text.body:
<1.1> paraṃbrahmāṃḍaparaṃbrahma śriyaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim | sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ vande devaṃ sarvāvatāriṇam || 1 || śrīśca lakṣmīśca yatpatnyau viprāgnī yanmukhaṃ matam | santo yaddhṛdayaṃ śaśvat tasmai cānvayine namaḥ || 2 || diviṣadbarhiṣat triṣat pitṛsadbhūtasacca yaḥ | dhyānalabhyasvarūpāya tasmai śaṃvarṣiṃṇe namaḥ || 3 || himavacchikhare ramye svāśrame parvatottame | nārāyaṇena vai lakṣmyai yā proktā nijasaṃhitā || 4 || badrikāśramatīrthe tāṃ tato labdhvādirūpadhṛk | śvetavyāso divyadṛṣṭiścatuḥśiṣyānuvāca ha || 5 || śvaitiṃ ca suśikhaṃ cāpi śvetāśvaṃ śvetalohitam | catvāraste mahātmāno brahmiṣṭhā brahmapāragāḥ || 6 || bhūtvā dhāma hareḥ prāpuḥ punarāvṛttivarjitam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnyastu tāḥ kathāḥ || 7 || patiṃ nārāyaṇaṃ premṇā papracchurlomaśāśrame | saurāṣṭre kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre’śvapaṭṭasārase || 8 || nārāyaṇaśca tābhyo vai jagādemāṃ hi saṃhitām | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākhyāṃ sarvārthasaṃbhṛtām || 9 || pañcaviṃśatisāhasrādhikalakṣaṃ hi vartate | ślokānāṃ yatra saṃkhyānaṃ mokṣadaṃ pāṭhamātrataḥ || 1.1.10 || ekadā nāradaḥ prāyāt kartuṃ vaikuṇṭhidarśanam | sabhā tena samāsīnā dṛṣṭā śrīviṣṇvadhiṣṭhitā || 1 1|| divyā muktāstvakṣarākhyā golokasthāstathāpare | vaikuṇṭhavāsino muktāḥ śvetadvīpanivāsinaḥ || 1 2|| avyākṛtāmṛtavāsāḥ śrīlakṣmīdhāmavāsinaḥ | badrīkṣīrābdhimāścāpi tadanyaddhāmavartinaḥ || 13|| ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devāḥ siddhā gāndharvacāraṇāḥ | lokapālāśca manavastāpasāḥ sādhavaśca ye || 14|| munayo divyagatayo divyāhatasuvigrahāḥ | āsan sarve tatra yoge nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ || 15|| lakṣayojanavistīrṇāprāntasaṃkulitā sabhā | nāradena tu saṃdṛṣṭā hyardhā puṃbhiḥ prakāśitā || 16|| vāmabhāge yatra lakṣmīstatra devyastu saṃsthitāḥ | muktānyo vāsudevānyo gopyaḥ sakhyastathā parāḥ || 17|| īśvariṇyo bhagavatyaḥ pārṣadāṇyaśca sevikāḥ | brahmāṇyo mātaro devyo mānavyaḥ siddhavigrahāḥ || 18|| nāradena sabhā dṛṣṭā hyardhā nārīprakāśitā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ hariṃ viṣṇuṃ sanātanam || 19 || śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ mahāmāyāṃ nāradaḥ prāṇaman mudā | sarvāṃ sabhāṃ praṇamyātha viṣṇudatte suviṣṭare || 1.1.20 || nyaṣīdannāraṭastatra taiḥ sarveḥ satkṛtaḥ ṛṣiḥ | vyāso’haṃ śvetasaṃjño vai sūtaḥ suśikhanāmakaḥ || 21 || vyākhyātārastathā cānye bṛhaspatipurogamāḥ | divyarūpāstu te sarvai nārāyaṇasamīhayā || 22|| kathāstu vividhāstatra cakrurbhaktivivardhanāḥ | tatra nārāyaṇenoktaṃ nārado’yaṃ mahāmuniḥ ||2 3 || bahuśruto bahujñātā samākhyānanidhirmahān | lokavṛttāntakuśalaḥ praṣṭavyo vṛttavittaye || 24|| lakṣmīruvāca bho tapasvin mahāyogin viṣṇoraṃśa mahāmune | kutastādāgamyate kiṃ vartate viṣṇusṛṣṭiṣu || 25 || kathaṃvratā janā bhūmau samayaścāpi kīdṛśaḥ | tīrthānāṃ susatāṃ pṛthvyāṃ bhūsurāṇāṃ gavāṃ tathā || 26 || dīnānāṃ sukṛtasyāpi sādhvīnāṃ nyāsināṃ sthitiḥ | kīdṛśī sāmprataṃ cāsti mokṣādhvā kaccidakṣataḥ ||27|| jñānaṃ vijñānasahakṛt kaccidvipreṣu rājate | nārāyaṇasya sadbhaktirlokaṣu vartate nviti || 28 || śrīnārada uvāca pitarau sarvadā vande kṛpālū muktidāyakau | svalpaṃ nāviditaṃ cāpi pitroḥ sarvajñayoḥ kila || 29 || tathāpi śiṣyadharmatvāt kathayāmi yathākramam | paryaṭan subahūn lokān dṛṣṭvā kṛtayugasthitim ||1.1.3 0 || vilokya viṣṇusṛṣṭau vai viṣṇubhaktiyutān janān | hṛṣyāmi ca muhurmātaḥ pātivratyaparāḥ prajāḥ || 31 || dhanyo’yaṃ bhagavān vipṇurdhanyā mā parameśvarī | yatpratāpād dhruvā muktirlabhyate mānavaiḥ kila || 3 2|| śravaṇātkīrtanādviṣṇoḥ smaraṇātpādasevanāt | arcanādvandanāt sakhyāddāsyādvātmānivedanāt || 33 || jñānājñānakṛtādvāpi saṃsāramalavarjanāt | sadyaḥ saṃprāpyate mokṣastasmādbhāgyaṃ nu kiṃ param || 34|| sakṛjjapanti ye jāpyaṃ gṛṇanti nāma vā hareḥ | divyabhāvanayā mātarmuktiṃ yānti tu te dhruvām || 35|| sāmānyāmathavā mukhyāṃ viṣṇordīkṣāṃ hi ye janāḥ | gṛhṇantyābālavṛddhādyāste syurvaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ || 36 || ānukūlyaṃ sadā viṣṇoḥ prātikūlyavivarjanam | viṣṇau pūrṇo hi viśvāsastavāsmītivareṣaṇā || 37|| dehendriyamanaḥ prāṇābhimatidhīṣaṇātmanām | nyāso viṣṇau tathā dīnādhīnatā ca hareḥ sadā || 38 || sarvasvaṃ me hariḥ sākṣānnānyaśceti matiḥ sthirā | ityevaṃ ṣaḍvidhā viṣṇau prapantiḥ śaraṇāgatiḥ || 39 || tadekaṃ vā samāsādya nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ | bhāvaikyaṃ vā kriyaikyaṃ vā hyātmaikyaṃ vā prasādhayet ||1.1.40 || tathā tu śrīhareraikyaṃ yathā yāvatprajāyate | tāvattathā svayaṃ nārāyaṇānandaṃ samaśnute || 41 || prematattvaṃ dravarūpaṃ cātmāpi dravatāṃ bhajet | dravadvayaṃ samāsādya svayaṃ viṣṇurdravo bhavet ||42 || ānandaghanacidghanavijñānaghanamiṣṭatāḥ | nityatṛptanityaśaityanityasukhasupuṣṭatāḥ || 43 || nārāyaṇaikyamāpannaḥ sarvān kāmān samaśnute | kvacitpārśve kvacinmūrtau kvacittasmin pralīyate ||44 || kvacinmuktaḥ kvacillakṣmīḥ kvaciddāsaḥ pravartate | śarīravaccendriyavanmanovattasya jāyate ||45|| ahaṃ tu nārado mātarviṣṇormana itīritaḥ | tvaṃ tu lakṣmīstasya cārdhaṃ śarīrātmeti kathyase ||46 || sanpadārthaṃ hariḥ sākṣāccidardhastvaṃ nu sammatā | tayordrave mahānandaḥ saccidānanda ucyate || 47|| yena kenāpi bhāvena tvātmā vai dravatāṃ vrajet | tadbhāvadravamāsādya muktiṃ viṣṇumayī vrajet |||48 || śrīśvetavyāsa uvāca ityuktvā dravarūpeṇa nārado līnatāṃ gataḥ viṣṇau premaparākāṣṭhāsukhānubhavavāridhau ||49 || paśyatāṃ tu sabhāsthānāṃ sarveṣāmidamadbhutam | camatkṛtikaraṃ jātam aho bhaktasya bhaktatā ||1.1.5 0|| lakṣmīrjijñāsamānā vai nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā | papraccha paramātmānaṃ lokopakārasattaye ||5 1 || śrīlakṣmīruvāca aho bhaktāstu bahavā dṛṣṭāste paramātmanaḥ | na kaścidīdṛśo dṛṣṭo yo’yaṃ tvayi gato dravam |||52|| manye tu kāraṇaṃ tatra karuṇā śrīmatastava | yasyopari bhaved deva niḥsīmānugrahastava ||53 || tasyaiva nātha no bhinno bhavasīti matirmama | etādṛśātmalābhārthe yathā yad bhavato matam ||54|| yadvānugrahalabdhyarthaṃ kiṃ kartavyaṃ tvayeṣyate | śrīśvetavyāsa uvāca nārāyaṇastu tacchrutvā sarveṣāṃ hitakāmyayā ||55|| uvāca paramaprītyā svalpamapyatulārthabhṛt | yena sādhāraṇā jīvā api yāntīdṛśīṃ gatim ||56|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vaikuṇṭhe lakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasabhāyāṃ nāradīyadravībhāvabhakticamatkṛtinirūpaṇātmakaḥ prathamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||
<1.2> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi bhaktasya dravalabdhaye | yathā me’nugrahaḥ prāpyastadvidhāraya tattvataḥ || 1 || mukta sṛṣṭāvīśasṛṣṭau jīvasṛṣṭāvapi prabhuḥ | asṛjatsākṛtīnsarvān śarīriṇa iti sthitiḥ || 2 || ātmā tvindra itiproktaḥ sarvaśaktiguṇāśrayaḥ | manaścittamahaṃbuddhistasya karaṇamāntaram || 3 || indrasya śaktayaścaitāścatasraḥ samudāhṛtāḥ | śrotratvaṅnetrarasanāghrāṇavākpādapāṇayaḥ || 4 || pāyūpasthe cendriyāṇi bahiḥkaraṇakāni hi | daśāpi śaktayaścaitā indrasyaiva bhavanti vai || 5 || grāhyeṣu tāstu gacchanti padārtheṣu bahirbahiḥ | grāhyākāreṇa tā bhūtvā grāhyākāraṃ bhajanti ca || 6 || parāvṛtya tu tāḥ sarvā dhāryākāraṃ bhajanti ca | vidhvāntaḥkaraṇānyetā ātmānaṃ yānti vai yadā || 7 || bhogyākāraṃ gatāstāśca tā indrānubhavaṃ gatāḥ | aparokṣānubhāvo’yaṃ svātmanyeva bhavatyatha || 8 || ahamindre sthitaḥ sākṣātsarvaśaktiprapūrakaḥ | indro madyogataḥ pūrṇaśaktyāśraya itisthitiḥ || 9 || āgrāhyāttu madantaṃ vai prematattvaṃ dravo mataḥ | sarvatra nihitaṃ tadvai tena snihyanti mūrtayaḥ || 1.2.10 || snehapūrṇānandapūrṇapremapūrṇaḥ sukhāśrayaḥ | dravapūrṇo hyahaṃ viṣṇurmadyogāddravavān hi saḥ || 11 || sarvaṃ sthūlaṃ tathā sūkṣmaṃ cetanaṃ cānyadeva vā | maddravāddravitaṃ sarvaṃ me’nugraho’tra kāraṇam || 1 2|| ayaṃ tu dravito bhūyāditime’nukṛpā bhavet | tadā dravati tatkālaṃ nānyathā tu kadācana || 13 || matkṛpāyāḥ sādhanaṃ tu sarvasvātmārpaṇaṃ matam | sarvadāhaṃ kṛpāpūrṇaḥ kṛpāluḥ karuṇodadhiḥ || 14|| bhaktollāsātkṛpāvṛṣṭiṃ karomi kṛpayānvitaḥ | yathā yathā kṛpāyā me pravāho viśati dhruve || 15|| bhakte tathā tathā tattvaṃ dravatāṃ yātyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ | eka evādvitīyo’haṃ sthito’smyakṣaradhāmani || 1 6|| manmūrtau tatra me muktā brahma cākṣaramityapi | dravanti premabāhulyānme’nugrahabalādapi || 17|| tadā samrāḍvirāje’haṃ na kiñcidvyatiricyate | muktiṃ seyaṃ tadaikyātmāpyate tatsthitivedibhiḥ || 18|| sa ekākī na ramate cecchaddvitīyamātmanaḥ | brahma taccākṣaraṃ tasmātprādurbhūtaṃ mahātmanaḥ || 1 9|| dvedhābhūttannirākāraṃ sākāraṃ ceśavāñcchayā | nirākāraṃ paraṃ dhāma yasmād dhāmāni jajñire || 1.2.20 || sākāraṃ svasamākāraṃ mūrtaṃ mūrtyanurūpakam | sa haristu punaraicchannaikarūpatvamātmanaḥ || 21 || muktā anādinastasmātprādurbhūtā anantaśaḥ | tatrāsam̐stanmaṇḍalāni tripāde divi cāmṛte|| 22|| muktā brahma parabrahma brahmasṛṣṭistrikaṃ matam | rūpānurūpāvayavā divyāḥ sarve sarūpiṇaḥ || 23 || ātmarūpāṇīndriyāṇi tattvābhinnāni santi vai | upacārāttu nāmāni rasaśaktyātmakāni hi || 24|| manaḥ śrotraṃ ca vāk cakṣustvag rasādīni tāni vai | pūrṇe cinhe’pi guptā na tadratirvāsanā na ca || 25|| amātṛjaṃ yatastatra kośaṣaṭkaṃ na vidyate | prāṇastatrātmanaḥ śaktiḥ kāśo’nāvaraṇātmatā || 26|| suhiraṇyakeśanakhadantā naiva viyoginaḥ | saccidrūpaikamānāste svātmakāḥ pravibhānti hi || 27|| divyāḥ sarve prakāśāste rājante divyadhāmani | ityayaṃ brahmalokastu aupaniṣad ucyate || 28 || brāhmī muktistanurbrāhmī brahmānandānubhogyatā | so’śnute sarvakāmām̐stu saha śrīhariṇā sadā || 29|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne akṣaradhāmni parabrahmabrahmamuktādīnāṃ dravamuktyāpi sākāratādarśakodvitīyo’dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||
<1.3> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca athākṣarasvarūpasya harervāmāṅgasaṃsthiteḥ | vāmārūpeṇa sevecchā saphalāṃ kartumicchatā || 1 || nārāyaṇeva vāmāṃgātsvātmaśaktimayaṃ śubham | sarvamāṃgalyasaubhāgyapremasnehadravāśrayam || 2 || rūpānurūpaṃ svādhānaṃ svakṣetraṃ svāśrayaṃ svakam | svaguṇaiśvaryasāmarthyarajobalaguhāśrayam || 3 || mūrtaṃ lakṣmyātmakaṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtaṃ ratiguṇāśrayam | amogharatisāphalyaṃ lakṣmyā icchan kṛpānidhiḥ || 4 || amoghavīryavadrūpaṃ vāsudevākhyamādadhat | so’yaṃ nārāyaṇo vāsudevaḥ śrīharirīritaḥ || 9 || dvedhābhavat sa lakṣmīnārāyaṇetisamāhvayaḥ | lakṣmīrdṛṣṭvā brahmaloke sarvānmuktām̐stu pūruṣān || 6 || svāṃ tvekāṃ svasamākārāṃ nānyāṃ tatra vyalokayat | tadā tvaprārthayad devaṃ svapatiṃ śrīhariṃ mudā || 7 || patipatnīkṛte sthānaṃ yogyaṃ prakalpaya prabho | tasyā bhāvaṃ samājñāya priyāyāḥ śubhavāṃcchayā || 8 || vaikuṇṭhākhyaṃ dhāma divyaṃ brahmalokaṃ hyakalpayat | sevārthaṃ dāsadāsīśca tatrāpyavāsayatprabhuḥ || 9 || tadarthaṃ divyabhogām̐śca divyopakaraṇānyapi | divyāṃ tadīśvarīṃ sṛṣṭiṃ pūrṇāṃ pūrṇamanorathām || 1.3.10 || sarvasādhanasampannāṃ smṛddhisaukhyasamanvitām | cakāra śrīhariḥ sākṣānmene tadīyapūrṇatām || 11 || so’haṃ sā tvamayaṃ lokau vaikuṇṭhaścāvayoriti | dṛṣṭvā cainaṃ mahāyogaṃ patipatnīmayaṃ navam || triguṇājā hareḥ śaktirnityā yā tattvasūtikā || 12 || anādinidhanā māyā cakame śrīhariṃ patim | yathā tattvātmikā sṛṣṭirjāyate yatra līyate || 13 || sā vai lakṣmīsamaṃ rūpaṃ dhartumiṣṭaṃ tadārthayat | prabhuṃ sarveśvaraṃ nāthaṃ śrīhariṃ tu tadā punaḥ || 14|| prabhuṇā tu samājñaptā rūpaṃ mohakaraṃ navam | rādhārūpaṃ hi subhagaṃ hyasaṃkhyaratibhājanam || 15 || dadhārābhinnapatnītve sthitā cāpi tadicchayā | śrīharistu tadarthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇarūpo babhūva ha || 1 6|| sarvakāmāśrayaḥ sarvarasavarṣī pumānparaḥ | amoghāmeyavīryaśrīsaundaryabalakāntimān || 17|| rādhāramaṇayogyārthayuvamūrtidharaḥ prabhuḥ | rādhā vilokya subhagaṃ svānuyogyaṃ varaṃ patim || 18 || svāvāsamārthayad divyaṃ svatantraṃ tatra dhāmani | madvihārakṛtodyānaṃ madratyarthamahāśrayam || 19 || madvibhūtiparākāṣṭhaṃ matsāmagrīsamāhitam | saccidānandarūpāṇi sarvopaskaraṇāni ca || 1.3.20 || śrīkṛṣṇasya kṛte tatra sarvāṇi saṃbhavantviti | rādhābhilāṣayā sarvaṃ jātaṃ dāsyaśca koṭiśaḥ || 21 || susmṛddhaṃ tatparaṃ divyaṃ dhāma golokamakṣaram | prasīmnā lokyate yattad brahmaloke samāyatam ||22 || cāru golokasaddhāma rādhākṛṣṇo hyakalpayat | śrīhariṇā samājñaptaṃ rādhākṛṣṇasabhājitam || 23 || śāśvataṃ brahmaloke taddhāma golokamāhitam | tatra rādhākṛtāṃ sevāṃ gṛhṇāti kṛṣṇarūpadhṛk || 24 || brahmaloke ca goloke vaikuṇṭhe bhogyasañcayāḥ | samānāḥ śrīhareḥ santi bhaktānandakarāḥ sadā || 25|| yathāliṃgaṃ yathārūpaṃ yathāyogaṃ yathārhaṇam | yathājoṣaṃ yathāpekṣaṃ hareḥ kāmādbhavanti tai || 26 || divyaṃ ratisukhaṃ nitya divyānandastadātmanām | divya prema hareryogānnityaṃ tatrābhijāyate || 27|| svapriyāsu sadā nātho vaikuṇṭhe ramate yathā | goloke’pi tathā bhartā preyasīṣu pramodate || 28 || akṣare tu pare dhāmni mukteṣu ramate hariḥ | muktān bhaktān sakhīn dāsīḥ svayaṃ krīḍayati prabhuḥ || 29 || ekaṃ vā yugalaṃ rūpaṃ yathā māṃ samupāsate | tathā te māṃ prapadyante svāminaṃ sukhadaṃ patim || 1.3.30 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne lakṣmīrādhākṛte vaikuṇṭhagolokadhāmadvayaklṛptinirūpaṇanāmā tṛtīyo’dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||
<1.4> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca sa aikṣata prajāyeya paramātmā svayaṃ hariḥ | mahākālaṃ svakāṃ śaktiṃ sasarja vibhurātmanaḥ || 1 || sarveṣāmantakartāraṃ māyākṣobhakaraṃ param | ājñāṃ cakre haristasmai māyāṃ saṃkṣobhayeti hi || 2 || māyāṃ tatkṣobhitāṃ dṛṣṭvā pumānmuktastu vai hareḥ | ājñākaro’paraḥ kaścinmāyayā yuyuje tadā || 3 || sā māyā prakṛtirmūlā pumām̐stu puruṣaḥ patiḥ | iti prakṛtipuruṣau sargaṃ sasarjatuḥ svakam || 4 || tābhyāṃ pradhānapuruṣā jajñire koṭiśaḥ khalu | pradhānaṃ tu mahattattvaṃ triguṇaṃ kṣetramucyate || 5 || pūruṣastatpatiḥ prokto yugalāni bhavanti vai | pūruṣā īśvarāḥ sarve līnā ye prakṛtau tu prāk || 6 || prādurbhūtāśca te sarve jāyāpatisarūpiṇaḥ | pradhānapuruṣābhyāṃ tu mahāviṣṇuḥ prajāyata || 7 || ahaṃkāraḥ sa vai proktaḥ svarṇapūruṣa ityapi | pradhānāyāḥ suputrī sā tvahaṃkṛtiriti smṛtā || 8 || hiraṇyā sā mahālakṣmīrmahāviṣṇoḥ sahāyinī | mahālakṣmīrmahāviṣṇuryugalaṃ tatprakīrtitam || 9 || mahāviṣṇormahālakṣmyāṃ yo garbhaḥ samajāyata | hiraṇyagarbha ityuktastaccāṇḍaṃ samajāyata || 1.4.1 0|| hiraṇyāṇḍaṃ dvidhā bhinnaṃ tato jajñe virāḍayam | vairājyapi pramadā ca virāṭpatnī tu sā matā || 1 1|| ahaṃkṛtermahāviṣṇostattvāni ṣoḍaśo’bhavan | sāttvikāttu samanaskānīndriyāṇi daśābhavan || 12|| tāmasāttanmātravargo taddevā rājasāttathā | śrotratvaṅnetrarasanā vākpāṇipādapāyavaḥ || 12|| upasthaṃ cetīndriyāṇi manaḥ karaṇamāntaram | pañcajñānendriyaṃ bodhyaṃ pañca karmendriyaṃ matam || 14|| śrotrādīnāṃ tu pañcānāṃ jñānotpādanaśaktitaḥ | vāgādīnāṃ tu pañcānāṃ karmotpādanaśaktitaḥ || 15|| jñānakarmendriyākhyā vai manaḥ syādubhayātmakam | digvātārkapraceto’śvivahnīndropendramitrakāḥ || 16|| candraśceti matā devā īśasṛṣṭimayā ime | īśvarāṇāṃ śarīreṣu golakeṣu vasanti te || 17|| manaścaikaṃ caturdhā tu jāyate vṛttibhedataḥ | mano’haṃcittabuddhyākhyaṃ procyate tattvavedibhiḥ || 18|| tāni virāṭsvarūpeṇa saṃhatānīśavāñcchayā | tathāpi prāṇaśūnyaṃ tannodatiṣṭhad yadā virāṭ || 19|| śrīhariḥ prāṇarūpo vai bhūtvā tatra viveśa ha | prāṇaśaktirjīvanākhyā yena nyastāntare tataḥ || prāṇātmanaścetanasya śrīharestatsamanvayāt |||1.4.20|| vairājaṃ rūpamityarthe kārye’nvarthaṃ babhūva ha | tasya nābhimahānālapadmādbrahma vyajāyata ||21 | rājasaḥ sarjakaḥ so’tha rudrastadbhālato’bhavat | tāmasaḥ sa tu saṃhartā hṛdo viṣṇurbabhūva ha ||22| sāttvikaḥ poṣakaḥ proktaste svaśaktisamanvitāḥ | brahmaṇastu śarīrasthā brāhmī proktā tadaṃganā ||23 sṛṣṭiriti samākhyātā brahmaṇo’rdhāṃganā hi sā | rudraśaktistu rudrāṇī śivā harāṃganā satī || 24|| vaiṣṇavī viṣṇuśaktiryā sāpi lakṣmīriti smṛtā | teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ tisrastāḥ sṛṣṭivinaṣṭipuṣṭidāḥ || 25|| patnyastadātmikāstattatkāryasāhāyyadā matāḥ | pagbrahmājñayā sṛṣṭipravāhaṃ vāhayanti te ||26|| āmūlapuruṣātsarve keśāntā īśvarāḥ smṛtāḥ | śuddhasattvaśarīrāste sattvaṃ bhūtistu sā hareḥ || 27|| tasmānīśāstu te sarve parabrahmavibhūtayaḥ | tatreśvareṣu sarveṣu praviṣṭau dīvyati prabhuḥ || 28 || teṣāṃ tūpāsyamūrtidhṛk śrīhariḥ saṃbabhūva ha | vāsudevaḥ sa vai proktaḥ īśvarāṇāṃ niyāmakaḥ || 29|| īśvarāṇāṃ mahārāja īśvareḍyapadāmbujaḥ | svaśaktyā vāsudevyā sa sahito bhagavānayam || 1.4.30 || dhāmnyakṣare svavāsāya śvetaṃ nirmāya dhāma tat | śvete divye svake dhāmni nivāsamakarotprabhuḥ || 31 || amṛtākhye pare dhāmni vāsudevaḥ sa eva hi | vāsudevaḥ svayaṃ svasyeśvarasṛṣṭikṛte punaḥ || janmapuṣṭilayārthaṃ svaṃ rūpatrayamadhārayat || 32|| īśasṛṣṭisamunnetā hyaniruddho vyajāyata | īśasṛṣṭestu sampoṣṭā pradyumnaḥ samajāyata || 33 || īśasṛṣṭerviloptā sa saṃkarṣaṇo’nujāyata | tisrastu mūrtayaḥ sākṣādvāsudevasya santi hi || 34|| śrīhariṇā svayaṃ prohya dhṛtaṃ rūpacatuṣṭayam | vyūhacatuṣṭayaṃ tasmātprocyate śāstravedibhiḥ || 35 || vyūhādhīnāstatra kecidīśāścaturmukhāḥ pare | aṣṭamukhāstathā cānye ṣoḍaśāsyāḥ śatānanāḥ || 36|| sahasrāsyā ayutāsyā niyutāsyāstathā pare | arbudāsyāḥ koṭimukhāstāvaccaraṇapāṇayaḥ || 37|| viṣṇostatrāṇḍagolāstu canurdaśasamīritāḥ | sadāśivasya rudrasya tvaṣṭāviṃśatigolakāḥ || 38 || aṇḍāḥ pradhānamāyāyāḥ ṣaṭpañcāśatsamīritāḥ | mahāviṣṇoḥ śate dve ca tathā dvādaśa golakāḥ ||39 || prakṛtipuruṣāṇḍāni santi pañcaśatāni vai | mahākālasya lokāstu sahasraṃ parikīrtitāḥ ||1.4.40 || vāsudevasya kṛṣṇasya nārāyaṇasya bhūmayaḥ | divyānantā asaṃkhyātāḥ santi vācāmagocarāḥ ||41 || īśvarāṇāntu sarveṣāṃ manobuddhīndriyādayaḥ | ātmabhūtāḥ śaktayaḥ svāḥ śuddhasattvānvitā matāḥ ||42|| bhogyabhogopakaraṇabhogasādhanabhūmayaḥ | śuddhasattvātmikāḥ santi paramānandamiśritāḥ ||43|| paramātmā haristatra prāvirbhavatyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ | yathākāryaṃ yathā tattadīśaprārthanabhāvanam ||44|| īśvarāṇāṃ tu kāryāṇi nirvartya śrīharistataḥ | tattadīśāyuṣā sthitvā tirobhāvamupaiti hi ||45|| tattatsvarūpasadbhaktyā te’pi yānti parāṃ gatim | pūrṇamaiśvaryamābhuktvā te gacchantyapunarbhavam ||46|| tadā muktastu te sarve śrīhariṃ samupāsate | īśvarāṇāmapi muktirevaṃ bhavati śāśvatī ||47|| svāmī nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmām̐steṣāṃ muktikaraḥ prabhuḥ | niyāmakaḥ parabrahmānvito’pi vyatirekavān ||48|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vāsudevādibrahmānteśvarāṇāṃ sṛṣṭikathananāmā caturtho’dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
<1.5> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca vāsudevaḥ samutpannaḥ svaprayojanamārthayat | kiṃ mamātra vidheyaṃ syāt kathamīdṛksvarūpavān || 1 || iti sañcintya sasmāra paramaṃ mūlarūpiṇam | śrīharistu tadā tasmai rūpatrayamadarśayat || 2 || vāsudevāt samutpannā vāsudeve’pyayaṃ gatāḥ | aniruddhaśca pradyumnastathā saṃkarṣaṇo’paraḥ || 3 || vāsudevo harāvāste vāsudeve tvime trayaḥ | dṛṣṭvā jñātvā punastāvadvicāraṃ kṛtavān hi saḥ || 4 || kiṃ mamaibhistribhī rūpairanuṣṭheyaṃ bhavediti | śrīhariṇā tatastasmai īśasṛṣṭestu netṛtā || 5 || darśitā bhūsthairyabhaṃgamayī sā tryadhinīkṛtā | sṛṣṭistu kīdṛśī kāryā kīdṛśo lokavistaraḥ || 6 || iti sañcintane tasmai vāsudevāya vai hariḥ | svamūrtau tatkṛtīḥ sarvāḥ kalāḥ sarvā adarśayat || 7 || anantāyāmamāyāyāmagādhāyāṃ harestanau | svasvadhāmānyapaśyam̐śca sarve svasvavibhūtibhiḥ || 8 || mahākālaṃ ca prakṛtipūruṣaṃ bhūmapūruṣam | pradhānapuruṣaṃ cāpi mahāpūruṣamityapi || 9 || mahāviṣṇuṃ tathā tadvad vairājapuruṣaṃ hyapi | tathā hiraṇyagarbhaṃ ca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān || 1.5.1 0|| golokaṃ cāmṛtaṃ vaikuṇṭhakaṃ śvetaṃ ca dhāma yat | avyākṛtaṃ tathā dhāma śriyā viṣṇośca dhāma yat || 11 || sadāśivakṛtaṃ dhāma mahāmāyāpramaṇḍalam | caturviṃśatitattvānāṃ dhāmāni vividhāni ca || 12|| sanniveśo yathā yasya yathāśaktibalodayāḥ | yathā vyavasthayā yatra yādṛśī divyatā parā || 1 3|| yādṛśāni samāścaryaprakārāṇi bhavanti ca | aiśvaryāṇi camatkārā brahmarasasarāṃsi ca || 14|| iṣṭamiṣṭalatā sampat sviṣṭamiṣṭavibhūtayaḥ | brahmarasapravāhārthā atyāścaryāṇi yāni vai || 15|| rūpānurūpaghaṭanāḥ kalpānukalpavallayaḥ | modapramodataravo nandānunandabhūmayaḥ || 16|| tṛptyanutṛptapānāsvādanasaugandhikārcanam | śaityānuśaityanivahā hrādānuhrādarañjanam || 17|| ye ca yāni yatra yatra citrāścaryāṇi tāni vai | darśayāmāsa bhagavān śrīhariḥ svatanau tadā || 18|| vāsudevastu bhagavānīśalokānusaṃkṛtīḥ | dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā tu tatpāraṃ nāyān neti jagau tadā || 19|| svavibhūteḥ svayamantaṃ neyāya vāsudevarāṭ | jagād haraye tāvadananto’si niyāmakaḥ ||1.5.20|| śaśaṃsa bahudhā rūpaṃ vavre jñānaṃ ca naityakam | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha vaheśasṛṣṭibhāvanam ||21|| prāvirbhāvaya puṃsastrīn īśabhāravahān svakān| ityājñāṃ samabhigṛhya vāsudevena cātmataḥ ||22|| aniruddhaśca pradyumnaḥ saṃkarṣaṇa iti trayaḥ | īśvarāṇāntu sarvoṣāṃ sṛjipuṣṭivirāmakāḥ ||23|| samāvirbhāvitāḥ svasmād rājādhirājarājakāḥ | teṣāmaṃśāstrayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ||24|| vairājadehotpannānāṃ brahmāṇḍānāṃ niyāmakāḥ | avarāṇḍapraṇetāro jīvasṛṣṭipraśāsakāḥ ||25|| aniruddhādayastasmādīśatuṣṭipraśāsakāḥ | parasṛṣṭipraṇetāraḥ paramātmasvarūpakāḥ ||26|| ityevaṃ sṛṣṭivaicitryamīśvarāṇāmanusmṛtam | tattadīśvarabhāvatvaṃ parabrahmānvayānmatam ||27|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vāsudevasyeśasṛṣṭipradarśananāmā pañcamo’dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||
<1.6> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca vairājasya nābhideśāt kamalaṃ yadajāyata | tatra caturmukho brahmā samajāyata prāg yathā || 1 || tatastannābhideśādvai dvitīyaṃ padmamutthitam | tatra brahmā dvitīyo’bhūdaṣṭānana iti śrutaḥ || 2 || tatastṛtīyapadme tu brahmā ṣoḍaśamastakaḥ | caturthe kamale brahmā dvātriṃśanmastako hyabhūt || 3 || pañcame kamale brahmā pañcāśanmukhavānabhūt | ṣaṣṭhe jāte tu kamale brahmā śatamukho hyabhūt || 4 || tatastu saptame padme brahmā pañcaśatānanaḥ || aṣṭame paṃkaje vedhāḥ sahasrānana ityabhūt || 5 || brahmā pañcasahasrāsyo jāto vai navame kaje | daśame hyabhavadbrahmā daśasāhasramastakaḥ || 6 || ekādaśe kaje pañcāśatsāhasrānano hyajaḥ | samudbhūtastathā tu dvādaśe lakṣamukho hyajaḥ || 7 || trayodaśe tu kamale dvilakṣamukhavānajaḥ | padme caturdaśe pañcāśallakṣamukhavānajaḥ || 8 || jātaḥ pañcadaśe padme koṭyāsyaśca prajāpatiḥ | ṣoḍaśe kamale brahmā jajñe hyarbudamastakaḥ || 9 || tataḥ saptadaśe padme viśvasṛḍabjamastakaḥ | aṣṭādaśe tathā padme brahmā kharvapramastakaḥ || 1.6.10 || ekonaviṃśake tatra padmāsyaḥ samabhūddhi saḥ | viṃśake kamale vedhāḥ parārdhamukhavānabhūt || 1 1|| ityevaṃ tatra tatraikakamale brahmakoṭayaḥ | samudbhūtāḥ sajātīyāḥ saṃkhyāsteṣāmanantakāḥ || 1 2|| tathaiva viṣṇurudrāṇāṃ koṭayaśca tathāvidhāḥ | tattatsthānātsamutpannāsteṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate || 13|| īśasṛṣṭau yathaiṣāṃ vai pāro nāsti tathā punaḥ | vairājānāṃ na cāstyantastatpitṝṇāṃ mahātmanām || 14|| mahāviṣṇuprabhṛtīnāmasaṃkhyānāṃ tu tatra vai | saṃkhyāpāramapārāṇāṃ kenāpyāptuṃ na śakyate || 15|| atha teṣāṃ caturāsyaprabhṛtivedhasāṃ kṛte | adhikāraḥ sunirṇītaścaturdaśastarātmake || 16|| aṣṭāsyānāṃ tu sattā syādaṣṭāviṃśatibhūstare | brahmāṇḍe’tha tathā bodhyā ṣoḍaśānanavedhasām || 17|| ṣaṭpañcāśadvivarātmabrahmāṇḍeṣvādhikāritā | dvātriṃśanmastakānāntu śatastarāṇḍanenṛtā || 18|| śatadvayaprabhūmidhṛgbrahmāṇḍeṣvadhikāritā | saṃsthāpitā virājeṇa pañcāśanmukhavedhasām || 19|| śatāsyabrahmaṇāṃ paṃcāśatastarāṇḍanetṛtā | pañcaśatamukhājasya sahasrabilake’ṇḍake ||1.6.20 || netṛtādhikṛtā cātha sahasrānanavedhasaḥ | dvisahasrastarāṇḍeṣu netṛtā vihitā tathā ||21 || pañcasahasramukhavadvedhaso netṛtā tathā | catuḥsahasrakakṣāṇḍe virājeṇa sthirīkṛtā ||22|| daśasahasramukhavadvedhaso’pyadhikāritā | daśasāhasrakakṣāṇḍe virājeṇa suniścitā ||23|| adhikāripadaṃ pañcāśatsāhasrānanasya tu | kṛtaṃ viṃśatisāhasravivarāṇḍeṣu tena vai ||24|| lakṣāsyasya catuścatvāriṃśadbilāṇḍakeṣu tat | dvilakṣamukhavān vedhā lakṣabhūmyaṇḍakāryakṛt |||25|| pañcāśallakṣamukhavān dvilakṣabilakāṇḍake | kṛto netātha koṭyāsyaḥ pañcalakṣastarāṇḍake ||26|| kṛto netārbudāsyastu daśalakṣastarāṇḍake | abjāsyo viṃśatilakṣabilāṇḍanetṛtāṃ gataḥ ||27|| kharvāsyastu kṛtaḥ pañcāśallakṣabilakāṇḍake | netātha padmasakhyāsyaḥ kṛtaḥ koṭistarātmake |||28|| parārdhamukhavān brahmā koṭidaśastarātmake | brahmāṇḍe sthāpitaścaite hyevamanye’pi cāhitāḥ ||29|| svasvakāryaṃ prakurvanti svādhikārānusārataḥ | athaikadā virājasya rājasūyamahotsave || 1.6.30 || virājasya gṛhe ceśāḥ samājagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ | naikabhujā viṣṇavo’pi rudrā vibhinnanetriṇaḥ || samājagmuśca vairājā tathānye’pīśvareśvarāḥ ||3 1 || tatrotsave samāje vai ko yāyādagrapūjyatām | itijāte vicāre tu mahān kolāhalo’bhavat || 32 kecidāhuḥ parārdhāsyo brahmāgrapūjyatāṃ labhet | anye’pyāhuḥ parārdhadṛk śaṃbhuragrārhaṇāṃ labhet ||33 || pare tvagrārhaṇāṃ viṣṇuḥ parārdhabhujavām̐llabhet | itivāde vivāde ca nirṇayaṃ naiva lebhire ||34|| tadā vicāritaṃ sarvairvāde jāte parasparam | vṛddhānāṃ vacanaṃ grāhyaṃ kārye vādādivibhrame || 5|| vṛddhastu prapitā teṣāṃ mahāviṣṇustu buddhimān | yaṃ vai nirṇayamāsthāya darśayet sa bhavenmataḥ ||36|| iti te samayaṃ kṛtvā mahāviṣṇoḥ samantike | natvā nivedayāmāsuḥ sarvaṃ vṛttāntamīśvarāḥ || 37|| mahāviṣṇuḥ kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā prāha pautrān vicāritam | bhavantastu trayastulyāḥ samānabalaśālinaḥ || 38 || samapūjyāḥ samaśreṣṭhāḥ samakāryavahāstathā | parasparaṃ na vai nyūnāḥ pūjanārhāstrayo’pi hi || 29 || tathāpi rājasūye tu pūjaikasya bhavediti | vicāryaiva bhavanto vai nirṇayaṃ yāntu ceśvarāḥ ||1.6.40 || ekasmai pūjyatā deyā dvābhyāṃ grāhyānuvṛttitā | ityājñāpya mahāviṣṇurmaunamāsthāya saṃsthitaḥ ||4 1 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bahuvidhabrahmādīnāmadhikārādivarṇananāmā ṣaṣṭho’dhyāyaḥ ||6 ||
<1.7> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca tatasteṣāṃ trayāṇāntu syāgrapūjyatvalabdhaye | durāgraheṇa mahatā jātaḥ kolāhalaḥ paraḥ || 1 || ahaṃ pūrvaṃ tu pūjyaḥ syāṃ na tvaṃ nānya itīśvarāḥ | svasya pūjyatvasaṃprāptyai kalahaṃ samacakrire || 2 || tiraskurvanti cānyonyamadhikṣepaṃ dadhatyapi | duruktairvākprabāṇaiśca vidhyanta iva marmasu || 3 || kalahaṃ cakrire yāvattāvatteṣāṃ matānugāḥ | koṭiśo viṣṇavo rudrā brahmāṇaḥ samudāyudhāḥ || 4 || yuyudhurbhṛśamatyugramardanaṃ tadabhūnmahat | yadaikasya prapūjyatve nirṇayo na kṛtaśca taiḥ || 5 || tadā vairājapuruṣairmahāviṣṇusamanvitaiḥ | īśo devo hariḥ sākṣānnirṇayāya samarthitaḥ || 6 || paraṃbrahma svayaṃ teṣāmarthanāmavagatya vai | nyāyālayaṃ paraṃ sthānamavyākṛtasudhāma yat || 7 || viracayyākṣare dhāmni nyāyakartāpi ca svayam | bhūmapūruṣarūpeṇa nyāyādhīśo virājitaḥ || 8 || nyāyasampādakāścānye īśvarāstena yojitāḥ | bhūmnā svasya vāmabhāgād bhūmnī lakṣmīḥ prasaṃkṛtā || 9 || sāpi nyāyaparādhīśā nyāyakartrī pareśvarī | avyākṛtaṃ ca taddhāma bhūmabhūmnyoḥ paraṃ kṛtam || 1.7.10 || nyāyakartryastathā nyāyādhīśāstatrāpyanekaśaḥ | upanirṇayadāḥ santi parāvaraniyāmakāḥ || 11 || santi prakṛtipuruṣapradhānapuruṣātmakaḥ | mahāviṣṇuvirājādīśvarāṇāṃ nirṇayapradāḥ || 12|| tatra tatra teṣu teṣu sthāneṣvīśvarakoṭayaḥ | nyūnātiriktasukhadaiśvaryavatyo bhavanti hi || 13 || parārdhabhujavān viṣṇuḥ pūjyo rājasusammataḥ | bhūmnā nyāyaḥ kṛtastadvad rājasūyo’pi nirvṛtaḥ || 14|| nyāyājñayā kṛtanyāyaprotasarveśasṛṣṭibhiḥ | phalantu nyāyakāryasya tatra tatra hyavāpyate || 15|| ekarājakṣaye’nyasya paṭṭābhiṣekasūtsavaḥ | kārye vinimaye prāpte netṝṇāṃ parivartanam || 16|| yuddhakāle vināśe vā cākasmika upadrave | vyūhāṃśavibhavāveśavibhūtīnāṃ prakāśane || 17|| brahmāṇḍeṣvavatārāṇāṃ preṣaṇe ca vikarṣaṇe | sarvathāpyadhikāro’sti bhūmno bhagavataḥ sadā || 18 || śrīharistu svayaṃ sākṣādbhūmūpūruṣarūpataḥ | avyākṛte svake dhāmni nyāyakāryārthamāsthitaḥ || 1 9|| brahmāṇḍe ca yadā yarhi yasmin yasmin sthale sthale | hānirdharmasya budhyeta tadāṃśaṃ prerayatyayam ||1.7.20|| rāmakṛṣṇādayaḥ sarve vibhinnā vai yuge yuge | avatārā anantā vai bhavantyaṇḍe pṛthakpṛthak ||21||| īśvarāṇāṃ ca lokeṣu hyavatārā anantakāḥ | bhavanti samaśīlāstatsamarūpāḥ samakriyāḥ ||22|| śrīhareravatārāṇāṃ nāntaḥ saṃkhyā na vidyate | kālānantyātsṛṣṭyapārātkāryānantyācca kṛtsnaśaḥ || 23 || atheśvarāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvadā sukhalabdhaye | śrīhariṇā hṛdi dhyātaṃ tapaścātha bṛhadvratam || 24|| sarveśvarāḥ sadā santu sukhinaḥ sattvasaṃbhṛtāḥ | prakṛtipūruṣaścātha pradhānapuruṣastathā ||25||| bhūmapūruṣalokasthā mahāviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | hiraṇyagarbhā vairājā aṣṭāvaraṇakeśvarāḥ ||26||| golokasthā vikuṇṭhasthāḥ śvetadvīpasthitāstathā | avyākṛtasthitā viṣṇurudramāyākṣarasthitāḥ ||27|| sarve bhavantu sukhinaḥ sadā mattapasā tviti | dayayā hariṇā caivaṃ kṛtaṃ dhāma tapaḥkṛte ||28|| akṣarākhyapradeśe taddivyaṃ badarikāśramam | tapastyāgamayaṃ ramyaṃ śāntyānandamayaṃ sadā ||29|| bṛhadvratadharaṃ rūpaṃ divyaṃ śrīhariṇā dhṛtam | sa vai nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī divyaṣoḍaśavārṣikaḥ ||1.7.3 0|| akṣareṇa tadā tasya sevārthaṃ rūpamarthitam | narākāraṃ ca tadrūpa dhṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśavārṣikam || 3 1|| sevakaḥ sa naraḥ svāmī nārāyaṇa iti hariḥ | naranārāyaṇaḥ so’yamakṣarādiparaḥ prabhuḥ ||32|| rājate tatra tejasvī brahmavarcasvavāridhiḥ | ūrdhvasrotā brahmacārī naranārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||33|| īśvarāstatra gacchanti darśanārthaṃ harermuhuḥ | muktāstatra hyasaṃkhyātā kāśyo naiṣṭhikāḥ sthitāḥ ||34|| te vai dayālavaḥ śāntāḥ sādhavo munayo matāḥ | īśānāntu gṛhasthānāmuddhārakaraṇāya vai ||35|| bhramantīśvaralokeṣu śaraṇāgatarakṣakāḥ | mantraṃ nārāyaṇasyaiva datvā mokṣaṃ nayantyapi ||36 || upāsanāṃ hareḥ sākṣātparabrahmaṇa ityapi | pravartayanti ceśeṣu mokṣayanti ca tām̐stataḥ ||37|| goloko’pyatha vaikuṇṭhaḥ śvetadvīpo’tha divyakaḥ | avyākṛtaśca badarikāśramaśceti nāmabhiḥ || 38|| kīrtyamānāni dhāmāni dīvyānyakṣaradhāmani | akṣarasya pradeśeṣu hariṇā racitāni hi || 39|| śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīrāmacandraḥ śrīnārāyaṇaṃ ityayam | śrībhūmā śrīnaranārāyaṇaḥ śrīharireva ca ||1.7.40 || svayaṃ brahmeśvaraḥ sākṣādakṣarādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ | brahmalokeśvarastāni rūpāṇi dhārayatyataḥ ||41|| puruṣottamasaṃjño yo bhagavānparameśvaraḥ | sarvatra saṃsthitaḥ so’yaṃ bhinnarūpeṇa rājate ||42|| dhāmnastvakṣarasaṃjñasya pradeśeṣu kṛtāni vai | dhāmānyanyāni tatteṣu sarvatrākṣaramasti hi ||43|| tasmād golokādimadhye dhāma vyāpakamakṣaram | paraṃdhāma brahmalokaḥ sarvatrāstīti varṇyate ||44|| īśvarāṇāṃ ca lokānāṃ sīmā prakṛtirucyate | sīmni dhāmāni caitāni brahmalagnāni santi hi ||45|| tasmādakṣarasaṃjñāste’kṣaravyāpyā bhavanti ca | prakṛteḥ sparśarahitāḥ prakṛterupari sthitāḥ ||46|| lokā mokṣabhūmayaste gadyante marmavedibhiḥ | itīśasṛṣṭisaṃsthānaṃ lakṣmi saṃjñeyamañjasā ||47|| tavaiva sarvasāmarthyaṃ tavaivaitatprabhāvajam | sarvamīśvarasaṃsthānaṃ tvāṃ vinā naiva śobhate ||48|| tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca sadā tatra sarvātmarūpadhārakau | tvāṃ vinā na mameśatvaṃ māṃ vinā na ratistvayi |||49|| saccitoḥ sarvathā tatra prānandaḥ sukhamucyate | sarve lokā īśvarāścāśnuvate sukhamāvayoḥ ||1.7.50 || tasmānnārāyaṇalakṣmyātmakamīśvaramaṇḍalam | prādurbhūtaṃ tadāvābhyāṃ tirobhavati cāvayoḥ ||51 || ātyantike laye līnaṃ prāraṃbhe punarutthitam | bhavatīti vicāryaiva bhajantīśāḥ sadā nu mām ||52|| madaiśvaryaṃ samāpannā īśvarā madadhiṣṭhitāḥ | madyogādīśvarā jātā madvinā neśvarā iti ||63|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’vyākṛtadhāmabadarikāśramadhāmapradarśananāmā saptamo’dhyāyaḥ ||7||
<1.8> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca namaḥ parasmai devāya bhūmne śaktitrayāya ca | sākṣiṇe dehināṃ madhye’nupalakṣyātmavartmane || 1 || namo bhūyaḥ satāṃ gottre’satāṃ nāśāptabhūtaye | namo nirastasāmyātiśayāya dhāmni raṃsyate || 2 || kuyogināṃ vidūrāya sannikṛṣṭāya te namaḥ | nārāyaṇaparā vedā nārāyaṇaparā makhāḥ || 3 || nārāyaṇaparaṃ jñānaṃ sṛjirnārāyaṇātmikā | nārāyaṇa idaṃ sarvaṃ nārāyaṇaparā gatiḥ || 4 || guṇatrayaṃ samāgṛhya nirguṇo’pi hariḥ svayam | vairājapuruṣo bhūtvā sasarjāpaḥ svadehataḥ || 5 || āpo nārā iti bodhyā āpastu naraputrikāḥ | kṛtvā tāsvayanaṃ śete tato nārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 6 || jale tatra śayānasyātītāḥ sahasravatsarāḥ | tadā tannābhito nālaṃ pādmaṃ prādurbabhūva ha || 7 || padmoparyabhavadbrahmā nārāyaṇasamīhayā | sa dadarśābhito vāri nānyatsa pramumoha ca || 8 || kathaṃ kasmātkutaścāhaṃ kiṃ karomyatra kevale | tasmānmūlaṃ madīyaṃ vai didṛkṣāmyanunālataḥ || 9 || niścityaivaṃ svayaṃ nāle brahmā saṃpraviveśa ha | caturyugasahasraṃ taccacālāntaṃ na cāptavāna || 10 || tadā viśramya tannāle nyavartata yadā tu saḥ | yogasiddhisahāyena vegādupari saṃsthitaḥ || 11 || kimarthaṃ vā kathaṃ cāhaṃ samutpanno jale kaje | vicārayati yāvatsa vāguvācāśarīriṇī || 1 2|| tapaḥ kuru sthitastatra kāle jñānaṃ bhaviṣyati | vetsyasi svajanerarthaṃ śrutvā tāṃ tapa āsthitaḥ || 13|| tato jñānaṃ hyabhūttasya sṛṣṭyarthaṃ me janistviyam | sṛṣṭistu kīdṛśī kāryā mayetyarthe mano dadhau || 14|| tāvannārāyaṇamūrtau sṛṣṭiṃ pūrvāṃ dadarśa ha | pūrvātpūrvatarāṃ cāpi dṛṣṭvā saṃmumude sa ca || 15|| tapomahimnā svaguruṃ hariṃ sa vai samādhimāpyānudadarśa kāraṇam | kṛtvā jale vai śayanaṃ mahāprabhuṃ samastasṛṣṭyanvitacitrarūpakam | 16| divyena cakṣuṣā tatra vairāje jaḍacetanam | bhāvi sṛṣṭyātmakaṃ sarvaṃ dṛṣṭavān nāmarūpakam || 17|| pādamūle’sya pātālaṃ pārṣṇibhāge rasātalam | dadarśa gulphayorasya lokaṃ brahmā mahātalam || 18|| talātalaṃ tathā lokaṃ jaṃghayoḥ sa dadarśa vai | jānvostu sutalaṃ lokamurvostu vitalātale || 19|| bhūtalaṃ sakthimūle’tha nābhau bhuvardivaṃ hṛdi | grīvāyāntu maharlokamāsye janaṃ dadarśa saḥ ||1.8. 20||| lalāṭe’sya tapolokaṃ satyaṃ śirṣṇi vyacaṣṭa saḥ | bāhvorindrādidevām̐śca karṇayordiśa eva ca ||21|| śrotre śabdaṃ ca nāsatyau nāsārandhre dadarśa saḥ | ghrāṇe gandhaṃ mukhe vahniṃ dyāṃ tu netradvayāṇḍayoḥ ||22|| cakṣuṣoḥ sūryacandrau tatpakṣmaṇordivasaṃ niśām | bhrūvilāse parameṣṭhipadaṃ tālau jalaṃ tathā ||23|| jihvāyāntu rasām̐stasya daṃṣṭrāyāṃ yamamityapi | medhāyāṃ cāsya chandāṃsi kaṭākṣe kālaviplavam ||24|| uttarauṣṭhe tathā vrīḍāmadharauṣṭhe tu gardhanam | stanayorubhayordharmaṃ pṛṣṭhe’dharmaṃ tu dṛṣṭavān |||25|| śiśne prajāpatiṃ mitrāvaruṇau tu tadaṇḍayoḥ | kukṣiṣvasya mamudrām̐śca girīnasthiṣu dṛṣṭavān |||26 || nadīrnāḍīsu vṛkṣām̐stu vyācaṣṭe sa hi romasu | śvāse vāyuṃ gatau kālaṃ meghānkeśeṣu tasya vai ||27|| sandhyāṃ vāsasi hṛdaye māyāṃ manasi candrakam | citte mahadahaṃkāre rudraṃ nakhe gajāśvakān || 28|| naipuṇye pakṣiṇaḥ sarvān buddhau svāyaṃbhuvaṃ manum | nitambayormṛgānsarvānsmṛtau gandharva gāyakān ||25|| vīrye tvāsurasainyāni mukhe’sya brāhmaṇām̐stathā | bhujayoḥ kṣatriyānūrvorvaiśyānaṃghrau tu śūdrakān |||1.8.3 0 || sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ yāvat sṛjya svenaṃ bhavettu yat | sarvaṃ vairājadehe’yaṃ brahmā samyak dadarśa ha ||3 1 || kāryaṃ yasya yathā yāvat karaṇaṃ yasya yad yathā | kāryayogasamākṛṣṭiśleṣāvirbhāvavaibhavam ||32|| hastāmalakavatsarvaṃ dṛṣṭavān sa prajāpatiḥ | tattvādhīnāṃ mano’dhīnāṃ dvedhā jñātvātha padmajaḥ ||33 || bījajāṃ mānasī ceti sṛṣṭiṃ pratiṃ mumoda ha | pūrvaṃ naṣṭāṃ smṛtiṃ labdhvā brahmā tuṣṭāva keśavam ||34|| namaḥ sṛṣṭisvarūpāya namo vairājamūrtaye | namo’vāntarasargāya namo brahmādirūpiṇe |||35|| namo hiraṇyagarbhāya mahāviṣṇutvarūpiṇe | namaḥ pradhānapataye prakṛtisvāmine namaḥ ||26|| namo bhūmne’niruddhāya pradyumnāya ca te namaḥ | namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇākhyāya vāsudevāya te namaḥ ||27|| namo mahāpūruṣāya mahākālāya te namaḥ | namo’kṣaranivāsāya muktāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ ||30|| vyāpakāya pareśāya naikarūpāya te namaḥ | sati tvayi viparyāso vivartaḥ pariṇāmakaḥ ||29|| jagato’sya bhavennūnaṃ tadabhinnāya te namaḥ | sākṣiṇe sarvanetrāya svarāje ca namo namaḥ ||1.8.40 || nānāścaryanivāsāya nānārūpadharāya ca | bhinnātmadarśine pūrvaṃ paścādekātmadarśine ||41|| anvitānanvitārthāya namaḥ sadasadātmane | paramāṇusvarūpāya vyāpakāya ca te namaḥ || 42|| tridhācchedavihīnāya srīpuṃrūpātmane namaḥ | namo jñānāya divyāya jñeyāya jñātṛrūpiṇe ||43 || namo mānasvarūpāya mānāya mitaye namaḥ pramātre ca namaste’stu satkāryāya ca te namaḥ |44|| phalavyāptisvarūpāya śrutivādāya te namaḥ | vaptivaśrāntisvarūpāya namo jñaptilayātmane ||47|| prakāśākāśatanave divyādivyaguṇātmane | sarve yasmādyatra sarva yaśca sarvātmakaḥ prabhuḥ ||46|| svapnāsvapnobhayārthāya śāstre te’stu namo namaḥ | tvayā kṛpālunā deva hṛtkapāṭa pravodhitam ||47|| yadartha tatkariṣye’haṃ tatra mā vismara prabho | tvatpradattaprabodhena kariṣye sargaghaṭṭanām ||48|| tatra me bandhanaṃ mā syātsāhāyyaṃ prārthaye tava | sarvakāryasamutpāde klṛptidarśakaro bhava ||49|| iti stutvā svayaṃ brahmā tūṣṇīmāsa kṣaṇāntare | tāvannārāyaṇenāpi saṃhṛtaṃ naikabhāvanam ||1.8.50 || vairājasya svarūpantu yāvatpaśyati padmajaḥ | tāvadvairājahṛddeśādviṣṇuḥ prādurbabhūva ha |||51|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmaṇaḥ saṣṭijñānaprāptyādinirūpaṇanāmā aṣṭamo’dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||
<1.9> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca viṣṇuḥ sarvaguṇopetaḥ sarvapoṣaṇaśaktimān | sarvāścaryanidhiḥ śrīmān kundanābhimahojjvalaḥ || 1 || prāntabhugnapiśaṃgābhasnigdhakeśāktamastakaḥ | naikaratnamaṇiprotasauvarṇamukuṭāvahaḥ || 2 || śaṣkulyākṛtisatkarṇadhṛtasauvarṇakuṇḍalaḥ | viśālojjvalarekhātrayayugbhālasthacandrakaḥ || 3 || kaisaraṃ tilakaṃ bibhrat lalāṭe’gurucandanaḥ | kāmabāṇaprarohārhavakrabhrūkuṭibhaṃguraḥ || 4 || aravindadalāśubhraprāntaraktābhanetrakaḥ | kajjalāñjanasaṃsiktākarṇāntākṣiprakoṇakaḥ || 5 || tilapuṣpapraphullābhanāsiko dīrghagaṇḍakaḥ | suvartulasamākāraraktadvayakapolakaḥ || 6 || sugandhapadmakeyūro divyapuṣpāvataṃsakaḥ | śuddhacāmīkarakarṇapūrakarṇaṭibhūṣaṇaḥ || 7 || sūkṣmanīlahiraṇyāgrodbhavacchmaśruprasundaraḥ | raktabimbābhasaddhāsyasamāśritasamauṣṭhakaḥ || 8 || kambukaṇṭhaḥ sucibukastejomaṇḍalakaṃdharaḥ | dedīpyamānavapuṣā hṛttimirapraṇāśakaḥ || 9 || pauṣpān hārām̐śca sauvarṇān gale bibhratsukaustubham | supuṣṭāṃsaḥ supralambabhogapūvārdhabāhukaḥ || 1.9.10 || ājānulambahastaśca suprakoṣṭhaścaturbhujaḥ | vidyotaccandrasadṛśanakharaktakaradvayaḥ || 11 || svarṇāṃgulīyasattejoratnanaddhasupadmakaḥ | dhanuścakradhvajasvastikenamīnāṃkahastakaḥ || 12|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmahetirhāradharaḥ prabhuḥ | śrīvatsāṃkaḥ suraśanaḥ kundadantaḥ supṛṣṭhakaḥ || 13| viśālonnatasadvakṣāḥ puṣṭakaṭisuliṅgakaḥ | karihastoruyugalaḥ samavartulajānukaḥ || 14|| kramavṛttāpuṣṭajaghaḥ samanimnasupattalaḥ | madhyanimnonnataraktacārudṛśyapadāmbujaḥ || 15|| sarvatīrthāśrayapuṇyaprapadaḥ pāṇḍuracchaviḥ | aṅgulyuparisatsūkṣmaromarājivirājitaḥ || 16 || sūkṣmaromāvalirājattattadvīryasukukṣikaḥ | trigulphacaraṇaḥ śrīmān sarvābharaṇabhūṣaṇaḥ || 17 || amlānamadhusatsaurabhārdravividhapuṣpayā | virājito vaijayantyā divyayā vanamālayā || 18 || padmaketvaṃkuśavajrasvastikajavajambavaḥ | aṣṭakoṇordhvarekhe’ṅkāni pade dakṣiṇe nava || 1 9|| mīnārdhacandrakalaśatrikoṇavyomagoṣpadam | dhanuśceti pade vāme sapta cihnāni saṃdadhat || 1.9.20 || āprāntadvayasaṃlagnavistīrṇabhālarekhayā | ṣaḍvidhaṃ bhagamaiśvaryaṃ vyañjayan sāttvikīṃ janim || 21 || vāme sakthini sattejaḥpāṇḍurāṃkaṃ tu sundaram | sahajāyāstu lakṣmyāstaccandrābhaṃ cihnamudvahan || 22|| etādṛśo’bhavadviṣṇurbahurūpaguṇāśrayaḥ | dṛṣṭvā brahmā svayaṃbhūstaṃ sṛṣṭinetrabhimānavān || 23 || ko’yamanyo’bhavadrūpaguṇavīryabalādhikaḥ | itikṛtvāpṛcchadenaṃ viṣṇuṃ lokaprapoṣakam || 24|| kastvametādṛśo vidvan matpratidvandvarūpakaḥ | sṛṣṭeḥ kartāhameko’smi sarvaiśvaryavibhūtimān || 25|| sarvadhātā sarvapoṣṭā sarvanetṛtvamāvahan | matto nānyo’sti kaścidvai sṛṣṭeḥ saṃhārapoṣakaḥ || 26|| ko vai hetustavotpattau kiṃkartā kiṃvidhāyakaḥ | madvirodhaṃ prakurvan vai na kaścitsukhabhāgbhavet || 27|| bhūtvā prahasya viṣṇustaṃ brahmāṇaṃ pratyuvāca ha | sṛṣṭirmayi tvaha sṛṣṭau cāhaṃ sṛṣṭimayo vibhuḥ || 28 || tvādṛśāḥ padmajā naike mayi līnāḥ samāsate | ahamanādinidhano dhātāhaṃ viśvatomukhaḥ || 29|| vyāpyavyāpakabhāvena viśvamāvṛtya yaḥ sthitaḥ | sarvasṛṣṭimayo devo’nantabrahmādisaṃstutaḥ || 1.9.30 || so’haṃ nārāyaṇo viṣṇurnānyaḥ kaścitparaḥ samaḥ | gaccha dūramito no cedvināśaṃ yāsyasi dhruvam || 31 || iti viṣṇuvacaḥ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | prāha viṣṇuṃ ca mā garva kuru darśanabāliśaḥ || 32|| māvamaṃsthāśca māṃ deva eṣa tvāṃ nāśayāmyaham | ityuccārya tu saṃrabdhau parasparajighāṃsayā || 33 || ahameva varo natvamahamekaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ | itibruvau hantukāmau cakraturyuddharaṃbhaṇam || 34|| yuyudhāte parau vīrau mānavyājau mahāyudhau | ahaṃkāraniveśādvai yuddhaṃ tayorbabhūva ha ||25 || īśvarāstatsamakakṣāḥ samājagmurdidṛkṣavaḥ | kṣipantaḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi paśyanto yuddhavartinau |||36|| tāvat kruddho haristatra bāṇānmumoca duḥsahān | astrāṇi vividhān kṣepān brahmavakṣasi pāragān ||37|| atha brahmā paraṃ kruddhau viṣṇorvakṣasi duḥsahān | bāṇān vidyutsatejaskānastrāṇi vividhāni ca ||38|| mumoceti tayoryuddhaṃ drāgāścaryakaraṃ hyabhūt | prasamīkṣyeśvarāḥ sarve praśaśaṃsuḥ samākulāḥ |||3 9 || viṣṇurvegavaśo bhūtvāgnyastraṃ mumoca vedhase | parjanyāstreṇa vidhinā tadastraṃ sannivāritam || 1.9.40|| viṣṇunā preritaṃ tatra vidyudastraṃ sameghakam | brahmaṇā nāśitaṃ tadvai vāyvastreṇa mahāmbare || 41 || viṣṇuryuyoja giryastraṃ ko vajrāstraṃ mumoca ha | harirnāgāstramasṛjad brahmā cikṣepa gāruḍam ||42|| hariṇā prahitaṃ bhāraṃ laghimnā brāhmaṇā hṛtam | viyogaśaktimudyamya viṣṇurjaghāna korasi |||43 || brahmā śūlena tāṃ chitvā jṛmbhaṇāstraṃ mumoca ha | viṣṇurnidrāpramantreṇa jṛmbhaṇaṃ pravilayya ca || 44|| jagrāha yāvadbrahmāstraṃ brahmā cāpi ca tad dadhe | dvayorbrahmāstrayoryuddhaṃ praghoraṃ cāmbare’bhavan ||45|| mahānalāstato jātā īśasṛṣṭipradāhakāḥ | viṣṇustvāvat svakaṃ cakraṃ saṃjagrāha sudarśanam || 46|| koṭisūryasamānograṃ tīkṣṇadhāraṃ vināśakam | īśāstāvattu santrastā hāhākāraṃ pracakrire || 47|| brahmaṇastu vināśāya yāvatprerayati prabhuḥ | tāvad brahmā viṣṇunāmabhaktyākhyaṃ kavacaṃ dadhau || 48|| viṣṇurnārāyaṇo devo mayyāvasatu duḥkhahāḥ | paraṃbrahma śiraḥ pātu brahma pātu galaṃ mama || 49|| vāsudeva uraḥ pātu kaṭiṃ pātvaniruddhakaḥ | pradyumna udaraṃ pātu saṃkarṣaṇastu pṛṣṭhakam |||1.9.50|| bhūmā śiśnaṃ tu me pātu mahāviṣṇustu sakthinī | hiraṇyagarbho me jānū jaṃghe vairājapūruṣaḥ ||5 1 || gulphau pradhānapuruṣaḥ pādau prakṛtipūruṣaḥ | kṛṣṇaḥ pūrvaṃ hariḥ paścād vaikuṇṭhaścottare’vatu ||52|| nārāyaṇastu paścānme’ntaryāmī sarvato’vatu | viṣṇustvaṃ mayi sarvāṃge praviśyāvatu māṃ vibho ||53|| sattvāśrayastu me sattvaṃ pātu nārāyaṇaḥ svayam | raktāśrayastu me raktaṃ pātu śrībhagavān svayam |||54|| bhayāśrayaṃ tu māṃ pātu cakrī cābhayadānadaḥ | nālasthitaṃ tu māṃ pātu nālodbhavakaraḥ prabhuḥ ||55|| ākasmikamahāduḥkhātpāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam | brahmāstre śāntaya cakraṃ saṃharādya dyāṃ kuru ||56 || stutvetthaṃ paramaṃ devaṃ brahmā tūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha | brahmabhaktiṃ samajñāya viṣṇuścakraṃ mumoca na ||57|| paraṃ brahmāstrayostejaḥ saṃhārārthaṃ mano dadhe | saṃkarṣaṇasvarūpo yaḥ paraṃbrahma janārdanaḥ ||58 || mahājyotirmayastambho dvayormadhye babhūva saḥ | brahmāstre cāpi te tāvatsarvasaṃhārasakṣame ||99 || nililyāte kṣaṇenaiva mahājyotirmaye’nale | astraśāntikaraṃ tejaḥ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā tadadbhutam ||1.9.6 0 || brahmā viṣṇustatheśā ye tatra santi samāgatāḥ | lebhire vismayaṃ mugdhāḥ kimetajjyotirityaho ||6 1 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmaviṣṇvorvivādabhaktikavacādinirūpaṇanāmā navamo’dhyāyaḥ || 9||
<1.10> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ahau tejomayaṃ bimbaṃ staṃbhākāraṃ kimutthitam | asyordhvaṃ ca tathādhastād brahmatejomayaṃ nvidam || 1 || ititarkayatostatra paśyatośca kṣaṇāntare | tayostu devayoryuddhyad brahmāstre dve layaṃ gate || 2 || staṃbhatejasi līnatvādastrayorbrahmarūpiṇoḥ | dvayormadhye mahān kaḥ syādityanirṇayataḥ punaḥ || 3 || brahmāstragrāsasāmarthyāśrayasyāsya tu yo dvayoḥ | adhaḥprāntaṃ paraṃ prāntaṃ nayet so’stu mahāniti || 4 || evaṃ saṃketamāsthāya militau vīramāninau | pratasthāte’tha kāryantu dvayorekaṃ na saṃbhavet || 5 || vicāryeti harirviṣṇuḥ gāruḍaṃ rūpamāptavān | brahmā haṃsatanurbhūtvā tadantaṃ vīkṣituṃ gataḥ || 6 || viṣṇurvarṣaśataṃ divyaṃ dūrād dūrataraṃ gataḥ | nāpaśyattu yadā tasya staṃbhasya mūlamityataḥ || 7 || atiśrāntaśca nirviṇṇaḥ prāpa pūrvaṃ raṇājiram | brahmā varṣaśataṃ divyamūrdhvādūrdhvataraṃ gataḥ || 8 || agatvāntaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā cintāmagno hyajāyata | tadānīmeva samaye jyotirūpaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ || 9 || vyacintayadaho devau kīdṛśau bālavanmatau | anantasyāprameyasya me mānaṃ kartumudyatau || 1.10.10 || naikasyāpi gabhasterme prāntaṃ prāptumapi svayam | vāsudevo’pi saṃśaktaḥ kā vārtānyeśamāninām || 11 || parihāsaṃ vidhāyetthaṃ śiraḥkampaṃ cakāra ha | tāvajjyotiśśirobhāgātpuṣpaṃ vai patitaṃ śubham || 12|| ketakyāḥ saurabhaṃ puṣpaṃ divyayugaśatacyutam | brahmā dadarśa tatpuṣpaṃ patamānaṃ tadagrataḥ || 13 || papraccha ca vidhiḥ kiṃ tvaṃ kasmātpatasi puṣparāṭ | śrutvā prāha vidhiṃ puṣpaṃ dhṛto’haṃ paramātmanā || 14 || svena jyotiḥsvarūpeṇa mūrdhni tasmātpatāmyaham | vyatītaṃ me yugaśataṃ patatastasya mūrdhataḥ || 15 || tathāpyalpapramāṇo vai mārgaḥ prollaṃghito mayā | na paśyāmi gabhastestu kadā prānto bhaviṣyati || 1 6|| tasmāttvamapi jahyāśāmanantasyāntadarśane | parāvṛtya tadā brahmā ketakyā saha mantraṇām || 17|| kṛtavān yat sakhe me’dya tvayā kartavyamīpsitam | viṣṇostu sannidhau vācyaṃ tvayaitadvai mayā saha || 18|| dhātrā dṛṣṭo jyotiṣo’ntastatra sākṣyahamacyuta | itikṛtvā ketakaṃ tu brahmā nanāma vai muhuḥ || 19 || asatyamapi śastaṃ syādāpatkāle hi śāsanāt | brahmapuṣpe samāyāte yatrābhūdvai raṇāṃgaṇam || 1.10.20 || brahmā samīkṣya viṣṇuṃ ca jayahīnaṃ nanarta ha | uvāca kapaṭī ṣaṇḍhaḥ satyādhāraṃ tu keśavam || 21 || jyotiḥsvarūpasya paraṃ tu cāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā nu devātra samāgato’ham | athātra sākṣī khalu ketako’yaṃ papracchaviṣṇo nu mahānahaṃ hi || 22 || kūṭasākṣye kṛtaṃ tadvai ketakena mṛṣāpi san | brahmā cāntaṃ jagāme’ti viṣṇuḥ satyamamanyata || 23 || namaskṛtvā vedhase ca matvā svasya śiromaṇim | ṣoḍaśairupacāraiśca pūjayāmāsa vedhasam || 24|| brahmaṇā tu prasahyāptaṃ mahattvaṃ kūṭasākṣiṇā | brahmaketakayostatra daṇḍaṃ kartuṃ mahāprabhuḥ || 25|| parabrahma svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ svajyotīrūpamadhyataḥ | prādurbabhūva sākāraḥ sa sadāśivarūpadhṛk || 26 || saṃkarṣaṇāṃśa ityukto layakṛtsa sadāśivaḥ | parabrahmasvarūpasya saṃkarṣaṇamahātmanaḥ || 27|| śirasaḥ kiraṇaṃ caikaṃ jyotiḥstaṃbho’bhavat khalu | tasya bāṇasvarūpatvaṃ liṃgarūpatvamityapi ||28||| brahmatejaḥsvarūpatvamarcimārgatvamityapi | suṣumṇātejaso rāśirbrahma cāpi nirākṛti || 29|| anākāraṃ śaṃbhutattvaṃ kīrtyate bahunāmabhiḥ | parabrahmalalāṭotthakiraṇāntarato janeḥ |||1.10.3 0|| lalāṭācchivasaṃbhūtiriti vedaḥ pravaktyapi | sākāraṃ saccidānandaṃ śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu padmajaḥ |||3 1 || sakampaḥ prāṃjalirbhūtvā parigṛhya ca tatpadam | satriśūlaṃ śivaṃ prāha kṣamasva parameśvara ||32||| mama kalmaṣanāśāya bhavān daṇḍadharaḥ prabhuḥ | prādurbhūto mahādeva prasīda karuṇākara || 33|| śādhi māṃ mohamāpannaṃ mṛṣā gauravamāśritam | śaraṇya śaraṇāyātaṃ trāhi māṃ bhrātaraṃ tava ||34|| mohabuddhyā mayā tatra kṛtaṃ viṣṇoramānanam | viṣṇurasti parabrahma mahān mānyo’sti me sadā || 35|| tasmāt kṣamasva deveśānṛtaṃ māṃ daṇḍamāvaha | parabrahmasvarūpatvaṃ parabrahmātmako hariḥ ||36|| dvayorbhedaṃ na kurvīta bhedadraṣṭā patatyadhaḥ | ajānatā mayā cedṛṅmahimā śrījanārdanaḥ ||37|| atīvāvamataścāpyanṛtaṃ proktaṃ tathā punaḥ | atastaddoṣapātratvād daṇḍyo’haṃ bhagavam̐stvayā|| 38|| śiraśchindhyanṛtaṃ chindhi chindhi vā kalmaṣaṃ mama | bhedadṛṣṭiṃ ca me chindhi yatheṣṭaṃ kuru śaṃkara || 39|| tvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ pareśānastvaṃ devaḥ parameśvaraḥ | tvaṃ jyotistvaṃ nirākāro vyāpako brahma ityapi ||1.10.40|| tvaṃ sākāraḥ parabrahma jyotiṣo mūlameva ca | tava brahmanmukhatejaḥparidheḥ kiraṇaṃ tu yat ||41 || anantapāraṃ sandṛṣṭaṃ tasya te mahimā mahān | śāntiṃ dehi kṣamāṃ dehi trāhi tvaccharaṇāgatam ||42|| prārthayitvetthamīśeśaṃ brahmajyotiḥsthamacyutam | parabrahmākṛtiṃ devaṃ mahādevaṃ sadāśivam ||43 || namaskṛtya punarnatvā muhurnatvāpatat pade | tūṣṇīmāsa yadā brahmā tamutthāpyābravīcchivaḥ ||44|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tejomayabrahmaliṃgāvirbhāvapūrvakaśaṃkaraprāvirbhāvavarṇananāmā daśamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 0||
<1.11> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca līnamarthaṃ yato gacchettato liṃgamudīritam | līno brahmaparaḥ śrīmān puruṣottamakeśavaḥ || 1 || taṃ vai gamayate tasya tejomaṇḍalamātrakam | tadvai tejo bhavelliṃgaṃ bāṇaṃ ceti prakīrtitam || 2 || tejastejasvinostatrābhedāttejo hariḥ svayam | tasmācchivastathā liṅgaṃ parabrahmeti vaidikāḥ || 3 || vadantyapunarāvṛttipradaḥ svecchāttavigrahaḥ | śivaḥ provāca namraṃ taṃ vidhiṃ mā bhaiṣṭa cāgraja || 4 || śiraśchedādvaraṃ manye mahatāmavamānanam | mānahānirmahābhaṃgo mahatāṃ maraṇaṃ matam || 5 || śiraśchedasamaṃ daṇḍaṃ dāsye tvāṃ kalmaṣāpaham | brahmam̐stvaṃ pūjyatākāṃkṣī kitavatvaṃ samagrahīḥ || 6 || tato loke na vai te syādiṣṭadevotsavādikam | iṣṭadevatayā tvaṃ vai pūjyo naiva bhaviṣyasi || 7 || kintu yajñeṣu gṛhyeṣu bhavatsthānaṃ bhaviṣyati | sarvāṃgadakṣiṇo yajñastvadṛte niṣphalo bhavet || 8 || ato daivabaliprāptau yajñe bhāgastavāstviti | pitāmahaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ mānyasthānasthitaṃ tvayi || 9 || tvaṃkāreṇa vyavahariṣyanti tvāṃ tu janā vidhe | athāha bhagavān devaḥ ketakaṃ kūṭasākṣiṇam || 1.11.1 0 || matpūjāyāmanarhastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ | nāpi devāḥ svapūjāyāṃ tvāṃ grahīṣyanti kecana || 11 || iti śrutvā mahādevaṃ ketakaḥ samatoṣayat | devadeva mahādeva namaste’khilanāyaka || 12 || prasādaṃ kuru deveśa kṣamasva kilbiṣaṃ mama | vidhehi saphalaṃ nātha janma me te namo namaḥ || 12 || prāha śaṃbhustadā taṃ tu karuṇālaya īśvaraḥ | madgaṇāstvāṃ dhariṣyanti janma te saphalaṃ bhavet || 14|| madālaye vitāne te sthānaṃ dāsyāmi śaṃ labha | ityādiśya mahādevo yāvadviramate svayam || 15 || tāvajjyotirmayaṃ liṃgaṃ śanaiḥ saṃkocatāṃ gatam | svalpaṃ bhūvāviśat tatra sadāśivatanau sphuṭam || 16 || tadā tu vedhasā caiva viṣṇunā ca sadāśivaḥ | sākāraḥ pūjito devaḥ parabrahmasvarūpakaḥ || 17|| brahmākṛtimayaṃ liṅgaḥ nirākārasvarūpakam | parabrahmapratīkākhyaṃ tābhyāṃ tatra prapūjitam || 18 || sthāpitaṃ cāpi tatraiva yatra ceśvarasṛṣṭayaḥ | tamādikālamārabhyaḥ liṅgapūjā pravartitā || 1 9|| brahmaviṣṇūbhayābhyāṃ vai viṣṇupūjā tu vedhasā | śivapūjāpyubhābhyāṃ vai tadānīmevamāsthitā || 1.11.20 || asadvāgvedhasaḥ pūjā na kenāpyādṛtā yataḥ | viṣṇuśivau prapūjyete na vedhāstu kadācana || 21 || tatra sthitaistadeśairvai śivaviṣṇū prapūjitau | bhaviṣyatsṛṣṭilābhāya pūjanaṃ tatpravartitam || 22|| atha jyotirmayaṃ liṅgaṃ yadā cādṛśyatā gatam | tāvajjijñāsitaṃ mūlaṃ puṃrūpaṃ samadṛśyata || 23 || dvibhujaṃ saccidānandaṃ parabrahmākhyameva yat | tattejaḥparidhipreryaliṃgākhyakiraṇāttu vai || 24|| prakṛtipuruṣastasmātpradhānapuruṣastataḥ | mahāviṣṇustataḥ sākṣādvairājapuruṣaḥ pitā || 25| dṛṣṭo devatrayeṇāpi trayo yatra samāsate | nābhau brahmā hṛdi viṣṇurlalāṭe śaṃkaraḥ svayam || 26|| svaṃ svaṃ vyalokayanpaścād bhrātaraśceti menire | prasammīlya pariṣvajya trayo devāstamīḍire || 27|| namo’dbhutasvarūpāya janakāya namo namaḥ | svecchayā cātidūrāya kṛpayāntikavartine || 28 || nārāyaṇāya vairājapūruṣāya namo namaḥ | vayaṃ trayo bhavatputrā bhavadājñāvahā yataḥ || 29|| śādhi tātetikartavyaṃ kariṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ | vairājena tadā kāya sṛṣṭikārye samarpitam || 1.11.30 || viṣṇave sṛṣṭipuṣṭyākhyaṃ śivāya pralayastviti | tadālokya tadānīṃ vai samasteśvarakoṭibhiḥ || 31 || abhiṣiktāstathā te’pi tattaddhiṣṇyeṣvavasthitāḥ | kirīṭahāranupūrakeyūramaṇikuṇḍalaḥ || 32 || kṣaumamālyottarīyasragyajñasūtrāṃgulīyakaiḥ | puṣpatāmbūlakarpūracandanāttarabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 33 || dhūpakuṃkumadīpācchacchatravyañjanacāmaraiḥ | rājādhirājasaccihnadhvajadivyopahārakaiḥ || 34|| divyaistattadvyaktiyogyairvāṅmano’tītavaibhavaiḥ | pūjitāste trayo devāḥ sarvaiḥ samyak sabhājitāḥ || 3 5 || viṣṇostu vaiṣṇavī lakṣmīḥ śaṃkarasya tu śāṃkarī | brahmāṇī brahmaṇaścaivotpannā teṣāṃ tu vāmataḥ || 36 || viṣṇubrahmamaheśānāṃ svapatnīsahitātmanām | nivāsā īśalokeṣu vairājenāpi kalpitāḥ || 37|| viṣṇorvaikuṇṭhamanyattat kailāso’nyo harasya saḥ | vedhasaḥ satyadhāmānyat svasvadhāmni gatāśca te || 38 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne parameṣṭhiketakayorapūjyatāśikṣākaraṇaliṅgamūladarśanādināmā ekādaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||
<1.12> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu padme pravakṣyāmi brahmāṇḍāni yathākarot | caturviśatitattvātmavairājatanumadhyataḥ || 1 || brahmā karāñjalī piṇḍaṃ gṛhītvaikaṃ ca taṃ punaḥ | mardayitvāsaṃkhyabhāgānaṇurūpānakalpayata || 2|| tām̐śca hastatale dhṛtvā phutkāreṇodaḍīḍayat | sattvātmakamahākāśe samantāduḍḍitāstu te |||3 || aṇḍasvarūpagolātmabrahmāṇḍānyabhavan priye | tadānīṃ brahmaṇā tatra saṃkalpā bahavaḥ kṛtā ||4|| mahāmbare pratiṣṭhantu sarve’saṃkhyāṇavaḥ pṛthak | parasparaṃ sadā tatrāghaṭṭayantaḥ sthirāḥ iti ||5|| sarve tathaiva vartante parasparamanāhatāḥ | atha pratyekamadhye’stu mahākāśo’vakāśadaḥ || 6|| iti saṃkalpamātreṇa madhyākāśāstadābhavan | tatra canurdaśādyāśca bhūmikāḥ saṃbhavantviti ||7|| tādṛksaṃkalpamātreṇa caturdaśādibhūmikāḥ | pratyekāṇḍe nu jātā santamovyāptā hi sarvaśaḥ ||8 || teṣu praveśanārthāya brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | yogaśaktyāsaṃkhyasūkṣmasvasvarūpāṇyadhārayan || 9 || tattaṇḍe tatra tatra devāḥ praviviśustrayaḥ | tatrālokya tamastīvraṃ vedhāḥ saṃkalpamācarat || 1.12.1 0 || sarveṣvatra prabileṣu tejodravyāṇi santviti | tadā sarvapare loke satyadīpaḥ prakāśitaḥ || 11 || satyasaṃyamajo dīpo yatastatra prakāśate | atastadbhūmikāyāstu satyaloka iti prathā || 1 2 || tato’dhobhūmikāyāntu tapasaśca prakāśanāt | tatolokaitikhyātirbrahmaṇā parikalpitā || 1 3|| tato’pyadhastare pitṛjanānāṃ puṇyayogataḥ | prakāśaḥ samabhūttasmājjanalokābhidhā kṛtā || 14|| tato’dho bhūmikāyāṃ vai mahardīpaḥ prakāśitaḥ | pitṛdehotthasattejo mahaścetyabhiniścitam || 15 || mahaḥpradīpayogādvai maharlokābhidhā kṛtā | tato’dhastāttathā loke sūryapradīpasaṃgamāt || 16 || svargalokastathā tārādyotanāda dyauriti prathā | tato’dhastādantarāle nakṣatrekṣaṇadīpanāt || 17|| antarīkṣamiti khyātirbhuvarbhūvivarāḍhapi | ato’dhastādbhūmikāyāṃ pṛthoragneḥ prakāśanāt || 18 || agnināmā pṛthivīti bhūriti bhrājanādapi | tato’dhastāttalānā tu saptānāṃ sapta dīpakāḥ || 19 || maṇayaḥ maṇi divyārthāstattadādyakṣarādiyuk | tattannāma kṛtaṃ samyak tattannāmāni me śṛṇu || 1.12.20 || oṣadhayastvadholoke prakāśante’talaṃ tataḥ | vaidūryamaṇitejastvād vitalaṃ tadadhaḥ smṛtam || 2 1 || kaustubhastomakāntyā ca sutalaṃ tadadho matam | phaṇātālumaṇidīpāt talātalamitīritam ||22 || mārakatamaṇīnāṃ tu prakāśāttanmahātalam | ratnānāṃ tu vibhinnānāṃ prakāśāttad rasātalam || 23 || puṣparājamaṇīnāṃ ca prakāśāt pattalasthiteḥ | pātālamiti tatsaṃjñā kṛtā vai brahmaṇā svayam || 24|| maharjanatapasatyaprastarāḥ puṇyatattvajāḥ | svarge tejasstaro vāyoḥ staro bhuvaritīritaḥ || 25 || pṛthivyāstu kṛtā bhūścātalādyāstu tamasstarāḥ | ityevaṃ tatstarāṇāṃ vai klṛptanaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam || 26|| teṣvapi pārthivā bhāgā dārḍhyārthaṃ svalpamātrakāḥ | kvacittejomayā bhāgā dhātavaḥ staramiśritāḥ || 27|| kvacijjalīyabhāgāśca sudṛḍhāstāmasā api | starāḥ prajāsamādhārā vivarākhyā bhavanti hi || 28 || atha brahmā starādhāraṃ staṃbhaṃ madhye’pyakalpayat | sauvarṇaḥ sa tu pātālādāsatyaṃ suvyavasthitaḥ || 29|| satyaloke svakaṃ dhāma brahmā vai samakalpayat | madhyaloke tu kailāsaṃ śaṃbhuḥ svaṃ samakalpayat || 1.12.30 || viṣṇustu śeṣaśāyī svaṃ pātālādho jale svakam | kṣīre tu sāgare vāsaṃ svayogyaṃ samakalpayat || 31 || yogināṃ darśanārthaṃ vai nāradādi mahātmanām | devānāṃ cāpi siddhānāṃ gatiryatra bhavatyapi || 32 || ṛṣīṇāṃ ca gatiryatra ruciraṃ dhāma tanmatam | anyeṣāṃ divyadehānāṃ yatra vai sugatirbhavet || 33 || dvitīyaṃ tādṛśaṃ śvetadvīpākhyaṃ samarocayat | kṣīrābdheścottare bhāge divyo dvīpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ || 34|| tataścāpi tṛtīyaṃ svaṃ mānavairgamyamarthadam | bhūmau himagireḥ śṛṃge badrikāśramanāmakam ||35|| naranārāyaṇamūrtyā tapastapati tatra saḥ | lokakṣemakarā devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ||36 || prayatante sadaivaṃ te rakṣārthaṃ tatsthitā yataḥ | teṣāṃ dhāmāni cāṇḍe’tra bhautikānyavarāṇi ca ||37|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’saṃkhyabrahmāṇḍotpattistaravyavasthātridevavāsādinirūpaṇanāmā dvādaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 12||
<1.13> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca etadbrahmāṇḍamānaṃ tu pañcāśatkoṭiyojanam | bhūmyāvaraṇamityetat kaṭāhaṃ prathamaṃ matam || 1. || athotpanneṣvasaṃkhyeṣu brahmāṇḍeṣu ca teṣu vai | madhyotpannoṣmaṇā bhaumaṃ kaṭāhaṃ śīrṇatonmukham || 2 || dṛṣṭvā tu brahmaṇā tattacchāntyarthaṃ cāparaṃ tataḥ | tādṛgguṇaṃ kaṭāhaṃ tu salilāvaraṇātmakam || 3 || āhitaṃ tatsamāvṛttaṃ pañcābjayojanāvṛtam | jalātiśaityaniyamakṛte taijasamāvṛtam || 4 || tṛtīyaṃ jalatastadvai daśottaraguṇaṃ matam | tanniyamakṛte vāyostato’pi daśapuṣṭikam || 5 || tasyākāśaṃ tatastasyāhaṃkārastasya vai mahān | mahataḥ prakṛtiḥ proktā cāṣṭamāvaraṇātmikī || 6 || etānyaṣṭakaṭāhāni brahmāṇḍāvaraṇāni vai | pratyekaṃ tatra lagnāni teṣāṃ dārḍhyakarāṇi hi || 7 || brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca sṛṣṭīnāṃ vairājādeśca kṛtsnaśaḥ | āyuṣyaniyamārthaṃ tu parabrahma svayaṃ hariḥ || 8 || mahākālaṃ svamūrtestu prakaṭīkṛtavām̐stataḥ | mahākālasya rūpaṃ vai samayaḥ parikathyate || 9 || kālaḥ kalayate lokān kālaḥ saṃharate prajāḥ | kṣaṇādārabhya ca mahāpralayāvadhikāryakṛt || 1.13.10 || sa evāyuṣyasaṃkṣeptā hariṇā parikalpitaḥ | kṣaṇaḥ syād yā paramāṇvorvibhāgajanikā kriyā || 11 || kriyāviśiṣṭakālaḥ saḥ kṣaṇākhyāṃ labhate tataḥ | vibhāgenāpyabhivyāptaḥ kālaḥ kṣaṇo dvitīyakaḥ || 1 2|| pūrvasaṃyoganāśāḍhyaḥ kālaḥ kṣaṇastṛtīyakaḥ | uttaradeśasaṃyogavyāptaḥ kṣaṇaścaturthakaḥ || 1 3||| caturbhiśca kṣaṇaiḥ kālaḥ kūṭa ityabhidhīyate | tribhiḥ kūṭaistruṭiḥ proktā tisrastruṭayo lavo mataḥ || 14|| lavatrayaṃ nimeṣaḥ syānnimeṣā daśa paṃca ca | kāṣṭhā proktā tathā pañcadaśakāṣṭhāstu nāḍikā || 15|| te dve muhūrtaḥ saṃproktaḥ praharaḥ ṣaṇmuhūrtakāḥ | praharāḥ sapta yāmaḥ syāt divā yāmacatuṣṭayam || 16|| tathā yāmāśca catvāro niśā rātryahanī hyubhe | pañcadaśa bhavetpakṣaḥ dvau pakṣau māsa ucyate || 17|| māso’yantu manuṣyāṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ tadaharniśam | dvau tāvṛtuḥ ṣaḍayanaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ cottaraṃ matam || 18|| dakṣiṇantu niśā proktottaraṃ tu divaso divi | ayane dve tu māsānāṃ dvādaśa vatsaro’pi saḥ || 19|| divyavarṣapramāṇena yugāḥ samanukīrtitāḥ | kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśceti yugāḥ smṛtāḥ ||1.13.20|| catvāri trīṇi dve caikaṃ varṣāṇāṃ tu yathākramam | tattadyugānāṃ samayo varṣadaśasahasrakam |||2 1 || tathā sandhyaṃśayosteṣāṃ samayo dvisahasrakam | aṣṭa ṣaḍatha catvāri dve varṣāṇi yathākramam |||22|| tādṛśaṃ yugasāhasraṃ brahmaṇo dinamucyate | tāvatyeva niśā tasya yatra triloki naśyati ||23|| prātaḥ punaḥ samudeti sāyaṃ nāśo yathākramam | brahmaṇastu dine yānti manavo vai caturdaśa ||24|| manuḥ svaṃ samayaṃ bhuṃkte catuṣkīmekasaptatim | indro’pi samayaṃ bhuṃkte svacatuṣkyekasaptatim ||25|| brahmaṇo’pi svadivasaiḥ paramāyurvayaḥśatam | pañcāśadvarṣamānantu pūrvārdhamiti tanmatam ||26|| evameva parārdhaṃ tatpañcāśadvarṣamānakam | brahmaṇo yadbhavedvarṣaṃ vairājasya divā hi saḥ ||27|| vairājasya ca yadvarṣaṃ mahāviṣṇordivā tu saḥ | mahāviṣṇostu yadvarṣaṃ pradhānapuruṣasya saḥ ||28|| divaso’thāsya yadvarṣaṃ prakṛtipūruṣasya saḥ | divasastatpramāṇena varṣāṇāṃ śatamityayam |||29|| sṛṣṭimayaḥ samayaḥ sa unmeṣo’kṣarabrahmaṇaḥ | tasya pratinimeṣastu mahāpralaya ucyate ||1.13.3 0 || nimeṣonmeṣayostasya sṛṣṭayo’nantarītayaḥ | vilīyante ca jāyante tatpravāhasya nāditā || 3 1|| athavā kālamānaṃ tu sūkṣmaṃ kṣaṇacatuṣṭayam | ṣaṣṭiḥ kṣaṇacatuṣkāṇāṃ vipalaḥ parikīrtitaḥ 32|| vipalānāṃ tu yā ṣaṣṭiḥ palaḥ sa samayo mataḥ | palānāṃ tu ca yā ṣaṣṭiḥ sā ghaṭiketi sammatā ||33|| sārdhadvayaghaṭikānāṃ ghaṇṭākālaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | caturviśatighaṇṭānāṃ rātridinaṃ tu mānuṣam |||34|| varṣantvahnāṃ ca rātrīṇāṃ pañcaṣaṣṭiḥ śatatrayam | evaṃ kālaḥ sadā sarvān svāyattīkṛtya vartate ||35|| pakṣo yo mānuṣaścātra cāndraḥ sa divaso mataḥ | rātriśca tādṛśī lambā māso rātridivaṃ tataḥ || 36||| cāndraṃ bodhyaṃ tathā sauryaṃ rātriśūnyaṃ tu maṇḍalam | dhruve’ti divaso nityo yataḥ sṛṣṭarvibhinnagā ||37|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āyuḥpramāpakasamayavyavacchedādinirūpanāmā trayodaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 3|
<1.14> śrī nārāyaṇa uvāca atha brahmā mānasīṃ tu sṛṣṭiṃ caicchat sarūpiṇīm | mṛdyamardakabhāvena guṇasṛṣṭimakalpayat || 1 || brahmā svavittivibhavādbahuvītidhārāḥ svecchāpravāhavibhavādabhilāṣadhārāḥ | yatnāt svakīyaguṇato vahuyatnakūṭānutpādya sṛṣṭikaraṇāya purukriyāśca || 2 || svasmānmanāṃsyaparimāṇaguṇāni kṛtvā saṃkhyāṃ parārdhaguṇitāṃ ca tato’pyasaṃkhyām | mānaṃ ca hrasvamaṇu dīrghamatho mahacca sṛṣṭvā viyoganu suyogamataḥ paraṃ ca || 3 || jyeṣṭhatvamarthasukaniṣṭhakatāntikatve dūratvamarthagurutāṃ dravatāṃ tato’nyam | snehaṃ tathā kamalajo viracayya naijāt dehād guṇān bahuvidhān samatiṣṭhipattān || 4 || māyāṃ nigṛhya nijamānasasaṃsthitāṃ saḥ tasyāstamo’pi ca vimohamapi dvitīyam | mohaṃ mahāntamapi turyasuparvasaṃjñaṃ tāmisramandhatamasaṃ ca sasarja pañca || 5 || ajñānavṛttaya iti sma bhavanti sṛṣṭāvālambya yā bhavavahāḥ subhavanti jīvāḥ | tā eva rūpavivareṇa vibhinnasaṃjñā āvidyamasmibhavanaṃ samarāgakaśca || 6 || dveṣo bhayaṃ ta iti sarvaśarīrisaktā brahmā sasarja punarapyatha satpramāṇam | vaikalpakaṃ ca nu viparyayamugranidrāṃ svapnaṃ suṣuptimatha ghoratarāṃ nu vṛtim || 7 || mauḍhyaṃ ca narma hasanaṃ kapaṭaṃ ca māyāṃ vedhāstataḥ samasasarja nu saṃśayaṃ ca | tarkaṃ ca vādamatha jalpamatho vitaṇḍāṃ kāpaṭyacauryamatha tacchalamāmṛṣātvam || 8 || laulyaṃ tṛṣāmapi tathāsurabhāvanāṃ ca nāstikyamugrataranirdayatāmaśāntim | asnigdhatāṃ paramarukṣataratvamārtiṃ ghātaṃtiraskṛtimathārdhagaḍutvamugram || 9 || sṛṣṭiṃ samānāṃ samupadravānvitā dṛṣṭvā vicāryyātha tamomayīṃ muhuḥ | pāpīyasīṃ svasya viruddhayāminīṃ na cittaśāntiṃ samavāptavānajaḥ || 1.14.10 || aśāntasya vidheḥ pṛṣṭhādadharmaḥ samajāyata | anītistena sākaṃ vai protpannā sahacāriṇī || 1 1|| bhāryāstathābhavaścintāsūyerṣyā mamatā mṛṣā | āśāhantā tathā tṛṣṇā duṣṭatā nikṛtiḥ spṛhā || 12|| hiṃsā duruktiraśraddhāśāntinirdayatā tathā | amedhā cāpyatuṣṭiścāpuṣṭyamaitryakriyāstathā || 13|| abuddhiragatiścāpyatitikṣāthāgatistathā | anunnatiramūrtiścānuparaktistathākṣamā || 1 4|| asmṛtiśca suṣuptiścājāyanta saṃsṛtipradāḥ | tatputrāstu mado lobho raso mohaśca matsaraḥ || 15|| daṃbhaḥ kāmastathā krodho darpaḥ pāruṣyamanṛtam | sneho mānaṃ ca kāluṣyaṃ droho’śaucaṃ kalistathā || 16|| aśaucaṃ cāpyaviśvāsaścauryaṃ pānaṃ dyutaṃ tathā | garvo nāstikyamevāpi pramādo rāga eva ca || 17|| paiśunyaṃ vyasanaṃ duḥkha dveṣo’jñānaṃ bhayaṃ tathā | pāpaṃ mṛtyuranaiśvaryaṃ kauṭilyaṃ cāpyanigrahaḥ || 18|| amārdavamasantoṣo’dhairyaṃ caivāpyanarthakaḥ | atyāgaścāpyayogaścāprasādo’praśrayastathā || 19|| alābho’nudyamaścāpyadamo vighnamiti smṛtāḥ | putryaścaivāpyadharmasya jātā bahvyo hi duḥkhadāḥ ||1.14.20|| ghṛṇā nindā ca kutsā ca jugupsā kūṭatā tathā | pratāraṇā chalānyāyā prasahyatā ca dhikkṛtiḥ ||21|| chicchikārā hyararrāṭī hāhākārā ca vedanā | pīḍā hṛdayadāhā ca kālimā mohinī tathā ||22|| hṛtphālā prabhayā yonirmaladā phaṭprakāṇḍikā | kāmanā ca rajasrotā liṭkarī kṣuvatī tathā ||23|| kudṛṣṭiśca kuśīlā ca praguhyāśāṅgaliṅgikā | kṛpaṇatā parādhīnā malinatā daridratā ||24|| ariṣṭā cāpaśakunā duritā pāpiṇī tathā | kuṇapā raktapā śukrapāyinī pātinī tathā |||25|| parasvabhedikā ṣaṇḍhā māriṇī vihvalā tathā | abhānā ca tamaskarī ghorā digvibhramā tathā ||26|| āḍambarā viḍambānā cākasmikī mṛtaṃkarī | etāḥ proktā adharmasya putrya udvejikāḥ sadā ||27|| sāpatyaṃ tu tamadharmaṃ dṛṣṭvā vedhāstutoṣa na | tadā śāntipradāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ kartumaicchad hṛdā punaḥ ||28|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmaṇo mānasasṛṣṭau guṇājñānādharmasṛṣṭinirūpaṇanāmā caturdaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 14 ||
<1.15> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca lakṣmī prajānāṃ sukhadā sṛṣṭiḥ kāryā mayā punaḥ | padmajena vicāryetthaṃ dharmaḥ svahṛdayātkṛtaḥ || 1 || śubhravarṇaḥ suprakāśo vidyāśaktisamanvitaḥ | sukhasvargapramokṣādiphaladaḥ sāttvikapriyaḥ || 2 || dharmasyāpi tathā patnyaḥ śraddhā śāntirdayā gatiḥ | medhā tuṣṭistathā puṣṭirmaitrī lajjā kriyonnatiḥ || 3 || mūrtirbuddhistitikṣā ca bhaktirārādhanādikāḥ | dharmeṇa saha sañjātā hṛdayādvedhasastu tāḥ || 4 || tāsāṃ prajāstu saumyāsyāḥ saumyarūpāḥ sukhapradāḥ | aiśvaryaṃ cārjavaṃ jñānaṃ vairāgyamabhayaṃ tapaḥ || 55 || sthairyaṃ dhairyaṃ sukhaṃ kṣemaḥ satyaṃ śaucaṃ ca mārdavam | tyāgo yogo damo yajñaḥ santoṣo nigrahaḥ śamaḥ || 6 || āstikyaṃ ca prasādaśca tejaḥ svādhyāya udyamaḥ | praśrayodhyānamarthaśca sāmyaṃ lābhaśca vedanam || 7 || alobho’matsaro’daṃbho’kāmo’krodho’rasastathā | amoho nirmado’darpo’sneho’māno’kaliḥ ṛtam || 8 | apāruṣyamaśaucaṃ ca viśvāso’cauryameva ca | agarvo’dyutamabhayamadveṣo’rāgameva ca || 9 || apaiśunyamapāpaṃ ca puṇyaṃ satkarma ityapi | ṛjutvaṃ cāśaṭhatvaṃ cāvyasanaṃ dānamityapi || 1.15.10 || ityete dharmaputrā vai jajñire’tha kumārikāḥ | dayā sūktirahiṃsā ca kṛtiḥ smṛtiśca dakṣatā || 11 || kṣamā coparatirvidyā ratiḥ smṛtiśca sāmyatā | kāntiḥ komalatā cātha dakṣatā ca svatantratā || 12|| gaṃbhīratātha sthiratā nirbhayatā pragalbhatā | agarvatāpyahiṃsā ca nirmānitāpyadaṃbhatā || 13 || asteyatā tathā sevā śuśrūṣā ca śaraṇyatā | brahmaṇyatā rakṣatā ca niṣparigrahatā tathā || 14|| rūpatā mitratā tṛptiḥ pavitratā prasannatā | śuddhatā svacchatā caiva nirmalatā prakāśitā || 18|| divyatā ceśatā cātha sevyatā sānukūlatā | smṛddhirdhavalatā sampat sukhatā mohatā tathā || 16|| līlā pramodatā cāpyujjvalatā rasatā tathā | viṣayārthā dhanavatī ratnavatī vibhūṣikā || 17|| śaradvatī sasyavatī dhānyavatī pragāyanā | rāgiṇī miṣṭatā cāpi lāvaṇyatā madhuratā || 18|| mādhavī ramaṇārāmā ramaṇī ramaṇīyatā | sundaratā camatkārā sāmarthyā phalatā tathā || 19|| poṣikā śaktidā cāpi vilāsā pravilāsikā | īśvariṇyaśca divyāśca mūrtāścāmūrtikāstathā |||1.15.20 || sahasraśo dharmaputryaḥ samutpannāḥ kumārikāḥ | tābhistaiśca svayaṃ vedhāḥ santuṣṭaḥ svas mānase |||21|| dharmasargamimaṃ dṛṣṭvātmānaṃ siddhamamanyata | paraṃ pariśramo jātastenājo vikalo’bhavat ||22|| tāvattasya lalāṭādvai svedabinduḥ papāta ha | bindustu patito yāvat tatra rudro babhūva ha |||23|| śvetarūpaḥ sukumāro bālo’pyadbhūtadarśanaḥ | pañcaśirāstrinetraśca daśahastastamoguṇaḥ || 24|| śarīravyāptaromā ca vikarālo digambaraḥ | raktanetro jaṭādhārī tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraḥ kapardavān || 25|| ḍhakkātriśūlarudrākṣapinākadaṇḍapāśadhṛk | lalāṭaśaśisallekho netraprāntāruṇaprabhaḥ ||26|| utpannaḥ san rurodāyaṃ mā rodīrabravīdajaḥ | tasmād rudra iti proktastaṃ brahmāha prajāḥ sṛja || 27|| rudraḥ piturnideśaṃ svīkṛtyāsṛjadatha prajāḥ | tāmasīḥ svasamānāśca hyupadravakarī bhṛśam ||28|| ulbaṇā vyagracittāśca kṣudhāroṣasamanvitāḥ | bahurūpā virūpāśca kṛṣṇā lauhitikāstathā ||29|| caturdaśeṣu lokeṣu vyāptā rudrasya tāḥ prajāḥ | sarvāstā rudrajātīyā abhavan sarvatodiśi || 1.15.30|| kecanāsan kṛśadehāḥ sthūlakaṃdharanāsikāḥ | āsaṃśca kecana dīrghaghoṇāḥ pīvaraśroṇayaḥ || 3 1|| pīnāśca vāmanā eke kharvārdhā lambanordhvakāḥ | hrasvottamā lambapādā mañjuṣākārapṛṣṭhakāḥ || 32|| anye ṛkṣā mahodarāsstambhahastā guhānanāḥ | kṛṣṇādrisadṛśāścānye mahākālasamāḥ pare ||33|| yatra tatrābhavan rudrāḥ koṭirarbudameva ca | caturdaśasu lokeṣu rudrā rudrā na cetare ||34|| krūrāḥ kruddhā yuyudhānā bhoktuṃ brahmāṇamāyayuḥ | rudraṃ sveṣāṃ prasraṣṭāraṃ cāpi jagdhuṃ pradudruvuḥ || 35|| tadā brahmā svaputraṃ taṃ prāhemān drāk prasaṃhara | nedṛśī tu prajā kvāpi lokaśāntikarī bhavet || 36|| rūpeṇāpyapratimā ca guṇena kṣayakāriṇī | rudrān bhayaṃkaraṃ karma kurvāṇān bhakṣakānimān ||37|| śīghraṃ nāśaya putra tvaṃ nedṛśī sṛṣṭiriṣyate | rudreṇa pitṛvākyaṃ tatsamāgṛhya kṣaṇāntare ||38|| svāṭṭahāsād bibhatso nā kṛtāntākhyo mahābalaḥ | pāśakhaḍgakaro daṃṣṭrācūrṇitāṇḍa ivādvayaḥ || 39|| samutpādita evāyaṃ dhṛtahastāṃjalirmuhuḥ | kasmādutpāditaścāhaṃ kiṃ kāryaṃ me’nuśādhi mām ||1.15.40|| rudraḥ prāha tvimāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ kāpathamanugāminīm | raudrāṃ bhayaṃkarīṃ sarvalokasaṃsthāsu saṃsthitām ||41 || śīghraṃ nāśaya bhadraṃ te mama prītyā bhaviṣyati | kṛtāntastāṃ janakājñāṃ samādāya pracakrame ||42||| kṣayaṃ kartuṃ hi rudrāṇāmagnimutpādya vaktrataḥ | netrebhyaśca tathā jvālānalamutpādya sarvaśaḥ ||43|| caturdaśasu lokeṣu yatra yatrābhavan prajāḥ | raudryastatra hi sarvatra vināśaṃ kṛtavān param ||44|| netravaktraśarīrebhyo jvālākarṣaṇavidyutaḥ | utpannā dīrghapravahā brahmāṇḍe ca sthale sthale ||45|| gatvā gatvā ca rudrām̐stānanviṣyāviṣya kṛtsnaśaḥ | prasaṃjahruraśeṣām̐stān hāhākāro mahānabhūt ||46|| vidravanti pradravanti cotpatanti tatastataḥ | prakrośanti sakaruṇaṃ trāyasveti vadanti ca ||47|| tathāpi yatra gacchanti tatra jvālāstadagragāḥ | vināśārthamathāyānti nāsti trāṇasthalaṃ manāk ||48|| kutrāpyalabdhatrāṇāste parāvṛtya patanti vai | jvālānale mahākāye kṣayaṃ rudrāḥ prapedire ||49|| yadā catudarśabileṣveko’pi nahi śeṣitaḥ | tadā kṛtānto virataḥ śāntaścājo’bhavattadā ||1.15.50 || rudraścātha svaputreṇa kṛtāntena samaṃ sadā | nivāsārthaṃ svakaṃ sthānaṃ yayāce svasya pitṛtaḥ ||51|| dattaṃ ca brahmaṇā tasmai dhāma satyasthamaiśvaram | nāmnā raudraṃ tu divyaṃ tatkhyātaṃ lokaṃ tu vai mahaḥ ||52|| yatra brāhmāstu saṃkalpāḥ satyā bhavanti sarvadā | yadicchanti satyasthāste phalanti ca tattathā ||53|| satyalokasya māhātmyaṃ satyameva bhavatyapi | satyetibrahmaṇaḥ śabdaḥ sattāmātrastu sammataḥ ||54|| brahmalokastataḥ satyo brahmaṇaiva prabhāsvaraḥ | brahmaṇaḥ sa tu sāmarthyādapratīghātalakṣaṇaḥ ||55|| tasmādayaṃ satyaloko hyapunarbhavagāmiṇām | tatrāpi nyāyahīnānāṃ kṛtānto daṇḍadaḥ smṛtaḥ ||56|| nāmnā kṛtapuraṃ ceti tasya nyāyālayaḥ smṛtaḥ | brahmaṇo’pi sudharmākhyā sabhā lokottarā matā ||57|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dharmarudrayoḥ sṛṣṭyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 15||
<1.16> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi tato vai brahmaṇā svayam | kṛtaṃ lokanivāsārtha yadyat tuṣṭyarthameva ca || 1 || tatastu sāttvikīṃ sṛṣṭiṃ brahmā kartuṃ mano dadhe | sakalpaṃ kṛtavān sarvaṃ sāttvikāḥ saṃbhavantviti || 2 || tāvadrudrātsamutpannā rudrā vai sāttvikāḥ śivāḥ | śuddhāḥ śuddhatamāḥ sarve vidvāṃso ghanamūrtayaḥ || 3 || sarve sūkṣmaśarīrāste sthiralokasthitāḥ sadā | prakāśāḥ śuddhabuddhisthāḥ siddhāśca yogadharmiṇaḥ || 4 || sarve te brahmaṇā sārdhaṃ samaiśvaryāvasāyinaḥ | śāntāḥ sukhadatanavaḥ sarve te bhāvanāmayam || 5 || ānandaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prāpya cāmṛtatvāya te gatāḥ | sarve vai sukhadātmāno buddhaśuddhatayā matāḥ || 6 || ānandaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prāpyāmṛtānandaṃ bhajantyuta | dvandvaistairnābhibhūyante bhāvaduḥkhavivarjitāḥ || 7 || ādhipatyaṃ vinā tulyā brahmaṇaste mahaujasaḥ | prabhāvavijayaiśvaryasthitivairāgyadarśanaiḥ || 8 || te brāhmalaukikāḥ sarve brāhmīṃ prāpya gatiṃ śubhām | vītarāgā jitakrodhā nirmohāḥ satyavādinaḥ || 9 || svasmin praṇihitātmāno dayāvanto jitendriyāḥ | niḥsaṃgā śucayaścaiva brahmasāyujyagāḥ smṛtāḥ || 1.16.10 || akāmayuktairye vīrāstapobhirdagdhakilbiṣāḥ | teṣāmabhraṃśino lokā aprameyasukhāḥ smṛtāḥ || 11 || etadbrahmapadaṃ divyaṃ paramaṃ vyomni bhāsvaram | yatra gatvā na śocanti hyamarā brahmaṇā saha || 12 || cyavante na yato bhūyo brahmāṇaṃ ta upāsate | apunarmārakāmānāṃ brahmalokaḥ sa ucyate || 13 || purastād brahmalokasya tvaṇḍādarvāk ca vedhasaḥ | madhye divyaṃ puraṃ ramyaṃ sthānaṃ rudramanomayam || 14|| tadvigrahavataḥ sthānamīśvarasyāmitaujasaḥ | śivaṃ nāma puraṃ tatra śaraṇaṃ brahmavāsinām || 1 5|| sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ pūrṇaṃ yojanānāṃ suvistaram | ābhyantare viśālaṃ tad vyāsamaṃḍalasaṃsthitam || 16 || bahumadhyāhnasūryādiparatejo’timardinā | śātakauṃbhena mahatā prākāreṇārkavarcasā || 17|| maṇḍitaṃ cātha sauvarṇairmuktādāmavibhūṣitaiḥ | caturdvāraiḥ śubhairgamyaṃ divyaṃ sukṛtarūpakam || 18 || taccākāśe mahadvyomni satye loke sthitaṃ puram | na tatra kramate mṛtyurna tāpo na jarā śramaḥ || 19 || na taccānyaiḥ puraiḥ kvāpi rūpamāptuṃ hi śakyate | tādṛśaṃ tattu nagaraṃ govṛṣāṃkasya taijasam || 1.16.20 || bhāvena mānasī bhūmirvinyastā kanakātmikā | ratnavālukayā pūrṇā tejasā vyāpya vartate || 21 || śāradenduprakāśāni vālasūryanibhāni ca | ardhaśvetārdharaktāni sauvarṇāni tathaiva ca || 22|| rathacakrapramāṇāni nālairmarakataprabhaiḥ | sukumāreṇa rūpeṇa gandhināpratimena ca || 23 || tatra divyāni padmāni vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca | bhṛṃgapatranikāśāni tapanīyāni yāni ca || 24|| ardhakṛṣṇārdharaktāni sukumārāntarāṇi hi | ātapatrapramāṇāni paṃkajāni bhavanti vai || 25|| puṇyāmṛtapravāhāśca nadyo divyā vahanti ca | padmotpaladalonmiśraṃ phenādyavarttavigraham || 26|| jalaṃ maṇidalaprakhyamāvahanti saridvarāḥ | tadvai ye dhyānamavyagrā suyuktā vijitendriyāḥ || 27|| paśyantīha mahātmānaḥ puraṃ tadgovṛṣātmanaḥ | madhye puravarendrasya divyo bhadraśriyā vṛtaḥ || 28 || sahasrapādaḥ prāsādastapanīyamayo mahān | anupamaiśca ratnaiśca sarvataḥ sa vibhūṣitaḥ | sphaṭikaiścandrasaṃkāśairvaidūryaiḥ somasaṃprabhaiḥ || 29|| bālasūryaprabhaiścaiva sauvarṇaiścāgnisannibhaiḥ | rājataiścāpi śuśubhe hīndranīlamayaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 1.16.30 || dṛḍhairvajramayaiścaiva nirmitaḥ sumahattaraiḥ | jalaiśca vividhākārairdīpyadbhiradhivāsitam || 31 || puraṃ candraprakāśābhiḥ patākābhiralaṃkṛtam | rukmaghaṃṭādinādaiśca nityamutsavasaṃśritam || 3 2|| rudradāsāstu gāndharvāḥ kinnarāḥ sutamāgadhāḥ | stuvantīśaṃ mahārudraṃ parivārasametakam ||33|| rudraprāsādarājo’sau śatabhūmivirājate | vāsantīpratimā yatra tryambakasya niveśane || 34|| rudrāṇī śāmbhavī śaktirdevī rūpaguṇānvitā | sugandhitaśarīrā sā rudraṃ devaṃ hi sevate || 35|| śrīśca lakṣmīśca māyā ca kīrtiḥ śobhā sarasvatī | devyā vai sahitā etā rūpagandhasamanvitāḥ || 36|| nityāścāparisaṃkhyātāḥ parasparaguṇādhikāḥ | bhūṣā vai sarvaratnānāṃ devyaḥ kāntivilāsayoḥ || 37|| koṭīśataṃ mahābhāgyā vibhajyātmānamātmanā | bhagavantaṃ mahārudraṃ pratimodantyatandritāḥ || 38 || tāsāṃ sahasraṃ cānyāstatpṛṣṭhataḥ paricārikāḥ | rūpiṇyaśca śriyāyuktāḥ sarvāḥ kamalalocanāḥ || 3 9|| līlāvilāsasaṃyuktabhāvairatimanoharaiḥ | rudraistāḥ saha modante yuvabhiḥ pāvakottamaiḥ ||1.16.40 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sāttvikarudrarudrāṇībhavanādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣoḍaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 16 ||
<1.17> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca nibodha lakṣmi vakṣyāmi bahūpāsanatatparāḥ | rudrasyāsaṃkhyadāsīśca gaṇām̐ścāyudharūpiṇaḥ || 1 || ramyāḥ saumyāḥ surūpāḥ sudṛḍhabandhanagātrikāḥ | samasakthikaṭijaṃghāḥ samasūkṣmasumadhyamāḥ || 2 || kāścit kubjā vāmanikā varagātrāḥ śubhānanāḥ | puṇḍrāśca vikaṭāścaiva karālāścipiṭānanāḥ || 3 || lagbodarā hrasvabhujāstrinetrāśca hayānanā | mṛgendravadanā hrasvapādikāśca gajānanāḥ || 4 || gajavaktrodarāścānyāḥ siṃhavyāghrānanāstathā | lohitākṣā mahāstanyaḥ subhagāścārulocanāḥ || 5 || hrasvakuṃcitakeśāśca sundaryaścārugaṇḍakāḥ | sarvāstāḥ kāmarūpiṇyo dṛḍhamadhyā varāḥ striyaḥ || 6 || pūrṇapriyasusadbhāṣā hāvabhāvānvitāḥ sadā | ramate bhagavām̐stābhirdaśabāhurmaheśvaraḥ || 7 || nandinā ca gaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ viśvarūpairmahātmabhiḥ | tathā rudragaṇaiścāpi tulyaudāryaparākramaiḥ || 8 || pāvakātmajasaṃkāśairyūpadaṃṣṭrotkaṭānanaiḥ | vandyamāno vimānasthaiḥpūjyamānaśca tatparaiḥ || 9 || sarvartukusumāṃ mālāṃ prasaṃjighrannurasthitām | nīlotpaladalaśyāmaṃ pṛthutāmrāyatekṣaṇam || 1.17.10 || iṣatkarālalamboṣṭhaṃ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭragaṇāśritam | ṣaḍūrdhvanetraṃ duṣprekṣyaṃ ruciraṃ divyavāsasam || 11 || āhaveṣvaparikliṣṭaṃ sarveṣāmarināśanam | bāhunā bāhumāveśya pārśve savye’ntare sthitam || 12 || rājate paṭṭiśaṃ tasya vāmāgrakaragocaram | mahābhairava nirghoṣaṃ balenāpratimaujasam || 13 || daśavarṇadhanuścaiva vicitraṃ śobhate’dhikam | triśūlaṃ vidyutābhāsamamoghaṃ śatrunāśanam || 14|| jājvalyamāno vapuṣā paraśustattviṣāyutaḥ | asiścaivaujasāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ śītaraśmiḥ śaśī tathā || 15|| tejasā vapuṣā kāntyā deveśasya mahātmanaḥ | sthitaḥ purastād devasya śātakuṃbhamayo mahān | śobhate ruciraḥ śrīmān sarvārisukamaṇḍaluḥ || 1 6|| asimāveśya kośe ca pāṇḍurāmbaradhāriṇī | vakṣaḥsthitena mahatā mauktikena virājitā || caturbhujā mahābhāgā vijayā lokasammatā || 17|| devyā ādyapratīhārī śrīrivāpratimā parā | bhrājamānā sthitā caiva kṛtvā devasya cāṃjalim || 18|| tasyā pṛṣṭhānugāścānyāḥ striyo’psarogaṇānvitāḥ | tāḥ khalvabhinavaiḥ kāntairupatiṣṭhanti śaṃkaram || 19|| sarvalakṣaṇasampannā vāditrairupabṛṃhitāḥ | upagāyanti deveśaṃ gaṇā gandharvayonayaḥ |||1.17.20|| abhyunnato mahoraskaḥ śaranmeghasamadyutiḥ | śobhate nadamānaśca gopatistasya veśmani ||21 || parivārayutaḥ skandaḥ putro’syāmitavīryavān | raktāmbaradharaḥ śrīmān varāmbujadalekṣaṇaḥ ||22|| tasya śākho viśākhaśca naigameyaśca cāṣṭavān | vyapetavyasanāḥ śiṣyāḥ prajānāṃ pālane ratāḥ ||23|| taiḥ sārdhaṃ sa mahāvīryaḥ śobhate śikhivāhanaḥ | bālakrīḍanakaiḥ saṃkrīḍati vai viśvatomukhaḥ ||24|| vyāghrāścaivānugāstatra kāñcanābhāstarasvinaḥ | svacchandacāriṇaḥ sarve svayaṃ devena nirmitāḥ ||25|| mṛtyormṛtyusamāste tu yamadarpāpahāriṇaḥ | siṃhā rudragaṇāḥ santi rudrecchāvaśavartinaḥ ||26|| mandarādriprakāśānāṃ balenāpratimaujasām | hārakundenduvarṇānāṃ vidyudghananinādinām ||27|| cūḍāmaṇidharāṇāṃ vai meghasannibhavāsasām | śrīvatsāṃkitavajrāṇāmaṃgulīśūlapāṇinām ||28|| evaṃvidhasurūpāṇāṃ devānāṃ daivaśālinām | siṃhānāṃ tasya prāsādamukhyastaṃbheṣvavasthitiḥ |||29|| yadvai sahasra siṃhānāmīśvareṇa mahātmanā | nija krodhātkṛtaṃ krodhāste sarve siṃhavigrahāḥ ||1.17.30 || atha rudramaheśasya bhaktiryairanukalpitā | hrīmantaḥ sūrjitā dāntāḥ śauryayuktā hyalolupāḥ ||3 1|| karmaṇā manasā vācā viśuddhenāntarātmanā | ananyamanaso bhūtvā prapannā ye maheśvaram ||32||| tairlabdhaṃ rudrasālokyaṃ śāśvataṃ padamavyayam | bhavasya rūpasādṛśyaṃ nītāścaiva hyanuttamam || 33|| sarve vaiśvānaramukhyā viśvarūpāḥ kapardinaḥ | nīlakaṇṭhāḥ sitagrīvāstīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāstrilocanāḥ ||34|| ardhacandrakṛtoṣṇīṣā jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇaḥ | sarve daśabhujā vīrāḥ padmāntarasugandhinaḥ ||35|| taruṇādityasaṃkāśāḥ sarve te pītavāsasaḥ | pinākapāṇayaḥ sarve śvetagovṛṣavāhanāḥ ||36|| śriyānvitāḥ kuṇḍalino muktāhāravibhūṣitāḥ | tejaso’pyadhikā daivātsarvajñāḥ sarvadarśinaḥ ||37| vibhajya bahudhātmānaṃ jarāmṛtyuvivarjitāḥ | krīḍanti vividhairbhāvairbhogānprāpya sudurlabhān |||38| svacchandagatayaḥ siddhāḥ siddhaiścānyairvibodhitāḥ | ekādaśānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ koṭyo’nekāstataḥ kṛtāḥ || 39|| ebhiḥ saha mahātmā sa devadevo maheśvaraḥ | bhaktānukampī bhagavān modate bhaktasatpatiḥ ||1.17.40 || ābhūtasaṃplave ghore sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ kṣaye | mahābhūtavināśānte pralaye samupasthite ||41 || anekarudrakoṭyaścānekadāsīgaṇāstathā | anekagaṇavyāghrādyā naikasiddhādayaśca ye |||42|| rudralokagatāḥ sarve mahātmāno maheśvare | rudre yānti layaṃ sarve rudro brahmaṇi līyate |||43 || prapadya parayā bhaktyā jñānayuktena cetasā | prāpnoti rudrasālokyaṃ śāśvataṃ padamavyayam ||44|| ajaputrasya rudrasya sṛṣṭī rudrātmikī tviyam | dāsadāsīgaṇavyāghrayānavāhanarūpiṇī ||45|| āyudhasiddhagandharvāpsaromāgadhasevikāgṛhodyānamahāsaudhanadīpadmādimaṇḍanā ||46 || sarvā sattvamayākārā sattvarūpā susaukhyadā | rudrasya raudrabhāvo yaḥ sa na vai vartate’tra yat ||47|| tasmāttu brahmaṇā ceyaṃ satyalokanivāsinī | raudrī tu sāttvikī sṛṣṭiḥ sarvadā vai sthirīkṛtā ||48|| dṛṣṭvemāṃ sukhadāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ brahmā tuṣṭiṃ jagāma ha | kintu sāttvikadevāste rudrāstaddāsadāsikāḥ ||49|| sukhaṃ sāttvikamāsādya prāpyaiśvaryāṇi kṛtsnaśaḥ | aiśvaryeṣu sukheṣvāsan līnā vai vodhadurbalāḥ ||1.17.50|| ataste vañcitā yatsyurjñānena pāramārthinā | tathāsati kadācidvā mokṣamārgasya rodhanam ||51 || āpatteścānarthaprāptirityevaṃ mā bhavediti | vicāryyaiva svayaṃ brahmā sṛṣṭiṃ jñānabharāṃ śubhām |||52|| mokṣadāṃ brahmasaṃlagnāṃ mānasīṃ brahmarūpiṇīm | kartuṃ mano dadhe paścāt dhyātuṃ cakrāma siddhaye ||53|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sāttvikarudradāsadāsīgaṇādisṛṣṭikathananāmā saptadaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||
<1.18> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca brahmaṇā yogamāsthāya samādhimadhigamya ca | ātmānaṃ śrīharau sākṣāt pare dhāmni tadā prabhau || 1 || tādātmyena prayatnena samaikīkṛtya cārthitam | śāntipradā yathā sṛṣṭirbhavecchāntāśca pūruṣāḥ || 2 || mokṣadāśca tathānyeṣāṃ brahmabhānapariplutāḥ | sarveṣāṃ bodhakartāro nirlepā sāttvikottarāḥ || 3 || brahmarūpāḥ sadā brahmabhāvanāparisaṃbhṛtāḥ | brahmānandaparisnātā brahmamūrtivicintakāḥ || 4 || guravo lokasṛṣṭīnāṃ dharmasampatsamāśrayāḥ | daiveśvarasamakakṣā ābrahmāhata sarpaṇāḥ || 5 || putrā bhaveyurme nātha yairlokā sukhinaḥ sadā | ityabhyarthanamājñāya pareṇa brahmaṇā tadā || 6 || muktāścatvāra ājñaptāḥ putrārthaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ | saṃkalpajñāścaturmuktā akṣarabrahmadhāmataḥ || 7 || lokānatītya caiśām̐śca satyalokamupāgatāḥ | brahmāpi vyutthito yogād dṛṣṭvā muktām̐ścatuḥsamān || 8 || ime me mānasāḥ putrā bhavantu mokṣahetavaḥ | iti saṃkalpya muktām̐stān surūpān pañcahāyanān || 9 || jātamātrān brahmarūpān brahmānandamayān parān | tejomaṇḍalakṛcchubhravastrān sthalābjasatprabhān || 1.18.10 || divyān sadaikamārnauṃścābrahmāṇḍasthitijīvanān | labdhvā putrām̐stu caturo bahutoṣamavāpa ha || 11 || nāmnā te mānasāḥ putrā lokakalyāṇahetavaḥ | sanakaśca sanandaśca sanataśca sanātanaḥ || 12|| sādhavaste sādhudharmāḥ puṇyāḥ puṇyamayāḥ sadā | darśanād doṣahartāro duḥkhaśokalayaṃkarāḥ || 13 || dayālavaḥ kṣamāśīlāḥ sarvasṛṣṭihitecchavaḥ | titikṣavaśvānasūyāḥ śāntā anuditārayaḥ || 14|| anīrṣyavaśca nirvairā nimānāśca vimatsarāḥ | mānyāśca mānadāḥ sarvapriyasatyagiraḥ sadā || 15|| nirmadāḥ krodhalobhādidoṣahīnā nirañjanāḥ | ahantāgamatāśūnyā jitakāmapravartanāḥ || 1 6|| nirdaṃbhāḥ śucayo dāntāḥ ṛjavo mitabhāṣiṇaḥ | nirdvandvāścāpramattāśca dhīrāścaiva jitendriyāḥ || 17|| bodhapūrṇā ātmaniṣṭhā aparigrahaśālinaḥ | sarvopakāriṇaḥ śraddhāstikyabhaktiguṇāśrayāḥ || 18 || udārāśca taponiṣṭhā nirapekṣaparigrahāḥ | paiśunyastainyarahitāḥ paraguptāprakāśakāḥ || 19|| jitaśārīrabhāvāśca santuṣṭāḥ sthirabuddhayaḥ | sukhaduḥkhasamāstṛṣṇārahitāstoṣaṇānvitāḥ ||1.18.20 || paranindādirahitā ātmavṛttisamāśritāḥ | daivīsampatsamāyuktā dharmavaṃśanivāsinaḥ ||21|| harijñānamahāpūranidhayo brahmasadṛśāḥ | harerbhaktiṃ vinā yeṣāṃ kṣaṇo yāti na niṣphalaḥ ||22|| śravaṇamanana nididhyāsanādisamāśrayāḥ | evaṃlakṣaṇasampannāḥ santaste sanakādayaḥ |||23|| karmaṇā manasā vācā viśuddhenāntarātmanā | ananyamanaso bhaktiṃ nityaṃ kurvanti vai hareḥ ||24|| prapadya parayā bhaktyā jñānayuktena tejasā | virājanmūrtayo divyāḥ saumyabhāvasudarśanāḥ ||25|| ṛddhisiddhinidhiyogān tṛṇavad gaṇayanti te | ātmānandamahāmagnā brahmarūpāśca mokṣadāḥ ||26|| saṃsāradāvadagdhānāṃ darśanāmṛtavarṣaṇāḥ | bhāvijīvasamūhānāṃ guravo muktidāyakāḥ |||27||| pūrvajāḥ sādhuvaṃśānāṃ tārakā brahmaghātinām | sṛtayo vipathagānāṃ dṛṣṭāntā brahmacāriṇām ||28 || āśrayāḥ sarvavidyānāṃ bījāni śreyasāṃ tathā | nidhayaḥ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ rūpāṇi sāttvanātmanām ||29|| āśrayāḥ sarvasiddhīnāṃ praśrayāḥ śaraṇārthinām | mokṣadāstu mumukṣūṇāṃ phaladāḥ sarvakarmiṇām ||1.18.30|| sadāśiṣāṃ prerakāśca maṇḍanaṃ brahmavarcasām | tapaḥ sākṣāt tapovatāṃ saṃyamā yamināṃ tathā ||3 1 || sadā divyāḥ pañcavarṣā mūrtayaḥ komalāntarāḥ | yauvanodbhedarahitā jarāmaraṇavarjitāḥ ||32|| catvāro dehato bālā vṛddhāstu jñānato matāḥ | pitaraṃ svamajaṃ natvā procuḥ ki karavāma śam ||33|| tadā tu brahmaṇā te vai saṃskṛtā brahmavāribhiḥ | upanītāḥ kṛtāścātha naiṣṭhikā brahmacāriṇaḥ ||34|| sthāpitā brahmaloke te satye vyomni sumaṇḍale | puṇye saṃkalpaje ramye vimāne kāmage pare ||35|| mahārudrapurī yatra stare vyomni suvartate | tatra stare same teṣāṃ kṛte dhāma sukalpitam ||36|| divya sarvarddhisampannaṃ sveṣṭasaṃlabdhyupakṛtim | saṃkalpotthaphalapuṣpamañjarīśālivṛkṣakam || 37||
