bhaved deva sevakasyetyuvāca saḥ || mayoktastvaṃ prativyakti bhūtvāviśa śriyo hṛdi ||18|| raja utpādakastvaṃ vai ratyarthaṃ bhava sarvadā || tatrāviśya tathā vīryotpādako bhava sarvathā ||19|| anyeṣvāviśya sṛṣṭau me sarvatra tatkaro bhava || sṛṣṭiryena sadā tattadbhāvabaddhā sthirā bhavet ||1.33.20|| ityājñāṃ sa samāgṛhya sanniveśitavān hṛdi | tadā tvaṃ prathamaṃ lakṣmi samāśleṣitavatyabhūḥ ||21|| madaṃgasaṃgamāllakṣmi śāntaste jvara āsa ha || mama vīryasya te garbhe vāsātputro’bhavaddhanam ||22|| dhanaṃ suśuviṣe taṃ tvaṃ yatkāle samayaḥ sa ca | tṛtīyena ca kāmena hyāvayoḥ kṛtayojanāt ||23|| tathā putratṛtīyābhyāmāvābhyāṃ sudaśāgamāt | dhanena ca saha trayo vayaṃ prāptā daśāṃ śubhām ||24|| daśā putravatī jātā dhanatrayodaśī matā | atra te pūjanaṃ ye vai kurvanti dhanakāṃkṣiṇaḥ ||25|| teṣāṃ suvarṇarajataratnādidhanamāvaha || kāmastataḥ samājñapto mayā bāṇasahāyakaḥ ||26|| gaccha sṛṣṭau kiśoreṣu deheṣvāviśa sarvataḥ | rajovīryasamutpattikaraḥ sṛṣṭisahāyakṛt ||27|| kāmenābhyarthitā svasya sahāyā pūrvagāminī|| yuvāvasthā mayā dattā kāmāya pūrvacāriṇī ||28|| tatastatra kṛte vāse dvitīyā sahacāriṇī || ratiḥ patnī mayā sṛṣṭā dattā kāmāya rāmaṇī ||29|| dāsaḥ svārthābhidhastasmai mayā kāmāya cārpitaḥ|| anujaḥ sa tu kāmasya mānaso mama bālakaḥ ||1.33.30|| hāvabhāvau tathā putrau mānasau ca mayā kṛtau || dattau kāmāya tau tatra bhavataḥ sahasañcarau ||31|| premākhyāśca tataḥ putrau mānasaśca mayā punaḥ || samutpādya pradatto’smai so’pyabhūdasya sāhabhūḥ ||32|| saṃśleśākhyastato guptātputra utpādya cārpitaḥ || so’pyabhūt kāmadevasya guptendriyasahāyakaḥ ||33|| jāgarākhyastato dāso mayā datto’sya jāgrate | svādabhogau ca taddāsau samutpādya samarpitau ||34|| srāvākhyaśca tataḥ putro mayotpādya tathārpitaḥ| so’pyabhūt tatra bindūnāṃ kāmavegasahāyakaḥ ||35|| ānandākhyastataḥ putro mayā dhātoḥ prakāśitaḥ | sa cāpyasmai pradatto vai kārye phalasahāyakṛt ||36|| uttejanastathā putro mayotpādya tathārpitaḥ || ciraṃ jāgrabalāpūrakārkaśyena sahāyakṛt ||37|| nirvṛttiśca mayā dāsī tato’pyasmai samarpitā || srāvottaraṃ samāgamya viśleṣayati dehinau ||38|| śaithilyaṃ ca tato dāso mayotpādya samarpitaḥ || tiṣṭhati tatra ghaṭikā kāmanivṛttibodhakaḥ ||39|| ityevaṃ maṇḍalaṃ devi mayā sṛṣṭyarthamādṛtam || kṛtaṃ dattaṃ rakṣitaṃ ca aiśe jaive dvaye dvaye ||1.33.40|| tadvai madātmakaṃ sarvaṃ bhāvayannaiti bandhanam | mayā pañcāgnayaḥ klṛptāḥ svasmādeva prakāśitāḥ ||41|| naro nārī tathā kāmo vīryaṃ rajaśca pañcakam || agnayaḥ pañca te proktā mayā mattaḥ prakāśitāḥ ||42|| dhātoścāpi tathāvasthāḥ pañcapañcāgnayastvime || puruṣaḥ prathamo hyagniḥ pauruṣo dhāturucyate ||43|| liṅgamagnidvitīyastu laiṅgo dhātuḥ sa ucyate || yonistatastṛtīyo’gniryonau dhātustadocyate ||44|| garbhastataścaturtho’gnirgārbho bālaḥ sa ucyate | apatyāgniḥ pañcamaścāpatyeyo mūrta ucyate ||45|| ityevaṃ dhātubījādvai sṛṣṭiḥ pracalati dhruvam || jñātvā madātmakān tām̐stūpāste vyaktiḥ samāhitaḥ ||46|| mama bhāvaparidhyānānmāmeti naiti bandhanam | kāmastu dehinoḥ snehād bandhanāya prakalpyate ||47|| sa eva brahmaṇoḥ snehaḥ kalpitau muktaye mataḥ || brahmadṛṣṭayā guṇo yasmād bhedadṛṣṭayā tu dūṣaṇam ||48|| nirguṇatvāddhareḥ sarvā yogācca nirguṇāḥ kriyāḥ || harerjātāddhareryogāddhareḥ prajananāśrayāt ||49|| devo hi procyate kāmo ratirdevī tadāśrayāt || tasmāddevasya devatvaṃ sarvadevaharerbalāt ||1.33.50|| kāmo mūrtirharerbodhyā dehyānandasukhapradā || ānando brahmaṇo rūpaṃ brahmadṛṣṭayā na bandhakṛt ||51|| lakṣmi te ca sutau dvau vai vyājaśca vyavasāyakaḥ || tau dadāmi janā yābhyāṃ sodyamāḥ syuḥ sukhāśrayāḥ ||52|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tāmbūlanimittakāmotpattitatsantānakriyāgnīnāṃ varṇananāmā trayastriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 33 ||
<1.34> śrīlakṣmīruvāca nārāyaṇasya piṇḍādvai brāhmaṇo yo hyajāyata || sa kva gataścakārātha kiṃ kiṃ tad brūhi me hare || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca brāhmaṇaḥ puruṣaścādyo divyaḥ ṣoḍaśahāyanaḥ || pitrā samupadiṣṭo vai sarvavidyāviśāradaḥ ||2|| nārāyaṇasamastanvā guṇaiścāpi sa tatsamaḥ | rūpeṇa vayasākṛtyā nārāyaṇa ivāparaḥ ||3|| astaunnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ pitaraṃ svopadeśikam || nārāyaṇa gavāṃ nātha pitā tvaṃ jagatāṃ guruḥ ||4|| kiṃ kāryaṃ me bhavecchādhi pālayāmi na saṃśayaḥ || pāti yaḥ sa pitā proktaḥ putrastvajñāprapālakaḥ ||5|| pitā viṣṇuḥ pitā daivaṃ pitāṃśo vāsudevajaḥ | pitā kṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma pitā tasmāt prapūjyate || 6 || pitṛtīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tārakaṃ puṇyadaṃ varam || pitā devo varo devaḥ pitā brahmasanātanam || 7 || pitā bījapradātā yaḥ poṣakaḥ pālakastathā | sarvaṃ cārpayitā svasya ko’nyastasmātparo mataḥ || 8 || pitā santoṣito yena tena santoṣito hariḥ | pitā ca sevito yena tena saṃsevito hariḥ || 9 || dāna puṇyavratātithyayajñahomadamādayaḥ | akṛtā api sukṛtāḥ syuḥ pitā yena sevyate ||1.34.10|| mahāpāpo’tipāpaśca paśughnaścātmaghātakaḥ | pitṛpādodakaṃ pītvā brahmaloke mahīyate ||11|| pitṛbrahma paraṃbrahma śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇārthinaḥ || dehajñānadhanādīnāṃ pradātā poṣakaḥ prabhuḥ ||12|| piturājñā kṛtā yena tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet | anyannaivāvaśiṣyena pitrāśīrbhyo vidheyakam ||13|| saṃskṛtaḥ saṃskṛto vā na putraḥ pitrā nibhālitaḥ || nirbhayo bhavate mānyo mahadbhiścāpi sarvathā ||14|| na viṣṇurna mahādevo na vairājo na ceśvarāḥ || pitṛtulyā bhavantyete pitā hyeva pitā mataḥ ||15|| jalānnavastravāhādyaiḥ pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ | vārdhakye pārśvavāsena pituḥ sevāṃ karoti yaḥ ||16|| āhvāne vartane cāpi neti na prativakti yaḥ || omityeva karotīṣṭaṃ sa mokṣabhāṅ na saṃśayaḥ ||17|| piturmataṃ vinā naiva kiñcitkāryaṃ karoti yaḥ || ājñayaiva prakartā yaḥ sarvathā phalabhāg hi saḥ ||18|| āpadbhirnīyamāno yo duḥkhairāmarditaśca yaḥ | vighnaiścāpi parābhūtaḥ pitṛbhaktyā hi rakṣyate ||19|| tādṛśena suputreṇa pitā vai putravān mataḥ || anājñākaraputreṇa pitā naiva hi putravān ||1.34.20|| tasmāttātaḥ karomyājñāṃ yena janmaphalaṃ bhavet || kṛtaṃ sarva sukutaṃ syāt tadājñāṃ dehi satvaram ||21|| pitṛbhaktiṃ pradarśyaivaṃ yāvad baddhāṃjaliḥ sthitaḥ | tāvannārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt pitā prāha suputrakam || 22|| aho putra ciraṃ jīva vardhito’si śubhāśiṣā | pitṛbhaktiparaḥ putre dharmeṇa vardhate’nvaham || 23 || īdṛśaste vicāro’sti vartanaṃ pitṛbhaktikṛt | pitṛ bhakti vibeke’haṃ varte vai putra siddhidaḥ |||24|| suputraḥ sa hi vijñeyaḥ pitā yena supālitaḥ | vanditaḥ sevito nityaṃ pūjitaśca namaskṛtaḥ || 25| prātarutthāya ye putraḥ pitṝndevāngurūm̐stathā | vandante ca namantyāryāste’kṣayārthaprabhāgiṇaḥ || 25 || teṣāṃ vai cākṣayā lokāsteṣāṃ cākṣayamamṛtam | teṣāṃ vai cākṣayaṃ śreyasteṣāmabhyudayaḥ paraḥ |||27|| teṣāṃ dārāḥ sadā sādhvyaḥ pātivratyaparāyaṇāḥ | miṣṭavāṇyo miṣṭadātryo miṣṭabhoga pradāstathā || 28 || teṣāṃ gṛhāṇi divyāni smṛddhikoṭibhṛtāni ca | rasadravyadharāsampallalitāni bhavanti ca || 29 || sevante ye janāḥ pitṝn vastrabhojanavāribhiḥ | sevānuvṛttiśuśrūṣāparicaryādibhistathā || 1.34.30 || teṣāṃ syurakṣayā lokā akṣayāśca vibhūtayaḥ | akṣayaṃ ca sukhaṃ divyaṃ nirvighnaṃ cirajīvanam ||31 || siddhayastatra tiṣṭhanti pitaro yatra satkṛtāḥ | samṛddhayastatra cāyānti pitrāśīrvādayojitāḥ || 32 || svarṇaṃ raupyaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca | śayyā mṛdvyo dugdhaphenā gauryo nāryastathā rasāḥ || 33 || yānavāhanasaudhāni dīvyanti pitṛsevinām | udyānopavanāvāsasarovihārabhūmayaḥ || 34|| vimānāni ca divyāni gāvo dāsyaḥ sumadhyamāḥ | dāsāścājñākarāḥ saumyā bhavanti pitṛsevinām || 35|| pitṛsevākṣayo lābho nānyo lābhastathāparaḥ | yena lābhena modante putrāścātra paratra ca ||36 || pūrvaṃ yaistu pitā bhaktyā sevitaḥ paritoṣitaḥ | taiḥ padaṃ pārameṣṭhyādi labdhaṃ cāthāpunarbhavam || 37|| pitṛprasannatāpātraṃ yamo naivābhisarpati | pitṛprasannatāpātrāt kālaścāpi palāyate || 38 || pitṛprasādapātrasya hareḥ prasādapātratā | pitṛprasādahīnānāṃ durantā kaṣṭadā gatiḥ || 3 9|| labdhapitṛprasādānāṃ vaṃśo na śīryate kvacit | pitṛprasādamāptānāṃ svāsthyaṃ na jīryati kvacit ||1.34.40 || pitṛprasādamāptānāmītayo yānti dūrataḥ | ādhyātmikāni duḥkhāni dṛśyante naiva naiva hi ||41|| indriyāṇi sadā teṣāṃ nirogāṇi bhavanti hi | pitā bījapradaḥ pūjyo mātā garbhe vivardhinī ||42|| bālye tu sevikā mātā sevyā mātā yathā pitā | pitā nārāyaṇo bodhyo mātā lakṣmīsvarūpiṇī |||42|| mātṛsevā kṛtā yena sevitā devakoṭayaḥ | mātā dadhāti vai garbhe garbhārthaṃ niyame sthitā ||44|| iṣṭānbhogyānbhojyapānādikān tyaktvāpi rakṣati | janmadāne paraṃ duḥkhaṃ sahate mṛtimūrchanam ||45|| bālaṃ mūtramalopetaṃ nirmalaṃ prakaroti sā | nidrāṃ tyaktvāpi bālārthaṃ cintā grastā bhavatyasau ||46|| dhyāyatīśvaravad bālaṃ sevate poṣayatyapi | rakṣati svārjitaṃ sarvaṃ dadāti tatkṛte sadā ||47|| kiṃ ṛṇaṃ tūlanāṃ yāti putre mātuḥ ṛṇasya vai | putrastatpratikartuṃ na kṣamo varṣaśatairapi ||48|| yādṛśau tādṛśau vāpi pitarau brahmavanmatau | pūjyau sevyau sadā vandyau putraiḥ puṇyābhilāṣibhiḥ ||49|| andhau rugṇau daridrau vā kṛpaṇau vyabhicāriṇau | stenau hiṃsāparau vāpi pitarau pūjanārhaṇau ||1.34.50|| dhanyo’si tvaṃ sadā putra yanmadājñāṃ karoṣi hi | madājñaiva ca dharmaste dharmātmā bhava sarvadā ||51 || patnīvratamitiprakhyāṃ karomi tava putraka | patnīvratastvamevāsi brāhmaṇo divyasiddhimān ||52|| mama kṛṣṇasya rūpastvaṃ mamātivallabho yataḥ | kṛṣṇavallabha ityākhya ācāryo bhava putraka |||53|| mamāvatāra eva tvaṃ bhagavān sarvamokṣakṛt | matsṛṣṭyasaṃkhyasādhvīnāmekalaḥ satpatirbhava |||54|| sarvasṛṣṭau divyarūpo bhūtvā vyāpaka eva ca | nare nare nivāsaṃ ca kuru koṭiguṇo bhava ||55|| śṛṇu patnīvrataṃ te’hamupadiśāmi tattvataḥ | tathā nareṣu vṛttyaṃ vai tathāsanmokṣado bhava ||56|| patyurbhāgaṃ svake garbhe nayate rakṣaṇāya yā | patnī proktā ca sāpyagnisākṣiṇī sahacāriṇī ||57|| tadarthaṃ tatsukhārthaṃ ca tasyāmeva pumarthakam | vartanaṃ vratamityevaṃ patnīvratamitīritam ||58|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pitṛsevāpatnīvratapuruṣātmakabrāhmaṇamahimakathananāmā catustriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 34 ||
<1.35> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca patnīvratasya śabdasya samyagartho mayoditaḥ | tava patnyāḥ kṛte kiṃ kiṃ kāryaṃ tadvakṣyate mayā || 1 || prathamaṃ brahmacāritvaṃ paścādgārhasthyameva ca | brahmacārī purā bhūtvā patnyā saha tato vaset || 2 || brahmacaryaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ yajñopavītamityapi | vedārthāṃśca nibodha tvaṃ paścāt patnīyuto bhava || 2 || ityājñapya svakaṃ putraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ yauvanonmukham | muhūrtaṃ śubhamāsthāya pravṛtto hyupanāyane || 4 || tathopanītiṃ putrasya kartumutsukamānasaḥ | sarvān sampādayāmāsa saṃbhārānuruvikramaḥ || 5 || tadā maṃgalavādyāni hyavādyanta muhurmuhuḥ | lakṣmyādayo jagustatra gītānyānandatastadā || 6 || kṛcchratrayanimittena dhenutrayapradānakam | kāmacārāśanāśuddhiśāntaye kṛtamuttamam || 7 || tryahaṃ prātastryahaṃ sāyaṃ tryahamadyādayācitam | tryahaṃ paraṃ ca nāśnīyācchuddhaṃ kṛcchramudīritam || 8 || mātṛkāpūjanaṃ caiva nāndīśrāddhaṃ tathaiva ca | svastivāco gṛhaśāntiṃ dvijabhojanamityapi || 1 || sthaṇḍile tu samudbhavavahnisthāpanamityatha | pūjanādi tathā tasya cakāra śrīhariḥ svayam || 1.35.10 || snātaṃ bhukta kṛtakeśavāpaṃ ca samalaṃkṛtam | dakṣabhāge sthitaṃ saṃskārayāmāsa sutaṃ tu saḥ ||1 1 || kaupīnaṃ kaṭisūtraṃ ca navaṃ yajñopavītakam | triguṇaṃ sma dadātyājyahomaṃ kṛtvāvadatprabhuḥ || 12|| sāmākhyaste bhaved vedo gotraṃ śrībrahma vidyate | pravarāste trayo nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo haristathā || 13|| śākhā patnīvratākhyā te nāmnā bhaviṣyati hyanu | idānīṃ tvaṃ brahmacārī bhavasīti nibodhaya || 14|| śṛṇu dharmāṃstava yogyānkathayāmi samāsataḥ | juhudhyagniṃ prātarādāvapośāna tathā kuru || 15|| guroḥ sevāṃ kuru nityaṃ brahmapāṭhaṃ tathā kuru | gṛhāṇemaṃ ca gāyatrīmantraṃ japaṃ sadā kuru || 16 || oṃ nārāyaṇāyavidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi | tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayādityāvarttaya mālikām || 17|| brahmadaṇḍaṃ gṛhāṇemamaiṇājīnamidaṃ tathā | sandhyopāstiṃ vidhehi tvaṃ krodhānṛte tu varjaya || 18|| brahmacaryaṃ tathā rakṣa vikṛtiṃ māviśa kvacit | aśuddhaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ pānaṃ mātiṣṭha hananaṃ kvacit || 1 9|| vyasanaṃ mā kuru brahman nindanaṃ mā kuru kvacit | snānaṃ sandhyāṃ japaṃ homaṃ svādhyāyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam ||1.35.20 || ātmajñānaṃ hareḥ pūjāmaṣṭau nityaṃ samācareḥ | omityādāya tadvākyamupatasthe raviṃ tathā || 21 || agneḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ cakre bhikṣāṃ jagrāha mātṛtaḥ | śrīharirgāḥ svarṇamudrā vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca ||22|| īśvarebhyo dadāti sma ye te tatra samāgatāḥ | bhojanāni dakṣiṇāśca datvā santarpitāśca te |||23 || putraṃ jñānastavātmānaṃ vedamadhyāpayaddhariḥ | jaṭākamaṇḍalūdaṇḍacarmavalkaladhāriṇaḥ ||24|| patnīvratākhyaputrasya vivāhārthaṃ vyacintayat | pativratākhyayā sārdhaṃ rūpayauvanapūrayā || 25|| kanyayā tadvivāhaṃ ca nārāyaṇo hyakārayat | dvayorjanmākṣare dṛṣṭvā lagnārthaṃ niścikāya saḥ || 26|| muhūrtaṃ ca balaṃ dṛṣṭvā lagnapatraṃ lilekha ca | gītiṃ māṃgalikīṃ svastivācanikāṃ vidhāpya vai || 27 || mukhaṃ miṣṭaṃ tathā kṛtvā varasyākṣatabindukam | piṣṭacūrṇairvarasthāṃgaṃ mardayitvā hyapūjayat||||28 || maṇḍapāropaṇaṃ kṛtvā māṇekastaṃbharopaṇam | gaṇeśasthāpanaṃ kṛtvā mātṛkāpūjanaṃ tathā || 29 || kalaśasthāpanaṃ kṛtvā yajñakuṇḍamakārayat | kare kāmaphalaṃ (mīṃḍholakaṃ) badhvā varaṃ maṇḍapamānayata || 1.35.30 || kanyāṃ tatra samānīya varamālāmadhārayat | gārhapatyaṃ ca kuṇḍe’gniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya hyajūhavat || 31 || hastayormelanaṃ kṛtvā mukhe miṣṭamadāpayat | vastragranthiṃ samābadhya pradakṣiṇā hyakārayat || 3 2 || vedavādyadhvaniṃ kṛtvā magalādīnyagāpayat | mudrādibhī rāmayitvā hastadravyāṇi cārpayat || 23 || saha dharmaṃ caretyuktvā lagnakarmāsamāpayat | vighnān śirasa uttārya hyāśīrbhiḥ samayojayat || 34|| brāhmeṇa vidhinā dattvā varakanye hyavāhayat | atha nārāyaṇastatra dampatibhyāmaśikṣayat || 25|| patibhinnā na vai patnī patnībhinno na vai patiḥ | dvayoḥ premṇorabhinnatvāddvayoraikyaṃ svabhāvajam || 36|| patyurguptaṃ mahāvīryaṃ patnī garbhe dadhāti hi | aṃgayośca tayoraikyāddampatyoraikyamaṃgajam || 37|| piturbhāgaḥ sthito garbhe patnībhāgena puṣyate | dvayorbālo bhavedekastato hyaikyaṃ dvayorapi ||38|| ekasyāniṣṭatāprāptau dvayorduḥkhaṃ samaṃ bhavet | ekasya sukhasampattau dvayoḥ saukhyaṃ samaṃ bhavet ||39|| hānirlābhaḥ sukhaṃ dukhaṃ samaṃ dvābhyāṃ nu vedyate | ātmātmani dvayoḥ saktastasmādaikyaṃ dvayorapi ||1.35.40|| ekenāpyarjite dravye’nyasya svatvaṃ pravartate | eke na kṛtapuṇyasya dvitīyo bhajate phalam ||41|| ekena tu kṛte kārye viśvasityaparo yataḥ | ekenopārjitaṃ bhojyaṃ bhuṃkte tu dvayameva vai ||42|| divā rātrau sahaikatvaṃ dehayormanasorapi | mamāhante na vai bhinne tasmādaikyaṃ dvayorapi ||43|| rodane rudanaṃ yāti harṣaṇe harṣaṇaṃ tathā | mūrchane mūrchanaṃ yāti cintane cintanaṃ bhavet || 44|| dvayoraikyādidaṃ sarvaṃ bhinnayornahi jāyate | tasmāttu sarvathā bodhyaṃ dampatyoraikyamuttamam ||45|| ityevamaikyasāmarthyātpuṇye’pyaikyaṃ bhavatyapi | śatrudaṇḍe rājadaṇḍe sahanaikyaṃ bhavatyapi ||46|| tīrthe dāne copakāre śubhe puṇye ca dharmaṇi | patipatnyoḥ samo bhāgaḥ smṛddhau cātra paratra ca ||47|| tasmādardhaṃ śarīrasya svasyānyasya parārdhakam | puṃso’rdhaṃ vāma patnyeva patnyardhaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ patiḥ || 48|| patnyāṃ patiḥ sadā hyāste kānte patnī ca vartate | tasmādardhāṃganā patnī patiścārdhāṃgano mataḥ ||49|| tataḥ svārthaṃ parityajya dvayorarthaṃ vibudhya ca | dvābhyāmājīvanaṃ cārthe sthātavyaṃ tu parasparam ||1.35.50|| parasparaṃ svakaṃ jñātvā pratibimbaṃ sahāyakṛt | prasoḍhvāpi dvayomardaṃ kartavyaṃ kāryamanvaham ||51|| patnyā yathā patiḥ sevyo mānyaḥ pūjyaśca devavat | patyā tathā sadvā patnī sevyā mānyeva devikā ||52| bhojanācchādanālāpavihārotsavakhelane | śṛṃgārahāsasammānāsanayānādhirohaṇe ||53|| vartane vārtane svatve pūjane satkṛte’rhaṇe | patnī tu sarvathā hyagre gaṇanīyā nareṇa hi ||54|| ramaṇyo yatra pūjyante vasanti tatra devatāḥ | ramaṇyo yatra tuṣyanti tatra vasanti sampadḥ ||55|| ramaṇyo yatra modante vardhante smṛddhayo’tra vai | ramaṇyo yatra tṛpyanti tatrākṛṣyanta ṛddhayaḥ ||56|| nāryo hyānandayantyatra tatrāgacchanti siddhayaḥ | nodvejyā naiva tāḍyāśca nāryo vaṃśadharā yataḥ |||57||| janakaṃ tu parityajya yāgatā pativeśane | patyadhīnā patibhāgyā kastāmudvejayed budhaḥ ||58|| dāsīvājīvanaṃ yā vai bhūjiṣyeva nu vartate | dīneva kṛpaṇā bhūtvā patiṃ caivānuvartate ||59|| govat vā vahyate yatra dīnā vahati tatra vai | chāyā tviva śarīrasya kastāṃ buddho nu duḥkhayet ||1.35.60|| dattaṃ bhuktaṃ paraṃ vṛṃkte cābhiyukte’vaśeṣajam | parādhīnā patiṃ dhatte kastāṃ na rakṣayed budhaḥ ||61|| kṣudhāṃ tṛṣāṃ prasoḍhvāpi gṛhakāryaṃ karoti yā | kaṣṭaṃ kālaṃ sahitvāpi patikāryaṃ karoti yā ||62|| tyaktvā nidrāṃ tathālasyaṃ vigaṇayya manaḥ svakam | patyuḥ kāmapravṛttyarthamupatiṣṭhatyadho bhuvi ||6 3|| tāḍane bhartsane krośe’dhikṣepe tyajane’pi yā | nirbalā sahate sarvaṃ kastāṃ duḥkhaṃ pradāpayet ||64|| etādṛśyāṃ suśīlāyāṃ patnyāṃ lakṣmīḥ pratiṣṭhati | rādhā ramā jayā padmā śāradā ca sarasvatī ||65|| ekādaśī ratiḥ sandhyā mohinī ca jayantyapi | etāścānyā mahādevyastatra patnyāṃ vasanti hi ||66|| andhā rugṇā daridrā vā kurūpā kubhagāpi vā | kustanī kumukhī kubjā sthūlā śaithilyamadhyamā ||67|| kuśvāsā kupadī kuṣṭhā kupriyā kusvabhāvinī | api duṣṭā durācārā patnī sevyeva padmajā ||68|| na kvāpi duḥkhinnīṃ kuryāt svasya śreyo hyabhīpsatā | tasyā niḥśvāsamātreṇa sarvaṃ dahyati tatkṣaṇāt ||69|| tasyā duḥkhakṛtocchvāsān nirvaṃśo jāyate naraḥ | puṇyaṃ pūrvakṛtaṃ naśyet tasyāḥ kalpāntavahninā ||1.35.70|| tasmātputra sadā patnīṃ pūjaya tvaṃ yathocitam | svasmād daśaguṇaṃ patnyai dehi sarvaṃ tvayārjitam ||71|| tena gṛhyasukhaṃ labdhvā saha svargaṃ vigāhya ca | ante brāhmaṃ padaṃ divyaṃ prayāsyatho’punarbhavam ||72|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne patnīvratākhyapuruṣasyabrahmacaryagārhasthyadampatītvadharmamāhātmyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ ||35||
<1.36> śrīnārāyāṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ kamale lokavyavahārapraghaṭṭanām | yacchrutvāścaryameva syātkathayāmi tu tattvataḥ || 1 || karmaloke vyavahāro hyādānapratidānajaḥ | parasparasahāyena sarvadā bandhanātmakaḥ || 2|| daridrebhyo nirdhanebhyo’śakyebhyo dhanavān sadā | dravyaṃ dadāti sāhāyyaṃ dehayātrāpravṛttaye || 3 || samayastena kaṭhino niryāti sukhapūrvakam | yadā svasya suyogaḥ syātsamayaścāpi lābhadaḥ || 4 || tadā tu dhanino dravyaṃ sampradeyamaśeṣataḥ | grahītā yadi dadyānna ṛṇyeva mriyate yadi || 5 || ṛṇāpākaraṇārthāya punarjanmani vai tadā | manuṣyo yadi jāyeta prāk pitā bhavatīti saḥ || 6 || tadānīṃ pūrvadātāraḥ putrā bhavantyakarmaṭhāḥ | patnīgarbhe sthitā eva kārayanti bahuvyayam || 7 || patnīṃ tu rogiṇīṃ kuryustadarthaṃ dravyanāśakāḥ | janmanyapi na sāralyaṃ tadānīṃ dravyanāśakāḥ || 8 || janmottaraṃ na susvāsthyaṃ tadānīṃ dravyanāśakāḥ | bālye’pi sarvathā duṣṭāḥ kārayanti vyayaṃ bahum || 9 || bhojanācchādanāpānavilepanamahotsavaiḥ | kurvanti vipulaṃ nāśaṃ pitṛdravyasya putrakāḥ || 1.36.10 || roge vyayo vrate vyayo vyasane vyaya eva ca | vidyādhyāye vivāhe ca vyayād vyaya itīyate || 11 || yāvannopārjanārhāste tāvattu vyaya eva vai | yāvadupārjanārthāya samayaḥ pratidṛśyate || 1 2|| tāvad yuvā kṛtaḥ putro’kasmād vā mriyate yataḥ | pūrvajanmani dattaṃ yat sarvamādāya yāti saḥ || 13 || athavā dīrghajīvī ced vicittonmattavadbhavet | tadartha sarvathā dravyavyaya eva na saṃśayaḥ || 1 4|| ityevaṃ pūrvadātāro jāyante’tra tu putrakāḥ | dattaṃ dravyaṃ samāpyaiva yānti karmānusārataḥ || 15|| tasmātpṛrvapradātāraḥ putrāḥ jñeyā svake gṛhe | ye vā na pratidātāraḥ paśavo’pi bhavanti te || 1 6|| vṛṣā aśvā rāsabhā vā coṣṭrā bhūtvā vahanti te | taddvārā svāmino dravyaṃ datvā yāntyanyavigraham || 1 7|| ṛṇamukto bhavedyastu na kiṃcitkasyacicca vai | ṛṇaṃ yasyāvaśiṣyeta sa naivāpatyavān bhavet || 18 || tasmātputrāḥ sadā bodhyā dravyanāśārthamāgatāḥ | satputrāstvāgate yogye samaye lābhadāyakāḥ || 1 9|| karmānubandhisaṃsāre yasya yatra ṛṇaṃ bhavet | sa tat tasya samādāya dūraṃ cirāya gacchati || 1.36.20 || na kaścitkasyacit putro na kaścitkasyacitpitā | ṛṇādānapradānābhyāṃ pitṛputrāptayojanāḥ || 21 || svapitṛsevanaṃ putrāstyaktvotpathagatā yadi | pitṛniḥśvāsasaṃdagdhā yāntyadho’pyadhamāṃ gatim || 22|| mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vāpi vṛddhaṃ pālyaṃ gṛhād yadi | niṣkāsayati kuputro naṣṭapuṇyo bhavatyaram || 2 1 || guruṃ hūṃkṛtya tūṃkṛtya pitaraṃ mātaraṃ vadet | śmaśāne jāyate vṛkṣaḥ kaṃkagradhropasevitaḥ ||24|| mātre pitre vṛddhatāyāṃ yo’nnaṃ naiva dadāti ca | devāḥ syustasya vai ruṣṭā annanāśakarāstathā ||25 || tābhyo vāsaṃ tu vṛddhatve jīvikāṃ na dadāti yaḥ | tasya vāsaṃ jīvikāṃ ca haranti devayonayaḥ || 26|| pitrostu bhartsanaṃ yadvā tāḍanaṃ cāvamānanam | karoti yaḥ kuputraḥ sa pare tattatprapadyate || 27|| kuputrairbhavitavyaṃ na bhavitavyaṃ suputrakaiḥ | suputrasya kṛte svargaṃ sampanmokṣo’pi hastagaḥ || 28 || sudevārādhanaṃ yadvā yābhyāṃ puṇyaṃ purā kṛtam | tābhyāṃ tu labhyate putraḥ suputro dhārmikaḥ śuciḥ || 29|| sevako mānadātājñāpālako’nusṛtaḥ sadā | gurvarthaṃ sukhaduḥkhādisahanaḥ paripoṣakaḥ || 1.36.30 || satputrajanane yogā apekṣyante śubhāḥ sadā | garbhasya dhāraṇe yogāḥ suyogā vai suputradāḥ || 31 || ṛtudāne pituryādṛga vicāro vartate hṛdi | kāmaḥ krodho’thavā lābho bhartsanaṃ cauryameva vā || 32|| moho daṃbho malinatvaṃ śāṭhyaṃ kauṭilyameva vā | śauryaṃ vidyā sāttvikatvaṃ rājasaṃ tāmasaṃ ca vā || 33 || dyūtaṃ pānaṃ vyasanaṃ ca yadyadaniṣṭameva vā | vartate tanmayo binduḥ putro’pi tanmayo bhavet || 34|| dānadharmadayāpremakomalāntaratāstathā | varteran tanmayo bindustatputrastadguṇo bhavet || 3 5|| ṛtudāne śunaḥ śabdā gardabhādestathāśubhāḥ | kleśakalahaśabdā vā śrūyante cettathā tadā || 36 || bindavastanmayā bhūtvā garbhe te vai patanti yat | putrā api śvakharavat jāyante tadguṇāstathā || 37|| nīcajāteḥ sahavāsāt tadbhāvānāṃ ca vartanāt | tādṛśā bindudāne vai jāyante bālakāstathā || 38 || gṛhe sarvatra bhittyādau yādṛśyaḥ santi mūrtayaḥ | tādṛśākṛtayasteṣāṃ putrāṇāntu bhavanti hi || 39 || kṛṣṇavarṇāstāmasāśca yuddhāraṃbhāḥ pratārakāḥ | caurāśca kāmanāvanto hāsyasadanakārakāḥ ||1.36.40 || daridrāśca dhanāḍhyaśca vijayinaḥ palāyitāḥ | rākṣasāśca tathā pretā bhūtā bhāṇḍāśca nartakāḥ ||4 1 || naṭā naṭyo yathā yā yā ākṛtayo bhavanti vai | gṛhe vā darśane vātha smaraṇe bindupātane |||42|| tathā tathā guṇāsteṣāṃ bhavantyeva prajāsu vai | tasmānniṣekakārye’pi sukṛtaṃ cintayed budhaḥ |||43 || santaṃ dharmayutaṃ bhaktaṃ yaśobhājaṃ ca sukṛtam | śvetaṃ puṇyayutaṃ śāntaṃ sadguṇaṃ mānavaṃ tathā ||44|| guruṃ patiṃ ca pitaraṃ mātaraṃ devameva vā | vidvāṃsaṃ satkriyaṃ śūraṃ surekhaṃ bhāgyaśālinam || 45|| gauraṃ prakhyātakāryaṃ ca śīlavantaṃ tapasvinam | lokahitakaraṃ devapūjanāstikameva vā ||46 || udyaminaṃ ca nītijñaṃ saumyaṃ devaguṇākaram | paropakāraśīlaṃ ca subhagaṃ dānaśālinam ||7|| sarvasadguṇasadvāsaṃ pavitraṃ cintayet tadā | naraṃ vāpyathavā nārīṃ devaṃ devīṃ tathāpi vā ||48 || santaṃ sādhvīṃ bhagavantaṃ tathā bhagavatīṃ ca vā | yādṛśaṃ yādṛśīṃ caiva niṣekasamaye tu yaḥ ||49 || yā ca saṃsmarati tādṛgapatyaṃ labhate tathā | ṛtudāne yathā yādṛgbhāvo bhavati dehinoḥ ||1.36.50 || tathāpatyāni jāyante dampatyorbhāvavanti hi | atra sṛṣṭau tu bahudhā svabhāvāḥ saṃkarīkṛtāḥ ||5 1 || parasparānumiśreṇa śuddhā naiva bhavanti hi | tathāpi sukhadaṃ cintyaṃ yāvadbuddhibalodayam ||52|| tenāpatyaṃ bhavettasya sukhadaṃ mānadaṃ sadā | ārtavastu guṇaḥ sarvāpatyeṣvāviśati dhruvam ||53 || ṛtvāraṃbhād bhavedgarbhakamalaṃ vyāttasammukham | āṣoḍaśadinaṃ paścād garbhaṃ gṛhṇāti naiva tat ||54|| madhyarātryuttaraṃ matvā cāgāmimadhyarātrikam | yadā rajaḥ sudṛśyeta taddinādgaṇanā bhavet ||55|| rajodināni catvāri vihāyāṣoḍaśāvadhim | garbhādhānasya yogyatvaṃ bhavatītyavadhārya ca ||5 6 || yadvā tadvā rajoyuktā rātryaścatasra eva tu | hātavyāstapare kāle pañcamī kanyakāpradā ||57|| ṣaṣṭhī rātriḥ putradā vai bhavatītyevamaṃkataḥ | gaṇayitvā yatheṣṭaṃ tu yogaḥ kāryaḥ phalapradaḥ ||58|| putradāstasya yugmāḥ syurayugmāḥ kanyakāpradāḥ | ṛturajo’nvitā rātryaścatasrastatra garhitāḥ ||59|| tāsu yogo na kartavyo garbhanāśaka eva saḥ | tasmāddhairyapado bhūtvā śuddhiṃ kṛtvā tu saṃviśet || 1.36.60 || tyaktvā candramasaṃ duṣṭaṃ maghāṃ mūlaṃ vihāya ca | śuciṃ sanniviśetpatnīṃ punnāmarkṣe viśeṣataḥ ||6 1 || patiḥ patnyāḥ saha śuddhiṃ kṛtvā śayyāṃ samāviśet | śuciṃ putraṃ prapadyeta pumarthasya prasādhakam ||62|| mālinye tu tayoḥ putrā malināḥ syuśca pāpinaḥ | nāryā śṛṃgārahāsyādi kāryaṃ maithunakarmaṇi |||63 || tenāpatyaṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ syāt sukhabhāk saumyadarśanam | hāsyayug divyarūpaṃ ca bhavenmānasaraṃjanam ||64|| dugdhapākaṃ tathā miṣṭaṃ śuklaṃ bhuktvā tu saṃviśet | tenojjvalamapatyaṃ syād rūpāḍhyaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ sadā ||65|| śākaṃ bhuṃktvā yadā gacchet striyaṃ tasya tu bālakam | kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ bhavettasmācchākaṃ bhojyaṃ na taddine || 66|| ujjvalena prabhojyena vīryaṃ bhavati cojjvalam | tasmād dvābhyāṃ tadā bhakṣyamujjvalaṃ paya ādikam ||67|| tataḥ ṛtuprasaṃgastu kāryaḥ sarvaśubhāvahaḥ | śubhe kāle śubhe yoge mūhūrtādau śubhe tathā ||68 || saṃgaḥ kāryo nānyathā tu sadapatyasulabdhaye | satsamayaṃ tvanādṛtya kāmavegena ye janāḥ || 69 || akāle garbhadātārasteṣāṃ bālāstu durbhagāḥ | alpavīryā alpasattvā alpasukṛtakāriṇaḥ ||1.36.7 0 || buddhihīnā duḥkhadāśca jāyante duḥkhavartanāḥ | tasmācchrubhaprajāyāstu lābhāya sarvadā yuvām ||7 1 || vartethāṃ dharmasadbhāve nānyabhāve kadācana | tena saukhyaṃ paraṃ bhūyād bhavatorekabhāvayoḥ ||72|| lokadvayavijetārau bhavatāṃ śaṃ bhavatvapi | bhūyāstaṃ ca sadā sārthau viyogarahitau tathā ||73 || dāmpatyasukhamaśnantau nityamānandaśālinau | dehasampatkṛtau pṛṣṭau bhūyāstaṃ bhāgyaśālinau ||74|| rajasvalārajo doṣo hyaśuddhibhrājako hi saḥ | tāvaddūre’nvahaṃ stheyaṃ yāvaddinacatuṣṭayam ||75 || nāryā rajasvalādharmasthayā spṛśyaṃ na sarvathā | gṛhavastvādikaṃ yattatsparśādaśucitāṃ vrajet ||76|| ajñānādvā prasaṃgādvā spārśano doṣa udbhavet | tannivṛttirbhavedvarṣe tad ṛṣipaṃcamīvratāt ||77|| upavāstatra kāryo nāryā devaprapūjanam | bhādraśuklasupakṣasya pañcamī ṛṣipañcamī ||78|| tadvrate tu phalāhāro hyaśaktānāṃ mataḥ śubhaḥ | tathākṛte vratasyāpi bhaṃgo naiva bhavediti ||79|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ṛṇānubandhasantatidāmpatyaniṣekānurūpasantānarājasvalyadoṣaparihārakavratādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭūtriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 36 ||
<1.37> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca patnīvratapativrate śrīhariṇā vivāhite | namaskṛtya paraṃ devaṃ tato lokeṣu ceratuḥ || 1 || tābhyāṃ saṃkalpamātreṇa koṭiśo brāhmaṇāḥ kṛtāḥ | ete tu brāhmaṇāḥ sarve saṃkalpasiddhayo’bhavan || 2 || teṣāṃ na maithunī sṛṣṭirnānyasādhanabandhinī | na ca puṇyasya sāpekṣā na vā vedhaḥsahāyinī || 3 || iyaṃ tu brahmasṛṣṭirvai brāhmaṇā brahmarūpiṇaḥ | nārāyaṇasamāḥ sarve nārāyaṇasvarūpiṇaḥ || 4 || brahmā svakīyasṛṣṭyarthaṃ yadā svaṃ tvakarottapaḥ | tadā tu samaye sṛṣṭiriyaṃ brāhmaṇamātrajā || 5 || prajāpatestu divase prathame brāhmaṇāśca te | sarve nārāyaṇī sṛṣṭirna tu vaidhasī sābhavat || 6 || viprāṇāṃ tatra sarveṣāmāyuṣyaṃ brahmaṇā samam | vedhasā ca sahotpannāḥ saha yānti pralīnatām ||7|| divyāste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve yānti brahmapure pare | atha satyātmake sthāne divye vai parameṣṭhinaḥ || 8 || tiṣṭhanto brāhmasṛṣṭau tu viprāsta eva sarvaśaḥ | brahmarṣayaḥ saṃbhavanti brāhmadivasavartinaḥ || 9 || prathamaṃ tu dināraṃbhe satyaloke’pyanantakāḥ | tapoloke’pi ta eva jane’pi brāhmaṇāśca te || 1.37.10 || maharloke’pi ta eva brāhmaṇā divyamūrtayaḥ | svarge caivāntarīkṣe ca pṛthvyāṃ pātālasaptake || 11 || sarvatra brāhmaṇā divyāścaikarūpaikabhāvanāḥ | ekasaṃskṛtabhāṣājñāścaikavarṇaikavṛttayaḥ || 12|| sarve ṣoḍaśavarṣāśca nāryā dvādaśahāyanāḥ | samāvasthā vikārādirahitāḥ kāmavarjitāḥ ||13|| nāśuddhirna manojanyo vikāro mithunārthitaḥ | brahmadhyātāra evaite brahmayajñaparāḥ sadā || 14|| caturdaśasu lokeṣu gamanāgamanakṣamāḥ | ākāśagāminaḥ sarve yatheṣṭarūpadhāriṇaḥ || 16|| dṛśyādṛśyasvarūpajñāḥ sūkṣmasthūlādisaṃbhavāḥ | ekajñātaya evaite saṃkalpakṛtasādhanāḥ || 16|| bhojanaṃ cāmṛtaṃ teṣāṃ gavāṃ dugdhaṃ phalāni ca | gāvaḥ kāmadughāḥ sarvāḥ pradattā hariṇā ca yāḥ || 17|| tā eva saha vartante caturdaśastareṣu yat | na nyūnaṃ jāyate teṣāṃ nārāyaṇasvarūpiṇām || 18|| yadyadapekṣyate vastu tattadbhavati tatra vai | śīlasantoṣatṛptyādiśālināṃ ca tapasvinām || 19|| nāsan varṇāśramāstatra nāsan grāmādayastathā | nāsan bālādijanmāni nāsan maraṇavṛddhatāḥ ||1.37.20|| nāsan dehapariṇāmā nāsan gṛhanivāsinaḥ | nāsan kṣetrāṇi kṛṣyarthaṃ nāsan vāhanajātayaḥ ||21||| nadīparvatakāsāraguhoccabhūmivāsinaḥ | jale kecit sthale kecitkecidvyomanivāsinaḥ ||22|| vāyvādhārāḥ starādhārā bāṣpādhārāśca kecana | siddhyādhārāstathaiśvaryādhārāḥ sarve nivāsinaḥ |||23|| brahmapūjāparā brahmadhyānādiniratāśca te | brāhmaṇāḥ sarvalokānāmanantā yugalāḥ smṛtāḥ ||24|| pativratākṛtāḥ sarvāḥ kanyā hyarbudakoṭayaḥ | patnīvratakṛtāḥ sarve kumārāścābjakoṭayaḥ ||25| yāvantaḥ satyaloke te tāvantastāpase jane | maharloke ca tāvantaḥ svarge bhuvari bhūsthale ||26|| atale vitale tadvatsutale ca talātale | mahātale ca pātāle brāhmaṇyo brāhmaṇā hi vai ||27||| vyavasthāstu tadā nāsan keṣāñcitkutracitprathāḥ | āsan snānaṃ tathā dhyānaṃ japaḥ śrīharipūjanam |||28||| ātitheyaśca satkāraḥ svādhyāyaḥ ṣaṭ ca satkriyāḥ | saṃkalpenopatiṣṭhanti kimarthaṃ kośarakṣaṇam ||29|| sarve vaikuṇṭhagantāraḥ punarāvartanā muhuḥ | paraloke pragantāraḥ punarāvāsasaṃgatāḥ ||1.37.30|| bhavantyeva yathā muktā muktānyaśca yathā sadā | avyāhataśarīrāste’vyāhatārthyapadārthakāḥ || 31 || apratihatasaṃkalpā avyāhataśriyaśca te | vaikuṇṭhe brahmaṇo loke nāsīdbhedo manāgapi || 32|| caturdaśasu lokeṣu nāsīd vaiṣamyamaṇvapi | yathā puṃsu tathā strīṣu nāsīd bhedo’ṅgamantarā || 32 || divyadṛṣṭyā tu te sarve parasparaprabhālinaḥ | divyarūpairvirājante yathāsaṃkalpasaṃpadaḥ || 34|| teṣāṃ tu premabhaktyā yā śrīhareḥ syātprasannatā | saiva dharmaḥ sadācāraḥ saivānandaprasādhanam || 35|| sarve tu vaiṣṇavā āsannārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ | nārāyaṇaprapannāste muktāviva pariplutāḥ || 36|| vasanti ca jarājanmamṛtivyādhivivarjitāḥ | na cintā na ca vopādhirna vighno nāstyariṣṭakam || 37|| na bhāgyālaṃbanaṃ tatrālambanaṃ harireva yat | śāsturālambanaṃ naiva śāstā śrīharireva yat || 38 || ityevaṃ prathamaḥ kālaḥ samāraṃbhasya vartate | vedhaso hi mahādivyaḥ satkālaḥ sa hi vartate || 39|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne prajāpateḥ prathamadivasīyasarvādibrāhmaṇamātrasṛṣṭinirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 37 ||
<1.38> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tato brahmā svayaṃbhūrbhagavānprabhuḥ | sisṛkṣurjīvasaṃghātānabhidhyānamathākarot || 1 || satyaloke mama sṛṣṭirmānasī sāttvikī bhavet | ityevaṃ dhyāyatastatra brāhmaṇāḥ sāttvikāśca ye || 2 || ūrdhvasrotasa evaite paraṃ cordhvaṃ vyavasthitāḥ | vyavartanta yata ūrdhvamūrdhvasrotasa āmatāḥ || 3 || te sukhaprītibahulā antarbahiśca sadvratāḥ | prakāśā bahirantaśca brahmasrotasa eva ca || 4 || ṛṣayaste sadā ṛṣerbrahmaṇo jñānasaṃbhṛteḥ | ṛṣervedasya vijñānādṛṣayaste sadā matāḥ || 5 || ṛṣītyeva gatau dhātu śrutau satye tapasyatha | etatsanniyatastasmin brāhmaṇaḥ sa ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ || 6|| nivṛttisamakālantu buddhyāvyaktamṛṣiḥ svayam | paraṃ hi ṛṣate yasmātparamarṣistataḥ smṛtaḥ || 7|| gatyarthād ṛṣaterdhātornāmanirvṛttirāditaḥ | yasmādeṣaḥ svayaṃbhūtastasmācca ṛṣitā matā || 8 || īśvarāḥ svayamudbhūtā mānasā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ | yasmānna hanyate mānairmahānparigataḥ puraḥ || 9 || yasmādṛṣanti ye dhīrā mahāntaṃ sarvato guṇaiḥ | tasmānmaharṣayaḥ proktā buddheḥ paramadarśinaḥ || 1.38.1 0|| brahmacāriṇa evaite santi vedhaḥsamāyuṣaḥ | bhavanti brahmaṇā tulyā rūpeṇa viṣayeṇa ca || 11 || ānandaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prāpya santyaiśvaryeṇa tatsamāḥ | aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi ṛṣayastūrdhvaretasaḥ || 12||| brahmaṇo mānasāḥ sarve jātāḥ satyanivāsinaḥ | teṣāṃ tu nāmadheyāni yathāpekṣaṃ dadhātyajaḥ || 1 3||| athābhidhyāyataḥ sargo jñānasroto’bhyavartata | ṛṣayo jñānino divyā jñānātmabalapūrvakāḥ || 14|| saṃnyāsā brahmarandhrāttu brahmaṇaḥ samajajñire | vaikhānasā bālakhilyā audumbarāśca phenapāḥ || 15|| kuṭīcakāśca bahvodā haṃsāḥ paramahaṃsakāḥ | aṣṭau saṃnyāsino bhedāstatrādyāstu sahasraśaḥ || 16|| santi ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi bālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ | tadanye koṭiśo bodhyā audumbaraprabhatiyaḥ || 17|| athābhidhyāyatastasya ṛbhuragnirbabhūvatuḥ | punaśca dhyāyatastasya daśa putrāḥ prajajñire || 18|| lokasantānakartāro jñānavijñānavidvarāḥ | marīciratryaṃgirasau pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ || 19|| bhagurvaśiṣṭho dakṣaśca daśamastatra nāradaḥ | utsaṃgānnārado jajñe dakṣoṃ’guṣṭhāttu vedhasaḥ ||1.38.20|| prāṇādvaśiṣṭhaḥ saṃjāto bhṛgustvacaḥ karāt kratuḥ | pulaho nābhito jajñe pulastyaḥ karṇayorṛṣiḥ |||21||| aṃgirā mukhato’kṣṇo’trirmarīcirmanaso’bhavat | puṇyastu dakṣiṇastanāt pāpo jātastu pṛṣṭhataḥ ||22|| chāyāyāḥ kardamo jajñe trayaste’pi ca mānasāḥ | athābhidhyāyato jajñe svāyaṃbhuvamanustathā ||23||| śatarūpā ca tatpatnī dampatī tau babhūvatuḥ | tābhyāṃ mithunadharmeṇa prajā hyedhāmbabhūvire ||24|| athābhidhyāyatastasya jajñire ṛṣayastvime | vaṃśavistārayitāro lokasantānahetavaḥ ||25|| yuge tu prathame sarva mānasāḥ saṃbhavanti hi | kalpāntare tu te kecijjāyante vaṃśajā api ||26|| yonijāyonijatve tu viṣṇoricchaiva kāraṇam | yeṣāṃ yatra yadāpekṣā tadā tānprerayatyapi ||27|| diśaḥ kāvyāni rāgāśca sūkṣmāṇi viṣayāṇi ca | indriyāṇi tathā prāṇā brahmaṇo mānasāni vai ||28|| ruciragnistathā medhā brahmaṇo mānasāśca te | kāvyo bṛhaspatiścaiva kaśyapaścośanāstathā ||29|| utathyo vāmadevaśca sayojyaścauśijastathā | kardamo viśravāḥ śaktirbālakhilyāstathādharāḥ ||1.38.30 || śvetaśca ṛṣayo jñānānmānasā brahmaṇo matāḥ | vatsaro nagrahūścaiva bhāradvājo’nalāyanaḥ |||3 1|| bṛhadukthaḥ śaradvām̐śca hyagastyaścauśijastathā | ṛṣirdīrghatamāścaiva bṛhadgranthaḥ śaradvataḥ ||32|| vājaśravāḥ suvittaśca suvāg veṣaparāyaṇaḥ | dadhīcaḥ śaṃkhamām̐ścaiva rājā vaiśravaṇastathā ||33 || ete’pi mānasāḥ sarve satyena ṛṣayo matāḥ | bhṛguḥ kāvyaḥ pracetāstu dadhīco hyātmavānapi ||34|| aurvo’tha jamadagniśca vidaḥ sārasvatastathā | adviṣeṇo hyarūpaśca vītahavyaḥ sumedhasaḥ |||35|| vāstuḥ pṛthurdivodāsaḥ paśvāsyo gṛtsamānnabhaḥ | atrirarcisanaścaiva śyāmavām̐ścātha niṣṭhuraḥ ||36|| valgūtako munirdhīmām̐stathā pūrvātithiśca yaḥ | ityete mānasāḥ pūrve mantraiste ṛṣayo matāḥ ||37|| aṃgirā vaidhasaścaiva bhāradvājo’tha bāṣkaliḥ | amṛtaśca tathā gārgyaḥ śyenī saṃhṛtirityapi ||38|| purukutsaśca ṛṣabhaḥ kaṇvaścaivātha mudgalaḥ | utathyaśca bharadvājastathā vājaśravā api ||39|| āpyāyaśca suvittiśca vāmadevastathaiva ca | kakṣivānaugajo dīrghatapā vyāsaśca devalaḥ ||1.38.40|| kaśyapo vibhramo raibhyo’sitaścaiva parāśaraḥ | vaśiṣṭho yājñavalkyaśca maitrāvaruṇa eva ca ||41|| indrapramītiḥ kuṇḍiśca kuśaśca pippalāyanaḥ | gopālaḥ kambharā ceti dampatī brahmaṇaḥ prajāḥ ||42|| ityāsan mānasāḥ pūrve paścātte yonijā api | anye’pi mānasāḥ paścājātā yonisamudbhavāḥ |||43|| teṣāṃ vaṃśapravaṃśāścābhavan yaiḥ pūritaṃ jagat | kalpe kalpe prajāyante’nye’nye brahmājñayā punaḥ ||44|| lokasaṃgrahakartārastataḥ satyaṃ prayānti te | vedhaḥsālokyasāyuṣyasārṣṭibhājo bhavanti ca ||45|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satyalokīyaṛṣyādimānasīsṛṣṭikathanaṃ nāmāṣṭātriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ ||38||
<1.39> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi pitṝm̐stu mānasān bahūn| brahmaṇaḥ sṛjataḥ putrān jajñire pitaro’sya vai || 1 || madhvādyaḥ ṣaḍṛtavaḥ pitaraḥ samajajñire | agniṣvāttāstathā bārhiṣadāste mānasāḥ khalu || 2 || ājyapāḥ somapāścaite pitaro mānasā api | ayajvānastathā teṣāmāsanvai gṛhamedhinaḥ || 3 || agniṣvāttāstu ye te vai pitaro’nāhitāgnayaḥ | yajvānasteṣu ye te tu pitaraḥ somapīthinaḥ || 4 || ye ca bārhiṣadāste vai pitarastvagnihotriṇaḥ | ṛṣayaḥ pitaraścaite brahmasaṃkalpajā hi te || 5 || madhumādhavau rasāktau śuciśukrau tu śuṣmiṇau | nabhanabhasyau jivāviṣorjau tu sudhayā plutau || 6 || sahasahasyau samanyū tapastapasyau ghorakau | ta ime ṛtavo dvandvāḥ kāryakāraṇarūpiṇaḥ || 7 || tatra ye brahmaṇaḥ putrā mānasāste’bhimāninaḥ | kāryasthalaṃ kalākāṣṭhāmāsasaṃvatsarādikam || 8 || syāninastvabhimānajñāścetanāḥ pitaro hi te | saṃvatsaro mahān kālastatputrāḥ ṛtavaḥ smṛtāḥ || 9 || yugāḥ kalpāstu ye te tu mahattara mahattamāḥ | kāryakāraṇarūpā vai pitaro brahmasūdbhavāḥ || 1.39.1 0|| ṛtvātmajā dinādyā ārtavāsteṣāṃ kalādayaḥ | ārtaveyāḥ sutāḥ sthāneśvarāḥ sthānātmakā api || 1 1|| prajāpatiḥ svayaṃ brahmā saṃvatsarādirūpadhṛk | saṃvatsaraḥ svayamagnirṛtamityarthakastu saḥ || 1 2|| ṛtāttu ṛtavastebhyo māsāśca ārtavā matāḥ | dvipadāṃ ca catuṣpadāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ sarpatāṃ tathā || 1 3|| sthāvarāṇāṃ ca yatpuṣpaṃ tadvai kālārtavaṃ matam | kāryahetvorabhedāśca nāmaikyaṃ pitṛbodhakam || 14|| ityevaṃ pitaro jñeyā ṛtavaścārtavāstathā | sarvabhūtāni tebhyo’tha ṛtukālātprajajñire || 15|| tasmādete’pi pitaraḥ ārtavā brahmaṇāḥ kṛtāḥ | jajñāte’tha ca pitṛbhyaḥ kanye menā ca dhāraṇī || 1 6|| yoginyau brahmavādinyau pitryau te cāpi sammate | bārhiṣadāstu tāṃ menāṃ patnīṃ himavate daduḥ || 17|| maināko menayā jāto dhāraṇyā mandarastataḥ | kanyā velā niyatiśca āyatiścāpi jajñire || 18 || dhātuścaivāyatiḥ patnī vidhāturniyatiḥ smṛtā | suṣuve sāgarādvelā sāmudrīṃ kanyakāṃ śubhām || 19 || sāvarṇinā ca sāmudrī suṣuve daśaputrakān | prācīnabarhiṣaste va pracetasa iti daśa ||1.39.20 || tebhyo’tha kanyakāṃ vārkṣī dadurvakṣāstataḥ param | prācetaso’bhavad dakṣaḥ dakṣāntāḥ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ || 21 || patnyaśca tāḥ pitryo bahvyastapoloke vasanti vai | sarvā sā mānasī sṛṣṭirmanvantare tu yonijāḥ || 22|| athāpi satyalokasthā ye vai ṛṣaya īritāḥ | teṣāṃ vaṃśeṣu cotpannāḥ pitaraste’pi kīrtitāḥ || 23 || bhṛguraṃgirā marīciḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ | atriścaiva vaśiṣṭhaśca hyaṣṭau te brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ ||24|| ebhistu mānasaiḥ putrairbrahmaṇā preritaistadā | utpāditāstapolokavāsinaḥ pitarastathā ||25|| te bhārgavāścāṃgīraso mārīcāśca tathā pare | paulastyāḥ paulahāścaiva krātavāśca tathā pare || 26 || ātreyāśca tathā vāśiṣṭhā iti lokaviśrutāḥ | pitṝṇā te gaṇāḥ proktāstapolokanivāsinaḥ || 27 || tatra kecidamūrtāśca prakāśāśca tathāpare | jyotiṣmantastathā cānye bhavanti pitaro hi te || 28 || dakṣaputrāśca haryaśvāḥ śavalāśvāstathā punaḥ | daśasāhasrasaṃkhyākāḥ sahasrāṇi ca paṃca ca || 29|| te sārdhaikasahasraṃ vai sarve tu brahmavarcasaḥ | ete tapaḥpathaṃ prāpya vartante tapaāsthitāḥ || 1.39.30 || nāradasyopadeśena brahmānveṣaṇatatparāḥ | tapolokamupāgamya tiṣṭhanti divyakāntayaḥ || 31 || ta ete pitaraḥ sarvai prajākalyāṇakārakāḥ | ṛbhuḥ sanatkumārādyāḥ kvacittiṣṭhanti tāpase || 32|| tapasi kāryavāhārthaṃ dhyānārthaṃ tu sati sthitā | marīciḥ kaśyapo dakṣo vaśiṣṭhaścāṃgirā bhṛguḥ || 33 || pulastyaḥ pulahaścaiva kraturityevamādayaḥ | pūrvaṃ tu samprasūyante brāhmaṇo manasā saha || 34|| tataḥ prajāḥ pratiṣṭhāpya janamevāśrayanti te | yāmādayo gaṇāḥ sarve maharlokanivāsinaḥ ||35|| maharlokavināśe tu janamevāśrayanti te | sarve sūkṣmaśarīrāste tatra gatvā bhavanti hi ||36|| teṣāṃ te tulyasāmarthyāstulyamūrtidharāstathā | janaloke vivartante yāvadrātristu vedhasaḥ ||37|| tatrāpi pūrvakalpānāṃ puṇyakhyātibalānvitāḥ | prajāpataya ye cāsannivṛttādhipatitvataḥ ||38|| nivṛttavṛttayaḥ sarvai svasthāḥ sumanasastathā | tapolokaṃ prapadyante janamutsṛjya taiḥ saha |||39|| manvantarāṇāṃ ca svāyaṃbhuvādyānāṃ jane sthitiḥ | vinivṛttādhikārāṇāṃ devānāṃ mahasi sthitiḥ ||1.39.40|| śukrādyāścākṣuṣāntāśca manvantarā bhavanti ye | te maharlokasaṃsthāśca brahmamānasasaṃbhavāḥ ||41 || marīciḥ kaśyapo dakṣastathā svāyaṃbhuvoṃ’girāḥ | bhṛguḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kraturityevamādayaḥ ||42|| lokayātrāpravāhāya maharloke’pi yānti hi | prajānāṃ patayaḥ sarve vartante tatra taiḥ saha ||43|| satyasthā api kāryārthamiha cāyāntyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ | kāryaṃ sampādyate sarve punaryānti svakaṃ gṛham ||44|| lokāḥ somapadā nāma maharjanamiti smṛtāḥ | pitarastatra vartante hyagniṣvāttādayaśca te ||45|| vasavaścāpi vartanti amāvasvādayastu te | susūkṣmā agnisphulliṃgā te vai pitaro devatāḥ ||46|| virajāyāstu ye putrā vairājā nāma te gaṇāḥ | agniṣvāttāḥ smṛtāstatra pitaro bhāsvaraprabhāḥ ||47|| svadhāputrāstathā svāhāputrā ye jyotibhāsvarāḥ | marīcigarbhāste tatra pitaro hyagnirūpiṇaḥ ||48|| ājyapā nāma pitaro ye bhavanti vihaṃgamāḥ | mānasā nāma tallokā bhavanti yatra te sthitāḥ ||49|| virajasya tu putrā ye vairājā nāmato matāḥ | bhāsvarāḥ puṇyabhakṣyāśca hyamūrtaya gaṇāstu te ||1.39.50|| pitṝṇāṃ yā duhitaro dauhitrāśca tu ye matāḥ | pitaro vaṃśavistārā bodhyā bhinnanivāsinaḥ ||5 1 || pṛthvyāṃ sādhvīsādhurūpā antarikṣe’nilātmakāḥ | svarge devātmakā maharjanatapassu mānasāḥ |||52|| pitaraḥ saṃvasantīti mūrtāmūrtasvarūpiṇaḥ | ādidevāstu te sarve mahāsattvā mahaujasaḥ ||53|| sarvakāmapradāstṛptā ruṣṭāḥ sarvaharā matāḥ | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena toṣaṇīyāḥ sadā hi te ||54|| maharādau sthitā ye vai teṣāṃ siddhistu mānasī | sadyaścotpadyate teṣāṃ manasā sarvamīpsitam ||55|| ityevaṃ tu priye lakṣmi sarve maharṣayaḥ sthitāḥ | tapoloke janaloke pitaraḥ sarvathā sthitāḥ ||56|| maharloke lokapālā rudrāḥ prajeśvarāstathā | manavaḥ pitaraścaiva yathākāryaṃ samasthitāḥ |||57|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne maharjanatapolokeṣu mānasīsṛṣṭipitṝṇāṃ nirdeśanāmā ekonacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ |||39||
<1.40> śrīlakṣmīruvāca pitaraḥ katidhā bodhyāḥ kiṃ deyaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tathā | abhisandhāya pitaraṃ pituśca pitaraṃ tathā || 1 || pituḥ pitāmahaṃ caiva triṣu piṇḍeṣu nāmataḥ | kāni śrāddhāni deyāni kathaṃ gacchanti vai pitṝn || 2 || bhuvi bhuvari svarge vā duḥkhinaḥ sukhino’pi vā | pūrvajā dehamāpannā bhaveyuḥ pitaro na vā || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca devāśca ṛṣayaścaiva jīvāścāpi hyanekaśaḥ | karmaloke samāgamya kṛtvā karmāṇi bhūriśaḥ || 4 || jāyante pitaraste vai pṛthvyādilokavāsinaḥ | kecitpṛthvyāṃ saṃvasanti tiṣṭhantyanye bhuvaḥ stare || 5 || te tu sarve vāsanābhirjātākasmikamṛtyavaḥ | kecitsvarge tu gacchanti ye vai puṇyaparāyaṇāḥ || 6 || kecinmaharjanatapolokānprayānti puṇyataḥ | somalokaṃ sūryalokaṃ vidyullokaṃ tathā pare || 7 || agnilokaṃ cendralokaṃ nakṣatrādigrahastarān | yānti puṇyānusāreṇa devāste pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ || 8 || bhavanti pitaro devā devāśca pitaraḥ punaḥ | lokāḥ sāntānikā nāma pitṝṇāṃ bhāsvarā matāḥ || 9 || yatra kvāpi sthitān pitṝn smaranti vaṃśajāstu yān | sāntānikaistu pitṛbhistatrāgantavyameva yat || 1.40.10 || pitṝṇāṃ tu bhavedrājā somaścāpyaryamā tathā | aryamā kiraṇaiḥ somamuttejayati cānvaham || 1 1|| somaśca kiraṇaiḥ sarvamāpyāyayati vai jagat | tasmāśca pitaraḥ sarve somaṃ tṛpyanti cāpya vai || 12|| somaṃ tu pitaraṃ śrāddhairāpyāyya tṛptimāpnuyuḥ || somalokanivāsā ye pitaraḥ somajīvanāḥ || 13|| śrāddhairāpyāyitaḥ somo lokonāpyāyayiṣyati | kṛtsnaṃ saparvatavanaṃ jaṃgamājaṃgamairvṛtam || 14|| śrāddhāni puṣṭikāmāśca ye kariṣyanti mānavāḥ | tebhyaḥ puṣṭiṃ prajāścaiva dāsyanti pitaraḥ sadā || 11|| śrāddhe yebhyaḥ pradāsyanti trīn piṇḍān nāmagotrataḥ | sarvatra vartamānāste pitaraḥ prapitāmaham || 16|| teṣāmāpyāyayiṣyanti śrāddhadānena ca prajāḥ | sukhino duḥkhino vāpi pitarastu savāsanaḥ || 17|| tebhyo’vaśyaṃ jalamannaṃ deyaṃ śaktyā tu vaṃśajaiḥ | pitarastena tṛptāḥ syuḥ sumūrtā vāpyamūrtayaḥ || 18|| teṣāṃ sapta samākhyātā gaṇāstrailokyapūjitāḥ | amūrtayastrayasteṣāṃ catvārastu samūrtayaḥ || 19|| upariṣṭāt trayasteṣāṃ vartante bhāvamūrtayaḥ | teṣāmadhastād vartante catvāraḥ sūkṣmamūrtayaḥ ||1.40.20|| śraddhayā bhāvanayā ca tṛpyanti bhāvamūrtayaḥ | annādipuṇyatṛptāste bhavanti sūkṣmamūrtayaḥ |||2 1|| manojavāḥ svadhābhaktāḥ sarvadeya suvastavaḥ | annaṃ somaṃ ca saṃlabdhvāpyāyante tṛptamānasāḥ ||22||| tatra śrāddhe jalānnaiste tṛpyanti dānabhāvanaiḥ | jñānino viṣṇubhaktāste brahmārpaṇakriyādibhiḥ ||23|| pūrṇayugasahasrānte jāyante brahmavādinaḥ | utsṛjya dehajātāni mokṣaṃ gacchantyamūrtayaḥ |||24|| kriyayā gurupūjābhistṛpyanti tu samūrtayaḥ | śrāddhe tṛptāḥ punaḥ somaṃ pibanti pitaraśca te ||25|| sahasraśastu viprānvai sādhūn bālām̐śca bhojayet | tṛpyanti pitarasteṣāṃ sādhvīnāṃ bhojanena ca ||26|| viprāṇāṃ tu sahasreṇa snātakānāṃ śatena ca | anāthānāṃ sahasreṇa vānaprasthaśatena ca ||27|| sādhvī caikā sādhureko bhojane tu viśiṣyate | sādhuḥ sādhvī harerbālau jñānadhyānamayau yataḥ ||28|| divyau mokṣakarau tuṣṭau yoginau brahmatanmayau | putraḥ pautraḥ prapautro vā bālau tau bhojayiṣyati ||29|| pitarastasya tṛpyanti suvṛṣṭeneva karṣukaḥ | alābhe sādhusādhvīnāṃ bhojayed brahmacāriṇau ||1.40.30|| tadalābhe tu dauhitraṃ hyatithiṃ cāpi bhojayet || siddhāśca guptarūpeṇa caranti bahudhānvaham ||31|| sādhusādhvīsvarūpaṃ tamatithiṃ pūjayetsadā | urvī sāgaraparyantāṃ devā yogeśvarāstathā ||32|| nānārūpaiścarantyete prajādharmaprapālakāḥ | siddhāḥ santaśca sādhvyaśca vicaranti mahītale ||33|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇarūpāsteṣāṃ pūjanamācaret | dadyācca bhojanaṃ ramyaṃ vyaṃjanāni phalāni ca ||34|| devāśca pitaraścaica vahriścātithirūpakān | āviśya bhuṃjate tadvai pūjayeda tithīnsadā ||35|| bālānabhyāgatān khinnānsādhūn sādhvīrnirāśrayān | bhaktām̐śca yācakān jānīyādatithyātmakān sadā ||36|| abhyāgato yācakaḥ syādatithiḥ syādayācakaḥ | pipāsināya śrāntāya bhrāntāyātibubhukṣate ||37|| viduṣe sādhave sādhvyai bālāyānāśrayāya ca | tasmai satkṛtya dātavyaṃ yajñasya phalamicchatā ||38|| sādhavaśca mahātmānaḥ śrāddhe satkṛtya pūjitā || mokṣaṃ yogamathaiśvaryaṃ prayacchanti pitāmahāḥ ||39|| sarveṣāṃ rājataiḥ pātrairapi vā rajatānvitaiḥ | dattaṃ svadhāṃ purodhāya tathā prīṇāti vai pitṝn ||1.40.40|| pitṝn prīṇāti vai bhaktyā pitaraḥ prīṇayanti tam || pitaraḥ puṣṭikāmasya pūjākāmasya vā punaḥ ||41|| puṣṭi prajāṃ ca susvargaṃ prayacchanti na saṃśayaḥ || vimānāni sahasrāṇi yuktānyapsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ||42|| sarvakāmaprasiddhāni prayacchanti pitāmahāḥ || prajñāṃ puṣṭiṃ smṛtiṃ medhāṃ rājyamārogyamityapi ||43|| muktāvaidūryavāsāṃsi vājināgāyutāni ca | koṭiśaścāpi ratnāni prayacchanti pitāmahāḥ ||44|| sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ pitṝṇāṃ pātramucyate | rajataṃ rajatāktaṃ vā pitṝṇāṃ pātramuttamam ||45|| rajatasya kathā vāpi darśanaṃ dānameva ca | anantamakṣayaṃ svargyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ dānamucyate ||46|| pitṝnetena dānena satpātrāstārayantyuta || kāṃcanaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ dauhitraḥ kutapāstilāḥ ||47|| vastraṃ ca pāvanīyāni sādhvī ca sādhurityapi | prīyante pitaro yena bhojyena surasena ca ||48|| tāni teṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvakāmapradāni vai || śrāddhakāle subhojyāni pitṝṇāṃ toṣaṇāya vai ||49|| paramānnaṃ dugdhapākaḥ pūrikāḥ polikāstathā | śatacchidrāṇyapūpāśca miṣṭāḥ pūraṇapolikāḥ ||1.40.50|| rutalyaśca tathā ghāripūrikāśca praroṭakāḥ || phāphaṭāḥ sthirakāścaiva ghṛtacūrṇā guḍaudanāḥ ||51|| śaśkulyaḥ khājakāścaiva saṃyāvo modakāstathā | kaṃsāraḥ parpikākhaṇḍāḥ piṇḍakā granthakāstathā ||52|| kalikālaḍaḍukāścāpi kalikāḥ sevikāstathā | sohālikā maṇḍakāśca vaṭikā ghṛtapūraṇāḥ ||53|| pūpāśca mauktikāścaiva śāṭakāḥ sūtrapheṇikāḥ || sukhadāḥ śālipiṣṭāśca mudgamodakaghurgharāḥ ||54|| tilaśrṛṃkhā gundrapākaḥ pītasārāśca śarkarāḥ || meśubho mohanasthāla odanaḥ puṣpavaṭṭikāḥ ||55|| nivārāśca yavāścaiva rājagarvādayastathā || śrṛṃgāṭakā raktālavo vaṭāṇā dvidalāstathā ||56|| vhālāśca parpaṭāścaiva parpaṭyaḥ kvathikā dadhi | harinmāṣāśca mudgāśca tuvaryaścaiva dugdhakam ||57|| śākāni tvaṅlavaṃgailāsaṃskṛtāni madhūni ca | gavāhārā bhiṇḍakāśca raktālavaśca cirbhaṭāḥ ||58|| karkaṭyaḥ kāravellāśca kūṣmāṇḍāḥ sūraṇastathā | vṛntākaḥ śarkarākandaḥ śimbikākharbujastathā ||59|| paṭolā gaṇḍakāścāpi ghṛtaṣoḍhāḥ parāvalāḥ || lūnikā methikā rājñī jīvantī suvamūlakāḥ ||1.40.60|| tāṇḍulājyo hyamblalūnī rājagrahaśca dugdhikā | kunarāḥ śarkarātiktāḥ patravallyaśca naikadhā ||61|| vṛntākabharjanaṃ cāpi caṭanyo navanītakam | dhānyākākauthumībuddhihīnānāṃ caṭanī tathā ||6|| drākṣākhārikakadalai rājikātiktavastujam | dadhyāktaṃ rājikārāddhamāranālānyanekadhā ||63|| miṣṭānnāni navānyeva bhojyākāni varāṇi ca || peyāni miṣṭamiśrāṇi sugandhīni rasāni ca ||64|| ikṣunāraṃgakadalajambīrāṅgudasanturāḥ| seturāmṛtasaphalajananaspatijāmbavaḥ ||65|| iṅgudīnārikelāmrapanasalipsikācikāḥ| badarāṅgurapūpīyānānasāmalakāstathā ||66|| rāmaphalapapanasasītāphalasubilvakāḥ | phalānyetāni tāmbūlapūgīvarīyasītvacaḥ ||67|| jalaṃ tu tīrthasaṃbhūtaṃ puṣpāṇi susugandhayaḥ || deyaṃ śrāddhe viśeṣeṇa pitṝṇāṃ tṛptihetave ||68|| yena pradīyate yasmai yattṛptyarthaṃ ca yatra vai || triṣvatra bhagavān sākṣād dātā grahītā nāyakaḥ ||69|| yajamānena svarūpaṃ dātāraṃ vyāpakaṃ harim || vibhāvya pātrarūpāya haraye deyameva ha ||1.40.70|| sa harirvyāpakaḥ śrīmān pitaryapi suvartate || sarvatra tu hareryogāt tṛptistu pitṛṇāṃ bhavet ||71|| pitṝṇāṃ nāma vyāhṛtyaḥ dātavyaṃ haribuddhitaḥ || akṣayyā sā bhavet tṛptiḥ svalpamapyatulaṃ bhavet ||72|| kanyakā vidhavā nāryo vṛddhā ādhāravarjitāḥ | saubhāgyā bhojanīyāśca śrāddhe phalamanantakam ||73|| grāmo dhūmranirodhena bhojanīyāḥ phalārthinā | yajñādhikaṃ phalaṃ tasya bhujyante paśupakṣibhiḥ ||74|| jalasthaiścāpi bhujyante yatra kīṭādibhistathā | śrāddhaḥ sarvāntarātmātmā sārvabhaumaḥ sa kathyate ||75|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vividhapitṛtatpātrataddeyānnaphalāditatprāptiphalādivarṇananāmā catvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 40 ||
<1.41> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca prīyante pitaro yena japyena niyamena ca | stotraṃ teṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham || 1 || śrāddhakāle pravaktavyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ toṣaṇāya tat || yajamānena putreṇa brāhmaṇena susādhunā || 2 || amūrtānāṃ samūrtānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ dīptatejasām || namasyāmi sadā tām̐stu dhyānino yogacakṣuṣaḥ || 3 || indrāderjanayitāro bhṛgumārīcayostathā | saptarṣīṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca tānnamasyāmi kāmadān || 4 || manvādīnāṃ sureśānāṃ sūryācandramasorapi | janayitṝnnamasyāmi pitṝn kuśaladāyakān || 5 || nakṣatrāṇāṃ carādīnāṃ pitṝnatha pitāmahān || dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ pitṝm̐śca namasyāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ ||6|| devarṣīṇāṃ janayitan sarvalokanamaskṛtān || abhayasya sadā dātṝn namasye’haṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ || 7 || prajeśāya kaśyapāya somāya varuṇāya ca || yogayogeśvarebhyaśca namasyāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ || 8 || pitṛgaṇebhyaḥ saptabhyo namo lokeṣu saptasu || svayaṃbhuve namastasmai brahmaṇe yogacakṣuṣe || 9 || anena stotravareṇa trīnvarām̐llabhate janaḥ || annamāyuḥ sutām̐ścaiva dadate pitaraḥ sukhāḥ ||1.41.10|| yat kiñcitpacyate gehe bhakṣyaṃ bhojyādikaṃ tathā | anivedya na bhoktavyaṃ devapitṛbhya ityapi ||11|| pityubhyo yastu mālyāni sugandhīni ca sarvaśaḥ || sadā dadyācchriyā yuktaḥ sa vibhāti divākaraḥ ||12|| gugulādīṃstathā dhūpān pitṛbhyo yaḥ prayacchati || saṃyuktānmadhusarpibhyāṃ so’śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||13|| dhūpaṃ gandhaguṇopetaṃ kāntaṃ pitṛparāyaṇam | labhate strīṣvapatyāni hīha cāmutra cobhayoḥ ||14|| dīpaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ prayataḥ sadā yastu prayacchati || sa loke’pratimaṃ cakṣurlabhate divyadṛṣṭidam ||15|| tejasā yaśasā caiva kāntyā cāpi balena ca | svayaṃprakāśo bhavati bhrājate ca triviṣṭape ||16|| apsarobhiḥ parivṛto vimānāgre tu modite || gandhān puṣpāṇi dhūpām̐śca dadyādājyāhutīśca vai ||17|| phalamūlanamaskāraiḥ pitṝṇāṃ prītimāvahet | śrāddhakāle tu satataṃ vāyubhūtāḥ pitāmahāḥ ||18|| āviśanti dvijānsādhūn sādhvīrdṛṣṭvā ca harṣataḥ || vastrairannaiḥ pradānaiśca bhakṣyairbhojyaistathaiva ca ||19|| pānairgobhistathā grāmaiḥ pūjayet pātrasaṃsthitān | kāśāḥ punarbhavā ye ca barhiṇā upabarhiṇā ||1.41.20|| ta eva pitaro devā devāśca pitaraḥ punaḥ || dvijātyabhimukho dadyād darbhān piṇḍaॉśca yatnataḥ ||21|| athāhṛtya dakṣiṇāṃ ca tato homo vidhīyate | agnaye kavyavāhāya svadhā cāṃgirase namaḥ ||22|| somāya vai pitṛmate svadhā cāṃgirase namaḥ || yamāya caivāṃgirase svadhā nama iti bruvan ||23|| bahuhavyatvamevāgnau susamiddhe viśeṣataḥ || vidhūme lelihāne ca hotavyaṃ karmasiddhaye ||24|| aprabuddhe sadhūme ca juhuyād yo hutāśane || yajamāno bhavedandhaḥ so’putro bhavatītyapi ||25|| alpendhano vā rūkṣo vā visphulliṃgaśca sarvaśaḥ || jvālādhūmo’pasavyaśca sa tu vahnirna siddhaye ||26|| durgandhaścaiva nīlaśca kṛṣṇaścaiva viśeṣataḥ || bhūmiṃ vigāhate yatra tatra vidyātparābhavam ||27|| arciṣmān piṇḍitaśikhaḥ sarpiṣkāṃcanasaṃbhavaḥ || snigdhaḥ pradakṣiṇaścaiva vahniḥ syātkāryasiddhaye ||28|| anujñātaḥ kuruṣveti tathaiva dvijasattamaiḥ || patnīmādāya putrām̐śca juhuyāddhavyavāhanam ||29|| samānaplakṣīnyagrodhaplakṣāśvatthavikaṃkatāḥ| udumbarāstathā bilvacandanā yajñagā samidh ||1.41.30|| saralo devadāruśca śālaśca khadirastathā || samidarthaṃ praśastāḥ syurete vṛkṣā viśeṣataḥ ||31|| viśvedevāśca ye proktā hyete’pi pitaro hyuta || teṣāmājyaṃ ca piṇḍaṃ ca vahnau dadyātprayatnataḥ ||3|| puṣpāṇāṃ ca phalānāṃ ca bhakṣyānnānāṃ tathaiva ca || agramuddhṛtya sarveṣāṃ juhuyājjātavedasi ||33|| tīrthe homaśca piṇḍāśca śrāddhaṃ kartavyamādarāt | devālayo gurorvāsaḥ parvatāḥ saritastathā || 34|| puṇyavṛkṣāstaḍāgāni yatra vā brāhmaṇo bhavet || te te śrāddhārhadeśāḥ syustatra puṇyamasaṃkhyakam ||35|| pṛthvīṃ sāgaravelāntāṃ divyāḥ satpuruṣāḥ sadā || nānārūpaiścarantyatra teṣāṃ yogāttu mokṣaṇam ||36|| siddhāḥ santaśca sādhvyaśca tīrthānāṃ tīrthamuttamam | lakṣmīrnārāyaṇaścātra tadrūpeṣu vasatyaram ||37|| pipāsitāya śrāntāya kṣudhitāya vivastriṇe | satkṛtya kiṃcid dātavyaṃ yajñasya phalamāpnuyāt ||38|| śrāddhe sthūlaḥ sthūlamatti pitaro’danti sukṛtam | tṛptimātmā svayaṃ bhuṃkte’nvitabrahmasamarpaṇāt ||39|| karmaloke tu kṛtvaiva datvaiva ca muhurmuhuḥ | pare loke hyavāpyante tasmād deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||1.41.40|| yeṣāṃ dāsyanti piṇḍām̐strīn bāndhavā nāmagotrataḥ || bhūmau kuśottarāyāṃ ca brāhmaṇoktavidhānataḥ ||41|| sarvatra vartamānām̐ste piṇḍāḥ prīṇanti vai pitṝn | yadāhāro bhavejanturāhāraḥ so’sya jāyate ||42|| yā goṣṭhe pranaṣṭāṃ vai vatso vindati mātaram | tathā taṃ nayate mantro janturyatrāvatiṣṭhate ||43|| nāma gotraṃ ca mantraśca dattamannaṃ nayanti tam || api yoniśataṃ prāptām̐stṛptistānanugacchati ||44|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne stotrahomāgnivṛkṣasthānādinirūpaṇanāmā ekacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ ||41||
<1.42> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha devavyavasthāṃ tu kathayāmi samāsataḥ || brahmaṇo mānasā devāḥ svarge sarve susaṃsthitāḥ || 1 || śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi tataḥ kiṃ kimabhūditi | sattapojanamahasāṃ pitṝṇāṃ puṣṭikārakāḥ || 2 || apekṣitāśca rājānaḥ prajānāṃ paripālakāḥ || lokānāṃ pālakāścaiva manavo’pi nirīkṣakāḥ || 3 || teṣāṃ kṛte nivāsāśca prakāśāḥ puṣṭihetavaḥ || vicāryeti svayaṃ brahmā hyabhidhyānamakurvata || 4 || nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ smṛtvā kartavyaṃ pratyapadyata || prathamaṃ tu mahattejaḥ pākaprakāśakārakam ||5|| dvitīyaṃ tu mahattejaḥ śakti puṣṭikaraṃ tathā | prārthayacchrīharestasmāt samādhau prāṃjalirmudā || 6 || tadā prāgeva dakṣādvai netrāttu śrīharestataḥ | kaṇastu tejaso jajñe brahmāṇḍānāṃ prakāśakaḥ || 7 || tasmātkaṇā hyasaṃkhyātā jātāścogratamāstataḥ | te’pi tattadvirañcīnāṃ brahmāṇḍeṣu praveśitāḥ || 8 || tatra tatra ca sūryāste jātāstejomayā iti | evaṃ sūryaṃ samāsādya vedhasā parameṣṭhinā || 9 || prakāśārthaṃ ca lokānāṃ svarge saṃsthāpito hi saḥ || tasmai cājñāpayāmāsa brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ||1.42.10|| sarvadā tvaṃ trilokyāṃ vai bhāskaro bhava tejasā | jīvānāṃ netramātrāṇi vastūnāṃ grāhakāṇi na ||11|| yatra nāsti prakāśo’tra vastūnāṃ grāhyatā katham | tasmāt tejaḥsuyogena draṣṭṛtvaṃ vai bhaviṣyati ||12|| tena lokasya yātrāpi sarvā darśanamūlikā | sampatsyate tu vai tasmāt tvaṃ divākaratāṃ vraja ||13|| evamājñāpitaḥ sūryastejodānena sarvathā | śaṃkamānaḥ kṣayaṃ svasya brahmāṇaṃ pratyabhāṣata ||14|| devadeva jagatkartastvadājñāṃ pālayāmyaham || api vai mama dehasya tejohāsāt kṣayo bhavet ||15|| vināśaṃ ca gamiṣyāmi śīghraṃ yadrakṣako bhava | rakṣaṇopāyamatra tvaṃ kuru me syāmavikṣataḥ ||16|| brahmaṇā tatsamāśrutya smṛtaḥ śrīhariravyayaḥ | sūryasyāpūraṇārthāya svayamāpūrako bhava ||17|| nārāyaṇo haristasya brahmaṇaḥ prārthanāṃ tu tām | aṃgīkṛtyābravīd devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ pūrtidaṃ yathā ||18|| brahman dadāmi bhadrante sūryasya mama cakṣuṣaḥ || yathā hyakṣayyabhāvaḥ syāttathā rūpaṃ prapūrakam ||19|| ityuccārya hariḥ sākṣāttejorāśirghanāddhanaḥ || hiraṇmayākhyaḥ puruṣo hiraṇyaśmaśrakastathā ||1.42.20|| hiraṇyakeśa ānakhātsarva eva suvarṇakaḥ | babhūva ṣoḍaśavarṣaḥ svarṇālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaḥ ||21|| muñcatsahasraraśmīṃstu lalāṭaṃ yasya kevalam || ūrdhvaṃ muñcallakṣaraśmīn mastakaṃ yasya kevalam ||22|| koṭiraśmīnpramuñcadvai śarīraṃ yasya kevalam || romṇi romṇi svarṇamayastejorāśiprapūritaḥ ||23|| rūpasaundaryamādhuryakalyāṇaguṇasaṃśritaḥ | mukuṭī kuṇḍalī sragvī svarṇaprāvaraṇānvitaḥ ||24|| akṣayyatejasa rāśiḥ sūryatejaḥprakāśakaḥ || bhagavānīdṛśo bhūtvā viveśārkasya maṇḍalam ||25|| pūrayan sarvatejāṃsi svīyatejaḥpravāhakaiḥ || raviṇā brahmaṇā cānyairmaharlokādivāsibhiḥ ||26|| pūjito vandito devaḥ ṣoḍaśātmopacārakaiḥ | sūryanārāyaṇastasya svarṇapuṃsa upāsanam ||27|| karotyavirataṃ lokacakṣurdātṛtvahetave || vakti stotraṃ prārthanāyāmidaṃ tejaḥprapūrtaye ||28|| oṃ namaḥ tejaḥprasavitre bṛhate’vyayatejase | tejasvibhyo’vyayatejaḥpradātre brahmaṇe namaḥ ||29|| yasya gāvo bhūriśṛṃgā ayāso bhānti varṣaṇe || īśanīṣu tadīśeṣu yasya bhrājyo’nvayaṃ yayuḥ ||1.42.30|| namo bhrājiṣṇave tasmai gomate goprasāriṇe | hṛttamodrāviṇe divyāsāya devāya te namaḥ ||31|| prakāśayitṛsamrāje svaprakāśakṛṇe namaḥ || namo bhāvittiviprāya jñānaprabodhasūriṇe ||32|| namaḥ śrāṇavidhātaste nama ātmasadātmane | namo rājiṣṇave dīvyan saptabhājanudāyine ||33|| namo bhaumāya raktāya namo divyāya vidyute | namaḥ sūryāya cogrāya namo hiraṇmayāya te ||34|| namaḥ khāneyasaddhemne nama udaryatejase | nama uḍupabhāvāya namo yāvatprabhātmane ||35|| namaḥ kāryasvarūpāya namaḥ kāraṇarūpiṇe | hiraṇmayāya devāya brahmaṇe paramātmane ||36|| tvaṃ sṛṣṭā tvaṃ poṣayitā saṃhartāpi tvameva vai | tvameva paramaṃ tejastejasvināṃ dṛgagrajam ||37|| sadā tejaḥpradānena rakṣa māṃ parameśvara || cakṣuṣmantaśca yāvanto bhajiṣyanti prabhāprabhum ||38|| tvameva bhagavān bhāvān prabhāvaॉśca prabhāsvaraḥ | tvameva netravān trātāmatrātā cāvinaśvaraḥ ||39|| maharcakṣuḥ svargacakṣurbhuvarcakṣustvameva hi | bhaumacakṣuḥ sarvacakṣuścakṣuṣāṃ cakṣuṣe namaḥ ||1.42.40|| oṃ oṃ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svastat oṃ tatsaviturvareṇyam | bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ||41|| iti mantraṃ tu yaḥ ko’pi japeddhyāyedatandritaḥ | hiraṇmayaḥ paro devaḥ sākṣādyāti tadagrataḥ ||42|| ayutaṃ japanāttasya svayaṃ sūryo mahānprabhuḥ || varado bhavate tasya bhagavatvaṃ dadāti ca ||43|| divyaṃ karoti taccakṣurudghāṭayati cāntaram | uttejayati cātmānaṃ sampādayati brahma tat ||44|| tasmāddhayānaparo bhūtvā japet svaśreyase sadā | stotraṃ sūryakṛtaṃ svopāstyarthaṃ hiraṇmayasya vai ||45|| tato vai brahmaṇā sūryo hiraṇmaya pumanvitaḥ || sarvamadhyāntarāle vai sarvatejaḥprado bhavet ||46|| tathā saṃsthāpitaḥ svarge jagaccakṣuḥ sa eva hi | cakṣuṣmantastadabhāve hyacakṣuṣkā bhavanti vai ||47|| sūkṣmāṇurūpabhābhistu cakṣurdevo bhavatyapi | cakṣuṣāṃ svakatejo’ṇupūrakaḥ sa pravartate ||48|| | rātrau divā ca yatkiṃcitprāṇimātraṃ bhaveddhi tat || svalpaṃ vā bahulaṃ vāpi sūryatejasvinetrakam ||49|| | divā ghanaṃ bhavettejo rātrau tu viralaṃ bhavet || taccāpi sūryasaṃbhūtaṃ tadāptāptaprabhāmayam ||1.42.50|| sūryāya tu jalaṃ deyaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ tathā || namaskārāḥ sadā deyā jagannārāyaṇo hi saḥ ||51|| hiraṇmayastu puruṣo lakṣmīṃ hiraṇmayīṃ tanum || saha svena ravestatra maṇḍale’rakṣayatsadā ||52|| | kalpānte ca yadā svargavināśo jāyate tadā || sūryo hiraṇmayo lakṣmīrdevyaḥ sūryāṇya ityapi ||53|| brahmalokaṃ tu gacchanti paramākṣaramavyayam | tatastatra nivāsāya śrīhariṇā svayaṃ kṛtam ||54|| hiraṇyākhyaṃ svakaṃ dhāma divyamakṣaradhāmani | tatra hiraṇyayā lakṣmyā sākaṃ hiraṇmayaḥ pumān ||55|| koṭyarbuda hiraṇyābhadāsīdāsaprasevitaḥ| rājate sarvadā rājādhirājaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||56|| tattu divyaṃ paraṃdhāma sūrye’tra sthūlamucyate | mūlaṃ brahmagataṃ dhāma tacchāyaṃ sūryamaṇḍalam ||57|| puruṣaḥ sa parabrahma svarṇaḥ sūryaśca cākṣuṣaḥ | dhyānākṣividyayā so’yaṃ labhyate mokṣakāṃkṣibhiḥ ||58|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mānasasūryotpattitatstotrahiraṇmayapuruṣādinirūpaṇanāmā dvicatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ ||42||
<1.43> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca yadā tu brahmaṇā dṛṣṭaṃ tejaḥ kevalamulbaṇam | sarvaṃ dahyedvinaśyecca puṣyecchiśyeta naiva ca || 1 || tatastacchāntikārāya puṣṭyai ca prārthayat prabhum | devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tāvannārāyaṇasya mānasāt || 2 || saṃkalpādvāmacakṣuṣṭa udbhūtaṃ teja alpakam | śītalaṃ poṣakaṃ tṛptikaraṃ cāmṛtavarṣi yat || 3 || tasmādekātkaṇānnānākoṭyarbudakaṇāḥ kṛtāḥ | golakāste mahānto vai jātā vedhasa icchayā || 4 || vedhobhī rakṣitāste vai brahmāṇḍeṣu svakeṣu ca || tatra jātāśca te candrāśca śaityaṃ drāvayantyataḥ || 5 || tasya tejaḥ prapūrtyarthaṃ yācito bhagavān yadā | prāha sūryanivāsena kiraṇena mayā sadā || 6 || poṣaṇaṃ dāsyate tatra pūrtiste tejaso bhavet | ityataḥ svarṇapuruṣastejo’rpayatyaharniśam || 7 || śāntipuṣṭikaraṃ peyamamṛtaṃ sukhasaṃbhṛtam | snigdhamānandabhratsarvaṃ tāpanivṛttikāraṇam || 8 || uṣṇaduḥkhāttārakatvāttārakaṃ teja eva tat | casya śaityasya saṃdānāt cāndraṃ tejo’pi caiva tat || 9 || tādṛśaṃ tu paraṃ tejomayaṃ candraṃ vidhāya ca || brahmā rakṣitavān svarge miṣṭānandāya dehinām ||1.43.10|| candro’pi sarvadā pūrṇaḥ sadaikasthitiko hyabhūt | paścātkālāntare strīṣu pakṣapātātkṣayaṃ gataḥ ||11|| punaśca śaṃkareṇāpi tadrogādardhatāritaḥ | tathaiva tasya yogyatvādardharakṣā kṛtā tadā ||12|| śrīlakṣmīruvāca kathā candramasaḥ strīṣu pakṣapātitayā ca yā|| kṣayaṃkarābhavattāṃ me śrāvayasva kṛpānidhe ||13|| kāśca tasya striyaḥ kati kathaṃ tatpakṣapātitā || kathaṃ śāpaḥ kathaṃ muktiḥ kathaṃ cārdhakṣayiṣṇutā ||14|| etatsarvaṃ samākṣasva paramāścaryamatra me || devasyāpīdṛśī pīḍā tava rūpasya he vibho ||15|| śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu sāṃgāṃ kathāṃ tasya vicitrāṃ kāmavegajām | śrutvā sāpatnyaduḥkhāpi tvaṃ māṃ maivaṃ kariṣyasi ||16|| brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putro dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ purā | manasā kalpayāmāsa kanyakāḥ sṛṣṭi hetave ||17|| saptaviṃśatikanyāstu rohiṇīpramukhā iti | dadau candramase yāstu nakṣatrāṇi bhavanti tāḥ ||18|| nāmnāśvinī ca bharaṇī kṛttikā rohiṇī tathā || mṛgaśīrṣā tathārdrā punarvasuśca puṣyakam ||19|| āśleṣā ca maghā pūrvāphālgunyuttaraphālgunī || hastiścitrā tathā svātirviśākhā cānurādhikā ||1.43.20|| jyeṣṭhā mūlaṃ tathā pūrvāṣāḍhā cottaraṣāḍhikā || śravaṇaṃ ca dhaniṣṭhā ca śatatārā tathā ca vai ||21|| pūrvabhādrapadā caivottarabhādrapadā tathā || revatī ceti candrasya patnyastu saptaviṃśatiḥ ||22|| sarvā divyāḥ kāṃcanābhā raktā dvādaśahāyanāḥ || tāsvapi rūpalāvaṇyasaubhāgyasadguṇorjitā ||23|| rohiṇī sarvadā kāmakuśalā prāṇahāriṇī || candro yathā yathā hīcched rohiṇī vartate tathā ||24|| netraṃ premabharaṃ tasmai darśayatyeva cittahṛt || mukhaṃ hāsyabharaṃ saumyaṃ sarvaśrṛṃgārataijasam ||25|| vakranetrabhruvorbhaṃgaṃ darśayatyapi cittahṛt || raktāvoṣṭhau phullagaṇḍau darśayatyeva śāntidau ||26|| puṣpamālāṃ kare dhṛtvā manojñāmarpayatyapi || stanau svalpau sughaṭau ca kaṃcukīdṛḍhatāṃ gatau ||27|| ramyau kesararaṃgāḍhyau yuvatī darśayatyapi | udaraṃ suvarṇavarṇaṃ kaṭiṃ tanvīṃ sukomalām ||28|| nitambau madhyakuṃbhābhau vāsastāralyadarśanau | alomakaṃ sūkṣmamadhyaṃ svarṇābhaṃ darśayatyapi ||29|| sakthnoḥ suvarṇayormūlaṃ mantharaṃ darśayatyapi | āgatya gaṇḍake tālīṃ datvā gacchati satvaram ||1.43.30|| parāvṛtya punaḥ kaṇṭhe hastaṃ kṛtvā ca cumbanam | spṛṣṭvā guptaṃ mukhaṃ datvā vilāsaṃ bhāvayatyapi ||31|| kvacidvāso vinā bhūtvā svātmānaṃ darśayatyapi | mano jahāra candrasya lajjāṃ santyajya sarvathā ||32|| candraḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣo’pi vīryasyākṣayaśevadhiḥ | reme reme punā reme tṛptyā reme punaḥ punaḥ ||33|| sarvadaiva tu rohiṇyāṃ reme reme punaḥ punaḥ | rohiṇyapi navaṃ saumyaṃ rūpaṃ cakre punaḥ punaḥ ||34|| ramitvāpi punā reme nānyāḥ sasmāra candramāḥ | kvacitkadācidanyābhiḥ saṃreme’pi tathāpi tāḥ ||35|| kvācitkādramaṇāttṛptiṃ na yānti rohiṇīva hi | sarvāsāṃ yauvane puṣṭe sadṛśe’pi tu candramāḥ ||36|| rohiṇīrodhataḥ sarvā bheje samatayā nahi | tatastābhiḥ prārthitaḥ svapatiḥ saukhyāya bhāgataḥ ||37|| tathāpi rohiṇī tāsāṃ saukhyārthaṃ nānvamanyata || svārthamātra parākrāntā pakṣapātamakārayat ||38|| tadā tvanyā udāsīnā hyakurvan śokamātmasu || kiṃ nāma kṛtalagnena yāsāṃ patisukhaṃ nahi ||39|| vegārūḍhayuvatvāḍhyakāmavyāptadvayorapi | yadi kāmasukho yogo na syāt kiṃ tena lagninā ||1.43.40|| pūruṣasya striyāścāpi yatheṣṭaṃ kāmatarpaṇam || na syād yadi kṛtaṃ tena lagnena viphalārthinā ||41|| kāmapūrṇaśarīrā yā navayauvanaśālinī || patyuḥ sukhaṃ labheccenna kiṃ lagnena kṛtena vai ||4|| vaidhavyaṃ vā kumārītvaṃ tasmāttu varamucyate || sati patyau na kāmasya sukhaṃ prāpnotyabhāginī ||43|| varaṃ tu kūpapatanaṃ varaṃ dahanamagninā || varaṃ tu garalaṃ bhakṣyaṃ kāmadāhanaduḥkhataḥ ||44|| varaṃ pitṛgṛhe vāso varaṃ sādhvītvamityapi | na tu patyau sati kāmāgninā hyātmapradāhanam ||45|| mā vai bhavatu kāsāṃcit patirnapuṃsakaḥ kvacit || vā mā bhavatu duṣpremā vipremā kṣaṇiko’pi vā ||46|| mā vā bhavatu sāpatnyaṃ śātravaṃ duḥkhamaṇvapi || evaṃ vilapya bahudhā sarvāstāḥ svapitugṛhe ||47|| gatvā nivedayāmāsuḥ patyurduḥkhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || pitaḥ kanyā na dātavyā premahīnāya śuṣmiṇe ||48|| pakṣapātapragantre ca rogiṇe’nyāsu śāyine || asmābhirnaiva gantavyaṃ candrasya bhavane kvacit ||49|| asmān samatayā candro bhajate naiva karhicit | pitugṛhaṃ yathā śuṣkaṃ patyugṛhaṃ tato’dhikam ||1.43.50|| śuṣkaṃ śuṣkāyate sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ ratisukhaṃ vinā || satyaṃ yathānubhūtaṃ vai vadāmaḥ sarvathā pitaḥ ||51|| jāmātā rohiṇīṃ te tu sarvadā bhajate muhuḥ || nāsmān kvacitkvaciccedvai tatrāpi naiva pūrṇatā ||52|| tato vayaṃ na gantāsmāścandrasya bhavane punaḥ || martavyaṃ naiva gantavyaṃ yatra duḥkhaṃ hi kevalam ||53|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne candrotpattistato rohiṇyāṃ pakṣapātenānyāsāṃ patnīnāṃ dakṣāya nivedanādināmā tricatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ ||43||
<1.44> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tataḥ paścād yadbhūtaṃ tad bravīmi te || pitā dakṣastadākarṇya para khedamavāpa ha || 1 || śanaiḥ śvāsaṃ parāmucya kanyāḥ prāha dayāvaśaḥ | samāgacchantu candraṃ tu śikṣayāmi punaḥ sa hi || 2 || naivaṃ kuryāt prakuryāttu sarvāsu samakāmanām | iti kṛtvā gatāḥ sarve candrabhavanamādarāt || 3 || dakṣaḥ prāha śaśindeva tvaṃ me śiṣyo’si suvrata | sujño’si kinnu bahunā vaktavyaṃ te praśikṣaṇam || 4 || sarvāḥ samānā me kanyā yuvatyaste’rpitā mayā | tava patnyaśca tāḥ sarvāstvayi raktā vilokya tu || 5 || sarvā bhaja samānā vai pakṣapātaṃ jahīti ca | sarvā nārīrbhajasva tvaṃ samakāmasukhepsayā || 6 || naikasyāmanurakto’bhūḥ sarvāsveva rato bhava | sarvāśca kāmaya candra tāstṛptāḥ syuryathā yathā || 7 || nārīṇāṃ kāmadāhasya yaḥ patiḥ śāntatāṃ nayet | smṛddhiḥ svargaṃ ca tasyaiva vividhāśca vibhūtayaḥ || 8 || bhavantyakṣatakuśalā vivardhante dine dine | patnīnāṃ prāṇadātrīṇāṃ raṃjanād raṃjanaṃ sadā || 9 || tāsāṃ hṛtkalpakād duḥkhānnaro narakamāpnuyāt | narasyaiva tu saddharmo nārīṇāṃ kāmaśāntanam ||1.44.10|| tanna kuryāttadā lagnaṃ kṛtaṃ kevalamṛtyave | varaṃ nāryā samaṃ nāryā lagnaṃ kāmadhurojjhitam ||11|| yadi lagnaphalaṃ na syānnāryāḥ puṃsaḥ samāgame | tadā nāryāśca vā puṃso lagnaṃ bhārāya kevalam ||12||| yadi lagne kṛte’naṃgānandaṃ nāpnoti mānavaḥ | dvandvārthaṃ tatkṛtaṃ lagnaṃ nābhūd ratyarthamityatha ||13|| nāryoḥ puṃsośca vā dvandvo lagnataḥ syāt kathaṃ nahi || kathaṃkāraṃ naraṃ nārīṃ racayed bhagavān hariḥ ||14|| kathaṃ vā cārpyate nārī narāya na naraḥ punaḥ | kathaṃ vā tatra gṛhṇāti naro nārīṃ naraṃ tu na ||15|| iti candra vicāryyaiva sarvāḥ saubhāgyasampadaḥ || tava patnyaḥ sadā sevyāstvayā saukhyapradāpane ||16|| candra omiti sammatvā dakṣaṃ saṃpūjya bhāvataḥ | patnīḥ sarvāḥ samāgṛhya bahudhāramayacca saḥ||17|| punaḥ sarvāḥ samāgṛhya bahudhāramayacca saḥ ||17|| kāle bahutithe jāte rohiṇyāmeva sarvathā | pūrvavat snehabāhulyamanyāsvalpaṃ punarvyadhāt ||18|| tadā punaḥ punastābhirdakṣaḥ samyaṅniveditaḥ || bhūtvā dakṣastadā kruddhaḥ prāha candramasaṃ hitam ||19|| candra tvaṃ śikṣitaḥ samyaṅ śikṣyate ca punarmayā | vartitavyaṃ tvayā sarvadāreṣu samabhāvataḥ ||1.44.20|| tadā tvaṃ sarvadā smṛddho yogīva bhava śaktimān | akṣayyavīryatejaskaḥ sarvāsāṃ samatṛptikṛt ||21|| iti te’nugrahaṃ kurve putrīṇāṃ snehatastava | yadi śāpaṃ sṛjāmi tvāṃ putrīṇāṃ duḥkhado bhavet ||22|| tasmāttvāmanuśikṣyāmi sarvāsu samabhāgbhava | sarvāḥ samyak saṃbhajasva yatheṣṭaṃ sukhado bhava ||23|| yadi pravartsyasenaivaṃ tadā kṣayamavāpsyasi || śakteśca tejasaścaiva kṣayaṃ duḥkhamavāpsyasi ||24|| ekayā kalayā tvaṃ vai jīviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ | evaṃ me vacane yāhi kalāpūrṇaḥ sadā bhava ||25|| iti dakṣakathitaṃ tadabhidhyāya punaḥ punaḥ || ramate sarvapatnībhiḥ sarvadā sa muhuḥ samaḥ ||26|| rohiṇī tu haṭhāttaṃ vai nirodhayati kāminī | svagṛhe eva bahudhā kāmanātṛptamānasā ||27|| patnyaścānyāḥ pratīkṣante mārgaṃ candrasya cāṃgaṇe | na cāyāti yadā nāthaḥ śapantyastāstadārudan ||28|| nāthe sati vayaṃ patnyo nāpnumaḥ kāmadānatām || anyathā tu tadā kanyā nāthe satyapyanāthavat ||29|| asmākaṃ yadi nātho na rohiṇyā api mā bhavet || ityākruśya ca tāḥ sarvāḥ śepurnāthaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||1.44.30|| kṣayaṃ yāhi sadā candra tejovīryakṣayastava | savīrye vā hyavīrye vā tvayi sattve’pi pakṣaga ||31|| nāsmākaṃ ṛtulābho’pi tasmād vīryakṣayastava | rūpakṣayo’pi bhavatu pakṣapātin karoṣi kim ||32|| atibhogakarī ceyaṃ rohiṇī rogiṇī bhavet | raktasrāvā pradarārtā rohiṇi bhava rogiṇī ||33|| itīdaṃ tasya patnīnāmulbaṇaṃ śāpavācanam | dakṣasyāpi vacobhaṃgakṛtāptadoṣamulbaṇam ||34|| candrasya tu tadaiva drāk kṣīṇaṃ tejaḥ savīryakam | ṣaṇḍhaścaikakalāmātrajīvanaḥ samavartata ||35|| sadā duḥkhī sadā tyājyo nārībhiḥ samajāyata | rohiṇyapi raktasrāvā pradarārtā babhūva ha ||36|| candro gṛhaṃ parityajya patnīḥ sarvāśca tatkṣaṇam | prāptastapaḥ samākartuṃ saurāṣṭre vāridhestaṭe ||37|| tatra varṣaśataṃ tepe tapaḥ paramadāruṇam | svasya rogavināśāya rogo naiva nyavartata ||38|| śokaṃ jagāma bahulaṃ vimanāiva so’bhavat || rohiṇyapi sadā raktasrāvādyāpi ca vartate ||39|| athātra samaye loke śatavarṣeṣu bhūtale | candrāmṛtaṃ vinā sarvā oṣadhayaḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ ||1.44.40|| kaṇā naiva tu jāyante tuṣeṣu puṣpakeṣu ca || pṛthvyā rasaśca kandeṣu mūleṣu na ca rohati ||41|| puṣṭistu sarvadā naṣṭā jīvāstadā tu duḥkhitāḥ || devāścāpyalabdharasāḥ ṛṣayaścāmṛtakṣayāḥ ||4|| brahmāṇamupasaṃgamya prārthayan duḥkhanāśanam || candrastatra mahādevaṃ śivaṃ saṃsthāpya yatnataḥ ||43|| punarvarṣaśataṃ taptvā śaṃkaraṃ cāprasādayat | prasannaḥ śaṃkarastasmai prāha kiṃ te hyapekṣitam ||44|| varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te sukho bhava sadā śaśin | candrastadāha nandīśaṃ deva someśvaro bhava ||45|| mayā prasāditaścātra tapastaptvā sudāruṇam | saurāṣṭre paścime prānte vāridhestaṭasannidhau ||46|| mama pūjyo mahādevaḥ sadā someśvaro bhava || mama dakṣavacojanyaṃ kṣayaṃ rogaṃ vināśaya ||47|| tava deva mahādeva pratiṣṭhā prakaromyaham | brahmādīṃścātra cāhūya kurve yajñamahotsavam ||48|| iti saṃkalpya candreṇa brahmādyā devatāstathā | ṛṣayo munayastatra prajānāṃ patayastathā ||49|| manavo devagandharvāḥ sūtamāgadhanartakāḥ || śaṃkarasya pratiṣṭhārthamākāritāḥ samāgaman ||1.44.50|| bhadrāvatyāstu nadyāstatkṣetraṃ dakṣiṇadigbhavam || ābhadrāyā āsamudraṃ kṣetraṃ mokṣakaraṃ nṛṇām ||51|| tatra kuṃkumavāpyākhyanagare saṃvasan dvijaḥ | patnīvratākhyaviprarṣirvedān nītvāgamattathā ||52|| parabrahāvatāro’yaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ svayameva hi || vidhinā somanāthasya pratiṣṭhānamakārayat ||53|| pratiṣṭhānottaraṃ brahmā tadā prāha triśūline | candrakṣayeṇa yāvatya oṣadhayaḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ ||54|| tanmūlāśca prajāḥ sarvāḥ kṣayaṃ yānti muhurmuhuḥ| tataścandrakṣayo nāśyo bhavatā sukṛpālunā ||55|| śaṃbhuḥ prāha tu tānsarvān gacchāmo dakṣamāturam || kathayāmo hitaṃ kartuṃ yathā syāt susukhaṃ jagat ||56|| ityāmantrya prajagmuste dakṣasya bhavanaṃ prati || svāgataṃ kṛtavān dakṣo niṣeduśca yathāsthalam ||57|| kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭhavāndakṣo jijñāsāṃ kṛtavānapi | mayi prayojanaṃ na syānnispṛhāṇāṃ mahātmanām ||58|| tathāpi mama lābhāya kṣemāya ca hitāya ca | bhavatāmāgamo bhāvyo dāsaḥ kiṃ karavāṇi vaḥ ||59|| ityāvedya namaḥ kurvandakṣaḥ prāñjalirāsa vai || somārthaṃ ca tadā śaṃbhuḥ prāha dakṣamidaṃ vacaḥ ||1.44.60|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dakṣakṛtacandraśikṣaṇaśāparogasomanāthapratiṣṭhāpanādināmā catuścatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 44 ||
<1.45> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā dakṣaṃ candrarogaṃ vināśaya | dakṣaḥ prāha ca me śāpaṃ hariṣyāmi tu śaṃkara || 1 || putrīṇāṃ somato nairāśyajaṃ duḥkhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | ko hariṣyati tadduḥkhaṃ nityajaṃ śaśinaṃ vinā || 2 || sādhvīnāṃ tasya patnīnāṃ duḥkhadāhakṛtaṃ punaḥ || śāpaṃ ko vārayed devo yatheṣṭaṃ kuru śaṃkaraḥ || 3 || ityāśrutya gurorvākyaṃ dakṣasya prayatātmanaḥ || śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā candraṃ dakṣaśāpo vinaśyatu || 4 || savīryo bhava śītāṃśo maivaṃ pakṣagamo bhava || atha patnīkṛtaśāpavināśāyāpi śaṃkaraḥ ||5|| revatīprabhṛtibhyastatkṣamāṃ yācitavānprabhuḥ || patnībhiśca tadā rogo nāśaṃ yāhīti kīrtitam || 6 || rogo vīryakṣayo naṣṭo na naṣṭastu kalākṣayaḥ | pakṣapātitvadoṣasya vināśāya kṣamāpitam || 7 || rohiṇyāmeva pātitvaṃ parityaktaṃ himāṃśunā | vīryakṣayaprapātitvaṃ śaṃbhunā samvināśitam ||8|| sarvāsu samagāmitvamaṃgīkṛtaṃ himāṃśunā | kalānāṃ kṣayagāmitvaṃ na nāśitaṃ tu śaṃbhunā || 9 || tadā candraḥ punardevaṃ brahmāṇaṃ pratyabhāṣata || pitastejaḥkṣayo duḥkhaṃ sarvaduḥkhādviśiṣyate ||1.45.10|| tejastejasvināmātmā tejaḥ sammānamucyate | tejaḥ kīrtiyaśo dravyaṃ mahattā tejasi sthitā ||11|| nistejā yo bhavelloke gaṇanāto bahiṣkṛtaḥ || tejasvināṃ tu gaṇane tejasvī parigaṇyate ||12|| anyaguṇaivihīno’pi tejorūpasamanvitaḥ | cakṣuṣāṃ tu priyaḥ syādvai puṣpaṃ kiṃśukajaṃ tathā ||13|| naikaguṇairyutaṃ cāpi rūpatejovihīnakam | cakṣuḥpriyataraṃ na syātkṛṣṇaṃ vyāptaṃ tamo yathā ||14|| śuklaṃ nīlaṃ tathā pītaṃ rakta ca haritaṃ tathā | kapīśaṃ karburaṃ ceti saptarūpāṇi tanvate ||15|| sarvebhyastatra śuklaṃ vai śreṣṭhaṃ rūpaṃ hi kathyate | tataḥ pītaṃ tato raktaṃ kapīśaṃ tadanantaram ||16|| haritaṃ ca tataḥ proktaṃ tato nīlaṃ tu gaṇyate | karburaṃ citrasaṃjñaṃ tu tataḥ priyaṃ tvihocyate ||17|| śuklaṃ tejo brahmaṇastu parabrahmaṇa ityapi | muktānāṃ brahmasaṃjñānāṃ golokādisthalījuṣām ||18|| rūpaṃ śvetaṃ sadā cakṣuḥpriyatākaramiṣyate | mama rūpaṃ sadā śuklaṃ tejaādhārakaṃ matam ||19|| vinātejo’pyahaṃ kṛṣṇo lohamṛttikayā samaḥ || tasmāttejo madīyaṃ me śāśvataṃ dehi padmaja ||1.45.20|| nāhaṃ tejovihīno vai sthātumicchāmi pūrvaja || tejohīnaṃ ca māṃ sarve tiraskurvanti sarvathā ||21|| nāryaścāpi madīyā na mānayiṣyanti pūrvavat || pūrvaṃ tejaḥsamudrekād vyarājaṃ devasaṃsadi ||22|| idānīṃ tejasā hīnaḥ kathaṃ yāmi suragṛhe || tejohīno na jīveyaṃ mriyeya vacmi cāntikam ||23|| soma ityabhyarthayati yāvattāvat tu tatra vai || oṣadhayaḥ samāyātā vividhā bhinnalokajāḥ ||24|| kāścidoṣadhayastatra kalaikāmṛtajīvanāḥ || kāścidoṣadhayastatra dvikalāmṛtajīvanāḥ ||25|| trikalāmṛtapā kaścitkāściccatuḥkalāmṛtāḥ | kāścitpañcakalābhoktryaḥ kāścicchaṭkalanāmṛtāḥ ||26|| kāścit saptakalābhoktryaḥ kāścidaṣṭakalāmṛtāḥ || kāścinnavakalābhoktryaḥ kāściddaśakalāmṛtāḥ ||27|| kāścidekādaśakalāḥ kāściddvādaśasatkalāḥ | kāścit trayodaśakalāḥ kāściccaturdaśāmṛtāḥ ||28|| kāścitpañcadaśakalāmṛtabhogāptatṛptayaḥ | prāpte tattaddine tāstā bhakṣayantyamṛtaṃ svakam ||29|| evaṃ vibhinnasāmarthyā vibhinnāmṛtajīvanāḥ || vibhinnakalayā puṣṭā hyāsam̐statra samāgatāḥ ||1.45.30|| oṣadhibhirvibhinnābhiḥ prārthitaṃ svārthajīvanam || hrāsavṛddhikalāyuktaścandramā yadi pākṣikaḥ ||31|| varteta tu tadāsmākaṃ jīvanaṃ cāpi pauṣṭikam || saphalaṃ sarasaṃ smṛddhaṃ yathābhakṣyasupoṣaṇam ||32|| yathāvṛddhi yathāpoṣaṃ yathārtavaṃ sabījakam || yadi pūrṇakalaścandraḥ sarvadā syāttathā tu tāḥ ||33|| kalā asahamānāśca naśyāmo vayamaṃjasā || sarvakalāmṛtasyāsya śaityāgnidahanākṣamāḥ ||34|| kumāryaḥ peśalāḥ sarvā nāśamāpsyantyaharniśam || tasmāccandramaso nityaśītatāsahanākṣamā ||35|| komalā hyaṃkurādeva mā nāśaṃ yāntu vallayaḥ | iti tāsāṃ prārthanāṃ tu śrutvā brahmā ca śaṃkaraḥ ||36|| candramoṣadhināthaṃ tau prāhatuḥ sukhakṛdvacaḥ | candra tvayāvadhāryaṃ vai vallīnāṃ prārthitaṃ khalu ||37|| svīkurve tatprasahyātra nānyo mārgo’tra dṛśyate | oṣadhyadhīnamevaiṣāṃ lokānāṃ jīvanaṃ kṛtam ||38|| oṣadhīnāṃ jīvanantu kalāḥ ṣoḍaśa te matāḥ | bhinnā bhinnāḥ kalāstāṃ tāṃ jīvayatyanvahaṃ yataḥ ||39|| kalādhāro bhavānproktaḥ sa cet kṛpāṃ na cācaret || sarvāni naṣṭā bhaveyurvai parasparatayā muhuḥ ||1.45.40|| tasmāttejaḥkalālābhe kathayāvastathā kuru || bhava pakṣe vardhamānaḥ pakṣe kṣayamavāpnuhi ||41|| pakṣapātitvadoṣaste kalāsveva niveśitaḥ || kalāyāste kṣayaḥ syādvai vīryaṃ te cākṣayaṃ bhavet ||42|| patnīpradattaśāpo vai vajraḥ kena hi vāryate|| poṣyavargārthyamiṣṭaṃ tu poṣyārthaṃ tyajyate na kim ||43|| paropakāraśīlāstu pareṣāṃ sukhahetave || nijārthaṃ svānukūlaṃ ca tyajanti paramārthataḥ ||44|| candra sarvāsu patnīṣu samānaṃ ramaṇaṃ kuru || mā niḥśvāsaṃ tu tāsāṃ vai gṛhāṇa sukhavān bhava ||45|| oṣadhīnāṃ jīvanasya puṇyaṃ gṛhāṇa pakṣadhṛk | evaṃ candramasaṃ kṛtvā brahmā ca śaṃkarastathā ||46|| devāḥ kalāhrāsavṛddhī tathaivāsthāpayam̐stadā | tadārabhya sadā candraḥ pūrṇavīryasusaṃbhṛtaḥ ||47|| reme nakṣatrarūpābhiḥ patnībhiḥ samabhāvataḥ || kalānāśavivṛddhī tu hayoṣadhiprārthite sthite ||48|| brahmādyāśca tathā devā hyagacchansvaniketanam || atha śaṃbhuryayāce taṃ candraṃ lalāṭabhūṣaṇam ||49|| brahmā prādādabdhijaṃ tatkalācandraṃ dvitīyakam | atrerjātaśca yaścandraḥ sa tu rājā tṛtīyakaḥ ||1.45.50|| te te candrāḥ prabhinnā vai bodhyā vibhinnakāryajāḥ | yāvantaḥ śaṃbhavaḥ santi yāvantyaṇḍāni santi ca ||51|| tāvantaścandramasaḥ syuḥ kalpabhedāt tvanantakāḥ || iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi candre’pi kṣayakāraṇam ||52|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne caṃdrasya tejaḥkalāhrāsavṛddhisthitikāraṇapradarśananāmā pañcacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 45 ||
<1.46> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi devasṛṣṭaṃ tu mānasīm | tatrābhimānino devānmānasānasṛjat tvajaḥ || 1 || ābhūtasaṃplavāvasthān nāmatastānnibodha me| āpo’gniḥ pṛthivī vāyurantarikṣaṃ diśastathā || 2 || svarg divaḥ samudrāśca nadāḥ śailā drumā latāḥ || oṣadhīnāṃ tathātmāno hyātmāno vṛkṣavīrudhām || 3 || lavaḥ kāṣṭhā kalā sandhirmuhūrt ca divāniśam || māsārdhamayanaṃ māsaścābdaṃ yugaśca sādhikā || 4 || sthānābhimānino devā ityetānasṛjat tvajaḥ || nakṣatragrahatārāṇāmabhimantrīśca devatāḥ ||5|| aṣṭāviṃśatikoṭīṃśca sasarja sukṛtātmanām | vaimānikāstu tāḥ proktā devaloke divaukasaḥ || 6 || devāśca pitaraścaiva munayo manavastathā || teṣāmanucarā ye ca manuputrāstathaiva ca || 7 || prasaṃkhyayā trīṇyabjāni koṭyo dvinavatistathā | saptalakṣāṇi ca tathā sahasrāṇyaṣṭa santi hi || 8 || devā hyete’bhimantārastattadgolakadevatāḥ | ādhipatyaṃ vinā te vai aiśvaryeṇājasannibhāḥ || 9 || jaṃgamāḥ sthāvarāścaite brahmaṇo mānasīprajāḥ | tuṣitānmarutaḥ sādhyān viśvedevām̐śca vidyutaḥ ||1.46.10|| stanayitnūm̐śca bhānūm̐śca vasūnaṣṭau tathaiva ca | 1 droṇaprāṇadhruvāgnidoṣavasuvibhāvasūn ||11|| siddhān yakṣām̐śca gandharvānasurān rākṣasām̐stathā || apsarasaścāraṇām̐śca piśācapretabhūtakān ||12|| vidyādharān kiṃpuruṣānaśvamukhām̐śca kinnarān | vetālān ḍākinīṃ caiva śākinīṃ yoginīstathā ||13|| vināyakaॉśca kūṣmāṇḍān vetālām̐śca grahānapi | yātudhānām̐stathonmādānmātṝrguhyakacāraṇān ||14|| prajāpatīnṛṣīṃścaiva nāgānsarpāṃstathoragān | khagānmṛgānpaśūnvṛkṣān girīnmartyānsarīsṛpān ||15|| sūtamāgadhabandīṃśca bhāṭṭamindraṃ yamaṃ tathā | varuṇaṃ ca kuberaṃ ca hīśānaṃ niṛtiṃ tathā ||16|| aṣṭasiddhīrnavanidhīn rudrānekādaśāpi ca | daityāśca dānavaॉścaiva mānasānasṛjat tvajaḥ ||17|| yajñānpuṇyajanān devavāhanāni paśūnapi | gaurajo mahiṣaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sūkaro gavayo ruruḥ ||18|| aviruṣṭrādayaścaite dviśaphāḥ paśavastathā | kharo’śvaḥ śarabho gauraścamaryekaśaphā ime ||19|| śvā śṛgālo vṛko vyāghro mārjāraḥ śaśaśallakau || siṃha kapirgajaḥ kūrmo godhā ca makarādayaḥ ||1.46.20|| kaṃkagradhravaṭaśyenabhāsabhallukabarhiṇaḥ | haṃsasārasacakrāhvakākolūkasakukkuṭāḥ ||21|| evamādīn nāmatastānmānasānasṛjat tvajaḥ | ādyaṃ sargaṃ mahattattvaṃ guṇavaiṣamyamasṛjat ||22|| dravyajñānakriyākṛdahamaṃ dvitīyamasṛjat | tanmātrāṇi tṛtīyaṃ tu dravyaśaktaṃ samasṛjat ||23|| indriyāṇi caturthaṃ tu jñānakarmātma cāsṛjat || pañcamaṃ tu manodevān ṣaṣṭhamāvidyamasṛjat ||24|| saptamaṃ sthāvaraṃ sargaṃ vānaspatyamavāsṛjat | aṣṭamaṃ tu gavādīnvai tiryañcaḥ samavāsṛjat ||25|| martyaṃ tu navamaṃ devasargaṃ daśamamasṛjat | tatra tatrāpekṣitaṃ ca gauṇasargamathāsṛjat ||26|| dravyaṃ karma svabhāvaṃ ca saha ojo balaṃ tathā | prāṇaṃ daśavidhaṃ cakre mānasān sa pitāmahaḥ ||27|| aśanāpipāse tālūṃ jihvāṃ vācaṃ hutāśanam | ghrāṇaṃ ca nāsikāṃ netre śrotre caiva diśo daśa ||28|| romāṇīndraṃ karaṃ pādau gatimānandaśiśnakam ||| rajo yoniṃ ca vāyuṃ ca mitraṃ yajñaṃ sahavyakam ||29|| pāyūṃ ca mitrakaṃ caiva bījaṃ vīryaṃ ca raktakam || nābhimapānaṃ mṛtyuṃ ca kukṣimantrāṇi nāḍikāḥ ||1.46.30|| tuṣṭiṃ nadīḥ samudrām̐śca puṣṭiṃ hṛdayamityapi || manaścandraṃ ca saṃkalpaṃ kāmaṃ tvacaṃ ca carma ca ||31|| māṃsaṃ raktaṃ ca medaṃ ca majāmasthi tu bhūtajān | ityetānmānasām̐ścakre prāk sṛṣṭau tatra viśvasṛk ||32|| tatra tatra tadāvāse devām̐stām̐stānatiṣṭhipat || āsye tvagniṃ lokapālaṃ vāṇyādevamatiṣṭhipatu ||33|| tālau tatra varuṇaṃ tu jihvādevamatiṣṭhipat || nasyaśvinīkumārau tu ghrāṇadevāvatiṣṭhipat ||34|| mahattattve tu vāgīśaṃ buddhidevamatiṣṭhipat || caraṇayostathā viṣṇu pādadevamatiṣṭhipat ||35|| akṣṇi tvaṣṭāramādityaṃ cakṣurdevamatiṣṭhipat || karayorindraṃ vārtārthaṃ hastadevamatiṣṭhipat ||36|| carmaṇyanilaṃ prāṇāya tvaco devamatiṣṭhipat || karṇayordik yathāyogyaṃ śrotradevamatiṣṭhipat ||37|| gude mitraṃ visargāṇaṃ pāyudevamatiṣṭhipat || tvaci kaṇḍūkṛte yāvadoṣadhīn samatiṣṭhipat ||38|| guhye meḍhraṃ mahānandaṃ brahmadevamatiṣṭhipat || hṛdi mano vikārāya candramasamatiṣṭhipat ||39|| mahattattve mahatsattvamahaṃkāre’bhimānakam || citte vijñānamādhatta mānasān tānakalpayat ||1.46.40|| mukhāttu brāhmaṇaṃ brahma bāhvostrāṇaṃ tu rājakam || urvorvṛttiṃ viśaṃ paddhayāṃ sevāṃ śūdrānakalpayat ||41|| brahmā svasya śarīre vai sṛṣṭiṃ sasmāra mānasīm || indrādayo bāhavo me diśaḥ karṇau dhvaniḥ śrutiḥ ||42|| nāsatyadasrau nāse cākṣiṇī dyauścakṣuraryamā || pakṣmāṇyahanī cobhe bhūvijṛmbho hyajadhiṣṇyakam ||43|| apastālū raso jihvā chandaḥ śirṣṇastathaiva ca || yamo daṃṣṭrā dvijāḥ snehakalonmādastu hāsyakam ||44|| apāṃgamokṣaḥ sargo’yaṃ vrīḍā cottara oṣṭhakaḥ || lobhastvadhara oṣṭhaḥ syāt stanau dharmo matastathā ||45|| pṛṣṭhamadharmaḥ ko meḍhraṃ vṛṣaṇau mitrakāviti || kukṣiḥ samudrā girayo’sthisaṃghāḥ śvasitaṃ jagat ||46|| nadyo nāḍyastanuruhāṇi bhūruhā gatirvayaḥ || guṇapravāhaḥ karma syāt keśā meghā manaḥ śaśī ||47|| avyaktaṃ hṛdayaṃ vāsaḥ sandhyā jñānaṃ mahattvakam giritramantaḥkaraṇaṃ nakhānyaśvoṣṭrahastinaḥ ||48|| śroṇirmṛgā vayāṃsi tu śaṣphāṇi manīṣā manuḥ | martyo
