nivāso gandharvavidyādhrāpsarasaḥ svaraḥ ||49|| smṛtivīryaṃ brāhmaṇāstu mukhaṃ kṣatrā bhujāstathā || viḍūruraṃghriḥ śūdro vai nānādravyāṇi karma ca ||1.46.50|| havyakavyāmṛtānnādiraso jihvā manastu hṛt || vikramo bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca chandāṃsi saptadhātavaḥ ||51|| tīrthāni nāḍyaḥ kāmāptiścaraṇaṃ hyudaraṃ mṛtiḥ || kośaśmaśrunakhyāneva śilālohābhravidyutaḥ ||52|| śiśna ānandaparjanyajalavīryasravā iti | pāyuryamaparimokṣamitra ityapi mānasīm ||53|| hiṃsā niṛtirnirayo mṛtyurgudamiti pradhīḥ | tamo’dharmaparābhūtiḥ pṛṣṭho’sthīni tu parvatāḥ ||54|| rakte’vyaktarasāḥ sarve prāk dhyātā mānasā ime | svātmanyevaṃ paraṃ dhyātvā mānasīṃ sṛṣṭimityataḥ ||55|| yogyasthānāni teṣāṃ vai kṛtvā datvā ca tānyapi | tebhyo hyavāsayatsarge devān tārāgrahādikān ||56|| bhūvarī yakṣarakṣaḥprabhūtapretapiśācakān | rudrān rudragaṇām̐ścāpi gaṇikāḥ samavāsayat | bhuvi martyānpaśūnpakṣigaṇān jantūnanekaśaḥ ||57|| parvatādau mahāraṇye gandharvāścāraṇām̐stathā | kinnarān kiṃpuruṣām̐śca vidyādharavihaṃgamān ||58|| atalādipañcaloke’suradānavadaityakān | mahātale kādraveyān sarpāṃśca pannagām̐stathā ||59|| pātāle tu mahānāgān brahmā vāsamadāpayat | eṣā sarvā mahāsṛṣṭirmānasī prathame yuge ||1.46.60|| yadyathāpekṣyate kāryaṃ tathā sṛṣṭistu kalpyate || brahmā vikalpya sarvaṃ tanmānasād vyākarottadā ||61|| aiśvaryasrotasaścātra īśvarāḥ satyalokajāḥ || saṃprajñāsrotasaścātra ṛṣayo jñānino’malāḥ || 62 || saṃtṛptisrotasaścātra pitaraḥ śrāddhatṛptijāḥ || saṃpuṇyasrotasaścātra devāḥ puṇyādisampadaḥ || 63 || sadhyānassrotasaścātra pretā vāsanadhyānajāḥ || samūrdhvasrotasaścāpi rākṣasā daityadānavāḥ ||64|| arvākprasrotasaḥ pṛthvyāṃ manuṣyā rājasāḥ sadā | tiryasrotasa evātra paśukīṭaprapakṣiṇaḥ ||65|| tamaḥsrotasa evātra nāgasarpādayo matāḥ | avidyasrotasaścātra parvatāstarugulmakāḥ ||66|| ityevaṃ daśasrotaskānsargān dhyānakṛtānpunaḥ || tatra tatra sthale loke brahmā samyagatiṣṭhipat ||67|| teṣāṃ tu bhojanaṃ svasmāccharīrātsamakalpayat | ṛṣīṇāṃ tu payaḥ chandomayaṃ bhojyamakalpayat ||68|| pitṝṇāṃ bhojanaṃ kavyaṃ siddhānāṃ siddhayo’danam || daiteyānāṃ surā proktā dānavānāmathāsavam ||69|| gandharvāṇāṃ tu saṃgītamapsarasāṃ tu saubhagam || vidyādhrāṇāṃ nabhovidyāṃ māyināmapyadarśanam ||1.46.70|| yakṣarākṣasabhūtādipretānāṃ māṃsaraktakam | sarpodīnāṃ tu garalaṃ paśūnāṃ yavasaṃ tathā ||71|| daṃṣṭriṇāṃ palalaṃ vṛkṣavallīnāṃ vividhaṃ rasam || girīṇāṃ bhinnadhātūm̐śca devānāmamṛtaṃ tathā ||72|| manuṣyāṇāṃ godhūmādi pakṣiṇāṃ ca vanaspatīn | jalajānāṃ jalajantūn sarveṣāṃ pāñcabhautikam ||73|| brahmaiva kalpayāmāsa yasya yādṛgapekṣitam | teneyaṃ lokayātrā cā nirvahatbhūtasaṃplavam ||74|| evaṃ yuge tu prathame sāṃgopāṃgaṃ tu sarjanam | sarva tu mānasaṃ kṛtvā virarāma pitāmahaḥ ||75|| sṛṣṭirvivardhate naiva navīnā jāyate nahi | yathā yādṛk tathā tāvat tāvadeva hi vartate ||76|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne devayakṣamānuṣapaśupakṣidaityadānavanāgasarpasthāvarādisṛṣṭitadabhimānidevādipradarśananāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ ||46||
<1.47> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca mayā sṛṣṭeḥ sabhāraṃbhe divase prathame priye | sṛṣṭistu mānasī proktā satyayugamayī hi sā || 1 || sthānābhimāninaścaiva sthānāni ca pṛthaka pṛthak | sthānātmanaḥ sa sṛṣṭvā vai yugāvasthāṃ vinirmame || 2 || kṛtaṃ tretāṃ dvāparaṃ ca kaliṃ caiva tathā yugam || kalpasyādau satyayuge’sṛjatsa mānasīṃ prajām || 3 || catvāri tu sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ tatkṛtaṃ yugam | sandhyāṃśau tasya divyāni śatānyaṣṭau ca saṃkhyayā ||4|| abdānāṃ trisahasrāṇi tathā tretāyugaṃ matam | sandhyāṃśau tasya divyāni ṣaṭśatāni tu saṃkhyayā ||5|| varṣāṇāṃ dvisahasrāṇi yugaṃ dvāparamucyate || sandhyāṃśau tasya divyāni catuḥśatāni saṃkhyayā || 6 ||| varṣāṇāmekasāhasraṃ yugaṃ kalimathocyate | sandhyāṃśau tasya divyāni dviśatāni tu saṃkhyayā || 7 || dvādaśābdasahasrāṇi caturyugaṃ vyadhādajaḥ | tatra kṛtayuge lakṣmi prajā mānasasiddhayaḥ ||8|| dharmādharmau na tāsvāstāṃ nirviśeṣāḥ prajāstu tāḥ | tulyamāyuḥ sukhaṃ rūpaṃ tāsāṃ tasminkṛte yuge || 9 || saritsaraḥsamudrām̐śca sevante parvatānapi | tadānātyambuśītoṣṇā yuge tasmiṃścaranti vai ||1.47.10|| manaḥsiddhyudbhavaṃ miṣṭamāhāramāharanti tāḥ || sarvaśaḥ kāmacāriṇyo mānasīṃ siddhimāsthitāḥ ||11|| na tāsāṃ pratighāto’sti na dvandvaṃ nāpi ca kramaḥ || viśokāḥ satvabahulā ekāntasukhitāḥ sadā ||12|| paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścaiva nityaṃ muditamānasāḥ || sarvakāmasukhaḥ kālo mano’bhilaṣitapradaḥ ||13|| uttiṣṭhanti pṛthivyāṃ vai tābhirdhyātā rasādayaḥ || balarūpapradāstāsāṃ siddhiḥ sā roganāśinī ||14|| dṛḍhapuṣṭaśarīrāstāḥ prajāḥ susthirayauvanāḥ || tadā satyamalobhaśca kṣamā tuṣṭiḥ sukhaṃ damaḥ ||15|| nirviśeṣāstu tāḥ sarvā rūpāyuḥśīlaceṣṭitaiḥ | satyādhāro vyavahāraḥ prajānāṃ jāyate svayam ||16|| apravṛttiḥ prajānāṃ tu karmaṇoḥ śubhapāpayoḥ | varṇāśramavyavasthāśca na tadāsan na saṃkaraḥ ||17|| rāgadveṣavihīnāstā vartayanti parasparam | tulyasiddhyāyuṣaḥ sarvā adhamottamavarjitāḥ ||18|| sukhaprāyā aśokāśca mahotsāhā mahotsavāḥ || nityaprahṛṣṭamanaso mahāsatvā mahābalāḥ ||19|| lābhālābhau na tāsvāstāṃ mitrā mitre priyāpriye || manasā viṣayastāsāṃ nirīhāṇāṃ pravartate ||1.47.20|| anyonyaṃ naiva lipsanti nānugṛhṇanti caiva tāḥ || akṛṣṭapacyaṃ vai sarvamavṛṣṭisalilaṃ bhuvi ||21|| aprayatnakṛtaṃ bhojyamanāyāptasadrasam | tatra prasavaduḥkhaṃ na na garbhadhāraṇaṃ tathā ||22|| nārīṇāṃ nārtavaṃ tatra nṝṇāṃ na vīryasaṃsravaḥ || sarvāḥ kāmadughā gāvaḥ sarvāḥ saṃkalpasiddhayaḥ ||23|| catudarśasu lokeṣu nirviśeṣāstu sampadaḥ || gatayo’vyāhatāḥ sarvā vācaḥ paricitāstathā ||24|| vaimānikā avimānā yogasiddhitapobalāḥ | īśvarā eva sarve te pūrṇakāmā iveti ca ||25|| dhyānaṃ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ jñānamucyate | pravṛtto dvāpare yajño dānaṃ kaliyuge varam ||26|| sattvaṃ kṛtaṃ rajastretā rajastamasī dvāparam || kalistamastu vijñeyo yugavṛttavaśena te ||27|| pādāvaśiṣṭo bhavati yugadharmastu sarvaśaḥ || satye yuge tu niḥśeṣe siddhistvantardadhe hi sā ||28|| siddhiranyā yuge tasmiṃstretāyāmabhavatpunaḥ || āpāṃ saukṣmye vinaṣṭe tu tadā meghātmanā punaḥ ||29|| meghebhyaḥ stanayitnubhyaḥ pravṛttaṃ varṣaṇaṃ sakṛt | sakṛdeva tayā vṛṣṭyā plāvite pṛthivītale ||1.47.30|| prādurāsam̐stadā hyāpaḥ kalpavṛkṣā gṛhasthitāḥ || sarvapratyupabhogastu tebhyastāsāṃ prajāyate ||31|| kalpadrumairvartayanti tretāyugamukhe prajāḥ | tadā rājasabhāvena tāsāmeva viparyayāt ||32|| rāgalobhātmako bhāvastadā hyākasmiko bhavat | yattadbhavati nārīṇāṃ jīvitānte tadārtavam ||33|| satye mānasasṛṣṭānāṃ mithunānāṃ sahasrakam | pratyekaṃ prāṇināṃ yattadidānīmārtavaṃ vyadhāt ||34|| tato vai harṣamāptāste dvandvībhūtāstu jantavaḥ | anyonyahṛcchrayāviṣṭā maithunāyopacakramuḥ ||35|| tataḥ prabhṛti tretāyāṃ mithunotpattirucyate | āyuṣo’nte hyekavāramārtavaṃ tatra yoṣitām ||36|| jāyate kāmabhogārthaṃ sugarbhadhāraṇāya ca | tattadā na suṣuvire sevitairapi maithunaiḥ ||37|| āyuṣo’nte prasūyante mithunānyeva tāḥ sakṛt | samaṃ janma ca rūpaṃ ca mriyante cāpi tāḥ saha ||38|| tasmin kṣīṇe kṛtāṃśe tu tretāyāṃ kāladharmataḥ || kṣīyante mānasīsiddhitapaḥśrutabalāyuṣaḥ ||39|| kṣīyante ca tadā yāvatkṛtadharmāḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || pādanyūnabalatattvasāmarthyasukhavaibhavāḥ ||1.47.40|| athendreṇa hate vṛtre brahmahatyātmakaṃ malam || nārīvṛkṣābilāsvetaccaturbhāgaṃ prasañjitam ||41|| tataḥ prabhṛti nārīṇāṃ jīvitāntaṃ yadārtavam | tadeva tāsāṃ pravṛttaṃ māse māse tadārtavam ||42|| tatastenaiva yogena vartatāṃ mithune tadā | tāsāṃ tatkālabhāvitvānmāsi māsyupagacchatām ||43|| akāle hyārtavotpattirgarbhotpattirajāyata | viparyayeṇa kālena tāsāṃ vikalanena ca ||44|| kalpavṛkṣāḥ praṇaṣṭā vai sarve sarvagṛhasthitāḥ | kvacitkvacit tvavaśiṣṭā āśrayāgatasiddhidāḥ ||45|| kalpavṛkṣeṣu naṣṭeṣu vibhrāntā vyākulendriyāḥ || gatvā kvācitkakalpadrūn abhidhyāyanti vastukam ||46|| tadā vastrāṇi sūyante phalānyābharaṇāni ca || teṣveva jāyate tāsāṃ gandhamiṣṭarasādikam ||47|| amākṣikaṃ mahāvīryaṃ puṭake puṭake madhu || evaṃ sarvaparikarāḥ pravartante prayatnataḥ ||48|| tena tā vartayanti sma sukhaṃ tretāyugārdhake || hṛṣṭapuṣṭāstathā tuṣṭāḥ kalpavṛkṣairgatajvarāḥ ||49|| atha kāle gamyamāne punarlobhāvṛtāḥ prajāḥ || vṛkṣām̐stānjagṛhusteṣāṃ balānmadhuphalādikam ||1.47.50|| tāsāṃ tenāpacāreṇa tathā kālabalena ca | praṇaṣṭāḥ kalpavṛkṣāste prajāstu nirupāśrayāḥ ||51|| śītavātātapaistīvraistatastā duḥkhitā bhṛśam | dvandvaiśca pīḍyamānāstu cakrurāvaraṇāni ca ||52|| kṛtvā dvandvapratīkāraṃ niketāni hi bhejire | yathāyogyaṃ niketāni sasyakṣetrāṇi bhejire ||53|| marutvatsu pranimneṣu parvateṣu nadīṣu ca || saṃśrayanti sma durgāṇi pradeśa śāśvatodakam ||54|| yathāyogaṃ yathākāmaṃ sameṣu viṣameṣu ca || ārabdhāste niketā vai kartuṃ śītoṣṇavāraṇam ||55|| ārabdhāni ca sasyānāṃ kṛṣikṣetrāṇi pārśvataḥ | tatra saṃsthāpayāmāsuḥ kheṭāni ca purāṇi ca ||56|| grāmam̐ścaivaṃ yathājoṣaṃ tathaivāntaḥpurāṇi ca || saṃpramāpyāṃgulaiḥ svīyairgrahādyaṃ cakrire tataḥ ||57|| kaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhavitastirdvādaśāṃgula ucyate | caturviṃśatibhiścaiva hastaḥ syādaṃgulairatha ||58|| caturhastaṃ dhanurdaṇḍo dvihasto bāṇa ucyate | dhanuḥsahasre dve tatra gavyūtiḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||59|| gavyūtīnāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ yojanaṃ parikīrtitam || etena pṛthunā rājñā sanniveśo’pi vai kṛtaḥ ||1.47.60|| dhanūm̐ṣi daśa vistīrṇaḥ śrīmān rājapathaḥ kṛtaḥ || nṛvājirathanāgānāmasaṃbādhaḥ susaṃcaraḥ ||61|| amito daśadhānuṣkaṃ gṛhaṃ madhyamavargakṛt || śatadhanuṣkaṃ nṛpateḥ samrājastu sahasrakam ||62|| ityevaṃ vartamānānāṃ gṛhaprāsādakeṣu ca || kalpavṛkṣeṣu naṣṭeṣu vārtāpāyo vicintitaḥ ||63|| vṛṣṭerjalāni khātebhyo nimnagāni kṛtāni vai | apāṃ bhūmeśca saṃśleṣādoṣadhyastāsu cābhavan ||64|| ṛtupuṣpaphalāścaiva vṛkṣā gulmāḥ prajajñire | kaṇā aphālakṛṣṭāśca prasaṃpūrṇā prajajñire ||65|| tenauṣadhena vartante prajāstretāyuge tadā | tataḥ punarabhūtteṣāṃ rāgo lobhaśca kālataḥ ||66|| tatastā jagṛhuścāpi nadīkṣetrāṇi parvatān || vṛkṣān gulmauṣadhīṃścaiva prasahya tu yathābalam ||67|| balātprasahya bhoktāraḥ kṛtvā svakīyameva ca | haṭhātprabalā gṛhṇanti cālpatejobhya eva hi ||68|| balaiśca prabalaiścaiva svakīyā vai kṛtā kṣitiḥ || alpabalāstadā teṣāṃ sevayā nirvahanti vai ||69|| te tu śūdrāstadā jātāḥ paricaryāparāyaṇāḥ | kṛṣiṃ kṛṣṭvā tu jīvanto vaiśyā jātāstathā pare ||1.47.70|| balāt pṛthvyāḥ praśāstāraḥ kṣattrā jātāstathā pare | śāntāstu sāttvikāstatra bhikṣāṃ yācanta eva ye ||71|| brāhmaṇāste tathābhūtā mahātmānaḥ śubhāśayāḥ || ityevaṃ karmato varṇā brāhmaṇebhyo vijajñire ||72|| evaṃ vipratipanneṣu mānaveṣu parasparam | tena doṣeṇa teṣāṃ tā oṣadhyo miṣatāṃ tadā ||73|| praṇaṣṭā hriyamāṇāśca nīrasā hyabhavan punaḥ || patrapuṣpaphalairhīnā śuṣkāyante samagrataḥ ||74|| prajā bhojyavihīnāstu vibhrāntāśca samantataḥ || svāyaṃbhuvaṃ prabhuṃ jagmuḥ kṣudhāviṣṭāḥ prajāpatim ||75|| vṛttyarthamarthitaṃ jñātvā brahmā samyag vicārya ca | kṛtvā vatsaṃ sumeruṃ ca dudoha pṛthivīmimām ||76|| tadā prajajñire grāmyāraṇyā oṣadhayaḥ punaḥ | vrīhayaśca yavāścaiva godhūmā aṇavastilāḥ ||77|| priyaṃgavo hyudārāśca kāruṣāśca satīnakāḥ | māṣā mudgā masūrāśca niṣpāvāḥ sakulatthakāḥ||78|| āḍhakyaścaṇakāścaiva śyāmākāḥ sagavedhukāḥ | kuruvindā veṇuyavā nivārā jartilāstathā ||79|| markaṭakāścetyaphālakṛṣṭāḥ sarvā matāḥ śubhāḥ || vṛkṣā gulmalatāvallīvirudhastṛṇajātayaḥ ||1.47.80|| ṛtupuṣpaphalāḥ sarvā oṣadhyo jajñire tviha | yadā prasṛṣṭā oṣadhyo na prarohanti tāḥ punaḥ ||81|| tadā brahmā prarohārthaṃ vārtopāyaṃ cakāra ha || kṛṣyā tu vārtayā tāstu kṛṣṭapacyā hi jajñire ||82|| karṣukāstatra vaiśyāśca rakṣakāḥ kṣatriyāstathā | paricarantaḥ śūdrāśca brahmārpaṇāstu brāhmaṇāḥ ||83|| gurutvaṃ tu kṛtaṃ sthānaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ kriyāvatām | rājyaṃ sthānaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ saṃgrāmeṣvapalāyinām ||84|| vaiśyānāṃ bhūmijaṃ sthānaṃ kṛyādiyatnajīvinām | grāmāntakaṃ kṛtaṃ sthānaṃ śūdrāṇāṃ sevayā dhṛtam ||85|| tataḥ sthiteṣu varṇeṣu sthāpayāmāsa cāśramān | gṛhastho brahmacārī ca vānaprasthaśca bhikṣukaḥ ||86|| cāturvarṇyātmakaḥ pūrvo gṛhasthaścāśramo mahān | trayāṇāmāśramāṇāṃ sa pratiṣṭhā yonireva ca ||87|| svasvadharme sthitānāntu sthānāni brahmaṇā svayam | kalpitāni ca tānyeva kathayāmi nibodha me ||88|| gṛhasthānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ prājāpatyaṃ mataṃ param || kṣatriyāṇāṃ bhavedaindraṃ nyāsināṃ brahmaṇo gṛham ||89|| satyaṃ tu brahmacārāṇāṃ vānaprasthagatāyuṣām || vaiśyānāṃ mārutasthānaṃ gāndharvaṃ śūdrasatkṛte ||1.47.90|| panthāno devayānāya teṣāṃ dvāraṃ raviḥ smṛtaḥ || tathaiva pitṛyānānāṃ candramā dvāramucyate ||91|| ityeṣādau tu tretāyāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ sarvābhyavartata || tretānte dvipādahrāsabalavīryasujīvanāḥ ||92|| dvāpare tripādahrāsabalavīryādijīvanāḥ || kalau yathākathaṃcijjīvanā vai sakalāḥ prajāḥ ||93|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne yugavarṣasaṃkhyākṛtayugasiddhipādahrāsamithunasṛṣṭinagarādimānabhakṣyauṣadhivarṇāśramasthāpanādināmā saptacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ ||47||
<1.48> śrīlakṣmīruvāca indrasya brahmahatyā tu kathaṃ jāteti me hṛdi | paraṃ kutūhalaṃ prāptaṃ tatkathāṃ kathaya prabho || 1 || pṛthunā ca kadā pṛthvī samīkṛteti kīrtaya | tatpūrvaṃ kīdṛśī devī samāsītpṛthivī prabho || 2|| śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi hyāditastāṃ kathāṃ śubhām | yā śrutā bhagavadyogātpāpahantrī bhavatyapi || 3 || brahmaṇo marīciḥ putrastasya vai kaśyapaḥ sutaḥ | kaśyapasya tvadityāṃ ca tvaṣṭā putro hyabhūcchubhaḥ || 4 || tvaṣṭā patnyāṃ racanāyāṃ viśvarūpamajījanat || viśvarūpo’bhavattatra devānāṃ tu purohitāḥ || 5 || ekadendrasabhāyāṃ tu bṛhaspatirupāgamat | abhyutthānādinā cendraḥ satkāraṃ tasya nācarat || 6 || tata ārabhya gururāḍ bṛhaspatirdivaukasām | paurohityaṃ tu tatyāja devānāmityataḥ param || 7 || paurohityaṃ dadāvindro viśvarūpāya tatparam || indreṇa tu kṛte yajñe viśvarūpaḥ purohitaḥ || 8 || devebhyastu baliṃ datvāsurebhyo’pi dadau rahaḥ | daityāstu mātulāstasya tasmācchannaṃ baliṃ dadau || 9 || pracchannaṃ tatpradattaṃ vai baliṃ jñātvā tu devarāṭ | cukrodha jagṛhe śastraṃ ciccheda tacchirastrayam ||1.48.10|| ekaṃ tu mastakaṃ tasya somapānakaraṃ hyabhūt || tacchedane tu sañjātāḥ pakṣiṇo vai kapiñjalāḥ ||11|| dvitīyaṃ mastakaṃ tasya kvāthapānakaraṃ hyabhūt || tacchedane tu sañjātāḥ kalaviṃkāstu pakṣiṇaḥ ||12|| tṛtīyaṃ mastakaṃ tasya cānnabhojanakṛt tvabhūt || tacchedane tu sañjātāstittirākhyāstu pakṣiṇaḥ ||13|| purohitacchiraśchede brahmahatyā babhūva sā || raktā kṣārā harit kṛṣṇā bhayadā citrarūpiṇī ||14|| vavalge sā mahendraṃ tu citravarṇo’bhavaddhi saḥ || tato devairmilitvā tāṃ caturbhāgairvibhajya ca ||15|| yajñānte’śrāvayatspaṣṭaṃ deyā vinimayena hi || brahmahatyāturyabhāgaṃ gṛhṇantu vyaktayastu yāḥ ||16|| tābhyo deyo varastāsāmiṣṭa eva na saṃśayaḥ || śrutvā tu kāmatṛptyarthaṃ nārībhirīpsito varaḥ ||17|| arthitaḥ kāmabhoge vai bahumaithuna sevane | kṛte’pi na śramo nityakāmabhogo’stu caicchikaḥ ||18|| devairevaṃ varaṃ datvā brahmahatyā caturthakaḥ || bhāgo’rpitastu nārībhyastadraktamārtavaṃ hyabhūt ||19|| tata ārabhya nārīṇāṃ kāmadevo navo navaḥ || māsi māsi rajolābhaḥ puṣpaṃ garbhadhṛgapyabhūt ||1.48.20|| atha bhūmyārthitaṃ yatra yatra me nimnatā bhavet | khātatā vā tatra tatra prapūrtirme sadā bhavet ||21|| imaṃ varaṃ dharāyai tu datvā bhāgaṃ caturthakam || bhūmeḥ khātapradeśāstu pūryante tatsvabhāvataḥ ||22|| tatra tatra kṣārabhāgo bhavatīti tu tatphalam | athavṛkṣādibhistatrārthitaṃ hyākasmikasthitau ||23|| kṣate chinne ca bhugne ca punaḥ saṃrohaṇaṃ bhavet || datvā drubhyo varastatra hatyābhāgacaturthakaḥ ||24|| drubhyo dattaśca teṣāṃ vai kṛṣṇagundrasravaśca yaḥ || na bhakṣyate sa vai kīṭo brahmahatyāphalātmakaḥ ||25|| athādbhiḥ svepsitastatra varo’pyarthita udgame || jalapūrtirbhavetprasravaṇādyeṣu samantataḥ ||26|| yatra dravye jalakṣepastasya vṛddhirbhavet sadā || tatra vāso rasarūpeṇāsmākaṃ bhavatāditi ||27|| tādṛgvarastu tebhyo vai hatvā hatyācaturthakam | datte tena jale bhūmau sarvadā pūrtirīkṣyate ||28|| jale hatyāsvarūpantu śaivālaḥ phenabudbudāḥ || ityevaṃ brahmahatyānāṃ bhāgāścatvāra īritāḥ ||29|| icchukebhyaśca dattāste hīndraḥ śuddhiṃ jagāma ha | tata ārabhya devendro yajñānkārayati prathān ||1.48.30|| athendrasya vivadhārthaṃ putraniṣkrayalabdhaye || hataputrastadā tvaṣṭā juhāvāgnau samantrakam ||31|| indraśātṛ vivardhasva jahīndraṃ cātra satvaram | iti homena tatraiva puruṣo ghoradarśanaḥ ||32|| samutpede mahākāyaḥ kālasannibharūpadhṛk || nityaṃ sahasra hastānāṃ vardhamāno’gradhūmrabhaḥ ||33|| kāntyā sandhyābbhrasadṛśaḥ triśūlaṃ bhrāmayan sthitaḥ || tāmrāmakeśajaṭilo madhyāhnārkogranetravān ||34|| garjaṃśca kampayan pṛthvīmākāśaṃ saṃlihanniva | prakāśaṃ bhakṣayannagre’ndhaṃ tama udvamanniva ||35|| andhakārasvarūpeṇa tena lokāḥ samāvṛtāḥ | sa vai vṛtra iti nāmnā tvaṣṭrāhūtastu dāruṇaḥ ||36|| taṃ devāḥ samabhidrutya nijaghnurdivyahetibhiḥ | astraśastrāṇi sarvāṇi so’grasatsarvataḥ svayam ||37|| vismitāśca tadā devā viṣaṇṇā naṣṭatejasaḥ || antaḥsthitaṃ prabhu devamastuvan bhagnavṛttayaḥ ||38|| namo’stu te śrīpuruṣottamāya brahmādhidevāya parātparāya | brahmātmane muktatanusthitāya namo’stu te trāhi bhayāvṛtānnaḥ ||39|| śrīvāsudevaprabhṛtīśvarāṇāṃ vaikuṇṭhadhāmādipatīśvarāṇām | sadāśivādīśvarakoṭikānāṃ śāstre namastrāṇamatho kuru tvam ||1.48.40|| tvayāsvapṛṣṭhe vidhṛtastu śailaḥ śrṛṃge svakīye’vadhṛtā tu naukā | tvayāsvadante’vadhṛtā vasundhrā sa eva devaḥ prakarotu rakṣām ||41|| vayaṃ visṛṣṭāḥ paripālanāya tannaśyāma īkṣāndhatamaḥ suviklavāḥ || śastrāstrahīnā ariṇārditā muhurdevādhidevo’raṇamārtihā kriyāt ||42|| iti stutvā viraramurdevā brahmapurogamāḥ | bhagavān śrīharistatrāvirbabhūva dhṛtāyudhaḥ ||43|| sarvāvayavasaundaryadivyadhyeyamanoharaḥ | daṇḍavatpatitā devāḥ punarutthāya tuṣṭuvuḥ ||44|| pāhi nātha mahāghorād vṛtrāsuramahābhayāt | hare tvāṃ vai prapannāḥ sma trātāramacyutaṃ prabhum ||45|| śrīhariruvāca indra yāhi svasti vo’stu dadhyaṃcaṃ yoginamṛṣim | vidyātapomayaṃ gātraṃ yācateti pradāsyati ||46|| śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ityuktvā śrīharistāvat tatraivāntardadhe tataḥ || devā gatvā tu dadhyañcamayācata muhustanum ||47|| dadhyañcā suprasannena paropakṛtiśālinā | śarīraṃ yogamāsthāya parityaktaṃ tadaiva hi ||48|| tadasthikāritaṃ vajramindraścādāya harṣataḥ || vṛtramabhyadravaddhantuṃ harṣayandevamaṇḍalam ||49|| tatra devā rudravasvādityāgnivāyavastathā | pitaraḥ ṛbhavaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāḥ kumārakāḥ ||1.48.50|| anye ca devatāstatra militā raṇagāminaḥ || asurāścāpi vṛtrasthā vṛtrapakṣaprapātinaḥ ||51|| namuciśaṃbarānarvaṃdvimūrdharṣabhakālayaḥ | hayagrīvaśaṃkuśiravipracittisvayomukhāḥ ||52|| pulomavṛṣaparvādihetiprahetidānavāḥ| yakṣāśca rākṣasāścāpi siṃhagarjanakārakāḥ ||53|| sarvaśastrakarāste vai gadāparighapāṇayaḥ | bāṇatomaramudgaprāsaśūlaparaśvadhaiḥ ||54|| khaḍgaiḥ śastraistathāstraiśca śataghnībhūśuṇḍibhirhi saḥ || sarvato’vākirankrodhāttumulaṃ vibudharṣabhān ||55|| teṣāṃ śastrāṇi devaistu bhagnānyeva sahasradhā || vṛtrapakṣāḥ palāyitā devāḥ svāsthyaṃ pralebhire ||56|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne viśvarūpasya hatyāyāścaturdhā vitaraṇaṃ vṛtrotpattirvṛtranāśāya dadhyaṃcāsthinirmitavajreṇa yuddhamiti nirūpaṇanāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ ||48||
<1.49> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca vṛtraḥ prāha prabhagnām̐stānpalāyato vihasya vai || he vipracitte namuce puloman śambarādayaḥ || 1|| dhruvo janmajuṣāṃ mṛtyuḥ śūrāṇāmapi dehinām || āgatasya svabhāvasya pratīkāro na vidyate || 2 || śūrāṇāṃ raṇamadhye vai śatrūṇāṃ prativakṣasi || kathaṃ mṛtyurna vai pūjyo yaśase śreyase tathā || 3 || mokṣadau tu matau mṛtyū dvāveva niyatau yathā | yogināṃ yogarandhreṇa śūrāṇāṃ śastrarandhrataḥ || 4 || ityevaṃ bodhyamānāpi vṛtrasenā palāyitā || nāgṛhṇāt taddharmavacaḥ prāṇāpattrastamānasā || 5 || tadā kruddhaḥ punarvṛtro vyājahāra sabhartsanam || kiṃ mātṛhantṛbhiḥ kṣudrairnāmadhāmavināśibhiḥ || 6 || pṛṣṭhamṛtyusamāsadbhirmātṛdugdhaviḍambibhiḥ na vai palāyane kīrtirna loko na parāgatiḥ || 7 || nāyaṃ dravadraṇaḥ ślāghyaḥ kṣullakānāmivārtidaḥ || svasthā bhavantu sammukhā jayaṃ yāntu mamāgrataḥ ||8|| iti śrutvā balaṃ prāptāḥ parāvṛtya tadā ca te || bhīṣayantaḥ surān śastrairardayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ || 9 || vṛtrastvindrebhakuṃbhe vai gadāṃ cikṣepa dhātavīm || gajaḥ prahāraghātena saptadhanurapāsarat ||1.49.10|| indro jagrāha vajraṃ tad daityabhrātṛhaṇaṃ yadā | vṛtraḥ prāha paraṃ kruddho diṣṭyā me samavasthitaḥ ||11|| brahmahā guruhā me ca bhrātṛhā śiṣyahā tathā | diṣṭyānṛṇo bhavāmyeṣa śūlena sādito mayā ||12|| śrotrīyaṃ ca guruṃ bālaṃ viśvastaṃ dīkṣitaṃ dvijam || khaḍgena hatvā te nūnaṃ kā gatiḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ||13|| hrīśrīdayādihīnaṃ tvāṃ gradhrāḥ khādantu bhūtale | mama śūlena nirbhinnamaspṛṣṭavahnikaṃ śavam ||14|| yadi vajreṇa naṣṭo’haṃ gatiṃ yāsyāmi śūragām || yadi śūlena naṣṭastvaṃ padamaindraṃ mama dhruvam ||15|| athavā kinnu rājyena nirayeṇa matena vai | rāgadveṣau na me syātāṃ śrīharirme prasīdatu ||16|| dāsānudāso bhavitā tava vajreṇa nāśitaḥ | saṃsārapāśaduḥkhābdhermocitaḥ syāmahaṃ tvayā ||17|| seviṣye bhagavatpādaṃ kariṣye bhaktasevanam || kimanena vinaśvarakāyalokapadādinā ||18|| mā bhūyānmama cittasya saṃgo gehātmajādiṣu || sarvadā mama saṃbhūyād vāsastaccaraṇādiṣu ||19|| ityevaṃ katthamānāya vṛtrāya prāhiṇod gadām || gurvīṃ parvatasaṃkāśāmindro vajradharastadā ||1.49.20|| līlayeva gadāṃ tāṃ tu vṛtro jagrāha pāṇinā | tāvadindraḥ svakaṃ vajraṃ prāhiṇod vṛtraśāntaye ||21|| taṃ ca lohamayaṃ vajramagrasanmukhagartayā | vṛtro’thendravināśāya triśūlaṃ samavāsṛjat ||22|| jagādādya hato’syatra pāpa yāhi yamālayam | indraḥ śatāravajreṇācchinat kṣaṇāt triśūlakam ||23|| yāvadvṛtro dvitīyaṃ tu śūlaṃ jagrāha pāṇinā | tāvadindro’nyavajreṇācchinatsabhujaśūlakam ||24|| ekena hastena tadā ca vṛtro vegena jagrāha ca śūlamanyat || cikṣepa cendrāya punastadānīṃ saṃgṛhya cānyaṃ parighaṃ tamāha ||25|| mṛto’sīndra gato’sīndra pūrvajānāṃ gamisthale | kṛtvā tu garjanāṃ ghorāṃ tatāḍendraṃ hanau pragham ||26|| hastāttu nyapatadvajraṃ maghavāpi bhramiṃ gataḥ || devāḥ siddhāśca śūrāśca hā heti cukruśurbhṛśam ||27|| vṛtraścendraṃ tadā prāha vajraṃ gṛhāṇa pāṇinā | raṇabhūmau gatānāṃ tu kā hrīrbalatulāpaṇe ||28|| āyuḥ śrīḥ kīrtiraiśvaryaṃ gṛhadārāsusampadaḥ naiva santīti kṛtvaiva viharasva raṇāṃgaṇe | 29|| sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ mṛtyujīvī mānāmāne jayājayau | sarvaṃ māyāmayaṃ jñātvā viharasva raṇāṃgaṇe ||1.49.30|| raṇāsanaśca śastrākṣaḥ prāṇaglaho’yamucyate | akasmādvijayaḥ kasya yāte prāṇe prapatsyate ||31|| śrutvedantu bhāgavataṃ vacanaṃ vṛtranoditam | tutoṣa paramaṃ tasmai vajramādāya pāṇinā ||32|| cikṣepa yāvad vṛtrāya tāvat sa daityarāṭ drutam || kṛtvādharāṃ hanuṃ bhūmau vṛtro divyuttarāṃ hanum ||33|| śīghraṃ savajramindrantu vṛtro jagrāsa tatkṣaṇam | hāhākāro mahānāsīccukruśuśca maharṣayaḥ ||34|| tāvadindraḥ svavajreṇodaraṃ tadvajrakartitam | bhittvā kukṣiṃ viniṣkramya hyuccakarta śirastataḥ ||35|| papāta bhūmau yāvadvai vṛtracchinnamahātanuḥ || nedurdundubhayo devamārge hṛṣṭā maharṣayaḥ ||36|| jagurgandharvasiddhāścāpsaraso nanṛturmudā | puṣpavṛṣṭistadā devaiḥ kṛtā vijayagītikā ||37|| vṛtrātmā paśyatāṃ tatra līno mahasi brahmaṇaḥ | hate vṛtre tadā lokā vijvarā hyabhavannatha ||38|| pratijagmuḥ svadhiṣṇyāni devā brahmādayaḥ punaḥ || vṛtraghātasamutpannahatyayendrastu duḥkhitaḥ ||39|| na ca śarma manāk lebhe hatyāṃ nāśayituṃ tataḥ | maharṣīn prārthayāmāsa hatyāṃ kva mārjayāmyaham ||1.49.40|| prāhustu ṛṣayastaṃ vai hayamedhena yājaya || iṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ mokṣyase pāparāśitaḥ ||41|| brahmahā pitṛhā gohā mātṛhā guruhā tathā | śuddhyati yajanād yasya nāmakīrtanasevanāt ||42|| evaṃ prerita indrastu brahmahatyāparādrutaḥ | udīciṃ diśamāśritya mānasākhye sarovare ||43|| varṣamekaṃ mahānāle hyuvāsa tāpapīḍitaḥ | cāṇḍālī ghorakṛṣṇā sā raktavastrāntracarviṇī ||44|| durgandhā paritastatra saraso’pyanvavartata || ṛṣayastaṃ samāhūya hayamedhena sarvaśaḥ ||45|| yathāvad dīkṣayāṃcakruḥ puruṣārādhanena ca | pūrṇe’śvamedhe saṃjāte hatyānāśaṃ gatā tathā ||46|| indro vidhūtapāpaḥ san svargarājyamagātpunaḥ || katheyaṃ lakṣmi divyāsti sūkṣmarūpeṇa matkṛtā ||47|| sthūlākhyānena te devi darśitā sukhasaṃśravā | sūryādigrahagatidā śaktirindraḥ samucyate ||48|| jalaprakāśarodhāḍhyā śaktirvṛtraḥ samucyate || jalaprakāśasāmarthyād grahāḥ sugatikāḥ sadā ||49|| vṛtro’ndhakārarūpaḥ sa gatirodhaṃ karoti vai || tannāśāya mahānindro yuddhaṃ karoti nityaśaḥ ||1.49.50|| viśeṣeṇa tu śaradi hīndro hantyasuraṃ tadā | iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ hatyāphalamaniṣṭadam ||51|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vṛtranāśottarabrahmahatyāvināśakahayamedhakaraṇādinirūpaṇanāmaikonapaṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ||49||
<1.50> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha pṛthvyāḥ samīkāraḥ kathaṃ vai pṛthunā kṛtaḥ | tatte vacmi mahālakṣmi katheyaṃ brahmadāyinī || 1 || āpo nārā iti proktā āpo vai narasūnavaḥ | tasya tāsvayanaṃ yasmāttato nārāyaṇo virāṭ || 2 || virājo nābhipadyādvai padmaṃ yadabhavanmahat | tatra brahmā svayaṃ jajñe dadarśa jālapūritam || 3 || kamalaṃ tu svakīyaṃ tajjale kardamarūpiṇī | pṛthivīkledimāvyāptā na raukṣyaṃ tatra dṛśyate || 4 || vinā raukṣyaṃ kathaṃ tatra pārthivajanisevinām | nivāso vṛkṣavallīnāmudbhavaścāpi saṃbhavet || 5 || tatastu brahmaṇā nārāyaṇasya stutirīritā | nārāyaṇa dayāsindho sarvādhāra prapoṣaka || 6 || vinā pṛthulabhāvaṃ vai jale sthāsyanti kāḥ prajāḥ | tasmājjale sthitāmārdrāṃ sūkṣmakardamarūpiṇīm || 7 || sthūlāvasthāṃ samānayya pṛthvīrūpaṃ kuru prabho | tadvinā mānavī sṛṣṭiścatuḥkhanyabhirūpiṇī || 8 || kutra sthāsyanti bhakṣyaṃ vā kasmātprāpsyanti ityapi | namo’nantasvarūpāya namo dharmadharāya ca || 9 || namaḥ sthūlasvarūpāya namaḥ sūkṣmasvarūpiṇe | namo’nvayasvarūpāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ ||1.50.10|| namo’kṣarasvarūpāya namo muktātmakāya te | namo vyūhasvarūpāya namaḥ kālasvarūpiṇe ||11|| namaḥ kṛṣṇādirūpāya namo hiraṇmayāya ca | namo vairājarūpāya namo golokavāsine ||12|| namo vaikuṇṭhavāsāya namo’vyākṛtavartine | namo devāya śāntāya sūkṣmatatvāntarātmane ||13|| namaḥ kāryasvarūpāya namaḥ kāraṇarūpiṇe | namo nārīsvarūpāya namo bījapradāyine ||14|| namaḥ pṛthusvarūpāya namaḥ salilaśāyine | namo’gnyarkasvarūpāya namo yajñamayāya ca ||15|| kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpānātha jalātsthaulyaṃ vibhāvaya | ityevaṃ stūyamānaḥ sa devadevo janārdana ||16|| divyaṃ śvetaṃ saumyarūpaṃ dadhāra kāryasiddhaye | sahasravadano devaḥ sahasralambadanturaḥ ||17|| sahasraghoṇanāsāsyaḥ sahasrakhurapādukaḥ | dvisahasramahānetro mahāromāñcagātrakaḥ ||18|| sahasrapucchavālardhiḥ sahasradvayakarṇakaḥ | mahāmerusamastatra babhūva kṣaṇamātrataḥ ||19|| prahasyājaṃ svayaṃ prāha jalānme vai pratāpataḥ | pṛthvīṃ sthūlāṃ kariṣye’hamānayiṣye tatastadut ||1.50.20|| mama vaktreṣu danteṣu lambamāneṣu sarvathā | amblamākarṣakaṃ piṇḍīkāraṃ sāmarthyamābhṛtam ||21|| mama dantasamāśleṣājalāni nirmalāni ca | bhaviṣyantyacirāt tatra sthūlabhāvaḥ pṛthagbhavet ||22|| kardamānāṃ piṇḍībhāvasāmarthyena tu danturāḥ | piṇḍān vidhāpya tānsarvānekīkṛtya samagrataḥ ||23|| kāṭhinyabhāvamāpannāṃ pṛthvīṃ golakarūpiṇīm || kṣaṇataścānayiṣyanti jalordhvasthāṃ tavāgrataḥ ||24|| brahmam̐statra nivāsastu sarveṣāṃ sugamo bhavet | ityāmantrya gato devo vārāhaḥ śvetarūpavān ||25|| jalamālokya kṛtsnaṃ tatsthaulyakardamasaṃstarān | piṇḍānkṛtvā svake ghoṇe sthāpayāmāsa koṭiśaḥ ||26|| ekīkṛtya ca tānsarvāngolakaṃ saṃvidhāya ca | dhṛtvā ghoṇadatormadhye hyājagāma jalopari ||27|| golaṃ pṛthvīmahāpiṇḍaṃ nidhāya ca jalopari | virarāma mahābhūtaḥ śūkaraḥ parameśvaraḥ ||28|| brahmā ca ṛṣayaḥ sarve nāradādyā munīśvarāḥ | tuṣṭuvuḥ kṛtakāryaṃ taṃ saumyaṃ pṛthvīdharaṃ harim ||29|| namo yajñasvarūpāya citīmukhāya te namaḥ | vedapādyupadaṃṣṭrāya tatkratuvakṣase namaḥ ||1.50.30|| analajihvāya darbharomṇe tapasvine namaḥ | brahmaśirṣṇe namo vedatadaṃgaśratisragviṇe ||31|| ahorātrakṣaṇadhṛge namaḥ sruvasutuṇḍine | namaḥ sadājyanāsāya sāmaghoṣasvanāya ca ||32|| mahate satyadharmāya namo vikramaśāline | prāyaścittarathāya oṃ ghorāya paśujānave ||33|| udgātrantrāya devāya homaliṃgāya te namaḥ | sthānabījāya devāya sanmahauṣadhaye namaḥ ||34|| namo mantrasphije bhūmne namo vedyāntarātmane | nama ājyaspṛje somaśoṇitāya ca te namaḥ ||35|| vedaskandhāya śāntāya havirgandhāya te namaḥ | havyakavyātivegāya namaḥ prāgvaṃśadehine ||36|| namo dyutimate nānādīkṣānvitāya te namaḥ| namaste dakṣiṇāhṛde yogine satrarūpiṇe ||37|| namaḥ pravargyavittādibhūṣaṇāya mahātmane | upākarmeṣṭirucirabrahmaṇe prabhave namaḥ ||38|| nānāchandogatipathajuṣe prāṇāya te namaḥ | namo guhyopaniṣadāsanāya savanāya te ||39|| iti stutaḥ paro devo hyāśīrdatvā tirodadhe | vārāhasya tirodhāne pṛthvīṃ dṛṣṭvā svayaṃ tvajaḥ ||1.50.40|| cintayāmāsa satataṃ sarvataḥ śikharānvitām | kvāpi nimnāṃ ca khātāṃ ca kvāpi pāṣāṇaparvatām ||41|| samyagālocya vedhāḥ sa punaḥ sasmāra taṃ prabhum | tadā pṛthusvarūpeṇa sadhanuṣkaḥ sa ābabhau ||42|| tasya dakṣakare cakradhanuṣościhnamīkṣitam || brahmaṇā niścito devo bhagavānayamityatha ||43|| pṛthivyāḥ pravibhāgīya pṛthvīṃ nātha samīkuru | ityarthitaḥ pṛthurdevastadā saṃvartakāgninā ||44|| dāhayāmāsa bhūtuṇḍān viśīrṇā bhasmasaṃcayāḥ | jātāḥ sarve mṛdavaste mṛttikāstāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||45|| samīkṛtya mahīṃ sarvāṃ mṛttikāstaraśobhanām | bījānyādhāya tatsthalyāṃ sasyasampatkarīṃ vyadhāt || 46|| yatrādagdhāstu pāṣāṇāstatra tatparvatānvyadhāt | yatra nimnapradeśāstu tatra sārasakān vyadhāt ||47|| pṛthunā tu bhagavatā nārāyaṇamahātmanā | svena kṣetrāṇyaraṇyāni grāmanagarakharvaṭāḥ ||48|| khātākhātāḥ samudrāśca nadyo nadamahāplavāḥ | kṛtāḥ samayamālokya yatrāvaśyakatā yathā ||49|| lokānprakalpayitvā ca prajāsargaṃ sasarja saḥ | pṛthuḥ rājyaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā vyavasthāṃ vāsadāyinīm ||1.50.50|| kṛtvā ca brahmaṇe datvā svayamantarbabhūva ha || tata ārabhya sapaṭā samānā ca samasthalī ||51|| babhūva mahatī devī pṛthvī yogyavasānakā | punarnāśe punardevaḥ pṛthurbhūtvā hariḥ svayam ||52|| kariṣyati samāṃ pṛthvīṃ rājā bhūtvā muhurmuhuḥ | brahmaṇaḥ khalu kalpānte daśalokātmikā tu bhūḥ ||53|| layaṃ jale yadā yāyāt tadā tatra muhurmuhuḥ | svayaṃ hariḥ pṛthurbhūtvā pṛthvīṃ samīkariṣyati ||54|| kadācit pṛthuścāhaṃ mānasaḥ saṃbhavāmi ha | kadācittu ṛṣibhyo vā rājabhyo vā janigrahaḥ ||55|| iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ pṛthurūpaṃ mayā dhṛtam | atha vai dvāparānte tu kimabhūt kathayāmi te ||56|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jalaśāyinārāyaṇena vārāharūpeṇa pṛthvyuddhāraḥ pṛthurūpeṇa pṛthvīsamīkaraṇādinirūpaṇanāmā paṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 50 ||
<1.51> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi prajā yāstu syurvai mithunadharmajāḥ | vedhaso’bhidhyāyato vai patiḥ patnī babhūvatuḥ || 1 || prāk ca svāyaṃbhuvamanuḥ śatarūpā ca tadvadhūḥ | tābhyāṃ mithunadharmeṇa prajā hyedhāmbabhūvire ||2|| labdhvā svāyaṃbhuvaḥ patnīṃ reme sārdhaṃ tayā muhuḥ | prathamaṃ samprayogaḥ saḥ kalpādau samavartata || 3 || priyavratottānapādau tayoḥ putrau babhūvatuḥ | ākūtiśca prasūtiśca dve kanye ca babhūvatuḥ || 4 || dadau prasūtiṃ dakṣāya ākūtiṃ rucaye dadau | ākūtyāṃ mithunaṃ jajñe yajñaścāpi ca dakṣiṇā || 5 || tābhyāṃ prajāstu yāmākhyā devā dvādaśa jajñire| dakṣātprasūtyāṃ kanyāstu caturviṃśatijajñire || 6 || sarvāstā brahmavādinyo yoginyo lokamātaraḥ | śraddhā lakṣmīrdhṛtistuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirmedhā kriyā tathā || 7 || buddhirlajjā vapuḥ śāntiḥ siddhiḥ kīrtistrayodaśī | etāstu pratijagrāha dharmaḥ patnyarthameva hi || 8 || tābhyaḥ śiṣṭā yavīryasya ekādaśa sulocanāḥ | khyātiḥ satyatha saṃbhūtiḥ smṛtiḥ prītiḥ kṣamā tathā || 9 || sannatiścānasūyā ca ūrjā svāhā svadhā tathā | tāstataḥ pratyapadyanta ekādaśa maharṣayaḥ ||1.51.10|| bhavo bhṛgurmarīciśca hyaṃ girāḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ | pulastyo’trirvaśiṣṭhaśca pitaro’gnistathaiva te ||11|| satī bhavāya prāyacchatkhyātiṃ ca bhṛgave tathā | marīcaye tu saṃbhūtiṃ smṛtimaṃgīrase dadau ||12|| prītiṃ dadau pulastyāya kṣamāṃ tu pulahāya ca | kratave sannatiṃ caiva hyanasūyāṃ tathātraye ||13|| ūrjāṃ dadau vaśiṣṭhāya svāhāṃ ca hyagnaye dadau | svadhāṃ caiva pitṛbhyastu tāsvapatyāni maithunāt ||14|| śraddhāṃ kāmaṃ vijajñe vai darpo lakṣmyāḥ sutaḥ smṛtaḥ | dhṛtestu niyamaḥ putrastuṣṭyāḥ santoṣa ucyate ||15|| puṣṭyā lābhaḥ sutaścāpi medhāputraḥ śrutastathā | kriyāyāstu nayaḥ prokto daṇḍaḥ samaya ityapi ||16|| buddherbodhaḥ sutaścāpi hyapramādaśca tāvubhau | lajjāyā vinayaḥ putro vyavasāyo vapuḥsutaḥ ||17|| kṣemaḥ śantisutaścāpi sukha siddhervyajāyata | yaśaḥ kīrteḥ sutaścāpi hītyete dharmasūnavaḥ ||18|| kāmasya harṣaḥ putrau vai devyāṃ ratyāṃ vyajāyata | ityeṣo vai sukhodarkaḥ sargo dharmasya maithunāt ||19|| bhavaḥ satyāmasaṃkhyātān rudrān raudrānsamasṛjat | brahmaṇā mā sṛjetyukte hyūrdhvaretāḥ sthito haraḥ ||1.51.20|| tataḥ prabhṛti śaṃbhustu prāsūyata na vai prajāḥ | brahmacārī sthitaḥ sthāṇuryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam ||21|| jñānaṃ vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ | sṛṣṭṛtvamātmasaṃbodhastvadhiṣṭhātṛtvameva ca ||22|| aiśvaryāṇi daśaitāni nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti śaṃkare | sarvadā bhānayuktatvād yuktayogī maheśvaraḥ ||23|| maheśvaraprasādādvai trīdaṇḍī jāyate naraḥ | vākdaṇḍaḥ karmadaṇḍaśca manodaṇḍaśca te trayaḥ ||24|| yasyaite niyatā daṇḍāstridaṇḍī mukta eva saḥ | ariṣṭāni svayaṃ jñātvā mṛtyu paśyati cātmanaḥ ||25|| śṛṇu lakṣmi prasaṃgādvai tāni vakṣyāmi kṛtsnaśaḥ | vijñāyeta yadaivaṃ tajjñātavyaṃ maraṇaṃ svakam ||26|| arundhatīṃ dhruvaṃ caiva somacchāyāṃ sitampatham | yo na paśyet sa no jīvennaraḥ saṃvatsarātparam ||27|| araśmivantamādityaṃ raśmivantaṃ ca pāvakam | yaḥ paśyenna sa jīvedvai māsādekādaśātparam ||28|| vamenmūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā | pratyakṣamathavā svapne daśamāsān sa jīvati ||29|| agrataḥ pṛṣṭhato vāpi khaṇḍaṃ yasya padaṃ bhavet | pāṃsule kardame vāpi saptamāsān sa jīvati ||1.51.30|| kākaḥ kapoto gṛdhro vā nilayed yasya mūrdhani | kravyādo vā khagaḥ kaścit ṣaṇmāsān nātivartate ||31|| badhyeta vāyasapaṃktyāṃ pāṃśuvarṣeṇa vā punaḥ | chāyāṃ vā vikṛtāṃ paśyeccatuḥ paṃca sa jīvati ||32|| anabhre vidyutaṃ paśyed dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritām || udakendradhanurvāpi trayo dvau vā sa jīvati ||33|| apsu vā yadi vādarśe ātmānaṃ yo na paśyati | aśiraskaṃ tathātmānaṃ māsādūrdhvaṃ na jīvati ||34|| śavagandhi bhavedgātraṃ vasāgandhi hyathāpi vā | mṛtyurhyupasthitastasya cārdhamāsaṃ sajīvati ||35|| yasya vai snātamātrasya hṛtpādau vāvaśuṣyataḥ | dhūmaṃ vā mastakātpaśyed daśāhaṃ na sa jīvati ||36|| saṃbhinno māruto yasya marmasthānāni kṛntati || adbhiḥ spṛṣṭo na hṛṣyecca tasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ ||37|| ṛkṣājavānarayuktarathenāśāṃ tu dakṣiṇām | gatyannatha vrajet svapne vidyānmṛtyurupasthitaḥ ||38|| kṛṣṇāmbaradharā śyāmā gāyikā vātha cāṃganā | yaṃ nayed dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ svapne so’pi na jīvati ||39|| chidraṃ vāsaśca kṛṣṇaṃ ca svapne yo bibhṛyānnaraḥ | bhagnaṃ vā śravaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā vidyānmṛtyurupasthitaḥ ||1.51.40|| āmastakatalād yastu nimajjetpaṃkasāgare | dṛṣṭvā tu tādṛśaṃ svapnaṃ sadya eva na jīvati ||41|| bhasmāṃgārām̐śca keśām̐śca nadīṃ śuṣkāṃ bhujaṃgamān | paśyed yo daśarātraṃ tu na sa jīvettu tādṛśaḥ ||42|| kṛṣṇaiśca vikaṭaiścaiva puruṣairudyatāyudhaiḥ | pāṣāṇaistāḍyate svapne yaḥ sadyo na sa jīvati ||43|| sūryodaye pratyūṣasi pratyakṣaṃ yasya vai śivā | krośantī sammukhābhyeti sa gatāyurbhavennaraḥ ||44|| yasya vai snātamātrasya hṛdayaṃ pīḍyate bhṛśam | jāyate dantaharṣaśca taṃ gatāyuṣamādiśet ||45|| bhūyo bhūyaḥ śvased yastu rātrau vā yadi vā divā | dīpagandhaṃ ca no vetti vidyānmṛtyumupasthitam ||46|| rātrau cedrāyudhaṃ paśyed divā nakṣatramaṇḍalam | paranetreṣu cātmānaṃ na paśyenna sa jīvati ||47|| netramekaṃ sraved yasya karṇau ca bhraśyataḥ sthalāt| nāsā tu vakrā bhavati sa jñeyo gatajīvitaḥ ||48|| yasya kṛṣṇā kharā jihvā paṃkabhāsaṃ ca vai mukham | gaṇḍe cipiṭake rakte tasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ ||49|| muktākeśo hasaṃścaiva gāyannṛtyam̐śca yo naraḥ | yāmyāśābhimukho gacchettadantaṃ tasya jīvitam ||1.51.50|| yasya svedasamudbhūtāḥ śvetasarṣabhasannibhāḥ| svedā bhavanti hyasakṛt tasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ ||51|| uṣṭrā vā rāsabhā vāpi yuktāḥ svapne rathe’śubhāḥ | yasya so’pi na jīvedvai dakṣiṇābhimukho gataḥ ||52|| ghoṣaṃ na śṛṇuyātkarṇe jyotirnetre na paśyati | dūraṃ dṛṣṭirna ca yāti raktaṃ dṛśyeta maṇḍalam ||53|| mukhe coṣmākṛṣṭanābhiḥ proṣṇamutro na jīvati | śvabhre yo nipatet svapne dvāraṃ cāsya na vidyate ||54|| na cottiṣṭhati yaḥ śvabhrāt tadantaṃ tasya jīvitam | divā vā yadi vā rātrau pratyakṣaṃ yo’bhihanyate ||55|| taṃ paśyedatha hantāraṃ sa hatastu na jīvati | agnipraveśaṃ kurute svapnānte yastu mānavaḥ ||56|| smṛtiṃ nopalabheccāpi tadantaṃ tasya jīvitam | yastu prāvaraṇaṃ śuklaṃ svakaṃ paśyati mānavaḥ ||57|| raktaṃ kṛṣṇamapi svapne tasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ | raktaikavastrāṃ nagnāṃ vā snāpayantīṃ striyaṃ tu yaḥ ||58|| svapne paśyatyāliṃgantīmatha vā sa na jīvati | svapne karālakṛṣṇaṃ tu dūtaṃ dṛṣṭvā na jīvati ||59|| chinnaṃ svamastakaṃ haste nītvā gacchati yo raṇe | svapne paśyati śūrātmā tasyāvaśyaṃ mṛtiḥ smṛtā ||1.51.60|| vātavege jalaughe vā jvālāmukhe ca bhūtale | yantre vṛkṣe paśau saudhe praveśaḥ patanaṃ ca vā ||61|| mardanaṃ mūrchanā vāpi svapne paśyettu yo naraḥ || tasyāsannamṛtirbodhyā vidyatpātābhimarśinaḥ ||62|| pravāse śakune kṛṣṇasarpasammukhadarśanam | maraṇāpādakaṃ mṛtyusamakaṣṭapradaṃ ca vā ||63|| agre tu rajako yāti pṛṣṭhe cāyāti nāpitaḥ | madhye kadā na gantavyaṃ mṛtirvā kāryanāśanam ||64|| svapne rauti sveṣṭadevaḥ pitā mātā virautyapi | mahāduḥkhaṃ bhaved yadvā mṛtistatra hyupasthitā ||65|| patet siṃhāsanādrājā rudanti devamūrtayaḥ | dhūmraketorudayanaṃ tvasaṃkhyajananāśakāḥ ||66|| kākaḥ siṃhāsane rauti rauti śvā sanmukhaṃ sthitaḥ | gavādīnāṃ vihvalatā jñāpayanti bhayaṃ drutam ||67|| prasthāne hyalūkadṛśiḥ kṛṣṇasarpadṛśistathā | chinnanaso dṛśiśceti jñāpayanti mṛtiṃ muhuḥ ||68|| cihnānyevaṃ parijñāya mṛtiṃ niścitya cātmanaḥ | ātmānaṃ brahmaṇā yujyād harermūrtiparo bhavet ||69|| bhogyaṃ dehaṃ tu nāryuktā nara ātmā svayaṃ mataḥ | nārīṃ tyaktvā naro bhaktyā nārāyaṇaṃ samaśnute ||1.51.70| nānyamālocayet kiṃcinnānyavṛttiṃ vibhāvayet | ātmavṛttyā parātmānaṃ svaṃ nijaṃ samabhāvayet ||71|| na kasmaicidbhayaṃ dadyātsarvasyābhayakṛdbhavet | bhayaṃ drohaśca hiṃsā ca pāpameva hi sarvathā ||72|| ahiṃsā paramo dharmaḥ paralokasahāyakṛt | bhayaṃ hiṃsā na vai dharmaḥ paralokātprapātakaḥ ||73|| vasoruttānapādaistu hiṃsāyajñasya kīrtanāt || svargāt pāto’bhavacchīghraṃ pṛthivyāṃ ca layo’bhavat ||74|| tasmād dveṣaṃ yathā tadvad rāgaṃ caiva parityajet | ātmanātmānamālambya brahmamārgaṃ parivrajet ||75|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mithunīsṛṣṭimaraṇasūcakasvapnādipradarśananāmaikapaṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ||51||
<1.52> śrī lakṣmīruvāca kadā yajñaḥ pravṛttaḥ sa kimabhūttatra pāpakṛt | kena kṛtaḥ kathaṃ vasoḥ patanaṃ samabhūtkutaḥ || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca prathame tu yuge tretānāmake rājacihnavān | uttānapādaputrastu vasunāmābhavannṛpaḥ || 2 || viṣṇoraṃśena jāyante pṛthivyāṃ cakravartinaḥ | ājānubāhavaścaiva dhanurhastā vṛṣāṃkitāḥ || 3 || tāmraprabhauṣṭhadantauṣṭhāḥ śrīvatsāścordhvaromaśāḥ | keśasthitā lalāṭorṇā jihvā caiṣāṃ pramārjanī || 4 || nyagrodhapariṇāhāśca siṃhaskandhāḥ sumehanāḥ | gajendragatayaścaiva mahāhanava eva ca || 5 || aiśvaryeṇāṇimādyena prabhuśaktyā balena ca | annena tapasā caiva ṛṣīnabhibhavanti vai || 6 || nayena tapasā caiva devadānavamānuṣān || abhibhavanti yogena viṣṇupradattaśaktibhiḥ || 7 || | pādayoścakramatsyau ca śaṃkhapadme tu hastayoḥ | dhanurbhuje hyurau chatraṃ rekhāstāścakravartinām || 8 || cakraṃ ratho maṇiḥ khaḍgaṃ dhanūratnaṃ ca paṃcamam | keturnidhiśca saptaite ratnaśreṣṭhā acetanāḥ || 9 || rājñī purohitaścaiva senānī rathasārathiḥ | mantryaśvaḥ kalabhaścaite ratnaśreṣṭhāḥ sacetanāḥ ||1.52.10|| divyaitāni caturdaśa sarveṣāṃ cakravartinām | antarikṣe samudre ca pātāle parvateṣu ca || 11 || ahatā gatayasteṣāṃ catasraścakravartinām | cakravartī bhavedaṃśastasya śrīparamātmanaḥ ||12|| tena tasya prajāyāṃ vai prādurbhavanti śaktayaḥ | divyāśca laukikāścāpi rājyasīmāntabodhikāḥ ||13|| dūraśravaṇayantrāṇi dūrabhyo dūradarśanāḥ | kālamānasuyantrāṇi dūravācakaraśmayaḥ ||14|| dūramūrtidarśakāni divyakācāni bhūriśaḥ | dehānāvaraṇadṛṣṭipradavidyutprasādhanam | ||15|| dhātutantudhṛtividyutprakāśāḥ supradīpakāḥ | agniyantrodbhavodyogā jalayantrāṇi bhūriśaḥ ||16|| jalāntargatiyānāni vyomayānāni cāpyatha | vimānāni hyasaṃkhyāni kācikā dūradarśinī ||17|| vāyutantudhvanigrāhyaśabdaśaktiniyantraṇā pravāsayānayantrāṇi bhūvimānāni bhūriśaḥ ||18|| jalapravāsayantrāṇi meghotpādakaśaktayaḥ | sainikā vyomagatikā jalāntargatikā api ||19|| dhūmrayānāni bāṣpāṇāṃ śakaṭāni rathāstathā | mohamāraṇadravyāṇi saṃhārāṇḍāni bhūriśaḥ ||1.52.20|| cakradrāvaṇagatayaścauṣadhīnāṃ suśaktayaḥ | grahāntaragatiścāgnau gatiḥ pṛthvyudarekṣaṇam ||21|| rūpāntaradhṛtiścāpi hayadṛśyabhavanādikam | bhautikyaḥ śaktayaścaitāḥ sahāgacchanti tena vai ||22|| tattacchaktimayā devā mānuṣā vā bhavanti ca | tattadāviṣkṛtairbhaumairjalīyaistaijasairapi ||23|| dhātujairmānasaiścaiva sādhanaiścakravartinaḥ | mānavā rājyabhāraṃ nirvahanti cālayanti ca ||24|| lokāntaragataṃ rājyaṃ dvīpāntaragataṃ ca vā | samudrāntaritaṃ rājyaṃ karoti nikaṭe iva ||25|| paśyati ca śṛṇotyapi spṛśatyapi prajighrati | vadati cānubhavati svagṛhe iva saṃsthitam ||26|| cakravartiprajāḥ sarvāstatsamā bhāgyaśālinī | tatsamānaprabhogā ca puṇyayugabalādbhavet ||27|| uttānapādatanujo vyomagāmī vasurnṛpaḥ | cakravartyabhavaddharmasatyejyādānasattapāḥ ||28|| tadā viśvabhugindraśca yajñaṃ prāvartayacchubham | devaistu sahitaiḥ sarvairmunibhiḥ ṛṣibhistathā ||29|| pitṛbhiryakṣarākṣasagandharvakinnaroragaiḥ | mānuṣairnadanadībhiḥ samudraistīrthaparvataiḥ ||1.52.30|| nakṣatradaityadānavasādhusādhvīsutattvakaiḥ | jalasthalacarairvṛkṣavallīgulmalatādibhiḥ ||31|| sātvikairmanubhiścāpi rājasairnaramānavaiḥ | tāmasairdevadevībhiḥ sahitaścākaronmakham ||32|| mānasī maithunī sṛṣṭiḥ sarvā tatrāgamanmudā | athāśvamedhe vitate tāmasāścārdhatāmasāḥ ||33|| yajante paśubhirmedhyairhutvā māṃsapriyāśanāḥ | karmavyagreṣu ṛtvikṣu santate yajñakarmaṇi ||34|| saṃpragīteṣu teṣvevamāgameṣvatha susvaram | parikrānteṣu laghuṣu cādhvaryuvṛṣabheṣu ca ||35|| āhuteṣu ca deveṣu yajñabhāṃkṣu mahātmasu | ālabdheṣu ca medhyeṣu tathā paśugaṇeṣu vai ||36|| haviṣyagnau hūyamāne devānāṃ devahotṛbhiḥ | ya indriyātmakā devā yajñabhājastathā tu ye ||37|| kalpādiṣu ca ye devāstān yajante hyadhvaryavaḥ | tadā tu sātvikāḥ praiṣakāle ye vai maharṣayaḥ ||38|| vīkṣyotthitā adhvaryavo dīnānpaśugaṇān sthitān | papracchurindraṃ saṃbhūya ko’yaṃ yajñavidhistava ||39|| adharmo balavāneṣo hiṃsākāryecchayā tava | neṣṭaḥ paśuvadhastveṣastava yajñe surottama ||1.52.40|| adharmo dharmaghātāya prārabdhaḥ paśubhistvayā | nāyaṃ dharmo hyadharmo’yaṃ na hiṃsā dharma ucyate ||41|| hiṃsā nāma śarīrasya sajīvasya vighānatam | sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ tādṛk duḥkhaṃ nānyattu vidyate ||42|| yathākasmācchastraghātād duḥkhaṃ bhavati prāṇinām | yatkarmaṇā bhaved duḥkhaṃ pāpaṃ tattu prakīrtitam ||43|| tasmānna hiṃsayā puṇyaṃ kasyāpi ca kadāpi ca | kathaṃ tvaṃ kuruṣe pāpaṃ devo bhūtvā surādhipa ||44|| nirāgasāṃ ca maunānāṃ parādhīnaprajīvinām | hiṃsanaṃ mā kuru cendra karmaitannindyameva yat ||45|| ṛṣīnindrastadā prāha yajñe hiṃsā sukhapradā | yajñe hutā ime jīvā yāsyanti svargamīpsitam ||46|| mokṣo’tha bhavate teṣāṃ yān bhuṃkte’gnimukho hariḥ | paśuyoneśca mokṣo’pi duḥkhabāhulyanibhṛteḥ ||47|| ṛṣayaḥ prāhurindraivaṃ yajñe homācca mokṣaṇam | duḥkhanāśastathā svargaṃ sukhaṃ tādṛk na ko labhet ||48|| sarpasatre bhāviyuge kuhakena saha dvijāḥ | tava homaṃ kariṣyanti tadā te śikṣaṇaṃ bhavet ||49|| pārameṣṭhyaṃ caindrapadaṃ sārvabhaumaṃ rasātalam || vairājaṃ tattvadhāmāni prākṛtaṃ lokaghaṭṭanam ||1.52.50|| sarve māyāphenajanyā nirayā brahmaṇo hareḥ | tavāpīndra padaṃ tādṛṅ niraya eva nāparam ||51|| duḥkhadaṃ kleśabahulaṃ paśuprāyaṃ vibhāti naḥ | tasmādindra imaṃ dehaṃ padaṃ caindraṃ parityaja ||52|| yajñe svayaṃ paśurbhūtvā homaṃ kuru nijasya vai | yadi svahome trāsaste svaṃ homaṃ na kariṣyase ||53|| vayaṃ tu ṛṣayastvāṃ vai juhmo’vyagraḥ sthiro bhava | tena homena te rājan paraṃ svargaṃ bhaviṣyati ||54|| yadvai brahmapadaṃ prāhurmokṣasthānamanuttamam | tatra gantāsi cāgaccha tvāṃ prajuhmo hare’dya vai ||55|| tava māṃsena yajñeśaḥ prasannaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati | asmākamapi puṇyaṃ syānmāṃsahomena te matam ||56|| annasyendratvalābhaḥ syātpaśavaḥ syuḥ sujīvinaḥ | lābhāḥ subahavaścendra hate tvayi bhavanti hi ||57|| tata āgaccha devendra bhavān huto bhavatviti | ityevamṛṣibhiścote śacyā hyākrandanaṃ kṛtam ||58|| | indro’pi trāsamāpanno maraṇakṣaṇadarśanāt | maṇḍape ca sadasyeṣu mahānkolāhalo’bhavat ||59|| indro hūyate ṛṣibhirbahvaniṣṭaṃ bhavediti | indrastu maraṇaśrāvāt mukhena śyāmalo’bhavat ||1.52.60|| tejastimiratāṃ yātaṃ śuṣkāsyo hyabhavatkṣaṇāt | trāsāt hṛdayakaṃpaśca vepathurdehajo’bhavat ||61|| śaktihīnāni gātrāṇi hyabhavanmaraṇaśravāt | athavā ṛṣibhiḥ proktaṃ mā te homo’stu devarāṭ ||62|| bahavaḥ santi hotārasteṣāṃ homo bhavatvatha || adhvaryavaḥ ṛtvijāśca hotāraśca sadasyakāḥ ||63|| aneke santyupasthitāste hutāḥ saṃbhavantviti | tenādya prīyatāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ paśavaḥ santu rakṣitāḥ ||64|| hutāḥ sarve gamiṣyanti brahmaṇaḥ padamavyayam | devamānuṣanirayāt prayāsyanti pramokṣaṇam ||65|| śrutvaitadindraḥ svastho’bhūtkathaṃcijjīvanāśayaḥ || adhvaryuhotṛpramukhāścintāmagnāstadābhavan ||66|| aho kaṣṭamiti procurnecchāmo mokṣaṇaṃ jaguḥ || na ca muktiṃ na vai homaṃ na bhojyaṃ na ca dakṣiṇām ||67|| vastu kimapi necchāmastava sarvaṃ bhavatviti | na sthāsyāmo vayaṃ cātra maraṇaṃ kasya vai priyam ||68|| gamiṣyāmo gṛhānsvānsvān homadravyāṇi no vayam | . ityevaṃ trāsamāptānāṃ mahān kolāhalo hyabhūt ||69| tāvattatra samāyāto rājoparicaro vasuḥ || vimānātsa samuttīrya yajñamaṇḍapamāgamat ||1.52.70|| indrādibhiḥ satkṛtaḥ sannyaṣīdanmadhyamāsane | ṛṣibhistu tadā proktaṃ hiṃsāyajño na vaidikaḥ ||71| āgamena sadā yajñaṃ karotu yadihecchasi || vidhidṛṣṭena yajñena dharmamavyayahetunā ||72|| yajñabījaiḥ suraśreṣṭha yeṣu hiṃsā na vidyate | trivarṣaparamaṃ kālamuṣitairaprarohibhiḥ ||73|| eṣa dharmo mahānindra svayaṃ vicārya sādhyatām | evaṃ viśvabhugindrastu munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ ||74|| proktaste tu vivādena khinnā divyā maharṣayaḥ || saṃdhāya paśumubhayaṃ papracchuśceśvaraṃ vasum ||75|| vaso rājankathaṃ dṛṣṭastvayā yajñavidhirnṛpa | auttānapāde prabrūhi saṃśayaṃ chindhi naḥ prabho ||76|| śrutvā sarvamubhayeṣāmavicārya balābalam | vedaśāstramanusṛtya yajñatattvamuvāca ha ||77|| indrasya ca sureśasya chāyāmāśritya pakṣataḥ | rāgāccāpyavirodhena kṣattrāṃśaprabalena ca ||78|| yathopadiṣṭairyaṣṭavyamiti hovāca pārthivaḥ | yaṣṭavyaṃ paśubhirmedhyairatha bījaiḥ phalaistathā ||79|| hiṃsāsvabhāvo yajñasya iti me darśayatyasau | yathehasaṃhitāmantrā hiṃsāliṃgā maharṣibhiḥ ||1.52.80|| dīrgheṇa tapasā yuktairdarśanaistārakādibhiḥ || tatprāmāṇyānmayā coktaṃ tasmānmāṃ mantumarhatha ||81|| yadi pramāṇaṃ tānyeva mahāvākyāni vai dvijāḥ || tadā prāvartatāṃ yajño hyanyathā no’nṛtaṃ vacaḥ ||82|| evaṃ prāptottarāste vai yuktātmānastapodhanāḥ || bhūtvā hyadhomukhā vasuṃ prāhurmā vada pārthiva ||83|| vedārthastalasparśitvabuddhyā naivāhṛtastvayā | vedasya nahi tātparyaṃ kadāpi hiṃsane matam ||84|| svabhāvaprāptahiṃsāyā nivṛttau yuktikṛdvacaḥ | anāloḍyocyate hiṃsā vidhiścetyanṛto bhavān ||85|| mithyāvādī vasuḥ so’yaṃ satyaṃ naiva bravītyapi || ityuktamātre nṛpatiḥ praviveśa rasātalam ||86|| ūrdhvacārī vasustvāsīd rasātalacaro’bhavat | vasudhādhaḥ sadāvāsī mithyāvākyena so’bhavat ||87|| tasmānna vācyamekena bahujñenāpi saṃśayāt | bahudvārasya dharmasya sūkṣmāt sūkṣmatarā gatiḥ ||88|| tasmānna niścayādvaktuṃ dharmaḥ śakyastu kenacit | tato na hiṃsā dharmasya dvāraṃ bhavati karhicit ||89|| patraṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ śākaṃ munyannaṃ paya eva ca | yajñe datvā mahīyante svarge loke tapodhanāḥ ||1.52.90|| adrohaścāpyalobhaśca damau bhūtadayā tapaḥ | brahmasevā ca satyaṃ ca hyupakāraḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ ||9 1|| sanātanasya dharmasya mūlānyetāni sarvathā | tasmād drohaṃ mā kuru tvaṃ paśūnmocaya yajñataḥ ||92|| phalānnādidravyahavyairyajñaṃ kuru sureśvara | ityetadvākyamādṛtya śakreṇa hatapāyasaiḥ ||93 || yajñaḥ kṛtastataḥ paścād yajñāstu sāttvikāḥ sadā | vaiṣṇavāḥ sarvathā tretāyāṃ prāvartanta cādruhaḥ ||94|| ṛṣayastu tadārabhya śaṃ prākurvan susattapaḥ | yajñām̐śca vaiṣṇavām̐ścakrurahiṃsādharmasaṃbhṛtān ||95|| ajena tu yajete’ti ajastraivārṣiko brihiḥ | na jāyateṃ’kuro yasya taddhānyamaja ucyate ||96|| maithune mādake māṃse tāmasānāṃ svabhāvajā | pravṛttirbhavatīti tannirodhāya vidhirmataḥ ||97|| maithunecchā yadi tīvrā vivāhena praśāmyatu | yadīcchā māṃsarasane yajñenaiva praśāmyatu ||98|| yadīcchā mādake pāne sautrāmaṇyā praśāmyatu | kathaṃcidanubhūyaitānnivṛttāḥ saṃbhavantviti ||99|| vidhipūrvo niṣedhaḥ sa na vidhistattraye’pi vai | madyamāṃsamithunairyo nākrānto mukta eva saḥ || 1.52.100 || ahiṃsā paramo dharmo brahmacaryaṃ mahattapaḥ | amādakaṃ parā śuddhistribhirbrahma suvindati || 101 || athāpi kālavegāśca tāmasāhāramiśraṇāt | annādilābhavaidhuryād rasanārasalolanāt || 102|| tāmasaistāmasī rītirgṛhyate tattrayātmikā | teṣāṃ daṇḍapradānārthaṃ dharmo vaivasvato yamaḥ || 1 03|| vartate nyāyakartā śrīnārāyaṇasamīhayā | tadanyāyaparā śuddhiryamaloke karoti saḥ || 1 04|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne cakravarticihnamahendrayajñasambandhihiṃsāpratipādakoparicaravasuprapatanādinirūpaṇanāmā dvipaṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ||52||
<1.53> śrīlakṣmīruvāca prāṇapriya trikālajña sarpasatra kadābhavan | kathaṃ kasmād yataścendrastatra huto mahādvijaiḥ || 1 || yamo vaivasvataścāpi kadāsīt kiṃ karoti saḥ | kīdṛśo yamalokaśca brūhi te’haṃ yadi priyā || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu kathāṃ tāṃ surasāṃ sarpasatramayīṃ priye | ādye tu dvāpare jātāṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 3 || jāte tretāyuge kṣīṇe dvāparaḥ pratipadyate | praṇaśyanti prajānāṃ vai tretāyāḥ siddhayastu yāḥ || 4 || udbhavanti tadā doṣā adhairyaṃ lobha ityapi | vāṇijyaṃ ca tathā yuddhaṃ tattvajñānāvinirṇayaḥ || 5 || varṇānāṃ svārthasaṃbhedo kāryāṇāṃ cāpyanirṇayaḥ | yāñca vadhaḥ paṇo daṇḍo mado daṃbho’kṣamābalam || 6 || eṣā rajastamaḥprāyā pravṛttirdvāpare tadā | dharmabhedo’bhavattena rāgadveṣau kṣaṇe kṣaṇe || 7 || karaṇānāṃ tu vaikalyāt kāraṇānāmaniścayāt | doṣāṇāṃ darśanāccaiva matibhedāstadā nṛṇām || 8 || karmaṇā manasā vācā kṛcchrādvārtā prasiddhyati | kāyakleśastu bahulo dharmāṇāṃ saṃkarastathā ||9|| varṇāśramaparidhvaṃsāḥ kāmadveṣau mahābalau | svamānaṃ cāparāmānaṃ doṣī hyāsan mahābalāḥ ||1.53.10|| asatyavācanaṃ prāyo vyāpāre vyavahārake | svasvodarabharatvaṃ ca prāyaśaḥ parivartate ||11|| etādṛśadvāparasya samayasya prabhāvataḥ | gṛhavanto janāḥ svīyaṃ svatvaṃ kartuṃ samudyatāḥ ||12|| kṣetraṃ gṛhaṃ samudyānaṃ vāṭikā paśavo drumāḥ | vāpyaḥ khanyo vanānyārdrāraṇyāni ca sarāṃsi ca ||13|| yeṣāṃ svatvāvṛtāsteṣāṃ bhogyā bhavanti te tadā | ityevaṃ mānasīṃ vṛtti saṃkocapravaṇāṃ sadā ||14|| manujānāṃ vilokyaiva satyaṃ vilīnatāṃ gatam | pṛthvyā rasaḥ kṣayaṃ yāto drumā naiva phalāni ca ||15|| kalpavṛkṣā na dṛśyante kāmanā pūryate nahi | gāvaḥ kāmadudhā naiva dṛśyante dvāpare tadā ||16|| pralīnāścintāmaṇayaḥ kāmavṛṣṭirna varṣati | na phalantyārtavā vṛkṣāḥ sasyānyapi phalanti na ||17|| tadā tatra balaṃ yasya bhuṃkte sa balavānamum | ityevaṃ hrāsa āpannastadā vai dvāpare bahuḥ ||18|| rājāpi dveṣavān mānī brahmāvamānanādaraḥ | prajā svārthasādhikā ca kiṃ vācyaṃ kālaparyaye ||19|| evaṃ kāle pravṛtte vai sarpasatramayī kathā | pravṛttābhūcchṛṇu lakṣmi bhavabandhavimocinīm ||1.53.20|| haryārādhanasaṃdātrīṃ gāthāṃ jagatsupāvanīm | śrutvā tāṃ tu kathāṃ ramyāṃ pūyante śravaṇādarāḥ ||21|| svāyaṃbhuvamanoḥ putraḥ priyavrata itīritaḥ | tasya raivatanāmābhūtputraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ ||22|| ābālyācca tapoyogabhaktisevāparāyaṇaḥ | snānaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ kurvan sandhyāvandanatatparaḥ ||23|| prātastu pitarau natvā vṛddhānnatvā ca bhūsurān | gavāṃ ca pūjanaṃ kṛtvā pitṝn jalāṃjalīn dadau ||24|| agnāvājyaṃ ca havyaṃ ca datvā tato nijāśritān | bhojayitvātithīn viprān svaṃ āda devatārpitam ||25|| śeṣaṃ tu samayaṃ sarvaṃ mālayā bhajanena ca | sārthakayan svakaṃ janma sarvān bhajanamādiśat ||26|| nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa svāminmādhava satpate | vāsudeva parabrahmāntaryāmin pāhi sarvadā ||27|| ityevaṃ bhajatastasya nārado’gād yadṛcchayā | raivatenādṛtaṃ tasya svāgataṃ cāsanādikam ||28|| pādāvanejya ca ṛṣeḥ kṛpākāṃkṣyavadat sa tam | dayālo lokajīvānāṃ samuddhāraka divyadṛk ||29|| svayaṃ brahma tvamevokto nārāyaṇamanojaniḥ | tvādṛgbrahmavido yogo hareryogasamo mataḥ ||1.53.30|| nispṛhāṇāṃ satāṃ naiva mādṛśātsyānnu vāñchitam | tathāpi karuṇāḥ santo hyāyānti parabhūtaye ||31|| avaśyaṃ me karagataṃ śreyo bhavati niścitam | nānyathā bhagavaddṛśāṃ darśanaṃ saṃbhaved drutam ||32|| śādhi śiṣyaṃ cānukūlaṃ sevādāsaṃ praśādhi mām | nārado vādayan vīṇāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gṛṇan ||33|| prāha raivata dhanyo’si bālyādbhajasi keśavam | ko’nyalābho janimataḥ prākṛtātkardamādbhavet ||34|| saditi brahmaṇaḥ śabdastadvanto ye bhavantyuta | sāyujyaṃ brahmaṇo’tyantaṃ tena santaḥ pracakṣate ||35|| tādṛśā ca satā bhāvyaṃ nāsatā tu kadācana | satsu satāṃ virāmaḥ syānna tvasatsu kadācana ||36|| tava niṣkāmasadbhaktyā lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ svayam | prasannaḥ san prerayanmāṃ kiñcidāvedyamasti yat ||37|| brahmadhāmādhipaḥ śrīmān harirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam | prabhurdāmodaro bhūtvā pṛthvyāmāgantumicchati ||38|| brahmadhāmapradeśaṃ svavāsāyānetumicchati | śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ rājan pṛthvyāṃ paścimabhūtale ||39|| suratrāsapathaṃ chidraṃ śatagavyūtirāyatam | vartate tadvivareṇātalād daityaprakoṭayaḥ ||1.53.40|| svargaṃ gatvā surānsarvān trāsayanti nirāgasaḥ | suratrāsakaraṃ chidraṃ śatagavyūtivistaram ||41|| pūraṇīyaṃ mayā tatra vastavyaṃ cāpi sarvadā || raivatāya tadarthaṃ vai dāsye’kṣarapradeśakam ||42|| śatagavyūtivistāraṃ divyaṃ samṛddhaṃ sukhapradam | yatra svarṇarasāḥ kūpāḥ svarṇarakṣā sarittathā ||43|| saṃjīvanī śalyahartrī chedasandhā hyamūrchanā | raktadā dhārahantrī ca kṣutṛṇnirodhinī tathā ||44|| vividhauṣadhayastatra bhaviṣyanti mayā saha | yatra bhadrā subhadrā me patnī bhadrāvatī nadī ||45|| yatra corjā mama patnī tatra ojasvatī bhavet | yatrārdrakuṃkumaṃ lakṣmyāḥ siktaṃ kuṃkumavāpikā ||46|| yatra patnīvrato vipro madaṃśaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati | yatrā vāḍavamādāya sarasvatī samudragā ||47|| yatra me plakṣachāyāyāṃ kṣaṇaṃ vāso bhaviṣyati | yatra svarṇapurī ramyā dvīpāntarme bhaviṣyati ||48|| yatra khaṭvāṃgado rājā tava putro bhaviṣyati | yatra someśvaro devo mahādevo bhaviṣyati ||49|| yatra talasya nāśādvai talaśyāmo bhaviṣyati | yatra guptatayā yāgāt prayāgo’pi bhaviṣyati ||1.53.50|| yatra bhakto mahānme vai dāmanāmā bhaviṣyati | yatraikatadvītatrītāḥ bhaviṣyantyṛṣayastrayaḥ ||51|| yatra tapaḥpriyo dattātreyaḥ sthāsyāmyahaṃ nage| yatronmattā ca gaṃgā sā madarthaṃ pravahiṣyati ||52|| yatra bhaveśvarapatnyāḥ siṃhāḥ sthāsyanti vāhanam | yatra sarvasvadātā me bhaktimārgo bhaviṣyati ||53|| yatra jayā lalitā me rādhā lakṣmīrbhaviṣyataḥ | yatra sūryo’rkavṛkṣasya rūpaṃ janma grahīṣyati ||54|| yatra śatrūṃjitā devī nadīrūpā bhaviṣyati | yatrānartaḥ punā rājā tapase saṃgamiṣyati ||55|| yatra sarpagararodhānnagaraṃ ca nivatsyati | yatra kṛṣṇo dhanuścihnaḥ sādhurūpo bhaviṣyati ||56|| gopālakambhare me ca pitarau saṃbhaviṣyataḥ | yatra mamāvatārāśca bhaviṣyanti maharṣayaḥ ||57|| yatra madrājyadeṣṭāro bhaviṣyanti mamāṃśinaḥ | yatra nṛpābhiṣektā ca devānīko bhaviṣyati ||58|| yatra me niyatasthānaṃ rajikuṭṭaṃ bhaviṣyati | tatra me yugalaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ saṃsthāpayiṣyati ||59|| anādinidhanaṃ tanme sthānaṃ divyaṃ bhaviṣyati | kṛṣṇamuktipradaḥ so’yaṃ dvīpo divyo bhaviṣyati ||1.53.60|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvāparadharmarevatagṛhanāradāgamapaścimabhūtalavivarapūrakabrahmapradeśānayanamatibhaviṣyattattvoddeśādipradarśananāmā tripaṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ||53||
<1.54> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pradeśaḥ sa vivarātmā kva vidyate | abriktākhyapradeśāttu pūrvaṃ kacchācca dakṣiṇam || 1 || narmadāyāḥ paścimaṃ tat siṃhāraṇyata uttaram | pradeśaḥ sa suratrātā surāṣṭraḥ saṃbhaviṣyati || 2 || pratīcyāṃ malayādreśca prācyāmabriktadeśataḥ | āyato vistṛto viśvak paṃcasāhasrayojanaḥ || 3 || siṃhāraṇyamiti khyāto deśo’vicchinnabhūmikaḥ | siṃhāraṇyādudagdeśo devadamanasaṃjñakaḥ || 4 || devadamanabhūdeśāt śatagavyūtiruttaram | mahābhūvivaraṃ cāsti tasya vai pūraṇāya ca ||5|| śrīhariste yathāpekṣaṃ pradeśaṃ svaṃ pradāsyati | samāgaccha mayā sākaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ prati cānagha || 6 || deyaṃ deśaṃ tu saurāṣṭraṃ nītvā tvāyāhi bhūtale| vivaraṃ tatsamprapūrya divyaṃ tadbhūtalaṃ kṛthāḥ || 7 || suratrātari taddeśe saurāṣṭre tvaṃ sthiro bhava ||| tatra deśe maṇisvarṇamayo brahmagirirmahān || 8 || somabhadrāmadhyadeśe svanivāsāya kalpaya | raivatasya nivāsātte parvato’pi ca raivataḥ || 9 || revatācalasaṃjñaḥ syād divyo brahmagirirmahān || revatasya svakanyāyā revatītisamāhvayā ||1.54.10|| tatra sthāsyati tīrthākhyā golokasthāpi sarvadā | raivato bhagavadbhaktaściraṃ tatra nivatsyati ||11|| pañcamastvaṃ manurbhūtvā punastatra nivatsyasi | raivatācalatīrthaṃ tanmahattīrthaṃ bhaviṣyati ||12|| yatra dāmodaraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śaṃbhuryatra bhaveśvaraḥ | brahmā yatra svayaṃbhūśca tatra kiṃ nāma māyikam ||13|| kṛṣṇayogātsadā divyā bhūmiḥ kṛṣṇā rasānvitā | vāsanāyāḥ karṣaṇācca vaikuṇṭhaṃ nayanāttathā ||14|| saurāṣṭraḥ kṛṣṇa ākhyāto nāmnā rūpeṇa caujasā | kṛtasmaro giriścāpi raivatācalapaścime ||15|| tena lagno mahān bhāvī kadācidvaḍavānalam | nītvā sarasvatī devī tanmārgeṇa gamiṣyati ||16|| mahāsamudre kṣepārthaṃ tadā smaragiriḥ svayam | utthāya tatsamīpe ca nirodhaṃ saṃkariṣyati ||17|| tadā kruddho vaḍavāgnirgiriṃ bhasmīkariṣyati | tadbhasmastarapāṣāṇā mṛduśvetā bhavantyapi ||18|| śilpibhistaiḥ kariṣyante prāsādāḥ śvetabhūmayaḥ | cūrṇaṃ śvetaṃ saudhadravyaṃ vahnipākāt tato bhavet ||19|| atharṣayaḥ pitṛsiddhā devāḥ sādhvyaśca sādhavaḥ | yogino yatayo bhaktāḥ sthāsyanti raivate girau ||1.54.20|| daśaparvataprākāro lakṣmyambāsaudhaśobhitaḥ | koṭiyātrālubhaktaughaiḥ kārtikyāṃ kṛtpradakṣiṇaḥ ||21|| śroṇyāṃ meghasamākīrṇaḥ śrṛṃge devarṣisevitaḥ | mūle kṛṣṇajanākīrṇaḥ pārśve vimānasatpathaḥ ||22|| pūrve śatruṃjitā vārgā caturyojanataḥ param | tīrthaṃ kuṃkumavāpyākhyaṃ yojanatrayataḥ param ||23|| yasyottare ca bhadrākhyā sarit dviyojanātparam | yasyāvācyāṃ somatīrthaṃ caturyojanataḥ param ||24|| yasya pratīcyāṃ yoginīparvatasyaiva chāyayā | rakṣitoccabhuvo deśastvāyataḥ krośavistaraḥ ||25|| tatra tvayā svakaṃ nirmātavyaṃ vai raivataṃ puram | tatastava suto nāmnā khaṭvāṃgado bhaviṣyati ||26|| sa dvitīyaḥ śaśī bhūtvā naiśaṃ tamo hariṣyati | tannāmnā tatpuraṃ khaṭvāṃgadasaṃjñaṃ bhaviṣyati ||27|| tadvaṃśe hāṭako rājā bhaviṣyati tu bhaktarāṭa | hāṭakeśamahādevaṃ pātālādānayiṣyati ||28|| tannāmnā tatpuraṃ hāṭakeśapuraṃ bhaviṣyati | tadvaṃśe maṇimān rājā śaṃbhorgaṇo bhaviṣyati ||29|| tannāmnā tatpuraṃ maṇipuraṃ khyātaṃ bhaviṣyati | prācīnānāṃ tu durgāṇāṃ darśanānmānavāstadā ||1.54.30|| jīrṇadurgapuraṃ nāmnā khyāpayiṣyanti kālataḥ | tatastatra gate kāle pārṣado vijayaḥ prabhoḥ ||31|| prāvirbhaviṣyati tatra rājyaṃ so’pi kariṣyati | tannāmnā vijayapuramityākhyāṃ saṃgamiṣyati ||32|| sādhvyaśca sādhavastatra mokṣadā brahmamūrtayaḥ | sarvadā tu nivatsyanti lokakalyāṇahetavaḥ ||33|| camatkārā bhaviṣyanti tatra bhūmau yuge yuge | daivāstu puruṣāstatra bhaviṣyanti yuge yuge ||34|| bhuvo rakṣaṇakartāro dharmasya sthāpakāstathā | kṛṣṇadāmodarāvāsādgopyaścāpi muhurmuhuḥ ||35|| tatra tatra bhaviṣyanti mānavyo vai mahāvratāḥ | sādhvyo bhūtvā bhajiṣyanti kṛṣṇaṃ santaṃ pratāpinam ||36|| tadāśrayaṃ sukurvāṇā narā nāryo mṛgāḥ khagāḥ | mokṣyante saṃsṛteḥ pāśāttādṛśī bhūmikā bhavet ||37|| atha bhāvī raivato’yaṃ mlecchāśrayaḥ samantataḥ | tadā kalpasya sāyaṃ vai kalkerantimajanmanaḥ ||38|| netrakrodhāt kvathito vai jvālāmukho bhaviṣyati | jvālābhī rasasantapto deśo’pi rasatāṃ vrajet ||39|| raso vaikuṇṭhamāsādya yathāpūrvo bhaviṣyati | saurāṣṭro vaikuṇṭhajanirvaikuṇṭhaṃ punareṣyati ||1.54.40|| atha kalpāntare cāpi yathāpūrvaṃ bhaviṣyati | tasmādāgaccha rājendra vaikuṇṭhaṃ tu mayā saha ||41|| dāsyati śrīharistubhyaṃ pradeśaṃ vai surāṣṭrakam | ityāmantrya gatastatra raivato nāradena ca ||42|| saha vaikuṇṭhamabhyetya praṇipatya prabhuṃ harim | nanāma śirasā daṇḍavacca tuṣṭāva sāṃjaliḥ ||43|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne prapūritabhūvivarabhāvitīrthādinirdeśanirūpaṇanāmā catuḥpaṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 54 ||
<1.55> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi raivatākhyo manurvaikuṇṭhamāptavān | tuṣṭāva ca mahāpremṇā dayāluṃ māṃ tvayānvitam || 1 || namaḥ| saccitsvarūpāyānandasandohavārdhaye | namastvekasvarūpāyobhayarūpāya te namaḥ || 2 || namo hiraṇyakeśāya śmaśrvaśmaśrumate namaḥ | namaḥ stanyāstanyavate bījābījadhṛte namaḥ || 3 || namo bahiḥ pracihnāyāṃbahiścihnāya te namaḥ | namo viśvakpravālāya kvacidvālāya te namaḥ || 4 || namo dakṣiṇasattvāya . vāmasattvāya te namaḥ | nama ūrdhvasvarūpāyānūrdhvarūpāya te namaḥ || 5 || nama ādheyarūpāyādhārarūpāya te namaḥ | namo dvidalarūpāyāṅkuraprasūtaye namaḥ || 6 || namo vaikuṇṭhavāsāya kuṇṭhavāsāya te namaḥ | namo mānasarūpāya bhaktarūpāya te namaḥ || 7 || namaste karuṇāsindho namaḥ saurāṣṭravardhine | namo raivatavāsāya dāmodarāya te namaḥ || 8 || namaḥ patnīvratākhyāya namaḥ kṛṣṇāya viṣṇave | namo’nantasvarūpāya mamāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ || 9 || svatantrastvaṃ mahāviṣṇo na jāne tvaṃ kimicchasi | bhakto yadarthamāhūtastadvai vidhātumarhasi ||1.55.10|| dāso’yaṃ kṛpayā viṣṇo neyaḥ pāraṃ bhavādhvanaḥ | yatra te caraṇau stastaddeśo me hyaraṇaṃ bhavet ||11|| na vai tyājyaḥ kṛpānātha dāso’yaṃ śaraṇāgataḥ | karuṇayā gṛhīto’yaṃ na vai taṃ tyaktumarhasi ||12|| yadiṣṭaṃ kṣemakṛlloke tadiṣṭaṃ saṃvidhīyatām | iti stutvā virarāma raivato bhaktasattamaḥ ||13|| prāha taṃ bhagavān śrīmān vaikuṇṭhādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ | gṛhāṇemāṃ cāṇurūpāṃ mama vaikuṇṭhabhūmikām ||14|| svayaṃbhvākhyacaturvaktrabrahmaṇo golake tava | priyavratasya bhūrājye paścimaṃ vivaraṃ mahat ||15|| suratrāsapathaṃ chidraṃ śatagavyūtirāyatam | pūraṇīyaṃ bhūmikayā vikasantyā tvayaiva tat ||16|| suratrāṇaṃ bhavettena saurāṣṭrasaṃjñatāṃ vrajet | tatrāhaṃ śrīsamāyukto nivatsye tava kāraṇāt ||17|| anyad yannāradenoktaṃ vidhāsye tatra coṣitaḥ | ityabhidhāya devena vaikuṇṭhāṇuḥ samarpitaḥ ||18|| tamādāyājñayā viṣṇoḥ raivataḥ punarāgataḥ| yathoktaṃ tamaṇuṃ yāvadvivare nyastumicchati ||19|| tāvadvipulatāṃ yātaṃ śatagavyūtirāyatam | jāḍye bhūstaratulyaṃ tad divyaṃ paṃcaguṇātmakam ||1.55.20|| yathāpekṣaṃ yathāsthānaṃ sthitaṃ chidraṃ prapūritam | adivye divyasaṃmiśrāt sandhiḥ śvetaraṇātmakaḥ ||21|| śvetākhātaśca bhūḥ śvetā vyāvartayati maṇḍalam | śatagavyūtimātraṃ tanmaṇḍalaṃ śyāmapāṇḍuram ||22|| divyatyakhaṇḍabhūmadhyaṃ surāṣṭraṃ raivatārjitam | raivatastanmadhyabhāge viṣṇuṃ dhyeyaṃ vidhāya ca ||23|| sarvadārādhanaparo hyāste visṛjya māyikam | nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ tasmai datte sakaruṇekṣaṇam ||24|| dadau cāsmai maṇeḥ svasya sahasrāṃśaṃ tadā hariḥ | sa vai sthaulyaṃ samāpannaḥ śailarūpaṃ paraṃ dadhau ||25|| so’yaṃ saṃsthāpito madhye surāṣṭrasyātha nāmataḥ | neturnāmnā hyabhūt khyāto raivatācala ityayam ||26|| raivatena puraṃ tatra nirmitaṃ raivatāhvayam | raivataḥ sarvadā viṣṇoḥ smaraṇe kīrtane śrave ||27|| sevane hyarcane stotre dāsye sarvanivedane | hyavartata mahābhakto jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiṣu ||28|| rājyabhāre vyavahāre bhojane śayane tathā| sarvathā devadeveśa nārāyaṇaṃ samābhajat ||29|| tatraikadā mahāmaṃce śayāno yoganidrayā| ātmani śrīhariṃ dhyāyan samādhiṃ tvagamaddhi saḥ ||1.55.30|| nārāyaṇecchayā tasya dakṣiṇasya bhujasya ca | svarṇāṃgado dravo bhūtvā patito maṃcake’bhavat ||31|| svarṇavarṇaḥ kiśoro’bhūt śvetakāntiḥ śaśīva ha | śītaśvetaprakāśasya paridhiḥ sarvato’bhavat ||32|| sarvataḥ śvetakiraṇairvyāpto’bhūdityakhaṇḍitaḥ | prāsādaṃ nagaraṃ deśaṃ dugdhadhavalatejasā ||33|| kurvan vitimiraṃ sarvamāste sma maṃcake tu saḥ | yadṛcchayā mahābhakto raivato jāgrato’bhavat ||34|| khaṭvāyāṃ svāṃgadotpannaṃ kumāraṃ pratyapadyata | candramasamiva śuklaṃ saumyaṃ tejomayaṃ śubham ||35|| dikṣu vidikṣu dhavalīkurvantamakhilaṃ jagat | jātamātraṃ susaṃskṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśābdaṃ sadāprabham ||36|| cakravartidhanuścihnaṃ kuśalaṃ jñaptisaṃbhṛtam | jñātvā rājyāsanaṃ datvā raivato raivatācale ||37|| viśālāyāṃ kandarāyāṃ jagāmopāsanākṛte | tatra samādhimāpanno raivataḥ sarvadā harau ||38|| ekātmanā sthito yāvatpaṃcamo manurābhavet | athottare mahākāle kalpe kalpe tu sa svayam ||39|| satye mahāvibhūtyākhye vartiṣyata iti sthitiḥ | tatra tatra tasya vaṃśe khaṭavāṃgadanṛpādayaḥ ||1.55.40|| bhūmicakrapraśāstāro bhaviṣyantyabdakoṭiṣu || khaṭvāyāmaṃgadājjāto nāmnā khaṭvāṃgadaḥ kṛtaḥ ||41|| ūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ svarṇarekhaṃ lalāṭe tilakaṃ tvaci | svābhāvikamabhūttasya madhyaraktābhabindukam ||42|| kaṇṭhe svarṇamayī mālā tvaci svābhāvikī hyabhūt | sarvaiśvaryāśrayo bhūbhṛt tejasā timiraṃ haran ||43|| vimānamadhiruhyāthāntarīkṣe vyacaranmuhuḥ | dūrāddūrataraṃjñātaṃ amādau timiraṃ niśi ||44|| yatra candraśūnyadeśe tatrāgacchad vihāyasā | timiraṃ nāśayan sarvaṃ dvitīyaścandramā iva ||45|| māsi māsi bhraman vyomni śūnyadikṣu niśāpateḥ | lokān karoti sālokān śītaraśmīn prasārayan ||46|| athaivaṃ tu kṛte tatra samudrāḥ pārvaṇāḥ sadā | kṣubdhā bhūmistaraplāvā velābhirabhavanmuhuḥ ||47|| velā ūrdhvaṃ samāyānti nivartante na vai tathā | bhūmayastu jalākrāntā jāyante sma tadā tadā ||48|| ekadvitrikalāpoṣyā auṣadhyaḥ prāyaśastadā | poṣyātiśaityasaṃghātādajīrṇatvātkṣayaṃ yayuḥ ||49|| ityevaṃ hānimālokya vimānaṃ svaṃ nyavārayat | tādṛśo’bhūnmahādivyaḥ śītatejomayaḥ svarāṭ ||1.55.50|| karoti śrīharerbhaktiṃ kārayatyaparān janān | udghoṣayati prātaḥ sa viṣṇuḥ pūjyaḥ sadā janaiḥ ||51|| puṇḍraṃ sacandrakaṃ kāryaṃ bhojyaṃ prārpyaṃ harau sadā | sāyaṃ viṣṇorgṛhe gatvā stutyo devo janārdanaḥ ||52|| sādhvyaḥ santaścātimānyā bhojyapānādidāpanaiḥ | hotavyamanale deyaṃ devebhyo bhaktipūrvakam ||53|| nārāyaṇaparo yo vai bhajennārāyaṇaṃ sadā | na mayā tu karastasmād grahītavyaḥ kadācana ||54|| evaṃ tena kṛtā bhūmiḥ sarvā vaiṣṇavamaṇḍitā | nābhakto hyabhavat kaściccakre tasminpraśāsati ||55|| evaṃ bhaktiyute cakre śāntaḥ khaṭvāṃgado nṛpaḥ | rājyacintāṃ parityajya bhagavantaṃ sadāsmarat ||56|| vimānaṃ kandare sthāpya svayamārādhane’bhavat | kāle bahvarbude krānte tapase hyakaronmataḥ ||57|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne lakṣmīśastutimaṇibhūmyaṇugrahaṇabhūvivarapūraṇasatejaskāparacandrībhavanatejaḥprasāraṇabhaktividhāpanādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ||55||
<1.56> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tato rājā vairāgyāvegajṛṃbhitaḥ | raivatācalataḥ pūrvaṃ yojanatrayataḥ param || 1 || aśvapaṭṭaṃ saroramyaṃ vyāghrāraṇye mahattaram | akhaṇḍasalilaṃ mūlaphalavṛkṣādipārśvakam || 2 || nirjanaṃ cāpi nirupadravaṃ jñātvā sa bhūpatiḥ | jagāmāśvapaṭṭatīre nātidūre’tha nirjane || 3 || śītachāyāmayaṃ deśaṃ dṛṣṭvā khaṭvāṃgado nṛpaḥ| badrīdāḍimajambūdruciṃcāguṃdrādisudrumaiḥ || 4 || vyāpte deśe ca pātālajalavāpīsamanvite | vāpyā jalaṃ tu satataṃ nirjharaṇasvarūpataḥ || 5 || sravaddhyuparito yāti hyaśvapaṭṭasarovaram | tatra vāpyupakaṇṭhasthabadrīmūle bhuvastale || 6 || śālagrāmaṃ puraskṛtya tapaḥ khaṭvāṃgado’tapat | varṣāṇāṃ tu sahasraṃ so’karojjāmbūprabhakṣaṇam || 7 || dvitīyaṃ tu sahasraṃ so’karod guṃdraprabhakṣaṇam | tṛtīyaṃ tu sahasraṃ so’karod dāḍima bhakṣaṇam || 8 || caturthaṃ tu sahasraṃ so’karod badarabhakṣaṇam | paṃcamaṃ tu sahasraṃ so’karot ciṃcāmblabhakṣaṇam || 9 || ṣaṣṭhaṃ cātha sahasraṃ so’karot kandaprabhakṣaṇam | saptamaṃ tu sahasraṃ so’karot patraprabhakṣaṇam ||1.56.10|| aṣṭamaṃ tu sahasraṃ so’karot salilabhakṣaṇam | navamaṃ tu sahasraṃ so’karod vāyuprabhakṣaṇam ||11|| daśamaṃ tu sahasraṃ so’nāhāro’ṅguṣṭhasaṃsthitaḥ | tiṣṭhandhyāyan śālagrāme kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gurum ||12|| cintayan satataṃ devaṃ viṣṇuṃ śrīmantameva ca | japan lakṣmīpate śrīmannārāyaṇāya te namaḥ ||13|| tāvattadasya mūrdhno vai prādurbhūto’nalo mahān | dhūmastasya mahājvālaḥ saṃvyāpnod bhuvanatraye ||14|| devāndaityān mānavādīn prājvālayannabhaḥsthitān | cakampe pṛthivī devī cukṣubhuḥ sāgarāstathā ||15|| dāvānalo mahām̐statra tapo’gniprasamudgataḥ | tatra dāvānale vyāpte lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||16|| dayālustapato dehabhānahīnasya tasya vai | rakṣaṇāyāgamattatra mūrdhnyasiñcattadamṛtam ||17|| tena śāntastu mūrdhno’gnirdāvāgniśca nyavartata | prāha nārāyaṇastasmai bhakta bhaktyā vaśīkṛta ||18|| khaṭvāṃgada mahābhakta bhakti kurvanpraśobhase | tapo bhaktimayaṃkurvanprajāśreyo vidhāsyasi ||19|| viramedṛśatapaso darśanaṃ kuru me’nagha | niḥspṛhasya tu bhaktasya kiñcinnādeyamasti me ||1.56.20|| kiṃ te’pekṣyaṃ vṛṇu rājan dadāmi yadabhīpsitam | ityādiśya hariḥ śrīmān maunamāste tadā tu saḥ ||21|| netre uddhāṭya caṣṭe taṃ nārāyaṇamupasthitam | aho bhāgyamahobhāgyamiti snehaprapūritaḥ ||22|| nartanaṃ darśanāccakre padrajo śirasā vahan | viluṇṭhito muhurlakṣmīnārāyaṇapadeṣu saḥ ||23|| pādasevāṃ sadā vavre dāso bhūtvā sa cakrarāṭ | yatra tapaḥ kṛtaṃ tatra svasya mūrteśca sannidhau ||24|| lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vavre sadā darśanakāṃkṣayā | nārāyaṇājñayā tatra tadā lakṣmyā tathāstviti ||25|| uktvā kuṃkumārdracandrastasya bhāle kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ | lakṣmyāḥ karagatārdrasya kuṃkumasya ca bindavaḥ ||26|| bahavaḥ patitā vāpyāṃ tathā prakṣālitau karau | pītvā jalaṃ tathā snātvā pāyayitvā nṛpaṃ tathā ||27|| śālagrāme śāśvataṃ svaṃ nivāsamakarotprabhuḥ | śrīsārthaśca sadā nārāyaṇaścāste mahāprabhuḥ ||28|| tata ārabhya sā vāpī kuṃkumavāpikābhidhā | tatra tena nṛpatinā śrīnārāyaṇamandiram ||29|| sāptabhaumaṃ kāritaṃ ca sevāṃ tasyākarot svayam | sā ca lakṣmīḥ sukhaṃ kaṃ vai bibhratīti tu kambharā ||1.56.30|| goḥ pṛthivyāḥ pālakaṃ tu nṛpaṃ khaṭvāṃgadaṃ sadā | śaraṇe lāti gṛhṇāti gopālaḥ śrīharirhi saḥ ||31|| ucyete kambharāgopālākhyau lakṣmīnarāyaṇau | tayoḥ patnīvrataḥ putraḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇāṃśajaḥ ||32|| tatraiva tapa ātiṣṭhannāste kalpe prakalpake || dhyāyan svapitarau devau sutastu kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ||33|| tīrthe kuṃkumavāpyākhye śritamokṣaprade śubhe | āste divyaśarīreṇa sarvatra vyāpako’pi san ||34|| etadaśvasaro divyaṃ vyāghrāraṇyaṃ ca vistṛtam | divyā kuṃkumavāpī kambharāgopālamandiram ||35|| patnīvratadvijatīrthaṃ khaṭvāṃgadakṛtaṃ puram | ramyaṃ kuṃkumavāpyākhyaṃ hyāsan deśe surāṣṭrake ||36|| sarvavaikuṇṭhasāmagrī dāsadāsīgaṇaṃ tathā | ṛddhimaiśvaryamādāya kṛṣṇastatra virājate ||37|| tasya yāvadrajaḥkaṇāḥ pavitrā mokṣadāyakāḥ | divyā bhūmirdivyajalā divya vaikuṇṭhasannibhā ||38|| yāgaśrāddhavratadānapuṇyasthalīpramuktidā | tatra nārī naro vāpi yāṃ kāṃcidyonimāsthitaḥ ||39|| tyajandehaṃ parāṃ yāti muktiṃ brahmākṣarābhidhām | tatra bhūmau narā ye vai te sarve haripārṣadāḥ ||1.56.40|| nāryaścāpi vasanti yāstāḥ sarvāḥ kṛṣṇacārikāḥ | paśupakṣyādayaḥ sarve vṛkṣavallyādayastathā ||41|| muktā vaikuṇṭhadhāmasthā nānye bodhyā nṛcakṣuṣā | divyadṛṣṭyā bhālanīyā na tu vai cārmacakṣuṣā ||42|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne aśvapaṭṭasarovare khaṭvāṃgadatapaścaraṇena lakṣmīnārāyaṇapratyakṣadarśanaṃ kuṃkumacandrakakaraṇe bindukṣaraṇāt kuṃkumavāpītitīrthapuraṃ kaṃbharāgopālarūpeṇa lakṣmīnārāyaṇanivāsaścetinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭpaṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 56 ||
<1.57> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca khaṭvāṃgadasya putro vai barhiṣāṃgada īritaḥ | mayūrāstapatastasya tiṣṭhantyāgatya mastake || 1 || barhāṇi mocayantyatra na cāyaṃ tattu paśyati | tatra mayūrapicchānāṃ samūhe samupasthite || 2 || patnīvratena teṣāṃ vai mārjanī mahatī kṛtā | mandiramārjanakārye rakṣitā mūrtisannidhau || 3 || khaṭvāṃgadena sā dṛṣṭā gṛhītā karayoryadā | mārjanāya pravṛttaḥ sa tāvadvṛṣṭirabhūcca khāt || 4 || mārjanīṃ tāṃ gṛhītvā sa kuṭyāṃ praviśya tiṣṭhati | divārātrau mahāvṛṣṭiḥ samabhūd bahuvarṣaṇā ||5|| mārjanīpūlakaṃ coṣṇaṃ snigdhaṃ saṃkomalaṃ tathā | citraṃ tathaiva susparśaṃ śītasaṃhārakaṃ tathā || 6 || pārśve nidhāya śayyāyāṃ nīdrādhīno’bhavattadā | tatrecchayā hareḥ rūpaṃ cāpsarasaṃ vyalokayat || 7 || svāpnaḥ srāvo’bhavattasya dhātorbarhiṣu teṣu ca | tasya drāgeva putro’bhūt prātaryāvadvipaśyati || 8 || taṃ tu putraṃ mahāsiddhaṃ jātamātrasya yauvanam | vīkṣya tadābhidhāṃ cakre bahiṣāṃgada ityayam || 9 || tadrājye tvabhiṣiktaśca mānī śūro dhanurdharaḥ | khaṭvāṃgadapure ramye rājadhānyāṃ tu pūjitaḥ ||1.57.10|| bhaktaḥ sa ekadāraṇye parimeyānugaḥ śuciḥ | vicaran svapiturdivye vyāghrāraṇye paribhraman ||11|| kuṃkumavāpīsattīrthe patnīvratadvijāśrame | samāgacchattadā tatra darśanārthaṃ dvijanmanām ||12|| gurūṇāṃ ca piturlakṣmīnārāyaṇasvarūpayoḥ | devayordarśanaṃ kṛtvā yāvadāyāti sadguroḥ ||13|| samīpe tatra samaye samādhau saṃsthito guruḥ | nāvait rājña akasmāccāgamanaṃ cāntarasthiteḥ ||14|| svāgataṃ cāpi sanmānaṃ cāsanaṃ cādaraṃ tathā | naiva lebhe sa rājarṣirāśrame janavarjite ||15|| rājā kṣaṇaṃ ca sanmānaṃ nādhyagacchad yadā tadā | mānādhīno naṣṭabuddhiḥ kṣudraṃ svārthamakalpayat ||16|| aho hyasmaddhānyabhoktā bhikṣuko no’vamanyate | vāṇyāpi naiva satkāraṃ karoti brahmamānyayam ||17|| netre nimīlya kapaṭāt kīdṛśaṃ dhyānamāsthitaḥ | yadi jāgarmi nṛpateḥ sammānaṃ kartumāpatet ||18|| tasmātsamādhimāsthāya sthātavyamiti vañcanām | puraskṛtya dvijo’yaṃ me’vamānaṃ tu karoti vai ||19|| tasmānnaivedṛśo vipro hyupekṣitavya ityayam | bahiṣāṃgadanṛpatirmahāsarpaṃ mṛtaṃ gale ||1.57.20|| patnīvratasya nikṣipya gatavān svapuraṃ prati | tāvattasya ṛṣeḥ brahmavrataḥ samāgataḥ ||21|| ṛṣeḥ śiṣyaiḥ svayaṃprakāśādibhiḥ sahitaḥ sthitaḥ | ṛṣergale mṛtaṃ sarpaṃ dṛṣṭvā jñātvā samādhinā ||22|| rājñā sarpo mṛtaḥ kṣiptastaṃ śāpaṃ prairayatkhalam | aho śvā vai gṛhapatiṃ bhaṣan padabhyāṃ vimānayan ||23|| dhulīṃ prakṣipatītyetad vaicitryaṃ viṣamaṃ mahat | brāhmaṇairabhiṣikto vai malakīṭo bhujaṃgatām ||24|| nītastāneva daśati kīdṛśīyaṃ kupātratā | mūṣako bhayamāpanno siṃhatve yena yojitaḥ ||25|| samīhate tamovāttuṃ kā nāma kṣudratāparā | śveva balibhuk pāpātmā patnīvrataṃ nirāgasam ||26|| avigaṇayya pitaraṃ pūjanīyaṃ sudaivatam | gale’kṣipat śavaṃ sārpamavaśyaṃ daṇḍamarhati ||27|| punarevaṃ kukurāste kuryurnaiva vimānanam | ityāmatya jalaṃ dhṛtvā kare dakṣe’vadatsutaḥ ||28|| yena sarpo gale kṣiptaḥ kuhakānmṛtyumetu saḥ | māsābhyantara eveti salilaṃ vyasṛjadbhuvi ||29|| datvā brahmavrataḥ śāpaṃ satīrthyaiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ | yāvad roditi gurvagre samādherutthito guruḥ ||1.57.30|| paśyati sma gale svasya mṛtasarpaśavaṃ yadā | rudantaṃ cāśṛṇotsvīyaṃ sutaśiṣyasumaṇḍalam ||31|| sāntvayāmāsa tān sarvān patnīvrato gurustadā | yūyaṃ sarve kimarthaṃ vai rudathātra nibodhata ||32|| śave mānuṣadehe vai śavaḥ sarpo dhṛto yataḥ | hāraḥ sa vai tu mantavyaḥ śavasya śavapūjane ||33|| nātra hānirna vā doṣo hyeṣaḥ snānaṃ karomyaham | śuddhirvai snānamātreṇa kimarthaṃ rudatha bhṛśam ||34|| śāntistu sarvadā rakṣyā kṣamā rakṣyā ca sarvathā | śāntyā ca kṣamayā sarve ṛṣayaḥ pūjyatāṃ gatāḥ ||35|| satyaṃ śīlaṃ tapo dhyānaṃ svādhyāyaḥ śaṃ titikṣaṇam | kṣamā ceti dhanaṃ divyaṃ maurdhanyaṃ no mataṃ sadā ||36|| tanna tyājyaṃ kadācidvai tadasmākaṃ tu daivatam | kṣamā tu paramaṃ śastraṃ krodhaśastranibarhaṇam ||37|| kṣamayā vāḍavāḥ sarve devaiḥ pūjāmavāpnuyuḥ | putrāḥ pṛcchāmi yuṣmābhistasyāniṣṭaṃ nu cintitam ||38|| iti praṣṭāstadā putrāḥ ṛṣiṃ tatra nyavedayan | rājānaṃ bhinnamaryādaṃ māsāntare tu sarparāṭ ||39|| kuhako’smannodito vai daṃkṣyatītyeva noditam | ṛṣirvajramayaṃ śrutvā rājanāśanamulbaṇam ||1.57.40|| tepe’tīva svahṛdaye kṣaṇaṃ tu maunamāsthitaḥ | āha svayaṃprakāśaṃ vai tvanāhāryaṃ tvayā hṛtam ||41|| svalpe drohe mahān daṇḍo na vai nyāyyaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā | rājñi śāstari caurādyā na prajāḥ pīḍayantyapi ||4|| rājaśūnye prajāḥ svaṃ svaṃ ghnanti luṇṭanti dasyavaḥ | apakvabuddhinā tāta tvayā śaptaṃ tu dāruṇam ||43|| ajñātena kṛtaṃ doṣaṃ bhagavān kṣantumarhati | aparādhisahasreṣu satsvapi naiva śocati ||44|| kliṣyati no pratikāraṃ karoti bhaktimān janaḥ | tiraskṛtāstāḍitāścākruṣṭāśca kutsitīkṛtāḥ ||45|| gālīdattāḥ praśaptāśca viprakṛtāśca pātitāḥ | āpatsvapi na duṣṭānāṃ pratikurvanti sādhavaḥ ||46|| tasmāt svayaṃprakāśa tvaṃ yāhi śīghraṃ nivedaya | māsābhyantara eva tvāṃ kuhako daṃkṣyatīti vai ||47|| iti tu preritaḥ śiṣyo jagāma barhiṣāṃgadam | rājarṣiḥ khedamāpanno duṣṭatāṃ svāṃ vyacintayat ||48|| aho’nāryo’pi no kuryāt kṛtaṃ tādṛṅmayā hyagham | brāhmaṇe pūjanīye me mahatpāpaṃ samarjitam ||49|| sampattiryauvanaṃ garvo sattā caivāvivekitā||| vipatteḥ kāraṇānyāhurmayyevānvarthatāmaguḥ ||1.57.50|| aho me ko bhavelloko brahmadveṣṭurvijṛmbhṛtaḥ || asya pāpasya pratyarthovaśyaṃ me bhavatu kṣayaḥ ||51|| punarevaṃ na vai kuryāṃ tathā śāstu dharāmaraḥ | athavā kṣemakuśale rājñāṃ viprābhisatkṛte ||52|| tathāpi me mahān daṇḍo bhagavān dātumarhati | evaṃ cintayatastasya brahmadaṇḍārthasaṃbhṛtā ||53|| śiṣyavāṇī kuhakādvai mṛtyuśaṃsinyupasthitā | śrutvā vinayasampanno’naśanavratamāsthitaḥ ||54|| brāhmaṇaṃ tu namaskṛtya svātmānaṃ brahmaṇi nyadhāt | khaṭvāṃgadapurātprācyāṃ raivatādhityakābhuvi ||55|| bhaveśasaraso madhye dvīpe jalamaye tadā | vrataṃ cānaśanaṃ kṛtvā niṣasāda udaṅmukhaḥ ||56|| jñātvā samādhiyogena ṛṣayo manavastathā | pitaro devagandharvāḥ surā yakṣāśca mānavāḥ ||57 brāhmaṇāḥ sādhavaḥ sādhvyo tīrthāni parvatāstathā| graharkṣatārakā divyā auṣadhyaḥ kalpapādapāḥ ||58|| kāmadughāḥ surabhyaśca mātaro lokapālakāḥ | āyayustānsamabhyarcya vavande daṇḍavanmuhuḥ ||59|| teṣu sukhopaviṣṭeṣu rājā mānasamarthitam | ante kartavyamālakṣya nyavedayaccikīrṣitam ||1.57.60|| aho dayābhṛtāṃ muktidātṝṇāṃ puṇyaśālinām | darśanaṃ tvaghanāśāya paralokaprasattaye ||61|| dvijaśāpo’nugraho me yanmiṣaṃ bhavadāgamaḥ | nirvedamūlaṃ saṃjāto muktaye prerako’pi ca ||62|| miṣṭaṃ vā kaṭu viproktaṃ sarvathā śreyase bhavet | tad yūyaṃ me dṛṣṭipathaṃ yātāḥ santo mṛtikṣaṇe ||63|| stheyaṃ kṛpālubhistāvad geyaṃ harerdaśastathā | kuhako daśatu sveṣṭaṃ na me cintādya vartate ||64|| satāṃ maṇḍalamadhye me prāṇo yātu sukhaṃjuṣaḥ | yatra yāmi tatra brahmajuṣāṃ sevāṃ lasāmyaham ||65|| iti kṛtvā ca natvā ca bhaveśvarasarovare | madhyadvīpe nirāhāro niṣasāda mahīpatiḥ ||66|| tadā devaiśca munibhirapsarobhirmuhurmuhuḥ || praśasya vṛṣṭiḥ puṣpāṇāṃ kṛtā jayadhvaniśritā ||67|| tāvattatrāgato vyāsaḥ śvetavyāsamuniḥ svayam | śvetarūpadharaḥ kalpe prathame yo hyajāyata ||68|| tejasā sūryasaṃkāśo vidyayā jñānabhāsuraḥ | yogena brahmasadṛśa aiśvaryeṇa hariḥ svayam ||69|| āgatāya namaścakrurutthāya tatra ye’bhavan | taṃ copaveśayāmāsuḥ samarhe tu mahāsane ||1.57.70|| āsīnaṃ taṃ sa nṛpatiḥ praṇanāma kṛtāṃjaliḥ | paripapraccha vinayāt śreyaskaramadaḥ śubham ||71|| vayaṃ vai kṣatradāyādāḥ karmaṇā hyadhamāḥ punaḥ | bhavādṛśaiḥ samāgatya lokānāmuparikṛtāḥ ||72|| tirthībhavanti saudhāni yasyābhidhānakīrtanāt | darśanaspṛśisānnidhyasevāmardanaprahvaṇaiḥ||73|| sevitāḥ sādhavaḥ samyak sevakānprapunanti hi | yeṣāṃ pādarajaḥprāptyā śuddhyanti gṛhamedhinaḥ ||74|| gṛhāṇyapi viśuddhayanti kiṃ punastatsamāgamāt | bhavato darśanaṃ mahyaṃ dayāmṛte kathaṃ bhavet ||75|| tasmānmokṣo mama dhruvaṃ bhavitā śāśvatīsamāḥ | atha me kiṃ vidheyaṃ vai mriyamāṇasya sarvathā ||76|| pṛcchāmi śravaṇaṃ jāpo bhajanaṃ vā yathocitam | anyadvā donahomādi śreyaskaraṃ pradarśyatām ||77|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne barhiṣāṃgadotpattipatnīvratāśramagamanasanmānālābhaprayojyamaharṣigalamṛtasarpanikṣepatadṛṣiputrakṛtamāsābhyantarakuhakasarpadaṃśajamṛtyuśāpatajjñānottaraprāyopaveśanavratarṣisamāgamaśvetavyāsāgamanasvaśreyaskarajijñāsādipraśnanirūpaṇanāmā saptapaṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ||57||
<1.58> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tatastatra kiṃ kiṃ jātaṃ nibodha me | śvetavyāsamuniścādyaḥ provāca hāṭakāṃgadam || 1 || rājaṃstavāśramastādṛk śreyo’rthaḥ svalpa āpyate | ātmattattvasya lābho na nidrāvyavāyakarmabhiḥ || 2 || vayo vyatyeti kāmena rātryo niryānti nidrayā | dinānyudarapūrtyarthaṃ vyavasāyaviḍambanaiḥ || 3 || draṣṭā paśyatyavirataṃ līyamānaṃ kṣaṇa jagat | gṛhāpatyakalatrādi mṛtaṃ paśyanna paśyati || 4 || hyaḥ samupārjitaṃ cādya śvo vā nāśaṃ prayātyapi | loko naiva vijānāti svasya nāśamupasthitam ||5|| sarpeṇārdhaṃ mukhe grasto maṇḍuko nikaṭāgatām | yatate makṣikāmattuṃ jīvitāśā duratyayā || 6 || kaścideva kṛpāleśād vijānātyātmamokṣaṇam | kaścideva kṛpāpātraṃ yatate śreyase punaḥ || 7 || kaścit tatrāpi sukṛtī mokṣārthameva tiṣṭhati | rājan samyagvyavasitaṃ tvayā vai mokṣakāṃkṣiṇā || 8 || śrotavyaḥ kīrtitavyaśca smartavyaḥ śrīhariḥ prabhuḥ | yogasādhanasampatteḥ sāṃkhyavijñānasaṃdhṛte || 9 || śāstrāṇāṃ ca tathābhyasterlābho mokṣaviniścayaḥ | lābho mānavasaṃbhūteryadante śrīharismṛtiḥ ||1.58.10|| sādhavaḥ prāyaśo rājan ramante’jaguṇārṇave | nirguṇā api kurvanti kathākīrtyādikaṃ hareḥ ||11|| kīrtanaṃ tu caritrāṇāṃ mūrteśca smaraṇaṃ tathā | samāgamastadbhaktānāṃ paraṃ śreyo dadāti hi ||12|| śravaṇaṃ tatkathānāṃ tadvibhūtīnāṃ ca vijñatā | upāsā hṛtsthitestasya paraṃ mokṣaṃ dadāti hi ||13|| śrīharestu kṛpāyogācchrīhareḥ kiraṇodbhavaḥ | śvetavyāsamuniścādyo nirguṇo’haṃ haro harim ||14|| dhyāyāmi ca smarāmi ca kīrtayāmi kathā hareḥ | kathāstāstu mayā lakṣmīnārāyaṇamukhācchrutāḥ ||15|| tābhiścāhaṃ sthitiṃ prāpto nirguṇāṃ muktirūpiṇīm | tathāpyetāḥ śrāvayāmi janān paramamuktaye ||16|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitaiṣā tu brahmarūpiṇī | mahābhāgavatī vāṇī brahmarūpān karoti hi ||17|| yatra sthale śravaścāsyā māsapārāyaṇena vai | sārasyāpi sthalaṃ tadvai divyaṃ vaikuṇṭhakaṃ bhavet ||18|| yeṣāṃ śravaṇagā hyeṣā saṃhitātmanyadhiṣṭhitā | te vai muktāḥ sadā bodhyā dehadhṛgo’pi mānavāḥ ||19|| eṣāṃ tu saṃhitāṃ rājan ṣaṭvāṃgadaḥ pitā tava | śrutavān kuṃkumavāpyāṃ gatavānabhayaṃ harim ||1.58.20|| brahmaṇā saṃśruteyaṃ tu saṃhitā ṛṣibhiḥ samam | tretāyāṃ satyaloke ca devaiśca pitṛbhiḥ samam ||21|| vaikuṇṭhe pāṭhamasyāśca lakṣmīrdevī karoti hi | etatpārāyaṇaṃ sarvavedebhyo’pyuttamaṃ matam ||22|| sarvataḥ prāgidaṃ śāstraṃ nārāyaṇamukhodgamam | parabrahmāvatārāstadvibhūtikoṭayastathā ||23|| pravarṇitā yathārthā vai nārāyaṇamukhācchrutāḥ | sarveṣāmādimaṃ śāstraṃ saṃhiteyaṃ sunirmitā ||24|| ādyavyāsena vai śveteneyaṃ saṃviśadīkṛtā | imāmādhāramādāya śāstrapurāṇasaṃhitāḥ ||25|| granthiṣyantyanyavyāsādyāḥ purāṇetikathānakān | tadidaṃ paramaṃ śrāvyaṃ nārāyaṇapadārjakam ||26|| ekāgreṇaiva manasā cintyastasyārtha uttamaḥ | yena mokṣo bhavetsadyo brahmalokagamātmakaḥ ||27|| viṣayebhya indriyāṇāṃ vigamaṃ hi samācaret | vṛttīnāṃ cāntare tattve layamanvahamācaret ||28|| āntarāṇāṃ tu vṛttīnāṃ svasmin sthairyaṃ samācaret | svasya yogaṃ tu hariṇā samaṃ sudṛḍhamabhyaset ||29|| ityevaṃ brahmaśīlasya drāgvimuktiḥ kare sthitā | svastikāsanamāsīnaḥ prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇaḥ ||1.58.30|| indriyavṛttīrāhṛtya sthūlaṃ prāgvai pradhārayet | mūrtaṃ vai śrīhareḥ rūpaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇātmakam ||31|| iṣaddhāsyāmṛtajharaṃ prasannaṃ premanirjharam
