| ramyamākarṣakaṃ saumyaṃ saprabhaṃ dhavalaṃ mukham ||32|| tayoḥ pṛthakpṛthagdhāryaṃ bhaktena tu mumukṣuṇā | harernetradvayaṃ cābjarājīvapatrikāyatam ||33|| premarasapravāhādāhlayanniva sudarśakam | viśālaṃ prānta dhavalaṃ smaramūrtiviḍambanam ||34|| kamanīyaṃ tayordhyeyaṃ pṛthakpṛthaṅamumukṣuṇā | bhṛkuṭīyugalaṃ dhyeyaṃ tiryakasnigdhaṃ kramātkṛśam ||35|| sūkṣmaromāvalīprāntapicchamākarṇamāyatam | madhye tu kāmacandrāḍhyaṃ sumūrtamiva sūjjvalam ||36|| athālakāḥ kṛśāḥ snigdhā vakrāścakacakāyakāḥ | projjvalā madhyasannyastabrahmamārgāvalambanāḥ ||37|| tayordvayoḥ pṛthag dhyeyāḥ svarṇamukuṭamaṇḍitāḥ | gumphitaṃ dhammilaṃ yadvā cūḍāmaṇiṃ śikhāmaṇim ||38|| tantvīmuktādāmamṛṣṭe kapole dhārayed dvayoḥ | ūrdhvaṃ vā candrakaṃ tatra dhārayenmana ātmanaḥ ||39|| udgamānudgamaśmaśrupakvabimbaphaloṣṭhakau | ākiṃcinmilitau bhugnau darśitacumbanakṣaṇau ||1.58.40|| hṛdyau dhanuṣkasadrekhāvyañjitāvamṛtaṃdharau || pṛthak tau dhārayedbhaktyā śanaistatraikatānayet ||41|| cibuke’ñcitasadratnasvarṇabinducamatkṛte | tayorvai dhārayetkarṇau svarṇaśaṣkulikāvṛtau ||42|| karṇapūrāvataṃsasraksubuṭṭimalasadvarau | evaṃ lakṣmyānanaṃ kāmyaṃ ramyaṃ nārāyaṇānanam ||43|| prollasanmiṣṭapāṇḍurāmṛtatejaḥsuvartulam | dhyāne cākṛṣyātmavṛttau dhyeyaṃ sthāpyaṃ tataḥ punaḥ ||44|| tatra cittasyātmanaśca līnībhāvaḥ samādhikṛt || evamātmani cātmānaṃ parabrahmaṇi yojayet ||45|| kṛtaṃ tu yojanaṃ yena tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ nijam || ityeva kaṇṭhahṛdayabhujodarakaṭīṃganam ||46|| sakthijānunalapiṇḍīgulphaprapadapārṣṇikān | avayavānmahālakṣmyā mahānārāyaṇasya ca ||| pratyekaṃ dhārayed dhyāyetsamādadhyācca sarvadā ||47|| mokṣastena bhavet sadyo’punarāvartanātmakaḥ | atha bandhakaraṃ tatrāvaraṇaṃ vastumātrakam ||48|| brahmāṃḍasthaṃ virodhi syāt tatrāpīkṣeta taṃ tadā || pātāle tasya caraṇau pārṣṇidvayaṃ rasātale ||49|| mahātale tu tadgulphau jaṃghe tasya talātale | sutale jānunī tasyorudvayaṃ vitale tathā ||1.58.50|| atale mehanaṃ tasya sakthimūlaṃ mahītale || nabhastale nābhikūpaṃ svarge taddhṛdayaṃ tathā ||51|| mahari tasya kaṇṭhaṃ vai jane tasyāsyamīkṣayet || lalāṭaṃ tasya tapasi satye śīrṣāṇamīkṣayet ||52|| indrādiṣu ca tadbāhūn dikṣu karṇau samīkṣayet | śabde tasya śravaṇaṃ cāśvineyayośca nāsikām ||53|| gandhe tasya prāṇamiddhānale tasyānanaṃ tathā | divi tasyākṣiṇī paśyet sūrye tannetramīkṣayet ||54|| divārātrau pakṣmaṇī tadbhruvaṃ brahmāsane tathā | apsu paśyeddharestālūṃ rase jihvāṃ samīkṣayet ||55|| chāndassu tacchiro daṃṣṭrā yame snehe dvijāṃstathā || māyāyāṃ śrīharerhāsaṃ sarge kaṭākṣamokṣaṇam ||56|| taduttarauṣṭhaṃ vrīḍāyāṃ lobhe cauṣṭhamadhaḥsthitam || dharme stanamadharme tu pṛṣṭhaṃ hareḥ samīkṣayet ||57 meḍhraṃ vedhasi tasyaiva mitrayorvṛṣaṇau hareḥ | samudreṣu hareḥ kukṣīn giriṣvasthicayām̐stathā ||58|| nadīṣu tasya nāḍīṃśca vṛkṣeṣu tattanūdbhavān | pavane śvasanaṃ tasya vayasi śrīharergatim ||59|| kriyāṃ guṇapravāhe ca keśānmegheṣu tasya vai | sandhyāsu tasya vastrāṇi pradhāne tasya sūkṣmatām ||1.58.60|| candre harermanaḥ paśyedvijñāne mahanīyatām | rudre tadantaḥkaraṇam aśvādiṣu nakhāni vai ||61|| kaṭiṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ paśuṣveva taccāturyaṃ tu pakṣiṣu svāyaṃbhuve harerbuddhiṃ parṇakuṭiṃ nareṣu ca ||62|| gandharveṣu smṛtiṃ tasyāsurasainyeṣu sadbalam | brāhmaṇeṣu mukhaṃ tasya kṣatriyeṣu bhujadvayam ||63|| vaiśyeṣūrudvayaṃ tadvaccaraṇe śūdramīkṣayet || kāme tasya tu saṃkalpaṃ strīṣu divyaharestanum ||64|| nareṣu divyavīryaṃ tasyānandaṃ brahmabhāvanam | sthūle sūkṣmaṃ mahatyalpaṃ vairāje kṛṣṇamīkṣayet ||65|| evaṃ sarvatra ca śrīmannārāyaṇamitīkṣayet || śravaṇaṃ mananaṃ dhyānaṃ tena tatra samāpayet ||66|| tadānandaṃ tasya saukhyaṃ tasya miṣṭarasaṃ dhruvam || sarvadaiva bhajato’nyat sarvaṃ tanmayatāṃ nayet ||67|| iti mukteḥ kṛte rājan vidheyaṃ te pradarśitam || tena mārgeṇa sākṣādvai hariḥ sannihito bhavet ||68|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śvetavyāsakṛtopadeśasaṃhitāpārāyaṇanirdeśabhagavanmūrtidhāraṇāvibhūtyādiharitādātmyadhāraṇādikathananāmāṣṭapaṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ||58||
<1.59> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca athāpi vāsanāleśād bahujanmabhramestathā | mano yadi punaścāyātsthairyaṃ naiva samāśrayet || 1 || tadā tu mana evedaṃ brahma ityapi dhārayet | tasmin yadudbhavecchuklaṃ mantavyaṃ kṛṣṇameva vā || 2 || tadapi brahma eveti nānyo vai viṣayo hi saḥ || ityevaṃ kalpayet prājño mumurṣurnānyamarthayet || 3 || athāpi tatra bhāsaḥ syādvividhānāṃ tu dehinām || paśukalatraputrādidravyabhavanasampadām ||4|| sarvaṃ vai brahma ityevaṃ kalpayennānyamarthayet | evaṃ tadbrahmabhāvena brahmarūpāṇi tāni vai ||5|| bhavantyeva tatastāni naiva bandhakarāṇi hi | athāpi tanmano brahmarūpaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ janaḥ || 6 || sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ paśyennānyat kiṃcidvilokayet | nendriyairnāntarairnaiva vāsanākiraṇena vā || 7 || svātmariktaṃ vipaśyeddhi kiṃcidanyadatanmayam || tādṛśaṃ svaṃ manaścaiva mantavyaṃ brahmarūpakam || 8 || kṛtvā tataḥ paraṃbrahma dhyāyecchāntarayeṇa vai || tad yathā svaṃ brahma kṛtvā paraṃ brahma sumūrtakam || 9 || cintayet saumyarūpaṃ taṃ sūkṣmaṃ prādeśamātrakam || caturbhujaṃ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ prabhum ||1.59.10|| suprasannamukhāṃbhojaṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇam | kesarapiśaṃgadhautraṃ ratnanaddhasubhūṣaṇam ||11|| mahāratnāñcitaprāntakalgikirīṭakuṇḍalam śrīvatsaṃ vakṣasi dadhadvanamālāsukaustubham ||12|| raśanāvṛttakaṭyāḍhyaṃ svarṇanūpurapatkajam | komalasvarṇapattrāṇaṃ varaprāvārasaṃvṛtam ||13|| suvarṇaśṛṃkhalāyuktāṅgulīyakaṃkaṇānvitam | snigdhābhugnanīlakeśaṃ mandahāsāmṛtānanam ||14|| premarasodgamannetraṃ bhrūcāṃcalyakṛpāparam || ityevaṃ divyatejaskaṃ surūpaṃ cintayennije ||15|| tathā nakhaśikhāpūrṇamekaikamaṃgamīkṣayet | yāvannasthiratāṃ yāyāt samabhyasyettu tāvatā ||16|| sukhasthirāsanasaṃstho jihāsurlokamulbaṇam | prāṇānyacchenmano yacched buddhiṃ yacchennijātmani ||17|| ātmānaṃ brahmaṇi yacched brahmātmānaṃ parātmani | evaṃ kramātparaṃ ruddhaḥ śāntastadrūpatāṃ gataḥ ||18|| virameta śanaiḥ kṛtyānna guṇā bandhanapradāḥ | kuto’nyatkālamāyādi yatpadaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tu tat ||19|| nābhiṃ saṃkucya ca gudaṃ kramāccakrāṇi laṃghayet | suṣumṇayā bhruvormūle guruṃ dhyātvordhvamāgataḥ ||1.59.20|| mūrdhnaśchidraṃ tato bhittvā muktaiḥ saha parivrajet | śuklaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ gatvā sūryaṃ cāndraṃ ca tārakāḥ ||21|| paitryaṃ sthānaṃ samullaṃghya ṛṣīṇāṃ maṇḍalāni ca || satyaṃ lokaṃ samulaṃghyāṣṭaiśvarāvaraṇāni ca ||22|| samullaṃghya tato gacchedvirāṭnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || hiraṇyagarbhamullaṃghya mahāviṣṇupadaṃ tataḥ ||23|| taccāpi saṃparityajya prādhāne prākṛte pade | samapohya brahmalokaṃ śāśvataṃ dhāma cāpnuyāt ||24|| na mṛtyurna jarā tatra na kālo na ca śocanam | nārtirnodvega ityeṣaḥ śrīharerloka ucyate ||25|| tanmūrtestu parānandamāpnotyānandatanmayaḥ | evaṃ mumukṣuḥ kriyayā dhyānenopāsanena vā ||26|| upāsitvā tathā dhyātvā paraṃbrahma samaśnute | bhagavatā śrīhariṇā lakṣmyai sṛtī pradarśite ||27|| kriyāyogo bhaktiyogo yenātmā mokṣamāpnuyāt || hariḥ sarvatra niyataḥ sarvaṃ caiva harau matam ||28|| tena sarvātmanā dhyāyed draṣṭāramantarātmani | ataḥ sarvasvabhāvena sarvatra sarvadā harim ||29|| śṛṇuyātkīrtayeddhyāyed yena tanmayatāṃ vrajet | ye vai kathāmṛtaṃ nityaṃ pibanti harimāśritāḥ ||1.59.30 prajvalantyāśayāsteṣāṃ vrajanti tatpadāmbujam || evaṃ vijñānarasanāmāśrito rasavijjanaḥ ||31|| kṣitiṃ tu gendukaṃ kṛtvopabarhaṇaṃ bhujadvayam | añjaliṃ bhujisatpātraṃ diśo vastraṃ prakalpya ca ||32|| vṛkṣādbhikṣāṃ saridbhyaśca jalaṃ guhāgṛhaṃ tathā | nārāyaṇāttu santoṣaṃ prāpyātmaramaṇo muniḥ ||33|| kiṃ kasmāttu samīheta nārāyaṇamṛte punaḥ | sakāmo vātha niṣkāmo hariṃ dhyāyettadātmanā ||34|| pratīkeṣvapratīke vā tattānastanmayo bhavet | tenaivaikena devena svasmāt svasya vibhūtayaḥ ||35|| bhinnopāsakakāmānāṃ tṛptyarthaṃ prakaṭīkṛtāḥ | yato nāyaṃ janaḥ sarvo mṛtau bhavati nispṛhaḥ ||36 subahūn mṛtikāle’pi padārthānīhate punaḥ | tatastenāpi tattasmin brahmabhāvanayā muhuḥ ||37|| sakāmanayā vicintyamiṣṭadaṃ brahmacaiva tat || vipratejasvitākāmo bhajetpatnīvrataṃ harim ||38|| lakṣmīkāmo bhajellakṣmīṃ tvāṃ suvarṇapradāṃ sadā | indriyasauṣṭhavamicchan bhajedindraṃ śacīpatim ||39|| apatyecchurbhajedatra dakṣādikaprajāpatīn | apradhṛṣyatvakāmo’gniṃ dravyakāmo vasūnbhajet ||1.59.40|| vīryakāmo bhajedrudramannecchuraditiṃ bhajet | svargecchustu bhajet sūryaṃ rājyecchurviśvadevatāḥ ||41|| prajāvaśitvakāmastu sādhyadevān yajeta vai || cirāyuricchuraśvinau puṣṭīcchuḥ pṛthivīṃ yajet ||42|| pratiṣṭhecchurvyomabhūmī patnīcchururvaśīṃ yajet || rūpakāmastu gandharvān kīrtikāmaḥ kratuṃ yajet ||43|| sarvādhipatyakāmastu yajed brahmāṇameva ca | dhanasaṃgrahakāmastu varuṇaṃ vai prapūjayet ||44|| vidyākāmo yajecchaṃbhuṃ dharmecchurviṣṇumarcayet || dāmpatyapremakāmastu satīmumāṃ sadā yajet ||45|| santānakulavṛddhyarthaṃ yajet pitṝnatandritaḥ || sarvathā duḥkhanāśāya yajñān kuryānmuhurmuhuḥ ||46|| balecchuko maruddevān rājyecchurmanudevatāḥ | bhogecchuḥ śaśinaṃ śatrunāśecchū rākṣasān yajet ||47|| muktikāmastu puruṣaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram | bhajeta satataṃ bhaktaḥ kāmākāmamayo dhiyā ||48|| tameva paramātmānaṃ sarvasvapradamarthayet || tattatkāmaprasiddhiḥ syāt siddhau tṛptistṛṣākṣayaḥ ||49|| tato’pi nityasaccidānandasandohamarthayet || vihāre bhojane pāne śrṛṃgāre mehane ratau ||1.59.50|| paraśūnāmapi kālo vai pṛthaggacchatyato nu kim | taravo’pi hi jīvanti bhastrāścāpi śvasanti vai ||51|| kathā naiva śrutā karṇe te’pi tādṛgvidhā janāḥ | kathāśrutiṃ vinā karṇau vālmīkau tu bilau matau ||56|| saṃkīrtanamṛte jihvā dārdurikyeva bhautikī || mukuṭārhaṃ śiro natimṛte bhārastu kevalaḥ ||53|| hareḥ sevāmṛte hastau svarṇārhāvapi cendhanau| haryadarśanakṛnnetre māyūrabarhacandrake||54|| haryamandiragau pādau vṛkṣastambau hi kevalau | hareraṃghrirajo lābhaṃ vinā martyo jīvanmṛtaḥ ||55|| harervṛndāpuṣpagandhaṃ vinā nāsāpi śāvikī | harerbhaktau dravābhāve hṛdayaṃ prastaropamam ||56|| hareḥ kathāyāṃ yannetre jalaṃ romeṣu harṣaṇam | aṃgeṣu pulako bhāvo dravo hṛdi sa sāttvataḥ ||57|| sātvatānāṃ hṛdi sākṣānnārāyaṇo vasāmyaham | namastasmai pareśāya tajjalāya namo namaḥ ||58|| anantaśaktyadhiṣṭhānāntarātmam̐ste namo namaḥ || adṛśyarūpiṇe’lakṣyavartmane brahmaṇe namaḥ ||59|| durītanāśane’khilaprāṇirūpāya te namaḥ || asannirasananāmne sāttvatāmpataye namaḥ ||1.59.60|| dīnānāṃ bandhave tubhyaṃ svadhāmni raṃsyate namaḥ | nirastātiśayasāmyaguṇaiśvaryavate namaḥ ||61|| ayogināṃ vidūrāya svahṛdisthāya te namaḥ || yatkīrtiśravadṛśyarhāsmṛtistotrāṇi sarvathā ||6|| kalmaṣāṇi vidhunvanti tasmai bhadrakṛte namaḥ || prapannā yatpadopāstyā mātrāspṛśiṃ vidhūya ca ||63|| nirāśayā brahmagatiṃ yānti tasmai ca te namaḥ || śīladānakriyāmantrayajñatyāgatapovratāḥ||64|| yadarpaṇamṛte kṣemaṃ vindanti nahi te namaḥ| śvādamatsyādacarmakṛdyavanābhīrasaṃkarāḥ||65|| kaṃkaśabarajhallādapāradhirgaṇikāpivāḥ| kirātakhasaghātāśca pāpāścānye’pi jantavaḥ ||66|| yadāśritāśrayācchīghraṃ śuddhyanti te namo namaḥ | avatāramayaḥ so’yaṃ sādhusādhvīmayaḥ prabhuḥ ||67|| īśeśājāmayo devo nārāyaṇaḥ prasīdatām | ṛṣipitṛdevamayo mānavāsuranāgadhṛk ||68|| patipatnīmayo devo nārāyaṇaḥ prasīdatām | naranārīsvarūpo’yaṃ nṛparājñīmayaḥ prabhuḥ ||69|| lokadhāmadharādhīhrīśrīpatirme prasīdatām | yatpādadhyānadhautāntarhṛdo vindanti yaṃ prabhum ||1.59.70|| tadotaprotasadbuddhyā yādṛgrūpaḥ sa dṛśyate | tathā taṃ kavayo loke varṇayanti parātparam ||71|| brahmavāṇyāṃ brahmarūpo lokavāṇyāṃ rasātmakaḥ | ubhavāṇyāṃ miṣṭatikto prasīdatāṃ katheṣṭadaḥ ||72|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhagavaddhayānabrahmalokagamanatattadvibhūtidhyānādikathananāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||59||
<1.60> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ityevaṃ pratyahaṃ lakṣmi hāṭakāṃgadabhūpatiḥ || kathāḥ śvetavyāsamukhācchṛṇoti śrotṛbhiḥ saha || 1 || ṛṣerbālakṛtācchāpātpreritaḥ kuhakaḥ phaṇī | samāgacchati daṃśārthaṃ paścimāśāvibhāgataḥ || 2 || viprarūpaṃ sa vai dhṛtvā vratadākhyasarittaṭe| viśrānto vaṭacchāyāyāṃ yāvattiṣṭhati sarparāṭ || 3 || tadā tatra samāyāto vaidyaveṣāparo dvijaḥ || so’yaṃ dhanvantarirvaidyo viṣanāśakamauṣadham ||4|| ādāya gacchati yatra tvasyāḥ pārāyaṇaṃ vṛtam || rājño viṣaṃ hariṣye’haṃ lapsye svarṇamayaṃ bahu || 5 || pāritoṣikamityevaṃ kṛtvā taṃ hāṭakāṃgadam || rakṣituṃ yāti so’pyatra mahāvaṭataroradhaḥ || 6|| chāyāṃ suśītalāṃ prāpya (vratadā) kankalāsalilaṃ śubham || pātuṃ viśramituṃ tatra niṣasāda vaṭasthale || 7 || kuhakena paripṛṣṭhaḥ prāha dhanvantaristadā | hāṭakāṃgadarājarṣervipraśāpakṛtādbhayāt II 8 II kuhakadaṃśajanyādva garalātmakavighnataḥ | taṃ gacchāmi mocayituṃ pāritoṣikavāñcchayā || 9 || kuhakena tu tacchrutvā kathitaṃ śṛṇu bho dvija || kuhakasya garaṃ tīvraṃ kathaṃ tvaṃ vārayiṣyasi ||1.60.10|| kurvatraiva vaṭe tasya parīkṣāṃ yāhi bho tataḥ || daśāmyenaṃ vaṭa tvaṃ taṃ kuru pallavitaṃ punaḥ ||11|| uktvaivamadaśadvṛkṣaṃ nyagrodhaṃ yāvadeva hi || tāvadāmūlato vṛkṣaḥ śuṣko’bhūd viṣayogataḥ ||12|| dhanvantaristadā nadyā jalamādāya cauṣadham || āplāvya tasya mūle tu yāvatkaroti secanam ||13|| tāvadvaṭo’pyaṃkuritaḥ patrarasabharo yathā | pūrvamāsīttathaiva drāgjāto harita ityapi ||14|| āścaryamidamālokya kuhakaḥ prāha taṃ dvijam | mā yāhi bho dvijaśreṣṭha kastvaṃ māṃ sannivedaya ||15|| dravyaṃ svarṇaṃ parārdhaṃ te dadāmi tatra yāhi mā | dvijo dhanvantariḥ prāha nārāyaṇāṃśajo’smyaham ||16|| hāṭakāṃgadabhaktaṃ me rakṣituṃ yāmi mānada | kuhakaḥ prāha te diṣṭyā brahmaśāpo babhūva ha ||17|| bhavāneva kathaṃ tadvai vyalīkaṃ kartumicchati | āyuṣastasya sāntatvātsukṛtasya kṣayādapi ||18|| tava saṃketakāryatvānnāśaṃ yātu dharāpatiḥ || gṛhāṇedaṃ parārdhaṃ vai svarṇamaṇimayaṃ dhanam ||19|| parāgaccha mahārāja yāmyahaṃ daṃśanāya tam | kuhakastvevamābhāṣya maṇiṃ svamūrdhna ādadau ||1.60.20|| yasmātsvarṇamanantaṃ vai sparśādbhavati lohataḥ | dhanvantarirdhanaṃ nītvā gataḥ svasya niketanam ||21|| kuhakastu bhāviyogātkathāsthānamagād drutam || vaṭo’mṛtauṣadhiprāptestūrṇaṃ tvamaratāṃ gataḥ ||22|| śvetaharitaparṇāḍhyo yāvatkalpaṃ bhaviṣyati | dhanvantarivaṭakhyātiṃ loke vai sa gamiṣyati ||23|| raivatātparvatānnairṛtyāyāṃ diśi vaṭo’lpakaḥ | yojanatritayaṃ dūre vartate sūcayan sthitim ||24|| mahālayakṣiteḥ paścād dūraṃ gavyūtirasti saḥ || tīrthaṃ viṣaharaṃ tadvai snānamātrātpraśasyate ||25|| vaṭasparśanamātrācca viṣaṃ naśyati dehinām | mantro viṣaharaścāyaṃ dhanvantarisamīritaḥ ||26|| viṣāpasarpa bhadraṃ te gaccha viṣa ito drutam | hāṭakāṃgadarakṣārthaṃ dhanvantaribalaṃ smara ||27|| iti mantraṃ samuccāryāvatārayati yo viṣam || drāgeva pralayaṃ yāti viṣamulbaṇamulbaṇam ||28|| atha saḥ kuhako viprarūpadhṛk sadasi drutam || pracchannaśca samāgamya kathāṃ śṛṇoti nityaśaḥ ||29|| prāpte triṃśattame tvahni pūrvaṃ sāyāhna eva tu || pārāyaṇasamāptau vai vyāsapūjottaraṃ tadā ||1.60.30|| hāṭakāṃgadabhūpālaṃ yajamānaṃ yadā guruḥ || vyāso jagāma sahāśīrvādadānāya tāvatā ||31|| rūpāntaraṃ śalākeva sūkṣmaṃ kṛtvā tu sarparāṭ || hārapuṣpeṣu vai līnaḥ puṣpavarṇa ivākalaḥ ||32|| hāreṇa saha nṛpateḥ kaṇṭhe tiṣṭhati vāñchayā | yāvad rājāpi vadati vyāsadeva namo’stu te ||33|| tava prasādād vighno me gata eveti lakṣaye | tāvatsa kuhakaḥ kaṇṭhe sūkṣmaṃ daṃśaṃ cakāra vai ||34|| viṣaṃ svamulbaṇaṃ tīvraṃ daṃṣṭrayāsiñcadaṇvapi | rājñastadbrahmarandhre vai gataṃ nāḍyā tu satvaram ||35|| avyāpnottāvadānakhaśikhaṃ hāhādhvanistadā | samabhūcca sadasyānāṃ śokodvignadhiyāṃ mahān ||36|| rājā tu kṛṣṇasaṃlagnamānasātmeva yogirāṭ | divyavigrahavān bhūtvā yayau brahmapuraṃ param ||37|| kuhukastu svakaṃ rūpaṃ darśayitvā nigūhya ca | satvaraṃ paridudrāva jagāma nijamālayam ||38|| atha rājñaḥ suputreṇa svarṇāṃgadena yajñarāṭ | sarpayajñaḥ kṛto yatra sarpāṇāmanale havaḥ ||39|| svapituḥ pratikārāya kṛto roṣanivṛttaye | sarpāṇāṃ tu vināśāya sarpamantravidastadā ||1.60.40|| samāhūya dvijām̐stūrṇaṃ sarpasatraṃ samācarat || agniṃ prājvālya nāmāni sarpāṇāṃ parihṛtya ca ||41|| juhāva subahūn sarpān petuścāgnau ca saṃghaśaḥ | kuhakastu tadā cendraśaraṇaṃ gatavān kila ||4|| prāha rakṣa surādhipa mṛterasyāḥ dayāṃ kuru | śrutveti ca tadā hīndro rājā trilokirakṣakaḥ ||43|| sarpaṃ rarakṣa pārśve sve na vai patati sarparāṭ | dhyānena tu tadā viprairjñāta indrasurakṣitaḥ ||44 tadā vai brāhmaṇāstatra mantrānuccārya vegataḥ || suparṇadvijamukhyāste prasahyāhūya bhoginaḥ ||45|| juhuvuścānale mukhyān gauṇām̐ścāpi samantataḥ || sendraṃ ca kuhakaṃ mantramuccāryāpyajuhod yathā ||46|| omagnaye svāhā kuhakaṃ sendraṃ juhomi mantram | yāvaduccārya sarṣapān juhotyagnau tadā svayam ||47|| indraḥ kuhakayukto vai svāsanātpatito bhuvi || agnau sasarpaḥ patitaḥ prajajjvālākaṭi drutam ||48|| brahmaṇā sa niruddho vai maivaṃ deve’tigaṃ kuru || tadā dvijaḥ suparṇastu dvijāścānye mahābalāḥ ||49|| pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā nivṛttāḥ karmaṇastataḥ || indraṃ dhanvantariretya tvauṣadhenācikitsayat ||1.60.50|| nīrujaṃ tu cakārainaṃ jagāma svaniketanam || kuhakastvardhadagdho vai śeṣeṇāgatya mocitaḥ ||51|| jīvitaḥ prāṇasandhinyā samauṣadhyā tataḥ khalu | sarpāḥ kuhakajātīyāḥ pṛṣṭhe deśe samantataḥ ||52|| kṛṣṇapītasudhūmrādivicitracandrakāḥ sadā | dagdhatvacāṃ darśanāni bhavanti tvagnipāśataḥ ||53|| ityevaṃ prathamadvāparasya jātaṃ kathānakam || tadānīmindradevasya trāso’bhūnmaraṇasya vai ||54|| tadvat trāso bhavatyeva prāṇināṃ ghātakarmaṇi || tasmād ghāto na kartavyaḥ kenacittu dayālunā ||55|| ityevaṃ tu kathā divyā proktā kalpādikālajā | bhaktyahiṃsādidharmāḍhyā paraśreyaskarī śubhā ||56|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vratadānanadītaṭīyavaṭacchāyāyāṃ kuhakadhanvantaribalaparīkṣaṇasarpadaṃśajahārakāṃgadanidhanasarpasatrāgnimadhyasendrakuhakahomasuparṇadvijādikṛtahavanagrastendrakuhakā dikaruṇākṛdbrahmaśeṣādivacanadvārakarakṣaṇādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 60 ||
<1.61> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi tava praśnānusāriṇīm | kathāṃ yamasya tatpūryā yatrāsti jīvaniṣkṛtiḥ || 1 || dvāpare prāṇināṃ bhāvāḥ satyahīnā yadābhavan | pāpe ca kapaṭe buddhiryadā muhuravartata || 2 || pakṣapātastadā cauryaṃ svārtho mithyābhiśaṃsanam | prasahye ca parasvādi hartavyamapi dūṣaṇam || 3 || hiṃsā droho’vamānaṃ ca nindānyābhibhavo’rdanam | ityādidoṣasahitān lokān dṛṣṭvā prajāpatiḥ || 4 || svayaṃbhūrbhagavān brahmā daṇḍārthaṃ tu vyacintayat || devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ dadhyau kṣaṇaṃ tāvaddhariḥ svayam || 5 || prāvirbhūya prasannāsyaḥ prāha kasmādahaṃ smṛtaḥ || brahmā nivedayāmāsa devāya paramātmane || 6 || dvāpare khalu saṃprāpte lokāḥ satyavivarjitāḥ | parasparasvahartāro mithyāvādāśca nirdayāḥ || 7 || teṣāṃ kṛte tu kartavyaṃ kinnu vai bhagavan mayā || daṇḍasteṣāmavaśyaṃ vai kartavyo bhavati prabho || 8 || anyathā tvavyavasthā syāllokā vināśamāpnuyuḥ || bhojanācchādanagṛhāvāseṣvapi baliṣṭhakaiḥ || 9 || kṛtādupadravātteṣāṃ sukhaṃ syānna kadācana || tasmātteṣāṃ niyamanaṃ kimapyādhehi śaṃ kuru ||1.61.10|| śratvaivaṃ brahmaṇo vākyaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ | sasmāra dharmaṃ śāstāraṃ dharmastatrāgato drutam ||11|| praṇipatya ca saṃpūjya devadevaṃ janārdanam || brahmāṇaṃ cāpi pitaraṃ namaskṛtyābravīdidam ||12|| kinnu me kāryamāpannaṃ dehyājñāṃ tatkaromyaham || hariḥ prāha tadā dharmaṃ daṇḍakāryaṃ gṛhāṇa vai ||13|| lokānāṃ svārjitānāṃ tu karmaṇāṃ phalado bhava || satkarmaṇāṃ satphalado’satkarmaṇāmasatpradaḥ ||14|| rūpadvayaṃ gṛhītvā tvaṃ daṇḍakāryaṃ kuru dvija | brahmaṇā moditaḥ so’pi tatkāryaṃ śirasi nyadhāt ||15|| punardharmastadā prāha nārāyaṇaṃ jagadgurum || kiṃ kāryaṃ kena rūpeṇa kva sthale kaiśca hetubhiḥ ||16|| kathaṃ daṇḍayitavyaṃ tacchādhi śrīparameśvara | tadāha bhagavān kṛṣṇo gṛhāṇa tvaṃ tanudvayam ||17|| ghorarūpaṃ tu tatraikaṃ trāsadaṃ ca bhayaṃkaram aparaṃ saumyarūpaṃ tu sukhadaṃ śāntidaṃ sadā ||18|| tadetadrūpalabdhyarthaṃ sūryāpatyaṃ bhavāciram || yamarūpo vikarālasvarūpastrāsado bhavā ||19|| dvitīyaṃ tu tava rūpamidameva bhavatvatha || tataste vāsayogyaṃ vai sthānaṃ dakṣiṇadigbhavam ||1.61.20|| kalpayiṣye viśālaṃ tatpurī saṃyamanīti yat | daṇḍākhyaṃ puruṣaṃ dāsye yamadūtām̐śca koṭiśaḥ ||21|| lekhakām̐ścāpi saṃdāsye citraguptākhyamukhyakān | svakarmaphalabhogāya sthānāni karmiṇāṃ kṛte ||22|| vividhāni racayiṣye gaccha sūryasuto bhava || ityādiśya haristasmātsthānāttiro’bhavattadā ||23|| brahmāṇaṃ tu namaskṛtya dharmaḥ sūryaṃ viveśa ha sūryo’pyaicchattadā patnīṃ putrasantatihāyinīm ||24|| atha sarvaguṇopetā prāptā saṃjñābhidhā priyā || viśvakarmasutā divyā raviṇā sā vivāhitā ||25|| sūryastu tejasā tīvraḥ saṃjñā mṛdvī svatejasā || sūryatejo’sahamānā raveḥ sevāṃ karotyapi ||26|| yadā sūryastu saṃjñāyā mukhaṃ paśyati kāmataḥ || tadā saṃjñā sūryatejaḥpradhṛṣyā bhavati drutam ||27|| sūryasya tejasā saṃjñā netre nimilate sadā | premṇā paśyantyapi sūryaṃ tejasābhibhavāttadā ||28|| nahi vivṛttanetreṇa draṣṭuṃ śaktā bhavatyasau | sūryaḥ svayaṃ svabhāvāddhi dehe’pyuṣṇatamaḥ paraḥ ||29|| saṃjñā sūryasya tattejo hyugraṃ soḍhuṃ śaśāka na | yadā yadā tu sūryastāṃ samāśliṣyati vai priyām ||1.61.30|| tadā tu sūryaṃ santaptaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca vivaśā hi sā || patiṃ dṛṣṭvā muhuḥ saṃjñā svākṣisaṃyamanaṃ vyadhāt ||31|| sūryastu premasamaye priyāṃ saṃruddhalocanām || muhurdṛṣṭvā hyadhīraḥ san roṣādvacanamabravīt ||32|| mama yoge sadā bhīru kuruṣe svākṣisaṃyamam | tasmānmadvīryataste’pi putro bhavatu saṃyamaḥ ||33|| nāmnā yamastu vikhyāto yamarājeti vai mahān | jīvānāṃ karmapākasya daṇḍadātā bhaviṣyati ||34|| mama krodhavaśāt so’pi krūradharmā bhaviṣyati | tava netrasaṃyamanāt sopi tādṛgbhaviṣyati ||35|| yadā tu karmapākaṃ vai daṇḍaṃ dāsyati karmaṇe | tadā hyākrośato jīvānnaiva drakṣyati netrataḥ ||36|| netre sammīlya daṇḍaṃ vai yathākarma pradāsyati | yādṛg vai saṃgame pitrorbhāvastādṛk tu bālake ||37|| ityevaṃ vadamāne tu ravau saṃjñā yathā tathā || priyacikīrṣayā patyuścaṃcalāpyabhavattadā ||38|| hāvaṃ bhāvaṃ darśayantī sneharatiṃ karoti vai || kāmabhogaṃ ratiṃ rītyā netre conmīlya bhāvataḥ ||39|| śaṃ nirvartayate yāvat sūryādgarbhaṃ samādadhau || sūryaḥ prāha tadā saṃjñāṃ priye tvaṃ cañcalā muhuḥ ||1.61.40|| vilolitasucāñcalyapūrṇadṛṣṭyā ca māṃ punaḥ || vilokayasi ramaṇād raṃjayasi ca māṃ muhuḥ ||41|| tato’patyaṃ dvitīyaṃ te caṃcalaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati | sāpi kanyā tvayā tulyā caṃcalā vai bhaviṣyati ||42|| ityevaṃ yamakaṃ garbhe dadhāra ravikāmyayā | atha prāpte tu samaye suṣuve yamakaṃ tu sā ||43|| patipradattavacanāttasyā jajñe yamo yamī || jātamātaṃ tu ṣoḍaśahāyanaṃ samabhūd dvayam ||44|| sūryagṛhe tu ramate yamakaṃ tad yamo yamī || putro dvitīyaḥ saṃjñāyāḥ śrāddhadevo’bhavanmanuḥ ||45|| yamastu yamarājo’bhūt saṃyaminyāṃ phalapradaḥ || yamī tu yamunā bhaktā nadī kṛṣṇecchayābhavat ||46|| golokātkṛṣṇacandreṇa preritātra samāgatā || sūryaputrī svayaṃ bhūtvā vṛndāvane gamiṣyati ||47|| kalindasya sutā paścāt kālindī sā bhaviṣyati | yamunā sā mahādevī divyā mokṣapradāyinī ||48|| ākalpāntaṃ jalarūpā vṛndāvanavihāriṇī || kṛṣṇakelihradaramyā gopagopīkṛtāplavā ||49|| devadevīmahāpūjyā gokulāgre gamiṣyati || evaṃ putradvayaṃ putraṃ saṃjñā saṃsuṣuve raveḥ | ||1.61.50|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sūryotpāditasvapatnīsaṃjñāgarbhotpannaśrāddhadevayamayamīprāvirbhāvakathananāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 61 ||
<1.62> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tataḥ paścāt saṃjñāyā yā kathā hyabhūt | nityaṃ sūryaprasaṃge’syā jvalanaṃ duḥsahaṃ hyabhūt || 1 || evaṃ saṃjñā ravestejomahaduḥkhena bhāminī || asahantīva sā citte cintayāmāsa vai sadā || 2 || kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kva yāmi sukhadaṃ sthalam || yadi yāmi vinā hyājñāṃ sūryo me kopavānbhavet || 3 || tasmādājñāṃ gṛhītvaiva svapiturgṛhamemyaham || iti sañcintya bahudhā sūryaṃ prāha muhustadā || 4 || deva me jāyate nityaṃ vicārastu piturgraham || gantuṃ mīlayituṃ sarvān svasṝrbhātṝnsakhījanān || 5 || ājñāpayatu māṃ nātha yāmi devāya rocate || sūryaḥ prāha na vai devi kālo’yaṃ gamanāya na || 6 || putrapālanakālo’yaṃ gṛhasaṃbhālanāya ca | patyuḥ sevātilābhāya samayo’yaṃ tava priye || 7 || tatra gatvā nu te lābhaḥ ko vā bhāvī mama priye || māṃ vihāya viyogasthaṃ kathaṃ sthāsyasi tatra vai || 8 || anāhūtā piturge he putrī gacchati vegataḥ || satī śaṃkarapatnīva durdaśāmāpnuyāddhi sā || 9 || tasmānmā gaccha rambhoru gantavyaṃ tvanyadā punaḥ || kanyā vivāhapūrvaṃ vai śobhante tu piturgṛhe ||1.62.10|| kṛtodvāhāstu tāḥ paścācchobhante svapatigṛhe | khānapānavilepābhyaṃjanaprābhūṣaṇādibhiḥ | 11|| vastravāhanayānodyānopavanavihārakaiḥ| vividhaiḥ smaraṇottejisādhanaistu navairnavaiḥ ||12|| ramayanti patiṃ premṇā tṛpyanti patisaukhyataḥ || nirdhano vā pitā yāsāṃ vyayāśaktaśca sarvathā ||13|| putryastadgṛhamāgatya duḥkhe taṃ yojayanti hi || vastrairdhanairābharaṇaiścānyairbhogyaistu vastubhiḥ ||14|| aśakto raṃjane putryā mā duḥkhe pātayantu tam | dine deha prayāsena śramyaṃ kāryaṃ vidhāya ca ||15|| dhanaṃ svodarapūrtyātma nītvā sāyaṃ gṛhaṃ gataḥ || evaṃ tu pratidivasaṃ svodyogārjyālpanāṇakam ||16|| nītvā krīṇātyannavastraṃ mā taṃ duḥkhe nipātaya || ityevaṃ bahu sandiṣṭā hyanunītā muhurmuhuḥ ||17|| saṃjñā tejo’sahaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhartre naiva vadatyapi || paścāttu mohamāpannā vicārya ca muhuḥ svayam ||18|| patiryathā na jñāyeta dvitīyaṃ rūpamādadhe | seyaṃ tanudvitīyā sā chāyā svasyaiva daihikī ||19|| hyabhūttatra tu saṃkalpya cetanaṃ samanodayat || tejasvinī vahnisamā sūryatejaḥsahā tathā ||1.62.20|| pārthivāṃśasamakrāntā chāyābhūt strīsvarūpiṇī | tathā sā cetanavatī nārīrūpā tu sundarī ||21|| saṃjñāsadṛśarūpā ca sarvaṃ saṃjñāmayaṃ hyabhūt || piturgṛhaṃ tato gantuṃ kṛtabuddhiryaśasvinī ||22|| chāyāmāhūya satkṛtya datvā gṛhadhanādikam || tāṃ provāca tvayā stheyamatra bhānoryathā mayā ||23|| tathā samyagapatyeṣu vartitavyaṃ yathā ravau | na duṣṭamapi vācyaṃ te yathā bahumataṃ mama ||24 saṃjñāhamasmi saiveti vācyamevaṃ tvayānaghe | yadi pṛcchetpatiḥ krodhātpremato vānyakāraṇāt ||25|| tvaṃ tu sūryasya tāpaṃ vai sahiṣyase yathā tathā | śītalaṃ te śarīraṃ vai bhaviṣyati tathā tathā ||26|| tāpasahanayogye vai śāntide jvaranāśake | sukhade te śarīre vai tāpaḥ śamiṣyati drutam ||27|| uṣṇasya layakaraṇāt sūryo’pi śāntimeṣyati | tasmāttvayā sadā sevyaḥ sūryo mayeva bhāvataḥ ||28|| bhartsane tāḍane vātha gālīdāne sumardane | tvayā nodāsitavyaṃ na prakāśyaṃ mama gopanam ||29|| chāyā provāca saṃjñāṃ tu sahiṣye sarvamādarāt | ākeśagrahaṇāccāhamāśāpācca vacastathā ||1.62.30|| kariṣye pālayiṣyāmi yāvatkeśāpakarṣaṇāt || yadā vā maraṇaṃ yāvad duḥkhaṃ paśyāmi tāvatā ||31|| na tathāpi kathayiṣye tava vā mama vartanam | gaccha devi bhagini tvaṃ piturgṛhaṃ sukhā bhava ||3|| kadāciccittavaiklavye smartavyāhaṃ tvayā svasaḥ | ityevaṃ samayaṃ kṛtvā saṃjñā yayau piturgṛham ||33|| dadarśa tatra tvaṣṭāraṃ tapasaidhitavigraham | namaskṛtya ca pitarau niṣasāda tadantike ||34|| bahumānācca tenāpi pūjitā viśvakarmaṇā | piturgṛhe sukhaṃ tasthai bahukālamaninditā ||35|| patyurgṛhaṃ prati gantuṃ yadā necchati putrikā | tataḥ prāha sa dharmajñaḥ pitā putrīṃ ciroṣitām ||36|| tvāṃ tu me paśyato vatse dināni su bahūnyapi || muhūrtena samāni syurbālaṃ kasya na rocate ||37 putro vā yadi vā putryaḥ saguṇā nirguṇāśca vā | sucittā vā vicittā vā yathā tathā ca vā punaḥ ||38|| tathāpi pitroḥ snigdhāḥ syurāhlādakārakāḥ sadā || tvaṃ putri yauvanavatī raviṇā ca vivāhitā ||39|| ciraṃ tvatra nivāsena tava dharmo vilupyati | bāndhaveṣu ciraṃ vāso nārīṇāṃ na yaśaskaraḥ ||1.62.40|| icchanti bāndhavā dharm patnyāḥ patigṛhe sthitim | sā tvaṃ trailokyanāthena bhartrā sūryeṇa saṃgatā ||41|| piturgehe ciraṃ kālaṃ vastuṃ nārhasi putrike | patyurgṛhe nivāsaṃ vai kartumarhasi putrike ||42|| ato bhartṛgṛhaṃ gaccha dṛṣṭo’haṃ pūjitā ca me | punarāgamanaṃ kāryaṃ darśanāya śubhe kṣaṇe ||43 yadi te manasi kiñcid duḥkhaṃ jāmātṛtaḥ kṛtam || bhavejjñāpayitavyaṃ me satvaraṃ putrike’tra vai ||44|| no ced duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ gaccha sevayāṃśukaraṃ prabhum || tena tvamatra cāmutra dharmyāṃ siddhiṃ gamiṣyasi ||45|| ityuktāpi svakaṃ duḥkhaṃ lajjamānā satī tadā | novāca pitaraṃ kiṃcid vicāryāpi muhurmuhuḥ ||46|| tathetyuktvā ca natvā ca pūjayitvā gurūm̐stathā || bhrātṝnsvasṝśca saṃśliṣya sā jagāmottarān kurūn ||47|| sūryatāpakṛtodvegā tejasastasya bibhyatī || na gatā sā sūryagṛhaṃ gatāraṇyaṃ tapaḥpriyā ||48|| tatrānyeṣāmaviditā vaḍavārūpadhāriṇī | tapaścacāra paramaṃ ghāsagrāsādijīvanā ||49|| saṃjñāmityeva manvāno chāyāyāṃ tu divākaraḥ | janayāmāsa tanayau kanyāṃ caikāṃ manoramām ||1.62.50|| nāmnā tu sāvarṇimanuṃ tāpīṃ śanaiścaraṃ tathā || sāvarṇistu manurbhāvī śanaiścaro graho bhavet ||51|| tapatī tu nadī tāpī gaurjare bhāvinī priye || saṃjñāmityeva niścitya chāyāyāṃ ca divākaraḥ ||52|| ratyā saṃyujyamāno vai reme subahuvatsarān | nāvidatseyamanyeti tadā daivavaśāttu sā ||53|| chāyā divāniśaṃ samyak svasyāpatyasya vai muhuḥ || cakārābhyadhikaṃ snehaṃ bhojanācchādanādiṣu ||54|| saṃjñāyā na tathā putrīputrayoścāpyavartata | manustatkṣāntavānasyā yamastasyā na cākṣamat ||55|| prāgabhūdbahumānaḥ sa sapatnyā duḥkhito’dya ca || sapatnyāścāvamānāya krodhaṃ sa tu cakāra vai ||56|| tato roṣācca bālyācca bhāvino’rthasya vai balāt || tāḍanāya tu tāṃ chāyāṃ pādastena samudyataḥ ||57|| tasyāḥ punaḥ kṣāntamanā na tu dehe nyapātayat || tataḥ śaśāpa taṃ krodhāt sapatnī jananī yamam ||58|| kiñcitprasphuramāṇauṣṭhī vicalatpāṇipallavā || patnyāṃ pituryadi mayi pādamudyacchase balāt ||59|| bhuvi tasmādayaṃ pādastavādyaiva patatviti || ityākarṇya yamaḥ śāpaṃ mātaryativiśaṃkitaḥ ||1.62.60|| abhyetya pitaraṃ prāha praṇipātapuraḥsaram | tātaitanmahadāścaryamadṛṣṭamiti ca kvacit ||61|| krodhaṃ karoti nityaṃ me subahu bhartsayatyapi | mātā vātsalyamutsṛjya śāpaṃ putre prayacchati ||6|| nirguṇeṣvapi putreṣu na mātā nirdayī bhavet || yathā mātā tu māṃ cakhyau neyaṃ mātā tathā mama ||63|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayuga santāne saṃjñāyāḥ svacchāyārūpanārīṃ sūryāya samarpya svapitṛgṛhagamanaṃ chāyāyā yamaṃ prati snehaśūnyavartanaṃ cetivarṇananāmā dviṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||62||
<1.63> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca yamasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā bhagavān lokabhāskaraḥ || hārdaṃ gambhīramevaitajjñātvā provāca vai yamam || 1 || asaṃśayaṃ mahatputra bhaviṣyatyatra kāraṇam | yena tvāmāviśatkrodho mātaraṃ prati tattathā || 2 || putraṃ pratyapi mātuśca krodhaḥ samāviśannanu | putra tvamasi dharmajñaḥ satyavādī ca mānadaḥ || 3 || na śakyametanmithyā tu kartuṃ māturvacastava || kṛmayo māṃsamādāya yāsyanti tu mahīṃ tava || 4 || tataḥ pādaṃ mahāprājña punaḥ saṃprāpsyase sukham | kṛtamevaṃ vacaḥ satyaṃ mātustava bhaviṣyati ||5|| śāpasya parihāreṇa tvaṃ ca trāto bhaviṣyasi || ādityastvabravīcchāyāṃ kimarthaṃ tanayeṣu vai || 6 || nyūnādhiko nu tulyeṣu sneho vai kriyate tvayā || kathamevaṃ dvitīyāṃ tu vinā syātpakṣapātitā || 7 || kā tvaṃ saiva dvitīyā vā vada yāthārthyameva me | sā cāha tanayā tvaṣṭurahaṃ saṃjñā vibhāvaso || 8 || patnī tava tvayāpatyānyetāni janitāni me || itthaṃ vivasvatastāṃ tu bahuśaḥ pṛcchato yadā || 9 || nācakṣe tu tadā kruddho ravistāṃ śaptumudyataḥ || tataḥ sā kathayāmāsa yathāvṛttaṃ vivasvate ||1.63.10|| viditārthaśca bhagavān sūryaḥ śaśāpa tāṃ tadā | sarvadā tvaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇā chāyā vṛkṣādijā bhava ||11|| andhakārasvarūpā tvaṃ madviyogavatī sadā || rodhakavastvāvaraṇā jaḍarūpā sadā bhava ||12|| gaccha gehātsadā dūraṃ mā māṃ darśaya te mukham || madraśmirodhakavastvadhastāttvaṃ tu sadā vasa ||13|| nirvivāsyeti vai chāyāṃ jagāma tvaṣṭurālayam || tatra saṃpūjayāmāsa tvaṣṭā sūryamupāgatam ||14|| bhāsvan kiṃ rahitaḥ śaktyā mama gehamupāgataḥ || papracchātha ca tasmai sa kathayāmāsa tattvataḥ ||15|| prāha tvaṣṭāgatā sātra bhavataḥ preṣitā rave || mama gṛhātpunaryātā tava gehaṃ divākara ||16|| divākaraḥ samādhau tām vaḍavārūpadhāriṇīm | tapaścarantīmācaṣṭe cottareṣu kuruṣvatha ||17|| tāṃ śaptukāmo bhagavānnāśāya kupito raviḥ || tvaṣṭā tu taṃ yathānyāyaṃ sāntvayāmāsa vai śanaiḥ ||18|| deva te sāsahamānā tejasā hyatipīḍitā | vahnyābhanijarūpasya chāyārūpaṃ vimucya ca ||19|| ghorāraṇye tu sā gatvā tapaścarati duścaram || ghṛṣṇyauṣṇyād dagdhadehā sā tapaścarati duḥsaham ||1.63.20|| yena tvāṃ tejasāsahyaṃ śarīreṇāpyasaṃskṛtam || bahuśṛṃgoccadhāraṃ ca khararūkṣocanīcinam ||21|| vajrādapi sukaṭhinaṃ draṣṭuṃ soḍhuṃ śaśāka na | tavedamativairūpyaṃ naiva bhāti na śobhate ||22|| asahā tasya sā saṃjñā vane carati śādvale| tasmādrūpaṃ vraja mandaṃ tādṛṅnirvartaye tvaham ||23|| rūpaṃ vivasvatastvāsīdavyavasthaṃ kharāghaṭam | ekataḥ prajvālayati cānyato’nuṣṇaśītalam ||24|| vivasvānatha tacchrutvā vrīḍito’bhūnmuhustadā || anujñātastatastvaṣṭā rūpasamīkarāya vai ||25|| bhramimāropya sūryaṃ tu śātayāmāsa śāṇataḥ | śṛṃgadeśāstadā tasya dvādaśa śātitāḥ pṛthak ||26|| samīkṛtastadā saumyaḥ surūpobhūcca bhāskaraḥ || sahyatejāḥ sparśayogyaḥ sahavāsyo’bhavadraviḥ ||27|| dvādaśebhyastu khaṇḍebhyastvaṣṭāyudhāni nirmame || cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ kṛtvā viṣṇave tatsamārpayat ||28|| triśūlaṃ sumahat kṛtvā śaṃbhave tatsamārpayat || śaktiṃ kṛtvā mahālambāṃ kārtikāya samārpayat ||29|| vajraṃ kṛtvāṣṭadhāraṃ tatsurendrāya samārpayat || daṇḍaṃ kṛtvā mahāghoraṃ yamāya sa samārpayat ||1.63.30|| maṇiṃ kṛtvā mahāmūlyaṃ kuberāya samārpayat | pāśaṃ kṛtvā tu vaidyutaṃ varuṇāya samārpayat ||31|| khaḍgaṃ kṛtvā mahaddhoraṃ devyai kālyai samārpayat | kṛpāṇaṃ tu mahāghoraṃ kṛtvāgnaye samārpayat ||32|| phalaṃ kṛtvā mahābāṇe narāya tatsamārpayat | ulkāṃ kṛtvā mahādivyāṃ vāyave tāṃ samārpayat ||33|| kṛkaśāṃ dantrikāṃ kṛtvā nirṛtāya samārpayat | tadanye svalpakhaṇḍāstu hīrakā maṇayo’bhavan ||34|| atha susaṃskṛtaḥ sūryo devarūpaṃ dadhāra ca | dadarśa yogamāsthāya svāṃ bhāryāṃ vaḍavāṃ raviḥ ||35|| gatastatra sthale rūpaṃ pracchādya cāspṛśattataḥ || aśvarūpeṇa mārtaṇḍaḥ tāṃ cucumba muhurmuhuḥ ||36|| pṛṣṭhe gacchannathordhvaṃ tāṃ samārohati kāmataḥ | maithunāya viceṣṭantaṃ parapuṃsaṃ viśaṃkya sā ||37|| vivṛtya tatsamīpe tu mukhaṃ kṛtvā sthitābhavat || aśvarūpo’pi sūryastu kāmavegena cākulaḥ ||38|| kaṃdharāyāṃ samutplutya ghrāṇe liṃgaṃ niveśya ca | vīryaṃ sarvamasiñcadvai nāsikāyāṃ dvidhā tadā ||39|| sā taṃ niradhamacchukraṃ nāsikāśvāsavāyunā || devau tasmātsamutpannāvaśvinau bhiṣajāṃvarau ||1.63.40|| nāsatyaścaiva dasraśca smṛtau dvāvaśvināviti || atyadbhutaśarīrau tau devavedyau babhūvatuḥ ||41|| avaśeṣeṇa vīryeṇa nāsikātastadaiva hi || tṛtīyo’bhūd revatākhyaḥ putro nīlasurūpakaḥ ||42|| sa vai tasmāt tapaḥ kartuṃ paścimāyāṃ gato diśi || raivatācalamāsādya tatra vāsaṃ cakāra ha ||43|| raivatasya gireḥ so’yamātivāhikadaivataḥ || bhūtvā vasati tatraiva kalpāntaṃ tapa ādadhan ||44|| atha sūryaḥ svakaṃ rūpaṃ bhāskaraṃ samadarśayat || tadā saṃjñāpi viśvastā patipādau prapūjya ca ||45|| kṣamāpya svāparādhaṃ vai jagāma ravimaṇḍale | sarvadā sā mahādivyā devī sūryasarūpiṇī ||46|| samāste ramate sārdhaṃ sūryeṇa divi modate || ityevaṃ sūryabālānāṃ navānāṃ divyajanmatā ||47|| śrāddhadevo yamo yamī sāvarṇiśca śanaiścaraḥ || tapatī cāśvinībālau revataśca nava smṛtāḥ ||48|| tatra yamāya sūryeṇa brahmaṇā ca samarpitam || lokapālatvamevaitya dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāsthitaḥ ||49|| yamapūrīti sā proktā kṛtānāṃ tu vikarmaṇām || phalabhogāya duḥkhātmaniṣkṛtistatra kāryate ||1.63.50|| prāyaścittenātra loke pāṃkto bhavati mātrataḥ | yamapūryāṃ phalabhogācchuddho bhavati cātmataḥ ||51|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne saṃjñāyā vaḍavārūpeṇa tapaścaryā sūryo’śvo bhūtvā tayā saṃśliṣṭo’śvinīkumārau revataṃ cotpādayāmāsa viśvakarmaṇā śāṇollīḍhasūryasya khaṇḍairdivyacakraśūlādiśastrotpādanamityādivarṇananāmā triṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||63||
<1.64> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca yāmyanairṛtayormadhye puraṃ vaivasvatasya tu | sarvaṃ vajramayaṃ divyamabhedyaṃ yat surāsuraiḥ || 1 || caturasraṃ caturdvāraṃ saptaprākāratoraṇam | svayaṃ tiṣṭhati tasyāntaryamo dūtaiḥ samanvitaḥ || 2 || yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ hi pramāṇena tu dṛśyate | sarvaṃ ratnamayaṃ divyaṃ vidyunmālārkavarttulam || 3 || pañcaviṃśapramāṇena yojanāni samucchritam | vṛtaṃ stambhasahasraistu vaidūryamaṇimaṇḍitam || 4 || muktājālaṃ gavākṣantu patākāśatabhūṣitam | ghaṇṭāśataninādāḍhyaṃ toraṇānāṃ śatairvṛtam || 5 || tatrastho bhagavān dharmaḥ āsane niyate śubhe | daśayojanavistīrṇe nīlajīmūtasannibhe || 6 || dharmajño dharmaśīlaśca dharmanyāyahito yamaḥ | bhayadaḥ pāpayuktānāṃ dharmiṇāṃ tu sukhapradaḥ || 7 || puramadhye praveśe tu citraguptasya vai gṛham | pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyānāṃ yojanānāṃ pramāṇataḥ || 8 || daśocchritaṃ mahādivyaṃ lohaprākāraveṣṭitam | pratolīśatasañcāraṃ patākāśataśobhitam || 9 || dīpikāśatasaṃkīrṇaṃ gītadhvanisamākulam | citritaṃ citrakuśalaiścitraguptasya vai gṛham ||1.64.10|| maṇimuktāmaye divye āsane paramādbhute | susthito gaṇapatyāyurmānuṣeṣvitareṣu ca ||11|| na muhyati kathaṃcitsaḥ sukṛte duṣkṛte’pi ca | janmanopārjitaṃ yāvat sadasadveti tasya tat ||12|| dehendriyamanobhiśca kṛtaṃ karma likhatyasau | citraguptagṛhātprācyāṃ jvarasyāsti mahāgṛham ||13|| dakṣiṇe cāpi śūlasya lūtāvisphoṭakasya ca | paścime kālapāśasya ajīrṇasyārucestathā ||14|| madhyapīṭhottare jñeyā nānāvidhā visūcikā | aiśānyāṃ tu śirorogo vahridiśi tu mūrchanā ||15|| nairṛtyāmatisāraśca vāyavyāṃ dāhapīḍanam | ebhiḥ parivṛto nityaṃ citraguptaḥ sa vartate ||16|| yatkarma kriyate yaiśca tatsarvaṃ tu likhatyasau | dharmarājagṛhadvāri dūtāstiṣṭhanti koṭiśaḥ ||17|| yamalokasya cādhvā vai antaro mānuṣasya ca | duḥkhena pāpino yānti yamamārgaṃ sudurgamam ||18|| yamaścaturbhujo bhūtvā śaṃkhacakragadābjabhṛt | āhūya pāpinaḥ sarvān dūtairdaṇḍaṃ dadāti vai ||19|| pralayāmbudanirghoṣo hyaṃjanādrisamaprabhaḥ | mahiṣastho durārādhyaḥ sūryatejaḥsamadyutiḥ ||1.64.20|| yojanatrayavistṛtadeho | krūro’tibhītidaḥ | doṣṇā daṇḍadharo bhīmaḥ pāśapāṇirdurākṛtiḥ ||21|| raktanetro’tibhayado darśanaṃ yāti pāpinām | aṃguṣṭhamātraḥpuruṣo hāhākurvan kalevarāt ||22|| yadeva nīyate dūtairyāmyairyamapurīṃ tadā | darśayanti bhayaṃ tīvraṃ dūtāḥ saṃtarjayanti hi ||23|| śīghraṃ pracala duṣṭātman yāsyasi tvaṃ yamālayam | kumbhīpākādinarakān tvāṃ neṣyāmo drutaṃ kuru ||24|| mārge prayāti vai preto . hyasipatravanānvite | kaṇṭakaśarkarātaptavālukāviṣakardame ||25|| ahanyahani sa preto yojanānāṃ śatadvayam | catvāriṃśattathā sapta ahorātreṇa gacchati ||26|| trayodaśe’hni sa preto nīyate yamakiṃkaraiḥ | tasminmārge vrajatyeko gṛhīta iva markaṭaḥ ||27|| saptadaśadinānyeko vāyumārgeṇa gacchati | aṣṭādaśetvahorātre pūrvaṃ yāmyapuraṃ vrajet ||28|| yāmyaṃ tu prathamaṃ proktaṃ sauripuraṃ dvitīyakam | surendrapuraṃ tṛtīyaṃ gandharvanagaraṃ tataḥ ||29|| śailapuraṃ pañcamaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhaṃ krūrapuraṃ tathā | saptamaṃ krauṃcanagaraṃ citrapuraṃ tathāṣṭamam ||1.64.30|| bahvāpannagaraṃ paścād daśamaṃ duḥkhadaṃ puram | daśaikamākrandapuraṃ sutaptanagaraṃ tataḥ ||31|| trayodaśaṃ raudrapuraṃ payovṛṣṭaṃ caturdaśam | pañcadaśaṃ śītapuraṃ bahubhayaṃ tu ṣoḍaśam ||32|| saptadaśaṃ dharmapuraṃ yāmyaṃ cāṣṭādaśaṃ puram | purāṇyetāni santyeva mārge viśrāntilabdhaye ||33|| pāpī mṛto bhavetpretaḥ pretadehaṃ tu vindati | pretadehastu navabhirahorātraiḥ subaddhyate ||34|| dehaniṣpattilābhāya piṇḍā deyāḥ pṛthak pṛthaka | prathame’hani yaḥ piṇḍastena mūrddhā prajāyate ||35|| grīvāskandhau dvitīye tu tṛtīye hṛdayaṃ bhavet | caturthe’hni bhavet pārṣṇirnābhirvai paṃcame tathā ||36|| ṣaṣṭhe kaṭiḥ saptame tu guhyaṃ pūrṇaṃ prajāyate | dine’ṣṭame sakthinī ca jānvaṃghrī navame tathā ||37|| navabhirdehamāsādya daśame’hni bhavet kṣudhā | deharūpaḥ kṣudhitaśca gṛhāgropari tiṣṭhati ||38|| daśame’hani taṃ piṇḍaṃ dadyātkṣudhānivartakaḥ | ekādaśadvādaśāhe preto bhuṃkte dinadvayam ||39|| trayodaśe’hni vai preto nīyate tu mahāpathe | saptadaśadinaṃ yāvat vāyumārgeṇa gacchati ||1.64.40|| aṣṭādaśe tvahorātre pūrvaṃ yāmyapuraṃ vrajet | tatra mahānpretagaṇaḥ puṣpabhadrānadītaṭe ||41|| mahānyagrodhachāyāyāṃ preto viśrāmamṛcchati | krandati karuṇairvākyaistṛṣārtaḥ śramapīḍitaḥ ||42|| śambalastatpurādhyakṣaḥ pretāya saṃprayacchati | yadi dattaṃ sutaiḥ putraiḥ snehādvā kṛpayāthavā ||43|| māsikaṃ piṇḍamattvā ca yāti sauripuraṃ tataḥ | tatra nāmnā tu rājā vai jaṃgamaḥ kālarūpadhṛk ||44|| tripākṣikaṃ tu piṇḍaṃ vai dadātyasmai subhuktaye | jalaṃ cānnaṃ tatra bhuktvā tatpuraṃ so’tigacchati ||45|| māsadvayābhyantare vai surendrapuramṛcchati | surendro bhīṣaṇastantādhiṣṭhātāsmai dadāti hi ||46|| māsadvayāntare dattaṃ piṇḍaṃ vā yadi bhojanam | vyatikramya puraṃ tacca tṛtīye māsi cāparam ||47|| gandharvapuramāsādyāśnāti piṇḍaṃ trimāsagam | tataḥ śailapuraṃ māsi caturthe preta eti ca ||48|| patanti tatra pāṣāṇāḥ pretasyopari pṛṣṭhataḥ | caturthamāsikaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhuktvā krūrapuraṃ gataḥ ||49 pañcame māsi tatrasthaḥ piṇḍaṃ pañcamamāsikam | bhuktvā yāti krauṃcapuraṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ krauṃcādhivāsitam ||1.64.50|| sārdhapaṃcamamāsārjyamūnaṣāṇmāsikaṃ tathā | śrāddhe dattaṃ tu piṇḍādi bhuktvā viśramya yāti ca ||51|| citrapuraṃ saptamaṃ tatpurarājastu citrakaḥ | yamānujo hyadhiṣṭhātā piṇḍaṃ ṣāṇmāsikaṃ jalam ||52|| bhojayatyatha bhuktvā sa mārge gacchati cāgrataḥ | āyānti sammukhāstatra kaivartāstu sahasraśaḥ ||53|| vayaṃ tvāṃ tārayiṣyāmo mahāvaitaraṇīṃ nadīm | śatayojanavistīrṇāṃ pūyaśoṇitapūritām ||54|| āmiṣādapatatryahijhaṣakṛkacasaṃvṛtām | yena tatra pradattā gauḥ pretaṃ tārayati drutam ||55|| na pradattā yadi dhenurvaitaraṇyāṃ sa majjati | svasthāvasthe śarīre tu vaitariṇyā vrataṃ caret ||56|| deyā ca viduṣe dhenustāṃ nadīṃ tartumicchatā | ṣāṇmāsikaṃ kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ tatra bhuktvā prasarpati ||57|| saptame māsi saṃprāpte yāti bahvāpadaṃ puram | tatra bhuktvā pradattaṃ yat sāptamāsikasaṃbhavam |58|| tatpuraṃ sa vyatikramya puraṃ duḥkhadamṛcchati | mahadduḥkhamanubhūya krośatyatra pratāpitaḥ ||59|| māsyaṣṭame pradattaṃ yat tatra bhuktvā sa gacchati | navamaṃ māsikaṃ bhuṃkte nānākrandapure sthitaḥ ||1.64.60|| tatrāyaṃ śūnyahṛdayaḥ samākrandati duḥkhitaḥ | vihāya tatpuraṃ preto yāti taptapura prati ||61|| sutaptanagaraṃ prāpya daśame māsi so’śnute | bhojanaiḥ piṇḍadānaistu dattaistatra phalaṃ bhavet ||62|| māsi caikādaśe pūrṇe raudraṃ puraṃ sa gacchati | daśaimāsikaṃ bhuktvā payovṛṣṭaṃ pragacchati ||63|| meghāstatra pravarṣanti pretānāṃ duḥkhakārakāḥ | nyūnābdikaṃ ca yacchrāddhaṃ tatra bhuṃkte paretakaḥ ||64|| sampūrṇe ca tato varṣe yāti śītapuraṃ tataḥ | mahāśītārditaḥ preta ākrandati muhurjaḍaḥ ||65|| śītapuraṃ cātikramya bahubhītipuraṃ vrajet | tatra kṣuttṛṭbhayād dagdho yāti dharmapuraṃ tataḥ ||66|| yatroṣmaṇā prabāṣpeṇa bharjito bhavate mṛtaḥ | khādanti yamadūtāstaṃ mārgaśramāpanuttaye ||67|| bahubhītipuraṃ dharmapuraṃ ca dharmakheṭakau | dharmarājapurasyaitau śākhāgrāmau samīpagau ||68|| atha pretaṃ nayantīme yāmyaṃ dharmapuraṃ param | caturaśītilakṣaiśca mūrtāmūrtairadhiṣṭhitam ||69|| yamadūtairmahākrūrairāgatānāṃ prapīḍakaiḥ || pretamatra nyāyasaudhe dūtāḥ kurvantyupasthitam ||1.64.70|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne yamapurapariṇāhacitraguptasaudhamārgīyāṣṭādaśapuragamanavat pretadaśāpradarśananāmā catuḥṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||64||
<1.65> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi yāmyapure śrāvaṇā dvādaśo’nugāḥ | brahmaputrāḥ pratīhārāḥ manuṣyāṇāṃ tu ceṣṭitam || 1 || śubhāśubhaṃ tu yatkarma vicāryyaiva punaḥ punaḥ | śrāvayanti tadānīṃ vai citragupte yame tathā || 2 || naraistuṣṭaiśca ruṣṭaiśca yadyatkarma kṛtaṃ bhavet | sarvamāvedayanti sma yathārthaṃ yādṛśaṃ ca yat || 3 || dūrāchravaṇavijñānaṃ dūrād darśanagocaram | svarbhūḥpātālavāsānāṃ ceṣṭājñānaṃ ca dūrataḥ || 4 || evaṃ teṣāṃ śaktirasti martyādau guptabodhinī | te vai pretasya yāvaddhi karma gāyanti tatra ca || 5 || śrīlakṣmīruvāca śrāvaṇāḥ kasya putrāste kathaṃ yamapure sthitāḥ | trilokasthaiḥ kṛtaṃ karma kathaṃ jānanti te prabho || 6 || kathaṃ śṛṇvanti te sarve kasmājjñānaṃ samāgatam | kadā te ca samutpannā brūhi me kānta sarvathā || 7 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ādau jagatsamutpannaṃ brahmayā nirmitaṃ hi tat | mayā tu pālitaṃ tadvai rudraḥ saṃhārakṛt tataḥ || 8 || dharmarājo mayā sṛṣṭaścitraguptena saṃyutaḥ | svasvakāryaṃ nirvahanti trayo devāḥ svatantrataḥ || 9 || sarve’pyādye satyayuge svatantrā hyabhavan janāḥ | sarve tridevasadṛśā na teṣu kasya śāsanam ||1.65.10|| tretāyāmapi tadvacca svatantrāḥ karma cakrire | śāstṝṇāṃ tadaviditaṃ śāstṛtvaṃ kutra sārthakam ||11|| tadā devāstrayastatra militāścintanāya vai | prāṇināṃ tu svatantrāṇāṃ karmajñānaṃ na no yadi ||12|| na jānīmaḥ kathaṃ śāsayitavyāḥ prāṇinastadā | vicāryetthaṃ vimamṛśuḥ sraṣṭavyāstādṛśāḥ sutāḥ ||13|| tadā brahmā śivaviṣṇvormatamādāya mantrayuk| gṛhītvā dvādaśakuśān jalaṃ saṃprokṣya tatra ca ||14|| dadau dharmāya sajalakuśān dvādaśa cetanān | yamo haste gṛhītvā tān saṃkalpayati putrakān ||15|| tejorāśīn viśālākṣān dūraśravaṇadarśanān | ātmadraṣṭṝrnigitajñān parasaṃkalpabodhakān ||16|| adṛśyān dṛśyarūpām̐śca so’sṛjad dvādaśātmajān | yamaputrā ime loke sarvatra karṇanetragāḥ ||17|| yo yaṃ vadati loke’smin yat karoti śubhāśubham | prāpayanti ca te śīghraṃ yamasya karṇagocare ||18|| dūrācchravaṇavijñānaṃ dūrāddarśanagocaram | sarvaṃ śṛṇvanti te sarve tenaiva śrāvaṇā matāḥ ||19|| vicaranti vāyurūpāḥ sthitvā cākāśavarmani | jantūnāṃ ceṣṭitaṃ jñātvā yamāya pravadanti te ||1.65.20|| mṛtyoruttarakāle te yathākarma yathākṛtam | dharmaṃ cārthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca yadvā mokṣaṃ yathā kṛtam ||21|| tathā sarvaṃ prāṇināṃ tu citraguptāya satvaram | nivedayanti paścādvai yamāyāvedayanti ca ||22|| śrāvaṇāste bahurūpāṇyapi dhārayituṃ kṣamāḥ | caturdaśabhuvaneṣu naikarūpaiścaranti te ||23|| dharmacarā janā ye te yānti vimānasaṃsthitāḥ | arthadāste’jñapyapsarobhiryānti vimānasaṃsthitāḥ ||24|| kāmadānapradātāro yāntyaśvayuktasadrathaiḥ | haṃsahastivimānaiśca mokṣabhājaḥ prayānti vai ||25|| adhārmikāstu padbhyāṃ vai yānti mārgaṃ suduḥsaham | pāṣāṇaiḥ kaṇṭakaiḥ kliṣṭaṃ hyasipatravanātmakam ||26|| taptavālukayā vyāptaṃ pāśabaddhāḥ prayānti vai | teṣāṃ sukhapravāsārthaṃ dānaṃ deyaṃ yathābalam ||27|| chatropānahavastrāṇi mudrikā ca kamaṇḍaluḥ || āsanaṃ bhājanaṃ caiva vāhanaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ jalam ||28|| annamājyamupavītaṃ gomahiṣyādikaṃ dhanam | dātavyaṃ pretamuddiśya mārgaṃ sukhakaraṃ bhavet ||29|| mṛtoddeśena yatkiṃcid dīyate svagṛhe priye | jalātmā sākṣikastaddhi varuṇo vetti sarvathā ||1.65.30|| gṛhṇāti varuṇo dānaṃ mama haste prayacchati | ahaṃ nārāyaṇastato’rpayāmi bhāskare ravau ||31|| bhāskarāt sa ca vai pretaḥ saṃgṛhyāśnāti cetyataḥ | deyaṃ pretasukhārthaṃ vai dānaṃ bahuvidhaṃ priye ||32|| yastu dharmaḥ kṛto naiva dānaṃ paścānna dīyate | puṇyaṃ tu nārjitaṃ svaiśca narakān yāti dāruṇān ||33|| caturaśītilakṣāste narakāḥ santi duḥkhadāḥ | teṣāṃ madhye mukhyatamā dhaureyāstvekaviṃśatiḥ ||34|| tāmisraścāndhatāmisro mahārauravarauravau | kuṃbhīpākaḥ kālasūtramasipatravanaṃ tathā ||35|| sūkarāsyamandhakūpaḥ kṛmibhojanamityapi | saṃdaṃśastaptasūrmiśca vajrakaṃṭakaśālmalī ||36|| pūyodo vaitaraṇī ca prāṇarodho viśaṃsanam | ayaḥpānamavīciśca śvādanaṃ lālabhakṣaṇam ||37|| ityete mukhyarūpā vai yamapūryāṃ matāstathā | tebhyo’dhastātpare sapta santyanye nāmataḥ śṛṇu ||38|| kṣārakardama eko’nyo rakṣogaṇaprabhojanaḥ | śūlaproto dandaśūko’vaṭanirodhanastathā ||39|| paryāvartanakaścaiva sūcīmukhamiti pṛthak | athānye narakagrāmāstatra santi nibodha tān ||1.65.40|| talapāto mahājvālaḥ śabalaśca vikartanaḥ | adhaḥśirā rudhirāndhaścakṣuḥśūlaḥprapācanam ||41|| śailapāto lohaśaṃkupratodanigaḍāstathā | lohayantraśca kākolo mṛtajīvanavaiśasau ||42|| narakāṇīti cānyāni bhedaprabhedatastathā | bhavanti pāpakartṝṇāṃ niṣkṛtyarthaṃ kṛtāni vai ||43|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvādaśaśravaṇākhyadūtānāmaṣṭāviṃśatyādinarakāṇāmuddeśanāmā pañcaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 65 ||
<1.66> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca yeṣāṃ tu narake ghore gatānyabdaśatāni vai | santatirnaiva vidyeta dūtatvaṃ te prayānti hi || 1 || yamena preṣitāste vai mānuṣādermṛtasya ca | dine dine pragṛhṇanti dīpamannaṃ ghaṭādikam || 2 || pretasyaiva prayacchanti hyannakāmasya sattṛṣaḥ | tṛptiṃ prayānti te sarve pratyahaṃ caiva vatsaram || 3 || citraguptapuraṃ pūrvaṃ yojanānāṃ tu viṃśatiḥ | kāyasthāstatra paśyanti pāpapuṇye ca sarvathā || 4 || yojanānāṃ caturviṃśatistu vaivasvataṃ puram | tatra gatvā preṣyadūtāḥ pratīhāraṃ vadanti vai || 5 || dharmadhvaja pratīhāre brūte tasya śubhāśubham | yamarājasya dūtāstu bhīṣaṇā yamakiṃkarāḥ || 6 || pāśadaṇḍadharā ghorāḥ sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa | ekaikasya purasyāgre sahasraikaṃ ca tiṣṭhati || 7 || dharmarājaḥ svayaṃ nyāyaṃ dadātyasmai tu pāpine | tatra tatra ca narakān prabhuṃkte tadyathā śṛṇu || 8 || prasahya paravittastryapatyapatyādihārakāḥ | patanti tatra tāmisre bhṛśaṃ kṣuttṛṭprabādhitāḥ || 9 || vaṃcayitvā paravittāpatyanāryādibhoginaḥ | patanti tvandhatāmitre naṣṭadṛṅmatayastu te ||1.66.10|| patanti hiṃsakā mahāraurave tatra dehinaḥ | kravyādā ruravo bhūtvā ghātayanti svaghātakam ||11|| bhūtadrohaiḥ kuṭumbasya poṣakā yānti raurave | bhūtāni ruravaḥ sarpā bhūtvā hiṃsanti hiṃsakān ||12|| paśvādirandhakā duṣṭāḥ kuṃbhīpāke patanti vai| dūtāstām̐staptataileṣu randhayanti muhurmuhuḥ ||13|| gurupitṛbrahmasādhusādhvyādiprāṇināṃ druhaḥ | yānti vai kālasūtrākhye’yutayojanamaṇḍale ||14|| vahnitapte tāmrakhale loṭhayanti dahanti te | svadharmahantā pākhaṇḍī vane yātyasipatrake ||15|| ubhatodhārakhaḍgaiḥ saṃchidyate mṛdyate muhuḥ | anyāyadaṇḍadā yānti sūkarāsyākhyayantrake ||16|| niṣpīḍyamānāvayavāścūrṇībhavanti tatra vai| īśakalpitavṛttīnāṃ yūkāmaśakapakṣiṇām ||17|| jantūnāṃ nāśakartāro hyandhakūpe patanti vai| tatra dūtā janturūpā drugdhā druhyanti tānpunaḥ ||18|| asaṃvibhajya bhoktāraḥ patanti kṛmibhojane | bhakṣyante kṛmibhiste ca śatasāhasrayojane ||19|| steyādbalātparasvarṇaratnabhvādyapahārakāḥ saṃdaṃśe yāntyayodaṃśairniṣkṛntanti ca tān yamāḥ ||1.66.20|| agamyām̐stu narānnārīrbalātkāreṇa kāmukān | taptasūrmyāṃ taptaloṣṭhaputalyāliṃgayanti te ||21|| paśvādinaramādāsu prasahya kāmukān janān | vajrakaṃṭakaśālmalyāmāropya kartayanti vai ||22|| paśvācārā naṣṭaśaucāḥ śleṣmaviṇmūtrapūyake | pūyodākhye patantyete hyaśnanti tanmalaṃ tathā ||23|| rakṣakā bhakṣakā bhūtvā rakṣyān bhindanti bhītidāḥ| viṇmūtrapūyaraktātmavaitaraṇyāṃ vahanti te ||24|| mṛgayāsaktapaśvādighātinaḥ prāṇarodhane | pātayitveṣubhistatra vidhyanti yamapūruṣāḥ ||25|| viśaṃsane paśu pakṣimanuṣyādividārakān | vidārayanti khādantyasṛk pibanti ca te punaḥ ||26|| asaṃkhyajantunāśotthamadirāpānakṛjjanān | taptāyorasapānaṃ vai kārayanti balād yamāḥ ||27|| kūṭasākṣyaprakartṝṃścāvīcau yāmyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ | gavyūtidviśatocchrāyagirestu pātayanti vai ||28|| viṣadānagnidānduṣṭān śvādane’danti kukkurāḥ | retaḥprapāyakān lālāḥ pāyayanti yamānugāḥ ||29|| pūjyapūjāvyaticārakartā tu kṣārakardame | patatyavākśirāstatra tatphalaṃ ca samaśnute ||1.66.30|| paśupakṣinaranārīkhādakānāṃ yamānugāḥ | khādantyasṛk prāpibanti rakṣogaṇaprabhojane ||31|| prāṇināṃ kaṇṭakasūcīśūlaistu vedhakānmuhuḥ | śūlaprote pravidhyanti tīkṣṇāgrairyamasevakāḥ ||32|| prāṇyudvegaprakartṝṃśca daṃdaśūke śatānanāḥ | dandaśūkāstroṭayanti grasante ca muhurmuhuḥ ||33|| guhāvivarakusūlabilādau prāṇirundhakān | yāmyā rundhanti dhūmādyairvahninā sagareṇa ca ||34|| māṃsādikhādakān dūtāḥ khādanti kṣudhitāḥ punaḥ | karasparśeṇa jāyante pūrṇāḥ khādanti tānpunaḥ ||35|| āḍhyābhimāninaṃ tiryakprekṣakaṃ pāpakāriṇam | sūcīmukhe pātayitvā sūtraiḥ parivayanti ca ||36|| dīnadurbalasatpātramīkṣate kruddhacakṣuṣā | tannetre vajratuṇḍairutpāṭayanti patattriṇaḥ ||37|| anyeṣāṃ tu vṛkṣaphalacauryakartārameva tu | tāle uttolya bhūbhāge pātayanti yamānugāḥ ||38|| araṇyakṣetradagdhāraṃ mahājvāle nipātya vai | vahnau taṃ bharjayantyeva yamadūtā muhurmuhuḥ ||39|| aśuddhaṃ bhojayitāraṃ śamale pātayanti hi || tatrāśuddhaṃ ca durgandhaṃ bhojayanti yamānugāḥ ||1.66.40|| kaṃcukapuṭakaṃ ye cotkṛtya dravyaṃ haranti tān | vikartane kṣipantyugrāḥ kṛntanti prapibantyasṛk ||41|| bhittyādau vivaraṃ kṛtvā corayanti ca ye dhanam | tānadhaḥśirasā vyomni tolayanti talāgninā ||42|| dugdhadānannatoyābhyāṃ sevante na paśūnnarāḥ | rudhirāndhe pātayanti rudhiraṃ tat pibanti te ||43|| dṛśyānarhe duṣṭacakṣuḥprayoktāraṃ yamānugāḥ | śūlaṃ netre praviśyaiva daṇḍaṃ dadati tatra vai ||44|| agninā randhitā jīvāḥ pācayanti ca taṃ tu te | pāṣāṇairbhūtahantṝnvai pātayanti śilopari ||45|| nirāgaso bandhayitā badhyate nigaḍairyamaiḥ | jñātvā jantucūrṇayitā cūrṇyate lohayantrakaiḥ ||46|| jīvānduḥkhapradātā tu kākole paripīḍyate | ājīvanaṃ duḥkhadātā mithyābhiśaṃsakaśca yaḥ ||47|| mārayitvā khādayitvā jīvayitvā yamānugāḥ | kṛntanti saṃchedayanti khādayanti hyamuṃ yamāḥ ||48|| patnyai duḥkhapradātā yaḥ svāmine duḥkhadā ca yā | āśritānāṃ duḥkhadā ye te patanti tu raurave ||49|| ityevaṃ rakṣakā yatra bhakṣakā luñcajīvinaḥ || sarve te nārakāḥ pāṭyā jāyante yamakiṃkaraiḥ ||1.66.50|| ityevaṃ nirayāḥ santi prāṇināṃ niṣkṛtātmakāḥ | yatra śuddhyanti pāpiṣṭhāstato gacchanti janmane ||51|| yasya yādṛk janma karma vidyate prāk tu saṃcitam | tasya tathaiva mārgeṇa yamaḥ prāpayate janim ||52|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne catvāriṃśannarakagāmināṃ pāpaphalavarṇananāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 66 ||
<1.67> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca narakāṇāṃ mahākaṣṭamanubhūya tu nārakāḥ | svakarmaśeṣabhāgena prāpnuvanti ca vai tanum || 1 || daivikīṃ paitṛkīṃ yoniṃ mānuṣīṃ vātha nārakīm | prāpya dharmasya vacanānmuktirbhavati vā tataḥ || 2 || yathā yathā kṛtaṃ karma tāṃ tāṃ yoniṃ vrajennaraḥ | tattathaiva hi bhuñjāno vicaretsarvayoniṣu || 3 || yena karmavipākena yathā nirayabhāgbhavet | yathā taduttara janma tattanme śṛṇu padmaje || 4 || yātanānte vimuktāste hyanekāṃ jīvasantatim | gatvā mānuṣayonau tu pāpacihnā bhavanti te || 5 || tatrānṛtapravāhī tu galatkaṇṭho’rdhajihvakaḥ | yadvā mūko bhavedeva devādīnāṃ vinindakaḥ || 6 || jīvahā tu kṣayī kuṣṭhī śyāvadantastu madyapaḥ | svarṇahārī kunakhī duścarmā strībhogakṛd balāt || 7 || mātsaryādapi jātyandho janmāndho’nyākṣisaṃharan | phalahartā vānaraḥ syāt kākaścauryānnabhojanāt || 8 || anyavaṃśaṃ vinindanvai vaṃśahīno’napatyakaḥ | dravyahartā bhaved godhā garadaḥ sarpajanmavān || 9 || prasahya tu balātkārī jāyate’tra piśācakaḥ | cātako jalahartā syād dhānyahartā tu mūṣakaḥ ||1.67.10|| jalaprasravaṇabhettā jale matsyo bhavediti | vañcanākarmakṛtprāṇī hyulūko jāyate muhuḥ ||11|| anyādācchidya bhuṃjānaḥ sārameyo’bhijāyate | pratiśrutyādadanprāṇī jambūko jāyate vane ||12|| cauryaṃ kṛtvā sadā bhuṃjan viḍvarāhaḥ prajāyate | pūjyānāṃ tvavamānādvai labhate kācchapī tanum ||13|| sarveṣāṃ tu tiraskartā cāṇḍālo jāyate’tra vai | syādanyasya ṛṇagrāhī vṛṣo’śvo gardabhaśca vā ||14|| rativighnakaraḥ ṣaṇḍho mārjāraḥ paramāṃsabhuk | pārakyasya prahartā vai tittiro jāyate vane ||15|| prasahya vaśakartāro nārījanma hyavāpnuyuḥ | prasahya ratikartāro bhagaliṃgādirogiṇaḥ ||16|| gṛhāvāsādihartāro jāyante’raṇyajantavaḥ | paśūnāṃ ghātakāścātra jāyante ghātyajantavaḥ ||17|| svāmidravyāpahartāro draridrāḥ saṃbhavantyapi | vidvannindāprakartāro mūrkhā bhavanti bāliśāḥ ||18|| viśvāsayitvā jantūnāṃ bandhakā ghātakā janāḥ | pañjarīyapaśupakṣijanmānaḥ saṃbhavanti hi ||19|| manuṣyāṇāṃ tiraskartā vicitto jāyate’tra vai | śāṭhyakāpaṭyanairghṛṇyapoṣṭā kitavatāṃ vrajet ||1.67.20|| manuṣyahā jāyate’tra pāśadhṛk pāradhiśca vai | paśuhā ghātakī bhūtvā śatajanmā hyajo bhavet ||21|| matsyādo matsyajanmā syāt sarvādo jhaṣa eva ca | anyānnavastragehāderhartā vṛkṣomarusthale ||22|| gandhacandanasaṃhartā nāsāhīnaḥ prajāyate | gurupitṛpūjyanindāśrotā syād badhiro’tra vai ||23|| pādahartā bhavet paṅgurhastaghno vṛkṇa eva ca | nārīṇāṃ duḥkhakṛtkuṃbhakārasya gardabho bhavet ||24|| patyurduḥkhakarī nārī gardabhī saṃbhavettathā | karmacāridravyachettā daridro vānaro bhavet ||25|| jantujāṃ nāśako bhittijantvadā godhakī bhavet | malino makṣikājanma krodhī sarpatvamāpnuyāt ||26|| dveṣī grāmyaśunaḥ pipīlikānāṃ janma cāpnuyāt | anyāyakāmī vṛṣaṇocchettā syāt ṣaṇḍhagovṛṣaḥ ||27|| dharmānnadravyavasvādehartā syādārtikukkuraḥ | pārakyānnādibhoktāraḥ kukkuṭīṃ yonimāpnuyuḥ ||28|| kāryahantā tu ghūkaḥ syāt kāryaroddhā śṛgālakaḥ | pariveṣitapātrāṇāṃ hartā syādvṛkṣavāgulī ||29|| nārīhartā rākṣasaḥ syāt māntrikaḥ syāt piśācakaḥ | vāsanikastu bhūtaḥ syāt krūradṛṣṭistu śākinī ||1.67.30|| samātsaryā ḍākinī syāt piśācinyabhicārikā | garbhahantrī gaṇikā syāt kulaṭā patyakāmanā ||31|| parāpatyāsahāpyatrāpatyahīnā bhavatyapi | ṛtudānāgrāhikā tu ṣaṇḍhā bhavati sarvathā ||32|| parocchedakarī svīyocchedakartrī bhavetpunaḥ | suptanāśaprakartāro hanyante ghātakīgṛhe ||33|| parasasya praloptāro bhavantyakṣetravṛttayaḥ | parakarmaviloptāro jāyante’karmayoniṣu ||34 tailahārī tailapāyī pūtivaktrastu sūcakaḥ | dhānyahāryatiriktāṃgaḥ piśunaḥ pūtināsikaḥ ||35|| brahmahā śvāḥ svaroṣṭaḥ syānmūkaścānte bhavatyapi | dravyacauraḥ kṛmiḥ kīṭastṛṇādo gurunāśakaḥ ||36|| kṣayarogī śyāvadantaḥ kunakhī svaṇacauryakṛt | pakvahartā tvanāhārī mūko rāgāpahārakaḥ ||37|| tulakūṭapramākartā vaṭavāgulikā bhavet | vikreyakūṭasāṃkaryakartā śvāsārtiko bhavet ||38|| anyeṣāṃ prāṇaroddhā vai kṣayarogārtiko bhavet | krayavikrayakauṭilyakartārṣarogavānbhavet| ucchiṣṭajalapātā syānmūtrakṛcchrādirogavān | anyavṛttiharo loke bhikṣukaḥ satiraskṛtaḥ ||1.67.40|| anyonyātyasaho duṣṭaścāṇḍālo vāghgharirbhavet | chalachadmaprakartā syād dhīvaraḥ śabaro’pi ca ||41|| vastravikrayakāpaṭyatantuvāyo bhavatyapi | rathyācatuṣkamālinyakartā malaharo’ntyajaḥ ||42|| snānaśuddhiniṣeddhā syād rajako vastraśodhakaḥ | anyāniṣṭecchukacauro mārjāro jāyate rudan ||43|| kūṭauṣadhapradātā syānnakūlo nirjane vane | kūṭavastuprakartā syāt kūṭastrīputrako’tra vai ||44|| svarṇarūpyādisāṃkarye kāpaṭyena karoti yaḥ | varṇasaṃkarajanmā syād galatkuṣṭho bhavettathā ||45|| kaumāryaduṣakāśca syurājīvanaṃ vidhūrakāḥ | svāminyasatpravaktā syānnāpitaḥ kṣurakarmakṛt ||46|| āyudhānāṃ tu nirmātā jalaukā saṃprajāyate | paśupakṣigavājādimāṃsādāḥ gṛdhraviḍbhujaḥ ||47|| siṃhā vyāghrā vṛkā dīpā jāyante māṃsabhojinaḥ | kanyāvikrayakartāro jāyante yonikīṭakāḥ | rasasāṃkaryakartāro jāyante malakīṭakāḥ ||48|| nirādhārapradogdhāro bhavanti māstikīyūkāḥ | paṃktibhettodaraṃbharo jāyate cāntrarogavān ||49|| dampatīkleśakartāro bhāṃḍā bhavanti nartakāḥ | kāmāsaktaviyoktāro vṛndalāḥ saṃbhavanti hi ||1.67.50|| kāmasukhaprabhaṃktāro’raṇye śūnyaraṃtimṛgāḥ | maṇḍukāścaiva jāyante ratimātsaryavannarāḥ ||51|| sādhusādhvīdrohakartā syānmūko badhiro janeḥ || poṣyāpoṣaṇakartṝṇāṃ malamūṣakatā bhavet ||52|| dugdhadaprāṇihantṝṇāṃ janma nirjalabhūphaṇam | vāgbāṇamarmabhettṝṇāṃ kaṃkiṭakṛkalāsajam ||53|| piṣṭacauryaprakartṝṇāṃ janma bhallukarūkṣajam | mahaccauryaprakartṝṇāṃ janma tvandhasarīsṛpe ||54|| devatīrthagurudrohī dharmāṇāṃ nindakastathā | kuṭumbakleśakartā syādaraṇye kākadīpakaḥ ||55|| madirāmāṃsasaṃjīvī siṃho’raṇye nṛpo bhavet | jālatarkaṭapāśāśī bahuśrṛṃgo mṛgo bhavet ||56|| snānālasastu khaḍgākhyamṛgo genḍo bhavediti | bhallukaḥ syāt piṣṭahartā vāgulī guptabhojinī ||57|| citrapicchā chalakartrī śilakī syāt svatantriṇī | guptapibā gṛhagodhā gavayo guptabhojanaḥ ||58|| yathā vā vāsanāyogājjāyante citradehinaḥ | caturaśītikhanyantāścitrakarmakarā muhuḥ ||59|| jāyante tāmasāḥ kīṭā vṛkṣādyā vā tṛṇaukasaḥ | vṛddhāpamānakartāro jāyante māhiṣā vṛṣāḥ ||1.67.60|| dāmpatyabhaṃgakartāro vidhurā janmajanmasu | malendriyātilubdhāstu kīṭā malagatāḥ sadā ||61|| guptaghātāstu jhallādāḥ pāśinaḥ śvapacādayaḥ | indriyahā bhavedindriyeṇa hīnaḥ kṣatiśritaḥ ||62|| ātatāyijanā yānti bhugnadehān sadārtidān | tāmasāḥ saṃprajāyante yavanā daityarākṣasāḥ ||63|| patyurhantryaḥ prajāyante vidhavā janmajanmasu | śvaśrūduḥkhapradā nārī gardabhī jāyate kṛśā ||64|| vadhūdveṣṭrī bhavenmārjārikā kuṣṭhādirogiṇī | sāpatnyadveṣakartrī syācchunī kharjanarogiṇī ||65|| pakṣapātakarī yāyād daridre pāśavīṃ daśām | kāryahantrī bhaved ghūkī kleṣadā kābarī bhavet ||66|| anaivedyarasāsvādā bhaved gṛdhrā ca garjukī | śyenā bakī bhavet sā yā gṛhe kāpaṭyavartinī ||67|| dhūrtā kākī bhavet kṛṣṇā śṛgālī nāpitī tathā | jāṃgulikī bhaved dviṣṭā santāne dveṣacāriṇī ||68|| ṣaṇḍhā syāt liṃgapātātmābhicārādiprayogiṇī | mantrābhicārakartrī syād bhūtī piśācikā tathā ||69|| bālahā garbhahā bījahantrī tu rākṣasī bhavet | antardāhakarī duḥkhapradā syād yavanī khasī ||1.67.70|| ityevaṃ bahujanmāno bhavanti nārakā janāḥ | punaḥ karma punarjanma lakṣayoniṣu jāyate ||71|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nārakāṇāṃ punarjanmacihnaparicayādikathananāmā saptaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||67||
<1.68> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi janaṃ śārīracihnakam | kīdṛgrūpo janaḥ kīdṛkkarmā kīdṛgguṇo bhavet || 1|| saṃkṣepāttatpravakṣyāmi lokavijñāna hetave | śarīrāṇi samānyeva naranārīdivaukasām || 2 || ākṛterbhedabhāvo vai paricāyaka eva ha | cihnānāṃ bhedabhāvastu karmaṇāṃ paricāyakaḥ || 3 || dhanahīnasya tu pādau śūrpākārau śirālakau | vakrau rukṣau ca saṃśuṣkau pāṇḍunakhaudarāṃgulī || 4 || vaṃśasya nāśakau pādāvutkamaṭhau kaṣāyakau | brahmaghnasya bhavetāṃ tu caraṇau śaṃkusannidhau ||5|| nirdhanasya romakūpe ekaika eva romakaḥ | nṛpasya śrotriyasyāpi dvau dvau śrīdhīmatāṃ tathā || 6 || tryādyairniḥsvā duḥkhabhājo ninditāśca bhavanti hi | yasya keśāḥ kuṃcitāḥ syuḥ sa pravāse mriyeta vai || 7 || yasya jānū tu nirmāṃsau saubhāgyaḥ sa bhavejjanaḥ | nimnālpajānumān bodhyaḥ sarvadā strīrato janaḥ ||8|| daridro viṣamajānuḥ puṣṭajānurnṛpo bhavet | mahajjaānurdīrghajīvī vakrajānustu kāmukaḥ || 9 || yasya pādau mṛdutalau kamalodarasannibhau | śliṣṭāṃgulī tāmranakhau supārṣṇī va śirojjhitau ||1.68.10|| uṣṇau kūrmonnatau gūḍhagulphau sa nṛpatirbhavet | yo naro hyalpaliṃgaḥ syādapatyarahitastu saḥ ||11|| yastu bhavet sthūlaliṃgaḥ sāpatyo’pi dhanojjhitaḥ | meḍhraṃ vāmanataṃ yasya tasya putrārthahīnatā ||12|| liṃgamadhonataṃ yasya dāridryaṃ tasya sarvadā | dakṣavakraṃ yasya meḍhraṃ putravānsa matau janaḥ ||13|| sthūlagranthiyute liṃge śirāle bahuputrakaḥ | koṣagūḍhe prajanane nṛpaḥ syādbahuputrakaḥ ||14|| dīrghakāṣo bhugnakoṣo dhanahīnaḥ sadā bhavet | durbalatvekavṛṣaṇo viṣamavṛṣaṇaścalaḥ ||15|| samābhyāṃ nṛpatiḥ proktaḥ pralambena śatābdavān | bhavet siṃhakaṭī rājā niḥsvaḥ kapikaṭirnaraḥ ||16|| sarpodarā daridrāḥ syurdhaninaḥ sthūlapārśvakāḥ | samakakṣāśca bhogāḍhyā nimnakakṣā dhanojjhitāḥ ||17|| nṛpāśconnatakakṣāḥ syurjihmā viṣamakakṣakāḥ | aśīghramaithunyalpāyurdīrghāyuḥ śīghramaithunī ||18|| sukhī syādvistīrṇanābhirduḥkhyatinimnanābhikaḥ | valimadhyagato nābhiḥ śūlapīḍāṃ karoti vai ||19|| medhāvī dakṣiṇāvarto vāmāvarto vaśī naraḥ | pārśvāyatā cirāyuḥ syādupariṣṭhāddhaneśvaraḥ ||1.68.20|| ekavaliḥ śatāyuḥ syāt śrībhogī dvivalirnaraḥ | trivaliḥ kṣmeśa ācārya ṛjubhirvalibhiḥ sukhī ||21|| dakṣiṇāvartaromā syācchāsakaḥ sumahān janaḥ | vāmāvartānyathāvartaromā preṣyaśca duḥkhitaḥ ||22|| anuddhataiścucukaiśca bhavanti subhagā janāḥ | uddhatairviṣamairdīrghaiḥ pītāgrairnirdhanā narāḥ ||23|| samonnataṃ ca hṛdayamakampaṃ māṃsalaṃ pṛthu | nṛpāṇāmadhamānāṃ ca khararomaśirālakam ||24|| samavakṣāstu dhanavān pīnavakṣāḥ ramāpatiḥ | nirdhano viṣamavakṣāḥ śastreṇa mṛtyumāpnuyāt ||25|| viṣamajatruko niḥsvaḥ pīnajatrurdhanādhipaḥ | nirdhanaścipiṭakaṇṭhaḥ śirāśuṣkagalaḥ sukhī ||26|| śūraḥ syānmahiṣagrīvaḥ śāstrānto mṛgakaṇṭhakaḥ | kambugrīvaśca nṛpatirlambakaṇṭho’tibhakṣakaḥ ||27|| kakṣāśvatthadalā śreṣṭhā sugandhirmagaromikā || anyathā tvarthahīnānāṃ dāridryasya ca kāraṇam ||28|| samāṃsau vipulau śliṣṭau bhugnālpau pīvarau tathā | vṛttāvājānulambau ca bhujau daivau ca rājakau ||29|| niḥsvānāṃ romaśau hrasvau śreṣṭhau karikaraprabhau | hastāṃgulaya eva syuḥ svarṇavarṇā dhaneśituḥ ||1.68.30|| tāśca medhāvināṃ sūkṣmā bhṛtyānāṃ cipiṭāḥ smṛtāḥ | susthūlāṃgulayo niḥsvāḥ kapitulyakarāstathā ||31|| pitṛdravyavināśī syānnimnakaratalo janaḥ | maṇibandho nigūḍhaḥ syād rājyado dhanado vṛtaḥ ||3|| karaiḥ karatalaiścaiva lākṣābhai raktakomalaiḥ | guravaḥ syuḥ pītarukṣairnidhanā eva sarvadā ||33|| tuṣatulyanakhāḥ klībā niḥsvāḥ sphuṭitavakrakaiḥ | kunakhaiśca vivarṇaiśca paratarkakarā matāḥ ||34|| tāmraiśca vartulairdevā madhyonnatanakhairmatāḥ | sayavāṃguṣṭhako rājā putrī parvaprapūrṇakaḥ ||35|| yugamīnāṃkitakaro bhavetsatraprado naraḥ | vajracihnaṃ tu dhanināṃ viduṣo matsyapucchakam ||36|| śaṃkhātapatraśibikāgajapadmāni bhūbhrati | kuṃbhāṃkuśapatākāśca mṛṇālaśca nidhīśvare ||37|| dāmarekhā gavāḍhye vai svastikaśca nṛpeśvare | cakrāsitomaradhanurdantarekhā nṛpeśvare ||38|| ulūkhalasamā rekhā yājñikasya kare matā | cakrāṇi bahūni caiva vedīrekhāgnihotriṇi ||39|| vāpīdaivīnadīrekhāstrikoṇo dhārmike kare | aṃguṣṭhamūlagā rekhāḥ sukhakṛtsutabodhikāḥ ||1.68.40|| kaniṣṭhāmūlataḥ pradeśinīmūlagatā ca yā | śatāyurbādhikā rekhā chinnā cet taruto bhayam ||41|| niḥsvāśca bahurekhāḥ syurnidhanāścibukaiḥ kṛśaiḥ | māṃsalaiḥ raktavarṇaiśca hyadharairdhanavānbhavet ||42|| bimbopamaiśca sphuṭitai rūkṣairviṣamakhaṇḍitaiḥ | oṣṭhairdhanarahitāḥ syurdantāḥ snigdhā ghanā śubhāḥ ||43|| tīkṣṇā dantāḥ samāḥ śreṣṭhā jihvā raktā samā śubhā | ślakṣṇā dīrghā tu vijñeyā tāluḥ śveto dhanakṣayaḥ ||44|| kṛṣṇā tu paruṣā jihvā raktāgrā rogiṇī matā | vaktraṃ saumyaṃ samaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ saṃvṛtaṃ nṛpateḥ smṛtam ||45|| viparītaṃ tu duḥkhānāṃ durbhagāṇāmalokakam | āḍhyānāṃ vartulaṃ vaktraṃ nirdravyāṇāṃ tu dīrghakam ||46|| bhīruvaktraḥ pāpakārī dhūrtānāṃ caturasrakam | nimnaṃ vaktraṃ tvaputrāṇāṃ kṛpaṇānāṃ ca hrasvakam ||47|| sampūrṇaṃ bhogināṃ kāntaṃ śmaśrusnigdhaṃ śubhaṃ mṛdu | saṃhataṃ cāsphuṭitāgraṃ raktaśmaśru ca caurakam ||48|| śaṃkukarṇāstu rājāno romakarṇā gatāyuṣaḥ | bṛhatkarṇā dhaninṛpāḥ kṛpaṇā hrasvakarṇakāḥ ||49|| bhogī vai nimnagaṇḍaḥ syānmantrī sampūrṇagaṇḍakaḥ | śukanāsaḥ sukhī proktaḥ śukanāso’tijīvanaḥ ||1.68.50|| chinnāgrakūpanāsastu bahunārīvyavāyakaḥ || dīrghanāsaḥ saubhagaḥ syāccauraḥ kuñcitanāsikaḥ ||51|| cipiṭanāsaḥ krūraḥ syāttathā bhāgyavihīnakaḥ | svalpachidrā supuṭā cāvakrā sā nṛpatermatā ||5|| krūre dakṣiṇavakrā syād vāmavakrā hyaniṣṭadā | vakrāntaiḥ padmapatrābhairlocanaiḥ sukhabhāginaḥ ||53|| mārjāralocanaiḥ pāpmā durātmā madhupiṃgalaiḥ || krūrāḥ kekaranetrāśca haritākṣāḥ sakalmaṣāḥ ||54|| jihmaiśca locanaiḥ śūrāḥ senānyo gajalocanāḥ | gaṃbhīrākṣā īśvarāḥ syurmantriṇaḥ sthūlacakṣuṣaḥ ||55|| nīlotpalākṣā vidvāṃsaḥ saubhagāḥ śyāmacakṣuṣaḥ || syurutpāṭanakartāraḥ kṛṣṇatārakacakṣuṣaḥ ||56|| maṇḍalākṣāśca pāpāḥ syurniḥsvā syurdīnalocanāḥ || dhanī dīrghasaṃsaktabhrūrdaridrā viṣamabhruvaḥ ||57|| viśālonnatabālendūnnatabhruvaḥ sukhāḍhyakāḥ | niḥsvo bhavati khaṇḍabhūrdārakabhrūśca nirdhanaḥ ||58 nirdhanā vipulaiḥ śaṃkhairlalāṭairviṣamaistathā | ardhendusamabhālaistu dhanavanto matā janāḥ ||59|| śuktiviśālairācāryāḥ śirālaiḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ | unnatābhiḥ śirābhiśca svastikābhirnareśvarāḥ ||1.68.60|| nimnairbhālairvadhārhāśca krūrakarmāratāstathā | saṃvṛtaiśca lalāṭaiśca kṛpaṇā unnatairnṛpāḥ ||61|| akampaṃ hasitaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nimīlitamaghāvaham | asakṛddhasitaṃ duṣṭaṃ sadarpaṃ ghātakaṃ bhavet ||62|| lalāṭopasṛtāstisro rekhāḥ syuḥ śatavarṣiṇām | nṛpaḥ sa syāccatasṛbhiḥ paṃcanavatirjīvati ||63|| arekhenāyurnavatirvicchinnābhistadardhakam | keśāntopagatābhiśca hyaśītyāyurnaro bhavet ||64|| paṃcabhiḥ saptabhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ paṃcāśat bahubhistathā | catvāriṃśacca raktābhistriṃśad bhrūlagnagāmibhiḥ ||65|| viṃśatirvāmavakrābhirāyuḥ kṣudrābhiralpakam | chatrākāraiḥ śirobhistu nṛpo bāṇasamo dhanī ||66|| ghaṭamūrdhā pāparuciḥ piturmṛtyuścipīṭakaḥ | kṛṣṇākuṃcitasnigdhāgrābhinnāntakeśavān nṛpaḥ ||67|| rājñyāḥ pādau mṛdutalau matsyāṃkuśadhvajāṃcitau | vajrābjahalacihnau ca nigūḍhagulphakau matau ||68|| aśvatthapatrasadṛśaṃ vipulaṃ guhyamuttamam | gūḍhaḥ śukaśva śubhado māṃsalaṃ vartulaṃ mukham ||69|| nābhiḥ pradakṣiṇāvartā madhyaṃ trivaliśobhitam | āraktāvadharau śreṣṭhau māṃsalaṃ vartulaṃ mukham ||1.68.70|| snigdhanīlāśca mṛdavo mūrdhajāḥ kuṃcitāḥ śubhāḥ | strīṇāṃ pādatale yadvā pāṇidvayatale imāḥ ||71|| vājikuṃjaraśrīvṛkṣayūpeṣuyavatomarāḥ | dhvajacāmaramālāśca śailakuṇḍalavedikāḥ ||72|| śaṃkhātapatrakamalamatsyasvastikasadrathāḥ | aṃkuśādyāśca rekhāḥ syurdevyastā rājavallabhāḥ ||73|| haryaṃśāḥ svastikadhanustriśūladhvajamatsyakāḥ | rekhā yā maṇibandhotthā gatā madhyāṃgulīkare ||74|| ūrdhvarekhā tu sā proktā haste pāde’thavā bhavet | strīṇāṃ puṃsāṃ tathā sā syād rājyāya ca sukhāya ca ||75|| naracihnavatī nārī naraśca strīsvarūpakaḥ | na maṃgalakṛtau syātāṃ vaiparītyakarāvubhau ||76|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne naranārīdaivīśārīracihnapradarśananāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||68||
<1.69> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi tava cihnāni me priye paśya nābhiṃ dakṣiṇāvartāṃ te gāmbhīryaśālinīm || 1 || aromāṃ trivalīṃ paśya hṛtstanau romavarjitau | madhyāṃśaṃ sarvaśaktyāḍhyaṃ paśyāntardṛḍhakuṇḍalam || 2 || nābhyadhaḥ paśya rekhāṃ tu svarṇabāṇasya piṃgalām | vāmasakthni tathā paśya pādukācihnamagrataḥ || 3 || vakṣasi stanayormadhye pādarekhāṃ vilokaya | lalāṭe mukuṭākārāṃ gaṇḍe binduṃ ca lokaya || 4 || urasī paśya viṣṇuṃ māṃ rekhārūpacaturbhujam | vāme bhuje gadācihnaṃ cāvalokaya me priye || 5 || hṛdaye vaijayantyāstu rekhāṃ paśya prapauraṭīm | gajaṃ karatale dakṣe sapadmaṃ paśya cānaghe || 6 || dakṣiṇe tu pade paśya śaṃkhacihnaṃ sumaṃgalam | aṃgulyā mūlake paśya rekhāṃ vimānasadṛśīm || 7 || kaniṣṭhāyāḥ paśya mūlādhastvaṃ naukāṃ surekhayā | tathā śaṃkhagadārekhāḥ paśya makaralekhanam || 8 || tathā madhye suśikhararekhāṃ nibhālaya priye | paśya pārṣṇau matsyarekhāṃ madhye tāmbūlavallikām || 9 || paśya vāmāṃguṣṭhamūle yavacihnaṃ surekhayā | tadadhastu mahāntaṃ vai prāsādaṃ paśya rekhayā ||1.69.10|| chatraṃ paśya tadadhastu yutaṃ taccordhvarekhayā | kamalarekhāṃ phaṇake dhvajarekhāṃ prapaśya ca ||11|| aṃkuśacihnaṃ kumudaṃ paśya śrīphalamityapi | sthalīyapadmarekhāṃ ca ghaṭarekhāṃ nibhālaya ||12|| dvitīyāyāścandrarekhāṃ daśacakrāṇi paśya ca | svarṇarekhāṃ phaṇopari bhāle tāntikalekhanām ||13|| cibuke bindukaṃ paśya stane vāme tu cakrakam | dakṣe stane hastarekhāṃ kaṇṭhe hāraṃ supiṃgalam ||14|| jaghane tu suvarṇāṃ vai dhanūrekhāṃ prapaśya ca | svastikaṃ dakṣiṇe hastatale matsyaṃ dhvajaṃ tathā ||15|| dhanurvaṃśīmatsyarekhāḥ paśya kalaśarekhikām | aṃkuśaṃ maṇḍalaṃ cakraṃ paśya dakṣe kare tale ||16|| paśya prākārarekhāṃ ca tatra toraṇamityapi | paśya lāṃgalacihnaṃ ca tatraiva phaṇake priye ||17|| gūḍha śukaṃ paśya lakṣmi āraktāvadharau tathā | haste dakṣe cordhvarekhāṃ paśya vāme tathaiva ca ||18|| pādatalayostūrdhvarekhāḥ prapaśya mama priye | pāde tu vājinaṃ caiva kuṃjaraṃ śrīmahādrumam ||19|| yūpaṃ bāṇaṃ yavaṃ caiva tomaraṃ paśya rekhayā | haste ca mālikārekhāṃ paśya dīpaṃ ca cāmaram ||1.69.20|| paśya śailaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ ca vedikāṃ paśya rekhayā | mukhanetrabhrūlalāṭauṣṭhanāsikākapolakān ||21|| paśya vibhrājamānām̐ste gaurān svarṇamanoharān | tattaccihnaistathā devyo bhavanti bhagavatpriyāḥ ||22|| bhaktimatyaśca me nāryo lakṣmīrūpā bhavanti vai | mamopāsanasāmarthyāt karomi kamalālayāḥ ||23|| brahmalokanivāsinyo golokabhūkṛtālayāḥ | vaikuṇṭhavāsamāpannāḥ śvetadvīpagatāśca yāḥ ||24|| amṛtadhāmasthāyinyo vahnimaṇḍalamadhyagā | sūryalokanivāsinyaḥ candramaṇḍalasaṃsthitāḥ ||25|| satyalokanivāsinya īśvarasṛṣṭisaṃbhavāḥ | pitṛsargagatā yāśca ṛṣipatnyastathā ca yāḥ ||26|| devyaścātha manuṣyāṇyo’devyo nāgādisaṃpriyāḥ | sarvāstu māṃ parābhaktyā samāsādyābhavan śriyaḥ ||27|| tāścāhaṃ naikalokeṣu nārāyaṇasvarūpakaḥ | ramayāmi mahālakṣmi yathā tvāmatra dhāmani ||28|| mana bhaktyā tu sarvāstā lakṣmyo jāyanta eva hi | yāśca māṃ na bhajantyanyāḥ tāstu pāpena karmaṇā ||29|| gacchanti vividhākārakhaniṣvatra paratra ca | yamaloke mahāduḥkhānyanubhūyāpi janmani ||1.69.30|| jāyante nahi śubhadā duḥkhāya saṃbhavanti tāḥ | yamapuryāstu yā nāryo yātanā anubhūya ca ||31|| pāpaleśājjanmavatyo duḥkhadā eva kīrtitāḥ | śṛṇu tā api saṃkṣepātprasaṃgātpravadāmi te ||32|| kaniṣṭhikānāmikā vā yasyā na spṛśate mahīm | aṃguṣṭhaṃ vā gatātītya tarjanī kulaṭā ca sā ||33|| romaśe cātimāṃse ca jaṃghe cātiśirālake | vāmāvartaṃ nimnamalpaṃ guhyaṃ yasyā hi duḥkhadā ||34|| grīvayā hrasvayā niḥsvā dīrghayā ca kulakṣayaḥ | pṛthulayā pracaṇḍā ca bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||35|| kekare piṃgale netre śyāme lole tu cāsatī | smite kūpe gaṇḍayośca sā dhruvaṃ vyabhicāriṇī ||36|| pralambinī lalāṭe tu devaraṃ hanti cāṃganā | udare śvaśuraṃ hanti patiṃ hanti sphicordvayoḥ ||37|| yā tu romottarauṣṭhī syānna śubhā bhartureva ha| stanau saromāvaśubhau karṇau ca viṣamau tathā ||38|| karālā viṣamā dantāḥ kleśāya tu bhavanti tāḥ | cauryāya kṛṣṇamāṃsābhā dīrghā bhartuśca mṛtyave ||39|| kravyādarūpairhastaiśca vṛkakākādisannibhaiḥ | śirālairviṣamaiḥ śuṣkairvittahīnā bhavanti tāḥ ||1.69.40|| samunnatottarauṣṭhī yā kalahaiḥ rūkṣabhāṣiṇī | lambakarṇasvarā śmaśrumatī pāde tu kālikā ||41|| netre raktā bhuvi tīvrā svalpabhālā tu ghātinī | bahurekhā bahuromā bahubhāṣāticañcalā ||42|| bahusaṃgā bahunidrā bahvālasyā bahuvyayā | sarvathā nirdhanatvaṃ ca dāridryaṃ mantrayatyasau ||43|| tasmāt satkarma kartavyaṃ nāsatkarma kadācana | susatkarmakṛtātpuṇyāccharīraṃ śubhalakṣaṇam ||44|| prāpyate dhanadhānyārthyagṛhodyānādi cottamam | kālaḥ pratīkṣate naiva kimanena kṛtaṃ na vā ||45|| mriyate jāyate jantuḥ puṣyate ca punaḥ punaḥ | maraṇaṃ jananaṃ puṣṭiryā tu mokṣāya nirmitā ||46|| sā vai svenaiva kartavyā yadvā putrakuṭumbibhiḥ | śubhaṃ jantorbhaved yena tathācaryyaṃ divāniśam ||47|| pṛthvī vāsāya salilaṃ tṛptaye śāntaye marut | dehaḥ śramāya cānnāya śreyaḥ kasmānna sādhayet ||48|| sarvatrātiśayaścāsti vicāryaiva punaḥ punaḥ | yathāpekṣe cātiśayo nāstītyapi vicārya ca ||49|| yadṛcchayopapannena nirvāhya svakalevaram | nātisaṃsaktamanasā lokayātrāṃ tu nirvahan ||1.69.50|| nārāyaṇaṃ bhajennityaṃ yathā tvaṃ kamalekṣaṇe | tasya nāsti sukhaṃ śreyo mokṣaśca dūramaṇvapi ||51|| sādhusādhvīsvarūpaṃ māṃ bhajet sarvasamarpaṇāt | dīnātithinirādhārarūpaṃ māṃ sevayenmudā ||52|| vidyārthibālabālāsuvṛddhagurvādirūpataḥ | vicarāmi kvacid devi tadrūpaṃ māṃ prasevayet ||53|| tatrastho’haṃ paraṃ śreyaḥ kariṣyāmi yathā svayam | bhaktasya tu sadā śreyaḥ kartuṃ dīkṣāṃ vahāmyaham ||54|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne lakṣmīcihnāni pramadāntaracihnāni cetyādikathananāmā ekonasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||69||
<1.70> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi vinā muktiṃ paralokagatiḥ sadā | kaṣṭā kaṣṭapradā syādvai hyātma svārjitajīvanaḥ || 1 || mṛtasya yadi kārye’pi yogyapiṇḍādi nārpayet | agre gatervilopaḥ syād duḥkhabāhulyamāpatet || 2 || tasmātkarmagatiṃ yāsyan mariṣyam̐śca svayaṃ tadā | jīvanneva svasaukhyārthaṃ kuryātpuṇyamatandritaḥ || 3 || naro vā yadi vā nārī śarīrendriyayogataḥ | sukhaṃ dharmaṃ duḥkhamadharmaṃ kurvanti svabhāvataḥ || 4 || sukhārthaṃ dharmamākuryādadharmaṃ tu duḥkhāya vai | svena naiva kṛtaṃ kiñcit pāścātyaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati || 5 || tathāpi snehilo loko janaścāpi tathā vidhaḥ | snehādhīnaḥ karotyeva pāścātye’pi janaḥ kvacit || 6 || yadā jantuḥ śarīrādvai paralokāya yāti vai | tadā prāṇairvihīnaṃ taccharīraṃ śavasaṃjñitam || 7 || aspṛśyaṃ jāyate tūrṇaṃ kṛmiviṭbhasmasaṃjñitam | mṛtasyotkrāntisamayāt ṣaṭpiṇḍān kramato’rpayet || 8 || mṛtasthāne śavo nāma piṇḍastatra pradīyate | tena bhūmirbhavet tuṣṭā tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā || 9 || dvāradeśe bhavetpānthastena nāmnā pradīyate | tena dattena tuṣyanti gṛhavāstvadhidevatāḥ ||1.70.10|| catvare khecaro nāma tannāmnā tu pradīyate | tena tatropaghātāya bhūtakoṭiḥ palāyate ||11|| viśrāme bhūtasaṃjño’yaṃ tamuddiśya pradīyate | piśācā rākṣasā yakṣā ye cānye tatra vāsinaḥ ||12|| tasya hotavyadehasya naivāyogyatvakārakāḥ | citāyāṃ sādhako nāma pretastasmai pradīyate ||13|| ityevaṃ pañcapiṇḍairhi śavasyāhutiyogyatā | dehadoṣavināśaśca tatognirjvālayeccitām ||14|| saṃmṛjya copalipyātha ulikhyoddhṛtya vedikām | abhyukṣīya samādhāya vahniṃ tatra vidhānataḥ ||15|| puṣpākṣataiḥ susampūjya devaṃ kravyādasaṃjñakam | svargaṃ mṛtaṃ nayetyuktvā śarīrāhutimācaret ||16|| ardhadehe tathā dagdhe dadyādājyāhutiṃ tataḥ | yamāya cāntakāyeti mṛtyave brahmaṇe tathā ||17|| jātavedomukhe deyā hyekā pretamukhe tathā | ūrdhvaṃ tu jvālayed vahniṃ pūrvabhāge citāṃ punaḥ ||18|| asau svargāya lokāya svāhā jvalati pāvakaḥ | evamājyāhutiṃ datvā tilamiśrāṃ samantrakām ||19|| tato dāhaḥ prakartavyaḥ putreṇa kila niścitam | roditavyaṃ tato gāḍhaṃ evaṃ tasya sukhaṃ bhavet ||1.70.20|| dāhasyānantaraṃ tatra kṛtvā saṃcayanakriyām | pretapiṇḍaṃ pradadyācca dāhārtiśamanaṃ kila ||21|| tataḥ sacailakaṃ snānaṃ putraiḥ kṛtvā tilodakam | śilāyāṃ nāmagotreṇa dadyācca karatāḍanīm ||22|| viṣṇurviṣṇuriti brūyāt tatastasya gṛhaṃ janāḥ | dvārasya dakṣiṇe gatvā gomayaṃ gaurasarṣapān ||23|| nidhāya varuṇaṃ devamantardhāya svaveśmani | bhakṣayennimbapatrāṇi ghṛtaṃ prāśyaṃ gṛhaṃ vrajet ||24|| aśrupātaṃ na kurvīta datvā cātha jalāṃjalim | śleṣmāśru bāndhavairbhuktaṃ preto bhuṃkte yato’vaśaḥ ||25|| dugdhaṃ ca mṛnmaye pātre toyaṃ dadyād dinatrayam | śmaśānaṃ catvaraṃ gehaṃ paśyan yāmyaiḥ sanīyate ||26|| gartapiṇḍān daśāhāni pradadyācca dine dine | jalāṃjalayo dātavyāḥ pretamuddiśya nityadā ||27|| putro bhāryā ca vā śiṣyo bhrātā kriyāṃ karotu vai | pratyahaṃ tu pradattasya piṇḍasyārdhe tu dehadam ||28|| tṛtīyaṃ yamadūtānāṃ caturthenopajīvati | ahorātraistu navabhiḥ preto niṣpattimāpnuyāt ||29|| jantorniṣpannadehasya daśame tu kṣudhā bhavet | dehabhūtaḥ kṣudhāviṣṭo gṛhopari sa tiṣṭhati ||1.70.30|| tatra sthitvā yamamārge gacchantyatha yamālaye | duḥkhānyanubhavan paścājjanma prāpsyan praśocati ||31|| aho kiṃcinmayā naiva svāsthye mokṣapradaṃ kṛtam | na harernāmajapanaṃ na kathāśravaṇaṃ kṛtam ||32|| na mayā kīrtanaṃ gītaṃ smaraṇaṃ na hareḥ kṛtam | ne kṛtaṃ tvarcanaṃ tasya satāṃ pādābhimardanam ||33|| na stotraṃ na namaskāraḥ śarīreṇa kṛtaṃ nahi | śarīra tanmadīyaṃ na yanmayā poṣitaṃ bahu ||34|| rakṣitaṃ lālitaṃ samyak sevitaṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ | vṛthaiva tatparityaktaṃ tena kāryaṃ na sādhitam ||35|| indriyaiḥ saha sammīlya deho vyarthaṃ prayāpitaḥ | samayo mokṣalābhārthaṃ na mayā sārthakīkṛtaḥ ||36|| anukūlābhavannārī patiścāpyabhavat priyaḥ | putra dāsāścānukulāstathāpyātmā pravañcitaḥ ||37|| dhanaṃ cāsīdvipulaṃ me dānārthaṃ vastujātayaḥ | kevalena pralobhena mayā mokṣo na cārjitaḥ ||38|| sādhusādhvījanānāṃ tu sevā naiva kṛtā mayā | duṣkṛtasya phalaṃ bhuṃje kimidānīṃ bhavennanu ||39|| mahatā puṇyayogena mānuṣaṃ janma labhyate | tanmayā sārthakaṃ naiva kṛtamanyatkṛtaṃ bahu ||1.70.40|| krīḍayā yāpitaṃ bālyaṃ yauvanaṃ kṣapitaṃ ratau | vārdhakyaṃ cintayā kṣiptaṃ mṛtau kiṃ syādaśaktinā ||41|| śarīraṃ tatkalpavṛkṣakāmadhenumaṇiprabham | kṣapitaṃ cānyakāryeṣu nātmakāryaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ||4|| kiṃkaraiḥ pīḍyate’tyarthaṃ parādhīnaḥ karomi kim | dānaṃ naiva pradattaṃ vai tapastaptaṃ na vai mayā ||43|| vrataṃ vā pālitaṃ naiva hutaṃ sādhumukhe nahi | tīrthaṃ naiva kṛtaṃ kiñcid vāpyādi naiva kāritam ||44|| gocaraṃ na kṛtaṃ kvāpi sāhāyyaṃ kaḥ kariṣyati | kṛtaḥ paropakāro na na kṛtaṃ pāralaukikam ||45|| niyamā nādṛtāḥ samyak idānīṃ kiṃ bhavennanu | guroḥ pitrostathā sevā naiva kvāpi mayā kṛtā ||46|| nārīdeho mahākaṣṭaḥ parādhīnaḥ sadāśuciḥ | bhaktyā vā sevayā naiva mayā vai sārthakīkṛtaḥ ||47|| naradeho mahābhāro naikatṛṣṇāvaho’śubhaḥ | bhajanena ca puṇyena na mayā sārthakīkṛtaḥ ||48|| evaṃ sa yātanāpreto brūte śocati roditi | pīḍyate tāḍyate dūtaiḥ krandantyapi muhurmuhuḥ ||49|| jāyādhanadharādhāmasukhaṃ smarati duḥkhitaḥ | bhṛtyamitrasutāputrakuṭumbaṃ saṃpraśocati ||1.70.50|| mārge gantuṃ samartho na dūtairākṛṣyate hyadhaḥ | karuṇaṃ vilapatyeva re priye he sutādayaḥ ||51|| mocayantu samāgatya māmetadduḥsahārdanāt | putraḥ pautro bāndhavo vā puṇyaṃ karotu matkṛte ||52|| dhenudānaṃ madarthaṃ vai karotu mama putraka || vaitaraṇīṃ tariṣyāmyanyathā me tatra majjanam ||53|| mayā pātheyamalpaṃ tu na nītaṃ puṇyanāmakam | na taptaṃ na hutaṃ japtaṃ na dattaṃ kuta āvrajet ||54|| uṣṇenārdreṇa śītena mārgeṇa gamyate yadā | mūrchitastrāsitastatra hṛdi śocati kevalam ||55|| yadi me bāndhavaḥ ko’pi vastrāderdānamarpayet | tadaitaduḥkhanāśaḥ syānnānyathā bhoga eva ha ||56|| kiṃkarāstu vadantyenaṃ kva te puṇyaṃ hi tādṛśam | tadā hā daiva samprocya dhairyamālabhate kṣaṇam ||57|| yadi vai mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ prāpnuyāṃ punareva cet | avaśyaṃ muktidaṃ mārgamāśrayiṣye śapāmyaham ||58|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mṛtaśavasya kriyāpiṇḍadānaśokapretaśokādipradarśananāmā saptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 70 ||
<1.71> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca yamapuryāstu duḥkhāni samanubhūya nārakāḥ | viniḥsṛtāśca narakādvicaranti yathā śṛṇu || 1 || te tu pretā yadi janma kimapyāptumaniścitāḥ | kuṭumbaṃ svaṃ samanviṣya patnyāṃ putre kuṭumbini || 2 || bāndhave vā kṛtasthānā nivasanti gṛhe jane | vicarantyaśarīrāste kṣutpipāsārditā bhṛśam || 3 || kvacitkadācidbalato rundhanti mohayanti tān | duḥkhayanti mūrchayanti pīḍayanti muhurmuhuḥ || 4 || kathaṃ tvayā madarthaṃ vai mokṣaṇārthaṃ kṛtaṃ nahi | tasmād vayaṃ pretabhūtāḥ pīḍayiṣyāma ulbaṇam ||5|| itiroṣeṇa saṃrabdhā pīḍayanti punaḥ punaḥ | pitṛdvārāṇi rundhanti tanmārgarundhakāstathā || 6 || pitṛbhāgām̐śca gṛhṇanti pathikām̐staskarā iva | svaveśmani malamūlotsargādyaśuddhabhūtale || 7 || uṣitvā ca nirīkṣante yaṃ janaṃ syāt sa rogavān | pīḍayanti jvararūpaistadbhakṣyaṃ bhakṣayanti ca || 8 || pibanti cāpi tadraktaṃ sūkṣmaṃ svalpaṃ kvacitkvacit | cintayanti sadāniṣṭamucchiṣṭādisthalasthitāḥ || 9 || pibanti tatra pānīyaṃ bhojanocchiṣṭayojitam | kuṭumbasyātmajādīnāṃ cintayanti chalaṃ sadā ||1.71.10|| evamaniṣṭamatayaḥ svakān pīḍāṃ prakurvate | svakulaṃ pīḍayet pretaḥ paraṃ chidreṇa pīḍayet ||11|| jīvan sa snehavānāsīnmṛto duṣṭatvameti hi | chidraṃ mālinyamāsādya muhuḥ pīḍāṃ karoti saḥ ||12|| sarvakriyāparimṛṣṭaṃ devapūjāvihīnakam | aśuddhabhojyabhoktāraṃ janaṃ pretaḥ prapīḍayet ||13|| ekasya putranāśaḥ syātputraṃ na labhate’paraḥ | ekaḥ santatihīnaḥ syātpretadoṣo’sti tatra vai ||14|| santatirgarbhato naśyet samutpanno vinaśyati | paśudravyavināśaśca virodho bāndhavaiḥ samam ||15|| prakṛtiśca vivarteta suteṣu kalahastathā | akasmād vyasanaprāptiḥ sā pīḍā pretasaṃbhavā ||16|| unmattatā hyanidrā ca bhojanāpācano jvaraḥ | udgārā udaraśūlaṃ sā pīḍā pretasaṃbhavā ||17|| cauryarucirgṛhakalirdhanadhānyadaridratā | sampattestu śanairhāsaḥ pīḍeyaṃ pretasaṃbhavā ||18|| bahutpannamapi dravyaṃ viniḥsarati hastataḥ | subhikṣe kṛṣināśaḥ syād udyoge viparītatā ||19|| hīnakarmābhiyānaṃ syāt caurāgnirājabhirbhayam | mahārogopapattiśca svadehapīḍanaṃ tathā ||1.71.20|| pūrvaṃ tu sevikā patnī paścācchūnīva jāyate | gṛhanāśamatirnityaṃ pīḍā sā pretasaṃbhavā ||21|| bhāvanā smṛtihīnā ca kāryaṃ mānasavarjitam | kalaho’nudinaṃ sveṣu sā pīḍā pretasaṃbhavā ||22|| strīṇāṃ garbhavināśaḥ syānna puṣpaṃ dṛśyate tathā | puṣpaṃ pradṛśyate’thāpi phalaṃ naiva pradṛśyate ||23|| jīvitānāṃ kramānnāśo gṛhe dantakaliḥ sadā |
