bhojane kopasamudvegādinā tṛptiśūnyatā ||24|| kalaho ghātakāścaiva putrāḥ śatrorivātmajāḥ | na prītirna ca vai saukhyaṃ sā pīḍā pretasaṃbhavā ||25|| pitrorvākyaṃ na kuruto svapatnīṃ na ca sevate | patnī patidṛśiṃ nāyāt sā pīḍā pretasaṃbhavā ||26|| akasmānmṛtikartāraḥ pretā bhavanti pīḍakāḥ | vikarmaṇā bhavet preto vidhihīnakriyastathā ||27|| tatkāle duṣṭasaṃsargād vṛṣotsargādṛte tathā | duṣṭamṛtyuvaśādvāpi hyadagdhavapuṣastathā ||28|| dāhakriyādilopācca khaṭvādimṛtidoṣataḥ | kṣuttṛṭdāhamṛterdoṣāt pretatvaṃ jāyate priye ||29|| vāsanāvaśataḥ kvāpi vāṇīceṣṭāvivarjitam | pretatvaṃ susthira bhāvi pretamuktiṃ samācaret ||1.71.30|| na yo vai manute pretān mṛtaḥ pretatvamāpnuyāt | pretadoṣaḥ kule yasya sukhaṃ tatra na vidyate ||31|| matiḥ prītiḥ ratirbuddhirlakṣmīḥ pañcavināśanam | tṛtīye paṃcame puṃsi vaṃśacchedo’bhijāyate ||32|| daridro nirdhanaścaiva pāpakarmā bhave bhave | pretā evaṃ duḥkhayanti svāneva krūrabhāvataḥ ||33|| kṣutpipāsārditāḥ pretāḥ praviśeyuḥ svaveśmani | praviṣṭā vāyudehena śayānān svasvavaṃśajān ||34|| svapne putrakalatrādīn darśayanti svarūpakam | gajo hayo vṛṣo bhūtvā dṛśyante vikṛtānanāḥ ||35|| mārjāro vanitā sarpo dṛśyantevai kṣaṇaṃ muhuḥ | śayanaṃ viparītaṃ vā svātmānaṃ vā viparyayam ||36|| utthitaḥ saṃvīkṣate vai yaḥ sa pretena pīḍyate | nigaḍairbadhyate svapne pretakṛt tanna saṃśayaḥ ||37|| annaṃ tu yācate svapne vadhyate bahuśastrakaiḥ | svayaṃ vā hanti manujaṃ tatsarvaṃ pretadarśitam ||38|| bhuṃjānasya tu pakvānnaṃ gṛhītvā vai palāyate | svasya vānyasya salilaṃ tṛṣārtastu pibed balāt ||39|| vṛṣabhārohaṇaṃ svapne vṛṣabhaiḥ saha vāṭanam | utplutya vyomagamanaṃ tīrthe vā kṣudhayā gatim ||1.71.40|| svakalatraṃ svabandhūm̐śca svasutaṃ svapatiṃ gurum || vidyamānaṃ mṛtaṃ paśyet tatsarvaṃ pretadarśitam ||41|| yastvapo yācate svapne kṣuttṛṣābhyāṃ pariplutaḥ | tasya pretasya muktyarthaṃ tīrthe piṇḍānpradāpayet ||42|| nirgacchato gṛhād rātrau svapne putrām̐stathā paśūn | pitṛbhrātṛkalatrāṇi pretadoṣeṇa paśyati ||43|| tacchāntyarthaṃ gṛhe tīrthe śrīvṛkṣe tarpaṇaṃ caret | kṛṣṇadhānyāni saṃpūjya pradadyād vedapārage ||44|| sarvavighnāni santyajya muktyupāyaṃ karoti yaḥ | tasya karmaphalaṃ sādhu pretatṛptiśca śāśvatī ||45|| ātmaiva śreyasā yujyat pretastṛptiṃ vrajecciram | te tṛptāḥ śubhamicchanti svātmabandhuṣu sarvadā ||46|| anyathā tu durātmānaḥ kleśayanti svavaṃśajān | darśanādbhāṣaṇād yastu ceṣṭanātpīḍanādapi ||47|| sadgatiṃ na prāpayati pretaśāpaiḥ prapīḍyate | aputrako’paśuścaiva daridro vyādhitastathā ||48|| vṛttihīnaśca dīnaśca bhavejjanmani janmani | tasmānmuktiḥ prakartavyā pretānāṃ tarpaṇaiḥ sadā ||49|| te tṛptā vārayanti – svān jāyamānānupadravān | paścātte muktimāyānti kāle prāpte tu putrataḥ ||1.71.50 || sadābandhuṣu yacchanti ṛddhiṃ vṛddhiṃ ca sampadaḥ | pitṝnuddiśya yaḥ kuryānnārāyaṇabaliṃ śubham ||51|| kṛtena tena vighnāni vinaśyanti na pīḍyate | bhūtapretapiśācādipīḍābhyo mucyate dhruvam ||52|| nārāyaṇabaliṃ kṛtvā vṛṣotsargādikaṃ kriyāt | sarvopadravarāhityaṃ sarvasaukhyamavāpnuyāt ||53|| pitṛmātṛsamaṃ loke nāstyanyad daivataṃ param | prabhuḥ śarīrajanmakṛt pratyakṣadaivataṃ pitā ||54|| hitānāmupadeṣṭā ca guruḥ pratyakṣadaivatam | tasmāt pitāgururmātā vṛddhāḥ pūjyāḥ patistathā ||55|| śarīraṃ sampado dārāḥ sutā lokāḥ sanātanāḥ | yasya prasādātprāpyante ko’nyaḥ pūjyatamastataḥ ||56|| puṃnāmno narakād yasmāt pitaraṃ trāyate tu yaḥ | tasmāt putra iti proktastasmāt pitaraṃ tārayet ||57|| apamṛtyumṛtau syātāṃ pitā mātā ca kasyacit | dharmaṃ tīrthaṃ vivāhādi śrāddhaṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ kriyāt ||58|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pretānāmaśuddhabhūvāsapretakṛtavividhapīḍāpretakṛtasvapnacihnatannivṛttyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||71||
<1.72> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi pretān tvakālamṛtyujān | pākhaṇḍakān lobhamṛtān cāsaṃskāramṛtām̐stathā || 1 || cāṇḍālādudakātsarpāt śāpād drumācca vaidyutāt | daṃṣṭriśṛṃgipaśubhyaśca mṛtāḥ pretā bhavanti te || 2 || udbandhanamṛtā ye ca viṣaśastrādisaṃhatā | ātmaghātina evābhicārakarmādisaṃhatāḥ || 3 || mahakaṣṭairmṛtā rogairdasyubhirmāritāśca ye | visūcyagnihatā ye ca bhūkhaṇḍādimṛtāśca ye || 4 || asaṃskṛtāḥ pramṛtā ye malinā malamṛtyavaḥ | piṇḍaluptā vṛṣotsargakriyāhīnā mṛtāśca ye || 5 ||| parvatād bhittipātādvā vyomnyevaṃ gamanānmṛtāḥ | rajasvalāsthitau vātha maithune śaucage mṛtāḥ || 6 || antarikṣe hyantarāle sīmni nirjanake mṛtāḥ | duṣṭaśalyādinā naṣṭāḥ sūtakādau mṛtāśca ye || 7 || tṛṣāyāṃ ye jalānāptāḥ kumṛtyuvaśagāśca ye | te vai pretāḥ prajāyante tvaṭanti kṣitimaṇḍale || 8 || gaupaśugrāsaloptāro jalārāmavināśakāḥ | devavṛttivineṣṭāro dīnavṛttivibhedakāḥ || 9 || dānakarmaviloptāraḥ puṇyakārya prabhañjakāḥ | bahūnāṃ duḥkhakartāraḥ pretā bhavanti pāpataḥ ||1.72.10|| paradroharatāḥ pāpāḥ pāpamṛtyuvaśaṃgatāḥ | kṣutpipāsārditā nityaṃ pretatvamupayānti te ||11|| na mātā na pitā pretajanmādau kāraṇaṃ matam || pretatvaṃ karmato yāmyasaṃkalpācca bhavatyataḥ ||12|| tatra vai vikṛtākārā lamboṣṭhā vikṛtānanāḥ | bṛhaccharīradaśanā vakrāsyāścāpi kecana ||13|| sarpāsyāśca biḍālāsyā vividhāsyā bhavanti te | nāmāpi yādṛśaṃ karma kṛtvā bhavanti nārakāḥ ||14|| tādṛgguṇaṃ bhavatyeva pretasya tu tadā tadā | yādṛkpāpaṃ vidhāyaiva pretatāṃ yāti mānavaḥ ||15|| tathā tathā kṣudhā tasya pipāsāpi muhurbhavet | bhojanaṃ vā jalaṃ vāpi śuddhaṃ naivāpyate kvacit ||16|| śuddhe tu bhojane kvāpi jale vā nāstyadhikṛtiḥ | śuddha tvannaṃ vasubhiśca śuddhaṃ jalaṃ tu vāruṇaiḥ ||17||| sarvadā rakṣitaṃ tatra pretānāṃ bhāga eva na | śleṣmamūtrapurīṣaiśca recakaiḥ samalaiḥ saha ||18|| paryuṣitaistathocchiṣṭaiḥ pretānāṃ bhojanaṃ bhavet | śaucahīnaṃ malinaṃ yat pretā bhuṃjanti tatsadā ||19|| yasya gṛhe na vai śuddhirna vā devārpaṇaṃ bhavet | madyamāṃsamaye duṣṭe pretā bhuṃjanti tadgahe ||1.72.20|| lobhakrodhamadālasyanidrāśokabhayāni ca | māyākalahakāpaṭyaṃ mālinyaṃ snānahīnatā ||21|| dhātvādimalaśuddhirna rajovīryāktamambaram | lālāliṭṭamayī bhittirnālikā mūtrasaṃbhṛtā ||22|| yatra yatra gṛhe santi pretā bhuṃjanti tatra vai | nityaṃ liṃgabhagābhyāṃ ca kṣarat tatpretabhojanam ||23|| mṛtyurnityaṃ varaṃ jantoḥ pretatvaṃ mā bhavet kvacit | patitānnena bhuktena jaṭharasthena yo mṛtaḥ ||24|| pāpamṛtyuvaśād yo vai sa preto jāyate naraḥ | devadravyaṃ parasvādi haretpretaḥ sa jāyate ||25|| gurudravyaṃ paranyāsaṃ haret pretaḥ sa jāyate | viśvāsaghātaḥ kūṭaśca kanyā vikrayakṛjjanaḥ ||26|| bhrātṛdhṛk janahā goghnaḥ paśughnaḥ pāradārikaḥ | hemahartā bhuvo hartānṛtaḥ pretaḥ sa jāyate ||27|| mātaraṃ bhaginīṃ bhāryāṃ snuṣāṃ duhitaraṃ sutam | pitaraṃ yo vā tyajati sa preto jāyate naraḥ ||28|| śiṣṭācāravihīnā ye pitrorbhaktivihīnakāḥ | madyamāṃsaratā ye ca paśughātādikarmiṇaḥ ||29|| paradrohaprakartāro mahātrāsapradāśca ye | ye chidrānveṣiṇo nityaṃ parakalpāntakārakāḥ ||1.72.30|| bahuvyavāyasaṃsaktā hārdamāṃsādibhakṣakāḥ | krūrā vyasanino duṣṭā niṣiddhācaraṇe ratāḥ ||31|| cānye ye tādṛśāsteṣāṃ jāyate hyāyuṣaḥ kṣayaḥ | svalpāyuṣaṃ kuśarīraṃ hitvā pretā bhavanti te ||3|| tādṛśena śarīreṇa śreyaḥ svasya prasādhayet | puṇyena karmaṇā svargaṃ sādhayenmokṣameva vā ||33|| prāktanaiḥ karmapākaistu sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ tu vindati | tadatra janmani saukhyapradaṃ dharmaṃ samācaret ||34|| naro vā yadi vā nārī svārthaṃ kṛtvāpi bhūtale | parārthaṃ sādhayennityaṃ śreyo mokṣakaraṃ param ||35|| anyattu vismaret kāmaṃ mokṣaṃ tu naiva vismaret | anyattu vismaretkāryaṃ dharmaṃ tu naiva vismaret ||36|| anyattu vismared bhogyaṃ ātmasaukhyaṃ na vismaret | kṛtrimaṃ vismared yogaṃ hariṃ hṛtsthaṃ na vismaret ||37|| prabhuṃ vihāya sukhadaṃ duḥkhadaṃ bhajate tu yaḥ | duḥkhaṃ syāttu phalaṃ tasya nānyat śreyaḥ sa vindati ||38|| nārakāstrividhāstasmāt vijñeyāḥ kamalekṣaṇe | eke yamapurasthāścāpare tu pretarūpiṇaḥ ||39|| anye tu nārakāḥ sarve gṛhe gṛhe’tiduḥkhinaḥ | yeṣāṃ gṛhe na vai saukhyaṃ bhojyabhojanavaibhavāt ||1.72.40|| nārīputradhanadhānyāt te’tra pratyakṣanārakāḥ | yeṣāṃ kuṭumbaṃ bahulaṃ poṣaṇe tu daridratā ||41|| vastrānnāni na pūryante te’tra pratyakṣanārakāḥ | ekādhikastrīpatiryaḥ sa tu pratyakṣanārakī ||42|| vyabhicāro gṛhe yasya tadvai pratyakṣanārakam | paradāragaṇikādirataḥ pratyakṣanārakaḥ ||43|| śvavat svanāryā gaṇitaḥ so’tra pratyakṣanārakī | patnī śunīva yā yatra sāpi pratyakṣanārakā ||44|| yeṣāṃ hūm̐ tūm̐ kṛto dveṣaḥ kleśo gṛhajaneṣu vai | na nidrā na sukhaṃ prema te vai pratyakṣanārakāḥ ||45|| svajanaścauryakṛt yatra svajano yatra ghātakī | svajano vaṃcako yatra tadvai pratyakṣanārakam ||46|| ājñākarā na putrādyāḥ premadā vanitā nahi | kuṭumba mānadaṃ nāsti tadvai pratyakṣanārakam ||47|| bhojanaṃ sarvadā rūkṣaṃ gālīdānādipūrvakam | darśanaṃ dveṣanetreṇa so’tra pratyakṣanārakī ||48|| sphāṭitāni tu vastrāṇi gṛhaṃ rathyā ca catvaram | satkāre tu tiraskāraḥ sa tu pratyakṣanārakī ||49|| parādhīnā daśā nityaṃ sevakāḥ kṣepakāstathā | svajanaḥ śvajanavacca sa tu pratyakṣanārakī ||1.72.50|| ādhivyādhisamupādhikleśagṛhaṃ tu yadgṛham | chidraraudradhūrtaśāṭhyāśrayaṃ pratyakṣanārakam ||51|| patnī kāmapradā naiva sarvathā pratipakṣiṇī | patiḥ ratiprado naiva tāḍakaḥ so’tra nārakaḥ ||52|| janmakṣatā janmarogā janmaduḥkhāḥ pratāpinaḥ | kleśāḍhyā janmata eva te vai pratyakṣanārakāḥ ||53|| narakaṃ tu śarīraṃ vai tatra vāsāttu nārakī | narakaḥ khalu saṃsārastatra vāsāttu nārakī ||54|| bhaktyā śreyaḥprakartā tu narakānmucyate khalu | yāvannaiva pramucyante tāvat sarve tu nārakāḥ ||55|| narakasya malānāṃ ca lālānāṃ dhātuyoginām | dvārāṇyālambya ramate so’tra sākṣāddhi nārakī ||56|| narakebhyaḥ samutpanno narake sajjate punaḥ | puṣṭau narakarūpo’yaṃ ko’nyastasmāddhi nārakī ||57|| avamānaṃ mahāduḥkhaṃ bandhanaṃ tu tato’dhikam | parādhīnaṃ mahātrāsastadvānatraiva nārakī ||58|| tṛṣṇākhyaṃ narakaṃ yasya lagnaṃ sa nārakī mataḥ | evaṃ tṛtīyanarakaṃ sarvasyātra gṛhe gṛhe ||59|| aviśuddhiḥ kṣayaścaivātiśayaśca tridoṣakam | yasya yasyābhavat śliṣṭaṃ sa vai nārakavad bhavet ||1.72.60|| ete pretāstu jīvanto mṛtāḥ pretā yamālaye | adṛśyā vāyurūpāśca pretāstrayaḥ paretakāḥ ||61|| sarve vai duḥkhabhoktāraḥ sarve ca duḥkhadāstathā | sarve bhaktivihīnāśca ko bhedo’tra paretake ||62|| yāmyāścaiva ca vāyavyā mānavīyāśca te trayaḥ | yadi śreyo na kurvanti tarhi pretāḥ samāstrayaḥ ||63|| tasmānmānuṣadehena kartavyaṃ mokṣakārakam || tena muktiṃ pragantāraḥ pretatvaṃ naiva yānti hi ||64|| nārī tu ḍākinī yasya patirvā bhūtabhītidaḥ | putrā rākṣasahantāraḥ pretastasmātpalāyate ||65|| yonistu kaṇḍanī yasyāḥ kledinī mūtravīryakaiḥ | kardamābhaṃ śarīraṃ ca tasyā bhoktā tu nārakī ||66|| śvapacā grāmabāhyasthā aśuddhā doṣapeṭakāḥ | doghe doṣastu ko deyaḥ pretastatra karoti kim ||67 pretaṃ preto yathā naiva trāsayenna ca pīḍayet | tathā pretasamaṃ duṣṭaṃ pīḍayitvā labheta kim ||68|| tādṛśaṃ tu kuṭumbaṃ vai tyaktvā pretāḥ prayānti vai | tīrthe’raṇye’thavānyatra vasanti nityaduḥkhitāḥ ||69|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne keṣāṃ pretatvaṃ pretānāṃ vāso bhojanādi pretāstrividhetyādivarṇananāmā dvāsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||72||
<1.73> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca sarveṣāṃ sarvayonyādau sukhaṃ nyūnādhikaṃ kṛtam | manuṣyayonau dharmātmā sukhī bhavati sarvathā || 1 || puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ vidhijaṃ ca niṣedhajam | āgarbhāt pañcavarṣāṇi na vai pāpena lipyate || 2 || pañcavarṣottaraṃ dehī tvardhapāpena lipyate | dvādaśābdaparo dehī sarvapāpaiḥ pralipyate || 3 || yathāvasthaṃ yathāpāpapralepastatpramāpataḥ | mṛtasya sūtakaṃ cātrādhikaṃ nyūnaṃ ca gamyate || 4 || yāvanmāse garbhapātastāvaddināni sūtakam | tasya kiñcidapi karma kartavyaṃ naiva vidyate ||5|| janmata ācūḍānmṛtyau bālaṃ garte viniḥkṣipet | dugdhaṃ deyaṃ yathāśakti bālānāṃ tuṣṭi hetave || 6 || ācūḍātpañcavarṣe tu mṛtau dehaṃ dahettataḥ | kṣīra bhojyaṃ pradātavyaṃ bālānāṃ bhojanaṃ yataḥ || 7 || pūrṇapaṃcamavarṣasya mṛtau karmāṇi sarvathā | aurdhvadaihikāni yathāvidhi kāryāṇi sarvathā || 8 || kumārāṇāṃ ca bālānāṃ bhojanaṃ vastraveṣṭanam | mahādānavihīnaṃ tu kumāre kṛtyamācaret || 9 || bāle vā taruṇe vṛddhe ghaṭo bhavati dehinām | garne nikṣepaṇaṃ bālamāvarṣadvayameva ha ||1.73.10|| tataḥ paraṃ vā sarvasya dehadāho vidhīyate | śiśurādantajananād bālaḥ syād yāvadāśikham ||11|| tataḥ paraṃ kumāraśca syādāmauñcīprabandhanam | pañcavarṣādhike mṛtyau vṛṣotsargavidhiṃ vinā ||12|| tathā sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ vinā hyekādaśe’hani | śrāddhāni ṣoḍaśa kuryādudakubhaṃ ca dāpayet ||13|| dīpānnajalavastrādisvarṇadānādi bhojanam | kāraṇīyaṃ yathāyogyaṃ pretatvavinivṛttaye ||14|| putramukhaṃ pitā dṛṣṭvā pituḥ ṛṇātpramucyate | ata aurasaputrastu kuryācchāddhaṃ tu pārvaṇam ||15|| pautraṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛṇatrayānmucyate svargamāpnuyāt | anaurasāḥ saṃgṛhītāḥ putrā navavidhā matāḥ ||16|| ekoddiṣṭaṃ navabhistaiḥ kartavyaṃ śrāddhameva hi | aurasena prakartavyaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ pituḥ ||17|| saṃvatsare tu sampūrṇe kuryāt piṇḍapraveśanam | varṣānte ca kṛte piṇḍamelane yāti sadgatim ||18|| evaṃ kṛte tata eva pretaḥ pitṛgaṇo bhavet | bhikṣurbhikṣāṃ na gṛhṇīyād yāvanna syātsapiṇḍanam ||19|| svagotreṣvaśucistāvad yāvat piṇḍaṃ na melayet | ānantyātkuladharmāṇāṃ puṃsāṃ caivāyuṣaḥ kṣayāt ||1.73.20|| asthiratvāccharīrasya dvādaśāhe sapiṇḍayet | tripakṣe vā ṣaṇmāse vā vatsare yā sapiṇḍayet ||21|| putrābhāve priyā kuryāt patnyabhāve sahodaraḥ | bhrātā vā bhrātṛputro vā sapiṇḍaḥ śiṣya eva vā ||22|| sapiṇḍanakriyāṃ kṛtvā kuryādabhyudayaṃ tataḥ | sarveṣāṃ putrahīnānāṃ putrī kuryāt sapiṇḍanam ||23|| ṛtvijaḥ kārayedvāpi purohitamathāpi vā| kṛtacūḍaiḥ sutaiścāpi pitṛśrāddhaṃ ca kārayet ||24|| tena vai pitarastṛptāḥ pretatṛptistathā bhavet | pretasya sukhalābhāya sarvaṃ putreṇa kāryate ||25|| tārayennarakātputro yadi mokṣo na vidyate | aputrasya gatirnāsti svargaṃ naiva ca naiva ca ||26|| dāhaḥ putreṇa kartavyo hyagnidātā ca pautrakaḥ | tilairdarbhaiśca bhūmyāṃ vaikuṇṭhe tatra matirbhavet ||27|| pañcaratnāni vaktre ca tena jīvaḥ prarohati | pralepyā gomayairbhūmistilāndarbhāṃśca nikṣipet ||28|| tasyāmevāturo nyastaḥ sarvaṃ dahati duṣkṛtam | darbhatūlī nayetsvargamāturaṃ tu na saṃśayaḥ ||29|| sarvatra vasudhā puṇyā liptā nirlaṃpajā hyapi | yātudhānāḥ piśācāśca rākṣasāḥ krūrakarmagāḥ ||1.73.3 0 || alipte hyāturaṃ muktaṃ viśantyete viyonayaḥ | brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca śrīrhutāśana eva ca ||3 1 || maṇḍale copatiṣṭhanti tasmātkurvīta maṇḍalam | anyathā mriyate yaḥ saṃkrīḍate vāyunā sa tu ||32|| mama dehasamutpannāstilāḥ lakṣmi pavitrakāḥ | asurā dānavā daityā vidravanti tilaiḥ sthitaiḥ ||33|| darbhā romasamutpannāstilāḥ svedādato nyaset | darbhamūle sthito brahmā darbhamadhye tu keśavaḥ ||34|| darbhāgre śaṃkaraścāste trayo devāḥ kuśe sthitāḥ | viṣṇurekādaśī gaṃgā tulasī vipradhenavaḥ ||35|| asāre durgasaṃsāre ṣaṭpadī muktidāyinī | nivārayanti caitāni durgatiṃ prāptamāturam ||36|| viṣṇudehasamutpanno yato vai lavaṇo rasaḥ | prāṇayāne tu lavaṇaṃ deyaṃ vai svargamārgadam ||37|| dāna vai tatra dātavyaṃ tena puṇyena rakṣyate | tilām̐śca gāṃ kṣitiṃ hema kārpāsaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā |||38|| saptadhānyaṃ tathā lohaṃ hyekaikaṃ pāvayettu tama | hemadānātsukhaṃ svargyaṃ bhūmidānānnṛpo bhavet ||39|| saptadhānyaistu dhānyāptistṛptāśca yamakiṃkarāḥ | lohadānena yāmyāstu nāgacchanti mṛtagṛhe ||1.73.40|| kuṭhāro muśalaṃ daṇḍaḥ khaḍgaśca cchurikā tathā | pāśaḥ kaśā mudgaraṃ ca yamahastāyudhāni vai ||41 || kuriṇāḥ sārvasūtrāpāḥ śūṇḍā markāstvanurvarāḥ | śabalāḥ śyāmadūtāśca prīṇitā lohadānataḥ |||42|| uddharettu lohadānaṃ hyātmānaṃ pāpasaṃcayāt | vaitaraṇīṃ tārayedvā svargaṃ mokṣaṃ nayeddhi gauḥ |||43|| gavāṃ sevāṃ mahādevo goloko’pyakaronmuhuḥ | śrauharistu gavāṃ sevāṃ sarvadā prakaroti vai ||44|| gāvaḥ sarvavidhā lakṣmīḥ goṣu nityaṃ vasāmyaham | hemadānātsūryalokaṃ candrasyāgneśca vaibhavam ||45|| dattaṃ tu lavaṇaṃ svargadvāramudghāṭayettathā | tiladānaṃ tu martyasya mahāpātakanāśanam ||46 || tadanyāni ca dānāni vastūpakaraṇāni ca | dātavyāni paretasya sukhamokṣaprapattaye ||47|| bhūmisthaṃ pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā hyardhonmīlitalocanam | svasthānāccalite śvāse dānamāturamucyate ||48|| tasmin kāle suto yastu sarvadānāni dāpayet | nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa śrīpate kamalāpate ||49|| vāsudeva parabrahma svāmin śrīrāma gopate | ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ kāryaṃ prāṇaprayāṇasaṃgatau ||1.73.50|| śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama śrīkṛṣṇa tvaṃ gatirmama | oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāyeti vā japet ||5 1|| dadyādāturasanyāsaṃ mantraṃ śrīharirityapi | śrīkṛṣṇa ityapi mantraṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇetyapi ||||52|| śrīmannārāyaṇetyeva svāminnārāyaṇetyapi | rāmakṛṣṇa harikṛṣṇa rādhākṛṣṇa omityapi |||53|| nṛsiṃha dattātreya śrīśaṃbho viṣṇo japetyapi | jaya govinda gopāla jaya mādhava ityapi ||54|| viṣṇurmātā pitā viṣṇurviṣṇuḥ svajanabāndhavāḥ | jalaṃ viṣṇuḥ sthalaṃ viṣṇurviṣṇurbhūrvaiṣṇavaḥ kuśaḥ ||55|| viṣṇurviprastilā gāvo hema dhānyaṃ tu vaiṣṇavam | viṣṇurdātā gṛhītā ca netā prāpayitāpi saḥ |||56||| tameva pūjayennityamantakāle tu kīrtayet | na tasyāsadgatiḥ kvāpi pretabhāvo’pi naiva ca ||57|| yena santastvantakāle dṛṣṭā natāśca sevitāḥ | prasāditāḥ sa vai mokṣaṃ yāti drāk nātra saṃśayaḥ |||58||| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mṛtasya yathāyogyasūtakasapiṇḍīkaraṇāditilādidānāturamantrapradānādipradarśananāmā trisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||73||
<1.74> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca antakāle gavāṃ dānaṃ svargavāsaphalaṃ khalu | aśvārūḍhāśca te yānti dadate ye hyupānahau || 1 || pretastu chatradānena chāyayā vicaretsukham | evaṃ tathānnadānena kṣudhāhīnaścaretsukham || 2 || tadvadvai dīpadānena prakāśe yāti saukhyataḥ | prāṅmukhodaṅmukho dīpo devāgāre kṛto bhavet || 3 || āsanaṃ bhājanaṃ dadyāt paralokahitāvaham | kamaṇḍalujalaṃ dadyāt tṛṣitaḥ pibatīti vāḥ || 4 || ekādaśāhe dātavyaṃ kusumaṃ cāṃgulīyakam | bhājanaṃ cānnadānaṃ ca preto yātyuttamāṃ gatim || 5 || kuṃbhadānaṃ vastradānaṃ gajāśvarathadānakam | mahiṣīdānamityevaṃ dātavyaṃ mṛtanāmataḥ || 6 || śayyādānaṃ savastraṃ cānyāni vai śaktitastathā | kāryāṇi pretasaṃtṛptisukhaśāntyupalabdhaye || 7 || śarīrād vāyumiśraḥ sa ātmā yadā prayāti hi | kaṭyūrdhvaromacchidrebhya indriyagolakāttathā || 8 || prāṇaḥ puṇyakṛto yātyanyasyādhobhāgataḥ saret | daśendriyacaturantaḥkaraṇapaṃcamātrakam || 9 || sūkṣmaṃ dehaṃ puṇyapāpe gṛhītvā yāti yatra ca | tatra karmānusāreṇa navaṃ dehaṃ gṛhaṃ matam || 1.74.1 0|| ekaviṃśatilakṣāṇi jarāyujāni tāvatā | svedajā udbhijjāścaiva aṇḍajāścāpi tāvatā || 11 || ityevaṃ caturaśītilakṣāṇi yonayo matāḥ | tatra tatra gataḥ preto punarduḥkhī punastathā || 12|| punargarbhe nivasati janirmṛtiḥ punaḥ punaḥ | hariṃ cābhajamānasya garbhe vāsaḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 1 3|| strīṣu puruṣabījena garbhā jāyanta ityataḥ | ṛtukāle tu nārīṇāṃ tyajed rātricatuṣṭayam || 14|| saptarātrimadhyagato garbhastu malino bhavet | pūrvasaptakamutsṛjya tato yugmeṣu saṃviśet || 15|| ṣoḍaśartuniśāḥ strīṇāṃ garbhadhāraṇakārikāḥ | caturdaśyāstu yā rātrirgarbhastiṣṭhati tatra cet || 16|| guṇabhāgyanidhistatra putro jāyeta dhārmikaḥ | yugmāsu putrā jāyante striyāstvekāsu rātriṣu || 17|| pañcame’hani nārīṇāṃ gaulmamādhuryabhojanam | kaṭukāraṃ ca tīkṣṇaṃ ca sājyaṃ yuvatībhojanam || 18|| nāryā tvevātapo varjyaḥ śītalaṃ kevalaṃ caret | tāmbūlagandhaśrīkhaṇḍaiḥ samaṃ saṃgaḥ śubhe’hani || 19|| niṣekasamaye śukraśoṇitamiśraṇe yathā | naranārīpracitte tu bhāvanā tadyutaḥ sutaḥ ||1.74.20 || caitanyaṃ bījarūpe tu śukre nityaṃ vyavasthitam | kāma cittaṃ ca śukraṃ ca yadā hyekatvamāpnuyuḥ ||21|| tadā dravamavāpnoti yoṣāgarbhāśaye naraḥ | raktādhikye bhavennārī śukrādhikye bhavennaraḥ ||22|| śukraśoṇitayoḥ sāmye garbhaḥ ṣaṇḍhatvamāpnuyāt | ahorātreṇa kalalaṃ budbudṃ pañcabhirdinaiḥ ||23|| daśame’hani karkandhurviṃśāhe ghanamāṃsatā | tathā māse tu sampūrṇe pañcatattvāni dhārayet ||24|| māsadvaye tvacāmedau majjāsthīni tribhistathā | caturthe tu gulphakeśāḥ pañcame karṇanāsike |||25|| saptame kaṇṭhaguhyādi hyaṣṭame’ṅgaprapūrṇatā | navame bahirjigamiṣā daśame tu prasūyate ||26|| pṛthivyāstvagasthināḍīromamāṃsetipañcakam | apāṃ lālāmūtraśukramajāraktetipaṃcakam |||27|| vahneḥ kāntikṣudhānidrātṛṣṇālasyetipañcakam | vāyoḥśvāsagatirodhākuṃcaprasārapañcakam |||28||| rāgadveṣabhayalajjāmohā vā pañca vāyujāḥ | vyomno ghoṣāśrayacchidragāmbhīryaśravaṇā guṇāḥ ||29|| iḍā piṃgalā suṣumṇā gāndhārī gajajihvikā | pūṣā yaśā hyalambuṣā kuhūḥ śaṃkhinī nāḍikāḥ ||1.74.30|| prāṇo’pānaḥ samānaścodāno vyānaśca vāyavaḥ | nāgaḥ kūrmaḥ kṛkalaśca devadatto dhanaṃjayaḥ ||3 1|| hṛdi prāṇo gude’pānaḥ samāno nābhimaṇḍale | udānaḥ kaṇṭhadeśe syād vyānaḥ sarvaśarīragaḥ ||32|| nāgasya jṛṃbhaṇaṃ kūrmavāyo saṃkocanaṃ matam | śūlaṃ kṛkalajaṃ devadattasyodgāraprabhṛti ||33|| dhanaṃjayo vikāsāya mṛte’pi tridivāsthitiḥ | karṇākṣināsikānanagudaguhyāni vai nava ||34|| nābhirdaśamī brahmarandhramekādaśakaṃ smṛtam | strīguhye garbhagarto dvādaśaṃ stanau caturdaśa ||35|| romakoṭistathā tisro hyardhakoṭisamanvitā | dvātriṃśaddaśanāḥ proktā nakhā viṃśatireva ca |||36|| trilakṣakeśā mūrdhanyā mukhasthāśceti vai sthitiḥ | trayastu mātṛto romalohitamāṃsasaṃjñakāḥ ||37|| pitṛtaśca snāyvasthimajjānaśca koṣaṣaḍvidham | māṃsaṃ palasahasraikaṃ raktaṃ palaśataṃ tathā ||38|| palāni daśa medaśca majjā palaṃ daśa dvayam | raktaṃ palatrayaṃ proktaṃ śukraṃ dvikuḍavaṃ tathā ||39|| śoṇitaṃ kuḍavaṃ śleṣmā ṣaṭ viṇmūtraṃ tathārdhakam | mano buddhirahaṃ cittametatkaraṇamāntaram ||1.74.40|| tatsarvaṃ dehasaṃbhūto garbhaḥ prasūtivāyunā | niṣkāsito bahiryāti mūrchito janma caiti hi ||41|| brahmāṇḍasyākṛtiḥ sarvā śarīre samavasthitā | satyalokaṃ śirorandhraṃ tapolokaṃ lalāṭakam ||42|| janalokaṃ mukhaṃ proktaṃ mahaḥ kaṇṭhamudāhṛtam | hṛdyaṃ tu svaraṃ vidyādbhuvarlokamudaryakam |||42|| bhūlokaṃ nābhyadhobhāgo hyatalaṃ kaṭisaṃsthitiḥ | vitalaṃ guhyamākhyātaṃ sutalaṃ sakthimūlayoḥ ||44|| ūrū talātalaṃ mahātalaṃ jānudvayaṃ tathā | rasātalaṃ mate jaṃghe pādau pātālamucyate ||45|| kṣārodastvatra tu mūtre dugdhe kṣīrodasāgaraḥ | surodadhiḥ śleṣmasaṃstho majjāyāṃ ghṛtasāgaraḥ ||46|| rasodadhirmiṣṭarase śoṇite dadhisāgaraḥ | svādūdakaḥ kukṣibhāge garbhodaḥ śukrasaṃsthitaḥ ||47|| netrayoḥ sūryacandrau ca oṣṭhe tu maṃgalaḥ smṛtaḥ | budhastu hṛdye bodhyo gururjñāne vyavasthitaḥ ||48|| śukre śukraḥ śanirnābhau mukhe rāhurvyavasthitaḥ | keturguhye sthitaśceti piṇḍaṃ brahmāṇḍamīritam ||49|| āyurvidyā ca vittaṃ ca yaśo nidhanameva ca | pañcaivaitāni sṛjyante garbhasthasyaiva dehinaḥ ||1.74.50|| adhomukhaṃ cordhvapādaṃ garbhādāyāti vai bahiḥ | rakṣyamāṇo janmakartryā rakṣam̐ścānyānnijāśritān ||51 || putraiḥ saṃrakṣitaḥ paścānmṛtaḥ punaḥ sa eva hi | bhaktyā hariṃ bhajennityamatandritamanukṣaṇam ||52|| tadā muktirbhavedeva svargaṃ sarvasukhāspadam | yanna duḥkhena sambhinnaṃ na ca grastamanantaram ||53 || abhilāṣopanītaṃ ca tatsukhaṃ svaḥpadāspadam | so’śnute sarvakāmāṃśca saha brahmaṇā vipaścitā ||54|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dānaphalaniṣekasamayagarbhanirmāṇaśārīrakoṣabrahmāṇḍaikyatādikathananāmā catuḥsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||74||
<1.75> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ṣaḍaśītisahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ pramāṇataḥ | mārgo yamapurasyeti sarvaiḥ pātheyamiṣyate || 1 || yamagrāme’pi bhojyaṃ tairiṣyate vaṃśajaiḥ kṛtam | vṛkṣāstu ropitā yena taḍāgādijalāśayāḥ || 2 || kṛtā yena hi mārge tatsukhaṃ yānti yamādhvani | hime tuṣāraśītābhyāṃ pīḍyate na yamālaye || 3 || tapyamānaḥ sukhaṃ yāti hīndhanāni dadāti yaḥ | yajñotsavādikartāro bhavanti tatra modinaḥ || 4 || tṛptā vibhūṣitāścaiva gandhapuṣpasamanvitāḥ | bhūmidāne sukhaṃ yānti sarvakāmaiśca pūritāḥ || 5 || suvarṇabhūmimuktādivastrābharaṇagodhanam | tena sarvamidaṃ dattaṃ yena dattā vasundharā || 6 || vyaṃjanāni vicitrāṇi bhakṣyabhojyāni yāni ca | dīyante vidhinā putraiḥ pitre tadupatiṣṭhati || 7 || apakve mṛnmaye pātre dugdhaṃ dadyād dinatrayam | ākāśasthaḥ pibed dugdhaṃ preto vāyuvapurdharaḥ || 8 || caturthe saṃcayaṃ kṛtvā gaṃgāsparśo vidhīyate | prātaḥ prathamayāme tu dadyādādyajalāṃjalim || 9 || adharottaravastrābhyāṃ vastragranthiṃ ca dāpayet | ekavastraḥ pradadyāttu sadarbhe ca tilāṃjalim || 1.75.10 || dinatrayaṃ vasettoye agnau cāpi dinatrayam | ākāśe ca vaset trīṇi dinamekaṃ ca vāsave || 11 || vāyurūpo bhramatyeva vāyuḥ kuṭyāṃ sa gacchati | ekādaśāhe yat śrāddhaṃ tatsāmānyamudāhṛtam || 1 2|| kṛtvā caikādaśāhantu punaḥ snātvā śucirbhavet | prathame’hani yaḥ kuryāt sa daśāhaṃ samāpayet || 1 3 || ekādaśāhe pretasya dadyāt piṇḍaṃ samantrakam | siddhānnaṃ tasya dātavyaṃ śarkarāpūpakādayaḥ || 14|| śayyādānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ paścāt ko’nupradāsyati | tāvadbandhuḥ pitā tāvad yāvajjīvati mānavaḥ || 15 || mṛtamenaṃ śavaṃ jñātvā kṣaṇāt sneho nivartate | ātmā vai hyātmano bandhurātmā caivātmano ripuḥ || 16 || ato jīvan hi sarvasvaṃ svahastenaiva dāpayet | tasmāt kāṣṭhamayīṃ khaṭvāṃ hemādipaṭṭikābhṛtām || 17|| sagendukāṃ sopadhānāṃ sādarśaguptadorakām | gandhavastrādisatpuṣpāṃ sadvyajanasadantikām || 18 || sapracchādanapaṭikāṃ haimalakṣmīhariśritām | ghṛtakuṃbhaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ karpūrāgurucandanam || 1 9|| kuṃkumaṃ dīpakaṃ chatraṃ cāmarāsanabhājanam | upānahau saptadhānyaṃ bhṛṃgārakaṃ vitānakam || 1.75.20 || evaṃ śayyādidānena svarlokaḥ sukhado bhavet | upayuktaṃ ca tasyāsīd yatkiñciddhi gṛhe tathā || 2 1 || gātre cāpi ca yallagnaṃ vastrabhājanabhūṣaṇam | dātavyamupatiṣṭhettadaindre saurye’pi dhāmani || 22|| navakaṃ ṣoḍaśaśrāddhaṃ śayyāṃ saṃvatsarakriyām | bharturyā kurute nārī tasyāḥ śreyo bhavediha || 23 || pramadāyā mṛtau deyaṃ vastu strībhūṣaṇādikam | ācāryāya pradātavyaṃ śayyāratnāmbarādikam || 24|| bahubhyo na pradeyāni gaurgṛhaṃ śayanaṃ striyaḥ | ekasmai tu pradātavyamācāryāya tu kevalam || 25|| yatpuṇyaṃ ca vyatīpāte kārtikyāmayane tathā | ekādaśyāṃ ca yatpuṇyaṃ candrasūryagrahe tathā || 26|| prayāge naimiṣe yacca kurukṣetre tathārbude | gaṃgāyāṃ yamunāyāṃ ca sindhusāgarasaṃgame || 17|| śayyādānāḍhikāryeṇa tattatphalamavāpnuyāt | yatrāsau jāyate janturbhuṃkte tatraiva tatphalam || 28 || karmakṣaye kṣitau jāto mānuṣaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ | mahādhanī ca dharmajñaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ || 29|| arho’sau havyakavyeṣu pitṛbhiḥ saha modate | divyaṃ vimānamāruhya tvapsarobhiḥ samāvṛtaḥ || 1.75.30 || devaiḥ susatkṛto yāti vaikuṇṭhaṃ maraṇottaram | śrāddhe tṛptaḥ pitā dadyātputrān santativardhakān || 31 || tathā tṛpto godhanaṃ tu sandadāti pitāmahaḥ | tathā tṛpto hemadaḥ syād yastasya prapitāmahaḥ || 32|| dadyādvipulamannādyaṃ vṛddhastu prapitāmahaḥ | nārāyaṇabaliṃ kuryād yasya vaṃśo na vidyate || 33 || vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo muktaḥ sa narakād dhruvam | dhaniṣṭhāṃ tu samārabhya revatyantaṃ tu pañcakam || 34|| paṃcake tu mṛtasyātra dāho naiva vidhīyate | śavasya tu samīpe ca kṣipyante puttalāstataḥ || 35|| darbhamayāśca catvāra_ ṛkṣamantrābhipūjitāḥ | tato dāhaśca kartavyastaiśca puttalakaiḥ saha || 3 6|| pañcakeṣu mṛto yo’sau na gatiṃ labhate naraḥ | dīyate na jalaṃ tatra sarvadā hyaśubhaṃ bhavet || 37||| lokayātrā na kartavyā duḥkhārtaḥ svajano yadi | paṃcakānantaraṃ sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ vidhipūrvakam || 38 || putrāṇāṃ gotriṇāṃ tasya santāpastvanyathā bhavet | gṛhe hānirbhavet tasya paṃcake tu mṛtasya vai || 3 9|| sūtakānte tataḥ putraḥ kuryācchāntikṛduttamam | tilān gām̐śca hiraṇyaṃ ca tasyoddeśe ghṛtaṃ diśet ||1.75.40 || bhojanopānahau chatraṃ hemamudrā ca vāsasī | dakṣiṇā dīyate cāpi pretapātakanāśinī ||4 1 || aṣṭādaśaiva vastūni pretaśrāddhe vivarjayet | āśiṣo dviguṇā darbhāḥ svastyastu praṇavastathā ||42||| agnīkaraṇamucchiṣṭaṃ śrāddhaṃ tu vaiśvadaivikam | vikīraśca svadhākāraḥ pitṛśabdo’pravācanam |||43 || āvāhanamulmukaṃ cāsīmāntaṃ ca pradakṣiṇā | visarjanaṃ tilahomaḥ pūrṇāhutirdaśāṣṭa tān ||44|| tāmbūlaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca bhojanaṃ ṛtusevanam | grāmamadhye sthite prete varjayet piṇḍapātanam ||45 || kṛtvā niraśanaṃ yo vai mṛtyumāpnoti ko’pi cet | mānuṣīṃ tanumutsṛjya prāpnoti haritulyatāma ||46|| tasmādanaśanaṃ nṝṇāṃ vaikuṇṭhapadadāyakam | svasthāvasthena dehena mokṣasyaiva prasādhakam ||47|| anaśanavratakartā ṛṣīṇāṃ maṇḍale vaset | yadvā vairājadeveṣu īśeṣu vātha mokṣaṇe ||48 || tuṣṭā brahmādayastasya yāmyāḥ santi na yātanāḥ | asthīni mānuṣe dehe ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatrayam ||49||| udakuṃbhena puṣṭāni jalakuṃbhaḥ pradīyate | sulipte bhūmibhāge ca pakvānnamapi dīyate ||1.75.50 || ityevamapi kartavyaṃ brahmabhāvanayā sadā | nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ tasya muktiṃ karoti saṃsmṛtaḥ ||5 1 || mṛtyupūrvaṃ mṛtau śavayātrāyā śavadāhane | śrāddhe sarvatra vācyaṃ śrīharirnārāyaṇo muhuḥ ||52||| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne prakīrṇakadānaśayyādānādipaṃcakamṛtordhvakāryānaśanakṛnmṛtyūttaragatyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||75 ||
<1.76> śrīśvetavyāsa uvāca evaṃ suśikha bhajanāddharernāmānukīrtanāt | hāṭakāṃgadarājāpi kathārasasukho’bhavat || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu priye prasaṃgādvai mayā tu bahu varṇitam | lokasyaiva hitārthe tat kathaye’pyadhikaṃ hitam || 2 || jīvanneva janaḥ kuryānmokṣamārgāvalambanam | mokṣadāni mayā cātra klṛptāni subahūnyapi || 3 || jñānānmuktiḥ karmanāśānmuktirvairāgyavegataḥ | tīrthānmuktiḥ satāṃ saṃgāddharmānmuktirgurūśrayāt || 4 || niṣkāmakarmato muktirmuktiḥ saṃnyāsamārgataḥ | sādhvīdharmāśrayānmuktirmuktistyāgācca sevayā | svasyākartṛtvavijñānānmuktiḥ saṃkīrtanādapi || 5 || pitrostu sevayā muktirmuktiḥ patiniṣevayā | sarvabrahmātmavijñānānmuktiḥ sarvasamarpaṇāt || 6 || paropakārakaraṇānmuktiḥ parasukhārpaṇāt | anyārthitapradānācca muktirātmasutoṣaṇāt || 7 || vāsanākṣayato muktirmuktirvimalabodhataḥ | sarvakārye kṛte’pyātmā nirlepo mukta eva saḥ || 8 || ahaṃmamatvarahitaḥ śītoṣṇarahitastathā | abrahmasattvarahito mukta eva na saṃśayaḥ || 9 || visṛjya saccidānandaṃ bhānaṃ mṛṣājaḍārtikam | manute svaṃ sa vai baddho na manute sa muktakaḥ || 1.76.1 0|| bhagavadyogatīrthāni puryaśca harinirmitāḥ | nadyaśca parvatāḥ puṇyāraṇyāni mandirāṇi ca || 11 || śālagrāmaśilā devaśilā bāṇaśca mūrtayaḥ | tulasīcandanaplakṣadhātrībimbavaṭadrumāḥ || 12|| ropaṇātpālanātsekānnamaḥsparśanakīrtanāt | nirmāṇoddhārakaraṇātpāpakṣapā hi muktidāḥ || 13|| jñānahrade satyajale rāgadveṣamalāpahe | yaḥ snāto mānase tīrthe muktiṃ yāyānna saṃśayaḥ || 14|| devaḥ sarvatra vasati yadi bhāvo’sti nirmalaḥ | devaḥ kvāpi na vasati nāstikyaṃ yadi rājate || 15|| prātaḥ prātaḥ prapaśyanti gaṃgādyāṃ matsyaghātakāḥ | sūryaṃ sarve’pi paśyanti bhāvahīno na muktibhāk || 16 || pitṛmātṛsādhusādhvīgurugodevadharmaṇām | kṛte prāṇām̐styajan vyaktirniścayaṃ mokṣamāpnuyāt || 17|| jīvanaṃ dānabhogābhyāṃ maraṇaṃ raṇatīrthayoḥ | avaśyaṃ muktidaṃ syāttad yadvi devārpaṇānvitam || 18|| puṇyakṣetre puṇyatīrthe puṇyajanasamāśraye | puṇyasthitau puṇyatithau maraṇaṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet || 19|| kanyādātā bhuvo dātā dātā cāpyabhayasya yaḥ | devaprāsādanirmātā sadmadātā ca muktibhāk || 1.76.20 || vāpīkūpataḍāgānāmārāmodyānadharmiṇām | jīrṇoddhāraṃ prakurvāṇo muktibhāg saṃśayo nahi ||2 1 || sarvopakaraṇopetaṃ gṛha dhenuṃ savatsakām | kanyāṃ sarvaguṇāḍhyāṃ vai dadan muktimavāpnuyāt ||22|| sādhvī pativratā nārī patiṃ vilokya vai mṛtam | svāṃguṣṭhādagnimutpādya patyā saha prayāti cet |||23|| tisraḥ koṭyo’rdhakoṭiśca samāḥ svarge mahīyate || yadi bhaktimatī nārī patiṃ nayati dhāmani ||24|| mahāpāpasamācāro bhartā ced duṣkṛto bhavet | tasyāpyanuvratā nārī nāśayet sarvakilbiṣam || 25|| nityamannapradātā yaḥ sadā jñānapradāyakaḥ | nityātmasukhadātā yaḥ sa vai mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||26|| vidyādānapradātā yaḥ kanyādānakaraśca yaḥ | jīvanavṛttidātā yaḥ sa vai mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||27|| sukṛtaiḥ svargamāpnoti svargaṃ mokṣasthalaṃ matam | tyaktvā phalgukriyāṃ tasmātsatataṃ mokṣabhāgbhavet || 28|| dānaṃ deyaṃ daridrāya kanyā nirvaṃśakāya ca | anāthakāya sadvṛttiḥ sādhave sveṣṭavastukam |||29|| bhāvanā gurave deyā vidyā pātrāya mokṣiṇe | jñānaṃ sāttvikaśiṣyāya bhaktirdeyāntarātmane |||1.76.3 0 || mohajālaṃ tu māyāyai sarvasvaṃ paramātmane | muktiśca svātmane deyā svātmā deyaḥ parātmane ||2 1 || evaṃ mokṣaṃ prapadyeta dātā dānaphalaṃ labhet | tasmātsarvaṃ pradātavyaṃ koṭiyajñaphalādhikam || 32|| sarvadānapradātā yaḥ svasminnarakṣakaśca saḥ | arthānmukta iti bhāvyo nityamuktaḥ sa sammataḥ |||33|| nāryā kāryaṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi dānaṃ kīdṛgvidhaṃ matam | mātre’rpaṇīyaṃ kanyātvaṃ kaumāryaṃ lagnavahnaye |||34||| dehastu pataye deyaḥ putrāyāhaṃmamatvakam | saundaryaṃ tu jarāyai ca vāsanārpyā tu mṛtyave ||35|| apatyasneho vadhvai ca nanāmikyai tu bandhanam | bhāvanā brahmaṇe deyā bhaktirdeyāntarātmane ||36|| muktiśca svātmane deyā svātmā deyaḥ parātmane | iti sarvasvadānaṃ vai kartavyaṃ mokṣakāṃkṣibhiḥ |||37|| vinā vinimayaṃ naiva vastvamūlyamavāpyate | sarvasvadānamūlyenāmūlyamokṣamavāpnuyāt |||38|| ātmā tu nityaśuddho’sti śuddhistasya na śiṣyate | śarīreṇāpyaśuddhena śuddhasyāśuddhatā katham ||39|| pātraṃ naivāstyaśuddhaṃ vai lagnaṃ dravyaṃ tvaśuddhidam | lagnadravyādyapasārātpātraṃ tu śuddhameva ha ||1.76.40|| hasto nāstyaśuddho vai tu malaṃ cāśuddhirucyate | malāpasaraṇāddhastaḥ śuddha eveti manyate ||41|| yadi pātraṃ ca hastaścāśuddhau bhavataḥ saṃgataḥ | tadā nāśyaṃ bhavetpātraṃ hastaśchedyo bhavettathā |||42|| kintu naivaṃ prakurvanti malaṃ niṣkāsayanti vai | evamātmā sadā śuddhaḥ svarṇāgnivyomavanmataḥ |||43|| rāgadveṣamalāstasmādapaneyā dhiyāgninā | bhaktyārādhanayā premṇā prītyā snehena bhāvataḥ ||44|| malā dhyeyā vināśyāśca nirmalo brahma eva saḥ | brahmarūpaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā parabrahma bhajetsadā ||45|| nārāyaṇabalaṃ prāpya nārāyaṇamavāpnuyāt | nārāyaṇabalistasya kartavyo nāvaśiṣyate ||46|| nārāyaṇabalaṃ yasya nāsti tasyaiva muktaye | nārāyaṇabaliḥ kāryastadrītiṃ kathayāmi te ||47|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne muktervividhasādhanāni niṣkāmatayā kṛtāni niṣkāmatayā pradattavastūni ca muktidāni deyadānāni nijātmaśuddhyādīni ceti nirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||76||
<1.77> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca tava snehāt priye jñānaṃ proktaṃ bhavanibarhaṇam | nārāyaṇabaliṃ brūve lokopakṛtihetave || 1 || akasmātādinaṣṭānāmuddhārārthamayaṃ vidhiḥ | śubhe tīrthe śubhe kṣetre pavitre devamandire || 2 || vāritaṭe puṇyavṛkṣatale nārāyaṇabalim | kuryādviṣṇuṃ samuddiśya mantraiḥ paurāṇavaidikaiḥ || 3 || dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā pretaṃ viṣṇumiti smaret | nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa pretamokṣakaro bhava || 4 || pūrṇaṃ tu tarpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ śrāddhānyekādaśāpi ca | toyavrīhiyavān dadyād godhūmām̐śca priyaṃgavān || 5 || haviṣyānnaṃ śubhāṃ mudrāṃ chatroṣṇīṣau ca celakam | kṣīraṃ kṣaudraṃ ca dhānyāni vastre copānahau tathā || 6 || bhūmau sthiteṣu piṇḍeṣu gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ | dātavyamatha śaṃkhe vā pātre tāmre ca tarpaṇam || 7 || prathamaṃ vātadhāreṇa jānubhyāmavanīṃ gataḥ | jalārthaṃ cārpayed devamekoddiṣṭaṃ pṛthakapṛthak || 8 || āpo devī madhumatī tvādipiṇḍe prakalpitā | upayāmagṛhīto’si dvitīye tu nivedayet || 9 || ye devāsaḥ caturthe tu samudraṃ gaccha pañcame || 1.77.10 || agnirjyoti stathāṣaṣṭe’hihyayagarbhaḥ saptame | yamāya tvaṣṭame jñeyaṃ yajjāgrannavame’ tathā || 11 || daśame’yāḥ phalinīti piṇḍe caikādaśe tataḥ | bhadraṃ karṇebhirityādyaiḥ kuryāt piṇḍavisarjanam || 12|| kṛtvaikādaśadaivatyaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryātpare’hani | viprānāvāhayedarghyaṃ dadyāddevān vidhāpayet || 13 || viṣṇuṃ sarvamayaṃ rudraṃ tāmrajaṃ lohajaṃ yamam | brahmāṇaṃ rājataṃ pretaṃ sīsakaṃ darbhakaṃ ca vā || 14|| tato’yamāya tvetyādimantreṇa sāmavedinam | agne āyāhimantreṇa govindaṃ paścime nyaset || 15|| agnimīletimantreṇa pūrvāśāyāṃ prajāpatim | iṣe tventyādimantreṇa dakṣiṇe sthāpayed yamam || 16|| madhye tu maṇḍale tatra sthāpyo darbhamayo naraḥ | brahmā viṣṇustathā rudro yamaḥ pretaśca paṃcamaḥ || 17|| pṛthak kuṃbheṣu saṃsthāpyāḥ pañcaratnayuteṣu hi | vastrayajñopavītāni mudrāścaiva pṛthakpṛthak || 18|| japaṃ kuryātpṛthak tatra brahmādidevatāsu vai | paṃca śrāddhāni kurvīta devatānāṃ yathāvidhi || 19|| jaladhārāṃ tataḥ kuryāt piṇḍe piṇḍe pṛthakpṛthak | śaṃkhe vā tāmrapātre vā hyalābhe mṛṇmaye’pi vā |||1.77.20|| tilodakaṃ samādāya sarvauṣadhisamanvitam | āsanaṃ mudrikāṃ chatramupānahau kamaṇḍalum ||2 1|| pātraṃ bhojyārhadhānyaṃ ca vastrāṇyaṣṭavidhaṃ padam | tāmrapātraṃ tilapūrṇaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ sadakṣiṇam ||22|| dadyāttu vidhinā tatra mukhyāya brāhmaṇāya vai | ṛgvedine tu viprāya dadyāt sasasyamedinīm ||23 || yajurvedibrāhmaṇāya dadyād gāṃ tu payasvinīm | sāmavedibrāhmaṇāya dadyāt sadvastradhautrakam ||24|| dadyād yamaṃ samuddiśya tilān lohaṃ ca dakṣiṇām | atha puttalakaḥ kāryaḥ sarvauṣadhisamanvitaḥ ||25|| palāśasya ca vṛntānāṃ bhāgaṃ kṛtvā ca tatra vai | kṛṣṇājinaṃ samāstīrya kuśaiśca puruṣākṛtim ||26 || śatatrayaṣaṣṭiyutairvṛntaiḥ prokto’sthisaṃcayaḥ | vinyasya tāni badhnīyāt kuśairaṅge pṛthak pṛthak ||27|| catvāriṃśacchirobhāge grīvāyāṃ ca daśa nyaset | viṃśatiścorasi kṣepyaṃ viṃśatirjaṭhare tathā ||28|| bāhudvaye śataṃ dadyāt kaṭyāṃ dadyācca viṃśatim | ūrudvaye śataṃ cāpi triṃśacca jaṃghayordvayoḥ |||29||| dadyāccatuṣṭayaṃ śiśne ṣaḍ dadyād vṛṣaṇadvaye | daśa pādāṃgulībhāge evamasthīni klṛptayet ||3 0|| śiraḥsthāne nārikelaṃ dadyāttāraṃ ca tāluke | āsye dadyātpaṃcaratna jivhāyāṃ kadalīphalam ||1.77.3 1|| antreṣu vālukāṃ dadyād vāhlīkaṃ ghrāṇa eva ca | vasāyāṃ mṛttikāṃ dadyād gomūtraṃ mūtrake tathā ||32|| gandhakaṃ dhātave dadyād haritālaṃ manaḥśilām | yavapiṣṭaṃ tathā māṃse madhu śoṇita eva ca || 33 || keśeṣu ca jaṭājūṭaṃ tvacāyāṃ ca mṛgatvacam | pāradaṃ retasaḥ sthāne purīṣe pittalaṃ tathā |||34|| manaḥśilāṃ tathā gātre tilakalkaṃ ca sandhiṣu | karṇayostāḍapatraṃ ca stanayoścaiva guṃjakau ||35||| nāsāyāṃ śatapatraṃ ca kamalaṃ nābhimaṇḍale | vṛntākaṃ vṛṣaṇe dadyāt liṃge tu gṛṃjanaṃ śubham ||36|| ghṛtaṃ nābhyāṃ pradadyādvai kaupīne tu trapu smṛtam | mauktikaṃ stanayormūrdhni kuṃkumena vilepanam ||37|| karpūrāgurudhūpaiśca śubhairmālyaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ | paridhāne paṭṭasūtraṃ hṛdaye rukmakaṃ nyaset ||38|| ṛddhivṛddhibhujau dvau ca netrayośca kapardikām | sindūraṃ netrakoṇeṣu tāmbūlādyupahārakaiḥ || 39 || sarvauṣadhiyutāṃ pretapūjāṃ kṛtvā yathoditām | sāgnikaiścāpi vidhinā yajñapātrāṇi cārpayet ||1.77.40|| śanno devī punantu me imaṃ me varuṇe’ti ca | pretasya pāvanaṃ kṛtvā śālagrāmaśilodakaiḥ ||41 || viṣṇumuddiśya godānaṃ mahādānaṃ tilāni ca | vaitaraṇīṃ pradadyācca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām ||42 || prakuryād vaiṣṇavaṃ śrāddhaṃ pretamuktyarthamātmanā | pretamokṣaṃ tataḥ kuryāddhariṃ tatra prakalpayet ||43 || tvaṃ viṣṇuriti saṃsmṛtya pretamagnau dahettathā | tridinaṃ sūtake rakṣya daśāhaṃ gatapiṇḍakāḥ ||44|| sarvaṃ vai varṣaparyantaṃ kartavyaṃ pretamuktaye | svarṇabhūgopradānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ mokṣalabdhaye |||45 || saṃkrāntau kṛtadānaṃ tu dyupradaṃ saptakalpakam | harau sarvasvadānaṃ tu syādanantaṃ pramokṣadam ||46 || vaitaraṇī bhaved dvedhā ekā vai yāmyamārgagā | śatayojanavistīrṇā godānātsā tu tīryate ||47|| aparā vāsanā sākṣād vaitaraṇī hṛdi sthitā | anantayojanadīrghā jñānabhaktyā hi tīryate ||48||| prathamā tatra durgandhā dvitīyā bhāvagandhinī | ādyā rakta pūyatoyā rāgadveṣajalāparā ||49 | māṃsakardamayuktādyā dhātukardamakāparā | vajratuṇḍaiḥ śiśumārairmakarairvajrakartanaiḥ |||1.77.50 | kṛkacaiḥ kharjakairjīvairyuktādyā viṣayaiḥ parā | patanti tatra martyāstu krandamānā hi pāpinaḥ ||51| payasvinyāśca godānaṃ tārayet pūyaśoṇitam | amṛtakṛddharerdānaṃ tārayed vāsanānadīm ||52 || prāṇāḥ prāghūṇikā bodhyā na yāsyantyātmanā saha | atraiva layameṣyanti prāṇadaṃ ta hariṃ bhaja ||53 || saprāṇaṃ maraṇaṃ nidrā hyaprāṇaṃ maraṇaṃ mṛtiḥ | dvayornāstyeva viśvāso jīvasya jīvanāya hi ||54| mokṣārthamadya kurvīta yāvanna maraṇaṃ bhavet | maraṇaṃ mokṣaparyāyaṃ prāpyaṃ nānyābhidhānakam ||55|| kaḥ patiḥ kasya vā nārī kaḥ putraḥ kasya vā pitā | ṛṇānubandhasaṃsargāḥ santi vaitaraṇīpradāḥ ||56 || mamedamiti sammatvā ghorayatnaṃ karoti yat | tatsarvaṃ tu yatnakṛtaḥ tyaktvā tiṣṭhati dūrataḥ ||57|| valgantaṃ naiva valganti mānayantaṃ na manvate | snihyantaṃ naiva snihyanti tathāpyajño na paśyati ||58|| guṇavantaṃ tu śuṣkārthā janāḥ śaṃsanti vāha vāha | rūkṣāḥ svārthaṃ prasādhyaiva yānti dūraṃ na tān saret ||59|| ādau sārthastathā madhye yo’nte’pi sārthatāṃ bhajet | anyat tyaktvā sadā sārthaṃ sakhāyaṃ saṃbhajeta tam ||1.77.60|| yena kartavyamanyadvai nāvaśiṣyeta kiṃcana | kartavyaṃ tatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sakhā mitraṃ vimokṣyate ||6 1 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nārāyaṇabalikriyānirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||77||
<1.78> śrīlakṣmīruvāca gatayo vividhāḥ karmaprāpyāstu saṃśrutā mayā | pretānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ dānaṃ prabhuṇā śrāvitaṃ tathā || 1 || prasaṃgādyamarājñastu yamaloko’pi bodhitaḥ | dhanvantareḥ kathā cāpi śrotumicchāmi mādhava || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca pūrve satye tathā tretāyuge saṃkalpasiddhijam | sarvamāsīd yatheṣṭaṃ vai yadecchātyupatiṣṭhate || 3 || nāsīdapūrṇatā kācitkasyacidvastuno’pi ca | sadā tṛptiḥ sadā toṣaḥ sadaivaḥ kāmanāphalam || 4 || pañcabhūtāni ca tadā parivartanta icchayā | jano yadicchati bhūtāt tattasmāllabhate drutam || 9 || sarvalokā hṛṣṭapuṣṭā nīrogāḥ svātmatṛptayaḥ | āsanprāpte dvāpare tu jātaṃ tatparivartanam || 7 || śaktistu kalpavṛkṣāṇāṃ kiñcinnaṣṭābhavattadā | cintāmaṇīnāṃ sāmarthyaṃ kiṃcinnāśonmukhaṃ gatam || 7 || aiśvaryaṃ kāmadhenūnāṃ layamāpat kvacitkvacit | tadā kṣetravane svatvaṃ janā hyasthāpayan svakam || 8 || bhojyādilabdhikā cintā janānāmabhavad hṛdi | svatvaparatvabhedena cintāśokaspṛhādhayaḥ || 9 || adharmavaṃśāḥ svāvāsaṃ cakrurjanahṛdi drutam | janāścintādyākulāstu śuṣkāyante śarīrataḥ || 1.78.10 || teṣāṃ vyathāṃ nirbalatvaṃ dūrīkartuṃ tadā khalu | hyapekṣā samabhūttatrauṣadhānāṃ baladāyinām || 11 || bhojyauṣadhikaṇādīnāṃ bhājānāṃ phalamūlinām | janānāṃ bhojyasampattyai kṛṣisiddhyai tadā khalu || 1 2|| apekṣā samabhūdudbhijjātīnāṃ lokavṛttaye | kā cauṣadhirbhakṣyaphalakaṇapatrātmiketi vai || 13 || kā ca kathaṃ susampoṣyā hyupayojyā kathaṃ bhuji | ityevamudbhidvijñānī kaścinnāsīttadā hyajaḥ || 14|| jñātṛguruṃ prasasmāra punarnārāyaṇaṃ punaḥ | āgato bhagavām̐statra sarvajñānamayo vibhuḥ || 15 || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ sauvarṇakuṇḍalaḥ | suvarṇamukuṭaḥ svarṇamālākaustubharājitaḥ || 16 || mandahāsyaṃ sravam̐stejaḥ saṃvyāptamukhamaṇḍalaḥ | pītāmbaradharaḥ āyurvedasaṃstutasadyaśāḥ || 17|| sarvarasaprapūrṇo hi yāvaddugdhābdhipūjitaḥ | yāvacchākarasairvandyaḥ sarvagundrābhisannataḥ || 18 || divyauṣadhilatāvṛkṣatṛṇakandādisaṃstutaḥ | śubhramukho haridvarṇo raktapādakarāmbujaḥ || 19 || yuñjan śubhāśiṣā viśvasṛjaṃ prāha dayāmayaḥ | brahman kathaṃ tvayā saṃsmārito’haṃ dvāpure yuge || 1.78.20 || brahmovāca tadā devaṃ sarvagaṃ bhiṣajāṃ varam | namaskaromi deveśa vande yugalapatkajam |||2 1|| namo hyaṇusvarūpāya dvyaṇukāya namo namaḥ || tryaṇukāya namaścaturaṇukāya namonamaḥ |||22|| namaḥ pañcāṇurūpāya rajorūpāya te namaḥ | namo dhūlīsvarūpāya namaste kaṃkarātmane ||23|| namo grāvasvarūpāya namaste piṇḍanāmine | namaḥ piṇḍāḍhyabījāya namo’vyaktāṃkurātmane |||24|| namaḥ patrasvarūpāya namaḥ kāṇḍādirūpiṇe | namaḥ śākhapraśākhāya namaḥ stambādihetave |||5|| namo nālāya puṣpāya namo rasaphalātmane | namaḥ kaṇasvarūpāya namaḥ piṣṭarasātmane ||26|| namo’pākajarūpāya pakvarūpāya te namaḥ | namo bhakṣyabhojyalehyacośyarūpāya te namaḥ || 27|| namo miśrasvarūpāya nama oṣadhirūpiṇe | namaḥ kvāthādirūpāya namaścūrṇādirūpiṇe ||28|| namo recakamātrāya namo bhasmādivedine | nama āyuḥpradātre te nama oṣadhiśaktaye ||29|| namaste parameśāna kṣemakuśalakīrtaye | bhoktre bhogyapradānāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ || 1.78.30 || devadeva śarīrāṇāṃ dhātā tvaṃ poṣako’vitā | yuge’smin kalpanāsiddhirlayaṃ prayāti dehinām || 31 || saṃkalpitaṃ na cāyāti nopatiṣṭhati nekṣyate | tasmādvṛttikaraṃ dhānyaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalādikam |||32||| kaṇaṃ mūlaṃ tathā stambaṃ tṛṇaṃ sasyaṃ payobhṛtam | ṣaḍrasaṃ madhuraṃ snigdhaṃ pathyaṃ vai sarvadehinām ||3 3 || mṛgayitvā saṃviśuddhya miśrayitvā mahauṣadhīn | bhojyaṃ cāpyauṣadhaṃ lokān prabodhayitumarhasi ||34|| na kaścit tvāmṛte cāsya prodbhidvargasya bodhakaḥ | vijñātāpi bhavennaiva yaḥ sarvaśaḥ sa sarvavit ||35|| kāryakāraṇavijñātā yasya jñānamayaṃ tapaḥ | tasmād rasāyanaṃ sarvaṃ yadbhojyaṃ peyameva vā ||36|| yallehyaṃ mṛdyamāghreyamāsevyaṃ śāntidaṃ bhavet | āsvādanīyamābandhyaṃ tatsarvaṃ kartumarhasi ||37|| yattapyaṃ yacca vai kvathyaṃ yadbhṛjyaṃ cūrṇyameva yat | yanmiśryaṃ yatsārarūpaṃ tatsarvaṃ kartumarhasi ||38|| ityevamarthito viṣṇurmerostu śikhare svakām | kuṭīṃ cakre nivāsaṃ ca tasyāmevākarotprabhuḥ ||39|| devarṣimunipitṛbhyo mānavādibhya eva ca | dattāstu mārgaṇaṃ kṛtvā kṛṣyoṣadhaya ityatha ||1.78.40 || karṣukāstāḥ sasyarūpā vardhayāmāsurutsukāḥ | tābhyo vividhadeśeṣu vividhānnāni jajñire ||41 || tāḥ kṛṣivṛttayo jātā udyānāni ca bhūriśaḥ | athāpi prāṇināṃ tābhirvanauṣadhibhirapyayam |||42|| balalābhāya bhagavān āyurvedaṃ lilekha vai | tādṛśāḥ saṃprayogāśca vyāptā dhanvantarikṛtāḥ |||43|| rasāyanādiśālāśca kṛtā merau bahuprathāḥ | yatrauṣadhaṃ trikālīyaṃ jñātavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||44|| kartavyaṃ miśraṇaṃ yatrauṣadhīnāṃ nāvaśiṣyate | iti tu prathame caturyuge tvevābhavaddhariḥ ||45||| svayaṃ dhanvantarirdivyaḥ prabhurbrahmāṇḍarakṣakaḥ | athāpi kalimāpannā lokāstu bahuduḥkhitāḥ ||46|| tadā vai bhagavān sākṣādavatarītumicchati | sa vai dvitīyarūpeṇa dhanvantarirbabhūva ha ||47|| vaṃśaparamparājanmā kāśyāṃ so’bhūd bhiṣagvaraḥ | śṛṇu tāṃ ca kathāṃ lakṣmi kasmin vaṃśe babhūva saḥ ||48|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ādyasatyugīyadhanvantariprādurbhāvakathanādināmāṣṭasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||78||
<1.79> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putro’triṛṣirlokaviśrutaḥ | kāṣṭhavadūrdhvabāhuḥ sam̐stapaścacāra duścaram || 1 || trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi divyāni vigatāni vai | tasyānimiṣanetrābhyāṃ tapastejomayaṃ jalam || 2 || susrāva dyotayandaśa diśaḥ kāntyā sudugdhayā | taṃ tu jalātmakaṃ garbhaṃ diśo vidhyājñayā daśa || 2 || daghustathāpyaśaktāstaddhāraṇe’to jalaṃ hi tat | ghanībhūtaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ śītahimasugolakam || 4 || patitaṃ vai pṛthivyāṃ tat samādāya tu padmajaḥ | rathamāropayāmāsa lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 5 || tuṣṭuvurbrahmaṇaḥ putrāḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ | bhṛguraṃgirā marīcirvaśiṣṭhāśceti mānasāḥ || 6 || ṛgbhiryajubhirbahubhiratharvāṃgirasairapi | evaṃ vivardhamānasya tejaḥ somasya bṛṃhitam || 7 || ārdrīkurvacca lokām̐strīnsarvatra puṣṭimādadhat | śuklaṃ śītaṃ ca tejastatpṛthivīmanvapadyata || 8 || oṣadhyastāḥ samudbhūtāstejasā poṣaṇaṃ gatāḥ | brahmaṇāpi ratho vājisahasasahitaḥ śubhaḥ || 9 || somāyārpita eveti tena proccarite divi | evaṃ poṣṭābhavad devo jagataḥ sarvadehinām || 1.79.10 || tapastepe punaścandraḥ padmānāṃ daśatīrdaśa | hiraṇyavarṇā lakṣmyastu dhārayantyātmanā jagat || 1 1|| vibhustāsāṃ dharaḥ somo babhāra tāḥ svatejasā | tatastasmai dadau rājyaṃ brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥ ||12|| bījauṣadhiṣu sarvāsu cāpsu vipreṣu rātriṣu | sa tatprāpya mahadrājyaṃ somaḥ somavatāṃ prabhuḥ || 13|| yajñaṃ cakre rājasūyaṃ sahasraśatadakṣiṇam | hiraṇyagarbhaścodgātā brahmā brahmatvamāptavān || 14|| sadasyastatra bhagavān harirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam | sanatkumārapramukhairādyairbrahmarṣibhirvṛtaḥ ||15|| dakṣiṇāyāṃ trilokānvai somo’rpayantu sarvathā | taṃ sinī ca kuhūścaiva vapuḥ puṣṭiḥ prabhā vasuḥ || 16|| kīrtirdyutiśca lakṣmīśca nava devyaḥ siṣevire | prāpyāvabhṛthamavyagraḥ sarvadevarṣipūjitaḥ || 17|| atirājātirājendraḥ prāpyaiśvaryaṃ tu garvitaḥ | patnīṃ bṛhaspatestārānāmnīṃ jahāra kāmataḥ || 18|| sa yācyamāno devaiśca devarṣibhiśca vai punaḥ | naiva vyasarjayattārāṃ bṛhaspataya ityata || 19|| śukro bṛhaspaterdveṣādagrahītsāsuroḍupam | haro gurusutaṃ snehātsarvabhūtagaṇāvṛtaḥ ||1.79.20 || sarvadevaguṇopeto mahendro gurumanvayāt | jagrāha tena rudro’pi svīyamājagavaṃ dhanuḥ |||1 || surāsuravināśo’bhūtsarveṣāṃ kadanaṃ mahat | saṃjātaṃ ca tadā daivāstuṣitānāmakāśca vai |||2|| brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmurādidevaṃ pitāmaham | tato nivāryośanasaṃ rudraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ ca śaṃkaram |||23|| dadau bṛhaspataye tu tārāṃ svayaṃ pitāmahaḥ | antarvatnīṃ ca tāṃ tārāṃ dṛṣṭvā prāha bṛhaspatiḥ |||24|| tāre candramaso garbhaṃ samutsṛjya tvimaṃ bahiḥ | tārā nāvasṛjattaṃ tu kumāraṃ dasyuhantamam |||25|| tadā bṛhaspatirgarbhākarṣaṇaṃ tvakarotsvayam | jātamātraḥ sacetāḥ sa devebhyo’pyatibhāsvaraḥ ||26||| abhāt sa rūpavān sarvadevādhidevasadṛśaḥ | taṃ vilokya bṛhaspatirlulobha putrake nave |||27|| mamāyamiti jagrāha putraḥ prāha na te’smyaham | ahaṃ candramasaḥ putro mā māṃ spṛśa bṛhaspate |||28|| tadānīṃ brahmaṇā putraḥ somāyaiva samarpitaḥ | budha ityakaronnāma tasya putrasya candramāḥ ||29|| budhasyelākhyapatnyāṃ tu putraḥ pururavā hyabhūt | tasya rūpaguṇaudāryaśīlaujaskaparākramān ||1.79.30|| nāradenendrabhavane gīyamānānmahāguṇān | śrutvaurvaśī manaścakre purūravasamīkṣitum |||3 1|| mitrāvaruṇau tatrāstāṃ gāyakau tu tayā saha | ūrvaśyā tu manastatra mānuṣe saṃgataṃ param ||32|| jñātvā tu mitrāvaruṇau prāhaturūrvaśīṃ priyām | devau vihāya mānuṣye svairiṇyāścalate manaḥ ||33|| tasmātsvargādadho gaccha nareṇa saṃgatā bhava | evaṃ śāpāttu drāgeva svargādūrvaśyadhogatā |||34||| bhūmau tu mārgayāmāsa purūravasameva sā | kokilālāpamadhuravīṇayopavane jagau ||35|| tādṛśīmūrvaśīṃ tatra rājā purūravastadā | uvāca sundarīṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāryā mama bhaveti ca |||36||| sāpi tatra sakāmāsīt tatastaṃ pratyabhāṣata | bhavatvevaṃ mahārāja samayaṃ yadi me bhavān ||37|| karotu cennivasāmi karomītyabravīnnṛpaḥ | ūrvaśī prāha meṣau dvau putrabhūtau matau mama ||38|| yāvad rakṣiṣyasi rājam̐stāvadvatsyāmi te gṛhe | na nagno dṛśyase rājan kāmādanyatra vai kṣaṇe |||39|| nocchiṣṭaṃ me yāvad dadyāstāvadvatsyāmi te’ntike | atsyāmi ghṛtamātraṃ vai ramiṣye ca tvayā saha ||1.79.40|| evamastviti rājoktvā jagṛhe tatkaraṃ varam | vimāne tāṃ samāropyālakāyāṃ tu himālaye ||41|| vane caitrarathe pṛthvyāṃ saritsu ca sarassu ca | antarīkṣe ca merau ca mānase’pi sarovare |||42|| kamalānāṃ vane kundavane ca raivatācale | sarasvatītaṭe tadvad reme vardhitarāgataḥ ||43|| ekaṣaṣṭiṃ sa varṣāṇi ramamāṇāṃ hyaraṃjayat | sāpi svargaṃ tu vismṛtya tasminneva spṛhāvatī ||44|| nāmanyata devalokaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ ca taṃ vinā | atha viśvāvasunāmā gandharvastāṃ vinākulaḥ |||45|| tāmānetuṃ svargalokādbhūrlokamagamat kṣaṇāt | ūrvaśyā saha rājñastu kṛtaṃ vāksamayaṃ tataḥ ||46|| viditvā saha gandharvaiḥ saṃyutaśca niśāntare | ūrvaśyāḥ śayanābhyāśājjahāroraṇakaṃ javāt ||47|| ūrvaśyāhoraṇaḥ kena gṛhyate tyajyatāmayam | purūravāstadā śrutvā vastrahīno vicārya vai ||48|| māṃ na nagnaṃ nirīkṣeta devīti na yayau tadā | jahārānyaṃ tu tanmeṣaṃ vilalāporvaśī tadā ||49|| anāthāyā mama bālau gṛhyete taskarairaho | nāsti me rakṣakaḥ kaścit kaṃ yāmi śaraṇaṃ naram ||1.79.50|| amarṣavaśamāpannaṃ śrutvā tadvacanaṃ nṛpaḥ | khaḍgamādāya nirvastro nagno’dhāvattamomaye ||51|| ko duṣṭo harate meṣaṃ kuto yāsi sthiro bhava | santiṣṭha matpriyāmeṣāvādāya naiva jīvasi |||52|| tāvadvidyullatā dīptā gandhavairjanitā bhṛśam | tatprakāśaistadā devī rājānaṃ vigatāmbaram |||53|| dṛṣṭvā samāptasamayā tadgṛhātsā viniryayau | tyaktvā meṣau ca gandharvaścitraratho’pi niryayau ||54|| rājā meṣau samādāyāgamatsvaśayanāntikam | ūrvaśīṃ tatra nālokya babhrāmonmattavadbhuvi ||55|| mārgayannūrvaśīṃ bhūmau kurukṣetramavāpa ha | ramye sarovare tatra kamalaiḥ sarvatovṛte ||56|| caturbhirapsaraḥstrībhiḥ krīḍamānāṃ vilokya saḥ | he jāye kvāgatā cātra snānārthaṃ māṃ vihāya vai ||27|| āgaccha madgṛhaṃ tvehi ramasvāti mayā saha | tvāṃ vinā naiva jīveyaṃ priye kasmādihāgatā |||28|| ityevaṃ lapamānaṃ taṃ provācorvaśikā ṛtam | rājarājālametena cāgraheṇa tava priya ||99|| tvattogarbhiṇyahaṃ varte ratiṃ naiva karomyaham | varṣapūrvaṃ bhavānatra cāyātu putralabdhaye ||1.79.60|| putrajanmottaramekāṃ rātriṃ vatsyāmi vai tvayā | ityukto nṛpatiḥ prāyāt rājadhānīṃ sacintanaḥ ||6 1 || ūrvaśī varṇayāmāsa patiṃ kṣmeśaṃ susadguṇam | uṣitāsmi sahānena rājñā kāmavaśā ciram ||62|| śrutvā tadūrvaśīsakhyaḥ sādhu sādhviti cābruvan | prāhuḥ sarvā vayamapi raṃsyāmo’nena bhūbhṛtā |||63|| athābde tatra rājāpi yayau taṭākasannidhau | ūrvaśīṃ putrayuktāṃ vai dṛṣṭvātiharṣamāpa saḥ |||64|| āyuṣākhyaṃ suputraṃ sā dadau tasmai yathā punaḥ | sakāmā tena sākaṃ tāṃ rātrimekāṃ nināya vai |||62|| pañcaputrapradaṃ garbhaṃ dadhārovāca taṃ punaḥ | gandharvebhyo varān rājan gṛhāṇa manasi sthitān ||66|| tāvattatrāpi gandharvā dṛṣṭā rājñātha cāha tān | ahaṃ sampūrṇakośaśca vijitārātimaṇḍalaḥ ||67|| ūrvaśyā saha vāsena kālaṃ netuṃ sadā vṛṇe | gandharvāstatsamākarṇya svargārohaṇakāriṇīm ||68|| agnisthālīṃ striyaṃ rājñe daduḥ procurnṛpaṃ tadā | agniṃ tredhā vibhajya tvaṃ yajñaṃ kurvanayā saha ||69|| tena tvamūrvaśīlokaṃ prāpsyasī nātra saṃśayaḥ | agnisthālīṃ gṛhītvātha rājā tasmin vane’nayā ||1.79.70|| agnisthālyā striyā sākaṃ reme tṛptamanā alam | atha stryagre tu yat pātraṃ sthālīrūpaṃ tadābhavat ||71 || rājā cikṣepa tatpātraṃ vane vyarthaṃ viditya hi | tāvat sā strīragnivarṇā tūrṇamadṛśyatāṃ gatā |||75|| pātraṃ cāpi tadādṛśyaṃ jātaṃ tadavamānataḥ | rājā nirāśatāṃ prāptaścāyayau nijamandiram |||73|| kintu kāmapravegena cintayāmāsa tanmuhuḥ | aho nārī gatā pātraṃ gataṃ kṣiptaṃ vane mayā ||74|| ūrvaśīlokasaṃprāptyai gandharveṇārpitaṃ hi me | tadāhariṣye tatpātraṃ vicāryetthaṃ vanaṃ yayau ||751|| gatvā hyārādhanāṃ cakre’gnisthālīpātrayormuhuḥ | tāvattatrāgnisthālī sā vṛkṣarūpeṇa codgatā ||76|| agninārī śamīrūpā pātraṃ sthālī tu pippalaḥ | śamīṃ ca pippalaṃ rājā gṛhītvā gṛhamāyayau ||77|| tayorviśvāsamāpannaścorvaśīlabdhidāvimau | yadvā nārī tathā sthālī punaḥ syātāmimāviti ||78|| gṛhe rājā saṃpratarkya nirmamanthobhayaṃ saha | adho’raṇīṃ śamīṃ cakre pippalaṃ cottarāraṇīm ||79|| gāyavyakṣarasaṃkhyākāṃgulamānāraṇīdvayāt | nirmathanāt samutpannaṃ tatrāgnitrayameva tat ||1.79.80|| juhāvāgnitrayaṃ rājā yajñe corvaśikāptaye | yajñeṣvagniḥ prasanno’bhūdvimānaṃ cānayat divaḥ ||8 1 || tenaiva divyayānena yajñapuṇyapratāpataḥ | ūrvaśīlokamāsādya reme rājā tayā saha |||82|| athendrasya sabhāyāṃ tu nṛtyaṃ surāṃganākṛtam | rājā vyalokayat tatrorvaśīnṛtyaṃ muhuḥ kṛtam ||8 3 || nṛtyābhinayasāmarthyagarvayuktorvaśī tadā | purūravasaṃ sānnidhye jahāsātīva modataḥ ||84|| rājā prasannatāṃ prāpto jahāsāpi nijāṃ puraḥ | nāṭyācāryastumburustau vilokya krodhamāpa vai ||85|| asaṃkhyadevasadasi nṛtye vai hasanaṃ vṛthā | tasmāttu yuvayostāvadviyogo bhavatu drutam ||86|| evaṃ śaptau tadendraṃ tau jagmatuḥ śaraṇ tataḥ | indraḥ prāha dayāṃ kṛtvā pṛthvyāṃ vai gandhamādane ||87|| parvate tu yuvāṃ gatvā tīrthe sādhyāmṛtābhidhe | susnān kurutaṃ tena śāpamokṣo bhaviṣyati ||88|| sadā yogaśca yuvayoḥ susampanno bhaviṣyati | ityevaṃ kṛtavannau tau tato diviṃ vimānagau ||89|| remāte pañcaputrāśca tayorāsan mahābalāḥ | eko jyeṣṭhatamastvāyurmilitvā ṣaṭ suputrakāḥ || 1.79.90 || gandharvaloke viditāḥ āyuḥ dhīmān amāvasuḥ | viśvāyuśca śatāyuśca gatāyuścorvaśīsutāḥ ||9 1|| rājy cakruḥ prayāge te pratiṣṭhāne subhūtale | tadvśe’bhūddhanvantarirbhagavāṃstaṃ vadāmyatha ||92|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne atreḥ somastasya bṛhaspatipatnītārāyāṃ budhotpattistasya purūravāstasyorvaśyapsarāyāṃ ṣaṭ putrā ityādipradarśananāmā ekonāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||79||
<1.80> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca yaḥ purūravasaḥ putra āyustasyābhavan sutāḥ | pañcādyastatra nahuṣaḥ kṣatravṛddho dvitīyakaḥ || 1 || rajastatra tṛtīyastu caturtho raṃbhanāmakaḥ | pañcamastvanenā vai pitṛtulyaparākramāḥ || 2 || kṣatravṛddhasya caiko vai sutahotro’bhavat sutaḥ | sutahotrasya dāyādāstrayaḥ paramadhārmikāḥ || 3 || kāśyaḥ kuśo gṛtsamado gṛtsamadasya vai sutaḥ | śunakastasya sutaḥ śaunakākhyastasya vai sutāḥ || 4 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścaivābhavan śubhāḥ | kuśātmajo hyārṣṭiṣeṇaścarantastasya cātmajaḥ || 5 || śaunakāścārṣṭiṣeṇāśca kṣatropetā dvijātayaḥ | kāśyasya kāśistatputro rāṣṭro dīrghatapāstataḥ || 6 || dīrghatapaso bhagavān dhanvantariḥ sutaḥ prabhuḥ | so’yaṃ kāśīpurīrājo hyāyurvedapravartakaḥ || 7 || yasya nāma smarejjantustasya rogo vinaśyati | dvitīyo’yaṃ dhanvantariḥ parameśvara eva ha || 8 || prāk tu jātaḥ samudre tu mathyamāne’mṛtārthadhṛk | sa provāca tadā nārāyaṇaṃ putro’smi te prabho || 9 || vidhatsva bhāgaṃ sthānaṃ ca mama loke’tra me pitaḥ | śrīhariḥ prāha taṃ putraṃ dhanvantariṃ samudrajam || 1.80.10 || kṛto yajñavibhāgastu yajñiyairhi suraistathā | vedeṣu vidhiyuktaṃ ca vidhihotraṃ maharṣibhiḥ || 11 || na śakyastu tvayā homaḥ kartuṃ tattulya eva ha | arvāk suto’si he deva nāmamantro’si vai prabho || 1 2|| tasmādidānīṃ te bhāgo naiva yajñe bhaviṣyati | kintu dvitīye tvaṃ tatra janmani khyātimeṣyasi || 1 3||| aṇimādiyutā siddhirgarbhasthasya bhaviṣyati | tenaiva ca śarīreṇa devatvaṃ prāpsyasi dhruvam || 14|| carumantrairghṛtairgandhairyakṣyanti tvāṃ dvijātayaḥ | atha ca tvaṃ punaścaiva āyurvedaṃ vidhāsyasi || 11|| avaśyaṃbhāvi hyartho’yaṃ prathamastvaṃ tu mānasaḥ | samudrajo dvitīyo vai kāśīrājastṛtīyakaḥ || 16|| ityevaṃ trividhaṃ dhanvantareḥ prākaṭyamasti vai | dvāpare tatra samprāpte putrārthaṃ tapa ācaran || 17|| dīrghatapā vyapaśyadvai bhagavantaṃ hariṃ puraḥ | prasannāsyaṃ praśāntaṃ ca kiṃciddātuṃ samāgatam || 18|| jagād bhagavān dīrghatapasaṃ vṛṇu cepsitam | dārghatapāstadovāca prāṃjalirvinayānvitaḥ || 19|| bhagavān yadi tuṣṭastvaṃ putro me dhṛtimān bhava | tatheti samanujñāya prabhurantaradhīyata |||1.80.2 0 || tasya dehāt samutpanno lakṣmi dhanvantarirhariḥ | kāśīrājo mahārājaḥ sarvarogapraṇāśakaḥ ||21 || dhanuścihnakaro devo bhagavān lokarakṣakaḥ | poṣakaḥ sarvavastūnāṃ jñānado mokṣadastathā || 22|| āyurvedaṃ sa vai devaścakāra sabhiṣakkriyam | tamaṣṭadhā punarvyasya śiṣyebhyaḥ pratyapādayat ||23|| dhanvantarisutaścāsīt ketumān sumahāyaśāḥ | ketumato bhīmaratho divodāsāparābhidhaḥ ||24|| divodāso mahānāsīd bhakto viṣṇusamo balī | prajāyāṃ vardhitā tena harerbhaktistu sarvathā || 25|| sthito’pi bhagavān śaṃbhurmandaraṃ cārukandaram | kāśīṃ vinā sukhaṃ nāpa divodāsanṛpoṣitām |||26|| bhagavān śaṃkaro devo vaiṣṇavo’styeva sarvathā | nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃbrahma bhajatyeva samādhinā || 27|| divodāso’pi tu tadvatparamo vaiṣṇavo mataḥ | niṣkāsayitvā taṃ bhaktaṃ vāsamaicchattu śaṃkaraḥ || 28|| śrīśvetavyāsa uvāca suśikhaivaṃ śaṃkarasya kathāyogaṃ praśāntidam | divodāsasya bhaktasya cāpi śrutvā drutaṃ tadā ||29||| lakṣmīḥ papraccha cākarṇya divodāsaṃ trilocanaḥ | kāśīṃ saṃtyājayāmāsa kathaṃ tatrāgamat nagāt || 1.80.3 0|| kiṃ kṛtaṃ tena devena divodāso yadatyagāt | kāśīṃ tu rājadhānīṃ svāṃ śrotumicchāmi mādhava || 31 || hāṭakāṃgad ityevaṃ lakṣmīḥ pṛṣṭvā patiṃ prabhum | ekāgramānasābhūt tāṃ nārāyaṇa uvāca ha ||32 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dhanvantaryavatāratrayakathananāmāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 80 ||
<1.81> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pavitrāṃ tāṃ kathāṃ bhaktacamatkarām | divodāso mama bhaktastato’pi bhūtarāṭ svayam || 1 || paramo mama bhakto vai tiṣṭhatī mandare girau | mandareṇa tapastaptaṃ ghoraṃ paramadāruṇam || 2 || tapasātiprasanno vai mahādevo jagatpatiḥ | mandaraṃ prāha bhūbhṛt te hṛdye kiṃ nu vidyate || 3 || prasanno’smi mahādevo vṛṇu sveṣṭaṃ vadāmyaham | mandaraḥ prāha deveśa tava vāsaṃ vṛṇomyaham || 4 || tava vāsena me kāyaḥ pavitraḥ saṃbhaviṣyati | tīrthamaurdhanyamāpanno mānyatāṃ saṃvrajiṣyati || 5 || sarve devarṣimunayo bhavaddarśanamāgatāḥ | svapādajaladānena pāvayiṣyanti māṃ sadā || 6 || ityabhyarthanamāsādya śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ | uvāsa mandaragirau tadā sarve divaukasaḥ || 7 || ṛṣayo munayaścātha yakṣarākṣasapārṣadāḥ | sarve’pi mandaravāsaṃ cakruḥ śaṃbhusamāśrayāḥ || 8 || kāśyāṃ pūrve ca ye hyāsan skandaviṣṇugaṇādhipāḥ | sūryo devyastathā cānye tyaktvā kāśīṃ giriṃ gatāḥ || 9 || gateṣu devasaṃgheṣu divodāsaḥ pratāpavān | cakāra rājyaṃ nirdvandvaṃ prabhorbhaktibharaṃ śubham || 1.81.10 || rājadhānī kṛtā rājñā vārāṇasī suniścalā | vardhayāmāsa bhaktyā tāṃ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan || 1 1|| kāśīvāsāstu ye devāḥ svargiṇaḥ sāpsarogaṇāḥ | saṃyamena tu hīnām̐stān divodāso vyavāsayat ||12|| dharmahīnairvratahīnaiḥ saṃyamena tu varjitaiḥ | mama kāśyāṃ na vai stheyaṃ devairanyairapi dhruvam || 1 3|| bhagavadbhaktihīnaiśca viśeṣeṇa na vai kṣaṇam | sthātavyaṃ ceti rājā vai devādīn nirakāsayan ||14|| sūryavat sa pratapitā durhṛdāṃ hṛdi netrayoḥ | candravat suhṛdāmāsīt hṛdi manasi netrayoḥ || 15|| śatrugaṇāḥ palāyante dṛṣṭvā taṃ tu dhanurdharam | dharmādharmavivektā sa dharmarāja ivāparaḥ || 16|| indra iva balī caiva pāśīva vairipāśakṛt | kuberaiva dhanavān prāṇa iva prajāgrahaḥ || 17|| rājarājaḥ sa evāsīd rudra iva ripuñjayaḥ | viśvadevasamo rūpe hyasādhyo vasunādhikaḥ || 18|| dasrato rūpamāpanno marutāmapi rodakaḥ | sarvavidyādharo gītikuśalo lokatoṣaṇaḥ || 19|| yakṣarākṣasanāgāśca dānavāstaṃ siṣevire | guhyakā guptadāsāstu yasya karmakarāḥ saṭā ||1.81.20 || pavano yasya cāśvānvai parāṃ gatimaśikṣayan | dāninastu gajā yasya dānamanyānaśikṣayan ||21|| sabhāyāṃ yasya boddhāro yoddhāraśca raṇājire | śāstrairyasya vijetā na na śastraiḥ kenacit kvacit ||22|| rājye yasya na vai dveṣyāḥ prajāḥ sukhamayāśayāḥ | kalāvāneka evāsījjanāḥ sarve kalālayāḥ ||23|| na ko’pyāsīd gotrabhit tadrājye sva eva gotrabhit | nāsīt kopi kṣayī tasya rājye svarge kṣayī śaśī ||24|| na tadrājye’vagraho’bhūd grahāstu nava vai diti | hiraṇyagarbho divyeko hyasya sarve hiraṇmayāḥ ||25|| svarge saptāśva eko’styasya janā bahuvājinaḥ | svargāpsarogaṇaśreṣṭhā viṣaye’syāpsarāḥ sadā ||26||| ekaiva padmā vaikuṃṭhe’sya vai padmākarāḥ śatam | iti duḥkhāni naivāsya nāsannupadravāḥ kvacit ||27|| vasudhā vasudā sarvā dhanahāstu gṛhe gṛhe | evaṃ sukhayato rājyaprajā rājño’yutāṣṭakam |||28|| śaradāṃ tu gataprāyaṃ tadā śaṃbhurmano dadhe | vārāṇasyāṃ nivāsāya pratīkāraṃ cikīrṣati ||29|| devā bṛhaspatiṃ prāpya tena cakruśca mantraṇām | vayaṃ bhavadyutāḥ syāmo vipatkartāra eva ha ||1.81.30|| yadyapi bhūbhṛtā tena devā yajñaiḥ sumānitāḥ | tathāpi mānavā naiva mitrāṇi vastuto matāḥ ||3 1|| yadyapi tena cāsmākaṃ nāpakṛtyaṃ vidhīyate | tathāpi dyusadāṃ rītiḥ parotkarṣāsahiṣṇutā ||32|| divodāsagṛhe rājye nālpo’pyadharmasaṃgrahaḥ | nāsya parābhavo rājñaḥ kartuṃ kenāpi śakyate |||33|| ekapatnīvratāḥ sarve narāstasya ca maṇḍale | pātivratyaparā nāryo vidyante cāsya maṇḍale ||34|| tadrājye’vidyavipro na nāvīro bāhujastathā | nānudyogo’pi vaiśyo’sti nāsevākṛt tu śūdrakaḥ ||35|| nāsya rājye brahmacāryabrahmavrataparāyaṇaḥ | nāpyasatkārakṛdasya gārhasthyamapi maṇḍale ||36|| nāpyavanyavṛttikarā vānaprasthāśca niḥspṛhāḥ | na cāsaṃgavihīnāstu sanyāsapathagāminaḥ |||37|| evamanye’pi tadrājye nāvartmagatikā vṛthā | nānapatyo na cābhakto nādravyaḥ ko’pi tadbhuvi ||38|| nāvṛddhasevī nākāṇḍamṛtirnādrohaketaraḥ | na cāṭā naiva vācāṭā na śaṭhā vaṃcakā nahi ||39|| na pākhaṇḍā na vai bhaṇḍā na raṇḍā na ca śauṇḍikāḥ | tasya rājye tu sarvatra śrutiśāstrādisevanam ||1.81.40|| sarvatra śubhakṛdvāṇī madyamāṃsādihīnatā | na dyūtadyotakāstatra ṛṇino na na taskarāḥ ||41|| pitṛdevādipūjāpi na vicchinnā kadācana | na tadrājye vratalopo nātīrthasevanaṃ tathā ||42|| patipatnyoḥ sadā snehaḥ kuṭumbaṃ kleśakṛnnahi | vandyante vandakairvandyāḥ pūjyante pūjakaiḥ parāḥ ||43|| ādriyante tu vidvāṃsaḥ prajābhistatra sarvadā | vidvadbhiśca tapaḥśreṣṭhāstāpasaiśca jitānnarāḥ ||44|| jitāntarairjñānadhanā jñānibhirbrahmavijjanāḥ | brahmavidbhiḥ sarvatattvamīkṣyate brahmarūpakam ||45|| viprasādhuprasādhvīnāṃ mukhe devānnamarpyate | vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ jalānyāpūravanti ca ||46|| meghā mehanta aiśānyā sasyavastrā mahī sadā | hṛṣṭapuṣṭāḥ prajāstasya śucayo’pyubhaye sadā ||47|| mārgayanto’pi chidraṃ tadrājye devā manāgapi | nāpnuvannatha devām̐stān bṛhaspatiruvāca vai ||48|| parābhavo vinā chidraṃ naiva bhāvīti sarvathā | upāyaṃ bhedamādāyāchidro’pi paribhūyate ||49|| asmatpakṣā api tatra bhavanti sukhasampadaḥ | tathāpi bhedakārye tu sāhāyyāḥ syuratanmatāḥ ||1.81.50 || iti nirṇayamāsādya tadāsyāntarbahiścarān | vijñāpya dyusadaḥ sarve cāgnidevaṃ vavandire ||51 || indro’pyagniṃ tadā prāha tvaṃ kāśyāṃ saṃpratiṣṭhitaḥ | mūrtirūpo bhavām̐statra rājate viṣayāt tataḥ ||52|| tāmupāsaṃhara kṣipramevaṃ syādvijayastu naḥ | mūrtiśūnye yājakāstu havyakavyādivarjitāḥ ||53|| viraṃkṣyante nṛpe tatra prajā apyarthaśūnyatām | rājaśabdasya cālokya rūḍhiśaktivihīnatām ||54|| prajāstatra viraktāḥ syuḥ kṣīṇaṃ kośabalaṃ bhavet | rājāpi kṣīṇavṛttiḥ syāt trivargaḥ kṣīyate svayam ||55|| divodāsastathā kṣīṇo naśyatyathavā yāsyati | tena cāsmākamevātra kāśyāṃ vāso hyakaṇṭakaḥ |||56|| atiśayākhyadoṣādyasaṃbhinna eva saṃbhavet | ityagnirindrakathitamupāgamya hṛdi smaran ||57|| mahādevaṃ svakāṃ mūrtimājahāra sthalāt tataḥ | āhavanīyāṃ ca gārhapatyāṃ dākṣiṇakāṃ trikam ||288||| jāṭharāgniṃ cāpi tatratyaprajānāṃ jahāra saḥ | rājā prajā na vindanti prātarmadhyāhnakarmasu |||59|| kamapyagniṃ tadā sarve karmaṭhāḥ pācakāstathā | cintayāmāsurugraṃ vai kiṃ syātkṛtyaṃ vināgninā ||1.81.60 || rājā mādhyāhnikaṃ kṛtvā praviveśa mahānasam | vaiśvadevāya bhojyāya yāvadāgatya tiṣṭhati ||6 1|| āndhasikā vepamānāḥ kṣudhārtaṃ taṃ vyajijñapan | yadi viśrāvayed rājan bhavānabhayadakṣiṇām ||62||| tadā vijñāpayiṣyāmaḥ kimabhūditi tatvataḥ | rājñā tathā kṛtādeśāḥ pācakā hyūcire śanaiḥ ||63|| na jānīmo vayaṃ nātha kathamagnirapāsarat | purāt kṛśānau vigate kathaṃ pātrādi saṃbhavet ||64|| sūryapākena yatpakvaṃ tat kiṃcidānayāmahe | tāvadrājā vivedaitaddevānāṃ kṛtyameva ha ||65|| tapobalādavetyaitadvicāryāpyavadattadā | agnau gate na me hānirdevānāṃ hānireva vai ||66|| mayā tebhyo na rājyaṃ vai labdhaṃ labdhaṃ pitāmahāt | svātmabalād racayiṣye vāyumagniṃ jalaṃ bhuvam ||67|| prakāśaṃ ceti tatsarvaṃ yadyadvāpekṣyate’tra tat | sarvaṃ kariṣye caitanyājjaḍe me na prayojanam ||68|| iti cintayatastasyāyayurjānapadā janāḥ | tameva virāvaṃ kartuṃ dvāḥsthenāntaḥ praveśitāḥ ||69|| datvopadāṃ yathārhaṃ te niṣedurmānadāsane | jagadurduḥkhamatyarthaṃ vahniyātrākṛtaṃ tadā ||1.81.70 || prāha rājā tadāśrutya sarvasya sukhamāvahan | cikīrṣurahamevāsaṃ paurāḥ kāryamidaṃ purā ||71|| paraṃ hyupekṣitaprāyaṃ droho na syāditīcchayā | gato’nalo’bhavadbhadraṃ prāṇo’pi yātvito drutam ||72|| śaśī sūryo varuṇaśca bhūrākāśo’pi yāntvitaḥ | bhagavadyogaprābalyādahamagnirbhavāmyaham |||73|| caturdhā vahnirūpeṇa gṛhṇāmi pācayāmi yat | ahaṃ prāṇa svayaṃ bhūtvā jīvayiṣyāmi dehinaḥ ||74|| mahāvāyuḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā dhārayiṣyāmi golakān | śaśī cāhaṃ svayaṃ bhūtvāpyāyayiṣyeṃ’kuraṃ jagat ||75 || tāpayiṣye svayaṃ sūryo bhūtvemāṃ medinīṃ sadā | megho bhūtvā svayaṃ vṛṣṭiṃ kariṣye varuṇo’pyaham ||76|| sthāsyehaṃ jalarūpeṇa bhūrūpo’pi bhavāmi ca | dhārayiṣye jagatsarvaṃ vyomarūpo bhavāmi ca ||77|| ityuktvā sāntayitvā svaprajā rājā hyabhūt tathā | bahurūpaśca saṃbhūya tattatkāryāṇyavartayat ||78|| bhagavallabdhayogena hyekopyanekaśo’bhavat | tadā divaukasāṃ rājā śalyarūpo babhūva ha ||79|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃkarasya mandaragirau varadānakṛtāvāsaḥ kāśīto devā api tatra gatāḥ divodāsarājye guṇavarṇanaṃ kāśīto divodāsasya niṣkāsanopāyaracanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||8 1||
<1.82> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mahādevo mandarācalamandire | sukhaṃ nāpa kāśyayogātsarvathopaskarānvite || 1 || sukhadomandarastasya sukhamāndyakaro’bhavat | lepārthaṃ candanaṃ tasya pāṃsulendhanamābhavat || 2 || kaṃkaṇāni mṛṇālāni kaṃkarāṇyabhavam̐stadā | bhāla candro’bhavattasya virahānalacandrakaḥ || 3 || kāśīviyogamūrdhanyatāpaśāntikṛte’munā | jaṭāghaṭṭadhṛtā gaṃgā na tyaktā rakṣitā balāt || 4 || devaiścāpi na vidito virahāgnivadīśvaraḥ | dhyānamagno yathāpūrvamāste mandarabhūbhṛti || 5 || hyeṣaiva līlā devasya svamūrtyā tapyate prabhuḥ | aṣṭamūrtiḥ svayaṃ yo vai tāpayatyakhilaṃ jagat || 6 || viṣaṃ hālāhalaṃ kaṇṭhagataṃ no tāpayatyamum | kāśīvirahatāpastaṃ tāpayatyativardhitaḥ || 7 || api śītalacandrakāntajā nanu mālā vidhṛtā tu vakṣasi | virahānnavakāśikākṛtād ravikāntabhramamāvahatyasau || 8 || yadapāṃgavimokṣaṇodbhavādanalālūlokasukhāvaho’pyayam | nanu mānasabhūśca bhasmasādabhavatso’pyanalena tapyate || 9 || śrutimārgamabhidruto’pi yo nijabhaktāntarasaukhyasaṃpradaḥ | sa hi śāntarayo viyogajānalatapto bhavatīti vaiśasam || 1.82.10 || api kāśisugaṃgajānkaṇānabhisaṃgṛhya samāgato’nilaḥ | spṛśate yadi māṃ viyoginaṃ parisaukhyaṃ mama jāyate tadā || 11 || api kāśisurathyagaṃ rajo yadi cāyātyanilena vāhinā | tadapi prabhu syādviyogajaṃ hyasukhaṃ vārayituṃ balādalam || 1 2|| ityevaṃ śokasaṃmagnaṃ śaṃkaraṃ vīkṣya pārvatī | patidevaṃ namaskṛtya prāha cāntarakhedahṛt || 1 3|| kathaṃ deva mahādeva jagatāṃ nātha ceśvara | hṛdi santapyase lokasantāpahara śaṃkara || 14|| vāmā vāmasvarūpā te saṃsthitāsmi tavārcane | tāpahārāya me nātha kathamuttapyase tvayā || 15|| bhūvāragnyanilākāśacandrasūryātmamūrtika | sākṣānumopamāśabdārthāpattyaitihyamānavan || 16|| anupalaṃbhāsaṃbhavaceṣṭāyogajabhānavan | kathaṃ kāśiviyogaste sarvayogin pradharṣati || 17|| sarvāntarātman sarvajña kāśavadbrahmarūpadhṛk | triśūlāgre’sti te kāśī kastāpastatkṛtastvayi || 18|| tathāpi devayogātsā divyā mokṣakarī ca pūḥ | na kāladeśavastukṛtparicchedo’tra vartate || 19|| na vivṛttiḥ pariṇāmo na dhvaṃso na mṛṣātmatā | na layo na tirobhāvastvadyogāt kāśikāśavat ||1.82.20 || divyā divyagaṇopetā divyatīrthā ca pāvanī | divyamokṣapradā kāśī gantavyā nātha sarvathā ||21|| naiva kāśīsamaṃ saukhyaṃ naiva kāśīsamā sthitiḥ | naiva kāśīsamā śāntiḥ kāśī sarvārthadāyinī ||22|| kaṃ sukhamāpyate kā sā śaṃ sukhamīyate’taḥ śī | kāśī sukhamayī tasmāt sarvasevyā bhavatyapi ||23 || kasya vai brahmaṇo vāsādasya viṣṇoḥ samāśrayāt | śasya śaṃbhornivāsācca kāśī tridevamūrtikā ||2|| kā tu sarasvatī proktā ā tu lakṣmīḥ ramā svayam | śī tu devī pārvatī vai kāśī devītrayātmikā |||25|| na mandaro na himavān nodyānāni vanāni ca | vaihāyasāni bhūgāni sukhayanti tu kāśivat ||26|| na karmadevo nādharmo na yāmyo nāpi nākajaḥ | kāśīvāsijanaṃ daṇḍayituṃ śakto bhavediha |||27|| vāsanānāṃ kṣayo yatra maraṇānna punarbhavaḥ | nivāsātkarmalepo na kadā dṛkṣye nu tāṃ vibho ||28||| purāṇi santyanekāni nagarāṇyapi vai tathā | pade pade smṛddhimanti na kāśīsadṛśāni vai ||29||| satyasthā bhūmayaḥ sarvāḥ kāśītulyā bhavanti na | yathā tvāṃ ca tathā māṃ ca bādhate kāśitāpanā ||1.82.30 || kāśī tāpaharā yādṛṅ na tādṛṅ mama janmabhūḥ | tapoyajñeṣṭapūrtyarhādānadharmavratādibhiḥ ||3 1 || na tathā prāpyate muktiḥ kāśyāṃ tu dehapātanāt | na yogasāṃkhyavedāntakarmakāṇḍātmavittibhiḥ ||32|| yathā kāśyāṃ dehapātānmuktirbhavati śāśvatī | na vedādhyayanād brahmavratādapi gatistathā ||33|| na satye cendraloke vā munīnāṃ nilaye’pi na | nātalādau tathā kvāpi sukhaṃ kāśyāṃ tu yādṛśam || 34|| manasā saṃsmṛtya kāśīṃ yogābhyāsaphalaṃ labhet | mānavātkhalu tiryaktvaṃ kāśyāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mataṃ sadā ||35||| maraṇādeva muktiḥ syājjñānajanmani kiṃ phalam | tasmād yāyāṃ yathā kāśyānandāraṇyaṃ tathā kuru || 36|| śaṃbhuruvāca deveśi jānāsi mama yadvratam | abhuktapūrvamanyena vastūpāśnāmi netarat ||37|| brahmaṇā nodito divodāso dharmeṇa tāṃ purīm | śāsti tatra kathaṃ gamyamanyaśāstari saṃsthite ||38|| divodāsaḥ purīṃ kāśīṃ tyaktvā yāyād yathā tathā | kartavyameva sammīlya tato vāsaḥ sukhāvahaḥ ||39|| adharmiṇastu vighnāni bhaveyurna tu dharmiṇaḥ | dharmasthitasya yo vighnamācaret sa vipadyate ||1.82.40 || vinā chidraṃ kathaṃ dharmayukto hyutsādyate sthalāt | na jarā na mahākālo na mṛtyurvyādhayo’śamāḥ ||4 1 || na vighnā naiva rogāśca na grahā na piśācakāḥ | netayo nāpi bhūtāni bādhante dharmasaṃgraham |||42|| tasmātkaṃ preṣayāmīśe yastaṃ vidrāvayet tataḥ | evaṃ cintayataḥ śaṃbhoryoginīmaṇḍalaṃ puraḥ ||43 || upasthitaṃ tu taccakraṃ prāha vākyamidaṃ haraḥ | satvaraṃ yāta yoginyo yatra rājātidhārmikaḥ ||44|| divodāsa iti khyātaḥ kāśyāṃ dharmeṇa śāstyayam | yathā kāśīṃ tyajecchīghraṃ tathā kuruta māyayā ||45 || ahaṃ tato navīkṛtya purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ śubhām | sannivatsyāmi tatraiva śīghraṃ sarvaṃ vidhīyatām ||46 || ityājñāṃ śirasā tāśca gṛhītvā yayurutsukāḥ | pravadantyo dhanyatamā vayaṃ devaprasāditāḥ ||47|| preṣitāścāpi kāryārthaṃ śrīmadānandakānanam | uḍḍīya mandaradroṇyā vyomni kāśyupari sthirāḥ ||48 || dadṛśurdivyasaudhāḍhyaṃ puraṃ svargamivāparam | patākābhistu mārgasthānpānthānāhvayatīva tat ||49 || śvetamaṇimahājālairnīlaṃ vyomāpi nirmalam | sarvaṃ dhavalayattejaḥpravāhaiḥ svargagāmibhiḥ ||1.82.50 || atha vyomnyeva sarvābhiḥ svarūpāṇāṃ vivartanam | vividhaṃ tu kṛtaṃ tāśca vibhinnajñānavartanāḥ |||5 1 || vibhinnaveṣā hyabhavan kāśyāṃ sthale sthale striyaḥ | avateruśca yoginyaḥ sundaryaḥ kāryasiddhaye ||52 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mandarācalaguhāyāṃ śaṃbhoḥ kāśīvirahajatāpottaraṃdivodāsasya vighnārthaṃ yoginīcakrapreṣaṇamityādikathananāmā dvyaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ |||82||
<1.83> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca paśya lakṣmi kiyadveṣā nāryo svārthārthamudyatāḥ | bahurūpāṇi kurvanti yāvatsvārthau na siddhyati || 1 || yoginītvaṃ parityajya devītvaṃ cāvaguhya ca | kācit saṃnyāsinī kācit tapasvinī tu mānavī || 2 || kācit babhūva sairandhrī kācittu bhikṣukī tathā | kācittu mālinī kācit nāpitī sūtikābhavat || 3 || kācidbhiṣagvarārohā kācit tulāsuvikrayā | kācicchākavikrayiṇī kācit sarpādirakṣikā || 4 || kācittu nartakī jātā kācid dhātrī ca kiṃkarī | aparā gāyikā jātānyā vāditrapravādinī || 5 || kācit tālakarī cānyā jātā kārmaṇamantradā | kācinmālāgumphanajñā kācittailādivikrayā || 6 || parā dyūtavidhānajñā itarā gopavallabhā | kācinnaṭī ca kācittu rathyācatvaramārjikā || 7 || anyā madhvādivyāpārā rathyācīvaramārgaṇā | apatyadāparā jātā śvapacī carmakāriṇī || 8 || sādhvī ca karṣukī dugdharasavyāpārahāriṇī | tīrthavāsinī cānyā ca muṇḍinī grāmaṭhāparā || 9 || kācid rekhācihnadraṣṭrī kācillekhanacitrikā | vaśīkaraṇamantrajñā kācij jvarapramārjikā || 1.83.1 0|| kācidaṃjanakuśalā guṭikāsiddhibodhikā | dhātvādimiśrikā kācid vāstrapattrāṇakāriṇī || 1 1|| puṃmohinī bahurūpā vāgagnistaṃbhabodhikā | adṛśyatvakhecaratvānyākāratvādimantradā || 12|| uccāṭanākarṣaṇajñā yuvacittavimohinī | cintitārthapradā jyotirvijñānyā paśurakṣikā || 12|| dantadhāvanadātrī ca gośakṛtsaṃgrahāṭinī | mṛttikāyāśca vikretrī kācittu nāgarī tathā || 14|| karmacāriṇi dāsī ca bhūtvā bhūtvā pratigṛham | prāviśam̐stāśca yoginyo’harniśaṃ vicaranti ca || 15|| vighnārthaṃ chidramalpaṃ vā mārgayantyo’pi nālabhan | tatastā etya gaṃgāyāstīre sametya niṣphalāḥ || 16|| kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ divodāse prajāsu ca | chidraṃ no labhyate kiṃcitkathaṃ dūraṃ prakurmahe || 17||| kāryasiddhiṃ vinā naiva gantavyaṃ svāminaṃ prati | saṃmantryeti tatra tasthurna gatā mandarācalam || 18|| prabhoḥ kāryamaniṣpādya preṣyaḥ ko nikaṭe bhavet | prabhuṃ vināpi kāśyāṃ vai jīviṣyāmo’tra sarvadā || 19|| prabhū ruṣṭo hared vṛttyaṃ kāśī tvarthacatuṣṭayam | tasmātkāśyāṃ pravastavyaṃ gantavyaṃ nahi mandaram ||1.83.20|| ityārabhya ca yoginyaḥ kāśyāṃ tiṣṭhanti sarvadā | caritvā dikṣu vidikṣu tiṣṭhantyāgatya tatra vai ||21|| nārāyaṇaṃ prabhajantyo divodāsaṃ namanti ca | ātmanaḥ paramaṃ lābhaṃ manyante sma ca tāḥ sadā || 22| kāśīsevākṛtātpuṇyādīśo’pyasmān sameṣyati | kāśīṃ vinā sa tatrāpi duḥkhito’trāgato bhavet |||23|| iti niścitya yoginyaḥ śaṃbhorānandakānane | atiṣṭhan saṃsmarantyastaṃ śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram |||24|| tāsāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇvatra kamalālaye | gajāsyā siṃhavaktrā ca gṛdhrāsyā kākatuṇḍikā ||25|| uṣṭrāsyāśvakharagrīvā vārāhasyā śivānanā | ulūkākṣī ghoraravā māyūrī śarabhānanā ||26|| koṭarākṣī cāṣṭavaktrā kubjā ca vikaṭānanā | śuṣkodarī lalajjihvā śvadaṃṣṭrā vānarānanā |||27|| ṛkṣākṣī kekarākṣī ca bṛhattuṇḍā surāpriyā | kapālahastā raktākṣī śukī śyenī kapotikā ||28|| pāśahastā daṇḍahastā pracaṇḍā caṇḍavikramā | śiśughnī pāśahantrī ca kālī rudhirapāyinī ||29|| vasāpānā garbhabhakṣā śavahastāntramālikā | ṛkṣakeśī mahākukṣirnāgāsyā pretapṛṣṭhakā ||1.83.30|| dandaśūkadharā krauṃcī mṛgaśṛṃgā vṛṣānanā | phāṭitāsyā dhūmaśvāsā vyomapādordhvadṛṣṭikā ||3 1|| tāpinī śoṣiṇī schaghoṇoṣṭhā koṭarī tathā | vidyullolā balākāsyā mārjārī kaṭapūtanā ||32|| aṭṭahāsyā ca kāmākṣī mṛgākṣī ceti tā matāḥ | catuḥṣaṣṭistu yoginyaḥ pūjitā navarātrake ||33|| duṣṭabādhāṃ nāśayanti garbhabālādirakṣikāḥ | na ḍākinyo na śākinyo na kūṣmāṇḍā na rākṣasāḥ ||34|| tasya pīḍāṃ prakurvanti nāmānyetāni yaḥ paṭhet | raṇe rājakule vāpi vivāde jayadānyapi ||35|| balipūjopahāraiśca dhūpadīpasamarpaṇaiḥ | kṣipraṃ prasannā yoginyo prayaccheyurmanorathān ||36||| kṛṣṇacaturdaśīrātrāvupavāsī narottamaḥ | praṇavādicaturthyantanāmabhirhavanaṃ caret ||37|| pratyekaṃ havanaṃ cāsāṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ matam | sasarpiṣā guggulunā laghubadaramānataḥ ||38|| ekāgramanasā śuddhaḥ sveṣṭaṃ vicintya sarvathā | yāṃ yāṃ siddhimabhīpsetāṃ tāṃ suprāpnoti mānavaḥ ||39|| atheśo yoginīcakre’nāgate ciramityapi | sūryaṃ saṃpreṣayāmāsa jñātuṃ kāśīpravartanam ||1.83.40 || prāha śaṃbhustu sūryaṃ vai divodāsasya vai rave | dharmakṣatyā nivāsaḥ syāttathā kuru divākara ||41 || dharmamārgasthitasyātra bhaktasya yo’vamānanam | karoti tasya sarvasvanāśo bhavati bhāskara |||42|| yāvaddharme sthirā buddhiryāvadbhaktiśca mādhave | tāvadvighnodayo nāsti tathāpi kuru ceṣṭitam ||43|| raviḥ śaṃbhorvacasā cāgamatkāśyāṃ manuṣyavat | antarbahiścarankāśyāṃ divodāse prajāsu ca ||44|| dharmabhaktipravāhe tu manāk kṣatiṃ na caikṣata | vatsaraṃ vicaransūryo’tithirbhūtvārthayacca tam ||49|| sarvaṃ saṃprāptavān paścād bahurūpāṇyadhārayat | yācako bahudo dīno gaṇako mantrado’pyabhūt ||46|| kadācinnāstiko dhūrto jaṭilaśca digambaraḥ | jāṃgaliko viṣavaidyaḥ pākhaṇḍī brahmavādyapi ||47|| vratakṛdaindrajālajñaḥ kathākāraḥ kapāladhṛk | dvijo jñānī dhātuvettā khagolajñaḥ sumantravit ||48|| sādhuḥ sanyāsadharmā vai sanyāsinīsvarūpadhṛk | vipraḥ kṣatriyavaiśyau ca śūdro brahmacaro gṛhī ||49|| vanasthaḥ saṃkararūpo’thāpi cāṇḍālarūpadhṛk | ityevaṃ vicaran kāśyāṃ kvāpi chidraṃ na cāpa saḥ ||1.83.50|| tadāhyakṛtakāryo’sau gantuṃ tu mandara punaḥ | neyeṣāvamānabhayād divodāsabalāttathā ||51|| kāśyāmeva kṛtāvāso bhaktilagnahṛdantaraḥ | anivedanajanyainonāśo bhaktyā bhaviṣyati ||52|| dharmo hi rakṣito yena sarvaṃ tena tu rakṣitam | ayameva hi saddharmaḥ kāśīsevanasaṃbhavaḥ ||53|| putramitrakalatrāṇi kṣetrāṇi ca dhanāni ca | pratijanmeha labhyante kāśyekā naiva labhyate ||54|| divodāsasamo bhakto naivānyatra kvacinmilet | tasmādatraiva vastavyaṃ niścityaivaṃ divākaraḥ |||55|| bhūtvā dvādaśarūpo’sau kāśīpuryāṃ vyavasthitaḥ | lokārka uttarārkaśca sāmbādityaḥ khakholakaḥ ||56|| drupadādityo mayūkhādityastathāruṇāhvayaḥ | vṛddhārkaḥ keśavārkaśca vimalārko yamāhvayaḥ ||57|| gaṃgādityau dvādaśetirūpaiḥ kāśyāṃ vyavasthitaḥ || bhajate śrīhariṃ nityaṃ divodāsasamāgame ||58|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne divodāsachidrānveṣaṇāya catuḥṣaṣṭiyoginīnāṃ rūpāntaradhṛtiḥ kāśyāmeva vāso raveścāpi tathaiva tatkāryārthamāgamanaṃ kāśyāmeva dvādaśarūpairvāsaścetyādipradarśananāmā tryaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||83||
<1.84> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca lakṣmi devo mahādevo yaṃ yaṃ preṣayati prabhum | sa saḥ punarna cāyāti cintāmagno haro’bhavat || 1 || nādyāpyāyānti yoginyo nādyāpyāyāti bhāskaraḥ | kāśyāṃ vāso na vai syāccet kālo yāsyati kena me || 2 || adhākṣiṣamahaṃ kāmaṃ kāmo māṃ dunuyāttarām | kāśīpravṛttimanveṣṭuṃ kaṃ vā prahiṇuyāmitaḥ || 2 || iti cintya vidhātāraṃ bahumānapuraḥsaram | śivaḥ provāca yoginyaḥ sūryaśca preṣitā mayā || 4 || nādyāpi te nivartante kāśyā vijñāya vartanam | nābādhiṣṭa tathā kṣveḍaṃ māṃ kāśīviraho yathā || 5 || vidhe vidhehi me kāryaṃ yāhi kāśīṃ yatasva ca | adyaiva ca mayā satyā gantavyaṃ kintu dhārmikam || 6 || divodāsaṃ tu rājānamullaṃghayituṃ notsahe | nānyarājye pravastavyaṃ nocchiṣṭaṃ bhojyameva ca || 7 || svastimān gaccha panthāste śubhodarko bhavatvalam | ādāyājñāṃ vidhirdrāgvai kāśīmāyād vihāyasā || 8 || haṃsastho’paśyadānandavāṭikāṃ kāśikāṃ śubhām | gaṃgā vṛkṣā janāḥ saudhā yatrānandamayāḥ sadā || 9 || kāśibhūrālocitā yairindriyaistāni santi vai | varāṇi tṛṇadhānyāni kāśyāṃ yāni patanti hi || 1.84.1 0|| adya me saphalaṃ cāyuraho me bhāgyagauravam | adya me phalito vṛkṣo deho yatkāśidarśanam || 11 || mayā sṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā sarvā bahudākṣyapuraḥsarā | paramanyādṛśī kāśī devena nirmitā svayam || 1 2|| iti hṛṣṭamanā vedhā vṛddhabrāhmaṇaveṣadhṛk | avatīrya kṣitau haṃsād divodāsaṃ dadarśa ha || 1 3|| rājñā saṃmānito vṛddhabrāhmaṇaḥ satkṛtastathā | upaviśyāsane ramye cāśīrvādān dadau nṛpam || 14|| kośavṛddhiḥ satyadravye’saukhyavṛddhiḥ samāntare | gativṛddhiḥ satyamārge kāśavṛddhistavāntare || 15|| rājā prāha kathaṃ dvyarthaṃ bhāṣase vṛddhabhūsura | dharmabhaktyoryatra vṛddhistatra vṛddhiḥ satī sadā || 16 || adravye ca amārge ca sati vṛddhirbhayapradā | adravye satyaṇḍavṛddhiramārge sati dhāvanam || 17|| varṣāntare hyasaukhyaṃ tu dhārmikasya na saṃbhavet | adhārmikasyāntare tu asaukhyaṃ sadṛśaṃ bhavet || 18|| stutau prakāśavṛddhiḥ syādantare nānyathāvile | kimicchasi vṛddhavipra dravyahīnaḥ kumārgagaḥ || 19|| hṛdi me kiṃ daṃbhavṛddhirvarṣapūrvaṃ ca duḥkhabhāk | bhavāmyahaṃ divodāsaḥ itīcchasi kimīcchasi |||1.84.20|| kāśyāḥ palāyanaṃ me syāditīcchasi kimicchasi | kūṭavāg brāhmaṇo yatra bhūsuraḥ kūṭaveṣadhṛk ||21|| kūṭadharmo bhavettatra kūṭāśīrvādavān bhava | brahmā prāhātra kūṭaṃ ca kāpaṭyaṃ śṛṃgagauravam ||22||| śreṣavāg brāhmaṇo yatra bhūsuraḥ śreṣṭhaveṣadhṛk | śreṣṭhadharmo bhavettatra śreṣṭhāśīrvādavānaham ||23|| kāpaṭyaṃ yadi śāṭhyaṃ vai tadā tādṛṅ na cānyathā | śāṭhyavāg brāhmaṇo yatra bhūsuraḥ śāṭhyaveṣadhṛk |||24|| śāṭhyadharmo bhavettatra śāṭhyāśīrvādavān bhavet | rājā prāha tadā vipraṃ brahmāṇaṃ kūṭadharmakam |||25|| yadyevaṃ dharmamūrtistvaṃ kathaṃ śāṭhye pravartase | śāṭhye parājayo bhāvyaḥ śāṭhyapādaḥ patatyadhaḥ ||26|| ehi vipra svāgataṃ te karomyaśāṭhyadharmataḥ | pādyaṃ bhojyaṃ phalaṃ gāṃgajalaṃ peyaṃ prasādhanam ||27|| sarvaṃ gṛhāṇa viprendra vṛṇu yad hṛdi vartate | brahmovāca gṛhītaṃ tat bhaktyā pravardhase nṛpa ||28|| vidyayā satyabodhinyā jayase dharmaṇā nṛpa | rājāno bahavo dṛṣṭā yajvāno bhūridakṣiṇāḥ ||29|| śrotriyā nītinipuṇāḥ sattvaśīlā jitendriyāḥ | kṣamādayāsugāṃbhīryadākṣiṇyasaumyabhūmayaḥ || 1.84.30|| paraṃ tebhyastvayi rājan guṇā dvitrā viśeṣataḥ | prajā eva kuṭumbaṃ te brāhmaṇā eva daivatam ||3 1|| bhaktidharmau sahāyau te tapasvināṃ sahāyakaḥ | ete nānyeṣu dṛśyante dhanyo mānyo’si vai satām ||32|| sadguṇaiḥ pūjanīyo’si bhaktyā dharmeṇa vardhase | devā drohaṃ ca te kartumapi bibhyati dhārmika |||33|| ahaṃ tu brāhmaṇo rājan yajñān kartumihāgataḥ | tvādṛśaṃ bhaktamāsādya mama vāso’tra bhūyatām ||34|| anyattu mantritaṃ dūraṃ tatsadā dūramastu vai | atra tīrthatrayaṃ rājan tvaṃ gaṃgā bhūḥ parātparam ||35 || yatra kṛtānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ saṃvarte’pi na saṃkṣayaḥ | saṃcitaṃ yaddhanaṃ yatnād viniyujyeta tanmakhe ||36|| iti joṣaṃ sthitaṃ vipraṃ divodāsa
