uvāca ha | hariṃ yiyakṣamāṇasya tava dāso’smi sarvathā ||37|| kośād gṛhāṇa me yajñasaṃbhārān samapekṣitān | svāmyamātyasuhṛtkośarāṣṭradurgasusainyakam ||38|| viniyuṃkṣvāvaśyakaṃ tatsvārthaṃ tanna manāgapi | putraiḥ kalatrairdehena rājā prajāstu raṃjayet ||39|| prajāsantāpajo vahnirvajrādapi bhayaṃkaraḥ | dvitrān vināśayed vajraṃ tāpo rājyaṃ kulaṃ tanum ||1.84.40|| viprapādarajobhistu karomyavabhṛthaṃ sadā | viprānane prahutaṃ tanmanye yajñādviśiṣṭakam ||41|| ekaivādyāpi jāgarti samīhā brāhmaṇakṛte | svadeho’pi tadarthaṃ vai cārpaṇāt saphalo bhavet ||42|| adya me saphalaṃ jayema kuru yajñān sudakṣiṇān| yaja devān kṛtaṃ viddhi sāhāyyaṃ sarvavastubhiḥ |||43|| śrutvā rājño vaco viprabrahmā saṃbhāramāharat | iyāja daśabhirgaṃgātīre’śvamedhayajñakaiḥ ||44|| yatra sthale ca tattīrthaṃ pūrvāṃ rudrasaro’bhidhām | tyaktvā daśāśvamedhākhyāmāpede viśrutaṃ tathā ||45|| divodāsasya bhaktasya chidraṃ nāvāpa kiṃcana | kiṃ vadenmandaraṃ gatvā śaṃbhoragre tu viśvasṛk ||46|| ato daśāśvamedheśaṃ liṃgaṃ brahmeśvaraṃ tathā | svakāṃ mūrtiṃ ca saṃsthāpya vidhistatraiva cāvasat ||47|| divodāsasya satsaṃgād harerbhakto’bhavat sadā | satyaloke ca vairāje vaiṣṇave śāṃbhave pade ||48|| mokṣākhyaṃ yadbhavetsaukhyaṃ tadvai kāśiniṣevaṇāt | jyeṣṭhaśuklapratipadi snātvā mucyeta bandhanāt ||49|| snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam | saṃdhyā devārcanaṃ śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tatrākṣayaṃ bhavet ||1.84.50 || snātvā daśaharāyāṃ ca liṃgaṃ sampūjya cāpnuyāt | puṇyaṃ daśāśvamedhīyaṃ na punargarbhamāviśet ||51 || brahmā brāhmaṇarūpeṇa sthito yāvacchivāgamaḥ | brahmaṇe tu divodāso brahmaśālāmakārayat ||52|| ahalyayā kṛtā tatra brahmapurī suśobhitā | ityeṣā bhūḥ sadā brāhmī brahmalokapradāyinī ||53 || divodāso mahābhaktaḥ kīdṛśo me’bhavat priye | yasya brahmādayo devāḥ pratikartuṃ na cāśakan ||54|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne mandarācalataḥ śaṃbhupreṣitabrahmāpi viprarūpeṇa kūṭaślokadvārāśīrvādān dadau tatsaṃvādottaraṃ daśāśvamedhayajñān kṛtvā kāśyāmevovāsetyādikathananāmā caturaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||84||
<1.85> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mahādevi mandare nivasan haraḥ | śuśoca bahudhā tatra gatā nāyānti vai punaḥ || 1 || kiṃ vai kāśyāṃ sthitāste vākṛtakāryā hataujasaḥ | nāyānti yoginīsūryavedhasaḥ prahiṇomi kān || 2 || cintayanniti deveśo gaṇānāhūya bhūriśaḥ | preṣayāmāsa bho yāta kāśīṃ vivasituṃ drutam || 3 || śaṃkukarṇaṃ mahākālaṃ ghaṇṭākarṇaṃ mahodaram | nandiṣeṇaṃ somanandikālapiṃgalakukkuṭān || 4 || kuṇḍodaraṃ mayūrākṣaṃ bāṇagokarṇatārakān | tilaparṇaṃ sthūlakarṇaṃ dṛmicaṇḍaṃ prabhāmayam || 5 || sukeśaṃ vindatiṃ chāgaṃ kapardipiṃgalākṣakau | vīrabhadraṃ kirātaṃ ca caturmukhaṃ nikuṃbhakam || 6 || paṃcākṣaṃ bhārabhūtaṃ ca kṣemakaṃ lāṃgaliṃ tathā | tryakṣaṃ virādhaṃ sumukhamāṣāḍhiṃ skandameva ca || 7 || mahāśākhaṃ viśākhaṃ ca śākhaṃ nandinameva ca | bhṛṃgiṇaṃ naigameyaṃ ca preṣayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ || 8 || ete gaṇā mahābhāgāḥ svāmibhaktā dṛḍhavratāḥ | kṛtvā māyāṃ bahuvidhāṃ bahurūpā vicakṣaṇāḥ || 9 || animeṣakṣaṇāstasthuḥ kṣoṇīśacchidrakāṃkṣiṇaḥ | dharme satye dayāyāṃ ca daṇḍe prajāprapālane || 1.85.1 0|| rakṣaṇe dānadharme ca rājyadharme śrutau smṛtau | varṇāśramavipaddharmadeśakālādidharmasu || 11 || pañcayajñajapabhaktisevāsatkāravṛttiṣu | kvāpi kutrāpyalabdhvā vai kṣatiṃ truṭiṃ sacchidratām || 1 2|| rājānaṃ cāparābhavyaṃ divodāsaṃ prapūjya ca | sarve gaṇā asiddhasvasvāmikāryāḥ sulajjitāḥ || 13 || svasvanāmnā mahādevaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya nirantaram | kāśyāmeva nivāsān svān cakrire vigatajvarāḥ || 14|| na nivṛttā mandaraṃ te kāśīmāhātmyabodhanāt | vārāṇasī na vai tyājyā svargādapi garīyasī || 15|| ānandodyānasaṃlabdhasukhatulyaṃ na cetarat | atra kailāsa evāsti vaikuṇṭho’pyatra vidyate || 16|| kārśīṃ tyaktvā kathaṃ kāryā śuṣkā mandarasaṃsthitiḥ | vārāṇasīti kāśīti ānandodyāna ityapi || 17|| mukhena yena saṃproktaṃ nāsti tasya yamādbhayam | pañcakrośyā parimitā tanustridevasaṃbhavā || 18|| anākalitapuṇyānāṃ parikṣīṇadhanāyuṣām | sarvopāyavihīnānāṃ gatirvārāṇasī purī || 1 9|| kāśyāṃ vasanti ye dhīrā āpaṃcatvaviniścayāḥ | jīvanmuktāstu te jñeyā vandyā pūjyāsta eva ha || 1.85.20 || yatra kāśyāṃ mṛto janturbrahmanārāyaṇādibhiḥ | prabaddhamūrdhāñjalibhirnamasyetātiyatnataḥ || 21 || maraṇaṃ maṃgalaṃ yatra vibhūtiryatra bhūṣaṇam | kaupīnaṃ yatra kauśeyaṃ kāśī kutropamīyate ||22 || apāsya sodarāndārānputraṃ kṣetraṃ gṛhaṃ vasu | apyaṃgīkṛtya nidhanaṃ vastavyamatra caiva ha ||23 || iti te nirṇayaṃ kṛtvā kāśyāmeva vyavasthitāḥ | atha śaṃbhurgatānkāśyāṃ sthitānpunaranāgatān || 24|| gaṇān jñātvā ca herambaṃ prāhiṇottu gajānanam | gaccha putra vinā tvāṃ vai kaścinna pārayennṛpam || 25|| yathābuddhi yathākālaṃ yathāyogyaṃ prakalpya ca | divodāsaṃ viniṣkāsya kāśīṃ karagatāṃ kuru ||26 || tatra sthitopi saṃsiddhyai yatasva sahito gaṇaiḥ | nirvighnaṃ kuru cāsmākaṃ nṛpe vighnaṃ samācara ||27||| ājñāmādāya śirasā praṇipatya ca dhūrjaṭim | pratasthe tvaritaḥ kāśīṃ gaṇeśaḥ pitṛsiddhaye |||28 || śaṃbhoḥ kāśyāgamopāyaṃ cintayanvāḍavo’bhavat | sthūlaveṣṭanapaṃcāṃgapatradhṛk śakunaṃ diśan || 29 || nakṣatrajño mahājyotiścakravettāviśatpurīm | cacāra pratyavarodhaṃ sthavīro rekhayā diśan || 1.85.30 || hastarekhāṃ śakunāni bhāgyaṃ janmākṣarāṇi ca | sudṛṣṭvā gaṇitaṃ kṛtvā paurāṇāṃ prītimānabhūt || 31 || svayameva niśāyāṃ tu svapnaṃ sadarśayannṛṇām | prātasteṣāṃ gṛhaṃ gatvā teṣāṃ vakti śubhāśubham || 3 2|| praśnān saṃkārayitvā tān phalaṃ svāpnaṃ jagāda tān | svapne rātrau bhavān majjan jale majjan taṭaṃ gataḥ || 33 || taṭasthakardame magnaḥ punarmagno’si bhūriśaḥ | svapnasyāsya phalaṃ duṣṭaṃ jale ghāto bhavettava || 34|| anyasyāpi gṛhe gatvā phalaṃ svāpnaṃ hyavarṇayat | muṇḍī kāśāmbaradharaḥ praikṣi svapne tvayā tataḥ || 35 || maraṇatulyaduḥkhaṃ vā maraṇaṃ vā phalaṃ bhavet | svapne sūryagraho dṛṣṭo mṛtirvā tatsamaṃ phalam || 36 || aindraṃ dhanurdvayaṃ rātrau yadaloki dhruvā matiḥ | paścimāyāṃ svayaṃ sūrya udayaṃ prāpya śītagum || 37|| prodyantaṃ vyomamārgādvai pātayāmāsa bhūtale | iti svapne tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ rājyanāśo bhaved dhruvam ||38|| dhūmaketudvayaṃ yudhyamānaṃ vyomni vyaloki yat | taccāpi rāṣṭrabhaṃgāya phalaṃ svāpnaṃ vināśakṛt ||39|| viśīrya tvekadaśanaṃ nīyamānaṃ ca dakṣiṇe | ātmānaṃ yat samadrākṣīḥ mṛtiḥ kuṭumbabhīṣaṇā ||1.85.40|| tvayaikṣatāpararātrau prāsādadhvajabhaṃjanam | rājyakṣayakaraṃ caitanmahotpātaḥ prajāsu ca ||41|| samudreṇa puraṃ caitatplāvitaṃ yadadarśi tat | dvimāsābhyantare eva mahānāśaḥ puraukasām ||42|| svapne vānarayānena tvaṃ prayāto’si dakṣiṇām | atastava vināśo vā puratyāgo’thavā dhruvaḥ ||43|| rudatī yā tvayā dṛṣṭā nārī rātrau digambarā | muktakeśī vyomagābhūt phalaṃ rājyaviparyayaḥ ||44|| devālayasya kalaśaḥ patan dṛṣṭastvayā yataḥ | drāk svalpairdivasaireva rājyabhaṃgo bhaved dhruvam ||45|| purīṃ parita āgatya mṛgāḥ śivādayo muhuḥ | rorūyamāṇā dṛśyante tanmāse nodvasīṃ kriyāt ||46|| ghūkaśyenabakagṛdhrā uḍḍayantyabhitaḥ purīm | sūcayanti mahākaṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyatyatravāsinām ||47|| gadāmādāya hanumān pṛṣṭhe lagno dhruvaṃ kṣayaḥ | yamadūtāḥ pradṛśyante mahiṣānaḥparasthitāḥ ||48|| prajāmādāya gacchanti prajānāśo bhaved dhruvaḥ | pararājyabhaṭaścātragatyemān tāḍayanti tat ||49|| phalaṃ kāśīparibhaṃgo lokānāṃ kadanaṃ bhavet | tasmānmāsāntare eva gantavyamitaratra vai ||1.85.50 || nātra vāso hi sukhado bhavenmāsadvayottaram | evaṃ nirvāsayāmāsa śaṃsanbahūn prajājanān ||51|| prāyaśo’rdhaṃ prajāyāstu gataṃ deśāntaraṃ prati | athāpi grahacāraṃ vai vilokyāha janānpunaḥ ||52 || ekarāśau sthitāḥ śukraśanirbhaumā vināśakāḥ | dhūmaketurayaṃ vyomni bhittvā saptarṣimaṇḍalam ||53 || saṃyāti paścimāmāśāṃ vaiśyānāṃ nāśako bhavet | śaniścaraḥ samullaṃghya rāśiṃ vakraḥ prayāti vai |||54|| rāhuketubhaumayukto mahāvināśakṛddhi saḥ | sāyaṃkāle tu bhūkampo’vaśyaṃ nāśakaro bhavet ||55|| utarāddakṣiṇāṃ yātā vyomnyulkā garjanākarī | līnā cāpi tu saivāsyāḥ sūcayatyeva nāśanam ||56|| catvarasthacaityavṛkṣo vātenonmūlito’pi saḥ | sūcayatyeva kāśyāśca prajānāṃ kadanaṃ mahat |||57|| prātaḥ sūryodaye prācyāṃ kāko vakti bhayaṃ bhavet | kāśīmadhye mṛgau kaucidāraṇyakau praviśya ca ||58|| janadṛṣṭiṃ pravicyāvya gatāvudvāsasūcakau | śaradi dṛśyate cāmraśālapuṣpaṃ phalāṃkuram | mahākālabhayaṃ manye puryāmasyāmakālajam ||59||| sādhvasaṃ janayitveti gaṇeśena dvijena vai | uccāṭitā dhanāḍhyāśca bhūmanto’pi kuṭumbinaḥ ||1.85.60|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃkareṇa dvicatvāriṃśadgaṇānāṃ preṣaṇaṃ gaṇeśapreṣaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tena ca vividhasvāpnapratyakṣādiśakunotpātādivarṇanena prajānāṃ kāśīto niṣkāsanaṃ kṛtamitivarṇananāmā pañcāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 85 ||
<1.86> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tadā strīṇāṃ viśvāsāya samādhinā | prāgudantaṃ parijñāya gaṇeśo’ntaḥpuraṃ hyagāt || 1 || dṛṣṭārthameva kathayan strīṇāṃ viśvāsabhūrabhūt | yadyatpūrvaṃ tu sajjātaṃ tat sarvaṃ kathayatyayam || 2 || ekāmāsādya saṃprāha putrāṇāṃ navatistrayam | tava jajñe teṣu caiko’śvātpatito mamāra ca || 3 || sagarbheyaṃ śubhāṃ kanyāṃ janayiṣyati bhāgyataḥ | adyāpi yāvaddurbhāgyā sāmprataṃ subhagā tviyam || 4 || rājñā yasyai pradatto’yaṃ muktāhāraḥ suśobhanaḥ | seyaṃ rājñiṣu mānyā vai bhavatīvāti jīvavat||| 5 || imāṃ rājātimanute bahusnehāspadāṃ muhuḥ | dvau grāmau tu prasādena cāsyai dātumudīritau || 6 || anyāṃ rājñīṃ tataḥ prāha kumāro yadi jāyate | tadā tubhyaṃ pradāsye vai daśagrāmām̐stu vṛttaye || 7 || iti rājñā pratijñātaṃ śayyāyāṃ tava sannidhau | aparāṃ tu tadā prāha yadi tvaṃ syāḥ suputrakā || 8 || ardhaṃ rājyaṃ pradāsye tvāṃ suputrāyai tato’vadat | anyasyai premasamaye rājā prāha madarthakam || 9 || tāmbūlaṃ yad rakṣitaṃ tad dehi dāsye puratrayam | ityevaṃ pratyakṣajātaṃ samuvāca gaṇādhipaḥ || 1 0|| svapnānapyāha tāsāṃ vai tena viśvāsabhūrabhūt | varṇayanti ca rājñyo’sya parokṣe ca guṇān bahūn || 1 1|| aho kaścit sthavīro vai vipraḥ satyavivecanaḥ | prāgudantaṃ yathārthaṃ vai vakti sarva pramāṇataḥ || 12|| alolupaḥ sadācāraḥ santuṣṭo bhūtabhāvidṛk | prasannāsyaḥ śuciḥ śāstraśrutismṛtiviśāradaḥ || 13|| yadyad vakti jyotiṣā saḥ sarvaṃ satyaṃ pravartate | nānyādṛśaḥ svapnavaktā sākṣādvaktā ca dṛggataḥ || 14|| divodāsasya paṭṭāṃgī rājñī līlāvatī svayam | prāha rājñe mahārāja vipro brahmasamo nidhiḥ || 15|| kāśyāṃ kaścit samāyāto draṣṭavyo grahabodhane | kā daśā kīdṛśaṃ svapnaṃ kaḥ kālaḥ śakunaṃ kimu || 16|| vetti sarvaṃ tadasmādvai praṣṭavyaṃ kiṃ ca bhāvi vai | ityākarṇya tadā rājñā hyākārito gaṇādhipaḥ || 17|| samājagāma rājarṣiṃ labdhavān satkṛtiṃ tataḥ | samupaviṣṭoviṣṭare hyāśīrbhirabhyanandayat || 18|| kṣemaṃ te kuśalaṃ cāstu śreyo’bhyudaya ityapi | śivo dharmo’stu te saudhe tava vāso harergṛhe || 19|| samākarṇya ca rājā taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prāha bho dvija | prāptaṃ saṃrakṣitaṃ kṣemaṃ kau pṛthvyāṃ śaṃ sukhāvaham ||20 || tatsarvaṃ laṃ layaṃ yāyāditi te’sti manorathaḥ | mama śreyo’bhyudayaśca śivo śivārthamastviti ||21|| abhyudayaḥ śivo yo vai so’pyadharmo bhavatviti | mama saudhe śivarājyaṃ mama muktirharāviti ||22|| asmātsthānādvināśo me kimicchasi dvijottama | divodāsasya sārvajñyaṃ jñātvāścaryamavāpa saḥ ||23|| saṃgṛhyārhāṃ gaṇeśastu svasthānaṃ saṃjagāma ha | rājā rājñīṃ tadā prāha vipro’styayaṃ trikāladṛk ||24|| prajā yāntyanyaviṣayaṃ svapnaṃ bhāti bhayāvaham | udghoṣaḥ śrūyate bhāvivināśonmukhatā sthitā ||25|| prātarāhūya praṣṭavyaḥ kiṃ bhaviṣyaditi sphuṭam | manye devo viruddho me śaṃkaro’pyastyaśaṃkaraḥ ||26|| yadbhāvi tadbhavedeva nārāyaṇasamicchayā | prātarāhūya satkṛtya rājā papraccha hṛdgatam ||27|| śāsiteyaṃ mahīṃ sarvāṃ bhuktā bhogā vibhūtayaḥ | rājyaprajā hyatandriṇā prapālitāḥ svajīvavat ||28|| dvijasevā kṛtā pūrṇā nāpūrṇaṃ me’vaśiṣyate | prajāpalāyanaṃ svāpnaduṣṭatāṃ tu vilokya vai ||29|| kiṃbhāvīti pramugdho’haṃ dṛṣṭvā tathyaṃ nivedaya | gaṇeśaḥ prāha rājānaḥ prāyaḥ karṇaprasādanāḥ ||30|| miṣṭaṃ miṣṭaṃ tu śṛṇvanti daṇḍayanti kaṭubruvam | ahaṃ miṣṭaṃ kaṭuṃ cāpi tathyaṃ vacmi prasahyatām ||3 1|| vikrānto bhāgyavān śūro yaśaḥ puṇyasubuddhimān | yādṛśo’si tathā nāsti tridaśeśo’pi vai divi |||32||| dhiyā gurusamaścāsi prasādena sudhākaraḥ | tejasāsi bhānusamaḥ pratāpenāmninā samaḥ |||32|| bale’si vāyunā tulyaḥ śriyā kuberasadṛśaḥ | śāstā rudrasamo devo nirṛtisadṛśo raṇe ||34|| duṣṭapāśe varuṇo’si daṇḍe tu yamarāḍasi | kṣamayā bhūmisadṛśo maryādayā saritpatiḥ ||35|| mahattve himavām̐ścāsi śukro nītyāṃ nṛpasya vai | rājāsi manusadṛśastāpahā meghavanmataḥ ||36|| pavitro gaṃgayā tulyaḥ kāśīva sugatipradaḥ | sṛjipuṣṭirhṛtikārye brahmaviṣṇuharārthavān ||37|| sarasvatī mukhe te’sti kamalā te karāmbuje | viṣaṃ cāsti tava krodhe’mṛtaṃ vāci tava sthitam ||38|| hṛdi nārāyaṇaste’sti macchiṣyāḥ santi na tvayi | teṣāṃ vṛttipradānāya hyāgato’smi tavāṃgaṇe ||39|| tathyaṃ vacmi na cātathyaṃ guptaṃ vacmi na cānṛtam | svārthaṃ vacmi parārthāḍhyaṃ miṣṭaṃ vacmi phalaṃ kaṭu ||40|| ārabhyādya dinādbhūpa brāhmaṇo’ṣṭādaśe’hani | udīcyaḥ kaścidāgatyāvaśyaṃ tvāmupadekṣyati ||41|| tattathaiva prakartavyaṃ tvaṃ hṛtsthaṃ prāpyase tataḥ | adyāhaṃ svagṛhaṃ yāmi pratīkṣasva tadāgamam ||42|| ityuktvā śrīgaṇeśastu kāśyāmeva hi tasthivān | kīrtaye śrīgaṇeśasya nāmāni mūrtayo yathā ||43|| ḍhuṇḍhivināyakaścārkavināyako gaṇādhipaḥ | dūrgo’tha bhīmacaṇḍaśca dehalināyakastathā ||44|| uddaṇḍaḥ pāśapāṇiśca kharvaḥ siddhivināyakaḥ | bāhyāvaraṇagāścaite kāśyāmaṣṭau vināyakāḥ ||45|| laṃbodaraḥ kūṭadantaḥ tathā śālakaṭaṃkaṭaḥ | kūṣmāṃḍo muṇḍo vikaṭadanto’tha rājaputrakaḥ ||46|| praṇavaścāṣṭau dvitīyāvaraṇe tu vināyakāḥ | vakratuṇḍo hyekadantaḥ kapisiṃhadvipānanaḥ ||47|| pañcāsyo herambanāmā vighnarājo varapradaḥ | modakapriya ete’ṣṭau tṛtīyāvaraṇasthitāḥ |||48||| abhayadaḥ siṃhatuṇḍaḥ kūṇitākṣo gajānanaḥ | kṣipraprasādanaścātha cintāmaṇivināyakaḥ ||49|| dantahastaḥ piciṇḍila uddaṇḍamuṇḍasaṃjñakaḥ | ete’ṣṭau tu gaṇādhīśāścaturthāvaraṇasthitāḥ ||50 || sthūladantaḥ kalipriyaścaturdanto dvituṇḍavān | jyeṣṭho gajastathā kālo nāgeśaḥ pañcamāvṛtau ||5 1|| maṇikarṇa āśāvināyakaḥ sṛṣṭigaṇādhipaḥ | yakṣākhyagajakarṇaścitraghaṇṭaḥ sthūlajaṃghakaḥ ||552||| maṃgalo mitranāyako’ṣṭau te ṣaṣṭhyāvṛtau matāḥ | modaḥ pramodaḥ saṃmodo mahāmodo’tha arthadaḥ ||53|| jñāno dvāro vimuktākhyo’ṣṭau saptamāvṛtau sthitāḥ | ṣaṭpaṃcāśadgaṇeśāste kāśyāṃ parita āsthitāḥ ||54|| nāmānyetāni śrutvāpi duḥkhebhyo viprahīyate | jātu vighnairna bādhyeta pāpebhyo’pi prahīyate ||55||| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne rājño’ntaḥpurastrīṇāṃ viśvāsāya gaṇeśena prāgudantasvapnādi kathitaṃ divodāsāya bhāvivipadādikathitaṃ ṣaṭpaṃcāśadgaṇeśasthityādi kathitaṃ ceti nirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 86 ||
<1.87> śrīlakṣmīruvāca patideva namastubhyaṃ kṛṣṇātmā tu gajānanaḥ | kāśyāmavasthitaḥ paścānmandare’bhūddharasya kim || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śaṃkareṇa tadā viṣṇuḥ proktaḥ kāśīgamāya tu | tathā tvamapi mā kārṣīryathā prākprasthitaiḥ kṛtam || 2 || viṣṇuścaturbhujaḥ prāha yathābuddhibalodayam | udyamaḥ prāṇinā kāryaḥ phalaṃ daivakṛtaṃ matam || 2 || atīva yadasādhyaṃ tatsusādhyaṃ haryanugrahāt | sumuhūrtaṃ saṃvilokya salakṣmīko hariḥ svayam || 4 || viṣṇuścaturbhujo’gacchat kāśīṃ snātaśca gaṃgayā | sā vai pādodakī gaṃgā kīrtyate bhaktapuṃgavaiḥ || 5 || kṛtapādodakasnānaṃ pītapādodakodakam | dattapādodapānīyaṃ naraṃ na nirayaḥ spṛśet || 6 || viṣṇupādodake tīrthe prāśya pādodakaṃ sakṛt | jātucijjananīstanyaṃ pātavyaṃ na bhavediti || 7 || sacakraśālagrāmasya śaṃkhena sthāpitasya ca | adbhiḥ pādodakasyāmbu pibannamṛtatāṃ vrajet || 8 || viṣṇupādodake tīrthe viṣṇupādodakaṃ pibet | sapta sapta tathā sapta svavaṃśām̐stārayiṣyati || 9 || tatra tīrthe svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ svamūrtiṃ dārṣadīṃ vyadhāt | ādikeśavanāmnīṃ tāṃ svayamasthāpayattataḥ || 1.87.10 || śvetadvīpaitisthānaṃ tatkāśīsīmni vartate | yatra yatra sthitaḥ supto viśrānto nidritastathā || 1 1|| tatra tatra ca tīrthāni jātāni viṣṇusaṃjñayā | kṣīrābdhināmakaṃ tīrthaṃ śaṃkhatīrthaṃ tathā param || 12|| cakratīrthaṃ gadātīrtha tīrthaṃ ca padmasaṃjñakam | mahālakṣmyabhidhaṃ tīrthaṃ tārkṣyatīrthaṃ tathāparam || 13|| tatra nāradatīrthaṃ ca prahlādatīrthamityapi | ambarīṣamahātīrthamādikeśavatīrthakam || 14|| dattātreyamahātīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ ca bhārgavaṃ tathā | tathā vāmanatīrthaṃ ca naranārāyaṇābhidham || 15|| yajñavārāhatīrthaṃ ca gopīgovindatīrthakam | lakṣmīnṛsiṃhatīrthaṃ ca śeṣatīrthaṃ tathāparam || 16|| śaṃkhamādhavatīrthaṃ ca tīrthaṃ hayānanaṃ tathā | matsyodarāmahātīrthaṃ rādhākṛṣṇasumandiram || 17|| kāśīviśveśvarasaudhaṃ tīrthamevamanekadhā | viṣṇunā tatra vāsāya sthāpitā nijamūrtayaḥ || 18|| viṣṇunā cātha kāryaṃ vai śaṃkarārthaṃ tu kiṃ kṛtam | saugataṃ prathamaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtaṃ trilokimohanam || 19|| lakṣmīstadā tu saṃjātā subhagā parivrājikā | garutmānapi saṃjātaḥ śiṣyo hastāgrapustakaḥ ||1.87.20|| guruḥ puṇyasūryabhidhaḥ śiṣyo vinayasūrikaḥ | lakṣmīrāryasūriṇī ca vivecayanti catvare |||2 1|| vinayasūriḥ papraccha guruṃ dharmaṃ sanātanam | puṇyasūrirguruḥ prāha janānāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tadā || 22|| anādisiddhaḥ saṃsāraḥ kartṛkarmavivarjitaḥ | svayaṃ prādurbhavedeṣaḥ svayameva vilīyate |||23|| ātmaivaikastu sarvatra nāmānyekasya santi ca | śarīraṃ bhūtajaṃ kālakṛtaṃ kālena līyate ||24|| āhāro maithunaṃ nidrā bhayaṃ ceti samānakam | atra catuṣṭaye sarve tulyāḥ santi vicāryate ||25|| karmakṛtaṃ paraṃ sarvaṃ nāsmātkaścitparo mataḥ | bhajanaṃ kasya kartavyaṃ nāsti kaścitparo yataḥ ||26|| dharmo jīvadayātulyo nāsti pālyaḥ sa sarvadā | hiṃsyante jantavaḥ snāne tasmātsnānaṃ na dhārmikam ||27|| dahyante jantavo dīpe tasmāddīpo na dhārmikaḥ | upavāsaiḥ pramartavyaṃ karmanāśastadā bhavet |||28|| ātmā bhavetparamātmā sarve tathā bhavantviti | paṃcakarmendriyāṇyeva paṃcajñānendriyāṇi ca ||29 || mano buddhiśca saṃpūjyaṃ dvādaśāyatanaṃ śubham | na dharmo nāpyadharmaśca svargaṃ na narakaṃ nahi ||1.87.3 0 || sukhaṃ svargo duḥkhamanyat tannāśo mokṣa ucyate | vṛkṣān chitvā kaṇān hutvā vṛthā vināśya karmaṇi ||3 1 || dagdhā vahnau tilājyādi yajñastu pāpameva tat | na kartavyaṃ na kartavyaṃ karmahiṃsāmayaṃ kvacit || 3 2|| tadvināśāya gantavyaṃ parvatāraṇyabhūmiṣu | jñānaśravaṇamityetat kṛtvānyepi janāstadā ||33|| trayāṇāṃ tatra śiṣyā vai bhavanti bahavo janāḥ | prayānti kāśīṃ visṛjya parvatāraṇyabhūmiṣu ||34|| atha nārīṣu āryā sā hyupadeśaṃ karotyapi | prāha deho manuṣyāṇāṃ svakarmaṇā hyavāpyate ||35|| karma tu hiṃsanādyātma na sevātma vicāryate | naiko niyāmakaścānyā niyamyeti yathātatham ||36|| sevayā cānyadehasya yadi labhyeta nākadam | svasya dehasya tāṃ sevāṃ kathaṃ naiva prakurmahe ||37|| svārthaiva patisevāsti na puṇyādikarī matā | parādhīnaṃ mahāduḥkhaṃ svādhīnaṃ sukhamucyate ||38|| tasmānnareṇa patnyāstu sevā kasmānna ceṣyate | ataḥ sevā na kartavyā hiṃsā svārthaśca pāpakṛt ||39|| ityāryāyā upadeśānnāryaḥ sevāṃ na kurvate | dānahomādikāryaṃ ca pratiruddhaṃ na jāyate ||1.87.40 || devasnānavidhiḥ sarvo vilīnaśca tataḥ punaḥ | abhyasyākarṣiṇīṃ vidyāṃ vaśīkṛtimatīmapi ||41 || narā nāryo vimohena brahmacaryaṃ ca tatyajuḥ | evaṃ sarveṣu paureṣu parāṅmukheṣu dharmataḥ ||42|| praviṣṭo’dharmapādaśca rājā saṃkalpakuṇṭhitaḥ | sāmarthyaṃ līnamevāsya divodāsasya sarvathā |||43 || ajigaṇaddivodāso’pyaṣṭādaśadināvadhim | tāvadaṣṭādaśe prāpte divase’gād dvijottamaḥ ||44|| sa eva viṣṇuḥ pratyakṣo dvijo bhūtvā samāgataḥ | taṃ sa natvā prapūjyāntaḥpure nināya cāha tam ||45 || māsadvaye tu madrājyaṃ nirmālyamiva dṛśyate | na śaktirna ca saṃpattirna prajā na ca dhārmikam ||46|| kīdṛśo’yaṃ samāyātaḥ samayo na ca vedmyaham | citte virāga āyātaścāhaṃ jigamiṣurvanam ||47|| sarvaṃ samyak kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhogyaṃ bhuktaṃ harerbalāt | eka evāparādhastu mayā devāstṛṇīkṛtāḥ ||48|| niṣkāsitā mayā rājyāttapobalasulambinā | yadeva kathayasvādya tattathaiva karomyaham ||49|| avanto’pi prajāḥ sarvā nijadharmamanuvratāḥ | purā te tripurāḥ śena līlayā bhasmasātkṛtāḥ ||1.87.50 || baliṃ yajñakṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pātāle nītavān hariḥ | vṛttavānapi vai vṛtra indreṇaiva niṣūditaḥ ||51 || dadhīcivipro devairasthikṛte tu hato’malaḥ | tasmādvirodho bhadrāya na bhaved daivataiḥ saha ||52|| viṣṇuḥ prāha tadā tasmai divodāsāya muktaye | na bhavatsadṛśo rājā bhavan bhūto bhaviṣyati |||53|| tvayā dharmasya devānāṃ kimapyapakṛtaṃ nahi | kāśīviśveśvaro dūraṃ kṛto’parādha eva saḥ ||54||| tacchāntyai liṃgamekaṃ vai kāśīviśveśvarābhidham | pratiṣṭhāpyaṃ tvayā paścāt saptame hyadyavāsarāt ||55|| divyaṃ vimānamāruhya gantavyaṃ śrīhareḥ padam | śrutvā rājāpyadād deyaṃ vipraṃ praṇamya bhāvataḥ ||56|| sarvato mana ākṛṣya liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya śobhanam | oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāyeti saṃjapan ||57|| prāyopaveśanavrataṃ gṛhītvā paścime taṭe | mahāntaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā samāhūya prajājanān ||58|| āhūya paṇḍitānsarvān sāmātyānmaṇḍaleśvarān | sarvāṃstattatkṛtādhyakṣān putrān pañcaśatāni ca ||59|| purohitaṃ pratīhāramṛtvijo gaṇakān dvijān | sāmantān rājaputrām̐śca sūpakārām̐ścikitsakān ||1.87.60 || bahūn vaideśikām̐ścāpi bālagopālavṛddhakān | sāntaḥpurāñca mahiṣīṃ sarvān provāca bhāvataḥ ||61 || ādyārabhyasaptame’hni maraṇaṃ me bhaved dhruvam | mama rājye’bhisiñcāmi kumāraṃ samaraṃjayam ||62|| krāśīviśveśvarārthaṃ ca saudhaṃ kurvantu śilpinaḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāsaptāhaṃ śṛṇomyaham ||63||| sārameva ca dravyaṃ me vyayārthaṃ dīyatāṃ muhuḥ | atha śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃ sarvaṃ maṇḍalaṃ svaṃ nināya ca ||64|| viprarūpeṇa kāśyāṃ vai tatkathāyāṃ samagataḥ | brāhmaṇastu svayaṃ viṣṇurvedaśāstrārthapāragaḥ ||65|| vaktābhavat tadā tatra pāṭhakaśca haro’bhavat | jāpakā ṛṣayastatra devāḥ prajāḥ sabhāsadaḥ ||66 || dharmayajño mahān jāto na bhūto na bhaviṣyati | svayamagniḥ samāptau tu nīrājayati nityaśaḥ ||67|| saptame tu dine pūrṇe mandire svarṇaśobhite | viśveśvaraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya mahatā vidhinā tataḥ ||68|| kathāpūrṇāhutiṃ kṛtvā koṭijanānabhojayat | rājā yajñaprasādaṃ cājighrad vyāsājñayātha ca ||69|| yāvattiṣṭhati madhyāhne sandhyāyāṃ harisannidhau | tāvadvimānamākāśādujjvalaṃ brahmalokajam ||1.87.70 || alpamavātarad bhūtvā tasmānnārāyaṇaḥ śriyā | sahitastatra saptāhasthale pratyakṣatāmagāt ||71 || rūpānurūpāvayavaṃ kaṃjanetraṃ kṛpāmayam | prasannavadanaṃ hāsyaṃ kurvantaṃ ca manoharam |||72||| brahmadhāmasthitaṃ divyaṃ svarūpaṃ tarkabhūmyagam | āyāhīti bruvantaṃ śrīnārāyaṇaṃ praṇamya saḥ |||73|| divodāsaḥ parābhaktyā vismṛtyānyadaho prabho | āyāmīti vadan dehaṃ divyaṃ tameva vartayan ||74|| sadehastu mahālakṣmyā brahmavāryabhisiñcitaḥ | mahāmukto’bhavad divyo viṣṇutulyaḥ sadehakaḥ ||75|| āruroha vimānaṃ tat prārthayāmāsa vai harim | yā prajā tava bhaktāsti naya tāmapi mokṣad ||76|| hariḥ prāha divodāsa yābhiryaiḥ samabhīṣyate | vaikuṇṭhaṃ tu samāgantumāyāntu te’nivāritāḥ ||77|| śrutvaivaṃ ḍiṇḍimaṃ viṣṇoḥ prajā lakṣapralakṣakāḥ | nāgarā deśikāścānye jānapadasabhāsadāḥ ||78|| arbudāśca parārdhāśca divodāsena vai samam | āruruhurvimānaṃ tā vaikuṇṭhagamanecchayā ||79|| sarve divyā divyadehā bhūtvā tyaktvānavāni vai | tāvadvimānamākāśe mahadrūpaṃ vyadṛśyata ||1.87.80|| sūryacandrādayo yasya nikaṭe sarṣapā iva | koṭipārṣadasaṃjuṣṭaṃ koṭimuktasamanvitam ||8 1 || ūrdhvamapāsaran tāvatkṣaṇenādṛśyatāṃ gatam | kāśyāṃ trilokyāṃ vailokyāṃ jayaśabdāstadābhavan ||82|| evaṃ rājā divodāso bhaktyā vaikuṇṭhamāptavān | etāṃ kathāṃ paṭhedvāpi śṛṇuyānmukta eva saḥ ||83| bhaktyā hyanekajīvām̐śca sa vai tārayituṃ śamaḥ || divodāsasamānasya vaikuṇṭho’tra paratra ca ||84|| tataḥ sarve’pi devā vai śaṃkaraḥ sakuṭumbakaḥ | kāśīṃ cāvāsayan sarvāṃ rājadhānī purā yathā ||85|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne hareṇa kāśīṃ prati viṣṇuḥ preṣitaḥ viṣṇutīrthāni viṣṇunā sugatarūpeṇa nāstikopadeśadvārā prajā dharmaśūnyā nāstikā kṛtā tena divodāsasya pratāpasya hrāsaḥ tataḥ asyāḥ saṃhitāyāḥ śravaṇam kāśīviśveśvarasthāpanam tato divyavimānena divyadehasya divodāsasya prajayā saha vaikuṃṭhagamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||87||
<1.88> śrīlakṣmīruvāca mandarādriprārthanena śaṃbhustu gatavānpurā | kathaṃ devāparādho vai divodāsasya so’bhavat || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ divyāṃ kathaṃ drohastvajāyata | puraikadā mahāvṛṣṭirjātā kāśīvināśinī || 2 || vṛṣṭyā kāśyā vināśena deśaviplavajena ca | dhyānasthitasya śaṃbhorvai duḥkhenāntaradūyata || 3 || tadā devo mahādevo meghānāhūya sarvataḥ || sarvān nibadhya jaṭayā samādhyantarhito’bhavat || 4 || gatvā kailāsaśikhare gaṇān saṃsthāpya rakṣakān || daśavarṣaṃ samādhau tu so’bhūt jāgarito nahi || 5 || anāvṛṣṭyā tadā deśā vināśaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ || divodāsastadā bhakto ghore tapasi saṃsthitaḥ || 6 || pṛthvī rājyavihīnāsīt devāḥ svargaṃ gatāstadā || manuṣyā naiva dṛśyante lokaviplava āpatat || 7 || avyavasthā caturyonau yajñādayo bhavanti na | na bhakṣyaṃ na ca havyaṃ vā patraṃ puṣpaṃ na labhyate || 8 || devānāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi yajñīyaṃ bhojanaṃ ca yat | sāvagrahaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ jātaṃ tadā divaukasām || 9 || itastataḥ pradhāvanti manujā rākṣasāstathā | devāśca prāṇino bhūtāḥ piśācā vaninastathā ||1.88.10|| avyavasthaṃ hyabhūtsarvaṃ mahābhayaṃ tu bhūtalam || bālā nāryo hriyante’nyairdravyaṃ bhojyaṃ na labhyate ||11|| arājake tadā deśe duḥkhino devamānavāḥ | brahmāṇaṃ tu samārādhya nṛpatiṃ supratāpinam ||12|| vavrire devasāhāyyaṃ yathā vai varṣaṇaṃ bhavet | mārgayannṛpatiṃ viṣṇusamaṃ brahmā hyuvāca tān ||13|| yāntūpāyaṃ kariṣye’haṃ duḥkhanāśāya sarvathā | svayaṃ vimānamāruhya jagāma himaparvatam ||14|| tapasyantaṃ mahāghoraṃ vidyutprabhaṃ pratāpinam || divodāsaṃ vilokyaiva brahmovāca hitāvaham ||15|| paśya rājan svayaṃ brahmā lokarakṣaṇahetave || āgato’smi bhavānatra tāpasaḥ sankaroti kim ||16|| paropakārasadṛśaṃ tapo na na ca pauruṣam || na dhyāna na ca homo vā na kriyāntaramityapi ||17|| ārādhito yadi haristapasā tataḥ kiṃ nārādhito yadi haristapasā tataḥ kim | niṣkāmatāṃ yadi gatastapasā tataḥ kiṃ satkāmatāṃ yadi gataḥ phalamāpnuhi tvam ||18|| phalaṃ svayaṃ samāgatya haste patati yatsvataḥ | na gṛhṇāti nopayuṃkte ko’nyastasmād vicetanaḥ ||19|| devāḥ prayojanavaśāt tuṣyanti yasya yogataḥ | tānnādriyata ityasmātko’nyastu viphalāyatiḥ ||1.88.20|| tapaḥ samāpya nṛpate nibodha madvaco hitam || tvāṃ vināvagrahaṃ ghoraṃ nānyo vārayituṃ kṣamaḥ ||21|| tvāṃ viṣṇuṃ tvāṃ mahārudraṃ brahmāṇaṃ tvāṃ prajāpatim || manye tatkāryakartṛtvāt tatpratīkaṃ tadātmakam ||22|| tvadṛśānāṃ tapo dharmo nocito deśaviplave | sevādharmaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ rājyaṃ kuru mayārpitam ||23|| āgaccha tava mūrdhnyatra mukuṭaṃ sthāpayāmi vai | abhiṣekaṃ kārayāmi matkamaṇḍaluvāriṇā ||24|| idānīṃ śaṃkaro devo hyavimuktaṃ mahāvanam | parityajya mahāmeghān badhvā nītvā gato darīm ||25|| tvaṃ gṛhāṇa mahārājyaṃ rājadhānīṃ tu kāśikām | abhiṣeke tvayi jāte drāgvṛṣṭiḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ||26|| prāṇinaḥ sukhinaḥ syuśca haristuṣṭo bhaviṣyati | tapasāpyadhikaṃ janmasāphalyaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ||27|| ityukte brahmaṇā rājñi netre prānmilya vedhasam | praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau vavande hṛdayena vai ||28|| pitāmaha namastubhyaṃ pitrājñāṃ pālayāmyaham || prāpte prasannavadane pitari ko na tuṣyati ||29|| prāpte kṣaṇe tu devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ vā satāṃ janaḥ | nājñāvaho bhaved bhāgyavikretā sa na saṃśayaḥ ||1.88.30|| pitā pitāmahaścāpi prapitāmaha ityapi || ājñāpayettu yattadvai kāryaṃ putreṇa dhīmatā ||31|| ta eva tu trayo devā vedāścāpi ta eva ha | ta eva muktidātāra āśīrvādaparāyaṇāḥ ||32|| kintu nirvāhake putre yadi vighnaṃ tu kiṃcana | dṛśyate tannāśanīyaṃ tasmāt kiṃcinnivedaye ||33|| devānāṃ devalokeṣu daityadānavabhogiṣu | nāsti dharmavyavasthā yā mānuṣeṣviha nirmitā ||34|| yadi mānuṣabhinno vā kaścidvasati bhūtale || tadā mānuṣadharmāṇāṃ bādhā syātpramadādiṣu ||35|| devāḥ patnīvrataṃ dharmaṃ manvate naiva cetyataḥ || yadi madviṣaye na syū rājyaṃ karomi dhārmikam ||36|| brahmā prāha varaṃ rājan vardhase vimalāśayaḥ || gṛhāṇa mukuṭaṃ gāṃgaṃ jalaṃ khaḍgaṃ ca mālikām ||37|| devāḥ saṃkalpitāstatra kṣaṇādāyayuragrimāḥ || abhiṣekaḥ kṣaṇājjāta udghoṣaḥ sadasi kṛtaḥ ||38|| śṛṇvantu devatāścānye’tratyānyalokavāsinaḥ | divodāsasya rājye tu nāgatavyamamānavaiḥ ||39|| vasanti ye ca taiḥ sarvairdevairgantavyamanyataḥ|| yo na manvīta me nyāyaṃ sa devebhyo bahiṣkṛtaḥ ||1.88.40|| matsṛṣṭeśca bahiṣkārya ityājñā vaidhasī dhruvā | sarve tvamānavā devā atalādigṛhāstathā ||41|| kāśyā nirgatya nāke’nyaparvatādau gatāstadā | na yatra mānavo vāso na devānāṃ ca saṃkaraḥ ||4|| śaṃkarastu yayau pūrvaṃ mandareṇārthito yadā|| gatāḥ svasvāmivāseṣu tridevāstridaśālayāḥ ||43|| niṣkāsanena devānāṃ divodāso mahān ripuḥ || devānāmaparāddhā sa vivāsadaṇḍakṛcca vai ||44|| nāgantavyaṃ mama rājye devaiḥ kvāpi kadācana || svārthāḥ parārthalubdhāśca paradārasusaṃginaḥ ||45|| te rājye me na cāyāntu tvāgatā nāśamāpnuyuḥ | ityudghoṣastato jātastena devā ruṣaṃ gatāḥ ||46|| sūryo naiva pratapati candro na śaityado’bhavat | pacatyagnirna vai bhojyamindro naiva hi varṣati ||47|| na vāti pavanastatra ṛtavo vimukhāstadā | evaṃ sarve’pi ruṣṭāste divodāsastadā svayam ||48|| nārāyaṇahareryogāt tapate sūryarūpadhṛk | poṣayatyauṣadhīṃścandro bhūtvā dadāti cāmṛtam ||49|| agnirbhūtvā pācayati megho bhūtvā pravarṣati | vāyurbhūtvā pravātyeva vikāsayati san ṛtuḥ ||1.88.50|| yatra yatra ca yatkāryaṃ devādhīnaṃ babhūva ha || tattaddevātmako bhūtvā svayaṃ sādhayati drutam ||51|| svayaṃ yajñaḥ prabhūtvā ca bhūtvā taddevamaṇḍalam || svayaṃ nārāyaṇe prārpya svayamaśnāti śeṣajam ||52|| nānyamāhvayate kaṃciddevaṃ nārāyaṇo’paraḥ || ato’tiruṣṭā devāste nāyānti tatra ke’pi vai ||53|| avagrahakṛto doṣo divodāsena nāśitaḥ | ripūnnārāyaṇabalājjayatīti ripūñjayaḥ ||54|| itikhyātiṃ samāpanno divo nārāyaṇasya ca || dāsaśceti divodāsa ityevaṃ nāma sārthakam ||55|| satyaṃ śīlaṃ brahmacaryamahiṃsā tyāga ārjavam | sarvabrahmātmadṛṣṭiśca tathā sarvātmaveditā ||56|| sevā satāṃ satīnāṃ ca nārāyaṇena caikatā | ityevaṃ sadguṇāstatra santi śīlapurogamāḥ ||57|| kāmadughāḥ kalpavṛkṣāścintāmaṇaya ityamī || nityaṃ tadrājyavāstavyaprajānāṃ tu gṛhe gṛhe ||58|| rājā tu navadhā bhaktyopāste nārāyaṇaṃ harim || kāmavarṣyabhavattasya svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||59|| gṛhakāryakarī cāsīllakṣmīrnārāyaṇī ca mā || vaikuṇṭha iva tadrājyaṃ vikāsamagamacchriyā ||1.88.60|| kiṃ nyūnaṃ vai bhaved yasya bhāle vasati śrīhariḥ | ḍiṇḍimodghoṣitā rājye hyābālayuvavārdhakāḥ ||61|| sarve bhajantāṃ govindaṃ nānyaṃ kurvantu tadvinā || pūjayantu ca govindaṃ śṛṇvantu śrīhareḥ kathām ||62|| dhyāyantu śrīharermūrtiṃ paśyantu pratimāṃ hareḥ || spṛśantu tatsatāṃ pādān bhakṣayantu niveditam ||63|| jighrantu haripuṣpāṇi sevayantu ca tatsataḥ | raṭantu harināmāni viharantu tadālaye ||64|| ānandayantu haryarthamutsṛjantu viśuddhaye | svapantu hariśayyāyāṃ jāgratu harisevane ||65|| āntaraṃ cāpi yatkiṃcit kurvantu harigocaram || mā kurvantvanyamudyogaṃ divodāse praśāsati ||66|| yadyad yasya bhavediṣṭaṃ tasya tasya tu labdhaye || śrīnārāyaṇamūrtyagre sthitvoccārya ca nāma vai ||67|| prārthanīyamamukaṃ me bhūyādviśvaṃbhara prabho || divodāsasya bhaktyā śrīnārāyaṇo dadātu me ||68|| ityevaṃ prārthyate yena prāpsyate tena sarvathā || anyathā me bhaved ghātyo dhruvaṃ cetyanuśāsanam ||69|| kaṇṭhe srajastulasyāśca bhāle tilakaṃ cāndanam || candrakaṃ kuṃkumāḍhyaṃ ca japārthaṃ karamālikā ||1.88.70|| śrīnārāyaṇamūrtiśca sauvarṇī kaṇṭhagā sadā || ityevaṃ pañcacihnāni rakṣennārāyaṇasya vai ||71|| yasyaivaṃ naiva mānyaṃ me ghātyaḥ khaḍgena vai sa me || paśuvṛkṣalatāpakṣiprāṇino yasya santi vai ||72|| tānsarvān vaiṣṇavān kuryurityasti mama śāsanam | nāvaiṣṇavī prajā me syānna deśo me tvavaiṣṇavaḥ ||73|| nāvaiṣṇavaṃ ca vastu syāditi me śāsanaṃ mahat | anivedya na bhoktavyaṃ na pātavyamanarpitam ||74|| nodvartyaṃ naiva cābhūṣyaṃ nādhāryaṃ cānivedya vai | nandayantu viharantu rāmayantu sadā prajāḥ ||75|| militābhyāṃ jayahariritivācyaṃ na cānyathā | vaktavyaṃ yatkimapyetat hareścaritrameva ha ||76|| ājñollaṃghayituḥ kaṇṭhe me khaḍgo vicariṣyati | ityevaṃ tu divodāso rājyaṃ cakāra vaiṣṇavam ||77|| sarvaṃ vaikuṇṭhabhaṃ tvāsīnna nyūnaṃ tu kimapyabhūt || prajāḥ kāmavimānaiśca viharanti sadāmbare ||78|| gṛhe gṛhe vimānāni kāmadughā gṛhe gṛhe | kalpavṛkṣāḥ pratigṛhaṃ kalpaśilāḥ pratisthalam ||79|| svarṇahariḥ prativyakti sākṣādvaikuṇṭha ityabhūt || evaṃ prabhāvo rājāsau prajā nītvā hariśritāḥ ||1.88.80|| āgātsadeho vaikuṇṭhaṃ ko’nyastadvat prayāsyati | ye ye tatrāgatā devāḥ kāpaṭyena ca śāṃkarāḥ ||81|| viṣṇunā rakṣitāste ca khaḍgāghātaṃ na lebhire| ityeṣā bhagavanmāyā kartā kārayitā hi saḥ ||82|| yasya lalāṭe vasati tasya sarvaṃ samāvaset | prayāti yasya bhālātsa hyapayātyakhilaṃ tataḥ ||83|| prasahya vedhaso dvārā devānāṃ yadvivāsanam | tadeva tvaparādhaḥ sa yatphalaṃ svasya mokṣaṇam ||84|| aparādho’pi mokṣākhyaṃ phalaṃ dadyācchubho hi saḥ || ityevaṃ kathito bhaktapratāpo’nyat kimicchasi ||85|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne divodāsasya rājyapadottaraṃ devānāṃ kāśīto niṣkāsanamaparādhaḥ svasya sarvadevavatkāryasāmarthyaṃ vaiṣṇavadharmabhaktipravartanamityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 88 ||
<1.89> śrīlakṣmīruvāca bhagavān sarvahṛdvāsa sarvajña bahurūpadhṛk || dhanvantaristṛtīyo vai jajñe ratnākarātkatham || 1 || tāṃ kathāṃ śrāvaya svāminnārāyaṇa jagadguro | śrutvā patimukhād vārtāṃ naiva tṛpyāmi mokṣadām || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca dvāpare tu yuge cānte yadā sarve’lpabuddhayaḥ | svārthasādhanamātrārthā atṛptasvasvavṛttayaḥ || 3 || lobhamānādyadharmāṃśavyāptā devāśca mānavāḥ || āsam̐stadā yuge cendro rājyābhimānavānapi || 4 || rājasena tu bhāvena samāviṣṭaḥ purandaraḥ || tarkayāmāsa manasā dṛṣṭvā kāle sadūṣaṇam ||5|| aho satyaṃ tathā tretā kīdṛśau samayau śubhau | vyatītau subhagau sarvasampatpradau yatheṣṭadau || 6 || dvāpare gamyamāne’tra mānasāni phalanti na | neṣṭaṃ ca prāpyate kiṃcit durāpaṃ jāyate muhuḥ || 7 || doṣo’tra na prajānāṃ syād yathā rājā tathā prajā | ato’trāhūya dikpālān śāsmi kālasya śuddhaye || 8|| rājño’pi vā kiyān doṣo rājāno guruśāsitāḥ | guravo’tra tu dṛśyante lubdhāḥ svārthaparāyaṇāḥ || 9 || tasmād daṇḍyāśca guravaḥ kālaśuddhistato bhavet | yādṛśā rājyaguravastādṛśā rājyapālakāḥ ||1.89.10|| tasmādāhūya sarvān vai kenāpyutsavachadmanā | vijñāpayāmi saukhyārthaṃ stheyaṃ satyayuge yathā ||11|| kālaḥ kaluṣatāṃ neyāt vartantāṃ tattathaiva hi | evaṃ vicārya śakreṇa svarge hyākāritā sabhā ||12|| śrāvitaṃ ca trilokyāṃ vai svarge cendrasabhāgṛhe || samāgantavyamānāgamartyadevamunīśvaraiḥ samāje cātra devānāṃ bhaviṣyati mahotsavaḥ || narotpannāpsarasāṃ tu navaṃ nṛtyaṃ bhaviṣyati ||14|| dharmasya patnyāṃ mūrtyāṃ yau jātau naranarāyaṇau || pitrorājñāmanuprāpya tapo’rthaṃ kṛtamānasau ||15|| tapatastau vighnakartuṃ mayendreṇa praṇoditāḥ || apsaraso mohanārthaṃ tadā nareṇa cājñayā ||16|| nārāyaṇasyāmrapuṣpairūrvaśī prakaṭīkṛtā | surūpā yauvanavyāptā rūpamūrdhanyabhāsvarā ||17|| yadagre’nyāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇā nistejaskā ivābhavan | saivorvaśī tu me dattā sā vai nṛtyaṃ kariṣyati ||18|| taddarśanāya sarvaistu samāgantavyameva ha || ityudghoṣayitvendreṇa kṛtā svarge mahāsabhā ||19|| nṛtyaṃ karotyūrvaśī ca nṛtye rūpe ca mohitā || kaṇṭhasvare pralīnā ca hyamānā tvabhavatsabhā ||1.89.20|| lokapālāśca devāśca ṛṣayo’psarasastathā || gandharvāśca tathā siddhā vidyādhrāścāraṇādayaḥ ||21|| devyaścāpi tadā sarvā mugdhāstallagnamānasāḥ || abhavam̐stāvadāgacchad devarājaguruḥ sudhīḥ ||22|| bahuśiṣyaiḥ parivṛto bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ | nṛtye saṃvartamāne’tra sabhākṣobho bhavedataḥ ||23|| indrastatrāgataṃ paśyan guruṃ vācaspatiṃ dvijam | novāca kiṃcid durmedhā vaco mānapuraḥsaram ||24|| nāhvānaṃ nāsanaṃ tasya satkāraṃ nākarottadā | devāstu sahasā dṛṣṭvā praṇemustamupasthitam ||25|| tadorvaśī svayaṃ tatra guruṃ jñātvā bṛhaspatim | nanāma nṛtyaṃ saṃtyajya sabhākṣobho’bhavattadā ||26|| indra utthāya yāvadvai kālaḥ śubho bhaved yathā bhaved yadi śubho rājā so’pi syād cet śubho guruḥ ||27|| śubhena guruṇā rājā prajā kālaḥ śubhā matāḥ || ityupadiśati tāvat surācāryoṃ ruṣānvitaḥ ||28|| jñātvā śakraṃ pramattaṃ ca madād rājyasya durmatim || tirodhānamanuprāptaḥ kva gato naiva bhālitaḥ ||29|| gate devagurau tasmin vaimanasyaṃ gatāḥ surāḥ || yakṣanāgāśca gandharvā apsarasa dvijarṣayaḥ ||1.89.30|| nṛtyagānāvasāne tu hariḥ prāha surām̐stadā || kva gato’yaṃ devagururnāradaḥ prāha taṃ tadā ||31|| tvayā kṛtā hyavajñā vai gurormānaṃ tu na kṛtam || guroravajñayā rājyaṃ līyate bhayamāgatam ||32|| naro yatate saukhyārthaṃ tadeva duḥkhakṛd bhavet || so’yaṃ kālasya saṃvego na rājā kālakāraṇam ||33|| na gururna prajā heturyugaḥ kālasya kāraṇam | yugaḥ paryāvartayati mānasāni mahātmanām ||34|| tathāpi bhadrasantatyai yatitavyaṃ yathābalam || guruḥ kṣamāpanīyo vai sarvabhāvena tu tvayā ||35|| nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā sadaḥsthai parivāritaḥ || āsanātsahasothāyāgacchad gehaṃ bṛhaspateḥ ||36|| dṛṣṭvā tārāṃ praṇamyāha kva gato hi mahātapāḥ | na jānāmītyuvācetthaṃ tārā devān gṛhasthitā ||37|| tadā cintānvito bhūtvā śakraḥ svālayamāvrajat | airāvataṃ samāruhya gurormārgaṇakāmyayā ||38|| vyomamārgātpṛthivyāṃ vai yāvadāgacchati drutam || mārge munirmahākrodho durvāsā rudrakāṃśajaḥ ||39|| pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālāmādāya cāgataḥ || gurościntanajānmohād bhāvibhāgyaparikṣayāt ||1.89.40|| kālāvegāttathā tatra turāṣāṇna nanāma tam | tathāpi ṛṣiṇā rājñaḥ satkāryadharmagauravāt ||41|| mālā vyomnaiva mārgeṇa tvindrakaṇṭhe samarpitā || indrastāṃ tu samuttārya dattavān hastimastake ||42|| hastinā sā kareṇaiva phālitā nihitā pade || kaccaritā marditā ca dṛṣṭvā cukrodha tāṃ muniḥ ||43|| krodhajvālāparītāṃgo vikarālabhayaṃkaraḥ || oṣṭhau daśan garaṃ netre darśayan sphārayan tharan ||44|| uvāca duṣṭa deveśa dūre tiṣṭhatu mānanam | pratyuta mānito’pi tvaṃ mālāṃ gaṇayase nahi ||45|| viditvā devarājaṃ tvāṃ pūjayitvā tathāpi vai || śaṭharājaḥ prabhūtvā manmālāṃ kṣipasi bhūtale ||46|| mardanaṃ hastipādena kārayasyavamānanam | puṣpe puṣpe tu ratnāni lakṣmyo vasanti madbalāt ||47|| vaikuṇṭhācchrīhareḥ prāsādikī labdhārpitātra te | sā pradattā mayā tāṃ tvaṃ kaccarayasi pattale | ratnānāṃ lakṣmīnāṃ cāpi nāśaṃ karoṣi mauḍhyataḥ ||48|| tasmāt trilokirājyaṃ te vināśaṃ yātu sarvathā | sampadaḥ smṛddhayo lakṣmyo ratnāni vividhāni ca ||49|| layaṃ yāntu mahāvārdhau tvamanidro bhava kṣaṇāt | durvāsā evamuktaiva kailāsamagamat tataḥ ||1.89.50|| ambālikādhvajastatraivāpatadbhūtale tataḥ | mukuṭo’pyapatanmūrdhnaḥ kṣauti sma ca karī tadā ||51|| aṃkuśaṃ vai vigalitaṃ hastāt hastipakasya tu || etasminnantare svarge tvaniṣṭānyabhavankṣaṇāt ||52 airāvataścālito’pi svargaṃ prati na gacchati | unmattaḥ san devarājaṃ drāvayatyeva cābhitaḥ ||53|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne naranārāyaṇotpāditorvaśyā nartanotsavasamāje bṛhaspateravamānanaṃ durvāsaso’vamānaṃ rājyalakṣmīnāśakaśāpaścendrasyetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekonanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 89||
<1.90> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca devaguruḥ svayaṃ yāto kāveryāścottare taṭe | homaṃ cakāra cendrasya rājyanāśāya śeṣataḥ || 1 || oṃ namo bhagavati ṛkṣakarṇi caturbhuje | ūrdhvakeśi kālarātri vasārudhirabhojane || 2 || indrasya prāptakālasya mṛtyude huṃ phaṭ hana | hana daha daha māṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ paca paca svāhā || 3 || iti homaṃ prakurvatā kṛtyā krūrā tu nirmitā || sā gatā cendranāśāya dṛṣṭendro vihvalo’bhavat || 4 || palāyito vyomamārgād brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ yayau || kṛtyā parāvṛtā tasmād bṛhaspatimupāgatā || 5 || bṛhaspatyājñayā cendraratnānāṃ nāśanāya hi || gatā svargaṃ tadā sarve bhayabhītā tvitastataḥ || 6 || vināśikāṃ mahāghorāṃ kālānalasamaprabhām || vyāttānanāṃ saśastrāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā cakruḥ palāyanam || 7 || durvāsaso muneḥ śāpo mahākāyaḥ karālakaḥ || kṛṣṇaparvatasannibho meghān lihan svajihvayā || 8 || sūryacandranibhe netre visphārayan prabhakṣakaḥ || trilokyāstu vināśāya svargaṃ tu prathamaṃ gataḥ || 9 || karālakaḥ sa puruṣaḥ kṛtyā ṛkṣaśravasyapi | vināśayāmāsatuśca svargaratnāni sarvataḥ ||1.90.10|| tadā śacī tirodhānaṃ gatā tu kamalekṣaṇā | airāvato mahānāgastathaivoccaiḥśravā hayaḥ ||11|| pradudruvustathā cānyaratnāni svargataḥ kila || pātālasthena balinā jñātvā śakrasya durdaśām ||12|| akāri svargalābhāya yuddhaṃ daityaprasenayā | labdhāmarāvatī tena ratnānyāskanditāni ca ||13|| saptāṃgaṃ sakalaṃ tasyendrasya nītaṃ talātalam | śukraprasādād daityāstu tadā vijayino’bhavan ||14|| samudre patitāvuccaiḥśravaairāvataistadā | anyānyapi ca ratnāni hyanekāni bahūnyapi ||15|| svargānnītāni daityaiśca daityānahārṇi tāni tu || vidrutvā tāni daityebhyaḥ patitāni tu sāgare ||16|| candro jaladravo bhūtvā bhūtvā kāmadughā payaḥ || kalpavṛkṣaḥ pārijātaścādṛśyau bījabhāvataḥ ||17|| apsaraso nadīrūpā hīrakāḥ kaṃkarāstathā | amṛtaṃ tu tadā bhūtvā vārirasamayo dravaḥ ||18|| ṛddhismṛddhiramārāmā bhūtvā rūpāntarātmikāḥ | jagmuḥ samudramadhyādhastale viśrāntimāpnuvan ||19|| devabhogyāni ratnāni daityabhogyāni naiva hi | tadā sa vismayāviṣṭo balirāha guruṃ prati ||1.90.20|| balājjitāni ratnāni peturjalamahārṇave || śukraḥ prāhāśvamedhānāṃ śatenāptvā sureśatām ||21|| yastiṣṭhati surarājāsane ratnāni tasya vai || aśvamedhaśataṃ kṛtvā teṣāṃ bhoktā na saṃśayaḥ ||22|| aśvamedhairvinā kiñcitsvargīyaṃ naiva bhujyate | gurorvacanamājñāya baliḥ prāha guruṃ tadā ||23|| yatiṣye prāptasamaye nedānīṃ samayo’sti saḥ | athendro’pi śikṣitaḥ śrībrahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā ||24|| brahmāṇaṃ lokapālām̐śca puraskṛtya surāstathā | munīn devām̐ścāgamat sa samudraṃ kṣīrasāgaram ||25|| prāptā vimṛśya te sarve hariṃ stotuṃ pracakramuḥ || devānāṃ duḥkhaharṣe te kṣīrasāgaravāsine ||26|| sarvāntaryāmiṇe tasmai śayānāya namo namaḥ || kālakṛtaṃ mahāduḥkhaṃ devānāṃ samupasthitam ||27|| pravidhotuṃ ca duḥkhaṃ tat tvamevāsi balānvitaḥ | devadeva jagattrātaḥ paramātmannamo’stu te ||28|| kṛpālurbhagavan bhūtvā rakṣa surānsvakāndrutam | guroravajñayā cāpi durvāsaso’vamānanāt ||29|| śatakraturbhraṣṭarājyo’bhavattaṃ vai samuddhara || tadā tu bhagavānāha madaḥ pātityakārakaḥ ||1.90.30|| guroravajñayā sarvaṃ nāśaṃ yātyakhilaṃ svakam || pitrorgurostathā patyuḥ patnyāḥ sādhvyāḥ satāṃ tathā ||31|| gavāṃ caivāpamānasya kartṝṇāṃ syānmahān kṣayaḥ || kṛtamindreṇa tādṛgvai taddoṣātsakalaṃ jagat ||32|| kṣaṇādduḥkhaṃ samāpannaṃ sadya eva nirīkṣyatām || viparīto yadā kālastadā sarvaṃ samāpayet ||33|| viparīte tadā kāle dhairyamālambya sandhinā | śatruṇāpi militvaiva svakāryaṃ sādhayet sudhīḥ ||34|| ata indra tvayā kāryo daityaiḥ saha samāgamaḥ| militvā naṣṭaratnāni prāpsyante tūdyamātpunaḥ ||35|| sāhāyyado bhaviṣyāmi samudramathane’nvaham || daityā devā militvaiva prāpsyāmaḥ svadhanaṃ punaḥ ||36|| ityājñaptastadā cendro jagāma sutalaṃ balim | āśrito vinayī bhūtvā nanāma prabalaṃ balim ||37|| balināpi tadā dṛṣṭo niḥśrīko niṣprabho’madaḥ || vimatsaro gatatejāḥ surarājo mahartimān ||38|| nirmadaṃ taṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā dayāpanno balistadā || uvācendraṃ tu sāmānya prahasanniva dākṣyataḥ ||39|| kasmādihāgataḥ śakra sutalaṃ prati kathyatām | jijñāsamānaṃ jñātāraṃ samayajñaṃ baliṃ tadā ||1.90.40|| indraḥ prāha bale sarvaratnāni vigatāni vai || yathā vayaṃ tathā yūyaṃ ratnahīnāḥ kaliśritāḥ ||41|| mama rājyaṃ tvayā nītaṃ kālavegena vigrahāt | na te bhogyaṃ jāyate tadvinendrapadavīṃ nṛpa ||42|| daityahastagatānyeva ratnāni subahūnyapi | ayogyānīti tānyeva yatratyāni gatāni tat ||43|| idānīṃ rājyaratnādivihīno’haṃ talādhipa || tasmātprayatnaḥ kartavyo ratnānāṃ labdhaye tvayā ||44|| śaraṇārthamahaṃ prāptaḥ suraiḥ saha tavāntikam || amṛtaṃ tu samudrādvai punarāptavyameva ha ||45|| tatra te tu yathāyogyaṃ svatvaṃ dāsye tu labdhijam | devā daityā militvaiva samudramathanaṃ muhuḥ ||46|| kariṣyāmastadā tatra gatāni yāni tāni vai || lapsyāmahe śaraṇyastvaṃ sāhāyyaṃ dātumarhasi ||47|| evamuktastadendreṇa balidaityapatiḥ svayam | vimṛśya parayā buddhyā kāryākāryavicakṣaṇaḥ ||48|| śakraṃ saṃpūjayāmāsa bahumānapuraḥsaram || śakraḥ saṃsmṛtya vacanaṃ viṣṇoḥ svārthaprasādhanam ||49|| prāptavyāni tvayā vīra ratnāni subahūnyapi | śīghraṃ coddharaṇe daitya yatno manthe vidhīyatām ||1.90.50|| evaṃ sa samayaṃ kṛtvā yatnārthamakaronmanaḥ || balirāha tadā śakraṃ kenendra mathanaṃ bhavet ||51|| tadā nabhogatā vāṇī viṣṇurūpātmikā śubhā | uvāca devadaityāṃśca manthata kṣīrasāgaram ||52|| mandarācalamanthānaṃ manthanarajjuvāsukim || kṛtvā devāśca daityāśca saṃhṛtya kurutārthadam ||53|| iti śrutvā tadā daityā udyamaṃ kartumutsukāḥ || pātālebhyo nirgatāste dānavā asurādayaḥ ||54|| koṭiśaste tadā cātha devā api tu koṭiśaḥ || udyuktā brahmaviṣṇubhyāṃ yuktā yayuśca mandaram ||55|| candraṃ spṛśate yacchṛgaṃ pādāni balisattale | śroṇīḥ pṛthvyāṃ tu yasyāsti mandaraṃ taṃ namāmahe ||56|| anekadevasaṃvāsa ratnānāmākarākaram | sarvauṣadhisamākīrṇaṃ natāḥ smo girimandaram ||57|| adre surā vayamatra sāhāyyārthaṃ samāgatāḥ | balirindro babhāṣāte prastāvasadṛśaṃ vacaḥ ||58 amṛtotpādanasyārthe manthastvaṃ bhava gotraja || tatheti matvā śailendraḥ prāha tacchṛṇvatāṃ vacaḥ ||59|| tvayā vajreṇa pakṣau me śātitau hi sureśvara ||| kathamāyāmi gacchāmi vyomamārgaṃ vinā taṭam ||1.90.60|| tadā mahābalā devā daityāśca militā girim | mūlādutpāṭayāmāsurdhṛtvā skandheṣu taṃ tadā ||61|| kṣīrābdhitaṭamāptuṃ vai jagmurbahubaleśvarāḥ || devā daityā mandarātibhārākrāntā bahuśramāḥ ||62|| mārge eva niṣeduśca mandaraḥ patito bhuvi || tadadhastānmṛtāḥ kecitkecidbhagnā vimūrchitāḥ ||63|| punarnetuṃ na vai śaktā mṛtaśokaparāyaṇāḥ || ratnāni tu kadāpsyante hyete tu jīvato gatāḥ ||64|| māsmābhiḥ prāṇahā yatnaḥ kartavyaścāśayā hyayam| dūre tiṣṭhantu ratnāni parvato’pyatra tiṣṭhatu ||65|| vayaṃ svaṃ svaṃ tu vivaraṃ gamiṣyāmaḥ sukhāśrayam | evaṃ nirāśā bhūtvaivābhavam̐stūṣṇīṃ kimīkṣakāḥ ||66|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bṛhaspatisamutpāditakṛtyayā durvāsasaḥ śāpapuruṣeṇa ca svargaṃ parābhūtaṃ ratnāni samudre gatāni brahmendrādayo viṣṇuṃ nītvā balinā daityaiśca sandhāya samudramathanārthaṃ mandarācalānayanayatnavanto’bhavannitinirūpaṇanāmā navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||90||
<1.91> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca paśya lakṣmi parvatodvāhane kaṣṭaṃ tu kīdṛśam || asādhye tu mahākārye duḥkhaṃ pūrva tataḥ sukham || 1|| viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ tadā devān daityān prāha hitaṃ vacaḥ || eṣa āyāmi gṛhṇāmi cottolayāmi parvatam || 2 || mṛtā bhavantu saprāṇāḥ svasthāśca subalāstathā | mā hṛdbalaṃ parityājyaṃ mā kāryā hāsyapātratā || 3 || ityevaṃ procya pakṣīndraṃ garuḍaṃ prāha connaya | līlayā tolayitvaiva cañcvā taṃ garuḍastataḥ || 4 || kṣīrodadheruttare tu taṭe nikṣipya tatsthalāt | gato vaikuṇṭhameveti devā daityādayastadā || 5 || vāsukiṃ varayāmāsū rajjvarthaṃ so’pi cāgataḥ | manthanaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā vāsukiṃ rajjumeva ca || 6 || kṛtvā surāsurāḥ sarve mamanthuḥ kṣīrasāgaram | devā mukhaṃ parigṛhya yadā tu saṃsthitāstadā || 7 || daityāḥ prāhurvayaṃ pucche na sthāsyāmo’timānitāḥ || kṛtvā devān hariḥ pucche mukhe daityām̐ścakāra ha || 8 || kṣīrābdhau mathyamāne ca vāsukyasthnāṃ viyojanām | tadā jātaṃ vāsukiśca mṛta evopadṛśyate || 9 || atha viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ tatra praviṣṭo rajjurūpataḥ || vāsukiśca tadā puṣṭo balamāsādya saṃsthitaḥ ||1.91.10|| athāpi mathyamāne’tha parvato’pi gurutvataḥ || vimagno’gāttale nītvā devāndaityānpramanthakān ||11|| tadā viṣṇurabhūtkūrmo gatvā vārdhitalāṃ svayam || ūḍhvā taṃ nijapṛṣṭhe sa dadhāreti tadadbhutama ||12|| athāpi mathyamāne’tha pārśve namati mandaraḥ || taṃ tu sthiraṃ tadā kartuṃ madhye mūrdhānamāsthitaḥ ||13|| viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ caturbhyāṃ vai dorbhyāṃ dhṛtvā vyavasthitaḥ || tadā surāsurāḥ sarve mamanthuḥ kṣīrasāgaram ||14|| kaṭhoraṃ kamaṭhapṛṣṭhaṃ kaṭhoro mandarācalaḥ || dvayoḥ saṃgharṣajo vahnirabhūt tatra bhayaṃkaraḥ ||15|| jvālāmālāmahāvyāpto didhakṣanniva sāgaram || devā daityāśca taṃ dṛṣṭvā pradudruvuritastataḥ ||16|| prāha viṣṇustadā sarvān mā bhayaṃ gacchato’khilāḥ || praśāmyāmi kṣaṇādenaṃ paśyantu mama pauruṣam ||17|| saṃkarṣaṇastadā bhūtvā viṣṇurmukhaṃ vivṛtya ca | śvāsamekaṃ jagṛhe’tha vahnirudaramāviśat ||18|| athāpi mathyamāne’pi viṣaṃ hālāhalaṃ hyabhūt || maholbaṇaṃ mahādhūmraṃ mahābāṣpatanūlbaṇam ||19|| vyomni sarvatra cāvyāpnod bāṣparūpaṃ vināśakam || yatra yatra gataṃ tatra prāṇino’nāśayatkṣaṇāt ||1.91.20|| śvāsaṃ nītvā tadā sarve mūrchitāḥ śūnyatāṃ gatāḥ | mahadviṣaṃ tale cāsīd yāvadvahirna cāgatam ||21|| tāvantu tatsthalaṃ tyaktvā viṣṇunāradabodhitāḥ | amūrchitā devadaityāḥ śaṃkaraṃ prati cāyayuḥ ||22|| bahudhā prārthayāmāsuḥ viṣanāśāya śaṃkaram || māṃgalyaṃ maṃgalānāṃ ca devaṃ paśupatiṃ vibhum ||23|| sañjīvaya mahādeva tvaṃ trātā tripurāntaka | rakṣolbaṇādgaralāt tvaṃ kālakūṭānmṛtīśvara ||24|| evamabhyarthitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ prāha sarvānsurāsurān || matputraṃ vighnahartāraṃ śrīgaṇeśaṃ tu ye janāḥ ||25|| na pūjayanti cāraṃbhe kāryasiddhirna saṃbhavet || pratyuta jāyate vighno nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||26|| asmābhirnirmito devo gaṇeśaḥ kāryasiddhaye || yūyaṃ sarve mahāmagnāḥ pāṇḍityakāṇḍakatthanāḥ ||27|| gaṇeśaṃ nābhisaṃpūjya kāryāraṃbhakarā yataḥ || kālakūṭaṃ viṣaṃ tasmād vighnārthaṃ samupasthitam ||28|| tasmānnamantu taṃ devaṃ pūjayantvadya eva hi | vighnaṃ naṣṭaṃ bhavet sadyo mātra vilambayantu vai ||29|| anyathā hi kṛte hyarthe’nyathātvaṃ saṃbhavet kila | yadi devo na pūjyeta kāryasiddhikaraḥ sutaḥ ||1.91.30|| kāryasiddhirna teṣāṃ vai bhavettu bhavatāṃ yathā || drāgeva śaṃbhuvacanaṃ gṛhītvā te surādayaḥ ||31|| pūjayanti gaṇeśaṃ sma kailāse śaṃkaragṛhe || āvāhanaṃ cāsanaṃ ca pādyamācamanārghake ||32|| pañcāmṛtakṛtasnānamabhiṣekāplavastathā vastreṇa mārjanaṃ vastraṃ yajñopavītameva ca ||33|| abīraṃ ca gulālaṃ ca sindūrakaṃ ca kuṃkumam || akṣatāśca tathā dūrvāṃkurāṇi dhūpadīpakau ||34|| candanaṃ puṣpahāraścābhūṣaṇāni prabhojanam || jalapānaṃ laḍḍukāśca tāmbūlārārtrike tathā ||35|| pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavacca namaskāraḥ stutistathā || phalāni ca kṣamāyāñcā vandanaṃ kusumāñjaliḥ ||36|| dvātriṃśadupacāraiḥ saḥ pūjitastejasā jvalan | santuṣṭaḥ san gaṇādhyakṣo devānāṃ varado’bhavat ||37|| sagaṇeśaḥ tadā śaṃbhuḥ prasanno’bdhiṃ jagāma ha || bāṣpātmakaṃ viṣaṃ tatra grasitvā śvāsavāyunā ||38|| hālāhalaṃ mahākṣveḍamākṛṣyābdhitalātsvayam || papau brahmapratāpena kaṇṭhe rarakṣa tadviṣam ||39|| śuṣkīkṛtaṃ samādhisthayogaiśvaryeṇa śaṃbhunā || tatra tvaci gale kṛṣṇatilaṃ pariṇataṃ tu tat ||1.91.40|| kaṇṭhe nīlatilāttasya nīlakaṃṭhābhidhābhavat | viṣapānasya samaye kṣūyamānasya dhūrjaṭeḥ ||41|| svalpā viṣakaṇāḥ śvāsād bahirye patitāśca tān || gṛhṇanto dehino jīvā ye te viṣāḍhyajātayaḥ ||42|| daṃdaśūkāśca sarpāśca vṛścikāḥ kṛkalāsakāḥ || godhāśca jalalālāśca kharjanākaṭuvallayaḥ ||43|| samabhavam̐stato’pyete mamanthurmandarācalam jalaśaityadyanāvasthahimadehastu candramāḥ ||44|| dvitīyāyāḥ kalārūpaḥ pīyūṣasaṃbhṛtastadā || atiśītaṃ tu taṃ jñātvā jagṛhurna surāsurāḥ ||45|| śaṃbhurviṣoṣṇatā vyāptaḥ śītāṃśuṃ jagṛhe bhruvi || bhṛguḥ prāha tadā devān grahāḥ sarvepi cottamāḥ ||46|| kāryasiddhiṃ praśaṃsanti yatnaṃ kuruta līlayā | candraṃ guruḥ samāyāto budhaścaiva samāgataḥ ||47|| sūryaścaiva tathā śukraḥ śanirmaṃgala eva ca || tasmāccandrabalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kāryasya siddhaye bhavet ||48|| gomantanāmako’yaṃ ca muhūrto’sti jayapradaḥ || etacchrutvā balaṃ te tu dviguṇaṃ prāpya garjitāḥ ||49|| mamanthurabdhiṃ tvaritāstāvatsurabhirgauḥ sadā || kāmadughā kapilā sā tūdho bhāravatī śanaiḥ ||1.91.50|| jalamārgāttīramāyāt sarvaiḥ saṃpūjitā ca sā || yeṣāṃ dugdhaṃ bhaved bhogyaṃ tairneyā seti nirṇaye ||51|| ṛṣibhirdevakāryārthaṃ yajñārthaṃ ca svakīkṛtā || tāvadanyāḥ sitāḥ pītāḥ kṛṣṇā aruṇapāṇḍurāḥ ||52|| haridvarṇāścitravarṇā gāvo’nekāstato’bhavan | viprāstu munayastā vai jagṛhire pramāṇataḥ ||53|| atha sarve susaṃrabdhā mamanthuḥ kṣīrasāgaram | kalpavṛkṣastathā pārijāta āmrādayo drumāḥ ||54|| jajñire’tha ca tānsarvān taṭe’sthāpayadacyutaḥ | punaḥ saṃmathyamānādvai kaustubhākhyaṃ mahāprabham ||55|| ratnānāmuttamaṃ ratnaṃ cintāmaṇisamanvitam || hīrakaiśca sahotpannaṃ kaustubhaṃ viṣṇave daduḥ ||56|| cintāmaṇiḥ sureśāya daityebhyo hīrakāndaduḥ | athāpi mathyamānāttaduccaiḥśravasamadbhutam ||57|| bahubhiraśvajātīyairutpannaṃ haraye daduḥ || athāpi mathyamānādvai catuḥṣaṣṭigajānvitam ||58|| airāvataṃ mahāratnaṃ caturdantamadānvitam | pāṇḍuraṃ śṛṃgisadṛśaṃ turāṣāhe’pi taṃ daduḥ ||59|| anye gajāśca bahavo lokapālebhya ārpitāḥ | athāpi mathyamānādvai madirā vijayā tathā ||1.91.60|| kaṭuśṛṃgī cāhiphenaṃ gṛñjanaṃ laśunaṃ tathā || dhattūraśca tamālaśconmādakā abhavam̐stadā ||61|| daityaiśca tāmasaistāni gṛhītāni prasahya vai || athāpi mathyamānādvai lakṣmīḥ prādurbabhūva ha ||62|| surūpā hāsyavadanā vastrābharaṇabhūṣitā || gauravarṇā divyatanvī yauvanāṃkurasustanī ||63|| karāptavanamālā ca nārāyaṇasarūpiṇī || nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ viṣṇuṃ mārgayantīva mohikā ||64|| ānvīkṣikī brahmavidyā mūlavidyā sarasvatī | ṛddhiḥ siddhiḥ smṛddhiḥ sampadvaiṣṇavī prakṛtiḥ parā ||65|| yuktānyābhiḥ sudāsībhiḥ sugrīvā cārulocanā | bimbauṣṭhī sunasā snigdhā sudatī ca sumadhyamā ||66|| nānāratnaprakāśaiśca nīrājitamukhāmbujā | saumyapremabhṛtanetrā nūpuraraśanādharā ||67|| mūrdhani dhriyamāṇena svarṇachatreṇa rājitā | cāmarairvijyamānā ca stūyamānā sakhījanaiḥ ||68| pāṇḍuraṃgagajārūḍhā vīkṣitāśca surāsuraiḥ || devāṃśca dānavān siddhām̐ścāraṇānpannagānnagān ||69|| vīkṣya daityānsadoṣānsā yogyaṃ viṣṇumacintayat || sarve tadā vismitāśca mudamāpustadādbhutam ||1.91.70|| lakṣmyā vṛto mahāviṣṇurlakṣmīstenaiva saṃvṛtā | evaṃ parasparaṃ prītyā vavrāte prematatparau ||71|| sarvaiḥ sabhājitau ratnairnīrājitau prapūjitau | śuśubhāte tadā lakṣmīnārāyaṇau jagadgurū||72|| praṇamya saccidānandaṃ ramāyuktaṃ janārdanam || sarve mamanthurvegena jajñe dhanvantaristataḥ ||73|| so’yaṃ dhanvantarirvaidyaḥ pūrvaṃ yaḥ kathito mayā | tṛtīyo vaidyasāmudro yuvā mṛtyujayo’jitaḥ ||74|| sudhāsampūrṇakalaśaṃ pāṇibhyāṃ parigṛhya ca | rūpeṇa vayasā kāntyādharīkṛtya surāsurān ||75|| samudrāttīramāyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā tastaṃbhurīśvarāḥ| na jñātavanto yāvatte sudhāṃ cāsya karasthitām ||76|| mathyamānārṇavālāvalakṣamapsarasāṃ śubham || samutpannaṃ sthitaṃ tīre dhanvantarī sumohitam ||77|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne samudre mandaramanthane viṣṇurūpāṇi manthanotpannasya vaḍavānalasya saṃkarṣaṇakṛtaṃ pānaṃ śaṃkarakṛtaṃ viṣasyapānaṃ gaṇeśapūjanaṃ vividharatnotpattiśceti nirūpaṇanāmā ekanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||91||
<1.92> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tvayā tulyāstanvyo dvādaśahāyanāḥ | apsarasaḥ surūpāśca śaśiśītalamadhyamāḥ || 1 || svargaṃ jagmuḥ svakaṃ sthānaṃ tvājñayā śrīharestataḥ || paśyatāṃ daityavaryāṇāṃ dānavādipramāthinām || 2 || dhanvantariṃ tadā prāha dānavendro baliḥ svayam | bhagavan kiṃ dhṛtaṃ haste kalaśe’tra prapūritam || 3 || svakaṃ vā sārvajanikaṃ sudhā notpadyate kutaḥ | dhanvantarirbaliṃ prāha sudhātra kalaśe sthitā || 4 || nātaḥ parā samudre vai sudhā svalpāpi śiṣyate || tāvattu daityadhaureyā hartukāmād balād yayuḥ || 5 || vṛṣaparvā mahādaityo ghaṭaṃ nītvā palāyitaḥ || asurāstu tadā sarve jagarjuritibhīṣaṇam || 6 || mandaraṃ vāsukiṃ tyaktvā labdhakāryāḥ svamāninaḥ | svārthamātraparāstatrāmṛtaṃ labdhvāticukruśuḥ || 7 ||| nārāyaṇo garuḍena mandaraṃ nītavān sthale | anyarūpāṇi saṃhṛtya saṃsthito’bdhitare prabhuḥ || 8 || daityāḥ sudhādharaṃ nītvā palāyante payo’rṇavāt | ratnānyanyāni devaistu gṛhītānyeva kevalam || 9 || tasmātsudhāṃ grahīṣyāmo’nyebhyo dāsyāma eva na | ityuccārya sudhāṃ nītvā palāyante tu yāvatā ||1.92.10|| tāvadviṣṇuḥ svayaṃ kanyā babhūva mohinī śubhā | śvetatejaḥ pūritāṃgā samaṃkuritayauvanā ||11|| mitahāsyā kaṃjanetrā hāvabhāvavilāsinī | anaṃgapūrṇā netrābhyāmāhvayantī vilāsinaḥ ||12|| netrāpāṃgaiḥ sudhāyuktaṃ daityaṃ cānyān vimohitum || teṣāṃ pālāyane mārge samīpe samupasthitā ||13|| ślathayantī śanairnīvīṃ vastraṃ hastena bibhratī || sakthistanau darśayantī kāmavyāpteva kāminī ||14|| daityā ayatnalabhyāṃ tāṃ parirabdhuṃ prapedire | ahaṃ pūrvamahaṃ pūrvaṃ mama bhāryā na vai tava ||15|| mayā netreṇa pūrvaṃ vai dṛṣṭā ca dyotitā mayā | na tvayeti muhurmugdhāḥ sudhāṃ tyaktvā parasparam ||16 tadā vivadire devī sudhāyāḥ kalaśaṃ kare | dhṛtvā prāha ca tāndaityān matkṛte vivadantu mā ||17|| sudhāpānaṃ kārayitvā no bhajiṣye sadāmṛtān | ye vai mayoktaṃ gṛhṇīyustānpāsyāmi sudhāmṛtam ||18|| teṣāṃ dāsī bhavāmyeva bhujyatāṃ pramadāmṛtam | dhanyā yūyaṃ mahābhāgā vinā yatnena cāgatam ||19|| prāpsyatha pramadāratnaṃ sudhāpānottara dhruvam | aho mayātra saṃsāre narāḥ sarve’valokitāḥ ||1.92.20|| bhavatāṃ sadṛśā naiva jñātāro bhadrakāriṇaḥ | śāntā vibhajya bhoktāro viśvastā nirmalāntarāḥ ||21|| paropakāradharmajñāḥ strīvaconyastanirṇayāḥ | strīṇāṃ sukhena sukhinaḥ strīkṛcchāsanamārdavāḥ ||26|| strīpradattaprabhoktāro dhanyā yūyaṃ bhavādṛśāḥ | vidvāṃso naiva kurvanti viśvāsaṃ pramadājane ||23|| vṛthā doṣānkalpayanti māyāsāhasamanṛtam | atilobho’timūrkhatvamaśaucaṃ nirdayālutā ||24|| asneho dhūrtatā svārthaḥ pracchannakāritādayaḥ || mamāsti yadi viśvāsastadā pibantu matkarāt ||25|| sarva tiṣṭhantu paṃktyā vai nāpāṃkto’mṛtamaśnute vāme devāḥ pratiṣṭhantu dakṣiṇe daityadānavāḥ ||26|| dvayoḥ pariveṣayitrī bhavāmi nyāyataḥ kramāt | eṣā ghaṭaṃ ca gṛhṇāmi dadhatvagre prapāpuṭam ||27|| mohinī cetyabhidhāya tūṣṇīmāsīt kṣaṇaṃ hṛdi | paścādvicārya provāca hṛdyaṃ sarvābhisammatam ||28|| śṛṇvantu cāsurāḥ sarve bhavanto jyeṣṭhapūrvajāḥ || avibhajya na bhoktavyaṃ yallabdhaṃ sārvayatnikam ||29|| surāsurāṇāṃ yatnastu samāno’styabdhimanthane | kiñcidapi pramāthibhyo nyāyyaṃ deyaṃ sudhāmṛtam ||1.92.30|| mahadbhyaścādhikaṃ deyaṃ svalpebhyo nyūnameva ca | balābale parijñāyāvaśyaṃ deyaṃ pramāthine ||31|| yatne ye tu sahārthāḥ syuḥ phale tu pakṣapātinaḥ || teṣāṃ pātaḥ sadā bhāvī labdhārtho’pi vinaśyati ||32|| asurāṇāṃ yadi mānyaṃ maduktaṃ nyāyato bhavet || tadā surebhyo dātavyamamṛtaṃ bhāgaśaḥ kṛtam ||33|| pucche surā mukhe yūyaṃ madhye devo janārdanaḥ || tasmādardhaṃ surebhyaścāsurebhyo’rdhaṃ pradīyate ||34|| balistatra pramāṇaṃ vai kāryākāryavicakṣaṇaḥ || evameva baliḥ prāha sarve prāhuśca omiti ||35|| athāmṛtavibhāgārthaṃ ghaṭo’nyo’pyarthitastvayā || daityaistu saṃbhramāt tūrṇaṃ ghaṭo rikto’tra yo bhavet ||36|| dātavya iti kṛtvaiva madirāyā ghaṭaśca yaḥ || madirāpātṛbhiḥ pītvā madirāṃ tu visarjitaḥ ||37|| rikto ghaṭaḥ pradattaḥ sa mohinyā saṃdhṛtastataḥ || madirāyā ghaṭe tasmim̐ścānamayya sudhāghaṭam ||38|| yathārdhamamṛtaṃ tatra dīyate dhārayā tathā || mṛṣaiva darśitaṃ sarvaṃ mohinyā svaprabhāvataḥ ||39|| dṛśyate cāmṛtaṃ kṣiptaṃ jāyate madirā tu sā || sāpi mṛṣaiva madirā miṣṭā cāmṛtasadṛśī ||1.92.40|| saṃklṛptā madirā mithyā mohinyā māyayā svayā || amṛtaṃ ceti vai tatrāsurāṇāṃ niścayo’bhavat ||41|| satyāmṛtaghaṭaṃ vāme mithyāmṛtaṃ tu dakṣiṇe | kare dhṛtvā mohinī sā paṃktimadhye cacāra vai ||42|| sā mithyāmadirādānaṃ karotyasurapātrake| satyāmṛtapradānaṃ tu karoti surapātrake ||43|| pradadāti samastām̐śca mohayatyapi narmaṇā | agre tvagre gatā tuṣṭā datvā datvāsurānsurān ||44|| praśaṃsantaḥ pibanti sma devā daityādayastathā | ghaṭukaṃ ghaṭukaṃ pītvā ḍakārayanti tṛptitaḥ ||45|| mohinyapi tadā devān pibatāmṛtamutsavāt | daityān prāhāsvādayantu miṣṭaṃ paramamutsavāt ||46|| aho surāṇāṃ paramo bhāgyodaya upasthitaḥ| yadamṛtaṃ prāpyate’dyāsvādayantu muhurmuhuḥ ||47|| aho devā pibantvatrāmṛtaṃ bhāgyāvalambitam || indra sūrya śaśinnagre jaleśa yama nirṛta ||48|| kubereśāna vāyo maṃgala cāndra bṛhaspate | dharma vasavo rudrāśca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ||49|| nidhayaḥ ṛṣayaḥ sādhyā nakṣatrā maruto’pi ca | gandharvāḥ kinnarāḥ kiṃpuruṣā vidyādhraviśvinaḥ ||1.92.50|| saṃvatsarāḥ pāvakāḥ pitaro devyaśca pārṣadāḥ | pibantvamṛtamākaṇṭhaṃ divyabhāṇḍātpradīyate ||51|| atha daityānprasaṃbodhya mohinī prāha vai śaṭhā || bale rājan vṛṣaparvan namuce śaṃkhabudbudau ||52|| sudaṃṣṭra śṛṇu saṃhlāda kālaneme vibhīṣaṇa || vātāpe celvala kuṃbha nikuṃbha praghasa śṛṇu ||53|| upasunda bho niśuṃbha śuṃbha bho sunda saṃśṛṇu | mātaṃga māhiṣa mahiṣa biḍālāsya ca cikṣura ||54|| bahubāho jṛṃbha vṛṣa vibāho ghoradarśana | ghorākṣa bho mahādaityāḥ śṛṇvantu pānakālikam ||55|| nāyaṃ lābho bhavetkvāpi mama hastātsukomalāt | kumārikākarāt prāptaṃ svādānandaṃ bhajantviha ||56|| nāsā netre tu sammīlya gṛhṇantu ghuṭakān bahūn | dāsye punaḥ punaḥ peyaṃ mṛṣā deho’yamityataḥ ||57|| saṃpibantu mahābhāgā nāmnāpyamṛtavatsukham || prāptaṃ yasya tu satyaṃ sa jāyate tvamṛtaḥ sadā ||58|| vadamānā dadānā ca ramyāgre yāti mohinī || vākyārthajño rāhunāmā jānanvai svāmṛtaṃ mṛṣā ||59|| satyāmṛtaprapānāya devānāṃ rūpadhārakaḥ || upaviṣṭo devapaṃktau madhye candrārkayoḥ kramāt ||1.92.60|| mohinī pradadānā cāgatā tatra kramāgatam || sūryaṃ rāhuṃ tathā candraṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā dadau sudhām ||61|| tāvatsūryeṇa saṃdiṣṭo rāhuḥ paṃktau praveśitaḥ || śaśināpi sa ādiṣṭo devo nāyaṃ surārirāṭ ||62|| mohinī tu nijaṃ kāryaṃ karotyagre pragacchati || viṣṇurūpaḥ svayaṃ rāhoḥ śiraściccheda cakrataḥ ||63|| galordhvaṃ sudhayā vyāptaṃ kabandhaḥ klinatāṃ gataḥ || ekasmāttu sudhāyogād rāhuketū babhūvatuḥ ||64|| dvau tau cāmaratāṃ prāptau grahāvabhavatāṃ tataḥ || śiraḥ ketuḥ kabandhastu rāhurgraho’sti daityarāṭ ||65|| sūryaṃ parvaṇi grasati kvaciccandraṃ sa rāhukaḥ || tau dvau tadā sudhāṃ tyaktvā paṃktito vai palāyitau ||66|| dhūmrarūpo’bhavatpūrvaṃ dhūmrarūpau babhūvatuḥ || ākāśe bhramati so’yaṃ dhūmraketurgraho hi saḥ ||67|| diteḥ putrāstathā cānye vyomni vai dhūmraketavaḥ | na sūryaṃ na ca candraṃ te grasante na grahā yataḥ ||68|| athaitat kautukaṃ vīkṣya śaṃkamānā tu mohinī || tadānīṃ tvaritā paṃktau devānapāyayatsudhām ||69|| rāhuṇā dvisvarūpeṇa daityebhyastatra sūcitam | yuṣmābhirnāmṛtaṃ pītaṃ pītā yā madirā tu sā ||1.92.70|| nāryā paṃktivibhedastu kṛto nāśakaro mahān || tasmādyuddhaṃ prakurvantu mārayantu surāndrutam ||71|| kāpaṭyena tayā dattā madirāpi mṛṣātmikā || viṣṇunā strīsvarūpeṇa devebhyaścārpitā sudhā ||72|| yaugapadyena sarvaistu kṣīrābdhermathanaṃ kṛtam || siddhirjātā hi devānāmasiddhistu surāriṇām ||73|| vinā daivena jānīdhvamudyamaṃ hi nirarthakam || tataḥ kopānalo māyāmohitāsuramaṇḍale ||74|| prodbhūtastena śastrāstrairyutā yuddhāya niryayuḥ || devāścāpi tathā sajjā babhūvurbhayavarjitāḥ ||75|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne asurāṇā pratāraṇāya mohinīrūpa viṣṇunā devebhyaḥ sudhā daityebhyo mṛṣāmadirā pāyitā rāhuśiracchedaḥ ketugrahaśca kṛta ityādi nirūpaṇanāmā dvinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 92 ||
<1.93> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca asurā garjamānāste ākṣipanto raṇe surān | śatakoṭipramukhyāśca balena balinā saha || 1 || pradudruvuḥ surām̐ste vai mahābalaparākramān || svāni rūpāṇi bibhrantaḥ samāpeduḥ sahasraśaḥ || 2 || kecidvyāghrakṛtasvārāḥ kecinmahiṣapṛṣṭhagāḥ || kecidaśvasamārūḍhā dvipapṛṣṭhasthitāḥ pare || 3 || siṃhārūḍhāstathā kecitkeciccharabhavāhanāḥ || kecidgṛdhrasamārūḍhāḥ kecicchārdūlapṛṣṭhagāḥ || 4 || kecitkuliṃgamayūrahaṃsakākādivāhanāḥ| anye makarakūrmoṣṭraśvāśvajambūkapṛṣṭhagāḥ || 5 || evaṃ paśuklṛptavāhāḥ pakṣipṛṣṭhāptavāhanāḥ || jalākāśādisaṃcāriprāṇipṛṣṭhāsanāstathā ll6|| rathayantraśakaṭādivahrivimānasaṃsthitāḥ| pādātyā bahavastatra khaḍgaśaktyṛṣṭipāṇayaḥ || 7 || paṭṭiśapāśaparighaśūlamudgalapāṇayaḥ bhūśuṇḍīchurikākhaḍgagadācakraśarāyudhāḥ Il8ll vimānānāṃ gajānāṃ ca rathānāṃ vājināṃ tathā | padgānāṃ tatra sainyāni balimukhyāni koṭiśaḥ || 9 || spardhamānāstato’nyonyaṃ garjamānā bhaṭā mithaḥ | bahukruddhā durādharṣā yoddhukāmā vyavasthitāḥ ||1.93.10|| vadanti sma ca viśvāso na kāryo durhṛdāṃ kvacit ||| na viśvasetpūrvavirodhiṣu svārthijaneṣvapi ||11|| yo viśvasedarātau sa kleśābdhiṃ mastake vahet | pūrvaṃ paricitā devā bahuvāraṃ tu dānavaiḥ ||12|| tatra punaḥ punaḥ śāṭhyaṃ kṛtavantasta eva tu | sudhā na pāyitāsmabhyaṃ manāgapi na dīyate ||13|| tasmādyuddhena nāśastu teṣāṃ kāryastato’mṛtam || svargarājyaṃ ca bhokṣyāmo vayaṃ yuddhārjitaṃ svakam ||14|| dhvajaiśchatraiḥ patākaiśca raṇabhūmimamaṇḍayan | cāmaraiḥ paṭahaiḥ śaṃkhaistūryaiśca dvigalaistathā ||15|| tadvat sarve surāścendrapramukhā raṇagāminaḥ | pītvāmṛtaṃ mahābhāgā vāhānāruhya daṃśitāḥ ||16|| svasvabalasamāyuktā daityānprati samutkaṭāḥ || gajārūḍho mahendraśca sūryaścoccaiḥśravaḥsthitaḥ ||17|| śaśārūḍhaḥ śaśī tadvad yamo mahiṣamāsthitaḥ || nairṛtaḥ pretapṛṣṭhastho varuṇo makare sthitaḥ ||18|| pavanastu mṛgārūḍho vṛṣārūḍhaḥ śivastathā || kuberaḥ puṣpakārūḍho devāścānye balānvitāḥ ||19|| vimānasthā lakṣalakṣāḥ pakṣisthāḥ koṭiśastathā || paśumṛgādivāhasthā hyarbudā devakoṭayaḥ ||1.93.20|| svasvābhimānasaṃyuktāḥ sarve devāstvarānvitāḥ || chatracāmarasaṃvītāḥ śobhitā vijayaśriyāḥ ||21|| viṣṇuṃ praṇamya saṃgrāme raṇe daityānupasthitāḥ | bhīmāstatrāsurāḥ sarve surāśca bhīmavikramāḥ ||22|| teṣāṃ ghoramabhūd yuddhaṃ daityadānavanākibhiḥ || mahāghoraṃ mahānāśaṃ sarvabhūtabhayāvaham ||23|| bāṇavarṣi śastraghāti cāstrakṣepi bhayānakam | śabdā hṛnnāśakā jātāḥ śarapātāstathābhavan ||24|| tīratomaranārācairāhatāstvapatan bhuvi | vadhyamānāstathā kecitsamādhiṃ tatra lebhire ||25|| bhallairbhagnā nipatitā nārācaiḥ śakalīkṛtāḥ | kṣuraiḥ prahāritāḥ kecinmudgaraiśca vipothitāḥ ||26|| śastraghātaiḥ prabhinnāśca chinnāśca bāṇapātanaiḥ || daityasainyaṃ mahāmārairbhagnaṃ devāśca prahṛṣuḥ ||27|| śaṃkhanādānprakurvāṇāḥ sūcayāṃcakrire jayam || devānprati kṛtāmarṣā dānavāste mahābalāḥ ||28|| baliprabhṛtayaḥ sarve saṃśrameṇotthitāḥ punaḥ || vimānaiḥ sūryasaṃkāśairanekaistvarayānvitāḥ ||29|| dvandvayuddhamabhūtteṣāṃ surāṇāmasuraiḥ saha || balinā dānavendreṇa mahendro yuyudhe tadā ||1.93.30|| yamo namucinā sārdhaṃ nairṛtaḥ praghasena ca | kuṃbhena saha varuṇo nikuṃbhena samīraṇaḥ ||31|| sudaṃṣṭreṇa kuberastu śeṣaiḥ śeṣā vavalmire| rāhuṃ ketuṃ samāyāntau dṛṣṭvā devāḥ palāyitāḥ ||32|| ketunā vyomasadṛśaṃ mukhaṃ svasya prasāritam | devānāṃ vai bhakṣaṇārthaṃ devāḥ pradudruvustadā ||33|| keciddhariṃ smaranti sma kecidbhaktyā vināyakam || kecid durgāṃ tathā śaṃbhuṃ brahmāṇaṃ cāpare’mṛtam ||34|| rāhuśiraḥ puraskṛtya daityā jayonmukhāḥ surān | tāḍayāmāsuratyugrāḥ śastrāstraprastarādibhiḥ ||35|| devāḥ palāyitā daityā jayaṃ samāpnuvam̐stadā | keturādau mukhaṃ svaṃ vai vyādāya grasituṃ harim ||36|| candraṃ śaktaṃ tathā sūryaṃ taṃ taṃ samīpamāgatam | udyukto’bhūdamṛto’sau vajreṇāpi na naśyati ||37|| tadā candro mahādevamastaut dhāvan kṛtāṃjaliḥ | tvaṃ śaṃbho trāhi māṃ deva śaraṇāgatarakṣaka ||38|| devām̐strāhi tathā sarvān ketuduḥkhaṃ vināśaya || evamabhyarthitaḥ śaṃbhurmā bhaiṣṭetyavadatsutān ||39|| ketustatrāgamaccandraṃ grasituṃ yāvadeva hi | dhṛtaśca śaṃbhunā keturmuṇḍamālāsu gumphitaḥ ||1.93.40|| ketū rūpadvayaṃ kṛtvā jagāma divi tatsthalāt || śaṃbhuṃ tadā puraskṛtya devā yuddhe mano dadhuḥ ||41|| surairdaityā hanyamānāḥ śastrāstrabāṇatomaraiḥ || nipeturbahavastatra kṣatā bhagnāśca kartitāḥ ||42|| cakrurbhuvaṃ mṛtā daityā māṃsaśoṇitakardamām || nadyo bhayāvahāstatra vahanti mṛtadānavān ||43|| dhvajayantrapatākānogajavājiśirāṃsi ca || agādhāḥ śoṇitodāśca pravahanti raṇāṃgaṇe ||44|| tathā tasminmahāraudre surāsurasamāgame || śaktyā jaghāna devendraṃ vairocaniramarṣaṇaḥ ||45|| śaktiṃ tāṃ vaṃcayitvendro baliṃ vajreṇa tatkṣaṇam || jaghāna bāhuṃ ciccheda bhūmāvapātayad baliḥ ||46|| vajreṇa ca punarvṛṣaparvāṇamapyapātayat || tatrāpi śatadhāreṇa vajreṇaiva punaḥ punaḥ ||47|| anyena hetinā cendro dānavānavadhīdraṇe || śirāṃsi kartitānyevendreṇa prakupitena vai ||48|| yamena vāyunā caiva varuṇena tathāgninā | nairṛtena kubereṇa śaṃbhunāpi vidāritāḥ ||49|| ityevaṃ kadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā kālanemimahāsuraḥ| siṃhastho daṃśitaścograḥ triśūlena samanvitaḥ ||1.93.50|| daityānāmarbudenaiva siṃhārūḍhena saṃgataḥ | siṃhasthāṃ daityasenāṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cendrapurogamāḥ ||51|| kiṃ kurmo’dya vayaṃ sarve jeṣyāmaḥ kathamāsurān | vinā viṣṇuṃ nāsya jetā kaścidanyo hi lakṣyate ||52|| iti viṣṇuṃ smarantaścāstuvannārāyaṇaṃ harim | namastubhyaṃ bhagavate namaste viśvanāyaka ||53|| śrīnivāsa namastubhyaṃ suratrātre namo namaḥ || trātumarhasi daityendrakālanemibhayādiha ||54|| śrutvā stotraṃ hariḥ śīghramāruhya garuḍe svakam | cakrapāṇiḥ samāyāto devānāṃ vijayāya vai ||55|| hariṃ dṛṣṭvā kālanemiḥ prahasyovāca roṣataḥ | kastvaṃ kathaṃ samāyāto mama śastrasya bhojanam ||56|| hariḥ prāha tadā daityaṃ yuddhārthaṃ samupāgataḥ | devānāṃ mūlabhūto’haṃ sthiro bhava sumṛtyave ||57|| sapakṣasiṃhasainyena kālanemirvihāyasā || yuyudhe sagaruḍena śāṅgapāṇisuviṣṇunā ||58|| garuḍena tadā tuṇḍapakṣanakhādihetibhiḥ || siṃhā daityāḥ pāṭitāśca khaṇḍitāśca vināśitāḥ ||59|| viṣṇunā svīyacakreṇa nihatāḥ śakalīkṛtāḥ | triśūlenāhanadviṣṇuṃ kālanemiḥ pratāpavān ||1.93.60|| vāmahastena saṃgṛhya triśūlaṃ tattu līlayā | tenaiva ca triśūlena kālanemiṃ jaghāna ha ||61|| mūrchitaḥ patitaścāthotthāyonmīlya svalocane | dhṛtvā khaḍgaṃ samadhāvadviṣṇuṃ tāvattu viṣṇunā ||62|| cakreṇa kartitaṃ tasya mastakaṃ tatkṣaṇāt khalu || anye daityāstu devaiśca hatā naṣṭā kṣayaṃ gatāḥ ||63|| kālanemirhato daityo devā jātā hyakaṃṭakāḥ || tirodhānaṃ gato viṣṇurindrastatrākarod dayām ||64|| patitaklībarūpāṇāṃ bhagnānāṃ bhītacetasām | muktakacchaśikhānāṃ ca cakre svāsthyakriyāṃ hariḥ ||65|| āyāt triviṣṭapaṃ cātha surasenānvito hariḥ || babhūvurmuditāḥ sarve yakṣagandharva kinnarāḥ ||66|| devarṣayo brahmarṣayaḥ procurindro’bhiṣicyatām || sa evendro’marāvatyāmabhiṣiktaḥ śacīyutaḥ ||67|| tadā mahotsavo lakṣmi devaloke paro’bhavat || śaṃkhapaṭahamṛdaṃgamurajānakagomukhāḥ ||68|| bherīdundubhitūryāṇi neduḥ svarge gṛhe gṛhe || jaguśca gāyakāḥ sarve gandharvāḥ kinnarāstathā ||69|| tuṣṭuvuśca tadā siddhagandharvacāraṇarṣayaḥ | nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇā utsavo’bhūtsthale sthale ||1.93.70|| śukrācāryo daityagurustapo’rthaṃ mānasottaram | gato’bhūt kṣayamāśrutya jagāma samarāṃgaṇe ||71|| saṃjivanyā vidyayā sa mṛtadaityānajīvayat || nidrāpāyagatā yadvadutthitāste tadāsurāḥ ||7|| te’pi sarve nivāsārthaṃ pātālamagaman sukham || sudhāpānapralābhena devā naivāmriyanta ha ||73|| vāhanādīni bhagavān saṃkalpenāpyajīvayat | iti devi samudrasya manthanaṃ tvabhavatpurā ||74| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sudhāpānabhedajanyadevāsurasaṃgrāmendrābhiṣekādinirūpaṇanāmā trinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||93||
<1.94> śrīlakṣmīruvāca nārāyaṇaṃ bhavantaṃ vai tyaktvā gaṇeśapūjanam | prathamaṃ vai kathaṃ kena kadā klṛptaṃ taducyatām || 1|| śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ ramyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇātmakabodhadām | sa cāṃśaḥ kṛṣṇacandrasya tathaivāyonisaṃbhavaḥ || 2 || mahālakṣmīḥ svayaṃ māyā dakṣakanyā babhūva ha || sā ca nāmnā satī śaṃbhornindayā dakṣajanyayā || 3 || dehaṃ tyaktvā menakāyāṃ himālayāttu pārvatī | jātā tāṃ parvataḥ putrīṃ śaṃkarāya dadau mudā || 4 || tāṃ gṛhītvā mahādevo jagāma vijanaṃ vanam || gārhasthyayogyakuṭyāṃ tu sadā nivasatostayoḥ || 5 || sahasravarṣaparyantaṃ śṛṃgāro hyabhavat sukhaḥ | devānāṃ garbhato janma putrāṇāṃ naiva jāyate || 6 || putrālabdhyā tu pārvatyāḥ sukhaṃ kiñcinna jāyate | dine dine gate tasyāḥ putraspṛhā vyavardhata || 7 || rateḥ phalaṃ sukhaṃ putro hyubhayaṃ saṃbhavatyapi || putraphalaṃ vinānando vārdhakye duḥkhado bhavet || 8 || putraśūnyaṃ ratimātraṃ bhāvyudvegāya kalpyate || vināpatyaṃ striyā kālakṣepaḥ kāryastu kena vai || 9 || patyā samaṃ rateḥ kālakṣepo bhavati svalpakaḥ || tadanyakālagamakaṃ striyo’patyaṃ bhavediha ||1.94.10|| lālane pālane tasya krīḍanakādikarmaṇi || samayo’tyeti nārīṇāṃ sa eva svarga ucyate ||11|| svāmisukhaṃ prathamaṃ ca svargaṃ dvitīyamaṃgajam | apatyasukhakṛtsvargaṃ tṛtīyaṃ dhanadhānyajam ||12|| caturthaṃ tu bhavetsvargamārogyaṃ paṃcamaṃ yaśaḥ | ityetānyeva saukhyāni svargāṇi laukikāni hi ||13|| iti cintānvitā nityaṃ reme svasvāminā saha | śaṃbhurvijñāya tadhārdaṃ tāṃ papraccha pativratām ||14|| kimicchasi priye nityaṃ kiṃ te manasi vartate | kiṃ vai cintayase ratyāṃ brūhi kriye tavepsitam ||15|| pārvatī prāha deveśa kiṃ me nyūnaṃ tavāntike | sarvadaḥ sarvalokānāṃ kartā labdho mayā yataḥ ||16|| yatra bhagavato vāsastatra syuḥ susamṛddhayaḥ | na nyūnaṃ nāpyaśāntiśca nālābhaḥ preṣṭhavastunaḥ ||17|| ṛtūttaraṃ tu nārīṇāṃ preṣṭhaḥ patistataḥ sutaḥ || mayā patistrilokeśaḥ prāpto’pi nāsti me sutaḥ ||18|| putreṣaṇā hṛdaye me jāgarti tava darśane | yadā yadā tu deveśa paśyāmi tvāṃ tadā tadā ||19|| saṃkalpo jāyate mohād balena cāgrapūjayā || patidevasamāno me kadā putro bhavediti ||1.94.20|| kāntānāṃ kāntavicchedaḥ prathamaṃ duḥkhamucyate || kāntasattve yadyaratidvitīyaṃ duḥkhamucyate ||21|| duḥkhātirekiduḥkhaṃ ca tṛtīyamanapatyatā || trailokyakāntaṃ kāntaṃ tvāṃ labdhvāpi na ca me sutaḥ ||22|| yā strī putravihīnāsyā jīvanaṃ tannirarthakam | janmāntarakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ tapodānajapādibhiḥ ||23|| tadā putraḥ prajāyeta paratreha sukhapradaḥ | suputro nijapitraṃśaḥ pitṛtulyasukhapradaḥ ||24|| kuputrastu kulāṃgāro manastāpāya kevalam || prārthayanti janāstasmāt suputro me bhavediti ||25|| svāmī svāṃśena sustrīṇāṃ garbhe janma labhed dhruvam || sādhvī strī mātṛtulyā ca satataṃ hitakāriṇī ||26|| asādhvī vairitulyā ca śaśvatsaṃtāpadāyinī | kimupāyaṃ kariṣyāmi vada putraphalaprada ||27|| ityuktvā pārvatī devī tūṣṇīmāsa yadā tadā || prahasya śaṃkaro devo bodhayāmāsa pārvatīm ||28|| śṛṇu pārvati vakṣyāmi tava bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati || prayatnataḥ kāryasiddhiḥ sarveṣāṃ khalu jāyate ||29|| sarvasiddhipradaṃ hṛdyamupāyaṃ kathayāmi te || harerārādhanaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ kuru varānane ||1.94.30|| puṇyakavratasaṃjñaṃ tad varṣamekaṃ kariṣyasi || manorathakalpataruṃ sukhadaṃ putradaṃ vratam ||31|| sarvavratānāṃ saṃśreṣṭhaṃ harestatpuṇyakaṃ vratam | yathā gaṃgā saritśreṣṭhā yathā deveṣu vai hariḥ ||32|| vaiṣṇaveṣu yathā cāhaṃ devīṣu tvaṃ mahāsatī || yathā varṇeṣu vipro vai śreṣṭhastīrtheṣu puṣkaraḥ ||33|| puṣpeṣu pārijātaṃ ca patreṣu tulasīdalam || tithiṣvekādaśī śreṣṭhā vāreṣu raviruttamaḥ ||34|| māseṣu mārgaśīrṣaśca sarvartuṣu vasantakaḥ | saṃvatsaro vatsareṣu kṛtaṃ yugeṣu cottamam ||35|| pūjyeṣu ca yathā vidvān mātā gurujaneṣu ca | patnī yathā hitakṛtsu viśvasteṣu hṛdantaram ||36|| yathā dhaneṣu ratnāni priyeṣu ca patiryathā || yathā bandhuṣu satputro vṛkṣeṣu kalpapādapaḥ ||37|| tathā harervrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvavrateṣu puṇyakam || phaleṣvāmraphalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vane vṛndāvanaṃ yathā ||38|| yathā strīṣu śatarūpā hyurvaśyapsarasāṃ yathā || yathā mātṛṣu kamalā sūryastejasviṣūttamaḥ ||39|| āhlādakeṣu candraśca sundareṣu ca manmathaḥ | śreṣṭhāḥ śāstreṣu vedāśca siddheṣu kapilo yathā ||1.94.40|| kīrtideṣu yathā vidyā vyāpakeṣu prabhuryathā | śreṣṭhaṃ cakṣuryathāṃgeṣu satyaṃ puṇyeṣu cottamam ||41|| tapassu śrīhareḥ sevā gavyeṣu ghṛtamuttamam || śreṣṭhamamṛtaṃ bhakṣyeṣu śuddheṣu ca hutāśanaḥ ||42|| taijaseṣu yathā svarṇaṃ miṣṭeṣu priyabhāṣaṇam | patattriṣu ca garuḍaḥ kariṣyairāvato yathā ||43|| tathā harervrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvavrateṣu puṇyakam || devarṣiṣu nāradaśca yogiṣu sanakādayaḥ ||44|| gandharveṣu citrarathastattveṣu cetano yathā | kavane jīvane śukraḥ kṣamāvatsu yathā ca bhūḥ ||45|| śreṣṭhā lābheṣu vai muktiḥ sampatsu bhaktiruttamā | pavitreṣu yathā sādhurvarṇeṣu praṇavo yathā ||46|| mantreṣu śrīharermantro goṣu kāmadughā yathā | vedeṣu sāmavedaśca tṛṇeṣu kuśa uttamaḥ ||47|| sukhadeṣu yathā jñānaṃ sarpeṣu vāsukiryathā | akṣareṣu akāraśca yathā tāto hitaiṣiṣu ||48|| catuṣpātsu yathā siṃhaḥ śālagrāmaśca mūrtiṣu | yathā buddhiḥ karaṇeṣu śaktimatsu hariryathā ||49|| nāśavatsu dvayaṇukaśca dadhīcirdātṛṣūttamaḥ || brahmāstraṃ tu yathāstreṣu cakreṣu ca sudarśanam ||1.94.50|| sarvasāro yathā kṛṣṇo vrateṣu puṇyakaṃ tathā | vrataṃ kuru mahādevi śīghraṃ sveṣṭapradāyakam ||51|| sarvaśreṣṭhastu putraste vratādeva bhaviṣyati | vratārādhyo hariḥ kṛṣṇo golokādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ ||52|| prasannaḥ sarvadātā sa bhuktimuktiprado bhavet | jano yatsevayā bandhānmucyate pitṛkoṭibhiḥ ||53|| uddhṛtya koṭipuruṣān goloke sukhamṛcchati || bhrātṝnbhṛtyānsahāyām̐ścāśritānnārīsutādikān ||54|| kṛṣṇabhaktaḥ samuddhṛtya sukhaṃ yāti hareḥ padam || tasmād gṛhāṇa girije harermantravrataṃ param ||55|| kuru vrataṃ japa mantraṃ śīghraṃ siddhirbhaviṣyati | ityuktvā jalamādāya devyai mantravaraṃ dadau ||56|| śaṃbhurvāme girijāyāḥ karṇe mantraṃ jajāpa | pārvatī taṃ dīyamānaṃ mantraṃ dadhyau hṛdi tvimam ||57|| "oṃ namo harikṛṣṇāya patirūpadharāya ca | bījāya garbharūpāyāpatyarūpāya śaṃbhave ||58|| saṃkalpagarbhahṛdyāya namaḥ putrapradāya ca | vijetre’grārcyarūpāya namo dehi suputrakam ||59|| sarvavijayinaṃ dehi sarvāgrārcyaṃ ca me sutam || puṇyakaṃ te vrataṃ kṛṣṇa kriyate prītaye tava ||1.94.60|| nirvighnaṃ saphalaṃ tatsyāt putrātman sutado bhava || tvatsamaṃ me sutaṃ dehi ciraṃjīvi namo namaḥ ||61|| itimantraṃ haradattaṃ gṛhītvā pārvatīṃ sati | jagāma jāhnavītīraṃ śaṃbhunā saha pāvanam ||62|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pārvatyai putrajijñāsamānāyai śaṃkarapradattabahudṛṣṭāntasamanvitakṛṣṇamantrapradānapradarśananāmā caturnavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||94||
<1.95> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrutvā vratasya kartavyaṃ pārvatī hṛṣṭamānasā | sarvaṃ vratavidhānaṃ tu papraccha śaṃkara punaḥ || 1 || puṇyakaṃ tadvrataṃ nātha niyamena yutaṃ mayā || kayā rītyā prakartavyaṃ kāni dravyāṇi tatra ca || 2 || phalānyanyāni deyāni bhavantīti nirūpyatām | yadyadapekṣitaṃ vastu tanniyojaya kalpaya || 3 || nārīṇāṃ vratakartrīṇāṃ svāmī sarvārthado mataḥ || pitā kaumārasamaye sadā pālayate sutām || 4 || lagnottaraṃ patiḥ pātā vārdhakye tu sutādayaḥ || pitā prāṇasamāṃ putrīṃ datvā satpataye sukhī || 5 || patiḥ patnīṃ svaputreṣu sannyasyaiva sukhī bhavet || evaṃ trayayutā nārī loke bhāgyavatī matā || 6 || ekena rahitā madhyā sarvahīnā tu duḥkhinī | etaistu rakṣitā dhanyā ninditānyāśrayasthitā || 7 || pitṛrakṣaṇayogyaṃ tu kaumāraṃ vigataṃ mama || bhartṛrakṣaṇayogyaṃ ca yauvanaṃ tu gamiṣyati || 8 || vinā putraṃ tu vārdhakye ko me rakṣāṃ kariṣyati || ato dehi sutaṃ nātha mama nirvṛttikāraṇam 9 || sarvajñasya samīpe vai pāṇḍityaṃ kaluṣāyate || na mamānyadyācitavyaṃ sutadāṃ satkṛpāṃ vinā ||1.95.10|| iti śrutvā tu pārvatyāḥ śaṃkaraḥ prāha pārvatīm || śṛṇu devi kṛṣṇavratātsaphalaḥ syānmanorathaḥ ||11|| māghaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ vratāraṃbhaḥ śubhaḥ priye || dvādaśyāṃ māghaśuklasya vratasya pūrṇatā bhavet ||12|| sāṃvatsaraṃ vratametatpuṇyakaṃ kṛṣṇatuṣṭikṛt || kartavyaṃ tu vidhānena putrārthinyā tu yoṣayā ||13|| dvādaśyāṃ tu samupoṣya śiraḥsaṃskārapūrvakam || gātraśuddhiṃ vastraśuddhiṃ kṛtvā rātrau hariṃ smaret ||14|| nidrottaraṃ brāhmakāle talpādutthāya vai harim | smaran śaucādikaṃ dantadhāvanaṃ snapanaṃ tathā ||15|| kṛtvā cācamya haraye dattvārghyaṃ dhautavāsasī || dhṛtvopaviśya ca tataḥ punarācamya cāndanam ||16|| binduṃ vā tilakaṃ kṛtvā kauṃkumaṃ ca hariṃ smaret | svāhnikaṃ naityakaṃ kṛtvā vṛṇuyātsupurohitam ||17|| ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhivatsvastivācanapūrvakam || saṃkalpaṃ vedavihitaṃ kārayitvā vrataṃ caret ||18|| upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pūjanīyo hariḥ svayam | āvāhanamāsanaṃ ca pādyamarghyaṃ tataḥ param ||19|| ācamanaṃ tathā snānaṃ madhuparkaṃ tathāmbaram | candanaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ nivedanam ||1.95.20|| yajñasūtraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ deyāni bhaktibhāvataḥ || tatra nyūnaṃ na kartavyaṃ phalahānikaraṃ hi tat ||21|| dānāni tu yathāśakti deyāni kṛṣṇaviṣṇave | yadyaddānena yatprāptirbhavet tadvacmi saṃśṛṇu ||22|| puṣpaṃ tu pārijātasya deyaṃ surūpahetave | śvetacampakapuṣpaṃ tu deyaṃ saundaryahetave ||23|| padmaṃ deyaṃ tu kṛṣṇāya mukhasaughaṭyahetave | ratnāḍhyaṃ darpaṇaṃ deyaṃ netrayordīpti hetave ||24|| nīlotpale tathā deye cakṣuṣo rūpahetave | śvetaṃ tu cāmaraṃ deyaṃ keśasaundarya hetave ||25|| ratnāktapuṭakaṃ deyaṃ nāsāsaundaryahetave || deye bandhūkapuṣpe ca svoṣṭhayoḥ raktatākṛte || 26|| muktāphalāni deyāni dantasaundaryahetave | ratnagaṇḍūṣake deye gaṇḍasaundaryahetave ||27|| ratnapāśāstathā deyā suṣṭhu cibukahetave || saratnakarṇabhūṣāśca deyāḥ karṇaprasuṣṭhave ||28|| mādhvīkaṃ śārkaraṃ deyaṃ svaramādhuryahetave || miṣṭaṃ sudhāmṛtaṃ deyaṃ vāṇīmādhuryahetave ||29|| deyo ratnapradīpaśca dṛṣṭinairmalyahetave | jalapātrādayo deyā baladārḍhyasya hetave ||1.95.30|| padmanālāni deyāni bāhudārḍhyasya hetave || raktapadmāni deyāni karasaundarya hetave ||31|| aṃgulīyāni deyāni tvaṃgulīṣṭatvahetave | deyāstu śvetamaṇayo nakhasaundarya hetave ||32|| ratnahārāstathā deyā vakṣaḥsaughaṭyahetave | pakve’rpye śrīphale tasmai stanasaundaryahetave ||33|| svarṇapatraṃ tathā deyaṃ dehasaundaryahetave || deyā ratnakṛtā nābhirnābhisaundaryahetave ||34|| dve ratnakhacite cakre deye nitambasuṣṭhave || raṃbhāstaṃbhāḥ pradeyāśca śroṇisaundaryahetave ||35|| sthalapadmāni deyāni pādasaundarya hetave || svarṇamatsyāni deyāni gaticāṃcalyahetave ||36|| svarṇahaṃsagajendrāśca deyāḥ sugatihetave | deyaṃ cāmīkaracchatraṃ mūrdhnaḥ saundarya hetave ||37|| mālatīkusumaṃ deyaṃ saumyahāsyādihetave || deyānyamūlyaratnāni vratapūrtyai sukhāptaye ||38|| deyāḥ sphāṭikamaṇayo manaḥpraśāntaye’malāḥ || deyāḥ pravālamaṇayaḥ priyārāgavivṛddhaye ||39|| deyā māṇikyamaṇayaḥ svāmisaubhāgyahetave | kūṣmāṇḍaṃ navaraṃgaṃ ca jambīraṃ śrīphalaṃ tathā ||1.95.40|| deyāni harikṛṣṇāya pūjāyāṃ putrahetave || ratnasārāṇi deyāni svāmino dhanavṛddhaye ||41|| vādyaṃ sampattivṛddhyarthaṃ śrīhariṃ śrāvayed vrate | pāyasaṃ piṣṭakaṃ sarpiḥ śarkarāḥ kesaraṃ tathā ||42|| deyāni haraye bhaktyā svāmino bhogavṛddhaye || puṣpamālāḥ pradātavyā harau bhaktivivṛddhaye ||43|| madhurasvādunaivedyaṃ deyaṃ miṣṭānnalabdhaye | tulasīpatrapuṣpāṇi deyāni kṛṣṇatuṣṭaye ||44|| sādhūn sādhvīśca dīnām̐śca bhojayet sasyavṛddhaye || puṣpāñjalipraṇāmāstu kartavyā bhaktivṛddhaye ||45|| ṣaṇmāsām̐śca haviṣyānnaṃ māsānpaṃca phalādikam | haviḥ pakṣaṃ payaḥ pakṣaṃ bhakṣayettu vrate sthitā ||46|| akhaṇḍadīpakaṃ kuryādāsaṃvatsaramacyute || nityaṃ kuśāsane madhyarātrijāgaraṇaṃ caret ||47|| brahmacaryaṃ sadā pālyaṃ vratasya phalalabdhaye || kṣatau tu niṣkṛtiḥ kāryopavāso’ṣṭau śataṃ japāḥ ||48|| pratikṣati prakartavyā vratākhaṇḍitatāptaye | māghaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ kāryastadutsavo mahān ||49|| yathāśakti pradātavyā svarṇamudrā ca rājatī | vastrāṇāṃ triśataṃ ṣaṣṭyadhikaṃ tāvacca rūpyakāḥ ||1.95.50|| svarṇamudrāśca tāvatyo bhojyāstāvanta ārṣakāḥ || tilahomaḥ prakartavyastriśataṃ cāpi ṣaṣṭikaḥ ||51|| etat pratidinaṃ kṛtyaṃ varṣānte kāryameva vā || haritulyo bhavetputro vijetāgryārcya eva ca ||52|| saundaryaṃ pratisaubhāgyamaiśvaryaṃ vipulaṃ dhanam | sarveṣṭasiddhayaścāsyā jāyante vratavaibhavāt ||53|| vratānte svapatiśayyā rantavyā na vrate’ntarā | vratasya vatsare nāryā na rantavyaṃ kadācana ||54|| vratamadhye tu ramaṇe vratabhaṃgo bhavedataḥ | ṛtukālāsevanaṃ yaddūṣaṇaṃ cātra bhūṣaṇam ||55|| evaṃ tvaṃ vārṣikaṃ caikaṃ vrataṃ kuru maheśvari | putrastvayonijaste syānmama dhātostu pārvati ||56|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne putrārthaṃ puṇyakākhyavārṣikavratanirūpaṇadeyadānanirūpaṇanāmā paṃcanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 95 ||
<1.96> śrīśvetavyāsa uvāca suśikha śaṃkaraḥ prāha deveśīṃ tu purāvṛtam | vaivasvatamanoḥ patnī śatarūpā hyaputriṇī || 1 || śuśoca niṣphalaṃ janma dhanamaiśvaryamityapi | gṛhasthānāṃ gṛhaṃ smṛddhaṃ
