vinā putraṃ na śobhate ||2|| tapodānodbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ janmāntarakṛtaṃ bhavet | tadā putrīputramukhadarśanaṃ jāyate nṛṇām || 3 || phalaṃ punnāmanarakāttāraṇaṃ putrataḥ smṛtam || suśive niṣkiṃcanārṣā apīcchanti suśiṣyakam || 4 || svayaṃ nārāyaṇo devo vinā śiṣyaṃ na tiṣṭhati || śiṣyaḥ putro hyadārāṇāṃ sadārasya suto dhanam || 5 || nityavandhyāvidhurayoḥ putrā menāśukādayaḥ | tasmāt sutaṃ vinā vāso varo bhavati tāpasaḥ || 6 || rājyaṃ cābhijano lakṣmīrnirarthaṃ sutamantarā|| aputriṇormukhaṃ prātarna vai paśyanti mānavāḥ || 7 || mukhaṃ darśayituṃ lajjāṃ samavāpnotyaputrakaḥ || ityevaṃ śokasantaptā brahmaṇe’vedayattadā || 8 || brahmovāca śṛṇu vatse māghaśuklatrayodaśī | puṇyakavratayogyā sā tadārabhya tu vatsaram || 9 || vrataṃ kuru yathoktaṃ vai labha viṣṇusamaṃ sutam | brahmaṇo vacanātsā tu cakāra vidhinā vratam ||1.96.10|| priyavratottānapādau lebhe putrau manoharau | devahūtirvrataṃ kṛtvā labdhvā nārāyaṇādvaram ||11|| nārāyaṇāṃśaṃ kapilaṃ lebhe siddhamuniṃ sutam || arundhatī vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe śaktyabhidhaṃ sutam ||12|| śaktikāntā vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe putraṃ parāśaram | aditiśca vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe putraṃ tu vāmanam ||13|| śacyapīdaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā jayantamāpa vai sutam | uttānapādapatnīdaṃ kṛtvā lebhe dhruvaṃ sutam ||14|| anasūyā vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe candraṃ sutaṃ śubham | aṃgiro bhāryayā bṛhaspatirlabdho vratena vai ||15|| bhṛgoḥ khyātirvrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe śukraṃ sutaṃ śubham | tathā vrataprabhāveṇa svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sutaḥ ||16|| kaṃbharāyā gṛhe jātaḥ sa te putro bhaviṣyati || kathayitveti deveśīṃ datvā bahugaṇaṃ dhanam ||17|| sādhanāni kathayitvā śivo dhyāne vyavasthitaḥ | harerārādhanaparo jñānānandābdhibhāvanaḥ ||18|| pārvatī sarvadravyāṇi cānīya vratahetave | vipraṃ sanatkumāraṃ vai vidhaye cāvṛṇottadā ||19|| deveśāstu samājagmurjñātvā vratamahotsavam | brahmājagāma sabhāryaḥ salakṣmīkaścaturbhujaḥ ||1.96.20|| dhyānaṃ tyaktvā tadā śaṃbhurājagāma vratasthale || sanakaśca sanandaśca kapilaśca sanātanaḥ ||21|| āsuriśca kraturhaṃso voḍhuḥ pañcaśikho’ruṇiḥ || yatirvaśiṣṭhaḥ sumatiḥ pulastyaḥ pulaho bhṛguḥ ||22|| agastyo’triraṃgirāśca durvāsāścyavanastathā | patnīvrataḥ pracetāśca kaṇvo marīcikaśyapau ||23|| gautamaśca jaratkārurbṛhaspatiśca saubhariḥ || utathyo jamadagniśca jaigiṣavyaśca devalaḥ ||24|| saṃvarto vāmadevaśca viśvāmitro vibhāṇḍakaḥ | ṛṣyaśṛṃgaḥ pāribhadro mārkaṇḍeyaśca lomaśaḥ ||25|| gokarṇaśca mṛkaṇḍuśca puṣkaraḥ pippalāyanaḥ || kautso dvītaścaikataśca trīto vatsaśca lekhanaḥ ||26|| śaṃkhaḥ śaṃkurāpiśaliḥ svayaṃprakāśa āruṇiḥ || dakṣaḥ kaṇādo bālāgniraghamarṣaṇapāṇinī||27|| kātyāyano nāradaśca naro nārāyaṇastathā | brahmavrato mahāśvetavyāsaścānye maharṣayaḥ ||28|| gītā jayantyo gāyatrī lakṣmīrvidyā sarasvatī | stutiścārādhanā pūjā bhaktirnīrājanā ramā ||29|| ekādaśyaśca yoginyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginya ityapi | sādhvyaśca vītarāgiṇyo nyāsinyaḥ siddhayastathā ||1.96.30|| mātaraḥ saritaḥ puryastathānyā vividhāḥ striyaḥ || ājagmustatra pārvatyā vratotsavasamutsukāḥ ||31|| pradikpālāstathā devā yakṣā gandharvakinnarāḥ || kiṃpuruṣāścāraṇāśca parvatā divyavigrahāḥ ||32|| himālayo harṣabharaḥ sāpatyaśca sabhāryakaḥ || samājagāma sagaṇo dravyaratnamaṇīnnayan ||33|| vrate yāvanti dānāni tāni saṃgṛhya cāyayau || pārvatyai tāni dattāni vratasiddhiprapūrtaye ||34|| anantaratnaprabhavaḥ śailaḥ putryai dadau bahu | brāhmaṇā manavaḥ siddhā nāgā vidyādharāstathā ||35|| sādhavo bhikṣuko bandijanā sūtāśca māgadhāḥ || vidyādharyaśca nartakyo nartakāpsarasastathā ||36|| ājagmurvratakartryāstu pārvatyāstoṣahetave || āśīrvādāḥ pradattāstaistābhiḥ putravatī bhava ||37|| sarveṣāṃ svāgataṃ sevā bhojanātithyamānanam || śaṃbhunā satkṛtaṃ sarve tuṣṭā daduḥ śubhāśiṣaḥ ||38|| natāḥ kṛtādhicaryāśca pūjitā bhojitāśca te | kailāse tu mahatyāṃ vai sabhāyāṃ saṃhitāḥ surāḥ ||39|| ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ narāyaṇam | mahādeva uvācedaṃ śrīnivāsa śṛṇu prabho ||1.96.40|| vratānāṃ phalado devo mantrāṇāṃ phalado bhavān || pārvatī tu vrate naiva putraṃ vāñchati saukhyadam ||41|| viṣṇuḥ prāha mahādeva nārāyaṇo jagadguruḥ || bhaktaprāṇaśca bhakteśo bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ ||42|| bhaktyadhīno hi bhagavān sarvasiddhiṃ pradāsyati | kṛṣṇavrataṃ kṛṣṇamantraṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ||43|| vrate pūrṇe tu sampanne pārvatyā saha saṃgame || tava dhātorbahiḥskannāttvayonijaḥ suputrakaḥ ||44|| vijetā sarva sainyānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ maṃgalapradaḥ || bhaviṣyati na sandeho devāḥ kāṃkṣanti taṃ sutam ||45|| ityevamucyamāne ca tadā devādisannidhau | pārvatī kṛṣṇacaraṇe namanāya samāgatā ||46|| natvā pādāvavanejya prāha viṣṇuṃ janārdanam || bhaktakalpataro śrīmannārāyaṇa namo’stu te ||47 kṛtena tava puṇyakavratena sutavatyaham || yathā syāṃ tattathā deva saṃkalpaṃ ca kṛpāṃ kuru ||48|| kṛṣṇaḥ prāha tadā devīṃ sāvadhānatayā tvayā | kartavyaṃ vratameva tvāṃ drakṣye pūrṇe vrate punaḥ ||49|| devakāryasahāyānuṣṭhātṛputravatī bhava || gacchāmi svasya golokaṃ vrate tandrāṃ tu mā kuru ||1.96.50|| satkṛtaḥ pūjito devastathānye’pi divaukasaḥ || āśiṣaśca tadā devyaḥ prayuñjya svagṛhān yayuḥ ||51|| pārvatī māghaśuklasya dvādaśyāṃ dehaśuddhaye || upavāsena sākaṃ vai sarvaṃ kṛtavatī satī ||52|| trayodaśyāmāhnikaṃ yatprātaḥkṛtyaṃ vidhāya tat || sarvaratnamaṇidhānyadravyavastrādibhiḥ saha ||53|| maṇḍape tu samāgatya saṃsthitāpūjayad gurūn | natvā sarvāṃstatrasaṃsthān hariṃ natvāntarātmanā ||54|| saṃsthāpya ratnakalaśaṃ śukladhānyopari sthiram | pañcapallavasaṃyuktaṃ phalākṣatādiśobhitam ||55|| candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumādivirājitam || tathā purohitaṃ natvā pūjayitvā tridevatāḥ ||56|| samārebhe pūjanaṃ tu svastivācanapūrvakam | āvāhyābhīṣṭadevaṃ taṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ maṃgale ghaṭe ||57|| bhaktyā dadau krameṇaiva copacārām̐stu ṣoḍaśa || yāni vrate vidheyāni deyadravyāṇi yāni ca ||58|| vedamantreṇa sarvāṇi dattvā homān vyadhāpayat || trilakṣāṇi tadā homān tilaiśca sarpiṣā tathā ||59|| mantrajāpaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ smarantī brāhmaṇān bahūn | bhojayāmāsa vidhinā pratyahaṃ pūrṇavatsaram ||1.96.60|| samāptidivase kṛṣṇaḥ sarvātmā smārito muhuḥ || āgacchatu svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prasannaḥ pūjanasthale ||61|| tuṣṭuvustaṃ tadā sarve sāyudhaṃ ca caturbhujam || koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ koṭimanmathamohanam ||62|| prasannavadanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ koṭicandrasamaprabham | vāsayāmāsa taṃ devaṃ ratnasiṃhāsane vare ||63|| taṃ praṇemuśca śirasā brahmaśaktiśivādayaḥ || svāgatottaramārādhyo vratenāplāvito hariḥ ||64|| prāha devi vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ tava jātaṃ suputradam || pārvatī ca tadā prāha devadeva mahāprabho ||65|| putraṃ dehi vijetāraṃ sarvāgrārcyaṃ sutaṃ tathā | kṛṣṇaḥ prāha tadā devīṃ tathāstviti bruvanprabhuḥ ||66|| devā daityavināśāya tārakāsurahānaye | prārthayanti muhustasmād vijetṝṇāṃ śiromaṇiḥ ||67|| putraścaiko bhavitā te dvitīyo’pi sutaḥ śubhaḥ || sarvadevāgrapūjyaśca sarvamaṃgaladastava ||68|| bhavitā cetyubhau putrāvayonijau tu vīryataḥ || śaṃkarasya bhavetāṃ vai patiṃ raṃjaya bhāmini ||69|| śivā prāha tadā viṣṇuṃ karmaṇāṃ phaladāyakam || dhyāyanti yoginaḥ kecicchāntaṃ sākāramadbhutam ||1.96.70|| pītāmbaraṃ caturhetiṃ lakṣmīkāntaṃ caturbhujam || kecitkiśoraṃ dvibhujaṃ sundaraṃ ratnabhūṣitam ||71|| śyāmaṃ gopāṃganākāntaṃ māyānāthaṃ manoharam | ahaṃ putrapradaṃ devaṃ dhyāyāmi kṛṣṇamacyutam ||72|| tava preraṇayā nātha tava tejoṃ’śasaṃbhavā || māyayā tava māyāhaṃ mohayitvāsurānpurā ||73|| nihatya sarvān śailendramagamaṃ taṃ himālayam || tato’haṃ saṃstutā devaistārakākṣeṇa pīḍitaiḥ ||74|| abhavaṃ dakṣajāyāyāṃ śivastrī bhavajanmani | tyaktvā dehaṃ dakṣayajñe śivāhaṃ śivanindayā ||75|| abhavaṃ śailajāyāyāṃ menakāyāṃ tu kālikā || anekatapasā prāptaḥ śivaścātrāpi janmani ||76|| pāṇiṃ jagrāha me yogī prārthito vedhasā muhuḥ || śrṛṃgārajaṃ ca tattejo nālabhaṃ devamāyayā ||77|| staumi tvāmeva deveśa vinā putraṃ tu duḥkhitā | vrate bhavadvidhaṃ putraṃ labdhumicchāmi sāmpratam ||78|| sarvasenāvijetāraṃ sarvapūjyaṃ ca vāparam || śrutvā sarvaṃ kṛpāsindho kṛpāṃ me kartumarhasi ||79|| ityabhyarthya tadā devī tūṣṇīmāsa ca pārvatī | svasmin kṛṣṇena divyau dvau putrau devyai pradarśitau ||1.96.80|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne putrārthaṃ vratakartrīṇāṃ dṛṣṭāntāni devarṣiṇāṃ samāgamanamāśīrvādāśca śrīkṛṣṇadarśanaṃ cetyādivarṇananāmā ṣaṇṇavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||96||
<1.97> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kṛpāluḥ sa śrīkṛṣṇaḥ karuṇānidhiḥ || svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa prathamaṃ sarvamohanam || 1 || brahmacaryasvarūpaṃ vai sākṣādrūpanidhiṃ param | ṣaṇmukhaṃ samayūraṃ ca bahuhetisamanvitam || 2 || bahujñānaṃ bahubalaṃ bahukalaṃ suyauvanam || divyaṃ senāsvāmiyogyacihnaṃ ṣoḍaśahāyanam || 3 || atha dvitīyarūpaṃ svaṃ sthūlaṃ vaṃśakaraṃ param || vanamālāgalaṃ śyāmaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam || 4 || kiśoravayasaṃ sarpayajñopavītaśobhanam || koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ mūṣakasthiravāhanam ||5|| atīva hṛṣṭaṃ sarveśaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam || dṛṣṭvā rūpe rūpavatī putrau tadanurūpakau || 6 || manasā varayāmāsa varaṃ samprāpya tatkṣaṇam || varaṃ datvā tadā kṛṣṇastattejo’ntaradhīyata || 7 || prāptau putrāviti hṛṣṭā jagadambā nirambikā | brāhmaṇabhikṣubandibhyo dadau dānāni cāmbikā || 8 || tām̐stathā bhojayāmāsa pūjayāmāsa śaṃkaram || dundubhiṃ vādayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṃgalam || 9 || saṃgītaṃ gāpayāmāsa kṛṣṇasambandhi susvaram | vrataṃ samāpya śailotthā bhojayitvā tadāśritān ||1.97.10|| dugdhapākaṃ pūrikāśca bubhuje svāminā saha || tāmbūlaṃ susugandhāḍhyaṃ bubhuje śaṃbhunā saha ||11|| sarvān prāghūṇikān sā tu prasthāpya prayatā punaḥ | śrāṃgārika pariṣkṛtya śārīrakaṃ pramodanam ||12|| payaḥphenanibhāṃ śayyāṃ ramyāṃ sadratnamaṃcake || puṣpacandanasaṃyuktāṃ kastūrīdānavāsitām ||13|| rahasi svāminā sārdhaṃ suṣvāpa parameśvarī || sugandhikusumāḍhyena vāyunā surabhīkṛte ||14|| bhramaradhvanisaṃyukte puṃskokilarutāśraye || kailāsadhāmasīmānte ramye candanakānane ||15|| gandhamādanabhūbhāge siṣeve surataṃ patim || vyahārṣīt sā surasikā śaṃkareṇa sahāmbikā ||16|| dvayoḥ suratamāpannaṃ yad dvayośca tadābhavat || skandanaṃ mahadāścaryaṃ prathame vīryapātane ||17|| vīryamagnisvarūpaṃ tad bhayakṛcca mahāprabham | yonidvāre skhalitaṃ tad bahireva pravāhitam ||18|| ayonijasya putrasyotpattaye’bhūddharīcchayā || atha pravāharūpeṇa jvālārūpeṇa retasā ||19|| uṣṇatejaḥsamudbhūtoṣmasvarūpeṇa cāmbare | antarikṣe bhūtale ca prāṇino mūrchanāṃ yayuḥ ||1.97.20|| tacchāntyarthaṃ svayaṃ brahmā viṣṇuścānye divaukasaḥ || sasmarurmanasā cāgniṃ so’pyājagāma satvaram ||21|| devānāmanumatyā ca viveśa suratasthalam | tadaṃgaṇamanuprāpya bhikṣāṃ dehīti tūcivān ||22|| pāṇipātrasya me hyamba bhikṣāṃ dehi vrajāmyaham || bhikṣāṃ tasmai dadau cāmbā dugdharūpāmupasthitām ||23|| paramānnaṃ dugdhapākaṃ pradattaṃ cāṃjalau yadā || tadā ca prāsarad retaḥ śaṃbhorvyomādhvanaścyavat ||24|| vahnyaṃjalau prapatitaṃ miṣṭaṃ sugandhi sadrasam | nigīrṇaṃ miśritaṃ bhaikṣaṃ pratyakṣaṃ vahninā svayam ||25|| rasāsvāde mohito’gniranyadreto’pi yattvabhūt || vyomno’ntarikṣādbhūmeśca śayyāyāścālabheddhi tat ||26|| tat sarvaṃ bhikṣayā sārdhaṃ rasalobhācca mohataḥ || svayameva gṛhītvā tanmiśrayitvā muhurmuhuḥ ||27|| jagrāsāsvādayandugdhapākaṃ vīryaṃ ca bhāvataḥ || na kiṃcidavaśiṣṭaṃ hi putrārthaṃ pārvatīśaye ||28|| tadā cintāparā gaurī rasāsvāde pralobhinam | vahniṃ śaśāpa bho vahne rasāsvādapradūṣaṇāt ||29|| bījaṃ putrātmakamapi śayyāsthaṃ bhakṣitaṃ tvayā || tasmād bhikṣo mama śāpātsarvabhakṣo bhavāśu vai ||1.97.30|| śāpaḥ prāpto mahadduḥkhamabhavadvahnimānase || reto na jīrṇaṃ prabalaṃ tejo’pyuṣṇataraṃ yataḥ ||31|| pratyuta vahniṃ tadretaḥ prājvālayadatīva ca || vahnirjājvalyamāno vai gatvā gaṃgāmahāhrade ||3|| vamati sma ca tatsarvaṃ vahniḥ svastho’bhavattadā || kintu vīryoṣmaṇā gaṃgā taptā dagdhābhavattadā ||33|| jalānyucchalitānyāsan tattāpaṃ naiva sehire | gaṃgayā projjhito dhātuḥ śarastambe papāta ha ||34|| tatra samajvaladdhāturvahnibhrāntikarastadā || saptarṣipramadāstatra gaṃgāyāṃ snātumāgatāḥ ||35|| dṛṣṭvā prajvalitaṃ tatra snātāśca śītapīḍitāḥ || kṛttikāstaptusaṃkalpā hyarundhatyā nivāritāḥ ||36|| api tatrāgaman ṣaḍ vai ṛṣipatnyaśca tatsthale || yāvat tepuśca tāḥ sarvā retasaḥ paramāṇavaḥ ||37|| viviśū romakūpeṣu tāsāṃ tatraiva satvaram || sagarbhāstāśca saṃjātāḥ ṣaḍgarbhairjajvalurbhṛśam ||38|| śuśucuśca kutastādvai garbhavatyo bhavāma ha || dāhayatyakhilaṃ dehaṃ kimidaṃ tvanalādabhūt ||39|| tyajāmaścainamevātra nālakhaṇḍauṣadhigrasāt || pītvā rasaṃ ca tadretaḥ utsasṛjurbhuvastale ||1.97.40|| aikapadyena tadretaḥ ṣaṇmukhaṃ hāṭakaprabham || apatyaṃ drāgabhavadvai surūpaṃ sukumārakam ||41|| gaṃgāyāḥ puline jātaḥ kārtikeyaḥ pratāpavān || jāto yadā hi gaṃgāyāṃ ṣaṇmukhaḥ śaṃkarātmajaḥ ||42|| tadānīmeva girijā jātā snutapayodharā | śivaṃ nirīkṣya tanvaṃgī he śaṃbho prasravaḥ stanāt ||43|| saṃjāto me mahādeva kimarthastannirīkṣyatām | samādhinā mahādevo jñātvābravīt suto’bhavat ||44|| nāradena tadāgatya kathitaṃ janma tasya tat || śivāya ca śivāyai ca putro jāto’tisundaraḥ ||45|| tadākarṇya vaco viprāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pramathāstathā || kailāsaṃ bhūṣayāmāsurvitānadhvajatoraṇaiḥ ||46|| patākākadalīstaṃbhaiḥ svastimaṃgalamaṇḍanaiḥ || tadā surarṣayaḥ siddhāścāraṇā apsarogaṇāḥ ||47|| yakṣāḥ sarpā mānavāśca jagmurgaṃgātaṭaṃ śubham || draṣṭuṃ gāṃgeyamāruhya vṛṣabhaṃ śaṃkarastathā ||48|| pārvatyā saha sagaṇo gaṃgātaṭamupāyayau || tathā śaṃkhāśca bheryaśca nedustūryāṇyanekaśaḥ ||49|| kecinnṛtyanti gāyanti stuvanti tadguṇārṇavam || yāvatsamīkṣayāmāsurgāṃgeyaṃ śaṃkaropamam ||1.97.50|| dadṛśustejasā vyāptaṃ bālaṃ sūryasamaprabham || sumukhaṃ suśriyaṃ ramyaṃ sunāsaṃ sasmitekṣaṇam ||51|| prasannaṃ cārudaśanaṃ sarvāvayavasundaram || snigdhālakaṃ kumāraṃ taṃ devā vavandire tadā ||52|| pramathāśca gaṇāḥ sarve vīrabhadrādayastathā | brahmā viṣṇurmahendraśca parivārya kumārakam ||53|| upasaṃsthāstathā cānye vāmadakṣiṇabhāgataḥ | avatīrya vṛṣācchaṃbhuḥ pārvatyā saha suvrataḥ ||54|| putraṃ dadarśa cātmānaṃ snehapluto babhūva ha || upaguhya guhaṃ tatra pārvatī premasaṃplutā ||55|| prasnutaṃ pāyayāmāsa stanyaṃ cāṃke nidhāya vai | cucumba pārvatī putramaślikṣat śaṃkaraḥ pitā ||56|| yojito hyāśiṣā sarvaiḥ śarkarā dāpitā tadā | dānāni vividhānyeva dāpitāni hareṇa vai ||57|| dampatī tau tadā tatra caikapadyena rejatuḥ || kumārastu tadā reme dhṛtvā kaṃṭhasthavāsukim ||58|| atha tatragatā gaṃgā kṛttikāścāgnidevatā | dṛṣṭvā bālaṃ mahārūpaṃ sabalaṃ sūryavarcasam ||59|| mamāyaṃ na ca te bālo vivadante sma cāgrahāt || bālaḥ prāha tadā sākṣānmadālokāt tu yatstanāt ||1.97.60|| dugdhaṃ parisnutaṃ snehāt tasyāścāhaṃ suputrakaḥ || ityuccārya nanāma svapitarau prāk tato’parān ||61|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pārvatyai śrīkṛṣṇapradattaputradvayarūpadarśanaṃ śaṃkarapārvatīvahnigaṃgāśarastambakṛttikādvārā kārtikeyajanma ceti pradarśananāmā saptanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||97||
<1.98> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śivaḥ prāha tadā devān kumāro’yaṃ pratāpavān | jātamātro yuvā divyo devānāṃ kāryakṛnmataḥ || 1 || tad bhavadbhiḥ sanniyojyo yatheṣṭaṃ balavān kṛtī || devāḥ prāhustadā śaṃbhuṃ sarveṣāṃ sukhahetave || 2 || tārakādbhayamastyeva sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ vibho || tasmāt senāpatitve’bhiṣecanīyaḥ sutastvayam || 3 || ityevaṃ sammatau tatra śaṃkaraḥ sumuhūrtake || saināpatyapradānāya lilekhotsavapatrikāḥ || 4 || gaṇā maṃgalapatrāṇi yayurnītvā caturdaśa || caturdaśasu lokeṣu ṛṣipitṛdyuvāsinām ||5|| yakṣarākṣasagandharvabhūtapretapalāśinām || mānavāsurasarpāṇāṃ kinnaroragabhūbhujām || 6 || pratigṛhaṃ pradadustāḥ patrikāśca śivājñayā || āyayuḥ ṛṣayaḥ satyalokāttu brahmaṇā saha || 7 || pitaraśca tapolokādagniṣvāttādayastathā | barhiṣadā ājyapāśca somapā vatsarādayaḥ || 8 || pāvanā vahnayaḥ sarve yamapretā digīśvarāḥ | samīyuśca sthale tatra manavo marutastathā || 9 || indraḥ kubero varuṇo yamo yamagaṇāstathā | bālakhilyāstathā sarve saptarṣayaśca nairṛtāḥ ||1.98.10|| adharmadharmasantānāḥ sumedhāḥ stanayitnavaḥ | vasantādyā ṛtavaśca kāmo bāṇādinānvitaḥ ||11|| viṣṇurlakṣmīpatirlakṣmyā pārṣadaiḥ saha cāgamat || devyaḥ sādhvyaścaturdaśalokagārhasthyaśobhanāḥ ||12|| vilāsinyaśca nartakyaḥ sevikāśca pativratāḥ || samājagmuśca bhūdevā nadā nadyaśca parvatāḥ ||13|| araṇyāni ca tīrthāni puryoṃ dhāmāni mūrtayaḥ || bhūtāni prāṇinastatra sūtamāgadhabandinaḥ ||14|| mānavā nāgasarpāśca vṛkṣā vallyaśca pakṣiṇaḥ || gaganasthā jalacaryāḥ sthalasthāḥ sthāsnujaṃgamāḥ ||15|| divyadehāḥ samājagmuḥ saināpatyamahotsave | gāyakā nartakā narmakāriṇo nāṭakaṃvidaḥ ||16|| vādakāḥ sevakāścānye ye devādevajātayaḥ | sarve tatra samāhūtā āgatāḥ protsavārthinaḥ ||17|| saināpatyasthānayogyaṃ bālakaṃ draṣṭumutsukāḥ | vidhiṃ draṣṭuṃ samājagmuḥ prāyo draṣṭuṃ svarakṣakam ||18|| samājaṃ ca tathā draṣṭuṃ prāyaḥ sarve samāgatāḥ || śaṃkareṇa tadā svasya kailāsaḥ supariṣkṛtaḥ ||19|| maṇḍapo hi mahān svarṇaratnavastrādibhiḥ kṛtaḥ || kadalīstaṃbhakalaśatoraṇollecaśobhitaḥ || 1.98.20|| paṭamaṇḍapalakṣāṇi koṭiśaḥ parṇaśālikāḥ || sabhāsthānāni ramyāṇi vihārodyānagopurāḥ ||21|| bhakṣyabhojyānyanantāni lehyacoṣyāṇi koṭiśaḥ | peyāni svādumiṣṭāni saugandhīnyapi lakṣaśaḥ ||22|| dṛśyāni ca manoraṃjanakānyagaṇitāni vai | amṛtāni vividhāni svāduphalānyanekaśaḥ ||23|| pakvānnāni sudivyāni sitāsudhājyavanti vai || atitṛptipradānyevaṃ tāmbūlādīni cābhavan ||24|| sthānopaveśanabṛsyo ratnasiṃhāsanāni ca | javanikāsusaudhāni vimānāni hyanekaśaḥ ||25|| vāhanāni jalavyomabhūgāmīni ca koṭiśaḥ | bhājanāni ca bhogyāni darpaṇāḥ keśadanturāḥ ||26|| puṣpāṇi tailasaugandhyacandanāni ca bhūriśaḥ || kuṃkumāni ca dhūpāśca dīpā vādyāni bhūriśaḥ ||27|| sthale sthale pṛtanādhipatyasūcakasudhvajāḥ || prasphuranti smāntarīkṣe gīyante jayagītikāḥ ||28|| muhūrte’bhijiti prāpte svastivācanapūrvakam | vedaghoṣān pracakrurvai bhūdevāḥ ṛṣayastathā ||29|| yajñopavītaṃ rakṣāyāḥ sūtraṃ jayamaṇiṃ tadā || dhārayāmāsa taṃ skandaṃ bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ ||1.98.30|| tilakaṃ sākṣataścandraḥ kauṃkumaśca kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ || guruṇā gāṃgatoyaiśca prokṣaṇaṃ ca kṛtaṃ śubham ||31|| mantrā balapradāstatra yojitā dakṣakarṇake | darbhaḥ karṇopari nyasto maṃgalaṃ mastake tathā ||32|| dravyaṃ tu prokṣitaṃ mūrdhni mukuṭo brahmaṇārpitaḥ || karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale datte kubereṇa tadā śubhe ||33|| samudreṇa tadā ratnahārāstasya gale’rpitāḥ || himālayena svarṇānāṃ bhūṣaṇānyarpitāni vai ||34|| dikpālaistattatpradeśodbhavadvastu samarpitam || varuṇenārpitaṃ chatraṃ śvetaṃ candrasamaṃ tadā ||35|| gaṃgayā ramayā tatra cāmare karayordhṛte | indreṇa kavacaṃ dattaṃ saināpatyasya rakṣakam ||36|| saināpatyasya veṣaśca datto vai viṣṇunā svayam | ādityena ratho datto raṇākṣatadṛḍhāṃgakaḥ ||37|| khaḍgaṃ carma pradatte vai dṛḍhe tu viśvakarmaṇā || śaṃbhunā tu dhanurdattamiṣudhyakṣayyasāyakau ||38|| cakraṃ tu hariṇā dattaṃ gadādaṇḍau yamena vai vajraṃ tadāgninā dattaṃ śaktiśca vāyunārpitā ||39|| mayūrāśvagajā dattāḥ parvatairvyomagāminaḥ || astraśastrāyudhahetipāśarṣṭitomarādayaḥ ||1.98.40|| pradattā vividhairdevaiḥ tadutsavasamāgataiḥ | devībhirvividhāstasmai pradattāḥ śaktayo’kṣayāḥ ||41|| pārvatyāśīrvaco dattaṃ sarvadā vijayī bhava | senābhogyaḥ parikaro munibhiścārpitastadā ||42|| nyūnaṃ sarvaṃ pūritaṃ ca tadā dakṣādirājakaiḥ || tato vijayaghoṣo’bhūtkārtikasya mahātmanaḥ ||43|| avādyanta ca vādyāni babhūvurjayaghoṣaṇāḥ || āsannugrāḥ surapakṣāḥ senāpatikṛtāvanāḥ ||44|| maṃgalāni vividhāni jātāni surayoṣitām | samājastatra lokebhyaścaturdaśabhya āgataḥ ||45|| bhojyairmiṣṭairmiṣṭapānaiḥ suvāsyaiśca sutarpitaḥ | puruṣāḥ pramadāścaiva vardhayanti sma śāṃkaram ||46|| senāpatiṃ mahāśaktaṃ durdharṣaṃ sarvato’dhikam || sainyānyapi suklṛptāni lokapālaistadā tataḥ ||47|| tadanyebhyastu saṃdatvā pātheyānyupadāstathā || śaṃbhunā preṣitāḥ sarve svasvadhāmāni te yayuḥ ||48|| atha sammilitā devāḥ brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ || mantrayāṃcakruradyaiva divāniśi mahāsuraḥ ||49|| diviṣadāṃ tārakākhyastrāsayate mahābalaḥ || ayaṃ skando mahāsatvo haniṣyati tu tārakam ||1.98.50|| dināni saptajātāni janmato’sya tathāpi vai || mahāsenāpatirjāto devadattabalairbalī ||51|| tasmādadyaiva yāsyāmastārakaṃ hantumudyatāḥ || matvā tatheti sahasā nirjagmustārakāsuram ||52|| tadā bheryo mṛdaṃgāśca paṭahānakagomukhāḥ | avādyanta ca vādyāni tūryāṇi vividhāni ca ||53|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kārtikeyasya senāpatitvadhikāratadaṃgāyudhādivarṇananāmāṣṭanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||98||
<1.99> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tadā loke bhayābhaye babhūvatuḥ || devānāmudyamaṃ jñātvā prabalastārakāsuraḥ || 1 || asurasainyakṛtkoṭyā yayau yoddhuṃ surānprati | asurā rākṣasā daityā dānavāstatra saṃgatāḥ || 2 || ākrośanto mahādarpā niryayuryuddhavāṃchayā | tāḍakasya mahatsainyaṃ tvāgataṃ devasannidhau || 3 || tadā devānnabhovāṇī prāha prasannatānvitā | skandaṃ vijayinaṃ cāgre kṛtvā yāntu jayo bhavet || 4 || vijayārthaṃ tu pārvatyā putraḥ sa prakaṭīkṛtaḥ | yeṣāṃ skandogrago yuddhe teṣāṃ vai vijayo dhruvaḥ || 5 || śrutvā devā jahṛṣurvai yoddhukāmāśca nirbhayāḥ | brahmaṇā tatra tāvadvai noditaikā kumārikā || 6 || mṛtyoḥ putrī samāyātā mṛtyusenābhidhā tadā || varaṇārthaṃ kumārasya tapaḥ paramamāśritā || 7 || śatrūṇāṃ mārayitrī sā sundarī varamālayā| kumāra kārtikaṃ tatra varayāmāsa mārtyavī || 8 || tayā yuktastadā skandaḥ senāpatiriyāya vai| raṇāṃgaṇe tadā ghorā raktottejakagomukhāḥ || 9 || mahādundubhayo nedurḍiṇḍimānyadbhutāni ca | raṇakarkaśatūryāṇi mṛdaṃgapaṭahānakāḥ ||1.99.10|| kharaśrṛṃgāṇi śaṃkhāśca bheryo’vādyanta utkaṭāḥ || aikapadyena cottasthuryoddhukāmāḥ surāsurāḥ ||11|| kumāraṃ gajamāropya devendro hyagrago’bhavat | surasainyena mahatā lokapālaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ||12|| yamo’pi svagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ marudbhiśca samīraṇaḥ || yādobhirvaruṇastatra kubero guhyakairvṛtaḥ ||13|| śaṃkaraḥ pramathaiḥ sārdhaṃ nairṛto vyādhibhiḥ saha || antarvedyāṃ sthitāḥ sarve gāṅgayāmunamadhyagāḥ ||14|| pātālāśca samāyātāstārakasyopajīvinaḥ | daityāśca dānavāścaiva rākṣasā asurāśca ye ||15|| gajā uṣṭrā eḍakāśca hayā aśvatarāḥ khagāḥ || syandanāni vicitrāṇi vimānāni ca bhūriśaḥ ||16|| padātayo bahavaścāśobhanta sāyudhāstadā | khaḍgatomaranārācaiḥ pāśamudgarapaṭṭiśaiḥ ||17|| bāṇaparighacakraiśca śaktiśūlaparaśvadhaiḥ || taiḥ suyukte tadā sainye daityānāṃ ca divaukasām ||18|| śuśubhāte mahākālavakradṛṣṭyā nirīkṣite || yuddhāraṃbhadhvajau dṛṣṭvā mumucuḥ sāyakām̐stadā ||19|| bāṇānvavarṣurātīkṣṇān kṣuradhārānsamantataḥ | śikhānardhacandrām̐śca tridhārānpaṃcadhārakān ||1.99.20|| bāṇairācchāditaṃ vyomāvidhyanta viśikhairbhaṭāḥ | praphullakiṃśukā yadvad rājante kartitā bhaṭāḥ ||21|| sainye parasparaṃ bāṇaiśchanne garjanti tadbhaṭāḥ | bhūmau ca patitāḥ kecitkecinmuṇḍā luṭhanti vai ||22|| keṣāṃcidbāhavachinnāḥ kaṃdharāśca vidāritāḥ | hṛdayāni vinirbhinnānyanyeṣāṃ cūrṇitā kaṭiḥ ||23|| pāśairbhallairaṃkuśaiśca kuntaiśca ṛṣibhistathā | bhaṭāśca bahavastatra bhūśayyā hyabhavankṣaṇāt ||24|| sadaṃśauṣṭhaśirāṃsyācchādayadvai raṇamaṇḍalam | nṛtyamānakabandhāni dhāvantvanyajighṛkṣayā ||25|| bhaumaścaivāntarikṣaśca saṃgrāmo dāruṇo’bhavat || nāste paricayastatra śastrapātanakarmaṇi ||26|| jalpantaṃ śatrumādāya cūrṇayanti gadādibhiḥ || nadyaḥ pravartitā raktapravāhinyaḥ śavastarāḥ ||27|| rakte raṇāṃgaṇe raktaśchinnā bhinnā bhaṭāstadā || dvandvayuddhaṃ ca kurvanto jayāya bahavo hatāḥ ||28|| kujaṃbho vāyunā sārdhaṃ jaṃbhaḥ sārdhaṃ yamena vai || varuṇena balaścātha kubereṇa saha tripāt ||29|| agninā saha saṃhrādo naiṛtena mahāhanuḥ || īśena saha meghābha indreṇa saha tārakaḥ ||1.99.30|| yakṣāḥ piśācī uragāḥ pataṃgāḥ pitarastathā || vyādhayaḥ sannipātāśca jvara bhūtāśca guhyakāḥ ||31|| yuyudhuḥ pramathā astraśastraiśca bahubhistadā || evaṃ yuddhe sutumule devadānavasaṃkule ||32|| tārakeṇaiva devendraḥ śaktyā paramayā hataḥ || sadyaḥ papāta nāgādvai pṛthivyāṃ mūrchito’bhavat ||33|| svastho drāgeva saṃbhūtvā vajramādāya vegataḥ || vivyādha tārakaṃ vakṣasthale daityo’patad bhuvi ||34|| mūrchitaśchinnahṛdayo bhinnapṛṣṭhāsthidaṇḍakaḥ || śukreṇa sandhinīvallībalena sandhitaḥ punaḥ ||35|| utthitaśca jaghānendraṃ brahmāstraṃ prāṇanāśakam || viṣṇurnārāyaṇastadvai jagrāsa jihvayā drutam ||36|| indrastato mahāroṣānmahākālāstramādadhe | viṣṇuḥ prāha tadā tvindraṃ mā mā māraya taṃ hare ||37|| tasya hantā kumāro’yaṃ samudbhūtaḥ śivātmajaḥ | tasmādbhavadbhiḥ sthātavyaṃ bālena yudhyatā saha ||38|| senānītāḍakau cograu yuddhayamānau mahābalau | śuśubhāte’tisaṃrabdhau prahārairjarjarīkṛtau ||39|| mahām̐statra gaṇo vīro vīrabhadro ruṣānvitaḥ || gaṇaiḥ subahubhiryuktastārakaṃ hantumudyataḥ ||1.99.40|| triśūlairṛṣṭibhiḥ prāsaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ parighapaṭṭiśaiḥ || jaghnatuḥ samare’nyonyaṃ surāsuravimardane ||41|| tārako vīrabhadreṇa triśūlena hato bhṛśam | papāta sahasā tatra kṣaṇaṃ mūrchāmavāpa ca ||42|| utthāya ca muhūrtādvai śaktyā tu tārako balī || śivasyānucaraṃ śūlaṃ vīrabhadraṃ jaghāna ha ||43|| triśūlena tu ghoreṇa vīrabhadro’pi tārakam || jaghāna hṛdaye vegāttārakaḥ pothito bhuvi ||44|| hariḥ prāha tadā vīrabhadraṃ tu tārako’suraḥ || kārtikeyasya vadhyo’sti mā kuru tvaṃ pariśramam ||45|| na rocate’sya tadvākyaṃ tārakasya vadhaṃ prati | vīrabhadro ruṣāviṣṭo jagarja jaladopamaḥ ||46|| atārakāṃ mahīṃ cādya kariṣye nātra saṃśayaḥ || tāvatkapardino’neke jaṭājūṭavibhūṣitāḥ ||47|| vṛṣārūḍhā daśahastāḥ śūrāḥ krūrāstrilocanāḥ | pañcāsyā nīlakaṇṭhāśca gaṇā vai candraśekharāḥ ||48|| yuyudhuste mahādaityaistārakāsurajīvibhiḥ || devadānavadaityānāṃ sannipāto mahānabhūt ||49|| aśvavārāśca vājisthān gajino gajinastathā | jaghnū rathasthān rathino vyomagā vyomagāminaḥ ||1.99.50|| vīrabhadrastārakaṃ saṃgṛhya vai pādayostadā | bhrāmayitvāntarīkṣe’tha pothayāmāsa bhūtale ||51|| kṣayaṃ praṇītā bahavo’pare yātā rasātalam | palāyamānā bahavo bhītāḥ prāṃjalayo’pare ||52|| śaraṇyāśca raṇādbhagnā mṛtāḥ kecidbhuvastale || nipetuḥ śikharāṇīva vīrabhadrādināśitāḥ ||53|| evaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ svakaṃ sainyaṃ dṛṣṭvā vai tāḍakāsuraḥ || bhujānāmayutaṃ kṛtvā hantuṃ devagaṇān yayau ||54|| viṣṇuḥ prāha tadā skandaṃ nānyo hantāsti kartika || tasmāt tvayaiva netavyastārako yamasādanam ||55|| tārakeṇa purā vīra tapastaptaṃ bhayāvaham | tapasā tena cogreṇa hyajeyatvamavāptavān ||56|| jitā indrādilokeśāstrailokyaṃ ca jitaṃ tathā | tasmāt tvayā nihantavyaḥ śāntiḥ syācca tadā parā ||57|| ityāśrutya tadā skaṃdaḥ śaktimādāya pāragām | adhāvattārakaṃ tāvattārakaḥ śaktimādade ||58|| provāca daityo garviṣṭho devānavigaṇayya tu || indraḥ palāyito’thāpi yūyaṃ devā gatatrapāḥ ||59|| kumāraṃ yatpuraskṛtya raṇāgre’tra vyavasthitāḥ || maruto ghātitā garbhe dharṣitā gautamapriyā ||1.99.60|| viśvarūpo hato vipro vṛtro yena niṣūditaḥ || kārayituṃ kumārasya ghātaṃ kva pragato hariḥ ||61|| dakṣayajñe tvanekeṣāṃ viprāṇāṃ nāśako hyayam | na bālo vai vīrabhadraḥ sannidhau mama tiṣṭhatu ||6|| vīraṃ cendraṃ kumāraṃ ca nayāmi yamasādanam || uktvaivaṃ tu tadā śaktitrayaṃ jagrāha tārakaḥ ||63|| tāvadindro bahudhāraṃ vajraṃ cikṣepa tārake | patito’pi samutthāya śaktyendraṃ prāharadruṣā ||64|| patitaṃ cendramālokya gatvā padā nipīḍya ca | vajraṃ tasyāharatpaścādyāvadindraṃ jighāṃsati ||65|| tāvat triśūlamudyamya vīrabhadreṇa tāḍitaḥ || patitaścāsuro bhūmau drāgeva punarutthitaḥ ||66|| prajaghāna triśūlena vīravakṣasi vegataḥ || vīrabhadrastataḥ kruddhastriśūlena jighāṃsati ||67|| kumāreṇa niṣiddho yat mama nāśyo hyayaṃ tviti || atho jayetyabhiprokto devairākāśasaṃsthitaiḥ ||68|| jagarja ca mahātejāḥ kārtikeyo mahābalaḥ || mūrdhni kaṇṭhe codare’pi jānvoścaiva kaṭibhramau ||69|| vakṣasi pṛṣṭha urasi tvanyonyaṃ pravijaghnatuḥ | na vavau ca tadā vāyurniṣprabho’bhūddivākaraḥ ||1.99.70|| cacāla vasudhā sarvā saśailabahukānanā || himālayādayaḥ sarve parvatāśca cakampire ||71|| kumāraḥ prāha pāpiṣṭha devānāṃ duḥkhadāyaka | ghātayāmi mahāśaktyā smara sveṣṭaṃ sthiro bhava ||72|| iti kṣiptā mahāśaktistīkṣṇāgrāṣṭapradhārikā | tārake vakṣasi śīrṇe pāraṃ pṛṣṭhe jagāma sā ||73|| tārakaṃ viddhamādāya pṛthvyāmardhā viveśa sā | viśīrṇastārakaścāyaṃ punaḥ skandena māritaḥ ||74|| dadṛśustaṃ suragaṇāḥ ṛṣayo guhyakāḥ khagāḥ | kinnarāścāraṇāścāpi siddhāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ||75|| parameṇa praharṣeṇa tuṣṭuvustaṃ kumārakam || vidyādharyaśca nanṛturgāyakāśca jagustathā ||76|| devā nirāmayā jātāḥ santuṣṭāśca śivādayaḥ || girijā harṣamāpannā svāṃkamāropya cātmajam ||77|| pariṣvajya śubhāśīrbhiryuyoja jayinaṃ sutam | pariśramaṃ kṣataṃ dehe sphāṭitaṃ vā praphullitam ||78|| pārvatī svakarasparśānnīrujaṃ tvakarotkṣaṇāt | devāḥ kalyāṇarūpāya namaścakrustadā mudā ||79|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mṛtyuputryā senayā vṛṇītena kārtikeyena yuddhe tārakāsuro hata ityabhivarṇananāmā navanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 99 ||
<1.100> śrīśvetavyāsa uvāca evaṃ suśikha sannaṣṭaṃ tārakaṃ lokahārakam || naṣṭaṃ śrutvā svayaṃ lakṣmīrnārāyaṇamuvāca ha || 1 || śrīlakṣmīruvāca nārāyaṇa mahāviṣṇo daityaḥ sa tārakāsuraḥ || ka āsīcca kathaṃ kasmādvaraṃ prāpto’tra me vada || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu caikahṛdā devi vajrāṃgasutatārakam | mānaso brahmaṇaḥ putro dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ | tena kanyā ditirdattā kaśyapāya mahātmane || 3 || tasyā garbhe marutdevā mahendreṇa vikartitāḥ | ekonapañcāśajjātā devāste maruto matāḥ | kintu ditisturāṣāho vināśāya tapo’karot || 4 || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tena vajrāṃgadaḥ sutaḥ | samutpanno janmataḥ sa vajrasāramayāṃgakaḥ || 5 || jātamātro mahāyoddhā śastraśāstraprapāragaḥ || uvāca mātaraṃ bhaktyā mātaḥ kiṃ karavāṇyaham || 6 || mātā prāha surendreṇa sutā me bahavo hatāḥ | teṣāmapacitiṃ cikīrṣāmi śakravadhādaham || 7 || bāḍhamityevamuktvā sa jagāma tridivaṃ tadā | pādenākṛṣya caivendraṃ māturantikamānayat || 8 || brahmā tāvatkaśyapaśca procaturmuñca vajriṇam | avamānaṃ mṛtyurasya tvayā māturvacaḥ kṛtam || 9 || tathā piturvacaḥ kāryaṃ muñcāmuṃ tu sureśvaram || natvā sa pitroścaraṇe taṃ mumoca śatakratum ||1.100.10|| vajrāṃgadastato yāto vane kartuṃ tapo mahat || brahmaṇā ca tadānīṃ tu varāṃgī kanyakārpitā ||11|| tāṃ patnīṃ tu samādāya vajrāṃgo hyagamadvanam | ūrdhvabāhuḥ sa daityendro’tiṣṭhadabdasahasrakam ||12| tāvannadhomukhaḥ kālaṃ tāvatpaṃcāgnisādhakaḥ | tataḥ so’ntarjale cakre tapo varṣasahasrakam ||13|| tatpatnī sarasastīre tapastepe pativratā | indro vibhīṣaṇāścakre bhūtvā vai markaṭaḥ svayam ||14|| jalakuṃbhaṃ babhaṃjāsyā meṣarūpo bhayaṃ dadau | sarparūpastato bhūtvā babandha caraṇāvubhau ||15|| gomāyūśca tato bhūtvā rauti sannidhimāgataḥ || agnirūpastato bhūtvā tasyā dadāha vastrakam ||16|| vāyurbhūtvā cakarṣaināṃ siṃho bhūtvā hyabhīṣayat | tāvadvarṣasahasraṃ tu vyatītaṃ ca pitāmahaḥ ||17|| āyayāvatha vajrāṃgo dharmavṛttiṃ tato’vṛṇot | evamastviti datvā tadvaraṃ brahmā tirodadhe ||18|| śokārtāṃ svāṃ striyaṃ rājā vajrāṃgo’paśyadāha ca | kiṃ te kāryaṃ dadāmīha mā śokaṃ kuru bhāmini ||19|| patnī prāha kṛpā cenme putraṃ duḥkhasya tārakam | dehi cendraḥ sadā māṃ tu trāsaṃ dadāti cetyataḥ ||1.100.20|| vajrāṃgastu virakto’pi hyanukampyā priyeti yat || matvā tatheti jāyāyai punastapaścakāra ha ||21|| yāvadabdasahastraṃ vai nirāhāraṃ tapo’karot || brahmā prāha punastasmai kathaṃ vidhīyate tapaḥ ||22|| prāha daityo dehi putraṃ gīrvāṇadarpanāśakam || brahmovāca tava patnyāṃ putro vai duḥkhatārakaḥ ||23|| devasīmantinīnāṃ yo dhammilakavimokṣakaḥ || bhaviṣyatīti tatsthānāt daṃpatī tau prajagmatuḥ ||24|| svāśramaṃ cātha sā garbhaṃ ditirdadhāra tārakam | pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu dadhārodara eva vai ||25|| tato jāte suputre tu pracacāla vasundharāḥ || celurdharādharāḥ sarve vavurvātāḥ prabhīṣaṇāḥ ||26|| sūryādyāśca jahuḥ kāntiṃ nīhārācchāditā diśāḥ || viṣaṇṇamanaso devā dānavāstu mahotsavāḥ ||27|| jātamātrastu daityendro hyabhiṣikto’surādibhiḥ || mahārājye’tha sarvānsa prāha surajigīṣayā ||28|| surāstu śatravo’smākaṃ jayyāste tapaso balāt | tapaḥ kartuṃ tu gacchāmi pāriyātragirerdarīm ||29|| tatra gataḥ śivaṃ dhyātvā śivamantraṃ jajāpa saḥ || nirāhāraḥ pañcatapāstathāvarṣāyutaṃ gatam ||1.100.30|| tataḥ svadehādutkṛtya karṣaṃ karṣaṃ dine dine | māṃsasyāgnau juhāvaiva tato nirmāṃsatāṃ gataḥ ||31|| dehaścāgnimayo jātastena bhūtāni jajvaluḥ || brahmā tasmai varaṃ dātuṃ suprasanno jagāma ha ||32|| brahmovācottiṣṭha putra varaṃ vṛṇīṣva cepsitam | tārakaḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā varaṃ vavre tadepsitam ||33|| jātivaireṇa devāstu sarvadā trāsayanti naḥ | ato daityasamuddhartā bhaveyamiti me matiḥ ||34|| avadhya sarvabhūtānāmastrāṇāṃ ca mahaujasām | syāmahaṃ cāmaraścaiṣa varo deyo madīpsitaḥ ||35|| brahmā prāha ca taṃ mṛtyumṛte dehī na jāyate || jātasya hi dhruvo mṛtyustasmādanyad vṛṇu priyam ||36|| mohito’pi sa daityendraḥ śiśorāsaptavāsarāt || vavre mṛtyuṃ tathetyāha brahmā śaṃkaravākyataḥ ||37 daityo jagāma rājye sve mahārṇavataṭottare|| sarvasmṛddhipariṣvakto modate sa sabhājitaḥ ||38|| sarvāstrajñaśca śastrajño yuddharītiviśāradaḥ || sarvāndaityāndānavām̐ścāsurānnītvā svarāyayau ||39|| dikpālān lokapālām̐śca jitvā devāngrahām̐stathā || trilokyāśca svayaṃ rājyaṃ cakre devān vyavāsayat ||1.100.40|| svayamindro nimirvahniḥ kālanemiryamo’pi ca || jambhaśca niṛtisthāne mahiṣo varuṇastathā ||41|| meṣo vātādhikāraśca kujaṃbho dhanado’bhavat | anyeṣāṃ cādhikārām̐śca daityebhyastārako dadau ||42|| evaṃ viprakṛtā devā mahendrasahitāstadā || yayuḥ svāyaṃbhuvaṃ dhāma tuṣṭuvuḥ parameṣṭhinam ||43|| namo jagatprasūtyai te hetave pālakāya ca | saṃhartre ca namastubhyaṃ tārakād rakṣaṇaṃ kuru ||44|| brahmā prāha tadā sarvān jāne yuṣmān vivāsitān || tasya hantā ca nādyāpi sa jāto bhuvane pumān ||45|| sa ca vavre vadhaṃ daityaḥ śiśutaḥ saptavāsarāt | sa vai saptadino bālaḥ skandākhyaḥ śaṃkarodbhavaḥ ||46|| kālarātrirmama tanuḥ dakṣaputrī satī ca yā | tanuṃ tyaktvā punaḥ sā ca pārvatī saṃbhaviṣyati ||47|| vivāhaḥ śaṃbhunā tasyā bhaviṣyati yadā tadā | skandākhyaḥ khalu putro yo bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ ||48|| saptadino haniṣyati senānīstārakāsuram | prāpte tu samaye sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati harīcchayā ||49|| ityanenāgate kāle senānyā ca raṇāṃgaṇe || hato vai tārako daityaḥ śāntimāpustadā surāḥ ||1.100.50|| atha senānyanujasya gaṇeśasya ca tāṃ kathām || śṛṇu vacmi tato lakṣmi śrīkṛṣṇasmārikāṃ śubhām ||51|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tārakāsurasya brahmaṇo varadānajanmādikathananāmā śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||100||
<1.101> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca tato vasantasamaye śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ || kokilākūjitaṃ śrutvā ghrātvā saugandhikaṃ dravam || 1 || dṛṣṭvā śrāṃgārikaiḥ puṣṭaṃ yauvanaṃ ratisaṃbhṛtam | patnīṃ svāṃke nidhāyeśo ramate sma ciraṃ ciram || 2 || śatavarṣasamaḥ kālo yayau ratikriyāparaḥ || viṣṇurvaraṃ pradattaṃ prāk smṛtvā tatrāgamatsvayam || 3 || pārvatyā cāgrapūjyo vai vṛtaḥ putro madātmakaḥ || ayonijaḥ sa evāhaṃ bhaveyaṃ miṣataḥ svayam || 4 || iti vicintya kṛṣṇaḥ sa vipro babhūva tatkṣaṇam || retaḥpātanakāle ca sa viṣṇurnijamāyayā ||5|| vidhāya viprarūpaṃ tadājagāma ratigṛham || jaṭāvantaṃ vinā tailaṃ kucailaṃ bhikṣukaṃ tathā || 6 || atīva śukladaśanaṃ tṛṣṇāvyāptahṛdantaram | atīva kṛśagātraṃ ca bibhrattilakamujjvalam || 7 || bahugharghasvaraṃ dīnaṃ dainyāt kutsitamūrtikam | karadaṇḍāvalambaṃ ca vārdhakyādatidurbalam || 8 || etādṛśena rūpeṇa ratikāle’nnayācakaḥ || bhūtvā sthito vadan svasti yajamānasya cāstviti || 9 || punarāha mahādeva kiṃ karoṣi śaraṇyada || paśya vṛddhaṃ jarāgrastaṃ kṣuttaṣādyatipīḍitam ||1.101.10|| saptarātrivrate’tīte pāraṇākāṃkṣitaṃ ca mām | vitraṃ saṃbhojayitvātra rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāgatam ||11|| māṃtaruttiṣṭha me’nnaṃ tvaṃ prayacchādya śivaṃ jalam | anantaratnayukputri rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāgatam ||12|| mātarmātarjaganmātarehi dehi subhojanam || sīdāmi kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ kasmāt sthitāyāmātmamātari ||13|| iti dīnaṃ svaraṃ śrutvā śivasyottiṣṭhato drutam || papāta vīryaṃ śayyāyāṃ yonimukhād bahirgatam ||14|| pārvatī tatra śayyāyāṃ nāvait patitavīryakam || svapityeva muhuḥ pārśve parāvartayati sma sā ||15|| dhātuḥ sarvopi pārvatyāḥ pṛṣṭhe pārśve tanau tadā || lagnaḥ śuṣko’bhavaddivyo rājato varṇataḥ khalu ||16|| na jānati śarīre me kiṃ lagnaṃ vai pariśramāt || svāpnanidrābhibhūtā sā svapityeva pariśramāt ||17|| śaṃkarastu bahidvāramājagāma dadarśa tam || yācantaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dīnaṃ jarayā paripīḍitam ||18|| vṛddhaṃ jarjaramātraṃ ca bibhrataṃ daṇḍamānatam | tapasvinamaśāntaṃ ca kurvantaṃ namanaṃ muhuḥ ||19|| śaṃkaraḥ prāha viprarṣe kimicchasi kuto bhavān || āgato’sti svāgataṃ te mama bhāgyādupasthitaḥ ||1.101.20|| adya me saphalaṃ janma brāhmaṇo madgṛhe’tithiḥ | atithiḥ śrīhareḥ rūpaṃ pūjitaḥ pūjitaṃ jagat ||21|| devāstiṣṭhantyatithiṣu brāhmaṇāḥ puṇyadāḥ sadā | atitheḥ pādapātreṣu vasanti tīrthajātayaḥ ||22|| atitheḥ pādasalilāt puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam | prāpyate gṛhasaṃsthānairlabhyante smṛddhayo’kṣayāḥ ||23|| snātāni sarvatīrthāni yajñā nirvartitāstathā | mahādānāni dattāni yenātithiḥ susatkṛtaḥ ||24|| vedaśāstrādivarṇyāni satkarmāṇi ca yāni vai || tāni cātithisevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||25|| asatkṛto’tithiryasya gṛhādvai vinivartate || pāpāni gṛhiṇe datvā puṇyamādāya gacchati ||26|| atitherasamarhāyāṃ viyanti pitṛdevatāḥ || sādhoḥ sādhvyā asatkāre gṛhī devairasatkṛtaḥ ||27|| sarvasampadvihīnaḥ syātpāpaṃ bhuṃkte darībharam || vipraḥ prāha śubhaṃ bhūyād brahmam̐ste’tithibhāvataḥ ||28|| jānāsi cedatithirme vedoktaṃ kuru pūjanam || manogataṃ ca dātavyaṃ nirāhārāya cārtiṇe ||29|| nānāvidhaṃ tu miṣṭānnaṃ dīyatāṃ me sutṛptikṛt | tṛptaścāhaṃ bhavatputro bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ||1.101.30|| sarvāgryārcyo bhaviṣyāmi bhaviṣyati bhavān pitā | tātāḥ pañcavidhāḥ proktā mātarastvaṣṭadhā matāḥ ||31|| putrāḥ pañcavidhāḥ sādho tanmadhye’haṃ bhavāmi vai | vidyādātānnadātā ca bhayatrātā ca janmadaḥ ||32|| kanyādātā brahmaṇoktā narāṇāṃ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ || guroḥ patnī garbhadhātrī stanyadātrī pituḥ svasā ||33|| svasā mātuḥ sapatnī ca putrabhāryānnadāyikā | etā aṣṭavidhā mātā pūjanīyā suputrakaiḥ ||34|| bhṛtyaḥ śiṣyaśca poṣyaśca vīryajaḥ śaraṇāgataḥ || pañca putrāḥ sadā bodhyā vīryajo’tra viśeṣakaḥ ||35|| kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ suparītāṃgaṃ putraṃ māṃ śaraṇāgatam | piṣṭakaṃ paramānnaṃ ca supakvāni phalāni ca ||36|| ikṣurasaṃ śarkarāṃ ca kṣīraṃ śālyannamityapi | laḍḍūkām̐ścūrṇagodhūmān vyañjanāni tilāni ca ||37|| preyāṃsi peyakhādyāni picchalaṃ madhuraṃ dadhi | mama priyāṇi vastūni sudhayā tulyakāni ca ||38|| tāmbūlaṃ ca varamelāpūgīkarpūramiśritam | rasamiṣṭasugandhāḍhyaṃ dravyāṇyetāni dāpaya ||39|| svāmī tvaṃ trijagatkartā pradātā sarvasampadām || mahālakṣmīsvarūpā te patnī caiśvaryadāyinī ||1.101.40|| ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ ramyamamūlyaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇam | vahriśuddhāṃśukaṃ cāru pradāsyasi sudurlabham ||41|| sudurlabhaṃ harermantraṃ harau bhaktiṃ sudurlabhām || sarvasiddhipradaṃ nāma kimadeyaṃ sutāya te ||42|| icchayā kurute karma tato bhogo bhavatyapi | sukhaduḥkhe sadā lagne dehināṃ viramedataḥ ||43|| karma nirmūlayantyeva santo hi satataṃ mudā | harismaraṇaśīlānāṃ nāyuryāti satāṃ vṛthā ||44|| na teṣāmīśvaraḥ kālo nānye vā tanniyāmakāḥ || ciraṃ jīvanti te bhaktāḥ svacchandaṃ sarvagāminaḥ ||45|| jātismarā harerbhaktā jānanti janmanāṃ śatam | kathayanti kathāṃ janma labhante svecchayā ca te ||46|| paraṃ punanti te pūtāstīrthāni svīyalīlayā || puṇyakṣetre’tra sevārthaṃ parārthaṃ ca bhramanti te ||47|| vaiṣṇavānāṃ padasparśāt sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā || gurorāsyād viṣṇumantro yasya karṇe viśatyapi ||48|| taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tīrthapūtaṃ kathayatyeva mādhavaḥ | puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ pūrvamuddharanti śataṃ param ||49|| līlayā parayā bhaktyā sodarān pitaraṃ tathā | mātāmahānāṃ puruṣāndaśa pūrvāndaśāparān ||1.101.50|| mātuḥ prasūmuddharanti dāruṇāt yamatāḍanāt || bhaktadarśanamāśleṣaṃ mānavāḥ prāpnuvanti ye ||51|| te yātāḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitāḥ || na liptāḥ pātakairbhaktāḥ santataṃ harimānasāḥ ||52|| trikoṭijanmanāmante prāpnoti janma mānavam || prāpnoti bhaktasaṃgaṃ sa mānuṣe koṭijanmataḥ ||53|| bhaktasaṃgād bhaved bhakteraṃkuro jīvito hara || aṃkuraścāvināśī ca vardhate pratijanmani ||54|| tattarorvardhamānasya harerdāsyaṃ bhavet phalam || pariṇāme bhaktipāke pārṣadaśca bhaveddhareḥ ||55|| tasmādbhaktiṃ harau dehi yathā te śrīharau sadā || gaṇeśarūpaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ kalpe kalpe tavātmajaḥ ||56|| bhaviṣyati śubhaṃ te’stu dehi bhikṣāṃ mama priyām || āgatosmi nivāsāya yadi te’pi mataṃ bhavet ||57|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pārvatyāḥ sahavāse śaṃkaramāhvayan śrīkṛṣṇo brāhmaṇarūpeṇa bhikṣārthamāgatastayoḥ sadbhaktamāhātmyasaṃvādaśceti nirūpaṇanāmā ekādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||101||
<1.102> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tato yadvai sampannaṃ kathayāmyaham | ityabhyarthya svapitaraṃ śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram || 1 || tūṣṇīmāsa yadā vipraḥ śaṃbhurāśvāsya taṃ dvijam || gṛhāntare gataḥ śaṃbhuḥ pārvatīṃ nidritāṃ priyām || 2 || śīghraṃ prabodhayāmāsa bhikṣārthaṃ ca dvijātaye || sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa yadyadicchati vāḍavaḥ || 3 || pārvatī karapādādi śodhayitvā jalena ca | viprepsitāni vastūnyāhārayāmāsa cāṃgaṇe || 4 || saṃkalpena tu siddhāni yānyapyanyāni vāñcchati | tatsarvaṃ tatra vṛddhāya brāhmaṇāya samarpayat || 5 || na vai nyūnamabhūt kiṃcit tutoṣāti sa vāḍavaḥ || vastūnyādāya vipraḥ saḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||6|| putro bhavitumicchan vai tatraivādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ || pārvatyāstu śarīre yo dhāturlagno’sti śāṃkaraḥ || 7 || tatra dhātau praviṣṭo’yaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || pārvatyapi tadā svāṃgeṣvabhilagnaṃ sacetanam || 8 || dhātuṃ dṛṣṭvā śārīraṃ tan malaṃ dhūlyādisaṃbhavam | matvā śuddhiṃ tadā naiva cakāra parameśvarī || 9 || śarīraṃ bahudhūlyādimalāḍhyaṃ pravilokya ca || snānaṃ viśālaṃ sodgandhaṃ kariṣye’dya dine śanaiḥ ||1.102.10|| nirmalaṃ vai śarīraṃ ca nadyāmeva bhaviṣyati | evaṃ vicāraṃ dadhatī sthitā prātaḥ śubhāsane ||11|| snānayogyavicitrāṇi gandhadravyāṇyakārayat || dāsībhirgṛhakāryāṇi maṃgalādīnyakārayet ||12|| atha śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃ devanadyāṃ snānāya nirgataḥ || gaṇaiḥ saha sa vai yāto’nye gaṇāstamanudrutāḥ ||13|| kelāse pārvatīkṣetre gopure nāsti rakṣakaḥ || sarve gaṇāstadā yātā jñātvā snānotsavaṃ param ||14|| śaṃbhumarghyaiścandanaiśca tailaiḥ sugandhibhistathā | saurabhaistilapiṣṭaiśca kaisareḥ karpuraistathā ||15|| upamṛdya mahādevaṃ snāpayanti sma dhārayā || gaṇānāmapi sarveṣāṃ vihārasnānatāraṇaiḥ ||16|| jalakelyādibhistatra sumahānutsavo’bhavat | snānānte tu gaṇaiḥ śaṃbhoḥ saṃskṛtā tu śirojaṭā ||17|| bhasmapuṣpasugandhyādidravaiḥ saṃprokṣitābhavat | lalāṭe bālacandrasya rekhayā saha candanam ||18|| lekhayā kṛtarekhaṃ tu carcitaṃ puṇḍrakaṃ yathā || karṇapūrau ca rudrākṣaiḥ kṛtau kaṇṭhe ca vāsukiḥ ||19|| hāro rudrākṣasampanno muṇḍamālāpi pauraṭī || karṇayordhatttūrapuṣpe rudrākṣadvayavuṭṭike ||1.102.20|| bhujayoḥ sarparājau ca prakoṣṭhe bhujagadvayam || kauśyastu mudrikā ratnaśrṛṃkhaleṃ’gulihastayoḥ ||21|| yajñopavītaṃ śubhagaṃ hasticarmasukaṃcukam || siṃhacarmakṛtadhautraṃ kaṭyāṃ ca muñjamekhalā ||22|| triśūlaṃ hastasannyastaṃ kaupīnaṃ mṛgacarmaṇaḥ || satkāṣṭhapāduke ramye śarīre bhasma saṃdhṛtam ||23|| atha netre dhyānayukte parāvṛtyārdhamelite || vyāghracarmaṇā prātarvai sandhyārthaṃ saṃsthito haraḥ ||24|| apāṃ kamaṇḍaluḥ pārśve pañcapātrāṇi cāgrataḥ || kuśapuṣpākṣatadhūpadīpacandanakuṃkumam ||25|| nyastaṃ gaṇaiḥ svayaṃ devo dhyānamagno babhūva ha || samādhiṃ svātmani prāpto nispṛhaḥ sarvathā sadā ||26|| yadā tiṣṭhati dhyāne vā samādhau śaṃkarastadā || nāsti kālasya niyamo nispṛhasya tṛṇaṃ jagat ||27|| samādhau saṃsthito devo gaṇāstatra tvitastataḥ | nṛtyanti ca pragāyanti ramante ca vanādiṣu ||28|| vṛkṣeṣvārohāvarohau kurvanti ca svapanti ca | phalamūlānyāharanti gṛhṇanti mādakāni ca ||29|| puṣpapatrāṇi cinvanti nayanti harasannidhau || nivedya dhyānamagnāya śaṃbhave’tha ca te gaṇāḥ ||1.102.30|| phalakandādi khādanti rasānāsvādayanti ca || evamutsavakartṛṇāṃ saṃgavastatra vai gataḥ ||31|| gaṇāḥ śaṃbhuṃ vihāyaiva na cāyānti haragṛham || pratīkṣate pārvatī tu nāyādeko’pi sevakaḥ ||32|| tataḥ snātuṃ samīhānā tailasaurabhavāribhiḥ || sugandhitadravairdevī sakeśaṃ snānamicchati ||33|| dvāre kaścinmayā sthāpyo dvārapālo nirodhakaḥ || snāne kaścinna cāgacched rahasīti vicārya vai ||34|| svasyā dhūlyādikaṃ lagnaṃ śaṃbhudhātumayaṃ malam | svedamiśraṃ dravaṃ matvā viśliṣya kṛtapeśikam ||35|| puttalaṃ sundaraṃ tasya sarvāvayavaśobhitam || satyaḥ putro yathā vā syāt tādṛśaṃ viracayya ca ||36|| yāvatkareṇa dehaṃ taṃ snigdhacikkaṇatāptaye || parimārjayate mohāttāvat tāvattu tat svayam ||37|| caitanye sadrūpe bhāve vivṛtiṃ prāpya śobhate | śiraḥ karatalenaiva yāvanmārjayate śivā ||38|| tāvattu mastakaṃ tasya sakeśaṃ sūjjvalaṃ hyabhūt || lalāṭe mukhanetrādau yāvaddhastau suyojitau ||39|| tāvannetre surūpe sugrāhake’bhavatāṃ tadā | kapolau prollasadgolau lalāṭaṃ cārucandrakam ||1.102.40|| oṣṭhau raktau mukhaṃ mandahāsyakṛt kalidantavat || sunāsaṃ ca surūpaṃ ca nirvṛttaṃ tatkṣaṇācchubham ||41|| tāvattu pārvatī devī sahāsyā svasakhīstadā || āhvayate prapaśyantu bālo’yaṃ nirmito mayā ||42|| hasan bālo’pi mandaṃ svanetre tudghāṭya paśyati | mātaraṃ tatsakhīśceti sarvānandakaro’bhavat ||43|| tato mātrā kṛtaṃ svasti putrasya karayostathā | pṛṣṭhe vakṣasi kaṭyāṃ ca sakthnostathaiva jānunoḥ ||44|| jaṃghayoḥ pādayoścāṃguliṣu prokṣyadravaiḥ śubhaiḥ || svahastau bhrāmitau tasyāṃgāni pramārjitāni ca ||45|| yatra yatra pradeśe ca spṛṣṭe hastatale śubhe | pārvatyāstatra tatrāyaṃ bālo bhavati cetanaḥ ||46|| surūpaḥ suṣṭhvavayavaḥ puṣṭaśca mātṛjo yathā | krīḍayā puttalaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ putro jātaḥ sa cetanaḥ ||47|| ityāścaryaṃ mahatprāpya pūjanaṃ prāṇarakṣaṇam || sarvāvayavapūrṇatvaṃ kṛtaṃ devyā viśeṣataḥ ||48|| saṃsmṛtya pārvatī kṛṣṇapradattaṃ varadānakam || ayonijo’grapūjyaste putraścānyo bhavediti ||49|| tadidaṃ varadānaṃ vai kṛṣṇarūpaṃ suputrakam | matvā niścayatastasya mahāpūjanamācarat ||1.102.50|| sugandhaiḥ snāpito dravyairarcito bhojitastathā | śrṛṃgāravastubhiḥ samyaka śobhito bodhitastayā ||51|| mama putreti cāhūya cumbanaṃ sā vyadhānmuhuḥ | stanyapānaṃ nidhāyāṃke’kārayatprāha pārvatī ||52|| mama rakṣākaraḥ putraḥ kṛṣṇo’yaṃ bhagavān svayam | prādurbhūto mama kalpavādapaḥ phalito’dhunā ||53|| aho sakhyaḥ kumāraṃ me vardhayantu śubhāśiṣā || sakhya āyāntu putraṃ me balaṃ dadatu rakṣakam ||54|| aho ālyaḥ kumāraṃ me śirastrāṇaṃ sukaṃcukam | yajñopavītakaṃ ramyaṃ hāraṃ kāṃcanajaṃ tathā ||55|| ratnahīrakabhūṣāśca dhārayantu yathāsthalam | dhautraṃ pītāmbaraṃ kaṭisūtraṃ ca kaṭibandhanam ||56|| samarpayantu tadyogyaṃ dadatvanyadapekṣitam || kurvantu jayatilakaṃ candrakaṃ sākṣataṃ tathā ||57|| evaṃ śrṛṃgāritaścāpi vardhitaśca sakhījanaiḥ || satyā ca bodhito me tvaṃ rakṣako bhava gopure ||58|| dattānyasmai mahaddhāryaṃ triśūlaṃ carma khaḍgakam | śaktiḥ pāśaḥ kuṭhāraśca rakṣāyā māliketi ca ||59|| evaṃ susajjya putraṃ taṃ śaṃbhoranyūnasadbalam || svasnānodyānamārgasya gopure’sthāpayat satī ||1.102.60|| tayājñapto vayaṃ snāmo devanadyā hṛde śubhe || udyāne saṃsthite tatra jalāgādhe ramāmahe ||61|| mama putro gaṇeśastvaṃ mā praveśaya kaṃcana | yāvadvayaṃ nivṛttāḥ sma snānādatra gṛhāṃgaṇe ||6|| tāvatkaścijjano nāyād gopurāntaramityayam || ādeśo me tvayā rakṣyo mā pumān viśatu sthalīm ||63|| yadi prasahya cāgacched balāttaṃ vinivārya vai | rakṣaṇaṃ tava mātustu pārvatyā me karotviti ||64|| yāvatsnānāni jāyante tāvanna praviśennara | evamuktvā dṛḍhayitvārpayitvā cāyudhāni sā ||65|| mantrāṇyapi tadā datvātiṣṭhipadgaṇanāyakam || so’yaṃ gopuramavati yathādeśamatandritaḥ ||66|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kṛṣṇātmakaviprasya bhikṣāprāptyuttaramadṛśyatā pārvatyāḥ śārīradhātumalād gaṇeśotpattiḥ saprāṇagaṇeśasya pārvatyāḥ snānakāle gopurarakṣārthaṃ niyuktiścetyādivarṇananāmā dvyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 102 ||
<1.103> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu priye sahālībhiḥ pārvatī harasundarī || devyaḥ sarvāśca dāsyaśca militvā dyunadīṃ saha || 1 || gatāḥ snānārthamityatra niḥśaṃkaṃ snānti vāriṣu | sugandhisāratailāni sammṛdyātyamṛtāni ca || 2 || dadhīni madhubhiścāpi rasyānyapi kaṭūni ca | sakhyaḥ snānaṃ kārayanti pārvatīṃ jagataḥ prasūm || 3 || ramayanti jale tāṃ vai prāṃjalakṣepaṇādibhiḥ || sugandhi salilaṃ jātaṃ sugandhadravamiśritam ||4|| snāne sakhīvihāre’tra tṛptirnāsāṃ prajāyate || snānti caiva punaḥ snānti patanti salile muhuḥ || 5 || vinirgatya punaḥ snānti snānāntaṃ naiva yānti hi || saṃgavo vigataḥ kālaḥ śaṃbhurdhyānād bahistadā || 6 || āgataḥ svāsanaṃ tyaktvā caikākī svāśramaṃ gataḥ || gaṇāṃścānye na jānanti snānalagnāstadābhavan || 7 || śaṃbhuḥ svābhāviko dhyānī śanaiḥ śanaiḥ prayāti hi || svāśramasya mahaddvāraṃ yāvat praviśatīśvaraḥ || 8 || tāvatpārvatyātmajena niruddho yāhi mā tviti || kastvaṃ kasmātsamāyātaḥ karamādviśasi gopuram || 9 || tiṣṭha vivṛtya taṃ mārgaṃ yāhi yenāgato’tra vai || nātra sthātuṃ pradeyo vai mayā kau’pi jano naraḥ ||1.103.10|| ājñā nāstyeva me mātustasmādvigaccha gopurāt | tathāpi śaṃkarastasya naiva śrutvā prayāti hi ||11|| tāvat krodhasamāviṣṭo gaṇeśo mātṛsevakaḥ | prodghuṣya ca samutplutya pradudrāva haraṃ prati ||12|| gatvā tanmārgamārudhya mā gacchoktvā hyupasthitaḥ | parāgaccha parāgaccha ko’si kva gacchasi drutam ||13|| atrodyāne praveśāya manmātrājñā na vartate snānaṃ kurvanti sakhyaśca manmātrā saha vāribhiḥ ||14|| mā yāhi naiva gantavyaṃ vigaccheto bahiḥ pivan | śaṃbhuḥ prāha tamajñātvā ko’si roddhā mama gṛham ||15|| mamodyānaṃ tu gacchāmi kastvaṃ roddhā mamāpi ca || gaccha yāhi tvitaḥ sthānāt kayā tvaṃ yojito’tra vai ||16|| bahirgaccha mama dvārādgopurānmama rakṣitāt | ityākruśya hareṇa svamavijñāya tu bālakam ||17|| haste dhṛtvā gopurāt sa bahirniṣkāsito balāt | tāvadgaṇeśastaddhastāddhastaṃ svaṃ praviyujya ca ||18|| śaṃbhuṃ hastadvaye dhṛtvā cākruśya nītavān bahiḥ | prāha śaṃbhuṃ yāhi dūraṃ mā mukhaṃ me pradarśaya ||19|| śaṃbhunāpi tadā jñātaṃ matto’pi balavānayam | na vai śārīrayuddhena jetuṃ śakyo bhavedayam ||1.103.20|| aho madīyaḥ kailāso gṛhodyānaśca rakṣasā || svāyattīkṛta evaitya kenāpi dhruvamarthataḥ ||21|| kva syād devī mama patnī kimabhūd viparītakam | kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā cādya hyayaṃ tu balavāniti ||22|| yadi gatvā gaṇān vakṣye tadā me balahīnatā || hāsyāspadatvamāpnuyāṃ yuddhe cāpi parājayam ||23|| svasya mānaṃ dhanaṃ mantraṃ cāvamānaṃ ca maithunam | dānaṃ dharmaṃ gṛhakleśaṃ kāryaṃ naiva prakāśayet ||24|| tataḥ kimiti vai kāryaṃ bālo’yaṃ balavāniti | pārvatī ced vijānīyād yuddhe śaṃbhuḥ parājitaḥ ||25|| tadagre ca mayā bhāvyaṃ natakaṃdharavartinā | vaktyayaṃ pārvatīputraḥ kimevaṃ saṃbhavediti ||26|| sarvasmājjayamicchedvai putrācchiṣyātparājayam || ataḥ sāmnā bodhayitvā gacchāmi mama mandiram ||27|| vicāryetthaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā yāvadvadati śaṃkaraḥ | gaṇeśo’pi tadā dvāraṃ niruddhya pratitiṣṭhati ||28|| śaṃbhuḥ prāha mamaiṣo vai kailāso vartate gṛham || patnī bhāryā mama devī pārvatī vartateṃ’gaja ||29|| māhaṃ tvayā niroddhavyo gantuṃ dehi mama gṛham || śrutvaitatsa gaṇeśastu prāha taṃ roṣataḥ khalu ||1.103.30|| mā vocaḥ śaṭha patnīti bhāryeti cāṃgajeti ca || mārayiṣyāmi ca tvāṃ vai no ced gacchasi dūrataḥ ||31|| sthūlo mahānaraṇyastho gaccha dūraṃ na te gamaḥ | śaṃbhuḥ prāha ca taṃ jñātvā mātṛbhaktaṃ samudyatam ||32|| aho bāla na te mātā na pitā te’sti kaścan | mātā piteti nāmnā vai svārthamātranibandhanā ||33|| kathaṃ prāṇān priyām̐styaktumīhase mātṛnāmataḥ || haniṣye tvāṃ triśūlena no cenmuñcasi mārgakam 34 ityuktvā taṃ haraścāpāsārayat svakareṇa vai | gaṇeśo’pi haraṃ cāpāsārayat svakareṇa hi ||35|| gopurānnirgatau bāhye deśe yuyudhatuśca tau || keśākeśi muṣṭāmuṣṭi daṇḍādaṇḍi nijaghnatuḥ ||36|| bahubalena pāśena bāhubhirjānubhistathā | kaphoṇikābhiranyonyaṃ tāḍayāmāsaturmuhuḥ ||37 tayostu tāḍanaṃ tatra tvākaṇṭhāgraṃ yadā hyabhūt || gaṇeśastu tadā śaṃbhumūrdhvamuttolya vegataḥ ||38|| bhuvi prakṣipya tadvakṣaḥ prapīḍyopari saṃsthitaḥ || yuvā kruddho gaṇeśastaṃ mūḍhamāramamārayat ||39|| śaṃbhuḥ prāha aho hā hā mṛto’smi muñca māṃ yadi | tadā te laḍḍukāndatvā pūjayiṣyāmi cāgrataḥ ||1.103.40|| gaṇeśastu tadā tyaktvā śaṃbhuṃ pārśve sthito’bhavat | śaṃbhurjaṭāṃ samāṃ kṛtvā dhulīrdehādamārjayat ||41|| svastho bhūtvā ca yāvadvai gopurāntarvivikṣati || triśūlaṃ tu gaṇastāvat samādāya ruṇaddhitam ||42|| śaṃbhuścāpi mahākruddhaḥ prāha bālamaninditam || kathaṃ prāṇān vihātuṃ tvaṃ mayā virodhamicchasi ||43|| gacchāntaḥ pṛccha jananīṃ śaṃkaraḥ ko bhavettava || yadi sā kathayenmāṃ svapatiṃ dehi praveśanam 44|| gaṇeśaḥ prāha dhūrtastvaṃ vadhyo bhavasi śastrataḥ | śaṃbhuḥ prāha varākastvaṃ vadhyo bhavasi śūlataḥ ||45|| gaṇaḥ prāha svamātrārthaṃ yadi prāṇāḥ paretakāḥ || tadāpi me śubhaṃ bhūyāt svargaṃ vindāmi sevayā ||46|| mātrarthaṃ janakārthaṃ ca patnyarthaṃ ca satāṃ kṛte || prāṇādyarpayitā yāti svargaṃ vā mokṣamityapi ||47|| yadi prāṇā mama yānti mātrarthaṃ saphalaṃ januḥ | hato yadyajñātapitrā tathāpi saphalaṃ januḥ 48|| evamuktvā namaḥ kṛtvā jagrāha ca triśūlakam | śaṃbhūrapi varaṃ putrahastānmṛtyumupasthitam ||49|| yāvadajñātacaryau svastāvat snehaḥ kuto mataḥ || mṛtyurbuddhimatāpohyo yāvadbuddhibalodayam ||1.103.50|| vicāryetthaṃ hariṃ smṛtvā jagrāha svatriśūlakam || parasparaṃ prajaghnaturdayāṃ kṛtvā tu pṛṣṭhataḥ ||51|| gaṇeśena tadā śaṃbhostriśūlaṃ parigṛhya ca | dvivṛttaṃ valayaṃ kṛtvā kṣepitaṃ bhūtale drutam ||52|| dṛṣṭvā bālabalaṃ śaṃbhuḥ kṣaṇamātraṃ sumohitaḥ | punaḥ paraśumādāya jaghāna gaṇakaṃdhare ||53|| gaṇastaṃ paraśuṃ svasya kuṭhāreṇa babhaṃja vai || dvedhā jātaṃ tu paraśuṃ tyaktvā śaktimupādade ||54|| gaṇeśo’pi tvaritaḥ san utplutya vyomavartmani | śaktiṃ vidhṛtya ca balācchaṃbhuṃ tayā jaghāna saḥ ||55|| mūrchito roṣamāpanno niṣasāda haro bhuvi || punarutthāya yāvadvai khaḍgaṃ gṛhṇāti śaṃkaraḥ ||56|| gajastāvat triśūlena khaḍgaṃ dvedhā babhaṃja ha || śaṃkaraścātikhinnaḥ san mahākālasurūpadhṛk ||57|| gaṇasyaiva triśūlaṃ tvāskandya prāmārayad gale || chinnaḥ kaṇṭho gaṇeśasya patitaṃ mastakaṃ bhuvi ||58|| kṛṣṇe tallīnatāṃ prāptaṃ kabandho vartate’tra tu | śaṃbhuḥ saroṣatāmrākṣaḥ snātvā svāṃ pārvatīṃ prati ||59|| tatra sthāne gato yāvad dṛśyate kālarūpadhṛk | pārvatī bhayamāpannā drāgeva pādayorgatā ||1.103.60|| kṣamāpaya mahādeva kiṃ krodho deharaktatā | kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavatā svāmin kathaṃ raktapluto bhavān ||61|| kva yuddhaṃ kena sākaṃ vā jātaṃ cāniṣṭamāgatam | śaṃbhustadā priyāśliṣṭaḥ śānto bhūtvābravīdidam ||62|| ko’yaṃ gopurasaṃroddhā tvayā rakṣita ujjaḍaḥ | kiṃ kiṃ deva kṛtaṃ kiṃ vā kiṃ jātaṃ vada me bhramaḥ ||63|| tava putro gaṇeśaḥ sa bahunā tapasārthitaḥ || mayā snānaprakālasyetarapraveśarodhakaḥ ||64 niṣāditaḥ kimaniṣṭaṃ jātaṃ prāṇada me vada | iti kṛtvā gale lagnāṃ śaṃbhuḥ prāha mṛto hyayam ||65|| mayā triśūlaghātena nāśitaḥ kādviyojitaḥ | pārvatī tu samāśrutya roditī kurarīva sā ||66|| aho putrajaneḥ saukhyaṃ nidhane duḥkhamityapi || patiṃ tyaktvā satvaraṃ so dudrāva gopuraṃ prati ||67|| patitaṃ tatkabandhaṃ tu svāṃke sthāpyaruroda ha || svātmābhimānajaṃ duḥkhaṃ sati jñāne nivartate ||68|| putraṃ śocāmi kiṃ vā me patiṃ śocāmi nāśakam | gṛhe hantā ca ghātyaśca kaṃ śocāmi gṛhiṇyaham ||69|| re putra tvaṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo ha janimṛtireva ha | na vai te maraṇaṃ yogyaṃ hyevaṃ cecca mriye’pyaham ||1.103.70|| yadi tvāṃ na jīvayate śaṃkaraste vināśakaḥ || anāhāravrataṃ kṛtvā yātrāpāraṃ karomyaham ||71|| ityuktvā hyaśanaṃ tyaktvā vilalāpa muhurmuhuḥ || saṃgṛhya gopurasthāne kabandhaṃ tatra saṃsthitā ||72|| aho ho lokamātā sā hyaśokāpi śucānvitā | loko’yaṃ dehasambaddho jñānināmapi śokakṛt ||73|| kṣaṇaṃ bhavati saṃmohādbhrāmakaḥ kā vicitratā | śrutvā vilāpaṃ pārvatyāḥ sakhyastatra samāgatāḥ ||74|| śaṃbhuśca kārtikeyaśca brahmaviṣṇusurādayaḥ | gaṇāśca prāyayuḥ sarve vilopaṃ cakrire tadā ||75|| caturdaśasu lokeṣu śoko’yaṃ prasṛto drutam || ājagmustatkṣaṇe tatra caturdaśabilasthitāḥ ||76|| śokārtāṃ pārvatīṃ devyo bodhayanti narāstathā | śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃ vicāraṃ saṃcakre tajjīvanāya ca ||77|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gaṇeśaśaṃkarayoryuddhe gaṇeśamastakacchedatajjanyaśokaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 103 ||
<1.104> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca etasminnantare tatra vāg babhūvāśarīriṇī | mā śokaṃ kuru deveśi sutaste kṛṣṇa īśvaraḥ || 1 || yattejo yoginaḥ śaśvad dhyāyanti satataṃ mudā | dhyāyanti vaiṣṇavā devā brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ || 2 || yasya pūjyasya sarvāgre kalpe kalpe ca pūjanam | yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sarvavighno vinaśyati || 3 || nāsīt sa bhikṣuko vipraḥ sa āsīdvai janārdanaḥ || kiṃ vā vilāpaṃ kuruṣe na nāśastava śāṃkareḥ || 4 || eṣāṃ sarasvatīṃ śrutvā dhairya cālambya yatnataḥ || tathāpi virahāt sābhūd vilapya kṣaṇamūrchitā || 5 || vismitāste surāḥ sarve putradehoparipragām || mṛtāmiva prapaśyanti citraputtalikāṃ yathā || 6 || devyaścaiva surāścaiva sarve’pi duḥkhamūrchitāḥ || tānsarvāṃstu tadavasthān dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ | 7 || sadvākyairbodhayāmāsa śītādbhirvyajanaistathā || sukhayitvākarot tatra prastāva śāṃkarikṛte || 8 || kiṃ kāryamasya bālasya mastakasya suyojane | prāṇa ātmā tu pārvatyāḥ śaktyā nihita eva vai || 9 || sa cātra punarāgacchetpārvatyāstu prabhāvataḥ || mastakaṃ tu gaṇeśasya kṛṣṇe vilīnatāṃ gatam ||1.104.10|| tasmād dvitīyamāptavyaṃ mastakaṃ tu śivādibhiḥ || gaṇeśo jīvito bhūyādasmābhiḥ pūjito bhavet ||11|| brahmā prāha tadā viṣṇuṃ bhavān sarvajña ucyate || karmaṇāṃ gativettā tvaṃ ṛṇānubandhabhānavān ||12|| kasya kena samaṃ karma bhogyaṃ vetti na cāparaḥ || vṛkṣaśākhā paricchinnā bhuvi nyastāpi rohati ||13|| tatra bījaṃ vinā jīvaḥ karmabalāt suyujyate | kecid bījācca kecidvai dehāt kīṭādayo’pare ||14|| pārthivakardamādanye stambāt kāṇḍācca māṃsataḥ || annādanye dehayogāddhātuyogāt tathāpare ||15|| jāyante jantavasteṣāṃ svasvakarmānusārataḥ || tasmāt tvameva vijñātā mastakaṃ kīdṛśaṃ bhavet ||16|| yasmānena śarīreṇa mastakasyaṛṇaṃ bhavet | tasyaiva mastakaṃ tvatra kabandhe yojyameva vai ||17|| brahmā prāha tadā sarvān yamo gacched vanāntare| prathamaṃ yo milet prāṇī tadā tasyaiva mastakam ||18|| gṛhītvā ca samāgatya gaṇaskandhe niyojayet || viṣṇuḥ prāha tadā tatra mama śṛṇvantu devatāḥ ||19|| uttarasyāṃ diśi puṣpabhadrāyāḥ saritastaṭe | asya ṛṇānubandhyeko hastī vartata ityamum ||1.104.20|| hastinaṃ prati gatvāhaṃ mastakaṃ tasya śobhanam || kabandhaitatpariṇāhamānagrīvasumaṇḍalam ||21|| chitvā sudarśanenaiva nayāmi tatra yāmi ca || ityāśvāsya ca tānsarvānāruhya garuḍaṃ hariḥ ||22|| jagāma puṣpabhadrāyāstaṭe yatra sa ībharāṭ | sughaṭṭavṛkṣavallyādisaṃvṛte tatra kānane ||23|| gajendraṃ divyavapuṣaṃ śvetaṃ svahastinīyutam | tathodakaśirasaṃ ramyaṃ sukhinaṃ surataśramāt ||24|| paritaḥ śāvakān kṛtvā paramānandamānasam || dadarśa bhagavām̐staṃ vai prāha cainaṃ gajādhipam ||25|| sukhito’si kuṭumbena dārāpatyajanādibhiḥ || athottaraṃ mahatsaukhyaṃ labhyaṃ dānādikarmabhiḥ ||26|| gajaḥ prāha bhavān ko’sti me’tithiḥ prasamāgataḥ || kadalīvanajātāni svarṇāni kadalāni vai ||27|| dāsye bhuṃkṣva paraṃ śreyaḥ kurvasmākaṃ vanaṃjuṣām || paśūnāṃ nedṛśo lābho kadāpi bhavati prabho ||28|| pūrvajātismarāt tvāṃ vai manye kṛṣṇaḥ samāgataḥ | matpūrvakarmaṇaḥ pāśād bandhanaṃ pāśavaṃ mayā ||29|| jñātaṃ ca jñāsyate yadvai bhāvi tadapi me kuru || bhagavānapi taddattaṃ jagrāha yāvadarhaṇam ||1.104.30|| tvarā me’sti mama prārthyaṃ dehi śreyo bhaviṣyati | gajaḥ prāha prabhuḥ sākṣānmadarthaṃ tu samāgataḥ ||31|| tasmātputraiḥ striyā cānyairmā śokastu vidhīyatām || nātha gṛhāṇa yanneyaṃ śīghraṃ kuru prasannatām ||32|| tava yogānmama muktiḥ kuṭumbasyāpi vai dhruvā || iti procya praṇamyātha samīpe samupasthitā ||33|| hariḥ sudarśanenaiva cicchede tacchiro mudā || garuḍe sthāpayāmāsa rudhirāktaṃ manoharam ||34|| vicchinnāṃgaṃ patiṃ dṛṣṭvā ruroda hastinī priyā | ruruduḥ śāvakāratasya vilapya ca śucāturāḥ ||35|| sā tuṣṭāva ramākāntaṃ śāntaṃ sasmitamāsthitam || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ pītāmbaraṃ harim ||36|| garuḍasthaṃ jagannāthaṃ bhrāmayantaṃ sudarśanam || saṃsārasukhadātāraṃ taddhartāraṃ namāmyaham ||37|| anāthinyai punarnāthapradātāraṃ namāmyaham | bhaktāyāḥ sukhakartāraṃ namāmi patijīvanam ||38|| prabhustatstavanāttuṣṭastasyai prāha praharṣitaḥ | tava kāryaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā jīvayitvā patiṃ tava ||39|| tato gamiṣye bhadraṃ te kṣaṇaṃ śokaṃ parityaja || ityuktvā ca mahāraṇyaṃ jagāma tatra yūthapaḥ ||1.104.40|| prāptaḥ kālavaśācchubhro mṛto’bhūtkaścidībharāṭ | akhaṇḍitaśarīrasya tasyaiva mṛtamastakam ||41|| pṛthakkṛtya yuyuje’trāgatya kabandhamaṇḍale| yadyapi bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ sarvasāmarthyavān vibhuḥ ||42|| gaṇeśasya mastakaṃ vai yoktuṃ tadeva cārhati || navaṃ vā mastakaṃ tatra cāṃkurayitumarhati ||43|| hastino’pi mastakaṃ tad dvitīyaṃ kartumarhati || tathāpi yatkṛtaṃ cātra svecchāyā ṛṇabandhanāt ||44|| evaṃ taṃ jīvayāmāsa hastinaṃ caraṇāṃbujam || sarvāṃge yojayāmāsa parivāraṃ pavitrayan ||45|| tvaṃ jīvākalpaparyantaṃ parivāraiḥ samaṃ gaja | ityuktvā ca garuḍena kailāsaṃ hyājagāma vai ||46|| kabandhaṃ tu gaṇeśasya nītvā svasyaiva vakṣasi | ruciraṃ tacchiraḥ samyag yojayāmāsa bālake ||47|| jīvayāmāsa taṃ śīghra huṃkāroccāraṇena ca || sarve prasannāḥ saṃjātāḥ kaṇṭhe tu sandhinīṃ dadhau ||48|| gaṇeśaḥ putrarūpo’sau praṇanāmāgatānmuhuḥ | sarvaiḥ sabhājito devairāśīrbhiścirajīvitā ||49|| pradattātha tato viṣṇuruvāca pārvatīṃ satīm || brahmādikīṭaparyantaṃ phalaṃ bhuṃkte svakarmaṇaḥ ||1.104.50|| śubhāśubhaṃ kṛtaṃ yadyat pratiyonau prapadyate | indraḥ svakarmaṇā kīṭayonau janma vrajet sati ||51|| kīṭaścāpi bhavedindraḥ pūrvakarmaphalena vai || siṃho’pi makṣikāṃ hantumakṣamaḥ prāktanaṃ vinā ||52|| maśako hastinaṃ hantuṃ kṣamaḥ prāktanakarmaṇā || sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokamānandaḥ karmaṇaḥ phalam ||53|| sukarmaṇaḥ sukhaṃ harṣamitare pāpakarmaṇaḥ || ihaiva karmaṇāṃ bhogaḥ paratra ca śubhāśubhaiḥ ||54|| golokanāthaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam || tava putraḥ samutpannaḥ śrutvā tuṣṭā ca pārvatī ||55|| stanaṃ dadau ca śiśave taṃ praṇamya gadādharam || tuṣṭāva prāṃjalirbhaktyā viṣṇuṃ taṃ kamalāpatim ||56|| āśiṣaṃ yuyuje viṣṇuḥ śiśuṃ ca śiśumātaram | dadau kaṇṭhe bālakasya kaustubhaṃ ca svabhūṣaṇam ||57|| brahmā dadau mukuṭaṃ ca dharmo vai ratnabhūṣaṇam | siddhāsanaṃ dadau dharmastasmai vedhāḥ kamaṇḍalum ||58|| śaṃkaro yogapaṭṭaṃ ca tattvajñānaṃ sudurlabham || ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ śakraḥ sūryaśca maṇikuṇḍale ||59|| māṇikyamālāṃ candraśca kuberaśca kirīṭakam || vahniśuddhaṃ ca vasanaṃ dadau tasmai hutāśanaḥ ||1.104.60|| ratnachatraṃ ca varuṇo vāyū ratnāṃgulīyakam || kṣīrododbhavasadratnaracitaṃ valayaṃ varam ||61|| mañjīraṃ cāpi keyūraṃ dadau lakṣmīrharipriyā || kaṇṭhabhūṣāṃ ca sāvitrī bhāratī hāramujjvalam ||62|| krameṇa sarve devāśca devyaśca yautakaṃ daduḥ | munayaḥ parvatāṃcaiva ratnāni vividhāni ca ||63|| vasundharā dadau tasmai vāhanāya ca mūṣakam | krameṇa devā devyaśca munayaḥ parvatādayaḥ ||64|| gandharvāḥ kinnarā yakṣā manavo mānavāstathā | nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi svādūni madhurāṇi ca ||65|| pūjāṃ cakruśca te sarve kramādvai bhaktipūrvakam | pārvatī jagatāṃ mātā smerānanasaroruhā ||66|| ratnasiṃhāsane putraṃ vāsayāmāsa jīvitam | kartuṃ pūjāṃ tatastasya viśeṣeṇopacakrame ||67|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vyomavāṇyā śrīkṛṣṇo’yaṃ gaṇeśa iti vijñāpite śrīhariṇā hastimastakasandhānaṃ kṛtaṃ brahmādibhirupadādānaṃ kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||104||
<1.105> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca sarvatīrthodakaiḥ ratnakalaśāvarjitaiḥ stutaiḥ | snāpayāmāsa vedoktamantreṇa munibhistadā || 1|| agniśuddhe ca vasane dadau tasmai satī mudā || godāvaryudakaiḥ pādyamarghyaṃ gaṃgodakena ca || 2 || dūrvābhirakṣataiḥ puṣpaiścandanena samanvitam | puṣkarodakamānīya dadāvācamanīyakam||3|| madhuparkaṃ ratnapātraiḥ supeyaṃ śarkarānvitam | snānīyaṃ viṣṇutailaṃ ca svarvaidyābhyāṃ vinirmitam || 4 || amūlyaratnaracitaṃ cārubhūṣākadambakam | pārijātaprasūnānāmanyeṣāṃ śatakāni ca ||5|| mālatīcampakādīnāṃ puṣpāṇi vividhāni ca | pūjārhāṇi ca patrāṇi tulasīsahitāni ca || 6 || candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumāni ca sādaram || ratnapradīpanikaraṃ dhūpaṃ ca parito dadau || 7 || naivedyaṃ tatpriyaṃ caiva tilalaḍḍukaparvatān | yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ laḍḍukānāṃ ca parvatān || 8 || pakvānnānāṃ parvatām̐śca susvādusumanoharān | parvatān svastikānāṃ ca susvāduśarkarānvitān || 9 || guḍāktānāṃ ca lājānāṃ pṛthukānāṃ ca parvatān | śālyannānāṃ piṣṭakānāṃ parvatān vyañjanaiḥ saha ||1.105.10|| payobhṛtkalaśānāṃ ca lakṣāṇi pradadau mudā || lakṣāṇi dadhipūrṇānāṃ kalaśānāṃ ca pūjane ||11|| madhubhṛtkalaśānāṃ ca trilakṣāṇi ca pārvatī || sarpiḥsuvarṇakuṃbhānāṃ paṃcalakṣāṇi sādaram ||12|| dāḍimānāṃ śrīphalānāmasaṃkhyāni phalāni ca | kharjurāṇāṃ kapitthānāṃ jambūnāṃ vividhāni ca ||13|| āmrāṇāṃ panasānāṃ ca kadalīnāṃ phalāni ca | anyāni paripakvāni kāladeśodbhavāni ca ||14|| dadau tāni mahādevī svādūni madhurāṇi ca || svacchaṃ sunirmalaṃ caiva karpūrādisuvāsitam ||15|| gaṃgājalaṃ ca pānārthaṃ punarācamanīyakam | tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam ||16|| suvarṇapātraśatakaṃ bhakṣyapūrṇaṃ ca sā dadau | śailarājapriyāmātyāḥ pupūjuḥ śailajātmajam ||17|| viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ pupūjainaṃ hyupahārairanuttamaiḥ || sarvāgre tava pūjā ca mayā dattā surottama ||18|| sarvapūjyaśca yogīndro bhava vatsetyuvāca tam || vanamālāṃ dadau tasmai brahmajñānaṃ ca muktidam ||19|| sarvasiddhiṃ pradāyaiva cakārātmasamaṃ hariḥ || dadau dravyāṇi cārūṇi copacārām̐śca ṣoḍaśa ||1.105.20|| nāmabhiḥ stavanaṃ cakre munibhiśca samaṃ suraiḥ || vighneśaśca gaṇeśaśca herambaśca gajānanaḥ ||21|| lambodaraścaikadantaḥ śūrpakarṇo vināyakaḥ | etānyaṣṭau ca nāmāni sarvasiddhipradāni ca ||22|| yadyatkāryaṃ bhavet kiṃcinmahadvā tatra sarvadā || pūjanaṃ tu gaṇeśasya kāryaṃ prathamameva vai ||23|| tato’nyeṣāṃ tu devānāṃ mamāpi pūjanaṃ bhavet || gaṇeśapūjanādīni vihāya kopi sādhakaḥ ||24|| yadyanyatkurute kāryaṃ na syāt siddhaṃ dhruvaṃ hi tat | ṛṣibhirmunibhiḥ pitṛdevamanvantarādibhiḥ ||25|| dikpālairlokapālaiśca yakṣagandharvakinnaraiḥ | bhuvarantarīkṣasadbhirmānavairatalādijaiḥ ||26|| caturdaśastarāvāsaiḥ sarvaireva sadā kṛtau || gaṇeśaḥ prathamaḥ pūjya iti brahmānuśāsanam ||27|| ityagrapūjyatā dattā sabhāyāṃ tatra vedhasā || śrīkṛṣṇena svayaṃ tatra prathamaṃ pūjitaśca saḥ ||28|| atha pūjottaraṃ tasyāśīrvādā devasatkṛtāḥ | viṣṇuḥ prāha śivatulyajñānī cirāyurīśvaraḥ ||29|| parākrame ca me tulyaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhava | brahmovāca yaśaḥkīrtikhyātibhistvatigo bhava ||1.105.30|| sarveṣāmagrataḥ pūjā jāyatāṃ te’tidurlabhā | dharmaḥ prāha mayā tulyo dharmiṣṭho bhava bhaktimān ||31|| śaṃbhuḥ prāha mayā tulyo dātā bhakto harerbhava | vidyābuddhisupuṇyāḍhyaḥ śānto dāntaḥ sadā bhava ||32|| lakṣmīḥ prāha mamāvāso gehe dehe bhavettava || pativratā mayā tulyā kāntā tava bhavatviti ||33|| vāṇī prāha mayā tulyā kavitā dhāraṇā smṛtiḥ | vivecanā sumedhā sacchaktirbhavatu te sadā ||34|| sāvitryuvāca vatsa tvaṃ vedajñānī japī bhava | śailaḥ prāha harau kṛṣṇe bhaktirbhavatu te sadā ||35|| śrīkṛṣṇatulyo guṇavān bhava kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ || menovācābdhitulyastvaṃ gāṃbhīrye’naṃgarūpavān ||36|| śrīyuktaḥ śrīsvāmitulyo dharme dharmasamo bhava | pṛthvī prāha mayā tulyaḥ kṣamayā sarvaratnavān ||37|| śaraṇyo vighnanighnaśca pāraṇyo bhava śobhanaḥ | umovāca mahāyoge tātatulyo’rthasiddhidaḥ ||38|| mṛtyuñjayaśca bhagavān bhavatvativiśāradaḥ | ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhāḥ sarve yuyujurāśiṣaḥ ||39|| brāhmaṇā bandinaścaiva yuyujuḥ sarvamaṃgalam | brāhmaṇebhyo dadau tatra koṭiratnāni pārvatī ||1.105.40|| aśvānāṃ ca gajānāṃ ca sahasrāṇi śatāni ca | bandibhyaḥ pradadau tatra dānāni vividhāni ca ||41|| brāhmaṇān bhojayāmāsa sādhūn sādhvīśca bālakān | vedām̐śca pāṭhayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṃgalam ||42|| oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ gaṇeśāya brahmarūpāya cārave | sarvasiddhipradeśāya vighneśāya namo namaḥ ||43|| itimantreṇa saṃpūjya datvā dravyāṇi bhaktitaḥ | sarve pramuditāstatra brahmaviṣṇuharādayaḥ ||44|| dvātriṃśadakṣaro mālāmantro’yaṃ sarvakāmadaḥ | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ phaladaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ ||45|| pañcalakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhirhi mantriṇaḥ || vighnāni ca palāyante tannāmasmaraṇena vai ||46|| yātrākāle paṭhitvā yo yāti tadbhaktipūrvakam || tasya sarvābhīṣṭasiddhirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||47|| rātrau dṛṣṭaṃ tu duḥsvapnaṃ susvapnamupajāyate | kadāpi na bhavetpāṭhādgrahapīḍāpi dāruṇā ||48|| śatrunāśo buddhivṛddhirlakṣmīvṛddhiḥ sadā bhavet | ādhayo vyādhayaścaiva śokāścaiva bhayāvahāḥ ||49|| nāśaṃ yānti na cāyānti gaṇeśasyārcanātstavāt | vināyakasya kavacaṃ sarvāpadvinivārakam ||1.105.50|| kathayāmi mahālakṣmi sarvalokeṣu śāntikṛt || uktaṃ kauthumaśākhāyāṃ sāmavede manoharam ||51|| kavacaṃ bibhratāṃ mṛtyurna bhiyā yāti sannidhim | nāyurvyayo nāśubhaṃ ca brahmāṇḍe na parājayaḥ ||52|| daśalakṣajapenaiva siddhaṃ tu kavacaṃ bhavet | saṃsāramohakasyāsya kavacasya prajāpatiḥ ||53|| ṛṣiśchando bṛhatī ca devo lambodaraḥ svayam || dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||54|| oṃ gaṃ huṃ śrīgaṇeśāya svāhā me pātu mastakam || dvātriṃśadakṣaro mantro lalāṭaṃ me sadāvatu ||55|| oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ gamiti vai satataṃ pātu locane | tālukaṃ pātu vighneśaḥ satataṃ ca dharātale ||56|| oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīmiti paraṃ santataṃ pātu nāsike | oṃ gauṃ gaṃ śūrpakarṇāya svāhā pātvadharau mama ||57|| dantām̐śca tāluke jihvāṃ pātu me ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ || oṃ laṃ śrīṃ lambodarāyeti svāhā gaṇḍau sadāvatu ||58|| oṃ klīṃ hrīṃ vighnanāśāya svāhā karṇau sadāvatu || oṃ śrīṃ gaṃ gajānanāyeti svāhā skandhaṃ sadāvatu ||59|| oṃ hrīṃ vināyakāyeti svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ sadāvatu || oṃ klīṃ hrīmiti kāṅkalaṃ pātu vakṣaḥsthalaṃ param ||1.105.60|| karau pādau sadā pātu sarvāṃgaṃ vighnanāśakṛt || prācyāṃ lambodaraḥ pātu cāgneyyāṃ vighnāyakaḥ ||61|| dakṣiṇe pātu vighneśo nairṛtyāṃ tu gajānanaḥ || paścime pārvatīputro vāyavyāṃ śaṃkarātmajaḥ ||62|| kṛṣṇasyāṃśaścottare ca paripūrṇatamasya ca || aiśānyāmekadantaśca herambaḥ pātu cordhvataḥ ||63|| adho gaṇādhipaḥ pātu sarvapūjyaśca sarvataḥ || svapne jāgaraṇe caiva pātu māṃ yogināṃ guruḥ ||64|| ityetatkavacaṃ kṛṣṇo goloke’dātsvayaṃ tu me || mayā nārāyaṇenātra yamādisurasannidhau ||65|| śanaiścarāyārpitaṃ tat sarvasaṃkaṭatārakam || tadevedaṃ mahālakṣmi sarvebhyaḥ śrāvitaṃ mayā ||66|| gurumabhyarcya vidhivat kavacaṃ dhārayettu yaḥ || kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau so’pi viṣṇusamo bhavet ||67|| sarvatra vijayī pūjyo bhavedgrahaṇamātrataḥ || bhūtapretapiśācāśca kūṣmāṇḍā brahmarākṣasāḥ ||68|| ḍākinīyoginīyakṣavetālā bhairavādayaḥ || bālagrahā grahāścaiva kṣetrapālādayastathā ||69|| varmaṇaḥ śabdamātreṇa palāyante tu bhīravaḥ || ṛjave gurubhaktāya svaśiṣyāya prakāśayet ||1.105.70|| atha gaṇeśadevasyāṣṭakaṃ vakṣye sukhapradam || yatpāṭhakaṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo gaṇeśo’vati sarvadā ||71|| oṃ namo’ntaḥsusattvāya śivasattvāya te namaḥ || oṃ namaḥ kṛṣṇarūpāya śailajāṃgāya te namaḥ ||72|| oṃ namo vṛddhaviprāya sattvasaṃsthāya te namaḥ | oṃ namaḥ piṇḍarūpāya nyastacittāya te namaḥ ||73|| oṃ namaḥ siddhyadhiṣṭhāya sarvavidyāya te namaḥ | oṃ namo gopuratrātre mātrājñāpāya te namaḥ ||74|| oṃ namo’stvalakṣyapitre pitṛśastyāya te namaḥ | oṃ namaḥ skandharūpāya karyānanāya te namaḥ ||75|| oṃ namaḥ śivaputrāya sarvapūjyāya te namaḥ | oṃ namaścāgrajārcāya laḍḍukādyāya te namaḥ ||76|| oṃ namo vighnanāśāya mūṣakāsanine namaḥ| oṃ namo hetilābhāya cirajīvāya te namaḥ ||77|| oṃ namo divyavarṣmaṇe bhavyavarmaṇe te namaḥ | oṃ namaḥ kavacāpyāya vaco’vyayāya te namaḥ ||78|| oṃ namo maṃgalāḍhyāya bhaktidārḍhyāya te namaḥ| oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya śrīkṛṣṇāya namo namaḥ ||79|| iti stutvā naro bhaktyāmaro bhavati mokṣagaḥ | gaṇeśavṛttamityuktaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ||1.105.80|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gaṇeśasya viśeṣāgrapūjāśīrvādamantrakavacastotrādipradarśananāmā paṃcādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||105||
<1.106> śrīlakṣmīruvāca gaṇeśasya śironāśaḥ kathaṃ vai kena karmaṇā | gajamastakasandhānaṃ kathaṃ vai kena karmaṇā 1 || 1|| paripūrṇatamaḥ śrīmānparamātmā parātparaḥ || golokanāthaḥ svāṃśena pārvatīputratāmagāt || 2 || āścaryaṃ śrīharestasya mastakacchedanādikam | vighneśasya kathaṃ vighnaṃ saṃbhavetparamātmanaḥ || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca sāvadhānā śṛṇu lakṣmi samaitihyaṃ purātanam | ekadā śaṃkaraḥ sūryaṃ jaghāna paramaṣṭadhā || 4 || sumālimālihantāraṃ śūlena ca tadā raviḥ || jahau svacetanāṃ sadyo rathācca nipapāta ha ||5|| dadarśa kaśyapaḥ putraṃ mṛtavattūrdhvalocanam | kṛtvā vakṣasi taṃ śokādvilalāpa bhaśaṃ muhuḥ || 6 || andhībhūtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ babhūva bhayakātaram | niṣprabhaṃ tanayaṃ dṛṣṭvā cāśapat kaśyapaḥ śivam || 7 || matputrasya yathā tejaśchinnaṃ śūlena vakṣasi | tvatputrasya śiraśchinnaṃ bhaviṣyati sataijasam || 8 || śivaśca galitakrodho jīvayāmāsa taṃ ravim | vakṣaḥ sandhānayāmāsa pūrayāmāsa tejasā || 9 || sūryastu cetanāṃ prāpya samuttasthau pituḥ puraḥ | sūryo yayau nijāvāse brahmaṇā kṛtamaṃgalaḥ ||1 0|| mālī sumālī daityau tu vyādhigrasto babhūvatuḥ | śvitrau galitasarvāṃgau śaktiśūnyau hataprabhau ||1 1|| sūryakopena malinau brahmovāca tadā tu tau | oṃ hrīṃ namo bhagavate sūryāya paramātmane svāhā || 12|| ityanena tu mantreṇa sāvadhānaṃ divākaram | bhaktyā saṃpūjya saṃdattvā tūpacārām̐śca ṣoḍaśa || 13||| evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvad dhruvaṃ muktau bhaviṣyathaḥ | atha sūryasya kavacaṃ bibhrato vyādhayo nahi || 14|| prajāpatiḥ ṛṣiśchando gāyatrī devatā raviḥ | vyādhipraṇāśe saundarye viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 15|| oṃ klīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śrīsūryāya svāhā me pātu mastakam | aṣṭādaśākṣaro mantraḥ kapālaṃ me sadāvatu || 16|| vakṣaḥ pātu raviḥ śaśvannābhiṃ sūryaḥ sadāvatu | kaṃkālaṃ me sadā pātu sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ || 17|| karau pātu sadā bradhnaḥ pātu pādau prabhākaraḥ | vibhākaro me sarvāṃgaṃ pātu santatamīśvaraḥ || 18|| ityetatkavacaṃ dhṛtvā nīrujau tu bhaviṣyathaḥ | stavanaṃ sāmavedoktaṃ sauryaṃ vyādhivināśakam || 19|| sarvapāpaharaṃ sāraṃ dhanārogyakaraṃ param | tatastau rākṣasau gatvā puṣkaraṃ tīrthamuttamam |||20 || dhṛtvā varma raviṃ stotramantreṇārādhya bhāvataḥ | tataḥ sūryād varaṃ prāpya nijarūpau babhūvatuḥ ||21|| gaṇeśamastakacchedavighnaṃ śāpoṃ’śumālinaḥ | jātastu śaṃkarāyeti kāraṇaṃ kathitaṃ tava ||22| atha hastikathāṃ vacmi śiraḥsambandhabodhinīm | sthiteṣvanyeṣu bahuṣu jantuṣvapi gajasya yat ||23|| mastakaṃ yojitaṃ tasya kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu padmaje | ekadā devarājo vai puṣpabhadrānadīṃ yayau ||24|| tattīre’tirahaḥsthāne puṣpodyāne sugandhini | dadarśa kāmukīṃ raṃbhāṃ candralokātsamāgatām ||25|| hāvabhāvānaṃgaceṣṭāsvedakaṭākṣacaṃcalām || āhvayantīmiva rantuṃ provācendro gaje sthitaḥ ||26|| raṃbhoru vāmanāśliṣya na gantumiṣyate mayā || raṃbhovāca na cāhaṃ te santoṣajananī matā ||27|| kṛtakāryajanānāṃ tu dhūrtānāṃ kā nu mitratā || nārī svāduttamaṃ yāti madhu tyaktveva makṣikā ||28|| kāmukī kākavallolā phalaṃ bhuktvā prayāti vai || yuvānaṃ rasikaṃ śāntaṃ suveṣaṃ sundaraṃ priyam ||29|| guṇinaṃ dhaninaṃ svacchaṃ kāntamicchati kāminī | duḥśīlaṃ rogiṇaṃ vṛddhaṃ ratiśaktivihīnakam ||1.106.30|| adātāramavijñaṃ ca naiva vāñcchanti yoṣitaḥ || tavājñākāriṇīṃ dāsīṃ gṛhāṇātra yathāsukham ||31|| ityuktvāgatya devendraṃ kaṇṭhe lagnā babhūva sā || puṣpabhadrātaṭe tatra tayoḥ ratisamāgame ||32|| etasminnantare tena vartmanā śaṃkarālayam | vaikuṇṭhād yāti durvāsā dṛṣṭaścendreṇa mānitaḥ ||33|| pārijātaprasūnaṃ tu durvāsā haraye dadau | puṣpaṃ yasya gṛhe caitallakṣmīstaṃ na jahāti vai ||34|| tasmādrakṣa sadaivaitadamlānaṃ smṛddhivardhanam | sarvavighnaharaṃ nārāyaṇaprasādalabdhikam ||35|| mālayā sahitaṃ mūrdhni yasya tasya jayaḥ sadā | puraḥ pūjā ca sarveṣāṃ devānāmagraṇīrbhavet ||36|| tacchāyeva mahālakṣmīrna jahāti kadāpi tam | jñānena tejasā buddhyā vikrameṇa balena ca ||37|| sarvadevādhikaḥ śrīmān viṣṇutulyaparākramaḥ || bhaktyā mūrdhni na gṛhṇāti yo’haṃkāreṇa mānavaḥ ||38|| naivedyaṃ ca hareratra sa naṣṭaśrīḥ svajātibhiḥ | durvāsāstu tataḥ sthānādagacchacchāṃkaraṃ girim ||39|| indro raṃbhāntike vegī tat tāṃ cikṣepa hastini || kuṃbhayoḥ patitāṃ puṣpamālāṃ hastī nije pade ||1.106.40|| śuṇḍhenāptvā mamardāpi taddṛṣṭvā śrīrvinirgatā | tathā raṃbhā divaṃ yātā gajo’raṇyaṃ viveśa ca ||41|| pāvanaṃ mastakaṃ tasya mālāpuṣpaprasaṃgataḥ | chitvā nītvā haristadvai yojayāmāsa bālake ||42|| evaṃ śvetagajasyāsya gaṇeśasthaṃ śiraḥ sadā || lakṣmi prapūjyatāṃ yātaṃ tvairāvatasya kaṃ hi tat ||43|| atha kaśyapaśāpena preritastu śaniścaraḥ || saṃjñāsūryātmajo vakradṛṣṭimān duḥkhadāyakaḥ ||44|| tatra vyomapathāyāto dadarśa gaṇanāyakam || gopure sa yadā devyā rakṣārthaṃ sthāpitastadā ||45|| śaṃkareṇa saha tasya gaṇeśasyābhavadraṇaḥ || savyalocanakoṇena sandadarśa śiśormukham ||46|| śanestu dṛṣṭimātreṇa cicchide mastakaṃ haraḥ | ityevaṃ kāraṇaṃ tatra śanerdṛṣṭiḥ raveḥ śapiḥ ||47|| gajakuṃbhaḥ pārijātamālā lakṣmīranantakā | trayaṃ tvekasya bhāgye na devānāmapi durlabham ||48|| sarve svakarmaṇā sādhvi bhuṃjate vividhaṃ phalam || koṭikalpairapyaluptaṃ karma kartāramīyate ||49|| karmaṇā brahmarudrādyā mānavāḥ paśupakṣiṇaḥ || rājā bhṛtyāśca vaikuṇṭhavāsino’pi svakarmabhiḥ ||1.106.50|| vyādhiviṣayasaundaryadhanadāridryaśālinaḥ| sudārāputrasukhavān bandhukuṭumbakaṇṭakaḥ ||51|| adārāputraduḥkhāḍhyā jāyante karmabhirjanāḥ| vibhinnakarmaṇāṃ teṣāṃ mūrtiḥ śaniścaraḥ svayam ||52|| tattatkarmānusāreṇa vakradṛṣṭyā sa paśyati | śaniścaro’pi duḥkhena jīvatītyapi karmaṇā ||53|| śaniścarāya kanyāṃ svāṃ dadau citrarathastataḥ || ṛtusnātā suveṣaṃ svaṃ vidhāya manmathārditā ||54|| śaniṃ smarati dānārthaṃ śanirnaiva smaratyapi | ṛtunāśād ratyalābhāt kopataḥ sā śaśāpa tam ||55|| na dṛṣṭāhaṃ tvayā yena na kṛtaṃ ṛturakṣaṇam || tasmāt sadaiva te dṛṣṭiḥ sukhadā naiva jāyatām ||56|| tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ bhavedvastu tatsarvaṃ vai vinaśyatu || itiśāpācchanirvakradṛṣṭyā paśyati yad yadā ||57|| tadvai naśyati sarvaṃ drāk tattatkarmānuyogataḥ | śaniḥ prakṛtinamrāsyo vinā karma na paśyati ||58|| karmaṇā prerito vai saḥ kartāramabhipaśyati | iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi ||59|| gajāsyayojanāyāśca kāraṇaṃ gahanaṃ mahat | yajjñātvā sukhaduḥkhādau śubhāśubhe na muhyati ||1.106.60|| aṃśenātmāntarasthasya kṛṣṇasyātmāntarakṛtāt || karmaṇo naiva lepyatvaṃ bhuṃkte tvātmāntaraḥ kṛtam ||61|| avatārāḥ sadā sarve nirlepāḥ santi padmaje || yatrātmanyavatīrṇāste sa ātmā karmabhogabhāk ||62|| sakhāyau sayujau dvau ca suparṇau karmadrusthitau || tayoḥ karmakṛdaśnātyakarmakṛto na tatspṛśiḥ ||63|| tasmāt kṛṣṇasya naivāsti kaṇṭhacchedakṛtivyathā | sā tu tatrānyabhoktuḥ syādātmāntaraṃ hi tanmatam ||64|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gaṇeśopari śanidṛṣṭiḥ śivasya sūryaśāpaḥ indrasya śvetakarikṛtaṃ durvāsaḥpradattaprasādipuṣpamālāmardanaṃ tanmālāpuṣpasparśajanyakuṃbhamastakapāvanatāprayojya gaṇeśamastakayojanāpūjyatā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||106||
<1.107> śrīlakṣmīruvāca gaṇeśasya śrutā nātha kathā citraparākramā | bhādre kṛṣṇe caturthyāṃ tu candrodayādyayāmake || 1 || gaṇeśastu samutpannastadā tasya vrataṃ matam || sāṃgadevo niraṃgo vā pūjyaḥ kiṃ tattu me vada || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca patnīputravāhanaiśca sahito’rcyo gaṇeśvaraḥ | mātṛpitṛsamaścāpi sadā pūjyo gaṇeśvaraḥ || 3 || skando gaṇapatiścaitau mātāpitroḥ sukhau sutau || tayorvivāhakāryārthaṃ śivāśaṃbhū samūcatuḥ || 4 || vivāhaśca kathaṃ kāryaḥ putrayorubhayoḥ śubhaḥ || ṣaṇmukhaḥ senayāptaśca gaṇeśo me priyojjhitaḥ ||5|| gaṇeśasya vivāhārthaṃ yatnaḥ kāryaḥ śubho mataḥ | kārtikeyasya vāñcchāsti vivāhāya punastathā || 6 || hārdaṃ kanyāpradānāya viśvarūpaprajāpateḥ || dvābhyāṃ kanyādvayaṃ deyaṃ vartate’tastathā bhavet || 7 || kintu deyaṃ gaṇeśāya kanyāratnadvayaṃ varam | kadācittau samāhūya kathayāmāsatustadā || 8 || śṛṇutaṃ susutau prītyā kathayāvo yathārthakam || ekaḥ sadāro jyeṣṭho’si gaṇeśo dāravarjitaḥ || 9 || yuvayorvai vivāhasya sukhado niyamaḥ kṛtaḥ | samau dvāvapi satputrau viśeṣo nātra labhyate ||1.107.10|| tasmātpaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ śaṃdaḥ putrayorubhayorapi | yaścaiva pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ krāntvā pūrvamupāvrajet ||11|| tasyaiva prathamaṃ kāryo vivāhaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ || śrutvaitadvacanaṃ pitroḥ kārtikeyo mahābalaḥ ||12|| jagāma mandirāttūrṇaṃ śikhivāhanasaṃsthitaḥ || pṛthivyāstu bahuvegāt parikramaṇahetave ||13|| gaṇanāthastu tatraiva saṃsthitaḥ suvicārya vai || vāhanaṃ mama tu pṛthvyāṃ gatimannaiva dhāvati ||14|| vyomamārgeṇa gantā kva kvāhaṃ pṛthivīmārgagaḥ || kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ svayaṃ sthūlaśarīrakaḥ ||15|| krośamātraṃ gate cāgre śramādgantuṃ na śakyate | kiṃ punaḥ pṛthivīṃ krāntvā vijayāśā viḍambyate ||16|| ityevaṃ suvicāryaiva gṛhaṃ snātvā praviśya ca || praṇamya pitarau devo gaṇeśaḥ samuvāca tau ||17|| mātā pṛthvī pitā svargaṃ gaustu brahmāṇḍamucyate | mātā me pārvatī devī pitā me śaṃkaraḥ prabhuḥ ||18|| gaustayorvāhanaṃ cāsti vṛṣabho’yaṃ sudharmarāṭ | gaustu pṛthvīsvarūpā me mātāpīlāsvarūpiṇī ||19|| pitā me śaṃkarastasya śarīraṃ vasudhā matā || pūjā trayāṇāṃ kartavyā mayā yātrāsusiddhaye ||1.107.20|| āsane sthāpite cātra pūjārthaṃ bhavatostathā || atiṣṭhataṃ gurū cātra pūrayataṃ manogatam ||21|| itiśrutvā vacastasya tatpūjāgrahaṇāya tau || asthātāmāsane tau ca pupūja gaṇanāyakaḥ ||22|| pradakṣiṇaṃ tayoḥ saptavāraṃ putreṇa satkṛtam || praṇāmāścāpi vihitāḥ sapta evārpitaṃ tataḥ ||23|| gaṇeśaḥ prāha mātarme śīghraṃ vivāhanaṃ kuru || mātā prāha drutaṃ putra pṛthvīpradakṣiṇāṃ kuru ||24|| kumārātpūrvamāyāhi vivāhaḥ prathamo bhavet || gaṇeśaḥ prāha re mātaḥ śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama ||25|| mayā tu pṛthivī krāntā saptavāraṃ punaḥ punaḥ || mātā prāha kadā putra tvayā krāntā vasundharā ||26|| gaṇeśaḥ prāha bhavatoḥ kṛtaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ mayā | tena vai sā samudrāntā mayā pradakṣiṇīkṛtā ||27|| mātā dharā pitā dyauśca dvayordharmasvarūpatā| vṛṣabho vāhanaṃ dharmastasya vāmādharka tu gauḥ ||28|| ityuktvā vṛṣabhaṃ tātaṃ mātaraṃ ca pradakṣiṇām | cakre tena tadā jātaṃ pṛthvīpradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ ||29|| pitarāvūcatuḥ hṛṣṭau bāḍhaṃ putra tvayā kṛtam | prāptaṃ tena samagrāyāḥ pṛthvyāḥ pradakṣiṇāphalam ||1.107.30|| śraddhayāvāpyate dharmaḥ śraddhayāvāpyate hariḥ | śraddhayāvāpyate siddhiḥ śraddhayāvāpyate phalam ||31|| mātā pitā gṛhe tīrthaṃ gaṃgā tu gṛhiṇī sadā | yadi śraddhā na tatrāsti vyarthaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet ||32|| pitrostu pūjanaṃ kṛtvā prakrāntiṃ ca karoti yaḥ || tasya vai pṛthivīkrāntijanyaṃ sampadyate phalam ||33|| apahāya gṛhe yo vai pitarau tīrthamāvrajet | na tīrthaphalabhāgī syādasevādoṣabhāg bhavet ||34|| putrasyātra mahattīrthaṃ pitroścaraṇapaṃkajam | idaṃ sannihitaṃ tīrthaṃ sulabhaṃ dharmasādhanam ||35|| patnyāstīrthaṃ patiḥ proktaḥ putrasya pitarau tathā || patyuḥ pativratā patnī tīrthāni tārakāṇi vai ||36|| yadi satyaṃ śāstradṛṣṭaṃ sadā pṛthvīpradakṣiṇam | jātaṃ prāha gaṇeśo me na cecchāstramasatyakam ||37|| pitṛbhaktirasatyā syāt sarvā sā niṣphalā bhavet | mātṛbhaktirgavāṃ bhaktiḥ sarvathā niṣphalā bhavet ||38|| tasmāt pradakṣiṇaṃ pṛthvyāḥ sarvathātra mayā kṛtam | śīghraṃ ca bhavitavyo me vivāhaḥ kriyatāṃ śubhaḥ ||39|| iti śrutvā vacastasya prasannau pitarau ca tam || prāhatuḥ putra śāstrajña buddhiste śāstragāminī ||1.107.40||
