kairapi śāstramaryādānyathākartuṃ na śakyate | upasthite tvagamye vai kārye śraddhā tu śāstrajā ||41|| yujyate ca tathā duḥkhe yasya buddhirviśiṣyate || tasya duḥkhaṃ vinaśyettu buddhiprajñāprabhāvataḥ ||42|| buddhiryasya balaṃ tasya nirbuddhestu kuto balam | kūpe siṃho madonmatto gomāyunā nipātitaḥ ||43|| samyak kṛtaṃ tvayā putra pṛthvīpradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtam | gomātṛpitṛkramaṇāt kṛtaṃ dharmasya pālanam ||44|| kārtikastu na cāyāti parādhāvati vegataḥ | mārge tvagre mūṣakasthaṃ yāntaṃ paśyati cānujam ||45|| yato gaṇeśaḥ pitrostu yadākarotpradakṣiṇām | tasya puṇyasya lābhena gaṇeśasyānyarūpakam ||46|| bhūtvā dhāvati cāgre vai kārtikeyasya vegataḥ || kārtikeyastu taddṛṣṭvā śuśoca paramaṃ tadā ||47|| aho’yamunduruḥ svalpastatra sthūlo gaṇeśakaḥ | kīdṛśena ca vegena tvagre prāgre pradhāvati ||48|| mayā mayūrabarhāṇi kaśayā vāyunā tathā || pātitāni hi sarvāṇi vegārthaṃ tāḍito muhuḥ ||49|| mayūro’pi tathā yāvadbalenoḍḍīyate’dhunā || tathāpi na gaṇeśaṃ vai saṃprāpnomi krameta kaḥ ||1.107.50|| ullaṃghanaṃ prāggamanaṃ svapne’pi naiva dṛśyate | tasmānnāyaṃ vivāho’nyo mayā kāryaḥ śape tviti ||51|| iti kṛtvā parāvṛtyāgacchad yatra gṛhaṃ svakam | śānto bhūtvā praviśya senayā śramamapānudat ||52|| gaṇeśasya vivāhārthaṃ pitarāvudyatau tadā || kārtikeyasya mārgaṃ ca pratīkṣantau pratiṣṭhataḥ ||53|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gaṇeśakārtikeyavivāhe gaṇeśena pṛthivīpradakṣiṇāphalārthaṃ mātāpitṛgopradakṣiṇā kṛtetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 107 ||
<1.108> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi jaganmātā pārvatī bahuharṣitā | snuṣādvayaṃ bhaviṣyanme cakre tat bahumaṃgalam || 1|| etasminnantare tatra viśvarūpaḥ prajāpatiḥ || dve putryau svasya dānārhe nītvaiva vidhinoditaḥ || 2 || ekā varāya dātavyo gaṇeśāya guṇābdhaye | anyā skandāya dātavyā yadvā kanyāmataṃ matam || 3 || dṛṣṭvā skandaṃ vadhūyuktaṃ vavrāte na dvayaṃ tu tam | gaṇeśaṃ kanyake dṛṣṭvā vavrāte rūpasadguṇam || 4 || siddhirbuddhirubhe patnyau gaṇeśasya babhūvatuḥ || mahotsavo vivāhasya tadā jāto’tiharṣakṛt || 5 || devagāndharvavidyādhrakinnarāguhyakādayaḥ | santuṣṭāśca trilokasthāstadvivāhe samāgaman || 6 || sahadharmaṃ caretāmityādipurohitasya vāk | saphalā tatra saṃjātā gaṇeśasya vivāhane || 7 || gaṇeśastu sadā saukhyaṃ tābhyāṃ vai prāptavān param | loke sāpatnaśatrutvaṃ duḥkhadaṃ khalu jāyate || 8 || yasya bhāgyaṃ bhaved bhagnaṃ loke’sya strīdvayaṃ bhavet | dvibhāryastu naraścārdhaṃ mṛto’styeva viniścayaḥ || 9 || na vai taṃ śatravo ghnanti dvibhāryastu mṛto yataḥ | ekā svapiti yāvadvai dvitīyā dveṣṭi vai krudhā ||1.108.10|| anyā sevāṃ karotyatra prathamā cerṣyati krudhā || kṣaṇe kṣaṇe dvibhāryasya krodhāgāraṃ gṛhaṃ matam ||11|| ekayā putrasampattyā dvitīyāṃ tu ghṛṇāyate | dvitīyā dhanasampattyā prathamā vai tṛṇāyate || 12|| ekayā rūpasampattyā dvitīyā notsavāyate | dvitīyā snehasampattyā prathamāṃ kutsitāyate || 13|| śayane bhojane yāne vilāse vastradhāraṇe | hāve bhāve tathā māne cotsave narakaṃ dvayam || 14|| tatrāpi kākajātīye śvajātīye yayā striyau | tadā sākṣāttu vai kuṃbhīpākākhyaṃ narakaṃ hi te || 15|| yadi bhārye kuṭumbinyau suniṣekabhave tadā | kleśo naiva bhavet tatra svargavācyaṃ gṛhaṃ matam || 16|| parasparaṃ sahāyinyau sukhaduḥkhasamakriye | parasparapradāyinyau naikāṃ vihāya tiṣṭhataḥ || 17|| nānyonyāntarabhedinyau dyekakriyaikamānase | parasparopakāriṇyau samaśīlavratārthike || 18|| apatyeṣvekabhāvinyau tathopakaraṇaikate | svargasukhaṃ patistatra bhuṃkte tābhyāṃ pramoditaḥ || 19|| siddhirbuddhiśca tādṛśyau patnyau śaṃde babhūvatuḥ | kiyatā caiva kālena gaṇeśasya mahātmanaḥ ||1.108.20|| siddhergaṇeśapatnyāstu kṣemanāmābhavatsutaḥ | buddherlābhābhidhaḥ putraḥ samajāyata śobhanaḥ ||21|| atha śrīnāradaścāyāt skandasya gṛhamadbhutam | prāha vacmi matsarānna nāsatyaṃ na chalena ca ||22|| pitṛbhyāṃ te kṛtaṃ yādṛk tādṛk nānyaḥ kariṣyati | niṣkāsya tvāṃ prādakṣiṇye miṣamutpādya tadvidham ||23|| gaṇeśasya varo’kāri vivāhaḥ strīdvayena yat | palayordvayorgaṇeśo’sau lebhe putradvayaṃ śubham ||24|| mātāpitrormatenaiva sukhaṃ bhuṃkte nirantaram | bhavatā pṛthivī krāntā tayorvai chalakarmaṇā ||25|| yadi mātā ca vā tātaśchaladharmeṇa putrakam | vañcayatyanyalokasya kā vārtā chaladharmaṇi ||26|| asamyagvai kṛtaṃ tābhyāṃ tvatpitṛbhyāṃ hi karma tat | vicāryatāṃ tvayāpīha maccitte na śubhaṃ matam ||27|| dadyād yadi garaṃ mātā vikrīṇīyād pitā yadi | rājā harati sarvasvaṃ ko’nyo rakṣākaro bhavet |||28|| yenaivedaṃ kṛtaṃ karma svaputre pakṣapātajam | kaḥ śāntimān sudhīḥ putrastādṛktātagṛhe vaset ||29|| iti nītirmayā proktā yathecchasi tathā kuru | ityuktvā nāradastasmād yayau satyapuraṃ tataḥ ||1.108.30 || skandaḥ śokaṃ samudvegaṃ samāpanno gṛhāttataḥ | vinirgatya ca pitarau praṇamya krodhapūritaḥ ||3 1|| jagāma parvataṃ kraucaṃ pitṛbhyāṃ vārito’pi san | yadyevaṃ kapaṭaṃ prītinapahāya kṛtaṃ mayi ||32|| gaṇeśasya sulagnasya kāryaṃ sāralyataḥ kṛtam | ahantu ghorapanthārthaṃ gṛhānniṣkāsitastataḥ ||33|| mayā nātra gṛhe yāvajjīvaṃ sthātavyameva hi | mayūraṃ svaṃ samāruhya senāṃ tyaktvā piturgṛhe ||34|| yayau krauṃce mahāśaile nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ | paramo vaiṣṇavo bhūtvā bhajatyaniśamacyutam ||35|| svāmitvaṃ sa samāpannaḥ sādhutāmagrahīttataḥ | brahmavrate sadā tiṣṭhan vartate sādhuśīlavāt ||36|| kārtikasvāmināmāsau pūjyate krauṃcaparvate | kārtikyāṃ tu sadā devā ṛṣayaśca satīrthakāḥ ||37|| darśanārthaṃ kumārasya gacchanti ca munīśvarāḥ | athomā duḥkhamāpannā skandasya virahe sati ||38|| uvāca śaṃkaraṃ dīnā tatra gaccha mayā saha | tatsukhārthaṃ svayaṃ śaṃbhurgataḥ svāṃśena parvate ||39|| mallikārjunanāmā sa śaṃbhuḥ satyā sahāvasat | kārtikastadravrataṃ jñātvā virajyānyatra gacchati ||1.108.40|| tāvad devādibhistatra prārthito hyavasat khalu | yojanatrayamutsṛjya sthitaḥ skandaḥ suśīladhṛk ||41|| putrasnehāturau tau vai śivau parvaṇi parvaṇi | darśanārthaṃ kumārasya snehilau cāpi gacchataḥ ||42|| amāvāsyādine tatra svayaṃ śaṃbhuḥ prayāti hi | pūrṇimāyāṃ svayaṃ yāti pārvatī senayā yutā ||43|| ityevaṃ śrīgaṇeśasya siddhirbuddhiśca vai priye | kṣemo lābhaśca putrau dvau saha taiḥ pūjanaṃ kriyāt ||44|| etadākhyānamanaghaṃ yaśasyaṃ sukhavardhanam | āyuṣyaṃ svargyamatulaṃ śivabhaktivivardhanam ||45|| kathitaṃ te mahālakṣmi mātṛsevāvivardhanam | apavargapradaṃ proktaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi ||46|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne viśvarūpaprajāpatinā siddhibuddhināmakakanyādvayaṃ śrīgaṇeśāya vivāhavidhinārpitaṃ tataḥ kṣemo lābhaśceti putrotpattiḥ kārtikeyasya krauṃcādriṃ prati sadā gamanamityādikathananāmāṣṭādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 108||
<1.109> śrīlakṣmīruvāca bhagavan devadeveśa śrāvitaṃ paramādbhutam | kathānakaṃ gaṇeśasya kārtikeyasya vai tathā || 1 || atra me bhagavan kācijjijñāsā bhavatīti te | pṛcchāmi devadeveśa śrutvā śamaya tāṃ prabho || 2 || kārtikeyastu pitarau tyaktvāgāddūrameva yat | tadyogyaṃ na bhavelloke śāstre’pi saṃbhavennahi || 3 || mātuḥ piturguroḥ sevā kāryeti mokṣadā śubhā | sevāṃ tyaktvā gato dūre duritaṃ tatkṛtaṃ bhavet || 4 || duritasya tu pāpasya prāyaścittaṃ tathā kṣayaḥ | phalaṃ syāditi kasmāttatkārtikeye babhūva na || 5 || mātuḥsevā muktikaro mātā bahuvidhā matā | stanadātrī garbhadhātrī bhakṣyadātrī gurupriyā || 6 || abhīṣṭadevapatnī ca pituḥ patnī ca kanyakāḥ | sagarbhā bhaginī cāpi putrapatnī priyāprasūḥ || 7 || māturmātā piturmātā sodarasya priyā tathā | mātuḥ pituśca bhaginī mātulānī tathaiva ca || 8 || janānāṃ vedavihitā mātaraḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ | tā vai pūjyā namaskāryāḥ sevyāḥ stutyāḥ suputrakaiḥ || 9 || tāsāṃ tvāśīrvaco’pyatra putraṃ rakṣati kilbiṣāt | tāsāṃ sevā kṛtā yena sa yāti brahma śāśvatam || 1.109.10 || tāsāṃ tu sevayā putro bhāgyavān bhavati dhruvam | tāsāṃ hṛdayaduḥkhena bhāgyaṃ dahyati vai śubham || 11 || puṇyaṃ naśyati sallakṣmīstaṃ tyaktvānyatra yāti ca | tatkathaṃ kārtikeyena tyaktā mā jagadīśvarī || 1 2|| senā pativratā patnī kathaṃ tyaktā priyā nijā | pativratāyāstyajane narakaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ || 13 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mayā sarvaṃ puraiva vihitaṃ tathā | mayājaśaṃbhupitrarṣidevāśryaṇḍaṃ vinirmitam || 14|| ādye satyayuge sarve brāhmaṇā brahmatejasaḥ | paramātmasamā hyāsan sakalpasmṛddhayo’bhavan || 15 || tretāyāṃ nyūnasāmarthyā hyabhavankālabhedataḥ | dvāpare tu viśeṣeṇa sāmarthyahīnatāṃ gatāḥ || 16 || sāmarthyaṃ tu tapomūlaṃ tapohānau vinaśyati | prajāyāṃ tapaso hāsātsāmarthyahīnatābhavat || 17|| yathā yathā ca sāmarthyaṃ hīyate tu tathā tathā | adharmavaṃśasāmarthyaṃ vardhate tu śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 18|| adharmeṇa prajāstatrāsatyalobhamadānvitāḥ | parasparaṃ duḥkhadātryo’bhavankālasya vegataḥ || 19|| dṛṣṭvaivaṃ brahmaṇā tāvannārāyaṇapareśvaraḥ | smṛtastatra prajārakṣopāyārthaṃ śrīharistadā ||1.109.20|| brahmadhāmasthitaḥ sākṣāllokarakṣaṇahetave | sakalpaṃ vedhaso jñātvā drāgeva cāyayau hariḥ |||21|| brahmā prāha tadā devaṃ natvā stutvā punaḥ punaḥ | mahārāja kṛpāsindho hyadhamoddhārakāraka |||2|| yugabhedātprajāḥ samyaṅ na vartante tapaḥpriyāḥ | tapo’bhāvānna vai puṇyaṃ sāmarthyaṃ sukhadaṃ bhavet ||23 || tadabhāvācca duḥkhāḍhyā mānavā daivavarjitāḥ | kathaṃ mayā rakṣaṇīyāḥ prabho bhaktā mumukṣavaḥ |||24|| śuṣkeṇa sākaṃ sarasaṃ dahyatyapi nirāgasam | tadrakṣaṇāya bhagavan kamupāyaṃ karomi vai ||25|| bhaktānāṃ tapaso yogād bhajanātparameśvara | sarve jīvāḥ prasukhino bhavantyeva hi niścitam ||26|| kālayogācca bhaktā vai tapaḥsādhanavarjitāḥ | bhavanti cettadā jīvā rakṣyante kena karmaṇā ||27|| tasmātprajānāṃ saukhyārthamupāyaṃ parikalpaya | yugeṣu yena sarveṣu bhaktāḥ syuḥ sukhinaḥ sadā ||28|| iti vedhaḥkṛtāṃ jīvarakṣāgarbhitarādhanām | śrutvā nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān paraṃbrahma svayaṃ hariḥ ||29|| brahmāṇaṃ prāha deveśa mā cintā vaha padmaja | tava brahmāṃḍajīvānāṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ tu rakṣaṇam || 1.109.30 || ahameva kariṣye’tra nānyastādṛgbhavedataḥ | mayaiva tatsamācintya yāvadbrahmāṇḍasaṃsthitiḥ ||3 1|| tāvattu rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ mama bhaktā yataḥ priyāḥ | yadyanyaṃ rakṣakaṃ tatra yojayāmi tadā tu saḥ || 32 || kālavegena galito duḥkhaṃ pratyuta cāpnuyāt | tasmādahaṃ svayaṃ sākṣātparabrahma parātparaḥ |||33 || akṣaraṃ brahma nītvaiva sākaṃ prajāvanāya vai | nivasāmyatra loke tachreyaḥ syājjagatāṃ param ||34|| dharmadevānmama janma mūrtyāṃ saṃkalpamātrataḥ | svīkṛtyātra bhaviṣyāmi naranārāyaṇātmakaḥ |||35|| yāvajjīvaṃ brahmacārī brahmatapasi saṃsthitaḥ | tapasaiva prajā rakṣan kariṣye’vanamādarāt ||36|| nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃbrahmākṣaraṃ brahma naraḥ smṛtaḥ | ubhau brahmavratāḍhyau vai tapasi kṛtamānasau ||37|| vartiṣyāmaha ityetatsādhanaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ param | brahācaryavrataṃ me’sti priyaṃ priyatamaṃ sadā || 38|| tadvrataṃ sarvadā brahmaloke saṃpālayāmi vai | tatraiva divye badarikāśrame pālayāmi ca ||39|| īśvarāṇāṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ sadā tapasi saṃsthitaḥ | atrāpyāgatya himavacchikhare yogamāsthitaḥ ||1.109.40 || sarvendriyapratirodhātmake tapasi saṃsthitaḥ | tapaḥpuṇyapradānena rakṣiṣyāmi janānmama ||41|| cintāṃ mā kuru padmastha tapasā rakṣyate jagat | bhavanti vividhānyeva tapāṃsi rakṣaṇāya vai |||42|| ghrāṇenānyanna ghrātavyamityetattapa ucyate | tato’pi ca tvacā cānyanna spraṣṭavyaṃ viśiṣyate ||45 || tato’pi cakṣuṣā cānyanna draṣṭavyaṃ viśiṣyate | tato’pyanyanna śrotavyaṃ śrotreṇeti viśiṣyate ||44|| tato rasanayā cānyanna rasyaṃ vai viśiṣyate | tato vācā na vaktavyaṃ tapo vai śreṣṭhamucyate ||45|| ūrdhvahastaścaikapādo nirāhārastapaḥsthitaḥ | maunādapyadhikaḥ proktastāpasaḥ kaṣṭamāsthitaḥ ||46|| tato’pi nirjalaḥ śreṣṭhastato’pyakalpitakriyaḥ | śreṣṭhastato’pi sarvasmānniṣkāmaścordhvavīryavān ||47|| ūrdhvaretā brahmacārī ratyabhāvādviśiṣyate | sarvendriyebhyo liṃgasya nirodho balavattapaḥ ||48|| rasanāyā nirodhaśca manonirodha ityapi | dhātornirodhastvagrodho rodhāścatvāra īritāḥ ||49|| brahmacarye nirodhāste catvāraḥ saṃbhavanti vai | tasmātkaṣṭataro rodho nānyo’sti balavān khalu ||1.109.50 || yena brahmavrataṃ sāṃgopāṃgaṃ saṃpālitaṃ tu saḥ | mūrtimān vai parabrahma harirnāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ||51 || brahmacaryavratasthasyānyatkartavyaṃ na śiṣyate | kāntākanakasūtreṇa veṣṭitaṃ sakalaṃ jagat ||52|| tāsu teṣu virakto yo dvibhujaḥ parameśvaraḥ | brahmacaryabalāt so’tra tārayatyakhilaṃ jagat ||53|| ahamanne nivasāmi śuddhasattvamayaḥ prabhuḥ | jāṭhare’haṃ nivasāmi parātṛptipradaḥ prabhuḥ ||94|| dhātuṣvahaṃ nivasāmi rajovīryātmakaḥ prabhuḥ | tasyāvanaṃ kṛtaṃ yena mama tenāvanaṃ kṛtam ||55|| kāmabhogasya saṃkalpaḥ kartavyo naiva sarvathā | kāmabhogāya vārtāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ kāryameva na ||5 6 || kāmabhogasya vacanaṃ noccāryaṃ sarvathā yataḥ | kāmabhogasya saṃsparśo vidheyo naiva sarvathā ||5 7|| kāmabhogakṛte kāmidarśanaṃ kāryameva na | kāmabhogakṛte guptasaṃketaḥ kārya eva na ||5 8 || kāmabhogādhyavasāyo naiva kāryaḥ kathaṃcana | rajovīryaprapātaśca naiva kāryaḥ kadācana ||59|| ityevaṃ brahmacaryaṃ vai sarveṣāṃ duṣkaraṃ matam | mithunībhūtajīvānāṃ duṣkaraṃ cātapasvinām ||1.109.60 || tādṛśaṃ brahmacaryaṃ tu naranārāyaṇamṛte | nānyatrāstīti tadrūpaṃ dhṛtvā dhāsye paraṃ tapaḥ ||6 1 || tadvratena prajāṃ sarvāṃ rakṣiṣyāmi tanuṃ mama | pāpāduddhārayiṣye tāṃ sukhayiṣye samantataḥ ||62|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne svaprajārakṣaṇāya brahmacaryatapaḥkaraṇāya nārāyaṇena brahmaṇe naranārāyaṇāvatārāvaśyakatetikathitamiti pradarśananāmā navādhikaśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 109 ||
<1.110> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ityevaṃ tu mayā lakṣmi pratijñātaṃ tu vedhase | tataścāhaṃ tataḥsthānād drāgevādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ || 1 || mamākṣare pare dhāmni brahmacārivrate sthitaḥ | varte yadvatsarvathaiva varte badrīvane tathā || 2 || divyaṃ cākṣaradhāmnastu prāntabhāge tadāśrame | tathaiva ca prasaṃkalpya dharmadeve praviṣṭavān || 3 || akṣarabrahmaṇā sākaṃ dharmānmūrtau praviṣṭavān | mūrtyā mama jananyā ca tadā saṃkalpamātrataḥ || 4 || bālau pravirbhāvitau tau naranārāyaṇātmakau | jātamātro ṣoḍaśābdau surūpau kāmamohanau || 5 || supuṣṭahṛṣṭasarvāṃgau mālā pustikarābjakau | koṭikoṭyarkasaṃkāśau projjvalau parameśvarau || 6 || sūkṣmasvarṇatantutulyajaṭāśobhitamastakau | kaupīnācchādanau vṛkṣaśālākanthākamaṇḍalū || 7 || sopavītau brahmacaryavratapūrṇau tapasvinau | anyatra puruṣe nārībhāgau tu bhavato yathā || 8 || pūruṣasya vāmabhāgo nyūnaśaktyāśrayo bhavet | mayi nārāyaṇe vāme nyūnaśaktirna vai manāk || 9 || vāmadakṣiṇayoḥ sarvāḥ samānā eva śaktayaḥ | nyūnaśaktyātmako nārībhāgo mayi na vidyate || 1.110.1 0|| vidyete vakṣasi cihne stanayostu mamaiva te | stanacihnasya virahe mūrtau me nyūnatā bhavet || 11 || sarvāṃgapūrṇatā na syāt tataścihne tu rakṣite | nare’tha mama rūpe vai vidyete na stanau yataḥ || 1 2| tasminnare mayā nārībhāvaleśasya hīnatā | darśitā na tu sāmarthyanyūnādhikyamubhāṃgayoḥ || 1 3||| nistanastu naro bodhyaḥ sastano’haṃ narāyaṇaḥ | mayā lakṣmīḥ sadā rakṣyā stano vai rakṣitau tataḥ || 14|| nararūpe tu lakṣmyāste susattve na prayojanam | brahmacaryasvarūpe me patnyā nāsti prayojanam || 15|| ityato nararūpaṃ me brahmacaryaṃ paraṃ matam | tādṛgrūpau samutpannāvājānubhujapaṃkajau || 16 || dṛṣṭvā tu pitarau samyakprasannau ca pracakratuḥ | saṃskārau jātasaṃśuddhathai samājñaptau tapaḥkṛte || 17|| tadā hyāvāṃ naranārāyaṇau tau ca vavandatuḥ | sevārthaṃ na tapo’rtha vai sevā pitrostu durlabhā || 18|| sevāyāṃ tu sadā samyagvartanīyaṃ suputrakaiḥ | loke sṛṣṭau sadā mātā putraṃ garbhe surakṣati || 1 9|| tannimittaṃ sadā kaṣṭaṃ sahate jananī mahat | prasave cāpi kaṣṭaṃ ca pālane kaṣṭamityapi || 1.110.20|| rātryahaṃ cānusandhānaṃ kṣālanaṃ malamūtrayoḥ | prāṇavad rakṣaṇaṃ śaśvatstanyapānena poṣaṇam ||21||| aṃke kaṭyāṃ ca vahanaṃ svamabhuktvā prapoṣaṇam | lālanaṃ raṃjanaṃ sevā mātrā tu kriyate sadā || 22|| tasyā jananyā ājanma āmṛti sevayāpi vai | na putro nirṛṇo vai syādasevakasya kiṃ bhavet ||23 || sevāhīnasya putrasya mātṝṇaṃ na nivartate | tasmātsevā prakartavyā cetyāvābhyāṃ prarocate ||24|| mātṛsevāvihīnastu putro na putra ucyate | sa tvaputra iti prokto mātṛbhārakaro hi saḥ ||25 || tasmātsevāṃ kariṣyāvo hyubhau pitrostu sarvadā | asevakasya putrasya narake niyatā gatiḥ || 26 || kālapāśena baddhaḥ syātpretaścāpi bhavettathā | ṛṇadānāya vividhāṃ yoniṃ gacchecca yātanām ||27|| ṛṇāni trīṇyapākṛtya mano mokṣe niveśayet | saṛṇasya gatirnāsti na svargaṃ nāpunarbhavaḥ ||28||| pitṝṇaṃ putramutpādya devarṇaṃ yāgakarmaṇā | ṛṣyṛṇa vidyayāpohya manastapasi yojayet ||29|| tasmātsevāṃ kariṣyāvo’nyathādhogatimāpnuvaḥ | vṛddhau tu pitarau putraiḥ pālanīyau samantataḥ ||1.110.3 0|| anujāḥ pālanīyāśca rakṣyāḥ svasāra ityapi | vivāhanīyāḥ satataṃ dattvā sāhāyyamarthajam || 3 1|| kuṭumbapoṣaṇaṃ kāryamudyamaśca dhanārjane | sukhaduḥkhe same cohye sambandhibhirgṛhasthitaiḥ ||32|| pitrorāsvargavāsaṃ vai sevanīyau tu tau matau | putro yuvā bhaviṣyanvai rakṣiṣyati ca nau tadā ||33|| sukhinau vai bhaviṣyāva iti pitroḥ prakalpanam | bhaṃktvā yāyādvane putrau na putraḥ sa tu rākṣasaḥ ||34|| vane phalaṃ na vai tasya bhavetpratyuta pātakam | pitrorāśīrvacoyuktān puṇyasaṃghānna yo’rjayet |||35||| sa svargaṃ vātha sāmrājye sthito’pi nārakī mataḥ | tasmāttu yuvayoḥ sevāṃ kariṣyāvastu sarvathā |||26|| mātṛsevā kṛtā yena tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet | dānaṃ yajñastapo homo vedādhyayanameva ca ||37|| devatāḥ pūjitāstena dhyānaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ tathā | tapastaptaṃ ca vividhaṃ brahmavidyāpi cārjitā ||38|| sāmrājyaṃ ca kṛtaṃ tena svargaṃ hastagataṃ kṛtam | pāramaiṣṭhyapadaṃ labdhaṃ yena mātā prasevitā ||39|| pitarastarpitāstena ṛṣayaḥ pūjitāstathā | atithayo’rcitāstena yena mātā susevitā ||1.110.40 || gamitāni ca tīrthāni kṣetrāṇyāyatanāni vai | vihitānīṣṭapūrtāni yena mātā prasevitā ||41|| nāsti sevāsamaṃ puṇyaṃ sāṃkhyayogādicarvaṇe | nāsti mātṛsamā devī nāpi pitṛsamo hariḥ ||42|| mriyamāṇo’pi bālo vai pitṛbhyāṃ ca nirīkṣitaḥ | tathāpi svargamāpnuyāt kastau devau parityajet ||43|| indraḥ sūryaḥ śaśī viṣṇurgaṇeśaḥ śaṃkaro’bjajaḥ | varuṇo’gnistathā cānye devāstu janake sthitāḥ || 44|| janakasya sutaḥ samyaksevayā labhate’nvaham | devapūjāphalātkoṭiguṇaṃ satphalamakṣayam ||45|| lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī sandhyā sāvitrī ca satī tathā | gāyatrī rohiṇī saṃjñā vāruṇī vaiṣṇavī tathā ||46|| sarvāśca pūjitāstena yena mātā susevitā | tāsāṃ pūjākṛtapuṇyāt koṭipuṇyaṃ prasūsthitam ||47|| sarvāstā jananīmūrtau tiṣṭhantyeva na vai pṛthak | tasmānmātuśca sevāṃ vai pituścāpi prasevanam ||48|| kariṣyāvo’tra pitrostu pādayorvāsamāsthitau | pitroḥ sevāmahimānaṃ vijānantau narācyutau ||49|| mahāpāpābhibhūtasya pitṛsevāratasya tu | putrasya nayane dūtā yamasya prabhavo na vai ||1.110.50|| mṛtikāle yadi pitrornetrābhyāṃ netramelanam | kriyate tu suputreṇa tadāpi sadgatirbhavet ||51 || mṛtyukāle suputreṇa mukhe vṛndādalaṃ jalam | dīyate’pi ca tanmātrāt pitrostu sugatirbhavet |||52|| yasya gehe bhavetputraḥ pratuṣyanti pitāmahāḥ | putrahīnaṃ kuṭumbantu śapantyeva pitāmahāḥ |||53|| vaṃśe śrāddhaprakartāramadṛṣṭvā prapitāmahāḥ | muñcantyuṣṇapraṇiḥśvāsān bhāvinīraśanārditāḥ ||54|| svasāraścāpi niḥśvāsān muñcantyabhrātrya ityataḥ | nāsmabhyaḥ kaṃcukīdātā bhrātāpi vidyate iti ||55|| lokā vadantyanapatyānanaṃ dṛśyaṃ na maṃgalam | kanyāṃ vadanti nabhrātrīṃ nirvaṃśyo’yaṃ jano vadet ||56|| putraśūnyaṃ gṛhaṃ saudho vimānaṃ ca śmaśānavat | putraśūnyāḥ khānapānābharaṇādivibhūtayaḥ ||57|| kṛṣṇāhiviṣavadbodhyā nānandāya bhavanti tāḥ | devāśca ṛṣayaḥ sarpā nāgāścāṇḍajajātayaḥ ||58|| sarve’pīcchanti satputrān janmāputraṃ nirarthakam | tasmādbhāvyaṃ suputreṇa susevakena sarvathā |||59|| ato hyāvāṃ kariṣyāvaḥ sevāṃ pitrostu sarvadā | tatraḥ śreyaḥ paraṃ bhāvyaṃ sevā muktipradāyinī ||1.110.60 || iti pitrormahimānamuktvā naranarāyaṇau | tūṣṇīṃ babhūvatustatra sevādharmaratau yadā ||61|| pitṛbhaktimayau mātṛsevākṛtaviniścayau | tutuṣaturmūrtidharmau śubhāśīrvādayojinau |||62|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne naranārāyaṇābhyāṃ janmottaraṃ pitroḥ sevādharmapraśaṃsananāmā daśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 110 ||
<1.111> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tato dharmadevaḥ sevāviniścayau | putrau prāha paraṃ dharm paro yasmānna vidyate || 1 || sarvadharmasamāveśo yatra dharme pratiṣṭhitaḥ | taṃ dharm prathamaṃ dhāmni hariṇā saṃpradarśitam || 2 || sarvaśreyaskaraṃ dharmamṛṇābādhyaṃ pramokṣadam | śrutaṃ nārāyaṇamukhānmuktidaṃ sādhanottaram || 3 || dharmaḥ prāha śṛṇutaṃ vai putrau paramaśobhanau | dharmavantau pitṛbhaktau yaduktaṃ tatsuśobhate || 4 || lakṣaṇaṃ tatsuputrasya mātāpitroḥ susevanam | tattato’pyadhikaṃ dharmaṃ śṛṇutaṃ hariṇoditam || 5 || brahmacaryasamo dharmo nāsti nāstyeva naiva hi | anye sarve tu dharmāṇaḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 6 || brahmacaryaṃ brahmadharmo brahma vai sa svayaṃ matam | brahmarūpaṃ brahmamūrtirbrahmātmā brahmarūpadaḥ || 7 || tuṣṭe brahmaṇi sarveśe sarvaṃ tuṣṭaṃ sadā bhavet | sevā ṛṇāni dānāni tadagre svalpamātrakam || 8 || yajñaprāpyaṃ tu yatproktaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate | tasmād yajño brahmacarye saṃpratiṣṭhati sarvathā || 9 || iṣṭāpūrtena yatprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate | tasmādiṣṭaṃ brahmacarye sampratiṣṭhati sarvadā || 1.111.10 || yadidaṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ brahmacaryamiti smṛtam | paraṃ tatsarvadharmebhyastena mokṣaḥ pralabhyate || 11 || brahmacarye sthito dharmo brahmacarye sthitaṃ tapaḥ | brahmacarye sthitā ye te brahmadhāmni sthitā matāḥ || 1 2|| yogena jāyate siddhiḥ siddhyā kīrtiḥ pravartate | kīrtiḥ siddhiśca tapasā tapo brahmaṇi caryayā || 13|| indriyanigraho’sādhyo brahmacaryeṇa sādhyate | brahmacaryeṇa tapasā brahmaloko hyavāpyate || 14|| brahmacaryapravṛttasya brahmaloko’pi kāmadaḥ | kiṃ punardevalokādyā brahmādhānaṃ hi tattataḥ || 15|| sattrāyaṇena yatprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate | sattrāyaṇaṃ brahmacarye saṃpratiṣṭhati sarvathā || 16|| maunavratena labhyaṃ yadbrahmacaryeṇa labhyate | maunaṃ tato brahmacarye saṃpratiṣṭhati sarvathā || 17|| anāśakāyanenāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate | anāśakāyanaṃ brahmacarye tiṣṭhati sarvathā || 18|| araṇyayanasaṃprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate| araṇyāyanamapyatra brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 19 || tyāgāyanena saṃprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate | dṛṣṭānuśravike tyāgo brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 1.111.20|| ahiṃsayā ca yatprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate | ahiṃsā sārvabhaumā sā brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 21 || satyavratena yatprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate | satyaṃ tasmād brahmacarye trividhaṃ pratitiṣṭhati || 22|| asteyena ca yatprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate | asteyaṃ sarvathā dvedhā brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 23 || aparigrahalabhyaṃ yadbrahmacaryeṇa labhyate | aparigraha evāpi brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 24|| śaucena prāpyate yadvai brahmacaryeṇa labhyate | śaucaṃ dvedhā brahmayogād brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 25|| santoṣāllabhyate yattadbrahmacaryeṇa labhyate | santoṣaḥ sarvathātmīyo brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 26|| tapaścaryā vividhā yā brahmacaryeṇa pūryate | tatastapomahākāṇḍo brahmacarye samāpyate || 27|| svādhyāyena ca yallabhyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate | svādhyāyaḥ sarvatovyāpto brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 28 || īśvarasya praṇidhānaṃ brahmacarye pravartate | tata īśapraṇidhānaṃ brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 29|| gorakṣādīnyāsanāni brahmacarye phalanti vai | tasmādāsanakūṭastu brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 1.111.30 || prāṇāyāmena yallabhyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate | prāṇāyāmaścaturdhāto brahmacarye vyavasthitaḥ || 31 || pratyāhārastvindriyāṇāṃ sati brahmavrate phalet | tasmādindriyarodho vai brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 32|| dhyānena yadbhavellabhyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate | dhyānaṃ pratyayaikatānaṃ brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 33 || dhāraṇā yatra kartavyā brahmacaryeṇa labhyate | tasmāttu dhāraṇā sarvā brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 34|| samādhiryatra kartavyo brahmacaryeṇa siddhyati | tasmāddvedhā caturdhā sa brahmacarye pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 35|| damaśāntititikṣehoparamādibhirāpyate | yacca tadvai brahmacaryāllabhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 3 6|| vivekācca vibho kāccābhyāsātsatkriyayā tathā | kalyāṇāccānavasādādanuddharṣācca yadbhavet || 37|| tatsarvaṃ tu brahmacaryāllabhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | jñānāddharmācca vijñānādbhaktyā vividhayā tathā ||38|| tattvajñānānmṛṣāprajñālopāccāpi tu yadbhavet | tatsarvaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||39|| śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ paraṃbrahmādhigacchati | śabdabrahmātra vistārād brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ||1.111.40 || brahmavimarśasadbindunādadhvānagiro’pi ca | pravartante brahmaṇastadbrahmacaryaphalaṃ matam ||41|| aṇimā mahimā prāptirgarimā laghimā tathā | prākāmyamīśitā sarvavaśitāpi ca siddhayaḥ ||42|| tārasutāratārātāraramyakasalilakāḥ | pramodamuditamodamānāścāpi ca siddhayaḥ ||43 || ūhaḥ śabdo’dhyayanaṃ ca duḥkhaghātāstrayastathā | suhṛtprāptirjñānasiddhiścāpyaṣṭau siddhayaśca yāḥ ||44|| dūraśravaṇadarśanādānagamanādṛśyatāḥ | siddhayaśca tathā sarvā labhyante brahmacaryataḥ ||45|| netyā dhotyā ca bastyā ca kuṃjarakriyayā tathā | yadāpyate tvāpyate tadbrahmacaryeṇa sarvathā ||46 || pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇāt śrāddhād yadāpyate tadāpyate | brahmacaryeṇa śrāddhādi brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ||47|| putrotpattyā vidyayāgnihotreṇārādhyate tu yat|| tatsamārādhyate brahmacaryeṇaiveti nirṛṇam ||48|| śrutyā smṛtyā ca yallābhastalābho brahmacaryataḥ | pratīkopāsanālabhya yanmataṃ dhāma tatkhalu ||49 || brahmacaryeṇa samprāpyaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | mātṛpitṛkuṭumbānāṃ lokānāṃ sevayā ca yat ||1.111.50 || labhyate tadbrahmacaryāllabhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | goviprāṇāṃ surāṇāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ mahatāṃ tathā ||5 1 || sādhūnāṃ sevayā labhyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate | pativratāyā lokāste labhyante brahmacaryataḥ |||52||| karmaṭhānāṃ śarmavatāṃ dharmiṣṭhānāṃ ca yā gatiḥ | tato’pyuccatarā sā vai brahmacaryeṇa labhyate |||53|| puṇyātmanāṃ dānināṃ ca yā gatirjāyate śubhā | tato’pyuccatarā prāptirbrahmacaryavato bhavet ||54|| yakṣarakṣobhūtavaināyakakūṣmāṇḍamātaraḥ | piśācapretavetālāstrasyanti brahmacaryataḥ ||55|| ḍākinīśākinīśūlāyoginītālikāstathā | vidravanti brahmacāribalānnāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ||56|| mānuṣā bhūtayaḥ sarvā devānāṃ smṛddhayastathā | labhyante brahmacaryadvai brahmacarye pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||57|| aindraṃ ca vāruṇaṃ sthānaṃ kauberaṃ saumameva vā | sauryaṃ ca gāṇapatyaṃ ca bhaumaṃ svargyaṃ ca paitṛkam ||58|| vairājamaiśvaraṃ vārṣaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ padaṃ ca vā | labhyate brahmacaryeṇa brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ||59|| āgneyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmaṃ śāṃbhavaṃ ca hiraṇmayam | prākṛtaṃ pauruṣaṃ mauktaṃ labhyante brahmacaryataḥ ||1.111.60|| avyākṛtaṃ ca golokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ tathā | kṣairaṃ śvaitaṃ bādrikaṃ ca labhyante brahmacaryataḥ ||6 1 || brahmacaryaprabhāveṇa jīvo’pi yāti śaṃbhutām | yo’yamātmā hatapāpmā viśoko mṛtyuvarjitaḥ ||62|| akṣudhaścātṛṣaścāpyajaraḥ satyamanorathaḥ | satyaphalo bhavatyeva brahmacaryapratāpataḥ ||63|| parabrahmasamo bhūtvā sarvatadbhāvabhāvitaḥ | samaśnute sarvakāmān brahmacaryapratāpataḥ ||64|| āprakṛṃtipūruṣaṃ yad dāsayogasthamaṇḍalam | kiṃkaraṃ caraṇe bhūtvā patati brahmacāriṇaḥ ||65|| apraskhalitadhātostu brahyacaryavataḥ sadā | tadūrdhvaretaso devā dāsā bhavanti kiṃkarāḥ ||66|| brahmacārikṛte lokā vartante śāśvatāḥ sadā | pragacchedyena mārgeṇa brahmacārī janastadā ||67|| vighnāḥ kṛtyā grahā daityāḥ śūlāścāmaṃgalāni ca | prayāntyapaśakunāni dūrādbrahmapratāpataḥ ||68|| yatra mārge brahmacārī pragacchati pratāpavān | samīpe svāgatārthaṃ taṃ samāyānti surādayaḥ ||69|| lokapālā diśāmpālāḥ prajeśā manavaśca tam | abhiyānti brahmacaryapratāpaṃ brahmacāriṇam ||1.111.70 || samvatsarāśca ṛtavo māsāśca divasā niśāḥ | abhiyānti svāgatārthaṃ brahmacaryapratāpinam ||91||| viśvedevā marutaśca vidyādhrāḥ kinnarādayaḥ | devyaścābhiprayāntyenaṃ brahmacaryapratāpinam ||72|| agnayo dakṣiṇāhomāvasathagṛhiṇo janāḥ | abhiyānti brahmacaryabalinaṃ brahmacāriṇam ||73|| sādhyāḥ kiṃpuruṣāścaiva gandharvāścāraṇādayaḥ | brāhmaṇāścāpyabhiyānti brahmacārijanaṃ mudā ||74|| naranārīmithunāni brahmāṇḍe santi koṭiśaḥ | tāni pavitratāṃ yānti brahmacāripadāśrayāt ||75|| brahmacārī svayaṃ brahma brahmacaryabalena vai | pṛthvījalāditattvāni parāvartayituṃ kṣamaḥ ||76|| brahmacārī svay svasya prāṇasya rakṣaṇe tathā | visarjane samartho vai na kālastatra vai prabhuḥ ||77|| mahākālo yāti dūr yamo yamānugāstu ke | vālakhilyāḥ sanakādyā siddhā yogeśvarāstathā ||78|| haryaśvāḥ śabalāśvāśca sādhavaḥ sādhvikāstathā | brahmacaryapratāpena brahmabhāvamito gatāḥ ||79|| hanumānkārtikeyaśca vartete brahmacāriṇau | bhagavatyo mahābhāgāḥ sarasvatyādikāstathā |||1.111.80||| brahmacāriṇya evaitā brahmabhāvamito gatāḥ | tasmātputrau brahmacarye tiṣṭhantau kurutaṃ tapaḥ ||8 1|| brahmacaryapratāpena ṛṇaṃ sarvaṃ nivartate | brahmacaryasamaṃ nānyattapo bhavati duṣkaram ||82|| brahmacāriśarīre vai brahma sākṣāddhi vartate | brahmacāripūjanena parabrahma prapūjitam |||83|| brahmacāribhojanena parabrahma subhojitam | brahmacāridarśanena parabrahmapradarśanam ||84|| brahmacārisparśanena parabrahmaspṛśirmatā | brahmacārinamaskāre parabrahmanamaskṛtiḥ |||85||| brahmacāriparicaryā brahmaśuśrūṣaṇaṃ matam | brahmacārijalapāne brahmaṇā pīyate jalam ||86|| brahmacāripārśvavāse brahmaṇyāvāsa ucyate | brahmacāripranetrābhyāṃ brahmaiva saṃprapaśyati ||87|| brahmacārināsikayā brahmajighrāti vai mudā | brahmacārijihvayā vai brahma vaktyeva sarvathā ||88|| brahmacārirasanayā brahmaivāsvādayatyapi | brahmacāryānanadvārā bhuṃkte brahmaparaṃ sadā |||85|| brahmacārikarapādā brahmaṇaḥ karapatkajāḥ | brahmacārimanovṛttyā manute brahma sarvathā ||1.111.90|| brahmacārikṛtabhogaṃ brahmabhogyaṃ tu tanmatam | brahmacārikṛtāvāso brahmavāso mataḥ sadā ||91|| ūrdhvaretā naiṣṭhikaścopakurvāṇo hariḥ svayam | mātāpi pūjitā tena pitā saṃsevitastathā ||92|| brahmacaryavrataṃ yena rakṣitaṃ brahmarūpiṇā | brahmacārikṛtaṃ sarvaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtameva tat ||93|| tasmād brahmaparo dharmo brahmacaryānna śiṣyate | avatārā harerye vai brahmacāriṇa eva te ||94|| brahmacāriṇa āmuktiḥ sadā karatale sthitā | atiṣṭhataṃ brahmacaryaṃ putro naranarāyaṇau || 95|| ityājñā pitṛbhyāṃ dattā gṛhītvā tau naro hariḥ | natvābhivandyaśaityādriṃ taptuṃ tu duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ || 96 || jagmatustatra badryādiśobhite śikhare sadā | badryadhastāttapo lokasukhārthaṃ kuruto hi tau || 97|| tathāyaṃ kārtikeyo’pi tapatyeva dṛḍhaṃ tapaḥ | brahmacārivrato bhūtvā viṣṇuṃ bhajati nityaśaḥ || 98 || nāstyato yogyatā tatrāparādhasyāpi leśataḥ | brahmacaryatulāyāṃ tvasevākiṃcitkarī matā || 99 || asevā vai na sā bodhyā sevā tapaḥsvarūpiṇī | brahmacaryatapoyogāduddhārayati yatsvakau || 1.111.100 || mātāpitarau sā sevā nānyatulyālpikā matā | yatkṛtena sadā mātuḥ pituḥ prasannatā bhavet || 101 || tatkṛtaṃ sarvadā sevā nānyā sevā viśiṣyate | kārtikena kṛtā sevā brahmavratatapomayī || 102|| iṣṭaṃ tapastu pārvatyāstathā śaṃbhorapi dhruvam | loke yogyaṃ ca śāstre’pi tapaḥ kāryamiti prathā || 103 || brahmavrataṃ tapo lakṣmi mokṣadaṃ duritaṃ na tat | mātā śivā prasannāsīt pitā śaṃbhuḥ prasādavān || 1 04|| senāpatitvamāpyaiva tārakāsuranāśanam | kṛtaṃ pitrorvacana tat tvājñāsevātmakaṃ param || 105 || mayaiva vihitā ceyaṃ skandasthitiranuttamā | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi kimanyacchrotumicchasi || 106 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmacaryamāhātmyavarṇanapūrvakakārtikeyāduritatādipradarśananāmā ekādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 111 ||
<1.112> śrīlakṣmīruvāca nārāyaṇa harekṛṣṇa prāṇanātha mahāprabho | bhavatoktaṃ mahādevo vaiṣṇavāgryo’sti sarvathā || 1 || kathaṃ sa vaiṣṇavaḥ proktastatkathāṃ śrotumutsahe | kva kadā vaiṣṇavo jātaḥ śrāvayādya mama priya || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu devi kathāṃ divyāṃ mahāvaiṣṇavakāriṇīm | mokṣadāṃ viṣṇusambaddhāṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 3 || santi pṛthvyāṃ parvatāśca devādivāsadāyinaḥ | teṣāṃ priyatamaḥ śaityaprado mokṣapradastathā || 4 || himālayaḥ sadā śāntastatra badarikāśramam | puruṣau tatra vartete naranārāyaṇāvubhau || 5 || tatraikaḥ śvetapuruṣaścānyaḥ kṛṣṇastu rūpataḥ | anujaḥ piṃgalaḥ proktaḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 6 || dvibāhuśca caturbāhurnaro nārāyaṇaḥ kramāt | tatra devā vasantīha ṛṣīṇāṃ cāśramāḥ śubhāḥ || 7 || gaṃgā yatrālakanandā divyā vahati sarvadā | ekasminvatsare tatra maheśastaptavām̐stapaḥ || 8 || tadā nārāyaṇo devo bhaktanāmabhayaṃkaraḥ | suprasanno’bravīcchaṃbhuṃ varaṃ varaya śaṃkara || 9 || yaṃ yamipsasi deva tvaṃ taṃ taṃ kāmaṃ dadāmyaham | śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā nārāyaṇaṃ tu karuṇākaram || 1.112.10 || ahaṃ gṛhṇāmi bho deva yadi dātuṃ tvamicchasi | dvau varau mama dīyetāṃ suprasanno janārdana || 1 1|| tava bhaktiḥ sadaivāstu bhaktarājo bhavāmyaham | sarvaloke prasiddhaḥ syāṃ śivo bhakto mahāniti || 12|| viṣṇubhakta itikhyātirlokeṣu bhuvaneṣvapi | jāyatāṃ sarvadā viṣṇu nārāyaṇa jagatprabho || 13 || atha ye māṃ bhajiṣyanti grahīṣyantyāśrayaṃ mama | tasya tava prasādena muktidātā bhavāmyaham || 14|| yasyāhaṃ varadātā syāṃ tasya muktirbhaved dhruvā | viṣṇubhakto muktidātā syāṃ me dehi varadvayam || 15|| iti śrutvā svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prāha śaṃbhuṃ guṇākaram | bhava śaṃbho mama bhakto dātā mukteśca saṃbhava || 16|| evaṃ varau tadā labdhvā śaṃkaraḥ prāha taṃ harim | dehi dīkṣāṃ ca me nātha vaiṣṇavaśca bhavāmyaham || 17|| nāvaiṣṇavo bhavedbhakto muktido nāpyavaiṣṇavaḥ | bhuktirmuktiśca te yogādvaiṣṇavatve sati dhruvā || 18|| vaiṣṇavena tato bhāvyaṃ dehi dīkṣāṃ kṛpāṃ kuru | viṣṇurnārāyaṇo devaḥ śrutvā prāha tu śaṃkaram || 1 9|| sādhu saṃkalpitaṃ śaṃbho sarvalokahitārthi yat | gṛhāṇa śaṃbho prathamaṃ mantraratnaṃ śubhāvaham ||1.112.20 || brahmāhaṃ brahmabhaktosmi japasvainaṃ nirantaram | mantraratnamidaṃ nāma prapāti śaraṇāgatam ||21 || lakṣmīnārāyaṇaśceti mantraḥ sarvaphalapradaḥ | śrīmannārāyaṇaśceti mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ ||22|| svāminārāyaṇaśceti mantro mokṣapradaḥ smṛtaḥ | naranārāyaṇaśceti mantro brahmagatipradaḥ ||23|| harinārāyaṇaśceti mantro duḥkhavināśakaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśceti mantro vibhūtidāyakaḥ ||24|| mantro vāsudevanārāyaṇastvaiśvaryadāyakaḥ | rāmanārāyaṇaśceti mantraḥ pāpavināśakaḥ ||25|| oṃ śrīnārāyaṇo mantro bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ | mantraḥ prapattidastveṣaḥ śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama ||26||| ityevaṃ mantradaśakaṃ deyaṃ bhaktebhya uttamam | oṃ namo bhagavata vāsudevāyeti mantrarāṭ ||27|| mantrarājaṃ mantraratnaṃ daśamantrām̐śca śaṃkara | etān dvādaśamantrām̐stvaṃ dehi śiṣyajanāya vai ||28|| mantroccāraṇamātreṇa cātituṣṭo’smi nityadā | mantrādhikāriṇaḥ sarve ye me bhaktā mumukṣavaḥ ||29|| jñānino yoginaścānye jaḍā nāryastathāśritāḥ | bhaktiśraddhānvitāḥ sarve mānavā hyadhikāriṇaḥ |||1.112.30 || brahmāṇḍe ye’tra tiṣṭhanti surādyāścādhikāriṇaḥ | tebhyo’nyatamamantro vai dātavyaḥ śreyase bhavet ||3 1|| śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ gṛhāṇa bhujayostathā | taptamudrāṃkanaṃ caitaccandanāṃkanameva vā ||32|| gṛhāṇa śaṃbho bāhvostadviṣṇurūpatvadāyakam | pañcaviṃśatyakṣarāṃ ca gāyatrīṃ ca gṛhāṇa vai || 33 || oṃ nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi | tanno brahma pracodayāditi japyānvahaṃ tvayā ||24||| dhyāyasva māṃ surūpaṃ ca dvibhujaṃ vā caturbhujam | dvibhujaṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ brahmadhāmani saṃsthitam ||35|| sarvāvatārasaṃdhartṛ parabrahmātmakaṃ śubham | cakrahastaṃ tathābhayapradahastaṃ dvihastakam |||36|| hārakuṇḍalamālākaṭakamukuṭabhūṣaṇam | pītāmbaraṃ ṣoḍaśābdaṃ prasannaṃ parameśvaram ||37|| caturbhujaṃ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakarānvitam | vāmāṃkasthaśriyā sārdhaṃ rūpaṃ dhyāyasva hṛdgamam ||38|| atha māṃ ṣoḍaśadivyopacāraiḥ pūjayasya ca | āvāhanaṃ svāsanaṃ ca pādyamarghyaṃ tataḥ param ||39|| ācamanaṃ tathā snānaṃ madhuparkaṃ tathāmbaram | candanaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ nivedanam ||1.112.40|| yajñasūtraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ dehi me bhaktibhāvataḥ | sugandhyarkaṃ karpūraṃ ca sugandhaṃ dehi me’nagham ||41 || kuru pradakṣiṇāṃ daṇḍavacca namaskriyāḥ kuru | stutiṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ dehi kṣamāṃ yācasva mat tathā ||42|| visarjaya bahiṣṭo māṃ sve hṛdi sthāpayātmani | śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ caiva smaraṇaṃ pādasevanam ||43|| arcanaṃ vandanaṃ dāsyaṃ sakhyamātmanivedanam | dhyānaṃ samādhiraikyaṃ ca kuru bhajasva sādhanaiḥ || 44|| ūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ ca tilakaṃ lalāṭe kuru śaṃkara | bāhvośca hṛdaye cāpyūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ tilakaṃ kuru ||45|| candanena sugandhena satkesarayutena ca | tanmadhye candrakaṃ tena kuṃkumenāthavā kuru ||46|| kaṇṭhe gṛhāṇa tulasīgraiveyaṃ dvisaraṃ śubham | kaṇṭhī sā tu sadā dhāryā na tu tyājyā kadācana ||47|| tulasīmālikāṃ cāṣṭottaraśatārthapūritām | gṛhāṇa japakāryāya maṇyādinirmitāṃ ca vā ||48 || īśvarāntaṃ ca te nāma prakaromi maheśvaram | pālakena ramayā ca kṛtastvaṃ parameśvaraḥ ||49|| pareṇa ca mayā lakṣmyā kṛtastvaṃ parameśvaraḥ | paṃ viṣṇuṃ raṃ ramāṃ maśca mimīte bhajate tu yaḥ ||1.112.50 || aiśvaryāśraya ityuktastvaṃ śaṃbhuḥ parameśvaraḥ | īśvarāntāni nāmāni tava śaṃbho bhavantu vai ||51 || evaṃ lakṣmi mayā dīkṣā dattā śrīśaṃkarāya vai | tadārabhya sadā śaṃbhurbhajate māmananyabhāg ||52|| dīkṣāmādāya śaṃbhu sa gato vai gandhamādane | svīyāvāse tu kailāse bhajate māmaharniśam ||53|| patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ kandaṃ toyaṃ grāhyaṃ ca yadbhavet | tatsarvaṃ māmanivedya naiva gṛhṇāti śaṃkaraḥ ||54|| karoti tilakaṃ sthāne māṃ ca japati mālayā | tiṣṭhati dhyānamagno’sau mama mūrtāvanīhayā ||55|| dṛṣṭvaivaṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ bhaktiṃ śaṃkaraṃ prāha pārvatī | kasya dhyānaṃ ca mālābhirjapaśca tilakādikam ||56 || kriyate lokanāthena parameśvararūpiṇā | bhavāneva parabrahma parātparataraḥ svayam ||57|| ityevaṃ pūrṇarūpasya kasya dhyānaṃ japaśca vai | iti śrutvā mahādevaḥ pārvatīṃ prāha tāttvikam ||58|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne badarikāśrame nārāyaṇena śaṃkarāya vaiṣṇavīdīkṣāpradānaṃ tadaṃgakalāpādipradarśana ceti nirūpaṇanāmā dvādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 12||
<1.113> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca pārvatyā vacanaṃ śrutvā vaiṣṇavaśca maheśvaraḥ | saṃpravaktuṃ samārebhe tajjijñāsānivṛttaye || 1 || śṛṇu sati pravakṣyāmi viṣṇuṃ bhaje’hamaṃjasā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo viṣṇuḥ parabrahma pareśvaraḥ || 2 || bhajanīyaḥ pūjanīyo japanīyaśca sarvadā | mayā dīkṣā tadīyā vai grahītā badarīvane || 3 || taṃ vai pareśvaraṃ nityaṃ dhyāye bhajāmi bhāvataḥ | pārvatī prāha deveśa vistarāt tadyathātatham || 4 || māmapi śrāvaya sarvaṃ yadi grāhyaṃ mayā bhavet | yenāhamapi govindamāśritya śreya āpnuyām || 5 || kathaṃ nādyāpi me nātha kathitaṃ nahi tatkvacit | etāvatkālaparyantaṃ śrīharerbhajanaṃ vinā || 6 || divasāḥ sarvathā vyarthā gamitā me hariṃ vinā | yadyahaṃ te devadeva satpātra sammatāsmi vai || 7 || tadā māmapi bhaktāṃ śrīhareḥ saṃdīkṣaya prabho | gururbahmā gururviṣṇurgurudevo janārdanaḥ || 8 || guruḥ svasyāḥ patiḥ proktaḥ patyau sarvaṃ samāsthitam | patyuḥ sevā parā sevā patyurbhaktiḥ parā matā || 9 || patidharmaḥ paro dharmastaṃ dharmaṃ dehi śaṃkara | patistu vaiṣṇavo yasyāḥ patnī yadi na vaiṣṇavī || 1.113.10 || avaiṣṇavyā kṛtā sevā bhaktiḥ sarvāpi niṣphalā | avaiṣṇavyā kṛtaṃ bhojyamaśuddhaṃ pāvanaṃ nahi || 11 || avaiṣṇavyāḥ karajalaṃ hyapeyaṃ pāvanaṃ nahi | avaiṣṇavyā gṛhaṃ sarvaṃ śmaśānamiti gīyate || 1 bhe || avaiṣṇavyā gṛhāllakṣmīrniḥsarati sarvathā | tasmādahaṃ svāmidharmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ pāvanaṃ param || 13 || saṃgrahītuṃ samicchāmi vistarādbrūhi tattvataḥ | śrutvaivaṃ pārvatīgāthāṃ prāha śaṃbhurmaheśvarīm || 14 || nādyāpi pātratā te’bhūt tasmānna kathitaṃ mayā | bahūnāṃ janmanāṃ puṇyaiḥ pātratā prāpyate khalu || 12 || etajjanmani pātratvaṃ puṣṭiṃ yāti kathāśravāt | satāṃ tu sevayā cātmā divo bhavati nityaśaḥ || 16 || pātivratyena patyuśca sevayātmā balaṃ vrajet | balavānbhāgyavānsādhusevako yo bhavejjanaḥ || 17 || tasyaiva nirmalā vṛttirbhavatyāntarabāhyajā | nairmalyaṃ tu bhavedbījaṃ śraddhāyāḥ sarvathā priye || 18 || tato bhavati jijñāsā tayā cāpyadhikāritā | tathā sati guroryoge sarvaṃ phalati yatkṛtam || 1 9|| tavedānīṃ tu tatsarvaṃ samutpannaṃ ca yojitam | hyupasthitaṃ ca saṃjātaṃ tasmāt tvaṃ pātramuttamam || 1.113.20 || jātāsyadya mahādevi prasannaśca bhavāmyaham | aho mama priyā patnī vaiṣṇavīṃ sthitimicchasi || 2 1 || asmāt kinnu mahadbhāgyaṃ paraṃ mama kṛte bhavet | atyatīva prasanno’smi śrutvā te hṛdayaṃ priye || 22|| sarvaṃ te’haṃ pradāsye vai yatastvaṃ vaiṣṇavī bhava | devi cādyāpi paryantaṃ bhojyaṃ peyaṃ yadarpitam || 2 3 || viṣṇave tatsamarpayya paścād bhuktaṃ mayā hi tat | kiṃ vacmi devadeveśi hyadyānandamayo mahān || 24|| sūryodayaḥ suvarṇasya mama jāto’sti sarvathā | patisevāphalaṃ sarvaṃ sakhi te bhavatu priye ||25||| gṛhaṃ sarvaṃ mama bhūyādvaiṣṇavaṃ bhāgyavānaham | adya devi dehaśuddhyai kārtike śuklapakṣake || 26 || daśamyāṃ tu nirāhāramupavāsaṃ kuru priye | dehaśuddhyarthamevātra paṃcagavyaṃ gṛhāṇa ca || 27|| maṇḍapaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapūjākṛte racaya śobhanam | kadalīstaṃbhasannaddhamaśokadalatoraṇam || 28 || saptadhānyakṛtaṃ tatra sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam | racaya tvaṃ mahābhāge tatra sthāpaya sadghaṭam || 29 || aṣṭadikṣu ghaṭānpārśve sthāpayāṣṭau navām̐stataḥ | kaṇṭhe veṣṭaya vastrāṇi mukhe paṃcārdrapallavān || 1.113.3 0 || nārīkelaphalānyaṣṭa kṛṣṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ ca tatra vai | madhye ghaṭe svarṇapātre pratiṣṭhāpaya bhāvataḥ || 31 || gaṇeśapūjanaṃ kṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇapūjanaṃ tataḥ | lakṣmyāśca pūjanaṃ nārāyaṇena saha kārayā || 32|| nivedaya varāṇyeva hyupacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāḥ prātaḥ snānaṃ tathā kuru || 33 || upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ pratipūjaya | tatra samāgataṃ dīkṣāvidhijñātārameva ca || 34|| ācāryaṃ māṃ śraya pūrvaṃ haryāśrayaṇasiddhaye | ācinoti ca śāstrārthānācāre sthāpayatyapi || 25|| svayaṃ tvācarate yasmāt brahmādhyāpayati dhruvam | mantraṃ jānāti viṣṇośca bhaktiṃ karoti sarvathā || 36|| śrīmannārāyaṇasampradāyavidyāṃ tu vetti yaḥ | tārayati svakaṃ śiṣyamācāryaḥ sa mato guruḥ || 37|| tadvākyeṣu suviśvāsaḥ śiṣyo bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ | gṛhṇīyānmantraratnaṃ tadekādaśyāṃ tu kārtike ||38|| gṛhāṇa devi dīkṣāṃgaṃ śaṃkhacakrasumudraṇam | paṃcāmṛtaiḥ prasaṃsnāpya śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ prapūjya ca ||39|| agniṃ saṃsthāpya vidhinā juhayājyaṃ vidhānataḥ | ghṛtapāyasayorhomamaṣṭottaraśataṃ kuru ||1.113.40 || śaṃkhacakre pratapte ca kuru hyagnau tato guruḥ | ahaṃ śaṃbhurgurustvāṃ vai cakreṇa jalajena ca ||41|| aṃkayāmi dvayorbāhvoḥ punaḥ prapūjya taddvayam | kalaśasthajalenātrābhiṣekaṃ kuru mastake |||42|| nūtanāṃ śāṭikāṃ dhṛtvā jalenācamanaṃ kuru | lalāṭe tilakaṃ cordhvapuṃḍraṃ sacandrakaṃ kuru ||43|| candanena kuṃkumena tato mantraṃ gṛhāṇa me | brahmāhaṃ brahmabhaktāsmi trivāraṃ tad gṛhāṇa me ||44|| tato māṃ prapūjayādritanaye māṃ namaskuru | gṛhāṇa tulasīkaṇṭhīṃ kaṇṭhe dhāraya cādrije ||45|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇaśceti mantraṃ gṛhāṇa cādrije | maheśvarīti te nāma parameśvarī cetyapi ||46|| bodhyaṃ tataḥ kuru dhyānaṃ śrīhariṃ dvibhujaṃ tathā | lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ divyaṃ dhyāne gṛhāṇa sarvadā ||47|| parasmād brahmaṇo nārāyaṇād devo’sti no paraḥ | tasyaiva cāparo mantraḥ śrīhariṃ śaraṇaṃ mama ||48|| gṛhāṇainaṃ śive’dya tvaṃ jātā pūjyā suvaiṣṇavī | kuru bhaktiṃ harernityaṃ gurorme sevanaṃ kuru ||49|| śiṣyapraśiṣyaśākhāśca mantradānena vardhaya | lakṣmyāvāsastvayi prāpto mayi nārāyaṇasya ca ||1.113.50|| āvāṃ bhaktiṃ kariṣyāvo nārāyaṇasya sarvadā | sevāṃ tasya kariṣyāvo yena muktirdhruvā bhavet ||51|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kailāse śaṃbhunā pārvatyai śrīvaiṣṇavīdīkṣādattetyaṃgabhūtakāṇḍanirūpaṇanāmā trayodaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 11 3|||
<1.114> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tato devyā vaiṣṇavyā prārthitaṃ punaḥ | śaṃbhoragre kathayāmi śravaṇārhaṃ paraṃ yataḥ || 1 || pārvatyuvāca deveśa mahādeva sureśvara| viṣṇubhaktiṃ mamācakṣva muktidāṃ vistarātpunaḥ || 2 nārāyaṇasvarūpāṇi mantrapūjāvidhīṃstathā | tadvibhūtiguṇādīṃśca taddhāmagatisādhanam || 3 dhāmnastasya svarūpaṃ ca cihnamāhātmyamityapi | vistareṇa mayi prītyā brūhi sarvamaśeṣataḥ || 4 | iti pṛṣṭo mahādevyā śaṃbhuvaiṣṇavasattamaḥ | uvāca paramapremṇā natvā nārāyaṇaṃ harim || 5 | sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ mahādevi sarvajīvahitaiṣiṇi | bhaktavarye śīlarūpaguṇopete maheśvari || 6 | parituṣṭo’smi te praśnād dhanyāsi vaiṣṇavi priye | kṛtapuṇyāsi bhaktāsi prabhornārāyaṇasya ca || 7 | vakṣyāmyahaṃ ca te devi bhagavadbhaktimuttamām | nārāyaṇasvarūpaṃ ca mantrapūjāvidhiṃ tathā || 8 | parabrahma paramātmā parameśvara eva saḥ | sarveśvaro mahāmukteśvaro’kṣaraparaḥ prabhuḥ || 9 || paramaḥ puruṣaḥ puruṣottamaḥ śrīhariḥ svayam | bhagavānakṣarātīto vāsudevo’cyutaḥ paraḥ || 1.114.1 0|| kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo deveśvaro viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ | īśeśvaro mahāmāyeśvaraḥ sākṣī sadāśivaḥ || 1 1|| hiraṇyagarbhaḥ śrīmān śrīyajño nārāyaṇo naraḥ | lakṣmīpatiḥ svāmyanantaścātmārāmo guṇātigaḥ || 1 2|| sarvanetrasarvavijñaḥ sarvahṛtstho ya niyāmakaḥ | guṇākaro divyamūrtiḥ śyāmalo hṛdayaṃgamaḥ || 1 3|| nityaṃ bhakteṣu vasati rakṣatyapi svakān janān | śeṣavedopavedādyaiḥ sabṛhaspatidevataiḥ || 14|| māhātmyaṃ tasya devasya vaktuṃ naiva hi pāryate | tasya bhaktikalāpaṃ te vacmi śṛṇu pṛthakpriye || 15|| mūrtirhareḥ sadā dhyeyā svātmanyeva muhurmuhuḥ | tasya cakrasya śaṃkhasya hyaṃkana prathamaṃ matam || 16|| dhāraṇaṃ cordhvapuṃḍrāṇā tanmantrāṇāṃ parigrahaḥ | arcanaṃ tajjapo dhyānaṃ tannāmasmaraṇaṃ muhuḥ || 17| kīrtanaṃ śravaṇaṃ tasya vandanaṃ caraṇārhaṇam | caraṇāmṛtapānaṃ ca tanniveditabhojanam || 18|| tadīyānāṃ satāṃ sevā dvādaśyekādaśīvratam | tulasīropaṇaṃ caiva bhaktiḥ ṣoḍaśadhā hi sā || 19| atha śrīmandire tasya mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ tathā | kṣālanaṃ dhūpanaṃ caivāndolanaṃ dīpanaṃ tathā ||1.114.20 vījanaṃ mardanaṃ raṃgaraṃjanaṃ cāṃjanaṃ tathā | sugandhanaṃ tathā vastupradāpanamanuvratam ||21|| hāsanaṃ vārtanaṃ caiva svāpaṇaṃ ṣoḍaśāparāḥ | bhaktibhedā bhavantyeva kriyārūpā hareḥ kṛte |||22|| etaiḥ sevāprabhedaiśca bhababandho vinaśyati | sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ devīnāṃ ca mamāpi ca ||23||| sādhūnāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ viśeṣataḥ | pūjanīyo harirnityaṃ vidhivatpūjayeddhi tam |||2|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmāṃkanaṃ vai bāhumūlayoḥ | dhārayitvaiva vidhivad brahmapūjāṃ samācaret |||25|| pāpāni kṣālayitvā sa yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam | cakrāṃkanavihīnena kṛtā pūjā nirarthikā || 26|| viṣṇucakravihīnena bhuktaṃ śrāddhe nirarthakam | nirāśāḥ pitaro yānti tadā dṛṣṭvā tvavaiṣṇavam |||27|| deyaṃ gobhūhiraṇyādi cakrāṃkitabhujāya vai | cakrahīnāya yaddattaṃ tadgṛhṇantyasurā balāt |||28|| taptacakrāṃkitaṃ bāhumūlā yānti hareḥ padam | cakracihnitabhakteṣu tīrthayajñā vasanti vai || 29|| cakracihnavihīnastu brāhmaṇaḥ prākṛtau mataḥ | na tasya kiṃcidaśnīyādapi kratusahasriṇaḥ |||1.114.30|| cakraṃ nārāyaṇasyaiva saṃsāracakranāśakam | taptaṃ vā cāndanaṃ cakra dhāryaṃ karmaprasiddhaye |||3 1|| śrautasmārtādisiddhyarthaṃ mantrasiddhyarthameva ca | harerarcanasiddhyarthaṃ vaiṣṇavattvasya siddhaye |||32|| jñānasya siddhaye caiva cakraṃ dhāryaṃ viśeṣataḥ | acakradhāriṇaṃ vipraṃ dūrataḥ parivarjayet |||33|| vāhane taṃ samāropya bahiḥ kuryātsvapattanāt | śvapākamiva nekṣeta loke vipramavaiṣṇavam |||34|| dakṣiṇe tu bhuje vipro bibhṛyācca sudarśanam | vāme śaṃkhaṃ tu bibhṛyāditi bodhyaṃ pareśvari ||35|| govindasyāyudhānyaṃge bibhran suśroṇi vai dvijaḥ | turīyaṃ dhāma tadviṣṇormahiṣṭhaḥ prāpnuyāditi ||36|| camūṣacchyenaḥ śakuno bibhṛtveti ṛgabravīt | brāhmaṇe tu śatapathe taptaṃ cakraṃ dvihastayoḥ |||37|| dhāryamagnihotrameva bhavati brahmamuktidam | taptaṃ cakraṃ bhuje dhāryaṃ viṣṇulokagatirbhavet ||38|| sudarśanaṃ tu sandhāryamityūrdhvapuṃḍramityapi | dvirekhaṃ bhavati veda brahmasāyujyameti saḥ ||39|| taptaṃ cakraṃ bhuje dhāryaṃ brahmasāyujyamicchatā | taptaṃ cakraṃ bhuje dhāryaṃ tatpuruṣapareṇa hi ||1.114.40|| devāsaḥ pitarau yena vidhūtena ca bāhunā | sudarśanena prayatātsvargaṃ lokaṃ yadaṃkitaḥ ||41|| manavo lokasṛṣṭiṃ vai vitanvanti tadaṃkitāḥ | taptaṃ cakraṃ bhuje dhāryamūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ samālikhet ||42| dvirekhaṃ bhavati tena punarāgamanaṃ nahi | viṣṇudaivataptaṃ taccakraṃ dhāryaṃ bhujadvaye |||43 || taptaṃ cakraṃ bhuje dhṛtvā devā gacchanti keśavam | brāhmaṇā dhārayantyūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ dvirekhamīśadam ||44|| nicakṣepa suṣaṇaṃ bhidyamānaṃ madhye bāhumadadhat sudarśanaṃ ca | viṣṇoridaṃ bhūridaṃ bhūritejo divānaktaṃ bibhṛyustajjanāsaḥ ||45 || pavitramityagnirnemiḥ sahasrārastanneminā | taptatanūrbrāhmaṇo vai brahmasāyujyamāpnuyāt ||46|| cakraṃ bibharti vapuṣābhitaptaṃ balaṃ devānāmamitasya viṣṇoḥ | sa eti nākaṃ duritāni vidhūya prayānti yadyatayo vītarāgāḥ||47|| ebhirvayamuruvikramasya cihnairaṃkitā loke nu subhagā bhavāmaḥ | tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padamakṣarākhyaṃ ye gacchanti lāṃchitāstaiḥ parasmin ||48|| pra te viṣṇo hyabjacakre pavitre janmāṃbhodhiṃ tartave carṣaṇīndrāḥ | mūle bāhvordadhate’nye purāṇā liṃgānyaṃge tāvakānyarpitāni ||49 || dhṛtordhvapuṃḍraḥ kṛtacakradhārī viṣṇuṃ paraṃ dhyāyati yo mahātmā | svareṇa mantreṇa sadā hṛdisthitaṃ parātparaṃ yanmahato mahāntam ||1.114.5 0|| ūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ tathā cakraṃ nityaṃ dhārayate janaḥ | tena tasyāśubhaṃ naśyecchubhamasya vivardhate ||5 1|| upavītādibaddhāryāḥ śaṃkhacakragadādayaḥ | mahāpastu prarakṣanti viṣṇuriva tadāyudhāḥ ||5 2|| sudarśanena yasyāṃgaṃ lāṃchitaṃ tu bhavetsadā | dehe tasya vasennityaṃ śriyā yuktaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ |||53|| cakrāyudhāṃkitaṃ dṛṣṭvā yamo’pi hṛdi śaṃkate | praṇāmaṃ dūrataḥ kṛtvā viṣṇubhaktaṃ prayāti vai ||54|| paśuputrādikaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhopakaraṇāni ca | aṃkayecchaṃkhacakrābhyāṃ nāma kuryācca vaiṣṇavam||55|| aṃkayecchaṃkhacakrābhyāṃ nāma kuryācca vaiṣṇavam ||55 || patnī patiśca kuryātāṃ saṃskārapaṃcakaṃ yadā | sadharmiṇau bhavetāṃ tu tadā bhaktau na cānyathā ||56|| vaiṣṇavā munayaḥ sarve sudarśanena mudritāḥ | teṣāṃ pādodakaṃ pītvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||57|| dhṛtordhvapuṃḍraḥ parameśitāraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ sāṃkhyayogādhigamyam | dhyātvā vimucyeta naraḥ samastaiḥ saṃsārapāśairiha caiti viṣṇum ||58|| dhṛtordhvapuṃḍro dhṛtacakralāṃchano nārāyaṇaṃ pūjayati sma lakṣmīm | arghyādibhiḥ pauruṣasūktamantraiḥ sa prāpnuyādviṣṇupadaṃ mahātmā |||59|| tatpriyārthaṃ śubhārthaṃ ca rakṣārthaṃ muktilabdhaye | sadbhakto dhārayennityamūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ bhayāpaham ||1.114.60|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakhaḍgaśārgāṃdicihnitaḥ | tulasīcandanairliptaḥ kuryātsandhyāmupāsanām ||6 1 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ sandhyā svādhyāyakarma ca | yaśaḥ pitṛkriyordhvapuṃḍraṃ vinā niṣphalaṃ matam ||62|| ataptatanurna tadāmo aśnute śṛtāsa vai | idvahantastatsamāśata vṛttadīrghe karādhikṛṇmahe ||63|| asya viṣṇostaptatanavaḥ tareyuḥ pātakāṃbudhim | pavitraṃ caraṇaṃ nemihareścakraṃ sudarśanam ||64|| dīrghaṃ samūrdhvatilakaṃ kṛtvā yānti paraṃ padam | tena taptā tanuryeṣāṃ te yānti paramākṣaram ||65|| sahasrāraṃ prākṛtaghnaṃ brahmadvāraṃ mahaujasam | pavitramarcivadagne brahma tena punīhi naḥ ||66|| yena devāḥ pavitreṇa hyātmānaṃ punate sadā | tena sahasradhāreṇa pavamānyaḥ punantu mām ||67|| prājāpatyaṃ pavitraṃ tacchatodyāmaṃ hiraṇmayam | vayaṃ brahmavidastena pūtaṃ brahma punīmahe ||68|| sanemicakraṃ satataṃ cākṣarasya mahātmanaḥ | tasmim̐ścakravṛte dehe mahonnatipadaṃ laset ||69|| divaspateḥ suvitataṃ pavitraṃ yasya dakṣiṇe | na tapyate bhuje samyaktasya śocanti vai kriyāḥ ||1.114.70|| ye vahanti bhuje cakraṃ śaṃkhaṃ ca vidhinā janāḥ | parānapi vilomasthāṃste rakṣanti hareḥ priyāḥ ||71 || dvividhaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ proktaṃ bāhyamābhyantaraṃ tathā | śaṃkhacakrādibhirbāhyamāntaraṃ harirakṣaṇam ||72|| aṃge cakrādihetīnāmaṃkanaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ purā | bhaktyā hṛdi sadā śrīmannārāyaṇasusevanam ||73|| tadetaddvayayuktatve vaiṣṇavatvaṃ bhuvaṃ bhavet | ityevaṃ cakramāhātmyaṃ vaidikārthapuṣaṃ bahu ||74|| tasmāddhāryaṃ mahādevi pārvatī tatsudarśanam | yena rakṣā tathā muktirubhayaṃ jāyate dhruvam ||75|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ṣoḍaśavidhabhaktitaptacakrapuṃḍrādimahimavarṇananāmā caturdaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 14||
<1.115> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śaṃbhuḥ prāha tato devīṃ pārvatīṃ svapriyāṃ priye | śruṇu śaityādrisatputri mahimānaṃ tathāparam || 1 || ūrdhvapuṃḍrasya saṃvakṣye dhāraṇānmuktiriṣyate | ūrdhvaṃ brahmaparaṃ lokaṃ puṃse dadyād vimuktaye || 2 || rakṣayecca jagadbandhāttadūrdhvaṃ puṃḍramīritam | madhye tu candrakaṃ lakṣmī puṃḍre devo janārdanaḥ || 3 || dvayorvāso lalāṭāgre yasya so’kṣayamokṣabhāk | tasyaiva darśanātprātarjvalanti tvaghaparvatāḥ || 4 || yasya dehe cordhvapuṃḍraṃ sa nārāyaṇamandiram | ūrdhvapuṃḍralalāṭasya sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhavet || 9 || sarvayajñaphalaṃ cāpi ceṣṭāpūrtaphalaṃ bhavet | sarvadānaphalaṃ cātha sarvayogaphalaṃ bhavet || 6 || ūrdhvapuṃḍralalāṭaṃ vai dṛṣṭvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate | namaskṛtya vimānastho yāti brahmapadaṃ param || 7 || śrāddhe cordhvapuṃḍradharaṃ bhojayiṣyati yo janaḥ | ākalpakoṭi pitarastṛptā hṛṣṭā bhavanti vai || 8 || sordhvapuṃḍradharādevakṛtaśrāddhe gayāphalam | yajñadānajapātithyasatkriyāhomatāpanam || 9 || sordhvapuṃḍrabhaktakṛtaṃ tasya puṇyamanantakam | ūrdhvapuṃḍravihīnena kṛtaṃ yajñādikaṃ vṛthā || 1.115.1 0|| anūrdhvapuṃḍrako dehaḥ śmaśānasadṛśo bhavet | anūrdhvapuṃḍrakasyātra puṇyaṃ sandhyāhijāpanam || 11 || haranti rākṣasāstadvai svayaṃ doṣeṇa lipyate | anūrdhvapuṃḍrako yāyānnaijapāpādyamakṣayam || 12|| sakesarasugandhāḍhyacandanenāthavā mṛdā | pāṇḍurayā piśaṃgyā vā kuṃkumenāthavā kriyāt || 13|| lalāṭabhūṣaṇaṃ tadvai caturdhā bodhyameva ha | ūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ ca puṃḍraṃ ca paṭṭapuṇḍraṃ tripuṇḍrakam || 14|| ūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ dvirekhaṃ syādekarekhaṃ tu puṇḍrakam | paṭṭasthūlaṃ paṭṭapuṃḍraṃ suptatryaṃkaṃ tripuṇḍrakam || 19|| devādipūjane daivakārye dvirekhamādṛtam | rājyābhiṣekaprabhṛtau tilakaṃ dīpavatsmṛtam || 16 || aśūnyakalalāṭārthaṃ paṭṭākāramaharniśam | śṛṃgārahāsaliṃgādipūjane tu tripuṃḍrakam || 17|| cāndanaṃ cordhvapuṃḍraṃ vai kauṃkumaṃ tilakaṃ matam | śvetamṛdā tu paṭṭākhyaṃ bhasmanā tu tripuṃḍrakam || 18 || viṣṇubhaktairmānavairvai kāryamūrdhvaṃ tu puṇḍrakam | ekāntino mahābhāgavatāstu sāttvatāḥ sadāḥ || 19 || kurvanti sāntarālaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ haripadākṛti | madhye sacandrakaṃ tadvai śrīharermandiraṃ smṛtam || 1.115.20 || ṛju saumyaṃ suśalākaṃ manohāri suśobhanam | tanurekhaṃ kesaraṃ tadūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ sacandrakam || 11 || naranārībhirādhāryaṃ darśane maṃgalāvaham | sāntarāle cordhvapuṃḍre madhyakuṃkumacandrake || 22|| madhye lakṣmyā saṃyuktaḥ śrīharistatra virājate | nirantarālātta tataḥ saśrīharirnivartate || 23 || nirantarālaṃ niḥśrīkaṃ sāntarālaṃ śriyānvitam | mṛdaṃ rpigataḍāgasya vaikuṇṭhākhyahradasya ca || 24|| śvetāṃ piśaṅgīṃ vādāya kuryādūrdhvaṃ tu puṇḍrakam | tīrthaprāsādikīṃ bhūmiṃ mṛdāmādāya śodhayet || 25|| tulasīmūlabhūmermṛdūrdhvapuṃḍre praśasyate | śrīkṛṣṇelābhuvaścāpi gaṃgāyamīpratīrayoḥ || 26|| gomatītīrabhūmestūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ tīrthapuṇyadam | yajñāgnihotrayorbhasma harikṣetrādimṛttikā || 27|| kuṃkumaṃvāpikāmṛdvai pāvanī hariṇīsamā | bilvapippalatulasīvaṭāmalakyudambarāḥ || 28|| devavṛkṣāstadadhobhūḥ pavitrā tilakārhaṇā | nagāgrasthā saritsaṃsthā jalāntaḥsthā ca sindhujā || 29|| valmīkasthā mandirasthā kṣetrasthā bhūmigarbhagā | devasnānajalaiḥ siktāraṇyasthā vṛṣṭivāhitā || 1.115.3 0 || mṛttikā sarvatīrthānāṃ dhāmnāṃ purīvanādijā | haryavatārodbhavabhūrbhagavadvāsayoginī || 31 || pāvanī ca tayā kāryamūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ sumokṣadam | kṛṣṇaṃ nu śāntidaṃ raktaṃ vaśyakṛnmokṣadaṃ sitam || 32 || pītaṃ lakṣmīpradaṃ proktaṃ dhūsaraṃ śrīvināśakam | vicchinnaṃ vā bahusthūlaṃ vakraṃ tiryagadarśanam |||33 || tathāsamāntarālaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ vā viṣamāntaram | hrasvadīrghādirekhaṃ ca sthūlasūkṣmādirekhakam ||34||| prāntalagnāntaravyāsaṃ vicchinnamūlakaṃ tathā | ardhaṃ tryardhaṃ lambamānaṃ śuṣkaṃ nisteja ātatam ||35|| kudṛśyaṃ vartulaṃ cordhvapuṃḍraṃ hānikaraṃ smṛtam| nāsāmūlaṃ samārabhya bhruvoḥ saṃlagnake tu vai ||36|| dve rekhe’ṅgulavistāre ākeśaprāntake gate | nāsāmūle nimnabhāge dvitīyācandravadyuje ||37|| sampadyetordhvapuṃḍraṃ tad brahmadhāmapradāyakam | lalāṭe tu parabrahma lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ hṛdi ||38|| dakṣe bāhau vāsudevaṃ vāme naranarāyaṇau | smṛtvā viṣṇujaladrāvairdravyaiḥ kāryāṇi sarvadā ||39|| nārāyaṇaṃ samudare govindaṃ kaṇṭhakarkaṭe | viṣṇuṃ vai dakṣiṇe pārśve vāmanaṃ vāmapārśvake ||1.115.40 || trivikramaṃ kaṃdhare tu smṛtvā dāmodaraṃ trike | pṛṣṭhe smṛtvā padmanābhaṃ vāsudevaṃ tu mūrdhani ||41 || evaṃ dvādaśapuṃḍrāṇi mahābhāgavataścaret | lalāṭe bhujayugme ca trike kaṇṭhe ca pṛṣṭhake ||42|| caturaṃgulakaṃ mānaṃ pārśvayostu daśāṃgulam | kaṃdhare mūrdhnyudare vakṣasyaṣṭāṃgulaṃ kriyāt ||43|| sabījaṃ sāntarālaṃ tu śriyāḥ kuṃkumacandrayuk | kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu catvāri lalāṭe bhujayorhṛdi ||44|| viśāṃ bhāle hṛdye dve bhālaikaṃ śūdrayoṣitoḥ | girije tava bhaktānāmaśvatthadalasadṛśam ||45|| mama śaṃbhostu bhaktānāṃ padmakuḍmalasadṛśam | gaṇeśādiprabhaktānāṃ veṇupatrādisadṛśam ||46|| harerbhāgavatānāṃ tad ūrdhvaṃ haripadākṛti | kiraṇākāramūrdhvaṃ tu puṇḍraṃ mokṣakaraṃ sadā ||47|| madhye haridrākuṃkumabindurlakṣmīnivāsabhūḥ | bhālamadhye rekhayoraspṛṣṭo ghaṭṭasamastaraḥ ||48|| hāridraḥ kauṃkumo binduścandravacchrīpradaḥ sadā | bindūrdhvapuṇḍrakau bodhyau lakṣmīnārāyaṇau sadā ||49|| bhāle hṛdi tathā bāhvoryasya tasya jayaḥ sadā | tacchūnyasya pare cātrānupadaṃ tu parājayaḥ ||1.115.50 || iti te kathito gauri | hyūrdhvapuṃḍrādinirṇayaḥ | nārāyaṇena mahyaṃ yaḥ kathitaḥ sarvathā śubhaḥ ||51|| brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ devīdevatapasvinām | bhaktā ye svairiṇo bhāvyā maniṣyante tu narmavat ||52|| te tu nārīsamānāsyāḥ kabarīkeśaveṣiṇaḥ | bhaviṣyanti pumāṃso’pi nārīśrāṃgārikakriyāḥ |||53|| nārīvadvastradhartāro nārībhāvasvadarśakāḥ | nāryo narādiveṣasthā nararūpasvadarśikāḥ ||54|| svasvadharmādihīnāḥ syuḥ svasvamokṣasya ghātakāḥ | acihnāste vicihnā vai yāsyanti narakānmuhuḥ ||55|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ūrdhvapuṃḍrādimāhātmyanirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 115||
<1.116> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tataḥ śaṃbhurmantramāhātmyamuttamam | pārvatīṃ prāha sarvārthaṃ sabījaṃ ca savistaram || 1 || avaiṣṇavopadiṣṭena mantreṇa naiva siddhyati | mokṣo vā kāryamevāpi tasmādvaiṣṇavamāśrayet || 2 || vaiṣṇavācāryadatto vai mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ | guruṃ tu vaiṣṇavaṃ kuryānnāvaiṣṇavaṃ kadācana || 3 || vaiṣṇavasya guroryogācchuddhā bhavanti mānavāḥ | baiṣṇavastu guruḥ prokto nārāyaṇasvarūpakaḥ || 4 || nārāyaṇasamo devo gururvai tārayejjanān | gururnārāyaṇaḥ sākṣānmantrado mokṣadastathā || 5 na vai nārāyaṇānnyūno nārāyaṇasukhapradaḥ | nārāyaṇasamo dehe nārāyaṇasamo guṇe || 6 || nārāyaṇasamo mokṣe nārāyaṇa ivārthadaḥ | tasmādvaiṣṇavamūrdhanyādgurorgrāhyaḥ sumantrakaḥ || 7 || sahasraśākhādhyāyī ca sarvayajñādhikāravān | viprādijanmavām̐ścāpi na guruḥ syādavaiṣṇavaḥ || 8 || gurumāśritya mantrārthaḥ samyag jñātavya eva ca | śaṃkhacakrādicihnāktaḥ kṛtordhvapuṃḍracaṃdrakaḥ || 9 || kaṇṭhasthatulasīmālo mantrārthaṃ cintayed budhaḥ | nyāsaścāṣṭākṣaro mantro brahmāhaṃ vrahmabhakto’smi || 1.116.10|| anye’pi vaiṣṇavā mantrā lakṣmīnārāyaṇā dayaḥ | nyāso mantro mantrarūpaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ paraṃ matam || 1 1|| tadanye vaiṣṇavā mantrāstārakāḥ santi dehinām | nyāsārthe tu parijñāte jñātavyārtho na śiṣyate || 12|| tasmācchṛṇu mahādevi mantraratnārthameva ca | brahmāhaṃ brahmabhakto’smi tatra catuṣpadāni vai || 13|| brahatvād bṛṃhaṇatvācca vyāpakaṃ brahma cocyate | tadvai brahma bhaved dvedhā sākāraṃ ca nirākṛti || 14|| sākāraṃ mūrtimatsevādharmavaddhāmni saṃsthitam | sevaka cākṣaraṃ brahmā vartate pārṣadā yathā || 15|| kadācinmama muktākhyaṃ kadācicchrīsvarūpakam | nararūpaṃ kadācittu kadācit siṃhamāsanam || 16|| tasya dharmo’nanyasevā pātivratyena sevanam | sevādharmo brahmadharmo tadvad brahmasumūrtikam || 17|| dvitīyaṃ tu nirākāraṃ brahmalokaḥ sa ucyate | akṣaraṃ dhāma cetyuktaṃ śrīharervyomadhāma tat || 18|| atitejomayaṃ śāntaṃ ramyamāhlādasaukhyadam | tejomayaḥ pradeśaḥ sa vyāpakaṃ dhāma cocyate || 19|| parabrahmanivāsāya muktānāṃ vāsahetave | sarvadā śāśvataṃ rūpaṃ vartate divyabhūstaraḥ ||1.116.20|| saccidānandatattvaṃ tat cidākāśākhyameva vai | tatra divyo hariḥ sākṣātpuruṣottamasaṃjñakaḥ ||21|| vasatyeva pare dhāmbi cākṣarākhye sukhāśraye | tasya dhāmno bhavatyeva dharmo nirlepitātmakaḥ || 22|| māyātattveṣu sarveṣu vyāpakaṃ cāpyalepi tat | māyādharmairna lepo’sti tasmādalepi kīrtyate |||23||| ityevaṃ dvividhau dharmau sevā nirlepatā tathā | sevakaścāpi nirlepo brahmaśabdārtha ucyate||| ahaṃśabdaḥ śarīryarthamātmānaṃ bodhayatyapi | viśeṣadehamāpannaścetanaścāhamucyate ||25|| mumukṣustādṛśo hyātmā dehabhinnastadāśritaḥ | ahaṃpadena boddhavyo nāmarūpopalakṣitaḥ ||26|| puṃstrīśārīraātmāhaṃ nirlepaḥ sevakastava | iti brahmāhamityasya tātparyortho’vadhāryatām ||27|| brahmabhaktapade vrahma parabrahmapada pareśvaraḥ | paramātmākṣaraparaḥ puruṣottama ucyate |||28|| tasya vai vividhā bhaktiḥ pātivratyasamāhvayā | tadāśrayaḥ sadā bhaktaḥ prapannaḥ śaraṇāgataḥ ||29|| bhaktiḥ prapattiḥ śaraṇāgatiḥ ṣaḍrūpadhāriṇī | viśvāso varaṇaṃ nyāsaḥ kārpaṇyaṃ ca sthirā matiḥ ||1.116.3 0|| anuvṛttiśca bodhyā sā ṣaḍvidhā śaraṇāgatiḥ | patnī dehaḥ patiścātmā tayoraikyena vartanam ||3 1|| pātivratyaṃ bhaveddharmaḥ sā bhaktiḥ patisevanam | śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ tasya smaraṇaṃ pādasevanam ||32|| arcanaṃ vandanaṃ dāsyaṃ sakhyamātmanivedanam | iti bhaktiḥ premapūrvā sevā vai svāmisevanam |||3 3|| nipatya pādayostasya yatkarotu kuruṣva me | ityarpaṇaṃ sarvathā sā prapattiḥ prāṇanārpaṇam ||34|| vyāpyādhīnāsamarthādidharmī yo’haṃpadāśrayaḥ | so’haṃ patyuḥ svāminaśca prāṇapriyasya sevanam || 35|| kāromītyeva traikālābādhyasevāśrayo’bhavam | samaṣṭyarthastu brahmāhaṃ brahmabhakto’smi mantrajaḥ || 36 || vyāpyādhīnāsamarthādidharmyahaṃ sevako hareḥ | nirlepaḥ san pātivratyaśravaṇādikabhaktimān || 37|| śāśvatikapadāvāso’bhavamityartha īritaḥ | enaṃ vai mantraratnārthaṃ vāraṃ vāraṃ vicārya ca ||38|| brahmānande sumagnena bhāvyaṃ bhakte na sarvathā | nārāyaṇaṃ vinā naiva sukhado mokṣado’paraḥ || 3 9|| tasmāt tatraiva sarvasvaṃ sthāpyaṃ cārpyaṃ samantataḥ | mantrādau brahmaṇo nāma niyojyaṃ omiti dhruvam ||1.116.40 || akārokāramavarṇā vedāstrayastu vai khalu | akāreṇa svayaṃ viṣṇurukāreṇocyate’bdhijā ||41 || makāreṇa tayorbhakta omititraya eva te | akāro vāsudevaḥ syādukāraḥ śrīprabodhakṛt ||42|| makāreṇa tayordāsa omityeva trayo matāḥ | akārastu parabrahma ukāro brahma kathyate ||43 || makāreṇa tayorbhaktaḥ sevādāsa iti smṛtaḥ | bhāskarasya prabhevāsti nityaṃ tato’napāyinī ||44|| lakṣmīrnārāyaṇatanuḥ patnī viṣṇormanoramā | jagatāmīśvarī nityā mātā jagadvidhāriṇī ||45|| jñāno jñānaguṇo jñānāśrayaḥ sūkṣmo hṛdisthitaḥ | cetanānandasandohāśraya ātmā hyahaṃ mataḥ ||46|| śeṣabhūto dāsabhūto bhaktaḥ śrīmaddharermataḥ | svasvatvaṃ tu harau nyasya tadāyattātmajīvanaḥ ||47|| nārāyaṇasya sāmarthyānnālabhyaṃ cātmano bhavet | narāṇāṃ tu samūho vai nārā ātmāna eva te ||48 || tatrāyanaṃ bhavedasya tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | sarvacidacitattveṣu vyāpakaḥ śrīharistu saḥ ||49 || narājjātaṃ jalaṃ nāraṃ tatrāyanānnarāyaṇaḥ | narāṇāṃ tragatāṃ yatra pralaye’yanamucyate ||1.116.5 0 || tasmānnārāyaṇo devaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ | yatra sarvaṃ yataḥ sarvaṃ yaśca sarvaṃ narāyaṇaḥ |||51||| anantacakṣuścaraṇo’nantaśīrṣāmṛtādhipaḥ | hiraṇyagarbho viṣṇurvai bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhuḥ ||52|| brahmasṛṣṭāvīśasṛṣṭau jīvasṛṣṭāvapi sthitaḥ | tripālloke hyekapāda vyāpya tiṣṭhati yo hariḥ |||53|| parabrahmākṣaraṃbrahma vāsudevo hiraṇmayaḥ | vairājo viṣṇurīśeśo yajño vai savitā śivaḥ ||54|| sa ca vai sarvataspṛtvā bhūmimāvṛtya tiṣṭhati | dityadityau tato jāte ye ke cobhayatodataḥ |||55||| grāmyāraṇyāstato jātāḥ sādhyāśca ṛṣayaśca ye | yajñasūtrāstathāsūtrāstata evāgnayastathā ||56|| kṛtāḥ paridhayastenānakhacūḍāmayaṃ jagat | diśāṃpālāstathā lokālokapālāstato’pi hi ||57|| jāyante ca tastasmim̐stasya bhakto bhavāmyaham | ityarthaṃṃ parivijñāya siddhiṃ vindati sevakaḥ ||58|| bhaktabhūtaṃ dāsabhūtaṃ dehabhūtaṃ sadā jagat | bhajanīyaṃ sevanīyaṃ dehinaṃ taṃ samāśrayet ||59|| athānyamantrasatyārtharahasyaṃ śṛṇu sundari | lakṣmaṃ mohakaraṃ cihnaṃ pārāvārakṛpā tu sā ||1.116.60 || tayā yuktā mahāśaktiḥ sā vai lakṣmīrudāhṛtā | nārāyaṇastayā yukto lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||6 1 || śrīḥ proktā divya sampattiḥ sā yasyāstīti sa prabhuḥ | śrīmannārāyaṇaḥ proktastatkṛpā sampadāmpradā ||62|| avyāhataṃ svamaiśvaryaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ cāṣṭadhāpi ca | sarvajñātā nityatṛptiḥ saphalecchāhanākṛtiḥ ||6 3|| nityānando niyāmakateti ṣaṭ santi tatra vai | āhatapāpmatāśokatāvijighatsatā tathā ||64|| tathāpipāsatā caiva vijaratvaṃ vimṛtyutā | satyasaṃkalpatā satyakāmatetiguṇāṣṭakam ||65|| yatrāsti sa svayaṃ svāmī nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ | naṃ brahmacaryaṃ rāti yo naro nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||66|| harati bhaktaduḥkhāni harinārāyaṇaḥ sa hi | māyāṃ nikṛṣya nayate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sa hi ||67|| vasati dīvyati cāntaryāmī yaśca prakāśakaḥ | vāsudevaḥ sa vai nārāyaṇaḥ śreyaskaraḥ prabhuḥ ||68|| ramante yogino yatra rāmanārāyaṇaḥ sa hi | omityuktaḥ parabrahma śrīrityuktā haripriyā ||69|| tābhyāṃ yukto narasaṃghastatrāntaryāmitā hareḥ | aiśvaryaṃ ca tathā vīryaṃ yaśo lakṣmīśca vijñatā ||1.116.70 || vairāgyaṃ ceti ṣaṣṇāṃ vai bhagasaṃjñā prakīrtitā | tadvate vāsudevāya nama utkṛṣṭavān bhava ||7 1 || jñānaśaktibalaiśvaryavīryatejāṃsi yatra ca | santyayaṃ bhagavān śrīmān parabrahmaparātparaḥ |72||| ātmāyanāya jānāmi dhyāyāmyantaḥsthitaṃ harim| vyāpakaḥ sa prabhustvasmānmokṣakārye pravartayet ||73 || gāyatrīmantramityarthaṃ jñātvā yo bhajate harim | tasya muktiḥ sadā devi hastamadhye kṛtāspadā || śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ me’sti prapattirarthasaṃbhṛtā ||74|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vaiṣṇavagurupradattavividhaśaraṇāgatimantrāṇāmarthapradarśananāmā ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 16||
<1.117> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca pārvatī prāha deveśaṃ vaiṣṇavāgryaṃ maheśvaram | nātha brūhi yathā nārāyaṇarūpasya gauravam || 1 || muktidaṃ cāmṛtaṃ pītvā na vai tṛpyati mānasam | kathametāvatā dīrghakālenāpi na bodhitam || 2 || etatta parama śrāvyaṃ parabrahmāmṛtāmṛtam | śravaṇīyaṃ mayā nityaṃ nūtanaṃ tu śrave śrave || 3 || śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā devīṃ pārvatīṃ parameśvarīm | śṛṇu devi mamāpyeṣā nārāyaṇamayī kathā || 8 || nūtanā surasā bhāti tadāhlādo vivardhate | yathāsmaryaṃ kathayāmi hyavāṅgocaramastyapi || 5 || parabrahma svayaṃ sākṣāddivyo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | rājate sarvadā dhāmni svayaṃ rājādhirājakaḥ || 6 || anantaśīrṣā puruṣaścānantākṣo’pyasaṃkhyapāt | sa sṛṣṭiṃ sarvataspṛtvāpyatiṣṭhatkeśamātrake || 7 || sa vai sarvatra saṃbhāti mokṣeśāno’tiṛddhimān | nānyo’to’sti paraḥ kaścinna samo nāpi dāyabhāg || 8 || pratallokacaturthāṃśe sarvā jīveśasṛṣṭayaḥ | vyaṃśastu brahmaloko’tra brāhmaṇā vyomni vai pare || 9 || nāsti tatra vijighatsā no pipāsā pravartate | kṣutpipāsāśrayā māyā tadadhastādvikāsate || 1.117.10 || tasya dhāmni ca dhāmāni paramāṇi bhavanti vai | muktānāṃ ceśvarāṇāṃ cāvatārāṇāṃ manāṃsi saḥ || 1 1|| svasmin vai dhārayan divyo deva eko virājate | evaṃ bṛhatsvarūpo’yaṃ brahmaṇā saharājate || 12|| anantakoṭimuktaiśca pārṣadaiḥ parisevitaḥ | īśvarībhistathā śrībhiḥ śaktibhiścātisevitaḥ || 13|| niḥsīmadivyabhogāḍhyadivyamaṃgalarūpavān | yuvācyutamahāsattvaḥ sukumārāṃgakomalaḥ || 14|| jagajjananīśrīpūrṇajyotsnāmūrtikayauvanaḥ | koṭikandarpalāvaṇyākṣayapremaprapūritaḥ || 19|| śriyaḥ saṃkalpasiddhyarthaṃ vaikuṇṭhakṛtamaṇḍalaḥ | rādhāyai sukhadānārthaṃ goloke śyāmalaḥ sthitaḥ || 16|| muktasaukhyapradaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ brahma sadā matam | bhogārthaṃ parame vyomni vaikuṇṭhaṃ dhenulokakam || 17|| līlārthaṃ bhaktavāsārthaṃ trisṛṣṭamakhilaṃ jagat | sukhabhogapralīlākhyā bhūmikāstā vibhūtayaḥ || 18|| tisro bhavanti tasyaiva vibhūtitrayameva tat | līlākhyā sakalā sṛṣṭirbhogārthaṃ dhāma taddvayam || 19|| muktasaukhyapradānārthaṃ paramaṃ dhāma cāsthitam | yadā līlāṃ mahāsṛṣṭiṃ saṃharate janārdanaḥ ||1.117.20 || tadā bhogavibhūtau vai nityā sthitistu vidyate | tato’pyanyā mahānandā parā mūrtimayī sthitiḥ ||2 1|| līlā bhogastathā saukhyaṃ trayaṃ tasyaiva śaktayaḥ | tripāt tatparamaṃ dhāma nityaṃ śāśvatamaiśvaram |||22|| tasyaiva prāntabhāgeṣu dhāmānyanyāni nityadā | tāni sarvatra bhaktānāṃ sevābhogārthamātanot |||22||| amṛtaṃ dhāma badarīdhāmāvyākṛtamityapi | lakṣmīdhāma śvetadhāma sevābhogārthamātanot |||24|| taporthaṃ cāpi vyatanollokarakṣaṇahetave | tripāttattu śāśvataṃ vai pādamekamaśāśvatam ||25|| acyutaṃ brahmarūpāḍhyaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca gavāṃsthalam | amṛtaṃ śrīpuraṃ ceti rādhikāyāḥ śriyastathā ||26|| anyāsāṃ prabhupatnīnāṃ krīḍārthāni kṛtāni vai | bhagavānśrīharistatra nityaṃ yauvanamāśritaḥ ||27|| nityaiṣā ca jaganmātā lakṣmīśca rādhikā tathā | yathā sarvagato viṣṇustathā lakṣmīśca rādhikā |||28||| īśāno bhūtabhavyasya tatheśānī maheśvarī | śrīśca lakṣmīśca rādhā ca viṣṇoścaivānapāyinī |||29||| sarvatohastacaraṇā sarvato’kṣiśiromukhā | nārāyaṇī ca kṛṣṇā ca viṣṇupatnī jaganmayī ||1.117.3 0|| mahāmāyā jagatkartrī sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāriṇī | yadapāṃgasthitaṃ sarvaṃ jaḍacetanamiśraṇam |||3 1 || meṣonmeṣakṛtaṃ yasyā layodbhavamayaṃ jagat | nityājā vāmabhāgā mā mahālakṣmīḥ pareśvarī ||32|| avyaktā vyaktarūpā sā samavyāpyā vyavasthitā | pṛthvyāṃ rasā sudhā svarge puṇyā sā pitṛmandire ||3 2 || jale miṣṭānale pākā lakṣmīśca dhanarūpiṇī | saundaryaṃ kāntisaubhāgye rūpaṃ lāvaṇyamityapi ||34|| nārīṇāmakhilaṃ sarvaṃ tasyā evāsti saṃgatam | tayā brahmapadaṃ śaivaṃ māhendraṃ yāmyamityapi ||35|| sauryaṃ kauberamāgneyaṃ cāndraṃ dṛṣṭaṃ samṛddhimat | mahāmāyā mahālakṣmīrlakṣmīḥ śrīḥ rādhikā priyā ||26|| kamalā śāradā padmā vidyā mā paramā ramā | abdhiputrī satī śyāmā mahādevī ca vaiṣṇavī || 357|| nārāyaṇī mahāvidyā viṣṇupatnī maheśvarī | gaurī sarasvatī śāntiḥ prabhā svāhā svadhā ratiḥ ||38|| sāvitrī kaṃbharādevī pārvatīti dviṣoḍaśa | nāmānyasyāḥ pratiprātaḥ pāṭhyāni bhūtilabdhaye || 39|| hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīṃ hiraṇyarajatātmikām | cāndrīṃ svarṇamayīṃ lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇo ma āvaha ||1.117.40 || dhanāṃ dhānyāṃ gosvarūpāṃ vāhanīṃ puruṣātmikām | nārāyaṇo ma āvaha lakṣmīmanapagāminīm ||41|| tṛptiṃ tejasvinīṃ svarṇaprākārāṃ bhāsvarāṃ śriyam | daivīṃ varcasvinīṃ vārkṣīṃ kīrtiṃ kṛṣṇo ma āvaha ||42|| sugandhāḍhyāmanādhṛṣyāṃ nityapuṣṭāṃ karīṣiṇīm | sarveśvarīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇo ma āvaha ||43 || ākūticitisaṃkalpasiddhiṃ harirma āvaha | hiraṇyadāsadāsīdāṃ tāmihopahvaye śriyam || 44|| yairevaṃ prastutā lakṣmīsteṣāmanapagāminī | harervakṣasi nityāptā sa hariḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||45 || sarveśvaraḥ sarvasvāmī nārāyaṇo guṇākaraḥ | sarvajñaḥ sarvaśaktyāḍhyaḥ pūrṇakāmaḥ suhṛtsukhī ||46 || karuṇāsāgaraḥ śrīmān śaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ | svargāpavargavibhavastasya dāsyaṃ karomyaham ||47|| sarvadā sarvathā sarvāvasthāsu taṃ bhajāmyaham | dāsyaṃ tasya karomyeva dāsabhūtamidaṃ hareḥ ||48|| śrīmān nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī sevyaḥ prāpyaḥ paro’kṣarāt | sa eva jananī bhrātā pitā putraśca bāndhavaḥ ||49|| śaraṇaṃ cāśrayo vāso gatirnidhanameva saḥ | sarvadivyaguṇairyukto māyāguṇādivarjitaḥ ||1.117.50 || nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃbrahma tattvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ | nārāyaṇaḥ parojyotirātmā nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ ||51|| nārāyaṇaparo dhyātā dhyānaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ | yacca kiṃcijjagatsarvaṃ dṛśyate śrūyate’pi vā ||52|| antarbahiśca tatsarvaṃ vyāpya nārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ | hṛdye jīvamadhye sa paramātmā vyavasthitaḥ |||53|| sa vai tatra pare dhāmni śrīyuṅnārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ | tasya śaktyā śriyā mūlaprakṛtyā racitaṃ mahat ||54|| tato virāḍabhūdbhūmirgrāmyāraṇyāśca jīvinaḥ | yadāsyabāhūrupādā varṇā vai saṃbhavanti hi ||55|| praviprakṣatraviḍḍāsā hyajāyanta makho hi saḥ | havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca hotā ca bhāgabhuk samidhaśca saḥ ||56|| yajñaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devā ayajanta ca tāḥ kriyāḥ | prāgevāsan pare dharmā ārādhanādibhaktayaḥ ||57|| pūrve muktāḥ pare dhāmni mahimānaṃ sacanta vai | taddāsabhaktikartāro yānti nārāyaṇaṃ padam ||58|| te vai divyā sadā siddhā muktā vasanti dhāmani | māyāpāre pare loke brahmasādharmyamāsthitāḥ ||59|| na vai māyāmahākālapāpakarmayamādibhīḥ | yadgatvā na parāvṛttistaddharerdhāma cākṣaram ||1.117.60 || māyā jaganmayī nityā triguṇā prakṛtirhi sā | avidyā yoganidrā ca pradhānāvyaktaśāśvatī ||6 1 || dhāmacchāyāsvarūpā sā jñānaghanasvarūpiṇī | lūtātantusamaṃ cāṇḍamanityaṃ prakaroti hi | tayāvṛtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ sā brahmatejasāvṛtā |||62|| māyābrahmasambandhaśca sīmā dhāmnaḥ samucyate | sarvavyāpi tvasīmaṃ tat tūpacārāt sasīmakam ||62|| māyāntare gataṃ sarvaṃ saṃkocaṃ ca vikāsanam | tiraḥprāvirbhavatyeva bhaktā gacchanti tadbahiḥ ||64|| tadā sīmni brahmahade tejaānandacetane | snātvā yānti brahmatanuṃ parajyotiḥpratāpataḥ ||65|| niṣpadyante tadātmānaḥ svena rūpeṇa mūrtayaḥ | naro vā yadi vā nārī bhaktyā yānti yadākṣaram ||66 || sīmni brahmahade snānti tanurbrāhmī svayaṃ bhavet | nānyadravyavibhūtervā yogo dehe’sti kaścana ||67|| ātmā sudṛk harirūpānurūpo dṛśyate svayam | na yogo na vibhāgo vā na yogidravyasākṛtiḥ ||68|| ekātmatattvamūrtyātmā sumūrtaḥ sa hariryathā | mahāmāyā tu virajā sā tu vaikuṇṭhagāminām ||69|| vaikuṃṭhamāyayormadhye nārāyaṇadravātmikā | dṛśyate tatra saṃsnātvā śrīryathā pārṣadā yathā ||1.117.70|| niṣpadyante dāsadāsyastathā nityā vikuṃṭhake | yantu jyotiḥparaṃ vyomākṣaraṃ brahma sanātanam ||71 || saccidānandatattvaṃ taddivyaṃ vai brahmasaṃjñitam | koṭisūryāgniromaikamajaraṃ layavarjitam ||72|| svapnādiśūnyamānandavārdhiśītalaśāntikṛt yadakṣaraṃ vedaguptaṃ niṣedurmuktakoṭayaḥ ||73|| tanna viduḥ ṛcastasya vidastatra samāsate | tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatprapaśyanti sūrayaḥ ||74|| vairājā api yallokaṃ na vai paśyanti yatpadam | yatra gāvo bhūriśṛṃgā āyatāḥ sukhadāḥ sadā ||75|| tadvai dhāma paraṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇasya gosukhāvaham | ādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastādyānti tadvidaḥ ||76|| tatra pūrve hyanādinaḥ sādhyā muktā vasanti hi | viśve viśvādgatā devā muktāḥ sacanta tatsukham ||77|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne parabrahmākṣaradhāmavibhūtilīlābrāhmītanunārāyaṇanārāyaṇīgauravaprabhṛtivarṇanaṃnāmā saptadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 117||
<1.118> śrīnārāyāṇa uvāca śaṃbhuḥ prāha tato devīṃ brahmadhāmavibhūtikāḥ | kathayiṣye samāsena śṛṇu parvataputrike || 1 || akṣaraṃ dhāma paramaṃ brahmavyoma paraṃ sadā | rājate taddhi sarvatra śvetatejomayaḥ staraḥ || 2 || yāvantastārakāḥ sarve sūryāḥ syurdivi saṃsthitāḥ | pṛthvī sṛṣṭisuyuktā ca divyakācamayī bhavet || 3 || parasparaṃ ca tadyogādyādṛśaṃ tejaudbhavet | tādṛśaṃ tu ghanaṃ tejo mahat satye tu vedhasaḥ || 4 || tādṛgvedhastarātsatyāt koṭiguṇaṃ tu taijasam | vairājaikakaṇṭhamaṇau vartate’tha tato’pi vai || 5 || koṭiguṇaṃ mahattejo mahāviṣṇoḥ śiromaṇau | tataḥ koṭiguṇaṃ tejo vāsudevasya vai maṇau || 6 || tādṛśāścāpyanantāśca maṇayo’vyākṛte stare | badaryāmamṛte śvete śrīpure ca vikuṇṭhake || 7 || goloke ceti tejāṃsi teṣāmādāya piṇḍakam | kuryāccettattvakṣarākhyadhāmnaḥ pūgīphalasthale || 8 || līnatāṃ tu samīyādvai pūrṇaṃ tatkīdṛśaṃ bhavet | tādṛśākṣaradhāmnaśca muktānāṃ tejasāṃ tathā || 9 || samūho līnatāṃ gacchecchrīharerekaromṇi yat | tadā pūrṇaharau tatra tejaḥ kīdṛgbhavenmahat || 1.118.10 || api śakyaṃ nānumātumagamyaṃ teja aiśvaram | ahantu nahi sākṣādvai draṣṭā kintu samādhinā || 1 1|| brahmāṇḍapiṇḍabrahmākhyadhāmagaṃ śrīhariṃ prabhum | ekīkṛtyātmani svasminpaśyāmyalaukikena vai || 12| tattadā sannikarṣeṇa dṛśyate’pārameva yat|| mantuṃ cintayituṃ boddhaṃ nainaṃ śakyamagocaram || 13 || kathaṃ tarhi bhavedvaktuṃ śakyaṃ cāvaihi sundari | tādṛśo’nantatejasvī tathāsīmaguṇārṇavaḥ || 14|| saundaryarūpasaumyeṣaddhāsyāpāramahodadhiḥ | koṭimuktacakorākṣisthiravṛttyekacandramāḥ || 15|| rājādhirājo bhagavān paramātmā parātparaḥ | virājate mahāsiṃhāsane ṣoḍaśahāyanaḥ || 16|| rūpānurūpāvayavo mandahāsyalasanmukhaḥ | koṭikoṭyarkacandrāgnilīnamāṇikyakuṇḍalaḥ || 17|| asaṃkhyamaṇiratnādinaddhakirīṭakalgikaḥ | divyahīrakasadratnāmūlyahāṭakahāradhṛk || 18|| yāvattejaḥkhanivrātikaustubhaujjvalakaṇṭhakaḥ | naikatejaḥprasaratsatkiraṇodbhavamaṇḍakaḥ || 19|| divyaprakāśasaṃrājanmadhyabhālasubhāsvaraḥ | meghaghaṭṭasadānīlaklṛptakesarakuntalaḥ ||1.118.20|| naikakāmakṛtavakradhanuḥprāntabhruvānvita | svarṇasūkṣmanimeṣāḍhyapuṭaromālinetrakaḥ ||21|| divyaśvetasphaṭikāgryasatkoṇanetragolakaḥ | raktasūkṣmasukiñjalkabhāsavatpārśvanāyanaḥ |||22|| madhyadivyaghaṭṭarūpasphurattejasvikṛṣṇikaḥ | tatrāpi grāhyasāmarthyasphuratkṛṣṇakanīnikaḥ |||23 || śaratsarojapatrābhākarṇāntavyāsanetrakaḥ | komalasaptavalayaśaṣkulīpītakarṇaka ||24|| divyapuraṭasatphullacampakaśṛṃgalāśravāḥ | golaphullāḍhyakārpāsapiṇḍakomalagaṇḍakaḥ ||25||| tilapuṣpapiśaṃgadvipuṭanatāntanāsikaḥ| sūkṣmasvarṇatantukalparekhārājitaśmaśrukaḥ || 26 || madhyāgrāṇikavakrāntadhanūrekhottarauṣṭhakaḥ | premapātrasarinmūrtikāmasthānādharauṣṭhakaḥ ||27|| raktasthalābjapatrābharasasetūbhayauṣṭhakaḥ | abahiracipīṭāgranimnasughaṭacībukaḥ || 28|| kundaśubhrasutīkṣṇāgryāviralasthiradantakaḥ | raktarasāḍhyadāḍimabījacaṃcaddaṃtasthaliḥ ||2|| svarṇamukhyamaṇiprāptaśaṃkhatulyakṛkāṭikaḥ | merumūlasamasthūlāraṃbhadyudharakandharaḥ ||1.118.3 0 || yugacandrakalāvyastāskandhādhiṣṭhitajatrukaḥ | tattvapūrabalābaddhonnataskandhasupuṣṭakaḥ || 31 || yogidhyānasadāyogyaromadrukukṣikandaraḥ || śeṣabhogasamākārasvarṇapuṣṭasubāhukaḥ || 32 citsupuṣṭalasadraktakaṃcanābhobhasadbhujaḥ | dhruvacakrabhramibindusthirakīlakaphoṇikaḥ ||3 3 || kramavṛttapuṣṭatanusughaṭobhayahastakaḥ | dhṛtakārtasvarasaumyaśṛṃkhalākaṭakāṃgadaḥ || 34|| ratnahīrakamaṇyāḍhyormikābhūṣāñcitāṃguliḥ | nakhacandrasphuratkāntidyotisadbhaktamaṇḍalaḥ || 35|| supeśalasuraṃgāḍhyamakhamallāṃgarakṣakaḥ | svarṇaprāntakṛtaśobhottarīyābhyanvitāṃsakaḥ || 36|| divyarājatsvarṇarekhaśrīvatsoraḥsulāṃchanaḥ | saptaviṃśatisrakklṛptasvarṇamaṇyāḍhyamekhalaḥ || 37|| brahmakūpasamānābhiprasarattrivalodaraḥ | kramavṛttakariśūṇḍhojjvalakāmāḍhyasakthikaḥ ||38 || karikuṃbharacanārhapuṣṭagaddikaśroṇikaḥ | aṣṭasiddhyakṣayavīryasamavartulaliṅgakaḥ || 39|| yuvatīvrātamadhvatyānandarasaratipradaḥ | svarṇaromāvalīrājatsvarṇavarṇapaṭodaraḥ | samavartulaśobhāḍhya kaṭhinojjvalajānukaḥ ||1.118.40 || puṣṭatanunālīpaścimāsthitārhasujaṃghakaḥ | antarekabahiḥsattrighūṭikāmaṇibandhanaḥ ||4 1 || upamuktikṛtanimno’dhodhanurdaṇḍavakrapat | svarṇaraktanakhakānticandrasacchaviśobhanaḥ ||42|| puṣṭipṛṣṭhaḥ svastiguptaścottamottamamūrtikaḥ | virājate mahādhāmni hariḥ siṃhāsanasthitaḥ ||43 || sarvaiśvaryakriyāśaktijñānayogādibhiryutaḥ | siṃhāsanaṃ catuṣpādaṃ pauraṭaṃ ca suśobhitam ||44|| saptasopānakaṃ cāste kammānikābhitolitam | makhamallamahāgaddīpārśvatakkīyarājitam |||45||| upari saṃdhṛtaṃ chatraṃ śalākāviṃśativṛtam | pauraṭaṃ komalaṃ divyaṃ vastraṃ chatre niyojitam ||46|| svarṇanirmitakalaśaṃ ratnādyañcitadaṇḍakam | parito maṇayo baddhāḥ svarṇakiṃkaṇikāstathā ||47|| samantataḥ saptarūpidivyajhallarikāyutam | cāmare tadbhave śvete vyajano darpaṇastathā ||48|| divyā muktāstathā santi sevādharmasusaṃsthitāḥ | chatroparimahāmuktaḥ sahasraphaṇarājitaḥ ||49|| mahadrūpaṃ phaṇī dhṛtvā phaṇābhiḥ kṛdvitānakaḥ | sevate śrīhariṃ paścāttiṣṭhandhāmanibho mahān ||1.118.50|| tatra siṃhāsane paścādbhāge divyamahāpaṭaḥ | svarṇatantumayo muktaścitraraṃgādisevanaḥ |||51||| kamalākāramagryaṃ yatstaṃbhā divyāstathā sthitāḥ | muktānāṃ ca maṇīnāṃ ca maṇḍalāni ca teṣu vai ||52|| saccidānandarūpāśca śukasārasamenakāḥ | vṛkṣavallyādayastatra staṃbheṣu kṛtasusthalāḥ ||53|| śobhante cetanāḥ sarve parabrahmaprasaṃginaḥ | citraśilpakalāramyaṃ pīṭhikākomalāstaram ||54|| tejovārdhiriva dṛśyaṃ ratnakoṭivirājitam | nakhacandramaṇikāntidyotitānantamuktakam ||55|| siṃhāsanaṃ svayamakṣarākhyaṃ dhāma na cetarat | tatra mūrtau mahātejaḥparidhirvartulo mahān |||56|| miṣṭaśaityasaumyatejo’nantagovyāptapārśvakaḥ | saptarūpaḥ saptabhūmiḥ paridhiḥ sopi muktakaḥ ||57||| daśadikṣu harestejo mahāsiṃhāsane’bhitaḥ | vyāpnotyeva na cānto’sti gāvastā bhūriśṛṃgikāḥ ||58|| yatra siṃhāsane tadvai maṇḍapaḥ samayojanaḥ | tatra divyamahāstaṃbhā hyakṣarāḥ kadalīkṛtāḥ ||59|| haridvarṇā haritpatrā haritkadalamaṃgalāḥ | śatastaṃbhāḥ svarṇavarṇā vastraveṣṭitaśobhanāḥ ||1.118.60|| teṣāṃ kammānikāḥ śilpakalāvyāptivicitritāḥ | nānāvidhā gajāḥ śvetāḥ makarā haṃsasārasāḥ ||61 || menāśukaśvetapārāvatacakrakacātakāḥ | sarve muktā bhavantyeva saccidānandavigrahāḥ |||62|| divyasusvaramādhuryakṛtagītikamaṃgalāḥ | tatratyasaṃskṛtavāṇyā gāyanti guṇakīrtanam ||63|| naikakoṭimahāmuktamaṇḍalāni tu maṇḍape | pratiṣṭhanti sthale bhūmau madhye copari cāntare ||64|| sṛṣṭisṛṣṭyantare yāni rūpāṇi saṃdhṛtāni vai | hariṇā tāni sarvāṇi maṇḍape sthāpitāni hi ||65|| śobhante vividhākārā vividhaiśvaryacihnakāḥ | tattajjanmāvatārādicaritrodbodhahetayaḥ ||66|| vṛttāntabodhakākārā bhagavanto vibhūtayaḥ | sarve tiṣṭhanti tatraiva maṇḍapāgrordhvamadhyataḥ ||67|| tatratyā muktamūrdhanyāḥ sūryacandrādidarpaṇāḥ | bhūtvā bhūtvā teṣu teṣu staṃbheṣu saṃvasanti vai ||68|| ullecastatpramāṇāḍhyo yatra muktātmatārakāḥ | lagnāḥ samyakprakāśante śītakāntipravartakāḥ ||69|| muktāśca toraṇāstatra maṇihīrakarūpakāḥ | kācakāntikarā naikadivyadīpakacandrakāḥ ||1.118.70 || ūrdhvamadhastathā pārśve dikṣu sarvavidikṣu ca | maṇḍapāt kiraṇā yānti projjvalā vyomamārgagāḥ ||7 1 || tādṛśo maṇḍapastādṛk siṃhāsanamathāpi vā | nānyadhāmasu vidyete kā varṇyā taccamatkṛtiḥ |||72|| śobhā divyāpi nānyatra na varṇyā jāyate mayā | maṇḍapopariprāsādaḥ śrīharestaṃ śṛṇu priye ||73|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne’kṣaradhāmasthaparabrahmatatsiṃhāsanatanmaṇḍapavarṇananāmāṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 18||
<1.119> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śaṃbhuḥ prāha punardevīṃ śrīharermaṇḍapopari | prāsādaṃ śṛṇu kalyāṇi na bhūto na bhaviṣyati || 1 || lakṣayojanavistāraḥ sahasrayojanocchrayaḥ | sahasrastaṃbhapaṃktyekā sahasrapaṃktayastathā || 2 || kammānikācatuṣkīvatsarvatra protthitāḥ śubhāḥ | madhye mahān ghūmmaṭaśca dikṣu catvāra eva ca || 3 || catuṣkoṇeṣu catvāri śikharāṇi lasanti vai | śikharāṇi sapta taṃ vai ghūmmaṭaṃ dhruvametya ca || 4 || trīṇi dakṣe ca vāme’pi trīṇi madhye mahattamam | yatkolyāṃ maṇḍapastatra yadadhaḥ siṃhamāsanam || 5 || saudhopari koṣṭhalo’pi sahasrayojanocchrayaḥ | koṣṭhalopari śikharaṃ sārdhasahasrayojanam || 6 || tatra sthitā padmaśilā pañcaśatasuyojanam | tatra sthalīśilā cāste śatayojanamucchrayā || 7 || tadūrdhvaṃ divyasauvarṇakalaśāḥ śatameva ca | taduparyekakalaśī tatastadgarimo mataḥ || 8 || tai vai pañcaśatocchrāyā dhvajadaṇḍastataḥ param | sahasrayojanocchrāyo vaṃśaścāpi tathocchrayaḥ || 9 || dhvajastatrāmūlapucchaṃ pañcaśatasuyojanaḥ | saptaraṃgo dvipucchaśca koṭisūryasamojjvalaḥ || 1.119.1 0|| ta eta cetanā muktāḥ sevārtharūpadhāriṇaḥ | cihnadehāḥ sadā muktāstathā tiṣṭhanti sevane || 1 1|| śikhare sāṃkhyayoginyo yoginyo dikṣu santi vai | siṃhāścānye narasiṃhā hyavatārā bhavanti vai || 12|| gavākṣāstatra śikhare muktākṣāḥ saṃvasanti vai | puttalikāstathā cānyā muktānyaḥ saṃvasanti tāḥ || 1 3||| dhvajadaṇḍe pāṭalikā sādhvī muktā tu sā matā | ghaṇṭiṇyastāśca muktānyo divyāḥ śrīharisevikāḥ || 14|| dīpastatra mahādīpo mahāmukto na cāparaḥ | mahato’pi mahīyānvai dīpaḥ sarvottamo hi saḥ || 15|| anyeṣvapi tu śṛṃgeṣu sarve muktā vasanti vai | saudhopari ghummaṭo’pi sahasrayojanocchrayaḥ || 16|| divyo’yaṃ vai mahāsaudho vyomagastaijasaḥ svayam | yatheṣṭaśrīhareḥ kāmādgacchatyeva samantataḥ || 17|| tatrarṣīṇāṃ vimānāni kāmagāni
