viraktāḥ sarvabhogeṣu rāgadveṣavivarjitāḥ | bhaktyāhārā bhaktikāryāḥ kṛṣṇasatsaṃgamāśrayāḥ || 11 || narā nāryo’pi tapasā kṣapayantyaśubhaṃ svakam | puṇyāḥ puṇyatamāḥ sarve śvetāḥ śvetakṛtiprathāḥ || 12|| sāttvikāḥ krodhakāmādivarjitā muktibhāginaḥ | anantāste tapo’rthaṃ vai vasanti vaiṣṇavā janāḥ || 13|| teṣāṃ sandarśanārthāya teṣāṃ sannihito hariḥ | koṭicandrasame ramye nānāmaṇisuratnake || 14|| śvetadvīpe mahāyogijanaiḥ saṃsevite śubhe | nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ tvāste yogināṃ dṛśihetave || 15|| tatrodyānāni ramyāṇi viśālā vanabhūmayaḥ | saudhāḥ raivatasadṛśā nadyo devanadīsamāḥ || 16|| pārijātāmrakalpadrukalpavallyo bhavanti ca | phalapuṣpakandapatravyāptāstā bhūmayo matāḥ || 17|| caturdaśastarāṇāṃ ye ṛṣayo munayastathā | sādhvyaśca sādhavaścānye yāntyāyānti dṛśikṛte || 18|| sāntānikalatā bahvyaścandanāni bahūnyapi | saraḥsu phullapadmāni sthalapadmādayastathā || 19|| kundabakulaśṛṃgāramālatīmallikādayaḥ | tṛṇarājanāgaraṃganārīkelaphalādayaḥ |||1.128.20|| pūgīlavaṃgajāvaṃtrījīvaphalavanādayaḥ | badarīkadalījambūkarmadāmṛtajaṃbirāḥ ||21 || vaneṣu paritaḥ santi nānātoyālayāni ca | kūpāśca dīrghikāścaiva śītanirjharaṇāni ca |||22|| uṣṇakuṇḍā miṣṭakhātā vanauṣadhisujīvanāḥ | bhavanti dvīpamadhye vai dvīpaprānte’pi sarvathā |||23| āśramāḥ santi muktānāṃ tāpasānāmitastataḥ | sakuṭumbāśca ṛṣayo vasanti tatra sāttvatāḥ ||24|| darśanabhaktikāryāste vanyavastuprajīvanāḥ | divyāścandrasamā ramyāḥ saumyāścojjvalamūrtayaḥ |||25|| te vasanti śvetadhāmni tatrāsti nagarī śubhā | nāmnā airāvatī bodhyā bahuprāsādasaṃkulāḥ ||26||| divyapuṃstrībhirākrāntā ratnivimānaśobhitā | tatra vasanti bhaktā vai sakuṭumbā narāḥ striyaḥ ||27|| sarvāḥ smṛddhaya evātra saṃkalpotthā bhavanti vai | vimānāni vihārāṇi śayanāni dhanāni ca ||28|| vividhānyeva santyeva khaneryathā milanti hi | kalpavṛkṣairavāpyante tapobalavibhāvataḥ ||29||| vaikuṇṭhānnahi kiṃcidvai nyūnaṃ smṛddhau vibhūtiṣu | airāvatyāṃ satyalokavāsino munayo’pi vai ||1.128.30 || maharādivasatayaḥ svargasthā api devatāḥ | ṛṣayo bhūgatāścānye mervādikṣetrakāstathā ||3 1|| pātālagāmino daityā bhaktātmānastu ye matāḥ | teṣāṃ tatra nivāsā vai prāsādāḥ santi bhūriśaḥ |||32||| bālasūryanibhāstuṃgā vartulāḥ santi koṭiśaḥ | vimānānyabdhiyānāni jalayānāni koṭiśaḥ ||33|| samudratalayānāni mārgayānāni lakṣaśaḥ | parvatāraṇyayānāni bhavantyapi ca koṭiśaḥ ||34|| rājamārgā mahāvyāsā hastisadvājivāhanāḥ | bhavanti sarvadā divyāḥ suśobhā madasiñcitāḥ |||35|| tathāvidhāyāḥ puryāstu madhye vai maṇḍapo mahān| divyodyānasamāvṛtto maṇikāṃcananirmitaḥ ||36|| candanāgurukarpūrakuṃkumāmodagandhitaḥ | nānākusumatoraṇavitānaiḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ ||37|| divyāpsaraḥ kṛtāvāsaḥ sāmagānopaśobhitaḥ | nṛtyagītasamājotkotsavajayādināditaḥ ||38|| naisargikabhogyaśālāsahasraklṛptabhūstaraḥ | navadhābhaktisatkāryārādhanārthasubhūmikaḥ ||39|| nārāyaṇasya pūjāyāḥ sāmagrībhirbahusthalaḥ | pānabhojanamardanalepanārhakṛtagṛhaḥ ||1.128.40|| vaiṣṇavīsevanasvīkārārthakṛtagṛhāntaraḥ | svalpamapi na vaikuṇṭhānnyūno vai vastubhiśca saḥ ||41|| vimānāni tu devānāmāyānti yānti vāyunā | saṃkulo devasaṃghaiśca rājādhirājaśobhanaḥ ||42|| madhye siṃhāsanaṃ tatra nārāyaṇakṛte’sti vai | koṭisūryasamābhaṃ ca madhye padmaṃ śaśiprabham ||43|| tatra komalagaddīkapārśvatūlādi komale | svarṇavarṇe mṛdule’tra rājate tu svayaṃ hariḥ ||44|| svarṇavarṇaḥ svarṇamaṇimuktāhāravibhūṣitaḥ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmahetiyuktakarojjvalaḥ ||45|| hārakeyūrakaṭakairaṃgulīyaiḥ subhūṣitaḥ | kāṃcanojjvalayugalacaraṇābjavirājitaḥ ||46|| pūrṇacandranibhaśubhrasvalpanakhavirājitaḥ | ṣoḍaśābdavayorūpayauvanādisudarśanaḥ ||47|| kṛtordhvapuṃḍratanmadhyasugandhicandraśobhitaḥ | snigdhakabarīcaṃcadvakrakeśavirājitaḥ ||48|| dugdhaphenaśaśikāntisamasadvastraveṣṭitaḥ | muktāmaṇihīrakādinaddhakuṇḍalakarṇakaḥ ||49|| padmāsanaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā samāsīno virājate | tasya nārāyaṇaprabhorvāmāṃke divyarūpiṇī ||1.128.50 || dvādaśahāyanā lakṣmīḥ rūpe tasyaiva sadṛśī | rājate sarvasaukhyārhakṛtaśṛṃgāraśobhanā ||5 1 || padmakiṃjalkasadrūpā yauvanāvegasevitā | sarvalakṣaṇasampannā śīlaguṇagaṇāśrayā ||52 || kāṃcanatāravasanā sugandhihārarājitā | sthalapadmamālatīsatkusumāñcitamūrdhajā || 53 || caturbhujaiḥ rājamānā keyūrāṃgadabhūṣitā | muktāhāraiḥ śobhamānā mandārakṛtaśekharā || 54 || nimnanāsā kundadantā caṃcatkuṇḍalakarṇikā | kastūrīkṛtatilakā nāsādhṛtasumauktikā ||55 || sūkṣmasuvarṇakalaśaprakhyasughaṭṭasustanī | divyasugandhisaddehā puṣpamālādiśobhitā ||56 || dhṛtakamalapuṣpādiramaṇīyā manoharā | ādarśamātuluṅgasvarṇābjavasvādidhṛkkarā || 57 || nārāyaṇasya patyurvai cetasābhīṣṭakāriṇī | rājate śrīharervāmāṃkārdhabhāge sadā priyā || 58 || tatsadṛśyastathā kṛṣṇayogyāścānyāśca śaktayaḥ | virājante hi sevāyāṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ || |86 9 || īśāvāsyā mahādevī jāhnavī kamalā ramā | sāvitrī ca tathā śāntā kāntā brāhmī sarojinī || 1.128.60 || dāsyaścāpi tathā tatra prajñā medhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā | śraddhā ca dhāraṇā śāntiḥ śrutirmanīṣiṇī smṛtiḥ || 61 || vṛṣṭirvṛddhirmatirvanyāḥ śriyaḥ kaiṃkaryakārikāḥ | tato’nyāḥ koṭiśaḥ patnyaḥ santi nārāyaṇasya hi || 62 || ananto vainateyaśca ham̐saḥ karī suvaiṣṇavāḥ | anantāḥ kiṃkarāḥ santi nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ || 63 || sādhyā marudgaṇāścaiva viśvedevāśca kinnarāḥ | vidyādharāśca gandharvā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ || 64|| dāsā dāsyaśca vartante śvetadvīpe’tra dhāmani | prāsādeṣu vimāneṣu gṛheṣu nagareṣu ca || 65|| vaneṣūpavaneṣvevaṃ gṛhodyāneṣu cāmbare | prākāreṣu nikuṃjeṣu taṭeṣu taṭinīsthale || 66 || krīḍanti nityasaukhyāḍhyā heyaniṣphalavarjitāḥ | nārāyaṇakṛpālabdhadivyabhogānurañjitāḥ || 67|| nārāyaṇasamā rūpaguṇākṛtivayoṃ’ghribhiḥ | ye viṣṇumantrajaptāro viṣṇusmaraṇatatparāḥ || 68 || harivāsarakartārastatpadaṃ yānti te’vyayam | bhaktyā tvananyayā labhyo viṣṇulokaḥ sanātanaḥ || 69 || kīrtanaṃ nāmagṛṇanaṃ dhyānaṃ mantrajapo hareḥ | tarpaṇaṃ homakaraṇaṃ viṣṇorviṣṇupadapradam ||1.128.70|| tatratyā viṣṇusaṃkalpasukhādhīnasukhārthinaḥ | narā nāryaścāvasāne mahāvaikuṇṭhagāminaḥ ||71|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tṛtīyaśvetadvīpākhyavaikuṇṭhasthaṛṣimunitāpasanaranārīratnodyānairāvatīnagarīmaṇḍapavibhūtisiṃhāsanalakṣmīdāsadāsīprabhativarṇananāmāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 28||
<1.129> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu kānta tataḥ śaṃbhuḥ pārvatīṃ prāha śobhanam | kṣīrasāgarasaṃsthānaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ vai caturthakam || 1 || divaukasāṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ dugdhābdhau parameśvaraḥ | sadā śāntiparo devo nidrayā yogasaṃjñayā || 2 || svātmanyavasthito nīlāmbujavarṇo hariḥ svayam | vartate’bhyantaratale divyuvāsāya nirmite || 5 || vaikuṇṭhe vistṛte matsyakūrmāvirbhāvarājite | dugdhābdhau medinīpīṭhe nārāyaṇasya tejasā || 4 || sudarśanena cakreṇa stambhite kṣīrasustare | jātāni bhūtalānyatra dugdhadhavalabhūmikāḥ || 5 || dugdhānāmeva pakvānāṃ prākārāṇāṃ catuṣṭayam | vitānaprastaraṃ divyaṃ dugdhānāmeva nirmitam || 6 || bhittayo gopurāḥ saudhāḥ prāsādā vanarājayaḥ | mārgopamārgāḥ panthāno vṛkṣavallīvanāni ca || 7 || maṇayo bhūṣaṇānyatra vāsāṃsi bhojanāni ca | peyāni śayanānyeva yānāni vāhanāni ca || 8 || dugdhotpannāni sarvāṇi nārāyaṇasamīhayā | pradīpā maṇayastatra phalāni kṣīrajāni ca || 9 || puṣpasrakcandanādīni gandhadravyāṇi yāni ca | kajjalādīni saubhāgyadravyāṇi dugdhajāni vai || 1.129.10 || lakṣayojanavistāro maṇḍapo dugdhanirmitaḥ | dugdhasphaṭikamāṇikyamaṇiratnādinirmitaḥ || 11 || dhavalo brahmatejovat divyau brahmavibhūtivat | mahāvaikuṇṭhavat saukhya śāntido brahmalokavat || 1 2|| tatrāneke raṃgasaudhā bhaktānāṃ vāsahetave | bhavanti śrīhareḥ kāmanayā divyā suṛddhayaḥ || 1 3|| na nyūnaṃ kiṃcidatrāsti bhogyakaraṇasādhanam | tanmadhye tu sahasrāsyaḥ śeṣo’nanto vyavasthitaḥ || 14|| dhavalaḥ komalaḥ snigdha uṣṇaḥ śayyādhikāravān | śarīravalayaistatra kṛtaśayyo hareḥ kṛte || 15|| phaṇābhiśca sahasreṇa kṛtacchatro hareḥ kṛte | pucchena kṛtasopānastatrāroḍhuṃ hareḥ kṛte || 16 || phaṇāsthamaṇibhistatra kṛtadīpo hareḥ kṛte | tasminnanantaparyaṃke śete’sau kamalāpatiḥ || 17|| nūtnayuvā śyāmalaśca pītāmbaradharo hariḥ | sakeśamukuṭamūrdhā hārakaustubharājitaḥ || 18 || yajñopavītapuṃḍrābjajalabhūcakrahetimān | sagadaḥ sagaruḍaśca vanamālāvirājitaḥ || 1 9|| lakṣmīmarditacaraṇaḥ kaṭakāṃgadabhūṣitaḥ | sphuradraktāravindābhahastāṃghritalaśobhitaḥ || 1.129.2 0 || raśanāpādukormikāśṛṃkhalābhūṣaṇānvitaḥ | khaḍgacarmaśārṅgaśaktinārācaparighānvitaḥ || 21 || haricandanakuṃkumakastūryuttamapūjitaḥ | kalpamandārabakulapārijātādipuṣpavān || 22 || samonnatasunāsāṃsajānubhālavirājitaḥ | kiṃkiṇījālanupūradhṛtāṃghrinakhakāntimān || 23 || aśokapuṣparaktauṣṭhaḥ pūrṇacandranibhānanaḥ | mauktikadantasaṃśobhasmitavaktramanoharaḥ || 24|| ārūḍhayauvanāpūraḥ śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇārthinām | pariśrānta iva śete virāme iva sarvadā ||25 || daityaiḥ saha suyuddhāni kṛtvā śete punaḥpunaḥ | sadṛśī tasya lakṣmīstu rūpaśīlaguṇādibhiḥ || 26|| svarṇasadṛśasadrūpā taptakāṃcanabhūṣaṇā | sevāyā sarvadā tatra śayyāyāṃ saha vartate || 27|| viśālākṣo mṛgākṣī sā taruṇī tanumadhyamā | rūpalāvaṇyamādhuryakāntiśīlaguṇānvitā || 28 || dugdhaphenaprabhāśāṭīkaṃcukīnaktaśobhitā | mandāraketakījātīpuṣpāñcitaśiroruhā || 29 || tailasugandhicipiṭasūcīkabarīdhammilā | kastūrīkṛtatilakā ratnatantīsuśobhitā || 1.129.30 || nānāmauktikaratnāḍhyakarṇabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā | pakvabimbapravālādiraktabhāsādharānvitā || 31 || kaṭyālambinīlavaktrasnigdhakeśairalaṃkṛtā | svalponnatadṛḍhapīnagaṇḍaśroṇipayodharā || 32|| iṣadunnatasūjjvalamṛdulokakapolakā | caturhastaiḥ rājamānā premāpagāpravāhiṇī ||33 || udbāhubhyāṃ dhṛtavatī hemapadmayugaṃ śubham | itarābhyāṃ kvacitpremṇā samāśliṣya patiṃ sthitā || 34|| vartate nityasevāyāṃ lakṣmīrdevī hareḥ priyā | tathānyāstulyarūpāśca narmadā tapatī tathā || 35|| tuṃgabhadrā ca kāverī gaṃgā godāvarī tathā | sindhuḥ phalgurgaṇḍakī ca tāmraparṇī sarasvatī || 36|| karatoyā karmanāśā sābhramatī ca gomatī | ojasvatī bhadrāvatī sarayūḥ svarṇarakṣikā ||37|| indradyumnaṃ puṣkaraṃ ca nārāyaṇasarastathā | aśvapaṭṭasaraścaivākhātānyanyāni yāni vai ||38 || mānasaṃ ca saro rāmasaraḥ kṛṣṇasarastathā | matsyasarastathā śoṇo brahmaputraśca gargaraḥ ||39 || evaṃ nadāśca nadyaśca sarāṃsi sāgarāstathā | krauṃcamainākahīmādrivindhyamandararaivatāḥ ||1.129.40 || parvatāḥ pṛthivī devī varuṇo’nye ca vaiṣṇavāḥ | mārkaṇḍeyo balirbāṇośvatthāmahanumadvarāḥ ||41 || nimirbibhīṣaṇaḥ parśurāmo vyāso manustathā | satyavrataśca nandaśca gayaśca tala ityapi |||42|| ete cānye’pi devādyā divyā nārāyaṇāśritāḥ | vartante divyavapuṣaḥ kṣīrasāgaramaṇḍape ||42||| dugdhābdhau nirmite tatra vaikuṇṭhe vartate prabhuḥ | daiteyairvadhyamānairhi brahmarudrādibhiḥ suraiḥ ||44|| saṃstūyamāno deveśo garuḍena virājitaḥ | daityāṃśca rākṣasān hatvā punaretyātra tiṣṭhati ||45|| śeṣākhyaśayane śete dāsadāsīprasevitaḥ | ityevaṃ pārvati devi sarvaṃ te viniveditam ||46|| vṛttayaścendriyāṇāṃ tu jāyante kuṇṭhitā yadā | yadā tadā tatraiva vaikuṇṭhaṃ boddhavyaṃ mokṣamicchatā ||47|| dhanyāsi kṛtakṛtyāsi bhaktāsi puruṣottame | ityevaṃ bahudhā vyāptaṃ jānāsi vyūhavaibhavam ||48|| ahaṃ bhajāmi deveśi taṃ śrīnārāyaṇaṃ harim | mayā tubhyaṃ pramokṣārthaṃ sādhanaṃ śaraṇāgatiḥ ||49|| samantrā ca samudrā ca sakaṇṭhī sordhvapuṃḍrakā | sābhidhā kathitā pālyā yayā muktirbhavediti ||1.129.50 || jñānāddhyānācca tapaso yogādyajñādvirāmataḥ | japācchravāttathā na syādyathā muktistadarpaṇāt ||5 1 || tadvadātmaniveditvaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ mama priye | tena muktidhruvā bhāvyā brāhmīśrīharyanugrahān |||52|| evaṃ śaṃbhurdadau dīkṣāṃ svīyapatnyai tu vaiṣṇavīm | tata ārabhya sā nityaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya vai ||53|| pūjā kṛtvārpaṇaṃ kṛtvā gṛhṇātyannaṃ jalaṃ ca vā | tatastau vaiṣṇavau bhaktau pārvatīparameśvarau ||54|| mamaivārādhanaparau madarthātmanivedinau | mamaivānucarau śiṣyau madātmānau mama priyau |||55|| śrīlakṣmīruvāca yadi tau vaiṣṇavau devau tvayyevātmanivedinau | katha bhasmatripuṃḍrarudrākṣāndadhāti śaṃkaraḥ ||56|| soyaṃ me saṃśayo jātastanniṣūdaya satyate | na jñātā viṣṇutāṃ jahyād bhavedanyattu kāraṇam ||57|| ityāśrutya harirlakṣmīmuvāca tatkathānakam | kathaṃ bhasmatripuṃḍrādi bāhye dadhāti śaṃkaraḥ ||58|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kṣīrasāgare caturthavaikuṇṭhavasānamaṇḍapadivyabhogaśeṣatalpalakṣmīnadanadīparvatādiciraṃjīvivaiṣṇavabhaktādivaiṣṇavaśaṃbhukṛtabhasmatripuṃḍrādidhāraṇaśaṃkāpradarśananāmaikonatriṃśaṭadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 129 ||
<1.130> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi yathā pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā mahyaṃ tathaiva hi | pārvatyāpi harāyedaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ bhasmādi kiṃ dhṛtam || 1 || śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā devīṃ kathāṃ ramyāṃ purātanīm | sakāraṇā śṛṇu tvaṃ tāmāsurāṇāṃ tu mohinīm || 2 || pārvatyuvāca guhyaṃ te pṛcchāmi deva śaṃkara | mayi prītyā samācakṣva saṃśayo vartate bhṛśam || 3 || kapālabhasmacarmāsthidhāraṇaṃ bahugarhitam | tattvayā dhāryate śaṃbho garhitaṃ kena hetunā || 4 || strīcāpalyena deveśa pṛcchāmi tvāṃ mahāmate | apraṣṭavyamapi praśnaṃ kṣantumarhasi me prabho || 5 || iti devyā haraḥ pṛṣṭo rahasye janavarjite | uvāca paramaṃ guhyaṃ yadyadācaritaṃ svakam || 6 || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi guhyādguhyataraṃ param | apṛthaktvāccharīrasya vakṣyāmi tava suvrate || 7 || na vaktavyaṃ tvayānyatra vā janeṣu kathañcana | namucyādyā mahādaityāḥ khalāḥ svāyaṃbhuve’ntare || 8 || mahābalaparīvārā mahāvīryā mahaujasaḥ | yadāsaṃstairarditāśca bhagnā indrapurogamāḥ || 9 || viṣṇoḥ samīpamāgatya rakṣaṇaṃ vavrire surāḥ | ajeyānsumahāvīrāntaponirdhūtakalmaṣān || 1.130.1 0|| tvamevaitānmahādaityān jetumarhasi keśava | ityākarṇya haristeṣāṃ devānāṃ bhayamāgatam || 1 1|| tānavadhyānviditvātha śaṃkaraṃ prāha māṃ hariḥ | tvaṃ hi rudra mahābāho mohanārthe suradviṣām || 12|| pākhaṇḍācaraṇaṃ kiṃciddharmaṃ kuruṣva mohakam | yena pathā gatā daityā nirbalāḥ syuradhogatāḥ || 1 3|| balahīnā bhaveyuśca nistejaskāśca sarvathā | yathā svakarmabhraṣṭām̐stānpatitānmṛtasadṛśān || 14|| devā vijitya sukhino bhaveyuḥ śūnyakaṇṭakāḥ | dharmaṃ pākhaṇḍamūrdhanyaṃ granthānpākhaṇḍakalpitān || 15|| daityamohakarānviṣṇuvirodhipravarānkuru | malinānyapi cihnāni kalpitāni tathā kuru || 16|| yathā vai tāmasānāṃ tatsarvaṃ surucikaṃ bhavet | tavopadeśātte śāstrāttava kalpitavartanāt || 17|| tāmasāste vinaṣṭā vai bhaviṣyanti svabhāvataḥ | ahaṃ viṣṇustathā devā daityaviśvāsahetave || 18|| tvayā kṛtaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ kiṃcitkālaṃ ca bāhyataḥ | samanumodayiṣyāmastena viśvāsamāgatāḥ || 19|| daityāstaṃ kalpitaṃ sarvaṃ pākhaṇḍaṃ pātakāraṇam | satyadhiyā grahīṣyanti tato’smadvijayo bhavet ||1.130.20|| ityājñāgrahaṇārthaṃ vai śaṃbhuṃ prāha tadācyutam | tvayoditamidaṃ deva karomi yadi bhūtale |||21 || tena nāśo’pi me nātha bhavedeva bhayāvahaḥ | na śakyaṃ hi mayā kartumetatkṛtyaṃ tvadāśriṇā ||22|| tvadājñāpi ca nollaṃghyā hyetadduḥkhataraṃ mahat | evamuktastadā devaḥ samāśvāsya ca māṃ punaḥ |||23|| prāha śaṃbho na te nāśo bhavedyatte’smi rakṣakaḥ | devatānāṃ hitārthāya kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama |||24|| mamājñayā kuru śaṃbho na te bādho bhaviṣyati | kartā sannapi nirbādho hyakartā mama śāsanāt ||25|| japannāmāni nityaṃ me madājñayānusaṃcaran | karoti laukikaṃ vāpi naiva badhnāti mānavaḥ ||26||| hṛdaye māṃ smaran śāśvajjapa mantraṃ madarthakam | oṃ haraye nama itimantraṃ brahma samācara |||27|| bha ja māṃ bhaktilabhyaṃ tvaṃ kuru kāryaṃ madarthitam | mamājñaiva mahān dharmā madbhaktasya mayā kṛtaḥ ||28|| kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho vaṃcanā kapaṭaṃ ghṛṇā | aśubhaṃ vā ca hiṃsā vā mayoktaṃ dharma eva saḥ ||29|| mayā yaduktaṃ sākṣādvai sa eva veda ucyate | pratyakṣaṃ vā parokṣaṃ vā maduktaṃ veda eva saḥ ||1.130.3 0|| yadā niyuñje kurviti tadā dharmastu tanmayaḥ | yadā ruṇadhmi mā kuru tadā dharmo nivartanā ||3 1 || tasmānmamājñā dharmaḥ syādanājñā tadviparyayaḥ | kuru śaṃbho tava kṛtaṃ pūjayiṣye yuge yuge |||32|| tena daityāstāmasāśca pūjayiṣyanti tai kṛtam | yathāhaṃ ca tathā tvaṃ vai nirlopo’si sadā prabhuḥ |||3 3 || śīghraṃ kuru hitaṃ vighnān nāśayiṣyāmyahaṃ tava | madanyadevatābhaktirna te śaṃbho bhaviṣyati ||34|| manasaivārcaya māṃ vai yāvatkālaṃ prayojanam | madājñāṃ kuru matprītyā sarvametacchubhaṃ tava ||35|| iti sandiśya māṃ devi visasarja marudgaṇān | mayāpi cintitaṃ tatra kiyatyākhaṇḍakalpanam ||36|| yena daityā mohitāḥ syurnirbalāścaraṇāttathā | tato devahitārthāya daityasaṃhārahetave ||37|| kapālacarma bhasmāsthidhāraṇaṃ vai kṛtaṃ mayā | tripuṃḍrarekhārudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ vai kṛtaṃ mayā ||38|| bāhyatastāni sarvāṇi vārayāmi na cāntaram | antaḥpraviśya deveśi tulasīkaṇṭhamālikām ||39|| ūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ tathā mudrā vaiṣṇavāṃkāni sarvathā | dhārayāmi praguptāni yayā daityā vidurnahi ||1.130.40|| nārāyaṇaharerājñā mama dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ | daityānāṃ ca pratītyarthaṃ pākhaṇḍamiśritāni vai ||41 || tāmasāni śaivapāśupatatantrāṇi nirmame | tānimānmatkṛtagranthānālambya ca vilokya mām |||42|| bhagavadvimukhāḥ sarve bhavanti daityatāmasāḥ | bhasmādidhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā māṃsāsrakcandanādibhiḥ ||43|| māmeva pūjayanti sma mahogratamasāvṛtāḥ | sarvadharmaparibhraṣṭāḥ kāmakrodhasamanvitāḥ ||44|| matto varapradānāni labdhvā viṣayavartinaḥ | sattvahīnāśca nirvīryāḥ śanairyāntyadhamāṃ gatim ||45|| bhasmādidhāraṇaṃ ye me mataṃ gṛhṇanti tāmasāḥ | sarvadhamaistu rahitāḥ paśyanti nirayaṃ hi te ||46|| daityāstu tāmasāḥ sarve tathā cānye’pi tanmatāḥ | sarvadā devairjitā daityā naśyanti sarvathā ||47|| evaṃ devahitārthāya vṛttirme devi garhitā | viṣṇorājñāṃ puraskṛtya kṛtaṃ bhasmāsthidhāraṇam ||48|| bāhyacihnamidaṃ devi mohanārthāya vidviṣām | apyantarhṛdaye nityaṃ dhyāye nārāyaṇaṃ harim ||49|| japanneva ca tannāma sadānandaguṇākaram | sukhamātyantikaṃ brahma hyaśnāmi ca tvayā saha ||1.130.50|| tato bhaktā hyasattvasthā bhasmādyaṃ cāpayanti me | jānanti tāmasā ye te śaṃbhorbhasmādikaṃ priyam ||5 1|| māmapi tāmasaṃ devaṃ manyante tai tathāvidhāḥ | tāmasānyarpayanti me bhaṃgāgaṃjādi tāmasam ||52|| ahaṃ tu vaiṣṇavo devi na gṛhṇāmyaniveditam | viṣṇuprāsādikaṃ puṇyaṃ gṛhṇāṇi nānyadityataḥ ||53|| mā tvaṃ mohe pata devi tāmasaṃ mā gṛhāṇa ca | sāttvikaṃ sevaya devi vaiṣṇavī hyasi sarvathā |||54|| mayā nārāyaṇāyaivānivedya gṛhyate nahi | kintu mayā hareragre pratijñātaṃ tu bhaktitaḥ |||55|| svāmibhogyaṃ ca yadvastu dāsabhogyaṃ na tadbhavet | evaṃ dharma samāśrityānivedya nahi bhujyate ||56|| bhujyate svāmyabhogyaṃ yaddhattūrakuṃkumādikam | tadājñayeti naiva syādātmanivedane kṣatiḥ ||57|| bhasmāsthidhāraṇādyā vai daihikyaśuddhyamaṃgalā | sāpi śuddhirmaṃgalā tannāmajāpāt tadājñayā ||58|| ityetatte samākhyātaṃ tāmasāṃkādidhāraṇam | sahetukaṃ mahādevi jñātvā nātra vimuhyasi ||59||| aśuddhirhiṃsanaṃ yatra māraṇoccāṭanādikāḥ | mantrāśca tāmasī pūjā yatra syāttaddhi tāmasam ||1.130.60|| tanna grāhyaṃ mahādevi mokṣārthibhiḥ kadācana | vināśāntaṃ duḥkhadaṃ vai sarvathā tāmasaṃ yataḥ ||61|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vaiṣṇavaśaṃbhorvaiṣṇavīpārvatyā bhasmāsthikapālādidhāraṇasya kāraṇapraśne’suravimohanāya viṣṇorājñayā taditivṛttāntakathananāmā triṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 13 0||
<1.131> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrīhareravatārāṇāṃ vaibhavānāṃ ca sarvathā | yāthātathyaṃ na vai vettuṃ śaknotīha tu kaścana || 1 || śrīlakṣmīruvāca nanu daityāśca ke hyāsan kasya balena vardhitāḥ | kiṃ nimittaṃ samutpādya viṣṇunā māritāśca te ||2 || viṣṇoḥ sambandhataḥ pūtāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm | śrotumicchāmyavatārān śrīviṣṇoḥ paramātmanaḥ || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi matsyarūpaṃ sanātanam | brahmāsṛjatprajādhīśān prathame sṛṣṭisarjane || 4 || bhṛguṃ marīcimatriṃ ca dakṣaṃ kardamamityapi | pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ caivāṅgirasaṃ ca tathā kratum || 5 || maricirbhagavām̐statra janayāmāsa kaśyapam | kaśyapasya canasto vai patnyo jātā vijātikāḥ || 6 || aditiśca ditiścāpi kadrūśca vinatā tathā | aditestu sutāḥ sarve devā vai śubhadarśanāḥ || 7 || diteḥ putrāstu daityā vai tāmasāsurarākṣasāḥ | ditistu caikadāsīnā grīṣme svapatinā saha || 8 || vimānavaramāruhya samudratīramāgatā | kaśyapena saha tatra niṣasāda mahītale || 9 || samudajalasammiśraśītalānilayogataḥ | cakame svapatiṃ devī kāmavegena pīḍitā || 1.131.1 0|| patiṃ sā sevayāmāsa pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ | sumṛduvālukāyukte vṛkṣavallyādidarśane || 11 || śītasalilabindvāktapavanaiḥ śotalīkṛte | sukhade tattaṭe sevāṃ karoti rativihvalā || 1 2|| vividhantu rateḥ saukhyaṃ dadāti pataye yadā | sūryasthāstamanapūrvaṃ tadaiva jalajantavaḥ || 1 2|| makarāśca jalaghoṭāḥ kacchapā jalamānavāḥ | pavanārthaṃ ca tāpārthaṃ niṣīdanti taṭaṃ gatāḥ || 14|| sāyaṃtanaraveryogātprakāśante suvarṇavat | vālukāyāṃ taṭe tatra nakraiśca jalaghoṭayoḥ || 15 || kaśyapasrāvakāle tu kalaho’bhūtsavigrahaḥ | ditikaśyapayordṛṣṭirgatā makaraghoṭayoḥ || 16|| tadaiva ca niṣeko’pi samabhūt saphalaḥ sthale | niṣeke yādṛśī dṛṣṭirbuddhiśca yādṛśī bhavet||| 17|| tādṛśo jāyate garbho rūpasaṃskāratādṛśaḥ | tena deho makaravat mastakaṃ ghoṭavattathā || 18|| garbhe saṃskāratāṃ prāpya sthito’bhūdbālakaḥ sa hi | dampatī svavimānaṃ tu samāruhya gṛhaṃ prati || 19|| samāgatau smarantau taṃ makaraṃ jalaghoṭakam | vimānadarśanādvāriprāṇino viviśurjalam |||1.131.20 || tadbhāvabhāvitaṃ garbhaṃ suṣuve samaye ditiḥ | dehe tu makarākāraṃ mastake hayasadṛśam |||11 || hayagrīvo makaro’yaṃ kaśyapena susaṃskṛtaḥ | bhūvāso’pi viśeṣeṇa jalāvāso’bhavaddhi saḥ ||22|| upanītaḥ kaśyapena mātrā bhīkṣāpradāpitaḥ | kāmarūpadharo bālo vedādhyayanavāṃchayā ||23||| brāhmaṇaṃ rūpamāsthāya jagāma ca pitāmaham | praṇipatya ca sāmudraratnopahāṃ nidhāya ca |||24|| yayāce vedavidyāṃ sakapaṭo viprarūpadhṛk | brahmā papraccha pitarau nāmasaṃskāraprabhṛti ||25|| ahaṃ kaśyapadāyāda ityāha prapitāmaham | brahmāpi svīyaputrasya marīceśca sutasya vai |||26|| kaśyapasya sutaṃ vedān prapautrāya dadau tadā | vedānnītvā hayagrīvo jagāma kāśyapaṃ gṛham ||27|| pitābhūtsuprasanno vai kaśyapaḥ paṇḍitaṃ sutam | vilokya prāha putra tvaṃ cānyānadhyāpayeti hi ||28|| hayagrīvastadā prāha nāhamadhyāpaye pitaḥ | vedavidyā na dātavyā kasmaicidapi sarvathā || 29|| vedaiḥ samedhitā devā virudhyantyasurānmuhuḥ | vedāstu sarvathā nāśyā na poṣyā vai kadācana ||1.131.3 0 || vedairyajñāḥ pravartante dharmakarmāpi cāpi vai | yajñāśca dharmakarmāṇi mṛṣā santi yataḥ pitaḥ ||3 1|| mayā vidhiniṣedhau tu vede dṛṣṭau punaḥ punaḥ | tau sadā nigrahakarau nigraho me na rocate ||32|| bhakṣyaṃ sarvaṃ tathā peyaṃ mādyaṃ bhogyaṃ yatheṣṭakam | na vidhirna niṣedho vai cāsmākaṃ balināṃ bhavet || 33|| tasmānna pāṭhayiṣye’nyānna vartiṣye vidhānavat | nāśayiṣye vedavidyā dhvaṃsayiṣye nu pāṭhakān ||34|| ardayiṣye vaidhajanān mārayiṣye kratusthitān | karmakāṇḍān kariṣye na vartayiṣye tato’nyathā ||35|| itivadantaṃ putraṃ taṃ samākarṇya ca kaśyapaḥ | śuśocāsurabhāvaṃ taṃ svālayāmadhikāriṇam ||36|| nāstikaṃ jñānahartāraṃ vedavidyāvināśakam | vedastenaṃ paśuprāyaṃ devapuṣṭivirodhinam ||37|| īrṣyājvaraṃ bhāvisaukhyāpradaṃ sarvasvahānidam | kaśyapastaṃ tapovidyākupātraṃ paricintya ca ||38|| gṛhānniṣkāsayāmāsa ditimāpṛcchatha sarvathā | daityo hayaśirāḥ so’pi mākaraṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ ||39|| uvāsa ca mahābdhau vai bhakṣayan jalavāsinaḥ | parvateṣu pradeśeṣu gatvā gatvā kratusthalam ||1.131.40 || nāśayāmāsa yajñānvai viprāndharmānmuhurmuhuḥ | brāhmaṇānāṃ samāje vai bhakṣayāmāsa bhūsurān ||41|| devarūpaṃ surūpaṃ ca dhṛtvā svargaṃ jagāma saḥ | dārāpatyagṛhāṇyāśudevānāṃ sa jahāra ca |||42|| ṛṣīṇāmapi saṃvāsān vināśyārdanamācarat | tato devarṣibhirgatvā brahmā tannāśane’rthitaḥ ||43|| brahmā sasmāra deveśaṃ daityanāśakaraṃ harim | kṣīrasāgarasadratnamaṇḍape śeṣaśāyinam ||44|| tadā nārāyaṇo lakṣmīṃ hitvā cakraṃ pragṛhya ca | gadāṃ khaḍgaṃ tathā śaktiṃ nītvā yuddhāya cāgamat ||45|| yatra brahmā sthito dugdhasāgarasya taṭe’bhavat | tatra viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ cājaṃ dadarśa yuddharūpadhṛk ||46|| garuḍe susthito devaḥ prāha śīghraṃ prajāpatim | kathaṃ vai smārito brahman vada śīghraṃ karomi tat ||47|| brahmovāca namastubhyaṃ devavedamayācyuta | garuḍavāhanoddhartaḥ sṛṣṭipuṣṭivinaṣṭikṛt ||48|| tvameva dadhase rūpaṃ jagadrakṣaṇahetave | vipravedakratugobhūdharmatrātā tvameva hi ||49|| tvameva sarvadharmāṇāmāśrayaḥ puruṣottama | tvameva yajño vidyā ca vedāścāsi tvadudgamāḥ ||1.131.50|| tvadādhāra jagatsarvaṃ tvadāyattā maharṣayaḥ | tvadāyattā vayaṃ sarve niṣedhavidhivartanāḥ ||5 1 || tvadājñayaiva sarvatra vartayiṣyāmahe janān | tamimaṃ mārgamālambya vartase puruṣottamaḥ ||5 2|| tvayaiva preritā lokā vartante sādhvasādhuṣu | maryādā tvatkṛtā rakṣyā dharmo’smākamiti dhruvam ||5 3 || adhītya vedān gurutaḥ tataścādhyāpayet śiśūn | dharmānpravartayettatsthānityājñā pārameśvarī ||54|| tāṃ maryādāṃ samullaṃghya kāśyapo mākaro’suraḥ | hayāsyaḥ svecchayā vai saṃvartate devaduḥkhadaḥ ||55|| vedānāhṛtya daitya saḥ praviṣṭo’sti mahārṇavam | vedādhāramidaṃ sarvaṃ vedairdharmapariṣkṛtiḥ ||5 6 || vedadarśitakaraṇātsarvā tṛptiḥ prajāyate | tasmādasuramāhatya nāstikaṃ vidhināśakam ||57|| tato vedānsamānetuṃ tvamevārhasi keśava | evamukto hṛṣīkeśo brahmaṇā parameśvaraḥ ||58|| prāha śāntiṃ kuru brahman garuḍaścātra tiṣṭhatu | gacchāmi jalayogyaṃ vai rūpamāsthāya vāridhim ||5 9 || ṛṣīn natvā svayaṃ nārāyaṇo matsyo babhūva ha | mahātimiṃgilagilo tīkṣṇatuṇḍo hyapūrvakaḥ ||1.131.6 0 || himādrisadṛśadeho babhūva sa kṣaṇāntare | makarān śikharaprāyāna bhakṣayan jalamāviśat ||6 1 || samudraḥ kṣobhitastena cakampe pṛthivī muhuḥ | meghāścaivāpatanvyomno grahāścakṣubhire tadā ||6 2|| devā maharṣayastatrāgatya tuṣṭuvire harim | nārāyaṇaḥ samudrāntastalamāviśya sarvataḥ ||63|| mārgayitvā mahādaityaṃ jagrāhāruhya taṃ gale | tadāsuro mahāmāyo bhūtvā tvadṛśya eva hi ||64|| dhīvaraṃ rūpamāsthāya gadājālakarānvitaḥ | himālayasamo bhūtvā matsyaṃ yāvajjighṛkṣati ||65|| nārāyaṇo’pi raudraṃ vai mahākālānalopamam | rūpamāsādya gadayā tāḍayāmāsa dhīvaram ||66|| tāvatsa dhīvaraṃ rūpaṃ tyaktvābhūtparvato mahān | yasya mastakapādādi kutrāpi naiva labhyate ||67|| talamāśritya supto’bhūt pṛṣṭha kṛtvā tu vajravat|| nārāyaṇena śaktirvai kṣiptā yāvatpravegataḥ ||68|| ārapāraṃ gatā vidhvā pṛṣṭhaṃ vajrasamaṃ tadā | daityo rūpāntaraṃ mātsyaṃ kṛtvā sthānāntaraṃ sthitaḥ ||69|| matvā svāṃ jātijāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ mārayennaiva māmiti | athavā vañcayitvaiva mārayāmi ca taṃ punaḥ ||1.131.70|| vañcayitvā hariṃ tatra pucchena tāḍitaḥ punaḥ | dudrāva jalamadhye saḥ praveśāya tu kardame ||7 1 || tāvadāruhya pīṭhe taṃ gale jagrāha vai punaḥ | tuṇḍāgreṇa vidāryainaṃ jaghāna harirīśvaraḥ ||72||| taddhṛdisthān sarvavedān sāṃgopāṃgām̐stadātmanaḥ | jñānarūpānsamākṛṣya tirobhāvayya sarvathā ||73|| śaktyā samādhinā nītvābdheruparyājagāma ha | āsurātmānamajñāne viniḥkṣipya tu tāmase ||74|| yāmye loke vinipātyājagāmābdhitaṭaṃ hariḥ | mātsyaṃ rūpaṃ tadā himaśailatulyaṃ vilokya ca ||75|| devarṣimunayastatrāścaryastabdhā babhūvire | kṣaṇaṃ pradarśya tadrūpaṃ svalpamatsyo babhūva saḥ ||76|| tato narākṛtidevo nārāyaṇaḥ sudarśanaḥ | samabhūtsaṃstutaḥ sarvaiḥ saumyamūrtirjalārdanaḥ ||77|| vedānsarvāndadau tasmai brahmaṇe parameṣṭhine | jñānaṃ vedamayaṃ sarvaṃ brahmaṇe hyarpayadvibhuḥ ||78|| sarvānāśīḥ prayujyaiva pūjāmādāya tatkṛtām | gāruḍaṃ yānamāruhyāntardadhe dugdhavāridhau ||79|| iti matsyāvatārasya prathamadvāparasya vai | caritaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi śṛṇu mātsyaṃ dvitīyakam ||1.131.80|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kaśyapaputrahayagrīvadaityotpattitatkṛtavedajñānāpaharaṇatannāśakṛnnārāyaṇamatsyāvatāradvārakadaityanāśādikathananāmā ekatriṃśadadhikaśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 13 1||
<1.132> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca yadā yadā mahālakṣmi sāyāhno vedhaso bhavet | tadā tadā laye nitye daśa lokāḥ svarādayaḥ || 1 || pātālāntā layaṃ yānti pūrvasṛṣṭau yathā hyabhūt | tathā tathā laye kāle bījarakṣaṇahetave || 2 || harirgṛhṇāti mātsyaṃ vai rūpaṃ salilasañcaram | prathamaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sāyaṃ varṣaśatamavagrahaḥ || 3 || vṛṣṭyabhāvāt sudurbhikṣāddehino yānti nāśatām | jalaṃ śuṣkāyate sarvamudbhijjā yānti nāśatām || 4 || sūryatāpena pṛthivī rukṣā bhavati sarvathā | bījāni bharjitānyeva bhavanti kramaśastadā || 5 || kandamūlāni naśyanti prāṇijātaṃ ca naśyati | śatavarṣaṃ kramādeva vṛṣṭihīnaṃ pratāpitam || 6 || bhavatyataḥ samudrā vai śuṣkāyante samantataḥ | tadā tatsthaṃ prāṇijātaṃ sarvaṃ naśyati sarvathā || 7 || sūryā dvādaśa cottaptā ugrāstapanti kṛtsnaśaḥ | teneyaṃ śatavarṣeṣu pṛthvī satalaparvatā || 8 || dagdhā bhasmasamā sarvā jāyate hi samantataḥ | āpātālācca āsvargāt sarvepi jantavo mṛtāḥ || 9 || sūkṣmaśarīrasahitā tadā yānti mahartalam | maharloke ca te sarve tiṣṭhanti puṇyaraśmibhiḥ || 1.132.1 0|| meghāstataḥ pravarṣanti śatavarṣāṇi sarvadā | ādaśabhuvanaṃ yāvat sarvaṃ jalamayaṃ bhavet || 11 || āsvargaṃ vai jalaṃ tatra pūryate pralaye bahu | evaṃ sāyāhnamārabhya prātaḥparyantameva ha || 12|| daśalokavināśo’yaṃ nityapralaya ucyate | punaḥ prātaḥ svayaṃ brahmā sṛjati daśabhūstarān || 13|| svargamārabhya pātālān sṛṣṭvā sṛṣṭiṃ karoti saḥ | pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ tadā smṛtvā yathāpūrvamakalpayat || 14|| prāpte punaśca sāyāhne punarvai vilayo bhavet | layakāle tadā devaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇo hariḥ || 11|| sarvasadbījarakṣārthaṃ matsyarūpo bhavatyapi | vedhodināvasāne sa svayameva dayānidhiḥ || 16||| samāgatya surakṣārhaṃ rakṣatyeva kṛpāvaśāt | dināvasāne sāyaṃ vai brahmā sandhyārthamutthitaḥ || 17|| kamaṇḍaluṃ svamādāya puṣkaraṃ prati gacchati | snātvā kamaṇḍalau vāri bhṛtvā tīraṃ samāsīnaḥ || 18|| ācamanāya yāvadvai gṛhṇātyambu kamaṇḍaloḥ | hastatale tadā matsyarūpaṃ svalpaṃ dadarśa saḥ || 19|| yavabījasamaṃ hrasvaṃ yathā vai kṣudrajantukam | jale jalāṃjaliṃ yāvan kṣipatyeva pitāmahaḥ |||1.132.20 | tāvadvitastimātraṃ tad bhūtvotplutyāpatattaṭe | prāha māṃ rakṣa devānāṃ pitāmaha kamaṇḍalau ||21 || tathā karotyajo yāvanmamau naiva kamaṇḍalau | tataḥ prāha timistaṃ vai nālaṃ me bhavati prabho || 22|| deho me vardhate drāgvai tasmātkūpe tu māṃ kṣipa | brahmaṇā vai tataḥ kūpe nikṣipto’pi pravavṛdhe ||23 || kūpe mātuṃ na yogyo’bhūt sa prāha vedhasaṃ tataḥ | na kūpo’yamalaṃ me syāt pitaḥ sarasi mākṣipa |||24|| uddhṛtya brahmaṇā kūpāt puṣkare sarasi dhṛtaḥ | tāvatpuṣkaradeho’yaṃ mahān babhūva tatkṣaṇāt ||25|| puṣkare na mamau sopi punarāha pitāmaham | nālaṃ me puṣkaraṃ jātaṃ samudre māṃ kṣipeṣṭakṛt ||26|| brahmaṇā tu tato nītvā samudre vinipātitaḥ | uktaśca kastvamatrāsi vadāścaryaṃ karoṣi mām ||27|| samudre vardhito matsyastadovāca pitāmaham | ahaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣājjagadrakṣaṇahetave ||28|| matsyarūpaṃ sudhṛtavān sāyaṃ te’hno bhavatyataḥ | daśalokāstāpaśuṣkā jalamagnā drutaṃ matāḥ |||29|| tasmādbījāni mukhyāni catuḥkhanigatāni vai | gṛhītvāyaṃ manuścaturdaśo nāvi pratiṣṭhatu ||1.132.3 0|| naurapi koṭigavyūtidīrghā gabhīrabhūmikā | śatabhūmirdṛḍhā pūraṇīyā bījaiḥ prarohaṇaiḥ ||3 1|| ṛṣīnmunīṃstathā devān gohastiyānavāhanam | udbhijjātīni bījāni pṛthvīṃ devīṃ ca bhūsurān ||32|| yadyatpunastava prātarupayuktaṃ sṛjau bhavet | tatsarvaṃ bījarūpaṃ vai nītvā saṃsthāpya nāvi tat || 33|| manuṃ satyaṃ tatra vai tvaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya vraja svakam | satyalokaṃ tato’haṃ vai nādaṃ śṛṃkhalayāñcitām ||34|| mama śṛṃge nibadhyaiva bhramiṣyāmi mahājale | avagrahe sūryatāpe varṣaṇe śatavārṣike |||35|| mahāpātālavārīṇāṃ nidhau nāvaṃ nināya ca | rakṣiṣyāmi ca tānsarvānārātripralayāvadhim ||36 || āprātastānpoṣayiṣye mama divyabalānnanu | mā tvaṃ khedaṃ kuru brahman prātardāsye punardhanam |||37|| kariṣyati tato daśalokānāṃ sṛṣṭimeva tām | ityājñaptastato brahmā manuṃ prāha caturdaśam ||38|| bījānyarpayya sadevamunibījāntarāṇi ca | nāvaṃ samarpayāmāsa matsyāya keśavāya saḥ || 39|| brahmā tu gatavān satyaṃ lokaṃ rātrirbabhūva ha | sandhyākāle tadā yugasahasrānte yugakṣaye ||1.132.40|| sadā jātā anāvṛṣṭistadā sā śatavārṣikī | saptaraśmiratho bhūtvā hyudatiṣṭhadvibhāvasuḥ ||41 || tasya te raśmayaḥ saptāpibannambho mahārṇavāt | tatasteṣāṃ pratāpena dahyamānā vasundharā ||42|| sādrinadyarṇavā sarvā visnehā samapadyata | tīkṣṇapradīptakiraṇairekajvālaṃ babhūva ha ||43 || tataḥ saṃvartako ghoro lokān jahāra pāvakaḥ | nirdahya sarvapātālānūrdhvama dadāha vai divam ||44|| tato gajakulākārāstaḍidbhiḥ samalaṃkṛtāḥ | uttiṣṭhanti sma vai ghorā vyomni saṃvartakā ghanāḥ ||45|| nīlāḥ śvetāścāṃjanāśca dhūmrāḥ pītāḥ payodharāḥ | ghorarūpā ghoranādāḥ pūrayanti sma vṛṣṭibhiḥ ||46|| sughoramaśivaṃ sarvaṃ śamayanti sma pāvakam | naṣṭe cāgnau varṣaśate jalapūrṇaṃ nabhastalam ||47|| ityambhasāvṛte loke sarvamekārṇavaṃ jagat | jalaṃ vinā tadānīṃ vai prājñāyata na kiṃcana ||48|| caturyugasahasrānte rātriṃ sma kurute prabhuḥ | matsyāvatāro bhagavānnāvaṃ rakṣati sarvathā ||49|| śatavarṣe sudurbhikṣe mahākālānalāntare | svasyāmṛtapratāpena nāvaṃ rakṣati sa prabhuḥ ||1.132.50|| rātrau rakṣati caivāyaṃ tamasyekārṇave jale | tato rātrikṣaye prāpte pratibuddhaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||51|| racayāmāsa vividhān daśalokān yathāprajān | evaṃ layaṃ karoti sma pratisāyāhnameva hi ||52 || sṛṣṭiṃ punaḥ karoti sma pratiprātaḥ sadaiva saḥ | so’yaṃ dainandinaḥ proktaḥ pralayo daśalokinām ||5 3|| evaṃ varṣaśatānte vai brahmāṇḍaṃ brahmaṇā saha | naśyate sa tu saṃprokto layo naimittiko’paraḥ ||54|| tato’pi mūlamāyāyāścaturviṃśatimūrtayaḥ | vilīyante tadā bodhyaḥ prākṛtapralayo mahān ||55 || jīvasya tu prabhoḥ samyagyogād bhakteśca bhāvataḥ | yadā mokṣo bhavet so’yaṃ vodhyastvātyantiko layaḥ ||56|| pralaye tatra rātrau tu sṛṣṭyabhāvānna vāvanam | avanārthaṃ manūnāṃ ca naivāvaśyakatāsti yat ||57|| ato manvantarāṇāṃ vai rātrau sṛṣṭirna vidyate | antimo yo manuḥ prokto bījāni ṛṣayastathā ||58|| mahānaukāsthitāsteṣāṃ nidrāvṛttisuvartinām | viṣṇornārāyaṇecchāyā balānmṛtyurna vidyate ||5 9 || āprātaste tu jīvanti sṛṣṭerbījatayā sthiteḥ | ciraṃjīvāstu ye sarve brahmanārāyaṇehayā ||1.132.60 || prātaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ punaḥ kṛtvā svayaṃ brahma hi tām̐stataḥ | līnīkaroti tatraiva sṛṣṭau vai nānyathā kvacit ||6 1 || ityevaṃ matsyarūpāṇi jāyante me sahasraśaḥ | avatārā yathākāryaṃ lakṣmi jānāmi tānaham ||6 2|| evaṃ diterapatyaṃ yo hiraṇyākṣo’bhavanmahān | asuraḥ sa tadā sṛṣṭeḥ prāraṃbhe kardamasthitim ||6 3 || jalāntaḥsthāṃ mahāpṛthvīṃ bhuṃkte rājādhirājavat | tamahaṃ brahmaṇo nastaḥ saṃbhūya nāśayāmi vai ||64|| vārāharūpamāsthāya nayāmi yamasādanam | asuraṃ taṃ tadā hatvā pṛthvīṃ kṛtvā supiṇḍikām ||65|| nāyāmyupari vārāṃ tāṃ sthāpayāmi ca susthirām | evaṃ vārāharūpāṇi sahasrāṇi bhavanti me ||66|| yadā yadāvaśyakatva bhavet kroḍo bhavāmyaham | iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ kimanyat kathayāmyanu ||67|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmaṇaḥ sāyāhne nityapralaye sabījanaukārakṣaṇārthaṃ matsyāvatāradhāraṇahiraṇyākṣahṛtapṛthivyuddhāraṇārthavarāharūpadhāraṇādikathananāmā dvātriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 32||
<1.133> śrīlakṣmīruvāca hiraṇyākṣo yathā jāto yathā pṛthvīṃ jahāra saḥ | prabhustasya vināśāya kadā kroḍo’bhavatpunaḥ || 1 || iti divyāṃ kathāṃ viṣṇoḥ sambandharasadāyinīm | kathayasva hare kṛṣṇa tṛpyāmi na kathāśrave || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi māricestu kaśyapasyādhikāriṇī | patnī ditiścakārograṃ tapaḥ putrasulabdhaye || 3 || prathamaṃ sā mṛtaṃ putraṃ śuśoca bahuvāsarān | hayagrīvaṃ punaḥ punaḥ saṃsmṛtya tanutāṃ gatā || 4 || na khādati subhojyāni vāripānādi necchati | na vai śrāṃgārike bhāve prahṛṣyati kadācana || 5 || yadā yadā kaśyapasya mukhaṃ paśyati bhāminī | netrayorjaladhārā vai tadā patati śokataḥ || 6 || pravāsito niṣkāsito vicitto vidhuro’pi vā | sannyastaḥ paralokasthaḥ putro dahati mātaram || 7 || hayagrīvaṃ gṛhātsvāt vai niṣkāsitamapi mṛtam | śrutvā śuśoca bahudhā putrasneho hi tādṛśaḥ || 8 || viṣṇoḥ putranāśayiturnāśārthaṃ sā mano dadhe | naṣṭaputrapratīkāraṃ bahudhāptuṃ samīhate || 9 || balavantau mama putrau bhavetāṃ viṣṇunāśinau | yena jyeṣṭhahayāsyasya niṣkṛtiṃ bahudhā labhe || 1.133.1 0|| vinā vai tapasāṃ siddhiṃ naiva syānme manorathaḥ | evaṃ vicārya sā devī śatavarṣaṃ tapo’karot || 1 1|| kandamūlaphalāhārā pañcāśadvarṣamāsthitā | pañcaviṃśativarṣāṇi jalāhārābhavattathā || 12|| pañcadaśapravarṣāṇi bāṣpāhārābhavatpunaḥ | daśavarṣāṇi sā devī nirāhārābhavattathā || 13|| ditistapasā brahmāṇamārādhayatpunaḥ punaḥ | nānyatpaśyati subhagā nānyaṃ spṛśati sarvathā || 14|| nānyatkaroti śṛṃgāraṃ sarvadā tapasi sthitā | svapiti bhūtale nityaṃ nāṃgamardanamicchati || 15 || oṃ namo brahmaṇe tubhyaṃ prajānāṃ pataye namaḥ | prajāṃ dehi prajāṃ dehi viṣṇutulyaparākramām || 16|| evaṃ mantrajapaṃ nityaṃ niyamena karoti sā | varṣaśataṃ nītavatī tapo nirvighnameva hi || 17|| tvagasthiśeṣaśuṣkā sā mahāpūjanamācarat | uktamantreṇa homaṃ vai cakāra daśalakṣakam || 18|| ante brahmā samāgatya prāha tāṃ tāpasīṃ vadhūm | kiṃ te labhyaṃ bhaveddevi brūhi dadāmi mā tapa || 1 9|| vṛṇu śīghraṃ ca te kāmyaṃ pūrayiṣye tapobalāt | nādeyaṃ te kṛte me’sti kimapyatra drutaṃ vṛṇu ||1.133.20 || ditistaṃ vedhasaṃ natvā salajjā prāha mānasam | svāgataṃ me vṛddhamānyaśvaśurasya karomyaham ||21 || prapituśca padornatvā vande pūjyaṃ prapūrvajam | kṣamāṃ yāce’parādhasya yadi syādavinītatā ||22|| vṛddhā vaṃśāvitāro’nugrahaṃ kuryurna ced yadi | tarhi vaṃśyā duḥkhino vai kva ceyuḥ śaraṇaṃ param ||23|| yadi śaktāḥ pūrvavṛddhā vaṃśyānāṃ kāmapūraṇam | na kuryuścettadā vaṃśyoddhārakāḥ syuśca ke’pare ||24|| tato’haṃ nirṇayaṃ kṛtvā pūjyād vṛddhapitāmahāt | prāpsye sveṣṭasya saṃsiddhimevaṃ tapasi saṃsthitā ||25|| vṛṇomi prabalau putrau viṣṇuvīryaparākramau | yābhyāṃ jyeṣṭhasya putrasyāpacitiḥ syānmadīṃgitā ||26|| brahmā prāha tathāstveva nārāyaṇaḥ karotu tat | bhaviṣyataste satputrau viṣṇutulyaparākramau ||27|| viṣṇurvā viṣṇubhaktau vā viṣṇusāmyaparākramau | nānyatrāsti kvacitkvāpi viṣṇutulya parākramam ||28|| tasmānnārāyaṇaṃ gatvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ prārthayāmyaham | ditimāśīḥ pradatvaiva brahmā tvantaradhīyata ||29|| gataḥ sa drāṅmahāvegānmahāvaikuṇṭhamityatha | yatra nārāyaṇo devo bhagavān bhaktarakṣakaḥ ||1.133.30 || rājādhirājaḥ sarveṣāṃ śaṃkartā hi virājate | natvā stutvā copaviśyāsane kṛṣṇaṃ jagāda ha ||3 1 || dīnabandho dayāsindho jagaduddhārakṛdbhavān | dityai tapaḥphalaṃ dātuṃ samartho’sti sadācyuta |||32|| tayārthitau sutau nārāyaṇatulyau parākramaiḥ | tvameva tau pradānāya vicāraṃ kuru mādhava |||33|| yathā tasyā bhavetāṃ vai putrau sveṣṭau tathā kuru | nārāyaṇastadā svasya jyeṣṭhabhrātustu vedhasaḥ ||34|| vacanaṃ saphalīkartuṃ vicāraṃ kṛtavān hṛdi | nimittaṃ kiṃcidutpādya pūrayeyaṃ manoratham ||35|| yannimittamupāgṛhya mamāpi gamanaṃ bhuvi | yanmiṣeṇa manuṣyāṇāṃ mallīlācaritāni ca ||36 || geyāni ca miliṣyanti tena yāsyanti mokṣaṇam | tasmādetannimittaṃ me bhaktārthaṃ sukhadaṃ bhavet || 37|| madbhaktau matsamau syātāṃ madanyūnaparākramau | ditestāveva satputrau kārayitvā mama druhau ||38|| tapaḥphalaṃ pradātavyaṃ mama kāryaṃ tathā bhavet | vicāryeti hariḥ sākṣādavinayaṃ svapārṣadau ||39|| dvāsthau jayavijayākhyau prāveśayan svavāñcchayā | sanandanādicaturaḥ prairayannijadarśane ||1.133.40|| yāvacca vedhasā sākaṃ viṣṇorvārtā bhavatyati | tāvattu brahmaṇaḥ putrāḥ saṃkalpavegavattamāḥ ||41|| viṣṇostu darśanaṃ kartumājagmuḥ sanakādayaḥ | sanātanaśca sanakaḥ sanandanastṛtīyakaḥ ||42|| sanatkumārasturyaśca sarve te brahmavarcasaḥ | brahmaṇo mānasāḥ putrāḥ sarvajñā jñānamūrtayaḥ ||43|| vairāgyaṃ ca tṛṇīkṛtya vartamānā digambarāḥ | te pañcahāyanāḥ saumyā brahmamūrtaya eva ca ||44|| naranārīśarīrasthā doṣā yatra na santi vai | bhagavantaṃ vinā yeṣāṃ vṛttayo nānyasañcarāḥ ||4||| brahmadṛṣṭiṃ vinā yeṣāṃ dṛṣṭirnodbhavati kvacit | yeṣāṃ hṛtsu harermūrtiṃ vinā nānyadviśatyapi ||46|| nāmāni pragṛṇantaste cāyānti rājamārgataḥ | vaikuṇṭhavāsino’neke vaiṣṇavā yānti tānanu ||47|| praśaṃsanti ca tānbālānaho paśyata vaiṣṇavāḥ | rūpe kṛṣṇasamāścaite mandahāsyāsyacandrakāḥ ||48|| svarṇavarṇāḥ sūryatulyāstejoparidhiśobhanāḥ | manohāryaṃgasaṃpuṣṭāḥ sthalapadmāṃgakomalāḥ ||49|| nātidīrghasvarṇavarṇasnigdhaprāntālakānvitāḥ | kiraṇodgamabhālena muṣṇanto janamānasam ||1.133.50|| śaradabjadalanetrasthiradṛṣṭyatihṛdgamāḥ | raktapallavasattāmraraktauṣṭhacittahārakāḥ ||5 1 || kṛtordhvapuṃḍrakāḥ sarve karṇapuṣpāvataṃsakāḥ | devairdhṛtārcanahārāḥ koṭikoṭyarkabhāsurāḥ ||52 || vāmaskandhabrahmasūtrāḥ kaṭisthamuñjamekhalāḥ | rūpānurūpāvayavāḥ svarṇābhakarapattalāḥ ||53 || kaṇṭhe kare ca tulasīmālāṃ bibhranta aiśvarīm | svarṇarekhāmahālakṣmīvāso vakṣasi dṛśyate ||54|| nārāyaṇasamā rūpe cākṛtau kṛṣṇasadṛśāḥ | śvaitye dhyāne śaṃbhurūpāḥ śarīre brahmaṇāḥ samā ||55|| bhaktau lakṣmīsamāścaite ke bhaveyurjanā ime | paśyantu vaiṣṇāvāstvetānmahāpuruṣalakṣaṇān ||26|| asmadbhāgyavaśādetānpaśyāmo devapurūṣān | itidvitīyavaikuṇṭhavāsino vaiṣṇavā hyamūn ||57|| praśaṃsanti prapaśyanti tṛptiṃ yānti na darśane | āgacchatāṃ ca nagnānāṃ sarveṣāṃ bālarūpiṇām ||58|| gopura āgato yatra dvāḥsthau dvāraṃ hi rakṣataḥ | jayaśca vijayaścaiva prottasthatuḥ savetrakau ||59|| tāvanāpṛcchya gacchanti yāvattāvatsavetrakau | prāhatuḥ kā ime nagnā gacchantyantaḥpuraṃ katham ||1.133.60|| tiṣṭhantu naiva gacchantu pratyāvartantu ke gatāḥ | avinayena cāviṣṭāḥ pratiṣedhanti tānmuhuḥ ||6 1|| tathāpi tāvanādṛtya gacchanti brahmamānasāḥ | kiṃ dvāraṃ ke dvārapālā naiva paśyanti yoginaḥ ||62|| ātmatattvaṃ vinā cānyad yeṣāṃ dṛṣṭau na kilbiṣam | teṣāṃ ko vā vidhiścātha niṣedho rodha eva kaḥ ||63|| mā gacchantu ca mā yāntu ka ete badhirāḥ kimu | re stabdhāḥ kanyakādṛśyāḥ ke yūyaṃ pāyugūbharāḥ ||64|| ajñātāḥ kva nvime yānti jaya gaccha nivartaya | ke vai gardabhikāputrāḥ kasmācchūnīsutā ime ||65|| atra caivāgatāḥ santi sabadhnantu janā imān | tāḍayantu ca pāṣāṇairbandhayantu drumaiḥ saha ||66|| nirlajjā yāntyagaṇayya dṛśyante vai nirañjanāḥ | are vaḥ pitarau sto vā mṛtiṃ yāntau kathaṃ mṛgāḥ ||67|| vivastrā niṣparigrahāḥ kasya bhramatha mārgaṇe | na santi mātaro vo’tra drutaṃ dhāvantvitaḥ sthalāt ||68|| nivartante na cedete yaṣṭiṃ kuru gudasthale | ityevaṃ vijayo yāvajjayaṃ vakti tadā punaḥ || 69 || parāvṛtya ca saṃsthitvā śrutaṃ sarvamamaṃgalam | na gacchantyagratastāvanna vadanti kimuttaram ||1.133.70 || jayo gatvā svavetreṇa tānpṛṣṭhe mṛdvatāḍayat | madhye nitambayosteṣāṃ lakuṭyā samapīḍayat ||7 1 || datvā capeṭikāṃ gaṇḍe mastake samatāḍayat | liṃgāṃ gṛhītvā caiteṣāṃ chedayantvityabhīṣayat ||72|| iti bhartsya tiraskṛtya prakoṣṭhe parigṛhya ca | baddhvaikavallikārajjvā caturo’pyaniṣkāsayat ||73 || dhūlīḥ prakṣipya pṛṣṭhe tān mukhe kārṣṇamakārayat | ityevaṃ jayavijayāvavinayena mohitau ||74|| bālānmatvā tiraskārādyaparādhānpracakratuḥ | tāvadramā jayā cānyāḥ sakhyo vihartumutsukāḥ ||75 || tadgopureṇa nirgatya yāntyastāndadṛśustadā | paricitānviṣṇurūrpauṃścaturnārāyaṇānimān ||76|| patitvā pādayosteṣāmarhaṇaṃ cakrire’vanam | dhūlīnirdhūnanaṃ rajjubandhapramokṣaṇaṃ tathā ||77 || pādayoścumbanaṃ caiva mārjanaṃ cakrire muhuḥ | aho keneva duṣṭena nāthānāmardanaṃ kṛtam ||78 || kasya hastau ca pādau ca bhagnau bhāgyaṃ ca visphuṭam | vā kasyānnamitaḥ sthānāt samāptimagamat khalu ||79 || kasya jalaṃ tūdvinaṣṭamudiyāya ravirghṛṇī | kasya vā puṇyarekhādya trūṭitā dharaṇīṃ gatā ||1.133.8 0|| etādṛśānāṃ sādhūnāmavamānaṃ tu kaiḥ kṛtam | teṣāṃ naivātra vāso’sti bhavennaiva vidantu te ||8 1 || yāvannārāyaṇonaiva jānāti tāvadeva hi | avamānayitustvatra sthitiḥ paścāttu nāsti hi ||8 2 || ityevaṃ lapamānāstā dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā rudanti ca | tāvallalitayā gatvā nārāyaṇāya veditam |||83 || yāvacchṛṇoti deveśo drāk padbhyāṃ dhāvitaḥ svakāt | siṃhāsanāt samutthāyāprāvṛtābhyāṃ ciraveda ca ||84|| yāvadāyāti vai tatra gopure śrīhariḥ svayam | tāvattu lakṣaśaḥ patnyaḥ koṭiśo vaiṣṇavā api ||85 || samājagmuḥ sthale tatra praṇemuḥ sanakādikān | śrīharistān catuḥsādhūn praṇanāma sadaṇḍavat ||86 || kiṃ kṛtaṃ kena cetyevamapṛcchadavamānakam | bhavādṛśānāṃ sādhūnāṃ kṛtaṃ yenāvamānanam ||87|| na sa me gopure caiva vaikuṇṭhe vāsamarhati | mama pādau ca hastau sādhvaparādhakarau yadi ||88|| chindyāṃ tau yadi netraṃ vā jihvāṃ vā kartayāmi tām | lakṣmīṃ svakāṃ jahāmyeva sādhvaparādhakāriṇīm ||89|| lokavāyusparśahīnāḥ kilbiṣāspṛṣṭamānasāḥ | bālā api viharanti kalyāṇāya gṛhārthinām ||1.133.90 || bālā api na vai bālā mokṣādeḥ pitaro matāḥ | pāvanāḥ pāpināṃ lokapāvakā vicaranti hi ||9 1|| kṣamāpayantvaparādhān kṛpāṃ kṛtvā mamopari | antaḥsaudhaṃ samāyāntu gṛhṇantu dāsasevanam ||92|| ityabhyarthya ca teṣāṃ vai pādapāṃsūn śirasyadhāt | nītvā nārāyaṇastām̐śca yāvadāyācca gopure |||93|| pārṣadau jayavijayau tāvattejovihīnakau | mlānamukhau sakampau ca dṛṣṭau nārāyaṇena vai ||94|| tāvattaiḥ śiśubhiḥ proktaṃ harerdhāmnyatra nirguṇe | pavitre sarvathā śānte sukhade mokṣabhūmike ||95|| nirvikāre mahāsaumye divye hariniketane | nedṛśau dvārapau yogyau duḥkhadau maukṣanāśakau ||96|| savikārau tathā kruddhāvaślīlavācau stabdhakau | śiṣṭācārarahitau cāsuravatkṛtyakāriṇau ||97|| yato yogyāvāsuriṃ vai yonimeva prasevitum | na tu yogyau śuddhasattvavaikuṇṭhaṃ dhāma sevitum ||98|| śrīhareḥ pādayoretau krūrau yogyau na vai matau | yatpāpāmāsurīṃ yoniṃ yuvāṃ yātaṃ padacyutau ||99|| yāvadvai patataḥ sthānāt śāpayogāttadā punaḥ | prārthayāmāsaturviprānkṣamārthaṃ cāśrunetrakau || 1.133.100 || nārāyaṇecchayā prahvībhāvaṃ yātā dayālavaḥ | munayaḥ śiśavaścāhustānātrijanma tattathā || 10 1|| tataścāsurabhāvaṃ tu vihāyaitatsamāpsyathaḥ | punardauvārikatvaṃ vai gamiṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ || 1 02|| evaṃ śaptau svabhavanātpatitau viṣṇulokataḥ | diteḥ putrau tu tau jātau mahādaityau mahābalau || 1 03|| vaikuṃṭhe ca tayoḥ sthāne ajaṃ ajayameva ca | niyuyoja harirdvārapālau yāvattadāgamaḥ || 1 04|| lakṣakoṭidāsadāsīramārāmājayādibhiḥ | ātithyaṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi bhojanaṃ pādavāhanam || 1 05|| vividhaṃ sevanaṃ pānaṃ mardanaṃ śayanādikam | sampāditaṃ caturṇāṃ tu sanakādikaśaṃjuṣām || 106|| kṛtvaiva darśanaṃ samyak datvā ca darśanaṃ svakam | puṇyaṃ nītvā ca datvā cāgatā lokaṃ tu satyakam || 107|| vedhasā saha cāyātāste vai svapitṛmandiram | tato gatāḥ kaśyapaṃ vai draṣṭuṃ merau tataśca te || 108|| putrayorharisamayorāśīrvādānvidhāya ca | jagmurdhāma harerdivyaṃ śvetadvīpaṃ sadāsanam || 1 09|| atha jayaśca vijayo hyāsuraṃ bhāvamāsthitau | hiraṇyakaśipurjyeṣṭho hiraṇyākṣo’nujo’bhavat || 1.133.110 || varṣaśataṃ garbhasaṃsthau na ca janma hyavāpatuḥ | yadi janma bhavettarhi duḥkhaṃ prāpsyāvahe yataḥ || 11 1|| janma naiva parigrāhyamiti matvā na nirgatau | nāradena tadāgatya tatra tau tu prabodhitau || 1 12|| janmanāṃ grahaṇenaiva trijanmānte punaḥ svakam | prāpsyatho vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma pārṣadau ca bhaviṣyathaḥ || 1 13|| ityādiśya tato mantramādideśa punastathā | lakṣmīnārāyaṇetyevamāśrāvyājñāpayattadā || 1 14|| dveṣabhāvena vai lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ bhajiṣyathaḥ | dvitīye janmani sītārāmaṃ caiva bhajiṣyathaḥ || 1 15|| tṛtīye janmani kṛṣṇaṃ naraṃ cāpi bhajiṣyathaḥ | tato muktiṃ pragantārau bhaviṣyatho na saṃśayaḥ || 1 16|| iti coktvā gato devo nāradaḥ svaṃ trilokanam | aṭanārthaṃ pārṣadau tvāsurau janma hyavāpatuḥ || 1 17|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathamaṃ kṛtayugasantāne diteḥ putrārthaṃ tapo vedhasa āśīrvādo vaikuṇṭhagamanaṃ tatra viṣṇuṃ samprārthyavedhasā nārāyaṇasamaputraprāptivaradānakathanaṃ tato haripreraṇayā sanakādīnāṃ vaikuṇṭhagamane jayavijayābhyāṃ tiraskṛte janmatrayāsurabhāvaprātiśāpena hiraṇyakaśipuhiraṇyākṣajanmādivṛttāntakathananāmā trayastriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 133||
<1.134> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca kaśyapasya ca tau putrau jātamātrau mahābalau | hiraṇyasamavarṇābhau mahāvīryabaloddhatau || 1 || hiraṇyakaśipurjyeṣṭho hiraṇyākṣo’nujaḥ sa ca | apramāṇaśarīro’bhūt bhrūstasya parvatīsamā || 2 || sa vai mahājale yāti yāti pavanamaṇḍale | gamane cāntarīkṣe ca divi yāti punaḥpunaḥ || 3 || grahavad bhramati vyomni pātāle yāti śeṣavat | prayāti pakṣivat merau cākāśe vainateyavat || 4 || aṣṭāvaraṇapāraṃ vai yāti kṛṣṇavimānavat | mahākāyo hiraṇyākṣo no gaṇayati kaṃcana || 5 || yathecchati tathā dehe vardhayati kṣitiśravat | yadā yadā vihārārthe yāti lokāntare tadā || 6 || cintāṃ karoti saḥ svīyajanmagṛhasya tatra vai | yadi kaściddharenme vai gṛhaṃ svarṇamayaṃ tadā || 7 || nirādhāro bhaviṣyāmi vicāryāvartate punaḥ | hiraṇyākṣeṇa saudhaḥ svaḥ kārito viśvakarmaṇā || 8 || merornitambabhūmau 3 cāntarīkṣe samastare | pṛthvyā ūrdhva sahasraṃ vai yojanānāṃ samāntare || 9 || yojanadaśasāhasraṃ pariṇāho gṛhasya vai | ucchrāyaśca sahasraṃ vai yojanānāṃ kṛtastathā || 1.134.10 || yāvadindrasya sūryasya somasya varuṇasya ca | bṛhaspatervedhasaśca smṛddhayo’syābhavam̐śca tāḥ || 11 || nūtana manaso bhāvyaṃ saumyaṃ vā sundaraṃ hi yat | dṛṣṭipathaṃ cāsya yāyādbhavet tanmahatāmapi || 12||| prasahya tatsamānīya gṛhe bhuṃkte hyakaṇṭakaḥ | evaṃ smṛddha gṛhaṃ tasya merāvāsītsvaranyadut || 13||| evaṃ smṛddhaṃ gṛhaṃ tyaktvā yāti vihārabhūmiṣu | tadā cintāṃ karotyeva drogdhurvai parato bhayam || 14|| ataḥ sa ekadā samyagavvṛdhe meruvanmahān | uddhāṭya bāhusāhasre cotpāṭya ca mahīmimām || 15|| sāntardvīpāṃ saśailāṃ ca meroḥ saudhaṃ viyujya ca | merordūramubhau nītvā praviveśa mahājalam || 16 || hāhākāro mahānāsītpṛthvīnāśe trayodaśa | lokāścātrāvaśiṣyante’nyeṣāṃ nāśo’pi vai bhavet || 17|| prāṇisamāśritā sarvā pṛthvī nītā saparvatā | savanakānanā sarvā mahādaityena saṃdhṛtā || 18|| karāmalakavannītā prāpitādho mahājalam | tato devagaṇāḥ sarve cukruśurbhayapīḍitāḥ || 19|| śaraṇaṃ prayayurdevaṃ nārāyaṇahariprabhum | dugdhābdhitīramāsādya tuṣṭuvurbahuvistaram |||1.134.20 || rakṣa trāhi hare pāhi procya petuḥ padorbhuvi | rakṣa trāhi hare pāhi procya petu padārhikaiḥ ||21 || śrutvā nārāyaṇo devaḥ samāgacchatpatattriṇā | sarvān viśvāsayāmāsa jñātavānadbhutaṃ mahat ||22|| śaṃkhacakragadādhārī viśvarūpī janārdanaḥ | vārāharūpamāsthāya saṃsthito devasaṃyutaḥ | anādimadhyāntavapurmahādaṃṣṭro mahābhujaḥ || 2 3 || hāhākāraṃ mahāśabdaṃ kurvanromāṇi dhūnayan | viśvataḥ pāṇipāccakṣuḥsarvayajñamayo hariḥ | kṛṣṇavarṇo meghanīlo babhūva merusannibhaḥ || 24 || mukhāṃ vārāharūpaṃ vai deho nārāyaṇātmakaḥ | śaṃkhacakragadākhaḍgaśakticarmādidhṛkprabhuḥ | jagāma tarasā vyomnādho’dho’dho yanmahājalam || 25 || tasya gatau gato bhrāntaścakrito’bhūnmahānilaḥ | tadādhārā gṛhāścāpi kṛṣyante smāsya pṛṣṭhataḥ || 26 || mahājalaṃ yadā devaḥ praviṣṭaśca tadāsuraḥ | bhayena tarasā vyāpto’pyabhūd yuddhāya tatparaḥ || 27 || pṛthvīṃ kukṣau tadāsthāpya hiraṇyākṣo mahāsuraḥ | meruvajjagṛhe dehaṃ gadāṃ śaityācalopamām || 28 || bhrāmayitvā mahādaityo yuyodha jagadīśvaram | gadāyuddhaṃ śatavarṣaṃ bahujātaṃ vināśakam || 29 || tadā vārāharūpo’sau harirmerusamo’bhavat | daṃṣṭro ca vardhitā dīrghā vajrātivajraniṣṭhurā || 1.134.30 || pañcahimālayasthūlā daśahimādridīrghikā | daṃṣṭrāgraṃ tu mahātīkṣṇaṃ śatagavyūtimānavat || 31 || balaṃ vairājadehasya prāvirbhāvya tadā hariḥ | daṃṣṭrayā taṃ mahādaityaṃ paphāḍa parameśvaraḥ || 32 || maraṇe’kāri daityena mahārāvo bhayānakaḥ | trāsakṛdbāhyasṛṣṭīnāṃ vairājeśvaravāsinām || 33 || devānāmāhlādakṛcca daityādīnāṃ bhayaṃkaraḥ | avyāpnotsarvasṛṣṭyādāvutsavo’bhūt sthale sthale || 24 || saṃcūrṇitamahāgātro mamāra ditijo’dhamaḥ | patitāṃ dharaṇīṃ dṛṣṭvā svarṇasaudhaṃ ca tatra vai || 35 || daṃṣṭrayoddhṛtya deveśo hyājagāma bhuvastalam | merau yathābhavallagnā tathā pṛthvīṃ suyujya ca || 36 || tathaiva dṛśyarūpo’sau jagāma vai svakaṃ gṛham | tatra kṣīranidhestīre kroḍarūpaṃ mahāharim || 37 || dṛṣṭvā vai devatā bhaktinamrāstuṣṭuvurādarāt | namo mahāvarāhāya suyajñamūrtaye namaḥ || 38 || namo merusvarūpāya daityaghnāya namonamaḥ | namo mahāsudaṃṣṭrāya dharaṇīdhāriṇe namaḥ || 39 || samagravedavedāṃgamūrtaye te namonamaḥ | namaḥ sahasrahastāya namo viśvasvarūpiṇe ||1.134.40 || sargasthitisvarūpāya namaḥ kālasvarūpiṇe | nūtnarūpadhṛte te ca sarvatrātre namonamaḥ ||41 || śrībhūlīlāramālakṣmīkaṃbharāpataye namaḥ | namaḥ śāntasvarūpāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ ||42|| iti stutvā tayā devairmunibhiḥ ṛṣibhirbhuvā | vārāhasya hareḥ pūjā kṛtāsrakcandanādibhiḥ ||43|| samarcyamānastairdevaisteṣāmiṣṭaṃ varaṃ dadau | yadā yadā ca devānāmṛṣīṇāṃ matkalātmanām ||44|| āpadāyāttadā rakṣāṃ kariṣye smārito yadā | ityabhidhāya gandharvairapsarobhirmaharṣibhiḥ ||45|| gīyamānasstūmānastatraivāntaradhīyata | evaṃ kroḍāvatārāśca kalpe kalpe tadantare || 46 || bhavanti me jalayoge mahākārye hyupasthite | etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ vārāhaṃ vaibhavādikam ||47|| hiraṇyākṣādbalino’pi hiraṇyakaśiporvadhe | nārasiṃhaṃ dhṛtaṃ rūpaṃ vakṣye lakṣmi śṛṇu priye ||48|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne svavaimānikaprāsādena saha pṛthvīṃ nītavato hiraṇyākṣasya vārāharūpeṇa mahājale kṛtasaṃhārādivarṇananāmā catustriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 134 ||
<1.135> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu devi mahālakṣmi hiraṇyakaśipuḥ svakam | bhrātaraṃ nihataṃ śrutvā paryatapyadruṣā jvalan || 1 || uvāca daśanairoṣṭhaṃ daśan cāsphoṭayannurū | netre ca cūrṇayan rakte krodhāgnijvālite’ śvasan || 2 || garjayan vivaraṃ bhaumaṃ nirīkṣan dhūmramambaram | vikarālo mahākrūraḥ kampayam̐śca padā mahīm || 3 || duṣprekṣyabhūnetrakuṭiḥ svedabindulalāṭakaḥ | prāleyameghavadvyagro hyudgacchadroṣavāridhiḥ || 4 || khaṅga dīrghaṃ kare dhṛtvā samutthāya tadāsanāt | ākrauśanmeghavacchīghraṃ khaṅgamuttolya cāmbare || 5 || sambodhayandaityasabhāṃ pṛthvīṃ nirvīryaśobhanām | manyate yadi vai kaścit sa ghāsagrāsamatti vai || 6 || nirvīryā nahi daiteyā na bhūrnivīryadhāriṇī | nirvīryāstu śvasanto’pi mṛtā eva vinā mṛtim || 7 || na gaṇaye mahāviṣṇuṃ mahāviṣṇoḥ pitāmaham| tarhi ko nāma viṣṇurvai paśurūpeṇa sañcaran || 8 || yadi viṣṇuḥ svamanasi jānāti balagarvitaḥ | daityamūrdhanyahantāha tadātti ghāsameva saḥ || 9 || na daityā vai mṛtāḥ sarve yena viṣṇuḥ sukhī bhavet | sati daitye sukhī syāt ceddaityo’tti ghāsameva saḥ || 1.135.1 0|| sati viṣṇau na vai daityaḥ sati daitye na mādhavaḥ | viṣṇurjīvenmriyeddaityo daityo jīvenmriyeddhariḥ || 11 || na dvayorjīvatoḥ pṛthvyā rājyaṃ tu syādakaṇṭakam | balena yadi vā smṛddhyā vāhanena ca hetibhiḥ || 12|| sainyena vidyayāstraiśca mantreṇa nyūnatāsti cet | kariṣye sutapo ghoraṃ yena viṣṇurabhūddhariḥ || 13 || ahaṃ tato’pyadhikaṃ vai kariṣye tapa ulbaṇam | tādṛśānkoṭiviṣṇūn vai grasiṣye kavalena yat || 14|| mahākālamapigrāsaṃ kariṣye ko’yameḍakaḥ | meṣo’sti mama sāmye’yaṃ viṣṇurvaiṣṇavapūjitaḥ || 15|| dūraṃ daityakulādyāti cāntaryāti jalālayam | tasmāddaityā bhavantyeva susajjāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ || 1 6|| apacitiṃ kariṣyāmo mama bhrāturmahātmanaḥ | maddhetibhinnadehasya bhūriṇā rudhireṇa vai || 17|| raktapriyaṃ tarpayiṣye bhrātaraṃ me gatavyathaḥ | bho namuce śatabāho dvimūrdhastryakṣa śambara || 18|| bho śatāre sahasrāre bho puloman samilvala | bho pramedya mahādhūmra bho devāre gajāsura || 19 || re bho śakuna kākākṣe śṛṇutānantaraṃ mama | yūyaṃ yāta bhuvaṃ sarve viprakṣatrādirūpataḥ ||1.135.20 || sūdayadhvaṃ tapoyajñakāriṇo brāhmaṇānmuhuḥ | viṣṇorbalaṃ brāhmaṇairvai yajñaiḥ saṃvardhitaṃ sadā ||2 1 || yajñairdevāḥ sadā puṣṭiṃ yānti svarganivāsinaḥ | pitaraścāpi yajñena tṛptā bhavanti sarvadā ||22|| munayaḥ ṛṣayaścāpi viṣṇurvaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ | sarve’pi yajñabhāgairvai puṣṭiṃ yānti muhurmuhuḥ ||23 || yajñenendraḥ pravarṣati meghāśca vṛṣṭisanmukhāḥ | brāhmaṇā dakṣiṇāpūrṇā yajño mūlaṃ hi jīvane ||24|| brāhmaṇānāṃ vināśena yajñā naṣṭā bhavanti vai | yajñanāśe kuto vṛṣṭirdevānāṃ jīvanaṃ kutaḥ || 25|| viprayajñasurāṇāṃ ca vināśe sukhino vayam | evaṃ tapaḥprabhāveṇa samedhitā maharṣayaḥ ||26 || tasmānnārīḥ saha nītvā kurvantu tapasāṃ kṣayam | rūpāntarāṇi kāryāṇi sādhyante hyanurūpakaiḥ || 27|| tasmād bhavantu brāhmaṇyo daityapatnyaḥ sthale sthale | daityā bhavantu viprāśca munīnāṃ sevakāstathā || 28||| ūṭajāni mahāraṇye racayitvā vasantu vai | mṛṣāgnihotrakartāro mṛṣāyajñapradarśakāḥ || 29 || mṛṣādharmapradeṣṭāro bhavantu vanavāsinaḥ | mṛṣā brāhmaṇadharmeṇa teṣvāviśya ca chadmanā || 1.135.3 0 || mārayantu bhakṣayantu nāśayantu yathākṣaṇam | yatra yatra dvijā yajñā gāvo dharmāśca satkriyāḥ || 31 || tatra tatra yāta yūyaṃ sandīpayata vṛścata | pratijñāṃ prakurutātra sadasyuddhṛtahetayaḥ || 32 || sarvaidaityairmilitvaiva hyekībhūya ca sarvadā | brāhmaṇānāṃ kratūnāṃ ca nāśaḥ kāryaḥ sadaiva hi || 32 || atra ye saṃgatā na syuste jñeyāḥ suravardhakāḥ | hantavyāste daityayūthairanyathā mātṛghātakāḥ || 34|| ityāśrutya hiraṇyādyakaśiporvijayo’stu vai | uccāryaivaṃ ca daityāste saśastroddhṛtapāṇayaḥ || 32|| cakruḥ pratijñāṃ tadvākyād yātā deśāntaraṃ bhavi | viprāṇāṃ kadanaṃ cakruḥ pradehuḥ pattanāni ca || 36|| bibhidurnagarāṇyanye prādahan śaraṇārthinaḥ | babhañjuryajñavistārānkadanaṃ cakrire mahat || 37|| tadā devāśca viprāśca pṛthvyāṃ ceruralakṣitāḥ | tadā lakṣmi mahādaityo hiraṇyakaśipuḥ svakān || 38 || upadiśyaiva caikākī jagāma mandarācalam | bhogānsarvānparityajyaikākī ca nirjane vane || 39|| tapastepe mahāghoraṃ divyavarṣasahasrakam | vāyubhakṣo nirāhāraḥ pādāṃguṣṭhopari sthitaḥ ||1.135.40 || rudropari mahādaityo rudrāya nama īrayan | pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu mūrdhnastasya mahātmanaḥ ||41 || dhūmaḥ samudbhavan ghoro vyomnyutthito vyavardhayat | ābrahmabhavanaṃ vyāpto mahātejo’titāpanaḥ ||42|| yathāgnervā ravervāpi jvālāmālānvito bhavet | dāvānalo’thavā kiṃ vā vāḍavānala eva vā ||43 || tathānalo dhūmravarṇo hyutthito vyomapāragaḥ | tenāgninā samantādvai jajvaluśca diśo daśa ||44|| tena taptāḥ svargadevā brahmalokaṃ yayustadā | brahmaṇe jñāpayāmāsustapo daityasya duḥsaham || 45|| tadutthavahniśamanaṃ vidhehi tvaritaṃ prabho | anyathā sa mahādaityo vairājapadamicchati ||46|| brahmaviṣṇumaheśāstu tṛṇayante tadagrataḥ | itisaṃkalpabalinā tapasā jetumicchati ||47|| vināśayitvā devādīn vidhāsye sunavāṃ sṛjim | daityarūpāṃ svānukūlāṃ daityamayīṃ svatejasā ||48|| mahākālaṃ vaśīkṛtya cāpunarmārakāṃ sṛje | kiṃ kālakavalāpannānvṛthā viṣṇupadādibhiḥ ||49|| itinirbandhamāsthāya karoti duścaraṃ tapaḥ | tadvidhatsva yathānyāyaṃ trāhi śīghraṃ surādikān ||1.135.50 || devānnītvā saha brahmā rudraṃ prati gatastataḥ | śrāvayāmāsa rudrāya nītvā ca saha śaṃkaram |||51 || jagmuḥ sarve mandarasya droṇyāṃ yatra sa daityarāṭ | ākāśātparito dṛṣṭaṃ sthalaṃ kvāste mahāsuraḥ ||52|| na spaṣṭo dṛśyate kvāpi bahudhā mārgito’pi saḥ | tathāpi nirjane śuṣke’raṇye valmikamastakāt ||53 || jvālāmālāsamucchrāyo ghaṭṭadhūmrordhvamiśritaḥ | sarvairdṛṣṭastarkitaśca daityarājo’tra saṃbhavet ||54||| yāvat tvavatarantīme jvālāmālipradeśake | tatra dṛṣṭo mahānbhūmerucchrāyo mṛnmayotthitaḥ |||55||| pipīlikābhirācīrṇo vṛkṣāgryatṛṇakīcakaiḥ | vyāptaḥ śuṣkairmahāstambaiḥ suśṛṃgairiva parvataḥ |||56|| vividhaiḥ svalpaśṛṃgāḍhyairvalmīkaiḥ parigopitaḥ | pracchannaḥ śuṣkamāṃsāsragasthilambitajīvanaḥ ||57|| tatra samādhinā dṛṣṭo brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā | brahmāpyāścaryamagno’bhūdanye tu kampitāstadā ||58 || aho tapaḥparākāṣṭhetyūcurvigalitāntarāḥ | prāha vedhāḥ prahasan vai prapautraṃ kāśyapaṃ tadā ||59|| uttiṣṭha putra prottiṣṭha tapaḥsiddhirabhūt tava | ayaṃ rudro mahādevo varadānāya cāgataḥ ||1.135.60 || kaśyapastava janakastasyāpi janakastathā | maricirapyāgato’sti tasya bhrātara uttamāḥ |||61|| samāyātāstava kṛte prasannāstapasā tava | varapradā ime prāptā vṛṇu tvaṃ yadabhīpsitam ||62|| paśyāmaste cātmabalaṃ tapaaugryaṃ tato’pi ca | na kṛtaṃ na kariṣyantīdṛśaṃ cānye madantare ||63|| nirjalaṃ cāsthisaṃghāte prāṇān varṣāṇi vai śatam | ko’nyastu dhārayedevaṃ yathepsitaṃ varaṃ vṛṇu ||64|| puna punarbodhyamāno bahirnāyātsa vai yadā | deho’sya pṛthvyā saṃlīnaścātmā līnastu śaṃkare ||65|| kaḥ śṛṇoti ko jāgarti śavakalpasamādhigaḥ | śuṣkakāṣṭhakaṭhorāsthisaṃdhayaḥ kāṣṭhatāṃ gatāḥ |||66||| pāṣāṇakalpo daityendro yadā na kampate manāk | tadā tu brahmaṇā svasya kamaṇḍalujalaṃ śubham ||67|| kare nidhāya mantraiśca sajīvanavidhāyakaiḥ | abhimantrya prokṣitastadvalmīke tāvadeva saḥ ||68|| yuvā sūryasamo rūpe supuṣṭo divi devavat|| vajratulyaśarīrāṃgaḥ svarṇavarṇaḥ samutthitaḥ ||69|| vidhūya śarīrād vṛkṣastambapipīlikāmṛdaḥ | dṛṣṭvā devān brahmarudrakaśyapādīn nanāma ca ||1.135.70|| praharṣitaścakāraiṣāmātithyamaśrucakṣuṣā | rudraḥ prāha tadā daityaṃ kiṃ te manasi rocate ||71|| yadarthaṃ tapa ātiṣṭho vṛṇu varāndadāmyaham | śrutvā dṛṣṭvā ca varadaṃ natvā gadgadayā girā ||72|| namaḥ sarvādhibhūtāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ | tapaḥphalapradātre te brahmaṇe śaṃbhave namaḥ ||73|| namo’stu janakāyātrabhavate kaśyapāya ca | namo marīcaye tadvat sarvarṣibhyo namonamaḥ ||74|| sarve śubhapradātāro bhavantu mama sarvadā | yadi deyā varā mahyaṃ pātraṃ cāhaṃ mato’smi vaḥ ||79|| surāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām | paśupakṣimṛgāṇāṃ ca siddhānāṃ ca mahātmanām ||76|| yakṣavidyādharāṇāṃ codbhijjānāṃ kinnarātmanām | kiṃpuṃsāṃ sarvarogāṇāṃ mantryāyudhāstrayantriṇām ||77|| sarveṣāṃ dattaśāpānāmavadhyatvaṃ ca me bhavet | nāntarbahirna divase na rātrau cijjaḍairna ca ||78|| na pṛthvyāṃ nāmbare mṛtyurmama syādajasṛṣṭitaḥ | yuddhe cāpratidvandvatvamekapatyaṃ ca dehinām ||79|| sarveṣāṃ lokapālānāmīśvaratvamakhaṇḍitam | tapoyogaprabhāvāṇāmavināśo mamāstviti ||1.135.80 || ityete tu varāḥ sveṣṭā dīyantāṃ pitṛbhiśca me | brahmājñayā tadā rudraḥ prāha śiṣyaṃ tapasvinam ||8 1|| śiṣya caite varāḥ janmavatāṃ tu durlabhāḥ sadā | tathāpi vitarāmo’dya kaḥ sṛṣṭau śāśvato janaḥ ||82|| iti dattvā varān rudrabrahmādyāḥ ketanaṃ yayuḥ | hiraṇyakaśipuścāpi nivavṛte tapaḥsthalāt ||83|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne hiraṇyakaśipuḥ sakrodho viprayajñādināśārthaṃ daityānuttejayanmandarācale tapo’rthaṃ jagāma rudrabrahmādibhiḥ samāgatya tasmai vedhasaḥ sṛṣṭyāmaratvaṃ vitaritamitivarṇananāmā paṃcatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 35||
<1.136> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ sā kathā lakṣmi tvayā caikamanīṣayā | evaṃ varānsamāpanno hiraṇyakaśipuḥ ripuḥ || 1 || smṛtvā bhrātṛvināśaṃ vai dveṣaṃ karoti mādhave | gatvā gatvā diśāḥ sarvā jitvā tathā ca sāgarān || 2 || dvīpām̐stathopasudvīpān pātālasahitāṃ bhuvam | vedhaḥsthānaṃ parityajya sarvaṃ vaśīcakāra saḥ || 3 || manūnṛṣīnpitṛpatīnsurāsurāndivaspatīn | siddhacāraṇagāndharvān vidyādhrānmānuṣām̐stathā || 4 || yakṣarakṣaḥpretabhūtapiśācoragakinnarān | kiṃpuruṣām̐śca kūṣmāṇḍān vetālām̐śca vināyakān || 5 || sādhyāṃśca maruto viśvedevānsarisṛpām̐stathā | nāgān salilakṛdvāsām̐strilokisthānadhīśvarān || 6 || jitvā vaśaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā viśvajitso’bhavannatha | lokapālakṛtā devāḥ prāsādāḥ smṛddhayastathā || 7 || devodyānāni sarvāṇi sāmudraṃ ratnajātakam | mahendrabhavanaṃ yāvat dikpālānāṃ gṛhāṇi ca || 8 || grahāṇāṃ ca rathāḥ sarve devā devyo navā navāḥ | sarvaṃ vaśīkṛtaṃ tena daityāḥ sarvatra yojitāḥ || 9 || caturdaśabhuvanānāmagryā lakṣmīrnijīkṛtā | mahanto divyasatsaudhāḥ prāsādāḥ paramālayāḥ || 1.136.1 0|| yatra vidrumasopānā divyasphāṭikabhittayaḥ | mahāmārakatīsthalyo vaidūryastambharājayaḥ || 1 1|| divyāmbaravitānāni padmarāgāsanāni ca | vimānāni mahārhāṇi candraśālāḥ sudīptayaḥ || 12|| dugdhaphenasamāḥ śayyā muktāmaṇiparicchidāḥ | khānapānavilāsāśca vilāsinyo’bdaṣoḍaśāḥ || 13|| svarṇavarṇāḥ sugandhāḍhyāḥ mṛgākṣyo viditeṅgitāḥ | sakiṃkiṇīkanakakṛnnūpuraśabditagṛhāḥ || 14|| sadratnakhacitādarśadṛṣṭānanasaroruhāḥ | sudatyaḥ svalpamadhyāśca padmapatrāyatekṣaṇāḥ || 15|| susaṃkocavikāsādiśaktisvātantryasaṃbhṛta| dṛḍhagranthyagramadhyāntahṛsvāvakāśayonayaḥ | svarṇavarṇacamatkāracaṃcadgātrāḥ surastriyaḥ || 16 || vilasanti yatra daityaṃ ramayanti ca sarvadā | prāsādāstena te sarve svādhikāre vaśīkṛtāḥ || 17|| sarvadevābhivanditapādapīṭho mahābalaḥ || rājate ca mahendrasya siṃhāsanavirājitaḥ | aśeṣadhiṣṇyapairdivyopadābhiḥ paripūjitaḥ || 18|| viśvāvasutumburugāndharvāgryairatyabhistutaḥ | siddharṣimunividyādhrāpsarobhiḥ kṛtasaṃstavaḥ || 19|| nārāyaṇo’para iva rājate bhuvanaikarāṭ | yajñeṣu dānakāryeṣu vaiśvānaravidhānake ||1.136.20 || ityābhāgān svayaṃ bhuṃkte’rpitā ṛtvigbhirādarāt | bhūstasyāsīd vasumatī medinyakṛṣṭapākadā ||2 1|| svargaṃ kāmapravarṣyabhūd vāyuḥ śāntikaro’vasat | ratnānyarpayate cābdhiḥ saritaḥ salilāni ca ||22|| saptadvīpāḥ samudrāśca sevante vardhayanti tam | śailā drumā vanodyānāḥ ṛtavo gaganaṃ tathā |||23 || svasvaparicchadaistasya sevāṃ kurvanti nityaśaḥ | agnistasya pāvako’bhūd vāyurvai gṛhamārjakaḥ || 24|| pṛthvī śayyākarī cāsījjalaṃ vāriharaṃ hyabhūt | medhāḥ śaityābhivyañjakavyajanārpayiṇo’bhavan || 25|| candro ratiśramanode śaityado’bhūtsadāsthitaḥ | kuberastasya bhūṣādhṛk gāyikā ca sarasvatī || 26|| indraḥ pānapradātābhūd yamo hārādhipo’bhavat | kṣīramiṣṭodakāḥ sarve sāgarāścodakumbhayaḥ || 27|| sūryastasya kirīṭasyābhavanmaṇyamaṇiḥ svayam | pātālāni ca daityasya pādapīṭhāstadābhavan || 28|| apsarasaḥ sadā dāsyo devyaśca pādamardikāḥ | nadyaḥ snānavidhāyinyo’raṇyāni phaladāni ca ||29 || kiṃ nyūnaṃ kṛtabhakteśca dāsasya padabhraṃśane | tatrāpi tapasā prāptaprasādasya sadā priye || 1.136.30|| na me bhaktasya kiñcidvai nyūnaṃ bhogye bhavediha | yadyadicchati tasmādapyadhikādhikamuddade || 31 || aiśvaryaṃ madasampattiryauvanaṃ cāvivekitā | pratyekaṃ cāpyanarthāya kimu yatra catuṣṭayam ||32|| tasmāttu sarvadā bhāvyaṃ nirlepatvena sarvathā | sa vai bhogaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca vindate’nyaḥ patatyadhaḥ |||33|| yathā yathā prabhuṃkte ca mūḍho viṣayaparvatān | tathā tathā bhavellubdho mohapāśaprajālitaḥ || 34|| yatheṣṭaṃ saḥ prabhuñjāno viṣayān sārvabhaumajān | nātyatṛpyanmahāmūrkhaḥ pratyutotpathago’bhavat |||35||| ugradaṇḍairlokapālānudvejayati tāmasaḥ | rakṣati na prajā daityānuttejayati pakṣataḥ ||36|| daityapakṣavardhayitā surapakṣavināśakaḥ | nināya kālamarbudamabdānāmevameva saḥ |||37|| tato duḥkhaṃ paraṃ prāptā udvignā lokapālinaḥ | ṛṣayo munayaścaiva brāhmaṇā naṣṭarakṣaṇāḥ ||38|| devāśca pitaraścānye ye ye duḥkhadaśānvitāḥ | te sarve kṣīradhestīre śaraṇaṃ yayuracyutam |||39|| namaḥ śaraṇyāya śāntasvarūpāya namonamaḥ | duḥkhāvāsāya daityāṃśalakṣmīsthitāya te namaḥ ||1.136.40|| rakṣākartre yatisanyāsārthine haraye namaḥ | parivarttanivāsāya parivartātmane namaḥ ||41|| bahukālaṃ svabhaktāya daityāya sārvabhaumakam | dattavān sāmprataṃ daityabhinnebhyo dātumarhasi ||42|| surādivāñcchitaṃ cāpi kṛpayā dātumarhasi | parāvarttaṃ kuru viṣṇotvasahyaḥ samayo gataḥ ||43|| iti prārthya surāḥ sarve kṣīrābdhyuttarabhūtale | samādhau susthitāścānye japayajñe vyavasthitāḥ ||44|| nārāyaṇādvaraṃ labdhvā rakṣāyā vacanaṃ tathā | tato yāsyāma iti me pratipattiṃ vidhāya ca ||45|| smaranti sma hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇamahāprabhum | tāvadākāśaśabdākhyā vāguvācāśarīriṇī ||46|| bho bhoḥ surādayo mukhyā yuṣmatkāryaṃ bhaviṣyati | āyatiḥ subhagā yuṣmatkṛte cāyāti niścitam ||47|| sarveṣāṃ kālacakrasyodayasyāvanatestathā | samayo bhavati paścānna bhavatyeva sarvathā ||48|| puṇyāpuṇyakṛtaṃ cakraṃ sarveṣāṃ kṛtibandhanam | pravartate yathānyāyaṃ tadasyāsti pravardhitaḥ ||49|| api mahattaraṃ puṇyaṃ hiraṇyakaśipoḥ khalu | prakāśate ca yāvat tannāśo’pi duṣkaraḥ khalu ||1.136.50 || daurātmyaṃ pūjyahāniścādharmaḥ patnyavrataṃ tathā | āyurnāśaṃ karotyeva puṇyanāśaṃ tu vegataḥ || 51 || so’yaṃ lakṣmīmadāndho vai samācarati tadbahu | pūrṇe nāśaṃ kariṣyāmi cekṣantāṃ kālamāgatam |||52|| dvijadevagavāṃ sādhvīsādhudharmakṛtāṃ mama | vidveṣo nāśakṛddhyāśu madbhaktasya viśeṣataḥ ||53 || tadasya divasāḥ prāyaḥ samāptā eva sarvathā | tadupāyaṃ karomyeva yāta yūyaṃ svakaṃ sthalam ||54|| ityabhidhāya sā vāṇī virame’tha surādayaḥ | taddiśaṃ śrīhariṃ smṛtvā natvā sadaṃḍavatpunaḥ ||55|| sarve yātāḥ svakaṃ sthānaṃ hataṃ daityaṃ ca menire | hariḥ prahlādamālakṣya daityanāśamaciklṛpat ||56|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne hiraṇyakaśipukṛtasuramunyādidveṣatadvaibhavatadvināśārthadevādikṛtaviṣṇvārādhanādivarṇananāmā ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 136 ||
<1.137> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ lakṣmīpatiḥ lakṣmi sulakṣmakṛt | devānāṃ hitakāryāya sarvārpaṇaṃ karoti vai || 1 || sutā tūttānapādasya kalyāṇīnāmakanyakā | hiraṇyakaśipoḥ patnī suṣuve caturaḥ sutān || 2 || prahlādaścāpi saṃhlāda āhlādo hlāda eva te | prathamastatra madbhakto mahātejā babhūva ha || 3|| mahāpuruṣasevāyāṃ tyaktānyaḥ sarvathābhavat | brahmaṇyaḥ śīlasampannaḥ satyavartanamānasaḥ || 4 || ātmeva sarvalokānāṃ hṛdayaṃgama eva saḥ | mahatāṃ pādasevāyāṃ kiṃkara iva vartate || 5 || dīnaduḥkhaharaḥ saumyaḥ paryupāsitamādhavaḥ | vidyābhaktiprabhuśaktismṛddha eva tu janmataḥ || 6 || gurugoviprabhaktaśca vyasanādivivarjitaḥ | anityāśuciduḥkhāni jānan tattvāni daihike || 7 || nābhūdāsakta īrṣyādimāyākāryavivarjitaḥ | na bālakrīḍanake’sti prasanno vai manāgapi || 8 || krīḍā tasya harermūrtau suhṛt tasya hariḥ svayam | anurakto hṛṣīkeśe garbhavāse’pi yo harau || 9 || sarvāvasthāsu kāryeṣu manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ | nānyaṃ jānāti vai viṣṇornārāyaṇāt sanātanāt || 1.137.10 || yasminmahāguṇāḥ sarve sāttvatānāṃ sadā matāḥ | vāsudeve harau kṛṣṇe tasya naisargikī matiḥ || 1 1|| jagatprati suṣuptaḥ sa jāgarti śrīhariṃ prati | svapan śvasan samuttiṣṭhan calan pārśvaṃ vivartayan || 12| plavamānaḥ kṣutau paśyan rasan jighran vadan spṛśan| piban kṣalan prabhuṃjāno milan kiṃcidvicārayan || 13|| nānyavṛttirharau vṛttiṃ rakṣan gṛṇan hare hare | dhyāyati smarati pratikṣaṇaṃ cintayate prabhum || 14|| kvacidaśrūṇi vai premṇā vimuṃcati hariṃ smaran | kvaciddhasati devaṃ sa divyaṃ paśyan hṛdi sthitam || 15|| kvacidudgāyati nāmānyatipremṇā hareḥ svayam | kvacinnṛtyati premātmā harau dravati ca kvacit || 16|| kvacitspṛṣṭo divyamūrtyā vilīno jāḍyameti saḥ | evaṃ brahmarasapluto nārāyaṇe suvartate || 17|| kṣudhā na tṛṣā tasya na bhūṣā nāṃgamārjanam | na vastrādisamībhāvo nānyaccitte vasatyadaḥ || 18|| netre harirmukhe kṛṣṇo jihvāyāṃ harireva ca | bāhye caivāntare kārye hariryasyāśrayo’bhavat || 19|| sa kāle copanītaḥ san gurorgehe’vasat sudhīḥ | guruḥ purohitastasya kāvyaścāsurapūjitaḥ |||1.137.20 || kāvyasya tasya śukrasya sutau dvau śāstrapāragau | ādyaḥ ṣaṇḍo’paro’markastau rājñārpitaputrakam |||2 1 || pāṭhayāmāsatuḥ pāṭhyānarthānāsurabhāvanān | tathā ca sāmavedādīn grāhyaṃ gṛhṇāti nāparam |||2|| daivyo’daivyo mahāvidyā bahvyaḥ sarvāḥ prapāṭhitāḥ | guruproktaṃ hi tatsarvaṃ śuśrāvānupapāṭha ca |||23 || yayā mokṣo bhavet tāṃ sa samyak gṛhṇāti bhāvataḥ | asadgrahāśrayāṃ cānyāṃ vidyāṃ tyajati cāntarāt ||24|| adhītya sarvavedām̐śca śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca | kasmim̐ścidatha kāle ca guruṇā saha daityajaḥ ||25|| pituḥ samīpamāgatya vavande pātayoḥ patan | taṃ pariṣvajya bāhubhyāṃ tanayaṃ śubhamānasam ||26|| aṃkamāropya papraccha hiraṇyakaśipuḥ pitā | prahlāda cirakāle tvaṃ gurorgehe niveśitaḥ ||27||| śikṣitaṃ guruṇā śreṣṭhaṃ tanmamācakṣva sādhu yat | prahrādastu namaskṛtya prahṛṣṭaḥ san jagāda tat |||28|| gṛhajāla mahāyāmyaṃ parityajyātmavit pumān | ātmamālaṃ hṛcchayanaṃ pariṣvajyātmanā yajet |||29|| sarvavidyārthasaṃcārī yo’sti śrīparameśvaraḥ | sa vai sarvagataḥ sādhurartho’nyo’rthastvapārthakaḥ ||1.137.3 0|| śrutvā putragiro viṣṇubhaktipravāhagarbhitāḥ | daityastu prahasan prāha gurūn putrapraśāsane |||3 1|| bālabuddhiḥ svacchavastrasamā pārśvastharopiṇī | viṣṇupakṣikṛto bhede buddhāvasya kathaṃ gataḥ |||32|| yathā na bhidyate cāsyāpakvā buddhistathārthataḥ | śāsathainaṃ pūjyapādāḥ punarnaivaṃ vadedayam ||3 3|| tadā vai guravastaṃ svaṃ gṛhamānīya sāmabhiḥ | samapṛcchanta kenāyaṃ viṣṇurartho’dhiśikṣitaḥ |||34|| nāyamartho daityapakṣasukhadastaṃ parityaja | svato vā parataste’yamartho viṣṇumayaḥ kutaḥ ||35|| prahlādaḥ prāha sarvātmā nārāyāṇapareśvaraḥ | sarvāntarātmā diśati bhaja nārāyaṇaṃ sadā |||36|| guruḥ prāha tvayā prokto nārāyaṇaḥ sa te pitā | nānyo nārāyaṇaḥ kaścittaṃ bhajasva sukhī bhava ||37|| śiṣyaḥ prāha guro satyaṃ nārāyaṇasya bhaktitaḥ | nārāyaṇasamā bhaktā bhavantyevaṃ na me pitā ||38|| narasamūhavāsena nārāyaṇo’pi me pitā | kālagrāso na tu divyo nārāyaṇo’kṣarādhipaḥ ||39|| tayorasti mahān bhedaḥ pataṃgadyupataṃgayoḥ | khadyotaṃ mama pitaraṃ mṛṣā vedmi na bhāskaram ||1.137.40|| ātmaprakāśakaṃ satyaṃ vedmi nārāyaṇaṃ guro | tathāpi pitaraṃ manye pitarameva kevalam ||41|| nātyadhikaṃ nārāyaṇadveṣitvānmānanaṃ na me | guruḥ prāha tathāpi tvaṃ pitṛśāsanamāvaha ||42|| pituḥ pūjāṃ paricaryāṃ sevāmājñāṃ sadāvaha | śikṣita iti prahrādaḥ sāyaṃ gṛhamupāgataḥ |||43|| pitrā saṃpariṣvajyāṃke snehapūrvaṃ niṣāditaḥ | sāmnā pṛṣṭaśca me putrādya tvayādhītamatra kim ||44|| vada śrutvā sukhī syāṃ te vidyāmasmatkulocitām | prahlādaḥ prāha pitaraṃ natvādhītaṃ bravīmi tat ||45|| bhavānnārāyaṇo rājyānmṛṣā naiva yathārthataḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ satyo vaikuṇṭhavāsisevitaḥ ||46|| taṃ bhajāmi bhajatvenaṃ bhavānapi pitarmama | śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ viṣṇo smaraṇaṃ pādasevanam | arcanaṃ vandanaṃ dāsyaṃ sakhyamātmanivedanam ||47|| navadhādhyāpanaṃ śreṣṭhamanyat sarvaṃ viḍambanam | navadhādhyayanaṃ kāryaṃ kimanyena viḍambinā ||48 || śrutvaitatparamaṃ bhaktimayaṃ daityapatistadā | saroṣo gurumāhetthaṃ kimetacchikṣitaṃ tvayā ||49|| mamātmajasya durbuddhe harisaṃstavabhṛdvacaḥ | kimarthamuktavānasmatkulākāryaṃ surocitam ||1.137.50 || guruputra kimetadvai vipakṣagataśikṣaṇam | pracchanno’si viṣṇupakṣapoṣakaśchadmaveśadhṛk ||5 1|| kapaṭināmasādhūnāmapi kālo na dūrataḥ | guruputrasya putrasya saha daṇḍo bhaviṣyati ||52|| guruputrastadā prāha nedṛgadhyāpitaṃ mayā | buddhinaisargikī tvasya mā kadarthīkarotu naḥ ||53||| tathāpi prāha daityendro nādhītaṃ tu gurostvayā | kasmādadhītametadvai vada bāla yathocitam ||54|| prahlādaḥ prāha daityendra kṛṣṇadattā matirmama | kṛṣṇabhaktarajoleśābhiṣiktatanumantarā ||55|| sādhuprasaṃgasatsevāmṛte na tvīdṛśī matiḥ | kṛpayā devadevasya śikṣito’smi hareḥ prabhoḥ |||56|| nānyo gururme vadati sa eva prerako hariḥ | śrotā mantā tathā vaktā draṣṭā sarvatra vartate ||57|| harirevākṣayaḥ śāstā buddhidātāpi sa prabhuḥ | tadā hiraṇyakaśipuḥ prāha putraṃ ruṣānvitaḥ ||58|| ahameveśvaro loke trailokyādhipatirmataḥ | māmevārcaya govindaṃ tyaja śatruṃ tamacyutam ||59|| athavā śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ rudraṃ lokaguruṃ prabhum | arcayasva surādhyakṣaṃ sarvaiśvaryapradaṃśivam ||1.137.60|| prahlādaḥ prāha devasya māyāmohamime gatāḥ | rākṣasā api manyante vayameveśvarā iti ||61|| śaṃkaro’pi svayaṃ viṣṇubhakto’sti vaiṣṇavāgryagaḥ | daityo’yaṃ kiṃ na jānāti kathamevaṃ bhramaṃgataḥ ||62|| pitarnaitadvijānāsi madagarvadhiyāvṛtam | nārāyaṇaḥ parabrahma tattvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ ||63|| nārāyaṇaḥ paro dhyātā dhyānaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ param | gatirviśvasya jagataḥ śāśvataḥ sa prabhuḥ paraḥ || 64|| dhātā vidhātā jagato vāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ | viśvameveha puruṣastadviśvamupajīvati ||65|| hiraṇmayaśarīraḥ sa puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇaḥ | tenaiva sṛṣṭau brahmeśau vartete tasya śāsane ||66|| bhīṣāsmādvāti pavano bhīṣodeti divākaraḥ | bhīṣāsmādagniścendraśca mṛtyurdhāvati paṃcamaḥ ||67|| āsīdeko harirdevo divyo nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ | na brahmā na tatheśāno na ca candradivākarau ||68|| na vā dyāvāpṛthivyau ca nakṣatrāṇi divaukasaḥ | viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padaṃ tasya sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ ||69|| tyaktvā taṃ śrīhariṃ kasmātpūjaye pitaraṃ śivam | yamarcayanti brahmeśaśakrādyā devatāgaṇāḥ |||1.137.70 || yaṃ dhyāyanti mahātmāno yoginaḥ sanakādayaḥ | yasya lakṣmyāḥ kaṭākṣārdhadṛṣṭyā hṛṣṭā divaukasaḥ ||7 1 || brahmendrarudravaruṇayamasomadhanādhipāḥ | yannāmajapanādeva muktirbhavati śāśvatī ||72|| taṃ śrīpatiṃ devadevamanantaṃ puruṣottamam | śrīvatsakaustubhoraskaṃ nityānandasukhapradam ||73|| rakṣakaṃ pūjayiṣyāmi lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ harim | prāpsyāmi susukhenaiva tadviṣṇoḥ parama padam ||74|| citsthaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ prabhum | viśvataḥ paramaṃ nityaṃ viśvaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim ||75|| nārāyaṇaṃ sadā jñeyaṃ viśvātmānaṃ parāyaṇam | nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃjyotirūpaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam ||76|| yacca kiṃcijjagatsarvaṃ dṛśyate śrṛyate’pi vā | antarbahiśca tatsarvaṃ vyāpya nārāyaṇaṃ sthitam ||77|| ṛtaṃ satyaṃ paraṃbrahma puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇapiṃgalam | nārāyaṇaṃ cordhvaśīlaṃ vande viśvasvarūpiṇam ||78|| evaṃ putravacaḥ śrutvā hiraṇyakaśipustadā | krodhena mahatāviṣṭaḥ kaṣāyībhūtanetrakaḥ ||79|| bhaktaṃ svaputraṃ svotsaṃgāt paryatyajanmahītale | parito vīkṣya daiteyānityāha krodhamūrchitaḥ ||1.137.80 || bhīṣaṇaiḥ śastrasaṃghātaiḥ prahlādaṃ tvapathasthitam | mamājñayā ghātayantu śatrupūjanatatparam ||8 1 || vadhyatāmāśvayaṃ vadhyo hitvā svān suhṛdo’dhamaḥ | pitṛvyahanturyaḥ pādau viṣṇordāsavadarcati ||82|| aṃgaṃ rugṇaṃ cācikitsāviṣayaṃ chedyameva tat | paro’pi hitanivahaḥ sevyastiktauṣadhādivat ||83|| rakṣitā harireveti cocyate tena vai balāt| adyaiva saphalaṃ janma paśyeya harirakṣaṇama ||84|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne hiraṇyakaśipoḥ prahlāde putre vidyādhīte bhagavadvidyābhivyaṃjanāddveṣaprayukta mṛtyvājñādikathananāmā saptatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 137 ||
<1.138> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca tato lakṣmi mama bhaktaṃ nairṛtāḥ śūlapāṇayaḥ | tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāḥ karālāsyāstāmraśmaśrukumūrdhajāḥ || 1 || kurvanto bhairavānnādāna chindhi bhindhītivādinaḥ | parivārya ca taṃ jaghnuḥ śūlatomaraśaktibhiḥ || 1 || prahlādasya vapustatra hareḥ saṃsmaraṇācchubhe | vajrabhūtamabhūttatra hyāsan ghātāstu niṣphalāḥ || 3 || saṃprāpyājñaspṛśya taddehaṃ mahāsrāṇi tu rakṣasām | bhagnāni ca kṣitau petuḥ padmaśuṣkadalādivat || 4 || svalpamapyasya tadgātraṃ bhettuṃ daityāḥ kṣamā nahi | vismitāvāṅmukhāstasthurdaityarājāntike bhaṭāḥ || 5 || pare brahmaṇyanirdeśye bhagavatyakhilātmani | yuktātmani mahābhakte kasyāstraṃ saphalaṃ bhavet || 6 || prayāse niṣphale jāte dṛṣṭvā putraṃ tamavraṇam | vismayaṃ paramaṃ prāpto hiraṇyakaśipustadā || 7 || mahāduḥkhairhṛdi cāndho mūrchita iva roṣataḥ | cakāra tadvadhopāyānabhicārāvapātanaiḥ || 8 || māyābhiḥ sannirodhaiścābhojanairgalabandhanaiḥ | sarvatra śrīharistasya rakṣāṃ cakāra mātṛvat || 9 || evaṃ kṛte’pi nirvighne putre daityastu śaṃkitaḥ | mriyeta vā na mriyeta mārayeta vā kiṃ kriyāt || 1.138.10 || śatrustathāpi hantavyo yāvadbuddhibalodayaḥ | ādideśa tataḥ sarpān dandaśūkānmahāviṣān || 11 || vāsukitakṣakādīṃśca khādayantviti saṃbruvan | evamādeśamāptāste nāgā viṣolbaṇāstadā || 12|| jvalitāsyā mahābhīmāstaṃ cakhadurmahābalam | garuḍadhvajadāsaṃ taṃ vidaśya garalāyudhāḥ || 13 || nirviṣāśchinnadaśanā babhūvuranilāśanāḥ | viṣṇupreritagaruḍacchinnamarmādigātrakāḥ || 14|| dudruvustatsthalāt tūrṇamapṛṣṭhadarśinaḥ punaḥ | vamanto rudhiraṃ bhagnā mṛtāśca kiṃcanābhavat || 15|| mahāsarpānapi putre niṣphalām̐śca vilokya saḥ | ādideśa mahākruddho diggajānanivāryakān || 16|| madoddhatā mahākruddhā dantinaḥ parivārya tam | jaghnurdantaiḥ pṛthutamaistathāpi vajradehavān || 17|| mama kṛpāvaśo romṇi manāgapi na vai kṣataḥ | pratyuta hastināṃ dantā mūlāt chinnā adho’patan || 18|| dantairvinā kṛtā nāgāḥ pradudruvaḥ suduḥkhināḥ | dṛṣṭvaivaṃ tu camatkāraṃ virarāma tathāpi na || 19|| aho māyā hareḥ subhru pātayatyadhamādhamam | mahānāgairathācchinnaṃ putraṃ dṛṣṭvā sa roṣataḥ || 1.138.20|| prajvālite mahāvahnau cikṣepa sutamātmanaḥ | hāhākāro mahānāsīd grāme kheṭe ca rāṣṭrake ||21 || agnirdevo’pi bhaktantaṃ jalaśāyiharipriyam | matvā naiva dadāhāste śānto vahniḥ śaśīva saḥ ||22|| mūḍhastathāpi no vetti rakṣakaścāsya vartate | paścād viṣaṃ mahāghoraṃ dattavān pānabhojane |||23|| arcane vastrasaṃgrāhe prayuktamapi nāspṛśat | viṣamapyamṛtaṃ jātaṃ nārāyaṇaprabhāvataḥ ||24|| athāpi cākṣataṃ putraṃ yathāpūrvaṃ prapaśya saḥ | khaniṃ mahattarāṃ bhūmau khanayāmāsa tatra tam ||22|| prakṣipya ca mahāgrāvṇairmahīmāpūrayat samām | nārāyaṇena prahlādo rājasaudhe sukarṣitaḥ ||26|| yatrāsuro mahāsiṃhāsane vairājate’tra tam | jīvantaṃ devasadṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvāgataṃ bhayānvitaḥ ||27|| mamāyaṃ mārakaścāsti niścikāyāha daityarāṭ | unnītvā rākṣasā enaṃ kṣipantu jaladhau drutam |||28|| kṛtaṃ tathaiva taiḥ sarvaistebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ gṛhāgataḥ | dṛṣṭvaivaṃ taṃ himādrau tu mahāgniṃ tato’kṣipan ||29|| naranārāyaṇastaṃ cārakṣayad himavāraṇāt | aprāpayat tu daityasya saudhaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ sa rākṣasaiḥ ||1.138.30 || mṛterupāyāḥ santyeva paraṃ nātra phalanti te | kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ mṛtyurnāstyasya me yathā ||3 1|| mayā varo mama kṛte prāptaḥ sa phalito’tra kim | pitā putraḥ samau ślāghyau paraṃ vaiṣṇavatārtidā ||32||| bhāvi datsyāt tena bhāvyaṃ mama svit mṛtyurastyayam | tathāpi nirṇayaṃ kurve bhaktau kāṣṭhāsya kiṃbalā ||33|| vicāryetthaṃ sutaṃ prāha tvayā coktaṃ mayāgrataḥ | vyāpitvātsarvabhūtānāṃ viṣṇurityabhidhā yataḥ ||34|| tasya sarvatra cāstitve pratyakṣaṃ darśayasva me | yaśca sarvagato devaḥ sa eva parameśvaraḥ ||35|| tasyaiśvaryaśaktitejojñānavīryabalāni ca | rūpasmṛddhivibhūtisadgaṇacāritryakāṇi ca |||36|| dṛṣṭvā samyak tato manye tava viṣṇuṃ surādhipam | matto yadi sa jyeṣṭho’sti jitvā māṃ balavīryataḥ |||37|| īśvaratvaṃ labhatvatra nānyayā tu kadācana | mama pratibalo nāsti loke deveṣu kaścana |||38 || rudrasya varadānena hyavadhyo durjayo’smyaham | itipiturvacaḥ śrutvā prahlādaḥ prahasam̐stadā |||39 || hareḥ prabhāvaṃ daityasya kathayāmāsa sarvathā | yo vai nārāyaṇaḥ śrīśaḥ paramātmā parātparaḥ ||1.138.40|| nṛṣu nāreṣu ayanānnārāyaṇaḥ sa ucyate | vasanātsarvabhūteṣu vāsudevaḥ sa eva saḥ ||41|| sarvasya jagataḥ poṣṭā viṣṇurityapi veśanāt | na cānena vinā kiṃcijjagatsthāvarajaṃgamam ||42|| sarvacidacitormadhye rūpamasyaiva vartate | tripādvyāptiḥ pare dhāmni pādavyāptistu māyikī ||42 || so’yaṃ cakragadāpāṇirbhaktidṛśyo’sti sarvathā | roṣamatsaramānādidurguṇairnahi dṛśyate ||44|| devatiryaṅmanuṣyeṣu sthāvareṣu ca jantuṣu | vyāpya tiṣṭhati sarveṣu kṣudreṣu ca mahatsu ca ||45|| yāvadevaṃ kathayati prahlāde tāvadeva tu | hiraṇyakaśiporvāmanetroṣṭhāṃsādayo’sphuran ||46|| kāko ruroda nṛpaterdhvajadaṇḍe muhurmuhuḥ | dhvajabhaṃgo’bhavattāvadapatat skhalanāt svayam ||47|| cakampe hṛdyaṃ tasya jānato’śakunāni yat | dhūmraketuḥ sakalgiśca vyomamārge hyadṛśyata ||48 || kṛṣṇājaśakaṭī dṛṣṭā yāmyāṃ diśaṃ prayāti yā | raktaikavastrā svapatnīrdṛṣṭā svaśleṣitā kṣaṇam ||49|| dṛṣṭaṃ svamastakaṃ dehāt pṛthak svahastagaṃ kṣaṇam | divā śukrastadā dṛṣṭaḥ svarge diśaḥ sadhūlikāḥ |||1.138.5 0 || dṛṣṭā dṛṣṭvaiva mṛtyurme bhavitaitadvirodhataḥ | jñātavānatha taṃ kiṃcinmlānaśriyamadhomukham ||5 1 || śaṇḍāmarkau śukraputrau sāntvanāyeti hocatuḥ | mā khedaṃ kuru rājendra jagajjetā tvameva hi ||5 2|| āvāṃ taṃ śikṣayiṣyāvo yathā syāt kuladharmagaḥ | baddhvā varuṇapāśaistaṃ rakṣiṣyāvo nije gṛhe ||53 || vayasaḥ pakvabhāve tu buddhiḥ sujñā bhaviṣyati | iti saṃgṛhya tadvācaṃ śokama ca parityaja vai ||54|| arpayāmāsa putraṃ tau rājadharmādyadhītaye | gṛhadharmopadeśāya dharmārthakāmalabdhaye ||55|| guruputrāvapi yogyānuktāndharmān yathāyatham | śikṣayāmāsatustān sa nopājagrāha cātmani ||56 || yayā dvandvāni jāyante na sā vidyā tu muktaye | matvaivaṃ riktasamaye bālānāhvaya sadṛśān ||57|| upādideśa mokṣākhyān dharmānāsuratātigān | svacchātmānaśca te bālā sumiṣṭāniva mokṣadāna ||58|| ātmānandapradān svacchān dharmān jagṛhurādarāt | tānāha bhoḥ svacchabālā viṣṇuḥ sarvatra tiṣṭhati |||59|| svacchātmasu ca bāleṣu viśeṣeṇa ca tiṣṭhati | bālairabhyarhitaṃ sarvaṃ bhaktyārpayati keśavaḥ ||1.138.60|| abhyarthiteṣu
