sarveṣu mokṣo’styabhyarthitāgryagaḥ | sa evābhyarthanīyo’trādhruvamānuṣajanmanā ||61|| ātmāyaṃ bahuvāraṃ vai surāsurādiyoniṣu | jāto jātaḥ samāyāti bhogavilāsavartmanā ||62||| mokṣapathena nāyāti mokṣaḥ sarvatra durlabhaḥ | sarvatrāptaṃ sukhamaindriyakaṃ svabhāvasāri tat ||63|| tatra prayāse svāyurvai vṛthaiva vigataṃ bhavet | śrīharipādapādmaṃ tu kuśalakṣemakāraṇam ||64|| yāvaddeho na naśyeta svaṃ kṣemaṃ sādhayedbudhaḥ | puṃsaścāyurabjavarṣaṃ koṭayabdaṃ lakṣavatsaram ||65|| sahasrābdaṃ śatābdaṃ vā viṃśatyabdamathāpi vā | tatrārdhaṃ nidrayā nītaṃ daśāṃśaṃ bālakhelane ||66|| daśāṃśaṃ vidyayā nītaṃ daśāṃśaṃ vṛddhatāhṛtam | daśāṃśaścāvaśiṣyeta viṣaye vā dhanārjane ||67|| tasya vyayo bhaveccedbho kadātmārthaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet | mokṣārthaṃ na kṛtaṃ kiñcittadā sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ nahi ||68|| mokṣārthaṃ cetkṛtaṃ kiṃcittadā sarva kṛtaṃ bhavet | vicāryaivaṃ sadā bālāḥ kartavyaṃ mokṣasādhanam ||69|| sādhanīyaḥ svayaṃ svāmī hāre sarvāntarasthitaḥ | strīsnehaḥ putrakṛtsnehaḥ suhṛtsnehaḥ kuṭumbinām ||1.138.70|| bhrātṛsvasṛduhitṝṇāṃ sneho nigaḍabandhanam | aupasthyajaihvyaviṣayān bahumatvātra sajjate ||71|| duḥkhe kuṭumbapuṣṭau ca kliṣṭe ca viṣayārjane | tāpatrayeṇārdito’pi yatnaṃ naiva jahāti vai ||72|| dravyacitto dravyahartāśāntakāmo vinaśyati | jñātāpi naiva kaivalyaṃ vindate viśati mṛtim ||73|| kāmanānigaḍaprāptaḥ krīḍāmṛgo na mucyate | tasmād bālā mṛṣā tyaktvā hariṃ bhajata bhāvataḥ ||74|| drāgeva hṛṣyati devo dadātyānandamātmajam | sthūlasūkṣmaprabhūteṣvindriyaprāṇāntareṣu ca ||79|| vikṛtāvikṛtāvasthamāyāyāmapi mādhavaḥ | eka eva hi cānviṣṭo vyatirikto’pi caiva saḥ || 76|| dṛśyātmā ca pradraṣṭātmā vyāpyavyāpaka eva saḥ | ānandapūrṇacaraṇabāhūdaramukhādikaḥ ||77|| surāsurādisarvātmā hṛdi tiṣṭhati keśavaḥ | ṛtaṃ satyaṃ hitaṃ kāryamiti vakti hṛdi prabhuḥ ||78|| mṛṣā mithyā hataṃ tyājyamiti vakti sa eva saḥ | asatyarthe neti vakti satyerthe vakti o hi saḥ ||79|| āsuraṃ bhāvamutsṛjya yena tuṣyati mādhavaḥ | tena sauhṛdabhāvena vartadhvaṃ bhajatācyutam ||1.138.80 || dharmādayo harireva yamāśca niyamā hariḥ | sādhanāni harireva vidyāḥ sarvāḥ kalā hariḥ ||8 1 || yāvatkṛtyaphalaṃ viṣṇau sarvātmārpaṇamucyate | harau harerdāsadāsībhakteṣu vimalā matiḥ |||82|| teṣāṃ pādarajaḥsnānaṃ sāraṃ mokṣapradaṃ mahat | mahyaṃ nāradadevena garbhe’dhyāpitameva yat ||83|| haristatsādhavaḥ sevyāstadanyajjanmadaṃ yataḥ | māyādamabhimānaṃ ve hareḥ santastu muktidāḥ ||84|| śrutvaitaddaityaputrāstaṃ papracchurnāradaḥ kadā | ālambya samaye garbhe’karod bodhamasaṃbhavam ||85|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne hiraṇyakaśipukāritaprahlādamāraṇopāyanaiṣphalyagurukṛtopadeśaprahādakṛtadaityabālakopadeśanirūpaṇanāmnāṣṭatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 38||
<1.139> śrī nārāyaṇa uvāca prahlādaḥ prāha tāndaityārbhakān jñānānurāgiṇaḥ | mandarādrau me pitari tapati dhūmra utthite || 1 || valmīkavaṃśakāṣṭhādicchanne daityā nirāśakāḥ | mṛtau daityapramūrdhanya iti matvā ca duḥkhitāḥ || 2 || tadā tānnirbalān jñātvā cakruryuddhamatiṃ surāḥ | hatā daityāḥ surasainyairdudruvuḥ sarvatodiśam || 3 || strīputraduhitṛsvasṛpitṛkuṭumbajīvinaḥ | dhanadhānyaparicchadān parityajya ca dudruvuḥ || 4 || devāḥ sarvabalopetāḥ vyalumpan daityasaṃgrahān | rājaprāsādamācchidya kalyāṇīṃ mama mātaram || 5 || indro nītvā yadā yāti svargaṃ tāvacca nāradaḥ | mārge eva militastaṃ prāha kva nayasi drutam || 6 || satīṃ netumayogyastvaṃ muñcaināṃ vai nirāgasam | indraḥ prāha tadāsyāstu garbhe daityasya bālakaḥ || 7 || aprasahyo’sti tasmādvai yāvatprasava rakṣaya | kṛtārthena parityājyā nānyanme’sti prayojanam || 8 || nāradaḥ prāha cendrāya garbho mahān sa vaiṣṇavaḥ | devaviṣṇugavāṃ bhakto viprasāttvatasevakaḥ || 9 || yadbhayaṃ te’sti tannaiva śaṃkanīyaṃ parityaja | nāradoktaṃ tadā hīndraḥ svīkṛtyaināṃ vihāya ca || 1.139.10 || namaskṛtya gataḥ svargaṃ nārado’pi mahānprabhuḥ | mātaraṃ me saha nītvā jagāma svāśramaṃ prati || 11 || āśvāsanena sambodhya yāvattapasaste patiḥ | āgacchet tāvadatraiva sukhaṃ vatse samuṣyatām || 1 2|| ityāśrayaṃ śubhaṃ labdhvā satyavātsīcca nirbhayā | nityaṃ paramayā bhaktyā ṛṣiṃ paryacaranmudā || 13|| ṛṣiḥ sakaruṇastasyai prādāt jñānaṃ tu mokṣadam | tatsarvaṃ tu mayā garbhagatenāsāditaṃ sthiram || 14|| tanmāturme layaṃ yātaṃ mamaiva dṛḍhatāṃ gatam | dṛḍhasaṃskārakaṃ sarvaṃ smarāmi ca yathoditam || 15|| jñānaṃ rocayamānānāṃ bālānāṃ bhavatāṃ mudā | śreyaskaraṃ paraṃ no’sti śraddhāgrāhyaṃ hi tadyataḥ || 16|| vacmi kiñcicca tajjñānaṃ sāramākṛṣya sarvataḥ | ādarśasvacchahṛdaye drāglagnaṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet || 17|| strībālānāṃ kṛte yena lābhaḥ sāralyato bhavet | tadyathāvanmano datvā śrotavyaṃ sāramātmanaḥ || 18|| pūrvakarmānusāreṇa tejasvyātmātisūkṣmakaḥ | piturdhātau viśatyeva vīrya garbhe niṣicyate || 1 9|| vīryaṃ tadbhautikaṃ vastu jīvaḥ saccitsukhātmakaḥ | aṇuḥ prakāśo nityaśca jñātā jñānaghanātmakaḥ |||1.139.20 || jīvātmanānvitaṃ vīryaṃ rajoyuktaṃ bhavatyatha | rajovīryātmabhiḥ sarvā sūṣṭirbhavati cetanā ||2 1 || vyātmako’yaṃ bhaved dehaḥ puruṣaḥ pramadāthavā | napuṃsako vā jāyeta ṣaṭkośātmātridhāpi vai ||22|| pitṛtaḥ snāyvasthimajjā māṃsaromāsrajaḥ striyāḥ | ṣaṭkośāste śarīrasthāḥ ṣaṭsvātmā saṃpratiṣṭhati ||23|| sthūle bālaśarīre vai pṛthvyaptejo’nilāmbaram | bhūtapaṃcakamastyeva tatra viṣayapaṃcakam ||24|| sthūlaṃ gandharasarūpasparśaśabdātmakaṃ tathā | ghrāṇajihvānayanatvakśrotragrāhyaṃ kramāddhi tat ||25|| vāgdhastapādapāyūpasthendriyāṇi parāṇi ca | vāṇyādānaviharaṇamalamūtravisarjanam | kāryaṃ kramāddhi bodhavyaṃ manaścittamahaṃmatiḥ ||26|| antaḥkaraṇamityuktaṃ tatparaṃ prakṛtirmatā | sattvarajastamoyuktā samāvasthā hi kāraṇam | viṣamāvasthikā saiva saṃsārastattvavigrahaḥ ||27|| māyāyāstu vikārā ye nāśavantastu te matāḥ | ātmāstyamāyikaḥ śuddho nāśo nāsya kadācana ||28|| dehastu jāyate paścād vardhate bahubhojanaiḥ | vipariṇamate caiva kṣīyate naśyate mṛṣā ||29|| ātmā ca tatra sarvatra vartate’sti hyataḥ sa san | dehādi jaḍamityeva cātmā cetana eva hi ||1.139.30|| dehādi duḥkharūpaṃ vai hyātmānandamayaḥ sadā | saccidānanda ityukto na daityo na ca dānavaḥ ||3 1|| na suro nāsuraścātmā na nārī na pumān hi saḥ | napuṃsako na rāgī na na dveṣī śuddha eva saḥ ||32|| ajñastu bādhahīno vai kvacitsāttvikabhāvanaḥ | kvacittu rājasobhāvaḥ kvacittāmasabhāvanaḥ ||3 3|| sattvaṃ sukhakaraṃ manye rajo rāgakaraṃ bhavet | tamaḥ pīḍākaraṃ proktaṃ tasmāt sattvaguṇaṃ bhajet ||34|| sattvamapyātmano lābhakaraṃ hitadamiṣyate | yadyahitaṃ mokṣadaṃ na tadā tadapi tyajyate |||35||| svātmanyavasthite nārāyaṇe yā sāttvikī matiḥ | sā vai sadā bhavellābhakarī mokṣapradāpi ca ||36||| jāgratsvapnaṃ suṣuptiśca dehādau nātmani kvacit | sthaulyaṃ saukṣmyaṃ kāraṇatvaṃ dehādau nātmani kvacit||||37|| pāpaṃ puṇyaṃ cobhayaṃ ca janmapuṣṭirmṛtistathā | devadaityamānavatvaṃ dehādau nātmani kvacit ||38|| na gṛhaṃ gṛhamityuktaṃ śarīraṃ gṛhamucyate | kṣaṇabhaṃgurakaṃ tacca tena mokṣaṃ prasādhayet ||39|| ātmā hyasaṃgaḥ sarvatra janasaṃgī bhavedyadi | śuddhe saṃgaḥ kulajāterabhimānakaro bhavet ||1.139.40 || tena dveṣo bhavet tattadviparīte ṛtārthake | ahaṃ daitya ityahaṃkāreṇa cātmā yadi vṛtaḥ ||41|| tadā dveṣo bhaveddeve nārāyaṇe tu sarvathā | patanaṃ muktimārgācca dveṣānnārāyaṇe tathā ||42|| tasmād bālā vayaṃ śuddhā yāvanna buddhibhedakāḥ | śabdāḥ pakṣānugā labdhāstāvanmokṣaṃ prasādhayet ||43|| caturviśatitattveṣu paṃcaviṃśaṃ tu mārgayet | svayaṃ svaṃ mārgayitvaiva ṣaḍviṃśe taṃ samarpayet ||44|| tāvatparyantamevāyaṃ saṃsāro vāsanātmakaḥ | ātmatadātmanoryāvat saṃviveko’tra no kṛtaḥ ||45|| śāntaṃ ghoraṃ ca mūḍhaṃ ca tattvajālaṃ vibudhya ca | tatparaṃ svaṃ parijñāya parātparaṃ samāśrayet ||46|| na mātā na pitā putro bhaginī bāndhavāstathā | paraloke sahāyāḥ syuḥ hariḥ sāhāyyado bhavet ||47|| sa ca sarvatra bhūteṣu vartamāno’pi dehinā | vinā sādhanasampattyā nopalabhyata eva saḥ ||48|| prabhuprāpteḥ sādhanāni guroḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ tathā | premabhaktiḥ sadā sevā sarvalabdhārpaṇaṃ tathā ||49|| sādhusādhvīprasaṃgaśca viṣṇorārādhanaṃ param | tatkathāśravaṇaṃ tasya kīrtanaṃ guṇavarṇanam ||1.139.50 || tanmūrterdhyānamatyarthaṃ darśanaṃ smaraṇādikam | sarvabhūteṣu tadbhānaṃ bhaktānāṃ tatsamārhaṇam ||51|| sarvaṃ samarpyate tatra ratiḥ sarvāpi tatra ca | kriyāḥ sarvāśca tanmayyastato’nyannāvabudhyate ||52|| dhyāne vā dhāraṇāyāṃ vā samādhau cāpi tanmayaḥ | jāgrati vā tathā svapne suṣuptāvapi tanmayaḥ ||53||| pravṛttau vā nivṛttau vā sarvāvasthāsu tanmayaḥ | hasanaṃ rodanaṃ gānaṃ nartanaṃ krandanaṃ svapiḥ ||54|| chikkanaṃ vartanaṃ pānaṃ bhojanaṃ ramaṇaṃ gatiḥ | sadanaṃ mārgaṇaṃ yadvā darśanaṃ sparśanaṃ śrutiḥ ||55|| kṣuvanaṃ cintanaṃ nirṇāyanamadhyāsanaṃ tathā | mananaṃ tanmayaṃ harṣotpulakāśrusagadgadam |||56|| bhavettadā hariścātra bhaktiyogena dṛśyate | tasya kathāśravaṃ kṛtvā mananaṃ kāryameva yat|||57|| tasya mūrteścintanena kalmaṣaṃ kṣālitaṃ bhavet | nirmalātmā tadvā svasminnanyatrāpi ca sarvathā ||58|| nārāyaṇaṃ prapaśyet saṃbhajadhvaṃ vai tatocyutam | prājñenāpyaṃ dhruvaṃ tattvaṃ tyājyamadhruvameva yat ||59|| dhruveṇa cātmanā prāptavyo dhruvo harireva vai | sa vai sarvatra saṃpoṣṭā sukhado mokṣadastathā ||1.139.60|| sukhaṃ sātiśayaṃ tyājyaṃ kṣayiṣṇu tyājyameva ca | aviśuddhaṃ sadā tyājyaṃ grāhyaṃ taddoṣavarjitam ||61|| tattu nārāyaṇādeva nānyasmānmilati kvacit | tasmānnārāyaṇo dhyeyaḥ svātmanyārādhya eva saḥ |||62|| dṛṣṭānuśravadoṣāptaṃ sarvaṃ māyāmayaṃ jagat | tacchūnyaṃ sukhasaṃsthānaṃ nārāyaṇo bhavatyataḥ ||63|| tadbhaktyā śāśvatānandaḥ prāptavyo’smābhirarbhakāḥ | aśāśvataṃ sukhaṃ yatra putradāragṛhādiṣu ||64|| dhane rājye tathāmātye gajāśveṣu janādiṣu | prāsāde vā suhṛdvarge tucche śāśvatikeṣu yat ||65|| kṣaṇa dṛśyeta subhagaṃ saha dehena naśvaram | anarthadaṃ kṣaṇādarthābhāsaṃ duḥkhātikṛttathā ||66|| ko vāstyatrātmanaḥ svārthaḥ śāśvatastannirūpyatām | dehe daihikasaṃghāte vastunyapi ca yatpriyam ||67|| tattu virṣṇornivāsādyat hariḥ sarvapriyātmakaḥ | yatra kvāpi gato jīvo daityo yakṣo’thavāsuraḥ ||68|| suro vā mānavo vāpi gandharvo vāpi rākṣasaḥ | bhajannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ svastimān syānna tadṛte ||69|| mukundaprīṇane naiva vratadānatapaḥkriyāḥ | bahujñatāvayorūpejyāśaucātikulārthitāḥ ||1.139.70|| kāraṇaṃ nirmalā bhaktirbhāvanārdrātmani prabhā | evaṃvidhāṃ parāṃ bhaktiṃ harau kurvantu bālakāḥ ||71|| mayā sadā kṛtā bhaktyā yayā paśyāmi keśavam | ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā munayo mānavāstathā ||72|| dānavā rākṣasā daityā yakṣāḥ kiṃpuruṣāśca ye | kinnarāścaiva gāndharvāścāraṇāḥ siddhapūruṣāḥ ||73|| vidyādharāḥ piśācā vā bhūtapretāśca ye’pare | sādhyā viśvāśca kūṣmāṇḍā vaināyakāśca bhairavāḥ ||74|| vetālāśca gaṇāścaiva yāmyā nāgāḥ sarīsṛpāḥ | khagā mṛgā jalavāsā bhūvāsāḥ pavanāśrayāḥ ||75|| antarīkṣagatā ye ca grahāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ | bālā vṛddhāḥ striyaḥ śūdrāḥ saṃkarāḥ pāpayonayaḥ ||76|| hitvā pāpaṃ gatā muktiṃ śrīmannārāyaṇāśrayāt | tasmādasmābhirapyatra durlabhe narajanmani ||77|| bhajanīyo hariḥ sākṣāt tadanyattu viḍambanam | ityādeśo mayā garbhagatenāptastu nāradāt ||78|| nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa śrīpate kamalāpate | pārvatīśeśa mukteśa prabheśeśa ca te namaḥ ||79|| evaṃ bhajam̐śca varte’haṃ yūyaṃ kuruta tattathā | śrutvaivaṃ bālakāḥ sarve jagṛhustadyathātatham | śālāyāṃ te jagṛhurna guruśikṣitamaṇvapi ||1.139.80|| tadācāryasutaḥ khinno bhayabhītaśca bhūbhṛte | nivedayāmāsa sarvaṃ bālāstu kupathaṃgatāḥ | śrutvā svaputrakartavyamatikrodhena kampitaḥ ||8 1|| putrasya nidhanaṃ kartuṃ pitā daityo mano dadhe | prahlādaṃ ca samāhūya vācā paruṣayā kṣipan ||82|| pāpena cakṣuṣā paśyan tiraścīnena roṣataḥ | prāha śāntaṃ kuloddhārayogyaṃ bhāgavataṃ sutam ||83|| re buddhyādhama me vidyābhedakānyakṛtāśraya | manyase na svayaṃ śikṣāmanyām̐śca nayase’patham ||84|| abhīta iva lokānāṃ śāsituḥ śāsanaṃ mama | na gaṇayasi duṣṭātman preṣayiṣye yamālayam ||85|| caturdaśānāṃ lokānāṃ rājño’nādṛtya me vacaḥ | balaṃ kasya samāśritya stabdho bhavasi re’dhama ||86|| prahlādaḥ prāha tacchrutvā pitaste cāsti yadbalam | balaṃ tasyāpi me cāsti yadbalāt balavajjagat ||87|| vrahmarudrādayaḥ sarve yatsahaujobalādibhiḥ | rājādhirājā rājante tadbalaṃ cāvayoḥ sadā ||88|| dveṣabhāvaṃ parityajya pitastvaṃ dhatsva mānase | prahvībhāvena taddhyānaṃ manute sa samarhaṇam ||89|| tāvatāpyuddharedātmā nānyathā tu kadācana | digjetāro’pi mohasya krodhasya kṣudraveginaḥ ||1.139.90|| āpannā vaśameveti mā yāhi tadvaśaṃ pitaḥ | naivamātmā pātitavyastrilokeśena bhūbhṛtā ||91|| bhaktyā tvārohayitavyo harerdhāma paraṃ padam | kathaṃ pāpaṃ cārjayase sarvanāśakaraṃ pitaḥ ||92|| śrutvaitatsvasutoktaṃ sa hiraṇyakaśipustadā | mumūrṣurasahamāno’viṣahyavedanānalam ||93|| prāha putraṃ tava mṛtyurvyaktaṃ cātra samāgataḥ | asthāne katthase duṣṭa kvāsti te parameśvaraḥ ||94|| nānyo madanya īśo’sti cedasti tvāṃ sa rakṣayet | sarvatrāsti yadi cāsau yadi sarvagato bhavet ||95|| stambhe darśaya taṃ viṣṇumanyathā vadhamarhasi | ityuktvā khaḍgamādāya sahasā ditijeśvaraḥ ||96|| pracakrame sutaṃ hantuṃ tāvat stambho dvidhābhavat | jāto bhayaṃkaraḥ śabdaḥ staṃbhādvyāpto digambaram ||97|| saṃvartanāśasaṃrāvaiḥ khamiva sphuṭitāntaram | tena śabdena mahatā daityaśrotravighātinā ||98|| sarve nipātitā bhūmau daityāstu menire tadā | jagattrayaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ vā pralayaścāgato’sti naḥ ||99|| tāvat staṃbhe mahātejā niṣkrānto vai mahāgiriḥ | nṛsiṃhavapurāsthāya cakāra ghoraniḥsvanān || 1.139.100 || anekakoṭisūryāgnitejasā prajvalan ruṣā | mukhe pañcānanaprakhyaḥ śarīre mānuṣākṛtiḥ || 10 1|| daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaḥ sphurajjihvāgradairghyakaḥ | jvālāvalitakeśāntastaptālātekṣaṇo vibhuḥ || 10 2|| divyamālāmbaradharo divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ | tasthau nṛkesarī tatra saṃhartuṃ daityadānavān || 1 03|| dṛṣṭvādṛṣṭapūrvarūpaṃ vihvalāṃgo mahāsuraḥ | hiraṇyakaśipurdaityaḥ papātānye ca mūrchitāḥ || 1 04|| prahlādo’tha tadā dṛṣṭvā nārasiṃhopamaṃ harim | jayaśabdena deveśaṃ namaścakre janārdanam || 1 05|| nārasiṃhe tadā bhakto bhuvanāni dadarśa ha | śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi yathāvaddarśitaṃ tu yat || 106 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne garbhasthaprahlādasya nāradopadeśagrahaṇasamayahiraṇyakaśipuvivādabālopadeśakhaḍgaghātanṛsiṃhaprādurbhāvanirūpaṇanāmā ekonacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 139||
<1.140> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca prahlādo’nye ca daiteyā niścikyurnaiva vastu yat | kutaḥ kasmādayaṃ śabdo lokasphoṭanakṛnmahān || 1 || dṛśyate śabdamūlaṃ na nākṛtirnābhibhāvakam | niśamyāpūrvanirhrādaṃ surabhinnā vitatrasuḥ || 2 || satyaṃ prakurvan prahlādābhihitaṃ brahmaṇoditam | varaṃ cāyaṃ hariḥ kṛṣṇo nṛhariḥ samajāyata || 3 || mūrterdrāksumahattejño’vyāpnodābrahmalokagam | śanaiḥ śanaiśca tattejo’ntaḥsabhāyāṃ vyalīyata || 4 || tāvatstaṃbhāntare sattvaṃ mahākrūraṃ vyaloki tat | nāyaṃ mṛgo na manuṣaḥ kimetannṛmṛgendravat || 5 || yāvaddaityāśca daityeśo vyaktaṃ paśyati nṛharim | bhayānakaṃ lalajjihvaṃ sphāralohitalocanam || 6 || sūryavaccākacakyāsyaṃ harīvajjṛmbhitānanam | mahātejaḥsphuratsvarṇavidyudvallībhakesaram || 7 || karāladaṃṣṭraṃ bhrūkuṭīcaṇḍakopānalānvitam | stabdhordhvakarṇaṃ vyāttānananāsaṃ ca kalāsaham || 8 || candrāṃśuvālaṃ mahākhaṅgātitīkṣṇanakhāyudham | tāvattadvivṛdhe sattvaṃ mahākāyaṃ mahābalam || 9 || divyaṃ yanmandarasamaṃ prāsādastu vyalīyata | divye nārāyaṇe siṃhe nare’pūrvakṛtākṛtau || 1.140.1 0|| dadarśa tasya gātreṣu prahlādo bhuvanāni vai | lokān samudrān sadvīpān suragandharvamānuṣān || 11 || aṇḍajāni sahastāni saṭāgre sa dadarśa vai | dadarśa netrayostasya sūryacandrādikān gṛhān || 12|| karṇayoraśvinau devau diśaśca vidiśastathā | lalāṭe brahmarudrau ca nabho vāyuṃ ca tannasi || 13|| indrāgnī tasya vaktrānte jihvāyāṃ ca sarasvatīm | daṃṣṭrāsu siṃhaśārdūlaśarabhām̐śca mahoragān ||14|| kaṇṭhe dadarśa mervadriṃ skandhe himācalādikān | devatiryaṅmanuṣyām̐śca bāhuṣvapi parātmanaḥ || 15|| nābhau cāsyāntarīkṣaṃ ca pādayoḥ pṛthivīṃ tathā | romasvasyauṣadhīn sarvānpādapānnakhapaṃktiṣu || 16|| niḥśvāse’sya caturvedān sāṃgopāgāndadarśa saḥ | ādityām̐śca vasūn rudrān viśvedevānmarudraṇān || 17|| apsarasaśca gandharvān vidyādhroragarākṣasān | evamāpālalokānsopaskaraprajānvitān || 18|| dadarśāṃgeṣu prahlādastataḥ saumyaṃ dadarśa tam | śrīvatsakaustubhoraskaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam || 19|| śaṃkhacakragadākhaḍgaśārṅgādihetibhiryutam | sarvopaniṣadāmarthaṃ dṛṣṭvā nanāma daṃḍavat ||1.140.20 || harṣāśrujalasiktāṃgo dhyāyanpārśve hyupasthitaḥ | tāvaddhiraṇyakaśipuḥ krodhānmṛtyuvaśe sthitaḥ |||2 1|| kiṃsvidayaṃ nu hantā me hanmi taṃ purato jaye | yoddhuṃ khaḍgaṃ samudyamya nṛsiṃhaṃ tamathādravat ||22|| devāśca munayaḥ sarve prāṇino brahmasṛṣṭijāḥ | ājagmuḥ śrīharestasya yuddhasya darśanāya ca |||23|| atha daityagaṇāḥ sarve sajjaśastrā mahābalāḥ | jaghnurhariṃ mahāvegāḥ peturvahnau pataṃgavat ||24|| nṛhariṇā saṭodbhūtavahninā dānavā bhṛśam | nirbhasmitāḥ kṣaṇātsarve sahasrāṇyāyudhāni ca ||25|| anye ca rākṣasā daityā dānavā hyasurāstathā | ye cāpatan raṇaṃ kartuṃ tān dvedhāpātayaddhariḥ |||26|| kām̐ścid daṃṣṭrābhirugrābhiḥ kām̐ścinnakhaiḥ sutīkṣṇakaiḥ | kām̐ścicchastrairmahāghorairnāśayāmāsa keśavaḥ ||97|| prahlādaṃ sānugaṃ hitvā bhasmite rakṣasāṃ bale | nāśite daityasainye ca kālānalaśikhopamaḥ ||28|| hiraṇyakaśipuryāvadudyamyāsiṃ tu nṛhareḥ | vadhāya kṛtayatno’bhūt tāvajjagrāha taṃ prabhuḥ ||29|| khaḍgamācchidya deveśo mocayāmāsa taṃ ripum | gadāmādāya daityeśaścakāra maṇḍalāni ca ||1.140.3 0 || gadāpi pātitā yāvat carmakhaḍgāntaraṃ mahat | gṛhītvābhyadravad daityastaṃ harirmaṇḍalena vai ||3 1 || nināya ca gṛhadvāre madhye cotplutya dharṣitam | bahubalaṃ prakurvantaṃ kṣipantaṃ patkarādikān |||3.|| pātayāmāsa deveśastadā caikena pāṇinā | gṛhītvā patitaṃ bhūmau muhuḥ sampadya cāsuram ||3 2|| pādaghātaiścārdhamṛtyu kṛtvotsaṃge nidhāya ca | nakhairvidārayāmāsa tīkṣṇairvajranibhairghanaiḥ || 34|| viṣṇunindākṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tathā vaiṣṇavavairajam | nṛhareḥ sparśanādeva nirbhasmitamabhūttadā ||35|| vakṣo daityeśvarasyāsau vidadārāsthimaṇḍalam | tadgātraṃ śatadhā bhittvā nakhaistīkṣṇairmahāhariḥ ||36|| ākṛṣyāntrāṇi dīrghāṇi gale saṃsaktavān prabhuḥ | sa nirmalātmā daityendraḥ paśyan sākṣānmukhaṃ hareḥ || 37|| harihastāgatamṛtyuḥ kṛtārtho vijahāvasūn | nākāśe na kṣitau mṛtyurnāntarbahirna sṛṣṭijaiḥ ||38|| na śuṣkairnārdratattvaiśca satyaṃ kartuṃ hariḥ svayam | asṛṣṭeḥ rūpamāsthāya dhāmākāśaṃ vidhāya ca |||39|| nidhāyāṅke nakhaiḥ sāyaṃ madhye dvāri jaghāna tam | harirjānāti yatkartuṃ nānyo jānāti tattathā ||1.140.40 || atha daityendraraktena kiṃśukībhūtanṛharim | hantumudāyudhā daityāḥ samantāt śastrapāṇayaḥ ||41 || abhyadhāvam̐stadā tām̐ścāhan pārṣṇinakhadormukhaiḥ | cakre ca garjanāṃ brahmāṇḍāvṛtīn pravibhidya yā ||42||| aṭṭahāsānvitā vyāptā brahmaloke ca dhāmasu | jaladāścāpatan vyomno grahāśca kampitāḥ sthalāt ||43|| cukṣubhurvārinidhayo digibhāśca vicukruśuḥ | dyaurbhramitā vimānāni stabdhāni bhūśca kampitā ||44|| utpetuḥ bhūbhṛtaḥ śailāḥ khaṃ kakubho na rejire | daityaśūnye ca bhaktāḍhye prāsāde nṛhariṃ tadā ||45|| praharṣapūritā devyo vavṛṣuḥ kusumāni vai | devarṣimunayo divyavimānasthāstadā harim ||46 || paśyanti sma ca vāditrāndundubhiprabhṛtīm̐stadā | vādayāmāsurāpremṇāpsaraso nanṛtustathā ||47|| gandharvā gāyanaṃ cakrurjaguḥ svasti surastriyaḥ | brahmāṇḍavāsinastatrāgatyeḍire ca nṛharim ||48|| brahmā rudrendragirīśapitṛsiddhārṣicāraṇāḥ | prajāpatayo manavo vidyādharamahoragāḥ ||49|| yakṣāḥ kinnaravetālāḥ gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ | kimpuruṣāḥ sādhyadevā viśvedevāśca yājñikāḥ ||1.140.50 || bhūdevāḥ pārṣadā nandasunandakumudādayaḥ | īḍire taṃ narasiṃhaṃ mahābhayakaradṛśam ||5 1 || namo’kṣarapararūpākṣarāntaryāmiṇe ca te | namo muktābhivandyāya namo vyūhātmane ca te ||52|| namaḥ prakṛtirūpāya pradhānapuruṣāya te | mahākālasvarūpāya bhūmarūpāya te namaḥ ||23|| apratarkyasvarūpāyānantarūpāya te namaḥ | abhaktānāśakartre te bhaktarakṣaṇakāriṇe ||54|| varadānānurūpāya tathaiva daityaghātine | sarvātmane karālāya vikarālāya te namaḥ ||55|| yajñabhāgapradātre te rakṣakāya namonamaḥ | hṛdi bodhāya devānāṃ trātre tasmai namonamaḥ |||56|| tapomārgapravṛttāya ṛṣigamyāya te namaḥ | śrāddhatṛptipradāyātra paratradāyine namaḥ ||57|| yogagatiprasārāya siddhismṛddhigṛhāya ca | tapobalaprakṛṣṭāya dharmātmam̐ste namonamaḥ ||58|| stutistutyāya vidyāyāḥ śubhādhipataye namaḥ | ratnapradātre nyāyāya nītidhātre namonamaḥ ||59|| manutvasaṃrakṣakāya prajāpatitvadāyine | naṭanāṭyagāyakānāṃ krīḍāgītyātmane namaḥ ||1.140.60 || vāhakatvapradātre te saparyādipradāyine | viṣṭikāryaniyoktre te jagadīśāya te namaḥ ||61|| vaiṣṇavānāṃ rakṣakāya bahurūpadharāya te | nārāyaṇāya kṛṣṇāya śrīharaye namo namaḥ |||62|| nityaṃ śāntasvarūpāyedānīṃ bhayaṃkarāya te | avismṛtasvarūpāyādbhutāya haraye namaḥ ||63|| ityākāśāt tuṣṭuvuste’ntikaṃ ke’pi na cāyayuḥ | ugramṛtyormukhe gantuṃ śrīmṛte kaḥ patet śvasan ||64|| te prasādayituṃ bhītā jvalitaṃ viśvatomukham | mātaraṃ jagatāṃ dhātrīṃ cintayāmāsurīśvarīm ||65|| hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīṃ sarvopadravanāśinīm | viṣṇornityānavadyāṃgīṃ dhyātvā nārāyaṇīṃ śubhām ||66|| śrīsūktaṃ saṃjapanto vai namaścakruḥ pareśvarīm | cintyamānā tu sā devī tatraivāvirabhūttadā ||67|| caturbhujā viśālākṣī sarvabhūṣādyalaṃkṛtā | dukūlaśāṭikāyuktā kaustubhasraksumaṃgalā ||68|| tāṃ dṛṣṭvā devadevasya patnīṃ māṃ jagatāṃ tataḥ | ūcuḥ prāṃjalayo devāḥ prasannaṃ śrīhariṃ kuru ||69|| ityuktā sahasā lakṣmīḥ priyaṃ dūrātpatiṃ harim | praṇipatya namaskṛtya prasīdeti hyuvāca tam ||1.140.70|| tathāpi śrīharestasya krodhaḥ śaśāma no manāk | adṛṣṭābhūtapūrvatvāt sā nopeyāya cāntikam ||71|| tadā te preṣayāmāsurbhaktaṃ brahmamayaṃ śiśum | prahlādaṃ sa jagāmāśu pādayoḥ patitastadā |||72|| nanāma daṇḍavaddevaṃ prahasan vidhṛtāṃjaliḥ | dṛṣṭvā tamarbhakaṃ rakṣyaṃ kṛpāluḥ śrīharistadā ||73|| tamutthāpyābhayahastaṃ tanmūrdhnyadhānmuhurmuhuḥ | āślikṣaddhṛdaye kṛtvā dadau svacaraṇau hṛdi ||74|| tāvacchrīrapi deveśaṃ gatvā natvā ca saṃsthitā | aṃkamādāya tāṃ devīṃ samāśliṣya dayānidhiḥ ||75||| kṛpāsudhārdradṛṣṭyā vai niraikṣata mahāhariḥ | tato jayajayetyuccaiḥ stuvatāṃ namatāṃ tadā ||76|| tadyathādṛṣṭituṣṭānāṃ sānandaḥ saṃbhramo’bhavat | tato devagaṇāḥ sarve harṣanirbharamānasāḥ ||77|| ūcuḥ prāṃjalayo devaṃ namaskṛtya jagatpatim | draṣṭumatyadbhutaṃ tejo na śaktāste jagatpate ||78|| atyugraṃ te navaṃ rūpaṃ draṣṭumapi na śaknumaḥ | kathaṃkāraṃ samīpe te sthātu śaknuma īśvarāḥ ||79|| atyarthitastu vibudhaistejastadatibhīṣaṇam | na śaśāma ca raudraṃ tadrūpaṃ prahlāda īśvaram ||1.140.80 || nṛsiṃhaṃ hṛdye dhyātvāstauṣīddhariṃ samāhitaḥ | namo devādhidevāya sattvavilīnamūrtaye ||8 1|| brahmādayo bibhyati yadrūpāt tadrūpiṇe namaḥ ghanābhijanasaundaryatapaḥśrutabalādibhiḥ ||82|| smṛddhivākpaṭutābhiścātuṣyate te namonamaḥ | tavāṅghrivimukho vipro yamaiśca niyamairyutaḥ ||83|| bhaktaśvādāt kanīyānsa bhaktahṛṣṭāya te namaḥ | mānahīnāya dīnāya tuṣyate te namonamaḥ ||84|| bhaktimārgāśritasaukhyakartre te haraye namaḥ | rakṣāvibhūtisampatsusaukhyadātre punarnamaḥ ||85|| brahmādayo’pi devāśca śāntadarśanakāṃkṣiṇaḥ | stuvanti tvāṃ parātmānaṃ śāntarūpaṃ tataḥ kuru ||86|| nāhaṃ bibhaimi deveśa krūrānnṛsiṃharūpaṇāt | bibhemi kāmaroṣādestato rakṣāṃ vidhehi me ||87|| asurādrakṣaṇāṃ tattu dehasya rakṣaṇaṃ kṛtam | tadvai me rakṣaṇaṃ nāsti tasmānmadrakṣaṇaṃ kuru ||88|| kleśakarmavipākāderajāyā bandhanāt khalu | rakṣaṇaṃ kuru viśveśa tanmataṃ rakṣaṇaṃ bhavet ||89|| īhāḥ putrakalatrāderdhanaiśvaryadivaspateḥ | kadāpi naiva pūryante tābhyo me rakṣaṇaṃ kuru ||1.140.90 || daityendrasya mayā dṛṣṭāḥ smṛddhayastā na rakṣikāḥ | aiśvaryāṇi mayā dṛṣṭānyetānyavanti naiva hi ||91|| siddhayaścāpi devānāṃ rakṣā kurvanti naiva ca | bhaktānāṃ tvaṃ rakṣaṇāya bahurūpī bhavasyatha ||92|| uddhārayasi viśvātman tathoddhāraṃ ca me kuru | rājyaṃ tu bandhanaṃ proktaṃ pāpaṃ pāpataraṃ mahat ||93 || yat satāṃ sevane vighnaṃ mānasattādidūṣaṇaiḥ | dīnatve tapa āsthāya vāṃcchanti kāmanāmayān ||94|| bhogānāsādya paścāt tvāṃ vismarantīti kilbiṣam | tato devādhidevatvaṃ dārāsattādhanādiṣu ||95|| mā yogaṃ me dehi nātha dehi tvaccaraṇāmbuje | tava dāsasya dāsānāṃ madhye yogaṃ pradehi me ||96|| ime divāstava rūpaṃ saumyaṃ kāṃkṣanti darśane | tasmāt saumyaṃ sukhadaṃ vai rūpaṃ darśaya mādhava ||97|| ityarthitaḥ sa bhagavān tejastadatibhīṣaṇam | roṣānvitaṃ tu saṃhṛtya babhūva sukhadarśanaḥ ||98|| śaratkoṭīndusaṃkāśaḥ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇaḥ | sudhāmayasaṭāpuṃjavidyutkoṭinibhaprabhaḥ ||99|| sadratnāḍhyakaṭakakeyūrormikādibhūṣitaḥ | śaṃkhacakragṛhītābhyāmudbāhubhyāṃ virājitaḥ || 1.140.100 || varadābhayahastābhyāmitarābhyāṃ suśobhitaḥ | śrīvatsakaustubhorasko vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ || 101 || kuṇḍalahāraraśanāmaṇisvarṇavirājitaḥ | savyāṃgasthaśriyā yukto’bhavattadā nṛkesarī || 102||| lakṣmīnṛsiṃhaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā devatāḥ samaharṣayaḥ | ānandāśrujalaiḥ siktvā namaścakrurnirantaram || 103|| arpayāmāsurātmeśa divyapuṣpādipūjanam | ratnakuṃbhaiḥ sudhāpūrṇairabhiṣicya sanātanam || 104|| vastrairābharaṇairgandhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpairmanoramaiḥ | divyairniveditairdīpairarcayitvā janārdanam || 1 05|| tuṣṭuvurdivyasatstotrairnamaścakrurmuhurmuhuḥ | pādayoḥ patitānsarvāndatveṣṭāśīrvacāṃsi saḥ || 106|| prahlādaṃ sarvadaityānāṃ cakre rājānamavyayam | varārthaṃ prerayāmāsa prasanno bhagavānpunaḥ || 107|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nṛsiṃhaspaṣṭadarśanatattejovyāpanahiraṇyakaśipuvidāraṇadevādikṛtastavanaprahlādakṛtastutisaumyadarśanalakṣmīkṛtastavanādinirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 140||
<1.141> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha lakṣmi nṛsiṃhaḥ sa bhaktaparīkṣaṇāya vai | prāha varān grahītuṃ ca prasahya nijabhaktakam || 1 || gṛhāṇa rājyaṃ pṛthvyāstadāsamudraṃ sukhī bhava | saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ sukhī bhava || 2 || saptapātālarājyaṃ vā svīkuru bhaktapuṃgava | saptasvargamayaṃ rājyaṃ kuru dhruvapadaṃ tathā || 3 || gṛhāṇa nūtanaṃ rājyaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ cārpaye priya | yadyatkāmayase bhakta tattaddadāmi te sukham || 4 || yānāni pramadā dāsyo dāsā gajāsturaṃgamāḥ | divyāni ca vimānāni siddhayaścāṇimādikāḥ || 5 || vedhaḥ padaṃ śivapadaṃ viṣṇupadaṃ virāṭpadam | nūtanameva dāsye’haṃ gṛhāṇa yadi rocate || 6 || brahmāṇḍānāṃ madagre vai nāsti vai gaṇanā manāk | asaṃkhyāni ca vartante śāsane mama tāni vai || 7 || lokāśca lokapālāśca tathā brahmāṇḍapālakāḥ | brahmaviṣṇumaheśānā hyasaṃkhyāḥ santi madvaśe || 8 || tathā tvāmapi caiśaṃ vā vairājaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca vā | dhāmārpaye svatantraṃ vai yayecchasi gṛhāṇa bhoḥ || 9 || ityevaṃ bhrāmyamāṇo’pi niḥspṛhaḥ prākṛte’rthake | vinā hareḥ padaṃ naiva yayāce sa janārdanāt || 1.141.10|| yadyadditsasi govinda tavaivāstu na me spṛhā | vināśyarthayitā nāsmi prākṛtaṃ naṣṭameva yat || 1 1|| avināśī śāśvato’yaṃ nāśāntaṃ kathamarthaye | tatsarvaṃ kṛtrimaṃ rājyaṃ nāstyakṛtaḥ kṛtena vai || 12 || akṛtaśca sadā mokṣyaḥ kṛtena karmaṇā nahi | ātmanā śaraṇāgatyā nityo mokṣo hi labhyate || 13|| prakṛtipuruṣasyātra pradhānapuruṣasya vā | vairājānāṃ mahāviṣṇorviṣṇorvā vedhasastathā || 14|| rudrasya lokapālānāṃ devānāṃ phaṇināṃ tathā | lokā rājyāni vibhavāḥ sthānāni smṛddhimanti ca || 15|| prākṛtānīti sarvāṇi rajastamomayāni vā | sāttvikānyapi gauṇāni procyante nirayā hi yat || 16|| paraṃdhāmākṣaramṛte prākṛtā nirayā hi te | nāsti me tatra kutrāpi spṛhā haripadaṃ vinā || 17|| tasmānnātha sadā dehi dhāmni tvaccaraṇāmbujam | tava sevāṃ sadā dehi tathā tvadbhaktasevanam || 18|| satsu ratiṃ sadā dehi vāsaṃ prayaccha dhāmani | tvayi premāspadaṃ dehi caikāṃ niṣṭhāṃ sadā tvayi || 19|| dehi cātmakṛtānandaṃ tvayyeva śāśvataṃ param | nānyānandaṃ samīhe’tra paratrāśāśvataṃ kṣayam || 1.141.20|| tavecchāyā yadā yatra yasya yasmācca yatkṛte | yena yaṃ vā yo’haṃ kuryāṃ tattvayyaiva tavārthataḥ ||21 || bhavatsambandhakaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ sadāstu me | dehendriyamanobuddhiprāṇāstṛptāḥ kadāpi na |||22|| tvayi syācchāśvatītṛptistāṃ vṛṇe dehi nātha me | tvayyārāmaṃ sadā yaccha tvadvinānyad vidāraya ||23||| mokṣaṃ yaccha satāṃ sevāṃ prayaccha śaraṇaprada | ityabhyarthya virarāma prahlādo jñānināṃ varaḥ ||24|| bhagavānāha taṃ bhakta yo necchati dadāmi te | ya icchenna dadāmyasmai iti me vakravartanam ||25|| mayājñayā gṛhāṇedaṃ rājyaṃ tava piturhi yat | tatra tvaṃ bandhanaṃ naiva manniyogātprayāsyasi ||26|| madarpaṇaṃ vinā naiva bhoktavyamapi vastu sat | śarīre mānase vāpi māṃ sadā smara karmaṇi ||27|| bālo’si vṛddhavijño’si bhakto’si nityamuktavat | tasmād gṛhāṇa rājyaṃ vai saptapātālasaṃbhavam ||18|| āśayā bhajate yo māṃ na vai bhajāmi taṃ janam | anāśayā bhajan bhakto labhate’rghyaṃ mamāgrataḥ ||29|| ahaṃ svāmyaspṛhe bhakte dṛṣṭvā bhaktaṃ tu saspṛham | dūraṃ yāmi nāntikaṃ vai niṣkāmaṃ yāmi sarvathā |||1.141.3 0|| ato manvantaraṃ rājyaṃ daityānāmanubhuṃkṣva tat | kathāṃ śṛṇvam̐śca kathayan madīyāṃ mokṣadāyinīm ||31 || karmāṇi cārpayanmahyaṃ kuru rājyamakaṃṭakam | sadā māmanusandhāya kuru naiṣkarmyameva hi ||3 2|| kṛtasya kuru bhogena kṣapaṇaṃ nūtanaṃ ca yat | tattu samarpaṇenaivābhogyāyati vidhāpaya ||33 || kālena dehe vilaye māmupaiṣyasi sadyaśāḥ | prahlādaḥ prāha deveśa varaṃ me pitṛśodhanam ||34|| dehi tavāparādhaṃ sa kṛtavān nindayā ghṛṇī | tava bhakte mayi cāpyaparādhaṃ kṛtavān sa hi ||35|| tadasmātpāpmanaḥ sadyaḥ pūyeta tvatkṛpāśrayaḥ | bhavediti vṛṇe nānyad vṛṇe nātha namo’stu te |||36|| hariḥ prāha tvayā vaṃśyāścaikaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā | tāritā bhaktavaryeṇa kimatrāsti praśaṃsanam ||37|| yatra me sādhavaḥ santi praśāntāḥ samadarśinaḥ | taddeśā mlecchakācārāstatratyā mānavā api ||38|| pūyante tvādṛśabhaktayogādatra na saṃśayaḥ | kuru pituḥ pretakāryaṃ sa ca yāsyati vaidhase ||3 9|| satye loke punā rāme janmani rākṣaso bhavet | rāvaṇākhyastṛtīye tu kārṣṇe janmani me’nagha ||1.141.40 || śiśupālo’suro bhāvī tato mokṣaṃ gamiṣyati | prahlāda pārṣadau me yau jayaśca vijayaśca tau ||41 || sanakādyaparādhena bhrātarau dvau babhūvatuḥ | hiraṇyakaśipurjyeṣṭho hiraṇyākṣastato’nujaḥ ||42|| tāveva rāvaṇo jyeṣṭhaḥ kuṃbhakarṇastayo’nujaḥ | tāveva dantavaktraśca śiśupālo bhaviṣyataḥ ||43 || tato śāpād vimuktau tāveṣyataḥ pārṣadaṃ pakṣa | bhaktayoretayoryogāt mama janmakathāmayam ||44|| gāsyanti caritaṃ lokāstena yāsyanti mokṣaṇam | tava bhaktyā ca bhaktānāṃ dārḍhyaṃ bhaktau bhaviṣyati ||45|| evaṃ prasanno lakṣmīśastasmāyiṣṭānvarāndadau | tato devagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ sarveśo bhaktavatsalaḥ ||46|| prahlādaṃ sarvadaityānāṃ cakre rājānamavyayam | āśvāsya bhaktaṃ prahlādaṃ cābhiṣicya surottamaiḥ ||47|| dattvā naiṣkarmyarūpāṃ ca bhaktimavyabhicāriṇīm | harirdevagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ stūyamāno nṛkesarī ||48|| vikīrṇaḥ puṣpavarṣaistu siṃhāraṇye jagāma he | tatra śarabharūpeṇa śaṃbhunā kṛtavān raṇam ||49|| parasparaṃ parityajya dehāvadṛśyatāṃ gato | siṃhaḥ śilā nārasiṃhī śaṃbhustu śarabheśvaraḥ ||1.141.50|| vartiṣyete ca yāvadvai sṛṣṭiḥ sthāsyati tāvatā | tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ prapedire ||51 || punaśca yajñabhāgām̐śca bubhujuḥ prītamānasāḥ | prahlādastu tadā cakre rājyaṃ vaiṣṇavadharmataḥ ||52|| bahubhiryajñadānādyairarcayitvā hariṃ tataḥ | yāsyatyante harerdhāma yogigamyaṃ sanātanam ||53|| ityetatprahlādacaritaṃ śroṣyanti ye harerjanāḥ | te sarve pāpanirmuktā yāsyanti śrīhareḥ padam ||54|| etatte kathitaṃ lakṣmi nṛsiṃhavaibhavaṃ hareḥ | tadvaṃśyā siṃhamūrdhanyāḥ raivatāraṇyavāsinaḥ ||55|| atha vāmanarūpaṃ te kathayiṣye śṛṇu priye | raivatādrau divyagirau vāmano’yāt svayaṃ hariḥ ||56|| iti śrīlakṣmonārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nṛhariṇā prahlādāya varadānaṃ pitṛrājye’bhiṣecanaṃ nṛsiṃhasyāraṇye’dṛśyatā ceti kathananāmā ekacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 141 ||
<1.142> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca vāmanaṃ śrīhareḥ rūpaṃ yannimittamabhūt priye | tatsarvaṃ susphuṭaṃ te’haṃ kathayāmi yathātatham || 1 || saurāṣṭre paścime prānte raivatādrirmahāngiriḥ | yatra devagaṇāvāsāḥ siddhā vasanti lakṣaśaḥ || 2 || yoginyaścāpi tīrthāni nivasanti nirantaram | prahlādasyābhavat putro virocana itīrataḥ || 3 || tasya putro mahābāhurbalī rājābhavadbalī | tena yajñāḥ kṛtāḥ śreṣṭhā bahavo bhinnabhūmiṣu || 4 || eko yajñaḥ kṛtastatra raivatādritalasthale | yatrāgatya svayaṃ devo vāmano’bhyarthayadbalim || 5 || tatkathāṃ paramāṃ divyāṃ pāvanīṃ mokṣadāyinīm | kathayāmi mahālakṣmi tṛptirnāsti kathāmṛte || 6 || yatra dāmodaraṃ tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇahradastathā | kimanyairbahubhistīrthaistayoḥ snātvā pramucyate || 7 || siṃhāraṇyasyottare vai vyāghrāraṇyamaye sthale | somanāthasya sānnidhye hyudayānto girirmahān || 8 || yaḥ kṛtasmara ityukto vāḍavānalabhasmitaḥ | tasyaiva pārśvabhāge tu revatākhyo giriḥ smṛtaḥ | śrīhareḥ kaustubhamaṇeḥ khaṇḍo’yaṃ sthūlatāṃ gataḥ || 9 || raivatākhyo manustatra tadadhyātmatayā sthitaḥ | so’yaṃ vai raivatagirirdivyaḥ kṛṣṇahṛdi sthitaḥ | mahato hastinaḥ kaṇṭhe svarṇaghaṃṭādvayaṃ yathā || 1.142.10 || pūrṇimāyāstathā sāyaṃ cālambete śaśī raviḥ | svargaṃ yāvat taducchrāyo’ntarīkṣaṃ kaṭisaṃśritam || 11 || dattātreyādayaḥ siddhā vasanti śikhare’sya vai | śikharāṇāṃ kukṣibhāge vasanti sarvadevatāḥ || 12|| parvatasya kaṭibhāge’rhannāthagautamādayaḥ | vasanti bhagavanto vai munayaḥ sādhuyoginaḥ || 13|| parvatasyorubhāge tu gāndharvāḥ kinnarāstathā | vidyādharāstathā saumyāḥ kiṃpuruṣā vasanti hi || 14|| parvatasya jānubhāge yoginyaḥ śaṃkarapriyāḥ | devyaśca kṛttikāścaivābhīrāṇyaḥ sādhvikāstathā || 15|| jaṃghābhāge parvatasya kāmadhenukulāni vai | devāśca devakariṇaḥ śvetāścatuḥsudantakāḥ || 16|| siṃhā vyāghrāstathā daivā narasiṃhakuṭumbinaḥ | vasanti vyomagatayo divyāḥ sūryasamaprabhāḥ || 17|| pādasthāne raivatasya gopyaḥ kṛṣṇapriyāḥ śubhāḥ | divyāstathāpi mānuṣarūpeṇa vicaranti hi || 18|| mucukundasya mahatī guhā pātālasaṃcarā | rādhāyā mandiraṃ ramyaṃ svarṇarakṣānadīgatam || 1 9|| rukmāṃgadādirājñāṃ vai rājadhānī ca vartate | patnīvratākhyaviprasya camatkārā bhavanti ca |||1.142.20||| yatrāraṇyāni cūtānāṃ kṣīrikāṇāṃ vanāni ca | karmadānāṃ ṭimburūṇāṃ jāmbūnāṃ pravaṇāni ca ||21 || sītāphalānāṃ sauvarṇakadalīnāṃ vanāni ca | ikṣūṇāṃ śarkarākandamūlānāṃ prasthalāni ca ||22|| boriyākhyamahāsthalyāṃ devyaḥ snānti vasanti ca | nārāyaṇahṛdasthalyāṃ yoginyo vicaranti ca || 23 || devyastu kāṣṭhavāhinyo’raṇye tīrthe bhramanti ca | pārijātaprasūnānāṃ kundānāṃ kalpaśākhinām | vanānyatra bhavantyeva sugandhaśatayojanam || 24|| paritaḥ pavano nītvā karoti surabhisthalīḥ | agneruṣṇāḥ prakuṇḍāśca kvacicchaityajalāśayāḥ || 25 || saritaḥ svarṇarūpyābhā nirmalodakasaṃcarāḥ | sarasā oṣadhimiśrarasavatyo vahanti ca || 26 || yajjalāni janāḥ pītvā devā devyo bhavanti ca | pārthivā api nṛnāryo tajjalauṣadhibhogikāḥ || 27|| ṣoḍaśābdāḥ sadā hṛṣṭapuṣṭāḥ kāmātigojjvalāḥ | candramukhyo vilasanti svargabhramaṇakārikāḥ || 28 || navaraṃgapanasādiphalānāṃ nālpatā kvacit | kharjūrāṇāṃ śrīphalānāṃ nārīkelāmṛtātmanām || 29|| āmalakatriphalānāṃ saṃghātsaṃghā bhavanti vai | guṃdrakāṇāmiṅgudīnāṃ śimbipatraphalatvacām || 1.142.30 || vṛkṣāṇāṃ vaṃśamālānāṃ bilvatindukaśākhinām | udumbaravaṭasarjatilakānāṃ vanāni ca || 31 || tulasīnāṃ vanānyatra devadārupraśākhinām | drākṣāṇāṃ nāgavallīnāṃ tiktānāṃ vallayastathā || 32 || mālatīmallikāśvetājīvantīsvarṇavallayaḥ | phalapuṣpapatrasampadvilasantyo’tra bhānti vai || 33 || sthale sthalyāṃ niriāraṇā jalānāṃ pravahanti ca | svarṇakārāstāmrakārāḥ kāyākalpakarāstathā || 34|| kṣuttṛṭvināśikāścāpi vallyo vṛkṣā bhavanti ca | kuṇḍā divyāstatra santi snānenādṛśyatā bhavet || 35|| svarṇajalāstathā kuṇḍā lauhaṃ svarṇaṃ bhavejjalāt | patratṛṇāni vai santi chinno dehaḥ susīvyate || 36 || raktaṃ ghaṭṭaṃ bhavatyeva saṃjīvanī ca vartate | jalakuṇḍāstathā santi snātvā nārī naro bhavet || 37|| naro vā jāyate nārī tatastu parvate gatiḥ | nānyathā iti sāmarthyaṃ raivatādrau samīkṣyate || 38 || kvacitkuṇḍe kṛtasnānāt pakṣau bhavata uḍḍane | punaḥ snānānmānavatvaṃ yathāvasthaṃ bhavennanu || 3 9|| yaddroṇyāṃ yonidānena nāryo bhavanti devatāḥ | narā liṃgapradānena jāyante siddhayonayaḥ ||1.142.40 || kvacidoṣadhayogena janaḥ siṃhavapurbhavet | mārgayitvā hariṇādīn punaśca mānavo bhavet ||41|| kāmarūpajalāḥ kuṇḍāḥ svalpakāḥ santi parvate | yathecchati tathārūpaṃ jāyate snāturatra vai | tatratyāstu prajāḥ sarvā svargānnyūnaṃ na bhuṃjate ||42|| vanāni vividhānyeva kāmapūraṇakāni hi | sarvadā phalavantyeva patrapuṣpādimanti ca | meghāstatra sadā madhye śroṇyāṃ vasanti vṛṣṭidāḥ |||43 || vidyutaśca sadā rātrau śanaistejo dadatyamum | tārāḥ sthirāḥ kvacittatra vasanti śramanodane ||44|| rājatyaḥ svarṇakhanyaśca vividhadhātumiśritāḥ | khanyo hīrakamāṇikyasphāṭikaratnavidrumāḥ ||45|| rasāyanāni divyāni pātālamūlavanti ca | vidyante’tra raivatādrau labhyante puṇyaśālibhiḥ ||46|| apsarasaḥ svargavatyo’trāgatya snānti yānti ca | yātrālavo lakṣakoṭisuramānavasajjanāḥ | narā nāryo mahāprādakṣiṇyamūrje bhramanti hi ||47|| gaṇāśca gaṇikāścaiva śuddhyanti tanudānataḥ | parīsarovaraṃ tatra parīṇāṃ snānakāraṇāt | indrasarovaraṃ tadvad devīnāṃ snānakāraṇāt ||48|| rohasarovaraṃ tatra devāplavanakāraṇāt | dātṛsarovaraṃ droṇyāṃ dātṝṇāṃ snānakāraṇāt | vīrasarovaraṃ droṇyāṃ pitṝṇāṃ snānakāraṇāt ||49|| satīsarovaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ satīnāṃ snānakāraṇāt | bhaveśvarataḍāgaṃ ca sarvauṣadhirasāyanam | bhavantyevaṃ tatra śaile divyāni ca sarāṃsi ca ||1.142.50 || paritastatra sarito niḥsarantyakṣayairjalaiḥ | raivatādrau sthitāḥ sarve paśyanti medinīṃ diśam | samudrānparvatāndeśān grāmān lokān pradeśakān ||51 || sadehena yadā vāñcchā svargaṃ gantuṃ bhavet tadā | raivatādreḥ śikhare vai gatvā snānena siddhatām ||52|| prāpya yāyāt tato naiva pated yadi na vāsanā | gaumukhyāṃ snānamātrācca kamaṇḍalujalāplavāt | dattātreyajalabindupānāt siddhā bhavanti hi ||53|| grahāstacchikhare śrāntiṃ labdhvā yānti diśāntaram | divojuṣāṃ vimānāni tatra viśramya yānti ca ||54|| brāhmaṃ caiśaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca mokṣīyaṃ caiśvaraṃ tathā | yāmyaṃ svargyaṃ ca panthānaṃ tacchṛṃgād yānti vai janāḥ ||55|| bhīravajapanāmānaṃ sthalamāsādya mānavaḥ | patatyaraṇye tasyaiva tatra svargaṃ bhavatyapi ||56|| na svargānnyūnatā tatra kiṃcinmātramapi dhruvam | tatra tīrthāni devānāmanekāni bhavanti vai ||57|| raivatādriṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kartumāyānti devatāḥ | ṛṣayo munayaḥ svargyāḥ pitaro yoginastathā ||58|| siddhā vidyādharāścaiva cāraṇā devayonayaḥ | sādhurūpeṣu devāśca siddhāḥ krāmyanti taṃ pari ||59|| sādhvīrūpeṣu devyaśca parikrāmyanti taṃ girim | śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīrāmacandro dattātreyaśca nṛhariḥ ||1.142.60 || kapilo vāmano haṃsaḥ ṛṣabho nāradastathā | parśurāmaśca vai vyāsaḥ kumāro buddha ityapi ||61 || sanandanādayaḥ sarve vyūhā brahmādayastathā | kārtikyāṃ tu prabodhinyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ ca yāvatā ||62|| save devāśca tīrthāni pūryaḥ kṣetrāṇi dhāma ca | parvatāḥ saritaḥ sarve sāgarā bhūmayastathā ||63|| āyānti ca vasantyatra raivatādrau sthale sthale | patre patre vasantyete devāḥ kartuṃ pradakṣiṇam ||64|| raivatādrestadānīṃ vai kṛtaṃ yena pradakṣiṇam | kṛtaṃ tena pṛthivyāṃ vai savidhānapradakṣiṇam ||65|| raivatādriparikrāmayitāro mānavāstadā | manuṣyā nahi draṣṭavyā draṣṭavyā devakoṭayaḥ ||66|| teṣāṃ pādarajolābhe mucyante janmakoṭayaḥ | bālāḥ kumārāḥ sthavirā narā nāryopi ye tadā ||67|| raivataṃ parikrāmanti pāvanāste hariśritāḥ | sādhuḥ sādhvī ca sanyāsī sanyāsinī virāgiṇī ||68|| vaiṣṇavī śāṃkarī devī vaiṣṇavaḥ śāṃkaro’thavā | gāṇapatyāśca vā mokṣamārgagāste tu devatāḥ ||69|| tebhyo vai bhojanaṃ dānaṃ vastraṃ vānyat svakaṃ bhavet|| taddātavyaṃ samastaṃ vai sevāyāṃ svargadaṃ bhavet ||1.142.70 || yasyāgre yadbhavedvastu taddeyaṃ tatra sarvathā | santaḥ sādhvyastoṣaṇīyāḥ kāyavāṅmānasairapi ||71|| sarvasvārpaṇakartre vai nārāyaṇahariḥ svayam | svīyaṃ sarvaṃ dadātyeva bhaktāya brahmarūpiṇe ||72||| dāmodare’titīrthe ye mṛtā vai yatra tatra hi | te vasanti harergehe na patanti bhave kvacit ||73|| svārpaṇaṃ prathamaṃ dānaṃ dvitīyaṃ tu dhanārpaṇam | kṣetrādikaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca naijārpaṇaṃ caturthakam ||74|| etatsarvaṃ girestasya parikramaṇajaṃ phalam | labhyate tatra pāpāni jvalanti nodbhavanti vai ||75|| yatkiṃcidvā paropakārākhyaṃ svārthaṃ parārthakam | daihyaṃ caindriyikaṃ hārdaṃ kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ ca mokṣakṛt ||76|| jayed brahmātmabhāvastu dehabhāvaḥ parājayet | asaṃśayo vimucyeta saṃśayātmā vinaśyati ||77|| tanmamāpi mahālakṣmi sthānaṃ raivataparvakam | atīva rocate tatra dāmodaro vasāmyaham ||78|| rukmadurge mandire’haṃ trivikramo vasāmi vai | madhyenagaraṃ nṛsiṃharūpeṇāpi vasāmyaham ||79|| sthale vṛkṣe sume patre mūle rajasi parvate | saritsu bhūtale vāpyāṃ taḍāge ca vane jale ||1.142.80|| tatratye kamale padme kumude sthalapadmake | pāṣāṇe bhūvivare ca valmīke tarugulmake ||8 1|| yatra kvāpi raivatosti tatsarvatra vasāmyaham | ahaṃ vai raivatagiriḥ raivato’haṃ na bhinnatā |||82|| mama bhūṣā mama tanuḥ raivataḥ pāvanaḥ paraḥ | saurāṣṭravāsināṃ naiva yamāḥ paśyanti vai gṛham ||83|| ānartena tapaḥ kṛtvā golokāt kṣatriyeṇa vai | kṛṣṇātprāpyātra ca maṇerbhāgo bai sthāpito’sti saḥ ||84|| saurāṣṭra itivikhyātastatratyānāṃ kutobhayam | tadasminparvate divye gatānāṃ tu kuto bhayam ||85|| yatra vai dhātavo raktāḥ śvetā nīlāḥ sitāstathā | pāṣāṇā kuṃjarākārāḥ santyanye svarṇarājatāḥ ||86|| caṇakākṛtayaścānyā bālukā gokṣurāyatāḥ | divyāśca taravo vallyo gulmāḥ santānapādapāḥ ||87|| sarvaṃ tejomayaṃ svarṇaṃ mūlaṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ dalam | nahi paśyati pāpātmā muktaḥ pāpena paśyati ||88|| sevyate sa girirnityaṃ dhātvādikhanimārgaṇaiḥ | varṇāścāśramiṇastatra bhramanti ca vasanti ca ||89|| pakṣiṇastatra bahavaḥ sārasā vyomavāsinaḥ | kokilāścātakā menā haṃsā mayūrakāstathā ||1.142.90|| garuḍā gṛdhrajātīyāḥ kapotā dīrghadarśinaḥ | cakravākāḥ kṛkavākuḥ tittirā divyajātayaḥ ||91|| sarve śubhākṣarabhāṣāḥ śivāḥ śivakarāḥ sadā | 1 mṛgāśca vānarendrāśca vyāghrāḥ siṃhāstathaiva ca ||92|| bhallukāśca gajāścaiva daivāśvāḥ sāttvatāstathā | tasya tīrthaprabhāveṇa duṣṭaṃ naivācaranti te ||93|| kālena nidhanaṃ cāptāḥ paśupakṣisarīsṛpāḥ | sarve vimānamārūḍhā gacchanti vaiṣṇavaṃ padam ||94|| vāyunā patitaṃ yacca patrapuṣpaphalādikam | svarṇarakṣājale tatra sarvaṃ vai muktimeti yat ||95|| suvarṇākhyā hareḥ patnī premadraveṇa sarvadā | dāmodarasya sevāyāṃ nadīrūpeṇa vartate ||96|| nadī suvarṇarakṣā sā svarṇavālukayā yutā | cakāsti svarṇamayyeva svarṇāṃścānyān karoti ca ||97|| tatra snātuṃ nāgarājo bhitvā bhūmiṃ tu vāsukiḥ | tena mārgeṇa mūlena vivareṇāgate hyabhūt ||98|| svargādāgatya cendro’pi yaṣṭvā yajñeṣu puṣkalam | puṇyamādāya muktyarthaṃ gataḥ svargaṃ nirāmayam ||99|| kurvantyanaśanaṃ caikadivasīyamatho janāḥ | te śrīhareḥ pratāpena cāpnuyurdhāma vai hareḥ || 1.142.100 || vāsudevo’niruddhaśca pradyumnaśca sukarṣaṇaḥ | tathānye tvīśvarāḥ śatalakṣakoṭyo vasanti hi || 10 1|| prakrīḍanti priyāsteṣāṃ nityaṃ dāmodarāgrataḥ | sucandravadanā gauryaḥ śyāmāśca dṛḍhamadhyamāḥ || 102|| nitambinyaḥ sukeśyaśca sunāsāyatalocanāḥ | sugulphāḥ subhruvastatra sukukṣyaḥ supayodharāḥ || 1 03|| śobhanāsyāḥ sujaṃghāśca supādāṃghryudarāstathā | raivatākhye girau tasmin ramante ca hasanti ca || 1 04|| tatrāsti revatīkuṇḍastatra snātvā tu yāṅganā | dadyāt svarṇādidānāni putriṇī subhagā bhavet || 105|| gītikānartanairdāmodarāgre tu punaḥ punaḥ | deśabhāṣāvibhāṣiṇyo rāmā jāgrati kārtike || 1 06|| tāstu bhūtvā ramā lakṣmyo yānti śrīharimandiram | pañcapāṣāṇakaṃ ramyaṃ sundaraṃ harimandiram || 1 07|| kṛtvā vā śikharaṃ daivaṃ bahurūpasamanvitam | sarvān kāmānatikramya paraṃbrahmādhigacchati || 1 08|| paṃcavarṇaṃ dhvajaṃ dadyād dāmodaragṛhopari | tantupramāṇavarṣāṇi divyāni viṣṇulokagaḥ || 1 09|| dāmodarasvarūpeṇa vāmano’tra virājate | tasya ṣaḍgavyūtimātraṃ kṣetraṃ vastrāpathaṃ śubham || 1.142.11 0|| girerārohaṇād yāvat paścime vāmanasthalīm | sāṣaṭgavyūtidīrghā vastrāpathāntarabhūmikā || 11 1|| gayo rājā harerbhakto hyekavāraṃ samāgataḥ | viṣṇuyāgaṃ sa kṛtavān prajābhiḥ saha vaiṣṇavaḥ || 1 12|| datvā dānānyanekāni havirhutvā hutāśane | viṣṇuyāgaṃ cakārātra raivatācalasannidhau || 113 || kecit tadānī tadyajñe’piban dhūmamadhomukhāḥ | śuṣkapatrāśanāścānye’pare vai phalabhojanāḥ || 1 14|| mūlānāṃ bhakṣakāścānye pare vāyvaśanā dvijāḥ | paṃcāgnisādhakāḥ kecitkecicca salilāsanāḥ || 115|| kecijjapanti gāyatrīṃ daivīmanye sarasvatīm | kecijjapanti sūktāni dvādaśārṇaṃ japanti ca || 11 6|| aṣṭākṣaraṃ tathā kecit kaściddhaririti gṛṇan | ekabhaktaṃ tathā naktamayācitamupoṣitam || 1 17|| evamādīni puṇyāni kṛtvā dāmodarāgrataḥ | kṛtakṛtyāśca te jātā viṣṇuyāge mahāmakhe || 118 || gayo rājā tu ṛṣyādyairyāvadbhiḥ saha rājate | vimānānāṃ sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇyāgatāni ca || 11 9|| gandharvāpsarasastatra siddhacāraṇakinnarāḥ | viṣṇostu pārṣadaiḥ sākaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ netumāgatāḥ || 1.142.12 0 || samārūḍhā vimāneṣu ṛṣyādayastadā prajāḥ | sarvairjānipadaiḥ sārdhaṃ sa rājā bhāryayā saha || 121 || gato vimānamārūḍho viṣṇorlokaṃ nirāmayam | tatra kṣetre vāmanastu baliṃ bhikṣāmayācata || 1 22|| tādṛśaṃ tatparaṃ kṣetraṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati | yatra vāsādbhavenmuktiḥ kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate || 123 || tatra bahūni tīrthāni santi tāni vadāmyaham | sthānaṃ balavatā puṃsā balavad bhavatītyataḥ || 1 24|| tīrthāni tatra cāyānti svapāvitryāya padmaje | tāni vai prathamaṃ smṛtvā vakṣye trivikramaṃ tataḥ || 125 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne raivatācale dāmodarākhyavāmanapratāpadevādinivāsacamatkārikamāhātmyavibhūtikārtikaparikramaṇadivyavasatigayakṛtayajñādinirūpaṇanāmā dvicatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 142 ||
<1.143> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca tatra vastrāpathe lakṣmi kārtikyāṃ kurute tu yaḥ | yātrāṃ vigāhya tattīrthe kṛtamokṣaḥ prajāyate || 1 || dāmodare saritproktā svarṇarakṣābhidhā śubhā | brahmakuṇḍaṃ tatra tīrthaṃ tathā brahmeśvaraḥ śivaḥ || 2 || kālameghaśca saṃprokto bhavo dāmodarastathā | gavyūtidvitaye dūre kālikā śikharopari || 3 || indreśvaro vāyudiśi mṛgīkuṇḍo bhavāntike | kṛte sāraṇikaṃ tīrthaṃ tretāyāṃ hemamārakam || 4 || paścime unnabīleti kṣetraṃ yojanadūragam | tatra tīrthānyanekāni siddhasthānāni ṣoḍaśa || 5 || sūryakuṇḍastatra tīrthaṃ gaṃgeśo maṃgalaṃ tathā | siddheśvaramahādevo gavyūtiḥ paści me pure || 6 || indreśvare cakratīrthaṃ hāṭakeśastu paścime | yakṣeśvarī mahādevī tata uparikṣmādharaḥ || 7 || somaliṃgeti madhyaḥ sa yatra tīrthānyanekaśaḥ | gajendrasya padaṃ tatra tatraiva rasakūpikā || 8 || kuṇḍānāṃ ca śataṃ tatra hyambikā śikharopari | pradyumnaśca tathā sāmbastathā gorakṣako’pi ca || 9 || gaṇeśo hanumām̐ścāpi rāmalakṣmaṇamādhavāḥ | vasanti vanamadhye te tattannāmnā vanāni ca || 1.143.10 || bhavastatra samāyātaḥ kathayāmi kathāmimām | kailāsaśikhare ramye śivasya sannidhau kvacit || 11 || brahmaviṣṇusurendrādyā devāstatrāyayurdrutam | viṣṇuḥ provāca taṃ śaṃbhuṃ daityānāṃ ca varapradam || 12|| nāhaṃ pālayituṃ śaktastvaṃ dadāsi varān bahūn | daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca rakṣasā ca maheśvara || 13|| vikṛtiṃ yānti paścāt te kaṣṭavadhyā bhavanti me | śrupvovāca tadā śaṃbhurvaraṃ yadi dadāmi na || 14|| tadā tu tapasā daityāḥ sarvaṃ kuryurhi bhasmitam | tvayāhaṃ brahmaṇā devairvaradānāya yojitaḥ || 15|| madīyā prakṛtistveṣā tāṃ kathaṃ tyaktumutsahe | yena kena prakāreṇa prajāḥ pālyāstvayā prabho || 16|| kṣantavyaṃ me varadānakarmāpi bahudaṃ bhavet | tvāṃ vinā śrīhare viṣṇo daityānāmantako hi kaḥ || 17|| mayā vā brahmaṇā vāpi varadānena yojitāḥ | daityā vā dānavā vā ca rākṣasā vāpi ye ca ke || 18|| tvayā yuktyā prahantavyā nānyathā kuśalaṃ bhavet | aparādhastu soḍhavyaḥ karuṇāsāgaro bhavān || 19|| jālandharo hiraṇyākṣo hiraṇyakaśipustathā | anye cāsuramūrdhanyā yuktyā tvayaiva ghātitāḥ ||1.143.20 || yathā yuktiṃ bhavānvetti tathā jānāti nāparaḥ | vayaṃ tu varadāsteṣāṃ bhavām̐steṣāṃ tu śāntikṛt |||21 || ityasmābhiścālitaṃ vai saṃsāracakrakaṃ mahat | tathaivaitat saṃcalati kṣamasva puruṣottama ||22|| ahaṃ vyakto vicarāmi tenāgacchanti devatāḥ | daityāśca varalābhārthaṃ tato’vyakto bhavāmyaham |||23|| devīṃ tu pārvatīṃ rakṣa gacchāmyaviditasthalam | iti kṛtvā mahādevastatraivāntaradhīyata ||24|| kailāsaṃ tu parityajya raivatācalamāgataḥ | girīṇāṃ madhyamāsthāya tyaktvā divye ca vāsasī ||25|| gajājitaṃ parityajya tyaktvā mūrtaṃ surūpakam | bhittvā bhūmitalaṃ śaṃbhuḥ sthāṇurūpo babhūva ha ||26|| yasmātsvayaṃ babhūveti bhaveśvaraḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ | svayaṃbhūrvai bhavo jāto bhaveśvarataḍāgake |||27|| atrāntare tu kailāse te na paśyanti śaṃkaram | tato devāḥ pracalitāḥ kṛtvā gaurīṃ puraḥsarām ||28|| nandibhadrādayaḥ sarve devā indrādayastathā | putreṇa sahitā devī siṃhārūḍhā svayaṃ yayau || 29|| adhiruhya garutmantaṃ yayau viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ | haṃsādhirūḍho bhagavān brahmā cāyāti pṛṣṭhataḥ || 1.143.30 || airāvataṃ samāruhya devarājo gataḥ svayam | gaṃgā sarasvatī devī yamunā ca śaradvatī || 31 || devatāścāgatāḥ sarvā nāgā yakṣāśca kinnarāḥ | adhiruhya gireḥ śṛṃgamambādevī vyavasthitā ||32|| brahmā viṣṇustathā devā mārgayāṃcakrurīśvaram | dadṛśustaṃ taḍāgasya nimnabhūmau maheśvaram ||33|| kimarthaṃ vā kathaṃ cātrā samāyātāḥ surādayaḥ | mayā tvatraiva vastavyaṃ bhaveśvarasurūpataḥ || 34|| bhavanto yadi santuṣṭāḥ surā nadyaśca sevakāḥ | girau raivatake viṣṇurambā sarve’tra vāhakāḥ ||35|| siṃhādayo’pi tiṣṭhantu kailāso’nya ivātra vai | suvarṇā bhagavatpatnī svarṇarekhā nadī matā || 6|| tatra gaṃgāsarasvatyādayo vasantu sarvadā | parvate svarṇarakṣā sā svarṇarekhā tu sā bhuvi ||37|| evaṃ śaṃbhurbhaveśākhyo viṣṇurdāmodaraḥ svayam | brahmā svayaṃbhūstatrāsti cendra indreśvare sthitaḥ || 38|| anyānye yatra sāralyaṃ tatra tatra vyavasthitāḥ | tata etanmahattīrthaṃ mṛtyusaṃsāratārakam || 39|| bahurātraṃ haristatra kṛtvā daityanibarhaṇam | samāgatya ca viśrāntiṃ nayatyeva dayānidhiḥ ||1.143.40 || reme raivatake viṣṇuryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam | hiraṇyakaśipuṃ hatvā gatvā ca raivate girau ||41|| śarabhaṃ śivamāskandya nārasiṃhaṃ mumoca saḥ | hiraṇyākṣaṃ tathā hatvā gatvā raivatake girau |||42|| vane vyāghramavaskandya vārāhaṃ samumoca vai | pṛthvīṃ kṛtvā samāṃ devaḥ pṛthuścovāsa raivate ||43 || 1 jayamālā pṛthunā dāmodarāṃse niveśitā | brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca bhrūṇahā gurutalpagaḥ |||44|| svarṇarakṣājale snāto mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ | bhavadāmodarāmbānāṃ darśanādyāti dhāma tat ||45|| vāmanastu baliṃ prāpya jitvā raivatake sthitaḥ | kailāsaparvataṃ tyaktvā devīṃ devāṃśca saṃgatān ||46|| vaiśākhe paṃcadaśyāṃ tu bhūmiṃ bhittvā bhavo’bhavat | tasminneva dine lakṣmi svarṇarakṣānadījalāt ||47|| panthānaṃ vāsukiḥ prāpa sarvapāpapraṇāśanam | airāvatapadākrānta ūrjayanto mahāgiriḥ ||48|| susrāva toyaṃ bahudhā gajapādodbhavaṃ śuci | vastrāpathasya kṣetrasya pramāṇaṃ śṛṇu padmaje ||49|| harasya bhramato bhūmau patitaṃ vastrabhūṣaṇam | tāvanmātraṃ hi tatkṣetraṃ devairvastrāpathaṃ kṛtam ||1.143.50|| uttareṇa nadī bhadrā pūrvaṃ kuṃkumavāpikā | dakṣiṇe ca baleḥ sthānamūrjayantīnadīmanu ||5 1|| paścimāyāṃ paraṃ nadyoḥ saṃgamo vāmanātpuraḥ | etadvastrāpathaṃ kṣetraṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam ||52|| jñeyaḥ kṣetrasya cāyāmo yojanānāṃ catuṣṭayam | kṣetrasya dīrghatā yojanānāṃ dvādaśakaṃ matā ||53|| bhūmau luṇṭhandaṇḍavacca kṛtvā prakrāmati kramāt | daṇḍapramāṇabhūmervā prakramed dhūlikāṃ vahan |||54|| sa saptasāgarāṃ pṛthvīṃ śāsitvānne hareḥ padam | śatabhaumavimānastho divyadeho vrajatyatha |||55||| vidhāya bhujabandhaṃ vā pādau badhvā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | maunena mānuṣo yāyād dāmodaraṃ bhaveśvaram ||56|| sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyeta mokṣamante hyavāpnuyāt | vastrāpathe mahākṣetre nagare vāmanasthale ||57|| vaśiṣṭho bhagavām̐staptuṃ tapastatrājagāma ha | īśānakoṇe nagarāt svarṇarekhānadījale ||58|| snātvā dhyātvā hariṃ devaṃ praṇanāma muniryadā | tadā hariharau tatra samāyātau tamūcatuḥ ||59|| tvaṃ vai varṣaśataṃ cātra ghore tapasi saṃsthitaḥ | maharṣe tava tuṣṭau svaḥ kiṃ te prārthyaṃ vadasva tat ||1.143.60|| vasiṣṭhaḥ prāha deveśau yadi deyo varo mama | tadā bhavadbhyāmatraiva stheyamācandratārakam ||61|| mamāpi darśanaṃ sevā yuvayoḥ sarvadā bhavet|| atra ye pāpino lokā jalaṃ pītvā kṣaṇaṃ ca vā |||62|| grahīṣyanti ca viśrāmaṃ teṣāṃ pāpalayo bhavet | hyetadvāsiṣṭhasaṃjñaṃ ca tīrthaṃ khyātaṃ bhavetsadā ||63|| tathāstviti samuccārya devau cāṃśena tiṣṭhataḥ | svarṇadurge tu nagare kṛṣṇāyā uttare taṭe ||64|| dātārasya tu daityasya vināśāya sudarśanam | cakraṃ vai prahitaṃ tacca dagdhvā suramupāgatam ||65|| tadā nārāyaṇo yatra viśrāmaṃ prāptavān hariḥ | tatra trivikramo devaḥ siddheśvaraśca śaṃkaraḥ ||66|| śrīkṛṣṇo rādhayā sākaṃ gaṇeśo hanumām̐stathā | devāścānye samāyātā nārāyaṇadidṛkṣayā ||67|| parvatīyajanaiḥ śuddhaiḥ kalyāṇīyasumārgagaiḥ | divyadṛṣṭyā tu te devā dṛṣṭāstatra samāgatāḥ ||68|| tairbhaktapuṃgavairdevāḥ sāttvataiḥ samapūjitāḥ | namaskṛtāstathā devāḥ prasannā jagaduśca tān ||69|| bhaktyā tu bhavatāṃ tuṣṭā vadantu kimapekṣitam | prāhuste tu tadā devān yadi deyo varo bhavet ||1.143.70 || vasantu cātra saṃsthāne kalyāṇāya tu dehinām | parvatīyāstathāraṇyavāsino’pi tvadīkṣaṇāt ||71 || muktiṃ yāsyanti tasmādvai saṃprayacchantu tadvaram | tathāstviti varaṃ datvā sthitāścāṃśaistu mandire ||72||| suvarṇasiṃharājñā vai kārite’tra mahattare | suvarṇakalaśaiḥ svarṇāsanadvāraiḥ suśobhite ||73|| raktapītaiḥ śvetanīlairmaṇibhiḥ kṛtabhūmike | sphāṭikādyaiśca suklṛptasopānabhittimaṇḍale ||74|| atrāgatya tu ye lokā kariṣyantīkṣaṇādikam | dānaṃ puṇyaṃ japa homaṃ sādhusādhvyāditarpaṇam ||75|| śrāddhaṃ tathotsavaṃ daivaṃ teṣāṃ puṇyamanantakam | udyāpanaṃ kariṣyanti jīrṇoddhāraṃ ca ye janāḥ ||76|| naivedyaṃ phaladānādi satāṃ sevāṃ dhanādibhiḥ | tanubhiśca kariṣyanti te yāsyantyakṣaraṃ padam ||77|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne raivate vastrāpathe vividhatīrthabhaveśvaradāmodarasvayaṃbhūtrivikramavāsiṣṭhasvarṇarakṣādinivāsakāraṇapradarśanādināmā tricatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 143||
<1.144> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ahaṃ vasāmi sattīrthe lokoddhāraṇahetave | sarvatrāpi nivasāmi cāntaryāmitvahetave || 1 || mūrtau mūrtau sadā varte sevāgrahaṇahetave | tattatsthāne vasāmyatra bhaktasauhārdahetave || 2 || kvacidbhaktāgrahād yadvā mama saṃkalpakāraṇāt | kvacitkāryāvaśyakatvānnivasāmi sthale sthale || 3 || bhārate paścime bhāge yāvatsāgarasaṃgate | raivatādrisamaṃ tīrthaṃ nānyad divyaṃ hi vartate || 4 || tatraiva dakṣiṇe’raṇye somanāthasya saṃsthitiḥ | uttare svarṇanagare’nādikṛṣṇasya saṃsthitiḥ || 5 || pūrve kuṃkumavāpyāṃ ca gopālakṛṣṇasaṃsthitiḥ | paścime vāmanasthalyāṃ trivikramasya me sthitiḥ || 6 || evaṃ sarvatra taddeśe nivasāmi sthale sthale | mahatyāṃ vai rājadhānyāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇasthitiḥ || 7 || prānte prānte janoddhārahetave nivasāmyaham | yugānte mama saudhāni vivartante tvitastataḥ || 8 || vilīyante tu jīrṇāni kāryante nūtanāni ca | yathā bhaktā bhavantyeva tadvatpunarbhavāmyaham || 9 || nānto’smi mama divyānāṃ sthānānāṃ yugabhedataḥ | bhūmirdeśāsta eva syurahamapyasmi caiva saḥ || 1.144.10 || arcakasya tapaḥśraiṣṭhyād bhaktabhaktibalāttathā | mūrtīnāmatisaundaryādahaṃ varte samakṣavat || 1 1|| balerbhaktiṃ vilokyaiva kaśyapasya tapastathā | dīrgho’pi vāmano bhūtvāvasaṃ vai raivatācale || 12||| kaśyapena mahograṃ vai tapastaptaṃ nadītaṭe | ojasvatyāścottare vai cūtavṛkṣābhisaṃvṛte || 13|| ūrjayantyā jalaṃ pītvā tatra varṣasahasrakam | putrārthaṃ nirjane sthāne yatrāste vāmanasthalī || 14|| tatrādityā saha tena kaśyapena hariḥ svayam | prasāditaśca putratve vṛtto’to vāmano’bhavam || 15|| tatkāraṇaṃ tu te vacmi śṛṇu lakṣmi manogatam | hiraṇyakaśipuṃ hatvā nṛsiṃho bhagavān svayam || 16|| dadāvindrāya trailokyaṃ prahlādāyātalādikam | kāle haripadaṃ prāptaḥ prahlādaḥ sāttvatāgragaḥ || 17|| prahlādasya sutaḥ śreṣṭho virocana itīritaḥ | sa varṣāṇāmayutaṃ vai rājyaṃ kṛtvā divaṃ yayau || 18|| tasya putro mahābāhuḥ sātvatānāṃ varo baliḥ | satyapratijño dharmiṣṭho bhaktaḥ priyatamo hareḥ || 19|| sa jitvā lokapālāṃśca dikpālām̐śca samantataḥ | trīṃllokānsvavaśe kṛtvā rājābhūt tribhuvāṃ patiḥ ||1.144.20 || ekātapatrāṃ pṛthivīṃ baliścakre balaitinaḥ | akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī bahusasyaphalapradā ||21 || gandhavanti ca puṣpāṇi rasavanti phalāni ca | āskandhaphalino vṛkṣā puṭake puṭake madhu ||22|| gāvaḥ pūrṇadughāḥ sarvā balau rājye praśāsati | svadharmaniratāḥ sarve narāḥ pāpavivarjitāḥ |||23 || arcayanti hṛṣīkeśaṃ satataṃ vaiṣṇavīprajāḥ | indrāditridaśāstasya kiṃkarāḥ samupasthitāḥ ||24|| aiśvaryaṃ triṣu lokeṣu bubhuje baladarpakṛt | caturvedā dvijāstasya rājye yajñādikāriṇaḥ ||21|| kṣatriyā rakṣaṇe saktā yuddhaśāstrārthakovidāḥ | goṣu sevāparā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā śuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ ||26|| dāridryaduḥkhamaraṇairvimuktāścirajīvinaḥ | maṇidīpaprakāśāstu diveva niśi santi yat ||27|| sarve kuṭumbino hṛṣṭāḥ sukhinaḥ sveṣṭavastubhiḥ | nityaṃ vaivāhavāditrairgarjanti yūpamaṇḍapāḥ |||28|| yajñe santoṣitā devā nāto yuddhaṃ parasparam | sāpatnikakalirnāsti paśupakṣijaneṣvapi ||29 || maitrībhāvaṃ gataṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṃgamam | tadā tu nārado yuddhaṃ trailokye nahi paśyati ||1.144.30 || tāvattasyodare pīḍā mahatī samajāyata | kiṃ tarpaṇena snānena japahomādibhiśca kim ||3 1 || tat snānaṃ yatra yuddhyante gajā dantavighaṭṭanaiḥ | sandhyā yatra raktairbhūḥ kabandhānāṃ tu pāṭalā || 32|| kravyādā yatra tṛpyanti tarpaṇaṃ tanmama priyam | pūjā kṣatriyaśastraughairhanyante kṣatriyā raṇe ||33 || sa homo yatra hūyante hanyante narapuṃgavāḥ | yuddhaṃ vinā trilokyāṃ me śūnyaṃ tu dṛśyate’nvaham ||34|| tathā kariṣye cendrasya balinā kalaho bhavet | nāradastadvicintyaiva yayāvindraṃ prati drutam ||35|| indro dadarśa cāyāntamudāsīnaṃ tu nāradam | siṃhāsanaṃ parityajya samutthāyāgrataḥ sthitaḥ || 36 || svāgatenābhivandyātha babhāṣe nāradaṃ hariḥ | maharṣe kuśalo’syadya kuto vāgamyate tvayā ||37|| snāne sanghyārcane home kuśalaṃ svinnu vidyate | iti pṛṣṭo vihasyātha nāradaḥ prāha taṃ prati ||38|| baliryāvanmahām̐ścakravartī bhavati sarvagaḥ | tatra kiṃ kuśalaṃ me’sti te’pi pṛcchāmi tanmṛṣā ||39|| kuśalaṃ tu tadā mahyaṃ praṣṭavyaṃ yadi saṃyuge | devānāṃ vijayaṃ drakṣye baleścādhogatiṃ tathā ||1.144.40|| ādityādyā grahāḥ sarve baliṃ namanti yojitāḥ | baleryajñaistathā meghā varṣanti haviṣā bhuvi ||41 || rogādimaraṇaṃ nāsti kiṃ yamasya prayojanam | trilokīśo mahendraśca dikpālo lokapālakaḥ ||42|| surādhipaṃ baliṃ tvadya stuvanti mānavā api | tvāṃ tu hasanti daityendrā jalpanti nirbalānsurān |||43|| vasundharāṃ svarṇamayīṃ svāyattīkṛtya sarvathā | balirna manute tvāṃ vai sureśvara iti svayam ||44|| surāḥ sarve balyadhīnā balikratusubhojinaḥ | raṃbhā tiṣṭhati balyagre manute tvāṃ na menakā |||45||| tilottamā baliṃ yāti tūrvaśī ca balervaśā | sukeśī matrjughoṣā ca nirīkṣete baliṃ sadā ||46|| pulomā pulakodbhedaṃ na karoti baliṃ vinā | paulomī ca baliṃ stauti namati dyaurbaliṃ sadā ||47|| nāradaḥ parvataścaiva hāhā hūhūśca tumburuḥ | baleḥ rājyaṃ praśaṃsanti te kimasti prayojanam ||48|| bṛhaspatiryadācaṣṭe na tadvācyaṃ mayā tava | indrāṇī tu baliṃ cendraṃ matvā prātaḥ prapaśyati ||49|| iti śrutvā mahendrastu kopajvalitamānasaḥ | gajaṃ vajraṃ prāha sūtau rathamānayataṃ drutam ||1.144.50|| sūryaṃ rudraṃ yamaṃ vāyuṃ susajjān kurutaṃ tathā | raṇavādyāni vādyantāṃ prayāntu tvaritā bhaṭāḥ ||51 || itīndraṃ kruddhamālokya bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ | prāha sāmādyupāyena balirjayyo na cānyathā |||52||| yadadhīnaṃ jagatsarvaṃ viṣṇuṃ surasurakṣakam | mantrayantu samāhūyānutiṣṭhantu tadāritam |||53|| athavā rājate viṣṇuḥ kāryārthaṃ mandare girau | gacchāmastatra ṛṣayaḥ sendrā brahmapurogamāḥ ||54|| gautamo’trirbharadvājo viśvāmitro’tha kaśyapaḥ | jamadagnirvaśiṣṭhaśca bālakhilyāśca nāradaḥ ||55|| gatāḥ sarve tadā viṣṇurbālakhilyām̐stu vāmanān | jahāsāṅguṣṭhaparvābhān bhāvikāryabalāddhariḥ ||56|| tadā sarve bālakhilyā uccairūcuḥ parasparam | asmān hasasi tasmāttvaṃ vāmano vai bhaviṣyasi ||97|| vastrāpathe raivatādrau devakāryaṃ vidhāya ca | vāmanatvaṃ parityajya dāmodaro nivatsyasi ||58|| ityukto bālakhilyaiḥ sa viṣṇuḥ svāgatamācarat | indro balestrilokādhipatyaṃ prāha suduḥsaham ||99|| vaśīkṛtaṃ tu balinā daityā yajñabhujaḥ kṛtāḥ | tasmādbalirbhraṣṭarājyaḥ pātālamadhitiṣṭhatu ||1.144.60|| sūryasomānvaye kaścid rājā bhavatu bhūtale | ityāśrutya svayaṃ prāha kariṣye ca tathā hariḥ ||6 1|| ṛṣayastatra gacchantu kārayantu mahāmakham | ahaṃ tatra samāgatya sādhayiṣyāmi taṃ balim ||62|| ityuktā munayaḥ sarve svasvasthānaṃ yayustadā | kālaṃ pratīkṣamāṇāste pratīkṣante harerjanim ||63|| kaśyapo’pi sutaṃ tvindraṃ bhraṣṭarājyaṃ vilokya ca | ādityā saha saurāṣṭre tapastepe payovṛtam ||64|| arcayāmāsa deveśaṃ padmanābhaṃ janārdanam | śarīre tu tayostatra pipīlikābhirāvṛte ||65|| tejo mahattayovyāptaṃ saurāṣṭre paritastadā | lokāstu vismitāstena tau stuvanti punaḥ punaḥ ||66|| harirvarṣasahasrānte prasannastapasā tayoḥ | tatraivāvirabhūt tasya devyā saha sanātanaḥ ||67|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam | indīvaradalaśyāmaṃ sarvābharaṇaśobhitam ||68|| kirīṭahārakeyūrakuṇḍalaśṛṃkhalānvitam pītāṃbaraṃ śrīvatsāṃkakaustubhahāravakṣasam ||69|| lakṣmīyuktaṃ garuḍasthaṃ prasannaṃ jagadīśvaram | harṣanirbharahṛdayastuṣṭāva kaśyapo harim ||1.144.70 || namo namaste lakṣmīśa sarveśa bhuvaneśvara | svāśritānāṃ sukhadātre bhaktakāryakṛte namaḥ ||71 || ādimadhyāntarahitanityarūpāya te namaḥ | namaḥ sarvatrāṇakṛte vedavedāṃgacakṣuṣe ||72|| sūkṣmāya sthūlarūpāya nārāyaṇāya te namaḥ | kalyāṇaguṇapūrṇāya parātmane ca te namaḥ ||73 || namaste yogigamyāya bhaktecchāpūrakāya te | nityamuktaikabhogāya paradhāmeśvarāya ca ||74|| caturātmannamastubhyaṃ vyūhātmane ca te namaḥ | paṃcapaṃcasvarūpāya paṃcasaṃskāriṇe namaḥ ||75|| nārāyaṇāya kṛṣṇāya vāsudevāya te namaḥ | śārṅgiṇe viśvarūpāya dhātre trātre ca te namaḥ ||769|| viṣṇave jiṣṇave tubhyaṃ śuddhasatvāya te namaḥ | balerbalaṃ mahajjātaṃ tanniṣūdaya mādhava ||77|| devāstadā sukhinaḥ syuriti cābhyarthanāsti me | yadyapi balirājo’sau bhakto’sti suramelanaḥ ||78|| kintu surātikramaṇaṃ māstu daityasya mādhava| tasmāt trilokagaṃ rājyaṃ tvindrasyaiva sadāstu vai ||79|| balestvāsurarājyaṃ ca pātālādau yathāstu ca | tathāstyabhyarthanīyaṃ me yathecchasi tathā kuru ||1.144.80 || uktvā tu kaśyapastatra virarāma hareḥ puraḥ | aditiḥ prāha deveśaṃ natvā stutvā jagatprabhum ||8 1|| he nātha yadi devānāṃ śāstṛtva cāsure bhavet | tadāsmatputrabāhulye nāsti kiñcitprayojanam |||82|| yadi śṛgālāḥ kākāśca syurdevasya vibhūtayaḥ | kiṃ siṃhena ca haṃsena tadā vai mahimā tava ||83||| yadi daityāḥ sārvabhaumā bhrātaraste ca kiṃkarāḥ | alaṃ tarhi jīvitena tvadityā ramayā śriyā ||84|| yadi bhavānmahaiśvaryo daityo’pi tādṛśo bhavet | alaṃ bhagavatā tarhi daityo vai mādhavo bhavet ||85|| tasmātpātrādhikāreṇa deyā smṛddhirhi nānyathā | yadi lauhaṃ gale nyastaṃ śobhate rūpabhāsuram ||86|| kṛtaṃ tarhi suvarṇena vyartha sṛṣṭaṃ hi hāṭakam | yadi daityau bhavedindro vyarthā hyasarasastathā ||87|| rājamātaro rākṣasyaścedindrāṇyā hyalaṃ tadā | kiṃbahūktena me nātha vyavasthāṃ kuru keśava ||88|| ityabhyarthita evāyaṃ śrīpatiḥ parameśvaraḥ | prāha tau vai varārthāya kaśyapaḥ prāha taṃ tadā ||89|| putratvaṃ mama deveśa saṃprāpya traidaśaṃ hitam | prakuruṣvendrāvarajo bhūtvopendro mama priyaḥ ||1.144.90|| yena kenāpyupāyena baliṃ nirjitya līlayā | trailokyaṃ dehi devāya śakrāyeti sukhaṃ kuru ||9 1|| ityuktastena vipreṇa tathetyāha janārdanaḥ | aditiḥ kaśyapaścainaṃ pūjayāmāsaturbahu ||92|| devaiḥ saṃstūyamānaḥ śrīharistvantaradhīyata | aditiḥ kaśyapaścaitau madhyadeśaṃ gatau tadā ||93|| himālayasya bhūmau vai kaṃcitkālaṃ samūṣatuḥ | etasminneva samaye kaśyapasya mahātmanaḥ ||94|| adityā garbhamāgacchad bhagavān mādhavaḥ svayam | prāvirbhāvamagamat sa devastryaṃguladehavān ||95|| daśavarṣavayaskaḥ sa vitastidehavānabhūt | mātre pitre vane tatraikadā hyāsurasainyapaḥ ||96|| adṛśyata baliḥ pṛthvyāṃ jetuṃ sarvān samāgataḥ | tato devān munīn pitṝn jetuṃ yāsyati yāvatā || 17|| tāvatā hyaditiḥ prāha kaśyapaṃ prāṇavallabham | baliḥ sainyena devānvai jitvā smṛddhiṃ hariṣyati ||98|| kiṃ kartavyaṃ mama putro’dyāpi vitastimātrakaḥ | rakṣaṇaṃ durlabhaṃ cāsya devānāṃ tu kathaṃ hi tat ||99|| tathā bhavatu yadbhāvi hariḥ rakṣāṃ kariṣyati | iti dīnāṃ mātṛvācaṃ saṃśrutvā guptamādhavaḥ || 1.144.100 || tadā prādarśayanmātre vitastivigrahe śubhe | anantānantasṛṣṭyaṇḍakoṭīryāścāṇurūpiṇīḥ || 10 1|| uḍḍīyante sma cāṇḍāni saptāvaraṇavanti tu | lokālokaśca meruścādrayo’nye tatra darśitāḥ || 102| āpagāścābdhayaścāpi nakṣatragrahatārakāḥ | meghā vanāni pātālālayāsteṣāṃ gṛhāṇi ca || 10 3|| uccāvacāni sarvāṇi sthalāni darśitāni vai | tatra himagiristasya vanāni tatra kaśyapaḥ || 104|| aditiśca svayaṃ kṛṣṇo vitastimātravigrahaḥ | baleḥ sainyaṃ tathā sarvaṃ darśitaṃ tatra vāmane || 1 05|| vāmanena mahādīrghe dehe pradarśya tattanum | kṣaṇāttirohitaṃ tatrābhavadvitastimānakaḥ || 1 06|| athaivaṃ darśane jāte pitrorāśvāsanaṃ hyabhūt | devānāṃ bhayahartāyaṃ prāpte kāle bhavediti || 1 07|| tataḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣo’yaṃ hastamātrapramāṇakaḥ | prāptamaśrusvarṇarekhaḥ kaustubhena virājitaḥ || 1 08|| svarṇāntameghavatsnigdhakeśayūthasumastakaḥ | padmapatranibhanetraścandrojjvalāsyaśobhanaḥ || 1 09|| sudṛḍhapakvaśarīraḥ komalaḥ karapattalaiḥ | haste svalpaṃ tvātapatraṃ yaṣṭikā ratnapauraṭī || 1.144.11 0|| mālikā śuklamaṇibhiḥ kṛtā karagatā śubhā | candanasyordhvapuṃḍraṃ ca bhāle kuṃkumacandrakaḥ || 11 1|| suvarṇavarṇaṃ svalpaṃ suyajñopavītamaṃsake | raktorṇāyāḥ paṭaṃ mūrdhni kaustubho hṛdaye tadā || 1 12|| svarṇaprāntaṃ śvetavastramuttarīyaṃ ca kaṃcukam | kaṭyāṃ tu komalā cārdrā śubhā muñjasya mekhalā || 11 3|| pītāmbaraṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ pāduke svarṇabhūṣite | kāṣṭhakamaṇḍalurhaste rajjūḥ kārpāsanirmitā || 1 14|| kare puruṣaviṣṇunārāyaṇasūktapustakam | pūjārthaṃ vaṃśapātraṃ ca grathitaṃ rājate kare || 1 15|| āsanaṃ cājinaṃ kukṣau dhṛtvā natvā ca pādayoḥ | pitrorāśīḥ samādāya vijayāyābhijitkṣaṇe || 1 16|| tatsthalātsa viniryāto yātrānimittamacyutaḥ | athāpi balibhūpaḥ saḥ pṛthvīṃ jitvā divaṃ tathā || 1 17|| ājagāma bhuvaṃ ramyāṃ raivatācalayoginīm | raivatādrernirṛtāyāṃ dakṣiṇe vāmanātpurāt || 1 18|| āmrāraṇyaṃ nadīṃ cojasvatīṃ deśaṃ supallavam | jalasthalatarucchāyāsukhaṃ sarvaṃ vilokya ca || 11 9|| uvāsa yajñakhātāni kārayāmāsa vai baliḥ | balikhātapradeśaḥ so balimakheti viśrutaḥ || 1.144.120|| bhūmiṃ tāṃ saṃskṛtāṃ kārayitvā ca makhamaṇḍapam | dvādaśāhaṃ mahāyajñaṃ prārabhat sarvadakṣiṇam || 121||| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nārāyaṇasya sattīrthavāso baliguṇavarṇanaṃ nāradasyendraṃ prati gamanaṃ baleḥ pātanamantraṇā kaśyapādityoḥ saurāṣṭre tapaścaryā nārāyaṇādvaraprāptirvāmanajanmabalidigvijayaḥ saurāṣṭre balimakhāraṃbhaśceti varṇananāmā catuścatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 144||
<1.145> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi vāmano’pi tīrthāni vyacaradbhuvi | yayau saḥ prathamaṃ hariharakṣetraṃ tataḥ purīm || 1 || kapilāśramamāsādya brahmaputrānadṃ yayau | kāmarūpasya kāmākṣīṃ dṛṣṭvā paśupatiṃ tathā || 2 || kedāreśvaramāsādya yayau badarikāśramam | hanumattīrthamāsādya kailāsādrimupāyayau || 3 || agāttato haridvāraṃ kurukṣetraṃ tataḥ param | prayayau yāmunaṃ vṛdāvanaṃ gokulamityapi || 4 || tato’yodhyāpurīṃ gatvā sarayūṃ ca prayāgakam | gayāṃ godāvarīṃ gatvā kāverīṃ gatavām̐stataḥ || 5 || kāṃcīṃ gatvā ca kṛṣṇāṃ ca tāmraparṇīṃ kumārikām | setubandhaṃ cāpi janārdanaṃ ca malayācalam || 6 || aruṇācalamāsādya padmākṣetraṃ varāhakam | bhūtapurīṃ tataḥ siṃhāraṇyaṃ ca narmadāṃ tataḥ || 7 || tāpīṃ siddhapadaṃ paścātpuṣkarākhyaṃ sarastataḥ | sindhuṃ nārāyaṇasaraḥ suvarṇadvārikāṃ tataḥ || 8 || samudre gomatīsaṃge yāvat snāti tu vāmanaḥ | tāvattatra samāyātāḥ snānārthaṃ munayo’pi ca || 9 || gautamo’trirbharadvājo viśvāmitro’tha kaśyapaḥ | jamadagnirvasiṣṭho nārado’paśyanpareśvaram || 1.145.10 || vāmanaṃ lakṣaṇairjñātvā nemustaṃ parameśvaram | hariḥ prāha ca tānsarvān gacchantu balikhātakam || 1 1|| ṛṣayastatra gacchantu kārayantu mahāmakham | ahaṃ tatrāgamiṣyāmi sādhayiṣyāmi taṃ balim || 12|| ityuktāḥ ṛṣayaḥ sarve gatāste yajñamaṇḍape | dvādaśāho mahāyajñaḥ prārabdhaḥ sarvadakṣiṇaḥ || 13|| śukreṇāmantritāḥ sarve munayo yajñakarmasu | patnīvrataḥ samāyāto brāhmaṇo yajñakarmaṇi || 14|| ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā munayo yakṣarākṣasāḥ | daityāśca dānavā nāgāḥ sarpā uragajātayaḥ || 15|| bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca vaināyakāśca kinnarāḥ | sūtāśca māgadhāścaiva bandinaścāraṇāstathā || 16|| gāndharvā nartakāścaiva naṭāścāṭā bahirgṛhāḥ | kūṣmāṇḍāścaiva vetālā aśuddhāḥ śuddhajātayaḥ || 17|| dyaurgrahāḥ ketavaścāpi tattvānyapi ca śaktayaḥ | siddhayo yoginīcakraṃ sādhvyaśca sādhavastathā || 18|| brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāstathā sevakajātayaḥ | nadyaśca parvatāścāpi kṣetratīrthāni sāgarāḥ || 19|| sarāṃsi cāpyaraṇyāni caitāni cāṇḍajāni ca | yāni kāni ca divyāni puṇyarūpadharāṇi ca ||1.145.20|| caturdaśastarasthāni balirājye sthitāni ca | tāni tvākārayāmāsa balistrailokyarājyakṛt ||2 1|| lakṣaśaḥ koṭiśastatra pṛthvyāṃ divi ca parvate | samudre’raṇyadeśe ca nūpuretya samantataḥ ||22|| sarveṣāṃ tu kṛte rājyasamāḥ saudhā vinirmitāḥ | antarīkṣavimānāni nagaryo jalavāsinām ||23 || vāyoḥ stare ca saudhāni meghasthabhavanāni ca | parvate’raṇyavṛkṣādau bhūmau bhūmyantare tathā ||24||| yathā yathā ca yeṣāṃ vai vāse dehānukūlatā | tathā tathā ca teṣāṃ vai bhavanānyakaronnṛpaḥ ||25|| viśvakarmā mayaścātha kāravaḥ śilpinastathā | catuḥṣaṣṭhikalāḥ sarvāḥ śilpavidyāḥ sumūrtikāḥ ||26|| nagarāṇi tathā grāmā mūrtimanta upasthitāḥ kāraṇāni ca kāryāṇi ṛtavo māsavatsarāḥ ||27|| agnayo marutaḥ sarve dikpālā lokapālakāḥ | mūrtimanti ca tattvāni bhūtāni viṣayāstathā |||28|| brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca pārṣadā dāsakoṭayaḥ | vaiṣṇavāḥ śivabhaktāśca tathānye daivasāttvatāḥ |||29|| yajñe tvākāritāstatra śakunāśakunāni ca | kāmadughāśca paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo garuḍādayaḥ || 1.145.30|| amṛtāni ca dugdhāni vividhānnāni sarvaśaḥ | peyānyanekajātīni bhakṣyabhojanaparvatāḥ ||3 1|| rasāśca vividhāstatra madyapalalamādakāḥ | rūkṣā ārdrāstathā snigdhāḥ khecarānnāni bhūriśaḥ ||32|| nivārāśca yavāścaiva godhūmacaṇakākṣatāḥ | tilā javarikā māṣā havīṃṣyannāni bhūriśaḥ || 33|| na dṛṣṭāni śrutānyeva caturdaśasu bhūmiṣu | yāni yeṣāṃ subhojyāni phalapatrādikāni ca ||34|| abdhijānyagnijānyatra sambhārottamajāni ca | pātravastravibhūṣādiyānavāhanapaṃktayaḥ ||35|| vidyuddīpāḥ koṭiśaśca jalayantrāṇyanekaśaḥ | kūpā vāpyo vastrasaudhā rasavatyaḥ sahasraśaḥ ||36|| sūdāśca yājñikāstatra ṛtvijā lakṣaśaḥ kṛtāḥ | jāpakāḥ pūjakāṃstatra gāyakā vaidikāstathā ||37|| vṛtāśca koṭiśaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāstathāpare | vidvāṃso devaguravo daityānāṃ guravastathā ||38|| yajñasya vividhe kārye tathāṅge yojitāstadā | devyo gaṅgādisaritaḥ śāradā ca sarasvatī || 39|| sāvitryādyāstathā cānyā gītakīrtipragalbhikāḥ | ṛco vedāśca śāstrāṇi mūrtimanti bhavanti ca ||1.145.40 || tatra kā nyūnatā vai syād yatra trailokyapālakaḥ | mahābhāgavato rājā balirvai yajñakārakaḥ ||41 || pravarṣantīcchayā yasya sadā lokāścaturdaśa | mahāyajñe tadātrābhūt sarvaṃ vai vāmanaṃ vinā ||42||| kāmo vasanto bāṇāśca ratiścāpi samāgatāḥ | rāgiṇyaśca tathā rāgā grāmāśca mūrchanā yayuḥ ||43|| manvantarāṇi dharmasya vaṃśajāḥ sadguṇādayaḥ | vasavo nidhayo rudrā diśā ādityadevatāḥ ||44|| candramasaśca nakṣatrā grāmāḥ kheṭāśca kharvaṭāḥ | oṣadhyo jalajāścāpi sthalajā mūlajāstathā ||45|| amṛtavallikā nāgavallyaśca jīvavallikāḥ | bhūgolajñāḥ khagolajñā daivajñā gaṇakāstathā ||46|| muhūrtāni tathā yogāḥ sarve ye te samāyayuḥ | mallā naṭā bahurūpā nāṭakāni ca khelakāḥ ||47|| pradarśanāni divyāni vahnisphoṭāni bhūriśaḥ | paśuyuddhāni ramyāṇi naravyāyāmakāṇi ca ||48|| vyākhyānāni kathakāśca tyāgisanyāsisādhavaḥ | brahmacārijanā bālakhilyāstathordhvaśīlinaḥ ||49|| yatkiṃcidvai jagattattvaṃ sarvaṃ tatra samāgatam | balinā bahumānena svāgatenādṛtaṃ jagat ||1.145.50|| siṃhāraṇyaṃ tadā sarvaṃ prajādevamayaṃ hyabhūt | antarīkṣaṃ jalaṃ sthānaṃ prāghūrṇikasupūritam ||5 1 || yathā vā nūtanaṃ tatra brahmāṇḍamiva dṛśyate | nedṛśastu samājo vai bhūto bhāvī na vā punaḥ ||52|| yajñasya maṇḍapastatra śatagavyūtimānataḥ | ā ca svarṇadvārikāta ā ca someśvarāvadhi ||53|| ā ca makarālayata ā ca kuṃkumavāpikam | bhūmistu maṇḍapaiḥ sā śobhate dyauriva nūtanā ||54|| yajñakuṇḍo yojanaṃ tu kamalākāravatkṛtaḥ | araṇyebhyaḥ pippalāpāmārgodumbarakiṃśukāḥ |||55 || homakāṣṭhāni cānyāni samidhāṃ parvatāḥ kṛtāḥ | ājyanārīkelaraṃbhādrākṣādiphalaparvatāḥ ||5 6 || tilaśāliyavadhānyanivārāṇāṃ ca parvatāḥ | puṣpapatramūlaśākhāmañjarībījaparvatāḥ ||57|| śarkarā dugdhapākāśca pāyasānnāni bhūriśaḥ | hūyante puṣkalānyeva vedaghoṣāśca nākagāḥ ||58|| bhojanāni prabhujyante yajñaśiṣṭāni nityadā | miṣṭapānāni pīyante yajñaprāsādikāni vai ||59|| īśvarāṇāṃ ca devānāmāgamo gama ityapi | maṇḍape vartate tatrāvyavacchinnapravāhaṇaḥ ||1.145.60|| ekataśca dvitaścāpi tritaśceti ṛṣitrayam | tattaddevādimantraiśca navamutpādyate’rthakam ||6 1 || arko dvitīyarūpeṇa dvitīyaścandramāstathā | prakāśete sadā tatra divārātryorna vai bhidā ||62|| avyavacchedyadhārābhirghṛtānāmagnisammukhaiḥ | bhuṅakte harirvāmano’yaṃ vyāpakaḥ śrīhariḥ svayam ||63|| evaṃ satatamāgneyaṃ karma sampadyate śubham | kimu tatra varṇanīyaṃ śeṣo’pi śramamāptavān ||64|| śramamāpurdarśakā vai varṇakānāṃ tu kā kathā | bhagavadbhaktiyuktasya sarvaṃ smṛddhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||65||| prabhorbhakteḥ pratāpādvai tvanantāḥ smṛddhayo baleḥ | nityaṃ homasya bhojyasya pānasyārthyarpaṇasya ca ||66|| dakṣiṇāyāṃ suvarṇasyānantyasyānto na dāpane | dīyatāṃ dīyatāṃ ceti bhujyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ tathā ||67|| pīyatāṃ pīyatāṃ ceti nīyatāṃ nīyatāṃ tathā | svāgataṃ svāgataṃ vaśca pañcakaṃ nātra śāmyati ||68|| vedaghoṣā gītighoṣā nāmavoṣā harestathā | vādyaghoṣāḥ kīrtighoṣāḥ pañcakaṃ nātra śāmyati ||69|| atihṛṣṭo baliryajñe dadau dānaṃ parārdhakam | suvarṇānāṃ hīrakāṇāṃ rūpyakāṇāṃ ca koṭikāḥ ||1.145.70|| gavāṃ dānaparārdhāṇi vastradānārbudārbudam | vibhūṣāṇāṃ rūpyakāṇāṃ mudrāṇāṃ tvabjakoṭayaḥ ||71 || chatrāṇāṃ pādukādīnāṃ pātrāṇāṃ ca parārdhakam | yānānāṃ vāhanānāṃ ca hastīnāṃ vājināṃ tathā ||72|| rathānāṃ kanyakānāṃ ca koṭikoṭyarbudāni ca | dānānyevaṃ dadau sākṣād viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇa ivāparaḥ ||73|| vasavo dānakārye’tra mukhyāścaivābhavam̐stadā | lakṣmīḥ ramā mahālakṣmīḥ mukhyāḥ svarṇādidāpane ||74|| dyauśca pṛthvī kṛte mukhye ratnabhojyādidāpane | merustatra mahāmukhyaḥ pātrapaśvādidāpane ||75|| samudrāśca kuberaśca himādryādaya ityapi | araṇyāni viśvakarmā mayaścānye divaukasaḥ ||76|| ratnabhūṣāvibhūtyādiyānavāhanadāpane | mukhyāḥ kṛtāśca te sarve daduḥ sarvasvameva yat ||77|| uddhoṣo’bhūccaturdaśalokeṣu sarvato diśi | trilokeśo baliryajñe dadau dānāni koṭiśaḥ ||78|| svarṇapātreṣu sarvebhyo dīyate bhojanaṃ bahu | atithirbrāhmaṇo vidvān sarvasvenāpi pūjyate ||79|| sarvalokanivāsinyaḥ prajāstatrāyayurmakhe | gacchantu pratigṛhṇantu dānaṃ bhuñjantu bhojanam ||1.145.80 || paśyantu kīdṛśo yajño na bhūto na bhaviṣyati | saurāṣṭradeśe vikhyāto raivatācalasannidhau ||8 1|| kṣetraṃ vastrāpathaṃ khyātaṃ tatrāyaṃ vaiṣṇavo makhaḥ | paścimād dakṣiṇe bhāge balerasti mahāmakhaḥ ||82|| ityuddhoṣaṃ paraṃ śrutvā vāmano’pi mahāprabhuḥ | sarvajño’pyasarvajñavat evaṃ cedyāmi labdhaye ||83|| iti kurvan caturvedī brāhmaṇastīrthayātrayā | raivatādrau samāyāto lokairajñātaceṣṭitaḥ ||84|| mahodaro hrasvabhujo hrasvapādo mahāśirāḥ | mahāhanuḥ sthūlakaṇṭhaḥ sthūlajaṃgho’tilālasaḥ ||85|| baddhaśikho dhṛtavastracchatropānatkamaṇḍaluḥ | vastrāpathe samāyātaḥ svarṇarakṣānadītaṭe ||86|| vāmanaścintayāmāsa somanāthaṃ bhaveśvaram | dāmodaraṃ tathā dattātreyaṃ raivatakaṃ girim ||87|| dṛṣṭvā dattaṃ tato yāmi baleryajñasthalaṃ khalu | iti kṛtvā gataḥ someśvaraṃ śaṃbhuṃ dadarśa ca ||88|| somanātho mahādevo viṣṇuṃ provāca vāmanam | siddhastvaṃ sarvathā viṣṇo kāryasiddhirbhaviṣyati ||89|| taṃ natvā ca yayau yatra harastvāste bhaveśvaraḥ | samprāptastadvanaṃ divyaṃ ramyaṃ raivatake girau ||1.145.90 || yatra vṛkṣā naikavidhā dīrghaśākhāḥ phalānvitāḥ | vaṭodumbarabilvāśca sarjārjunakadambakāḥ ||9 1 || palāśāśvatthajambvaśca dhavādyā vāruṇadrumāḥ | śamīkaṃkolanimbāśca bījapūrāśca dāḍimāḥ ||9 1 || badaryaśca bakāḥ pūgā śivāḥ kamalaśalyakāḥ | hintālāśca śirīṣāśca bījakā vaṃśakhādirāḥ ||13|| ajamodā nikuṃbhāśca iṅgudyaśca karīrakāḥ | dhāmārgavāḥ kurabakāḥ karaṃjāśca punarnavāḥ ||94|| aṃkolāḥ pāribhadrāśca kambalyaḥ panasāstathā | utpalāśca haridrāśca gaṇḍīrā vāyasīdrumāḥ ||95|| tamālakā rasālāśca kharjūryaḥ karamardakāḥ | sevatīśālmalīśālā madhūkāśca bibhītakāḥ ||96 || harītakyaḥ kandarālā vaṭāścaivāṭarūṣakāḥ | vikaṃkatāḥ kapitthāśca rohiṇīvetrapāṭalāḥ ||97|| madanāścaiva nirguṇḍyaḥ kadalyaḥ śiṃśapādayaḥ | elālavaṃgalavalīsaralāgurupādapāḥ ||98|| śrīkhaṇḍakaravīrāśca kalpavṛkṣā mahottamāḥ | vāmanena tadā dṛṣṭāḥ chāyāvṛkṣāḥ surārcitāḥ ||99|| udayāstamane yeṣāṃ chāyā na pratihanyate | dṛṣṭvā vṛkṣām̐staḍāge ca snātvā mūlaṃ gireryayau || 1.145.10 0|| vāpikāyā jalaṃ pītvā yāvadviśrāntimicchati | kṣetrapālāḥ pañca tāvad darśanāya samāgatāḥ || 101 || ekapādabhidho girestaṭe vasati sarvadā| giridāruṇanāmāsau dvitīyo vartate girau || 1 02|| ūrjayantagirermūrdhni meghanādastṛtīyakaḥ | bhavānīśikhare ramye siṃhanādaścaturthakaḥ || 103|| svarṇarakṣānadītīre kālamegho vasatyapi | vāmanasya darśanaṃ ca kṛtvā te svasthalaṃ gatāḥ || 104|| ekādaśīṃ samārabhya yāvadvai pūrṇimātithiḥ | tadbhīṣmapaṃcakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kārtike mokṣakṛddhi tat || 1 05|| pradakṣiṇā prakartavyā svarṇarakṣāplavastathā | darśanaṃ sarvathā kāryaṃ dāmodarabhaveśayoḥ || 1 06|| atha nṛsiṃho bhagavān vāmanaṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ | stutvā sthitastadā taṃ vai vāmanaḥ prāha nṛhare || 1 07|| dāmodarāgre bhavatā stheyaṃ vai vacanānmama | sadātra rakṣā kartavyā sarveṣāṃ tīrthavāsinām || 108|| devasyāgre sadā stheyaṃ yāvadindrāścaturdaśa | evamastviti tatraiṣastīrtharakṣāṃ karoti vai || 109|| tato vai vāmano devo bhavānīṃ skandamātaram | draṣṭuṃ sa ca hariryāto śikhare gaganāśrite || 110 || dṛṣṭvā bhavānīṃ tāmambāmūrdhvabāhurvyavasthitaḥ | nirīkṣya medinīṃ sarvāṃ paścime sāgarāmbarām || 11 1|| tato gatau gorakṣasya śikhare svayamacyutaḥ | tatastṛtīye śikhare dattātreyaṃ vyalokayat || 112|| uḍuīya pūrvasyāmaśvapaṭṭasarovaram | kukumavāpīṃ gatvā kaṃbharāgopāladarśanam || 1 13|| kṛtvā patnīvratatīrthamāyāduḍḍīya raivatam | tato maṇipuraṃ cāyāt tataḥ sa vāmanaṃ puram || 1 14|| āsure’tra pure tatra vāmanastu gṛhād gṛham | brāhmaṇānāṃ śubhaṃ gatvā nityaṃ bhikṣāṃ tu yācate || 1 15|| catuṣpatheṣu ramyeṣu devatāyataneṣu ca | āste parivṛto lokaiścālayan sthūlayaṣṭikām || 1 16|| vidhunoti śiraḥ sthūlaṃ nṛtyati bālalīlayā | kvacidyāti hrasvapādairgāyatyatimanoharam || 1 17|| vedānadhīte caturo ghanacchaṭāvibhūṣitān | daityānāṃ tanujāḥ sarve brāhmaṇānāṃ tathaiva ca || 1 18|| vāmanaṃ parito yānti divārātraṃ tu narmabhiḥ | vicitraṃ vāmanaṃ rūpaṃ draṣṭumāyānti mānavāḥ || 1 19|| kumārairbahubhirnīto vāmano yajñamaṇḍape | yatrāsti dānakartā vai yajamāno balirnṛpaḥ || 120|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vāmanasya tīrthayātrā baliyajñe caturdaśabhavānāṃ koṭyabjādisamājaikatrībhavanaṃ yajñamaṇḍapakuṇḍahomadānāni vāmanasya raivatācalayātrā vāmanapurasthitistato yajñamaṇḍape baliṃ pratyāgamanamiti nirūpaṇanāmā pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ|| 145||
<1.146> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mamāścaryakaraṃ vāmanadarśanam | vilakṣaṇaṃ tu sarvebhyo dṛṣṭvā jātaṃ kutūhalam || 1 || mahān kolāhalo jātaḥ kaściddhrasvaḥ samāgataḥ | rūpeṇa tejasā viṣṇusamo dehena chadmakṛt || 2 || brāhmaṇairbahubhiḥ sārdhaṃ vedānuccārayan sthitaḥ | praviṣṭairdaityabālaiḥ sa daityāya viniveditaḥ || 3 || draṣṭuṃ samāgato’yaṃ vai brāhmaṇo vāmano’dhvaram | balirhṛṣṭo’bravrīdvākyaṃ mama bhāgyodayo hyayam || 4 || nirīho vāmano devo yācate naiva kiṃcana | pūjayiṣyāmi viprendraṃ dāsye cāsya yadīpsitam || 5 || abhyāgataḥ svayaṃ viṣṇustasmai deyaṃ yadicchati | kiṃcidvedamayaṃ pātraṃ kiṃcitpātraṃ tapomayam || 6 || pātraṃ satyaṃ samāgatya balimuddhārayiṣyati | yajñe pravartamāne tu dātavyā dakṣiṇā mayā || 7 || sahasrapūrakaścāyaṃ yajño me’ntima eva vai | sarvasvamatra dātavyaṃ yācakebhyo’vicārya yat || 8 || indrapadapralābhāya śataṃ tu kratavo matāḥ | pārameṣṭhipadalābhaḥ sahasrakratubhirbhavet || 9 || tasmādayaṃ mahāyajño mā bhūnnakārasaṃkaraḥ | dātavyameva dātavyaṃ dātavyaṃ sarvathaiva hi || 1.146.10|| nakāro naiva vaktavyo dehastryapatyavastuṣu | dhanyo’smi kṛtakṛtyo’smi saphalaṃ mama jīvitam || 1 1|| pūjayāmāsa vidhinā niveśya kusumāsane | praṇipatya namaskṛtvā prāha gadgadayā girā || 12|| tvāṃ samabhyarcya viprendra kiṃ karomi tava priyam | āgato’si yadarthaṃ tvaṃ māmuddiśya dvijottama || 13|| tatprayacchāmi te śīghraṃ brūhi vedavidāṃ vara | hrasvaḥ prahṛṣṭamanasā tamuvāca mahīpatim || 14|| agnikuṇḍasya pṛthivīṃ dehi daityapate mama | mama trivikramamitāṃ pṛthvīṃ tvaṃ dātumarhasi || 15|| sarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ bhūmidānaṃ mahottamam | yo dadāti mahīṃ rājan viprāyākiṃcanāya vai || 16|| aṃguṣṭhamātrāmapi vā sa bhavetpṛthivīpatiḥ | na bhūmidānasadṛśaṃ poṣakaṃ ceha vidyate || 17|| bhūmiṃ yaḥ pratigṛhṇāti bhūmiṃ yaśca prayacchati | ubhau tau puṇyakarmāṇau niyatau svargagāminau || 18|| tasmād bhūmiṃ mahārāja prayaccha tripadīṃ mama | etāmalpāṃ mahīṃ dātuṃ mā viśaṃka mahīpate || 1 9|| jagattrayapradānena nāma bhūpa bhaviṣyati | tataḥ prahṛṣṭahṛdayastathetyāha mahīpatiḥ |||1.146.20|| tasmai mahīpradānaṃ tu kartuṃ mene vidhānataḥ | tāvattasya guruḥ śukro vārayāmāsa taṃ balim ||21|| anyadvai dīyatāṃ dāna mā rājan dīyatāṃ mahī | kintvanyacchrūyatāṃ rājannakāryaṃ kriyate tvayā ||22|| bahiḥ pūjyā dvijā ye syurdīnāndhakṛpaṇādayaḥ | badhirā vāmanāḥ kubjā vṛkṇā rugṇāśca niṣṭhurāḥ |||22||| kratukuṇḍāntike naiva khāṇḍāste’rhanti pūjanam | suvarṇarajatairvastrairvāmanaḥ pūjyatā bahiḥ ||24|| caturṇāṃ tu vṛthā janma vṛthā dānāni ṣoḍaśa | aputrāṇāṃ vṛthā janma hyadharmiṇāṃ vṛthā janiḥ ||25|| parānnināṃ vṛthā janma parastraiṇī vṛthājaniḥ | vyarthamabrāhmaṇe dānamanūḍhe patite tathā ||26|| sandhyāhīnanāmavipre kuṭile taskare tathā | guroścāprītijanake pitṛmātṛparāṅmukhe ||27|| brahmabandhau kṛtaghne ca vedavikrayiṇi tathā | svagrāmayācake strīnirjite ca vṛṣalīpatau ||28||| vyālagrāhe nindake ca vṛthādānāni ṣoḍaśa | atrāntare balirbrūte naivaṃ vācyaṃ tvayā guro ||29|| vedānadhīte yaḥ kaścit sa me viṣṇusamo mataḥ | na vilambastu kartavyaḥ śrotriye gṛhamāgate ||1.146.30|| abhyutthānena vacasā pādaprakṣālanena ca | yathāśaktyā pradātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ gṛhamedhinā || 3 1|| apūjito yadā yāti vāmano yajñamaṇḍapāt | tadāyaṃ vyarthatāṃ yāti yajñaḥ sarvasvadakṣiṇaḥ ||32|| tasmādenaṃ dvijaṃ channaṃ vāmanaṃ viṣṇurūpiṇam | prakāśamānaṃ vapuṣā piṃgalaṃ sūryasannibham || 33|| yatheṣṭaṃ tasya dāsye vai rājyaṃ kiṃ na samicchati | dhanyo’haṃ yasya me yajñe prāpto viṣṇusamo dvijaḥ |||34|| iti kṛtvā dadau tasmai ṣoḍaśopacarāṇi vai | madhuparkaṃ ca gāṃ tasmai satvaraṃ sa nyavedayat |||35|| āghrāya madhuparkaṃ ca gaurhrasvena
