namaskṛtā | yajñaṃ yajñagatān sarvānnamaskṛtya ca vāmanaḥ || 36|| ahamarthī samāyāto dīyatāṃ vada kiṃ bale | vāsārthaṃ mama daityendra dayitāṃ me kramatrayam ||37|| vidhāya kuṭikāṃ divyāṃ śiṣyānadhyāpayāmyaham | dattaṃ kramatrayaṃ tubhyaṃ gṛhītaṃ vāmano’bravīt ||38|| mā dehītyavadacchukro viṣṇureṣaḥ sanātanaḥ | baliḥ prāha tadā śukraṃ pātraṃ syāt kimataḥ param ||39|| savyaṃ kṛtvā balirdarbhān sākṣatān dakṣiṇe kare | prayogaṃ na guruścakre na muṃcati jalaṃ kare ||1.146.40 || sabhāsadaśca hotāro vismitā ṛṣayastathā | viprāḥ surāstathā lokā daityāstasya kuṭumbinaḥ ||41|| dattaṃ gṛhītamityukte kasmāttoyaṃ na muñcati | vāmanāya kare toyaṃ kalyāṇāya pradīyate ||42|| yad dānaṃ vacasā dattaṃ karmaṇā nopapadyate | dātāraṃ niraye kṣiptvā tatkuṭumbaṃ nikṛntati |||43|| uśanāḥ prāha daityendraṃ vāmano harirityayam | eṣa viṣṇuḥ pareśo’tha devaiḥ samprārthito hariḥ ||44|| kenāpi daivayogena tvāṃ draṣṭuṃ samupāgataḥ | vañcayitvā mahīṃ sarvāṃ tvattaḥ prāptumihāgataḥ ||45|| apriyaṃ vā priyaṃ vāpi na jāne kiṃ kariṣyati | tasmānmahī na dātavyā tasmai rājanmahātmane ||46|| anyamarthaṃ samādatsva vacanānmama bhūpate | tataḥ prahasya rājāsau taṃ guruṃ prāha dhairyataḥ ||47|| jānāmyahaṃ daivabalād viṣṇoranugrahāttathā | yajñastu pūrṇatāṃ ceyād dvijaiḥ pūrṇo bhavatyapi ||48|| ahamindro dvijo viṣṇurdravyamādityadevatā | tatkathaṃ na mayā deyaṃ viṣṇave prīyatāmiti ||49|| ityuktvā sa dadau toyaṃ vāmanāya kare baliḥ | hāṃ hāṃ hāṃ kimidaṃ rājan kriyate yogyameva na ||1.146.50|| ityuccārya tadā śukraḥ saṃsthito maṇḍapādbahiḥ | prītaye vāsudevasya sarvaṃ puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ||51|| adya dhanyo’smyahaṃ viṣṇuḥ svayamevāgato yadi | tasya pradeyamevādya jīvitaṃ ca mahāsukham ||52 || tasmādasmai prayacchāmi trilokīmapi ca dhruvam | pariṇīya namaskṛtya pādau prakṣālya bhaktitaḥ ||53|| caraṇāmṛtamevāsye balinā mūrdhni ca dhṛtam | prahṛṣṭenātmanā tena datvā vai dakṣiṇaṃ vasu ||54|| dhanyo’smi kṛtakṛtyo’smi prāha datvā mahīṃ tadā | yatheṣṭaṃ tava viprendra tadgṛhāṇa mahīmimām ||55|| api cedicchasi rājyaṃ svarṇaṃ vā hīrakādikam | naikadhāni ca ratnāni dāsadāsīśatāni ca ||56||| godhanaṃ ca tadanyacca prāsādā bhavanāni ca | sādhanāni vimānāni dadāmīcchasi ced yadi ||57|| ahaṃ vā rājapatnī me putrapautrādikaṃ ca yat | sarvaṃ dadāmi deveśa tvadarthaṃ mama yad bhavet ||58|| anantajanmatapasā nāpyate’pi paraḥ pumān | kṛpayā sa yadi prāptaḥ kiṃ me dārādhanādibhiḥ ||59|| ityuccārya balirbhakto’luṃṭhad vāmanapādayoḥ | vāmanaḥ prāha bhaktendra sarvaṃ padatraye sthitam ||1.146.60 || tava bhaktyā prasanno’smi rājam̐stava samīpataḥ | māpayāmi padenādya pṛthivīṃ tava paśyataḥ ||61|| ityuktvā baṭurūpaṃ tad vihāya parameśvaraḥ | vavṛdhe vāmano’tīva kṛtvā rūpaṃ caturbhujam ||62||| vardhamānaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇāḥ ṛṣayaḥ surāḥ | tuṣṭuvurgagane jātaṃ bhagavantaṃ janārdanam ||63|| jaya viṣṇo jaya viṣṇo jaya bhaktakṛpākara | jaya hrasva jaya dīrgha jaya bhikṣuka vāmana ||64|| jaya devakṛpākartṛ jaya bhaktasya gocara | jaya yajña jaya havya jaya vahne jayācyuta ||65|| jayārthin dātṛ netṛ tvaṃ jaya brahmāṇḍakṛdvapuḥ | jaya matsya namastubhyaṃ jaya kūrma dharādhara ||66|| jaya vārāharūpadhṛk nṛsiṃhāya namo’stu te | jaya kṛṣṇa jaya śrīmannārāyaṇa namo’stu te ||67|| namaḥ kṛṣṇāya kambharāgopālāya namo namaḥ | namaḥ patnīvratākhyāya lakṣmīnāthāya te namaḥ ||68|| varṇitaṃ bahudhā śāstre dṛṣṭaṃ naiva kadāpi yat | dṛśyate’dya kṛpāleśāccaturdaśadharāsthitaiḥ ||69|| vairājaṃ te mahadrūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭāḥ sma tāritāḥ | yoginaḥ sanakādyā ye te stuvanti janārdanam ||1.146.70|| gaganārdhaṃ gate kṛṣṇe vardhamāne baleḥ puraḥ | ūrdhvavaktrāḥ sthitāḥ sarve nirīkṣante divaṃ gatam ||71|| chatraṃ yaṣṭirmṛgacarma kamaṇḍaluśca pāduke | yad yadabhūddhareragre sarvaṃ vai vavṛdhe saha ||72|| dṛṣṭacchatrākṛtistāvat paścādūrdhvagato hariḥ | cūḍāmaṇirivābhāti bhāskaro harimastake ||73|| tataḥ punarvavṛdhe’tha lalāṭe tilakāyate | athāpi vardhito hariḥ sūryaḥ sa kuṇḍalāyate ||74|| uccairgato haristasmāt sūryaḥ sa kaustubhāyate | agre gatvā mahendreṇa vanamālā gale’rpitā ||75|| pṛthivī kampate bhārāt svargasthaṃ grahamaṇḍalam | nāśameṣyati daityāste bhītāḥ paśyanti vāmanam ||76|| athāpi vavṛdhe kṛṣṇo nābhau padmāyate raviḥ | pañcāśatkoṭivistīrṇāṃ sasamudramahīdharām ||77|| sasāgarāṃ sadvīpāṃ ca sadevāsuramānuṣām | pādenaikena puruṣo jagrāha madhusūdanaḥ ||78|| tatpadaṃ pṛthivīṃ sarvāmākramya padmaje śubhe | atiriktaṃ samabhavacchatayojanamāyatam ||79|| divyaṃ cakṣurdadau tasmai daityeśāya sanātanaḥ | tadviśvarūpaṃ devasya dṛṣṭvā daityośvaro baliḥ ||1.146.80 || praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe sānandāśrupariplutaḥ | dṛṣṭvā devaṃ namaskṛtya stutvā stutibhireva ca ||8 1 || prāha gadgadayā vācā prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā | dhanyo’smi kṛtakṛtyo’smi tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā parameśvaram ||82|| lokatrayaṃ tvamevaitad gṛhāṇa parameśvara | atha sarveśvaro viṣṇurdvitīyaṃ padamacyutam ||83|| ūrdhvaṃ prasārayāmāsa brahmalokāntamacyutaḥ | pādo na paripūrṇo’bhūdacyutasya śubhānane ||84|| vegenotkṣipya hariṇā nīto brahmāṇḍamastake | brahmāṇḍaṃ jarjaraṃ jātaṃ pādāṃguṣṭhābhidhātanāt ||85|| bhinnaṃ cāsmin samāyātaṃ bāhyaṃ toyaṃ jagattraye | viṣṇupādodbhavā gaṃgā tatsthānāt prasṛtā tadā ||86|| pitāmaho hareḥ pādaṃ cakrapadmādicihnitam | jñātvā kamaṇḍaluṃ bhṛtvā tatastajjalavāribhiḥ ||87|| muhuḥ prakṣālayāmāsa śrīhareścaraṇāmbujam | tat toyamakṣayyameva jātaṃ kṛṣṇaprabhāvataḥ ||88|| tattīrthaṃ meruśikhare papāta salilaṃ śubham | jagataḥ pāvanārthaṃ vai caturdikṣu pravāhitam ||89|| pūrve sītā dakṣiṇe sālakanandeti kīrtitā | paścime cakṣurityākhyā bhadrākhyā cottare matā ||1.146.90|| tatra cālakanandāpi tridhā nāmnābhavat tadā | ūrdhve mandākinī proktā madhye gaṃgā prakīrtitā || 9 1|| pātāle sā yadā prāptā hyajo bhogavatī matā | svardhunī procyate svarge gaṃgā tu gāṃ gatā satī |||92|| pātāle tu gatā sābhūnnāmnā tripathagāpi ca | sevitā pūjitā dṛṣṭā spaṣṭā pītāvagāhitā ||93 || prajvālya sarvapāpāni muktiṃ dadāti dehine | tāṃ dṛṣṭvā merumadhyāttu prasravantīṃ śubhānane ||94|| ativegapravāhaiśca patantīṃ dhārayettu kaḥ | mahāpravāhavegaṃ bhūrdṛṣṭvā bhītā vidāraṇāt ||95|| prārthayāmāsa śaṃbhuṃ tāṃ dhārayituṃ jaṭāvane | ātmanaḥ pāvanārthāya mūrdhnā śaṃbhuradhārayat ||96|| divyavarṣasahasraṃ sā jaṭāyāmeva saṃsthitā | tato bhāgīrathī rājā gautamaśca mahātapāḥ ||97|| prasādya tapasayā śaṃbhuṃ gaṃgārthaṃ samayācata | sarvalokahitārthāya tābhyāṃ dattā tu śaṃbhunā ||98|| gautamena samānītā gautamīti prakīrtitā | bhagīrathena cāyātā bhāgīrathīti cocyate ||99|| jahnunā pīyamānā sā jānośca prakaṭīkṛtā | jāhnavīti samākhyātā samudrāntā hi pāvanī || 1.146.10 0|| kapilasyāśrame dagdhān sagarasyātmajān bahūn | uddhārayitvā ṣaṣṭisāhasrānabdhāvavāpatat || 10 1|| evaṃ vṛddhiṃ gato viṣṇurjagṛhe ca padadvayam | sthānaṃ nāsti tṛtīyasya brahmāṇḍaṃ sakalaṃ hṛtam || 10 2|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vāmanasya yajñasthale praveśaḥ bhūmiyācanā śukrakṛnniṣedhe’pi tripadabhūmidānaṃ vāmanavardhanaṃ dvitīyapadenāṇḍakaṭāhād gaṃgodbhava ityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 146 ||
<1.147> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca asurāṇāṃ tadā cāsītkaśmalaṃ paramaṃ mahat | vicakrame padaikena kṣitiṃ sa vā mano rame || 1 || saptasvargān dvitīyena tṛtīyārthaṃ na śiṣyate | atha brahmā marīcyādyāḥ sanandādyāśca yoginaḥ || 2 || vedopavedā niyamā yamāḥ purāṇasaṃhitāḥ | yatayo munayo brahmacāriṇaścordhvaretasaḥ || 3 || vavandire padaṃ satyākrāntaṃ śrīvāmanasya te | toyaiḥ puṣpaiścandanaiśca divyagandhānulepanaiḥ || 4 || sugandhadhūpadīpaiśca lājākṣataphalādibhiḥ | stavanairjayaśabdaiśca śaṃkhadundubhiniḥsvanaiḥ || 5 || nṛtyavāditragītaiśca tatsāmarthyamayaistathā | pupūjurvijayasyāsya mahotsavamaghoṣayat || 6 || asurāstu prajvalitā hṛtsu naitad viṣehire | kapaṭino vāmanasyāsatyakramasya sarvathā || 7 || devapakṣaprapāteśca vadha evāsti śāsanam | ityāyudhāni jagṛhurdaityā hyāsuradānavāḥ || 8 || sahetihastakā ugrāḥ svārthamātraparāyaṇāḥ | anicchanto baleḥ rājñaḥ prādravajjātamanyavaḥ || 9 || tānprati pārṣadā viṣṇordhṛtaśastrāstrapāṇayaḥ | balo nandaḥ sunando’tha prabalaḥ kumudastathā || 1.147.10 || viśvaksenaḥ kumudākṣo garuḍaḥ sāttvatastathā | jayantaḥ śrutadevaśca puṣpadantastathāpare || 11 || sarve nāgāyutabalāścamūṃ te jaghnurāsurīm | balistu vārayāmāsa daityān dānavapuṃgavān || 1 2|| mā yudhyata nivartadhvaṃ kālo nāsmākamarthadaḥ | yo no bhavāya devo’bhūd divaukasāṃ viparyaye || 1 2|| sa eva bhagavānadyāsmatto viparyayaṃ gataḥ | tasmātparājayaṃ prāpya stheyaṃ tacchāsane’dhunā || 14|| prāpte punastu samaye vijeṣyāmo harerbalāt | daityā vākyaṃ baleḥ śrutvā viviśuste rasātalam || 15|| athātra garuḍaḥ pāśairbaliṃ babandha vāruṇaiḥ | hāhākāro mahānāsīd brahmāṇḍe’tra sthale sthale || 16 || vāmanaḥ prāha baddhaṃ taṃ rājyahīnaṃ śriyojjhitam | padāni trīṇi dattāni tatraikamavaśiṣyate || 17|| dvābhyāṃ krāntaṃ tava rājyaṃ tṛtīyamupakalpaya | pratiśrutamadātuste narake vasatirdhruvā || 18|| vipralabdheḥ phalaṃ bhuṃkṣva nirayaṃ katicitsamāḥ | evaṃ viprakṛto bhaktaḥ prāha devaṃ hi rañjayan || 19 || na me vaco vyalīkaṃ syāt tavānugrahakāraṇāt | maccharīraṃ tṛtīyasya padasyārthe samarpitam ||1.147.2 0 || tava pāśaśca pādaśca mama syādabhavāya hi | ślādhyaścāsurabhāvānāṃ parokṣasthitiko guruḥ || 2 1|| pitāmaho mama deva tvayā rakṣita eva ha | prahalādastadvadatrāpi bhavapāśātsurakṣitaḥ || 22|| tava hastakṛtaḥ pāśo na pāśaḥ kintu muktaye | rājyaṃ svarga sukhaṃ bandhurjīvanaṃ maraṇaṃ guruḥ ||23|| muktiḥ pāśaśca yatkiṃcit tanme tvameva vartase | nānyaṃ jānāmi sukhadaṃ bandhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ ca vā |||24||| āsanācca tadāgatya prahlādaḥ prāha keśavam | tvayā datte pade moho’syātra tvayā vināśitaḥ || 25|| sa evānugraho jātastvāṃ vinā ko vimocayet | sandhyāvalī baleḥ patnī prāṃjaliḥ prāha mādhavam |||26|| tvayā dattaṃ tvayā bhuktaṃ tvayaivopahṛtaṃ tathā | tava krīḍāmayaṃ sarvaṃ mūḍha svāmitvavaibhavāḥ ||27|| brahmovāca tadā devaṃ muñcainaṃ sāttvataṃ balim | ātmanivedinaṃ bhaktaṃ hṛṣyantaṃ bandhane’pi yat ||28|| hṛtaṃ sarvasvamevāsya bandhanaṃ cāpi saṃkṛtam | śarīraṃ cārpitaṃ tena nāyamarhati nigraham ||29|| vāmanaḥ prāha madbhakte’haṃmamatve tu māyayā | ahite yadi rājyādestadā ko’nugraho nu me ||1.147.30 || janmakarmavayorūpavidyaiśvaryadhanādibhiḥ | yadi naiva vimuhyeta so’yaṃ tvanugraho mama ||3 1 || yadi muhyeta tanmohaṃ nāśayāmi prasahya vai | tadāpi manmati syāccedajaiṣīdajayāṃ hi saḥ |||32|| kīdṛśo’yaṃ mama bhaktaḥ parīkṣito mayādhunā | kṣīṇarikthaścyutaḥ sthānād baddhaścaivāpamānitaḥ ||33 || guruṇā pratisiddho’pi satya jahau na matkṛte | chalena yācitaḥ sarvasvaṃ balāt hṛtavānaham ||34|| tathāpi mama dāsatvaṃ naiva tyajati sanmatiḥ | tasmānnāhaṃ tyajāmyenaṃ madārādhanatatparam ||35|| rasātalaṃ śubhaṃ lokaṃ dadāmyasmai samṛddhimat | sarveṣāṃ dānavānāṃ ca nāgānāṃ yādasāmapi || 36|| rājānaṃ tu baliṃ kurve yāvadābhūtasamplavam | manvantare ca sāvarṇau punaścendro bhaviṣyasi || 37|| bale yamanugṛhṇāmi tatsarvaṃ vidhunomyaham | mānaṃ mohaṃ vināśyaiva punaḥ smṛddhaṃ karomi tam || 38|| baliḥ prāha tadā devaṃ nāthāptaṃ yādṛśaṃ mayā | tādṛśaṃ nānyalabdhavyaṃ vacmi kiṃ me’tidhanyatām ||3 9|| tṛtīyacaraṇārthaṃ me śiraścātrāvaśiṣyate | nidhehi caraṇaṃ tatra sarvaṃ prāptaṃ mayā bhavet ||1.147.40 || hariḥ sakaruṇastasya nyadhānmūrdhni padaṃ svakam | tṛtīyaṃ kramamāsādya prasampūrṇamanorathaḥ ||41|| baliṃ prasahya bhāreṇa rasātalamavānayat | tatra rājye niyuyoja jñātibhiḥ parivāritam ||42|| balistaṃ vāmanaṃ prāha bhagavan padmakomale | pattale te mama lomaśūlāḥ protā hi duḥkhadāḥ ||43|| kva daityasya vapurvajraṃ kva hareḥ pādapaṃkajam | pāde pīḍābhavad yasmātkuru nātha mayi kṣamām ||44|| iti kṛtvā balistatra lileha jihvayā padam | cucumba pattalaṃ premṇā komalaṃ mokṣadaṃ muhuḥ ||45|| yallābhe labdhamevedaṃ sarvaṃ yatra pratiṣṭhitam | kathaṃ tallehanaṃ na syādānandāmṛtapānadam ||46|| hariḥ prāha bale’laṃ tai bhaktyā tuṣṭo’smi vāñchitam | śṛṇu tad yadi kiṃcitsyānna me’deyaṃ tavāsti yat ||47|| baliḥ prāha sadā tvetaccaraṇaṃ me gṛhe vaset | śaśvatprapūjanārthāya daityāghakṣālakaṃ śubham ||48|| kūpāṃ kuru mayi śrīśa sadā rakṣāṃ vidhehi me | na punardaityatāṃ yāyāṃ pārṣadaṃ kuru māṃ prabho ||49|| hariḥ prāha tadā rakṣāṃ kariṣye dvārasaṃsthitaḥ | sudarśanaṃ ca me cakraṃ rājyarakṣāṃ kariṣyati ||1.147.50 || nāhaṃ baliṃ vinā tiṣṭhe māṃ vinā na baleḥ sthitiḥ | tubhyaṃ darśanadānāya tiṣṭhāmi tava gopure |||5 1 || tvacchāsanātigānduṣṭām̐ścakraṃ me sūdayiṣyati | rakṣayiṣye sadāhaṃ tvāṃ sakuṭumbaparicchadam ||52|| sadā sannihitaṃ māṃ tvaṃ drakṣyase bhavane tava | mama kṛpāvaśātte hyāsuro bhāvo vinaṅkṣyati ||53||| kuru rāsātalaṃ rājyaṃ sutale te pitāmahaḥ | prahalādosti mama bhaktaḥ pātāle hāṭakeśvaraḥ ||54|| śaṃbhuścāsti mama bhaktastatra tatra vasāmyaham | gadāmādāya govindo vasāmi balimandire || 55 || vāmano bhagavān sākṣād kṛtvā rūpāntaraṃ tataḥ | bale saudhe nivasati sadā rakṣaṇahetave ||5 6 || pratigṛhya balerlokān vaṭuveṣeṇa vāmanaḥ | mahendrāya samukuṭahāratilakabhūṣitam ||57|| kṛtvā maṃgalasatkāryaṃ dadau rājyaṃ trilokagam | tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ ṛṣayaśca mahaujasaḥ ||58|| caturdaśastarāvāsāḥ pupūjustvindramacyutam | yajñāntimastadā homaḥ saśrīphalasamedhitaḥ || 59 || viṣṇunā cendrahastena kāritastatra pūrtakṛt | śukraṃ prāha haristatra karmacchidraṃ tathākramam ||1.147.6 0|| vaiṣamyaṃ parihāryaṃ ca tvayā vai guruṇā yataḥ | śukraḥ prāha hariṃ yatra karmadraṣṭā bhavānmataḥ ||6 1 || kutastatkarmavaiṣamyaṃ yajñeśo yatra pūjitaḥ | mantratastantrataśchidraṃ deśakālārhavastutaḥ |||5|| sarvaṃ jātaṃ tu niśchidraṃ tava sākṣādupasthiteḥ | pūrṇāhutiṃ vidhāyāvabhṛthasnānaṃ ca vāridhau ||63|| somanāthe mahākṣetre kṛtavantaśca yājñikāḥ | viṣṇunā preṣitāḥ sarve gatā svasvaniketanam ||64|| trailokyaṃ mahadaiśvaryamavāpa tridaśeśvara | atha prajāpatirbrahmā viṣṇustathā ca śaṃkaraḥ ||65|| dakṣabhṛgvaṃgiromukhyā devarṣipitṛbhūmipāḥ | kaśyapasyāditeḥ prītyai sarvalokasya śāntaye ||66|| dikpālā lokapālāśca hyakurvan vāmanaṃ patim | ṛṣīṇāṃ ca munīnāṃ ca devānāṃ bhūbhṛtaḥ tathā ||67|| lokānāṃ lokapālānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ yaśasāṃ śriyaḥ | vratānāṃ dānadharmāṇāṃ yajñānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām ||68|| maṅgalānāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ tathā svargāpavargayoḥ | upendraṃ kalpayāñcakre patiṃ sarvavibhūtaye ||69|| tadā sarve mumudire vāmanaṃ praṇipatya ca | gatāḥ svasvarājadhānīmindro’nujaṃ tu vāmanam ||1.147.70 || devayānena saudhaṃ svaṃ nītvāpūjayadacyutam | prāpya trilokajaṃ rājyaṃ copendrabhujarakṣitaḥ ||71|| mahendro mumude devāḥ sukhino vāmanāśritāḥ | itthaṃ surakṣitāḥ sendradevāḥ śrīviṣṇunā purā ||72|| devānāṃ paramo harṣaḥ sañjāto vāmanārpitaḥ | nivāsāya manaścakre vāmano vāmanasthalīm ||73|| vāmanena purā yatrārthitā bhikṣā muhurmuhuḥ | balestu nigrahāt tadvai pura daityairvināśitam ||74|| puraṃ sarvaṃ tathā smṛddhiṃ ninyudaityā rasātalam | tatastaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ gargaṃ papraccha bhagavānprabhuḥ ||75|| kasminsthāne mayā kāryaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ nagaraṃ vada | yatra saukhyaṃ tathā muktirnṝṇāṃ syād bhavabandhanāt ||76|| vastrāpathe raivatasya paścime vāmanasthalī | nagarī kāritā viśvakarmaṇā viprasātkṛtā ||77|| patnīvratena vipreṇa rājyaṃ tasyāḥ kṛtaṃ purā | vaṃśaparamparāprāptaṃ yugānte’nyakarasthitam ||78|| tīrthānāṃ raivate sārdhakoṭitrayaṃ vasatyapi | bhadrā madhumatī corjasvatī svarṇasurakṣikā ||79|| sarvā vai bhagavatpatnyo nadīrūpeṇa saṃsthitāḥ | yannāmasmaraṇād yatra snānād dānācca tīryate ||1.147.80|| pratikalpaṃ mahāyajñā bhavanti balinā kṛtāḥ | kvacid himagireḥ prānte kvacidbhūmau tu puṣkare ||81|| kvacicca raivate tvadrau narmadāyāstaṭe kvacit | kalpāntare vāmano’yaṃ narmadāyāstaṭe baleḥ ||82|| yajñe gatvā baliṃ badhvā trilokīṃ tu hariṣyati | evaṃ vāmanarūpāṇi sahasrāṇi bhavanti vai ||83|| kalpe kalpe catuṣkyāṃ ca bhinnā vai vāmanāḥ smṛtāḥ | nāntosti me’vatārāṇāṃ diṅmātraṃ procyate mayā ||84|| etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ vāmanaṃ vaibhavaṃ priye | vada lakṣmi tataḥ puṇyaṃ hṛdyaṃ śrotuṃ kimicchasi ||85|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne baleḥ pāśabandhanaṃ rasātalarājyadānaṃ vāmanasya baligṛhe vāsaḥ indrāya trilokīdānam avabhṛthasnānaṃ vāmanasthalīnāmnī purī kāritetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||147||
<1.148> śrīlakṣmīruvāca payovratamavaidhavyavrataṃ ca kīdṛśaṃ katham | kartavyaṃ yena putrāptiḥ patyuryogaḥ sadā bhavet || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca brahmaṇā prathamaṃ proktaṃ kaśyapāya mahātmane | tena patnyai tato’dityabhidhāyai kathitaṃ tataḥ || 2 || hiraṇyākṣādiputravatyaditiḥ sambabhūva ha | tadvrataṃ dvādaśāhaṃ tu kāryaṃ keśavatoṣakṛt || 3 || phālgunasya site pakṣe vratametatprakīrtitam | pratipaddinamāramya yāvacchuklatrayodaśī || 4 || brahmacaryamadhaḥsvāpaḥ snānaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ caret | satyaṃ vadet tyajedbhogānuccāvacām̐stu rājasān || 5 || drohaṃ hiṃsāṃ tyajennityaṃ kārayetpūjanaṃ hareḥ | nṛtyavāditragītaiśca stutibhiḥ svastivācanaiḥ || 6 || ṣoḍaśopacārakaiśca kathābhirbhajanaistathā | śaktito brāhmaṇān pañca nityaṃ vai bhojayet tathā || 7 || ārambhe tu hyamāvāsyādine madhyāhnato gṛham | saṃlipya goṣakṛtā ca mṛdā ca śuddhatāṃ nayet || 8 || svayaṃ prakṣālya vastrādi nārī śuddhiṃ samācaret | sāyaṃkāle śuddhamṛdālipya snāyād vrataṃkarī || 9 || mṛttikāmānayet kṣetrājjalasrotasa eva vā | udāharenmṛdādāne mantraṃ svabhāṣayā vadhūḥ || 1.148.1 0|| tvaṃ devi śrīvarāheṇa pṛthvīrūpā samuddhṛtā | uddharāmi namastubhyaṃ pāpmānaṃ me vināśaya || 1 1|| ityuccārya samunneyā mṛttikātha tato gṛhe | snātvā saṃpūjayed viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ niśādime || 12|| niśāraṃbhe ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ saṃpūjayeddharim | saṃkalpayecca śvodināt kariṣyehaṃ payovratam || 13|| putrasya prāptaye tanme pūrṇaṃ te kṛpayā bhavet | dvādaśāhe vrate tatra brahmacaryādikān yamān || 14|| pālayiṣye bhojayiṣye dvyavarān brāhmaṇān sadā | dvādaśāhaṃ tava pūjāṃ kariṣye ṣoḍaśarddhibhiḥ || 16|| arcāyāṃ sthaṇḍile sūrye jale vahnau gurāvapi | patyau vā śrīhariṃ nityaṃ pūjayed bhaktibhāvataḥ || 16|| bhāṣayā ca stutiṃ kuryādarthasandarbhitāṃ śubhām | namo bhagavate tubhyaṃ parapuṃse namonamaḥ || 17|| sarvāntaḥkṛtavāsāya vāsudevāya sākṣiṇe | namo’vyaktāya sūkṣmāya vyaktapuṃse namonamaḥ ||18|| caturviśatitattvāya vikṛtihetave namaḥ | namo dvimūrdhne tripade catuḥśṛṃgāya sūtriṇe || 19|| saptahastāya kratave veṭatrayātmane namaḥ | mahādevāya rudrāya vṛṣabhāya namo namaḥ ||1.148.20|| yāvadvidyādhiṣṭhitāya prāṇināṃ pataye namaḥ | namo hiraṇyakośāya jagatprāṇātmane namaḥ ||21|| yogasiddhyaiśvaryavate yogakartre ca te namaḥ | namaḥ sarvādidevāya namaste cātmavartine ||22|| namaste harikṛṣṇāya naranārāyaṇarṣaye | namaḥ indīvaraśyāmavapuṣe śrīmate namaḥ |||23 || namaste keśavānanta pītavastravate namaḥ | varadātā vareṇyaśca tvaṃ janābhīṣṭadaḥ prabhuḥ ||24|| upāsitā mokṣadā vai tava pādādireṇavaḥ | devāstvāmanuvartante sthitā śrīstava pādayoḥ ||25|| spṛhayāmi kṛpāmodaṃ bhagavanme prasīdatām | iti saṃstūya taṃ kṛṣṇamāvāhayejjagadgurum ||26|| pādyamarghyamācamanamāsanaṃ dāpayeddharim | sutailārkādi saṃmṛdyaṃ tataḥ pañcāmṛtaṃ diśet ||27|| payodadhighṛtamadhuśarkarāsnānamarpayet | śuddhodakajalasnānamabhiṣekaṃ ca kārayet |||28||| vastreṇa mārjanaṃ kṛtvā śubhavastrāṇi cārpayet | yajñasūtraṃ kaustubhaṃ ca tailasārārkamarcayet ||29|| kuṃkumābīragulālākṣatairdevaṃ samarcayet | candanakusumadhūpadīpanaivedyamarpayet ||1.148.30 || bhūṣāhetimukuṭādi tilakādi ca dhārayet | jalamārārtrikaṃ dadyānmukhe tāmbūlakaṃ tathā |||3 1|| phalaṃ dadyājjalaṃ dadyāt kuryānnamaḥ sadaṇḍavat | pradakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ ca dadyādarthyaṃ nivedayet ||32|| dvādaśāhaṃ tava pūjāṃ kariṣye dehi putrakam | ūṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāyeti saṃjapet ||33| aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā dugdhapāko’nyadeva vā | ghṛtaśarkarasampūrṇaṃ juhuyājjapavidyayā ||34|| niveditaṃ dugdhapākaṃ miṣṭānnamanyadeva vā | svalpaṃ svalpaṃ tu bhaktebhyo dadyātprasādabhāvataḥ ||346|| svayaṃ bhuñjīta putrārthaṃ stuvīta stutibhiḥ prabhum | tajjalaṃ śirasi dhṛtvā tato devaṃ visarjayet ||36|| dvayavarān brāhmaṇām̐statra bhojayetpāyasena ca | bhuñjīta tairanujñāto vratī vratakarī ca vai ||37|| niśāraṃbhe prasaṃsādhya svapyādatha bhuvi vratī | svapyād rātrau brahmacārī śvobhūte prathame dine || 28|| brāhme muhūrte vidhivat snātvā coktavidhānataḥ | snapayitvā ca vidhivannityaṃ prātaḥ prapūjayet|||29|| devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yāvadvratasamāpanam | ekabhaktaṃ prabhuñjīta dugdhapākaṃ na cetarat ||1.148.40 || divasaṃ kṣapayed bhaktyā rātriṃ japena nidrayā | nityaṃ saṃjuhuyādagnau brāhmaṇām̐ścāpi bhojayet ||41 || evaṃ pratidinaṃ kuryād dvādaśāhaṃ payovratī | payobhakṣavratamidaṃ careddharyarcanānvitaḥ |||42|| harerārādhanaṃ homaṃ pūjanaṃ sādhubhojanam | pratipaddinamārabhya yāvacchuklatrayodaśī ||43|| kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ kuryāt patiḥ patnī hyubhāvapi | trayodaśyāṃ prabhāte vai śrīhareḥ snapanādikam ||44|| kārayed vidhinā sarvaṃ brāhmaṇairvidhikovidaiḥ | mahāpūjāṃ prakurvīta vittaśāṭhyaṃ na cācaret |||45|| śrapayitvā caruṃ dugdhapākasyāgnau havārthini | tena śṛtena ca vahnimukhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yajeta saḥ ||46|| nārāyaṇāya naivedyaṃ dadyāt subahutuṣṭidam | ācāryaṃ śrotriyaṃ jñānasampannaṃ toṣayed bahu ||47|| dhenvābharaṇavastrādyaiḥ ṛtvijaścāpi toṣayet | bhojayettām̐śca bahubhirmiṣṭānnaiḥ dakṣiṇādibhiḥ ||48|| anyān viprām̐stathā sādhūn sādhvīṃśca bhojayenmudā | viprācāryagurusādhusādhvībhyaśca yathārhataḥ ||49|| dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ tathānyān samupāgatān | abhyāgatānatithīṃścāśvapākān prīṇayedapi ||1.148.50 || annajalādidānena dīnāndhakṛpaṇādikān | teṣāṃ tṛpto bhavedviṣṇostṛptiśceti vicārayan |||51 || gośvapipīlikādīṃśca dattvā bhuñjīta bandhubhiḥ | nāmaprakīrtanaiḥ kṛṣṇakathābhiḥ stavanairjapaiḥ ||52|| dinaṃ śeṣaṃ kṣapayed yatpuruṣārādhanaṃ param | payovratamidaṃ proktaṃ mayā te samudāhṛtam |||53|| dugdhapāke taṇḍulā vā nivārā vā matāḥ śubhāḥ | śākāhāro na kartavyaḥ śyāmalaḥ śākajo bhavet ||54|| dugdhapākaśca bhoktavyastenāpatyaṃ balojjvalam | vratapūrṇāhutau paścād yugmāsu rātriṣu svayam ||55|| patnī tu saṃviśet tena jāyeta śaktimānsutaḥ | ayugmāsu viśet patnīṃ kanyā jāyeta siddhidā ||56 || tapaḥsāramidaṃ lakṣmi vrataṃ putrapradaṃ śubham | patyā patnyā hyubhābhyāṃ ca kartavyaṃ tatphalapradam ||57|| nānyathā phaladaṃ vai syāt sandigdhaphalavattu tat | avaidhavyavrataṃ cāpi kathayāmi śṛṇu priye ||58 || raivatasya gireḥ putrī raivatī raivatācale | dāmodarāt paścimāyāṃ diśi tiṣṭhati nityadā ||59|| tatra vai raivatīkuṇḍo vartate pāpanāśakaḥ | avaidhavyaṃ ca nārīṇāṃ tathā santānakāraṇam ||1.148.60 || saubhāgyaṃ sarvanārīṇāṃ sampādayati tajjalam | tatra snātvā bhavennārī bahuputradhanānvitā ||61 || na vaidhavyaṃ bhavet tasyāḥ saubhāgyamatule bhavet | snātvā phalāni deyāni kuṃkumaṃ ca sakajjalam ||62|| gaurīsūtraṃ pradātavyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ puṣpamityapi | pītaṃ vastraṃ pradātavyaṃ kaṃcukaṃ yaṣṭikā tathā ||63|| phalāni vaṃśapātreṣu bhṛtvā miṣṭānnamityapi | strīṇāṃ tu sādhvīnāṃ satīnāṃ ca sadakṣiṇam ||64|| prātaḥ snātvā pradātavyaṃ raivatīdarśanaṃ tataḥ | pūjanaṃ ca ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ kartavyameva ca ||65||| stutiṃ putrārthamevāvaidhavyārthamapi ca kriyāt | sadā kṛpāvati devi raivati me kṛpāṃ kuru || 66 || avaidhavyaṃ sadā me’stu putrapautravatī tathā | dhanadhānyavatī ca syāṃ dehi me vāṃchitaṃ śubhe || 67 || iti stutvā namaskṛtya dāmodarasya darśanam | kṛtvā kārtika śukle vai pañcadaśadināvadhim || 68 || gantavyaṃ svagṛhe nityaṃ bhojyaṃ dugdhānnamityapi | miṣṭānnaṃ vyañjanaṃ cāpi ghṛtapakvādikaṃ tathā || 69 || sahavāsaśca patinā kāryo na tu niṣidhyate | nopavāsastathā kāryo nānyā pūjāpyapekṣate || 1.148.70 || vratī kuṇḍasnapanaṃ raivatīstutidarśane | uktaphalādidānaṃ ca dāmodarasya darśanam ||7 1 || pañcadaśadinaprātaḥkṛtaṃ saubhāgyavardhakam | iti tubhyamavaidhavyakaraṃvrataṃ tu darśitam || 72 || athānyat tvaṃ mahālakṣmi kiṃ mattaḥ śrotumicchasi | lakṣmīḥ prāha kṛpāsindho tīrthāni raivate girau ||73 || tatpārśve ca yadanyāni vasanti tāni me vada | kiyatsāmarthyavantyeva śrotumicchāmi keśava ||74 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne putraprāptidaṃ payovratam avaidhavyavrataṃ ceti nirūpaṇanāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 148 ||
<1.149> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi raivatasthatīrthāni kathayāmyaham | yātrāphalasuyuktāni bhuktimuktipradāni ca || 1 || vastrāpathasya tīrthāni yāni yena kṛtāni ca | tānyapi te kathayiṣye svargamokṣapradāni ca || 2 || pūrve kṛtayuge kānyakubje bhojanṛpo’bhavat | tasmai vanāt samabhyetya vanapālabravīdidam || 3 || āścaryaṃ bhramatā rājan mayā dṛṣṭaṃ vanedhunā | mṛgayūthagatā nārī mayā dṛṣṭā mṛgānanā || 4 || tatastu bhojarājaḥ saḥ senādhyakṣamuvāca ha | idānīmeva gantavyaṃ yatra sā yuvatī sthitā || 5 || sāśvāśca pattayo yāntu veṣṭayantu vanaṃ girim | strīveṣadhāriṇī nārī vaśaṃ neyā mṛgī hi sā || 6 || giriṃ saṃveṣṭayāmāsa bhojaḥ sainyapadātibhiḥ | plavamānā tu sainyena vidhṛtā hariṇānanā || 7 || nārīdehāṃ samāninye kānyakubje mṛgīṃ nṛpaḥ | dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ jāyate nṛpamandire || 8 || rājā tāṃ snāpayāmāsa divyagandhānulepanaiḥ | ekānte nirjane rājā babhāṣe samalaṃkṛtām || 9 || kā tvaṃ kasya sutā kena hetunā ca mṛgānanā | iti pṛṣṭhāpi novāca na bhuṃkte na papau tathā || 1.149.10 || tadā bhojastu daivajñān mantrajñān bhiṣajastathā | tāntrikān sunamaskṛtya babhāṣe paśyata dvijāḥ || 11 || nārīdehā kathaṃ nveṣā kathaṃ ca hariṇānanā | manuṣyavāṇīvadanā kathameṣā bhaviṣyati || 12 || viprāḥ prāhuḥ kurukṣetre sārasvatākhyabhūsuraḥ | jānāti sa ca vṛttāntaṃ yathātathaṃ sa vakṣyati || 13 || bhojo jagāma taṃ vipraṃ tapantaṃ tapa ityamum | namaskṛtyopaviṣṭaṃ taṃ bhojaṃ prāha sa bhūsuraḥ || 1 4|| gacchāmo yatra sā nārī vakṣyati svayameva tat | ityāgatā yatra nārī tataḥ sārasvato dvijaḥ || 19|| upalipya ca bhūbhāgaṃ svastikaṃ sanniveśya ca | sajalaṃ kalaśaṃ nyasya cāgnikāryaṃ nidhāya ca || 16 || indraṃ devāṃśca dikpālān kalaśe sanniveśya ca | hutvāgniṃ ca caruṃ kṛtvā grahapūjāmakārayat || 17|| abhiṣekaṃ svayaṃ cakre tāṃ nārīṃ cābhiṣecayat | tāvatā divyadṛṣṭyā sā babhāṣe prāgbhavān bahūn || 18 || bhoja tvaṃ saptame pūrve janmani bhvāṃ mayā saha | kaliṃgadeśanṛpatirahaṃ patnī ca baṅgajā || 19 || duṣṭātmā tvamanācāro dayādharmavivarjitaḥ | gobhūvipraguruvedadevaśāstravināśakṛt ||1.149.2 0 || militvā ca prajābhistvaṃ hato lokavirodhakaḥ | mṛtaṃ kānta gṛhītvāgnau praviṣṭāhaṃ mṛtā saha ||21 || mṛtaṃ kāntaṃ samādāya bhāryāgnau praviśed yadi | mahīyete hyubhau svarge yāvadābhūtasamplavam ||22 || tatastu mālave deśe viprastvaṃ nāstiko’bhavaḥ | ahaṃ tu brāhmaṇī bhaktimatī bhāryābhavaṃ tava || 23 || tvayārjitaṃ dhanaṃ svarṇaṃ tyaktvāptaṃ maraṇaṃ yadā | sahāhaṃ na mṛtā lobhāt kintu kālāntare mṛtā ||24|| śvetasarpo’bhavastvaṃ vai viprakanyābhavaṃ tvaham | pariṇītānyavipreṇa vipraṃ tvamadaśaśca tam || 25 || ahantu vidhavā jātā sarpastvaṃ mārito janaiḥ | vaidhavyaṃ mama datvā tu dvijasarpāvubhau mṛtau || 26 || tvaṃ mṛtvā makaro jāto godāvaryāṃ tadāpyaham | tīrthaṃ bhīmeśvaraṃ draṣṭuṃ samāyātā janaiḥ saha |||27|| yāvat snātuṃ praviṣṭāhamākṛṣṭā makareṇa vai | lokaiḥ kuntādighātena makaro vinipātitaḥ ||28|| ahaṃ makaradaṃṣṭrābhistadānīṃ ca mṛtiṃ gatā | tvaṃ tato lubdhako jāto’haṃ śabaryabhabadvane |||29 || agnerjalācca sarpācca gajāt siṃhāddhayādapi | roṣādvisphoṭakānmṛtyuryeṣāṃ te narakaṃgamāḥ || 1.149.3 0|| ātmahā bhrūṇahā strīghno brahmaghnaḥ kūṭasākṣiṇaḥ | kanyāvikrayakartā ca mithyāpavādadāyakaḥ || 31 || vikrīṇāti kratuṃ yastu madyaṃ pāti dvijastu yaḥ | rājadrohī svarṇacauro brahmavṛttivilopakaḥ || 32|| goghnaśca nikṣepaharo grāmasīmaharastu yaḥ | sarve te narakaṃ yānti yā ca strī pativañcakī || 33 || śabaryahaṃ mṛtā rogāt krauṃcī jātā vane tadā | kvacit krauṃcena kāmena krīḍitumudyatābhavam || 34|| tāvadvyādhena sa krauṃco bāṇena vinipātitaḥ | krauṃcena ca tadā śaptaḥ krūro bhava mahāvane ||35|| strīhīnaḥ śārdūlarūpo duḥkhī bhava punaḥ punaḥ | tatastvaṃ śārdūlarūpo raivate ca girābabhūḥ || 36|| mṛtā daivavaśāt krauṃcī mṛgyabhūd raivate girau | bhaveśvarātpaścime tu svarṇarakṣānadījalam || 37|| pātuṃ cāhaṃ samāyātā dṛṣṭā kesariṇā tadā | utplutā tadbhayāccāhaṃ patitā cāparaṃ taṭam ||38|| tāvat siṃhaḥ samutplutya madagre patito balāt | ahaṃ yāvatparāvṛtyotplavitumupacakrame || 39|| pārśvasthakīcakastambe jalasthe mama mastakam | dvayoḥ kīcakayormadhye plavane pāśavat hyabhūt ||1.149.40|| śarīraṃ jalamadhye me mastakaṃ vaṃśamadhyagam | siṃhena saṃdhṛtaṃ kaṇṭhāddaṃṣṭrābhiśca viyojitam ||41|| yāvat siṃho’pi me varṣma jalamadhyād vikarṣati | tāvat saibalayogena padbhyāṃ sṛptvā jale’patat ||42|| agādhācca jalāt śaivālabāhulyātsamantataḥ | na nirgantuṃ śaśākāsau mṛtimāpat sa kesarī ||43|| svarṇarakṣājale siṃho mṛto bhojo’bhavannṛpaḥ | tasya tīrthaprabhāveṇa nṛpatvaṃ samajāyata ||44|| idaṃ hi saptamaṃ janma rājābhojeti viśrutam | lambate me śiro vaṃśe śarīraṃ jalamadhyagam ||45|| svarṇarekhājale tatra viśīrṇaṃ mama tadvapuḥ na tu vaktraṃ nipatitaṃ tvaṅmāṃsaṃ śirasi sthitam ||46|| tato’haṃ hariṇīgarbhe jātā mānuṣarūpiṇī | jātaṃ vaktraṃ mṛgīṇāṃ me yasmānna patitaṃ jale ||47|| nāhaṃ hariṇakanyāsti kintūddālakasanmuneḥ | kanyāsmi caikadā svarṇarakṣāyāṃ snātumāgataḥ ||48|| sa tadānīṃ ca tatraiva yoginyaḥ snātumāgatāḥ | yoginībhistadā tatra muniḥ parīkṣito muhuḥ ||49|| kīdṛśo’yaṃ brahmacārī dṛḍho vādṛḍha ityamum | gṛhītvā kaṇṭhapāśaiśca samāśliṣya muhurmuhuḥ ||1.149.50 || krīḍayanti bahurītyā ṛṣirna vikṛtiṃ gataḥ | athaikā yoginī nāmnā kāmadāhābhidhā tadā ||51 || uddālakasya dehe’ntaḥpraviṣṭā yogasadbalāt | tāvatkāmo’bhavadbhīto vidudrāva ṛṣestanoḥ ||||52|| anyathā dagdhatāṃ kuryād yoginī sāntarasthitā | kāmadevasya vidrāvād yoginyā uṣṇatāvaśāt ||53|| yauvanodbhedavegācca sahakrīḍanakādikāt | stambhito’pi tadā dhāturvegācca patito jale ||54|| pravāheṇa saha dhāturnārāyaṇahrade gataḥ | tatraikā hariṇī vāri papau taddhātumiśritam ||55|| tadgarbhe mama vāso’bhūt pūrvakarmānusārataḥ | ahamuddālakaṛṣeḥ putrī jātā mṛgānanā ||56|| yoginībhirvardhitāsmi yoginīnāṃ sutā yataḥ | yoginyasmi mṛgīmukhā divyāpi mānuṣī tathā ||57||| rājam̐stava tathā me’pi saptamaṃ janma vidyate | jānātyayamṛṣiḥ sārasvato yogabalāddhi tat ||58 praviśyāgnau mṛtā pūrve tvayā sārdhaṃ tu saptame | tvāṃ vinā me patirmā bhūnmaraṇe yācitaṃ mayā ||59|| tadāntarīkṣe rājendra vāguvācāśarīriṇī | rājāsau duṣṭakarmāsti hiṃsraḥ krūro’tilubdhakaḥ ||1.149.6 0|| na vedaśāstrakuśalo dayādharmavivarjitaḥ | kāmī mānī mahākrodhī satyācāravivarjitaḥ ||61|| na devaṃ na guruṃ viprānna jānāti durāśayaḥ | na sādhūnna ca sādhvīṃśca pūjayatyatimānavān ||62|| asatyavādī duṣṭātmā yajñadharmavināśakaḥ | palalāśī ca vai viṣṇornindako vṛttihārakaḥ ||63||| veśyāgāmī snānadānadharmakarmavivarjitaḥ | caṇḍālatāmayaṃ prāptastasya pāpaṃ kiyadguṇam ||64|| gaṇayituṃ na śakyeta tādṛśaḥ pāpavānayam | yadyapi tvaṃ satī nārī dagdhā bhavasi tena vai ||65 || tatastvaṃ saptajanmāni sahayuktā bhaviṣyasi | kintu cāsya mahāpāpaiḥ svargaṃ nāsya bhaviṣyati ||66 || ādau pāpaphalaṃ bhuktvā paścād rājyaṃ bhaviṣyati | aṣṭamaṃ cāsya sajjanma devajanma bhaviṣyati ||67|| tadā tvaṃ mānuṣī bhūtvā paścātsvargaṃ gamiṣyasi | ityuktvā sā virarāma sarvaṃ smarāmi yogataḥ ||68 || api me mastakasyāsti kharparaṃ vaṃśasaṃsthitam | yadi vastrāpathe gatvā śiraḥ kaścid vimuñcati ||69 || svarṇarakṣājale rājan mānuṣaṃ syānmukhaṃ mama | asmyahaṃ mānuṣavaktrā dṛśyate’nyairmṛgānanā ||1.149.70 || pāpacchāyāvṛtaṃ caitanmṛgākṛtimukhaṃ mama | śrutvaitadbhojarājena pratīhārastu tatsthalam ||7 1 || preṣitastena dṛṣṭaṃ tat svarṇarekhājalopari | vartate tanmṛgaśiro vaṃśaprotaṃ mahāvane ||72 || gṛhītvā pātitaṃ yāvat svarṇarekhājale tadā | bhojarājagṛhe tasyā mukhaṃ candrasamaṃ śubham ||73 || mānuṣa cābhavad divyaṃ padmapatrasulocanam | suśobhanaṃ dīrghakeśaṃ dīrghakarṇaṃ śubhadvijam ||74|| kambugrīvaṃ padmagandhaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam | na devī na ca gāndharvī nāsurī na ca kinnarī ||75|| yādṛśī sā tadā jātā tīrthabhāvena sundarī | pariṇītā tu sā tena bhojarājena sundarī ||76 || mṛgānaneti vikhyātā devī sā bhojasundarī | kutāsau paṭṭamahiṣī bhojarājena dhīmatā ||77|| deśānāṃ pravaro deśo girīṇāṃ pravaro giriḥ | kṣetrāṇāmuttamaṃ kṣetraṃ vanānāmuttamaṃ vanam ||78 || gaṃgāsarasvatīrevāḥ svarṇarekhājale sthitāḥ | brahmā viṣṇuśca sūryaśca sarve rudrādayaḥ surāḥ ||79 || nāgā yakṣāśca gandharvā asmin kṣetre vyavasthitāḥ | svarṇarakṣānadīvārṣu snātvā nārāyaṇe hrade ||1.149.8 0 || mṛgītīrthe tathā snātvā kuṇḍe dāmodarābhidhe | tathā ca revatīkuṇḍe snātvā svarmokṣamāpnuyāt ||8 1 || gaṃgā sarasvatī puṇyā yamunā svarṇarūpiṇī | nadyāmāgatya tiṣṭhanti dṛśyante svarṇapatrikāḥ |||82 || sarasvatī svarṇarūpā gaṃgā rajatapatrikāḥ | yamunā tāmrapatrāṇi nadyapsu pracakāsati ||8 3 || evaṃ suvarṇarakṣākhyā svarṇarekhābhiranvitā | sarit sā raivate bhūdhre vartate mokṣadāyinī ||84|| brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca bhrūṇahā gurutalpagaḥ | svarṇarekhājale snātvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||85|| ye ca kīṭapataṃgādyāḥ svarṇarekhājale mṛtāḥ | vṛkṣavallītarugulmāste’pi yānti parāṃ gatim ||86 || bhojaḥ sārasvataṃ vipraṃ stutvā vacanamabravīt | brahmā viṣṇurharaḥ sūryaṃ indro’gnirmarutāṃ gaṇāḥ ||87|| brahmacaryeṇa tapasā tvayā santoṣitāḥ prabho | tvayā saha mayā cāpi yātrārthaṃ raivate girau ||88|| kṛpā cet tarhi gantavyaṃ kṛtārthaśca bhavāmyaham | kiṃ grāhyaṃ kiṃ ca bhoktavyaṃ kiṃ deyaṃ kiṃ na dīyate ||89|| tīrthopavāsaḥ snānaṃ ca sandhyāsnānavidhikramaḥ | pūjā nidrā japo rātrau sarvaṃ saṃkṣepato vada ||1.149.90 || iti sārasvataḥ pṛṣṭho bhūbhṛtā prāha tadvidhim | dānādikaṃ phalaṃ sarvaṃ prāha vipro yathātatham ||9 1 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pūrvakṛtayuge bhojākhyarājñastatpatnyāśca mṛgānanāyāḥ saptajanmavṛttāntamukhena svarṇarakṣānadyā māhātmyavarṇananāmonapaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 149||
<1.150> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tato vipraḥ sārasvato mahāmuniḥ | saurāṣṭre raivatagireryātrābalaṃ jagād tam || 1 || saurāṣṭradeśe gantavyaṃ girau raivatake yadā | tadā gurubalaṃ vīkṣya kṛtvā sūryasya tarpaṇam ||2 || vāme pṛṣṭe ca kṛtvānyad dinaśuddhiṃ vilokya ca | candralagnagrahān dṛṣṭvā baliṣṭhān janmarāśitaḥ || 3 || śakunaṃ ca śubhaṃ buddhvā prasthātavyaṃ janaiḥ khalu | aśvinī revatī citrā dhaniṣṭhā samalaṃkṛtau || 4 || mṛgāśvicitrāpuṣyāśca mūlā hastā śubhāḥ sadā | kanyāpradāne yātrāyāṃ pratiṣṭhādiṣu karmasu || 5 || śukracandrau tu janmasthau śubhadau ca dvitīyake | śaśijñaśukrajīvāśca rāśau cātha tṛtīyake || 6 || bhaumamandaśaśāṃkārkā budhaḥ śreṣṭhaścaturthake | śukrajīvau pañcamau ca candraketusamāhitau || 7 || mandārkau ca kujaḥ ṣaṣṭhe gurucandrau ca saptame | jñaśukrāvaṣṭame śreṣṭhau navamastho guruḥ śubhaḥ || 8 || arkārkicandrā daśame ekādaśe’khilā grahāḥ | budho’tha dvādaśe caiva bhārgavaḥ sukhado bhavet || 9 || siṃhena makaraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kanyayā meṣa uttamaḥ | tulayā saha mīnastu kuṃbhena saha karkaṭaḥ || 1.150.1 0||| dhanuṣā vṛṣabhaḥ śreṣṭho mithunena ca vṛścikaḥ | etat ṣaḍaṣṭakaṃ prītyai bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 1 1|| caraḥ saumyau guruḥ kṣipro mṛduḥ śukro ravirdhruvaḥ | śaniśca dāruṇo jñeyo bhauma ugraḥ śaśī samaḥ || 12|| carakṣipraiḥ prayātavyaṃ praveṣṭavyaṃ mṛdudhruvaiḥ | dāruṇograiśca yoddhavyaṃ kṣatriyairjayakāṃkṣibhiḥ || 13|| nṛpābhiṣeko’gnikāryaṃ somavāre praśasyate | some tule pramāṇe ca kuryāccaiva gṛhādikam || 14|| saināpatyaṃ śauryayuddhaṃ śastrābhyāsaḥ kuje smṛtaḥ | siddhikāryaṃ ca mantraśca yātrā caiva budhe smṛtā || 15|| paṭhanaṃ devapūjā ca vastrādyābharaṇaṃ gurau | kanyādānaṃ gajārohaḥ śukre syāt samayaḥ striyāḥ || 16|| sthāpyaṃ gṛhapraveśaśca gajabandhaḥ śanau śubhaḥ | saptamopacayādyasthaścandraḥ sarvatra śobhanaḥ || 17|| śuklapakṣe dvitīyastu pañcamo navamastathā | sampūjyamāno lokaistu guruvad dṛśyate śaśī || 18|| janmasthaḥ kurute tuṣṭiṃ dvitīye nāsti nirvṛtiḥ | tṛtīye rājasanmānaṃ caturthe kalahāgamaḥ || 19|| pañcamena mṛgāṃkena strīlābho vai tathā bhavet | dhanadhānyāgamaḥ ṣaṣṭhe ratiḥ pūjā ca saptame ||1.150.20 || aṣṭame prāṇasandeho navame koṣasañcayaḥ | daśame kāryaniṣpattirdhruvamekādaśe jayaḥ |||21||| dvādaśena śaśāṃkena mṛtyureva na saṃśayaḥ | aśuklā pratipat śreṣṭhā dvitīyā candrasūnunā ||22|| tṛtīyā bhūmiputreṇa caturthī ca śanaiścare | gurau śubhā pañcamī syāt ṣaṣṭhī maṃgalaśukrayoḥ ||23|| saptamī somaputreṇa aṣṭamī kujabhāskarau | navamī candravāreṇa daśamī tu gurau śubhā ||24|| ekādaśyāṃ guruḥ śuddho dvādaśyāṃ ca punarbudhaḥ | trayodaśī śukrabhaumau śanau śreṣṭhā caturdaśī ||25|| paurṇamāsyapyamāvāsyā śreṣṭhā syācca bṛhaspatau | mūle’rkaḥ śravaṇe candraḥ proṣṭhapadyuttare kujaḥ ||26|| kṛttikāsu budhaścaiva gurau cātha punarvasuḥ | pūrvaphalgunī śukre ca svātiścaiva śanaiścare ||27|| ete cāmṛtayogāḥ syuḥ sarvakāryaprasādhakāḥ | haste’rkaśca guruḥ puṣye anurādhā budhe śubhā || 28|| rohiṇī ca śanau śreṣṭhā saumaṃ somena vai śubham | śukre ca revatī śreṣṭhā aśvinī maṃgale śubhā ||29|| eteṣu siddhiyogā vai sarvadoṣavināśakāḥ | kāryasiddhipradāścaiva tatra kāryaṃ samārabhet ||1.150.3 0|| aśvinīmatrarevatyo mṛgamūlā punarvasuḥ | puṣyā hastā tathā jyeṣṭhā prasthāne śreṣṭhamucyate || 31 || yoginyo’pi praboddhavyāḥ sanmukhe’tīva duḥkhadāḥ | brahmāṇī saṃsthitā pūrvaṃ pratipannavamītithau || 32|| māheśvarī cottare ca dvitīyādaśamītithau | pañcamyāṃ ca trayodaśyāṃ vārāhī dakṣiṇe sthitā |||33|| ṣaṣṭhyāṃ caiva caturdaśyāmindrāṇī paścime sthitā | saptamyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca cāmuṇḍā vāyugocare || 34|| aṣṭamyamāvāsyayoge mahālakṣmīśagocare | ekādaśyāṃ tṛtīyāyāmagnikoṇe tu vaiṣṇavī ||35|| dvādaśyāṃ ca caturthyāṃ tu kaumārī nairṛte tathā | yoginīsammukhe naiva gamanādi prakārayet ||36|| caturthī cāśubhā ṣaṣṭhī aṣṭamī navamī tathā | amāvāsyā pūrṇimā ca dvādaśī ca caturdaśī ||37|| dvādaśīṃ dahate bhānuḥ śaśī caikādaśīṃ dahet | kujo dahecca daśamīṃ navamīṃ ca budho dahet ||38|| aṣṭamīṃ dahati jīvaḥ saptamīṃ bhārgavo dahet | sūryaputro dahet ṣaṣṭhīṃ gamanādyāsu nāsti vai ||39|| pratipannavamīṣveva caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca | budhavāre ca prasthānaṃ dūrataḥ parivarjayet ||1.150.40 || meṣe karkaṭake ṣaṣṭhī kanyāyāṃ mithune’ṣṭamī | vṛṣe kuṃbhe caturthī ca dvādaśī makare tule ||41|| daśamī vṛścike siṃhe dhanurmīne caturdaśī | etā dagdhā na gantavyaṃ kila jīvādimānavaiḥ |||42|| viśākhātrayamāditye pūrvāṣāḍhātraye śaśī | dhaniṣṭhātṛtīyaṃ bhaume budhe vai revatītrayam ||43|| rohiṇyāditrayaṃ jīve śukre puṣyātrayaṃ tathā | śanivāre varjayecca uttarāphalgunītrayam ||44|| eṣa autpātiko yogo mṛtyurogādikaṃ bhavet | viṣkaṃbhe ghaṭikāḥ pañca śūle sapta prakīrtitāḥ ||45||| ṣaṭ gaṇḍe cātigaṇḍe ca nava vyāghātavajrayoḥ | vyatīpāte parīghe ca vaidhṛte ca dine dine ||46|| ete mṛtyuyutā hyeṣu sarvakarmāṇi varjayet | viśākhā cottarā trīṇi maghārdrā bharaṇī tathā ||47|| āśleṣā kṛttikāḥ caitāḥ prasthāne maraṇapradāḥ | tadetadvai vicāryaiva prasthānaṃ sukhadaṃ bhavet ||48|| pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ dvijaṃ veśyāṃ śukladhānyāni darpaṇam | dadhyājyaṃ madhulājām̐śca puṣpaṃ dūrvākṣatān sitān ||49|| vṛṣaṃ gajendraṃ turagaṃ jvaladagniṃ suvarṇakam | ūrṇa ca paripakvāni phalāni vividhāni ca ||1.150.50|| patiputravatīṃ nārīṃ pradīpaṃ maṇimuttamam | muktāṃ prasūnamālāṃ ca sadyomāṃsaṃ ca candanam ||5 1|| puro dṛśyanta etāni vastūni maṃgalāni vai | vipraḥ kanyā śavaṃ gauśca śaṃkho bherī vasundharā ||52| veṇuḥ strīḥ pūrṇakuṃbhaśca yātrāyāṃ darśane śubhāḥ | savye śivoṣṭrakharanakulakuṃbhaśavāḥ śubhāḥ |||23 || rājahaṃso mayūraśca khañjanaśca śukaḥ pikaḥ | pārāvataḥ śaṃkhacillaścakravākaśca māṃgalā ||54|| kṛṣṇasāraśca surabhiḥ camarīḥ śvetacāmaram | dhenurvatsaprayuktā ca patākā dakṣiṇe śubhāḥ ||55|| kārpāsauṣadhitailāni pakvāṅgārabhujaṅgamāḥ | muktakeśī raktamālyaṃ nagnādyaśubhamīkṣitam ||56|| hikkāgneye śokakarī dakṣiṇe hānidā matā | nairṛtye codvegakarī paścime miṣṭabhuktidā ||57|| vāyavye’rthapradā proktā uttare kalahaṃkarī | īśāne mṛtyudā ceti jñeyaṃ śubhāśubhaṃ phalam ||58|| tīrthe sadaiva gantavyaṃ sarve māsāśca śobhanāḥ | tithayaścottamāḥ sarvāḥ snānadānārcanādiṣu ||59|| vasante tīrthayātrāyāḥ prayāṇaṃ śreṣṭhamucyate | nigṛhya niyamān bhūtvā śuciḥ snāto jitendriyaḥ ||1.150.60 || gajavājirathān tyaktvā pādābhyāṃ yānti ye janāḥ | haṃsayuktavimānena yānti te kṛṣṇamandiram ||6 1 || ekabhaktena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca | bhikṣāhāreṇa toyena phalāhāreṇa vā yadi |||62|| upavāsena kṛcchreṇa śākāhāreṇa vā janāḥ | tīrthayātrāṃ prakurvanti teṣāṃ lokāstu śāśvatāḥ ||63|| yadvā yāti divaṃ devīgaṇaiḥ saṃvījito’rcitaḥ | anupānatpado yātrākartā yātyarkamaṇḍalam ||64|| mātaraṃ pitaraṃ deśaṃ bhrātṛsvajanabāndhavān | grāmaṃ bhūmiṃ gṛhaṃ tyaktvā kṛtvā cendriyasaṃyamam |||65|| gṛhītvā vaiṣṇavīṃ dīkṣāṃ raivataṃ yāti yo janaḥ | bhuktirmuktirbhavettasya dāmodaraprabhāvataḥ ||66|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne prasthānayātrādau śubhāśubhagrahanakṣatravārayoginīśakunādipradarśananāmā pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 150||
<1.151> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca tataḥ sārasvataḥ prāha rājānaṃ bhojapuṃgavam | miṣṭānnaṃ bhojanaṃ ramyaṃ pānamuccāvacaṃ śubham || 1 || pūjārhāṇi ca pātrāṇi puṣpāṇyupaskarāṇi ca | vastrāṇi dānayogyāni sugandhicandanāni ca || 2 || kamalāni vicitrāṇi svarṇarūpyādyalaṃkṛtīn | skandhe nidhāya padbhyāṃ ca yātrāṃ karoti yo janaḥ || 3 || arpayitvā ca haryagre’kṣayapuṇyamavāpnuyāt | gaṃgodakaṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ kuṃkumāgurucandanam || 4 || guggulaṃ bilvapatrāṇi dhattūrakusumaṃ tathā | pādacārī bhajan devaṃ skandhe svayaṃ nidhāya ca || 5 || bhavanāthaṃ tu yo gacched dṛṣṭvā nivedayettathā | svarṇanadyāṃ tathā snātvā dāmodaraṃ samarcayet || 6 || sarvabandhavinirmuktaḥ sa vai kailāsamāpnuyāt | gaṇo mukto bhavatyeva yāvadābhūtasamplavam || 7 || kalatramitraputrairvā bhrātṛbhiḥ sujanairjanaiḥ | suhṛtsambandhibhiścānyairyāti devaṃ smaram̐stu yaḥ || 8 || sa tanmaṇḍalasahitaḥ svargaṃ yātyādivākaram | devamūrtiṃ śubhāṃ kṛtvā rathasthāṃ supratiṣṭhitām || 9 || candanāgurukarpūrairarcitāṃ kuṃkumena ca | pūjayan vividhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpadīpādikaistathā || 1.151.10 || gītanṛtyaiḥ savāditrairhāsyairlāsyairanekadhā | dharitrīṃ kāṃcanaṃ gāṃ ca jalānnavasanāni ca || 11 || tṛṇendhane priyāṃ vāṇīṃ yacchan yāti tu raivate | dāmodare tathā bhaveśvare gatvārcayatyatha || 12|| svarṇavatyāṃ taḍāge vā kuṇḍe ca raivatīkṛte | snāti japati govindaṃ dadātyannāni bhūriśaḥ || 1 3|| tatra yacchati dānāni sarvasvāni ca yo janaḥ | devāṃganākaragrāhe gṛhīto nandane vane || 14|| gatvā bhuṃkte śubhān bhogān yāvadācandratārakam | tīrthe vipravacaḥ kṛtvā snātvā sandhyārcanādike || 15|| darbhāṃstilān haviṣyānnaṃ prayuñjyācchraddhayā tataḥ | agastaṃ bhṛṃgarājaṃ ca puṣpaṃ śatadalaṃ śubham || 16|| karpūrāguruśrīkhaṇḍaṃ kuṃkumaṃ tulasīdalam | tīrthe saṃkalpitaṃ martyaistadanantaṃ prajāyate || 17|| bilvapramāṇapiṇḍāni dadyādvai tīrthabhūmiṣu | tāmbūlaphalanaivaidyatiladarbhodakaistathā || 18|| māsāntare śuklapakṣe kṣayāhe mātṛpaitṛke | gajacchāyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ dravye prāpte dvijottame || 19|| gṛhe śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta pitṛṇāmṛṇamuktaye | gṛhācchataguṇaṃ nadyāṃ yā nadī yāti sāgaram ||1.151.20 || tato’nantaguṇaṃ devamandire devasannidhau | prabhāse puṣkare tīrthe gayāyāṃ piṇḍatārake ||21 || prayāge cātha gomatyāṃ bhāve dāmodare tathā | narmadāyāṃ tapatyāṃ ca kuryācchrāddhaṃ trivikrame |||22|| svarṇarakṣāpagāyāśca nārāyaṇahrade tathā | ojasvatyāṃ ca bhadrāyāṃ tathā śatrujitātaṭe ||23 || vāmanasthalakuṇḍāgre kuryācchrāddhaṃ naro yadi | sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ pitaro yānti sadgatim ||24|| santānamuttamaṃ labdhvā bhuktvā bhogānanuttamān | divyaṃ vimānamāruhya śrāddhakṛdyāti mokṣaṇam |||25|| jātakarmādiyajñeṣu vivāhe gṛhakarmaṇi | devapratiṣṭhāprārambhe kūpavāpyādikarmaṇi ||26|| tṛpyanti devatāḥ sarvā hṛṣyanti pitaro nṛṇām | vṛddhiśrāddhe kṛte gehe jāyate sarvamaṃgalam |||27|| kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca moho madyaṃ madādayaḥ | māyāmātsaryapaiśunyamaviveko’vicāritā || 28|| ahaṃkāro yadṛcchā ca cāpalyaṃ laulyamityapi | anyāyasādhanāyāsaḥ pramādo drohasāhase ||29|| ālasyaṃ dīrghasūtratvaṃ paradāropasevanam | ete doṣāḥ sadā tyājyāstīrthagāminarādinā || 1.151.3 0|| sa syādvai maṇḍanaṃ bhūmedeśasya nagarasya ca | śrīmān vidvān kulīnaḥ syāt sa tīrthaphalamaśnute || 31 || snānaṃ sandhyā japo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam | śrāddhaṃ devasya pūjā ca tyaktadoṣasya jāyate || 32||| utthāyotthāya snātavyaṃ pūjyau hariharau tathā | satyaṃ vācyaṃ hitaṃ kāryaṃ dānaṃ deyaṃ svaśaktitaḥ || 33||| parāpavādabhīrutvaṃ paradāravivarjanam | tairthikadoṣāgrāhitvaṃ sevanaṃ ca satāṃ mudā ||34|| pitṛmātṛgurūṇāṃ ca nāpriyaṃ manasā vahet | auṣadhaṃ śākamarthibhyo dātavyaṃ gṛhamedhinā || 36 || ekādaśī pañcadaśī caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca | amāyāṃ ca vyatīpāte saṃkrānto grahaṇeṣu ca || 36 || vaidhṛtau pitṛmātṝṇāṃ kṣayāhe śubhavāsare | yugamanvādidivase gṛhe kāryo mahotsavaḥ || 37|| tīrthe vā gamanaṃ kāryaṃ puṇyaṃ śataguṇaṃ bhavet | indriyāṇāṃ jayaḥ kāryo madyadyūtavivarjanam || 38 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ surapūjā dvijārcanam | sādhusādhvīprapūjā ca kartavyākṣayapuṇyadā || 39 || ekāpi goḥ pradātavyā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣitā | dogdhrī savastrā taruṇī savatsā sudvijāya ca ||1.151.40 || sādhave’nnasubhojyāni sādhvyai vastrādyalaṃkṛtiḥ | deyānyannāni vastūni yathā syādvai prasannatā || 41 || saptajanmasu pāpiṣṭha iha janmani cādhamaḥ | ekāṃ dadāti yo dhenuṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||4 2 || yadāsau nīyate baddho yamamārgeṇa kiṃkaraiḥ | tadā dhenuḥ samāgatya svaṃ putramiva rakṣati ||43 || vijitya huṃkṛtenaiva tān dūtān dūrataḥ kṛtān | gaurdātāraṃ samādāya yāti vai harimandiram ||44|| vṛṣo dharma iti proktastīrthe dānaṃ vṛṣasya ca | kartavyaṃ rakṣayed dharmo dātāraṃ nayate divam ||45 || grāsamātrāpi bhikṣā sattīrthe deyā gṛhasthitaiḥ | kuṃbhapatrādisiddhānnachatropānatkamaṇḍalum || 46 || aṃgulīyakavāsāṃsi datvā yāti naro divi | pānaṃ śrāntatṛṣārtāya kṣudhārtāyānnameva ca ||47 || nagnāya vastraṃ saṃdeyaṃ devyo nayanti taṃ divam | bhojanaṃ satataṃ deyaṃ yathāśaktyā ghṛtaplutam || 48 || śutpīḍā mahatī loke tasyānnaṃ bheṣajaṃ matam | tena sā śāntimāyāti cānnadānaṃ taduttamam ||49 || annaṃ vastraṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ takra śākaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu | patraṃ puṣpaṃ tathopānat kanthā yaṣṭiḥ kamaṇḍaluḥ || 1.151.5 0 || chatraṃ pātraṃ tathā vidyā pustakaṃ ca surārcanam | kanyākuśopanītāni bījauṣadhigṛhāṇi ca || 51 || ratnaṃ kṣetraṃ yajñapātraṃ yogapaṭṭaṃ ca pāduke | kṛṣṇājinaṃ buddhidānaṃ dharmadeśakathānakam ||52 || tīrthe gatvā bahu deyaṃ tena śreyo mahadbhavet | sarvapāpakṣayaṃ kṛtvā dātā yāti hareḥ padam || 53 || aśvamedhādibhiryajñairgayāyāṃ piṇḍadānataḥ | yatphalaṃ syānnṛṇāṃ tatsyād dṛṣṭe dāmodare bhuvi ||54|| ekādaśyāṃ kṛtasnāno devapūjāparo bhavet | paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya snātvā tīrthodakena ca ||55|| kuṃkumāguruśrīkhaṇḍakarpūrodakamiśritaiḥ | pūjayitvā tataḥ puṣpaiḥ śatapatraiḥ sugandhibhiḥ ||56|| mālatīkusumaiḥ śubhrairbahubhistulasīdalaiḥ | vastraṃ yajñopavītaṃ ca dhūpaṃ caiva pradhūpayet ||57|| dīpaṃ dadyād ghṛtenaiva tailenāpi ghṛtaṃ vinā | naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ dadyāt phalaṃ tāmbūlamityapi |||58|| prāsādapūjāṃ kuryācca dhvajadānādinā tathā | gāṃ savatsāṃ tato dadyāt saṃsārārṇavatāriṇīm |||59|| tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā gītavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ | vedapāṭhapurāṇaiśca vyākhyādivyakathānakaiḥ ||1.151.60|| devāgre jāgaraṃ kuryād dīpadyotitabhūmiṣu | saptadhānyamayān sapta parvatān dīpasaṃyutān ||61|| phalatāmbūlapakvānnapūjitān parikalpayet | vidvadbhiḥ śrotriyaiḥ śāntairbrāhmaṇaiḥ sādhubhistathā ||62|| sādhvībhiśca gṛhasthaiśca śrotavyā vaiṣṇavī kathā | evaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ rāgadveṣādivarjitaiḥ ||63|| kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrāvudite sūryamaṇḍale | pūrvāṃ sandhyāṃ kṛtasnānaḥ kṛtvā madhyāhnamācaret ||64|| devān pitṝn manuṣyām̐śca tarpitvā vidhipūrvakam | kṛtvā snānaṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca dānaṃ dadyāttu śaktitaḥ ||65|| devaṃ dāmodaraṃ puṣpadhūpādinā prapūjya ca | raivatīkuṇḍasalile snānaṃ kuryāt tataḥ punaḥ ||66 || rādhāderīdarśanaṃ vai kuryācca svarṇadījale | tata ārohaṇavāpyāṃ pragacchecca hanūmataḥ ||67|| darśanaṃ ca prakuryādvai jalaṃ pibet| tataḥ punaḥ | parvatārohaṇaṃ kuryād yadvāgacchet puraṃ prati ||68|| trievikramaraṇacchoḍadarśanaṃ saṃvidhāya ca | vividhāni ca dānāni bhojanādīni sarvathā ||69 || datvā kṛtvā pragacchecca svālayaṃ tīrthakārakaḥ | iti te tīrthakaraṇaṃ kathitaṃ mokṣadaṃ param ||1.151.70|| śrutvaitad bhojarājo’pi jagāma raivatācalam | dadarśa mukhyatīrthāni maṃgalāni vidhāya ca ||71 || bhavaṃ dāmodaraṃ svarṇarakṣāṃ mṛgānanāsthalīm | ambāṃ dattātreyarūpaṃ nārāyaṇahradaṃ tathā ||72|| raivatācalamālokya gaṃgāṃ gomukhikāṃ tathā | trivikramaraṇacchoḍamandiraṃ vāmanasthalīm ||73|| balermakhasthalīṃ bhadrāṃ tathā kuṃkumavāpikām | ojasvatīṃ somanāthaṃ suvarṇadvārikāṃ tathā ||74|| tīrthānyevaṃ vividhāni kṛtvā datvā mahīṃ ca gāḥ | suvarṇarajatādīni ratnābhūṣaṇakāni ca ||75|| vastrāṇyannāni viprebhyaḥ sādhusādhvībhya eva ca | dīnāndhakṛpaṇādibhyo datvā deyāni bhūriśaḥ ||76|| ājagāma skakaṃ rājyaṃ kānyakubjaṃ narādhipaḥ | svarājñyā saha yātrāyā mahotsavamakārayat ||77|| tāvad bhojasya dṛṣṭirvai divyābhūt puṇyayogataḥ | vaikuṇṭhaṃ cātha kailāsaṃ hariṃ haraṃ sapārṣadam ||78|| dadarśa suvimānaṃ ca divya mokṣakaraṃ tataḥ | pārṣadaiḥ sthāpitastatra sastrīko divyavigrahaḥ ||79|| yayau vaikuṇṭhamevāyaṃ mukto bhūtvā harerbalāt | ityuktaste camatkāro raivatasya priye rame ||1.151.80|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathamaṃ kṛtayugasantāne tīrthavidhidānādipradarśananāmaikapaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 151 ||
<1.152> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca tīrthe pālyām̐śca niyamān yamām̐śca vacmi padmaje | niyamānāṃ yamānāṃ ca pālanaṃ phaladaṃ bhavet || 1 || kāmakrodhavijetā yo lobhamohādivarjitaḥ | śraddhāluścāstikaḥ śuddhaḥ sa tīrthaphalabhāgbhavet || 2 || karapādodarajihvāmanaḥśiśnāni yasya hi | saṃyatāni bhaveyurvai sa tīrthaphalamaśnute || 3 || satyavāk suvrataḥ śāntaḥ sarveṣvātmopamadṛśiḥ | tapovidyākṛtaśuddhiḥ satīrthaphalamaśnute || 4 || tīrthe hyupoṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ kṣauraṃ śrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍakam | bhojanīyāḥ sādhusādhvyo dānaṃ deyaṃ tu bhāvataḥ || 5 || nārīṇāṃ pativatnīnāṃ kṣauraṃ naiva vidhīyate | parīkṣā bhojanīyānāṃ kartavyā naiva kenacit || 6 || tatratyadevatānāṃ ca kartavyaṃ mukhyamarcanam | bhūṣāvāsodravyapātraphalanaivedyavastubhiḥ || 7 || aśaktastu namaḥ kuryāt tathā sammārjanādikam | sādhucaraṇaśuśraṣāṃ sevāṃ prasannatāpradām || 8 || sādhavaḥ sevitā yena tanumānasavastubhiḥ | mahāpūjāphalaṃ tasya sarvaṃ tīrthaphalaṃ bhavet || 9 || sādhavastoṣitā yena sarvasvārpaṇasādhanaiḥ | sarvadānaphalaṃ tasya sādhurnārāyaṇo yataḥ || 1.152.1 0|| puṇyatīrtheṣu yatkāryaṃ kriyate sānusaṃgame | sahasraguṇitaṃ cāpyanantaphalakaraṃ bhavet || 1 1|| kṛtaṃ tīrthe svalpamapi tīrthabalādvivardhate | puṇyaṃ vivardhate nityaṃ pāpaṃ tu līyate sadā || 12|| tīrtha kṛtānāṃ jīvānāṃ pāpaleśo na vidyate | tārayati janān yasmāt tasmāt tattīrthamucyate || 13|| yadyat karoti sat tīrthe sarvaṃ tatpuṇyadaṃ bhavet | niyamena ca tīrthe vai sthātavyaṃ tanudhāribhiḥ || 14|| manaḥśuddhiṃ tathā sevāṃ satāṃ kuryāddhi tīrthakṛt | lubdhasya piśunasyātha krūrasya dābhikasya ca || 15|| malinasya ca caurasya nāstikasya śaṭhasya ca | nindakasya tathā drogdhurna syāt tīrthaphalaṃ kvacit || 16|| śārīramalasaṃtyāge mano na nirmalaṃ bhavet | doṣadṛṣṭiparityāge manastu nirmalaṃ bhavet || 17|| rāgadveṣau malarūpau tattyāge nirmalo bhavet | nārībhiśca narairvāpi tīrthe vīkṣyā tu divyatā || 18|| divyabhāvena svasyāntardivyatā vardhate’nvaham | divyāntaḥkaraṇe dhāryo bhagavān tīrthamaṇḍale || 1 9|| sa vai saṃtārayed bhaktaṃ nirmalaṃ puṇyabhājanam | ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryamanāgrahaḥ || 1.152.20|| śaucaṃ tapaśca santoṣaḥ svādhyāyo bhajanaṃ hareḥ | japaśca pūjanaṃ devadarśanaṃ śravaṇaṃ natiḥ |||21|| kartavyāni viśeṣeṇa pūrṇaṃ tīrthaphalaṃ bhavet | krodhastīrthe na kartavyaḥ puṇyaprajvālako hi saḥ |||22| tīrthe’nyasya na bhoktavyaṃ peyaṃ nānyasya vai kvacit | pratigrahaśca na grāhyastapastejoharo hi saḥ |||23|| laḍḍukairmauktikaiḥ ramyaiḥ kasārairghṛtapūrakaiḥ | saṃyāvapāyasāpūpaiḥ śaṣkulīkhājakādibhiḥ |||24|| parpikāpiṇḍakādyaiśca vyañjanairdvidalādibhiḥ | dadhidugdhaiśca takraiśca śrīkhaṇḍadaugdhasadrasaiḥ ||25|| ghṛtaśarkarasupakvaiścānyairbhakṣyasulehyakaiḥ | tarpaṇīyāḥ sādhuviprasādhvyaśca dīnabālakāḥ ||26||| pitarastena tṛptāḥ syustasya puṇyamanantakam | bhoktavyaṃ bhojanīyāśca tīrthasya phalamicchatā |||27|| vandhyaṃ tīrthaṃ na vai kuryāt yadi saukhyaṃ samīhate | jaḍatīrthāt cetanaṃ tu tīrthaṃ tīrthottamaṃ matam ||28|| santaḥ sādhvyo yoginaśca yatayo brahmacāriṇaḥ | te sarve cetanaṃ tīrthaṃ tallābhe sukṛtaṃ mahat ||29|| cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa tīrthasevā vidhīyate | taponiyamasatkāle phalaṃ tvanantakaṃ bhavet || 1.152.30 || alpāyāsān bahuphalān putralakṣmīpradāyakān | cāturmāsyavrataśreṣṭhān kurvataḥ phalamakṣayam ||3 1|| gāṃ spṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇaṃ natvā sampūjya sādhudaivatān | tapasvinaṃ yatiṃ śāntaṃ śrotriyaṃ brahmacāriṇam |||32|| mātāpitarau bhaginīṃ tatpatiṃ duhituḥ patim | bhāgineyaṃ ca dauhitraṃ mitrasambandhibāndhavān |||33|| sādhvīḥ satīśca kanyāśca dīnāndhakṛpaṇān janān | bālān vṛddhānāturām̐śca gāścātithīnanāthakān ||34|| bhikṣukān kṣudhitān śrāntān pathikān tīrthavāsinaḥ | bhojayitvā pātakaiḥ saṃmucyante gṛhamedhinaḥ ||35|| rājā gajāśvanakulasatīvṛṣamahīdharāḥ | ādarśakṣīravṛkṣānnapradāḥ sādhujanāstathā |||36|| jalasthalātmatīrthāni devamandiramūrtayaḥ | dṛṣṭamātrāḥ punantyete cāturmāsyavratasthitāḥ ||37|| vedadharmakathāṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā muktiparānnarān | smṛtvā lakṣmīṃ hariṃ śaṃbhuṃ śivāṃ gaṃgāṃ ca svarṇadīm ||38|| kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ viṣṇordatvā dānaṃ ca śaktitaḥ | tāmbūlaṃ kusumaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyaṃ tulasīdalam ||39|| gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca vādyaṃ ca vidhāya suramandire | mahodayamavāpnoti phalaṃ svargyaṃ ca mokṣadam ||1.152.40|| indriyāṇāṃ ca manasa aikāgryaṃ tapa uttamam | tadaikāgryaṃ vāsudeve kāryaṃ dhyānādinā janaiḥ ||41 || ṛṣayo munayaścāturmāsye jaihvaṃ rasaṃ drutam | jitvā tapaḥ prakurvanti tīrthayātrāphalāptaye ||42|| phalāhāraḥ payaḥpānaṃ caikabhuktamathāpi vā | śākatyāgo’thavā śākamātrāhārastilādanam ||43 || dadhiprāśo ghṛtatyāgaścaikānnabhojanaṃ tathā | māṣamudgādimātrasya bhojanaṃ vratameva vā ||44|| bhūśayanaṃ jalasnānaṃ tailābhyaṃgādivarjanam | bhajanaṃ pūjanaṃ mālājapaḥ śrīharikīrtanam ||45|| kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ nityamiṣṭadevasya darśanam | sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ tīrthe vrataṃ puṇyapradaṃ bahu ||46|| brāhmaṇaḥ sādhavaścārcyā bhojanīyāśca sadrasaiḥ | ṣoḍaśopacāravaryairnityaṃ kṛṣṇārhaṇaṃ vratam ||47|| sādhūnāṃ pūjanaṃ nityaṃ yadvā homo vrataṃ param | ghṛtaikṣavalavaṇādervarjanaṃ ca vrata matam ||48 || nityaṃ bhagavate’rpyaiva peyaṃ khādyaṃ ca tadvratam | kṛtena karmaṇā yena sādhavo bhagavām̐stathā ||49 || prīyeran tadvrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kartavyaṃ mokṣadaṃ yataḥ | mātāpitrorguroḥ sevā vratānāṃ vratamuttamam ||1.152.5 0 || patyuḥ sevā vrataṃ patnyāḥ patnītoṣaṃ pativratam | śiṣyavrataṃ guroḥ sevā śiṣyatoṣo gurorvratam ||5 1 || raivate kārtikavrataṃ kartavyaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ | vaṭatāle hariharakṣetre ca kapilāśrame ||52 || vrataṃ māsopavāsākhyamathavā cāndrakālikam | cāndrāyaṇaṃ vrataṃ kārya pūrṇimātastapaḥ śubham |||53 || āśvīnapūrṇimāyāṃ vai kavalā daśa pañca ca | kārtikakṛṣṇapratipaddine grāsāścaturdaśa ||54|| ekaikasya tithikramāddhrāso vai kavalasya ca | amāyāmupavāsaḥ syātpratipadyeka eva ca ||55|| grāsadvayaṃ dvitīyāyāmevamāpūrṇimāvadhi | grāsavṛddhiryathātithivṛddhi kāryaṃ ca tadvratam ||56 || grāsaścaikena yatnena galādho yāti tādṛśaḥ | na nyūno nādhiko vāpi vratārthe sammataḥ sadā ||57|| yadvānyat tīrthakartṝṇāṃ tapovratamudīryate | udayāstāvadhi divā jalakṛcchraṃ jale sthitiḥ || 58 || daśamyāṃ gomūtraśakṛdghṛtadugdhadadhigrahaḥ | ekādaśyāmupavāso harikṛcchravrataṃ hi tat ||5 9 || saptamītaḥ kramādgrāhyaṃ jalaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhighṛtam | ekādaśyāmupavāsaḥ kṛcchraḥ paitāmahastu saḥ || 1.152.60 || ṣaṣṭhītastridinaṃ dugdhapānaṃ tryahamupoṣaṇam | māhendrakṛcchra ityuktastīrthe kāryo viśeṣataḥ ||6 1 || tṛtīyātastryahaṃ bhojyaṃ nivārādi tatastryaham | yavādikaṃ tryahamupoṣaṇaṃ kṛcchraḥ sa vaiṣṇavaḥ ||6 2|| pañcadinaṃ payaḥpānaṃ pañcāhaṃ dadhibhojanam | ekādaśyāmupavāso bhāskarakṛcchra ucyate ||6 3 || pañcamītaḥ kramāt bhājīṃ yavān śākaṃ dadhi kṣīram | ghṛtaṃ jalamekādaśyām ṛṣikṛcchraḥ sa ucyate ||64|| palāśabilvadarbhābjodumbaraparṇasuśṛtam | payaḥ peyaṃ pratipadaḥ ṣaṣṭhyā kuryādupoṣaṇam || 65|| tadidaṃ vratamāgneyakṛcchrākhyaṃ samudīritam | saptamītaḥ payobilvāṃbujamṛṇālabhakṣaṇam ||66 || ekādaśyāmupavāso lakṣmīkṛcchra udīritaḥ | ekādaśadineṣveva parṇādaḥ parṇakṛcchrakṛt || 67|| tryahaṃ prātastryahaṃ sāyaṃ tryahaṃ bhojyamayācitam | tryahaṃ copavaset kṛcchraḥ prājāpatya udīritaḥ ||68 || dvādaśāhopavāsaistu pārākakṛcchra ucyate | phalamātragrahaṇena phalakṛcchraḥ prakīrtyate ||69 || jalamātragrahaṇena jalakṛcchraḥ sa ucyate | dalamātragrahaṇena dalakṛcchrastathocyate ||1.152.7 0 || puṣpamātragrahaṇena puṣpakṛcchraḥ prakīrtyate | bījamātragrahaṇena bījakṛcchraḥ sa bhaṇyate ||7 1 || tilamātragrahaṇena caṇakagrahaṇena ca | bharjitataṇḍulagrāhe tattatkṛcchraḥ sa ucyate ||72|| pakvakṛcchraścāmakṛcchraḥ saktukṛcchraudanavrate | kārtike śuklapakṣe te kṛcchrāḥ kāryā vidhānataḥ ||73 || tattadbhagavato bhaktyā sahitā eva sarvathā | bhuktimuktiphaladāste’nyathā tu svargadā matāḥ ||74|| kṛcchramadhye bhavenmūrchā gokṣīraṃ pāyayettadā | jalaṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ dugdhaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhi ||75 || takraṃ tailaṃ śarkarādi munyannaṃ śākamabdhijam | karpūraṃ tvaṅlavaṃgailātiktamarīcamauṣadham ||76 || mukhaśuddhikaradravyamārdrakaṃ kvāthamityapi | caturviśatitattvānyavrataghnāni bhavanti hi || 77 || athavāyācitaṃ bhaikṣyamapakvāśanameva vā | śākatyāgaḥ phalatyāgo rasatyāgo’nnasutyajiḥ ||78 || kṣāratyāgo daugdhavastutyāga aikṣavasutyajiḥ | vratānyetāni sūktāni bhuktimuktikarāṇi vai ||7 9 || tīrthe kāryāṇi caitāni varṣāsu kārtike’thavā | annadānaṃ jaladānaṃ vastradānaṃ sahāyakṛt ||1.152.8 0 || yānadānaṃ bhuvo dānaṃ kanyādānaṃ gavārpaṇam | svarṇadānaṃ tiladānaṃ dīpadānaṃ gṛhārpaṇam ||8 1 || evaṃ svāpekṣitaṃ sarvaṃ dātavyaṃ punaricchatā | ramādāmodarasyāpi pūjanaṃ vratamucyate ||8 2|| ketakījātyagastīnāṃ kusumairambujairapi | kamalaistulasīpatrairlakṣeṇa pūjayeddharim ||8 3 || patre patre ca kusume’śvamedhaphalamāpnuyāt | dhātrīphalarasāktāṃgo dhātrīphalasubhojanaḥ ||84 || dhātrīphalabhūṣitāṃgo dhātrīchāyāsamāśritaḥ | dāmodaraṃ samabhyarcya vrajennārāyaṇaṃ padam ||85|| deyaṃ ākāśadīpaśca devālaye niśāmukhe | pakvānnāni pradeyāni devāya dhanibhiḥ sadā ||86 || gṛhṇīyāt kārtike dīkṣāṃ mahābhāgavatīṃ janaḥ | hareḥ padārpitāṃ mālāṃ tulasījāṃ gale dharet ||87|| sā vyaktirmucyate nūnaṃ janmasaṃsārabandhanāt | ekenāpi vratenorje cāturmāsyaphalaṃ labhet ||88|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pālanīyayamaniyamadānakṛcchravratādinirūpaṇanāmā dvipaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 152||
<1.153> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca vastrāpathasya vāyavye koṇe divyaṃ sarovaram | tasya paścimadigbhāge vanaṃ gahanabhūruham || 1 || bilvavṛkṣamayaṃ tatra madhye liṃgaṃ tu mṛnmayam | tatraiko lubdhakaḥ prāpto vasante jalakāṃkṣayā || 2 || pippalasya drumasyādhaḥ samāgatya vyavasthitaḥ | mūle kṣaṇaṃ tu viśramya jalaṃ pātuṃ ca gacchati || 3 || tāvattena tadā dṛṣṭau puruṣau kṛṣṇapāṇḍurau | pītāmbaracarmavastrau sukeśasujaṭādharau || 4 || kaustubhamuṇḍakadharau cakratriśūlahastakau | vṛndārudrākṣamālau ca padmanetra trinetrakau || 5 || tilakacandrakabhālau padmāsatīprasevitau | patattrivāsukiyuktau kambunīlābhasadvalau || 6 || divyau poṣāntakarūpau jīvanivṛttiyatnakau | satvatamaḥparākrāntau vyomamārgāvalambinau || 7 || bilvavanaṃ prati yātau yāvat paśyati lubdhakaḥ | tāvattāvaddṛśyabhāvaṃ liṃge ca prastare gatau || 8 || śveto liṃge’bhavalluptaḥ kṛṣṇastu prastare gataḥ | lubdhakaśca tadāścaryayukto jagāma tatsthale || 9 || tāvalliṃgaṃ mṛnmayaṃ ca viṣṇumūrtiṃ śilāmayīm | dṛṣṭvā tu lubdhakastatra jalapānaṃ vihāya ca ||1.153.10|| tatraiva susthito devau cintayam̐statra bhāvataḥ | kṣudhitastṛṣitaḥ sāyamevameva vyavasthitaḥ ||11|| māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ sāyaṃ vṛttamidaṃ yadā|| nirjane tatra tau devau saṃsmṛtya ca punaḥ punaḥ ||12|| lubdhako bilvapatrāṇi padmāni sarasastathā | samādāyārpayatyetau liṅgaviṣṇū bhajan muhuḥ ||13|| paścājjalaṃ parigṛhya snāpitau puṣpapūjitau | vanditau tāvatā rātryā madhye tau nīlapāṇḍurau ||14|| tasmādeva samudbhūtau puruṣau divyavigrahau | prāhatustaṃ lubdhakaṃ tau yasmādatra vanāntare ||15|| tvayāgatyādya divase bilvapadme samarpite | etatpūjāprabhāveṇa dagdhānyaṃhāṃsi te tathā ||16|| ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ svargaṃ va sa devaśarīrakaḥ | lubdhakastvaṃ bhava devaḥ śivarātriprapūjanāt ||17|| śivarātrervratayogāt śivarātri prajāgarāt | pippalādhonivāsācca viṣṇubhakto bhaviṣyasi ||18|| evaṃ varaṃ pradatvaiva tirobhūtau harirharaḥ | tāvat tatra vimānaṃ surukmavarṇaṃ śaśiprabham ||19|| avātaradvyomamārgād apsarobhiḥ suśobhitam | sarvasmṛddhisamāyuktaṃ dāsadāsīnivāsitam ||1.153.20|| devyaḥ prāha tadā taṃ vai lubdhakaṃ puṇyaśālinam | āgaccha kānta susvargaṃ vayaṃ klṛptāśca te’ṅganāḥ ||21|| bhavān devo’sti sampannaḥ śivaviṣṇuprapūjanāt | māghe some caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ jāgare kṛte ||22|| tadetallabhyate sarvaṃ samāroha gṛhāṇa ca | evaṃ divyāṃganāstaṃ ca lubdhakaṃ kāntameva ha ||23|| kṛtvāvimānamāropya jagmurdivaṃ hareḥ puram | indro’pi taṃ samālokya tadātyantasuvismitaḥ ||24|| lubdhakaśca tadā pṛṣṭaḥ kena puṇyena labdhavān | uktavān sa tadā śaivarātryāṃ tayostu darśanam ||25|| vrataṃ pūjāṃ yathāvṛttaṃ tatsarvaṃ devarūpavān | tataḥ punaḥ samāyāte māgha kṛṣṇe caturdaśe ||26|| dine cendraḥ samāyāto lakṣmi devi dharātale | asaṃkhyadevadevībhirbhavaṃ natvā ca mādhavam ||27|| pūjayāmāsa vidhinā vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ cakāra saḥ | kiṃ dānairbahubhirdattaiḥ kiṃ vrataiḥ kiṃ surārcanaiḥ ||28|| kiṃ yajñaiḥ kiṃ tapobhiśca brahmacaryeṇa kiṃ tathā | gayāpiṇḍapradānena prayāgamaraṇena kim ||29|| someśvare sarasvatyāṃ somaparvaṇi kiṃ gataiḥ | kurukṣetre gataiḥ kiṃ syād rāhugraste divākare ||1.153.30|| tulāsuvarṇadānena vedapāṭhena kiṃ bhavet | sarvapāpakṣayo yena vṛṣotsargeṇa tena kim ||31|| godānaṃ kiṃ karotyeva tiladānaṃ karotu kim | ayane viṣuve caiva saṃkrāntau kīdṛśaṃ phalam ||32|| māghe māsi caturdaśyāṃ yādṛśaṃ jāgare kṛte | akṣayyaṃ phalamāpnoti mahendraḥ prāptavān phalam ||33|| vāmanaṃ trivikramaṃ ca dāmodaraṃ bhaveśvaram | yathāśāstraṃ pūjayitvā vrataṃ kṛtvā tathā hariḥ ||34|| nārāyaṇe hade snātvācamya gomukhato jalam | ambāṃ nāthaṃ ca dattātreyaṃ namaskṛtya vāsavaḥ ||35|| uttarābhimukhaṃ gatvā viśrāntimāpa vai kṣaṇam | tatra cendreśvaraṃ liṃga sthāpitaṃ devabhūbhṛtā ||36|| vāsavena pūjitaṃ tad devībhiḥ snāpitaṃ tathā | sākṣādindrasya deveśo bhavo dṛṣṭipathaṃ gataḥ ||37|| viṣṇurdevastathā tatra vyadṛśyata caturbhujaḥ | indreṇa sthāpito viṣṇuścaturbhujastathā sthale ||38|| pūjito bhojitaścaiva nīrājitaśca vanditaḥ | viṣṇuḥ prāha tadendraṃ tvaṃ brahmā janmāntare bhava ||39|| anyabrahmāṇḍarājyaṃ vai kṛtvā vaikuṇṭhamāpnuhi | itīndrastadvaraṃ prāpya pratiṣṭhāpya haraṃ harim ||1.153.40|| svargaṃ jagāma deveśaḥ prativarṣaṃ prayāti saḥ | śivarātrivratavantaṃ vastrāpathanivāsinam ||41|| nārāyaṇahṛde snāntaṃ dāmodaraprasevinam | bhaveśvarasya sadbhaktaṃ trivikramaprapūjakam ||42|| netuṃ varaṃ tathā kartuṃ samāyānti varāṃganāḥ | varaṃ draṣṭumindravāsād varayanti parasparam ||43|| śaṃbhunārāyaṇasamo divyo me bhavatātpatiḥ | mamāyaṃ na tavāstyeṣaḥ patirvai puruṣottamaḥ ||44|| vṛkṣāḥ kīṭāḥ pataṃgā vā paśavaḥ pakṣiṇastathā | mriyante te viṣṇusamā bhūtvā svargaṃ prayānti hi ||45|| vastrāpathe tadā tāṃstān patiṃ kurvanti devikāḥ | prāpya devaṃ śaṃbhusamaṃ viṣṇurūpaṃ patiṃ ca tāḥ ||46|| prahasanti ca gāyanti nṛtyanti kīrtayanti ca | jayaṃ vadanti nayanti sukhaśayyāṃ ca taṃ suram ||47 nandane’pi vane devyaḥ pṛcchāṃ kurvanti taṃ suram | vada kena prabhāveṇa devo divyo bhavānabhūt ||48|| tadā vakti sa devo vai vastrāpathaprabhāvataḥ | devā bhavanti divyāstat tīrthaṃ muktiṃ dadātyapi ||49|| airāvataṃ samāruhya yadāyāto maheśvaraḥ | ūrjayantagirermūrdhni gajarājaḥ sma tiṣṭhati ||1.153.50|| tadagre caraṇaṃ hastī dadau mūrdhni sa kāraṇāt | tenākrānto girivarastoyaṃ susrāva nirmalam ||51|| gajapādodbhavaṃ vāri jātaṃ tadvai sadā sthiram | iti kṛtaṃ surendreṇa tairthikānāṃ hitārthakam ||52|| atha cottaradigbhāge dhanadena pratiṣṭhitam | dhanadeśvaramityākhyaṃ liṃgaṃ tīrthaṃ sukhapradam ||53|| triśūlinī tathā devī pārvatī tatra rājate | bhavasya nirṛte koṇe gaṇo hairambasaṃjñitaḥ ||54|| yamena sthāpitaṃ yameśvaraṃ bāṇaṃ tu vartate | citraguptasthāpitaṃ vai citragupteśvaraṃ tathā ||55|| prajāpatiścakāroccaiḥ kedāreśaṃ tu paścime | parvate raivate śrṛṃge nimināthaśivastathā ||56|| bhavasya dakṣiṇe bhāge nṛsiṃhaḥ śrīharistathā | sthāpitau śrīvāmanena pūjanīyau viśeṣataḥ ||57|| samprāpya mānuṣaṃ janma jñātvā haraṃ hariṃ tathā | śivarātrirvāmanadvādaśī kāryāmumukṣubhiḥ ||58|| puṇyadā saukhyadā proktā bhuktimuktipradāyinī | dvādaśābdaṃ vratametatkartavyaṃ vārṣikaṃ janaiḥ ||59|| jīvitaṃ caṃcalaṃ nṝṇāṃ kartavyaṃ prātimāsikam | pratimāsaṃ śivarātrerdvādaśyāśca vrataṃ caret ||1.153.60|| vighnaśca jāyate madhye yadi vā daivayogataḥ | na bhaved vratabhaṃgaśca samāptaṃ tatkṛtaṃ matam ||61|| kṛṣṇāyāṃ tu caturdaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ ca kṛtāhnikaḥ | gṛhṇīyād vrataniyamaṃ snāyānnadyāṃ hrade śubhe ||6|| tailābhyaṃgo na kartavyo na kāryā rājasī kriyā | tīrthasevā prakartavyā sādhusevā sukhāvahā ||63|| devasevā prakartavyā brahmacaryaparāyaṇaiḥ | rātrau devāgrato gatvā kartavyāḥ sapta parvatāḥ ||64|| pakvānnaphalatāmbūlapuṣpadhūpādipūjitāḥ ghṛtadīpaḥ prakartavyaḥ pāpanāśanahetave ||65|| divā vā niśi sandhyāyāṃ dīpaḥ kāryaḥ svaśaktitaḥ | divyo dīpaḥ prakartavyaḥ phalaṃ tasya mahanmatam ||66|| kiṃcitprakāśamātreṇa devāstuṣyanti sarvathā | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ gītavāditrapūrvakam ||67|| śivarātricaritraṃ ca vāmanadvādaśīvratam | śrotavyaṃ ca bhajanāni kartavyāni tu maṇḍalaiḥ ||68|| rātrau deyāni dānāni vrate jāgaraṇe tathā | punaḥ snānaṃ prabhāte ca pūjyau hariharāvubhau ||69|| sādhavaḥ pūjanīyāśca bhojanācchādanādibhiḥ | tapasvināṃ pradātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ gṛhamedhibhiḥ ||1.153.70|| dvādaśāṣṭau catasraḥ ṣaḍ bhojanīyā viśeṣataḥ | eko’pi brahmavettā vā brahmacārī tu pūjitaḥ ||71|| sahasrāṇāṃ samo bhaktyā gṛhe saṃpūjito bhavet | akṣāralavaṇaiścānnairbhoktavyaṃ prākdine svayam ||72|| putramitrakalatrāṇāṃ dātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ tathā | anena vidhinā kāryā dvādaśī śivarātrikā ||73|| vāmanastu svayaṃ tuṣyet śivastuṣyetmuhuḥ punaḥ | vratānte gauḥ pradātavyā kṛṣṇā vatsayutā śubhā ||74|| savastrābharaṇā divyā ghaṇṭāśrṛṃgādiśobhitā | gurave dakṣiṇā deyā brāhmaṇebhyaśca śaktitaḥ ||75|| tapasvibhyo vitīryānnaṃ deyaṃ kṣamāpayettathā | evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktastasya pāpaṃ na vidyate ||76|| puṇyātmā vimalo bhūtvā bhuktvā bhogānanuttamān | santānamuttamaṃ labdhvā śāntiṃ labdhvaihikīṃ tathā ||77|| divyaṃ vimānamārūḍho divyastrīpariveṣṭitaḥ | gītavāditranirghoṣairnīyate lokamaiśvaram ||78|| māsi bhādre śuklapakṣe dvādaśyāṃ śravaṇākhyabhe | budhe madhyāhnasamaye vāmanastvaditerabhūt ||79|| ekādaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ ca phalāhāro vidhīyate | ekādaśyāmupavāso dvādaśyāṃ naktameva vā ||1.153.80 pūjanārthaṃ tadā kuryāt vāmanārcāṃ tu pauraṭīm | hrasvāṃ sajaṭāṃ chatradaṇḍakamaṇḍalūyutām ||81|| pītāmbarābharaṇāḍhyāṃ puṣpākṣatādibhistataḥ | suṣoḍaśopacārairvai vāmanaṃ saṃprapūjayet ||82|| maṇḍale sarvatobhadre madhyāhne pūjayettu tam | yathālabdhopacāraiśca bhaktyā pañcāmṛtādibhiḥ ||83|| aditiṃ kaśyapaṃ cendraṃ sakuṭumbaṃ prapūjayet | ghṛtakhaṇḍādimiṣṭānnaṃ naivedyaṃ cārpayet śubham ||84|| vāmanasyāvatārasya caritrāṇi tu gāpayet | trayodaśyāṃ tu miṣṭānnaistarpayet kṣudhitān bahūn ||85|| māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ mahādevo mahāniśi | viṣṇośca brahmaṇormadhye śrīhareḥ kiraṇātmakaḥ ||86|| śivaliṃgātmako jātaḥ koṭisūryasamaprabhaḥ | adṛśya sa vai liṃge mahādevastṛtīyakaḥ ||87|| brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ sṛṣṭikāle hyabhūdidam | caturdaśyāṃ mahādevaṃ citravāsāṃsi dhārayet ||88|| satīṃ śāṭīṃ sucitrāṃ ca pauraṭābharaṇāni ca | dhārayetpūjayet prītyā sakuṭumbaṃ maheśvaram ||89|| prapāṭhayedrudrasūktaṃ tvabhiṣekapuraḥsaram | niśīthe pūjayet śaṃbhuṃ bhaṃgādugdhaphalacchadaiḥ ||1.153.90|| mallikākundapuṣpaiśca kanakaiḥ karavīrakaiḥ | vastubhiḥ ṣoḍaśavidhairarcayeccānyavastubhiḥ ||91|| naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ dadyād deśakālānusārataḥ | tadā caikātmapadyāni gāpayerddhārarudrayoḥ ||92|| dānāni vidhinānyeva dadyādraratnāni bhūriśaḥ | dvitīye divase bhojyotsavaṃ kuryānmahattamam ||93|| evaṃ harerharasyāpi vrataṃ kuryāttu raivate | kārtike māghamāse ca yātrāṃ kuryāttu mokṣadām ||94 kailāso viṣṇulokaśca mokṣaśca tasya niścitaḥ | naro vā pramadā vāpi vratena mokṣamāpnuyāt ||95|| sakāmā pramadā tena ramā vā pārvatī bhavet | akāmā pramadā tena muktiṃ yātyeva dhāmani ||96|| ūrje pradakṣiṇā kāryā savratā sarvamānavaiḥ | māghe tu pūjanaṃ dānaṃ savrataṃ raivatācale ||97|| kartavyaṃ tena pṛthvyāśca prakramaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet | trayastriṃśatprakoṭīnāṃ devānāṃ pūjanaṃ bhavet ||98|| vandhyau māsau na netavyau ūrjamāghau mumukṣubhiḥ | vandhyatve sarvavandhyatvaṃ bodhyaṃ mānavajanmanaḥ ||99|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne lubdhakasya hariharadarśanottaramindreśvaraviṣṇupratiṣṭhānaṃ gajapadaṃ dhaneśvaratriśūlinīyameśvaracitragupteśvaranṛsiṃhatīrthāni ca vāmanadvādaśīśivarātryorvratamahimā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tripaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||153||
<1.154> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi maṇivrāte raivate divyataijase | mandarādriḥ samāyātaḥ svarṇapāṣāṇamiśraṇaḥ || 1 || divye tejomaye tatrāntargatvā sthūlabhāvataḥ | militvā saṃsthitastena maṇestejo na dṛśyate || 2 || kumudādristathā tatrāyāto raivatake girau | so’pyantarbhūya sthaulyena vartate raivatācale || 3 || śṛṇu divyāṃ kathāṃ tāṃ vai pūrvakṛtayugodbhavām | purā kṛtayuge sarve sapakṣāḥ parvatāḥ kṛtāḥ || 4 || uḍḍayanto mahākāyā nipatanti yadṛcchayā | merumandarakailāsā brahmaṇā vāritāḥ sthirāḥ |||9 || anye tu vāritāścāpi sthāyino na yadābhavan | tadendreṇa svavajreṇa pakṣāsteṣāṃ nikṛntitāḥ || 6 || merordakṣiṇaśṛṃge tu kumudo nāma parvataḥ | divyaṃ sapakṣaḥ sauvarṇo divyodyānasamṛddhimān || 7 || sarvā vaikuṇṭhasadṛśī sthalī smṛddhā suśobhanā | tatropari purī divyā vaiṣṇavī viṣṇunā kṛtā || 8 || tanmadhye ca mahān viṣṇo prāsādo ramayā yutaḥ | meroḥ śṛṃge mandarākhye purī śivasya śobhanā || 9 || sauvarṇā ca sabhā tatra bhavānī modate sadā | brahmaṇaścāpi nagarī prāsādaśca supauraṭaḥ || 1.154.10|| ratnahīrakamaṇyāḍhyaḥ śṛṃge tasyāruṇācale | vartate yatra te devāstrayaḥ kurvati mantraṇām || 1 1|| kumude vaiṣṇave sthāne sauvarṇā vallayo’bhavan | puṣpāṇyapi piśaṃgāni sauvarṇāni ca saurabhaḥ || 1 2|| sugandho dīyate nityaṃ puryāṃ pauṣpaḥ suvāyunā | vṛkṣāścāpi sugandhāḍhyapatramañjarikānvitāḥ || 13 || sugandhaṃ vāhayantyeva pratisaudhaṃ ca vāyavaḥ | ekadā bhagavān rudraḥ kumude tu samāgataḥ || 14|| gṛhāgataṃ haraṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇunā paripūjitaḥ | lakṣmyā ca pūjitā gaurī harṣitā satkṛtā hyati || 15|| ekāsanopaviṣṭau tau mantrayantau parasparam | tāvadvai kumudastatra mandaraścāpi parvataḥ || 16|| nararūpaṃ sudhṛtvā vai sevāyāṃ samupāgatau | śaṃbhuḥ prāha hariṃ tatra balistu balavān yataḥ || 17|| tvayā neyastu sutalaṃ pṛthvītaḥ sarvathā hare | vāmanaṃ rūpamāsthāya girau tu raivatācale || 18|| mayāpi tatra gantavyaṃ girau vai raivatācale | baleḥ sutale vāsaṃ ca kārayitvā tu chadmanā || 19|| punaścātrāgamiṣyāmaḥ kṛtakāryau divaukasām | saṃprāha mādhavastam om tāvattau parvatau mudā ||1.154.20 || kumudamandarau hariharau prārthayataḥ puraḥ | āvāṃ saha gamiṣyāvastatra yatra harirharaḥ ||2 1|| tathāstviti varaṃ prāpya bhūbhṛtau tau tirogatau | hariharau sapatnīkau jagmaturvedhasaṃ prati |||22|| aruṇācalaśikhare purī yatra prajāpateḥ | baleḥ sutalavāsārthaṃ kṛtvā vai mantraṇāṃ tataḥ ||23|| tau pratyājagmatuḥ svasvapuryāṃ svasvagirau punaḥ | prāpte tu samaye viṣṇurvāmanaḥ saṃbabhūva ha ||24|| jagāma ca baleryajñe śaṃkaro’pi jagāma ca | saurāṣṭre raivate deśe tadā kumudamandarau || 25 || āyayatuḥ sapakṣau tāvuḍḍayitvāntarīkṣagau | tāvanyān bahunakṣatragaṇānākṛṣya vegataḥ || 26|| ājagmatuḥ svarṇarekhānadīsthe raivatācale | tadā tayostadanyāyaṃ jñātvā deveśvaraḥ svayam || 27|| gṛhītvā ca svakaṃ vajraṃ pakṣanāśanahetave | vimānavaramāruhya jagāma yatra tau girī ||28|| yāvad vajraṃ prahiṇoti tāvat tau parvatau muhuḥ | prāñjalī prāhaturdevau rakṣaṇāya harācyutau ||29|| drāgevendraḥ stambhitaśca savajrahastakastadā | mā hantavyāvimāvadrī prāhatustaṃ harācyutau ||1.154.30 || indrastau prārthayāmāsa staṃbhanasya vimuktaye | varayāmāsa kumudamandaroḍḍayanakṣayam ||3 1 || tathāstviti varaṃ datvā mahendrastaṃbhanaṃ tadā | nivārya ca kumudādriṃ mandarādriṃ tu raivate ||32|| taijase’drau hariharau sthāpayāmāsatuḥ sadā | ambāyā mandaraḥ so’yaṃ kumudastu samantataḥ |||3 3 || kamalākāratāṃ prāpto dvādaśapatrabhedataḥ | tāvimau parvatau śailau dṛśyete taijase maṇau || 34|| raivate taijase tattve pārthivau tau niṣedatuḥ | tatra dāmodaro viṣṇurbhavaḥ śaṃbhurniṣedatuḥ ||35|| brahmāruṇācalaṃ nītvā samājagāma tatra vai | mandarāt pūrvadigbhāge’sthāpayat so’ruṇācalam || 36|| tatra brahmā svakaṃ vāsaṃ kṛtvovāsa kamaṇḍalum | yatra vai mandare kuṇḍe babhāra sa jalāśayaḥ || 37|| jātaḥ kamaṇḍalukuṇḍastīrthamakṣayapuṇyadam | aruṇādrau prathame tu śṛṃge brahmā hyuvāsa yat || 38|| sthala tad brahmakuṭyākhyaṃ jātaṃ tīrthaṃ tu mokṣadam | aruṇādrau dvitīye ca dattātreyo mahān prabhuḥ || 39 || dāruṇaṃ vai tapastepe tīrthaṃ mokṣakaraṃ ca tat | evaṃ vedhohariharāstiṣṭhanti revatāśrite ||1.154.40 || mandare kumude caivāruṇādrau prakṣiṇi priye | prāpte laye gamiṣyanti merau tai parvatāstrayaḥ ||41|| sapakṣā vai gamiṣyanti tāvat sthāsyanti tatra vai | teṣu triṣu trayo devāstrayastriṃśacca koṭayaḥ ||42|| devā vasanti tatrāpi rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ priye | raivatasya prakramaṇo kṛtaṃ merupradakṣiṇam ||43|| raivatasya pūjane ca kṛtaṃ meroḥ prapūjanam | raivatasya darśane tu kṛtaṃ merośca darśanam ||44|| triṃśatkrośaṃ raivatādriṃ ye prayānti pradakṣiṇam | kṛtaṃ merośca pṛthvyāśca pradakṣiṇaṃ tu tairiha ||45|| mandarāruṇayoryaistu kṛtaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ tu taiḥ | pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtaṃ satyakailāsābhidhalokayoḥ ||46|| kumudasya dvādaśaparvatānāṃ tu pradakṣiṇam | yena kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ tena vaikuṇṭhasya pradakṣiṇam ||47|| yadā devāstrayaścātra nivāsāya samāgatāḥ | naranarāyaṇau tatra boriyākhye vane gatau ||48|| brahmakamaṇḍalukuṇḍād gaṃgā guptā tu jāmbavī | patatyadho boriyākhye bhūgate badrikāśrame ||49|| naranārāyaṇau sarvarṣibhiryuktau tu tāpasau | janādṛśyau hi vartete dṛśyete puṇyaśālibhiḥ ||1.154.5 0|| dakṣiṇe mandarādgaṃgāmūle tau vasataḥ sadā | uttare mandarāt tatra bhavantyāmravanāni vai ||5 1 || vaikuṇṭhātparamād vāryāvaraṇasthāt samāgataḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ sītāpatiścāmravanaiḥ saha ||52|| ātmā muktāḥ śāśvatā vai sarvadā phalaśālinaḥ | sughaṭāpatraśākhābhiḥ sāketānāṃ niketanam ||5 3|| sughaṭṭaṃ ca vanaṃ tatra sītāvanamitīritam | lakṣmaṇasya vanaṃ rāma vanaṃ kīśavanaṃ tathā ||14|| sītāpaṭī vanakṣmā ca divyā dhāmasamāsti sā | yatra sūryo na vai bhāti na bhāti śaśitārakam ||55 || vidyuto yatra no bhānti hyagnirbhāti kutastadā | tādṛśaṃ tanmahādivyajalaprasravaṇānvitam ||56|| svarṇarūpyagairikādidhātubhūkhanikānvitam | sarvartusukhadaṃ divyaṃ viśālaṃ vanamasti yat ||57|| śāśvate tatra sākete vane prasravaṇātmikā | sarayūrbhinnasalilanirjharaṇairvahatyapi |||58|| hanumān vartate tatra vane rakṣaṇakāraṇāt | tīrthametat mahat proktaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ param ||59|| pūrve ca raivate bhāge’ruṇācalasamīpataḥ | indradyumnasarastatra samāgatya pratiṣṭhati ||1.154.60 || brahmaviṣṇumaheśāṃśca naranārāyaṇaṃ tathā | lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ sītārāmaṃ śrutvā samāgatān ||6 1 || puruṣottamapuryāstu jagannāthaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | nīlākhyaṃ parvataṃ nītvā vaṭavṛkṣaṃ tathābdhijam ||62|| samāgato’tra vāsāya nyūṣuste prāgdiśi dhruvam | ṭīmburuphalajātāni jāmbvāmalakakarmadāḥ ||53|| āmrāśca rāvaṇāścaiva badaryaścāmṛtāni ca | sītāphalāni bahuśaḥ santi yatra vanāni vai ||64|| dugdhasamaṃ jalaṃ yatrāmṛtasvāduphalāni ca | sukhaṃ svargasamaṃ yatra prāgbhāgeraivatācale ||656|| kṛṣṇā ca mṛttikā yatra svarṇarasasumiśritā | vibhinnā dhātavaḥ santi viṃśatikrośabhūmayaḥ ||66 || tataḥ pūrve śubhaṃ kṣetramaśvapaṭṭasarovaram | ciñcāṃgūdīvanaṃ ramyaṃ śubhā kuṃkumavāpikā ||67|| śatrūñjitānadī saumyā kaṃbharākṣetramucyate | lakṣmīnārāyaṇaśca kaṃbharāgopālasaṃjñayā ||68|| pūjyate vandyate devairbhūsurairmānavaistathā | patnīvratasya viprasya vaṃśastatrāpi tiṣṭhati ||69|| kuṃkumavāpikāyāścottare krośadvayāt param | kṣetraṃ puṇyamaraṇyādiyutaṃ ramyaṃ ca vidyate ||1.154.70 || laṃkācatuṣṭakīkṣetraṃ yatra guptā sarasvatī | prakāśā vartate cāpi sudivyasalilānvitā ||71 || himācalād yadā devī sarasvatī mahānadī | vāḍavāgniṃ samādāya yātā paścimavāridhim ||72|| tadārbudācalāt siddhakṣetraṃ śrīnagaraṃ tathā | gatvā virāṭanagaraṃ sāraṃgaṃ durgametya ca ||73 || unmattagaṃgāṃ bhogāṃ ca bhadrāṃ samprāpya vai tataḥ | laṃkācatuṣṭakīkṣetraṃ prāptvā jayantamāgatā ||74|| bhadreśvaranṛsiṃhākhyaghaṭṭaṃ gatvā taduttaram | skandapuraṃ tathā kālīvaṭaṃ ca nagaraṃ gatā ||79 || ājyāṃ prakāśamāsādya suvarṣādvārikāṃ gatā | tato dakṣiṇadigbhāge barāṭākhye tu parvate ||76|| bilveśaṃ harṣadāṃ prāpya navanītādrimāgatā | vāmanasthalamāsādya vastrāpathamumāgatā ||77|| raivatādriṃ parivīya parvataṃ ca kṛtasmaram | prajvālya balikhātaṃ ca gatvā prācīsthapippalam ||78|| ekatarṣisthalaṃ prāpya somanāthaṃ samāgatā | vyāghrāraṇye śubhaṃ guptaprayāgaṃ prāpya sā tataḥ ||79|| siṃhāraṇye divyabhūmau gatvāro’bdhau viveśa sā | vāḍavāgniṃ samutsṛjya punaḥ sā raivatācale ||1.154.80|| sarvadā saṃsthitā devī pratisthānaṃ sarasvatīṃ | kuṇḍe kuṇḍe sthitā devī janakalyāṇahetave ||8 1|| hanumannāmavikhyātāḥ kapayo raivatācale | sītāmaḍhī ca hanumanmaḍhī santamaḍhī tathā ||82|| vyāghreśvarī mahādevī māhiṣākhye girau sthitā | śrīrāmapādukātīrthaṃ bilveśaṃ hāṭakeśvaram ||83|| evamanyāni tīrthāni santi lakṣmi tu raivate | tārakāṇi prāṇināṃ vai bhuktimuktipradāni ca ||84|| yathākathañcikchraddhādyaiḥ svārthenāpi prahelayā | kṛtāni yena tīrthāni dṛṣṭapītāni vā tathā ||85|| snātāni tajjaladhūlīkardamāni dhṛtāni vā | teṣāṃ pāpavināśena bhuktirmuktirbhaveddhruvam ||86|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathamaṃ kṛtayugasantāne taijasaraivatācale kumudamandarāruṇanīlādiparvatānāṃ badrikānaranārāyaṇalakṣmīnārāyaṇasītārāmajagannāthasarasvatīṃprabhatitīrthānāmāgamananirūpaṇanāmā catuḥpaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 154||
<1.155> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mahālakṣmīḥ paravaikuṇṭhavāsinī | yathā nārāyaṇenaiva sahājagāma raivate || 1 || baliryadā hariṇā vai baddhastadātra raivate | maṇḍape tu baleḥ patnī sasmāra parameśvarīm || 2 || mahālakṣmīṃ tadā stotrairbalerbandhanivṛttaye | mahāvaikuṇṭhadhāmastho prahvībhāvena hṛdgatām || 3 || sandhyāvalī prāñjalistāṃ natvā hṛdi jagāda ca | namo mātre mahālakṣmyai trāhi bhaktaṃ ca me patim || 4 || namaḥ prakṛtisaṃjñāyai mūlāyai te namonamaḥ | saṃhartryai brahmamātre te kukṣisṛṣṭyai namonamaḥ || 5 || vāmanā vāpi dīrghāśca nārāyaṇāstu te mukhe | mahākālādayaścāpi santi grāsāśca te namaḥ || 6 || saṃkarṣaṇāstathā rudrā yamāścaiva tavānane | daṃṣṭraikacarvaṇāḥ sarve mahāmātre namonamaḥ || 7 || vāsudevastathā bhūmā nārāyaṇāśca pūruṣāḥ | tvatpallatātāḍitāste mahāśaktyai namonamaḥ || 8 || tvatto lakṣmīḥ samutpannā mahāviṣṇustvadaṃkajaḥ | brahmāṇḍāni ca te romṇi rakṣa lakṣmyai namonamaḥ || 9 || mahāgnayastu te gupte tvatsvede vāḍavānalāḥ | bhagavantaśca te garbhe caṇḍalakṣmyai namo’vatu || 1.155.10|| jṛmbhe te pralayāḥ santi caṇḍe kālaḥ prakampate | cūrṇāyante mahāṇḍāni pṛṣṭhamnīḍe namo’stu te || 1 1|| rakṣa rakṣa mahāmāye patiṃ me parameśvari | caṇḍī taṇḍī mahāmuṇḍī ghamaṇḍī ḍiṇḍikādikāḥ |||12|| kālīkarālīprajvālīlihālīraktilādikāḥ | śaktayaste raktaleśaḥ pāhi kāntaṃ drutaṃ kuru || 13 || pāhi śīghraṃ cānyathā tvāṃ galaṃ nikṛtya pūjaye | yadyahaṃ vidhavā syāṃ cet pūrvaṃ tvaṃ vidhavā bhava || 14|| yadyahaṃ rājyaśūnyāṃ syāṃ tvaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ vinā bhava | yadyavamānito rājā syātpatiste’pyamānitaḥ || 15|| madyajñe ced bhavet vighnaṃ tava yajñe tathāstu vai | vadatyevaṃ caṇḍavegā dravṛṇvantyapi sabhāsadaḥ || 16|| mā metyevaṃ tadā devā nivārayanti tāṃ striyam | tāvat tatrāgatā patnī mahālakṣmīrmahāprabhoḥ || 17|| sāntvayitvā ca tāṃ rājñīṃ patitā kharvapādayoḥ | mā maivaṃ deva cātyantaṃ mā bhaktasya hara prabho || 18|| vāmanaśca tadā prāha nainaṃ vai mārayāmyaham | rājyabhraṣṭaṃ ca naivāhaṃ karomyenaṃ susevakam || 19|| sandhyāvalī sadevāstu susaubhāgyavatī priye | daityo’yaṃ daityarājyaṃ vai karotu sutale priye ||1.155.20|| vaikuṇṭhaṃ yadyahaṃ tyakṣye nivatsye tadbalergṛhe | tvayā saha mahālakṣmi rājñī sevāṃ karotu me ||2 1|| devarājyaṃ tu devebhyo daityarājyaṃ tu tadbalau | dattvā nidhāya gantavyaṃ sandhyāvalyāḥ śubhaṃ bhavet|||22|| tadā tu daityavaryaiḥ sā mahālakṣmīḥ prapūjitā | devaiśca pūjitā mātā sarvasaubhāgyarakṣikā ||23|| vāmanena samaṃ sāpi raivate’bhyarthitā ca taiḥ | sadoṣitā mahālakṣmīḥ sarvasaubhāgyahetave ||24|| raivatātpaścime tatrocchrāye nitya vyavasthitā | mahāmāyā mahālakṣmīḥ prāṇarakṣaṇakāriṇī ||25|| vanditā pūjitā puṣpakuṃkumākṣatacandanaiḥ | sindūraśrīphalavastraśāṭītailasugandhibhiḥ ||26|| tathā saubhāgyadravyaiśca bhojanairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ | ābharaṇakaṭakormiśṛṃravalātroṭikādibhiḥ |||27|| peyairnānāvidhaiścaiva kaṃcukīśāṭikādibhiḥ | maṃgalasūtrakarṇādibhūṣaṇādibhirādarāt ||28|| prasannā sā mahālakṣmīrdīpotsavadine sadā | asaubhāgyamamāṃgalyamanarthaṃ ceti hasti sā ||29|| dadāti kuśalaṃ rājyaṃ kāntaṃ putraṃ dhanaṃ tathā | pūjanārthaṃ mahālakṣmyā mūrtiḥ kāryā caturbhujā || 1.155.30|| pauraṭī susvarūpā ca ramyā ṣoḍaśahāyanā | padmāmṛtaghaṭakarā pūjāpātrakarā tathā ||3 1|| abhayadānahastā ca dakṣayorvāmayoḥ kramāt | ṣoḍaśopaparicāravastubhiḥ pūjayet tu tām ||32||| naivedyaṃ phalatāmbūlaṃ dattvā nīrājayet tataḥ | bhojanāni vividhāni dātavyāni ca dakṣiṇāḥ ||33|| dānāni ratnahīrakamaṇisvarṇamayāni ca | vastrāṇāṃ ca dukūlānāṃ kambalānāṃ gavāṃ tathā |||34|| tasyākṣayaṃ bhavetpuṇyaṃ mahālakṣmīpratāpataḥ | ante vaikuṇṭhavāsaḥ syād bhuktvā bhogānanekaśaḥ ||35|| kanyakā dvādaśavarṣapūrvā lakṣmīsvarūpikāḥ | pūjanīyā yathālakṣmīrvastrānnadhanadāpanaiḥ ||36|| bhojanīyāstathā bhūṣālaṃkāradravyaśobhitāḥ | vividhairmiṣṭapakvānnapāyasānnādisadrasaiḥ ||37|| bhojanīyāstathā sādhvyo viraktāḥ sāṃkhyayogagāḥ | pūjanīyāśca dātavya vividhaṃ dānamiṣṭakṛt ||38|| sati vai vibhave tatra sāpatyasadhavāḥ striyaḥ | vidhavāścāpi dīnāśca śaraṇyāśca nirāśritāḥ || 39|| bhojanīyāḥ pūjanīyā dāpanīyāśca dakṣiṇāḥ | sammānanīyāḥ satataṃ yattṛptau śrīśca tṛpyati ||1.155.40 || mahālakṣmyāṃ prasannāyāṃ sarvā smṛddhirvivardhate | nyūnaṃ kiñcidbhavennaiva yadyattvapekṣate milet ||41 ||
