palāyanaparo’bhavat || 67 || tāvaccotplutya gagane devyā keśeṣu saṃdhṛtaḥ | unnīya bhrāmayāmāsa cikṣepainaṃ tu sā kṣitau || 68 || papātopari sā devī śūlamādāya tatkṣaṇam | tadvakṣo dārayāmāsa bhedayāmāsa tadgalam || 69 || muhuścikṣepa daityendraḥ karapādau tadā bhuvi | pavartaprāyarūpo’bhūt kampayan sakalāṃ mahīm ||1.168.7 0 || uttānaḥ patitaścorvyāṃ karapādau prasārya ca | vikṣipya bahudhā dhūlyāṃ virarāma mamāra ca ||7 1 || gaganaṃ nirmalaṃ jātaṃ vātavṛṣṭiḥ śamaṃ yayau | devā devyastadā kātyāyanīṃ harṣitamānasāḥ |||72|| jayāśīrbhimudā saṃvardhayāmāsurathārhaṇām | cakrurnaikopadābhiśca gandharvā lalitaṃ jaguḥ ||7 3 || nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇā vāditrāṇi hyavādayan | vātā vavuśca sukhadāḥ sūryastepe prabhānvitaḥ ||74|| agnayo jajvaluḥ śāntāstrailokyaṃ sukhabhāgabhūt | rājyabhāgāstadājena yathāyogyaṃ samarpitāḥ ||75|| yāvadbhyastatra devebhyaścopadā arpitāstadā | devībhyo yuddhakartrībhyo brahmaṇā viṣṇunā tathā ||76 || śaṃbhunā cārpitā hārā lalantikāśca mudritāḥ | vijayākhyavibhūṣāśca tantikāśca sumudrikāḥ || 77|| mukuṭakaṭakajhaṃjhrīvaṃgadāraśanāstathā | kalgyaḥ śekharaścairiṇyaḥ karṇapūrāśca kaṃcukīḥ ||78 || ghargharīśāṭikāsvarṇamayī ratnamayībṛsīḥ | ratnahīrakasauvarṇavijayākhyaprapatrikāḥ ||79 || bhojanāni ca pānāni yānāni vāhanāni ca | daityagṛhasthitānyanyaratnāni vividhāni ca ||1.168.8 0 || upadāyāṃ pāritoṣikākhyaṃ hārdaṃ dhanaṃ bahu | yathāyogyaṃ yathākāryaṃ pradattaṃ tatra parṣati ||8 1 || devyo mauktikahārāḍhyāḥ sakalgimukuṭāvahāḥ | prasannāśca tadā prāhurdevān yaddhṛdayaṃgamam ||82|| devā vā mānuṣā vātha tiryañco’tha surāsurāḥ | gṛhadevīrgṛhapatnīḥ svasṝḥ putrīḥ snuṣāstathā ||83|| mātṝśca pramadā dāsīṃnayiṣyanti bhāvataḥ | tadiṣṭaiḥ sukhayiṣyanti pūyiṣyanti vastubhiḥ ||84|| khānapānāmbarabhūṣāśṛṃgāradravyasānaiḥ | hārdikasnehavṛttyā prasannayiṣyanti sarvadā ||85|| teṣāṃ gṛhe vayaṃ devyo nivatsyāmabalāsu vai | sukhayiṣyāma aiśvaryairdhanaputramṛddhibhiḥ ||86|| rakṣiṣyāmaśca tānsarvān devāniva janānsvakān | bhogyabhogāvihārādīn dāpayiṣyāma eva tān ||87|| sukhinaḥ santu te sarve yatra nārījanaḥ sukhī | asukhāḥ santu te sarve yatra nārījano’sukhaḥ ||88|| evaṃ sarvāgryadevībhirdevaiścāśīḥ prayuṃjitaḥ | kātyānī mahādevī pūjitā bahudhā tata ||89|| atha devāḥ stutiṃ cakre samāje vijaye tat | kātyāyani namastubhyaṃ kauśiki te namonamaḥ||1.168.90|| kālike kāli te’jasraṃ cāmuṇḍe te namonamaḥ| mahāmāri namastubhyaṃ te brahmāṇi namonamaḥ ||9 1|| cāndri ca vāruṇi kuṇḍalini tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ | triśūlini namastubhyaṃ kaumāri śaktini namaḥ |||92| nārasiṃhi śivadūti vaiṣṇavi te namonamaḥ | vārāhi caṇḍike caṇḍe carmamuṇḍe ca te namaḥ ||93|| raudri siṃhi yamadāsi yāmye devi ca te namaḥ | īśāni dikprapāle te nairṛtāni ca te namaḥ ||94|| aindri ca vāyavi bhadre bhagavatyastu te namaḥ | namo’stvanantarūpe te namaste rājyadāyini ||95|| namaste daityadarpaghni namo’ṣṭādaśabāhavi | namo nārāyaṇi brāhmi cakradhāriṇi te namaḥ ||96|| namo vajradhare hastidhvaje te’stu namonamaḥ | mayūravāhini te’stu namaste haṃsavāhini ||97|| muṇḍamāle namaste’stu sukeśini namo’stu te | trinetre varade devi namaste’stu prasīda ca ||98|| prapannārtihare devi mātaḥ prasīda pāhi ca | mahīrūpe sadādhāre jalarūpe ca tṛptide ||99|| bījarūpe moharūpe muktirūpe namo’stu te | vidyārūpe samastastrīsvarūpe te namonamaḥ || 1.168.100 || svargamokṣaprade devi nārāyaṇi namo’stu te | kālarūpe tattvarūpe kāryakāraṇarūpiṇi || 10 1|| triguṇe nirguṇe devi mahāmāye hṛdisthite | sarvāntaryāmiṇi devi nārāyaṇi namo’stu te || 1 02|| brahmāṇi haṃsayānasthe śivāni vṛṣabhasthite | vaiṣṇavi garuḍasthe te nārāyaṇi namo’stu te || 1 03|| mātṛrūpe stanyayukte patnīrūpe sagarbhike | ratirūpe jīvaśānte nārāyaṇi namo’stu te || 1 04|| yuge yuge mahāsuropadravanāśanaṃ kuru | devānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ caiva nārāyaṇi namo’stu te || 105|| śaraṇyānāṃ sadā bādhāghātanaṃ kuru sarvathā | triśūlaṃ sarvadā bhīteḥ pātu devi namo’stu te || 1 06|| ghaṇṭā pātu ca pāpebhya khaḍgaḥ sukhaṃ karotu ca | pāśādyāste sadā pāntu naśca devi namo’stu te || 1 07|| sṛṣṭau sadā tvayā kāryamevameva tu rakṣaṇam | rakṣaṇāya sadā devi prasannāstu namo’stu te || 1 08|| iti stutvā tato devaiḥ kusumāṃjalirarpitaḥ | namaskṛtā prasannā ca prāha devān vihasya sā || 109|| bhavatāṃ vai prasādāttu prāpto’yaṃ vijayo mayā | punarbhavatprasādācca haniṣyāmyeva dānavān || 1.168.11 0|| gṛdhrāsuraṃ tathā garjāsuraṃ harjāsuraṃ tathā | jaṭhrāsuraṃ tathā magnāsuraṃ ca suravairiṇaḥ || 111 || vaipracitān haniṣyāmi raktadantikarūpayā | śatākṣī ca bhaviṣyāmi punaḥ śākaṃbharī tataḥ || 1 12|| śtavārṣikadurbhikṣe dāsye śākaṃ janām̐stadā | śatairnetrairnirīkṣye’haṃ śatākṣī kīrtyate tadā ||1 13|| bhīmarūpeṇa bhīmāhaṃ rakṣobhyo munipuṃgavān | himādrau rakṣayiṣye ca bhīmā devī bhavāmyaham || 1 14|| aruṇākṣavināśāya bhrāmaraṃ rūpamāsthitā | bhrāmarīti bhaviṣyāmi rakṣayiṣye janām̐stadā || 1 15|| yadā yadā ca madyogyaṃ kāryaṃ copasthitaṃ tadā | bhaviṣyāmi tathārūpā nānto me nāmarūpayoḥ || 1 16|| kālasya ca tathā sṛṣṭernānto’sti mama karmaṇām āsurāṇāṃ ca nānto’sti mamāpyanto na vidyate || 1 17|| matstotrairmāṃ pratyahaṃ yaḥ stoṣyati śraddhayānvitaḥ | tasya pīḍāṃ nāśayiṣye trividhāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 18|| madhukaiṭabhamahiṣaśuṃbhaniśuṃbhanāśanam | śroṣyanti caritaṃ me ye gāsyanti ca samāhitāḥ || 119 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ caika cetasaḥ | dāridryāpattiduṣkarmāniṣṭaśastrabhayādikam || 1.168.120|| śatrudasyunṛpadaṃṣṭritoyānalabhayādikam | nāśayiṣye kariṣye ca teṣāṃ svastyayanaṃ dhruvam || 121|| upasargamahāmārīrogotpātārtibandhanam | nāśayiṣye kariṣye ca saubhāgyapuṣṭivardhanam || 1 22|| madgṛhe balinaivedye pūjāyāṃ havanotsave | navarātre caritraṃ me pāṭhyaṃ śrāvyaṃ ca bhāvataḥ || 123|| dāsye parākramaṃ tasmai kalyāṇaṃ bhītiśūnyatām | dhanadhānyasuvarṇādistrīputrapautrasampadaḥ || 124|| śāntikarmaṇi duḥsvapne grahaduḥkhe’rbhakagrahe | gṛhakleśe mitrakalau durvṛtte bhūtapīḍane || 125|| roge daityādije duḥkhe yuddhe vairiṇi prāntare | dāvānale tathāraṇye deśabhaṃge’rinigrahe || 1 26|| stenāvṛtaṃ gajavyāghrasiṃhāvṛte vanabhrame | bandhane vātavege ca pote mahājale raṇe || 127|| nigaḍe śastrasampāte vedanāyāṃ hṛdantare | dasyuvairisamākrānte paṭhedvā śṛṇuyāttathā || 128|| śrāvayeccāpi me bhaktyā caritaṃ vividhaṃ mama | mahāpūjā kārayecca bhojayedbhūsurānbahūn || 1 29||| tatra tatra sthale kāle bādhāyāṃ karmaṇi sthitau | rakṣayiṣye janaṃ bhaktaṃ sarvavidhaprasaṃkaṭāt || 1.168.13 0|| ityāśīrbhirvardhayitvā sabhājayitvā tānsurān | teṣāṃ ca paśyatāṃ kātyāyanī tvantaradhīyata || 13 1|| devāḥ svarga yayū rājye nirātaṃkā vyavasthitāḥ | asurāḥ śeṣabhāvāśca jagmuḥ pātālameva te || 1 32|| śṛṇu lakṣmi saiva tuṣṭā lakṣmīvṛddhikaro gṛhe | ruṣṭā yadā tadā saivālakṣmīrvināśakāriṇī || 1 33||| saiva stutārcitā dadyāddhanadhānyasutādikam | śrutā ca kīrtitā dadyātsukhasampadgṛhādikam || 1 34|| dhyātā ca saṃśritā dadyādaiśvaryātmabalādikam | ārādhitā ca sā dadyāt jñānamuktipadādikam || 135|| prasāditā ca sā dadyāt svāṃ ca nārāyaṇādikam | tasyai cidacidvyāptāyai nārāyaṇyai namonamaḥ || 1 36|| iti te kathitaṃ devīsāmarthyaṃ daityanāśakam | kathayiṣye prasaṃge’nyat kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 1 37|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’nekavidhadevīnāmanekavidhāsurāṇāṃ ca sainyayoḥ kālakavalamantritaśastrāstrādibhirbhūvyomayuddhaṃ brahmāstraprayogaḥ śuṃbhasya mṛṣamāyā śuṃbhanāśaḥ devīstutyupadāstotraphalādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 168||
<1.169> śrīlakṣmīruvāca śrutaṃ devyāścaritraṃ vai mahābalaparākramam | atha śrotuṃ samicchāmi satīcaritamadbhutam || 1 || dakṣagṛhe satījanma satīlagnaṃ ca śaṃbhunā | dakṣayajñe tathā satyā vahnisnānaṃ sakāraṇam || 2 || himādrermenakāyāṃ ca satījanmogratattapaḥ | madhye śaṃbhorliṃgapāto mahaccānyatparākramam || 3 || tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi kṛpayā tava keśava | ityarthitaḥ śriyā svāmī lakṣmīṃ vaktuṃ pracakrame || 4 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca kaśyapena purā snehāt ditiḥ proktā svabhāvataḥ | vajrasāramayairaṃgaiḥ putro devi bhaviṣyati || 5 || vajrāṃgaṃ nāma sā devī suṣuve vajraduścidam | sa jātamātra evābhūt sarvayuddhaviśāradaḥ || 6 || prāha svajananīṃ mātaryadājñā karavāṇi tat | ditiḥ prāha mahendreṇa putrā me bahavo hatāḥ || 7 || teṣāmapacitiṃ kartuṃ gaccha śakraṃ divi sthitam | sahasrākṣaṃ sa baddhvā svamāturagre nināya saḥ || 8 || brahmaṇā mocitaḥ paścādgatastvindraḥ svamālayam | vajrāṃgasya varāṃgyāṃ tārakāsura iti balī || 9 || suto’bhavat mahāduṣṭo devāṃścakre vaśān raṇe | lokapālānindramukhyān baddhvā pāśaiḥ paśūniva || 1.169.10|| nināya meruśikharaṃ yatrāsti svakamālayam | kālanemiḥ surānbaddhvā prādāya dvāri tiṣṭhati || 1 1|| yatheṣṭaṃ tārakaḥ prāha drutaṃ kārāgṛhe kṣipa | kevala vāsavaṃ tvekaṃ muṇḍayitvā vimocaya || 1 2|| evaṃ kṛtaṃ tadā devāḥ samājagmuḥ pitāmaham | tārakasya vināśāya prārthayāṃcakruraṃjasā || 13 || niśāṃ sasmāra ca brahmā sopatasthe pitāmaham | brahmovāca mahatkāryaṃ vibhāvari upasthitam || 14|| tārakāsuranāśārthaṃ satī dakṣasutā bhava | tava skandaḥ sutaḥ saptadineṣveva mahāsuram || 15|| kārtikeyastārakākhyaṃ haniṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | tvaṃ kālarātriniḥśeṣabhuvanāvalivāsinī || 16|| śaṃbhukaṇṭhagrahānandadāyinī tvaṃ vibhāvarī | gaccha dakṣagṛhaṃ śīghraṃ bhava putrī harapriyā || 17 || ityuktā tu niśādevī yayau vai dakṣamandiram | tatrāsīnāṃ mahāharmye ratnabhīttisamāśrayām || 18 || dadarśa dakṣapatnīṃ cāsiknīṃ viraṇakanyakām | camatkṛtiprabhāvyāptāpāṇḍurānanavārijām || 19 || kiṃcitkṣāmāṃ mukhodagrastanabhārāvanāmitām | mahauṣadhigaṇairmantrairaiśvaryairabhisevitām || 1.169.2 0 || udvahatsvarṇasannaddhajīvacakrāṃ surūpiṇīm | maṇimālāmahājyotiṣparidhicakrakānanām || 21 || svarṇatārābhigrathitaprāntacañcalaśāṭikām | tailacandanasaugandhyadravyaśṛṃgāraśobhitām || 2 2 || svarṇakalaśacīnāṃśukakāraktacchatrachāyitām | dadarśa divasasyānte mahāsanavirājitām || 23 || namaskṛtya niśovāsāsiknībhrūromarājiṣu | prasuptaprāyaḥpuruṣe nidrābhūtopacārake || 24|| sphuṭāloke candramasi kṛtamanasijādare | gāḍhakaṇṭhagrahālagnasamaye dakṣasannidhau || 25 || ratikāle pakṣapatnīnetrayoḥ prāviśanniśā | āviveśa mukhe rātrirdakṣeṇādbhutasaṃgame || 26 || śvāsasṛtyā tadāsiknyāḥ krameṇa jaṭharāntare | āviveśa sthitā bīje dakṣakṛtaniṣecane || 27 || dakṣapatnī tadārabhya dauhṛdāśobhatātigam | ādhānādiprasaṃskārā dakṣeṇāpi nivartitāḥ || 28 || prāpte prasūtisamaye’dīpayadgrahamandiram | brāhme muhūrte subhage prāsūyata vibhāvarīm || 29 || mahātejasvinīṃ devīṃ kanakojjvalamūrdhajām | padmapatrābhanayanāṃ sthalapadmaguṇālayām || 1.169.30 || lakṣmīcihnātiśobhāḍhyāvayavāṃ ca trinetrakām | candrabhālāṃ śūlaghaṭadhanurdhvajakarāṃbujām || 31 || svastikacakraḍamarūpadma hārakarānvitām | ūrdhvarekhānāgavallīdalamīnādipattalām || 32 || sāmrājyacihnasahitāṃ daivīrekhāsamanvitām | dṛṣṭvā dakṣastathāsiknī mumudaturhṛdantare || 32 || tasyāṃ tu jāyamānāyāṃ jantavaḥ sthirajaṃgamāḥ | abhavan sukhinaḥ smṛddhā taṃ sarvalokakṛtālayāḥ || 34|| nārakāṇāmapi svargasamaṃ jātaṃ tadā sukham | cetāṃsi krūrarasattvānāṃ suśāntānyabhavam̐stadā || 35 || jyotiṣāmapi sutarāṃ tejo’vardhata cāmbare | devāḥ praharṣamatulaṃ lebhire devatāyutāḥ || 36 || araṇyauṣadhayaḥ svāduphalapuṣpasugandhayaḥ | diśaḥ praseduratyarthaṃ vimalaṃ ca nabho’bhavat || 37|| mārutaśca sukhasparśo mandasugandhaśītalaḥ | sarvartuphalayugapadudbhavā hyabhavandrumāḥ || 38 || sasyalakṣmīdharā pṛthvī rasāvirbhāvaśobhanā | jalaprasravaṇā bhūmau prākaṭyamanulebhire || 39 || vismṛtāni ca bodhāni smṛtermārgaṃ prapedire | tīrthasāmarthyamatyutkarṣatāṃ prāptamakāśata || 1.169.40 || jīvāścaturdaśalokasthitāḥ śāntiṃ gatāstadā | sāttvikānāṃ śakunāni suśubhānyabhavam̐stadā ||4 1 || svapnānyapi mahotsavakarāṇyāsan dyumanti ca | mānaseṣu janānāṃ ca protsāhāḥ prābhavam̐stadā |||72 || antarīkṣe’marāstvāsan vimāneṣu sahasraśaḥ | brahmā saptarṣayo manvantarāṇi dikprapālakāḥ |||43 || lokapālāśca munayaḥ santaḥ sādhvyo maharṣayaḥ | pitaro vahnayaḥ sādhyā viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ ||44 || kinnarāśca kiṃpuruṣā devā devyaśca koṭiśaḥ | siddhāśca cāraṇā sūtā māgadhā vandinastathā ||45 || sāttvikā rājasāścaiva tathā pātālavāsinaḥ | dakṣagṛhopari vyomno mumucuḥ puṣpavarṣaṇam ||46 || jagurgandharvamukhyāśca nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ | vāditrāṇi hyavādyanta stāvakāścakrire stutīḥ || 47|| parvatāśca samudrāśca sarāṃsi saritastathā | vanāraṇyāni mūrtāni samājagmuśca sarvaśaḥ ||48 || mūrtimanti ca tattvāni guṇā mūrtā vibhūtayaḥ | tatra mahotsave jagmurdivyā upadapāṇayaḥ || 49 || dakṣagṛhaṃ tadārabhya tīrthībhūtamakūparam | nityaṃ koṭijanāstatra yānti darśanalabdhaye || 1.169.50 || yā parabrahmaśaktiḥ sā catūrūpā vyavasthitā | śāntirvidyā pratiṣṭhā ca nivṛttiśceti tāḥ smṛtāḥ ||5 1 || vāsudeve’niruddhe ca pradyumne samakarṣaṇe | kramaśaḥ saṃsthitāścātra tatra sṛṣṭau kṛtādarāḥ || 52 || tā eva cāpi vairāje hyaje viṣṇau maheśvare | tiṣṭhantyeva ca śāśvatyo yogibhiḥ svātmasu dhṛtāḥ || 53 || pramāṇaviparyayavikalpanidrātmikāśca tāḥ | śābdikaistu parā paśyā madhyamā vaikharīti tāḥ || 54|| vimarśabindunādadhvanyātmikāścāpi tāḥ kṛtāḥ | śāntaṃ jāgrat tathā svapnaṃ suṣuptaṃ cāpi tā matāḥ ||55|| garbho bālyaṃ yuvatvaṃ ca hāso’vasthāśca tāḥ smṛtāḥ | bījaṃ cotpattirapyatra sthitirlayaśca tā matāḥ ||56 || aṛturvārṣṭikama śaityaṃ cauṣṇya cāpi matāśca tāḥ | ajā īśā tathā devī cāsurāṇī ca tā matāḥ ||57|| śāntā krūrā vyavasāyā śūdrī vṛttaya eva tāḥ | brāhmaṃ prāptastathā sāyaṃ niśā cāpi ca tā matāḥ ||58|| kimu vaktavyametāsu catasra eva sarvathā | ekaiva vidyate kāryakāraṇābhinnarūpiṇī ||59|| tasmāttu prāṇinaḥ sarve ākṛṣṭiṃ yānti tatra vai | nityaṃ tatra samāyānti darśanārthama mahotsavaḥ ||1.169.60 || dakṣagṛhe sadā jāto devīvāsena sarvathā | jñānaśaktirbhaktiśaktiḥ kriyāśaktiśca muktikā ||61 || catūrūpāṃ janā draṣṭuṃ samāyānti ca koṭiśaḥ | atha dakṣaṃ prāha patnī paśya bālāṃ suśobhanām ||62|| sarvabhūtādhivāsāṃ ca rājīvadalalocanām | tryambakāṃ ca caturvaktrāṃ taruṇādityasannibhām ||63|| śrutvaivaṃ tu pitā dakṣo yāvatpaśyati putrikām | tāvaddivyaṃ darśanaṃ vai piturjātaṃ kṛpākṛtam ||64|| dakṣo’paśyat mahātejastatra siṃhāsanottame | nārāyaṇasya vāmāṃke sthitāṃ lakṣmīṃ dadarśa vai ||65|| atha līnāṃ punastatra kṛṣṇaṃ rādhāṃ dadarśa saḥ | atha līnāṃ ca tatraiva śivāṃ śivaṃ dadarśa saḥ ||66|| śivāṃke saṃsthitāṃ devīṃ candrāvayavabhūṣaṇām | trinetrāmaṣṭahastāṃ ca satriśūlādicihnitām ||67|| tejoparidhisaṃvyāptāṃ carmacakṣuralabdhikām | praṇamya śirasā bhūmau dakṣaḥ provāca ceśvarīm || 68|| kā tvaṃ devi viśālākṣi mahātejo’bhisaṃbhṛtā | na me cakṣuḥ kṣama tvasya tejasaste grahe’sti vai ||69|| na jāne tvāmahaṃ vatse svarūpaṃ brūhi me sute | devyuvāca ca māṃ viddhi brahmaśaktiṃ pareśvarīm ||1.169.70|| ajāmekāṃ lohitāṃ ca śuklāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ ca nirguṇām | bahvīḥ prajāḥ sṛjamānāṃ sarūpāśca catūrūpām ||71 || divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me rūpamaiśvaram | uktvaivaṃ dakṣanetre svakarābhyāṃ sā tvamārjayat ||72|| divye kṣaṇāttadā jāte kṣame trisṛṣṭilokane | svaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa divyaṃ tatpārameśvaram ||73|| koṭisūryasamābhāvattejobimbaṃ sukhāśrayam | svarṇamālāsahasrāḍhyaṃ divyāmbaravibhūṣitam ||74|| saumyaṃ śāntaṃ tataḥ samyak pravṛttaṃ rājasaṃ śubham | tataḥ paścāt tadevātra mahākrūraṃ bhayānakam ||75|| jvālāmālāyutavyāptaṃ kālānalaśatānvitam | daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ durdharṣaṃ jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam ||76|| gadāhastaṃ samukuṭaṃ śaṃkhacakradharaṃ tathā | mahātriśūlahastaṃ ca ghoraṃ layabhayānakam ||77|| candrarekhāḍhyabhālaṃ cānantāścaryādisaṃyutam | divyamālyāmbaradharaṃ nūpurairupaśobhitam ||78|| kāmyaṃ kṛttidhṛtapṛṣṭhaṃ divyagandhānulepanam | sarvaśaktyāśrayaṃ śubhraṃ sarvādhāramanāmayam ||79|| brahmendropendrayogīndrairvandyamānapadāmbujam | sarvataḥ pāṇipādāntaṃ sarvato’kṣiśiromukham ||1.169. 80|| sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhantaṃ sarvataḥ śrutimatparam | etādṛśīṃ mahādevīṃ dadarśa parameśvarīm ||81 || tuṣṭāva cāṣṭa ca śataṃ nāmnāmuccārya dakṣarāṭ | parabrahmāṇyakṣarāṇi śāśvatī parameśvarī ||82||| muktānī sarvagā māyā satyā lakṣmīniraṃjanā | sarvāntarasthā cicchaktistārāmṛtapradā ramā ||83|| vyomarūpācyutā kāryakāraṇātmā kalāmayī | prāṇeśvarī mahāmātā pradhānā prakṛtistathā ||84|| vidyā vibhūtirākāśā śābdī nādamayī prasūḥ | sarvayoniḥ purāṇā ca kūṭasthā pauruṣī śivā ||85|| kṣetrajñā vyāpinī vyaktā cāvyaktā triguṇā layā | bhūntīcāvyākṛtiryonirvaidyutī mohinī tathā ||86|| mūrtiśca vaiṣṇavī buddhirmahatī mānasī kṛtiḥ | īśvarāṇī ca śarvāṇī bhavānī cāmbikā tathā ||87|| pativratā ca rudrāṇī yoginī śrīḥ sumaṃgalā | sāvitrī kamalā gaṃgā pārvatī ca sarasvatī ||88|| vāṇī kīrtiścānnapūrṇā svadhā svāhā jagadbharā | sudhā siddhiḥ stutirmedhā śrutirnītiḥ smṛtistathā ||89|| haṃsā kālī kauśikī ca kātyāyanī ca caṇḍikā | durgā sādhvī ca gaurī ca trinetrā brahmacāriṇī ||1.169.90|| vibhāvarī ca dīkṣā ca gītirdhenuśca mohinī | avidyā dakṣiṇā bhargā sandhyā dhātrī prabhā ca bhūḥ ||9 1 || sa stutvāṣṭottaraśatanāmabhirdakṣarāṭ svayam | bhūyaḥ praṇamya deveśīṃ provācedaṃ kṛtāṃjaliḥ ||95|| dṛṣṭaṃ te caiśvaraṃ rūpaṃ rūpaṃ saumyaṃ pradarśaya | saṃhṛtya darśayāmāsa rūpamanyattadā punaḥ ||93|| dvādaśābdaṃ tadā saumyaṃ gauraṃ vikasitākṛti | sugandhāḍhyaṃ dvinetraṃ dvibhujaṃ nīlālakānvitam ||94|| raktapādāmbujatalaṃ suraktakarapallavam | bhūṣitaṃ cārusarvāṃgaṃ lalāṭatilakojjvalam ||95|| īṣatsmitaṃ subimbauṣṭhaṃ nūpurārāvasaṃyutam | svarṇahārān dadhadvakṣaḥsthale’ṅgulīṣu cormikāḥ ||96|| svarṇavastrasuśobhāḍhyaṃ ramyaṃ sarvāṃgakomalam | divyaṃ sukanyakārūpaṃ koṭikandarpamohanam ||97|| dṛṣṭvā dakṣaḥ suhṛṣṭātmā babhāṣe parameśvarīm | adya me saphalaṃ janma cādya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ ||98|| adya me puṇyakallolāḥ putrīrūpā upasthitāḥ 1 nārāyaṇyā jagaddhātryā darśanaṃ me’dya jāyate ||99|| śivāyāḥ prakṛterdevyā darśanaṃ me’dya jāyate | dhanyo’smi kṛtakṛtyo’smi prasaṃpūrṇatamo’smi ca || 1.169.10 0|| adya me nu jaganmāturdarśanaṃ tava jāyate | mama putrī svarūpā tvaṃ jaganmātā samāgatā || 101 || ato me kaḥ paro lābho yatra devāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ | tvaṃ hi sā paramā śaktiranantā parameṣṭhinī || 1 02|| tvameva paramānandā tvamevānandadāyinī | tvayaiva saṃgato devaḥ svātmānandaṃ samaśnute || 1 03|| śivaṃ sarvagataṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ brahma sanātanam | tvayi tiṣṭhatyabhedena parabrahmamayī sthitā || 1 04|| namaste’stu mahādevi namaste parameśvari | namo bhagavatīśāni śivāyai te namonamaḥ || 1 05|| tvanmayo’haṃ tvadādhārastvameva ca gatirmama | tvāmeva śaraṇaṃ yāmi prasīda parameśvari || 106 || mayā nāsti samo loke devo vā dānavo’pi vā | jaganmāteva matputrī saṃbhūtā sā svayaṃ yataḥ || 1 07|| eṣā tavāmbāsiknī vīrakanyakāpyaho | jaganmātuśca mātādya cāho’syāḥ puṇyagauravam || 1 08|| pāhi māmamareśāni cāsiknyā saha sarvadā | namāmi tava pādābbjaṃ vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ śivam || 109 || aho me sumahadbhāgyaṃ mahādevīsamāgamāt | ājñāpaya mahādevi kiṃ kariṣyāmi śāṃkari || 1.169.11 0|| etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ tadā dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ | samprekṣamāṇo gaurīṃ tāṃ prāṃjaliḥ pārśvataḥ sthitaḥ || 111 || dhyātavān svasutāṃ devīṃ parabrahmātmikāṃ satīm | aśeṣakalyāṇamayīṃ sarvavikṛtipāragām || 11 2|| ādimadhyāntarahitāṃ tamasaḥ parataḥ sthitām | jagatprasūtiṃ vedāntavijñānagamyavigrahām || 1 13|| ānandamātrāṃ praṇavābhidhānāṃ śaraṇapradām | sarvabhūtāntarasthāṃ ca prakṛtipuruṣābhidhām || 1 14|| pradhānapūruṣarūpāṃ prāṇarūpāṃ manomayīm | sarvāśrayāṃ sarvatragāṃ śuklāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ ca lohitām || 115 || aiśvaryavijñānamūrtiṃ dharmamūrti sumuktidām | mahāviṣṇusvarūpāṃ ca hiraṇyāṃḍamayīṃ tathā || 1 16|| parameṣṭhipadavyāptāṃ vairājīṃ sauraśaktikām | sahasrakarapādāsyāṃ jale nārāyaṇātmikām || 1 17|| saṃhāradharmasaṃdhartrīṃ yugāntakṣayasaṃjñitām | phaṇāsahasrabhogīndrāṃ raudrīṃ netratrayānvitām || 1 18|| sukomalāṃgāṃ bālikārūpāṃ śubhrāṃ sutāṃ nijām | ādimadhyāntasaṃsthāṃ ca jñātavān dakṣarā ṭ parām || 119 || tato’mbikā śivaṃ smṛtvā pitaraṃ prāha sasmitam | bhaktyā tvananyayā tāta madbhāvaṃ gantumarhasi || 1.169.120 || sarvayajñatapodānaistadrūpamāpyate nahi | yanme sākṣātparaṃ rūpamaiśvaraṃ dṛṣṭamadbhutam || 121 || tanniṣṭhastatparo bhūtvā tadeva śaraṇaṃ vraja | tadeva manasā paśya taddhyāyasva yajasva tat || 1 22|| ahaṃ tvāṃ parayā bhaktyā caiśvaraṃ yogamāsthitam | saṃsārasāgarādasmāduddharāmyacireṇa tu || 122 || dhyānena karmayogena bhaktyā jñānena caiva hi | prāpyāhaṃ te prajāpate nānyathā karmakoṭibhiḥ || 124|| śrutismṛtyuditaṃ samyak karma varṇāśramātmakam | adhyātmajñānasahitaṃ muktaye satataṃ kuru || 125 || dharmātsaṃjāyate bhaktirbhaktyā saṃprāpyate param | śrutyudito yajñadharmo vedāddharmo hi nirbabhau || 126 || mamaivaiṣā parā saṃjñā vedarūpā purātanī | na ca vedādṛte kiñcicchāstraṃ dharmābhidhāyakam || 1 27|| varṇānāmanukampārthaṃ manniyogādvirāṭsvayam | svāyaṃbhuvo manurbhūtvā vedadharmān sa uktavān || 128|| antarhiteṣu dharmeṣu yugānteṣu maharṣayaḥ | brahmaṇo vacanāttāni darśayanti yuge yuge || 129 || brahmaṇā saha te sarve saṃprāpte pratisaṃcare | harerante kṛtātmānaḥ praviśanti paraṃ padam || 1.169.130 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena dharmārthaṃ vedamāśrayet | dharmajñānayutā bhaktiḥ paraṃbrahma prakāśayet || 131 || etādṛśaṃ mayā rūpaṃ kathaṃ sandarśitaṃ śṛṇu | nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ brahma nārāyaṇī tathaiva ca || 132|| bāhyadṛṣṭyā tayorbhedo na tvāntaradṛśā manāk | sa eva tu paraṃbrahma kvacitkṛṣṇaḥ prajāyate || 13 2|| sa eva rādhā bhavati yatheṣṭaṃ viharatyapi | sa eva ca paraṃbrahma nārāyaṇo bhavatyapi || 1 34|| nārāyaṇī ramā lakṣmīḥ sa eva saṃprajāyate | yatheṣṭaṃ ca viharati nāsti bhedo manāgapi || 1 35|| paraṃbrahma sa vai brahmā brahmāṇī jāyate tathā | sa eva viṣṇurbhavati vaiṣṇavyapi sa eva saḥ || 1 36|| śivo rudraḥ sa evāsti rudrāṇī ca śivaiva saḥ | ahaṃ satī śivā raudrī tava gehe prakāśitā || 1 37|| parabrahmasvarūpāsmi śivārthaṃ tyāgatāsmi ca | parabrahmasvarūpaśca śivo’pi bhagavān svayam || 1 38|| kailāse rājate devo devyahaṃ te gṛhe sthitā | tasmātsarvaprakāreṇa madbhakto matparāyaṇaḥ || 1 39|| māmevārcaya sarvatra manasā śaraṇaṃ gataḥ | yadyatsvarūpaṃ me tāta manaso gocaraṃ tava || 1.169.140 || tanniṣṭhastatparo bhūtvā tadarcanaparo bhava | saḥ śivaśca tvayā tātābhyarthanīyo madarthakaḥ || 141 || dātavyā ca śivāyaiva śāśvatī te sutā śivā | dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya niyogād brahmaṇastathā || 142||| asiknyāśca samutpannā tvāmeva pitaraṃ śritā | pradāsyase mahendrāya prasīdati sa śaṃkaraḥ || 143||| tena devādayaḥ sarve tvāṃ namasyanti bhāvataḥ | arpitayā mayā sākaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja || 144|| ityupadiśya dakṣāya satī bālā hyajāyata | dakṣastutoṣa paramaṃ sutāṃ jñātvā pareśvarīm || 145|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vibhāvaryāḥ satījanma maṃgalamahotsavaḥ dakṣāya divyasatī darśanaṃ stutiḥ sutādhyānam śivāśivayoḥ parabrahmaṇaikyaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonasaptatyadhikaśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 169 ||
<1.170> śrīlakṣmīruvāca nanu vibhāvarī keyaṃ yā satī dakṣaputrikā | jātā brahmātmikā devī saṃśayaṃ chindhi me hare || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi satī vibhāvarī rātriryathābhavat | goloke dhāmni bhagavān śrīmān kṛṣṇo virājate || 2 || parabrahmasvarūpaḥ sa golokādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ | mahāmāyā ca yā mūlā prakṛtirbrahmavāmagā || 3 || kṛṣṇavāme sthitā kvāpi līnarūpā virājate | naikākī ramate kṛṣṇaḥ sa tadaicchad dvitīyakam || 4 || tadā kṛṣṇasya vāmāṃgādāvirāsa sukanyakā | dhāvitvānīya kusumaṃ rājacampakavṛkṣajam || 5 || kṛṣṇasya caraṇe nyasya svayaṃ rāse dadhāra ca | tena rādhā tadā proktā kāryasiddhikarī tu sā || 6 || kāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ saha nītvā vṛkṣakuṃje viveśa sā | ratyānandaṃ dadātyasmai so’pi ratipramūrchanām || 7 || avāpa cāpi ca nidrāṃ supravṛtte mahāsukhe | rādhā prāha tadā kṛṣṇaṃ kiṃ na kṛṣṇaḥ praceṣṭase || 8 || kṛṣṇaḥ prāha priye nidrā samāyātā kṣaṇaṃ śramāt | rādhā kruddhā tadā nidropari nidrāpi bālikā || 9 || bhūtvā pārśve sthitā namrā kṛṣṇanetre vihāya vai | dṛṣṭvā prāha tadā rādhā re nidre ratikhaṇḍike || 1.170.10 || māstu golokavāsaste gaccha vairājapūruṣe | sarvānandanāśayitrī tāmasī rudrasaṃgatā || 11 || bhava tāmasabhāvā tvaṃ devī saṃhāriṇī sadā | abhāvapratyayādhārā vṛttirnidrā vināśinī || 12|| ghorā hyāsuranāśāya paryāptā bhava sarvadā | daityasainyeṣu nityaṃ tvaṃ sannaddhā bhava tāmasī || 13|| sṛṣṭau sarvatra jīvānāmindriyeṣu virāmikā | bhava sthitiṃ kṛtavatī rudrāṇī rudrasaṃgatā || 14|| rānārthasya hi bhānasya antrī rātrirbhaviṣyasi | bhānaṃ ca vigataṃ yasmādvibhāvarī bhaviṣyasi || 15|| vairājaputrīṃ tvāṃ brahma svayaṃ sṛṣṭau grahīṣyati | sa ca vibhāvarīṃ devīṃ dakṣāya putrikātmikām || 16|| dāsyati pravarāṃ kanyāṃ dakṣaḥ satīṃ tu śaṃbhave | sā kālī caṇḍikā devī hyasurān nāśayiṣyati || 17|| sā tvaṃ kālī tathā rātrirvibhāvarī ca nidrikā | rudrasahacarī bhūtvā vihariṣyasi tāmasī || 18|| ityādeśāddhareḥ kāmādbhāvikāryavaśāttathā | vibhāvarī satī rātrirdakṣakanyā babhūva sā || 1 9|| śrīlakṣmīruvāca nanu śaṃbhuryadotpanno vairājātpuruṣāttadā | sahaiva śāṃbhavī śaktiḥ protpannā śrūyate tu yā ||1.170.20 || tasyāḥ śivāyā asyāśca rātryā bhedo’sti vā na vā | śivā tu sarvadā patnī rātrirjāyāparāsti kim || 21|| śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca yogyaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā devi gahanaṃ mama ceṣṭitam | nānyaistu jñāyate caitatkadā kiṃkimabhūditi || 22|| śṛṇu pūrvaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ jñātavyaṃ bhavatīti yat | kathayāmi kathāśeṣaṃ śivasyānādibhāvanam ||23||| nārāyaṇaḥ sarvapatiḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam | akṣare ca pare dhāmni rājate muktasevitaḥ ||24|| yathecchati yadā sṛṣṭiṃ tadā tāṃ sṛjjati dhruvam | tadā tena kṛtaṃ kīdṛk prasaṃgātkathayāmi te ||25|| parabrahmaṇa evāṃgād rādhā yadopajāyata | tadarthaṃ dhāma golokaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rūpaṃ cakāra ca ||26|| sā ca kṛṣṇasya patnyāsītprāṇebhyo’pi garīyasī | devī ṣoḍaśavarṣīyā prodbhinnanavayauvanā ||27|| vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā komalāṃgī samujjvalā | puṣṭanitambabhārārtā sundarī sumanoharā ||28||| raktamṛdusundarauṣṭhā pīnaśroṇipayodharā | muktāpaṃktisamacaṃcaddantapaktimanoharā ||29|| koṭipārvaṇacandrātiriktatejobharānanā | padmapatrāyatanetrā keśaveśādimaṇḍitā ||1.170.30|| tilapuṣpaśukacañcusamanāsātisundarā | svarṇavarṇasamagaṇḍayugmakāntibahūjjvalā ||3 1 || dhṛtasvarṇamaṇiratnabhūṣākarṇasuśobhanā | candanāgurukastūrīsindūrakuṃkumādibhiḥ ||32|| kapālayoḥ kṛtapatrā puṣpagrathitadhammilā | kṛtasṛtisasindūrarekhākabarīmastakā ||33|| sthalapadmadalakāntilasaccaraṇasacalā | haṃsahastigatidyotadvakṣaḥpiṇḍobhamantharā ||34|| ratnahārānmaṇihārān vanamālāṃ manoharām | hārān hīrakanirmāṇān ratnakeyūrakaṃkaṇam ||35|| sadratnasāranirmāṇavalayān ratnavaṃgadāḥ | svarṇakiṃkiṇikāguṃjadraśanāṃ dadhatī satī ||36|| amūlyaratnanirmāṇakvaṇanmaṃjīraraṃjitā | nānāprakāraratnāḍhyapadmakaṃ paribibhratī ||37|| alaktaspṛśakarapattalanakhauṣṭhamaṃjulā | uvāsa sasmitā bhartuḥ ratnasiṃhāsanārdhake |||38|| athāsyā lomakūpebhyaḥ sadyo gopāṃganāgaṇaḥ | veśarūpākṛtibhistatsamaḥ susthirayauvanaḥ || 39|| lakṣakoṭipramātaśca goloke gopikāgaṇaḥ | prāvirbabhūva vai śaśvatkṛṣṇadāsīsamāhvayaḥ ||1.170.40 || kṛṣṇasya lomakūpebhyaḥ sadyo gopagaṇo’pyatha | āvirbabhūva vai śaśvadrūpaveśādibhiḥ samaḥ ||41|| triṃśatkoṭipramātaśca kṛṣṇadāsagaṇaḥ sa hi | kṛṣṇasya lomakūpebhyaḥ sadyaścāvirbabhūva ca ||42|| bahuvarṇo gogaṇaśca śaśvatsusthirayauvanaḥ | surabhyaśca balīvardā vatsataryaśca vatsakāḥ |||43|| śobhanā maṃgalakarā hyāsan prādustadā śubhāḥ | teṣāmekaṃ balīvardaṃ koṭisiṃhasamaṃ bale ||44|| śaṃbhuvāhanalābhārthaṃ kṛṣṇo’rakṣanmanoharam | kṛṣṇāṃghrinakharandhrebhyo haṃsapaktiḥ supāṇḍurā ||45||| āvirbabhūva śaśvatstrīpuṃlakṣmātisundarā | teṣāmekaṃ rājahaṃsaṃ vedhovāhanalabdhaye ||46|| kṛṣṇo’rakṣatsudhavalaṃ mahābalaparākramam | kṛṣṇasya vāmakarṇasya vivarātsumanoharaḥ ||47|| gaṇaḥ śvetaturaṃgāṇāmāvirbabhūva nityakaḥ | teṣāṃ śvetatamaṃ tvekaṃ dharmavāhanalabdhaye ||48|| kṛṣṇo’rakṣaddadau cānyānsurebhyo bhagavān svayam | kṛṣṇasya dakṣakarṇasya vivarācchobhanākṛtiḥ ||49|| prāvirbhūtā sihapaṃktirmahābalaparākramā | teṣāmekaṃ dadau kṛṣṇo vibhāvaryai mahābalam ||1.170.50 || bhogyaṃ yadyat tadāpekṣya kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇena yoginā | tathā sarvagataṃ divyaṃ cakāra rathapaṃcakam ||51 || vividharatnakhacitaṃ manoyāyi mahattaram | lakṣayojanāyataṃ ca śatayojanamūrdhvagam ||52|| lakṣacakraṃ vāyuraṃho lakṣakrīḍāgṛhānvitam | bhogyaśṛṃgāratalpādivihārodyānarājitam ||53|| ratnapradīpalakṣāṇāṃ prakāśāśca gṛhe gṛhe | divyatoraṇakalaśadhvajacitrādibṛṃhitam ||54|| ratnadarpaṇacāmarachatramuktāgavākṣakam | maṇīndramuktāmāṇikyahīrahārasuśobhitam ||55|| nīlaraktapiśaṃgapāṇḍurapaṃkajaśobhanam | ekasteṣu pradatto vaikuṇṭhavāsisvarūpiṇe ||56|| aparo’vyākṛtavāsibhūmne’rpitaḥ svarūpiṇe | tṛtīyastu mahāviṣṇusvarūpāya svarūpiṇe ||57|| caturtho rādhikāyai ca paṃcamaḥ svāya rakṣitaḥ | āvirbabhūvuḥ kṛṣṇasya guhyadeśāttu guhyakāḥ ||58|| kubero guhyakeśaśca sundarī guhyakī tathā | atha kṛṣṇasya mukhato hyāvirbhūtāśca pārṣadāḥ ||59|| pītavastrā vanamālādharāḥ śyāmāścaturbhujāḥ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakirīṭaratnakuṇḍalāḥ ||1.170.60 || nārāyaṇāya vaikuṇṭhe dadau caturbhujān bahūn | dvibhujāḥ śyāmalā kṛṣṇasadṛśāḥ pārṣadāḥ kṛtāḥ ||6 1 || vaiṣṇavā dāsyadāsāśca kṛtāḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ | rakṣitāḥ svīyasevāyāṃ dhyāyantaścaraṇāmbujam ||62|| āvirbabhūva kṛṣṇasya vāmanetrāt triśūladhṛk | śvetavarṇastāmasaśca trinetro bhālacandrakaḥ ||63||| vyāghracarmadharo haste ḍamaruṃ dhārayan jaṭī | sa īśāno mahābhāgo dikpālānāmadhīśvaraḥ ||64|| tathā triśūlapaṭṭīśadharāśca candraśekharāḥ | trinetrāśca mahākāyā gaṇāścānye babhūvire ||65|| surāstrikoṭisaṃkhyātāḥ kṛṣṇamūrteḥ pratisthalāt | prādurbabhūvuḥ sarve te yathāsthānamavasthitāḥ ||66|| ratirmūrtiśca sāvitrī manoramā sarasvatī | mahālakṣmīḥ satī lakṣmīrbabhūvurhṛdayāmbujāt ||67|| nārāyaṇāya pradadau mahālakṣmīṃ sarasvatīm | sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇe prādāt mūrtiṃ dharmāya sādaram ||68|| ratiṃ kāmāya rūpāḍhyāṃ kuberāya manoramām | lakṣmīṃ ca viṣṇave prādāt satīṃ śivāya cārpayat|||69 || śivaḥ prāha tadā yogī praṇataḥ kṛṣṇamacyutam | adhunāhaṃ na gṛhṇāmi prakṛtiṃ prākṛto yathā ||1.170.70|| yogajñānabrahmacaryadāsyabhaktivirodhinīm | muktīcchābandhakartrī ca sakāmāṃ kāmavardhinīm ||71 || tapasyānāśinīṃ cittasantoṣabhakṣikāṃ kṣudhām | bhavakārāgrahe ghore dṛḍhanigaḍarūpiṇīm ||72|| śaśvadvibuddhijananīṃ sadbuddhicchedakāriṇīm | sadā bhogārthasārāṃ ca viṣayecchāvivardhinīm ||73|| malamūtramayīṃ vallīṃ dehataruprabandhanām | ratikāryādhikakākṣepiṇīṃ svārthatanmayīm ||74|| svātantryanāśinīṃ śokamohasthānamayīṃ dṛḍhām | dhāraṇādhyānaguptāṃgāṃ brahmadhyānavirodhinīm ||75|| necchāmi gṛhiṇīṃ nātha varaṃ dehi madīpsitam | tvadbhaktau dāsabhāve ca prema saṃvardhate’niśam ||76|| tvannāmajapane pādasevane’rcanakarmaṇi | śravaṇe kīrtane stotre smaraṇe mitrabhāvane ||77|| sarvadā jāgrati svapne tvayyeva prabhramāmyaham | tṛptirjāyeta naiva tvaddhyāne yoge tapassu ca ||78|| tavāvāhanāsanācāmanābhisnānasevane | gandhapuṣpadhūpavastradīpacandanacarcane ||79|| naivedyajalatāmbūlārārtrikastutivandane | namaskārapradakṣiṇālaṃkṛtisatphalārpaṇe ||1.170.80 || samarpaṇe cātmanaśca nityaprasādabhojane | tṛptiryathā na jāyeta tathā dehi dayānidhe ||8 1 || sārṣṭisālokyasārūpyasāmīpyasāmyalīnatāḥ | tava bhaktisukhāṃśasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||82|| aṇimā laghimā prāptiḥ prākāmyaṃ mahimā tathā | īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca sarvakāmāvasāyitā ||83|| sārvajñyaṃ dūradarśitvaṃ dūrasaṃśravaṇaṃ tathā | parakāyapraveśaśca vāksiddhiḥ kalpavallitā ||84|| janināśamahāśaktiḥ tathāmaratvamityapi | siddhayaḥ ṣoḍaśa bhakteḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||85|| yogāstapāṃsi dānāni vratānyanaśanāni ca | yaśaḥ kīrtirvacaḥsatyaṃ dharmastīrthaṃ surārcanam ||86|| devārcādarśanaṃ sarvabhūmimaṇḍalaprakramam | sarvasvargasukhābhogaḥ sarvābdhisnānamityapi ||87|| avabhṛthāni sarvāṇi brahmaviṣṇumaheśatā | vairājatā cāpi tato’nyavidhāḥ smṛddhayaśca yāḥ ||88|| tava bhaktikalāṃśasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm | tasmād bhaktiṃ vinā cānyannaiva prārthyaṃ mayā vibho ||89|| na satī na śaṭhī me cāpekṣyate prakṛtī hyubhe | viraktau yādṛśaṃ saukhyaṃ sānurāge na tādṛśam ||1.170.90 || śrutvaivaṃ śāṃkaraṃ vākyaṃ bhagavānprāha sasmitam | yadīdānīṃ tvayā śaṃbho neṣyate prakṛtiḥ satī ||9 1|| sā vasatu mama netre yoganidrāmayī śivā | yadāvaśyakatā te syāttadā dāsye vibhāvarīm ||92|| tāvatkālaṃ mama sevāṃ netrayoḥ saṃkariṣyati | ityabhidhāya bhagavān jagrāha netrayoḥ śivām ||93|| śaṃbhuṃ ca dāsyasevāyāmarakṣadvaiṣṇavaṃ sutam | prāha kṛṣṇastadā śaṃbhuṃ matsevāṃ kuru sarvathā ||94|| yāvat te’vaśyakāryaṃ ca sṛṣṭau naivopatiṣṭhate | tapasvisiddhayogijñasuravaiṣṇavapūjitaḥ ||95|| vasātrāmarabhāvaṃ ca labha mṛtyuṃjayo bhava | vedaśāstrādisārvaśyasiddhiṃ prāpnuhi madvarāt ||96|| asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāṃ nāśaṃ līlayātraiva paśya vai | jñānena tejasā śaktyā vayasā yaśasā śriyā ||97|| parākrameṇa tapasā mahasā matsamo bhava | mama prāṇādadhikastvaṃ preyān bhaktottamaḥ śiva ||98|| mamoktaṃ vacanaṃ sārthaṃ kāle kartuṃ tvamarhasi | tava vākyaṃ pālayāmi putra tvaṃ madgṛhe vasa ||99|| madvākyaṃ ca svavākyaṃ ca pālanīyaṃ kariṣyasi | kāle gṛhītvā prakṛtiṃ śṛṃgāraṃ ca kariṣyasi || 1.170.10 0|| na kevalaṃ tapasvī tvaṃ ceśvaro matsamo mahān | kāle gṛhī tathā kāle tapasvī bhava vāñchayā || 101 || duḥkhaṃ tu dārasaṃyoge yat tvayā kathitaṃ śṛṇu | kustrī dadāti duḥkhaṃ ca svāmine na pativratā || 1 02|| mahatkulaprasūtā yā satkulā kulamāninī | karoti sukhinaṃ kāntaṃ sevayātmārpaṇāhvayā || 103 || patirbandhuḥ patirbhartā patiḥ paramadaivatam | patireva paraṃbrahma patiḥ svaṃ kulayoṣitām || 1 04|| patito’patito vāpi kṛpaṇaśceśvaro dṛḍhaḥ | śithilo vāpi sarvasvaṃ patirvai kulayoṣitām || 1 05|| asatkulaprasūtā yā pitrorduḥśīlamiśritā | dhruvaṃ sā parabhogyā syāt patinindā parā sadā || 1 06|| patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ patirviṣṇuḥ patiḥ śaṃbhuḥ sadā mama | patideve sarvadevā dṛśyante kulayoṣitām || 1 07|| etādṛśī tu te sādhvī śivāsti mahatī satī | bhavitā sā śivā śaivī prakṛtirvaiṣṇavī śiva || 1 08|| goloke vasa deveśa yāvatsṛṣṭau na te kṛtiḥ | matsamādhau sadā magno mama sevāparaśca vā || 1 09|| ityabhidhāya kṛṣṇastaṃ svasevāyāmarakṣayat | golokasyaikadivase vairājānāṃ sahasrakam || 1.170.11 0|| naśyati tatra kā saṃkhyā kṣudrabrahmāṇḍavedhasām | yadā vairājadehācca brahmā viṣṇurbhaviṣyataḥ || 111 || tadā tejaḥpravāhe vai bhaviṣyati sadāśivaḥ | tejo liṃgaṃ śivo mūrtirloke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati || 11 2|| śivapārśvagatā sādhvī śivā saha bhaviṣyati | tataḥ kālāntare dakṣaputrī satī bhaviṣyati || 11 3||| bhagavāṃśca tataḥ prāha śivāṃ netrādhivāsinīm | adhunā tiṣṭha vatse tvaṃ goloke mama netrayoḥ || 1 14|| kāle bhajiṣyasi śaṃbhuṃ virāṭputraṃ śivāyanam | tejaḥsu sarvadevānāmāvirbhūya tataḥ punaḥ || 1 15|| saṃhṛtya daityānsarvāṃśca bhavitā vindhyavāsinī | bhavitā dakṣakanyā ca suśīlā śaṃbhugehinī || 1 16|| tataḥ śarīraṃ santyajya yajñe bhartustu nindayā | menāyāṃ śailabhāryāyāṃ bhavitā pārvatīti ca || 1 17|| bahukāryakarī krūrā caṇḍikā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi | bahunāmnī bahurūpā tāmasī tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 1 18|| paṃcāyatanadeveṣu śivā śivaśca tatsutaḥ | mukhyāḥ sarveṣu viśveṣu bhaviṣyantyeva madvarāt || 1 19|| grāmeṣu nagareṣveva pūjitā grāmadevatā | bhavatī bhavitā tatra bhinnanāmādidhāriṇī || 1.170.120|| bhaviṣyanti mahāntaśca tatra te paricārakāḥ | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ siddhārthaphalalipsavaḥ || 1 21|| ye tvāṃ tatra bhajiṣyante pṛthvyāṃ puṇye sutīrthake | teṣāṃ yaśaśca kīrtiścaiśvaryaṃ vardhiṣyate bahu || 122|| ityāśīrbhiḥ śivāṃ śarvaṃ toṣayāmāsa mādhavaḥ | śarvaṃ rarakṣa sevāyāṃ śivāṃ rarakṣa netrayoḥ || 1 22|| netrasthatvācchivā jātā nidrā sukhakarī sadā | nidrā vibhāvarī rātriścaikaiva nāparā tu sā || 124|| sā kṛṣṇahṛdayājjātā śivā netradvaye sthitā | rādhikāvacanāt nidrā gatā vairājanetrayoḥ || 125|| sārdhaṃ ca śaṃbhunā tatra śivā nityābhivyaṃjitā | saiva nārāyaṇasyendriyeṣu dugdhābdhike sthitā || 126|| saiva sarvāgryadevānāmindriyavrātasaṃsthitā | saiva śeṣaśayānaśrīnārāyāṇendriyāditaḥ || 127|| śivā śaktiryoganidrā rātrirvibhāvarī satī | kātyāyanī kauśikī caṇḍikā kālī ca pārvatī || 128|| kramayogādyathāpekṣaṃ yathākāryaṃ prakāśitā | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi satīrūpaṃ sadātmakam || 1 29|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satīcaritre goloke rādhāratau kṛṣṇanetranidrāyai śāpaḥ śrīkṛṣṇāṃgebhyo rādhāgopagopīgogaṇahaṃsaśvetaturagasiṃharathapaṃcakaśivaśivāmahālakṣmīsarasvatīratimūrtisāvitryādyāvirbhāvaḥ satyāḥ śivārpaṇe śivavairāgyaṃ kṛṣṇanetrasthaśivāyā vairājaputrītvaṃ tato devendriyajakātyāyanītvaṃ dakṣaputrīsatītvaṃ himālayaputrīpārvatītvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 170||
<1.171> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha vairājapuruṣāt nābhau padme’bhavat tvajaḥ | viṣṇuśca hṛdayājjātastadā vai viṣṇupadmajau || 1|| mahāmahaṃ mahām̐ścāhamitiśraiṣṭhyavivādinau | tayormadhye mahattejaḥkiraṇaṃ samabhūttadā ||2|| tatra devastṛtīyo vai śaṃbhuḥ prādurbabhūva ha | golokātpreṣitaścāsyāṇḍasya devādhivṛttaye ||3|| śrīkṛṣṇena svayaṃ cātra preṣitaḥ śaṃkaro mudā | vaiṣṇavo bhaktavaryaśca samutpanno harīcchayā ||4|| harestadaiva kiraṇaṃ mūrterverājanetrayoḥ | samāgatya babhūvātisthiraṃ tasya prabhāvataḥ ||5|| lalāṭātsa samutpannaḥ kiraṇāḍhyo maheśvaraḥ | kiraṇaṃ divyabāṇaṃ vaiṃ brahmaṇaścihnameva tat|||6 || maheśastatra vairājātmajo jātaḥ sutāmasaḥ | śivā ca tasya dehe vai vāmabhāge’prakāśitā ||7|| kṛṣṇājñayā samāyātā śivo vetti na tāṃ tadā | śivo jānāti caikaṃ svaṃ devaṃ tatra śivāṃ vinā ||8|| kintvadṛśyā śivā śaṃbhorvāme śaktisvarūpiṇī | āsīd yā kṛṣṇanetrasthā saivāsīcchivanetrayoḥ ||9|| brahmaṇā preritā rātriḥ sā saṃbabhūva dākṣiṇī | satītināma saṃcakre tasyā dakṣastadājñayā || 1.171.10 || atha tāṃ ca sutāṃ mātā susaṃskṛtya yathocitam | śiśupānena vidhinā tasyai stanyādikaṃ dadau || 1 1|| pālitā sātha vīriṇyāsiknyā dakṣeṇa vavṛdhe | tasyāṃ susadguṇāḥ sarve viviśuḥ śaiśave’pi vai || 12|| sakhīmadhyagatā krīḍācaraṇe’pi svabhāvataḥ | lilekha śaṃbhudevasya pratimāṃ vai kvacitkvacit || 13 || bālyociteṣu gīteṣu jagau rudraṃ haraṃ muhuḥ | hare tvevaṃ bhaktimatī sasmāra smaranāśakam || 14|| tasyāṃ pitroḥ sukaruṇā vavṛdhe’tīva nityadā | bālāpi guṇavṛddhā sā toṣayāmāsa janmadau || 15 || ekadā nārado brahmā jagmaturdakṣamandiram | dṛṣṭā tābhyāṃ dakṣapārśve tvāsīnā sā satī śubhā || 16 || pitrā namaskṛtau cobhau satyā cāpi namaskṛtau | praṇāmānte satīṃ vīkṣya dakṣadattaśubhāsane || 17|| sthitāvātithyavidhinā satkṛtāvūcaturmudā | brahmā prāha muniṃ paśya nāradevaṃ maheśvarī || 18|| kasya bhāryā suyogyā syād rekhāḥ paśyātha māṃ vada | nāradastatra deveśīṃ natvā prāha sukanyake || 1 9|| ehi paśyāmi te hastarekhāḥ kā bhavasīti yat | vihasya kanyayā hastatale sandarśite tadā ||1.171.20 || dhanurmīnastathā ketuḥ svastikaśca triśūlakam | pradīpaḥ kamalaṃ bāṇoṃ’kuśaḥ śaṃkhaśca cakrakam || 21 || paraśuḥ sāyakaḥ śaktiḥ ṣaḍvāme ṣaṭ ca dakṣiṇe | kramāddhaste nāradena dṛṣṭānyetāni rekhayā ||022|| lalāṭe’kṣi tṛtīyaṃ ca kalā candrasya vakragā | hṛdye śivamūrtiśca svarṇarekhāmayī śubhā ||23|| nābherūrdhvaṃ carmacihnamadhaśca karavālakam | dhanurbāṇena yuktaṃ ca padoḥ siṃho vṛṣastathā ||24|| śikharaṃ vallikā nāgadalaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ tathā | ūrdhve rekhe sarpaphaṇā dṛṣṭānyetāni rekhayā || 25 || kathitaṃ brahmaṇe cāpi dakṣāya nāradena tu | neyaṃ vai mānavī putrī nāpi daivī na cāparā ||26|| jaganmātā gurūṇāṃ ca gurvī parā tu vaiṣṇavī | kṛṣṇāṃganā ca vā nārāyaṇavāmā pareśvarī ||27|| brahmāṃganā ca vā viṣṇoraṃganā parameśvarī | śivāṃganā bhavedyadvā nānyā syājjagadaṃbikā |||28|| manye’syā hṛdi śarvo’sti netracandrau lalāṭake | kare triśūlarekhāsti caraṇe vṛṣabho hariḥ ||29|| ataḥ śivasya ratnaṃ syānnānyasya kasyacid dhruvam | salajjādhomukhī śrutvā bhūtvā vihasya satvaram ||1.171.30 || gṛhāntare jagāmātha mātre nyavedayacca tat | asiknyā ca gṛhāttatra bahirāgatya tau tadā ||3 1 || namaskṛtau jalabhojyaphalādyaiśca prapūjitau | dakṣeṇa vanditau vṛddhau satī tāvadgṛhātpunaḥ ||32|| bhargacitraṃ svalikhitaṃ nītvā bahirupāgatā | sahāsā darśitavatī omityarthaṃ maharṣaye || 33||| nanāma nāradaṃ sā ca brahmāṇaṃ praṇanāma sā | brahmā prāha tadānīṃ mastake datvā karāṃjalim ||34|| yastvāṃ kāmayate yaṃ tvaṃ tathā kāmayase sati | tamāpnuhi patiṃ devaṃ sarvajñaṃ jagadī śvaram ||35|| yo nānyāṃ jagṛhe nāpi gṛhṇāti na grahīṣyati | jāyāṃ sa te patirbhūyādananyasadṛśaḥ śubhe ||36|| ityuktvā suciraṃ tāṃ vai sthitvā dakṣālaye punaḥ | visṛṣṭau tena saṃyātau svasthānaṃ tau samudraje ||37|| dakṣo’bhavat tadā prīto manyamānaḥ svadhanyatām | satī ca vardhamānāpa kiṃcidyauvanabhāvanām ||38||| dakṣaśca cintayāmāsa satīyogyaṃ varaṃ śivam | bālyaṃ vyatītaṃ putryā me kaumāryaṃ vigataṃ tathā |||39|| prodbhinnāntarvayoyuktāmudvāhārhasukanyakām | tapobhiḥ svarṇarūpāḍhyāṃ dāsye bhargāya sarvathā ||1.171.40|| satī svayaṃ tathā bhargaṃ prāptumaicchat hṛdantare | pituśca nirṇayaṃ jñātvā mātaraṃ prāha sā satī ||41|| śaṃkarasya kṛte mātastapovratādi darśaya | tavājñayā vrataṃ kurve śivasantoṣaṇāya vai ||42|| māturājñāṃ tu sā labdhvā śivaṃ prāptuṃ dṛḍhavratā | gṛhe tvārādhayāmāsa vrataiśca vividhaiḥ satī ||43 || īṣaśuklāṣṭamīnandātithāvānarca śaṃkaram | guḍaudanaiḥ salavaṇaiḥ ṣoḍaśādyupacārakaiḥ ||44|| kārtikasya caturdaśyāmapūpaiḥ pāyasairapi | ṣoḍaśādyupacāraiśca pupūja śaṃkaraṃ satī ||45|| mārgaśīrṣe’sitāṣṭamyāṃ satilaiḥ sa yavaudane | ṣoḍaśādyupacāraiśca pupūja śaṃkaraṃ satī ||46|| pauṣe tu śuklasaptamyāṃ kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi | prātaḥ sā kṛśarānnena pupūja śaṃkaraṃ satī ||47|| māghe tu pūrṇamāsyāṃ sā kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi | ārdravastrā nadītīre’karocchaṃkarapūjanam ||48|| phālgune śivarātryāṃ ca vrataṃ jāgaraṇaṃ niśi | śailūṣaiḥ ṣoḍaśārthaiśca sānarca taṃ divāniśam ||49|| caitre śuklacaturdaśyāṃ palāśairdamanaiḥ śivam | ṣoḍaśādyupacāraiśca divā rātrāvapūjayat ||1.171.50|| rādhaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ tilāhārayavaudanaiḥ | navaiśca ṣoḍaśāthaiṃścāpūjayacchaṃkaraṃ satī ||5 1 || jyeṣṭhasya pūrṇimārātrau nirāhārā ca śaṃkaram | vasanairbṛhatīpuṣpairapūjayadvrate satī |||2|| āṣāḍhasya caturdaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ kṛṣṇa vāsasā | bṛhatīkusumaiḥ śaṃbhumapūjayadvrate satī |||5 3 || śrāvaṇasya sitāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ ca sā śivam | yajñopavītairvāsobhiḥ pavitrairapyapūjayat ||54|| bhādre kṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ bahupuṣpaphalaiḥ satī | pūjayitvā caturdaśyāṃ cakāra jalabhojanam ||55|| nānāvidhapatrapuṣpaphalaistatkālajaiḥ satī | cakre suniyatāhārādhikamāse śivavratam ||56|| nityaṃ ca sarvamāseṣu śivapūjāparāyaṇā | dṛḍhavratābhavadadevaṃ nānyat sasmāra taṃ vinā ||57|| itthaṃ nandāvrataṃ kṛtsnaṃ samāpya tāpasī satī | dadhyau śivaṃ vyavasthāsu yoginīva kṛtādarā ||58 || kṛśākṛśāṃgī tapasā tejomūrtiḥ surūpiṇī | jātā śivamayī saumyā śivāṃkārhaṇatāṃ gatā ||59 || janmajayantyāṃ satyāśca dvādaśābde mahotsave | dakṣeṇākāritā devā manavo’nye maharṣayaḥ || 1.171.60 || tadā tu sarvato devā munayaścākhilāḥ priye | ahaṃ brahmā ca dikpālā lokapālāḥ surādayaḥ || 61 || āśīrvādān pradātuṃ ca jagmurdakṣagṛhe tadā | satkṛtāśca mahatyāṃ vai sabhāyāṃ sarvadevatāḥ ||62 || āśīrvādān daduḥ satyai praṇanāma satī ca tān | pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭā satī puṣṭā tapasārdhāpi nāsti yat ||6 3 || dṛṣṭvā satītapastādṛk jñātvā śivārthameva tat | prasannāḥ sarvadevādyāścakrurdevyai natiṃ muhuḥ || 64|| prāhuḥ sati tapaścātikaṣṭapradaṃ tu mā kuru | avaśyaṃ te patiḥ śarvo mahādevo bhaviṣyati || 65|| āśīrvādānprayujyaivaṃ gṛhītvārhaṇamityatha | praśaśaṃsustapastasyāḥ siddhāvasthāṃ gatāṃ satīm || 66 || dakṣoktiṃ ca satīcchāṃ ca samprāpya munayaḥ surāḥ | pūjāṃ prāpya satīṃ natvā jagmuḥ kailāsabhūbhṛtam || 67|| sāvitrīhito brahmā lakṣmīnārāyaṇastathā | ramayā sahito viṣṇurdevībhiḥ sahitāḥ surāḥ || 68|| saptarṣayaḥ svapatnībhiḥ sahitā manavastathā | jagmuḥ kailāsaśikharaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ ||69|| gatvā śaṃbhuṃ praṇamyaiva dṛṣṭvā śāntaṃ ca yoginam | tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotrairbaddhāṃjalipuṭā mudā ||1.171.70 || namo’kṣarasvarūpāya kṛṣṇanetrātmane namaḥ | namaḥ sadāśivākhyāya tejaḥpūjāya te namaḥ ||7 1|| vairājaputrarūpāya brahmacaryāya te namaḥ | namo brahmasvarūpāya sadā śāntāya te namaḥ |||72|| nirguṇāya guṇāḍhyāya vaiṣṇavāya namonamaḥ | avyaktarātridehāya nirvikārāya te namaḥ ||73|| maheśāya pareśāya śivādhipataye namaḥ | kvacicchāntikṛte kādācitkasaṃhāriṇe namaḥ ||74|| namaḥ śeṣāya saṃkarṣaṇasvarūpāya te namaḥ | namo vairāgyavāsāya satīrāgāya te namaḥ ||75|| na yasya devā ṛṣayaḥ siddhāḥ sādhvyaśca sādhavaḥ | viduḥ padaṃ svarūpaṃ ca tasmai śivāya te namaḥ ||76|| padaṃ didṛkṣavo yasya yatante yoginaḥ sadā | tasmai namaḥ pareśāya yogasthāya namonamaḥ ||77|| anantasiddhiyuktāya girāṃ dūrāya te namaḥ | nama ātmaprakāśāya nirvāṇasthāya te namaḥ ||78|| jñānine te namaścāstu niṣkriyāyātmavedine | tapasā drāk prasannāya sarvadātre ca te namaḥ ||79|| trinetrāya sacandrāya sarvādhyakṣāya te namaḥ | śaraṇāyātaprārthyārthalābhadāya ca te namaḥ ||1.171.8 0|| aiśvaryāṇāṃ pradātre te mokṣadāya ca te namaḥ | bhakteṣṭapūrakāyāmnāyodadhaye ca te namaḥ ||8 1 || svaprakāśāya nityāya pratyakdraṣṭre ca te namaḥ | sakāmā vātha niṣkāmā bhaktāste śaraṇāgatāḥ ||82|| aprāpya siddhiṃ yasmānna nivartante ca te namaḥ | kācitkanyā tvadarthaṃ vai karoti tapa utkaṭam ||83 || tvaṃ kathaṃ cākaruṇo’si prasanno bhava te namaḥ | lokakāryapravāhārthaṃ vicāraṃ kuru śaṃkara ||84|| adhyātmayogagamya tvāṃ praṇamāmaḥ stumo vayam | na tvaṃ devo’suro martyo na tiryaṅn dvijaḥ paśuḥ ||85|| na strī na ṣaṃḍho na pumān yo’si so’si ca te namaḥ | viśvalayakṛte viśvadhāriṇe praṇatā vayam ||86 || sāṃkhyā jñānena paśyanti samādhau yoginaśca yam | bhaktāḥ kṛpayā paśyanti trayīmayaṃ ca te namaḥ ||87|| namo bhaktoddhārakartre namaste gūḍhavarcase | namaḥ pratyakṣadevāya cāparokṣānubhūtaye ||88|| kālarātrivilāsāya dakṣaputryārthitāya ca | pravṛttāya namastubhyaṃ nivṛttāya ca te namaḥ ||89 || bhaktecchāpūraka svāmin pūrayecchāṃ ca vedhasaḥ | tūṣṇīmāsannitistutvā śrutvā śaṃbhurjahāsa vai || 1.171.90 || dṛṣṭvā devamunīṃścānyān sastrīkām̐śca yathocitam | svāgataṃ cātitheyaṃ ca kṛtvā papraccha kāraṇam || 91 || he viṣṇo he vidhe devā he munipravararṣayaḥ | nijāgamanahetuṃ vai kathayadhvaṃ yathārthataḥ || 92|| sastrīkā āgatāḥ sarve kiṃ kāryaṃ vidyate mama | iti pṛṣṭāstadā brahmā viṣṇunā parinoditaḥ || 93 || prāha śaṃbhuṃ miṣṭavāṇyā deva te’viditaṃ nahi | tathāpi lokadharmatvātkathanīyaṃ śṛṇu prabho || 94|| viśeṣataḥ sahārthārthā vayaṃ suranarādayaḥ | asurā vahudhā sṛṣṭau jāyante ca muhurmuhuḥ || 95|| tatra kecinmama vadhyā harervadhyāśca kecana | atikrūrāstava vadhyā devīvadhyāstathāpare || 96 || anye tvadvīryaputrasya vadhyāścāpi bhavanti vai | anāśayitvā tānduṣṭān jagatsvāsthyaṃ na nirbhayam || 97|| tvayi rāgadveṣaśūnye yogamārge sthite sati | dayāmātrasvabhāve te naṣṭā na syuḥ kadācana || 98|| tapaḥ prakurvatāṃ teṣāṃ varaiḥ puṣṭiryadi dhruvā | tadā tu sātviko sṛṣṭiḥ kathaṃ susthā bhaviṣyati || 99 || ataśca bhavitā yuktamayukteṣūcchriteṣu vai | sṛṣṭisthityantakarpāṇi kāryāṇyasmābhireva ha || 1.171.100 || vayaṃ tvekasvarūpā hi bhinnāḥ kāryasya bhedataḥ | kāryabhedo na siddhaśced rūpabhedo’prayojanaḥ || 101 || ahaṃ viṣṇuśca sastrīkau sujātau kāryahetutaḥ | tathā tvamapi sastrīko bhava viśvahitāya vai || 10 2|| parigṛhṇīṣva bhāryārthe rāmāmekāṃ suśobhanām | striyaṃ vivāhya lokasya kuru kāryaṃ mahattamam || 103 || yathā padmālayā viṣṇoḥ sāvitrī ca yathā mama | tathā sahacarīṃ śaṃbho kāntāṃ gṛhṇīṣva kāminīm || 1 04|| śaṃbhurvihasya brahmāṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca prāha tāttvikam | he brahman he hare me stho yuvāṃ priyatarau sadā || 1 05|| yuvayordarśanādadyānando me jāyate’dhikaḥ | bhavadbhyāṃ tu madarthaṃ yanniścitaṃ vyāvahārikam || 10 6|| yuktameva bhavet kintu me hṛdi rocate nahi | tapasvino viraktasya yogamārgātigasya ca || 1 07|| jñāninaḥ kāmaśūnyasya svātmārāmasya sarvathā | nivṛttasyātmadraṣṭuśca kāminyā kiṃ prayojanam || 108 || ātmano yogalagnasya mamānandaḥ sadāsti vai | nānyasaṃsargasaṃprāptānandaśeṣī bhavāmyaham || 1 09|| vivāho bandhanaṃ raudraṃ dvayoreva parasparam | yoginastatkimarthaṃ vai nirāśasya balānnayet || 1.171.110 || tasmātpatnyā rucirme no satyaṃ vaḥ pravadāmyaham | viṣṇuḥ prāha tadā śrutvā śaṃbhuṃ śrīkṛṣṇadarśitam || 11 1|| goloke yatpratijñātaṃ sṛṣṭau kāryaṃ yadā bhavet | yadāvaśyakatā te syāttadā dāsye vibhāvarīm || 1 12|| kāle gṛhītvā prakṛtiṃ śṛṃgāraṃ ca kariṣyasi | kāle gṛhī tathā kāle tapasvī bhava vāṃcchayā || 11 3|| vidhuro maṃgalāyātra kalpyate nahi kutracit | vidhurasya sastrīkeṣu vāso’pi bhayado bhavet || 1 14|| samo bhūtvā sameṣveva mānyo bhavati nāsamaḥ | sameṣu viṣamo naśyet naśyeyurviṣamātsamāḥ || 1 15|| sṛṣṭiśāsanakartṝṇāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ samānatā | sadā cāpekṣyate tasmāt sapatnīko bhavādhunā || 11 6|| nahi vai vidhuro bhrātā strīṣu viśvāsabhūmikaḥ | nahi yajñādipaitryādikārye yogyo vinā strīyam || 1 17|| amaṃgalaḥ sadā nārīśūnyo bhavati karmaṭhaḥ | akarmaṭhastathā nārīyuktaścāmaṃgalo bhavet || 1 18|| sūṣṭikāryādhikṛtastvaṃ śaṃbho māmaṃgalo vasa | sadā sumaṃgalo bhūtvā tiṣṭhāsmatsu vicārya ca || 11 9|| saṃsmṛtya kṛṣṇavacanaṃ sadāro bhava śaṃkara | śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ viṣṇoḥ smṛtvā kṛṣṇoktimityatha || 1.171.120 || nityasiddhaśivāprāptiṃ dharmaṃ vicārya śaṃkaraḥ | prāha viṣṇo kariṣyāmi bhavaduktaṃ sadā hitam || 121 || matvā vaco gariṣṭhaṃ vo niyogaṃ śrīharestathā | kariṣyāmi vivāhaṃ vai kṛṣṇavaśyo’smyahaṃ sadā || 122|| parantu yādṛśīṃ kāntāṃ grahīṣyāmi śṛṇuśva tām | yā me tejo grahītuṃ dhārayituṃ sudṛḍhā bhavet || 1 23|| ahaṃ yogī yathā jñānī sāpi matsadṛśī bhavet | raṇe yoge ca vijñāne guṇaiśvarye ratau samā || 124|| evaṃ na cedvinodvāhaṃ sthātavyaṃ sukhataḥ sadā | tasmājjāyāṃ prādiśa tvaṃ matsamā vartate yadi || 125|| tatrāpyekaḥ paṇo me syāt tayā bhāvyaṃ tathā mayi | aviśvāso madukte cet mayā tyaktā bhaviṣyati || 126|| iti śaṃbhorvacaḥ śrutvā viṣṇurbrahmā vihasya tam | prāhaturyādṛśī preṣṭhā te’styasmābhiḥ sumārgitā || 127|| goloke kṛṣṇahṛdayāt yā śivā netrayoḥ sthitā | vairājanetrayoḥ sthitvā devendriyeṣu taijasī || 128|| sthitā yā śeṣaśāyiśrīharerindriyama ṇḍale | rātrirvibhāvarī śaṃbho yā śivā vāmagā ca te || 129|| apṛthaksiddhasambaddhā sā satī dakṣaputrikā | tvādṛśī sā bhaved bhāryādhikatejobalānvitā || 1.171.13 0|| sā tapasyati deveśa tvadarthaṃ hi dṛḍhavratā | tvāṃ patiṃ prāptukāmā sā dakṣagehe’sti kanyakā || 131 || dātuṃ gaccha varaṃ tasyai kṛpāṃ kuru maheśvara | tāṃ vivāhaya suprītyā varaṃ dattvā yatheṣṭadam || 132|| atrāgatānāṃ devānāṃ saṃkalpaṃ paripūraya | maṃgalaṃ paramaṃ bhūyāt paśyāmaśca tadutsavam || 133||| śrutvā tu śaṃkaraḥ prāha omiti svīkṛtaṃ mayā | yāmi tapaḥphalaṃ dātuṃ bhavanto yāntu bho surāḥ || 134| punarvo darśanaṃ bhāvyaṃ vivāhotsavakarmaṇi | ityājñaptāḥ satkṛtāśca brahmaviṣṇusurādayaḥ || 135|| datvāśīrvādavacanaṃ saphalo’stu manorathaḥ | jagmuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niketaṃ te sastrīkāścātiharṣitāḥ || 1 36|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃbhorvairājalalāṭādutpattiḥ śivāyā dakṣagṛhe prākaṭyottaraṃ brahmanāradāgamaḥ nāradakathitacihnarekhābhiḥ śivapatnītvaniścayena satyā vārṣikatapovratakaraṇam dvādaśe vārṣikasatījanmajayantyā utsave brahmaviṣṇusurāṇāṃ sastrīkānāmāgamanaṃ satītapaḥ prekṣya brahmādīnāṃ kailāsagamanaṃ satīpāṇigrahaṇavaradānārthaṃ śaṃkarāyopadeśa ityādinirūpaṇanāmaikasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 171 ||
<1.172> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ me priye lakṣmi priyārthaṃ śaṃbhurutsukaḥ | gantu dakṣagṛhaṃ cintāṃ cakārodbuddhabhāvanaḥ || 1 || atho satī punaḥ śuklapakṣe’ṣṭamyāmupoṣitā | āśvine pūjayāmāsa ṣoḍaśārthaiśca śaṃkaram || 2 || itthaṃ nandāvrate pūrṇe navamyāṃ divase haraḥ | sarvāṃgasundaro devaḥ pratyakṣamabhavacchivaḥ || 3 || gauravarṇaḥ paṃcavaktrastrinetraścandraśekharaḥ | prasannātmā nīlakaṇṭhaścaturbāhuḥ savāsukiḥ || 4 || triśūlarudrākṣavarakamalabhasmaśobhitaḥ | gaṃgayā śobhitajaṭaḥ sarvāṃgasvarṇasannibhaḥ || 5 || mahālāvaṇyasaundaryasaukumāryaśarīrakaḥ | koṭikāmātikāntaśca koṭicandrasamānanaḥ || 6 || udbhinnayauvanākrāntaḥ sarvathā strīmanoharaḥ | pratyakṣaṃ śaṃkaraṃ dṛṣṭvā satī matvā svakaṃ dhanam || 7 || atīva hṛdi saṃhṛṣṭā sulajjāvanatānanā | vavande caraṇau śaṃbhoścakṣurbhyāmapibanmukham || 8 || manasārpitasarvasvāmanyata svāṃ mahodayām | tato harastu bhāryārthamicchannapi manaḥpriyām || 9 || satyāḥ hṛdayabhāvotthāṃ prītiṃ vettaṃ tu śāśvatīm | śrotuṃ priyāṇi vākyāni satīṃ prāha kṛtavratām || 1.172.1 0|| surūpāṃ subhagāṃ svarṇavarṇāṃ prāptālpayauvanām | svārpitāṃ ca svakāṃ patnīṃ kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā mumoha ca || 1 1|| jagāda suvrate kanye prīto’smyanena dakṣaje | nandāvratena saṃdāsye varaṃ varaya cepsitam || 12|| tadā satī trapāyuktābhavatpremapariplutā | yajñopavītaṃ saṃgṛhya hṛtsthaṃ vaktuṃ śaśāka na || 13|| jñātvā hārdaṃ sadākāntaḥ prasanno’tīva śaṃkaraḥ | varaṃ brūhi varaṃ brūhi varaṃ brṛhi punaḥ punaḥ || 14|| sāptapadīnamevātra maitryamicchan jagāda tām | satī prāhavrataṃ prekṣya tapaḥ prekṣya vilokya hṛt || 15|| dṛṣṭvāvasthāṃ prekṣya bhargacitraṃ yallikhitaṃ mayā | jñātvopavītagrahaṇaṃ dūrācca bhavadāgamam || 16|| sāptapadīnaṃ yanmaitryaṃ varaṃ dehi yadicchasi | tato vākyasyābhihārdamanuprāpya sphuṭaṃ haraḥ || 17|| gāha vākyaprapūrtyarthaṃ dehi te’rdhāṃganātmakam | kathaṃ na vākyaśeṣārthaṃ priye jñāpayasi drutam || 18|| dattaṃ maitryaṃ mama bhāryā bhaveti varadānakam | prāpya śaṃbhorvaco miṣṭaṃ premamagnābhavat satī || 19|| tūṣṇīṃ tasthau ca muditā varaṃ prāpya manogatam | satṛṣṇamānasā cāruhāsyayuktānanā satī ||1.172.20|| akaronnijabhāvām̐śca hāvānpremavivardhakān | hāvabhāvavilāsām̐śca samāśritya tayorhṛdi ||21|| śṛṃgārapremarasaḥ saṃviveśāśu tayostadā | kāpyabhikhyā prādurāsīllokalīlānukurvatoḥ ||22|| reje satī haraṃ prāpya candraṃ prāpyeva śarvarī | sukhaṃ vakṣasi saṃśliṣya ciraṃ sparśaṃ vidhāya ca || 23 || satyuvāca haraṃ premṇā karau badhvā natānanā | devadeva patideva vivāhavidhinā prabho |||24|| piturme gocarīkṛtya gṛhītvā yāhi māṃ vibho | sāgrahaṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā śaṃkaraḥ sarvaśaṃkaraḥ || 25|| tathāstviti pratibhāṣya nirīkṣya premataśca tām | śanairbhāvīti matvāsau kṣaṇaṃ cintāṃ jagāma saḥ || 26||| tāvat satī haraṃ natvā gṛhītvājñāṃ sasaṃbhramā | śaṃkarāgamanaṃ mātre śaṃsituṃ satvaraṃ gatā || 27|| asiknī kanyayā proktaṃ viditvā satvaraṃ bahiḥ | bhāvijāmātṛrūpaṃ saṃdraṣṭuṃ yāvatprayāti vai || 28|| tāvacchaṃbhuṃ manāk dṛṣṭvā sphaṭikojjvalavarṣmakam | atīva mumude’siknī śaṃbhustvadṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ||29|| jāmātaraṃ sutāyogyaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāvinamuttamam | dhyātvā tameva hṛdaye paraṃ bhāgyamamanyata || 1.172.30 || haro’pi svīyakailāsaṃ gatvā praviśya cāśramam | brahmāṇaṃ cintayāmāsa lokarītyanusārataḥ || 31 || brahmā tūrṇaṃ sarasvatyā sahitastatra cāyayau | dṛṣṭvā tu vedhasaṃ śaṃbhuḥ premabaddho hyuvāca tam || 32|| ahamārādhitaḥ satyā dakṣaputryātibhaktitaḥ | tasyai varo mayā datto nandāvrataphalātmakaḥ || 33|| satyārthitaṃ patideva vivāhavidhinā prabho | piturme gocarīkṛtya gṛhītvā yāhi māmiti || 34|| tathāstviti śanairbhāvi mayoktaṃ pratinirṇaye | satī ca vartate māturagre’haṃ tvāgato’tra ca || 35 || tasmāt tvaṃ gaccha bhavanaṃ dakṣasya mama kāraṇāt | dakṣaḥ kanyāṃ svakīyāṃ me yathā dadyāttathā kuru || 36|| brahmovāca haraṃ śaṃbho devānāṃ mama śārṅgiṇaḥ | āgrahaḥ sarvathā so’sti devakāryaprasattaye || 37||| vivāhastvarayā te syāttathā kurmo vayaṃ drutam | dakṣastubhyaṃ sutāṃ svāṃ ca svayameva pradāsyati || 38 || śīghraṃ yathā tathā taṃ ca pravakṣyāmi ca śaṃ kuru | kailāse brahmaṇā śaṃbhorevaṃ vārtā pravartate || 3 9|| etasminnantare’siknī dakṣaṃ prāha satīvratam | tapastaptvā varaṃ prāpya mano’bhilaṣitaṃ satī ||1.172.40 || śaṃkaradarśanaṃ labdhvā kṛtakṛtyā hyajāyata | śrutvā dakṣaḥ satīṃ prāha putri sukhavatī bhava ||41 || dakṣe jijñāsite sarvaṃ samācakhyau satīvratam | maheśvarādvaraprāptiṃ pāṇigrahaṇakāriṇīm ||42|| mātā pitā ca vṛttāntaṃ sarvaṃ śrutvā satīmukhāt | ānandaṃ paramaṃ lebhe cakre ca paramotsavam |||43 || satī nandāvratasyānte lebhe śaṃbhoḥ pradarśanam | tannimittaṃ vratapūrtau mahotsavamakārayat ||44|| dadau dānāni viprebhyo dravyaratnāmbarāṇi ca | anyebhyaścāndhadīnebhyo vīriṇyapi dadau dhanam ||45|| satī ca svavayasyābhyaḥ kanyābhyo bhojanaṃ dadau | dhanavastrabhyaṃjanādidravyāṇi ca dadau mudā |||46||| vīriṇī tā samāliṃgya svaputrīṃ siddhabhāvanām | mūrdhnyupāghrāya muditā praśaśaṃsa muhurmuhuḥ ||47|| dakṣo’tha cintayāmāsāgato’pi śaṃkaraḥ svayam | pratinivṛtto me kanyāmagṛhītvā kathaṃ gataḥ ||48 || āgato’pi mahādevaḥ prasanno nirjagāma ha | punarevaṃ kathaṃ so’pi sutārthe’trāgamiṣyati ||49|| kena yogena deyeyaṃ svasutā śaṃbhave’dhunā | prasthāpyo’tha mayā kāścicchaṃbhornikaṭamaṃjasā |||1.172.50 || yadi vaco na gṛhṇīyāt sarvaṃ me viphalaṃ bhavet | yadvā me tanayā nandāvrataṃ kuryātpunastathā ||51 || śaṃbhurbhavatu madbhartetyevaṃ punaravāpnuyāt | ityevaṃ kurvataścintāṃ dakṣasya purato’pyajaḥ ||52 || sarasvatyā sahitaścopasthito bhāvatastadā | dakṣastaṃ pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamyāvanato’bhavat ||53 || dadāvāsanamagryaṃ cārhaṇāṃ cakretibhaktitaḥ | papracchāgamane hetuṃ snehaṃ kāryaṃ ca vā param ||54|| brahmovāca śṛṇu dakṣa yadarthamahamāgataḥ | tava putryā tapastaptvā mahādevaṃ prasādya ca ||55|| labdho varaśca yastasya samayo’yamupasthitaḥ | tadarthameva nirdhārya śaṃbhunā preṣito’smi vai ||56|| tato’trārthe ca yatkṛtya śreyastadavadhāraya | varadānottaraṃ rudrastvatsutā hṛdye sthitām ||57|| dhyātvā smṛtvā punaścemāṃ na śarma labhateṃ’jasā | kāmaṃ yo jītavān devaḥ sa vai kāmena vidhyate ||58|| satīṃ vicintayannāste vyākulaḥ prākṛto yathā | prakṛtāṃ sārthakāṃ vāṇīṃ parityajya gaṇān kvacit ||59 || kva satīti janamadhye bhāṣate tvatsutā gṛṇan | mayā tvayā ca kāmena kṛṣṇena ṛṣibhistathā || 1.172.60 || pūrvaṃ yadvāñcchitaṃ cāsīt siddhaṃ tadadhunā dhruvam | tvatputryārādhitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ śaṃbhunārādhyate satī ||6 1 || tasmāddakṣa sutāṃ svīyāṃ śaṃbhvarthaṃ parikalpitām | tasmai dehyavilambena kṛtakṛtyo bhavānbhavet ||62|| ahaṃ śaṃbhumānayiṣye nāradena tvadālayam | satīṃ tasmai saṃprayaccha vivāhavidhinā suta ||63 || dakṣaḥ śrutvā piturvākyaṃ tatheti prāha harṣitaḥ | brahmā satkāramādāya jagmivān śaṃkaragṛham ||64|| sa vīkṣya lokasṛṣṭāraṃ prasannamanasa haraḥ | kāryasiddhiṃ viniścitya praṇanāma pitāmaham || 65|| papraccha kimakārṣīd vai dakṣaḥ satīkṛte iti | brahmovāca tadā śaṃbhuṃ kāryaṃ siddhaṃ tavāsti hi ||66 || deyā putrī śaṃbhave’sti dakṣasya nirṇayo dhruvaḥ | mama vākyasya mānyatvāt satyāścaiva tapobalāt ||67 || tvayā varapradānācca satī deyāsti śaṃbhave | śubhe lagne sumuhūrte samāgacchatu śaṃkaraḥ ||68 || tadā dāsyāmi tanayāṃ bhikṣārthaṃ śaṃbhave satīm | ityuvāca sa māṃ dakṣastasmāttvaṃ gaccha tadgṛham ||69 || rudraḥ prāha tadā lokarītimāśritya vedhasam | gamiṣyāmi tvayā sārdhaṃ nāradena ca tadgṛham ||1.172.70 || tasmāttvaṃ nāradaṃ caiva marīcyādīṃśca sanmunīn | saṃsmara taiḥ samaṃ dakṣagṛhaṃ yāsyāmi śobhayā ||7 1 || ityādiṣṭaḥ parameṣṭhī sasmāra nāradādikān | tataḥ samāgatāḥ sarve mānasāḥ paramarṣayaḥ ||72 || sastrīkāḥ sabandhuvargā devāśca pitarastathā | viṣṇuḥ samāgatastatra lakṣmyāśca pārṣadaiḥ saha ||73 || śrīkṛṣṇo golokadhāmnaścāyāto rādhikāyutaḥ | gopagopīgaṇairyukto dāsīlakṣasamanvitaḥ ||74|| vaikuṇṭhācca ramāyukto nārāyaṇaḥ samāgataḥ | koṭivaiṣṇavapārṣadadāsadāsīsamanvitaḥ ||95|| indraśca varuṇo vāyuragniḥ kubera ityamī | yamaḥ sūryaśca candraśca tathānyā gṛhadevatāḥ ||76 || ṛṣayo munayo viprāḥ sādhyaḥ sādhujanāstathā | devyaścāpsarasaścānyā nartakyo gāyikāstathā ||77|| samājagmuḥ śaṃkarasya vāhinyāṃ kṛtakautukāḥ | atha caitrasite pakṣe nakṣatre bhagadaivate ||78 || trayodaśyāṃ dine bhānau niragacchat maheśvaraḥ | kailāsāttu suraiḥ sārdhaṃ brahmaviṣṇupuraḥsaraiḥ ||79 || munibhiḥ ṛṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ gacchan babhau maheśvaraḥ | gaṇāśca koṭiśo yātā varapakṣamahotsavāḥ ||1.172.80 || mārge samutsavo jāto vāhinyā gacchatāṃ tadā | devādīnāṃ gaṇānāṃ ca sānandamanasāṃ tathā ||8 1 || mahālakṣmyāḥ śaṃkarasya śṛṃgāraḥ sthānataḥ kṛtaḥ | jaṭā tu gaṃgayā mūrtimatyā saṃśobhitā tadā ||82|| lalāṭe kalayā candro bhūṣaṇaṃ samajāyata | vāsukiścopanītyarthaṃ vāmāṃse vartate sukham ||83 || rudrākṣamuṇḍahārāśca dhṛtā kaṇṭhe viṣāśrite | triśūlaṃ saṃdhṛtaṃ haste gajacarma ca pṛṣṭhake ||84|| vvāghracarma kaṭiprānte dhṛtaṃ bhasma śarīrake | pādayoḥ pāduke gupte kaupīnaṃ mṛgacarmajam ||85|| kaṭyāṃ tu kuhakaḥ sarpo mekhalābhūṣaṇārthakaḥ | evaṃ śṛṃgāritaḥ śaṃbhurbalīvardoparisthitaḥ ||86 || anye ca vāhane bhinne bhinne sthitāḥ śivecchayā | garuḍasthau tadā viṣṇurlakṣmīśca yayaturmudā ||87|| haṃsasthau ca tadā brahmā sāvitrī yayaturmudā | rathasthāḥ sūryacandrādyā gajasthā indradevatāḥ ||88 || vimānayānavāhasthāḥ ṛṣayo munayastadā | nāryo vimānamadhyasthā vyomagāmisuvāhanāḥ ||89|| rathaguptimadhyagatā gāyanti gītikāstadā | vāditrāṇi ca vādyante stūyante bandibhistadā ||1.172.90|| āśīrvādāḥ pradīyante munibhirbhūsuraistathā | evaṃ sā vāhinī śaṃbhoḥ kiṃkiṇījālaśabditāḥ ||9 1 || śobhitā divyanārībhirdevamūrticamatkṛtā | prāpad dakṣarājadhānīsamope śaṃbhvadhiṣṭhitā ||92|| tato dakṣo vinītātmā saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ | prayayau sanmukhaṃ śaṃbhoḥ saṃyuktaḥ sakalairnijaiḥ ||93|| sarve devāśca munayaḥ ṛṣayaḥ pramadājanaḥ | jalapānādinā tatra svayaṃ dakṣeṇa satkṛtāḥ ||94|| dakṣālayaṃ tadā prāpyāsaneṣu munayaḥ sthitāḥ | vṛddhā devāśca ṛṣayo yathāyogyaṃ pratiṣṭhitā ||95|| dakṣaḥ sammānayāmāsa gṛhābhyantarataḥ śivam | samānarca vidhānena datvāsanamanuttamam ||96|| tato viṣṇuṃ ca devām̐śca brahmāṇaṃ sarvabhūrasurān | gaṇām̐śca pūjayāmāsa sadbhaktyā vastubhirmudā ||97|| bhojayāmāsa mṛṣṭānnaistarpayāmāsa pānakaiḥ | raṃjayāmāsa śṛṃgāraiḥ prokṣayāmāsa saurabhaiḥ ||98|| tāmbūlādipradānaiḥ saṃbhāvayāmāsa cāsanaiḥ | kṛtvā yathocitāṃ pūjāṃ cakāra saṃvidaṃ suraiḥ || 9 9|| munibhiśca tato brahmā prerito’tra vidhānake | dakṣeṇābhihitaścaiva kāryaṃ vaivāhikaṃ tu yat || 1.172.100 || kārayāmāsa vidhivat prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā | tataḥ śubhe muhūrte hi lagne gṛhabalānvite || 101 || satīṃ nijasutāṃ dakṣo dadau harṣeṇa śaṃbhave | udvāhavidhinā śaṃbhurjagrāha ca satīkaram || 102|| satīpāṇigrahakāle brahmaviṣṇusurādayaḥ | nemuḥ sarve saṃstutibhistoṣayāmāsurīśvarau || 103 || samutsavo mahānāsīnnṛtyagītapuraḥsaraḥ | ānandaṃ paramaṃ jagmurbhojanācchādanādibhiḥ || 10 4|| dakṣo’pyāsīt kṛtārthaśca datvā kanyāṃ tu śaṃbhave | śivāśivau prasannau sto nikhilaṃ maṃgalaṃ hyabhūt || 1 05|| kṛtvā dakṣaḥ sutādānaṃ yautakaṃ vividhaṃ dadau | harāya bahudhā dravyaṃ dvijebhyo vividhaṃ janam || 106|| harāya varamālā sā satyārpitā galasthale | mūśalādīni śaṃbhorvai mastake’bhrāmayam̐stadā || 1 07|| mṛṣṭaṃ miṣṭaṃ ca dampatyordattaṃ parasparaṃ mukhe | dugdhasthālyāṃ suvarṇāṃgulīyakrīḍā ca cakratuḥ || 108 || viṣṇustadā haraṃ prāha satīṃ caiva śubhaṃ vacaḥ | tvaṃ pitā jagatāṃ śaṃbho satī mātā jagatprasūḥ || 109 || yuvāṃ līlāvatārau staḥ satāṃ kṣemāya sarvadā | khalānāṃ nigrahārthāya jātau vai yugalātmakau || 1.172.110 || gārhasthyadharmamālambya carataṃ sahadharmakam | saṃhārārthakṛtarūpau pravartethāṃ ca saṃhṛtau || 111 || dhārmikāṇāṃ janānāṃ ca rakṣārthaṃ ca gavāṃ satām | yajñānāṃ bhūsurāṇāṃ ca vedānāṃ kurutaṃ śramam || 11 2|| satyāśca rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ bhaktānāṃ maṃgalaṃ tathā | ya enāṃ sābhilāṣo vai dṛṣṭvā śrutvāthavā bhavet || 113 || taṃ hanyād deva kāleśa vijñaptiriti me’sti vai | asurāḥ prabalāḥ santi kaṇḍūyanaprahastakāḥ || 1 14|| teṣāṃ kaṇḍūrmārjanīyā tvayā satyā sutena ca | smartavyaśca tathā kāle yadi sāhāyyamarthyate || 115 || iti śrutvā harervācaṃ vihasya śaṃkarastadā | evamastviti satkṛtya nanāma kamalāpatim || 116 || tato dakṣaḥ sāmayikaṃ kārayāmāsa cotsavam | brahmā ca maṇḍape tatra gṛhyoktavidhinākhilam || 11 7|| agnikāryaṃ yathoddiṣṭamakārṣīcca suvistaram | homaṃ ca kārayāmāsa vidhivad vahnikuṇḍake || 118 || tataḥ śivā śivaścaiva yathāvidhi praharṣataḥ | agniṃ susākṣiṇaṃ cāpi brahmācāryadvijājñayā || 119 || catuḥpradakṣiṇāḥ kṛtvā sthitau śivāśivau tadā | nematuśca gārhapatyamagniṃ niṣedatustataḥ || 1.172.120 || tadā mahotsavastatrādbhuto’bhūddakṣamandire | sarveṣāṃ sukhadaṃ vādyaṃ gītanṛtyapuraḥsaram || 1 2 1 || pravartitaṃ ca śṛṇvanti maṇḍapāgatadarśakāḥ | vadhvāśca vararājasya rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā muhurmuhuḥ || 1 22|| bahavo mohitāstatra narā nāryaśca padmaje | na tatrāsīdrūpavatī hyekāpi tu yathā satī || 123 || na cāsīdrūpayostatra dhavalaḥ śaṃbhusadṛśaḥ | ratnakāṃcanayoryogaḥ kaumudīcandrayoryathā || 1 24|| taḍicchravetāmrayoryogaḥ satīśaṃkarayostathā | nārīnetracakorāṇā naranetrasphuliṃginām || 1 25|| candravadvahnijvālāvannirvāṇasukhado’bhavat | nāsannarāḥ satīṃ dṛṣṭvā hyamugdhāstatra maṇḍape || 126 || nāsan striyo haraṃ dṛṣṭvā hyamugdhāstatra maṇḍape | satīśaṃkarayoryogastathābhūnmohakārakaḥ || 1 27|| tadidaṃ lokaśikṣārthaṃ vivāho mohamūlakaḥ | rājasaṃ ca tadā sarvaṃ manasijasya vaibhavam || 128 || vadhvā rūpaṃ vivāhe vai mukhaṃ draṣṭuṃ samutsukāḥ | jāyante vikalāḥ sarve prāyaśo lokabhāvataḥ || 1 29|| tathā tatrāpi satyā vai mukhaṃ draṣṭuṃ samutsukāḥ | prāyaśaścābhavan sarve lajjayā vastrasaṃvṛtam || 1.172.130 || sarvathā nakhamārabhya keśacūḍāvadhi tadā | satī kāṃcanavarṇābhā śāṭyādisaṃvṛtā hyabhūt || 131 || vidyullatāsamāddehāt kāntirvastrāṇi bhidya vi | bahiryātā ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā netrāṇi militāni hi || 132 || darśakānāṃ tadā tatra maṇḍapo’pyatitejasā | śuśubhe suprabho jāto dyauryathātrāgatāsti kim || 133 || śṛṇu lakṣmi tadā jātamāścaryaṃ brahmaṇo’param | vedhāstu rājasaṃ bhāvaṃ prāpya rūpaṃ vilokitum || 1 34|| vicāraṃ bahudhā cakre kintu nāpa vilokitum | śaṃkarasyaiva kartavyaṃ hyetajjātaṃ tu viddhi tat || 1 35|| brahmaṇā mohituṃ māṃ vai prathamaṃ preraṇā kṛtā | sarve te mohitāḥ santu vivāhe mama sannidhau || 136 || iti kṛtvātra rūpaṃ tat prakāśitaṃ tu yogataḥ | dṛṣṭvā ca mumuhuḥ sarve mahāmāyāvimohitāḥ || 1 37|| tadā tu brahmaṇā tatra śubhopāyo vicāritaḥ | ārdrendhanāni bhūrīṇi kṣiptvā tatra vibhāvasau || 138 || svalpājyāhutivinyāsādārdradravyodbhavaḥ kṛtaḥ | prādurbhūto mahādhūmo vyāptastatra samantataḥ || 139 || tena sa maṇḍapastatra tamobhūto’bhavattadā | śaṃbhurdhūmrākule netre chādayāmāsa līlayā || 1.172.140 || tāvacca brahmaṇā vastraṃ samutkṣipya satīmukham | vilokitaṃ muhuḥ premṇā bahubhiścāvalokitam || 141 || brahmaṇastu tadā retaḥ pracaskanda paṭāntare | ācchāditaṃ marditaṃ ca yathā kaścid bubodha na || 142|| mardanācca kaṇāstatra tuṣāracayasannibhāḥ | saṃjātā ye’bhavan meghāścatvārastu catuḥkaṇāḥ || 143 || saṃvartakastathāvartaḥ puṣkaro droṇa ityapi | phelurvyomni ca garjantastoyadāste kadāravāḥ || 1 44|| anye kaṇā aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi tadābhavan | tebhyo jātā bālakhilyā aṃguṣṭhaparvasadṛśāḥ || 145|| ṛṣayaste ca vairājalokeṣu saṃgatāstadā | tiṣṭhantyeva ca tatraiva sadā brahmavratā hi te || 1 46|| athānye ca kaṇā vastre saṃlagnāste tadā punaḥ | bālakhilyāśca vai ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇyabhavam̐śca te || 147|| aṃguṣṭhaparvamātrāśca sūryasya kiraṇāni vai | pibantaḥ sūryasāmmukhye dhāvanti pṛṣṭhapādataḥ || 148 || mandehānāmarakṣāṃsi nāśayanti ca te’nvaham | nityaṃ brahmavaradānājjīvanti nāśayanti tān || 149 || atha tadbhagavān śaṃbhurjñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā | kimetadvihitaṃ brahman kopādetaduvāca ha || 1.172.150 || ityeṣa hantuṃ brahmāṇaṃ śūlamudyamya śaṃkaraḥ | sannaddhaḥ sa niṣiddhaśca pratiruddho maharṣibhiḥ || 151 || śikṣitaśca tadā sarvaiḥ trayāṇāmaikyamityapi | na brahmā bhavato bhinno na bhavo brahmabhedavān || 152|| na viṣṇurdvayato bhinnastrayāṇāmaikyamasti hi | śirogrīvādibhedena yathaikasyaiva varṣmaṇaḥ || 153 || aṃgāni ca tathā devāstrayo’bhinnāḥ parātmanaḥ | svasvarūpe brahmaṇi te śaṃbho kopo na yujyate || 154|| śrutvaivaṃ śaṃkaraḥ śāntaḥ saṃprāha vedhasaṃ punaḥ | svaśiraḥ spṛśa hastena madājñāṃ kurvasaṃśayam || 155|| brahmā nijakareṇa svaṃ śiraḥ spṛśati yāvatā | tāvadbrahmo’bhavatsadyo vṛṣabho vāhanaṃ param || 156|| tatpṛṣṭhe ca svayaṃ śaṃbhurniṣasāda niyāmakaḥ | āhānena svarūpeṇa madadhiṣṭhitakena ca || 157|| tapaḥ kuru ca te khyātiḥ rudraśiro bhaviṣyati | brahmāṃśo vṛṣabhastatra śaṃkarāṃśo niyāmakaḥ || 158|| bhūtvā vivāhavedyāṃ ca sarvadā tau vyavasthitau | atha mūlasvarūpeṇa brahmā śaṃbhvājñayā tadā || 159|| śeṣaṃ vaivāhikaṃ karma samāptimanayat drutam | papāta puṣpavṛṣṭiśca śivāśivaśiraskayoḥ || 1.172.160 || vādyamāneṣu vādyeṣu gāyamāneṣu teṣu ca | paṭhatsu vipravargeṣu vedān bhaktyanviteṣu ca || 16 1|| raṃbhādiṣu purandhrīṣu nṛtyamānāsu sādaram | mahotsavo mahānāsīt devapatnīṣu padmaje || 162|| śaṃbhuḥ prāha tvayā brahman kṛtaṃ vaivāhikaṃ ca yat | gṛhāṇa dakṣiṇāṃ koṭiṃ svācāryo’si sulagnakṛt || 163|| gṛhītā dakṣiṇā cātha brahmaṇā prārthitaṃ tadā | gantavyaṃ svagṛhaṃ sarvaiḥ sthātavyaṃ naiva śiṣyate || 164|| tato dakṣa samāmantrya patnyā satyā saheśvaraḥ | gantumanā hyabhūt tāvat dakṣastuṣṭāva śaṃkaram || 165|| surāśca munayo viprā ṛṣayo viṣṇusevakāḥ | kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ sūryaścandra indrādayastathā || 166|| svasvakuṭumbaparivārānvitā yayurīśvaram | āropya vṛṣabhe śaṃbhuḥ satīṃ dakṣājñayā mudā || 167|| cālayāmāsa vṛṣabhaṃ kailāsaṃ svālayaṃ prati | kecidvādyānvādayanto gāyantaḥ susvaraṃ pare || 168|| śivaṃ śivayaśaḥ śuddhamanujagmuḥ śivaṃ mudā | madhyamārgādvisṛṣṭo hi dakṣaḥ prītyātha śaṃbhunā || 169|| svadhāma prāpa sagaṇaḥ śaṃbhuḥ premasamākulaḥ | tatra gatvākhilān devān munīnapi parām̐stathā || 1.172.170|| mudā visarjayāmāsa bahu sammānya sādaram | śaṃbhumābhāṣya bhojyādi gṛhītvā kṛṣṇadevatāḥ || 171 || viṣṇvādyāḥ ṛṣayaḥ sarve svaṃ svaṃ dhāma yayurmudā | śivo’pi mudito’tyarthaṃ navavadhvā samaṃ muhuḥ || 172|| kailāsācalasaṃstho hi vijahāra yathāsukham | iti lakṣmi śaṃkarasyākhyāto vivāhasūtsavaḥ || 173|| vivāhasamaye yajñe prāraṃbhe vā śṛṇoti yaḥ | tasyāvighnaṃ bhavetsarvaṃ karma vaivāhikaṃ śubham || 174|| kanyā ca sukhasaubhāgyaśīlācāraguṇānvitā | sādhvī syātputriṇī dhanyā sarvasmṛddhiyutā gṛhe || 175|| athāyaṃ śaṃkaro yogī viveśa girikandaram | gaṇānniryāpayāmāsa nandyādīn prāha tāṃstadā || 176|| yadāhaṃ ca smarāmyatra smaraṇādaramānasāḥ | samāgamiṣyatha tadā matpārśvaṃ me gaṇā drutam || 177|| kailāse te gaṇāḥ sarve nānāsthāneṣu saṃyayuḥ | śaṃbhurvadhvā samaṃ reme vinā kāmaratiṃ tadā || 178|| kvacidgṛthitvā puṣpāṇāṃ mālāṃ satyai nyavedayat | kvacicca darpaṇe satyā sahānanaṃ vyalokayat || 179|| kadācitkuṇḍale satyāḥ karṇayorapyadhārayat | kadācitpattale cāsyā raktenāraṃjayaddharaḥ||1.172.180 keśaveśaṃ kadācitsveṃ’ke niṣādya hyakalpayat | lalāṭe patrikāṃ śaṃbhuścandanenākarotkvacit || 18 1|| āhṛtya padmapuṣpāṇi ramyapuṣpāṇi śaṃkaraḥ | sarvāṃgeṣu karoti sma puṣpābharaṇamādarāt || 182|| evaṃ bahuvidhairmārgaiḥ reme satīṃ vinodayan | tayā vinā sma no yāti nāsthito na sma ceṣṭate || 18 3|| tayā vinā kṣaṇamapi śarma lebhe na śaṃkaraḥ | agamaddhimavatprasthaṃ sasmāra svecchayā smaram || 184|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satyai śaṃkaradarśanaṃ bhāryā bhaveti varadānaṃ śaṃbhoḥ kailāsagamanaṃ brahmaṇo dakṣagṛhaṃ prati preṣaṇaṃ kailāsaṃ pratyāgamanaṃ ca śaṃkarasya janavāhinyā dakṣagṛhaṃ prati gamanaṃ satī vivāhaḥ satyāṃ rūpe mohitabrahmaṇo retaḥpatanaṃ tena meghānāṃ vālakhilyānāmutpattiḥ janavā hinyāḥ kailāsaṃ pratyāgamanam janavāha vargavisarjanaṃ kailāsakandare satī śaṃkarayorviharaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 172 ||
<1.173> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi himādrau tu tayorviharatostadā | kāmasmṛtyā kāmadevaḥ praviṣṭastatra sannidhau || 1 || tasminpraviṣṭe śaṃbhau ca satyāṃ ca kāmanā śubhā | samabhavattadā śaṃbhorbhāvaṃ vijñāya sarvathā || 2 || vasantaḥ svasya kartavyaṃ samārebhe harāntike| mandasugandhaśaityāḍhyo vavau ca malayo marut || 3 || vṛkṣāśca puṣpitāḥ sarve latāśca puṣpitāstadā | virejire palāśāśca kiṃśukaiḥ raktakomalaiḥ || 4 || kamalāni vicitrāṇi saraḥsvapi virejire | padmapuṣpāḍhyapavano vavau tatra harāntike || 5 || nāgakeśarapuṣpāṇi svarṇavarṇasugandhibhiḥ | manojñānyabhavam̐statra śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ || 6 || sugandhagandhasaṃpṛktā nāgavallī ca mārutam | satī śaṃkaranikaṭe prairayanmohakārakam || 7 || kokilāśca tadānīṃ susvaraṃ jagurmanoharam | āmrāḥ praphullitāḥ patramaṃjarībhirbabhustadā || 8 || jalāni nirmalānyabhirejuśca phullakāśakāḥ | jyotiścakrāṇi saṃrejurvāsantikaprabhādibhiḥ || 9 || kaumudyā saha raktāśca vibhāvaryo’bhavan priyāḥ | śādvalāḥ supradeśāścābhavan kāmasukhapradāḥ || 1.173.1 0|| nadīṣu ca nikuṃjeṣu kandarīṣu sthalīṣu ca | reme satyā samaṃ śaṃbhurvireje śaṃbhunā satī || 11 || ramayāmāsa deveśaṃ vividhābhistu kelibhiḥ | harastu puṣpamālābhiḥ priyāṃ śṛṃgārayatyapi || 1 2|| kabarīkaraṇairaṃke svāpanaiścūmbanaistathā | santoṣayati cālāpairhāsyavīkṣaṇamardanaiḥ || 12 || tadvaktraśaśyadharāmṛtapānamattatāṃ gatā | nānāvidhāsanasetumādideśa priyai tadā || 14|| satyā vaktrasugandhena saundaryeṇa ca narmaṇā | premṇā ratyā subaddho’yaṃ śaṃkaraḥ saṃtutoṣa ha || 15 || ityevaṃ himavacchṛṅge ramayitvā satīṃ śivaḥ | kailāsamagamat svasya nivāse śāntimāvahat || 16 || tāpakālo vyatītaśca yadā meghāgamo’bhavat | satī prāha tadā śaṃbhuṃ śṛṇu me vacanaṃ priya || 17|| ghanāgamo’yaṃ samayo meghā varṣanti sarvadā | pravānti vātā hṛdyaṃ kampayantyativeginaḥ || 18 || sthalyaḥ sarvatra saṃklinnāḥ kardamāḍhyā anāśrayā | vṛkṣā vallyaḥ prabhinnāśca samārdrā jalasaṃbhṛtāḥ || 19|| meghānāṃ garjanā vidyudvilāsāḥ prabhavanti ca | meghacchannau na dṛśyete sūryācandramasau divi || 1.173.20|| vātāhatā mahāvṛkṣāḥ patanti trāsadā bhuvi | vyāghrāḥ siṃhā mahākrūrā viṣavantaśca dehinaḥ ||21 || bhramanti nirjane’raṇye śītoṣṇānilavahnayaḥ | ete cānye duḥkhadāśca vighnā bhavanti sarvadā || 22|| tasmāt kvacinnivāsārthaṃ gṛhaṃ kāryaṃ tvayādhunā | yatracchāyā sukhaśayyā pānabhojanavaibhavāḥ || 23 || rakṣituṃ ca bhaveyurvai śakyāḥ sāmayikāḥ sadā | yadi virāmalābhāya saudhaṃ nāsti janasya tu || 24|| tadā ko dāravahane lābho’sti vanavāsinaḥ | cakravākakapotādyā pakṣiṇo’pi nirāśrayāḥ ||25|| prāpte kāle prakurvanti gṛhāṇi vṛkṣakoṭare | pipīlikāmūṣakādyāḥ kurvanti bhūgṛhāṇyapi || 26 || tasmādgārhasthyadharmasyāṃgabhūtāpatyarakṣaṇam | gṛhe vai syānnirābādhaṃ sarvartusukhade dṛḍhe ||27|| anyāsāṃ madbhaginīnāṃ bhavanāni mahānti vai | divyānyasaṃkhyasmṛddhīni vartante nāsti me gṛham ||28|| prathame gṛhaśūnyatvaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṃsārasāgare | dvitīyaṃ dhānyahīnatvaṃ tṛtīyaṃ dhanaśūnyatā ||29 || caturthaṃ nirapatyatvaṃ mālinyaṃ paṃcamaṃ matam | ṣaṣṭhaṃ rogakṛtamaitryaṃ saptamaṃ cāgavādikam || 1.173.3 0|| aṣṭamaṃ ca gṛhe kleśaḥ siṃhavṛṣabhabhoginām | etadduḥkhāṣṭakaṃ me’sti kiṃ gārhasthyena yoginaḥ || 31 || yogī syānna bhavedbhogī bhogī syāt kintu yogitā | tasmādyogaphalaṃ duḥkhāṣṭakanāśe prayujyatām || 32| paśyāraṇye ca dāvāgnirbahudhā jāyate’tra vai | prarohanti ca sasyāni nibīḍāni nivāsane ||33 || śyāmalā rājatā raktā viśadāstṛṇajātayaḥ | āsanasthalabhūmau vai prarohanti prakardamāḥ || 34|| asamaśrīśca kuṭilā sthalī sevyātiduḥkhadāḥ | nidrāyāṃ ratiyoge vā madhyarātrau bhayaṃkarāḥ ||35 || śabdāḥ śrūyanta ugrāśca kāryadhvaṃse’tiduḥkhadāḥ | madhyāhne tūlbaṇastāpo varṣādhārāśca duḥkhadāḥ ||36 || paśya me pādayostīkṣṇakaṇṭakānāṃ ca śāśvatī | kuṭikā saṃgatā tatra kaṇṭakāḥ santi kīdṛśāḥ ||37|| śarīre paśya me meghakarakāṇāṃ ca durnayam | patitvā chādayantyeva śarīraṃ śaityaduḥkhadam || 3 8|| etasmin viṣame kāle nīḍaṃ kākāścakorakāḥ | kurvanti tvāṃ vinā gehān kathaṃ śāntimavāpsyasi || 39|| mahatīvādya me bhītirmeghotthā jāyate hṛdi | tato yatasva saudhārthaṃ mā ciraṃ vacanānmama ||1.173.40|| bhāryā rakṣyā vane stheyaṃ ratiḥ svādyā na bhojanam | etatsarvaṃ vināśāya no sukhāya prajāyate ||4 1 || kailāse vā himādrau vā gaṃgātīre’thavā kṣitau | yatra kvāpi vāsayogyaṃ bhavanaṃ kuru śaṃkara || 42||| prāghūṇikāḥ samāgatya śāntā bhaveyurāśrame | dhanadhānyasmṛddhimati yathāpekṣaṃ tathā kuru || 43 || śrutvā satīvyāhṛtaṃ ca matvā manasi sārthakam | śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā devyai rañjayanmānasaṃ muhuḥ ||44|| vada devī yatra meghā gacchantyeva nahi kvacit | tatra saudhaṃ kārayeyaṃ yadi te rocate śive ||45 || meghā nitambaparyantaṃ saṃcaranti mahīdhare | merau vā tādṛśe śṛṃge kurve te yadi rocate || 46|| kailāsasya tathā devi nitambe prāyaśo ghanāḥ | varṣāsvapi pracaranti kurve te tatra rocate ||47|| aruṇācalaśṛṃgai ca nitambe prāyaśo ghanāḥ | saṃcaranti na gacchanti tata ūrdhvaṃ kadācana ||48 || saurāṣṭre raivate śaile svargaśṛṃge sutaijase | yatra meghā nitambasthā na gacchantyuparīti vā || 49 || himālaye śivaśṛṃge meghā gacchanti naiva yat | yatrāsti candrajaṃ śaityaṃ kurve saudhaṃ tu rocate ||1.173.5 0 || ityeteṣu girīndreṣu tvayā dṛṣṭeṣu prāgbhave | manorucirbhavedyatra tamācakṣva drutaṃ hi me || 5 1 || yatra haime proccaśṛṃge siddhapatnyo vasanti vai | tatra te yadi vāñchāsti kurve tatra mahālayam ||52 || svarṇaśṛṃge yatra devyo nivasanti sakautukāḥ | tatra te yadi vāñcchā syāt kurve saudhaṃ suvarṇajam ||5 3 || āruṇe maṇikuṭṭe vā lokāloke’tha raivate | nāgakanyā girikanyāḥ kinnaryaḥ phaṇikanyakāḥ |||54|| gāndharvyaścāpsaraso vidyādhryaḥ pravasanti ca | yatra tatra ruciste’sti kurve svargopamaṃ gṛham ||61 || sarvāstāḥ satataṃ sevāṃ kariṣyanti tava priye | anumodaiḥ sahayānaiḥ sahakrīḍādibhiḥ sadā ||56 || rūpaṃ tavedamatulaṃ vadanaṃ cāru vīkṣya tāḥ | tava dāsyo bhaviṣyanti helayitvā nijaṃ vapuḥ ||5 7 || yadvā himālaye menā bahurūpaguṇānvitā | tatra te sā manomodaṃ kariṣyatyatisevayā ||58 || girīṇāṃ kanyakā haime śikṣārthaṃ yānti nityadā | tatra vai śikharaṃ ramyaṃ śivākhyaṃ yadi rocate || 59 || vicitraiḥ kokilālāpamodaiḥ kujagaṇāvṛtam | sadā vasantaprabhavaṃ vastumicchasi kiṃ priye || 1.173.60 || nānājalasaroyuktaṃ sarojāsaṃkhyatākulam | kalpavṛkṣāmṛtavallīkāmadhenusamanvitam || 61 || praśāntaśvāpadagaṇaṃ yatisādhususevitam | sphāṭikasvargahīrakarājatairupaśobhitam || 6 2 || mānasatālahaṃsāśvavyomahastiniṣevitam | hiraṇmayai ratnajālaiḥ paṃkajairmukulaiḥ sumaiḥ || 63 || nīlotpalādibhiḥ puṣpairmaṃjulaiḥ suniṣevitam | kuṃkumaiḥ sarvagandhaiśca lasadgandhajalaistathā || 6 4|| śādvalaistaruṇaistuṅgairvaṃśavṛkṣaiḥ suśobhitam | nṛtyadbhirvṛddhamayūrairguṃjadbhirbhramarādibhiḥ || 65 || sārasaiḥ kokilābhiśca madhurārāvibhiryutam | gāyanaiḥ satataṃ teṣāṃ śabdāyamānamanvaham || 66 || sahelībhiḥ sadāyuktaṃ kāmoddīpanakārakam | nūtnanūtnasakhīyukta vastumicchasi kiṃ priye || 67 || yadvā meroḥ suśikhare sārabhūte mahāśubhe | saṃvihartuṃ sakhīyuktā sāpsarogaṇamaṇḍitā ||68 samicchasi tatra rantuṃ kurve bhavanamuttamam | nityaṃ śacī kariṣyati tava sevāṃ sahāyatām || 69 || jaleśasya kuberasyeśānasya ca yamasya ca | agnernairṛtadevasya mārutasya parasya vā || 1.173.70 || purībhiḥ śobhite śṛṃge meroruccasurālaye | śacīraṃbhāmenakādiraṃbhorugaṇasevite || 71 || tvamicchasi savihartuṃ kurve tatra mahālayam | athavā mama kailāse parvatendre sadāśraye || 7 2 || sthānamicchasi kuberanagarīsannidhau śubham | gaṃgājalakaṇairārdraṃ pūrṇacandrasamojjvalam ||7 3 || darīṣu sānuṣu droṇyāṃ brahmakanyābhiśobhitam | nānāmṛgakṛtāvāsaṃ padmākaraśatāvṛtam ||74|| merorapi viśeṣeṇa sadvastuguṇamaṇḍitam | āvayoḥ sānukūlaṃ ca racaye tādṛśaṃ tadā || 75 || yatrāstyadhikavāsecchā samācakṣva drutaṃ mama | gṛha svarṇamaṇiratnasampatpūrṇaṃ karomi vai ||76 || satyuvāca tadā śaṃbhuṃ himādrau vasituṃ sadā | samīhe nacirāt tatra kuru saṃvāsamiṣṭadam ||77|| śrutvā śaṃbhuḥ satīṃ nītvā tuṃgaṃ śṛṃga yayau sadā | siddhāṃganāgaṇayuktaṃ sarasīvanarājitam || 78 || vicitraiḥ kusumairvyāptaṃ naikadhāratnakarburam | pakṣibhiryadagamyaṃ vai sphaṭikābhramayaṃ ca yat || 79|| vicitrapuṣpatatibhiḥ śādvalairdrabhiranvitam | praphullataruśākhāgra guṃjadbhramaraghoṣitam || 1.173.80 || paṃkeruhaiḥ praphullaiśca nīlotpalacayairyutama | svargīyasārasahaṃsaśukamenābhisevitam ||8 1 || turaṃgavadanaiḥ siddhairapsarobhiśca sevitam || vidyādharībhirdevībhiḥ kinnarībhirvihāritam ||8 2 || purandhrībhiḥ pārvatībhiḥ kanyābhirabhisaṃgatam | viṇāvipañcītantrikāmṛdaṃgapaṭahasvanaḥ ||8 3 || nṛtyadbhirapsarobhiśca kṛtakautukaśobhitam | devikābhidīrghikābhirgandhibhiḥ susamāvṛtam ||84| praphullapuṣpavallīnāṃ sukuṃjairupaśobhitam | himālayapurābhyarṇe kuberapurasannidhau ||85|| ramyaṃ viśālaśikharaṃ svargatulyamanoharam | śivaśṛṃgaṃ haro gatvā dākṣāyaṇyā samaṃ mudā ||8 6 || ciraṃ reme kṛtasaudhaḥ kṛtakailāsanāmake | saprākāre mahāśāle kailāsanagare nave ||87|| viśvakarmāṇamāhūya kārayāmāsa satpuram | kailāsanāmakaṃ yatra bhavanāni cakāsire ||88 || svarṇaratnamaṇinaddhabhittimanti dṛḍhāni ca | śayyāsthānāni ramyāṇi snānasthānāni santi ca || 89 || śītoṣṇajalakuṇḍāśca vāpyo miṣṭodakāstathā | mahānasāni ramyāṇi vahniśālāstathā śubhāḥ || 1.173.90 || bhakṣyabhojyādisāmagrīrakṣāsthānāni santi ca | śṛṃgārakāryasusthalyo hāsyavinodamaṇḍapāḥ || 91 || hāvabhāvavilāsārthaṃ guptaharmyāṇi santi ca | prāghūṇikanivāsārthaṃ gṛhāṇi sumahānti ca || 92 || nidrāvirāmamañcāḍhyaśayyāgṛhāṇi santi ca | preṃkhādolādisaṃrājadvitardībhūmikottamāḥ || 93 || glahadyūtādiraṅgāni samājaraṃgamaṇḍapāḥ | catuṣkyaścodakuṃbhyaścāṭṭālikāḥ santi sarvaśaḥ || 94|| udyānāśca gṛhodyānā gṛhayānāni vaidyutāḥ | pradīpāḥ śrāvayantrāṇi dṛśyayantrāṇi santi ca || 95 || vastrāṇi lakṣaśo naikajātīyāni kṛtāni vai | pātrāṇi svārṇaraupyāṇi vibhūṣā rātnapauraṭāḥ || 96 || veśāstathopaveśāśca kapāṭaguptasaṃgrahāḥ | vāyuvyajanayantrāṇi kāmasaṃgītaśālikāḥ || 97 || manoraṃjanamārgāśca bahudṛśyāpaṇāstathā | koṭilakṣāyutagaṇanivāsāḥ sadgṛhottamāḥ || 98|| vāṭikāśca vihārāśca rājadhānyaḥ śubhāḥ kṛtāḥ | yatrāmṛtarasā divyāḥ santi brahmarasāstathā || 99 || kāmottejakapānādyāḥ sadrasāḥ santi yatra vai | navayauvanapuṣṭyāpādakavallyoṣadhisthalam || 1.173.100 || kāmadhenunivāsāśca rasaśālāstathā śubhāḥ | vṛṣabhasiṃhagaruḍagajāśva vāhanāni ca || 101 || kṛtāni kāritāni vai kanyāśikṣāgṛhāṇi ca | etādṛśo navastatra kailāso nagarottamaḥ || 102 || kāritaṃ śaṃbhunā viśvakarmadvārā mahottamaḥ | yasyāgre lokapālānāṃ sodhāḥ kṣudrāstadābhavan || 103 || dakṣagṛhācchataguṇasmṛddhiyuktāṃ purīṃ nijām | vilokya vīkṣya saṃlokya satī jaharṣa sā muhuḥ || 1 04|| yadyacca kalpyate vastu tattat tatropatiṣṭhate | na nyūnaṃ vartate kiñcit brahmaviṣṇusurāditaḥ || 1 05|| rājādhirājasallakṣmyā sevyate satīśaṃkarau | rājete rājarājeśasampattyā chatracāmaraiḥ || 106 || vimānavaramāruhya kvacidyātaḥ sthalāntaram | mervādāvantarīkṣe ca svargādau saṃvihṛtya ca || 107|| gatvā gatvā punarnūtne kailāsaibhyetya rematuḥ | satīśau caivamānaṃdaṃ gārhasthyamanucakratuḥ || 108 || evaṃ śrīśaṃkarasukhaṃ satyapaśyatsma sarvadā | śrīśaṃbhurapi sarvatra samadrākṣīt| satīsukham || 10 9|| evamanyonyasaṃsargādanurāgamahīruham | vardhayāmāsatuḥ satīśivau bhāvāmbusecanaiḥ || 1.173.110 || satī tatraikadā śaṃbhuṃ papraccha vismitānanā | vairāgyavṛttimāpannā santuṣṭā sukhabhogataḥ || 111 || devadeva mahādeva kṛpāṃ kuru mamopari | tvaṃ parabrahmatādātmyabhāvāpanno’guṇaḥ paraḥ || 112|| dhanyāhaṃ te priyā jātā jātastvaṃ me patiḥ prabhuḥ | jñātumicchāmi deveśa tattvaṃ yena bhavaṃ taret || 113 || yatkṛtvā viṣayī jīvo’vaśyaṃ vrajetparaṃ padam | ākarṇya tat śivo’vocat satījñānārthamatra yat || 1 14|| śṛṇu priye pravakṣyāmi tattvaṃ mukto bhaved yataḥ | paratattvaṃ vijānīhi hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ sadā || 1 15|| durlabhaṃ tasya vijñānaṃ tajjñātā viralaḥ priye | nārāyaṇasya
