dāso’haṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ || 116 || nārāyaṇasya bhaktiśca bhuktimuktiphalapradā | smaryase prāgbhave devi naranārāyaṇāśrame || 11 7|| gatvārhaṃ vaiṣṇavo jātastatastvaṃ vaiṣṇavī kṛtā | golokādvaiṣṇavaścāhaṃ punarbhāvī ca vaiṣṇavaḥ || 118 || tvayā bhāvyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavyā brahmabhaktyā mama gṛhe | brahmadhāmni sthitasyāsya nārāyaṇasya sarvathā || 119 || smṛtirvijñānamevārādhanopāstiśca sarvadā | mananaṃ cātha bhaktiśca premaseveti caikatā || 1.173.12 0 || tayā vai prāpyate nārāyaṇo nānyena kenacit | sulabhā tatprasādātmā navadhātra prakīrtitā || 121 || śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ caiva smaraṇaṃ sevanaṃ sadā | dāsyaṃ tathārcanaṃ devi vandanaṃ śrīharestathā || 122 || sakhyamātmaniveditvaṃ navāṃgāni ca tāni vai | kathādernityasammānaṃ kurvandehādibhirhareḥ || 123 || tadarthapānaṃ sthairyeṇa yattacchravaṇamucyate | śrutvā tadarthamananaṃ kartavyaṃ phaladaṃ hi tat || 1 24|| hṛdaye śrīharerjanmakarmāṇi cintayanmuhuḥ | prītyoccoccāraṇaṃ teṣāmetatkīrtanamucyate || 125|| vyāpakaṃ śrīhariṃ jñātvā sa vai sarvatra sarvadā | smaryate yena manasā smaraṇaṃ tadudāhṛtam || 126 || sarvathā jāgrati svapne vastubhiḥ svasya supriyaiḥ | paricaryā tu yā tasya sevanaṃ tadudāhṛtam || 127 || sadānukūlabhāvena hṛdayāmṛtabhogataḥ | hareḥ priyaṃ yathā vṛttyaṃ tadvai dāsyamudāhṛtam || 128 || sadā smṛddhyānukūlyena vidhinā paramātmane | arpaṇaṃ ṣoḍaśānāṃ vai pādyādīnāṃ tadarcanam || 129 || nāmoccāraṇadhyānābhyāṃ manasā vacasā tathā | yadaṣṭāṃgena bhūsparśā daṇḍavat vandanaṃ hi tat || 1.173.130 || maṃgalāmaṃgalaṃ yadyat karoti śrīharirhi me | sarvaṃ tanmaṃgalāyeti viśvāsaḥ sakhyamucyate || 131 || kṛtvā dehādikaṃ tasya prītyai sarvaṃ tadarpaṇam | nirvāhāya svaśūnyatvaṃ harāvātmaniveditā || 132 || navāṃgāni harerbhakterbhuktimuktipradāni ca | mama priyāṇi cātīva vijñānotpādakāni ca || 133 || upāṃgāni ca tadbhakterbahūni santi me priye | tulasīsevanādīni mandiramārjanāni ca || 1 34|| devālayaprarakṣādi samūhyāni vicārataḥ | iti sāṃgopāgabhaktirhareḥ sarvottamā priye || 135 || jñānavairāgyajananī muktidāsī virājate | trailokye bhaktisadṛśaḥ panthā nāsti sukhāvahaḥ || 136 || bhaktimato janasya śrīhariścāsti sahāyakṛt | bhaktitattvaṃ paratattvaprāpakaṃ tattvameva tat || 1 37|| sā ca bhaktiḥ punardvedhā saguṇā nirguṇā tathā | phalecchayā kṛtā sarvā saguṇā parikathyate || 138 || phalecchārahitā saiva nirguṇā bhaktirucyate | sā ca bhaktiḥ punardvedhā vaidhī svābhāvikī tathā || 139 || prasahya vidhinā kāryā vaidhī sā tvājñayā kṛtā | svabhāvenaiva kāryā yā svābhāvikī tu sā matā || 1.173.140 || sā ca bhaktiḥ punadvaidhā parā cāthāparā tathā | parā sādhyaharirūpāparā sādhanarūpiṇī || 141 || naiṣṭhikyanaiṣṭhikī dvedhā ṣaḍvidhā naiṣṭhikī matā | viśvāso varaṇaṃ nyāsaḥ kārpaṇyaṃ ca sthirā matiḥ || 142||| ānukūlyasahakṛtaprātikūlyavivarjanam | ṣaḍvidhā naiṣṭhikī bhaktiranaiṣṭhikyekadhā matā || 143 || svārthamātrakṛtā bhaktiranaiṣṭhikī prakīrtitā | vihitāvihitā sātha dvedhājñā vihitā matā || 144|| anājñā cāvihitoktā punarmadhyottamāvamā | tredhā tatra taratamairbhāvairbhavatyanekadhā || 145|| harernāmajapasāmyaṃ nānye bhavati kutracit | harirityarthakaṃ brahma vyāharam̐śca hariṃ smaran || 146 yaḥ prayāti tyajandehaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim | bhaktyā tuṣyati lokaśca bhaktyā tuṣyati vai hariḥ || 147|| śṛṇu devi mayā pūrve kalpe nārāyaṇopari | yugaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi tapastaptaṃ suduścaram || 148|| tadā nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādabhūnme dṛṣṭigocaraḥ | atīva kamanīyāṃgaḥ kiśoraḥ śyāmasundaraḥ || 149 || rūpānurūpāvayavaḥ suprasannamanoharaḥ | dṛṣṭvā hariṃ tādṛśaṃ me netre tṛptiṃ na vai gate || 1.173.150 || paśyannimeṣarahito’bhavaṃ tṛpto na vai ciram | tadā māṃ bhagavānprāha kiṃ śaṃbho naiva tṛpyasi || 151 || gacchāmyahaṃ svakaṃ dhāma varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam | tava bhaktyā ca tapasā prasanno’smi ca mā ciram || 1 52|| tadā mayārthitaṃ nārāyaṇāt śṛṇu priye mama | tavopabhogyaṃ yatsyāttanna me bhogyaṃ bhavettu prāk || 15 3 || tava prasādasarvasvaṃ mama bhogyaṃ mataṃ prabho | tava dāsyaṃ sadā me syādātmaniveditāpi ca || 15 4|| anyāpi vividhā bhaktistavaiva me’stu mokṣadā | mastake me jaṭā nityā tapasyābodhikāstu vai || 155 || śarīre me citābhasma vairāgyabodhikāstu vai | samatā candane paṃke loṣṭhe ratne maṇīśvare || 156|| sadāstu mukuṭādyā na bhūṣā dhāryā mayā prabho | tatra sarpā mayā dhāryā garuḍadveṣiṇo hare || 157|| vāhanaṃ tu vṛṣo golokāt kṛṣṇārpita eva me | pārijātādikaṃ puṣpaṃ sugandhi candanādikam || 158 || tava yogyaṃ bhavettatra me bhāgaḥ kvāpi mā bhavet | dhattūre’stu sadā prītirbilvapatrānudhāraṇe || 159 || gandhahīneṣu puṣpeṣu prītirme’stu virāgataḥ | vastraveśe māstu rāgo’stu gajavyāghracarmaṇoḥ || 1.173.160 || dityatalpe divyabhoge māstu prītiḥ kadācana | śmaśāne’stu sadā vāso janatāyāṃ na me kvacit || 161 || śmaśāne vighnaśūnye me dhyānaṃ tava sadā bhavet | jñānaṃ te śrīhare nityaṃ guṇatrayavināśakam || 162 || triśūlarūpaṃ me syācca vairāgyaṃ bhasmarūpakam | dharmo me vṛṣarūpaḥ syādbhaktirme yogitā tvayi || 163 || kaṇṭhahāraśca te bhaktivirodhiśirasāṃ kṛtaḥ | bhūṣāmālāśca te’yogyarudrākṣa phalakalpitāḥ || 1 64|| māstu vṛndādivṛkṣāṇāṃ bhogyaṃ te māstu matkṛte | lakṣmīrdevī mama māstu kintvalakṣmīrmamāstu vai || 165 || miṣṭaṃ peyaṃ hareryatsyāt tanme māstu kadācana | mamāstu viṣadhattūragaṃjābhaṃgādikaṃ sadā || 166 || ityevaṃ tu mayā sarvaṃ tapaḥkāle prapārthitam | hariṇā ca pradattaṃ tadvaradānaṃ śubhāya me || 1 67|| prabhaktānāṃ praśikṣārthaṃ dāsabhaktyabhivyaṃjakam | asurāṇāṃ vimohārthaṃ rakṣitaṃ tu tadājñayā || 168 || tasmāt sati tvayā dāsye harervṛttyaṃ na cānyathā | śṛṇu cānyāṃ kathāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ hareḥ prasādagarbhitām || 169 || sanatkumāro vaikuṇṭhamekadā tu jagāma ha | dadarśa bhuktavantaṃ ca hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ muniḥ || 1.173.170 || tuṣṭāva gūḍhaiḥ stotraiśca praṇamya bhaktipūrvakam | avaśeṣaṃ dadau tasmai santuṣṭo bhaktavatsalaḥ || 171 || tatraiva kiṃcittenaiva bhuktaṃ śeṣaṃ ca yaddhṛtam | tadvai rarakṣa bandhūnāṃ bhakṣaṇārthaṃ ca durlabham || 172|| tasmādapi ca kiṃcicca siddhāśramasthitāya me | dattavān sa munistacca bhuktaṃ sarvaṃ mayādarāt || 173 || bhuktvāhaṃ durlabhaṃ hareḥ prasādaṃ nṛtyamācaram | pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgaḥ sāśrunetro’bhavaṃ mudā || 174 || śrīharerguṇagānaṃ ca tālamānena susvaram | rāgabhedaikatānena bhaktyā cākaravaṃ tadā || 175||| papāta ḍamarurhastācchṛṃgaṃ ca vyāghracarma ca | svayaṃ nipatya paścācca rudanmūrchāṃ gato’pyaham || 176 || atīva kamanīyaṃ śrīhareḥ rūpaṃ manoharam | hṛdaye mūrchitastatra dhyāyāmi tāvadeva ha || 177 || tadantare ca durgā tvaṃ mudājagāma bhāminī | ahamutthāya mūrchāto yāvattiṣṭhāmi bhāmini || 178 || tāvanmūrchākaraṃ tatra kāraṇaṃ pṛṣṭameva me | mayā tubhyaṃ tu kathitaṃ prasādalābha eva yat || 179 || jñātvā tvaṃ kupitā devi proktavatī ca māṃ tadā | tvaṃ poṣṭā jagatāṃ pātā mamaiva ca viśeṣataḥ || 1.173.180 || vaktā caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ dātā ca sarvasampadām | tvaṃ cetkaroṣi durnītiṃ ko dharmaṃ rakṣayiṣyati || 181 || sadā te paripālyāhaṃ poṣyā bhaktā ca kiṃkarī | vaṃcitā karmadoṣeṇa hareḥ prasādabhakṣaṇe || 182 || kiṃcicchuddhaṃ hiraṇyena kiṃcicchuddhaṃ ca vāyunā | kiṃcitprakṣālanenaiva sarvaṃ viṣṇornivedanāt || 183 || viṣṇorniveditānnena yaṣṭavyāḥ sarvadevatāḥ | pitaro’tithayaścaivamiti vedeṣu niścitam || 184|| anivedyamabhakṣyaṃ ca naivedyaṃ bhakṣyameva hi | evamaśnāti yo bhaktyā pārṣadapravaro bhavet || 185|| amṛtaṃ sarvavastūnāmiṣṭasāraṃ sudurlabham | viṣṇorniveditānnasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm || 186 || hantyakālikamṛtyuṃ tadamṛtaṃ mūḍharaṃjanam | naivedyaṃ ca harereva haritulyaṃ karotyaho || 187 || yadṛcchayā tannaivedyaṃ yo bhuṃkte sādhusaṃgataḥ | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇāṃ prāpnoti tapasaḥ phalam || 188 || yo nivedya hariṃ bhuṃkte bhaktyā bhaktaśca nityaśaḥ | sa paṃktipāvano bodhyaḥ sa harestejasā samaḥ || 189 || nāhaṃ vedavidhātryasmi kimahaṃ vaktumīśvarī | suciraṃ tu tapastaptvā mayā labdhastvamīśvaraḥ || 1.173.190 || tvayā viṣṇoḥ prasādena vaṃcitāhaṃ kathaṃ prabho | ityabhidhāya durgā tvaṃ rodanaṃ kṛtavatyasi || 191 || tato’haṃ tvāṃ parapremṇā kṛtvā vakṣasi sādaram | kareṇa cakṣuṣornīraṃ saṃmṛjyābodhayaṃ muhuḥ || 192 || parituṣṭā tadā tvaṃ māṃ bhartāramuktavatyasi | kalevaraṃ ca tyakṣyāmi naivedyena vinā hareḥ || 193 || bibharmi dehaṃ satataṃ tava saubhāgyavardhanam | kathaṃ vahāmi saubhāgyarahitaṃ tu kalevaram || 1 94|| apūrvaṃ harinaivedyaṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam | mahyaṃ dattaṃ na vai yasmātpaśya dehaṃ tyajāmyaham || 195 || ityuktvā tvaṃ mahādevi dehaṃ tyaktuṃ samudyatā | tadā mayā stutā tvaṃ vai mahādevi sthirā bhava || 196 || mamāparādhamakhilaṃ kṣantumarhasi sundari | māṃ bhṛtyaṃ tapasā krītaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru mamopari || 197 || icchaiva śrīhareḥ sākṣānnāhaṃ dātumapi kṣamaḥ | śrutvaivaṃ śrīharericchāṃ durgā tuṣṭā babhūva sā || 198 || tato jagāma tūrṇaṃ svarṇadīṃ snānārthamityatha | snātvā sampūjya bhaktyā ca kṛtvā pakvānnamityatha || 199 || naivedye me’rpitavatī tadā nārāyaṇo’pyaham | gatvā sarvamahaṃ bhuktvā tasyai datvābhivāñchitam || 1.173.200 || ājagāma ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ lakṣmi prasādameva tam | bhartre datvā ca śeṣaṃ yad durgā bhuktavatī ca tat || 201 || evaṃ śivāśivau bhaktau prāgbhavīyau hi vaiṣṇavau | vartete sarvadā magnau yanmūrtau yoginau parau || 202|| na saṃvasāmi goloke vaikuṇṭhe tava vakṣasi | sadā śivasya hṛdaye nibaddho bhaktipāśataḥ || 203 || svarasiddhaṃ sutānena pañcavaktreṇa śaṃkaraḥ | śaśvadgāyati madgāthāṃ tenāhaṃ taddhṛdi sthitaḥ || 204 || mama bhaktiṃ ca dāsyaṃ ca muktiṃ ca sarvasampadaḥ | mayyevāyaṃ sarvasiddhīḥ samarpayati śaṃkaraḥ || 2 05 || pañcavaktre mannāma yo hi gāyatyaharniśam | madrūpaṃ dhyāyati śaśvanna bhaktaḥ śaṃkarātparaḥ || 206 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satīśivayorhimācale vihāraḥ gṛhanirmāṇārthaṃ satī prārthanāgṛhayogyaparvatādināmāni himālaye kailāsapurīnirmāṇaṃ satīkṛtasaṃsārataraṇapraśraḥ śivoktaharinavadhābhaktiḥ śivakṛtapūrvakalpīyatapasā haridarśanaṃ haribhogyaṃ śivasyābhogyamitidhattūrabhasmādidhāraṇaṃ pārvatyoktaharinaivedyamahimetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trisaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 173 ||
<1.174> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi sutāsnehāt svayaṃ dakṣaprajāpatiḥ | sutāsaṃbhāvanārthaṃ vai samāyācchaṃkaragṛham || 1 || samāyāntaṃ mahādevo dakṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathocitām | dakṣāya pradadau pūjāṃ satkāraṃ ca yathocitam || 2 || dakṣastu mānavān śaṃbhurmānahīno munīśvaraḥ | dvayostu mīlane dakṣa iyeṣādhikasatkṛtam || 3 || śaṃbhunā munitulyaṃ vai sammānaṃ tasya saṃkṛtam | kintu cotthāyābhiyānaṃ tatra nācaritaṃ tadā || 4 || tatra heturmahānāsīcchṛṇu lakṣmi hitāvaham | tapasā cātha dharmeṇa yogena śreṣṭhatāṃ gataḥ || 5 || svāpekṣayāpakṛṣṭasyāgame notthānamācaret | śreṣṭhe samutthite’lpasya sarvapuṇyakṣayo bhavet || 6 || vicāryetthaṃ harastatra dakṣaṃ prati na cotthitaḥ | kintu dakṣastamobhāvaṃ prāpya cukopa cāntare || 7 || bālo’yaṃ śaṃkara iti matvā novāca kiṃcana | evameva prakupito gṛhaṃ jagāma maunataḥ || 8 || atha satīṃ gṛhaṃ prāptāṃ dakṣaḥ prāha sudurmanāḥ | anye jāmātaraḥ śreṣṭhā bhartustava pinākinaḥ || 9 || sarve hyutthāya sammānaṃ kurvanti mama cādarāt | śaṃbhurutthāya sammānaṃ na karoti sute mama || 1.174.10 || avyāvahārikaḥ śaṃbhurbāliśaḥ pratibhāti me | astu śokaṃ na vai kurve bāle kā nāma dharṣaṇā || 11 || ityuktvā svīyaputryāḥ saḥ sammānaṃ vidadhe bahu | satī satkāramādāya kailāse svagṛhaṃ gatā || 12 || proktavatī śaṃbhave tattadā vai śaṃbhunā priyā | bodhitā spaṣṭarūpeṇa mā naśyed dakṣasukṛtam || 13 || satī jñātvā ca taddhārdaṃ kiṃcinnovāca tatra vai | piturlābhāya śarveṇa kṛte tatsukhadaṃ matam || 1 4|| athāpi śaṃbhunā śaptaṃ dakṣo hyāṅgiraso dvijaḥ | sammānaṃ cecchati matto’dhikaṃ cāghaṭitaṃ bahu || 15 || tasmātsa kṣatriyāṃ yoniṃ yātu prācaitasāṃ gṛhe | prācetasaḥ kṣatriyaḥ sa bhavatu yatra neṣaṇā || 16 || sammānasyādhikā matsadṛśādbhavet kadācana | iti śaṃbhoḥ kṣudraśāpo’bhavad dakṣaprajāpateḥ || 17 || nāradasyāpi śāpo’bhūt punarjanmagrahe yataḥ | dakṣo dvitīyaṃ janmedaṃ prācetasāṃ gṛhe’labhat || 18 || tathāpi pūrvasaṃskāro vartate dakṣamānase | prāgbhavīyajanako’haṃ satyā asmīti mānayan || 19 || vartate sarvathā mānī saṃskāro naiva naśyati | janmāntare ca kaḥ kasya śvaśuro jananī pitā || 1.174.2 0 || śaṃbhunaiva gaṇayate bhave’tra śvaśuraṃ nijam | lokapālaṃ gaṇayati kṣatriyaṃ bahumāninam || 21 || athāpi satyāḥ śaṃbhośca jātismarastu vartate | dakṣaḥ pūrvaḥ evāyaṃ satāpitā punarbhavaḥ || 22 || tathāpi cātra kiṃ me’sti gataṃ pūrvabhave’khilam | iti matvā na vai śaṃbhurmanute śvaśuraṃ nijam || 23 || athaikadā punastādṛk prasaṃgaḥ samabhūt priye | śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃ svakailāse nagarāyāvicārayat || 24 || viśvakarmāṇamāhūya puro ramyaṃ susmṛddhimat | svīyasurabhiśālāyāṃ kārayāmāsa sundaram || 25 || bhavanaṃ vistṛtaṃ samyak tatra siṃhāsanaṃ varam | tatra chatraṃ mahādivyaṃ sarvathādbhutamuttamam || 26 || tadvāstukaraṇārthaṃ vai cakāra sumahotsavam | śakrādīnājuhāvāśu samastān devatāgaṇān || 27 || siddhagandharvanāgādīnupadeṣṭṛm̐śca kṛtsnaśaḥ | devānmunīnāgamām̐śca vidhiṃ śiṣyaiḥ ṛṣīnapi || 28 || devīḥ sarvā apsarobhirnānāvastubhiranvitāḥ | devānāṃ ca tatharṣīṇāṃ siddhānāṃ phaṇināmapi || 29 || ānayanmaṃgalahastāḥ kanyāḥ ṣoḍaśa ṣoḍaśa | vīṇāmṛdaṃgapramukhavādyānnānāvidhām̐stathā || 1.174.30 || utsavaṃ kārayāmāsa vādayitvā sugāyanaiḥ | rājyābhiṣekayogyāni dravyāṇi sakalauṣadhaiḥ || 31 || pratyakṣatīrthapāthobhiḥ paṃcakubhām̐śca pūritān | tathānyāḥ saṃvidhā divyā ānayat svagaṇaistadā || 32 || brahmaghoṣaṃ mahārāvaṃ cakrustatra tu bhūsurāḥ | haro hariṃ sanmuhūrte nūtne sihāsane vare || 33 || upāveśya bahuprītyā bhūṣayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ | ābaddhya ramyamukuṭaṃ kṛtakautukamaṃgalam || 34 || viṣṇuṃ tuṣṭāva taṃ śaṃbhuḥ svatantraṃ bhaktavatsalam | anyaṃ sarvaṃ samājaṃ ca namaskṛtya haraḥ sthitaḥ || 35 || dakṣo’tra mānavānāyāt prajāpatibhiranvitaḥ | śaṃbhunā satkṛtāḥ sarve dakṣo’pi saha satkṛtaḥ || 36 || bhojanācchādanapānamānayānavihārakaiḥ | satkṛtāḥ sarvathā sarve dakṣaścaicchadviśeṣataḥ || 3 7|| sammānaṃ tu nijaṃ tatra śvāśuryasyābhiyogataḥ | dakṣaḥ śaṃbhorgṛhamadhye jagāma svasutānanam || 38 || draṣṭuṃ praṣṭuṃ sukhaṃ śāntiṃ tadā śaṃbhustu notthitaḥ | dakṣastadāntare’tīva mānī cukopa vai punaḥ || 3 9|| satīmāpṛcchya kuśalaṃ sukhaṃ cānāmayaṃ tathā | dakṣo jagāma harmyaṃ svaṃ cānye’pi svagṛhān gatāḥ ||1.174.40 || pratyakṣaṃ tadidaṃ cābhūdavamānaṃ prajāpateḥ | anāhūte’paricite hyanāgamanamuttamam ||4 1 || evaṃ manasi sandhārya tadāpi dakṣa ātmani | avamānaṃ rarakṣaiva bahirnaivāprakāśayat ||42 || atha kālāntare naimiṣāraṇye ca tapodhanāḥ | dīrghasatraṃ prakurvanto bhṛgvādyāstu maharṣayaḥ ||43|| āsannekatritāstatra samājagmurharādayaḥ | āgatām̐ste ca dadṛśurmunayo dīrghasatriṇaḥ ||44|| uttasthuryugapatsarve saharṣāśca samutsukāḥ | datvārghyapādyaṃ satkṛtya munayo vītakalmaṣāḥ ||45 || paśyanti sma haraṃ viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇaṃ pulahādikān | manavaścāgatāstatra tathā dakṣo’pi cāgataḥ ||46|| yadṛcchayā samāpannaḥ pūjitaśca maharṣibhiḥ | stutibhiḥ praṇipātaiśca tathā sarvaiḥ surāsuraiḥ ||47|| abhipūjita evāsau niṣasāda sabhāntare | rudreṇa na kṛtā tasyābhyutthānanatisatkriyāḥ ||48|| viśeṣataḥ svasya mānaṃ na jātaṃ rudrasatkṛtam | cukopa rudraṃ tvaritaṃ tadā dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||49|| uvāca paruṣaṃ vākyaṃ rudramuddiśya tatra vai | ete namanti sarve māṃ viprāḥ surāsurādikāḥ ||1.174.50 || abhyutthānādinā sarve mānayanti bhṛśaṃ ca mām | kathaṃ durjanavaccāyaṃ naivottiṣṭhati bhūtapaḥ ||5 1 || śmaśānavāsī nistrapaḥ pretapiśācasaṃyutaḥ | anuttamo mattasakhā karoti na natiṃ ca me ||52|| jātyā ca karmabhirhīnaḥ pākhaṇḍī durjanapriyaḥ | pāpaśīlaścoddhataśca nindako’śucireva ca ||5 3 || tyājyo’yaṃ sarvadā sadbhirbahiṣkāryaśca sarvathā | yadā yadā gṛhaṃ tasya gato’haṃ mūrkharāḍayam ||54|| naivottiṣṭhati sāmīpye me’vamānaṃ karoti vai | tasmādayaṃ yajñabāhyo bhavatvadyadinātsadā ||55|| rudrasyānucarāṃ ye ca te’pi vedbahiṣkṛtāḥ | pākhaṇḍavādasaṃyuktāḥ śiṣṭācāravivarjitāḥ | 56|| kapālinaḥ pānaratāḥ kālānanā bhavantviti | nandī niśamya tadvākyaṃ dakṣaṃ prati ruṣānvitaḥ ||57|| śaśāpa dakṣaṃ tatpakṣān brāhmaṇām̐ścānyavarṇinaḥ | vedavādaratā yūyaṃ nānyadastītivādinaḥ ||58|| kāmātmānaḥ svargaparāḥ krodhalobhasamanvitāḥ | vaidikavidhinā viprā bhavantu śūdrayājakāḥ ||59|| daridriṇo bhavantvatra pratigraharatāstathā | asatpathagatāḥ sarve bhavantu brahmarākṣasāḥ ||1.174.60 || śaṃbhuḥ śāntastadā prāha nandinaṃ svasya sevakam | kopaṃ nārhasi vai kartuṃ brāhmaṇānprati sarvadā ||61 || ko’yaṃ kastvaṃ kva cāhaṃ vai kasmācchaptāstvayā dvijāḥ | prapaṃcaracanāṃ tyaktvā prabuddho bhava sevaka ||62|| śātiṃ ca prāpitāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇusurādibhiḥ | dakṣo gato gṛhaṃ svasya svāvamānaṃ smaran muhuḥ ||63 || tataḥ kāle mahān yajñaḥ samārabdhaśca tena vai | dakṣeṇa dīkṣitenātivistārastatra carṣayaḥ ||64|| āhūtāśca vaśiṣṭhādyāstapasvinaḥ samāyayuḥ | kaśyapo’trirvāmadevo hyagastyaśca bhṛgustathā ||65|| parāśaro dadhīcaśca vyāsaśca gautamaḥ sitaḥ | gargaḥ pailo bharadvājo bhārgavaḥ kakupaḥ kṛtiḥ ||66|| tathānye ṛṣayo devā lokapālā diśādhipāḥ | gandharvāḥ kinnarā vidyādharāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ||67|| satyalokānsamānītaḥ sāvitrīsaṃyutastvajaḥ | vaikuṇṭhācca tato viṣṇurlakṣmīramādisaṃyutaḥ ||68|| indrastatra samānītaścendrāṇyā saha svargataḥ | tathā candro’pi rohiṇyā vāruṇyā varuṇastathā ||69|| kuberaḥ puṣpakārūḍho māruto mṛgavāhanaḥ | pāvako bastayānaśca nairṛtaḥ pretavāhanaḥ ||1.174.70|| dārāḥ putrāśca śiṣyāśca pārṣadā mantriṇastathā | parivārāstathā vedāsteṣāṃ teṣāṃ samāgatāḥ ||71 || evamanye samāyātā dakṣayajñe kṛtādarāḥ | satkṛtāstena dakṣeṇa sarve te bahuvastubhiḥ |||72|| bhavanāni mahārhāṇi suprabhāṇi mahānti ca | tvaṣṭrā kṛtāni divyāni tebhyo dattāni tena vai ||73|| teṣu sarveṣu dhiṣṇyeṣu yathāyogyaṃ ca te sthitāḥ | sammānitā arājam̐ste sakalā viṣṇunā mayā ||74|| athāsiknī satīmātā pūrvadakṣavivāhitā | dakṣaṃ jātaṃ punarjñātvā tatrāgatyāvasat sadā ||75|| sā cāsiknī tatra śaṃbhuṃ yadarthamatapatsatī | na dadarśa samāyātaṃ tadā prāha prajāpatim ||76|| dakṣaṃ natvāvadatprahvīkṛtāntaḥkaraṇā natā | kathaṃ satī tathā śaṃbhurdṛśyete nātra tūtsave ||77|| dakṣaḥ prāha tadāsiknīṃ tayornāsti prayojanam | satī tu sarvadā snigdhā pitrormānābhilāṣiṇī ||78 || śaṭhaḥ śarvo na vai snigdho me’vamānaprakārakaḥ | atīva garvito jātaḥ satīṃ me prāpya kanyakām ||79 || kasyacinnāpyasau prāyo na kaścidasya vā priyaḥ | kiṃvaṃśyastveṣa kiṃgotraḥ kiṃdeśīyaḥ kimātmakaḥ ||1.174.8 0 || kiṃvṛttiḥ kiṃsamācāro viṣādī vṛṣavāhanaḥ | na prāyaśastapasvyeṣa kva tapaḥ kvāstradhāraṇam ||8 1 || na gṛhastheṣu gaṇyo’sau śmaśāne tiṣṭhate sadā | nāyaṃ tu brahmacārī syād yataḥ satyā vivāhitaḥ ||8 2|| vānaprāsthyaṃ na caivāsminnaiśvaryamadamohite | na jāne brāhmaṇo nāsti vedaścainaṃ na vetti yat ||8 3 || na jāne kṣatriyo nāsti prāyaḥ śastrāstrasaṃgrahāt | kṣatāttrāṇaṃ nāsti cāsminsarveṣāṃ pralayapriye ||84|| nirdhano’raṇyaratimāna vaiśyo’pi naiva bhāti me | kathaṃ śūdre samāveśo nāgayajñopavītinaḥ ||85 || evaṃ varṇāśramātītaḥ ko bhavenaiva budhyate | sarvaḥ prakṛtyā jñāyeta sthāṇuḥ prakṛtivarjitaḥ ||86|| prāyaśaḥ puruṣo nāsau yato’rdhapramadāmayaḥ | nāpi vai kevalānārī yato’sau śmaśrulānanaḥ ||87|| nāpi napuṃsako vāsti liṃgaṃ tvasya prapūjyate | na cāpi bālarūpoyaṃ bahuvarṣodbhavo yataḥ ||88|| manvate taṃ marīcyādyā vṛddhaṃ nāyaṃ yuvā yataḥ | vṛddho’pi kathamāstheyo jarāmṛtyuvivarjitaḥ ||8 9 || saṃhārayati sarvānvai tathāpyeṣa na pātakī | puṇyaleśaḥ kathaṃ cātra brahmamastakanāśake || 1.174.90 || muṇḍahāradhare kvāsya śucitvaṃ vai digambare | nāyaṃ ca dhanavānnaivāpatyavānna kuṭumbavān || 91 || nāsya mātā nāsya gotraṃ na vaṃśo nāpi dehavān | śmaśāne vartate nityaṃ śvādo naivopalakṣyate ||92 || kiṃ bahūktena me devi jñāyate nāsya ceṣṭitam | aho dhārṣṭyaṃ māṃ pratyeva jaṭilasyāvamānakṛt || 93 || yadāsanānnotthito’yaṃ dṛṣṭvā māṃ śvaśuraṃ gurum | etādṛśā bhavantyeva mātāpitṛvivarjitāḥ || 94||| nirguṇā akulīnāśca karmabhraṣṭā niraṃkuśāḥ | yatheṣṭācaraṇāḥ svābhimānino yantṛvarjitāḥ || 95|| akiṃcanā api stabdhā bhavantīśvaramāninaḥ | jāmātā jambukatulyaḥ śvaśure mṛgapāyate || 96|| asikni tava jāmātā mama mastakanāśakaḥ | yato’vamantā me jātastasmānnākārito mayā || 97|| tasyāhaṃ garvasarvasvaṃ hariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ | yathāvamānitaścāhamavamaṃsye tathaiva tam || 98 || tasmāttvayā na smartavyo mā yajñe phalabhāgbhavet | iti dakṣeṇāgryapatnī bodhitā maunamāsthitā || 99 || viniḥśvāsaṃ tadā muktvā dīrghaṃ sutāṃ vināśapat | notsave svasutāputrajāmātrādyāsyadarśanam || 1.174.100 || prajvalatūtsavastādṛk kusavaḥ sa tu kathyate | yatrāsusamaputryādidarśanaṃ nopalabhyate || 101 || ityasiknyā manodagdho yajñāraṃbhastu bhasmitaḥ | rājyamātuḥ śāpadagdho’vaśyaṃ dagdho bhaviṣyati || 102 || dakṣaścāgatya māṃ viṣṇuṃ yajñapūruṣamityapi | mahākratūpadraṣṭāraṃ cakre’rpitasvamastakaḥ || 103 || prāha devānṛṣīn viprānprajāpām̐śca manūm̐stathā | ahaṃ yiyakṣuryūyaṃ me yajñasāhāyyakāriṇaḥ || 1 04|| bhavata yajñasaṃbhārānānayata tvarānvitāḥ | śṛṇu lakṣmi vartamāne tīrthe kanakhale makhe || 10 5|| tasyartvijo’bhavansarve ṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ | bhṛgvādyāśca trikālajñā vedamūrtaya eva te || 106 || adhiṣṭhātātvahaṃ viṣṇuḥ saha sarvamarudgaṇaiḥ | brahmā tatrābhavadbrahmā trayīvidhinidarśakaḥ || 1 07|| tathaiva sarve dikpālā dvārapālāśca rakṣakāḥ | sāyudhāḥ saparīvārāḥ kutūhalakarāḥ sadā || 108 || upatasthe svayaṃ yajño mūrtimām̐stasya cādhvare | vedadharāḥ svayaṃ mahāmunayaścābhavanmakhe || 109 || agniḥ svayaṃ nijaṃ rūpaṃ cakre sahasradhā tadā | haviṣāṃ grahaṇāyāśu tatra yajñamahotsave || 1.174.110 || aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi juhvati sma ca ṛtvijaḥ | udgātāraścatuḥṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi surarṣayaḥ || 111 || adhvaryavo’tha hotārastāvanto nāradādayaḥ | saptarṣayaḥ sāmagārthāḥ kurvanti sma pṛthakpṛthak || 112 || siddhagandharvavidyādhrādityayajñagaṇānbahūn | samastānnāgasarpāṃśca vavre dakṣo mahādhvare || 113 || dvijarṣisurarājarṣivasunidhigaṇā nṛpāḥ | mitrasacivasainyāḍhyā vṛtā makhopavettrakāḥ || 114 || dīkṣāyuktastadā dakṣaḥ kṛtakautukamaṃgalaḥ | bhāryayā sahito reje kṛtasvastyayano bhṛśam || 115 || tatra yajñe vṛtaṃ sarvaṃ na vṛto hara ekalaḥ | kapālīti viniścitya tasya yajñārhatā nahi || 116 || avamanteti kṛtvaiva yajñe bhāgo’pi māstviti | kapālibhāryeti satī pūrvajā svasutāpi ca || 11 7|| nāhūtā yajñaviṣaye dakṣeṇāguṇadarśinā | evaṃ pravartamāne vai dakṣayajñe mahotsave || 118 || svakāryalagnāstatrāsan sarve te’dhvarasammatāḥ | etasminnutsave tatra na dṛṣṭvā śaṃkaraṃ satīm || 119 || prodvignamānasaḥ śaivo dadhīco vākyamabravīt | dakṣaprajāpate dakṣa sākṣād dhātṛsvarūpadhṛk || 1.174.120 || na tvayi dṛśyate tejaḥ sāmarthyaṃ vā kratukṛte | yādṛśaḥ kraturārabdho na vai pārayituṃ kṣamaḥ || 121 || kratustu naiva kartavyo nāsti kratusamo ripuḥ | kartavyaśca tadā yajño yadi sampattirīdṛśī || 122 || sākṣādagniḥ svayaṃ mūrtimān kuṇḍe’tra virājate | indrādayastathā devāḥ sākṣātsanti samāgatāḥ || 123 || mantrāḥ sarve’pi sākṣācca vartante yajñakarmasu | yajñaśca bhagavān sākṣānmūrtaścātra virājate || 1 24|| bṛhaspatiḥ svayaṃ cātrācāryasthāne suśobhate | brahmā sākṣādbrahmasthāne karmakāṇḍī bhṛguḥ svayam || 125 || ayaṃ pūṣā bhagaścāyaṃ sākṣāddevīsarasvatī | śāradā ca tathā sākṣāt lakṣmīrnārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 126 || dikpālā lokapālāśca sākṣādrakṣākṛtaḥ svayam | jāmātā tveṣa te dharmaḥ patnībhiḥ samupasthitaḥ || 127 || tvaṃ ca patnyā samaṃ dīkṣāṃ prāpto’si yajane svayam | saptaviṃśatipatnibhiḥ saha tai kāryakṛcchaśī || 128 || mārīcaḥ kaśyapaścāyaṃ rājasūyasya kārakaḥ | tava yajñe samāyāto dattatrailokyadakṣiṇaḥ || 129 || tasya patnyastava sutāstrayodaśa samāgatāḥ | anyā api suputryaste jāmātāraśca sagatāḥ || 1.174.130 || kāmadhenava ājyādihavīṃṣi te’rpayanti vai | kalpavṛkṣāḥ svayaṃ cātra samitkuśānvahanti ca || 131 || kāṣṭhapātrāṇi yānāni maṇḍapādīni yāni ca | apekṣyante tāni vṛkṣairarpyante svayamāgataiḥ || 132 || abhyāgatartvijāṃ bhūṣā viśvakarmā karoti ca | vāsāṃsi vasavaścāṣṭau dadatyatra makhe tava || 133|| svayaṃ lakṣmīḥ suvāsinīralaṃkaroti te makhe | sarvaṃ sukhakaraṃ dakṣa tava yajñe’tra dṛśyate || 1 34||| jīvahīno yathā dehaḥ kvāpi naiva tu śobhate | bhūṣito’pi tathā yajñaḥ śaṃbhuṃ vinā na śobhate || 1 35|| etad duḥkhakaraṃ cātra śmaśānamiva bhūmikā | śaṃbhuṃ binā tava yajñaścitābhūriva lakṣyate || 1 36|| sarve devarṣipramukhā madvākyaṃ śṛṇutātra vai | kasmānna vidyate śaṃbhurasmin yajñamahotsave || 1 37|| yadadhīnāni sarvāṇi maṃgalāni bhavanti ca | so’sau prāṇaḥ kratoścātra dṛśyate na kathaṃ haraḥ || 138|| amaṃgalānyapi yena maṃgalānyadhivartinā | bhavanti sa kathaṃ nātra cāyātaḥ śaṃkaraḥ śivaḥ || 1 39|| tasmāddakṣeṇa kartavyamāhvānaṃ parameśituḥ | athavā brahmaṇā vā ca viṣṇunā ṛṣibhiḥ saha || 1.174.140 || dvijaiḥ siṃhairlokapālairindrādibhiḥ sahādhunā | sarvairbhavadbhirgantavyaṃ girau yatrāsti śaṃkaraḥ || 141 || dākṣāyaṇyāsamaṃ śaṃbhumānayadhvaṃ śubhaṃ bhavet | śaṃkarānayane yajño’vabhṛthapūrtiko bhavet || 142|| bhaviṣyatyanyathā vighnaṃ satyaṃ bhāvi bravīmyaham | mayā niveditavyaṃ yat tadatraiva niveditam || 143 || śrutvaitadvai dadhīcyuktaṃ bhṛśaṃ jajvāla yajñakṛt | dakṣaḥ roṣaparītātmā provāca kalahānvitam || 144|| brāhmaṇo’si dadhīce tvaṃ yaccha maunaṃ bahirvraja | yajñadīkṣāsthitaste’haṃ vaiśasaṃ kartumakṣamaḥ || 145|| pṛṣṭaḥ kena samāhūto yadatrāgatya katthase | mūlaṃ viṣṇurdevatānāṃ yatra dharmāḥ sanātanāḥ || 146 || sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyaḥ samānīto mayātra saḥ | yatra vedāstathā yajñāḥ karmāṇi vividhāni ca || 147|| svayaṃ vai yajñapuruṣaḥ kimūnaṃ yajñakarmaṇi | sarvakarmapratiṣṭho’yaṃ viṣṇurme vartate makhe || 148|| yatra trilokanātho’yaṃ śatakratuḥ samāgataḥ | trayastriṃśatprakoṭīnāmamarāṇāṃ patirmakhe || 149 || satyalokātsamāyāto brahmā sāvitrikāyutaḥ | vedopaniṣadaiḥ sarvairāgamairbrāhmaṇaiḥ saha || 1.174.15 0|| dharmarāṭ saha patnībhiḥ putrapautraiḥ samāgataḥ | tathā yūyaṃ ca ṛṣayo dharmādharmavido’pare || 151 || kubero dhanadātā ca patnībhiḥ saha pāvakaḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ svayaṃ yajñācāryatvena vyavasthitaḥ || 152 || ete yajñocitāḥ śāntāḥ pāvanā pramaharṣayaḥ | mama yajñe karmakarāstaṃ śmaśānaṃ bravīṣyaho || 153 || śmaśānaṃ tu sadā yatra bhūtapretapiśācakāḥ | gaṇā vasanti tatraiva śaṃkarasya gṛhe bhavet || 154 || yatra karmakarāḥ sarve mūrdhanyāśca samāgatāḥ | kimatrāsmākamūnaṃ yadrudreṇāpi prayojanam || 155 || yatrārtvijyaṃ bhajante’mī vaśiṣṭhādyā maharṣaya | taṃ tvaṃ copamimīṣe’tra citābhūmyā śubhāśrayam || 156 || kanyā dattā mayā tasmai brahmaṇā noditena vai | haro’kulīno vipro na mātāpitṛvivarjitaḥ || 157 || bhūtapretapiśāceśo mānī stabdho’śuciḥ sadā | karmaṇyasminna yogyo’sau yasmānnānītavānaham || 158 || tasmānnedṛkpunarvācyaṃ yajñavighnakaraṃ tvayā | yajñā vinā hariṃ kāryā māstu sa yajñabhāgabhuk || 159 || niśamyeti dadhīcirvai punaḥ prāha nayānvitam | sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyo harirbhavati sarvathā || 1.174.160 || tathāpi śaṃkaro vede viṣṇurnārāyaṇo mataḥ | durvāsāḥ śaṃkarasyāṃśastaddhaste vai śatakratuḥ || 161 || patitaḥ prāpa niḥśrīkabhāvaṃ kṣaṇena yatpunaḥ | bhargaṃ cārādhya jaladhau prāpatsvāmamarāvatīm || 162 || dharmo’tra kraturakṣārthaṃ sthito’sti vartatāṃ sadā | kintu śvetena muninā śivabhaktena dharmarāṭ || 163 || jito mṛtyusametaḥ saḥ kiṃ balaṃ vedmi sarvathā | dhanadastryambakasakhaḥ sthāsyati na vinā śivam || 1 64|| agnistasya lalāṭasthaṃ netraṃ bhavati sarvadā | yadā tu candramāstārāmadharṣīt tryambakastadā || 165 || gurvārādhita evābhūt devācāryasya rakṣakaḥ | ete sarve’pi jānanti śivaṃ yadā śivaṃ sukham || 166 || yadāgāmyaśivaṃ bhāvi tadā rudro’styayaṃ śivaḥ | yadi me brāhmaṇasyaikaṃ dhāryate vacanaṃ hṛdi || 1 67|| śaṃbhumāhūya yajño’yaṃ pravartatāṃ mahāmakhaḥ | vinā tena kratuścāyaṃ kṛto’pi na kṛto bhavet || 168 || sati śaṃbhau phaliṣyanti yuṣmākaṃ vai manorathāḥ | arthahīnā yathā vāṇī dharmahīnā yathā tanuḥ || 169 || patihīnā yathā nārī putrahīnā yathā gṛhāḥ | gaṃgāhīnā yathā deśāḥ śrutihīnā yathā dvijāḥ || 1.174.170 || dānahīnā yathā sampat tilahīnaṃ ca tarpaṇam | mantrahīnaṃ yathā rājyaṃ sukhaṃ patnīṃ vinā yathā || 171 || darbhahīnā yathā sandhyā homo havirvinā yathā | niṣphalāni samuktāni yajño haraṃ vinā tathā || 172|| evaṃ dadhīcinākhyātaṃ dakṣo jagrāha naiva tat | provāca ca bhṛśaṃ kruddhaḥ kā cintā tava me kratoḥ || 173 || kratukarmāṇi siddhyanti yathārthakaraṇādiha | ayathārthakṛte naiva siddhyet karmāpi ceśituḥ || 174|| dadhīciśca tadā prāha yathārthakaraṇādapi | īśvaraprātikūlyācca siddhimapi vinaśyati || 175|| amaṃgalo maṃgalo vā kratuṃ yadāgamiṣyati | tadā kratuḥ kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyatyanyathā kṣayaḥ || 176|| evaṃ brūvati cukrudhe dadhīcau dakṣa airayat | brāhmaṇāpasadaṃ niṣkāsayituṃ kiṃkarān svakān || 177|| dadhīcirvīkṣya vai prāha dakṣaṃ garvātimohitam | kiṃ māṃ dūrayase mūḍha dūraṃ bhavatu vai bhavān || 178|| ebhiḥ samaṃ maṃgalebhyo hīno bhavatu sarvadā | asthale krodhajo vahnistava mūrdhni patiṣyati || 179|| ityuktvā niryayau yajñasthalāddadhīcirarthavit | niryayuścyavano’gastyo durvāsā ṛcīkastathā || 1.174.180|| uddālaka upamanyuruttaṃko gargagautamau | māṇḍavyo vāmadevaśca gālavaścetare tathā || 18 1|| anye’pi ca trikālajñāḥ śaivā yajñādviniryayuḥ | tadā dakṣaḥ śivadrohī hasan sarvān samabravīt || 182|| gatā vai kaṇṭakāḥ sarve jātaṃ me sammataṃ bahū | ete khalā vedabāhyāstyājyā vai yajñakarmaṇi || 183|| vaidikāśca surā viprā brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ | yajñaṃ me saphalaṃ pūrṇaṃ sarve kurvantu mā ciram || 184|| gateṣu śivapakṣeṣu prāvartata mahāmakhaḥ | ye sthitā brāhmaṇāstatra tebhyo dviguṇadakṣiṇām || 185|| bhūyasīrdakṣiṇāḥ prādādanyebhyaścādhikaṃ dhanam | sarve jāmātarastena toṣitā bhūriśo dhanaiḥ || 186|| kanyāścālaṃkṛtāḥ sarvā mahāvibhavadāpanaiḥ | ṛṣipatnyo’pi bahuśo devapatnyo’pyanekaśaḥ || 187|| tathā purāṃganā deśāṃganāścāpi prapūjitāḥ | evameva pravartite yajñe dakṣastu nityaśaḥ || 188|| bhojayati tarpayati cārpayati dhanādikam | agnirmandāgnitāṃ tena prāptavān pratyahaṃ śanaiḥ || 189|| svāhākāraiḥ svadhākārairvaṣaṭkāraiḥ surādayaḥ | tṛptā nityaṃ prajāyante sadannabhojanādibhiḥ || 1.174.190|| racitā girayastatra pakvānnānāṃ sthale sthale | ghṛtakulyā madhukulyā dugdhakulyāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 19 1|| guḍānāṃ śarkarāṇāṃ ca phalānāṃ rāśayaḥ kṛtāḥ | dukūlānāṃ ca ratnānāṃ bhogyānāṃ śikharāṇi ca || 192|| kṛtāni yajñavāṭaśca svarṇarūpyamayaḥ kṛtaḥ | dhvanirmaṃgalagītānāṃ vyānaśe sarvatomukham || 193|| jahṛṣe cāpsarovṛndairgandharvairmumudetarām | vidyādharairnanande ca vasudhā vavṛdhe bhṛśam || 194|| pratyahaṃ prāṇinastatra tṛpyanti sveṣṭavastubhiḥ | evaṃ pravartate yajño nāradastu kratusthalāt || 195|| uttiṣṭhansarvataḥ paśyana siñcansukalahāṃkuram | sarvamanaḥsu saṃkurvan saṃśayaṃ rudramīlane || 196|| udaḍīyata gagane yayau kailāsaparvatam | tadā saṃkalpā bhīrūṇāṃ palāyanakṛtau’bhavan || 197|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dakṣasya śaṃbhugṛhe trivāragamanaṃ punaḥpunaravamānam naimiṣāraṇye bhṛgvādīnāṃ parasparaśāpadānaṃ dakṣakṛtaśaṃbhunindā kanakhale dakṣayajñe devādīnāmāgamanaṃ śaṃbhoranāgamane dadhīcasya dakṣāya śāpādikamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 174||
<1.175> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kalahasya gṛhaṃ rudragṛhaṃ gatam | dvayorvai gṛhayoraikye kimaniṣṭaṃ na jāyate || 1 || nārado vyomamārgeṇa prāpya vai dhāma śāṃkaram | kṣaṇaṃ tatra mahodyāne kailāse’vātaradbhuvi || 2 || viśaśrāma hariṃ dhyāyan satī tadantare bahiḥ | tasminnevodyānavarye’viharat svasakhīyutā || 3 || tayā dṛṣṭāni vyomnyeva svargātpṛthvīṃ patanti vai | vimānāni bhaginīnāṃ dāsadāsīyutāni ca || 4 || patibhiḥ kṛtaśṛṃgāraprabhṛtīnāṃ mahānti hi | svasakhīṃ vijayāṃ prāhālokya satī tu rohiṇīm || 5 || re sakhīpravare paśya rohiṇī bhaginī mama | candrayuktā vimānasthā kva yāti pṛccha satvaram || 6 || śīghraṃ tu vijayāpṛcchya jñātvā yajñotsavādikam | dakṣagṛhe vartate’tastatra yātīti cāha tām || 7 || tāvadanyavimānāni prayānti vyomamārgataḥ | tānyapyālokya bahudhā satī cetasyacintayat || 8 || dakṣaḥ pitā mama mātā hyasiknī vīriṇī tathā | āhvānaṃ me na kurvanti vismṛtāḥ kiṃ satīṃ sutām || 9 || pṛccheyaṃ kāraṇaṃ tatra śaṃkaraṃ sarvamādarāt | vicāryetthaṃ yayau tūrṇaṃ satī tu śaṃkarānvitam || 1.175.1 0|| satkṛtā śaṃkareṇātha satyuvāca prabhuṃ tadā | piturmama mahān yajño bhavatīti mayā śrutam || 11 || tatrotsavo mahānasti samavetā maharṣayaḥ | tatra kathaya gamanaṃ kasmāttava na rocate || 12|| āvābhyāṃ tatra gantavyaṃ bahūnāṃ darśanaṃ bhavet | śaṃbhuḥ prāha sati dakṣo mama drohī viśeṣataḥ || 1 3|| pitustavādhvare prāptā mānino jñānavarjitāḥ | tatra yajane me sthānaṃ nāsti yāvaḥ kathaṃ sati || 14|| anāhūtāstu ye yānti paragṛhaṃ tu te janāḥ | prāpnuvantyavamānaṃ yanmaraṇādatiricyate || 15|| parālayaṃ gato’pīndro laghurbhavati vai yataḥ | tasmāt tvayā mayā cāpi na gantavyaṃ hi tadgṛham || 16|| śatruśaraiḥ praviddho’pi na tathā vyathate janaḥ | yathā svajanarūkṣoktairmarmabhedibhirardyate || 17|| mamopari tapastaptaṃ tasmānmayā vivāhitā | na cet taptaṃ mādṛśastu kathaṃ pāśe’tra saṃpatet || 18|| vidyaiśvaryādibhirjāte garve khalāḥ satāṃ guṇān | gaṇayantyeva nahite nādriyante mahājanān || 19|| śrutvaitatsahasā devī prāha svaprāṇarakṣakam | kathaṃ dakṣeṇa nāhūtau jñātumicchāmi tattvataḥ ||1.175.20|| anujñāṃ dehi me nātha gantuṃ dakṣamakhe’dya vai | śaṃbhuḥ prāha satīṃ sādhvi gantuṃ te prabalā ruciḥ ||21|| yadyastyāruhya vṛṣabhaṃ sajjaṃ bhūṣitameva ca | mahārājñyupacārāṇi kṛtvā nītvā gaṇānbahūn |||22| subhūṣitā gaccha yajñaṃ chatracāmaralakṣitā | ityetadantare tatra nārado’pyāgato haram |||23|| dṛṣṭvā śivau praṇamyātha śaṃbhunā satkṛtādaraḥ | tatpradattāsane ramye hyupāviśanmahāmuniḥ ||24|| śaṃbhuḥ prāha kathaṃ dattaṃ darśanaṃ bhavatā mune | asti kiṃcidvicitraṃ cedbrūhi śīghraṃ ca mā ciram |||25|| ityājñāṃ prāpya devarṣiḥ vṛttaṃ tatprāha śaṃkaram | adya nīlagireścāhaṃ haridvārasamīpataḥ ||26|| apūryamiva saṃvīkṣya pariprāptastavāntikam | trailokye yacca puṃjātaṃ sakalatrasutādikam ||27|| sālaṃkāraṃ samānaṃ ca sānandamukhapaṃkajam | dṛṣṭaṃ dakṣādhvare kintu bhavaddvandvaṃ na lokitam ||28|| prāyo viṣādajanakaṃ tatra yuṣmadadarśanam | dakṣasya marmabhedīni vacanāni śrutāni vai |||29|| tāni vaktuṃ na śakyāni śrutvā tvadgarhaṇāgiraḥ | mayā tu pihitau karṇau pratyuktāni dadhīcinā ||1.175.30|| dakṣaḥ śaptaḥ kratuṃ tyaktvā durvāsaḥ pramukhā dvijāḥ | śaṃbhunindāṃ samākarṇya kiyantastu viniryayuḥ ||3 1|| prāvartata mahāyāgo dakṣapakṣātipātibhiḥ | bhaginyastatra yāste tāḥ svasvāmiparicārikāḥ ||32|| dakṣato gauravaṃ prāptāstadvaktuṃ nāhamutsahe | tatro’trārthe vidheyaṃ tadvidhīyetāṃ prayāmyaham ||33|| gate tu nārade devī prāṃjaliḥ prāha śaṃkaram | vijayasvāndhakadhvaṃsin dehyanujñāṃ mama prabho ||34|| gatvā paśyāmi duṣṭatvaṃ kathamāvāṃ nirākṛtau | śaṃbhuḥ prāha priyāṃ yajño gantavyārtho na bhāti me ||35|| kimapūrṇaṃ tavāstyatra mā parīkṣākṛte’pyagāḥ | kuto māṃ hātumicchestyaṃ gamane śaṃ na dṛśyate ||36|| satī prāha mano me te pādayoḥ sthāsyati dhruvam | kratuṃ draṣṭuṃ pituryāmi naikṣi yajño mayā kvacit ||37|| śaṃbhuḥ prāhādharekṣā cedāharāmi tataḥ kratum | kratuṃ kriyāṃ tathā yajñapuruṣaṃ lokapālakān ||38|| anyānāśu vidhehi tvamṛṣīnārtvijya karmaṇi | satī prāha niṣedhīrmā draṣṭavyaḥ pituradhvaraḥ ||39|| śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā devīṃ nārīhaṭhādhirohitām | adya devi paścimāyāṃ dikśūlaṃ vāsaro’śubhaḥ ||1.175.40|| tithinakṣatrayogāśca viparītā bhavanti vai | mā gā devi gatādya tvaṃ nahi drakṣyasi māṃ punaḥ ||41 || tadā satī babhāṣe yat yadi nāmnāsmyahaṃ satī | tadā tanvantareṇāpi kariṣye tava dāsatām ||42|| tadā bhavaḥ punaḥ prāha ko vā vārayituṃ kṣamaḥ | haṭhavyāptamanovṛttiṃ striyaṃ vā puruṣaṃ ca vā ||43|| mā yāhi devi māṃ hitvā gatā tvaṃ na miliṣyasi | paraṃ na devi gantavyaṃ mahāmānadhanecchubhiḥ ||44|| anāhūtatayā kānte mātāpitṛgṛhānapi | punarna darśanaṃ devi mama satyaṃ bravīmyaham ||45|| devyuvāca yadi raktā tava pādāmbujadvaye | tathā tvameva me nātho bhaviṣyasi bhavāntare ||46|| ityuktvā niryayau devī haṭhāndhīkṛtamānasā | na nanāma tadā śaṃbhuṃ na ca cakre pradakṣiṇam ||47|| ata eva hi sā devī gatā na punarāgatā | devo’pi tāṃ satīṃ yāntīṃ dṛṣṭvā tu vivyathe hṛdi ||48 || gaṇānprāha saha devyā gacchantu sainyaśālinaḥ | vimānaṃ śāṃkaracihnamāruhya yātu vaiṃ satī || 49 || devī vimānamāruhya yātā yajñasthalāṃgaṇam | suchatracāmarādīni sadvastrābharaṇāni ca ||1.175.50 || mahārājñyupacārāṇi dattāni śaṃkareṇa vai | gaṇāḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi raudrā jagmuḥ śivājñayā ||5 1 || hetisajjāḥ sayānāśca kutūhalotsavānvitāḥ | nabho’ṅgaṇādvimānasthā sā tu vegādavātarat || 52 || āviśadyajñavāṭaṃ ca harṣastasyā vyavardhata | śivapriyāyāḥ satkāro vāmadevādibhiḥ kṛtaḥ ||53 || kutūhalaṃ gaṇāścakruḥ śivayoryaśa ujjaguḥ | pupluvuḥ kūrdanaṃ cakrurākāśe gaṇapuṃgavāḥ ||54|| jayāmbike jaya śaṃbho hyārāvaiḥ pūritaṃ jagat|| dākṣāyaṇī gatā tatra yajñasthale mahāprabhe ||65 || surāsuramunīndrādikutūhalasamanvite | namaskṛtyāgnidevaṃ ca samājaṃ maṇḍapasthitam ||56 || jagāma jalapānāya svapiturbhavanaṃ tataḥ | dadarśa suprabhaṃ cāru nānāścaryasamanvitam |||57|| mātṛsvasṛduhitṛtatsutāsutādisaṃśritam | āgatāṃ ca satīṃ dṛṣṭvāsiknī ca vīriṇī tathā ||58 || cakruḥ samādaraṃ tasyā bhaginyaśca yathocitam | daduḥ salilapānādi cāsanaṃ sukhaśāntidam ||59 || viśramya ca kṣaṇaṃ natvā mātaraṃ bhaginīstataḥ | avaruhyāsanāt śīghramekaivāgacchadadhvaram ||1.175.6 0 || tatra svapitaraṃ natvā tathānyānvṛddhapuṃgavān | kṛtamaṃgalanepathyāḥ prasūścānyāḥ kirīṭinīḥ || 61 || sabhartṛkāśca bhaginīrnavālaṃkṛtiśālinīḥ | jyeṣṭhāḥ kaniṣṭhāḥ sāścaryāḥ sānandāśca kuṭumbinīḥ |||62|| satī cāho samāyātetyāścaryeṇa prapaśyatīḥ | sarvā natvā vṛddhamātṛsamāśca haravallabhā ||63 || maṇḍapasthasamāje sā gatā dakṣāntikaṃ satī | pitrā pṛṣṭā ca mātrā ca bhadraṃṃ jātaṃ tavāgame || 64|| ehi tiṣṭha priyaputri jāmātā svidanāmayaḥ | te’pi svargyaṃ sukhaṃ nityaṃ nirābādhaṃ svidasti vai || 65|| satyuvāca yadi vṛddhau sukhinau cāsmi sukhyaham | yuvayoścāpi jāmātā śivaḥ sukhī sadāsti vai ||66|| duḥkhamātraṃ prasaṃge’tra yadadarśanameva yat | yena yajñaḥ paripūrṇo bhavet so’tra na vidyate ||67|| yadi bhadraṃ janetarme samāgamanato bhavet | kathaṃ śaṃbhurahaṃ naivāhūtau cātra mahotsave ||68 || anye jāmātaraḥ putryaḥ samāhūtāḥ prasaṃgataḥ | satīṃ śaṃbhuṃ parityajya kuto bhadraṃ śubhaṃ tava || 69 || abhadraṃ hyaśubhaṃ cātra paśyāmi ca kṣaṇāntare | iti saṃbhāṣya mumocāśrubindūn piturantike ||1.175.7 0 || dakṣaḥ prāha ayi putri mahādhanye’timaṃgale | tava doṣo manāṅnāsti mā śokaṃ kuru mānasam ||7 1 || jahyudvegaṃ sukhaṃ tiṣṭha mama doṣo’sti sarvathā | yanmayābuddhinā kanyāratnaṃ śarve’pavarjitam ||72 || yadahaṃ tatsamājñāsyamīśo’panīśa āntare | tadā kathamadāsyaṃ tvāṃ māyādhipataye śubhe ||73 || ahaṃ śivābhidhānena vañcito’śivakarmaṇi | brahmaṇā bahudhā so’yaṃ praśaṃsito mamāgrataḥ ||74|| śaṃkaro’yamayaṃ śaṃbhuḥ śivaḥ sārthakanāmavān | dehyasmai ca satīṃ kanyāṃ tadyogyā sarvathāsti sā ||75 || śrīkaṇṭho’sau maheśo’sau sarvajño vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | dhanvī sārthakanāmāsau dehyasmai te satīṃ sutām ||76|| iti viśvāsamādhāya dāpitā tvaṃ hi vedhasā | na jñātaḥ sa virūpākṣa ukṣago viṣabhakṣakaḥ ||77|| pitṛkānanasaṃvāsaḥ śūladhṛkca kapāladhṛk | dvijihvasaṃgasubhago jalādhāraḥ kapardavān ||78 || kalaṃkikṛtamauliśca dhūlīdhūsaracarcitaḥ | kvacitkaupīnavasano nagno vātūlavat kvacit ||79 || kvacittu carmavasanaḥ kvacidbhikṣāṭanapriyaḥ | virūpabhūtānucaraḥ sthāṇurugrastamoguṇaḥ ||1.175.8 0 || rudro raudraparīvāro mahākālavapurdharaḥ | nṛkaroṭīparikaro jātigotravivarjitaḥ ||8 1 || brahmaṇā guṇavānukto jānāno’haṃ pratāritaḥ | kimbahūktena tanaye samastanayaśālini ||8 2 || kva pāṃsulapaṭacchanno mahāśaṃkhavibhūṣaṇaḥ | prabaddhasarpakeyūraḥ pradhūsarajaṭāsaṭaḥ ||8 3 || ḍamaḍḍamarukavyagrahastāgraḥ khaṇḍacandrabhṛt | tāṇḍavāḍambararuciḥ sarvāmaṃgalaceṣṭitaḥ ||84|| evaṃvidho haraḥ kvāyamadhvaro maṃgalālayaḥ | ata eva samāhūtau yuvāṃ na maṃgale’dhvare ||85 || dukūlānyanukūlāni ratnālaṃkaraṇāni ca | hāraśreṣṭhā vibhūṣāśca prāgeva tvatkṛte mayā ||86 || rakṣitāstānpaśya putri sarvān śreṣṭhān gṛhāṇa ca | śaṃkarārthamapi putri yadyannetuṃ samīhase ||87 || tatsarvaṃ saha netavyaṃ yajñapūrtyuttaraṃ sati | yāvadetāstava sakhyaḥ svasāraścoṣitā makhe ||88 || tāvat tato’pyadhikaṃ tvaṃ vasātra tava rocate | śrutvātidūnahṛdayā satī vaktuṃ pracakrame ||89 || bhāgānapaśyad devānāṃ haryādīnāṃ tadadhvare | śaṃbhubhāgamanālokya kaṣṭaṃ vaktuṃ pracakrame || 1.175.90 || nākarṇitaṃ mayā kiṃcit prabrūvati pitastvayi | padadvayīṃ samākarṇya tāṃ ca te kathayāmyaham || 91 || māyādhipatirevāyaṃ jānāno’pi pratāritaḥ | etatsatyaṃ tvayākhyāyi māyādhipatireva saḥ || 92|| parabrahmaparamātmā śivarūpeṇa vartate | māyānvitaśca māyāyā vyatiriktaḥ śivaḥ sa vai || 93 || tvaṃ ca pratāritaḥ pūrvamadhunāpi pratāritaḥ | ajñātvā dattavān kanyāṃ dattvāsambaddhamucyate || 94|| tādṛśo manyate śaṃbhuḥ kuto māmadadāstadā | na hetuste matistatra heturmatpuṇyagauravam || 95|| yena pūtamidaṃ viśvaṃ samagraṃ sacarācaram | yajño yajñavidāṃ śreṣṭho yajñāṃgo yajñadakṣiṇaḥ || 96 || yajñakartā svayaṃ śaṃbhustaṃ vinā tu kathaṃ makhaḥ | makhaḥ syānmama dehasya paśya dakṣa kṣaṇāntare || 97|| yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sarvaṃ pūtaṃ bhavatyaho | taṃ tu śaṃbhuṃ vinā sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ cākṛtameva tat || 98 || dravyamantrādikaṃ sarvaṃ havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca yanmatam | śaṃbhunā hi vinā kṛtamapavitraṃ bhaviṣyati || 99|| kiṃ śivaṃ surasāmānyaṃ matvākārṣīranādaram | bhraṣṭā buddhistava jātā vārdhakye iva sarvathā || 1.175.100 || viṣṇubrahmādayaḥ sarve yaṃ jānanti pareśvaram | tva na jānāsi taṃ śaṃbhuṃ mā jānīhi tathottaram || 101 || ete kathaṃ samāyātā viṣṇubrahmādayo’dhvare | jānanto’pi vinā śaṃbhuṃ lajjante na mukhadṛśaḥ || 102 || he viṣṇo tvaṃ mahādevaṃ tyaktvā yajñe’tra dṛśyase | na lajjase sadā mitraṃ vismṛtyātra pravartase || 103 || re brahmam̐stvaṃ paṃcamukho’bhūrgarviṣṭho haraṃ prati | kṛtaścaturmukhastena vismṛto’si tadadbhutam || 1 04|| yadi kruddho mahādevaścatvāryapi vineṣyati | he sūrya candra cendrāde na svijjānatha śaṃkaram || 105 || vaśiṣṭhādyāśca munayo na vai jānatha śaṃkaram | vajraṃ prajvālitaṃ yena kāmaḥ prajvālitastathā || 106 || dāruvane liṃgapāte yena prajvālitaṃ jagat | prāgbhavīyām̐ścamatkārān kiṃsvid vismarathātra hi || 107 || sa yadi krodhamāpanno yuṣmākaṃ kiṃ bhaviṣyati | sarve kāṃ mūrkhatāṃ prāptā vinā śaṃbhuṃ pratiṣṭhatha || 108 || iti tvekavidhā vāco’gadanmakhe maheśvarī | kaupānvitā satī tatra hṛdyena vidūyatā || 109 || maunī bhūto’bhavacchrutvā samājo bhayavihvalaḥ | śṛṇu lakṣmi tato dakṣaḥ kruddho’bravīt kṣayakaram || 1.175.110 || tava kiṃ bahunoktena na te kāryaṃ hi sāmpratam | gaccha vā tiṣṭha vā putri kasmāccātra samāgatā || 111 || sarvapūjyāvamānaṃ tvaṃ karoṣyāgatya cādhvare | gaccha maunaṃ vasa vātra nāhūtāsi vilajjike || 112 || amaṃgalastu te bhartā bhūtapretapiśācarāṭ | akulīno vedabāhyaḥ nāhūto’tra mayā tadā || 113 || devarṣisaṃsadi vedhaḥpreritena mayārpitā | mandabhāgyena rudrāyāviditārthāya kiṃ bhavet || 11 4|| kopaṃ mā vraja rudrāṇi svasthā bhava śucismite | yadyāgatāsi me yajñe dāyaṃ gṛhṇīṣva cātmanā || 115 || śrutvātha sā satī śaṃbhornindāmacintayat hṛdi | dāyaṃ nītvāpi kiṃ me syātkathaṃ vai yāmi śaṃkaram || 116 || śaṃkareṇa yadi pṛṣṭā tatra vakṣye kimuttaram | tasmādatraiva martavyaṃ prāpsye dehāntare haram || 117 || iti nirṇīya pitaraṃ niḥśvasantī hyuvāca ha | kiṃ jīvitena me tāta śṛṇvantyā patigarhaṇām || 118 || yo nindati mahādevaṃ nindyamānaṃ śṛṇoti vā | tāvubhau narakaṃ yātau yāvaccandradivākarau || 119 || yadi śakto nindakasya jihvāṃ chindyātprasahya vai | yadyaśaktaḥ supidhāya karṇau gacchet sthalāntaram || 1.175.12 0 || śaṃbhunā tu niṣiddhāpi prasahyātra samāgatā | phalaṃ tasyātra me prāptaṃ kva gantavyaṃ mayādhunā || 12 1 || asmaracchāṃkaraṃ vākyaṃ paścāttāpamavāpa sā | sā saṃkruddhya munīndevān dakṣaṃ niḥśaṃkamāha yat || 1 22|| tāta tvaṃ nindakaḥ śaṃbhoḥ paścāttāpaṃ gamiṣyasi | māyaṃ dhūmro tava yājño vṛṣṭiheturbhavediha || 123|| aśruheturbhavedevāgatānāṃ yajñabhoginām | sphuṭaṃ bha vantaḥ śaṃbhostu pratīpā militāḥ khalu || 1 24|| pratīpānāṃ pratīpaṃ saṃkariṣye yajñamārjanam | śaṃbhuṃ vinā na yajñaḥ syāt kariṣye’gnipratoṣaṇam || 125|| dakṣaḥ svīyaṃ juhotyagnau svīye’pi gaṇanā mama | svaṃ svīyaṃ ca juhotyagnau kariṣye havanaṃ mama || 1 26|| kiṃ bahūktena vacasā dakṣo hare sadā kudhīḥ | tadudbhavena dehena na me kiṃcitprayojanam || 127|| tajjanma dhik yanmahatāmavajñāpādakaṃ bhavet | parityājyo viśeṣeṇa janmasamvandha eva vai || 128|| vaimanasye sadā śaṃbhurdākṣāyaṇīti vakti mām | tasmāddakṣāṃgajaṃ caitatkuṇapaṃ garhitaṃ sadā || 129|| vyutsṛṣṭavyaṃ nūnamatra projjhitavyaṃ tu vahnaye | yāvajjīvitanāthasya na śrotavyā vigarhaṇā || 1.175.130|| satyantimaṃ vacaḥ prāha naśyantu śivanindakāḥ | ahaṃ tu krodhadīptāgnau mahādevasvarūpiṇi || 13 1|| juhomi dehasamidhaṃ prāṇarodhavidhānataḥ | evamuktvā satī prāṇāyāmaṃ cakre śanaistadā || 1 32|| prāṇarodhaḥ kṛtaḥ satyā sudṛḍhastāvadeva vai | sarveṣāṃ ca surādīnāṃ prāṇarodho’bhavattadā || 133||| nāgnirjajvāla ca tathā yathājyāhutibhiḥ purā | mantrāḥ kuṇṭhitasāmarthyāstatkṣaṇādeva cābhavan || 134|| mahājhanjhānilaḥ prāptaḥ parvatāndolanakṣamaḥ | makhamaṇḍapabhūstena kṣaṇataḥ sthapuṭīkṛtā || 135|| akāṇḍataḍidāpāto jāto’bhūdbhūprakampanaḥ | divaścolkāḥ prapatitāḥ piśācā nṛtyamādadhuḥ || 136|| āpatadgradhrairupari gagane maṇḍalāyitam | tatra purastādaśivaṃ śivāḥ krūramarāriṣuḥ || 137|| meghā rudhiravarṣābhistatrāhuścātyamaṃgalam | nirghātaniḥsvano bhūmerutthito hṛtprakampanaḥ || 138|| divyāyudhāni ca mitho yuddhyanti smātibhīṣaṇam | havanīyaṃ mahādravyaṃ dūṣitaṃ kroṣṭṛbhiḥ śvabhiḥ || 1 39||| satyāḥ prāṇanirodhāśca sarvarodhena tattadā | śmaśānavāṭavajjātaṃ niṣkriyaṃ makhabhūtalam || 1.175.140 || yadyatrābhūcca vinyastaṃ tattatraiva vyavasthitam | citranyastamivāsīśca prāṇarodhabalāttathā || 141|| sujaḍā iva saṃjātāstadā cakradharādayaḥ | devī prāṇaṃ bahirnītvā śamayāmāsa bhīṣikām || 142|| camatkāro darśito’yaṃ devyā tathāpi dakṣarāṭ | śaṃkarāhvānavacanaṃ novāca mānanaṣṭadhīḥ || 143|| maunībhūtā satī smṛtvā śaṃbhuṃ svapatimādarāt | pṛthvyāṃ punaḥ sā sahasā niṣasāda praśāntadhīḥ || 144|| jalamācamya vidhivat saṃvṛtā vāsasā śuciḥ | dṛṅnimīlya patiṃ smṛtvā yogarītimupādade || 145|| kṛtvā samāne hyanilau prāṇāpānau tathā punaḥ | utthāpyodānasamānau nābhicakrātparaṃ gatā || 146|| hṛdisthāpyorasi nītvā nītvā kaṇṭhād bhruvoḥ satī | madhyamānīya dyurandhraṃ sā jagāma tvarānvitā || 147|| agnimutpādayāmāsa brahmarandhrasthitā satī | brahmarandhrāgninā deho jājvalyamāna eva vai || 148|| ākāśamutthito vyomnā cāgnikuṇḍe hyavātarat | bhasmasādabhavat kuṇḍe satī samājagocarā || 149|| tatpaśyatāṃ ca khe bhūmau hāhākāro vyavartata | hāhābhūcca jagatsarvaṃ bhītā viṣṇusurādayaḥ || 1.175.150|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satyā vyomnā svasṛvimānāvalokanam dakṣayajñe gamanāya śaṃbhorājñā kailāse nāradāgamanaṃ yajñāddadhīcinirgamaḥ yajñe satī gamanaṃ śaṃkarāsanādarśanaṃ satīdakṣavākyāni satīdehatyāgaityādinirūpaṇanāmā paṃcasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 175||
<1.176> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca mahālakṣmi kīdṛśaṃ trāsakṛddhi tat | anātmyaṃ tu pitustasyā nānyastathā kariṣyati || 1 || bhasmībhūte satīdehe dṛśyaṃ sakaruṇaṃ tadā | samabhūcca samāje’nyonyavāṇī karuṇāvahā || 2 || hanta priyā parā śaṃbhorahādasūnprakopitā | dakṣeṇa paśyataitasya daurātmyaṃ tu prajāpateḥ || 3 || carācaraṃ prajā yasya tasyāpi hṛdayaṃ sadā | kṣubdhaṃ ruṣṭaṃ kharaṃ śuṣkamaho saṃsārakaṣṭatā || 4 || śaṃkarasya priyābhīkṣṇaṃ mānayogyā satāṃ sadā | dakṣeṇa vimanā sābhūt tatrāpi sumahotsave || 5 || tasmāddurmarṣahṛdayo brahmadhik ca duhitṛdhṛk | mahatīmapakīrtiṃ saḥ prāpsyatyakhilasṛṣṭiṣu || 6 || yaḥ svāṃgajāṃ sutāṃ śabhudviṭ nyaṣedhatsamāgatām | mahānarakabhogī sa putrīhā no’parādhataḥ || 7 || vadatyevaṃ jane dṛṣṭvā satyāścāsuviyojanam | drāgeva pārṣadāḥ krūrā hyudatiṣṭhannudāyudhāḥ || 8 || ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi te sarve saṃvṛtya makhabhūmikām | mā kaścid bahirnigacchedghātayantu makhasthale || 9 || hāhākārairvikrośanto dhigdhikdakṣetivādinaḥ | mārayantu nāśayantu mardayantu makhāṃgaṇe || 1.176.10 || gaganaṃ ca tadā hāhākārairvyāptamabhūt priye | devāḥ prāpan bhayaṃ sarve munayo’nye’pi ye sthitāḥ || 11 || akāṃḍayuddhaṃ saṃprāptaṃ pralayo vai bhaviṣyati | dakṣayajñāgatānāṃ te hyakurvan hananaṃ bahu ||12|| śastrairaghnanparāṃgāni sutīkṣṇaiḥ prāṇanāśibhiḥ | dakṣapakṣaistathā tatra ghātitā dve’yute tadā ||1 3|| anye śastrairdakṣanāśaṃ kartuṃ yātā udāyudhāḥ | teṣāmāpatatāṃ vegaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu bhagavān bhṛguḥ || 14|| yajñaghnaghnena yajuṣā dakṣiṇāgnau tadājuhot | hūyamāne samutpetuḥ ṛbhavaśca sahasraśaḥ || 15|| alātaśastrāste sarve bhṛguvahnibalānvitāḥ | yuyudhuḥ pramathaistatra prāṇārpaṇasamīhayā || 16|| ṛbhubhiḥ prabalaistatra hanyamānāḥ satīgaṇāḥ | dve’yute cāpare tatra mṛtāḥ śeṣāḥ palāyitāḥ || 17|| dakṣapakṣasya sainyānāṃ lakṣaṃ yamagṛhaṃ gatam | tatkāle ye gurujanā viṣṇubrahmarṣayo’malāḥ || 18|| na hantavyā iti kṛtvā na hatā bhūsurāstathā | tadā te ṛṣayo devāḥ śakrādyāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ || 19|| viśve’śvinau lokapālāstūṣṇīmāsan grahādayaḥ | svasvavimānayāneṣu vyomamārge vyavasthitāḥ ||1.176.20|| udvignāḥ prārthayantaśca vighnābhāvaṃ muhurmuhuḥ | dakṣajāmātaro dakṣakanyā dakṣakuṭumbinaḥ ||21 || viṣṇubrahmarṣisainyaistu rakṣitā bahuyatnataḥ | yajñabhūmistadā śuddhāṃ kṛtā śavavivāhanaiḥ ||22|| yajñabhūmau punardakṣāgrahātsarve vyavasthitāḥ | yajñapūrtīcchayā śīghraṃ homakarmābhavattataḥ ||23||| etasminnantare tatra vyomavāṇī jagāda ha | re re dakṣa durācāra daṃbhācāra mahākhala ||24|| kimidaṃ kṛtavān mūḍha bhāvyanarthakaraṃ tava | dadhīciste makhācchāpaṃ datvā yāto na buddhavān ||25|| gṛhāgatāṃ jyeṣṭhaputrīṃ yogyāṃ mānitavānnahi | jñānahīna śivau pūjyau garvātpūjitavānnahi ||26|| putrīṃ matvā satīṃ phaladāmārādhitavānnahi | sarvasaubhāgyadāṃ sādhvīṃ samprasāditavānnahi ||27|| bhaktamaṃgaladāṃ devīṃ tvaṃ samarcitavānnahi | sarvabhītiharāṃ śaktiṃ natvā raṃjitavānnahi ||28|| mano’bhīṣṭapradāṃ prahvāṃ premṇā drāvitavānnahi | kīrtisampatpradāmīśāṃ dhyātvā yājitavānnahi ||29|| bhuktimuktipradāṃ dhātrīṃ prasaṃbhojitavānnahi | rakṣikāṃ poṣikāṃ hantrīṃ hṛdi dhāritavānnahi ||1.176.30|| sarvasṛṣṭiprajananīṃ śāntiṃ nayitavānnahi | śaṃbhorbhāgaṃ śaṃbhupatnyai yajñe cārpitavānnahi ||3 1|| tapyate hi tapaḥ siddhaiḥ sādhvībhirdarśanecchayā | yujyate yogibhiryogairetaddarśanakāṃkṣayā ||32|| tayoḥ sarvajagatpitroḥ satkāraṃ kṛtavānnahi | ata evādhvarasyāsya vināśo bhavitā dhruvam ||33|| satkāryau satkṛtau naiva kathaṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati | daurbhāgyaṃ tvayi saṃkrāntaṃ saṃkrāntāstvayi cāpadaḥ ||34|| anabhyarcya śivāṃ śaṃbhuṃ kalyāṇaṃ prāpnuyāmiti | kiṃ te garvaḥ samāyāto garvaste’dya vinaṃkṣyati ||35|| śaṃkarādvimukho bhūtvā deveṣveteṣu kastava | sāhāyyado bhavedatra na taṃ paśyāmi kaṃcana ||36 devā vā yadi vā cānye’dhunā ye te sahāyinaḥ | dhruvaṃ te nāśamāpsyanti vahninā śalabhā iva ||37| śiraste jvalitaṃ cāstu yajñopadā jvalantvapi | tvatsahāyā amāṃgalye viśantu prajvalantu ca ||38|| viniryāntu surāḥ svokaścāsmādadhvarabhūsthalāt | adyātrasthāyināṃ dhvaṃso bhavitātra kṣaṇāntare ||39|| bālā vṛddhāḥ striyaścānye svakā niryāntu cādhvarāt | viṣṇo vidhe puṣpavantau niryāntu cādhvarasthalāt ||1.176.40|| anyathā bhavatāṃ nāśo bhavitā vai kṣaṇāntare | sarvān saṃśrāvya vyaramat nabhovāṇī tathāpi vai ||41|| yajñabhūmigatā bhāvidaivanaṣṭā na niryayuḥ | yajñakālaḥ saśoko’pi yajñapūrtyarthameva te ||42|| kurvanti havanaṃ śīghraṃ yajñakāryaṃ pravartate|| atha śrīnārado devaḥ satīdāhottaraṃ drutam ||43 || satīvṛttāntamakhilaṃ harāyāśaṃsituṃ yayau | kailāse śaṃbhunikaṭe gatvā natvā haraṃ śvasan ||44|| duḥkhaṃ ca darśayan śokaṃ vaimanasyaṃ pradarśayan | kāruṇyaṃ cātijanayan bhayamāvedayam̐stathā ||49|| netrādaśru vimuñcaśca prakampan prāha śaṃkaram | amāyikasya māyāyā bādho naiveti dṛśyate ||46|| sarvasvamapi naśyeta kā cintā yogino’tra vai | nāpacīyeta te kiṃcinnopacīyet te’thavā ||47 || avyayatvācca pūrṇatvāt hānivṛddhī kutastvayi | dakṣeṇādya tavaiśvaryamāskanditaṃ padena vai ||48 || yasya mānāvamānena nindāstutī same tathā | hānyahānī na gaṇite kiṃ tadagre raveṇa vai ||49 || svasya nāśe’pi yatkeśaḥ kampate nahi sarvathā | kiṃ vṛthā saṃbhṛtastena bhāraścaiśvaryakośajaḥ |1.176.50 nābhimānadhanaṃ yasya nāvajñājanyaśocanam | tasyāgre kathanaṃ sarvaṃ mahiṣyagre kathā yathā ||5 1 || abhimānarahitāgre sābhimānāṃganā varā | dhanyā nirabhimānasya sābhimānā tu sā satī || 12 || śrūyate svapyate kiṃvā karṇau sto vā na vā mune | tava nindāśravātsādhvī tṛṇīcakre svajīvitam ||1 3 || ityākarṇya tadā śaṃbhurmahākāla ivāparaḥ | rudraścātīva rudro’bhūt bahukopāgnidīpitaḥ || 5 4|| vikarālānanastatrāvocattu nāradaṃ drutam | hum̐ hum̐ hum̐ kimabhūt tatra tṛṇīcakre svajīvitam ||55 || ho nārada kiṃ bravīṣi satī tatyāja jīvitam | ḍūm̐h ḍūm̐h ḍūm̐h ḍūm̐h ḍūm̐h ḍamāk ḍaṃ ḍūm̐h ḍamarūṃ ninādya śaṃkaraḥ | 56 | jaṭāṃ saṃbhramya bhūpṛṣṭhe balāt tāḍitavān ruṣā | praghaṭṭanānmahādhūmraḥ samutpannaḥ kṣitiṃ khanan ||57|| tanmadhyāttu samutpanno mahājvālodayo giriḥ | girideva tato jātaḥ kālamṛtyuprakampanaḥ ||58 || pratyakṣaḥ pratimākāro rudra iva bhayaṃkaraḥ | vīrabhadro’paro rudraḥ śatarudraparākramaḥ ||59 || yasya haste mandarādrisamā cāsīt gadā tadā | bhūśuṇḍī vindhyavaddīrghā parighaṃ raivatādrivat ||1.176.6 0 || netre prasphārite tasya sūryācandramasāviva | lalajjihā jvalajjvālāmukhipaṭṭābhisadṛśī ||6 1 || arbudācalavattasya vakṣaḥsthalamaśobhata | pādāṃguṣṭhāṃgulībhyāṃ sa madhye saṃgṛhya satvaram || 62 || himādreḥ śṛṃgamutpāṭya dhṛtvā kukṣau kapardavat | natvā śaṃbhuṃ tadovāca ki dāsyaṃ karavai tava || 63 || karavāṇyekakavalaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarācaram | pibāmi sakalānabdhīnekenāṃjalinājñayā || 64 || pātālāni vinimayya nayāmyadho uparyapi | ihānaye lokapālān keśaiḥ pragṛhya sendrakān || 61 || kālaṃ mṛtyuṃ tathā vadhvā hyānaye tu tvadantikam | daityadānavasaṃgrāme prabalaṃ praṇihanmyaham || 66 || paśya matpādapatanāt kampate kṣoṇimaṇḍalam | dorbhyāṃ tu parvatānsarvān cūrṇayāmi ca te balāt || 67 || kiṃ bahūktena dehyājñāṃ mamāsādhyaṃ na kiṃcana | tvatpādabalamāsādya kṛtaṃ viddhyadya cintitam || 68 || ityuktvā vīrabhadraḥ saḥ pronnato doḥsahasravān | yāvacchaṃbhoḥ pādadhūlīṃ dadhāra mūrdhni sannidhau || 69 || tāvattatra rudantaśca samāyātā makhādgaṇāḥ | procurdeva mahādeva pāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān || 1.176.70 || saṃśṛṇvādarato nātha satīvārtāṃ pravistarāt | garvitena tu dakṣeṇa satyā anādaraḥ kṛtaḥ ||7 1 || tubhyaṃ bhāgamadānno saḥ devebhyaśca pradattavān | durvacāṃsyavadat proccaiḥ śrutvākupyat satī makhe || 72 || vinindya bahuśastātamadhākṣītsvatanuṃ makhe | caturayutasaṃkhyākā gaṇā naṣṭā tadādhvare || 73 || lajjayā raṇasaṃgrāmaṃ kṛtvā cāpi hatā makhe | yajñanāśaprakartāro’smatpakṣāśca gaṇāstadā || 74|| bhṛguhomotpāditaiśca ṛbhubhirvai hatā makhe | lakṣayoddhāra evānye dakṣasya tu hatā gaṇaiḥ || 75 || tathāpi makhabhūmeste śuddhiṃ kṛtvā vitanvate | yajñaṃ dakṣastathā dakṣapakṣagrāhāḥ surarṣayaḥ ||76 || satīśokaṃ na kurvanti śaṃbhuṃ naiva smaranti ca | vihasanti satīnāśāt dantān kurvanti vaḥ prati ||77 || apamānaṃ tava satyāstasmin yajñe viśeṣataḥ | dakṣādyāste’khilā duṣṭā akurvan garvitā ati || 78 || naṣṭānāṃ ca gaṇānāṃ tu saṃjīvanārthameva vai | mantraṃ bhasmobhayaṃ dehi dehi no’mṛtabuṭṭikām || 79 || tatra bhṛgvādayaścānyāna navānutpādayanti tān | vināśayituṃ roddhuṃ ca dehi śaktiṃ mahālayām ||1.176.8 0 || brahmaṇā śaṃbhave dattaḥ kālakavalasaṃjñakaḥ | sa mantraḥ śaṃbhunā datto vīrabhadrāya dhīmate ||8 1 || śastraṃ phutkṛtya roṣeṇa śatrūn dṛṣṭvā prayojayet | kālakavalamantraḥ sa hyanyebhyo’pi pradīyatām ||82|| oṃ mṛtemṛtyo mahāmṛtyo mṛtyā saha sthiro bhava | oṃ mṛtimṛtyo mahāmṛtyau svamṛtyā sam̐stiro bhava |||83|| iti phutkārapūrvaṃ vai śastraṃ śarādikaṃ ca yat | prakṣipecchatruśarīre mṛtvā punarna jīvati ||84|| vīrabhadreṇa tatkāle śaṃkarādeva śikṣitaḥ | sādhitaścāpi tatreva śaṃkarasya nideśataḥ ||85 || śarīre bhasma sammṛdya homāyutaṃ tadānale | lakṣajapān sa tatraiva kṛtvāyutasuvarṣmabhiḥ ||86|| sādhayitvā kālamantraṃ śarīrāṇi vilīya ca | ekākyeva punarbhūtvā vīrabhadro mahākṣayaḥ ||87|| sajjo’bhūdgamanāyaiva nideśamārthayaddharāt | haro’pi ca satīdehaṃ bhasmībhūtaṃ tu nāradāt ||88|| gaṇebhyaśca nijāṃ nindāṃ dakṣasyātipragarvitām | śrutvā dakṣasya sarvasya nāśārthaṃ svajaṭāṃ kṣitau ||89|| prāsphālayāmāsa roṣāt tāḍayāmāsa vegataḥ | mārjayāmāsa saṃkrodhāddhūnayāmāsa sarvataḥ ||1.176.90|| prāsphālane jaṭābhyaśca mahālayākhyaśaktitaḥ | tāḍane ca jvarā jātā mārjane kālikāhvayāḥ ||9 1 || dhūnane ca gaṇā jātā arbudārbudakoṭayaḥ | hastatālikayā mahābhayadā bhūtakoṭayaḥ ||92|| devyo mahālayāstatra koṭirarbudamityapi | saśastrā aṣṭasaddhastā navayauvanagarvitāḥ ||93 || atibhayaṃkarākārā yuddhakarmakṛtaśramāḥ | jvarā mūrtidharāḥ krūrāstrayodaśābjakoṭayaḥ ||94|| saśastrā nāśakāryāntā ripvapunarāvartikāḥ | kālikādimahācaṇḍyo raṇāṃgaṇapranartikāḥ ||95|| saśastramantrabuṭṭyāḍhyā mahākālyo bhayaṃkarā | gaṇāḥ sarve parārdhāśca parārdhasya parārdhakāḥ ||96|| saśastrakavacāstrādijñātāro yuddhakovidāḥ | prārthayanto haraṃ śīghraṃ prajvalanto diśo daśa ||97|| sajjā vai tvarayāṃcakruḥ śaṃbhvājñāvāṭadarśinaḥ | sainyaṃ tvasaṃkhyamevātra kailāse samabhūnnavam ||98|| vīrabhadro haraṃ prāha śīghramājñāpaya prabho | śoṣaṇīyā mayā śaṃbho kṣaṇārdhenaiva sindhavaḥ ||99|| peṣaṇīyā mayā tatra kṣaṇārdhenaiva parvatāḥ | kṣaṇena bhasmasātkuryāṃ brahmāṇḍamuta devatāḥ || 1.176.100 || sarve lokā vyasavaśca kimu kāryāśca me vad | praṇato’smi mahādeva bhūyo’pi praṇato’smyaham || 101 || spando’pi jāyate’savyāṃgānāṃ te vijayapradaḥ | harṣotsāhaviśeṣopi jāyate’pūrva eva me || 1 02|| śīghraṃ preṣaya māṃ śaṃbho kiṃ kāryaṃ brūhi satvaram | śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā vīrabhadraṃ tāmravilocanaḥ || 103 || dakṣo makhaṃ karotyāśu madvirodhena garvataḥ | tanmakhaṃ bhasmasātkṛtvā sayāgaparivārakam || 1 04|| punarāyāhi kailāsaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ tvarāṃ kuru | madviruddhāḥ surā yadvā gandharvā munayo’pare || 1 05|| ṛṣayo bhūsurā yadvā ye kecittatra saṃgatāḥ | tānapyadyaiva sahasā bhasmasātkuru satvaram || 1 06|| yadi viṣṇuśca brahmā ca mahendro vā yamo’pi vā | dakṣasya pakṣapātī syād bhasmasāt tānvidhehi vai || 107|| dadhīcimatamullaṃghya ye dakṣapakṣapātinaḥ | tiṣṭhanti cādhvare tām̐stvaṃ bhasmasātkuru bhadraka || 108|| ākāśavāṇyā bodhitāstathāpi yānti no bahiḥ | yajñasthān me drohiṇastān bhasmasātkuru bhadraka || 1 09|| dakṣamakhāptadraviṇān dakṣaśraiṣṭhyapravādinaḥ | satīśaṃbhurghrāṇanastān bhasmasātkuru bhadraka || 1.176.110 || dakṣapakṣagatāścāpi mṛtyubhayaṃ vilokya ye | syustāvakāḥ kṣaṇikā bhasmasātkuru tānapi || 111 || devā vā devaputrā vā manavo manuputrakāḥ | brāhmā vā brahmaputrā vā tatpautrā vāpi ye khalāḥ || 11 2|| sastrīkāśca saputrāśca satīśaṃbhuvirodhinaḥ bhasmasātkuru tānsarvān paścāśca salilaṃ piba || 113 || ityukto vīrabhadrastu raktāveśo bhavan muhuḥ | rudrāveśastathā kālāveśo’bhavat pracaṇḍakaḥ || 1 14|| adṛśyaścāpradhṛṣyaśca nārāyaṇena vedhasā | babhūva pralayāveśo bhayāveśo bhayaṃkaraḥ || 1 15|| mastakāttasya kālāgnisamudrāḥ prābhavam̐stadā | brahmāṇḍaṃ jvālayannatvā śaṃkaraṃ pracacāla saḥ || 1 16|| nārado’pi kaliṃ samyagudbhāvyāgre makhaṃ gataḥ | prāha viṣṇuṃ ca śakraṃ ca vedhasaṃ ca tathā surān || 1 17|| vīrabhadraḥ samāyāti vināśaḥ syādbhayaṃkaraḥ | tasmādato’pasarpantu mā paśyantu yamagṛham || 1 18|| kālo nāyaṃ kuṭumbasya sambandhasyāpi locakaḥ | tasmātpralayavegebhyo’pasartavyaṃ subuddhibhiḥ || 1 19|| śrutvā viṣṇuyamavedhomahendrabhūsurādayaḥ | dakṣapakṣāvamantāro makhāttasmādviniryayuḥ || 1.176.120 || sastrīkā saparīvārāḥ svasvavimānasaṃsthitāḥ | vyomamārgeṇa yātāste dūraṃ dūraṃ prayānti vai || 121|| bhṛguṇā tu tadā jñātvā sainyāni homakarmabhiḥ | ṛbhuśṛṃbhudharāṃbhvādigaṇānāmarbudāni ca || 122|| parārdhāni navānyeva kṛtāni dakṣapātataḥ | saśastrāḥ sāgnikā svecchārūpavirūpadhārakāḥ || 123|| yuddhamātranipūṇāste mantreśūnyā najīvanāḥ | sajjāḥ samabhavan bhūmau gagane yakṣarakṣakāḥ || 1 24|| pravartate yajñakāryaṃ pūrṇatvamavaśiṣyate | pūrṇāhutistu madhyāhne bhāvinīti ca satvaram || 125|| yājakā yajñakāryāṇi kurvanti tvaritāstadā | kintu satīpraśāpena dadhīcivacanena ca || 1 26|| pūrṇo yajño na vai bhāvī madhyāhnapūrvameva yat | vīrabhadraḥ samāyāto’rbudārbudaprasainyavān || 127|| śatayojanataḥ pūrvaṃ sainyaśabdaṃ samāgataḥ | daśayojanataḥ paścāddhūlīprādrirvyadṛśyata || 128|| kṣayāntare’drisadṛśāḥ samadṛśyanta śāṃkarāḥ | gaṇā bhayakarā raudrā yoddhāro’māpavigrahāḥ || 129 || avaterurnipetuśca ṛbhusainyeṣu cāmbare | śṛṃbhusainyeṣu pṛthvyāṃ ca dharāmbhupṛtanāsvapi || 1.176.130 || atha śaṃbhurvīrabhadrānugām̐ścānyān mahāgaṇān | svaniśvāsasamudbhūtān śatakoṭīnavāsṛjat || 131 || ambaraṃ taiḥ samākrāntaṃ celuḥ pārśve ca pṛṣṭhataḥ | śṛṃgāgrāṇi girīṇāṃ ca kaiścidutpāṭitāni vai || 13 2|| kaiścittvācūḍamūlāśca parvatā vai samuddhṛtāḥ | kecanotpāṭya vai śālavṛkṣānādāya saṃyayuḥ || 133 || pārṣadāḥ kālakālasya sarve rudrasvarūpiṇaḥ | ayutāyutasiṃhāśca śārdūlā makarā gajāḥ || 134|| koṭilakṣāṇi yānāni vāhanāni pragṛhya ca | gatāni tatra sainyāni puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūdgatau || 1 35| kālī kātyāyanīśānī cāmuṇḍā muṇḍamardinī | bhadrakālī tathā bhadrā kauśikī vaiṣṇavī tathā || 136 | etābhirnavadurgābhiryuktā ghorasvarūpiṇī | mahākālī yayau dakṣavināśāya tu satvarā || 1 37|| ḍākinī śākinībhūtagaṇapramathaguhyakāḥ| kūṣmāṇḍāḥ parpaṭāścaiva caṭakā brahmarākṣasāḥ || 138 || bhairavāḥ kṣetrapālāśca vetālāśca vināyakāḥ | niryayustvaritaṃ vīrā dakṣayajñavināśakāḥ || 139 || tathaiva yoginīcakraṃ catuḥṣaṣṭigaṇānvitam | niryayau sahasā kruddhaṃ koṭivetālinīyutam || 1.176.140 || abhyayācchaṃkukarṇaśca daśakoṭyā gaṇeśvaraḥ | daśabhiḥ kekarākṣaśca vikṛto’ṣṭābhirityapi || 141 || catuḥṣyā viśākhaśca navabhiḥ pāriyātrikaḥ | ṣaḍbhiḥ sarvāṃkako vīrastathaiva vikṛtānanaḥ || 142|| jvālakeśo dvādaśakoṭibhirjīmām̐stu saptabhiḥ | dudrubho’ṣṭābhiḥ koṭibhiḥ kapālīśastu paṃcabhiḥ || 143 || ṣaḍbhiḥ saṃdārako yāyāt kokuṇḍaḥ koṭikoṭibhiḥ | viṣṭaṃbho’ṣṭāṣṭabhiryāyāt koṭibhirgaṇasattamaḥ || 144|| sahasrakoṭibhiryāyāt śaṃnādaḥ pippalastathā | āveśānastathāṣṭābhiraṣṭābhiścandratāpanaḥ || 145 || mahāveśaḥ sahasreṇa koṭinā gaṇapastathā | kuṇḍī dvādaśakoṭibhistathā parvatako yayau || 146 || kālaśca kālakaścaiva mahākālastathā gaṇaḥ | koṭīnāṃ śatakenaiva yajñanāśaṃ yayuḥ prati || 147|| agnikṛcchatakoṭyā ca koṭyāgnimukha ityapi | ādityamūrdhā koṭyā ca tathā koṭyā ghanāvahaḥ || 148 || sannāhaḥ śatakoṭyā ca koṭyā ca kumudo gaṇaḥ | amoghaḥ kokilaścaiva koṭikoṭyā gaṇādhipaḥ || 149|| kāṣṭhāgūḍhaścatuḥṣaṣṭyā sukeśī vṛṣabhastathā | sumantrako gaṇādhīśastathā yajñaṃ viniryayuḥ || 1.176.150 || kākapādodaraḥ santānakaśca ṣaṣṭikoṭibhiḥ | mahābalaḥ puṃgavaśca navabhiḥ koṭibhistathā || 151 || madhupiṃgaḥ pūrṇabhadro navatikoṭibhiryayau | virūpākṣastālaketuḥ ṣaḍāsyaḥ paṃcavaktrakaḥ || 152|| saṃvartakaḥ kulīśo daityānto lokāntakastathā | bhṛṃgīriṭiḥ śṛṃgiriṭiraśanirbhālakastathā || 153 || catuḥṣaṣṭyā sahitāste pratyekamadhvaraṃ yayuḥ | bhūtakoṭisahasrāṇi śvagaṇastisṛkoṭibhiḥ || 1 54|| nyapatadvyomamārgeṇa dakṣasyādhvarabhūmiṣu | tayā bheryaśca śaṃkhāśca paṭahāścāpi gomukhāḥ || 155|| śṛṃgāṇi vividhānyeva nineduśca raṇotsave | dakṣavāmākṣi bāhūruvispandaḥ samajāyata || 156|| bhūkampo’bhūcca madhyāhne dakṣo’paśyannakṣatrakam | diśo malīmlucastvāsan nistejo’bhūddivākaraḥ || 157|| pariveṣaiḥ saptabhiśca parivṛto bhayapradaḥ | nakṣatrāṇi patanti smākālikastanayitnavaḥ || 158|| nakṣatrāṇāmabhūdvakrā gatiścādhomukhī tadā | gṛdhro dakṣaśiraḥ spṛṣṭvā yayau nītvā śiraḥpaṭam || 159|| vavāśire ca jambūkāḥ kharā vātā vavustadā | ulkāvṛṣṭiḥ pāṃsuvṛṣṭiḥ śvetavṛścikavarṣaṇam || 1.176.160 || arbudārbudaśalabhā dṛśyante sma makhāṃbare | nītaśca pavanairūrdhvaṃ dakṣasyādhvaramaṇḍapaḥ || 16 1|| vemuḥ raktaṃ yājñīyāste sakampā babhūvustadā | asṛgvṛṣṭirdiśāṃ dāhastimirāvṛtikā diśaḥ || 162|| evaṃvidhānyariṣṭāni cādrākṣurdakṣayajñagāḥ | bhuvi te mūrchitāḥ peturhā hatāḥ smeti cairayan || 163|| etasminnantare tatrākāśavāṇī jagāda tān | dhik dakṣa dhik surādyā vo’nivāryaṃ duḥkhamāgatam || 164|| tāvattu śaṃbhusainyāni praviṣṭāni makhāṃgaṇam | bhayāviṣṭastadā dakṣo hyagacchaccharaṇaṃ hareḥ || 165 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satī pārṣadānāṃ yuddhaṃ dakṣāya vyomavāṇī nāradasya punaḥ kailāsagamanaṃ śaṃbhujaṭāto vīrabhadrotpattiḥ avaśeṣagaṇānāṃ kailāsāgamanam kālikājvaragaṇabhūtasiṃhādisainyasarjanam yajñaṃ prati preṣaṇam nāradasya yajñaṃ pratyāgamaḥ dakṣāderapaśakunāni cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 176 ||
<1.177> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca dakṣastadā bhayodvigno viṣṇuṃ sasmāra padmaje | devadeva harekṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa jagadguro || 1 || mama rakṣā vidhātavyā makhasya ca janasya ca | makhabhaṃgo mā bhavatu makhātmakastvamacyuta || 2 || brahmaṇā viṣṇunā tasya śrutā vai prārthanā tadā | haṃsaṃ garuḍamāruhya svasthānātpunarāgatau || 3 || papāta pādayostayorbhayavyākulamānasaḥ | utthāpya ca tato viṣṇurdakṣaṃ viklinnamānasam || 4 || prāha dakṣa śṛṇu tattvaṃ sarvathā hitakṛdvacaḥ | avajñā hi kṛtā dakṣa tvayā tattvamajānatā || 5 || īśasyāvajñayā sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati niṣphalam | viphalaṃ kevalaṃ naiva vipattiśca pade pade || 6 || apūjyā yatra pūjyante pūjanīyo na pūjyate | trīṇi tatra bhavantyeva dāridryaṃ maraṇaṃ bhayam || 7 || asatkṛtānmahādevāt mahadbhayamupasthitam | śaṃkaro vaiṣṇavo devo nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ || 8 || nārāyaṇasya bhaktasya hyaparādhaḥ kṛtastvayā | bhaktāparādhino rakṣāṃ kartuṃ svāmī na vai kṣamaḥ || 9 || śivasya śaraṇaṃ yāhi sa vai rakṣāṃ kariṣyati | ahaṃ bhaktaparādhīnaḥ satīnāśena duḥkhyaham || 1.177.10 || krūrasya kṛtakāryasya phalaṃ prāpnuhi kiṃ bhavet | dakṣastadvacanaṃ śrutvā vivarṇavadano’bhavat || 11 || prāha ca śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇa yajñāraṃbho bhavadbalāt | kṛto’yaṃ karmaṇāṃ sākṣin vedadharmasya siddhaye || 1 2|| tasmād rakṣā vidhātavyā yajñasyāsya mama prabho tvāṃ vinā rakṣituṃ yajñaṃ cāsmān śakto na vidyate || 13 || viṣṇuḥ prāhādhvararakṣā vidhātavyā mayā dhruvam | khyāto mama paṇaḥ sarvo dharmasya paripālanam || 14|| maryādā vedadharmasya rakṣaṇīyā mayā sadā | yajñe devatrayāṇāṃ ca tathānyeṣāṃ mahātmanām || 15|| surādīnāṃ ca bhāgo’sti vedo vakti na cānyathā | tvayā vyatikramastasya mānenācarito’dhvare || 16|| vada dakṣa dharmapaṇaḥ kathaṃ tyājyo mayā bhavet | kathaṃ satīśivau yajñe tvayā nākāritau purā || 17|| kathaṃ yajñasya maryādā hyullaṃghitā vijānatā | kiṃ karma kimakarmeti na kiṃ paśyasi durmate || 18|| devenaikena śūnyo’yaṃ yajño naiva phalapradaḥ | kevalaṃ jñānamāśritya mānamāśritya yājakāḥ || 19|| īśvaraṃ ca parityajya kevale karmaṇi sthitāḥ | te nu karmamayaiḥ pāśairbadhyante bahujanmasu ||1.177.20||| nirayeṣu prapacyante hīśvarasya vamānakāḥ | ekatra tu śivākhyasya bhrātuḥ sainyamupasthitam ||21||| aparatra ca dakṣādeḥ putrapautrādivāhinī | sarve sambandhino devāḥ kuṭumbaṃ tvekameva ha ||22|| kutra sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ moktavyaṃ vada me’dhunā | kuṭumbināṃ sevakānāṃ sarvathā ca mahātmanām |||23|| nāśa upasthitaste’tra śivāvamānadoṣataḥ | nāśa āmantrito buddhyā gṛhanāśa upasthitaḥ ||24|| ayaṃ rudragaṇādhīśo vīrabhadro’rimardanaḥ | sarvavināśanārthaṃ vai cāgato’sti na saṃśayaḥ |||25|| evaṃ bruvati govinde sainyamāpatitaṃ tadā | parito’dhvarabhūmau tad vyapaśyan vai surādayaḥ ||26|| indrastadā hasan rudraṃ vīrabhadraṃ tathā gaṇam | vajraṃ dhṛtvā kare yoddhuṃ sajjo’bhūt surasainyakaḥ ||27|| indraḥ svagajamārūḍho vastārūḍho’nalaḥ svayam | yamo mahiṣamārūḍho nirṛtiḥ pretavāhanaḥ ||28|| varuṇo makarārūḍho mṛgārūḍho’nilastathā | kuberaḥ puṣpakārūḍho yuyudhe śaṃkaraiḥ saha ||29|| tathānye surayoddhāro yakṣacāraṇaguhyakāḥ | āruhya vāhanānyeva yuyudhire pratāpinaḥ ||1.177.3 0|| devānāṃ ca gaṇānāṃ ca tadāsītsamaro mahān | neduḥ śaṃkhāśca bheryaśca mahādundubhayastathā ||3 1|| ḍiṇḍimāḥ paṭahā neduḥ raṇaśṛṃgāṇi gomukhāḥ | tīkṣṇatomaranārācaiḥ surā jaghnurgaṇān bahūn ||32|| indrādyairlokapālādyairgaṇāḥ śaṃbhorvinirjitāḥ | bhṛgormantrajasainyaiśca nirjitāśca palāyitāḥ ||33|| uccāṭanaṃ kṛtaṃ teṣāṃ bhṛguṇā yajvanā tadā | caṇḍikānāṃ ca sainyāni makhe tatrāpatanti ca ||34|| mahālayānāṃ sainyāni yuddhyanti ṛbhusaṃgare | kālānāṃ bhairavāṇāṃ ca bhūtapretādidhanvinām ||35|| sainyāni devasainyeśca śṛṃbhusainyaiḥ raṇaṃ vyadhuḥ | nipātitāni sarvāṇi ṛbhuśṛṃbhudharāṃbhubhiḥ || 36|| abjārbudaparārdhāni gamitāni yamakṣayam | araṇyaṃ ca śarīrāṇāṃ samabhūt raṇapātinām |||37|| parājitān svakān dṛṣṭvā vīrabhadro’drisannibhaḥ | bhūtapretapiśācām̐śca kṛtvā tāneva pṛṣṭhataḥ ||38|| mahāgaṇānpuraskṛtya samāpatadraṇāṃgaṇe | mahātriśūlamādāya pātayāmāsa nirjarān |||39|| devānsādhyagaṇānyakṣām̐ścāraṇānguhyakānapi | śūlaiśca tomaraiḥ śaktipravaraiste prajaghnire ||1.177.40 || keciddvedhā kṛtāḥ khaḍgairmudgaraiśca vipothitāḥ | anyaiḥ śastraistathāstraiśca surā bhinnā mahāgaṇaiḥ ||41 || kālakavalamantraiśca svabhaṭā jīvitāḥ kṛtāḥ | dakṣabhaṭā vinaśyanti ko’pi tajjīvako’sti na ||42|| sarve parājitā devāḥ palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ | yuddhasthānaṃ parityajya gatāḥ sarve triviṣṭapam ||43|| kevalaṃ lokapālāste śakrādyāstasthurutsukāḥ | vīrabhadro’bravītsarvāndakṣapakṣaprapātinaḥ ||44|| sarve yūyaṃ bāliśatvādavadānārthamāgatāḥ | avadānaṃ prayacchāmi samāgacchata me’ntikam ||45|| he śakra he guro bhāno śaśin yama dhaneśvara | vāyo varuṇa nirṛte śeṣa sūryādayaḥ surāḥ ||46|| samāgacchata sānnidhye prayacchāmyavadānakam | evamuktvā tīkṣṇabāṇaiḥ śastrairastraiśca parvataiḥ ||47|| nirjaghāna surānsarvān dikpatīndrasureśvarān | te ca palāyanaparā vidudruvurdiśo daśa ||48|| atha palāyitāndṛṣṭvā yajñanārāyaṇaḥ svayam | nārāyaṇo naro bhūtvā dadhmau śaṃkhaṃ mahāsvanam ||49|| śrutvā taṃ śaṃkhanirhrādaṃ devāste punarāyayuḥ | nandinā yuyudhe śakro vahnistatrāśmanā saha ||1.177.50||| kuṣmāṇḍāgreṇa dhanarāṭ yuyudhe prāṇadānataḥ | yamena ca mahāloko muṇḍastu varuṇena vai ||5 1|| nairṛtena tu caṇḍaśca bhṛṃgiṇā vāyurityapi | yoginīcakrasaṃyukto bhairavīnāyako mahān |||52|| vidāryāparadevānvai papau śoṇitamuṣṇakam | kṣetrapālā jajakṣustānkālī ca rudhiraṃ papau ||53|| avaśiṣṭāstadā devāḥ pracakrire palāyanam | viṣṇurbrahmā svasvalokaṃ jagmatuḥ prāk tato’dhvarāt ||54|| vināśo’rbudakoṭīnāṃ tadābhūdadhvarasthale | praviṣṭāśca gaṇā yajñe mardanaṃ vai pracakrire |||55|| kaiścidutpāṭitā yūpāḥ kecitkuṇḍānyapūrayan | kaiścittu maṇḍapā dhvastā vedāśca khanitāḥ paraiḥ ||56|| kaiściddhavīṃṣi bhuktāni pītānyājyāni cāparaiḥ | kaiściddhvastāni cānnāni pītāni pāyasāni ca ||57|| pakvānnāni prabhuktāni kṣīrāṇyāsvāditāni ca | cūrṇitāni ca bhagnāni yajñapātrāṇi sarvathā ||58|| bhagnāśca śakaṭāḥ kaiścit srucaḥ sruvāśca moṭitāḥ | paśavaḥ khāditāḥ kaiścit kuṇḍāgnayo vināśitāḥ ||59|| dukūlāni ca ratnāni kaiściddhṛtāni tatsthale | tamupadravamālokya yajño mṛgarūpadhṛk ||1.177.60 || bhītaḥ palāyito vyomnā vīrabhadreṇa saṃdhṛtaḥ | tataścālātacakreṇa viśiraskastadā kṛtaḥ ||6 1 || nandī bhagasya netre dve samujjahāra yo bhagaḥ | śapantaṃ dakṣaṃ netrābhyāmasūsucatpunaḥ punaḥ ||62|| caṇḍaścotpāṭayāmāsa pūṣṇo dantānpravegataḥ | śapamāne hare pūrvaṃ yo’hasad darśayandataḥ ||63|| sarasvatyāśca nāsāgraṃ ciccheda vīrabhadrakaḥ | aditeroṣṭhapuṭakau cicchedaścānyabhadrakaḥ ||64|| vyapothayad bhṛguṃ pṛthvyāṃ maṇibhadro mahābalaḥ | padākramyorasi tasyākārṣīdvai śmaśruluṃcanam ||65|| aryamṇo bāhuyugalaṃ tadotpāṭitavānparaḥ | agnerutpāṭayāmāsa jihvāmanyo gaṇastadā ||66|| ciccheda vāyorvṛṣaṇau gaṇo’nyo balavardhanaḥ | gaṇo yamaśirāḥ kaścit yamaṃ babandha rajjubhiḥ ||67|| śṛṃgī ca nairṛtaṃ vṛkṣe babandha jaṭayā tadā | atolayacca śākhāyāṃ tāḍayāmāsa kaṭyadhaḥ ||68|| kuberaṃ padayordhṛtvā rajjvā badhvā hyadhomukham | tolayāmāsa yūpordhvaṃ gaṇo dharābhunāmakaḥ ||69|| rudrāstu vāmayāmāsurbhakṣakānadhvarāhutīḥ | varuṇodaramāpīḍyodgīrayāmāsurājyakam ||1.177.70|| indro mayūrarūpeṇoḍḍīya cchanno’bhavad girau | prathamāḥ kālayāmāsuranyānapi ca yājakān ||71 || pragṛhyāriṣṭaneminamaṃgirasaṃ ca kaśyapam | dattaṃ kṛśāśvaṃ pādena jaghāna mūrghni bhadrakaḥ ||72|| tato’nyānapi devādīn vidārya pṛthivītale | munīnṛṣīn vīrabhadrādayaḥ śāntiṃ na vai yayuḥ ||73 || viḍambitāḥ svadhā svāhā dakṣiṇānyāśca yoṣitaḥ | mantrāstantrāstathā cānye vastuśeṣā vināśitāḥ ||74|| vavṛṣuste purīṣāṇi vinānāgnau ruṣā gaṇāḥ | pramathaiḥ sā kṛtā yajñabhūmiḥ śmaśānasannibhā ||75|| atiśocyadaśāpannā vīrabhadro jagau gaṇān | kva sa dakṣo durācāraḥ kva ca yajña bhujaḥ surāḥ |||76||| sarvānānayata dhṛtvā yāta drutataraṃ gaṇāḥ | ityājñayā dhāvatastān dṛṣṭvā kruddho janārdanaḥ ||77|| kṛtavān śaktihrāsaṃ yat gaṇāḥ śuṣkatṛṇāyitāḥ | tena kruddho vīrabhadro dadarśa śārṅgiṇaṃ harim ||78 || prāha dakṣaṃ samānīya dehi yuddhyasva vā mayā | hariḥ prāhāhamapyatra dakṣarakṣaṇadakṣadhīḥ ||79|| paśyāmi tava sāmarthyaṃ kathaṃ dakṣaṃ hariṣyasi | iti kṛtvā dhṛtaṃ cakraṃ mumoca vīrabhadrake ||1.177.80|| hāhākāro mahānāsīt lagnaṃ bhadragale tadā | yāvat kṛntati kaṇṭhaṃ ca kaṇṭhe śaṃbhuḥ samāsthitaḥ ||8 1 || kaṇṭhaṃ tyaktvā samāyātaṃ vipṇuhastagataṃ hyabhūt|| garuḍaśca tadā kruddhastvekaikaṃ pramathaṃ nakhaiḥ ||82|| dārayāmāsa lakṣām̐ste prāpuḥ śobhāṃ tu kaiṃśukīm | sarvāngaṇām̐stato viṣṇuḥ staṃbhayāmāsa tatsthale ||83|| vīrabhadravināśāya yāvatsudarśanaṃ hariḥ | prairayacca punastāvad vyomavāṇī jagād tam ||84|| hare sāhasaṃ mākārṣārvīrabhadre haraḥ sthitaḥ | haranāśāya te yatno lajjāvaho nivartaya ||85|| dakṣaḥ karmaphalaṃ yātu mānyaḥ kaścit tathācaret | śrutvaitāṃ ca hariścakraṃ na mumoca punastadā ||86|| antarvedyāntaragataṃ nilīnaṃ prāpya dakṣakam | vīrabhadro vinadyoccaiḥ prāha dhikśaṃbhunindakam ||87|| yasyedṛgasti sampatiryatra devāḥ sabhāsadaḥ | saḥ kathaṃ seśvaraṃ yajñaṃ na kuryāddakṣatāṃ dadhan ||88|| yenāsyenāpavitreṇa bhavatā ninditaḥ śivaḥ | chedayāmi tadāsyaṃ te tīkṣṇadhārāsinā drutam ||89|| evamuktvāsya mūrdhātra khaṇḍitastvasināpi saḥ | kabandhād bhinnatāṃ nāpto yato’bhedyo hi yogataḥ ||1.177.90|| abhedyaṃ tacchiro matvā śastrāstrairapi sarvaśaḥ | cūrṇayāmītyabhidhāya capeṭābhiracūrṇayat ||9 1|| karābhyāṃ troṭayāmāsa padbhyāmākramya corasi | agnikuṇḍe ca tatkṣiptvā vīrabhadro juhāva ha ||92|| athānyānapi yajñasyāndhṛtvā saṃmṛdya tatra ca | tarūnprajvālya tatraiva jvālayāmāsa bhūsurān ||93 || athāṭṭahāsamakarot pūrayam̐śca jagattrayam | tatastvaditimukhyānāṃ militānāṃ mahotsave ||94|| troṭayāmāsa karṇādīnyaṃgapratyaṃgakāni ca | veṇīdaṇḍām̐śca kāsāñcit tena chinnā tadā ruṣā ||95|| kāsāṃcicca karāśchinnāḥ kāsāṃcitkartitā bhujāḥ | nāsikāśca tathāṃgulyaḥ chinnā kāsāṃcideva ha ||96|| jihvāḥ karṇāstathā chinnā nindoktā vā śrutā yayā | candro dharmo bhṛguścaiva mārīcādyāḥ sutādhavāḥ ||97|| atyantamapamānasya bhājanaṃ tena kāritāḥ | tāni kuṇḍāni te yūpāste staṃbhāḥ sa ca maṇḍapaḥ ||98|| tā vedyastāni pātrāṇi tāni havyānyanekadhā | te ca vai yajñasaṃbhārāste te yajñapravartakāḥ ||99|| te rakṣapālāste mantrā vineśuḥ śivahelayā | kṣaṇatulyena kālena āsan nāsan babhūvire || 1.177.100 || mahatāṃ helanāllakṣmi kṣīyate’rjitasukṛtam | tannāśe sarvanāśaḥ syād yathā dakṣasya sampadām || 101 || tasmāddroho na kartavyo’lpīyasāmapi dehinām | paraduḥkhaphalaṃ svasyāvaśyaṃ bhoktavyamāpatet || 102 || atha viṣṇuryayau vyomni vimānasthaṃ tu vedhasam | prāha brahman śaṃkaraṃ vai nītvāyāhyatra satvaram || 103 || vidhihīnaṃ makhadhvasa paśyedāgatya śaṃkaraḥ | adhvarasya ca dakṣasya nistāro’pi bhavettadā || 10 4|| śrutvaivaṃ satvaraṃ brahmā kailāsaṃ prajagāma ha | uvācādhvaravṛttāntaṃ śaṃbhumādāya vai drutam || 1 05|| ājagāmādhvarasthānaṃ sarvaṃ dhvastaṃ vilokya ca | trāsadaṃ dṛśyamālokya dayāleśānvito haraḥ || 106 || kṣaṇaṃ śarvastu saṃpaśyan dūyamānamanā hyabhūt | vīrabhadro’pi natvaiva saṃsthito bahulajjitaḥ || 1 07|| brahmā prāha haraṃ tatra prasādya ca muhurmuhuḥ | aparādhyapyayaṃ dakṣaḥ samprasādyaḥ surottama || 108 || yathāpūrvaṃ punaramūn sarvānkāraya śaṃkara | yathā vidhiḥ pravarteta vaidikaḥ punareva saḥ || 109|| tathājñā dīyatāṃ śaṃbho karma siddhyati seśvaram | anīśvarāsu sarvāsu kriyāsu vai maheśvara || 1.177.110 || evameva bhavantyeva vighnajātāḥ sahasraśaḥ | devabhakto’pi dakṣo’yaṃ devaṃ tyaktvākarot kratum || 111 || loke vigarhaṇāṃ prāptā nidarśanāya so’bhavat | īśaṃ tyaktvā ca kāryāṇi kariṣyanti janā yadi || 112|| tadantaṃ te na paśyanti lokā gāsyanti dakṣavat | tato magaladaṃ devaṃ vihāyānyo janaḥ kvacit||| 113 || svārthaṃ cāpi padārthaṃ ca daivaṃ vādaivamityapi | karma naiva kvacitkiṃcit śrutvaitatpravidhāsyati || 11 4|| brahmaṇoktaṃ vicāryaiva prahasya śaṃkaraḥ punaḥ | vīramājñāpayāmāsa yathāpūrvaṃ prakalpaya || 115|| tadā gaṇān svasainyāni prairayanmārjanāya tat | sthalaṃ bhūtairmārjitaṃ ca bhūmirvipraiḥ susaṃskṛtā || 116 || ujjīvitā mṛtā mantraiḥ saṃjīvanyāmṛtādibhiḥ | ye sainyārthaṃ dvayoḥ pakṣe nūtnāścotpāditā bhaṭāḥ || 1 17|| śaṃbhunā bhṛguṇā svasvamantrairlīnīkṛtāśca te | koṭyarbudāni sainyāni parārthalakṣakāṇi ca || 118 || asaṃkhyadevadevīnāṃ paśūnāṃ pṛtanāstathā | sarvaṃ līnīkṛtaṃ tatra bhṛguṇā śaṃbhunā tathā || 119 || aṃganāśāśca nārīṇāṃ dravyanāśāḥ kratostathā | dehanāśā makhasthānāṃ punarujjīvya sandhitāḥ || 1.177.120 || viṣṇunā brahmaṇā candramasā ca śaṃbhunā makhe | kumāreṇāśvinījena dhanvantariyutena ca || 121 || sūryeṇa guruṇā yoginībhiḥ śrībhistathā tadā | munibhiḥ ṛṣibhiścaiva svasvasāmarthyasaṃyutaiḥ || 122 || yathāpūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ cotpāditaṃ tu mānasam | sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ dāravaṃ caurṇamikṣujam || 123 || pāyasaṃ vallijaṃ sasyajanyaṃ kārpāsakaṃ tathā | annajaṃ jalajaṃ codbhijjātaṃ hrasva mahacca yat || 124 || svalpaṃ pracūrakaṃ cāpi havyaṃ cānyacca yaddhyabhūt | vinā dakṣasya vadanaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ samīkṛtam || 125 || śaṃkarādyājñayāgṛhya yajñīyameṣamastakam | tena meṣamukhaṃ dakṣaṃ vīrabhadragaṇo vyadhāt || 126 || dakṣasya yajñaśīrṣṇaḥ syāt sadā hyajamukhaḥ śiraḥ | mitranetreṇa saṃpaśyet yajñabhāgaṃ bhagaḥ suraḥ || 127 || bhagnadantaḥ suraḥ pūṣā bhavatu yajñapiṣṭabhuk | bastaśmaśrurbhavedeva bhṛguḥ śivavirodhakṛt || 128 || devāḥ prakṛtisarvāṃgā bhavantveva sadā svayam | bāhubhyāmaśvinau pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ kṛtavāhakaḥ || 129 || bhavantvadhvaryavaścānye yathāpūrvaṃ śivājñayā | abhavam̐ste tathā sarve sarvaṃ svasthamabhūttadā || 1.177.130 || atha yajñakriyāstatra prāvartanta punaḥ suraiḥ | pūrṇāhutiḥ pradattāvabhṛthasnānaṃ kṛtaṃ surān || 131 || viprānabhyāgatānputraduhitṛsvasṛbāndhavān | bhāgineyāndeyapātravarānsatkṛtya sarvathā || 132 || dānāni dattavām̐stebhyo dakṣo bastamukho’rthinām | tṛptiṃ cākārayat bhakṣyabhojyapānāmbarādibhiḥ || 133 || sarve svānsvānsvatvabhāgānnītvā yātā nijālayān | viṣṇuryayau ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ brahmā satyaṃ jagāma ha || 1 34|| dikpālā lokapālāśca surā munyādayaśca ye | gatāḥ sarve tṛptahṛdo dānamānārhaṇādibhiḥ || 1 35|| atha śaṃbhurvidhuro vai kva yāmīti vicārayan | himālayasya śikharaṃ tapase saṃjagāma saḥ || 136 || vānaprasthakriyādharmaṃ jagrāha śaṃkarastadā | anāśramavatā puṃsā yataḥ kālo manāgapi || 137|| vyarthaṃ kalayitavyo na vane śreyastapaḥśramaḥ | tapaścacāra śarvaḥ sagaṇaḥ śṛṃge śivābhidhe || 1 38|| kailāsasya ca rakṣārthaṃ vīrabhadramayojayat | dakṣo’pi pāpaśāntyarthaṃ kāśīṃ jagāma caikalaḥ || 1 39|| tapasārādhayacchaṃbhuṃ liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya satvaram | prāvirbhūtvā svayaṃ śaṃbhurdakṣapāpaṃ hyamārjayat || 1.177.140 || prāha brūhi varaṃ dakṣa dāsyāmi manasepsitam | prāha dakṣo haraṃ deyo varo mama yadi tvayā || 141|| tava bhaktiḥ sadā cāstu kṣantavyo me’parādhakaḥ | dakṣeśvare tvayā stheyaṃ liṃge tu sarvadā prabho || 142|| dattamiti tathā cānyad gṛhāṇa dakṣa me’grataḥ | parārdhadvitīyaprānte tato mokṣamavāpsyasi || 143|| iti haro dadau tasmai varadānaṃ pramokṣaṇam | dakṣasya yajñabhaṃgaḥ sa na hareṇa kṛtaḥ khalu || 144|| paraṃ dveṣṭi pareṣāṃ yadātmanastadbhaviṣyati | pareṣāṃ kadanaṃ karma na kāryaṃ tat kadācana || 145|| paraṃ dveṣṭi pareṣāṃ yadātmanastadbhaviṣyati | iti sambodhitaṃ tasmād drohaṃ parasya nācaret || 146|| ārto jijñāsurarthārthī jñānī caiva caturthakaḥ | caturvidhā bhajante’jaṃ caturtho’tra viśiṣyate || 147|| kevalaṃ karmaṇā yo vai saṃsāraṃ tartumicchati | na ca pāramavāpnoti madhye vighnena lupyate || 148|| harerbhakto haraṃ nindet harabhakto hariṃ tathā | tayoḥ śāpā bhaveyuste tattvaprāptirbhavennahi || 149|| hariharau sadā caikatattvaṃ brahmāpi tanmayaḥ | haro brahmā ca viṣṇuśca jagataḥ kāraṇaṃ param || 1.177.150 || haransṛjam̐stathā rakṣandadhe saṃjñāḥ kriyocitāḥ | advitīye pare tasmin brahmaṇyātmani kevale || 151|| ajñaḥ paśyati bhedena bhūtāni brahma ceśvaram | ityetadbrahmarūpasya satyāśca śaṃkarasya ca || 152|| caritraṃ śṛṇuyād bhaktyā śrāvayedbhaktimān janān | sarvasaukhyaṃ labhedatra paratra paramāṃ gatim || 153|| yaḥ paṭhetpāṭhayedvāpi satyākhyānamidaṃ śubham | bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyaṃ sarvārthasampradāyakam || 154|| svargyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaputrapautraphalapradam | sa ca bhuktvākhilān bhogānante mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 155|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhītadakṣaprārthanā vipṇunyāyavākyaṃ surādīnāṃ gaṇādīnāṃ ca yuddhaṃ yajñādidhvaṃsaḥ ṛtvijāmaṃgabhaṃgāni cakreṇa śivāviṣṭavīrabhadrānāśaḥ śaṃkarāgamanaṃ sarveṣāṃ punaḥ sajīvanaṃ yajñasamāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 177||
<1.178> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pareśo vā maheśo vā janārdanaḥ | lokarītiśca prakṛtirbādhate tānapi kvacit || 1 || mānāvamāne devasya bādhete brahmaṇo yadi | tarhi tatra ca dakṣādeḥ kā kathā kṣudradehinaḥ ||2 || satīdehe pradagdhe ca śaṃkaro mohamāptavān | kalatraśoko balavān svātmārāmaṃ parātparam || 3 || bādhate jñāninaṃ cāpi yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorgurum | satīdehasya yadbhasma cāsthipuṣpāṇi yāni ca || 4 || gṛhītvā śaṃkarastāni vilalāpāśrunetrakaḥ | uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha subhage sati prāṇeśvari priye || 5 || śaṃkaro’haṃ tava svāmī paśya māṃ nikaṭāgatam | sarvātmānamatidīnaṃ śavatulyaṃ tvayā vinā || 6 || yaśca śaktiṃ na jānāti jñānahīnaśca nindati | taṃ tyaktumucitaṃ vijñe kathaṃ māṃ tyajasi priye || 7 || sasmitaṃ sakaṭākṣaṃ ca vadāgatya sudhopamam | madhurābhāsadṛṣṭyā ca māṃ dagdhaṃ siktamācara || 8 || prāṇādhike samuttiṣṭha rudantaṃ māṃ na paśyasi | parityajya ca naḥ prāṇān gantuṃ nārhasi sundari || 9 || pativrate samuttiṣṭha kathaṃ māṃ nādya sevase | ityuktvā ca satībhasma dehe śaṃbhuradhārayat || 1.178.10 || gaṃgātaṭe rurodoccaiḥ sati sādhvītyudīrya ca | trinetranetranīraiśca saṃbabhūva saraḥ tanuḥ || 11 || tadvai netrasaro nāma tīrthaṃ jātaṃ tapaḥsthalam | satyasthimālikāṃ kṛtvā dadhāra kaṇṭhabhūṣaṇam || 12|| nityaṃ tadbhasma bhaktyā ca cakāra gātralepanam | sati prāṇeśvarītyuktvā punarmūrchāmavāpa saḥ || 1 3|| tadā devāḥ sapārṣado nārāyaṇaścaturbhujaḥ | brahmā śeṣaśca
