dharmaśca surāḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ || 14|| mūrchitaṃ ca samutthāya rudantaṃ śaṃkaraṃ tadā | ucitaṃ bodhayāmāsurviṣṇuḥ prāha taduttaram || 1 5 || śaṃbho māyāguṇāḥ sarve hetavaḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ | viṣṇumāyā balavatī guṇayuktaṃ prabādhate || 1 6|| duḥkhaṃ śoko bhayaṃ śaṃbho guṇātīte bhavennahi | manvate sukhaduḥkhāni svapnānīva vipaścitaḥ || 1 7|| jñānaṃ labha mahādeva svastho bhava maheśvara | cetanāṃ kuru bhadraṃ te satīṃ prāpsyasi niścitam || 18 || sudinaṃ durdinaṃ śaśvad bhavatyeva bhave bhave | tābhyāṃ harṣaśca śokaśca jāyate prākṛte jane || 19 || śubhena cāśubhena karmaṇā sudinadurdine | tatra karma śubhaṃ kāryaṃ sadā sattvasvabhāvajam || 1.178.20 || sattvaṃ saṃsargasādhyaṃ ca saṃgaḥ puṇyabalādbhavet | puṇyaheturmano bodhyaṃ mānasehaṃ hariḥ sthitaḥ || 21 || mayā ca hariṇā sarvaṃ kāryate śocanaṃ tyaja | atha caikaṃ parabrahma dvividhaṃ bhavatīcchayā || 22 || nityaṃ ca prākṛtaṃ caiva śarīraṃ dvividhaṃ hi tat | nityaṃ vināśarahitaṃ naśvaraṃ prākṛtaṃ sadā || 23 || ahaṃ tvaṃ cāpi bhagavānnāvayornityavigrahaḥ | āvayoraṃśabhūtā ye prākṛtā naṣṭavigrahāḥ || 24|| rudrādayastadaṃśāśca madaṃśā viṣṇurūpiṇaḥ | mamāpyevaṃ dvidhā rūpaṃ dvibhujaṃ ca caturbhujam || 25|| caturbhujo’haṃ vaikuṇṭhe padmayā pārṣadaiḥ saha | goloke dvibhujo’haṃ ca gopībhiḥ saha rādhayā || 26|| evaṃ sa bhagavānāste nityaḥ saḥ puruṣottamaḥ | nityā ca prakṛtistasya hyuttamā pauruṣī matā || 27|| mahāmāyā mahālakṣmīrmaheśvarī ca saiva ha | sadā tau dvau ca saṃśliṣṭau sarveṣāṃ pitarau śiva || 28|| satīmicchasi cecchaṃbho prakṛteḥstavanaṃ kuru | śokaṃ tyaja svīyamāyāṃ bhaja smara jagatprasūm || 29|| śokanāśo jāyatāṃ te śivaṃ syācca mamāśiṣā | dūraṃ viplavahetuśca yātustrīvirahajvaraḥ || 1.178.30 || ityuktvā śroharirmaunamāsasādātha śaṃkaraḥ | snātvā natvā ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ baddhapuṭāṃjalistataḥ || 31 || stavanaṃ kartumārebhe brahmaśakteḥ sabhaktikaḥ | brāhmi brahmasvarūpe tvaṃ māṃ prasīda sanātani ||32|| paramātmasvarūpe ca paramānandarūpiṇi | oṃ prakṛtyai namo bhadre māṃ prasīda bhavārṇave ||33|| sarvamaṃgalarūpe ca prasīda sarvamaṃgale | vijaye śivade devi māṃ prasīda jayaprade || 34|| vedavedāṃgarūpe ca vedamātaḥ prasīda me | śokaghne jñānarūpe ca prasīda bhaktavatsale ||35||| sarvasampatprade māye prasīda jagadambike | lakṣmīrnārāyaṇakroḍe sraṣṭurvakṣasi bhāratī ||36 || mama kroḍe mahāmāyā vipṇumāye prasīda me | kālarūpe kāryarūpe prasīda dīnavatsale || 37||| kṛṣṇasya rādhike bhadre prasīda kṛṣṇapūjite | samastakāminīrūpe kalāṃśena prasīda me ||38|| sarvasampatsvarūpe tvaṃ prasīda sampadāṃ prade | yaśasvibhiḥ pūjite tvaṃ prasīda yaśasāṃ nidhe || 39 || carācarasvarūpe ca prasīda mama mā ciram | mama yogaprade devi prasīda siddhayogini ||1.178.40 || sarvasiddhisvarūpe ca prasīda siddhidāyini | adhunā rakṣa māmīśe pradagdhaṃ virahāgninā || 41 || svātmadarśanapuṇyena krīṇīhi parameśvari | ityuktvā virataḥ śaṃbhurdadarśa gaganasthitām ||42|| taptakāṃcanavarṇābhāṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitām | īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ śatabhujāṃ ca tāṃ satīm ||43|| dṛṣṭvā tāṃ virahāsaktaḥ punastuṣṭāva satvaram | duḥkhaṃ nivedayāmāsa prarudan virahodbhavam ||44|| darśayāmāsāsthimālāṃ svāṃgasthaṃ bhasma bhūṣaṇam | kṛtvā bahuparīhāraṃ toṣayāmāsa sundarīm ||45|| babhūva parituṣṭā sā śaṃbhumuvāca bhāvataḥ | sthiro bhava mahādeva prāṇādhika mama prabho ||46|| bhavānātmā ca yogīśaḥ svāmī janmani janmani | ahaṃ śailendrakāminyāṃ labdhvā janma maheśvara ||47|| tava patnī bhaviṣyāmi muñca tvaṃ virahajvaram | ityuktvā śivamāśvāsya cāntardhānaṃ cakāra sā ||48|| svanivāsānsurā jagmuḥ kailāsaṃ ca yayau haraḥ | nanarta sagaṇastūrṇaṃ santyajya virahajvaram ||49|| etatpaṭhecchṛṇuyācca na viyogajvaro bhavet | na bhavetkāminībhedastasya janmani janmani |||1.178.5 0 || ityevaṃ śaṃkaraṃ tūktvā menāyāṃ janmakāmukī | jagāma himavaddeśe’dṛśyarūpā cacāra sā ||51|| kurvāṇā ca tapo divyaṃ śivasya vyacarat sakhī | śivaṃ śivaṃ bhajamānā samayaṃ taṃ pratīkṣate ||52|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satīdāhottaraṃ bhasmāsthīni samādāya śaṃkarasya gaṃgātaṭe śokaḥ satīstotraṃ satīdarśanaṃ pārvatī janmavacanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭasaptatyadhikaśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 178 ||
<1.179> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca mahālakṣmi vidhuraḥ śaṃkaraḥ kvacit | himālaye vicacāra śailapatnīṃ dadarśa saḥ || 1 || sādhusvarūpaḥ saumyaśca prasannatāṃ prakāśayan | śaṃbhuruvāca mātarme bhikṣāṃ dehyekalāya me || 2 || menā pakvānnamādāya yāvaddadāti śaṃbhave | śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā menāṃ bhikṣāṃ dehyekalāya me || 2 || iyaṃ pakvānnabhikṣā tu naikasyaiva kṛte bhavet | tatrānyeṣāṃ vibhāgo’stita bhikṣāṃ dehyekalāya me || 4 || yatra nānyasya bhāgo’sti vṛṇe bhikṣāṃ tu tādṛśīm | menā prāha tadā sādhuṃ sādho kimicchasi priyam || 5 || yathecchasi tathā dāsye sphuṭaṃ vada dadāmyaham | menāṃ śaṃbhustadā prāha dadāmītyucyate yadi || 6 || prāpnomītyeva ca prāptā prāpsyāmyavasarāgame | mātastadāgamiṣyāmi bhikṣāṃ dehyekalāya me || 7 || menā tvāścaryamālokya patitā pādayostadā | uvāca dāsye’vaśyaṃ te yadi yogyā kṛte tava || 8 || śaṃbhuḥ prāha tathāstveva mātaḥ paśya tayā vinā | vicarāmi mahāraṇye priyayā śivayā vinā || 9 || tava gehe satī dakṣaputrī janma grahīṣyati | sā matkṛte bhavedbhikṣā śaṃkaro’haṃ samāgataḥ || 1.179.1 0|| menā śrutvā tvatyatīva prasannābhūd hṛdantare | bhojitaḥ pūjitaḥ śaṃbhurjagāma ca yathecchayā || 1 1|| tata ārabhya menā sā sasmāra bhāviputrikām | śaṃbhuṃ jāmātaraṃ caiva mumoda hṛdayāmbare || 12|| prāgbhavīyabhaktivaśāt śive bhaktirvyavardhata | śivāṃ dhyātvā śivāmātā bhaviṣyati samudraje || 1 3|| lakṣmīruvāca menakā sā śivāmātā kāsīttacchrīhare vada | hariḥ prāha śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 14|| vedhaḥputrasya dakṣasya kanyāḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ prakīrtitāḥ | tāsāṃ vivāhamakarot sa varaiḥ kaśyapādibhiḥ || 15|| tāsāṃ madhye svadhānāmnī pitṛbhyo dattavān sutām | tisro’bhavan sutāstasyāḥ subhagāḥ dharmasaṃbhṛtāḥ || 16 || jyeṣṭhā madhyā kaniṣṭhā ca menā dhanyā kalāvatī | etāḥ pitṛmānasotthāstisraścāyonijā hi tāḥ || 17|| avyāhatagatikāstā yoginyaḥ kāmarūpagāḥ | ekasmin samaye tisro bhaginyastīrthavāñcchayā || 18|| śvetadvīpaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ jagmurdarśanahetave | divyaṃ vimānamāruhya gatāstāḥ kāmagaṃ śubham || 1 9|| vimānādavatīryaiva cakrurviṣṇoḥ stutiṃ natim | tasthustadājñayā śvete susamājo mahānabhūt |||1.179.2 0 || samāje tatra pañcahāyanā brahmasutāstadā | sanakādyāḥ samājagmuḥ stutvā natvā hariṃ tataḥ ||2 1 || samāje viṣṇuvacanāt tasthuste sanakādayaḥ | samājaśca tadottasthau munisvāgatamācaran ||22|| devīsatīyoginīnāṃ samājo’pyutthitastadā | tisro bhaginyaḥ paścātsthā nottasthurmohato yathā ||23|| tāstisro yoginīnāṃ madhyapṛṣṭhe saṃsthitā yataḥ | pāścātyā naiva paśyanti paurvāste’pi ca tām̐stathā ||24|| naḥ tisra naiva paśyanti samājāgrasthitā yataḥ | kimutthāya ca kartavyaṃ matvaivaṃ notthitā yataḥ ||25|| saiṣā māyālasyarūpā pramādātmakamohinī | bhūtvā tadvaśagāstā vai na cakruryogyamarhaṇam ||26|| yadyapi jñāninaḥ santo na krodhavaśagā nanu | kintu bhāviprabalena preritāḥ krodharaśminā ||27|| tāsāṃ tātkālikīṃ dṛṣṭvā śāntopi yogīśaḥ kṛtim | sanatkumāro muktātmā śāpaṃ daṇḍakaraṃ dadau ||28|| yūyaṃ tisro bhaginyo vai pitṛkanyā api dhruvam | śiṣṭācāravihīnāḥ sthābhyutthānanativarjitāḥ ||29|| kṣudramānavakṛtyāḍhyāḥ dūrā bhavatu vai divaḥ | narastriyaḥ saṃbhavatu labhadhvaṃ svakṛteḥ phalam ||1.179.3 0|| tisra ākarṇya sādhvyastāḥ patitvā pādayormuneḥ | prāhurmune dayāsindho prasanno bhava sarvathā ||3 1 || tvādṛśānāṃ satāṃ bhāvo hṛdaye’smākamasti vai | pramādānna natirabhyutthānādisatkriyāḥ kṛtāḥ ||32||| phalaṃ labdhaṃ kṛteḥ svasyāḥ kuruṣvānugrahaṃ mune | tavaiva vacanād brahman labhema svargatiṃ punaḥ |||33 || kṛpāṃ kṛtvā ṛṣistatra provāca prītamānasaḥ | śāpoddhāraṃ karomyeva mahatkāryaṃ bhaviṣyati ||34|| tvannimittaṃ ca sukhadaṃ yatrāśleṣo harerbhavet | jyeṣṭhā menā hareraṃśabhūtasya himabhūbhṛtaḥ || 35|| patnī bhavatu te kanyā pārvatī saṃbhaviṣyati | yāṃ śaṃbhave pradāyaiva prāpsyasi sukhamuttamam ||36|| ante śivāśivāśīrbhirmuktiṃ kailāsamāpsyasi | madhyā dhanyā siradhvajajanakasya priyāṃganā ||37|| bhavatu te sutā mahālakṣmīḥ sītā bhaviṣyati | yāṃ rāmāya pradāyaiva prāpsyasi sukhamuttamam ||38|| ante sītārāmasya kṛpayā vaikuṇṭhamāpsyasi | kalāvatī kaniṣṭhā ca vṛṣabhānuviśo gṛhe ||39|| patnī bhavatu te kanyā rādhikā saṃbhaviṣyati | yāṃ kṛṣṇāya pradatvā tvaṃ prāpsyasi sukhamuttamam ||1.179.40|| ante ca rādhākṛṣṇakṛpayā golokamāpsyasi | sukarmiṇāṃ gate duḥkhe prabhaved durlabhaṃ sukham ||41|| yūyaṃ pitṛsutāḥ sarvāḥ sadā svargavilāsikāḥ | etannimittamālambya mokṣagāḥ saṃbhaviṣyatha ||42|| paścātsanatkumārādyāḥ samājātsvālayaṃ gatāḥ | menādikāstisra īyuḥ svapitṛbhavanaṃ tataḥ ||43|| athaikadā kurukṣetre snātvā hīndrādayaḥ surāḥ | āṣāḍhe māsi mārgarkṣe candrakṣayatithirhi sā ||44|| dadurindrādayastasyāṃ piṇḍān pitṛbhya ādarāt | tilānmadhu supakvānnaṃ miṣṭaṃ haviṣyamityapi ||45|| tataḥ prītāstu pitaro devānāha sutṛptitaḥ | vṛṇuta kiṃ vitarāmo devāḥ prāhustadā pitṝn ||46|| sarve śṛṇuta no vākyaṃ pitaraḥ prītamānasāḥ | kartavyaṃ tattathaivāśu devakāryepsavo yadi ||47|| yūyaṃ smaratha kanyānāṃ śvetadvīpe vṛtaṃ ca yat | sanatkumāraśāpaṃ taṃ smaratāthocitaṃ matam ||48|| menā nāma sutā yā vo jyeṣṭhā maṃgalakāriṇī | tāṃ vivāhya ca suprītyā himākhyena tu bhūbhṛtā ||49|| sarve bhavantu sukhino lābhavantaḥ pade pade | yuṣmākamamarāṇāṃ ca duḥkhahānirbhaviṣyati ||1.179.50 || surāṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā smṛtvā śāpaṃ purā bhavam | omiti procuḥ pitaro dadurmenāṃ himādraye ||51||| himādriḥ parvato divyo mahātejāḥ samṛddhimān | dvirūpo vartate loke jaṃgamasthirabhedataḥ ||52|| pūrvāparau toyanidhī suvigāhya sthitaḥ sthiraḥ | tuṣāravidhiratyugro devarṣisiddhasaṃśritaḥ ||53|| tapaḥ siddhipradaṃ śīghraṃ pāvanaśca mahātmanām | sa eva divyarūpo hi ramyaḥ sarvāṃgasundaraḥ ||54|| viṣṇvaṃśaśca mahābhaktaḥ śailarājaḥ sumūrtimān | sa eva svakulasthityai dharmavardhanahetave ||55|| svavivāhaṃ kartumanā pitṛdevahitecchukaḥ | menāpāṇiṃ ca jagrāha vivāhavidhinā tadā |||56|| samutsavo mahānāsīt tadvivāhe sumaṃgale | haryādayo’pi te devā ṛṣayo munayo’drayaḥ ||57|| ājagmustatra vaivāhe praśaśaṃsurhimācalam | utsavaṃ kārayāmāsurdadurdānāni bhūriśaḥ ||58|| mahāmodānvitā devāḥ pitṝndivyānpraśasya ca | saṃjagmuḥ svasvadhāmāni prāpya satkārapūjanam ||59|| menāṃ tu yuvatīṃ prāpya himavān gṛhadharmataḥ | prītimānabhavattatra reme kāmād yathecchayā ||1.179.60|| atha dakṣasutā kāle satī tu himaparvate | yadāsīcchaṃbhunā sārdhaṃ tadaiva tāṃ tu menakā ||61|| mama gehe kṛtāvāsā matsutā vai satī matā | iti sutāsamāṃ jñātvā siṣeve mātṛvarcasā ||62|| evaṃ nityaṃ dhyāyamānā sevate menakā satīm | satī ca dakṣayajñe svatanuṃ tyaktvāsmaratprasūm ||62|| tasyāmahaṃ sutā syāmityavadhārya satī hṛdā | samayaṃ prāpya prītyā sā menakāputrikābhavat ||64|| pārvatī sā tapaḥ kṛtvā patiṃ prāpa śivaṃ punaḥ | menāyāṃ kanyakāstisro jātā rūpaguṇānvitāḥ ||65|| rāgiṇī kuṭilā kālī tisraḥ kanyā yathākramam | raktāṃgī raktanetrā ca raktāmbaravibhūṣitā ||66|| rāgiṇī nāma saṃjātā jyeṣṭhā menāsutā priye | śubhāṃgī padmapatrākṣī nīlakuṃcitamūrdhajā ||67|| śvetamālyāmbaradharā kuṭilā nāma madhyamā | nīlāṃjanacayaprakhyā nīlendīvaralocanā ||68|| rūpeṇānupamā kālī jaghanyā menakāsutā | sunābha iti ca khyātaścaturthatanayo’bhavat ||69|| jātāstāḥ kanyakāstisraḥ ṣaḍabdāt purataḥ priye | kartuṃ tapaḥ prayātāśca devāstā dadṛśuḥ śubhāḥ ||1.179.70||| tato divākaraiḥ sarvairvasubhiśca tapasvinī | rāgavatī nāma kanyā divaṃ nītā suraistadā ||71 || brahmaṇā sā kṛtā sandhyārāgavatī suvigrahā | mahiṣāsuranāśāya sandhyāsamayarūpiṇī ||72 || pratīcchukī kṛttikābhāge sadā tiṣṭhate divam | kuṭilā brahmalokaṃ tu nītā devaiḥ śaśiprabhā ||73 || brahmā prāha mahiṣasya vināśārthamiyaṃ sutā | śārvaṃ dhārayituṃ tejo na vai śaktā hi dṛśyate ||74|| ataśceyaṃ brahmaloke satye kṛtālayā sadā | āpomayī plāvayantī nadī tiṣṭhatu madgṛhe ||75 || iti gate kanyake dve jñātvā menā tapasvinīm | tṛtīyāṃ putrikāṃ menāṃ tapaso’vārayadyataḥ ||76 || u mā tapaḥ kuru putrītyevamumābhidhābhavat | ityetatkathitaṃ svalpaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ||77|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne menāyai śaṃbhunā satījanmārthasūcanam menā dhanyā kalāvatī tisraḥ pitṛkanyāḥ śvetadvīpaṃ jagmuḥ tatra sanatkumāraśāpaḥ kramaśo himagireḥ sīradhvajajanakasya vṛṣabhānuvaiśyasya ca patnyo jātāḥ kramaśastatputryaḥ śivā sītā rādheti menāyāṃ sandhyārāgiṇī kuṭilābrahmanadī kālī ceti putrītrayaṃ sunābhaputraścetinirūpaṇanāmaikonāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 179||
<1.180> śrīlakṣmī uvāca kālījanmakathāṃ divyāṃ vada me parameśvara | kālī punaḥ kathaṃ gaurī jātetyapi kathāṃ vada || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi satī dehaṃ tyaktvāvyaktābhavattataḥ | himālayapradeśeṣu guptādṛśyā vyavartata || 2 || devāḥ kailāsamāsādya susthāne praṇipadya ca | sasmaruśca praṇemuśca tuṣṭuvuśca tadā satīm || 3 || devyubhe omiti tvaṃ vai gāyatrī parameśvarī | pūjitā brahmamunibhirūrjitā rājabhirnṛpaiḥ || 4 || tvaṃ bhūritiviḍbhi pṛthvī śūdraiḥ śiveti pūjitā | kṣāntirmunīnāmakṣobhyā dayā niyamināmapi || 5 || tvaṃ mahopāyasandohā nītirnayavisarpiṇām | paricitistvamarthānāṃ tvamīhā prāṇihṛcchrayā || 6 || tvaṃ muktiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvaṃ matiḥ sarvadehinām | itistvaṃ raktacittānāṃ prītistvaṃ hṛdi dehinām || 7 || tvaṃ kīrtiḥ satyabhūtānāṃ tvaṃ śāntirduṣṭakarmaṇām | tvaṃ bhrāntiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvaṃ gatiḥ kratuyājinām || 8 || tvaṃ samudramahāvelā tvaṃ ca līlā vilāsinām | saṃbhūtistvaṃ padārthānāṃ sthitistvaṃ lokapālinām || 9 || tvaṃ kālarātrirniḥśeṣabhuvanāvalivāsinī | priyakaṇṭhagrahānandadāyinī tvaṃ vibhāvarī || 1.180.1 0|| rakṣikā tvamanāthānāṃ darśanaṃ dehi cāmbike | anekairvividhairloke rūpairdevi tvamarcitā || 11 || sadā śivapriye durge tvāṃ namāmo maheśvari | śrīśaktiṃ pāvanīṃ puṣṭiṃ mahadavyaktarūpiṇīm || 12|| vayaṃ namāmahe bhaktyā śuddhāṃ brahmaparāyaṇām | antarvidyāsuvidyābhyāṃ suprītāṃ tvāṃ namāmahe || 1 3|| tvaṃ dīdhitiḥ sūryagatā kaumudī candrasaṃgatā | āpyāyayasi brahmāditṛṇāntaṃ tvāṃ namāmahe || 14|| gāyatrī tvaṃ vedamātā tvaṃ sāvitrī sarasvatī | tvaṃ vārtā sarvajagatāṃ tvaṃ trayī dharmarūpiṇī || 15 || tvaṃ nidrā sarvabhūteṣu kṣudhā tṛptistvameva ha | tvaṃ lakṣmīḥ puṇyakartṝṇāmalakṣmīḥ pāpināṃ tathā || 16 || tvaṃ śāntiḥ sarvajagatāṃ tvaṃ dhātrī prāṇapoṣiṇī | gītistvaṃ sāmavedasya granthistvaṃ yajuṣāṃ hutiḥ || 17|| ṛgvedasya tathā mātrātharvaṇasya parā gatiḥ | samastagīrvāṇaśaktirduḥkhanistārakāriṇī || 18|| śive rudrāṇi sannidre caṇḍe kātyāyani sati | kauśiki caṇḍike kāli nārāyaṇi namo’stu te || 19 || tapaḥpriye sadādṛśye pārvati te namonamaḥ | prasannā bhava deveśi darśanaṃ dehi suvrate ||1.180.2 0|| menāyāṃ labha putrītvaṃ mahādevi namo’stu te | itthaṃ devaiḥ stutā devī durgā durgatināśinī ||21|| āvirbabhūva devānāṃ purato jagadambikā | babhūvānandasandohaḥ sarveṣāṃ tridivaukasām ||22|| punardevāḥ praṇemuśca tuṣṭuvuśca viśeṣataḥ| śive śarvāṇi kalyāṇi vijñaptiṃ śṛṇu cāmbike ||23|| dakṣasutā surakāryakṛte jātāpi śāṃkarī | nahi jātaṃ prapūrṇaṃ tat devakāryaṃ maheśvari ||24|| pūrṇaṃ kuru mahādevi nirjarāṇāṃ manoratham | sanatkumāravacanaṃ saphalaṃ syāttathā kṛte ||25|| bhūtvā tvaṃ menakāputrī rudrapatnī punarbhava | sarve bhavantu sukhino duḥkhaṃ naśyatu kṛtsnaśaḥ ||26|| śrutvaitatprāha śarvāṇī prasannāhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | menāputrī bhaviṣyāmi svaṃ sukhaṃ labhatāṃ haraḥ ||27|| sarve gacchata dhāma svaṃ sadā smarāmi śaṃkaram | mama hetormahāduḥkhī vartate sa kuveṣabhṛt || 28|| vidhāya mālāṃ suprītyā mamāsthnāṃ virahākulaḥ | dehe mama citābhasma dhārayatyaniśaṃ prabhuḥ ||29|| ataścāvatariṣyāmi rudrasantoṣahetave | bhaktāḥ śaṃbhupriyā bhūtvā tapaḥ kṛtvā suduḥsaham |||1.180.3 0 || surakāryaṃ kariṣyāmi satyaṃ svaṃ gacchata gṛham | ityuktvāntardadhe devī jagāma himavadgṛham || 31 || surāstaddiśi natvaiva svasvadhāmani saṃyayuḥ | himādrirmenakā cobhau tepāte paramaṃ tapaḥ || 3 2|| śivāmārādhayāmāsatuśca bhaktyāḍhyacetasā | dānaṃ dadaturviprebhyaḥ sadā tattoṣahetave || 33|| caitramāsaṃ samārabhya saptaviṃśativāsarān | śivāṃ sampūjayāmāsa putryarthinī tu menakā ||34|| aṣṭamyāmupavāsaṃ ca kṛtvādānnavamītithau | modakairbalipiṣṭaiśca pāyasairgandhapuṣpakaiḥ ||35 || gaṃgāyāmauṣadhiprasthe kṛtvā mūrtiṃ mahīmayīm | umāṃ saṃpūjayāmāsa nānāvastvarpaṇādibhiḥ || 36 || nirāhārā jalāhārā vāyvāhārā kvacitkvacit | nināya menakā saptaviṃśativāsarān vrate || 37|| vratapūrṇe satī cāvirbabhūva parameśvarī | menāṃ dadarśa santuṣṭāṃ tejomaṇḍalamadhyagām || 38|| uvāca suprasannā sā menāṃ pratyakṣatāṃ gatā | varaṃ brūhi mahāsādhvi yatte manasi vartate || 39|| dāsye te’haṃ prasannāsmi tapovratasamādhibhiḥ | dṛṣṭvā ca praṇanāmaitāṃ provāca menakā satīm ||1.180.40 || praṇamāmi mahādevīṃ sarvakāmārthadāyinīm | praṇamāmi sadā siddhāṃ paramātmasvarūpiṇīm ||4 1 || praṇamāmi sadānandāṃ vanitābuddhirūpiṇīm| praṇamāmi karuṇāḍhyāṃ vidhehi mama vāñchitam |||42|| yoṣāṇāṃ satpriyakartrī brahmasukhapradāyinī | bhaktecchāpūraṇī śaktirnārāyaṇi namo’stu te ||43|| iti stutā satī prāha menāṃ varaya vāṃchitam | menā prāha tadā devīṃ varayogyāsmyahaṃ yadi ||44|| prathamaṃ śataputrā me bhavantu jagadambike | tatastisraḥ sutāścāpi sadguṇaścaikaputrakaḥ ||45|| tatra tisṛsutāmadhye kaniṣṭhā mama putrikā | bhava mama snehapātraṃ sukhasthānaṃ sadā mama ||46 || rudrapatnī bhava tathā līlāṃ kuru mamāntike | devyuvāca ca tacchrutvā tathāstviti tu menakām ||47|| kathayitvā tirodhānaṃ jagāmāśu harapriyā | atha menā svapataye śaśaṃsa varadānakam ||48|| śrūutvā himagirirhṛṣṭaḥ praśaśaṃsa priyāṃ prati | kālakrameṇa ca tayoḥ pravṛtte surate priye ||49|| garbho babhūva menāyā vavṛdhe pratyahaṃ ca saḥ | asūta menā mainākaṃ putraṃ sarvaguṇaṃ śubham ||1.180.5 0|| tataḥ krameṇa vai cānyānputrān sā suṣuve samān | kanyādvayaṃ ca suṣuve tataḥ satīprasādataḥ ||51 || samadhatta tadā menā garbhaṃ gireḥ satī tanum | giripriyāṃ sarvajagannivāsāsaṃśrayādhikam ||52|| vireje sutarāṃ menā tejomaṇḍalaśobhitā | priyāprīteśca manasaḥ svārjitadraviṇasya ca ||53|| samunnateḥ śruteḥ śailaḥ kriyāścakre yathocitāḥ | dadarśa kāle menāṃ sa pratītaḥ prasavonmukhīm ||54|| vyatīte navame māse daśame māsi pūrṇataḥ | ardharātre vyatīte’tha menā śūlāyate tanau ||5 5 || vasantartau madhau māse navamyāṃ mṛgadhiṣṇyake | brāhme muhūrte śubhage prāsūyata suputrikām ||56|| divyā devī samutpannā sā lakṣmīriva sāgarāt | tejasā vyāptamabhavanmenāgṛhaṃ samantataḥ ||57|| tadā susamayaścāsīcchāntabhagrahatārakaḥ | nabhaḥ prasannatāṃ yātaṃ prakāśaḥ sarvadikṣu ca ||58|| mahī maṃgalabhūyiṣṭhā savanagrāmasāgarā | sarassravantīvāpīṣu puphulluḥ paṃkajāni vai ||59|| vavuśca sukhadā vātāḥ śītalāśca sugandhinaḥ | babhūva puṣpavṛṣṭiśca toyavṛṣṭipuraḥsarā ||1.180.60|| jajvaluścāgnayaḥ śāntā jagarjuśca tadā ghanāḥ | mumuduḥ sādhavaḥ sarve jagurgandharvasattamāḥ ||61 || vidyādharastriyo vyomni nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ | tadotsavo mahānāsīt devādīnāṃ nabhastale ||62|| tasminnavasare devī brahmaśaktiḥ satī śivā | āvirbabhūva purato menāyā nijarūpataḥ ||6 3|| āvirbabhūva tadgarbhāt śrīlakṣmīriva sāgarāt | śivapriyā samutpannā gaṃgeva śaśimaṇḍalāt ||64|| himavannagare tatra sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ kṣayaṃgatam | abhavansukhinaḥ sarve sarvalokanivāsinaḥ ||65|| nārakāṇāmapi tadā sukhaṃ svargasamaṃ hyabhūt | abhavatkrūrasattvānāṃ cetāṃsyapi mṛdūni vai ||66 || jyotiṣāmapi tejāṃsi prabhāvantyabhavanbahu | vanāśritāścoṣadhayaḥ susvādaphalasaṃbhatāḥ ||67|| meruprabhṛtayaścāpi mūrtimanto mahācalāḥ | tasminmahotsave prāptā divyaprasṛtapāṇayaḥ ||68|| sāgarāḥ saritaścaiva samājagmuśca sarvaśaḥ | ṛṣayo munayaḥ śāntā viṣṇvādyā sakalāḥ surāḥ ||69|| ājagmuḥ sukhinaḥ prītyā dadṛśurjagadambikām | tuṣṭuvustāṃ śivāmambāṃ śivārthadhṛtavigrahām ||1.180.70 || jagadambe mahādevi sarvadā tvāṃ namāmahe | devānāṃ maṃgalaṃ kāryaṃ kuru tvaṃ bhaktavatsale ||71 || menāmanorathaḥ pūrṇaḥ kṛtaḥ kuru śivasya ca | puṣpāñjalīn prakīryaiva devāḥ svadhāma saṃyayuḥ ||72|| himaśailo’bhavalloke tadā sarvacarācaraiḥ | saṃsevyaścādhigamyaśca sāśrayaścācalottamaḥ ||73|| tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā divyarūpāṃ janmabālāṃ suvarṇabhām | api varṣmaṇi śyāmāṃ tāṃ nīlotpaladalaprabhām ||74|| mudramāyāti menātituṣṭā stutiṃ cakāra sā | jagadambe kṛtāmbe māṃ kṛtātikaruṇā tvayā ||75|| āvirbhūtā mama gehe sadā putri sthirā bhava | namaskaromi praṇayapūrṇahṛdayavihvalā ||76|| ityānandaprapūrṇāśrunetrābhyāṃ sā papau sutām | tāvaddevī samabhavaddivyāṣṭabhujadhāriṇī ||77|| prodbhinnāvayavā rūparūpānubhṛtayauvanā | dvādaśottaravarṣāyā ūnaṣoḍaśahāyanā ||78|| svarṇābhūṣaṇaśobhāḍhyā divyavastrātisūjjvalā | hāsyapūrṇānanā saumyapremapūritalocanā ||79|| rājādhirājasampattyā śobhayāśritavigrahā | śivayogyābhavaddvivyā kṛpayā darśanaṃ dadau ||1.180.80 || mātre coktavatī devī mātaste’stu muhurnamaḥ | tvayā cārādhitā bhaktyā pūrvaṃ dātuṃ varaṃ tadā ||8 1 || yācitāhaṃ samāyātā svaputryarthaṃ tvayā tataḥ | omityuktvā tirodhānaṃ gatāhaṃ parameśvarī ||82|| sāhaṃ divyā satī cāsmi śivapatnī tava gṛhe | putrī jātāsmi mātastvaṃ madyogātsaṃmukhī bhava ||83|| divyarūpaṃ dhṛtaṃ hyetat yatte matsmaraṇaṃ bhavet | anyathā martyabhāvena tavājñānaṃ bhavenmayi ||84|| yuvāṃ māṃ putrikārūpadivyabhāvena sarvadā | cintayantau me pitarau yātau stho madgatiṃ parām ||85|| devakāryaṃ kariṣyāmi līlāṃ kṛtvādbhutāṃ kṣitau | śaṃbhupatnī bhaviṣyāmi tārayiṣyāmi sajjanān ||86|| ityuktvā sā mahādevī sutā bhūtvā mahādyutiḥ | cakāra rodanaṃ tatra laukikīṃ rītimāśritā ||87|| śrutvā tadrodanaṃ ramyaṃ gṛhasthāḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ | jahṛṣuḥ saṃbhramāt menāgṛhaṃ yayurmudānvitāḥ ||88|| girirhimācalaścāpi putrījanmanivedine | dadau ratnāni vastrāṇi dhanaṃ ca pāritoṣikam ||89|| dṛṣṭvā divyatanuṃ kanyāṃ mumuhurdarśakāstadā | tathotsavo mahānāsīnnedurvādyāni bhūriśaḥ ||1.180.90|| babhūva maṃgalaṃ gānaṃ nanṛturvarayoṣitaḥ | himācalo dadau dānaṃ viprebhyo jātakarma ca ||9 1|| vidhāpya bahirāgatya bhikṣubhyo draviṇaṃ dadau | nāmākarot sutāyāśca kālītyekādaśe’hani ||92|| nityaṃ sā vardhate kālī śukle candrakalā yathā | janaḥ kulocitanāmnā pārvatītyājuhāva tām ||93|| kandukaiḥ kṛtrimaiḥ putraiḥ sakhīmadhyagatā satī | gaṃgāsaikatavedībhirbālye reme muhurmuhuḥ || 94|| samaye sadgurorvidyā yatacittā papāṭha ca | nityaṃ śaṃbhordhyānaparā taporucimatī hyabhūt ||95|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne himagirāvadṛśyasatyāḥ devakṛtastutiḥ satījanmavara dānam menāhimādryostapaḥ menāgarbhaḥ kālījanmadivyadarśanaṃ mahotsavaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 18 0||
<1.181> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ekadā nārado devo yāyāddhimagirergṛham | cakāra śailo devarṣeḥ saparyāṃ bahubhāvataḥ || 1 || nāradāṃghryoḥ svatanayāṃ pāvitryārthamapātayat | prāha ca matsutābhāgyaṃ brūhi devarṣisattama || 2 || nāradastatsutāhastaṃ sarvāṃgāni viśeṣataḥ | dṛṣṭvāvocadgire kanyā pitroḥ prītivivardhinī || 3 || svapateḥ sukhadātyantaṃ mahāsādhvī pativratā | bhaviṣyati mahādivya mahārājñīva pūjitā || 4 || aṃguṣṭhamadhyasandhau ca rekhayā hīśvarī bhavet | haste hastidhvajapadmaśūlarekhābhirīśvarī || 5 || kare cihnaṃ mahaccihnaṃ rājñī saiṣā bhaviṣyati | lalāṭe candracihne yamīśapatnī bhaviṣyati || 6 || kare’syāḥ svastikaṃ cihnaṃ kārye vijayinī bhavet | netre karṇāntalagne’syā brāhmī kācitpareśvarī || 7 || hṛdaye cāsya śaṃbhurvai dhavalāṃkamayo’sti vai | yataḥ śaktirmahādevī bhaviṣyatyeva bhūdhara || 8 || udare’dhobāṇarekhā pūjyā devī bhaviṣyati | caraṇe’syā nāgavallī devapatnī bhaveddhruvam || 9 || ekā vilakṣaṇā rekhā hyaṃguṣṭhopari vartate | lalāṭe ca tathā rekhā vartate tatsahārthikā || 1.181.1 0|| tayoḥ phalaṃ śṛṇu śaila bhavedvā na bhavettathā | tyāgī nagno guṇahīno mātṛtātavivarjitaḥ || 11 || akāmo’śivaveṣaśca patirasyā bhavediti | menāhimālayau śrutvā kṣaṇaṃ duḥkhamavāpatuḥ || 12|| pūrvāṃ śivasmṛtiṃ labdhvā sukhamatyantamāpatuḥ | pārvatī tu vacaḥ śrutvā jaharṣāti muhurhṛdi || 13 || daivarekhā brahmalipirna mṛṣā jāyate kvacit | tādṛśo’sti varaḥ śaṃbhurnānyo’sti tādṛśaḥ patiḥ || 14|| iti matvā śailaputrī smaratyaharniśaṃ haram | nāradaḥ satkṛtiṃ labdhvā gacchanvai śivamandiram || 15|| smārayāmāsa śailendraṃ satīṃ prati haroditam | na tvāmṛte’nyāṃ varaye dākṣāyaṇi sati priye || 16|| bhāryārthaṃ na grahīṣyāmi satyametadbravīmi te | iti śarvavacaḥ śailaṃ smārayitvāha nāradaḥ || 17|| siṃhāsanaṃ tava putryāḥ śaṃbhorūrau bhaviṣyati | śaṃbhorūrvāsanaṃ prāpya mahārājñī bhaviṣyati || 18|| ityuktvā sa gato brahmalokaṃ devarṣināradaḥ | putrīṃ bālāṃ ca pitarau ramayāmāsatuḥ sadā || 19|| vivardhamānā girijā vivāhārhasuyauvanā | samabhavat tadā cendraḥ sasmāra nāradaṃ punaḥ ||1.181.20 || sa tu drāgeva samagāt mahendrabhavanaṃ muniḥ | indra utthāya pādyādyaiḥ pūjayāmāsa nāradam ||21 || prāha vai kuśalaṃ svasya jñātavānnāradasya ca | kathaṃ smṛto’hamityukto mahendraḥ prāha nāradam ||22|| yuvatī śailajā jātā yogaṃ yāyācca śaṃbhunā | śīghraṃ tathodyamaḥ kāryaḥ sarvaṃ tādṛgvidhīyatām ||23|| śrutvā tu nāradaḥ śīghraṃ jagāma śailaketanam | vṛddhaviprasvarūpeṇa jyotiḥpatraṃ kare dadhan ||24|| śailārpitāsane ramye niṣasādātha bhūsuraḥ | śailārpitārhaṇāṃ saṃgṛhyāvadacchūlakṣṇayā girā ||25|| kuśalaṃ śailarājātra tapasaḥ sarvadā kimu | śailaḥ prāha suvṛddhānāṃ kṛpayā kuśalaṃ mama ||26|| kintu putrī varayogyā jātāsti vada tatphalam | tāvanmenā duhitrānuyātājagāma bhūsuram ||27|| vavande vipracaraṇau menā ca śailaputrikā | putrīṃ vilokya viprarṣirāśīrbhistāṃ vyavardhayat ||28|| provāca vismitāsyaḥ sa vākyaṃ bhāgyaṃ vilokya ca | na jāto’syāḥ patirbhadre lakṣaṇaiśca vivarjitā ||29|| uttānahastā nitarāṃ caraṇau vyabhicāriṇau | svacchāyāṃ ceti bodhyaṃ vai kimanyadvācyamatra vai ||1.181.3 0 || śrutvaitatbhramamāpannaḥ śokamagno himālayaḥ | pūrvaṃ nāradakathitaṃ vismṛtyovāca bhūsuram ||3 1 || karmarekhātidurgamyāvaśyaṃbhāvi phalapradā | janmāntaramanuyāti vicitrabhūtajātiṣu ||32 || striyā virahitā sṛṣṭiḥ prāṇināṃ naiva jāyate | strījātistu prakṛtyaiva kṛpaṇā dainyabhāginī ||3 3|| tāsāmavajñā ca mā bhūditi vicārya vedhasā | daśaputrasamā kanyā vaṃśakṣetramudīritā || 34|| durbhagā kṛpaṇā kanyā piturduḥkhakarī sadā | tatrāpi patiputrārthasaubhāgyavidhurādhikā ||25|| tvaṃ coktavānmama putryā durguṇāneva sarvathā | aho duḥkhaṃ mahajjātaṃ śrutvā tvanmukhato’dya me ||36|| athāpi kiṃcitsaubhāgyaṃ vārdhakye’syā bhavediti | tarhyapi vipra vaktavyaṃ duḥkhaṃ mārjaya me’ghajam |||37|| striyastu brahmaṇā sṛṣṭāḥ puruṣāṇāṃ sukhāya vai | tāsāṃ janma patilābhe sārthakau viphalo’nyathā ||38|| patipitṛkulānāṃ cehāmutroddhārikāḥ striyaḥ | satpatiprāptimatyo’troddhārikāḥ kīrtitā hi tāḥ |||39|| durlabhaḥ satpatiḥ strīṇāṃ viguṇo’pi patiḥ kila | na prāpyate vinā puṇyaiḥ sujaḍo’pi patiḥ striyā ||1.181.40 || asādhano’pi saddharmaḥ putraprāptyātmikā ratiḥ | dhanamājīvanaṃ bhāgyaṃ nāryāḥ kānte pratiṣṭhitam ||41 || nirdhano durmukho mūrkhaḥ sarvalakṣaṇavarjitaḥ | bhāgyaṃ tu paramaṃ nāryāḥ patireva sadā mataḥ |||42 || yā nārī matsarād dveṣādīrṣyayā vā svabhāvataḥ | anyaratisukhaṃ hanti tatphalaṃ patihīnatā ||43 || yānyakāmasukhaṃ dveṣṭi kāme vighnaṃ karoti ca | kāmena sukhinornindāṃ karoti nāpnuyātpatim ||44|| vivāhitāpi pataye kāmabhikṣāṃ dadāti na | ratyadātryāḥ kāmukasya patiprāptirhi durlabhā ||45|| bahusaṃcitapuṇyānāṃ phalaṃ kāmasukhādikam | manuṣyebhyaḥ sadā dattaṃ pāpināṃ tadbhavennahi ||46|| paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi kāmāsaktā viyojitāḥ | yayā tasyāḥ kāmasukhaṃ patisukhaṃ na jāyate ||47|| dharmakāmā narā yābhistiraskṛtya tṛṇīkṛtāḥ | tāsāṃ satkulajanmāpi patyalābhāt tṛṇīkṛtam ||48|| yāsāṃ kāmasukhaṃ nāsti tāsāṃ kāmāgnidagdhatā | dukhaṃ satatasaṃlagnaṃ taptasūrmī hi sātra vai ||49|| kāmāvighnātmakaṃ dānaṃ nānyaddānaṃ hi vidyate | trasya puṇyaṃ sadā prāptiḥ satpaterbhavatīti vai ||1.181.50|| kāmadānamahatpuṇyaṃ yasyā bhavati saṃcitam | tasyā mānuṣajanmātra bhavati nityakāmadam ||51 || pārāvatacaṭakādyāḥ pakṣiṣu nityakāminaḥ | prākpradattakāmadānaphalaṃ bodhyaṃ na cānyathā ||52|| paśūnāṃ gomahiṣīṇāṃ kāmanā viralā tu sā | prāgapradattakāmasya phalaṃ svalpaṃ kṛtaṃ tathā ||5 3|| vṛkṣeṣvapi narayogājjāyante tu phalāni hi | vallīṣvapi puṣpayogo phalaṃ naiva ca dṛśyate |||54|| tatsarvaṃ tu pradattasya kāmākāmasya vai phalam | mama putryā kīdṛśaṃ vai kṛtaṃ karma purā bhavet|||55|| yena nāsyāḥ patirjāta ucyate bhūsura tvayā | etad daurbhāgyamatulamasaṃkhyaduḥkhabhājanam ||56|| kiṃ cottānitahasteyaṃ tvayoktā nityadāṃ hyataḥ| uttānahastatā bhikṣāṃ yācatāmeva saṃbhavet ||57|| śubhodayānāṃ bhāgyānāmadātārau daridrakau | succhāyayāsyāścaraṇau tvayoktau vyabhicāriṇau ||58|| tatrāpi śreyasī hyāśā na me’syā vai sudṛśyate | pūrvaṃ tu nāradenoktaṃ bhūsura śrāvayāmi tat ||59|| tyāgī nagno guṇahīno mātṛtātavivarjitaḥ | akāmo’śivaveṣaśca patirasyā bhavediti ||1.181.60|| tadatra bhrāmaṇe satyaṃ kiyadgrāhyaṃ mayānagha | brūhi jānāsi ced deva duḥkhaṃ me līnatāṃ vrajet ||6 1 || nārado vṛddhaviprātmā prāha śailaṃ suduḥkhitam | harṣasthāne tu mahati duḥkhaṃ te bhrāntijaṃ yataḥ ||62|| śṛṇu śaila na jāto’syāḥ svāmī tvajaḥ sadāśivaḥ | nityaḥ sa śāśvataḥ sthāṇuracalo’sti sanātanaḥ ||63|| anyeṣāṃ karmajanmāno dehā nāsya tathā hyajaḥ | śṛṇu vai lakṣaṇaireṣā varjiteti vivicyate ||64|| lakṣaṇaṃ karmajanyāṃkaṃ cihnaṃ śārīramucyate | taccāyurdhanasaubhāgyasampanmṛtipradarśakam ||65|| iyaṃ tu brahmarūpāsti karmaśūnyā maheśvarī | nāsyāḥ karmakṛtaṃ dehaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vidyate iti ||66|| svābhāvikāni daivāni cihnānyasyā bhavanti hi | śṛṇu cottānakaratāṃ hyuttāno varadaḥ sadā ||67|| hasto’syāśca mahādevyā bhaviṣyatyeva sarvathā | surāsuramuniprāṇivaradātrī bhaviṣyati ||68|| śṛṇu cāsyāstu caraṇau svacchāyau vyabhicāriṇau | caraṇau padmasaṃkāśau svacchāvasyā nakhojjvalau ||69|| surāsurāṇāṃ namatāṃ kirīṭamaṇikāntayaḥ | viśiṣṭā abhitaścāriṇyaḥ praviṣṭā yayorhi tau ||1.181.70 || tādṛśau bhavataścāsyāścaraṇau bhāgyasevitau | śivapatnyāstu kiṃ vastu nyūnaṃ śaila bhaved vada ||71|| pūrvaṃ yaduktaṃ tyāgī ca patirasyā bhaviṣyati | śivastu sarvadā rāgaśūnyastyāgī mato dhruvam ||72|| nagno’pimāyayā hīno māyāvastravihīnakaḥ | guṇahīnaśca māyāyā guṇatrayavihīnakaḥ |||73 || parabrahmasvarūpasya na mātā janakastathā | mātṛtātavihīnatvaṃ śivasya ghaṭate sadā ||74|| akāmaḥ kāmanā gradhnā tṛṣṇā tayā vihīnakaḥ | aśivastāmaso bhāvaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ ||75|| sa cātra veśarūpeṇa kāryārthaṃ sandhṛtaḥ khalu | raudraḥ saṃhārako veṣo hyaśivaveṣa ucyate ||76|| citābhasmajaṭājūṭavyāghracarmāsthidhāraṇam | aśivaveṣa ityevaṃ loke’pi śaṃkare’sti hi ||77|| sa śaṃbhuḥ svaḥ paraṃbrahmāvatāro bhagavān haraḥ | patirasyāstava putryā bhāgyodayād bhaviṣyati ||78|| tatropāyaṃ śṛṇu prītyā kṛtvā yaṃ lapsyase sukham | tatra śaṃbhau lakṣaṇāni śubhānyaśubhavanti vā ||79|| sukhadānyeva bodhyāni sukhamūrtiryato haraḥ | ravipāvakagaṃgānāṃ tatra grāhyaṃ nidarśanam ||1.181.80|| tasmāttvamapi śailendra dehi śivāya kanyakām | śīghraprasādaḥ sa haro grahīṣyati sutāṃ tava ||8 1|| śivasya tapasā prāptiḥ kuryāttapaḥ sutā tava | samartho’pi tava putryā vaśaṃ yāsyati sarvathā ||82|| kulipirapi sulipirbhaviṣyati tapobalāt | avaśyaṃ bhāvinī patnī tava putrī śivapriyā |||82|| śaṃbhościttaṃ vaśe caiṣā kariṣyati susevayā | so’pyenāṃ te sutāṃ tyaktvā nānyāmudvāhayiṣyati ||84|| nānayoḥ sadṛśī prītiranyayorbhūtabhāvinī | anayormelane devakāryāṇi subahūni vai ||85|| kartavyāni suvidyante tasmād dehi harāya tām | anayā kanyayā śaṃbhurardhanārīśvaro’sti vai |||86|| vivāhavidhinā khyātiṃ tādṛśīṃ tu gamiṣyati | tapasā ca haraṃ samyagārādhya tava putrikā ||87|| kṛṣṇarūpaṃ vidhūyaiva gaurarūpā bhaviṣyati | gaurīti vai tathā nāmnā vidyudgaurī bhaviṣyati ||88|| nāmānyasyāstathānyāni bahūni santi tāni ca | śṛṇu tubhyaṃ kathayāmi bhaviṣyanti yathātathā ||89|| kālī tārā mahāvidyā ṣoḍaśī bhuvaneśvarī | bhairavī chinnamastā ca vidyā dhūmāvatī tathā ||1.181.90|| bagalāmukhī siddhavidyā mātaṃgī kamalā tathā | caṇḍī ca bhairavī saiṃhītyevaṃ nāmāni santi vai ||9 1 || nānyasmai tvamimāṃ dātuṃ kvacitsaṃkalpamācareḥ | idaṃ copāṃśu devānāṃ na prakāśyaṃ ca kutracit ||92|| śailaḥ prāha tadā vṛddhabrāhmaṇaṃ śṛṇu madvacaḥ | śivastu sarvadā dhyānī devānāmapyagocaraḥ ||93||| tyaktasaṃgo virāgaśca dhyānayogaparaḥ sadā | brahmārpitāntarātmā saḥ kathaṃ sādhyo bhaviṣyati ||94|| nirguṇo nirvikāraśca nirāmayo nirīhakaḥ | akṣaro brahma paramaḥ kathaṃ sādhyo bhaviṣyati ||956|| yasyāntarvartate viśvaṃ bāhyaṃ naiva nirīkṣate | saḥ kathaṃ tapasā putryānayā sādhyo bhaviṣyati ||96|| brāhmaṇaḥ prāha tacchrutvā cintā kāryā na vai tvayā | devadevo nirīho’pi tvatputryāmīhayā yutaḥ ||97|| tapasāvaśyameva syādato’sādhyaṃ na vidyate | kālī svayaṃ mahākālaṃ haraṃ tu prāpsyati dhruvam ||98|| gacchāmyahaṃ tu śailendra vivāhakaraṇaṃ kuru | itikṛtvotthito vipro gamanāya mano dadhe ||99|| śailastāvatsusatkārārhaṇāṃ tasyākaronmudā | vṛddhaviprasvarūpaṃ ca tirodhāyāpi bhūsuraḥ || 1.181.100 || devarṣirnāradaṃ rūpamāsthāya vyomamārgagaḥ | nārāyaṇaṃ raṭanpremṇā paśyatośca tayordvayoḥ || 101 || menakāśailayoḥ śīghraṃ jagāmendrapurīṃ prati | menāśailau mahāścaryaṃ gatau dṛṣṭvā tu nāradam || 1 02|| niścitā śaṃbhupatnīyaṃ sutā bhāgyavatī sadā | ānanditā ca sā kanyā prasannau pitarau tathā || 103 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vṛddhaviprarūpeṇa nāradasya himagirigṛhāgamanaṃ pārvatyā rekhābhiḥ aguṇasya patnītvamuktam himālayacintā aguṇādiśabdārthasphuṭatā śivapatnī bhāvinīti nirṇayaḥ vṛddhabrāhmaṇatvaṃ vihāya nāradarūpeṇā kāśapathā mahendrapurīṃ prati gamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 181 ||
<1.182> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca athālpasamaye kānte menā mohavaśā priye | uvāca haimaṃ śailendraṃ prahvībhūtamanomayī || 1 || daridrāya na dātavyā dātavyā dhanine sutā | vivāhaṃ kuru kanyāyāḥ sundareṇa vareṇa hi || 2 || prāṇapriyā mama putrī komalā bhāgyaśālinī | vardhitā vividhairbhogyaiḥ sukhasampatsamṛddhibhiḥ || 3 || ato’syāśca vivāho’pi sarvasampanmaye gṛhe | vareṇa sulakṣaṇasatkulodbhūtena yujyate || 4 || sadvaraṃ prāpya sukhinī yathā syāttattathā kuru | śrutvā menāṃ tu śailendraḥ prāha śaṃkānivṛttaye || 5 || bhramaṃ tyaja priye patni dātavyā śaṃkarāya vai | yadyasti te pratītirvai tadā dāsye’nyathā nahi || 6 || yadi snehaḥ sutāyāste sutāṃ śikṣaya sādaram | śivopari tapaḥ kuryāt tapasā sādhyate śivaḥ || 7 || prasannaśca haro bhūtvā kālyāḥ pāṇiṃ grahīṣyati | sarvaṃ vai śaṃkare cāsti sukhaṃ dravyaṃ smṛddhyādikam || 8 || amaṃgalāni sarvāṇi maṃgalāni śive sadā | sarvavidhāni saukhyāni vartante ca śive sadā || 9 || akhaṇḍavīryatā śaṃbhau svāmitā suranākinām | pūjyatā lokināṃ śaṃbhau hetutā bhūtadehinām || 1.182.10 || pṛthvī jalaṃ tathā tejaḥ pavano gaganaṃ tathā | sūryacandrādayo yasya tanavaḥ santi sarvadā || 1 1|| śaṃbhostasya tanuṣveva nihitāḥ sarvasmṛddhayaḥ | śivārthaṃ tapase putryai vinirdiśa śubhaṃ bhavet || 1 2|| menā śrutvā tapaḥ drākca sutāṃ saṃlokya komalām | kṣaṇaṃ tu vivyathe sutāmupadeṣṭuṃ śaśāka na || 1 3||| atha sā pārvatī jñātvā provāca jananīṃ tadā | mātaḥ śṛṇu mayā dṛṣṭaḥ svapno brāhmamuhūrtake || 14|| viprastapasvī suprītaḥ provāca vihituṃ tapaḥ | śaṃkarasyetyupādiśya kṛtvā bhāle sucandrakam || 15 || karau manmastake datvā dhṛtvā māṃ vakṣasi svake | āśīḥ prayujya gatavān surūpaḥ śaṃkaro yathā || 16 || tasmāttapaḥ kariṣye’haṃ smṛtvā taṃ puruṣaṃ hṛdi | śrutvaitatsvapnamevārthaṃ kathayituṃ jagāma sā || 17|| giriṃ tāvat girīndro’pi svakaṃ svapnamuvāca ha | śṛṇu mene’dya me svapne tapasvī jana āgataḥ || 1 8|| nāradoktasvarūpaḥ saḥ puropakaṇṭhamādarāt | tapaḥ kartuṃ pravṛttaśca tatrāhaṃ nītavān sutām || 19 || mayā tu lakṣaṇairjñātaḥ śaṃkaro’yamiti dhruvam | sevāyāṃ pārvatīṃ tasyopādiśyāhaṃ tapasvinaḥ || 1.182.20|| prārthitavām̐śca taṃ bālaṃ nāṃgīcakāra vai yadā | mayā vedāntavijñānairbahudhā vāda ādṛtaḥ || 21 || yathākathaṃcit sa tato bālāṃ jagrāha sevane | sāpi premṇā pārvatī taṃ sevate lokitaṃ mayā || 22|| tato’sti samayaḥ prāptaḥ samīpe phaladāyakaḥ | pārvatīṃ tapase mene śikṣayācirasiddhaye ||2 3 || śrutvā menābhavad hṛṣṭā śikṣayāmāsa pārvatīm | sāpi śaṃbhuṃ sadā dhyātvā tapase saṃsthitā satī ||24|| phalāni bhojane devī gṛhṇātyekasubhaktake | yoginīva triṣavaṇaṃ snānaṃ śaṃkarapūjanam ||25|| mālikāyāḥ sahasraṃ tu śaṃbhunāmnānuvartanam | netre sammīlya svastikāsane niṣadya cintanam ||26|| prātaḥ sāyaṃ śaṃkarasyārārtrikaraṇamarthanā | stotrasya raṭaṇaṃ paścāt kiṃcijjāgaraṇaṃ tathā || 27|| svāpaḥ pṛthvyāṃ tṛṇāḍhyāyāṃ tathā valkaladhāraṇam | maunaṃ cādarśanaṃ pārśve tapaścaivaṃ cakāra sā |||28|| śaṃkaro’pi svayaṃ vetti tapaḥ karoti yatsatī | vicaran vidhuraścamatkārām̐ścakre hyalaukikān ||29|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satītapaḥ satīhimālayayoḥ svapne śaṃbhunā tāpasaveṣeṇa dattadarśanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 182|||
<1.183> śrīlakṣmīruvāca kīdṛśām̐śca camatkārām̐ścakre vai śaṃkarastadā | satīṃ vinā tapaḥ kurvan vicaram̐śca kṣitau sukham || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca camatkārā mahābhāgavatasya śaṃkarasya me | bhaktasyāsan bahavo’pi dvitrām̐ste kathayāmi vai || 2 || satīdāhottare kāle pārvatyudvāhapūrvake | ekadā śaṃkaraḥ satīvirahāgnipratāpitaḥ || 3 || kailāse maunamāsthāya priyāvirahakātaraḥ | sasmāra svapriyāṃ patnīṃ guṇām̐śca premavardhanān || 4 || varṇayāmāsa bahudhā darśayan laukikīṃ gatim | vairāgyavegena gārhasthyasya rītiṃ vihāya ca || 9 || digambaraḥ subabhrāma sthale vane hyaraṇyake | kvāpi śāntiṃ na ca lebhe satīvirahaduḥkhitaḥ || 6 || mano niyamya kailāse samādhiṃ kṛtavān haraḥ | samādhau bahuvarṣāṇi vyatīyuśca punastadā || 7 || brahmāgninā brahmarandhraṃ lalāṭaṃ cātapat bahu | tapoyogoṣmaṇā bhāle cābhavat svedabindukaḥ || 8 || sthūlo bhūtvāpatat pṛthvyāṃ tapodhātuvimiśritaḥ | tasya babhūva pṛthvyāṃ vai bālo raktapravarṇakaḥ || 9 || caturbhujo’ruṇo ramyo’laukikadyutimān śubhaḥ | sa ca ruroda tasyaiva tadā śaṃbhostu sannidhau || 1.183.1 0|| śaṃbhuḥ samādhimagno’sti jñātvā devī vasundharā | āvirbabhūva tatraiva dhṛtvā sustrītanuṃ navām || 1 1|| bhūmirbālaṃ nidhāyāṃke stanyaṃ sāpāyayat sutam | cucumba tanmukhaṃ snehāt samakrīḍayadātmajam || 12| śaṃbhurantaḥsthito devo jñātvā sarvaṃ samādhinā | utthitaḥ sahasā tatra samādheśca vihasya tām || 13|| bhūmiṃ prāha prasannaḥ san dhanyāsi dharaṇe priye | prītyainaṃ rakṣitavatī tvayi jātaṃ sutaṃ mama || 14|| mama svedodbhūtabindujanyo’yaṃ bālakastava | nāmnā khyāto bhavelloke bhūmidātṛguṇādimān || 15|| bhaumo’yaṃ maṃgalakaro maṃgalaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati | mamāpi sukhadātāyaṃ gṛhāṇainaṃ sutaṃ tava || 16|| bhūmirjagrāha taṃ bālaṃ śivaṃ saṃpūjya vai tataḥ | āśīrvacanamādāya svasthānaṃ sasutā yayau || 17|| rūpāntareṇa sā bhūmiḥ sutamādāya sarvadā | kāśyāṃ vāsaṃ kṛtavatī suto’bhūd yauvanānvitaḥ || 18|| sa ca jānāti pitaraṃ devaṃ śaṃbhuṃ sadā smaran | kāśyāṃ mūrtau mahādeve siṣeve śaṃkaraṃ sadā || 19|| yuvānaṃ ca sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā pitā prāhādya sevayā | prasanno’smi vṛṇu kiṃcit dāsye tvadabhivāñcchitam || 1.183.20|| putraḥ prāha mayā labdhaṃ sarvaṃ labdhā prasannatā | pitṛprasannatātulyaṃ nahi kiṃcid bhavediti ||2 1|| sarvalabdhavyabhogyeṣu śreṣṭhā pitṛprasannatā | sā yadyadhigatā putraiḥ sarvaṃ cādhigataṃ bhavet |||22|| pitṛsevāphalaṃ svargaṃ mokṣaścāpunarāvṛtaḥ | sarvavighnavināśaśca sarvasampatkaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||23|| sūryacandrādirājyāni bhaumānyatalajāni vā | pārameṣṭhyapadānyatho pitṛprasannatāphalam |||24|| tava sevā sadā kāryā na me’styanyamanorathaḥ | ityuktvā hṛdgadabhāvāt patito harapādayoḥ ||25|| śaṃbhuḥ karau bhaumamūrdhni kṛtvā prāha suputrakam | sthāpaye tvāṃ gṛhamadhye maṃgalākhyo graho bhava ||26||| yāvat dyauḥ sthāsyati sṛṣṭau tāvat tvaṃ vai bhaviṣyasi | ityāśiṣaṃ ca samprāpya natvā śaṃbhuṃ vasundharām ||27|| divyaṃ lokaṃ jagāmāśu śukralokātparaṃ varam | tatra rājyaṃ mahallebhe bhaumagolakanāmakam || 28|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi bhaumasyotpattilakṣaṇam | śaṃkarasya caritaṃ vai satīvirahakālikam ||29|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃkarasya lalāṭasvedabindormaṃgalagrahasyotpattiritinirūpaṇanāmā tryaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 183||
<1.184> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ataḥ paraṃ śṛṇu prītyā hanumaccaritaṃ priye | ādyayuge yadabhūttad rudrasya caritaṃ śubhe || 1 || brahmaṇaścāpi caritaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu mohinīṃ tadā | dhātavo nyapatan śaṃbhorvedhasaścāpi yadyathā || 2 || ekadā vidhuraḥ śaṃbhuḥ śaradi himaparvate | śṛṇvan vai kokilālāpān candrikādhavalīkṛte || 3 || surabhyanilasaṃvyāpte mayūraiścāpi nādite | śaityavyāptanikuṃjāḍhye sasmāra dakṣajāṃ satīm || 4 || aho nāsti mama kāntā kīdṛśī me’sti vai gatiḥ | sakhīṃ vinā śaratkālaḥ kathaṃ niryāpito bhavet || 5 || devānāmīśvarāṇāṃ ca parabrahmasvarūpajaḥ | bādhakaḥ samayo’vaśyaṃ bhavati prāṇadhāriṇām || 6 || yadyapyasmi nirīho’haṃ tathāpi varṣmayogataḥ | tātkālikehayā cātra smarāmi dakṣajāṃ satīm || 7 || kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi vinā satīṃ sahāyinīm | tāṃ vinā bādhate śaityaṃ smaro’pi bādhate’dya vai || 8 || brāhmamuhūrtaprāraṃbhe cintāmagno haro’bhavat | atīva sasmāra satīmutthāyotthāya tiṣṭhati || 9 || niṣīdati viharati kāmajvarasamākulaḥ | āmravṛkṣaṃ samāśritya nirāśī niṣasāda saḥ || 1.184.10 || tāvad viditvā deveśī himālayasutā satī | yogabalaṃ samāsādya dhṛtvā rūpaṃ dvitīyakam || 11 || vyomni tatra samāgatyākāśavāṇyāvadat priyā | re brahma tvaṃ parabrahmakṛṣṇamūrteḥ kṛtodbhavaḥ || 12|| parabrahmasvarūpo’si gaccha golokadhāma yat | tatra sakhyo hyanantāste viharasva yathāsukham || 13|| kathamatrāraṇyabhūmau vṛthā śocasi dīnavat | tatra kṛṣṇastava kartā duḥkhaṃ te nāśayiṣyati || 14|| ityuktvā virarāmātha maunaṃ tiṣṭhati taddrume | śaṃkaro’pi tadāśrutya cakito’bhūd hṛdantare || 15|| vicārya bahudhā citte samutthāya ca tatsthalāt | jagāmākāśamārgeṇa golokaṃ dhāma śāśvatam || 16|| satī cāpi priyā śaṃbhoradṛśyā cūtasaṃsthitā | pṛṣṭhe pṛṣṭhe jagāmāpi golokaṃ dhāma śāśvatam || 17|| yāvatkumārikā cāsti tāvannecchati śaṃkaram | vivāhe saṃvṛte paścāt sadā cecchati śaṃkaram || 18|| iti kṛtvā gatā patyuḥ śāntyarthaṃ kṛṣṇamaṇḍalam | gatvā śaṃbhustu golokaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇanāma saḥ || 19|| svāgataṃ kṛtavān śaṃbhoḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | prayojanaṃ papracchāpi tadā novāca śaṃkaraḥ ||1.184.20||| lajjito’bhūt tato devī satī kamalalocanā | praviveśa harau kṛṣṇe śaṃkarānandakāriṇī || 21 || provāca hṛdayaṃ jñātvā harasya kṛṣṇasaṃsthitā | priyo’si me sadā śaṃbho satīṃ nānītavān katham |||22|| śrutvaitat kṛṣṇavacanaṃ netrāśrūṇi mumoca saḥ | śanairdhairyaṃ samālambya prāha satīpraṇāśanam ||23 || svasya vaidhuryamapi ca duḥkhadaṃ cānivedayat | kṛṣṇaḥ prāha tadā śaṃbhumāśvāsya sukhadaṃ vacaḥ ||24|| manmūrtestvaṃ samutpannaḥ satī manmūrtisaṃbhavā | mama putro’si deveśa cāgato’tra śubhaṃ kṛtam ||25|| golokaṃ yanmama sarvaṃ tatsarvaṃ ca tathāpi vai | yatheṣṭaṃ vasa goloke viharasva yatheṣṭakam ||26|| dāsyo dāsā aneke vai kariṣyanti tvadarhaṇā | sukhaṃ bhuṃkṣva sadā śaṃbho yatte manasi vartate ||27|| śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā kṛṣṇaṃ bhakto’smi nātha te’pyaham | tava bhogyaṃ mamābhogyaṃ vṛtaṃ me’sti sadā hare || 28|| tasmānnānena rūpeṇa vicariṣyāmi mādhava | yadi te’sti kṛpā śiṣye bhavāmi vṛṣabho’tra vai ||29|| gavāṃ madhye nivasāmi vihariṣyāmi goṣu vai | ityājñāṃ dehi me nātha kṛpāṃ kuru mayi prabho ||1.184.30|| yāvatkālaṃ prabhorājñā tāvattiṣṭhāmi cātra vai | paścāt punargamiṣyāmi himavadgṛhamuttamam ||3 1 || tathāstviti jagādainaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | kṛṣṇecchayā tadā śaṃbhurvatso yuvābhavad drutam ||32|| gāvaśca mohitā dṛṣṭvā surūpaṃ vatsamuttamam | lelihānā jihvayā taṃ siṣevire muhurmuhuḥ |||33|| jṛṃbhamāṇā dhāvamānāḥ sparśamagnāḥ siṣevire | dṛṣṭvā devī satī tāsu goṣu yogasamādhinā ||34|| praviveśa ca sarvāsu yāḥ sevante haraṃ vṛṣam | satīpraveśasāmarthyāt gāvastāḥ śaṃkaraṃ vṛṣam ||35|| sevante bahudhā premṇā yathā śaṃbhuḥ sukhī bhavet | evaṃ viharato goṣu tṛpto’bhūt vṛṣaśaṃkaraḥ ||36 || tṛptistu śāśvatī jātā yathā necchati gāṃ vṛṣaḥ | tataḥ satī gavāṃ dehād viniḥsṛtya ca mādhave ||37|| praviśyāha haraṃ gaccha himaśailaṃ satīpate | śaṃbhustadā vṛṣarūpaṃ vihāya śaṃkaro’bhavat || 38 || prapūjya parameśānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ hṛdaye smaran | vidhuraḥ pṛthivīṃ yātuṃ nākaronmana eva saḥ |||35|| kṛṣṇaḥ prāha tadā śaṃbho kiṃ te manasi vartate | brūhi dadāmi te sarvaṃ mahābhāgavatāya hi ||1.184.40 || śaṃbhuḥ prāha hare kṛṣṇa vidhuro yāmyahaṃ katham | vaidhuryaṃ duḥkhadaṃ sarvaṃ sarasaṃ nīrasāyate ||41 || tasmādatraiva tiṣṭhāmi yogī bhūtvā tavāntike | omityāha tadā kṛṣṇaḥ śaṃbhuścāpi vaṭāntike |||42|| niṣadyāvatatārāntaḥsamādhau dhyeyamādhave | na jānātyākūticiticāpalyavedanādikam ||43|| satī cāpi tadā śaṃbhoḥ pārśve rakṣatyavyaktikā | dvitīyena svarūpeṇādṛśyena śaṃkarapriyā ||44|| atha himālayaputrī pārvatī tapasi sthitā | śaṃbhuṃ pratīkṣate nityaṃ kadāgacchenmaheśvaraḥ ||45|| evaṃ pratīkṣate nityaṃ śaṃbhuścātrāgato bhavet | śaṃbhuḥ samādhimāpanno jāgartyeva nahi kvacit ||46 || samā bahvyastadā tatra vyatītāḥ parameśvarī | satī tvadhairyamāpannā kṛṣṇaṃ prāha na tā muhuḥ ||47|| kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa prāṇadātarbhaktaste brahmaṇi sthitaḥ | bahiḥ samādhernāyāti samā yānti nirarthikāḥ ||48|| ahaṃ tu pārvatī bhūtvā tapaḥ karomi parvate | pratīkṣe’haṃ mahādevaṃ kadāgacchenmamāntikam ||49|| tasmādenaṃ samādhestvaṃ bahirānaya mādhava | prāpaya yatra śailendro himavān vartate bhuvi ||1.184.50|| yatra mayā vivāhaḥ syāt tacchīghraṃ kuru keśava | satyuktāṃ prārthanāṃ śrutvā śaṃbhorjāgaraṇāya vai ||51|| prerayāmāsa gopīnāṃ rāsamaṇḍalameva saḥ | gopībhiḥ saṃkṛte rāse bahughoṣasamanvite ||52|| satataṃ vādyatālādinṛtyagītipramiśrite | racite’pi mahāyogī bahirnāyātsamādhitaḥ ||53|| gopyo devyaḥ pariśrāntā viramuḥ rāsakhelanāt | jagaduḥ śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śaṃbhurjāgarti naiva ca ||54|| nāsmākaṃ tatra sāmarthyaṃ pravartate mahāyatau | spṛśāmo nahi devaṃ taṃ dāhasya bhītito vayam ||55|| tasmāddeva yatheṣṭaṃ tvaṃ gatvotthāpaya yoginam | śrutvā kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ tatra gatvā paśyati śaṃkaram ||56|| kṛṣṇe svaṃ paṃcaviṃśākhyaṃ saṃvilīya sthitaṃ haram | utthāpayituṃ sūpāyaṃ klṛptayāmāsa keśavaḥ ||57|| tūrṇaṃ tu mohinīrūpaṃ yoginīdhāryameva saḥ | dadhāra ca svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ saṃyamaṃ kṛtavān śive ||58 || ātmānaṃ paṃcaviṃśaṃ taṃ samādherbahirānayat | tadā netre samunmīlya śaṃbhurdadarśa sannidhau ||59|| tāvatsurūpāṃ yuvatīṃ dadarśa mohinīṃ haraḥ | mohinyātmakakṛṣṇena hāvabhāvavilāsanaiḥ ||1.184.60|| ākarṣakamṛdusparśacūmbanālāpaliṃganaiḥ | saṃbhāvito mahādevo mumoha mānase manāk ||61 || satī tāvat sthitā tatra praveśamakaroddhare | viśeṣeṇa harastatra mohinyāṃ pramumoha ca ||62|| utthitaḥ sahasā bhrānto mohinīṃ dhartumicchati | tāvattāvanmohinī sā paścātpaścātpragacchati ||63||| brahmāṇḍe mohinī yāti haro’pyanuyayau ca tām | virajāṃ ca samullaṃghya tvāyātau mohinīharau ||64|| prakṛtyāvaraṇe tatra satī niṣkramya śaṃkarāt | pṛthaksthitābhavat tāvacchaṃkaro mohinīṃ prati ||65|| provāca yāsi kaṃ lokaṃ gaccha yaṃ prati gacchasi | nāhaṃ yāsye tvayā sākaṃ yoginā kiṃ prayojanam ||66|| ahaṃ sthāsye’tra śāntyāḍhye nirjane sukhade sthale | dhyāne magno bhaviṣyāmi gaccha yatra pragacchasi ||67|| na mayā yoginā kāryaṃ yuvatyā saha vidyate | yuvatīrnarakadvāraṃ yogavighnakarī hyati ||68|| viśvāso naiva kartavyo yoginā pramadājane | yogābhyāsādviyujyaiva saṃyojayati svātmani ||69|| svakāryaṃ sādhayatyeva parakāryaṃ dhunoti ca | jñānaṃ dhyānaṃ guṇānsarvān dhvaṃsayatyeva sarvathā ||1.184.70|| surūpaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvasvaṃ pradadāti sā | kintu cātmasukhaṃ brahmasukhamākṛṣya yāti vai ||71|| tasmātsakhyaṃ na vai kāryaṃ mayā vijānatādhunā | gaccha mohaprade ramye nāhaṃ sahacarastava || 72|| ityuktvā niṣasādaiva harastatra vinirjane | kṛṣṇaḥ prāha tadāveśayituṃ netramiṣeṇa tām ||7 || satī punaḥ praviveśa śaṃkare so’tha mohitaḥ | utthāyānujagāmāpi parirabdhuṃ tu mohinīm ||74|| mohinī tatsthalāt satyalokaṃ prati sasarpa vai | śīghraṃ jagmuḥ satyalokaṃ satī śaṃbhuśca mādhavaḥ ||75|| tatra brahmasabhāṃ tvālokayāmāsuḥ prapūritām | mohinīṃ pravilokyaite brahmādyāḥ kṣobhitā hyati ||76|| apsarasaśca sāvitrī devyaśca kṣobhitāḥ kṣaṇam | mohinyāstatparaṃ rūpaṃ rādhāto’pi pralaukikam ||77|| sabhā sarvā devadevyātmikā kṣubdhā dravaṃgatā | kimu vaktavyamevātra sākṣātkṛṣṇe pramohake ||78|| kṣaṇāntare tu mohinyā mohaḥ saṃkucitastadā | sabhājano’bhavat svasthaḥ śaṃbhoḥ svāgatamācarat ||79|| satī punaḥ śarvadehāt bahirnirgamya saṃsthitā | adṛśyā sarvadevaiśca viśaśrāmātha mohinī ||1.184.80 || jagāma śaṃkaraṃ spraṣṭuṃ nirvikāraṃ guṇākaram | tāvat tāṃ prāha śaṃbhurmā tavāsti me prayojanam ||8 1 || brahmāṇaṃ gaccha deveśi yadi tatra prayojanam | tāmājñāṃ lokanāthasya gṛhītvāgādajaṃ prati ||82 || savyahastaṃ brahmaṇaśca kaṇṭhe kṛtvā cucumba sā | sparśamātreṇa kāmādvai brahmasattvaṃ samaskhalat ||83|| brahmāsane tu tatsattvaṃ guptyarthaṃ vastramarditam | kaṇāḥ lakṣaṃ tato jātā siṃhāsanasamantataḥ ||84|| tebhyo jātāśca paryākhyā brahmasarasaḥ kanyakāḥ | apsarobhyaścātirūpāḥ striyo brahmasaro’bhidhāḥ ||85|| rūpalāvaṇyasaundaryaujjvalyasaumyaguṇākarāḥ | prodbhinnayauvanonmukhyaḥ sarvadaikatanusthitāḥ ||86|| ye ye chatradharā rājādhirājā devatottamāḥ | taddevīnāmupadevyastābhyaḥ pratyekamarpitāḥ ||87|| tāśca brahmasaraḥsṛṣṭiḥ paryaḥ proktā hi vedhasā | athāyaṃ śaṃkaro devo netre sammīlya saṃyame ||88|| antarjagāma tatraiva sabhāyāṃ brahmasannidhau | antarvṛttirapi bahirvṛttiḥ śṛṇoti śaṃkaraḥ ||89|| mohinī kathayāmāsa trailokyacittamohinī | nibodha sādho me vākyaṃ kāminyāste sukhapradam || 1.184.90|| tyaktvā kaṭhoratāṃ gupte bhaja māṃ sukhadāyinīm | tvaṃ vareṣu varaḥ sṛṣṭau varārhāhaṃ svayaṃvarā ||9 1|| vidagdhāyā vidagdhasya durlabho navasaṃgamaḥ | stanayoryugmamūrvorme sundaraṃ mukhapaṃkajam ||92|| hāsyabhrūbhaṃgasahitaṃ dṛṣṭvā ko na laset sukham | strīrasaḥ sukhasāraśca munīnāmabhivāñcchitaḥ ||92|| rasikāsukhasaṃbhogaḥ paryāptaścātidurlabhaḥ | tyaja dhyānaṃ suraśreṣṭha bhuṃkṣvemāṃ tapasaḥ phalam || 14|| svayamupasthitāṃ kāntāṃ na bhajedyo jitendriyaḥ | saḥ tasyāstu viniḥśvāsāgninā dagdho vinaśyati ||95|| śaṃbhuḥ śrutvā tathāvākyaṃ hitaṃ tathyamuvāca tām | śṛṇu kānte pravakṣyāmi pariṇāmasukhāvaham ||96|| kuladharmocitaṃ satyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tapasvinām | svayoṣiti yogyakāle ratirdharmaḥ praśasyate ||97|| yatra kvāpi labdhajanmā jano yaḥ parayoṣiti | ratiṃ yāti gṛhāttasya lakṣmīḥ ruṣṭā prayāti vai ||18|| grāhyā copasthitā nārī gṛhiṇāṃ na tapasvinā | tyāge doṣo gṛhasthānāṃ śāpabhākpāpabhāggṛhī || 99|| brahmā jagadvidhātāsti sastrīko na viraktimān | tyāge doṣo bhavettasya nāsmākaṃ tyāgināṃ kvacit || 1.184.100 || svabhāryāṃ tu parityajya yo gṛhṇāti parastriyam | yaśodhanāyuṣāṃ hānistasyātrāmutra cāgatiḥ || 101 || susampadā striyā sāmrājyena vā kiṃ tapasvinaḥ | niṣkāmena ca mattena mayā kiṃ te prayojanam || 10 2|| suveṣaṃ sundaraṃ puṣṭaṃ yuvānaṃ gaccha sundari | ityevaṃ tyajanaṃ śrutvā provāca vinayānvitā || 10 3|| cārucampakavarṇābhaḥ kandarpasamasundaraḥ | tapaḥprabhāvāt sastrīkaḥ sughaṭaḥ sammataḥ striyāḥ || 104|| tvayā vinānyaṃ kaṃ yāmi ko vāsti tvatparaḥ pumān | mādṛśī tvāṃ parityajya kva vā gacchet smarāturā || 105|| śīghraṃ māṃ bhaja yogīndra dagdhāṃ kāmāgninā parām | na cecchāpaṃ pradāsyāmi satvaraṃ vā gṛhāṇa mām || 1 06|| dagdhāḥ prāṇā mano dagdhaṃ svātmā ca dahyate’dhunā | navaśṛṃgārapīyūṣapānanirvāṇatāṃ kuru || 1 07|| svāntarduḥkhena duḥkhārtā yā yaṃ śapati niścitam | śāpaṃ khaṇḍayituṃ śakto na vidhātā na śaṃkaraḥ || 1 08|| samuttamābhāṃ māṃ paśya pradagdhāṃ madanānalaiḥ | prodbhinnanavasārāṃ cākṣatāṃ kenāpyadharṣitām || 109|| sindūrabinduṃ dadhatīṃ kastūrībindunā saha | cārucampakavarṇābhāṃ satataṃ sthirayauvanām || 1.184.110 || bṛhannitambayugalāṃ pīnaśroṇipayodharām | śaratpārvaṇaśubhrāṃśuprabhāmuṣṭakarānanām || 111 || sūkṣmavastraparīdhānāṃ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitām | sarvaṃ mohayituṃ śaktāṃ kaṭākṣaireva līlayā || 112 || tvādṛśaṃ kāmayamānāṃ gajendramadagāminīm | pulakāṃcitasarvāṃgīṃ mūrchāsanmukhayāyinīm || 113 || gṛhāṇa tvaritaṃ tvaṃ māṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukām | ityevaṃ mohinī śarvaṃ vacanairmohayatyapi || 114 || śivo mohaṃ na cāpnoti dhyānaṃ naiva vimuñcati | tāvattatra samāgatya raṃbhayāpsarasoditam || 1 15|| śṛṇu cāli yuvayogisamākarṣaṇamantraṇām | yadi te’sti mano yuvapuruṣe rantumarthanā || 116 || kāmadevasahāyena kuru kāryaṃ nijepsitam | brahmāyaṃ dāsyati kāmaṃ sopakaraṇamarthanāt || 117 || yadyatra nāsti te rāgo’nyaṃ yuvānaṃ vimārgaya | kṛtvā veṣamapūrvaṃ vā pūrvaṃ prayujya manmatham || 118 || tena sārdhaṃ svayaṃ gatvā mohaṃ kuru ca mohini | jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaraṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇātmakam || 119||| vinā kāmasahāyena kā śaktā jetumīśvaram | atra pārśve kṛtāvāsaṃ kāmaṃ saṃvraja mohini || 1.184.120 || sadyaḥ sahāyo bhavitā dayāluryoṣitāṃ prabhuḥ | ityuktā mohinī tatra gatā yatra smaragṛham || 121 || kāmo’pi mohito dṛṣṭvā mohinīṃ kṣobhamāptavān | skhalitaḥ sahasā kāmaḥ kṣaṇaṃ jaḍa ivābhavat || 1 22|| tatsattvāt dvau sutau jātau śṛṃgārakavasantakau | mohinīsamarūpāḍhyau sarvasaundaryabhājanau || 123 || drāgeva yauvanodbhedau kāmasāhāyyadau sutau | jātau tau sahanītvaiva kāmo’pi mohinīkṛte || 1 24|| sahāyārthaṃ prārthitaḥ san samāyāt yatra śaṃkaraḥ | dadarśa saṃyamasthaṃ ca mohinī yoginaṃ haram || 125 || tameva mohitaṃ kartuṃ samārebhe puraḥsthi tā | kṣaṇaṃ nanarta ruciraṃ sugānena kṣaṇaṃ jagau || 126|| satīsambandhisaṃgītaṃ bhaktānāṃ cittamohakam | vinetā jagatāṃ tasyāḥ śrutvā saṃgītamīpsitam || 1 27|| pulakāṃcitasarvāṃgo netre pronmīlya paśyati | kāmāviṣṭo harastasyāṃ mumoha sāśrulocanaḥ || 128 || dṛṣṭvā mugdhaṃ paṃcavaktraṃ mohinī hṛṣṭamānasā | kalāpramāṇaṃ bhāvaṃ ca cakāra tatra līlayā || 129|| svāṃgāni darśayāmāsa smerabhrūbhaṃgapūrvakam | kā lajjā tasya saṃsāre yaḥ kāmahatacetanaḥ || 1.184.130 || tathāpi śaṃkarastatra netre sammīlya dhairyavān | virato yogamārgeṇa na dadarśa tu mohinīm || 131 || kintu sā mohinī śaṃbhościtte samāruroha vai | dhyāne’pi dṛśyate cāntaḥkaraṇe mohakāriṇī || 1 32|| bahiḥsthitaṃ tadā kāmaṃ prairayat mohinī kṣaṇam | sarvendriyāṇāṃ pravaraṃ viṣṇoraṃśaṃ ca mānasam || 1 33|| ratibījaṃ paṃca bāṇaṃ śaśvadyoṣidadhiṣṭhitam | sugandhivātasacivaṃ madhuśṛṃgāravegitam || 1 34|| athāyaṃ kāmadevo’pi sajjībhūto harīcchayā | cakāra śarasandhānamantarīkṣe sthitaḥ svayam || 135|| mantrapūtaṃ mahāstraṃ ca cikṣepa śaṃkaropari | babhūva caṃcalaḥ śaṃbhuḥ kāmāstreṇa tu kāmukaḥ || 1 36|| kṣaṇaṃ nirīkṣaṇaṃ cakre mohinyāsye punaḥpunaḥ | sasmite vakranayane kāmabhāvapravarṣiṇi || 1 37|| etasminnantare kāmaḥ samayajñaḥ suyogavit | āvirbhūya paṃcabāṇānnicikṣepa ca śaṃkare || 1 38|| sammohanaṃ tu prathamaṃ sampravegaṃ dvitīyakam | unmattavīryaṃ tṛtīyaṃ jvalajjvara caturthakam || 1 39|| paṃcamaṃ cetanaharaṃ prakṣipya vyomamārgataḥ | kiṃkarānpreṣayāmāsa kokilāṃ ca vasantakam || 1.184.140|| bhramarān gandhavātaṃ ca svayaṃ cāpi gato hare | puṃskokilaḥ kalaṃ rāvamuvāca tatsamīpataḥ || 141 || ṣaṭpadaḥ sundaraṃ sūkṣmaṃ juguñja purataḥ sthitaḥ | śaśvad vavau gandhavaho mando’tiśītalaḥ priye || 142|| satataṃ muditastatra babhrāma ca madhuḥ svayam | kāmaśca mānase sthitvā tadvikāraṃ cakāra ha || 143|| pulakāṃcitasarvāṃgo babhūva yogiśaṃkaraḥ | dadarśa mohinībhāvaṃ vihasya ca punaḥ punaḥ || 144|| provāca vakranayanā kāmāstrahatacetanā | iṅgitenaiva nārīṇāṃ sadyo mattaṃ bhavenmanaḥ || 145|| karotyākṛṣya saṃbhogaṃ yaḥ sa evottamo mataḥ | nāryāḥ sphuṭamabhiprāyaṃ jñātvā hyākāritastu yaḥ || 146|| paścāt karoti śṛṃgāraṃ puruṣaḥ sa tu madhyamaḥ | kāmārtayā striyā yaścākārito vai punaḥ punaḥ || 147|| dhṛtvā prasahya saṃliptaḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ sa pumānmataḥ || tayā na lipto rahasi sa klībo na pumānaho || 148|| uttiṣṭha jagatāṃ nātha pāraṃ kuru smarārṇave | nimagnāṃ dustare ghore karṇadhāra bhayānake || 149|| satataṃ tvanmanaskāṃ māṃ dāsīṃ janmani janmani | krīṇīhi ratipaṇyenāmūlyaratnena satvaram || 1.184.15 0|| ityuktvā mohinī tatra samīpamabhisṛtya vai | vicakarṣa karaṃ śaṃbhoḥ sasmitā kāmavihvalā || 151 || śaṃbhuścāpi samutthāya parirabdhuṃ samicchati | tāvatprāha satī kṛṣṇaṃ nayainaṃ himavatsthalam || 152|| mohinīśaḥ karagrāhaṃ kṛtvaikāntaṃ sthalāntaram | jigamiṣurapasarpan cāgre yātyanuśaṃkaraḥ || 153|| kṣaṇāntare mohinī taṃ nināya himavatsthalam | kāmajaḍaṃ ca nirlepaṃ kiñcillepaṃ haraṃ hariḥ || 154|| kailāsasannidhau nānāvṛkṣavallīsamanvite | mandasugandhaśaityāḍhyavāyuvyāpte suśītale || 155|| supuṣpāñcitaśākhānāṃ nikuṃje tu manohare | prasravajjalajharaṇāntike nirjanake sthale || 156|| mohinī prāha śaṃbhuṃ vai kānta smaraśayī bhava | ehyatra ratibhedairvā ramāvo bahubhedataḥ || 1517|| netramiṣeṇa ca satīṃ prāha kujāntarasthitā | paśya līlāṃ bhagavatordvayoranupamāṃ sakhi || 158|| ityuktvā mohinī puṣpaśayyāṃ mṛdvīṃ cakāra vai | śaṃbhuṃ dhṛtvā vakṣasi sve suṣvāpa kāmasundarī || 159|| śaṃbhukāmottejakāni sādhanāni smarastadā | susajjāni preritāni cakāra sarvato diśi || 1.184.16 0|| parirebhe mohinīṃ saḥ kṛṣṇarūpāṃ susundarīm | kāmabāṇahataḥ śaṃbhuḥ kṣubhito dhairyavarjitaḥ || 161 || yāvattu saṃgamaṃ kartumicchati tāvatā bahiḥ | vīryaṃ caskanda vai sarvaṃ niroddhaṃu na śaśāka saḥ || 162|| sarvaṃ tu pātayāmāsa puṣpaśayyātmake sthale | mohinī drāk samutthāyādṛśyatāṃ prāpya tatsthalāt || 16 3|| satīṃ kāmaṃ parirabhyājñāpya gantuṃ svakaṃ sthalam | golokaṃ prāpa śrīkṛṣṇo bhūtvā gopīgaṇānvitam || 164|| śaṃkaraścakito bhūtvā jñātvā kṛṣṇaviceṣṭitam | nāvamānaṃ svakaṃ mene yayau kailāsameva vai || 165|| satyalokāccaritraṃ tat draṣṭuṃ saptarṣayastadā | āsansamāgatāstatra dṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ rahaḥsthitāḥ || 166 || rāmakāyārthamevaitadvīryaṃ patre nidhāya te | saṃrarakṣuḥ patrapuṭāntare nirvighnatā yathā || 167|| etasminnantare putrī kesarasyāṃjanī śubhā | araṇye nirjane tatra tapaḥ karoti duṣkaram || 168|| putrecchayā tapaḥkartryai vyomavāṇyā samīritam | tapasaste phalaṃ putro vāyubalo bhaviṣyati || 169|| vāyudevaḥ svayaṃ cātrāgatya bījaṃ pradāsyati | niḥśaṃkaṃ tadgṛhāṇa tvaṃ tāpasyapi śubhānane || 1.184.170 || na te tatra bhaveddoṣo rāmakāryaṃ yato’sti tat | akṣatatve’pi te putro bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ || 171|| tathāstviti jagādaiṣā drutaṃ nanāma taddiśi | vyomavāṇī nivṛttābhūt sā tu bījaṃ pratīkṣate || 172|| tāvad vāyuśca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣubhito’tīva rūpataḥ | dṛṣṭvā tu nirjane kanyāmāgato divyarūpadhṛk || 173 || saptarṣayo’pi tatraiva cāgatā daivayogataḥ | vāyurlajjāṃ gatastatra tān ṛṣīnsaṃvilokya vai || 174|| tadā maharṣayaḥ prāhurdevakāryārthamatra vai | tvayā kāryaṃ mahatkāryaṃ rāmakāryārthameva yat || 175|| gṛhāṇa śāṃkaraṃ bījaṃ gacchāṃjanīṃ tu kaisarīm | svastho bhūtvā tadā vāyurvīryaṃ jagrāha śāṃkaram || 176|| patrapuṭaṃ samuddhāṭya vāyuḥ paśyati tadyadā | tāvat vahnisamaṃ dīptaṃ jvālābhūtaṃ puṭāntarāt || 177|| ūṣmābhūtaṃ bhavatśīghraṃ vāyudehe viveśa ha | vāyuścāpi tadādhātuṃ na saṃśakto babhūva ha || 178|| prajajvālodare dehe prādravat tatsthalātsthalam | tanmārge cāṃjanī yatra tāpasī saṃsthitā sthale || 179|| pṛthvyāṃ khātaṃ ca ākaṇṭhaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭhati sarvadā | upari śādvalaṃ śītaṃ bhūtalaṃ yatra dṛśyate || 1.184.180 || dṛśyate na ca deho’syā mastakaṃ dṛśyate’kalam | vāyustu kesarī bhūtvā prādhāvat cāpalastadā || 181 || vāyurdhāvansthale tatra patitaḥ pādasaṃskhalāt | śītaṃ ca śādvalaṃ jñātvā hyāśliṣṭo mastakaṃ ca tat || 182|| liṃgaṃ vāyordaivayogādaṃjanyāḥ karṇamāviśat | vīryaṃ ca śāṃbhavaṃ vāyusaṃsthaṃ yat tattu sarvathā || 183 || skhalitaṃ cāṃjanīkarṇāntare tatkaṇṭhato hyadhaḥ | avātarat samagraṃ ca garbhakoṣṭhe gataṃ sthiram || 184|| daivecchayābhavattadvai garbhaṃ dadhāra kaisarī | aṃjanī ca śarīre sā prajajvāla viśeṣataḥ || 185|| bhūmerbahirvinirgatya saṃsthitā śādvale jale | kṣaṇāntare samutpannaḥ putro daivaprabhāvavān || 186|| meṣasūrye caturdaśyāṃ citrānakṣatrayogake | suvarṇamukharīnīre prādurāsānilātmajaḥ || 187|| vāyutulyo bale śaṃbhusamaścaiśvaryasiddhiṣu | kṛṣṇatulyo brahmacarye ṛṣiścārādhane tathā || 188|| ākṛtau vānaratulyastapasvī cāṃjanīsamaḥ | rūpe kāmasamo bhaikṣye vasantartusamastathā || 189|| kīśajātisamaḥ sarvauṣadhijñāne viśeṣataḥ | tāpasīsadṛśaḥ śānto nirdvandve saṃyamī yathā || 1.184.190 || sainye’raṇyasamo mohinīsamaścirajīvane | romṇi vasantasadṛśo nakheṣu vanisannibhaḥ || 19 1|| bhrūkuṭau rudrasadṛśastanau himādrisadṛśaḥ | rākṣasānāṃ yathākāmaṃ garvabhaṃjanakārakaḥ || 192||| hṛdaye śādvalasamo dārḍhye pṛthvīsamaḥ sadā | rakṣaṇe puṭatulyaśca vīratve vīryasatprabhaḥ || 193 || bhūtādijvālane tvagnisadṛśaḥ saṃbabhūva saḥ | tatraiva samaye mātā hanuṃ vīkṣya tu lambinīm || 194|| hanumānitināmnaiva samājuhāva taṃ śiśum | vavṛdhe tatkṣaṇādeva parvataprāya eva saḥ || 195|| jaharṣa mātā nitarāṃ dṛṣṭvā balaparākrame | prātaḥ svamātaraṃ prāha prāṃjaliḥ śiśurūpataḥ || 196|| kṣudhā me bādhate mātardehi jāṭharaśāntikṛt | śiśuṃ cāṃke nidhāyaivāpāyayat stanyameva tam || 197|| tathāpi na kṣudhā śāntā dadarśa phalamambare | ravibimbaṃ tadā netumākāśe cauḍuyatprage || 198|| devaprārthanayā taṃ so’tyajat jñātvā raviṃ suram | prāpya divyānbhaktimiśrāndattānvarānsurarṣibhiḥ || 199|| svajananyantikaṃ prāgādatha so’ti praharṣitaḥ | hanumān sarvamācakhyau tasyai tadvṛttamādarāt ||1.184.20 0|| tadājñayā tato dhīraḥ sarvavidyādiśevadheḥ | sūryātpapāṭha kīśaḥ saḥ gatvā nityaṃ tadantikam ||20 1|| mātre ca prājalirbhūtvā sevārthaṃ prārthayanmuhuḥ | mātā prāha tu me vāso vaikuṇṭhe ca yathā bhavet ||202|| tathā sevāṃ kuru putra nānyanme rocate’tra vai | putraḥ prāha tadā mātarniṣīd skandha eva me ||20 3||| nayāmyanena dehena vaikuṇṭhaṃ tvāṃ tu śāśvatam | samāruroha mātā tatskandhaṃ kapirvimānavat ||204|| vyomni balātsamuḍḍīya prathamaplavanena saḥ | sūryamullaṃghya pāścātyapādenāpīḍya taṃ ravim || 2 05|| dvitīyaplavane dhruvamullaṃghyāpīḍya taṃ dhruvam | tṛtīyaplavane satyaloke brahmasabhāṃ gataḥ || 206 || caturthaplavane gaṃgādvāraṃ tvaṇḍakaṭāhakam | bhittvā pṛthvīṃ padāpīḍya vegājjalānalānantare || 207 || vaikuṇṭhaṃ dvitīyaṃ dhāma prapede sa mahābalaḥ | mātaraṃ tatra rāmasya caraṇe’rpayya bhaktitaḥ || 208 || prāpya rāmāya namo vai mantraṃ mālāṃ ca vaiṣṇavaḥ | bhūtvā prāpya varān rāmāvatāradāsyabodhakān || 209 || samāgacchatpunaḥ pṛthvīṃ padā tatāḍa saḥ śanim | janmakāle vakradṛṣṭyā paśyantaṃ duḥkhadaṃ tadā || 1.184.210 || śanistatpallatāghātātpapāta pṛthivītale | brahmacārī kapiḥ soyaṃ nārīṃ na spṛśatīti saḥ || 211 || śanirnārīsvarūpaṃ tu dhṛtvā dudrāva cāmbare | tāvaddhanumatā mūrdhnaḥ keśānākṛṣya pātitaḥ || 212 || prasahya sa śaniḥ svasya vaśe syāditi nityaśaḥ | pattale marditaḥ samyak yāvaccandradivākarau || 213 || pādayoḥ sa natiṃ kṛtvā prārthayāmāsa vāyujam | vimocanāya naijaṃ ca gṛhaṃ saṃgamanāya ca || 214 || tadā prāha kapīśastaṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvā dvitīyakam | gaccha svagolakaṃ cātra pratijñāya tu sarvathā || 215|| yatrāsti hanumatstotraṃ hanumatpūjanādikam | tatra tatra tasya śanidṛṣṭikṛtā pīḍā na saṃbhavet || 21 6|| nārīrūpaṃ sadā te’stu mama pādatalārditam | yatrāsti hanumatpādastatrākiṃcitkaraḥ śaniḥ || 217 || nārīrūpasya śāṭhyasya phalaṃ te’stu ca nigrahaḥ | pannatiste nāma kurve sadāstu mama pattale || 218 || gaccha dvitīyarūpeṇa grahastho bhava sūryaja | sūryaputraṃ parijñāya na tvā badhnāmi jīvataḥ || 219 || mama chāyāṃ parityajyānyatra parākramī bhava | iti kṛtvā pratijñāṃ sa śanaiścaro grahaṃ gataḥ || 1.184.220 || oṃ namo hanumate duḥkhabhaṃjanāya kṣaḥ phaṭ svāhā | iti ṣoḍaśavarṇātmamantraṃ jayati nityaśaḥ || 221 || na tasya duṣṭagrahajā pīḍā tu jāyate kvacit | himālaye yatra janma sa tatra kadalīvane || 222 || sarvadā cirajīvī sa hanumān vasati dhruvaḥ | rāmadāsyaṃ prakurvansa rāmāgre nivasatyapi || 223 || iti te kathitaṃ devi hanumajjanma śaṃkarāt | āyuṣyasukhadaṃ pāpanāśakaṃ balabhaktidam ||224||| śrīkṛṣṇamohinījanyaṃ duḥkhaghnaṃ paṭhanācchravāt | kīrtanātpāvanakaraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ||225|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne himālaye vidhuraśaṃkarasya satīsmaraṇaṃ vyomavāṇyā golākaṃ gatvā vṛṣabharūpeṇa viharaṇaṃ satyāḥ himādrau śaṃbhvānayanāya kṛṣṇaprārthanā mohinīrūpakṛṣṇena saha śaṃbhoḥ satyalokāgamanaṃ mohinīṃ dṛṣṭvā skhalitasya brahmaṇo vīryāllakṣabrahmasarasaḥ puryo jātāḥ skhalitasya kāmadevasya tu śṛṃgārakavasantakau jātau mohinī śaṃkareṇa saha himādrāvāgatya śaṃbhuṃ parirabdhā śaṃbhudhātoḥ skhalitāt vāyupraviṣṭāt vānararūpavāyunāṃjanī karṇapraviṣṭāt hanumadutpattiḥ saḥ sūryaṃ phalaṃ jñātvā dadhāra aṃjanīṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ nināya tatra vaiṣṇavo bhūtvāgacchan śaniṃ padā tāḍayan pātayāmāsa panna tinārīrūpaṃ pattale rarakṣa cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 184 ||
<1.185> śrīlakṣmīruvāca hare himālayaṃ prāpte pārvatyā śaṃbhulabdhaye | kṛtaṃ kiṃ śaṃbhunā cāpi kiṃ kṛtaṃ tad vadasva me || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca satī tepe harārthaṃ ca harastepe satīkṛte | dvayoryatno’bhavadvegānmahālakṣmi nibodha me || 2 || kām̐ścid gaṇavarānśāntānnandyādīnavagṛhya saḥ | gaṃgāvatāramagamat himavatprasthamīśvaraḥ || 3 || yatra gaṃgā brahmalokātprathamaṃ patitā girau | tapaḥprāraṃbhamakarot sthitvā tatra vaśī haraḥ || 4 || ekāgraṃ cintayāmāsa svātmānaṃ brahma yatparam | dhyānasthitā gaṇāḥ kecitkecitsevāparāstadā || 5 || ke’pi maunaparāścāsan dvārapāḥ kecanābhavat | etasminnantare tatra jagāma himabhūdharaḥ || 6 | praṇanāma prabhuṃ rudraṃ tuṣṭāva ca kṛtāṃjaliḥ | devadeva mahādeva yogirūpa namo’stu te || 7 | nirguṇāya saguṇāya līlākārāya te namaḥ | paripūrṇāya vikṛtirahitāya ca te namaḥ || 8 | śāntāya sukharūpāya brahmaṇe te namonamaḥ | tapaḥphalapradātre te tapaḥsthāya namonamaḥ || 9 | abahirbhogakārāya namaste paramātmane | paramātmasvarūpāya te satīpataye namaḥ || 1.185.10 | bhāgyodayaphalaṃ me’tra tvāgatastvaṃ mama gṛhe | sanāthaṃ kṛtavān māṃ tvaṃ prabho sādhusukhaprad || 11 | adya me saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ mama | adya me saphalaṃ sarvaṃ yadatra tvaṃ samāgataḥ || 1 2 | jñātvānanyaṃ tava dāsaṃ cājñāṃ dehi yadi prabho | tvatsevāṃ tu sadā prītyā kuryāṃ dāsyavidhānataḥ || 13 | śrutvā netre samunmīlya dṛṣṭvāgrasthaṃ himālayam | prītyā provāca śailendraṃ dhyānayogasthito haraḥ || 1 4|| tava pṛṣṭhe tapastaptuṃ rahasyamahamāgataḥ | yathā na kopi nikaṭe samāyādvai tathā kuru || 15 ||. tvamāśrayo muniyogiyatisanyāsināṃ tathā | devarṣiyakṣagandharvarākṣasadvijanākinām || 16 || tapodhāmā mahātmāsi gaṃgāpūto’si sarvadā | sadā paropakārī ca girīṇāmadhipo mahān || 17| ahaṃ tapaścarāmyatra gaṃgāvataraṇe sthale | nirvighnaṃ me tapo bhūyātsāhāyyaṃ sevanaṃ kuru || 18 | śrutvā śailastadā śaṃbhuṃ praṇayādidamabravīt | kariṣye sarvathā rakṣāṃ vighnaṃ tapasi mā bhavet || 19 | nirvighnaṃ kuru deveśa svatantraḥ parama tapaḥ | kariṣye’haṃ tathā sevāṃ dāsavanniyatasthitaḥ || 1.185.20 | devendrādadhikaṃ manye svamanugrahabhājanam | aprāpyaścogratapasā sa tvaṃ svayamupasthitaḥ || 21 || no’nyo’sti puṇyavānmatto yatpṛṣṭhe tapasi sthitaḥ | gacchāmyājñāpālanārthaṃ prasanno bhava sarvadā || 22 || ityuktvā svasthalaṃ gatvāmātyādīnāha sarvathā | yāntu gaṃgāvataraṇe parito rakṣaṇāya vai || 23 || tapaḥ karoti deveśo matprasthe dhyānasaṃsthitaḥ | tatrādyaprabhṛti kopi mā yātu svaḥ paropi vā || 24|| gamiṣyati janaḥ kaścittatra cettaṃ mahākhalam | daṇḍayiṣye viśeṣeṇa śaṃkarasya kṛte’pyaham || 25|| ājñāpyātha svayaṃ śailaḥ satpuṣpaphalasaṃcayam | samādāya svatanayāsahito’gāt śivāntikam |||26|| natvā cāgre phalādīni nidhāya prāha śaṃkaram | bhagavan tanayā me tvāṃ sevituṃ pārvatī satī || 27|| sakhībhyāṃ sahitānītā sevane’styutsukā tava | anujānīhi tāṃ nātha mayi te yadyanugrahaḥ || 28 || atha tāṃ śaṃkaro’paśyatprathamārūḍhayauvanām | phullendīvarapuṣpābhāṃ pūrṇacandrasamānanām || 29 || surūpāṃ ca viśālākṣīṃ svarṇakāntisamujjvalāma | rājīvakuḍmalaprakhyaghanapīnadṛḍhastanīm || 1.185.30 || tanumadhyāṃ sthūlaśroṇīṃ trivalīyukkṛśodarīm | sthalapadmapratīkāśapādasaundaryarājitām || 31 || tapaso bhraśane śaktāṃ komalāṃ kāmavardhinīm | dṛṣṭvā nyamīlayannetre śīghraṃ dadhyau svarūpakam || 32|| prāha śailastadā śaṃbhuṃ paśya māṃ śaraṇāgatam | na tvāṃ jānanti śāstrāṇyatītaṃ vāṅmanasoḥ sadā || 33 || atadvyāvṛttitastvāṃ cābhidhatte śrutirīśvarī | yeṣu kṛpā tvayā kṣiptā bhaktā jānanti te haram || 34|| sabhāgyo’haṃ prasādātte matvā dāsaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru | anayā sutayā svāmin seviṣye’nvahamādarāt ||35 || śrutvā netre samunmīlya devadevo’bravīttadā | kumārīṃ sadane tyaktvā sevāṃ kuru mamācala || 3 6|| śailaḥ prāha kathaṃ putrīṃ nānayeyaṃ vada prabho | śaṃbhuḥ prāha sadā nārī māyā vighnaṃ tapasvinām || 37|| tapasvī yuvatīsaṃgāttapasā bhraśyati dhruvam | atastapasvinā śaila na kāryaṃ strīprasaṃjanam || 38 || śrutvaivaṃ ca tadā natvā bhavānī vākyamabravīt | yayā śaktyā tvayā rudra tapaḥ saṃkriyate’dhunā || 39 || sā śaktiḥ prakṛtirmūlā tvayi tiṣṭhati sā satī | tvāṃ vinā tu kathaṃ cārcyo vandyo dhyeyo bhaviṣyasi ||1.185.40 || śaṃbhuḥ prāha prakṛtiṃ tāṃ vināśya tapasā tataḥ | sthāsyāmyahaṃ parabrahmasvarūpo’vikṛtaḥ sukhī || 41 || kālyuvāca tadā śaṃbhuṃ prakṛtidhvaṃsanasthitiḥ | sā kiṃ prakṛtiranyā vā vicāryaiva samucyatām || 42 || tadānīmapi sā brāhmī sthitiḥ prakṛtirucyate | idānīṃ śāṃbhavī sā ca sthitiḥ prakṛtirucyate ||43 || prakṛteḥ paramaścet tvaṃ kimarthaṃ tapase tapaḥ | prakṛterantaraścet tvaṃ kathaṃ satīṃ niṣedhasi ||44|| kiṃ bahūktena yogīśa yadarthaṃ tapase tapaḥ | pratyakṣaṃ balavatsarvapramāṇebhyastathātra tat||||45|| sa cāhaṃ puruṣo’si tvaṃ mayaiva saguṇo bhavān | māṃ vinā tvaṃ nirīhaḥ sanna kiṃcitkartumarhasi ||46 || evaṃsthite na bhettavyaṃ matsānnidhye’pi nirguṇa | śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā devīṃ yadyahaṃ brahma nirguṇaḥ ||47|| nirlepaścāpyakartā cābhoktā hyātmā niraṃjanaḥ | tadā sevāṃ kuru saumye tvaṃ kariṣyasi kinnu mām ||48 || pitrā bināpi sā kālī sakhībhyāṃ saha nityaśaḥ | sevāyāṃ vartate nityaṃ sā śaṃbhoranapāyinī ||49|| idameva mahaddhairyaṃ dhīrāṇāṃ sutapasvinām | vighnasvarūpayā cāpi kṛtavighnairna hanyate ||1.185.50 || kālī prakṣālya caraṇau papau taccaraṇodakam | vahniśaucena vastreṇa cakre tadrātramārjanam ||51 || ṣoḍaśabhirupacāraiḥ sampūjya vidhivaddharam | punaḥ punaḥ praṇamyaiva yayau kvacitpiturgṛham ||52 || bahule samaye yāte sasakhī śaṃkarāśrame | vitene sundara gānaṃ sutālaṃ smaravardhanam ||53 || visismiye vīkṣamāṇā sakāmā śaṃkaraṃ prabhum | śaṃkaro’pi kvacittāṃ saṃcintayatyeva sarvathā ||54 || mahālāvaṇyanicayāṃ sarvadā nikaṭasthitām | cintayamānāṃ satataṃ śaṃbhuṃ patidhiyācyutam ||55 || etasminnantare devāḥ śakrādyā munayastathā | brahmādyāśca mahāduṣṭatārakeṇa prapīḍitāḥ ||56 || kāmaṃ saṃpreṣya ca tayoryogaṃ kārayituṃ muhuḥ | akurvanbahudhā yatnaṃ haraḥ kintu na cukṣubhe ||57|| śivavīryasamutpannaṃ putraṃ vinā na tārakaḥ | mahāsuro vinaśyedvai vicintyendraḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||58 || sasmāra smaramatyarthaṃ savasantaṃ ratipriyam | āgatastatkṣaṇātkāmaḥ savasanto ratipriyaḥ ||59|| provāca prāṃjaliḥ śakraṃ dāso’yaṃ samupasthitaḥ | indraḥ prāha vijayasva sanmitraṃ tvaṃ mahānmama || 1.185.60 || jayārthaṃ me dvayaṃ śastraṃ vajraṃ kāmaśca sarvadā | vajraṃ tu niṣphalaṃ syādvai tvaṃ tu naiva kadācana || 61 || dātuḥ parīkṣā durbhikṣe raṇe śūrasya jāyate | āpatkāle tu mitrasyāśaktau strīṇāṃ kulasya ca || 62 || kṣamāyāḥ saṃkaṭe prāpte satyasya tu parokṣake || susnehasya mahatkārye nānyathā tatparīkṣaṇam || 63 || vyarthaṃ ca bahu yo brūte sa kiṃ kāryaṃ kariṣyati | sarvasurādisaṃprārthya kārya caitatkuru smara || 64|| smaraḥ prāha tadendraṃ vai grahītuṃ tvatpadaṃ yadi | tapaḥ karoti kaściccet pātayāmi kṣaṇāntare || 65 || strīkaṭākṣairbhraṃśayāmi kṣaṇāt devarṣidānavān | vajraṃ śastraṃ tathāstraṃ te dūre’stu mayyupasthite || 66 || brahmāṇaṃ śaṃkaraṃ viṣṇuṃ pātayeyaṃ kṣaṇāntare | anyeṣāṃ gaṇanā nāsti madvaśā māyikākṛtiḥ ||6 7|| paṃcaiva mṛdavo bāṇāste ca puṣpamayā mama | cāpastridhā puṣpamayaḥ śiṃjinī bhramarārjitā ||68 || balaṃ suyuvatī me’sti vasantaḥ sacivaḥ sadā | ahaṃ paṃcabalo devo mitraṃ mama sudhākaraḥ || 69 || senāpatiśca śṛṃgāro hāvabhāvāśca sainikāḥ | tāni me mṛduśastrāṇi mṛduścāpyahameva vai ||1.185.7 0 || yadyena pūryate kāryaṃ dhīmām̐stat tena sādhayet | mama yogyaṃ tu yatkāryaṃ tatra māṃ vai niyojaya ||7 1 || śrutvā mahendrastaṃ prāha brahmaṇābhihitaṃ purā | tārakākhyamahādaityamaraṇaṃ śāṃbhavātsutāt ||72|| bhaviṣyatīti śaṃbhośca sevāyāṃ pārvatī satī | vartate ca rucistasyāṃ yathā śarvasya jāyate ||7 3 || tathā kāryaṃ tvayā kāryaṃ sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ vinaṃkṣyati | omityuktvā ca natvā ca yayau smaraḥ samaṇḍalaḥ |||74 || sa tu prāpyākarot cintāṃ kāryasyopāyapūrvikām | mahātmāno hi niṣkampā manasteṣāṃ sudurjayam || 75|| tadādāveva saṃkṣubhya tatasteṣāṃ jayo bhavet | krodhakrūratarāsaṃgādbhīṣaṇerṣyāmahāsakhī ||76|| cāpalyānmūrdhni vidhvastadhairyādhāramahābalā | tāmasya viniyokṣyāmi manaso vikṛtiṃ puraḥ ||77|| pidhāya dhairyadvārāṇi santoṣamapakṛṣya ca | kāmatṛṣṇāṃ samudbhāvya praviśāmi tato hare ||78|| cintayitveti madano jagāma haramandiram | dadarśa śaṃkaraṃ kāmaḥ kramaprāptāntikaḥ śanaiḥ ||79 || mohakaḥ sa madhoścādau dharmān vistārayan sthitaḥ | vasantasya tadā dharmaḥ prasasāra ca sarvataḥ ||1.185.8 0 || vanāni ca praphullāni puṣpāṇi cūtaśākhinām | aśokānāṃ ca kalikāḥ virejuḥ saurabhānvitāḥ ||8 1|| kairavāṇi ca puṣpāṇi bhramarākalitāni ca | babhūburmadanāveśakarāṇi ca viśeṣataḥ ||82|| sukāmoddīpanakaraṃ kokilākalakūjitam | āsīdapisuramyaṃ ca manoharamatipriyam ||83|| kāmoddīpakarāḥ śabdā dvirephāṇāṃ tadābhavan | candrasya viśadā kāntirvikīrṇābhūtsamantataḥ ||84|| kāmināṃ kāminīnāṃ ca sābhavat śītadīpikā | mārutaścainayoryogakṛtsukhaḥ saṃvavau tadā ||85|| evaṃ vasantavistāro hyabhūnmadanabodhakaḥ | acetasāmapi tarhi kāmāśaktirabhūt priye ||86|| sacetasāṃ tu jīvānāṃ lakṣmi kā varṇyate kathā | vanaukasāṃ munīnāṃ tāpasānāṃ duḥsaho’pyabhūt ||87|| tato bhramarahum̐kāramālambyādṛśyavigrahaḥ | praviṣṭaḥ karṇarandhreṇa bhavasya madano manaḥ ||88|| śaṃkarastamathākarṇya madhuraṃ madanāśrayam | sasmāra ca satīṃ tatra dayitāṃ rantumānasaḥ ||89|| tataḥ sā tasthau śanakaistirodhāyātinirmalā | viveśa madano drāk ca vikṛtiṃ nītavām̐stadā ||1.185.90 || īṣatkrodhasamāviṣṭo dhairyamālambya dhūrjaṭiḥ | nirasya madanaṃ yogasāmarthyena vyavasthitaḥ ||9 1 || tataḥ smaraḥ prajajvāla nirgato hṛdayād bahiḥ | cūtaṃ bāṇaṃ samākṛṣya sthitastadvāmapārśvataḥ ||92|| sahakāratarordṛṣṭvā mandamārutakampitam | stabakaṃ madano ramyaṃ haravakṣasi satvaram ||93|| mumoca mohanaṃ nāma mārgaṇaṃ makaradhvajaḥ | harasya hṛdye puṣpabāṇaḥ papāta mohanaḥ ||94|| babhūva viddhahṛdayo’dhairyaśca madanonmukhaḥ | evaṃ pravṛttasuratau śṛṃgāro’pi gaṇaiḥ saha ||95|| hāvabhāvayutastatra praviveśa harāntikam | haro’pi yogavibhavādakampo’bhūnnijātmani ||96|| na dṛṣṭavānsmaracchidraṃ tadā yena viśatyapi | etasminnantare tatra sakhībhyāṃ sahitā śivā ||97|| vyaktaṃ śaṃkarapūjārthaṃ nītvā puṣpāṇyanekaśaḥ | saundaryayauvanonmattā śivā tasthau śivāntike ||98|| tadaiva śaṃkaro dhyānaṃ tyaktvā kṣaṇamavasthitaḥ | tacchidraṃ prāpya madano harṣaṇākhyaśareṇa tam ||99|| harṣayāmāsa śaṃbhuṃ ca dṛṣṭvā ca harṣitaṃ satī | śṛṃgārairvividhairbhāvairdadau kāmasahāyatām || 1.185.10 0|| tadaiva ca punaḥ kāmo rucyākhyaṃ prairayaccharam | rucimantaṃ haraṃ dṛṣṭvāmuṃcatpuṣpaśaraṃ smaraḥ || 10 1|| tena vai śaṃbhunā dṛṣṭā strīsvabhāvātsulajjayā | vivṛṇvatī nijāṃgāni saṃśleṣārthamupasthitā ||1 0 2 || pūjānimittamālambya spṛṣṭau ca caraṇau tayā | hārārpaṇaṃ samālambya spṛṣṭau gaṇḍakapolakau || 103 || lalāṭabindumālambya spṛṣṭā bhālākṣisubhruvaḥ | puṣpakaṭakamālambya spṛṣṭāḥ karatalādayaḥ || 1 04|| puṣparaśanāmālambya spṛṣṭāḥ kaṭyūrunābhayaḥ || candanadravamālambya spṛṣṭānyaṃgāni sarvaśaḥ || 1 05|| śivaḥ sparśairmahāmugdho varṇayāmāsa pārvatīm | kiṃ mukhaṃ kiṃ śaśāṃkaśca kiṃ netre cotpale ca kim || 106 || aho bhrukuṭyau dhanuṣī kandarpabhavanārhaṇe | adharaḥ kiṃ ca bimbaṃ kiṃ kiṃ nāsā śukacañcukā || 1 07|| kiṃ svaraḥ kokilālāpaḥ kiṃ madhyaṃ kiṃ ca vedikā | kiṃ rūpaṃ kiṃ gatiścāsyāḥ kiṃ vastrābhūṣaṇārhatā || 1 08|| kiṃ lālityaṃ ca kiṃ sarvāvayavaiḥ ramaṇīyatā | aho’dbhutākṛtiśceyaṃ lāvaṇyakāmanānidhiḥ || 10 0.|| madarthaṃ nirmitā ceyaṃ gṛhṇāmyeva na saṃśayaḥ | iti kṛtvā harastasyā acālayata cāmbaram || 1.185.11 0|| tāvatkumārikābhāvāllajjitā dūrato gatā | vivṛṇvatī nijāṃgāni paśyantī ca muhurmuhuḥ || 111 || suvīkṣaṇairmahāmodāt susmitā tiṣṭhati sma sā | śaṃbhurvicintayāmāsa dṛṣṭvā bhogyārhasundarīm || 112 || asyā darśanamātreṇa mahānando bhavatyaho | yadāliṃganametasyāḥ kuryāṃ kiṃ kiṃ mahatsukham || 1 13|| vicāryetthaṃ samutthāya pārvatīmabhigacchati | tathā tathā tu sā devī paścātpaścādvisarpati || 1 14|| tadā svaṃ tadvaśaṃ jñātvā jñātvā tāṃ svāvaśāṃ tathā | vicāraṃ kṛtavān śaṃbhuḥ keyaṃ nārīviḍambanā || 1 15|| īśvaro’haṃ yadīccheyaṃ parāṃgasparśanaṃ vaśī | tarhi ko’nyo’kṣamaḥ kṣudraḥ kiṃ kiṃ naiva kariṣyati || 1 16|| kimu vighnāḥ samutpannāḥ kurvatastapa uttamam | kena me vikṛtaṃ citta kṛtamatra pradharṣiṇā || 1 17|| asvastrīdharṣaṇaṃ dharmavirodhaḥ śrutilaṃghanam | na yogyaṃ tanmādṛśānāṃ kathamīdṛkdṛśāṃ gataḥ || 1 18|| vicārthetthaṃ sa parito lokayāmāsa śaṃkitaḥ | vāmabhāge sthitaṃ kāmaṃ dadarśākṛṣṭabāṇakam || 119|| tāvacchaṃbhormahākrodhaḥ saṃjātastatkṣaṇe priye | kāmo’pyuḍḍīya vyomasthaścikṣepāmoghamārgaṇām || 1.185.120 || amoghamapi moghaṃ tajjātaṃ kruddhe maheśvare | manmatho bhayamāpāśu cakampe bhayavihvalaḥ || 121|| sasmāra tridaśānsarvān te’pyāyayuśca tuṣṭuvuḥ | tathāpi ca mahākrodhānalavyāptānane sati || 122| netratrayaṃ ca bhālaṃ cāniyamyānalapūritam | jātaṃ raudraṃ vikarālaṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ lalāṭakam || 1 23|| prasahya vahninā netraṃ tṛtīyaṃ jāgrataṃ kṛtam | rudrasya raudravapuṣo jagatsaṃhārabhairavāt || 124|| lalāṭamadhyagānnetrāttṛtīyātpūravegataḥ | niḥsasāra mahāvahniḥ pralayāgnisamaprabhaḥ || 125|| jajvālordhvaśikho dīpto jvālāpravāharūpakaḥ | yaddiśaṃ cekṣate śaṃbhustatrotpatya nipatya ca || 126 || bhrāmaṃ bhrāmaṃ yathādṛṣṭi dhāvatyagre mahānalaḥ | etasminnantare śaṃbhurdadarśa pārśvagaṃ smaram || 1 27|| maccittavikṛteḥ kartā kāmo’yamiti taṃ prati | bhālanetramatisphāraṃ vyasphārayata śaṃkaraḥ || 128|| tadutthavahninā kāmaṃ bhasmasāt kṛtavān haraḥ | abhavanmarutāṃ vācaḥ kṣamyatāṃ kṣamyatāmiti || 129 || sa tu taṃ bhasmasāt kṛtvā jagad dagdhuṃ vyajṛmbhata | tato bhavo jagaddhetorvyabhajajjātavedasam || 1.185.13 0|| sahakāre madhau candre sumanaḥsvapareṣvapi | bhṛṃgeṣu kokilāsyeṣu vibhāgena smarānalam || 131 || dagdhe tasmin smare vīre devā duḥkhamupāgatāḥ | sasakhī pārvatī mlānā svapiturmandiraṃ yayau || 13 2|| patitā ca ratistatra visaṃjñābhūnmṛtaiva sā | jātāyāmatha saṃjñāyāṃ sākrośaṃ vilalāpa ha || 133 || kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kiṃ kṛtaṃ daivatairiha | matpatiṃ te samāhūya nāśayāmāsurīśvarāt || 1 34|| hā hā nātha smara svāmin prāṇapriya sukhaprada | idannu kimabhūdatra hā me bhāgyaṃ vidāritam || 135|| itthaṃ vilāpinī hastau pādau prasārya bhūtale | keśānatroṭayat tvāghātayan śaśvat svamastakam || 136 || tasyā ākrandanaṃ śrutvābhavan sarve suduḥkhitāḥ | āgatya suvicāryaiva devā āśvāsanaṃ daduḥ || 1 37|| kiṃcidbhasma gṛhītvā saṃrakṣa yatnāt bhayaṃ tyaja | jīvayiṣyati śaṃbhuḥ saḥ prāpsyasi tvaṃ punaḥ patim || 1 38|| atha devāḥ śivamūcuḥ saṃprasādya punaḥ punaḥ | kāmenaitatkṛtaṃ tatra na svārthastasya vidyate || 139 || tārakapīḍitairdevairakhilaiḥ kāritaṃ tu tat|| tvayā kāmapradāhena sastrīkā niṣphalīkṛtāḥ || 1.185.140 || kathaṃ jagatpravāho nirvahedevaṃ kṛte sati || ratimāśvāsaya śarva kuru śokāpanodanam || 141|| ratiścāpi tadā śaṃbhuṃ jagāma śaraṇaṃ tataḥ | uddhūlyagātraṃ śubhreṇa hṛdyena smarabhasmanā || 142|| jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā provāca duḥkhasāgarā | namo’stu śaṃbhave nāmnā karmaṇā duḥkhadāya ca || 143|| namaste pārvatīsmartre ratyā vilāpakāriṇe | satīmṛgāya namaḥ kādācitkayogine namaḥ || 144|| namo māyādyadhiṣṭhāya māyāhīnāya te namaḥ | namo brahmasvarūpāya kṛṣṇarūpāya te namaḥ || 145|| namo vairājarūpāya sadāśivāya te namaḥ | namaḥ śivāya rudrāya liṃgarūpāya te namaḥ || 146|| namo jyotiḥsvarūpāya śatarudrāya te namaḥ | namaste koṭirudrāya namaḥ kailāsavāsine || 147|| namaste dvisvarūpāya duḥkhavirahiṇe namaḥ | satīnāthāya śāntāya yogine te namonamaḥ || 148|| namo vṛṣabharūpāya śarabhāya ca te namaḥ | namaḥ kirātarūpāya vivastrāya ca te namaḥ || 149||| brāhmaṇīṣu bhikṣukāya ratirāmāya te namaḥ | anaṃgāya mahāṃgāya jīvanāya ca te namaḥ || 1.185.150|| namaste’stu sakāmāya dhvastakāmāya te namaḥ | namaste’stu śaraṇyāya bhakteṣṭadāya te namaḥ || 151 || namo’stvasahyakopāya priyāptidāya te namaḥ | prayaccha kāmadravyaṃ me kathaṃ jīve patiṃ vinā || 152|| iti stutvā punastatra vilāpaṃ tvakarodratiḥ | śaṃbhuḥ prāha prasanno’smi jīvayiṣyāmi cāntare || 153 || rate mā khedamāpnuhi sadā manasi cetasi | sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ kāmo’dṛśyo nityaṃ nivatsyati || 154|| vasa tvaṃ pramadāvarge’naṃgo vasatu puṃjane | dvayoryoge yuvatyośca sadāyogo’stu cāntaraḥ || 155 || matkopena ca yajjātaṃ tattathā nānyathā bhavet | anaṃgastāvadeva syānnānyathā syādratīśituḥ || 156 || kṛṣṇastvādyadvāparānte hiraṇyeśo bhaviṣyati | sa hiraṇyāṃ pradyumnākhyaṃ kāmaṃ cotpādayiṣyati || 157|| kāmāvatāraṃ pradyamnaṃ śaṃbaro vai hariṣyati | saḥ prakṣipya samudre taṃ nagaraṃ svaṃ gamiṣyati || 158|| tāvat tvaṃ śāmbarapure rate vāsaṃ sukhaṃ kuru | tadā tatra saśarīraḥ kāmastvāṃ sammiliṣyati || 159|| kāmaśca śaṃbaraṃ hatvā dravyaṃ nītvā tvayā saha | gamiṣyati svakaṃ nityaṃ nagaraṃ satyalokajam || 1.185.160|| ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ tatra sukhinau saṃbhaviṣyathaḥ | ityuktā śirasāvandya śaṃkaraṃ kāmavallabhā || 161 || jagāmopavanaṃ cānyadratistuhinaparvate | ruroda cāpi bahuśo dīnā ramye sthale sthale || 1 62|| evaṃ ratistvaraṇyeṣu vicacāra ciraṃ samāḥ | tato gatvā tu nagaraṃ śambarāsurapālitam || 163|| dāsī bhūtvā samuvāsa patijanmehayā sadā | pratīkṣamāṇā taṃ kālaṃ rudrādiṣṭaṃ yugātmakam || 164|| atha krodhamayaṃ vahniṃ dagdhukāmaṃ jagattrayam | taṃ vāḍavatanuṃ brahmā saumyajvālāmukhaṃ priye || 165|| sāgaraṃ samagāllokahitāyādāya vāḍavam | prāha kṣārārṇavaṃ brahmā nirdiśāmi gṛhāṇa tat || 166 || ayaṃ krodho maheśasya vāḍavaṃ rūpamāśritaḥ | jvālāmukhastvayā dhāryo yāvadābhūtasamplavam || 167|| bhojanaṃ toyametasya tava nityaṃ bhaviṣyati | ityuktaḥ sāgaro vahnimaṃgīcakre tu vāḍavam || 1 68|| tataḥ praviṣṭo jaladhau sa vāḍavatanuḥ śuciḥ | vāryaughānsudahaṃstasya jvālāmālātidīpitaḥ || 169|| tatpītamiṣṭasalilā meghā varṣanti bhūtale | svāsthyaṃ prāpa jagatsarvaṃ nirmuktaṃ vāḍavādbhayāt || 1.185.1 70|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gaṃgāvatāre śaṃbhostapaḥ pārvatyāḥ sevā indrapreṣitakāmakṛtabāṇaprayogaḥ tṛtīyanetravahninā kāmadāhaḥ rativilāpaḥ anaṃgasya pradyumnātmakabhāvisadehasya varadānam rateḥ śambaragṛhe vāsaḥ krodhāgnirūpavaḍavānalasya samudre vāsa ityādinirūpaṇanāmā paṃcāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 185||
<1.186> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mahādevo kāmaṃ dagdhvā svamālayam | kailāsamagamatpaścātpārvatī khinnamānasā || 1 || piturgṛhe tato gatvā militvā mātaraṃ svayam| punarjātaṃ tadā mene svātmānaṃ
