atha dakṣaḥ kāmamāha sadrūpaguṇasaṃyutām || 44|| enāṃ gṛhṇīṣva bhāryārthaṃ matputrīṃ sadṛśīṃ guṇaiḥ | ityuktvā pradadau tasmai dehasvedāmbusaṃbhavām ||45|| ratināmnīṃ tu bhāryārthaṃ kandarpāya sahārthinīm | vivāhya tāṃ smaraḥ sopi mumodātīva sadratim ||46|| tasyā bhrūyugalaṃ vīkṣya visasmāra dhanuḥ svakam | kaṭākṣayorgatiṃ dṛṣṭvā visasmārāstranirgatim ||47|| sugandhiśvasamāghrāya visasmāra sumānilam | kāntavṛttānanaṃ dṛṣṭvā visasmāra śaśāṃkinam ||48 || suvarṇapadmakalikātulyaṃ tasyāḥ kucadvayam | dṛṣṭvā cūcukayugmāḍhyaṃ sasmāra tārakādvayam || 49 || dṛḍhapīnonnatastanadvayamadhyasulambinīm | ānābhipattalaṃ mālāṃ dṛṣṭvā sasmāra kaumudīm ||1.198.5 0 || visasmāra svadhanuṣo jyāṃ ca śiñjitaṣaṭpadām | akṣidvandvaṃ samālokya visasmārābjapatrike ||5 1 || udaraṃ tanu cālokya sasmāra svarṇavedikām | ūrudvayaṃ samālokya sasmāra kadalīdvayam ||52|| āraktapārṣṇipādāgraprāntabhāgān vilokya ca | sasmāra cānurāgākhyaṃ mitraṃ taccaraṇasthitam ||53 || tasyāḥ karayugaṃ raktaṃ nakharaiḥ kiṃśukopamaiḥ | vṛttābhiraṃgulībhiśca sūkṣmāgrābhirmanoharam ||54|| dṛṣṭvā sasmāra haribhujaṃgasanmaṇibhogakam | tasyāśca bāhuyugalaṃ mṛṇālayugalāyatam ||55 || mṛdu snigdhaṃ pravālābhaṃ dṛṣṭvā kāmo jaharṣa vai | nīlanīradasaṃkāśakeśapāśo manoharaḥ || 56 || camarīvāladhiprakhyo vibhāti smarajīvanaḥ | etādṛśīṃ cakrapadmāṃ mṛṇālaśakalānvitām ||57|| sarvalāvaṇyasadanāṃ sarvāṃgarāmaṇīyikām | dvādaśābharaṇairyuktāṃ śṛṃgāraiḥ ṣoḍaśairyutām || 58|| mohinīṃ tāṃ ratiṃ vīkṣya kāmo jagrāha sotsukaḥ | vivāhaṃ vidhivattatra tayorbrahmā cakāra vai |||59 || tadā mahotsavastatra babhūva sukhavartanaḥ | dakṣaḥ prītataraścāsīnmumude tanayā ratiḥ ||1.198.6 0 || kāmo’tīva sukhaṃ prāpto rarājāti tayā saha | vāraṃ vāraṃ ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā jagṛhe hṛdayopari || 61 || yā ca sandhyā brahmasutā manojātā purābhavat | tapastaptvā tanuṃ tyaktvā saiva jātā tvarundhatī || 6 2|| medhātitheḥ sutā bhūtvā vavre patiṃ vaśiṣṭhakam | candrabhāgānadītīre tepe yugacatuṣṭayam || 63 || tato vai prārthitaṃ jātamātrānmāviśatu smaraḥ | brahmaṇāpi tathāstviti pradattaṃ varadānakam ||64 || taddināttu smaro dvādaśottaraṃ viśati prajāḥ | sāpyevamupasaṃhṛtya tapo jagāma cāmbaram ||65|| saptarṣimaṇḍale cāste vaśiṣṭhasahacāriṇī | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi punaḥ kāmakathānakam ||66 || kalpādau sābhavatputrī cāṇḍālasyātidharmiṇī | ṛṣayo dvādaśe’vagrahakāle’nnasamīhayā || 6 7|| bhikṣārthaṃ ca samājagmustadā pitrā samarpitā | sākaṃ tu bhikṣayā vaśiṣṭhāya pāvanakāriṇe || 68 || niḥsāritā ca gomadhyāt pāvitā ca vivāhitā | saivāstyarundhatī devī pātivratyaparāyaṇā ||6 9 || iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yathā bhavati tattathā | kalpabhede sṛṣṭibhedaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi ||1.198.7 0 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jīvasṛṣṭau sandhyāpitṛkāmaratyarundhatyutpattipradarśananāmāṣṭanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 198 ||
<1.199> śrīlakṣmīruvāca samudramanthane daityamohārthaṃ tvamabhūḥ prabho | mohinīrūpamāpannastvāṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṃkarastadā || 1 || māyeśopi kathaṃ māyāmohamavāpa nirguṇaḥ | iti me saṃśayaṃ chindhi tāṃ kathāṃ kathaya prabho || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ tanmahālakṣmi sarvaṃ niḥsaṃśayaṃ yathā | ahaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣātparaṃbrahma parātparaḥ || 3 || nirguṇo’pi sadā divyaguṇākaro bhavāmyapi | madicchāyā jagatsarvaṃ nirguṇānmama varṣmaṇaḥ || 4 || samutpannaṃ saguṇaṃ tat sattvādiguṇamiśritam | prakṛteśca guṇānāṃ ca prerako’haṃ prayojakaḥ || 5 || yathā yatra yādṛśaṃ ca kārye bhavati tādṛśam | rūpamāsthāya tatsarvaṃ sādhayāmi svayaṃ yathā || 6 || anyapraveśamāsthāya sādhayāmi guṇārthivat | śaṃkaro mama bhakto’sti nirlepo māyayā sadā || 7 || māyāguṇairanudvejyo māyayā sa na lipyate | tathāpyanyapraśikṣārthaṃ mohanaṃ darśitaṃ mayā || 8 || sādhvyaśca sādhavaścāpi tyāgavrataṃ samāśritāḥ | te tu mohaṃ prajitvaiva divyabhāvā bhavanti hi || 9 || tathāpīndriyavegena kadācidyogasaṃbhave | grāmyakriyāprakartāro bhaveyurmohasaṃbhave || 1.199.10 || śaṃkaro yogirāṭ bhakto māyāmohamavāptavān | tasmānmuktiṃ samicchadbhirbhettavyamindriyāditaḥ || 11 || apramādaḥ sadā rakṣyaḥ pramādo mṛtyurucyate | moha eva pramādo’sti naranārīprayogajaḥ || 1 2|| tadbhaktairnaiva yoktavyaṃ mohanaṃ dehajaṃ kvacit | iti pratyupadeśārthaṃ darśitaṃ śaṃkare mayā || 13 || anyaccāsyā vasumatyā garbhe svarṇaprapattaye | śivadhātupradānārthaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā sahetukam || 1 4|| śṛṇu tacca yathājātaṃ mamaiva tatkathānakam | dvayoraikyānmokṣakarī kathaiṣā śravaṇānmatā || 15|| yoṣidrūpadharo viṣṇurmohayitvā tu dānavān | somamapāyayaddevān śrutveti śaṃkaraḥ svayam || 16 || draṣṭumaicchacca tadrūpaṃ samāyācca tvarānvitaḥ | śaṃkarasya ca saṃkalpaṃ jñātvātha mohinīhariḥ || 17|| pāyayitvāmṛtaṃ devānapāsarat yato haraḥ | ṣoḍaśahāyanā nārī kāmapūrabharānvitā || 18|| kabarīkeśaveṣāḍhyā caṃcatpatralatānvitā | śaratpūrṇaniśānāthanibhānanamanoharā || 19 || kāmabāṇāśritabhālabhrṛkuṭidvayahṛdgamā | raktapītasudhavalapuṣpāvataṃsaśobhitā || 1.199.20 || sthalapadmakṛtagucchagrathitadhammilottamā | sugandhacandanamiśrakuṃkumapatrikānvitā || 21 || madhyasūkṣmaprabhābindvīsmāritānaṃgasadguhā | nīlacaṃcatkajjalārdrakoṇāpāṃgasunetrakā || 22 || sūkṣmaratnamaṇisvarṇahīrakāñcitakuṇḍalā | caṃcanmauktikasūkṣmāgryālambamānairikānvitā || 23 || suprabhahīrakāñcitasvarṇacandrakapolikā | tanutārātmasauvarṇavālīmaṇibhanāsikā || 24|| pakvabimbauṣṭhayugalasmāritācumbanakriyā | ratnamadhyakṛticaṃcatsvarṇacibukabindvikā || 25 || prodyatadsūryasamakāntikaustubhavaramaṇḍanā | svarṇahārāvalīśobhadvakṣaḥsthalastanadvayā || 26 || kambukaṇṭhī niṣkakaṇṭhī kadalīgarbhasadbhujā | raktapallavasatkānticandranakhāṅguliprabhā || 27 || svarṇormikāṃgadaramyakaṭakavaṃgiḍīyutā | śaṃkhalāraśanānūpurarājicaraṇadvayā || 28 || kvaṇatkiṃkiṇikāyuktasvarṇamaṃjīraśobhitā | svarṇaraktaraṃgacitravicitraghargharīyutā || 29 || svarṇatārāñcitaprāntaśobhacchāṭīsamambarā | nava raṃgaphalakalpastanāptakaṃcukīyutā || 1.199.30 || candravidyudvilāsābhaṃ naktakaṃ bibhratī kare | kūrdatkandukavaryeṇa sakrīḍā ca muhurmuhuḥ || 31 || puṣpapallavaśobhāḍhye vṛkṣakuṃje gatīmatī | īṣatkampāñcitastananitambacāpalānvitā || 32 || viguṇṭhadvastravaivartagocarībhavadaṃkanā | hāvabhāvavilāsādicaṃcalāyatalocanā || 33 || kaṃcukīṃ stanayorhastaṃ datvāpīḍayadatyati | kvacicca kabarīṃ dhṛtvā sannahyatī ca śāṭikām || 34 || ramamāṇā kandukena manomohātikāriṇī | muhurhāsyānanā śāṭīmuddhṛtyoddhṛtya gacchati || 35 || ghargharīṃ mukulīkṛtyānāvṛtasakthidarśanā | yatrāsti śaṃkarastatra miṣeṇāsṛtya sarpati || 36 || evaṃvidhāmekatānāmekatānena lokayan | jaḍībhūto’bhavacchaṃbhurvihvalātmā hatāntaraḥ || 37 || jñaptismṛtivilopenābhavadbhānavivarjitaḥ | kāmabhāvaprabhāmātrārūḍhasaṃkalpatanmayaḥ || 38 || vātataraṃgaprotkṛṣṭaśāṭīhīnā tadābhavat | ślathannīvyapatadbhūmau ghargharyapi tadantare || 39 || cidākāśagataṃ vidyudbinduṃ sābhramivāntaram | mahāprakāśatejasvi svarṇacampakabhānvitam ||1.199.40|| vilokya śaṃkarastasyāṃ manaścakre’tiṣañjitum | vāyurharati vastrāṇi sā ca harati śaṃkaram ||41|| apasarpati vrīḍāḍhyā vṛkṣādvṛkṣāntaraṃ tadā | kāmavegāptakārkaśyendriyo vīryaprapūritaḥ |||42||| so’nugatvātidārḍhyena keśāndhṛtvā ca tadvapuḥ | samākṛṣya samunnīya bāhubhyāṃ pariṣasvaje ||||43 || prasahyopāliṃgitā sā cūmbitā ca muhurmuhuḥ | anicchukī ca sātmānaṃ mocayitvā bhujāntarāt ||44|| prādravatsā vṛkṣasaṃghe’nujagāma haraśca tām | retaso vegaprābalyātsrāvabhavatpradhāvataḥ ||45|| yatra yatrāpradhāvatsā tatra tāmanudhāvataḥ | reto mahyāṃ cāpatad yat tā hemnaḥ khanayo’bhavan ||46|| mohinī vyomamārgeṇa purogā yāti vegataḥ | mugdho maheśvaraḥ kāmavegastāmanudhāvati ||47|| bhūmāvaraṇyaśailādau cāpagāsu vaneṣu ca | yatrādhāvanmahādevo dhātustasyāpatattathā ||48|| tatra tatra ca tadyogāt pṛthvī raupyamayī hyabhūt | śaṃkarasya samagrasya dhātorvai kṣaraṇādanu ||49|| samajāyata śaithilyaṃ prabodho’bhūttataḥ punaḥ | keyaṃ vai mohinīrūpā ko’haṃ gacchāmi kutra ca ||1.199.50 || kathaṃ me kalmaṣaṃ prāptamavikṛtasya vikṛtiḥ | naitādṛśaṃ bhavedrūpaṃ jagaddhātāramantarā ||5 1|| amāyikasya kā māyā yena māyā vaśīkṛtā | māṃ yāhīti kṛtayatnā māyeyaṃ vaiṣṇavī nanu ||52|| tasyaiva māyayā vyāptaṃ jagadetaccarācaram yadyahaṃ tena cākṛṣṭastadā nāstyadbhutaṃ hi me ||53 || tenaiva saṃyojito’haṃ ramāmi śivayā sadā | tenaiva preritaścāhaṃ viharāmi tadicchayā || 54|| iti vicārya mumude na mlānimagamaddharaḥ | bhagavānapi taṃ bhaktaṃ pramātāraṃ vicintya ca ||55|| mohinīrūpadhṛk prāha kastvaṃ kasmājjaḍīkṛtaḥ | kva gataṃ tava satsattvaṃ vinā yogamasatvavat ||56|| samarthasyāpi te kena gamitaitādṛśī daśā | ehyāgaccha nikuṃjeṣu ramāvo nirjane vane ||57|| naitādṛśī punarnārīṃ prāpsyase’kṣatamadhyamām | iti kṛtvā svayaṃ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaścucumba tam ||58|| harastu dhātunirbhinnaḥ śaithilyākrāntameḍhrakaḥ | notsāhavānabhūttatra tayā sākaṃ riraṃsitum |||59|| sa prāha mohinīṃ tatra nārāyaṇamṛte kvacit|| yogināṃ manaso dhairyaṃ hartuṃ śakto na vai paraḥ ||1.199.60 || tasmai namo bhagavate māyārūpadhārāya ca | namaḥ kṛṣṇāya devāya nārāyaṇāya viṣṇave ||6 1 || mohinyātmasvarūpāya moharūpāya te namaḥ | tvayi nātra mama śoko nārāyaṇe parātpare ||62|| tathāpi devadeveśa rakṣa māyāvimohanāt | moho’yaṃ jagatāṃ bandhakaro’sti vāsanodayaḥ ||6 3 || tava yogo’pi mohātmā muktyātmā nirguṇo mataḥ | tavedaṃ rūpamatyarhasaundaryabhājanaṃ param ||64|| na me cānyasya bandhāya mokṣamātrapradaṃ hi tat | tasmāt tvayā kṛtaṃ yadvai tadvai me lābhadaṃ param ||65|| pārvatyāḥ sahavāse’pi smṛtvā tvāṃ mohinīṃ sadā | vinirbandho bhaviṣyāmi lapsye nairguṇyameva ca ||6 6 || śrutvaitacchaṃbhuhārdajño bhagavān kamalāpatiḥ | yoṣidrūpaṃ ca saṃhṛtya caturbāhuḥ kṣaṇe’bhavat ||67|| prahasanprāha sarvātmā samāśliṣya haraṃ hṛdā | madbhakto matkṛtāṃ māyāṃ jītavānasi śaṃkara ||68|| jñānena cāpi dhairyeṇa bhaktyā ca parayā tathā | nānyaścātitarenmāyāṃ yoṣidrūpāṃ hi tvadṛte ||69|| seyaṃ bhāvānsṛjamānā mohinīvadviḍambanā | rajjūrūpā bandhanākhyā spṛśatyeva na macchritān ||1.199.70|| abhaktānāṃ mohikā sā bhaktānāṃ bhuktimuktidā | saiva madyogamāpannā bhaktānāṃ nirguṇā sadā ||7 1 || mahāmāyā mahālakṣmīḥ kamalā rādhikā ramā | sarasvatī ca sāvitrī pārvatī naiva bandhadā ||72 || rukmiṇī kambharā brāhmī pativratā ca jānakī | mohinī tulasī caitā mokṣadā na tu bandhadāḥ ||73|| prabhā ca māṇikī jayā lalitā naiva bandhadāḥ | kṛṣṇarūpāstu tāḥ sarvā muktidā yogataḥ smṛtāḥ ||74|| haṃsā ca maṃjulā campā haimī dayā ramā tathā | puṣpā muktā tathā devī śāntā godāvarī manuḥ ||75|| ojasvatī ca jīvā ca maṃgalā tāḥ sakhīvarāḥ | divyāstāsāṃ mūrtayo yāḥ sādhvyo yoginya eva ca ||76|| sākṣātkṛṣṇāṃkavāsāstāḥ pāvanā mokṣadāstataḥ | sāṃkhyayoginya evātra sanyāsinyaśca yāstathā ||77|| virāgiṇyaśca madrūpā yatinyaścāpi mokṣadāḥ | macchaktayastu tāḥ sarvā madrūpā eva nirguṇāḥ ||78|| tāsāṃ yogaṃ gatā ye ye te jīvā nirguṇāḥ sadā | pavitrāścātra jīvanto muktā eva na saṃśayaḥ ||79|| yathā tāsāṃ yogavanto brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | kṛṣṇarāmādayo nityamuktā nityapareśvarāḥ ||1.199.80|| atha tāsāṃ kṛpāpātrajīvā mukteśvarāḥ sadā | iti te kathitaṃ śaṃbho manmāhātmyamanuttamam ||8 1|| nedṛksamyagvijānanti ye doṣādṛtadṛṣṭayaḥ | matsvarūpaprasaktā ye matto bodhagrahāśca ye ||82|| madātmakamidaṃ sarvaṃ jānanto’nidameva yat | ta evedṛksumatayo nirbandhāḥ santi sarvathā |||83|| ityuktvā śaṃkaraṃ viṣṇurantardhānaṃ gataḥ kṣaṇāt | mahādevo’pi gaṃgāyāṃ snānārthamagamattadā ||84|| iti te lakṣmi sāmarthyaṃ mohinyā śaṃkarāya yat | darśitaṃ kathitaṃ sarva kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchasi ||85|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃkarasya mohinīdarśanena dhātupātāt svarṇakhanyutpattiḥ tatsakhīnāṃ divyatā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 99||
<1.200> śrīlakṣmīruvāca nāradasya punarjanma dāsīputratvamityapi | kadā jātamiti brūhi śrotumicchāmi mādhava || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ divyāṃ sarvathā pāpanāśinīm | brahmā viśvaṃ vinirmāya sāvitryāṃ gṛhadharmataḥ || 2 || cakāra vīryādhānaṃ ca śatavarṣottaraṃ tu sā | suṣuve caturo vedān tadaṃgāni ca sarvathā || 3 || ṣaṭtriṃśadrāgiṇīścaiva ṣaḍrāgān tālasaṃyutān | caturyugām̐śca kālaśca yogām̐śca ṣaṭsukṛttikāḥ || 4 || devasenāṃ mahāṣaṣṭhīṃ kārtikeyapriyāṃ satīm | mātṛkāsu pradhānāṃ tāṃ bālānāmiṣṭadevatām || 5 || caturvidhaṃ layaṃ mṛtyukanyāṃ vyādhigaṇām̐stathā | pṛṣṭhādadharmaṃ cālakṣmīṃ vāmapārśvata eva ca || 6 || nābhestu viśvakarmāṇaṃ vasūnaṣṭau mahābalān | mānasāt caturaḥ putrān kumārān sanakādikān || 7 || mukhāt svāyaṃbhuvaṃ putraṃ śatarūpāsamanvitam | tānsarvān sṛṣṭikṛdbrahmā sṛṣṭiṃ kartumuvāca ha || 8 || jagmuste ca nahītyuktvā taptuṃ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ | cukopa hetunā tena brahmā tasya lalāṭataḥ || 9 || rudrā ekādaśotpannāsteṣāmeko vināśakṛt | pulastyo dakṣakarṇācca pulaho vāmakarṇataḥ || 1.200.10 || dakṣanetrāttathātriśca vāmanetrāt kratuḥ svayam | araṇirnāsikārandhrādaṅgirāśca mukhādruciḥ || 11 || bhṛgustu vāmapārśvācca dakṣo dakṣiṇapārśvataḥ | chāyāyāḥ kardamo jāto nābheḥ paṃcaśikhastathā || 12|| vakṣasaścaiva voḍuśca kaṇṭhadeśācca nāradaḥ | marīciḥ skandhadeśāccaivāpāntaratamā galāt || 1 3|| vasiṣṭho rasanādeśātpracetā adharauṣṭhataḥ | haṃsaśca vāmakukṣeśca dakṣakukṣeryatistathā || 1 4|| sṛṣṭiṃ kartuṃ sutānsarvānājñāṃ cakāra viśvasuṭ | nāradastu tadā prāha yuktiyuktaṃ śubhaṃ vacaḥ || 15|| pūrvamānaya majjyeṣṭhānsanakādīn pitāmaha | kārayitvā dārayuktānasmānvada jagatpate || 16|| te tapaḥsu yojitāścet saṃsārāya vayaṃ katham | ekasmāyamṛtaṃ dattamanyasmai tu viṣaṃ katham || 17|| ghore saṃsāravārdhau saṃpatitasya na nistariḥ | koṭikalpe’pi bhavati tasmātsaṃsārasāgare || 18|| māsmānpātaya hitakṛtpitā bhūtvājñavat pitaḥ | nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ bījaṃ nistārasyeha kathyate || 1 9|| sarvado bhaktido mokṣapradaścāpi sa eva hi | bhaktekaśaraṇo bhaktavatsalaḥ karuṇānidhiḥ ||1.200.20 || bhaktapriyo bhaktanātho bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ | bhaktārādhyo bhaktasādhyaḥ sa eva tārakaḥ svayam || 21|| vihāya taṃ paraṃbrahma ko mūḍho viṣaye bhramet | kṛṣṇasevāmṛtaṃ tyaktvā viṣamaśnāti ko’budhaḥ ||25|| viṣayā naśvarāḥ sarve tucchāśca mṛtyuhetavaḥ | svapnavanna sthirāḥ santi dīpajvālāgravartanāḥ ||23 || baḍiśapiṣṭavat matsyāpātābhikārakā iva | duḥkhadā mṛtyudāstāpāḥ kastānseveta sanmatiḥ ||24|| tasmādayaṃ brahmabhājo brahmānvayaprakāśakāḥ | vicintayāmo brahmaiva na kurmaḥ sarjanaṃ pitaḥ ||25|| ityuktvā nārado mauno’bhavat pratyuttarecchukaḥ | tāvadbrahmābhavat kruddhaḥ provāca sphuritādharaḥ || 16|| nārad tvaṃ piturvākyamanādṛtyābhimānavān | jñānīvopadiśanmāṃ ca niṣedhasi tu sarjanam ||27|| tasmājjñānavihīnastvaṃ bhava yoṣitsu lampaṭaḥ | sthirayauvanayuktānāṃ surūpāṇāṃ vilāsakṛt ||28||| pañcāśatkāminīnāṃ tvaṃ bhartā śṛṃgāravidbhava | śṛṃgāraśāstravettā ca mahāśṛṃgārakārakaḥ |||29|| nānāśṛṃgāravijñānāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca gururbhava | gandharvāṇāmagragaṇyo gāyakaḥ susvaro bhava ||1.200.30|| vīṇāvādananiṣṇātaḥ sarvadā sthirayauvanaḥ | bhaviṣyasi na sandeho dvilakṣābdasujīvanaḥ |||3 1|| punarmadīyaśāpena dāsīputro bhaviṣyasi | tadā vaiṣṇavasaṃsargād vaiṣṇavocchiṣṭabhojanāt |||32|| śrīkṛṣṇasya prasādena bhaviṣyasi mamātmajaḥ | jñānaṃ dāsyāmi te divyaṃ punareva purātanam |||33|| adhunā bhava naṣṭastvaṃ matsuto nipata dhruvam | nāradaḥ prāha pitaraṃ krodhaṃ saṃhara viśvasṛṭ || 34|| śapetparityajedvidvān putramutpathagāminam | tapasvinaṃ sutaṃ śaptuṃ kathamarhasi me pitaḥ || 35|| yatra janiśca me tatra vaiṣṇavatvaṃ sadā bhavet | na jahātu harerbhaktirmāṃ vedo dehi me varam || 26|| janma yadi mahallakṣmīsampadvatsu bhavedapi | bhaktihīnaṃ tu tatsarvamadhamaṃ cāgatipradam || 37|| sūkare’pi yadi janma jātismaraṃ bhavedyadi | bhaktiyuktaṃ tu tacchreṣṭhaṃ golokadhāmadaṃ hi tat ||38|| śrīhareścaraṇe bhaktirmadhu divyaṃ prakīrtitam | tadaśnatāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ pādapūtā dharā bhavet ||39|| tīrthāni vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu sparśamicchanti sarvadā | pāpināṃ snānasaṃsṛṣṭapāpānāṃ kṣālanāya vai ||1.200.40 || śrīkṛṣṇamantragrahaṇānnarā muktā bhavanti vai | koṭimuktā nāmagrahājjātā jāyanta eva ca ||41 || bhaviṣyanti tathā muktā nāmabhaktyā tu koṭiśaḥ | koṭijanmārjita pāpapuñjā naśyanti mantrataḥ || 42|| śuddhyanti ca bhavantyeva muktā naiṣkarmyamātrataḥ | pūrvaṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ karma nāmnā nirmūlayanti te ||43|| gṛhaṃ dāsām̐stathā dāsīrapatyāni ca bāndhavān | sutāndārām̐stathā śiṣyānsevakām̐śca kuṭumbinaḥ ||44|| yo darśayati sanmārgaṃ sopi sadgatimṛcchati | sa kiṃguruḥ sa kiṃtātaḥ sa kiṃsvāmī sa kiṃsutaḥ ||45|| yo darśayatyasanmārgaṃ taistairviśvasito janaḥ | yaśca kṛṣṇapadāmbhoje bhaktiṃ dātumanīśvaraḥ ||46|| tvaṃ na dadāsi me bhaktiṃ nirodhayasi māmuta | tatastvamapi vedāsyāpūjyo bhava jagattraye ||47|| ityuktvā nāradastatra virarāma kṣaṇaṃ yataḥ | viśvasṛjaśca śāpena gandharvaśca babhūva ha ||48|| gandharvarājasya patnyāmupabarhaṇanāmadhṛk | kathayāmi suvistīrṇaṃ tadvṛttāntaṃ niśāmaya ||49|| gandharvarājaḥ sarveṣāṃ gandharvāṇāmadhiprabhuḥ | paramaiśvaryasaṃyuktaḥ putrahīno’bhavaddhi saḥ ||1.200.50|| gurvājñayā puṣkare saḥ tapaścacāra dāruṇam | dadau tasmai vaśiṣṭhaśca stotraṃ tu dvādaśākṣaram ||51 || śivasya kavacaṃ mantraṃ varṣaśataṃ jajāpa saḥ | nirāhārastapaḥ kurvan dadarśa purataḥ śivam ||52|| mahattejaḥsvarūpaṃ ca bhaktānugrahakārakam | īṣaddhāsaṃ prasannāsyaṃ tapasyāphaladāyakam ||53||| śaraṇāgatabhaktāya dātāraṃ sarvasampadām | triśūlapaṭṭiśadharaṃ vṛṣasthaṃ candraśekharam ||54|| taptasvarṇajaṭājūṭaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ trinetrakam | nāgayajñopavītaṃ ca carmavastraṃ subhaktidam ||55|| dṛṣṭvā nanāma gandharvarājaḥ sa daṇḍavat bhuvi | tuṣṭāva paramantreṇa prasannaṃ dhavalaṃ haram ||56|| varaṃ vṛṇuṣveti harastaṃ provāca tapasvinam | sa yayāce harerbhaktiṃ bhaktaṃ putraṃ ca vaiṣṇavam |||57|| śaṃbhuḥ prāha kṛtārthastvaṃ sarvaṃ bhaktau pratiṣṭhitam | varādekād vṛtaṃ sarvamanyaccarvitacarvaṇam ||58|| yasya bhaktirharau tasya sarvaṃ caiśvaryamasti hi | sarvāśca siddhayastasya na nyūnaṃ vidyate’pyaṇu ||5 9|| saḥ samarthaḥ sarvaviśvān pātuṃ kartuṃ bhavediha | ātmanaḥ kulakoṭiṃ ca śataṃ mātāmahasya ca ||1.200.6 0 || puruṣāṇāṃ samuddhṛtya golokaṃ dhāma yāti saḥ | koṭijanmaprapāpāni hatvā dāsyaṃ harerlabhet ||6 1|| tāvatpatiśca patnī ca sutāḥ putrā dhanādayaḥ | sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ nṛṇāṃ tāvad yāvadbhaktirharau nahi ||62|| harau bhaktiḥ kalpavṛkṣaḥ sarvepsitaṃ dadāti vai | bhaktirmahām̐stīkṣṇakhaḍgaḥ karmadrumūlakṛntanaḥ ||6 3 || harau tu mānase lagne sarvaṃ siddhaṃ bhavatyapi | yeṣāṃ tu sukṛtaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ teṣāṃ putrāstu vaiṣṇavāḥ ||64|| bhavantyuddhārayantyeva kulakoṭiṃ tu sevayā | sukhe vaiṣayike yadvā sāmrājye pārameṣṭhyake ||65|| prāpte sarvavidhe cāpi maṃgale naiva tuṣyati | bhaktirbhaktaśca putraḥ syādityekātsarvamarthitam ||66|| caritārthaḥ pumānekādīdṛśāttu varottamāt | kiṃ vareṇa dvitīyena yasmāt tṛptirna śāśvatī ||67|| vaiṣṇavānāṃ dhanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kṛṣṇe bhaktirhi śāśvatī | sañcitaṃ bhaktidāsyaṃ yat sarvaṃ tena hi sañcitam ||68|| yadyapi tvarthitaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvasmāchreṣṭhameva ca | tathāpi na vayaṃ dātuṃ samarthāstādṛśaṃ varam ||69|| varayānyaṃ varaṃ rājan yatte manasi vartate | mahendratvamamaratvaṃ brahmatvamīśatāṃ labha ||1.200.70|| siddhīryogaṃ ca vijñānaṃ mṛtyuñjayabalaṃ tathā | sarvaṃ dāsyāmi labha tat kṛṣṇadāsyaṃ tyaja dhruvam ||71 || śrutvā gandharvarājaścovāca śrīśaṃkaraṃ tadā | yatpakṣmacālanenaiva brahmādeḥ patanaṃ bhavet ||72|| tadbrahmatvaṃ mahendratvamamaratvaṃ na me priyam | siddhayaśca mahaiśvaryaṃ yogo mṛtyuñjayastathā ||73|| na me’styatipriyaṃ deva jñānaṃ ca bhaktimantarā | sālokyasārṣṭisāmīpyasāyujyaikatvamityapi ||74|| vaiṣṇavā nahi vāñcchanti vinā tatsevanaṃ kvacit | vāñcchanti dāsyabhaktiṃ ca śāśvatīṃ svāpajāgratoḥ ||75|| tasmāt taddāsyabhaktiṃ ca bhaktaputraṃ vṛṇomyaham | anyatsarvaṃ parityajya tuṣṭāt tvatto varapradāt ||76|| na vā dāsyasi cecchaṃbho duṣkṛtaṃ me’sti niścitam | śiraśchitvā sannidhau te pradāsyāmi hutāśane ||77|| śrutvā kṛpānidhirbhaktadayāluḥ prāha śaṃkaraḥ | labhasva śrīharerdāsyabhaktiṃ putraṃ suvaiṣṇavam ||78|| gāndharvavidyākuśalaṃ cirāyuṣaṃ jitendriyam | jñāninaṃ gurubhaktaṃ ca śaśvatsusthirayauvanam ||79|| varaṃ datvā yayau śaṃbhurgandharvaḥ svālayaṃ yayau | kālena tasya bhāryāyāṃ lebhe janma ca nāradaḥ ||1.200.80 || vaśiṣṭhastannāma cakre gandhamādanaparvate | upabarhaṇanāmāsau gandharvaḥ khyātimāptavān ||8 1 || upārthaścādhiko bodhyaḥ pūjyaśca barhaṇārthakaḥ | adhikapūjya ityarthe upabarhaṇa nāma tat ||82|| cakāra saḥ sutajanmamahotsavaṃ mudānvitaḥ | dadau ratnāni dhānyāni dravyāṇi hīrakāṇi ca ||8 3 || dhanāni kṣetravastrāṇi paśūn dānāni bhūriśaḥ | upabarhaṇagandharvo vaśiṣṭhānmantramuttamam ||84|| prāpya kṛṣṇārādhanāyāścakāra duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ | gaṇḍakyāḥ saritastīre vṛkṣajālasamāvṛte ||85|| tapantaṃ projjvalaṃ prāptayauvanaṃ sumanoharam | dṛṣṭvā kāmāt tadā mūrchāmavāpuḥ pramadā muhuḥ ||86|| snānārthaṃ ca jalāptyarthaṃ yā yāstatra samāgatāḥ | gandharvapatnyastāḥ sarvā mumuhuḥ kāmabhāvataḥ ||87|| tāśca tīvraṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā prāṇān santyajya yogataḥ | pañcāśat tā babhūvuśca kanyāścitrarathasya vai ||88 || upabarhaṇagandharvaṃ tāśca taṃ vavrire patim | kāmukyaḥ kanyakā mālā dadustasmai tapasvine ||8 9 || patnyastasya babhūvuśca tābhiḥ saha yayau gṛham | divyaṃ dvilakṣavarṣaṃ ca tābhiḥ reme sa kāmukaḥ || 1.200.90 || atha kālāntare satyaloke devasamājake | sabhāyāṃ brahmaṇastatra jagāma gāyanaṃ jagau || 91 || tatra rambhāpsaronṛtyakrame tu samupasthite | tasyā ūrū stane rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā mūrchāmavāpa saḥ || 9 2|| kāmavegena sattvapraskhalanaṃ saṃbabhūva ha | tyaktvā saṃgītamevāyaṃ niṣasāda sabhātale || 93 || uccaiḥ prajahasurdevā brahma krodhācchaśāpa tam | upabarhaṇa jānāsi pañcāśatpramadāpatiḥ || 94|| bhūtvāpi mohamāpanno raṃbhāṃ dṛṣṭvā hyadhīravat | tasmādvihāya gāndharvī tanuṃ śūdro bhava drutam || 95 || tatra prāpya harerbhaktiṃ sāttvatānāṃ samāgamam | punaḥ kāle samāpanne matputrastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 96 || vinā vipattimahimā sukhaśāntyorbhavennahi | ataḥ kramātsukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ sarveṣāṃ bhāvyameva yat || 97|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | upabarhaṇagandharvo jagāma svagṛhaṃ prati || 98 || sarvāḥ patnīḥ samāhūya vṛttāntamabhidhāya ca | āsane yogamāsthāya jahau tāṃ tanumādarāt || 99|| mūlādhāraṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ maṇipūramanāhatam | viśuddhamājñācakraṃ ca bhittvā ṣaṭcakrameva saḥ || 1.200.100 || iḍāṃ suṣumṇāṃ medhāṃ ca piṃgalāṃ prāṇahāriṇīm | sarvajñānapradāṃ cāpi manaḥsaṃyaminīṃ tathā || 101 || viśuddhāṃ ca niruddhāṃ ca vāyusaṃcāriṇīṃ tathā | tejaḥśuṣkarīṃ caiva balapuṣṭikarīṃ tathā || 10 2 || buddhisaṃcāriṇīṃ caiva jñānajṛmbhaṇakāriṇīm | etāḥ ṣoḍaśadhā nāḍīrbhitvā haṃsaṃ manoyutam || 103 || brahmarandhraṃ samānīyātmānaṃ yuyoja keśave | dehaṃ tatyāja yogīndraḥ samprāpa brahma śāśvatam || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmaṇā sāvitryāṃ mānasaputrā utpāditāḥ nāradotpattiḥ sṛṣṭyarthaṃ niyoge nāradasya tanniṣedhaḥ brahmaṇaḥ śāpādupabarhaṇākhyagandharvabhavanam punaḥ brahmasabhāyāṃ gāyanakāle śāpāt tanutyāgaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 200 ||
<1.201> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca upabarhaṇagandharvo yogamāsthāya mṛtyave | yadāsanaṃ prasaṃkalpya saṃsthito’bhūttadā hi saḥ || 1 || vīṇāṃ tritantrīṃ duṣprāpyāṃ vāmaskandhe nidhāya ca | śuddhasphaṭikamālāṃ ca sandhṛtvā dakṣiṇe kare || 2 || saṃjalpannakṣaraṃ brahma kṛṣṇa ityakṣaradvayam | prācyāṃ kṛtvā śiraḥsthānaṃ paścime caraṇadvayam || 3 || śayitvā darbhaśayane śrīkṛṣṇaṃ manasā smaran | yogena brahma samprāpa patnyādyā rurudurbhṛśam || 4 || pañcāśadyoṣitāṃ mukhyā rājñī mālāvatī tadā | uccaiḥ ruroda sā tīvraṃ kāntaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi || 5 || uvāca bhagavanmūrteḥ saṃsargo’pi vimuktikṛt | nārīṇāṃ devasaṃsargo bahubhāgyāddhi jāyate || 6 || sādhunā saha saṃsargo vaikuṇṭhādapi durlabhaḥ | sādhunā saha vicchedo maraṇādapi duḥsahaḥ || 7 || tato’pi bandhuvicchedo mahāśokaprado mataḥ | tato’patyaviyogo’pi maraṇādatiricyate || 8 || tasmādapi ca sarvasmāt pativicchedajaṃ mahat | kaṣṭaṃ tu saṃkaṭaṃ ghoraṃ nāsti kaṣṭaṃ tataḥ param || 9 || śayane bhojane snāne yāne svāpe ca jāgrati | svāmivicchedajaṃ duḥkhaṃ nūtanaṃ vai dine dine || 1.201.10 || svāmisaṃyogamātreṇa sarvaduḥkhāni vismaret | nānyat tādṛk prapaśyāmi yacca vismārayetpatim || 11 || sādhvīnāṃ kulajātānāṃ na bandhuḥ svāminā vinā | etāsāṃ matsvasṝṇāṃ ca mamāpi svāminā vinā || 12|| kā gatirvai duḥkhadātrī bhaviṣyati patiṃ vinā | he digīśāśca dikpālā he dharma he prajāpate || 13 || he śaṃbho he ramākānta patidānaṃ tu dehi me | ityuktvā prāpa mūrchāṃ ca kanyā citrarathasya sā || 14|| punaśca cetanāṃ prāpya vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ | anyāścātivilapantyaḥ sambodhya rurudurharim || 15|| he kṛṣṇa jagatāṃ nātha jagadrakṣaka īśvara | abalāṃ nirbalāṃ kṛtvā kathaṃ mārayasi vṛthā || 1 6|| bhartā bhāryā vapuste’sti na kathaṃ rakṣyate tvayā | karmaṇā ca patirlabdhaḥ karmaṇā ca viyojitaḥ || 17|| saṃyoge paramānando viyoge saṃkaṭaṃ mahat | patiḥ putrastathā patnyo bāndhavāḥ karmaṇā sadā || 18 || svayaṃ tyaktāḥ sukhāyaiva duḥkhāya tyājitāḥ paraiḥ | ataḥ santaḥ svayaṃ tyaktvā bhavanti sukhinaḥ sadā || 1 9|| vayaṃ nāryo na vai satyo jñānavatyo’pi naiva ca | tasmāt kṛṣṇa varaṃ kāntaṃ punardehi prajīvaya || 1.201.20 || nedṛśaḥ sundaraḥ kāntaḥ kābhiścillabdha ātmavit | rūpeṇa ca guṇenaiva tejasā vikrameṇa ca || 21 || jñānena śāntyā santuṣṭyā haritulyaḥ prabhurhi naḥ | haribhakto harisamo gāṃbhīrye sāgaropamaḥ || 22 || dīptau sūryasamaḥ śuddhau vahnitulyaśca pāvanaḥ | darśane candratulyaśca kāme kandarpasadṛśaḥ || 23 || buddhau bṛhaspatitulyaḥ kāvye kavisamastathā | vāṇyāṃ sarasvatītulyaḥ pratibhāyāṃ bhṛguprathaḥ || 24|| dhane kuberasadṛśo dāne manurivāparaḥ | dharme dharmasamo dharmī satye satyavrato’paraḥ || 25 || tapasi skandatulyaḥ sadācāre brāhmaṇopamaḥ | aiśvarye śakratulyaśca kṣamāyāṃ bhūmisadṛśaḥ || 26|| evaṃbhūte mṛte kānte prāṇā yānti na naḥ katham | are surā yajñabhājo ghṛtaṃ bhoktuṃ kṣamāḥ katham || 27 || nārāyaṇa jagatkānta śīghraṃ jīvaya naḥ patim | prajāpate mahādeva dharmadeva yameśvara || 28 || jīvayata svāminaṃ no nirdayāḥ syāta vai katham | jīvayatānyathā yuṣmān praśapsyāmaśca mā ciram ||29 || tadā brahmādayaḥ sarve glāniṃ jagmurbhayāt khalu | imā devānpraśapsyanti nāśaṃ yāsyanti devatāḥ || 1.201.30 || aho pativratātejaḥ sarveṣāṃ tejasāṃ param | kimatra pratikartavyaṃ vicārayanti devatāḥ || 31 || etasminnantare’kasmādvāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī | yūyaṃ gacchata śāntyarthaṃ yatra mālāvatī satī || 32 || yogāsanaṃ kurvatī ca śavaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi | devā jagmuśca kauśikītīraṃ yatra pativratā || 33 || mālāvatī surān dṛṣṭvā praṇanāma muhurmuhuḥ | ruroda kāntaṃ saṃsthāpya devānāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ bahu || 34|| etasminnantare tatra viprabālakaveṣadhṛk | ājagāma svayaṃ viṣṇurbibhrattilakamujjvalam || 35 || prāha mālāvatīṃ devāḥ kathamatra samāgatāḥ | brahmā śaṃbhuśca dharmaśca raviścandro hutāśanaḥ || 36 || kālo yamaśca deveśāḥ keyaṃ śavavatī satī | śrutvā mālāvatī natvā tamuvāca vicakṣaṇam || 37 || upabarhaṇabhāryāhaṃ nāmnā mālāvatī satī | imāścānyāḥ svasāro me śavo’yaṃ svāmino’sti naḥ || 38 || divyaṃ dvilakṣaṃ varṣāṇāṃ krīḍitāḥ svāminā vayam | priye sneho hi sādhvīnāṃ cāprameyo hi yoṣitām || 39 || akasmād brahmaṇaḥ śāpāt prāṇām̐statyāja naḥ patiḥ | devānuddiśya vilape yathā jīvetpatirhi naḥ ||1.201.4 0 || sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaḥ santāpo bhadramutsavaḥ | aiśvaryaṃ paramānando janma mṛtyuśca mokṣaṇam ||4 1 || eteṣāṃ janakā devāḥ karmaphalapradāyakāḥ | mūlacchedakarāste ca mūlāṃkurapradāśca te ||42 || nahi devāt paro bandhurna devādrakṣako’paraḥ | dayāvānduḥkhahartā ca na devādvidyate paraḥ || 43 || sarvāndevānahaṃ yāce patidānaṃ mamepsitam | yadi dāsyanti kāntaṃ me bhadraṃ sarvavidhaṃ bhavet || 44|| anyathā tām̐stu śapsyāmi dāruṇaṃ durnivārakam | śrutvaitadviṣṇuravyagraḥ prāha mālāvatīṃ tadā ||45 || karmaṇāṃ phaladātāro devāḥ satyaṃ hi mālike | na sadyaḥ sucireṇaiva dhānyaṃ kṛṣakavannṛṇām ||46 || gṛhī ca kṛṣakadvārā kṣetre dhānyaṃ vapet sati | tadaṃkuro bhavetkāle kāle vṛkṣaḥ phalatyapi || 47 || kāle supakvaṃ bhavati kāle prāpnoti tadgṛhī | evaṃ sarvaṃ samunneyaṃ cireṇa karmaṇaḥ phalam ||48 || na balaṃ na ca saundaryaṃ naiśvaryaṃ na dhanaṃ sutaḥ | naiva strī na ca satkāntaḥ kiṃ bhavet tapasā vinā ||49 || prakṛteḥ sevanāt kāntāṃ sadguṇāṃ labhate janaḥ | śriyaṃ ca niścalāṃ putraṃ pautraṃ bhūmidhanaṃ prabhām || 1.201.50 || śivasya sevanādvidyāṃ jñānaṃ putraṃ parāṃ śriyam | balaṃ dhanaṃ satīṃ nārīṃ santaṃ ca labhate patim || 5 1 || brahmaṇaḥ sevānādvidyaiśvaryaśryānandasatprajāḥ | sūryasya sevanād vidyārogyadhanasutādikān |||52 || gaṇeśasevanādvighnanāśaṃ putradhanādikam | lakṣmīkāntasya dāsyāttu muktiṃ bhuktiṃ sadonnatim || 53 || tapo dharmaṃ yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ sukhaṃ ca labhate janaḥ | iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante śrīhareḥ padam ||54|| śrīhariṃ bhajate yo vai cākṣarātparataḥ param | jīvanmuktaḥ sa satyaṃ hi na varaṃ sa ca vāñcchati || 55 || sa sarvaṃ manute tucchaṃ sālokyādicatuṣṭayam | brahmatvamamaratva vā mokṣaṃ yattucchavat sati || 56 || aiśvaryaṃ loṣṭatulyaṃ ca naśvaraṃ manute’pi ca | indratvaṃ ca manutvaṃ ca ciraṃjīvitvamityapi || 57|| jalabudbudavad buddhyā cāti tucchaṃ vicintati | svapne jāgaraṇe vāpi śaśvat sevāṃ hi vāñcchati || 58 || dāsyaṃ vinā na yāceta śrīhareśca paraṃ padam | tatpādābje dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ labdhvā jāto’sti pūrṇakaḥ || 59 || sa svasya kulakoṭiṃ ca śataṃ mātāmahasya ca | śvaśurasya śataṃ cātha putrādīnāṃ paraṃ śatam || 1.201.60 || dāsaṃ dāsīṃ prasūṃ bhāryāṃ coddhared yāti dhāma tat | guruvaktrādviṣṇumantro yasya karṇe viśatyapi || 61 || yamastallikhana dūraṃ karoti tatkṣaṇaṃ bhiyā | madhuparkādikaṃ brahmā puraiva tanniyojayet || 62 || ābrahmalokavāsāśca mārge tiṣṭhanti pūjakāḥ | aho vilaṃghya no lokaṃ mārgeṇānena yāsyati || 63 || purātanaṃ kṛtaṃ karma yadyat tasya śubhāśubham | kṛṣṇaśchinatti cakreṇa tīkṣṇadhāreṇa santatam || 64|| niḥśaṃko yāti golokaṃ vihāya mānavīṃ tanum | gatvā brāhmīṃ tanuṃ dhṛtvā śrīhariṃ sevate sadā || 65 || yāvat kṛṣṇo hi goloke tāvadbhakto vaset sadā | nimeṣaṃ manute dāso naśvaraṃ brahmaṇo vayaḥ || 66 || kena rogeṇa te sādhvi patirmṛtyuṃ gato vada | mṛtyutulyaṃ mṛtaṃ yadvā saptāhābhyantare sati || 67 || mahauṣadhairmṛtaṃ taṃ ca jīvayāmyeva jīvataḥ | rājamṛtyuṃ yamaṃ kālaṃ vyādhimānīya cātra te || 68 || darśayāmi nibadhyaiva na yataḥ saṃcaret punaḥ | vyādhibījaṃ ca jānāmi bandhamantrām̐śca tattvataḥ || 69 || yogena dehaṃ tyaktvā yo mṛtaste jīvayāmyaham | yaśca viṣeṇa khedena mṛtastaṃ jīvayāmyaham ||1.201.7 0 || śrutvā mālāvatī hṛṣṭā snigdhacittā hyuvāca tam | yadyevaṃ śrīhare śīghraṃ jīvayātra patiṃ mama || 71 || svāmī kartā ca hartā ca śāstā poṣṭā ca rakṣitā | abhīṣṭadevaḥ pūjyaśca na guruḥ svāminaḥ paraḥ || 72|| kanyā satkulasaṃjātā kāntarakṣaṇarakṣitā | upabarhaṇabhāryāhaṃ putrī citrarathasya ca || 73 || vadhūrgandharvarājasya kāntabhaktā sadā hare | tvaṃ tu sarvaṃ kālayituṃ śakto bhavasi mādhava || 74| kālaṃ yamaṃ ca mṛtyuṃ ca madabhyāśaṃ samānaya | śrutvā mālāvatīvākyaṃ bhagavān karuṇākaraḥ ||75|| samāje tānsamāhūya pratyakṣaṃ samadarśayat | mālāvatyā mṛtyukanyā dṛṣṭā tatra samāgatā ||76 || kṛṣṇavarṇā ghorarūpā raktāmbarātibhītidā | ṣaḍbhujā kālanāmnaśca patyurvāme sthitā tathā ||77|| sasmitā krūrabhālā ca catuḥṣaṣṭisutānvitā | dṛṣṭaśca kālo mālatyā ṣaḍvaktro vikaṭaḥ saruṭ ||78 || caturviṃśatinetraśca ṣoḍaśabhuja ugrakaḥ | ṣaṭpādaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaśca raktavastro bhayānakaḥ ||79|| mālāvatyā tathā dṛṣṭā vyādhisaṃghāśca bhītidāḥ | bālā vṛddhāścātivṛddhā yuvānaścātivikṛtāḥ ||1.201.8 0 || dṛṣṭastatra yamaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ krūrasvarūpakaḥ|| dṛṣṭvā mālāvatī pūrvaṃ papraccha dharmaśāsakam ||8 1 || dharmarāja hyakāle tvaṃ kāntaṃ harasi me katham | yamaḥ prāhāprāptakālo na kaścin mriyate bhuvi ||82|| īśvarājñāṃ vinā sādhvi nānṛtaṃ cālayāmyaham | ahaṃ kālo mṛtyukanyā vyādhayaśceśakiṃkarāḥ ||8 3 || niṣekeṇa yathābhāgyaṃ kālayāmaśca dehinam | mṛtyukanyāpi saṃprāha mālike śṛṇu sādaram ||84|| purā viśvasṛjā sṛṣṭāpyahamevātra karmaṇi | na ca kṣamā parityaktuṃ prāptamṛtyuṃ tu dehinam || 85|| satī ca bhasmasātkartuṃ kṣamā yadi bhavet bhave | tadāhaṃ bhasmitā naiva mārayiṣyāmi dehinaḥ ||86 || kālena preritāhaṃ ca matputrā vyādhayastathā | kurmo kāryaṃ yathādiṣṭaṃ na doṣo no’tra kaścana ||87|| mālāvatī tadā kālaṃ prāha nārāyaṇāṃśajam | kathaṃ harasi matkāntaṃ jīvitāyāṃ mayi prabho || 88 || kālaḥ prāha śṛṇu mālāvati sarvaṃ harikṛtam | ko vāhaṃ ko yamaḥ kā ca mṛtyukanyā tathādhayaḥ ||8 9 || vayaṃ bhramāmaḥ satataṃ kṛṣṇājñāparipālakāḥ | yasya sṛjyā vayaṃ sarve māyā brahmādayastathā || 1.201.90 || vairājā ṛṣayo devā mānavāḥ sarvajantavaḥ | yadbhayādvāti vātaśca sūryastapati yadbhayāt || 91 || brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca sṛṣṭṛpālakahārakāḥ | yadbhayācca karmasākṣī yamo dharmaśca vartate || 92 || rāśayaśca grahāścaiva bhramanti yadbhayāt kramāt | digīśāśca diśāṃpālā yasyājñāṃ saṃvahantyapi || 93 || ṛtavo yadbhayādvṛkṣādiṣu caranti puṣpadāḥ | jaladāśca pravarṣanti pṛthvī ca vasudā tathā || 94|| sarvādhārā kṣamāyuktā sarvān rakṣati mātṛvat | māyā sarvaprasūryasya bhayādāpūrikā matā || 95 || yasyāntaṃ na viduḥ sarve yaḥ sarvajño’sti hṛdgataḥ | ṣoḍaśāṃśo’smi tasyāhaṃ kālaḥ sa kālakālakṛt || 96 || tatastaṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ cābhīṣṭadaṃ cintayācyutam | so’yaṃ kṛpānidhiḥ kṛṣṇo bhartāraṃ te pradāsyati || 97 || vayaṃ yatpreritāḥ sarve sa dātā sarvasampadām | ityuktvā virarāmāsau kālaḥ prāha haristu tām || 98 || dṛṣṭaḥ kālo yamo dṛṣṭo mṛtyukanyā tathādhayaḥ | śīghraṃ sati tvayā dṛṣṭāḥ praccha kiṃ te manogatam || 99 || mālāvatyāha durvāro yathā vyādhirna saṃcaret | tadupāyaṃ tu sakalaṃ bhavān vaktumihārhati || 1.201.100 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne upabarhaṇagandharvātmakanāradamṛtyuḥ patnīnāṃ vilāpaḥ brahmādibhyaḥ patijīvanābhyarthanāceti nirūṇanāmaikādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 201 ||
<1.202> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca mālāvatyā vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ | prāha mālāvatīṃ māle śṛṇu vacmi yathātatham || 1 || sarvavyādhipraśamanaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | sa īśaścaturo vedān sasṛje maṃgalāyanān || 2 || ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvākhyān dṛṣṭvā vedān prajāpatiḥ | vicintya teṣāmarthaṃ caivāyurvedaṃ cakāra saḥ || 3 || kṛtvā taṃ paṃcamaṃ vedaṃ bhāskarāya dadau prabhuḥ | cakāra bhāskarastarhi svayaṃ bhāskarasaṃhitām || 4 || bhāskarastu svaśiṣyebhyaḥ pradadau tāṃ tataśca te | cakruśca saṃhitāścānyā vyādhicikitsakakriyāḥ || |9 || cikitsātattvavijñānaṃ dhanvantariścakāra ha | ghanvantarirdivodāsaḥ kāśīrājo’śvinīsutau || 6 || nakulaḥ sahadevo’rkiścyavano janako budhaḥ | jābālo jājaliḥ pailaḥ karatho’gastya ityapi ||| 7 || ete cikitsakāḥ sarve ṣoḍaśa vyādhināśakāḥ | svasvadehacikitsāyāṃ sva eva tu gururbhavet || 8 || tadā rogā na cāyānti naśyanti ca samāgatāḥ | śṛṇu svāsthya yathārakṣyaṃ sāvadhānatayā sati || 9 || cakṣurjalaṃ ca vyāyāmaḥ pādādhastailamardanam | karṇayormūrdhni tailaṃ ca jarāvyādhivināśanam || 1.202.10 || vasante bhramaṇaṃ vahnisevāṃ svalpāṃ karoti yaḥ | bālāṃ ca sevate kāle jarā taṃ nopagacchati || 11 || prātaḥ śītodakasnānaṃ sevate candanadravam | nidāghe pavanaṃ yaśca nopayāti jarā tu tam || 12 || prāvṛṣyuṣṇodakasnānaṃ ghanatoyaṃ na sevate | āhāraṃ samaye pathyaṃ jarā taṃ nopagacchati || 13 || atiśaityaṃ na sahate hemante khātajāplavaḥ | bhuṃkte navānnamuṣṇaṃ ca jarā taṃ nopagacchati || 14|| sadyomāṃsaṃ navānnaṃ ca bālāstrīṃ kṣīrabhojanam | ghṛtaṃ ca sevate yo hi jarā taṃ nopagacchati || 15 || bhuṃkte sadannaṃ kṣutkāle tṛṣāyāṃ pīyate jalam | nityaṃ bhuṃkte ca tāmbūlaṃ navanītaṃ tathā guḍam || 16 || dadhiṃ haiyaṃgavīnaṃ ca taṃ jarā nopagacchati | nityaṃ vyāyāmakartṛṇāṃ jarā dūraṃ palāyate || 17 || vṛddhastriyaṃ śuṣkamāṃsaṃ bālārkaṃ taruṇaṃ dadhi | saṃsevantaṃ jarā yāti prahṛṣṭā bhrātṛbhiḥ saha || 18 || mṛtyukanyāsutāścatuḥṣaṣṭiḥ rujaḥ sutā jarā | jarā ca bhrātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ śaśvad bhramati bhūtale || 19 || rātrau ye dadhi sevante vṛddhāṃ nārīṃ rajasvalām | bahuvyavāyakartārastān jarā grasate drutam || 1.202.20 || kṣudhi jājvalyamānāyāmāhāro labhyate nahi | prāṇināṃ jāyate pittaṃ cakre ca maṇipūrake || 21 || tālabilvaphalaṃ bhuktvā jalapānaṃ ca tatkṣaṇam | tadeva tu bhavet pittaṃ sadyaḥ prāṇaharaṃ param || 22|| taptodakaṃ ca śirasi bhādre tiktaṃ bhunakti yaḥ | apathye ca punarbhuṃkte pittaṃ tasya prajāyate ||23 || saśarkaraṃ tu dhānyākaṃ piṣṭaṃ śītodakānvitam | caṇakaṃ sarvagavyaṃ ca dadhitakravivarjitam || 24|| bilvatālaphalaṃ pakvaṃ sarvabhaikṣavamityapi | ārdrakaṃ mudgayūṣaṃ ca tilapiṣṭaṃ saśarkaram || 25|| pittakṣayakaraṃ sadyo balapuṣṭipradaṃ param | bhojanānantaraṃ snānaṃ jalapānaṃ vinātṛṣām || 26|| paryuṣitānnaṃ takraṃ ca pakvaṃ raṃbhāphalaṃ dadhi | meghāmbuśarkarātoyaṃ āvilavārisecanam || 27|| nārikelodakaṃ mūlakaṃ tathā karkaṭīphalam | khātasnānaṃ ca varṣāsu sarvaṃ tacchle’ṣakārakam || 28 || brahmarandhre ca tajjanma mahadvīryavināśanam | marīcaṃ pippalī śuṣkamārdrakaṃ jīvakaṃ madhu || 29|| vahniseveti vastūni sadyaḥ śleṣmaharāṇi hi | balapuṣṭikarāṇyeva roganāśakarāṇi ca || 1.202.30 || tvatkāntaḥ kena doṣeṇa mṛtaḥ kathaya śobhane | śrutvā mālāvatī prāha mṛto yogena me patiḥ || 31 || adhunā prāṇakāntaṃ me dehi dehi janārdana | natvā vaḥ svāminā sārdhaṃ yāsyāmaḥ svagṛhaṃ striyaḥ || 32 || śrutvā janārdanaḥ śīghraṃ yayau vai devasaṃsadam | prāhopabarhaṇabhāryā kanyā citrarathasya ca || 3ā || yayāce jīvadānaṃ svasvāminaḥ svasṛbhiḥ saha | śaptukāmā surānsarvān śāntyarthaṃ bodhitā mayā || 3 4|| anuṣṭhānamadhunā ki tvasya kāryasya niścitam | brahmā prāha tadā viṣṇuṃ nāradaścopabarhaṇaḥ || 35|| prāṇān yogena tatyāja punaḥ śāpānmamaiva tu | kālaṃ lakṣayugaṃ vyāpya sthitistvasya mahītale || 36|| śūdrayoniṃ tataḥ prāpya bhavitā matsutaḥ punaḥ | asya kālāvaśeṣasya kiṃcidasti pareśvara || 37|| tattu varṣasahasraṃ caivāyurasyāsti sāmpratam | dāsyāmi jīvadānaṃ ca svayaṃ viṣṇoḥ prasādataḥ ||38 || yathaitānna bhavecchāpastatkariṣyāmi niścitam | viṣiśca vyāptivacano nuśca sarvatravācakaḥ || 3 9|| sarvavyāpī sa vai viṣṇurjīvadānaṃ karotu vai | ityuktvā ca prayayuste yatra mālāvatī vadhūḥ ||1.202.4 0 || brahmā kamaṇḍaluvāri dadau gātre śavasya ca | sañcāraṃ manasastasya cakāra sundaraṃ vapuḥ ||41 || śivo jñānaṃ dadau tasmai dharmo dharmaṃ dadau tataḥ | jāṭharaṃ ca dadau vahniḥ prāṇaṃ dadau tadānilaḥ |||42|| sūryo dṛṣṭiṃ dadau tasmai vāṇī vākyaṃ dadau tadā | lakṣmīrdadau ca saundaryaṃ kriyāṃ dadau śacīpatiḥ ||43|| śavastathāpi nottasthau jīvaṃ viṣṇurdadau tadā | viśiṣṭabodhanaṃ prāpa nottasthau sākṣiṇaṃ vinā ||44|| tadā mālābatī śokaṃ prāptā nanāma mādhavam | tvāṃ vinā me patirnāsti patirūpastvameva me ||45|| prāṇarūpaḥ prāṇināṃ tvaṃ samujjīvaya me patim | hariḥ svaśaktibhistatra tvadhiṣṭhānaṃ cakāra vai ||46|| tāvadutthāya gandharvo vīṇāṃ dhṛtvā ca vāsasī | devasaṃghaṃ praṇanāma viṣṇuṃ ca purataḥ sthitam || 47|| nedurdundubhayastatra puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūttadā | sarve devāśca dampatyoḥ pradaduḥ paramāśiṣaḥ ||48|| upabarhaṇanāmāsau nanarta ca jagau tadā | jīvitaṃ purataḥ prāpa devānāṃ vai prasādataḥ ||49|| jagāma sārdhaṃ palībhirgandharvanagaraṃ punaḥ | ratnakoṭiṃ tadā rājñyo dhanāni niyutaṃ gavām ||1.202.50|| pradadurbrāhmaṇebhyo bhojayāmāsuśca tānbahūn | mahotsavaṃ ca vividhaṃ kārayāmāsurādarāt ||51|| cakruśca vividhānveṣān svāsāṃ ca svāminaḥ kṛte | bhartuścakruśca śuśrūṣāṃ pūjāṃ ca samayocitām ||52|| tena sārdhaṃ surucirā remire suciraṃ ca tāḥ | yena mantreṇa tāḥ sarvā gandharvaṃ lebhire patim ||53|| vaśiṣṭhena pradattena mantraṃ taṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaram | stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ tadvai śṛṇu tvaṃ kamaleśvari ||54|| oṃ namo bhagavate rāsamaṇḍaleśāya svāhā | imaṃ mantraṃ kalpavṛkṣaṃ jānāhi ṣoḍaśākṣaram || 55|| goloke kṛṣṇa īśāya dattavān ca tataḥ param | brahmaṇe tu purā kṛṣṇaḥ puṣkare dattavām̐stathā ||56 || kumārāya dattavām̐śca brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | brahmāṇḍapāvanasyāsya kavacasya hariḥ svayam ||57|| ṛṣiśchandaśca gāyatrī devo’haṃ bhagavānhariḥ | dhamārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ sadā mataḥ ||58|| trilakṣavārajapanāt sarvasiddhiprado bhavet | praṇavo me śiraḥ pātu namo rāmeśvarāya ca ||59|| bhālaṃ pāyānnetrayugmaṃ namo rādheśvarāya ca | kṛṣṇaḥ pāyācchrotrayugmamaṃ śrīharirghrāṇamityapi ||1.202.60 || jihvikāṃ vahnijāyā tu kṛṣṇāya sarvato namaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇāya svāheti ca kāṣṭhaṃ pātu ṣaḍakṣaraḥ ||6 1 || hrīṃ kṛṣṇāya namo vaktraṃ klīṃ pūrvaśca bhujadvayam | namo gopāṃganeśāya skandhāvaṣṭākṣaro’vatu ||6 2|| dantapaṃktimoṣṭhayugmaṃ namo gopīśvarāya ca | oṃ namo bhagavate rāsamaṇḍaleśāya svāhā || 63 || harirvakṣaḥsthalaṃ pātu mantrātmā ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ | śrīkṛṣṇāya svāheti oṃ karṇayugmaṃ sadāvatu || 64||| oṃ viṣṇave svāheti ca kapolaṃ sarvato’vatu | oṃ haraye nama iti pṛṣṭhaṃ pādau sadāvatu ||65|| oṃ govardhanadhāriṇe svāhā sarvaśarīrakam | prācyāṃ māṃ pātu śrīkṛṣṇa āgneyyāṃ pātu mādhavaḥ ||66 || dakṣiṇe pātu gopīśo nairṛtyāṃ nandanandanaḥ | vāruṇyāṃ pātu govindo vāyavyāṃ rādhikeśvaraḥ ||67|| uttare pātu rāseśa aiśānyāmacyutaḥ svayam | satataṃ sarvataḥ pātu harirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||68|| gurumabhyarcya vidhivad vastrālaṃkāracandanaiḥ | snātvā taṃ ca namaskṛtya kavacaṃ dhārayet sudhīḥ ||69|| kavacasya prasādena jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ | yadi syāt siddhakavaco viṣṇureva bhavet priye ||1.202.7 0 || asya pāṭhāt mahatpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhavet | aputro labhate putram abhāryo labhate satīm ||7 1 || vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ dhanārthī dhanamāpnuyāt | bhraṣṭarājyo labhedrājyamaiśvaryaṃ siddhikāmanaḥ |||72|| rogārto mucyate rogād baddho mucyeta bandhanāt | bhaktiṃ prāpya hareścānte labhate dhāma cākṣaram ||73|| iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā kṛtvā kīrtiṃ sudurlabhām | pārṣadapravaro bhūtvā golokaṃ dhāma yāti ca ||74|| evaṃ gandharvapravaraḥ upabarhaṇasaṃjñakaḥ | reme kālāvaśeṣaṃ ca tābhiḥ patnībhirādarāt ||75|| nānāvidhān kratuvarān cakāra ca sutaiḥ saha | atha kāle brahmaśāpāt prāṇān tyaktvopabarhaṇaḥ ||76|| sa jajñe vṛṣalīgarbhe brahmabījena śāpataḥ | mālāvatī vahnikuṇḍe prāṇām̐statyāja vai satī ||77|| anyāścāpi ca vaidhavyaṃ dharmamāptāḥ sthitāḥ sadā | manuvaṃśaprajātasya nṛpasya saṃjayasya sā ||78|| patnyāṃ jātismarā jajñe patirme bhaviteti saḥ | upabarhaṇagandharvapramadāhaṃ sadābhavam ||79|| kānyakubje ca deśe vai drumilo nāma rājakaḥ | tasya kalāvatī patnī vandhyā cāpi pativratā ||1.202.80|| svāmidoṣeṇa sā vandhyā ṛtau bhartuḥ samājñayā | upatasthe vane ghore nāradaṃ kāśyapaṃ munim ||8 1|| yo vai dakṣasya śāpena kaśyapasya suto’bhavat | taṃ ca kaśyapaputraṃ vai dvitīyaṃ nāradaṃ yayau ||82|| śrīkṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyamānaṃ ca jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā | tasthau suveṣaṃ kṛtvā sā dhyānānte ca muneḥ puraḥ ||83|| dadarśa nāradaścāgre sundarīṃ sthirayauvanām | svarṇavarṇāṃ svarṇabhūṣāṃ candrāsyāṃ kaṃjalocanām ||84|| putrecchayā ca samprāptāṃ kāmaśṛṃgāraśobhitām | muniḥ papraccha tāṃ rājñīṃ kā tvaṃ kasyāsi me vada ||85|| kalāvatī hariṃ smṛtvā tadā provāca nāradam | drumilasyāsmi bhāryāhaṃ gopikā bharturājñayā ||86|| putrārthinī sannidhau te cāgatāsmi kṛpāṃ kuru | vīryādhānaṃ kuru yonau strī nopekṣyā hyupasthitā ||87|| tejīyasāṃ na doṣāya vahneḥ sarvabhujo yathā | nāradaḥ prāha dharmātmā brāhmaṇo dharmamācaran ||88|| yaḥ śūdrapatnīṃ gṛhṇāti brāhmaṇo jñānadurbalaḥ | sa jātyā hīnatā gacchenna karmārho dvijātiṣu ||89|| pitṛśrāddhe ca yajñe ca śilāsparśe surārcane | adhikāravihīnaḥ syāt śūdryāṃ gacchati vai dvijaḥ || 1.202.90|| tadiṣṭadevo gṛhṇāti naivedyaṃ na tajjalam | sa vipro śūdrayonau ca gṛhṇāti janma tatphalam ||9 1 || tvayoktaṃ na ca doṣāya tejīyasāmṛtaṃ ca tat | dūrād dadāmi te bījaṃ gṛhāṇa śaktirasti cet |||92|| garbhe dhāraya sāmarthyāt tadā doṣo na vidyate | nāhaṃ samāgamaṃ kurve bhavet doṣaḥ samāgame ||93|| ityuktā sā śūdrapatnī pātivratyaparāyaṇā | smṛtvā svakīyabhartāraṃ dhyānamagnābhavattadā ||94|| sthūlaṃ dehaṃ vilīyaiva sūkṣmadehena nārade | prāviśat sarvathā yogānnārado’pi kṣaṇaṃ tadā ||95|| na bubudhe svakaṃ dehaṃ sakāmaṃ dhātusaṃbhṛtam | tasyāḥ praveśayogena sthūladehācca svapnavat ||96|| sarjapatrastare tatra munervīryaṃ papāta ha | drāgeva śūdrī jagrāha pītvā garbhe rarakṣa sā ||97|| muniṃ praṇamya prahṛṣṭā saṃgaṃ vinārthasādhikā | muniścāpi saṃhṛṣṭo’bhūt saṃgadoṣaṃ vinārthakṛt ||98|| gatvā bhartuḥ sannidhau sā vṛttāntaṃ prāha sarvathā | drumilo’pi prasanno’bhūt prāha kāntāṃ sukhāvaham ||99|| nāradasya vaiṣṇavasya tvadgarbhe vīryameva yat | vaiṣṇavo bhavitā bālo nāradāṃśaḥ sa eva saḥ || 1.202.10 0|| yadgarbhe vaiṣṇavo jāto yasya vīryeṇa vā sati | tayoryāti ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ śatam || 10 1|| tau ca viṣṇuvimānena divyena ratnaśobhinā | yātārau vaikuṇṭhapuraṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam || 1 02|| ityuktvā goparājaḥ saḥ snātvā kṛtvā ca tarpaṇam | sampūjyābhīṣṭadevaṃ ca brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dadau || 1 03|| gajāśvarathagohaṃsadāsadāsīsahasrakam | pātrabhūṣāmbararatnaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā || 104|| patnīṃ putrānvitagarbhāṃ dṛṣṭvā hariṃ hṛdi smaran | vaṃśatantuṃ śubhaṃ jñātvā vairāgyamagamat tataḥ || 1 05|| jagāma badarīkṣetraṃ prāṇān tatyāja yogataḥ | vimānena harerdūtairvaikuṇṭhaṃ sa jagāma ha || 1 06|| tatra prāpa harerdāsyaṃ haridāso babhūva saḥ | brāhmaṇaiḥ rakṣitā devī kalāvatī samāntare || 107|| taptakāṃcanavarṇābhaṃ suṣuve tanayaṃ śubham | kāmadevādhikaṃ rūpe jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā || 1 08|| padmacakrāṃkitapādaṃ dhanurdhvajakarābjakam | svarṇaurdhvatilakaṃ vakṣaḥsthalaṃ mālāṃkaśobhitam || 10 9|| viṣṇurūpaṃ ca tajjñātvā sarve mumudire janāḥ | pupuṣurbrāhmaṇāstāṃ saputrāṃ rājñīṃ yathā sutām || 1.202.11 0|| saputrā sā brāhmaṇānāṃ dāsīva sevate dvijān | sa bālo vavṛdhe tatra śuklapakṣe yathā śaśī || 111 || jātismaro jñānayuktaḥ pūrvamantrasmaraḥ sadā | tasya janmakṣaṇe nāraṃ jalaṃ bhūmau vavarṣa ha || 1 12|| janmakāle dadau nāraṃ tenāyaṃ nāradaḥ smṛtaḥ | dadāti nāraṃ jñānaṃ ca bālebhyaśceti nāradaḥ || 1 13|| vīryeṇa nāradasyaiva babhūva nāradastataḥ | gāyane ca narān kaṇṭhaṃ dadau tenāpi nāradaḥ || 1 14|| no’rtho nārāyaṇaḥ prokto hyaraṃ śīghraṃ dadāti yaḥ | śīghraṃ nārāyaṇadānānnāradaśca prakīrtitaḥ || 1 15|| radā dantāśca yeṣāṃ na te’radā vṛddhatānvitāḥ | aradā vṛddhatā yasya nāsti sa nāradaściraḥ || 11 6|| babhūva kāle bālaḥ saḥ krameṇa pañcahāyanaḥ | gāyati satataṃ kṛṣṇayaśogānaguṇādikam || 1 17|| kṛṣṇagāthāṃ prakurvaṃśca dhūlinaivedyamīrayan | dhūliṣupratimāṃ kṛtvā dhūlinārcayati prabhum || 118 || putramāhvayate mātā prātarāśāya taṃ śiśum | hariṃ saṃpūjayāmīti pratyuttaraṃ pravakti saḥ || 119 || śiśavaḥ pañcavarṣīyā brāhmaṇāḥ suhṛdaśca te | pracchannaṃ hṛtavantaśca catvāraḥ sanakādayaḥ || 1.202.120 || nāmamantraṃ harerdīkṣāṃ dadustasmai vidhānataḥ | mūlaphalādikaṃ bāladattaṃ te munipuṃgavāḥ || 121 || catvāraḥ saṃbubhujire taccheṣaṃ bubhuje śiśuḥ | caturthako munistasmai kṛṣṇamantraṃ dadau tadā || 122 || evaṃ śūdrīsutaḥ so’yaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ prasaṃgataḥ | ṛṣīṇāmannapātrāṇāṃ bubhuje dāsavacchubham || 123 || saṃśuddho gopikābālo vipragehe dine dine | kaṣāyā jajvaluḥ sarve ārṣaprasādabhojanāt || 1 24|| sādhūnāṃ bhojanocchiṣṭaṃ prasādayati cāntaram | vidhunoti mahatpāpaṃ pavitrayati mānasam || 1 25||| āpādayati vijñānaṃ vardhayatyātmasattvatām | vinirmalayati śraddhāṃ sampādayati rādhanām || 1 26|| uttejayati satprema bhaktiṃ vardhayati dhruvām | prayojayati tanmūrtau preṣayatyakṣaraṃ padam || 127|| nārado muniviprāṇāṃ patrāvalyodanādikam | prāsādikaṃ prabhuktvaiva divyatāmagamat khalu || 128 || ekadā śiśumātā sā gacchantī niśi vartmani | mamāra sarpadaṣṭā drāk harismaraṇamānasā || 129|| sadyo jagāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ viṣṇupārṣadasaṃyutā | viṣṇuyānena sadratnanirmitena hi sā satī || 1.202.130 || tadūrdhvadaihikaṃ kṛtvā tasthau gaṃgātaṭe śiśuḥ | tatra snātvā vipradattaṃ harermantraṃ jajāpa saḥ || 131 || tīre vṛkṣeṣu madhye sa hyaśvatthamūlasannidhau | kṛtvā yogāsanaṃ tasthau dadhyau mūrtiṃ harestathā || 13 2.|| mantraṃ jajāpa dvāviṃśatyakṣaraṃ śrīhariṃ smaran | oṃ śrīṃ namo bhagavate rāsamaṇḍaleśvarāya || 133 || śrīkṛṣṇāya svāheti ca mantraṃ jajāpa kalpadrum | dhyānaṃ cakāra devasya kṛṣṇasyātimanoharam || 1 34|| cintayati sma govindaṃ navyajīmūtasundaram | śaratpaṃkajanetraṃ ca śaraccandraśubhānanam || 1 35|| pakvabimbauṣṭhasacchobhaṃ kundābhadantarājitam | sasmitaṃ muralīhastaṃ koṭikandarpasundaram || 136 || koṭicandraprabhābhāntaṃ puṣṭaśrīvyāptayauvanam | tribhaṃgaṃ dvibhujaṃ pītavāsasaṃ kaustubhānvitam || 137|| ratnakeyūravalayasvarṇanūpurabhūṣitam | ratnakuṇḍalakarṇaṃ cojjvalagaṇḍapraśobhitam || 1 38|| mayūrapucchacūḍaṃ ca ratnamālāḍhyavakṣasam | ājānulambahastaṃ ca vanamālāsudhāriṇam || 1 39|| candanādidravadehaṃ bhaktānugrahatatparam | vakralocanagopībhirvīkṣitaṃ krīḍayā mudā || 1.202.140|| ūnapañcadaśavarṣasvarūpagopikāyutam | rādhāramāmahālakṣmīsevitaṃ bhūṣitaṃ varam || 141|| kiśoraṃ gopikākāntaṃ nirliptaṃ nirguṇaṃ harim | dadhyau sa nārado devaḥ paramātmānamacyutam || 142|| divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ sa nirāhāraḥ kṛśodaraḥ | yogasiddhaḥ kṛṣṇayogāt prāṇadhāraṇaśaktimān || 143|| mantrayogāddadarśāyaṃ divyalokasthabālakam | ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇaśobhitam || 144|| kiśoravayasaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gopaveṣaṃ susundaram | pītāmbarayutaṃ gopagopīgaṇasusevitam || 145|| dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ kastūrīcandanārcitam | dṛṣṭvā ca śāntavadanaṃ śāntaśca gopikāsutaḥ || 146|| tirobhūtaṃ ca tadrūpaṃ punarnaiva dadarśa saḥ | rurodāśvatthamūle sa na dṛṣṭvā śyāmasundaram || 147|| babhūvākāśavāṇī ca hitasatyamitākṣarā | sakṛdyaddarśitaṃ rūpaṃ punardrakṣyasi nādhunā || 148|| api pakvakaṣāyāṇāṃ durdarśaṃ ca kuyoginām | asmindehe layaṃ yāte prāpte divye ca varṣmaṇi || 149|| punardrakṣyasi govindaṃ golokasthaṃ hariṃ prabhum | śrutveti virarāmāsau kāle tatyāja tāṃ tanum || 1.202.150 || kṛṣṇaṃ smaran yayau śāpamukto nārada aiśvaram | padaṃ golokadhāmākhyaṃ nedurdundubhayastadā || 151 || puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūvātha vilīno brahmavigrahe | punaśca brahmaṇaḥ putro jāto brāhmaṇanāradaḥ || 152||| āvirbhāvatirobhāvau svecchayā muktadehinām | janmamṛtyurjarāvyādhirbhaktānāṃ nāsti padmaje || 153|| punaryugāntare’tīte sraṣṭuḥ sṛṣṭau ca nāradaḥ | vidhernāradanāmnaśca kaṇṭhadeśād babhūva saḥ || 154|| nāradaśceti vikhyāto munīndro mānasaḥ sutaḥ | kṛṣṇarūpo nārado’yaṃ harermānasamucyate || 155|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āyurvedādirītyā vyādhināśanopāyāḥ mālāvatī prārtha nayā upabarhaṇasya punarjīvanadānaṃ tatpradaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaramantrakavacaṃ punaḥ drumilaśūdrasya gopasya kalā vatyā kāśyapanāradavīryadvārā nāradajanmasanatkumāradvārā vaiṣṇavī dīkṣā mātṛmaraṇottaraṃ varṣasahasraṃ tapastaptvā dehaṃ tyaktvā golokaṃ prāpa punarbrahmaṇaḥ kaṇṭhādutpattirityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 202 ||
<1.203> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca brahmā ca prerayāmāsa sṛṣṭiṃ kartuṃ ca nāradam | sarveṣāmapi vandyānāṃ janakaḥ paramo guruḥ || 1 || vidyāgururmantragururdvau śreṣṭhau pitrapekṣayā | tavāhaṃ janmadātā ca vidyādātā ca mantradaḥ || 2 || mamājñayā ca matprītyā kurupatnīparigraham | gurorājñākaraḥ śiṣyaḥ putraḥ santārayet pitṝn || 3 || kṣemaṃ ca labhate nityaṃ śāśvataṃ laukikaṃ tathā | saḥ paṇḍitaḥ sa ca jñānī kṣemī ca puṇyavānsa ca || 4 || medhāvī vinayī bhāgyaśālī svargādhikāravān | gurorvacaskaro yaḥ syāt kṣemaṃ tasya pade pade || 5 || sarvāśramāśrayadātā gṛhyāśramo hi puṇyavān | putrapautrakalatrāḍhyaṃ bhavanaṃ tapasaḥ phalam || 6 || pitaraḥ parvakāle ca pūjākāle tu devatāḥ | bhikṣākāle ca munayaḥ samāyānti gṛhigṛham || 7 || nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāryamarjayanti gṛhāśramāḥ | bhuktvā sarvaṃ sukhaṃ tvatra yānti svargaṃ mahatsukham || 8 || gṛhastho dhanavān kīrtidharmānandādimān sukhī | jīvanmukto mṛte’mutra mukta eva na saṃśayaḥ || 9 || mṛtasyāpi yaśodeho vartata sa ca jīvati | jīvato’pi yaśodeho nāsti mṛtaḥ sa vai sadā || 1.203.1 0|| vidyā labhyā tathā kīrtirlabhyā bhaktiśca mādhave | dārā labhyāḥ śubhā lakṣmīḥ svargaṃ labhyaṃ sutādibhiḥ || 11 || puṇyaṃ labhyaṃ tathārogyaṃ labhyaṃ vai śāśvataṃ sukham | aihikaṃ ca tathā pāralaukikaṃ labhyamuttamam || 12 || kāryaṃ bhogyaṃ gṛhirītyāsaṃgena yativat sadā | sadā vai bandhanaṃ nāstītyāha nārāyaṇo hi mām || 13 || śrutvaitannāradaḥ prāha satīṣṭatve pravartate | na me’stīṣṭasādhanatvamaniṣṭānanubandhitā || 14|| kathaṃ pravarte nāryāṃ vai kāraṇābhāvabandhakāt | pūrvajanmasu caitasya viṣayasya virodhane || 1 5|| tvacchāpādabhavaṃ mṛtvā gandharvaḥ śūdrakastathā | kālena śāpānmukto’haṃ virodho na sukhāya vai || 1 6|| sa guruśca pitā bandhuḥ sutaḥ svāmī sa rakṣakaḥ | yaḥ śrīnārāyaṇabhaktiṃ bodhayetkāraye dṛḍhām || 1 7|| asanmārgāsthitabālanivṛttirucitā pituḥ | sanmārgarodhake dāramārge pravartayet katham || 18|| patnīgrāho mahāgrāho duḥkhāyaiva hi kevalam | tapaḥsvargajīvanmuktimahāmuktinirodhakṛt || 19 || nāryastredhā vibhidyante sādhvī svārthā virodhinī | dharmaṃ matvā nāthasevāṃ karoti sukhadā sadā || 1.203.2 0 || svadharmaniratā sādhvī sukhaduḥkhasamā hi sā | atha svasyā arthasiddhyai kurute kāntasevanam || 21 || bhogārthaṃ kāntasevāṃ ca nānyathā svārthinī hi sā | vastrālaṃkārasaṃbhogasnigdhāhāradhanādikam || 22 || yāvacca dīyate patyā tāvatsvārthā tu sevikā | atha kāpaṭyabhāvena patiṃ vānyaṃ ca sevate || 2 3 || svasya vātha parasyātha yasyā nāsti samādaraḥ | sarve kāmapradā yogyā narāḥ prakalpitā yayā || 24 || sā tu viruddhadharmasthā virodhinī tṛtīyakā | hṛdayaṃ kṣuradhārābhaṃ śaratpadmotsavaṃ mukham || 25 || sudhāmadhuraṃ vacanaṃ sarvaṃ svārtha striyā matam | viṣatulyā prakope syād viśvāse nāśakāriṇī || 26 || abhiprāye’tigūḍhā syāt karma stenamayaṃ sadā | avinayastathā svārthaḥ sāhasaṃ chalamanṛtam || 27|| māyā kāpaṭyamaśuciścaite’ṣṭo tatsvabhāvajāḥ | puṃsaścāṣṭaguṇaḥ śaśvatkāmadevo’tikālahṛt || 28|| āhāro dviguṇo nityaṃ naiṣṭhuryaṃ ca caturguṇam | krodhaścātha haṭhaścāpi ṣaḍguṇāstatra santi hi || 29 || sneho daśaguṇaḥ svārthaḥ ṣoḍaśādhiguṇo’sti vai | evaṃ doṣagrahe nārīdehe kāsthā pitāmaha |||1.203.3 0 || malamūtrādikhanyākhye kā krīḍāśuddhavarṣmaṇi | bhoge tejaḥkṣayaḥ sakhye kīrternāśo dhanakṣayaḥ || 3 1|| vapuḥkṣayo’tisaṃbhoge kalahe mānasaṃkṣayaḥ | viśvāse sarvanāśaśca bandhane mokṣarodhanam || 32|| hānireva tayā klṛptā ko lābhaḥ pramadāgrahe | yāvaddhanaṃ yuvāvasthā tāvatsvīyānyathā tu na ||3 3 || vṛddhaṃ niḥsvaṃ tathā rugṇaṃ patiṃ sā prekṣate’priyam | śvavat lokācārabhayād dadātyāhāramalpakam || 34|| sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvajña vidāyaṃ dehi sāmpratam | kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ prārthayāmi yayāce tapa uttamam || 35 || natvā stutvā ca yācitvā kṣamāṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam | gacchantaṃ tanayaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣaṇaṃ brahmā śuśoca ha ||36|| yadi tvaṃ tapase yāsi kiṃ me saṃsārakarmaṇi | sanakaśca sanandaśca tṛtīyaśca sanātanaḥ || 37|| turyaḥ sanatkumāraścetaraḥ sanatsujātakaḥ | yatirhaṃsiścāruṇiśca voḍhuḥ paṃcaśikhastathā ||38|| putrāste tapase yātāḥ kiṃ me saṃsārakarmaṇi | anye’vivekino’sādhyāḥ kiṃ me saṃsārakarmaṇi ||39|| nodanālakṣaṇamarthaṃ dharmaṃ vāñcchanti paṇḍitāḥ | vipro dhṛtvā yajñasūtraṃ vedānadhītya śaktitaḥ ||1.203.40 || parisamāpya tatpaścāt dadāti gurudakṣiṇām | tataḥ sādhvīṃ sukulajāṃ suvinītāṃ samudvahet ||41 || na nārī bandhanaṃ proktaṃ bandhanaṃ vāsanā matā | avāsano janaḥ sādhvīyukto’pi muktimṛcchati ||42|| strīṇāṃ doṣāśca ye proktā na te satpatisaṃbhave | patiḥ kupathagāmī syāt tadā kiṃ strīvidūṣaṇam ||43|| sati svāmini patnyāśca doṣā bhavanti sadguṇāḥ | guṇāguṇau patyadhīnau yathā svāmī tathā satī ||44|| na doṣo’sti ca kanyānāṃ yathābījaṃ tathāphalam | kṣetraṃ tu sarvathā śuddhaṃ yathā khādyaṃ tathāṅkuram ||45|| striyastu sukhalābhāya narāṇāṃ vai vinirmitāḥ | sahante sarvamākrośaṃ vaśībhavanti sarvadā ||46 || duḥkhaṃ svayamanugṛhya sukhākurvanti satpatim | tāpatrayavidagdhasya narasyārāmasādhanam ||47|| nārīratnaṃ mayā sṛṣṭaṃ na doṣaṃ dātumarhasi | pitrā parāya dattā sā kanyā sarvaṃ vihāya vai ||48|| yāti gauriva nirduḥkhā raṃkāṃ mā ninda nārada | parādhīnā sadā tvanyāśrayā dāsīva kiṃkarī ||4 9 || mānaṃ vihāya sevāyāṃ sthitāṃ mā ninda nārada | ākare padmarāgāṇāṃ janma kācamaṇeḥ kutaḥ ||1.203.50 || tad vatsa sukhadāḥ sarvā yoṣitaḥ kamalāṃśajāḥ | nirguṇaṃ svāminaṃ sādhvī sevate ca praśaṃsati ||51 || sādhuḥ sadvaṃśajāṃ kanyāṃ gṛhṇīyāddharmanetravān | tasyāṃ putrānsamutpādya vārdhakye tapase vrajet || 52 || matto’dhītastvayā vedo mahyaṃ ca gurudakṣiṇām | putra dehīdameveha kuru patnīparigraham ||5 3 || vatsa tvaṃ kulajāṃ kanyāṃ pūrvapatnīṃ ca mālatīm | manuvaṃśīyasṛṃjayaputrīṃ tapaḥparāyaṇām ||54 || gṛhṇīṣva tāṃ tava patnīṃ vivāhaṃ kuru putraka | vaiṣṇavastaṃ gṛhe tiṣṭha kuru bhaktiṃ hareḥ sadā ||55 || ādau brahma tato nārī tato vanagatistataḥ | antarbāhye hariryasya tasya kiṃ tapasā suta ||5 6 || nāntarbāhye hariryasya tasya kiṃ tapasā suta | nārīṃ prāpya hariṃ rakṣa nāryāṃ hariravasthitaḥ ||57|| putrā harikṛtā bodhyā narakatrāṇakā yataḥ | tapasāpi hariḥ sevyaḥ sevā hi paramaṃ tapaḥ ||58 || tapasā sevayā caiva muktirlabhyeti tatphalam | vatsa madvacanenaiva gṛhe sthitvā hariṃ bhaja |||59 || pitṛprasādaḥ prāptavyo’pākartavyamṛṇaṃ pituḥ | dārāgrahaṇasādhyaṃ tat kuru vai dārasaṃgraham || 1.203.60 || dārāsukhaṃ kāmasukhaṃ copasparśasukhaṃ mahat | tataḥ sukhatamaṃ putradarśanaṃ tad gṛhī bhava || 61 || putraprayojanā kāntā sarvebhyaḥ preyasī hi sā | śatakāntāpriyaḥ putro nāsti putrāt paraḥ priyaḥ || 62|| sarvebhyo jayamanvicchetputrācchiṣyātparābhavam | putra ātmā suto bandhurnyasyet tatrātmasaddhajam ||63 || śrutvaitannāradaḥ prāha pitarjānannapi svayam | jalabudbudatulye’tra pravartayasi māṃ katham || 64|| vihāya haridāsyaṃ me mā bhūt nṛjanma niṣphalam | kasya patnī sutaḥ kasya patiḥ kasyāśca bāndhavāḥ || 65|| sarvaṃ karmakṛtaṃ jālaṃ bandhanaṃ cetanātmakam | yo vai mocayati tasmāt sa pitā sa guruḥ sakhā || 66|| bandhanaṃ tu dadātyeṣu vinirbandhanacetanam | mokṣāttu pātayan taṃ sa ripuḥ saṃsārayojakaḥ || 67 || kintu mumukṣuṇā grāhyaṃ piturvākyaṃ caturthakam | nāṃgīkṛtaṃ trivāraṃ te tatphalaṃ prāptamārtidam ||68|| prathame mānase putre tavājñā naiva pālitā | tena mṛtyurmama jāto mārīco hyabhavam̐stataḥ ||69|| punarmṛteśca gandharvastato mṛtyośca śūdrajaḥ | tato mṛterayaṃ brāhmo bhavāmyatra caturthakaḥ ||1.203.70 || tasmād yogyāpyayogyā vā tavājñā śirasi dhṛtā | prasanno bhava me brahman yenāhaṃ syāṃ sadā sukhī ||7 1|| ādau yāsyāmi bhagavannaranārāyaṇāśramam | nārāyaṇakathāṃ śrutvā kariṣye dārasaṃgraham ||72|| yathāhaṃ dārayoge’pi nirbandhaḥ syāṃ sadā pitaḥ | tathāśiṣaḥ pradātavyā na niruddhyeta mokṣaṇam ||73 || dehi me kṛṣṇamantraṃ ca sārthaṃ tadguṇavarṇanam | brahmā prāha tadā putraṃ sarvajñānākaraṃ priyam ||74|| patyurmantraṃ piturmantraṃ na gṛhṇīyāt kadācana | gururmaheśvaraste’sti prāktano gacchataṃ prati ||75|| śrutvā praṇamya pitaraṃ śivalokaṃ yayau muniḥ | dvitīyamiva vaikuṇṭhaṃ sarvasmṛddhisamanvitam ||76|| koṭyabjārbudalakṣaiśca gaṇaiśca pārṣadottamaiḥ | vikaṭairbhairavaiḥ kṣetraiḥ kalpavṛkṣaiśca śobhitam ||77|| śivaṃ dadarśa madhyasthaṃ gaṇānāṃ divyasaṃsadi | trinetraṃ pañcavaktraṃ ca gaṃgāḍhyaṃ candraśekharam ||78|| svarṇacaṃcajjaṭājūṭaṃ japantaṃ mālayā harim | nīlakaṇṭhaṃ sarpasūtraṃ yogisiddhādivanditam ||79|| prasannaṃ śāntidaṃ bhaktapriyaṃ paramavaiṣṇavam | gatvā namāma tuṣṭāva tritantrīṃ kvaṇayan jagau ||1.203.80|| dadau ca śaṃkarastasmai cāsanaṃ yogyamarhaṇam | papracchāgamasaddhyeyaṃ cātithyaṃ pracakāra ca ||8 1 || munirnivedanaṃ cakre mantrārthāgamanādikam | śrutvā śaṃbhuḥ prasanno’bhūtprāha nāradamomiti ||82|| haristotraṃ ca kavacaṃ mantraṃ śrīharaye namaḥ | dhyānaṃ jñānaṃ nāradāya dadau samyaṅmaheśvaraḥ ||83 || nāradaḥ prāha deveśaṃ cāhnikaṃ me vad prabho | śaṃbhurbrāhmaṇadharmāṃśca kathayāmāsa taṃ tataḥ ||84|| saṃkṣepeṇa sadācārān ihāmutra sukhapradān | śṛṇu lakṣmi ca te sarvān kathayāmi sanātanān ||85|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmaṇā nāradāya sṛṣṭyarthamupadiṣṭam nāradena jñānadvārā tadaṃgīkṛtaṃ vaiṣṇavagurumantrārthaṃ kailāsagamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 20 3||
<1.204> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śaṃbhuḥ prāha ca devarṣiṃ nāradaṃ śṛṇu cāhnikam | brāhme muhūrte cotthāya guruṃ bhāle vicintayet || 1 || brahmarandhre hariṃ dhyāyeddhṛdaye kṛṣṇamarcayet | prasannavadanaṃ śāntaṃ projjvalaṃ ca manoharam || 2 || guruṇā dīyate devo mantraḥ pūjā vidhirjapaḥ | guruṇā pūyate śiṣyastasmāddevātparo guruḥ || 3 || gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgururdevo maheśvaraḥ | guruḥ prakṛtirīśādyā guruścandro’nalo raviḥ || 4 || gururvāyuśca varuṇo gururmātā pitā suhṛt | gurureva paraṃbrahma nāsti pūjyo guroḥ paraḥ || 5 || abhīṣṭadeve ruṣṭe ca samartho rakṣaṇe guruḥ | na samarthā gurau ruṣṭe rakṣaṇe sarvadevatāḥ || 6 || yasya tuṣṭo guruḥ sākṣājjayastasya pade pade | yasya ruṣṭo gurustasya vināśaḥ sarvaśo mataḥ || 7 || asaṃpūjya guruṃ devaṃ kevalaṃ yaśca pūjayet | duritaṃ gurvasevotthaṃ na nāśayati devatā || 8 || devāpūjanajaṃ pāpaṃ guruḥ śakto vyapohitum | tasmādabhīṣṭadevācca guruḥ pūjyatamo mataḥ || 9 || guruṃ hariṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca dhyātvā smṛtvā sato janān | malamūtratyajanāya gacchet tadyogyabhūmikām || 1.204.1 0|| jaladevālayavṛkṣavartmagoṣṭhaśubhasthalam | gṛhavahnicatuṣkārdrasasyavalmīkakandaram || 11 || udyānadarbhaphaladruśmaśānakrīḍanasthalam | evamādyasthalaṃ hitvā tyājyaṃ malādikaṃ sadā || 1 2|| ekāṃ liṃge mṛdaṃ dadyād vāmahaste catuṣṭayam | ubhayorhastayodvai tu mūtraśaucaṃ prakīrtitam || 13||| maithunānantaraṃ śaucaṃ dviguṇitaṃ samācaret | ekā liṃge gude tisrastathā vāmakare daśa || 14|| ubhayoḥ sapta dātavyā pādayostrirviśuddhyati | purīṣaśaucaṃ sarveṣāṃ sāmānya caitadeva hi || 15|| gandhalepakṣayakaraṃ vastunā payasā mṛdā | kṛtaṃ śaucaṃ hi śaucaṃ tadanyathāśaucameva vai || 16|| aśuddhāṃ jantusampannāṃ marditāṃ varjayenmṛdam | kṛtvā śaucaṃ tato vārbhiḥ svasya prakṣālayenmukham || 17|| dantakāṣṭhena dantāṃśca vāriṇā ca pramārjayet | sakṣīraṃ sakaṇṭakaṃ ca kāṣṭhaṃ dantapraśodhakam || 18|| aṣṭāṃgulottara grāhyaṃ jihvollekhyārdhacīrayā | jalasnānaṃ prakurvīta smṛtvā devaṃ guru harim || 1 9|| raviṃ viṣṇuṃ haraṃ lakṣmīṃ satīṃ brahmādikānsurān | nadyāṃ nade taḍāge vā tīrthe vāpyāṃ samudrake ||1.204.20 || kṛtvā saṃkalpamevādyaṃ mṛdaṃ gātre vilepayet | aśvakrānte rathakrānte viṣṇukrānte vasundhare |||2 1|| mṛttike hara me pāpaṃ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam | uddhṛtāsi varāheṇa kṛṣṇena śatabāhunā |||2|| āruhya mama gātrāṇi sarvaṃ pāpa pramocaya | puṇyaṃ dehi mahābhāge snānānujñāṃ kuruṣva mām ||23|| gaṃge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati | sindho narmade kāveri jale’smin sannidhiṃ kuru ||24|| nalinī nandinī sītā mālinī pārvatī prabhā | viṣṇupādābjasaṃbhūtā gaṃgā māṇakī gaṇḍakī ||25 || padmāvatī bhogavatī svarṇarekhā ca kauśikī | dakṣā pṛthvī ca śubhagā viśvakāyā śivāmṛtā ||26|| vidyādharī suprasannā tathā lokaprasādhinī | kṣemā ca kaṃbharā śāntā śāntidā gomatī satī ||27|| sāvitrī tulasī durgā mahālakṣmīḥ sarasvatī | kṛṣṇāprāṇādhikā rādhā lopāmudrā ratirditiḥ |||28|| ahalyā cāditiḥ saṃjñā svadhā svāhāpyarundhatī | śatarūpā devahūtirityādyāḥ saṃsmaretsudhīḥ ||29|| snātvā jalena saṃdhṛtvā yogye dhautre ca vāsasī | jalena candanenāpi kuryāttu tilakaṃ budhaḥ ||1.204.30 || bāhvormūle lalāṭe ca kaṇṭhadeśe ca vakṣasi | tanmadhye candrakaṃ kuryāt kauṃkumaṃ vartulaṃ śubham ||3 1|| ācamya cāsane sthitvā tataḥ sandhyāṃ samācaret | tataḥ pūjāṃ tu devānāṃ kuryācchoḍaśasādhanaiḥ ||32|| śālagrāme maṇau mantre pratimāyāṃ jale sthale | gopṛṣṭhe ca gurau vipre praśasta tvarcanaṃ hareḥ || 33|| āsanaṃ vasanaṃ pādyamarghyamācamanīyakam | puṣpaṃ ca candanaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyamuttamam || 34 || sugandhatailaṃ bhūṣāśca tāmbūlaṃ ca jalaṃ phalam | arārtrikādikaṃ deyaṃ ṣoḍaśātmaprapūjanam || 35 || snānaṃ paṃcāmṛtaiścāthābhiṣekasnānamapyatha | vastrāṇi candanādīni puṣpāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca || 36 || āsanaṃ ca pradīpaśca dhūpo nevedyamityapi | jalapānaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ cārārtrikaṃ pradakṣiṇam || 37|| sastotranamanaṃ puṣpāṃjaliścaite’pi ṣoḍaśa | upacārā hareḥ pūjākārye’rpyā bhāvataḥ sadā || 38 || ādau kṛtvā bhūtaśuddhiṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ param | aṃgapratyaṃgayornyāsaṃ mantranyāsaṃ tataḥ param || 39 || varṇanyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā cārghyapātraṃ vinirdiśet | trikoṇamaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tatra kūrmaṃ prapūjayet ||1.204.40 || jalenāpūrya śaṃkhaṃ ca kūrme saṃsthāpayettathā | jale tīrthāvāhanaṃ ca kṛtvā vastūni mārjayet ||4 1 || ghaṇṭāṃ ca pūjayecchaṃkhaṃ pūjayetkalaśaṃ tathā | śālagrāmaṃ pūjayecca tatau vai pūjayeddharim || 42 || ṣoḍaśopakaraṇaiḥ saṃpūjya devān visarjayet | devayajñaṃ tathā śrāddhaṃ kuryādvittānusārataḥ ||42 || atithipūjane bhūtayajñaṃ kuryāśca śaktitaḥ | vṛddhānvandeta sūryādīnnamaskuryācca sarvadā || 44|| poṣyām̐śca bhojayitvā vai gṛhī bhuñjyāttu nityaśaḥ | haviṣyānnaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ praśastaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ sadā ||45 || nārāyaṇocchiṣṭamiṣṭamabhakṣyamaniveditam | nityaṃ naivedyabhojī yaḥ śrīviṣṇoḥ sa hi vaiṣṇavaḥ ||46 || annaṃ jalaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ patraṃ śrīharaye’rpitam | bhakṣyaṃ peyaṃ tadanyattvapeyaṃ cābhakṣyamityatha || 47 || jātiduṣṭaṃ rūpaduṣṭamākṛtiduṣṭameva yat | guṇaduṣṭaṃ pariṇāmaduṣṭaṃ na bhakṣyameva tat || 48 || vrateṣvannaṃ na vai bhakṣyaṃ na bhakṣyaṃ prāk prapūjanāt | ahiṃsāsatyamasteye brahmacaryāparigrahau || 49 || yamā hyete rakṣaṇīyāḥ sukhadā mokṣadā api | śaucaṃ tuṣṭistapaḥ pāṭhaḥ kṛṣṇapūjā ca mokṣadāḥ ||1.204.5 0 || nindanaṃ naiva kartavyaṃ kvacitkasyāpi kenacit | parapīḍākaraṃ satyaṃ na vācyaṃ duḥkhadaṃ hi tat ||5 1 || preraṇālakṣaṇo hyartho dharmo nānartha eva yaḥ | kṛtaghnatā na kartavyā śāṭhyaṃ kāryaṃ na kutracit ||52 || vyavahāryaṃ yathānyāyaṃ copārjyaṃ dravyamityatha | dhanadhānyajīvikāścodyamaḥ kāryo yathābalam ||53|| mithyābhiśaṃsanīyaṃ na parasvaṃ nāharet kvacit | divase codyamaḥ kāryaḥ sāyaṃ sandhyājapādikam |||54||| harermandiragamanaṃ stavanaṃ kīrtanādikam | kṛtvā cāyavyayamantraṃ suptavyaṃ gṛhamedhibhiḥ ||55|| pramadāḥ sarvathā rakṣyāḥ santoṣṭavyāśca vastubhiḥ | na codvegavatā bhāvyaṃ kleśaḥ kāryo na vai kvacit ||56|| ātmānātmavicārādi kartavyaṃ vai mumukṣubhiḥ | paramātmā parabrahma sarvadehiṣvavasthitaḥ ||57|| sākṣī ca phaladātā ca vartate dehikarmaṇām | pañcaprāṇāḥ svayaṃ viṣṇustarpitavyaḥ subhojanaiḥ ||468|| mano brahmā tarpitavyaścānandarañjanādibhiḥ | indro rudraścendriyāṇāṃ tarpitavyaḥ sadarthakaiḥ ||59|| jñānarūpā tarpitavyā māyā tu śravaṇādibhiḥ | ātmā sākṣī svayaṃbrahma tṛptavyaṃ yāvadarpaṇaiḥ ||1.204.60|| parabrahma harikṛṣṇaścetaneṣu sadā sthitaḥ | tadadhīnāścetanā vai ātmāno bhinnakarmaṭhāḥ ||6 1|| karmaphalānvitā jīvā jaḍeṣu vṛttijīvinaḥ | jaḍāḥ parārthāḥ pareṇa yujyante bhogyatāptaye ||62|| cetanāśca sadarthairvai yujyante bhogalabdhaye | triguṇātmā jaḍā māyā mahattattvaṃ tato hyabhūt || 33 || ahaṃkārastato jātastasmādindriyadevatāḥ | sūkṣmabhūtāni sūkṣmebhyaḥ sthūlabhūtāni niryayuḥ ||64|| teṣāṃ kalevaraṃ labdhaṃ cetanena svakarmabhiḥ | jñānena karmaṇā nāśo vairāgyeṇāvibandhanam ||65|| dharmeṇāgragateḥ puṇya bhaktyā yānaṃ harergṛhe | kartāpi naiva mantavyaḥ karoti bhagavān nanu ||66|| ātmā dehī na ca kartā kartā dhartā hariḥ svayam | baddhā muktā svabhāvena prakṛtirna tu cetanaḥ ||67|| śarīraṃ bhūtasaṃghātairjāyate nātmano janiḥ | śarīraṃ śīryate bhāvairna tvātmano viśīrṇatā ||68|| sajātīyaṃ sajātīyadehena bhujyate sadā | śarīraṃ tu śarīreṇa bhujyate bhogavaddhi tat ||69|| sthūlaṃ bhogāśrayaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vividhaṃ rūpamāsthitam | idaṃ labdhaṃ cānubhūtaṃ sukhyahaṃ ceti cāntare ||1.204.70|| ahaṃkārakṛte buddhitattve bhavati nātmani | anyatra bhavati svasmin jānātyeṣo bhramo nanu ||7 1 || bhrama ityapi saṃsārastajjanyavāsanānvitaḥ | bhramābhāve gṛhābhāvaḥ saṃsārābhāva eva vai || 72|| bhramasattve gṛhasattvaṃ gṛhiṇībhāvanā tathā | kva gṛhaṃ kva gṛhiṇī ca vāsanā sarvamucyate || 73 || tadbhāve kva gṛhaṃ ca gṛhiṇī kva sutādayaḥ | śarīraṃ cāpi nāstyeva kā kathā tatsuyoginām ||74|| tasmādātmā parabrahmabhakto’sti kiraṇaṃ hareḥ | māyāguṇaiḥ rahito’sti na kālena sa lipyate ||75 || karmaṇāpi na lepo’sti svabhāvo nāsti tatra ca | nirguṇasya cita ānandamūrterbandhanaṃ nu kim ||76|| prabhuḥ karoti sarvaṃ vai mantavyaṃ tvevameva hi | vapate karṣuko bījaṃ jalaṃ siñcati karṣukaḥ || 77|| rakṣati karṣukaḥ khādyaṃ dadātyapi ca karṣukaḥ | lunāti dhānyaṃ kṛṣikṛdbhakṣayatyapi karṣukaḥ ||78 || karoti sarvaṃ kṛṣikṛt sasyaṃ naiva karoti saḥ | mahām̐stu karṣukaḥ kṛṣṇo bījamutpādayatyayam ||79|| bījaṃ tvavati garbhe saḥ dadāti janma mādhavaḥ | bālye yauvane vārdhakye sa vai rakṣati keśavaḥ ||1.204.8 0 || annaṃ jalaṃ ca vastraṃ ca dadāti kṛṣṇa eva vai | mṛtyuṃ prerayati kṛṣṇo layaṃ nayati mādhavaḥ ||8 1 || karoti sarvaṃ sākṣī śrīkṛṣṇo nāhaṃ karomi vai | evaṃ sarvaṃ samarpyaṃ vai kṛṣṇe nirbandhanāya tat ||82|| upāsanā sadā kṛṣṇe hyārādhanāpi mādhave | bhaktiḥ sevā ca yā kācit sarvaṃ vai kamalāpatau ||8 3 || samarpyaṃ sarvathā tadvai mokṣaṇaṃ cātra jīvataḥ | sarvatra vyāpakaścāntaryāmī śrīpatirīśvaraḥ ||84|| sarvadivyaguṇairyukto goloke cākṣare pare | vaikuṇṭhe śvetabhūmau ca badaryāṃ cāmṛte’mbare ||85|| kṛṣṇo harirnarāvāso nārāyaṇaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ | rādhāpatiḥ prabhāsvāmī māṇikyādhipatiḥ sa hi ||86 || lakṣmīpatiḥ kambharāsatpatiḥ śrīharireva saḥ | sītāpatiḥ satīsvāmī pārvatīpatireva saḥ ||87|| sarvapatiḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sākṛtiḥ sadā | paro vyūho vibhavaścāntaryāmi mūrtireva saḥ ||88 || svarūpaśceti ṣaḍrūpo vartate bhagavān hariḥ | nirākāraśca sākāro bhūmā sumūrtiko’pi san ||8 9 || adṛśyo’pi sudṛśyo’sti tādṛccakṣuryutaiḥ sa hi | yogināṃ dhyānaviṣayo bhaktānāṃ premabandhanaḥ || 1.204.90 || nārīṇāṃ bhartṛviṣayo dīnānāṃ dīnatātmakaḥ | dṛśyādṛśyo’pi divyena cakṣuṣā dṛśya eva saḥ ||91 || dhyāyante yogino nityaṃ taṃ vai kṛṣṇaṃ parātparam | paramānandarūpaṃ ca sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ||92|| yathā mṛdā kulālo hi ghaṭaṃ nirmāti tattathā | parabrahma prakṛtyā ca sṛṣṭiṃ nirmāti sarvathā ||93|| nityaṃ tatparamaṃ brahma nityā vai prakṛtirmatā | tadbrahmaśaktiḥ prakṛtiḥ śarīraṃ bījarūpiṇī ||94|| prakṛtiśaktimadbrahma tejoyuktaṃ sadāsti vai | yasya tejaśca tatrāsti sa vai paramapūruṣaḥ ||95|| kāraṇena vinā kāryaṃ kuto vā vartate katham | tasya tejo mahatkāryaṃ na syādvai puruṣaṃ vinā ||96|| vaiṣṇavāḥ sarvathā tasya saumyaṃ rūpaṃ manoharam | divyaṃ muktādisaṃsevyaṃ dhyāyante paramātmanaḥ ||97|| navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ kiśoravayasaṃ prabhum | śaranmadhyāhnamārtaṇḍaprabhodbhāsisulocanam ||98|| śaratpārvaṇapūrṇendukoṭyadhikaprabhānanam | koṭikandarpalāvaṇyalīlānanditamanmatham ||99|| puṣṭaṃ sarvāṃgasaundaryamādhuryapūritābharam | sasmitaṃ mūralīhastaṃ pītāmbaradharaṃ harim || 1.204.1 00|| candanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ kaustubhena virājitam | ājānu mālatīmālāvanamālāvirājitam || 101 || tribhaṃgabhaṃgyā tiṣṭhantaṃ maṇiratnādibhūṣitam | mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca hīrakamukuṭojjvalam || 10 2|| ratnakeyūravalayaratnamañjīrarājitam | ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalasuśobhitam || 1 03|| muktābhadaśanaṃ pakvabimbauṣṭhaṃ śukanāsikam | sthirayauvanayuktābhiḥ sasmitābhiśca sādaram || 104|| vīkṣitaṃ gopikābhiśca ramārādhājayādibhiḥ | bhaktapriyaṃ bhaktanāthaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam || 105|| rāseśvaraṃ surasikaṃ mahāmuktaiḥ susevitam | akṣaraṃ paramaṃ brahma bhagavantaṃ sanātanam || 1 06|| evaṃrūpaṃ hariṃ lakṣmi cātra dhyāyanti vaiṣṇavāḥ | sa eva bhagavānādigoloke dvibhujaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 07|| gopaveṣaiśca gopālaiḥ pārṣadaiḥ parisevitaḥ | paripūrṇatamaḥ śrīmān śrīkṛṣṇo rādhikāpatiḥ || 108|| sarvāntarātmā sarvatra pratyakṣo bhaktabhāvataḥ | kṛṣiśca sarvavacano nakāraścātmavācakaḥ || 10 9| sarvātmā ca parabrahma svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | kṛṣiśca sarvavacano nakāraścādivācakaḥ || 1.204.110 || sarvādipuruṣo vyāpī svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | kṛṣirbhū(rmū?)vācakaḥ śabdo ṇaśca nirvṛttivācakaḥ || 111 || ānandabhūḥ parabrahma kṛṣṇa ityasti sarvathā | kṛṣistu vāsanānāśo naśca svālaya prāpaṇam || 112| śuddhasya muktidastasmāt svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | kṛṣiśca karṣaṇaṃ naśca nayanaṃ divyamakṣare || 113 || nītvā dhāmni svayaṃ sākṣād bhavati kṛṣṇa eva saḥ | sa evāṃśena bhagavān vaikuṇṭhe tu caturbhujaḥ || 1 14|| caturbhujaiḥ pārṣadaiḥ saṃsevitaḥ kamalāpatiḥ | sa eva phalayā viṣṇuḥ pātā ramāpatiḥ svayam || 115 || sa eva śvetaloke’bdhikanyāsvāmī caturbhujaḥ | sa eva kṣīravārdhisthaśeṣaśāyī hariḥ svayam || 116 || sa eva kāraṇaṃ sarvarūpāṇāmakṣare sthitaḥ | parabrahma śrīharirvai paramātmā parameśvaraḥ || 117 || etatsarvaṃ kathitaṃ te cintanīyaḥ sa hi tvayā | ityuktvā viramantaṃ nāradaḥ śaṃbhuṃ pratuṣṭuve || 118 || jñānamāsādya mantrādi sarvamāsādya nārada | praṇamya śaṃkaraṃ divyaṃ yayau nārāyaṇāśramam || 119 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nāradāya śaṃkareṇāhnikaṃ nārāyaṇapūjanaṃ tattvajñānaṃ bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ parabrahmādi ca kathitamitinirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 204 ||
<1.205> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi cātiramyaṃ badarīvanasaṃyutam | jagāmāśramavaryaṃ śrīnāradaśca dadarśa tam || 1 || divyavṛkṣaramyavallīmahābhūruhaśobhitam | cātakamenakākīrapum̐skokilarutaśrutam || 2 || śarabhakesarivyāghrakarigoveṣṭitam | naranārāyaṇayogāddhiṃsābhayavivarjitam || 3 || siddharṣimunigandharvatrikoṭyāśramamaṇḍitam | kalpacandanatulasīpārijātavanānvitam || 4 || divyaṃ divyacidacidvastujātasamanvitam | śāntipradaṃ mahāraṇyamagamyaṃ bhūmivarṣmabhiḥ || 5 || nārāyaṇo naro yatra tāpasau lokarakṣakau | bhagavantau surājete’saṃkhyātā munayo’pare || 6 || badarīcchāyayā rājadramyānilasugandhini | badaryadhaḥ sabhāsthāne munimadhye manoharau || 7 || dadarśa bhagavantau tau ratnasiṃhāsanasthitau | japantau paramaṃ brahma śrīkṛṣṇaṃ parameśvaram || 8 || praṇanāma ca tau dṛṣṭvā yogināṃ paramau gurū | utthāya tau tamāliṅgya yuyujāte śubhāśiṣaḥ || 9 || papracchatuśca kuśalaṃ cakrāte’tithipūjanam | ratnasiṃhāsane niṣādayāmāsaturādarāt || 1.205.10 || āsane nivasan ramye vartmaśramavivarjitaḥ | uvāca tāvṛṣiśreṣṭhau bhagavantau sanātanau || 11 || adhītya vedānsakalān pitureva hi sārthakān | jñānaṃ mantraṃ ca saṃprāpya kailāse śaṃkarādaham || 1 2|| labdhuṃ jñānaviśeṣaṃ ca kṛpāṃ ca pārameśvarīm | āgato’smi bhagavantau vande saṃsāratārakau || 13 || ityuktvā svīyatantryā saṃjagau stotraṃ suchandasā | susvareṇa sunṛtyena satālena ca nāradaḥ || 14|| jaya jaya harikṛṣṇa svāmin nārāyaṇa rādhāramaṇakaram | jaya sati siddhapate trayavikrama | raṇamocana daharam || raṇamocanadaharaṃ numastvāṃ brahmaparaṃ graharam | jaya sati siddhapate trayavikrama raṇamocanadaharam || 15|| jaya jaya sadasattaditarakalpana tatvamasiśrutisañcaraṇam | aśvatthākhyatarūrdhvakamūlaṃ cidacittanudharaṇam || cidacittanudharaṇaṃ stumam̐stvāṃ vyaṣṭisamaṣṭyaraṇam | aśvatthākhyatarūrdhvakamūlaṃ cidacittanudharaṇam || 1 6|| jaya jaya viśvaṃbhara viśvātman svātmani jagaduḥ suvivaraṇam| pariṇatimadhyasitiṃ śrutayastvayi jagatastvadhikaraṇam || jagatastvadhikaraṇaṃ imam̐stvāṃ duritadalanacaraṇam | pariṇatimadhyasitiṃ śratayastvayi jagatastvadhikaraṇam || 17|| jaya jaya bhūtraya | saguṇa trīśvara vṛṣasuta tattvatrayabharaṇam | aṅkahṛdayapārśvasthitadevyā vartitaparicaraṇam || vartitaparicaraṇaṃ vṛṇīmovittyavayunaharaṇam | aṅkahṛdayapārśvasthitadevyā vartitaparicaraṇam || 18 || jaya jaya śāstracchandāṃgādyabhivedya vyāhṛtiphalaphalanam | jaya bhoktar hotar jaya havya svātmaramaṇakalanam || svātmaramaṇakalanaṃ bhajāmo munijanakaralalanam | jaya bhoktarhotarjaya havya svātmaramaṇakalanam || 1 9|| jaya jaya naiṣṭhikaguṇapoṣaka jaya tāpasa karuṇākaraśaraṇam | jaya dakṣiṇa jaya savya dvyātman prākṛtamatiharaṇam || prākṛtamatiharaṇaṃ namāmaḥ svāṃghrisugatikaraṇam | jayadakṣiṇa jaya savya dvyātman prākṛtamatiharaṇam |||1.205.20 || stutvaivaṃ daṇḍavat kṛtvā pulakāṃcitavigrahaḥ | aśruprāvilacakṣuṣkaḥ praṇanāma muhurmuhuḥ ||2 1|| śrutvā nārāyaṇaścātiprasannaḥ prāha nāradam | aho gandharvavaryādya śratvā gītiṃ sanṛtyakām ||22|| satālāṃ sasvarāṃ sārdramānasāṃ bhāvagarbhitām | prasanno’smyatigāndharve pārāvāro’tra saṃ bhava |||23 || bhaktipravartako me syāḥ sadārādhanakṛdbhava | sarvavidyāguṇābdhiḥ syāḥ śāśvatasthirayauvanaḥ |||24|| anenaiva hi dehena muktadeho’kṣaro bhava | na te mṛtyurna te vyādhirna jarā na vivartanam ||25|| naro yathā yathā cāhaṃ tathā tvaṃ mānasaṃ mama | matsvarūpaḥ sadā tiṣṭha bhakto’pi bhagavān bhava ||26 || ityāśīrvādamāsādyāvatāro brahmaṇaḥ svayam | kalāṃśo hyabhavatso’yaṃ nārāyaṇaprasādataḥ |||27||| nārāyaṇaḥ punaḥ prāha mūrdhni spṛṣṭvā kareṇa vai | mamādya hṛdyaṃ tvaṃ vai svīkṛto’si mahāmune |||28|| mayi yādṛk susārvajñyaṃ tvayyapyastvanivartanam | mama bhaktipradaṃ śāstraṃ vidhehi pañcarātrakam ||29|| viṣṇuḥ śivo viśvasṛṭ ca śeṣo gaṇapatiḥ surāḥ | manavo munayaśceśā bhajante yaṃ ca taṃ bhaja |||1.205.30 || lakṣmīḥ śivā ca sāvitrī ramārddhisiddhidevikāḥ | mānavya īśvariṇyaśca bhajante yaṃ ca taṃ bhaja ||3 1|| gaṃgā ca gomatī revā gaṇḍakī ca sarasvatī | yamunā svarṇarekhā ca bhajante yaṃ ca taṃ bhaja || 32|| pārvatī ca prabhā caivāmṛtā lakṣmīśca māṇikī | dīpotsavī tathā rādhā bhajante yaṃ ca taṃ bhaja ||33|| saṃsārasāgaraṃ tartuṃ bhavadāvaṃ vilaṃghitum | jagatsarpādavituṃ ca harerdāsyaṃ gṛhāṇa vai ||34|| janmāraṇyaṃ samullaṃghya mṛtyuśailamullaṃghitum | dhāmadeśamabhiyāsyan śraya kṛṣṇavimānakam ||35|| romasu yasya viśvāni daśanāgre samagrabhūḥ | govardhano’ṅguliprānte bhūsthaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca taṃ bhaja ||36|| yasyāsye nigamāḥ santi so’yaṃ yasmādviniḥsṛtaḥ | akhilāgamasañcāriśrīkṛṣṇaṃ bhaja nārada ||37|| kālamāyāpāpakarmasvabhāvayamakiṃkarāḥ | yacchaktyaṃśādīśvarāste taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sarvadā bhaja ||38|| bhūḥ sītā bhārgavī padmā gopyo vṛndā ca kubjikā | śabarī piṃgalā devyo bhajante yaṃ ca taṃ bhaja ||39|| virāṭ yasya kalā muktāḥ kalāśca manavaḥ kalāḥ | kalākalāṃśāśca munayastaṃ hariṃ bhaja sarvathā ||1.205.40 || pṛthvī sahasraśīrṣāṇaṃ śeṣaḥ kūrmaṃ jalaṃ sa ca | tattejastanmahotejastadādhāraṃ hariṃ bhaja ||41 || dhāmasthā lokadhīṣṇyasthā yogasthā brahmaṇi sthitāḥ | svasthitasya na vai pāraṃ yāntyapāraṃ hariṃ bhaja |||42|| yasya muktāstvasaṃkhyātā dāsyaścānantasaṃkhyakāḥ | śrutayaḥ sṛṣṭayo’nantāstamanantaṃ hariṃ bhaja ||43|| śriyo lakṣmyo dhiyo brāhmyaḥ sādhvyo māyāśca śaktayaḥ | mūrteryasya kalaikāṃśāstaṃ ca nārāyaṇaṃ bhaja ||44|| nārāyaṇī hareḥ śaktistadaṃśāḥ pramadāḥ kṛtāḥ | patnīṃ vivāhya vatsa tvaṃ nārāyaṇīṃ vadhūṃ bhaja ||45|| mamājñāṃ piturājñāṃ ca tvājñārūpāṃ vadhūṃ bhaja | evaṃ dharmapratipālaḥ pūjyaśca vijayī bhava ||46 || svapatnīṃ raṃjayedyo vai vastrālaṃkāravastubhiḥ | tasya nārāyaṇī tuṣṭā tārayatyeva kṛṣṇavat ||47|| lakṣmīrnārāyaṇaśaktiḥ sā vai yoṣitsvarūpiṇī | yoṣitāmavamānena parābhūtā tu sā bhavet ||48|| tayāvamānitayā ca naro’vamānito bhavet | tayāvamānito’bhāgyaḥ saukhyaṃ kvāpi na vindate ||49|| divyā strī pūjitā yena tadabhīṣṭapradāyinā | satī putravatī sā syāt sarvamaṃgaladāyinī ||1.205.50|| mūlaprakṛtirekā sā pūrṇabrahmasvarūpiṇī | sā cāsti ṣaṭsvarūpā vai pūjanīyā śubhārthibhiḥ ||51|| śrīkṛṣṇaprāṇarūpaikā preyasī rādhikā hi sā | lakṣmīḥ sampatpradā nārāyaṇaprāṇā dvitīyakā ||52|| vāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā sarasvatī tṛtīyakā | sāvitrī vedamātā yā brahmaprāṇā caturthikā ||53 || śaṃkaraprāṇarūpā ca satī pārvatī paṃcamī | kanyā vivāhitā sā tu vadhūḥ sarvasya dehinaḥ ||54|| mūlaprakṛtirūpaiṣā ṣaṣṭhī bodhyā ca vaṃśadā | tāṃ ca sevaya yogīndro bhūtvā kṛṣṇa ivāparaḥ ||55|| mā te’stu bandhanaṃ tatra matsvarūpo mayā kṛtaḥ | iti jñānaṃ mayā dattaṃ sadā dhāraya nārada ||56|| nāradaśca harerājñāmāsādya praṇanāma ca | kṛtvā ca daṇḍavat premṇā vidhāya ca pradakṣiṇam ||57|| dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ taṃ ca kartuṃ tīrthāni tatra ca | yayau nareṇa sārdhaṃ sa tartuṃ ca tārito’pi san ||58 || prāgvai cālakanandāyāṃ sasnau śītena vāriṇā | tāvaddivyamabhūttasya varṣma nārāyaṇasya tat ||59|| deśataḥ kālato vastutaścābādhyamabhūttadā | cinmātraṃ sarvasāmarthyāśrayaṃ kṛṣṇasya varṣmavat || 1.205.60 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nāradasya badarikāśramagamanaṃ naranārāyaṇadarśanaṃ gītyāstavanam divyatāprāpaṇaṃ bhaktyupadeśanaṃ vivāhakaraṇājñāpanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 205 ||
<1.206> śrīlakṣmīruvāca tatrāśrame ca muninā tīrthāni kāni kāni vai | kṛtāni bhagavan brūhi pāvanāni samāsataḥ || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca gaṃgāyāṃ nāradaḥ snātvā bhūtvā divyavapurdharaḥ | yayau prāk badarīṃ yāstyakṣarabrahmāvatāriṇī || 2 || natvā stutvā pūjayitvā tathā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam | patraṃ ca badaraṃ tasyā attvā prasādarūpakam || 3 || snigdhaṃ cākaṇṭakaṃ divyaṃ haritaṃ pallavānvitam | sapuṣpaṃ saphalaṃ ramyaṃ dhyātvā tadrūpamāntare || 4 || jagāma ca tato vahnitīrthaṃ vai pāvanaṃ muniḥ | jalaṃ papau tadākhyānaṃ śuśrāva ca narānanāt || 5 || purā samājaḥ samabhūdṛṣīṇāmūrdhvasrotasām | gaṃgāyamunāsaṃyoge prayāge puṇyabhūtale || 6 || tatrāśvamedhe hutabhuk saṃpraṣṭumupacakrame | sarvadurbhakṣaṇodbhūtapātakāliptacetasaḥ || 7 || kathaṃ syātpātakānmuktirmama brahmavittamāḥ | vyāsaḥ prāha tadā vahniṃ badarīṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja || 8 || yatrāste bhagavān bhaktapāpahāḥ puruṣottamaḥ | tatra gaṃgājale snātvā hareḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇām || 9 || daṇḍavatpraṇipātena sarvadoṣakṣayo bhavet | tato’gnirbadarīṃ prāpya snātvā gaṃgāṃbhasi tathā || 1.206.1 0|| naranārāyaṇaṃ gatvā natvā stutiṃ cakāra saḥ | agneśca pāvakaṃ cātmapāvakaṃ brahmapāvakam || 11 || māyāyāḥ pāvakaṃ tīrthapāvakaṃ praṇamāmyaham | ṛṣīṇāṃ tapasāṃ puṇyaphaladaṃ mokṣadaṃ prabhum || 12 || vidyāpradaṃ dharmadaṃ ca yogadaṃ tāpasaṃ harim | sukhadaṃ valkalavastramīḍe śaktyaṣṭakaṃ gurum || 13 || śrutvā nārāyaṇaḥ prāha varaṃ varaya pāvaka | agniḥ prāha hare sarvabhakṣo’haṃ dūṣaṇaṃ mahat || 14 || doṣanāśaḥ kathaṃ syādvai bhayaṃ doṣāt sudustaram | nārāyaṇastadā prāha kṣetrasyāsya tu darśanam || 15 || matprasādātprāṇināṃ ca tava māstu ca pātakam | yatra snātaśca vahne tvaṃ tadagnitīrthamadyataḥ || 16 || khyātaṃ bhaviṣyati kṣmāyāṃ sarvabhakṣaṇapāpahṛt | tava vāsaśca kalayā matpratāpātsadāstu ca || 1 7|| tataḥ snātvā ca tattīrthe nārado lokapāvanaḥ | jagāma ca śilāpañcatīrthāni kartumādarāt || 18 || nāradī nārasiṃhī ca vārāhī gāruḍī tathā | mārkaṇḍeyīti vikhyātāḥ śilāḥ paramapāvanāḥ || 19 || nāradaśca munirbrāhmaḥ prathame janmani svayam | darśanārthaṃ mahāviṣṇostapastepe’tidāruṇam || 1.206.20 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi śilāyāṃ vāyubhojanaḥ | vṛkṣavṛttisthitaṃ taṃ ca viṣṇurbrāhmaṇarūpadhṛk || 2 1 || darśanaṃ dattavānprāha kimiti kliṣyate mune | yadīpsitaṃ mama brūhi tapasāsti śucirbhavān || 22 || nāradaḥ prāha karuṇākaro’raṇye’sti ko bhavān | tava darśanamātreṇa mano yāti prasannatām || 23 || tāvannārāyaṇastatra śaṃkhacakragadābjavān | pītāmbaraḥ sakaustubhavanamālopavītakaḥ || 24|| śrīvatsāṃkitavakṣāśca kamalāsvarṇarekhakaḥ | sunandādyaiḥ pārṣadaiśca sevamānaḥ suhāsyavān || 25|| darśayāmāsa rūpaṃ svaṃ nāradāya tapasvine | dṛṣṭvā taṃ sahasotthāya namaskṛtya kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 26 || tuṣṭāva paramātmānaṃ karuṇāsāgaraṃ prabhum | jagatāmīśvaraṃ sākṣirūpaṃ bhaktakṛtādaram || 27 || kṛpāluṃ tāpasaṃ divyaṃ vande prasīda pāvana | satāṃ lokasya rakṣāyai hitāya tapa ādadhan || 28 || tapaḥphalapradātarme prasīda sattvamūrtiman | koṭikandarpalāvaṇyavilāsaḥ kāmavarjitaḥ || 29 ||
