brahmacāryasi deveśa prasīda satyavāg vibho| āśritānāṃ kalpavṛkṣo dīnānāṃ duḥkhahārakaḥ || 1.206.30 || jñānena bandhahā brahmasukhadātā prasīdatām | jīvāntarindriyasūkṣmabhūtāntaryāminīśvara || 31 || brahmasukhānubhūte tvaṃ prasīda cidacinmaya | yadāśritāḥ surā duḥkhāmbudhiṃ taranti gopadam || 3 2|| namaste sarvadā parabrahmaṇe brahmaṇe tathā | vāsudevāya kṛṣṇāya bhūmne nārāyaṇāya ca ||33 || mahāviṣṇusvarūpāya vairājāya ca te namaḥ | namo hiraṇyakośāya tridevebhyo namo namaḥ || 24 || adya me saphalaṃ janma cādya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ | adya me saphalaṃ jñānaṃ śrīhare tava darśanāt || 35|| śrutvā prāha haristaṃ ca tuṣṭo’haṃ tapasā tava | stotreṇātisutuṣṭo’haṃ varado’haṃ tavāgrataḥ || 36 || sarvaśreṣṭho mama bhaktastvaṃ cāsi siddhakāmanaḥ | varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te sarvaṃ dadāmi mā ciram || 3 7|| nāradaḥ prāha bhaktiṃ te padayordehi niścalām | eṣā śilā me tapasāṃ sthānaṃ tīrthaṃ sadāstu ca || 38 || macchilāsannidhānaṃ tu na tyājyaṃ bhavatā kvacit | mattīrthadarśanātsparśātsnānādācamanāt tathā || 39 || punardehaṃ na cāpnuyāt tṛtīyo’stu varaśca me | śrutvā nārāyaṇaḥ prāha evamastu sadānagha ||1.206.40 || carācaravideho’haṃ tava tīrthe vasāmyaham | tava bhaktiḥ śāśvatī ca mayi bhavatu nārada ||4 1 || ityuktvā ca haristatra mūrtāvantaradhīyata | prathamo nārado hṛṣṭo yayau madhupurīṃ tataḥ || 42 || ityasti nāradaśilā tīrthaṃ paramapāvanam | caturtho nāradastatra tīrthaṃ kṛtvā yayau punaḥ ||43 || mārkaṇḍeyaśilāyāśca tīrthārthaṃ narasaṃyutaḥ | purā tretāyugasyānte mṛkaṇḍutanayo mahān ||44|| mārkaṇḍeyastapaścakre śilāyāṃ tatsthalaṃ yayau | purā nāmnā mṛgaśṛṃgo munistvāsīt tapodhanaḥ ||45|| tasya bhāryāścatasraśca pātivratyaparāyaṇāḥ | suvṛtā kamalā caiva vimalā surasā tviti ||46 || kālena mahiṣī tasya suvṛtā suṣuve sutam | jātakarma kumārasya pitā cakre vidhānavat ||47|| cakāra nāmakaraṇaṃ mṛkaṇḍumiti viśrutam | niḥśaṃkāśca mṛgagaṇāḥ kaṇḍūyante’sya vigrahe ||48|| tasmānmṛkaṇḍuriti ca nāma sārthakameva tat|| kṛtopanayanaḥ pitrā vedānadhyaiṣṭa sarvaśaḥ ||49|| mudgalasya muneḥ kanyāmupayeme marudvatīm | mṛkaṇḍuranapatyo’bhūdidamevābhyacintayat || 1.206.50 || ahaṃ sadāro gacchāmi rājadhānīṃ śivasya vai | bhaktapriyaḥ śivo yatra karṇe japati tārakam || 51 || gatvā tatra prathamato maṇikarṇyāṃ vidhānataḥ | snānaṃ kṛtvā mahādevaṃ natvovāsa yathāsukham || 52 || śaṃkaraṃ toṣayāmāsa tapasā saha bhāryayā | tuṣṭaścāha pinākī tvaṃ matto varaṃ gṛhāṇa ca ||5 3 || so’pi vavre varaṃ śaṃbho putraṃ dehīti mā ciram | śaṃbhustasyānapatyasya bhālaṃ dṛṣṭvā hyuvāca tam || 54 || saptajanmasu te’patyaṃ nāstīti vaidhasī lipiḥ | tathāpi tapasā tuṣṭo dadāmi putramekalam ||55|| kimihecchasi putraṃ tvaṃ nirguṇaṃ cirajīvinam | āhosvidekaṃ saguṇaṃ sarvajñaṃ ṣoḍaśābdikam ||56|| ityuktaḥ sopi dharmātmā nāhamicchāmi nirguṇam | alpāyurapi putro vā sarvajño’stu jagatpate || 57 || śaṃbhuḥ prāha bhavitā te ṣoḍaśāyuḥ suto mune | dhārmiko guṇavān khyātaḥ sarvajñaḥ kīrtimām̐stathā || 58 || ityuktvā prayayau śaṃbhurmuniryayau nijāśramam | kāle bhāryābhavattasya cāntarvatnī marudvatī || 59 || tanayaḥ samaye tasyāṃ marudvatyāmajāyata | jātakarma nāmakarma pitā cakāra yatnataḥ || 1.206.60 || saṃskārān kṛtavān sarvān pañcame’bde vrataṃ dadau | vedānsa vidhinādhyaiṣṭa vidyāṃ jagrāha śaktimān || 61 || saṃprāpte ṣoḍaśe’bde tu pitā tasya mṛkaṇḍukaḥ | śokamagno’bhavat dṛṣṭvā putramantikamṛtyukam || 6 2|| putro’pi pitaraṃ prāha kiṃ te śokasya kāraṇam | mṛkaṇḍaḥ prāha tanayaṃ śocāmi tava kāraṇam || 63 || āyuḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣāṇi tava dattaṃ pinākinā | sa kālo’yaṃ samāyātastasmācchocāmi putraka || 64 || pitreti kathitaṃ śrutvā mārkaṇḍeyo’bravīdidam | mannimittaḥ pitaḥ śokaṃ kadācittvapi mā kṛthāḥ || 65|| prayatiṣye yathā tāta yathā yāsyāmyamartyatām | samārādhya parātmānaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ hariṃ prabhum || 66|| iti nirṇīya tātena sahitaḥ sa yayau drutam | mathurāyāṃ yamunāyāṃ snātuṃ rādhayituṃ harim || 67|| gatvā tatra yamunāyāstīre tasthau smaran harim | dvādaśākṣaramantrasya japaṃ kurvanpupūja tam ||68|| yadṛcchayā nārado’pi mathurāyāmagāttadā | mṛkaṇḍustaṃ nirīkṣyaiva saputrastaṃ nanāma ca ||69|| satkṛtaḥ svāgatādyaiśca nārado mlānabhāvataḥ | prāha dṛṣṭvā putrabhāle lekhāṃ mṛtyuprayāyinīm ||1.206.70 || mṛkaṇḍo’yaṃ tava putraḥ svalpāyurdṛśyate khalu | mṛkaṇḍuḥ prāha devarṣe dīrghāyuṣyaṃ prakalpaya ||71 || nāradaḥ prāha viprarṣe lekhāṃ vedhaḥprakalpitām | mārjayituṃ na vai śaktāḥ surāsurāstathāpare ||72|| karmasāpekṣakā lekhā likhyante janmanā saha | āyurvidyā ca vittaṃ ca yaśo nidhanamityapi ||73|| pañcaivaitāni sṛjyante garbhasthasyaiva dehinaḥ | tathāpi santi santo vai lipiṃ mārjayituṃ kṣamāḥ ||74|| satāmāśīrvacanaiśca sadā duḥkhaṃ sukhāyate | kubhāgyaṃ līyate caivotpadyate bhāgyasauṣṭhavam ||75|| pāpaṃ pralīyate puṇyaṃ janyate ca satāṃ balāt | māyāṃ pāpaṃ ca karma ca kālaṃ durbhāgyamityapi ||76|| tasya vai parivartante yena santaḥ pratoṣitāḥ | mahābhāgavatāḥ santaḥ ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ ||77|| prasannā yatra jāyante tatra bhadrāṇi koṭiśaḥ | santaḥ prasannā jāyante praṇāmastutisevanaiḥ ||78|| tasmādatithayo ye ye samāgaccheyuratra hi | tathā ca tīrthayātrāyāṃ mileyurye ca tārakāḥ ||79|| tebhyaḥ sarvebhya eva drāk praṇatiḥ sāṃjalistathā | kartavyānena bālena nālasyaṃ kāryameva yat ||1.206.80|| tatraivaṃ ca kvacitkasyacinmahatpuruṣasya vai | ciraṃjīvetyāśiṣāyaṃ vardhitaḥ sabhaviṣyati ||8 1|| tasmāttīrthāṭanaṃ samyak kuru kṣemaṃ bhaviṣyati | tato badrīmahākṣetraṃ sthānaṃ tu nityadā hareḥ ||82||| yāhi yatra svayaṃ sākṣāddhariṃ paśyasi cakṣuṣā | ciraṃjīvī tava putro bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||83|| śrutvetyāśīrvaco labdhvā mṛkaṇḍuḥ sasutastataḥ | yayau tīrtheṣu sarvatra prabhāse raivatācale ||84|| dvārikāyāṃ puṣkare ca narmadāyāṃ ca bhārgave | sarayvāṃ yamunāyāṃ ca gaṃgāyāṃ tryambakeśvare ||85|| kāveryāṃ tāmraparṇyāṃ cāruṇācale’tidakṣiṇe | rāmeśvare’tha sāmudre tīrthāni pracakāra saḥ ||86|| pituranujñāṃ saṃprāpya dakṣiṇārṇavarodhasi | liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhivanmārkaṇḍeyo nijāhvayam ||87|| kṛtvā triṣavaṇaṃ snānaṃ trikālaṃ śivapūjakaḥ | prārthyaṃ trikālapūjānte’rthayitvā nṛtyati priyam ||88 || tenārhaṇena santuṣṭo dinenaikena śaṃkaraḥ | pūjitaśca mahābhaktyā mārkaṇḍeyena vastubhiḥ ||89 || tāvattatrārṇave snātuṃ saptarṣaya upasthitāḥ | mārkaṇḍeyaḥ samutthāya nanāmarṣīṃśca pādayoḥ || 1.206.90 || ciraṃjīveti saptoktaḥ praharṣa paramaṃ yayau | mṛkaṇḍuḥ prāha saptarṣīn nāsyāyurvardhate’dhikam || 91 || kathaṃ cirāyurbhavitā satyavācāṃ vaco mṛṣā | yadvā lalāṭalekhā sā vedhaso’līkatāṃ vrajet || 92 || maharṣibhistadālokya nīto drāk brahmaṇaḥ sabhām | natvā ca tiṣṭhati cāgre ciraṃjīvetyajo jagau || 93 || ṛṣibhiḥ kathitaṃ cāsya rekhā saṃpūrṇatāṃ gatā | kathaṃ ciraṃjīvano’yaṃ saṃbhavettava vākyataḥ || 94|| yadi vākyaṃ tava tathyaṃ rekhāmanyāṃ vidhāpaya | śratvā ca vedhasā lekhā ciraṃjīveti nirmitā || 95 || drāgeva saḥ ṛṣibhirānīto dakṣiṇasāgare | tāvadāyāta evātra kālo mṛtyusahāyavāna || 96|| vṛttaraktāntanayanaḥ sarpavṛścikaromavān | daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaścūrṇitāṃjanasannibhaḥ || 97|| samāgatya ca tasyāsau yamasyājñānusārataḥ | adṛṣṭvā nūtanāṃ rekhāṃ pūrvarekhāvidhānataḥ || 98 || pāśamavāsṛjatkālo mārkaṇḍeyastamabravīt | kāla tāvatpratīkṣasva pūjāṃ nirvartayāmyaham || 99|| maheśvaraḥ prasīdatāt satataṃ pūjayānayā | tamabravīt tataḥ kālo mārkaṃḍeyaṃ hasanmuhuḥ || 1.206.100 || saptarṣīṇāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ ca nītivākyāni tatra ha | prathame vayasi puṇyaṃ yo na karoti śucyate || 101 || māsāṣṭakena tatkuryād yena varṣāḥ sukhaṃ vaset | divase caiva tatkuryād yena rātriṃ sukhaṃ vaset || 10 2|| pūrve vayasi tatkuryādyena vṛddhaḥ sukhaṃ vaset | yāvajīvaṃ tu tatkuryād yena pretya sukhaṃ vaset || 103 || śvaḥ kāryamadya kurvīta pūrvāṅge cāparāhṇikam | na ca pratīkṣate kālaḥ kṛtamasya na vā kṛtam || 10 4|| idṃ kṛtamidaṃ kāryamidamanyatkṛtākṛtam | evamīhāsamāyuktaṃ kṛtāntaḥ kurute vaśe || 10 5|| nāprāptakālo mriyate viddhaḥ śaraśatairapi | kuśāgreṇāpi saṃspṛṣṭaḥ prāptakālo na jīvati || 106 || cakravartisahasrāṇi purandaraśatāni ca | prāpitāni mayā yābhyāṃ prāptakālastvamehi ca || 107 || mārkaṇḍeyastadā prāha tvayā naitacchrutaṃ ca kima | nṝṇāmīśvarabhaktānāṃ na bhavantyāpadaḥ kvacit || 108 || brahmādayo’pi tān kruddhā na śaktā hantumīśvarāḥ | kālaḥ prāha ca yāvatyo gaṃgāyāṃ sikatā mune || 109 || tāvanta eva brahmāṇo mayā kālena saṃhṛtāḥ | tvāṃ ca nayāmi sāmarthyād yasya bhaktaḥ sa rakṣatu || 1.206.110 || tenaivaṃ garjatā tatra kālenāsau mahāmuniḥ | haṭhādgrasituṃ cārabdhaḥ kṣiptaḥ pāśaḥ galopari || 111 || tāvalliṃgātsamuttasthau śaṃbhurhuṃkāragarjanaḥ | uddhṛtya pādakamalaṃ prajahāra bhujāntare || 112 || pāśo vicchinnatāṃ yāto dūre mṛtyuḥ papāta ha | saptarṣayo’pi sattoyairavardhayan mṛkaṇḍujam || 113 || prāhurmṛtyuṃ paśya mṛtyo ciraṃjīveti nūtanām | rekhāṃ lalāṭalikhitāṃ brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā || 114 || etasminnantare citraguptāyāveditaṃ navam | śrāvaṇaiḥ pitṛbhirlekhyaṃ ciraṃjīva mṛkaṇḍujaḥ || 115 || tāvad dūtāḥ preṣitāścāpare datvāmṛtāvalim | mānayantu mṛkaṇḍośca sutaṃ kalpāntareṣvapi || 116 || iti mṛtyuśca kālaśca dūtāśca viphalā yayuḥ | mārkaṇḍeyaḥ pralaye’pi kṣīrābdhau viṣṇusannidhau || 117 || samādhau tiṣṭhate naiva mriyate cirajīvanaḥ | svasthānamṛṣayo jagmuḥ śaṃbhurliṃge tiro’bhavat || 118 || mṛkaṇḍuśca yayau svasyāśramaṃ putraśca kevalaḥ | nāradasyopadeśena yayau badarikāśramam || 119 || snātvā cālakanandāyāṃ śilāmupāviśattataḥ | jajāpāṣṭākṣaraṃ mantraṃ trirātryante narāyaṇaḥ || 1.206.120 || prasannaścājagāmāśu darśanaṃ maṃgalaṃ dadau | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmavanamālāvibhūṣitam || 121 || hariṃ dṛṣṭvā samutthāya premagadgadayā girā | tuṣṭāva praṇato bhūtvā mārkaṇḍeyo narāyaṇam || 122 || aśāśvate’tra saṃsāre’śāśvate varṣmaṇi sthitam | cetanaṃ māṃ kṛthāścirajīvinaṃ muktameva hi || 123 || kālamṛtyū kṛtau dūrau śaṃbhurūpeṇa sarvathā | mṛtaṃ jīvantaṃ bhrāntaṃ māṃ sadaivaṃ trāhi keśava || 1 24|| ṛṣistvaṃ carṣirūpeṇa mṛtān jīvayase vibho | śāśvate’mṛtadhāmākhye sadā jīvaya māṃ prabho || 125 || dehi dīkṣāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ me pūjāyāṃ darśanaṃ tava | niścalāṃ dehi me bhaktiṃ śilāyāṃ tava sannidhim || 126 || tathetyuktvā naranārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavānsvayam | dadau ca vaiṣṇavīṃ dīkṣāṃ mantramaṣṭākṣaraṃ śubham || 127|| śilāyāṃ harisānnidhyaṃ pūjāyāṃ daśanaṃ sadā | dadau tasmai cirajīvimārkaṇḍeyāya yogine || 128 || mārkaṇḍeyo vaiṣṇavo’bhūcchilāyāmatra nārada | nārāyaṇastathā cātra śilāyāṃ samavasthitaḥ || 129 || mārkaṇḍeyaśilā ceyaṃ dvitīyā kīrtitā ca te | haristiro’bhavattatra yayau gṛhaṃ mṛkaṇḍujaḥ || 1.206.130 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vahneḥ sarvabhakṣitvadoṣaparihārakāgnitīrtha nāradātapaḥsthalanāradaśilātīrthamārkaṇḍeyacirajīvitvākhyāna mārkaṇḍeyaśilātīrthamiti nirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 206 ||
<1.207> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca tato lakṣmi nāradaḥ sa nareṇa sahayāyinā | vainateyaśilāṃ nītaḥ kathitākhyānakaśca vai || 1 || kaśyapasya vinatāyāṃ garuḍo’ruṇa eva tau | sutau caikā ca kanyā saudāminī nabhasi sthitā || 2 || garuḍo viṣṇuvāho’bhūdaruṇaḥ sūryasārathiḥ | viṣṇubhaktau samarthau tau mahābalaparākramau || 3 || badaryā dakṣiṇe gandhamādane śikhare hime | garuḍastapa ātepe harervāhanakāmyayā || 4 || kvacitphalaṃ kvacinmūlaṃ kvacidvāri tato’nilam | nārāyaṇajapaṃ kurvansmaranmūrtiṃ hareḥ śubhām || 5 || padaikenopasaṃkramya kṣmāyāṃ jepe’tisaṃyamaḥ | triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi tapaścacāra duścaram || 6 || tataḥ prasanno viṣṇuśca divyapītāmbaradvayaḥ | caturbhujo nijaśastradharo hāsyasuśobhanaḥ || 7 || āvirbabhūva purataḥ koṭīndukāntisūjjvalaḥ | ājuhāva garuḍaṃ saḥ vatsa nibodha jāgṛhi || 8 || tathāpi notthito dhyānād dadhmau śaṃkhaṃ haristadā | tathāpi na bahiryātastadā yogeśvaro hariḥ || 9 || tataḥ praviśya garuḍe prāṇendriyāntarātmasu | bahirānīya ca jāgrataṃ kṛtvā purataḥ sthitaḥ || 1.207.10 || garuḍo’tiprasannaḥ san dṛṣṭvā nanāma daṇḍavat | pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgastuṣṭāva ca kṛtāñjaliḥ || 11 || jaya trilokajīvānāṃ prāṇarūpa prabho hare | aghanāśakagīrvāṇavanditacaraṇāmbuja || 12 || surāridhvaṃsasāmarthya surāsuranamaskṛta | svabhaktahṛdgatamohadhvaṃsakṛt te namonamaḥ || 13 || tāpatrayapraśāntikṛccaraṇobha namo’stu te | jagajjanmasthitidhvaṃsakāryakṛttrisvarūpaka || 1 4|| bhaktamānasasadgamya śāstravedādirūpita | surāsurapravanditapādapadma namo’stu te || 15 || aṣṭaiśvaryasamāyukta vanamālāvirājita | kaṃjanetra tilapuṣpanāsikālakta pattala || 16 || sthalapadmapatratulyakaradvaya namo’stu te | bhaktahṛtkṛtanityāsa divyaguṇagaṇānvita || 1 7|| avitātmajana dharmamūrte hare namo’stu te | divyaiśvaryasamajuṣṭa pātu māṃ parameśvara || 18 || ekaḥ sannapi sarvatrānantarūpadhara prabho | bhaktakāryakṛte drāk cāyāsi nātha namo’stu te || 19 || kvāhaṃ pakṣī tamovyāptaḥ kva tvaṃ sattvamayaḥ prabhuḥ | kṛpā te darśane hetuḥ kṛpālo’stu ca te namaḥ || 1.207.20 || sāparādhasya lokasya rakṣāṃ karoṣi sarvathā | hitakṛt sukhakṛccaiva guṇāśraya namo’stu te || 21 || yajñabhuk viśvasaṃpuṣṭikṛt trāhi māṃ janeśvara | kanyāmbarāṇi nītvā ca kadambavṛkṣamāsthita || 22 || premabhaktisamālabhya dāsaikakaruṇāva mām | viśvaduḥkhapraśamana me dāsyaṃ dehi keśava || 23 || evaṃ stuto hariḥ sākṣād garuḍena mahātmanā | samājuhāva gaṃgāṃ ca pūjārthaṃ svasya tatra vai || 24|| tataḥ paṃcamukhī gaṃgā hyāvirāsīnnagopari | tajjalena hareḥ pūjāṃ cakāra vinatāsutaḥ || 25 || vriyatāṃ vara ityukto garuḍo hariṇā tataḥ | tavaikavāhanaḥ śrīmān balavīryaparākramaḥ || 26 || ajeyo devadaityānāṃ syāmahaṃ te prasādataḥ | śileyaṃ mama nāmnā ca tīrthībhūtāstu sarvadā || 27|| etasyāḥ smaraṇātpuṃsāṃ viṣavyādhirna jāyatām | śrutvā prāha haristasmai sarvaṃ bhavatu te’ṇḍaja || 28 || badarīṃ tvaṃ prayāhyeva nārāyaṇasamīpataḥ | snānaṃ nāradatīrthādāvupavāsatrayaṃ tathā ||29|| kṛtvā me darśanaṃ te vai sulabhaṃ hi bhaviṣyati | garuḍaḥ śīghramāgatya natvā ca badarīṃ tathā || 1.207.30|| vahnitīrthe kṛtasnānastīrthe ca nārade’pi ca | snātvā śilāṃ samāśritya bhakticaryāparo’bhavat ||3 1 || śilā seyaṃ gāruḍī vai kathyate tatprasaṃgataḥ | gandhamādanapāṣāṇo vainateyī śilocyate || 32|| tatrāgatya svayaṃ viṣṇurlīno nārāyaṇe tadā | śilāsānnidhyamāptaśca tena tīrthaṃ hi tanmatam ||33|| garuḍaśca yayau viṣṇorvāhano viṣṇudhāma yat | vaikuṇṭhaṃ divyatāmāptaḥ prabhoryogātprabhurbhavet ||34|| vārāhyāḥ śṛṇu māhātmyaṃ nāradātra purā hariḥ | rasātalātsamānīya pṛthvīṃ saṃsthāpya vāridhau ||35|| hiraṇyākṣaṃ nihatyaiva badarīṃ samupāgataḥ | yogadhāraṇayā cātra vārāho bhagavān sthitaḥ ||36|| seyaṃ śilā ca vārāhī procyate muktidā sadā | gaṃgājalena saṃsnātvā cāhorātre japet sthitaḥ ||37|| śilāyāṃ divyadṛṣṭiśca jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | nārasiṃhyāśca māhātmyaṃ śilāyāḥ śrūyatāṃ śubham ||38|| hiraṇyakaśipuṃ hatvā gatavān nṛharistadā | atyugrakrodhadīptāṃgaḥ pralayānalasannibhaḥ ||39|| abhūddevaiśca śāntyarthaṃ stutaḥ sthitvā sudūrataḥ | prasanno’bhūduvācaitānāvṛṇīdhvaṃ varaṃ surāḥ ||1.207.40|| śrutvā brahmā hariṃ prāha rūpaṃ bhayāvahaṃ tava | cātyugraṃ saṃhara nātha gṛhāṇa ca caturbhujam ||41 || tato harirvicāryaiva viśālāṃ prayayau drutam | gaṃgājale svayaṃ snātaḥ śānto’bhūcca caturbhujaḥ ||42|| yatra sthito hariḥ seyaṃ śilā ca nārasiṃhikā | nṛsiṃhopi śilārūpī jalakrīḍāparo’bhavat ||43 || evaṃ rūpaṃ śilāprakhyaṃ kṛtvā dvitīyarūpataḥ | samāgacchaddhariḥ siṃhāraṇyaṃ raivataparvate ||44|| tatrābhavanmahadyuddhaṃ śarabheṇa śivena vai | tato dehaṃ hi tatyāja nṛsiṃho līlayā bhuvi ||45|| ityevaṃ nāradaḥ pañcaśilātīrthaṃ vidhāya ca | śrutvā sahetukaṃ sarvaṃ nareṇa kathitaṃ tadā ||46 || yayau snātvā tīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā tīrthāntaraṃ tataḥ | brahmatīrthaṃ yayau tatra śrutavān vṛttameva saḥ ||47|| ekadā nābhikamale sthitasya brahmaṇo mukhāt | vedānnītvā hyasurau dvau jagmaturmadhukaiṭabhau || 48 || tadā hatasmṛtirbrahmā kicitkartuṃ śaśāka na | ato badarikāmetya tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ||49 || tataḥ kuṇḍātsamutpanno hayaśīrṣo nijāyudhaḥ | pītāmbaradharaḥ śuklasvarṇavarṇaścalacchaṭaḥ ||1.207.5 0 || brahmaṇā prārthito’suravināśāya yayau prabhuḥ | vinihatyāsurau vedānādāya brahmaṇo’ntikam ||5 1 || upāyayau hayaśīrṣā bhagavān pradadau ca tān | yatra sthale dadau vedān svastho’bhavacca viśvasṛṭ || 52|| līno’bhavacca bhagavān tattīrthottamamucyate | brahmakuṇḍamiti khyātaṃ divyaṃ jñānapradaṃ śubham ||| 53 || darśanātpāpanāśaśca brahmalokagatirbhavet | snānādviṣṇostu vaikuṇṭhaṃ yānti prāṇadharā yataḥ ||54|| siddhaistatra stutā vedā dhartuṃ rūpaṃ dvayaṃ dvayam | ekānte dravarūpeṇa mūrtirvo’trāvatiṣṭhatām ||55|| dvitīyā brahmaṇā sārdhaṃ brahmalokaṃ vrajetpunaḥ | tato vedāstu catvāro dvaidhīkṛtātmarūpakāḥ ||56 || brahmaṇā brahmalokaṃ te yayuḥ sārdhaṃ praharṣitāḥ | dravarūpā badaryāṃ cāvasan śāśvatasaṃsthitāḥ ||57|| ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvāṇo bhagavatpārśvavartinaḥ | vartante tīrtharūpāste tatra snānādikaṃ kṛtam ||58 || nāradenātha vedānāmudagasti sarasvatī | tatra jale kṛtaṃ snānaṃ tīrthe sārasvate śubhe ||59|| darśanasparśanasnānapūjāstutyabhivandanaiḥ | sarasvatyā na vicchedaḥ kule tasya kadācana ||1.207.6 0 || mantrasiddhiśca jāyeta vāṇī vāgvibhavapradā | dravarūpadharā tatra tīrthakṛtāṃ hi jāyate ||6 1 || tatra kṛtvā tīrthavidhiṃ tato’rvāgdakṣiṇe manāk | dravadhārāsti yatrendrastapaścakre tu pūrvaje || 62|| indrapadaṃ ca tannāma dvitīyamapi viśrutam | tapaḥ kṛtvā mahāghoraṃ prasantuṣya narāyaṇam ||6 3 || lebhe cendrapadaṃ sarvasurāsuranamaskṛtam | pratimāsaṃ trayodaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ haritoṣaṇe || 64|| upavāsadvayaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā janārdanam | sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śakraloke mahīyate ||65|| tatraiva mānasodbhedanāmakaṃ tīrthamasti hi | yatra sthalyāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ vāso’sti nityadā mataḥ ||66 || mānasaṃ cidacidgranthimudgrathnanti ca sarvaśaḥ | bhindanti hṛdayagranthīśchindanti bahusaṃśayān ||67|| karmāṇi kṣapayantyasmānmānasodbheda ityabhūt | paritaḥ ṛṣayastatra vasanti tāpasāḥ sadā ||68|| giridarīṣu phalasumūlavāryanilāśanāḥ | te triṣavaṇasnātāraḥ sadā jītendriyāntarāḥ ||69|| yadā tatra jalabinduṃ labhate puṇyavān janaḥ | bhavati vyāsasadṛśo yamapitṛsamaḥ kramāt ||1.207.70|| sakāmo vā ca niṣkāmo mānasodbhedake ca yat | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ samicchanvā karoti karma sadvidham ||7 1|| phalaṃ bhuktvā punarmuktiṃ labhate hi na saṃśayaḥ | svargādiṣu phalaṃ bhuktvā puruṣārthaṃ paraṃ labhet ||72|| atha tasmātpaścime’sti vasudhāretisaṃjñitam | tīrthaṃ tatra yayau so’yaṃ nārado narasaṃyutaḥ ||73|| trilokyāṃ sarvatīrthebhyaḥ śreṣṭho badarikāśramaḥ | śrutveti vasavaścāṣṭau nāradātprathamāt yayuḥ ||74|| triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi dalāṃbuprāśanāstapaḥ | cakrurupāyayuḥ siddhiṃ nārāyaṇasya darśanam ||75|| darśanena prasaṃhṛṣṭā avāpuḥ sukhamuttamam | vaiṣṇavīṃ prāpya dīkṣāṃ te yayuḥ sthānaṃ svakaṃ svakam ||76|| atra puṇyavatāṃ jyotirdṛśyate jalamadhyataḥ | tatra snātvā pūjayitvā nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ tathā ||77|| iha sarvaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā yāntyante cākṣaraṃ padam | dinatrayamupoṣitāḥ siddhānpaśyanti sādhavaḥ ||78|| āmo bhavaśca somaśca dharaścaiva nalo’nilaḥ | pratyūṣaśca prabhāvaśca vasavo’ṣṭau vasanti ye ||79|| tānapi tatra paśyanti divyarūpām̐śca tairthikāḥ | malināścāpi śuddhyanti muktibhājo bhavanti ca ||1.207.80 || vasudhārātmake tīrthe snātvā ca nāradastataḥ | pañcadhārātmakaṃ tīrthaṃ yayau nairṛtyadigbhavam ||8 1|| prabhāsaṃ puṣkaraṃ kurukṣetraṃ gayāṃ ca naimiṣam | etāni pañcatīrthāni pāpināṃ pāpadoṣataḥ ||82|| malināni yayurviśvasṛjaṃ nairmalyahetave | śrutvā brahmāgamahetuṃ smṛtvā badarikāśramam ||83 || prāha pragacchata kṣipraṃ harerbadarikāśramam | yatra praveśamātreṇa puṇyaṃ syātpāpanāśakam ||84|| tato natvā yayuḥ sarvatīrthāni badrikāśramam | tatra praveśamātreṇa niraināṃsi babhūvire ||85|| tato dvirūpamāsthāya tiṣṭhanti dravarūpataḥ | svasthāne’pi gatānyeva vasanti svīyarūpataḥ ||86|| teṣu snātvā hariṃ natvā pañcopavāsakṛjjanaḥ | iha bhogānbahūn bhuktvā hareḥ sālokyamāpnuyāt ||87|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vainateyaśilā gāruḍīśilā paṃcamukhīgaṃgā nārasiṃhīśilābrahmatīrtha sarasvatītīrtha dravadhārendrapadatīrtha mānasodbheda vasudhārā paṃcadhārātīrthādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||207||
<1.208> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tato yayau nāradaḥ somakuṇḍakam | tapaścacāra bhagavān somo yatra sthale purā || 1 || atrestu tanayaḥ somaḥ divyaṃ svargasukhaṃ mahat || gandharvebhyo’sakṛcchrutvā pitaraṃ prāptikāraṇam || 2 || papraccha ca punaḥ prāha bhavāmyahaṃ yathā pitaḥ | grahanakṣatratārāṇāmoṣadhīnāṃ patiḥ paraḥ || 3 || tathā me sādhanaṃ brūhi śrutvātriḥ samuvāca tam | tapasā prāpyate sarvaṃ samārādhya hariṃ tathā || 4 || na cāsti durlabhaṃ kiñcitsādhūnāmubhayatra vai | tādṛśaṃ ca paraṃ tīrthaṃ badrikāśramamasti hi || 5 || śrutvā jagāma badarīṃ somo viṣṇoḥ prapūjanam | aṣṭākṣaramanorjāpapūrvakaṃ pracakāra vai || 6 || aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi varṣāṇi bhagavatparaḥ | nityatriṣavaṇasnāyī tapastepe’tidāruṇam ||7 || śrīharistattapasā ca prasannaḥ san samāgataḥ | somaṃ provāca tu varaṃ varayeti muhurmuhuḥ || 8 || somo natvā hariṃ tatra daṃḍavat prahasaṃstadā | grahanakṣatratārāṇāmoṣadhīnāmahaṃ patiḥ || 9 || dvijānāmapi sarveṣāṃ bhūyāsaṃ te prasādataḥ | hariḥ prāha na te tādṛk tapo’styanyadvṛṇuṣva ca || 1.208.1 0|| somo nānyaṃ yayāce vai varaṃ tepe punastapaḥ | triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi tataśca bhagavānagāt || 11 || varaṃ varaya somaṃ ca prāha somo’pi tādṛśam | vavre śrutvāntardadhe ca hariḥ somaḥ punastadā || 12|| catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi tapastepe’tidāruṇam | tatastuṣṭo haristatra śaṃkhacakragadābjadhṛk || 1 3|| prāvirbabhūva covāca vṛṇuṣva varadānakam | somaḥ prāha yadi tuṣṭastaṃ varaṃ saṃprayaccha me || 14|| grahanakṣatratārāṇāmādhipatyaṃ prayaccha me | tathauṣadhīnāṃ viprāṇāṃ yāminyāśca jagatpate || 15|| bhagavānāha somaṃ vai prārthitaṃ durlabhaṃ tvayā | tathāpi vitarāmyadya bhava rājā tathāvidhaḥ || 16|| tato divaukasaḥ sarve militā badarīvane | abhiṣiṣicurvidhivatsomaṃ rājānamādṛtāḥ || 17|| tato vimānamāruhya rājā bhūtvā niśākaraḥ | divaṃ yātaśca tīrthaṃ tatsomakuṇḍeti viśrutam || 18|| darśanādgatadoṣāḥ syuḥ somalokaṃ prayānti ca | tatsparśanād yadvā snānādviṣṇulokaṃ prayānti ca || 19|| na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi | trirātreṇa sthito mantraṃ japan siddhiṃ suvindati || 1.208.20|| somatīrthaṃ tadā kṛtvā yayau śrīnārado muniḥ | dvādaśādityatīrthe saḥ snānaṃ cakre vidhānataḥ || 21 || kaśyapasyāditeḥ putrāstapastaptvātidāruṇam | ādityāḥ sūryatāṃ prāptāstīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ hi tat ||22|| ravivāreṣu saptamyāṃ saṃkrāntyāṃ vidhivajjanaḥ | snānena saptajanmāptapāpanāśaṃ karoti hi ||23|| pārākakṛchravrataṃ tu vidhivacca karoti yaḥ | sūryaloke sukhaṃ bhuktvā viṣṇulokaṃ prayāti saḥ ||24|| snātvā pītvā mahārogānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | tīrthaṃ kṛtvā yayau catuḥsrotaṃ tīrthavaraṃ tataḥ || 25|| dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca vartante’tra dravātmakāḥ | pūrvādidikṣu kramaśo bhūtānāṃ muktirūpakāḥ ||26|| vartante’tra pare kṣetre harerājñānusārataḥ | nānyakṣetre milantyete devānāmapi durlabhaḥ ||27|| puruṣārthānmūrtimantaste paśyantyatra sāttvikāḥ | yaistu puṇyānyarjitāni nārāyaṇasya sevayā || 28|| pumarthatīrthe brahmādyāḥ ṛṣayo munayastathā | parvaṇi prayatāḥ snātumāyānti tatprasiddhaye ||29|| tattīrthaṃ samanuṣṭhāya yayau śrīnārado naraḥ | tīrthaṃ satyapadaṃ nāma trikoṇakuṇḍamaṇḍitam ||1.208.30|| brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca trikoṇasthāḥ samāhitāḥ | tapaḥ kurvanti lokānāṃ toṣāya saharṣibhiḥ ||3 1 || ekādaśyāṃ haristatra svayamāyāti pāvanaḥ | ṛṣayo munayaścaiva surāścānye tapodhanāḥ ||32|| snātumāyānti kuṇḍe’tra harerbhaktiparāyaṇāḥ | japaṃ tapaḥ stutiṃ dhyānaṃ vaṃdanaṃ pūjanaṃ hareḥ ||3 3|| kurvatāṃ brahmaṇā puṇyapuñjaṃ vaktuṃ na pāryate | snātvā kṛtvā copavāsaṃ pūjayitvā hariṃ prabhum || 34|| jīvanmuktaścātra bhūtvā brahmamuktastato bhavet | snātvā prāpya satyalokaṃ tato mokṣapadaṃ vrajet || 35 || gandharvāpsarasāṃ yatra madhyāhne harivāsare | gānaṃ divyaṃ śrūyate vai satyavrataparāyaṇaiḥ ||36|| darśanātpātakādīni līyante tatpratāpataḥ | yayau tīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā naranārāyaṇāśramam ||37|| tīrthaṃ tīrthādimūrdhanyaṃ jalaṃ paramanirmalam | dvividhaṃ dṛśyate tatra śvetaṃ cāśvetamityapi ||38|| tatra snātvā pūjayitvā hariṃ pāpāt pramucyate | tatra tīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā hyurvaśītīrthamuttamam ||39|| yayau nārāyaṇāvāsaśikhare vimalaṃ jalam | vartate yatra śaityāḍhyaṃ nārado munirāṭ tataḥ ||1.208.40 || papraccha ca naraṃ tasya vṛttāntaṃ prāha vai naraḥ | dharmasya patnī mūrtyāsīnnaranārāyaṇau tayoḥ || 41 || putrau jātau tu bhagavān harirakṣaradhāmavān | naro’kṣara iti prokto nārāyaṇo hariḥ svayam ||42|| tau ca tapo vidhātuṃ vai sthitau ca nagayordvayoḥ | pitroḥ samājñayā śaśvat tepāte dāruṇaṃ tapaḥ ||43|| prajārakṣārthamevaitau dharmarakṣārthamityapi | indrastattapasā bhīto rājyanāśābhiśaṃkitaḥ ||44|| preṣayāmāsa sagaṇaṃ kāmaṃ vasantapārśvakam | harṣaḥ premā tathā bāṇāḥ dhanuścāpsarasastathā ||45|| pavanaśca sugandhāḍhyaḥ śītalo modakṛttathā | meghakaṇairmiśritaśca niśāyāḥ samayaḥ śubhaḥ ||46|| cāndrajyotsnāpi dhavalā kokilāścātakāstathā | mayūrā gāyakāścaiva nartakā vādakāstathā ||47|| evaṃ sarve militvaiva na nyūnaṃ sādhanaṃ bhavet | tathendrasyājñayā sarve kāmena saha saṃgatāḥ ||48|| yayuryatra naranārāyaṇau tapataḥ sanmunī | prathamaṃ candramāstatra jyotsnāṃ vistārayan sthitaḥ ||49|| sarvaṃ śāntaṃ ca dhāvalyadhautamivābhavattalam | niśāpi rājasaṃ vegamacchatimirabhāsayā ||1.208.50 || samaprāsārayattatra samayo’pi ca rājasaḥ | rajaḥsaṃkalpamādadhan prottejako’bhavanmuhuḥ ||5 1|| kokilā devalokasthā menāścaiva mayūrakāḥ | kūjanāni miṣṭaśabdān kekāścārebhire śanaiḥ ||5 2|| āmrāḥ puṣpairmañjarībhiḥ śobhante kāmabodhakāḥ | vasanto vṛkṣavallīṣu surabhipuṣparūpabhāk ||53 || sugandhāḍhyāstadā jāto mandaśca śītalo’nilaḥ | gāyakā nartakāḥ sarve vādakāścānurūpataḥ ||54|| gāyanaṃ nartanaṃ vādyaṃ hyakurvan kāmamiśritam | harṣaḥ premā viviśaturnaranārāyaṇau tadā ||55|| dhanuṣā mohanādyāśca bāṇāḥ kṣiptā manobhuvā | apsarasāṃ gaṇo divyo hāvabhāvavilāsakṛt ||56|| vividhāṃgapracālanapradarśanapramohanam | cakāronapañcadaśavarṣarūpadharastadā ||57|| naranārāyaṇayośca pādau mamarda bhāvataḥ | cucumba bahudhā pārśve gatvā gatvā punaḥ punaḥ ||58|| kāmasparśāṃstathā cakre gaṇḍahastakasakthiṣu | kāmo mumoca vai bāṇān pariśramamagāt tataḥ ||59|| sarvavikārayoge’pi naranārāyaṇau yathā | sthitau tu niścalanetrau tapasyeva tathā sthitau ||1.208.60|| manāgapi na calitau dhyānamagnau tathā sthitau | samājaśca tadā kāmadevasya niṣphalo’bhavat ||61|| tapodhvaṃsaṃ prakartuṃ te samarthā nābhavanyadā | vimanaskā gatāḥ sarve mahendramūcurasthirāḥ ||62||| na tatrāsmadbalaṃ kiñcidvikramate hi niṣphalam | sarvaṃ jātaṃ kṛtaṃ yadyat kūrmaścājñāṃ yathā hareḥ ||63|| indraḥ śrutvā ca tānsarvān nītvā tatsthalamāyayau | punaḥ kāmaprayogām̐śca kārayāmāsa tām̐stathā ||64|| niṣphalā abhavan samyak samādhisthahareḥ puraḥ | nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ dhyānādutthāyāha samāgatān ||65|| kimarthamāgatā yūyamātithyaṃ gṛhyatāmiti | ityuktvā phalamūlāni tebhyo dadau sa bhūriśaḥ ||66|| nārāyaṇastataḥ prāha naraṃ paśyendramaṇḍalam | apsarobhirmahendro’yaṃ garvaṃ karoti mānase ||67|| naitādṛśyo’nyatra santi mohikā vai surāṃganāḥ | na ca jānātyayaṃ me tvaiśvaryaleśaṃ vimohitaḥ ||68|| mayaiva racitāḥ sarvā mayi līnā bhavanti ca | mayaiva poṣitā rūpavatyo jānāti naiva saḥ ||69 || tasmādānaya cāmrāṇāṃ mañjarīrgaccha mā ciram | tāśca vāmena sakthnā tvaṃ mardayātra hi sannidhau ||1.208.70|| naraiṇaivaṃ kṛte tatrotpannā nārī mahojjvalā | ūrorjātā corvaśī sā dvādaśādvāpi kāmukī ||71 || rūpānurūpāvayavā yadagre’psaraso’sitāḥ | nistejaskāstadā jātāḥ kāmo’pi garvakhaṇḍitaḥ ||72|| indro mlānānano jāto dṛṣṭvorvaśīṃ navīkṛtām | yasya sparśena puṣpādvai śreṣṭhaṃ trilokasundaram ||73|| nārīratnaṃ samutpannaṃ kastaṃ mohayituṃ kṣamaḥ | matvaivaṃ ca kṣamāyācanārthaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ yayau ||74|| patitaḥ pādayoḥ śīghraṃ trāhi kṛtāparādhataḥ | uvāca vihvalo bhūtvā cāparādhīva mānavaḥ ||75|| nārāyaṇastadā prāha tava kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā | gaṇayāmi nāparādhaṃ svargaṃ yāhi sukhī bhava |||76 || tapaścarāmi lokānāṃ prasukhārthaṃ na tṛṣṇayā | rājyasya tava cānyasya pārameṣṭhyasya vā kṛte ||77|| na me tṛṣṇāsti rājyasya na te rājye spṛhā mama | vaikuṇṭhaṃ cidacitsarvaṃ mama rājyaṃ hi śāśvatam ||78|| mayā kṛtamidaṃ viśvaṃ nāhaṃ muhyāmi tatra vai | tvaṃ yathā prākṛtaṃ matvā mohayituṃ ca tāpasam ||79|| kṛtavānvai śramaṃ sarvaṃ vṛthā nārāyaṇe mayi | indro nārāyaṇaṃ natvā mohito corvaśīmaye ||1.208.80|| māyākārye surūpe ca yayāce tāṃ hareḥ punaḥ | bhagavannīdṛśaṃ ratnaṃ tāpasānāṃ ca vighnakṛt ||8 1 || svargayogyaṃ ca me bhāti nānayā te prayojanam | dehi tasmācca me nātha yāce’haṃ kiṃkarastava ||82|| punarnaivāparādhaṃ vai kariṣye te tapovidhau | nārāyaṇena śrutvaitaddattorvaśī ca sundarī |||83|| indrāya so’pi hṛṣṭaḥ san yayau svargaṃ samaṇḍalaḥ | yatrorvaśī samutpannānarasakthipramardanāt ||84|| tatsthale jalasampannamurvaśīkuṇḍatīrthakam | tatra snātvā vidhānena hyupoṣya rajanīdvayam ||85|| pūjayitvā hariṃ tatra naro nārāyaṇo bhavet | sakāmasya corvaśīsannibhā devī bhaved divi ||86|| urvaśīkuṇḍamāsādya kāmanāprabalo janaḥ | urvaśīlokamāpnuyāt snānamātreṇa bhāvataḥ ||87|| sadaiva bhagavām̐statra corvaśīkuṇḍasannidhau | prāṇināṃ kampayan śreyastapomūrtirvyavasthitaḥ ||88|| kīṭāḥ pataṃgāḥ śakuntā hasanti divi devatāḥ | bhuktimuktisamāyuktā vayaṃ yūyaṃ vimuktidāḥ ||89|| urvaśīkuṇḍamāsādya dinamekaṃ vasennaraḥ | urvaśīdakṣiṇe bhāge hyāyudhāni jagatpateḥ ||1.208.90|| vidyante darśanātteṣāṃ na śastrabhayabhāgbhavet | bahūni santi tīrthāni girau nārāyaṇāśrite ||91 || tānyahaṃ veda sarvāṇi nānyo vai prākṛto janaḥ | ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā śrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ ||92|| paṭhedvā pāṭhayettasya tattattīrthaphalaṃ bhavet | sarvapāpāni nirdhūya sālokyaṃ prāpnuyāddhareḥ |||93|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne somakuṇḍatīrthādityatīrtha catuḥpuruṣārthatīrthorvaśīsamutpattitīrthādivarṇananāmāṣṭādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 208 ||
<1.209> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi yayau paścānnārado merusaṃjñakam | sthalaṃ tīrthaṃ śubhaṃ brahmakuṇḍāddakṣiṇataḥ sthitam || 1 || narāvāsagirirmeruḥ sthāpito hariṇātra saḥ | yadā bhagavatā vāso viśālāyāṃ kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ || 2 || tadā meruṃ vihāyaiva savidyādharacāraṇāḥ | devā maharṣayaḥ siddhā harerdarśanalālasāḥ || 3 || viśālāyāṃ sadā sthātuṃ samāyātāḥ samutsukāḥ | bhagavaddarśanalabdhitiraskṛtatadālayāḥ || 4 || merurdevādihīno 3 jātaḥ śokaṃ cakāra ha | bhūtvā dīno yayau nārāyaṇaṃ prārthanahetave || 5 || prāha he bhagavan sarve tava darśanalālasāḥ | māṃ vihāyātra saṃyātā vināhaṃ vasatiṃ śubhām || 6 || śobhe nāto mayā tatra naiva vastavyameva ha | ahamapyatra vasitumicchāmi caraṇe tava || 7 || bhagavām̐śca tadā prāha naivaṃ kṣemāya vai bhavet | tava sthityā caturdaśabhuvanānāṃ sthitirmatā || 8 || tasmāddevādibhistatra sthātavyaṃ vai madājñayā | dvitīyasvasvarūpaiśca sthātavyamatra caiva yat || 9 || tvayāpyatra dvitīyena svarūpeṇa mamāśrame | sadā sthātavyamevātra matsevā lābhasaṃbhavāt || 1.209.10 || ityājñāṃ samanuprāpya meruśṛṃgāṇi sarvaśaḥ | rūpaṃ dvitīyamāsādya samāyātāni sūkṣmataḥ || 1 1|| tāni kāṃcanarūpāṇi hariṇā svakareṇa hi | gṛhītāni sthāpitāni sarvavāsāya tatra vai || 1 2|| sarve cālokya śṛṃgāṇi svarṇarūpāṇi harṣitāḥ | prasannāstuṣṭuvurdevaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛpākaram || 13 || dayālurbhagavān devo divānāṃ sukhahetave | meroḥ śṛṃgāṇyānināya tasmai namo vidhema ca || 14|| bhaktakṛpālpabhaktestu bahudhā phalado’sti yaḥ | so’yaṃ kṛpālayo devastuṣyatāṃ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ || 15|| sakaruṇaḥ sadā śikṣāṃ piteva vidhāti naḥ | karuṇāsāgaraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prapāyād vipado’pi naḥ || 16|| vidyādharāṇāṃ siddhānāmṛṣīṇāṃ mānaseṣṭadaḥ | sadā rakṣatu naścātra bhagavān bhaktarakṣakaḥ || 17|| tatastuṣṭo hi bhagavān varaṃ vṛṇudhvamāha tān | devāḥ prāhurmeruśṛṃgāṇi paśyanti ca ye janāḥ || 18|| teṣāṃ tava prasādena merau vāsau hi jāyatām | tvayā naitatsthalaṃ tyājyaṃ merustyājyo na vai tathā || 19|| merau vāsaṃ ca labdhānāṃ bhogānte’stu layastvayi | evamastviti saṃbhāṣya tatraivāntarhito hariḥ ||1.209.20|| tataḥ prabhṛti devādyā naranārāyaṇāśrame | kvacinmerau kvacitsvarge kvacidvai raivatācale ||21|| nirviśaṃkā nivasanti yatra nārāyaṇo naraḥ | evaṃ vai nārado merutīrthaṃ kṛtvā yayau tataḥ || 22|| lokapālairadhiśritaṃ tīrthaṃ saumyaṃ saroyutam | hariḥ svayaṃ gato merau dṛṣṭāstatra ca devatāḥ ||23|| ṛṣayaścātha munayo lokapālāḥ surādayaḥ | dṛṣṭvāha lokapālānsaḥ yūyaṃ rājāna eva vai || 24|| ṛṣyādivasatau vāso na yogyau bhavatāṃ kṛte | āgacchantu mayā klṛpte sthāne yogye bhavatkṛte ||25|| nivasantu ca tatraiva mama sānnidhyamāśritāḥ| ityānītā lokapālā merumadhyapradeśataḥ || 26|| sthāpitāstatsukhārthaṃ ca jalāśayo mahān kṛtaḥ | daṇḍena ca bhuvaṃ hatvā krīḍāpuṣkariṇī kṛtā ||27|| lokapālāśca gandharvā gīrvāṇāḥ pramadāyutāḥ | vicarantyanumodante pragāyanti ca sarvadā ||28|| vanāni kusumāmodaramyāṇi ca kṛtāni vai | bhagavānapi sarveṣāmatyānandaṃ samāvahan ||29|| dvādaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca svayamāyāti majjane | dṛśyate paramaṃ tejo jale madhyāhnakālataḥ ||1.209.3 0|| sarvatīrthāvagāhasya phalaṃ tatraiva labhyate | daṇḍapuṣkariṇītīrthamihāmutra phalapradam ||3 1 || piṇḍadānācca jāyeta gayāto’ṣṭaguṇaṃ phalam | dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣasya jyeṣṭhamāse’tra puṣkare ||32|| yajñaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā kṛtakṛtyo bhavejjanaḥ | akṣayyaṃ phalamaśnāti mokṣaṃ yāti tataḥ param ||33|| badarītīrthamadhye tu guptametaddhi vartate | bahuprasūtapuṇyā vai paśyantyetanna cetare ||34|| iti daṇḍodakaṃ tīrthaṃ kṛtvā ca nārado yayau | gaṃgāyāṃ mānasodbhedasaṃgame tīrthasūttame ||35|| triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi prayāge tapasaḥ phalam | tatphalaṃ mānasodbhede tīrthe snānakṛtaṃ bhavet ||36||| saṃgamāddakṣiṇe bhāge dharmasya bhavanaṃ śubham | yatra mūrtyāṃ janma cāptau naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ||37|| yatra dharmaścatuṣpādaḥ satyaṃ yajñastapastathā | dānaṃ ceti vartate smānuṣṭhitasyākṣayaṃ phalam || 38|| tato dakṣiṇadigbhāge urvaśīsaṃgamābhidham | kūrmoddhārastatastīrthaṃ snānātsattvasya śuddhikṛt || 39|| brahmāvartastatastīrthaṃ brahmalokapradaṃ hi tat | evaṃ bahūni tīrthāni bhavanti badarīvane ||1.209.40|| darśanātsmaraṇātsnānātpānādācamanāttathā | mārjanātpāpahantṝṇi mokṣadāni ca yogataḥ ||41|| kṛtvā sarvāṇi tīrthāni nāradaḥ punarāyayau | narasyāśramamādivyaṃ sthitvā naramukhāttataḥ ||42|| śuśrāva kṣetramāhātmyaṃ śāntyaikāgradhiyārttihṛt | badaryākhyaṃ hareḥ kṣetraṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham ||43|| smaraṇāścāsya pāpāni naśyanti dāruṇānyapi | anyatīrthe kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ badaryāḥ smaraṇādbhavet ||44|| aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ vāyubhojyasya yatphalam | kṣetrāntare badaryāṃ tu tatphalaṃ kṣaṇamātrataḥ ||45|| kṛte muktipradā nāmnā tretāyāṃ yogasiddhidā | viśālā dvāpare nāmnā kalau badryāśramo hi saḥ ||46|| mukteḥ pradā ca yogasya siddhidā sarvathā yathā | śālātmakasya dehasya viśālā tu vināśanāt ||47|| badarītaruyogāddhi badarikāśramo hi saḥ | tyajetsarvāṇi tīrthāni kāle yugāntare’pi ca ||48|| badarīṃ tu harirnārāyaṇo muñcati naiva hi | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi yogātkāśyāṃ tu yatphalam ||49|| badaryā tu dinaikena tatphalaṃ samavāpyate | devatīrtharṣīṇāṃ śālā viśiṣṭāḥ santi yatra hi ||1.209.50|| viśālā ca matā sārthā śālā jñānasya vestathā | viśālānādisiddhā sā yathā vedā harestanuḥ ||5 1|| anyatra maraṇānmuktiḥ svadharmavidhipūrvakāt | badarīdarśanādeva muktiṃ puṃsāṃ kare sthitā ||52|| dharmādharmau vijityātha badarīśaṃ narāyaṇam | dṛṣṭvā muktiṃ tūpayāti vināyāsaṃ jano’tra vai ||53|| sarvayugeṣu bhagavān vaikuṇṭhasadṛśīṃ śubhām | badarīṃ samanuprāpya sākṣādevāvatiṣṭhate ||54|| vinā jñānena yogena tīrthāṭanapariśramaiḥ | ekena janmanā jantuḥ kaivalyapadamaśrute ||55|| janmāntarasahasraiśca yena cārādhito hariḥ | sa gacched badarīṃ draṣṭuṃ yatra gatvā na śocati ||56|| badarībadarītyuktvā prasaṃgānmuktibhāgbhavet | viśālāṃ badarīṃ dṛṣṭvā puṃso mṛtyubhayaṃ kutaḥ ||57||| saśailakānanā pṛthvī daśadhā dakṣiṇīkṛtā | hareḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ bhūmau badaryāṃ tu pade pade ||58|| aśvamedhasya yajñasya vājapeyaśatasya ca | hareḥ pradakṣiṇāyāśca puṇyaṃ pade padetra vai ||59|| badaryāṃ bhagavānatti yadannaṃ divyatāṃ gatam | tatsattvaśuddhaye sarvairbhoktavyamavicāritam ||1.209.60|| amarā harinaivedyaṃ bhoktuṃ bhavanti tatparāḥ | bālyayauvanavārdhakye kṛtaṃ prāṇāntapātakam ||6 1|| viṣṇorniveditaṃ bhuktvā badaryāṃ tannivartate | naivedyabhakṣaṇādatra sālokyaṃ labhate hareḥ ||62|| hṛdi rūpaṃ mukhe nāma naivedyamudare hareḥ | pādodakaṃ sanirmālyaṃ mastake yasya so’cyutaḥ ||63|| brahmahatyādipāpāni naśyanti caraṇāmṛtāt | kiṃ dānaistapasā tīrthairniyamaiśca pariśramaiḥ ||64|| badaryā viṣṇupādāderbindumātraṃ miled yadi | sūryagrahe kurukṣetre mahādānaphalaṃ hi yat ||65|| badaryāṃ grāsamātreṇa cāturmāsyaphalādhikam | vedāntaśravaṇātpuṇyaṃ badaryāṃ caraṇāmṛtāt ||66||| badaryāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ dīkṣāṃ ye gṛhṇanti jaḍā api | muktiḥ karatale teṣāṃ bhūmikādarśanādapi ||67|| ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ śrāvayeccāpi pāṭhayet | paṭhedvā pāpamuktaḥ saḥ padaṃ viṣṇoḥ prapadyate ||68|| rājā vijayamāpnoti sutārthī labhate sutam | kanyārthī labhate kanyāṃ kanyā vindati satpatim ||69|| dhanārthī dhanamāpnoti vyādhyādhyadhananāśanam | daurbhāgyāpamṛtyugrahaduḥsvapnādivināśanam ||1.209.7 0 || śrutvā natvā naranārāyaṇau bhuktvā prasādakam | yayau satyaṃ brahmalokaṃ vivāhārthaṃ sa nāradaḥ ||7 1|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne merutīrthadaṇḍapuṣkariṇīmānasodbhedanaranārāyaṇajanmasthānadharmorvaśīsgamakūrmoddhārabrahmāvartāditīrthatatkṣetraprasādacaraṇāmṛtamāhātmyādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||209|||
<1.210> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca mahālakṣmi nārado haribhaktimān | jagāma bhavanaṃ svasya brahmā tuṣṭo’bhavad bahu || 1 || tīrthayātrāṃ vidhāyābhyāgatasya nāradasya ca | yogyamutsavamāreme samāhūya surādikān || 2 || nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo viṣṇuścāpi ramāpatiḥ | śivaścānye lokapālāḥ ṛṣayaśca samāgatāḥ || 3 || brahmasabhā tadā divyā śuśubhe brahmadhāmavat | brahmā putraṃ nāradaṃ vai sabhāyāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ satām || 4 || nāradaṃ prāha dharmyaṃ sadvacaḥ śaṃkarasannidhau | upabarhaṇagandharvaḥ paṃcāśatkāminīpatiḥ || 5 || janmāntare bhavānāsīdadhunā brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ | tāsvekā ca satī mālāvatī tapasā śaṃkaram || 6 || ārādhya ca varaṃ lebhe vāñchitaṃ nāradaṃ patim | sā ca sṛṃjayakanyāsti svarṇaṣṭhīvīsahodarā || 7 || tāṃ vivāhaṃ kuruṣveti śaṃkarājñāṃ prapālaya | sundarīṃ sundarīṣveva pātivrataparāyaṇām || 8 || kamanīyāṃ haravarāt śaśvatsusthirayauvanām | vidhātrā likhitāṃ bhāle vivāhaya ca nārada || 9 || tvayā pūrvaṃ yathoktaṃ vai tīrthayātrottaraṃ tathā | vivāhabhāgyamāpannaṃ prāktanaṃ kena vāryate || 1.210.10 || nāyuktaṃ kṣīyate karma kālakoṭiśatairapi | avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham || 1 1|| brahmaṇaśca vacaḥ śrutvā pitrājñāpālakastadā | nārado vinayaṃ kṛtvā nanāma sarvadevatāḥ || 12|| pitrādiṣṭaṃ sadaivedaṃ dhāryate ca mayā punaḥ | bhavatāṃ kṛpayā tatra bandhanaṃ me bhavennahi || 1 3|| varaṃ vṛṇomi bhagavadbhaktimanmānasaṃ bhavet | kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo viṣṇuḥ śivaścāhustathāstviti || 14|| praṇamya prayayau devān nāradaḥ sṛṃjayālayam | dṛṣṭvā sa mohito ramyāṃ divyāṃ sṛṃjayakanyakām || 15 || tapasvinīṃ mahābhāgāṃ viṣṇuvrataparāyaṇām | svīkṛtya manasā tāṃ ca śubhāṃ provāca nāradaḥ || 16 || bāle jānāsi māṃ vā na tvāṃ jānāmi tu pūrvajām | mālāvatītivikhyātāṃ gandharvapramadottamām || 17|| śrutvā mālāvatī dṛṣṭvā nāradaṃ ca mumoha ca | pratyabhijñāya pūrvasya janmanaḥ patimeva ca || 18|| pādayoḥ patitā śīghraṃ cucumba varaṇāya sā | nārado’pi yayāce tāṃ tatpituḥ purataḥ sthitaḥ || 1 9|| mālāvatyabhiprāyaṃ ca jñātvā śrīsṛṃjayaḥ svayam | vākdānena dadau tasmai nāradāya svaputrikām || 1.210.20 || tilakaṃ bhojanaṃ kṛtvā vastraśāṭīṃ pradāya ca | nāradaḥ śvaśuraṃ natvā śvaśrūṃ pṛṣṭvā priyāṃ tathā || 21 || yayau brahmasabhāṃ ramyāṃ sarvadevādhivāsitām | praṇamya pitaraṃ śāntaḥ sarvaṃ tattvamuvāca tam || 22|| brahmā prahṛṣṭavadanaḥ śrutvā vākgdānamaṃgalam | cakre samutsavaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvānāhūya ceśvarān || 23 || munīnṛṣīṃstathā pitṝn devān daityāṃśca dānavān | kāśyapīśca prajāḥ sarvāścakārāhūya maṃgalam || 24|| sṛṃjayaḥ preṣayāmāsa vipreṇa lagnapatrikām | brahmā svīkṛtya tāṃ putraṃ lokācāramakārayat || 25|| vivāhasya muhūrtaṃ ca vācayāmāsa tatra vai | bhojanāni vividhāni kārayāmāsa viśvasṛṭ || 26 || dānayānopakaraṇapeyādheyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ | bhojyajātāni vastūni kārayāmāsa viśvasṛṭ || 27|| śubhe kṣaṇe svayaṃ brahmā koṭyabjārbudakoṭibhiḥ | surāsurairjanavāhaistattannārīsamanvitaiḥ || 28 || sahito ratnayānaiśca varayātrāmakalpayat | putraṃ kṛtvā ca purato janasenāṃ suśobhitām || 29 || mahīmānārbudakoṭikoṭyarbudasamanvitām | nītvā śaṃbhvacyutayukto yayau sṛṃjayamandiram || 1.210.30 || sṛṃjayaḥ satkṛtaye’bhiyayau svajanabāndhavaiḥ | varasya vāhinīṃ svasyodyāne cāsthāpayatkṣaṇam || 31 || jalapānaṃ ca viśrāntiṃ kārayitvā ca bhojanam | varaṃ sāyaṃ bhūṣayitvā nināya maṇḍapaṃ prati || 32|| kanyāyāśca kṛte vastrabhūṣagāni bahūni ca | preṣayāmāsa ramyāṇi brahmā vai svānurūpataḥ || 32 || dvāre pūjāṃ śiṣṭācāraṃ vidhāya sṛṃjayaḥ | lokācāraṃ vidhāyāthāpūjayannāradaṃ varam || 34|| mukhyāgnivedikāyāśca samīpe’tiṣṭhipadvaram | kanyāṃ śṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyāmānayāmāsa tatra ca || 35 || brāhmaṇairmunibhistatra saptarṣibhiśca bhūsuraiḥ | māṃgalyamantrāḥ paṭhitā dehaśuddhiśca kāritā || 36 || vastragranthiṃ bandhayitvā varamālāṃ samarpya ca | kanyāhastaṃ varahaste dadau sṛṃjayarāṭ svayam || 37|| vedaghoṣāstadā jātā vādyānyavādayam̐stathā | vadhūḥ kavalamādāya nāradāsye dadau tadā || 38|| nārado’pi navavadhvā mukhe grāsaṃ dadau śubham | agneḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā homakāryaṃ cakāra vai || 39 || śiṣṭācāraṃ paraṃ kṛtvā dattvā dānāni bhūriśaḥ | vivāhakāryaṃ sarvaṃ saḥ samāptamakarottadā ||1.210.4 0 || kanyāyāśca yautadravyaṃ varasyāpi prapūjanam | dattaṃ kṛtaṃ janaiḥ sarvairbhojanaṃ svīkṛtaṃ tataḥ ||4 1 || nidrāṃ kṛtvā samājaśca prātarmaṃgalavādanam | nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ gandharvāpsarasāṃ vyalokayat ||42 || bahudānāni dattāni bhojanāni ca sarvathā | kāritāni sṛṃjayena prāghūṇikāḥ samānitāḥ ||43 || sarvasvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā maṇimuktādikaṃ tathā | puṭāṃjaliyuto bhūtvā parihāraṃ cakāra saḥ ||44|| sṛṃjayaśca śubho rājā kanyāṃ samarpya bhāvataḥ | vāhinīṃ yāpayāmāsa vinayena mudānvitaḥ ||45 || sṛṃjayastasya patnī ca kanyāviyogasaṃbhavam | sehāte na tadā duḥkhaṃ rurudāte kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ || 46 || kanyāpi rurude snehād viyogārtisumiśritāt | praṇamya pitarau kanyā rudantau mātaraṃ tathā || 47|| āśliṣya dhairyamādāya cāruroha rathaṃ vidheḥ | gṛhītvā ca sabhāryaṃ taṃ putraṃ dhātā mudānvitaḥ ||48 || lokācāraṃ ca satkṛtya brahmalokaṃ yayau sukham | ṛṣīnmunīṃstathā devān pitṝn siddhām̐śca mānavān || 49|| viprām̐śca bhojayāmāsa sāṃge maṃgalakarmaṇi | dānāni dāpayāmāsa vādayāmāsa dundubhim ||1.210.5 0 || yāpayāmāsa sarvāṃśca mahīmānānsurāsurān | nāradastu muniśreṣṭho likhitena svakarmaṇā ||5 1 || suramye puṣpatalpe ca sugandhicandanārcite| sa reme ramayā sārdhaṃ bubudhe na divāniśam ||52|| ekadā nāradastatra vaṭamūle vyavasthitaḥ | tatrājagāma nagnaśca prajvalan brahmatejasā |||53|| sanatkumāro bhagavān bālakaḥ pañcahāyanaḥ | acūḍo’nupanītaśca vedasandhyāvihīnakaḥ ||54|| kṛṣṇamantraṃ japan tribhirbhrātṛbhiḥ sahitastadā | vaiṣṇavānāmagraṇīśo jñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ ||55||| nārāyaṇo gururyasya darśanānmuktido muniḥ | ārād dṛṣṭvā nāradastaṃ bhrātaraṃ ca satāṃ varam ||56|| natvā ca daṇḍavat bhūmau dadāvāsanamuttamam | uvāca bālakastatra prahasya nāradaṃ śubham ||57|| aye bhrātaḥ kiṃ karoṣi kuśalaṃ yuvatīpate | strīpuṃsorvardhate prema kāmavegānnavaṃ navam ||58|| argalaṃ jñānamārgasya bhaktimārganirodhakam | mokṣamārgavyavadhānaṃ śaśvadbandhanadaṃ matam ||59|| nārāyaṇāmṛtaṃ tyaktvā viṣaṃ viṣiyajāmṛtam | viṣaye’tiprasakto vai matvā bhuṃkte’timūḍhavat ||1.210.60|| sudhāṃ tyaktvā viṣaṃ cātti māyāmohavaśaṃgataḥ | tvaṃ tu bhaktaścātmavettā jīvanmukto’si sarvadā ||6 1|| nirgaccha tapase bhrātarmāyāṃ patnīṃ vihāya vai | sthite nārāyaṇe pṛthvyāṃ bhaja taṃ tapasā sadā ||62|| gṛhāṇa mama mantraṃ ca kṛṣṇa ityakṣaradvayam | nārāyaṇānmayā labdhaste mantraṃ taṃ dadāmyaham ||63|| ityuktvā pradadau mantraṃ dadau śubhāśiṣaṃ tathā | golokaṃ prayayau draṣṭuṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam || 64|| nārado mālayā nityaṃ japati dvyakṣaraṃ manum | śrīkṛṣṇe niścalāṃ bhaktiṃ pūrvakarmanikṛntanīm ||65|| cakārābhyāsavairāgyasahitāmātmavedinīm | bhāryāṃ dvilakṣavarṣāṇi bhuktvā sutāḥ sutām̐stathā ||66 || lakṣānutpādya gandharvān gandharvīrlakṣakanyakāḥ | sarvāpatyāni gāndharvaloke saṃsthāpya śaktitaḥ ||67|| sarvāṃśca vaiṣṇavān kṛtvā bhaktiṃ nirdiśya mādhave | patnīṃ ca rāgarahitāṃ kṛtvā bhaktiṃ pradiśya ca ||68|| tatkauśalyaṃ sutebhyaśca vinirdiśya yayau muniḥ | kṛtamālānadītīre tapase sa mano’karot ||6 9|| tatra dadarśa śaṃbhuṃ saḥ pūrvaguruṃ sanātanam | dṛṣṭvā ca nārado mūrdhnā praṇanāma śivaṃ gurum ||1.210.70|| śivaḥ provāca dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ prasanno’haṃ bhavāmi vai | bhaktānāṃ darśanaṃ yatra sudinaṃ taccharīriṇām ||7 1 || ayaṃ hi paramo lābho bhaktānāṃ saṃgamo yadā | sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu yo dadarśa ca vaiṣṇavam ||72 || goloke kṛṣṇadatto vai mantro dvyakṣara eva yaḥ | kṛṣṇa iti mayā prāpto dharmeṇa brahmaṇā tathā ||73 || dharmo nārāyaṇāyārthasahitaṃ pradadau tataḥ | brahmā sanatkumārāya tubhyaṃ dattaśca tena vai ||74|| mantragrahaṇamātreṇa naro nārāyaṇo bhavet | pañcalakṣajapenāsya puraścaraṇamucyate ||75 || dhyānaṃ ca pāpadahanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyettu vaiṣṇavaḥ | kiśoramūrtiṃ jīmūtasamavarṇaṃ manoharam ||76 || pītāmbaraṃ ghanaśyāmaṃ koṭikandarpasundaram | amūlyaratnakhacitābhūṣaṇādivibhūṣitam ||77|| candanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ kaustubhena virājitam | mayūrabarhacūḍaṃ ca ratnamālāvirājitam ||78 || prasannahāsyavilasanmukhaṃ saundaryabhājanam | bhaktānugrahakartāraṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sarvadā bhaje ||79 || śaṃbhurevaṃ smārayitvādṛśyabhāvaṃ gatastataḥ | nārado’pi hariṃ smṛtvā tapaḥ kṛtvā sudāruṇam ||1.210.8 0 || bhaktyā nārāyaṇaṃ prāpya dehaṃ divyaṃ vidhāya ca | nityamuktasvarūpo’bhūt golokādyahatasṛtiḥ ||8 1 || iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi nāradasya vivāhanam | yacchrutvāpi virajyeta kimanyacchrotumicchasi ||82 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nāradasya brahmasabhāgamanaṃ brahmaṇā vivāhāya kathitam sṛṃjayasya putryā mālāvatyā vivāhāya nāradasya varayātrā lagnaṃ lakṣaputrān lakṣaputrīṃścotpādya dvilakṣavarṣottaraṃ kṛtamālātīre tapase gamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā daśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 210 ||
<1.211> śrīlakṣmīruvāca agnayo vai brahmamukhā brahmāṃśā yajñadevatāḥ | kadā kasmātsamutpannāstatkathāṃ śrāvaya prabho || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca uṣṇasparśavataścāgneḥ kāryātmakasya kāraṇam | devaḥ sa cetano vahnirbrahmaṇo mānasaḥ sutaḥ || 2 || agnyabhimānidevaḥ saḥ tasmāt svāhā vyajāyata | pāvakaḥ pavamānaśca śuciśceti trayaḥ sutāḥ || 3 || sauraḥ śucirbhavatyeva pāvakā vaidyutā matāḥ | śrāddhe vahniḥ pavamānastatsutaḥ kavyavāhanaḥ .|| 4 || pāvakasya suputro’bhūt saharakṣābhidhastathā | śuceḥ putro havyavāho devānāṃ bhojanapradaḥ || 5 || pitṝṇāṃ kavyavāhaścāsurāṇāṃ saharakṣakaḥ | eteṣāṃ putrapautrāśca catvāriṃśattathā nava || 6 || vaidyutasya brahmaudanastatsuto bharatāhvayaḥ | tasya vaiśvānaravahnistasya kāvyo hyapāṃ rasaḥ || 7 || puṣkarodadhimathanādatharvāgnirajāyata | tasya sutaśca dadhyaṃgo bodhyo vai vahnimaṇḍale || 8 || atharvā ca bhṛguḥ prokto’ṅgirāścātharvaṇaḥ sutaḥ | ataśca bhārgavoṃ’girā laukikāgniḥ prakathyate || 9 || pavamānastu nirmathyo gārhapatyo’pi nāmataḥ | tasya putradvayaṃ śaṃsyaḥ śukraśceti pranāmataḥ || 1.211.1 0|| śaṃsyastvāhavanīyo’gniryo havyavāṭ kriyātmakaḥ | tathā sabhyāvasathyau dvau śaṃsyasyāgneḥ sutau matau || 11 || śaṃsyastu ṣoḍaśanadīścakame pramadāvarāḥ | kāverīṃ kṛṣṇaveṇīṃ ca narmadāṃ yamunāṃ tathā || 1 2|| godāvarīṃ vitastāṃ ca candrabhāgāmirāvatīm | vipāśāṃ kauśikīṃ caiva śatadruṃ sarayūṃ tathā || 13 || sītāṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva hrādinīṃ pāvanīṃ ca tāḥ | tāsūtpannā hyagnayo ye dhiṣṇayaste prakīrtitāḥ || 14|| ṛtuḥ pravāhaṇognīdhraḥ samrāḍagniḥ kṛśānukaḥ | samrāḍagnayastvaṣṭau ca parṣannāmnā nabhastathā || 15|| vasuśca havyasūryaśca viśvasyāyaśca paṃcamaḥ | ṛtudhāmājaikapāccāhirbudhnaśceti te smṛtāḥ || 16 || śaṃsyasutā hyupastheyā viharaṇīyāstatsutāḥ | aṣṭau viharaṇīyāḥ syuḥ śāntiḥ pracetāḥ satyakaḥ || 17|| viśvadevaścāvakṣuśca hyacchāvāka uśīrakaḥ | vyaratniśceti te bodhyāḥ yajñe savanasaṃkramāt || 18|| apāṃ garbhe pāvako’vabhṛthastasya ca hṛcchrayaḥ | jāṭharasya suto manyustasya ghorasaṃvartakaḥ || 1 9|| samudre sa vaḍavākhyastatsutaḥ saharakṣaka | tasya kṣāmastasya kravyādo’gniḥ pāvakavaṃśajāḥ || 1.211.20|| śuceścāraṇeyavahnirāyurnāmā sa ucyate | tasya mahimān putraśca tasya śāvānsuto mataḥ ||2 1 || tasyāpi savanaḥ putrastasyāpyadbhuta ucyate | adbhutasya viviciśca tasyārkaḥ suta ucyate ||22|| arkasyānīkavān vāsṛjavāśca rakṣohā tathā | pitṛkṛt tathā surabhiḥ rukmavām̐śceti vahnayaḥ ||23|| manvantareṣu sarveṣu bhavanti jātavedasaḥ | prajānāṃ patayaḥ sarve jyotiṣmantaśca te smṛtāḥ ||24|| iti te kathitā lakṣmi vahnayo mukhyanāmataḥ | homādyaiḥ phaladāḥ sarve mantrasiddhikarāḥ sadā |||25|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vahnivaṃśavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||2 1 1||
<1.212> śrīlakṣmīruvāca dvāparānte tadā cādye kāśyapeyīṃ ca maithunīm | sṛṣṭiṃ śrotuṃ samicchāmi vada me parameśvara || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu kaśyapadāyādān vacmi te tu yathākramam | dakṣeṇa svasya putrstu kaśyapāya caturdaśa || 2 || dattā vivāhavidhinā tāsāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu | aditirdevamātābhūt daityamātā ditistathā || 3 || kadrūśca sarpamātābhūd vinatā pakṣisūstathā | surabhiśca gavāṃ mātā paśūnāṃ cāpi sā prasūḥ || 4 || sārameyādisattvānāṃ saramā sūścatupadām | danuḥ prasūrdānavānāṃ timiryādogaṇaprasūḥ || 5 || tāmrā sūḥ śyenagṛdhrāṇāṃ munirapsarasāṃ prasūḥ | krodhavaśā prasūḥ sarpadandaśūkādiroṣiṇām || 6 || ilā prasūḥ pādapānāṃ surasā yātudhānasūḥ | gandharvaprasūrariṣṭā yāsāṃ prajāmayaṃ jagat||| 7 || indraśca dvādaśādityā upendrādyāḥ surāstathā | kathitāścāditeḥ putrā mahābalaparākramāḥ || 8 || indraputro jayantaśca patnyāṃ śacyāmajāyata | śanaiścarayamau sūryāt saṃjñāyāṃ yamunā tathā | upendravīryāt pṛthvyāṃ tu maṃgalaḥ samajāyata || 9 || upendrarūpamālokya kāmārtā ca vasundharā | vidhāya sundarīveṣaṃ śayyāyāṃ samupasthitā || 1.212.10|| upendrastanmano jñātvā śṛṃgāraṃ pracakāra ha | vīryādhānaṃ ca yajjātaṃ durbalā rakṣituṃ ca tat || 11 || pravālapatre patitaṃ kumāraḥ samapadyata | tejasā sūryasadṛśo nārāyaṇasutaḥ svayam || 12|| maṃgalākhyaḥ sa hariṇā graheṣu sthāpitaḥ śubhaḥ | atha diterhiraṇyakaśipurhiraṇyanetrakau || 13|| kanyā ca siṃhikā jātā saihikeyaśca tatsutaḥ | nirṛtiḥ siṃhikā sā ca tena rāhuśca nairṛtaḥ || 14|| vārāheṇa hiraṇyākṣo jalamadhye yuvā hataḥ | hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putraḥ prahlādo vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ || 15|| virocanaśca tatputrastatputraśca baliḥ svayam | balerbāṇo mahāyogī ditivaṃśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 16|| atha kadrvā sutāḥ sarpāḥ kālīyo vāsukistathā | karkoṭako dhanañjayastakṣakaḥ padma ityapi || 17|| airāvato mahāpadmaḥ śaṃkuḥ śaṃkhastathāparaḥ | dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ saṃvaraṇo durdharṣo durjayastathā || 18|| durmukhaśca balaścaiva gokṣo gokārmukastathā | virūpaśceti pravarāḥ sarvā vai sarpajātayaḥ || 1 9|| jaratkārvīti vai kanyā jaratkārustu yatpatiḥ | āstīkatanayo viṣṇutulyaguṇaparākramaḥ ||1.212.20|| eteṣāṃ nāmamātreṇa nāgabhītirna vai bhavet | atha danordvimūrdhā ca śaṃkukarṇo nirāmayaḥ ||2 1 || mahāviśvo gaveṣṭhiśca dundubhiraṃgirāvṛtaḥ | marīcirakṣakaścaiva mahāgārgyo hyajāmukhaḥ ||22|| śilo vāmanasaścaiva vikṣobhyaḥ suhṛdastathā | suketuśca suvīryaśca cendrajit viśvajittathā ||23|| suravimardanaścaikacakraśca tārakastathā | mahābalaḥ suvāhaśca pulomā ca pravīṇakaḥ ||24|| vaiśvānaro mahāśirāḥ svarbhānurmuṇḍakastathā | vṛṣaparvā dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ sūkṣmaśca tāpinastathā ||25|| ūrṇanābho mahāgirirasilomā sukeśakaḥ | sadaśca balakaścaiva kuṃbhanābho mahodaraḥ ||26 || pramodāho vyomamūrdhā kupatho hayamastakaḥ | asuraśca virūpākṣaḥ śatamāyuśca śambaraḥ ||27|| śarabhaḥ śalabhaścaiva danoḥ putrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | teṣāmaparisaṃkhyeyaṃ putrapautrādyanantakam ||28|| siṃhikāyāmathotpannā vipracittisutāstvime | śatagālaśca balavān nyāsaḥ śāmbastathāparaḥ ||29|| ilvalo namuciścāpi vātāpī dasṛyājakaḥ | harakalpaḥ kālanābho bhaumaśca narakastathā ||1.212.30 || rāhuścaite saiṃhikeyā daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ | bhavantyeva vaṃśaparamparājātāḥ surāriṇaḥ ||3 1 || citrasena ugrasena ūrṇāyuranaghastathā | dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ pulomā ca sūryavarcāstathaiva ca ||32|| yugapat tṛṇapat kāliditiścitrarathastathā | bhramiśirāśca parjanyaḥ kaliśca nāradastathā ||33|| ityete devagandharvā mauneyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ | miśrakeśī tathā cāśī parṇinī cāpyalambuṣā ||34|| māricī putrikā caiva vidyudvāṇī tilottamā | adrikā lakṣaṇā caiva devī raṃbhā manoramā ||35|| suvarā ca subāhvī ca pūrṇitā ca pratiṣṭhitā | puṇḍarikā sugandhā ca sudantā surasā tathā ||36|| hemā śāradvatī caiva suvṛttā kamalā tathā | subhujā haṃsapādā ca laukikyo’psarasastathā ||37|| gandharvāpsaraso hyetā mauneyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ | suyaśāyā duhitaraścatasro’psarasaḥ smṛtāḥ ||38|| lauheyī bharatā caiva kṛśāṃgī ca viśālikā | viśālena ca tābhyastu yakṣā utpāditā yathā || 39|| lauheyā bharateyāśca kṛśāṃgeyā viśālajāḥ | śivā ca sumanā caiva kanye dve’pi sulocane ||1.212.40 || tābhyāṃ viśravasā vidyādharā utpāditāḥ samam | vikrāntena ca tenaivotpāditāḥ kinnarā api ||41|| samudrasenaḥ kālindo mahānetro mahābalaḥ | suvarṇaghoṣaḥ sugrīvo mahāghoṣaśca vīryavān ||42|| hayānanānāmevaṃ ca kinnarāṇāṃ gaṇastathā | naramukhāḥ kinnarāścotpāditāḥ śāṃśapāyanāḥ |||43|| hariṣeṇaḥ suṣeṇaśca vāriṣeṇaśca vīryavān | rudradattendradattau ca candradrumamahādrumau ||44|| binduśca bindusāraśca candravaṃśā hi kinnarāḥ | lauheyā duhitā suravindeti nāmadhāriṇī ||45|| bhūtāstasyāḥ samutpannā āveśakaniveśakāḥ | sutāraḥ kālabhavanānirdeśakavideśakāḥ ||46|| vṛkṣāgramātramākāśaṃ te caranti tarusthitāḥ | paiśācena vivāhena sudatyāṃ buddhavāhanaḥ ||47|| kanyādvayaṃ janayāmāseti te hi picāśike | brahmadhanā jantudhanā tābhyāṃ piśācakoṭayaḥ ||48|| rākṣasāścāpi cotpannāḥ koṭikoṭyarbudāśca te | yakṣamātā kratusthalī cāpsaro hi matā śubhā ||49|| yakṣo rajatanābhastu guhyakānāṃ pitāmahaḥ | catvāro viṃśatiścaiva puṇyāḥ puṇyajanā matāḥ ||1.212.50|| maṇibhadrātpuṇyajanyāmete puṇyajanāḥ smṛtāḥ | evaṃ maṇivarasyaite yakṣāśca guhyakāḥ sutāḥ ||51||| khaśāyāśca praputrāste rākṣasāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ | vikacāyāṃ ca rākṣasyāṃ nairṛtinā piśācakāḥ ||52||| pūtanāścotpāditāste bālanāśakarā matāḥ | krodhāyāṃ kanyakā jātā dvādaśa hyātmasaṃbhavāḥ ||53|| mṛgī ca mṛgamandā ca haribhadrā irāvatī | bhūtā kapiśā daṃṣṭrā ca niśā tiryā tathaiva ca ||54|| śvetā caiva svarā caiva surasā ceti viśrutāḥ | mṛgyāstu hariṇāḥ putrā mṛgāścānye śaśāstathā ||55|| nyaṃkavaḥ śarabhā ye ca ruravaḥ pṛṣatāśca ye | mṛgarājā mṛgamandā gavayāścāpare tathā ||56||| mahiṣoṣṭravarāhāśca khaṅgagauramukhāstathā | harestu harayaḥ putrā golāṃgulāstarakṣavaḥ |||57|| vānarāḥ kinnarāścaiva vyāghrāḥ kiṃpuruṣāstathā | irāvatyāḥ suto gaja airāvata iti smṛtāḥ ||58|| dvidantāśca caturdantā aṣṭadantāstathāpare | tatputrapautrādayo’pi gajā jātā anantaśaḥ ||59|| atha bhūtyāḥ sutā bhūtāḥ sarve te hyūrdhvaretasaḥ | bhavabhaktāśca te sarve bhāryāputravihīnakāḥ ||1.212.60|| kuṣmāṇḍī kapiśānputrān kapiśebhyaḥ piśācakān | suṣuve ṣoḍaśānyeṣāṃ yugmāni piśitāśinām ||61|| chagalaḥ chagalī caiva vakro vakramukhī tathā | sūciḥ sūcīmukhī caiva kuṃbhī ca kuṃbhapātrakaḥ |||62|| vajradaṃṣṭraśca dundubhiḥ upacāro’pacārikā | ulūkhalī ulūkhalo hyanakānarka ityapi ||63|| kukhaṇḍikā kukhaṇḍakaḥ pāṃśuḥ pāṃśumatī tathā | pāṇipātraḥ pāṇipātrī nipuṇā nipuṇastathā ||64|| nituṇḍaśca nituṇḍī ca praskandaḥ skandikā tathā | chalādoccheṣaṇā caiva gaṇāścānantavaṃśagāḥ ||65|| ajāmukhā bakamukhāḥ kuṣmāṇḍānāṃ gaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ | sarvāṃgakeśā vṛttākhyā daṃṣṭriṇo nakhinastathā ||66|| tiryaṃgāḥ puruṣādāśca piśācāste hyadhomukhāḥ | ṛṣāyāśca mīnā mātā vṛttā parivṛttā tathā ||67|| anuvṛttā duhitaraḥ tāsāṃ vai śṛṇuta prajāḥ | sahasradantā makarāḥ pāṭhināstimirohitāḥ ||68|| ete maino gaṇaḥ prokto grāhāśca śiśumārakāḥ | vṛttā kūrmavikārāṇi janayāmāsa śaṃkhalān ||69|| maṇḍukānāṃ vikārāṇi hyanuvṛttā hyajījanat | aiṇeyān śaṃbūkām̐ścaiva śuktīn varāṭakām̐stathā ||1.212.70 || tathā śaṃkhavikārāṇi parivṛttā vyajījanat | svedāyāḥ putrapautrādyāḥ koṭikoṭyaṃśavaṃśajāḥ ||71|| jalajā nṛkṣajāstiryagjātāścetanajāstathā | pṛthivījalajātāśca varṣāyogasamudbhavāḥ ||72|| tathā śuṣkavikārebhyo gomayādibhya eva ca | kardamādisamutpannāḥ sūryoṣmāsaṃbhavāstathā ||73|| kāśyapīyaṃ prajā yonijanyāścāyonijāstathā | saramāyāḥ prajā tūlātśvakaḥ kolaḥ śivā tathā ||74|| śyāmaśca śabalaścaiva hyarjuno haritastathā | kṛṣṇo dhūmrāruṇaścaiva tūlālābūśca kadrukāḥ ||75|| surasājījanatputraśatamekaṃ śiromṛtān | sarpān takṣakamūrdhanyān nāgān vāsukiśobhanān ||76 || tāmrāyāṃ pulahasutāt śyenī bhāsī śukī tathā | dhṛtarāṣṭrī tathā krauṃcī jajñire śyenirāruṇāt ||77|| sampātiṃ ca jaṭāyuṃ cājījanat pakṣisattamau | jaṭāyuṣastu putrādyāḥ kākagṛdhrāśca karṇinaḥ ||78|| śukī garutmataḥ putrān suṣuve garuḍān bahūn | caturdaśasahasrāṇi vistaraḥ pannagāśinām ||79|| bhāsīputrāḥ smṛtā bhāsā ulūkāḥ kākakukkuṭāḥ | mayūrāḥ kalaviṃkāśca kapotā lāvatittirāḥ ||1.212.80 || krauṃcī vārdhīṇasād śyenī kurarān sārasān bakān | dhṛtarāṣṭrī tu haṃsām̐śca kalahaṃsām̐ś bhāminī ||8 1|| cakravākāṃśca vihagān tayā dvijānantakān | ilāyāstisraḥ putryaśca latā vallī ca vīrudhā ||82|| latā vanaspatīn putrān hyapuṣpān pulinasthitān | evaṃ puṣpaphalavṛkṣām̐ścāpi hyudyānasaṃsthitān ||83 || atha vallī tu gulmāṃśca tvaksārām̐śca tṛṇādikān | virudhā virudhān putrān patrasārām̐śca mūlakān ||84|| etāsāṃ ca prajānāṃ vai deśakālavigauṇake | rūpakriyāvibhedaiśca vairūpyaṃ saṃprajāyate ||85|| kṣetrabhede tu bījasya rūpaṃ saṃkaratāṃ vrajet | bījabhede ca garbhasya rūpaṃ rūpāntaraṃ vrajet ||86|| latāvallīvirudhānāmanekayogasambhave | vividhāstā bhavantyeva nāntastāsāṃ hi vidyate ||87|| vṛkṣadrumatarūṇāṃ ca vibhinnayogasambhave | rūpāt rūpāntaraṃ tatra jāyate’nekajātikam ||88|| devarṣimānavānāṃ ca yakṣarākṣasaroṣiṇām | sāṃkarye ca prajāścānyā bhinnarūpā bhavanti hi ||89|| pārthivānāṃ jalīyānāṃ taijasā cāpi dehinām | yathāvikṛtirūpāṇi vibhidyante navāni vai ||1.212.90|| sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭyantare golāntare pralayajāntare | kati kidṛk kiṃ ca jātaṃ pāraye’haṃ na padmaje ||9 1|| saṃkṣepāt kāśyapī sṛṣṭirmayā proktā prasiddhigā | sṛṣṭervistārasattve’pi varṇane na prayojanam ||92|| kālo hyayaṃ niravadhiḥ sṛṣṭeścānto na vidyate | mukhyaṃ mukhyaṃ kathitaṃ te kimanyacchrotumicchasi ||93|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne diteraditeḥ kadravā vinatāyāḥ surabheḥ saramāyā danostimestāmrāyā muneḥ krodhāyā ilāyāḥ surasāyā ariṣṭāyāśca kāśyapīprajāyāścaturdaśabhuvanīyāyā nirdeśanāmā dvādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 212 ||
<1.213> śrīlakṣmīruvāca ṛṣivaṃśamaha śrotumicchāmi pāvanaṃ prabhau | saṃkṣepāt tata samākhyāhi śrutvā hṛt pāvanāyate || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca kaśyapo gotrakāmastu cacāra paramaṃ tapaḥ | gotrasūtrau sutau me ca bhavetāmityacintayat || 2 || asito’pi ca vatsāro vrahmarūpau babhūvatuḥ | vatsārasya nidhruvaśca raibhyaśceti sutāvubhau || 3 || raibhyāśca ṛṣayo raibhyāḥ saṃjātā bahukīrtayaḥ | nidhruvasya sumedhāśca jātāśca kuṇḍapāyinaḥ || 4 || asitasyaikaparṇāyāṃ brahmiṣṭhaḥ samajāyata | nidhruvāḥ śāṇḍilā raibhyāstrayaḥ ete tu kāśyapāḥ || 5 || devalasya varā prakhyā ṛṣayo hyabhavam̐stathā | mānasasya ca riṣyantastasya dama iti smṛtaḥ || 6 || damasya tṛṇabinduśca maharṣiḥ samajāyata | tṛṇabindusutā tviḍavilā pulastyasaṃpriyā || 7 || tasmācca viśravā jātastatpatnī devavarṇinī | bṛhaspaterbṛhatkīrtistasyaiṣā kanyakā matā || 8 || tasyāṃ vaiśravaṇaḥ kubero vai jātaḥ kurūpakaḥ | atrerdattaśca durvāsāścadraśceti trayaḥ sutāḥ || 9 || kaśyapānnāradaścaiva parvato’rundhatī tathā | arundhatyāṃ vaśiṣṭhasya śaktiḥ putro’bhavacchubhaḥ || 1.213.1 0|| pulastyasya rāvaṇaśca kuṃbhakarṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ | tadvaṃśā rākṣasā jātā brāhmaṇā api sākṣarāḥ || 11 || bhṛgoḥ khyātirajījanat dhātṛvidhātṛsaṃjñakau | ekāṃ kanyāṃ śrīṃ ca patnī jyeṣṭhā nārāyaṇasya sā || 1 2|| sādhvi nārāyaṇīyau ca balotsāhau sutau mama | dhāturbhāryā niyatiśca vidhātustvāyatirmatā || 1 2|| tayoḥ putrau kramāt pāṇḍurmṛkaṇḍuśca sanātanau | mṛkaṇḍośca manasvinyāṃ mārkaṇḍeyo vyajāyata || 14|| tasya vedaśirāḥ putro mūrdhanyāyāṃ vyajāyata | tasya vaṃśo’bhavat sarvo mārkaṇḍeya itiprathaḥ || 15|| pāṇḍoḥ puṇḍarikāyāṃ ca dyutimān sṛjamānakaḥ | tayoḥ putrāḥ prapautrāśca bhārgavāste prakīrtitāḥ || 16|| patnī marīceḥ saṃbhūtiḥ pūrṇamāsama vyajījanat | kuṣṭiṃ puṣṭiṃ tviṣāṃ cāpacitiṃ kanyācatuṣṭayam || 17|| pūrṇamāsaḥ sarasvatyāṃ virajaṃ parvasaṃ sutau | virajasya sudhāmābhūt tasya vairājanāmakaḥ || 18|| gaurīputraḥ sudharmā ca lokapālo’bhavat tadā | parvasaḥ parvasāyāṃ tu yajñavāmaṃ ca kāśyapam || 1 9|| āṃgirasaḥ smṛtirvyajījanat kanyācatuṣṭayam | sinīvālīṃ kuhūṃ rākāmanumatiṃ ca kanyakāḥ ||1.213.20 || bharatāgniṃ kīrtimantaṃ putrau dvau lokaviśrutau | agneḥ putrastu parjanyaḥ sahatyāṃ samajāyata ||1 1 || hiraṇyaromā parjanyāt mārīcyāṃ samabhūtsutaḥ | kṣamā tu suṣuve putrān pulahasya prajāpateḥ ||22|| kardamaścāmbarīṣaśca sahiṣṇuśceti te trayaḥ | ūrjāyāṃ tu vasiṣṭhasya vāsiṣṭhā bahavo’bhavan ||23|| vāśiṣṭheṣu kāśyapeṣu tathā bhagvaṃgiro’triṣu | pañcasveteṣu jāyante gotreṣu brahmavādinaḥ ||24|| kratoḥ putrā vālakhilyā bhṛgoḥ śukraḥ suto’bhavat | tvaṣṭā varūtrī śaṇḍaścāmarkaśceti kaveḥ sutāḥ ||25|| yajanyāṃ devayānī ca śukrasya duhitā bhavat|| triśirā viśvarūpastu tvaṣṭuḥ putro’bhavanmahān || 26|| yaśodharāyāmutpanno viśvakarmānujaḥ sutaḥ | pracetasaścyavano’bhūt cyāvaneyāstato matāḥ || 27|| bhārgavasya ātmavām̐śca dadhīcaścetyubhau sutau | ātmavataścorudeśādaurvaḥ prasamajāyata || 28 || ṛcīkasya jamadagniḥ satyavatyāṃ vyajāyata | jamadagneḥ parśurāmo reṇukāyāṃ vyajāyata || 29|| atharvaṇasya dāyādo bṛhaspatiśca dhiṣṇukaḥ | saṃvartaśca vicittiśca hyutathyo vāmadevakaḥ || 1.213.30 || utathyasya śaradvām̐śca hyete ātharvaṇā matāḥ | bṛhaspaterbharadvājo bhāradvājaśca tatsutaḥ || 31 || marīcestvariṣṭanemiḥ kaśyapaśceti vai sutau | somasya tu budhaḥ putro budhasya tu purūravā || 3 2|| tasya hyamāvasurattasya bhīmastasya ca kāṃcanaḥ | tasya suhotrastasya jahnuryajjānostu jāhnavī || 33 || jahnorbhāryā ca kāverī tasyāṃ jātaḥ suhotrakaḥ | tasyājakaśca tasyāpi balākāśca itīritaḥ || 34|| tasya kuśastasya sutaḥ kuśiko gādhināmakaḥ | tasya viśvāmitraḥ putro brahmarṣirabhavatpurā || 35|| viśvāmitrasya putrastu devarāta iti smṛtaḥ | kauśikā bahavo jātāḥ ṛṣayo vai tapodhanāḥ || 3 6|| viśvāmitraśca māndhātā saṃskṛtiśca kapistathā | kapestu purukutsaśca satyaścānṛhavānṛthuḥ || 37|| ārṣṭiṣeṇo’jamīḍhaśca bhāgānyo’nyastathaiva ca | kākṣīvaścaiva śijayastathānye ca mahārathāḥ || 38 || rathītaraśca rundhaśca viṣṇuvṛddhādayo nṛpāḥ | kṣatropetāḥ smṛtā hyete tapasā ṛṣitāṃ gatāḥ || 3 9|| pururavasastvāyustasya sutahotrasaṃjñakaḥ | tasya gṛtsamadastasya śunakastasya śaunakaḥ ||1.213.40 || suhotrasya śalastasya hyārṣṭiṣeṇastaponidhiḥ | suhotrasya sutaḥ kāśastasya dīrghatapāḥ sutaḥ || 41 || dīrghatapasaḥ suputro vidvān dhanvantariḥ prabhuḥ | dhanvantare ketumām̐śca divodāsaśca tatsutaḥ ||42|| tasya pratardanaḥ putrastasya gargaśca vatsakaḥ | vatsaputro hyalarkaśca sannatistasya cātmajaḥ ||43 || tasya vaṃśe ca gārgyo vatsasya vātsyo’bhavadṛṣiḥ | brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāścaite maharṣayo’bhavaṃstathā ||44|| marutto hyabhavadrājā maharṣiḥ sātvataḥ paraḥ | nahuṣasya yayātyādyā dhārmikā hyabhavan nṛpāḥ ||45|| ūśijo mamatāyāṃ ca dīrghatamā hyajāyata | baleḥ kṣetre sudeṣṇāyāṃ dīrghatamo’karotsutam ||46|| sa kakṣīvānabhavacca tatputrāstu sahasraśaḥ | ātreyo vaṃśajo medhātithiḥ kāṇṭhāyanā dvijāḥ ||47|| vṛhaspatermamatāyāṃ bharadvājo’bhavat sutaḥ | tasya vaṃśe’bhavat trayyāruṇirnāmarṣipuṃgavaḥ ||48|| bṛhatkṣatrasya putro’bhūt suhotrasaṃjñakaḥ ṛṣiḥ | tasya vaṃśe’bhavanmedhātithirnāma ṛṣirmahān ||49|| pauravaśca kauthumo’bhūt sāmavedasya śākhayā | rikṣasya mudgalaḥ putro maudgalyāstasya vaṃśajāḥ ||1.213.50|| ahalyāyāḥ śatānandastasya sutaśca suvrataḥ | cyavanasyoparicaravasustasya kuśāgrakaḥ ||5 1 || kuśāgrasya sutaḥ ṛṣabhākhyastasyārṣabharṣayaḥ | brahmakṣatrā ime proktāḥ ṛṣayo lokapāvanāḥ ||52|| bhavantyanye’pi pṛthivyāmṛṣayo vedabodhakāḥ | tāpasāścāpi jāyante tairvai saṃrakṣitaṃ jagat ||53 || karmakāṇḍaparāḥ kecit kecidbrahmaparāstathā | kecidyogaparāścānye tapomātraparāstathā ||54|| siddhiparāstathā cānye hyupāsanāditatparāḥ | bhavantyeva paraśreyaḥ pradāste puṇyaśālinaḥ ||55|| mukhyā hyete maharṣayo madaṃśasaṃbhavāḥ khalu | kathitāste mahālakṣmi kimanyacchrotumicchasi ||56|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmakṣatrarṣāṇāṃ vaṃśādipradarśananāmā trayodaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||213||
<1.214> śrīlakṣmīruvāca kalpānmanūm̐śca saṃkṣepācchrotumicchāmi mādhava | dvāparānte kalerdharmān śrotumicchāmi tadvad || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi caturdaśamanūnpratyahajām̐stathā | daśaśatāni jāyante kalpā varṣe tu vedhasaḥ || 2 || daśaśatāni ca yugacatuṣṭayāni kalpake | eṣa kalpastu vijñeyaḥ sarvakalpeṣu sadṛśaḥ || 3 || vārāhaḥ prathamaḥ kalpo lokādau prathitaḥ khalu | dvitīyastu bhuvaḥ kalpastṛtīyastapa ucyate || 4 || bhavaścaturtho vijñeyaḥ paṃcamo raṃbha ucyate | ṛtukalpastathā ṣaṣṭhaḥ saptamastu kratuḥ smṛtaḥ || 5 || aṣṭamastvabhavad vahnirnavamo havyavāhanaḥ | sāvitro daśamaḥ kalpo bhāvastvekādaśaḥ smṛtaḥ || 6 || uśiko dvādaśastatra kuśikastu trayodaśa | caturdaśastu gandharvo gāndhāro yatra vai svaraḥ || 7 || ṛṣabhastu tataḥ kalpo jñeyaḥ pañcadaśaḥ priye | ṣaḍjastu ṣoḍaśaḥ kalpaḥ ṣaḍjanā yatra carṣayaḥ || 8 || śiśiraśca vasantaśca nidāgho varṣa ityapi | śaraddhemanta ityete mānasā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ || 9 || tataḥ saptadaśaḥ kalpo mārjālīya iti smṛtaḥ | tatastu madhyamo nāma kalpo’ṣṭādaśa ucyate || 1.214.1 0|| tatastvekonaviṃśastu kalpo vairāgyasaṃjñakaḥ | vairājo yatra samabhūt manurvai brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ || 11 || tato viṃśatikaḥ kalpo niṣādaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | ekaviṃśatikaḥ kalpo vijñeyaḥ pañcamaḥ priye || 12|| brahmaṇo mānasāḥ putrāḥ pañcaprāṇāḥ svaro’bhavat | dvāviṃśastu tathā kalpo vijñeyo meghavāhanaḥ || 1 3||| trayoviṃśatikaḥ kalpo vijñeyaścintakastathā | caturviṃśatikaścāpi hyākutiḥ kalpa ucyate || 14|| paṃcaviṃśatikaḥ kalpo vijñātiḥ parikīrtitaḥ | ṣaḍviṃśastu tataḥ kalpo mana ityabhidhīyate ||15|| saptaviṃśatikaḥ kalpo bhāvo vai kalpasaṃjñitaḥ | aṣṭāviṃśatikaḥ kalpo bṛhadityabhisaṃjñitaḥ || 16 || ekonatriṃśakaḥ kalpo vijñeyaḥ śvetalohitaḥ | tatastriṃśattamaḥ kalpo rakto nāma prakīrtitaḥ || 17|| ekatriṃśattamaḥ kalpaḥ pītavāsā iti smṛtaḥ | dvātriṃśattamakalpastu sitakalpo hi nāmataḥ || 18|| trayastriṃśattamaḥ kalpaḥ kṛṣṇakalpo hi nāmataḥ | catustriṃśattamaḥ kalpo viśvarūpastu nāmataḥ || 1 9|| evamete bhavanānāmṛtūnāṃ nāmatastathā | kratūnāṃ nāmataścaiva vahnīnāṃ nāmatastathā ||1.214.20|| svarāṇāṃ nāmataścaiva prāṇānāṃ nāmatastathā | ākūtīnāṃ tathā śaṃbhorviṣṇośca nāmatastathā ||2 1|| kalpā hyete catustriṃśatproktāstadyogataśca te| saptarṣīṇāṃ nāmataśca saptakalpāstathā pare ||22|| aṣṭavasvabhidhānāśca hyaṣṭau kalpāstathā pare | navagrahasamāyogānnavakalpāstathetare || 23 || aṣṭānāṃ dikprapālānāṃ kalpā hyaṣṭau tathāpare | brahmaṇaśca svīyakalpaścaikaḥ kalpastathā mataḥ || 24|| triguṇānāṃ ca devānāṃ trayaḥ kalpāstathāpare | ekādaśānāṃ rudrāṇāmekādaśa ca kalpakāḥ || 25 || caturdaśamanūnāṃ ca nāmnā kalpāścaturdaśa | caturdaśamahendrāṇāṃ tathā kalpāścaturdaśa || 26 || saptaviṃśatinakṣatranāmnā tāvanta eva te | ekonapañcāśanmarunnāmnā tāvanta eva te || 27|| caturviṃśatyavatāranāmnā kalpāstathāpare | ekonapaṃcāśadvahnikalpāstāvanta eva te || 28 || catūrṇāṃ dharmapādānāṃ nāmnā catvāra eva te | vidyānāṃ ca trayīnāṃ ca nāmnā kalpāstrayastathā || 29 || ityevaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃraṃbhe yadyadyogo bhavetpurā | brahmaṇaḥ smṛtimārge ca yasya yogo bhavetpurā || 1.214.30 || tattannāmnā ca kalpāste divasā brahmaṇo matāḥ | sahasraṃ saṃbhavatyeva kalpā hi brahmavatsare || 31 || ta ete brahmaṇaḥ sarve punarvarṣāntare tathā | evaṃ viparivartante śatavarṣīyajīvane || 32|| kalpāstu vedhasaścātra sṛṣṭau pravāhalīlayā | ete hyeva prajāyante nāstīti niyamo’pi vai || 33 || anye’pi nāminaḥ kalpā lakṣmīkalpā bhavantyapi | ramākalpāstathā padmākalpāḥ śrīkalpakāstathā || 34|| śivākalpā yoginīnāṃ kalpāḥ satīprakalpakāḥ | śacikalpāstathā kālīkalpāḥ śaktidināni ca || 35 || vidyākalpāstathā cānye tvādyavyaktidināni ca | bhavantīśvarakalpāśca devakalpāstathāpare || 36|| devīkalpā apsarāṇāṃ kalpā bhaktadināni ca | tattvakalpāstathā cādyakāryakalpā bhavantyapi || 37 || yannavaṃ vedhasaḥ prātardṛśyate mukhyamuttam | tannāmnā te tu kalpā vai brahmaṇā hi pradhāritāḥ || 38 || indrāśca manavaḥ kalpe caturdaśa caturdaśa | eko manurdīrghakālaṃ bhuṃkte hyekaṃ tu saptatim || 39 || catuṣkīnāṃ catuṣkī tu caturyugaṃ samīritam | dvādaśābdasahasrāṇi caturyugaṃ viduḥ surāḥ ||1.214.40 || catuṣkīṇāṃ sahasraṃ tu kalpe gacchati vedhasaḥ | catuṣkīṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca rātrau gacchati vedhasaḥ ||4 1 || dve sahasre catuṣkīṇāṃ brahmaṇastaddivāniśam | etatkrameṇa vedhāstu śatavarṣāṇi jīvati | 42|| vairājasyaikadivasastadā vai parikalpitaḥ | hyetatkrameṇa vairājaḥ śatavarṣāṇi jīvati ||43|| mahāviṣṇorekadinaṃ tadā vai parikalpitam | etatkramānmahāviṣṇuḥ śatavarṣāṇi jīvati || 44|| pradhānapuruṣasyaikadinaṃ tatparikalpitam | etatkramāt pradhānanā śatavarṣāṇi jīvati ||45|| prakṛtipuruṣasyaikadinaṃ tatparikalpitam | puṃprakṛtestasya sṛṣṭiḥ śatavarṣaṃ pravartate ||46|| tato mahāpralayo vātyantikalaya āpyate | tato brahmamuktiloko vartate sapareśvaraḥ ||47|| tāvati samaye yāte īkṣate sa punastathā | bahu syāmiti sṛṣṭyarthaṃ prakṛtipūruṣakramāt || 48|| kalpe kalpe manūnāṃ ca tathaivāsti prabhāvanam | brahmāṇḍānāṃ bhuvanānāṃ tathaivāstyutsubhāvanam ||49|| caturdaśamanūn nāmnā kathayāmi śṛṇu priye | kratusaṃjñe’tra vārāhe kalpe ca prathamo manuḥ ||1.214.5 0 || svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ prokto brahmaṇaḥ putra eva saḥ | svārociṣo dvitīyo vai manuragneḥ suto’bhavat ||51 || auttamaśca tṛtīyo vai priyavratasuto manuḥ | tāmasaśca caturtha uttamabhrātā ca vai manuḥ || 52|| raivataḥ pañcamaḥ prokto manustāmasasodaraḥ | ṣaṣṭhaśca cakṣuṣaḥ putraḥ cākṣuṣo nāma vai manuḥ ||53 || svārociṣottamau caiva tāmaso raivatastathā | priyavratānvayā hyete catvāro manavo matāḥ ||54|| uttānapādasya vaṃśe cākṣuṣo manurucyate | kaśyapasyāditeḥ putrā dvādaśādityasaṃjñakāḥ ||55|| tatra vivasvataḥ putraḥ śrāddhadeva iti śrutaḥ | vaivasvato manuḥ so’yaṃ saptamo manurucyate ||56|| chāyāyāṃ sūryaputraśca sāvarṇiścāṣṭamo manuḥ | navamo dakṣasāvarṇirmanurvaruṇasaṃbhavaḥ ||57|| daśamo brahmasāvarṇirupaślokasuto manuḥ | manurvai dharmasāvarṇirekādaśaḥ samucyate ||58|| bhavitā rudrasāvarṇirnāmnā dvādaśako manuḥ | manustrayodaśo devasāvarṇiḥ sunṛtāsutaḥ |||59|| satyasahaso dāyādo vedasāvarṇireva saḥ | manuśca hīndrasāvarṇiścaturdaśaḥ sa ucyate ||1.214.6 0|| priye caturdaśaitāni kalpe kalpe bhavanti vai | proktairebhirmitaḥ kalpo yugasāhasraparyayaḥ ||6 1 || akalpaśca niśā tasya yugasāhasraparyayā | yugacatuṣṭaye yugaśabdo’tra bodhya eva vai ||62|| evaṃ kalpāntaro cānye manavaśca caturdaśa | indrāstathā bhavantyeva hyanye’nye vai caturdaśa ||63 || ṛṣayaśca bhavantyanye sapta sapta tathāvidhāḥ | dikpālā lokapālāśca bhavantyanye tathākriyāḥ || 64|| vedavyāsāḥ praticaturyugaṃ bhavanti cāpare | avatārā hareḥ praticatuṣkī caturviṃśatiḥ || 65 || aṃśāveśakalāṃśāṃśāstvanantāḥ pratisādhikām | bhavantyevāvatārāśca lokakalyāṇahetave ||66|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bahūnāṃ kalpānāṃ caturdaśamanūnāṃ ca nirdeśanāmā caturdaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 214 ||
<1.215> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi dvāparāntān kalerdharmāṃśca sarvaśaḥ | prathame dvāpare prāpte sṛṣṭistu yugalodbhavā || 1 || mithunadharmajanyā sā naranārīprasaṃgajā | prāvartata yadā tatra kāmajanyāśca durguṇāḥ || 2 || gopyakarma cauryakarma roṣakarma nijārthatā | hiṃsānṛtaṃ tathā steyaṃ vīryanāśaḥ parigrahaḥ || 3 || aśuddhistṛṣṇikā bhogo vyavasāyo’tilubdhatā | dehadaihikacidacidahantāmamatādayaḥ || 4 || pravartante prativyaktiṃ svārthapravāhavardhitāḥ | apuṇyā alpapuṇyāśca jāyante dehinastataḥ || 5 || mana kāluṣyamāpnoti buddhirviparitāyate | asatsaṃkalpā jāyante pravartante’pyasatpathe || 6 || dyūtaṃ pānaṃ striyaḥ sūnā adharmādhisthalāni vai | suvarṇamanṛtaṃ kāmo mado vairaṃ rajastathā || 7 || kleśasthānāni pañcaiva kalervāsakṛtāni hi | mlecchaprāyā janāḥ sarve’dharmānṛtaparāstathā || 8 || strībālagodvijaghnāśca paradāradhanādarāḥ | uditāstamitaprāyā phalgudāstīvramanyavaḥ || 9 || asaṃskṛtāḥ kriyāhīnā alpasattvālpakāyuṣaḥ | rajasā tamasā vyāptā mlecchaprāyā dhanādhipāḥ || 1.215.10 || tannāthāśca janapadāstacchīlācāratatparāḥ | dharmaḥ satyaṃ dayā kṣāntiḥ śaucamāyuḥ smṛtirbalam || 11 || prakṣayaṃ yāntyanudinaṃ kaleḥ prābalyasaṃkrame | sarvaprakārake śraiṣṭhye vittamevodayapradam || 1 2|| dharmanyāyavyavasthāyāṃ vittaṃ heturbalaṃ bhavet | dāmpatye’bhirucirvittaṃ viṣayo vāpi kāraṇam || 13 || vipratve sūtrakaṃ liṃgaṃ luṃcāyāṃ vijayo mataḥ | pāṇḍitye tu vitaṇḍā syāt dāridryaṃ tyāgayogini || 14|| daṃbhī sādhurmahān bhāvyo vivāhe svīkṛtirdvayoḥ | bahiścamatkṛtiḥ snānaṃ mṛṣātejaḥ prasādhanam || 15|| dūre vāri bhavettīrthaṃ keśaveṣo vibhūṣaṇam | udaraṃbharatā puṇyaṃ cāpradhṛṣyaṃ tu satyatā || 16 || svakāryasādhanaṃ dākṣyaṃ yaśo’rthaṃ dānasevanam | dviśataṃ ca śataṃ caiva pañcāśat paṃcaviṃśatiḥ || 1 7|| pañcadaśāntaṃ sattveṣu kṣīṇeṣvāyustadāntimam | cauryānṛtavṛthāhiṃsāvyavāyādiprasevinaḥ || 18|| yuvatyaścāvivāhitāḥ svalpavastrāḥ kalau yuge | sarvasparśā narā nāryaḥ sarvasvāpakarāstathā || 1 9|| mlecchāprāyāḥ sarvavarṇāśchāgaprāyāśca dhenavaḥ | dārāmayā āśramāśca dhanaprāyāśca bāndhavāḥ || 1.215.2 0 || tṛṇaprāyā oṣadhayaḥ prāṃśulabhyā mahīruhāḥ | kṣaṇavṛṣṭikarā meghā vastuhīnagṛhāṇi ca || 21 || kṛte satyaṃ dayā dānaṃ tapo nāsti kalau tu tat | santuṣṭāḥ karuṇā maitrāḥ śāntā dāntāstitikṣavaḥ || 22 || ātmārāmāḥ samadṛśaḥ sarve’pi tu kṛte janāḥ | tretāyāṃ dharmapādāṃśāḥ pādonāste hrasanti vai || 23 || viśantyadharmapādāścānṛtaṃ hiṃsā ca tṛṣṇikā | vigrahaśca janāstatra pravartante svabhāvataḥ || 24|| kintu janāstaponiṣṭhā nātihiṃsrā na lampaṭāḥ | dharmārthakāmanāprāyā bhavanti tritasaṃyuge || 25|| varṇā brahmottarāścāpi jāyante vṛttidūṣitāḥ | tapaḥsatyadayādāneṣvardhaṃ hrasati dvāpare || 26|| hiṃsātṛṣṇānṛtadveṣairnindāmātsaryabhartsanaiḥ | kalau vṛṣāśasturyo’pi naśyatyadharmadurguṇaiḥ || 27|| nirdayā vairiṇo lubdhāḥ satṛṣṇāḥ sarvabhakṣiṇaḥ | durācārā sarvapeyabhogyavyasanasūtsukāḥ || 28 || bhavantyeva prajāḥ sarvā jaihvaśaiśnaprayojanāḥ | kāpaṭyaṃ cānṛtaṃ nidrālasyaṃ dveṣo viṣādanam ||29 || śoko moho bhayaṃ dainyaṃ pratyahaṃ tu kalau jane | dravyahīnā vyayadhauryā madyapānāḥ kudṛṣṭayaḥ ||1.215.3 0 || narā nāryaḥ svārthaparāḥ kāmamūlāśca sarvaśaḥ | deśā dasyumayā vedā devāḥ pākhaṇḍanāśitāḥ ||3 1 || prajābhakṣāśca rājāno janāḥ śiśnodaratṛpāḥ | vratahīnāśca kāṣāyāḥ sadārā bhikṣukāstadā ||32|| tapa kāpaṭyalābhārthaṃ nyāsopyarthapralabdhaye | vāmanāścātibhojyāśca bahvapatyā bahustriyaḥ || 33|| striyo’pi gālikāmiṣṭabhāṣiṇyo nagnavastrikāḥ | kūṭakāryapaṇāḥ kṣudryo’satpathapremapāṃsulāḥ ||34|| patiṃ tyajanti nirdravyaṃ hitvā kuṭumbamityapi | pitṛbhrātṛsuhṛdaśca tyaktvā prayānti kāmukam ||35|| sarve dānaṃ pragṛhṇanti sarve vai yājakāstathā | sarve mantrādhikārāśca mlecchā brāhmābhimāninaḥ ||36|| upadiśanti ca śaṭhāḥ śiṣyān śāṭyasamanvitān | śaṭhaṃ guruṃ śrayantyeva śaṭhāḥ śiṣyāḥ svabhāvavat ||37|| adharmiṇo dharmavāco bhavanti ca vidharmiṣu | svadharmiṣu sadā dveṣanindāmātsaryakāriṇaḥ || 38|| annadhanāmbarahīnā gṛhahīnā hyabhojanāḥ | mriyante tu vinā mṛtyuṃ prāpte ghore kalau yuge ||39|| anāvṛṣṭiratiśatruratirogāturā janāḥ | svalpasvārthasya siddhyarthaṃ ghātino vai kalau yuge ||1.215.40 || na vṛddhau pitarau putrā rakṣayanti kalau khalāḥ | na patnīṃ vā satīṃ bhāryāṃ rakṣayanti khalā varāḥ ||41 || yatheṣṭaṃ viṣayānandāṃ rakṣayanti striyaṃ kalau | dhanadaṃ ratidātāraṃ tvāśrayanti striyo janam ||42|| kapardikākṛte kleśaṃ prakurvanti biḍālavat | prāṇāścaivāpyanṛtārthe tyajantyapi kalau janāḥ ||43 || saṃpraghnanti svakām̐ścāpi svalpārthe svārthaghātinaḥ | ācāryā guravaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ pākhaṇḍavyāptacetasaḥ ||44|| na sukhaṃ nāpi nirvāṇaṃ na śāntiṃ yānti vai kalau | kālagrastāḥ prajāḥ śīghraṃ sadodvegā vināśagāḥ ||45|| alpaprasādā anṛtā mahākrodhā adhārmikāḥ | prajāyante mānavā vai yavanaiḥ parimiśritāḥ ||46|| strīṇāṃ bālavadhenaiva hatvā caiva parasparam | yugadoṣadurācārā bhuñjate mānavāḥ kalau ||47|| uditodita vaṃśāśca hyuditāstamitāstathā | cāṇḍālabhojyāḥ sarve vai nṛpā viprāḥ śvapākavat ||48 || dharmakāmārthahīnāśca mlecchācārāśca sarvaśaḥ | tadā vināśamāpannāḥ prajā nāstikatānvitāḥ ||49|| tadālpanaravarge ca bahustrīke kalau yuge | lavāllavaṃ bhraśyamānā āyūrūpabalaśrutaiḥ ||1.215.5 0 || mlecchaiścopahatā mlecchāḥ prayānti vai kṣayaṃ muhuḥ | hatasvā vyādhibhūyāṃso’nāvṛṣṭyādivināśitāḥ ||5 1 || anāthā vṛttihīnāśca bhaviṣyanti vanaukasaḥ | puragrāmādināśaśca bhraṣṭasnehāstathā mithaḥ |||52|| sāṃkaryamāśritāḥ kubjāḥ saritparvatasaṃśrayāḥ | dhīvarā iva jāyante’raṇyagā matsyabhojinaḥ ||53 || mṛgairmīnairvihaṃgaiśca śvāpadaistarkṣubhistadā | madhuśākaphalairmūlairvartayanti ca jantubhiḥ ||54|| cīraṃ parṇaṃ ca vividhaṃ valkalānyajināni ca | dhārayanti ca kaupīnaṃ pāśavaṃ jīvanaṃ śritāḥ ||55|| ajaiḍakaṃ kharoṣṭraṃ ca pālayanti nadīśritāḥ | bahvapatyā annahīnāḥ śaucācāravivarjitāḥ ||56|| hīnāddhīnān tadādharmān svīkurvanti paśuśritān | viprāḥ śūdrātmakā mantrābhicārādividhāyinaḥ ||57|| nārīsanmantriṇī gehe śyālakāśca pradhānakāḥ | dāmpatyaṃ vikrayādhīnaṃ nirmanastvaṃ viyogagam ||58|| tīrthāni yavanārtāni devāścāṇḍāladharṣitāḥ | mlecchairnaṣṭānyāyatānyekākāraṃ kalau yuge ||59 || na yogī naiva siddho na jñānī vā brahmabhāvanaḥ | śāṃḍhyena śūnyaḥ kaścinna paśya lakṣmi kalerbalam ||1.215.60|| annahīnā janapadāḥ kathāvikrayiṇo dvijāḥ | rāmā rativikrayiṇyo bhavantyeva kalau sadā ||6 1 || sarve tvaghāsurāyante sārahīnāḥ śaṭhāḥ khalāḥ | padārthāstuṣamātrā vai kaṇaśūnyā niraṃkurāḥ ||62|| śrūyate ca kathā sarvaiḥ pālyate nahi kenacit | kalau śrāvaṇakalyāṇe kathāsāro gato bhavet ||63|| snānti tīrthe nivasanti pālayanti vratāni na | kalau tairthikakalyāṇe kathāsāro gato bhavet ||64|| kāmakrodhabhayalobhatṛṣṇāvyākulacetasām | kalau tāpasakalyāṇe tapaḥsāro gato bhavet ||65|| manasaścājayāllobhāddaṃbhātpākhaṇḍasaṃśrayāt | kalau dhyānajakalyāṇe dhyānasāro gato bhavet ||66|| vastusāro layamevaṃ prayātyeva sthale sthale | yugabalāddhi tatsarvaṃ nāsti kasyāpi dūṣaṇam ||67|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kaliyugasvabhāvaguṇadoṣapravartanadarśananāmā pañcadaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 215 ||
<1.216> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca kaleḥ pañcasahasre ca gate varṣe bhuvaḥ sthalāt | gagādyāstīrthamūrdhanyāḥ prayānti śrīhareḥ padam || 1 || śālagrāmo harermūrtirjagannāthaśca devatāḥ | tataḥ svalpe gate kāle prayāsyanti hareḥ pakṣa || 2 || dīkṣāśca devamantrāśca vidhayaḥ śrāddhatarpaṇam | sāttvikāni ca karmāṇi prayāsyanti hareḥ padam || 3 || hareḥ pūjā harasyāpi tannāmaguṇakīrtanam | tattvajñānāni sarvāṇi prayāsyanti hareḥ padam | 4 || vrataṃ tapasyānaśanaṃ svāgataṃ grāmadevatāḥ | sūtakādyabhimantāro na bhavanti yuge kalau || 5 || krūrāhaṃkārasyuktā ghātakā vai mahājanāḥ | puṃsāṃ bhedo mitho naiva strīṇāṃ naiva ca vai kalau || 6 || sarvapṛthvyāṃ strīvaśāśca puṃścalyaśca gṛhe vane | tarjanairbhartsanauḥ śaśvat hanti jāraṃ tathā patim || 7 || gṛheśvarī ca gṛhiṇī gṛhī bhṛtyādhiko’dhamaḥ | ceṭibhṛtyāsamā vadhvo bhavantyeva kalau yuge || 8 || kartāro balino gehe yonisambandhibāndhavāḥ śvaśrūśca śvaśuraścaiva gṛhe mukhyāḥ kalau yuge || 9 || vidyāsambandhibhiḥ sārdh saṃbhāṣāpi na vidyate | svakīyā bāndhavādyāstu yathā paricitāḥ pare || 1.216.1 0|| mlecchavidyāṃ prapaṭhanti dehadaihikavādinaḥ | uttamāḥ sārahīnāśca śūdrāṇāṃ sevakāḥ kalau || 11 || brahmasūtravihīnāśca trāṇaśūnyāḥ kṛṣikṛtaḥ | dharmahīnā dvijā mlecchakarmakarāḥ kalau yuge || 1 2|| phalahīnāśca taravo’patyahīnāśca yoṣitaḥ | dugdhahīnāstathā gāvaḥ kṣīraṃ ghṛtavivarjitam || 13|| dampatī premaśūnyau ca sthāninaḥ sukhavarjitāḥ | bhūpāḥ sattāvihīnāśca prajāśca karakarṣitāḥ || 14|| jalahīnā nadā nadyo vāpyaḥ kūpāḥ sarāṃsi ca | lakṣeṣu puṇyavān kaścin miledvā na miledapi|| 19|| kutsitā vikṛtākārā narā nāryaśca bālakāḥ | kuvārtāḥ kutsitapathāḥ prajāyante kalau yuge || 16|| na nagarāṇi na vai grāmā vṛkṣagartanivāsinaḥ | śaśavat parṇabhojyāśca bhavantyeva kalau ciram || 17|| araṇyāni prajāyante grāmanagarabhūmiṣu | sarittaḍāgasasyāni kṣetrāraṇyāni vai kalau || 18|| dhanaṃ na dṛśyate kvāpi pāśavīṃ vṛttimāśrite | dhūrte satyasya viśvāsaḥ pāpe puṇyasya mānyatā || 19|| aśiṣṭā ye te tu śiṣṭā lampaṭāste jitendriyāḥ | puṃścalyastāḥ satīpūjyā gaṇyante vai kalau yuge || 1.216 .20|| jārā brahmavratāstatra sarvastrīkāśca naiṣṭhikāḥ | tāpasā ye guptapāpā nindakāḥ satyamāninaḥ || 2 1|| ghātakā ye kāruṇikāścaurā ye sādhubhūṣagāḥ | bhikṣukā ye vaṃcakāste jāyante vai kalau yuge ||22|| nīcasevā mahatsevā dveṣākhyānaiśca raṃjakāḥ | hāsyapradā jaḍā vyādhāḥ pūjyāste vai kalau yuge ||23|| bālye vyādhijarāyuktāḥ palitāḥ svalpakālajāḥ | mahāvṛddhāḥ pañcadaśavarṣeṣveva kalau yuge |||24|| pañcavarṣā tu yuvatī rajoyuktā sutānvitā | ṣaḍmāsānte prasūtā strī dvādaśe vṛddhatānvitā |||5|| prāyaśo bahuśo vandhyā hatagarbhāḥ durodarāḥ | kanyāvikrayiṇaḥ putravikrayiṇaśca sarvaśaḥ ||26|| mātṛjāyāvadhūnāṃ ca jāropārjanatatparāḥ | kanyānāṃ bhaginīnāṃ ca jāropārjanajīvinaḥ ||re7|| harernāmnāṃ vikrayiṇaḥ kīrtyarthaṃ dānakāriṇaḥ | devavṛtterbrahmavṛttergurorvṛtteśca hārakāḥ ||28|| snuṣāśvaśrūkanyakāsapatnībhaginībhoginaḥ | bhrātṛjāyābhoginaścāgamyāgamanakāriṇaḥ ||29|| janmayoniṃ parityajya viharanti kalau narāḥ | patnīnāṃ niścayo nāsti bhartṝṇāṃ ca kalau yuge ||1.216.30|| prajānāṃ caiva vastūnāṃ grāmāṇāṃ vādhikāriṇaḥ | alīkavādinaḥ sarve caurā yānti balaṃ kalau || 31 || narāṇāṃ mārakā sarve’balānāṃ mārakāstathā | gurūṇāṃ mārakā dharmamārakā vai kalau janāḥ || 32|| lākṣāloharasānāṃ ca vyāpāraṃ lavaṇasya ca | putrāṇāṃ cātha patnīnāṃ prakurvanti kalau yuge || 33|| puṃścalī vārdhuṣāvīrā kuṭṭinī ca rajasvalā | raṇḍāśca randhanāgāre prabhavanti hi yācikāḥ || 34|| annānāṃ nirṇayo nāsti yonināṃ nāpi nirṇayaḥ | liṃgānāṃ nirṇayo nāsti bālānāṃ sutarāṃ nahi ||35|| bhūruhā hastamānāśca vitastimānamānavāḥ | ardhavitastipaśavo bhavantyante kalestadā || 36|| sādhūnāṃ ca gurūṇāṃ ca vadhaścaiva tapasvinām | anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ śaśvaddeśānāṃ viplavastathā |||37|| viṣoṣmamaraṇāścāpi vahnigolakanāśinaḥ | narā nāryaḥ
