samastāśca yugapannāśinaḥ kalau ||38|| duriṣṭairduradhītaiśca duṣkṛtaiśca durāgamaiḥ | viprāṇāṃ karmadoṣaiśca prajānāṃ patanaṃ kalau || 39|| hiṃsā māyā tatherṣyā ca krodho’sūyākṣamā nṛṣu | tiṣye bhavanti lokanāmugrā rāmaśca lubdhatā ||1.216.40|| saṃkṣobhāḥ kalayaḥ kleśāḥ kalau tatra jane jane | sarveṣāmantyayoneśca sambandhāḥ suptibhojanaiḥ ||4 1 || āyurmedhā balaṃ rūpaṃ kulaṃ caiva praṇaśyati | ḍākinyaścāpi māriṇyo māntrikyaḥ pramadāḥ kalau ||42|| śvāpadānāṃ prabalatvaṃ gavāṃ tatra hyupakṣayaḥ | sampradāyavināśaśca kalau ghore pravartite ||43|| citravarṣī tadā devaścitrāpatyā janā api | kūṭamānāḥ paṇyajanā kuśīlā vyādharūpiṇaḥ ||44|| bahuyācanako lokaḥ pratyupakāravarjitaḥ | naṣṭacittāḥ sāhasāśca muktakeśastrīveṣiṇaḥ ||45|| sasyacaurā vastracaurāścaurāṇāṃ caurakā api | hartṝṇāṃ cāpi hartāro bhavantyeva kalau yuge ||46|| kīṭamūṣakasarpāśca dharṣayanti tu mānavān | strībālagovadhaṃ kṛtvā hatvānyadvā parasparam ||47|| apahatya kulaṃ naijaṃ mārgayanti sukhaṃ kalau | duḥkhādromādadharmāccānītervai tāmasāḥ kalau ||48|| tretāyāmābdhiko dharmo dvāpare māsikaḥ sa vai | nāstikānāmaśaktānāṃ kalau divasamātrakaḥ ||49|| dīkṣālopo brahmalopaḥ saṃskārayajñalopanam | rājasvalyasūtakāspṛśyatālopaḥ kalau sadā ||1.216.50|| pakvāpakvādiśuddhiśca mukhagaṇḍuṣaśodhanam | śavaśmaśānaśaucādi vinaśyanti kalau yuge |||51|| mandirāṇi pratimāśca pūjyatā mahatāṃ tadā | paropakārasatrāṇi vinaśyanti kalau yuge ||52|| sadhavāvidhavābhedā gṛhyagṛhivibhāgagāḥ | mānyamaryāditabhedā vinaśyanti kalau yuge ||53|| daṇḍyādaṇḍyavivekāśca pālyāpālyapraṇālikāḥ | sevyāsevyavivekāśca vinaṃkṣyanti kalau yuge ||54|| nāryo gāvaśca kanyāśca yugandharāḥ kalau tadā | nyāyālaye’pi nāryaśca śvapacāśca nṛpāsanāḥ || 55|| sarvaṃ śvapacasāmrājyaṃ jāyante vai kalau tadā | luṃcārājyaṃ yaunarājyaṃ svārtharājyaṃ kalau sadā ||56|| balirājyaṃ śaṭharājyaṃ nagnarājyaṃ kalau bhavet | dṛṣṭa satyaṃ tadanyaccāpramāṇaṃ vai kalau matam ||57|| dravyasāmyaṃ saudhasāmyaṃ dāyasāmyaṃ kalau drutam | janasāmyaṃ kriyāsāmyaṃ nagnasāmyaṃ kalau yuge ||58|| nārīsāmyaṃ narasāmyaṃ vṛddhasāmyaṃ ca guhyake | karmasāmyaṃ varmasāmyaṃ duḥkhasāmyaṃ kalau yuge ||59|| mukhasāmyaṃ keśasāmyaṃ stanasāmyaṃ ca mastake | nagnasāmyaṃ sakthisāmyaṃ garbhasāmyaṃ kalau tadā ||1.216.60 || tailaghṛtasnehasarpirvārisāmyaṃ ca raṃkatā | dugdhadadhihaiyaṃgavīnādisāmyaṃ tadā kalau ||6 1|| ikṣukandaphalamūlasitāgūḍādiśarkarāḥ | miṣṭakṣārakaṭutiktarasāstulyāḥ kalau yuge ||62|| vāṇīsāmyaṃ kriyāsāmyaṃ rūpasāmyaṃ ca veṣatā | devamānavayakṣārtināgasāmyaṃ kalau samā ||63|| utsavaśokaśṛṃgārayānāsanasamānatā | bālayuvasthavīrādimanaḥsāmyaṃ kalau tadā ||64|| svaparānyasuhṛcchatrusvārthahānisamānatā | hrāsasāmyaṃ vyayasāmyaṃ kṣudhāsāmyaṃ kalau yuge ||65|| ṛtusāmyaṃ varṣasāmyaṃ niśādivasusāmyatā | nidrājāgradavasthānāṃ suptisāmyaṃ kalau tadā ||66|| mañcakhaṭvābṛsīkusūlodakumbhīsamānatā | durgaprākāragopurāṃganasāmyaṃ mataṃ tadā ||67|| vanodyānāraṇyaṇyakheṭagrāmavāsasamānatā | manuṣyapaśupakṣyādeḥ kīṭasāmyaṃ kalau yuge ||68|| ājñopadeśavidhyāderjalpavitaṇḍikāḥ samāḥ | saddhetūnāṃ niyamānāmasiddhisāmyatā kalau ||69|| sarasvatyāśca lakṣmyāśca vidhavāsāmyatā kalau | viduṣāṃ svātmavṛttīnāṃ klībasāmyaṃ kalau yuge ||1.216.70 || vṛṣṭīnāṃ vyomasāmyaṃ ca kṛṣīṇāṃ kālasāmyatā | bhuvaḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhasāmyaṃ bhavatyeva hi tiṣyake ||71 || mukhānāṃ grahaṇaiḥ sāmyaṃ hṛdāṃ phoṭarasāmyatā | premṇāṃ raṇena sāmyaṃ vai bhavatyeva kalau yuge ||72|| dhārmikakarmaṇāṃ vṛddhendriyasāmyaṃ hi tiṣyake | āstikatve nānyataracihnasāmyaṃ kalau yuge ||73|| punaḥ kṛtayuge prāpte jagat sajīvanaṃ punaḥ | hareryogāt tathābhāvi brahmaśaktyanvitaṃ sukham ||74|| sarvasmṛddhimayaṃ sarvadharmakarmaguṇānvitam | iti te kathitaṃ kalpaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi ||75|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kalidharmāṇāṃ viśeṣato nirūpaṇaṃ nāmā ṣoḍaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 216 ||
<1.217> śrīlakṣmīruvāca bhagavan śrotumicchāmi prathame dvāpare ca yā | bhūmikānartarājñā svatapasātra samāhṛtā || 1 || yatra śrīkṛṣṇadevena svavāsaḥ sthāpitaḥ sadā | tasyāstīrthasumāhātmyaṃ setihāsaṃ vad prabho || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca kalau yuge mahāghore bahupākhaṇḍasaṃśrite | taraṇāya mahattīrthe kathayāmi nibodha me || 3 || paścimasya samudrasya tīramāśritya tiṣṭhati | kuśasthalīti yā rājñā kuśena nirmitā bhavet || 4 || tato’pi pūrvamānartarājñānītā bhuvaḥ sthalī | ānartanagarī saiva sarvābhyaḥ prāg babhūva sā || 5 || gomatī yatra vahati sāgareṇa ca saṃgatā | dvārāvatī ca sā puryānartānāmnā prakīrtyate || 6 || tatra vasati viśvātmā sadā muktiprado hariḥ | kalāṣoḍaśasaṃyukto mūrtidvādaśabhiryutaḥ || 7 || dvārikā sā tu dhanyaiva yatra kṛṣṇaścaturbhujaḥ | janā muktiṃ prayāsyanti tatra gatvā yuge yuge || 8 || ānarto vai mahānbhakto śaryāterātmajo’bhavat | pitrā vibhajyamāne ca rājyaṃ vāgrahīt svakam || 9 || upādideśa pitaraṃ bhaktimānartakastathā | mamāyaṃ mānuṣo deho mokṣāyaiva hi kevalam || 1.217.1 0|| nāyaṃ rājye kṣayitavyo durlabhaḥ kalpabhūruhaḥ | cintāmaṇisamenātra sādhyo mokṣo mayaiva hi || 11 || śrutvā pitrā tadaivoktaṃ na yogyaṃ manyase ca yat | mama vaṃśe na cārājyakaro me rocate sutaḥ || 12|| gṛhāṇa rājyabhāgaṃ vā yadvā gacchānyabhūtale | ānartastatpituḥ śrutvā natvāgacchacca paścimam || 1 3|| raṇaṃ kṣāraṃ samudrasya vālukāvyāptabhūtalam | tapastepe bahukālaṃ kṛṣṇanāmnā bhajan harim || 14|| prasannaśca tadā kṛṣṇaḥ sametya bhaktasannidhau | ānartaṃ prāha me bhakta kiṃ te manasi vartate || 15|| varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te dadāmi yadabhīpsitam | praṇamya daṃḍavat prāha golokaṃ naya māṃ prabho || 16|| na me’sti kāpi tṛṣṇā vā na cāsti varṣmavāsanā | nādaraśca tapo’rthe me vinā tvatpādasevanam || 17|| prahasya bhagavān prāha śṛṇu bhakta tavārthakam | vivāsitastava pitrā tapaḥ karoṣi matkṛte || 18|| mayā deyaṃ mahadrājyaṃ te’tipitṛvaśaṃgatam | āgaccha ca mayā sārdhaṃ divyaṃ dadāmi bhūtalam || 1 9|| iti kṛtvā saha nītvā yayau golokadhāma saḥ | śrīkṛṣṇaḥ svasya golokād divyaṃ khaṇḍaṃ vibhajya ca ||1.217.20|| ānartāyārpitavām̐śca gṛhāṇemaṃ maṇiṃ śubham | divyaṃ gaccha ca bhūloke yatra taptaṃ tapastvayā ||21 || tatrainaṃ maṇikhaṇḍaṃ vai sthāpayābdhitaṭe śubhe | so’yaṃ rājyapradeśo vai svatantraste bhaviṣyati ||22|| ityāśāṃ samanugrahya nītvā golokakhaṇḍakam | samājagāma cānartaḥ paścimābdhitaṭasthalam ||23|| tatra yāvanmaṇirmuktastāvad viśālatāṃ gataḥ | śatayojanavistāro divyabhūstara uttamaḥ ||24|| navīnaṃ bhūtalaṃ jātaṃ divyaṃ rājyaṃ babhūva tat | ānartena tadā kṛṣṇaṃ smṛtvānartapurī tataḥ ||25|| vinirmitā rājadhānī kṛṣṇoddiṣṭā yathā tathā | śrīkṛṣṇastatra cāgatya pūjākāle jagād tam || 26|| mayā dvāparasaṃprānte vastavyaṃ cātra yattataḥ | śreṣṭhāṃ purīṃ ramaṇīyāṃ sanniveśaya matsthitām ||27|| ānartenāpi sāśreṣṭhā kṛṣṇoktavartmanā śubhā | purī sanniveśitā ca divyā golokadhāmabhā ||28|| evaṃ prasādarūpeyaṃ bhūmikānartasevitā | so’yaṃ tīrthamayo bhāgo mokṣado’sti surāṣṭrakaḥ ||29|| śṛṇu lakṣmi tataḥ kālāntare sāmudravāribhiḥ | bahuvāraṃ layaṃ yātā nagarī vāryupaplavaiḥ || 1.217.30 || dvāparānte yadā kṛṣṇastatrāyātuṃ mano dadhe | tadā na vidyate grāmo nagarī vātisusthalī ||3 1|| paścāt kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ bhrātrā saṃkarṣaṇena saṃyutaḥ | praṇamya pitarau svasya sasmāra garuḍaṃ hariḥ ||32|| madhupuryāṃ sthito vaṭamūle sasmāra sāgaram | sasmāra viśvakarmāṇaṃ nṛpaveṣaṃ dadhāra ca || 33 || gopaveṣaṃ parityajya cakraṃ sasmāra śāśvatam | sudarśanaṃ cājagāma sūryakoṭisamaprabham ||34|| tejasā kṛṣṇatulyaṃ ca sarvaśatruniṣūdnam | avyarthamastramastrāṇāṃ dadhāra tatsudarśanam || 35|| ratnayānaṃ puraskṛtya garuḍaścāpyupasthitaḥ | viśvakarmā kārubhiśca jagmuḥ sāgarasannidhim ||36|| jaladhiḥ kampitastām̐śca dṛṣṭvā natvā hyupasthitaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prāha jaladhe sthalaṃ te daśayojanam ||37|| dehi me nagarārthaṃ ca mama golokakhaṇḍakam | drāgeva ca samudreṇa tāvadbhūrnirjalā kṛtā ||38|| śuśubhe divyagolokasthalī sā tu yathāparā | viśvakarmāṇamevāha samīkāraya bhūsthalīm ||39|| nagaraṃ kuru me kāro triṣu lokeṣu śobhanam | ramaṇīyaṃ mahādivyaṃ kamanīyaṃ ca yoṣitām ||1.217.40|| vāñcchitaṃ cāpi bhaktānāṃ paraṃ golokasadṛśam | sarveṣāmapi svargāṇāṃ mūrdhanyaṃ mannivāsakam ||41 || divāniśaṃ garuḍa tvaṃ sannidhau viśvakarmaṇaḥ | sthitiṃ kuru vastukṛte yāvannirmāti matpurīm ||42|| divāniśaṃ ca matpārśve sudarśana sthitiṃ kuru | ityādiśya svayaṃ kṛṣṇo madhupuryāṃ jagāma ha ||43|| sāyaṃ sāyaṃ sadā viśvakarmā kṛṣṇaṃ prayāti vai | kāryaṃ niṣpannamākhyāti nūtanaṃ cintayatyapi ||44|| śrīkṛṣṇo viśvakarmāṇaṃ nirmāṇakramamāha ca | daśayojanaparyantaṃ nagaraṃ sumanoharam ||45|| padmarāgairmarakatairindranīlātinīlakaiḥ | rucakaiḥ pāribhadraiśca palaṃkaiśca syamantakaiḥ ||46|| gandhakairgālimaiścāpi sūryakāntādibhistathā | candrakāntamaṇibhiśca svarṇavarṣisuhīrakaiḥ ||47|| sphaṭikaiśca haridvarṇaiḥ śyāmairgauramukhaistathā | gorocanābhiḥ pītaiśca dāḍīmabījarūpakaiḥ ||48|| ārasaiḥ padmabījaiśca nīlaiḥ kamalavarṇakaiḥ | śyāmaiśca kajjalatulyaiḥ svacchairmaṇibhirujjvalaiḥ ||49|| śvetaiścampakavarṇābhaistaptakāṃcanasannibhaiḥ | bahumūlyairbahuguṇairāraktapītaśobhanaiḥ ||1.217.50 || gariṣṭhaiśca variṣṭhaiśca sadratnamaṇihīrakaiḥ | yathāvidhi yathāyogaṃ yatra yacca yadīpsitam ||51 || kuru divyaṃ nu ṣoḍaśasahasrayoṣitāṃ mama | anyapatnījanasyāpi cāṣṭādhikaśatasya ca ||52||| śibiraṃ śreṣṭhaparikhaṃ proccaprākāraveṣṭitam | dvādaśaśālābhiyuktaṃ siṃhadvārasuśobhitam ||53|| triraṃgādisucitritakapāṭādisvalaṃkṛtam | nākīyadrumasūdyānavartulādisuśobhitam || 54|| sulakṣaṇaṃ ghaṭīyantraṃ candravedhaṃ ravigṛham | nakṣatracakravijñānabhūtajñānartucakrakam ||55|| sabhāśālaṃ vaidhaśālaṃ bhūśālaṃ vyomaśāli ca | śrāvyayantrapraśālaṃ ca dūraśrāvaṇaśālikam ||56|| dūradṛśyapraśālaṃ ca vidyucchālādisaṃyutam | ṛtujñānaṃ pavijñānaṃ vāyujñānaṃ tathā bhavet ||57|| bhūstarasya pravijñānaṃ cotpātajñānaśālikam | tatsarvaṃ tatra nagare sthale yogye prakalpaya ||58|| yadūnāmāśramānramyān kiṃkarāṇāṃ gṛhāṇi ca | karmacārigṛhodyānavihārāṇi ca kāraya ||59|| sarvasaudhātigaṃ svargyaṃ cograsenasya bhūbhṛtaḥ | hyāśramaṃ bhavanaṃ sarvabhadraṃ kāraya śobhanam ||1.217.60|| tathā siddhiprasiddhibhiryuktaṃ divyaṃ viśālakam | kārayāśramamūrdhanyaṃ vasudevasya matpituḥ ||6 1 || viśvakarmā hariṃ prāha vṛkṣaprāśastyavātrcchayā | kete vṛkṣāḥ praśastāśca niṣiddhāśca tathā ca ke ||62|| bhadrābhadrapradāḥ ke ca tānvadasva jagadguro | keṣāmasthiniyuktaṃ ca śibiraṃ ca sukhāsukham ||63|| kutra diśi jalaṃ bhadramabhadraṃ ca vada prabho | kutra diśi ropitaśca vṛkṣo bhadraṃ dadāti vai ||64|| gṛhāṇāṃ prāṃgaṇānāṃ ca pramāṇaṃ kiṃ vada prabho | kutra diśi tarudyānaṃ puṣpodyānaṃ ca bhadrakṛt ||65|| prākārāṇāṃ parikhāṇāṃ dvārāṇāṃ ca pramāṇakam | bhavanānāṃ ca saudhānāṃ pramāṇaṃ vada me prabho ||66|| kasya kasya ca vṛkṣasya kāṣṭhaṃ śubhaṃ gṛhe prabho | abhadraṃ ca bhavet keṣāṃ taccāpi vada me prabho ||67|| kṛṣṇaḥ prāha tadā kāruṃ śṛṇu dhyānaṃ vidhāya ca | āśrame nārikelaśca gṛhiṇāṃ syāddhanapradaḥ ||68|| śibirasya yadīśāne pūrve putrapradastaruḥ | sarvatra maṃgalakarastarurājo manoharaḥ ||69|| rasālavṛkṣaḥ pūrvasmin nṛṇāṃ sampatprado bhavet | bilvaḥ panaso badarī sukhadāḥ sarvadā matāḥ ||1.217.70|| prajāpradāśca pūrvasmin dakṣiṇe dhanadāśca te | sampatpradāśca sarvatra tebhyo vivardhate gṛhī ||71 || jambūvṛkṣo dāḍimaśca kadalyāmrātakastathā | bandhūpradāśca pūrvasmin dakṣiṇe mitradāśca te ||72|| suvāko dakṣiṇe tadvat paścime sukhaharṣadaḥ | dhanaputrapradaścaiva sarvatra gṛhapārśvagaḥ ||73|| gṛhapārśve campakastu sarvatra bhadrabhadradaḥ | īśāne sukhadaścaiva svarṇādyāpādakastathā ||74|| alābuścāti kuṣmāṇḍamāyāmbuśca sakiṃśukaḥ | kharjūrī karkaṭī cāpi śibire maṃgalāyanāḥ ||75|| vāstūkakārabilvaśca vārtākaśca sukhapradaḥ | latāphalaṃ ca sukhadaṃ gṛhapārśve tu vardhitam ||76|| phalavṛkṣāstathā puṣpavṛkṣā maṃgaladāḥ sadā | phalavallyastathā puṣpavallyo maṃgaladāstathā ||77|| gandhapuṣpaphalavṛkṣalatātṛṇāni sarvathā | maṃgalānyeva jāyante putradravyarddhidāni vai ||78|| vicitraraṃgapatrāyaṇi citrapuṣpāṇi yāni ca | stambānyapi ca saumyāni sukhadāni bhavanti ca ||79|| praśastāni kathitāni niṣiddhāni niśāmaya | vanyavṛkṣā niṣiddhāśca phalapuṣpavihīnakāḥ ||1.217.80 || gṛhe saudhe samudyāne nagare gopure tathā | araṇyataravo vyarthā niṣiddhā na śubhā matāḥ ||8 1|| yatra gṛdhrakaṃkadhūkavāso bhūtapiśācakāḥ | vasanti yatra ca te vai niṣiddhā gandhahīnakāḥ ||82|| vaṭo niṣiddhaḥ śibire nityaṃ caurabhayapradaḥ | nagareṣu viśālāyāṃ bhūmau dṛṣṭastu puṇyadaḥ ||83|| śivire nagare grāme śālmalirna praśasyate | kṣitipānāṃ tu satataṃ duḥkhadaḥ parigaṇyate ||84|| grāme vā nagare vā ca na niṣiddho bahiḥ sthale | vidyāsthale niṣiddhaśca satataṃ duḥkhado yataḥ |||85|| tintiḍīdrurdhanahānikaraḥ prajāvināśakaḥ| śibiretiniṣiddhaśca nagare kiñcideva saḥ 86|| na niṣiddhaḥ kvacit siddhā grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca | vidyāsthale niṣiddhaśca prājñastadvarjayet sadā ||87|| kharjuraśca gahuścaiva niṣiddhau śibire hyubhau | grāme vā nagare vā ca niṣiddho na bahiḥ sthale || 88 || vṛkṣāśca caṇakādīnāṃ dhānyāni maṃgalāni vai | grāme vā nagare vāpi śibire ca gṛhe’bhitaḥ ||89|| ikṣudaṇḍāḥ śubhakarāḥ satataṃ smṛddhivardhakāḥ | aśokaśca śirīṣaśca kadambaśca śubhapradaḥ ||1.217.90 || haridrā śubhadā bodhyā hyārdrakāḥ śubhadāstathā | harītakyaśca śubhadā āmalakyaḥ śubhapradāḥ ||9 1 || gajānāmasthi śubhakṛt vājināmasthi saukhyakṛt | vānarāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca gardabhānāṃ gavāmapi ||95|| kukkuṭānāṃ śṛgālānāṃ mārjārāṇāmabhadrakam | bheṭakānāṃ sūkarāṇāṃ tvasthi vastau śubhapradam || 93|| īśāne ca tathā pūrve paścime cottare tathā | śibirasya jalaṃ bhadramanyatrābhadrameva tat|||94|| nimne prasthe’samāne viṣame kuryānna mandiram | caturasre gṛhe saudhe gṛhiṇāṃ dhananāśanam ||95|| dairghye śūnyena rahitaṃ trayeṇa rahitaṃ tathā | bhadraṃ gṛhaṃ ca nagaraṃ śūny śūnyapradaṃ nṛṇām ||96|| prasthe hastadvayātpūrvaṃ dīrghaṃ hastatrayaṃ tathā | gṛhāṇāṃ śubhadaṃ dvāraṃ prākārasya gṛhasya ca ||97|| na madhyadeśe kartavyaṃ kiñcinyūnādhike śubham | caturasraṃ candravedhaṃ śibiraṃ maṃgalapradam ||98|| abhadradaṃ sūryabhedaṃ śibiraṃ maṃgalāpradam | abhadradaṃ sūryabhedaṃ prāṃgaṇaṃ maṃgalāpradam ||99|| śibirābhyantare bhadrā ropitā tulasī sadā | dravyāpatyapradātrī ca dharmadā mokṣadā tathā || 1.217.100 || mālatī yūthikā kundo mādhavo ketakī tathā | nāgacampako mallikā dhattūro bakulaḥ śubhāḥ || 101 || śubhadahā cāparājitā tāsāmudyānamarthadam | pūrve ca dakṣiṇe caiva śubhadaḥ sukhadastathā || 1 02|| ūrdhvaṃ ṣoḍaśahastebhyo naiva kuryād gṛhaṃ gṛhī | ūrdhvaṃ viṃśatihastebhyaḥ prākāro na śubhapradaḥ || 103|| tailakāraṃ svarṇakāraṃ hīrakādikrayārthinam | sūtradhāraṃ vāṭikāyāṃ grāmamadhye na vāsayet || 1 04|| brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ sacchūdro gaṇakaḥ śubhāḥ | bhadraṃ vaidyaṃ puṣpakāraṃ sthāpayet śibirāntike || 1 05|| prākāre parikhāpānaṃ śatahastaṃ praśasyate | śibirāṇāṃ paritastu daśahastaṃ praśasyate || 1 06|| guptaṃ ca parikhādvāraṃ sasaṃketaṃ praśasyate | tintiḍyaścāpi śālmalyo hintālāḥ sindhuvārakāḥ || 1 07|| nimbāścodumbarā dhattūrā eraṇḍā vaṭāstathā | na śubhā duḥkhadāstasmācchibire tanna vardhayet||| 1 08|| vṛkṣaṃ tu vajrahastaṃ ca rājā tu varjayet sadā | putradāradhanaṃ hanyāt tasmānna sthāpayettu tam || 1 09|| ityādeśaṃ hareḥ prāpya viśvakarmā vaṭasthale | abdhitīre ca suṣvāpa svapne dadarśa dvārikām || 1.217.11 0|| viśvakarmāṇamālokya devakāryasukāravaḥ | prasvapantaṃ hasanti sma dvārikā yaistu nirmitā || 111 || rātrāveva suniṣpannā svapne dṛṣṭā yathā tathā | prātaḥ prabudhya kārustu paśyati dvārikāṃ śubhām 11 2|| buddho dadarśa pūrṇāṃ tāṃ viśvakarmā vilajjitaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇena yathoktāṃ ca daśayojanavistṛtām || 113 || brahmādīnāṃ nagarīśca vijityotkarṣarājitam | dvitīyāṃ dyāṃ ca tejobhī ratnarāśipariṣkṛtam || 1 14|| etasminnantare lakṣmi dvārāvatīṃ vilokitum | samājagmuścaturdaśalokeśāḥ prātareva yat || 115 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvārikāmāhātmye śaryātiputrānartānītagolokakhaṇḍātmakasaurāṣṭre śubhāśubhavṛkṣavalyādisahitadvārikānirmitanirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 2 17||
<1.218> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha purīṃ samādraṣṭuṃ brahmā patnyā sahāyayau | bhavo bhavānyā sahito’nanto dharmaśca bhāskaraḥ || 1 || hutāśaśca kuberaśca varuṇaḥ pavano yamaḥ | rudrāścaikādaśa candro mahendro vasavastathā || 2 || ādityāḥ kinnarā daityā gandharvā āyayustadā | vimānasthairvaṭamūle sthitaḥ kṛṣṇaśca vanditaḥ || 3 || stutastairdvārikā dṛṣṭā ramyā cātimanoharā | muktāmāṇikyahīrakaratnarājivirājitā || 4 || paritaścaturasrā ca daśayojanavistṛtā | sāptabhiḥ parikhābhiśca gaṃbhīrābhiḥ suveṣṭitā || 5 || prākārairnavabhiryuktā jalakrīḍāsarovaraiḥ | vividhairjalapadmaiśca kalhāraiḥ kamalaistathā || 6 || sarvatobhadravṛkṣaiśca puṣpodyānaiḥ samantataḥ | śobhitā phullapuṣpaiścānilaiśca surabhīkṛtā || 7 || mandacandanavṛkṣaiśca tulasīdrubhirañcitā | āmoditā sugandhibhiḥ pavanairmandaśītalaiḥ || 8 || nārikelataruṣaṇḍaiḥ pūgābhiratiśobhitā | lakṣādhiguṇaguvākadrumaiścāpi vibhūṣitā || 9 || tato’pi ca caturguṇacūtavṛkṣaiḥ sumaṇḍitā | prakāśitā paritaśca tāvadbhiḥ panasadrumaiḥ || 1.218.10 || tathā tāladrumairyuktāśvatthabadarikādibhiḥ | vaṭairāmrātakairbilvairjambūkadambavaṃśakaiḥ || 11 || śālmalītintiḍīnāgaraṃgairjambīradāḍimaiḥ | campakairbakulairnāgeśvarairarjunakharjuraiḥ || 1 2|| ikṣubhiḥ kāṃcanairharītakīdhātrībhirindubhiḥ | śālaiḥ priyālairhintālaiḥ śiśiraiḥ saptaparṇakaiḥ || 13 || vallībhiḥ parito vyāptā svarṇakalaśamaṇḍitā | navalakṣaiḥ ramyasaudhaiḥ ramyoccamandirairyutā || 14|| ratnendrasāranirmāṇamuktāmāṇikyabhūṣitā | māṇikyahīrakaratnasvarṇakalaśamandirā || 15 || maṇinirmitasopānakapāṭabhittikāyutā | harinmaṇikṛtastambhaśvetasphaṭikasattalā || 16 || citravicitrasusūkṣmavastracāmaradarpaṇā | padmarāgapariklṛptaprāṃgaṇā śvetasadgṛhā || 17|| indranīlamaṇivyāptarathyāvīthīsamanvitā | ratnakhacitamadhyādirājamārgādiśobhitā || 18 || grīṣmamadhyāhnasūryābhā jvalitā ratnatejasā | gavākṣalakṣasaṃyuktamahatsaudhādipaṃktikā || 1 9|| hastiśālā vājiśālā haṃsagaruḍajālikā | dṛṣṭaivaṃ dvārikā ramyā devaiḥ sarvaiḥ samāgataiḥ || 1.218.20 || ānartaḥ śuśubhe deśaḥ śatayojanabhūtale | dvārikayā militaśca dviguṇavat sa lakṣyate || 21 || atha kṛṣṇaḥ prasasmāra vasudevaṃ ca devakīm | ugrasenaṃ yādavām̐śca pāṇḍavām̐śca samātṛkān || 22|| nandaṃ yaśodāṃ gopālān gandharvān kinnarān munīn | āyayuḥ saṃsmṛtāḥ sarve kṛṣṇakṛṣṇetivādinaḥ || 23 || kṛṣṇapratāpād divyāste divyavyomagatiprabhāḥ | vidyādharyaśca kinnaryo nartakyo gāyikāstathā ||24|| gāyakā vādyabhāṇḍāśca bhaṭṭā gaṇakabhikṣukāḥ | anekadeśavāsīyā bhūpā vaidyāśca bhūsurāḥ ||25|| nyāsino yatayo vānaprasthāśca brahmacāriṇaḥ | avadhūtāstathā siddhā āyayurmunayastathā || 26|| sanandaḥ sanakaḥ sanātanaḥ sanatkumārakaḥ | sanatsujātaśca voḍhā pañcaśikhastathāsuriḥ || 2 7|| brahmacaryavratapālā āyayurlakṣaśo janāḥ | daśasāhasraśiṣyāḍhyo durvāsāstatra cāyayau || 28 || patnīvrato mahābrahmasvarūpo bhagavānsvayam | lakṣaśiṣyasahitaścāyayau kṛṣṇaniketanam || 29 || lakṣaśiṣyaiḥ kaśyapaśca vālmokaśca sahasrayuk | lakṣaśiṣyairgautamaśca koṭidevairbṛhaspatiḥ || 1.218.30 || śukro’pi koṭiśiṣyaiśca bharadvājaḥ salakṣakaḥ | aṃgiro’yutaśiṣyaiśca vasiṣṭho’yutaśiṣyakaḥ || 31 || pracetāḥ śataśiṣyaiśca pulastyaśca sahasrayuk | agastyo’yutaśiṣyaśca pulahaśca sahasrayuk || 3 2|| śataśiṣyaḥ kratuścātrirbhṛguścāpi tathānugaḥ | tathā sahasraśiṣyaśca marīcistatra cāyayau || 33 || pañcaśatānugaḥ śatānandaśca pāṇinistathā | sahasraśiṣyairyuktaśca ṛṣyaśṛṃgo vibhāṇḍakaḥ || 34|| kātyāyanastathā yājñavalkyaḥ sahasravān yayau | sahasraśiṣyakairvyāso gargaḥ śiṣyaiḥ śatādhikaiḥ || 35 || gālavaśca śatenāpi saubharirviṃśatirjanaiḥ | lomaśo daśalakṣaiśca mārkaṇḍeyastrilakṣakaiḥ || 36 || sāndīpanirdevalaśca svaśiṣyaiśca śataiḥ śataiḥ | boḍhuḥ pañcaśikhaścaitau ṣaṣṭiśiṣyapraśiṣyakaiḥ || 37|| naro nārāyaṇaścaitau tāpasairbahusaṃkhyakaiḥ | viśvāmitrastathā vatsaḥ yayau śiṣyasahasrakaiḥ || 38 || jaratkārurāstīkaśca parśurāmaśca dakṣakaḥ | saṃvarto jaiminiścāpi pailaścāpi nijānugaiḥ || 39 || upamanyuḥ śukadevaḥ kaco gauramukhastathā | lālāyanādyāścāpyanye’śvatthāmā droṇa ityapi ||1.218.40 || kṛpo bhīṣmaśca karṇaśca tathānye yugadevatāḥ | sudivyau kambharāgopālākhyau śiṣyaiḥ samāyayuḥ ||4 1 || sādhyā viśve marutaśca yakṣāśca vāstukarmaṇi | cāraṇāḥ pitaro rudrā mātṛkā dikprapālakāḥ ||42|| catuḥkhanijadehyādyāḥ pātālādigatāstathā | grahanakṣatratārāśca kṛṣṇavāstau samāyayuḥ ||43|| vasavo nidhayaścaiva pare saptarṣayastathā | prajāpatayo manavo vālakhilyāḥ samagrata || 44|| dharmādharmakulotthāśca vasantādyāḥ ṣaḍartavaḥ | kāmādyāścāpsarasaśca paryo devyaśca dāsikā ||45|| sādhavo yatayaḥ sādhvyaḥ sanyāsinyo virāgikāḥ | sāṃkhyayoginya eveyuḥ kṛṣṇo vāstuṃ karoti vai ||46|| avadhūtyastathā caṇḍyo durgā māyā ramādikāḥ | lakṣmyo jayāvijayādyāḥ sakhyo māṇikyakanyakāḥ ||47|| prabhā ca pārvatī gāyatrī sāvitrī sarasvatī | gopyo gopā golokasthāstathā vaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ ||48|| kumāryaśca kumārāśca brahmacāriṇya ityapi | śaktayaḥ smṛddhayaḥ siddhimūrtayaścāyayustadā ||49|| tattvāni vedaśāstrāṇi vidyāśca vividhāḥ śubhāḥ | guṇā aiśvaryasāmarthyamuktamuktānya āyayuḥ ||1.218.50 || catvāra āśramā varṇā dīnā anāthadehinaḥ | lokālokā āyayurvai kṛṣṇo vāstuṃ karoti yat ||51|| śṛṇu lakṣmi yatra sarvatīrthatīrtheśvareśvarāḥ | samāyayuśca sā bhūmirvarṇanīyā mayā kimu ||52|| sarvatīrthaparā śreṣṭhā dvārikā bahupuṇyadā | yasyāṃ praveśamātreṇa janmamṛtyuvināśanam ||53 || dānaṃ śrāddhaṃ devapūjānantaguṇaphalapradam | tīrthānāṃ tīrtharūpaṃ tat kiṃ tīrthaṃ dvārakāparam ||54|| ugraseno mahārājaḥ sadā kṛṣṇājñayāvasat | svālayaṃ dvārakāmadhye mahendrabhavanātparam ||55|| sahasrairdvārapālaiśca dvāraṃ dadarśa rakṣitam | abhyantaraṃ ca śibiraṃ dvārebhyaḥ ṣaḍbhya eva ca ||56|| mandirāṇāṃ śatakaiścaratnaphalaśaśālinām | mattāyutagajendrāṇāṃ turagāṇāṃ tathāyutam ||57|| uṣṭrāṇāmayutaṃ cāpi rathānāmayutaṃ tathā | ardhalakṣaṃ sārathīnāṃ dadarśa rājapuṃgavaḥ |||58|| dadarśābhyantare ramye devaughamunisaṃsthitām | sudharmākhyāṃ sabhāṃ divyāṃ svarṇasiṃhāsanānvitām ||59|| śuddhāṃśukaiḥ pariṣkṛtāṃ ratnatejaḥsamujjvalām | praviveśa sabhāṃ ramyāṃ śuśrāva śaṃkhasaddhvanim ||1.218.60 || ninādaṃ ca dundubhīnāṃ munīnāṃ vedaghoṣaṇām | śrutvā sabhāṃ praviśantaṃ hyugrasenaṃ harirbalaḥ ||6 1 || brahmā śivastathā viṣṇuḥ śeṣaśca devapuṃgavāḥ | samuttasthuḥ surāḥ sarve munayo mānavāstathā ||62| ratnasiṃhāsane ramye samuvāsa nṛpeśvaraḥ | ugrasenaśca devānāṃ harergargasya cājñayā || 63 || saptatīrthodakapūrṇakuṃbhena tatra nāradaḥ | cakāra vedamantraiśca nṛpasyāpyabhiṣecanam || 64|| tasmai vastrayugaṃ dattaṃ varuṇena mahātmanā | mālyaṃ ca pārijātānāṃ candanaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇam || 65|| ratnachatrādikaṃ tasmai baladevo dadau pṛthak | dadau kamaṇḍaluṃ brahmā triśūlaṃ ca maheśvaraḥ ||66 || pārvatī ratnamālyaṃ ca mukuṭaṃ kṛṣṇa eva saḥ | svarṇabhūṣāśca rājendrāḥ prajāścopāyanāni ca || 617 || anye caturdaśalokavāsāśca yautakaṃ daduḥ | vasudevo dadau tasmai śvetaṃ tu cāmaradvayam ||68 || nando dadau kāmadhenuṃ yaśodā ratnamālikām | dadhāra chatramakrūro bhaktyā śrīkṛṣṇadeśanāt ||6 9 || ratnasiṃhāsane ramye rājā dadarśa darpaṇam | śuśrāva puṇyavācaśca bhaṭṭabhikṣukavedinām ||1.218.70 || daduḥ śubhāśiṣastasmai devāśca munayo dvijāḥ | brāhmaṇobhyo bhikṣukebhyo dadau ratnāni koṭiśaḥ ||7 1 || vastrānnabhojanapānasvarṇapātrāṇi bhūriśaḥ | sarvebhyo dānapātrebhyo dadau dānāni mādhavaḥ || 32 || vāstuyajñaṃ hariḥ kṛṣṇaścakāra sarvamaṃgalaḥ | bhojayāmāsa sarvāṃścānnāni tadrucirāṇi vai ||73 || sabhāyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇadevaṃ nemurlokanivāsinaḥ | prāhuśca bhagavan ramyā dvārikātimanoharā ||74|| tava bāhuparitrāṇā pāvanī pāpanāśinī | purī naitādṛśī cātra brahmāṇḍe’nyā hi vartate ||75 || asmākaṃ yāni bhaumāni vismṛtānyeva darśanāt|| naitādṛśaṃ paraṃ divyaṃ sthānaṃ kvāpi vilokyate ||76 || ityevaṃ sā praśaṃsitā nagarī dvārakā suraiḥ | atha kṛṣṇa upadāśca tebhyo dātuṃ pracakrame ||77|| tadā brahmādayo devā īśvarā lokapālakāḥ | ṛṣayo munayo devyo devajātaya eva yāḥ ||78|| samudrāḥ sarito divyāḥ parvatāḥ kṣetrabhūmayaḥ | araṇyāni ca dhāmāni pūryo vanāni cāpagāḥ ||79 || sarāṃsi ca taḍāgāśca śikharāṇi ca kandarāḥ | devālayāstathā khātā akhātāḥ pāvanastarāḥ ||1.218.80 || mūrtimanto hariṃ natvā prārthayāmāsurādarāt | bhagavanparameśāna tavāśiṣaḥ śubhāvahāḥ ||8 1 || śreyomokṣapradāḥ sarvā upadā nātiricyate | upadāstu cārthayāmo yadi te rocate prabho ||82|| divyarūpaiḥ sadāsmābhiḥ stheyaṃ cātra pade tava | tava yogānmahānando bhaviṣyatyeva naḥ sadā ||83 || pāvanāśca bhaviṣyāmastīrthasaṃghāstavaspṛśeḥ | dvārakāyāṃ sadāsmām̐stvaṃ rakṣaya śrīhare prabho ||84|| kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpānātha vatsyāmo’tra pade tava | anyatrāsmāsu pāpiṣṭhāḥ pāpāni kṣālayanti vai || 85 || datvā no yānti te sarve vayaṃ pāpena cāvṛtāḥ | tava pāde patiṣyāmaḥ kṣālayiṣyāma eva ca ||86 || pāpāni ca bhaviṣyāmo pāvanāni pade tava | tasmātprabho sadāvāsa dehi cātra pure tava ||87|| yatra kvāpi prasīmnyatra vane tīre bahistathā | paritaḥ pārśvataścāpi nivatsyāmaḥ sukhaṃ sadā ||88|| darśanaṃ te kariṣyāmo’mṛtaṃ pāsyāma eva te | pādaprakṣālanapūtaṃ vahiṣyāmaḥ śiraḥsu ca ||89 || sārthakyaṃ janmanāmatra yāsyāmastava pādayoḥ | ityarthanāṃ hariḥ śrutvā prāha sarvān prabhūn tadā || 1.218.90 || sarve vasantu sukhino dvārikāyāṃ yathāyatham | nārado’yaṃ mama bhaktaḥ sthalīḥ sandarśayiṣyati || 91 || tīrthāni tāni yuṣmākaṃ bhaviṣyanti ca nāmabhiḥ | tatra tatra sthale stheyaṃ mayā saha nirantaram || 9 2|| ityājñāṃ samanuprāpya śrīkṛṣṇasya parātmanaḥ | sarvadevādhitīrthāni nyūṣurānartabhūstare || 9 3|| pūrve nagaraparyantaṃ dakṣiṇe raivatācalam | uttarenārāyaṇākhyasaro’vadhi bhūvatsalam || 94|| sarvaṃ tīrthamayaṃ devamayaṃ pade pade’bhavat | tataḥ kṛṣṇaśca tān sarvānāhūya kṛtavāsakān || 15|| bhāvataḥ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā bhojayāmāsa sadrasān | sadannāni sumunyannottamāni peyavāri ca || 96 || pūjāṃ cakāra sarveṣāṃ munīnāṃ ca yathāyatham | maṇiratnaṃ pravālaṃ ca suvarṇaṃ paramaṃ dhanam || 97|| muktāmāṇikyahīrādi hyāgatebhyo dadau mudā | gajaratnaṃ dhenuratnaṃ ghoṭakām̐śca manoharān || 98|| āsanāni ca pātrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni maṇīṃstathā | dhānyānyapi ca sasyāni vastrāṇi ca dadau bahūn ||9 9 || yānāni vāhanānyeva vimānāni ca mādhavaḥ | dāpayāmāsa sāmagrīrgṛhayogyāśca keśavaḥ || 1.218.10 0|| dundubhīnvādayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṃgalam | sarvāṃśca bhojayāmāsa vāsayāmāsa sarvataḥ || 101 || atha tīrthāni cāhūya bhagavānāha tattvataḥ | kalau samāgate pāpā bhaviṣyanti ca mānavāḥ || 10 2|| dvārikā divyanagarī teṣāmuddhārahetave | sarvatīrthādhivāseyaṃ mayā vai sthāpitā bhuvi || 103 || kalikalmaṣakṛṣṇā ye janāścātra jale sthale | tīrthavidhiṃ kariṣyanti yāsyanti dhāma te mama || 1 04|| janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiharaṃ harṣakaraṃ param | śokasantāpaharaṇaṃ karmamūlanikṛntanam || 1 05|| dvārikāsthaṃ paraṃbrahma bhagavantaṃ ca māṃ harim | dhyāyaṃ dhyāyaṃ ca māṃ bhaktiṃ labdhvā yāntu paraṃ padam || 1 06|| yadā kaliḥ samāyāti dharmamūlanikṛntanaḥ | strīpuṃsorniyamau nāsti jātīnāṃ niyamo’pi na || 1 07|| vipre sandhyādikaṃ nāsti cihnaṃ yajñopavītakam | yajñasūtraṃ ca tilakaṃ śeṣaṃ luptaṃ bhaviṣyati || 1 08|| divā vyavāyaniratā viratā dharmakarmaṇi | bhaviṣyanti tathā caurā narā nāryo gṛhe gṛhe || 1 09|| yajñānāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca tapasāṃ lopa eva ca | svacchandagāminīnārīvaśe patiḥ sadā bhavet || 1.218.110 || tāḍayed bhartsayed vā strī patiṃ nārī pradhānabhūḥ | kalau ca yoṣitaḥ sarvā jārasevāsu tatparāḥ || 11 1 || śataputrasamasnehastāsāṃ jāre bhaviṣyati | dadāti pataye bhakṣyaṃ yathābhṛtyāya kopataḥ || 11 2|| sasmitā sāmṛtadṛṣṭyā jāraṃ paśyati kāmataḥ | viṣadṛṣṭyā krūradṛṣṭyā patiṃ paśyati roṣataḥ || 113|| satataṃ gauravaṃ tasyā snehaṃ jāre ca tādṛśe | patyau karaprahāraṃ ca nityaṃ nityaṃ karoti vai || 1 14|| miṣṭānnaṃ śraddhayā bhaktyā jārāya pradadāti ca | veṣayuktā ca satataṃ jārasevanatatparā || 1 15|| prāṇā bandhurgatiścātmā kalau jāraśca yoṣitaḥ | luptā cātithisevā ca praluptaṃ viṣṇusevanam || 1 16|| pitṛdevārcanaṃ luptaṃ bhaviṣyati kalau yuge | viṣṇuvaiṣṇavayordveṣakartāro mānavāḥ kalau || 1 17|| bhaviṣyanti vāmadharmagrahitāro janāstadā | śālagrāmaṃ ca tulasīṃ kuśaṃ gaṃgodakaṃ tathā || 1 18|| na spṛśenmānavo dhūrto mlecchācāraparāyaṇaḥ | kaleḥ pañcasahasrordhvaṃ madarcā tu vilupyati || 11 9|| catuḥsahasrakālordhvaṃ gaṃgā yamī sarasvatī | tīrthāni viṣṇubhaktāśca vinaṃkṣyanti bhuvastale || 1.218.120 || etadante kalau sarve pagsparavimiśritāḥ | ekavarṇā bhaviṣyanti cāṇḍālā balinaḥ śaṭhāḥ || 121 || pitroḥ sevā guroḥ sevā sevā ca devaviprayoḥ | vivarjyate janaiḥ sarvaiścātithīnāṃ tathaiva ca || 122 || sasyahīnā bhavet pṛthvī vṛṣṭihīnā vasundharā | phalahīnāstathā vṛkṣā jalahīnāstathāpagāḥ || 1223 || vedahīno brāhaṇaśca balahīnaśca bhūpatiḥ | jātihīnā janāḥ sarve mlecchā bhūpatayastathā || 124 || bhṛtyavat tāḍayet tātaṃ putraḥ śiṣyastathā gurum | kāntaṃ ca tāḍayet kāntā lubdhakukkuṭavad gṛhī || 125 || dharmo layaṃ yadā yāto bhaviṣyati tadā janāḥ | hṛdyeṣu mṛṣākalpā bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge || 126 || svārtha eva susambandho bhaviṣyati navo navaḥ | pratārakāḥ kalipuṣṭā bhaviṣyanti gurūttamāḥ || 127 || adhamebhyopyadhamāśca nīcakarmāṇa eva ca | harerbhaktiṃ vinā naiva tariṣyanti kalau khalāḥ || 128 || teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya dvārakā sarvapāvanī | sarvatīrthamayī bhūmiḥ kāleyatāraṇakṣamā || 129 || yatra nāsti kalerleśastādṛśī sthāpitā bhuvi | tatra snānaṃ darśanaṃ ca vrataṃ cārcanamarthanam || 1.218.130 || bhajanaṃ jalapānaṃ ca rajaḥsnānaṃ ca kīrtanam | kariṣyanti janā bhāvāt te yāsyanti paraṃ padam || 131 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne divyadvārikāvarṇanaṃ śrīkṛṣṇatmatāsaṃkhyasuramunyādyāgamanatatpūjanatannivasana tattīrthamāhātmyakalitāraṇapratāpāścetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 218 ||
<1.219> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca mahālakṣmi sarvā tīrthamayī hi sā | dvārakā bhagavadvāsā kimu varṇyaṃ viśeṣakam || 1 || tathāpi varṇayiṣyami tīrthāni kānicid yathā | tatra mukhyāṃ gomatīṃ vai pragacchet kṛṣṇasaṃśrayām || 2 || yasyā darśanamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ| amaṃgalānāṃ pāpānāṃ nāśakaṃ sparśamātrataḥ || 3 || sarvecchāpūrakaṃ puṇyaṃ praṇamet gomatījalam | ubhaśreyaḥpadaṃ gatipradaṃ vai gomatījalam || 4 || ekārṇave purā jāte naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame | brahmā jajñe nābhipadme tena vai sanakādayaḥ || 5 || samutpāditā ājñaptāḥ sṛṣṭikāryārthameva ca | agṛhītavacasaste yayurvai tapase tataḥ || 6 || paścimāṃ diśamādāya tīre nadanadīpateḥ | tejomayasvarūpasya draṣṭukāmā harestadā || 7 || harau manaḥ samādhāya tepire dāruṇaṃ tapaḥ | bahuvarṣasahasraiśca prasanno bhagavān svayam || 8 || babhūva prerayāmāsa cakraṃ svīyaṃ sudarśanam | pṛthvīṃ bhittvā jalaṃ nītvā tejomayaṃ sudarśanam || 9 || bahirāyāt sūryasamaṃ sahasrāraṃ durāsadam | daityadānavahantṛ ca bhaktarakṣā karaṃ sadā || 1.219.10 || dṛṣṭvā cakraṃ vismitāśca brahmaputrāḥ parasparam | tadā nabhogatā vāṇī prāha tāṃśca kumārakān || 11 || bho brāhmaṇā yogisiddhāḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇo hariḥ | prasannastapasā sākṣācchīghramāvirbhaviṣyati || 12|| tasyārhatākṛte cetajjalamāvirbabhūva ha | jalenānena pūtena śīghramarghaṃ prayacchata || 13 || yadidaṃ tejasā vyāptamāyudhaṃ tatsudarśanam | śrīharerlokanāthasya tasmādarghaṃ prayacchata || 1 4|| tacchrutvā ca sanakādyāstuṣṭuvurvai sudarśanam | namo jyotiḥsvarūpāya brahmaśastrāya te namaḥ || 15 || namo bhaktasurakṣāya viṣṇuśastrāya te namaḥ | sahasrāśaya sūryāyāmoghāya te namo namaḥ || 16 || iti stutvaḥ namaskṛtvā pūjayāmāsurakṣataiḥ | puṣpaiḥ patrairjalaiḥ stotraiḥ praṇemuśca punaḥ punaḥ || 17|| harirbrahmā vasiṣṭhaśca samāyātāśca tatsthale | putrāṇāṃ tapasā hṛṣṭā daduḥ svadarśanaṃ tadā || 18 || satyalokasthitā gaṃgā mūrtāpi tatra cāgatā | brahmā prāha tadā gaṃgāṃ vaśiṣṭhaṃ mama putrakam || 19 || anuyāhi samudrāntaṃ jalaṃ bhūtvā jale vasa | yatra sudarśanādvāri puṇyaṃ cātra samudgatam || 1.219.20 || tatra sthānaṃ sadā te syāt tīrthaṃ sarvāghanāśanam | śrīkṛṣṇasya pādasparśāt sadā puṇyā sute bhava || 21 || gavāṃ kiraṇamukhyānāṃ jale sudarśanodbhave| sthitimattvāt sadā te vai saṃjñāstu gomatī śubhā ||22| vaśiṣṭhasyānugā bhūtvā nadīrūpā sute bhava | piteva putrīti yathā vaśiṣṭhatanayā bhava || 23 || bāḍhamityeva tānuktvā prasthitā jalabhāvataḥ | vasiṣṭhaścāgrato yāti gaṃgā taṃ pṛṣṭhato’nvagāt || 24|| tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavāḥ sarve devāśca tīrthakoṭayaḥ | namaścakrurmahāpuṇyāṃ gacchantīṃ paścimārṇavam || 25|| vaśiṣṭhamanugacchantī prasthitā varuṇālayam | samākiran mahābhāgā sumanobhiśca tāṃ nadīm || 26|| divyairmālyaiḥ sugandhaiśca garndhairdhūpaistathākṣataiḥ | pūjayāmāsurāścaryasametā vai surādayaḥ || 27|| asyā darśanamātreṇa muktiṃ yāsyanti mānavāḥ | kiṃ punaḥ snānadānādi kṛtvā yānti hareḥ padam || 28 || ityuktvā cārpayitvārghyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇamīḍire harim | pītakauśeyavasanaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam || 29|| divyagandhasugandhāḍhyaṃ divyasvarṇāṃgadānvitam | divyābharaṇahetiṃ ca makarākārakuṇḍalam || 1.219.30 || jvalatkirīṭamukuṭaṃ śrīvatsāṃkitavakṣasam | bhaktābhayapradahastaṃ pralambitacaturbhujam || 31 || ghanaśyāmaṃ prasannāsyaṃ lakṣmīsevitapatkajam | natāḥ smaśca natā smaśca tuṣṭuvuśca punaḥ punaḥ || 32 || nārāyaṇo hariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prasannamanasā dvijān | uvāca paramaprītyā surān kumārakām̐stathā || 33 || yūyaṃ sarve tiṣṭhatātra cāspṛṣṭā mama māyayā | jñānino mokṣiṇaścaiva pāvanā vasatātra vai || 34|| iyaṃ vai gomatī gaṃgānītā bhavatkṛte mayā | sarveṣāṃ bhavatāṃ caiva tīrthānāṃ śraiṣṭhyamāsthitā || 35||| mokṣyarthibhiḥ kumāraiścāpyahamatra prasāditaḥ | tasmādidaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ gomatyākhyaṃ ca mokṣadam || 36|| anugrahāya bhavatāṃ mayā cakraṃ sudarśanam | darśitaṃ prathamaṃ viprā bhuvaṃ bhitvā jalaṃ tathā || 37|| bhitvā tejomayaṃ divyaṃ samāyātaṃ mamāgrataḥ | cakratīrthamiti khyātaṃ gomatyāṃ saṃbhaviṣyati || 38 || mamāpi niyataṃ vāso bhavatāmapi sarvathā | cakratīrthe sadāvāso bhaviṣyati hi śāśvataḥ || 39 || gomatyarṇavasaṃyoge ye snāsyanti janādayaḥ | cakratīrthe ca ye snātāsteṣāṃ muktiḥ kare sthitā ||1.219.40 || gomatyāṃ sāgare sarvatīrthāni pravasanti hi | sarve devāśca ṛṣayaḥ pravasanti hi saṃgame ||41|| sanakādibhirācamya snātvā pītvā jalaṃ tadā | hareścaraṇau prakṣālya dhṛtaṃ mūrdhni jalaṃ tadā |||42|| sarvadevaistathā caturdaśalokanivāsibhiḥ | gomatī pūjitā tatra pītaṃ puṇyaṃ jalaṃ tathā ||43|| mūrdhni dhṛtaṃ jalaṃ tasyāḥ pādau prakṣālitau hareḥ | gomatī cāpi kanyā ca bhūtvā dhṛtvā ghaṭe jalam ||44|| avanījya hareḥ pādau mūrdhnā jalamadhārayat | kṛtvārghaṃ śrīharaye ca datvā sā ca jalāṃjalim ||45|| vikīrya kusumānyatra praviṣṭā varuṇālaye | sanakādyā maharṣayo devāśca munayastathā ||46|| ye ye tatra ca tīrthāni pūryo’raṇyāni cāyayuḥ | te te tatra kṛtasthānāstīrtharūpaiḥ samasthitāḥ ||47|| evaṃ sā gomatī sarvatīrthamayī mahodayā | saṃjātā śrīhareryogāt pāvanī mokṣadā śubhā ||48|| hariśca paśyatāṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ vai tiro’bhavat | sarve devādayo natvā tāṃ diśaṃ svālayān yayuḥ ||49|| evaṃ sā gomatī lakṣmi saṃjātā sāgaraṃgamā | kṛṣṇayogātsarvapāpaharā gaṃgā saridvarā ||1.219.50|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gomatītīrthacakratīrthetihāsamāhātmyakathananāmaikonaviṃśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 219 ||
<1.220> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca gatvā ca gomatītīre praṇamya daṇḍavacca tām | hastapādau ca saṃśodhya jalena kuśahastakaḥ || 1 || akṣatām̐śca phalaṃ dadhan dadyādarghaṃ ca prāṅmukhaḥ | sarvapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ dadāmyarghaṃ ca gomati || 2 || trailokyavandite devi pāpaṃ me hara gomati | ityuccārya mṛdaṃ labdhvā viṣṇuṃ smṛtvā hyudīrayet || 3 || aśvakrānte rathakrānte viṣṇukrānte vasundhare | uddhṛtāsi varāheṇa kṛṣṇena śatabāhunā || 4 || mṛttike hara me pāpaṃ yanmayā pūrvasaṃcitam | tvayā hatena pāpena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 5 || ityevaṃ mṛttikāṃ dhṛtvā snānaṃ kuryānnadījale | kurukṣetre sūryagrahe yatpuṇyaṃ tacca labhyate || 6 || snānamātreṇa vidhinā gomatyāṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau | devān pitṝn manuṣyāṃśca tarpayedbhāvasaṃyutaḥ || 7 || gomatīnīradānena muktiṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ | viprānāhūya vedajñān pitṝṇāṃ śrāddhamācaret || 8 || dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ svarṇaṃ rajataṃ cāmbarādikam | suvarṇaśṛṃgasahitāṃ khurarājatabhūṣitām || 9 || ratnapucchāṃ dugdhayutāṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhāṃ savatsakām | dadyād dhenuṃ samabhyarcya vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 1.220.10 || saptadhānyāni dadyācca viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti | gomatī gorajaḥsnānaṃ godānaṃ gopicandanam || 1 1|| gopīśadarśanaṃ ceti gakārāḥ paṃca durlabhāḥ | gomatyāṃ śrāddhakaraṇāt pretā muktā bhavanti vai || 12|| nārakāḥ sthāvarāścaiva vāyavaḥ kīṭatāṃ gatāḥ | sarve te muktimāyānti gomatyāṃ śrāddhadānataḥ || 1 3||| hayamedhasya yajñasya prayāgāplavanasya ca | pratyahaṃ hutabhoktuśca phalaṃ tadgomatījalāt || 14|| viṣṇulokaṃ hi gacchanti pitarastrikulodbhavāḥ | anekajanmasāhasraṃ vāṅmanaḥkarmabhiḥ kṛtam || 15|| pāpaṃ pravilayaṃ yāti gomatīdarśanena vai | gomatyāṃ kārtike snātuḥ prasannaḥ śrīyuto hariḥ || 16|| sampūrṇe kārtike māse samprāpte budhavāsare | paṃcāmṛtena tīrthasya jalena snāpayeddharim || 17|| kasturīkesaramiśraśrīkhaṇḍaṃ ca vilepayet | puṣpahāraiḥ phalairdīpairdhūpaiśca pūjayeddharim || 18|| naivedyaṃ ruciraṃ dadyād viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti | gītavādyakathāstotranṛtyairjāgaraṇaṃ caret || 19|| kārtikānte gomatīsaṃgame’bdhau snānamācaret | ramāpatiṃ prapūjyaiva vrataṃ sampūrṇatāṃ vrajet ||1.220.20|| māghasnānaṃ ca gomatyāṃ kartuḥ śrīsaṃyuto hariḥ | prasanno bhavati tatra muktiṃ cāpi dadāti saḥ ||21|| tilā hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ modakā guḍamiśritāḥ | dakṣiṇāścāpi dātavyā brāhmaṇāya sarittaṭe ||22|| tilairājyena dhānyaiśca phalairhomopi sammataḥ | vratānte raktasadvastrakaṃcukoṣṇīṣamityapi |||23||| dadyādupānahau caiva miṣṭānnaṃ cāpi bhojanam | tailapakvaṃ ghṛtapakvaṃ viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti |||24|| sarvadānaphalaṃ tasya sarvatīrthaphalaṃ tathā | sarvānkāmānavāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ sanātanam || 25|| prāpnoti cātra gomatyāṃ māghasnānena vai janaḥ | māghaṃ samāpayenmāghyāṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgame ||26|| brāhmaṇānujñayā sarvaṃ nyūnaṃ sampūrṇatāṃ vrajet | brahmadevasvahartṝṇāṃ pāpaṃ snānādvinaśyati ||27|| mitradrohagurughātapāpaṃ naśyati sparśanāt | brahmarudrapadādūrdhvapadaṃ prāpnoti darśanāt || 28|| bhītābhayapradānena yatphalaṃ labhate janaḥ | tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti gomatīvārisaṃgamāt |||29|| kṛtakṛtyo bhavennīraṃ gomatyāḥ pātiyo janaḥ | gaṇḍūṣaṃ pibati yaśca ṛṇānmucyeta vai trayāt || 1.220.30 || gomatīsevino bhaktā vasanti kṛṣṇasannidhau | vanamālāścaturbhujā divyagandhānulepanāḥ || 31 || narā viṣṇusvarūpāśca nāryo lakṣmīsvarūpikāḥ | bhūtvā viṣṇupadaṃ yānti cāpunarbhavalakṣaṇam ||32|| kṛtvā ca gomatītīrthaṃ gacchedvai cakratīrthakam | cakrāṃkitāśca pāṣāṇā dṛśyante yatra sarvathā ||33 || gale dhṛtaśca pāṣāṇo dhārakaṃ tīrthakṛnnaram | goloke preṣayatyeṣaścakralāṃchanasadbalāt || 34|| yatrāsthi patitaṃ yasya sopi yāti parāṃ gatim | prayāgādadhikaṃ caitaccakratīrthaṃ vimuktidam || 35|| yatra cakrāṃkanaṃ labdhaṃ tatra ṣaṇmāsasaṃsthiteḥ | vidhūya sarvapāpāni naro yāti harergṛham ||36|| cakratīrthe jano gatvā prakṣālya pādahastakān | ācamya ca punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamed daṇḍavat tataḥ || 37|| gṛhītvā paṃcaratnāni patraṃ puṣpaṃ tathākṣatān | gandhaṃ phalaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca candanaṃ cārghamityapi |||38||| vilokya ca samudraṃ vai dadyāccakrāya viṣṇave | namo viṣṇusvarūpāya viṣṇucakrāya te namaḥ || 39|| gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ sarvakāmaprado bhava | agniyoniryajñadeho viṣṇubalaśca muktidaḥ ||1.220.40|| viṣṇucakradharo’bdhistvaṃ cakratīrthānvitaḥ sadā | snānaṃ karomi tīrthe’tra muktiṃ dehi rathāṃgadhṛk ||41 || mṛdaṃ śirasi dhṛtvā ca snātvā bhajan hariṃ tadā | santarpya devatāḥ pitṝn narān hariṃ ca pārṣadān ||42|| arghayitvā tathā kṛṣṇaṃ sahasrāśvayajeḥ phalam | snānamātreṇa labhyeta cakratīrthe vidhānataḥ ||43|| viśvedevāḥ svarṇadānād rūpyadānātu pitṛkāḥ | bhojanenāpi saṃtṛptā bhavanti cakratīrthake ||44|| dīnebhyaḥ kṛpaṇebhyaśca deyaṃ vastravibhūṣaṇam | rathadānaṃ mukhyamuktaṃ vāhopaskarasmṛddhayaḥ ||45|| aśvā vṛṣāḥ pradātavyā gantryaścāpi viśeṣataḥ | dakṣiṇā cāpi dātavyā prīṇanārthaṃ jagatpateḥ ||46|| pitarastrikule jātāḥ pretāḥ kīṭāśca nārakāḥ | sarve te muktimāyānti cakratīrthaprabhāvataḥ || 47|| śrāddhe gayāphalaṃ bodhyaṃ snāne yajvigatirmatā | tarpaṇe somaparvotthaṃ dāne sūryagrahādhikam ||48|| phalaṃ labhyeta cakrāṃkaṃ grāhyaṃ bāhvostu mānavaiḥ | manovākkarmabhirjanyaṃ pāpaṃ snānād vinaśyati ||49|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi cakratīrthamapi dhruvam | tīrthakṛto janāḥ śuddhā viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyuḥ ||1.220.50 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gomatītīrthacakratīrthavidhiphalādikathananāmā viṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 220 ||
<1.221> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca tato gacchenmahālakṣmi gomatyudadhisaṃgame | muktidvāraṃ tu tatproktaṃ kalikāle na saṃśayaḥ || 1 || gaṃgāsāgarasaṃyoge sindhusāgarasaṃgame | phalaṃ yat tallabhyate’tra gomatyudadhisaṃgame || 2 || pāpaṃ praṇaśyate snātvā hyarghyaṃ dadyādvidhānataḥ | kuśāṃśca karayordhṛtvā nārikelaphalaṃ tathā || 3 || arghaṃ dadyānnamaskṛtya śrīkṛṣṇaparamātmane | tīrtharāja namastubhyaṃ trāhi saṃsārasāgarāt || 4 || ratnākara gṛhāṇārghaṃ gomatyā saha te namaḥ | arghaṃ datvā śikhāṃ badhvā smṛtvā ca jalaśāyinam || 5 || kuryāt snānaṃ prāṅmukhaśca pitṝn saṃtarpayet tataḥ | pitṛśrāddhaṃ tathā kṛtvā dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ śubhām || 6 || suvarṇaṃ vāsasī dadyāt kañcukoṣṇīṣamityapi | mahādānāni dadyācca yadīcchet kṣemamātmanaḥ || 7 || lakṣmyāḥ saha hariḥ sākṣādviṣṇurme prīyatāmiti | uktvā dadyād vividhāni dānāni bhojanāni ca || 8 || tulāpuruṣadānaṃ ca kuryātsāgarasaṃgame | sapta dvīpanṛpo bhūtvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti mānavaḥ || 9 || tulayā tolayet svaṃ yaḥ suvarṇarajatādibhiḥ | vastrakuṃkumakarpūraśarkarāphalasadrasaiḥ || 1.221.10 || sotra bhogān sukhān bhuktvā mokṣaṃ yāti surārcitaḥ | svarṇadānaṃ vājapeyaṃ snānaṃ gomatīvāriṇī || 11 || kanyādānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ vidyādānaṃ vidhānataḥ | gomatyāḥ saṃgame kuryāt yāti brahmapadaṃ hi saḥ || 1 2||| svarṇadhenuṃ ghṛtadhenuṃ tiladhenuṃ pradāya vai | vastrādiśarkarādhenuṃ datvā yāti paraṃ padam || 1 3||| yugāditithimukhyāsu pañcakāsvaṣṭakāsu ca | vaidhṛtau ca vyatipāte gajacchāyāhvaye tathā || 14|| ṣaṣṭhyamaikādaśyaṣṭamīdvādaśīśrāddhasadvrate | snātvā nīranidhau tadvat gomatīcakratīrthayoḥ || 15|| gomatyudadhisaṃyoge snātvā brahmapadaṃ labhet | amāvāsyādine śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ gomatisaṃgame || 16|| pakṣaśrāddhakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ dinaikena labhejjanaḥ | śraddhāhīnaṃ mantrahīnaṃ pātrahīnamathāpi vā || 17|| dravyahīnaṃ kālahīnaṃ manaaikāgryavarjitam | paripūrṇamamāśrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāmudadhau bhavet || 18|| gomatī kamalā candrabhāgā tadodadhau vaset | gayāyāṃ piṇḍadānena prayāge cāsthipātanāt || 19|| amāyāṃ śrāddhadānena śāśvataṃ puṇyamāpyate | yadīcchet sarvatīrtheṣu snānaṃ vratadharaḥ pumān ||1.221.20||| snānaṃ kurvīta bhaktyā vai gomatyudadhisaṃgame | aputrā mṛtaputrā vā kākavandhyā sravatsutā ||21 || doṣaiḥ pramucyate nārī gomatyudadhisaṃgame | śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tathā pitṛtarpaṇaṃ jaladarśanam |||22|| vrataṃ snānaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ japo homaśca kīrtanam | śāśvatītṛptikṛtpuṇyaṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgame |||23 || mātṛpakṣāḥ pitṛpakṣā bhaginīpakṣakāstathā | putrīpakṣāḥ śvaśrūpakṣāstathā śvaśurapakṣakāḥ |||24|| pitṛsvasṛpakṣagāśca snuṣāpakṣāstathā janāḥ | sapatnīpakṣagāścāpi rakṣikāpakṣagā api ||25|| bhrātṛjāyāpakṣagāśca svasṛputryādipakṣagāḥ | pitṛbhrātṛsutāpatnīprabhatipakṣakā api |||26|| mitrabāndhavabhṛtyānāṃ ye’pi sambandhadhārakāḥ | janmāntaragatā ye ca nārakāḥ khanigarbhagāḥ ||27|| te sarve saṃsmṛtāḥ śrāddhe gomatyudadhisaṃgame | snāne dāne saṃsmṛtāśca tṛptiṃ yānti tu śāśvatīm |||28|| sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyante muktiṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ | śrāvaṇadvādaśīyoge samabhyarcya tu vāmanam ||29|| paramaṃ lokamāpnoti snātvā gomatisaṃgame | pītāmbaradharo bhūtvā divyābharagabhūṣitaḥ || 1.221.30|| caturbhujadharaścaiva vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ | sevyamānaḥ surastrībhirvimānakṛtavāhanaḥ ||3 1 || saṃstūyamānaḥ ṛṣibhiḥ śrīharerarcako janaḥ | gomatīsaṃgame pūto yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ||32| gomatīsāgare snātvā gacchet saptaprakuṇḍakān | sarvairārādhitaḥ kṛṣṇo harirāvirbabhūva ha || 33 || saha lakṣmyā hariṃ dṛṣṭvā sanakādyā maharṣayaḥ | saptamiṣṭajalagartān kṛtvā siṣicurindirām ||34|| tato lakṣmīhradā ete kalau te rukmiṇīhradāḥ | bhṛguṇā sevitāścaite bhagutīrthamiti smṛtam ||35|| tatra prakṣālya caraṇau tathācamya kuśām̐stataḥ | saṃgṛhya prāṅmukho bhūtvārghaṃ gṛhṇītvākṣatādibhiḥ || 36|| hastau ca mastakopari samunnīya phalādibhiḥ | arghaṃ dātavyamevātra hrade rukmiṇisaṃjñite ||37|| snānaṃ kuryāttato dhyātvā tīrthāni pitṛdevatāḥ | devamānavapitṝm̐śca santarpya haribhāvataḥ ||38|| viprānāhūya ca śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta ca bhaktitaḥ | dakṣiṇāṃ rajataṃ svarṇe phalaṃ miṣṭānnamambaram |||39|| bhojanaṃ cāpi dampatyordadyācca bhūṣaṇādikam | śāṭīṃ ca kaṃcukīṃ śreṣṭhāṃ ghargharīṃ karpaṭādikam ||1.221.40 || pitṛpaṃktīśca saṃpūjya nārīścānyāḥ kumārikāḥ | sampūjya dadyād dānāni rukmiṇī prīyatāmiti ||4 1 || vasate ca sadā lakṣmīstasya gehe na saṃśayaḥ | smṛddhiṃ sarvāṃ samāpnoti lakṣmīstasya prasīdati |||42|| saptasvapi hṛdeṣveva dānaṃ dadyāt pṛthak pṛthak | tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ vindellakṣmīloke sukhapradam ||43||| alakṣmīrnaśyati tasya lakṣmīryasya prasīdati | paśuputragṛhavāṭīkṣetrabhavanaśālayaḥ ||44|| bhavanti satataṃ śreṣṭhā lakṣmīryasya prasīdati | svarṇādivardhanaṃ tasya lakṣmīstuṣṭā tu yaṃ prati ||45|| sarvānkāmānavāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati | saptahradeṣu lakṣmyātmanārīṇāṃ bhojanaṃ varam ||46|| dānaṃ ca pūjanaṃ caiva sammānaṃ bhūṣaṇādikam | śṛṃgāraṃ vāhanaṃ yānaṃ dehopakaraṇādikam ||47|| pṛthak pṛthak pradadyādvai lakṣmīrme prīyatāmiti | vasatyeva sadā gehe lakṣmīstasya na saṃśayaḥ ||48|| hīnabhāgyo na ca bhavenna bhavetparayācakaḥ | agryo bhavati sarveṣu yaḥ snāti rukmiṇīhrade ||49|| punarāgamanaṃ na syād vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti mānavaḥ | sapatnīkaścaturbhujaḥ śāśvataṃ sukhamaśnute |||1.221.50|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gomatīsāgarasaṃgamatīrthalakṣmīsaptahradatīrthavidhānanirūpaṇanāmaikaviṃśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 221 ||
<1.222> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca tato gacchenmahattīrthaṃ kṛkalāsavimuktidam | nṛgatīrthamitikhyātaṃ nṛgo’bhūcca mahīpatiḥ || 1 || anekaśatasāhasrā bhūmipālāstu yadvaśe | sa nityaṃ gurubhaktaśca devapūjanatatparaḥ || 2 || mahādānāni sudadau nityaṃ nityaṃ sahasraśaḥ | viprebhyo gosahasraṃ ca pradadau nityameva saḥ || 3 || prakṣālya caraṇau bhaktyā dattvā kṣaumayugaṃ tathā | candanapuṣpaiḥ sampūjya prativiprāya gāṃ dadau || 4 || dadau ca dakṣiṇāṃ dravyaṃ gavārthe ca tṛṇāni vai | datvā tāmbūlamavadat viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti || 5 || dānāni dadatastasya yajñām̐śca kurvatastathā | bhogāṃśca bhuṃjatastasya bhajataḥ śrīhariṃ tathā || 6 || dharmeṇa pālayataḥ kṣmāṃ yayau kālaḥ sukhānvitaḥ | ekadā gautamaṃ vipraṃ sarvadā cāparigraham || 7 || samāhūya ca sampūjya tasmai sa gāṃ dadau nṛpaḥ | suvarṇaśṛṃgasahitāṃ raupyakhurādiśobhitām || 8 || gāṃ nītvā svagṛhaṃ yāto gautamastāṃ savatsikām | sutṛptāṃ śobhanāṃ gāṃ ca dāmabaddhāṃ jalāśayam || 9 || jalaṃ pāyayituṃ vipro gṛhītvā niryayau gṛhāt|| mārge coṣṭraṃ pradṛṣṭvā sā trastā cācchidya hastataḥ || 1.222.10 || dhāvitvā sā yayau dhenuḥ sumahadrājagodhanam | vicinvan gautamo gāṃ tāṃ na prāpat svagṛhaṃ yayau || 11 || dvitīye’hni punarviprānāhūya nṛgabhūpatiḥ | dadau dānāni vidhivadgodānāni bahūnyapi || 12|| sampūjya bhaktyā satkṛtya vastrālaṃkārabhojanaiḥ | vidhivadgāṃ dadau tāṃ ca sa nṛgaḥ somaśarmaṇe || 1 3|| gṛhītvā rājabhavanānniryayau so’pi gāṃ ca tām | gautamo’pi vicinvāno tāmeva ca dadarśa gām || 14|| saṃyāntīṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ somaśarmaṇaḥ samuvāca tam | mamemāṃ cāpahṛtvā tvaṃ dasyuvat kiṃ prayāsyasi || 15|| śrutvā dasyuṃ svamātmānaṃ vismito’bhūt sa somakaḥ | prāha taṃ rājato labdhvā dāne’dya nāsmi dasyukaḥ || 16|| mama svatvaṃ gavi cātra gāṃ nayāmi svamandiram | gautamaḥ prāha nṛpato hyo mayā prāpitā nviyam || 17|| dāne mamaiva gavyatra svatvaṃ bhavati te nahi | kathaṃ nayasi soma tvaṃ mayi jīvati gautame || 18|| vivadantau tathā viprau rājadvāramupāgatau | kurvāṇau kalahaṃ ghoraṃ dvāḥsthau praṇayapūrvakau || 19|| nṛgā dvāri dvijau dṛṣṭvā natvā pupūja tau punaḥ| prārthayāmāsa kalahaṃ śāmayituṃ nṛpottamaḥ ||1.222.20 || ekasyā goḥ prati dravyaṃ lakṣaṃ suvarṇamudrikāḥ | sahasraṃ ca gavāṃ cāpi dadāmi pratibhūdhanam ||2 1|| eko gāṃ pratigṛhṇātu caināṃ dattā mayā dvijau | anyo gavāṃ sahasraṃ ca sahasrasvarṇamudrikāḥ |||2 2|| gautamaśca tathā somaḥ prāhaturvai pragarvataḥ | haṭhāveśāccocaturgāṃ gṛhṇāvo na sahasrakam || 13|| gautamaḥ prāha gāmenāṃ gṛhṇāmyeva hi māmakīm | somaḥ prāha ca gāmenāṃ gṛhṇāmyeva ca madvaśām ||24|| na gṛhṇāmi sahasraṃ tu gavāṃ svarṇasahasrakam | naiva prayojanaṃ dravye sahasre’pi tu madgavi |||25|| rājñā bahuprārthitau bodhitau ca pūjitāvapi | kopavyākulacetaskau trirātraṃ samupoṣitau ||26 || avajñātau nṛpeṇātha kupātre mūrkhabhūsurau | gacchataṃ svagṛhaṃ viprau mūrkhau stho bhānavarjitau || 27|| prāpte viṣamasamaye mārgaṃ kuryāt sa vai budhaḥ | ekena bhāvya namreṇa cānyena ruṣatā yadā ||28|| mānaṃ tyājyaṃ haṭhastyājyo yatra nānyā gatistadā | tattu na kriyate viprau kiṃ karomi samānake ||29|| ekasmin vastuni tvatra kliṣṭāvubhau bhaviṣyathaḥ | tasmād gaccha tamatyugrau yatheṣṭaṃ kurutaṃ dvijau || 1.222.30 || evamuktau tadā viprau rājānaṃ prati krodhataḥ | ūcatuḥ kupitau vākyaṃ samarthau nṛpatiṃ prati ||3 1|| avamānayase tvasmānna nyāyaṃ ca dadāsi yat | bhaviṣyati bhavānasmāt kṛkalāso na saṃśayaḥ || 3 2|| evaṃ śaptvā tadā viprau parityajya ca gāmubhau | duḥkhitau svagṛhaṃ gantumudyatau ca tadā nṛpaḥ || 33|| nṛgo dvāraṃ samāgatya daṇḍavatpraṇipatya ca | cakre ca prārthanāṃ yūyamamoghavacanā dvijāḥ || 34|| mamopari kṛpāṃ kṛtvā śāpāntaṃ diśatāśu yat | somaśarmā tadā prāha dvāparānte hariḥ svayam || 15 || dvārakāyāṃ samāgatya tava muktiṃ kariṣyati | vāsudevaḥ sa vai kṛṣṇastvāṃ golokaṃ ca neṣyati || 36 || ityuktvā tau tadā viprau jagmatuḥ svaniketanam | rājā nṛgo’pi tacchāpātkāladharmamupeyivān || 37|| dharmarājagṛhaṃ prāptaḥ pṛṣṭhaśca bhogyakarmaṇi | prathamaṃ bhokṣyase puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ vā brūhi satvaram || 38 || puṇyaṃ cānantakaṃ te’sti pāpaṃ govaiparītyajam | śrutvā nṛgaḥ samuvāca bhokṣyaṃ svalpaṃ hi duṣkṛtam || 3 9|| yamasyānumatenāya kṛkalāso’bhavanmahān | so’yaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi kūpataḍāgasaṃsthitaḥ ||1.222.40 || jātismaro’bhavad bhuṃkte’nnakaṇādīn vanauṣadhīn | ekadā yadubālairākṛṣyamāṇa itastataḥ ||4 1 || reme taiḥ svamokṣakālaṃ manyamāno hariṃ smaran | kintu guruśarīraḥ sa śramayukto’bhavad yadā ||42|| pṛthvyāṃ mūrchāṃ gato bhūtvā papāta na cacāla vai | sthūlāt sthūlatamaṃ dehaṃ kṛtvā yogena saṃsthitaḥ || 43 || bahubhirbālakaiḥ kṛṣyamāṇopi na cacāla saḥ | atīva sthaulyamāpanno vardhate ca kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ||44|| bālā dṛṣṭvā cakitāśca bhayayuktāśca kecana | kṛṣṇaṃ nivedayāmāsuḥ kṛṣṇo’pyavetya taṃ mṛgam ||45 || samāgatya ca hastena pasparśa taṃ nṛgaṃ tadā | śāpabandhād vinirmukto divyo rājā nṛgo’bhavat ||46 || devatulyaśarīraḥ saḥ tadā bhaktyā kṛtāṃjaliḥ | tuṣṭāva parameśānaṃ mokṣadaṃ kṛṣṇamuttamam ||47|| bhagavan karma sampūrṇaṃ bhuktaṃ nānyacca vidyate | śubhaṃ te śaraṇe nyastaṃ mokṣaṃ kuru mamācyuta ||48 || tadā kṛṣṇaśca taṃ prāha mama yogācca pārthiva | yāhi puṇyakṛtān lokān bhuktvā bhogānanuttamān ||49 || prāpnoṣyante mama dhāma cāpunarbhavalakṣaṇam | uvāca ca nṛgaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ yadi tuṣṭo’si me hare |1.222.5 0 || garto’yaṃ mama nāmnā ca tīrthaṃ bhavatu puṇyadam | atra snātvā tarpaṇaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ yaḥ kariṣyati ||51 || tvatprasādena pitaro gacchantu tava dhāma te | atra yātrāṃ ca ye kuryuste syurvai mokṣabhāginaḥ ||5 2 || tathāstviti nṛpaṃ tūktvā tataḥ kṛṣṇastvapāsarat | rājā divyavimānena yayau yajñakṛtāṃ gṛham ||53 || vaikuṇṭhaṃ dvitīyaṃ yadvai vairājapadamucyate | tadārabhya nṛgakūpastīrthottamamabhūdbhuvi ||54|| arghaṃ nṛgāya kṛṣṇāya dadyāt snāyājjalaṃ pibet | santarpayet pitṝn devān manuṣyān śrāddhamācaret ||55 || dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ svarṇāṃ dānāni vividhāni ca | akṣayyaṃ phalamāpnoti cānte vai paramāṃ gatim ||56 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nṛgarājño godānavyatyāse kṛkalāsajanma śrīkṛṣnākṛtamuktatā nṛgakūpatīrthaṃ ceti nirūpaṇanāmā dvātriṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 222 ||
<1.223> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca tato gacchenmahālakṣmi tīrthaṃ viṣṇupadodbhavam | yatra gaṃgā samutpannā viṣṇupādāśrayā ca yā || 1 || ekadā khalu durvāsā yātrārthaṃ samupāgataḥ | tacchrutvā sahasotthāya bhagavān ramayā yutaḥ || 2 || yayau cātithyavidhyarthaṃ durvāsasaṃ prati prabhuḥ | gṛhiṇī na gṛhe yasya satpātragamanaṃ ca na || 3 || tasya devā na gṛhṇanti pitaraścodakaṃ tathā | iti kṛtvā yayatustau śrīśca kṛṣṇaśca harṣitau || 4 || rathamāruhya śrīkṛṣṇo rukmiṇyā sahito yayau | samudrasya taṭe śrāntaṃ snātaṃ jvalanamojasā || 5 || praṇamya bhagavān bhaktyā papracchānāmayaṃ tathā | muniruvāca kuśalaṃ kva vāsaḥ kṛṣṇa te’dhunā || 6 || kati dārā dhanānyeva kaccitte kuśalaṃ sadā | kṛṣṇa prāha bhavadāśīrvādairvai kuśalaṃ mama || 7 || darśanācca viśeṣeṇa pāvitaṃ me kulaṃ tvayā | samudreṇa pradattā me bhūmistu daśayojanā || 8 || daśayojane bhūbhāge purī hemamayī mayā | kāritā tatra prāsādā navalakṣāṇi kāritāḥ || 9 || tasyāṃ vasāmi saṃhṛṣṭo nirbhayaste prasādataḥ | durvāsāḥ prāha śrutvā tat saṃkhyāṃ vadasva me tava || 1.223.10 yāvatyaśca mahiṣyo vai putrāḥ parijanāstathā | śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prāha bhagavan kṛpayā te mama gṛhe || 11 santi ṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ bhāryāścāṣṭādhikaṃ śatam | ekaikasyāṃ daśa putrāḥ kanyā caikā prajā mama || 12| ṣaṭ paṃcāśat jñātayo me santi parijanāstathā | iyaṃ mukhyā mama patnī rukmiṇī yā ramā smṛtā || 13| bhavān muniprapūjyo’sti samāgacchatu me gṛham | śirasādhāya pādāstu tato yāmi pavitratām || 14| durvāsāḥ prāha bho kṛṣṇa sadākṣamo bhavāmyaham | kṣaṇe ruṣṭo bhavāmyeva kiṃ māṃ nayasi keśava || 15| naya māṃ yadi madvākyaṃ karoṣi sahabhāryayā | yadi māṃ netukāmo’si sabhāryastvaṃ rathaṃ vaha || 16|| śrutvā kṛṣṇaḥ prasanno’bhūt rukmiṇyā sahitastadā | rathadhuryo’bhavacchīghraṃ pāvitohamiti bruvan || 17|| tadā ca ṛṣivaryaḥ saṃyujya kṛṣṇaṃ ca rukmiṇīm | rathe sthitvāgṛhya rajjuṃ yāhi yāhītyabhāṣata || 18|| devaiśca kusumaiḥ kṛṣṇa pūjyamāno jagāma ha | vāhyamāne rathe tābhyāṃ rukmiṇī tṛṣitābhavat || 19|| prāha kāntaṃ jalaṃ dehi tṛṣā māṃ bādhate’dhunā | tacchrutvā pṛthivī kṛṣṇastatāḍa pādalattayā ||1.223.20|| bhūmirbhinnā tato gaṃgā nirgatā śītalā tadā | sugandhasalilā śvetā jalarūpā babhau śubhā ||21|| apṛṣṭvā ca muniṃ payau rukmiṇī jāhnavī jalam | dṛṣṭvā ṛṣiścukopāśu śaśāpa parameśvarīm ||22|| māmapṛṣṭvā pītavatī jalaṃ tasmācca tatphalam | kṛṣṇaviyogarūpaṃ tvaṃ prāpnuhīti bruvan rathāt ||23|| samuttīryātiraktākṣo bhūmāvevādhyatiṣṭhata | śrīkṛṣṇastaṃ vinayena tuṣṭāva ramayāyutaḥ ||24|| ṛṣivarya yathārthaṃ te vākyaṃ bhavatu sarvathā | rukmiṇī madviyuktāstu vane’tra jalarūpiṇī ||25|| gaṃgayā saha nityaṃ vai gaṃgārūpeṇa tiṣṭhatu | yatra jalaṃ vinirbhidya bhūmiṃ prakaṭatāṃ gatam ||26|| tajjalaṃ rukmiṇī rūpaṃ tīrthaṃ samastu śāśvatam | atraiva rukmiṇīvāso mandire’stu sadā vane ||27|| mokṣaścāpi tairthikānāṃ cāstu ramāprasādanāt | durvāsāśca tadā prāha kṛṣṇa prātarniśāmukhe ||28|| rukmiṇyāstava yogo’stu nityaṃ karomyanugraham | ityuktvā prayayau tasmātsthalānmunistadātrijaḥ || 29|| rukmiṇī saṃsthitā tatrodyānaprāsādapuṃgave | jalarūpā dvitīyena rūpeṇāpi pratiṣṭhitā ||1.223.3 0|| tīrthaṃ tajjalarūpaṃ vai viṣṇupādodakaṃ smṛtam | mukhyarūpeṇa mahiṣī sadā kṛṣṇasya sevane || 31 || sadā tiṣṭhatu prāsāde ityapyanugrahaṃ vyadhāt | durvāsā varadānaṃ tadgatvā pūjāmavāpya ca || 32|| yayau kailāsamevāsmātsthānāt kṛṣṇo gṛhaṃ yayau | rukmiṇī ca trirūpābhūt kṛṣṇāpādodake jalam || 33 || tatrodyānasthasaudhe sā mūrtirūpā dvitīyakā | tṛtīyā ca mahārājñī śrīkṛṣṇe nityayoginī || 34|| ityevaṃ rukmiṇītīrthaṃ kṛṣṇapādodakaṃ hi tat | gaṃgārūpaṃ samajani snāturmokṣapradaṃ śubham || 35|| śrāddhakartuśca pitṝṇāmakṣayyapuṇyadaṃ tathā | akṣayyatṛptidaṃ cāpi tathā golokadhāmadam || 36|| dānaṃ homaṃ japaṃ dhyānaṃ pūjāṃ cārghaṃ karoti yaḥ | tatsarvamakṣayapuṇyapradaṃ bhavati tatsthale || 37|| yatra sākṣācchriyā yuktaḥ kṛṣṇo vasati sarvadā | tatra kiṃ vai bhavennyūnaṃ golokāttīrthavāsinām || 38 || tīrthakṛto’pi na nyūnaṃ golokātprāpyate phalam | bhojanaṃ vividhaṃ dadyād dakṣiṇāṃ svarṇarājatīm ||39|| dīnāndhakṛpaṇebhyaśca dānaṃ deyaṃ vidhānataḥ | upānahau pradātavye jalakuṃbhaḥ savastrakaḥ || 1.223.40 || dadhyodanaṃ pradātavyaṃ dhānyāni vividhāni ca | raktavastraṃ tathā śāṭī kaṃcukī ghargharī tathā ||4 1 || rukmiṇyai saṃpradātavyā bhūṣāḥ śṛṃgārakāṇi ca | pūjayed viprayugalaṃ viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti ||42|| evaṃ tīrthe kṛte tatra pitarastrikulodbhavāḥ | tṛptā yānti harerlokaṃ prasannaḥ śrīyuto hariḥ ||43 || iha kāmān sadā bhuktvā bhuktvā svargādivaibhavān | ante yānti harerdhāma rukmiṇītīrthapāvanāḥ ||44|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne durvāsorathavahanakarmaṇi vyāpṛtāyāḥ rukmiṇyāstṛṣānivṛttyarthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇaghātaniḥsṛta gaṃgājalākhyarukmiṇītīrtha rukmiṇītrisvarūpatā ceti nirūpaṇanāmā trayoviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 223 ||
<1.224> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca tato gacchenmahādivyaṃ gopītaḍāgatīrthakam | yatra kṛṣṇena gopīnāṃ prathamaṃ melanaṃ hyabhūt || 1 || śrāyaṇe tatra dānena snānena japanena ca | muktiṃ vai mānavo yāti śrāddhena bhajanena ca || 2 || śrīkṛṣṇo dvārikāsaṃsthaścoddhavaṃ bhaktapuṃgavam | gokulaṃ preṣayāmāsa gopīnāṃ suhṛdāṃ tathā || 3 || gopānāṃ ca priyaṃ kartuṃ vaktuṃ ca kuśalaṃ svakam | āgataṃ coddhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā sotkaṇṭhā gokulāgṛhāḥ || 4 || uddhavaṃ pūjayāmāsurvastrālaṃkārabhojanaiḥ | bhuktavantaṃ ca viśrāntaṃ yaśodā sutavatsalā || 5 || papracchānāmayaṃ nandaḥ papraccha kuśalaṃ hareḥ | kaścidāste sukhaṃ kṛṣṇo rāmaśca sukhamedhate || 6 || kaścitsmarati śrīkṛṣṇaścātratyān svapriyān janān | kaccideṣyati śrīkṛṣṇastārayiṣyati no’sukhāt || 7 || kaccit kṛṣṇakuṭumbaṃ ca susukhyāste tathoddhava | iti pṛṣṭvā snehabāṣpapūrṇākṣau saṃbabhūvatuḥ || 8 || uddhavastau tathā tām̐śca gokulasthān janām̐stadā | madhuraiḥ kṛṣṇasandeśaiḥ snehaplutairajījanat || 9 || namaskurvanti pitṛbhyāṃ kṛṣṇo rāmo vadhūjanaḥ | anāmayaṃ ca pṛcchanti tiṣṭhanti kṣemataśca te || 1.224.1 0|| sameṣyati drutaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ saha rāmeṇa gokulam | vidhāsyati sukhaṃ sarvaṃ kariṣyati ca vo hitam || 1 1|| iti śrīkṛṣṇasandeśaiḥ samāśvāsyoddhavaśca tān | sukhaṃ suṣvāpa caikānte śramanāśāya vai saḥ || 12|| tāvad gopyo rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā muhuḥ sūryasamojjvalam kasyāyaṃ kaścāgato’tra vismitāścāyayustadā || 13|| parasparaṃ samāgatya sarvāstā vrajayoṣitaḥ | vivikte kṛṣṇasandeśaṃ prapracchuḥ śokakarṣitāḥ || 14|| kṛṣṇaḥ kaccit sukhamāste kathaṃ nātra samāgataḥ | asmatprāṇānparigṛhya gataḥ kathaṃ na cāgataḥ || 15|| iti smṛtvā tadā gopyo ruruduḥ śokamohitāḥ | īkṣamāṇāḥ kṛṣṇadāsaṃ kṛṣṇasnehavaśīkṛtāḥ || 16|| āśvāsayāmāsa tāścoddhavo vākyaiḥ sukhāvahaiḥ | kṛṣṇo’pi ca divārātraṃ yuṣmānsmṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ || 17|| kandarpapīḍito duḥkhī bhavate cintayan hi vaḥ | tāvad gopyo’bhavan vyagrāḥ prāhurvākyāni naikadhā || 18|| nirdayo’smān parigṛhya paścācca parityajya saḥ | gato punarna cāyāti pūtanāghnasya kā priyā || 19|| gamyate yatra tatraiva nūtanā prāpyate priyā | nāgarastrīsaṃvṛtasya nāstyasmābhiḥ prayojanam ||1.224.20|| kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ kathaṃ miliṣyati prabhuḥ | vilapantya iti vākyaiḥ smarantyo rurudurharim || 21 || bhaktimekāntikīṃ tāsāṃ dṛṣṭvovāca tadoddhavaḥ | sarvāsāṃ saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ yauvanaṃ dhanam |||22 || yāsāṃ bhavati śrīkṛṣṇe bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī | tāśca prāhurnayāsmām̐stvaṃ yatrāste prāṇavallabhaḥ || 23 || tāsāṃ bhāvaṃ dṛḍhaṃ jñātvoddhavaśca bāḍhamāha tāḥ | uddhavena samaṃ sarvā jagmuḥ kṛṣṇekṣaṇecchayā || 24||| gāyantyaḥ kṛṣṇagītāni yayustā dvārakāṃ prati | adhvaśramo na vai spṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇamānasayogataḥ || 25|| samprāptā mayakhanitataḍāgasya taṭe tu tāḥ | uddhavaḥ praṇipatyāha tiṣṭhantu cātra gopikāḥ || 26 || nivedayituṃ gacchāmi kṛṣṇo hitaṃ vidhāsyati | uktvaivaṃ ca yayau kṛṣṇaṃ pratyuddhavo jagāda ca || 27|| sarastaṭe sthitā gopyo yathecchasi tathā kuru | kṛṣṇaḥ śīghraṃ taḍāgaṃ vai narayānena saṃyayau || 28 || āyāntaṃ prāṇarūpaṃ taṃ bhrājamānaṃ vibhūṣitam | jvalatkirīṭamukuṭahāramakarakuṇḍalam || 29 || śrīvatsāṃkaṃ mahābāhuṃ pītāmbarasuvāsasam | sātapatrasucāmarasvarṇayaṣṭisunaktakam || 1.224.30 || dṛṣṭvā kāntaṃ ca tāḥ pariṣasvajire samantataḥ | haste pṛṣṭhe stane gaṇḍe kaṇṭhe mūrdhni kapolake || 31 || mukhe netre cibukeṃ’se urasyurau ca pārśvayoḥ | kaṭyāṃ sakthni pade cāgre vastre dhautre tathodare || 32|| spṛṣṭvāśliṣya muhuḥ kṛṣṇa cucumbaḥ premavihvalāḥ | priyaṃ priyāściraṃ dṛṣṭvā mumuhuḥ rurudurbhṛśam || 33 || hā nātha kānta hā svāmin hā vrajeśa manohara | sarvāstvayā parityaktāḥ kathaṃ ruṣṭo’si śuṣkahṛt || 34|| pitṛmātṛparityāgin bhaktatyāgin janārdana | parityaktā vayaṃ kṛṣṇa punarnāvekṣitāstvayā || 35|| kathaṃ sahyo virahaste kathaṃ neṣyāma ārtihan | divasānnāthavidhurān yathecchasi tathā kuru || 36|| bhāvajño bhagavām̐stāsāṃ śrutvā tā anvaśikṣata | bhavatīnāṃ viyogo me kadācidapi nāsti vai || 37|| ahaṃ sarvāntarātmāsmi bhavatīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ | patirūpeṇa me yogo vittha bhavati sarvadā || 38|| kāmaḥ sukhaṃ sadānando mattaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate | etajjñātvā mahāsādhvyo mā kurudhvaṃ vṛthā śucam ||3 9|| iti kṛṣṇavacaḥ śrutvā samāśliṣya muhurmuhuḥ | dīrghavirahajaṃ tāpaṃ tatyajuścātinirvṛtāḥ ||1.224.40|| adya naḥ saphalaṃ janma tvadya naḥ saphalā dṛśaḥ | paśyāmastvāṃ hare kṛṣṇa prāhuśceti ca tā muhuḥ ||41|| kṛṣṇaḥ prāha ca tāḥ sarvāstaḍāgaṃ cātra kāraye | gopītaḍāganāmnā vai prasiddhiṃ yāsyati dhruvam ||42||| yatra maddarśanaṃ jātaṃ pūrṇakāmāḥ kṛtā mayā | mayā sahaiva snānaṃ ca kurvantvadya hi gopikāḥ ||43|| iti kṛtvā hariḥ snāto gopikābhiḥ samaṃ tadā | bhojitā gopikāstatra miṣṭānnaiḥ piṇḍakādibhiḥ ||44|| vihṛtyaivaṃ jale kṛṣṇo nityaṃ cāyāti mandiram | sarvāśca sma sukhayati kāmena sukhado hariḥ || 45|| śrāvaṇasya site pakṣe snātvā sarasi vai pitṝn | tarpayiṣyati dvādaśyāṃ teṣāṃ tṛptistu śāśvatī ||46|| dānaṃ dadyāttathā pitṝnuddiśya māṃ vicintya yaḥ | labhate vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha śāśvatam ||47|| arghaṃ deyaṃ tathā kāryaṃ śrāddhaṃ deyā ca dakṣiṇā | pāyasānnaṃ ghṛtaṃ bhojanīyaṃ saśarkaraṃ śubham ||48|| vastraṃ chatraṃ kambalaṃ ca śāṭī kaṃcukī ghargharī | dāne deyāstaḍāge’tra smṛtvā māṃ bhavatīstathā ||49|| putrapautrasamāyuktā dhanadhānyasamanvitāḥ | bhuktvā bhogānbahūnatrānte prāpsyantyakṣaraṃ padam ||1.224.50|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne uddhavena saha gokulagopīnāṃ kṛṣṇena saha gopītaḍāke samāgamena tīrthamāhātmyakathananāmā caturviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 224 ||
<1.225> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca sannidhau mayasarasaḥ sarastvanyaccakāra saḥ | tacca gopīsaraḥkhyātaṃ mahattīrthaṃ hi padmaje || 1 || sevitaṃ yadunārībhistathā yadukumārakaiḥ | kāraṇād gopikānāṃ ca kṛṣṇena kāritaṃ śubham || 2 || govacaḥvācako śabdo bhavatībhirmayā saha | gopracāreti vai nāma gopīsaraitipratham || 3 || gopītaḍāgaityevaṃ khyātaṃ loke bhaviṣyati | arghaṃ datvā vidhānena snānaṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ || 4 || gāṃ pradadyāt savatsāṃ ca vastrālaṃkārabhūṣitām | yathoktadakṣiṇopetāṃ brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine || 5 || pṛthvīdānaphalaṃ cātra godānena hi labhyate | snānamātreṇa godānaphalaṃ vai labhate janaḥ || 6 || yāvatpadāni manujo gacchati gopikāsaraḥ | kulāni divi tāvanti modante harimandiram || 7 || kṛṣṇakīrtanakartāro ye gacchanti sarovaram | na māturjaṭhare teṣāṃ punarvāso bhavediha || 8 || gopīsarastīratīrthaṃ yaḥ karoti janaḥ sa tu | sarvānkāmānavāpnoti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 9 || śrāddhaṃ kuryāttathā pitṝn tarpayedvai viśeṣataḥ | tāmbūlaṃ kajjalaṃ svarṇaṃ dāne dadyācca vastrakam || 1.225.10 || dampatyorvāsasī dadyād bhūṣaṇāni dhanāni ca | kanyābhyo bhojanaṃ dadyād vastrabhūṣādhanādikam || 11 || gopyastena prasannāḥ syu saubhāgyasmṛddhidāḥ sadā | gāvo deyāśca vṛṣabhā gajāścāśvāśca kanyakāḥ || 12|| yadyat kāmayate lokastattad dadyānmiletpunaḥ | yāvallokā bhaviṣyanti tāvat sthāsyati vai saraḥ || 13 || gopyaśca patibhāvena brahmabhāvena vā punaḥ | cintayānāḥ paraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vasānā dvārikāpure || 14|| sevayamānā nityaṃ tāḥ kṛtārthā hyabhavaṃstataḥ | kṛṣṇājñayā namaskṛtya kṛṣṇaṃ saṃsevya tṛptitaḥ || 15|| uddhavena saha yātā gokulaṃ svagṛhaṃ śubham | kṛṣṇena gopikānāṃ tattīrthaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhuvi kṛtam || 1 6|| gopīsarorajo divyaṃ divyā dhūlī ca piṃgalā | divyaṃ jalaṃ tathā divyā vṛkṣavallyastaṭasthitāḥ || 17|| divyā vasatayastasya paśupakṣyādicetanāḥ | divyā golokadhāmnaste hyadhikāriṇa eva vai || 18|| gopīcandanaliptāṃgo gopīdhūlyūrdhvapuṇḍrakaḥ | gopīmṛtkaṇikāsyaśca mukto bhavati mānavaḥ || 19 || gopīcandanabinduyuklalāṭaṃ yasya dṛśyate | dṛṣṭvā taṃ yamadūtāśca dūraṃ yānti hi padmaje || 1.225.20 || gopīcandanatilakaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ devatāḥ sadā | paśyanti nityadā prātarlayaṃ pāpāni yānti ca || 21 || gopīcandanabindurvai kaṇṭhe vātha lalāṭake | bhujayorvā kṛto yena muktistasya na saṃśayaḥ || 22|| gopīdhūlīkṛtacandrā nārī yā sadhavāthavā | vidhavā vātha kanyā ca kumārī vidhurāthavā ||23|| gaṇikā kiṃkarī dāsī śaraṇāptā ca sāśritā | nirāśritāthavā vyagrā vicittā bahugāminī || 24|| smṛddhā raṃkā ca viduṣī mūrkhā ca kūṭinī tathā | yādṛśī tādṛśī caurā kāmukī vāsanāvatī || 25|| sadyaḥ śuddhyati pāpebhyo yujyate puṇyakoṭibhiḥ | divyā bhavati gopīvat vrajet kṛṣṇāṃkayogyatām ||26 || svarge bhogānakṣayām̐śca bhuktvā koṭiyugāni sā | devaiśca vanditā yāyādante golokadhāma sā || 27|| tatra rādhāsamā gopī bhūtvā kṛṣṇena modate | gopīsarovare yacca kīṭapataṃgamakṣikam || 28 || paśupakṣisarīsṛpapipīlikāmṛgādikam | mṛtiṃ yāsyati tatsarvaṃ golokaṃ yāsyati dhruvam || 29 || kṛṣṇamṛttikayā snāto gopīmṛttikayāplutaḥ | premasarovare magno golokādhikṛto’sti saḥ || 1.225.30 || na yajñairna ca dānairna japaiḥ svādhyāyatāpanaiḥ | prāpyate tādṛśaṃ sthānaṃ gopīdhūlyāpyate yathā || 31 || gomatī gopikātālo gopālakṛṣṇa eva ca | gopīdhūlī gavāṃ dānaṃ gakārāḥ pañca mokṣadāḥ || 32 || gakarāḥ pañca yaiḥ prāptāḥ prāptaṃ sarvaṃ ca tena vai | prāptaḥ kṛṣṇo hariryena kiṃ tasyātrāvaśiṣyate || 33 || maraṇe yasya kasyāpi mukhe ca kaṇikā patet | gopīdhūlyāstataḥ sopi muktiṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ || 34 || gomatyāḥ gopikātālasyāgre vā sannidhau mṛteḥ | golokaṃ dhāma tasyārthe niścitaṃ viṣṇupārṣadaiḥ || 35 || ākāśamārgato yātā pakṣiṇo’pi divaṃ gatāḥ | bhavanti gopikātāloparitaḥ kimutāplave || 36 || haraye na ca naivedyaṃ dhṛtaṃ vā jalamityapi | gopīcandanamiśraṃ cet prasādastadbhavetkhalu || 37||| deśakālādivaiṣamye hareḥ prāsādikaṃ yadi | milennaiva tadā bhojye peye vā kaṇikāṃ kṣipet || 38 || tato bhuñjyācca vai peyāt prasādastaddhi jāyate | nāniveditabhojyasya pratyavāyo bhavet khalu || 3 9|| bhūtapretapiśācānāmāveśaduḥkhavān janaḥ | kaṇṭhe vai dhārayed gopīcandanagūṭikāṃ śubhām ||1.225.40 || bhakṣayed gopikāsa rorajaḥ snāyācca tajjale | candrakaṃ bhālamadhye ca kuryānnityaṃ samāhitaḥ ||4 1 || evaṃkṛte piśācādyāveśo naśyati vai dhruvam | svastho bhavati puṇyātmā pūto bhavati sarvathā ||42 || daridrasyāpi bhāgyaṃ vai vardhate smṛddhisa mpradam | roganāśo bhavet duḥkhanāśaścāpi bhavettathā |||43|| kṛṣṇasya divyamūrteśca sambandhāddivyatāṃ gatāḥ | mṛttikāśca tathā hyāptā nirguṇā muktidā matāḥ ||44|| kṛṣṇayogāt kṛṣṇarūpā gāvo gomatīgopikāḥ | svaprasaṃgāgatān jantūnnayanti nirguṇātmatām ||45|| kṛṣṇasambandhasambaddhā nirguṇā jaḍacetanāḥ | mokṣayanti tathā cānyān kṛṣṇavat kṛṣṇamānasāḥ ||46 || kāmo lobhastathā krodho māno mohaśca ma tsaraḥ | doṣatvaṃ svaṃ parihāya guṇatvaṃ yānti kṛṣṇake ||47|| nāryo narāśca paśavo’surāḥ śastrāṇi vāhanam | vastraṃ bhojyaṃ tathā peyaṃ sarvaṃ nirguṇatāṃ vrajet ||48|| māyāpi nirguṇā divyā yatsambandhād bhavatyapi | kimvanyat tatra vaktavyaṃ nirguṇakṛṣṇasaṃgatam ||49|| dhanyaṃ vai gopajātīyaṃ dhanyaṃ gojātikaṃ tathā | dhanyaṃ golokajātīyaṃ yatkṛṣṇānandasaṃbhṛtam ||1.225.50|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gopīcandanamahimakathananāmā paṃcaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 225 ||
<1.226> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca tato gacched brahmakuṇḍaṃ tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam | kṛṣṇasya darśanārthaṃ vai daivataiḥ parivāritaḥ || 1 || brahmājagāma ca puryāṃ dvāravatyāṃ samutsave | pāśīndrayamavitteśāḥ sūryācandramasau tathā || 2 || anye ca dikprapālādyā darśanārthaṃ samāgatāḥ | tadā ca brahmaṇā yatra samājaḥ parikalpitaḥ || 3 || tatsthale vai mahattīrthaṃ brahmakuṇḍaṃ ca tattaṭe | brahmaṇā sthāpitaḥ sūryaḥ sarvadā yaśca tiṣṭhati || 4 || sūryatīrthaṃ ca tatproktaṃ sarvapāpavināśakam | brahmatīrthaṃ sūryatīrthaṃ dṛṣṭvā cakre saraḥ śaśī || 5 || taḍāgaṃ candranāmnā tatprasiddhaṃ samajāyata | sūryasthānaṃ mūlasthānaṃ śrāddhapuṇyasahasradam || 6 || pitṛtṛptikaraṃ ramyaṃ koṭipātakasaṃharam | māghe śukle tu saptamyāṃ snātvā liptvā sthalaṃ raveḥ || 7 || pūjayiṣyati sūryaṃ yo puṣpadhūpanivedanaiḥ | jalapatraphaladravyadakṣiṇābhiśca mānavaḥ || 8 || sarvān kāmānatra bhuktvā brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyati | tataśca brahmaṇā sūryamandirasya ca sannidhau || 9 || sāvitryā mandiraṃ kārayitvā sūryarathe ca tām | sthāpayitvāyatane tāṃ sāvitrīṃ nāmataḥ svayam || 1.226.1 0|| padmajaḥ pūjayāmāsa mūrtau devyā vidhānataḥ | candrasarastathā sāvitryāśca sanmandiraṃ sthalam || 1 1|| tīrthottamaṃ kṛtaṃ tena vedhasā parameṣṭhinā | brahmā svayaṃ tathā svasya mūrtau nivāsamācarat || 12| pratiṣṭhāvidhinā svasya pratiṣṭhāmakarodajaḥ | brahmatīrthaṃ ca tajjātaṃ vyādhyādhibalanāśakam ||1 3||| brahmāṇaṃ cāpi sāvitrīṃ sūryaṃ candramasaṃ tathā | pūjayiṣyanti ye dṛṣṭvā te yāsyanti parāṃ gatim || 14|| tataśca brahmaṇā tatra gāyatrī sthāpitā śubhā | svenaiva ca pratiṣṭhāyā vidhistatra kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ || 15|| gāyatrītīrthamityetat brahmalokapradaṃ param | tāṃśca devām̐stathā devīḥ puṣpārghajalakuṃkumaiḥ || 16|| snāpayetpūjayed bhaktyā vastranaivedyabhojanaiḥ | bhūṣaṇaiśca tathā pātraiḥ karpūrailādibhistathā || 17|| tāmbūlaiḥ kesaraiścaiva pūjayed bahubhāvataḥ | dhyāyedvandeta ca namaḥ kuryād daṇḍavadutsukaḥ || 18|| dīpena yajñasūtreṇa tulasyā karavīrakaiḥ | anyaiḥ puṣpai sugandhaiścārārtrikaiḥ stutibhistathā || 19|| pradakṣiṇaiścatān devān viṣṇunā saha pūjayet | kṛṣṇaṃ ca pūjayettatra śālagrāmaṃ ca pūjayet ||1.226.20 || śaṃkaraṃ pārvatīyuktaṃ sagaṇaṃ pūjayet tataḥ | sampūjya snāpayet sāvitrīṃ ca yātrāphalaṃ bhavet ||21 || na vaidhavyaṃ na daurbhāgyaṃ na vandhyātvaṃ bhavet tataḥ | na vai mṛtaprajātvaṃ syānnāprajātvaṃ kathaṃcana ||22|| dhanadhānyadharāsmṛddhiḥ putrapautrādisiddhayaḥ | bhavanti raviprabhṛtipūjakasya dine dine ||23|| parituṣṭo bhavet kṛṣṇo yātrā ca saphalā bhavet | tatastatra rukmiṇīsahitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ samarcayet ||24|| brahmaṇā ca tatastatra brahmaliṃgasaraḥ kṛtam | indraścakre tathā tatra saraḥ paramaśobhanam ||25|| brahmāṇaṃ sthāpayāmāsa mahendraṃ ca śacīyutam | tatra cendrapade snātvā svargaṃ satyaṃ ca vidanti ||26|| brahmeśvaraṃ tathā cendreśvaraṃ vṛddhīśvaraṃ tathā | snāpayitvā pūjayitvā dṛṣṭvā ca mucyate janeḥ||27|| aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ kṛtamakṣayapuṇyadam | pitṝṇāṃ śāśvatī tṛptirjāyate tatra śrāddhataḥ ||28|| viśeṣatastu sampūjyā makarasthe divākare | uttarāyaṇasaṃkrāntiśivarātryādiṣu prage |||29|| snātvā tattatsaraḥsveva tattattīrthāni sañcaret | pūjayitvā ca taddevān muktibhāṅ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||1.226.3 0 || śaṃkaraśca tathā satyā sahitaścākarotsaraḥ | tatrāpi ca jale snātvā pūjayet śaṃkaraṃ satīm ||3 1 || brahmaṇā viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ snātastatra pinākadhṛk | mahādevasaronāmābhavat tajjagatītale ||32||| pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ tatrākṣayasukhapradam | darśanātpāpanirmuktirmahādevasarovare ||33| snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ surapūjanam | sarvaṃ tadakṣayaphalapradaṃ bhavatyanuṣṭhituḥ ||34|| na daurbhāgyaṃ narasyāsti nāprajātvaṃ striyastathā | snātvā gaurīsarasyatra sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ||35|| varuṇo’pi ca tānyeva dṛṣṭvā sarvasthalāni vai | svanāmnā ca saro divyaṃ kārayāmāsa tatra ca ||36||| tattīre vāruṇīṃ devīṃ jaladevīṃ tathā svakām | mūrtiṃ ca sthāpayāmāsa pūjayāmāsa cādarāt ||37|| bhādrasya pūrṇimāyāṃ tu kṛtvā varuṇadarśanam | śrāddhaṃ kuryāttarpaṇaṃ ca kuryāttatrākṣayaṃ phalam ||38||| pradadyādudakuṃbhām̐śca dadhyodanasubhojanam | gāśca vāsāṃsi ratnāni pakvānnāni rasām̐stathā |||3 9 || viṣṇurme prīyatāmuktvā dadyācchatrādikaṃ tathā | sādhave brahmadevāya sādhvyai vā cākṣayaṃ phalam ||1.226.40 || dāturbrahmagatiścāsti yatra gatvā na śocati | vāruṇaṃ ca saro dṛṣṭvā kuberaścākarotsaraḥ ||41|| kuberasara ityevaṃ nāmnā khyāto tato’bhavat | kuberadarśanaṃ snātvā tīre kṛtvā ca bhojayet ||42|| viprān sādhūm̐stathā sādhvīrdakṣiṇāṃ cāpi dhūpayet | suvarṇadānaṃ dadyācca dhaneśastuṣyati drutam ||43|| lakṣmīvṛddhiṃ karotyeṣaḥ sahasraguṇitaṃ phalet|| rajataṃ ca suvarṇaṃ ca tāmraṃ vā pittalaṃ trapu ||44|| hīrakaṃ vātha ratnaṃ vā maṇiṃ vā cāmbarādikam | dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tathā gāśca mahiṣīścāpi kanyakāḥ ||45|| vastraṃ khaṭvā gendukādi kalaśaṃ pātramityapi | puṣpaṃ phalaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ tailaṃ sugandhameva vā ||46|| kapūraṃ cāpi śṛṃgāradravyaṃ ca candanādikam | upānahau tathā chatraṃ cāmaraṃ vāhanaṃ tathā ||47|| yānaṃ nārīṃ sutaṃ bhṛtyaṃ paśuṃ svaṃ śakaṭaṃ tathā | peṭikāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ cānyad bhakṣyaṃ peyaṃ ca bhojanam ||48|| yadyad dadyānmārjanīṃ vā kaṇḍanīṃ peṣaṇīṃ tathā | cullīṃ gargarikāṃ sthālīṃ sarvaṃ sahasradaṃ bhavet|||49|| kṛṣṇaṃ smṛtvā kuberaṃ ca sūryaṃ śivaṃ vicintya ca | rukmiṇyādimahādevīḥ smṛtvā dadyādanantadam ||1.226.50|| mahāpuṇyaṃ mahāsvargaṃ tathā cānte hareḥ padam | prāpnotyeva ca kuberatīrthakṛnmānavo’vyayam ||51 || tataḥ pañcanadaṃ tīrthaṃ gacchedvai pāvanaṃ param | gomatīṃ ca tathā lakṣmīgaṃgāṃ dvārāvatīṃ tathā ||552|| gopītālaṃ tathā cānyasarāṃsi pravilokya ca | prajānāṃ patayastīrthaṃ cakruḥ pañcanadātmakam ||53|| pañcanadyaḥ samāhūtāstatrājagmustvarānvitāḥ | marīcigomatīmatrirlakṣmaṇāmājuhāva vai ||54|| aṅgirāścandrabhāgāṃ ca pulahaśca kuśāvatīm | kraturjāmbavatīṃ tatra nadīṃ samājuhāva ca ||55|| tāsu snātā brahmaputrāḥ snātāśca sarvadevatāḥ | pañcanadīsamākhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ tanmokṣadaṃ param ||56|| snātavyaṃ tatra vidhivat dātavyamarghamityapi | gṛhṇantvarghamimaṃ nadyo bhavantu svargamokṣadāḥ ||57|| snānaṃ kuryājjalaṃ peyāt pitṝn santarpayettathā | pañcaratnāni dhānyāni sapta dadyād dvijātaye ||58|| dīnāndhakṛpaṇebhyaśca dadyādvastu svapekṣitam | sarvān kāmānavāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati |||59||| putrapautrasamāyuktaḥ paraṃ saukhyamavāpnuyāt | pretāśca pitaraḥ sarve muktiṃ yāsyanti tatsthale ||1.226.6 0|| tato gacchenmahattīrthaṃ siddheśvaramiti dhruvam | sanakādyaiścatuḥsiddhaiḥ sthāpitaṃ liṃgameva tat ||61|| samīpe ca tathā kūpo miṣṭodaḥ khanitaśca taiḥ | ṛṣitīrthamiti khyātaṃ jalapānād vimucyate |||62|| bhaktitaḥ snānamātreṇa brahmalokamavāpyate | asanto nindakāścātha vaṃcakāśca śaṭhā janāḥ ||63|| snānamātreṇa śuddhyanti ṛṣitīrthe na saṃśayaḥ | viṣuve ca manūnāṃ ca tithiṣu yugaraṃbhaṇe ||64|| māghakṛṣṇe śivarātryāṃ siddheśaṃ yaḥ prapūjayet | ṛṣitīrthe vasan japan paraṃbrahma sanātanam ||65|| snātvā devaṃ pūjayitvā naman kuryācca tarpaṇam | śrāddhaṃ kuryāttathā dadyād dānāni vividhāni ca ||66 || tasya hastagatā muktirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | dātavyāni rasavanti phalānyatra viśeṣataḥ ||67|| deyau śyāmākanīvārau vidrumaśca tilā api | śālayaḥ saptadhānyāni saktavaḥ śarkarāyutāḥ ||68|| ghṛtaṃ mālyāni tāmbūlaṃ gandho vastrāṇi gopayaḥ | deyānyevaṃ dīnaraṃkaviprasādhubhya eva ca ||69|| siddheśvaraṃ ca dugdhena snāpayet mokṣabhāgbhavet | siddheśvaramahādevadarśane sati mānavāḥ ||1.226.70 || aputrāḥ putriṇaḥ pautriṇaśca bhavanti sarvathā | nirdhanā dhanavantaśca bhaveyuḥ sukhavedinaḥ ||71|| kanyakāḥ satpatiṃ prāpnuyuśca saubhāgyasampadaḥ | duṣkṛtaṃ vilayaṃ yāti sukṛtaṃ cāpi vardhate ||72|| tato gacchenmahālakṣmi gadātīrthamanuttamam | yatra snānena manujaścāgniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet ||73|| tatra bārāharūpaṃ vai bhagavantaṃ praṇamya ca | natvā stutvā pūjayitvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||74|| tatrādye yugasaṃyoge vārāho bhagavān svayam | samāgatya viśaśrāma gadāṃ nihitavān kṣaṇam ||75|| tato gacchennāgatīrthaṃ kṛṣṇasya darśanecchayā | nāgāḥ pātālato yātā dvārakāyāṃ kṣaṇaṃ sthitāḥ ||76|| yatra snātvā paraṃbrahma prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ | tato gacchenmahattīrthaṃ candrabhāgābhidhaṃ param ||77|| tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā vājapeyaphalaṃ vrajet | candrabhāgā śaktihastā khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇī ||78|| kaṃsādidaityabhayadā svasā yā rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ | yasyā darśanamātreṇa sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt ||79|| tato gacchenmuktidvāranāmakaṃ tīrthamityapi | vaśiṣṭhena samānītā gomatī yatra saṃsthitā ||1.226.80 || tajjalaṃ mastake dhṛtvā svargalokamavāpnuyāt | tato gacchecca kālindīsarastīrthamanuttamam ||8 1|| sūryaputrī yamī cātrāgatya tiṣṭhati sarvathā | kṛṣṇasevāparā nityā snānānmuktimavāpnuyāt ||82|| sāmbatīrthaṃ tato gacchettīrthaṃ paramapāvanam | ambayā sahitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ kṛṣṇaputro’bhavatpurā ||83 || tasya sthalaṃ mahattīrthaṃ sāmbatīrthaṃ sumuktidam | tatra snātvā jano bhaktyāpnuyād rūpaṃ suvarṇakam ||84|| lakṣmīnadīṃ tatau gacchennāyaṇasamāśritām | lakṣmīstatra jalarūpā hyavasat kṛṣṇalālasā ||85|| yasyāḥ sparśanamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ | kambusarastato gacchennirmalaṃ jalamāpibet ||86|| nārāyaṇena śaṃkhasya jalaṃ yatrāsti vai dhṛtam | tatra tadvai sarorūpaṃ jātaṃ śaṃkhaśca saṃsthitaḥ ||87|| śaravatīrthaṃ ca tatproktaṃ snātvā muktimavāpnuyāt | jāleśvaraṃ tatastīrthaṃ gacchedvai lokapāvanam ||88|| kaṇvarṣiṇā purā yadoḥ śaptāścātra kumārakāḥ | vināśāya yadoḥ kulasyaiveti śāpajālataḥ ||89|| jāleśvaro mahādevaḥ sthāpitastatra bālakaiḥ | śāntyarthaṃ tasya śāpasya tattīrthaṃ sukhadaṃ param ||1.226.90 || sampūjayitvā jāleśaṃ śivalokamavāpnuyāt | tato gacchejjaratkārutīrthaṃ paramapāvanam ||91|| yatra vai nāgakanyaikā jaratkārvīti vartate | vivāhitā jaratkāruṛṣiṇā pitṛtāraṇe |||92|| putralābhena pitara uddhṛtāstena sarvathā | tacca tīrthaṃ pitṝṇāṃ vai tārakaṃ snānadānataḥ ||93|| ānakadundubhitīrthaṃ hyakrūratīrthamityapi | balatīrthamugrasenatīrthaṃ cārjunatīrthakam ||94|| devakītīrthamevādyaṃ rohiṇītīrthamityapi | subhadrātīrthamevāpi kardamatīrthamityapi || 95|| kṛṣṇapārṣadatīrthāni patnītīrthāni caiva ha | bhaktatīrthāni cāpyatra camatkārakṛtāni ca ||96|| prasiddhāni ca luptāni tīrthāni santi koṭiśaḥ | sākṣādyatra tu golokaṃ vartate tatra kiṃ nahi ||97|| sarvatīrthāni santyeva pade pade na saṃśayaḥ | plāvitāni ca sāmudrajalena pāṃśunā muhuḥ ||98|| rajopi mokṣadaṃ yasya pavanaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | jalaṃ dityatanudātṛ kṛṣṇayogānna saṃśayaḥ ||99|| mokṣadvāraṃ svargadvāraṃ sukhadvāraṃ ca dvārikā | lakṣmi tadvai sadā sevyaṃ tīrthaṃ tu dvārikāhvayam || 1.226.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvārakāyāṃ brahmakuṇḍasūryavaruṇakuberaprabhatidevasaro varādi pañcanadyādiṣaḍtriṃśattīrthapradarśananāmā ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 226 ||
<1.227> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi dvārapālān pratidikṣu vasanti ye | dvārakāṃ paritaḥ sthitvā rakṣanti kṛṣṇadeśataḥ || 1 || pūrve jayanta indrasya putrastiṣṭhati sarvadā | tasya śiṣyā danujāśca tiṣṭhantyājñāvahāstathā || 2 || vajranābhaḥ sunābhaśca vajravāhurmahāhanuḥ | vajradaṃṣṭo vajradhārī vajrahā vajralocanaḥ || 3 || śvetamūrdhā śvetamālī naranātho vināyakaḥ | sūryaśca mātaraḥ sapta śaṃbhuścāpi ca takṣakaḥ || 4 || kārtikeyo rājasaśca dīrgharomākhyadānavaḥ | viśvāvasuśca gandharvo menakā cāpsarāstathā || 5 || sanatkumāro vaśiṣṭho nyagrodhaśca mahāvaṭaḥ | athāgnidiśi tiṣṭhanti jvālāmukho’ruṇākṣakaḥ || 6 || kuśaḥ śmaśānanilayo māṃsāśī rudhirāśanaḥ | kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇajaṭādhārī trāsano bhañjanastathā || 7 || agnisthālī cāpsarā ca gandharvo’māvasustathā | atha dakṣiṇakāṣṭhāyāṃ daṇḍapāṇirmahāsvaraḥ | pāśahastastrinetraścātivarto māraṇastathā || 8 || dundubhisvarakaḥ kharasvaro ghargharavastathā | maunapriyo mallikaśca durdarśaśca vināyakaḥ || 9 || mahiṣīkaśca sūryaśca bhūṣaṇaścaturastathā | citrāṃgadaḥ sugandhaścāpsarorvaśyabhidhānikā || 1.227.1 0|| gorajo dānavaścaiva śālo mahādrumastathā | sanātanarṣiragastyo dakṣiṇadvārarakṣakāḥ || 11 || atha nairṛtakāṣṭhāyāṃ gomukho muṇḍanastathā | nagnaśca kambalī caiva rodano hasanaśca vai || 12|| lambagrīvo bhrūvikāro dvijaṃbhakaśca sūryakaḥ | muśalī menakā cāpi rakṣanti nairṛtīṃ diśām || 1 3|| atha paścimakāṣṭhāyāṃ svastikaḥ śaṃkhamastakaḥ | śubhāsyo nīlavāsāśca pādahasto mūlākaraḥ || 14|| ekapāda ekanetraḥ sthūlajaṃgho mahacchirāḥ | puṣpadanto gaṇeśaśca sūryaḥ satrājiteśvaraḥ || 15|| tumburuśca ghṛtācī ca mahodarasarīsṛpaḥ | ghaṭotkacaḥ paṃcajanaḥ kāśyapaśca kapālinī || 16|| aśvatthadruḥ kapilaśca rakṣanti paścimāṃ diśam | atha vāyavyakāṣṭhāyāṃ bhaṃjano bhairavastathā || 17|| ghaṭodaraśca kāliko daṇḍako mardano ruruḥ | ṣaṅgaḥ sarvabhujo ghṛṇī supārśvo vāyudigbhavāḥ || 18|| athottare mūlasthānaḥ sūrya indreśvaraḥ śivaḥ | kaṇṭheśvarī khaṃjanaśca vāsukiḥ kūrmadānavaḥ || 19|| sanakaśca golakākhyarākṣaso nāradastathā | raṃbhāpsarāḥ plakṣavṛkṣo rakṣanti cottarāṃ diśam || 1.227.20 || atheśānyāṃ kilīkaśca durdharo bhairavānanaḥ | dīrghāsyo meghavaktraśca karālo vikacastathā ||2 1 || mūkaśca balibhuk caiva balipriyaśca māṃsabhuk | ete sarve diśāṃ pālāstatratyāḥ saṃti padmaje || 22|| jayantaḥ sarvamūrdhanyo nāgo rakṣati pattalam | etānprapūjya kṛṣṇasya kāryaṃ vai pūjanaṃ mahat |||23 || atha rukmigaṇeśasya pūjanaṃ darśanaṃ tathā | kartavyaṃ vidhinā kṛṣṇājñayā dvāravyavasthiteḥ || 24|| kṛṣṇāya rukmiṇīṃ dātuṃ bhīṣmakaśca kṛtotsavaḥ | rukmī viruddhamatago tadvākyaṃ nānvamanyata ||25|| bhagavāṃśca hariḥ kṛṣṇo rukmiṇīmambikāsthalāt | jahāra ca yadā rukmī pratijñāmakarottadā || 26 || kṛṣṇaṃ cāvinihatvāhaṃ nivartiṣye raṇānnahi | iti vegād gato yuddhaṃ kartuṃ kṛṣṇena rukmakaḥ ||27|| kṛṣṇenābaddhya so’pyardhaśmaśrunikṛntanaḥ kṛtaḥ | avamānena maraṇe kṛtaniścaya eva saḥ || 28|| rakṣitaḥ śrībhagavatā rukmiṇyāḥ priyakāraṇāt|| pūjitaśca gaṇānāṃ vai nāyakaścāpi nirmitaḥ ||29||| tatastasya sadā pūjā kāryā kṛṣṇasya tuṣṭaye | tato durvāsasaṃ caiva baladevaṃ prapūjayet ||1.227.30||| śrīkṛṣṇaṃ pūjayettasya mandire dhāmasannibhe | sarvayajñaphalaṃ sarvadakṣiṇāphalamityapi || 31 || sarvayogaphalaṃ jñānaphalaṃ gaṃgāphalaṃ tathā | sarvadānaphalaṃ mokṣaphalaṃ labhyeta pūjanāt ||3 2|| tatastrivikramaṃ devaṃ pūjayedvāmanṃ mudā | ekadā tu baleḥ rājño rājyaṃ cābhūnmahītale ||33 || tadā durvāsakaścakratīrthe snātuṃ samāgataḥ | tatra daivairjānubhirmuṣṭibhiścātīva tāḍitaḥ || 34|| nivārayāmāsa tām̐śca rururnāma mahāsuraḥ | rakṣitaścāpi durvāsāḥ kailāsaṃ saṃyayau tadā || 35|| etasminnantare rājan vāmano bhagavānsvayam | jigāya tripadairbhūmiṃ balidvāre vyavasthitaḥ || 36|| durvāsāśca tadā cintāmakarot sukhakāriṇīm | vāmanaṃ prati śaraṇaṃ jagāma balisevitam || 37|| āyāntamṛṣimālokya balirdaityapatistadā | pratyutthāyārhaṇāṃ cakre cāsane sannyaveśavat || 38 || provāca praṇato brūhi cātrāgamanakāraṇam | durvāsāśca balerdvāre dṛṣṭvā viṣṇuṃ caturbhujam || 39 ||
