rudan śvasan muhurvegāt trāhi trāhītyabhāṣata | brāhmaṇaṃ duḥkhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā dayāluḥ prāha mādhavaḥ || 1.227.40 || kiṃ kasmād duḥkhamāpannaṃ vada śīghraṃ tu me mune | durvāsāḥ prāha bhagavan jñātvā tīrthaṃ tu muktidam || 41 || cakratīrthaṃ gataḥ snātuṃ cākṛtasnāna eva ca | gale gṛhīto daityaiśca muṣṭibhiścātitāḍitaḥ || 42|| balād gṛhītvā vāsāṃsi kuśām̐ścaivākṣatāṃstathā | niṣkāsitaścākruṣṭa haniṣyāmo yadyāgataḥ ||43 || snātvā ca cakratīrthe’haṃ kariṣye bhojane tataḥ | tasmād snāpaya govinda rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāgatam || 44|| virarāmetyabhidhāya durvāsāḥ krodhano muniḥ | brahmaṇyadevo bhagavān brāhmaṇaṃ tamuvāca ha || 45|| hatvā daityān snāpayiṣye samāgaccha mayā saha | trivikramaśca bhagavān āyayau muninā saha ||46|| kṛṣṇaśca prāha snānaṃ tva kuru śāntyā mune hyatha | durvāsāstadvacaḥ śrutvā snānaṃ cakre tvarānvitaḥ ||47 || sandhyādikaṃ nityakarma kartumārabhata dvijaḥ | durmukho dānavastatra krodhāsaṃraktalocanaḥ ||48 || samāyayau tathā durvāsasaṃ hantumiyeṣa vai | kṛṣṇaścakreṇa durmukhaśiraściccheda līlayā ||49|| tato daityāḥ samājagmuryuddhārthaṃ śastrakovidāḥ | viṣṇuḥ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo vāmanaśceti sarvaśaḥ ||1.227.5 0 || mārgaṇairastraśastraiśca raṇe daityān nijaghnire | duḥsahaṃ kūrmapṛṣṭhaṃ ca golakaṃ vedadūṣakam ||5 1 || yajñaghnaṃ yajñahantāraṃ dharmānta ca nijaghnire | kuśastadā samāyāto yuddhāya kṛtaniścayaḥ ||52|| anīkaṃ daśasāhasraṃ nāgānāmayutaṃ tathā | ayute dve rathānāntu cāśvānāṃ ca daśāyutam |||53 || vakrago dīrghanakhaśca nighasaḥ prasavastathā | ūrdhvabāhurvakraśirāḥ kaṃcukaśca śilonmukhaḥ || 54|| yajñadhnaśca tathā rāhurbabarako mahāhanuḥ | sunāmā vasunāmā ca daityā yuddhāya niryayuḥ || 55|| kuśastadā mahādevaṃ pupūja jayavāñcchayā | yayau khaḍgaṃ kare dhṛtvā keśavaṃ prati vegataḥ ||56 || uvāca yadi jeṣyāmi kīrtirme hyatulā bhavet | patito’haṃ tvayā yadvā yāsyāmi paramāṃ gatim ||57|| ityuktvā dhāvamānasya śiraściccheda līlayā | patitaḥ śivasānnidhye punarjīvita utthitaḥ ||98|| uvāca viṣṇumānamya daityeste’pakṛtaṃ ca kim | durvāsasaṃ snāpayitvā yathecchasi tathā kuru ||59|| kṛṣṇaḥ prāha bhavadbhiśca tīrthaṃ ruddhaṃ hi sarvathā | tasmāt sarvān haniṣyāmi dānavānnātra saṃśayaḥ ||1.227.60|| yuyudhe ca tadā kuśaḥ kṛṣṇena saha vegataḥ | bhagavān krodhasaṃyuktaścakreṇāpātayacchiraḥ ||61 || tadā daityaiḥ kuśadeho mastakaṃ ca śivālaye | nikṣipto tāvadevāyaṃ prasādācchaṃkarasya vai ||62|| upasthitaḥ sahasā dhṛtvā gadāṃ yoddhumupasthitaḥ | mahādevena tuṣṭena yato’maraḥ sa vai kṛtaḥ ||63|| punaśca hariṇā svasya gadayā bhinnamastakaḥ | kuśo garte tadā kṣipto mṛtpāṣāṇaiśca bhāritaḥ ||64|| tadupari śivaliṃgaṃ sthāpitaṃ viṣṇunā tadā | jīvito’pi punarnāyamutthito’bhūduvāca ca ||65|| śivaliṃgaṃ tvayā viṣṇo sthāpitaṃ yanmamopari | mama nāmnā bhavatvetat kuśeśa itiviśrutam ||66|| kuśasthalyāṃ kuśeśaśca tīrthaṃ kṛtaṃ mahattathā | kṛṣṇena tattathāstviti kuśānugrahakāraṇāt ||67|| tato’nyadānavānsarvān nāśayāmāsa mādhavaḥ | rasātalagatāḥ kecitkecid bhṛtyatayā sthitāḥ ||68|| vāmanaśca tathā viṣṇuranantaḥ krodhano muniḥ | ete’nyepi dvāravatyāṃ sthānaṃ kṛtvā sadā sthitāḥ ||69|| dvitīyena ca rūpeṇa tāni tīrthāni santi vai | kṛṣṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ vāmanaṃ ca saṃkarṣaṇaṃ durvāsasam ||1.227.70|| tīrthakṛtpūjayed gandhaiḥ puṣpanaivedyabhūṣaṇaiḥ | vastraiḥ phalaiśca tāmbūlākṣatacandanakuṃkumaiḥ ||71|| ārārtrikeṇa dhūpena dīpavāditrakīrtanaiḥ | pradakṣiṇādakṣiṇābhiḥ stutibhirvandanaistathā ||72|| sarvārpaṇaiśca sampūjya kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ niśi | bhādreṣṭamyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ ca pūjayitvā tu tānsurān ||73|| golokaṃ dhāma cāpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati | snāpayitvā hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ||74|| tulasīṃ pūjayitvā cārcayed durvāsasaṃ tataḥ | gaṇeśaṃ vainateyaṃ ca pūjayecca tataḥ param ||75|| rukmiṇīṃ pūjayecchaktyā ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ | grahapīḍā na jāyeta vyādhayo na bhavanti ca ||76 || bhūtapretādipīḍā ca naśyed rukmiṇīkārcanāt | rukmiṇīṃ snāpayed dadhnā kṣīreṇa madhunā tathā ||77|| śarkarayā ghṛtenāpi gandhaiḥ sugandhicandanaiḥ | utaraiḥ śreṣṭhatailaiśca tato’bhiṣekasajjalaiḥ ||78 || śrīkhaṇḍakuṃkumenāpi kastūrīkesaraistathā | vilepayeyenmahālakṣmīṃ rukmiṇīṃ cātibhāvataḥ || 79 || aputrasya bhavetputro’dhanaśca dhanamāpnuyāt | dāsān bhṛtyān paśūn gāśca prāpnuyād bhogavaibhavān || 1.227.80 || pūjayenmālatīpuṣpaiḥ śatapatraiḥ sugandhibhiḥ | karavīrairmallikābhistulasīrājacampakaiḥ ||8 1 || karavīraiḥ ketakaiśca dhūpairvastrairdhanaistathā | bhūṣaṇairbhūṣayed devīṃ maṇiratnairvibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||8 2|| evaṃ pūjayamānasya na kule nirdhanaḥ kvacit|| nāputro nāpyasadbhāgyo na nīcasevako bhavet ||8 3 || naivedyaṃ bhakṣyabhojyādi tato dadyāt priyaṃ priyam | tāmbūlaṃ ca sakarpūraṃ bhāvena vinivedayet ||84|| phalaṃ jalaṃ tathārghaṃ ca dadyādārārtrikaṃ tataḥ | nīrājanaṃ karpūreṇa kṛtvā śaṃkhajalaṃ tataḥ ||85|| bhrāmayet sarvato rakṣākaraṃ śirasā dhārayet | daṇḍavat praṇamed bhūmau namaḥ kṛṣṇapriye vadan ||86|| viprapatnyai tato dadyād dānāni vividhāni ca | sindūrahāravastrāṇi gandhakusumakuṃkumam || 87|| kajjalaṃ cāpi tāmbūlaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ navaṃ navam | athaivaṃ satyabhāmāṃ ca devīṃ jāmbavantīṃ tathā ||88 || mitravindāṃ ca kālindīṃ bhadrāmagnijitīṃ tathā | pūjayitvā ṣoḍaśabhistarpayitvā ca pāyasaiḥ ||89|| sarvān kāmānavāpnoti paratreha ca pūjakaḥ | tasmātsarvaprayatnena rājñyaśca kṛṣṇavallabhāḥ || 1.227.90 || toṣaṇīyāścātibhaktyā bhaveyuḥ svargamokṣadāḥ | saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ teṣāṃ saphalāśca manorathāḥ || 91 || māghe māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ caitrasya dvādaśīdine | vaiśākhe cāpi jyeṣṭhasyāṣṭamyāṃ bhādre ca kārtike || 92|| dvādaśyāṃ sitapakṣe sā pūjitā kṛṣṇasaṃyutā | dadyādvai cirajīvitvaṃ cākṣayāṃ putrasantatim || 93 || kārayet sudṛḍhaṃ yaśca rūkmiṇīkṛṣṇamandiram | tasya golokadhāmnyeva vāsaḥ kṛṣṇasya mandire || 94|| nityanaivedyasampūrṇavyavasthā kārayecca yaḥ | tasya dhāmni harernityaṃ prasādaprāpaṇaṃ bhavet ||95|| vastravyajanasacchatracāmarakalaśādikam | arpayed yaḥ śrīkṛṣṇāya tasya taddhāmnyanantakam ||96|| kṛṣṇalakṣmīcaraṇānāṃ sevakasya susmṛddhayaḥ | sadā divyā bhavantyeva nāryāśca kṛṣṇabhogyatā ||97|| snāyācca sarvatīrtheṣu dānaṃ śaktyā dadāti yaḥ | sarvayajñaphalaṃ naiva kalau kṛṣṇaśriyo’rcanāt || 98|| muktvā dvāravatīṃ puṇyāṃ muktirnānyatra vai kalau | labhyate ca mahālakṣmi kṣetraṃ divyaṃ ca me’sti tat ||9 9 || iti te kathitaṃ mukhyaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam | janaḥ śrutvā paṭhitvā ca tattīrthaphalamāpnuyāt || 1.227.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvārikākṣetrarakṣakāṇāṃ nāmāni durvāsasaḥ snānanimittaṃ kuśādidaityānāṃ nāśaḥ kuśeśvarāditīrthāni vāmanāditīrthāni paṭṭarājñītīrthādīni cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||227||
<1.228> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca kalau kṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ ye śṛṇvanti paṭhanti ca | teṣāṃ vaikuṇṭhagolokadhāmnorvāso mataḥ sadā || 1 || nityaṃ kṛṣṇakathā yasya prāṇādapi garīyasī | na tasya durlabhaṃ cātra paratrāpi yathepsitam || 2 || manvantarasahasreṇa kāśīvāsasya yatphalam | tatphalaṃ dvāravatyāṃ tu pañcadivasavāsataḥ || 3 || śvapacopi vasannatra yatīnāṃ gatimāpnuyāt | dvārakāṃ prati yātasya puṇyaṃ syāttu pade pade || 4 || kurukṣetre ravigrahasnānasyetyāha padmajaḥ | candragrahe bhaved yaśca phalaṃ tadatra darśane || 5 || puṣkare kārtikasnānaphalaṃ yadvarṣakoṭibhiḥ | tatphalaṃ dvārakāvāse nityaṃ bhavati dehinaḥ || 6 || avantyāṃ yatphalaṃ manuśatena bhavati priye | tatphalaṃ dvārakāyāṃ tu dinaikavāsato bhavet || 7 || kṛṣṇadarśanapuṇyaṃ tu mataṃ koṭivratādhikam | rukmiṇīkṛṣṇasevāyāḥ phalaṃ golokamokṣaṇam || 8 || dhanyāste kṛtakṛtyāste dṛṣṭaṃ yaiḥ kṛṣṇamaṇḍalam | dvādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapūjā ca karoti yastu bhāvataḥ || 5 || kṣīrasnānaṃ kārayati śatāśvamedhajaṃ phalam | dugdhād daśaguṇaṃ darbhād ghṛtāttasmād daśottaram || 1.228.10 || ghṛtāddaśaguṇaṃ kṣaudraṃ śaṃkhena taddaśottaram | puṣpodakaṃ ca darbhodaṃ vardhate taddaśottaram || 1 1|| mantrodakaṃ ca gandhodaṃ tato’pi ca daśottaram | snānamikṣurasenāpi śatavājimakhaiḥ samam || 1 2|| tīrthanīreṇa saṃsnānaṃ tato daśaguṇaṃ smṛtam | sakāmastvāpnuyātsvargaṃ niṣkāmo muktimāpnuyāt || 13 || kṛṣṇasnānārdragātraṃ yo vastreṇa mārjayejjanaḥ | tasya janmāntaralakṣapāpaṃ bhavati mārjitam || 1 4|| snāpayitvā hariṃ tasmai puṣpahāraṃ dadāti yaḥ | tasya puṇyaṃ svarṇaniṣkākoṭidānaphalaṃ bhavet || 15|| snānakāle kṛṣṇanāmnāṃ jātastu sahasrakam | pratyakṣaraṃ miletpuṇyaṃ kapilāśatagopradam || 16|| snānakāle ca kṛṣṇāgre nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ ca vā | karoti sa tu kṛṣṇasya goloke jāyate priyaḥ || 17|| snānakāle hare jaya kṛṣṇā jayetivādinaḥ | tālikā vādayataśca na yoniyantranirgamaḥ || 18|| vastrairdhūpena sauvarṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ pūjayanti ye | śatamanvantaraṃ vāso vaikuṇṭhe ca tataḥ param || 19|| goloke śāśvato vāso bhavati kṛṣṇasevane | ketakyā cātha tulasīmaṃjaryā kusumaistathā ||1.228.20 || mālatyā rukmiṇīpatiṃ pūjayanti ca yā striyaḥ | krīḍanti saptasu svargabhūmiṣu patinā saha ||21 || manvantaraśatapūrṇaṃ tato golokamāpnuyuḥ | yogināṃ yajñināṃ caiva dānināṃ tīrthasevinām || 22|| pitṛmātṛprabhaktānāṃ dvādaśīvratināṃ tathā | ekādaśyāṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kurvatāṃ nṛtyatāṃ tathā ||23|| gāyatāṃ smaratāṃ vedaghoṣaṇāṃ kurvatāṃ tathā | viṣṇunāmnāṃ sahasraṃ ca paṭhatāṃ cāpi yatphalam || 24|| tatphalaṃ kṛṣṇapūjāyāṃ tulasyarpaṇato bhavet | rukmiṇīkṛṣṇapūjāyāḥ phalaṃ cāpi tato’dhikam ||25|| yathā lakṣmīḥ priyā viṣṇoḥ tulasī ca tatodhikā | yatra kvāpi tulasyā vai pūjito bhavati hariḥ ||26 || tatra tasya dvārakāyāstīrthayātrāphalaṃ bhavet | ketakyāpyarcayet kṛṣṇaṃ pratipuṣpāśvamedhajam ||27|| phalaṃ vai prāpyate cānte golokagatirāpyate | mālatyā pūjayet kṛṣṇaṃ prāpyate ca hareḥ padam ||28|| yathāptapatrapuṣpairvā pūjayecchrīpatiṃ harim | divyām̐śca mānuṣān bhogān bhuktvā yāti hareḥ padam ||29| aṣṭākṣaro’yaṃ mantrastu śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ mama | taṃ japan pūjayetkṛṣṇaṃ candanena sugandhinā ||1.228.30 || karpūreṇa ca kastūryā sa ceyāt kṛṣṇatulyatām | ājyena guggulenāpi dhūpaṃ kuryācca yo hareḥ ||3 1 | pātakaṃ pravidhūyāsau surūpo jāyate’kṣare | kṛṣṇāyane dīpamālāṃ kārayati dine dine || 32|| saptadvīpanṛpaḥ syādvai dīpe dīpe phalaṃ hi tat | naivedyāni vividhāni kṛṣṇāya yo nivedayet ||33|| tasya vai pitarastṛptāḥ śāśvatīṃ muktimāpnuyuḥ | tāmbūlaṃ karpūrayutaṃ pūgādicūrṇikānvitam || 34|| kṛṣṇāya yacchato nāsti punarjanmātra māyike | nīraṃ śītaṃ sugandhāḍhyaṃ deyaṃ kṛṣṇāya tṛptaye ||35|| nityā tṛptirbhavet tasya nityāmṛtādipānataḥ | phalāni cārumiṣṭāni pakvānyarpayatastathā ||36|| anyadapi mukhasyaiva śuddhyarthaṃ dadatastathā | goloke nityatṛptiḥ syāt sugandhaśvāsavānbhavet ||37|| śrīkṛṣṇasya prakramaṇaṃ karturvairājadhiṣṇyakam | śrīkṛṣṇamandire puṣpodyānaṃ yaḥ kārayetpari ||38|| sa puṣpakavimānena krīḍati devakoṭibhiḥ | cāmarairvyajanairvāyuṃ kṛṣṇāya yā prayacchati || 3||| tasyā dhāmni svayaṃ kṛṣṇaścūmbati mukhapaṃkajam | śayyākartryāśca śayyāyāṃ saha svapiti keśavaḥ ||1.228.40 || śrīkṛṣṇamaṇḍapaṃ kadalīstaṃbhaiḥ kārayettu yaḥ | tasya sevāmapsarasaḥ kurvanti kadalīsamāḥ ||41 || kṛṣṇālaye patākābhiḥ śobhāṃ karoti yo janaḥ | sūryaloke tasya vāso sadā bhavati sūryavat ||42|| dhūpacandanasaugandhyuttaraiśca vāsayed hareḥ | mandiraṃ tasya bhavanaṃ divi vai vāsitaṃ bhavet ||43|| kṛṣṇapādaprasaṃvāhaṃ yā karoti hṛdā sadā | kṛṣṇena saha goloke ramā bhūtvā pramodate ||44|| bhojanaṃ nūtanaṃ kṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ saṃprabhojayet | sā vai lakṣmīḥ sadā bhūtvā vaikuṇṭhe śrīhariṃ bhajet ||45|| śrīkṛṣṇasya sadā sevāṃ ye kurvanti janā bhuvi | devakanyāvṛtāḥ svarge sevyante cāpsarogaṇaiḥ ||46 || śrīkṛṣṇaśikhare yaśca dhvajamāropayecchubham | tasyākṣare pare dhāmni sadhvajaṃ bhavanaṃ bhavet ||47|| śrīkṛṣṇamandire citrakāryaṃ kārayate tu yaḥ | tasya citramayaṃ dhāmni vimānaṃ bhavati dhruvam ||48|| darpaṇaṃ yaśca kṛṣṇāgre dadyātsa somalokagān | bhogānākalpamābhuktvā golokaṃ śāśvataṃ vrajet ||49|| chatraṃ bahuśalākaṃ sakṣaumaṃ dadyāttu śārṅgiṇe | sa vai vairājalokeṣu samrāṭ bhūtvā hariṃ vrajet ||1.228.50|| dadyād yānaṃ vimānaṃ vā vāhaṃ khaṭvāṃ bṛsīṃ kaṭam | kuberaḥ kalpaparyantaṃ bhūtvānte yānti mokṣaṇam ||51 || ārārtrikaṃ hareḥ kuryāt bahuvarttighṛtādibhiḥ | tasyārārtrikamanvahaṃ kriyate devakoṭibhiḥ ||52|| keśavopari sajalaṃ śaṃkhaṃ ca bhrāmayettu yaḥ | sa kṣīre sāgare kṛṣṇasannidhau vāsabhāg bhavet ||53|| kṛṣṇapradakṣiṇāṃ kuryāt pṛthvīdānaphalaṃ pade | kuryād daṇḍanamaskāraṃ cāśvamedhaphalaṃ bhavet ||54|| kīrtanaṃ śrīhareḥ kuryāt sāmavedaphalaṃ labhet | nṛtyaṃ kuryāddhareragre koṭipāpavināśanam ||55|| vasatāṃ dvārakāṃ golokadhāmāvāsajaṃ phalam | gomatīnīrapānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryāttasya mokṣaṇam ||56|| gaṃgādvāre prayāge ca gaṃgāyāṃ kurujāṃgale | puṣkare ca prabhāse ca śrīsthale śuklatīrthake ||57|| cāndrāyaṇasahasrasya phalaṃ tvekadine’tra vai | dvārikāgomatīkṛṣṇagopītālaprasevinaḥ ||58|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvārikāvāsakṛṣṇapūjanamāhātmyaphalādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||228||
<1.229> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatā ca mahālakṣmi dvārikā gomatī tathā | nirmitā svarganiḥśreṇiḥ kalau kṛṣṇena gomatī || 1 || sukhadā sevināṃ nityaṃ snānamātreṇa mokṣadā | śilāścakrāṃkitā yatra gomatyudadhisaṃbhavāḥ || 2 || dṛṣṭā api paraṃ mokṣaṃ prāpayanti tu darśakān | yanmṛttikā mokṣadāsti tāṃ purīṃ ko na sevayet || 3 || āvantyo brāhmaṇaḥ kaścitsomaśarmetināmakaḥ | śivabhakto na jānāti tadanyadevatāvratam || 4 || caturdaśīṃ karotyeva viṣṇuṃ tu manute nahi | prativarṣaṃ karoti sma somanāthasya darśanam || 5 || saptāyutaṃ gataṃ tasya varṣāṇāṃ jarjaro hyabhūt | somanāthasya yātrāyāṃ koṭiśo hyabhavan janāḥ || 6 || te ca sarve mahattīrthaṃ kṛtvā gatvā ca raivatam | tato gatāśca dvārikāyātrārthaṃ na gato dvijaḥ || 7 || somaśarmā yayau naijaṃ gṛhaṃ suṣvāpa caikalaḥ | svapne ca pitarastasya pitāmahāḥ samāyayuḥ || 8 || prapitāmahayuktāśca bāndhavā vṛddhasantateḥ | pretarūpāḥ kṣudhāvyāptā raudrāḥ śokasamanvitāḥ || 9 || dṛṣṭvā tān bhayamāpannaścovāca saḥ prakampitaḥ | ke yūyaṃ raudrarūpāḥ stha kutaḥ kasmāt samāgatāḥ || 1.229.10 || pretāḥ prāhuśca taṃ putraṃ te smo vayaṃ pitāmahāḥ | duḥkhitā kṣudhitāścātra tvatsamīpe samāgatāḥ || 11 || putraḥ prāha mayā dattaṃ taptaṃ hutaṃ ca bhojitam | bhavatāṃ tuṣṭilābhāya bhavadbhiścāpi tatkṛtam || 12 || kathaṃ tiṣṭhatha pretatve brūta kāraṇamatra me | pretā ūcuḥ śṛṇu putra viddho vai harivāsaraḥ || 13 || kṛto’smābhistvayā cāpi kriyate na harerdinam | tena doṣeṇa cāsmākaṃ pretatvaṃ duḥkhadaṃ vṛtam || 1 4|| na cāpyuddhāra evāsti tava pāpānmahattarāt | na tvaṃ kuruṣe bhagavadvrataṃ yātrāṃ karoṣi na || 15 || kṛṣṇaṃ na manuṣe putra dvārikāṃ na ca gacchasi | kevalaṃ śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ bhajase nindasi prabhum || 1 6|| tena doṣeṇa pretatvaṃ prāptāstvamapi prāpsyasi | na viṣṇudveṣiṇaḥ śaṃbhuḥ kariṣyati hi sadgatim || 17|| śaṃkaro viṣṇubhakto’sti vaiṣṇavāgryaḥ sa vartate | kṛṣṇanindākarasyāyaṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇāti naiva ca || 18 || haribhaktivihīnānāṃ dvādaśīvratavarjinām | pāpaṃ nāśaṃ na cāyāti pretatvaṃ na nivartate || 19 || vinā keśavapūjāṃ tu pūjyamāne’pi śaṃkare | nārakaṃ duḥkhadaṃ kaṣṭaṃ pāpaṃ bhavati govadham || 1.229.20 || prathamaṃ keśavaḥ pūjyaḥ paścācchrīśaṃkaro’rhati | pūjanaṃ ca tato devāḥ pūjyāścānye vyavasthitiḥ || 21 || tvayā nāstikabhāvena pūjyate na hariḥ svayam | na pūjā rakṣati śaivī bhāskarī na pitāmahī || 22| pretabhāvaṃ nārdayati viddhavāsarajaṃ khalu | vaiśākhe tu tṛtīyāṃ ca viddhāṃ tithiṃ karoti yaḥ || 23 || havyaṃ devā na gṛhṇanti kavyaṃ naiva pitāmahāḥ | kurute yadi mohāttāṃ pretatvaṃ tasya vai dhruvam || 24|| dvādaśī pūrṇamāsī ca pitroḥ samvatsaraṃ dinam | pūrvaviddhaṃ prakurvāṇo narakaṃ pratipadyate || 25|| praṇamya somanāthaṃ tvaṃ dvārakāṃ naiva gacchasi | karoṣi kṛṣṇasevāṃ na yātrāyāste phalaṃ nahi ||26|| tasmāt someśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā gantavyaṃ dvārakāpurīm | dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ dvārakāṃ yāti naiva yaḥ ||27|| sa patennarake ghore pitṛbhiḥ saha putraka | tadvayaṃ patitāḥ sarve pātitāśca punastvayā ||28||| nirgamo yamalokācca tadasmākaṃ na dṛśyate | gomatīnīrasamparkāt kṛṣṇavaktrāvalokanāt ||29|| gopīsaraḥśrāddhadānāt taranti pitaraḥ suta | kṛṣṇasya dvārakāṃ gatvā paśyānanaṃ hareḥ prabhoḥ || 1.229.30 || śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ samudrasya gomatīsaṃgame kuru | tarpaṇaṃ gopikātāle kuru kṛṣṇasamarpaṇam || 3 1|| tava puṇyaṃ bhavecchubhraṃ cāsmākaṃ ca gatirbhavet | pūjite devadeveśe kṛṣṇe rukmiṇīsevite ||32 || pūjitāśca vayaṃ puṣṭiṃ kurmaḥ putrapautrikīm | pretayonivinirmuktā yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim ||33|| gomatīniradhau tasya na vai pretatvamasti hi | tatra śrāddhapradānena pitṛtṛptiśca mokṣaṇam ||34|| tīrthakoṭisahasraiśca tatra śrāddhaiśca yatphalam | tatphalaṃ labhyate sarvaṃ dvārakāyāṃ jalārpaṇāt ||35|| yatīnāṃ bhojanaṃ kṛṣṇabhojane cāpi yatphalam | tatphalaṃ prāpyate koṭikalpatṛptikaraṃ śubham ||36|| dvārakāvāsināṃ muktiḥ śāśvatī sarvathā matā | na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi ||37|| yā nārī vidhavā nityaṃ kurute dvārakāśrayam | sā tu lakṣmīrbhavatyeva kṛṣṇasya priyakāriṇī ||38|| kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇapurīṃ gatvā yo’rcayet tulasīdalaiḥ | prāptaṃ janmaphalaṃ tena tāritāśca pitāmahāḥ ||39||| tulasīdalamālāṃ ca kṛṣṇottīrṇāṃ tu yo vahet | patre patre’śvamedhānāṃ daśānāṃ jāyate phalam ||1.229.40 || tulasīmālayā yuktaḥ śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ samācaret | pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca svalpaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet ||41 || tulasīkāṣṭhamālāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā dravanti yāmakāḥ | yadgṛhe tulasīkāṣṭhaṃ patraṃ śuṣkamathārdrakam 42|| bhavate tadgṛhe naiva pāpasaṃkramaṇaṃ kvacit | tasmātputra tulasyāśca mālāṃ dhṛtvā ca vaiṣṇavaḥ ||43||| bhūtvā gaccha hareḥ saumyāṃ dvārakāṃ śrāddhamāvaha | tarpaṇaṃ ca kuru tīrthajalaiścātaḥ pramokṣaya ||44|| unmolanī ca śayanī triḥspṛśā pakṣavardhinī | tvayā putra prakartavyā jayantī vijayā jayā |||45|| kṛṣṇāṣṭamī prakartavyā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī | sarvasampatpradā mokṣapradā gaccha sukhān kuru ||46|| iti śrutvā ca pitṝṇāṃ pretānāṃ dvārakāṃ dvijaḥ | candraśarmā yayau nityagolokadhāmasadṛśīm ||47|| yatra śrīrukmiṇīkṛṣṇaḥ tīrthāni santi sarvadā | yajñāśca devatā yatra tiṣṭhanti munayo’malāḥ ||48|| kinnaraiḥ siddhagandharvaiḥ sevyate yā ca dvārakā | svargārohaṇaniḥśreṇirvartate yatra gomatī || 49|| yasyāḥ sīmapraviṣṭasya naśyanti pāpaparvatāḥ | sā purī dvijavaryeṇa dṛṣṭā nirmalanetrataḥ ||1.229.50 || mudaṃ prāpto dvijastatra gomatīṃ kṛṣṇamandiram | kṛṣṇaṃ ca sāgaraṃ dvārāvatīṃ nanāma bhāvataḥ ||51 || mene ca kṛtakṛtyaṃ svaṃ dhanyaṃ bhāgyodayānvitam | tīrthakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ nādyāsti me prayojanam |||52|| śuklā vaiśākhamāsasya samprāptā madhusūdanī | dvādaśī triḥspṛśā nāma koṭipāpanikṛntanī ||53|| ahau puṇyodayo jāto mayā dṛṣṭādya dvārakā | iti kṛtvā tvapaḥ spṛṣṭvā snātvā santarpya devatāḥ ||54|| cakratīrthaṃ samāsādyānarca cakrāṃkitāṃ śilām | kṛṣṇasya darśanaṃ ṣoḍaśopacāraśca pūjanam ||55|| śivasya pūjanaṃ caiva cakre bhāvasamanvitaḥ | pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍadānaṃ ca jalaṃ datvā vidhānataḥ ||56|| hareḥ snāpanaṃ dugdhena candanena vilepanam | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ navānnaṃ kandamūlakam ||57|| tāmbūlaṃ karpūraṃ vastraṃ phalamārārtrikaṃ tathā | pradakṣiṇaṃ namaskāraṃ stavanaṃ kusumāñjalim ||58|| daṇḍavacca kṣamāyāñcāṃ kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ tathā | rātrau yāmatraye’tīte prārthanā sa cakāra vai ||59|| kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa hare kṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa namo’stu te | dīnāndhaduḥkhamagnānāṃ tvameva śaraṇaṃ sukham ||1.229.6 0 || tava pādaprasevāyāḥ phalaṃ nityaṃ mahāsukham | duḥkhaṃ sarvaṃ vinaśyedvai tava dvādaśīsevinām ||6 1 || daśamīvedhajaṃ pāpaṃ yatkṛtaṃ mama pūrvajaiḥ | tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yātu mokṣaṃ yāntu ca pūrvajāḥ ||62|| yathā pretatvaśūnyāḥ syurmama pūrvapitāmahāḥ | muktiṃ prayānti deveśa tathā kuru jagatpate ||63|| mayā śivaprabhaktena tavāpi helanaṃ kṛtam | pūjanaṃ vandanaṃ tīrthaṃ me darśanaṃ naiva yat kṛtam ||64|| tajjanyaṃ yanmahatapāpaṃ vilayaṃ yātu me sadā | na kṛtā dvārakāyātrā na kṛṣṇo’tra prasevitaḥ ||65|| na snātā gomatī yacca doṣa mārjaya taddhare | adyaprabhṛti dāso’smi vaiṣṇavastava keśava ||66|| tava pūjā tava vrataṃ tava pāṭhaṃ ca sevanam | lepanaṃ kīrtanaṃ stotraṃ kariṣye vandanaṃ tava ||67|| śravaṇaṃ te kathāyāśca pādodakasya dhāraṇam | naivedyabhakṣaṇaṃ te ca kariṣyāmi hare sadā ||68|| prasanno bhava bhagavan pāpaṃ prajvālaya mama | muktiṃ kuru ca pitṝṇāṃ prārthanāṃ svīkuru prabho ||69|| śrutvaitadvacanaṃ devaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prāvirāsa vai | candracaryan tava bhaktyā tuṣṭo’smi pitaraśca te ||1.229.70|| tvaṃ ca pāpāni nirdhūya gantāro mama dhāma yat | uktvā kṛṣṇastiro’bhūcca pitaraḥ samupasthitāḥ ||71 || procuḥ putra tava yatnānmuktiṃ prāptā na saṃśayaḥ | gomatī nīradānena piṇḍadānena darśanāt ||72|| pretayonivinirmuktā gacchāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim | dhanyāste pitaro loke yatkule dvārakāṃ sutaḥ ||73|| gatvā tu tārayet pitṝn kṛṣṇasevādibhiḥ sadā | dhanyā sā vidhavā nārī kṛṣṇayātrāṃ karoti yā ||74|| tārayatyeva janakaṃ svāminaṃ ca kulaṃ śatam | śvapaco’pi yadi tīrthaṃ karoti kṛṣṇamānasaḥ || 75|| sa yāti paramāṃ muktiṃ pitṛbhiḥ parivāritaḥ | yasmāt sarvāṇi tīrthāni sarvadevāstathā makhāḥ ||76|| dvārakāyāṃ samāyānti trikālaṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau | phalaṃ samagratīrthānāṃ tato’tra labhate janaḥ ||77|| dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ yastu dvārakāṃ naiva paśyati | dhik sutaṃ ca kulaṃ tasya pitaro narake sthitāḥ ||78|| brahmā rudrastathā sūryo mahendrādyāśca devatāḥ | mānavāśca nṛpā viprāḥ sarpā nāgāśca pattalāḥ ||79|| nadā nadyaśca śailāśca vanānyupavanāni ca | puryo grāmā nagaryaśca sāgarāśca sarāṃsi ca ||1.229.80 || yakṣā gaṇāśca gandharvāḥ siddhā vidyādharāstathā | apsarasaśca paryaśca dhanado daityarākṣasāḥ ||81|| ṛṣayo munayo yogāḥ sanakādyāśca sādhavaḥ | sādhvyaśca yoginīcakraṃ sāṃkhyayoginya ityapi ||82|| gṛhanakṣatrayogāśca dhruvaśca lokapālakāḥ | yatkiṃcittu trilokyāṃ vai vartate sthāṇujaṃgamam |||83 || śrīkṛṣṇasannidhau nityaṃ tiṣṭhate pratyahaṃ hi tat | na tyajati purīṃ puṇyāṃ dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇamaṇḍitām ||84|| sā tvayā sevitā putra vayaṃ ca kṛṣṇadarśanāt | pretayonipramuktāḥ smo gacchāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim ||85 || svasti te’stu na gacchāmo golokaṃ divyadhāma tat | prāptaṃ kṛṣṇapadaṃ putra tvaṃ ca gantāsi dhāma tat ||86|| na kalau phaladā vedā na dānāni makhā na ca | gomatī phaladā svargamokṣadā sarvathā matā ||87|| kalau kāśī ca mathurā hyavantī revatācalaḥ | ayodhyā kuṃkumavāpī kāṃcī ca puruṣottamā ||88|| śālagrāmā nadī māyā badarī ca tathā gayā | kurukṣetraṃ bhṛgukṣetraṃ puṣkaraṃ śuklatīrthakam ||89|| prayāgaśca prabhāsaśca hāṭakeśvara ityapi | gaṃgādvāraṃ ca vārāhaṃ gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgamaḥ ||1.229.9 0|| naimiṣaṃ daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ tathā vṛndāvanaṃ suta | sindhukṣetraṃ cārbudaṃ ca sarvāraṇyāni yāni ca ||9 1 || vanānyāyatanānyeva tathoparāṇi yāni ca | śailā śaileyatīrthāni himāni ca vanāni ca ||92|| saritaḥ sāgarāḥ sarve kṛṣṇasevanalālasāḥ | pāpanāśaprakāmāśca divyānandābhilāṣukāḥ ||93|| tiṣṭhanti gomatīnīre dvārakāyāṃ kalau yuge | nāsti vai triṣu lokeṣu purī tu dvārakāsamā ||94|| tavāyuḥpūrṇatāprāptau mṛtyurdivyo bhaviṣyati | triḥspṛśāvāsare śukle vaiśākhe budhavāsare || 95|| brahmarandhreṇa te yānaṃ bhaviṣyati harergṛhe | ityuktvā pitarastasya caturbhujasvarūpiṇaḥ ||96|| divyavimānasaṃsthāśca yātā golokadhāma tat | somaśarmā yayau svasya gṛhaṃ bhūtvā ca vaiṣṇavaḥ ||97|| āyuṣo’nta tu samprāpte gatvā dvāravatīṃ purīm | prāṇān kṛṣṇopadeśena tyaktvā mokṣaṃ jagāma saḥ ||98|| śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ caiva māhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam | jāyate vai phalaṃ sarvaṃ cānte mokṣo bhaved dhruvaḥ ||99|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śivabhaktasya somaśarmaṇaḥ pitṝṇāṃ dvārakāyātrādinā mokṣaṇanirūpaṇanāmaikonatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||229||
<1.230> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śaṃkhoddhāraṃ mahātīrthaṃ śaṃkhāsuro’tra śārṅgiṇā | uddhārito’sti kṛṣṇena tatra gacchettu muktaye || 1 || prabhāsādyāni tīrthāni gaṃgādyā āpagāstathā | śailāḥ samudrāḥ kṣetrāṇi divyāścaityadrumāstathā || 2 || aśvamedhādayo yajñā mahendrādyāśca devatāḥ | bhṛgvādyāḥ ṛṣayaścaiva gandharvāstumburuprathāḥ || 3 || dhaneśāśca kuberādyā viśvaksenādipārṣadāḥ | brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca siddhāścāpsarasastathā || 4 || paryo’tha kiṃ bahuktena trailokyaṃ jaḍacetanam | adhyātmasaṃsargagataṃ śaṃkhoddhāre pratiṣṭhati || 5 || ye smaranti gṛhe nityaṃ śaṃkhoddhāraṃ mahatsaraḥ | teṣāṃ na punarāvṛttiryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 6 || ye tu smaranti manasā śaṃkhoddhāraṃ ca śaṃkhinam | kulakoṭiśatairyuktāḥ kṛṣṇaloke vasanti te || 7 || yatphalaṃ tu sarasvatyāṃ sūryagrahaṇakoṭibhiḥ | yo yatīn bhojayed bhaktyā nityamabdaśataṃ naraḥ || 8 || śaṃkhoddhāre ca nuḥ snātuḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm | trīṇi koṭīni sārdhāni tīrthānāṃ ca mama priye || 9 || śaṃkhoddhāre nivāso’sti sarvatīrthaphalaṃ tataḥ | brahmahatyāsahasrāṇi cāgamyāgamanāni ca || 1.230.10 || pāpāni nāśamāyānti śaṃkhoddhārajalaspṛśeḥ | yo dadyād gāṃ gṛhaṃ svarṇe labhate koṭijaṃ phalam || 11 || kurukṣetrasya vāsena gaṃgāyāṃ maraṇena ca | gomatīsnānamātreṇa phalaṃ śaṃkhasthadarśanāt || 12|| jalamadhye samudrasya dvārakā cātidurjayā | tasyā madhye sthito devaḥ śaṃkhī pāpapraṇāśanaḥ || 1 3|| tataḥ piṇḍārakaṃ tīrthaṃ gacchedvai pāpanāśakam | yatra kṛṣṇaścaturbāhuḥ svayaṃ santiṣṭhate sadā || 14|| sarit rukmavatī yatra tatra snātvā vimucyate | agastyasya ṛṣestatra taḍāgaṃ lokaviśrutam || 15|| snātvā śrāddhaṃ tathā kṛtvā pitṝnvai mocayet sutaḥ | yajñavāṭastathā tīrthaṃ yatra pūrvaḥ prajāpatiḥ || 16 || yajñaṃ cakāra vidhinā savalokahitāya vai | yajñanāśayiturhastau yatra daityasya kartitau || 17|| viṣṇunā devadevena taddṛṣṭvā mucyate hyaghāt | pitarastatra piṇḍān vai samicchanti sutṛptaye || 18|| vaiśākhe tu kṛte śrāddhe mucyate pātakatrayāt | dānaṃ śrāddhaṃ vrataṃ jāpastarpaṇaṃ kāryamityapi || 19|| aśvamedhasahasrasya rājasūyaśatasya ca | pade pade phalaṃ syācca dvārakāṃ gacchatastu nuḥ ||1.230.20|| piṇḍārakaṃ smarataśca tatphalaṃ bhavati dhruvam | śrīkṛṣṇaṃ mandire dṛṣṭvā śaṃkhoddhāre tu śaṃkhinam || 21 || piṇḍārake caturbāhūm vīkṣya muktimavāpnuyāt | śrīḥ kṛṣṇaścakratīrthaṃ ca piṇḍārakaṃ ca gomatī ||22| gopīcandanamevāpi tulasī durlabhā kalau | tāni milanti tu dvāravatyāṃ kṛṣṇaprasaṃgataḥ ||23|| varddhinī dvārakā gaṃgā lakṣmīrgovinda ityapi | gomatī gopikātālamṛttikā ceti durlabhāḥ ||24|| yasya jāgaraṇaṃ jātaṃ vardhinī dvādaśīdine | punarjanmakṛtaṃ dagdhaṃ tena bhaktena sarvathā |||25||| trispṛśāvāsare yena kṛtaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ priye | keśavasya śarīre vai sa līno bhavati dhruvam ||26 || kṛṣṇāya preṃkhā dātavyā tasyāḥ puṇyamanantakam | svarṇapreṃkhā rājatīṃ vā kāṣṭhīyā vā tathāmbarī || 27|| deyā vai viṣṇave tasyāḥ phalaṃ vaikuṇṭhavāsanam | preṃkhāyāṃ ca hariṃ kṛṣṇamāndolayenmuhuḥ śanaiḥ || 28|| kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ caiva mokṣadaṃ puṇyamatra yat | kanyādānaṃ gayāśrāddhamaśvatthāropaṇaṃ tathā ||29||| dvādaśyāṃ jāgaraścāpi vājimedhāyutaiḥ samam | nimiṣe nimiṣe lakṣmi cāśvamedhaphalaṃ bhavet ||1.230.30 || sarve devāśca tīrthāni muktāśca munayastathā | samāyānti jāgaraṇe hyekādaśyāṃ niśi prabhoḥ ||3 1 || yāvatpadāni gṛhataḥ kṛṣṇasyāyatanaṃ prati | jāgarārthaṃ gacchataśca pādayoḥ pāṃsavaḥ khalu ||32|| spṛśanti yāvatsaṃkhyāni tāvatsahasravatsarāḥ | diviṃ bhogān prabhuktvā ca golokaṃ dhāma cāpnuyāt||| 32 || ekadā śaṃkaraṃ devī pārvatī prāha jāgare | kathaṃ śaṃbho vādayan vai rātrau ḍamaruṃ nṛtyasi ||34|| śaṃbhuḥ prāha mayā devī harivāsarajāgaraḥ | kriyate kṛṣṇatuṣṭyarthaṃ yatrālasyaṃ bhavennahi ||35|| yathākathaṃcidapi tu jāgaritavyameva vai | saṃgītena sunṛtyena kīrtanena surāsataḥ |||36 || naranārīsamudāyakṛtotsavena krīḍayā | kathayā vārtayā tālīvādanena ca sevayā ||37|| kṛṣṇaṃ smaratā bhaktena jāgaritavyameva yat | yatrālasyaṃ pramādo vā bhavennaiva tathācaret || 38 || ityahaṃ kṛṣṇatuṣṭyarthaṃ karomi nṛtyajāgaram | tvayā punaridaṃ kāryaṃ smartavyaḥ kamalāpatiḥ || 39 || ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyaṃ kartavyo jāgarastathā | goṣṭhyāṃ samāgatastatra sopi yāti parāṃ gatim || 1.230.40 || merumandaramātrāśca kṛtāḥ pāpasya rāśaya | kṛṣṇajāgaraṇe sarve uhyanti tūlarāśivat || 41 || sarvatīrthakratubhyo’pi jāgaraḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | sarve devāḥ samāyānti jāgare kṛṣṇavallabhe || 42|| nāryo bhavanti hṛdyāśca jāgare kṛṣṇavallabhāḥ | ityuktvā ca haropi virarāma kṛṣṇavallabhe || 43 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvārikāyāṃ śakhoddhāratīrthapiṇḍārakatīrtharukmavatī saridagastyataḍāgayajñatīrthaikādaśīdvādaśī vratajāgaraṇādipraśaṃsananāmā triṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 230 ||
<1.231> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi siṃharāśigate bṛhaspatau muniḥ | nārado gautamāśramaṃ yayau godāvarītaṭe || 1 || ekavarṣamuvāsātra dṛṣṭvāyātāni sarvaśaḥ | tīrthāni pāvanānyeva varṣakālaṃ sthitāni hi || 2 || vārāṇasī kurukṣetraṃ madhupurī hyavantikā | māyā kāṃcī ca sāketā gayā kuṃkumavāpikā || 3 || tisro gayā hariharakṣetraṃ ca puruṣottamā | prabhāsādīnyaraṇyānyāśramā gaṃgā sarasvatī || 4 || tāpī payoṣṇī sarayū bhīmarathī ca gaṇḍakī | kṛṣṇā svarṇā ca kāverī sarāṃsi jharaṇā yamī || 5 || caturdaśasu lokeṣu bhavanti yāni tāni vai | girayo bhūstarā dvipāḥ sthitā godāvarītaṭe || 6 || siṃhe bṛhaspatau tatra varṣamekaṃ praharṣitāḥ | sindhavaḥ puṣkarādyāśca maryādāparvatāstathā || 7 || prayāgaṃ vedaśāstrāṇi siddharṣimunidevatāḥ | pitarodyusurāścāpi bhūsurā yogisādhavaḥ || 8 || sādhvyo devyaśca devāśca varṣamūṣuḥ praharṣitāḥ | gautamo nārado vīkṣya tānyavasan maharṣayaḥ || 9 || kṣālāyitvā svapāpāni tairthikairarpitāni vai | gautamyāṃ ca tato gantumudyuktāni tu tāni vai || 1.231.10|| tīrthānyāsan tadā godāvarī nāradamabravīt | etāni sarvatīrthāni matprasaṃgena nārada || 1 1|| niṣpāpāni prajātāni pāpāni pradaduśca me | mayā tatpāpabhāraṃ kva kṣeptuṃ gantavyameva yat || 12|| adhunāhaṃ dahyamānā tattatpāpāgnibhiḥ prabho | kva yāmi bho mune’tyarthaṃ duḥkhitā kiṃ karomyanu || 13|| śrutvā tannārado dhyātvā kṣaṇaṃ maunaṃ samāsthitaḥ | tāvacca gautamo yogī tatrāyāto munīśvaraḥ || 14|| tīrthānyāhurmuniṃ tatra tvatprasādena gautamī | bhūtale yatsamāyātā tathā vai pāvitā vayam || 15|| tathā tvasmatprapāpāni godāvaryārjitāni vai | pāpamuktā jāyate sā tattu gautama cintyatām || 16|| gautamo’cintayat tādṛk tīrthaṃ pāpavināśakam | tathāpi tasya prajñāyāṃ na bhātaṃ balavattadā || 17|| maunamāsthāya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ cintayāmāsa gautamaḥ | tāvadākāśavāgdevī harṣayantī jagāda tām || 18|| śṛṇvantu tīrthamunyādyāḥ kṛpayā saṃvadāmyaham | paścimasya samudrasya tīramāśritya vartate || 19|| dvārakākṣetravaryaṃ ca yatrāste gomatī śubhā | paścimābhimukho yatra mahāviṣṇuḥ sadā sthitaḥ ||1.231.20|| tatsarvaṃ pāparāśīnāmugrāṇāmapi dāhakam | tad gamyatāṃ ca gautamyāḥ pāpadāhāya devatāḥ || 21 || śrutvā sarvottamaṃ kṣetraṃ jagarjustīrthadevatāḥ | jitaṃ bho jitamasmābhirdhanyā dhanyatamā vayam || 22|| ityuktvā niryayuḥ sarve dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇapālitām | durlabho dvārikāvāso durlabhaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam ||23|| durlabhaṃ gomatīsnānaṃ rukmiṇīdarśanaṃ tathā | dvārakādarśanaṃ puṇyaṃ cāsmākaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati || 24|| nārado gautamo godāvarī tīrthāni devatāḥ | sarve cābhyāyayurdvārāvatīsīmāntamādarāt || 25|| pṛṣṭhavanto nāradaṃ ca mudā tīrthavidhiṃ ca te | prāha vai nāradastām̐śca vidhiṃ ca jānāti yādṛśam ||26|| kṛtasnānastu gomatyāṃ tataḥ sampūjya gomatīm | kṛṣṇasya darśanaṃ kuryāt sādhūn viprān prabhojayet || 17|| kṛṣṇaprasādaṃ saṃbhujya śayīta bhuvi tīrthakṛt | prabhāte ca punaḥ snātvā sampūjya parameśvaram || 28|| pradakṣiṇaṃ namaskṛtvā sadgurum praṇipatya ca | gītaṃ ca kīrtanaṃ kuryāt bhajanaṃ śrīharestathā || 29 || brahmacaryaṃ prarakṣecca niyamyetendriyāṇi ca | devānāṃ ca satāṃ pādasaṃvāhanamathācaret || 1.231.30 || darśanaṃ pūjanaṃ kuryān dānaṃ dadyācca śaktitaḥ | api svalpaṃ yathāśakti kṛtaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet|| | 31 || ekagrāsasya dānasya yāvadbhūdānajaṃ phalam | ekasmin bhojite sādhau rājasūyāyutaṃ phalam || 32|| upānadannapānīyapādukāchatrakambalān | vāsāṃsi toyapātrāṇi dadyāt kṛṣṇāya tuṣṭaye || 33 || yasya hastau ca pādau ca mano jihvā janīndriyam | saṃyatāni bhavettasya tīrthapuṇyamanantakam || 34|| parānnaṃ parapākaṃ ca paravastu vivarjayet | śrotavyā satkathā viṣṇorjaptavyaṃ nāma vai hareḥ || 35 || utsavaśca prakartavyo gītavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ | ārārtrikaṃ phalaṃ cāpi naivedyaṃ cārpayettathā || 36 || ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ kṛṣṇapūjanaṃ kārayettathā | na śakyate phalaṃ tasya vaktuṃ vai yugasaṃkhyayā || 37|| evaṃ te nāradenoktāstīrthadevamaharṣayaḥ | cakrustīrthe yathoktaṃ tatsarvaṃ bhaktisamanvitam || 38 || śṛṇvanti tatkathāḥ kecid varṇayanti guṇāntare | gāyanti ca yaśaḥ kecitsmaranti śrīhariṃ pare || 39 || kecijjapanti tannāma kecit kurvanti darśanam | utsavaiśca vrajantyanye nṛtyanti cāpare tadā ||1.231.40 || kecid garjanti yugapajjayaśabdaṃ harermuhuḥ | gṛhaṃ harermārjayanti raṭanti vaiṣṇavaṃ manum || 41 || premamagnāḥ prahasanti spṛśanti sādhupatkajam | kurvanti guṇagānaṃ militā pathi sarvathā || 42|| maṇḍalībhūya tīrthāni kurvanti tairthikaṃ vidhim | tān dṛṣṭvā brahmahāḥ śuddhaye satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmi te || 43 || ete vai vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve naranārī svarūpiṇaḥ | prayāgādīni tīrthāni kṣetrāṇi śailasāgarāḥ || 44|| nararūpadharāḥ sarve saṃghaṃ kṛtvā prayānti vai | gaṃgādyāḥ sarito devyo nārī rūpairyayustadā || 45 || kuṃkumavāpikā svasyāstīrthānyādāya saṃyayau | caturdaśastarasthānāṃ saṃgho divyo hyabhūttadā ||46 || vādanaṃ kīrtanaṃ saṃghe sarve kurvanti vai tadā | dvārikāyā mahāyātrā kṛtā saṃghena vai tadā || 47|| gomatyāṃ ca kṛtaṃ snānaṃ kṛṣṇasya darśanaṃ kṛtam | yātrāvidhiḥ kṛtaḥ sarvaḥ pāpaṃ sarvaṃ vināśitam ||48|| godāvarī saṃghayuktā cātiśuddhābhavattadā | tatkālīnaṃ rajasteṣāṃ pathi vai gacchatāṃ ca yat | spṛṣṭaṃ syādaśvamedhānāṃ puṇyadaṃ varṇayāmi kim ||49|| ekaikasminpade datte dvārakāpathi gacchatām | puṇyaṃ kratusahasrāṇāṃ pratyekarajasā bhavet ||1.231.50|| nārada prāha sarvāṃstān divyām̐stairthikasaṃghagān | rāśayaḥ puṇyapuñjānāṃ yuṣmākaṃ vai sahasraśaḥ ||51|| yaiḥ kṛtaṃ gomatītīrthaṃ darśanaṃ śrīharestathā | yūyaṃ sarvāṇi tīrthāni kṣetrāṇyapi ca kṛtsnaśaḥ |||52|| dhanyānyatra bhavadbhiśca dṛṣṭā kṛṣṇapurī yataḥ | imāṃ paśyati tīrthāni yūyaṃ sarvāḥ saridvarāḥ ||53|| dvārakā naśca pāpānāṃ hantrī tīrthottamottamā | brahmāṇḍasya kīrtikarī dvārakā kṛṣṇavallabhā ||54|| gomatī kṛṣṇadevaśca rukmiṇī ca haripriyā | golokasadṛśī ceyaṃ rājate sarvato’dhikā ||55|| bhū vaikuṇṭhamiti bodhyā vaikuṇṭhapratimā nviyam | nāradena praśaṃsāyāṃ varṇitāyāṃ tadā svayam ||56|| dvārakā gomatī mūrtimatī svāgatakāṃkṣayā | samāgatā tadā devaistīrthaiścāpi namaskṛtā ||57|| nāradaśca tadā prāha dvārakāṃ gomatīṃ tathā | namaskurvanti te pādau gautamī ca prayāgarāṭ |||98|| gaṃgā ca narmadā sūryaputrī prācī sarasvatī | candrabhāgā ca sarayūḥ kṣiprā kuṃkumavāpikā ||59|| sindhuḥ śoṇā gaṇḍakī ca vipāśā tapatī tathā | kṛṣṇā bhīmarathī svarṇā payoṣṇī tvāṃ namanti vai ||1.231.60|| iyaṃ vārāṇasī te vai pādayornamati dhruvam | kurukṣetraṃ mathurā cāvantikā tvāṃ namanti vai ||6 1 || māyāyodhyā gayā kāṃcī viśālā tvāṃ namanti ca | śālagrāmaṃ mahākṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ puruṣottamam ||6 2|| saptābdhayo dhenukaṃ ca daśāraṇyaṃ ca daṇḍakam | arbudaṃ ca kurukṣetraṃ dharmāraṇyaṃ ca kālakam ||63 || nārāyaṇasaraścāpi puṣkaraṃ gokulaṃ tathā | mānasaṃ merukailāsau mandaro himavām̐stathā ||64|| vindhyo namanti te pādau dvārike kṛṣṇasevite | vadato nāradasyaivaṃ dvārakā hṛṣṭamānasā ||65 || uvāca lalitāṃ vācaṃ karaiḥ saṃsmṛtya gomatīm | yūyaṃ dhanyāḥ samāyātā mam lābho mahānayam ||66|| sarveṣāṃ svāgataṃ kurve bhuñjantāṃ kṛṣṇabhojanam | pibata kṛṣṇacaraṇāmṛtaṃ tiṣṭhata cātra vai ||67|| kṛṣṇayogānmama sparśāt pāpāni bhavatāṃ khalu | prajvalitāni sarvāṇi kṛpayā śrīharerhi vaḥ ||68|| iti svāgatasaṃlāpaiḥ sarvānānandayattadā | adṛśyanta ca vai vyomni brahmādyā devatāgaṇāḥ | 69|| śivā śivau gaṇairyuktau yakṣagandharvakiraṇaiḥ | maruto lokapālāśca siddhā vidyādharāstathā ||1.231.70 || viśvādityāḥ grahāḥ sarve bhṛgvādyāḥ ṛṣayastathā | maharṣayaḥ sanakādyā vairājāścāpyadhīśvarāḥ ||7 1|| patnīvratāśca nṛtyanti cāvateruḥ praharṣitāḥ | kṣmāyāṃ snātvā ca gomatyāṃ te cakruḥ kṛṣṇadarśanam ||72|| prasādaṃ ca jalaṃ pītvā dṛṣṭvā saṃghaṃ ca tairthikam | paramāścaryamāpannāstīrthāni jayateti ca ||73|| cakrurvai ghoṣaṇāṃ vāraṃvāraṃ hṛṣṭā hṛdantare | dvārikayā ca teṣāṃ vai svāgataṃ mānanaṃ kṛtam ||74|| gomatyāpi ca sarveṣāṃ pāpaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtam | praṇemuryugapatsarve devāstīrthāni bhāvataḥ ||75|| devasaṃghastīrthasaṃghaḥ parasparaṃ praṇematuḥ | praṇemuryugapat sarve prahṛṣṭāścābhavam̐stataḥ ||76|| jñātvā śraiṣṭhyaṃ dvārakāyā gomatyāḥ śraiṣṭhyamityapi | kṛṣṇakṛṣṇetikṛṣṇeti jaya kṛṣṇeti vādina ||77 |1 gomatyā dvārakāyāśca śriyaḥ kṛṣṇasya te tadā | pūjanaṃ divyavastraiśca divyagandhānulepanaiḥ ||78|| sudivyābharaṇairbhaktyā sadratnahīrakādibhiḥ | divyamālyavibhūṣābhiḥ karpūrāgurucandanaiḥ ||79|| tulasyā kesarairdhūpairnīrājanapradakṣiṇaiḥ | naivedyairvividhairdivyairmiṣṭairmiṣṭānnapānakaiḥ ||1.231.80|| tāmbūlaiḥ svāducūrṇaiśca priyaiścopāyanaistathā | mahāmāṃgalyasaddravyaiścāmaravyajanādibhiḥ ||8 1 || sampūjya kṛtakṛtyāste nanṛtuḥ purato hareḥ | tadā kṛṣṇaḥ svayamāvirbhūtastānprāha saṃhasan ||82|| bho tīrthāni tathā devā devyaḥ śailā maharṣayaḥ | prīto’haṃ bhavatāṃ tīrthavidhānena ca vo’stu śam ||83|| tīrthādyāśca tadā prāhustāritāḥ paramātmanā | prāptaḥ kāmavaro’smābhirbhavataḥ kṛpayā bibho ||84|| bhūyāt tava padāmbhoje bhaktirno hyanapāyinī | tathā syācca hi sarveṣāṃ vandyeyaṃ dvārakā sadā ||85|| ityuktvā ca tadā saṃghau dvāvapi dvārakāṃ tathā | gomatīṃ sarvatīrthānāmādhipatye’bhyaṣiñcatām ||86|| divyopacārakaiḥ pūjāṃ cakrāte prāñjalī muhuḥ | tadāyātā mahādivyāḥ puruṣāḥ pārṣadā hareḥ ||87|| ūcuśca tīrtharājānāṃ mahārājñī tviyaṃ śubhā | dvārakā sevanīyā vai sthīyantāṃ svecchayā sadā ||88|| tadā pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā dvārakāṃ praṇipatya ca | āvāsāñcakrire tatra kṣetratīrthasurādayaḥ ||89|| pañcāśatkoṭitīrthāni sthitānyuttarataḥ priye | nadyastu pūrvadigbhāge tīrthaiḥ ṣaṣṭiprakoṭibhiḥ ||1.231.90|| dakṣiṇasyāṃ tīrthaśailāraṇyādīni sarāṃsi ca | sthitāni svakuṭumbaiśca navanavatikoṭibhiḥ ||9 1|| sāgarādyāśca saptādyāḥ paścimāyāṃ diśi sthitāḥ | vidiśāsu ca sarvāsu tīrthasaṃkhyā na vidyate |||92||| śatakoṭipratīrthāni vasantyudadhisaṃgame | vārāṇasī ca hīśāne hyavantī pūrvadiksthitā ||93|| āgneyyāṃ kuṃkumavāpī kāṃcī dakṣe tu māthurī | nairṛtyāṃ ca sthitā māyā hyayodhyā paścime sthitā ||94|| vāyavyāṃ kurukṣetraṃ ca harikṣetraṃ tathottare | tīrthakṣetrādibhiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ prapālitam ||95|| prajeśvarairdvitīyaṃ tu tṛtīyaṃ devanāyakaiḥ | caturthamṛṣisiddhaughairgaṃgādyābhiśca paṃcamam ||96|| ṣaṣṭhaṃ cāvaraṇaṃ tīrthaiḥ kāśyādyābhiśca saptamam | aṣṭamaṃ kṣetramukhyādyairnavamaṃ cāśramādibhiḥ ||97|| mervādyairdaśamaṃ divyadṛśaḥ paśyanti tāni vai | iti vai pārṣadā devā stīrthāni cānyapāvanā ||98|| nivāsaṃ cakrire sveṣāṃ dvitīyairvai svarūpakaiḥ | vidāyaṃ te samagṛhya śrīkṛṣṇād gomatīvarāt ||99|| tīrthaṃ kṛtvā yayuḥ sarve tīrthadevādipārṣadāḥ | āyānti prativarṣaṃ ca siṃharāśisthite gurau || 1.231.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvārakāmāhātmye siṃharāśisthabṛhaspatau godāvarīsahitasarvatīrthasarvadevasarvapārṣadādīnāṃ dvārikātīrthe saṃghaśaḥ samāgamanaṃ tatra vāsaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ |||23 1||
<1.232> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca viśeṣeṇa mahālakṣmi siṃharāśisthite gurau | dvārakātīrthakartṝṇāṃ dahyanti pāparāśayaḥ || 1 || prativarṣaṃ prakurvanti dvārakāgamanaṃ tu ye | teṣāṃ pādarajaḥ spṛṣṭvā muktiṃ prayānti mānavāḥ || 2 || dilīpena vaśiṣṭhāya pṛṣṭhaṃ pūrvaṃ vadāmi tat | anyakṣetre kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ naśyati tīrthasevanāt || 3 || tīrthakṣetrajapāpānāṃ vajralepatvamucyate | vajralepāyato’ghasya kvāpyasti mokṣaṇaṃ na vā || 4 || yatra pāpapraroho na tatkṣetraṃ kathyatāṃ mune | śrutvā tad divyacakṣuṣko vaśiṣṭhaḥ prāha bhūpatim || 5 || māyānando yatiḥ kaścid tridaṇḍī kāśikāsthitaḥ | yuvatyāṃ khalu mātaṃgyāṃ surūpāyāṃ vimohitaḥ || 6 || rājasena ca bhāvena cākṛṣṭo madyamāṃsakam | yuyuje bhojane kāmagarveṇa matimohitaḥ || 7 || cāṇḍālatāṃ vahan rātrau cauryaṃ karoti lobhataḥ | pāpāni vardhitānyasya mātaṃgyāḥ saṃgatermuhuḥ || 8 || kāśyāṃ kālavaśātso’pi mṛtastiryagvṛko’bhavat | tato vyāghro markaṭaḥ śvā śṛgālaḥ śūkaro’bhavat || 9 || pāpaṃ janmasahasraistannānaśyadatha coṣare | nirjane rākṣaso jātismaro’bhūtkāśikābalāt || 1.232.1 0|| aṭannaraṇyaśailām̐śca vindhyādriṃ prāpa rākṣasaḥ | tatrābhūt tasya sāścaryaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ pāpayonitaḥ || 11 || dvārāvatyāṃ mahāyātrāṃ kṛtvā ca kṛṣṇadarśanam | snātvā ca gomatīnīre pītvā kṛṣṇāmṛtaṃ jalam || 12|| kaścid vipro gayāvāsī gacchan gṛhaṃ pathi sthitaḥ | vindhyādrau vṛkṣasustambe viśrāntyarthaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sadā || 13 || tamūrdhvatilakaṃ vipraṃ bhaktaṃ tulasīmālikam | gomatīnīrasaṃpūtaṃ tatra dadarśa rākṣasaḥ || 14|| tasya darśanamātreṇa vajralepo’ghasañcayaḥ | bhāviduḥkhaprado’pyasya bhasmasādabhavat kṣaṇāt || 15|| reje puṇyaprakāśena kṛṣṇapānthikadarśanāt | tato’bhimukhamabhyetya dvārakākṛṣṇapānthikam || 16|| natvā stutvā ca taṃ prāha tavādya darśanānmama | vajralepo’ghasaṃbhāro dagdho mukto’smi sarvathā || 17|| tataḥ pāntho’vrajat svasya gṛhaṃ cāpyatha rākṣasaḥ | samprāpto dvārakāṃ tatra jñātvā tīrthabalaṃ mahat||| 18|| gomatyāṃ svatanuṃ tyaktvā prāptaśca vaiṣṇavaṃ padam | na prarohanti pāpāni yasyā yātrāludarśanāt || 19|| dvārāvatyāstadā sākṣād yoge vācyaṃ nu kiṃ phalam | vajralepātilepānāṃ pāpānāṃ dāhakaṃ mahat ||1.232.20||| sarvakṣetrapramūrdhanyaṃ kṣetraṃ golokajaṃ param | dvārakākṣetramevāsti kṛṣṇena sthāpitaṃ bhuvi || 21 || śrutvā cāpi dilīpopi tīrthārthaṃ dvārakāṃ yayau | kṛṣṇaṃ ca gomatīṃ dṛṣṭvā parāṃ siddhimupāyayau ||22| dvārakāyāṃ sthitāścaturbhujāḥ narāśca yoṣitaḥ | golokasthā bhavantyeva tānpaśyanti divaukasaḥ ||23 || api kīṭapataṃgādyā jaḍāśca sthāvarāstathā | dvārakāvāsamāpannā divyā golokamūrtayaḥ ||24|| gatirdvāravatīsthānāṃ durlabhā cordhvaretasām | dvārakāyāṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ dattaṃ snātaṃ tapaḥ kṛtam ||25 || sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ lakṣmi hyanantaṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau | dvārakāyāṃ sthitāḥ sarve narā nāryaścaturbhujāḥ ||26 || dvārakāyāṃ na vai pāpaṃ prarohati harerbalāt | supuṇyāḥ pāṃsavo yasyāḥ pāpināṃ muktikārakāḥ ||27|| kuśāvartāt samārabhya yāvacca sāgarānvitā | gomatī bhavati tatra siṃharāśigate gurau ||28|| snānaṃ tu dviṣaṣṭigodāvarīsnānādhikaṃ phalet | dvārakāṃ gomatīṃ gopīsaraḥ śrīṃkṛṣṇameva ca ||29|| smaranti pratyahaṃ ye tu sahasrayojanasthitāḥ | te’pi dvārāvatītīrthapūrṇaphalaprabhāginaḥ ||1.232.30|| mitradhugbhrātṛhā goghnaḥ paradārarataśca yaḥ | mātṛhā pitṛhābhrūṇabrahmahā gurutalpagaḥ |||3 1 || sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyante dvārakākṛṣṇadarśanāt | viśeṣeṇa tu vaiśākhyāṃ jayantyāṃ viṣṇuvāsare ||32|| māghe ca phālgune caiva caitre cāpi viśeṣataḥ | paurṇamāsyāmamāyāṃ caikādaśyāṃ saṃgame tathā ||33|| dvādaśyāṃ ca pratipakṣaṃ rohiṇyāṃ śravaṇe tathā | puṣye punarvasau caiva vyatīpāte dinakṣaye ||34|| sapuṣyatithinakṣatre grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ | śrīkṛṣṇadarśanaṃ dvārāvatyāmanantapuṇyadam ||35|| yasyāṃ satraṃ prapāṃ saudhaṃ prāsādaṃ maṭhameva vā | yatisādhuvāsaśālāṃ sādhvīśālāṃ ca mandiram ||36|| vāpīṃ kūpaṃ taḍāgaṃ ca jīrṇoddhāraṃ ca jīvikām | mūrterviṣṇoḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca rājabhogādikaṃ tathā || 37|| kārayitvā naro nārī bhuktvā bhogān divi sthitān| vairājān vaikuṇṭhabhogān prāpnuyāt kṛṣṇasāmyatām ||38|| sthāpayed dvāravatyāṃ yo mūrtiṃ dāruśilāmayīm | sārvabhaumatvamāptvaiva śrīviṣṇoḥ sāmyatāṃ vrajet ||39|| dvārikātīrthasaṃyātāḥ kulamekottaraṃ śatam | tārayantyeva gotrāṇāṃ saptānāṃ kṛṣṇayogataḥ ||1.232.40|| ekaikasminpade datte purīṃ dvārāvatīṃ prati | puṇyaṃ kratusahasrāṇāṃ kalau bhavati dehinām ||41|| pāṣāṇaścakracihno’pi dṛṣṭo yena sa muktibhāg | sudarśanaścaikacakro lakṣmīnārāyaṇāvubhau ||42|| tribhiścaivācyutaścaindraścatuḥcakro janārdanaḥ | pañcabhirvāsudevaḥ saḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ pradyumna eva saḥ ||43|| saptabhirbaladevaḥ sa cāṣṭabhiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | sarvātmā navacakraśca daśacakro daśaprabhuḥ ||44|| ekādaśairmahāviṣṇudvādaśātmā tu mokṣadaḥ | ataūrdhvamananto’sau bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ ||45|| vṛṣotsarge prakurvanti vaiśākhyāṃ caiva kārtike | dvārakāyāṃ piśācatvaṃ muktvā muktāḥ pitāmahāḥ ||46|| kulakoṭisahasrāṇi kulakoṭiśatāni ca | vasanti tatpadaṃ viṣṇostrispṛśākṛṣṇadarśanāt ||47|| sukarmasthā vikarmasthā yānti śrīkṛṣṇamandire | saptaṣaṣṭiṣu tīrtheṣu snānāt kiṃ vai mama priye ||48|| samprāpte mānuṣe dehe dvārakāṃ na gato yadi | dvārakāsthā janā divyāḥ śocantyenaṃ vṛthājanim ||49|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi mama kṣetrasya sarvathā | māhātmyaṃ śravaṇād yasya muktiḥ karagatā matā ||1.232.50|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvārakāmāhātmye kāśīsthamāyānandayatervajralepapāpanā śakadvārakāyātrālumahimakathanādināmā dvātriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||232||
<1.233> śrīlakṣmīruvāca nārāyaṇa mahāviṣṇo kṛṣṇa śrīkamalāpate | dvārakāmṛttasaṃśrāvānmamānandaḥ prajāyate || 1 || kṛtakṛtyā kṛtā cādya kṛpālunā tvayā prabho | trispṛśāyāstu māhātmyaṃ svarūpaṃ vāpi me vada || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi trispṛśāyāṃ māhātmyaṃ kathayāmi te | yatsamaṃ na vrataṃ cānyat phaladaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā || 3 || yatphalaṃ tu samāśrutya mucyate karmabandhanāt | mokṣaṃ yāti vratādeśād vratāt hṛṣyati mādhavaḥ || 4 || tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi sarvasaṃkalpapūrakam | pratyakṣamarcitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛtaṃ yena vrataṃ hi tat || 5 || trispṛśāyā nāmavaktā puraścaraṇapuṇyabhāk | na vedairna purākhyānairna yajñaistīrtharāśibhiḥ || 6 || anyairasaṃkhyakṛcchraiśca pūjitairdevatādibhiḥ | muktiḥ syātpadmaje tasya trispṛśā nārjitā yadi || 7 || brahmaṇābhisamāpṛṣṭaścāhaṃ saṃproktavām̐stadā | viṣayārttijanavrātatāraṇāya mahāpathaḥ || 8 || trispṛśāvratamevokto nānyaḥ panthāḥ pramuktidaḥ | indriyavājimattānāṃ sthairyaṃ na tapasā vinā || 9 || tapastrisparśagā hyekādaśī proktā mayā tadā | viṣayāraṇyamagnāśca kariṣyanti yadi vratam || 1.233.1 0|| trispṛśāyāstadā teṣāṃ muktiḥ śāśvatakālikī | seyaṃ mokṣapradā kāryā kṛtā bahusaduttamaiḥ || 1 1|| kārtike śuklapakṣe sā yarhi bhavati yogataḥ | somayajñāyutapuṇyapradā sā muktidottare || 12| hatyākoṭimahāpāpanāśayitrī mahābalā | brahmahatyādipāpāni trispṛśāvratasaṃśrayāt || 13|| yānti pravilayaṃ sadyaḥ pāpeṣvanyeṣu kā kathā | na prayāge puṣkare vā badaryāṃ kāśikāsthale || 14|| gomatyāṃ naiva revāyāṃ raivate nendradyumnake | kuṃkumavāpyāṃ kedāre rāmeśvare na māthure || 15|| muktirbhavenmahālakṣmi trispṛśā yadi no kṛtā | prāṇatyāgātprayāge vā kāśyāṃ kuśapure tathā || 16 || gomatyāṃ snānakaraṇāt yā muktiḥ śāśvatī matā | sā gṛhe jāyate muktistrispṛśāyā upoṣaṇāt || 17|| ajñānāṃ muktidā proktā strīśūdrāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ | vijñānadā sadā puṇyā pavitrā paramārthadā || 18|| kalyāṇajananī sadyo dharmārthakāmamokṣadā | jīvanī viṣṇubhaktānāṃ nārīṇāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ || 19|| sarveṣāṃ pāvanī puṇyā jananī vedamātṛvat | pāvanī kamalātulyā rakṣikā ramayā samā ||1.233.20|| sāṃkhyayogaphalādhikyaphalavyāptaphalapradā | tīrthakoṭiśatairyuktā jāhnavīṃ snānakāmyayā ||21 || gomatyāṃ yāti kṛṣṇasya sannidhau śuddhihetave | tīrthakoṭisahasrāṇi tiṣṭhanti gomatī sthale ||22|| sāpi vrataṃ trispṛśāyāḥ karoti pāpaśuddhaye | brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ govadhaḥ pramadāvadhaḥ ||23 || brahmadevasvaharaṇaṃ mātāpitrośca tāḍanam | gurudroho haredrohastathā cābhakṣyabhakṣaṇam ||24|| agamyāgamanaṃ hiṃsta nindanaṃ ca satāṃ sadā | anyāni krūrakarmāṇi yāni pāpāni cāpyatha ||25|| vyapohatyeva sā lakṣmi trispṛśā pāvanottamā | sarasvatyadhikā yā vai tīrthārbudātipūjitā |||26|| koṭiyajñādhikā homadānapuṇyādhikā ca yā | japakoṭyadhikā puṇyā puruṣārthādhikā tathā |||27||| sāṃkhyayogādhikā cātmajñānamūrdhanyapūjitā | trispṛśā vratarūpā vai kāryā mokṣapradāyinī ||28|| ekādaśī sūryayoge paścācca dvādaśī tathā | trayodaśī niśāśeṣe trispṛśaikādaśī tu sā || 29|| aruṇodayavelāyāṃ sūryodayasya prāg yadi | daśamī vartate cet sa daśamīvedha ucyate ||1.233.3 0|| daśamīvedhajaṃ doṣaṃ na kṣamāmi mama priye || daśamīvedhasahitā na hyapoṣyā kvaciddhi sā ||3 1|| yathā rajasvalādoṣād duṣyatyapi ca tatpatiḥ | tathaiva daśamīviddhaikādaśī doṣadāyinī ||32|| daśamyekādaśī bhadrā dinaikye tu yadā bhavet | tadāpi trispṛśā sā tvāsurī varjyā prayatnataḥ ||33|| daśamīmiśritaṃ yena kṛtaṃ caikādaśīvratam | bhuktaṃ hālāhalaṃ tena kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ na tadvratam ||34|| janmakoṭikṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ santānaṃ yāti saṃkṣayam | patati svakulaṃ svargād yāti vai rauravaṃ tataḥ ||35|| tasmād vai daśamīyuktaṃ maddinaṃ varjyameva yat | vṛddhau tyājyā vedhavatī kartavyā dvādaśīyutā ||36|| mohinyai daśamīvedhe vāso datto’sti vedhasā | mahatpāpaṃ tato bodhyaṃ daśamīvedhayugvate ||37|| vṛddhau kṣaye ca vā tadvat sandehe samupasthite | mamājñayā sadā kāryā dvādaśī vallabhā mama ||38|| śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi trispṛśāvratasadvidhiḥ | palena vā palārdhena tadardhenāpi padmaje || 39|| pratimā mama sauvarṇī kāraṇīyā yathāvasu | tāmrapātre tilapūrṇe ghaṭo ratnajalādiyuk ||1.233.40|| patrapuṣpaśvetavastrakarpūrādiyutastathā | sthāpyo vai sarvatobhadramaṇḍale dhānyanirmite ||41|| ghaṭe sthālyāṃ kāñcanī sā mūrtiḥ sthāpyā mama priye | lakṣmīḥ sthāpyā mama pārśve tataḥ pūjāṃ samācaret |||42|| āvāhanaṃ cāsanaṃ ca pādyaṃ cārghyaṃ samarpayet | tata ācamanīyaṃ ca jalasnānaṃ samarpayet |||43||| dugdhasnānaṃ dadhisnānaṃ ghṛtasnānaṃ taduttaram | kārayeccharkarāsnānaṃ madhusnānaṃ samarpayet |||44|| abhiṣekaṃ jalaistairthaiḥ kārayenmārjayet paṭaiḥ | dhautraṃ ca śāṭikāṃ cāṃgarakṣakaṃ kaṃcukīṃ tathā |||45|| uttarīyaṃ tathā śāṭīṃ yajñopavītamityapi | dadyānmaṃgalasūtraṃ ca kaustubhaṃ tantikāmapi ||46|| keśaprasādhanaṃ kuryāt tailapuṣpādi dhārayet | kabarīṃ sādhayet cūḍāṃ gandhayed granthayettathā ||47|| kajjalaṃ netrayordadyād bhāle puṇḍraṃ sacandrakam | candanaṃ kasturīyuktaṃ karpūrāḍhyaṃ samarcayet ||48|| nāsānatthīṃ cibukaṃ ca ṭibakīṃ gaṇḍake’rpayet | kuṇḍale cairane karṇabhūṣaṇe śṛṃkhale tathā ||49|| sindūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ dadyādoṣṭhayoḥ raṃgaraṃjanam | kuryād dadyāt tulasyāśca hārānpauṣpānsugucchakān ||1.233.50 || svarṇaratnamaṇihārān śṛṃkhalāḥ kaṭakām̐stathā | ūrmikā raśanāṃ dadyāt kiṃkiṇyāḍhyasunūpurān ||51|| pāduke naktake yaṣṭyau dadyādattarakesarān | mukuṭaṃ śekharān karṇapūrān saṃdhārayettathā ||52|| vyajanaṃ pāduke dadyād rājayogyasvalaṃkṛtīn | tulasīmālike dadyāllakṣmīnārāyaṇāya me ||53|| gulālābīraraktani cākṣatān kusumāni ca | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ dadyāt śrīviṣṇave janaḥ ||54|| naivedyāni manojñāni miṣṭānnāni bahūnyapi | phalāni sumadhurāṇi dadyādvai śītalaṃ jalam ||55|| sugandhaṃ śāntidaṃ ceṣṭaṃ jalapānaṃ samarpayet | tāmbūlaṃ bahudravyāḍhyaṃ dadyānmukhasya śuddhaye ||56|| dadyācca mudrikāṃ svarṇāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ keśavāya vai | tadyattvapekṣitaṃ tatra pūjāyāṃ tat samarpayet ||57|| nīrājanaṃ navāvattaṃ pañcavartiprakāśitam | kuryāt tataḥ śubhravastrāmārjanaṃ triḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||58|| ānanāgre tataḥ kuryācchaṃkhabhrāmaṇamityatha | jalaṃ tvārdrāmbaraṃ mūrdhna uttārayet subhāvataḥ |||59|| daṇḍavacca stutiṃ kuryāt pradakṣiṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | namaskārān bahūn kuryāt kṣamāyācanamityapi ||1.233.60 || puṣpāñjaliṃ vikīryaiva prārthayetparameśvaram | netre sammīlya tanmūrtiṃ dhyāyet tiṣṭham̐stadagrataḥ |||6 1 || dāmodarāya vai pādau jānunī mādhavāya ca | guhyaṃ kāmasvarūpāya kaṭiṃ vāmanamūrtaye ||62|| padmanābhāya nābhiṃ vai jaṭharaṃ viśvahetave | hṛdayaṃ jñānadehāya kaṇṭhaṃ vaikuṇṭhavāsine ||63|| sahasrabāhave bāhū cakṣuṣī yogamūrtaye | sahasraśīrṣā śirasi sarvāṃgaṃ svāmine tathā ||64|| dhyāyāmi vyastarūpaṃ vai samastaṃ cāntare mama | dhyānagamyo mahārāja pāpaṃ nāśayasi drutam ||65|| smṛto harasi pāpāni duḥsvapnaṃ durvicintitam | durnimittaṃ bhayaṃ yāmyaṃ duḥkhaṃ durgatisaṃbhavam ||66|| anyacca yadbhaved daihyaṃ caihikaṃ pāralaukikam | rakṣa tasmācca sarvasmādaparādhācca duḥkhadāt ||67|| sadā bhaktistvayi cāstu lakṣmīnārāyaṇa prabho | dehi tvaccaraṇe dāsyaṃ naya vaikuṇṭhameva mām ||68|| trispṛśāyāḥ svayaṃ dhātā svāmī nārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ | bhavāneva harirmahyaṃ mokṣaṃ dadātu mādhavaḥ ||6 9|| iti stutvā tato nṛtyaṃ gītavāditrasaṃyutam | susvaraṃ susamadṛśyaṃ kuryād devasya sannidhau ||1.233.70|| evaṃ prātaḥ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayitvā suvarṇajām | mūrtimekādaśīrūpāṃ lakṣmīrūpāṃ vidhānataḥ ||71|| namaskṛtya tato gacchet kathāyāṃ satsamāgame | kīrtanena tathā bhaktyā bhajanena japena ca ||72|| śravaṇena smaraṇena sevanenāpi sarvathā | arcanenāthavā samyagvandanena dinaṃ nayet ||73|| nirāhāro jalāhāro naktabhuk caikabhojanaḥ | śakto’śakto vrataṃ kuryāt sveṣṭasampatphalapradam ||74|| madhyāhnasamaye dadyāt tāmbūlaṃ bhojanaṃ phalam | jalaṃ dadyāttathā śayyāṃ mañcagendukapārśvakām ||75|| sāyaṃ jalaṃ punardadyādārārtrikaṃ vidhānataḥ | pūjanaṃ ṣoḍaśavastuvaryaiḥ kuryācca bhāvataḥ ||76 || evaṃ guruṃ ca sampūjya kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ niśi | gītanṛtyasamācārakīrtanādyabhisaṃyutam ||77|| tato niśānte haraye dattvā cārghaṃ vidhānataḥ | snānādikāṃ kriyāṃ kṛtvā sādhūn viprān subhojayet ||78 || sādhvīśca bhojayed bālān dadyāddānāni dakṣiṇāḥ | evaṃ ca dvādaśībhāge trayodaśyāmathāpi vā || 79|| pāraṇārthaṃ prasādaṃ vai bhuṃjīta bhaktasaṃyutaḥ | maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ ghaṭaṃ cāpi hariṃ tathā ||1.233.80 || visarjayed vidhānena phalaṃ mokṣamavāpnuyāt | trispṛśāyā vratākhyānaṃ śrutvāsya tatphalaṃ milet ||8 1|| aśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni ca | kṛtānyeva kṛtaṃ yena trispṛśāsamupoṣaṇam |||82|| trispṛśāvratakṛdaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ kulāni vai | mātāpitṛprapakṣāṇi tārayatyeva sarvathā ||83|| taiḥ sarvaiḥ saha saṃyukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate | tīrthakoṭikṣetrakoṭiphalabhāk trispṛśāvratī ||84|| narā nāryaḥ sarvavarṇā muktimāyānti tadvratāḥ | brahmaṇā sā kṛtā pūrvaṃ paścānmaharṣibhiḥ kṛtā ||85|| seyaṃ kāryā sadā bhaktaiḥ sakāmaiḥ kāmavarjitaiḥ | gaṃgāvagāhane varṣakoṭibhiryatphalaṃ bhavet ||86|| tato’pyadhikaṃ satpuṇyaṃ trispṛśāvratino bhavet | yatphalaṃ kurukṣetre syātsūryagrahaṇakoṭibhiḥ ||87|| hemabhāraśatadāne pratyahaṃ tatra yat phalam | koṭigodānajaṃ puṇyaṃ trispṛśāvratino bhavet ||88|| pāpakoṭisahasrāṇi hatyākoṭiśatāni ca | vinaśyantyupavāsenaikādaśyāstrispṛśervrate ||89|| prakāśayati yaścedaṃ vrataṃ so’pyarjayet phalam | trispṛśā durlabhā loke prāpyate naiva mānavaiḥ ||1.233.90|| pitaro’jñātakarmāṇaḥ pretatvaṃ ye gatā api | kulajastrispṛśāṃ kṛtvā tārayettānadhogatān ||91|| kimu vaktavyamevātra trispṛśā muktidāyinī | sampatpradāyinī cātra paratra mokṣadā hi sā ||92|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne trispṛśaikādaśīvrataphalapūjanādikathananāmā trayastriṃ śadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||233||
<1.234> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ caikādaśyā utpattibodhikām | pūrve kṛtayuge jātāṃ nārāyaṇavibhāvitām || 1 || tatra satye yuge jātastālajaṃghakule mahān | atyadbhuto mahāraudro nāḍījaṃghāhvayo’suraḥ || 2 || tasya putrau murajaṃgho’bhavad devabhayaṃkaraḥ | tapastaptvābdasāhasraṃ paraṃ balamavāpa saḥ || 3 || indro’pi nirjitastena sarve devāśca nirjitāḥ | svargānniṣkāsitā devā vicerurbhūmimaṇḍale || 4 || bhītāḥ svāsthyavihīnāste yayuryatra purandaraḥ | purandaro’pi dukhāḍhyo yayau yatra janārdanaḥ || 5 || śaṃkaraśca tathā brahmā yayuścānye sureśvarāḥ | jalamadhye śayānaṃ śrīnārāyaṇaṃ pratuṣṭuvuḥ || 6 || namaste devadeveśa śaraṇāgatavatsala | dānavānāṃ ca daityānāmasurāṇāṃ vimardaka || 7 || śaraṇaṃ tvaṃ sadārtānāṃ duḥkhahāḥ śaraṇārthinām | rakṣāsmān karuṇāsindho daityādbalasamedhitāt || 8 || tvaṃ gatistvaṃ paraṃ saukhyaṃ bhaktānāṃ paramāyanam | tvaṃ mātā rakṣakaḥ svāmī tvaṃ pitā pālakaḥ prabhuḥ || 9 || tvaṃ sadvācyaṃ kāraṇaṃ vai cotpattiḥ sṛṣṭirityapi | tvamevāpūrakastatra tvameva rūpavān haraḥ || 1.234.1 0|| saṃhārakārako devastvameva bhojanapradaḥ | svāhā svadhā vaṣaṭkārastvamevāgnistvamomiti || 11 || aniruddhaśca pradyumnaḥ saṃkarṣaṇastvameva hi | brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāstvameva devakoṭayaḥ || 12||| sūryaścandrastvamevāsi vyomānilānalābbhuvaḥ | tato’vāntarasṛṣṭiśca tvameva puruṣottama || 13|| varadātā rakṣakaśca varasaṃhārakṛd bhavān | sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ sarvaṃ bhavatyeva pratiṣṭhitam || 14|| daityadānavarakṣobhirnirjitāḥ surapuṃgavāḥ | yadā bhavantyasukhāste śaraṇaṃ yānti te tadā || 15|| vayaṃ sarve svargabhraṣṭā dānavādibhirarditāḥ | aṭāmo’raṇyabhūbhāge rakṣāmicchāma īśvara || 16|| rakṣāsmān sarvathā deva dānavānmurasaṃjñakāt | śrutvā nārāyaṇasteṣāṃ papraccha bhaktavatsalaḥ || 17|| kīdṛśo dānavaḥ so’sti kiṃnāmā kiṃbalaṃ sthitiḥ | sarvaṃ brūta surendrā yacchrutvā nāśāya cintaye || 18|| indraḥ prāha tadā devaṃ viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | brahmaṇo vaṃśajaḥ so’sti kaśyapād danujo’bhavat || 19|| tālajaṃgho mahākrūrastasya nāḍīprajaṃghakaḥ | suto’bhavanmahāpāpastasyāsti putra eva saḥ ||1.234.20 || murajaṃgha iti nāmnā kṛtavām̐stapa ugrakam | varṣāṇāṃ vai sahasraṃ yannirāhāro’bhavattadā ||21 || śatavarṣaṃ bhuve pādāṃguṣṭhe sthitvātapat tapaḥ | śatavarṣaṃ jalaśāyī ghoraṃ tapaścakāra saḥ ||22| śatavarṣaṃ vāyubhakṣī sūryadraṣṭā śataṃ samāḥ | śatavarṣaṃ bāṣpabhojī tapastaptvātidāruṇam |||23|| paṃcaśataṃ ca varṣāṇāṃ samādhāvatapattapaḥ | tasya dehopari tatra valmīkaḥ kācakānvitaḥ ||24|| vṛkṣavallīsamākrānto hyabhavacchṛṃgasadṛśaḥ | tato dhūmo viniṣkrānto divaṃ yāto’tidāruṇaḥ || 25|| tanmūrdhno’bhūnmahānagniryena jajvāla dyauratha | bhūśca satyādilokāśca devāstresuśca mānavāḥ ||26|| yayurvai śaraṇaṃ sarve brahmāṇaṃ prapitāmaham | sveṣāṃ nāpātipātitvaṃ jagadurduḥkhasāgaram || 27|| ko’yaṃ vahniḥ kathaṃ jātaḥ sarvaṃ prajvālayatyaho | rakṣa rakṣa prajānātha śāntiṃ kuru jagatprabho ||28|| śrutvaivaṃ tadvaco brahmā sasuro mārgaṇāya tat | yayau vahnidhūmalekhāsṛtyā mūlaṃ bhuvi sthitam ||29|| dṛṣṭvā vṛkṣādikān tatra mumoha sṛṣṭikṛttadā | aho kaścinna vai cātra dṛśyate tāpaso janaḥ || 1.234.30 || kathaṃ kasmānmayā cātra mārgaṇīyo bhaveddhi saḥ | iti vicārya brahmā vai niṣasāda mahītale || 3 1|| viṣṇustadā mahāśaṃkhanādaṃ cakāra vai muhuḥ | tathāpi na murastatra prabubodha tadā surāḥ ||3 2|| hatāśāḥ saṃsthitāḥ sarve pramlānāntarakāmanāḥ | tadā 3 viṣṇunā tatra samādhiḥ saṃyamaḥ kṛtaḥ ||33|| praveśaśca kṛtastatra muradaityasya varṣmaṇi | śuṣkakāṣṭhasamaṃ śuṣkanāḍīmāṃsāsthipiṇḍakam ||34|| sādraṃ ca sakriyaṃ kṛtvā varṣma cāplāvayat tvajaḥ | kamaṇḍalorjalenābhyasiñcan mūrdhni yadā punaḥ ||35 || tadā pallavatāṃ yāte varṣmaṇi muradānave | netre pronmīlite jāte dṛṣṭvā sa dānavaḥ surān ||36|| natvā prāha kathaṃ yātāstapobhaṃgavidhitsayā | yāta dūraṃ na me kāryaṃ devaiḥ kiñciddhi vidyate ||37|| brahmā prāha tadā daityaṃ prasannāstapasā tava | vayaṃ prāptā varaṃ dātuṃ yatheṣṭaṃ brūhi putraka ||38|| muraḥ prāha na me mṛtyustava sṛṣṭyā kathaṃcana | viṣṇunā vā hareṇāpi bhavediti pradehi me ||39|| tathāstviti varaṃ datvā yayurbrahmādayastataḥ | muro’pi protthito hṛṣṭo yayau svasthānameva saḥ ||1.234.40 || merau candrāvatīṃ ramyāṃ rājadhānīṃ kulāgatām | pālayāmāsa vidhinā dānavairadhivāsitām ||4 1 || devāśca nirjitāstena svargāccāpi nirākṛtāḥ | indrasthānaṃ samāhṛtya dānavaścendrakaḥ kṛtaḥ ||42|| vahnisthānaṃ svakaṃ kṛtvā vahiścānyo vinirmitaḥ | sūryacandrau kṛtau cānyau grahanakṣatrasaṃyutau ||43|| dikprapālāḥ kṛtāścānye dānavāḥ svīyavarṇajāḥ | lokapālāḥ kṛtāścānye devān jitvā mureṇa vai ||44|| kārāgrahe devagaṇā nigaḍeṣu nipātitāḥ | devalokaḥ kṛtaścānyo dānavaiḥ pariśobhitaḥ ||46|| sarvaṃ tvanyat kṛtaṃ tena pūrvaṃ vai parivartitam | yāvannāyāti lakṣmyarthaṃ tāvattaṃ prajahi prabho ||46|| yāvaccirāyate devo hānistāvatpale pale | tasmācchīghraṃ samutthāya tannāśāya manaḥ kuru ||47|| śrutvaitadindravacanaṃ hariḥ śeṣāyanaḥ svayam | samutthāya ca vidhvaṃse murasyāvāpa niścayam ||48|| hariśca śaṃkaro brahmā tathā devā maharṣayaḥ | gatā yatrābhavatpuryāṃ candrāvatyāṃ mahāsuraḥ ||49|| upakaṃṭhe bahiḥ sthitvā śaṃkhaṃ dadhmau haristadā | yuddhasambodhaśabdaṃ sa śrutvāyayau purādbahiḥ ||1.234.50 || sasainyo yuddhadānāya cakāra raṇamulbaṇam | naikarūpadharo vīro muro’straśastrakoṭibhiḥ ||5 1 || mantrairmāyābalaiścaindrajālikaiḥ rūpakoṭibhiḥ | saṃgrāmamakarodghoraṃ devasaṃhārakārakam ||52|| kṣatā hatā vinaṣṭāśca devā rūpāntarātmakāḥ | bhagnāśca mūrchitā naṣṭā viprāṇāścetanojjhitāḥ ||53|| asaṃkhyātasahasrairāyudhairasurapuṃgavaiḥ | hanyamānāḥ surāḥ sarve dudruvuśca diśo daśa ||54|| viṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭvā murastaṃ ca tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt | gadāṃ gurvīṃ prāhiṇot mukundastāṃ vyapothayat ||55|| svīyayā gadayā śīghraṃ prāhiṇoccakramulbaṇam | varadānaprabhāveṇa cakraṃ vikhaṇḍitaṃ mure ||56|| viṣṇustvāścaryamāpanna krodhasaṃraktanetrakaḥ | dvitīyaṃ cakramādāya mumoca sainyakoṭiṣu ||57|| dānavā daityamūrdhanyāḥ chinnaśirasa eva te | patitāśca mṛtāścānye mūrchitā vyasavo’bhavan ||58|| medinī tatra daityādimedamāsādya sārthakā | samabhūd raṇabhūmiḥ sā dānavāraṇyasuptikā ||99|| na vai talamabhūd riktaṃ kabandhena vinā kvacit | murastato mahākhedamavāpa sainyanāśataḥ ||1.234.60|| ekākī vyacaran śastrairyuyudhe viṣṇunā tadā | viṣṇorāyudhadhuryāṇāṃ vināśastena śatruṇā ||6 1|| kṛtaṃścāstrāṇi sarvāṇi pragrastāni tadā punaḥ | astraśastravihīnaśca viṣṇurjāto yadā tadā ||62|| mumudire daityagaṇāḥ praharṣuścātidānavāḥ | surā vai mlānatāṃ prāptāḥ sāśakāśca prajīvane ||63|| atha viṣṇuṃ viśastraṃ vai jñātvā nītyā murastadā | bāhuyuddhaṃ samakarod viṣṇunā dāruṇaṃ tataḥ ||64|| māyayā muradaityena viṣṇorbāhuḥ pradharṣitaḥ | bāhubandhaḥ kṛtastena jaḍībhūtā bhujāḥ khalu ||65|| catvāro’pyabhavam̐statra devā vai duḥkhino’bhavat | hāheti karuṇa cākruśyāsam̐strastā gatāśayāḥ ||66|| murasyāsīttadā samyag vijayo devakardane | cakāra rājyaṃ ruciraṃ vijitvā satyalokajam |||67||| caturdaśabhuvanānāṃ samrāḍabhūnmurastataḥ | viṣṇustrasto gato badrikāśramaṃ himaśailagam ||68|| himālaye guhā siṃhavatī nāmnī mahattarā | vartate yojanānāṃ vai catvāro dīrghavistarā ||69|| dvāramekaṃ ca yasyāste tasyāṃ gatvā mahāprabhuḥ | suptau bhayaṃ darśayan vai lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ||1.234.70 || dānavatsaṃ mārgayan vai kadācittatra gahvare | jñātvā viṣṇuṃ prasuptaṃ sa praviveśa guhāntaram ||71|| prasuptaṃ śrīhariṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavendro jagāda tam | aho trailokyapūjya tvaṃ kathamāśrayase guhām ||72||| tvadāśritānāṃ rakṣāṃ cāpatkāle kiṃ karoṣi na | uttiṣṭha viṣṇo bhadraṃ te prottiṣṭha yuddhamācara ||73 || tvādṛśānāṃ śṛgālānāṃ svapanaṃ kiṃ nisargajam | nayāmi yamabhavanaṃ yadvā tvaṃ māṃ samāśraya ||74|| kuru dāsyaṃ sadā me tvaṃ dehi vaikuṇṭhameva me | yadvā yuddhaṃ kuru viṣṇo śāṭhyaṃ mā samaye cara ||75|| ityevaṃ vadatastasya murasya nāśanāya vai | hariḥ saṃcintayāmāsa supta eva tadantare ||76|| mahālakṣmīṃ prasasmāra dānavāntakarāya vai | smṛtvā brahmapradattaṃ ca varaṃ murasya pūrvajam ||77|| vedhaḥsṛṣṭikṛtānnāśo mā bhūditi vicintya ca | lakṣmyaṃśātmakasāmarthyaṃ svaikādaśendriyātmakam ||78|| divyaṃ tapaḥsvarūpaṃ tat prāviścakāra vai hariḥ | tacca mūrtamabhūttatra kanyārūpaṃ susundaram ||79|| kanyakā sātitejobhiḥ projjvalā svarṇasannibhā | candrakāntisamavyāptaḍhīptisandohaśītalā ||1.234.8 0|| sarvākṛtisamāyogyā harirūpātisundarī | divyapraharaṇairyuktā prodbhinnanavasustanī ||8 1|| kiñcidanaṃgarūpābhibhūtā dṛṣṭimanoharā | saubhāgyadravyabhūṣābhivastrakuntalaśobhanā ||82|| vidyuttejaḥsamākrāntākarṇāntadīrghalocanā | mahābalasamāviṣṭā mohinīva vapuṣmatī ||82|| svarṇābhūṣaṇaśobhāḍhyā sugandhamukhamārutā | susvarā sarvalāvaṇyaprasannamukhapaṃkajā ||84|| campakābhakarapādatalo’ṅguliprabhāvatī | komalā komalāṃgī ca sarvaśobhādhivāsinī ||85|| cakṣurharā manoharā cātmaharātikarṣaṇī | samudbhūtā mahāramyākṛtirhāsyaṃ karoti ca ||86|| dṛṣṭā mureṇa tatraiva tejomadhye virājitā | muraśca mohamāsādya parirabdhuṃ pracakrame ||87|| kanyā prāha mahādaitya sujño’si dharmavānasi | vinā vaivāhikaṃ kṛtyaṃ tvadarthaṃ nāhamutsahe ||88|| vijitya māṃ gṛhāṇādya paṇo’yaṃ mama dānava | yuddhe jitvā gṛhāṇemāṃ dāsībhūtāṃ manasvinīm ||89|| murastasyāḥ samākarṇya vismṛtya viṣṇumeva ca | sajjo’bhūd yuddhavṛttāya śastrāstrādibhiranvitaḥ ||1.234.90 || kanyayā raṇasaṃgrāme pravartite mahāsure | kartitaḥ kaṇṭhadeśādvai mastakaṃ bhasmitaṃ tadā ||91 || dehaścūrṇīkṛtastasya gadayā pallatādibhiḥ | muraśca nihatastasya yoddhāro’pi hatāstayā ||92|| mahākolāhalaṃ śrutvā viṣṇurnidrāṃ vihāya ca | abudhyata mṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā muraṃ vismayamāgataḥ ||93|| aho’nayā kanyayā vai hato mahābalo’suraḥ | mayā yo na jitaḥ pūrvaṃ jito hato’nayā hi saḥ ||94|| mahālakṣmīrmahāśaktirmahāmāyā nviyaṃ khalu | samarthā duḥkhanāśāya devānāṃ hitakāriṇī ||95|| upakāraḥ kṛtaḥ sarvo devānāṃ mama cāpi vai | nihato dānavo duṣṭo devāsurabhayaṃkaraḥ ||96|| iti prasannatāṃ prāpya tadā papraccha kanyakām | kā tvaṃ kathaṃ hato daitya kiṃ te manasi vartate ||97|| kanyā prāha hariṃ viṣṇorahamekādaśī matā | sarvaśatrukṣayakartrī sarvapāpavināśinī ||98|| sarvatejomayī cāsmi sarvapumarthadāyinī | tavāsmi vigrahājjātā tavendriyabalodbhavā ||99|| tava caitanyasaṃpṛktā tavāsmi putrikā prabho | prasuptaṃ pitaraṃ daityo hantumatra samāgataḥ || 1.234.100 || cicchaktiścāsuraṃ vīkṣyāhamudbhūtendriyādibhiḥ | ekādaśendriyatejomayī cāhaṃ bhavāmi te || 10 1|| tasmādekādaśīnāmnā sarvapuṇyapradā hare | asurasya vināśāya samudbhūtāsmi mādhava || 1 02||| vināśito mayā daityo devānāṃ duḥkhado mahān | iti śrutvā sutāvākyaṃ hariḥ prāha ca tāṃ sutām || 1 03|| varaṃ varaya kalyāṇi kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ mahanmama | prasanno’smi ca bhadraṃ te sarvaṃ dāsye manogatam || 104|| nādeyaṃ vidyate devi tvayā devāḥ surakṣitāḥ | dharmaḥ saṃsthāpanāṃ prāpto vrataṃ daivaṃ ca lakṣitam || 1 05|| kalyāṇamārgaḥ satataṃ janānāṃ kāritastvayā | tasmāt svasya ca yāvadvai sarvaṃ deyaṃ hi te kṛte || 1 06|| śrutvaitadbhagavadvākyamekādaśī jagāda yat|| ahamekādaśī nāmnā hyadhiṣṭhātrī vratātmikā || 1 07|| ekādaśīdinasyāsmi sa dino māmako mataḥ | śuklaḥ kṛṣṇaśca me divyo divaso vratameva saḥ || 108|| mahāpuṇyaḥ pavitro’yaṃ sarvapuṇyeṣu puṇyakṛt | ato maddivasaḥ pālyo vratopoṣaṇajāgaraiḥ || 1 09|| indriyāṇāṃ tadāhārā varjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ | mānavo maddine yo’tra hyupavāsaṃ karoti saḥ || 1.234.11 0|| aśvamedhasamaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnotyeva na saṃśayaḥ | ekabhaktena naktenopavāsena phalena vā || 111 || jalenāpi vrataṃ kuryāt sa yāyānmādhavālayam | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāddhareste ca prapūjanam || 11 2|| puṣpairdhūpaiśca dīpaiśca vividhaiśca suvastubhiḥ | pūjanaṃ kārayenme te hyudyāpanaṃ samācaret || 11 3|| evaṃ vrataprakartā te dhāma yāyānparākṣaram | garbhavāsaṃ na cāpnuyānniṣpāpaḥ syācca sarvathā || 1 14|| mamāhani tu bhaktānāṃ nairmalyaṃ jāyatāṃ sadā | bhaktiśca vardhatāṃ deve tathā śraddhā ca madvrate || 1 15|| mā kṣudhā pīḍayedbhaktaṃ vratinaṃ pramadājanam | ityevaṃ varadānāni me deyāni yadi prabho || 1 16|| dātavyāni hare mahyaṃ tathānyanme śṛṇu prabho | hariḥ pitā harirmātā bāndhavo’pi hariḥ sadā || 1 17|| harirbhartā hariḥ kartā poṣṭā hartā hariḥ svayam | tasmād rūpāntaraiḥ kṛṣṇa patirme bhava sarvadā || 1 18|| ahaṃ ṣaḍviśatirūpā patnī te syāṃ tathā kuru | yenāsaṃskāradoṣo me vinaśyet saṃvivāhataḥ || 1 19|| pātivratyaparā nityaṃ seviṣye tvāṃ patiṃ priyam | varaṃ dehi tathā nātha saubhāgyaṃ me pravardhaya || 1.234.120||| śrutvā prāha harirbhadre bhavatād vāñcchitaṃ tava | vrataṃ bhavatāt puṇyaṃ te rūpāṇyapi bhavantu te || 121 || patirbhavāmi te rūpāntaraiḥ śreyaḥpradā bhava | dharmārtha kāmamokṣāṇāṃ sampradā bhava sarvathā || 1 22|| ekādaśīvratapūtā yāntu me vaiṣṇavaṃ padam | aihikaṃ satphalaṃ prāpya cānte mokṣamavāpnuyuḥ || 123|| iti te varadānāni vitarāmi mama priye | omityuktvā svayaṃ caikādaśī vai bahudhābhavat || 124||| haristadā svamūrteśca ṣaḍviṃśatisvarūpakaiḥ | jagrāha vidhivat patnīrūpāmekādaśīṃ tadā || 125 || putrīrūpaṃ vilīyaiva patnīrūpaiśca vartate | varṣe dvādaśamāsānāṃ dve’dhikasyāpi vai tathā || 126 || militvaikādaśikāḥ ṣaḍviṃśatisaṃkhyakā matāḥ | ekādaśī tvahorātraṃ daśamī ghaṭikāpi cet||| 127|| sā tithiḥ parihartavyā hyupoṣyā dvādaśī śubhā | ekādaśī tu sampūrṇā dvādaśī vṛddhigāminī || 128|| tasyāṃ śataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇā | evaṃ vrataṃ janaḥ kuryāt phalabhāṅ mokṣabhāgbhavet || 129 || na gaṃgā na gayā naiva kāśī puṣkarameva vā | na cāpi vaiṣṇavaṃ kṣetraṃ tulyaṃ haridinena vai || 1.234.130 || iti kṛtvā praśaṃsāṃ ca patnīṃ nītvā yayau hariḥ | yatra candrāvatī rājadhānī murakṛtāsti vai || 131 || tatra nigaḍabandhasthān devān vyamocayaddhariḥ | svargaṃ devātmasātkṛtvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayau prabhuḥ || 1 32|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi vratamāhātmyamuttamam | ekādaśyāstrispṛśāyāḥ kimanyacchrotumicchasi || 133 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne muradānavayuddhanimittakaikādaśyutpattivratādivaradānanirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||234||
<1.235> śrīlakṣmīruvāca hare kathaya ṣaḍviṃśatyekādaśīvratāni me | kathaṃ kāryāṇi vidhinā pūjanīyaṃ ca yadyathā || 1 || kāni nāmāni patayaḥ phalaṃ karma vidhistathā | ekādaśīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ pṛthaktvenopavarṇaya || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ tāsāṃ pāvanīṃ mokṣadāṃ tathā | mama yogavatīṃ divyāṃ vaikuṇṭhādipradāyinīm || 3 || unmīlanīṃ tathā pakṣavardhinīṃ cāpi me śṛṇu | jāgaraṇaphalaṃ cāpi mano datvā nibodha me || 4 || ekādaśī hyahorātraṃ prabhāte ghaṭikā bhavet | unmīlanī tu sā bodhyā hareścātipriyāsti sā || 5 || trailokye yāni tīrthāni yāni puṇyasthalāni ca | tapo vedā makhāstraite koṭyaṃśenāpi tāni vai || 6 || unmīlanīpratulyāni bhavantyeva na vai kvacit | unmīlanīsamaṃ kiñcinna bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 7 || na kāśī na gayā naiva prayāgaḥ kurubhūmikā | puṣkaraṃ na saro nārāyaṇaṃ no himavān giriḥ || 8 || raivato na ca vindhyādrirmalayo merurapyatha | kuṃkumavāpī naimiṣaṃ kālakṣetraṃ vanaṃ na vā || 9 || candrabhāgā na kāverī sarayūśca na gomatī | godāvarī narmadā na svarṇalekhā na vedikā || 1.235.1 0|| na tāpī nāpi vai bhadrā na ca sindhurna candanā | śatruṃjitā na cojasvatī vipāśā na gaṇḍakī || 1 1|| na śoṇo no tuṃgabhadrā tathā nāpi sarasvatī | anyānyapi ca tīrthāni nonmīlanīsamāni vai || 12|| nonmīlanīsamaṃ puṇyaṃ na devaḥ śrīhareḥ paraḥ | unmīlanīdinaṃ prāpya yaiḥ kṛtaṃ haripūjanam || 1 2|| pāpapuñjaṃ vidhūyaiva yānti te dhāma cākṣaram | yanmāse syādunmīlanyekādaśī tu śubhā tithiḥ || 14|| māsanāmnā svarṇamayo hariḥ kāryastamarcayet | śraddhayā parayā bhaktyā bahubhiḥ sūpacārakaiḥ || 15|| pavitrajalasaṃyuktaṃ pañcaratnasamanvitam | gandhapuṣpākṣatairyuktaṃ kuṃbhaṃ sragvastrabhūṣitam || 16 || nārīkelādiphalakaṃ sthāpayenmadhyamaṇḍale | sarvatobhadrasaṃjñe’tra mūrtiṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet || 17|| pātraṃ godhūmapūrṇaṃ ca nānāratnasamanvitam | nānāgandhasamāyuktaṃ mallikāmodavāsitam || 18|| jātīkusumasaṃyuktaṃ sthāpayedvaṭasannidhau | śvetākṣaistaṇḍulaiścaiva pūritaṃ pātramityapi || 19|| sthāpayettu ghaṭapārśve pūjayecca hariṃ muhuḥ | pradadyādvastrayugmaṃ ca sottarīyopavītakam |||1.235.20|| upānahau cātapatraṃ sthālīṃ jalakamaṇḍalum | saptadhānyaprapātrāṇi tilān dadyācca bhūriśaḥ ||2 1 || rūpyaṃ svarṇaṃ pradadyācca kārpāsaṃ pāyasaṃ tathā | mudrikā ūrmikāścaiva dhenūrdadyācca śobhanā || 22|| alaṃkārān pradadyācca pātrāṇi vividhāni ca | svarṇaśṛgīṃ raupyakhurīṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhīṃ sajhullikām ||23|| kāṃsyadohāṃ ratnapucchāṃ gāṃ dadyād gurave tadā | śayyāṃ dadyāt saparyaṃkāṃ gendukopaskarānvitām ||24|| dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ phalaṃ patrādi cārpayet | tulasīpatrakamalapuṣpāṇi vividhāni ca || 25|| pūjāyāṃ haraye dadyād dakṣiṇā vividhāstataḥ | cintayecchrīharermūrti pratyaṃgaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||26|| māsanāmnā tu caraṇau viṣṇunāmnā ca jānunī | śrīśanāmnā praguhyaṃ ca kṛṣṇanāmnā kaṭiṃ smaret|||27|| brahmanāmnā smarennābhimudaraṃ viśvapākhyayā | hṛd vai jñātrākhyayā kaṇṭhaṃ vaikuṇṭhavāsivācinā |||28|| lalāṭaṃ gurunāmnā ca pareṇa brahmaṇā śiraḥ | sarvāṃgāni tathāntaryāmināmnā saṃsmared budhaḥ ||29|| āyudhāni vibhūṣāśca vastrālaṃkaraṇāni ca | dhyānaṃ kṛtvā pūjayed vai bhaktyārghyādīni cārpayet || 1.235.30 || śaṃkhopari phalaṃ kṛtvā gandhapuṣpākṣatānvitam | sūtreṇa veṣṭanaṃ kṛtvā dadyādarghyaṃ ca bhāvataḥ ||3 1 || evaṃ vai ṣoḍaśavastupravaryaiḥ pūjayeddharim | prārthayecca hariṃ natvā samuddhara mahārṇavāt || 32|| samuddhārāya kiñcidvai kṛtaṃ no sukṛtaṃ mayā | tathāpi tvaṃ mama svāmī samuddhara mahārṇavāt ||33|| unmilinyā vratenātra pūrvajānme samuddhara | viyoniṃ ca gatānpāpān vimṛtyaṃ gamitām̐stathā ||34|| atītān bhāvinaścānyān samuddhara mahārṇavāt | pretānsarvānmahāmuktiṃ dehi śrīkṛṣṇa mādhava ||35|| ārtasya mama mūrtau te bhaktiṃ dehi ca śāśvatīm | evaṃ dhūpaistathā dīpairnaivedyairjalabhojanaiḥ ||36|| stotrairnīrājanairnṛtyaiḥ śrīhariṃ sampratoṣayet | vastradānaiśca godānairbhojanaiḥ sevanaistathā ||37|| guruṃ santoṣayed bhakto yathā santoṣamāpnuyāt | tathā tathā vidhātavyaṃ gurau tuṣṭe phalaṃ mahat ||38|| lokānāṃ tāraṇārthāya dhātrā sṛṣṭo gururyataḥ | ataḥ sarvasvasevādyairguruṃ santoṣayet sadā ||39|| guroḥ pūjā prakartavyā mokṣado’sti gururhariḥ | ahitaṃ mocayed yo vai suhitaṃ darśayet sadā ||1.235.40|| jñānadānena cājñānaṃ nāśayet sukhado bhavet | anādibandhanaṃ chindyāt śāśvataṃ sukhamarpayet ||41|| dharmārthakovidaṃ taṃ vai guruṃ hariṃ sadāśrayet | sevayet sarvadā bhaktyā vittaśāṭhyaṃ na cācaret ||42|| guroḥ prasādaḥ prāptavyaḥ paripūrṇaṃ vrataṃ bhavet | dvādaśyāṃ ca kṛtasnāno bhakto hariṃ prapūjayet ||43|| guruṃ ca bhojayet paścād bahūn viprām̐śca bhojayet | sādhūn sādhvīrbhojayitvā pāraṇāṃ svaḥ samācaret ||44|| kṛṣṇakathānakaiḥ kālo netavyo vratakāriṇā | dānaṃ jñānasya dānaṃ vai nānyat tattulyamasti hi ||45|| pradātavyaṃ sadā jñānaṃ nityaṃ śāstrakathādibhiḥ | viṣṇurjñāne pradātavyo dātā mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||46|| evaṃ yaḥ kurute conmīlanyaikādaśikāvratam | anantakalpakālaṃ sa vaikuṇṭhe vasati dhruvam ||47|| vaiṣṇavaṃ vratamevaitallakṣmi tubhyaṃ prakīrtitam | yacchrutvā pāpinaḥ sarve muktimāyānti tatkṣaṇāt ||48|| unmīlanīvratakartā svarge loke mahīyate | devāśca pitaraścaiva divyāṃ gatimavāpnuyuḥ ||49|| vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ sarvasmṛddhikarāṃ śubhām | ekādaśyā vrataṃ viṣṇoḥ pūjanaṃ vaiṣṇavārcanam ||1.235.50|| sādhusādhvīsusevā ca durlabhaṃ taccatuṣṭayam | etasyāḥ śravaṇānmucyedājanmamṛtyubandhanāt ||51|| viṣṇuśca vaiṣṇavāścaiva nāpakāryāḥ kadācana | pūjayitvā bhojayitvā tato bhojanamācaret||||52|| śālagrāmaḥ samabhyarcyo vaiṣṇavo’pi viśeṣataḥ | dhūpamārārtrikaṃ śakhodakaṃ dadyācca viṣṇave ||53|| naivedyaṃ viṣṇave dadyād vaiṣṇavebhyastato’pi ca | hyekādaśīvratakartā tato bhojanamācaret ||54|| dīpaṃ dadyāttathā gītaṃ nityaṃ kuryācca vandanam | śyāmāṃkuraiḥ pūjanaṃ ca kuryātpremapariplutaḥ ||55|| pṛṣvīdānasamaṃ puṇyaṃ dūrvayā pūjane kṛte | śyāmāṃkuraiśca dūrvāyāḥ pūjanaṃ cātivallabham ||56|| nāsti loke’tra dūrvāyā aṃkuraiḥ sadṛśaṃ śubham | taiśca saṃpūjanaṃ kāryaṃ viṣṇusāyujyamicchatā ||57|| dūrvābhiśca yavaiścāpyakṣataiḥ sampūjayeddharim | pakṣe pakṣe ca vidhivad dvādaśyāṃ pūjanaṃ prage ||58|| mokṣadaṃ sukhadaṃ caiva tathāyuṣyapradaṃ śubham | etadviṣṇuvrataṃ proktaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ samṛddhidam ||59|| gṛhasthānāṃ tu sukhadaṃ yatīnāṃ muktidāyakam | sarvarogādiśamanaṃ dehatrayaviśodhanam ||1.235.60 || daśamīvedharahitaṃ mahattūnmīlanīvratam | sajāgaraṃ prakartavyaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ param ||6 1 || tulasīpatralakṣaiśca pūjayetparameśvaram | gopīcandanacandraṃ ca tilakaṃ puṇḍramūrdhvagam ||62|| dhārayetpūjanārthāya darśanānmokṣadaṃ hi tat | astraṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ varma dhārayed duḥkhanāśakam ||63|| brahmahā hemahārī ca madyapo māṃsabhakṣakaḥ | agamyāgo mahāpāpo nindānṛtaprabhāṣakaḥ ||64|| te pāpānmuktimāyānti tūrdhvapuṃḍrasya dhāraṇāt | kaṇṭhe dhātrīphalamālāṃ tulasīmālikāṃ tathā ||65|| dhārayed vaiṣṇavo bhakto pūjādīkṣāṃgarūpiṇīm | cakraśilāṃ dvārakāyā gaṇḍakyā viṣṇumityapi ||66|| tulasyā pūjayennityaṃ bhuktimuktiphalaṃ bhavet | savedho vāsaro viṣṇornopoṣitavya eva vai ||67|| savedho vāsaro yasya rājño rājye pravartate | rājā ca lipyate tena pāpena nārakī bhavet ||68|| vedhaṃ sarvavidhaṃ tyaktvā samupoṣya harerdinam | kulakoṭisamuddhāro viṣṇudhāmagatirbhavet ||69|| pañcapañcāśaddhaṭikā daśamyudayato’sti cet | paradinaikādaśī sā viddhaikādaśikocyate ||1.235.70|| ekādaśī tvahorātraṃ daśamīghaṭikāpi cet | sā tithirna hyupoṣyā vai dvādaśīvratamiṣyate ||71|| ekādaśīdvaye prāpte paropoṣyā na pūrvajā | dvādaśīdvitaye prāpte pūrvopoṣyā tu dvādaśī ||72|| ekādaśyāḥ kṣaye prāpte hyupoṣyā dvādaśī vrate | daśamyāśca kṣaye prāpte hyupoṣyā dvādaśī vrate ||73|| daśamī yugale prāpte hyupoṣyaikādaśī tadā | dvādaśyāśca kṣaye prāpte hyupoṣyaikādaśī bhavet ||74|| iti jñātvā vrataṃ kuryāt hariryāti prasannatām | vratakartā harerdhāma yāti śrīharivāñchayā ||75|| dvādaśyāṃ ca prabhāte yāruṇodayottaraṃ bhavet | ekāṭaśī ghaṭikāpi dinonmīlanakālinī ||76|| manuṣyāṇāṃ tathonmīlanārthaprabodhakālinī | tasmāttasyā unmīlanī nāma proktaṃ mayā priye ||77|| ut ūrdhvaṃ brahmavaikuṇṭhaṃ paraṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ tathā | golokaṃ melayet sonmīlanī saṃkathitā mayā ||78|| ut ūrdhvaṃ vai paraṃbrahma kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim | melayedyā vratācārāt sonmīlanī samucyate ||79|| ajñānaṃ pāparūpaṃ ca bhayaṃ mṛtyuṃ vidārya yā | ūrdhvaṃ lokaṃ prakāśaṃ ca melayet sārthakā hi sā ||1.235.80|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne unmīlanīnāmaikādaśīvratapūjādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 235||
<1.236> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣye tvāṃ pakṣavardhinikābhidhām | ekādaśī priyāṃ me’ti yayā mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 1 || ekādaśī prapūrṇā ca daśamīvedhasaṃyutā | ekadaśīvedhayuktā dvādaśyarkodaye ca yā || 2 || evaṃkramādamāvāsyā pūrṇimā vārkaprākkṣaṇe | sampūrṇā nāḍikāṣaṣṭiḥ pratipacca tathāvidham || 2 || ekādaśī samārabhya pratipaddivasāvadhi | sampūrṇā nāḍikāṣaṣṭiryadā tvahnaḥ pramāṇatā || 4 || saikādaśī tadā jñeyā pakṣavardhinikābhidhā | dvādaśī sā samupoṣyā vrataṃ kāryaṃ vidhānataḥ || 5 || aśvamedhāyutaistulyā sā bhavet pakṣavardhinī | yāṃ kṛtvā tu mahālakṣmi phalānantyamavāpnuyāt || 6 || pūjite cārcite viṣṇau vaikuṇṭhaṃ phalamāpyate | pūjāṃ tatra pravakṣyāmi yayā tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 7 || maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ saptadhānyaiḥ prakārayet | madhye ghaṭaṃ ca sauvarṇa sajalaṃ sthāpayennavam || 8 || tāmraghaṭaṃ ca yadvātra pañcapallavaśobhitam | pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ śvetavastrapraveṣṭitam || 9 || candanārcitamevainaṃ puṣpahārābhiveṣṭitam | ghaṭe tatra mahatpātraṃ sagodhūmaṃ tu tāmrajam || 1.236.10 || saphalaṃ sanārikelaṃ samiṣṭānnaṃ suyojayet | sauvarṇaṃ kārayet kṛṣṇaṃ māsasaṃjñābhidhānakam || 1 1|| snāpayecca tathā paṃcāmṛtena vidhinā harim | abhiṣekaṃ tīrthajalaiḥ kārayellepayettataḥ || 12|| kuṃkumākṣatakastūrīcandanāttarakarpuraiḥ | vastrayugmaṃ copavītaṃ kaustubhaṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca || 13 || alaṃkārāḥ pradātavyāḥ puṣpahārādayastathā | kaṭakāṃgadamukuṭaśṛṃkhalāraśanormikāḥ || 14|| siṃhāsanaṃ pradātavyaṃ chatropānahasaṃyutam | sugandhadravyamatyugraṃ pradātavyaṃ ca bhāvataḥ || 15|| lakṣmīstatra ca saṃsthāpyā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā | sarvālaṃkārasaubhāgyadravyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ||16||| pūjanīyā hareḥ pārśve tvekādaśī svarūpiṇī | pūjayecchrīhariṃ tatra kuṃbhapātropari sthitam || 17|| dhyāyecca padmanābhaṃ vai pādau tatra vicintayet | viśvamūrtiṃ vicintyaiva jānunī saṃsmarettataḥ ||18|| jñānagamyaṃ ca saṃsmṛtya hyūrū tatra vicintayet | jñānapradaṃ hariṃ smṛtvā kaṭiṃ cāpi vicintayet || 1 9|| viśvanāthaṃ hariṃ smṛtvā hyudaraṃ saṃvicintayet | śrīdharaṃ śrīhariṃ smṛtvā hṛdayaṃ cintayeddhareḥ ||1.236.20|| sakaustubhaṃ hariṃ smṛtvā kaṇṭhaṃ samyag vicintayet | kṣatrāntakāriṇaṃ smṛtvā bāhū samyag vicintayet ||21|| cidākāśaṃ hariṃ smṛtvā lalāṭaṃ cintayettataḥ | sarvarūpaṃ hariṃ dhyātvā śiraḥ samyag vicintayet ||22|| kṛṣṇanāmnā ca śastrāṇi sarvāṃgāni ca cintayet | evaṃ dhyātvā tataścārghyaṃ nālikereṇa dāpayet |||23|| saṃsārasāgarāt kṛṣṇa māṃ samuddhara keśava | pūjāmarghyaṃ gṛhāṇeśa harikṛṣṇa namo’stute ||24|| ṣoḍaśavastuvaryāṇi deyāni paramātmane | naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ dadyājjalaṃ dadyāttu śītalam ||25|| tāmbūlaṃ susugandhaṃ sudravyaṃ dadyācca bhaktitaḥ | ghṛtenāpyatha tailena dīpa kuryācca bhaktitaḥ ||26|| ārārtrikaṃ namaskāraṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ ca saṃstavam | kṣamāpanaṃ ca yāceta puṣpāñjaliṃ prakalpayet ||27|| hareḥ pūjāṃ śubhāṃ kṛtvā guroḥ pūjāṃ prakārayet | candanādyarpaṇavastrabhūṣādānādinā tathā ||28|| kañcukoṣṇīṣahārādisugandhādi pradāpayet | dakṣiṇāṃ cānnadhānyādi tathā mudrādi cārpayet ||29 || bhojanaṃ caiva tāmbūlaṃ datvācāryaṃ pratoṣayet | yathāvittaṃ yathāśakti kāryaṃ utsava uttamaḥ || 1.236.30 || sāyaṃ cāpi tathā pūjā kartavyā bhaktibhāvataḥ | tato jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādgītanṛtyasamanvitam |||31|| prācyākhyānakathāyuktaṃ hāsyāhlādasamāyutam | śrīṃ pakṣavardhinīnāmnīṃ pūjayet kṛṣṇasannidhau || 32|| tanmāhātmyaṃ saṃśṛṇuyādvratasya phalamāpnuyāt | paṃcāgnisādhane puṇyaṃ yattu syāttīrthakoṭiṣu || 33|| tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti viṣṇorjāgaraṇājjanaḥ | upavāse kṛte tatra hatyākoṭikṣayo bhavet ||34|| kartavyā tu viśeṣeṇa vaiṣṇavairjñānayogibhiḥ | na tīrthāni na cāraṇyakṣetrāṇi kulaparvatāḥ ||35||| tārayanti janān yadvattārayetpakṣavardhinī | site candre kalāvṛddhistathāsyāṃ puṇyavardhanam |||36|| sūryodaye tamonāśastathājñānavināśinī | pakṣavivardhinī seyaṃ mokṣapakṣavivardhinī ||37|| muktikalāpradā ṣoḍaśādikalāprapoṣikā | kāśīsamā sadā muktau dvārakāsadṛśī tathā || 38|| kuṃkumavāpikātulyā vāṃchitaṃ pradadātyasau | bhaktānāṃ tu sadā muktipakṣaṃ vardhayatīva sā ||39|| jñānaṃ dharmaṃ tathā bhaktiṃ vardhayatyeva sarvathā | yathā śuklā tathā kṛṣṇā vibhedaṃ naiva kārayet ||1.236.40|| santārayati kartāraṃ daśapūrvāndaśāparān | santārayati vratinaṃ dvādaśyubhayataḥ kṛtā ||41 || vārāṇasyāṃ bhavedvāsaḥ ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrakam | yajñadānaṃ kurukṣetre somaparvasahasrakam |||42|| vidhṛtyādisuyogeṣu lakṣadānottamottamam | sūryacandragrahadānaṃ kurukṣetre kṛtaṃ śatam ||43|| prabhāse vā kṛtaṃ dānaṃ somayāgasahasrakam | yatilakṣaṃ gṛhe bhuṃkte tatphalaṃ nityameva yat ||44|| kedārajalapānasya janmādarśanakaṃ phalam | ekādaśyupavāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||45|| gosahasrapradānādvai sahasraguṇitaṃ phalam | sādhūnāṃ pūjane proktaṃ tasmād daśaguṇaṃ phalam ||46|| brahmaniṣṭhaprapūjāyāṃ tato daśaguṇaṃ punaḥ | devārthaṃ bhūmidātuśca kanyādātustatastathā ||47|| tato’pi daśaguṇakaṃ yajñāvabhṛthapāvane | tato’nantaṃ bhavedekādaśīvratini vai phalam ||48|| upavāse tu yatpuṇyaṃ tato’rdhaṃ naktabhojane | naktasyārdhaṃ bhavedekabhukte vā phalabhojane ||49|| ekabhuktena naktenopavāsena phalena ca | yatpuṇyaṃ labhate tacca rātrau jāgaraṇe kṛte ||1.236.50|| ekādaśyupavāsasya puṇyasaṃkhyā na vidyate | pratyekāyāśca māhātmyaṃ pravadāmi nibodha me ||51 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pakṣavardhinyekādaśīvratapūjādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 236 ||
<1.237> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śruṇu lakṣmi mahānidrā puṇyakṣayavidhāyinī | sarvathā parihartavyā vratarātrau divāpi ca || 1 || nidrāvṛttirmahāghorā tāmasī cittadhūmriṇī | abhāvapratyayālambanātmikālasyakāriṇī || 2 || svāpnadoṣādikartrī ca bhaktisevāvighātinī | kadāciddoṣabāhulye rājase puṣṭatāṃ gate || 3 || brahmacaryavratabhaṃgapradasrāvādikāriṇī | vratanāśakarī syāt sā vāyuvīryajavādinā || 4 || tasmājjāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ vratasya niśi sarvathā | bahvāhāre’nnasaṃbhāre prāyaḥ śārīradhātavaḥ || 5 || puṣṭā bhavanti tadyogāt kvaciddhātukṣaye’vaśāt | brahmacaryavratabhaṃge tūpavāso nirarthakaḥ || 6 || tasmāt tadā phalāhārādikaṃ saṃkṣepato matam | annāhāraḥ sadāvarjyo vratasya divase janaiḥ || 7 || nidrā tu sarvathā varjyā sattvavṛttivināśinī | puṇyakṣayapradā
