sarvadoṣādhārātitāmasī || 8 || vijetavyā prayatnena bhaktena vratinā khalu | vratapuṣṭikaraṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ prayatnataḥ || 9 || ekādaśyāṃ janaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ saṃpūjya premato niśi | vaiṣṇavaiḥ saha sammīlya kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ vrate || 1.237.10|| gītavādyābhinṛtyādi saṃhitākathanādinā | vārtayā bhagavapkīrtyātmikayā sevayā ca vā || 11 || kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ bhakto vratasāphalyahetave | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ puṣpaṃ gandhānulepanam || 1 2|| phalamarghyaṃ tathā śraddhāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ premabhāvanam | vinidraṃ ca vrataṃ sarvaṃ dadyātkuryācca bhaktitaḥ || 13|| sa sarvapāpātisaṃśuddho jāyate pārṣado hareḥ | vrate jāgaraṇe prāpte sotsāhā vaiṣṇavāstadā || 14|| sopavāsaṃ vrataṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kuryuḥ satāṇḍavam | tadvrataṃ viṣṇusaṃjñaṃ vai kuryurnāmnāṃ ca kīrtanam || 15|| manasā śrīhariṃ dhyātvā muhurnāma vadanti vai | te tu dhanyatamā loke tārakā mama pārṣadāḥ || 16|| praśvāse ca tathā śvāse harernāma caturguṇam | prahare nāmaraṭaṇaṃ phaladaṃ koṭisadguṇam || 17|| caturyāme nāmabhaktistvasaṃkhyaphaladā matā | jāgaraṃ nimiṣārdhaṃ ca kṛtaṃ mūrteśca sannidhau || 18|| tatphalaṃ koṭikoṭyabjaguṇitaṃ syādanuttamam | kṛṣṇāgre nartanaṃ kuryāt sāścaryaṃ premasaṃbhṛtam || 19|| sotsāhaṃ ca pramādālasyādivarjitameva ca | pradakṣiṇaṃ tathā kuryāt namaskāraṃ muhurmuhuḥ ||1.237.20|| ārārtrikaṃ tathā kuryād yāme yāme punaḥ punaḥ | cetasā cārdrabhāvena paśyanmūrtiṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe || 11 || tālikāvādanaṃ kuryādityevaṃ jāgaraṃ bhavet | evaṃ bahuguṇairyuktaṃ kuryād yo jāgaraṃ vrate ||22|| vittaśāṭhyaṃ na ca kuryānna lobhaṃ pūjane tathā | evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā na punarjāyate bhuvi |||23|| jāgaraṇaṃ prakurvan vai vratī viṣṇau hi līyate | nāstikatvena cātmānaṃ vrate naiva pratārayet ||24|| nārāyaṇavrate jāgaraṇe tu hyupahāsakṛt | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate (kṛmiḥ) ||25|| vedavettā ca yo vipro nartane copahāsyakṛt | doṣalipto bhavedatra cāṇḍālādadhamo hi saḥ ||26|| kṣaṇaṃ vā praharaṃ vāpi jāgaraṃ nartanānvitam | karoti yo bhāvayuktaścaturvargaphalaṃ vrajet ||27|| yājako vaidikaścāpi jāgare pravinindakaḥ | ekaviṃśatikulayuk narakaṃ pratipadyate ||28||| nāstikabhāvasarpeṇa daṃṣṭāḥ svapanti vai vrate | māyayā mohitā naiva kurvanti jāgaraṃ hi te ||29||| vinaṣṭāste na sandeho mokṣātpracyavitā hi te | netrahīnā jñānahīnāḥ pumarthavigatā hi te ||1.237.30 || jāgare vācake prāpte hareḥ kathāṃ prakārayet | śrāvayed vividhān divyām̐ścamatkārān harermuhuḥ ||3 1|| vācakasyāpralābhe tadkīrtanaṃ kārayenmithaḥ | gāyanaṃ nartanaṃ kuryāt hāsyādi hariyogajam ||32|| utsavo rāsaramaṇaṃ kṛṣṇalīlāṃ pragāpayet | aśvamedhasahasrasya vājapeyāyutasya ca ||33||| puṇyaṃ bhavet koṭiguṇaṃ vrate jāgaraṇe kṛte | vinā jāgaraṇaṃ vrate vratapuṇyakṣayo bhavet ||34|| pitṛpakṣā mātṛpakṣā bhāryāpakṣāstathā yujaḥ | śataśaścoddharantyeva vrate jāgaraṇe kṛte ||35|| upoṣaṇasya rātrirvā dinaṃ vā nidrayā yadi | vidhyate tadvrataṃ viddhaṃ cāsuraṃ vratameva tat ||36||| phalaṃ tvāsurabhāvātma śāpātmakaṃ ca tadbhavet | viṣṇustatra na cāyāti tvāgatyāpi vigacchati ||37|| harirnidrākṛte sthāne śāpaṃ dattvā vigacchati | kṛte tu jāgare sthāne lakṣmīruddhopi vai hariḥ ||38|| samāgacchati dṛṣṭaḥ san bhakteṣu nṛtyati svayam | premapūrṇaprabhakteṣu praviṣṭo’tīva hṛṣyati ||39|| yāvad vratāni kurute jāgaraṃ harisannidhau | tāvad yugāni vratakṛd viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||1.237.40|| ekādaśyādivratāhe śaśvannidrālusadgṛhe | asurā rākṣasā yāmyā nṛtyantyaniṣṭakārakāḥ ||41|| harervratadine gānaṃ pāṭhaṃ japaṃ samācaret | mūkavannirgame saptajanmasu mūkatā bhavet ||42||| hareragre nartanaṃ yo nācaratyatilajjayā | paṃgutvaṃ tasya vijñeyaṃ cātra paratra janmani ||43 || gītanṛtyajapajāgaraṇakartustu matpadam | vāsāya vaiṣṇavaṃ sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ mayā vinirmitam ||44|| kārayeccānyabhaktān yo jāgaraṃ vai harerdine | animeṣo mama pārṣadāgryo vaset sa dhāmani ||45|| nidrāluṃ jāgrati bhāve yojayedyo harerdine | vasecciraṃ tu vaikuṇṭhe pitṛkoṭibhiranvitaḥ ||46|| matiṃ dadāti yaḥ kṛṣṇavrate jāgaraṇaṃ prati | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi śvetadvīpe vaseddhi saḥ ||47|| kāmadoṣakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ janmanyanyatra vāṃ kṛtam | śrīharerjāgare sarvaṃ niśi nāśaṃ pragacchati ||48|| hareścāgre tathā śālagrāmasyāgre prajāgaram | kurvanti tu phalaṃ teṣāṃ koṭitīrthakṛtaṃ bhavet ||49|| anyathā sukṛtaṃ sarvaṃ naśyatyeva hi nidrayā | nindayāpi vrataṃ naśyatyeva phalaṃ kṛto bhavet ||1.237.50|| pūruṣārthāḥ sampadaśca putrā kīrtirdhanādikam | śāśvatāḥ svargalokāya labhyante jāgare vrate ||51|| vinā jāgaraṇaṃ naiva viṣṇoḥ prasannatā bhavet | yajñāyutaiḥ śāśvato vai loko naivāpyate kvacit |||52|| vrate ca jāgare labdhe labhyate dhāma śāśvatam | jāgarārthaṃ gacchataḥ syātpade’śvamedhajaṃ phalam ||53|| pādayoḥ pāṃsavaḥ saktāstāvadvarṣasahasrakam | jāgarī tiṣṭhate divye vaikuṇṭhe ca pare divi ||54|| vratarātrau jāgarārthaṃ gantavyaṃ harimandiram | pādalagnarajaḥsaṃkhyayugavāso harergṛhe ||55 || ekādaśyāstathā dvādaśyāśca rātrau prajāgaram | prakartavyaṃ prayatnena jīvājñānavidhūtaye ||56|| uttamaṃ ca madhyamaṃ ca kaniṣṭhaṃ ceti vai matam | tridhā jāgaraṇaṃ tatra cottamaṃ kāryameva tat ||57|| kathāyuktaṃ gānayuktaṃ nṛtyayuktaṃ viśeṣataḥ | sāttvikībhāvanāyuktaṃ jāgaraṃ tūttamaṃ matam |||58|| gāndharvaharikīrtyādiyutaṃ tālādisaṃyutam | dīpadhūpādiśobhāḍhyaṃ jāgaraṃ cottamaṃ matam ||59|| bhaktibhāvasamāyuktaṃ nāmoccārasamanvitam | nairmalyatuṣṭijanakaṃ jāgaraṃ cottamaṃ matam ||1.237.6 0|| lokaraṃjanakotsāhaprotsavādisamanvitam | naivedyaphalapānādiyutaṃ jāgaramuttamam ||6 1 || harerārārtrika yatra hareryatra pradakṣiṇam | hareragre rāśayogastadvai jāgaramuttamam ||62|| śāstrajñānaṃ guroḥ sevā devasevā ca yatra vai | smaraṇaṃ pādasevā ca jāgaraṃ cottamaṃ hi tat ||63 || sarvabhāvā harau yatra vaiṣṇavāgryāśca yatra vai | tajjāgaraṃ hi kartavyaṃ pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ ||64|| vratadānatapohomasvādhyāyādibhirityapi | kiṃ cānyaiḥ puṇyakāryairvā na vrate jāgaraṃ yadi ||65|| pravāse ca vane kṣetre’raṇye grāmāntare’pi ca | vāṭikāyāṃ samāje vā nadyāṃ śaile’tige raṇe ||66 || khinnāvasthātikāle vā parādhīne mahāpathe | jāgaraṇaprakartā me vrate so’tīva me priyaḥ ||67|| yasya kasyāpi bhakto vā mama bhakto’pi sarvathā | vrate’hni sarvathā nidrātyāgaṃ kuryād vrajet phalam ||68|| śaivaḥ sauraśca śāktaśca gaṇeśabhakta ityapi | mama vibhūtibhakto’pi vrate jāgaraṇaṃ caret ||6 9 || nidrālustu paśurjñeyaḥ indriyārāma eva saḥ | vipriyaṃ me kṛtaṃ tena vrate no jāgaraṃ kṛtam ||1.237.70|| nidrā ca bhojanaṃ caivendriyāhārān karoti yaḥ | vrate me sa bhavet tiryagyonau pratikaṇaṃ muhuḥ ||7 1 || nihatāḥ pitarastena devānāṃ ca vadhaḥ kṛtaḥ | puṇyarekhā hatā tena saubhāgyaṃ nāśitaṃ tayā ||72|| sampado vipadāṃ pātraṃ kṛtaṃ tenātimāninā | jāgaraṃ ca vrataṃ yena kṛtaṃ naiva harerdine ||73|| satālīvādanaṃ kurvan gālavādyaṃ ca vādayan | nṛtyan gāyan kautukaṃ darśayan vai jāgaraṃ caret ||74|| caritrāṇi smārayaiśca raṃjayan vaiṣṇavān janān | romāṇi premapūrṇāni saṃprahṛṣṭāni darśayan ||75|| ālāpān janayan ramyān miṣṭān bhāvān prakāśayan | hāvān vyaṃgyān śaktalakṣyān kīrtanārthān vivecayan ||76|| evaṃ vrate prakurvan jāgaraṃ prema pradarśayan | nimiṣe nimiṣe tasya puṇyaṃ syānnaimiṣaṃ tathā ||77|| tīrthakoṭiphalaṃ tasya yajñakoṭiphalaṃ mahat | svargakoṭiphalaṃ caiva dānakoṭiphalaṃ mahat ||78|| śāntena manasā dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ nīrājanaṃ tathā | kuryācca jāgaraṃ rātrau saptadvīpādhipo bhavet ||79|| mahāpāpātipāpāni koṭihatyāsamāni vai | sajāgare vrate samyag vilayaṃ yānti khaṇḍaśaḥ ||1.237.80|| ekataḥ sarvapuṇyāni caikato vratajāgaram | jāgarasya mahatpuṇyaṃ viśiṣyate’nyapuṇyataḥ ||8 1|| kāśī dvārāvatī raivatācalaḥ somapāṭṭaṇam | arbudaścāruṇaścaiva mandaro himaparvataḥ ||82|| sahyādrirnavalakṣaśca vindhyo droṇācalastathā | mahākālavanaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ cāvantikā tathā ||83|| puṣkaraṃ ca prayāgaṃ ca revā svarṇā yamasvasā | gayā ca gokulaṃ godāvarī gaṃgā ca bhadrikā ||84|| gaṇḍakī tāmraparṇī ca brahmaputrādayo nadāḥ | kukumavāpikā māyā kāṃcī śrīpuruṣottamā ||85|| sarve te tīrthavidhinā kṛtā api na te tathā | phalaṃ yacchanti vai yādṛk phalaṃ haridinavratāt ||86 || sajāgarāt kṛtāt puṇyaṃ sarvapuṇyātigaṃ yataḥ | tīrthāni parvatā nadyaḥ sāgarāśca vanāni ca || 87|| araṇyāni ca caityāni dvīpāśca pṛthivī tathā | tattvāni devāḥ ṛṣayo munayaḥ pitaro’gnayaḥ ||88|| gandharvāḥ kinnarāḥ nāgāścāraṇā brāhmasṛṣṭayaḥ | vaimānikāśca vairājāḥ kālābhimānikeśvarāḥ ||89|| ye kecittārakāḥ proktāste sarve lokadhārakāḥ | ekādaśyā jāgare vai samāgacchanti sarvataḥ || 1.237.90 || tato jāgarakartāro devā eva na saṃśayaḥ | tatra samāgatān devān prasādaiśca sutarpayet || 91 || prāsādikaṃ sunaivedyaṃ rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnataḥ | dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇāyāṃ tad bhakṣaṇīyaṃ vratārthinā || 92||| prātaḥkāle brāhmabhāge snātvā hariṃ prapūjya ca | samarpayedupavāsaṃ jāgaraṃ vratamityapi ||93 || haraye cārpayet sarvaṃ vrataṃ ca phalamityapi | prasīda śrīhare me tvaṃ vratenānena sarvathā || 94|| ityuccārya jalaṃ dadyāt pṛthivyāṃ harisannidhau | jñānado muktido bhaktasukhado bhava sarvathā || 95|| ityuktvā ca tato natvā bhojayedvaiṣṇavān vratī | pāraṇāṃ ca tataḥ kuryād yathāsaṃbhavamagrataḥ || 96 || dānaṃ dadyātsarvatobhadrākhyamaṇḍalamityapi | sadhānyaṃ gurave dadyād ghaṭādikaṃ samūrtikam || 97|| prātaryadā dvādaśī tu svalpāpi na bhavettadā | rātrau tu pāraṇāṃ kuryād dvādaśyāmeva sarvathā || 98 || na tatra rātridoṣo’sti niṣedho nāsti pāraṇe | niśi snānaṃ pāraṇaṃ ca tatra doṣapradaṃ nahi || 99 || tatpūrvāparayāmābhyāṃ dinavat karma kārayet | yarhi bhavati svalpāpi dvādaśī pāraṇādine || 1.237.100 || uṣaḥkāle dvayaṃ kuryāt prātarmadhyāhnikaṃ tadā | sādhitā dvādaśī yena phalaṃ tasya hyanantakam || 101 || evaṃ vrataṃ kṛtaṃ yena sādhitaṃ sakalaṃ bhavet | dvādaśīṃ ca vrataṃ kṛtvā sādhayitvā harerdinam || 102 || bahavo vaiṣṇavā divyā gatā vaiṣṇavadhāma yat | nāsti hareḥ samo devo na tithirdvādaśīsamā || 103 || vrataṃ naikādaśītulyaṃ trayaṃ mokṣapradaṃ yataḥ | hareryogācca tatsarvaṃ bhavet pūrṇaṃ ca śāśvatam || 10 4|| bhaktānāṃ vallabhaṃ kuryād bhaktānāṃ vallabho hariḥ | vratajāgaraṇapūjāprakartā vallabho hareḥ || 1.237.1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ekādaśīvratajāgaraṇādimahimanirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 237 ||
<1.238> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mahādevaścaikadā māmupāgataḥ | pṛṣṭhavān sa ca māhātmyaṃ pratyekādaśikābhavam || 1 || dvādaśyāścāpi māhātmyaṃ tasmai saṃkathitaṃ mayā | yacchrutvā munayaḥ sarve phalaṃ prāpya divaṃ gatāḥ || 2 || taccāhaṃ te pravakṣyāmi koṭisvargaphalapradam | ekādaśī sadā ṛkṣayogena cottamā matā || 3 || jayā ca vijayā caiva jayantī ca matottamā | ekādaśyāṃ yadā ṛkṣaṃ śuklapakṣe punarvasū || 4 || nāmnā sā tu jayā bodhyā vratārthaṃ tithiruttamā | yadā ca śukladvādaśyāṃ nakṣatraṃ śravaṇaṃ bhavet || 5 || vijayā sā samākhyātā sahasraguṇitaṃ phalam | yadā ca śukladvādaśyāṃ prājāpatyaṃ bhavettadā || 6 || jayantīnāma sā sarvapāpanāśakarā tithiḥ | saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śuṣkaṃ cārdraṃ vināśayet || 7 || yadā vai śukladvādaśyāṃ puṣyaṃ bhavati karhicit | mahāpuṇyā ca sā bodhyā sarvottamā ca sā tithiḥ || 8 || tilaprasthapradānaṃ yaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ karoti hi | upavāsaśca tasyāṃ yaḥ kuryādasyādhikaṃ phalam || 9 || asyā vratasyānuyogāt svayaṃ tuṣṭo bhaveddhariḥ | pratyakṣadarśanaṃ yāti mokṣadaṃ ca phalaṃ bhavet || 1.238.1 0|| vācikānmānasāddehātpāpātsaptajanukṛtāt | puṣyayuktāmupoṣyaivāpnuyānmuktiṃ tathā parām || 11 || ekādaśīsahasrasya phalaṃ ca labhate vratāt | snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam || 1 2|| akṣayyaphaladaṃ cāsyāṃ kṛtaṃ mokṣapradaṃ bhavet | svarṇāṃgadena rājñā vai patnīvratadvijāya vai || 13 || pṛṣṭhaṃ kṛtayuge pūrve mokṣaprāptiprakāmyayā | upavāsasya naktasya caikabhuktasya kiṃ phalam || 14|| viṣayebhya upāvṛttendriyāṇāṃ vāsa aiśvare | mūrtau vā sa bhavelloke hyupavāsaḥ phalapradaḥ || 15|| nirjalo vā sajalo vā hyupavāsaḥ samucyate | saphalo vā payaḥpānayukto’pi saḥ prakathyate || 16 || daśamyāṃ tvekabhuktaṃ ca kṛtvā vrataṃ samācaret | daśamyāṃ vā tathā naktaṃ bhuktvā vai vratamācaret || 17|| divasasyāṣṭame bhāge mandībhūte divākare | bhojanaṃ naktamityuktaṃ na naktaṃ niśi bhojanam || 18|| nakṣatradarśane naktaṃ vyāpṛtasya bhavet khalu | vyavasāyijanasyaikādaśyāṃ naktaṃ ca bhojanam || 19|| nāsya niṣedhanaṃ yasmāt karmacārī jano’sti saḥ | madhyāhne caikabhuktaṃ vā kṛtvāpi vratamācaret ||1.238.20|| abalasya durbalasya kṛte’yaṃ bhojanādaraḥ | tataḥ prabhātasamaye caikādaśyāṃ vratī janaḥ ||2 1|| pragṛhṇīyācca niyamaṃ viṣayebhyo nivartane | pūjayecca hariṃ prātaḥ ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ ||22|| prārthayecca hariṃ sampūrṇaṃ vrataṃ me bhavediti | mā vighno me bhavettatra mā śraddhānāśa ityapi ||23|| vyavahāramayaṃ tatra vrate naiva samācaret | āvaśyakaṃ prakuryācca yanna vratavidhāyakam ||24|| payo jalaṃ phalaṃ mūlaṃ patraṃ śākaṃ rasastathā | oṣadhaṃ ca gurorvākyaṃ brahmavākyaṃ vivaśyatā ||25|| ekādaśāni caitāni hyavrataghnāni santi vai | bhojanaṃ cāpyaśaktasyāvrataghnaṃ bodhyameva ca ||26|| madhyāhne’pi jalasnānaṃ kuryācca pūjayeddharim | adhamaṃ kūpake snānaṃ vāpyāṃ tu madhyamaṃ hi tat ||27||| taḍāge vātha nadyāṃ vā snānaṃ vai cottamaṃ matam | tīrthe vāpi mahānadyāṃ samudre cottamottamam ||28|| gṛhe snānaṃ hyaśaktasya smṛddhasyāpi bhavet khalu | aśvakrānte rathakrānte viṣṇukrānte vasundhare ||29|| mṛttike tvāṃ śarīre me lepayāmi kṣamāṃ kuru | hara pāpāni sarvāṇi puṇyāni kuru sāmpratam ||1.238.3 0 || ityuktvā lepayed dehe śuddhyarthaṃ mṛttikāṃ janaḥ | maunamādāya kṛṣṇasya smarannāma jale śubhe ||3 1 || snāyāttathā ca haraye naivedyaṃ tatra kārayet | jalaṃ tathārpayet kālaṃ kathayā kṣapayed vratī ||32|| bhaktyā bhagavataḥ pūrṇaṃ dinaṃ tu gamayed vratī | rātrau tathā mahadbhāvabhṛtairvastubhirādarāt ||33|| pūjanaṃ devadevasya kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ niśi | yathā śuklā tathā kṛṣṇā vidhinaivaṃ prakārayet ||34|| ekādaśīdinaṃ vandhyaṃ vratahīnaṃ na yāpayet | evaṃ vratavidhāturvai bhagavān śrīhariḥ svayam ||35 || prasanno bhavati svasya dhāma nayati taṃ janam | phalaṃ ca śāśvataṃ pūrṇānandarūpaṃ dadātyasau || 36 || saṃkrāntīnāṃ caturlakṣaṃ yo dānaṃ pradadāti vai | ekādaśyupavāsasya taddhi naikakalāsamam || 37|| prabhāse kurubhūbhāge candrasūryagrahāplave | yatphalaṃ ca tataḥ śreṣṭhamekādaśyupavāsinaḥ || 38|| kedāre ca jalaṃ pītvā punarjanma na vidyate | tathā caikādaśīpuṇyavato janma na vidyate ||39 || aśvamedhādiyajñebhyo’dhikaṃ puṇyaṃ vrate bhavet | tapasvināṃ sahasraṃ ca pratyahaṃ yadgṛhe’bdakam ||1.238.40 || bhuṃkte ca tatphalācchreṣṭhaṃ caikādaśyupavāsinaḥ | gosahasrādhikaṃ puṇyaṃ śatordhvaṃ saṃprajāyate ||41|| brahmaviṣṇumaheśāḥ saṃvasantyekādaśīkṛtaḥ | dehe devasvarūpo’yaṃ vratī bhavati keśavaḥ ||42|| rukmiṇīsvāminaḥ sevāpuṇyasyānto na vidyate | ekādaśīvratasyāpi puṇyasaṃkhyā na vidyate ||43|| upavāsena pūrṇaṃ vai tadardhaṃ naktabhojanāt | ekabhuktāttadardhārdhaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃjāyate vrate ||44|| tāvadgarjanti tīrthāni dānāni niyamāni ca | yāvannopoṣayejjanturvāsaraṃ harivallabham ||45|| ekādaśīsamaṃ nāsti mahāyajñasahasrakam | mahādānasahasraṃ ca mahāsvargaśataṃ tathā ||46|| bhavatyekādaśīpuṇyāt mokṣārthaṃ hi matā tu sā | mārgaśīrṣe kṛṣṇapakṣe cotpannāto mama priyā ||47|| utpannatvācca sā nāmnotpattirekādaśī matā | utpattiṃ ca vidhānaṃ ca pūjanaṃ cācared vratī ||48|| abhayā sāpi saṃproktā pūjyaḥ sulakṣaṇāyutaḥ | kṛṣṇastu tilapuṣpaiśca naivedye ca guḍaudanaḥ ||49|| deyaṃ skandhaphalaṃ tvarghye vṛṣadānaṃ ca sammatam | tathaiva dakṣiṇā deyā kṛṣṇāya svarṇamudrikāḥ ||1.238.50|| utpattistatra kartavyā vidhinā vai vratotsave | prātarnārāyaṇo nidrāvaśo’sti gahvare yathā ||51 || siṃhavatīpranāptayeva parvate himavartini | himācalaguhā kāryā tadantaḥ śrīhariḥ svayam ||52|| supto’stīti praktvaptavyaṃ kartavyo muradānavaḥ | ekādaśī tathā kanyārūpā divyā suvarṇajā ||5 3 || kartavyā śastrasampannā tathā yuddhaṃ pradarśayet | muranāśastathā nārāyaṇajāgratsvabhāvatā ||54|| prakartavyā gahvare ca tayostatra prapūjanam | ekādaśyā hareścaiva tadā ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ||55|| sarvatobhadranāmātra saptadhānyaiśca maṇḍalam | kāraṇīyaṃ ca tanmadhye sauvarṇastāmrajo’thavā ||5 6 || ghaṭaḥ pañcasuratnādivastrapallavaśobhitaḥ | phalayuktaḥ sthāpanīyastatra sthālī tilānvitā ||57|| sthāpanīyā tatra mūrtidvayaṃ sthāpyaṃ hi mantrataḥ | pūjanaṃ vidhivat kārya pūrvoktavidhinā śubham ||58|| suśayyā sthāpanīyā saparyaṃkā sukhasaṃpradā | vrataṃ kāryaṃ divārātrau jāgaraṃ kāryamityapi ||59|| rātrau ca pūjanaṃ tatra hareḥ kartavyamaṃjasā | prātaḥ snānaṃ pūjanaṃ ca godānaṃ bhūmidānakam ||1.238.60 || svarṇadānaṃ yathāśakti gurave brāhmaṇāya vā | kāryaṃ visarjanaṃ paścāt pāraṇāṃ parivartayet ||61|| sādhūn sādhvīrarbhakāṃśca viprān dīnān subhojayet | mūrtidānaṃ ca gurave kuryād bhaktiprapūrvakam ||62|| yathādravyaṃ yathāśakti vistāraḥ kārya eva ca | rājyadānaṃ grāmadānaṃ kṣetradānaṃ gṛhārpaṇam ||63|| kanyādānaṃ paśordānaṃ ratnamaṇipradānakam | hastidānaṃ cāśvadānaṃ yānavāhanadānakam ||64|| annadānaṃ vastradānaṃ jñānavidyāpradānakam | yatsāmarthyo bhaved dātā tathā dānaṃ mataṃ sadā ||65|| vittaśāṭhyaṃ na prakartavyaṃ dhaninā ca nṛpeṇa ca | phaladānaṃ kāṣṭhadānaṃ tiladānādi vāpi ca ||66|| nirdhanenāpi kartavyaṃ sevā vā dehasaṃbhavā | vācā vā manasā vātha karābhyāṃ sevanaṃ tathā |67|| mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ vāryāharaṇaṃ pādamardanam | mandire dāsyavat vartyaṃ phalānantyādyavāptaye ||68|| bhāvayuktena bhagavān sevanena pratuṣyati | śṛṇu tatra śubhākhyānaṃ śravaṇādapi tārayet ||69|| purā tu vedhasastṛtīye kalpe marudeśajaḥ | rājāsīttu maruddhanvā svārthamātraparāyaṇaḥ ||1.238.7 0 || kalpasyānte kalau rājā pravṛtto viṣayeṣvati | kāmalobhotthadoṣaiśca prajā jātāpi tādṛśī ||71 || prajāyāṃ doṣabāhulye rājā doṣeṇa lipyate | rājñaḥ pāpācca vai vṛṣṭirjāyate nahi tadṛtau ||72|| evaṃ vṛṣṭipratibandhe prajāḥ sarvāḥ prapīḍitāḥ | anyonyaṃ svaṃ cāharanti vastra cānnādi sarvathā ||73|| nīyate ca balātsarvaṃ nyāyastatra na vidyate | yathā yathā vinā vṛṣṭiṃ samayo vyeti tattathā ||74|| prajāḥ niṣpīḍya rājā saḥ dhanānnāni vikarṣati | nārīśca gāśca tatsarvaṃ prasahya nayati nṛpaḥ ||75|| hiṃsānṛtasteyabalātkārādipāpadūṣite | deśe prajākṣayo jāto rājāpi dhvaṃsasanmukhaḥ ||76|| atipāpaṃ mahāpāpaṃ cakāra bahudhā muhuḥ | evaṃ saptābdaparyantaṃ vṛṣṭirnaivābhavattataḥ ||77|| rājño bhāryānnarāhityād rogapīḍātisaṃbhavāt | mṛtyūnmūkhī tathā putro mṛtyūnmukho’bhavat yadā || 78|| ākrośati sma rājāsau paramātmā samuddhara | pāpānyatikṛtānyeva na puṇyaṃ cārjitaṃ mayā ||79|| phalaṃ prāptaṃ mahadduḥkhaṃ nāśo’pi mastake dhṛtaḥ | ataḥ paraṃ na kiñcidvai kartuṃ śaknomi mādhava ||1.238.80|| samuddhara mahāduḥkhāt kṣudhayā prāṇanāśayā | ityākrośan hariṃ dhyāyan rauti vilāpapūrvakam ||8 1|| tāvadākāśavāṇyāsīnmā rājan rodanaṃ kuru | paścāttāpena pāpāni dagdhāni matsmṛtestathā |||82|| gṛhāṇedaṃ jalaṃ varṣābhavaṃ patrādikaṃ tathā | khādaya prāṇarakṣā vo bhaviṣyati sukhī bhava ||83|| ataścāgre tṛtīye ca dine tvekādaśī mama | priyā tithiḥ samupāvartate tasyā vrataṃ kuru ||84|| vṛṣṭiḥ sarvatra rājye te bhaviṣyati sukhāvahā | prajāḥ punaśca te rājye pravartsyanti sukhārthikāḥ |||85||| dhanadhānyamayo deśo bhaviṣyati ca tatphalam | prāpsyante ca prajāste’pi kurvantvekādaśīvratam ||86|| ityuktvopararāmeyaṃ rājā rājñī sutastathā | vrataṃ ca nirjalaṃ cakrurmahatpuṇyamabhūttataḥ ||87|| vrate kṛte mahāvṛṣṭirjātā deśaśca sasyavān | prajāvāsastato jāto rājñī nīrujatāṃ gatā ||88|| suto’pi sukhavān jātastasmai dadau dhuraṃ nijām | tatra varṣe kṛtāḥ sarvairekādaśyo hi vatsaram ||89|| tāvadākāśamārgeṇa vimānadvayamāgatam | rājñyarthaṃ ca nṛpatyarthaṃ vaimānikairadhiśritam ||1.238.90 || prāhuḥ svargīyadūtāstau samāgacchatamatra yat | yuvayorvratatajanyaṃ vai puṇyaṃ sahasranākadam ||9 1|| vartate tatsahasrayugavyāptaṃ bhogyameva hi | tatpuṇyena marunnāmā devaḥ kalpe caturthake ||92|| bhaviṣyasi kṣmāpate sabhāryastvaṃ svargṛhāṇa vai | ityuktaḥ sa tu bhūmīśo dehaṃ tyaktvā sabhāryakaḥ ||93|| yayau svargapradaṃ so’yaṃ kalpāntare punaḥ punaḥ | devo bhūtvā ca bhogāṃśca bhuktvā bhuktvātibhāvataḥ ||94|| svarṇāṃgado mahābhāgavato bhūtvātidāsavat | prasevya ca hariṃ prāpto dhāmāvṛtivivarjitam ||95|| tato mārgāsitapakṣotpattyaikādaśikāvratam | prayatnena prakartavyaṃ svargātsvargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam ||96|| ityutpattyabhidhaikādaśikāvratena sarvathā | rājyaputradhanalābhaścārogyaṃ sarvadā bhavet ||97|| sarvaṃ ceṣṭaṃ milet svargaṃ mokṣaścāpi bhavet tataḥ | sakāmaiścāpi niṣkāmaiḥ kartavyaṃ tadvrataṃ mahat ||98|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mārgaśīrṣakṛṣṇapakṣotpattyekādaśīvratavidhyāditatphalaprāptyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭātriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||238||
<1.239> śrīlakṣmīruvāca vande’haṃ devadeveśaṃ sarvajīvasukhapradam | antaryāmiṇamārādhyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 1 || pṛcchāmi bhagavan viṣṇo lokānāṃ kṣemakāmyayā | pāpināṃ pāpanāśāya sakāmānāṃ samṛddhaye || 2 || mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe kiṃnāmnyekādaśī śubhā | kiṃ phalaṃ ko vidhistasyāḥ ko devastatpatiḥ prabhuḥ || 3 || vistareṇa yathārthaṃ tat samācakṣva mama prabho | śrupvaitacchrīhariḥ prāha bhaktānāṃ hitakṛtprabhuḥ || 4 || śṛṇu lakṣmi mārgaśīrṣasitaikādaśikāvratam | asyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa vājapeyaphalaṃ bhavet || 5 || daśamyāṃ naktabhojī syād rātrau bhūśayanaṃ caret | brahmacārī bhavet krodhādikān doṣān parityajet || 6 || ekādaśyāṃ brāhmasaṃjñe muhūrte jāgratiṃ labhet | smared dāmodaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ mokṣadāyāḥ patiṃ prabhum || 7 || sarvapāpaharā mokṣapradā mokṣābhidhānikā | mokṣadā nāmataḥ proktā kṛṣṇena nijavāñcchayā || 8 || dāmodarasvarūpeṇa svīkṛtā raivatācale | dāmodaro hyataḥ pūjyo bhagavām̐śca tayā saha || 9 || prātaḥ smareddhariṃ dāmodaraṃ sanmokṣadā priyām | saṃkalpayenmayā kāryaṃ vrataṃ caivādya muktaye || 1.239.1 0|| smṛddhaye vāpi sarvasmai kāmāyeti gṛhī janaḥ | tataḥ śaucādiśuddhiṃ ca kṛtvā snātvā sutīrthake || 1 1|| ācamya ca hareḥ pūjāsāmagrīḥ samapādayet | maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kārayet saptadhānyakaiḥ || 12|| sauvarṇaṃ vātha tāmrasya ghaṭaṃ madhye nidhāpayet | paṃcapallavavastrādipañcaratnaphalābbhṛtam || 1 3|| nyasyetpātraṃ tilājyaṃ ca sthālīṃ vā tatra saddhare | mūrtiṃ dāmodaramokṣapradayoḥ svarṇanirmitām || 14|| sthāpayetpūjayet ṣoḍaśopacārairvidhānataḥ | tulasyā mañjarībhiśca dhūpadīpādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ || 15|| mālatīpuṣpamālābhiḥ śriyā saha ca keśavam | arghyaṃ phalaṃ tu nāriṃgaṃ naivedye modakāstathā || 16|| saptadhānyāni deyāni viśeṣaphalalabdhaye | yavagodhūmadhānyāni tilāḥ kaṃgūstathaiva ca || 17|| śyāmākaṃ cīnakaṃ ceti saptadhānyāni tāni vai | deyāni tu yathāśakti dāne śreṣṭhāni sarvathā || 18|| śriyā saha patiṃ vai keśavaṃ ca prārthayettadā | mayā vratamidaṃ mokṣadāyāḥ kṛtaṃ tvadāptaye || 19|| yathāśakti mayā pūjā kṛtā vai tava keśava | prasanno bhava deveśa sarvasmṛddhikaro bhava ||1.239.20|| mokṣado bhava me svāmin saṃsārārṇavatāraka | iti saṃstūya naivedyaṃ phalaṃ vāri samarpya ca ||21|| tāmbūlaṃ ca sugandhaṃ ca dadyātpaścānnamaskriyām | kuryāccārārtrikaṃ caivottārayed vandanaṃ stavam ||22|| pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavacca puṣpāṃjaliṃ samarpayet | yāni kāni ca pāpāni jñānājñānakṛtāni ca ||23|| vilayaṃ yāntu deveśa tava pūjāvratādinā | ityuccārya punarnatvā visarjanamathācaret ||24|| madhyāhne bhojanaṃ miṣṭaṃ devāya saṃpradāpayet | sāyaṃ niśāmukhe pūjāṃ ṣoḍaśābhisuvastubhiḥ ||25|| kārayecca tato jāgaraṇaṃ bhaktaiḥ prakārayet | dvādaśyāṃ ca tathā prātaḥ snātvā sampūjya keśavam ||26|| visarjayecca dānāni vividhāni pradāpayet|| bahudravyādi gurave dadyācca bhojanādikam ||27|| evaṃ vrataprakartā syād bhuktimuktipratāpavān | pitṝṇāṃ tārakaḥ sa syācchatavaṃśārtiśālinām |||28|| śṛṇu pūrvakathāṃ lakṣmi mokṣadāyāḥ phalārpaṇāt | adhoyonigatāḥ sarve pitaro muktimāgatāḥ ||29|| campāpūryāṃ bhūpatiśca mahān vaiśvānarābhidhaḥ | mahāvaiṣṇavatāṃ paścātprāpto’bhūt pitṛtārakaḥ ||1.239.30 || prajāḥ putrasamāḥ sarvā rakṣati sma sa bhūpatiḥ | vaiṣṇavā bahavo viprā vasanti sma ca tatpure ||3 1|| vedavedāṃgavijñānāḥ satkarmādiparāyaṇāḥ | smṛddhāśca vibhavairyuktāḥ prajāśca sampadādibhiḥ ||32|| sukhapūrṇāḥ samāsam̐śca rājño vaiśvānarasya vai | yadyapi puṇyapuñjena tapasā prākkṛtena ca ||33|| rājyaṃ smṛddhaṃ mahallabdhvā sadā rājyamadānvitaḥ | na karoti vrataṃ dānaṃ nāstikatvena bhūpatiḥ ||34|| na ca śrāddhaṃ karotyeva nānnavāryādidānakam | na puṇyapradakāryaṃ vā kārayati sma karhicat ||35|| puṇyaṃ na jāyate navyaṃ pitarastena duḥkhitāḥ | annavārivihīnāste pitṛlokādadhogatāḥ ||36 || svavaṃśajaṃ ca rājānaṃ śrāddhādihīnakarmakam | dṛṣṭvātiduḥkhino jātā uṣṇaśvāsātidurbalāḥ ||37|| niraye patitā rājño nāstikatvādipāpataḥ | te tu rātrau samāgatya svapne pratyakṣatāṃ gatāḥ ||38|| rudantaśca śvasantaśca rugṇāḥ saṃkṣudhitāstathā | tṛṣātiśuṣkakaṇṭhāścāśaktā naṣṭabalāstathā ||39|| tejohīnāstathā śuṣkaśirāḥ kṛṣṇānanāstathā | krośanto’tidaridrāśca duḥkhino bhikṣukā iva ||1.239.40 || parasparaṃ kathayanto duḥkhāni duḥsahāni vai | aho rājye sthitaścāsmadvaṃśajo’pi sa nāstikaḥ ||41|| na śrāddhaṃ kurute cāyaṃ vaiśvānaropi vāri vā | dadātyeva na vai kāle pitṛpakṣe manāgapi ||42|| piṇḍānnaiva dadātyeva jalaṃ naiva dadāti ca | tarpaṇaṃ na karotyeva kārayatyeva naiva ca ||43|| tena duḥkhena santaptā duḥkhinaḥ sarvadā vayam | adhogatiṃ gatāḥ sarve niraye patitāstathā ||44|| rājāyaṃ nāstiko jātaḥ kiṃ tena kusutena vai | varaṃ nirvaṃśatā yadvā varaṃ tvāstikaputratā ||45|| varaṃ mokṣagatiścāpi na varā tu kuputratā | anye naiva pradāsyanti putro naiva dadāti ca ||46|| kathaṃ kasmāt kutaḥ prāpyamannaṃ vāri ca vā manāk | yadi cāyaṃ jalaṃ piṇḍān dadyāt syāmaḥ sukhānvitāḥ ||47|| ityuktvāntarhitāḥ sarve rājābhūd vismayānvitaḥ | kathayāmāsa prātastadvṛttāntaṃ svapnajaṃ dvijān ||48|| mayā svapitaraḥ svapne dṛṣṭā nirayapātitāḥ | uktavantaśca putra tvaṃ tārayāsmānadhogatān ||49|| evaṃ bruvāṇāḥ saśvāsaṃ rudantaśca vikrandanam | dṛṣṭā mayā ca tān smṛtvā sukhaṃ me na bhavatyapi ||1.239.50|| adya me rājyamṛddhaṃ ca tathā rājñī gajāśvakam | na kiñcit sukhadaṃ bhāti rocate me na bhojanam ||51|| śaśvajjvalatyāntaraṃ me putrāghaṃ rocate nahi | kiṃ karomi hṛdayaṃ me dūyate pitṛjāgninā ||52|| kva gacchāmi samuddhārāyaiva teṣāṃ dvijottamāḥ | mucyante yena pitarastattapo vratamucyatām ||53|| yogo yajño’thavānyo’pi dānajādyutsavo mahān | yatkiṃcidvā mahatsvalpaṃ samuddhārakamucyatām ||54|| putre yogye samarthe ca jīvati pitarau yadi | duḥkhino niraye ghore phalaṃ sutasya kiṃ tadā ||55|| teṣāmuddhāra evātra tveṣṭavyo mama sarvathā | mā saṃkocaṃ prakurvantu dvijāḥ satyaṃ vadāmyaham ||56|| śrutvā rājñaḥ suvacanaṃ dvijā hṛṣṭā bhṛśaṃ tadā | procustaṃ pitṛkalyāṇaprayatnaṃ brāhmaṇāśritam ||57|| rājannasmatsu madhye’yaṃ samartho hi mahāmuniḥ | bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ vijānāti jaigīṣavyo’tiyogavān ||58 | sa ca te sarvamājñāya samādhau divyadṛṣṭimān | nivedayiṣyati drāk sat pitaro’dhogatāḥ katham ||59 || jaigīṣavyo’bhyarthitaśca pitṝn dhyātvā kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ | uvāca taṃ nṛpaṃ tatra jaigīṣavyo mahāmuniḥ ||1.239.60 || rājanna kevalaṃ cāsti nāstikatvaṃ tu kāraṇam | kintu te janakasyāsti nāstikatvaṃ ca kāraṇam ||6 1 || śṛṇu tathyaṃ kathayāmi mā kruddho bhava śaṃ bhaja | jāne’haṃ tava pitṝṇāṃ sarvaṃ pūrvaṃ viceṣṭitam ||62|| tava pituḥ kathayāmi śṛṇu cāvahito bhava | rājye tvāsīd yadā so’yaṃ tadā nāstikabhāvataḥ ||63 || vṛttiṃ jahāra devasya yā dattā pūrvajaittava | śāstradharmaṃ tathā cāsau gaṇayāmāsa naiva ca ||64|| rājyasya madamāsādya puṃścalīṣu pravartate | grāmāntare gataḥ so’yaṃ puṃścalyā vārayoṣitā ||65|| ṛtukāle’pi te māturnāyāto nijamandiram | na dattaṃ tava mātuśca ṛtudānaṃ tu dhārmikam ||66|| evaṃ muhurvartayitvā pāpalipto’bhavad bahu | śrāddhakāle tathā śrāddhaṃ na kṛtaṃ dharmalopinā ||67|| tena pāpaprabhāveṇa pātayitvā svakān pitṝn | narake vāsayitvā ca nāstikyabhāvapūritaḥ ||68|| antimam ṛtudānaṃ ca tava māturvidhāya ca | kālena nidhanaṃ prāptaḥ patito niraye’pi saḥ ||6 9|| pitṛbhirnijapāpena sahito niraye’patat | svapatnyartupradānaṃ ca puṃścalīgamanaṃ tathā ||1.239.70 || nāstikatvaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ śrāddhādyakaraṇaṃ tathā | svargalokānmahāsaukhyāt pitṛpātanahetavaḥ ||71|| ta ime patitāścaivehante tūddharaṇaṃ sutāt | suto’pi tvaṃ tathotpanno niṣekānnāstikasya vai ||72|| niṣeke yādṛśī vṛttiḥ putre bhavati tādṛśī | nāstikena samutpanno hyadhārmikeṇa yadbhavān ||73|| atastvaṃ nāstiko jātaḥ śrāddhaṃ naiva karoṣi ca | devavṛttiharastātaste’bhūt tasya pratikriyā ||74|| prāyaścittaṃ na caivāsti kalpakoṭiśatairapi | devavṛttirna vai hāryā pūrvairdattā nṛpaiḥ kvacit ||75|| tena pāpena narake duḥkhasyānto na jāyate | devavṛttiharasyātra padayoḥ raja ityapi ||76|| syād yasyopari patitaṃ saptakalpāḥ sa nārakī | ityuktaṃ prāṅ mahendrāya cāṇḍālyā gacchate puraḥ ||77|| ekadā kācidabalā cāṇḍālī tu śmaśānake | grāmaśūkaravakṣo’sthikṛtacūllyāḥ uparyatha ||78|| nṛmuṇḍaṃ pākapātraṃ ca dhṛtvā tatra śvamāṃsakam | madirātmajale kṣiptvā randhayati citāgninā ||79|| tāvattatpārśvatastatra mahendro nirgato yadā | pākapātraṃ tathā śīghraṃ chāditaṃ samupānahā ||1.239.80|| viśaṃkya tu tadā hīndrastāṃ papraccha paṭīyasīm | śuno māṃsaṃ surāpakvaṃ nṛmuṇḍe’tra citāgninā ||8 1|| sarvaṃ cāśuddhamevaitat carmaṇā chāditaṃ katham | pratyuvāca tadā sā vai cāṇḍālī śṛṇu devarāṭ ||82|| devadvijagavāṃ vṛttiṃ haranti hārayanti ye | teṣāṃ pādarajobhītyā carmaṇā chāditaṃ nvidam ||83|| yadi tvaṃ tādṛśo’bhūścenme pāko’śuddhatāṃ vrajet | na me bhojyaṃ bhavet tadvai vṛttighnāghapradūṣitam ||84|| indraḥ prāha kathaṃ yoṣit pātakaṃ cedṛśaṃ mahat | cāṇḍālī prāha madvākyaṃ nibodha ca yathārthataḥ ||85|| devā vai pitaraḥ proktā mātaro devatāstathā | devāśca vṛṣṭidātāro devāḥ saṃrakṣakāḥ sadā ||86|| yogakṣemaprakartāro lokānāṃ sarvadevatāḥ | jīvikāvṛttihā jīvahantā vai procyate khalu ||87|| vinā vṛttiṃ jīvanaṃ na vinā vṛttiṃ mṛto bhavet | devavṛttiharastasmāt pitṛhā mātṛhā tathā ||88|| devahā dharmahā tadvadātmahā svargahā hi saḥ | vṛṣṭihā lokahā caiva goghātī brahmaghātakaḥ ||89|| devaghātī vṛṣṭighātī sarvaghātī bhaveddhi saḥ | tasya pādarajaścāpi mahāpāpakaraṃ malam ||1.239.90 || tat śvamāṃse patitaṃ cenna me bhojyaṃ malaṃ hi tat | tasmānmayā tu pātraṃ taccarmaṇā chāditaṃ hi yat ||9 1 || yadi tvaṃ devavṛttīnāṃ dātā kartāsi cedyadi | tadā te padadhūlyātra pāvitaṃ palalaṃ bhavet |||92||| na me’styācchādane bhītirgaccha pūjya yathāsukham | indro’pi svasabhāyāṃ ca surarṣipitṛmānavaiḥ ||93|| śobhitāyāṃ taduktaṃ ca vṛttighnā mā bhavantviti | vṛttihārasya na cāsti niṣkṛtiḥ kathitā kvacit ||94|| tadārabhya trilokeṣu vṛttidānaṃ praśasyate | tasmād rājam̐stava pitrūddhārakaṃ karma nāsti vai ||95||| yenoddhāro bhavetteṣāṃ hareḥ sambandhamantarā | hareścāpi susambandho vratenaivopajāyate ||96|| mokṣadāyā vrataṃ mokṣapradaṃ prabhāvato hare | agatīnāṃ gatiḥ proktaṃ niṣkṛtirvajrapāpinām ||97|| sarvaṃ ca nirjalaṃ kāryaṃ pitṛbhyo dīyatāṃ phalam | mokṣadaikādaśījanyavratapuṇyaiḥ pramokṣaṇam ||98|| bhaviṣyatīti tatsarvaṃ gṛhītvā cābhipūjya ca | satkṛtya sādhūn viprām̐śca gṛhān gantuṃ nyavedayat ||99|| mārgaśīrṣe’tha samprāpte site caikādaśī ca yā | rājñā copoṣitā pūjā harervidhānataḥ kṛtā || 1.239.100 || sarvatobhadrakaṃ kṛtvā saikādaśīhari ca saḥ | pūjayāmāsa vidhinā dadau dānāni bhūriśaḥ || 10 1|| jāgaraṇaṃ ca kṛtavān prātaḥsnānādikaṃ tathā | kṛtvā ca puṇyamevaitad datvā pitṛbhya ityapi || 1 02|| pāraṇāṃ kṛtavān vaiśvānaro rājā vidhānataḥ | mokṣadaikādaśīpuṇyadānena pitarastadā || 10 3|| svapitrā sahitāḥ sarve śīghraṃ vai mokṣamāviśan | puṇye datte ca pitṝṇāṃ muktau vaimānikāḥ surāḥ || 1 04|| cakruḥ kusumavṛṣṭiṃ ca procuḥ puṇyā girastathā | svasti svasti ca putraste vayaṃ devāḥ samāgatāḥ || 1 05|| ekādaśyāḥ puṇyadānāt pitarastāritāstvayā | te sarve mokṣamāpannā prāhurvai pitaro’pi te || 106|| vayaṃ mokṣaṃ samāpannāḥ putra te kuśalaṃ bhavet | sukhī bhava sadā saukhyapradātā bhava dehinām || 1 07|| śrāddhakartā yajñakartā devānāṃ pūjako bhava | mātāpitṛprasevādikartā bhava sadānagha || 108|| dīrghajīvī cāstikastvaṃ patnīvrataparo bhava | devavṛttipradātā ca brāhmaṇānāṃ prapūjakaḥ || 10 9|| satāṃ sevā prakartā ca sādhvīnāṃ vratarakṣakaḥ | gobhūrakṣākaro nityaṃ smṛddhaḥ syāḥ sarvadā suta || 1.239.11 0|| ityevamāśīrvādaiśca saṃyujya pitaraḥ surāḥ | praśaṃsanto mokṣadāyā vratapuṇyaprabhāvakam || 11 1|| gatā yathāmataṃ sthānaṃ bruvantaḥ svasti vai muhuḥ | rājāpi pāpanāśena mokṣadāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ || 1 12|| mahābhāgavato jātaḥ sakuṭumbaḥ samāstikaḥ | yajñayāgakaro nityaṃ viprasādhuprapūjakaḥ || 11 3|| devapūjākaraścaiva dharmavān doṣavarjitaḥ | tasyābhūcca mahān dhārmirvaiṣṇavo hutabhuk sutaḥ || 1 14|| rājyaṃ sutāya dattvā saḥ paraṃ mokṣamavāptavān | hutabhuk cāpi jaṭhare prāṇināṃ devatātmakaḥ || 1 15|| mahām̐śca vaiṣṇavo bhūtvā vahnirūpeṇa tiṣṭhati | mokṣadāyā vrataiśvaryaṃ bodhyaṃ taddevabhāvadam || 1 16|| evaṃ yaḥ kurute lakṣmi mokṣāmekādaśīṃ śubhām | tasya pāpāni naśyanti mṛto mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 1 17|| nātaḥ parataraṃ kiñcid vajrapāpavināśakam | mokṣadaṃ cābhavat kiṃcinnārāyaṇaprabhāvavat || 1 18|| asyā na puṇyasaṃkhyāsti priyaṃ tvetadvrataṃ mama | cintāmaṇisamā mokṣapradā sā me bahupriyā || 1 19|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi vratatulyaphalapradā | putrasmṛddhipradā bhuktimuktidā mama vallabhā || 1.239.120|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mārgaśīrṣaśuklapakṣīyamokṣadaikādaśīvratavidhāne vaiśvānaranṛpativṛttāntatatpitruddhārādinirūpaṇanāmaikonacatvāriṃ śadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 239 ||
<1.240> śrīlakṣmīruvāca pauṣakṛṣṇaikādaśī ca kiṃnāmnī ko vidhistathā | kiṃ phalaṃ kā ca lakṣmīśca ko devaḥ pūjyate vada || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca kathayāmi śṛṇu lakṣmi pauṣaikādaśikāvratam | ekādaśīvratenāhaṃ tuṣṭo bhavāmi sarvathā || 2 || pauṣasya kṛṣṇapakṣīyā saphalā nāmato hi sā | tasyāṃ nārāyaṇaṃ saṃkarṣaṇākhyaṃ svāminaṃ prabhum || 3 || sunandāpatnikāyuktaṃ pūjayed bhāvanāyutaḥ | pūjāyāṃ munipuṣpāṇi naivedye guḍalaḍḍukāḥ || 4 || atrārghye cāmṛtaphalaṃ svarṇadānaṃ ca śasyate | prāguktavidhinā kāryā daśamyekādaśī tathā || 5 || dvādaśīpāraṇaṃ caiva kartavyaṃ coktarītitaḥ | prātarvai sarvatobhadramaṇḍale vratavāsare || 6 || ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya ca hariṃ phalaiśca vividhairvratī | nārīkelaphalaiścaiva kramukairbījapūrakaiḥ || 7 || jambīrairdāḍimaiścaiva tathā dhātrīphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ | lavaṃgairbadaraiścaiva tathāmraiśca viśeṣataḥ || 8 || yatra yatphalalabdhiḥ syāt tattatphalaiḥ prapūjayet | ṣoḍaśopasuvastvādyaiḥ pūjanaṃ mahadācaret || 9 || dīpadānaṃ viśeṣeṇa saphalāyāṃ prakārayet | dhānyadānaṃ vastradānaṃ svarṇadānaṃ gavārpaṇam || 1.240.1 0|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānmilitairvaiṣṇavaiḥ saha | yadi nimeṣamātraṃ yaḥ kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ niśi || 11 || yajñādhikaṃ phalaṃ sarvatīrthāplāvanaja phalam | varṣasahasratapasāṃ phalādhikaphalaṃ bhavet || 12| śṛṇu lakṣmi kathā māhiṣmatasya nṛpateḥ purā | satyayuge samajātā saphalāvratasaṃśrayāt || 13||| narmadāyāstaṭe’raṇye parvataprāyabhūtale | bhārate dakṣiṇe madhye purī māhiṣmatī śubhā || 14|| māhiṣmatasya rājñastadrājyaṃ cābhūnmahattaram | tasya saumyāḥ pañca putrā hyāsan sarve kumārakāḥ || 15|| dhīmān śrīmān dhṛtimāṃśca kīrtimān śaktimāniti | teṣāṃ madhye tu dhīmān vai jyeṣṭhaḥ pāparato’bhavat || 16|| yauvanaṃ prāpya madyādi piban māṃsaṃ prabhakṣayan | veśyāṃ ca gamayan dārāḥ parā atyabhimarṣayan || 17|| cauryaṃ ca pararāṣṭreṣu prasahya kārayan svakaiḥ | pāpātipāpaduṣṭātinikṛṣṭācāravānabhūt || 18|| dyūtaṃ pānaṃ ca mṛgayā pramadā māṃsamityamūn | doṣān sa poṣayan dravyaṃ nāśayāmāsa vai pituḥ || 19|| gamitaṃ maṇiratnādi svarṇādi pāpakarmabhiḥ | bubhukṣitastato jāto malino vedanindakaḥ || 1.240.20 || asadbhāvo brāhmaṇānāṃ satāṃ dharmasya nindakaḥ | vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca devānāṃ viśeṣānnindako’bhavat ||21|| prajāyāṃ sarvathā copadravaṃ piśācavaddhi saḥ | nityaṃ karotyato rājñā tvāhūto lumbhakābhidhaḥ ||22|| pitrā ca bāndhavaiḥ sarvairlumbhakastyakta eva hi | niṣkāsitaśca rāṣṭrādvai prajābhistāḍanādibhiḥ ||23|| yatra gacchati lumbho’sau tiraskāraṃ sa vindati | na ca saukhyamavāpnoti na ko’pi satkaroti tam ||24|| nirdhano gatasattāko veśyayāpi viniṣkṛtaḥ | paryaṭan vanavṛkṣeṣu kṣudhātṛṣārditaḥ svayam ||25||| duḥkhaṃ tapaḥsvarūpaṃ vai ghoraṃ sehe’tidāruṇam | paścāttāpaṃ karoti sma muhuḥ svārjitakarmaṇām ||26 || tyakto’haṃ bāndhavaiḥ pitrā prajābhirveśyayā tathā | rājyānniṣkāsitaścāpi sarvaiścāpi tiraskṛtaḥ ||27|| varaṃ cātra vane vāsaḥ paraṃ vairaṃ na śāmyati | vairasya yāpanāyaiva vairiṇo’haṃ nihanmi vai || 28|| pituśca nagaraṃ sarvaṃ ghātayiṣyāmi sarvathā | lopayiṣyāmi saudhām̐śca hariṣyāmi dhanādikam || 29|| śanaiḥ śanairidaṃ kāryaṃ dhanaṃ hartavyamuttamam | vane gupte pravastavyaṃ syāṃ na hastagato yathā ||1.240.30 || iti pāpamatiṃ kṛtvā dāruṇe gahane vane | jīvaghātarato nityaṃ steyahiṃsādiniṣṭhuraḥ ||3 1|| vasan rātrau ca nagaraṃ gatvā śastrairjanānbahūn | ghātayitvā dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ vastraṃ prabhūtamityapi || 32|| nayati sma mahāraṇye khādati hlādate muhuḥ | sarvaṃ ca nagaraṃ tena muṣitaṃ pāpavṛttinā || 33|| trāso mahān prajāyāṃ ca vartate sma nirantaram | akasmāddhanaharaṇaṃ prasahya śreṣṭhino janān ||34|| karoti sma kvacid vakrān mārayatyapi jīvataḥ | ekadā sa gṛhe rājamantriṇaḥ praviveśa ha ||35|| dhanaṃ bahu hṛtaṃ tena tathā khādyaṃ ca khāditam | pramadāśca tathā bhuktāstathā bālāśca tāḍitā |||36 || gṛhaṃ prajvālitaṃ tasya kṛtaścopadravo mahān | tāvattatra samāyātaiḥ rājabhaṭairniśācaraiḥ ||37|| gṛhīto nigaḍe baddho raśmibhirhastayordhṛtaḥ | uvāca tān suto’haṃ vai rājño māhiṣmatasya vai ||38|| mocanīyo’hamevātra tvanyathā vaḥ sukhaṃ nahi | hariṣye bhavatāṃ prāṇān nāśayiṣyāmi śastrakaiḥ ||39|| kariṣye vo nāśameva dhanadārāgṛhārthinām | rājñaḥ suto na dhartavyaḥ kadācana sukhepsubhiḥ ||1.240.40 || dharṣaṇīyo na vai sarpo vipraḥ kṣatriya eva ca | vināśaphaladāste vai rakṣakāstu natāḥ sadā ||41|| iti śrutvā ca tairmukto gato’raṇye punarhi saḥ | āmiṣaṃ bhakṣayannityaṃ vārkṣaphalāni bhakṣayan |||42|| prāṇayātrāṃ sa nirvāhayati kandādibhistathā | cauryeṇāpi svanirvāhaṃ karoti vanavāsavān ||43|| vane tatrābhavajjīrṇaṃ viṣṇusthānaṃ vinirjanam | aśvatthasya ca vṛkṣasyādhomūle naṣṭabhittikam ||44|| naṣṭadvāraṃ naṣṭaśālaṃ naṣṭacchāyaṃ nirāśrayam | tatrānena tu bhagnayā mūrterviṣṇorhi vedikā |45|| āśrayārthaṃ svīkṛtāsīd viśrāntirlabhyate’tra ca | aśvattho’pi jīrṇaśākhastambaśca bahuvārṣikaḥ ||46|| devabhāvena vṛkṣo’yaṃ viṣṇuyogāddhi vartate | tatra vāsāllumbhakasya devisthānapratāpataḥ ||47|| buddhistu sāttvikī jātā vicāraṃ cākaroddhi saḥ | aho mayā kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bahu yasya na niṣkṛtiḥ ||48|| athāpi na mayā kāryaṃ hiṃsanaṃ prāṇaghātakam | kandādyattvā ca nirvāhaṃ kariṣye pippalāśrayaḥ ||49|| viṣṇuścātra vasatyeva mūrtau tu pippale tarau | kariṣyati mama śreyaḥ pāpaṃ prajvālayiṣyati ||1.240.50|| ityevaṃ kṛtabuddhiḥ saḥ śaityakāle’pi bhūtale | vṛkṣastambāśraye rātriṃ nirgamayati kaṣṭataḥ ||51|| tāvattatra samāyātāścaurāścānye vanāśrayāḥ | lumbhakasya ca vastrādi prajahruḥ pauṣakṛṣṇake ||52|| pauṣasya kṛṣṇapakṣe tu daśamyāṃ prātareva saḥ | phalānyāhṛtya bubhuje kathaṃcid divaso gataḥ |||53 || rātrau tvākasmikaṃ śaityaṃ himāḍhyaṃ pravavarṣa ha | yatrāgnitāpanenāpi rakṣaṇaṃ na yathā bhavet ||54|| tathā śītapravāhasya bhogabhūto’bhavaddhi saḥ | vastrahīno vivṛttākṣo milanmukho’bhavajjaḍaḥ ||55|| nidrāsukhaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ ca gataprāṇa ivābhavat | miladdaśanajihvāsyo hastapādajaḍatvavān ||56|| śavavat sa tadā jātaḥ śaityena paripīḍitaḥ | kintu prāṇā gatā naiva gataceṣṭo’bhavaddhi saḥ ||57|| āntare smarati viṣṇuṃ rakṣakaṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ | prātarjātaṃ saphalāyā ekādaśyāstathāpi saḥ ||58|| bhānūdaye’pi śītārdro na lebhe cetanāṃ tadā | ravau madhyagate so’yaṃ saṃjñāṃ lebhe hi lumbhakaḥ ||59|| itastato vilokyaiva vyutthito hyabhavattataḥ | viṣṇuṃ vṛkṣaṃ raviṃ natvā skhalan padbhyāṃ vane gataḥ ||1.240.60 || khañjavat saśanairgacchan kṣutkṣāmaḥ śaktihīnakaḥ | vepamānāṃgakaścāpi satphalānyājahāra saḥ ||6 1|| viṣṇave cārpaṇīyāni tato grāhyāṇi vai mayā | ityācintya samāgatya vṛkṣamūle nidhāya ca ||62|| yāvattiṣṭhati vṛkṣādho luṃbhako’tīva nirbalaḥ | tāvadastaṃgataḥ sūryaḥ kaṣṭaṃ śuśoca vai tadā ||63|| aśrūṇi vinimucyaiva kā bhaviṣyati me daśā | śaityaṃ ca bādhate samyag bhavet parṇairna rakṣaṇam ||64|| śaityapravārakaṃ puṣṭaṃ valkalādi na vidyate | na gūhā na ca tārṇaṃ vā kaṭaṃ cāpyatra vidyate ||65|| tathāpi tṛṇapuṃje’trāśrayaṃ kṛtvā svapimyaham | iti vicintya nikaṭe tṛṇānyādātumutsukaḥ ||66|| phalāni viṣṇumūrteśca samīpe vinidhāya ca | uccārya ca phalairebhiḥ śrīpatistuṣyatāṃ hariḥ ||67|| tato yāto’tinikaṭe tṛṇānayanahetave | kintu balaprahīṇaḥ saḥ vedikāyāḥ samīpataḥ ||68|| punarmūrcchāmavāpaiva nārāyaṇa iti smaran | kṣaṇāntare samutthāya tṛṇānyādāya pippale ||69 || stambādhāre svayaṃ yāvadāgatya ca niṣīdati | tāvanmūrchā punarjātā punaścaitanyamāptavān ||1.240.70|| viṣṇuṃ smṛtvā lumbhakaḥ sa nidrāṃ lebhe na śāntidām | prātaḥ phalāni bhokṣyāṇītyevaṃ niśāṃ nināya saḥ ||7 1|| evaṃ vivaśataḥ prāptaṃ vratāhaṃ cāvidannapi | sopavāsaṃ sajāgaraṃ kṛtavān śītapīḍitaḥ ||72|| tatphalaiḥ pūjanaṃ mene naivedyaṃ cāpi keśavaḥ | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ mene viṣṇustasya durātmanaḥ ||73|| saphalāyā vrataṃ mene tapaḥ svāśrayajaṃ tathā | viṣṇuḥ prasannatāṃ prāpto dayālurdīnavatsalaḥ ||74|| lumbhakasyākarod bhāgyaṃ puṇyāḍhyaṃ śāśvataṃ śubham | akasmādvratamevaitatkṛtavān vai sa lumbhakaḥ ||75||| dvādaśyāṃ ca tadā prātaḥ phalānyattvā hareḥ puraḥ | stutiṃ cakāra devasya saṃsārādrakṣaṇaṃ prati ||76|| sūryasyodayanaṃ yāvat tāvadviṣṇuścaturbhujaḥ | saṃkarṣaṇasvarūpeṇa prāvirbabhūva tatpuraḥ ||77|| divyāvayavaśobhāḍhyo divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ | divyamandaprasannāsyahāsyalāsādiśobhitaḥ ||78||| dakṣahastena lumbhaṃ taṃ spṛṣṭvā ca mastake’vadat | rājyaṃ prāpsyasi bhakta tvaṃ saphalāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ ||79 || gaccha svanagaraṃ tatra te pitā nidhanaṃ gataḥ | anye parasparaṃ putrā viruddhyantyabhiṣecane ||1.240.80|| parasparaṃ viruddhāste rājyamukuṭavañcitāḥ | rājyaṃ ca nāpnuvan mantriprajābhiranadhikṛtāḥ ||8 1 || tavāgamaṃ pratīkṣante prajāste bhāgyavardhanāt | kālo’yaṃ te punaryāto hyekādaśīphalodayāt ||82|| yaiḥ pūrvaṃ tāḍyate tiraskriyate kālavegataḥ | taireva punariṣyate hyaho kālabalaṃ mahat ||83|| bhāgyahānermahatkaṣṭaṃ sukhaṃ bhāgyodaye punaḥ | bhāgyodayo vṛtādyaiśca jāyate kāryameva tat ||84|| tasmād gaccha svakaṃ rājyaṃ gṛhāṇa mā ciraṃ kuru | ityuktvā bhagavān viṣṇustatra tvantarjagāma ha ||85|| lumbhakaḥ pippale viṣṇuṃ natvā tejo hyavāptavān | divyarūpasvarūpaḥ san bhūtvā svanagarīṃ yayau ||86|| mantriprajāgragaiḥ sammānitaḥ svāgatavardhitaḥ | divyābharaṇaśobhābhiralaṃkṛto’tha vaiṣṇavaḥ ||87|| bhūtvā rājyābhiṣekaṃ svapitṛparamparāgatam | prāpto hareḥ prasādena saphalāyā vratena ca ||88|| bhāgyodayena rājā sa lebhe rājyamakaṇṭakam | śubhaṃ rājyaṃ prajārakṣāpālanādividhānataḥ ||89|| śatavarṣaṃ ca tadrājyaṃ kṛtvārādhya hariṃ tathā | prajāśīrvādamāsādya putraṃ mānajitāhvayam ||1.240.90 || rājye’bhiṣicya ca vanaṃ yāto yatrābhavatpurā | viṣṇumārādhya ca tatra nirmāya viṣṇumandiram ||91 || harerarcāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya sevitvā ca tathānvaham | tapasā yogasāmyena kṣapayitvāntarāśayān ||92|| gataḥ kṛṣṇasya sānnidhyaṃ vimānena sutejasā | pārṣadāśca harestatra vimāne taṃ pragṛhya ca ||93|| yayurdhāma harerdivyaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati | tatra golokasaṃjñe vai dhāmni lumbhakabhūpatiḥ ||94|| śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sevate nityaṃ pārṣadairabhipūjitaḥ | evaṃ yaḥ kurute loke saphalāvratamuttamam ||95|| iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya mṛto mokṣamavāpnuyāt | dhanyāste mānavā loke saphalāvratakāriṇaḥ ||96|| teṣāṃ tu saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ ca dhanādikam | saphalāyā vrataṃ yaistu kṛtaṃ vai bhāvapūrvakam || 97|| saphalaikādaśī rājyalakṣmīrūpaphalapradā | muktidā ceti sā kāryā bhuktimuktisamīpsubhiḥ ||98|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccaiva vratasya karaṇāttathā | rājasūyasya yajñasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ || 99|| putrān pautrān dhanaṃ smṛddhiṃ sampadṃ rājyamityapi | vidyāṃ puṣṭiṃ tathārogyaṃ muktiṃ ca labhate vratī || 1.240.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pauṣakṛṣṇasaphalaikādaśīvratavidhipāpilumbhakanṛpakumārarājyaprāptyākhyānādinirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||240||
<1.241> śrīlakṣmīruvāca nārāyaṇa namastubhyaṃ purāṇapuruṣottama | mokṣakaraṃ ca jīvānāṃ phaladaṃ ca vrataṃ śubham || 1 || śrāvayase yena pāparāśayaḥ prajvalanti vai | pauṣaśuklasya ca yā vai bhavedekādaśī śubhā || 2 || kathayasva prasādena kiṃnāmnī ko vidhistathā | ko devaḥ pūjyate tatra phalaṃ cāpi kiyanmatam || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca lokānāṃ hitalābhāya kathayāmi priye ca tām | pauṣasya śuklapakṣasyaikādaśī putradābhidhā || 4 || sarvapāpaharā bhaktaiḥ kartavyaiṣā prayatnataḥ | sānandāpi ca sā proktā putrānandapradāyinī || 5 || nārāyaṇo’dhidevo’tra pūjyaśca padmayā saha | sarvasiddhiprado devaḥ putrakāmaprapūrakaḥ || 6 || guggulapuṣpakaiḥ pūjyastathānyaiḥ kālasaṃbhavaiḥ | cūrṇalaḍḍukanaivedyaṃ dadyācca paramātmane || 7 || arghyaṃ ca dāḍimaphalaṃ phalānyanyāni cāpi vai | ghṛtapūrṇaghaṭo deyaḥ śrīpadmāpataye tathā || 8 || dakṣiṇāścāpi dātavyā svarṇarūpā viśeṣataḥ | daśamyāṃ naktabhojī yo vratī pṛthvyāṃ śayīta ca || 9 || ekādaśyāṃ brāhmakāle samutthāya hariṃ smaret | snātvā pūjopacārāṇi saṃgṛhya pūjayeddharim || 1.241.10 || satpātre ca samasthāpya paṃcāmṛtena vāriṇā | snāpayed devadeveśaṃ vastrabhūṣādi dhārayet || 11 || lepayed dravyagandhādi puṣpahāraiśca śobhayet | dhūpadīpākṣatapuṣpasāmagrībhiḥ prapūjayet || 1 2|| naivedyaṃ miṣṭabhojyādi jalapānādikaṃ dadet | nīrājanastutipradakṣiṇādibhiḥ prasādayet || 13|| vratārthaṃ prārthayed devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | putradāyā vrataṃ cāhaṃ karomi pūrṇatā vrajet || 14|| ityabhyarthya tataḥ saptadhānyaiśca racayecchubham | maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kartavyaṃ tatra vai ghaṭaḥ || 15|| sthāpanīyaḥ pallavādiyutastadupari sthale | tilapūrṇaṃ śubhaṃ pātraṃ tatra mūrtirharestathā || 16|| pratiṣṭhāpya ṣoḍaśabhirvastubhiḥ pūjayetprabhum | ārārtrikaṃ ca puṣpāṇāmaṃjaliṃ cārpayet tataḥ || 17|| prārthayet phalalābhāya tathā dānāni dāpayet | madhyāhne’pi tathā pūjānaivedyādi samarpayet || 18|| sāyaṃkālottaraṃ cāpi viśiṣṭaṃ pūjanaṃ tathā | jāgaraṇaṃ prakuryācca dvādaśyāṃ ca tathāvidham || 1 9|| pūjanaṃ vastudānaṃ ca kuryād vratī tato janān | dvijān sādhūṃśca sādhvīśca bhojayetpāraṇāṃ svayam ||1.241.20||| kuryāccaiva vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ phalaṃ mokṣādikaṃ bhavet | putradāyā vratameva yaḥ kuryād bhaktino janaḥ ||21|| putraputrīgajago’śvadhānyakṣetrādikaṃ śubham | prāpnuyāccāpi muktiṃ ca śrīhareḥ kṛpayā vratī || 22|| atrārthe śṛṇu lakṣmi te pravakṣyāmi kathānakam | putradāphalalābhātmasmṛddhidaṃ sukhadaṃ param ||23|| purā yuge tu saurāṣṭre bhadrāvatyabhidhe pure | rājāsīt ketumām̐stasya rājñī cumpābhidhābhavat ||24|| vārdhakyātisunaikaṭyaṃ gatasyāpi ca bhūpateḥ | putro nābhūd yato’putraḥ śocatyanudinaṃ nṛpaḥ ||25|| kālo yāti na cāśāsti putrārthe svastriyā api | tābhyāṃ pracintitaṃ putraprāptidaṃ dānapūjanam ||26|| kṛtaṃ ca vividhaṃ yādṛg viprairvai darśitaṃ tathā | bahubhirbahudhā proktaṃ kṛtaṃ tad vividhaṃ śubham |||27|| naivātmajaṃ nṛpo lebhe vaṃśakartāramapyatha | kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi vārdhakyaṃ dṛśyate puraḥ ||28|| kathaṃcitprāntakālepi sutaprāptiryathā bhavet|| tathopāyāḥ prakartavyā niścityeti nṛpaḥ punaḥ ||29|| yāti bahusthalaprakhyān sāmarthyāḍhyān sato janān | āśīrvādām̐śca gṛhṇāti viphalāśca bhavanti te ||1.241.3 0 || na rāṣṭrasya na rājyasya sukhaṃ lebhe suketumān | sādhvyā rātryā samaṃ nityaṃ duḥkhito vartate bhṛśam ||3 1|| cintāśokaparābhyāṃ ca tābhyāṃ dattaṃ jalādikam | śrāddhe tu pitaraḥ sarve kavoṣṇamupabhuṃjate ||32|| ketumati mṛte paścād vaṃśajaṃ tarpaṇāya naḥ | paśyāmo nahi kiṃ kurmo yo’smākaṃ tarpayiṣyati || 33|| ityevaṃ duḥkhitā sarve pitaro yānti niḥsukhāḥ | na ca bandhujanā mitrajanā amātyamantriṇaḥ ||34|| suhṛdaśca prajā dāsā dāsyaḥ samṛddhayo gajāḥ | rocayantyasya rājño vai svapne’pi duḥkhakāriṇaḥ || 35|| nityaṃ tasya mano’svasthaṃ nairāśyena vidūyate | aputrasya janasyātra khalu tatrāpi bhūpateḥ ||36|| smṛddhasya rājyabharturvai nāstyeva janmanaḥ phalam | aputrasya gṛhaṃ dārāḥ smṛddhiḥ śūnyaṃ hi dṛśyate || 37|| sutaṃ vinā ṛṇaṃ pitṛdevarṣīṇāṃ na mucyate | aurasaṃ sutamāsādyānṛṇatvaṃ paitradaivatam || 38|| labhyate ca yaśastvatra paraloke śubhā gatiḥ | putreṇa jāyate tasmāt sutamutpādayejjanaḥ ||39|| putrastu puṇyakartṝṇāṃ jāyate sukhadaḥ sadā | āyuṣyārogyasampattidhanadhānyapravardhakaḥ ||1.241.40 || hareḥ kṛpāṃ tathā puṇyaṃ vinā putrajanirna vai | na ca puṇyakṛtāṃ lokaprāptiścāpi sutaṃ vinā ||41|| putro dhanaṃ mahatproktaṃ putro vai sampaducyate | putro gṛhaṃ sutaḥ sambandho’pi lokeṣu gīyate ||42|| sutaṃ vinā na sambandho na taṃ vinā kuṭumbitā | tāṃ vinā na yaśo loke tadvinā na svaravyayam ||43|| rātriṃdivā svayaṃ rājā cintayan labhate na śam | ātmanāśaṃ cet karomi tvātmaghāte’tidurgatiḥ ||44|| anaśane’pi loke’tra hāhākāraśca durgatiḥ | tasmānmayā ca kiṃ kāryaṃ vicāryaivaṃ divāniśam ||45|| varaṃ tapasā dehasya kṣapaṇaṃ cetimānasaḥ | rātrāvaśvaṃ samāruhya jagāmāraṇyamekalaḥ ||46|| na jānanti prajāścāsya gṛhadārādayastathā | kva gato’yaṃ mahārāja ityabhūvan vicintitāḥ ||47|| cintāparātiduḥkhāste yayustanmārgaṇāya vai | aśvapādapravinyāsān dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā yayurvanam ||48|| śādvale’tighane deśe vājipādāvalekhanam | yadā dṛṣṭaṃ na tairbhūmau tadā te svapuraṃ prati ||49|| āyayuḥ śokacintāśca preṣayāmāsurāśritān | vanyān vane mārgaṇāya tairapyāpto na bhūpatiḥ ||1.241.50 || vanādanyavanaṃ rājā tatopi gahanaṃ vanam | dūraṃ dūraṃ siṃhahastisevitaṃ praviveśa ha ||51|| bhāgyayogānna vai kaiściddhiṃsairvyāpādito nṛpaḥ | nāśvo’pi maraṇaṃ prāpto daivayogāddhi jīvataḥ ||52|| vanavṛkṣānvaṭān bilvānkadambānpanasāndhavān | kharjūrān pippalānsvarṇacampakām̐śca vilokayan ||193|| tathā tālānsarjatarūm̐stamālām̐sūtilakān vaṭān | bakulānsaptaparṇāṃśca tintiḍīśca vilokayan ||54|| iṅgudīrbadarīścaiva jambūm̐śca karamardakān | vaṃśānaśokānkadalīnāryaṃgānnārikelakān ||55|| paśyan yayau vanaṃ ghoraṃ paśyansiṃhānmṛgānkhagān | analānhaṃsakāraṇḍabakām̐ścamarīgośaśān ||56|| vyāghrām̐śca bhallukān genḍānśṛṃgamṛgām̐śca śallakām | gajām̐śca gavayānvanyamahiṣānbhujagām̐stathā ||57|| paśyannāścaryasaṃyukto’dṛṣṭapūrvāṃśca dehinaḥ | śṛṇvannulūkajambūkarkṣamṛgādirutāni saḥ ||58|| vanyāni bhakṣayan puṣpaphalāni ca yayau nṛpaḥ | tṛṣitaścintayāmāsa saḥ śuṣkagalakandharaḥ ||59|| mārgayāmāsa salilāśayaṃ pakṣirutānugaḥ | tatra divyajalaṃ suṣṭhu saro dṛṣṭvā nisargajam ||1.241.6 0|| aśvapaṭṭaitikhyātaṃ raivatādreḥ prapūrvagam | mīnamakaramatsyādiśobhitaṃ kamalairyutam ||61 || haṃsaiḥ kāraṇḍavaiścakravākaiścānalapakṣibhiḥ | śobhitaṃ paridṛṣṭvaiva yayāvānandamuttamam ||62|| jagāma tvarito bhūpo jalapānārthamutsukaḥ | tadā netraṃ karo vakṣaḥ prāsphurad dakṣiṇaṃ śubham ||63|| jale tu snānakartṝn sa divyāndevānvyalokayat | gatvā tatra nanāmāsau hayāduttīrya cāgragaḥ ||64||| pṛthakpṛthagvavande’sau devānmunisvarūpiṇaḥ | japataḥ śrīharerjāpānvratakarṣitavigrahān ||65|| baddhāṃjalirgadgado’bhūddaṇḍavatpracakāra ca | āśīrvādaiḥ plāvito’yaṃ nṛpaḥ papraccha tānsurān ||66|| ke bhavanto’tra gahane nirjale’raṇyake jale | snātuṃ samāgatāḥ santi yatra vāso na mānuṣaḥ ||67|| yāthātathyaṃ vadantvatra yena me’pi śubhaṃ bhavet | duḥkhino duḥkhanāśāya satāṃ vai darśanaṃ matam ||68|| iti pṛṣṭāśca te devāḥ prāhustaṃ bhāgyasanmukham | viśvedevā vayaṃ rājan devāḥ svarganivāsinaḥ ||69|| munisvarūpaiścāyātāḥ snānārthaṃ putradāvrate | adyaivaikādaśī cāsti putradānāmanāmataḥ ||1.241.70|| tatra snātuṃ vayaṃ yātā tīrthe’smin raivatācalāt | snātvā svargaṃ gamiṣyāmo vrataṃ cādyāsti vai mahat ||71|| kathaṃ bhavānsamāyāto nirjane gahane vane | śrutvā rājātisaṃhṛṣṭo kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ duḥkhito’pi san ||72|| svānukūlaṃ sukhaṃ matvā jalaṃ naiva papau tadā | vrataṃ naisargato jātaṃ matvā putraphalapradam ||73|| uvāca tānmunīn rājā hyaputro’haṃ sutecchayā | kṛtavānbahupuṇyāni sutaṃ tathāpi nālabham ||74|| tataḥ śokaparītāṃgastapase’tra samāgataḥ | kariṣye ca tapaścātra putrārthaṃ kṛpayātra vaḥ ||75|| munayaśca tadā prāhurbhūpate putradāvratāt | putraprāptikaraṃ puṇyaṃ jātaṃ te mā tapaḥ kuru ||76|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāḥ prātaḥ sampūjya keśavam | jalasya pāraṇāṃ kṛtvā patrapuṣpādinā tathā ||77|| yāhi gṛhaṃ ca te putro bhaviṣyati narādhipaḥ | ityevaṃ daivayogena vratasya karaṇāttathā ||78|| āśīrvādām̐śca devānāmupalabdhvā gṛhāgataḥ | rājñī garbhaṃ dadhau kāle putro jāto’tibhāgyavān ||79|| dīrghajīvī prajāpālo babhūva sa narādhipaḥ | nāmnā ca kuṃkumān yasya saurāṣṭraṃ kaṃkasaṃjñayā ||1.241.80|| rājyaṃ khyātamabhūttasya vaṃśopi vaiṣṇavo hyabhūt | tasmāllakṣmi prakartavyaṃ putradaikādaśīvratam ||8 1 || lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya mayaitat kathitaṃ tava | ye’tra janāḥ kariṣyanti putradāyā vrataṃ śubham ||82|| putrānprāpyeha loke te svargaṃ yāsyanti vai mṛtāḥ | dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ paśūn putrān dīrghamāyuṣyamityapi ||83|| patnīṃ śubhāṃ patiṃ saumyaṃ kṣetraṃ smṛddhiṃ mahattamām | prāpsyantyavaśyamevaitadvratasya karaṇājjanāḥ ||84|| asyāśca paṭhanāllakṣmi śravaṇātsmaraṇāttathā | putraprāptiphalaṃ tadvaccāgniṣṭomaphalaṃ bhavet ||85|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne pauṣaśuklaputraikādaśīvratamāhātmyaketumādrājarṣiputralābhanirūpaṇanāmaikacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāya ||241||
<1.242> śrīlakṣmīruvāca mahāviṣṇo hare vāsudeva lakṣmīpate prabho | anugrahaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā vada māghāsite dale || 1 || ekādaśī ca kiṃnāmnī kaścādhipatirīśvaraḥ | vidhiḥ phalaṃ ca dānāni vaiśeṣikaṃ ca yadbhavet || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu priye māghakṛṣṇaikādaśī ṣaṭtilābhidhā | nāmnāsti tatpatirvāsudevaḥ śrīpriyayā saha || 3 || pūjanīyaḥ sthalapadmairgulābjaiḥ komalaistathā | naivedye ghṛtapūrāśca prārghyaṃ drākṣāphalāni ca || 4 || ūrṇāvastrāṇi deyāni kambalādīni bhāvataḥ | methikāpākabhakṣyāṇi māṣalaḍḍukabhojanam || 5 || anyatpuṣṭikaraṃ dravyaṃ śītahārakakaṃcukam | evamādīni deyāni pūjādānādikarmasu || 6 || tiladeyaṃ samākhyātā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī | dālbhyaṃ prāha pulastyaḥ prāg vratamasyāḥ sukhapradam || 7 || manuṣyā yauvanopetā dāridryaduḥkhakarṣitāḥ | jīvikārthaṃ ca pāpāni kurvanti tvavaśāśca ye || 8 || brahmahatyābālahatyāstrīhatyāgovadhādikam | hiṃsanaṃ paradravyāpahāraṃ ca vyasanāni ca || 9 || svadāreṣvaprasakiṃ ca parasmṛddhivināśanam | prasahya duḥkhadāyitvaṃ gurūnindānṛtāni ca || 1.242.1 0|| duṣṭakarmaprajīvitvaṃ kanyāvikrayaṇaṃ tathā | rasāniṣṭavimiśratvaṃ viśvāsaghātavañcanam || 11 || evamādīni pāpāni nareṣu yāni rāgataḥ | bhavanti cātha jāyante teṣāṃ nāśakaraṃ vratam || 12|| tiladaikādaśīrūpaṃ sarvapāpapradāhakam | prabalaṃ māghamāse tadvrataṃ kṛṣṇe dale kṛtam || 13 || śodhayeccāntaraṃ jantoḥ pāpāni kṣālayettathā | naitādṛśaṃ vrataṃ cānyad drāgeva jantuśodhakam || 14|| māghasnāyī vratī māghe kṛṣṇe daśamīvāsare | ekabhukto bhavet paścād rātrau pṛthvyāṃ śayīta ca || 15|| brahmacārī bhaveccaivaikādaśyāṃ brāhmasaṃjñake | muhūrte ca samutthāya smarennārāyaṇaṃ hṛdi || 16|| gṛhṇīyācca varīṣṭhānāṃ satāṃ ca sātvatāṃ tathā | nāmāni ca harernāmabhajanaṃ kṣaṇamācaret || 17|| tālikāṃ vādayitvā ca mūrtiṃ smṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ | hare rāma ghanaśyāma svāmin nārāyaṇa prabho || 18|| tavāsmi nityadā bhakte mayi tiṣṭha pramokṣada | iti stutvā tato yāyācchaucārthaṃ bahireva ca || 1 9|| mṛdā jalena śuddhiṃ ca kṛtvā gaṇḍūṣakām̐ścaret | tilacūrṇaṃ tato dehe samyagudvartayed vratī ||1.242.20|| satilasalilenātha snāyānnāma harergṛṇan | tilahomaṃ prakuryācca tilavāri pibettathā ||21 || tiladānaṃ prakuryācca tilabhojanamācaret | tilasnāyī tilodvartī tilahomī tilodakī ||22|| tiladātā tilabhoktā ṣaṭatilā pāpanāśinī | tilaprarohājjāyante yāvacchākhāstilāni ca ||23|| tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate | kṛṣṇatilā matāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ snāne dāne prapūjane ||24|| snātvā vratī tiladāyāḥ prātareva prapūjayet | vāsudevaṃ śriyā yuktaṃ navaiḥ ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ||25||| puṣpāṃjalipradāne ca prārthayecchaṭtilāvratam | kariṣye nātha nirvighnaṃ me tadastu phalapradam ||26|| tava kṛpākaṇenāpi vratasampūrṇatā bhavet | kāmakrodhādyahaṃlobhapaiśunyādi na me’stu vai ||27|| ityabhyarthya guruṃ natvā smṛtvā śrīharimeva ca | prātaśca sarvatobhadramaṇḍalaṃ kārayed vratī |||28|| tanmadhye svarṇajaṃ yadvā tāmrajaṃ ghaṭamuttamam | pañcapallavasadratnajalādyaiḥ saṃprapūritam ||29|| sthāpayettaṃ ca vastreṇa sūtreṇāpi ca veṣṭayet | pūjayettaṃ tatastasyopari kṛṣṇatilabhṛtam ||1.242.30 || sthālīpātraṃ sthāpayecca tatra mūrtiṃ suvarṇajām | vinyasyed vāsudevasya śrīpriyāṣaṭtilāyutām ||3 1|| pañcāmṛtajalaistāṃ ca snāpayedabhiṣecanaiḥ | vastrādi ca vibhūṣādi tvalaṃkārām̐śca dhārayet ||32|| gulālakuṃkumābīracandanākṣatahārakaiḥ | dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalatāmbūlasatphalaiḥ ||33|| kūṣmāṇḍairnārikelaiścāmṛtaiśca bījapūrakaiḥ | pradakṣiṇādaṇḍavatsunamaskārastavādibhiḥ ||34|| pūjayecchrīvāsudevaṃ kṣamāpayetpunaḥ punaḥ | naivedyaṃ bhojayetpāne salilaṃ miṣṭamarpayet ||35|| tāmbūlaṃ karpūragandhailātvaṅlavaṃgayuk dadet|| paryaṃkaṃ sopakaraṇaṃ darpaṇaṃ vyajanaṃ tathā ||36|| cāmaraṃ puṣpagucchāṃśca bhaktitaḥ prasamarpayet | nīrājayennavavāraṃ tato natvā ca keśavam ||37|| svavyāvahārikaṃ kuryād vrate vighnaṃ yathā na vai | madhyāhne haraye dadyān miṣṭaṃ śubhaṃ subhojanam ||38|| jalaṃ dadyāt phalaṃ dadyānmukhaśuddhikalīṭikām | sugandhasāraṃ gandhāḍhyasthalapadmārkavāri ca ||39|| sāyaṃ cāpi hareḥ samyak pūjanaṃ tvācared vratī | ārārtrikādikaṃ sarve bhojanaṃ cāpi kārayet|||1.242.40 || pūrvaṃ daśadinebhyaśca vratī snāto janaḥ svayam | bhūmyapatitaṃ saṃgṛhya gomayaṃ tatra sa vratī ||41|| tilānprakṣipya kārpāsaṃ piṇḍikāścaiva kārayet | aṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyāḥ yataḥ śuṣkā bhavanti te ||42|| atha māghe kṛṣṇapakṣasyaikādaśyāṃ ca mūlabhe | ārdrāyāṃ vā niśi homaṃ harernāmatrirācaret ||43|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād viṣṇupadyāni gāpayet | dvādaśyāṃ prātarutthāya snātvā pūjanamācaret ||44|| vastubhiḥ ṣoḍaśavidhairdānaṃ śrīgurave’rpayet | kuṃbhaṃ svarṇamayīṃ mūrtiṃ mudrāḥ svarṇāśca rājatīḥ |||45||| tilapātraṃ ca śayyāṃ ca vastrāṇi dhānyasadrasān | chatropānahapātrāṇi dadyānme prīyatāṃ hariḥ ||46|| kṛṣṇā dhenuḥ pradātavyā tilapātraṃ prapūritam | gurave’rpaṇamatroktaṃ viprāya vā kuṭumbine ||47|| svargādau tvannapānādi labhyate tiladānataḥ | mokṣe’pi śāśvatī tṛptirjāyate muktibhāginaḥ ||48|| kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ na kṛtaṃ cedannadānaṃ tilārpaṇam | tadāmutra milet sarvamannaṃ naiva milettataḥ ||49|| tilānnādi pradātavyaṃ sarvaṃ dātavyameva ca | yadyat tvapekṣyate cātra strīputragṛhavāṭikāḥ ||1.242.50 || udyānāni gomahiṣyo gajāśvājādayastathā | vāhanāni vimānāni gṛhopakaraṇāni ca ||51 || daihāni sādhanānyatra dharmārthakāmanādayaḥ | svarṇabhūṣāśca bhojyāni peyāni vividhāni ca ||52|| dṛśyānyathāpi bhogyāni śravyāṇi raṃjanāni ca | deyānyekādaśīlābhe dānāni vividhāni ca ||53|| tāni lakṣaguṇānyeva prāpsyante’mutra puṇyataḥ | tasmādekādaśīkarttā dātavyāni viśeṣataḥ ||54|| śṛṇvatrārthe kathāṃ prācyāṃ brāhmaṇyā romaharṣaṇām | purā kṛtayuge nāmnā kapilā brāhmaṇī satī ||55|| vidyāvatī kumārī sā brahmacaryaparāyaṇā | ātmajñānavatī devapūjāprītimatī sadā ||56|| svargādiphalavāñcchāḍhyā vartate smāparigrahā | śarīraṃ kleśitaṃ caiva tayopoṣaṇasadvrataiḥ ||57|| yadyadupārjyate vidyājñānādyaiśca gṛhādikam | tattatsamarpyate dāne satpātre samaye śubhe ||58| devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kumārīṇāṃ satāṃ tathā | sādhvīnāṃ brahmaniṣṭhānāṃ pradadānā gṛhāṇi sā ||59| anyānyupakaraṇāni pradadānā mahāsatī | vartate sarvadā devapūjau sukhakāmyayā ||1.242.60 | atitṛṣṇāmahāmohavyāptā nārīsvabhāvataḥ | ātmajñānaṃ ca kurute sukhecchāṃ na jahāti sā ||61| annaṃ tu sulabhaṃ jñātvā dadātyannaṃ na bhikṣuke | sādhavastarpitā naiva bālakā na ca bhojitāḥ ||62| anyatsarvaṃ pradattaṃ vai na dattaṃ tvannamaṇvapi | na dattā bhikṣuke bhikṣā kevalājñānaleśataḥ ||63 | ekadā mama bhaktāyāstasyā me’bhūt sucintanam | śuddhamatyāḥ śarīraṃ hi vrataiḥ kṛcchrairna saṃśayaḥ ||64| pūjitaśca harirdevo bahubhirvastubhirmuhuḥ | arcito vaiṣṇavo lokaḥ kāyakleśena tattvataḥ ||65| sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ sakāmaṃ sakāmanayānayā śubham | svargaṃ tasyāḥ kṛte tvasti parantvatrānayā kvacit ||66|| na kṛtaṃ tvannadānaṃ hi nirmūlyaṃ vigaṇayya ca | tato’syāḥ svargalokeṣu bhavennānnamupasthitam ||67|| annadānena bhojyaṃ cāmṛtaṃ svarge hyavāpyate | dattaṃ vai prāpyate tatra yena tṛptiḥ parā bhavet ||68|| tasmānmayā svabhaktāyāḥ saukhyārthaṃ tatra sarvathā | bhikṣukasya svarūpeṇa yācanīyaṃ hi bhojanam ||69|| annaṃ dāsyati mahyaṃ sā svarge tatphalamāpsyate | evaṃ lakṣmi vicintyāhaṃ martyalokamupāgataḥ ||1.242.70|| kapilasvāmirūpeṇa bhikṣārthaṃ tadgṛhaṃ gataḥ | bhavatī bhikṣāṃ dehīti bhikṣāṃ yācitavānaham ||71 || sā manmūrteśca madhyāhne pūjāyāṃ vyāpṛtābhavat | vighnaṃ jñātvātha pūjāyāṃ bhikṣāphalaśatojjhitā ||72|| roṣavegācca tatkāle nāvocat kiṃcideva hi | punareva mayā proktā dehi bhikṣāṃ tu sundari ||73|| pūjāprasattayā tatra tulasīmṛttikā tathā | gṛhītā jalasiktā ca piṇḍarūpā svabhāvataḥ ||74|| tataḥ kopena mahatā mṛtpiṇḍastāmrabhājane | mama pātre tayā kṣipto na dattaṃ tvannamaṇvapi ||75|| mayānnaṃ bhikṣitaṃ nāmnā nārpitaṃ tu tathāpi me | gālīdānādinā cāhaṃ tayā niṣkāsito bahiḥ ||76|| gato’haṃ svasya vaikuṇṭhaṃ mṛtā kālena tāpasī | brahmacaryaprabhāveṇa gṛhadānādinā tu sā ||77|| devī bhūtvā gatā svargaṃ devībhiḥ satkṛtā divi | mṛtpiṇḍikāpradānasya phalaṃ prāptaṃ gṛhaṃ śubham ||78|| sarvasmṛddhibharaṃ kintu dhānyarāśivivarjitam | gṛhaṃ divyaṃ paśyati sma bhojyaṃ kiñcinna dṛśyate ||79|| gṛhāttasmādviniṣkrāntā cāgatā mama mandiram | jalopari dvitīyaṃ yadvaikuṇṭhaṃ me’sti tatra vai ||1.242.80 || brahmacaryaprabhāvā sā kapilā sūryasadṛśī | krodhāviṣṭā hyavocanmāṃ bhojyaṃ kinna gṛhe mama ||8 1|| annahīno mahāsaudho labdho divyastriviṣṭape | yatra nāstyamṛtaṃ kiñcit khādyaṃ peyaṃ na vidyate ||82|| bhogasthale mahāsvarge jīvitavyaṃ mayā katham | tasmād dehi mahāviṣṇo bhaktāyai bhojanaṃ prabho ||83|| anyathā na mayā stheyaṃ śmaśānasadṛśe gṛhe | mayoktaṃ ca tadā tasyai nānnaṃ dattaṃ tvayā kvacit ||84|| brāhmaṇebhyo’thavā sadbhyaḥ sādhvībhyo vā na cārpitam | mayā bhikṣārthitā tvatto mṛtpiṇḍastvarpitastvayā ||85|| smaryate vā navā sādhvi tatphalaṃ nānnamāpyate | karmabhūmau kṛtaṃ dattaṃ phalaṃ svarge tvavāpyate ||86|| tvayānnaṃ na pradattaṃ vai prapadyeta kuto divi | tathāpi bhaktā tvaṃ hyanugrāhyā sadā mayā ||87|| mṛttikādānato bhikṣā phalaṃ te mṛttikāpi vai | annarūpeṇa bhavatu sadā bhuṃkṣyāmṛta phalam ||88|| tvayā vrataiśca kṛcchraiśca sūpavāsairanekaśaḥ | pūjābhirarcitaścāhaṃ tatphalaṃ te gṛhe’mṛtam ||89|| bhavatānmā gṛhaṃ śūnyaṃ sadā me bhavatu priyā | gaccha svargaṃ nūtanāṃ tvāṃ draṣṭuṃ kautuhalānvitāḥ ||1.242.90 || āgamiṣyanti devyaśca ṣaṭtilāvratakārikāḥ | dvāraṃ nodghāṭanīyaṃ ca tvayā stheyamadarśane ||9 1 || yadi tāsāmāgrahaścet tava darśanakāraṇe | vācyaṃ tābhyastadā devyo yadi darśanamiṣyate ||92|| dadata ṣaṭtilāpuṇyaṃ bhavatībhistu prākkṛtam | udghāṭayāmi dvāraṃ ca māṃ paśyantu haripriyām ||93|| tābhirdattaṃ tadā puṇyaṃ ṣaṭtilaikādaśībhavam | udghāṭitaṃ tato dvāraṃ dṛṣṭā tābhirharipriyā ||94|| na devī na ca gāndharvī nāsurī na ca pannagī | nānyāpi tādṛśī divyā svarge’bhūt kapilā yathā ||95|| hareryogānmahālakṣmi tvatsamā sābhavad divi | rūpakāntisamāyuktā vaiṣṇavī mama vallabhā ||96 || ṣaṭtilāphalalābhena saudho’nnāmṛtasaṃbhṛtaḥ | samabhavattadā drākca nānyatrāto’dhikaṃ hyabhūt ||97|| bhavanaṃ bahusampannaṃ ṣaṭtilāpuṇyalābhataḥ | dhanadhānyasuvastrādisvarṇarūpyādisaṃbhṛtam ||98|| bhuktaṃ ca kalpaparyantaṃ tataḥ kapilayā tayā | nitye laye samāyātā kapilā mama mandiram ||99|| caturbhujābhavattatra ramārūpā mama priyā | bhajate māṃ sakhī te sā sevanānme’tibhāvataḥ || 1.242.10 0|| tato yaistu kṛtaṃ sākṣāt ṣaṭtilāvratamuttamam | kiṃ kiṃ tena na cāpyeta sarvaṃ prāpyeta sarvathā || 101 || labhed bhuktiṃ ca muktiṃ ca madyogāttiladāvratī | vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ lobhaḥ kāryo na tu kvacit || 1 02||| dānaṃ sarvavidhaṃ deyaṃ dattaṃ prāpyeta bhāvini | ātmavittānusāreṇa tilān dhānyāni dāpayet || 1 03|| vastrānnavāhanayānagṛhavāryupasādhanam | nairogyaṃ labhate’mutra dadate yo’tra janmani || 1 04|| na dāridryaṃ na ca kaṣṭaṃ na daurbhāgyaṃ na śūnyatām | na bhinnatvaṃ vrajed bhaktaḥ ṣaṭtilāyā upoṣaṇāt || 1 05|| tasmād vrataṃ prakartavyaṃ tiladānaṃ vidhānataḥ | pātakairmucyate bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca labhate’tigām || 1 06|| ya idaṃ śṛṇuyād yadvā śrāvayecca paṭhecca vā | tasya puṇyaṃ ṣaṭtilāyā vratajaṃ bhavati priye || 1 07|| nāśubhaṃ śiṣyate kiṃcitparatrātra virodhakṛt | ātmapuṇyaṃ vrajedvipro vijayaṃ kṣatriyo vrajet || 108|| dhanasmṛddhiṃ vrajed vaiśyaḥ sukhaṃ cānyo lasetparam | dharmaṃ prāpnoti dharmārthī kāmārthī pramadāṃ labhet || 1 09|| dhanārthī dhanamāpnoti putrārthī satsutaṃ laset | yaśovipulamāpnoti jñātimūrdhanyamityapi || 1.242.11 0|| acaṃcalā śriyaṃ labdhvā śreyaḥ paramavāpnuyāt | bhayanāśo bhavatyasya tejovīryaṃ ca vindati || 11 1|| ṣaṭtilāvratasampannā nārī priyapatiṃ laset | putrapautradhanadhānyākhaṇḍasaubhāgyamāpnuyāt || 1 12|| labdhvā kāmasukhaṃ cātra divi devī pramodate | vaiṣṇavī ca ramā bhūtvā hareḥ śayyāsu modate || 1 13|| vaikuṇṭhe cātha goloke yauvanārthasukhāni 3 | aśnute svapatikṛṣṇahariṇā saha sarvadā || 1 14|| ṣaṭtilāyāḥ samaṃ cānyad vrataṃ nāsti sukhapradam | padmayā ca kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ sā tvaṃ lakṣmīrmamāsi vai || 1 15|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne māghakṛṣṇaṣaṭtilaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ vratapuṇyāt kapilānāryā devītvaṃ ramātvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvicatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 242 ||
<1.243> śrīlakṣmīruvāca hare kṛṣṇa kṛpāsindho jagaduddhārakāraka | māghaśuklaikādaśīṃ me kathayasva prasādataḥ || 1 || ko vidhiḥ ko’dhidevo’tra vratasya phalamityapi | kathayasvodyāpanaṃ ca vratino bhuktimuktidam || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi māghaśukle jayānāmetipuṇyadā | pāpahantrī mokṣakartrī kāmadātrī sukhapradā || 3 || ekādaśī samākhyātā kartavyā vratinā śubhā | brahmahatyādihantrī ca piśācatvādināśinī || 4 || sarvasampatkarī rājñāṃ saṃgrāme jayadāyinī | svarge jayapradā loke vyavahāre jayapradā || 5 || yatra kutrāpi kārye sā kṛtā jayaphalā matā | tatphalaṃ jayadaṃ proktaṃ triṣu lokeṣu yāyinām || 6 || etasmātkāraṇāllakṣmi kartavyā sā prayatnataḥ | daśamyāmekabhuktena naktamātreṇa vā svayam || 7 || dehayātrāṃ nirvaham̐śca rātrau bhūśayanaṃ caret | prātarutthāya ca brāhme muhūrtte śrīhariṃ smaret || 8 || śaucasnānādikaṃ kṛtvā sandhyāvandanamācaret | gāyatrīṃ ca japitvātha hareḥ pūjāṃ samācaret || 9 || nityayā saha saṃpūjyo mādhavastatpatiḥ prabhuḥ | pañcāmṛtena vai pūrvaṃ snāpayedabhiṣecanaiḥ || 1.243.1 0|| śuddhatīrthajalaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ snāpayellepayed dravam | sugandhasārottamatailacandanādi vilepayet || 11 || punaśca snāpayettīrthajalairvastrāṇi dhārayet | mukuṭaṃ kuṇḍale hārān kaṭakāṃgadasūrmikāḥ || 12|| śṛṅkhalāraśanāratnahīrakādikṛtāni ca | vibhūṣaṇāni sarvāṇi tathā divyāni dhārayet || 13|| gulālākṣatakuṃkumābīraiḥ saṃpūjayet prabhum | dhūpadīpaistathā puṣpairbakulasya prapūjayet || 14|| tatkālaprodbhavaiścānyaiḥ kamalai sthalapadmakaiḥ | śṛṅgārahāraiḥ satpatraistulasīmaṃjarīyutaiḥ || 19|| pūjayecchrīhariṃ cātha candanairgandhivastubhiḥ | miṣṭānnāni tu naivedye bījapūraphalāni ca || 16|| maṇḍakā laḍḍukā mudgabhavā meśubhamauktikāḥ | dātavyā haraye dugdhapākaḥ sugandhamiśritāḥ || 17|| dāḍimaṃ navaraṃgaṃ ca nārikelaphalaṃ tathā | dātavyāni tathā drākṣāphalāni kadalāni ca || 18|| ārārtrikaṃ tathā kāryaṃ pradakṣiṇādikaṃ tataḥ | puṣpāṃjaliṃ kṣamāṃ prārthya tato vai vratamarthayet || 19|| adyāhaṃ vai jayānāmnyā ekādaśyā vrataṃ śubham | karomi kṛṣṇa te’tīva prasannatvaprasaktaye ||1.243.20|| tad vrataṃ me prasaṃpūrṇaṃ bhavatvatra kṛpāṃ kuru | iti prārthya tato natvā devadevaṃ ca mādhavam ||21|| śobhitaṃ saptadhānyaiḥ san maṇḍalaṃ kārayed vratī | madhye svarṇaghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpayet tāmraghaṭaṃ ca vā ||22|| pañcapallavaratnādijalavastrādiśobhite | tilapātraṃ ghaṭe tatra sthāpayet phalasaṃyutam ||23|| ghaṭaṃ prapūjayettatra tīrthānyāvāhayettathā | svarṇamūrtiṃ mādhavasya jayayā saha nirmitām ||24|| nityayā ca tathā patnyā sahitāṃ sthāpayettathā | pūjayeccāvāhanādikrameṇa snāpayettathā ||25|| vibhūṣayettathā puṣpabhojanādi samarpayet | ṣoḍaśopasuvastvādyairarcayedbahubhāvataḥ ||26|| jalapānaṃ samarpyātha nīrājayecca mādhavam | tāmbūlaṃ cārpayettatrāparādhām̐śca kṣamāpayet ||27|| vratārthaṃ prārthayet pūrṇaṃ vrataṃ me ca bhavediti | gośca prapūjanaṃ kuryād godānaṃ cāpi kārayet ||28|| bhūdānaṃ vastradānaṃ ca svarṇadānaṃ ca kārayet | paścātpūjāṃ samāpyaivaṃ kuryātkāryaṃ svakaṃ dine || 29|| madhyāhne’pi tathā bhakṣyabhojyalehyasucośyakam | annaṃ caturvidhaṃ dadyāddevāya mādhavāya vai || 1.243.3 0|| sāyaṃ niśi tathā kṛṣṇapūjārthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ śubham | kārayettu mahāntaṃ ca tatrolleccaṃ prabandhayet ||3 1 || pūjanaṃ śrīhareḥ kṛtvā nīrājayedvidhānataḥ | naivedyaṃ ca kṣamādānaṃ kṛtvā tato hareḥ puraḥ ||32|| maṇḍape rāsarītyā śrīhareḥ padyāni gāpayet | kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ rātrau raṃjayetkṛṣṇamatyati ||33|| bhaktairnṛtyaṃ kīrtanaṃ ca savāditraṃ ca jāgaram | kartavyaṃ ca tataḥ prātaḥ snātvārcyo mādhavaḥ prabhuḥ ||34|| dānāni vividhānyeva deyāni ca yathābalam | sādhūn sādhvīrbrāhmaṇām̐śca bhojayecca niveditam ||35|| tataḥ svayaṃ pāraṇāṃ ca kuryādevaṃ vrataṃ kṛte | phalaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhavatyeva vijayaḥ sarvathā bhavet|||36|| śṛṇu tvatra vrate pūrvāṃ kathāṃ lakṣmi vadāmi te | svarge loke mahendre vai śāsati devatāgaṇāḥ || 37|| vasanti sukhinaḥ sarve pīyūṣapānapoṣitāḥ | apsarobhiśca devībhiḥ parībhiśca samarcitāḥ ||38|| pūjitāḥ sukhitā devā ramante nandane vane | ramayanti ca devīśca nṛtyanti kīrtayanti ca ||39|| nandanākhye vane divye svargaṃgā yā jalāntike | udyāne puṣpaśobhāḍhye sugandhyanilasevite ||1.243.40|| pravṛttaṃ nartanaṃ cāpsarasāmindrasya tuṣṭaye | gandharvāstatra gāyanti nṛtyantyapsarasastadā ||41 || vādayanti ca gandharvāstālasyāpūrikāḥ striyaḥ | evaṃ tu gāyane nṛtye pravṛtte’tipraharṣataḥ ||42|| darśako’pi mahendraḥ svecchayā raṅge hyupasthitaḥ | nanartendraḥ saharṣaḥ svapañcāśatkoṭināyakaḥ ||43|| gandharvāḥ sahagāyanti puṣpadantaśca susvaraḥ | citrasenastathā tasya patnī puṣpavatī tathā ||44|| puṣpadantasya putraśca mālyavānnāmatastathā | puṣpavatyāḥ svarūpe ca mālyavānmohitastadā ||45|| puṣpavatyā kaṭākṣaiśca mālyavān svavaśe kṛtaḥ | puṣpavatī mālyavām̐śca nṛtyārthamindratuṣṭaye ||46|| samāgatau ca kāmena parītāṃgau babhūvatuḥ | cittabhramasamāyuktau kāmabāṇavaśaṃgatau ||47|| gāyataḥ śuddhagānaṃ na baddhadṛṣṭī ca rāgataḥ | nṛtyatīndrastu vai samyaṅ nṛtyānusāri gāyanam ||48|| tayoḥ kṣatiṃ samagacchattālamānavilopanam | cintayitvā tu maghavā saṃgataṃ mānasaṃ tayoḥ ||49|| samakālīnavaigaṇyaṃ tāle māne ca gāyane | kramalopaṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā matvāvajñāṃ tathātmanaḥ ||1.243.50|| kupitaśca tayostatra śaśāpa ca vadannidam | dhiṅyuvā patitau mūḍhau manmahattāprabhaṃjakau ||5 1|| svarge viṣayabāhulye bhujyamāne’pi sarvadā | tṛptirnāsti na me śreṣṭhyamaryādārakṣaṇe matiḥ ||52|| nṛtyakāle mama dākṣye protsāhe’pi yuvāṃ yataḥ | vigaṇayya sabhāmadhye nṛtyaṃ vai mohitau kimu ||53 || tasmāt piśācau bhavataṃ dampatīrupadhāriṇau | na gandharvasthitiyogyau gauravabhaṃgakārakau ||54|| martyalokamanuprāptau bhuṃjānau karmaṇaḥ phalam | duḥkhaṃ cānubhavantau vai tiṣṭhataṃ tu ciraṃ samāḥ ||55|| evaṃ mahendraśāpāttau himādrau tvatidāruṇe | piśācatāṃ gatau duḥkhaistaptau śāntiṃ na ceyatuḥ ||56|| gandharvatvaṃ cāpsaratvaṃ vismṛtau ceraturvane | tuṣāreṇātivegena pīḍyamāno muhurmuhuḥ ||57|| dantagharṣaṃ prakurvāṇau vadataśca parasparam | piśācaḥ samuvāca svāṃ priyāṃ patnīṃ piśācikām ||58|| aho cālpāparādhasya phalaṃ duḥkhatamaṃ mahat | narakaṃ dāruṇaṃ cedaṃ piśācarūpakaṃ khalu ||59|| kadā syādantavaccaitat kadā śāntirmiliṣyati | śaityaṃ cātitamaṃ tvatra pīḍā tenātijāyate ||1.243.60|| iti cintāparau tau ca kṣudhāduḥkhātikarṣitau | pippalākhyadevataroḥ stambe vāsaṃ pracakratuḥ ||61 || himapātena daśamīrātrau caikādaśīdine | caikādaśyāstathā rātrau himajhaṃjhānilena tau ||62|| vepamānau bhojanārthaṃ nirgatau na svavāsataḥ | daivayogātsa divaso māghasyaikādaśī jayā ||63|| upoṣitā niśā tābhyāṃ sujāgarayutā kṛtā | tatrāstāṃ tāvubhau bhojyajalapānādivarjitau ||64|| kaṣṭena himavātena sarvāhāravivarjitau | na kṛto jīvaghātaśca na prāptaṃ phalabhakṣaṇam ||65|| na pānaṃ salilasyāpi jātaṃ nendriyaraṃjanam | na ca nidrāpi saṃjātā na tau saukhyamavindatām ||66|| tayorduḥkhitayoritthaṃ nirjagāma niśīthinī | prātaḥ sūryodaye prāpte dvādaśyāṃ ca mayā tayoḥ ||67|| pippalavṛkṣarūpeṇa kṛtā bhaktidhṛtā hṛdi | aśvattho’haṃ hi vṛkṣāṇāṃ bhavāmi mūrtimān yataḥ ||68|| tayorāśrayadātāhaṃ vrataṃ jayātithestayoḥ | gaṇayan jāgarāḍhyaṃ ca phalaṃ vratasya vai dadau ||69|| tena phalaprabhāveṇa piśācatvaṃ gataṃ tayoḥ | divyarūpau tu gandharvau pūrvarūpau babhūvatuḥ ||1.243.70 || purātanasnehayutau pūrvālaṃkāraśobhitau | puṣpāvatīmālyavantau vimānavaramāsthitau ||71 || gatau svargaṃ ca devendraṃ praṇāmaṃ cakraturmudā | tau devau devagandharvau vīkṣyendro vismito’bravīt ||72 || vadataṃ kena puṇyena vinaṣṭā vāṃ piśācatā | mama śāpāttu muninā kena vai mocitau yuvām || 73 || prā śca tadā tau taṃ daivayogena devarāṭ | vāsudevaprasādena jayāyāstu vratena ca ||74|| piśācatvaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ nau tava bhaktiprabhāvataḥ | śrutveti maghavā hṛṣṭaḥ punastāvāha cādarāt |||75 || yuvāṃ hareḥ kṛpāpātravaryau jātau vratāhataḥ | tasmātpūjyau mama jātau vratapuṇyaprabhāvataḥ ||76|| sadā sudhāṃ tu pibata vacanānme’tiharṣataḥ | ramethāṃ ca sadā svarge yathāsaukhyaṃ yuvāṃ priyau ||77|| harivrataprakartāro harerbhaktiparāyaṇāḥ | martyā amartyā ye kecittvasmatpūjyāḥ sadaiva te ||78|| evaṃ lakṣmi ca tau gandharvīgandharvau piśācakau | punarjātau svarnivāsau jayāyā vratavaibhavāt ||79|| etasmātkāraṇāllakṣmi kartavyaṃ ca jayāvratam | jayā pāpaharā puṇyapradā svargapradā tathā ||1.243.80 || brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ nāśinī mokṣadāyinī | sarvadānāni dattāni kṛtaṃ yena jayāvratam ||8 1 || sarve’pi kratavastena kṛtāḥ kṛte jayāvrate | kṛtāḥ paropakārāśca kṛte śreṣṭhe jayāvrate ||82|| dhanadhānyasutapatnīgṛhagovājisatpatim | labhate māghaśuklaikādaśījayāvratena vai ||83 || nātra paratra kiñcidvai durlabhaṃ vratino bhavet | sulabhaṃ syāddhareryogād durlabhaṃ naiva vidyate ||84|| kartavyaṃ sarvathā tasmādvrataṃ jayāsuvāsare | kalpakoṭiṃ vaset kartā vaikuṇṭhe modate dhruvam ||85 || vratasyāsya kathāyāśca śravaṇātpaṭhanādapi | agniṣṭomaphalaṃ syādvai bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca vindati ||86 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne māghaśuklajayaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ mālyavatīmālyavannāmagandharvayoḥ piśācatvaprāptayoḥ vratena muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā tricatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 243 ||
<1.244> śrīlakṣmīruvāca bhaktavallabha bhakteśa ramāvallabha matpate | mama sarvasva gopāla lakṣmīpāla dayānidhe || 1 || dharmapāla sadācārapravartaka surārcita | phālgunasya kṛṣṇapakṣe kābhidhā kathayasva sā || 2 || ekādaśyāstathā devaḥ kaḥ pūjyaḥ kīdṛśaṃ vratam | kiṃ deyaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa tatsarvaṃ vada me hare || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca phālgunasyāsite pakṣe vijayā nāma nāmataḥ | ekādaśī matā sarvapāpakṣayakarī priye || 4 || pradyumno vratibhistatra pūjanīyo dhiyā saha | pūjāyāṃ tulasī deyā phalaṃ jambīramarhaṇe || 5 || naivedye tu pradeyaṃ ca sohālikādi bhojanam | dāne tūpānahau mukhyau yathāśraddhaṃ dhanādikam || 6 || ādarāccotsavaḥ kāryo viṣṇubhaktasamarhaṇam | bhaktaiḥ śraddhāsamāyuktaistathā śrīśaparāyaṇaiḥ || 7 || kartavyaṃ ca prayatnenopoṣaṇaṃ vijayapradam | yathā śuklā tathā kṛṣṇā hyupoṣyā dhyeyasiddhaye || 8 || asakṛjjaladugdhādipānānmithunasevanāt | krodhanādaśrupātācca klośādikaraṇāttathā || 9 || cauryādidoṣaleśācca nopavāsaphalaṃ bhavet | dānaṃ cātmavicāraśca dhyāna homo japo’rhaṇam || 1.244.1 0|| kartavyāni prayatnena vratinā phalakāṃkṣiṇā | tajjapastatkathā śravyā hyekādaśyāṃ jayo bhavet||| 11 || upavāsavirodhī cedannadarśanasaṃspṛśaḥ | tyājyaḥ sa sarvathā sparśo hyupavāsadine priye || 12|| upavāsāsamarthastu kuryāt phalakṛtaṃ vratam | mūlaṃ phalaṃ payastoyamupabhogyaṃ bhavecchubhe || 1 3|| aśaktasya tathā naktaṃ haviṣyānnamanodanam | phalatilāśanaṃ cājyakṣīrāmbupānamityapi || 14|| gandhatāmbūlabhogām̐śca varjayed vratasiddhaye | jāgaraṃ viṣṇupūjāṃ ca vinā tvardhaphalaṃ vratam || 15|| jāgaraṃ pūjanaṃ pūrṇaphaladaṃ vratino bhavet | śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi vṛttāntaṃ vijayapradam || 16|| satyayugottare kāle jamadagnirmahāmuniḥ | kauśikyāḥ sarito’raṇye hyavasaddhārmiko hi saḥ || 17|| snānasandhyādisatkarmaparaścāntaḥśuciḥ sadā | dayādākṣiṇyamaunādikṣāntyādiguṇaśobhitaḥ || 18|| yajñayāgādinipuṇo devasevāparāyaṇaḥ | yatkuṭyāṃ mūrtimānagnirjamatyarpitabhojanam || 1 9|| jamadagniḥ sa vai khyāto narmadātaṭamāvasan | vrataṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ kurvannārādhayati mādhavam || 1.244.20 || reṇukā tasya patnyāsīt sāpi dharmapativratā | patidharmaparā sādhvī patiṃ saṃsevate’nvaham ||21 || yadṛcchālābhasantuṣṭau gate kālepi śāntigau | brahma cārādhayatastau nāpatyaṃ prāpaturhi tau || 22|| ekadā reṇukā snātvā hareḥ pūjanapūrvikām | patyuḥ pūjāṃ karoti sma tadā cintāṃ jagāma sā ||23|| patiḥ putrasvarūpeṇa jāyate iti vai śrutiḥ | patirme darśanīyo’sti tathā putro’pi me bhavet || 24|| patirme navasṛṣṭeśca sarjane poṣaṇe’pi ca | sṛṣṭeḥ saṃharaṇe cāpi samartho’sti tridevavat ||25|| devā yenākāritāścāyānti yasya makhe’nvaham | pūrayantīcchayā sarvaṃ tathā putro’pi me bhavet ||26|| kalpadrumāḥ kāmagāvo vasanti yasya mānase | satpatirdevatulyo me bhavetputraḥ samīśitā ||27|| svargatulyāni saudhāni vaikuṇṭhasya samṛddhayaḥ | golokasya rasā yasya saṃkalpe nivasanti hi || 28|| brahmatulyā pratiṣṭhā ca śaṃbhutulyā virāgatā | śeṣasamāḥ siddhayaśca yatsaṃkalpe vasanti ca ||29|| muktiḥ karatale yasya lakṣmīścāśīrvaco’mṛte | bhogāśca satyakāmādyā vasanti yasya sannidhau || 1.244.30|| vedā vidyāḥ kalā dākṣyaṃ yanmūrtau pravasanti ca | brahmacaryādayaḥ sarve dharmāḥ santi ca yaddhṛdi ||3 1|| tasyarṣerjamadagneśca sutastatsadṛśo bhavet | devā āśīḥpradānānme prayuñjantu sutāptaye ||32|| iti cintayamānaiva pūjayitvā svakaṃ patim | dakṣapādāṃguṣṭhavāri hyapibad viṣṇumānasā || 33 || tāvattatrābhavadvāṇī vyomagātimanoharā | prasanno’smi ca te devi sadā te patisevayā || 34|| viṣṇurasti svāmirūpe sevāṃ gṛhṇan vasan sadā | dadāmi te vaco devi reṇuke tava garbhajaḥ || 35||| bhavāmi tava putro’haṃ prabhuste patisadṛśaḥ | nānyo’sti te patiprakhyaḥ patirūpo’smyahaṃ striyāḥ || 36 || tasmātpatyau kalpavṛkṣatulye kāmān dadāmi vai | pativratābhyaḥ samyagvai vratasthābhyaḥ sutām̐stathā ||37|| śṛṇu mātarvrataṃ tatra kartavyaṃ ca tvayā yataḥ | phaladaṃ putradaṃ loke khyātikṛnmokṣasādhanam ||38|| ekādaśyā vijayāyā vrataṃ saṃkalpapūrakam | putraprāptau vijayaste bhaviṣyati yuge yuge ||39|| ityuktvā virarāmeyaṃ vāṇī ca reṇukāpi vai | vrataṃ cakāra phālgunakṛṣṇaikādaśikātitheḥ ||1.244.40 || dānāni ca dadau viṣṇutuṣṭaye vividhāni hi | prāpa putraṃ harestasya prasādācca vratāttathā ||41|| paraśurāmasaṃjño’sau viṣṇoraṃśo mahāprabhuḥ | janmottaraṃ caturbāhuṃ rūpaṃ svaṃ dhṛtavān hariḥ |||42|| mātre svadarśanaṃ divyaṃ dadau śrīkamalāpatiḥ | evaṃ kṛtvā vijayāṃ sā reṇukā sutavatyabhūt ||43|| śṛṇu priye tataścāyaṃ bālo viṣṇurdvijo’rbhakaḥ | jamadagnisutaścāyaṃ munidharmaparo’bhavat ||44|| vipradharmānpālayam̐śca mānayan ṛṣidevatāḥ | pūjayan śrīpatiṃ nityaṃ yajñopavītamāptavān ||45|| pitrā tu śikṣito vedānadhyagacchatsahāṃgakaiḥ | vidyayā tejasā cānyo divākara ivābhavat ||46|| bālyādevābhavaccāpi pitranyūnaparākramaḥ | trilokamārgāvyāhatagatikaḥ kamalāpatiḥ ||47|| viprakumāro brahmiṣṭho brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ | yasya saṃdarśanānmuktiṃ yānti vai mānavā bhuvi ||48|| yasya saṃsevanād devā devatvaṃ svargasampadaḥ | avāpuścānyajīvāśca lokapālakatāṃ parām ||49|| so’yaṃ bhikṣukakuṭyāṃ vai vartate’raṇyabhūmiṣu | līlā nārāyaṇasyaiva dīnānāṃ mokṣakāriṇī ||1.244.50 || athaikadā śṛṇu lakṣmi jātaṃ kṣatraṃ samuddhatam | gaṇayatyeva naiva svapūjyānāraṇyakāndvijān ||11 || māhiṣmatyā bhūpatiśca sahasrārjunanāmakaḥ | candravaṃśī kṛtavīryātmajo bāhuparākramaḥ ||52|| nārāyaṇāvatāraṃ saḥ dattātreyaṃ tapasvinam | prasannīkṛtya sevābhiryudhi bāhusahasrakam ||53|| tathā yogaprabhāvasya siddhiṃ lebhe śrīdattataḥ | yadṛcchayā sa mṛgayāṃ vicaran gahane vane ||54|| mahatā svasya sainyena sahito’raṇyabhūmiṣu | paryaṭannāśramaṃ cāyājjamadagnermahāmuneḥ ||55|| tasmai rājñe tu ṛṣiṇā pūjāsatkāramānanam | sasainyāmātyavāhāya dattaṃ yogabalād bahu ||56 || kāmadhenoḥ prasādena svargādadhikavaibhavān | prakaṭīkṛtya tatraiva tadānīṃ saḥ tamārcayat ||57|| rājālokya gatāścātivismayaṃ munivaibhavam | svaiśvaryātiśayitaṃ cādṛṣṭaṃ caivāśrutaṃ kvacit ||58|| sarvavibhūtisaudhādisamutpattiparākramām | kāmadhenuṃ sa tu jñātvā hyupājahāra tāṃ balāt ||59|| krandantīṃ vatsasahitāṃ ninye svanagaraṃ hi saḥ | tadānīṃ paraśurāmo gato’bhūttu gṛhādbahiḥ ||1.244.60 || āgataḥ san gṛhe dṛṣṭavān krandantīṃ svamātaram | tataḥ śrutvā tu nṛpaterdaurātmyaṃ krodhamāpa saḥ ||6 1 || mātre prāha tu kiṃ kāryaṃ mayā putreṇa me vada | vijayo me bhaveccaiva yathā tanniṣkrayo bhavet ||62|| tathā darśaya me mātaḥ kiṃ karomi vadādhunā | śikṣaye’smyapradhṛṣyo’haṃ kṣatramutpathagāminam ||6 3|| tathā me śādhi me mātaḥ putro’haṃ sevakastava | mātroktaṃ putra te samyag vijayo’stu tathā kuru ||64|| anapatyā ca pūrvaṃ yad vrataṃ putrecchayā hyaham | vijayaikādaśītitheḥ tadā kṛtavatī hariḥ |||65|| prasanno’bhūcca matkukṣau tvadrūpo janma cāptavān | tvaṃ vai hariḥ svayaṃ cāsi paśya haste dhanuḥ śubham ||66 || paraśuṃ ca patākāṃ ca rekhārūpān vilokaya | kuru ca tvaṃ vijayaikādaśītithervrataṃ śubham ||67|| vijayaste sadā bhaviṣyati kṣatriyayodhane | kṣatriyāṇāṃ śikṣaṇāya vrataṃ kuru suputraka ||68|| tato daṇḍapradānāya yāhi te vijayo’stu vai | ityuktaḥ paraśurāmaścakāra vijayātitheḥ ||69|| vrataṃ phālgunakṛṣṇe tu nirjalaṃ mātṛvākyataḥ | daśamyāṃ naktabhojī ca rātrau bhūśayanastathā ||1.244.70 || prātaḥ snānottaraṃ devaṃ pradyamnaṃ dhīyutaṃ tathā | vijayāsahitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pupūja bhāvabhaktitaḥ || 7 1 || kṛtvā tu sarvatobhadramaṇḍale tatra sadghaṭam | ratnapallavavastrādijalagandhādisaṃyutam ||72|| saṃsthāpya ca tatastasyopari tilabhṛtāṃ śubhām | sthālīṃ sannyasya mūrtiṃ sthāpayitvā svarṇanirmitām ||73|| prādyumnīṃ dhīsthitapārśvāṃ pupūja bahuvastubhiḥ | pañcāmṛtajalaiḥ snāpayitvā datvopavītakam ||74|| vastrabhūṣādyalaṃkārairbhūṣayitvā samarcya ca | candanādisugandhaiścākṣatādyaiśca supuṣpakaiḥ ||75|| phalādibhiśca saṃpūjya tulasīmañjarīdalaiḥ | dhūpadīpādidānaiśca pradakṣiṇāstavādibhiḥ ||76|| ārārtrikaistathā kṣamāparādhanaiḥ pupūja saḥ | madhyāhnepi tathā saṃpūjyārpayadbhojana jalam ||77|| sāyaṃ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ śreṣṭhairupacāraiḥ pupūja saḥ | vedaghoṣaiḥ kathākhyānairjāgaraṇaṃ cakāra saḥ ||78|| yāvad brāhmamuhūrtaṃ ca jātaṃ tāvatsvayaṃ punaḥ | snātvā cakāra devasya pūjanaṃ praṇayānvitaḥ ||79|| cakāra prārthanāṃ deva vijayāyā vratena me | viprasyānatiśaktasya svabhāvamṛdulasya ca ||1.244.80 || krūrakāpathagenaiva kṣatreṇa saha
