yodhane | vijayo bhavatāt kṛṣṇa hyakṣato’dhṛṣya eva ca ||81 || śikṣituṃ kāpathasthaṃ vai kṣatraṃ kālo’yamāgataḥ | mama miṣeṇa bhagavān kuru tvaṃ vijayaṃ svayam ||82|| yāvadabhyarthayatyevaṃ tadā viṣṇuścaturbhujaḥ | prādurbhūya tamuvāca vijayaste’stu sarvathā ||83|| vijayāyā vratenāhaṃ prasanno’smi dvijottama | mama rūpo’si viprendra nārāyaṇāṃśa eva ha ||84|| vijayaikādaśikāyāḥ phalena vijayastava | bhavatād bhūmipālānāṃ śikṣaṇaṃ tvannimittakam ||85|| śāstṛṇāṃ kṣitipānāṃ cetkupaye vai gatirbhavet | tadā teṣāṃ praśāstāro brāhmaṇāstu mayā kṛtāḥ ||86|| kṣatriyāṇāṃ balaṃ dharmād viprāṇāṃ brahmajaṃ balam | adhārmikāṇāṃ kṣatrāṇāṃ śāsanaṃ viprasātkṛtam ||87|| tasmād viprendra yuddhyasva śādhi kṣatraṃ vigarvagam | vijayāyā vratenātra bhūloke vijayastava ||88|| māṃ vihāyāstu trailokye vijayaste’bhito diśi | ityuktvā bhagavān viṣṇustatra cādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ||89|| parśurāmo’pi paraśuṃ tīkṣṇadhāraṃ dhanustathā | bāṇān khaṅgaṃ carmaśaktiṃ cakraṃ cādāya caikalaḥ ||1.244.90|| yayau yatra kārtavīryo māhiṣmatyāḥ patirnṛpaḥ | sahasrārjunanāmāsau sahasrakaraśobhitaḥ ||91 || virājate svabhavane tatra tvākṣipya bhūpatim | rāmaḥ prāha mahāduṣṭa kāmadhenuprahāraka ||92|| prāṇaglahārthaṃ nirgaccha kurvāsvādaṃ svakarmaṇaḥ | prāṇāndehi raṇaṃ dehi kāmadhenuṃ pradehi me ||93|| yadvā parājayaṃ dehi rāmavākyaṃ hi śāśvatam | śrutvaivaṃ krodhamāpanno yuyodhātibalo’rjunaḥ ||94|| kintu bāhusahasraṃ vai chinnamasya pramūlataḥ | tīkṣṇayā divyayā yuddhe rāmaparaśudhārāyā ||95|| bahvyo’kṣauhiṇya evāsya vidāritā dvijena vai | nāśitāstasya putrāścārjuno’pi māritastadā ||96 || kāmadhenuṃ punaḥ prāpya tato divaṃ yayau svayam | kṣatriyāṇāṃ vināśāya pṛthivyāṃ vicacāra ha ||97|| ekaviṃśatikṛtvaḥ saḥ kṣatriyāntakaro’bhavat | vijayaikādaśīvratabalena vijayī bhuvi ||98|| samabhūdvipravaryo’sau rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ | prāptā dhenurjitaṃ kṣatraṃ hyarjuno nihato raṇe || 99|| iha loke jayaḥ prāpto rāmeṇa vijayāvratāt | viṣṇoḥ sudarśanacakrāvatāro’rjuna āsa ha || 1.244.100 || tathāpi nihataḥ parśurāmeṇa kāpathavrataḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāścāpi vājapeyaphalaṃ bhavet || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne phālgunakṛṣṇavijayaikādaśīvratamāhātmye sahasrārjunanāśārthaṃ tapasā parśurāmavijayaścaityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuścatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 244 ||
<1.245> śrīlakṣmīruvāca svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ paraṃbrahma lokarakṣaṇahetave | avatāraṃ parigṛhya karotyapi vrataṃ svakam || 1 || lokasaṃgrahakāryāya samācarati vai svayam | śikṣayati janān sattvamayān cācaryyamityapi || 2 || vada kṛṣṇa mayāpyatra bhavateva vrataṃ śubham | kāryaṃ yasya pratāpena muktiḥ syāddhastagāminī || 3 || janā api vrataṃ kṛtvā paraṃ phalamavāpnuyuḥ | phālgunasyārjune pakṣe yannāmnyekādaśī matā || 4 || vada tāṃ dharmaputra tvaṃ nārāyaṇa pate mama | ityāpṛṣṭo harirviṣṇurvrataṃ provāca tāṃ priyām || 5 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu kalyāṇade devi sarvasampatkari priye | yadvratena janānāṃ susmṛddhayo yānti poṣaṇam || 6 || vardhante ca sadā lakṣmyaḥ sampadaśca bhavanti vai | bahumuktirmahāmuktistasya saṃkalpavartinī || 7 || phālgunasyārjune pakṣe bhavetyekādaśī śubhā | āmalakītināmnā sā viṣṇulokaphalapradā || 8 || vaikuṇṭhe śrīharirlakṣmī papraccha kimapekṣyate | kimiṣyate tvayā lakṣmi yat tad brūhi dadāmi te || 9 || nānavāptamavāptavyaṃ tvatkṛte brahmarūpiṇī | yanmadīyaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ tvadīyaṃ ca tvadātmakam || 1.245.10|| tasmādvaraya bhadraṃ te karomi tava kāmanām | mā saṃkocaṃ vaha lakṣmi yattavāsti mamāsti tat || 1 1|| lakṣmīrevaṃ hareḥ śrutvā provāca bhagavanmama | lalāṭabhūṣā preṣṭhāsti tantikā dehi tāṃ prabho || 12|| haristadānīṃ saṃkalpyābhūṣaṇārthaṃ navaṃ śubham | suvarṇavarṇaṃ sarasaṃ lalāṭe śītalaṃkaram || 13|| svacchaṃ divyaṃ maṇiprakhyaṃ śaśitulyaṃ guṇānvitam | prakaṭīkṛtavān bhāle bindvātmakaṃ vibhūṣaṇam || 14|| binduḥ sa phalarūpo’bhūnmaṇiśreṣṭhaḥ prabhānvitaḥ | akṣato vartulaḥ saumyaḥ suvarṇamaṇisadṛśaḥ || 15|| tasmāccānye’pi maṇayo divyā jātāstvanekaśaḥ | hārastantimayasteṣāṃ kṛto’laṃkāraśobhanaḥ || 16|| sūryakāntanibho dṛśye candrakāntasamo guṇe | kaustubhena samo hṛdye tantikābhūṣaṇātmakaḥ || 17|| cūḍāmaṇisamo dhārye spṛśye komalapeśalaḥ | puṇye viṣṇuśilātulyo dhārye candanaśītalaḥ || 18|| sugandhe divyagandhāḍhyaḥ puṣṭau stanyasamastathā | śāśvataśca mahādivyo harerbhālasya bindujaḥ || 19|| tantikātmakabhūṣākhyo hāro nirmalanūtanaḥ | saṃskṛto hariṇā caikacatvāriṃśatphalātmakaḥ ||1.245.20 || madhye saptaphalānyatra pārśvayośca dvisūtrayoḥ | aṣṭāviṃśatimaṇyāḍhyaḥ prāntayoḥ ṣaḍphalātmakaḥ ||2 1|| arpitaśca mahālakṣmyai hariṇā paramātmanā | samprāpya sūryasadṛśaṃ tejasvinaṃ praśītalam ||22|| sarasaṃ śāśvataṃ hāraṃ jaharṣa prajaharṣa sā | jighrāti spṛśati cainaṃ vilokayati sādaram ||23||| muhurbhāle dhārayati paśyati sma punaḥ punaḥ | nūtanaṃ kanakaprakhyaṃ sugandharasasaṃbhṛtam ||24|| lalāṭe śāntidaṃ snigdhasparśaṃ rekhābhiranvitam | svakṛte eva hariṇā kṛtaṃ vīkṣya mumoda sā ||25|| stauti praśaṃsati haste gṛhṇāti sma muhurmuhuḥ | sakhībhyaḥ sma darśayati prasannā saṃbabhūva sā ||26|| nārāyaṇo’pi bhagavān āsamantāt phalasya vai | nairmalyaṃ tu vilokyaiva nāmākarod yathāguṇam |||27||| āmalakaṃ phalaṃ ceti tantikāmalakaiḥ kṛtā | bhāle babandha lakṣmīstāṃ śuśubhe sarvato’dhikā ||28||| dyauryathānekaśaśikṛtpaṃktibhiḥ śobhate tathā | śuśubhe tu mahālakṣmī samāsādya sutantikām ||29|| evaṃ jāte mahānande sṛṣṭāvatrāpi vedhasaḥ | kalpādau prākṛte jāte sarge sthāvarajaṃgame ||1.245.30|| lakṣmyā yuto hariḥ sākṣātparamātmā parātparaḥ | samājagāma bhūmau ca lakṣmīkāntaḥ samādarāt ||3 1|| lakṣmyā lalāṭadeśācca tantikāyāḥ śubhaṃ phalam | śrīhariḥ pātayāmāsa pṛthvyāṃ tatsattvasiddhaye ||32|| tasyātphalātsamutpannaḥ phalabhāreṇa nāmitaḥ | śākhāpraśākhābahulaḥ svayaṃ dhātrītarurmahān ||33|| sarveṣāṃ caiva vṛkṣāṇāmatiśreṣṭhaḥ sa kīrtitaḥ | svarṇanibhaphalopeto vṛkṣo lakṣmīpriyaḥ śubhaḥ ||34|| yathā nārāyaṇabhālaṃ priyaṃ vṛkṣaḥ priyastathā | nārāyaṇasvarūpo’yaṃ nārāyaṇena nirmitaḥ ||35|| nārāyaṇyāḥ kṛte so’yaṃ muktido bhuktidastathā | badarikāśrame so’yaṃ prathamaḥ prakaṭīkṛtaḥ ||36|| tasmācca raivatādrau saḥ samāyātastarurmahān | ta ete muktidāḥ sarve vṛkṣā āmalakāhvayāḥ ||37|| yasmindine hariṇāyaṃ vṛkṣastu prakaṭīkṛtaḥ | so’yaṃ tu divaso’pyāsīdekādaśīsamāhvayaḥ ||38|| tatra tvāmalakīvṛkṣotpatterekādaśī tithiḥ | āmalakītināmnā vai kṛtā devarṣisattamaiḥ ||39|| devadānavagandharvayakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ | kinnarā mānavā nāgāḥ ṛṣayo munayo’pare ||1.245.40|| vidyādhrāḥ kiṃpuruṣāśca yogino bhūsurāstathā | yatayo nyāsinaḥ sādhvyo yoginyo brahmacaryagāḥ ||41 || sudivyadṛṣṭayo’pyanye ye’bhavan vedhasā kṛtāḥ | te sarve’pi yayustvatyāścaryaṃ śrutvāmaladrumam |||42|| sāścaryā āmalakīdruṃ cintayanto yayuśca te | praśaṃsanto’tibhūṣārhaphalānyāmalakāni ca ||43|| ājagmustatra devādyā yatra dhātrī haripriyā | tāṃ dṛṣṭvā te ca tatpatnyaḥ paraṃ vismayamāgatāḥ ||44|| viṣṇuḥ prāha svayaṃ tebhyaḥ pravaro vaiṣṇavo hyayam | āmalakīdrumaścāsya smṛtergodānajaṃ phalam ||45|| sparśanāddviguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ triguṇaṃ bhakṣaṇāttathā | āmalakāni vai bhāle karṇayorgalahastayoḥ ||46|| yena dhṛtāni teṣāṃ vai vaikuṇṭhe vasatirdhruvā | āmalakaṃ madutpannaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ priyam || 87|| vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇugamakaṃ bhakṣaṇātpāpaśodhakam | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sevyā tvāmalakī janaiḥ ||48|| evaṃ vadati śrīkṛṣṇe devyaḥ prāhurhariṃ tadā | ābhūṣaṇārthaṃ deveśa dehi phalāni no vibho ||49|| tadā śrīhariṇā tatra phalānyasaṃkhyakāni vai | saṃkalpya prakaṭīkṛtyārpitāni tābhya ityapi ||1.245.50|| tābhiḥ kṛtāni tatraivābharaṇāni bahūnyatha | dhṛtāni bhālakaṇṭhādau karakarṇādikeṣvapi ||5 1|| prajahṛṣuścātitamā yatheṣṭaṃ jagṛhustathā | atha devādayo’pyenaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ jagadgurum ||52|| prāhurnārāyaṇa viṣṇo śṛṇu no’bhyarthanaṃ prabho | vṛkṣo’yaṃ rocate’smabhyaṃ dīyatāṃ no’dhivāsanam ||53|| yadvāsena sadāsmākaṃ paraṃ niḥśreyasaṃ bhavet | hariḥ prāha tadā devān yogyaṃ yuṣmābhirarthitam ||54|| yadyatsthalaṃ nivāsāya rocate tu viśantu tat | ityāśrutya harervākyaṃ devā rucyanusārataḥ ||55|| praviṣṭā āmalakīdrau vasanti sma ca nityadā | tasya mūle sthito viṣṇustadūrdhvaṃ tu pitāmahaḥ ||56|| skandhe ca bhagavān rudraḥ śākhāsu munayaḥ sthitāḥ | devāstvanye praśākhāsu parṇeṣu vasavaḥ sthitāḥ |||57|| puṣpeṣu marutaḥ sarve phaleṣu ca prajeśvarāḥ | patraśalākāsvarṣayastvaci brahma svayaṃ sthitam ||58|| rase’vasadbrahmarasastṛptī rūpe vyavasthitā | sugandhe brahmasāyujyaṃ sparśe muktirvyavasthitā ||59|| muktāḥ phalānāṃ tantvādau bīje śrīpatirāsthitaḥ | sarvadevamayī hyeṣā dhātrī bodhyā jagatprasūḥ ||1.245.6 0|| lakṣmīpradā ramā sevyā sampatpradātivallabhā | tasmātpūjyatamā hyeṣā sarvairbhaktiparāyaṇaiḥ ||6 1 || phālgune cāmalakyāstu vratavanto hi mānavāḥ | gaccheyurāmalakyāstu chāyāyāṃ bhajanāya me ||62|| vrataṃ jāgaraṇaṃ tatra kuryād bhaktipuraḥsaram | dvādaśyāmapi tatraiva gatvā kuryācca pāraṇām ||63|| tatphalaṃ śāśvataṃ proktaṃ matsambandhātsureśvarāḥ | kārtike phālgune cāpi hyāmalakītaroradhaḥ ||64|| bhojanādi prakurvīta phalaṃ tasya tu śāśvatam | dhātrīphalaviliptāṃgo dhātrīphalavibhūṣaṇaḥ ||65|| dhātrīphalakṛtāhāro mānavo mokṣamāpnuyāt | dhātrīchāyāṃ samāśritya yo’rcayeccakradhāriṇam ||66 || puṣpe puṣpe bhavettasya rājasūyaphalaṃ priye | hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ samabhyarcya dhātrīvṛkṣatalasthale ||67|| brāhmaṇān bhojayet sādhūn vaikuṇṭhaṃ sa vrajed dhruvam | dhātrīvṛkṣatale dānaṃ kurvan svargamavāpnuyāt ||68|| dhātrīphalarasāsvādaṃ gṛhṇan nirguṇatāṃ vrajet | dhātrīphalaṃ prabhuñjan vai divyamuktiṃ vrajedvratī ||69|| dhātrīdhātrīti tannāma gṛṇan yāti mṛtiṃ yadi | dhātrīva lakṣmīrāyāti nārāyaṇena saṃyutā ||1.245.70|| nayatyenaṃ harerdhāma divyaṃ vaikuṇṭhamakṣaram | dhātrīsamudbhavo yatra dine jātastadīyakam ||71|| vrataṃ caikādaśīrūpaṃ kartavyaṃ muktimicchatā | dhanadhānyapradaṃ puṇyamātmanastuṣṭikārakam ||72|| alpāyāsaṃ bahuphalaṃ vratānāṃ vratamuttamam | kṛtena yena manujo viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||73 || phālgune śuklapakṣe tu puṣyeṇa dvādaśī yadi | bhavet saikādaśī puṇyā mahāpātakanāśini ||74|| kartavyā vratinā saiṣā bhuktimuktipradāyinī | daśamyāṃ tvekabhuktatvaṃ rātrau bhūśayanaṃ tathā ||75|| brahmacāritvamevāpi rakṣaṇīyaṃ vratārthinā | ekādaśyāṃ brāhmakāle samutthāyāntare nije ||76|| hariṃ smṛtvā tathā dhyātvā snānaṃ tīrthe samācaret | hareragre samāgatya vrataṃ saṃkalpayet tataḥ ||77|| adya devaprasādena kariṣye nirjalaṃ vratam | tadvai saṃpūrṇatāṃ yātu mā vighno me bhavetprabho ||78|| ityabhyarthyācamanaṃ vai kuryāt sandhyādikaṃ caret | naityakaṃ pūjanaṃ kuryād viṣṇornārāyaṇasya ca ||79|| tato vai maṇḍale sarvatobhadrākhye’nnanirmite | madhye svarṇakṛtaṃ tāmraṃ ghaṭaṃ vā pañcaratnakam ||1.245.80 || vastrapallavasalilatantuphalādiyojitam | sthāpayecca tilasthālīṃ nyasyettatra suśobhanām ||8 1|| āmalakyā adhipatiṃ govindaṃ svarṇanirmitam | candravatyā saha patnyā sthāpayettatra pūjayet ||82|| āvāhanāt samārabhya puṣpāñjalyantakaṃ tadā | pūjanaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ vratinā divyavastubhiḥ ||83 || ṣoḍaśasūpacāraiśca tathānyairupacārakaiḥ | nīrājanastutibhojyajalatāmbūlavastubhiḥ ||84|| guladāvadikāpuṣpaiḥ kamalādibhirityapi | pūjayettandulairdevaṃ kuṃkumāgurucandanaiḥ ||85 || nivedane viśeṣeṇa kaṃsārapūrikādikam | arpayedatibhaktyā cākṣoḍaṃ prapūjane phalam ||8 6 || tilapātraṃ tathā dadyād dāne svarṇādikaṃ dhanam | evaṃ prātaḥ samarcāṃ tu kṛtvā bhaktiṃ samācaret ||87 || madhyāhne tu viśeṣeṇa pūjā dhātrīdine matā | nadyāṃ taḍāge kūpe vā gṛhe vā niyatātmavān ||88 || śarīre mṛttikāṃ datvā tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret | sarvatīrthāni cāyāntu tatra snānaṃ karomyaham ||8 9|| evaṃ snātvā tathā śuddhe vastre dhṛtvātha puṇḍrakam | tilakaṃ candrakaṃ kṛtvā gacchedāmalakīdrumam || 1.245.90 || sarvopaskarasaṃyuktaḥ pūjopakaraṇairyutaḥ | dhātrīchāyāṃ samāśritya saṃśodhyāpi samantataḥ || 91 || racayet sarvatobhadramaṇḍalaṃ saptadhānyajam | madhye tu sthāpayetkuṃbhaṃ svarṇajaṃ tāmrajaṃ ca vā || 92 || pañcaratnasamopetaṃ divyagandhādhivāsitam | chatropānadvastrayuktaṃ sitacandanacarcitam || 93 || sraṅmālālambitagrīvaṃ sarvadhūpavidhūpitam | dīpamālākulaṃ ramyaṃ sarvataḥ sumanoharam || 94|| pātre nyasyet tadūrdhve ca divyalājāprapūritam | tilapātre ca lājāyāḥ sthālyāṃ candrāvatīyutam || 95|| jāmadagnyaṃ hariṃ rāma saparaśuṃ hiraṇmayam | sthāpayecca tathā dhātrīṃ svarṇamūrtimayī śubhām || 96 || āvāhanaṃ cāsanaṃ ca pādyamarghyaṃ jalena ca | dadyādācamanaṃ paṃcāmṛtaiḥ saṃsnapayet prabhum || 97|| tatastīrthajalairdevaṃ snāpayenmārjanaṃ caret | vastre sandhārayedyajñopavītaṃ dāpayenmaṇim || 98 || ābhūṣaṇāni sarvāṇi mukuṭādīni cārpayet | sugandhacandanādīnyattaratailādi cārpayet || 99 || gulālakuṃkumābīrāgurudravyākṣataistathā | puṣpairnānāvidhairdevaṃ dhūpadīpanivedanaiḥ || 1.245.100 || nīrājanena vidhinā jalatāmbūlasatphalaiḥ | daṇḍavatstutinamanairaparādhakṣamārthanaiḥ || 101 || pradakṣiṇādakṣiṇābhiḥ satpuṣpāṃjalinā tathā | arcayed devaveśaṃ dhātrīvṛkṣatale śubhe || 102|| dhyāyettu bhagavadrūpaṃ saumyābhaṃ pādayoḥ svayam | jānvostu viśvarūpaṃ ca sakthnoḥ tejaḥsvarūpakam || 103 || kaṭyāṃ dāmodaraṃ dhyāyetpadmanābhaṃ tathodare | vakṣasi śrīvatsayutaṃ vāmabāhau tu cakriṇam || 1 04|| gadinaṃ dakṣiṇe bāhau kaṇṭhe vaikuṇṭhamityapi | āsye yajñamukhaṃ dhyāyennāsāyāṃ sukhasāgaram || 1 05|| akṣṇordhyāyedvāsudevaṃ lalāṭe vāmanaṃ tathā | sarvātmānaṃ brahmarandhre dhyātvāṅgāni vicintayet || 106 || namaste devadeveśa jāmadagnya namo’stu te | mayā kṛtāṃ mahāpūjāṃ dhātrīphalārpaṇānvitām || 1 07|| gṛhāṇa paramaprītyā bhuktimuktiprado bhava | ityabhyarcya samāpyaiva tato vai bhojanādikam || 108 || gobhyo dadyāttathā sūkṣmajantubhyo’pi pradāpayet | dhātrīmūle prasādaśca samarpyo devabhāvataḥ || 10 9|| jalaṃ deyaṃ dhātrikāyāḥ mūle pitṛpratarpakam | sūryāya tvaṃjaliṃ dadyāt pitṝnuddiśya bhāvataḥ || 1.245.110 || bhūtebhyastu prasādāṃśaṃ dadyād bālebhya eva ca | śeṣaṃ prasādaṃ tvanayet svagṛhaṃ rakṣayecca tam || 111 || dvādaśyāmupabhuñjīta phalaṃ jalaṃ tu taddine | vratinā yadi grāhyaṃ syānna vrataghnaṃ hi tadbhavet || 11 2|| evaṃ kṛtvā tu dānāni maṇisvarṇamayāni hi | ābhūṣaṇāni vastrāṇi vividhānnāni bhūmayaḥ || 113 || gomahiṣyo gṛhodyānayānavāhanakāni ca | atiśreṣṭhāni ratnāni miṣṭānnāni bahūnyapi || 1 14|| dadyāddhātrītale tasya phalaṃ brahmaṇi śāśvatam | svargaṃ tasyākṣayaṃ cāpi niratiśayameva ca || 1 15|| evaṃvidhaṃ vrataṃ dānaṃ svargamokṣaphalapradam | sarvānsantoṣya dānena jalenānnena vāsasā || 116 || namaskṛtya hariṃ natvā dattvā dvijāya cetarat | gṛhaṃ yāyāt parabhaktyā cāparāhṇepi sarvathā || 1 17|| samayaṃ kīrtanabhaktyā yāpayecca tathā niśi | pūjanaṃ vidhivat kṛtvā kṛtvā cārārtrikādikam || 1 18|| naivedyaṃ ca jalaṃ gandhaṃ tāmbūlaṃ prasamarpya ca | devaṃ tvāndolayetpreṃkhādolādau jāgaraṃ tathā || 119 || kuryānnṛtyaistathā gītairvāditrādyaiḥ kathāmṛtaiḥ | dharmākhyānaistathā kṛṣṇaśṛṃgārapadagāyanaiḥ || 1.245.120 || gṛhe vā mandire yadvā dhātrīvṛkṣatale vratī | paraśurāmamūrtiṃ ca sthāpayitvā dine niśi || 12 1|| pūjanaṃ ca vrataṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād drumasthale | vaiṣṇavāmuktidākhyānairyāpayeyurniśāmimām || 1 22|| pradakṣiṇāstataḥ kuryāddhātrīdrau viṣṇunāmabhiḥ | aṣṭādhikaśataṃ cāpi hyaṣṭāviṃśatimityapi || 123|| dhātrīvṛkṣaṃ hariṃ jñātvā prātaḥ pūjanamācaret | snātvā nīrājanaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā tu bhūsuram || 124|| guruṃ samarcya dānārhaṃ sarvaṃ tasmai nivedayet | jāmadagnyaṃ ghaṭaṃ svarṇaṃ vastrayugmamupānahau || 125|| jāmadagnyasvarūpāya gurave tvarpayettataḥ | vadedāmalakīṃ spṛṣṭvā kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇām || 126|| jāmadagnyasvarūpeṇa prīyatāṃ mama keśava | dadyādbhaktajanebhyaśca viṣṇuprasādamuttamam || 1 27|| āśritebhyo vidhānena datvā tvannaṃ jalaṃ tathā | viprān bālān bhojayecca sādhūn sādhvīśca bālikāḥ || 128|| tataḥ svayaṃ samaśnīyāt kuṭumbena samāvṛtaḥ | evaṃkṛtena puṇyaṃ tu śāśvataṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet || 129|| sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvadāneṣu yatphalam | sarvayajñeṣu yatpuṇyaṃ tatphalaṃ labhate vratī || 1.245.130|| sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ parāmuktiṃ prapadyate | āmalakīvratakarturviṣṇuloko dhruvo mataḥ || 131 || etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vratānāṃ vratamuttamam | putradaṃ jayadaṃ kāntipradaṃ mokṣapradaṃ tathā || 132|| avyāhatagatisvargapradaṃ siddhipradaṃ drutam | sarvasaṃkalpaphaladaṃ lakṣmīprasannatāpradam || 133||| yānavāhanasadbhūṣopaskārādipradaṃ śubham | vratametaddurādharṣaṃ sarvapāpavimocakam || 134|| nāryā lakṣmīsvarūpatvaprada ramātvadāyakam || narasya tu caturbāhuviṣṇurūpatvasampradam || 1 35|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne phālgunaśuklāmalakīnāmnyekādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ lakṣmīlalāṭabhūṣārtham āmalakīprāvirbhāvaḥ pṛthivyāṃ vṛkṣarūpasyaikādaśīvrate pūjanamāhātmyaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||245||
<1.246> śrīlakṣmīruvāca aho cātiprahṛṣṭaṃ me cittaṃ bhavati keśava | āmalakyā vrataṃ śrutvā dhātrīmāhātmyamityapi || 1 || caitrasya kṛṣṇapakṣe tu kiṃnāmnyekādaśī matā | ko devastatra pūjyo’sti kā ca patnī harestathā || 2 || kiṃ phalaṃ ca vidhānaṃ ca dānaṃ pūjāṃ ca me vada | śrutvā lakṣmīvacaḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇohyuvāca tām || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi caitrasya prathame dale | ekādaśīṃ pāpamocanikānāmnīṃ mahāphalām || 4 || kāmānāṃ pūraṇī siddhidāyinī dharmavardhinī | nirjalā tu kṛtā yena prāpnuyādbrahma sa vratī || 5 || daśamyāṃ naktabhojī ca rātrau bhūśayanastathā | brahmacārī vratī prātaścāniruddhaṃ vicintayet || 6 || suśilāsahitaṃ devaṃ pāpamocanikāyutam | pūjāyāṃ kundakalikāpuṣpāṇi tvarpayettathā || 7 || naivedye sevikāṃ dadyādarghye badarikāphalam | tathānyāni phalānyatra miṣṭānnāni bahūnyapi || 8 || dadyāccāpyaniruddhāya dāne tu tilagaurmatā | evaṃ prātaḥ samutthāya dhyātvā hariṃ tu mānase || 9 || snātvā ca mānasaṃ cāniruddhasya pūjanaṃ caret | arpayenmānasānyevopakaraṇāni ṣoḍaśa || 1.246.10|| tato vai bāhyapūjāṃ tu kuryādvai kramaśo vratī | āvāhayedaniruddhaṃ suśīlāsahitaṃ prabhum || 1 1|| svarṇamūrtau samāhūyāsanaṃ dadyānmahattamam | pādyaṃ cārghyaṃ tathā dadyādācamanīyakaṃ jalam || 12|| paṃcāmṛtakṛtaṃ snānaṃ tvabhiṣekaṃ samarpayet | vastrairaṃgajalānāṃ ca pramārjanamathācaret || 1 3|| tato vastre’rpayed dhaute bahumūlye hyubhe śubhe | anyānyapi susūkṣmāṇi tvarpayet tṛptihetave || 14|| yajñopavītaṃ dadyācca maṇiratnāni cārpayet | keśaprasādhanadravyadantikātailadarpaṇam || 15 || arpayeddharaye cāpi prakṛṣṭābharaṇāni ca | kajjalaṃ kuṃkumābīragulālākṣatacandanam || 16|| puṣpāṇi tvarpayeccāpi tulasīdalamityapi | phalāni cārpayettasmai dhūpadīpanivedanam || 17|| bhojanaṃ vividhaṃ dadyād dugdhaṃ ca śarkarāyutam | jalaṃ phalaṃ mukhavāsaṃ tāmbūlaṃ gandhacūrṇakam || 18|| dadyāttvattaratailādi sugandhyarthaṃ tu śārṅgiṇe | ārārtrikaṃ tataḥ kuryānnamaḥ stotraṃ kṣamāpanam || 19|| pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavacca puṣpāṃjaliṃ ca dakṣiṇām | dadyācca vratakaraṇāyārthayetparameśvaram ||1.246.20|| adyaikādaśikā nāmnā pāpamocanakāriṇī | mayā vratāya manasā vṛtāsti parameśvara ||21|| asyāḥ kṛta vrataṃ mayā nirvighnaṃ syājjanārdana | prasanno bhava deveśa suśīlādhipa keśava ||22|| iti vai pūjanaṃ cātha samāpya saptadhānyakam | maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kārayetsthāpayettataḥ || 23|| ghaṭaṃ kanakajaṃ kimvā tāmrajaṃ pañcapallavaiḥ | ratnaiḥ pañcavidhaiścāpi jalavastrādibhiryutam |||24|| tasyopari śubhaṃ pātraṃ tilaiḥ saṃbhṛtamarpayet | tatra mūrtiṃ suśīlāyāścāniruddhasya vai prabhoḥ ||25|| sthāpayitvārcayet ṣoḍaśopacārairvratī tataḥ | nīrājayettu vidhinā namaskārādi cācaret ||26|| paryaṃkaṃ gendukaṃ guptadorakaṃ śayanāya ca | śiraskaṃ pārśvake cāpi chatraṃ copānahau śubhau ||27|| sthālīṃ sakalaśāṃ cāpi vaṭikāṃ vyajanaṃ tathā | darpaṇaṃ cāmare yaṣṭiṃ pāduke naktakaṃ śubham ||28||| śāṭīṃ ca pracchadapaṭīṃ kaṃcukīṃ kucalīṃ tathā | karpaṭikāṃ sacandrāṃ ca ghargharī ceti vai dadet ||29|| ghaṭaṃ yajñopavītaṃ ca śītasalilapūritam | candanaṃ ca sugandhaṃ cāniruddhāyārpayedvratī ||1.246.3 0 || phalāni cāmlamiṣṭāni laḍḍukān śarkarānvitān | cārpayedaniruddhāya sarvatobhadramaṇḍale ||3 1 || ghṛtadīpamakhaṇḍaṃ tu kārayennikaṭe vratī | evaṃ pūjāṃ tadā kṛtvā svakāryaṃ sa samācaret || 32|| madhyāhne tu vratī snātvā pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ | naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ miṣṭaṃ jalaṃ ca haraye’rpayet ||33|| phalaṃ tāmbulamelāṃ ca lavaṃgaṃ mukhavāsanam | phalaṃ pūgīphalaṃ cāpi vratī śrīharaye’rpayet || 34|| sāyaṃ ca kadalīstaṃbhairmaṇḍapaṃ kārayecchubham | savitānaṃ sakalaśaṃ haritpratrāditoraṇam ||35|| madhye tu vedikāṃ kuryāt dolāṃ ca bandhayettathā | sthāpayitvātra muralīdharaṃ tvāndolayed vratī ||36|| nīrājanaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyamarcanam | jalapānaṃ mukhavāsaṃ kārayet kīrtayedguṇān ||37|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ nṛtyagītavāditrasaṃyutam | kuryātprātaḥ pūjanaṃ ca tathā dānāni dāpayet || 38|| yathāśakti yathāvastu vratāṃgāni prapūrayet | sarvaṃ vai gurave dadyādevaṃ samāpayed vratam ||39|| sādhūnsādhvīstathā viprāndīnāndhakṛpaṇādikān | bālāṃśca bhojayedbhaktyā vividhānnāni vai vratī ||1.246.40 || tataḥ svīyān bhojayitvā bālikāstvatha pāraṇām | svayaṃ kuryād vratī bhakto bhuktiṃ muktiṃ sa vai vrajet ||41 || śṛṇvāścaryakathāṃ lakṣmi prāgvṛttāṃ pāpanāśinīm | purā caitrarathodyāne vanamadhye himālaye ||42|| hariti śādvale divye phalapuṣpabharadrume | vanadevīśrite deśe hyapsarogaṇasevite ||43|| vasantasamaye’raṇye ṣaṭapadairabhinādite | kokilākūjite ramye manobhavasupuṣṭide ||44|| gandharvakanyakā vādyaiḥ ramante saha kiṃkaraiḥ | mahendrādyāśca surapāḥ krīḍanti tridivaukasaḥ ||45|| ṛṣayo munayaḥ sarve tapanti bahulaṃ tapaḥ | sādhavo yoginaḥ sādhvyaḥ satyo yoginya ityapi ||46|| tapanti brahmalābhārthaṃ yatra śīlavratasthitāḥ | nāparaṃ sukhadaṃ tasmāccaitrarathād vanasthalam ||47|| trilokavāsinastatra pariśramavinuttaye | sāyaṃ nityaṃ samāyānti yānti ca svasvakālayān ||48|| mañjughoṣāpsarā tatra ramate vanavāsinī | munīnāṃ sevanaṃ cāpi premṇā karotyaharniśam ||49|| dāsīva kiṃkarīveyaṃ mokṣecchayā tu sevate | natu nikṛṣṭamanasā kintu śuddhena cetasā ||1.246.50|| sevate sma muniṃ bālaṃ yuvānaṃ vṛddhamityapi | munipatnīrbālikā vā kiṃkarīva prasevate ||51 || evaṃ nityaṃ munīnāmāśrameṣu bahubhāvataḥ | vāsaṃ karoti sā mañjughoṣāthaikadine śubhe ||52|| medhāvinaṃ nāma ṛṣiṃ krośamātravane sthitam | tapantaṃ brahmacaryasthaṃ yauvanaṃ puṣṭiśālinam |||53|| surūpaṃ sughaṭaṃ svarṇatantusamajaṭānvitam | prodbhinnaśmaśrusadrekhaṃ raktauṣṭhaṃ vartulānanam ||54|| padmapatranibhanetra sthalapadmaśarīrakam | prasannatānidhiṃ kāntiparidhivyāptakaṃdharam ||55|| sūkṣmacandranibhanakhaṃ svasyā api surūpiṇam | śrutvā rājasabhāvena sevanārthaṃ gatāntikam ||56|| prathamaṃ tu bhayāttasya sthitā tvāśramasannidhau | kiñciddūramuṣitvainaṃ prasādayituṃ cakrame ||57|| jagau sā madhuraṃ sādhu mārjayāmāsa cāśramam | vipañcikāṃ tadā ramyāṃ vādayāmāsa cādarāt ||58|| sevanārthaṃ tu sā kuṭyāṃ jagāma ca tvarānvitā | śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ṛṣiṃ vīkṣya pasparśa tāpasī yathā ||59|| puṣpasugandhakastūrīkesaracandanārcitā | sevābuddhyā hāvabhāvān vilāsān samadarśayat ||1.246.6 0 || medhāvinastu nikaṭe śanairnanarta śobhanam | namaścakāra hastābhyāṃ netrābhyāṃ svīkṛtiṃ dadau ||61 || nyavedayatsubhaktāṃ svāṃ kare jagrāha tamṛṣim | mānase niścikāyāpi sevālābho bhaviṣyati ||62|| yuvānaṃ surūpatejasvinaṃ prāpyātiharṣitā | cakitā mānase bhāve tvākṛṣṭā yūni sā munau ||63 || rājasī rajasā vyāptābhavadāliṃgane muneḥ | kṛtābhyāse pathi prāyastādṛśīnāṃ vrajenmanaḥ ||64|| tasyāḥ śarīre saṃvāsamakarodvai manobhavaḥ | evameva jayākāṃkṣī medhāvinyakarot sthalam ||65|| ubhayoḥ kāmanāvyāptau dehau jātau suvikṛtau | manasī cānaṃgavegāviṣṭe jāte punaḥ punaḥ ||6 6 || tadā medhāvinā tatra medhayā tu vicāritam | nāryāḥ prasaṃgajaḥ kāmaḥ ko’yaṃ māṃ bādhate’dhunā ||67|| kṣamāṃ dhairyaṃ samālambya gacchāmyanyadvanaṃ yataḥ | rakṣaṇaṃ me tapasaḥ syāt kāmavego’pi yāsyati ||68|| vicāryaivaṃ sa medhāvī śīghraṃ sthānāt sthalāntaram | yāvadgacchati viprendrastāvatkāmo’pi vegavān ||69 || śivabhaktaṃ vijetuṃ vai vane bahiḥ sumūrtimān | abhavacca prayantaṃ saṃcakāra sarvatomukham ||1.246.70 || kṛtvā bhruvaṃ dhanuṣkoṭi guṇaṃ kṛtvā kaṭākṣakam | mārgaṇe nayane kṛtvā pakṣmayukte yathākramam ||7 1 || kucau kṛtvā parakuṭau mohanāyopacakrame | mañjughoṣābhavattasya kāmasyātra varūthinī ||72|| kāmena pañcabāṇāstu ṛṣerupari cāhitāḥ | camatkṛtaṃ tu prathamaṃ dvitīyaṃ jāgratātmakam ||73 || tṛtīyaṃ rasavāhākhyaṃ caturthaṃ mohanātmakam | paṃcamaṃ mithunībhāvagamakaṃ sa mumoca ha ||74|| medhāvī tadvaśaṃ nīto yuyuje mañjughoṣayā | medhāvinaṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā sāpi kāmena pīḍitā ||75|| yauvanodbhinnadehena yuyuje ṛṣiṇā tadā | gāḍhamāliṃgya tau tatra rājete smarayojitau ||76|| sitopavītasaṃyukto dṛṣṭaḥ smara ivāparaḥ | mañjughoṣāyuto vipro rājate dyauryutaḥ śaśī ||77|| suratasya vaśaṃ yātā mandaṃ mandaṃ jahāsa sā | raṇadvalayahastābhyāmāślikṣat taṃ muniṃ hṛdi ||78|| premakaṇṭhasvaraṃ sūkṣmaṃ līnaṃ kṛtvā tu mūkavat | netre pramīlya cauṣṭhābhyāmāsvādayadṛṣermukham ||79|| sparśamagnānandamagnā śāntanūpuramekhalā | sparśaibhāvaistathā netrairvarṣmaṇā sasvaje munim ||1.246.8 0 || vīṇā tu patitā bhūmau patitā svaṃ ca sasvaje | balādiva latā vṛkṣaṃ vātavegena kampitam || 81 || sopi reme tayā sārdhaṃ kāmabhedairanekaśaḥ | śivatattvaṃ tu vismṛtya kāmatattvavaśaṃgataḥ ||8 2 || tapasā sādhite saudhe sodyāne savimānake | vāhane copakaraṇe bhakṣyabhojyasulehyake || 83 || dhāraṇe’laṃkaraṇe cotsave samānake ṛtau | vividhe gṛhayogye ca bhogye tatsādhane sati ||84|| niratiśayatāṃ prāpte tṛptiṃ lebhe tayā saha | punastṛṣṇāṃ punastṛptiṃ punastṛṣṇāṃ jagāma saḥ ||85|| tṛṣṇāyā naiva cāntosti bhuktvā bhuktvā vivardhate | evaṃ tāruṇyabharayā tṛṣṇayā taruṇo’pi saḥ ||86|| na niśāṃ na dinaṃ sopi ramañjānāti kāmukaḥ | dīrghaḥ kālo gato ramamāṇasyācāralopataḥ ||87|| navaśatāni varṣāṇāṃ gatānyasya tayā saha | sā reme muninā tasya niśārdhamiva cābhavat ||88|| mañjughoṣā devaloke gamanāyopacakrame | sannaddhā taṃ pratyuvāca satṛṣṇaṃ munisattamam ||89|| ājñā me dīyatāṃ vipra svarlokagamanāya vai | medhāvī tu samākarṇya tāmuvāca vimohitaḥ ||1.246.9 0|| yāvatprabhātasandhyā syāt tāvattiṣṭha mamāntike | śrutvā vicārayāmāsa mañjughoṣā hṛdantare || 051 || aho kāmena vaiklavyaṃ jānātyayaṃ na vatsarān | niśārdhamātraṃ jānāti kāmamūrchāparājitaḥ |||92|| pratyākhyāne śāpabhītisamudvignā babhūva sā | punarvai ramayāmāsa tamṛṣiṃ bahuvatsarān || 93 || varṣāṇāṃ pañcapañcāśannava māsān dinatrayam | sā taṃ punaruvācātha tathā kāle gate munim || 94|| ādeśo dīyatāṃ brahman gantavyaṃ svagṛhaṃ mayā | medhāvyuvāca kāmāndhaḥ kālabhānavivarjiṃtaḥ ||95|| niśāntasamayastvāste śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama | kṣaṇaṃ māṃ ramayitvā tvaṃ gantumarhasi śobhane ||96|| tvāṃ vinā me kṣaṇaścāpi yugatulyo bhaviṣyati | tvayā sārdhaṃ niśāmātraṃ vyatītaṃ tiṣṭha me ciram ||97|| punaḥ śāpaprabhītā sā ramayāmāsa tamṛṣim | varṣāṇāṃ pañcacatvāriṃśadityadhikabhāvataḥ ||98|| punaḥ prāha muniṃ namrā brahmam̐stṛpto’si vā nahi | ādeśo dīyatāṃ vipra gantavyaṃ svagṛhaṃ mayā ||99|| medhāvyuvāca tāṃ snigdhāṃ rakṣituṃ svāntike tadā | prātaḥkālo’dhunā tvāste śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama || 1.246.100 || sarvadā tiṣṭha me saudhe māṃ ca ramaya kāmataḥ | ekā niśā sthitā cātra kā me tṛptirbhaved vada || 10 1|| sandhyāṃ yāvacca kurve’haṃ tāvattvaṃ vai sthirā bhava | iti śrutvā munervākyaṃ smitaṃ kṛtvā hyuvāca tam || 1 02|| kiyatpramāṇā viprendra tava sandhyā gatādhunā | kativatsarakālaste gataśceti vicāryatām || 1 03|| ekāṃ sandhyāṃ niśāṃ vetsi kā te suptiryugātmikā | iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā prodbhinnāntaralocanaḥ || 104|| tāṃ pṛṣṭvā gatakālasya medhāvī mānamācarat | navanavatyadhikāni navaśatāni saṃkhyayā || 1 05|| jātānyeva gatānyeva varṣāṇi priyayā saha | suviditvaikonadaśaśatānyekaniśāmukhe || 106 || tathāpi tṛṣṇayā vyāpta iti svaṃ dhik cakāra saḥ | cukrodha tasyai kāmāya svasmai ca yauvanāya ca || 1 07|| mokṣahāniṃ tapohāniṃ cātmahāniṃ vilokya ca | netrābhyāṃ vispulliṃgānsa mumocātīva kopataḥ || 1 08|| tapaḥkṣayakarīṃ nārīṃ mṛtyurūpāṃ ca rākṣasīm | ātmamuktirodhakartrī kaṣṭāptapuṇyabhakṣiṇīm || 10 9|| hānidāṃ tāṃ sakmpauṣṭho muniruvāca vegataḥ | dhik tvāṃ priye durācāre kulaṭe kāmanāpriye || 1.246.110 || sevāmiṣeṇa muniṣu svairiṇi puṇyanāśini | tapolopakari yāmyamārgasaṃsargadāyini || 111 || piśācī bhava duṣṭe tvaṃ kāmacchidrapradāyini | medhāvī tāṃ śaśāpaivaṃ sāpi namrā hyuvāca tam || 11 2|| naikasyā me hi doṣo’sti yuvā tvaṃ suvicāraya | dvayoḥ kārye jaye prāpte sabala paripūjyate || 113 || parājaye tu samprāpte nirbalastatra hanyate | maivaṃ bhavatu medhāvin hāniste naiva kevalā || 114 || mamāpi svaparityāgastvayā tyaktā sadhikkṛtā | ātmahānirlokahāniryaśohānistu me tathā || 1 15|| śāpaṃ dātuṃ samarthāsmi yathā vadasi tattathā | tathāpi praṇayikānte naivaṃ kāryaṃ striyā kvacit || 116 || kṣamā dattā hi nārībhyo brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā | adoṣā api patyustāḥ sahante krauryamavyathāḥ || 1 17|| prasādaṃ kuru tasmāt tvaṃ śāpasyānugrahaṃ kuru | satāṃ saṃgaḥ sukhakaraḥ sāptapadīna eva saḥ || 118 || tvayā saha mayā vipra yoṣitā patnīrūpayā | nītāśca sevayā śaśvat kati sahasravatsarāḥ || 119 || etasmāt kāraṇātsvāmin tyaja krauryaṃ prasīda ca | iti tathyaṃ priyāvākyaṃ doṣaṃ svīyaṃ ca cintayan || 1.246.120 || prahvībhāvaṃ tathā patnyā vilokyovāca tāṃ muniḥ | śṛṇu me vacanaṃ bhadre śāpānugrahakārakam || 121 || kiṃ karomi tvayā sākaṃ kṣayaṃ nītaṃ mahātapaḥ | gataṃ tattu gataṃ tveva naṣṭaṃ nāyāti vai punaḥ || 122 || punaḥ saṃpādayiṣyāmi tavāpi śubhamastu vai | caitrasya kṛṣṇapakṣe tu bhavatyekādaśī śubhā || 1 2 3 || pāpamocanikā nāma sarvaśāpakṣayaṃkarī | tasyā vrate kṛte subhru piśācītvaṃ viyāsyati || 1 24|| śrutvaitanmañjughoṣā sā yayau vanāntaraṃ tadā | piśācī tu babhūveyaṃ yāvaccaitro na saṃgataḥ || 125 || prāpte caitre mañjrughoṣā vrataṃ jātismarā tadā | cakāra vidhinā caitrakṛṣṇaikādaśikādine || 126 || pupūja parayā bhaktyā śrīhariṃ mānase hi sā | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prātaḥ kṛtyaṃ vidhāya ca || 127 || piśācītvādvinirmuktā pāpamocanikābalāt | divyarūpadharā sā vai gatā svarge svake gṛhe || 128 || medhāvyapi tayā tyakto jagāma piturāśramam | cyavanasya ṛṣerdivyaṃ tapastejo’tiśobhitam || 129 || nistejaskaṃ ciraṃ yāntaṃ vilokya cyavanaḥ pitā | prāhaitat kiṃ kṛtaṃ putra tvayā puṇyakṣayaḥ kṛtaḥ || 1.246.130 || kathaṃ na dṛśyate tejastapobāhulyasaṃbhavam | medhāvī prāha tātāsminvane tu tapasā mayā || 131 || prāptāpsarā tayā sārdhaṃ pātakaṃ vai kṛtaṃ bahu | ramitā bahukālaṃ sā tapo naṣṭaṃ mamādbhutam || 132 || prāyaścittaṃ brūhi tāta yena pāpakṣayo bhavet | pitā prāha tadā putraṃ vrataṃ vacmi nibodha me || 133|| caitrasya tvasite pakṣe nāmnā tu pāpamocanī | ekādaśī matā hyasyā vrate tu vidhitaḥ kṛte || 134|| pāparāśiḥ kṣayaṃ yāyānmuktiṃ cānte vrajed vratī | iti śrutvā piturvākyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena vratottamam || 135|| gataṃ pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ tasya tapovṛddhirbabhūva ca | tejo vyāpto’bhavacchīghraṃ pāpamocanikāvratāt || 1 36|| yathāpūrvaṃ tapoyukto hyabhūd babhūva vai tathā | pāpamocanikāṃ lakṣmi ye kurvanti janā bhuvi || 137|| teṣāṃ pāpaṃ tu yatkiṃcit sarvaṃ vilayatāṃ vrajet | vājapeyasahasrasya phalaṃ tasyāpi jāyate || 1 38|| bhuktirmuktirmahāmuktiḥ sarvaṃ caikavratena hi | prāpyetaitādṛśī śaktā phaladāne tviyaṃ tithiḥ || 1 39|| brahmahā hemahārī ca surāpo gurutalpagaḥ | vratasya cāsya karaṇānmukto bhavati tadvratī || 1.246.140 || paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇātkīrtanādapi | bahupuṇyapradaṃ caitad gosahasraphalapradam || 141 || kartavyaṃ sarvathā lakṣmi śāpapāpanivṛttaye | nātaḥ parataraṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ sacarācare || 142|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne caitrakṛṣṇapāpamocanyekādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ medhāvinā tapasvinā sahasravatsaraṃ bhuktāyā majjughoṣākhyāpsarāyāḥ ṛṣiśāpātpiśācītvamanugrahād vratakaraṇān muktiśceti nirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 246||
<1.247> śrīlakṣmīruvāca bhagavantaṃ vinā nātra loke tūddhārakaḥ paraḥ | vinā ca sātvatān loke na paraḥ pāvano’paraḥ || 1 || sādhūn vinā ca jīvānāṃ nāparaḥ pāpanāśakaḥ | vrataṃ vinā tathā loke nānyadbhuktipramuktidam || 2 || ekādaśīṃ vinā nānyacchāpapāpapraṇāśakam | svargadaṃ siddhidaṃ dravyaputradaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā || 3 || bhagavan śrotumicchāmi kathayasva mamāgrataḥ | caitrasya śuklapakṣīyā kiṃnāmnyekādaśī matā || 4 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca caitrasya śuklapakṣe tu kāmadā nāma nāmataḥ | ekādaśī puṇyatamā pāpendhanadavānalā || 5 || vimalākhyāpi saivoktā sarvavāñchitadāyinī | ramayā sahito viṣṇurasyāḥ patirhi pūjyate || 6 || ṣoḍaśopacārakaistu yathāvittaṃ yathāvidhi | phalaṃ cārghye cirbhaṭādi cūtapuṣpāṇi pūjane || 7 || naivedye saktavo laḍḍukāśca pakvānnamityapi | arpaṇīyaṃ viśeṣeṇa vratinā phalasiddhaye || 8 || daśamyāmekabhaktaṃ vā vratī naktaṃ vrataṃ caret | rātrau bhūśayanaṃ kuryād rakṣayed brahmacāritām || 9 || prātastvekādaśīkāle samutthāya hariṃ smaret | dhyāyecca śrīhareḥ rūpaṃ snātvā devaṃ prapūjayet || 1.247.10 || snāpayedamṛtaiḥ pañcabhirjalaistīrthasaṃbhavaiḥ | arpayedatimūlyāni vastrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca || 11 || śṛṃgārayed vastubhiḥ śrāṃgārikaiśca sugandhibhiḥ | puṣpairhāraistathā dhūpadīpanaivedyasatphalaiḥ || 12|| jalapānamukhavāsatāmbūlailālavaṃgakaiḥ | ārārtrikaiḥ stutipradakṣiṇādyaiśca prasādayet || 13|| kṣamāpayet tvavarān vai tataśca stavanaṃ caret | ekādaśyā vrataṃ kṛṣṇa karomi phalasiddhaye || 14|| kṛpayā tava tatpūrṇaṃ bhavatvavighnakaṃ mama | ityabhyarthya tato dhānyaiḥ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam || 15|| kṛtvā svarṇaghaṭaṃ tatra yadvā tāmraghaṭaṃ śubham | pañcaratnairnavapatrairjalairvastreṇa candanaiḥ || 16|| akṣataiśca phalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjanārthaṃ nyadhāpayet | tilapātraṃ ghaṭe tatra tatra mūrtiṃ harestathā || 17|| ramāyāḥ kāmadāyāśca sthāpayed vidhinā vratī | āvāhanādimantraiḥ saṃpūjayetsnāpayejjalaiḥ || 18|| pūjādravyaiḥ pūjayecca vastrābhūṣaṇahetibhiḥ | śṛṃgārayeddhariṃ viṣṇuṃ ramāṃ śāṭyādibhistathā || 19|| bhūṣāśṛṃgārakairdravyairvividhairabhibhūṣayet | yathā viṣṇuṃ tathā lakṣmīṃ bhūṣayed bahubhūṣaṇaiḥ ||1.247.20|| keśānprasādhayettailasugandhidravavastubhiḥ | dhammilaṃ racayettatra bhūṣaṇaṃ stabakaṃ tathā ||21|| catuḥsaraṃ vā dvisaraṃ keśagranthanamācaret | sūtraṃ puṣpāṇi cipiṭaṃ svarṇaśṛṃkhalikāṃ tathā ||22|| trisaraṃ granthanaṃ sarvaṃ kārayettu caturvidham | agre kuryāttu kabarīṃ sindūraṃ dāpayecchubham || 23 || lalāṭe kesaricandanadravaistilakaṃ tathā | madhye kuṃkumabindvīṃ ca bhāle kuryāt suśobhitām || 24 || yadvā madhye tilabindvīḥ pañca sūkṣmāḥ samācaret | gaṇḍayoḥ puṇḍrapārśve ca patrikāviralāṃkanāḥ || 25|| madhye sūkṣmātisūkṣmābhirbindvikābhiḥ prapūritāḥ | racayedraṃjayedbhālaṃ lakṣmīvāsamivāparam || 26|| netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ dadyāt suvarṇasya śalākayā | pāṇḍurāraktagandhāḍhyacūrṇaṃ dadyānmukhopari || 27|| rūpalāvaṇyasamabhivyañjanārthaṃ samastaram | kapole ṭibakī kuryāt raktavarṇaṃ suśobhitām || 28 || cibuke’pi tathā kuryād bindvīṃ svalpāṃ suraktakām | oṣṭhayoḥ sthalapadmasya rūpaprākaṭyahetave || 29 || raṃgaṃ dadyāttathārūpaṃ nāsikāyāṃ tu natthikām | karṇayoḥ karṇapūrādīn kuṇḍale śṛṃkhale’rpayet || 1.247.30 || suvarṇaje tvairane’pi sadratnāḍhye samarpayet | kaṇṭhe hārānsvarṇapauṣpān kaustubhādisuhīrakān || 31 || bhujayoḥ kaṭake ratnajaḍite samadhārayet | prakoṣṭhayoḥ śṛṃkhale ca baṃginīśca suvarṇajāḥ || 32 || dadyāccāṃguliṣu svarṇormikā ratnādiyojitāḥ | hastatale raṃjanārhadravyeṇa raṃjayennakhān || 33 || vakṣasi tvarpayeddivyaṃ candanaṃ stanayorapi | svarṇahārānpuṣpahārān kaṃcukīṃ stanabandhanīm || 34|| kaṭyā samarpayet ramyāṃ raśanāṃ svarṇanirmitām | śāṭikāṃ bahumūlyāṃ ca prāntasvarṇasutārakām || 35|| triraṃgīṃ netrasukhadāṃ susparśāṃ dhārayettathā | ghargharīṃ sūkṣmavastrīyāṃ raṃgarañjitacitritām || 36 || prāntaraṃgāntaravyāptasubhaṃgībhiḥ sudarśanām | dadyāttu dhāraṇārthaṃ vai naktakaṃ peśalaṃ kare || 37 || kamalākṛti sauvarṇaṃ pātraṃ sadvyajanaṃ tathā | cāmare cāpi subhage chatraṃ copānahau tathā || 38 || pādaprakoṣṭhabhūṣāśca śṛṃkhalāḥ kiṃkiṇīyutāḥ | kaḍḍalikāḥ kāmbikāścāṃgulyarthaṃ karaṭām̐stathā ||39 || datvā sapūjayellakṣmīṃ hariṃ tvekādaśīṃ ramām | ekādaśyai tathā dadyād ramāvaccopabhūṣaṇam ||1.247.40 || yathā ramā tathā tvekādaśī patnī hareḥ priyā | sarvopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ śrāṃgārikaṃ suvastukam || 41 || sarvālaṃkaraṇaṃ cāpi dadyāttasyai phalāptaye | evaṃ tu pūjanaṃ kṛtvā candanādi sugandhakam |||42|| dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalatāmbūlapānakam dadyād devāya devyai ca carennīrājanaṃ tataḥ ||43|| pradakṣiṇaṃ kṣamāyāñcāṃ stutiṃ namaskriyāṃ tataḥ | puṣpāṃjaliṃ tato dadyādevaṃ prātarvidhiṃ vratī ||44|| sarvatobhadramadhyasthaharimūrtau vidhāya ca | tato gacched gṛhaṃ naijaṃ bhajanārthaṃ japaṃ caret ||45|| madhyāhnepi tathā pūjāṃ kṛtvā naivedyamarpayet | jalaṃ tāmbūlamanyacca sarvaṃ dadyāttu pūrvavat ||46|| sāyaṃ cāpi tathā pūjāṃ kuryādārārtrikādikam | sarvaṃ sotsavamagryaṃ ca vrataṃ kuryāt supuṇyadam ||47|| rātrau tu maṇḍapaṃ kuryāt kadalīstambhaśobhitam | pallavaistoraṇaṃ kuryād dolāṃ vai bandhayet drume || 48|| āndolayeddhariṃ viṣṇuṃ vimalākāmadāyutam | naivedyaṃ jalapānādi dadyād devāya sa vratī ||49|| rātrau tu jāgaraṃ kuryād nṛtyagītamahotsavaiḥ | hariṃ prasādayet sarvārpaṇena vidhinā vratī ||1.247.50|| prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā pūjayitvā janārdanam | dānaṃ ca vividhaṃ datvā nīrājayitvā mādhavam || 51|| ārdravastraṃ bhrāmayitvā śaṃkhenottārya vai jalam | tulasīdalasaṃyuktaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ vyaṃjanādikam ||52|| bhojayitvā hariṃ viprān sādhūn sādhvīśca bālakān | visarjayitvā kuryācca vratī vai pāraṇāṃ tataḥ ||53|| evaṃ kṛtena vidhinā puṇyaṃ bhavati śāśvatam | aihikaṃ paralokotthaṃ yadicchet tadbhaved dhruvam ||54|| śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ ramyāṃ gandharvadvayamuktidām | purā nāgapure ramye hemaharmyānvite śubhe ||55|| gandharvāḥ puṇḍarīkākhyajñātayaḥ sma vasanti hi | madoddhatā mahākrūrā mahāmadabalānvitāḥ ||56|| gandharvāḥ kinnarā yakṣā vidyādhrāḥ kiṃjanāstathā | satparyo’psaraso devyaḥ kumāryaḥ sma vasanti ca ||57|| tasminpure nṛpaḥ puṇḍarīko rājyaṃ cakāra ha | nāmnā pauṃḍra iti khyātastenotsave suyojite ||58|| gandharvāḥ kinnarāḥ sūtā māgadhā bandinastathā | kiṃpuruṣā gāyakāśca vyākhyātāro’pi cāraṇāḥ ||59|| śrotrīyavargā viprāśca rājasā daivayonayaḥ | tatrotsave samāyatā gāndharvavedapaṇḍitāḥ ||1.247.60|| nṛtyaṃ pravartate tatra samāje raṃgamaṇḍape | gāyanti sma svaradhanā vādayanti ca vādakāḥ ||6 1|| nṛtyanti nartakījanāḥ paśyanti cetare janāḥ | pātālānnāgalokācca kāmarūpā bhujaṃgamāḥ ||62|| daiteyā dānavāścāpi samājagmustadutsave | te’pi devasamā rūpe bhūtvotsave vyavasthitāḥ ||6 3 || anyeṣāṃ gāyakānāṃ ca nṛtye gīte vyavasthite | nartakīnāṃ tathā nṛtye gīte nirvartite tataḥ ||64|| pauṃḍrasya rājño gandharveśvaro’tikuśalāgraṇīḥ | lalito nāma gandharvo raṃge hyavātatāra ha ||65|| lalitā nāma gandharvapatnī tu gṛhakāryataḥ | nāyātā tatra raṅge vai lalitastvekalastadā ||66|| gītaṃ gānaṃ prakurute lalito dayitā vinā | dayitāyāstadānupasthityā tu lalitaḥ khalu ||67|| pārśvahīnaśca sāhāyyarahito manasā tu tām | smaran gāyati nṛtyam̐śca vādayati yathākalam ||68|| hṛdye tasya lalitā nityaṃ vasati bhāminī | prasaṃge tu viśeṣeṇa susmṛtā sā bhavatyapi ||69|| lalitāyāstu hṛdye patirvasati nityadā | ubhau rāgeṇa saṃraktau dampatī premabandhanau ||1.247.70 || remāte sma gṛhe yadvat tat lalitena saṃsmṛtam | raṅge patnyāḥ smaraṇena vyagramānasanartakaḥ ||7 1|| pādabandhaḥ skhalajjihvo babhūva lalitāṃ smaran | pādabandhacyutirjātā jātaṃ svarāvarohaṇam ||72|| gandharvāṇāṃ sabhāmadhye hāsyapātraṃ tu so’bhavat | pauṃḍrasyāpi yaśohānistadā jātā hi tatkṣateḥ ||73|| tadā pauṃḍraḥ puṇḍarīko babhūva krodhapīḍitaḥ | śaśāpa lalitaṃ raṅge gāyanta ca smarāturam ||74|| rākṣaso bhava durbuddhe kravyādaḥ puruṣādanaḥ | yataḥ patnīṃ smaram̐ścātra gāyamāno mahotsave ||75|| samāje’navadhānāt tvaṃ kalāyāṃ kṣatimāptavān | hāsyapātraṃ tvaṃ tathāhaṃ samājena kṛtāvubhau ||76|| tasmāttvaṃ rākṣaso bhūtvā duḥkhaṃ paśya ciraṃ samāḥ | iti pauṃḍrasya vacanād rakṣārūpo babhūva saḥ ||77|| raudrānano virūpākṣo dṛṣṭamātro bhayaṃkaraḥ | bahuyojanavistīrṇo mukhe kandarasannibhaḥ ||78|| sūryadvayanibho netre grīvāyāṃ parvatopamaḥ | nāsāyāṃ parvatamālānibho randhre guhāsamaḥ ||79|| oṣṭhayorgavyūtikalpa ucchrāye yojanadvayam | īdṛśo rākṣaso bhūtvā bhuṃjānaḥ karmaṇaḥ phalam ||1.247.80 || yayau gṛhaṃ ca lalitā svakāntaṃ vikṛtākṛtim | ālokya cintayāmāsa patiduḥkhena duḥkhitā ||8 1 || kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi patiḥ pāpena pīḍitaḥ | jñātvā sarvaṃ tu vṛttāntaṃ patisevāparāyaṇā ||82|| cacāra patinā sārdhaṃ lalitā gahane vane | pūrvaṃ saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya manasā śarma nālabhat ||83|| babhrāma vipine durge kāmarūpadharāpi sā | kāmarūpadhareṇāpi patinā saha sarvadā ||84|| lalito vipine durge kāmarūpī bhavannapi | nirghṛṇaḥ pāpanirato virūpaḥ puruṣādakaḥ ||85|| na sukhaṃ labhate rātrau na divā pāpapīḍitaḥ | lalitā duḥkhitātīva patiṃ dṛṣṭvātiduḥkhinam ||86|| babhrāma tena sārdhaṃ sā kṣuttṛṣādyatimarditāḥ | patirvai rākṣasarūpaḥ patnī gandharvarūpiṇī ||87|| vicitraṃ tu tayoryogaṃ dṛṣṭvā vai vanavāsinaḥ | āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpurbhītāśca dudruvuḥ sthalāt|||88|| atha śātātapamunerāśramaṃ tāvavāpatuḥ | śīghraṃ jagāma lalitā namaskṛtyāgrataḥ sthitā ||89|| dayāluḥ sa muniḥ prāha kā tvaṃ kasmādupasthitā | lalitovāca gāndharvī vīradhanvasutāsmyaham ||1.247.90|| lalitānāma me tvasti patyarthamiha cāgatā | bhartā me lalitaprakhyaḥ pauṃḍraśāpena rākṣasaḥ ||9 1|| bhūtvā bhramatyaraṇye’smin dṛṣṭvā taṃ nāsti me sukham | yena puṇyena me svāmī rākṣasatvādvimucyate ||92|| tādṛśaṃ puṇyakṛtyaṃ me śādhi śātātapa prabho | śrutvā śātātapaḥ prāha śāpapāpaharā śubhā ||93|| kāmadaikādaśī caitraśuklasya puṇyasaukhyadā | vrataṃ tasyā vidhānena kuru tvaṃ bhāmini dhruvam ||94|| bhaviṣyati phalaṃ puṇyaṃ tat svabhartre pradīyatām | datte puṇye kṣaṇāttasya śāpadoṣaḥ prayāsyati ||95|| śātātapamunervākyaṃ śrutvā sā harṣitābhavat | tatrāśrame’vasaccaikādaśīpratīkṣaṇāya sā ||96|| patistasyā vane tatrābhito vasati nityadā | kāmadaikādaśī prāptā nirjalā samupoṣitā ||97|| jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtaṃ rātrau dvādaśyāṃ prātareva ca | śātātapasya nikaṭe harermūrteśca sannidhau ||98|| vākyamuvāca lalitā svapatyustāraṇāya vai | mayā tvetadvrataṃ cīrṇaṃ kāmadāyā upoṣaṇam ||99|| tasya puṇyaprabhāveṇa naśyatvasya piśācatā | lalitāvacanāttasmin kṣaṇe eva piśācatā || 1.247.10 0|| gatā rākṣasatā tasya jātā gandharvatā punaḥ | gatapāpaḥ sa lalito divyadeho babhūva ha || 101 || svarṇaratnasamākīrṇo reme lalitayā saha | tau vimānasamārūḍhau pūrvarūpādhikau śubhau || 102|| dampatī cānyaśobhetāṃ gatau nāgapuraṃ hyubhau | kāmadāyā vratajanyapuṇyenaivaṃ piśācatā || 1 03|| vinaṣṭā śāpanāśaśca svasvarūpasamāgamaḥ | iti jñātvā mahālakṣmi kartavyaiṣātibhāvataḥ || 104|| vrahmahatyādipāpaghnī piśācatvavināśinī | paṭhanāchravaṇāccāpi vājapeyaphalapradā || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne caitraśuklakāmadaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ lalitalalitāgandharvayoḥ pauṃḍrasya śāpena jātasya piśācatvasya vratena muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ |||247||
<1.248> śrīlakṣmīruvāca mokṣadātarhare kṛṣṇa janoddhārakara prabho | pāpināṃ śāpināṃ cāpi śāpināṃ pāpanāśaka || 1 || bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyaṃ tvayā pradarśitaṃ vratam | śrutvā śrutvā praharṣāmi śravaṇe jāyate ruciḥ || 2 || vada nātha kṛpāsindho vaiśākhakṛṣṇapakṣake | kiṃnāmnyekādaśī tasyāḥ ko devaḥ ko vidhistathā || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca saubhāgyadāyinī putrapautrasampatpradāyinī | atra paratra sukhadā smṛddhidā pāpanāśinī || 4 || vaiśākhakṛṣṇapakṣīyā nāmnā cāsti varūthanī | tasyā vratena vratinaḥ saukhyaṃ bhavati sarvathā || 5 || pāpahāniśca bhavati saubhāgyaprāptirityapi | durbhagāpi vratakartrī sarvasaubhāgyamāpnuyāt || 6 || vratināṃ tvatra sarveṣāṃ bhuktimuktipradāyinī | sarvapāpaharā puṇyapradā janmaharā śubhā || 7 || vāsanānāśinī nityānandamuktipradāyinī | śāśvatyāśca sthiterdātrī kartavyā vratinā hi sā || 8 || māndhātṛdhundhumārādyā vratinaḥ svargatiṃ gatāḥ | nandayā sahitaḥ śaktyā tvatrārcyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 9 || jātiphalādi pūjāyāṃ naivedye vaṭakāḥ śubhāḥ | campakādini puṣpāṇi kundasya kalikāstathā || 1.248.10|| sthalapadmāni deyāni deyaṃ dānaṃ bhuvastathā | anyatsvaśaktyā kartavyaṃ vratinā pūrṇabhāvataḥ || 11 || daśamyāmekabhaktaṃ vā naktaṃ bhuktvātha bhūśayaḥ | brahmacārī bhaveccaiva prātaḥ smareddhariṃ vrate || 12|| kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ masūrām̐śca caṇakān kodravām̐stathā | śākaṃ madhu parānnaṃ ca punarbhojanamaithune || 13 || vaiṣṇavo vratakartā ca daśamyāṃ daśa varjayet | dyūtakrīḍāṃ ca nidrāṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ dantadhāvanam || 14|| parāpavādapaiśūnye steyaṃ hiṃsāṃ tathā ratim | krodhaṃ tvanṛtavākyāni hyekādaśyāṃ vivarjayet || 15|| kāṃsyaṃ māsaṃ surāṃ kṣaudraṃ tailaṃ patitabhāṣaṇam | vyāyāmaṃ ca pravāsaṃ ca punarbhojanamaithune || 16|| tāmasānnaṃ masūrānnaṃ dvādaśyāṃ parivarjayet | ekādaśyāṃ vratī prātaḥ snātvā śrīpuruṣottamam || 17|| pūjayennūtanadravyaiḥ ṣoḍaśottamavastubhiḥ | āvāhanādikaṃ kuryāt pañcāmṛtavilepanam || 18|| śuddhatīrthodakasnānaṃ vastrābhūṣaṇadhāraṇam | śrāṃgārikadravādeśca dānaṃ kajjalakāṃjanam || 1 9|| kuṃkumādimāṃgalikabhūrṇatilakacandrakam | gucchaṃ pauṣpaṃ tathā hārān pauṣpāṃśca śekharādikān ||1.248.20|| arpayeddharaye tatra dhūpadīpādi kārayet | nīrājayitvā natvā ca pradakṣiṇaṃ vidhāya ca ||2 1|| stutvā kṣamāpayitvā vai puṣpāṃjaliṃ samarpayet | evaṃ prātaḥ pūjayitvā mahāpūjanamācaret ||22|| kṛtvā dhānyaiḥ sarvatobhadrākhyaṃ vai maṇḍalaṃ śubham | kadalīmaṇḍape yadvā śubhe śrīkṛṣṇamandire ||23|| maṇḍale madhyadeśe ca pañcaratnasupallavam | jalacandanatandulapuṣpaphalasamanvitam ||24|| svarṇajaṃ tāmrajaṃ yadvā kalaśaṃ sthāpayennavam | tatra ghaṭe tilasthālīṃ sthāpayet pūritāṃ navām ||25|| puruṣottamamūrtiṃ ca nandayā sahitāṃ tathā | varūthinyā ca sahitāṃ sthāpayet tilamaṇḍale ||26|| pūjayedvidhinā tāṃ ca candanādibhirarcayet | āvāhanādi kuryācca pañcāmṛtābhiṣecanam || 27|| tīrthajalaistathā snānārpaṇaṃ bhūṣāmbarārpaṇam | saśṛṅgārālaṃkaraṇaṃ sugandhitailakārpaṇam || 28 || candanādyarpaṇaṃ puṃḍrakajjalakuṃkumārpaṇam | puṣparatnādimālādyarpaṇaṃ naivedyakārpaṇam ||29|| jalatāmbūlamiṣṭāgryaphalādyarpaṇamityapi | nīrājanaṃ namaskārān pradakṣiṇaṃ kṣamārthanam || 1.248.30 || prakuryācca vratasiddhyai prārthanāṃ vighnanāśinīm | dānaṃ śayyāgendukādivastūnāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ parām || 31 || dadyāccaiva samāpyaiva bhaktikāryaṃ tataścaret | madhyāhnepi vidhinaivaṃ pūjayedbhojayeddharim || 3 2|| hariṃ sāyaṃ pūjayitvā samārārtrikamācaret | bhojayejjalapānādi kārayejjāgaraṃ tathā ||3 3 || nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ vādanaṃ ca kathāṃ kuryācca kīrtanam | prātarvicintya lakṣmīśaṃ pūjanaṃ ca tataścaret || 34|| aśvadānaṃ gajadānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ tilārpaṇam | svarṇadānaṃ tvannadānaṃ kanyādānaṃ gavārpaṇam || 35|| jñānadānaṃ tathā dadyād dānaṃ tvabhayasaṃjñakam | evaṃ varūthinīṃ kāryā vāñchitārthapradāyinīm | 3 6|| daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tapastapati yo naraḥ | tattulyaṃ phalamāpnoti varūthinyā vratānnaraḥ || 37|| sarvadānaphalaṃ vratyāpnoti kṛtvā varūthinīm | lakṣmi pūrve kṛtayuge kathā jātātipāvanī || 38|| yāṃ śrutvā tu varūthinyā māhātmyaṃ jñāyate mahat | varūtho nāma vipraṣirbrahmaṇo mānasaḥ sutaḥ || 39 || viṃśatinyūnavarṣīyo vedādyadhyayanavrataḥ | gurusevāparaḥ śuddho marīcerāśrame vasan ||1.248.40 || nirmāno nirahaṃkāraḥ svacchamānasadarpaṇaḥ | brahmadhyānarato nityaṃ gururbrahmetipūjakaḥ ||4 1 || gurorvākyaṃ vedavākyaṃ vedo gurumukhodgatam | gururviṣṇurgururbrahma gururvedo vidhirguruḥ ||42|| gururdharmo gururmuktirgururjñānaṃ gururmakhaḥ | gurureva parabrahma gurvājñā baidikī śrutiḥ ||43 || yena kena prakāreṇa toṣaṇīyo gururyataḥ | gurau tuṣṭe brahma tuṣṭaṃ nāsti kaścid guroḥ paraḥ ||44|| brahmatattvaṃ gurustvasti nāsti tattvaṃ guroḥ param | gurorājñā paro dharmo gurvājñā svargamatra hi ||45 || gurvājñā lokadharmaśca dharmaśca pāralaukikaḥ | nānyaḥ kaścitparo dharma iti matvātibhāvataḥ ||46|| gurubhakto’bhavacchreṣṭho guroḥ sevāṃ karoti ca | yathā yathā gururvadet tathā tathā karoti saḥ ||47|| gurukaiṃkaryavṛttyaiva vartate sukhapūrvakam | marīceḥ sevayā nityamānandena pariplutaḥ || 48|| vartate brahmasaṃsthaḥ saḥ śarīrabhānavarjitaḥ | ātmārāmo’bhavat so’yaṃ gurorgehe vasan dvijaḥ || 49|| guroḥ sevāṃ guroḥ patnyāḥ kalāyāḥ sevanaṃ tathā | karotyabhinnabhāvena gurureva tu sā tviti ||1.248.5 0 || kalā marīcapatnī tu marīcārdhāṃganā hi sā | gurutvaṃ ca dvayorasti kalāyāṃ ca marīcake ||5 1 || dampatyorgṛhasevā ca mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ tathā | jalāharaṇaṃ pūjopakaraṇāharaṇaṃ tathā ||52 || pādasaṃvāhanaṃ bhojanottaraṃ pātramañjanam | śayyāvitānakaraṇaṃ śayyāsaṃharaṇaṃ tathā ||53 || vastraprakṣālanaṃ keśaprasādhanaṃ ca kajjalam | netrayoraṃjanaṃ hastatalālaktakaraṃjanam || 54|| tailena mardanaṃ dehe jalena snāpanaṃ tathā | vastreṇa mārjanaṃ cāpi sugandhārpaṇamityapi ||55|| vastrapuṣpavibhūṣādisaṃprasādhanamanvaham || dampatyoḥ prakarotyeva saguṇabrahmabhāvataḥ |||56|| dehaṃ na manute so’yaṃ tvātmānaṃ manute’tra hi | dehānyadātmano rūpaṃ nirvikāraṃ niraṃjanam ||57|| pāpapuṇyavihīnaṃ tadātmarūpaṃ nirāmayam | pāpena badhyate nātmā pāpena lipyate na ca ||58 || gurorbhaktiḥ paraṃ puṇyaṃ nānyatpuṇyamataḥ param | guruṃ vihāya nānyasya pūjanaṃ dhyānameva vā || 59|| karoti sa kadācidvai tṛptiṃ matvā gurau sadā | mūrtiṃ na manute viṣṇoḥ pūjanaṃ na karoti ca || 1.248.60 || naivedyaṃ viṣṇave naivārpayatyeṣo jalaṃ na ca | na ṣoḍaśopacārādyairarcayatyacyutaṃ harim || 61 || aprasādaṃ samaśnāti pibatyanarpitaṃ jalam | valkalaṃ kandapuṣpādi gṛhṇātyanarpitaṃ svayam ||62 || haryanarpitabhogena buddhiḥ kaluṣatāṃ gatā | rajobhāvena saṃvyāptābhavad bhogānugāminī ||63 || haryanarpitamannādi tvabhakṣyaṃ sarvamucyate | abhakṣyabhakṣaṇāccāsya jātā dehātmabhāvanā || 64|| deharūpo’bhavaccāyaṃ hīndriyārāmasadṛśaḥ | indriyaṃ balavaccāsya jātaṃ dehātmavādinaḥ ||65|| nāstikyaṃ yauvanaṃ guroḥ patnyāḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ tathā | nityayogād gamayanti smarajvarātitāpanam ||66|| tathāpi saṃyamaṃ so’pi rakṣati mānasād balāt | evaṃ bahutithe kāle yāte saptarṣayaḥ khalu ||67|| śaṃkarasya vivāhārthaṃ dakṣaputryā samaṃ tadā | brahmaṇā saṃsmṛtāḥ satye loke te brahmaparṣati ||68|| yayustadā varūthaṃ tu marīciḥ prāha putraka | yathā madvacajaṃ samyak pālyate kriyate tathā ||69|| kalāyāśca vacaḥ pālyaṃ kartavyaṃ sā yathā vadet | madgṛhaṃ sarvathā rakṣyaṃ tvayā śiṣya yathā mayā ||1.248.70|| ājñāṃ datvā yayau brahmasabhāṃ prati marīcikaḥ | brahmaṇā preṣitā saptarṣayo dakṣagṛhaṃ prati ||71 || satyāstu śaṃbhunā yoge vākpradānavinirṇaye | yayuḥ sthitāḥ punaḥ satyaṃ cāyayuśca punaryayuḥ ||72|| evaṃ bahutithaḥ kālo vyatītastatra nirṇaye | kalāpi cātituṣṭābhūd varūthasya prasevayā ||73|| varūthasya sahayogātsevane dehamardane | pādasaṃvāhane caikaśayyāsanasuvartane ||74|| rajobhāvena saṃsaktābhavadvarūthavarṣmaṇi | yuvānaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ prāpya tvekāntagṛhasevayā ||75|| prahvībhūya kalā prāha varūtha bhaja māmiha | smaratāpena saṃdagdhā śāntiṃ cārpaya me’nagha ||76|| varūtho’pi gurorvākyaṃ manvānaśca kalāvacaḥ | rājasībhāvajāyuktaḥ siṣeve tāṃ kalāṃ rahaḥ ||77|| kāmakārye vinirvṛtte śāntirjātā tayoryadā | kalāśīrvacanānyāha svargaṃ te tvakṣayaṃ bhavet ||78|| evaṃ kāmabalenaitau bhoginau kāmanānvitau | remāte kāmabhāvena marīcervacanāśrayāt ||79|| tāvatkāryaṃ harasyārthe kṛtvā saptarṣayo gṛham | yayustadā marīciścāyayau svasyāśramaṃ śubham ||1.248.80|| marīcervartamānena varūthaśca kalā tathā | maryādayā hi vartete kāmanāvarjitāvubhau ||8 1 || tathāpi gurupatnyāśca varūthasya ca bhālayoḥ | āyurekhābhavatpūrvaṃ pūrṇā yā sā kṣatiṃ gatā ||82|| vicchinnābhūt paridṛṣṭā pratyakṣeṇa marīcinā | marīciḥ prāha tau tatra kathaṃ tvāyuḥ kṣayaṃ gatam ||83|| prāhatustau yathā tathyaṃ marīcirvismayaṃ gataḥ | akṛtaṃ tu kṛtaṃ hyābhyāṃ kṛtaṃ vai vacanānmama ||84|| nirdoṣaṃ tad gurorbhaktakṛte vākyaṃ guroḥ sadā | anena pālitaṃ vākyaṃ madīyaṃ kintu hānidam ||85|| brahmasvaharaṇaṃ gurutalpagāmitvamityapi | viśvāsaghātitā kṛtaghnatā hyāyurvināśakāḥ ||86|| ābhyāṃ kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ tattu mayā kāryaṃ śubhaṃ tayoḥ | yāvadevaṃ cintayati tāvad yamasya sevakāḥ ||87|| āyayustau samānetuṃ purīṃ yāmyāṃ prati dhruvam | marīcistatra nāvocad yāmyā nītvā yayurdrutam ||88|| marīciranuyātaśca tadā tanaiva varṣmaṇā | dūtaistau dharmarājasya purataḥ saṃkṛtāvubhau ||89|| daṇḍaśca taptalohasya sūrmyā yogo’nayoḥ kṛtaḥ | marīciḥ prāha dharmeśaṃ tvayā yogyaṃ kṛtaṃ vibho ||1.248.90 || kintu madvacanātsarvaṃ kṛtaṃ doṣo na vai tayoḥ | duṣṭaṃ yadi gurorvākyaṃ doṣapātraṃ bhavāmyaham ||9 1 || yamasmṛtau tathā coktaṃ gurorvākyaṃ na doṣakṛt | yamavākyaṃ tu cetsatyaṃ mamavākyaṃ na doṣakṛt || 92||| mama vākyena saṃsaktau kathaṃ tau doṣasaṃyutau | tasmānnaitau daṇḍapātre yathecchasi tathā kuru ||93|| yāvadetau na muñcethāstāvannaiva jalādikam | gṛhṇāmyatra tavātithyaṃ yathecchasi tathā kuru ||94|| dharmastu pitṛvṛddhasya marīcervacanaṃ tadā | śrutvā vicārayāmāsa naṣṭaṃ tvāyurvikarmaṇā ||95|| sandhīyetānayoḥ kenopāyena prabalena tu | madvākyaṃ ca gurorvākyaṃ supramāṇaṃ bhavettathā ||96|| kiṃ kartavyaṃ mama tvatra viruddhe viṣaye khalu | yadi vākyaṃ pramāṇaṃ me naitau daṇḍārhaṇau tadā ||97|| yadi daṇḍārhaṇau tvetau nāsmadvākyapramāṇatā | tasmāt kimatra kartavyaṃ tvāyuḥsandhānakarmaṇi ||98|| varūthena tadā tatra saṃkalpitaṃ gurorbalam | yadyahaṃ gurubhakto’smi gurvājñāṃ prakaromi ca || 99|| tadā gurvātmakaḥ kṛṣṇo gurorvākyāt prarakṣatu | smaratyevaṃ tu yāvat saḥ varūtho gururūpiṇam || 1.248.10 0|| hariṃ tāvattadā tatra vyomavāṇī babhūva ha | dharmarāja śṛṇu tvaitau nirjalau nāptabhojanau || 10 1|| marīciścāpyannajalavihīno vartate’dya vai | gururūpo’smyahaṃ cāpi guruṃ tau smarato yataḥ || 102||| etairmadāśrayaṃ manye kṛtaṃ tvekādaśīvratam | kalāvarūthayorāyūrekhā pūrṇādya jāyatām || 1 03|| varūthasyoddharaṇena nāmnā tvekādaśī tvapi | varūthinī prasiddhāstu varūthoddhārakāriṇī || 1 04|| kalāyuṣaḥ pratisandhānena saṃjīvanī tu sā | ānandapradayā vyomavāṇyā hyānanditā hyapi || 1 05|| nandayā sahitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svāmyasyāḥ saṃbhavāmi ca | nandayā sahitaṃ māṃ tu ye’rcayiṣyanti mānavāḥ || 106 || gurudāraratāścāpi bhaviṣyanti hi pāvanāḥ | śiṣyaratiprakartryaśca śuddhiṃ yāsyanti yoṣitaḥ || 1 07|| varūthinyā vratinaśca niṣpāpā vai narāḥ striyaḥ | cirāyuṣkā bhaviṣyanti naṣṭāyuṣo’pi madbalāt || 1 08|| paradravyaharā ye ca paradāraprasaṃginaḥ | varūthinīvratapūtā bhaviṣyanti dyuvāsinaḥ || 1 09|| yamarājabhayaṃ teṣāṃ na syānnāyurvināśanam | na vaidhavyaṃ na vai duḥkhaṃ vidhuratvaṃ na vā bhavet || 1.248.11 0|| sūryaputrādatibhīto janaḥ kuryād varūthinīm | sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prayāti paramāṃ gatim || 111 || tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kartavyā pāpabhīrubhiḥ | śravaṇāt paṭhanāttvasyā gosahasraphalaṃ bhavet || 112|| ajñānācca haṭhāccāpi varūthinyā vrataṃ caret | sarvapāpavinirmuktaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ nayāmyaham || 113 || tasmādetau pramuñca tvaṃ yamarāja varūthakam | kalāṃ cātharṣivaryaṃ ca marīciṃ tvatithiṃ kuru || 1 14|| satkāraṃ kuru datvaiva patnīṃ śiṣyaṃ sukhī bhava | anyathā vratapuṇyena śāpaṃ dāsyati cedṛṣiḥ || 1 15|| bhasmībhūtaṃ tu te sarvaṃ sthalaṃ yāmyaṃ bhaviṣyati | varūthinyā vratakarturgṛhaṃ mā yāntu te carāḥ || 116 || varūthinīdine copoṣitāraṃ cāpyamānakam | mā prayāntu ca te dūtā yato me vratakṛddhi saḥ || 1 17|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau vyomavāṇī harikṛtā | yamarājo’pi tau pūrṇāyuṣau dṛṣṭvā mumoca ha || 1 18|| nirdoṣau guruvākyasthau doṣāliptau kalāruthau | marīcinā samaṃ yātau nijāvāsaṃ yamālayāt || 119 | evaṃ te kathito lakṣmi varūthinīvratotsavaḥ | kṛtvā śrutvā paṭhitvā taṃ viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 1.248.120 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vaiśākhakṛṣṇavarūthinyekādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ marīceḥ patnyāḥ kalāyāḥ varūthena śiṣyeṇa gurupatnīvākyabhaktena saṃgadoṣe’pi vratena taduddharaṇādītinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 248||
<1.249> śrīlakṣmīruvāca bhagavan devadeveśa bhaktānāmabhayaṃkara | āyuḥpradaṃ vrataṃ samyak śrāvitaṃ bhavatā vibho || 1 || śrutvā varūthaviprasya mahāpātakanāśanam | prasannaṃ jāyate cetaḥ kṛpāsāgara keśava || 2 || vaiśākhaśuklapakṣe tu kiṃ nāmnyekādaśī matā | kiṃ phalaṃ ko vidhistatra ko devo vada mādhava || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca padmaje kathayiṣyāmi lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā | pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ yadvratānāmuttamaṃ vratam || 4 || vaiśākhasyārjune pakṣe nāmato mohinī tu sā | bhavedekādaśī lakṣmi sarvapātakanāśinī || 5 || pāpajālāni naśyanti moho naśyati tadvratāt | mahāduḥkhāni naśyanti sukhaṃ bhavati tadvratāt || 6 || yasyāḥ kartavyatābhāvādapi pāpaṃ vinaśyati | daśamyāmekabhaktena naktenāpi vratārthinā || 7 || vartitavyaṃ tathā rātrau brahmacaryavratena ca | prātarutthāya kṛṣṇaśca smartavyo vratinā sadā || 8 || snātvā hariḥ supūjyaśca pūjanīyo vratārthinā | nityavidhyanusāreṇa vratārthaṃ prārthanāṃ kriyāt || 9 || adyāhaṃ devadeveśa kariṣye vratamacyuta | tavānugrahaleśena saṃpūrṇaṃ tadbhavediti || 1.249.10 || evaṃ tu pūjanaṃ nityatayā prāptaṃ samāpya ca | kārayet sarvatobhadramaṇḍalaṃ taṇḍulādibhiḥ || 11 || tanmadhye sughaṭaḥ sthāpyaḥ suvarṇasyātha vā navaḥ | tāmrajaḥ sajalaḥ pañcaratnayuk pañcapallavaḥ || 1 2|| vastraveṣṭitakaṇṭhaśca candanākṣatapūjitaḥ | phalaṃ nyasyennārikelaṃ pārśve tasyāntarābbhṛtam || 13 || nyasyenmukhopari ramyāṃ sthālīṃ tilaprapūritām | tatra nyasyet svarṇarūpyatāmradravyaṃ ca śarkarām || 14|| kārayitvā kanakasya mūrtiṃ tvekādaśīpateḥ | madhusūdanadevasya mādhavyā saha śobhitām || 15|| mohinyā ca yutāṃ tatra sthālyāṃ vai sthāpayettu tām | svarganiḥśreṇikāṃ kūpyamayīṃ nyasyetprapūjayet || 1 6|| svastikaṃ brahmasūtraṃ ca candrakaṃ tilakaṃ tathā | svarṇaraupyaṃ kārayitvā ghaṭapārśve nidhāpayet || 17|| phalāni vividhānyeva pūgīphalādikāni ca | elālavaṃgatvaksārajātīphalāni cūrṇakam || 18 || śarkarāṃ gūḍadhānādīn navavastūni dāpayet | paryaṃkaṃ gendukaṃ guptadorakaṃ pārśvakaṃ tathā || 1 9|| darpaṇaṃ vyajanaṃ chatraṃ cāmaraṃ yaṣṭikāṃ śubhām | pāduke keśasaṃskartrīṃ sugandhadravyasaṃyutām || 1.249.20 || sajalaṃ mṛdghaṭaṃ navyaṃ pakvānyāmraphalāni ca | vinyasyet pūjanaṃ kuryād vidhinā vratakārakaḥ || 21 || puṣpeṣu mallikāṃ dadyānnaivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ śubham | arghyaṃ phalaṃ tu panasaṃ śayyādānaṃ samuttamam || 22|| prathamaṃ tilapātre taṃ madhusūdanamacyutam | āvāhayet tato dadyādāsanaṃ cottamottamam || 23 || pādaprakṣālanavāri tathārcanajalaṃ śubham | ācamanārthe salilaṃ dadyād devāya bhāvataḥ || 24|| dantadhāvanamārdraṃ ca dadyāccūrṇaṃ sugandhavat | mukhaprakṣālanaṃ tasya kārayet tīrthavāriṇā || 25 || śaucādikalpayeddhastapādaśuddhiṃ prakalpayet | paṃcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayecca śuddhodakena tatparam || 26 || vastrairāmārjanaṃ kuryāt suvastrāṇi samarpayet | dhautraṃ sūkṣma śubhaṃ prāvaraṇaṃ śvetaṃ navaṃ tathā || 27|| arpayeccandanaṃ tailaṃ sugandhaṃ dravyamattaram | gandhasāraṃ maṇiṃ brahmasūtraṃ ca kajjalādikam || 28 || kuṃkumaṃ tvarpayeccābīraṃ gulālaṃ śubhākṣatān | puṣpāṇi kundakalikārūpāṇi puṣpamālikāḥ || 29|| vibhūṣaṇāni sarvāṇi śṛṃgāradravyamuttamam | alaṃkārāṇi ramyāṇi tvarpayeddharaye tadā || 1.249.30 || tilakaṃ candrakaṃ bhāle kārayeccandanena vai | lepayeccābhito varṣmaṇi vratī hṛdayādike || 31 || dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ dadyānmiṣṭānnamuttamam | śārkaraṃ dadhisāraṃ śrīkhaṇḍaṃ dadyāttu pūrikāḥ || 32|| śārkaraṃ śītasalilaṃ phalaṃ cāmraṃ ca bīṭikām | nāgavallīparṇakṛtāṃ dadyāttvanyattu yat kṛtam || 33 || ārārtrikaṃ namaskāraṃ stutiṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ tathā | daṇḍavacca kṣamāyāñcāṃ phalapūrṇatvayācanām || 34 || puṣpāñjaliṃ dakṣiṇāṃ ca dadyāt paścād visarjayet | kuryāccāvaśyakaṃ kāryaṃ vratī bhaktyātmakaṃ tadā || 35 || madhyāhne pūjayet kṛṣṇaṃ bhojanaṃ kārayed bahu | ṣaṭpaṃcāśatprabhogām̐śca dadyādarthānvitastadā || 36 || jalapānaṃ pradadyācca tāmbūlaṃ mukhaśodhakam | dadyācca taṃ namaskṛtya vratī bhaktyādikaṃ caret || 37|| sāyaṃ cārārtrikaṃ kuryānnaivedyaṃ ca jalārpaṇam | maṇḍapaṃ kadalīstaṃbhaiḥ kārayed bandhayecca saḥ || 38 || preṃkhāṃ suśobhitāṃ ramyāṃ navapallavatoraṇām | āndolayeddhariṃ tatra sthāpayitvā svayaṃ vratī || 39 || pūjanaṃ ṣoḍaśavastūttamairnirvartayedvratī | rātrau bhaktiyutaṃ kālaṃ bhaktaiḥ saha tu yāpayet ||1.249.40 || evaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānmahotsavapuraḥsaram | nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ gītiṃ tālamānādisaṃyutām ||4 1 || smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ cāpi kathākhyānāni kārayet | gāpayet kṛṣṇapadyāni narā nāryaśca sarvathā ||42|| harikīrtanayuktāśca kuryurjāgaraṇaṃ tathā | prātaḥ smareddhariṃ snātvā punaḥ pūjanamācaret ||43 || vratī dānāni dadyācca gurave’tisubhāvataḥ | bhojayed brāhmaṇān sādhūn sādhvīrbālām̐ca pūjayet ||44|| dīnān kṛpaṇān bālikāśca parādhīnām̐śca bhojayet | āśritān karmacārām̐śca pramadāśca kuṭumbinaḥ ||45|| pūjyām̐śca bhojayenmiṣṭaṃ mātṛm̐śca janakām̐stathā | vṛddhām̐śca bhojayennamrabhāvanāṃ ca pradarśayet ||46|| tato vratī svayaṃ kuryātpāraṇāṃ tu hariṃ smaran | śayyādānaṃ gajavājigodānaṃ bhūgṛhārpaṇam ||47|| susatpātre prakuryāttu yānavāhadhanārpaṇam | evaṃ vratī vrataṃ kurvannāpnoti paramaṃ padam ||48 || śāśvataṃ ca sukhaṃ svarge yatheṣṭaṃ kṛpayā hareḥ | śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ pūrvabhavāṃ vaiśyasya pāvanīm ||49|| saurāṣṭre tu sarasvatyāḥ prācyā nātividūrake | uttare tu pradeśe vai bhadrāvatyāstu dakṣiṇe ||1.249.5 0 || bhāṇḍīrākhyanagaryāṃ vai dhṛtisiṃho’bhavannṛpaḥ | tasya śreṣṭhī dhanapālo hyabhavaddhanaśevadhiḥ ||5 1 || dhanapālaḥ sadā khyātaḥ puṇyakāryapravartane | prapākūpamaṭhārāmataḍāgagṛhakārakaḥ ||52|| viṣṇubhaktaḥ sādhusevī paropakṛtisadvrataḥ | kathāśravaṇasuśraddhaḥ sarvadā bhaktitatparaḥ ||53|| putrāstasyābhavan pañca śreṣṭhino dhanaśālinaḥ | sumanā dyutimām̐ścaiva medhāvī sukṛtistathā ||54|| catvāraḥ puṇyapātrāṇi pañcamaścātipāpakṛt | dhṛṣṭabuddhiriti khyātaḥ parastrīsaṃgasaṃrataḥ |||55||| dyūtādivyasanāsakto vārastrīratikārakaḥ | devapūjāvihīnaśca pitṛtarpaṇanāstikaḥ ||56|| dvijānāṃ nindako vedanindako nyāyavarjitaḥ | duṣṭātmā svapiturdravyanāśako madirāpibaḥ ||57|| abhakṣyabhakṣaka pāpī sarvasampatkṣayaṃkaraḥ | cauryādikarmanirato duṣṭasaṃgo hyakarmakṛt ||58|| pitrā catuṣpathe dṛṣṭo veśyāskandhasthahastakaḥ | pāpācārarataścaivaṃ vijñāto bandhubhistataḥ ||59|| pitrā niṣkāsito gehād bāndhavaiśca vivāsitaḥ | dāyabhāgena yatkiṃcillabdhaṃ nirvāhakaṃ dhanam ||1.249.60 || sarvaṃ nītaṃ kṣayaṃ tena veśyāsaṃgena nityadā | ābhūṣaṇāni pātrāṇi vastrāṇyupaskarāṇi ca ||61 || kṣayaṃ nītāni tenaiva gaṇikāsaṃgakāriṇā | dhanahīnaḥ parityakto gaṇikābhistataḥ sa tu ||62|| cintāturobhavad vastradhanahīnaḥ kṣudhārditaḥ | kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi jīvanopāyavarjitaḥ ||63|| tasmāt kāryaṃ taskaratvaṃ cauryaṃ kāryaṃ prasahya ca | luṇṭhanāpaharaṇe ca kṛtvā jīvāmi nānyathā ||64|| evaṃ balāpaharaṇaṃ karoti vanage pathi | pitustu nagare rātrau taskaratvaṃ karoti ca ||65|| surāṃ pibati nityaṃ sa māṃsaṃ khādati nityadā | cauryaṃ nityaṃ karotyeva puṃścalīsaṃgatiṃ gataḥ ||66|| rātrau cauryaṃ suvarṇasya kṛtaṃ tena tu tatkṣaṇe | rājadūtairdhṛto rātrau kintu svarṇaṃ dhanaṃ tadā ||67|| luṃcārūpaṃ rājadūtebhyo’rpayitvā vibandhanaḥ | muktiṃ prāpya gato’raṇye punaścauryaṃ cakāra saḥ ||68|| punardhṛto rājadūto punarluṃcāpradānataḥ | bandhanānmuktimāsādya gato’raṇyaṃ punastathā ||69|| punaścauryaṃ samārebhe dhanāpaharaṇaṃ tathā | janānāmardanaṃ cakre saṃghānāṃ luṇṭanaṃ tathā ||1.249.70|| punaśca nagare caurye kartuṃ rātrau yayau tadā | manuṣyaiḥ sa durācāro nibaddho raśmibhirdṛḍhaiḥ ||7 1 || nigaḍairdaṇḍito rājñā kaśāghātaiśca tāḍitaḥ | kārāgāraṃ yathādaṇḍaṃ kṣapayitvā punarhi saḥ ||72 || nirbandho vanamāsādya bhojanārthaṃ pradhāvati | siṃhavadghātayatyugro mṛgaśūkaravānarān ||73 || āmiṣāhāranirato vane bhramati sarvathā | kare dhanuḥ samāgṛhya dhṛtvā pṛṣṭhe niṣaṃgakam ||74|| āraṇyakān paśūn patatriṇo hanti padā caran | cakravākānkapotām̐śca pārāvatām̐śca tittirān ||75|| kukkuṭān sārasān hanti mayūrānmūṣakānapi | varāhān gavayām̐ścaiva garuḍān hanti haṃsakān ||76|| etānanyān hinastyugro dhṛṣṭabuddhirhi nirdayaḥ | pūrvapāpaiḥ pāpamārge pravṛttaḥ pāpakarmasu ||77 || duḥkhāviṣṭaḥ sukhaleśarahito’bhūdaharniśam | evaṃ vṛkṣeṣu śaileṣu durge cāraṇyabhūmiṣu ||78|| anāsano’ṭati daivāt prāptaḥ kuṇḍinanāmakam | puraṃ hyudyānaśobhāḍhyaṃ nikaṭe vanabhūmikam ||79|| nātidūre vane tatra kauṇḍinyākhyo mahānṛṣiḥ | svāśrame vartate nityaṃ pānthānāṃ śāntisampradaḥ ||1.249.8 0 || atithīn satkarotyeṣo bhakṣyapānāsanādibhiḥ | gato’yaṃ tvāśramadvāre muniṃ śrutvā tapodhanam ||8 1 || vaiśākhe māsi sarasi kṛtasnānaṃ tapodhanam | āsasāda dhṛṣṭabuddhiḥ svoddhārodayasanmukhaḥ ||8 2|| pādayoḥ patitaḥ prahvībhāvenaivārdramānasaḥ | tāvadṛṣerārdravastrabindavaḥ patitāstadā ||8 3 || mastake dhṛṣṭabuddhestu skandhayoḥ karayostathā | nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi ||84|| vadato munirājasya śabdo’pi śravaṇe gataḥ | evaṃ mantreṇa ṛṣiṇā salilena tu pāvitaḥ ||85 || caraṇasparśamātreṇa naṣṭapāpo babhūva saḥ | mumukṣutāṃkurodbhedo jātastatra kṣaṇe’sya ca ||86 || kauṇḍinyasyāgrataḥ sthitvā samuvāca kṛtāṃjaliḥ | bho bho brahmanmokṣadātardayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari ||87|| yena puṇyaprabhāveṇa muktirbhavati pāpinaḥ | tādṛśaṃ puṇyakāryaṃ me vrataṃ vā vada mokṣadam ||88 || mahātmanāṃ prasaṃgena mahāpātakino’pi ca | taranti pāvanā bhūtvā pāvayantyaparānapi ||8 9|| tasmāccauryasurāpānāmiṣabhakṣaṇamaithunam | kṛtvā pāpadurācārān patito’smi ca sarvataḥ || 1.249.90 || pāvayitvedṛśaṃ māṃ ca mokṣabhājaṃ kuru prabho | śrutvā prāha tadā kauṇḍinyarṣistaṃ śaraṇāgatam ||9 1 || vaiśākhasya site pakṣe mohinī nāma viśrutā | ekādaśī bhavatyeṣā vrataṃ tasyāḥ samācāra ||92||| merutulyāni pāpāni kṣayaṃ yāsyanti tadvratāt | bahujanmārjitānyāśu naśyanti vratino dhruvam ||93 || iti kauṇḍinyasadvācaṃ śrutvā dhṛṣṭasudhīstadā | vrataṃ cakāra vidhivat kauṇḍinyāśramasannidhau || 94|| dhautapāpo’bhavacchuddho vāsanāsya layaṃ gatā | āyuścāpi gataṃ tvantaṃ karmaleśo na vidyate || 95|| dvādaśyāṃ saḥ phalapatrāhāraḥ san sarasastaṭe | supto muniṃ smaran kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ bhajan raṭan ||96 || śarīraṃ bhautikaṃ tyaktvā divyadeho babhūva saḥ | jagāma vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ garuḍopari saṃsthitaḥ || 97|| evaṃ lakṣmi mohinīsadvrataṃ mokṣapradaṃ śubham | nātaḥ parataraṃ kiñcit trailokye sacarācare ||98|| yajñāditīrthadānāni kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm | vratasyāsyāghaharturvaiṃ mokṣadāturharerbalāt ||99 || māyāmohaprasaktānāṃ mohinī mohanāśinī | brahmapūjātiriktānāṃ mohinī mohanapradā || 1.249.100 || mohaṃ nāsti yato yasyāṃ mohinī procyate tataḥ | mohī pāpī yayā dhāmni svarge vā nīyate tu sā || 101 || mohinī kṛṣṇasambandhātprocyate nityasaukhyadā | koṭiyajñaphalādhikyaphaladātrī vratena sā || 102 || pālanīyā prayatnena svargamokṣaphalapradā | pūrvajanmakṛtānekakarmapāpāpanuttaye || 103 || vaiṣṇavena viśeṣeṇa kartavyā mohaśāntaye | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādāmbujamohābhilabdhaye || 1 04|| putrapautradhanadārāsmṛddhiyānagṛhādikam | sakāmo labhate sarvaṃ vratenāsyāḥ kṛtena yat || 105 || labheddhanaṃ dhanahīno hyabuddho buddhimāpnuyāt | yadyatsaṃkalpayeccāpi saṃprāpnuyāttu tadvratī || 106 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vaiśākhaśuklamohinyekādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ dhṛṣṭabuddhināmnaḥ pāpivaiśyasya kauṇḍinyopadeśād vratakaraṇena muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmaikonapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāya || 249 ||
<1.250> śrīlakṣmīruvāca loke ca prāṇināṃ rītirnaisargikī tu keśava | bhakṣye pāne tathānande’laṃkāre viṣaye priye || 1 || mānavāstu tathā martye vidhiṃ vismṛtya mānavam | yānti te pāśave mārge dehendriyāsutarpaṇāḥ || 2 || teṣāṃ muktikaraṃ saumyaṃ vrataṃ nārāyaṇa prabho | ekādaśyā vratādanyannāsti drāṅ mokṣadaṃ khalu || 3 || śrutvaitanmānasaṃ me’tiprasannaṃ bhavati prabho | śrotumicchāmi māhātmyaṃ vidhiṃ prapūjanaṃ vratam || 4 || jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇaikādaśikātithestad vad keśava | kiṃ nāmnyekādaśī ko’syā devaḥ pūjyaśca kiṃ phalam || 5 || nārāyaṇa uvāca ekādaśī tvaparākhyā mahāpātakanāśinī | jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇadalīyā vai putrapautrapradāyinī || 6 || asyā adhipatirdevo hariḥ svayamadhokṣajaḥ | patnyā trayyākhyayā yuktaḥ pūjanīyo vidhānataḥ || 7 || ketakairarcanīyo’sau tathānyaiḥ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ | arghye bahuphalaṃ deyaṃ dugdhaudanādi bhojane || 8 || śārkaraṃ tu jalaṃ śītaṃ pānārthaṃ deyamuttamam | savatsāyāśca gordānaṃ gurave’tra prakīrtitam || 9 || daśamyāmekabhuktena naktena nirvahed vratī | rātrau bhūśayanaṃ kuryād rakṣayed brahmacāritām || 10 || ekādaśyāṃ samutthāya brāhmakāle hariṃ smaret | svarṇakeśaṃ padmanetraṃ tilapuṣpasunāsikam || 1 1|| sakuṇḍalaṃ samukuṭaṃ keyūrakaṭakānvitam | raktādharaṃ sucibukaṃ vartulānanaśobhitam || 12|| hasantaṃ kundakalikāpaṃktibhāsuradantakam | prodbhinnayauvanopetaṃ tejomaṇḍalamaṇḍitam || 13|| hāraratnābharaṇādibhūṣitaṃ sevitaṃ janaiḥ | rūpānurūpāvayavaṃ prasannamukhapaṃkajam || 14|| ceto harantaṃ bhaktasya kaṭākṣaśarakāriṇam | divyānandabharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ koṭikandarpasundaram || 15|| dhyāyedevaṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram | tataḥ snātvā pūjayecca vidhinā svāminaṃ prabhum || 16 || āvāhanādiṣoḍaśavidhānaiḥ pūjayetprabhum | puṣpāṃjalipraparyantaṃ naityakaṃ pūjanaṃ vratī || 17|| vidhāya prārthayedante vratavighnapraśāntaye | aparāyā vrataṃ tvadya kariṣye parameśvara || 18|| avighnaṃ tatprapūrṇaṃ me bhavatviti tato vratī | maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kārayedakṣatādibhiḥ || 19|| ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya sauvarṇaṃ sajalaṃ tāmramityatha | pañcaratnādisaṃyuktaṃ vastrapallavaśobhitam ||20 || pūjayettaṃ ca tīrthāni jale tvāvāhayet tataḥ | mūrtiṃ trayyā sahādhokṣajasya kundananirmitām |||21 || ghaṭamūrdhni tilapātre prasaṃsthāpya prapūjayet | āvāhanātsamārabhya yathā visarjanāvadhim || 22|| snānālaṃkārasaugandhyanaivedyajalavīṭikām | ārārtrikastutipuṣpāṃjalikṣāntisamarthanām ||23|| nirvartayitvā dānāni vividhāni tu dāpayet | madhyāhne’pi tathā kuryāt pūjanaṃ homamityapi || 24|| trayyādhokṣajanāmnā vai hyaṣṭottaraśataṃ vratī | naivedyaṃ miṣṭamarpayya tāmbūlādi samarpayet |||25|| sāyaṃ tu maṇḍapaṃ ramyaṃ haritaṃ kadalīkṛtam | navapallavapuṣpāḍhyaphalayuktoraṇānvitam ||26|| savitānaṃ suraṃgālicitraśobhācamatkṛtam | kārayet tatra dolāyāmāndālayettu mādhavam ||27|| jalaphuvvārasaṃsiktaśītalodyānamadhyagam | siṃhāsanasthitaṃ cādhokṣajaṃ viñjyāt tato vratī ||28|| kṛtvaivaṃ tu mahāpūjāṃ harerniśi prakārayet | ārārtrikādikaṃ cātha naivedyaṃ dadhiśarkaram ||29|| āmramiṣṭarasāḍhyaṃ ca pūrikādiyutaṃ śubham | arpayet naktabhojyaṃ ca tāmbūlādi samarpayet |||30 || kalpayecchayanārthaṃ ca paryaṃkaṃ preṃkhayānvitam | nimbavṛkṣapraśākhāyāṃ vyomni baddhaṃ sudolakam ||3 1 || komalaṃ gendukādyaṃ cāstaraṇaṃ cāpi kalpayet | bhagavantaṃ ghṛtadīpaprakāśe tatra dolayet ||32|| nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ kīrtanaṃ ca smaraṇaṃ bhajanaṃ tathā | kuryurjāgaraṇaṃ bhaktā militvā harisannidhau |||33||| ekādaśyāḥ kathāṃ tatra śṛṇuyācca paṭhecca vā | līlādīni harestatra śrāvayed vadanādinā ||34|| akhaṇḍanāmabhajanaṃ saśabdaṃ niśi kārayet | bhaktebhyo miṣṭasalilaṃ tathā phalādi cārpayet |||35||| payo dadyātkaṇṭhaśāntyai dadyāttvanyadapekṣitam | sādhūnāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ yogināṃ tathā |||36|| sevanaṃ pādasaṃvāhaṃ kuryācchramāpanodanam | evaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānnindāṃ kutsāṃ vivarjayet|||37|| divyāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ prakuryāccādhokṣajaṃ cintayeddhṛdi | śubhaṃ sarvaṃ caredekādaśījāgaraṇavratī ||38 || ālasyapṛṣṭhabhaṃgādi nāśayed rāsakarmaṇā | kūrdanaṃ gāyanaṃ nṛtyaṃ hāsyaṃ kuryātpunaḥ punaḥ ||39|| nidrālasyavināśārthaṃ dhāvanaṃ sapradakṣiṇam | kuryācca khelanaṃ bhakto bhakteṣu samavartiṣu ||40 || kṛṣṇalīlāṃ rāsalīlāṃ dānilīlāṃ prakhelayet | gopīlīlāṃ rādhayā saṃvihāraṃ ca vane’ṭanam ||41|| padmayā saha lagnaṃ ca bhārgavyā ramayā saha | nārāyaṇasya lagnaṃ ca protsavātmakamācaret ||42||| rātrau mahotsavaṃ kuryāt kṛṣṇasya gopikākṛtam | pārvatyā prabhayā māṇikyā lakṣmyā sākameva vā || 43|| vaivāhikotsavaṃ kuryād brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ | pragāyejjanmapadyāni śaktyutpattyutsavām̐stathā ||44|| kīrtayejjāgaraṇe ca prātaḥ snātvā prapūjayet | ṣoḍaśakopacārādyaiḥ pūjayeccāpyadhokṣajam ||45|| trayīṃ tvekādaśīṃ cāpi guruṃ prapūjayettataḥ | gurostu mastake kṛṣṇamastaka vartate sadā ||46|| gurornetre kṛṣṇanetraṃ gurvāsye tvānanaṃ hareḥ | guroḥ karṇe kṛṣṇakarṇaḥ harerjihvā gurormukhe || 47|| guroḥ kaṇṭhe hareḥ kaṇṭho gurvoṣṭhe mādhavādharaḥ | gurorvakṣasi kṛṣṇoro hyudaraikyaṃ harerguroḥ ||48|| gurorhaste harerhasto guroḥ kaṭyāṃ hareḥ kaṭiḥ | guroḥ pṛṣṭhe hareḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ hṛdayaikyaṃ harerguroḥ ||49|| gurorbuddhau harerbuddhirgurorvāci harestu vāk | gurorgupte harerguptaṃ guroḥ sakthnorharerurū ||50 || gurostvakṣu harestvag vai gurordehe harerbalam | gurorjānvorharerjānū nakhaikyaṃ ca gurorhareḥ ||51 || guroḥ pāde kṛṣṇapādo nakhaikyaṃ ca gurorhareḥ | gurau kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ tvāste nānyaḥ kṛṣṇo guroḥ paraḥ ||52|| guruḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇo gurustasmai śrīgurave namaḥ | iti dhyātvā guruṃ samyak pūjayet kṛṣṇabhāvataḥ ||53|| arpayeccāpi gurviṣṭaṃ gurau tuṣṭe sa toṣitaḥ | gurostu sevane kṛṣṇasevāpuṇyaṃ bhaveddhruvam ||54|| bodhyaṃ gurvarpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ | ahaṃ lakṣmi praśiṣyāṇāṃ gururūpo bhavāmi hi ||55|| gurau sthitvā divyasevāṃ gṛhṇāmi bhattasatkṛtām | yena kena prakāreṇa dānenābhyarcanena vā ||56 || namanenārpaṇenāpi sevanena stavena ca | pādasaṃvāhanenāpi priyavastvarpaṇena vā |||57|| gṛhādikaṃ samarpyāpi toṣaṇīyo guruḥ sadā | tasmādekādaśīvastudānaṃ śrīgurave’rpayet ||58 || patiṃ patnīṃ sutaṃ putrīṃ kuṭumbaṃ sarvamityapi | tārayeddhi gurustuṣṭastasmātkṛṣṇātmako guruḥ ||59 || evaṃ jñātvā dvādaśyāṃ vai dānaṃ tu gurave’rpayet | pāraṇāṃ kārayed viprān sādhūn sādhvīśca bhojayet || 60 || bālān kanyā bhojayecca dadyād dānāni bhūriśaḥ | evaṃ vratī bhuvi svarge vairājake’pi vā || 61 || aiśvare’vyākṛte cāpi śāśvataṃ sukhamāpnuyāt | loke prasiddhatāṃ yāti tvaparāṃ yastu sevate || 62 || brahmahatyāgotrahatyābhrūṇahatyākarastathā | strīhatyāmitrahatyādipāpakṛnmucyate vratāt || 63 || parāpavādanirataḥ parastrīratikastathā | aparāvratalābhena vipāpmā jāyate janaḥ || 64 || kūṭasākṣī kūṭamātā kūṭakapaṭakārakaḥ | kūṭavāk piśunaścaite mucyante pāpato drutam || 65 || kūṭavedaḥ kūṭaśāstraḥ kūṭajyotirgaṇastathā | kūṭāyurvedako vaidyo mucyate’syā vratena vai || 66|| brāhmaṇā brahmapatitāḥ kṣatriyā rakṣaṇāccyutāḥ | vaiśyāḥ parāṅmukhā dānānmucyante’syā vratena te || 67|| dharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ śūdrāḥ śiṣyā gurvādinindakāḥ | putro mātāpitṛhāpi mucyante’syā vratena vai || 68 || makarasthe ravau māghe prayāge yatphalaṃ nṛṇām | kāśyāṃ ca prāpyate puṇyaṃ śivarātryā vratena yat || 69 || gayāpiṇḍena puṇyaṃ yat pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaṃ matam | siṃhasthite bṛhaspatau godāvaryāṃ ca yatphalam ||7 0 || kedāradarśanātpuṇyaṃ badarītīrthajaṃ phalam | kurukṣetre ravigrāhe sarvatīrthaprasevanāt ||7 1 || gajāśvahemadānena yajñaṃ kṛtvā sadakṣiṇam | yatphalaṃ tatphalaprāptiraparāvratasevanāt ||72 || aghavṛkṣakuṭhārīyaṃ doṣāraṇyadavānalaḥ | pāpāndhakārataraṇirduritamṛgasiṃhikā ||73 || muktidā bhuktidā yāvadiṣṭadā hyaparā matā | asyā vratena yatpuṇyaṃ paraṃ yasmānna śiṣyate ||74|| aparā kṛṣṇayogātsā sārthakā vratakāriṇām | anyāsāṃ tu vratairatra khaṇḍapuṇyaṃ hi labhyate ||75 || aparāyā vratenātra sārvabhaumaphalaṃ bhavet | nāsti yadvratinaścātrālabhyaṃ kiñcid bhavediti ||76 || śrotā ca pāṭhako lakṣmi gosahasraphalaṃ labhet | vratī pāpāni nirdhūya viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 77 || parāścānyā yadagre vai svalpā bhavanti tejasā | aparā sā yataḥ proktā nāsti yasyāḥ paraṃ param || 78 || aparāṃ samupoṣyaiva pūjayitvā tvadhokṣajam | trayīpatnyā sahitaṃ ca vajralepātpramucyate ||79 || niṣkṛtiśūnyapāpānāṃ niṣkṛtiriyamucyate | agatikasya jīvasya gatirevāparāvratam ||8 0 || śṛṇu lakṣmi samākhyānaṃ śalabhāyāḥ kṛte yuge | yatinyāḥ saṃbabhūvāścaryānvitaṃ mokṣadaṃ śubham ||8 1 || śalabhānāmayatinī dīkṣāṃ bhāgavatīṃ gatā | sādhvī nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ bhajatyeva divāniśam ||82 || araṇye parvate sā cārbudākhye puṣkarāntike | vicaratyaniśaṃ tvekākinī yogabalāttu sā ||8 2 || ābālyātsā sanakasyābhavacchiṣyātiyoginī | lakṣavarṣe gate kāle yauvane’tibale gate ||84|| vane vanapaśusiṃhasiṃhikāmaithunakriyām | vīkṣya cānyāraṇyavāsikāmayogān punaḥ punaḥ ||85 || kāmadevasya saukhye’syā manovṛttirajāyata | vānaraṃ raktavarṇaṃ vai vanyaṃ sā svāśramasthitam ||86 || dhṛtvā taṃ ramayāmāsa nityadā kāmabhāvataḥ | vānarasya tu yogena garbho jāto vyavardhata ||87|| paśoryogena sāṃkaryaṃ pātakaṃ muktināśanam | śrutvā vaśiṣṭhaśiṣyātsā vedaśrutābhidhāttadā ||88 || paścāttāpaṃ para prāptā sanakasyāśramaṃ gatā | śiṣyāyāstvantarvatnītvaṃ dṛṣṭvāha sanakastu tām ||8 9 || kimidaṃ vai sute jātaṃ brahmacaryaṃ vilopitam | tathāpi gurave sarvaṃ hyakāpaṭyena varṇitam || 90 || saṃkarīkaraṇasyāsya pātitvasyāpyaghasya tu | yena nāśo bhavecchuddhiryathā jāyeta tadvada ||9 1 || ityabhyarthya sagarbhā sā ruroda khinnamānasā | garbhapāte’tipāpitvaṃ bhrūṇahatyādipātakam || 92|| kathaṃ me mama garbhasya nairdoṣyaṃ saṃbhavediti | vicā vidadhānāṃ tāṃ sanakaḥ prāha saṃśṛṇu || 93 || jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇāparaikādaśyā vrataṃ nirjalaṃ kuru | pātakaṃ te vinaṣṭaṃ syātprārabdhaṃ pūrṇatāṃ vrajet || 94|| muktiścāpi sulabhā syātprasavāt prāg vrataṃ kuru | iti śrutvā guruṃ natvā gatvā svāśramamarbude || 99|| cakāra vidhivatsarvam aparāyā vrataṃ śubham | tena śuddhiṃ gatā tasyāḥ pātityaṃ vilayaṃ gatam || 96|| āyuśca sāntamabhavat sthiravṛttyā tvadhokṣaje | ātmānaṃ yojayitvā ca brahmarandhreṇa sā tataḥ || 97|| brahmalokaṃ gatā nītvā garbhādhānasthacetanam | dehaṃ tyaktvā parāṃ muktimaparāvratato gatā || 98 || aparāyā vrataṃ tvevaṃ pāpasāṃkaryanāśanam | kartavyaṃ sarvathā lakṣmi sadā nāryāpi śuddhaye || 99 || yatinā brahmaniṣṭhena yoginā nyāsināpi ca | saṃkarīkaraṇāghasya śāntaye kāryameva tat || 1.250.100 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇāparaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ saṃkarīkaraṇādipātakanāśakaitadvratakaraṇena vānarayogāt garbhavatyāḥ śalabhāyatinyā nirdoṣatā muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā paṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 250 ||
<1.251> śrīlakṣmīruvāca asāre’smim̐stu saṃsāre sārastu bhagavān svayam | yaṃ bhajitvā narā yānti nirvāṇapadamakṣaram || 1 || kṛṣṇayogāt kṛṣṇatithiḥ kṛṣṇatulyaphalapradā | yadvrataṃ vidhivat kṛtvā dehī yāti parāṃ gatim || 2 || jyeṣṭhaśuklapakṣīyaikādaśī kimabhidhā matā | tasyā devo vratavidhirdānaṃ phalaṃ ca kīdṛśam || 3 || vad me śrīhare kṛṣṇa kṛpānātha ramāpate | svīyānāṃ cāhetukānugrahakartāsti yadbhavān || 4 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca jyeṣṭhaśukladalīyaikādaśī vai nirjalābhidhā | padmākṣyā sahitastrivikramākhyaḥ pūjya iṣyate || 5 || yūthikākusumaiḥ pūjyaścārghye tvāmraphalaṃ matam | dadhibhaktādi naivedyaṃ chatradānādi ceṣyate || 6 || daśamyāmekabhaktena naktena nirvahed vratī | rātrau śayīta pṛthvyāṃ ca brahmacārī bhaved vratī || 7 || prātarutthāya lakṣmīśaṃ dhyāyedaṃgāni cintayet | snātvā taṃ pūjayedbhakto bhāvayuktaistu vastubhiḥ || 8 || āvāhanaṃ samārabhya snānaṃ paṃcāmṛtādinā | śṛṃgāraṃ kārayitvāpi vastrabhūṣāsugandhibhiḥ || 9 || patrakuṃkumakastūrīhārāliśekharādibhiḥ | ārārtrikasunaivedyapānatāmbūladakṣiṇaiḥ || 1.251.10 || namaḥstutikṣamāvākyaiḥ puṣpāṃjalyādinā hareḥ | pūjāṃ kṛtvā tato dhānyaiḥ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam || 11 || kārayetsthāpayenmadhye ghaṭaṃ kāṃcananirmitam | tāmrajaṃ vā ghaṭaṃ tadvadaṣṭadikṣu ghaṭāṣṭakam || 12 || sthāpayitvā paṃcaratnaphalapallavataṇḍulān | vastraṃ sthālīṃ tilayuktāṃ sugandhaṃ candanādikam || 1 re || vinyasyettu kalaśeṣu mūrtiṃ trivikramasya ca | padmākṣyā nirjalayā ca sahitāṃ kanakodbhavām || 1 4|| pūjayed vidhinā bhakto vratārthaṃ ca vicārayet | karomi pūjanaṃ kṛṣṇa nirjalāvratasiddhaye || 19 || kṛpayā paripūrṇaṃ te jāyatāṃ sarvakāmadam | ityabhyarthya tataḥ kṛṣṇāvatāraṃ gaṇanāyakam || 16 || pūjayed dūrvayā sindūrāgurucandanākṣataiḥ | modakānarpayet paścāt trivikramaṃ samarcayet|| | 17 || āvāhanādikaṃ kṛtvā paṃcāmṛtaiśca gobhavaiḥ | śuddhodakena saugandhayuktena snapayeddharim || 1 8|| arpayecchuklavastrāṇi brahmasūtrādikāni ca | mukuṭābhūṣaṇādīni hārakeyūrakāṇi ca || 19 || sugandhitailadravyādikajjalālaktakānyapi | dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalatāmbūlakāni ca || 1.251.20 || ārārtrikastutipradakṣiṇāprakramaṇāni ca | kṣamāyācanakusumāṃjalivisarjanāni ca || 21 || evaṃ sarvavidhānena śrīkṛṣṇaṃ pūjayed vratī | tataḥ kuryāt svakaṃ kāryaṃ madhyāhne’pi tathācaret || 22 || śrīkhaṇḍasāraṃ naivedye pūrikā tvāmrasadrasam | jalaṃ śītaṃ śarkarailāsugandhaṃ bhāvagarbhitam || 23 || dadyād devāya tu paścāt sāyaṃ dolādhirohaṇam | kārayecchrīhariṃ puṣpodyāne druvāṭikābhuvi || 24||| jalasiktaśītalārdraśādvale mṛdulasthale | vihārayeddhariṃ sāyaṃ śītavāyuprasevite || 25 || niśi tvārārtrikaṃ kuryāt stutyādyaṃ ca yathākramam | takraṃ ca taralā dadyānnaivedye saghṛtāṃ śubhām || 26 || pānīyaṃ miṣṭasāraṃ ca dadyātpānārthamuttamam | mukhaśuddhikaraṃ dravyaṃ pradadyācchayanaṃ śubham || 27|| bhakto jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānmilitvānekasātvataiḥ | prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ natvā pūjayitvā tataḥ param || 28 || anyānpūjyān bhojayitvā kuryādvai jalapāraṇām | tato vratī prakuryāttu bhojanaṃ haraye’rpitam ||29|| dānāni vividhānyeva dadyātsatphalalabdhaye | nṛpo dadyādgajādīṃśca ratnāni nagarāṇi ca || 1.251.30 || vipro dadyātpustakādi vaiśyo dhānyadhanāni ca | śūdro dadyātkalālabhyavastūni nūtanāni tu || 31 || sarvo dadyād yathāśakti yatsvāgre deyamasti tat | gavāṃ dānaṃ ca bhūdānaṃ dānānyanyāni cācaret || 32|| yad yasyāgre svakaṃ sthāttatsatpātrāyārpayed vratī | brahmaṇe tvarpayāmīti matvā dadyāttu śārṅgiṇe || 33 || lakṣmīnārāyaṇāyaiva dadyācchrīgurave tathā | anāthāya daridrāya dadyāccāpyasahāyine || 34|| nāryai dadyādvidhavāyai hyanāthāyai tathārpayet | bālakebhyo bālikābhyaḥ pradadyāccharkarādikam || 35|| bhikṣāṃ sadbhyaśca sādhvībhyo dadyādvratī ghṛtānvitām | miṣṭānnāni tathānyāni bhojyānyapi samarpayet || 36|| evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ bhakto yāti svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam | vratametatsukhopāyaṃ sārabhūtaṃ mahāphalam || 37|| alpakleśaṃ svalpavastusādhyaṃ yacchraddhayā bhavet | api pāpadurācārāḥ pāpiṣṭhā dharmavarjitāḥ || 38 || nirjalāyāṃ na bhuṃjanti no pibanti jalādikam | harerbhaktiṃ prakurvanti na te yānti yamāntikam || 39 || śṛṇu vratakathāṃ tvasyā yābhūtpūrve kṛte yuge | brahmaṇā bhavanaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ yugādime || 1.251.40 || prathame tu dine tatra satyayuge ṛṣiḥ kratuḥ | agnimukhaḥ kratuḥ putro vedhaso bahubhojyabhūt ||41 || yadyad bhakṣayati prāptaṃ bhasmībhavati tatkṣaṇe | samakāle sahasrāṇi lakṣāṇi bhojanānyapi || 42|| asīmāni pradattāni bhuṃkte drāgeva caikalaḥ | jīryanti tāni sarvāṇi ghaṭikānte bubhukṣitaḥ ||43 || jāṭharāgnikṛtadāvānalavyāpto bhavatyapi | samicchatyatibhojyāni nāpyante tu yadā tadā ||44|| vanaṃ himālayāraṇyaṃ mervaraṇyaṃ mahattamam | gacchatyeva ca tatratyaṃ sarvaṃ khādatyaharniśam ||45|| jalārthaṃ tu kṣīramiṣṭasāgare tu patatyayam | pānīyaṃ pibati yāvat tṛptirbhavati tattathā || 46 || evaṃ tu gamyamānāyāṃ yātrāyāṃ varṣmaṇaḥ kratuḥ | kvacitpurukṣudhāviṣṭo brahmāṇaṃ saṃjagāma ha ||47|| prārthayaccātṛptibhakṣyaṃ nityaṃ me prāpyatāmiti | brahmā prāha kratuṃ putra tṛptiṃ tubhyaṃ dadāmyaham || 48 || yaḥ kopi
