cetanastubhyaṃ yajamānasvarūpakaḥ | yajñe dāsyati yāvatyā bhakṣyaṃ bhāvanayātulam ||49 || tāvatī te kṣudhā tatra jāyatāṃ pācanāya vai | bhāvanāyā abhāve tu kṣudhānāśopi te bhavet || 1.251.5 0 || tṛptistu tatra bhavatu yathābhāvanameva te | ita ārabhya putra tvāṃ kṣudhā bādhiṣyate nahi ||5 1 || yathā hotaḥ prāgbabādhe tathā bādhiṣyate nahi | kintu kratusvarūpāya havirdāsyanti te’dhikam || 52 || bahubhiḥ samakāle te hyapathyaṃ mā tadā bhavet | itihetoḥ kṣudhā te vai svecchayā saṃbhaviṣyati || 53 || kaściddāsyati yāvatte tāvatte’stu tadā kṣudhā | na dāsyati tadā kṣutte śamiṣyatīti sarvadā ||54|| sukhī bhava krato putra mā jihvālolyamīyatām | sa kraturbrahmaṇāśīrbhiryojito niryayau tataḥ || 55 || sa tvagnihotriṇāṃ nityāvāseṣūvāsa śāntahṛt | bhakṣayatyaniśaṃ tvagnau hotṝṇāṃ homakarmasu || 56 || havyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ prātarmadhye sāyaṃ ca naityakam | bhuktvā bhuktvā kṣudhā tvasya nityamāhāramicchati || 57|| ityabhyāsavaśāttasya trivāraṃ bhojanaṃ dhruvam | tato’pyadhikakālaṃ vā kartavyaṃ bhavati dhruvam || |58 || evaṃ sa bhojanābhyāsāt kāle kāle samicchati | bhojanaṃ vividhaṃ havyaṃ hyadattaṃ dattameva vā ||5 9 || jihvālaulyād bhojanecchā jāyate tu muhurmuhuḥ | svecchayā ca kṣudhā tvasya vardhate bahuveginī || 1.251.60 || evaṃ kratoḥ sthitau dakṣamarīcyādyā maharṣayaḥ | yayurbadarikāraṇyaṃ draṣṭuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ naram || 61 || mandākinyāṃ ca te snātvā dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ harim | niṣīduḥ śrīharestatra sānnidhye badarīvane || 62 || rūpābhirūpāvayavaṃ himagrāvasamojjvalam | brahmavratasvarūpaṃ ca tapomūrtiṃ pareśvaram || 63 || bhṛgurnatvā hariṃ smṛtvā papraccha parameśvaram | dīnabandho kṛpāsindho baddhoddhārakara prabho || 6 4|| namāmaḥ śaraṇaṃ prāptāstvāṃ hṛtsthaṃ ca bahiḥsthitam | vadāsmān saralaṃ puṇyapradaṃ bhuktipramuktidam ||61|| vrataṃ yenānnajā doṣā naśyeyuḥ sarvatomukhāḥ | parānnajāstathā śuddhirahitānnasamudbhavāḥ ||66|| sūtakānnakṛtāścāpi saṃsṛṣṭānnagrahodbhavāḥ | bhikṣānnajāstathā paryuṣitānnodbhavitāśca ye ||67|| te naśyeyuryathā doṣā jñānājñānakṛtāḥ prabho | anarpitānnajā doṣāḥ svārthapaṃktiprabhedajāḥ ||68|| te doṣā yena naśyeyustādṛśaṃ brūhi sattapaḥ | śrutvaivaṃ śrīhariḥ prāha śṛṇuta brāhmaṇottamāḥ ||69|| vrataṃ vratottamaṃ tvekādaśyā matamupoṣaṇam | tapastapaḥpradhānaṃ ca pāpasaṃhārakārakam ||1.251.70|| annāśritānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ śodhakaṃ param | saralaṃ sulabhaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vrataṃ sarvaphalapradam ||7 1|| ekādaśyāṃ na bhuṃjīta pakṣayorubhayorapi | sūtake’pi na bhoktavyaṃ nāśauce’pi maharṣayaḥ ||72|| yāvajjīvaṃ vratametatkartavyaṃ śreya icchatā | svargaṃ mokṣaṃ vāñcchatāpi kartavyaṃ tad vrataṃ śubham ||73|| annāśritāsaṃkhyadoṣā vratakarturbhavanti na | ekādaśyā avratānāṃ mokṣo naiva ca naiva ca ||74|| api vāpadurācārāḥ pāpiṣṭhā dharmavarjitāḥ | ekādaśyāṃ na bhuṃjanti na te yānti yamāntikam ||75|| ekādaśyāṃ tu bhoktāro’nnādā yānti yamālayam | iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kampito hṛdayāmbuje ||76|| kratuḥ prāha mahābhakṣyo naranārāyaṇaṃ prati | bhagavannaiva śakto’smi bubhukṣā duḥsahā mama ||77|| prātarme bhojanālabdhau madhyāhne maraṇaṃ bhavet | nāhaṃ kṣudhāṃ samartho’smi soḍhuṃ vai kālapaṃcake ||78|| prātardevamukhairadmi pūrvāhṇe’gnimukhena ca | madhyāhne cāparāhṇe cātithibhikṣukasanmukhaiḥ ||79|| sāyaṃ sarvamukhairadmi rātrau sthāvarajaṃgamaiḥ | evaṃ vai bhojanaṃ me’sti sarvathā parinirmitam ||1.251.80|| kṣudhāpi bādhate yāvadabhyāsasamaye’nvaham | tasmād dānāni dāsyāmi pūjayiṣyāmi keśavam ||8 1 || anyatpuṇyaṃ kariṣyāmi na kariṣyāmyupoṣaṇam | ityuktvā virarāmāsau prāha nārāyaṇastadā |||82|| yadi svargo’styabhīṣṭaste narako neṣyate tvayā | ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyaṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi ||83|| kratuḥ prāha hariṃ nātha tathyaṃ vacmi tavāgrataḥ | ekabhukte na śakto’smi tūpavāse kutaḥ kṣamaḥ ||84|| kro nāmā tvanalaḥ saptajihvastudati jāṭharaḥ | nāmnā bhavāmi lakṣmīśa kratureva yathārthataḥ ||85|| kraḥ krūraḥ sa mahānagnirativelaṃ ca bhojanam | atisnigdhaṃ yadāśnāmi tadā so’pi praśāmyati ||86|| sarvāsāmupavāse tu mariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ | tasmātkuru kṛpāṃ kṛṣṇa kartuṃ śaknomyahaṃ yathā ||87|| yenaiva prāpyate svargastatkartāsmi tavājñayā | mokṣaścāpi bhavedyena tadekaṃ vada matkṛte ||88|| yadahaṃ sugamaṃ kurve yena śreyo’hamāpnuyām | śrutvā nārāyaṇastasya dayālurbhaktavatsalaḥ ||89|| prāha yogyaṃ vicāryaiva tādṛśānāṃ kṛte vratam | vṛṣasthe mithunasthe’rke yadā tvekādaśī bhavet || 1.251.90|| jyeṣṭhamāse prayatnena sopoṣyā jalavarjitā | gaṇḍūṣācamanaṃ vāriṃ varjayitvā jalaṃ param ||91 || upabhuṃjīta naivātra nirjalā sā kṛtā bhavet | nirjalāyāṃ jale graste vrataṃ nyūnabalaṃ bhavet ||92|| udayādudayaṃ yāvad varjayitvā jalaṃ vratī | dvādaśaikādaśyupoṣaṇotthaṃ phalamavāpnuyāt ||93|| vrataṃ tu nirjalaṃ devārcanayuktaṃ sajāgaram | kṛtvā prātardvādaśyāṃ ca jalasnānaṃ prapūjanam ||94|| sajalaṃ sasuvarṇaṃ ca ghaṭaṃ datvā dvijātaye | annadānāni datvā ca bhuṃjīta pāraṇāṃ svakaiḥ || 95|| sādhūn sādhvīrbālikāśca bālān sabhojayed vratī | saṃvatsaraikādaśīnāṃ phalaṃ vai vratino bhavet |||96|| sarvānvādānparityajya māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajet | ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ sarvapāpāt pramucyate ||97|| ekādaśyāṃ na bhuṃjīta pakṣayorubhayorapi | tatrāpi jyeṣṭhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ vai nirjalo bhavet ||98|| ekasyā api puṇyaṃ saṃvatsaraikādaśībhavam | upoṣitā hi sarvāḥ syurekādaśyaḥ sitāsitāḥ ||99|| dhanadhānyapradā tveṣā putrārogyādisampradā | upoṣitā manovāñchitārthalābhapradā śubhā || 1.251.100 || yamadūtā mahākāyāḥ karālā vikaṭānanāḥ | daṇḍapāśadharāḥ krūrā vratīnaṃ nābhiyanti hi || 101 || pītāmbaradharāḥ saumyāścakrahastā manojavāḥ | vaiṣṇavāḥ saṃnayantyenaṃ hyante purīṃ tu vaiṣṇavīm || 1 02|| tasmātsarvaprayatnena krato tvaṃ tāṃ samācara | nirjalāṃ śraddhayā putra vidhehyadbhirvivarjitām || 1 02|| tena te jāṭharastīvro niyamastho bhaviṣyati | utsāhena prakartavyā sāvadhānena nirjalā || 1 04|| svapne’nnabhakṣaṇaṃ vāripānaṃ vā jāyate yadi | tadā me hyaparādho na vratabhaṃgo’tra māstu me || 1 05|| svapnadoṣe’pi me nātha vratabhaṃgo hi māstu me | nidrālasyanimitte’pi vratabhaṃgo’pi māstu me || 106 || bhokṣye pare’hni deveśa hyaśanaṃ vāsarāddhareḥ | ityabhyarthya hariṃ kṛṣṇamupavāsaparo bhavet || 1 07|| merulokālokatulyaṃ striyā puṃsā ca yatkṛtam | sarvaṃ tadbhasmatāṃ yāti pāpamekādaśībalāt || 1 08|| jaladhenuḥ pradātavyā dvādaśīpāraṇādine | sakāṃcanaḥ pradātavyo sughaṭo jalasaṃbhṛtaḥ || 109|| jalaṃ naiva hi pātavyaṃ hyasyāṃ yo niyamaṃ caret | phalaṃ koṭisuvarṇānāṃ yāme yāme bhavettadā || 1.251.110 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ karoti svalpakaṃ vratī | tatsarvaṃ śāśvataṃ puṇyaṃ dadātyacyutavāgbalāt || 11 1|| kimanyena tu kṛtyena nirjalaikādaśī vinā | suvarṇamannaṃ vāso vā yadasyāṃ saṃpradīyate || 1 12|| yo nirjalaṃ tūpavaset vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma yāti saḥ | yena yena kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaṃ cāpyakṣayaṃ bhavet || 1 13|| ye tu dāsyanti dānāni dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇādine | jyeṣṭhe site vratinaste prāpsyanti paramaṃ padam || 1 14|| brahmaghno madyapaścauro gurudveṣī vyavāyakṛt | mucyante pātakairete yadi dvādaśyupoṣitā || 115|| krato śṛṇu viśeṣaṃ tvaṃ nirjalaikādaśīdine | śraddhāyuktanarastrībhirjalaśāyī hariḥ svayam || 1 16|| pūjanīyastathā deyā dhenurjalamayī tadā | pratyakṣā vā savatsā vā deyā muktipradā bhavet || 1 17|| śreṣṭhābhirdakṣiṇābhiśca miṣṭānnaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ | toṣaṇīyā dvijāḥ santaḥ sādhvyo bālāśca bālikāḥ || 1 18|| teṣu tuṣṭeṣu kṛṣṇo’haṃ tuṣṭo bhavāmi mokṣadaḥ | yairna vrataṃ kṛtaṃ tvasyā ātmaghnāste na saṃśayaḥ || 119 || ekādaśyāṃ dine yo’nnaṃ bhuṃjate’ghabhujo hi te | pāpātmāno durācārā muṣṭāste nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1.251.120 || śāntairdāntairdānaparairarcayadbhistathā harim | kurvadbhirjāgaraṃ rātrau yaireṣā samupoṣitā || 121 || kulānāṃ śatamāgāmi hyatītānāṃ tathā śatam | ātmanā saha tairnītaṃ vāsudevasya mandiram || 1 22|| annaṃ gāvo mahiṣyaśca vastraṃ śayyāsanaṃ jalam | daṇḍaḥ kamaṇḍaluśchatraṃ pātraṃ svarṇaṃ tilādikam || 123|| upānahau tathānyadvā kiṃcitpātre dadāti yaḥ | sa sauvarṇena yānena svargaloke mahīyate || 124|| niyamena tu kartavyaṃ vrataṃ nirjalameva hi | dvādaśyāṃ devadeveśaḥ pūjanīyastrivikramaḥ || 125|| saśarkarā jalakuṃbhā dātavyā viṣṇusannidhau | bhojayitvā tato viprān svayaṃ bhuṃjīta pāraṇām || 126 || evaṃ yaḥ kurute pūrṇāṃ dvādaśīṃ pāpanāśinīm | sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ padaṃ gacchatyanāmayam || 127|| śrutvā natvā kratuḥ svasyāśramaṃ yāto mudānvitaḥ | vrataṃ cakāra vidhivannirjalāyā dine tu saḥ || 128|| phalaṃ tu prāptavānsarvaṃ tathānyo’pi kariṣyati | prāpsyatyeṣaścaturviṃśatyekādaśīkṛtaṃ phalam || 129|| yaścemāṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā yaścāpi parikīrtayet | ubhau tau dyāmāpnuyātāṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 1.251.130|| yatphalaṃ tu sinīvālyāṃ rāhugraste divākare | śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā japedyattat syādasyāḥ śravaṇādapi || 13 1|| paṭhanātpāṭhanāccāpi vratatulyaṃ phalaṃ bhavet | vratāttu śāśvataṃ svargaṃ muktiśca śāśvatī bhavet || 1 32|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāryāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jyeṣṭhaśuklanirjalaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ bubhukṣitasya kratorvratena sopākhyāna kṣudhāśāntyādi phalaprāptyādicetinirūpaṇanāmaikapaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 251 ||
<1.252> śrīlakṣmīruvāca kṛpāsindho sadālasyānvitānāṃ bhavapārakṛt | tāritā vai tvayā nātha nirjalāvratavarṇanāt || 1 || yena muktiṃ tathā bhuktiṃ sarvaikādaśikāphalam | vratinaḥ prāpnuvantyatra kāraṇaṃ karuṇā tava || 2 || saṃkalpastava jīvānāṃ kathaṃcidvai bhavedyathā | niḥśreyaḥ paramaṃ yadvā mokṣo vā svargameva vā || 3 || jananīvadrakṣaṇaṃ syād bhavasāgaravāridheḥ | tathā tvaṃ yatase nātha kṛpā kevalakāraṇam || 4 || vada me’ṣāḍhakṛṣṇaikādaśyā vrataphalaṃ vidhim | devaṃ pūjāṃ ca māhātmyaṃ kṛpālo dānamityapi || 9 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca aṣāḍhakṛṣṇapakṣīyā yoginīsaṃjñikā matā | kṣemaṃkaryā sahātrārcyo nṛsiṃhākhyo hariḥ prabhuḥ || 6 || bhṛṃgarājo’tra puṣpeṣu tathārghye jāmbavaṃ phalam | naivedye piṇḍakā deyā dāne tu jalagaurmatā || 7 | viśeṣo’yaṃ vidhiḥ proktaḥ kāryaṃ vrataṃ vratottamam | sarvapāpakṣayakṛcca sarvabhuktipradāyakam || 8 || saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ potarūpaṃ sanātanam | jagattraye sārabhūtaṃ yoginīvratamuttamam || 9 || daśamyāmekabhaktena naktena vratinā khalu | bhūśāyinā vartitavyaṃ brahmacaryādinā tathā || 1.252.10|| ekādaśyāṃ vratī prātarutthāya śrīhariṃ smaret | dhyātvā snātvā pūjayitvā hariṃ ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ || 1 1|| prārthayed bhagavan kṛṣṇa yoginyā vratamuttamam | karomyadya tu nirvighnaṃ sampūrṇaphaladaṃ bhavet || 12|| kṛpayā tava bhaktānāmabhayaṃkara mādhava | ityabhyarthya tato dhānyaiḥ kārayet sarvataḥ śubham || 13|| maṇḍalaṃ raṃgacitrādiśobhitaṃ maṇḍalāntare | madhye saṃsthāpayetsvarṇakalaśaṃ ratnagarbhitam || 14|| phalapallavayuktaṃ ca jalavastrasamanvitam | candanākṣatasatkuṃkumārcitaṃ navadhātujam || 15|| śaṃkhaṃ ca pūjayettatra ghaṇṭāṃ prapūjayettathā | śālagrāmaṃ pūjayecca gaṇeśaṃ pūjayettathā || 16|| pūjādravyaiḥ pūjayitvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ narasiṃhakam | pūjayetparayā bhaktyā svarṇanirmitamūrtikam || 17|| tilasthālyāṃ sthāpayitvā pūjayedakṣatādibhiḥ | āvāhanādibhiḥ paṃcāmṛtaiḥ sugandhicandanaiḥ || 18|| sadvastraiśca vibhūṣābhiḥ śṛṃgāradravamardanaiḥ | dhūpadīpasunaivedyaphalatāmbūlavāribhiḥ || 19|| ārārtrikastutipuṣpāṃjalyādibhiḥ samarcayet | kṣamāparādhaṃ tvabhyarthya svakāryaṃ cet kriyāt tataḥ ||1.252.2 0|| madhyāhnepi sunaivedyaṃ tvāmrarasaśrīkhaṇḍakam | śītalaṃ madhuraṃ vāri pūrikā dadhi śarkarām ||21 || āranālaṃ ca kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍapākaṃpayorasam | bhojayenmukhavāsaṃ ca pūgīphalaṃ ca vīṭikām ||22|| dadyātsāyaṃ tathā saumyaṃ kārayenmaṇḍapaṃ navam | tatra dolāṃ bandhayitvā sthāpayitvā hariṃ tataḥ ||23 || āndolayetsamudyāne vihārayeditastataḥ | śādvale śītale bhāge viśramayejjanārdanam ||24|| pūjayed vividhaiḥ śreṣṭhairvastubhiśca tataḥ param | nīrājayennarasiṃhaṃ stutiṃ kuryācca saiṃhikīm || 25|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānnṛsiṃhapadagāyanaiḥ | prātarutsāhapūrvaṃ taṃ dhyātvā snātvā prapūjayet||| 26 || vidhivadvastubhiḥ sarvairnivedya miṣṭamiṣṭakam | jalaṃ dadyāttato bhaktaḥ kuryādvai pāraṇāṃ śubhām || 27|| jaladānaṃ jaladhenuṃ svarṇadhenuṃ ghṛtādikam | dadhi dugdhaṃ navanītaṃ śarkarāṃ gūḍamityapi ||28 || dadyād dānaṃ supātrāya yānaṃ vāhanamarthakam | gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād ghaṭaṃ mūrtiṃ harestathā ||29|| miṣṭānnāni tathānyāni dāpayet sadbhya eva ca | gṛhakṣetrapaśūdyānadāsadānāni kārayet || 1.252.3 0|| evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ bhakto yoginyā_ śraddhayā yutaḥ | yogilabhyaṃ phalaṃ svargyaṃ kaivalyaṃ cāpi saṃlaset || 31 || śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ ramyāṃ daivīṃ pāpavināśinīm | alakāyāṃ nagaryāṃ vai kuberaḥ śivabhaktimān || 32|| yadā śaṃbhoḥ prapūjāyāṃ vartate tu tadā sadā | svānucaro mahāyakṣo hemamālīti nāmataḥ || 33 || samānayati puṣpāṇi pārśvodyānabhavāni vai | evaṃ nityaṃ śaṃkarasya pūjopakaraṇāni saḥ || 34|| upasthāpayati tatra sadā kuberasannidhau | sa kintu yauvanodbhedāt kāmapūreṇa saṃbhṛtaḥ || 35|| svapatnyā tu viśālākṣyā saha kāme viśeṣataḥ | kāmabāṇena cākṛṣṭo vartate divase’pi ca || 36|| kāryaṃ cāpi parityajya kāmanāyāṃ pravartate | evaṃ cātīva kāmārthī patnyā saha kvacitkvacit || 37|| kusumādīni cānetuṃ gacchatyeva drumādiṣu | ekadā tu kubereṇa mānasākhyasaraḥ prati ||38 || preṣito hemamālī saḥ kamalānayanāya vai | so’pi nūtnaṃ saro ramyaṃ dṛśyārhaṃ tvabhimatya ca || 39 || patnyā saha gatastatrānetuṃ su kamalāni tu | jalaṃ ca śādvalaṃ sūkṣmavālukācākacakyatām ||1.252.40 || ramaṇīyapradeśaṃ ca sugandhikusumādikam | rājasaṃ vividhaṃ bhāvaṃ vihārakṣobhakārakam ||4 1 || dṛṣṭvā vikṛtimāyāto visṛjya kusumāni ca | patnyā saha tadā reme mānase tu sarovare ||42|| patnyā muhurdhṛtaḥ kāme saṃsakto na nivartate | tṛptāpi tu punaḥ patnī pravṛttā na nivartate ||43|| evaṃ parasparaṃ prāptau kāmabhāvau viśeṣataḥ | punaḥ punaḥ pravṛttau tau vividaturna mohitau ||44|| kālātikramaṇaṃ jātaṃ pūjāyāśca tathāpi tau | puṣpāṇyādāya nāyātau kubero’pi pratīkṣate ||45|| kāmapremarasāsaktau na kuberālayaṃ gatau | kubero devasadane karoti śivapūjanam ||46 || prātaḥ kālo vyatītaśca madhyāhnasamaye tataḥ | kuberaḥ pūjanārthaṃ tu puṣpāgamasamīkṣakaḥ ||47|| cintayāmāsa vighnaṃ vai yato nāyāti yakṣakaḥ | dvitīyo yakṣakastatra preṣito’nveṣaṇāya yat ||48|| sa gatvā ramamāṇaṃ taṃ dadarśa hemamālinam | hemamālī tu salile ramate kāntayā saha ||49|| preṣyastau prāha puṣpāṇi sa kāṃkṣati kuberarāṭ | śīghraṃ vai tatra gantavyaṃ madhyāhne pūjanaṃ bhavet ||1.252.50|| iti kṛtvā gatau puṣpāṇyādāya rājarājakam | kuberaṃ tau tato natvā yayācāte kṣamāṃ muhuḥ ||5 1|| yakṣarāṭ pratyuvācātha kālātikramakopitaḥ | vanitākāmukaṃ jñātvā ramamāṇaṃ nijecchayā ||52|| āḥ pāpa duṣṭa durvṛtta kāmāsaktatayā tvayā | anādāya tu puṣpāṇi kṛtaṃ vai devahelanam |||5 3 || kāmabhogo mahān vighnaḥ sa ca doṣo mahānmataḥ | daṇḍastatra pradātavyo na kartavyā mayā kṛpā ||54|| bhavāṣṭādaśakuṣṭhī tvaṃ viyukto kāntayā tayā | asmātsthānādapadhvasto gacchasvādhama bhūtalam ||55|| ityukte vacane yakṣastasmātsthānātpapāta ha | mahāduḥkhābhibhūtaśca kuṣṭhaiścitritavigrahaḥ ||56|| galatkuṣṭhaḥ śvetakuṣṭho raktakuṣṭho’bhavattadā | carmakuṣṭho lalatkuṣṭho durgandhapūyakuṣṭhakaḥ |||57| evaṃ jātaḥ śarīre sa hemamālī svakarmaṇā | divā sukhaṃ na labhate na nidrāṃ labhate niśi ||58|| chāyāyāṃ vā nidāghe vā gṛhe kuṃje ca gahvare | kuṭyāṃ bhūmau latāmadhye labhate na sukhaṃ kvacit |||59|| dāhena pīḍyate cāti kharjanena jvalatyapi | pātakenābhibhūtopi pūrvakarma smaratyasau ||1.252.60|| śivārpitasu puṣpādiphalaprābalyato nanu | patitasyābhibhūtasya smṛtistasya na lupyati ||61|| himālaye mahāraṇye ghorarūpa itastataḥ | bhramamāṇo yayau devān mārkaḍeyāśramaṃ śubham ||62||| taponidhiṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ brahmadhyānaparāyaṇam | yasyāyurvidyate lakṣmi brahmaṇo dinasaptakam ||63||| vavande caraṇau tasya dūrataḥ kuṣṭhavigrahaḥ | mārkaṃḍeyo dayāṃ kṛtvā kampitaṃ duṣṭavigraham ||64|| paropakaraṇārthāya samāhūyedamabravīt | kasmātkuṣṭhābhibhūtastvaṃ kuto nindyatamo hyasi ||65|| śrutvā prāha tadā sopi muniṃ pāpavināśakam | rājarājasyānucaro hemamālīti nāmataḥ ||66|| udyānātpadmanicayaṃ tvānīya pratyahaṃ mune | śivapūjanavelāyāṃ kuberāya samārpayam ||67|| ekasmindivase patnyā sahito’haṃ kṛpālunā | saṃpreṣitaḥ kubereṇa tvānetuṃ kamalāni hi ||68|| atisugandhicitrāṇi mānasākhyasarovaram | dṛṣṭvā tu nūtanaṃ ramyaṃ bhūtalaṃ sajalaṃ śubham ||69|| kāmasukhaprasaktābhyāṃ kālaścāvidito gataḥ | puṣpaṃ vinā śivapūjā prātarjātā tato hyaham ||1.252.70|| atikruddhena śapto’smi rājarājena vai mune | kuṣṭhābhibhūtaḥ saṃjāto viyuktaḥ kāntayā tayā ||7 1|| bhramamāṇo’tra sānnidhye prāptohaṃ me śubhaṃ kuru | satāṃ svabhāvataścittaṃ paropakaraṇe kṣamam ||72|| iti madarthaṃ bhagavan kuru saukhyaṃ bhaved yathā | śrutvā tathyaṃ tadovāca mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ ||73|| śṛṇu vratopadeśaṃ te kathayāmi śubhapradam | āṣāḍhe kṛṣṇapakṣasyaikādaśīvratamācara ||74|| yoginīvratapuṇyena kuṣṭhaṃ yāsyati vai dhruvam | punaḥ prāpsyasi patnīṃ tvaṃ lapsyase śāśvataṃ sukham ||75||| itivākyamṛṣeḥ śrutvā daṇḍavatpatito bhuvi | āśīrbhirvardhitastena babhūvātīva harṣitaḥ ||76|| yoginyekādaśīṃ cakre vratī tvāśramasannidhau | mārkaṃḍeyasya kṛṣṇasya pūjanaṃ pracakāra saḥ ||77|| munervacanataḥ samyag vrate cīrṇe’bhavatsukhī | aṣṭādaśaiva kuṣṭhāni tanau naṣṭāni sarvathā ||78|| gato natvā svakaṃ lokaṃ yakṣo bhūtvā yathāyatham | labdhvā patnīṃ punastvevālakāyāṃ nyavasatsukham ||79||| evaṃ śāpanivṛttirvai yoginīvratato bhavet | kuṣṭhādiroganāśaśca patnī naṣṭāpi labhyate ||1.252.8 0|| lokaḥ sthānaṃ gṛhaṃ smṛddhirnaṣṭaṃ vai prāpyate punaḥ | yoginyā vratapuṇyena yogalabhyaṃ lased vratī ||8 1 || idṛgvidhaṃ mahālakṣmi kathitaṃ yoginīvratam | nāryā bhūtvā tu yoginyā yoginā tu nareṇa ca ||82||| kartavyaṃ yogaphaladaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ vratam | aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi sādhūn bhojayate tu yaḥ ||83|| tatsamaṃ phalamāpnoti yoginyā vratavānnaraḥ | yogābhyāsaphaladātrī yogilokapradāyinī ||84|| kṛṣṇayogānmokṣadātrī hyupoṣyā yoginītithiḥ | paṭhanāchravaṇāccāsyāḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||85|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āṣāḍhakṛṣṇayoginyekādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ hemamāliyakṣasya kuberaśāpena jātakuṣṭhādirogasya vratakaraṇena nāśa ityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvipaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 252 ||
<1.253> śrīlakṣmīruvāca kālo māyā tathātmānaḥ śaktayaḥ santi yasya tāḥ | namastasmai bhagavate śaktisvāmiparātmane || 1 || yoginīphaladātre te yogapuṇyaphalātmane | yogilabhyāya yogāya yoginīpataye namaḥ || 2 || tvameva phaladātāsi tvamevāsi ca muktikṛt | tvamevādhipatiścāsi namastasmai mahātmane || 3 || sarvadevasvarūpastvaṃ sarvatīrthātmako’si ca | sarvavratātmakastvaṃ vai tasmai sarvātmane namaḥ || 4 || āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe kiṃnāmnyekādaśī bhavet | ko devaḥ ko vidhistvasyāḥ phalaṃ dānaṃ ca me vada || 5 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca kathayāmi mahāpuṇyāṃ svargamokṣapradāyinīm | śayanīṃ nāma nāmnā tu sarvapāpavināśinīm || 6 || niyamāṃ bhāmikāṃ cāpi tāmeva viddhi nāmataḥ | yasyā vratena pāpātmā pūto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 7 || yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa vājapeyaphalaṃ bhavet | ataḥ parā na cānyāsti svargamokṣapradā śubhā || 8 || asyāstvadhipatirdevo vāmano’sti haristataḥ | kamalākhyapriyāyuktaḥ pūjanīyo hi vāmanaḥ || 9 || vāmanaḥ pūjito yena kamalaiḥ kamalekṣaṇaḥ | niyamākhyaśayanyāṃ tu tenārcitaṃ jagattrayam || 1.253.1 0|| trayo devāḥ pūjitāśca pūjitāḥ sarvadevatāḥ | kṛtā tvekādaśī yena harivāsara uttamaḥ || 11 || āṣāḍhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ śete kṣīranidhau hariḥ | sarvendriyapravāhām̐stu parāvṛtyātiyogataḥ || 12 || tasya pūjā tvapāmārgaiḥ pūrikādinivedanaiḥ | nālikerīphalādyaiśca svarṇagodānapūrvikā || 13 || kartavyā vratinā bhaktyā niyamagrahaṇaṃ tathā | śrūyatāṃ ca mahālakṣmi kathā puṇyapradāyinī || 14|| balirvai dānavaḥ pūrvamāsīt tretāyuge priye | pūjayam̐ścaiva māṃ nityaṃ madbhakto matparāyaṇaḥ || 15|| yajñaistu bahubhirdaityo vidhinā yajati sma mām | parayā snehasadbhaktyā vratopoṣaṇapūjanaiḥ || 16|| evaṃ puṇyaprabhāveṇa mamopāsanayā tathā | rasātalātsamāyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ sa nṛpo’bhavat || 17|| pṛthvyāṃ cāpi mama pūjābalena vardhito’bhavat | svargaṃ tenaiva dehena yayau puṇyaprabhāvataḥ || 18|| kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vaśe svasya svargabhūlokasaṃyutam | indrādayo’pi tasyāgre tvabhavannirbalāḥ surāḥ || 19|| dānavā vardhitāḥ puṣṭāstrilokyāmabhavannṛpāḥ | indrādibhistadā devairarthitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||1.253.20| hariḥ śaṃbhustathā brahmā taistu yuktiḥ parā kṛtā | baliḥ karotu yajñaṃ ca dātā bhavatu cādhvare || 21 || bhūtvā tu bhikṣukaḥ kṛṣṇo mahībhikṣāṃ karotu saḥ | evaṃ tu samayaṃ kṛtvā yajñārthaṃ prairayad balim ||22|| ṛṣayo munayo devā hyahaṃ sarve gatāḥ kṛtau | revatācalasānnidhye yatra yajñaḥ pravartate |||23|| tatra vāmanarūpeṇa hyavatāre hi paṃcame | atimahatsvarūpeṇa sarvabrahmāṇḍayoginā ||24|| vākchalena jito dātā satyamāśritya yaḥ sthitaḥ | śukrastaṃ vārayāmāsa yannārāyaṇa ityaham ||25||| yācitā vasudhā lakṣmi mayā sārdhapadatrayā | saṃkalpodakamātre tu kare tenaiva cārpite |||26||| rūpaṃ brahmāṇḍapūrṇaṃ vai tadā lakṣmi mayā kṛtam | bhūrloke caraṇau nyasya bhuvarloke tu jānunī ||27|| svarloke tu kaṭiṃ kṛtvā maharloke tadodaram | janaloke tu hṛdayaṃ tapoloke galaṃ tathā |||28|| satyaloke mukhaṃ nyasya vairāje mastakaṃ nyadhām | sūryacandragrahatārā nakṣatradhūmraketavaḥ ||29|| devāḥ sendrāśca nāgāśca yakṣagandharvakinnarāḥ | astuvanvedamantraiste sūktaiśca vividhaistadā || 1.253.30|| baliṃ dhṛtvā kare tatra padenāpūritā mahī | dvitīyena svarāptaṃ cāṇḍakaṭāhasamanvitam ||3 1|| tṛtīyaṃ tu baleḥ pṛṣṭhe tadā nyastaṃ padaṃ mayā | gato rasātalaṃ lakṣmi dānavo mama pūjakaḥ ||32|| nyasto rasātale rājye so’pi māmabhajattataḥ | prārthayanmāṃ bhavane sve sadā sthātuṃ sa bhaktarāṭ ||33|| tadāhaṃ vinayī bhūtvā nijabhaktaparāyaṇaḥ | akurvityubhayaṃ rūpaṃ tvekena tadgṛhe sthitaḥ ||34|| apareṇa svarūpeṇa śeṣe śayanamāsthitaḥ | aṣāḍhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ śayanaṃ śramanuttaye || 35|| naimittikaṃ gṛhītaṃ vai mayā tasmāddināttataḥ | bhaktāstāṃ śayanīṃ prāhustvekādaśīṃ supuṇyadām || 36|| ityevaṃ śeṣapṛṣṭhe vai kṣīrasāgaramadhyataḥ | svapimyahaṃ mahālakṣmi yāvadāgāmikārtikī || 37|| cāturmāsyaṃ tu tatproktaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ param | śayanīvratakṛccāpi bhuktiṃmuktimavāpnuyāt ||38 || śayanīṃ tu samārabhya cātumāsyāvadhiṃ pumān | tāvadbhavetsudharmātmā vratādiniyamī yamī || 39||| nātaḥ parataraṃ kiṃcidvrataṃ yāvadvratottamam | yatra svapiti deveśaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ ||1.253.40 || evaṃ yaḥ kurute lakṣmi śayanyāstu vratottamam | sarvapāpaharaṃ cāpi bhuktimuktipradāyakam ||41 || sa tu kṣudro’pi me loke jāyate me priyaṃkaraḥ | daśamyāmekabhuktena naktenāpi suvartayet ||42|| rātrau ca brahmacārī syātprātarvai brāhmasaṃjñake | kāle tūtthāya bhagavatsmaraṇaṃ saṃvidhāya ca ||43||| snātvā devārcanaṃ kṛtvā ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ | pūjāyā naityakaṃ sarvaṃ samāpyātha svayaṃ vratī ||44|| kārayennavadhānyaistu sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam | madhye svarṇaghaṭaṃ pañcaratnapallavasaṃyutam ||45|| jalavastraphalāḍhyaṃ vai sthāpayet taṃ prapūjayet | tilapātraṃ sthāpayitvā vāmanaṃ tatra pūjayet ||46|| kamalāṃ śayanīṃ cāpi pūjayed bahuvastubhiḥ | āvāhanādikaṃ kuryāt pañcāmṛtasusecanam ||47|| vastrālaṃkārabhūṣādihāracandanakajjalam | sarvaśṛṃgārarāgām̐śca tvarpayettilakādikam ||48|| dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalatāmbūlasatphalam | nīrājananamaskārastutibandikṣamāpanam ||49|| visarjanāṃjaliṃ datvā svīyavratasya pūrtaye | nirvighnaṃ me vrataṃ cāstu prārthayedevameva ha ||1.253.50 || baladravyānusāreṇa mahāpūjādi kārayet | maṇḍapaṃ kārayedramyaṃ rājyamaṇḍapasannibham ||51 || vaiṣṇavānpūjayetprātardānāni prārpayettathā | sādhūnāmagrataḥ sthitvā cāturmāsyavratāni ca ||52|| dhārayenniyamām̐ścāpi sukhamokṣakarām̐stadā | jaihvaśaiśnaniyamān saṃgṛhṇīyāttu tapaḥkṛte ||53|| haryagre vā guroragre gṛhṇīyānniyamān vratam | śārīraniyamauṃstadvanmānasānsayamām̐stathā ||54|| bhogyabhautikaniyamānmuktidānniyamānapi | vratāni dānaniyamāngṛhṇīyātprātareva hi ||15|| indriyāṇāṃ manasaśca vṛttīnāṃ saṃyamastapaḥ | abhyāsena tu kartavyaścāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ ||56|| viṣayāḥ parihartavyāḥ kṣobhakā vighnakāriṇaḥ | rasapuṣṭirna vai kāryā yataḥ sā kṣobhikā matā ||57|| raso jaihvyo mahān doṣaḥ sarvendriyasupuṣṭikṛt | jetavyaḥ sa viśeṣeṇa cātumāsyavratārthibhiḥ ||58|| phalāhāraḥ payaḥpānaṃ hyekānnamekabhojanam | śākāhāraḥ śākavarjyo ghṛtatyāgo’thavā tapaḥ ||59|| dadhityāgastilatyāgo dadhiprāśastilādanam | kandāhāraḥ kaṇāhāro bhājāhāro dalādanam ||1.253.60|| jalāhāraḥ śarkarāyāstyāgo gūḍhasya nīrasaḥ | śrāvaṇe śākavarjyaṃ ca bhādre dadhivivarjitam ||6 1|| āśvine dugdhahīnaṃ ca kārtike dvidalojjhitam | bhuñjīta mūlakaṃ kandaṃ vṛntākaṃ na kaliṃgakam ||62|| varjayed vratamevoktaṃ cāturmāsye śubhe tapaḥ | dhāraṇāpāraṇākhyaṃ vā vrataṃ proktaṃ mahāphalam ||63|| maunaṃ dhāryaṃ kathā kāryā harernāmnā ca mālikāḥ | uccāraṇena yuktāścāvartanīyāḥ śataṃmitāḥ ||64|| rūpāṇāṃ darśanaṃ nātikartavyaṃ cakṣuṣorvratam | śabdānāṃ śravaṇaṃ nātikartavyaṃ karṇayorvratam ||65|| gandhāstu rājasā nātigrāhyāstannāsikāvratam | nārīnaramithaḥsparśo nātikāryastvaco vratam ||66|| cāturmāsye sadaikatra vastavyaṃ pādayorvratam | patraśākhādyabhaṃgaśca hastayoḥ paramaṃ vratam ||67|| vīryādeḥ rakṣaṇaṃ tvetad brahmacaryaṃ mahad vratam | vātulaṃ tāmasaṃ nādanīyaṃ daihyaṃ mahattapaḥ ||68 || pañcāgnitapanaṃ vṛkṣālambanaṃ sūryadarśanam | ekapādena saṃsthānaṃ hastasyordhvavidhāpanam || 69|| adhomastakatādhāro nakhādyakartanaṃ tapaḥ | keśānāṃ vardhanaṃ bhasmadhūlīkardamamardanam ||1.253.7 0 || anupānattayā stheyaṃ vivastreṇa viśeṣataḥ | jaladhārātale stheyaṃ jale stheyaṃ tathātape ||7 1 || avitāne sadā stheyaṃ vṛkṣādhovāsa ityapi | bhūmau vāso bhūśayanaṃ vālukāśayanaṃ tathā ||72 || bāṇaśayyā lohaśayyā kaṇṭake śayanaṃ tathā | aśayanamanidrā ca jalapānaṃ tu no punaḥ ||73 || snānaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ caiva mūrteścāpi vicintanam | dhyānaṃ ca smaraṇaṃ cāpi pūjanaṃ pañcadhā dine ||74|| mantrajapastadarthasyābhidhyānaṃ mānasaṃ tapaḥ | aikāgryaṃ dhāraṇā ceti kartavyaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ||75|| ahiṃsā manasā vācā śarīreṇāpi sarvathā | jātyā deśena kālena prasaṃgenāpi varjitā ||76 || tṛṇacchedopi no kāryo vrataṃ cāhiṃsanaṃ hi tat | adrohaḥ sarvabhūtānāmanindā ca mahadvratam ||77|| anyavṛttānavalokanādikaṃ paramaṃ vratam | satyaṃ priyaṃ hitaṃ tathyaṃ sukhakṛdvacanaṃ tapaḥ ||78 || asteyaṃ sarvathā sarvairindriyairmanasā tapaḥ | kāmanāyā vicārasyānudbhavaḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ ||79|| agrāhyaṃ tu na rakṣyaṃ vai kiṃciccāpi mahattapaḥ | bhikṣānirvāha evāstu dehayātrā paraṃ tapaḥ ||1.253.8 0 || yadṛcchayā tu saṃlābhe tvanāsaktirmahattapaḥ | parasaukhyapradātṛtva paropakaraṇaṃ tapaḥ ||8 1 || parārthaṃ ca dayālutvaṃ dehenāpi paraṃ tapaḥ | śaucaṃ jñānajalābhyāṃ ca nairmalyaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ ||82 || akāpaṭyaṃ hṛdi vāci kriyāyāmekatā tapaḥ | santoṣo nātitṛṣṇatvamanāśā paramaṃ tapaḥ ||8 3 || svīye tṛptiḥ parakīye praudāsīnyaṃ paraṃ tapaḥ | mokṣamārgāvalambastu tapasāṃ tapa uttamam ||84|| akleśaḥ sarvadā śāntirakrodhastu mahadvratam | anudvego’nadhikṣepo nākrośo nakalittapaḥ || 85|| aluṃcāgrahaṇaṃ nānyadravyāśā mānasaṃ tapaḥ | īśadatte sadā tṛptiḥ parakīye na vāñcchanā ||86 || bhogyaṃ nāryādikaṃ tyājyaṃ khaṭvāgendukapārśvakam | sugandhastailamardādi bhūṣaṇaṃ ca surūpaṇam ||87|| vastraśṛṃgārasantyāgo bhogatyāgo viśeṣataḥ | bhogyasādhanasaṃtyāgo dehināṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ ||88 || yānavāhanadhūmrādipānadyūtasunāṭanam | vyasanaṃ miṣṭapānaṃ ca tyājyaṃ ceti paraṃ tapaḥ ||89 || cāturmāsye pratipātaḥ sādhūnāṃ caraṇāmṛtam | pātavyaṃ ca prasādaśca bhakṣaṇīyaṃ itivratam || 1.253.90 || sādhūnāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā | pādayormardanaṃ tvaṃgavāhanaṃ muktidaṃ vratam || 91 || dehena manasā vāṇyā dhanenānnena vāsasā | putreṇa priyayā sākaṃ toṣaṇaṃ vai mahadvratam || 92|| darśanaṃ sparśanaṃ nityaṃ namanaṃ pādasevanam | pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ sādhostoṣaṇaṃ tanmahadvratam ||9 3 || satāṃ nikaṭe saṃvāsaḥ snānajñānakriyādiṣu | śuśrūṣaṇaṃ sadā kāryaṃ pāvanāḥ sādhavo yataḥ || 94|| devasevā pitṛsevā sādhusevā mahāvratam | patnītoṣaḥ svāmisevā vrataṃ patyuḥ pratoṣaṇam || 95|| yasyāpekṣitamevaitaddātavyaṃ premagarbhitam | akṣayaṃ tasya puṇyaṃ syāt tasmānnāsti paraṃ vratam || 96|| svāśritānāṃ toṣaṇaṃ ca svarṇānnajñānakārpaṇam | grāmakṣetramaṇiratnodyānālayajalārpaṇam ||97 || dehena sevanaṃ nityaṃ sārvabhaumaṃ vrataṃ bhavet | kṣamā dayānasūyā cānīrṣyā doṣavivarjanam || 98|| guṇagrāho yaśaḥkīrtikāritā paramaṃ tapaḥ | amānitvaṃ mānadatvaṃ samānātmāvalokanam ||99|| anauṣṇyaṃ vaiparītye’pi śaityaṃ nāpyanukūlake | harṣāmarṣabhayodvegavarjanaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ || 1.253.100 || phaladhānyadalapatrapuṣpakaṇatṛṇādikam | arpaṇīyaṃ śrīharaye navaṃ nityaṃ vrataṃ mahat || 101 || kāṣṭhakarīṣaśākhāpraśākhānālakaraṇḍakam | pratyahaṃ tvarpaṇīyaṃ tad yathāyogyaṃ śubhaṃ vratam || 10 2|| śākapākasumiṣṭānnalavaṇārdrakadhānakam | bharjitaṃ taṇḍulādyaṃ ca deyaṃ nityaṃ tu tad vratam || 103 || khādyaṃ peyaṃ bhakṣyabhojye coṣyaṃ svādyaṃ ca lehyakam | dugdhaṃ dadhi raso miṣṭaḥ kaṇā deyā vrataṃ mahat || 10 4|| vastraṃ bhūṣā kajjalaṃ candanaṃ cāttaramuttamam | kastūrī kuṃkumaṃ cūrṇaṃ deyaṃ tvalaktakaṃ vratam || 105 || etāni svargadānyatra sukhadāni vratāni vai | śrīhareḥ smaraṇaṃ bhaktiḥ pūjanaṃ ca nivedanam || 106 || dvātriṃśadbhirupacārairarcanaṃ muktidaṃ vratam | paropakaraṇaṃ kṛṣṇabuddhyā puṇyapradaṃ vratam || 1 07|| yajanaṃ vividhairyajñairdīnānāṃ ca sahāyatā | kūpānāṃ khananaṃ vṛkṣāropaṇaṃ cāpi tad vratam || 108 || mārgāṇāṃ cāpi nirmāṇaṃ tvāśramasthalabandhanam | āśrayasatraśālādinirmāṇaṃ svargadaṃ vratam || 109 || kalākauśalyaśikṣā ca kṛṣyuttejanamityapi | yantravāhopakārādi svargadaṃ sukhadaṃ vratam || 1.253.110 || matsyapipīlīkādīnāṃ piṣṭadānaṃ sadāvratam | vṛkṣāṇāṃ jalrasekaśca tṛṣitānāṃ jalārpaṇam || 111 || kṣudhitānāṃ bhojyadānaṃ nagnānāṃ vāsaso’rpaṇam | ārtānāṃ vividhānāṃ tu tadārtiśamanaṃ vratam || 11 2 || rogiṇāmoṣadhadānaṃ vṛttidānaṃ ca jīvikā | poṣaṇaṃ pālanaṃ cāpi rakṣaṇaṃ paramaṃ vratam || 113 || nityamadhyātmayogasyābhyasanaṃ śāstravācanam | kṛṣṇakathāśravaṇaṃ ca mokṣadaṃ paramaṃ vratam || 114 || daṇḍavacca namaskārāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ ca tad vratam | dīpadānaṃ vāridānaṃ naivedyādyarpaṇaṃ vratam || 115 || nityaṃ phalārpaṇaṃ dhānyārpaṇaṃ cāpi rasārpaṇam | śarkarākhaṇḍikāgūḍamadhvādyarpaṇakaṃ vratam || 11 6|| mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ svacchīkaraṇaṃ maṃjanaṃ vratam | pātravastrakṣālanaṃ ca nīrājanasamarpaṇam || 11 7|| netrairmūrteḥ prapānaṃ ca prapāsatrādicālanam | mandirāgryayasusaudhādinirmāṇaṃ paramaṃ vratam || 118 || citrādyaṃ śilpitādyaṃ ca vayanaṃ bhagavatkṛte | grathanaṃ grantharacanaṃ chandaślokādivarṇanam || 119 || vyākhyānaṃ kathanaṃ bhaktavāñcchāpūraṇakaṃ vratam | sukhadaṃ svargadaṃ mokṣapradaṃ copakṛtirvratam || 1.253.120 || vratānyanyāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇu lakṣmi tapāṃsi vai | cāturmāsye kathā śravyā bhojanīyāśca sādhavaḥ || 121 || nityaṃ kāryā mahāpūjā vratatrayaṃ susiddhidam | śrīkṛṣṇasya mahāpūjā nityaṃ kāryā mahadvratam || 122 || śatādisaṃkhyayā mālāvartanaṃ mama nāmataḥ | bhaktapūjā havirhomo’rcāsevā mokṣadaṃ vratam || 123|| ahantāmamatātyāgo brahmacaryaprapālanam | pāyasaikṣavalāvaṇyaphāleyavarjanaṃ vratam || 124|| kṛṣṇasambandhidharmo yastadavrataṃ me paraṃ matam | kṛtena vratinā yena bhagavām̐stajjanāstathā || 125| prīyeram̐stadvrataṃ proktaṃ kartavyaṃ tu tadeva yat | kārtike śuklapakṣe’tha dvādaśyāṃ devapūjanam || 126|| kṛtvā bhagavatastvagre nivedyaṃ bhaktibhāvataḥ | idaṃ vrataṃ mayā deva kṛtaṃ tvatprītaye prabho || 127||| nyūnaṃ sampūrṇatāṃ yātu tena tuṣṭo bhavermayi | evaṃ samāpya niyamān pāraṇāmācarettataḥ || 128||| prātaḥsnānaṃ devapūjāṃ nityaṃ vṛddhābhivandanam | saṃvibhajyāśritānāṃ ca bhojanādividhāpanam || 129|| akleśaśca sumelaśca kuṭumbe snehitā tvati | miṣṭaṃ ceṣṭaṃ gṛhaṃ yasya svargaṃ tasyāsti bhūtale || 1.253.130 || vrateṣu yadvrataṃ cāturmāsye’tivāñchitam bhavet | kartavyaṃ tacchayanīprabhātamārabhya sarvathā || 131 || madhyāhṇe haraye dadyād bhojanaṃ sujalaṃ tathā | tāmbūlaṃ miṣṭapānaṃ ca sāyaṃ cāpi tathācaret || 1 32|| ārārtrikaṃ stavanaṃ ca dolārohaṇamityapi | āndolayeddhariṃ tatra bhojayeddugdhapūrikāḥ || 1 33|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānnṛtyagītakathāmṛtaiḥ | dvādaśyāṃ brāhmakāle ca snātvā kṛṣṇārcanaṃ caret | 134 dānāni svarṇamukhyāni dadyāt kuryācca pāraṇām | bhojayettu sataḥ sādhvīstoṣayedvinayānvitaḥ || 135||| evaṃ tvāṣādaśuklāyā vrataṃ saniyamaṃ śubham | kartavyaṃ sarvayajñānāṃ phaladaṃ bhuktimuktidam || 136 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āṣāḍhaśuklaśayanyekādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ vāmanāvatārakṛtaśayanaṃ cāturmāsye cāpi yamaniyamasaṃyamavratadamanatapaḥ śoṣaṇatyāgasevanadānopakārādisadvratādi ceti nirūpaṇanāmā tripaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 253 ||
<1.254> śrīlakṣmīruvāca śrīkṛṣṇasya hareryogāt sarvaṃ bhavati nirguṇam | svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ cāpi caturbāhusvarūpadam || 1 || yatkiṃcitkarma kāmyaṃ vā phalecchāvidhuraṃ ca vā | kṛṣṇatuṣṭyai kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ golokapradameva tat || 2 || tadvrataṃ sā kriyā ramyā sa dharmastattu pūjanam | yena tuṣṭo bhavetsvāmī harikṛṣṇaḥ satāṃ patiḥ || 3 || cāturmāsyavrataṃ tadvai yena tuṣyati mādhavaḥ | yamāśca niyamāste vai yena tuṣṭo hyadhokṣajaḥ || 4 || vada śrāvaṇakṛṣṇe me kiṃnāmnyekādaśī matā | ko devaḥ ko vidhistasyāḥ kiṃ puṇyaṃ kathaya prabho || 5 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi ca te vakṣye lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā | śrāvaṇaikādaśī kṛṣṇā kāmikā nāma nāmataḥ || 6 || acyuto vijayāyuktaḥ sampūjyastatra bhaktitaḥ | puṣpeṣu pārijātāni bilvamarghye phalaṃ matam || 7 || śatacchidrādi naivedye dānaṃ strīpuṃsuvastrayoḥ | deyaṃ tu vratinā sarvamacyutapremakārakam || 8 || na gaṃgāyāṃ na ca kāśyāṃ naimiṣe na na puṣkare | satphalaṃ labhyate yadvai phalaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapūjanāt || 9 || godāvaryāṃ gurau siṃhe vyatīpāte ca daṇḍake | yatphalaṃ labhyate tasmādadhikaṃ phalamucyate || 1.254.10 || sasāgaravanopetāṃ yo dadāti vasundharām | kāmikāvratavāṃstasmādadhikaṃ phalamaśnute || 11 || dhenuṃ sopaskarāṃ dadyād yastu cobhayatomukhīm | tato’dhikaṃ phalaṃ tasya jāyate kāmikāvratāt || 12|| śrāvaṇe śrīdharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayed yo vratī janaḥ | tena saṃpūjitā devā gandharvoragapannagāḥ || 1 3|| saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ kāmikāvratamuttamam | tatpāraprāpakaṃ potaṃ vidyate harinirmitam || 14|| adhyātmavidyāprāpyaṃ ca phalaṃ vai kāmikāvratāt | sajāgaraṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā durgatiṃ naiva gacchati || 15|| na paśyati yamaṃ raudraṃ kuyoniṃ naiva vindati | kāmikāvratapuṇyena kaivalyaṃ yogino yayuḥ || 16|| tulasīprabhavaiḥ patrairyo janaḥ pūjayeddharim | lipyate na sa pāpena padmapatramivāṃbhasā || 17|| suvarṇaṃ bhāramekaṃ ca rajataṃ ca caturguṇam | arpyate tatphalāvāptistulasīdalapūjanāt || 18 || raktamauktikavaidūryapravālādibhirarcitaḥ | na tuṣyati tathā kṛṣṇastulasīdalato yathā || 1 9|| tulasīmaṃjarībhiḥ saṃpūjito yena mādhavaḥ | anekajanmapāpāni tasya yānti hi saṃkṣayam || 1.254.20 || yā dṛṣṭā pāpaśamanī spṛṣṭā dehasya pāvanī | stutā roganirasanī siktāntakanivāriṇī || 21 || ropitā kṛṣṇacaraṇapratyāsattividhāyinī | arpitā muktiphaladā tattulasyai namo namaḥ || 22|| ityuktvā tulasīṃ dadyād devāya paramātmane | kṛṣṇāgre dīpako yasya jvalatyekādaśītithau || 23 || pitarastasya tṛpyanti hyamṛtena divi sthitāḥ | dīpadānaṃ tu śikhare kartavyaṃ vai harerdine || 24|| tasya puṇyasya saṃkhyāṃ tu viṣṇuścāpi na vettyalam | ghṛtasya tilatailasya dīpī deyo hi mandire || 25 || dātā prayāti dyulokaṃ dīpakoṭiśatojjvalaḥ | brahmahatyāpaharaṇī mahāpuṇyaphalapradā ||26 || tridivasthānadātrī ca bhrūṇahatyādināśinī | kartavyaikādaśī kāmapūraṇī śraddhayā priye || 27|| vratakartā pāvano vai bhūtvā bhaktisamanvitaḥ | viṣṇulokamavāpnoti bhuṃkte sukhaṃ tu śāśvatam || 28 || daśamyāmekabhojī syād bhūśāyī ca bhavenniśi | brahmacārī bhaveccaiva prātarutthāya ca vratī || 29 || snātvā nityārcanaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍapaṃ kārayecchubham | dhānyaiśca sarvatobhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ kārayettataḥ ||2.254.30 || acyutasya svarṇamūrtiṃ vijayāsahitasya vai | pūjayedvidhinā tatrāvāhanādibhirādarāt || 31 || pañcāmṛtairjalaiścāpi snapayenmārjayettataḥ | vastrabhūṣādyalaṃkāraśṛṃgāraiśca praśobhitām || 32 || sthāpayitvā tilapātre nyasyetpātraṃ ghaṭopari | pañcaratnasupallavaphalavārisamanvitam || 33 || bhojayed vividhairbhojyaistāmbūlādi samarpayet | nīrājayet stutiṃ pradakṣiṇāṃjalī samarpayet||| 34|| nirvidhnaṃ me vrataṃ bhūyādityevamarthayeddharim | madhyāhne’pi sumiṣṭānnaistarpayedacyutaṃ vratī || 35|| sāyaṃ cāpi tathā kuryānmahāpūjādikaṃ vratī | bhojayetpūjayedāndolayedaṃgāni mardayet || 36|| jāgaraṇaṃ prakuryācca dvādaśyāṃ prātareva tu | snātvārcayitvā dānāni dadyācca vividhāni vai || 37|| sataḥ sādhvīrbhojayecca bālān kuryācca pāraṇām | sukāmikāvrataṃ tvevaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 38 || dhanārthī dhanamāpnoti putrārthī labhate sutam | bhāryārthī tvāpnuyād bhāryāṃ svāmikāmā patiṃ labhet || 39 || gṛhakṣetrapaśusmṛddhidhānyārthī labhate tu tat | kīrtyārogyasusammānarājyasattārthī tallabhet | 2.254.40 || dharmārthakāmamokṣārthī vrataṃ kṛtvārjayettu tat | śatrūpadravavighnāttikṣayārthī tatkṣayaṃ vrajet || 41 || evaṃ sarvapradaṃ tvetat kāmikāvratamuttamam | svargadaṃ satyadaṃ tadvai tathā vairājalokadam ||42|| golokadaṃ vrataṃ caitadakṣarapradamuttamam | sarvasiddhipradaṃ tvasyā ākhyānaṃ śṛṇu pūrvajam || 43 || śravaṇāḥ pitaraḥ pūrvaṃ dharmarājakulodbhavāḥ | dharmeṇa yojitāḥ prāṇivṛttāntānayanāya te ||44 || yatra gacchanti jīvānāṃ vṛttāntānayanāya te | na śṛṇvanti na paśyanti karma sūkṣmāt susūkṣmakam ||45|| na jānanti ca vṛttāntaṃ tvānayeyuḥ kathaṃ tu te | ajānanto yama te nivedayeyuḥ kathaṃ tadā ||46 || iti cintāparā sarve militvāhuryamaṃ puraḥ | sūkṣmakarmakṛtāṃ sarvaṃ yathā vidmo vayaṃ tathā || 47 || dharmarāja vidhehyeva jānīmo jīvakarma yat | vayaṃ dvādaśasaṃkhyākā jīvāścāsaṃkhyakoṭayaḥ ||48 || kathaṃ kutra bhaved vyāptirasmākaṃ siddhimantarā | tasmāt siddhiṃ pradehi tvaṃ yadvā darśaya tattapaḥ || 49 || yena syāma tavāgre vai sarvāvedanaśaktayaḥ | śrutvā yamastu tānprāha sevadhvaṃ kāmikāvratam ||2.254.50 || śrāvaṇe kṛṣṇapakṣe sā kāmikaikādaśī matā | sarvakāmasusaṃsiddhiyātrī tvaiśvaryasamprada || |5 1 || vidhiṃ śrutvā kāmikāyā vratasya śravaṇāstataḥ | cakrurvrataṃ kāmikāyā dadurdānāni bhūriśaḥ ||5 2 || dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇākāle prasanno dharmarājakaḥ | svayaṃ viprasvarūpeṇātithirbhūtvā samāgataḥ || 53 || bhikṣāṃ dehīti sūccārya tasthau tvaṃgaṇabhūtale | śravaṇairarpitāṃ bhikṣāṃ jagrāha bahubhāvataḥ ||54 || varaṃ vṛṇuta bho kṣatrāḥ prasanno’smi vratena vaḥ | ityāha tān dharmadevo’cyutasya janakaḥ svayam ||55 || prāhuste śravaṇā taṃ vai jīvānāṃ sūkṣmakarmakam | yathā jānīma evātra sārvajñyaṃ dehi tadvidham ||56 || dūraśravaṇamevāpi dūradarśanamityapi | guptakartavyavettṛtvaṃ bahurūpadhṛtiṃ tathā ||57 || sarvadeśādisaṃstheṣu jīveṣu vyāpitāṃ tathā | sarveṣāṃ sarvathā sarvavettṛtvaśaktimuttamām || 58 || śāśvatīṃ tatsmṛtiṃ cāpi yathārthāṃ dehi yadyathā | śrutvaivaṃ dharmarājastu samuvāca tu tām̐stadā || 59 || kāmikāyā vrataṃ yuṣmābhiḥ kṛtaṃ tatphalaṃ bahu | sarvasiddhimayaṃ ceṣṭapradaṃ labdhaṃ yato hyaham || 2.254.60 || dadāmi sarvasiddhīśca tathā yūyaṃ bhavantviti | īśavatsarvadā sarvajīvānāmitivṛttajam || 61 || sarvaṃ jñānaṃ bhavatsveva bhavatviti dadāmyaham | evaṃ varaṃ paraṃ datvā dharmarājastirodadhe || 62 || śravaṇā dvādaśasaṃkhyāstata āramya sarvadā | asaṃkhyarūpadhartāro jīvakarma nivedakāḥ || 63 || sarvajñā iva saṃjātāścitraguptāgrataḥ sadā | nivedayanti vṛttāntaṃ mṛtānāṃ pūrvagāminām || 64|| sarvakāmaphalaṃ prāptāḥ kāmikāyā vratena te | sarvasiddhipradā tasmātkartavyā kāmikā janaiḥ || 65 || śṛṇu tvanyakathāṃ lakṣmi rate rjātāṃ purā yathā | śaṃkareṇa yadā dagdhaḥ kāmadevo himālaye || 66 || kāmapatnī ratirjātā vidhavā patimantarā | bahu sā pīḍitā jātā vaidhavyārttyatikarṣitā || 67|| śaṃkaraṃ prati gatvā sā prāha nātha kṛpāṃ kuru | patiṃ vinā tu me prāptaṃ hyamāṃgalyaṃ duḥkhapradam ||68 || tanme vināśayārttinyāḥ śaṃbho śaṃ kuru yoṣitaḥ | śrutvā śaṃbhuśca tāṃ prāha kāmikāyā vrataṃ kuru || 69 || amāṃgalyaṃ sadā te vai dūraṃ yāsyati niścitam | adeho’pi patiste vai ratisthāne miliṣyati || 2.254.70 || avaidhavyamamāṃgalyaṃ sarvaṃ te yāsyati kṣayam | kṛṣṇaputrastu vai pradyumnanāmā te patistataḥ ||7 1 || suśarīro’tisaubhāgyavatyā vai prāpsyate tvayā | śrutvaivaṃ sā kāmikāyā vrataṃ cakre ratirmudā ||7 2 || vidhivacca dadau sarvadānāni bahubhaktitaḥ | śaṃbhustu pāraṇākāle bhūtvā bhikṣuka eva ha ||7 3 || samāyayau subhikṣārthaṃ tayā bhikṣā samarpitā | bhuktvā prāha tataḥ śaṃbhurvaraṃ yācasva dadmyaham ||74|| kāmikāyā vratenāsmi prasannaḥ śaṃkaraḥ svayam | śrutvā ratistadā prāha patiṃ kāmaṃ pradehi me ||75|| tathāstviti samuccāryādṛśyo’bhūcchaṃkarastataḥ | ratyā labdhaḥ patiḥ svasyā ratyāḥ kāle pratisthale ||76|| bhūte bhūte sarvayonau pati prāptaḥ sa maithune | mūrtaḥ pradyumnanāmāpi prāptaḥ kṛṣṇasutastataḥ ||77|| evaṃ vrataprabhāveṇa ratiḥ saubhāgyatāṃ gatā | brahmāṇḍaprāṇiṣu vyāptiṃ prāptā siddhiṃ tu śāśvatīm ||78|| vrataṃ tvevaṃ kāmikāyāḥ sarvakāmaprasādhakam | sarvasaṃkalpasiddhidhṛk sarvasmṛddhipradāyakam ||79|| sarvārttināśakaṃ saumyaṃ svargamokṣapradaṃ śubham | sarvayajñaphaladātṛ yogasiddhikaraṃ tathā ||2.254.80|| naṣṭavastupradaṃ cāpi sadaiśvaryapradaṃ mahat | ratidaṃ kāmadaṃ patnīpradaṃ svāmipradaṃ tathā ||8 1|| duḥkhaghnaṃ tvārttiśamanaṃ kāmabhogasukhapradam | vighnanāśakaraṃ vāñchāpūrakaṃ narayoṣitām ||82|| kartavyaṃ sarvathā lakṣmi cāvaidhavyakaraṃ param | ratiśaktikāmaśaktisiddhidaṃ kāmyamityapi ||83|| niṣkāmānāṃ tu vaikuṇṭhaprāpakaṃ puṇyabhājanam | lakṣāśvamedhayajñānāṃ puṇyadaṃ śravaṇādapi ||84|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śrāvaṇakṛṣṇakāmikaikādaśīmāhātmyaṃ śravaṇākhyapitṝṇāṃ sarvasiddhiprāptiḥ rateśca kāmākhyapatiprāptiśceti nirūpaṇanāmā catuḥpaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 254 ||
<1.255> śrīlakṣmīruvāca sarvakāmapradaḥ kṛṣṇo harirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam | phaladātā sukhadātā vratapūrtikaraḥ sa hi || 1 || śraddhayā tvāpyate puṇyaṃ śraddhāyāṃ sa sadā sthitaḥ | bhāvanāsahito viṣṇuḥ phalatyeva vratāśrayaḥ || 2 || mokṣado mādhavo devaḥ sādhane vasati dhruvam | sādhanāni vinā taṃ vai no phalaṃ dadati kvacit || 3 || sa eva sarvathārādhyo viṣṇurnārāyaṇo hariḥ | lakṣmīśaśca rameśaśca śrīśo dhvajadhanuḥkaraḥ || 4 || kṛpayā vada me matsyasvastikacihnahastaka | svāminprabhāṣate pārvatīpate māṇikīśvara || 5 || śrāvaṇaśuklapakṣasyaikādaśī nāmatastu kā | kau vidhiḥ kiṃ phalaṃ tasyāḥ ko devo’rcyo vrate’tra vai || 6 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ekādaśī putradākhyā śrāvaṇasya sitā matā | śrīdharaḥ pūjanīyo’tra kāntimatyā saha prabhuḥ || 7 || kamalaiḥ pūjanīyo’sau bhojanīyastvapūpakaiḥ | arghyaḥ sītāphalaiḥ kṛṣṇo dātavyaṃ pādukādvayam || 8 || lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā dānaṃ mataṃ śubham | śrotavyāsyāḥ kathā divyā bhuktimuktipradāyinī || 9 || daśamyāmekabhojī syād brahmacārī bhavettathā | rātrau bhūśayanaṃ kuryādekādaśyāṃ prage vratī || 1.255.1 0|| snātvā nityaṃ mahāpūjāṃ kṛtvā vai maṇḍapāntare | maṇḍale sarvatobhadre sthāpite kānake ghaṭe || 11 || pañcaratnāmbaravāripatrākṣataphalānvite | tilasthālīṃ sthāpayitvā śrīdharaṃ sthāpayettataḥ || 12|| pūjayetsarvabhāvena ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ | āvāhanādikaṃ kuryāt paṃcāmṛtābhiṣecanam || 13|| vastrābhūṣaṇaśṛṃgārakajjalacandanāttaraiḥ | puṣpahārākṣatacūrṇaphalatāmbūlabhojanaiḥ || 14|| ārārtrikastutidaṇḍavatpradakṣiṇadīpanaiḥ | pūjayitvā hariṃ nirvighnaṃ vrataṃ prārthayet tataḥ || 15|| madhyāhne bhojanaṃ dadyāttāmbūlaṃ ca jalaṃ tathā | sāyaṃ dadyād dugdhapākaṃ pūrikāḥ śākamityāpe || 16|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt kathākīrtananartanaiḥ | dvādaśyāṃ tu prage snā tvā pūjayitvā ca mādhavam || 17|| dadyāddānāni sarvāṇi yathāśakti yathādhanam | bhojayet sādhuviprāṃśca sādhvīrbālām̐śca bālikāḥ || 18|| tato vai svajanān bhojayitvā svaḥ pāraṇāṃ caret | evaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavetpuṇyaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ bhuktimukti dam || 1 9|| dhanadhānyasutadārākṣetrodyānagṛhādikam | ārogyamānakīrtyādi labhate tu vratī śubham || 1.255.20 || śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ divyāṃ yābhūsūpūrve kṛte yuge | rājā pururavā nāmnā babhūva candrapautrakaḥ ||21 || budhaputraḥ pururavā rājyaṃ pālayati svakam | śrīpure narmadātīre vasati sma nirantaram || 22|| tasya guṇān devamukhācchrutvorvaśī varāṃganā | apsarāḥ svayamāgatya patnīrūpā hyupasthitā ||23|| bahukāle gate’pyasyāmapatyaṃ na vyajāyata | putrahīnasya tasyaiva na tadrājyaṃ sukhapradam || 24|| aputrasya sukhaṃ nāsti loke’smim̐śca paratra ca | evaṃ cintayatastasya kālo bahutaro gataḥ || 25|| na prāptaśca suto rājñā tena duḥkhāyate sukham | svarājyapaṇḍitān vṛddhānāhūyāveditaṃ hi tat || 26|| iha janmani bho viprā na mayā pātakaṃ kṛtam | anyāyopārjitaṃ dravyaṃ mayā kośe na yojitam || 27|| brahmadravyaṃ ca devasvaṃ vidhavānāthaḍhabbukam | api mayā gṛhītaṃ na dattaṃ pratyuta sarvadā || 28|| putravatpālito lokaḥ prajā dharmeṇa rakṣitā | yuddhena vijitā pṛthvī daṇḍo duṣṭeṣu pātitaḥ ||29||| anyāyo na kṛtasteṣu sutabandhuprajāsu ca | pūjyāḥ supūjitā nityaṃ sadā vṛddhāstu vanditāḥ || 1.255.30 || na dviṣṭā nyāyamārgasthāḥ pūjitā devatāḥ sadā | viprāśca sādhavaḥ sādhvyo gāvo dīnāśca pūjitāḥ || 31 || dravyayajñā jñānayajñāḥ kṛtāḥ śiṣṭaprasaṃgataḥ | tathāpi madgṛhe putro na jātastad vimṛśyatām || 32 || itivākyaṃ dvijāḥ śrutvā savṛddhāḥ sapurohitāḥ | nṛpaterhitamicchanto jagmuste lomaśamṛṣim || 33 || kalpe kalpe gate yasya lomaikantu viśīryate | evaṃ lomaśanāmnā sa rūḍhyā prasiddhimāpa ha || 34|| tapantaṃ ghorasutapo nirāhāraṃ nirīhakam | śāntaṃ sudharmatattvajñaṃ śāstravedaviśāradam || 35 || dīrghāyuṣaṃ trikālajñaṃ jaṭāśmaśrusuśobhitam | mahātmānaṃ dvijā dṛṣṭvā bhāgyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ hi menire || 3 6|| brahmātmānaṃ muniṃ natvāgrataḥ saṃharṣitāḥ sthitāḥ | tāṃstathā sāgrajān vīkṣya muniḥ provāca lomaśaḥ || 37 || kathaṃ kimarthamāyātā brāhmaṇā vṛddhasevakāḥ | yatkiṃcitsumahatsvalpaṃ sādhyaṃ tvasādhyamityapi || 38 || labhyaṃ cālabhyamevāpi brāhmaṇārthe karomyaham | asaṃśayaṃ kathayadhvaṃ kariṣye bhavatāṃ hitam || 39 || brāhmaṇānāṃ vaco vedaḥ parameśvaranodanā | pālayitvā tu vo vākyaṃ tvavāpsye janmanaḥ phalam ||1.255.40 || paropakṛtaye janma tapasvināṃ na saṃśayaḥ | aho’dya saphalaṃ janma kariṣye viprasevayā ||41 || itikṛtvā cakārāsāvātithyaṃ pūjanādi ca | jalaṃ phalāsanādīni dadau pūjyo’pi śiṣṭakṛt ||42 || tato viprāstu taṃ prāhuḥ śrūyatāṃ hṛdgataṃ tu naḥ | saṃśayasya nirāsāya vayaṃ svārthaparā prabho ||43 || iha kāryavaśātprāptāḥ samīpaṃ bhavato vayam | satāṃ saṃdarśanātpūrvabhavīyāghādiśevadhiḥ ||44|| bhasmībhavati drāgeva kiṃ punaḥ pādasevanāt | padmayoniṃ vinā tvanyastvattaḥ śreṣṭho na vidyate ||45|| bahujño’si bahukalpī bahuvettā samādhimān | bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ jāyamānaṃ bahu vetsi tapobalāt ||46|| sarvaṃ dātuṃ samartho’si brahmātmaikyabalānmune | nṛpaḥ pururavāstvatra putrahīno’sti sāmpratam ||47|| vayaṃ viprāḥ prajāstasya putravatpālitāḥ sadā | putrahīnaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā tasya duḥkhena duḥkhitāḥ ||48|| duḥkhanistārakartustu bhavataḥ pādayorvayam | chāyāyāṃ tvāgatāḥ smo’tra yogyaṃ rājñi vidhīyatām ||49|| tasya bhāgyena dṛṣṭo’si hyasmābhistvaṃ tapodhana | mahatāṃ darśanenaiva kāryasiddhirbhavennṛṇām ||1.255.50 || vad putraḥ kathaṃ nāsti kenopāyena vā bhavet | iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā muhūrtaṃ dhyānamāptavān ||51|| lomaśaḥ pratyuvācaitān prāgjanma nṛpatestadā | pūrvajanmani vaiśyo’sau vardhamānābhidho dhanī |||52|| vāṇijyakarmanirato lobhena janaśoṣakṛt | grāmādgrāmāntaraṃ yāti vastuvyāpārakāṃkṣayā ||53|| jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe daśamīdivase tu saḥ | madhyāhne tvātape prāpto grāmasīmni jalāśayam ||54|| khātṃ tu sajalaṃ caikamātrāvatāraśobhitam | tatrāvatāre gatvā sa niṣasāda kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ||55|| hastapādau mukhaṃ svasya prakṣālayati yatkṣaṇe | tāvattatra samāyātā savatsā gaustṛṣākulā ||56|| nidāghārtā bhayayuktā ghaṭṭe’vatarati drutam | pītagaṇḍūṣamātrāṃ tāṃ vārayitvā tu tāmasaḥ ||57|| toyaṃ papau svayaṃ snātvā vastraprakṣālanaṃ vyadhāt | ciraṃ tatra sthito mārgaṃ gave pātuṃ dadāti na ||58|| savatsā tṛṣitā sāpi ciraṃ mārgaṃ pratīkṣate | tathāpi na dhanī sthānād yayau vai ghaṭikāṣṭakam ||19|| vatsā saṃtṛṣitā prāha mātaraṃ janani mama | prāṇā yānti tṛṣāduḥkhād dūraṃ yāsyatyayaṃ kadā ||1.255.60|| gomātā prāha tāṃ vatsāṃ yāsyatyayaṃ kṣaṇāntare | tāvaddhairyaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ pāsyāvo’mbhaḥ kṣaṇāntare ||6 1|| nāpasṛto dhanī tasmād vatsākaṇṭho’pi śuṣkatām | prāpat tadā gavā proktaṃ duṣṭo’yaṃ yāti naiva tu ||62|| prāṇāḥ prayānti me putryāḥ pāmi prasahya vai jalam | nirṇīyetthaṃ tu vatsāṃ svāṃ nītvā hyavātatāra gauḥ ||62|| vardhamāno dhanī tāṃ tu bhṛśaṃ yaṣṭyā hyatāḍayat | tadā śapto gavā śreṣṭhin duṣṭa tāḍayasi vṛthā ||64|| anapatyaḥ sadā janmajanmāntareṣu vai bhava | patnyā virahito’raṇye duḥkhito bahudhā bhava ||65|| śaptvā padbhyāṃ ca śṛṃgābhyāṃ tāḍayitvā prasahya tam | dhaninaṃ dūrataḥ kṛtvā śāntyā gauḥ sujalaṃ papau ||66|| vatsā jalaṃ papau śāntyā vaṇijo niryayau tataḥ | gavā tu tāḍitaścārto grāmaṃ prāpya mamāra saḥ ||67|| mṛtyoḥ pūrvaṃ dhanaṃ sarvaṃ yajñārthaṃ dattavānasau | viprairyajñaḥ kṛtaścāpi tena puṇyena vardhanaḥ ||68|| jāto’yaṃ nṛpatistvatra nāmnā purūravā iti | goḥ śāpenānapatyo’sti putrabhāgyavihīnakaḥ |||69|| janmajanmāntareṣvasya nāsti putro hi śāpataḥ | patnyā saha viyogo’pi bhaviṣyatyasya kālataḥ ||1.255.70|| śrutvaitadbrāhmaṇāḥ prāhuḥ pāpakṣayastu puṇyataḥ | śāpanivāraṇaṃ cāpi bhavādṛśaprasādataḥ ||71|| asādhyaṃ nāsti te kiṃñcitputro bhavatu bhūpateḥ | puṇyakāryaṃ śādhi naśca dhruvaṃ rājā kariṣyati ||72|| lomaśaḥ prāha tānsarvān vicārya balavadvratam | śrāvaṇe śuklapakṣe tu putradā nāma viśrutā ||73|| ekādaśī vāñchitadā kurudhvaṃ tadvrataṃ dvijāḥ | rājā rājñī tathā yūyaṃ vrataṃ kuruta bhāvataḥ ||74|| lakṣagavāṃ pradānaṃ ca putradāyā dine prage | purūravāḥ prakarotu tataḥ putro bhaviṣyati ||75|| ekavrate kṛte lakṣagavāṃ dāne suto’dvayaḥ | bhaviṣyatyeva me vākyānnṛpaḥ karotu vāñchitam ||76|| ityājñāṃ śirasi dhṛtvā yayuḥ śrīnagaraṃ dvijāḥ | rājñā saha vrataṃ cakruryathāvidhisajāgaram ||77|| lakṣagavāṃ tadā dānaṃ kṛtaṃ pātrebhya eva ca | tena puṇyena sā rājñī garbhaṃ dadhāra śobhanam ||78|| kintu pūrvaṃ yadā svargādāyātābhūt patikṛte | tadā tayā kṛtastvāsītsamayaḥ sthitaye ciram ||79|| nagnaṃ nṛpaṃ vilokyāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi gṛhāttataḥ | athātrāvasare rātrau nṛpaṃ vīkṣya vivastrakam ||1.255.80 || prayātā sā vanaṃ tatra yayau purūravā hyanu | antarvatnī tu sāraṇye vahnisthālīsvarūpiṇī ||8 1 || suṣuve susutaṃ jātavedasaṃ hi vibhāvasum | ekādaśyā vratenaivaṃ vahniḥ putro’sya cābhavat ||8 2 || evaṃ vai putradāścaikādaśyaścānyāstu ṣaṭkṛtāḥ | lakṣagavāṃ pradānaṃ saḥ pracakāra prativratam ||8 3 || tena tasyorvaśīgarbhāt ṣaḍāsannātmajāḥ pare | āyuḥ śrutāyuḥ satyāyuḥ rayo’tha vijayo jayaḥ || 84 || teṣāṃ putrāḥ praputrāśca hyāsanvaṃśavivardhanāḥ | agninā prajayā rājā lokaṃ gāndharvamāptavān || 85 || bhuktvā bhogānanekān sa kāle tyaktvā kalevaram | svargād yātaḥ sa vaikuṇṭhaṃ caturbhujadharaḥ svayam || 86 || śṛṇu lakṣmi svarṇabhūṣānantyaṃ rājya yadicchati | kartavyaṃ tena godānapūrvakaṃ vratamuttamam || 87 || śrāvaṇasya site pakṣe karkaṭasthe divākare | dvādaśyāṃ vāsudevāya pavitrāropaṇaṃ caret ||88 || sūtraiḥ kṣaumairhemarūpyatāmraiḥ kauśeyapadmajaiḥ | kuśaiḥ kāśaiḥ sukārpāsaiḥ śaṇajaiḥ śobhanaiśca taiḥ ||8 9 || tantubhistriguṇitaṃ tat triguṇīkṛtya sūtrakam | śodhayet sumaṇidṛśyaṃ kārayetpāvanaṃ hi tat || 1.255.90 || haraye tvarpayettadvai pavitraṃ svarṇapuṇyadam | ekādaśyāṃ dhārayecca rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret || 91 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāstathā śūdrā narāḥ striyaḥ | harerbhaktau sthitāḥ sarvai śubhaṃ kuryuḥ pavitrakam || 92|| haraye tvarpayeccāpi gurave’pi samarpayet | pavitrāropaṇenāhaṃ supavitro bhavāmyaham || 93 || svarṇarūpyakṣaumavastrādyalakārām̐stathārjayet | pratyabdaṃ tu putradāyāṃ pavitrāropaṇaṃ janaiḥ || 94|| kartavyaṃ tūktamantreṇa dhanāḍhyastena jāyate | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ tathāpnoti pavitrāropaṇena ca ||95|| na karoti vidhānena pavitrāropaṇaṃ tu yaḥ | tasya sāṃvatsarī pūjā niṣphalā bhavati kṛtā || 96 || śrutvā putrapradāyāśca māhātmyaṃ mucyate tvaghāt | sukhaṃ svargaṃ paraṃ prāpya paraṃ mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 97|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śrāvaṇaśuklaputradaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ pūrvabhavegavāparādhino vaṇijaḥ purūravo’vatāre’putrasya vratakaraṇe ūrvaśyāṃ putralābhaḥ pavitrāropaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā paṃcapaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 255||
<1.256> śrīlakṣmīruvāca nārāyaṇasmaraṇena janmasaṃsārabandhanam | naśyatyeva janānāṃ vai vande nārāyaṇa tu tam || 1 || kartāraṃ karaṇaṃ kāryaṃ preritāraṃ vibhuṃ prabhum | sukhadaṃ putradaṃ śāntipradaṃ vande patiṃ harim || 2 || nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa lakṣmīnātha ramāpate | māṇikyeśa prabhāsvāmin pārvatīśvara te namaḥ || 3 || tvanmukhānme kathālābhe tṛptirnaiva hi jāyate | vada bhādrapade kṛṣṇe kiṃnāmnyekādaśī matā || 4 || ko devaḥ kiṃ phalaṃ dāne deyaṃ puṣpādikaṃ ca kim | ko vidhistadvratasyāsti vistarāt kathaya prabho || 5 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇuṣvaikamanā lakṣmi kathayiṣyāmi vistarāt | ajānāmnī bhādrakṛṣṇaikādaśī pāpanāśinī || 6 || sundaryā tu sahaivārcyastasyāṃ devo janārdanaḥ | puṣpeṣu pāṭalā deyā tvarghye pūgīphalaṃ matam || 7 || dāne tu mahiṣī deyā naivedye gūḍalaḍḍukāḥ | yathākālaṃ yathālabhyaṃ tathākāryaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 8 || daśamyāmekabhuktena tathā bhāvyaṃ vratārthinā | svaptavyaṃ bhūtale rakṣaṇīyaṃ vai brahmaśīlakam || 9 || ekādaśyāṃ prage dhyātvā nārāyaṇajanārdanam | snātvā pūjāṃ naityakīṃ tu kuryāt ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ || 1.256.10 || maṇḍapaṃ kārayed ramyaṃ bahustambhasuśobhitam | madhye tu sarvatobhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ kārayedvratī || 11 || tanmadhye svarṇakalaśaḥ pañcaratnajalānvitaḥ | savastraphalapatropavītacandanataṇḍulaḥ || 1 2|| sthāpanīyaśca tatpārśve ghaṇṭāṃ śaṃkhaṃ ca rakṣayet | pūjayedvidhinā mantraistilasthālī ghaṭe nyaset || 13 || mūrtiṃ tu kānakīṃ janārdanasundarikāyutām | ajaikādaśikāṃ sthālyāṃ sthāpayed rājatīṃ ca vā || 14|| āvāhanādibhiḥ pañcāmṛtairdravitacandanaiḥ | pūjayenmardayet devaṃ snāpayettīrthavāribhiḥ || 12 || vastrālaṃkāraśṛṃgārābhūṣāhārādirājibhiḥ | sugandhidravyavaryaiśca dhūpadīpanivedanaiḥ || 16|| kuṃkumāgurukastūrītailadravasusaurabhaiḥ | kajjalaśvetapāṇḍuracūrṇaśekharanaktakaiḥ || 17|| yaṣṭyrupānahasacchatracāmarairyānavāhanaiḥ | ārārtrikastutinamrabhāvadaṇḍavadādibhiḥ || 18 || puṣpāṃjalijalatāmbūlailālaṃvagacarvaṇaiḥ 19 | kṣamārthanādibhirdevaṃ pūjayedbahubhāvataḥ || 19 || śayyāṃ svarṇamayīṃ satkomalāstaraṇasaṃyutām | dadyāddevāya cādarśapārśvakavyajanānvitām || 1.256.20 || evaṃ samarcya govindaṃ vratārthaṃ prārthayed vratī | karomyajāvrataṃ kṛṣṇa nirvighnaṃ pūrṇatāmiyāt || 21 || dānaṃ dadyād vividhaṃ sadratnasārasuvarṇakam | dadyād gomahiṣīprabhṛtyapi dugdhānvitaṃ śubham || 22 || madhyāhne’pi hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayitvā nivedayet | meśubhaṃ mohanasthālaṃ mauktikām̐ścūrṇamodakān || 23 || apūpām̐śca tathā pūpān polikā miṣṭapolikāḥ | pūrikāḥ puṣpavaṭikā rājikārāddhamityapi || 24 || śākāni vividhānyāranālāni svādavanti ca | dadhidugdhapramiṣṭaṃ sadrasasārāṇi cārpayet || 25 || dadyātphalāni pānīyaṃ mukhavāsādikaṃ tathā | sāyaṃ caiva mahatsamyagarcanaṃ kārayedvratī || 26 || āndolayeddhariṃ preṃkhāṃ baddhvā vṛkṣādike’mbare | rātrau dugdhapracūraṃ vai bhojyaṃ dadyādbalapradam || 27 || ārārtrikaṃ stutiṃ kṣāntyarthanaṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ tathā | arpayedanyayogyaṃ yattvapekṣitamatho hareḥ || 28 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānnṛtyagāyanavācanaiḥ | harekīrtināmabhaktyā kathāśravaṇakhelanaiḥ || 29 || dvādaśyāṃ ca prage snātvā pūjayitvā janārdanam | bhojayitvā hariṃ dadyād dānāni vividhāni ca || 1.256.30 || anyānsamāśritān miṣṭaṃ bhojayitvā sato dvijān | bālām̐śca pāraṇāṃ paścāt kuryād vratī vratottare || 31 || evaṃ kṛte vrate sarvakāmanā vratinaḥ phalet | svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca sāmrājyaṃ yadicchet tadvratī vrajet || 3 2|| īdṛgvidhaṃ vrataṃ lakṣmi ye kurvanti tu mānavāḥ | sarvapāpavinirmuktāstridivaṃ yānti śāśvatam || 33 || śṛṇu kathāṃ vratayuktāṃ duḥkhanāśakarīṃ śubhām | hariścandrasya nṛpateḥ sakalatrasutasya vai || 34|| vādau satyaguṇopetaḥ yuge satye babhūva saḥ | hariścandrābhidho rājā sāketapurabhūpatiḥ || 35 || sarayūsaritastīre pañcayojanavistṛtām | sāketanagarīṃ śāsan bhūpo rarakṣa tatprajāḥ || 36 || cakravartī satyasaṃdhaḥ samastāyā bhuvaḥ patiḥ | atithīnsma pūjayati yatheṣṭaṃ sma dadāti ca || 37 || nārthī kaścidgṛhāttasya nivartate na satkṛtaḥ | arthī yadicchati tattad dadātyeva tu sarvadā || 38 || viprā miṣṭānnabhikṣādyaiḥ kṣatriyā bahumānakaiḥ | vaiśyāḥ sahāyatālābhaiḥ śūdāścāśramamīlanaiḥ || 39 || devā yajñīyahavyānnaiḥ ṛṣayaścātitheyakaiḥ | munayo brahmabhaktyādyaiḥ sakāmā vāñchitārthakaiḥ ||1.256.40 | nāryo vṛttipāla tādyairbālā vidyādiraṃjanaiḥ | anye yatheṣṭasamprāptaiḥ pūjyante tena sarvathā || 41 || tuṣṭāḥ sarve gṛhaṃ yānti sukhaṃ jīvanti tatprajāḥ | nāsya rājye dhanahīno bhaktihīnaśca mānavaḥ ||42 || pitṛsevāvihīno na pramadāsu ghṛṇākaraḥ | vedaghoṣo yajñahomaścārthidānapravāhakaḥ || 42 || sarvo dharmo harernāma pañcaka virarāma na | evaṃ vartayatastasya kīrtirdikṣu vidikṣu ca || 44 || vyāptā babhūva trailokye na satyāccalatīti saḥ | tadā brahmā hariḥ śaṃbhurviśvāmitrādayaḥ khalu ||45 | parīkṣārthaṃ samāyātāḥ kiyatsatyaṃ nu lambate | hariścandreṇa sammānaṃ dvijarūpadhareṣu vai || 46 | kṛtaṃ cātithyasevādi sveṣṭavyārtho niveditaḥ | viśvāmitrastataḥ prāha rājyaṃ sarvamapekṣyate || 47 | dīyatāṃ me mahārāja nirṛṇo’haṃ bhavāmyataḥ | tathāstviti nṛpaḥ prāha jalaṃ muktvā dadau tataḥ || 48 | rājyaṃ pragṛhya ca pṛthag yayāce dakṣiṇāṃ muniḥ | dakṣiṇārthaṃ pṛthagadrvyaṃ nāsīt tatpūrtaye nṛpaḥ ||4 9 | babhūva rājyabhraṣṭo’sau sevākaiṃkaryamāptavān | vikrītvā vanitā putrau sa cakārātmavikrayam ||1.256.5 0 | pulkasasya tu dāsatvaṃ prāpto rājā sa puṇyabhāg | śmaśāne satyamālambya mṛtacailāpahārakaḥ |||5 1 | so’bhavannṛpatipūjyo na satyāccalitaḥ khalu | evaṃ vai tasya nṛpaterbahavo vatsarā gatāḥ || 52| vetanaṃ tu dadātyeva viśvāmitrāya dakṣiṇām | tathāpi dakṣiṇā pūrṇā na jātā ṛṣituṣṭaye ||5 3 | vastraṃ pātraṃ bhavellabdhaṃ sarvaṃ taddakṣiṇākṛte | dadātyeva prapūrtyarthaṃ svayaṃ duḥkhaṃ tu vindati ||54| evaṃ prapūritā karmacārikaiṃkaryavartinā | dakṣiṇāpi tatā dāsyaṃ vṛttyarthaṃ prakaroti saḥ ||55 | duḥkhasyānto na cāyātastataścintāparo’bhavat | kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi duḥkhasyāntaḥ kathaṃ bhavet ||5 6 || patnī vaṇiggṛhe dāsī putrastvanyatra kiṃkaraḥ | ahaṃ śmaśānasevī cāpyaho cāṇḍālakiṃkaraḥ ||57|| kva rājyaṃ kva ca kaiṃkarya cakraṃ māyāmayaṃ nvidam |. tathāpi duḥkhanāśaḥ syāttathā yatnaṃ karomi vai ||58 || iticintayatastasya magnasya duḥkhasāgare | ājagāma munistatra jñātvā rājānamāturam ||59 || vaiṣṇavaṃ ca prajāśīrvādapātraṃ nyāyavartinam | gautamākhyaḥ kṛpāluśca paropakṛtikārakaḥ ||1.256.6 0 || āśīrvādān dadau rājñe sukhī bhaveti sarvathā | nṛpo nanāma taṃ vipraṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ||6 1 || kathayāmāsa vṛttāntamātmano duḥkhasaṃbhṛtam | śrutvā sarvaṃ gautamastu babhūva cātivismitaḥ || 62|| duḥkhanistaraṇopāyaṃ vrataṃ tūpādideśa tam | māsi bhādrapade rājan kṛṣṇapakṣe’tipāvanī ||63 || ekādaśī tvajānāmnī bhavati duḥkhanāśinī | asyāḥ kuru vrataṃ rājan duḥkhadhvaṃso bhaviṣyati || 6 4|| tava patnī vratamasyāḥ karotvapi sukhāvaham | putraste tvekabhuktaṃ vā vrataṃ kuryāt sukhāptaye || 65|| ityādiṣṭo hariścandraścakārājāvrataṃ param | muniryayau ca tatpatnīṃ putraṃ nirdiśya tadvratam || 66 || jagāma svāśramaṃ rājñī kumāraśca yathoditam | cakratuśca yathāśakti tvajāvratamaharniśam ||6 7|| kṛte tasmin vrate rājño duḥkhasyānto’bhavatkṣaṇāt | rājñyāścāpi ca kiṃkaryā duḥkhasyānto’bhavatkṣaṇāt || 68 || putro mṛto’bhavattatra vratottaraṃ divāpi saḥ | rohito jīvanaṃ prāpa vratasyaiva prabhāvataḥ || 69 || tadduḥkhaṃ bahubhirvarṣairbhoktavyaṃ kṣayatāṃ gatam | nistīrṇaduḥkho rājāsīd vratasyāsyāḥ prabhāvataḥ || 1.256.70 || patnyā saha samāsaṃgaṃ putrajīvanamityapi | putreṇa ca samāsaṃgaṃ hariścandrastvavāpa vai || 71 || brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca viśvāmitrādayastadā | svasvarūpāḥ samāyātāḥ pratyakṣā duḥkhanuttaye ||72 || te satyasya parīkṣādya pūrṇā jāteti cocire | sarve devāśca devyaśca samāyātāstadutsave || 73 || āśīrvādapradānārthaṃ hariścandrāya bhūbhṛte | divi dundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavarṣamabhūd divaḥ ||74|| ekādaśyāḥ prabhāveṇa hariścandraḥ saputrakaḥ | sadāraśca svakaṃ sarvaṃ prāpya rājyamakaṇṭakam ||75 || bhuktvā tu bahuvarṣāṇi kṛtvā bhaktiṃ harestataḥ | putraṃ rājye sthāpayitvā patnyā saha virāgavān ||76 || svargaṃ lebhe hariścandraḥ sapuraḥ saparicchadaḥ | anantakālaṃ tad bhuktvā yayau sāketadhāma saḥ || 77|| īdṛgvidhaṃ vrataṃ lakṣmi ye kariṣyanti mānavāḥ | sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ sarvaduḥkhavihīnakāḥ ||78 || svargaṃ mokṣaṃ paraṃ sarve yāsyanti paramaṃ padam | paṭhanācchravaṇād vāpi tvaśvamedhaphalaṃ bhavet || 79 || tasmādasyāḥ kathā śravyā kartavyaṃ śraddhayā vratam | tadaṃgabhūtadānārcāpūjanaṃ vidhivattathā ||1.256.8 0 || vratakartā tadanyeṣāṃ pāpakṣālanako bhavet | svargaṃ prāpayitā cāpi yāmyādibhayavārakaḥ ||8 1 || kimu tarhi svātmakṛte bhuktimuktisamarjane | samarthaśceti vaktavyaṃ nārāyaṇaprasaṃgataḥ ||82|| asyā vratī punarnaiva jāyate’tastvajā matā | ajā muktirbhavedasyā vratādasmādajā hi sā ||8 3 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhādrapadakṛṣṇājaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ viśvāmitrakṛtā hariścandrasya satyavrataparīkṣā rājyastrīputrahāniḥ gautamapradarśitājāvratena duḥkhanivṛttirityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭpaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 256 ||
<1.257> śrīlakṣmīruvāca duḥkhahārinsukhakārinsampatkārinkṛpānidhe | uddhārastvāṃ vinā naiva pāpināṃ jāyate dhruvam || 1 || tava tvadīyabhaktānāṃ bhaved yasyopari kṛpā | mahāpāpātipāpo’pi śuddhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 2 || kāmātkrodhādbhayāllobhāllābhādvāpi samāśrayet|| yastvāṃ mucyeta saṃsāripāśānmuktiṃ labheta saḥ || 3 || vrataṃ yajño dayā dānaṃ jñānaṃ dhyānaṃ japastapaḥ | tvamevāsi kṛpāsindho tvadyogānmuktidā ime || 4 || vada bhādrapade śukle kiṃnāmnyekādaśī bhavet | ko devaḥ ko vidhistasyāḥ kiṃ phalaṃ pūjanaṃ katham || 5 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca padmānāmnī bhādraśuklaikādaśī muktidāyinī | ṛṣikeśo’tra saṃpūjyastvaparājitayā saha || 6 || kāśapuṣpāṇi pūjāyāṃ tilapāko nivedane | kūṣmāṇḍamarghye vai deyaṃ dāne brahmagṛhaṃ śubham || 7 || mandiraṃ bhavanaṃ saudhaṃ kārayeddharyadhiṣṭhitam | dadyādvai gurave devapūjakāya sumandiram || 8 || daśamyāmekabhaktena bhāvyaṃ tu vratinā niśi | kāryaṃ bhūśayanaṃ brahmavrataṃ rakṣyaṃ tu yatnataḥ || 9 || iyaṃ pārśvaparivartinyekādaśī harermatā | śeṣaśāyī parivartayati pārśvaṃ dine’tra vai || 1.257.10 || śayanyāṃ pārśvavartinyāṃ prabodhinyāṃ ca mānavaiḥ | vrataṃ niraśanaṃ kāryaṃ nirjalaṃ śaktito’pi ca || 41 || atrānnabhojinaḥ śūlaṃ pārśve dadati me’ghṛṇāḥ | tasmādannaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ bhoktavyaṃ phalameva vā || 12 || dugdhaṃ peyaṃ saśaktena nirjalaṃ samupoṣaṇam | kartavyaṃ tena bhagavām̐stuṣyati kamalāpatiḥ || 13 || ekādaśyāṃ brāhmakāle samutthāya vratī harim | smareddhyāyecca nāmāni gṛṇan snānāya saṃvrajet || 1 4|| snātvā ca naityikīṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇasya vai vratī | maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ saddhānyaiḥ kārayecchubham || 15 || madhye ghaṭaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ tāmrajaṃ sthāpayecca vā | pañcaratnākṣatapuṣpajalavastraphalānvitam || 16 || śaṃkhaghaṇṭādisaṃyuktaṃ pūjayeccandanādibhiḥ | sthālīṃ tilabhṛtāṃ dhṛtvā ghaṭopari tu tatra vai || 1 7|| ṛṣikeśāparājitāpratimāṃ sthāpayed vratī | padmāṃ tvekādaśīṃ cāpi sthāpayetpūjayecca tām || 18 || āvāhanādibhiḥ paṃcāmṛtasnānādibhistathā | vastrābhūṣaṇaśṛṃgārakajalaiścandanādibhiḥ || 19 || hārakeyūrakaṭakairmukuṭaiḥ śekharādibhiḥ | pādukāyaṣṭinaktakapuṣpagucchāttarādibhiḥ || 1.257.20 || dhūpadīpasunaivedyairjalatāmbūlasatphalaiḥ | ārārtrikastutidaṇḍavannamanapradakṣiṇaiḥ || 21 || kṣamābhyarthanakusumāṃjalisaddakṣiṇādibhiḥ | prapūjya bhagavantaṃ ca vratanirvighnasiddhaye || 22 || prārthayecchrīhariṃ paścānnatvā kāryāntaraṃ caret | madhyāhne’pi bhagavate miṣṭānnānyarpayedvratī || 23 || tāmbūlakaṃ vāripānaṃ tvarpayed vācayetkathām | aparāhṇe tataḥ sāyaṃ nīrājayedvidhānataḥ ||24|| stotraṃ ca kīrtanaṃ kuryād bhojayetpāyasādikam | tāmbūlaṃ salilaṃ dadyād dolāyāṃ cādhiveśayet ||275|| āndolayetsvayaṃ bhakto bhaktairanyaistu sāttvataiḥ | sādhvībhiḥ sādhubhiścaiva brahmacāribhirityapi ||26|| miliravā jāgaraṃ kuryāt sotsavaṃ gītipūrvakam | nāmadhūnayutaṃ nṛtyaṃ kīrtanaṃ ca kathāmṛtam || 27|| kuryātkṛṣṇasya nikaṭe prātaḥ snātvā prapūjayet | bhojayedbhagavantaṃ ca prasādaṃ sātvatān janān |||28|| dadyācca pāraṇāṃ tvanyān kārayitvā tataḥ svayam | vratī vai pāraṇāṃ kuryād dvādaśyāṃ dānamācaret ||29|| gomahiṣīgajavājiyānavimānavāhanam | gṛhodyānapuragrāmakṣetravastrānnasādhanam || 1.257.30 || ratnahīrakamāṇikyamaṇisvarṇadhanādikam | khaṭvāśakaṭaparyaṃkapeṭāpātrakapāṭakam ||3 1 || bṛsīkṣaumāsanasiṃhāsanapaṭṭāsanakaṭam | preṃkhākusūlagendukaguptadorakarajjukam ||32|| granthagṛhopakaraṇaśṛṃkhalākuṇḍikātarūm | calavallīcalastambamṛgavyāghrādicarmakam || 33|| vṛkṣattvagāsanavalkalakauśeyadhanādikam | yadyacchakyaṃ bhavetsvasya dadyāttaddvādaśīdine || 34|| jalayānaṃ bhūmiyānaṃ vyomayānādikaṃ nṛpaḥ | dadyādācāryagurave yantraṃ bahuvidhaṃ tathā ||35|| dattaṃ pātre janairyat tatparaloke’bhipadyate | jñānadānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ kanyādānaṃ dhanārpaṇam ||36|| annadānaṃ jaladānaṃ vastradānaṃ gṛhārpaṇam | godānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ sādhanadānaṃ vratārpaṇam |||37|| puṇyadānaṃ svasvakīyātipriyasyārpaṇaṃ tathā | svarge vānyatra yonau tad dātāramupagacchati || 38|| tasmācchaktau pradātavyaṃ paralokasahāyakṛt | ihāmutra sukhadātṛ satāṃ sevanamācaret ||3 9|| yayā yayā prabhaktyā vai santastuṣyanti yadyathā | tathā tathā sevanīyāḥ santo vai harimūrtayaḥ ||1.257.40 || santo hareḥ svarūpāvatārā bhavanti bhūtale | prasevitā vrate santastuṣyanti yadi cāntare ||41|| tadā bhuktistathā muktiḥ sarvaṃ siddhaṃ vratārthinaḥ | hareḥ sevā satāṃ sevā sādhvīsevācyutārpaṇam ||42|| ātmajñānaṃ bhaktiyogo harerguṇānucintanam | brahmajñānaṃ yogasiddhiḥ pratyekaṃ mokṣasādhanam ||43 || vrataṃ tapo japo yogo yajñaścātmasamarpaṇam | kṛṣṇaprapattigatiyuk niścitaṃ mokṣasādhanam || 44|| tasmād brahmasusambandhamayaṃ vrataṃ caredvratī | sakāmasya bhaved bhuktirakāmasya parā gatiḥ ||45 || parālayadhvaṃsakartuḥ svālayaṃ naśyati dhruvam | paragṛhadhvaṃsakasya svagṛhaṃ dhvaṃsate khalu || 46|| parahiṃsāprakartuśca svahiṃsā jāyate dhruvam | paraduḥkhapradātuśca svaduḥkhaṃ jāyate dhruvam || 47 || anyasukhapradātuśca svasukhaṃ jāyate dhruvam | parasampatprahartuśca svasampannaśyati dhruvam || 48 || anyanāśayituścātra svanāśo bhavati dhruvam | paradravyādihartuśca svadravyadhvaṃsanaṃ dhruvam ||4 9 || parastrīnāśakartuśca svastrīnāśo bhaved dhruvam | pareṣvagniviṣadāturnaije’gniviṣitā dhruvam || 1.257.5 0 || parapratārayituśca svapratāraṇakaṃ dhruvam | paragārhasthyabhaṃktuśca svagārhasthyalayo dhruvam ||5 1 || parakāmasukhaghnasya svakāmasukhanāśanam | paropakāraśīlasya svopakārasahāyanam ||5 2 || aindriyakasukhadātustvaindriyakasukhāgamaḥ | sādhanaistu sukhadātuḥ sādhanānāṃ samāgamaḥ || 5 3 || vighnakartustu vighnāni sukhadātuḥ sukhāni vai | sarvadātustu sarvāṇi hyupatiṣṭhanti niścitam || 54 || tasmād dānāni sarvāṇi deyāni punarāptaye | dattaṃ vyarthaṃ na vai cātra paratrāpi ca lapsyate || 55 || adattānāṃ duḥkhitānāṃ dātṛ tvekādaśīvratam | kartavyaṃ tatprayatnena vāñchitaṃ dāsyati dhruvam ||56 || vyaktidoṣakṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ tatsamūhasya saṃbhavet | vyaktikṛtaṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ samudāyasya jāyate || 57 || samudāyakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ puṇyaṃ vā bhavati nṛpe | nṛpakṛte puṇyapāpe prajānāṃ spṛśatastathā || 58 || yasya kasyāpi vai dharmalopena duḥkhitāḥ prajāḥ | tāvadduḥkhavināśāya kāryamekādaśīvratam || 59 || tena pāpaṃ vinaśyedvai sukhaṃ syādatulaṃ khalu | māndhātṛnṛpatestādṛgjātaṃ kṛtayuge śṛṇu || 1.257.60 || māndhātā nāmarājarṣirvivasvadvaṃśasaṃbhavaḥ | udayāstamanakṣetracakravartī babhūva ha || 61 || prajāḥ sa pālayāmāsa dharmeṇa svātmajāniva | tasya rājye na durbhikṣaṃ nādhayo vyādhayo na ca ||62||| dhanadhānyasmṛddhiyuktaṃ rāṣṭraṃ svargamivāsya vai | kośo’pi nyāyalabdhena dhanena śevadhisamaḥ ||63 || varṇāstathāśramāḥ puṇyairvidyotante samedhitāḥ || pṛthvī vasundharā kāmagāvaḥ kalpakarā drumāḥ ||64|| vāksiddhā brāhmaṇāstasya sādhavo yogabhūmayaḥ | nāryaścānandadāḥ śāntimatyo vilāsamaṃgalāḥ ||65 || ṛtavaḥ kāmakārāśca rāṣṭraṃ svargamivāparam | sukhamagnaṃ samabhūdvai bahusaukhyaṃ gatāḥ prajāḥ ||66|| brāhmaṇā brahmakarmasthāḥ kṣatriyā rakṣaṇapradāḥ | vaiśyā upārjanodyogaparāḥ śūdrāśca sevinaḥ ||67|| āsan svadharmayātāro tena rāṣṭramabhūt sukhi | tasyaivaṃ kurvato rājyaṃ grahāḥ saumyā sadābhavan ||68 || devā āsanprasannāśca maṃgalāni gṛhe gṛhe | athaiko bhaktarāṭ kaścid vṛṣalo rājyavātrchayā ||69 || samārebhe tapa ugramaraṇye nirjane tadā | śūdradharmaparityāgādṛṣidharmagrahāttathā ||1.257.7 0 || adharmasya vidharmasya praveśenāsya rāṣṭrake | varṣatrayaṃ na vavṛṣurmeghāḥ prajāstu duḥkhitāḥ ||7 1 || bhagnā mṛtā janāḥ kecid babhūvuḥ kṣudhayārditāḥ | svāhāsvadhāvaṣaṭkāravedādhyayanapūjanam ||72|| vratopakārasanmānātithyadānādikaṃ tathā | śubhaṃ karmotsavādyaṃ ca sarvaṃ dhvastaṃ babhūva ha ||73 || deśastasya vibhāgyena babhūva daivapīḍitaḥ | tadā prajāḥ samāgatya prāhurnṛpeśvaraṃ tvidam ||74|| śṛṇu rājan vinā vṛṣṭiṃ rāṣṭrocchedo bhavatyayam | parjanyarūpo bhagavān viṣṇurvāriṣu saṃsthitaḥ ||75|| sa eva kurute vṛṣṭiṃ vṛṣṭerannaṃ tataḥ prajāḥ | vṛṣṭyabhāve mahārāja kṣayaṃ prayānti te prathāḥ ||76|| tasmād vidhehi rājendra yogakṣemam yathā bhavet | śrutvā prāha mahībhartā yathā kṣemaṃ prajājane ||77|| syāttathā prayatiṣye’haṃ rājamūlaṃ sukhaṃ yataḥ | nṛpāṇāmapacāreṇa prajānāṃ pīḍanaṃ bhavet ||78 || nāhamājanmataḥ kvāpi kṛtavānpātakaṃ tathā | tathāpi prayatiṣye’haṃ prajānāṃ hitakāmyayā ||79|| ityuktvā saprajo rājā parimeyaparicchadaḥ | pāpānveṣaṇasannaddho deśayātrāṃ cakāra saḥ ||1.257.8 0 || śrutaṃ lokamukhāttena gahane himavadvane | śūdrastapati so’yaṃ te rājye vidharma eva yat|| |8 1 || brāhmaṇānāṃ yatīnāṃ ca sādhūnāṃ dhārmikaṃ tapaḥ | śūdrāṇāṃ sevanaṃ dharmastapo vidharma eva yat ||8 2 || śūdrakṛtatapodoṣādavagraho’dya jāyate | so’yaṃ śūdrataporodhe dharmo vṛṣṭimayo bhavet|| |8 3 || śrutvā mahīpatiḥ śīghraṃ jagāma gahanaṃ vanam | cacāra munimukhyām̐śca svāśramām̐stāpasaiḥ śritān ||84 || dadarśātha brahmaputramṛṣimaṃgirasaṃ nṛpaḥ | tejaḥparidhisaṃvyāptānanaṃ yathā tu padmajam ||85 || rājā kṛtāṃjalirnamraścakre tatpādayornamaḥ | muniḥ papraccha kuśalaṃ rāṣṭre caivāpyanāmayam ||86 || dattāsane hyupaviśya māndhātā pratyuvāca tam | bhagavandharmavidhinā mama pālayato mahīm ||87|| anāvṛṣṭiśca saṃjātā pīḍyante sakalāḥ prajāḥ | varṣatrayaṃ vyatītaṃ ca bhavet kimatra kāraṇam ||88 || śūdrastapaḥ karotīti śrutaṃ lokamukhānmayā | tathāpi nirṇayaṃ brūhi bhavet kimatra kāraṇam || 89 || yogakṣemavidhānena prajānāṃ kuru nirvṛtim | aṃgirāḥ prāha nṛpatiṃ kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā nijāntare || 1.257.90 || asmin kṛtayuge dharmaścatuṣpādaḥ pravartate | atra brahmaparā lokā brāhmaṇāśca tapaḥparāḥ || 91 || tapasyanye’dhikṛtā na panthā hyeṣaḥ kṛte yuge | satyeva viṣaye te’tra vṛṣalo’pi tapaḥ paraḥ || 92 || tadvidharmaprabhāveṇa na varṣanti balāhakāḥ | kuru tasya vadhe yatnaṃ nātidūre vane’sti saḥ || 93 || evaṃkṛte tvanāvṛṣṭirna syād rājankadācana | śrutvā prāha mahābhāgavato rājā dayāparaḥ || 94 || nāhamenaṃ haniṣyāmi tapasyantaṃ śubhakriyam | taporodhaṃ kariṣyāmi śanaireva miṣāntare || 95 || yadi syātsādhanaṃ kiñcidanyadvṛṣṭikaraṃ tadā | darśayaitatkaromyeva hyupasargavināśanam || 96|| aṃgirā prāha rājānaṃ yadyevaṃ tarhi śobhanam | kuruṣva kṣemadaṃ padmābhidhaikādaśikāvratam || 97 || sarvasiddhipradaṃ caitatsarvopadravanāśakam | sarvaśāntikaraṃ yogakṣemadaṃ padmikāvratam || 98 || kuru padmāvrataṃ rājan saprajaḥ saparicchadaḥ | padmāvrataprabhāveṇa suvṛṣṭirbhavitā dhruvam || 99 || ityājñāṃ śirasā dhṛtvā pūjayitvā ca taṃ munim | śūdrataponirodhāya niyujya karmacāriṇam || 1.257.10 0|| smaran kṛṣṇaṃ hṛdaye sve rājā svagṛhamāgataḥ | bhādramāse site pakṣe padmāvratamathākarot || 101 || prajābhiḥ saha sarvābhiścāturvarṇyasamanvitaḥ | kṛtvā vrataṃ cakārāsau dānāni haripūjanam || 10 2|| evaṃ vrate kṛte lakṣmi pravavarṣa balāhakaḥ | bhūmirjalena saṃtṛptā tvabhavatsasyaśālinī || 103 || ekādaśīvratapuṇyāt nāśito’vagraho drutam | tasmātpadmāvrataṃ kāryaṃ duḥkhāpannāśanāya ca || 104|| tatra dadhyodanaṃ cāpi vastraratnayuto ghaṭaḥ | jalapūrṇaśca kalaśaśchatropānahamityapi || 1 05|| govindabuddhyā dātavyā gurau brahmavidi dvije | namaskāryastathā bhojyaistoṣaṇīyo gururdvijaḥ || 1 06|| evaṃ vrataṃ paraṃ kṛtvā janaśceṣṭamavāpnuyāt | śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya vratapuṇyaṃ hi labhyate || 1 07|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhādraśuklapadmaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ māndhātuḥ rājye satyayuge śūdre tapati vṛṣṭeravagrahaḥ vratena vṛṣṭirityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptapaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||257||
<1.258> śrīlakṣmīruvāca namo namaste govinda ṛṣikeśa janārdana | sākṣinprayojaka svāminnārāyaṇa niyāmaka || 1 || dṛśyaprada dṛśerdātardraṣṭṛtvena vyavasthita | bījapradāṃkurātman prastambapatrādiṣu sthita || 2 || kāṇḍanālasupuṣpastha bījātmaka namo’stu te | phalaprada phale tiṣṭhan svayaṃ phalasi tadṛtau || 3 || karmabījaphalavyāpin vṛṣṭibīja namo’stu te | vadāśvināsitapakṣe kiṃnāmnyekādaśī bhavet || 4 || ko vidhiḥ kiṃ phalaṃ cāsyāḥ kīdṛśaṃ ca vrataṃ matam | ko devaḥ pūjyate cātra dānādyaṃ pūjanādi kim || 5 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca āśvine kṛṣṇapakṣe’sti tvindirānāmanāmataḥ | upendraḥ subhagāyuktaḥ pūjyo dūrvābhiratra vai || 6 || āmalakīphalaṃ cārghye śaṣkulī tu nivedane | kanyādānaṃ pradhānaṃ ca pūjanaṃ sāṃgameva yat || 7 || pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ mukhyaṃ kartavyaṃ tṛptidaṃ śubham | agatīnāṃ gatikṛcca vrataṃ śrāddhādisaṃyutam || 8 || daśamyāmekabhukto’syā vratī brahmacaro bhavet | bhūśāyī saṃyamī prātastvekādaśyāṃ vrataṃ caret || 9 || utthāya śrīhariṃ smṛtvā dhyātvā mūrtiṃ harestataḥ | snātvā pūjāṃ prakuryācca naityikīṃ śuddhamānasaḥ || 1.258.10 || maṇḍapaṃ kārayitvā ca sarvatobhadramaṇḍale | ghaṭaṃ suvarṇajanyaṃ vā tāmrajaṃ sthāpayennavam || 1 1|| pañcaratnasupallavaphalavāryambarānvitam | ghaṭopari tilasthālīṃ sthāpayedvai prapūritām || 12|| pārśvetvāmānnamevātra pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaṃ tathā | jalaṃ tīrthāhṛtaṃ pātre sthāpayecca kuśām̐stathā || 1 3|| śarkarāphalapiṣṭādi vinyasyetpārśvatastadā | mūrtiṃ ca kānakīṃ tatropendrasya subhagāyutām || 14|| indirāsahitāṃ tilasthālyāṃ saṃsthāpayedvratī | gaṇeśaṃ pūjayitvā ca śaṃkhaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ ghaṭaṃ tathā || 15|| pūjayitvā tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ hṛdi smṛtvā vicintayet | mastake mastakaṃ cāstu netrādau harinetrakam || 16|| hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ cāstu hastādau tatkarādikam | kaṭyādau tasya kaṭyādi pādayorharipatkajam || 17|| mamāṃgeṣu hareraṃgāni santvātmani keśavaḥ | ityevaṃ sarvatobhāvāt devo bhūtvārcayeddharim || 18|| āvāhanādikaṃ kuryāt paṃcāmṛtābhiṣecanam | śuddhodakāplavanaṃ ca kārayitvāmbarārpaṇam || 1 9|| keśaprasādhanādyaṃ cāttarasugandhikārcanam | gulālakuṃkumābīracandanākṣatapūjanam ||1.258.20 || alaktakārdracūrṇādiraṃgakajjalaraṃjanam | kuryāddevasya sarvāṃgeṣvatha bhūṣādi dhārayet ||21 || śṛṃgāraśobhitāṃ mūrtiṃ puṣpahārādibhistataḥ | kaṭakamukuṭādyaiśca surūpairūpayedbahu || 22|| dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalatāmbūlacūrṇakam | ārārtrikastutipradakṣiṇadaṇḍavadādikam ||23|| dakṣiṇākṣatakusumāṃjalidānaṃ kṣamāpanam | vidhivatsarvatobhāvayuktena vratī cetasā ||24|| dadyāt kuryācca yadyogyaṃ yācetāvighnatāṃ vrate | pitṝnsmṛtvā pradadyācca prasādāḍhyajalām̐jalim || 25|| dadyāddānāni vai prātarmadhyāhne’pi prapūjayet | bhojayed vividhānnāni devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tataḥ ||26|| madhyāhnottarakāle ca pitṝṇāṃ śrāddhamācaret | pitṛtīrthena salilaṃ dadyāttattatsunāmabhiḥ ||27|| piṇḍān dadyāt phalānyanyat tṛptidaṃ cārpayet pitṝn | sāyaṃ nīrājanaṃ kṛtvā pūjayetparameśvaram ||28|| bhojayed dugdhapākādi jalapānādi cārpayet | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātsādhusaṃgatimācaret ||29|| kathāṃ kuryāttathā bhaktācchṛṇuyācca paṭhecca vā | nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ prakuryācca samutsāhamahotsavam |||1.258.3 0|| prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ | datvā naivedyamīśāya bhojayedvaiṣṇavām̐stataḥ ||3 1 || āśritān bhojayitvā ca sādhūn sādhvīrdvijām̐stataḥ | pāraṇāṃ ca vratī kuryād dadyād dānāni pātrake ||32|| guruṃ ca mātaraṃ vṛddhān pitaraṃ pūjayetpatim | āśīrvādām̐śca gṛhṇīyāt kuryātkāryaṃ svakaṃ tataḥ ||33|| evaṃ kṛte vrate lakṣmi vāñchitaṃ siddhyati dhruvam | pitṛtṛptikaraṃ bhojyaṃ jalaṃ vastrādi dāpayet || 34|| pitruddhārakaraṃ dānaṃ gavāṃ tvanyacca kārayet | gṛhodyānapaśukṣetrakanyāvidyāsuvāhanam ||35|| svarṇaratnavibhūṣānnavividhopaskarānvitam | dāpayet pitṛsantuṣṭibuddhyaiva śraddhayā vratī || 26 || gurave haraye dadyāt pitṛmuktikaraṃ bhavet | bhuktidānmuktidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tato muktidamācaret ||37|| yasmādyasya bhavedicchāśāntyarthaṃ vāñchanā tvati | tena tasya prakartavyā vāñchāyāḥ śāntiranyathā || 38|| vaiparītyaṃ bhavet pitratṛptito vaṃśajasya vai | tasmātkāmaphalaṃ cāpyakāmaphalakamityapi ||39|| kuryādvai vaṃśajaḥ pitṛtṛptyarthaṃ kāla āgate | iṣakṛṣṇe vrate kuryād viśeṣaphalatṛptikṛt ||1.258.40|| svalpaṃ vā vipulaṃ vāpi dadyāt tattatsunāmabhiḥ | paralokagatānāṃ tatsukhadaṃ bhavati dhruvam ||41 || pitaro yadi muktisthāstadā kartuḥ phalaṃ matam | kṛtaṃ na niṣphalaṃ yāyāditi kṛtvācared budhaḥ ||42|| bījaṃ vai cāṃkuraṃ dadyātpatraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalam | na yāti niṣphalaṃ kṣetre śraddhāvāryabhiṣecanam ||43 || uṣare kṣīyate bījaṃ kṣetre pātre na naśyati | tīrthe pātre satpuruṣe kṣiptaṃ dhruvaṃ prarohati ||44|| vrate pātre harau dadyād kṣiptaṃ cāpi na niṣphalam | tasmātsvalpaṃ bahulaṃ vā phalasandhānavarjitam ||45|| dadyātpratiphalatyeva haryanugrahakāraṇāt | śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ ramyāṃ vratena pitṛtṛptidām ||46 || adhoyonigatānāṃ tu pitṝṇāṃ gatidāyinī | indiraikādaśī śreṣṭhā vājapeyaphalapradā ||47|| indrasenena vai rājñopoṣitā pitṛtāraṇī | nārmadākhye mahārāṣṭre candrāvatīpurīpatiḥ ||48|| indrasenākhyanṛpatirbabhūva prākkṛte yuge | dharmeṇa pālayāmāsa prajāḥ putrānivaurasān ||49|| putrapautrasamāyukto dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ | gajavājiyānayukto viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ||1.258.50 || japan śrīharināmāni muktidāni tu sarvadā | kālaṃ nayati bhaktyaivādhyātmadhyānavicintakaḥ ||5 1 || tasyaikadā gṛhe śāntyāsīnasya purato muniḥ | nārado vyomamārgeṇāvatīrya samupasthitaḥ ||52|| āgataṃ nāradaṃ vīkṣya pratyutthāya kṛtāṃjaliḥ | kṛtātithyaṃ muniṃ bṛṣyāsane ramye nyaveśayat ||53|| provāca svāgataṃ te’haṃ karomi brahmavittama | adya me saphalaṃ rājyaṃ janma karma kulaṃ dhanam ||54|| dānaṃ kraturjapo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ saphalā mama | tvatprasādānmuniśreṣṭha bhāgyaṃ dhanyatamaṃ mama ||55|| sutapraputradārādidāsadāsīśatāni me | gajavājivāhanāni saphalāni tavāgamāt ||56 || sādhorvai darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ sparśanaṃ pāpanāśakam | sevanaṃ svargadaṃ divyamokṣadaṃ tvātmano’rpaṇam ||57|| yeṣāṃ gṛhe na sādhūnāṃ caraṇadhūlikārajaḥ | tāni śmaśānatulyāni bhavanāni gṛhāṇi ca ||58|| tāritaṃ mama sambandhikuṭumbaṃ sarvameva yat | prasādaṃ kuru devarṣe nispṛhāgamakāraṇam ||59|| nāradaḥ prāha rājarṣe śṛṇu vismayakārakam | brahmalokādahaṃ prāpto yamalokaṃ mahīpate ||1.258.60 || dharmeṇa satkṛto bhaktyā hyupaviṣṭo varāsane | dharmarājaṃ satyaśīlā dhārmikāḥ samupāsate ||6 1 || teṣāṃ sadasi pṛṣṭhasthaṃ nistejaskaṃ sthitaṃ tava | pitaraṃ prahasantyanye bahupuṇyātimāninaḥ ||62|| sabhāyāṃ śrāddhadevasya prāha mahyaṃ pitā tava | sandeśaṃ duḥkhanāśāya taṃ nibodha mahīpate ||6 3 || indrasena iti khyātaṃ candrāvatyā nṛpaṃ sutam | brahman kathaya sandeśaṃ pitā te candrasenakaḥ ||64|| tiṣṭhati dharmarājasya nagaryāṃ puṇyapuṃjataḥ | dānaṃ bahukṛtaṃ tena na kṛtaṃ vratameva yat ||65|| tena puṇyena dharmasya nagaryāmasti saṃsthitaḥ | vratapuṇyena vidhuro nistejasko’tipṛṣṭhagaḥ ||66|| niṣīdati sabhāyāṃ vai cātiduḥkhānvitaḥ sadā | tasmāt kuryād vrataṃ caikādaśyā uddiśya māṃ sutaḥ ||67|| mokṣaṃ kuryātsa me putra indirāpuṇyadānataḥ | ityukto’haṃ samāyātaḥ samīpaṃ tava bhūpate ||68|| piturmokṣakṛte rājannindirāvratamācara | tvatpitā tena puṇyena vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāsyati dhruvam ||69|| śrutvā pituḥ sa sandeśaṃ nāradaṃ pṛṣṭhavān vratam | vidhinā kena kartavyaṃ kasmin pakṣe tithau tathā ||1.258.70|| nāradaḥ prāha rājānamāśvināsitapakṣake | daśamyāṃ prātarutthāya smṛtvā kṛṣṇaṃ tataḥ param ||71|| snātvā devaṃ pūjayitvā madhyāhne snānamācaret | datvā haraye naivedyamekabhuktaṃ samācaret ||72|| sāyaṃ snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā rātrau bhūmau śayīta ca | ekādaśyāṃ prabhāte’yaṃ vratī nidrāṃ vihāya vai ||73|| smṛtvā dhyātvā hariṃ nāma raṭan śaucādikaṃ caret | mukhaprakṣālanaṃ kuryājjalairdvādaśadhā muhuḥ ||74|| snānaṃ tīrthajalaiḥ kuryād devapūjāṃ samācaret | harermūrtiṃ namaskṛtyācamanādigrahottaram ||75|| ṣoḍaśopaskaraiḥ kṛṣṇamupendraṃ pūjayed vratī | upavāsasya niyamaṃ gṛhṇīyācca tadagrataḥ ||76|| adya sthitvā nirāhāraḥ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ | śvo bhokṣye puṇḍarīkākṣa vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ kuru prabho ||77|| evaṃ niyamamāsthāya sarvatobhadramaṇḍale | ghaṭe kṛṣṇaṃ sthāpayitvā mahāpūjanamācaret ||78|| samāpya vidhinā pūjāṃ nīrājayecca bhojayet | madhyāhnepi svayaṃ snātvā śrīhariṃ bhojayettathā ||79|| nīrājayet svāpayeccotthāpayet pāyayejjalam | vījayenmardayennāthaṃ sukhayediṣṭadānakaiḥ ||1.258.80 || śālagrāmaśilāgre ca śrāddhaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi | pitṝṇāṃ prītaye śrāddhaṃ kuryāt śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||8 1 || godhūmacūrṇairyacchrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tanmadhyamaṃ bhavet | yavairvrīhitilairmāṣairgodhūmaiścaṇakaistathā ||82|| śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavecchreṣṭhaṃ kartavyaṃ vratinā tu taiḥ | śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vratinā na bhoktavyaṃ pitṛsevitam ||83|| vratarakṣaṇalābhāya ghrātavyameva cārpitam | paitryamannaṃ samāghrāya gave dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ||84|| rātrau mahārcanaṃ kuryājjāgaraṃ sotsavaṃ tathā | dvādaśyāṃ prātarevāyaṃ snātvā samarcya mādhavam ||85|| naivedyaṃ phalatāmbūle tvarpayitvā tato vratī | ārārtrikādikaṃ kṛtvā kṣamāyācanikāṃ tathā ||86|| dadyād dānāni bhūrīṇi brāhmaṇādīn prabhojayet | sādhūnsādhvīrbhojayecca bandhūn dauhitraputrakān ||87|| bhojayitvā ca dīnāndhān svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ | anena vidhinā rājan kuru vratamatandritaḥ ||88|| viṣṇulokaṃ prayāsyanti pitarastava bhūpate | ityuktvā nṛpatiṃ lakṣmi nārado’ntaradhīyata ||89|| yathoktavidhinā hīndrasenaścakāra tadvratam | antaḥpureṇa sahitaḥ putrabhṛtyasamanvitaḥ ||1.258.90 || kṛte vrate gavāṃ dāne puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūd divaḥ | puṇyārpaṇe kṛte cendrasenasya janakaḥ khalu ||9 1|| candrasenastathānye tatpitaro’pi vyavasthitāḥ | garuḍasthā vimānasthā yayurvai viṣṇumandiram ||92|| indraseno’pi kṛtvā tadvrataṃ vaiṣṇavapālitāḥ | rājyaṃ tvakaṇṭakaṃ bhuktvā datvā jyeṣṭhasutāya ca ||93|| mahīsenāya tatpaścājjagāma tridivaṃ svayam | tatra puṇyaṃ samāpyaiva vaikuṇṭhamagamaddhi saḥ ||94|| ityevaṃ vratamāhātmyaṃ lakṣmi te kathitaṃ mayā | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi vratapuṇyaṃ bhavedapi ||9 5|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āśvinakṛṣṇendiraikādaśīvratamāhātmyam indrasena nṛpapitṛcandrasenaprabhṛtīnāṃ pitṝṇāṃ vratapuṇyabalād yamalokānmokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭapaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||258|||
