<1.259> śrīlakṣmīruvāca sarvapuṇyamayo devastvameva bhagavān svayam | dadāsi karuṇāsindhuḥ phalāni karmaṇāṃ yathā || 1 || tvāṃ vismṛtyānutiṣṭhanti kurvanti mānavāstu yat | tatphalaṃ labhyate cātra paratra bhayayuk tu taiḥ || 2 || tvāṃ smṛtvā ye’nutiṣṭhanti kurvanti yāni yāni vai | tatphalaṃ nirguṇaṃ nityānandamokṣātmakaṃ tvayā || 3 || dayite bhagavam̐stasmai śaraṇāgatiśāline | evaṃ phalapradātāsi sarvakarmamayo’si yat || 4 || sarvajño’si kṛpāṃ kṛtvā vada me parameśvara | āśvinaśuklapakṣe tu kiṃnāmnyekādaśī bhavet || 5 || ko devastatra saṃpūjyaḥ ko vidhiḥ kiṃphalaṃ tathā | kiṃ dānaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ vada sarvaṃ hare’tra me || 6 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca iṣaśuklaikādaśī tu nāmnā pāśāṃkuśā matā | sarvapāpaharā puṇyapradā mokṣapradā tathā || 7 || padmanābhaḥ padmavatyā saha pūjyo’tra bhaktitaḥ | śamīpatrāṇi pūjāyāmarghye kāmaphalaṃ matam || 8 || śālipākastu naivedye dāne taṇḍulamodakāḥ | sarvābhīṣṭaphalaprāptyai sarvaṃ deyaṃ janārdane || 9 || tapastaptvā cātitīvraṃ ciraṃ muniryatendriyaḥ | yatphalaṃ samavāpnoti tannatvā padmanābhakam || 1.259.10 || bahupāpāni kṛtvāpi mohito mānavo vrate | padmanābhaṃ hariṃ natvā na yāti narakaṃ hi saḥ || 11 || pṛthivyāṃ tīrthamātrāṇi puṇyānyāyatanāni ca | kṛtāni tena sarvāṇi padmanābhaprapūjanāt || 12 || devadevaṃ padmanābhaṃ ye prapannā janārdanam | na teṣāṃ yamalokasya yātanāsti kadācana || 13 || ekāmekādaśīṃ kṛtvā prasaṃgenāpi mānavaḥ | yadyapi ghorapāpastho na yāti yamayātanām || 14|| nedṛśaṃ pāvanaṃ kiñcit triṣu lokeṣu vidyate | yādṛśī padmanābhasyaikādaśī pāpanāśinī || 15 || tāvatpāpāni vai vyaktau nirbhayāni vasanti hi | yāvannopāvasetprāṇī padmanābhadinavrate || 16|| aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca | ekādaśyupavāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 17|| naikādaśīsamaṃ loke pāpakṣālanakārakam | svargamokṣapradaṃ tvatra dhanamitrādidāyakam || 18 || śarīrārogyadaṃ dārāsutaputrīkulapradam | vyājenāpi kṛtaṃ yena na sa yāti yamālayam || 19 || na gaṃgā na gayā lakṣmi na kāśī na ca puṣkaram | na cāpi kauravaṃ kṣetraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ puṇyaṃ harerdināt || 1.259.20 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ hareḥ kāryaṃ mahārcanam | nirjalaṃ cāpi kartavyaṃ harerdine hyupoṣaṇam || 21 || tena vai labhyate lakṣmi śāśvataṃ dhāma vai mama | daśaiva mātṛpakṣīyāḥ pitṛpakṣasthitā daśa || 22 || daśa patnīpakṣagatā uddharanti vratād dhruvam | caturbhujā divyarūpā garuḍāṃsakṛtāsanāḥ || 23 || sragviṇaḥ pītavastrāste viṣṇutulyaparākramāḥ | nāryo lakṣmīsamā bhūtvā prayānti harimandiram || 24|| bālatve yauvane vāpi vārdhakye pāravaśyake | upoṣyaikādaśīṃ dehī naiti pāpo’pi durgatim || 25|| pāśāṃkuśāmupoṣyaiva harerlokaṃ prayāti vai | datvā hematilān gāśca jalamannaṃ tathāmbaram || 26 || upānacchatramanyadvā yamalokaṃ na paśyati | puṇyavratavihīnasya jīvanaṃ niṣphalaṃ matam || 27|| yasya puṇyavihīnāni dinānyāyānti yānti ca | sa lohakārabhastreva śvasannapi na jīvati || 28 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ dhyānaṃ satrādikaṃ tathā | samācaran yathāśakti hyavandhyaṃ divasaṃ nayet || 29||| dīrghāyuṣo dhanāḍhyāśca kulīnā rogavarjitāḥ | dṛśyante mānavā loke puṇyakartāra īdṛśāḥ || 1.259.30 || tasmād vrataṃ prakartavyaṃ pāśāṃkuśādinātmakam | daśamyāmekabhuktaḥ syād brahmacārī bhavettathā ||3 1 || bhūśāyī syānniśi prātaḥ snātvā svanaityakārcanam | kuryāt ṣoḍaśasaṃcārairarthayed vratapūrṇatām || 32|| maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kārayetsaptadhānyakaiḥ | madhye ghaṭaṃ vāripūrṇaṃ paṃcaratnasamanvitam || 33 || dhanapūrṇaṃ ca vā kṛtvā savastraṃ saphalaṃ nyaset | ghaṭopari tilasthālīṃ sthāpayetkānakīṃ śubhām || 34|| mūrtiṃ śrīpadmanābhasya padmāvatyanvitāṃ śubhām | pāśāṃkuśāsahitāṃ ca sthāpayedarcayettathā || 35 || āvāhanādikaṃ kṛtvā paṃcāmṛtādibhistataḥ | tīrthajalairhariṃ saṃsthāpayed vastrāṇi dhārayet || 36 || candanāttarasaugandhyaṃ tvarpayetkajjalādikam | puṣparatnasuvarṇādihārābhūṣāḥ samarpayet || 37|| bhojanaṃ vividhaṃ dadyājjalaṃ miṣṭaṃ samarpayet | mukhavāsaṃ phalaṃ datvā nīrājayennamenmuhuḥ || 38 || stutvā pradakṣiṇādaṇḍavataḥ kṛtvārthayetkṣamām | dhūpadīpādisaṃjuṣṭe dolāṃ vyomni prabandhayet || 39|| hariṃ saṃsthāpayettatra madhyāhne’pi subhojayet | tāmbūlajalapānādi datvā sāyaṃ tathācaret ||1.259.40 || ṣoḍaśopaskaraiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samarcyārārtrikādikam | kuryātsarvaṃ suvidhinā bhojyaṃ peyaṃ samarpayet || 41|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād bhāgavateṣu saṃsthitaḥ | nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ gītaṃ kīrtanaṃ smaraṇaṃ tathā |||2|| vandanaṃ caraṇāṃgānāṃ mardanaṃ sevanādikam | kuryātprātarhariṃ dhyātvā snātvā saṃpūjya keśavam ||43|| bhojayedbhagavantaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ jalamarpayet | sādhūn sādhvīḥ svāśritām̐śca bhojayenmānayettataḥ ||44|| vṛddhānnatvā hariṃ smṛtvā kṛtvā paṃcamakhān pṛthak | tato vai pāraṇāṃ kuryād dadyād dānāni bhāvataḥ ||45|| evaṃ vrataṃ samāpyaiva dvādaśyāṃ vai hariṃ bhajet | bhavapāśavināśo’sya vratino bhavati dhruvam ||46 || śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ divyāṃ yamapāśavimocanīm | āsītpūrve kṛtayuge vāmadevābhidhaḥ ṛṣiḥ ||47|| āsan śiṣyā aneke’sya brahmavettṛsamagragāḥ | munayastyāginaścānye gṛhasthā brahmavittamāḥ ||48|| snānaṃ sandhyāṃ japaṃ homaṃ svādhyāyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam | kurvanti sma ravau prāpte ratāḥ prāptaḥ svakarmasu ||49|| ekasteṣu karmakāṇḍī ṛṣirvedaśirā iti | nāmnābhavatsuvaidikakriyāniṣṇāta eva ca ||1.259.50|| cāturmāsyaṃ vratī kandāhāraṃ kurvannināya saḥ | kandavikṛtijanyo vai rogastasyodare’bhavat ||51 || jāṭharasyātimandatvamāntrāṇāmuṣṇaphullatā | apācanaṃ bhavatyasya yatkiṃcidbhakṣitaṃ bhavet ||52|| evaṃ śarīrakṣīṇatve’śaktiḥ samyag vyavardhata | ālasyaṃ snānagāyatrījapapūjādike’bhavat ||53|| evaṃ nityaṃ kṣīṇabhāvāt tyaktvā snānaṃ ca pūjanam | śūdravad vartayandehayātrāṃ karoti vai muniḥ ||54|| karmatyāgena ca vedaśirasaḥ pratyavāyakam | jātaṃ tatpratyavāyena puṇyaṃ vai kṣīṇatāṃ gatam ||55|| āyuṣyāntaḥ samāyāto yāmyā netuḥ samāgatāḥ | vedaśirāstadā samyagākulo hyavadattu tān ||56|| kathaṃ me yamadūtānāṃ darśanaṃ kena karmaṇā | pratyūcuryamadūtāstaṃ vedakarma vihāya vai ||57|| yatheṣṭaṃ vartase tvaṃ yatphalaṃ tad yāmyavāsadam | utpathapratipannasya brāhmaṇasya yamālayaḥ ||58|| prāyaścittārthamevāsti bhuṃkṣva tatpratyavāyakam | uktvaivaṃ bedaśirasaṃ yayurnītvā yamagṛham ||59|| yamarājastadīyaṃ vai dṛṣṭvā karma yathārthataḥ | citraguptaṃ tadā prāha pratyavāyo’sya vai mahān ||1.259.60 || adhītavedavismārātmakaṃ yatpātakaṃ mahat|| brahmahatyāsamaṃ proktaṃ pāśairbadhvā hi nīyatām ||6 1 || pātyatāṃ narake brahmaghātināṃ kālasūtrake | asipatravane tvenaṃ nītvā saṃpraharantvapi ||62||| ityuktvā virarāmāsau yamarājastu nītikṛt | vedaśirāstadā prāha yamarājaṃ subuddhimān ||63|| āpatkāle śarīrasya mayā vedastu vismṛtaḥ | tyaktaṃ karmāpyaśaktyā vai kathaṃ me narakaṃ bhavet ||64|| āpatkālasya dharmā vai nādharmagaṇanāṃ gatā | tasmātpāpaṃ na me tvasti nāsti me yamapūrakam ||65|| dharmarājastataḥ prāha yāvadrāgo’pi vidyate | tāvadāpatkṛto dharmo rugṇābhāve sa no mataḥ |||66||| svalpāpadi bahutyāgaḥ sa tvadharmo mahānmataḥ | na te’sti tādṛśo rogo yena noccāritā śrutiḥ ||67|| vismṛtā ca tvayā tvālasyena vai sakalā śrutiḥ | pratyavāyastato jātastyaktaṃ karmāpi sarvathā ||68|| yathāśaktiprakartavyaṃ brāhmaṇena vijānatā | sujānatā tadā sarvaṃ tyaktavyaṃ saṃbhavet katham ||6 9|| tasmādālasyadoṣeṇa karmadharmātivarjitaḥ | cyuto brahmakriyāmārgād daṇḍamarhati sarvathā ||1.259.70 || tadā vedaśirāstatra mānase’cintayadgurum | vāmadevaṃ mahābrahmāvatāraṃ so’pi cāyayau ||71 || dharmarājena tu tadā satkṛto vāmadevakaḥ | niṣasādāsane datte śiṣyeṇāpi namaskṛtaḥ ||72|| vāmadevena sarvaṃ tatkarma yamamukhācchrutam | pratyavāyātmakaṃ tathyaṃ vinā daṇḍaṃ na naśyati ||73 || vāmadevaḥ kṛpālurvai cintayāmāsa tatkṛte | yathā daṇḍo na bhoktavyaḥ karmāpi niṣphalaṃ bhavet ||74|| tādṛśaṃ cintayitvaiva kathayāmi taredayam | vilokya sarvatastatra prāha śiṣyaṃ yamaṃ tathā ||75|| śṛṇutaṃ dvāvapi śiṣyau yama vedaśirastathā | vrataṃ cāsti mahatkālasūtrāsipatranāśakam ||76|| āśvinaśuklaikādaśikāvrataṃ balavanmattam | brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ tatsamānāṃ ca nāśakam ||77|| kartavyaṃ śraddhayānena prāyaścittaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet | evamekādaśīnāmamātraśravaṇatastadā ||78|| bratasaṃkalpataścāpyāyuṣyaṃ susandhitaṃ punaḥ | guroścāpi pratāpena punarāyuṣyamāptavān ||79|| gṛhītvātīthyasatkāraṃ yayaturyatra vai śavam | śiṣyaṃ praveśayāmāsa guruḥ prāha tato vratam ||1.259.80 || snātvā guroḥ pūjanaṃ ca kṛtvā svāsthyena saṃsthitaḥ | āgataṃ ceṣaśuklaikādaśīvrataṃ kṛtaṃ tataḥ ||8 1 || vedavismaraṇotpannapāpadhvaṃso’pyabhūt kṣaṇāt | karmatyāgādipāpānāṃ bhasmabhāvo’bhavattadā ||82|| tato vedaśirā dīrghamāyuṣyaṃ cāptavān śubham | gurorbalāttu karaṇādekādaśīvratasya vai ||83|| yamapāśavināśo’syābhavatsevāvratena ca | iyamekādaśī tasmātpāśānāmaṃkuśaṃ matam ||84|| kariṇāmaṃkuśaṃ yadvat tathā pāśāṃkuśāvratam | kartavyaṃ yamapāśānāṃ nāśanāya janaiḥ śubham ||85|| svargamokṣapradaṃ sarvasampatkaraṃ sukhapradam | ārogyadaṃ trividhānāṃ tāpānāṃ śamanaṃ param ||86|| vāsanāpāśabandhānāṃ nāśakaṃ pāpanāśakam | dehadaihikapāśānāṃ nāśakaṃ vipadāṃ tathā ||87|| ahaṃmamatvapāśānāṃ dhvaṃsakaṃ dveṣarāgayoḥ | śamanaṃ subhagadātṛ dārāpatitvadāyakam ||88|| kleśadāvānalaśāntikaraṃ śāśvatadhāmadam | hareryogapradaṃ vaikuṇṭhadaṃ golokadaṃ tathā ||89|| pāśāṃkuśāvrataṃ lakṣmi prakartavyaṃ prayatnataḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi vratapuṇyapradaṃ hi tat ||1.259.90 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āśvinaśuklapāśāṃkuśaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ vāmadevarṣiśiṣyavedaśiraso’jīrṇarogādālasyena dharmakarmādivarjanātpātakabalena yamalokaprāptau smṛtaguruvāmadevopasthityā vratena ca yamapāśavimokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ekonaṣaṣṭyadhikadvipañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ||259||
<1.260> śrīlakṣmīruvāca mahākālo mahārudro yamo yamasya kiṃkarāḥ | yadātmāno jagatsarvaṃ niyamayanti te namaḥ || 1 || pāśo vajraṃ gadā śaktirdaṇḍaścakraṃ triśūlakam | yadātmānaḥ pravartante tasmai te vibhave namaḥ || 2 || dhṛtirdayā sahāyatvaṃ nītikṣamopakāritāḥ | yatprayuktā prabhavanti tasmai guṇātmane namaḥ || 3 || mamatā paratā naijaṃ sthitiḥ puṣṭirvimokṣaṇam | yadātmaka kṛtaṃ syādvai nirguṇaṃ guṇine namaḥ || 4 || bhagavam̐ste kṛpā pārāvāratulyā sadā mayi | vada kārtikakṛṣṇaikādaśī kiṃnāmikā bhavet || 5 || ko devaḥ pūjanīyo’tra dānaṃ puṇyaṃ vidhiṃ vada | vrate’pi kīdṛśaṃ kāryaṃ kartavyamiti me vada || 6 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kārtiko’yaṃ māso mokṣaprado’sti vai | cāturmāsyāntamāso’yaṃ vratadānādipūjane || 7 || māsaḥ śreṣṭhatamaścāyaṃ vartate vratināṃ kṛte | tatra sarvaṃ śubhaṃ puṇyaṃ karma kartavyameva yat || 8 || tatrāpyekādaśī śreṣṭhā kṛṣṇapakṣe ramābhidhā | hiraṇyayā sahābhyarcyo haristasyāmadhīśvaraḥ || 9 || puṣpeṣu baṭukundāni tadarghye kadalaṃ matam | naivedye śarkarājyāktakadalāni ca polikāḥ || 1.260.10 || dānaṃ ghṛtaghaṭādīnāṃ yadiṣṭaṃ svasya vai bhavet | tatsarvaṃ tu pradātavyaṃ svarṇaṃ lakṣmīvivṛddhaye || 11 || daśamyāmekabhuktaḥ syād vratī bhūśayano bhavet | brahmacārī bhavet krodhamohadoṣādivarjitaḥ || 12|| prātarutthāya govindaṃ dhyāyetsnātvā prapūjayet | pūjāṃ tu naityikīṃ kṛtvā kārayetsaptadhānyakam || 13 || maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ raṃgacitrāliśobhitam | tanmadhye tu ghaṭaṃ svarṇaṃ tāmrajaṃ sthāpayecca vā || 14|| pañcaratnasupatrādyakṣatavārisuvastrakaiḥ | śarkarāśrīphalapūgīphalacandanasaṃyutam || 15|| tanmukhāgre tilasthālīṃ rājatīṃ sthāpayed vratī | nyasyenmūrti tatra hiraṇyāramāśālino hareḥ || 16 || āvāhanādibhiḥ paṃcāmṛtādbhistailamardanaiḥ | sevetāthāmbarabhūṣāśṛṃgārādi samarpayet || 17|| puṣpamālāṃ kaṭake ca mukuṭādi samarpayet | dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalatāmbūlakādikam || 18|| ārārtrikādyarpayecca kuryāt stotraṃ kṣamārthanām | dānāni vividhānyeva dadyācchrīgurave tadā || 1 9|| madhyāhne’pi pūjayecca bhojayejjalamarpayet | sāyaṃ snātvā pūjayitvā nīrājanaṃ vidhāpayet ||1.260.20 || stutyādikaṃ vinirvṛtya bhojayet sevayettathā | rātrau tu jāgaraṃ kuryādbhaktamaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ || 2 1 || gītanṛtyakathāvārtākhyānaraṃjanatāṃ caret | dvādaśyāṃ tu vratī prātaḥ snātvā samarcya keśavam || 22 || dadyācchreṣṭhāni dānāni rājā vāpi prajā vratī | tyāgī vāpi gṛhī vāpi nārī vāpi naropi vā || 23 || yathāśakti sataḥ sādhvīrviprān bālān prabhojayet | tataḥ kuryātpāraṇāṃ vai vratasiddhiṃ samarthayet || 24|| evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ nārī ramātulyā bhaved dhruvam | naraḥ kṛtvā vrataṃ devo jāyate mukta eva saḥ || 25 || śṛṇu lakṣmi candrabhāgāśaśisenakathāṃ śubhām | mucukunda iti khyāto babhūva nṛpatiḥ purā || 26 || indrakundanasaṃjñaṃ tannagaraṃ dakṣiṇe’bhavat | rājadhānyāṃ vasanpṛthvīmekarāṭ praśaśāsa saḥ || 27 || devendreṇa samaṃ tasya mitratvamabhavad bahu | yamena varuṇenaiva kubereṇa tathāgninā || 28 || bibhīṣaṇena tasyaivaṃ mitratvamabhavattathā | yānavimānakaiḥ so’yaṃ trilokyāṃ yāti sarvataḥ || 29 || viṣṇubhaktaḥ satyasandhaḥ śāsti rājyamakaṇṭakam | sarve tu vaiṣṇavāstasya rājye bhavanti mānavāḥ || 1.260.30 || viṣṇubhaktāḥ prajāstasya saṃprāpte harivāsare | annaṃ na bhuṃjate sarvāḥ kurvate samupoṣaṇam || 31 || paṭahastāḍyate tasya saṃprāpte daśamīdine | na bhoktavyaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ samprāpte tu harerdine || 32 || gajairaśvaiśca kalabhairanyaiśca paśubhistvapi | tṛṇamannaṃ tathā vāri na bhoktavyaṃ harerdine || 33 || evaṃ kārayati sarvān rājyasthān vratamuttamam | candrabhāgā nadīśreṣṭhā sutā tasya babhūva ha || 38 || samakāle’tha kāveryāstaṭe babhūva bhūpatiḥ | candrasenāhvayaḥ puṇyaḥ kanakākhyapurādhipaḥ || 35 || tatputrāya śaśisenāhvayāya guṇaśāline | candrabhāgā pradattā vai mucukundena bhūbhṛtā || 3 6|| mahābhāgavatī sāpi vrataṃ karoti vaiṣṇavī | ekadā patiyuktā sā pitṛgehaṃ jagāma vai || 37|| bhartā jvarābhibhūto’syā babhūva tvatidurbalaḥ | ekādaśīvrataṃ cāhaḥ samāyātaṃ supuṇyadam || 38 || samāgate vrate candrabhāgā manasyacintayat | kiṃ bhaviṣyati bharturme hyatyaśaktasya vai vrate || 39 || kṣudhāṃ na kṣamate soḍhuṃ rugṇaḥ kṛśo’tinirbalaḥ | vratasya divase tvatra pitā me tūgraśāsanaḥ ||1.260.4 0 || saśakto vāpyaśakto vā vrataṃ karotu śāsanam | kenāpyulaṃghyate cet sa daṇḍapātraṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 41 || yadbhāvi tadbhavatvatra kiṃ kāryaṃ vivaśena vai | iti vicintya sā tvāste vratāhaścāpi saṃsthitam || 42 || paṭahastāḍyate tasya saṃprāpte daśamīdine | na bhoktavyaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ samprāpte tu harerdine ||43 || macchāsanollaṃghayitā daṇḍārho vai bhaviṣyati | śrutvā paṭahanirghoṣaṃ śaśiseno’bravīt priyām ||44 || kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā kānte mariṣyāmi vinādanam | candrabhāgā tadā prāha kāntaṃ cintāturaṃ śanaiḥ || 45 || matpiturviṣaye kvāpi bhoktavyaṃ nādya kenacit | mānavairmānavādhīnapaśupakṣisarīsṛpaiḥ || 46 || tṛṇamannaṃ jalaṃ piṣṭaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ harerdine | yadi tvaṃ bhokṣyase kānta tato daṇḍaṃ prayāsyasi ||47 || prayāsyasi vigarhāṃ ca tasmātkuru mano dṛḍham | śrutvāhaśaśisenastāṃ kariṣye’hamupoṣaṇam || 88 || daivena vihitaṃ yanme tattathaiva bhaviṣyati | evaṃ dṛḍhāṃ matiṃ kṛtvā cakāra nirjalaṃ vratam ||4 9 || kṣudhātṛṣātisaṃvyāpto babhūva bahuvihalaḥ | rātrau mūrchābhibhūtaḥ sa brahmarandhraṃ samāśritaḥ || 1.260.5 0 || raverudayavelāyāṃ śaśiseno mṛti gataḥ | dāhayāmāsa rājā taṃ rājayogyaiśca dārubhiḥ || 51 || candrabhāgā harerbhaktermāhātmyabodhavattayā | pativratāpi patinā sahātmānaṃ dadāha na || 52 || kṛtvaurdhvadaihikaṃ bhartustasthau janakaveśmani | śaśiseno divyadeho ramāvratasupuṇyataḥ || 53 || prāptaḥ svarge tu sāmrājyaṃ svatantramaindrasadṛśam | bahusmṛddhamanādhṛṣyamasaṃkhyeyaguṇānvitam || 54|| hemastambhamayaiḥ saudhaiḥ ratnavaidūryamaṇḍitaiḥ | sphāṭikairvividhākārairvicitrairdivyasūjjvalaiḥ ||55|| bhavanairasaṃkhyabhaumaiḥ śobhitaṃ svargamāpa saḥ | vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ siṃhāsanasamāśritaḥ |||56 || kirīṭakuṇḍalayuto hārakeyūramaṇḍitaḥ | stūyamānaśca gandharvadevāpsaraḥparīgaṇaiḥ || 57|| karāttavyajanacchatracāmarābhijanairvṛtaḥ | śaśisenaḥ svake svarge rājate modate bahu ||58 || athaikadā mahendrasya dūtaḥ pṛthvyāṃ samāgataḥ | mucukundagṛhe kāryavaśādindreṇa moditaḥ ||59|| yadendrasya mahāyuddhaṃ daityaiḥ sahopatiṣṭhati | mucukundastadā daityān vijitvendrasahāyavān ||1.260.6 0 || jayaprado bhavatyeva brahmaṇo varadānataḥ | ityarthe tvāgataṃ dūtaṃ bhojitaṃ satkṛtaṃ tathā ||6 1 || nṛpaḥ papraccha vai svargisurāṇāṃ tu nirāmayam | dūto yadarthamāyātaḥ sarvaṃ nivedya vai tataḥ || 62|| nṛpaṃ prāha mayā svargaṃ śaśiseno’valokitaḥ | indrādanyūnasāmarthyasmṛddhivaibhavavāridhiḥ ||6 3 || rūpalāvaṇyasampanno yuvā devo virājate | jāmātā tava rājendra dṛṣṭvāyāntaṃ bhuvaṃ tu mām ||64 || prāha pṛthvyāṃ śvaśurasya candrasenanṛpasya ca | kāntāyāścandrabhāgāyāstathaiva nagarasya ca ||65||| matsakāśāttu kuśalaṃ praṣṭavyaṃ ca nirāmayam | mama svasti ca vaktavyaṃ svargyaṃ sarvaṃ yathāsti me || 66 || mama patnī ca vaktavyā patiste tvāṃ pratīkṣate | iti rājan hi jāmātuste’sti svarge sukhaṃ bahu ||67|| kuśalaṃ vartate tasyāścaryaṃ ca vidyate’dbhutam | puraṃ vicitraṃ ruciraṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ kenacitkvacit || 68 || divyaṃ vyomni sugatimattejo’mbaraprakāśitam | amṛtabhogabhogāḍhyaṃ dāsāpsarobhisevitam ||69 || varṇayituṃ na śaknomi mahāścaryamayaṃ puram | tava labdhaṃ hi jāmātrā vratapuṇyena śāśvatam || 1.260.70|| kārtikasyāsite pakṣe yā nāmaikādaśī ramā | tāmupoṣya mṛtaścātra prāptavān svargamīdṛśam ||7 1 ||| śraddhāhīno vratakartā prāpto’pi svargamuttamam | tadūrdhvaṃ divyalokaṃ sa gantumicchati nākataḥ ||72 | svīyapatnyānuṣṭhitasya ramāvratasya vai balāt | śrutvā tatra sthitā candrabhāgā hṛṣṭāha vai muhuḥ ||73 | nāthadarśanavegāḍhyā mucukundasya putrikā | tatra māṃ naya dūta tvaṃ yatrāste me priyaḥ patiḥ ||74| neṣye taṃ brahmadhāmāpi ramāvratasya puṇyataḥ | āvayordūta saṃyogo yathā bhavati tat kuru ||75| śrutvā dūto mucukundasyājñāṃ prāpya tadāmbare | candrabhāgāṃ divyadehāṃ kṛtvā nītvā jagāma ha ||76| sāpi svargasahaṃ divyaṃ rūpaṃ yauvanamityapi | divyaṃ coḍḍayanaṃ prāpya bhartuḥ samīpamāgatā ||77 bhartuḥ svargaṃ mahārājyaṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā jaharṣa sā | indraseno jaharṣāti dṛṣṭvā kāntāṃ samāgatām || 78 || samāhūya svake vāme pārśve tāṃ sa nyaveśayat | dūtaḥ prāpya susatkāramindraṃ prati jagāma ha | 79 || athovāca priyaṃ harṣāccandrabhāgā priyaṃ vacaḥ | śṛṇu kānta hitaṃ vākyaṃ yatpuṇyaṃ vidyate mayi ||1.260.8 0 || aṣṭavarṣādhikā jātā yadāhaṃ pitṛveśmani | tataḥ prabhṛti yaccīrṇaṃ mayā tvekādaśīvratam ||8 1 || tasya puṇyaprabhāveṇa yāsyāvo dhāma cākṣaram | sarvakāmasamṛddhaṃ ca śāśvataṃ śrīhareḥ padam || 8 2 || bahukālaṃ tu tau svargaṃ bhuktvā puṇyaprabhāvataḥ | yayatustvakṣaraṃ dhāma divyamuktau babhūvatuḥ ||8 3 || cintāmaṇisamā tveṣā kāmadhenusamāpi vā | kalpadrusadṛśī ramābhidhānaikādaśī mama ||84|| ekādaśīvratānāṃ ca pakṣayorubhayorapi | yathā kṛṣṇā tathā śuklā vibhedaṃ naiva kārayet ||89 || dhenuḥ śvetā yathā kṛṣṇā cobhayoḥ sadṛśaṃ payaḥ | tathaiva tulyaphaladaṃ smṛtamekādaśīdvayam ||8 6 || sevitaikādaśī nṝṇāṃ bhuktimuktipradāyinī | śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāpi vratatulyaphalaṃ bhavet || 87|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇoyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kārtikakṛṣṇaramaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ mucukundaputryāścandrabhāgāyāḥ patyurindrasenasya vratadine maraṇāt svargaṃ tataḥ patnyāḥ svargagatyuttaraṃ dvayormokṣaṃ ityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 260 ||
<1.261> śrīlakṣmīruvāca kārtikaścaturo māsān varṣāḍhyān puṇyakāryataḥ | antarbhūyātimāhātmyaśālinaḥ saṃkaroti hi || 1 || cāturmāsye na vai jātaṃ vrataṃ puṇyaṃ samarpaṇam | kārtike tasya karaṇāccāturmāsyaphalaṃ bhavet || 2 || pāpānāṃ nāśakaḥ svargasatyavairājalokadaḥ | golokavaikuṇṭhadaścākṣaralokaprado hi saḥ || 3 || kārtike yat kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ sahasraguṇitaṃ bhavet | tasmādātmakṛte sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ kārtike vratam || 4 || kārtikaśuklapakṣe tu kiṃnāmnyekādaśī matā | ko devaḥ ko vidhistatra kiṃ dānaṃ ca vrataṃ phalam || 5 || cāturmāsyāntimamāse vaiśiṣṭyaṃ kiṃ hi gaṇyate | yena vai vratino muktiṃ prayāntyapi ca me vada || 6 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi kārtikasya site dile | nāmnā prabodhinī proktaikādaśī tūttamottamā || 7 || yasyāṃ jāgartiṃ lakṣmīśaḥ śeṣaśāyī tu dhārmikaḥ | yasyā vrataprabhāveṇa līyate’jñānajaṃ tamaḥ || 8 || prakarṣeṇātmabodhaśca jāyate’taḥ prabodhinī | muktidātrī sukhadātrī svargadātrī ca bodhadā || 9 || upoṣyā vidhivattatra pūjyo dāmodaraḥ prabhuḥ | rādhayā ca prabodhinyā sahārcyo bahuvastubhiḥ || 1.261.10 || kamalaiḥ śreṣṭhapuṣpaiśca pūjanīyo janārdanaḥ | naivedye mudgalaḍaḍukā arghye padmaphalāni ca || 11 || dāne sopaskaro mañco deyānyanyānyapi priye | prabodhinīvrataṃ lakṣmi pāpaghnaṃ puṇyavardhakam || 12|| tāvattīrthānyaraṇyāni garjantyāyatanāni ca | yāvatkārtikamāsasya nāyāti bodhinīvratam || 1 3|| aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca | vājapeyasahasrāṇi prabodhinīsamāni na || 14|| alabhyaṃ cāpyagamyaṃ cāsādhyaṃ cāśakyameva vā | dadātyupoṣitā vratyarthitaṃ vai haribodhinī || 15|| vidyāṃ dhanaṃ rājasattāṃ prajāsattāṃ yaśo’malam | siddhiṃ ca sampadaṃ dadātyupoṣitātra bodhinī || 16|| mahāpāpātipāpāni saṃkarīkaraṇāni ca | śuṣkārdrāṇi ca sarvāṇyupoṣitā dahati nviyam || 17|| anekajanmasamprāptapāpaduritaparvatāna | kṛtaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau dahati bodhinīvrate || 18|| jñātvājñātvāthavā rogādibhiśceyamupoṣitā | pāravaśyopoṣitā vā svargaṃ mokṣaṃ dadāti sā || 19|| śraddhayā bhāvataścātra vidhivat kṛtameva yat | api svalpaṃ kṛtaṃ tasya phalaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet ||1.261.20 || ajñātenāpyavidhinā cāmanaskena vāpi yat | nindādrohānvitaṃ merupramaṃ kṛtaṃ tu niṣphalam ||2 1 || kartavyaṃ khalu svalpaṃ vā nindādrohau na vai caret | nindādrohāpekṣayā nu na kartavyaṃ varaṃ matam ||22|| pitṝnsaṃsmṛtya ye tvatra puṇyaṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ | gacchanti pitarasteṣāṃ tṛptā viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ||23|| brahmahatyādipāpāni vrate naśyanti jāgarāt | aśvamedhādikairyajñairapi duṣprāpyameva yat || 24|| anyaiśca sādhanaiḥ śreṣṭhairalabhyaṃ cāpi yadbhavet | prāpyate tatsukhenaiva prabodhinyāstu jāgarāt || 25|| yāvattīrthābhiṣekasya mahīsvarṇārpaṇasya ca | phalātphalaṃ tvadhikaṃ vai prāpyate vratajāgarāt || 26 || sa eva sukṛtī jātaḥ kulānāṃ pāvitaṃ śatam | tena yena kṛtā bhāvāt kārtike tu prabodhinī || 27|| vratapuṇyaṃ dhruvaṃ proktaṃ tadanyat sarvamadhruvam | vicāryeti prakartavyaṃ vrataṃ samyaggharerdine || 28 || prabodhinīvratakarturgṛhe tīrthāni sarvaśaḥ | pāvanāni pravasanti tadgṛhaṃ tīrtharājakam || 29 || putrapautradhanasampatpradā vai haribodhinī | putrādyarthaṃ vrataṃ tvanyat kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate || 1.261.30 || prabodhinyā vratakarturbhogo mokṣaḥ kare sthitaḥ | jñānaṃ yogastapo homaḥ saṃyamo’pi vrate sthitaḥ || 31 || dharmapuṣṭikarī viṣṇoḥ priyā muktipradā nṛṇām | garbhavāsādiduḥkhānāṃ nāśayitrī hyupoṣitā || 32 || karmaṇā manasā vācā śuṣkaṃ cārdraṃ ca pātakam | kṛṣṇaḥ kṣālayati prabodhinyā vrate sajāgare || 23 || kṛṣṇamuddiśya bodhinyāṃ snānaṃ homo japo’rpaṇam | pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ caitatkṛtaṃ bhavati cākṣayam || 34|| mahāvratamidaṃ proktaṃ nedṛśaṃ tu vratāntaram | śatajanmārjitāsaṃkhyamahāpāpaughanāśanam || 35|| prabodhinyā vratenātra toṣayitvā janārdanam | satkṛtaḥ svargasaṃsthaiḥ saḥ prayāti harimandiram || 3 6|| rūpasaundaryapuṣṭatvasaughaṭyārthibhirādarāt | dārāputragṛhakṣetrapatijairogyamicchubhiḥ || 37|| dhanavāhanayānādismṛddhidhenudhanecchubhiḥ | kartavyaiṣā prayatnena bodhinī pramadānaraiḥ || 38 || bālyayauvanavārdhakyāvasthāyogena vai kṛtam | śatajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vratādasyā vinaśyati || 39 || sūryacandroparāgasya yatphalaṃ kaurave sthale | tataḥ sahasraguṇitaṃ prabodhinyāṃ tu jāgare ||1.261.40 || yasya prayāti māsastu kārtiko vandhya eva ha | tasya bodhyaṃ nṛjanmāpi vandhyaṃ tvatra paratra ca ||4 1 || janmārjitasya puṇyādikarmaṇaścāpi vai phalam | bandhyakārtikamāsasya vyarthaṃ yāti sukhāya na ||42 || parānnaṃ varjayettasya cāndrāyaṇaphalaṃ bhavet | kārtike tu kathākarturyajñāyutaphalaṃ bhavet ||43 || tuṣyati na tathā yajñairna dānairvā japādibhiḥ | yathā śāstrakathābhistuṣyati kṛṣṇastu kārtike ||44|| śrotāraścāpi vaktāraḥ kathāyāḥ kārtike tu me | pratiślokaṃ labhante te gosahasrārpaṇaṃ phalam ||45|| kārtike śreyaso buddhyā keśavāgre’tibhāvataḥ | kathāvācayitā lakṣmi kulānāṃ tārayecchatam ||46|| pratyahaṃ niyamenātra kārtike śṛṇuyātkathām | hareryogātphalaṃ tasyā gosahasrapradānajam ||47|| prabodhinīvrate viṣṇoścaritraṃ śṛṇuyācca yaḥ | saptadvīpavatīdānaphalaṃ sa labhate vratī ||48 || viṣṇubuddhyā kathāṃ śrutvā ye’rcayanti kathāvidam | dhanadhānyāmbaraiḥ śaktyā teṣāṃ loko’kṣayo mataḥ ||49|| nāmakīrtanabhajanaiścaritraśravaṇādibhiḥ | kārtikaṃ kṣapayettasya punarāvarttanaṃ na vai ||1.261.5 0 || haryagre tu kathāṃ gītaṃ vādyaṃ nṛtyaṃ samutsavam | yaḥ karauti vrate prāpte nityaṃ vā muktibhāk sa vai |||5 1 || lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāṃ paṭhecchṛṇuyāttu yaḥ | pratyakṣaraṃ bhavedasya kapilādānajaṃ phalam ||52|| vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ samprāpte harivāsare | yataḥ puṇyamasaṃkhyātaṃ dhanadāne bhavatyapi ||53 || daśamyāmekabhuktaḥ san vratī bhūśayano niśi | saṃyamī brahmacārī ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ hṛdi saṃsmaret ||54|| ekādaśyāṃ prage devo jāgartīti vibhāvya vai | dhyātvā snātvā hariṃ ghaṇṭānādaṃ kṛtvā prabodhayet ||55|| āvāhanaṃ samārabhya vratī visarjanāntimām | pūjāṃ tu naityikīṃ kṛtvā harermaṇḍapamuttamam ||56|| śobhitaṃ kadalīstambhapatratoraṇaketubhiḥ | kārayecca vitānaṃ saccitraṃ vai bandhayecchubham ||57|| catuṣkoṇeṣu kalaśānuparyupari saptakān | klṛptayetparitastatra raṃgāvalīśca kārayet ||58 || madhye tu sarvatobhadramaṇḍalaṃ saptadhānyakam | kārayecca ghaṭaṃ tāmrakṛtaṃ vātha suvarṇajam ||59 || maṇḍale sthāpayenmadhye mahattamaśubhaṃ navam | parito maṇḍale tatra caturviṃśatisadghaṭān || 1.261.60 || sthāpayetsvarṇajān yadvā tāmrajān sajalānnavān | paṃcaratnapaṃcapatrapūgīphalāñcitaṇḍulān ||6 1 || vastrasūtranārikelaphalamodakaśobhitān | puṣpacandanakuṃkumākṣatavāryabhipūjitān ||62|| tanmukheṣu sthāpanīyāstilasthālyastu nūtanāḥ | śarkarailālavaṃgāḍhyāḥ phalanaivedyasaṃyutāḥ || 63 || madhyasthālyāṃ sthāpanīyo rādhādāmodaraḥ svayam | prabodhinyā sahitaḥ śrīmūrtirūpo hariḥ prabhuḥ ||64|| pārśve paryaṃka āstheyaḥ śayyāsādhanaśobhitaḥ | gendukaṃ kaśipurguptadorakaṃ prāvaraṃ tathā ||65|| vyajanaṃ cāmaraṃ chatraṃ pāduke darpaṇastathā dantakaḥ kalaśaḥ sthālī vāṭikāḥ phulavāṭikāḥ ||66 || anyānyapi tvapekṣyāṇi phalamiṣṭānnakāni ca | sthāpanīyāni tatraiva paryaṃke kṛṣṇatuṣṭaye ||67|| śrīgaṇeśaṃ sakuṭumbaṃ pūjayecca nivedayet|| ghaṇṭāṃ ca kalaśaṃ śaṃkhaṃ pūjayedupacārakaiḥ ||68 || tīrthānyāvāhayetpaścāddhariṃ tvāvāhayed vratī | āsanaṃ ca dadet pādyamarghyamācamanaṃ tataḥ ||69|| arpayed dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca śaucaśuddhiṃ prakalpayet | gaṇḍūṣānkārayetpaścāttīrthavāryabhiṣecanam ||1.261.70|| kārayecca tataḥ paṃcāmṛtasnānaṃ samarpayet | punaḥ śuddhodakasnānaṃ tathā vastreṇa mārjanam ||71 || dukūlārpaṇamaṃgeṣu sugandhyattarakārcanam | kaustubhaṃ brahmasūtraṃ ca kaṃcukaṃ śāṭikādikam ||72|| dhautraṃ ca kaṃcukīṃ divyāṃ ghargharīṃ prasamarpayet | mukuṭaṃ cottarāvastraṃ kuṇḍalairanakādikam ||73|| kaṭake śṛṃkhale vyaṅgiḍīśca ratnormikāstathā | raśanāṃ jhanjhirām̐ścāpi tantīṃ natthīṃ ca mālikāḥ ||74|| hārānsvarṇamayām̐ścānyānbhūṣaṇāni samarpayet | candanaṃ kajjalaṃ cūrṇaṃ kauṃkumaṃ kaisaraṃ jalam ||75|| kastūrikāṃ śvetacūrṇaṃ sindūrakamalaktakam | anyatsaubhāgyasaddravyaṃ cārpayet rādhikeśvare ||76|| abīraṃ ca gulālaṃ cākṣatānpuṣpāṇi cārpayet | bahupuṣpairbahuphalaiḥ karpūrāgurukuṃkumaiḥ ||77|| hareḥ pūjāṃ prakuryācca kārtike bodhinīprage | phalairnānāvidhairdravyairdhūpadīpanivedanaiḥ ||78|| miṣṭānnairvividhaiḥ śākapatraistathāranālakaiḥ | bhakṣyairbhojyairlehyacoṣyai rasairmiṣṭaiśca pānakaiḥ ||79|| phalaiśca vividhairdevaṃ toṣayed bhāvato vratī | śaṃkhatoyena vidhivattoṣayettu janārdanam ||1.261.80|| ketakyā ekapatreṇa pūjito garuḍadhvajaḥ | samāsahasraṃ suprīto jāyate kamalāpatiḥ ||8 1|| agastikusumaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayettu vidhānataḥ | pūjayiturdarśanācca nirayāgniḥ praśāmyati ||82|| munipuṣpārcito viṣṇuḥ kārtike puruṣottamaḥ | dadātyabhimatānkāmān divyādivyām̐stathā parān ||83|| vihāya sarvapuṣpāṇi munipuṣpeṇa keśavam | kārtike yo’rcayed bhaktyā vājimedhaphalaṃ labhet ||84|| tulasīdalapuṣpāṇi śamīpatrāṇi lā tathā | viṣṇāvarpayitā janmaśatajaṃ kārtike dahet ||85|| dṛṣṭā spṛṣṭāthavā dhyātā kīrtitā nāmataḥ stutā | ropitā secitā nityaṃ pūjitā tulasī natā ||86|| navadhā tulasībhaktiṃ yaṃ kurvanti dine dine | yugakoṭisahasrāṇi tanvanti sukṛtaṃ priye ||87|| yāvacchākhāpraśākhābhirbījapuṣpadalairnavaiḥ | ropitā tulasī puṃbhirvardhate pṛthivītale ||88|| teṣāṃ vaṃśe tu ye jātā ye bhaviṣyanti ye gatāḥ | teṣāmākalpasāhasraṃ vāso harergṛhe bhavet ||89|| yatphalaṃ sarvapuṣpeṣu sarvapatreṣu yatphalam | tulasyekadalenaiva prāptaṃ vai kārtike bhavet ||1.261.9 0|| nityaṃ tu kārtike viṣṇustulasīdalakaistathā | padmairdhātrīdalaiścaiva pūjanīyaḥ śamīdalaiḥ ||9 1 || iṣṭvā kratuśatairdevāndattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ | tatpuṇyaṃ tulasīpatraiḥ kārtike keśavārcane ||92|| ārārtrikaṃ namaskāraṃ stotraṃ pradakṣiṇāstathā | dakṣiṇā daṇḍavat puṣpāṃjaliṃ ca kṣamaṇārthanam ||93|| vratapūrtiprārthanāṃ ca vratī kṛtvā tataḥ param | guroḥ pūjāṃ prakurvīta bhojanācchādanādibhiḥ ||94|| suvarṇadakṣiṇābhiśca tuṣṭyarthaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ | goprabhatīni dānāni dātavyāni bahūnyapi ||9 5 || madhyāhne pūjayeddevaṃ bhojayedvai vidhānataḥ | sāyaṃ cāpi mahāpūjāṃ kārayedbhojayeddharim ||96 || jalapānādyarpayecca preṃkhāyāṃ sthāpayettataḥ | āndolayettoṣayecca pādasaṃvāhanaṃ caret ||97|| vratī jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādgītavāditranartanaiḥ | kathābhī rāsaramaṇairlīlānukaraṇādibhiḥ ||98|| prātardvādaśikāyāṃ tu snātvā sampūjya mādhavam | bhojayettarpayedārārtrikeṇa vardhayeddharim ||99|| stutvā visarjayetsarvān bhojayedbahubhāvataḥ | sādhūnsādhvīḥ sātvatām̐śca viprān bālān subhojayet || 1.261.100 || dadyād dānānyanekāni pāraṇāṃ ca tataścaret | evamudyāpanaṃ kṛtvā ghaṭādi gurave’rpayet || 101 || evaṃ vrataṃ prapūrṇaṃ ca kṛtvākṣaramavāpnuyāt | bhuktiṃ bhuktiṃ samāpnoti śāśvataṃ ca sukhaṃ dhruvam || 102 || śṛṇu vrate prabodhinyāḥ kurvantaṃ harimandire| kīrtanaṃ tvekacāṇḍālaṃ rākṣasādrakṣitaṃ priye || 103 || araṇye raivate kṣetre hyaśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe | brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ tvāsīd viṣṇusthānamanāvṛtam || 10 4|| āraṇyakā janā yasya darśanād yānti sadgatim | bhadrāvatī taṭāvāsī kaściddīnajanaḥ khalu || 105 || dvijastu karmacaṇḍālaḥ kāṣṭhahāro’bhavannanu | nadīpūreṇa sannaṣṭa gṛhadārādikaḥ sa hi || 106 || araṇye’rocatāvāsaṃ kāṣṭhahāritvakarmataḥ | śubhasaṃskārayukto’sau nityaṃ sāyaṃ tu bhāvataḥ || 107 || viṣṇusthānaṃ prayāti sma kīrtanaṃ prakarotyapi | darśanaṃ nayanaṃ cāpi punaryāti nijālayam || 108 || kārtike tu prabodhinyāṃ jāgaraṃ kartumutsukaḥ | niśi gacchantamenaṃ vai jagrāha pathi rākṣasaḥ || 109 || jahāsa karmacāṇḍālo rākṣaso vismayaṃ gataḥ | papraccha maraṇe kāle nirbhayaṃ hāsyakāraṇam || 1.261.110 || karmacaṇḍāla āhainaṃ dhanyo’haṃ mṛtirāgatā | ekādaśītithistvadya vrataṃ me’sti prabodhinī || 111 || devālayaṃ tu gacchāmi kīrtanāyārcanāya ca | jāgarāya prayāmyevaṃ mṛtyuryadi samāgataḥ || 112 || tadā me sadgatistvasti na hyadho yāti bhaktikṛt | yadi te’sti kṣudhā tarhi śīghraṃ bhakṣaya māmiha || 113 || vrate yadvā jāgarādi kṛtvā bhakṣaya māṃ prage | rākṣasaḥ prāha mṛtyorvai mukhād yo mucyate janaḥ || 11 4|| na cāyāti punarmṛtyusthale tvāsthā name tvayi | cāṇḍālaḥ prāha yadyevaṃ samāgaccha mayā saha || 115 || kariṣye kīrtanaṃ paścād yatheṣṭaṃ māṃ prabhakṣaya | kīrtanena bhavenmuktiḥ śravaṇenāpi mokṣaṇam || 116 || rākṣasaḥ prāha yadyevaṃ tvayā gacchāmyahaṃ saha | pūrvaṃ devasvakośasyādhikāre hyāsameva yat || 117 || yaśodātrīpurīmadhye devasvaṃ coritaṃ bahu | tena pāpena jāto’haṃ brāhmaṇo brahmarākṣasaḥ || 118 || yadi vai kīrtanādatra śravaṇādvā pramokṣaṇam | bhavatīti mamāpi syānmokṣaṇaṃ nāgraho bhujeḥ || 119 || vicāryeti yayatustau vrate viṣṇusthale niśi | caṇḍālena pragītaṃ vai kīrtanaṃ nṛtyatālitam || 1.261.120 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ dvābhyāṃ subhāvataḥ | prātaḥ śuddhāvabhūtāṃ tau devayānaṃ samāgatam || 121 || dehau vihāya tatraiva yayatuḥ svargameva tau | bhogān bhuktvāsaṃkhyasamā apsarogaṇasevitau || 122|| paścānmuktiṃ prayātau tau vaikuṇṭhaṃ viṣṇvanugrahāt | evaṃ tvasadgatikānāṃ patitānāṃ ca mokṣakṛt || 123 || vrataṃ prabodhinī śreṣṭhaṃ kartavyaṃ sarvathā janaiḥ | anyānyapi vratānyatra kartavyānyapi me śṛṇu || 1 24|| eteṣvekatame jāte kārtikaḥ pāpakartanaḥ | snātavyaṃ brāhmakāle ca kartavyaṃ kṛcchramādarāt || 1 25|| āśvayujyāḥ samārabhya kārtikyavadhiṃ bhaktitaḥ | vrataṃ māsopavāsākhyaṃ kāryaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ śubham || 1 26|| tithihrāse kṛṣṇapakṣe grāsānāmalakopamān | tyaktvaikaikaṃ prabhuñjīta vardhayecca site dale || 1 27|| tithivṛddhyā śuklapakṣe grāsānāmalakopamān | ekaikavṛddhyā bhuñjīta hrāsayecca sitetare || 1 28|| pūrvaṃ pipīlikānāma dvitīyaṃ yavanāmakam | madhye kṣīṇaṃ ca puṣṭaṃ ca proktaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ śubham || 1 29|| carurbhaikṣaṃ saktukaṇā yāvakaḥ śākamityapi | payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ pānīyameva vā || 1.261.130 || uttarottaraśastāni havīṣyetāni vai vrate | amāyāṃ naiva bhuñjīta tithivṛddhau tu ṣoḍaśa || 131 || tithikṣaye tu tadgrāsā grāhyāścaturdaśaiva hi | yathākathañcit piṇḍānāṃ catvāriṃśacchatadvayam || 13 2|| māsenaivopabhuñjīta tadapīnduvrataṃ bhavet | aṣṭāvaṣṭau samaśnīyād yati cāndrāyaṇaṃ hi tat || 133 || prātaścaturaḥ sāyaṃ ca śiśucāndrāyaṇaṃ hi tat | athānyāni pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu lakṣmi samāhitā || 134 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kārtikaśuklaprabodhinīvratamāhātmyaṃ vipranimittakakīrtanavratayogena karmacaṇḍālaviprasya rākṣasasya ca muktiścāndrāyaṇasvarūpaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 261 ||
<1.262> śrīlakṣmīruvāca kāni vratāni cānyāni kārtike puṇyadāni vai | kartavyāni ca me nātha vada sarvāṇi tāni ca || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ākāśadīpo dātavyo vratinā devamandire | tīrthadīpāḥ pradātavyāḥ śataśo’tha sahasraśaḥ || 2 || nadyāṃ nade taḍāge ca sarasyapi ca vāridhau | kūpe vāpyāṃ jale deyā dīpāḥ svargapradā matāḥ || 3 || ekabhuktirdīpadānaṃ kārtike vratamityapi | dvidalāḥ kārtike deyā naktamuktirmataṃ vratam || 4 || trīṃstrīnpiṇḍānsamaśnīyānmāsam ṛṣiśaśivratam | gokṣīraṃ saptarātraṃ ca pibetstanacatuṣṭayāt || 5 || stanatrayātsaptarātraṃ saptarātraṃ stanadvayāt | ṣaḍrātraṃ ca tathaikasmāt trirātraṃ vāyubhugbhavet || 6 || etatsomāyanaṃ nāma mahaccāndrāyaṇaṃ matam | ekabhaktaistathā naktaistathaivāyācitairapi || 7 || upavāsaiścaturbhiścetyevaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirdinaiḥ | mahāpāpadhvaṃsakṛttat kṛcchrākhyaṃ vratamucyate || 8 || dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ jalaṃ coṣṇaṃ miśramekadinaṃ pibet | upāvasedekadainaṃ taptakṛcchravrataṃ tu tat || 9 || uṣṇadugdhaghṛtavāri pratyekaṃ pratyahaṃ pibet | caturthe’hni copavaset taptakṛcchrāntaraṃ tvidam || 1.262.10 || pratitryahaṃ jalaṃ dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ coṣṇaṃ samīraṇam | pibed dvādaśadainātmataptakṛcchravrataṃ hi tat || 11 || pibet pratitryahaṃ śītaṃ śītakṛcchravrataṃ ca tat | pāne kramātpramāṇaṃ tu tripalaṃ dvipalaṃ palam || 12 || ekāhaṃ pañcagavyaṃ saṃpibeddarbhodakānvitam | dvitīye tūpavāsena vrataṃ sāntapanaṃ matam || 13 || pratyahaṃ gavyamekaikaṃ ṣaṣṭhe kuśodakaṃ pibet | saptame’hni tpavasenmadhyasāntapana vratam || 14|| sāntapanaṃ trirāvṛdyaikaviṃśatidinairmahat | pratitryahaṃ kramād gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ ca godadhi || 1 5|| godugdhaṃ ca gavājyaṃ ca sāntapanaṃ mahattaram | tryahaṃ miśraṃ pañcagavyaṃ yatisāntapanaṃ vratam || 16 || palāśodumbarapadmabilvānāṃ pallavaiḥ pṛthak | kuśena kvathitaṃ pratyahaṃ tu vāri pibed vratī || 1 7|| pañcāhasādhyamityetat parṇakṛcchravrataṃ matam | trirātropoṣitasturye pañcakvāthaṃ pibed yadi || 18 || parṇakūrcavrataṃ tvetanmataṃ cāturdinīyakam | māsaḥ phalairhi netavyaḥ phalakṛcchra udāhṛtaḥ || 19 || śrīphalaiḥ śrīphalakṛcchraḥ padmaiśca padmakṛcchrakaḥ | āmalakaiśca śrīkṛcchraḥ pallavaiḥ patrakṛcchrakaḥ || 1.262.20 || puṣpaistu puṣpakṛcchraḥ syānmūlaiśca mūlakṛcchrakaḥ | jalena jalakṛcchraḥ syād dugdhena dugdhakṛcchrakaḥ || 21 || yena māso vyatīyeta tannāmā kṛcchra ucyate | ekabhaktena naktenāyācitenopavāsataḥ || 2 2|| caturbhirdivasaiḥ pādakṛcchraṃ taducyate vratam | tryahaṃ madhye tryahaṃ naktaṃ tryahaṃ yādṛcchikaṃ haviḥ || 2 3 || tatastryahaṃ ca nāśnīyātprājāpatyaṃ vrataṃ tu tat | dvādaśāhaścātikṛcchraḥ pāṇipūrānnabhojanaḥ || 24||| tryahaṃ niraśanaṃ kāryaṃ pādakṛcchraṃ vrataṃ matam | tryahaṃ yādṛcchikaṃ grāhyaṃ dvitīyaṃ pādakṛcchrakam || 25 || tryahaṃ naktaṃ tathā grāhyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ pādakṛcchrakam | tryahaṃ madhyāhnake grāhyaṃ caturthaṃ pādakṛcchrakam || 26 || madhye pañcadaśagrāsā nakte tu dvādaśa smṛtāḥ | yādṛcchikāścaturviṃśatigrāsā bhojane smṛtāḥ || 27|| ekāhaṃ madhyake grāhyaṃ dvitīyāhaṃ tu naktakam | punardvyahaṃ yādṛcchikaṃ tato dvyahamupoṣaṇam || 28 || vratamevaṃ ṣaḍāhaṃ tadardhakṛchramudīritam | ekaviṃśatyahaṃ dugdhaṃ pibet kṛcchrātikṛcchrakam || 29 || dvādaśāhaṃ jalamātraṃ pibet kṛcchrātikṛcchrakam | dvādaśāhopavāsaistu pārākaḥ kṛcchra ucyate || 1.262.30 | pratyahaṃ tilapiṣṭaṃ ca saktūn takramupoṣaṇam | caturdinātmakaṃ saumyakṛcchraṃ vratamudīritam || 31 | pratyahaṃ tilapiṣṭaṃ ca takraṃ vāri kuśodakama | pañcadinopavāsaśca saumyakṛcchrāntaraṃ tu tat || 32 | tilapiṣṭamodananiḥsrāvastakraṃ jalaṃ saktūn | upavāsaḥ ṣaḍahaṃ tat saumyakṛcchrāntaraṃ matam || 33 | tilapiṣṭādikaṃ pratyekaṃ trirātraṃ samabhyaset | tulāpuruṣakṛcchraḥ sa bodhyaḥ pañcadaśāhnikaḥ || 34| pañcadaśadinānte tu tryahaṃ vāyuṃ tryahaṃ tataḥ | upoṣaṇaṃ caikaviṃśatyahaṃ tulānṛkṛcchrakam || 35 | śukle corje caturdaśyāṃ jale sthitvānilaṃ pibet | pūrṇimāyāmupavasejjalakṛcchraṃ vrataṃ matam || 36 | daśamyāṃ pañcagavyāśī hyekādaśyāmupāvaset | viṣṇupūjāṃ prakurvīta harikṛcchraṃ vrataṃ smṛtam || 37 || saptamītaḥ pṛthag vāri dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ pibet | ekādaśyāmupavaset kṛcchraḥ paitāmaho vratam || 38 || ṣaṣṭhītastu tryahaṃ vāri tryahaṃ copavased vratī | dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇāṃ kuryānmāhendrakṛcchrakaṃ vratam || 3 9|| tṛtīyātastryahaṃ nivārādi tryahaṃ ca yāvakam | tatastryahaṃ tūpavased viṣṇukṛcchravrataṃ hi tat || 1.262.40 || pratipattaḥ pañcadinaṃ dugdhaṃ paṃcadinaṃ dadhiṃ | ekādaśīmupavased bhāskarakṛchra ucyate ||4 1 || pañcamītaḥ site bhājīṃ yavān śākaṃ payo dadhi | ghṛtaṃ jalaṃ kramād grāhyaṃ saptarṣikṛcchrakaṃ vratam |||42 || pratipattaḥ kramātpeyaṃ dugdhaṃ vā kvāthitaṃ jalam | palāśabilvadarbhābjodumbaraparṇakaiḥ pṛthaka || 43 || ṣaṣṭhyāmupoṣaṇaṃ caitadagnikṛcchraṃ vrataṃ smṛtam | saptamītaḥ kramād dugdhaṃ bilvaṃ pakvaṃ ca padmajam ||44|| bisatantūn bhakṣayeścaikādaśyāṃ samupoṣaṇam | pañcadinātmakaṃ cedaṃ lakṣmīkṛcchravrataṃ smṛtam ||45 || brahmakūrcavrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam | kṛtena yena mucyante mānavāḥ sarvapātakaiḥ ||46 || sādhyaṃ tvetat tridivasairvidhiṃ vakṣyāmi tasya tu | upavasennavamyāṃ tu pañcagavyaṃ kuśāṃbhasā ||47|| saṃpibettu daśamyāṃ ca hyekādaśyāmupāvaset | gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ dugdhaṃ darbhodikaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhi ||48 || pañcagavyaṃ tu tatproktaṃ pavitraṃ dehaśodhakam | gomūtraṃ tāmravarṇāyāḥ śvetāyāścaiva gomayam ||49 || dugdhaṃ suvarṇarūpāyāḥ nīlāyāstu tathā dadhi | kṛṣṇāyāstu ghṛtaṃ yadvā kapilāyāstu paṃcakam ||1.262.5 0 || suvarṇā kapilā tvekā dvitīyā sā tvapiṃgalā | tṛtīyā sā tu raktākṣī caturthī gūḍapiṃgalā || 51 || paṃcamī karburā sā syāt ṣaṣṭī syāt śvetapiṃgalā | saptamī śvetapiṃgākṣī hyaṣṭamī kṛṣṇapiṃgalā || 5 2|| navamī pāṭalā sā syād daśamī pucchapiṃgalā | etā daśavidhā proktā kapilā havyadāyinī ||5 3 || alābhe sarvavarṇānāṃ paṃcagavyaṃ mataṃ śubham | gomūtraṃ māṣakāssvaṣṭau gomayasya tu ṣoḍaśa |||54|| bodhyā dvādaśa dugdhasya dadhno grāhyā daśaiva ha | ghṛtasya māṣakāstvaṣṭau catvārastu kuśāṃbhasaḥ ||55|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇanāmnā gāyatryā vātha mantrataḥ | gṛhītvā tadṛcā yadvā gāyatryā vā puṃsūktataḥ |||56|| agnau hotavyameveti pañcagavyamuddhṛtya tu | haritākuṇṭhitāgryasaptapatrānvitasaḥkuśaiḥ || 57|| harernāmnāmaṣṭottaraśatena homa iṣyate | hutaśeṣaṃ tu pātavyaṃ praṇavenābhimantritam ||58 || praṇavenābhiśritaṃ ca praṇavenoddhṛtaṃ ca tat | palāśamadhyapatreṇa pibet padmadalena vā || 59 || svarṇapātreṇa raupyeṇa brahmatīrthena vā pibet | kathito brahmakūrco’yaṃ pāpaghno muktidastathā || 1.262.60 || dvādaśāhaṃ tilāḥ prāśyā agnikṛcchravrataṃ tu tat | gavā tyaktairyavairmāsaṃ nirvahed yavakṛcchrakam || 61 || gavā tyaktayavasaktūn bhuñjīta māsameva tu | yāmyakṛcchraṃ tu tatproktaṃ dehakalmaṣanāśakam || 6 2|| nityaṃ tu prasṛtimātratilapiṣṭena nirvahet | māsamekaṃ tu tatproktaṃ kuberakṛcchrakaṃ vratam || 63 || gomūtreṇācaret snānaṃ gomayaṃ bhakṣayedapi | gavāṃ madhye nivasecca gopūrīṣe svapettathā || 6 4|| pibenna goṣvapītāsu nābhuktāsu tu bhakṣayet | utthitāsu samuttiṣṭhedupaviṣṭāsu saṃviśet || 55 || māsamātraṃ vrataṃ caitad govrataṃ bodhyameva tat | sādhuṣu vasatiḥ sādhusevanaṃ sādhuvartanam || 66 || sādhoḥ prāsādikaṃ bhojyaṃ peyaṃ sādhuvrataṃ tu tat | āmikṣayā tu māsau dvau dugdhena pakṣameva ca || 6 7|| dadhnā cāṣṭāhamevāpi ghṛtena tryahameva ca | nirāhāraṃ tryahaṃ tiṣṭheduddālakaṃ vrataṃ tvidam || 68 || śrīkāmaḥ puṣṭikāmaśca svargakāmastathā janaḥ | devaprīṇanakāmaśca kṛcchraṃ kurvīta bhaktitaḥ || 69 || evametāni kṛcchrāṇi vratāni kathitāni te | pāpaghnāni muktidāni sarveṣāmapi padmaje || 1.262.70 || kurvan kṛcchrāṇi sarvāṇi yatavāṅmānasendriyaḥ | dhautavastradharaḥ śāntaḥ snātvā saṃpūjayeddharim || 71 || vratadravyāṇi sarvāṇi dugdhādīni sadā vratī | aśnīyācchrīhareḥ prāsādikānyeva na cetarat|| |7 2|| kurvan kṛcchrāṇi muhyeścen mūrchāṃ yadvābhisaṃviśet | amṛtaṃ tu gavāṃ dugdhaṃ pāyayettaṃ vratārthinam ||7 3 || jalaṃ rasaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ takraṃ patraṃ payo dadhi | bhājāmikṣauṣadhaṃ kvāthaḥ kandaḥ śākaṃ gurorvacaḥ ||74|| viprājñājñātakavalaḥ āpattigrasanaṃ tathā | mukhavāsārhasadvastu navanītaṃ ca śarkarā || 75|| gūḍo dugdhavikārādyāstailaṃ tilādikaṃ tathā | bhivārādi ca munyannaṃ bhūphalī vṛkṣapeśikā ||76 || lavaṃgailāmarīcatvagārdrakasūṃphagundrakāḥ | śilārasaśca kastūrī candanaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā ||77|| madhu dhūmraścatvāriṃśadavrataghnāni santi vai | vratānte bhojayet sādhūn śāśvataṃ tatphalaṃ bhavet ||78 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kārtike kartavyakṛcchravratānāṃ nirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvāṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 262 ||
<1.263> śrīlakṣmīruvāca kṛcchre kaṣṭamiti proktaṃ sukhaṃ tvayyarpitaṃ tu tat | sukhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ kṛcchravrataṃ tatte prasaṃgataḥ || 1 || vrataṃ puṇyaṃ tathā peyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ sarvaṃ tvameva hi | tvāṃ vinā niṣphalaṃ sarvaṃ yato nāsti dhruva hi tat || 2 || brūhi me bhagavan māse puruṣottamasaṃjñake | ekādaśī kṛṣṇapakṣe kiṃnāmnī kiṃ phalaṃ vrate || 3 || ko vidhiḥ pūjanaṃ kīdṛk ko devaścātra pūjyate | kiṃ dānaṃ ke ca niyamāḥ sarvaṃ brūhi suvistaram || 4 || kathaṃ snānaṃ ca kiṃ jāpyaṃ kiṃ bhojyaṃ tūttamaṃ matam | kiṃ tyājyaṃ cātra māse’pi tanme brūhi janārdana || 5 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ekādaśyadhike māsi kamalā nāma nāmataḥ | puruṣottama ityuktaḥ pūjanīyaśca tatpatiḥ || 6 || lakṣmīyutaḥ suvarṇasya mūrtirūpo hariḥ prabhuḥ | dhyeyau vaikuṇṭhatasthānau śrīlakṣmīpuruṣottamau || 7 || kamalāyā vratenātra kamalābhimukhī bhavet | daśamyāmekabhuktaḥ syād rātrau bhūśayano bhavet || 8 || brahmacārī bhaveccaiva krodhādyaṃ tu parityajet | brāhme muhūrte cotthāya saṃsmṛtya puruṣottamam || 9 || snātvā cāpi vidhānena niyamaṃ gṛhaṇīyād vratī | puruṣottamamāse vā prātaśca pratipaddine || 1.263.10 || gṛhṇīyānniyamānpālyānpāvanān dehināṃ khalu | nityaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ vā lakṣaṃ vā niyamo jape || 11 || gṛhe tvekaguṇaṃ jāpyaṃ nadyāṃ tu dviguṇaṃ smṛtam | sahasraṃ gosthale vahniśālāyāṃ tattu lakṣakam || 12|| devakṣetreṣu tīrtheṣu sādhūnāṃ sannidhau tathā | daśalakṣaguṇaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ tulasīsannidhau || 13|| viṣṇostu sannidhau jāpyamanantaṃ bhavati dhruvam | mālikāvartanaṃ saṃsārāvartadhvaṃsakaṃ smṛtam || 14|| cāturmāsye tu niyamā māsi te puruṣottame | grāhyā aivobhayatrāpi bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ || 15|| grāhyā māsasamāraṃbhe harermūrtestu sannidhau | gūḍasya varjanaṃ kāryaṃ tathā tailasya varjanam || 16|| ghṛtasya varjanaṃ tailādestyāgaḥ kaṭuvarjanam | sugandhatailasaṃtyāgaḥ puṣpabhogavivarjanam || 17|| kaṭvamblamadhurakṣāratiktakaṣāyavarjanam | tāmbūlavarjanaṃ miṣṭaphalādeścāpi varjanam || 18|| pālāśapatre tvaśanaṃ pādābhyaṃgavivarjanam | śiro’bhyaṃgaparityāgo dadhidugdhavivarjanam || 19|| kajjalādeḥ parityāgo dvirbhojanavivarjanam | maunaṃ grāhma kathā kāryā grāmyavārtāvivarjanam ||1.263.20 || sthālīpākaparityāgaḥ śākamātravivarjanam | annamātraparityāgaḥ phalānyatamavarjanam ||21 || śilopari prāśanaṃ ca kadalīpatrabhojanam | puṣkarasnānakararṇa gṛhasnānavivarjanam ||22|| guroḥ pādāmbujasparśo viṣṇoḥ pādābhivandam | ekabhaktāśanaṃ naktāśanaṃ niraśanaṃ ca vā ||23|| harergṛhe lepanaṃ mārjanaṃ prakṣālanādikam | pradakṣiṇaṃ śatamaṣṭottaraśataṃ ca vādhikam ||24|| gītavāditrasannṛtyaṃ pañcagavyāśanaṃ ca vā | śāstrakathāprabodhaśca vyāsākhyānaprabodhanam ||25|| tulasīdalapūjā ca prokṣaṇaṃ viṣṇumandire | patreṣu bhojanaṃ caiva dvidalādivivarjanam ||26|| prasādamātragrahaṇaṃ tāmrapātrādyabhojanam | kāṃsyapātrābhojanaṃ ca randhitānnāprabhojanam ||27|| jalapakvakaṇamātrādanaṃ pakvakaṇādanam | mṛttikāpātrabhojitvamañjalijalapānakam || 28| karapātrādanaṃ cāpi pṛthivyāmupaveśanam | kapilāgopradānaṃ ca padmapatraprabhojanam ||29|| bhikṣānnaṃ tvamṛtakalpaṃ vrataṃ mokṣakaraṃ śubham | svarṇadānaṃ rūpyadānaṃ vastradānaṃ gṛhārpaṇam ||1.263.30 || nityaṃ yathābalaṃ dānamannādīnāṃ supuṇyakṛt | yathā viṣṇustathā sādhurdvāvetau puruṣottamau || 31 || teṣāṃ pūjā prakartavyā pratyahaṃ sevanaṃ tathā | śūdro vāpyatha śūdrī vā sevāṃ kuryād gurorhareḥ || 22 || gururvai viṣṇurūpo’sti gururdevatrayātmakaḥ | dehena sevā kartavyā yathā tuṣṭo bhavedguruḥ || 33 || pāñcabhautikametaddhi tvanarthakamudāhṛtam | sevayitvā guruṃ tena phalānantyamavāpnuyāt || 34|| dharmo’yaṃ durlabho loke dharmakāmārthamokṣadaḥ | ayācitaṃ vrataṃ pālyaṃ drohahiṃsādivarjam || 35 || dānaṃ dayā dama iti kāryaṃ vai mahatāmapi | gurave ye prayacchanti dehadaihikasampadaḥ || 36 || te nu dānaprabhāveṇa viṣṇorvallabhatāṃ gatāḥ | madhu tyājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tyājyaṃ tyājyaṃ dugdhādikaṃ tathā || 37|| dāḍimaṃ mātuliṃgaṃ ca nālikeraṃ ca varjayet | vrīhityāgo yavatyāgo godhūmānāṃ vivarjanam || 38 || padaṃ ślokaṃ ṛcāṃ stotramadhyāyaṃ kīrtanaṃ tathā | kāryaṃ geyaṃ hareragre viṣṇordhāmapradaṃ vratam || 39 || ratestyāgo maithunasya karmatyāgo vrataṃ mahat|| dadhiṃ dugdhaṃ tathā takraṃ gūḍaṃ śākaṃ ca varjayet || 1.263.40 || snānamāmalakaiḥ kāryaṃ tilaiḥ kartavyameva vā | dhātrīphalaṃ sadā pāpaharaṃ vai pāvanāstilāḥ || 41 || sandhyāmaunaṃ vrataṃ rakṣyaṃ rātrāvagnyaprabodhanam | maunabhojitvamevāpi vrataṃ śuddhikaraṃ śubham || 42|| upavāsasamaṃ jñeyaṃ phaladaṃ maunabhojanam | mithyākrodhaśca paiśūnyaṃ rājasaṃ tāmasaṃ tathā ||43 || vartanaṃ sarvathā tyājyaṃ māsi vai puruṣottame | puṇyakāryaṃ śubhaṃ kāryaṃ tyaktavyaṃ pāpakarma ca ||44|| dhyeyaḥ pūjyastoṣaṇīyaḥ smartavyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | kṛcchrāṇyapi prakāryāṇi māse vai puruṣottame ||45|| kamalāyā vratakartuḥ kamalā jāyate gṛhe | kamalāyāstathā lakṣmyāḥ śrīpuruṣottamasya ca ||46|| ekādaśyāṃ prage dhyānaṃ kṛtvā snātvā vidhānataḥ | naityakaṃ pūjanaṃ kuryāt sarvatobhadramaṇḍale ||47|| ghaṭān dvādaśasaṃkhyākān jalaratnadalānvitān | akṣataphalavastrādyaiḥ saṃyutānpūjayettataḥ || 48 || madhye ghaṭaṃ suvarṇe vā tāmrajaṃ sthāpayed vratī | suvāriphalaratnādyaiḥ sahitaṃ pūjayet tataḥ ||49|| ghaṇṭāṃ śaṃkhaṃ kalaśaṃ ca pūjayedvastubhistathā | ghaṭopari tilasthālyāṃ vinyasya puruṣottamam ||1.263.50|| pūjayed vidhinā sarvavastubhirvratakārakaḥ | āvāhanādikaṃ kuryāt pañcāmṛtavilepanam ||51|| tīrthajalena ca snānaṃ kārayed varṣma mārjayet | vastrālaṃkārabhūṣādi candanādi samarpayet ||52|| kajjalāgurukastūrīsugandhi tailamarpayet | hāraśṛṃgāraśobhādi dhūpadīpādi cārpayet|||53||| naivedye vividhaṃ bhojyaṃ phalaṃ vāri ca cūrṇakam | tāmbūlaṃ subhagaṃ datvā tato nīrājayetprabhum ||94|| śaṃkhodakaṃ bhrāmayecca daṇḍavacca pradakṣiṇam | stutiṃ namaḥ kṣamāyāñcāṃ kṛtvā śayyādi kārayet ||55|| pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kuryāt tadānandaṃ vikāsayet | dadyād dānāni bhūrīṇi madhyāhne’pi tathācaret ||56|| bhojayedvividhānnāni pūjayeccātibhāvataḥ | sāyamārārtrikaṃ kuryāt stutvā saṃbhojayettathā ||57|| rātrau tu jāgaraṃ kuryānnṛtyagītapuraḥsaram | dvādaśyāṃ tu prage snātvā pūjayitvā hariṃ tathā ||58|| bhojayitvā guroḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvānyān bhojayed bahu | tataḥ svaḥ pāraṇāṃ kuryād dadyād dānāni bhāvataḥ ||59||| evaṃ vrataṃ prakuryādvai bhuktimuktipradāyakam | niyamānāṃ tathā kuryādudyāpanaṃ phalapradam |||1.263.60 || maṇḍapaṃ kārayedramyaṃ saptadhānyaistu maṇḍalam | svastikān kārayeccāpi śayyādānāni dāpayet ||6 1 || śrīhariṃ ca ramāṃ tatra pūjayed vidhinā vratī | gadinaṃ ca gavārcāṃ ca sādhubhyo bhojanaṃ tathā ||62|| dadyācca gurave’pekṣyaṃ vastrānnābhūṣaṇādikam | ṣoḍaśavastubhirdevamahāpūjottaraṃ tataḥ ||66|| dānāni khalu dadyād vai vividhāni svayaṃ vratī | udyāpane tu dānāni deyāni vratapūrtaye ||64|| udyāpane kṛte sarvaṃ sampūrṇaṃ bhavati dhruvam | vrataṃ kṛtvā mahālakṣmi yadi nodyāpanaṃ caret|||65|| vratavaikalyamāsādya na samyak phalabhāgbhavet | vrate yanniyamaḥ svena dhṛtastatpratirūpakam ||66|| udyāpane tvavaśyaṃ saṃdadyāddānaṃ vratī svayam | tailatyāge ghṛtaṃ dadyād ghṛtatyāge payaḥ smṛtam ||67|| maune tilādayo deyāḥ sahiraṇyāstu śārṅgiṇe | bhojane bhojanaṃ dadyād dadhyodanasamanvitam ||68|| annaṃ miṣṭaṃ suvarṇāḍhyaṃ dadyādvai bahubhāvataḥ | pālāśapātrabhojī tu dadyānmiṣṭaṃ ghṛtādikam ||69|| naktabhojī pradadyādvai bhojanaṃ ṣaḍrasānvitam | ayācite tvanaḍvāhaṃ sopaskaraṃ samarpayet ||1.263.70|| māṣatyāgī pradadyāttu savatsāṃ gāṃ sulakṣaṇām | dhātrīsnāne vratī dadyāt suvarṇaṃ māṣamātrakam ||7 1 || phalānāṃ niyame dadyāt phalāni vividhāni vai | dhānyānāṃ niyame dadyāt dhānyāni śāligodhūmān ||72|| dadyādbhūśayane śayyāṃ satūlāṃ gendukānvitām | brahmacaryakṛte dadyād dampatyorbhojanāni vai ||73|| śākatyāge tu śākāni nairlāvaṇye rasādikam | nityasnāne ca niḥsnehe dadyād ghṛtaṃ ca saktukān || 74|| nakhakeśavrate dadyādādarśaṃ vyajanādikam | upānahoḥ parityāge dadyādupānahau mudā ||75|| dugdhādisaṃparityāge dadyādvai kapilāṃ tu gām | dīpavrate pradadyādvai sauvarṇa dīpapātrakam ||76|| maithunānāṃ tu niyame raupyaṃ dadyād dhanādikam | evaṃ yadyad vrataṃ sveṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ ca niyamo dhṛtaḥ ||77|| tattad datvā niyamasya prapūrtiṃ parikalpayet | godānaṃ śarkarādānaṃ gṛhadānaṃ dhanārpaṇam ||78|| bhūdānaṃ kanyakādānaṃ brahmasūtrapradānakam | vidyādānaṃ mokṣadānaṃ svasarvārpaṇamityapi ||79|| svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ cāpi bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | kiṃ bahunātra coktena yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ bhavet ||1.263.80 || punaḥ prāptyarthamevāsya dānaṃ kuryādasaṃśayaḥ | svasya svīyasya sarvasya haraye dānamuttamam ||8 1 || gurave mokṣadātre vā dadyāt sarvasvameva vai | adhruveṇa dhruvaṃ mokṣaṃ sādhayet kuśalo janaḥ ||82|| kamalāyā vratakarturgṛhe tu kamalāgamaḥ | śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi prāgvṛttaṃ tu kathānakam ||83|| haridvāre’bhavat kaścit śākaṭāyanabhūsuraḥ | svalpaṃ vai śakaṭaṃ tasya gṛhamāsanamāśrayam ||84|| bhikṣāhārastṛṇatūlaḥ kaṭagenduka eva saḥ | vartate devagaṃgāyā nikaṭe karapātrakaḥ ||85|| ekadā sa gato bhikṣāyācanāya digantare | vṛṣṭyākasmikayā tasya hṛtaṃ vai śakaṭaṃ priye ||86|| asvo dṛṣṭvā hṛtaṃ svasya śakaṭaṃ sa yayau tataḥ | padbhyāṃ prayāgarājākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthāya caikalaḥ ||87|| kṣutkṣāmo dīnavadanastriveṇyāṃ snānamācarat | munīnāmāśramām̐statra gaveṣayan kṣudhārditaḥ ||88|| bhāradvājāśramaṃ tatra dadarśa divyamadbhutam | puruṣottamamāse vai janānāṃ saṃsad tathā ||89|| tatrāśrame tu sulabhāṃ kathāṃ kalmaṣanāśinīm | bhāradvājamukhād ramyāṃ śuśrāva kamalāmayīm ||1.263.90|| ekādaśyāḥ kathāṃ śrutvā bhuktimuktipradāyinīm | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāṃ proktāṃ dhanapradām ||9 1|| śākaṭāyanavipro’sau śrutvā tāṃ kamalākathām | vrataṃ taiḥ kṛtavān sārdhaṃ sthitvā munyāśrame tadā ||92|| rātraṃ jāgaraṇaṃ cakre kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ smaran hṛdi | brāhmemuhūrte dvādaśyāṃ lakṣmīstatra samāgatā ||93|| divyāṃgā divyatejaskā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā | prāha varaṃ dadāmyatra prasannāsmi vratānmama ||94|| śākaṭāyanavipro’pi papracchāścaryasaṃbhṛtaḥ | kā tvaṃ kasyāsi rambhoru prasannāpi kathaṃ mama ||95|| lakṣmīḥ prāha prasannāhaṃ jātā vrataprabhāvataḥ | preritā devadevena vaikuṇṭhādahamāgatā ||96 || puruṣottamamāsasya kamalāyā vratāttu te | kamalāṃ vipulāṃ lakṣmīṃ dātumatra samāgatā ||97|| mamavrataṃ tvayā cīrṇaṃ prayāge ṛṣiyogataḥ | āśiṣo vratavaśagā dade tvāṃ dhanavān bhava ||98|| ravāvekādaśī yatra madhyādau dvādaśī tathā | trayodaśī niśāśeṣe vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam ||99|| tatra kratuśanaṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇe | etadvrataṃ tvayā cīrṇaṃ prasannāsmi mahāmune || 1.263.10 0|| gṛhāṇemaṃ maṇiṃ divyaṃ yasmātsvarṇaṃ prapadyate | ityuktvā kamalā tasmai maṇiṃ datvā tirodadhe || 101 || śākaṭāyanavipro’pi maṇiṃ nītvā gṛhaṃ gataḥ | nityaṃ svarṇaśataṃ prātardadātyeṣo maṇirmahān || 1 02|| śākaṭāyanavipro’pi datte dānaṃ tvaharniśam | evaṃ sa ṛṣivaryo’pi śākaṭāyanabhūsuraḥ || 10 3|| indrādapyadhikāṃ smṛddhiṃ labdhavān kamalāvratāt | yācakāya pradātavyaṃ yadyad vāñchati madgṛhāt || 1 04|| evaṃ prakāśitaṃ śākaṭāyanena bhuvastale | athaikadā pulastyo vai brāhmaṇo brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ || 1 05|| śrutvaivaṃ dānakīrtiṃ ca maṇerbhikṣecchayā svayam | śākaṭāyanabhavanaṃ tvājagāma vicārya ca || 106|| yayāce tanmaṇerbhikṣāṃ nispṛho’pi munirdadau | pulastyo’pi maṇiṃ nītvā yayau dvīpaṃ tu siṃhalam || 1 07|| tatra svarṇamayaṃ sarvaṃ cakre puravanādikam | tenārpitaḥ kuberāya dhanādhipataye maṇiḥ || 1 08|| rāvaṇastaṃ jahārātha svarṇalaṃkāṃ cakāra saḥ | evaṃ vai kamalā devī vratena yadi tuṣyati || 1 09|| sarvaṃ dadāti bhaktāya vrataṃ yat toṣakārakam | śṛṇuyādvā paṭhedvāpi kamalāyāḥ phalaṃ bhavet || 1.263.110 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsasya kṛṣṇapakṣakamalaikādaśīmāhātmyaṃ niyamāḥ udyāpanam śākaṭāyanasya vratena maṇiprāptirlakṣmīprāptistato pulastyakuberarāvaṇasuvarṇalābhādiścetikathananāmā triṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 263 ||
<1.264> śrīlakṣmīruvāca śrotṝṇāṃ paramaṃ śrāvyaṃ pavitrāṇāmanuttamam | duḥsvapnanāśakaṃ divyaṃ śrotavyaṃ yatnato mayā || 1 || māsānāṃ paramo māsaḥ puruṣottamasaṃjñakaḥ | yasya devaḥ svayaṃ sākṣātpuruṣottama eva vai || 2 || svargīyā nirjarāḥ sarve bhūtale janma lipsavaḥ | tamarcayanti puruṣaṃ tūttamaṃ tu narāyaṇam || 3 || ye japanti sadā bhaktyā devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | tānarcayanti satataṃ brahmādyā devatāgaṇāḥ || 4 || tasya te devadevasya māsasya puruṣottama | śuklapakṣaikādaśī kiṃnāmnī bhavati me vada || 5 || ko vidhiḥ kiṃ phalaṃ dānaṃ ko devo vada me prabho | yadvrataṃ manujaḥ kṛtvā prāpnuyātsvargamakṣaram || 6 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca puruṣottamamāsasya śuklapakṣe tu dhāmadā | bhavatyekādaśī nāmnā yadbhūtaṃ brahmadhāmadam || 7 || vidhirbrahmamayaścātra phalaṃ brahmamayaṃ smṛtam | brahmadhāmeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patirmataḥ || 8 || akṣarātīta evāyaṃ bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ | akṣarayā svapatnyā tu sahito dhāmadāyutaḥ || 9 || pūjanīyo muktalatākusumaiścāmṛtaiḥ phalaiḥ | dānamupaniṣadvidyāśca vai mokṣadānakam || 1.264.10 || dīkṣādānaṃ brahmadānaṃ vedadānaṃ nijārpaṇam | sarvasvārpaṇamevātra dānānāmuttamaṃ matam || 11 || bhagavaddhāmadānāgre dānamanyat samalpakam | dhāmaprāptikaraṃ dānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dānaṃ mataṃ priye || 12 || daśamyāmekabhuktaḥ syād bhūśāyī brahmacaryavān | prātarutthāya saṃdhyāyedakṣarāṃ puruṣottamam || 13 || dhāmadāṃ cāpi saṃsmṛtya kuryātsnānaṃ yathāvidhi || naityakaṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā mahāpūjāṃ samācaret || 14 || maṇḍapaṃ kārayed ramyaṃ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam | kārayeccāvraṇaṃ kuṃbhaṃ ratnagarbhaṃ sakācanam || 15 || vastravāriphalayuktaṃ sthāpayenmaṇḍale tataḥ | viśālaṃ tāmrajaṃ pātraṃ kuṃbhopari nidhāpayet || 16 || kamalaṃ dvādaśapatraṃ kuṃkumaistatra darśayet | tatrārcayedakṣarayā sahitaṃ puruṣottamam || 1 7|| tathā kamalayopetaṃ sthāpayitvā yathāvidhi | upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirmahāpūjāṃ samācaret || 18 || divyaṃ divyamahāmuktaiḥ sevitaṃ ca prabhādibhiḥ | rādhālakṣmyādibhiryuktaṃ dhyāyāmi sundaraṃ varam || 19 || bhaktakṛpākaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ manasāvāhayāmyaham | svarṇasiṃhāsane kṛṣṇa niṣīda puruṣottama || 1.264.20 || gaṃgodakaṃ jalaṃ pādyaṃ gṛhāṇākṣarayā saha | gandhapuṣpādisaṃyuktaṃ jalamarghyaṃ gṛhāṇa vai || 21 || gālitaṃ tīrthasalilaṃ gṛhṇīṣvācamanīyakam | dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ śarkarāṃ ca janārdana || 22 || paṃcāmṛtaṃ snapanārthaṃ kṛpayā pratigṛhyatām | vāridheḥ saritāṃ toyaṃ snānārthaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 23 || dhautraṃ prāvaraṇaṃ kaṃcukādikaṃ pratigṛhyatām | śāṭīṃ ghargharikāṃ kaṃcukyādikaṃ pragṛhāṇa vai || 24|| paṭṭasūtraṃ brahmasūtraṃ gṛhāṇa puruṣottama | keyūraṃ kaṭakeṃ’gulīyakaṃ mukuṭanūpure || 25 || raśanāṃ tantikāṃ natthīṃ jhaṃjhirairāṇi gṛhyatām | ratnaṃ svarṇaṃ puṣpahārān śṛṃgārādi pragṛhyatām || 26 || kastūryagurukarpūraiścandanairlepanaṃ kuru | kadambaṃ campakaṃ padmaṃ kundaṃ jātīṃ ca gṛhyatām || 27|| dhūpa sugandhadaṃ nārāyaṇa gṛhāṇa bhāvataḥ | dīpaṃ ghṛtakṛtaṃ ramyaṃ gṛhāṇa puruṣottama || 28 || kuṃkumābīragūlālakajjalāttaramāvaha | ārārtrikaṃ suprakāśaṃ gṛhāṇa puruṣottama || 29 || annaṃ ca pāyasaṃ śaṣkulyādi goghṛtapolikāḥ | dadhi dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ miṣṭaṃ gṛhāṇa kamalāpate || 1.264.30 || jalaṃ tairthyaṃ sugandhāḍhyaṃ śītalaṃ piba mādhava | pūgyelākhadirāḍhyaṃ tu tāmbūlaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 31 || kadalāmrāmṛtadāḍimaśrīphalaṃ pragṛhyatām | dakṣiṇāṃ kāṃcanīṃ kṛṣṇa gṛhāṇa hīrakādikam || 32|| aṃjalisthāni puṣpāṇi hyakṣatām̐śca gṛhāṇa vai | namaste kamalākānta namo’kṣarādhināyaka ||3 3 || karomi daṇḍavat tvakṣareśa svāmin gṛhāṇa ca | tvāṃ vinā śaraṇaṃ nānyastvameva śaraṇaṃ mama || 34|| vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ kuru śrīśa rakṣa māmakṣareśvara | annaṃ vastraṃ suvarṇaṃ ca śākaṃ śayyāṃ ghṛtādikam || 35|| arpayāmi harerbuddhyā dvijāyaitad gṛhāṇa vai | iti saṃpūjya sadbhaktyā divāśeṣaṃ nayed vratī || 36|| dāna dadyād yathāśakti kurvītāvaśyakīṃ kriyām | madhyāhne’pi sumiṣṭānnaṃ naivedyaṃ ca jalādikam || 37|| sāyaṃ cāpi mahāpūjāṃ kārayed bahuvastubhiḥ | kuryānnīrājanaṃ tvājyapañcavartisamanvitam || 38|| naivedyaṃ jalapānaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ pādamardanam | datvā kṛtvā kīrtanaiśca rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret || 39 || haryālayaṃ jāgarārthaṃ satāṃ vā tu maṭhaṃ prati | gacchato’styaśvamedhasya phalaṃ puṃsaḥ pade pade ||1.264.40 || prātaḥ snātvā punaḥ pūjāṃ nityāṃ naimittikīṃ tathā | kuryācca bhojayed devaṃ tato bhaktām̐stu bhojayet ||4 1 || gurave svarṇamūrtīnāṃ dānaṃ kuryāt vratī tataḥ | bahūni tvanyadānāni kuryāṃccābhimatāni vai ||42|| sādhūm̐śca vaiṣṇavān sādhvīrbhojayenmṛṣṭabhojanam | haviṣyānnena kurvīta pāraṇāṃ ca tato vratī ||43 || divānidrāṃ parānnaṃ ca punarbhojanamaithune | dvādaśyāṃ varjayet tailaṃ tāmasaṃ cāpi bhojanam ||44|| pāraṇāhe tu labhyeta svalpāpi dvādaśī yadi | tatraiva pāraṇāṃ kuryānna tāmullaṃghayed vratī ||45 || dvādaśyāḥ prathamaḥ pādo harervāsara ucyate | tatra naiva hi bhoktavyaṃ puṇyāsyākṣayamicchatā ||46 || evaṃ dhāmapradāyāśca vrataṃ kāryaṃ vidhānataḥ | vimānena ca taṃ bhaktaṃ hyante dhāma nayet prabhuḥ ||47|| śṛṇu lakṣmi purā jātaṃ vṛttāntaṃ dhāmadāvrate | āsīt kṛtayuge rājā puṇḍarīkasamāhvayaḥ ||48|| viṣṇubhaktaścakravartī sarvatra samadarśanaḥ | sāghuvatsarvathā dehe daihike niṣparigrahaḥ ||49|| ardhaṃ dinaṃ tu pūjāyāṃ śeṣaṃ nyāyapradāpane | yāpayati vratāhe tu pūjāmātraṃ karoti vai ||1.264.50 || rājñī kumudvatīnāmnī tasya tvāsītpativratā | patyājñāmeva śāstrājñāṃ matvā saṃsevate patim ||51 || apṛṣṭvā svapatiṃ kiṃcinnaiva karoti mānasam | ekadāsītpuṇḍarīko dhāmadāvratapūjane ||52|| rājñī jvarābhibhūtāsīdantaḥpurādhivāsinī | sāyaṃ svāsthyaprarakṣārthaṃ vinā pṛṣṭvā tu tatpatim |||53|| dāsībhiḥ saha vāṭikāyāmudyānaṃ prajagāma sā | kṣudhayā cānukūlaṃ tu jvarānuttejakaṃ phalam ||54|| navaraṃgaṃ gṛhītvā tadrasaṃ papau pativratā | patiṃ tvapāyāyitvāsau papau pativratā yataḥ ||55|| pātivratye’bhavadbhaṃgo jvaraścātivyavardhata | tṛṣayā ca jalaṃ pītvā rātrau tatraiva saṃsthitā ||56|| prātaḥ patyurnityasevā na jātādya dine tathā | prātarbharturmukhadarśanaṃ na jātaṃ tathā param |||57|| patyaṃguṣṭhajalapānaṃ prāptaṃ naiva ca naiva ca | pāravaśyaṃ gatā rugṇā pātivratyaṃ kṣatiṃ gatam ||58|| jvaraścātiprabalo’bhūd varṣma śuṣkāyitaṃ tadā | pātivratyasya bhagena rājñī tvapuṇyabhāginī ||59|| maraṇasyonmukhī jātā pīḍyate’tīva śoṣitā | duritācca kumudvatyāḥ prāṇāḥ prayānti naiva ca ||1.264.60 || puṇḍarīkaśca śuśrāva rājñyā āmayamityapi | vrate pūrṇe samāgatya sevāṃ tasyāścakāra ha ||6 1 || āyuṣyaṃ pūrṇatāṃ yātaṃ prāṇā niryānti naiva ca | tadā rājñā jalaṃ datvā dhāmadāphalamarpitam ||62|| śīghraṃ prāṇāstu niryātā vimānaṃ divyamāgatam | viṣṇunā ca tathā lakṣmyā pārṣadaiśca suśobhitam ||63|| akṣarāsahitaśrīmatpuruṣottamaśobhitam | dvitīyaṃ ca vimānaṃ tvāgatamakṣaradhāmadam ||64|| prathamaṃ viṣṇunā nītā vimāne sā ramāyute | vaikuṇṭhaṃ prāpitā paścādārūḍhānyavimānake ||65|| akṣaraṃ dhāma nītā śrīpuruṣottamadhāminā | evaṃ vai dhāmadāyāḥ sā puṇyalābhena dhāmagā ||66|| abhavacca kimu tarhi dhāmadāvratinaḥ punaḥ | tasmāddhāmapradāyāstu vrataṃ kāryaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||67|| puruṣottamamāsasya śuklaikādaśikāvratam | paraṃ dhāmapradaṃ mokṣapradaṃ sampatpradaṃ tathā ||68 || śrutvā cāpi paṭhitvāpi vratatulyaṃ phalaṃ bhavet | sakāmānāṃ mahāsmṛddhapārameṣṭhyādi saṃbhavet || 69 || yathābalaṃ prakartavyaṃ tadidaṃ śubhakāṃkṣiṇā | akṣarā dhāmadā cāsmai bhuktiṃ muktiṃ pradāsyati ||1.264.7 0 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsasya śukladhāmadaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ puṇḍarīkanṛpasya kumudvatīpatnyāḥ kiṃcitpatisevālābhaśūnyāyā api vratenākṣaradhāmaprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 264||
<1.265> śrīlakṣmīruvāca udyāpanāni sarvāṇi sarvadevaprapūjanam | bhagavan kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tanmayā viditaṃ prabho || 1 || ekādaśīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ yadyudyāpanamekalam | kartavyaṃ syāttadā vistāraḥ kiyām̐staṃ ca me vada || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi sarvāsāmekalakṣaṇam | udyāpanaṃ samastaṃ vai sampūrṇaphaladaṃ yathā || 3 || maṇḍape nirmite ramye kadalīstambhaśobhite | vidhāya sarvatobhadraṃ tanmadhye sthāpayed ghaṭam || 4 || aśvatthodumbaraplakṣacūtanyagrodhapallavaiḥ | yuktaṃ ratnairvastrakaṇṭhaṃ tathā salilasaṃbhṛtam || 5 || tanmukhe sumahatpātraṃ nidadhyātkuṃkumānvitam | kamalaṃ dvādaśapatraṃ daladvādaśakānvitam || 6 || kṛtvā madhye ramājuṣṭaṃ vāsudevaṃ suvarṇajam | sthāpayetparitaścaturviṃśatyekādaśapatīn || 7 || tattatpatnīsametām̐śca sthāpayetpūrvataḥ kramāt | ādye śrīkeśavau padmānārāyaṇau tato dale || 8 || mādhavo nityayā sākaṃ govindaścandrayā saha | ramayā saha viṣṇuśca mādhavyā madhusūdanaḥ || 9 || trivikramaśca padmākṣyā vāmanaḥ kamalāyutaḥ | śrīdharaḥ kāntimatyā ca hṛṣīkeśāparājite || 1.265.10 || padmanābhaḥ padmavatyā rādhādāmodarau tataḥ | patreṣu pūrvataḥ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ saha sunandayā || 11 || vāsudevo hariṇyātha pradyumnaśca dhiyā saha | aniruddhaḥ suśīlāyuk nandayā puruṣottamaḥ || 12|| adhokṣajastrayīyuktaḥ kṣemaṃkaryā nṛkesarī | acyuto vijayāyuktaḥ sundaryā ca janārdanaḥ || 13 || upendraḥ subhagāyukto hariḥ saha hiraṇyayā | kṛṣṇaḥ sulakṣaṇāyuktaḥ sthāpanīyo vidhānataḥ || 14|| paṃcāmṛtena madhyasya snānamabhyaṃgapūrvakam | mahābhiṣekaṃ kuryācca vastrābhūṣādi cārpayet || 15|| sarvagandhaiḥ sumanobhiḥ pūjayettulasīdalaiḥ | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalamarpayet || 16 || modakān khājakām̐ścaiva cūrṇāni ghṛtapūrakān | sohilakām̐śca kaṃsāraṃ saktūn sevām̐śca polikāḥ || 17|| pūrikāḥ pāyasaṃ dugdhasāraṃ dadhyodanaṃ tathā | piṇḍakān vaṭakām̐ścaiva śatacchidrām̐śca śaṣkulīḥ || 18 || tilapākaṃ śālipākaṃ mudgacūrṇaṃ guḍaudanam | raṃbhāphalaṃ tathānyacca miṣṭānnamarpayed bahu || 1 9|| śākāni vividhānyeva phalāni vividhānyapi | tāmbūlaṃ mukhavāsādi jalaṃ cāpi samarpayet || 1.265.20 || mahānīrājanaṃ kṛtvā dadyātpuṣpāṃjaliṃ tataḥ | stutiṃ namo daṇḍavacca kṣamāyācanamityapi || 21 || kṛtvā samāpya pūjāṃ ca dadyād dānāni bhāvataḥ | gobhūtilahiraṇyāśvagajavāhāmbarāṇi ca || 22 || tato devagṛhe goṣṭhe samidājyatilaudanaiḥ | puṣparasānvitairhomamācaret tattadāhvayaiḥ || 23 || gāścaturviśatiṃ dadyādekā vā kāṃcanānvitām | madhyāhne pūjayettadvad bhojayecca yathāvidhi || 24|| sāyaṃ nīrājanaṃ kuryātpūjayed bhojayettathā | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prabhāta tvarcayeddharim || 25|| suvarṇanirmitāṃ mūrtiṃ dadyātsvagurave vratī | alaṃkārām̐śca vāsāṃsi śayyāṃ dadyāttato vratī || 26 || caturviṃśatibhūdevān sādhūm̐śca bhojayet satīḥ | ghaṭām̐śca viṣṇave dadyāt pradadyād dakṣiṇāṃ tathā || 27||| tataḥ sa pāraṇāṃ kuryād bhojayitvā janānsvakān | evaṃ kṛte caturviṃśatyekādaśīphalaṃ bhavet || 28 || vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyamudyāpanamahotsave | lakṣmīkāntaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇastuṣyatyevarddhisampradaḥ || 29|| atha lakṣmi kathayāmi dhenuśailādikān śṛṇu | pūjayitvā tato dadyād gurave bahulaṃ dhanam || 1.265.30 || vaibhave vipule dadyād dhenūrdaśavidhā vratī | merūndaśavidhāndadyāt śṛṇu tatra vidhiṃ priye || 31 || tatra gomayaliptāyāṃ darbhānāstīrya vai bhuvi | udakpādāḥ prāṅmukhyaśca kalpanīyāstu gā daśa || 32 || guḍadhenuṃ guḍenaiva śataprasthamitena vai | pañcaviṃśatisīraiśca tadvatsa kalpayed vratī || 33 || yadvā gūḍha yathāśraddhaṃ dhenusthāne nidhāya ca | yathāśraddhaṃ ca tadvatsaṃ kṛtvā guḍena vai tataḥ || 34 || anarghyairvasanaiḥ sūkṣmairveṣṭayitvā ca tāvubhau | śuktikarṇāvikṣupādau śuddhamauktikanetrakau || 35|| tāmrapṛṣṭhau kṣaumapucchau śvetorṇākṛtakambalau | svarṇaśṛṃgau rūpyakhurau vidrumabhrūkuṭīyutau || 2 6|| nānābharaṇaśobhāḍhyau kāṃsyadohanasaṃyutau | vidhāyaivaṃ tu govatsau pūjayedvidhinā vratī || 37 || ghṛtadhenuṃ dugdhadhenuṃ śarkarādhenumuttamām | tiladhenuṃ madhudhenuṃ rasadhenuṃ tathottamām || 38 || dadhidhenuṃ cāmbudhenuṃ svarṇadhenuṃ vidhāya ca | tattadvatsaṃ prathamavat kṛtvā saṃpūjayed vratī || 39 || yathāśakti prakuryādvai dhenūm̐śca vatsakāṃstathā | pradadyād gurave sarvāḥ puruṣottamatuṣṭaye ||1.265.40 || tadvacca parvatān ramyān vṛkṣataḍāgasaṃyutān | kalpayitvā daśavidhān caturaḥ koṇaparvatān || 41 || pūjayedvidhinā dadyādgurave harituṣṭaye | maṇḍape gomayalipte kuśānāstīrya bhūtale || 42 || madhye vrīhimayaṃ meruṃ sahasradroṇasammitam | kuryād droṇaṃ tu dvādaśaprasthapramitamuttamam |||43 || pūrve mauktikahīrakapadmarāgām̐śca dakṣiṇe | pītaśyāmān paścimāyāmuttare vidrumānnyaset || 44|| ikṣudaṇḍairguhāṃ kuryācchuktibhistu śilādikam | ghṛtena prasravaṇāni vastrairmeghām̐śca kalpayet ||45 || śṛṃgāṇi svarṇaraupyāṇi munīndevān hiraṇmayān | indrādīn dikpatīn raupyān kuryād vṛkṣām̐śca dhātubhiḥ ||46 || mandāraṃ pārijātaṃ ca kalpadru ca kadambakam | kṛtvā saṃśobhayetpuṣpaphalaiḥ sauvarṇarājataiḥ ||47|| mandarādriryavaiḥ pūrve godhūmairgandhamādanaḥ | vipulādristilaiḥ paśce māṣaiḥ supārśva uttare ||48|| kāryāścaite nagāḥ śobhāyuktāḥ svopaskarairyutāḥ | svastyayanaṃ vācayitvā tvāvāhya devaparvatān ||49 || pūjayitvā pradadyācca gurave smṛddhaparvatān | gāścaturviśatiṃ dadyād viprebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ tathā ||1.265.50|| lavaṇādriṃ guḍādriṃ ca hemādriṃ tilaparvatam | kārpāsādriṃ ghṛtādriṃ ca ratnādriṃ rājatācalam ||51|| śarkarādriṃ yathāśakti nagānnava prakārayet | pārśvasthānparvatām̐ścāpi caturaścaturo yathā ||52|| racayitvā pūrvavacca śobhāṃ kuryādanekadhā | pūjayedvidhinā sarvān dadyācca gurave tu tān ||53||| godānaṃ pṛthivīdānaṃ kanyādānaṃ gṛhārpaṇam | yānavāhananagaragrāmadānaṃ vidhāpayet ||54|| sarvasvaṃ gurave dadyād viprebhyastu yathārhakam | bhikṣukebhyastvannadānamanyebhyo yadapekṣitam ||55|| evamudyāpanaṃ kṛtvā paścād devān visarjayet | sarvaṃ tadgurave dadyād devālayāya vārpayet |||56|| vrateṣu tyājyavastūnāṃ gṛhītā niyamāstu ye | tattadvastupradānaṃ tu kāryamudyāpane tathā ||97|| dattaṃ sarvaṃ milatyevehāmutra tvanyathā na vai | tasmād yathā balaṃ kāryā prapūrṇatā vratottaram ||58|| vaivasvatena manunā kṛtamudyāpanaṃ purā | bhṛguputryā ramayā ca kṛtamudyāpanaṃ tathā ||59|| padmayā dharaṇipuvyā kṛtamudyāpanaṃ tathā | prāpya viṣṇuṃ ca vaikuṇṭhe modante sarvadā tathā ||1.265.6 0|| pārvatyā ca kṛtaṃ sarvamudyāpanaṃ mahat purā | prabhayā ca kṛtaṃ tadvadudyāpanaṃ yathāyatham ||61 || iti lakṣmi kathitāni vratāni vidhitaśca te | ekādaśīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi ||62|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sarvāsāmekādaśīnāṃ mahodyāpanavidhisvarūpanirūpaṇanāmā pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 265 ||
<1.266> śrīlakṣmīruvāca vārṣikāṇāṃ vratānāṃ ca rūpaṃ vistarato vada | yatkṛtvā mānavāścāpi prāpnuyurbhogamokṣaṇe || 1 || vinātmasādhanaṃ tvanyaddhruvaṃ duḥkhasaṃbhṛtam | jñātvā yateta nityārthaṃ jano yathā ca tadvada || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi pāvanāni dināni vai | vratātmakāni sarvāṇi niḥśreyasapradāni hi || 3 || harestasya vibhūtīnāṃ satāṃ yogācca sarvathā | kālo’pi divyatāṃ yāti vratātmā muktido bhavet || 4 || yasyāṃ tithau vrataṃ yasya yatphalaṃ pūjanaṃ yathā | yadvidhānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ tatsarvaṃ pravadāmi te || 5 || caitre māsi jagatsarvaṃ śuklapakṣe tu viśvasṛṭ | dināraṃbhe pratipadi sasarjaitaccarācaram || 6 || tatra pratipadi kāryā mahāśāntiḥ sukhapradā | sarvotpātapraśamanī dhanasaubhāgyadāyinī || 7 || āyuḥpuṣṭipradā ceyaṃ lokadvayasukhapradā | kuṇḍaṃ ca maṇḍapaṃ tatra kārayitvā śubhe sthale || 8 || vahnivapurdharaṃ brahmāṇaṃ vai samarcayet vratī | pādyārghyapuṣpadhūpaiśca vastrālaṃkārabhojanaiḥ || 9 || homairbalyupahāraiśca sādhusādhvīpratarpaṇaiḥ | pūjanīyo viśeṣeṇākṣatacandanasadrasaiḥ || 1.266.10 || suvarṇapratimāṃ kṛtvā brahmāṇaṃ saṃprapūjayet | ṣoḍaśottamakaraṇairbhojanairvividhaistathā || 11 || caturmukhaṃ caturhastaṃ dvipādaṃ vedahastakam | kamaṇḍalukaraṃ devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ tvabhipūjayet || 12 || ārārtrikottaraṃ devaṃ prārthayedvratakṛnnaraḥ | vrate phalādikaṃ bhuñjyādathavaikānnamityapi || 13 || brahmacaryaṃ rakṣayecca dadyād dānāni bhūriśaḥ | prārthayed vedhasaṃ putrapautravaṃśapravṛttaye || 14|| mūrtidānaṃ tu gurave dadyādajasvarūpiṇe | kanyādānamapi dadyād vratī saṃkalpapūrvakam || 15|| vaṃśavṛddhikaraṃ tvetadvrataṃ sarvasukhapradam | kṛtvauṃkāranamaskāraṃ kuśodakatilākṣataiḥ || 1 6|| savastraṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ ca gavādikam | anyaccāpi yathāśaktidhanaṃ dadyāddvijātaye || 17|| dakṣiṇāṃ vedaviduṣe vratasaṃpūrtihetave | etadbrāhmavrataṃ proktaṃ kartavyaṃ kāmanārthibhiḥ || 18 || asyāmeva tithau tadvat sarasvatīvrataṃ śubham | kartavyaṃ saphalāhāraṃ yadvaikāhāramityapi || 1 9|| brahmaṇo vadanātprātaḥ samutpannā hi śāradā | dvādaśādhikavarṣīyā savīṇā samayūrakā || 1.266.20 || nīlasvarṇamahāmūlyaśāṭikadisamanvitā | kartavyā sūjjvalā mūrtiḥ pūjanīyā vidhānataḥ || 21 || prātaḥ sampūjya sā devī ṣoḍaśādikavastubhiḥ | prārthanīyā brahmavidyālabdhaye vratinā tataḥ || 22|| dugdhapākastu naivedye tvarpaṇīyaśca pūrikāḥ | taddine kṣīrapākaśca bhojanīyo vratārthinā || 23 || dvitīye divase vidyāraṃbharaṇīyārthadā bhavet | dānāni vividhānyeva dadyācchrīgurave vratī || 24|| svarṇasarasvatīmūrtiṃ dadyācchrīgurave tataḥ | vidyā me rasanāgre tu nartakī syāttadarthayet || 25 || visarjayecca dānāni dadyācchaktyanusārataḥ | viprānsādhūnpaṇḍitām̐śca bhojayetpūjayed vratī || 26|| vaiśākhe śuklapakṣe tu pratipadyabdhimanthane | kriyamāṇe surairdaityaiḥ prātaḥ kūrmo’bhavaddhariḥ || 27|| sauvarṇaṃ kūrmarūpaṃ tu vāsudevaṃ samarcayet | uttarāṃgaṃ narākāraṃ pūrvāṃgaṃ kūrmarūpadhṛk || 28 || śaṃkhaṃ gadāṃ bhujayostu dadyānmodakabhojanam | śarkarāṃ dadhi ciñcvādyā vāri miṣṭaṃ samarpayet || 29|| utsavaṃ tu mahāntaṃ vai kuryātkūrmakathānakam | evaṃ vratī vrataṃ kṛtvā bhuktiṃ muktiṃ samāpnuyāt||| 1.266.30 || atha jyeṣṭhe site pratipadi druṃ karavīrakam | svargodyānāt pṛthivyāmāgataṃ prātaḥ prapūjayet || 31 || raktatantuparīdhānaṃ dadyād dhūpaṃ vilepanam | gandhākṣatān jalaṃ dadyānnāraṃgaṃ bījapūrakam || 3 2|| prarūḍhadhānyaṃ kurakairabhyukṣya stavanaṃ caret | karavīra mahābhāga phalāni yaccha sarvadā || 33 || saptadhānyāni saumyāni kusūleṣu vasantu me | iti pradakṣiṇīkṛtya datvā ca dakṣiṇāṃ vratī || 34|| namaskṛtya jalaṃ datvā paścāt svaṃ bhavanaṃ vrajet | evaṃ saṃpūjito vṛkṣo dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ dadāti vai || 35 || namaḥśukle pratipadi lakṣmībuddhipradāyakam | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ sampādakaṃ vrataṃ mahat || 36 || bhādraśuklapratipadi vrataṃ maunaṃ prakīrtitam | śivaprapūjanaṃ kuryāt kuṃbhopari vidhānataḥ || 37|| sauvarṇaśivamūrtestvarcanaṃ ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ | phalāni miṣṭapakvāni dadyādviprāya ṣoḍaśa || 38 || pakvānnāni ca dānāni dadyācchivāya ṣoḍaśa | dhenuṃ dadyāttathānyāni dadyād dānāni ṣoḍaśa || 3 9|| idaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ lakṣmi devadevasya śūlinaḥ | caturdaśābdaṃ dehāntaṃ bhuktabhogaḥ śivaṃ vrajet || 1.266.40 || āśvine śuklapratipadvrataṃ cāśokasaṃjñakam | aśokastu samāyātaḥ svargād bhuvi drumottamaḥ ||4 1 || aśokapūjanaṃ tatra kuryāt ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ | aśoko jāyate tena dhanadhānyaprapūritaḥ ||42 || vratānte dvādaśe varṣe mūrtiṃ cāśokaśākhinaḥ | samarpya gurave bhaktyā viṣṇuloke sukhī bhavet || 43 || aśokaphalavattasya prajā aśokakārikāḥ | sukhadāśca dhanāḍhyāśca phalanti phaladā bhuvi || 44|| asyāmeva pratipadi navarātraṃ samācaret | navarātraṃ tvekabhuktaṃ vartayeccāpyayācitam ||45|| athavopavasennityaṃ phalaṃ vā bhakṣayed vratī | pūrvāhṇe pūjayed durgāṃ ghaṭasthāpanapūrvakam ||46 || aṃkurāropaṇaṃ kuryād yavairgodhūmataṇḍulaiḥ | pūjanaṃ paṭhanaṃ mālājapanaṃ tvanvahaṃ caret ||47|| mārkāṇḍeyakṛtaṃ stotraṃ paṭhennityaṃ śubhāvaham | rātrau tu pūjanaṃ nityaṃ kuryātprajāgaraṃ tathā ||48 || kumārīpūjanaṃ kuryāt praśastaṃ bhojanādibhiḥ | durgāmūrtiṃ sahasrāḍhyāṃ kuryāt sudhanavān janaḥ || 49||| antime divase sāyaṃ jale tāṃ tu visarjayet | itthaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ lakṣmi sarvasiddhyālayo bhavet ||1.266.50 || bhuktimuktipradā durgā bhavatyasya na saṃśayaḥ | vittaśāṭhyaṃ balaśāṭhyaṃ vratinā kāryameva na ||5 1 || ūrje site pratipadi viṣṇuprītivivardhanam | annakūṭotsavākhyaṃ vai vrataṃ kuryād viśeṣataḥ ||52 || ekottaraśatānyatra miṣṭānnāni nivedayet | sarvāṇyapi ca śākāni śrāṇā bhājāśca patrikāḥ ||5 3 || vaṭikāḥ kandamūlāni daugdhāni śārkarāṇi ca | bhakṣyabhojyapralehyānucoṣyāṇi vividhāni vai ||54|| arpayed brahmaṇe govardhanaṃ ca pūjayettathā | nīrājayet tato bhojyaṃ prasādaṃ prāpnuyād vratī ||55|| annakūṭotsavakartā bhuktimuktī samāpnuyāt | dhanadhānyarasavastrabhūṣāyānādisampadaḥ ||56 || asminneva dine prātaḥ pūjayed gāśca vatsakān | vṛṣān vatsatarīścāpi haridrākuṃkumādibhiḥ ||5 7|| pauṣpairhāraiḥ śṛṃgaraṃgairnūtanairyavasādibhiḥ | sampūjya khelayet tām̐śca kṛṣṇamandiracatvare ||5 8|| mārge site pratipadi śreṣṭhaṃ dhanavrataṃ matam | kuryādvai dhanalābhāya naktaṃ viṣṇoḥ samarcanam ||59|| lakṣmīyuktasya sauvarṇīṃ mūrtiṃ vai kārayed vratī | pūjayitvā tu tāṃ mūrtiṃ sannidhau vahnimaṇḍale ||1.266.60|| aṣṭottaraśataṃ homaṃ lakṣmīnāmnā samācaret | raktavastrayugacchannāṃ viṣṇuyuktāṃ samarcayet ||6 1|| dadyācca gurave mūrtiṃ dānānyanyāni dāpayet | evaṃ kṛtvā dhanairdhānyairlakṣmīpūrṇaḥ prajāyate ||62|| smṛddho bhūtvā dhūtapāpo viṣṇuloke mahīyate | ekabhuktaṃ ca naktaṃ vā phalāhāraṃ cared vratī ||63|| pauṣaśuklapratipadi bhānuvratamanuttamam | bhānuṃ ṣoḍaśavastvādyaiḥ pūjayed bhaktibhāvataḥ ||64|| dvādaśātmābhavatsūryo hyasminneva dine purā | dvādaśātmānamādityaṃ sauvarṇaṃ gurave’rpayet ||65|| vratī sūryasamo bhūtvā svargaloke mahīyate | sūryanetro bhavatyatra paratra vratakṛnnaraḥ ||66|| māghaśuklapratipadi vahnirjāto maheśvarāt | vahnimabhyarcya vidhito vahnilokamavāpnuyāt ||67|| vahnimūrteḥ pradānaṃ ca homaṃ tilādibhistathā | pūjanaṃ vandanaṃ sarvaṃ prakuryād vratavān janaḥ ||68|| phālgunaśuklapratipad dhūlidhūsarakaṃ vratam | śaṃkareṇa prage tatra satīdehasamudbhavam ||69|| bhasma samantato liptaṃ dhūlidhūsarakaṃ vratam | atastatra mahādevaṃ devadevaṃ digambaram ||1.266.70 || dhūlidhūsarasarvāṃgaṃ jalaiḥ saṃprokṣitaṃ vyadhāt | tena tuṣṭo haraścāsmai svasāyujyaṃ prayacchati ||7 1 || sva dehaṃ ca tathā kuryād digambaraṃ sakardamam | karmaṇānena santuṣṭo dadyācchaṃbhuḥ sukhālayam ||72|| phālgune phalgunīnakṣatrayoge tu naro hariḥ | naranārāyaṇākhyo’bhūnmūrtyāṃ vai dharmadevataḥ ||73 || dharmāśrame nibaddhāyāṃ dolāyāṃ tau samarcya ca | devā āndolayāmāsurataḥ kāryo’tra cotsavaḥ ||74|| prātaḥ pūjāṃ prakurvīta naranārāyaṇaprabhoḥ | upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhistulasīvastracandanaiḥ ||75|| naivedye pāyasaṃ dadyād badarāṇi phalāni ca | raṃgotsavaṃ tathā kṛtvā vratī bhuṃjīta pāraṇām ||76 || vaiśākhaśuklapratipad viṣṇujanmavrataṃ param | tatra viṣṇuṃ samabhyarcya vairājasya sutaṃ śubham ||77|| viprān sādhūn bhojayecca dadyād dānāni bhūriśaḥ | ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kuryād bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt ||78 || śucau śuklapratipadi brahmā jajñe jagadguruḥ | tasyātra pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ deyaṃ dānaṃ suvarṇavat ||79 || ekabhaktaṃ vrataṃ kāryaṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ bhavet | satyalokapradaṃ tvante bhuktimuktipradaṃ bhavet ||1.266.8 0 || evaṃ pratipaddivase vārṣikāṇi vratāni te | uktānyatra brahmacaryaṃ haviṣyānnaṃ phalapradam ||8 1 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikapratipadvrateṣu jagatsarjanasarasvatījanmakūrmajanmakaravīrāgamanalakṣmīvratamaunavratāśokavratanavarātrānnakūṭadhanavratadvādaśabhānuvratavahnyutpattisatībhasmadhūlīvratanaranārāyaṇajanmaviṣṇujanmabrahmajanmavratānāṃ kathananāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 266 ||
<1.267> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi dvitīyāyā vārṣikāṇi vratāni vai | bhogamokṣobhau prāpnuvantīha mānavāḥ || 1 || caitraśukladvitīyāyāṃ brahmā vivāhito’bhavat | sāvitryā saha lagnasyotsavaṃ kuryād vrataṃ tathā || 2 || mahāntaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā sāvitryajau tu kānakau | pūjayitvā sotsavau ca haviṣyānnaṃ prabhojayet || 3 || vratī syādekabhuktaśca sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet | kanyādānaṃ ca godānaṃ dadyāt sadvaibhave sati || 4 || phalaṃ labdhvākhilānkāmānante brahmapadaṃ vrajet | asminneva dine lakṣmi candro jātastu vāridheḥ || 5 || candravrataṃ hyataḥ kāryaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam | samabhyarcya niśārambhe bālendumuditaṃ mudā || 6 || rūpyacandraṃ pradadyādvai dāne vipraṃ ca bhojayet | kumudaiḥ pūjanīyaśca vipraścandrapratikṛtiḥ || 7 || arthanīyastathā candro dvitīyā jananīva me | cullikāṃ bhrāṣṭrasaṃyuktāṃ vṛṣabhau dvau gavāṃ kulam || 8 || dhanadhānyayutaṃ gehaṃ samārogyaṃ janeṣu me | samādiśatu me nityaṃ dvitīyeśa namo’stu te || 9 || bhavauṣadhyannadātā me tejovṛddhiṃ pradehi me | bālapuṣṭikaro me’tra sarvadā sukhado bhava || 1.267.10 || asminneva dine tvaśvarūpātsūryāttu bālakau | saṃjñānāmnyā svapatnyāṃ tvaśvinyāṃ dasrau babhūvatuḥ || 11 || aśvinībālakau vaidyau pūjanīyau vrataṃ hi tat | kartavyaṃ tvekabhuktaṃ ca dāne tvauṣadhamiṣyate || 12 || suvarṇarajate netre pra dadyācca dvijātaye | aśvinyā vājinaścāpi dānaṃ deyaṃ tu śaktitaḥ || 13 || aśvāśvinīvrataṃ kāryaṃ puṃsā nāryā ca bhaktitaḥ | aśvebhyaścaṇakā deyā vratī tvadyād ghṛtaṃ dadhi | 14 || vratametad dvādaśābdaṃ netrāśvadānapūrvakam | kṛtvā syād bhūpatiśreṣṭhaścātirūpo nṛpāgraṇīḥ || 15 || rādhaśukladvitīyāyāṃ samārebhe tapo hyajaḥ | tapovratamidaṃ kuryāt kṛtvā kamalamuttamam || 16 || brahmāṇaṃ tāpasaṃ tatra vinyasya pūjayed vratī | saptadhānyānvitaṃ bhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ kārayecca vā || 17 || tatra kuṃbhopari viśvasṛjaṃ vinyasya pūjayet | kamaṇḍaluṃ tathā dhautraṃ valkalaṃ cāsanaṃ tathā || 18 || phalāni bhojanaṃ dadyātpāduke brahmasūtrakam | godānaṃ tvanyadānāni dadyād viprāya sādhave || 19 || viṣṇulokamavāpnoti bhuktvā bhogānmanoramān | jyeṣṭhaśukladvitīyāyāṃ bhāskaro dyumaṇirmahān || 1.267.20 || samudbhūto harernetrāt dyotayan bhuvanatrayam | caturvaktrasvarūpaṃ ta gāyatrīsahitaṃ harim || 21 | sarathāśvāruṇaṃ sūryaṃ samabhyarcya vidhānataḥ | ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā bhojayitvārbhakān sataḥ || 22 || svarṇasūryapradānaṃ ca hiraṇyārpaṇamityapi | kṛtvā vratī susamṛddhaṃ bhāskaraṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 23 || aṣāḍhaśukladvitīyā proktaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ vratam | rāmarūpeṇa jāto’tra śeṣanārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 24 || bhadrakayā samaṃ rāmaṃ devā vai prathame yuge | rathaṃ tvārohayitvā ca parikramya purādikam || 25 || jalāśayāntikaṃ gatvā pupūjustamanantakam | tato vai mānavaiḥ sarvaiḥ kāraṇīyo mahotsavaḥ || 26 || tadante devabhavane sthāpayitvā yathāvidhi | ārārtrikaṃ namaḥ kuryād brāhmaṇān bhojayed bahūn || 27|| sataśca bhojayetsādhvīrbālān dāne halādikam | rathadānaṃ tathā kṣetragrāmadānādikaṃ caret || 28 || śrāvaṇaśukladvitīyā viśvakarmavrataṃ śubham | viśvakarmā svapityatra hyaśokaśayanaṃ vratam || 29 || mūrtiṃ caturmukhīṃ patnīyutāṃ śayyāsthitāṃ śubhām | kṛtvā viśvakarmaṇaśca prapūjya jagatāṃ patim || 1.267.30 || prārthayed viśvakarmāṇaṃ bhagavantaṃ jagatkaram | śrīvatsadhārin śrīkānta śrīvāsa śrīpate prabho || 31 || gārhasthyaṃ bhavanādyaṃ ca mā nāśaṃ yātu me vibho | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ viyogo māstu me kvacit || 32 || gṛhadānaṃ tathā patnīdānaṃ candrārdhadānakam | kanyādānaṃ suvarṇāderdānaṃ kuryād vrate’tra vai || 33 || bhādraśukladvitīyāyāmindrajanmābhavad yataḥ | indraṃ hariṃ prapūjyaiva sarvakratuphalaṃ laset || 34|| tatputraśca jayantyākhyaḥ śacī vimānamityapi | sarvaṃ vai kānakaṃ kṛtvā vajraṃ dhanuśca mārgaṇam || 35 || gajaṃ svarṇamayaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ | sarvaṃ vai gurave dadyādekabhukto vratī bhavet || 36 || evaṃ kṛtvā vratī svargaṃ mahendrālayamityatha | prāpnuyāccirakālaṃ ca muktiṃ vairājalokagām || 37 || āśvinaśukladvitīyāvrataṃ durgākṛtaṃ matam | dānaṃ pradattametasyāmanantaphaladaṃ bhavet || 38 || ūrjaśukladvitīyāyāṃ yamo yamunayā purā | bhojitaḥ pūjito bhrātrā svagṛhe bahumiṣṭakaiḥ || 39 || vrataṃ yamadvitīyāyāḥ kuryāt svasā gṛhe gṛhe | puṣṭivivardhanaṃ cedaṃ bhaginyālayabho janam ||1.267.4 0 || bhuktvā bhrātrāmbarabhūṣāḥ svasre deyā dhanādayaḥ | tena svayaṃ bhavetsvarṇadhanadhānyaprapūritaḥ ||4 1 || asyāṃ tithau yamunayā yamarājaḥ prabhojitaḥ | tasyāṃ svasurhastatalāt sauhṛdena bhunakti yaḥ || 42 || sa bhrātā svarṇaratnādidhanadhānyādimān bhavet | dānaṃ svasre bhṛśaṃ deyaṃ svasrīyāyāpi mudrikāḥ || 43 || mārgaśukladvitīyāyāṃ pitarastvaryamādayaḥ | samutpannā brahmadehāt pitṛśrāddhavrataṃ hi tat || 44|| prātaḥ prapūjanaṃ sūryanārāyaṇasya kārayet | madhyāhnottarakāle tu śrāddhaṃ kuryācca tarpaṇam || 45 || pitṝṇāṃ pūjanaṃ caiva kārayet piṇḍamarpayet | vratakartā bhavennaktabhojī dāne tu dhānyakam || 46 || bhojanaṃ bhūsurāyāpi dadyād vastrādikaṃ tathā | godānaṃ ca yathāśakti kartavyaṃ vratinā tadā || 47 || vṛddhānsarvānpūrvajān saṃsmṛtya dvijāya vai namaḥ | kuryādārogyamāpnuyāllabhate putrapautrakān || 48 || pauṣaśukladvitīyāyāmutpannāḥ kāmadhenavaḥ | kāmadhenuvrataṃ kāryaṃ haviṣyāśī bhaved vratī ||49|| sarvakāmapradaṃ kuryād gośṛṃgodakamārjanam | gośṛṃgodakamṛdbhyāṃ ca saṃsnāyāt pūjayecca gām ||1.267.50 || dadyāddānaṃ gavādīnāṃ dharmakāmārthasiddhaye | tṛṇādikaṃ pradadyācca gavāṃ grāsādilabdhaye ||5 1 || bālendudarśanaṃ sāyaṃ prakuryāccārghyasarjanam | bhavedevaṃ vratakartā godhano’tighano’pi ca ||52 || māghaśukladvitīyāyāṃ bhāskaro viśvakarmaṇā | śāṇopari samanyastaḥ surūpaḥ kṛta eva vai ||53 || bhānurūpaṃ hariṃ tvatra pūjayedraktapuṣpakaiḥ | raktairgandhaistathā svarṇamūrtiṃ nirmāya śaktitaḥ ||54|| tataḥ pūrṇaṃ tāmrapātraṃ godhūmaiścāpi taṇḍulaiḥ | sūryāya cārpayed bhaktyā jalenārghyaṃ samarpayet ||55|| mūrtiṃ
