dadyād sādhave ca dānaṃ viprāya śaktitaḥ | evaṃ kṛte vrate lakṣmi sākṣāt sūrya iva vratī |||56|| durāsado durādharṣo jāyate bhuvi bhūsuraḥ | yadvā rājā prajāyeta cakravartī mahānnṛpaḥ ||57|| iha kāmānvarān bhuktvā yātyante ca raveḥ padam | sarvadevastutastvante yāti vā brahmaṇaḥ padam |||8|| atha phālgunaśuklāyāṃ dvitīyāyāṃ svayaṃ haraḥ | tapase prasthito haime śaile nārāyaṇāśrame ||59|| tato harasya sauvarṇīṃ kāryā mūrtirjaṭānvitā | puṣpaiḥ śivaḥ samabhyarcyaḥ suśvetaiśca sugandhibhiḥ ||1.267.60 || puṣpairvitānakaḥ kāryaḥ puṣpālaṃkaraṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ | naivedyairvividhairdhūpairdīpairnīrājanādibhiḥ ||61 || toṣaṇīyo mahādevo vratinā sukhalabdhaye | evamabhyarcya deveśaṃ vratī vyādhivivarjitaḥ ||62|| dhanadhānyasmṛddhiyukto jīvedvarṣaśataṃ dhruvam | vrateṣveteṣu homādi kāryaṃ yathādhanādikam ||63|| vahnireva pṛthaṅmāssu nānārūpo harervapuḥ | pūjanīyo homakṛtā brahmacaryādi rakṣatā ||64|| yadvidhānaṃ dvitīyāsu śuklapakṣagatāsu vai | proktaṃ tadeva kṛṣṇāsu kartavyaṃ vidhikovidaiḥ ||65|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikadvitīyāvrateṣu brahmasāvitrīlagnacandrotpattyaśvinīkumārotpattibrahmatapaḥsūryotpattisaṃkarṣaṇarāmotpattiviśvakarmāśokaśayanendrajanmadurgāvratayamayamunābhojanāryamapitrutpattikāmadhenūtpattisūryaśāṇollīḍhatāśaṃbhutapaiti vratānāṃ nirūpaṇanāmā saptaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 267||
<1.268> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi tṛtīyāyā vratāni vai | yāni kṛtvā naro nārī bhuktiṃ muktiṃ samāpnuyāt || 1 || caitraśuklatṛtīyāto gauryā tapaḥ sudāruṇam | kṛtaṃ śaṃkaraprāptyarthaṃ gaurīvrataṃ hi tanmatam || 2 || caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ gaurīṃ kṛtvā saśaṃkarām | sauvarṇāṃ rājatīṃ vāpi tāmrīṃ vā mṛṇmayīṃ ca vā || 3 || abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyairvastrairābharaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ | durvākāṇḍaiśca vidhivatsopavāsā tu kanyakā || 4 || varārthinī sutāputrārthinī bhartrarthinī tathā | nīrājayenmahāgaurīṃ śāṃkarīṃ śaṃkarānvitām || 5 || punaḥ punaḥ praṇamyaiva prārthayenmanasi sthitam | sapta navaikādaśa cādhikā vā dvijayoṣitaḥ || 6 || bhartṛmatīśca vā kanyā gaurīrūpā sulakṣaṇāḥ | samāhūya bahumānapūrvakaṃ tu ca tāstataḥ || 7 || sindūrāṃjanavastrādyairbhūṣābhiḥ prītamānasā | vratakartrī pūkayettā tathā dānaiśca toṣayet || 8 || miṣṭānnāni piṇḍakādīn phalānyapi samarpayet | evaṃ santoṣayitvā tāḥ vratinī phalamāpnuyāt || 9 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād vratasampūrtikāmyayā | prātastāṃ ca punaḥ saṃpūjyārpayed gurave mudā || 1.268.10 || yadvā visarjayenmūrtiṃ tīrthe vāryāśaye kṣipet | evaṃ dvādaśavarṣāṇi kṛtvā gaurīvrataṃ śubham || 11 || kanyā tu labhate śaṃbhusadṛśaṃ guṇinaṃ patim | dhenūrdvādaśa saṃkalpya dadyādvratasya siddhaye || 12 || kimatra bahunoktena gaurī saubhāgyadāyinī | strīṇāṃ yathā tathā nānyā vidyate bhuvanatraye || 13 || dhanaṃ putrānpatiṃ putrīṃ vidyāṃ siddhiṃ yaśaḥ sukham | dadāti sarvameveṣṭaṃ gaurī vratena toṣitā || 14|| pārvatyā prabhayā lakṣmyā māṇikyā ramayā kṛtam | vrataṃ labdhaḥ patirīśaḥ kṛṣṇo dhvajadhanuḥkaraḥ || 15|| mīnatriśūlacakrasvastikacihnakaro hariḥ | tasmādidaṃ vrataṃ rūpasaubhāgyabhogamuktidam || 16 || vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīyā tvakṣayatṛtīyāvratam | tithistretāyugādyā sā kṛtasyākṣayakāriṇī || 17|| atra tretāyugaṃ svarṇamūrtirūpaṃ vidhāya ca | yadvā lakṣmīyutaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ samarcayet || 18|| puṣpadhūpavilepādyairgaṃgāvārbhistathākṣataiḥ | vividhairbhojanaiścaiva toṣayecchrījagadgurum || 19|| saktūn saṃbhojayed viprān vratītvekādano bhavet | evaṃ kṛtavidhestasya vratito’nāśanaṃ phalam ||1.268.20 || kāryārambhopi saphalo nirvighno yāti pūrṇatām | naro nārī vrataṃ cāsmin kṛtakāryatvamāpnuyāt ||21 || vaiśākhasya site pakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ punarvasau | jamadagnigṛhe prādurāsītparaśudhṛk hariḥ ||22|| asmin rāmaṃ saparaśu sauvarṇaṃ kārayed vratī | madhyāhne tu mahāpūjāṃ kṛtvā kurvīta bhojanam ||23|| ita ārabhya nityaṃ ca jyeṣṭhapūrṇāvadhiṃ prabhum | dhārayed gandhavāsāṃsi vāsāṃsi ca sitānyapi ||24|| uśīratālavṛntaiśca vejayetpratyahaṃ prabhum | naivedye śarkarāyuktaṃ dadyādāmrarasādikam ||25|| jyeṣṭhaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ raṃbhā svargād bhuvaṃ gatā | rabhāphalaṃ vrate bhakṣyaṃ raṃbhā pṛjyākṣatairjalaiḥ ||26|| gandhapuṣpāṃśukādyaiśca sabhāryaṃ pūjayed dvijam | raṃbhāvrataṃ karotyatra nārī saubhāgyakāmyayā ||27|| vittaṃ labhate putrām̐śca matiṃ lakṣmīṃ dhanādikam | patiṃ gāṃ pṛthivīṃ saudhaṃ tathopakaraṇāni ca ||28||| labhate kadalīsāmyaṃ saukumāryaṃ vratārthinī | dāne raṃbhāphalānyatra śarkarāghṛtamityapi |||29|| athāṣāḍhatṛtīyāyāṃ samārebhe tapo ramā | keśavārthamato lakṣmīvrataṃ kāryaṃ tu yoṣitā ||1.268.3 0|| keśavaṃ tu salakṣmīkaṃ suvarṇapratimātmakam | ṣoḍaśopasuvastvādyaiḥ pūjayettu vidhānataḥ ||3 1|| bhojanaiḥ surabhīdānairvastraiścāpi vibhūṣaṇaiḥ | ārārtrikanamaskārairdakṣiṇābhiśca pūjayet ||3 2|| sastrīkaṃ ca dvijaṃ tatra pūjayed bhojayettathā | vipravākyairmānayecca toṣayeddharṣayettathā || 33 || evaṃ vrate prasādyaināṃ lakṣmīrūpāṃ tu bhūsurīm | vipraṃ viṣṇusvarūpaṃ ca visarjayecca tau gṛham || 34|| vratakartrī gṛhayuktā nārī saubhāgyavāñcchayā | devadevaprasādena dhanadhānyasamanvitā || 35 || putrapautrayutā bhūtvā viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt | kanyā vindetsurūpaṃ supatiṃ sveṣṭasubhogadam || 36 || śrāvaṇaśuklatṛtīyā svarṇagaurīvrataṃ matam | kālī tapaḥ paraṃ kṛtvā svarṇagauryabhavad yataḥ || 37|| upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirbhavānī pūjayet vratī | prārthayedtpūjanānte ca rūpaṃ gauraṃ pradehi me || 38 || putrāndehi dhanaṃ dehi saubhāgyaṃ dehi suvrate | anyām̐śca vividhānkāmānpūrayātra namo’stu te || 39 || tato bhavayutāṃ devīṃ vāyanaṃ tu dadecchubham | ṣoḍaṣavarṣaparyantaṃ vratametatprakīrtitam || 1.268.40 || tadante subhagā nārī kuryādudyāpanaṃ mahat | kadalīmaṇḍape sarvabhadrākhyamaṇḍale satīm ||4 1 || madhye saṃsthāpayetsvarṇaghaṭe ratnādisaṃyute | paritaḥ śrīgaṇeśādipaṃcāyatanamarcayet ||42||| kalaśopari tāmrasyākṣatayukte supātrake | sauvarṇī pratimāṃ śaṃbhubhavānyāḥ pratipūjayet ||43 || ṣoḍaśabhirvastubhiśca tato homaṃ samācaret | veṇupātraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pakvānnaparipūritaiḥ ||44|| samarpya satyai naivedyaṃ sādhuṣvetannivedayet | vāyanaṃ ca tato dadyāduttamaṃ bāndhavādiṣu ||45|| pratimāṃ gurave dadyād dvijebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ tathā | bahudānāni kurvīta vratasāphalyahetave ||46 || pūrṇaṃ vindet phalaṃ nārī kanyā vā sadhavādhavā | dhanadhānyādisusmṛddhā bhūtvā yāti paraṃ padam ||47|| bhādraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ vrataṃ vai haratālikam | harahastena pārvatyā hastasya melanaṃ hyabhūt || 48 || tadidaṃ haratālyākhyaṃ vrataṃ saubhāgyavardhanam | kuryād bhaktyā vidhānena pādyārghyārcanapūrvakam ||49 || atra vai kāṃcane pātre rājate vātha tāmrake | vaiṇave mṛnmaye vātha vinyasyānnaṃ sadakṣiṇam ||1.268.5 0 || bharjitaṃ tilataṇḍulacaṇakādikamityapi | phalaṃ vastrādikaṃ bhūṣāṃ vinyasyātraiva pātrake ||5 1 || dadyāttu gurave tadvai kuryātpaścāttu pāraṇām | bhojayed brāhmaṇānsādhūnsādhvīḥ kanyāśca bālakān ||52 || saubhāgyadravya pātrāṇi vaṃśapātrāṇi ṣoḍaśa | pradadyācchraddhayā tvevaṃ viprebhyo vidhinā tathā ||5 3 || anyebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaśca bhūyasīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ śubhām | dadyād vratavatī nārī tena saubhāgyamāpnuyāt ||54|| evaṃ kṛtavratā nārī bhuktvā bhogānmanoramān | vrataprabhāvato’mutra gaurosahacarī bhavet |||55||| dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutāṃ putrān labhate’tra paratra śam | bhuktimuktipradaṃ devīprasādāpyaṃ vrataṃ matam || 56 || yadā tṛtīyā bhādre’tra bhaveddhastarkṣasaṃyutā | sāmagaistvatra kartavyaṃ pitṛdevarṣitarpaṇam ||57|| navaṃ yajñopavītaṃ ca dhāryaṃ śākhoktakarmaṇā | hastagaurīvrataṃ nāma kartavyaṃ bhūtihetave ||58 || viṣaprāṇipradaṃśādinivārakamidaṃ bhavet | mahiṣāsuranāśārthaṃ koṭirūpadharā yadā ||59 || babhūva sā tadā durgā koṭīśvarīti nāmataḥ | pinākinā svayaṃ proktā koṭīśvarīvrataṃ tu tat || 1.268.60 || lakṣacaṇḍīsvarūpāṇi yadā dhṛtavatī hi sā | lakṣeśvarī tadā proktā svayaṃ pinākinā satī ||6 1 || lakṣeśvarīvrataṃ kāryaṃ yāvadvarṣacatuṣṭayam | sopavāsaṃ prakartavyaṃ lakṣeśvaryāḥ prapūjanam ||62 || akhaṇḍānāṃ taṇḍulānāṃ tilānāṃ vāpi padmaje | lakṣamekaṃ viśodhyātra kṣiped dugdhe’gnasaṃśrute ||63 || yāvadvai kaṭhino dravyasāro bhavetsupiṇḍakaḥ | tena piṇḍena nirmāya devyā mūrtiṃ surūpiṇīm ||64|| gandhapuṣpākṣataratnaromavastravibhūṣitām | pārvatīṃ tatra cāvāhya pūjayed bhaktibhāvataḥ || 65 || gandhaiḥ puṣpairjalairdhūpairdīpairnaivedyaprārthanaiḥ | vividhaiḥ satphalaiḥ śreṣṭhadakṣiṇābhiśca vandanaiḥ || 66|| ārārtrikairdaṇḍavadbhirvardhayecca kṣamāpayet | arthayeddhanadhānyādisutāputragṛhādikam ||67 || tato visarjayed durgāṃ jalamadhye’tha dakṣiṇām | datvā śrīgurave paścād rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret || 68 || datvā dānāni viprebhyo bhuñjītāyaṃ pare dine | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi koṭilakṣeśvarīvratam ||6 9|| vratakartryā gṛhe lakṣmīrdhanadhānyamayī sadā | rājate vardhate nityaṃ vratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ||1.268.7 0 || gaurīlokaṃ prayātyante bhogamokṣau hi vindati | iṣaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ bṛhadagaurīvrataṃ matam ||7 1 || pañcavarṣaṃ prakartavyaṃ koṭikundanamāpnuyāt | durgāṃ tu pūjayetprātaḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ suvastubhiḥ ||72|| suvāsinyaḥ paṃca pūjyā vastrālaṃkāracandanaiḥ | śāṭīkaṃcukatāṭaṃkakaṇṭhasūtravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||7 3 || dhātupātrāṇi paṃcaiva vāṭikāsthālikāstathā | sindūraṃ jīrakaṃ miṣṭaṃ saubhāgyadravyamaṃjanam ||74|| godhūmapiṣṭajātaṃ ca navāpūpaṃ phalādikam | vastrāṇi vividhānyeva vāyanāni ca pañca vai ||75 || tābhyo dadyād bhojayecca paścād bhuñjīta vāgyatā | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt kṛṣṇakīrtanamiśritam ||76 || phalaṃ tu dhārayetkaṇṭhe pūgīṃ vānyad yadarpitam | rātrau kaṇṭhagataṃ sarvakāmasmṛddhipradaṃ phalam ||77|| tata prātaḥ samutsāhā sālaṃkārā sakhījanaiḥ | gītavādyayutā gacchet saritaṃ snānamācaret ||78 || gaurīṃ sambodhayettatra prārthanāṃ saṃvadedimām | āhūtāsi mayā bhadre pūjitā ca yathāvidhi ||79 || mama saubhāgyade devi sarvaṃ rakṣaya nityadā | nyūnaṃ ca kṣamyatāṃ devi yatheṣṭaṃ gamyatāṃ tvayā ||1.268.8 0 || ityabhyarthya namaskṛtya jayaśabdaiśca vādanaiḥ | sotsāhapūrvakaṃ dṛṣṭvā jale gaurīṃ visarjayet ||8 1 || evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ bhaktyā vratī devīprasādataḥ | bhuktvā bhogām̐stu dehānte gaurīlokamavāpnuyāt ||82 || ūrjaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ viṣṇugaurīvrataṃ matam | gauryā prapūjito viṣṇustapasaḥ phalasiddhaye ||8 3 || tasmād vratamidaṃ proktaṃ viṣṇugauryabhidhaṃ śubham | tatra vai pūjanīyāsau gaurī viṣṇuyutā mudā ||84|| ṣoḍaśabhistūcārairbhojanaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ | suvāsinīrūpāṃ gaurīṃ lakṣmīnāmnā prabhojayet ||85 || pūjayenmaṃgaladravyaiviṣṇugaurīpratuṣṭaye | visarjayetpraṇamyaināṃ dadyād dānāni bhāvataḥ ||86|| putraṃ vai labhate nārī vratakartrī na saṃśayaḥ | mārgaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ haragaurīvrataṃ matam ||87|| haraśayyāgatā gaurī harayogamupāgatā | harayogena sā tṛptābhavat svāmisukhānvitā ||88 || haraṃ gaurīṃ vrate tvatra caikaśayyāṃ prakalpya ca | svāpayetpūjayed bhaktyā sevayed divyabhāvataḥ ||8 9|| etadvrataprabhāveṇa bhuktvā bhogānmanoramān | gaurīlokaṃ samāsādya hareṇa saha modate ||1.268.90 || pauṣaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ brahmagaurīvrataṃ matam | brahmaṇā tu samāgatyāśīrvādāḥ śaṃkarāptaye ||91 || pradattā tad vrataṃ proktaṃ kartavyaṃ suvidhānataḥ | gaurīṃ ca vedhasaṃ kṛtvā suvarṇasya prapūjayet ||92||| ṣoḍaśabhiścopacārairekabhuktaṃ samācaret | dānaṃ dadyād yatheṣṭaṃ tu gurave bhojayed dvijān ||93|| brahmagaurīprasādena modate tatra saṃgatā | māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ lakṣmīḥ saubhāgyasundarī ||94|| viṣṇau varamālikāyā arpaṇāt samabhūt priyā | tasmāt saubhāgyasundaryātmakaṃ kāryaṃ vrataṃ mudā ||95|| lakṣmīstatra pūjanīyā nālikerārghyadānataḥ | upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirmiṣṭānnairbhūṣaṇādibhiḥ ||96|| saubhāgyadā prasannā syāt svīyaṃ dhāma nayatyapi | dānaṃ śrāṃgārikaṃ sarvaṃ deyaṃ vastu tu yoṣite ||97|| ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kāryaṃ hāraścārpyastu viṣṇave | prasādamālā sā cārpyā patikaṇṭhe tu putradā ||98|| phālgunasya site pakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ niśottare | harayogātsatī labdhavatī putrām̐stu rudrakān ||99|| tasmātsoktā tṛtīyā tu kulasaukhyavratātmikā | pūjitā gandhapuṣpādyairgaurī kulakarī bhavet || 1.268.100 || evaṃ sarvavrateṣvatra dānaṃ homo visarjanam | devadevīprapūjā ca vipraguruprapūjanam || 10 1|| ekabhuktādikaṃ sarvasāmānyaṃ prasamācaret | bhaktyā kṛtāni sarvānvai kāmān dadyurmanogatān || 10 2|| sarvadeveṣu tatsarvāntarātmā śrīhariḥ svayam | vartate pūjanīyo’sau sarvakarmaphalapradaḥ || 103 || yadyad vratyarthayed vastu naro nārī tathānyakaḥ | samāpnoti ca tatsarvaṃ śrīhareḥ samanugrahāt || 1 .4|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikatṛtīyāvrateṣu gaurītapovratākṣayatṛtīyātretādya tithiparśurāmajayantīkadalīvratalakṣmītapovratakālī gaurīvrataharagaurīlagnavratasāmagaśrāvaṇīkoṭīśvarī māhiṣaghnalakṣeśvarībṛhadgaurīviṣṇugaurīharagaurīyogabrahmāśīrgaurīviṣṇuvaramālā kulavṛddhivratādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||268||
<1.269> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca lakṣmi śṛṇu kathayāmi caturthīnāṃ vratāni te | yāni kṛtvā naro nārī bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vrajet parām || 1 || golokādhipatiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pārvatyāḥ śaṃkaragṛhe | śarīrāktadhātuyogādutpanno yastvabhūt prabhuḥ || 2 || sa vai kṛṣṇaścaturdhāsti vāsudevasvarūpakaḥ | saṃkarṣaṇasvarūpaśca pradyamnarūpakastathā || 3 || aniruddhasvarūpaśca tasmāt sa gaṇanāyakaḥ | caturmūrtisvarūpo’sti vratānyapi tathā tathā || 4 || caitramāsacaturthyāṃ tu vāsudevasvarūpiṇam | gaṇeśaṃ samyagabhyarcya datvā suvarṇadakṣiṇām || 5 || āvāhanādi cārabhya visarjanāntameva yat | kṛtvā vidhānataḥ sarvaṃ viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt || 6 || ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kāryaṃ bhojye deyāstu laḍḍukāḥ | dūrvāsindūrakau deyau pūjane vratinā tathā || 7 || anyānyapi ca dānāni deyāni kṛṣṇatuṣṭaye | svayaṃ tu pāraṇāṃ laḍḍukānāṃ kuryād vratī śubhām || 8 || evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ loke bhuktiṃ muktiṃ samāpnuyāt | prasādya viṣṇuṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ gacched devābhivanditaḥ || 9 || vaiśākhasya caturthyāṃ tu pūjyaḥ saṃkarṣaṇābhidhaḥ | āvāhanādvisarjanaparyantaṃ vividhaṃ vidhim || 1.269.1 0|| kṛtvā saṃpūjayed devaṃ gaṇeśaṃ bhojayed bahu | śaṃkhadānaṃ tathā cānyaddānaṃ kuryād yathābalam || 11 || tena puṇyena vratakṛd bhūtvā divyavapurdharaḥ | prāpya saṃkarṣaṇaṃ lokaṃ modate bahukalpakam || 1 2|| jyeṣṭhaśuklacaturthyāṃ tu pūjyaḥ pradyumna īśvaraḥ | ṣoḍaśabhirupacāraiḥ pūjayitvā gaṇādhipam || 1 3||| phalaṃ mūlaṃ jalaṃ dūrvāṃ datvā vai bhāvato vratī | tena puṇyena saṃyāti prādyumnaṃ svargameva vai || 14|| āṣāḍhasya caturthyāṃ tu pūjanīyo’niruddhakaḥ | āvāhanātsamārabhya visarjanāntamarcanam || 15|| kuryād vividhapuṣpādyaiḥ phalairbhojyādibhistathā | dadyād dānāni bahūni kuryānnīrājanādikam || 16|| kṣamāṃ ca prārthayed dāne’lābupātrāṇi tumbikā | kāṣṭhapātrāṇyapi dadyāt sādhave nyāsine vratī || 17|| evaṃ kṛtvā vratī yāyādaniruddhālayaṃ param | caturmūrtivratānyevaṃ kṛtvā dvādaśa vatsarān || 18|| mahadudyāpanaṃ kuryānmaṇḍape maṇḍale śubhe | suvarṇasya ghaṭaṃ nyasya paṃcaratnādisaṃyutam || 19|| pañcāyatanaṃ gāṇeśaṃ vinyasya vidhinā tataḥ | pūjanaṃ ṣoḍaśavastūttamaiḥ kuryād vratī janaḥ ||1.269.20 || gītavāditranirghoṣairvedamantraiḥ stavaistathā | homairjapaistathā bhojyairvastudānādibhistathā ||21 || mahotsavaṃ śubhaṃ kuryādgaṇeśakṛṣṇatuṣṭaye | evaṃ vodyāpane jāte pūrṇaṃ vrataphalaṃ bhavet || 22|| bhuktiṃ muktiṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo dadātyatra paratra ca | yadyadicchati vratakṛt svargaṃ sarvamavāpnuyāt ||23|| anyajjyeṣṭhacaturthyāṃ tu satīvratamudāhṛtam | brāhmadakṣādasiknyāṃ vai satī jātā purā yataḥ ||24|| satījanmotsavaṃ kuryād vratī tvekānnamityapi | phalaṃ vā copavāsaṃ vā mahat kuryācca pūjanam ||25|| evaṃ satīvrataṃ kṛtvā datvā dānāni viṣṇave | vratī gaṇapatermāturloke modeta tatsamam ||26|| tathāṣāḍhacaturthyāṃ tu vrataṃ cānyad bhavecchubham | rathantarāhvakalpasyādyabhūtaṃ vai dinaṃ yataḥ ||27|| śraddhāpūtena manasā kalpaṃ rathantarāhvayam | kālarūpaṃ kṛṣṇarūpaṃ gaṇeśaṃ vā prapūjayet ||28|| ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kuryāt phalaṃ svargaṃ labhed vratī | śrāvaṇasya caturthyāṃ tu prage madhye niśāmukhe || 29|| śrīgaṇeśaṃ pūjayedvai sarvavidhiprapūrvakam | candrodaye tathā jāte punastaṃ pūjayed vratī ||1.269.30|| arghyaṃ dadyād bhojanādi sindūrādi samarpayet | lambodaraṃ caturbāhuṃ trinetraṃ raktapāṇḍuram ||3 1 || naikaratnavibhūṣāḍhyaṃ prasannāsyaṃ vicintayet | āvāhanādibhiḥ sarvairupacāraiḥ samarcayet ||32|| naivedye modakān dadyād gaṇeśatuṣṭidān vratī | evaṃ vrataṃ vidhāyaiva bhuktvā prasādamodakān ||33|| rātrau bhūśayanaṃ kuryātprātaḥ samarcayetpunaḥ | dānāni dadyād bahūni gaṇeśakṛṣṇatuṣṭaye || 34|| vratasyāsya pratāpena kāmān labdhvā manogatān | pare loke paraṃ sthānaṃ gaṇeśapadamāpnuyāt ||35|| tasmātkāryaṃ prayatnena kāmānsarvānabhīpsatā | nānena sadṛśaṃ tvanyat vidyate vratamuttamam || 36|| asminneva dine lakṣmi dūrvāgaṇeśapūjanam | kartavyaṃ tadvidhānaṃ te vadāmi pūrṇapuṇyakṛt || 37|| suvarṇasya gaṇādhyakṣaṃ vidhāya tāmrapātrake | sthāpayitvā ca tatpātraṃ sarvatobhadramaṇḍale || 38 || nyasyet tadveṣṭitaṃ kuryād raktāmbareṇa vai tataḥ | pūjayedraktakusumaiḥ patraiḥ pañcabhireva ca || 39 || bilbapatramapāmārgaḥ śamī dūrvā haripriyā | etatpatraiśca kusumaiḥ pūjayet satphalādibhiḥ ||1.269.40 || bhojayenmodakādīni śubhāṃ dadyāttu dakṣiṇām | arghyaṃ dadyādupahāraṃ śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ tathā ||4 1 || vighneśātmakagurave satkṛtya vinivedayet | kṛtvaivaṃ pañcavarṣāṇi vrataṃ gaṇapateḥ śubham |||42 || bhuktveha bhogānakhilān lokaṃ gaṇapatervrajet | iha loke bhavetsmṛddhaḥ pare loke mahāsukhaḥ || 43 || śrāvaṇe śukla pakṣe tu caturthyāṃ bhaumavāsare | madhyāhne brahmaṇo nasto varāho jajña īśvaraḥ ||44|| varāharūpaṃ sauvarṇaṃ kṛtvā taṃ pūjayed vratī | dhārayet tatra vāsāṃsi kausuṃbhāni ramāpatim ||45 || naivedye pāyasaṃ dadyādghaṭakām̐śca viśeṣataḥ | varāhajanmapadyāni gāpayetpūjayettathā ||46|| ṣoḍaśābhisūpacāraistataḥ kuryāttu bhojanam | narāṃgaṃ sūkarāsyaṃ ca caturbāhuṃ ca sāyudham ||47 || dharāṃ gṛhītvā dantāgre śobhantaṃ dānamācaret | evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ viṣṇorvaikuṇṭhaṃ prāpnuyād vratī ||48|| athabhādracaturthyāṃ tu bahulādhenusadvratam | gaṇeśo’pi samutpannaḥ pārvatīśayane sutaḥ ||49|| gaṇeśasya vrataṃ cāpi prakṛṣṭotsavapūrvakam | kartavyaṃ vidhinā lakṣmi dinacatuṣṭayātmakam ||1.269.5 0 || haritavallikāvṛkṣaśākhākadalītoraṇaiḥ | maṇḍapaḥ śobhanaḥ kāryaḥ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam |||5 1 || kartavyaṃ ca gaṇeśo’pi mṛdā vā dhātunāpi vā | suvarṇena ca raupyeṇa tāmreṇa maṇināpi vā |||52|| kartavyaścāpi sindūrakuṃkumādibhirityam | śobhanīyastathā pūjanīyaḥ ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ||53 || nityaṃ rātrau pūjanīyo vratinā laḍḍukādibhiḥ | toṣaṇīyaśca nityaṃ saḥ prārthanīyaḥ sukhāptaye ||54|| dānaṃ deyaṃ ca vividhaṃ naktabhojī vratī bhavet | ante visarjanaṃ vārṣuṃ kāryaṃ gaṇapatermudā ||55|| evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vai prāpnuyād vratī | pūrṇe varṣe gate māturājñayā śraddhayā tathā ||56 || gaṇeśena kṛtā pradakṣiṇā goratra vai dine | tasmādvratamidaṃ proktaṃ bahulādhenusaṃjñakam ||57|| pūjanīyātra yatnena sraggandhayavasādibhiḥ | tataḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ kuryācchaktaśceddānamācaret ||58|| aśaktaḥ punaretāṃ tu namaskṛtya visarjayet | paṃcābdaṃ vā daśābdaṃ vā ṣoḍaśābdamathāpi vā ||59|| vrataṃ kṛtvodyāpanaṃ ca dhenuṃ datvā payasvinīm | vrataṃ samāpayetpatnīṃ padminīmāpnuyātphalam ||1.269.60 || atra bhogānparān bhuktvā satkṛto devatāgaṇaiḥ | patnyā putrādinā sākaṃ golokaṃ samavāpnuyāt ||61|| atra śuklacaturthyāṃ vai siddhivaināyakavratam | kartavyaṃ śrīgaṇeśasya pūjanaṃ vratinādarāt ||62 || āvāhanādibhiḥ sarvairupacāraiśca modakaiḥ | ekāgramanasā dhyāyed gaṇeśaṃ siddhināyakam ||6 3 || viśvakarmasutāyāśca ṛddheḥ siddheśca nāyakaḥ | vivāhenādya saṃjāto gaṇeśaḥ siddhināyakaḥ ||64|| tasmāttaṃ pūjayedekadantaṃ suvarṇasannibham | pāśāṃkuśadharaṃ devaṃ gajavaktraṃ caturbhujam ||65 || śūrpakarṇaṃ sindūrādicarcitaṃ tundilaṃ śubham | dhyātvā cārghyaṃ samarpyaiva punaśca pūjayed vratī ||66 || ekaviṃśatipatrāṇi tvekaviṃśatināmabhiḥ | samarpayet vratī tāni nāmāni ca yathā śṛṇu ||67|| sumukhāya śamīpatraṃ gaṇādhīśāya bhṛṃgajam | umāputrāya bailvaṃ tu dūrvāṃ gajamukhāya ca ||68|| lambodarāya badarīṃ dhattūraṃ harasūnave | śūrpakarṇāya tulasīṃ vakratuṇḍāya śiṃbijam ||6 9|| apāmārgaṃ guhabhrātre bārhataṃ tvekadantine | herambāya tu sindūraṃ caturhotre tu patrajam ||1.269.70|| sarveśvarāya śāntāyāgastyapatraṃ pradāpayet | gandhapuṣpākṣatadūrvāpatrayugmaṃ samarpayet ||71 || modakapañcakaṃ dadyājjalaṃ miṣṭaṃ samarpayet | datvā tāmbūlakaṃ natvā samprārthya ca visarjayet ||72|| mūrtiṃ sopaskarāṃ haimīṃ gurave brāhmaṇāya bā | arpayed dakṣiṇāṃ dadyānmodakādīni bhojayet ||73|| ekaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ pañcavarṣāṇi mānavo bhuvi | upāsya labhate kāmānehikānpāralaukikān ||74|| asyāṃ caturthyāṃ candraṃ tu na paśyedvai kathaṃcana | paśyan mithyābhiśāpaṃ tu prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ ||75 || atastaddoṣanāśāya mantraṃ tu śāśvataṃ paṭhet | hato hiraṇyakaśipurnṛsiṃhena niśāmukhe ||76 || śarabheṇa hataḥ siṃhaḥ śarabhaḥ śaṃkaro’bhavat | śaṃkareṇa dhṛtaścandro mithyāśāpaṃ haro haret ||77|| ityuccārya na vai mithyākalaṃko jāyate jane | namaskuryācchivaṃ candraśekharaṃ bhāvasaṃyutaḥ ||78 || iṣaśuklacaturṣyāṃ tu kapardīśaṃ vināyakam | pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena pūjayedupacārakaiḥ ||79 || tāṇḍulān baṭave dadyād gandhapuṣpārcitāya ca | kapardigaṇanātho’sau prīyatāṃ taṇḍulārpaṇaiḥ || 1.269.80 || bhuktimuktiprado me’stu gaṇeśaḥ kṛṣṇarūpadhṛk | evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ dehī dhruvaṃ golokamāpnuyāt ||8 1 || caturthyāṃ kārtike śukle nāgavratamudāhṛtam | sarpadaṃśādināśārtha kartavyaṃ sarvathā janaiḥ ||82 || prātarvrataṃ tu saṃkalpya dhenuśṛṅgajalaṃ śuci | pītvā snātvātha madhyāhne śaṃkhapālādipannagān ||8 3 || śeṣaṃ tvāhvānapūrvaiśca pūjayedupacārakaiḥ | dugdhenāpyāyanaṃ kuryād dugdhaṃ dadyācca bhogine || 84|| kṛte nāgavrate tvevaṃ na vai daśanti pannagāḥ | nopadravanti viṣāṇi brahmaṇo varadānataḥ ||85|| sarpānprāha purā brahmā kārtike vaḥ prapūjakān | mā daśantu iti te’pi naiva daśanti pūjakān ||8 6 || kārtikakṛṣṇacaturthyāṃ karakākhyaṃ vrataṃ smṛtam | strīṇāmevādhikāro’tra kartavyaṃ tābhireva tat ||87|| snātvā dehamalaṃkṛtya pūjayed gaṇanāyakam | āvāhanātsamārabhya sarvaṃ vai vidhinā caret ||88 || tadagre pūrṇapakvānnaṃ vinyasyet karakān daśa | kalaśān vā jalapūrṇān nyasyed daśa tadagrataḥ ||89 || devo me prīyatāmevamuccāryaiva samarpayet | suvāsinībhyaḥ kalaśān dadyācca daśaśaṃkhyakān || 1.269.90 || miṣṭānnāni pradadyācca tataścandrodaye sati | datvārghyaṃ vidhinā nārī bhuñjīta miṣṭameva ha || 91 || dugdhapūrṇaṃ jalapūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ dadyād dvijātaye | sapūgākṣataratnāḍhyaṃ vratasya paripūrtaye || 92 || evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ nārī ṣoḍaśadvādaśābdakam | udyāpanaṃ vidhāyātha vrataṃ samāpayettataḥ || 93 || yāvajjīvaṃ tu vā nāryā kāryaṃ saubhāgyavāñchayā | vratenānena sadṛśaṃ strīṇāṃ saubhāgyadāyakam || 94|| nānyadvai vidyate loke kartavyaṃ tatprayatnataḥ | maṃgalo grahavaryaśca pṛthivyāḥ suta eva yaḥ || 95|| asyāṃ tithau śaṃkarasya bindorutpanna eva saḥ | aṃgārakaṃ vrataṃ tasmātkartavyaṃ śreya icchatā || 96 || maṃgalaḥ sarvadā tasya bhadraṃ bhadraṃ dadāti vai | ekabhuktaṃ ca vā naktaṃ vrataṃ kartavyamādarāt || 97|| maṃgalasya tathā pūjā japaḥ kartavya iṣṭadaḥ | raktaratnapradānaṃ ca raktavastrādidānakam || 98 || raktagodhūmadānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ vratinā tadā | raktatilapradānaṃ ca sarvasmṛddhikaraṃ bhavet || 99 || mārgaśuklacaturthyāstu varṣaṃ yāvad vratī janaḥ | kṣapayedekabhaktena naktena vatsarāntaram || 1.269.100 || ayācitena tṛtīyamupavāsaiścaturthakam | evaṃ catvāri varṣāṇi vrataṃ kuryādatandritaḥ || 101 || vināyakavrataṃ tvetatkāśyāṃ vināyakodbhavān | ṣoḍaśavastusaṃpūjyaḥ sarvāsu ca caturthīṣu || 102|| dadyād dānāni sarvāṇi yathāśakti yathādhanam | vatsarānte vratānte vā mahadudyāpanaṃ caret || 103 || kārayecchrīgaṇapatiṃ mūṣakaṃ kānakaṃ ratham | yadvā tu tāmrajaṃ sarvaṃ kāṣṭhajaṃ mṛttikākṛtam || 1 04|| yathāyogyaṃ kārayitvā yadvā padma supatrakam | yadvā tu sarvatobhadramaṇḍalaṃ dhānyanirmitam || 105|| madhye yogyaṃ ghaṭaṃ nyasya tāmrasthālyanvitaṃ śubham | pūrayettaṇḍulaistatra sthāpayecca vināyakam || 106 || āvāhanādibhiḥ snānaiḥ sindūracandanādibhiḥ | dūrvāpuṣpāmbarabhūṣādhūpadīpasugandhakaiḥ || 1 07|| modakātmakanaivedyaiḥ phalaistāmbūlacarvaṇaiḥ | dakṣiṇāstutikusumāṃjalibhirjāgaraistathā || 108 || pūjayettoṣayed devaṃ gītavādyakathānakaiḥ | prabhāte śarkarāvrīhiyavaghṛtatilādibhiḥ || 109 || śrīphalaiḥ sarṣapaiḥ śvetairhomaṃ kuryād vidhānataḥ | gaṇo gaṇādhipaścaiva kūṣmāṇḍastripurāntakaḥ || 1.269.110 || lambodaraikadantau ca rukmadaṃṣṭraśca vighnapaḥ | brahmā yamo’tha varuṇaḥ somaḥ sūryo hutāśanaḥ || 111 || gandhamādī parameṣṭhītyevaṃ ṣoḍaśanāmabhiḥ | tathā vakrasutuṇḍe’ti nāmato’ṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 112 || hūyādvai dahane bhaktyā hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ caret | dikpālān pūjayitvātha caturviṃśatibhūsurān || 113 || modakaiḥ pāyasaiḥ śākaiḥ pūrikābhiśca tarpayet | ācāryāya tato dadyād dogdhrīṃ gāṃ vatsikāyutām || 1 14|| dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathāśakti bhūyasīṃ prārpayettathā | anyebhyaścāpi dānāni dadyāt praṇamya bhūsurān || 115 || visṛjya bandhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ bhuñjīta prītamānasaḥ | evaṃ vratamidaṃ kṛtvā bhuktvā bhogānihottamān || 116 || sāyujyaṃ prāpnuyād viṣṇorvināyakaprasādataḥ | etad varavataṃ proktaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 1 17|| pauṣamāsacaturthyāṃ tu prapūjya tu vināyakam | vipraikaṃ bhojayeccaiva modakairdakṣiṇāṃ diśet || 11 8|| evaṃkṛte vratī syādvai sarvasampattibhājanam | māghaśuklacaturthyāṃ tu gaurīvratamanumattamam || 119 || gaurīpūjyā yoginīnāṃ gaṇaiḥ sākaṃ tu bhāvataḥ | naraiḥ strībhiḥ kundapuṣpaiḥ raktapuṣpādibhistathā || 1.269.120 || raktasūtrairalaktakairdhūpairdīpaiḥ subhojanaiḥ | sagūḍalaḍḍukaiścāpi kṣīreṇa pāyasena ca || 121 || pūjyāḥ saubhāgyavatyaśca nāryo viprāśca sādhavaḥ | saubhāgyavṛddhaye tebhyo dātavyāni viśeṣataḥ || 1 22|| dānāni bhojanānyevāmbarāṇisatphalāni ca | idaṃ gaurīvrataṃ lakṣmi saubhāgyārogyavardhanam || 123 || prativarṣaṃ prakartavyaṃ gauryāḥ kṛtaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | ḍhuṇḍhivratamidaṃ bodhyaṃ gaṇeśastatra pūjyate || 1 24|| kāśyāṃ saḥ śāṃbhavānāṃ ḍhuṇḍhanārthaṃ tvāgataḥ sthitaḥ | tannimittaṃ vrataṃ tvetat kartavyaṃ śreya icchatā || 125 || kuṇḍavrataṃ śāntivratalalitāvratamityapi | tilavrataṃ tvetadeva kundavrataṃ ca kīrtitam || 126 || snāna dāna japā homastarpaṇaṃ yatkṛtaṃ bhavet | sahasraguṇitaṃ tatsyād gaurīgaṇeśatoṣaṇāt || 1 27|| māghakṛṣṇacaturthyāṃ tu saṃkaṣṭahārakaṃ vratam | upavāsaṃ prakurvīta vīkṣya candrodayaṃ tataḥ || 128 || mṛdā kṛtvā gaṇeśaṃ sāyudhaṃ savāhanaṃ śubham | pīṭhe nyasya ca taṃ ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ prapūjayet || 129 || modakām̐stilacūrṇaṃ ca saśarkaraṃ nivedayet | arghyaṃ dadyāttāmrapātre raktacandanamiśritam || 1.269.130 || kuśān dūrvāḥ kusumānyakṣatān śamīdalān dadhi | dadyādarghyaṃ tato visarjanaṃ kuryādatha vratī || 131 || bhojayed bhūsurān sādhūn sādhvīśca bālabālikāḥ | vratī ca pāraṇāṃ kuryād dadyāddānāni bhāvataḥ || 132 || evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ smṛddhaḥ saṃkaṭaṃ naiva cāpnuyāt | dhanadhānyasutāputraprapautrādiyuto bhavet || 133 || phālgunaśuklacaturthyāṃ ḍhuṇḍhirāja vrataṃ punaḥ || prakartavyaṃ pūjanīyo gaṇaśaḥ sarvavastubhiḥ || 134 || tilapiṣṭaistilaiścaiva dānahomaprapūjanaiḥ | toṣayitvā ḍhuṇḍhirājaṃ sarvasampattimāpnuyāt || 1 35|| sauvarṇaṃ gajavaktraṃ ca datvā dvijātaye dhanam | bahubhogyānavāpnoti vratī nātra vicāraṇā || 136 || yasminkasmin bhavenmāsi caturthī ravivārayuk | maṃgalena yutā yadvā sā viśeṣaphalapradā || 13 7 || yāvatīṣu caturthīṣu vighneśaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ha | pūjanīyastathā paṃcāyatanaṃ bhaktibhāvataḥ || 13 8 || udyāpanaṃ vrate kārya niyamaḥ saṃyamastathā | brahmacaryaṃ rakṣitavyaṃ phalaṃ vai śāśvataṃ bhavet||| 139 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikacaturthīvrateṣu gaṇeśātmakavāsudevasaṃkarṣaṇapradyumnāniruddhavratasatījanmavratarathantarakalpavārāhajayantīgaṇeśa jayantīgopradakṣiṇāsiddhivināyakavratanāgavratakarakāvratāṃgārakavratakāśīvināyakavrataḍhuṇḍirājavratādīnāṃ nirūpaṇanāmaikonasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 269 ||
<1.270> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi pañcamīnāṃ vratāni vai | yāni kṛtvā janā yānti sukhaṃ mokṣaṃ ca sampadaḥ || 1 || caitraśuklasya paṃcamyāṃ matsyajanmābhavaddhariḥ | matsyaḥ kāryaḥ suvarṇasya tasya kāryo mahotsavaḥ || 2 || matsyo’yaṃ brahmaputro yo hayagrīvaṃ nihatya vai | vedān samānayāmāsa sa pūjyo bhūtimicchatā || 3 || caitraśukla tṛtīyāyāṃ matsyaḥ satyavratāya yaḥ | bījāni rakṣituṃ nāvi dideśa pūjya eva saḥ || 4 || ardho narākṛtirūrdhvamadho matsyākṛtirhi saḥ | sauvarṇo’rcyaḥ kṛtamālānadītīre sasatyakaḥ || 5 || vāme śaṃkhaṃ gadāṃ dakṣe dadhan mukuṭayuk śubhaḥ | naivedye dadhi bhaktaṃ ca dadhyaktānvaṭakām̐stathā || 6 || dadyācca gāpayedgāthāṃ matsyajanmamayīṃ kathām | dānāni gurave dadyād bhuñjītārārtrikottaram || 7 || iyaṃ śrīpañcamī proktā śriyā yatra tapaḥ kṛtam | śrīkṛṣṇāsyāptaye tasmād vrataṃ kāryaṃ śriyo’rcanam || 8 || gandhādyairupacāraiśca naivedyaiḥ pāyasādibhiḥ | vibhūṣaṇaiḥ phalapuṣpaiḥ śrāṃgārikasuvastubhiḥ || 9 || lakṣmyāstu pūjakaṃ pūjikāṃ tu lakṣmīrna muñcati | pṛthvī cātra tithau nītā varāheṇa jalopari || 1.270.10 || tasyā vrataṃ prakartavyaṃ mūrtyarcanādibhiḥ śubham | candravrataṃ tayā cātra kartavyaṃ kṣayanāśanam || 11 || candrakṣayo vinaṣṭo’bhūt tapasā śaṃbhvanugrahāt | hayagrīvāvatāraśca jāto’syāṃ paṃcamītithau || 12 || hayagrīvavrataṃ kuryād hayāsyaṃ tu samarcayet | sauvarṇaṃ mānavaṃ dehaṃ sāyudhaṃ pṛthivīyutam || 13 || hiraṇyākṣasya hantāraṃ vāsudevaṃ janārdanam | pūjayedvidhinā bhṛṣṭām̐ścaṇakān bhojayettathā || 14 || dadyād dānānyoṣadhīnāṃ rasānāṃ vāriśākhinām | vratakartā bhavennityaṃ nīrogo dhanadhānyavān || 15 || atha vaiśākhapañcamyāṃ śeṣaḥ pūjyo’tra mānavaiḥ | tena nāgagaṇairdattamabhīṣṭaṃ labhate phalam || 16 || nāgā nopadravaṃ kaṃcit kurvanti vratino gṛhe | kṣetre vāṭyāṃ tathodyāne rakṣakāste bhavanti vai || 17 || atha jyeṣṭhasya paṃcamyāṃ pitṝnabhyarcayet sudhīḥ | sarvakāmaphalāvāptirbhavedvai pitṛtarpaṇaiḥ || 18 || athāṣāḍhasya paṃcamyāṃ vāyuvratamudīritam | grāmādbahirvinirgatya dharocchrāye samāsthitaḥ || 19 || dhvajaṃ ca pañcavarṇaṃṃ vai vaṃśadaṇḍāgrayojitam | samucchritaṃ nidadhyācca daṇḍamūlaṃ prapūjayet || 1.270.2 0 || dhvajo yāṃ yāṃ diśaṃ yāti vāyunā preritastathā | daṇḍamūle taddigīśānāṃ vai kuryāt prapūjanam || 21 || prathamādiṣu yāmeṣu yāṃ yāṃ vāyuḥ pravartate | tasmai tasmai digīśāya pūjāṃ samyak prakalpayet || 22|| evaṃ sthitvā nirāhāro bahiryāmacatuṣṭayam | sāyamāgatya dehaṃ svaṃ bhuktvā svapyād bhuvi kṣaṇam || 23 || yaḥ svapno jāyate rātrau sa eva bhavitā dhruvam | aśubhaṃ dṛśyate cedvai hyupavāsaṃ samācaret || 24|| śivapūjāṃ niśi kṛtvā dvijānaṣṭau tu bhojayet | lasecchubhaphalaṃ tena dāne dadyādgavādikam || 25 || vratametatsusamproktaṃ śubhāśubhanidarśanam | nṝṇāṃ saubhāgyajanakaṃ paratrātra sukhāvaham || 26 || śrāvaṇe kṛṣṇapañcamyāmannavṛddhikaraṃ vratam | kartavyaṃ tu janenātra sarvānnasmṛddhikṛddhi tat || 27|| caturthyāṃ dinaśeṣe tu sarvāṇyannāni padmaje | pṛthakpātreṣu salilairākledayet prage tataḥ || 28 || tānyeva salilānyeva dadyāt sūryodaye sati | pitṝṣidevatābhyaśca suklinnānnāni cāpi vai || 29|| prāsādikāni tānyeva yācakebhyaḥ samarpayet | niśi śaṃbhugṛhaṃ gatvā liṃgaṃ gandhādinārcayet || 1.270.30 || namaḥ śivāya prajapet prārthayedannasiddhaye | śāradīyāni cānnāni tathā vāsantikānyapi || 31 || yāni syustaiḥ samṛddho’haṃ bhūyāṃ janmani janmani | evaṃ samprārthya viprebhyo dattvānnāni ca vāgyataḥ || 32 || prabhuñjīta ca tānyeva vrataṃ tvannakaraṃ hi tat | sarvānnasaṃpajjanakaṃ paralokagatipradam || 33 || śrāvaṇe śuklapaṃcamyāṃ mataṃ jīvantikāvratam | jīvantīpatrapuṣpādyairindrāṇīṃ pūjayed vratī || 34|| dvārasyobhayato lekhyā gomayena viṣolbaṇāḥ | nāgāstānpūjayitvaiva saṃpraṇamya dvijātaye || 35 || svarṇarūpyādikaṃ dadyāt tadanantaphalapradam | ekabhuktavrataṃ kuryād dārāpatyasuhṛdvṛtaḥ || 36|| bhādrakṛṣṇasya paṃcamyāṃ nāgān kṣīreṇa tarpayet | yastasyāsaptamaṃ yāvatkulaṃ sarpāt sunirbhayam || 37|| bhādrasya śuklapaṃcamyāṃ pūjayedṛṣisattamān | prage snātvā mṛdā kṛtvā vedikāṃ puṣpaśobhinām || 38 || āstīrya ca kuśām̐statra saptarṣīn vai samarcayet | gandhaiśca vividhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpadīpanivedanaiḥ || 39 || ṛṣyannaṃ bhojane dadyānnivārānnaṃ viśeṣataḥ | naivedyaṃ vipaced vratakṛt śyāmākādyairakṛṣṭajaiḥ ||1.270.40 || prāsādikaṃ vratī tvadyādācāryān sapta bhojayet | pratimāḥ sapta kurvīta jaṭilāḥ sopavītakāḥ ||4 1 || sauvarṇāstā ghaṭeṣveva tāmreṣu mṛnmayeṣu vā | sannyasya snāpayed bhaktyā pañcāmṛtādivāribhiḥ ||42|| upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pūjayitvārghyamarpayet | homaṃ kuryāt tilahavirvrīhighṛtayavādibhiḥ ||43 || puṇyairmantrairnāmabhiśca hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ caret | vastrālaṃkārasaṃyuktā dadyād gāḥ sapta vedine ||44|| gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dānaṃ dadyādvai vratapūrtaye | bhojayitvā gurūn viprān praṇipatya visarjayet ||45|| prāsādikaṃ svayaṃ tvadyāt saha bandhubhirādarāt | evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ sāṃgaṃ bhukiṃ muktiṃ vratī vrajet ||46|| nārī kṛtvā vrataṃ rājaṃssvalpāndoṣāndhunoti vai | āśvinakṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ gopālaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ha ||47|| kuṃkumavāpyāṃ saṃjajñe nimbadevānikālaye | kāryaścaturbhujaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pūjanīyo vidhānataḥ ||48|| utsavastu mahān kāryo vratadānaprabhojanaiḥ | kaṃbharālakṣmyā api tatpatnyā yukto’rcya ādarāt ||49 || āśvine śuklapaṃcamyāmupāṃgalalitāvratam | purā vrataṃ lalitayā hareḥ prāptikṛte kṛtam ||1.270.50|| tasyāḥ svarṇamayīṃ mūrtiṃ śaktyā nirmāya padmaje | upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pūjayettāṃ vidhānataḥ ||5 1 || pakvānnaṃ phalasaṃyuktaṃ saghṛtaṃ dakṣiṇādikam | prāsādikaṃ brāhmaṇāya pradadyād vratapūrtaye ||5 2|| kārtike śuklapaṃcamyāṃ jayayā harilabdhaye | kṛtaṃ vrataṃ jayāmatra ṣoḍaśādisuvastubhiḥ ||53|| pūjayitvā bhojayitvā datvā ca dakṣiṇādikam | visarjayettataḥ paścāt svayaṃ bhuñjīta vai vratī ||54|| jayāvrate saṃprakuryāttīrthe snānamaghāpaham | aśvamedhāvabhathasya snānasya phalamāpnuyāt ||55 || aputro labhate putraṃ vandhyā garbhavatī bhavet | rogī tvārogyamāpnuyād bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vrajed vratī ||5 6|| mārge śuklasya paṃcamyāṃ nāgānprapūjya bhāvataḥ | nāgebhyo hyabhayaṃ labdhvā modate saha bāndhavaiḥ ||57|| pauṣe’pi śuklapaṃcamyāṃ pūjyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇa eva ca | pitaraśca tathā nāgāḥ pūjyā sukhakarā matāḥ ||||58||| māghasya śuklapaṃcamyā vasantavratamīritam | vasantasya tadā pūjā kartavyā caikabhuktatā ||5 9 || navagodhūmasasyaiśca badarīpatrakaistathā | vanakharjūrakaiścaiva rājikābhiśca sattṛṇaiḥ ||1.270.6 0 || haritaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā kuṃkumādibhirarcayet | kalaśaṃ raṃgasalilairyuktaṃ saṃpūjayed vratī ||6 1 || śrīkṛṣṇaṃ pūjayeccaiva raṃgaiḥ krīḍāṃ vidhāpayet | evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ lājāṃ kharjūraṃ dāpayejjanām ||62|| bhuktimuktisukhaprāptikaraṃ caitadvrataṃ bhavet | phālgunakṛṣṇapaṃcamyāṃ jajñe lakṣmīstu kaṃbharā ||6 3 || prātaḥ premagṛhe omālaye kāryastadutsavaḥ | caturbhujā mahālakṣmīḥ pūjanīyā hi kānakī ||64|| vrataṃ sāṃgaṃ prakartavyaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam | phālgunaśuklapaṃcamyāṃ pūjyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇa eva ca || 65 || holikādivyaṃgyadoṣān śamayed bhagavām̐stataḥ | itivratāni kāryāṇi yathāśakti sukhārthinā || 66 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikapañcamīvrateṣu matsyajayantīśrītapovratavārāhapṛthvīvratacandrakṣayanāśavratahayagrīvajayantīnāgapaṃcamīpitṛvratavāyuvratānnavṛddhivratajīvantikānāgavrataṛṣipaṃcamīgopālakṛṣṇajayantīlalitāvratajayāvratanāgavratavasantapaṃcamīkaṃbharālakṣmīvratādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 270 ||
<1.271> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha vārṣikaṣaṣṭhīnāṃ vratāni vividhāni te | śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi bhuktimuktipradāni vai || 1 || caitramāse śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ skandajanmābhavatpurā | kumāravratamevaitatkartavyaṃ pūjanādibhiḥ || 2 || ṣaṇmukhaṃ samayūraṃ ca senānīṃ tu samarcayet | bhojanāni ca dānāni vratī dadyāt subhaktitaḥ || 3 || vratenānena balavān śūraḥ sarvaguṇānvitaḥ | ciraṃjīvī prāpyate vai putrastu vratinā dhruvam || 4 || śaṃkaraṃ pārvatīṃ skandaṃ sauvarṇaṃ sarvavastubhiḥ | śṛṃgāritaṃ dāpayecca gurave vratapūrtaye || 5 || vaiśākhe’pi tithau ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kārtikaṃ pūjayed vratī | labhate mātṛjaṃ saukhyaṃ lālanaṃ pālanādikam || 6 || jyeṣṭhe śukle tithau ṣaṣṭhyāṃ pūjayettu divākaram | labhate vāñchitān kāmān divākaraprasādataḥ || 7 || aṣāḍhaśuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca kuryāt skandavrataṃ punaḥ | labhate’bhīpsitān kāmānputrapautrādisantatim || 8 || śrāvaṇe śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca śarajanmānamarcayet | labhate’bhīpsitānarthān ṣaṇmukhasya prasādataḥ || 9 || atraiva divase kuryāt sūpaudanāśanaṃ vratam | haraye tvarpayed bhakto bhuñjīta tatprasādakam || 1.271.10 || sūpaudanaṃ vinā nānyad bhoktavyamekabhuktakam | vratenānena dadyācchrīhariḥ sūpaudanaṃ tadā || 11 || atraiva divase cāhaṃ kalkirūpo bhavāmi vai | mama janmavrataṃ kuryāt śvetāśvasthitameva ca || 12 || sacchatraṃ sāyudhaṃ svarṇahārāḍhyaṃ pūjayettu mām | rakṣāṃ karomi pākhaṇḍaduṣṭaduḥkhād vratārthinaḥ || 13 || bhādramāse kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhyāṃ lalitāṃ pūjayed vratī | nārī vratārthinī snātvā śuklāmbaradharā satī || 14|| nadyoḥ saṃgamavālukā gṛhītvā piṇḍamācaret | vinirmāya ca lalitāṃ paṃkajaiḥ karavīrakaiḥ || 15 || nīlotpalairmālatībhiḥ ketakaiśca prapūjayet|| aṣṭottaraśataṃ tasyai puṣpāṇāṃ cārpayet tataḥ || 16 || prārthayedagrataḥ sthitvā lalitāṃ śrīharipriyām | gaṃgādvāre kuśāvarte bilvake nīlaparvate || 17 || tathā kanakhale snātvā hariṃ labdhavatī patim | mamāpi śrīhareryogaṃ dehi saubhāgyavardhini || 18 || samprārthyaivaṃ prapūjyaiva naivedyaṃ purato nyaset | nārīkelasukūṣmāṇḍadāḍīmabījapūrakaiḥ || 19 || cirbhaṭṭakarkaṭikābhiḥ phalaiḥ saṃśobhayet puraḥ | navīnāṃkurapatraiśca dīpāvalyā ca toraṇaiḥ |||| 1.271.20 || dhūpaiḥ sugandhinaivedyairmiṣṭānnairvividhairapi | śaṣkulībhirmodakaiśca bhojayedbhāvato vratī || 21 || ārārtrikaṃ ca kurvīta rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret | gītaivādyairnartanaiśca bhajanairnāmakīrtanaiḥ || 22 || sakhībhiḥ sahitā sādhvī na netre saṃpramīlayet | saptamyāṃ saritaṃ gatvā snātvā samarcya tāṃ tataḥ || 23 || datvā dvijāya dānāni hutvā vaiśvānaraṃ tathā | devān pitṝn manuṣyām̐śca pūjayitvā suvāsinīḥ || 24|| brāhmaṇānkanyakāḥ sādhūnsādhvīḥ saṃbhojayed vratī | lalitā me’stu suprītā saṃprārthyaitān visarjayet||| 25 || naro nārī caredevaṃ vrataṃ saubhāgyadaṃ param | anyavrataistapobhiśca dānairniyamasaṃyamaiḥ || 26 || yatphalaṃ tatsulabhyeta praitya lokaṃ sanātanam | modate lalitādevyā sākaṃ vimānago vratī || 27|| bhādramāse śuklapakṣe vrataṃ candanaṣaṣṭhikam | tasyāṃ lakṣmīstu saṃpūjyā candanairbhūṣaṇādibhiḥ || 28 || rohiṇīpātabhaumaiśca yuktā ṣaṣṭhī hi kāpilā | tasyāṃ raviṃ samabhyarcya ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ || 29||| labheta vāñchitānkāmān vratakṛnnātra saṃśayaḥ | sūryaṣaṣṭhīyamevāpi bhāskarasya prasādataḥ || 1.271.3 0 || japo homastathā dānaṃ pitṛdevarṣitarpaṇam | sarvamevākṣayaṃ jñeyaṃ kṛtaṃ yad vratinā śubham || 31 || pūjayitvā kapilāṃ gāṃ mālyakuṃkumabhojanaiḥ | sopaskarāṃ pradadyādvai gurave ravituṣṭaye || 22||| evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ nārī labheta sukhamuttamam | rasānnaphalabhūṣādismṛddhaṃ gṛhaṃ patiṃ labhet ||33|| atheṣaśuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ vai pūjyā kātyāyanī priye | sugandhamaṃgaladravyairbhojanairmiṣṭasadrasaiḥ || 24|| pārvatī vai svayaṃ proktā kālā kātyāyanī prasūḥ | pūjyātra saikatīrmūrtiryadvā dvijasatī priye ||25|| vastrālaṃkāravān datvā natvā kṣāntvā visarjayet | kanyā vratārthinī daivaṃ varaṃ vindet susundaram ||26|| putrārthinī labhetputraṃ kātyāyanyāḥ prasādataḥ | kārtike śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu ṣaṇmukhena mahātmanā || 27|| devasenābhidhāpatnī labdhā sarvasurārcitā | devasenāyutaṃ skandaṃ pūjayedupacārakaiḥ ||38|| vahnipūjā tathā homaścāpi kartavya ādarāt | evaṃ vratī laset siddhiṃ manobhīṣṭāṃ tu śāśvatīm || 35|| mārgaśīrṣe śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ kārtikeyena dhīmatā | nihatastārako daityo brahmādyāḥ skandapūjanam ||1.271.40|| akurvan gandhapuṣpādyairvratināpi phalādibhiḥ | pūjanaṃ paramaṃ kāryaṃ vastrabhūṣāprahetibhiḥ ||41|| naivedyaṃ miṣṭamatroktaṃ dānaṃ gobhūmayaṃ smṛtam | ravivārayutā seyaṃ cettu śatabhiṣānvitā ||4|| campāṣaṣṭhī tadā proktā haraḥ pūjyastadatra vai | snānadānādikaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtamakṣayyamucyate ||43 || mahāpūjā prakartavyā harasya ca harestathā | dānāni vividhānyeva vratī dadyāttu bhāvataḥ ||44|| naro nārī vratenātra saukhyaṃ labdhvākṣaraṃ vrajet | pauṣamāse śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ sūrya pūjyaḥ prabheśvaraḥ ||45|| viṣṇurūpo jagattrātā jāto vai vedhasaḥ punaḥ | nārāyaṇo’yaṃ sākṣāt sarvaprakāśakṛtprabhuḥ ||46|| ṣoḍaṣottamavastvādyai pūjanīyaḥ sukhepsubhiḥ | netratejo vivardheta dhanasampadgṛho bhavet ||47|| brahmaṇā sahitaṃ putraṃ sūryaṃ sumukuṭaṃ vratī | sauvarṇaṃ kārayitvaiva dadyāt dānaṃ dvijātaye ||48|| māghamāse sitā ṣaṣṭhī varuṇotpattikā matā | tasyāṃ pūjyo jaleśo vai viṣṇurūpī sureśvaraḥ ||49|| raktagandhāṃśukapuṣpadhūpanaivedyadīpakaiḥ | vratinā pūjito dadyād yatheṣṭān sadrasān śubhān ||1.271.50 || phālgune śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca haraṃ paśupatiṃ prabhum | mṛnmayaṃ vāpi sauvarṇaṃ kārayitvā prapūjayet ||51 || saṃsnāpya śatarudreṇa pṛthak paṃcāmṛtairjalaiḥ | śvetacandanasaugandhyairālipyākṣatapuṣpakaiḥ ||52|| śvetairdhattūrapuṣpaiśca phalairbilvasupatrakaiḥ | pūjayitvā ca naivedye miṣṭānnāni samarpayet ||53|| nīrājayitvā natvā ca kṣamāpyātha visarjayet | naro nārī vrataṃ kṛtvā bhogānte śivatāṃ vrajet ||54|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikaṣaṣṭhīvrateṣu kārtikasvāmijayantīdivākaravrataskandaśarajanmotsavasūpaudanāśanavratakalkijayantīlalitāhariprāptivratacandanaṣaṣṭhīkapilāṣaṣṭhīkātyāyanīvratadevasenāvratatārakavadhakṛtskandavratacampāṣaṣṭhīviṣṇujayantīsūryajayantīvaruṇajayantyādivratanirūpaṇanāmaikasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 271 ||
<1.272> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca vārṣikasaptamīnāṃ vai vratāni kathayāmi te | yāni kṛtvā vratī lakṣmi bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt || 1 || caitrasya śuklasaptamyāṃ tīrthe snānaṃ samācaret | sthaṇḍilaṃ gomayāliptaṃ gauramṛttikayānvitam || 2 || kṛtvā tatrāṣṭadalakaṃ kamalaṃ karṇikopari | vibhāvasuṃ sthāpayitvā pūrvapatre raviṃ harim || 3 || āgneye cānalaṃ śukraṃ dakṣiṇe maṃgalaṃ yamam | nairṛtye nirṛtaṃ rāhuṃ ketuṃ vinyasya vai tataḥ || 4 || pratīcyāṃ śanivaruṇau vāyavye’nilacandrakau | udīcyāṃ budhakuberau aiśānyāṃ ca guruṃ haram || 5 || sthāpayitvārcayet sarvān gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ | dhūpadīpasunaivedyatāmbūlaphalacarvaṇaiḥ || 6 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ homaṃ ghṛtena kārayed vratī | aṣṭāṣṭa cāhutīrdadyātpratyekaṃ nāmamantrataḥ || 7 || tataḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ kuryād dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ śubhām | evaṃ vai dikprapālānāṃ kuryāttu pūjanaṃ vratam || 8 || vrataṃ kṛtvā tvekabhuktaṃ sarvaṃ saukhyamavāpnuyāt | dehānte maṇḍalaṃ bhānorbhittvā yāti paraṃ padam || 9 || vaiśākhaśuklasaptamyāṃ jahnunā jāhnavī purā | pītā tyaktā punaścaiva gaṃgāvratamidaṃ matam || 1.272.10 || gaṃgāṃ tu jāhnavī snātvā pūjayedupacārakaiḥ | ghaṭasāhasradānaṃ vai kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā || 11 || saptakulaṃ nayetsvargaṃ gaṃgāvratamidaṃ śubham | atra tithau tathā bodhyaṃ kamalavratamityapi || 12 || tilamātrasuvarṇasya kartavyaṃ kamalaṃ śubham | vastrayugmāvṛtaṃ kṛtvā gandhadhūpādinārcayet || 13 || sāyaṃ sūryāya natvātha padmaṃ dvijāya cārpayet | udakuṃbhaṃ ca tatpadmaṃ kapilāṃ gāṃ dvije’rpayet || 1 4|| upavāsaṃ prakuryācca pāraṇāṃ tu pare’hani | brāhmaṇān bhojayedbhaktyā sādhūn sādhvīḥ satīstathā || 15 || evaṃ vrataṃ prakartavyaṃ dānaṃ deyaṃ gavāṃ tathā | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vrajennārī vratakartrī dhanaṃ laset || 16 || atraiva tithau kāryaṃ nimbavrataṃ śubhāvaham | sūryapūjā prakartavyā nimbapatrairviśeṣataḥ || 1 7|| nimbapatraṃ tathāśnīyād bhūśāyī syādvināśanam | pare’hni brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā bhuñjīta bandhubhiḥ || 18 || śarkarāsaptamī tveṣā bhūmau sarvarasapradā | kartavyaṃ śarkarāyāstu vrataṃ rasārthibhiryataḥ || 19 || amṛtaṃ pibato hastātsūryasyāmṛtabindavaḥ | nipeturbhuvi cotpannā śālimudgayavekṣavaḥ || 1.272.20 || śarkarā cekṣuto jātā raveriṣṭā sadā śubhā | havye kavye pavitrā sā dātavyā devatuṣṭaye || 21 || atra vai śarkarādānaṃ śarkarābhojanaṃ tathā | kartavyaṃ vratinā samyak putrasantativardhanam || 22 || sarvaduḥkhopaśamanaṃ vājimedhaphalapradam | dānaṃ cānyatprakartavyaṃ bhojanīyāśca sādhavaḥ || 23 || jyeṣṭhe vai śuklasaptamyāṃ sūryaṃ indro’bhavat svayam | sopavāsaṃ vrataṃ kāryaṃ pūjya indro vidhānata || 24||| dānamindrasya kartavyaṃ sauvarṇasya dvijātike | sādhūn bālān bhojayitvā tatau bhuñjīta vai vratī || 15 || aṣāḍhaśuklasaptamyāṃ vivasvānnāmabhāskaraḥ | rājyābhiṣeka samprāptaḥ pūjā tasya matā vrate || 26 || vivasvantaṃ tu sauvarṇa prapūjya kusumādibhiḥ | labhate rarhasāyujya divyaṃ sukha ca śāśvatam || 27 || śrāvaṇe śuklasaptamyām arvyagākhyaṃ vrataṃ smṛtam | kārpāsaṃ vastrabhevātra dāne deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 28 || hastarkṣasahitā cetsyāt saptamī puṇyadāyinī | asyāṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ sarvaṃ tvakṣayatāṃ vrajet || 29 || śītalāsaptamī ceyaṃ ijyā vai pārvatī satī | śītalāyai pradātavyā śāṭī piṣṭādibhojanam || 1.272.30 || ārogyaṃ tena vratino bhavedvai sarvadā kule | upavāsaḥ prakartavyo deyaṃ dānaṃ phalādikam || 31 || bhādre tu śuklasaptamyām amuktābharaṇaṃ vratam | candro dhṛto lalāṭe vai śaṃbhunābhūṣaṇātmakaḥ || 32|| somasya ca maheśasya pūjanaṃ ṣoḍaśādibhiḥ | prakuryād visṛjennatvā sarvakāmasamṛddhaye || 32 || phalasaptamī caiveyaṃ phalasaptātmikī matā | nālikeraṃ ca vṛntākaṃ nāraṃgaṃ bījapūrakam || 34|| kūṣmāṇḍaṃ bruhatīpūgaṃ phalānyetāni cārpayet | saptatantukṛtaṃ cātra saptagranthisudorakam || 35 || samarpya śaṃkarāyātha badhnīyād vāmahastake | nārī vāme naro dakṣe haste varṣaṃ surakṣayet || 36 || vratāṃte bālakān sapta bhojayitvā tato vratī | svayaṃ bhuñjīta nijayug vratasampūrtihetave || 3 7|| phalāni tu dvijebhyo vai dadyāt santuṣṭihetave | evaṃ sapta tu varṣāṇi vrataṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi || 38|| sāyujyaṃ labhate lakṣmi mahādevasya tadvatī | pūjanaṃ tadvrate kārye yathāvidhi yathādhanam || 39 || āśvine śuklapakṣe tu pañcagavyavrataṃ smṛtam | śubhasaptamī saṃproktā śuddhidā puṇyadā tathā ||1.272.40 || snātvā devaṃ hariṃ sūrya pūjayitvā vratī tataḥ | kapilāṃ gāṃ pūjayitvā prārthayettāṃ śṛṇu priye || 41 || dade’haṃ tvāṃ sukalyāṇi prīyatāmaryamā svayam | pālaya tvaṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ dharmapuṇyaprabhāvataḥ ||42|| evamuccārya natvā ca dravā dvijāya visṛjet | matebhabhīyātpañcagavyaṃ pare’hi pāraṇā caret || 43 || dvijottamān bhojayitvā gṛhṇīyācchiṣṭakaṃ vratī | sa 3 iriprasādena bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt ||44|| atha kārtikaśuklāyāṃ śākākhyasaptamīvratam | śākāhāro vratī tiṣṭhet saptaśākāni sādhave ||4 5 || dvijāya saptakāyātha dadyādannaṃ ca dakṣiṇām | dvitīye’hni pāraṇāṃ ca kuryātpāpaharaṃ vratam ||46 || mārgasya śuklasaptamyāṃ mitravratamudāhṛtam | adityāṃ kaśyapājjajñe mitro nāmā divākaraḥ ||47|| tasya vrataṃ sopavāsaṃ sotsavaṃ kāryamuttamam | pūjanaṃ vidhinā kārya madhuraṃ bhojayet sataḥ || 48 || suvarṇadakṣiṇāṃ datvā visṛjecca tato vratī | pāraṇāṃ tu pare prātaḥ kuryānnatvā raviṃ punaḥ ||49|| kṛtvaivaṃ vratamevātra sūryalokaṃ prayāti vai | yaḥ kopi vratakartātra satkule janmavān bhavet ||1.272.50 || pauṣaśuklasya saptamyāṃ vrataṃ cābhayanāmakam | dharāsthito vratī sūryaṃ trikālaṃ pūjayettathā ||5 1 || sopavāso bhaveccānyān brāhmaṇān sapta bhojayet | kṣīrānnaṃ modakān prasthamitān dadyād dvijātaye ||52|| dakṣiṇāṃ bhūyasīṃ pṛthvīṃ suvarṇaṃ vārpayed vratī | viprāścāśiṣa evāsmai dadyurabhayadāstathā ||53 || abhayākhyaṃ vrataṃ tvetat sarvasyābhayadaṃ smṛtam | mārtaṇḍākhyaṃ vrataṃ caitanmārtaṇḍaṃ pūjayed vratī ||54|| māghe tu kṛṣṇasaptamyāṃ vrataṃ sarvāptināmakam | ādityapūjanaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ samupoṣaṇam ||55|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ bhojyāḥ santaḥ prage tataḥ | pāyasānnaistoṣaṇīyā dakṣiṇābhiḥ phalādibhiḥ ||56 || visṛjya ca tato’dyāt sa vratī ceyādabhīpsitam | etatsarvāptidaṃ nāma vrataṃ vai sārvakāmikam ||57|| māghaśuklasya saptamyāmacalākhyaṃ vrataṃ matam | upoṣaṇaṃ vidheyaṃ yatpuṇyaṃ syādacalaṃ dhruvam ||58 || trilocanaḥ pūjanīyastrilocanānvito haraḥ | trilocanājayantīyaṃ sarvapāpaharā kṛtā ||59|| rathīyasaptamīyaṃ vai cakravartitvadāyinī | hastiyuktarathasthaṃ śrīsūryaṃ sauvarṇamarcayet ||1.272.60 || bhāskarīsaptamī ceyaṃ prātaścātra vratī svayam | arkasya ca badaryāśca sapta sapta dalāni vai ||6 1 || nidhāya mastake snāyāt saptajanmādyaśāntaye | putrapradavrataṃ tvetatkartavyaṃ putramicchatā || 62|| tasya sūryo bhavetputraḥ svāṃśena bhṛśatoṣitaḥ | pare dine samupoṣya prātarhomaṃ samācaret ||6 3 || dadhyodanaṃ payaścāpi bhojayetpūjayet sataḥ | evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ putraṃ prāpnuyādvai cirāyuṣam || 64|| phālgunaśuklasaptamyāṃ vratamarkapuṭaṃ caret | arkapatrairyajet sūryamarkapatrāṇi bhakṣayet|||65|| arkanāma japecchaśvadarkavratamidaṃ matam | dhanaputrasutāsmṛddhipatipatnīpradaṃ śubham ||66|| dharmārthakāmadaṃ sarvapāpanāśakamityataḥ | kāryaṃ yajñavrataṃ tvetatsarvasaukhyasulabdhaye ||67|| bhāskarārādhanaṃ sarvakāmanāsampradaṃ bhavet | tasmātsarvāsu saptamītithiṣvarkaṃ prapūjayet || 68 || maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kalaśāropaṇaṃ tathā | pañcāmṛtaiḥ snapana cāvāhanādyupacārakam || 69 || naivedyaṃ taṇḍulapuṣpāṃjalivisarjanāntakam | sarvaṃ yathāvidhaṃ kuryād vrate vai vratakṛt sadā || 1.272.70 || udyāpanaṃ mahatkuryād bhojayed bālakānsataḥ | dānaṃ homo japo bhaktiḥ śrīhareśceti vai dhruvam ||7 1 || kartavyaṃ vratinā yena harestoṣo bhaved bahuḥ | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi vratapūrṇaphalaṃ bhavet || 72 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikasaptamīvrateṣu dikpālavratajāhnavīvratanimbasūryavratendrasūryavratavivasvadabhiṣekavratāvyaṃgaśītalāsaptamīcandrābharaṇavrataśubhaphalasaptamīśākavratamitrārkajayantīmārtaṃḍābhayavratasārvakāmikāptivratatrilocanājayantībhāskarīsaptamīputrapradārkapuṭavratādinidarśananāmā dvāsaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 272 ||
<1.273> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha lakṣmi kathayāmi tvaṣṭamīnāṃ vratāni te | yāni kṛtvā bhuktimuktimāpnuyāt padmaje vratī || 1 || śuklāṣṭamyāṃ tu caitrasya pārvatījanmasadvratam | maṇḍapaṃ kadalīstaṃbhāśokatoraṇamaṇḍitam || 2 || kṛtvātra sarvatobhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ tasya madhyagām | sauvarṇīṃ pārvatīṃ nyasya pradakṣiṇaśataṃ caret || 3 || pūjayet ṣoḍaśavastuśreṣṭhopadādibhojanaiḥ | nīrājayedrathe sthāpayitvā śrāṃgārikaṃ caret || 4 || gītavādyādibhirbhaktaiḥ kāryo yātrāmahotsavaḥ | gṛhe gṛhe prapūjyā taṇḍulalājājalaiḥ phalaiḥ || 5 || saubhāgyadravyakuṃkumakajjalābharaṇādibhiḥ | nārīkelaphalenātha kalaśenāpi vardhayet || 6 || evaṃ mahotsavapūrvaṃ jale vā mandire’tha vā | ānayitvā pūjayettāmārārtrikamathācaret || 7 || bhojayitvā ca deveśīṃ vidhinā tāṃ visarjayet | dadyād dānāni sarvāṇi bālābhyo’mbarabhojanam || 8 || evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ nārī saubhāgyaṃ labhate śubham | kanyā vrataṃ paraṃ kṛtvā rājñīpadamavāpnuyāt || 9 || atraivāśokakalikāṣṭakasyādanamācaret | evaṃ prāśanakartustu na śoko jāyate kvacit || 1.273.10 || mahāṣṭamīti saiveyaṃ kartavyā sopavāsikā | pārvatyāḥ pūjanaṃ visarjanāntaṃ kāryameva ca || 11 || vaiśākhasya sitāṣṭamyāmathopoṣaṇamācaret | durgāṣṭamīti sā proktāparājitāṃ tu pūjayet || 12|| naivedyaṃ śarkarāyuktaṃ dadyād dānāni vai tadā | kumārīrbhojayeccāpi navamyāṃ pāraṇāgrataḥ || 13 || vratī jyotirvimānastho’parājitākṛpāvaśāt | svargalokeṣu vicared bhuktimuktiyuto bhavet || 14|| jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇāṣṭamīprāptau kuryāt trilocanavratam | kailāse saṃvaset kalpaparyantaṃ bahumānitaḥ || 15|| jyeṣṭhaśuklāṣṭamīprātardurgāṃ śuklāṃ prapūjayet | śuklādevīprasādena kailāsaṃ labhate vratī || 16|| āṣāḍhadhavalāṣṭamyāṃ devīṃ sampūjayed vratī | naivedyaṃ śarkaropetaṃ dadyāt kanyāśca bhojayet || 17|| suvarṇadakṣiṇāṃ datvā visṛjyādyāt svayaṃ vratī | etadvrataṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā durgālokamavāpnuyāt || 18|| nabhaḥśukle tathāṣṭamyāṃ durgāṃ sampūjayed vratī | bhojayed vividhairannairvisarjayed vidhānataḥ || 19|| pāraṇāṃ ca tataḥ kuryād vrataṃ santativardhanam | bhādramāse sitāṣṭamyāṃ daśāphalamiti vratam ||1.273.20 || sopavāsaṃ prakuryādvai pūjanaṃ śrīharestathā | tulasyāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇāyā dalairdaśabhirarcayet ||21 || kṛṣṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ tathānantaṃ govindaṃ garuḍadhvajam | dāmodaraṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ padmanābhaṃ hariṃ prabhum ||22|| etairvai nāmabhiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayitvā dine dine | homaṃ kuryācchatamaṣṭottaraṃ śrīkṛṣṇanāmataḥ ||23 || juhuyāccaruṇā puṣpaiḥ phalaiḥ śarkarayā tathā | evaṃ daśadinaṃ kuryādācāryaṃ pūjayettataḥ || 24|| sauvarṇe vānyapātre tu sauvarṇaṃ tulasīdalam | pratimāṃ kānakīṃ cāpi nidhāya gurave’rpayet || 25|| gopradānaṃ prakuryādvai vastrālaṃkāraśobhanam | daśāhaṃ dugdhapākaṃ ca pūrikāśca nivedayet ||26|| svayaṃ prasāda gṛhṇīyāt viprān sādhūm̐śca bhojayet | vratānte daśasādhubhyaḥ pratyekaṃ daśa pūrikāḥ ||27|| dadyādevaṃ daśābdaṃ tu kṛtvā vratamanuttamam | sarvānsvargānanubhūya kṛṣṇasāyujyamāpnuyāt || 28 || naraḥ kṛṣṇapārṣadaḥ syānnārī kṛṣṇapriyā bhavet | naitādṛśaṃ vrataṃ tvanyat kṛṣṇasāyujyakṛdbhavet || 29 || bhādrakṛṣṇāṣṭamī kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīvrataṃ purā | upavāsena tatkartuḥ saptajanmāghanāśanam || 1.273.30 || upavāsī tilaiḥ snātvā nadyādau vimale jale | mandiraṃ śodhayet samyaṅ mṛjākṣālanalepanaiḥ || 31 || raṃgairnānāvidhaiścitraistoraṇaiḥ śobhayed dhvajaiḥ | navīnām̐śca vitānādīn badhnīyād rūpakāṇi ca || 32 || siṃhāsanaṃ bhagavataḥ pūjopakaraṇāni ca | sammārjayed dīpikāśca kuryādāstaraṇaṃ navam || 33 || pūjānaivedyavastrādi vratī sampādayettataḥ | sabhāmaṇḍapamadhye vā mandirasyāgrato’thavā || 34|| maṇḍapaṃ kārayed ramyaṃ kadalīstambhaśobhitam | vastravicitrasatpuṣpapallavaiḥ kalaśairyutam || 35 || phaladīpāvalīmālācandanādivirājitam | dhūpitaṃ kārayettaṃ ca tanmadhye kalaśaṃ nyaset || 36 || tasyopari nyasetpātraṃ tāmraṃ tasyopari sthitām | haimīṃ vastrayugacchannāṃ pratimāṃ śrīhareḥ śubhām || 27|| pādyādyairupacāraiśca pūjayed vratakārakaḥ | maṇḍape sūtikāgāraṃ devakyā vidadhīta ca || 38 || tatra vai devakīṃ bālakṛṣṇena sahitāṃ tathā | yaśodāṃ gokule kuryāt sutāyuktāṃ manoharām || 3 9|| vasudevaṃ ca nandaṃ ca gopān gopīśca gāstathā | vṛṣān vatsān vatsatarīḥ sauvarṇān kārayed vratī || 1.273.40 || maṇḍape sthāpitān dikṣu vidikṣvapi samarcayet | vādayet tūryavādyāni maṃgalāni ca gāpayet ||4 1 || snānapūjādikaṃ mūrte kṛtvā tvārārtrikaṃ caret | paṃcāmṛtairardharātre snāpayecchuddhavāribhiḥ || 42 || vāsobhūṣāratnahārān śobhanān paridhāpayet | kuṃkumakesarāgurucandanakusumāni ca || 43 || hārāpīḍām̐ścāvataṃsān pauṣpāṃśca tulasīsrajaḥ | dhūpadīpām̐stataḥ kṛtvā mahānaivedyamāharet ||44|| ajamām̐śca tathā śuṇṭhīṃ dhānyākān śarkarāṃ ghṛtam | pañcacūrṇī raupyapātre naivedyaṃ vinivedayet || 45|| pūrīpāyasasaṃyāvaghṛtapakvādi cārpayet | jalaṃ samarpayed dadyāt tāmbūlaṃ mukhaśodhanam ||46|| nārīkelaphalaṃ dadyād dakṣiṇāṃ tulasīdalam | tato nīrājayet kṛṣṇaṃ caturviṃśatirūpiṇam ||47| arghyaṃ dadyāt kṣamāṃ prārthya svāpayitvā vratī tataḥ | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryācchṛṇuyāttatkathānakam ||48 | tadā pibed vratī kṛṣṇacaraṇāmṛtamuttamam | saśarkaraṃ dadhiṃ kiṃcinmātraṃ pañcāmṛtaṃ graset || 49 || tataḥ prabhāte snātvaiva pūjayed bālakṛṣṇakam | kṣīraṃ bhaktaṃ śarkarāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa nivedayet ||1.273.50 | narānāryastatastatra dadhikṣīraghṛtāmbubhiḥ | kurvīran krīḍanaṃ tvagre lepakṣepaṇasecanaiḥ |||5 1 || snātvā sādhūn bhojayecca sādhvīrbālām̐śca bālikāḥ | viprān bhaktān bhojayecca dīnāndhakṛpaṇānapi || 52| dakṣiṇāṃ pradadedaśnīyāt svajanaiḥ prasādikam | prātaḥ sāyaṃ pūjanānte vratinā pālane hariḥ ||53 | āndolanīyo’nudinaṃ yāvadbhādradvitīyakam | dārāpatyasuhṛdbhṛtyairevaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ naraḥ ||54| sākṣād golokamāpnoti vimānavaramāsthitaḥ | trilokyāṃ vai vrataṃ caitatsadṛśaṃ nāsti yatparam ||55 | kṛtena yena labhyeta koṭyaikādaśakaṃ phalam | dānānyatra pradeyāni rājayogyāni padmaje ||56|| yathāśakti yathāvastu kāryaṃ kārṣṇaṃ vrataṃ priye | bhādrapadasitāṣṭamyāṃ rādhikājanma nirmitam ||57|| bhagavantaṃ tathā rādhāṃ raktavastrāṇi dhārayet | madhyāhne rādhikāmūrtiṃ sakṛṣṇāṃ pūjayed vratī ||58 | laḍḍukān mauktikān dadyānnaivedye’pi phalānyapi | yadyadiṣṭaṃ bhavet svasya tattat samarpayed vratī ||59 | rādhikājanmapadyāni gāpayed gopikādibhiḥ | ekabhaktaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā suvāsinīśca bhojayet || 1.273.60 | mūrtyarpaṇaṃ ca gurave kṛtvā bhuñjīta vai vratī | upavāsaṃ ca vā kuryād dadyādraktāmbarāṇi vai || 61 | evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ nārī rādhāparikare vaset | kṛṣṇapatnī sadā bhūtvā kṛṣṇasaukhyaṃ sadārjayet || 62| dūrvāṣṭamīvrataṃ caitatkartavyaṃ vratinā tathā | dūrvārūḍhasthale śaṃbhubāṇaṃ saṃpūjayed vratī ||6 3 | gandhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpadīpairdadhyakṣataphalādibhiḥ | dūrvābhiḥ pūjayeccāpyarthayed dūrve’mṛte sadā ||64| yathā śākhāpraśākhābhirvistṛtāsi mahīstare | saubhāgyaṃ vistṛtāṃ dehi santatiṃ cājarāmarām ||65| viprān sādhūn bhojayitvā śaṃbhuṃ visṛjya vai vratī | vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ prakurvīta nārī bhāgyavatī bhavet || 66 || evaṃ puṇyā pāpaharā santatideyamaṣṭamī | dūrvāṃ na pūjayed yā sā vidhavā syāt trijanmasu || 67 || jyeṣṭharkṣasaṃyutā ceyaṃ jyeṣṭhāṣṭamī vratātmikā | mahālakṣmyā vrataṃ caitaditaḥ ṣoḍaśavāsarān || 68 || punarvasupraparyantaṃ kālāṣṭamyavadhiṃ dhruvam | kartavyaṃ vratinā dakṣe kare badhvā tu ḍorakam || 6 9 || ṣoḍaśagranthisahitaṃ guṇaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryutam | nityaṃ prapūjayellakṣmīṃ tata udyāpanaṃ caret || 1.273.70 || vastramaṇḍapikāṃ kṛtvā sarvatobhadramaṇḍale | kalaśaṃ deyasya dīpaṃ ca kṛtvottārya ca ḍorakam || 71 || kuṃbhādhastat sthāpayitvā lakṣmyāścatuḥsumūrtikāḥ | snapanaṃ kārayetpacāmṛtaiśca salilairvratī ||7 re || upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśādyaiḥ pūjayitvā prabhojayet | niśi jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāccandre’rghya saṃpradāpayet ||7 3 || kṣīrasāgarasaṃbhūta mahālakṣmīsahodara | annauṣadhiprado me’stu śrīkhaṇḍārghyaṃ gṛhāṇa me ||74|| kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhūte kamale kṛṣṇasatpriye | viṣṇuvakṣaḥsthalāvāse bhava me sarvakāmadā ||75 || ekanāthe jagannāthe gopālasya priye’vyaye | kambhare trāhi māṃ devi kṛṣṇamātaḥ śivaṃ kuru ||76 || evaṃ prārthya mahālakṣmīṃ sampūjya bhaktayoṣitaḥ | bhojayitvā juhuyācca bilva padmakapāvasaiḥ || 77|| samittilaghṛtaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiśca vividhaistathā | viṣṇave candane tālapatraṃ mālāṃ tathākṣatān || 78 || dūrvāṃ kausuṃbhasūtraṃ ca yugalaṃ śrīphalaṃ tathā | tulasīṃ śarkarāṃ laḍḍūn dugdhasāraṃ tilān yavān ||7 9 || jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ ceti dadyāddharaye ṣoḍaśa | mahālakṣmyai tathā dadyācchūrpeṇācchādya śūrpake ||1.273.8 0 || lakṣmyai nārāyaṇāyāpi prasamarpya vratī svayam | visarjayetpūjanaṃ ca vrataṃ tadvai samāpayet || 81 || catasraḥ pratimā dadyāccaturviprebhya eva vai | ṣoḍaśasuvāsanībhyo dadyāt ṣoḍaśavastukam || 82 || miṣṭānnairāśayitvā tāḥ saṃvisṛjet sadakṣiṇāḥ | paścāttu pāraṇāṃ kuryād vratī tvevaṃ vratena vai || 8 3 || koṭyadhīśo bhavelloke lakṣmīloke vasetpunaḥ | ciraṃ bhogān prabhuṃkte vai kaṃbharālakṣmyanugrahāt ||84|| eṣā śokāṣṭamī proktāśokapūjanamācaret | ekabhaktaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā ramāṃ sampūjya bhāvataḥ || 85|| yatra kutrāpi janma syādaśokaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ | āśvine tu site’ṣṭamyāṃ durgāvratamupoṣaṇam || 86 || ekabhaktaṃ ca vā pūjāṃ kuryāttvetadvidhānataḥ | sarvato vibhavaṃ labdhvā modate divi devavat ||87 || ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīkāle karakākhyaṃ vratṃ smṛtam | putrecchubhiḥ pūjanīyaḥ umeśo niśi sarvathā ||88 || dānaṃ kṛtvā suvarṇasya candrodaye nīrājayet | vratī prātaḥ pūjayitvā tataḥ kuryāttu pāraṇām ||8 9 || kārtikakṛṣṇapakṣasyāṣṭamyāṃ śrībhagavadvratam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jajñe gopālakaṃbharāgṛhe || 1.273.90 || devāśca munayaḥ sarve tadākurvanmahotsavam | vimānāni samāruhyāgatā darśanalālasāḥ || 91 || puṣpādibhistadā divyairvardhayāmāsurādarāt | tadā vai maṇḍapaḥ kāryaḥ prātareva mahārhaṇaḥ || 92 || saudhamadhye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastanmaṇḍape tadā | sauvarṇaḥ sthāpanīyo’tra sarvatobhadramaṇḍale || 93 || ghaṭe paṃcasuratnādiphalapallavaśobhite | sthālyāṃ tilānvitāyāṃ vai pūjanīyo hariḥ svayam || 94 || śriyā yuktastathā pitrā mātrāyukto mahāprabhuḥ | śṛṇu lakṣmi tvayā sākaṃ mamārcanaṃ pramuktidam || 95 || sampatkaraṃ sarvasaukhyapradaṃ sarvepsitapradam | tatkartavyaṃ yoṣitā vā nareṇāpi vratārthinā || 96 || āvāhanāt samārabhya pañcāmṛtajalādikaiḥ | snapanaṃ vastrabhūṣādidhāraṇaṃ śobhanādikam || 97 || dhūpadīpasunaivedyārārtrikadakṣiṇādikam | stavanārādhanātāmbūlādanajalamarpayet || 98 || sarvaśāstramayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sarasvatīnivāsinam | sarvadevakṛtāvāsaṃ śrīramādikṛtālayam || 99 || prabhālakṣmīpārvatīmāṇikīnāthaṃ smarettathā | dadyād dānāni bahudhā jāgaraṃ sotsavaṃ caret || 1.273.100 || prātaḥ snātvā pūjayitvā bhojayitvā visarjayet | evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇajayantikam || 101 || patnīṃ patiṃ sutāṃ putraṃ gāṃ dhanaṃ svarṇamityapi | kṣetraṃ ca bhavanaṃ yānamārogyaṃ vindati vratī || 102 || vidyāṃ sattāṃ mahākīrtiṃ pūjyatāṃ sarvasampadaḥ | vratenānenāpnuyādvai svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca vindati || 10 3|| kālabhairavajanmāpi kālāṣṭamīti saiva hi | pūjanaṃ tasya yogyopacāraiḥ kāryaṃ vratārthinā || 104 || śaṃkaraḥ kālarūpo’yaṃ saṃjāto bhairavaḥ svayam | vratino bhairavādīnāṃ bhayaṃ naiva hi jāyate || 105 || kārtike dhavale gopāṣṭamī bodhyātra vai gavām | pūjāṃ gogrāsamevāpi godānaṃ gopradakṣiṇam || 106 || kuryāt kṛṣṇo’bhavadgopaścārayāmāsa gā yataḥ | govratena sadā lakṣmīrgṛhe rasātmikā vaset || 107 || mārgasya kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ vai darbhamithunakaṃ vratam | anaghāmanaghaṃ nāmnā kṛtvā darbhamithunakam || 108 || sutāsutasamāyuktaṃ sthāpayed gomayādibhiḥ | lepite bhūtale gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ pūjayecca tat || 109 || bhojayitvā ca dāmpatyaṃ visṛjellabdhadakṣiṇam | naro nārī vrataṃ kṛtvāpnuyātputraṃ sutāṃ sukham || 1.273.110 || atraiva kālabhairavajayantīvratamācaret | atha mārgasitāṣṭamyāṃ durgāvrataṃ ravermatam || 111 || kāryaṃ kālavrataṃ pūjāhomadānasubhojanaiḥ | kālabhairavasānnidhye sajāgaramupoṣaṇam || 112 || kṛtvā vai duḥkhadaṃ karma nāśamāyāti tadbalāt | atha pauṣasitāṣṭamyāṃ śrāddhamaṣṭakasaṃjñitam || 113 || pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaṃ varṣaṃ kulasantativardhanam | kartavyaṃ vidhinā sarvaṃ madhyāhnottarameva ha || 1 14|| śivapūjā prakartavyā bhuktimuktipradā yataḥ | māghasya kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ vai bhadrakālīvrataṃ caret || 115 || pūjayed vairivṛndaghnīṃ sarvakāmapradāyinīm | aṣṭamyāṃ māghaśuklasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ 116 || divyakāśyāṃ cakārāvataraṇaṃ brahmalokataḥ | navamyāṃ sa parāvidyāsaṃcāraṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ || 117 || avatāravrataṃ vidyāvrataṃ kāryaṃ dinadvayam | pūjanaṃ ṣoḍaśavastukṛtaṃ dānaṃ suvarṇakam || 118 || dugdhasāraṃ prabhuṃjyācca vidyāṃ bhuktiṃ vratī labhet | māṇikīṃ pārvatīṃ lakṣmīṃ prabhāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca pūjayet || 119 || kṛṣṇena sahitāḥ sarvāḥ prasannāḥ paṭṭayoṣitaḥ | nayanti puruṣaṃ nārīṃ svakaṃ dhāma parākṣaram || 1.273.120 || phālgune tvasitāṣṭamyāṃ bhīmādevīvrataṃ matam | bhīmāyāḥ pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 121 || śuklāṣṭamyāṃ phālgunasya śivaṃ śivāṃ samarcayet | śītalāṃ pūjayeccāpi pūrvakṛnmiṣṭabhojanaiḥ || 1 22|| digambarāṃ rāsabhasthāṃ mārjanīkalaśānvitām | visphoṭanāśinīṃ devīṃ jale japedatandritaḥ || 123 || tasya tu śītalā devī syād visphoṭakaśāntidā | śītalāyā vratakarturvarṣaṃ śāntimayaṃ bhavet || 1 24||| caitrasyādhavalāṣṭamyāmṛṣabho’haṃ babhūva vai | kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ viṣṇorvratinā puṇyadaṃ param || 125| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikāṣṭamīvrateṣu pārvatījayantīdurgāṣṭamīdaśāhaphalavratakṛṣṇāṣṭamīrādhāṣṭamīṭrūrvāṣṭamījyeṣṭhāṣṭamīkaṃbharālakṣmī jayantīdurgāvratakarakāvrataśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhagavajjayantīkālāṣṭamīgopāṣṭamīdarbhavrataśrāddhāṣṭamībhairavāṣṭamīśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāśyavataraṇavratavidyāvratapaṭṭarājñīkṛtapūjanavratabhīmādevīvrataśītalāṣṭamīṛṣabhajayantyādivratānāṃ nirūpaṇaṃnāma trisaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||273 ||
<1.274> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca kathayāmi vatsarasya navamīnāṃ vratāni tai | śṛṇu lakṣmi yāni kṛtvā svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca vindati || 1 || caitrasya dhavale pakṣe rāmajanmavrataṃ matam | śrīrāmanavamī kāryā sotsāhā bahupuṇyadā || 1 || upoṣyā sāthavā kāryaṃ tvekabhaktaṃ janeḥ param | maṇḍapaḥ sumahān kāryaḥ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam || 3 || kārayitvā ghaṭaṃ nyasya mūrtiṃ sthālyāṃ nidhāpayet | mukuṭādi dhanurbāṇau bhūṣaṇādi ca dhārayet || 4 || pūjanaṃ ṣoḍaśavastukṛtaṃ nīrājanādikam | naivedye kaisaraṃ bhaktaṃ śarkarāṃ dadhi pāyasam || 5 || dadyācca jāgaraṃ kuryātpare’hni dānamācaret | gobhūtilahiraṇyādi dadyādvai gurave vratī || 6 || viprānsādhūm̐śca santarpya vratī kurvīta pāraṇām | evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ viṣṇorvrajet saḥ paramaṃ padam || 7 || asyāmeva tithau harijayantīvratamityapi | kartavyaṃ dharmabhavane harikṛṣṇo vyajāyata || 8 || asminneva dine bhadrakālī tu yoginīvarā | śaṃkareṇābhiṣiktā sā sarvāsāmādhipatyake || 9 || idaṃ mātṛvrataṃ proktaṃ bhairaveṇa samanvitāḥ | catuḥṣaṣṭistu yoginyaḥ saṃpūjyāścaṇḍikānvitāḥ || 1.274.10 || vaiśākhe tu ramāṃ devīṃ pūjayeddhariṇānvitām | bhuktimuktipradāṃ putravittasaubhāgyadāṃ śubhām || 11 || ekabhuktaṃ navamyāstu śuklāyā vratamatra vai | kartavyaṃ pūjanādyaṃ ca dānaṃ sauvarṇavastunaḥ || 12 || jyeṣṭhaśuklanavamyāṃ tu devīmumāṃ sumaṃgalām | taponiṣṭhāṃ pūjayedvai vrataṃ naktaṃ mataṃ śubham || 13 || kumārīrbhojayecchaktyā naikadānāni dāpayet | dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ śreṣṭhāmaśnīyātpāyasaṃ vratī || 1 4|| lakṣmī māṣāḍhaśuklasya navamyāṃ pūjayed vratī | airāvatasthitāṃ caindrīṃ tadvat saṃpūjayed vratī || 15|| sa bhaveddevaloke tu bhogavān devayānavān | navamyāṃ śrāvaṇe śukle bhārgavī śriyamarcayet || 16 || kumārīṃ duḥkhahāṃ lakṣmīṃ yajennaivedyasadrasaiḥ | gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpāmbaranepālakambalaiḥ || 17 || kumārīrbhojayeccāpi duḥkhahāśrīsvarūpiṇīḥ | duḥkhahālakṣmyā vratakṛd yāti kṛṣṇālayaṃ param || 18 || nakulanavamī ceyaṃ kartavyā vratinā tathā | bhādraśuklanavamyāṃ tu nandāvratamudāhṛtam || 19 || nandā durgāṃ pūjayedvai vidhivaccopacārakaiḥ | aśvamedhaphalaṃ labdhvā vratī vaikuṇṭhago bhavet || 1.274.20 || aduḥkhanavamī ceyaṃ kartavyā duḥkhanāśikā | iyaṃ tvavidhavānavamī kartavyā dhavajīvikā || 21 || upavāsaśca kartavyaḥ pūjyā lakṣmīḥ satī tathā | āśvinaśuklanavamī mahānavamī ceritā | navarātravratānte sā yatra durgā prapūjyate || 22|| mahālakṣmīstathā pūjyā devyaḥ pūjyāstu koṭiśaḥ | sarvā devyaḥ prapūjyante sadhavā adhavāśca vā || 22 || vastrālaṃkārabhūṣādiśrāṃgārikadravādibhiḥ | yānavāhanabhojyādivilāsādibhirityatha || 24|| aparāhne śamīpūjā kartavyā prāgdiśi priye | sāyaṃ śaṃkhaṃ gadāṃ cakraṃ kamalaṃ ca prapūjayet || 25|| khaṅgaṃ dhanuripūn śaktiṃ śūlaṃ carma ca kheṭakam | churikāṃ paraśuṃ pāśaṃ daṇḍaṃ vajraṃ cipīṭakam || 26 || chatraṃ dhvajaṃ gajaṃ cāśvaṃ haṃsaṃ vīṇāṃ mayūrakam | vṛṣabhaṃ mahiṣaṃ granthaṃ tulāṃ gāṃ mastakādikam || 27 || yayā yadrakṣitaṃ svasyāstattatsarvaṃ prapūjayet | yasyā yacca bali preṣṭhaṃ tasyaitattvarpayed vratī || 28 || pūjāṃ rātrau samāpyaiva prātarviṃsarjanottaram | vratī pakvānnamadyād vai tathā viprāṃśca bhojayet || 29 || datvā ca dakṣiṇāṃ paścād datvā dānāni bhāvataḥ | vratapūrtiṃ prakuryādvai pratimāṃ nikṣipejjale || 1.274.30 || evaṃ vratena lokānāṃ mātaraḥ sukhadāḥ sadā | tuṣṭāḥ puṣṭāḥ poṣayanti bālān lokān dayāśrayāḥ || 31 || vratī bhuktvā varānbhogānante svargādikaṃ vrajet | mātṛlokaṃ satīlokaṃ devīlokaṃ vrajettathā || 32 || kārtikaśuklanavamī yākṣayā sā vrataṃ mahat | devarṣipitṝṇāmaśvatthamūle tarpaṇaṃ caret || 33 || sūryāyārghyaṃ pradatvātha dvijān bālām̐śca bhojayet | dānaṃ homaṃ japaṃ kuryād dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ vratī || 34 || tīrthe ca mandire sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ tattvakṣayaṃ bhavet | kūṣmāṇḍadānaṃ dadyādvai mukhyaṃ yajñaphalaṃ bhavet || 35 || mārge śukle nandinī tu navamīvratamucyate | upoṣito vratī nandālakṣmīṃ saṃpūjayettataḥ || 36 || dadyād dānaṃ tu kanyāyāḥ phalaṃ syādaśvamedhajam | pauṣaśuklanavamyāṃ tu mahālakṣmīṃ prapūjayet || 37 || māghamāse navamyāṃ tu mahānandāṃ prapūjayet | phālgunasya navamyāmānandālakṣmīṃ prapūjayet || 38 || atra snānaṃ japo mālā dānaṃ homa upoṣaṇam | sarvamakṣayatāṃ yāti kṛṣṇalakṣmīprasādataḥ || 39 || dānaṃ ca vividhaṃ deyaṃ pātre deśe dine śubhe | pātraṃ te vacmi kamale yatpātraṃ tārayejjanān ||1.274.40 || na vidyayā kevalayā tapasā vāpi pātratā | yatra vṛttaṃ dvayaṃ tadvai satpātraṃ bhaktisaṃyutam ||4 1 || svādhyāyī niyamī dhyānī tapoyukto jitendriyaḥ | kṣamāśīlaḥ śāntabhāvaḥ satyavādī dvijo’thavā || 42 || śāstrābhyāsī śrutasarvo’droho pratigrahārataḥ | suvrataḥ sādhuśīlaśca pātra bhakto mahattamam ||43 || sādhavo dhyānaśīlāśca paropakaraṇe ratāḥ | punanti darśanaṃ prāptāḥ kiṃ punaḥ saṃgatiṃ gatāḥ || 44 || tebhyo datvā yathāpekṣaṃ prāpnuyuḥ paramāṃ gatim | śrotriyāya sudharmāya brahmaniṣṭhāya cārpayet || 45 || kṣamā dayā spṛhā satyaṃ dānaṃ śīlaṃ tapaḥ śrutam | etadaṣṭāṃgamatroktaṃ paramaṃ pātralakṣaṇam ||46 || yājñikaṃ vācakaṃ paurāṇikaṃ cācāryakaṃ gurum | kṛṣṇaṃ strīṣu dayāvantaṃ gosevinaṃ supātrakam ||47|| nagnaṃ vṛttihīnaṃ kṣuttṛṭsahitaṃ śaraṇāgatam | satkarmakāriṇaṃ pātraṃ taddattaṃ śāśvataṃ tu tat || 48 || gobhūtilahiraṇyādi pātre dattaṃ sadākṣayam | kiṃcidvedamayaṃ pātraṃ kiñcit pātraṃ tapomayam || 49 || kiñcidbhaktimayaṃ pātraṃ pātraṃ brahmamayaṃ tathā | brahmacārī yatiḥ sādhuḥ sādhvī pātraṃ sadā matam ||1.274.5 0 || etādṛśaṃ samarthaṃ tu dātāraṃ tārayiṣyati | nistārayati dātāramātmānaṃ ca svatejasā ||51 || śataṃ tvabrāhmaṇe dānaṃ dviguṇaṃ brāhmaṇabruve | sahasraguṇamācārye hyanantaṃ sādhuṣu smṛtam ||52 || vedendhanasamṛddheṣu hutaṃ vipramukhādiṣu | santārayati dātāraṃ hutaṃ sādhvīṣu sādhuṣu ||53 || hṛtasvā hṛtasarvasvā dvijāḥ pātraṃ paraṃ matam | atithayo’bhyāgatāśca pātraṃ ca kṛśavṛttayaḥ ||54|| dharmaratā jñānaratā bhaktiratā dayālavaḥ | taporatā bhaikṣajīvāsteṣāṃ dattaṃ mahāphalam || 55|| sannihitaṃ parityajya pātraṃ deśāntarasthitam | abhigacchettu dānārthaṃ dahatyāsaptamaṃ kulam || 56 || yasya caiva gṛhe mūrkho dūre cāsti bahuśrutaḥ | tatra nātikramo doṣo hūyate’gnau na bhasmani || 57|| bālā bhojanapātrāṇi nāryaḥ śṛṃgārapātrikāḥ | yuvā tūnnatipātraṃ syāt sevāpātraṃ sthavīrakāḥ ||58 || sādhavaścārcanapātramannapātraṃ tu bhikṣukāḥ | duḥkhitāstu dayāpātraṃ satyapātraṃ suhṛttamāḥ ||59 || dīnāścopakṛteḥ pātraṃ rakṣāpātraṃ padāśritāḥ | svargapātraṃ dānavantaḥ sukhapātraṃ sutuṣṭayaḥ || 1.274.60 || vivāhamekhalābandhapratiṣṭhādikratupradam | dīnāndhakṛpaṇāpannādiṣu datta tadakṣayam || 61 || nindake drohake caure śaṭhe ghātini nāśake | krūre sakapaṭe serṣye dharmahīne ca pāpini || 62 || dhūrte chalinyaniṣṭacintake sāsūyake sulau | duḥkhade vyasanāḍhye cātatāyini hyabhaktake || 63 || hutaṃ dattaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | rodityetad dīyamānaṃ kiṃ mayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam || 64|| ūṣare bījamuptaṃ vā bhasmanyapi ca yaddhutam | apātrake ca yaddattaṃ tannāśe pariṇīyate || 65 || yadyadiṣṭaṃ bhavetsvasya svīyaṃ nyāyyaṃ ca yadbhavet | pātre tadvai pradātavyaṃ phalakṛd dānameva tat || 6 6|| saśraddhaṃ savidhiṃ pātre dattasyānto na vidyate | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi vratadānasupātrakam ||67|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikanavamīvrateṣu śrīrāmajayantīśrīharijayantībhadrakālīvrataramāvratomāvrataindrīvrataduḥkhahālakṣmīvratanakulavratanandādurgāvratāduḥkhanavamīvratāvidhavānavamīnavarātranavamīvratākṣayānavamīkūṣmāṇḍanavamīnandinīnavamīmahālakṣmīmahānandānandāpūjāsatpātrādicetinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥsaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 274||
<1.275> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca athānyāni daśamyāste vratāni kathayāni vai | yāni kṛtvā mahālakṣmi janaḥ svargaṃ śamāpnuyāt || 1 || caitraśukladaśamyāṃ vai dharmarājavrataṃ caret | snānapuṣpaphalagandhāmbarabhūṣābhirarcayet || 2 || ekabhakto vratī caturdaśaviprān samarcayet | bhojayed dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt kṛtvaivaṃ svargamāpnuyāt||| 3 || vaiśākhaśukladaśamītithau viṣṇuṃ prapūjayet|| ṣoḍaśabhistūpacāraiḥ śataṃ kuryāt pradakṣiṇāḥ || 4 || sādhūn viprān bhojayitvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ labhate dhruvam | jyeṣṭhaḥ śukladalaṃ hasto budhaśca daśamī tithiḥ || 5 || garānandavyatīpātāḥ kanyenduvṛṣabhāskarāḥ | daśayogo mahāpuṇyo daśapāpaharo hi saḥ || 6 || gaṃgādaśaharā bodhyā gaṃgā svargāt samāgatā | gaṃgāyāṃ vidhinā snātvā prayāti harimandiram || 7 || aṣāḍhaśukladaśamī manvādyātithirasti yat | asyāṃ snānaṃ japo dānaṃ homo vā svargatipradāḥ || 8 || śrāvaṇe śukladaśamī sarvāśāparipūrtidā | śivārcanaṃ prakuryādvai dānahomādipūrvakam || 9 || bhādraśukladaśamyāṃ ca daśāvirbhāvasadvratam | tīrthe snānaṃ tathā kuryād devarṣipitṛtarpaṇam || 1.275.10 || daśāvatārapūjāṃ ca kuryāt pṛthag vratī svayam | matsyaṃ kūrmaṃ varāhaṃ ca narasiṃhaṃ trivikramam || 11 || rāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ jāmadagniṃ bauddhaṃ kalkiṃ prapūjayet | daśamūrtīstu sauvarṇīḥ pūjayitvārpayed vratī || 12| dvijāya caikabhaktaṃ ca kṛtvā sādhūn subhojayet | evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ bhuktvā svargaṃ vaikuṇṭhamāpnuyāt || 13|| āśvinaśukladaśamī vijayādaśamī matā | caturgomayapiṇḍāni prātarnyasya gṛhāṃgaṇe || 14|| cakrarūpeṣu madhye’tra vāsudevasukarṣaṇau | pradyumnamaniruddhaṃ ca pūjayeccaturo’pi hi || 15 || sapidhānāsu pātrīṣu gomayīṣu catusṛṣu | klinnaṃ dhānyaṃ saraupyaṃ ca dhṛtvā śuklāmbarāvṛtam || 16|| saṃpūjyākṣatapuṣpādyairnamaskurvīta vai tataḥ | madhyāhne bhojayedbālān miṣṭamadyāttathā vratī || 17|| athāparāhṇe pūrvasyāṃ śamīmūlasthamṛttikām | gṛhītvā svagṛhaṃ nītvā saṃpūjyāpi vidhānataḥ || 18|| kṣatriyaścet svakaṃ sainyaṃ sajjīkṛtya ca sarvathā | nirgatya pūrvadvāreṇa grāmādbahiranākulaḥ || 1 9|| śatrupratikṛtiṃ tatra nirmitāṃ patrakādibhiḥ | manasā kalpitāṃ tāṃ ca svarṇapuṃkhaśareṇa saḥ ||1.275.20 || vidhyediti bhṛśaṃ prītaḥ prāpnuyāt svagṛhaṃ tataḥ | paścād yuddhaṃ prakuryācced vijayī syānna saṃśayaḥ ||21 || dhanaṃ jayaṃ mahārājyaṃ sutagogajavājinaḥ | ajāvikamiha dadyādante svargagatiṃ tathā | śrīrāmaḥ prasthitaścādya vijayāyotsavaṃ caret ||22 || daśamyāṃ kārtike śukle sārvabhaumavrataṃ caret | ekabhukto vratī tatra niśīthe’pūpakādibhiḥ ||23|| daśa dikṣu baliṃ dadyād gṛhādvāpi purād bahiḥ | gośakṛlliptabhūbhāge maṇḍale’ṣṭadale vratī || 24|| balidānaṃ prakurvīta vadannaitādṛśaṃ tadā | yanme pūrvagataṃ pāpamindro dhunotu ceṣṭadaḥ || 25 || yanme vahnigataṃ pāpaṃ vahnirdhunotu ceṣṭadaḥ | yanme dakṣagataṃ pāpaṃ yamo dhunotu ceṣṭadaḥ ||26 || yanme nairṛtigaṃ pāpaṃ rakṣo dhunotu ceṣṭakṛt | yanme paścimage pāpaṃ yādo dhunotu ceṣṭakṛt || 27|| yanme vāyugataṃ pāpaṃ vāyurdhunotu ceṣṭadaḥ | yanme saumyagataṃ pāpaṃ yakṣo dhunotu ceṣṭadaḥ || 28|| yanme tvīśagataṃ pāpaṃ ceśo dhunotu ceṣṭadaḥ | yanme ūrdhvagataṃ pāpaṃ brahmā dhunotu ceṣṭadaḥ ||29|| yanme’dhaḥsaṃgataṃ pāpaṃ nāgo dhunotu ceṣṭadaḥ | evaṃ datvā baliṃ dikṣu vidikṣu ca vratī tataḥ ||1.275.3 0 || kṣetrapālāya tadbāhye kṣiped balimatandritaḥ | śeṣarātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād gṛhaṃ samāgataḥ || 31 || prātaḥ snātvā samabhyarcya lokapālām̐stato dvijān | dvādaśābhyarcya saṃbhojayitvā dadyācca dakṣiṇām || 32 || itthaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ lakṣmi bhogān bhuktvaihikān śubhān | yugaṃ svargasukhaṃ bhuktvā sārvabhaumo nṛpo bhavet | 33 || mārgaśukladaśamyāṃ tvaśvinīkumāramarcayet | dhanvantariṃ pūjayeccārogyaṃ bhavati sarvadā || 34 || pauṣaśukladaśamyāṃ tu viśvedevān samarcayet | kratuṃ dakṣaṃ vasūn satyaṃ kālaṃ kāmaṃ muniṃ gurum || 35 || vipraṃ rāmaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpān samarcayet | darbhāsaneṣu sannyasya dhūpadīpanivedanaiḥ || 36 || ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ saṃpūjayitvā tān visarjayet | vratī lokadvayasaukhyabhoktā bhavati sarvathā || 37|| māghaśukladaśamyāṃ vai tvāṃgirasānsamarcayet | ātmā hyāyurmano dakṣo madaḥ prāṇo gaviṣṭhakaḥ || 38 || dattaḥ satyaśca varhiṣmān daśārcayet suvastubhiḥ | upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśādyairmūrtīrdadyād dvijātaye || 39 || āṃgirasānparān lokānāpnotyevaṃ vratī vrate | phālgunaśukladaśamītithau yamān prapūjayet || 1.275.40 || yamaśca dharmarājaśca mṛtyuścaivāntakastathā | vaivasvataśca kālaśca sarvabhūtakṣayastathā ||4 1 || audumbaraśca dadhnaśca nīlaścaiva vṛkodaraḥ | parameṣṭhī tathā citraścitraguptaścaturdaśa ||42 || pūjayettān bhojayecca tarpayecca tilāṃbubhiḥ | tataḥ sūryāya cārghyaṃ ca dadyādvai tāmrapātrataḥ |||43 || raktacandanasammiśratilākṣatayavāṃbubhiḥ | bhojayed vāḍavān paścād vratī bhuṃjīta vāgyataḥ ||44|| evaṃ vratī dharmarājaprasannatāmavāpya ca | atra bhogānparān bhuktvā dehānte viṣṇudhāmabhāk || 45 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikadaśamīvrateṣu dharmarājavrataviṣṇuvratagaṅgādaśaharāmanvāditithisarvāśāpūrtivratadaśāvatārapūjāvijayādaśamīsārvabhaumavratārogyavrataviśvedevāṃgirasayamavratādipradarśananāmā pañcasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 275 ||
<1.276> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca prāk kathitāni te lakṣmi hyekādaśīvratāni yat | tāni tridinasādhyāni sampūrṇāni vratāni vai || 1 || tyajeccatvāri bhuktāni padmaje vai dinatraye | ādyantayorekamekaṃ madhyame dvayameva ca || 2 || kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ masūrānnaṃ caṇakānkodravām̐stathā | śākaṃ madhu parānnaṃ ca punarbhojanamaithunaṃ || 3 || daśamyāṃ daśa vastūni varjayettu vratī sadā | dyūtakrīḍāṃ ca nidrāṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ dantadhāvanam || 4 || parāpavādaṃ paiśunyaṃ steyaṃ hiṃsāṃ tathā ratim | kopaṃ hyanṛtavākyaṃ ca hyekādaśyāṃ vivarjayet || 5 || kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ surāṃ kṣaudraṃ tailaṃ viṇmlecchabhāṣaṇam | vyāyāmaṃ ca pravāsaṃ ca punarbhojanamaithune || 6 || aspṛśyasparśamityetān dvādaśyāṃ daśa varjayet | ekabhuktaṃ ca vā naktaṃ kṛtvāpi vratamācaret || 7 || śrāvaṇaśuklaikādaśyāṃ pavitraṃ haraye’rpayet | haimaṃ raupyaṃ kauśeyajaṃ kṣaumaṃ kauśaṃ kārpāsajam || 8 || ṣaṣṭyādhikatriśatatantujaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pavitrakam | sādhāraṇaṃ trisūtrotthaṃ madhyamaṃ tu yatheṣṭakam || 9 || uttamaṃ śatagranthi ṣaḍtriṃśadgranthi kaniṣṭhakam | śreṣṭhamājānulambi kaniṣṭhaṃ nābhispṛśaṃ matam || 1.276.10 || pūjanaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ramayā saha | kurvīteha sukhī devā vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāpnuyātparam || 11 || dvādaśyāmapi gurave śrīkṛṣṇāyāpi cārpayet | pavitrāṇi tu ramyāṇi sukhasampatkarāṇi hi || 12 || atha bhādrapade māsi śuklaikādaśikādine | dānilīlāṃ hareḥ kuryāt kālindyāṃ nāvi tu prabhoḥ || 13 || dadhi nītvā vikrayārthaṃ yāntīrgopīrayācata | karaṃ dāṇamiti tasya tadā padāni gāpayet || 1 4|| naivedye ca dadhiṃ bhaktaṃ dadyāt kṛṣṇāya vai vratī | kaṭidānaṃ dadhidānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya prakalpayet || 15 || atha kārtikaśuklaikādaśyāṃ dharmārcanotsavaḥ | dharmajanmanimitto madhyāhne kāryo vratārthinā || 16 || svarṇamūrtiṃ racayitvā sarvatobhadramaṇḍale | maṇḍapāntargate tāmre ghaṭe nidhāya pūjayet || 17 || caturvaktraṃ caturbāhuṃ catuṣpādaṃ sitāmbaram | śvetavarṇaṃ kare dakṣe mālāṃ vāme ca pustakam || 1 8|| dadhānaṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve vyavasāyaṃ sumūrtakam vāmapārśve sukhaṃ nyasya sānnidhye bhaktimeva ca || 1 9|| pūjāpātraṃ dhṛtavatīṃ pūjayed bhāvato vratī | ṣoḍaśakairupacāraiḥ pūjayitvātha bhojayet ||1.276.20 || visarjayenniśi kṛtvā jāgaraṃ pūjanaṃ prage | dadyād dānāni cānyāni dharmabhaktibalaṃ bhavet |||2 1|| dharmeṇa saha tatpatnya śraddhādyā vai trayodaśa | dakṣaputryaḥ susaṃsthāpyā bhojyāḥ pūjyā vidhānataḥ ||22|| dharmasyemā dharmapatnyaḥ śraddhā śāntirdayā gatiḥ | medhā tuṣṭistathā puṣṭirmaitrī lajjā kriyonnatiḥ ||23|| mūrtibuddhirdivyarūpā nāmāntareṇa vāpi tāḥ | suvarṇamūrtayaḥ kāryāstāsāṃ vaṃśo’pi vistṛtaḥ ||24|| pūjanīyo viśeṣeṇa paralokaṃ samicchatā | tannimittāni dānāni pradeyānyuttamānyapi ||25|| ityekādaśikāsādhyaṃ tapo vrataṃ vratī caret | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vrajed yadyadiṣṭaṃ tatsarvamāpnuyāt ||26||| ekādaśīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ vratānyuktāni prāgyathā | vidhivat tadvratānyatra kṛtau grāhyāṇi sarvathā ||27|| udyāpanāni sarveṣāṃ kartavyāni vidhānataḥ | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vrajet kartā naro nārī napuṃsakam |||28|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ekādaśīpālyaniyamapavitrāropaṇavratadānilīlāvratadharmajayantyādivratanirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||276 ||
<1.277> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha lakṣmi śṛṇu vakṣye dvādaśīnāṃ vratāni te | kṛtvā yāni janā yānti śāśvataṃ harimandiram || 1 || caitraśukladvādaśīti madanavratamācaret | śvetatandulasaṃpūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ phalekṣuśobhitam || 2 || vastrayugmayutaṃ svarṇamiṣṭānnasthālikāyutam | candanādyarcitaṃ nyasya sarvatobhadramaṇḍale || 3 || sthālyāṃ śrīkāmadevasya mūrtiṃ ratisamanvitām | sthāpayetpūjayetsarvapuṣparasasugandhibhiḥ |4 || bhojayecca rājasāni bhojanāni ca pāyasam | trayodaśyāṃ prage’bhyarcya visarjayedanaṃgakam || 5 || evaṃ varṣaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā ghṛtaṃ śayyāṃ savatsagām | svarṇaṃ kāmaṃ ratiṃ dadyād dānaṃ śrīgurave mudā || 6 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ pūjayetprārthayettathā | prīyatāṃ kāmarūpī me hariḥ saukhyaprado bhava || 7 || madanadvādaśīvratakartā golokameti saḥ | dampatī sukhamāpnoti śāśvataṃ kṛṣṇasevanāt || 8 || asyāmeva vrataṃ cānyad bhartṛdvādaśikāvratam | maṃḍapaṃ kārayitvā ca sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam || 9 || svāstṛtā sukhaśayyāṃ ca sapuṣpāmupakalpayet | ramāyuktaṃ hari tatra sampūjya ṣoḍaśādibhiḥ || 1.277.1 0|| nīrājayitvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ svāpayedramayā saha | vratī jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād gītavāditrapūrvakam || 11 || prātaḥ punaśca sampūjya gandhādyairbhojayecca tam | saśayyāṃ śrīhariṃ haimaṃ śrīgurave nivedayat || 12 || bhojayitvā dvijān sādhūn visṛjed dakṣiṇāyutān | evaṃ vratakṛścātra dāmpatyaṃ śāśvataṃ bhavet||| 13 || saptajanmasu bhuṃkte’tra bhogān svarge stṛto vratī | bhartuḥ pūjā prakartavyā patnyā api viśeṣataḥ || 14|| bhartā sākṣād vāsudevaḥ sarvān kāmān dadāti vai | daihikaṃ laukikaṃ svargyaṃ sukhaṃ sarvaṃ dadāti saḥ || 15 || vaiśākhaśukladvādaśyāṃ hariṃ saṃpūjya mādhavam | pakvānnaṃ sajalaṃ dadyāt| sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 16 || jyeṣṭhaśukladvādaśyāṃ tu prasaṃpūjya trivikramam | miṣṭaṃ dadyāt karakādi sarvān bhogānavāpnuyāt || 17|| aṣāḍhaśukladvādaśyāṃ vāmanaṃ pūjayetprabhum | śākavrataṃ prakuryāccālavaṇavratamācaret || 18 || dadyād dānāni dharmātmā vastrabhūṣopavītakam | pātramudrormikādhānyadhanāni gurave’rpayet || 19 || śrāvaṇaśuklādvādaśyāṃ śrīdharaṃ pūjayed vratī | śākavrataṃ samāpyaiva dadhivrataṃ samācaret || 1.277.20 || kauśeyajaṃ pavitraṃ ca śreṣṭhaṃ śrīgurave’rpayet | dadyād dānāni sarvāṇi yathāśakti sukhī bhavet ||2 1 || bhādraśukladvādaśikā vrataṃ vāmanajanmanaḥ | pāyasaṃ haraye dadyāt pūjayet bahuvastubhiḥ || 22 || suvarṇasya śubhāṃ kuryād vāmanārcāṃ śubhānanām | bālā dvibhujāṃ sacchatradaṇḍakamaṇḍalusrajam || 23 || maṇḍape sarvatobhadre madhyāhne pūjayettu tām | aditiṃ kaśyapaṃ bhaktaṃ baliṃ devān prapūjayet || 24|| pracurājyasitaiḥ kuryānnaivedyaṃ cūrṇalaḍḍukaiḥ | phalāhāraṃ caikabhaktaṃ naktaṃ kuryācca vā vratī || 25|| dvādaśī yadi madhyāhne śravaṇarkṣayutā bhavet | vaikādaśyāṃ tu madhyāhne yadi dvādaśikā bhavet ||26|| śravaṇarkṣa milettatra sa yogo viṣṇuśṛṃkhalaḥ | bhuktimuttiprado viṣṇusāyujyaprada utsavaḥ ||27|| dvādaśyāmāśvine śukle padmanābhaṃ samarcayet | bhojayenmadhurānnaṃ ca dadyād dānāni bhūriśaḥ ||28|| śveta dvīpagatiṃ vinded bhogām̐śca vāñchitān śubhān | kārtike kṛṣṇapakṣe ca govatsadvādaśīvratam ||29|| kuryādvai vidhinā tatra kārayed gāṃ tu kānakīm | savatsāṃ pūjayet puṣpacandanādibhirādarāt ||1.277.30 || bhojayecchubhavastūni hyarghyaṃ dadyāttu pādayoḥ | māṣādivaṭakān dadyād grāsān dadyāttṛṇādikān ||3 1 || saṃkalpayecca tānnatvā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ tathā | sarvadevamayi mātarmamābhilaṣitaṃ kuru ||32|| svargaṃ mokṣaṃ sukhaṃ dehi mātarmātarnamo’stu te | pūjayitveti dadyācca gavāṃ dānaṃ yathābalam ||33 || taddine goḥ payastakraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ vivarjayet | sthālīpakvaṃ tailapakvaṃ vaikṛtaṃ ca vivarjayet ||34|| mūrtāṃ vatsatarīyuktāṃ pūjayedvā vratī prage | phalaṃ tu bahulaṃ syādvai pratyakṣārcanasevanāt || 35|| dvādaśyāmūrjaśuklāyāṃ devaṃ dāmodaraṃ priye | pūjayet ṣoḍaśavastūttamaiśca bhojayeddharim || 36|| kuṃbhām̐śca salilaiḥ pūrṇān vastrapallavapūjitān | pūgamodakaratnādiphalasvarṇādiśobhitān ||37|| dadyād dāne vratī prītyā gurave bhojayet sataḥ | evaṃ kṛte priyo viṣṇorjāyate’khilabhogayuk
