||38|| dvādaśyāṃ bhūbhṛtā kāryaṃ nīrājanottamavratam | suptotthito jagannātho hyalaṃkāryo’tivastubhiḥ ||3 9|| niśāgame navaṃ vahniṃ kṛtvā cābhyarcya mantrataḥ | hutvā ghṛtādi munyannaṃ raupyadīpikayā janaiḥ ||1.277.40|| gandhapuṣpādyarcitayā vratī nīrājayeddharim | kṛṣṇanārāyanaṃ lakṣmīṃ prabhāṃ ramāṃ ca pārvatīm ||41 || brahmāṇīṃ caṇḍikāṃ gaurīṃ māṇikīṃ maṃgalāṃ tathā | ādityaṃ śaṃkaraṃ yakṣaṃ nandāṃ gaṇapatiṃ grahān ||42|| mātṝḥ pitṝnnagānnāgānsarvānnīrājayettadā | gavāṃ nīrājanaṃ kuryānnamo jayeti saṃvadet ||43|| govṛṣām̐śca vājinaśca gajām̐śca lakṣaṇānvitān | rājacihnāni sarvāṇi chatrādīni navāni ca ||44|| nṛpaṃ purodhasaṃ mantribhṛtyāntaḥpuravāsinīḥ | pūjayitvā yathāyogyaṃ śaṃkhatūryādi vādayet || 45 || alaṃkṛtastato rājā tiṣṭhet siṃhāsane nave | sabhāpi paripūrṇā syāttadā veśyā kulāṃganā || 46|| śīrṣopari narendrasya vardhayedakṣataistathā | kusumaiḥ svarṇamudrābhistato nīrājayennṛpam || 47|| śāntimantrāstadā bhūdevānāṃ śravyāstu bhūbhṛtā | evameṣā mahāśāntiḥ kartavyā prativāsaram ||48 || rājñā dhanavatā vāpi varṣamārogyamicchatā | yeṣāṃ rāṣṭre pure grāme kriyate śāntiruttamā ||49 || nīrājanābhidhā lakṣmi tadrogā yānti saṃkṣayam | yathākathaṃcitkartavyā saṃkṣiptāpi janairiyam ||1.277.5 0 || asyāmeva tu dvādaśyāṃ kṛto vai viṣṇunā purā | kṛtayuge tu tulasīvivāho vratamuttamam ||5 1 || uṣṇīṣaṃ dhārayetkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kusumbhakam | hemasūtramayaṃ raktaṃ kañcukaṃ cāpi dhārayet || 52 || hemavarṇāṃ śubhāṃ śāṭīṃ tulasīṃ paridhāpayet | vastrābharaṇapuṣpādiśṛṃgārāṇi sudhāpayet || 53 || guḍaudanaṃ tathā miṣṭaṃ naivedye tu samarpayet | kadalyādikṛte ramye maṇḍape tu niśāmukhe ||54|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaviṣṇuṃ tulasīṃ pūjayed vratī | upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirgodhūlisamaye’rcayet |||55 || svarṇāmbaraṃ kaṇṭhasūtraṃ nāsābhūṣāṃ ca kaṃkaṇān | haridrāṃ kuṃkumādīni tulasyai vai samarpayet ||56 || phalāni cāmṛtādīni sekṣudaṇḍāni cārpayet | naivedye pītasārāṇi khājakāni samarpayet ||57|| kṛtvā nīrājanaṃ vṛndākṛṣṇayoścāntaraṃ paṭam | kṛtvā paṭhitvā māṃgalyaṃ vṛndāṃ śrīviṣṇave’rpayet ||58 || sādhūn sādhvīrbrāhmaṇām̐śca bālāṃśca bālikā janān | bhojayecchaktito dadyād dānāni vividhāni ca ||59 || vṛndāvivāhapadyāni gāpayed rasikāni vai | ityevamutsavaṃ kuryādakhaṇḍabhāgyarakṣakam || 1.277.60 || dvādaśyāṃ mārgaśuklāyāṃ sādhyavratamanuttamam | manobhavastathā prāṇo naro yātaśca vīryavān || 61 || citirhayo nṛpaścaiva haṃso nārāyaṇastathā | vibhuḥ prabhurdvādaśaitān sādhyān devān prapūjayet||| 62|| sauvarṇāṃstaṇḍulasaṃkalpitān gandhādyamarpayet | bhojayed bahumiṣṭānnaṃ priyānnārāyaṇastviti ||6 3 || etasyāmeva kartavyamādityadvādaśīvratam | dhātā mitro’ryamā pūṣā śakroṃ’śo varuṇo bhagaḥ ||64|| tvaṣṭā vivasvān savitā viṣṇurdvādaśa tān ravīn | pratimā dvādaśa haimīḥ kṛtvā saṃpūjya bhojayet ||65 || pratimāsaṃ tu śuklāyāṃ varṣamekaṃ vrataṃ caret|| dadyād dānāni sarvāṇi viprān sādhūṃśca bhojayet ||66 || evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ prāpya sūryalokaṃ samujjvalam | bhuktvā bhogām̐ściraṃ tatra bhittvā sauryaṃ tu maṇḍalam ||67|| māyāpare paraṃbrahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vrajet | athātraivākhaṇḍavrataṃ janārdanasya kārayet ||68|| mūrtiṃ kṛtvā ca sauvarṇīṃ janārdanaṃ prapūjayet | bhojayet pratimāsaṃ tu varṣamekaṃ vratī tataḥ ||69|| naktāśīstāṃ svarṇamūrtiṃ dhenuṃ vatsayutāṃ śubhām | arpayed gurave viprān bhojayetpāyasādikam || 1.277.70|| prārthayecchrīhariṃ kṛṣṇa vrataṃ cākhaṇḍamastu me | saubhāgyaṃ ca dhanaṃ dhānyamārogyaṃ nityamastu me ||71|| dadyād dānāni cānyāni paralokārthameva ha | kṛtvaivaṃ svarṇayānena yāti viṣṇoḥ padaṃ vratī ||72|| pauṣasya kṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ rūpavratamudīritam | daśamyāṃ vidhivat snātvā gṛhṇīyād gomayaṃ vratī ||73|| śvetāyā vaikavarṇāyā antarīkṣagataṃ priye | aṣṭottaraśataṃ tasya piṇḍikāḥ śoṣayettataḥ ||74|| dhṛtvā tāmre mṛtapātre vā rakṣayet havanāya vai | ekādaśyāṃ sopavāso viṣṇumabhyarcya kānakam ||75 || bhojayejjāgaraṃ kuryād dvādaśyāṃ ca prage punaḥ | ghaṭe sthālyāṃ hariṃ nyasya pūjayedupacārakaiḥ ||76|| kāṣṭhasaṃgharṣaṇajanyamagniṃ sampūjya piṇḍikām | ekaikāṃ homayet tilaghṛtādyuktāṃ tu śārṅgiṇaḥ ||77|| śatamaṣṭottaraṃ homaṃ dvādaśākṣaravidyayā | nāmabhirvā prakuryād bhojayetpāyasapūrikāḥ ||78|| ghaṭamūrtiṃ tu gurave’rpayetsaṃbhojayed dvijān | natvā virsajayennārī naro vā vratamādarāt ||79|| kṛtvaivaṃ labhate rūpaṃ saubhāgyaṃ cottamottamam | pauṣaśuvale sujanmadvādaśīvratamathocyate ||1.277.80 || snātvā prātaśca gośṛṃgavāri pītvā praṇamya ca | pradakṣiṇāṃ tathā kṛtvā gṛhṇīyād vārṣikaṃ vratam ||8 1 || pratimāsaṃ tataḥ śukle dvādaśyāṃ dānamācaret | ghṛtaprasthaṃ pradadyācca vrīhiprasthacatuṣṭayam |||82|| yavaprasthacatuṣkaṃ ca hema dviraktikaṃ vratī | tilāḍhakārdhaṃ dugdhaṃ tu ghaṭapūrṇaṃ samarpayet || 83 || raupyasya māsamekaṃ ca miṣṭānnāni bahūni ca | chatraṃ māṣārdhahemnaśca prastha phāṇitamuttamam || 84 || candanaṃ palikaṃ vastraṃ daśahastamitaṃ śubham | pratimāsaṃ tathā dānaṃ vratī dadyād yathābalam ||85 || gomūtraṃ jalamājyaṃ vā pibed vratī praśuddhaye | dadhiyuktaṃ yavānnaṃ ca tilājyaṃ tu saśarkaram || 86 || kṣīraṃ darbhāmbunā yuktaṃ śākaṃ yatheṣṭameva ca | bhakṣayetpratimāsaṃ vai varṣaṃ yāvattu bhāvataḥ ||87 || raveḥ pratimāṃ sauvarṇīṃ tāmrapātre samarcya ca | arpayed gurave tāṃ sadhenuṃ ca praṇamettataḥ || 88 || viprān sādhūm̐stathāsādhvīrbhojayitvā visarjayet | vratavām̐llabhate janma dhanāḍhye hyuttame kule ||8 9 || sarvasmṛddhimaye bhojyabhojanaujaḥpraśālini | ratiśaktyāśraye śreṣṭhāṃganāsaṃsevite kule || 1.277.90 || tato bhogānasaṃkhyātānatra bhuktvā divi dhruve | devabhogān prabhuktvaiva vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti śāśvatam || 91 || māghasya śukladvādaśyāṃ śālagrāmaṃ prapūjayet | raupya pātre prasaṃsthāpya suvarṇaṃ tanmukhe’rpayet || 92 || bhojayetpāyasānnena khāṇḍājyasahitena ca | pradadyād vedaviduṣe vastrābharaṇabhūṣitam || 93 || vratī yāyāttu vaikuṇṭhaṃ śāśvatānandabhāg bhavet | phālgunaśukladvādaśyāṃ sauvarṇīṃ pratimāṃ hareḥ || 94 || abhyarcya gurave dadyād bhojayed bālabālikāḥ | vrataṃ kṛtvā jano yāti śrīkṛṣṇamandiraṃ yataḥ || 95 || bhuktvā bhogānalabhyām̐śca śāśvataṃ sukhamaśnute | trispṛśānmīlanī pakṣavardhinī vaṃjulī tathā || 96 || jayā ca vijayā caiva jayantī cāparājitā | etā aṣṭau sadopoṣyā dvādaśyaḥ pāpahārikāḥ || 97 || ekādaśī nivṛttā cetsūryasyodayataḥ purā | tadā tu trispṛśānāma dvādaśī sā mahāphalā || 98 || asyā vratenāśvamedhasahasraphalamaśnute | yadāruṇodaye daśamyā viddhaikādaśī tithiḥ || 99 || tadā tāṃ samparityajya dvādaśīṃ samupoṣayet | sonmīlitā rājasūyasahasraphaladāyinī || 1.277.100 || yadodaye tu savituryāmyā tvekādaśī spṛśet|| tadā vaṃjulikā sā tu sarvakratuphalapradā || 101 || kuhūrāke yadā vṛddhe syātāṃ sā pakṣavardhinī | sarvaiśvaryapradā sā vai putrapautravivardhinī || 1 02|| yadā tu dhavale pakṣe dvādaśī syānmaghānvitā | tadā proktā jayā nāma sarvatra jayadā matā || 103 || śravaṇarkṣayutā cetsyād dvādaśī dhavale dale | vijayā sā sarvatīrthaphaladā sukhabhogadā || 1 04|| yadā syācca site pakṣe prājāpatyarkṣasaṃyutā | dvādaśī sā jayantyākhyā vratadānaphalapradā || 1 05|| yadā tu syāt site pakṣe dvādaśī jīvabhānvitā | tadāparājitā jñānamuktidā pāpanāśinī || 1 06 || yadā tvāṣāḍhaśuklāyā dvādaśyāṃ maitrabhaṃ bhavet | tadā vratadvayaṃ kāryaṃ na doṣo’traikadaivatam || 1 07|| śravaṇarkṣayutāyāṃ ca dvādaśyāṃ bhādraśuklake | ūrje sitāyāṃ dvādaśyāmantyabhe ca vratadvayam ||108|| etābhyo’nyatra kartavyaṃ dvādaśyāmekabhuktakam | ekādaśyā sahitaṃ vai vrataṃ dvādaśikādinam || 1 09|| pṛthaṅnodyāpanaṃ kāryaṃ dānaṃ kāryaṃ yathādhanam | iti vratāni kamale kāryāṇi dvādaśīdine || 1.277.110 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikadvādaśīvrateṣu madanavratabhartṛdvādaśīmādhavakarakaśākālavaṇadadhivratapavitrāropaṇavāmanajayantīpadmanābhavratagovatsadvādaśīdāmodaranīrājanavratatulasīvivāhasādhyādityarūpavratasujanmadvādaśīśālagrāmaharipūjātrispṛśonmīlanīpakṣavardhinīvaṃjulījayāvijayājayantyaparājitādvādaśyādinirūpaṇanāmāsaptasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 277 ||
<1.278> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca athāṃtaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi trayodaśīvratāni te | lakṣmi kṛtvā tu vidhinā vratī bhogyottamo bhavet || 1 || caitraśukla trayodaśyāṃ madanaṃ candanātmakam | ratyā yuktaṃ pūjayettaṃ vījayed vyajanena ca || 2 || sindūrarajanīrāgaiḥ phalake’naṃgamālikhet | ratiyuktaṃ sundaraṃ ca puṣpacāpeṣudhāriṇam || 3 || vasantaṃ vājivaktraṃ ca vṛṣadhvajaṃ ca kārayet | pūjayet gandhasragbhūṣāmbarairbhakṣyaiḥ supānakaiḥ || 4 || madanaṃ hyabhavaṃ kāmaṃ manmathaṃ ca ratipriyam | anaṃgaṃ cāpi kandarpaṃ pūjayenmakaradhvajam || 5 || kusumahetikaṃ cāpi viṣameṣu manobhavam | arcayenmālatīpuṣpairhyajādānaṃ vidhāpayet || 6 || ajeyaṃ śaninā yuktā sa mahāvāruṇī matā | gaṃgāyāṃ yadi labhyet koṭisūryagrahādhikā || 7 || śubhayogaḥ śatarkṣaṃ ca śanau kāme madhau site | mahāmahetivikhyātā kulakoṭivimuktidā || 8 || vasantasamaye prāpte varṣe varṣe mahotsavam | pratimāsaṃ ca vā kṛtvā yāvadvarṣaṃ samāpayet || 9 || tasya kāmaḥ sadā tuṣṭo dadātyatra varāṃganā | ratiśaktiṃ paraloke mahāsaukhyamanaṃgajam || 1.278.10 || vaiśākhe ca site trayodaśyāṃ kāmavrataṃ smṛtam | tatra gandhādibhiḥ kāmaṃ pūjayecca tathā punaḥ || 11 || pratimāsaṃ trayodaśyāṃ pūjayed yogyavastubhiḥ | varṣānte gāṃ pradadyācca gurave vratasiddhaye || 12 || bhuktiṃ muktiṃ parāṃ siddhiṃ labheta kāmatoṣaṇam | svargasaukhyaṃ varāṃ nārīṃ yatheṣṭāṃ bhogadāyinīm || 13 || jyeṣṭhaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ daurbhāgyaśamanaṃ vratam | snātvā nadyāṃ pūjayedvai dhūpadīpajalādibhiḥ || 14 || śvetamandāramarkaṃ vā karavīraṃ ca raktakam | nirīkṣya gagane sūryaṃ prārthayecca tato vratī || 15 || mandārakaravīrārkā bhavanto bhāskarāṃśajāḥ | pūjitā mama daurbhāgyaṃ nāśayantu namo’stu vaḥ || 16 || ityarcakasya daurbhāgyaṃ naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | trivikramastathā cātra pūjanīyo vratārthinā ||17 || santuṣṭaḥ pṛthivīṃ dadyātprayacched bhogavaibhavān | sāvitrīvratamevātra prakuryādvaibhavecchayā || 18 || sāvitrīṃ vedhasaṃ caiva pūjayed bahuvastubhiḥ | ghṛtaṃ ca pāyasaṃ pūrikāśca nivedayet vratī || 19 || bhuktimuktiphalaṃ nāryāḥ saubhāgyaṃ sarvadā bhavet | dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ paśuṃ putrādikaṃ vai labhate vratī || 1.278.20 || aṣāḍhasya sitāṃ trayodaśīṃ kuryād vidhānataḥ | ekabhakto vratī saṃkuryādjjayāpārvatīvratam || 21 || haimyau raupyau mṛnmayau ca mūrtī hyumāmaheśayoḥ | siṃhokṣasthe devagehe goṣṭhe brāhmaṇaveśmani || 22|| sthāpayitvā ca vidhinā tridinaṃ paripūjayet | tṛtīyadivase cārpaṇīyau tau gurave mudā || 23 || varṣe varṣe vrataṃ kāryamityevaṃ varṣapañcakam | bhojanaṃ vividhaṃ dadyād dānāni vividhāni ca || 24|| vratānte dhenuyugmena sahitau tau pradāpayet | na vai dāmpatyavicchedau vratinoḥ saptajanmasu || 25|| śrāvaṇasya sitāṃ trayodaśīṃ kuryād vidhānataḥ | upavāsī vratī kuryād ratikāmavrataṃ śubham || 26 || kanyā voḍhā ca vā tāmre sauvarṇe rājate mṛdi | ratikāmau sthāpayitvā gandhādyaiḥ samyagarcayet || 27|| pūjayed dvijadāmpatyaṃ dadyād vastrādidakṣiṇām | bhojayecca vrataṃ caturdaśābdaṃ kārayettataḥ || 28 || pratime godvayayute śrīgurave’rpayet | kāmanādṃ vrataṃ caitatsaubhāgyakāmasaukhyadam || 29 || bhādraśuklatrayodaśyāṃ gotrirātravrataṃ matam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ kṛtvā sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ ca vā || 1.278.30 || pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayitvā maṇḍale’ṣṭadale tataḥ | pīṭhe nidhāya ca puṣpagandhabhūṣābhirarcayet || 31 || nīrājayetpradadyācca bhojanaṃ miṣṭamuttamam | annodakānvitaṃ pātraṃ dadyācchrīgurave tataḥ || 32|| evaṃ dinatrayaṃ kuryād vratānte gāṃ prapūjayet | pañca gāvaḥ samutpannā mathyamāne mahodadhau || 33 || tāsāṃ madhye tu yā nandā tasyai dhenvai namonamaḥ | gāvo mamāgrataḥ santu gāvau me santu pṛṣṭhataḥ || 34|| gāvo me pārśvataḥ santu gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham | natvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tābhyo grāsān pradāpayet || 35|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇamūrtiṃ śrīgurave samarpayet | aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca || 36 || kṛtvā yatphalamāpnoti gotrirātravratāśca tat | iṣakṛṣṇātrayodaśyāṃ bālādiśrāddhamuttamam || 37|| kārayet sarvathā yena sadgatiḥ syāttu ghātinām | kaleryugasyādyatithiḥ procyate puṇyadā vrate || 38 || iṣaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ trirātrāśokasadvratam | haimaṃ tvaśokaṃ nirmāya pūjayitvā suvastubhiḥ || 36 || upavāsaparā nārī nityaṃ kuryāt pradakṣiṇam | aṣṭottaraśataṃ cāthārthayenmāṃ kurvaśokitām ||1.278.40 || tṛtīyehni haraṃ vṛkṣe samarcyārbhakabhojanam | dadyād dānāni pātrebhyaḥ kanyābhyaḥ kajjalādikam ||4 1 || evaṃ vratavatī nārī vaidhavyaṃ nāpnuyāt kvacit | putrapautrādisahitā syātsvabhartustu vallabhā ||42|| ūrjakṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ tailadīpaṃ prakāśayet | saṃpūjya ca gṛhadvāre bahiḥ saṃsthāpayettadā ||43 || yamo me prīyatāṃ dīpapradānena stavaṃ caret | evaṃkṛte mahālakṣmi yamakleśo na jāyate ||44|| ūrjakṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ dhanapūjanamācaret | dhanaṃ lakṣmīrdhanaṃ svarṇaṃ dhanaṃ dārāsutādikam || 45|| dhanapūjanataḥ sthairyamāpnuyānnaiva saṃśayaḥ | lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tatra suvarṇaṃ pūjayed vratī ||46 || mandiraṃ śodhayetsarvaṃ maṇḍapaṃ bandhayecchubham | suvarṇasya harerlakṣmyā mūrtiṃ kuryāt suśobhanām || 47|| tilakaṃ dhārayet kṛṣṇaṃ kuṃkumena suśobhanām | suvarṇaprāntaracitaṃ paṭakaṃ śīrṣṇi bandhayet ||48|| anyāmbaravibhūṣāśca dhārayed yogyavarṣmaṇi | lakṣmīṃ ca haritāṃ śāṭīṃ kausuṃbhīṃ cārukañcukīm ||49|| svanyāmbaravibhūṣādi dhārayecchobhayecchriyam | yogyaiḥ ṣoḍaśavastvādyaiḥ pūjayecca nivedayet ||1.278.5 0 || śaṣkulīkhājakādīni miṣṭānnāni śubhāni vai | nīrājayet pradīpām̐śca bahūn sarvatra kārayet ||5 1 || navīnapātravastrāṇāṃ dadyād dānāni bhāvataḥ | dinacatuṣṭayaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaprapūjanam ||52 || kārayettu viśeṣeṇa lakṣmīvāsaḥ sadā bhavet | datvā dānaṃ ca gurave vrataṃ paścāt samāpayet ||53 || ūrjaśuklatrayodaśyāmekabhojī niśāmukhe | pradīpānāṃ sahasraiśca satairvā dīpamālayā |||54|| gṛhaṃ ca mandiraṃ prakāśayet kṛṣṇaṃ prapūjayet | ṣoḍaśabhistūpacārairnaivedyaiśca rasānvitaiḥ |||55|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃ lakṣmīṃ pārvatīṃ māṇikīṃ prabhām | haraṃ sūryaṃ hariṃ cāpi pūjayet tuṣṭihetave ||56|| niśāmukhe prapūjyainaṃ nīrājanāṃ vidhāya ca | visarjayed bhojayitvā vratī svarṇādimān bhavet ||57|| mārgaśuklatrayodaśyāmanagaṃ vidhinārcayet | ratiṃ ca pūjayet prātarbhojayed dvijadaṃpatīm ||58 || evaṃkṛte vrate syāttu sarvasaubhāgyabhājanam | pauṣaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ samarcya kamalāṃ harim ||59|| ghṛtapātraṃ pradadyācca dvijāya smṛddhisiddhaye | dhanadhānyādimān kartā vratasya sukhavān bhavet || 1.278.60 || māghaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ samārabhya dinatrayam | śītajalena saṃsnānaṃ niśānte sariti priye ||6 1 || kuryādārdravāsasaiva devaṃ saṃpūjayed vratī | janmāntarādipāpāni naśyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 62 || māghasnānaṃ phalaṃ syādvai nānākāmaprapūrakam | prayāge māghamāse tu tryahaṃ snānasya yatphalam || 63 || nāśvamedhasahasreṇa tatphalaṃ labhate bhuvi | tatra snānaṃ japo homaḥ pūjanaṃ syādanantakam || 64 || kalpāditithireṣaiva viśvakarmajayantyapi | harirbrahmā svayaṃ viśvakarmaṇo janmavānabhūt || 65 || maṇḍapaṃ kārayed ramyaṃ kalācitraiḥ praśobhayet | viśvakarmāṇimānyasya pūjayet sarvavastubhiḥ || 66 || nīrājayed bhojayecca dadyād dānāni sūriṇe | vādyagānairvratī rātrau jāgaraṃ ca samācaret || 67 || prātaḥ prapūjya saṃbhojayitvā stutvā visarjayet | evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ śilpī prāpnuyād viśvakarmatām || 68 || dhanadhānyasutāputradārāgosampadādibhiḥ | sukhī syāt svakalākīrtiṃ labhetātra paratra ca || 69 || phālgune kṛṣṇapakṣe ca śivarātristrayodaśī | mahadvrataṃ śivatejomahalliṃgodbhavātmakam || 1.278.70 || nirmalaṃ ca nirāhāraṃ vrataṃ kuryāttadādarāt | prātaḥ śaṃbhuṃ pūjayedvai satyā saha suhaimayā || 71 || madhyāhne bhojayetpakvānnāni sarvāṇi bhāvataḥ | śatarudraṃ koṭirudraṃ rudrādhyāyām̐śca vācayet || 72 || sarvān rudrāvatārām̐śca pārvatyāścāvatāriṇīḥ | pūjayet ṣoḍaśavastūttamairbhaṅgāṃ nivedayet || 73 || rudrākṣadhatturapuṣpagaṃjādhūmrādidhūpakaiḥ | pañcāmṛtajalaiḥ śītacandanādibhirarcayet || 74|| sāyaṃ sampūjayetsarvavidhyupacāravastubhiḥ | mahābhiṣekavidhinā rudrasūktena śaṃkaram || 75 || niśīthe pūjayet prītyā sagaṇaṃ bilvapatrakaiḥ | mallikākundapuṣpaiśca dhattūrakaravīrakaiḥ || 76 || dugdhena snāpayed rudramekādaśasvarūpakam | dvādaśātmānamapi ca brahmaikarūpameva ca || 77|| dhūpadīpasuvādyādinīrājanādibhistathā | nartanaiḥ kīrtanaiścāpi prasādayecchivaṃ śivām || 78 || naivedye kṣairavaṭakān miṣṭānnāni śatāni ca | śākāni cāranālāni bhājāścāpi phalāni ca ||79|| pāyasāni śārkarāṇi caikṣavāṇi dravāṇi ca | peyāni coṣyalehyāni bhakṣyāṇi bharjitāni ca ||1.278.8 0 || kandamūlakaṇādīni patrapuṣpāṃkurāṇi ca | dadyādvai śaṃkarāyaiva śivāyai cātibhāvataḥ ||8 1 || bhasmatriśūlarudrākṣacandravāsukibhūṣaṇam | arpayecchaṃkarāyātra gāpayet tatpadāni ca || 82 || rātrau samutsavaṃ kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ janaiḥ saha | prātaśca pūjanaṃ kuryād dānāni dāpayedati ||8 3 || brāhmaṇānnyāsino yogijanān vai yoginīstathā | satīḥ sādhvīryatīn sādhūn bhojayetpūjayettathā ||8 4|| gurūn pitṝn gaṇān vṛddhānmātṝrbālām̐śca bālikāḥ | bhojayedarcayet kanyāḥ suvāsinīśca jaṃgamān |||85|| śaivām̐śca vaiṣṇavān brāhmān daivyān raudrān prapūjayet | mānayed bhojayed viprān dadyād dānāni sarvathā ||8 6 || visarjayed vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ kuryāttu havanaṃ tataḥ | avabhṛthaṃ śubhaṃ snānaṃ vratī kuryāttu sotsavam ||87|| rudrayajñaṃ mahāyajñaṃ kārayeddhanavān vratī | evaṃ śivacaturdaśyāṃ bhojanakratumācaret ||88 || kṛtvaivaṃ pāraṇāṃ kuryād bhuktiṃ muktiṃ phalaṃ bhavet | kailāsaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ golokaṃ tvakṣaraṃ labhet ||89 || phālgune śuklake trayodaśyāṃ dhanapradaṃ vratam | prakuryātpūjayedatra kuberaṃ candanādibhiḥ || 1.278.90 || pratimāsaṃ pūjanīyaḥ sauvarṇo yakṣarāṭ svayam | sanidhiḥ sagaṇo yakṣeśvaraḥ ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ || 91 || bhojanīyaḥ sumiṣṭānnaiḥ savatsārcyātra gaurapi | guruśca pūjanīyo vai bhojanīyaśca sarvathā || 9 2|| miṣṭānnāni ca dānāni pradeyāni dvijātaye | evaṃkṛte vrate tvekabhukte prāpyeta vaibhavaḥ || 93 || iha loke tathā svarge sarvasmṛddhisamanvitaḥ | sukhasāmrājyamāsādya rājarāja ivāparaḥ || 94 || modate saha kauṭumbijanairvai śāśvatīsamāḥ | vrate sarvatra naktaṃ vaikabhuktaṃ vā hyupoṣaṇam || 95|| yathāśakti prakartavyaṃ phalāśanajalāśanam | dugdhāśanaṃ dadhiprāśanaṃ vā guḍajalāśanam || 96|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikatrayodaśīvrateṣu madanavratadaurbhāgyaśamanatrivikramārcanasāvitrījayāpārvatīvrataratikāmavratagotrirātravratabālādiśrāddhakaliyugāditithitrirātrāśokavratayamadīpadānadhanalakṣmīpūjanaśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapūjanānaṃgavratakamalāharipūjanakalpāditithiviśvakarmajayantīmahāśivarātridhanadavratādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 278 ||
<1.279> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi caturdaśīvratāni te | kṛtvā yāni vratī cātra paratreṣṭamavāpnuyāt || 1 || caitrakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ | purā yuge mahotsavaḥ | nārāyaṇena vai śriyā vivāhasya kṛto’bhavat || 2 || vratinaikāśanenātra kāryaḥ kadalīmaṇḍapaḥ | maṇḍale sarvatobhadre sthāpanīyo ghaṭastathā || 3 || tanmukhe tilapātraṃ ca vahnikuṇḍasamīpataḥ | sthāpanīyaṃ pūjanaṃ ca kṛṣṇalakṣmyostadantare || 4 || upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kartavyaṃ ca nivedanam | tato bahūni vādyāni vādayed vai vratī niśi || 5 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇalakṣmyoḥ śobhāṃ prakārayettathā | śrāṃgārikadravavastravibhūṣāḥ paridhāpayet || 6 || lokācāraṃ kārayitvā varamālāṃ samarpya ca | devānāṃ pūjanaṃ sarvaṃ vinirvartyābhivandanam || 7 || vastrāntaraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kārayeddhastasaṃgraham | vahnau homaṃ kārayitvā gāpayitvā ca maṃgalam || 8 || pradakṣiṇaṃ kārayitvā dattvā ca yautakaṃ tadā | lokācāreṇa saṃpūjya vastūnyuttārya mastakāt || 9 || pūrṇaṃ homaṃ samāpyaiva gṛhamadhye niveśayet | kṛṣṇalakṣmyorbhojanaṃ kārayitvā svāpayed gṛhe || 1.279.10 || prātarjāte granthibandhaṃ gaṃgāyāṃ vai viyojayet | dadyād dānāni bahūni gobhūhiraṇyakāni vai || 11 || bhojayed brāhmaṇān devān munīn sādhūn satīstathā | bālakān bālikādīnān kṛpaṇāndhān nirāśritān || 12|| bhṛtyām̐śca bhikṣukām̐ścāpyanāthān gurūn mahattamān | brahmadhāmasugolokavaikuṇṭhāmṛtadhāmagān || 13 || śvetadvīpāvyākṛtasthān vairājān satyanākagān | bradrīgānāgatānmuktān viṣṇupatnīśca devikāḥ || 14|| mātṝśca mānuṣīrnārīrbhojayetsa tvatām̐stathā | śaṣkulīḥ khājakān ramyān śatacchidrāṇi pheṇikāḥ || 15 || ghṛtapūrām̐śca revālīḥ pītasārāṇi parpikāḥ | piṇḍakān śarka railāśca śārkarām̐ścaṇakām̐stathā || 1 6|| meśubhaṃ śāṭakām̐ścāpi mohanasthālakām̐stathā | bharjikān granthakām̐ścaiva praphullavaṭikāstathā || 17 || dugdhasāraṃ pāyasānnaṃ dadhiśrīkhaṇḍamityapi | śākāni vividhānyeva mauktikām̐ścūrṇamodakān || 18 || dvidalāśca kvathikāśca rājikārāddhakām̐stathā | śreṣṭhāni tvāranālāni peyāni takrakāṇi ca || 1 9|| bhojayejjalapānāni kārayenmukhaśuddhikām | tāmbūlāni dāpayecca dānāni dāpayettathā || 1.279.20 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇalakṣmya1 prapūjya ca visarjayet | amāyāṃ tu vratī paścāt kuryādvai bhojanaṃ śubham || 21 || evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ kṛṣṇalakṣmyorvivāhasaṃbhṛtam | tayoranugrahādatra dāmpatyaṃ śāśvataṃ bhavet || 22 || dhāmni cāpi vratino vai dāmpatyaṃ divyamuttamam | śāśvataṃ syāttu goloke śrīkṛṣṇasya prasādataḥ || 23 || caitraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ mahālakṣmīvrataṃ matam | kāryā tvatra mahālakṣmīyātrā pūjyā vidhānataḥ || 24|| jānakyāḥ śivarājasya pūjanaṃ cātra vai saha | kāraṇīyaṃ prabhaktāyā bhaktasyāpi viśeṣataḥ || 25|| naktaṃ kāryaṃ vratinātra jāgaraṃ nṛtyagītibhiḥ | bhojyāḥ pūjyāḥ punaḥ prātarvisarjanīyātibhāvataḥ || 26 || evaṃ samarcanaṃ kṛtvā mahālakṣmyā naro vratī | nārī| cāpi dhanadhānyaprajāsaukhyaṃ labheta vai || 27|| atrāpi ca caturdaśyāṃ kuṃkumāgurucandanaiḥ | gandhādyairvastramaṇibhiḥ kāryaṃ śivasya pūjanam || 28 || vitānadhvajachatrāṇi datvā pūjyāśca mātaraḥ | aśvamedhādisatpuṇyaṃ labhate mānavo vratī || 2 9|| atraiva damanārcāṃ ca kārayed gandhapuṣpakaiḥ | damanaṃ tu śivāyaivārpayet pūjottaraṃ vratī || 1.279.30 || suvarṇasya mahāliṅgaṃ pātālāt hāṭakāhvayam | samāyātaṃ pṛthivyāṃ vai hāṭakeśvara īśvaraḥ || 31 || sa evātra pūjanīyaḥ ṣoḍaśādisuvastubhiḥ | snānaśṛṃgāranaivedyapūjānīrājanādibhiḥ || 32 | hāṭakeśastoṣaṇīyo hāṭakaṃ vitareddhi saḥ | vratī bhogaprasaṃpūrṇo yāyāt kailāsamuttamam || 33 | vaiśākhasya tu kṛṣṇasya caturdaśyāṃ niśāgame | liṃgamabhyarcayed gandhādyupacāraiśca bilvakaiḥ || 34| bhojayetpūjayeccāpi prārthayecca visarjjayet | evaṃ śivavrataṃ kāryaṃ dhanasantānamicchatā || 35 | vaiśākhaśuklapakṣe tu narasiṃhacaturdaśī | nṛsiṃhajanmanaścātrotsavaṃ sāyaṃ prakārayet || 36 |. ekabhojī copavāsī narasiṃhaṃ suvarṇajam | ṣoḍaśādyairupacāraiḥ snānaiḥ paṃcāmṛtādibhiḥ || 37| dhūpadīpasupuṣpaiśca bhojanaiḥ pānacarvaṇaiḥ | ārārtrikādibhiścaiva pradakṣiṇāstavādibhiḥ || 38 || pūjayitvā nṛhariṃ ca sthāpayedvai vratī niśi | dānāni vividhānyatra tadā dadyād yathādhanam || 39 || taptahāṭakakeśāntaṃ jvalatpāvakalocanam | vajrādhikanakhasparśe divyasiṃhaṃ bhayaṃkaram || 1.279.40 || pīnaskandhakaṭigrīvaṃ kṛśamadhyaṃ kṛśodaram | siṃhānanaṃ nṛdehaṃ ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || 41 || jvālāmālākulāsya ca lalajjihvāgradaṃṣṭrakam | hiraṇyakaśiporvakṣaḥ pāṭayantaṃ nakhāgrakaiḥ || 42 || prahlādaṃ ca kayādhūṃ ca punaḥ prātaḥ prapūjayet | bhojayed vividhānnāni nīrājayed visarjayet ||43 || svayaṃ ca pāraṇāṃ kuryād vratī nṛharitoṣaṇāt | nakhadaṃṣṭribhayānmukto yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ||44 || oṃkāreśvarayātrā ca kartavyātra vratārthinā | paṃcāmṛtaiśca saṃsnapya liṃgamālipya kuṃkumaiḥ ||45 || naivedyaiśca phalairdhūpairdīpairvastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ | ārārtrikādibhirliṃgaṃ paiṣṭaṃ saṃpūjayed vratī ||46 || bhuktiṃ muktiṃ sa labhate mahādevaprasādataḥ | yatkuryāt tadbhavet sarvaṃ jñānamokṣapradaṃ nṛṇām ||47 || jyeṣṭhaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ snānayātrārthamuttamam | jalamāhārayet tasyādhivāsādisamācaret ||48 || pūrṇimāyāṃ tajjalena snāpayecchrīhariṃ prage | pūjayed vividhairdravyaiḥ kārayedutsavaṃ vratī ||49 || caturdaśyāṃ divā pañcatapā rātrimukhe’rpayet | homadhenuṃ rudravratametatkuryātprayatnataḥ ||1.279.50 || aṣāḍhe tu caturdaśyāṃ rudraṃ sampūjya vai vratī | deśakālārjyavastvādyaiḥ sarvasampadamāpnuyāt || 51 || śrāvaṇe śuklapakṣe tu caturdaśyāṃ tu śārṅgiṇe | pavitrāropaṇaṃ kuryāllakṣmyai cāthārpayettathā || 52 || naro nārī hariṃ lakṣmīṃ sampūjyāpi vidhānataḥ | tayoḥ prasannatālabhyāṃ bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt ||53 || bhādraśuklacaturdaśyāmanantavratamuttamam | anantākhyaṃ tadā śeṣaṃ tathā nārāyaṇaṃ harim || 54 || sauvarṇaṃ kārayetpaścātpūjayed vidhinā vratī | kārpāsaṃ paṭṭajaṃ sūtraṃ caturdaśasugranthikam ||55 || kṛtvābhyarcya kuṃkumādyairbadhnīyāt sve bhuje vratī | nārī vāme pumān dakṣe purāṇaṃ tu kṣipejjale || |56 || tato godhūmapiṣṭasya prasthaṃ śarkarayā yutam | sampacya saghṛtaṃ svādu tvanantāya nivedayet ||57|| bhojayitvārbhakām̐ścāpi tatastvadyād vratī svayam | dvisaptavarṣaparyantaṃ vrataṃ taddakṣiṇāyutam || 58 || prakuryādāvidāyaṃ vai tata udyāpayed vratī | maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ saptadhānyaiḥ prakalpayet|||5 9 || tāmraje kalaśe sthālyāmanantapratimāṃ nyaset | pūjayed vidhinā tāṃ ca nīrājayecca bhojayet || 1.279.60 || gaṇeśaṃ mātṛkāḥ kheṭān lokapālān yajet pṛthak | homaṃ ghṛtahaviṣyaiśca kṛtvā pūrṇāhutiṃ caret||| 61 || śayyāṃ pratimāṃ dhenuṃ ca dadyācchrīmukhe vratī | bhojayitvārbhakān sādhūn dakṣiṇābhiḥ pratoṣayet||| 62 || daded dānāni bahūni sādhūn sādhvīḥ prabhojayet | evamanantavratakṛjjāyate bhuktimuktibhāg || 63 || kadalīvratamapyatra kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā | naro nānyatarannārī raṃbhāṃ vanāntarasthitām || 64|| snātvā sampūjayed gandhapuṣpadhānyāṃkurādibhiḥ | dadhidūrvākṣatairdīpairvastrapakvānnasaṃcayaiḥ || 65 || natvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tataḥ saṃprārthayecca tām | apsaro’marakanyābhirnāgakanyābhirarcite || 66 || śarīrārogyalāvaṇyabhūtīn dehi namo’stu te | tataḥ kanyāścatasraśca suvāsinīḥ satīśca vā || 67 || bhojayitvāṃśukasindūrakairalaktakajjalaiḥ | pūjayitvā samāpyaiva vratī svasya gṛhaṃ vrajet || 68 || evaṃ kṛte vrate lakṣmi labdhvā saubhāgyamuttamam | laset svargaṃ vimānena paraṃ lokaṃ tato yajet || 69 || parībhiḥ sevitaḥ satye mahānandān prabhujya ca | yātyante’kṣaradhāmākhyaṃ divyalokaṃ hareḥ padam ||1.279.70|| iṣakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ viṣaśastrāmbuvahnibhiḥ | sarpaśvāpadavajrādyairhatānāṃ brahmaghātinām ||71 || śrāddhaṃ kuryād yathāyogyamekoddiṣṭavidhānataḥ | bālān saṃbhojayenmiṣṭaiḥ sādhūn sādhvīśca bhūsurān ||72|| tarpaṇaṃ ca gavāṃ grāsān balirdānaṃ śvakākayoḥ | kṛtvācamya vratī svīyairbhuñjīyād bandhubhiḥ saha ||73|| evaṃ kṛtvā mahacchrāddhaṃ pitṝnuddhṛtya pūrvajān | gacchetsanātanaṃ svargaṃ tvante brahmapadaṃ hareḥ ||74|| iṣaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ dharmarājaṃ tu kānakam | gandhādyaiḥ samyagabhyarcya bhojayenmiṣṭamuttamam ||75|| nīrājayed visarjayeddānaṃ śrīgurave’rpayet | vratinaṃ trāyate dharmarājaḥ svargaṃ nayettathā ||76|| ūrjakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ tailābhyaṃgaṃ vidhūdaye | kṛtvā snātvārcayed dharmarājaṃ pratarpayed yamam ||77|| pradoṣe tailadīpām̐śca dīpayed yamatuṣṭaye | catuṣpathe gṛhād bāhyapradeśe sthāpayed vratī || 78|| bhojayennamanaṃ kuryād visarjayet yamādhipam | evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ svargaṃ narakādabhayaṃ vrajet ||79|| athātraiva caturdaśyāṃ kuryāt hanumadarcanam | tailasindūrārkapuṣpasraṅmāṣavaṭakādibhiḥ ||1.279.8 0|| arcakānāṃ putrapautrā vṛddhimeṣyanti puṣkalām | ante vairājalokām̐śca prāpsyanti naiṣṭhikāñcitān ||8 1|| bhūtapretapiśācāditāmasānāṃ prasādhanam | rājasānāṃ ca devānāṃ mantrāṇāmapi sādhanam ||82|| laukikānāṃ sāttvikānāṃ viṣāgnijaḍakāriṇām | āveśānāṃ ḍākinīyoginīnāṃ ca prasādhanam ||83|| śmaśānavāsināṃ cāpi sādhanaṃ bhairavārthinām | prakuryāccātra rātrau ca yathādeśaṃ vidhānataḥ ||84|| tattadvrataṃ baliṃ pūjāṃ japaṃ nāma visarjanam | homaṃ kriyāṃ yathātantraṃ kuryādvai kramato vratī |||85||| ūrjaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ kāśyāṃ śrīśaṃkaraḥ svayam | cakāra vidhinā snātvā śreṣṭhaṃ pāśupataṃ vratam ||86|| tataścātra mahāpūjāṃ liṃge gandhādibhiścaret | droṇapuṣpairbilvadalairarkapuṣpaiśca ketakaiḥ ||87|| puṣpaiḥ phalairmiṣṭapakvairnaivedyairvividhairapi | ekabhukto vratī śaṃbhostoṣāt kailāsamāpnuyāt ||88 || brahmakūrcavrataṃ cātra kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā | pañcagavyaṃ pibed rātrau prātardevām̐śca tarpayet ||8 9|| brāhmaṇām̐stoṣayitvā ca bhuñjītāpi vratī svayam | sarvapāpāni naśyanti brahmakūrcavratād dhruvam || 1.279.90 || kapilāyāstu mūtraṃ vai kṛṣṇāyāstu śakṛttathā | śvetāyāstu payo grāhyaṃ raktāyāstu śubhaṃ dadhi || 91 || karburāyā ghṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ kuśādbhistāni melayet | tatpānena tu pāpāni naśyantyārdrāṇi mūlataḥ || 92 || pāṣāṇavratamapyatra naktaṃ kṛtvā kṛtaṃ bhavet | gaurīṃ gandhādibhiḥ prārcyārpayed ghṛtena pācitam || 93 || piṣṭaṃ pāṣāṇasadṛśaṃ piṇḍakākāramityatha | aiśvaryasukhasaubhāgyasvarūpāṇyāpnuyād vratī || 94|| mārgaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ vṛṣaṃ svarṇaṃ prapūjya ca | ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kuryādatha rātrau maheśvaram || 95 || pūjayet kamalaiḥ puṣpairgandhamālyānulepanaiḥ | bhojayedbahupakvānnaistato devaṃ visarjayet || 96 || dadyād dānāni gurave bhojayettu sataḥ satīḥ | evaṃ śivavrataṃ kṛtvā bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt || 97|| atraiva ca harirbrahmā śivo datto’trisaṃbhavaḥ | ekībhūya trayo devā babhūvurdatranāminaḥ ||98 || anasūyāṃ tathātriṃ ca dattātreyaṃ ca kānakān | kṛtvā tu maṇḍape bhadramaṇḍale ca ghaṭopari || 9 9|| sthālyāṃ saṃpūjayet samyag bhojayecca visarjayet | dadyād dānāni sarvāṇi vratī vaikuṇṭhamāpnuyāt || 1.279.100 || pauṣaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ virūpākṣavrataṃ caret | snātvā śivaṃ virūpākṣaṃ pūjayet sarvavastubhiḥ || 101 || bhojayettarpayecchaṃbhuṃ vidhitaḥ saṃ sarjayet | dānaṃ dvijātaye datvā kailāse modate vratī || 10 2|| māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yamatarpaṇamīritam | sūryodayātpūrvakāle snātvā saṃtarpayed yamam || 103 || tiladarbhāṃbubhiḥ paścād bhojayedannamuttamama | visarjayed dvijān sādhūn bhojayed bhakṣayed vratī || 1 04|| phālgunasya kṛṣṇacaturdaśī śaṃbhuniśāvratam | nirjalā śivarātristu tadopoṣyā subhāvataḥ || 105 || jyotirliṃgaṃ pārthivaṃ vā mūrtimantau śivāśivau | gandhādyairbilvapatrādyairnaivedyai_ pānasadrasaiḥ || 106 || pūjayedbhojayennīrājayedvisarjayennamet vratī | vratī vrataprabhāveṇa kailāsaṃ samavāpnuyāt || 10 7|| phālgunasya śuklacaturdaśī durgāvrataṃ matam | ekabhukto vratī durgāṃ pūjayedbhojayettathā || 108 || nīrājayennamedvisarjayet kailāsabhāgbhavet | udyāpanaṃ vratānāṃ tu kartavyaṃ phalamicchatā || 109 || kuṃbhāścaturdaśaivātra sapūgākṣatamodakāḥ | sadakṣiṇāṃśukāstāmrā mṛnmayāścāvraṇā navāḥ || 1.279.110 || tāvanto vaṃśadaṇḍāśca pavitrāṇyāsanāni ca | pātrāṇi yajñasūtrāṇi tāvantyeva hi kalpitāḥ || 111 || maṇḍape sarvatobhadramaṇḍale saphalā ghaṭāḥ | sthāpanīyāḥ pūjanīyā bhojanīyāśca devatāḥ || 112 || visarjanīyā dātavyā gurave dānarūpataḥ | bhojanīyāḥ susantaśca sādhvyo viprāśca bālikāḥ || 113 || sotsāhaṃ sarvathā kāryamudyāpanaṃ sahomakam | sajapaṃ sāṃgamevāsya phalaṃ svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam || 11 4|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣiṃkacaturdaśīvrateṣu śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇalakṣmīvivāhamahālakṣmīyātrāśivārcanadamanārcanaśrīhāṭakeśvarajayantīnarasiṃhajayantyoṃ kāreśvarayātrāsnānayātrājalāharaṇarudravratapavitrāropaṇānantacaturdaśīkadalīvratahatādiśrāddhadharmarājapūjananarakacaturdaśīyamatarpaṇābhyaṃgasnānahanumadarcanabhūtārcanamantrasādhanāpāśupatavratabrahmakūrcavratadattātreyajayantīśivarātriprabhṛtivratanirūpaṇanāmaikonāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāya ||| 279 ||
<1.280> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi pūrṇimāyā vratāni te | yāni kṛtvā naro nārī prāpnuyāt puṇyasampadaḥ || 1 || caitrakṛṣṇāmāvāsyā tu manvādistithirasti hi | asyāṃ sānnodakaṃ kuṃbhaṃ pradadyāt somatuṣṭaye || 2 || kuryācchrāddhaṃ yathoddiṣṭaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptihetave | caitryāṃ dhavalapūrṇāyāṃ hanumattithirucyate || 3 || pūjanaṃ tailasindūrairvaṭakādibhiruttamam | kartavyaṃ tvatra vaiśākhasnānāraṃbho’pi sammataḥ || 4 || vaiśākhāmātithau śrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ pitṛtṛptikṛt | vaiśākhaśuklapūrṇāyāṃ kūrmajayantikāvratam || 5 || kartavyaṃ vidhinā tatra dvibhujaṃ naramastakam | kaṭyadhaḥ kūrmarūpaṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ pūjayet prabhum || 6 || bhojayed dugdhasāraṃ ca cāṇakodbhūtamodakān | nīrājayed visarjayed dadyāddānāni ca vratī || 7 || evaṃvratakṛto vāso vaikuṇṭhe bhavati dhruvaḥ | dharmarājavrataṃ tvatra kartavyaṃ dharmatuṣṭaye || 8 || śṛtānnamudakuṃbhaṃ ca dadedgāṃ gurave vratī | dharmarājaṃ pūjayecca bhojayecca visarjayet || 9 || śubhaṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ dadyāt sakhuraṃ ca saśṛṃgakam | satilavastraṃ saṃdadyāt kuṃbhān svacchajalānvitāna || 1.280.1 0 || phalāni ca hiraṇyaṃ ca dāne dadyād vratī janaḥ | modate satyaloke’yaṃ yāvaccandrārkatārakam || 11 || ante vaikuṇṭhamāpnoti śāśvataṃ sukhamaśnute | jyeṣṭhāmā bhāvukā proktā śrīhariṃ bhāvayettadā || 12 || pūjayetsarvathā rātrau bhojayecca visarjayet | jyeṣṭhapūrṇātithau kāryaṃ vaṭasāvitrikaṃ vratam || 13 || sopavāsā vaṭaṃ siñcet salilairamṛtopamaiḥ | sūtreṇa veṣṭayeccaiva saśatāṣṭapradakṣiṇam || 14 || pippalaṃ vā veṣṭayecca sāvitrīṃ prārthayed vratī | jagatpūjye jaganmātaḥ sāvitri patidaivate || 1 5 || patyā sahāviyogaṃ me vaṭasthe kurute namaḥ | iti saṃprārthya sāvitrīṃ bhojayitvā suvāsinīḥ || 16 || svayaṃ bhuñjyād vratakartrī sā syāt saubhāgyabhāginī | atra bilvatrirātrākhyaṃ vrataṃ kartavyamādarāt || 17|| bilvapatraiḥ śaṃbhurarcyo bilvaṃ bhakṣyaṃ vratārthinā | bilvasnānaṃ prakartavyaṃ bilvadruḥ pūjya ityapi || 18 || bilvādhaḥśayanaṃ kāryaṃ bilvadānaṃ tathā matam | evaṃ kṛtvā trirātraṃ vai kailāsaṃ prāpnuyād vratī || 19 || manvāditithireṣāsti manuḥ pūjyo vidhānataḥ | deyaṃ dānaṃ tathā bhojyāḥ santaḥ sādhvyaḥ supuṇyadāḥ || 1.280.20 || jyeṣṭhābhiṣekasaṃsnānayātrā kāryātra vai dine | tatrābhiṣekavidhinā snapanīyo ramāpatiḥ || 21 || jalairujjvalapātrasthairnirmalaiśca sacandanaiḥ | śaṃkhena snapayet kṛṣṇaṃ mantrairvedānusāribhiḥ || 22 || tataḥ pītāmbarāṇyatra dhārayecchrīpatiṃ prabhum | uṣṇīṣaṃ pāṭalaṃ caiva bhūṣāśca vividhā api || 23 || bhaktaṃ sūpaṃ polikāśca vaṭikāṃ kvathikāṃ tathā | vyañjanāni ca naivedye miṣṭapeyānyupāharet || 24|| jalakrīḍanapadyāni śroharestvatra gāpayet | visarjayaddhariṃ paścād bhuñjīta vratakṛjjanaḥ || 25 || hariprasādajaṃ saukhyaṃ śāśvataṃ tena cāpyate | aṣāḍhāmātithau śrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ pitṛtārakam || 26|| aṣāḍhasya tu pūrṇāyāṃ gurorvyāsasya pūjanam | ṣoḍaśopasuvastvādyaiḥ kartavyaṃ vai yathā hareḥ || 27|| candanākṣatatulasīsrakphalāmbarakuṃkumaiḥ | bhūṣābhojyasumiṣṭānnottamācchādanavāribhiḥ || 28 || dravyaiḥ suvarṇarūpyādikṣetrairdravyādibhistathā | guruṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tathācāryaṃ gurvīṃ cābhyarcayed vratī || 29 || guroḥ pādāṃguṣṭhajalaṃ pibet svādyaviśuddhaye | gururhariḥ svayaṃ proktaḥ svamokṣārthaṃ prasevayet || 1.280.30 || guroḥ prasannatāprāptaṃ jñānaṃ vā sevanaṃ vratam | mokṣadaṃ sukhadaṃ puṇyapradaṃ bhuktivimuktidam || 31 || aṣāḍhasyātra pūrṇāyāṃ gopadmavratamuttamam | caturbhujaṃ śaṃkhacakragaḍhā padmavirājitam || 32 || prasannāsyaṃ kaṃjanetraṃ ramāgaruḍaśobhitam | svarṇavarṇaṃ surūpaṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ bhūṣaṇānvitam || 33 || sevitaṃ munibhirdevairyakṣagandharvakinneraiḥ | evaṃvidhaṃ hariṃ snāpayitvā pañcāmṛtairjalaiḥ || 34|| snāto vratī pūjayet saṃvadan puruṣasūktakam | vibhūṣayedarcayecca nīrājayecca bhojayet || 35 || namet kṣamāpayeccāpi vratī visarjayettataḥ | ācāryaṃ vā guruṃ sādhuṃ bhojayettoṣayenmuhuḥ || 36 || dadyād dānaṃ ca bhuñjīta prasādāt kamalāpateḥ | aihikāmuṣmikān kāmān labhate śāśvatān vratī || 3 7|| kokilāvratamatraiva kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā | śrāvaṇapūrṇimāntaṃ tad vrate snāyād bahirjale || 38 || gaurīrūpāṃ kokilāṃ vai nityaṃ prapūjayed vratī | svarṇapakṣāṃ ratnanetrāṃ pravālamukhapaṃkajām || 3 9|| kastūrīvarṇaśobhāḍhyāṃ nandanāraṇyavāsinīm | cūtacampakavṛkṣasthāṃ kalagītaninādinīm ||1.280.40 || cintayet pārvatīṃ devīṃ kokilārūpadhāriṇīm | gandhādyaiḥ pūjayennityaṃ nīrājayecca bhojayet ||41 || māsānte kānakīṃ tilapiṣṭajāṃ prārthayettadā | kṛṣṇe caitrarathotpanne kokile haravallabhe || 42 || hararūpāya viprāya dattā me sukhadā bhava | dvijaṃ suvāsinīstriṃśadekāṃ vā bhojayettataḥ || 43 || vastrādidakṣiṇāṃ datvā natvā devīṃ visarjayet | nārī vratavidhānena kokilāgauryanugrahāt ||44|| bhuktiṃ svargaṃ mahānandaṃ kailāsaṃ dampatīsukham | saubhāgyaṃ saptajanmāḍhyaṃ labhettvante pramokṣaṇam || 45 || manvāditithireṣāpi cāturmāsyapravartanam | śaṃbhoḥ śayanajaścātrotsavaḥ kāryo vidhānataḥ ||46|| kāryaḥ samudraḥ sajalaḥ śayyā tatra yathocitā | harirharaśca vā tatra śayanīyaḥ susevinā ||47 || bhojanīyo’rcanīyaśca prārthanīyo’pi bhāvataḥ | cāturmāsyasya niyamā grāhyāśca vratinā vrate || 48 || evaṃ vai pūjanaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ ca niyamagraham | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ phalaṃ divyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||49 || śrāvaṇāmātithau kāryā dīpapūjā yathāvidhi puṣpacandanatandulaśarkarāphalavāribhiḥ || 1.280.50 || cakṣustejaḥprado dīpaḥ sadā saubhāgyado bhavet | dīpadānaṃ tu devāya kartavyaṃ svargadaṃ hi tat || 5 1 || śrāddhaṃ cātra prakartavyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ divyatṛptikṛt | navavṛkṣāropaṇaṃ ca kartavyaṃ tvatibhāvataḥ || 52|| haritāṃ pṛthivīṃ kurvan svargaṃ haritamāpnuyāt | yānavāhanadāsyādisevitaṃ śāśvataṃ vratī || 5 3 || atha śrāvaṇapūrṇāyāṃ nārikelaphalaṃ vratī | pūjayed bhakṣayeccāpi dadyād dāne ca bhāvataḥ ||558|| nārikelatrinetreṣu haribrahmaharāstrayaḥ | vasanti pūjanīyāste nārikelaphale’tra vai || 55 || tvam brahmā kuparo viṣṇurjalaṃ śaṃbhustrayastu te | sattvaṃ viṣṇustvantarasthastrinetro madhyakurculaḥ || 56 || tvajjaṭātmā bahirbrahmā tridevātmā hariḥ sa vai | tasya vai pūjayā bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheta śāśvatīm ||5 7 || atra śrāvaṇapūrṇāyāṃ vedopākaraṇaṃ vratam | yajurbhistatra kartavyaṃ devarṣipitṛtarpaṇam ||58 || ṛṣīṇāṃ pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ svasvaśākhāvidhānavat | bahvṛcaistu caturdaśyāṃ kartavyaṃ taddhi tarpaṇam || 59 || sāmagairbhādramāse tu kartavyaṃ taddhi tarpaṇam | tṛtīyāyāṃ dvitīyāyāṃ śukle hastarkṣakālike || 1.280.60 || homaḥ kāryastathā varṣmaśuddhiḥ kāryā vidhānataḥ | jalena darbhamiśreṇa tarpaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ tathā || 61 || kārayitvopavītaṃ ca dhārayennūtanaṃ śubham | bhojayetsarvamiṣṭānnaiḥ sādhūn viprān gurūn satīḥ || 62 || tebhyo dadyād dakṣiṇāṃ tu suvarṇarajatātmikām | svayaṃ bhuñjīta bandhvādyairvratī sukhamavāpnuyāt || 63 || tathā rakṣāvidhānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ vidhinātra vai | rājikā raktavastrāṇi cākṣatān śarkarānvitān ||64|| kausuṃbhatantunā badhvā prakṣālya salilaistathā | dhṛtvā kāṃsye’tha saṃpūjya gandhādyairviṣṇumukhyakān ||6 41|| badhnīyād brāhmaṇadvārā muditaḥ svaprakoṣṭhake | dvijāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād rakṣāṃ karoti sūtrakam || 66||| atraiva tu tithau pūrvaṃ hayagrīvo mahāprabhuḥ | hiraṇyākṣavināśāya vedānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca ||67|| samajajñe tatastasya kartavyaṃ vratamādarāt | sukhaṃ hayasvarūpasya śubhaṃ varṣma narākṛti ||68 || vidhāya kānakaṃ pūjyaṃ ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ | bhojayecca vratī nīrājayedatha visarjayet || 69|| evaṃ vratakṛtaścātra parasmin jāyate sukham | atraiva ca dine kuryād rudrapavitrakārpaṇam ||1.280.7 0 || vividhaistu pavitrairvai pūjayecca śivāṃ śivam | kokilāvratapūrṇatvaṃ kuryāttvatra dine vratī ||7 1 || bhādrāmāyāṃ pitṛśrāddhaṃ prakuryāt tarpaṇādikam | kuśānāhārayet kṣetrācchastrāchinnān samūlakān ||72|| prauṣṭhapadyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmumāmaheśvaravratam | snātvā rudrākṣabhasmādi dhṛtvā śaṃbhuṃ prapūjayet ||73 || bilvapatraiḥ sugandhāḍhyairnaivedyairdhūpadīpakaiḥ | bhojayecca namennīrājayetprasvāpayettataḥ ||74|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātpunaḥ prātaḥ prapūjayet | bhojayet prārthayeccāpi vratī paścād visarjayet ||75|| pāraṇāṃ ca svayaṃ kuryāt kailāsaṃ prāpnuyād vratī | evaṃ pañcadaśābdāntaṃ kṛtvā tūdyāpanaṃ caret ||76 || umāyāśca maheśasya sauvarṇīṃ pratimāṃ śubhām | pañcadaśaghaṭeṣvantarghaṭe saṃpūjitā ca tām ||77|| vastrābhūṣaṇapuṣpādyairmiṣṭānnaiśca jalaiḥ śubhaiḥ | sahitāṃ ghaṭasampannāṃ pratimāṃ gurave’rpayet ||78|| evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ tvatra nidhānaṃ sarvasampadām | bhavatyeva vratī bhuktimuktisampattibhājanam ||79 || athātraiva dine śakravrataṃ kartavyamādarāt | gandhādyairupacāraiśca naivedyaiḥ pūjayeddharim | 1.280.80 || śakraṃ samarpya sauvarṇaṃ gurave tvanyabhūsurān | bhojayeda dakṣiṇādānaṃ kuryādvai dhanavānnṛpaḥ ||8 1 || dhanadhānyecchunā kāryametattu prativārṣikam | āśvināmādine kāryaṃ sarvapitṛpratarpaṇam ||82 || śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ piṇḍadānaṃ bhojanaṃ jalasecanam | vividhānnāni deyāni dugdhasārāṇi cāpi vai ||83|| viprāśca sādhavo bhojyāḥ satyaḥ sādhvyaśca bālikāḥ | tarpaṇīyāstṛṇairgāvastathā vṛkṣā jalādibhiḥ ||84|| harikṛṣṇastarpaṇīyo naivedyaphalasajjalaiḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo lakṣmīstarpaṇīyāvubhāvapi ||85|| evaṃ kṛtvā mahāśrāddhaṃ pitaraśca pitāmahāḥ | tattatpitrādayaḥ sarve mātaraścāpi vaṃśajāḥ ||86|| śāśvatīṃ yānti vai tṛptiṃ tvante brahmapadānugāḥ | mokṣasthitiṃ prayāsyanti tasmācchrāddhaṃ paraṃ vratam ||87|| āśvine māsi pūrṇāyāṃ rāsalīlotsavo mataḥ | pūrṇacandrodaye rātrau rāsalīlāṃ cakāra saḥ ||88|| bhagavān rādhayā sākaṃ gopībhiśca samaṃ ciram | gopīrādhākṛṣṇamūrtīḥ sauvarṇīścātiśobhayet ||89|| kausumbhaṃ dhārayed vāsaṃ uttarīyaṃ ca cellakam | kañcukīṃ pītavarṇāṃ ca bhāle kuṃkumapatrikām || 1.280.90 || pītāmbaraṃ tu kṛṣṇaṃ cānarghyaṃ saṃdhārayed vratī | nānāratnavicitraṃ ca mukuṭaṃ kuṇḍale tathā ||9 1 || kare tu muralīṃ svarṇāṃ dhārayed ratnakāñcitām | naivedye parpikā deyā piṇḍakāḥ pāyasādikam ||92|| sugandhipuṣpatailena sthalapadmodakena ca | vāsāṃsi mandiraṃ cāpi vāsayed rādhikāpateḥ ||93|| candraśālāsane nyasya pūjayenniśi mādhavam | gītavāditranṛtyaiśca toṣayedvai ramāpatim ||94|| navīnaśālipṛthukān śarkarādugdhamiśritān | tasmai nivedayed rāsalīlāpadyāni gāpayet ||95|| śaradvrataṃ tadārabhya kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā | kārtikasnānamasmāddhi dinātsamārabheta vai ||96|| atrāśvine tu pūrṇāyāṃ vrataṃ kojāgarābhidham | sopavāsaṃ prakartavyaṃ tvekabhuktaṃ ca vā caret ||97|| prātarlakṣmīṃ pūjayecca vividhairupacārakaiḥ | śṛṃgārayed bhojayecca madhyāhe’pi prapūjayet || 98|| candrasya darśane sāyaṃ lakṣmīmūrtiṃ tu kānakīm | tāmraje mṛnmaye vāpi ghaṭe pātre nidhāya ca ||99|| ghaṭadīpān sahasraṃ vā śataṃ lakṣaṃ prakāśayet | pūrikāḥ pāyasānnaṃ ca mahālakṣmyai nivedayet || 1.280.100 || jāgaraṃ nṛtyagītaiśca kuryāt prātaḥ prapūjya tām | arpayed gurave mūrtiṃ vrataṃ samāpayed vratī || 10 1|| atra rātrau mahālakṣmīrvarābhayakarāmbujā | yātīkṣituṃ madarthaṃ ko jāgartīti subhuktimān || 1 02|| tasmai vittaṃ prayacchāmi jāgrate pūjakāya me | prativarṣaṃ kṛtenātra smṛddhaḥ syād yāti vaiṣṇavam || 1 03|| kārtikāmātithau lakṣmīpūjā kāryā viśeṣataḥ | lakṣmīścaturbhujā kāryā padmasiṃhāsanasthitā || 104|| dakṣakare ca kamalaṃ vāme’mṛtaghaṭastathā | adho’nyabhujayoḥ kāryau bilvaśaṃkhau suśobhanau || 105|| tatpārśvayorgajau kāryau dhṛtakuṃbhakarāvubhau | tasyāstu mastake padmaṃ kartavyaṃ sumanoharam || 106|| maṇḍape nirmite ramye kadalīstabhatoraṇaiḥ | pūjayet sarvatobhadre lakṣmīsūktena tāṃ vratī || 107|| alakārām̐śca vāsāṃsi mahāntyevārpayecchriyai | bhāle’syāścandrakaṃ kuryāt kuṃkumākṣataśobhanam || 1 08|| sugandhapuṣpahāraiśca sauvarṇaiḥ sarvabhūṣaṇaiḥ | kamalaiḥ pūjayed ratnairdhūpadīpadravādibhiḥ || 109|| paritaḥ kārayecchaktyā dīpānāmāvalīstathā | naivedye śaṣkulīrdadyācchatacchidrāṇi pheṇikāḥ || 1.280.11 0|| ghṛtapūrām̐śca revālīḥ pītasārāṇi pūrikāḥ | parpikāḥ piṇḍakām̐ścāpi śākarām̐ścaṇakādikān || 11 1|| odanādīni bhojyāni śākānyasyai nivedayet | tāmbūlavīṭikāṃ datvā kuryānnīrājanaṃ mahat || 1 12|| lakṣmīpūjanapadyāni gāpayettu vratī tataḥ | dīpān prapūjayet sarvasthalīrdīpaiḥ prakāśayet ||1 1 3|| śāradāpūjanaṃ kuryādāyavyayādicarpaṭe | śāradāyāstu sauvarṇīṃ mūrtiṃ vā kārayed vratī || 1 14|| nāgavallīdalapūgīphalailāśarkarātvacaḥ | phalānyakṣatakuṃkumagūḍadhānādikāni ca || 1 15|| dhūpadīpasunaivedyairmaṣīlekhanikādibhiḥ | pūjayecchāradāṃ mantrairnīrājayed visarjayet || 1 16|| evaṃ vratakṛto lakṣmīḥ śāradā ca sthirā sadā | sarvasampatkarī syādvai dānabhojanakāmadāḥ || 1 17|| atraivābhyaṃgasaṃsnānaṃ tailādyairmardanena vai | kartavyaṃ vratinā yena dāridryaṃ naśyati dhruvam || 1 18|| kārtikaśuklapūrṇāyāṃ devadīpotsavo mataḥ | dīpānprajvālayettīrthe mandire bhavanādiṣu || 1 19|| lakṣmīkāntaṃ prabhākantaṃ dhārayenmukuṭādikam | saṃyāvapūrikābhaktakvathikāsūpasūraṇān || 1.280.120|| vṛntākādikaśākāni śrīkṛṣṇāya nivedayet | visarjayecca vidhivat svargaṃ mokṣaṃ vrajed vratī || 121 || tripurī pūrṇimā ceyaṃ tripurāriṃ prapūjayet | bhojayed vividhānnāni visarjayet sukhī vratī || 122||| cāturmāsyasamāptiśca kartavyā sotsavā janaiḥ | mantavyā cāpi manvāditithiḥ prapūjayenmanum || 123|| bhaktidevījayantī ca pālanīyātra sarvathā | bhaktervidhūdaye kāryā pūjā samyagvidhānataḥ || 124|| bhojayetsamalaṃkuryācchrāṃgārikavibhūṣaṇaiḥ | nīrājayed vratī visarjayet syāddhāmavāsakṛt || 125| kārtikyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ tu kuryāt skandasya darśanam | utsavastatra kartavyaḥ sarvaśatrujayāya vai || 1 26||| atraiva dīpadānena kartavyastripurotsavaḥ | kīṭāḥ pataṃgā maśakā vṛkṣā vallyaśca janminaḥ || 127|| dīpadarśanamātreṇa yānti vai paramāṃ gatim | kṛttikāḥ ṣaṭ kārtikeyaḥ khaḍgī vahnirjalādhipaḥ || 128|| gandhapuṣpaphalairdhūpadīpanaivedyapānakaiḥ | pūjanīyāḥ pradeyāśca dīpā bāhye gṛhātsthale || 129|| dīpopānte tathā gartaścaturasro manoharaḥ | caturdaśāṃgulaḥ kāryaḥ secyaścandanavāribhiḥ || 1.280.130|| gavāṃ kṣīreṇa saṃpūrya matsyaṃ haimaṃ kṣipettataḥ | namaskṛtya ca gandhādyaiḥ sampūjya brāhmaṇāya vai || 13 1|| arpayed vidhinā tena modate harisannidhau | kṣīrasāgaradānaṃ vai hyetadeva prakīrtitam || 132|| atra tithau vṛṣotsarge kṛtvā kailāsamāpnuyāt | mārgaśīrṣāmādine tu śrāddhaṃ kuryācca tarpaṇam || 133|| tṛptāśca pitaro yānti paraṃ bhāgavataṃ padam | mārgaśīrṣyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ svarṇāḍhyaṃ lavaṇāḍhakam || 134|| dāne deyaṃ tvanāthāya sarvakāmasamṛddhaye | pauṣasya pūrṇimāyāṃ tu snāyāt sarvauṣadhijalaiḥ || 1 35|| idaṃ jagat purā lakṣmi tvayāsīt tyaktameva ha | punarlakṣmīvidhānārthaṃ viṣṇurindro bṛhaspatiḥ || 136|| śukraḥ somaśca saṃbhūya cakruḥ puṣye prayatnakam | alaṃkṛtaṃ punaścakruḥ saubhāgyotsavakelibhiḥ || 1 37|| svasvaguṇapratāpaiśca sarvasaubhāgyavṛddhaye | ato vratī tathā kuryāt pūjayet tān yathāvidhi || 1 38|| gaurasarṣapakalkena tūpamṛdya tanuṃ svakām | sarvauṣadhijalaiḥ snāyād dhārayecca navāmbare || 1 39|| dṛṣṭvā tu maṃgalaṃ dravyaṃ natvā spṛṣṭvā tato vratī | hariśakrendupuṣyejyān pūjayedupacārakaiḥ || 1.280.140|| kṛtvā homaṃ bhojayecca grahān bālān supāyasaiḥ | devān visarjayet paścād vratī bhuṃjīta pāraṇām || 141|| alakṣmīnāśanaṃ lakṣmīpradaṃ vai mokṣadaṃ vratam | pūrṇimāyāṃ tathā cātra raivatādrau purābhavat || 142|| ambājanma tato gauryāḥ pūjanaṃ tatra kārayet | māghasnānasamāraṃbhaścāsmād dinād bhavatyapi || 143 || atraiva holikādaṇḍāropaṇaṃ kāryamityapi | ratnāni kañcukoṣṇīṣapādatrāṇāni vā dhanam || 144|| datvā pramodate svarge tilān kārpāsakambalān | samarcya śaṃkaraṃ cātra vājimedhaphalaṃ vrajet || 145|| phālgunāmātithau dugdhavratāraṃbho bhavatyapi | bodhyaiṣā dvāparayugādyā tithirmaṃgalāvahā || 146 || phālgune pūrṇimāyāṃ tu holikāpūjanaṃ matam | kāṣṭhādisaṃcaye vahniṃ hutvā rakṣoghnamantrakaiḥ || 147|| asṛkyābhayasantrastaiḥ kṛtā tvaṃ holi bāliśaiḥ | atastvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi bhūte bhūtipradā bhava || 148|| itimantreṇa sandīpya parikramya nayed vratī | holikāṃ rākṣasīṃ cemāṃ prahlādabhayadāyinīm || 149|| jvālayanti janā yadvat prahlādena subhasmitā | saṃvatsarasya dāho’yaṃ pāpānāmiti holikā || 1.280.150|| śaṃkareṇa kṛtaḥ kāmadāho’yaṃ holikā matā | kalpabhedena dāhasya bhidyate tu kathānakam || 151|| dolotsavastathā cātra pūrṇāyāṃ vottare’hani | uttarāphālgunīnakṣatrayoge raivatācale || 152|| dolāmāropya kṛṣṇaṃ cārjunaṃ dharmāśraye purā | āndolayāmāsuratra devāḥ kāryaḥ sa utsavaḥ || 153|| prātaḥ pūjāṃ prakurvīta naranārāyaṇaprabhoḥ | upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirmahānīrājanena ca || 154|| vastracandanapuṣpādyaistulasīpatrabhūṣaṇaiḥ | pāyasaiḥ pūrikābhiśca badarādiphalairapi || 155|| vāsantikaiśca puṣpādyaistathā raṃgagulālakaiḥ | pūjayedbhojayeccāpi nīrājayecca raṃjayet || 156|| krīḍāṃ ca kārayed yantraistataḥ prasvāpayet prabhum | bhaktān bālān bhojayitvā vratī bhuñjīta vai tataḥ || 157|| evamabhyaṃgakasnānamāmrakusumaprāśanam | vasantotsavaramaṇaṃ dhūlivandanamityapi || 158|| manvādyatithikaṃ kuryād vrataṃ vistarato vratī | naranārāyaṇaṃ prātaḥ prabodhya pūjayed vratī || 159|| bahūni dadyād dānāni vrataṃ cāpi samāpayet | dārāḥ putrān dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ svargaṃ yāyācca mokṣaṇam || 1.280.160|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikapūrṇimāmāvāsyāvrateṣu śrāddhābhāvāsyāmanvāditithihanumajjayantīvaiśākhasnānāraṃbhakūrmajayantīdharmarājavratabhāvukāmāvaṭasāvitrībilvatrirātravratajyeṣṭhābhiṣekayātrāguruvyāsapūjāgopadmakokilāvratacāturmāsyaniyamaśivaśayanadīpapūjānārikelapūrṇimā ṛgyajuḥśrāvaṇīsāmagaśrāvaṇīrakṣābandhanahayagrīvajayantīśivapavitrāropaṇakuśagrahaṇaprauṣṭhapadyumāmaheśavrataśakravratasarvapitṛśrāddhāmārāsalīlākārtikasnānaśaradvratakojāgaravratalakṣmīpūjādīpotsavaśāradāpūjābhyaṃgasnānadevadīpotsavatripurīpūrṇimābhaktijayantīskadadarśanamāghasnānāmbājayantīholidaṇḍāropaṇadvāparāditithipayovratadolotsavavasantotsavāmrakusumaprāśanadhūlivandanādinirūpaṇanāmāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 280 ||
<1.281> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha dvādaśamāseṣu yānyanyāni vratāni ca | kartavyānyapi te vakṣye śṛṇu puṇyāni padmaje || 1 || caitramāsasya śuklāyāmekādaśyāṃ tu vaiṣṇavaiḥ | āndolanīyo bhagavān lakṣmīyukto mahotsavaiḥ || 2 || sugandhipuṣpamayyāṃ tu tasyāṃ ta ghaṭikādvayam | āndolayitvā nīrājayitvā cottārayetprabhum || 3 || bhojayecca vratī natvā taṃ kṣamāpya visarjayet | āṣāḍhe śuklake puṣye rathayātrāṃ samācaret || 4 || sāśvaṃ rathaṃ sthāpayecca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāgrataḥ | vāsāṃsi rājayogyāni dhārayed bhūṣaṇāni ca || 5 || śreṣṭhān haimān śastravaryān khaḍgādīn dhārayetprabhum | dadhi bhaktaṃ laḍḍukām̐śca bhojayitvā rathe’rcayet || 6 || hariṃ nīrājayitvā ca caturvāraṃ punaḥ punaḥ | uttārayed rathāt tatra gāpayet kīrtanāni vai || 7 || tataśca bhojanaṃ kuryād vratī mokṣapradaṃ vratam | āṣāḍhakṛṣṇadvitīyādinādārabhya māsikaḥ || 8 || śrāvaṇakṛṣṇatṛtīyāvadhiṃ dolotsavo mataḥ | vṛṣarāśeścandrabale kuryād dolāṃ svalaṃkṛtām || 9 || nityaṃ navīnavastvādyairnavīnāṃ śrīhareḥ priyām | sāyāhne pratyahaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nidhārayet || 1.281.10 || nīrājayitvā naivedyaṃ samarpyāndolayed vratī | dolāpadyāni ramyāṇi gāpayennṛtyamācaret || 1 1|| nabhaḥkṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ prapūjyottārayeddharim | śrāvaṇaḥ sarvathā māso vrataiśca niyamairyamaiḥ || 1 2|| yāpanīyo viśeṣeṇa bhuktiṃ muktiṃ samicchatā | kārtiko’pi tathā neyo vratadānajapādibhiḥ || 1 3|| mārgaśīrṣe dhanūrāśau dhanurlagne ravau gate | vidhāyābhyaṃgamuṣṇena snapayedvāriṇā harim || 14|| dhārayitvā suvāsāṃsi tadagre’gniṣṭikāmapi | nidhāya naityakaṃ kuryācchṛṅgāraṃ saśriyaḥ prabhoḥ || 15|| naivedye modakān dadyānnavanītaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhi | roṭakaṃ taralāṃ bharjitaṃ vṛntākaṃ samarpayet || 16 || kvathikāṃ pāyayet kṛṣṇamadhyayanāya yojayet | evaṃ vai māsaparyantaṃ śikṣārthaṃ tūtsavaṃ caret || 17|| pauṣamāse makare ca yadā sūryāyanaṃ bhavet | catvāriṃśaddhaṭikā vai puṇyakālo viśeṣataḥ || 18|| dānasnānārcanādyaṃ tu kartavyaṃ tilalaḍḍukāḥ | miṣṭānnāni ca deyāni hyanāthebhyo viśeṣataḥ || 19|| gavāṃ grāsādi deyaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ puṇyapradaṃ tathā | māghamāse tu pañcamyāṃ vasantotsavamuttamam ||1.281.20|| tata ārabhya nityaṃ ca holikāvadhikaṃ sadā | kuṃkumaraṃgagulālārpaṇapūjanabhojanaiḥ ||2 1|| prakuryāt śvetavāsāṃsi hariṃ navāni dhārayet | raṃgān lakṣmīharikṛṣṇavāsassu prakṣiped vratī ||22|| gulālaṃ sthalapadmāmbu nikṣipecca punaḥ punaḥ | śekharaṃ tvāmrapuṣpāṇāṃ dhārayed bhojayeddharim ||23|| kaisarāṇyaṃśukāni śrīkṛṣṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ ca dhārayet holikāntāṃ ca vāsantīṃ krīḍāṃ gāyettu phālgunīm ||24|| athāvirbhāvadivasād yāvatṣaṭdivasāvadhim | pālane rohayet kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamapi vratī ||25|| pāyayet taṃ tu dugdhādi hyāndolayetsagītikam | sevayed bālabhāvena muhurnāthaṃ prasādayet ||26|| vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīyādinācchrīkṛṣṇamūrtaye | kesarāktaiścandanādyairlepanaṃ māsikaṃ caret ||27|| sūryacandragrahāhassu kuryātsnānajapādikam | āṣāḍhaśuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu kausuṃbhāmbaramarpayet ||28|| haraye sūkṣmasusnigdhatantujaṃ komalaṃ śubham | āśvinakṛṣṇapakṣe tu śrāddhaiḥ saṃtarpayet pitṝn ||29||| āśvine śuklapakṣe tu mūlenāvāhayet tathā | pūjayedbhojayeddugdhapākādyaṃ tu sarasvatīm ||1.281.3 0|| visarjayecchravaṇena vidvān bhavati vai vratī | svajanmadivasaḥ sarvairvardhanīyaḥ samutsavaiḥ ||3 1|| dānabhojanavṛddhābhivandanairdevadarśanaiḥ | ekādaśīto dvādaśyo mokṣadā harivāsarāḥ |||32|| kartavyā bhojanaidānaiḥ pūjanotsavatarpaṇaiḥ | prasīdati hariryaistu prayacchatyabhayaṃ padam ||33|| yena kenāpyupāyena prasanno yasya vai hariḥ | ihāmutra sukhaṃ tasya puṇyavṛddhirvrataṃ bhavet ||34|| dvādaśyāṃ mārgaśuklasya pūjayejjalaśāyinam | upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśakaiḥ pauṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet ||35|| dvādaśyāṃ pauṣaśuklasya pūjayet prayato harim | upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśakairagniṣṭomaphalaṃ laset ||36|| māghadhavaladvādaśyāṃ pūjayenmādhavaṃ prabhum | ṣoḍaśādyairupacārairvājapeyaphalaṃ vrajet ||37|| phālgunaśukladvādaśyāṃ govindaṃ pūjayejjanaḥ | vastuṣoḍaśakaiḥ śreṣṭhairgomedhasya phalaṃ jayet ||38|| caitradhavaladvādaśyāṃ viṣṇuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ samarcayet | ṣoḍaśādyupacārairvai syādagniṣṭomapuṇyabhāg ||39|| vaiśākhaśukladvādaśyāṃ pūjayenmadhumūdanam | ṣoḍaśottamasāmagryā tvaśvamedhaphalaṃ bhavet ||1.281.40 || jyeṣṭhadhavaladvādaśyāṃ pūjayedvai trivikramam | ṣaṭdaśabhistūpacārairnaramedhaphalaṃ bhavet ||41 || āṣāḍhaśukladvādaśyāṃ vāmanaṃ pūjayed vratī | ṣoḍaśākhyopacāraiśca śatāgniṣṭomapuṇyabhāg ||42|| śrāvaṇaśukladvādaśyāṃ śrīdharaṃ pūjayed vratī | ṣoḍaśāmitavastvādyairvājimedhasahasrabhāk ||43|| bhādradhavaladvādaśyāṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ prapūjayet | ṣoḍaśābhyupacāraiśca brahmamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||44|| āśvinaśukladvādaśyāṃ padmanābhaṃ prapūjayet | ṣoḍaśābhyupacārādyairīśamedhasahasrabhāk ||45|| kārtikaśukladvādaśyāṃ dāmodaraṃ prapūjayet | ṣoḍaśābhyupacārādyairdvyaśvamedhasahasrabhāk ||46|| homo japastapo dānaṃ sādhuviprādibhojanam | dakṣiṇāprārthanājāgaraṇānītyācared vrate ||47|| alpaparikarasyālpaṃ viśālasya mahat phalam | bhaktiyukte vrate jāte phalaṃ prāpyeta mokṣaṇam ||48|| vrataṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā kuryādudyāpanaṃ vratī | prātaḥ snātvāmbare śuddhe dhṛtvā bhāle supuṇḍravān ||49|| maṇḍapaṃ kārayed bhavyaṃ viśālaṃ caturasrakam | ghaṇṭācāmarakalaśādarśakiṃkiṇikāyutam ||1.281.50|| puṣpamālyadhvajatoraṇavitānāmbarāñcitam | dīpamālācaturdvārakomalāstaraṇānvitam ||51|| tanmadhye sarvatobhadraṃ kuryāddhānyādyalaṃkṛtam | tasyopari nyaset kuṃbhān dvādaśāmbuprapūritān ||52|| śuklāmbaraiśchāditām̐śca pañcaratnasamanvitān | tatra saṃsthāpayet haimīṃ rājatīṃ tāmrajāṃ ca vā ||53|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇamūrtiṃ tilapātre ghaṭopari | athāvāhanamārabhya pūjāṃgāni samārabhet ||54|| pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayecca bhūṣāvastrāṇi dāpayet | sugandhacandanādīni prāpayet dhūpadīpakān ||55|| śrāṃgārikadravān dadyānnīrājayecca bhojayet | pānaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ dadyāt prasvāpayet kṣamāpayet ||56|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt prātarhomaṃ samācaret | pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ vaisarjanaṃ devasya cārpaṇam |||57|| pāraṇāṃ ca svayaṃ kuryād vrataṃ samāpayed vratī | pratimāṃ dakṣiṇāyuktāmācāryāya samarpayet ||58|| evamudyāpanakartā vratakartātra bhogavān | trisaptakulasaṃyukto yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ||59|| ya idaṃ śṛṇuyāllakṣmi vratākhyānaṃ ca vācayet | sarvavrataphalaṃ labdhvā tvante yāyāddhareḥ padam ||1.281.60|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikaprakīrṇakavrateṣu dolāvratarathayātrādolotsavaśrāvaṇakārtikadhanurmāsamakarasaṃkrāntivasantotsavapālanārohaṇaholikāpuṣpadolakaisaracandanāmbaraśrāddhasarasvatyutsavadvādaśīvrataphalodyāpanaprabhṛtinirūpaṇanāmaikāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||28 1 ||
<1.282> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi lakṣmīnārāyaṇavratam | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ yāvadduḥkhanibarhaṇam || 1 || brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā | samastakāmaphaladaṃ sarvavrataphalapradam || 2 || duḥsvapnanāśakaṃ dharmyaṃ duṣṭagrahanivārakam | yena cīrṇena pāpānāṃ koṭirāśiḥ praśāmyati || 3 || mārgaśīrṣapūrṇimāyāṃ snātvā brāhme muhūrtake | śuddhavastradharaḥ śuddhāsanastvācamya vāgyataḥ || 4 || smarannārāyaṇaṃ nityaṃ kṛtvā devārcanaṃ tataḥ | deśakālādisaṃkalpya lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 5 || āvāhayetpūjayeccāsanādyarpaṇamācaret | pañcāmṛtādibhiḥ snapayitvā śṛgāramarpayet || 6 || gandhacandanapuṣpādimālādhūpapradīpanaiḥ | śṛgārairbhojanaiḥ peyaiḥ phalaistāmbūlagāyanaiḥ || 7 || nṛtyastavanabhajanaiḥ kṣamāyācanakaistathā | toṣayitvā purastasya sthaṇḍile caturasrake || 8 || aratnimātraṃ tvanalaṃ sthāpayettu vidhānataḥ | ājyabhāgāntaparyantaṃ kṛtvā puruṣasūktataḥ || 9 || varuṇā ca tilaiḥ puṣpairvṛtena juhuyāt phalaiḥ | rasaiścānyahaviṣyānnairjuhuyādvai yathābalam || 1.282.10 || pāpanāśāya śuddhyādiprāyaścittaṃ samācaret | homaṃ samāpya ca japecchāntisūktaṃ tataḥ punaḥ || 1 1|| pūjayecchrīhariṃ samprārthayed vrataprapūrtaye | nirāhāraśca pūrṇāyāṃ pāraṇākṛtpare’hani || 1 2|| vartiṣye iti saṃkalpya dadyādardhyaṃ tadendave | gṛhāṇārghyaṃ śuklapuṣpākṣatādyukta kṣapākara || 13||| namaḥ śuklāṃśave tubhyaṃ lakṣmībhrātre namo namaḥ | kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ rātrau kathākīrtananartanaiḥ || 14|| prātaḥ sampūjayet kṛṣṇaṃ brāhmaṇān bhojayet sataḥ | dānādidakṣiṇā dadyād bālān sādhvī prabhojayet || 15|| svayaṃ bhṛtyādibhiḥ sārdha kuryādvai pāraṇāṃ vratī | evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā kārtikīpūrṇimādine || 16|| udyāpanaṃ mahat kuryān maṇḍapaṃ kārayecchubham | maṇḍale sarvatobhadre ghaṭe ratnadalānvite || 17|| tilasthālyāṃ pūjayecchrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | āvāhanādikaṃ kuryāt pañcāmṛtādināplavam || 18|| gandhabhūṣāmbarairmālādhūpadīpādinārcanam | bhakṣyabhojyādinaivedyaṃ miṣṭaśītalavāri ca || 1 9|| samarpayecca tāmbūlaṃ phalādyarpaṇamityapi | jāgaraṃ nṛtyagānādi tathā nīrājanādikam || 1.282.20 || kṛtvā prasvāpayet kṛṣṇaṃ punaḥ prātaḥ samarcayet | ācāryāya dadenmūrti dakṣiṇāṃ bhojayed dvijān |||2 1|| kuryāt tilādibhiścāgnau homaṃ dānāni cārpayet | bhojayet sādhusādhvyādīn tilādyarpaṇamācaret || 22|| evaṃ kṛtvā vratī samyak lakṣmīnārāyaṇavratam | iha bhuktvā putrapautrakuṭumbasahitaḥ sukham || 23|| bhogāṃśca vividhām̐ścānte yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam | yogināṃ durlabhaṃ sarvaṃ prāpnoti śrīharīkṣaṇāt ||24|| śṛṇu lakṣmi dhvajāropavrataṃ te’tra vadāmi yat | rājyadaṃ jayadaṃ viṣṇuprītikārakamuttamam ||241 || devasya śrīhareryadvā tadvibhūteśca mandire | dhvajadānaṃ prakuryādyaḥ sa syātpūjyo dyuvāsinām || 26|| hemabhārasahasrasya dānajaṃ phalamāpnuyāt | gaṃgāsnānasamaṃ puṇyaṃ śivārcanasamaṃ phalam ||27|| tulasyarcāsamaṃ puṇyaṃ dhvajāropaṇato bhavet | aho’pūrvamaho’pūrvamaho’pūrvamidaṃ vratam || 28|| sarvapāpaharaṃ sarvapuṇyadaṃ dhvajaropaṇam | kārtike vānyamāse vā daśamyāṃ sitapakṣake |||29|| snātvā svanaityikī pūjāṃ kṛtvaikāśī bhaved vratī | bhuvi svapenniśi smarennārāyaṇaṃ prage punaḥ ||1.282.3 0|| ekādaśyāṃ ca vidhinā snātvā dhyātvā hariṃ tataḥ | śrīviṣṇoḥ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā bhojanādisamanvitam ||3 1 || atha vipraiścaturbhiśca svastivācanamarthayet | nāndīśrāddhaṃ prakurvīta dhvajastaṃbhau samānayet || 32|| vastrayutau ca tau kṛtvā gāyatryā prokṣayecca tau | sūryaṃ candraṃ vidhātāraṃ dhātāraṃ garuḍaṃ tathā ||3 3 || dhbajadaṇḍau pūjayecca śuklapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ | kuṃkumacandanagandhairharidrāśarkarādibhiḥ ||34|| tato gocarmamātraṃ tu sthaṇḍilaṃ copalipya ca | ādhāyāgniṃ vedamantrairājyabhāgādikaṃ tathā || 35 || juhuyātpāyasaṃ dhānyaṃ sājyamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena viṣṇornāmabhirityapi || 36 || irāvatīmanuvākamuccārya juhuyād vratī | tataśca vainateyāya svāhetyaṣṭāhutīḥ punaḥ ||37|| somo dhenumudutyaṃ ca juhuyācca tataḥ punaḥ | sauramantrājjapecchāntisūktāni ca vadettadā || 38|| nirjalaṃ tu vrataṃ kṛtvā rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret | dvādaśyāṃ prātarutthāya snātvābhyarcya hariṃ punaḥ || 39 || maṃgalavādyagītyādyaiḥ sūktapāṭhastavādibhiḥ | dhvajaṃ nayeddhareḥ sthānaṃ namaḥ kuryācca vai punaḥ ||1.282.40 || devasya dvāradeśe vā śikhare staṃbhasaṃyutam | saṃsthāpayed dhvajaṃ samyak sthiraṃ nīrājayeddṛḍham || 41 || nārikelaphalaṃ tatra kṣipet sāraṃ prasādakam | dadyātsarvebhya evātha viṣṇuṃ śṛṃgārayettadā ||42 || gandhapuṣpākṣatairdevaṃ dhūpadīpasugandhibhiḥ | bhakṣyabhojyādimiṣṭaiḥ sannaivedyaiśca hariṃ yajet ||43 || tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā vratī kṣamāpayetprabhum | yatra yatra hare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa dhvajasya te ||44|| śikharasya ca chāyāyā gatistatra ca tatra ca | duḥkhadāridryadoṣāṇāṃ vināśaḥ sarvadā bhavet ||45|| putrapautrādivistāro dhanadhānyādisampadaḥ | ārogyotsāhabhūtyādi vṛddhiṃ yāntūttarottaram || 46|| dhvajaḥ sarvopari te’sti māmapi tattathā kuru | dhvajapucchaṃ tu vijñānaṃ dhvajaḥ saccitsukhātmakaḥ | 47|| vaṃśāgraṃ brahmasadanaṃ vaṃśaḥ panthā samarciṣaḥ | staṃbhāgraṃ satyasadanaṃ paṭṭikā surabhūmikā ||48 || ghaṇṭikā jyotiṣāṃ cakraṃ staṃbho dharmaḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ | staṃbhamūlaṃ pūruṣārthāstvadātmastaṃbhine namaḥ ||49 || yamāmananti vai santa saccidānandavigraham | salakṣmīkaṃ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhaje’nvaham |||1.282.5 0 || itistutvā named viṣṇumācāryaṃ sadguruṃ dvijān | pūjayedbhojayeddadyād dakṣiṇāṃ pāraṇāṃ caret ||5 1 || paṭo dhvajasya kamale yāvaccalati vāyunā | tāvanti pāpajālāni naśyantyeva dhvajārpiṇaḥ ||52|| yāvaddināni santiṣṭhed dhvajau vai devatāgrahe | tāvadyugasahasrāṇi hareḥ sārūpyamaśnute ||53 || āropitaṃ dhvajaṃ dṛṣṭvā ye’bhinandanti harṣitāḥ | teṣāṃ pāpāni naśyanti vajralepasamānyapi ||54|| dhvajo dhunvanpaṭaṃ dhunotyarpiṇastvaghasaṃcayān | dhvajāropakaro yāti vimānena divaṃ param ||55|| purā kṛtayuge tvāsīt sumatiḥ somavaṃśajaḥ | nṛpo irikathārakto rājñī satyamatistathā |||56 || tāvubhau dampatī nityaṃ hareḥ pūjāparāyaṇau | jātismarau jalānnadau dharmakāryāṇi tenatuḥ ||57|| ropayati dhvajaṃ rājā dvādaśīdvādaśīdine | tasya kīrtiṃ jagurdevāḥ śrutvā vibhāṇḍako yayau ||58|| kṛtātithyaṃ muniṃ rājā prāñjaliḥ samuvāca ha | bhagavan kṛtakṛtyo’smi bhavadabhyāgamena vai ||59|| satāmāgamanaṃ sarvasaukhyārthaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ bhavet | yatra satāṃ paraṃ prema tatra syuḥ sarvasampadaḥ ||1.282.60 || tejaḥ kīrtirdhanaṃ dhānyaṃ putrā vṛddhiṃ prayānti ca | śreyāṃsyanudinaṃ tatra yatra syādvai satāṃ kṛpā ||6 1|| yo mūrdhni dhārayed bhāvāt mahatpādajalaṃ rajaḥ | saḥ snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu yajñāvabhṛthakeṣu ca ||62||| mama dārāśca putrāśca sampat tvayi samarpitāḥ | māmājñāpaya śīghraṃ kiṃ supriyaṃ karavāṇi te ||63|| śratvā kareṇa rājñaśca spṛṣṭvā śiro vibhāṇḍakaḥ | prasannaḥ saṃstadā prāha rājan yaduktavān bhavān ||64|| sarvaṃ kulocitaṃ te’sti bahuśreyāṃsyavāpnuhi | dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca mokṣaśceti catuṣṭayam ||65|| mahatāṃ sevayā prāṇī labhate śāśvataṃ sukham | svasti te satataṃ bhūyād yatpṛcchāmi taducyatām ||66|| pūjā bahuvidhāḥ kṛṣṇatuṣṭidāḥ santi tāsu vai | dhvajāropaṃ pradhānaṃ tvaṃ matvā karoṣi taṃ katham ||67|| bhāryāpi te sadā nṛtyaparā tatra kathaṃ vada | śrutvā rājā tu taṃ prāhāścaryakāri purābhavam ||68|| ahamāsaṃ purā śūdro mālinīnāmako hyaghī | madyamāṃsavyabhicāracauryādikārako’ghṛṇī ||69|| hatyākṛt matprajābandhuparityakto vanaṃ gataḥ | jīrṇaṃ devālayaṃ viṣṇorāśrayaṃ samupeyivān ||1.282.70|| phalamūlāśano nityaṃ varṣāṇāṃ viṃśatiḥ sthitaḥ | jīrṇasphuṭitasandhānaṃ tasya sarvamakāriṣam ||7 1|| svanivāsāya sā bhūmirmayā liptā susaṃskṛtā | vṛkṣāścāropitāstatra cābhisiktāḥ sarojalaiḥ ||72|| sandhāya jīrṇavastrāṇi dhvajaścāropito mayā | śalākārpaṇakāṇḍaiśca viṣṇubhittiḥ surakṣitā ||73|| iyaṃ niṣādo nāmnā tu kokilā bandhutarjitā | vindhyādrerdārukasutā tvāyātā daivayogataḥ ||74|| puṃścalīyaṃ mayā prāptā patnītvenābhirakṣitā | devasevāṃ prakurvantau dampatībhāvamāśritau ||75|| sthitau varṣāṇi daśa caikadā rātrau parasparam | madyapānena mattau ca muditau māṃsabhojanāt ||76|| tanuvastrāparijñānau nṛtyaṃ cakṛva mohitau | prārabdhakarmabhogāntamāvāṃ yugapadāsthitau ||77|| netumāvāṃ tadāyātā yamadūtā bhayaṃkarāḥ | tadā svasevakau matvā viṣṇurdevālayasthitaḥ ||78|| svadūtānpreṣayāmāsa śaṃkhacakragadādharān | te tūcurbho durācārā yāmyā muñcadhvamarcinau ||79|| pūjakau mama bhaktau vai madāśritau vanasthitau | śrutvocustām̐stadā yāmyā imau vai pāpinau parau ||1.282.80 || yamena pāpino daṇḍyāstanneṣyāmo vayaṃ tvimau | śrutvocurvaiṣṇavāstām̐śca pāpāgrahaṃ prakurvataḥ ||8 1 || etau pāpavinirmuktau hareḥ śuśrūṣaṇe ratau | hariṇā trāyamāṇau tu muñcadhvamavilambitam ||82|| eṣā tu nartanaṃ cakre tathaiṣaḥ dhvajaropaṇam | hareḥ saudhāvanaparau svārthe parārthakārakau ||83|| antakāle’pi yannāma śrutvoktvāpi ca vai sakṛt | labhate mokṣaṇaṃ svargaṃ kimu śuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ ||84|| kṛṣṇasevī yatisevī pāpo’pi yāti vaiṣṇavam | muhūrtaṃ vā muhūrtārdhaṃ yastiṣṭheddharimandire ||85|| so’pi yāti brahmalokaṃ kimu dvātriṃśavatsarān | mārjanalepanajīrṇaśīrṇasandhānakārakau ||86|| mandire dīpasalilavṛkṣachāyāvidhāyakau | kathametau mahāpuṇyau yātanābhogayoginau ||87|| ityuktvā saṃprasahyaiva yāmyapāśān nirasya ca | gṛhītvāvāṃ vimānāgrye yayurviṣṇoḥ sukhaṃ padam ||88|| tatra divyān mahābhogān bhuktvā yātau mahīmimām | atrāpi sadhvajaṃ rājyaṃ prāptaṃ sevāprasādataḥ ||89|| anicchayā kṛtenāpi prāptaṃ rājyaṃ mahatphalam | smṛtvā tacca mayā keturanayā nṛtyamarpyate ||1.282.90|| icchayārādhya govindaṃ prāpsyāvaḥ paramāṃ gatim | vivaśe’pi phalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kiṃ punaḥ śraddhayā kṛte ||91|| vibhāṇḍakastu tacchrutvā tau praśasya yayau vanam | iti jānīhi kamale kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ||92|| paricaryā tu sarveṣāṃ cintāmaṇisamā matā | haribhaktiparāṇāṃ hi sarvakāmaprado hariḥ ||93|| idṃ pavitramākhyānaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti paṭhettathā | harisevāparo vaktā te’pi yānti parāṃ gatim || 94|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇavrataṃ tadudyāpanaṃ devālayadhvajāropaṇalepanarakṣaṇādipuṇyaśālinorapi pāpakarmiṇormālinākhyaśūdraśūdryormaraṇe yamadūtāt mocitayoḥ prāptarājyakayoḥ sumatinṛpasatyamatirājñyorvibhāṇḍakaṃ prati vṛttāntakathanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 282 ||
<1.283> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi vikhyātaṃ haripañcakam | nārīnarāṇāṃ sukhadaṃ vrataṃ sarvavratottamam || 1 || mārgaśukladaśamyāṃ tu snātvā devārcanaṃ caret | pañcayajñān vidhāyāpi tvekabhuktaṃ dinaṃ nayet || 2 || ekādaśyāṃ prage snātvā hariṃ pañcāmṛtaistathā | tīrthajalaiḥ snāpayitvārcayed gandhadravādibhiḥ || 3 || āvāhanāt samārabhya visarjanāvadhiṃ kriyām | dhūpadīpasunaivedyatāmbūladakṣiṇānvitām || 4 || pūjātmikāṃ vratī kṛtvā śrīhariṃ prārthayet puraḥ | pañcarātraṃ nirāhāro hyadyaprabhṛti mādhava || 5 || kariṣye haripaṃcākhyaṃ vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ ca me bhavet | ekabhukto daśamyāṃ vai rātrau bhūśayano bhavet || 6 || ekādaśyāṃ triṣavaṇaṃ arcanaṃ trinivedanam | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād gītanṛtyakathānakaiḥ || 7 || dvādaśyāṃ ca trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ trikaṃ caret | paurṇamāsyāmapi snānārcananaivedyamācaret || 8 || paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā rātrau kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ vratī | pañcāmṛtādipūjāṃ tu prakuryāddinapañcasu || 9 || dugdhena snāpayed viṣṇuṃ paurṇāyāmatha ṣaṣṭhake | tilahomaṃ tiladānaṃ pañcagavyāśanaṃ tathā || 1.283.10 || kṛtvā viprān bhojayecca pūjayedvidhivaddharim | sādhusādhvīrbhojayecca svayaṃ bhuñjīta bandhubhiḥ || 11 || evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kāryaṃ pratimāsaṃ vrataṃ śubham | udyāpanaṃ mārgaśīrṣe kāryamaudāryapūrvakam || 12|| śuklapakṣavratasyātra śuklaikādaśikādine | nirāhāro dvādaśyāṃ tu paṃcagavyaṃ grased vratī || 13 | puṣpādibhirhariṃ caivābhyarcya dadyād dvijātaye| pāyasaṃ śarkarāyuktaṃ ghṛtayuktaṃ phalānvitam || 14|| miṣṭānnaśākapatrādyairanvitaṃ prasamarpayet | sugandhajalasadratnadakṣiṇāvastrasaṃyutam || 15|| pūrṇaṃ ca kalaśaṃ dadyādātmavide tu sādhave | sarvasvaṃ gurave dadyād bhojayed bālabālikāḥ || 16|| sādhūn sādhvīrbhojayecca svayaṃ bhuñjīta pāraṇām | etadvrataṃ tu te proktaṃ haripañcakasaṃjñitam || 17|| tatkartuḥ punarāvṛttirbrahmalokānna vai bhavet | gavāṃ koṭisahasrāṇāṃ dānasya phalamāpnuyāt || 18|| paṭhedetacca śṛṇuyād vācayecchrāvayecca vā | tasyāpi vratapuṇyaṃ syād bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheta ca || 19|| athānyatte pravakṣyāmi vrataṃ māsopavāsakam | pārākākhyaṃ mahālakṣmi yattulyaṃ nānyaducyate ||1.283.20|| āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe vāpi bhādre cāśvinake’pi vā | eteṣvanyatame māse śuklasyādyadine priye ||21|| prāśayet paṃcagavyaṃ ca tiṣṭhedviṣṇusamīpataḥ | snātvā dhyātvā prage viṣṇuṃ nityakarma samāpya ca ||22|| viṣṇuṃ samarcya saṃkalpaṃ kuryānmāsopavāsakam | svastivācanamantrām̐śca vācayed brāhmaṇastadā ||23 || prārthayecca vratī devaṃ tvadyaprabhṛti mādhava | māsamekaṃ nirāhāro bhaviṣyābhīṣṭamāvaha ||24|| tataḥ prabhṛti māsāntaṃ nivaseddharimandire | nityaṃ paṃcāmṛtairdevaṃ snāpayed dīpamādadet || 25|| apāmārgaśalākāṃ khādayet snāyāt sa cānvaham | devaṃ samarcayennityaṃ bālān viprām̐śca bhojayet ||26|| evaṃ māsopavāsām̐śca kuryād dvādaśavatsarān | prativarṣaṃ ca godānaṃ viprapitṛpratarpaṇam ||27|| dakṣiṇābharaṇānnāni dadyād dānāni śaktitaḥ | ekamāsopavāsena rājasūyaphalaṃ bhavet ||28|| māsopavāsadvitaye phalaṃ taddviguṇaṃ bhavet | māsopavāsatritaye caturguṇaphalaṃ bhavet || 29|| catuḥkṛtvaḥkṛte puṇyamaṣṭāgniṣṭomajaṃ bhavet | pañcakṛtvaḥkṛte puṇyamatyagniṣṭomajaṃ bhavet ||1.283.3 0 || ṣaṭakṛtvaḥsaṃkṛtaṃ jyotiṣṭomāṣṭakaphalaṃ bhavet | saptakṛtvaḥkṛte vājimedhāṣṭakaphalaṃ bhavet ||3 1|| aṣṭakṛtvaḥkṛte naramedhāṣṭakaphalaṃ bhavet | navakṛtvaḥkṛte puṇya gomedhāṣṭakajaṃ bhavet ||32|| daśakṛtvaḥkṛte brahmamedhāṣṭakaphalaṃ bhavet | ekādaśaparāke tu hareḥ sārūpyamaśnute ||33|| sadvādaśaparāke tu labhenmukticatuṣṭayam | pārākavratakartāro muktā eva na saṃśayaḥ ||34|| nārī vā puruṣo vāpi vratakṛnmokṣamāpnuyāt | vratākhyānaṃ paṭhedvāpi śṛṇuyānmokṣabhāg bhavet ||35|| nāsti gaṃgāsamaṃ tīrthaṃ nāsti mātṛsamo guruḥ | nāsti viṣṇusamo devastapo nānaśanātparam ||36|| nāsti kṣamāsamā mātā nāsti kīrtisamaṃ dhanam | nāsti jñānasamo lābho nāsti dharmasamaḥ pitā ||37|| na vivekasamo bhrātā naikādaśyāḥ samaṃ vratam | nāsti brahmasamaṃ pātraṃ nāsti patnīsamaṃ priyam ||38|| nāsti sādhusamā naukā nāsti pārākavad vratam | dānaṃ homādikaṃ kāryaṃ prāpte puṇye’hani priye ||39|| tṛtīyā mādhave śuklā bhādre kṛṣṇā trayodaśī | kārtike navamī śuddhā māghe pañcadaśī tithiḥ ||1.283.40|| etā yugādyāḥ kathitā dattasyākṣayakārikāḥ | akṣayukchuklanavamī kārtike dvādaśī sitā ||41 || tṛtīyā caitramāsasya tathā bhādrapadasya ca | āṣāḍhaśukladaśamī sitā māghasya saptamī ||42|| śrāvaṇasyāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathāṣāḍhī ca pūrṇimā | phālgunasya tvamāvāsyā pauṣasyaikādaśī sitā ||43|| kārtikī phālgunī caitrī jyaiṣṭhī pañcadaśī sitā | manvādayaḥ samākhyātā dattasyākṣayakārikāḥ ||44|| puṣkarādiṣu tīrtheṣu gaṃgādiṣu saritsu ca | ayodhyāyāṃ mathurāyāṃ māyāyāṃ kāśikābhuvi ||45|| kāñcyāmavantikāyāṃ dvārakāyāṃ dattamakṣayam | atithau vedavidvipre sādhusādhvīsatīṣu ca ||46|| deve devasame puṃsi dattamakṣayapuṇyakṛt | brahmacāriṣu yaddattaṃ bhabedakṣayapuṇyakṛt ||47|| vratinā sarvathā kāryaṃ tapo dānaṃ ca pūjanam | kāraṇīyaṃ bhojanādi sarvaṃ cākṣayapuṇyadam ||48|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne haripañcakavratamāsopavāsavratatadudyāpanayugamanvāditithidānamāhātmyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryaśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||283||
<1.284> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi vāragrahārcanavratam | yatkṛtvā tu grahāḥ sarve tuṣṭā dadati sampadaḥ || 1 || sūryavāre vrataṃ kāryaṃ naktaṃ ca vaikabhojanam | prātaḥ snātvā raviṃ natvā pūjayet sarvavastubhiḥ || 2 || kṛtvā tu kānakaṃ sūryaṃ sāruṇāśvarathasthitam | saṃjñāchāyāyutaṃ divyamālāmaṇivibhūṣitam || 3 || āvāhanādikaṃ kṛtvā pañcāmṛtābhiṣecanam | snapanaṃ vastrabhūṣādidhāraṇaṃ gandhalepanam || 4 || dhūpadīpasunaivedyaphalatāmbūlakārpaṇam | dhyānapradakṣiṇāstotranamanādivisarjanam || 5 || kārayecca tato madhyāhne’pi rātrau tathaiva ha | pūjanaṃ kārayet sarvaṃ sanīrājanabhojanam || 6 || rātrau tu snāpayed devaṃ prātaḥ snātvā prabodhayet | pūjayet kamalaiścārkakaravīrādipuṣpakaiḥ || 7 || jalaṃ punaḥ punardadyādupasthāpanamācaret | dānābhayābjayugalaṃ dhārayantaṃ kare ravim || 8 || kuṇḍalāṃgadakeyūrayutaṃ dhyāyet trayītanum | raktāṃbhojaistilairvāpi juhuyād vidhivadvasau || 9 || uccārayettu sūryāya svāhetyaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | bhūrbhuvaḥ svastatsaviturvareṇyam || 1.284.1 0|| bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt | iti gāyatrikāmantreṇāṣṭottaraśataṃ tathā || 1 1|| juhuyāt svāhāsaṃjñāyaichāyāyai cāpi saṃvadet | bhojayetpūjayedarghyaṃ dadyād bhāskaramūrtaye || 12|| prāṇānāyamya cācamya hastau prakṣālya pūjakaḥ | pātraṃ tāmramayaṃ prasthatoyagrāhi samādadet || 1 3|| kuṃkumaṃ rocanāṃ rājīṃ candanaṃ raktacandanam | karavīraṃ japāśālikuśaśyāmākataṇḍulān || 14|| tilaveṇuyavām̐ścaiva nikṣipet salile śubhe | hastābhyāṃ kalaśaṃ vṛtvā jānubhyāmavanīṃ gataḥ || 15|| āmūrdhni pātramuddhṛtyāmbareṇa varaṇe raveḥ | dṛṣṭiṃ cādhāya manasā dadyārghyaṃ jalāṃjalim ||16|| datvā puṣpāṃjaliṃ cāpi natvā stutvā visarjayet | nityaṃ vā taddine’pyevamarghyaṃ dadyādvivasvate || 17|| tena tuṣṭo dinaśo’smai dadyād vittaṃ yaśaḥ sukham | putrān pautrānabhīṣṭaṃ ca yadyat sarvaṃ prayacchati || 18|| sūryārcanavrataṃ tvetadāyurārogyavardhanam | dhanadhānyapaśukṣemakṣetramitrakalatradam || 19|| tejovīryayaśaḥkīrtividyāvibhavabhogadam | prakuryād vidhinā sūryamaṇḍalāptikaraṃ param ||1.284.20|| sūryamūrtiṃ pradadyāttu gurave dakṣiṇāyutām | bhojayed brāhmaṇān dugdhasāraṃ tathā supolikāḥ ||21 || svayaṃ bhuñjīta ca vratī vratameva samāpayet | atha candradine candravrataṃ kuryād vidhānataḥ ||22|| prātarutthāya saṃsnātvā dugdhapuṣpādi cāharet | sauvarṇaṃ samṛgaṃ somaṃ sapatnīkaṃ prapūjayet ||23|| saptaviṃśatipatnībhiḥ sahitaṃ candrakaṃ vratī | āvāhanāt samārabhya ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ ||24|| pūjayet kumudaiścāpi bhojayed dugdhaśarkarāḥ | rātrau nīrājayet pūrṇātithau candrasya darśane ||25|| prakāntyāsyaṃ sphaṭikābhaṃ nīlālakaṃ sakuṇḍalam | bibhrāṇamiṣṭaṃ kumudaṃ dhyāyenmuktāsrajaṃ vidhum ||26|| svāhā candrāya rohiṇyainakṣatrebhyaśca saṃvadet | juhuyātpāyasenāṣṭottaraśataṃ sasarpiṣā ||27|| sthāpayed rājataṃ pātraṃ pūrayet saurabhaṃ payaḥ | dadyānniśākarāyārghyaṃ sarvābhiṣṭhārthasiddhaye ||28|| nityaṃ vā taddine’tyevamarghyaṃ dadyācca pūjayet | tuṣṭaḥ kumudinīnātho dadyādauṣadhibhojanam ||29|| dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutāḥ putrān saubhāgyaṃ ca dadāti vai | ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kuryād gurave mūrtimarpayet ||1.284.3 0|| bālān saṃbhojayet kṣīraṃ pūrikāśca sato janān | svayaṃ vrataṃ samāpyaiva prabhuṃjīta tu pāraṇām ||3 1|| atha maṃgaladevasya vrataṃ rakṣyaṃ sukhārthinā | ekabhuktena kartavyaṃ sarvakāryasya siddhaye ||32|| prātaḥ snātvā dharāputradine dhyāyecca maṃgalam | meṣasthaṃ raktavastrāṃgaṃ śūlaśaktigadāvarān ||33|| karairbibhrāṇamīśānasvedataṃ bhūsutaṃ smaret | mārgaśīrṣe’tha vaiśākhe vratāraṃbhaḥ kujeḥ dine ||34|| aruṇodayavelāyāṃ bhaumavratamupācaret | sutakāmā dhanakāmā smṛddhikāmā vrataṃ caret ||35|| utthāya ca radān dhāvedapāmārgeṇa vāgyatā | snātvā raktāmbaradharā raktamālavilepanā ||36|| naivedyādikasaṃbhārān raktānsarvānprakalpayet | ācamya deśakālau ca saṃkīrtyātha vratārthinī ||37|| ṣoḍaśādyairupacāraiḥ saṃpūjyārghyaṃ nidhāpayet| dhūpadīpau samarpyātha godhūmānnaṃ nivedayet ||38||| tāmrapātre śuddhatoyapūrite raktacandanam | raktapuṣpākṣataphalānyākṣipyārghyaṃ samarpayet ||39|| bhūmiputra sutārthaṃ tvāṃ prapannārghyaṃ gṛhāṇa me | dehi putraṃ mahīputra gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo’stu te ||1.284.40 || tato rekhātrayaṃ pṛthvyāṃ khādirāṃgārakeṇa vai | kuryācca mārjayed vāmapādena ca vadettadā ||41 || duḥkhadaurbhāgyanāśāya putrasantānahetave | kṛtarekhātrayaṃ vāmapādena mārjayāmyaham ||42|| ṛṇaduḥkhavināśāya mano’bhīṣṭārthasiddhaye | mārjayāmyasitā rekhāstisro janmatrayodbhavāḥ ||43|| dhyātvā ca maṃgalaṃ puṣpāṃjalihastā stuvīta tam | ṛṇahartre namastubhyaṃ nityaṃ saubhāgyado bhava ||44|| yo vakragatimāpanno nṝṇāṃ duḥkhaṃ prayacchati | pūjitaḥ sukhasaubhāgyaprado bhavati te namaḥ ||45|| meṣavāhanaṃ rudrātman dehi putrān dhanaṃ yaśaḥ | stutvā natvā tathā nīrājayitvā puṣpamarpayet ||46|| yathāśakti pradāya svaṃ gṛhṇīyād brāhmaṇāśiṣaḥ | gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt prabhuñjyāt tanniveditam ||47|| evamāvatsaraṃ kuryāt pratimaṃgalavāsaram | tilairhomaṃ prakuryācca svāhā maṃgalamūrtaye ||48|| bhaumamūrtiṃ svarṇamayīṃ maṇḍalasthe ghaṭe sthitām | samabhyarcya japenmantraṃ sutasaubhāgyasiddhaye ||49||| omaṃgārakāya vidmahe śaktihastāya dhīmahi | tanno bhaumaḥ pracodayādityaṣṭottarakaṃ śatam ||1.284.50 || japennametpunaḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā dugdhādi bhojayet | śarkarāṃ ca sumiṣṭānnaṃ godhūmānnaṃ samarpayet ||51|| jalapānaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ samarpayet | visarjayettu vidhinā rātrau vyomni ca taṃ punaḥ ||52||| natvā dhyātvā jalaṃ datvākṣatān puṣpāṇi cārpayet | vratapūrtiṃ phalaṃ prārthya bhuñjyāt svapyāt smaret graham ||53||| evaṃ vratārthinī vātha vratī bhaumasya toṣaṇāt | labhate sutadhānyādi nirvighnaṃ sukhamuttamam ||54|| atha budhe dine vudhavrataṃ kuryātsamāhitaḥ | snātvā mūrtiṃ tu sauvarṇī pūjayettu yathākramam ||55|| āvāhanātsamārabhya puṣpāñjalyantameva tu | kṛtvā pītāmbaraṃ candraputraṃ sābhayapāṇikam ||56|| jānusthavāmahastaṃ ca dhyātvārghyaṃ ca samarpayet | budha cāndra mahāprājña duḥkhaṃ hara sukhaṃ kuru ||57|| athāgnau juhuyātsvāhā budhāyāṣṭottaraṃ śatam | prapūjya bhojayitvā ca kṣamāṃ prārthyāñjaliṃ dadet ||58 || puṣpākṣatairvardhayitvā tatastaṃ tu visarjayet | brāhmaṇān bhojayed vyomni rātrau paśyed budhaṃ vratī ||59|| arghyaṃ kamalapuṣpaiśca datvā samāpayed vratam | bhojayet sādhusādhvīśca svayaṃ bhuñjīta sādaram ||1.284.60 || evaṃ vratakṛto grahapīḍā sarvā nivartate | putrapaśudhanārogyasampadāṃ vardhanaṃ bhavet || 61 || atha gurau prakuryācca gurorvrataṃ samāhitaḥ | snātvā suvarṇajāṃ mūrtiṃ guroḥ samarcayed vratī ||62|| āvāhanātsamārabhya ṣoḍaśābhisuvastubhiḥ | puṣpāṃjalipraparyantaṃ pūjayitvā bṛhaspatim ||63 || dhyāyenyastavāmahastaṃ ratnarāśau ca dakṣiṇāt | kirantaṃ sarvaratnāni svarṇakāntiṃ śubhānanam ||64|| pītapuṣpādyalaṃkārālepāṃśukādipūjitam | sarvavidyānidhiṃ devaguruṃ śāntikaraṃ smaret ||65|| bhojayetpāyasānnaṃ ca namet kṣamāpayettathā | svāhā bṛhaspataye cetyaṣṭottaraśatāhutīn ||66 || daded ghṛtānnapakvānnadugdhasārakalādibhiḥ | viṣarogādipīḍāsu kalahe svajanodbhave ||67|| pippalotthasamidbhiśca juhuyāttannivṛttaye | juhuyāt tridinaṃ cāpi niśāpuṣpairghṛtaplutaiḥ ||68|| śīghraṃ tūpadravaśāntirbhavediti punastataḥ | pūjayecca named rātrau vyomni taddarśanaṃ caret || 69 || dadyādarghyaṃ jalaṃ natvā vidyāṃ ca prārthayed vratī | nīrājayet tataḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyād visarjayet ||1.284.70 || dānaṃ śrīgurave dadyāt samūrtikaṃ sabhojanam | evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ paścād bhuñjīteti sukhī bhavet ||7 1 || atha śukradine śukravrataṃ kuryād vidhānataḥ | snātvā suvarṇajaṃ śukraṃ dhyāyecchuklāmbaraṃ graham ||72|| śuklalepavibhūṣaṃ ca kareṇa dhanadāyakam | vyākhyānamudrā vāmena darśayantaṃ smared vratī ||73 || āvāhanātsamārabhya puṣpāñjalyantamarcayet | bhojayetpūjayetkṣamāpayennamettataḥ param ||74|| śvetapuṣpaiḥ sugandhaiśca juhuyād bhṛguvāsare | aṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ homaṃ ghṛtādibhiśca sañcaret ||75|| nīrājayed gurave tu dadyādarghyaṃ jalaṃ śubham | rātrau vyomni prapaśyecca natvā stutvā visarjayet ||76|| dānaṃ śrīgurave dadyād vrataṃ tasya samāpayet | ratnamaṇyādi labhate vratakṛcca sukhī bhavet ||77|| ekabhuktaṃ ca vā naktaṃ tūpavāsaṃ vrate ca vā | prakuryādvā yathāśakti payaḥpānaṃ phalāśanam ||78|| atha śanaiścare vāre vrataṃ śaneḥ samācaret | snātvā prātarhariṃ natvā hanūmantaṃ ca pannatim ||79|| praṇamecca śanermūrtiṃ tvāyasīṃ paripūjayet | kṛṣṇamāṣānsaptasaṃkhyānpūjāyāmarpayed vratī ||1.284.80 || āvāhanāt samārabhya puṣpāñjalyantamādarāt | sarvaṃ kuryātpradadyācca kṛṣṇapuṣpaṃ sukajjalam ||8 1 || kṛṣṇāmbaravibhūṣāśca kṛṣṇānnasya nivedanam | kṛṣṇatilādihomaṃ ca svāhā śanaiścarāya vai |||82|| aṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ kuryājjapenmantraṃ yathābalam | dhyāyet kṛpāṇahastaṃ taṃ kṛṣṇāmbarottarīyakam ||83|| rathasthaṃ tvāyasavarṇaṃ krūradṛṣṭipravaktrakam | vakragatiṃ prapaśyantaṃ nameddadyājalārghyakam ||84|| kṛṣṇapuṣpakṛṣṇamāṣānvitaṃ śāntiprado bhava | śubhāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ kuru saurya sampatsukhāni vardhaya ||85|| aniṣṭaṃ mā kuru tvarkin saṃjñāputra namo’stu te | yamabhrātargṛhāṇedaṃ kṛśarānnaṃ jalādikam ||86|| iti kṛtvārcanaṃ tasya kṛṣṇadānāni dāpayet | nīrājayennameccāpi vidhinā ca visarjayet ||87|| ekabhuktaṃ ca vā prāyo naktaṃ tvatrācared vratī | dvitīye vāsare prātaḥ prapūjyaiva śaniṃ hṛdā ||88|| bhojayedbālakān kanyā viprān kuryācca pāraṇām | evaṃ samvatsaraṃ kṛtvā śanerduḥkhāni saṃjayet ||89|| prāpnuyāt sukhasampattiṃ sukhaṃ svargasamaṃ labhet | iti vratāni proktāni kimanyacchrotumicchasi ||1.284.90 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sūryasomamaṃgalabudhaguruśukraśanivratānāṃ sāṃganirūpaṇanāmā caturaśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 284||
<1.285> śrīlakṣmīruvāca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa svāminnātha mādhava keśava | pārvatīprabhayornātha lakṣmīmāṇikyayoḥ pate || 1 || śuddhaikādaśakā grāhyā vrate viddhā na vai katham | vada tatkāraṇaṃ padyāpate’mṛtapate hare || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi brāhmaṃ jātaṃ kathānakam | viddhaikādaśikāyāṃ vai prātastiṣṭhati mohinī || 3 || vedhaḥputrī puṇyahantrī tasmād grāhyā na sā vrate | daśamīvedharahitā sadopoṣyā vrate matā || 4 || svargamokṣapradā kṣetrarājyaputrapradāyinī | kalatravittadāhārdaśarīrārogyadāyinī || 5 || kṣaye vāpyathavā vṛddhau samprāpte vā dinodaye | upoṣyā dvādaśī puṇyā pūrvaviddhā vivarjayet||| 6 || pūrvaviddhāṃ prakurvāṇo naro dharmaṃ nikṛntati | santatestu vināśāya sampadāṃ haraṇāya ca || 7 || pūrvaviddhā purā dattā dānavebhyastu sā tithiḥ | pūrvaviddhatithau puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ yātyasureṣvatha || 8 || dattaṃ japtaṃ hutaṃ snātaṃ sevitaṃ pūjanaṃ hareḥ | viddhatithau kṣayaṃ yāti tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā || 9 || āsīd rukmāṃgado rājā sārvabhaumaḥ surāṣṭrake | mahāvaiṣṇavadharmastho harivāsaratatparaḥ || 1.285.1 0|| gaje dhṛtvā paṭahaṃ vādayate harivāsare | bhunakti mānavo yo’dya viṣṇorahani mandadhīḥ || 11 || sa me daṇḍyaśca vadhyaśca nirvāsyo nagarād bahiḥ | pitā vā yadi vā bhrātā putro bhāryā suhṛnmama || 12|| śrīharervāsare bhoktā nigrāhyo dasyuvad bhavet | dadadhvaṃ sātvatebhyaśca majjadhvaṃ tīrthavāriṣu || 13|| mamedaṃ vacanaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭhantu mama rāṣṭrake | etatpraghuṣṭaṃ sammatvā prajā bhajanti keśavam || 14|| gacchadbhiḥ śrīharerdhāmno mārgaḥ saṃkulito janaiḥ | tadrājye tu mṛtā ye ye te yānti harimandiram || 15|| yamamārgaṃ na gacchanti pṛthvīto mānavāstadā | śūnyāstu nirayā jātāḥ pāpiprāṇivivarjitāḥ || 16|| bhagno yāmyo’bhavanmārgo dvādaśādityatāpitaḥ | sarve vai garuḍārūḍhā janā yānti hareḥ padam || 17|| lekhyakarmavinivṛttaścitragupto’pyathābhavat | mānavā bhajanātpūrvakarmāṇyapi vidhūya vai || 18|| prayānti vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma carpaṭā vyarthatāṃ gatāḥ | devānāmapi nākādyāste śūnyā hyabhavam̐stadā || 19|| śūnye triviṣṭape jāte śūnye ca narake tathā | nārado dharmarājaṃ saṃgatvā tvidamuvāca ha ||1.285.20|| kathaṃ śūnyaṃ yamakṣetraṃ na cāyānti janāstviha | citragupto’pi nivṛttaḥ likhatyeva na vai kṛtim ||21|| māyādaṃbhasamākrāntā duṣṭakarmaratā api | kathaṃ nātra samāyānti kāraṇaṃ tvatra me vada ||22|| yamo dainyānvitaḥ prāha pṛthvyāṃ rukmāṃgado nṛpaḥ | sārvabhaumaḥ sāmprataṃ sa bhaktimān
