puruṣottame ||23|| prabodhayati paṭahairna bhoktavyaṃ harerdine | ye kecid bhuṃjate martyāste me daṇḍyā dhruvaṃ matāḥ |||24|| tadbhayāddhi prajāḥ sarvā harerdinamupāsate | prayānti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ vyājenaivāpyupoṣitāḥ ||25|| tena rājñā harerbhaktyā śūnyāśca narakāḥ kṛtāḥ | svargāścāpi kṛtāḥ śūnyā lekhakā niṣkriyāḥ kṛtā ||26|| ekādaśyupavāsena mārjitaṃ likhitaṃ tu yat | naśyanti pūrvapāpāni hyabhuktvā harivāsare ||27|| kāṣṭhamṛgasamaḥ so’haṃ jāto’smi niṣphalakriyaḥ | tyaktakāmo’smyahaṃ tvadya lokapālatvamakriyam |||28|| yāsyāmi brahmaloko vai duḥkhaṃ jñāpayituṃ svakam | nirvyāpāro niyogī vetanaṃ dhatte na jīryati ||29|| sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ mānavo vā yamopi vā | evamuktvā mahālakṣmi nāradaṃ citraguptakam ||1.285.30 || saha nīravā yayau brahmasadanaṃ yamarāṭ svayam | dadarśa ca samāsīnaṃ mūrtāmūrtajanāvṛtam ||3 1 || upāsyamānaṃ vividhairlokapālairdigīśvaraiḥ | vedaśāstretihāsādyaiḥ saraḥsaritsamudrakaiḥ ||32|| vṛkṣavallītṛṇasasyairvanāraṇyamarudgaṇaiḥ | kṣetrabhūbhṛtsthalībhiśca munidevarṣipitṛbhiḥ ||33|| kalādinaniśāvarṣayugakalpalayādibhiḥ | sukhaduḥkhālābhalābhairnāgasākṣiguṇādibhiḥ ||34 || guṇāguṇairmāyikaiścānuktairupāsyate hyajaḥ | teṣāṃ madhye’viśatsūryātmajo bhagnahṛdāntaraḥ || 35|| vilokayannadhobhāgaṃ jātahāniṃ vyadarśayat | nipapātāgrato brahmam̐s trāhi trāhīti saṃvadan ||36|| vinivṛtto’smi niṣkāryaḥ kiṃ karomi niyojane | nāhaṃ vetanayogyo’smi rājapaṭṭaṃ gṛhāṇa te ||37|| ityuktvā rājapaṭakaṃ nicikṣepa vidheḥ puraḥ | lekhinīṃ citragupto’pi cikṣepa ca vidheḥ puraḥ ||38|| mlānanaṃ yamaṃ tvāśvāsayāmāsa pitāmahaḥ | vihvalaṃ bhagnahṛdayaṃ hyāsane sannyaveśayat ||39|| papraccha ca śanaiḥ kenābhibhūto’si vivāsitaḥ | kenāpamārjito devapaṭastavāpamānitaḥ ||1.285.40 || brūhi sarvamaśeṣeṇa duḥkhaṃ te hṛdaye sthitam | ime sarve tarkayanti lokān rodayate tu yaḥ ||41|| so’yaṃ kena parābhūto mlānāsyo’sti raveḥ sutaḥ | athavā satyagātheyaṃ drogdhurvai parato bhayam ||42|| atha śrutvā yamaḥ prāha śṛṇu pūrvapitāmaha | vetanaṃ yo vinā kāryaṃ gṛhṇāti karmayojitaḥ ||43|| nipatatyandhakūpe saḥ yastvanyāyena jīvati | karmacārī niyogaṃ na karoti lobhakarṣitaḥ ||44|| prabhorvittaṃ samaśnāti sa bhavetkāṣṭhakīṭakaḥ | paścāt sa narakaṃ yāti yāvatkalpaśatatrayam ||45|| svārthamātraparo yastu svāminaṃ tu vilumpati | sa bhaved grāmakhāteṣu hyākhuḥ kalpaśatatrayam ||46|| niyogī nispṛho bhūtvā svāmikāryaṃ karoti na | svāmivittaṃ samaśnāti gṛhe mārjāratāṃ vrajet ||47|| so’haṃ tvayā niyukto’smi daṇḍyādaṇḍyānpraśāsitum | puṇyena puṇyakarmāṇaṃ pāpena pāpakāriṇam ||48|| yojayāmīti tatrādya rukmāṃgadena bhūbhujā | parābhūto’smyādhikārye kṛto’smi niṣkriyo’dhunā ||49|| rukmāṃgadabhayād bhūmiḥ saptadvīpā sasāgarā | na bhuṃkte vāsare viṣṇoḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśane ||1.285.50|| pāpāśca satkriyāśūnyāḥ sarvadharmavihīnakāḥ | prayānti vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma hyupoṣya harivāsaram ||51|| ye tvāgatā yamapūryāṃ te’pi vaṃśajapuṇyataḥ | yamapūrīṃ parityajya dhṛtvā pādaṃ tu mūrdhni me ||52|| prayānti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ matkṣetraṃ śūnyatāṃ gatam | etasya vratapuṇyena śataṃ pitṛparamparāḥ |||53||| śataṃ mātāmahapuṃsāṃ śataṃ bhāryāpiturjanāḥ | śataṃ ca bhāgineyā vai bhrātṛbhāryājanāḥ śatam ||54|| śataṃ pitṛbhāgineyaḥ śataṃ mātṛsvasurjanāḥ | ekottaraṃ ca pratyekaṃ yānti mokṣapadaṃ hareḥ ||55|| etanme paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ mārjayitvā lipiṃ mama | anyakṛtena puṇyena yānti tvanye paraṃ padam ||56|| ekasya puṇyamāhātmyādanyagotrāḥ paraṃ padam | chitvā prayānti matpāśaṃ tena me śiraso rujā ||57|| na me prayojanaṃ deva niyogenedṛśena yat | ekādaśyupavāsyekaḥ kulasaptakamasya tu ||58|| prayāti śrīharerdhāma tyaktvā lokaṃ tu māmakam | na yajñairna ca tīrthairvā vratairnāpi japairna ca ||59|| jalāgnibhṛgupatanairna gatiṃ yāti tādṛśīm | yādṛśīṃ yāti tāṃ harervāsarasya vratena tu ||1.285.60|| bhūtvā so’haṃ nirāśo’dya tava pādasaroruham | vijñaptiṃ kartumāyātaḥ kuruṣvātra yathepsitam ||61|| yamakṣetraṃ yamamārgo yamaśāsanamityapi | mā syurbhagnā yathā pūrvapitāmaha tathā kuru ||62|| na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ kvāpi tvetādṛṅnyāyavarjitam | svakarmasthā vikarmasthāḥ śucayo’śucayo’pi vā ||63|| upoṣya vāsaraṃ viṣṇordhāma yānti nṛpājñayā | so’smākaṃ tu mahān śatrurnirgrāhyaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ ||64|| tena varṣasahasreṇa śāsitaṃ kṣitimaṇḍalam | atiduṣṭā janā nītā vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma tadbalāt ||65|| āropayitvā garuḍe kṛtvā rūpaṃ caturbhujam | nayatyaharniśaṃ lokamaprameyaṃ pitāmaha ||66|| yadi sthāsyati dīrghaṃ saḥ samastaṃ neṣyate’mṛtam | eṣa daṇḍaḥ paro hyeṣastava padbhyāṃ visarjitaḥ ||67|| lokapālatvamasmākaṃ vyarthīkṛtamanena vai | dhanyā sā jananī garbhe dhṛto’yaṃ mokṣakṛd yayā ||68|| kimapatyena jātena mātṛkleśakareṇa vai | yena tṛptirna toṣo na na sevā na ripukṣayaḥ ||69|| noddhṛtaḥ pitṛnicayo vidyayā vā balena vā | yasya na sphurate kīrtirjaneṣvabhijñakeṣvapi ||1.285.70 || vṛthāśūlā tu tanmātā kukṣiprastararakṣiṇī | vṛthājanmāpi ṣaṇḍhaḥ sa māturjāṭhararogavat ||71|| dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu virodhī yo bhavetsutaḥ | varaṃ tasmād garbhanāśo duḥkhaṃ tatra samāpyate ||72|| dharmahā yo bhavelloke vṛthā tasya tu jīvitam | vīraprasūridānīṃ tu yayā rukmāṃgado nṛpaḥ ||73|| janitaḥ śrīharerbhakto mallipermārjanāya vai | naitādṛśaṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ kenāpi paramārcanam ||74|| so’haṃ kathaṃ prajīvāmi śṛṇvam̐statpaṭahaṃ sadā | lumpamānaṃ mama mārgaṃ vṛthāvetanapāpabhāg ||75|| iti nivedayitvaiva virarāmātidurmanāḥ | brahmā prāha tadā lakṣmi śanaiḥ saurerviśokakṛt ||76|| kiṃ tatrāsti tavāścaryaṃ kathaṃ vā khidyate bhavān | sadguṇeṣu kathaṃ tāpastava jāto yamādhipa ||77|| yannāmoccāraṇād yānti janā mokṣapadaṃ dhruvam | tadvrataṃ samanuṣṭhāya kathaṃ neyuḥ paraṃ padam ||78|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyātraikaḥ praṇāmaḥ kṛto bhavet | daśāśvamedhaphaladaḥ phalaṃ tu kṣayaśāli tat ||79|| punarjanmapradaṃ tacca praṇāmastvantakṛjjaneḥ | kāśīgayākurukṣetraiḥ kimastyasya prayojanam ||1.285.80|| jihvāgre vartate yasya harirityakṣaradvayam | rajasvalāṃ tu cāṇḍālīṃ gacchan bhuñjan surānvitam ||8 1|| māsaṃ kurvanmahaccauryaṃ tathāpi sa hi mokṣabhāg | viṣṇulokaṃ prayātyeva vidhūya pāpasaṃcayam ||82|| yannāmoccāraṇānmokṣaḥ kimūta tadupoṣaṇe | yatra saṃkīrtyate vicintyate kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||83|| ajñānāllīlayā vātra helayāpi gṛṇan harim | śṛṇvansmarannupahasannapi yāti parāṃ gatim ||84|| kathaṃ tasya prabhakteṣu vratiṣvāśāsanaṃ tava | yastvaṃ na cūrṇito baddhaḥ pāṣadaistasya vai prabhoḥ ||85|| tadasmākaṃ paraṃ mānaṃ rakṣitaṃ tvaṃ na budhyase | niyoginā hi yatnena jñātavyā rājakīyatā ||86|| rājānugrahapātrāṇi sāparādhānyapi dhruvam | niyoktavyāni naiveha niyogī daṇḍyatenyathā ||87|| evaṃ pāpā api kṛṣṇabhaktaniyogamāśritāḥ | prayānti śrahirerdhāma mā tatra śāsanaṃ kuru ||88|| anyabhaktaiḥ sadoṣaiḥ pūrayiṣye yama te gṛham | na kariṣyāmi sāhāyyaṃ haribhaktaistu te kvacit ||89|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktanigraho naiva vidyate | taiḥ kṛte hyavamāne tu tava nāsmi sahāyavān ||1.285.90|| cet te sāhāyyamatrāpi karomi yādi sūryaja | mama dehāntadaṇḍaḥ syād bhraṣṭatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ padāt ||9 1|| tadātra tava kā vārtā tato maunaṃ gṛhāṇa bho | prayāntu te harerdhāma yamakṣetrānna rodhaya ||92|| bhavatvādityajanmam̐ste riktaṃ kṣetraṃ harerbalāt | mā śokaṃ vraja cātrārthe kāle tviṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati ||93|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne daśamīviddhaikādaśīvratākaraṇe mahābhāgavatarukmāṃgadanṛpākhyāne ekādaśīvratabalād yamapurīriktatve brahmāṇaṃ prati yamasya saśokanivedanamitināmā pañcāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||285||
<1.286> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tato dharmarājaḥ prāha pitāmaham | aho kīdṛśamāścaryaṃ yadi rājā pramokṣadaḥ || 1 || devāḥ sarve tadā vyarthāḥ śāsanaṃ ca nirarthakam | rukmāṃgadāddharau tatra bhedo na syānmanāgapi || 2 || yamapuryā devapuryā brahmapuryā niyāmakaḥ | rukmāṃgado bhaved bhaumo harireva bhaveddhi saḥ || 3 || tamekaṃ bhojayitvā tu prapūjya harivāsare | kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyāmi gṛhāṇa tvatparaṃ vidhe || 4 || yadi nāmādyaprabhṛti yairnaraiḥ saṃsmṛto hariḥ | upoṣitaḥ stuto vāpi te bāhyā mama śāsanāt || 5 || nedṛśaṃ karmacāritvaṃ dvisattākaṃ prarocate | anyaṃ niyuṅkṣva sahate bhagnasattākatāṃ tu yaḥ || 6 || iti kṛtvāṃ paṭaṃ tyaktvā sthito maunaṃ yamādhipaḥ | brahmā tadā sabhāyāṃ vai paṭagrāhaṃ vyacintayat || 7 || prakāśaṃ kṛtavām̐statra samutthāya punaḥ punaḥ | paṭṭaṃ gahṇantu ye kecid yamarājyaṃ dadāmyaham || 8 || rukmāṃgadanṛpājñā tu nollaṃghyeti paṇānvitam | yamāsanaṃ pragṛhṇantu paṭaṃ riktaṃ dadāmyaham || 9 || śrutvāpi na yadā kaścit svīyaśāsanamāpnavān | paraśāsanakaiṃkarye sthātuṃ paravaśe pade || 1.286.10 || iyeṣa tu tadā prāha nāradastaṃ pitāmaham | mānavādhīnamaiśvaryapadaṃ ko gṛhṇīyātsuraḥ || 1 1|| tasmādatrānyapanthānaṃ vicāraya pitāmaha | yena vai yamamārgo vā pratiruddho na vai bhavet || 1 2|| svargamārgo’pi saṃruddho na bhavet tattathā kuru | śratvaivaṃ nāradīyaṃ vai vacanaṃ bahugarbhitam || 13|| vaivasvatasya kāryārthaṃ tatsanmānacikīrṣayā | cintayāmāsa viśvasṛṭ mokṣe vighnakaraṃ tu yat || 14|| svasmādutpādayāmāsa pramadāṃ lokamohinīm | sarvayoṣidvarā devī manasā nirmitā babhau || 15|| iyaṃ brāhmī divyarūpā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā | prodbhinnayauvanā dṛṣṭā sarvaiścakitamānasaiḥ || 16 || mohitāstu tadā sarve saṃsatsthā brahmasṛṣṭijāḥ | moho mokṣapratiroddhā mohinī mokṣanāśinī || 17|| samyag jātaṃ kautukaṃ tat prāhemān paśyato hyajaḥ | sarāgeṇeha manasā sarāgeṇeha cakṣuṣā || 18|| cintayedvikṣayedvāpi jananīṃ vā sutāmapi | vadhūṃ vā bhrātṛjāyāṃ vā gurubhāryāṃ nṛpastriyam || 19|| sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ saṃcintya śvapacīmapi | dṛṣṭvā tu pramadāmetāṃ yaḥ kṣobhaṃ vrajate janaḥ ||1.286.20|| tasya janmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛthā bhavati putrakāḥ | prasaṃge daśasāhasra puṇyamāyāti saṃkṣayam |||21|| pāpena tu tadā prāṇī tiryagyonimavāpnuyāt | tasmānna cintayetpaśyed vadet strīṃ manasāghinā ||22|| strīrna vicintayetpaśyed vadet puṃ manasāghinā | sābhilāṣeṇa manasā tatkṣaṇātpatate janaḥ ||23 || evamābhāṣya bahudhā viriñcirjñānacakṣuṣā | vilokya mohinīṃ sārthāṃ kṣaṇaṃ vyacintayattataḥ ||24|| yatheyaṃ manasā klṛptā mānasonmādakāriṇī | tathaiva jātā bandhāya yamastoṣaṃ prayāsyati || 25|| yamamārgo’nayā samyag bhaviṣyati suvāhitaḥ | svargaṃ vā narakaṃ vāpi riktaṃ kvacinna patsyate ||26|| tāvadāha praṇamyainaṃ mohinī caturānanam | paśya mūrchānvitaṃ brahman sabhyaṃ sthāvaracetanam ||27|| mohitaṃ mama rūpeṇa nimagnaṃ bandhasāgare | sa nāstyadyātra yaḥ kopi dṛśyate mama darśanāt || 28|| svalpaṃ vā bahulaṃ vāpi na kṣobhaṃ saṃgato mayi | sāhaṃ sṛṣṭā tvayā brahman kasyacit kṣobhaṇāya tu ||29|| tamādiśa vidhe śīghraṃ kṣobhayiṣye kṣaṇāddhi tam | māṃ dṛṣṭvā ca bhuvi kṣmābhṛjjaḍopi drāg vimuhyati ||1.286.30 || kiṃ punaścetano jīvo mohapātraṃ vinirmitaḥ | ityuktvā virarāmeyaṃ brahmovāca tu tāṃ mudā ||3 1|| satyametad viśālākṣi tava rūpaṃ vimohakam | ime sabhāsadāḥ sarve jaḍā iva tu darśanāt ||32|| vidyante tattathaivāsi vijayo’stu sadā tava | yannimittā mayā sṛṣṭā tatprasādhaya mohini ||33|| surāṣṭrake mahīdeśe rājā rukmāṃgadosti vai | yasya sandhyāvalī patnī tava rūpopamāsti hi ||34|| yasyāṃ dharmāṃgadaḥ putro jāto’sti guṇato’dhikaḥ | yo na vākyādvicalati sarvadājñākaraḥ sudhīḥ ||35|| tasya rukmāṃgadasyaiva samīpaṃ yāhi mohini | raivatākhye mahāśaile sa rājā tvāgamiṣyati ||36|| mohitastava gītena saṃgaṃ yāsyati sa tvayā | tatra devi tvayā vācyaṃ kṛtvā taṃ vivaśaṃ tvati ||37|| ahaṃ bhāryā bhaviṣyāmi paṇo rakṣyo yadi tvayā | kathayiṣye tvahaṃ kāle tatkartavyaṃ tvayā dhruvam || 38 || iti śrutvā mohitaḥ sa tathaiva pratipatsyate | tadā taddakṣiṇo hastastvayā grāhyaḥ svake kare || 3 9|| śapathairvacane bandhanīyaḥ samayapālane | tataḥ suratakārye saḥ toṣaṇīyo’timugdhavat || 1.286.40 || gāḍhe snehe sthire jāte māseṣvapagateṣvatha | surate tava cārvaṃgi yadā mugdho hi lakṣyate ||4 1 || prahasya nṛpateḥ smārayitavyaṃ svaṃ paṇaṃ vacaḥ | yastvayā śapatho rājan kṛto madvākyapālane ||42|| tatpālaya mahārāja manye’haṃ samayo’stviti | evamukte tvayā rājā mugdho vai satyagauravāt ||43 || vadiṣyati pālayāmi brūhi kiṃ te dadāmyaham | evamukte tu vacane tvayā vācyastadā nṛpaḥ ||44 || surate tūpavāsastu mato nairbalyakārakaḥ | rateryoge mahān vighno hyupavāsaḥ kṣudhākaraḥ ||45|| nopavāsastvayā kāryo jātu vai harivāsare | suratasraṃsakārī me hyupavāso’sti vighnakṛt ||46 || sumugdhāṃ yauvanopetāṃ sevamānāṃ na sevate | parvākṣepī durācāro nirdayo yāti rauravam || 47 || trirātraṃ tvāṃ vinā rājan sthātuṃ śaktā kathaṃ nvaham | nāhaṃ divasamapyekaṃ sthātuṃ śaktā tvayā vinā ||48 || upoṣaṇaṃ tava rājan mahāpāpāya jāyate | yatrāhaṃ kāmadāhena prajvalāmi tvayā vinā ||49 || yadi cet taruṇī rakṣyā deyaṃ ratisukhaṃ sadā | yadyaśakto raterdāne na rakṣyā taruṇī tadā ||1.286.5 0 || kāmadāhaviniḥśvāsastaruṇīhṛdayodbhavaḥ | vratināmapi puṇyāni prajvālayati mūlataḥ ||5 1 || tasmād rājanpravārdhakye kartavyā harivāsarāḥ | tāruṇye tu mamātīte kariṣye harivāsarān ||52 || evaṃ sambodhyamānopi yadā bhūbhṛdvacastava | na kariṣyati cārvaṃgi tadā vācyaṃ paraṃ vacaḥ || 53 || yadi na tyajase rājannupavāsaṃ harerdine | svahastena śiraśchitvā svaputrasya varāsinā ||54|| dharmāṃgadasya rājendra mamotsaṃge kṣipa svayam | yadyetanmatpriyaṃ rājanna karoṣi vacaḥ kṣateḥ ||55 || dharmakṣīṇo bhavān gantā hyacirānnarake dhruvam | śrutvaitadvacanaṃ devi | na haniṣyati putrakam || 56|| devānumatimādāya bhokṣyate harivāsare | tadvā prajāḥ prabhokṣyante tadīyā harivāsare ||57|| yāmyamārgo janaistarhi saṃpravṛtto bhaviṣyati | nārakāṇāṃ bhālapaṃktipramāṇaṃ ca bhaviṣyati ||58|| yadā na bhokṣyate kiṃcid bhaktatvāddharivāsare | haniṣyati tadā putraṃ rājyābhiṣiktameva tam ||59 || tadā prayāsyati kṣmābhṛt strījītatvapradūṣaṇam | mūrdhābhiṣiktaghātitvaṃ punnāmanarakārtitām || 1.286.60 || pitṝṇāṃ pātayitṛtvaṃ svātmaghātitvamityapi | ebhirdoṣairacirāt sa nidhanaṃ prāpsyate nṛpa ||6 1 || yamamārge svayaṃ gatvā pūrayiṣyati rauravam | yadvā vratabalācchīghraṃ harerdhāmni prayāsyati ||62|| śāsanaṃ pratiruddhaṃ syājjanā atsyanti vai vrate | bhaviṣyati yamamārgaḥ samuddhāṭita eva ha || 63 || gaccha śīghraṃ pratīkṣasva rukmāṃgadaṃ tu raivate | kṛtakāryā samāgaccha viddhāṃ dāsye tithiṃ gṛham ||64|| mohinī tvevamuktā sā praṇamyājaṃ sabhāsadān | vīkṣyamāṇāmarairmārge pratasthe raivatācalam || 65 || tṛtīyena muhūrtena saṃprāptā girimastakam | raivato mandarādryātmā saurāṣṭre rājate’calaḥ || 66 || ratnānāṃ mandiraṃ hyeṣo bahudhātusamanvitaḥ | krīḍābhūmiḥ surāṇāṃ ca tapobhūryastapasvinām || 67|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāyaṃ vihārodyānasannibhaḥ | svarṇarakṣā nadī yatra vahate kāṃcanaprabhā || 68 || bhaveśvaraṃ mahāliṃgaṃ vartate vāmanopi vai | dāmodarasvarūpeṇa gahvarāraṇyabhūmiṣu ||69|| mṛgīkuṇḍataṭe bālā gatvā pītvā jalaṃ śubham | bhuktvā sītāphalaṃ svādu cakre saṃgītamuttamam ||1.286.70 || mūrchanātālasahitaṃ gāndhāradhvanisaṃyutam | klamahānikaraṃ miṣṭaṃ sarvasattvavimohanam ||7 1 || ciñcādrumaghaṭāchannaḥ śratvā bhaveśvaraḥ śivaḥ | tadā bhoktumanāḥ kāmāturaścāti vyajāyata ||72|| cacāla mandirātsvasmād yatra gāyati mohinī | svarṇarekhā sthirā jātā vanaṃ stabdhaṃ tadābhavat || 73 || dāmodaro’pi cāyāto vanarājisvarabhramāt | vanadevā raivatādriḥ svarākṛṣṭāḥ samāyayuḥ ||74|| mohinī gītikāmagnā pratīkṣati nṛpāgamam | rukmāṃgado’pi vairāgyādaraṇyaṃ gantumicchati ||75|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne yamarājasya sattāpaṭṭatyāgamiṣeṇa pitāmahena saṃvādo mohinīstrīsamutpādanaṃ śikṣayitvā raivatādrau rukmāṃgadanṛpaṃ pratimohinīpreṣaṇaṃ mohinīsaṃgītamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 286||
<1.287> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca tasminnavasare tveva lakṣmi rukmāṃgado nṛpaḥ | bhogāṃstu mānuṣān bhuktvā hariṃ sampūjya keśavam || 1 || kṛtvā śūnyaṃ yamapathaṃ jitvā vaivasvataṃ yamam | vaikuṇṭhasya tu panthānaṃ kṛtvā pūrṇaṃ tu mānavaiḥ || 2 || dharmāgadaṃ samāhūya dātuṃ rājyamabhāṣata | etāṃ vasumatīṃ putra saptasāgaramekhalām || 3 || pālaya tvaṃ rājyadhuraṃ gṛhāṇa ca madarpitām | putre yogye suniṣpanne dhuraṃ yo na samarpayet || 4 || kleśavāhī sa janako dharmakīrtipravicyutaḥ | putraśaktyaprasaṃpoṣṭā nonnatiṃ yāti vṛddhakaḥ || 5 || kāryakṣamaḥ sutaścāpi bhāraṃ nodvahate tu yaḥ | svakartavyacyutaḥ so’pi duḥkhī bhavati vṛddhakaḥ || 6 || pitā yena na tuṣyet sa putro yātyeva rauravam | pitā yena tu santuṣṭaḥ sutaḥ saḥ svargabhājanam || 7 || kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ prajāścānunītā viṣṇuparāyaṇāḥ | athāsādya vinirvṛttiṃ gamiṣye’raṇyamekalaḥ || 8 || girīn vanāni saritaḥ sarāṃsi vividhāni ca | taptukāmo lokayiṣye bhāraṃ tvayi niveśya vai || 9 || śrūtvā dharmāṃgadaḥ prāha pitā prokto janārdanaḥ | piturvākye mahat svargaṃ mokṣaścājñākare pituḥ || 1.287.1 0|| na hi putrasyānyadharmaḥ pitrājñākaraṇaṃ vinā | pitṛvākyamakurvāṇaḥ sudharmiṣṭho’pyadho vrajet || 11 || tasmāt kariṣye vacanaṃ bhavatsantoṣahetave | gurvīṃ rājyadhuraṃ tāta tvadīyāmuddharāmyaham || 12|| śrutvaivaṃ putravākyaṃ sa rājā tuṣṭo babhūva ha | prāha sandhyāvalīṃ patnīṃ sthitāṃ lakṣmīmivāparām || 13|| śṛṇu patnī tvahaṃ dhanyastvaṃ ca dhanyā sutena vai | karṇābhyāṃ śrūyate mokṣaḥ sa prāptaḥ satsutena vai || 14|| putre vinayasampanne vṛttaśauryasamanvite | pratāpini praṇiṣpanne piturmokṣo gṛhe dhruvaḥ || 1 5|| śatānandapradaḥ putrastārayatyeva bījadam | jananīṃ tārayeccātrāvābhyāṃ prāptastathā sutaḥ || 16 || rājyabhāraṃ nyasya putre tvāṃ cāpi nyasya rakṣaṇe | gamiṣye’raṇyavāsārthaṃ saṃsmṛtya prākparamparām || 17|| kālaśeṣaṃ kṣapayiṣye pravāsye’nte harergṛham | sukhinī bhava putreṇa jñānenātmaviniṣṭhayā || 18|| mā viyoge kuru duḥkhaṃ patyājñāṃ pārameśvarīm | matvā strītvād gṛhe tiṣṭha kalyāṇaṃ te bhaviṣyati || 1 9|| śrutvā sandhyāvalī prāha satyamuktaṃ tvayā nṛpa | bhogād vairāgyamāpannaḥ sevasva munisajjanān ||1.287.20 || prasannāsmi tavājñāyāṃ pātivratyaṃ tavādare | sarvathāstu tava toṣo manmokṣe vai sahāyakṛt || 21 || prajāścāpi samāpṛcchya kṣiptvā dhuraṃ svaputrake | dhurāmādṛtya bhūṣālo datvā svaṃ dakṣiṇa karam || 22|| hayamāruhya rājā sa yayau raivatakānanam | patnīvratābhidhaviprāśramaṃ tvaśvasaro’ntikam || 23 || praviveśātiramyaṃ satkadalīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam | aśokabakulopetaṃ punnāgasaralāvṛtam || 24|| āmrarāyaṇajāmbvādikṣīrikākarmadānvitam | kapitthapippalīkharjūranārikelaketakaiḥ || 25 || śrīvṛkṣatālapanasaiścandanaiḥ sālacampakaiḥ | kramukairdāḍimairvaṃśairdhātrīnimbaiśca śobhitam || 26|| stambavallītṛṇairvyāptaṃ sasyadhānyāḍhyabhūtalam | samprapaśyan muniṃ rājā dadarśa hutabhukprabham || 27|| patnīvratākhyavipraṃ saḥ praṇanāma tu sādaram | muninātithyasatkāraiḥ pūjitaḥ prāha bhūpatiḥ || 28 || adya me pātaka kṣīṇaṃ prāptaṃ satkarmaṇāṃ phalam | dṛṣṭaṃ tava padāmbhojaṃ tvāyatiḥ śreyasānvitā || 29 || patnīvratastataḥ prāha rājan janma phalīkṛtaḥ | tvādṛśenātipuṇyenāśramo me vīkṣito’dhunā || 1.287.30 || yamamārgaṃ vinirjitya riktaṃ kṛtvā ca nārakam | prāpito yena vai loko vaikuṇṭhapadamavyayam || 31 || so’smākaṃ draṣṭukāmānāṃ cakṣuṣorviṣayaṃ gataḥ | śvaco’pi mahīpāla viṣṇubhakto dvijādhikaḥ || 32|| tvaṃ tu bhāgavataśreṣṭhaḥ prapūnāsi mahītalam | sukhamāsvāśrame ramye vada vedyaṃ mayāsti yat || 3 3|| jalapānaṃ kuru kṣmeśa phalaṃ bhuṃkṣvāśramocitam | sarvaṃ te kuśalaṃ nvasti sukhyāśrame vasan bhava || 34|| rājā satkāramādāya tvuvāca munisattamam | kṛpayā te ṛṣe sarvaṃ kuśalaṃ modate mama || 35|| putraścājñākaraḥ samrāṭ sevako vijayī kṣiteḥ | khyāto mamādhiko jātaḥ saptadvīpaprapālane || 36|| ekāhnā pṛthivīṃ sarvāmatītya bahuvistarām | punarāyāti śarvaryāṃ matpādābhyaṃgakāraṇāt || 37|| tathāyaṃ me śubho dehaḥ sarvarogavivarjitaḥ | aprameyaṃ mama sukhaṃ vaśagā ca priyā gṛhe || 38 || yā vilokayate dṛṣṭyā māṃ sadā manmathādhikam | yatra yatra padaṃ devī vidadhāti sulakṣaṇā || 3 9|| tatra tatra nidhānāni prakāśayati medinī | yasyāstvaṃgaṃ jarāhīnaṃ vartate navayauvanam ||1.287.40 || vināgnināpi sā vipra sādhayatyeva ṣaḍrasam | annaṃ pacati yatsvalpaṃ tasmin bhuñjanti koṭayaḥ ||4 1 || vājino vāraṇāścāpi dhanadhānyamanantakam | vartate ca janaḥ sarvo mamājñayā harervrate ||42 || ityetat kuśalaṃ sarvaṃ kena puṇyena me’sti vai | vada vicārya me puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ tvatra paratra vā ||43 || śrutvaitad brāhmaṇaḥ patnīvrataḥ prāgjanmasaṃcitam | cintayitvā nṛpaṃ prāha śūdro’bhūtvaṃ purā janau ||44|| duṣṭayā bhāryayā sākaṃ dāridryeṇa suduḥkhitaḥ | kadācid dvijasaṃsargāt tīrthayātrāṃ gato bhavān || 45|| mathurāyāṃ tu viśrāntighaṭṭe yāmunake hrade | snātvā vārāhanilaye kathāṃ śuśrāva puṇyadām ||46|| aśūnyaśayanavrataviṣayāṃ haritoṣaṇīm | caturbhiḥ pāraṇairyasya vratasya pūrṇatā bhavet ||47|| tatkṛtaṃ bhavatā rājan tvatpatnyā ca vrataṃ gṛhe | śrāvaṇasya tu māsasya dvitīyāyāṃ mahīpate ||48 || grāhyametad vrataṃ puṇyaṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam | rājyadaṃ putradārādipradaṃ sampatkaraṃ śubham ||49|| ekabhuktaṃ prakartavyaṃ māsaikyaṃ vratinā tathā | nityaṃ viṣṇuḥ pūjanīyo lakṣmībhartā prage niśi || 1.287.5 0 || phalaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpaiścāruraktānulepanaiḥ | śayyādānairvastradānaistathā brahmiṣṭhabhojanaiḥ ||51 || yadvā māse tu saptāhaṃ pratyupoṣaṇamācaret | saptāhānte pāraṇaṃ vai kuryāt sādhvadanottaram ||52|| evaṃ tu pāraṇācatuṣṭayaṃ māse vidhāpayet | aśaktaścet pratyahaṃ tu dugdhena vartayed vratī ||53|| śayane śubhaparyaṃke lakṣmīṃ dadyāttu viṣṇave | śayanaṃ tu vinā lakṣmīṃ śūnyaṃ viṣṇorbhavedataḥ ||54|| salakṣmīkaṃ tu śayanamaśūnyaśayanaṃ bhavet | yathā rājñyāśca rājñaśca sevakā nityamācaret ||55|| kaiṃkaryaṃ vividhaṃ sarvaṃ dadyātsarvaṃ śrīviṣṇave | tadā sarvaṃ tamāpnoti vratī janmāntare dhruvam ||56 || tattvayā prāgjanau sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ sodyāpanaṃ yataḥ | prāptaṃ tvatra mahad rājyaṃ puṣṭyā dānaphalaṃ hi tat ||57|| lakṣmīdānaṃ viṣṇave tu śayane dattavān bhavān | rājñī prāptā tvayā tasya phalena devatā yathā ||58|| yānavāhanasaudhādi dānārthaṃ kalpitaṃ tvayā | na tu dattaṃ tathāpyatra prāptaṃ saṃkalpajaṃ phalam ||59|| putraḥ prāptastvayā rājan viṣṇulakṣmīprasādataḥ | piturvacanakārī vai manovākkāyaśaktitaḥ ||1.287.60 || jāyate’syāhanyahani snānaṃ bhāgīrathībhavam | tasmāt pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ dattaṃ paścājjanmani labhyate ||61|| iti te kathitaṃ vṛttaṃ kimanyat karavāṇi te | śrutvā prāha tadā rājā raivate bhavadarśanam ||62|| kartumicchāmi viprendra yadyājñā bhavato bhavet | ṛṣiḥ svastyastu te rājan gaccheti prāha cāśiṣā ||63|| rājā turaṃgamāruhya natvā śīghragatiryayau | raivatādrau bhavanāthaṃ śaṃkaraṃ yatra mohinī ||64|| pratīkṣate tu rājānaṃ gānaṃ miṣṭaṃ karoti sā | susvaraṃ tanmahārājo lakṣyīkṛtya yayau puraḥ ||65|| mṛgīkuṇḍe sthitāṃ taptasuvarṇābhāṃ tu kāminīm | ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣīyāṃ vahnijāmiva rūpiṇīm ||66|| dṛṣṭvaiva mohamāpanno viddhaḥ kāmaśareṇa ca | kāmajvarābhibhūtaḥ saḥ sasarpāsyāḥ samīpakam ||67|| jñātvā ceyaṃ ca taṃ kṣmāpaṃ kaṭākṣāni mumoca ha | netragaṇḍabhujāvakṣaḥkuṃbhādharanitambakān ||68|| pradhunvānā sumugdheva jagāma nṛpateḥ puraḥ | rukmāṃgadaṃ kāmataptaṃ prāhottiṣṭha vaśe tava ||69|| vartāmi ca karomyeva yadā diśa vane’tra mām | yadivātrchā surate’sti bhuṃkṣva māṃ ratidāsikām ||1.287.70|| rājā prāha tadā nārīṃ tapase yadyapi tvaham | samāgato’smyaraṇyeṣu tvāṃ tathāpi vilokya vai ||71|| jāto’smi kāmanāyuktaḥ pūrṇacandranibhānane | yādṛśaṃ tvaṃ dhārayase rūpaṃ sarvavimohanam ||72|| nedṛśaṃ vai mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tvadyāpi brahmaṇaḥ kṛtau | kuru prasādaṃ rambhoru baddhacetasi vai mayi ||73|| āgacchāṃkaṃ mamāmūlyaṃ svīyatvenāpyalaṃkuru | ātmānamapi dāsyāmi kiṃ punardhanaratnakam ||74|| rājyaṃ veṣṭatamaṃ datvā nivasiṣye tvayātra vai | nṛpaṃ sā mohitaṃ cāti vijñāyāvasaraṃ tathā ||75|| samuvāca smitaṃ kṛtvā brahmoktaṃ suvicintya ca | na rājyaṃ dhanaratnādi varaye vasudhādhipa ||76|| yadvadiṣyāmyahaṃ kāle tatkāryamaviśaṃkayā | bhajiṣyāmi na sandehaḥ kuruṣva samayaṃ mama ||77|| śapathaṃ kuru rājendrāvaśyaṃ kurve itīraya | tadā bhogaṃ pradāsye’haṃ nāsādhyaṃ te bhaveddhi tat ||78|| rājā prāha tadā kāmarūpayauvanamohitaḥ | yena santuṣyase devi samayaṃ te karomyaham ||79|| śapathaṃ coccaran vacmi kariṣye vacanaṃ tava | mohinyapi ca taṃ prāha dīyatāṃ dakṣiṇaḥ karaḥ ||1.287.80|| dharmakarapradānena pratyayo vacane tava | bhavenme’tha na vaktāsyanṛtaṃ kāle vinirṇayaḥ ||8 1|| dṛḍho jātaḥ paṇo nau vai mārgo’yaṃ dharmasākṣikaḥ | rājā prāha ca tāṃ nārīṃ kimebhiḥ pratyayairdṛḍhaiḥ ||82|| janmaprabhṛti vāmoru nānṛtaṃ bhāṣitaṃ mayā | datto hyeṣa mayā hasto dakṣiṇaḥ puṇyadānakṛt ||83|| yanmayā sukṛtaṃ kiñcit kṛtamājanma sundari | tatsarvaṃ tava vāmoru yadi kuryānna te vacaḥ ||84|| antare hyeṣa datto me dharmo bhāryā bhavāṅgane | rukmāṃgado mahārājaḥ kathayāmi vanāntare ||85|| pratyuttarapradānena prasādaṃ kartumarhasi | nṛpeṇaivaṃ samādiṣṭā mohinyāhottaraṃ vacaḥ ||86|| ahaṃ brahmabhavā rājan tvadarthaṃ samupāgatā | śrutvā kīrtiṃ smaropetā raivataṃ kanakācalam ||87|| sampūjayantī deveśaṃ gītadānena śaṃkaram | yena tuṣṭena devena hyupakāraḥ kṛto mayi ||88|| yadbhavānacireṇaiva prāpto’sīpsitasundaraḥ | abhiprīto’si me rājannabhiprītā hyahaṃ tava ||89|| mā śaṃkāṃ kuru rājendra kumārīṃ viddhyakalmaṣām | udvahasva mahīpāla gṛhyoktavidhinātra mām ||1.287.90 || āśrutya rājñā tatraiva vidhinā sā vivāhitā | bhavena viṣṇunā dāmodareṇa sa vivāhitaḥ ||9 1 || vanyamūlaphalānyattvā dampatīdharmamāśritau | remāte vividhairbhāvairnavayauvanagarbhitaiḥ ||92|| mohinī taṃ kāmabhāvaiḥ ramayatyatyaharniśam | satyalokāttathā svargād bhogyānādāya cottamān ||93|| sevate taṃ patiṃ bhuṃkte bhogānamaradurlabhān | rukmagrāmo navastatra racito divyanākibhiḥ ||94|| divyadāsīdāsabhṛtyaiḥ suramyasaudhapaṃktibhiḥ | yānavāhanakodyānaiḥ kāmadhenugajādibhiḥ ||95|| tatra bhojyādanapeyopadhāryāmbarabhūṣaṇaiḥ | rājasairdravavastvādyairna nyūnatvamabhūttadā ||96|| kāmabhoge ratayośca tayorvai varṣaviṃśatiḥ | samayaḥ samatīto’bhūt tṛpto rājāpyabhūttayā ||97|| aho rūpaṃ madarthaṃ vai brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ śubham | hastihastasannikāśe jaṃghe kāṃcanasannibhe ||98|| dantapaṃktiścandrapaṃktirgūḍhe gulphe tu mohake | netre paṃkajavistāre stanau kāṃcanakuṃbhakau ||99|| kaṭirmṛgendrakaṭivat svalpaṃ madhyaṃ susaurabham | kṛtārtho’haṃ khalvanayā deyaṃ yāciṣyate tu yat||| 1.287.100 || durlabhaṃ cāpi dāsyāmi tvadeyamapi sarvathā | yāciṣyate jīvitaṃ me dāsyāmyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 101 || evaṃ suratamūḍhasya rājño rukmāṃgadasya tu | catvāri paṃcavarṣāṇāṃ vyatītāni nimeṣavat || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne rukmāṃgadaḥ putre rājyaṃ vinyasya vanaṃ jagāma tatrāśvapaṭṭasarastīravāsipatnīvratarṣikathitasya rukmāṃgadapūrvajanmādeḥ śravaṇam tato raivatācale mohinyāḥ samāgamaḥ samayaśapathaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 287 ||
<1.288> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tadā rājyaṃ cakre dharmāṃgadaḥ sutaḥ | piturniyogāt saṃkurvan kārayan harivāsaram || 1 || dharme bhāgavate saṃrakṣayan sarvāḥ prajāḥ sutaḥ | viṣṇudinavratārthaṃ vādayate paṭahaṃ sadā || 2 || rājāpi vāsaraṃ viṣṇoḥ karoti niyamena vai | anyavratāni santyajya bhuṃkte patnīṃ suyauvanām || 3 || ekadāśvinasamaye mohinī sarvabhāvataḥ | rājānaṃ ramayāmāsa divyasaukhyaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 4 || pārthivaścātimugdho’pi vrataṃ nopekṣate hareḥ | krīḍāṃ tyajati kṣmāpālo daśamyādidinatraye || 5 || viṣṇordinaṃ na tyajati janmamṛtyunikṛntanam | tāvat prāptaḥ prabodhāya viṣṇormāsastu kārtikaḥ || 6 || yasmin kṛtaṃ tu sukṛtaṃ yaiḥ kaiścinmanujairiha | akṣayaṃ hi bhavet sarvaṃ viṣṇulokapradāyakam || 7 || iti vicārya nṛpatirmohinīṃ vākyamabravīt | rataṃ devi tvayā sārdhaṃ mayā samvatsarān bahūn || 8 || tavāpamānabhītena noktaṃ kiṃcidapi kvacit | tvayyāsaktasya me subhru bahavaḥ kārtikā gatāḥ || 9 || na vrataṃ kārtike jātaṃ me māsaṃ vārdhamāsakam | so’haṃ kārtikamicchāmi savrataṃ paryupāsitum || 1.288.10 || avrataḥ kārtiko yasya gatastasya vṛthā gatam | madyamāṃsavyavāyāḍhyā api kārtikasadvratāḥ || 11 || bhūtvā śuddhā gatāste vai śāśvataṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ padam | kārtike dīpadānena dātā vai divamāvrajet || 13 || paradīpaprabodhena daridro’pi divaṃ vrajet | puṣkare pūrṇimāṃ kṛtvājanmapāpātpramucyate || 1 4 || vratopavāsaniyamārcanadānādisatkṛtaiḥ | gacchati kārtiko yasya sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 14 || kārtike kṛcchrasevī yaḥ prājāpatyaparo’pi vā | ekāntaropavāsī vā trirātropoṣito’pi vā || 15|| saptāhaṃ vā daśāhaṃ vā pakṣaṃ māsamupoṣitaḥ | phalāhāro naro yāti sa viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 16 || ekabhaktena naktenāyācitena vratasthitaiḥ | dharā dārā suto rājyaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyamavāpyate || 17|| kārtiko bhaktidaḥ puṇyo vratadānārcanādibhiḥ | tasmin haridinaṃ puṇyaṃ tathaiva dinapañcakam || 18 || prabodhinīṃ jāgarāḍhyāṃ kṛtvā muktiṃ prayāti vai | kārtike varjayettailaṃ madhu sūpaṃ ca maithunam || 19 || niṣpāvān rājasān bhogān varjayettu prayatnataḥ | kārtike tvarjitā dīkṣā nṝṇāṃ janmani kṛntanī || 1.288.20 || paśuyonimavāpnoti dīkṣayā rahito janaḥ | ekādaśyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ dīkṣito yāti cākṣaram || 21 || kuṃbhān datvā jalapūrṇān prayāti harimandiram | samvatsaravratānāṃ tu samāptiḥ kārtike’rcanam ||22|| udyāpanādikaṃ sarvaṃ sampūrṇaphaladaṃ bhavet | naktavratī ca ṣaḍrasairbālān sādhūn prabhojayet ||23 || ayācite tvanaḍvāhaṃ saddvijāya pradāpayet | naivedyāśī bhaved yastu gāṃ pradadyātsadakṣiṇām |||24|| dhātrīsnāne jano dadyāt pāyasaṃ picchalaṃ dadhi | phalānāṃ niyame tatra phalāni tvarpayettathā ||25||| tailatyāge ghṛtaṃ dadyād ghṛtatyāge payastathā | dhānyānāṃ niyame śālīṃstattaddhānyamathāpi vā ||26|| bhūśāyitve saparyaṃkāṃ śayyāṃ dadyādalaṃkṛtām | patrabhojī pradadyādvai pātrāṇi saghṛtāni vai ||27|| maune ghaṇṭāṃ hiraṇyaṃ vā tilānvāpi pradāpayet | prātaḥsnāne hayaṃ dadyānniḥsnehe ghṛtasaktukān ||28|| nakhakeśāvapane tu darpaṇaṃ mṛttikāṃ dadet | pādatrāṇāgrahe dadyādupānahau ca pāduke ||29||| lavaṇādiparityāge dātavyā gauḥ sudugdhadā | dīpadātā pradadyādvai kāṃcanaṃ devamūrtaye ||1.288.30|| chatraṃ ca cāmare dadyāt kṣaumavastrāṇi cārpayet | trirātravratakartā tu dadyācchayyāmalaṃkṛtām ||3 1 || saptarātropavāsī tu śibikāṃ chatramarpayet | pakṣadinopavāsī tu yānaṃ dadyācca hastinam ||32|| māsopavāsakartā tu gṛhaṃ sarvasvamarpayet | ajāvikaṃ tvekabhakte phalāhāre suvarṇakam ||3 3 || śākāhāre phalaṃ dadyātpātraṃ vānyat samarpayet | evaṃ yathā dhanasmṛddhistathā dadyād vratānugam ||34|| labhyate vratakartātra rājyaṃ dārā dhanādikam | tasmānmohini kartāsmi kārtike vratasevanam || 35 || vratopavāsaniyamaiḥ kārtiko yasya gacchati | devo vaimāniko bhūtvā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||36|| tasmānmohaṃ parityajyājñāpaya kārtike vrate | ahaṃ vratadharaścaiva bhaviṣye haripūjane || 37|| śrutvaitatpratikūlaṃ sā mohinyāha nijārthinī | na vrataṃ hi tvayā kāryaṃ yadi māmicchasi priyām ||38|| dānaṃ prapālanaṃ yuddhaṃ kāryatrayaṃ tu bhūbhujām | vratādikaraṇaṃ rājñāṃ noktaṃ kvāpi nidarśane ||39|| muhūrtamapi rājendra na śaknomi tvayā vinā | sthātuṃ kamalanābhābha kiṃ punarmāsasaṃkhyayā ||1.288.40|| tvayi vrate kṛte’vaśya maraṇaṃ me bhavennanu | kariṣyāvastato vārdhakye vrataṃ kārtikasya vai ||4 1|| śrutvā prāha tadā rājā mohinyāṃ vacanottamam | na kariṣye vrataṃ subhru kariṣye tava sammatam ||42||| śrutvā tu mohinī hṛṣṭā saṃśliṣṭā rahasi sthitam | ramayāmāsa tanvaṃgī kāmarītividhānataḥ ||4 3 || tasyaivaṃ ramamāṇasya samāyātā prabodhinī | rukmāṃgadasya karṇābhyāṃ paṭahadhvanirāgataḥ || 44|| prātarharerdinaṃ lokāstiṣṭhadhvaṃ tvekabhojanāḥ | akṣāralavaṇāḥ sarve haviṣyānnaniṣeviṇaḥ || 45|| avanitalpaśayanāḥ kāmasaṃgavivarjitāḥ | smaradhvaṃ devadeveśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ||46|| sakṛdbhojanasaṃyuktā upavāsaṃ kariṣyatha | akṛtaśrāddhanicayā gacchadhvaṃ śrīhareḥ padam ||47|| prātaḥ kārtikaśuklāsti tvekādaśī prabodhinī | yāstūpoṣya harerdhāma vidhūya pāpajālakam ||48 || kurudhvaṃ śrīhareḥ pūjāmātmavittena mānavāḥ | vastraiḥ puṣpairdhūpadīpairvaracandanakuṃkumaiḥ ||49|| naivedyaiśca phalairyaṣṭvā gacchadhvaṃ śrīhareḥ padam | yo na kuryādvaco rukmāṃgadasya haridhāmadam ||1.288.5 0 || sa me daṇḍyaśca vadhyaśca dharmāṃgado bravīmyaham | iti śrutvā paṭahasya dharmyāṃ vai ghoṣaṇāṃ svakām ||51 || rukmāṃgada udatiṣṭhanmohinīśayanād drutam | prāha prātarharerahni bhaviṣyatyaghanāśanam ||52|| saṃyato’haṃ bhaviṣyāmi kṣamyatāṃ kṣamyatāmiti | iyamekādaśī kāryā bandhachetrī gatipradā ||53 || mayā saha viśālākṣi tvaṃ cāpi tamadhokṣajam | ārādhaya hṛṣīkeśamupavāsaparāyaṇā ||54|| yena yāsyasi nirvāṇaṃ dāhapralayavarjitam | punā rājyaṃ punaḥ svargaṃ punaryadvā pramokṣaṇam ||55|| mohinyuvāca sādhūktaṃ tvayā vratārcanaṃ hareḥ | janmamṛtyujarāchedi kariṣye vai tavājñayā ||56 || pratijñā yā tvayā pūrvaṃ kṛtāsmin raivate girau | karapradānasahitā bhavatā sukṛtāṃkitā ||57|| tasyāstu samayaḥ prāpto dīyatāṃ sahi me tvayā | anyathājanmanaḥ puṇyaṃ sarvaṃ te nāśameṣyati ||58 || śrutvā smṛtvāha rukmāṃgaḥ kartāsmi tvanmanogatam | nādeyaṃ vidyate kiñcittubhyaṃ me jīvitāvadhi ||59|| kiṃ punā rājyanagaraṃ vittaṃ vānyacca bhāmini | mohinyuvāca saṃprāptaṃ jñātvā hyavasaraṃ śubham ||1.288.60|| nātha kānta priya rājan jīviteśa ratipriya | nopoṣyo vāsaro viṣṇorbhoktavyā yadyahaṃ priyā ||61 || vinābhūtā bhaviṣyāmi tvatsaṃyogaṃ vinā nṛpa | tasmānmāṃ yadi vāñchethā bhoktumājīvanaṃ priyām |||62|| mayāvaśyaṃ ca vastavyamāmṛtyuṃ tvadgṛhe nṛpa | tadā tyajopavāsaṃ vai bhujyatāṃ harivāsare ||63|| eṣa eva varo deyo mayā saṃprārthitaḥ purā | na ced dāsyasi mohādvā bhūtvānṛtavacā bhavān ||64|| yāsyate narake ghore yāvadābhūtasamplavam | patnīhānau vratahānau vacohānau balābale ||65|| dṛṣṭādṛṣṭau vṛṣādharmau vicāryeṣṭatamaṃ kuru | rājovāca tvayā subhru ruddhaḥ kārtikasadvrate ||66|| rodhayasi punarekādaśyāmapi kathaṃ priye | vratapuṇyena sukhinau jātau sva iti cintaya ||67|| dharmasvasā vidheḥ putrī bhūtvaivaṃ tvayi nocitam | dharmarakṣākaro bhūtvā dharmavighnaṃ karoṣi kim ||68|| janmaprabhṛtyahaṃ naiva bhuktavān harivāsare | sa cādyāhaṃ tavādhīnaḥ kathaṃ bhoktā harerdine ||69|| antime svāyuṣo bhāge svarṇarekhāprasevanam | bhajanaṃ pūjanaṃ yuktaṃ nityaṃ ca harisevanam ||1.288.70|| na kṛtaṃ yanmayā bālye yauvane vaibhave sati | tadahaṃ vanamadhye’dya kathaṃ kuryāṃ jugupsitam ||71 || mā kuruṣva vrataṃ bhaṃgaṃ mā kuruṣvāgrahaṃ tathā | yadanyadicchasi subhru dātāhaṃ rājyasampadām ||72|| vimānaṃ saṃgṛhāṇedaṃ dolāṃ vyomavihāriṇīm | kalpalatārasaṃ bhuṃkṣva mā vrate vighnamācara ||73|| ātmamāṃsaṃ naro bhuṃkte yo bhuṃkte harivāsare | trailokyaghātinaḥ pāpaṃ maithune harivāsare ||74|| gocāralope yatpāpaṃ yatpāpaṃ kūṭasākṣike | nikṣepahārake cāpi tathā viśvāsaghātake ||75|| hatyākāriṇi yatpāpaṃ yatpāpaṃ gurunindake | tatsarvaṃ pātakaṃ tvanne saṃsthitaṃ harivāsare ||76|| evaṃ jānan viśālākṣi kathaṃ bhokṣyāmi pātakam | evaṃ jñānavatī tvaṃ ca kathaṃ nāśayasi vratam ||77|| mohinyuvāca tacchrutvā bādhadharmān nṛpaṃ prati | ekabhuktena naktena yadvā tvayārcitena ca ||78|| phalairvātūpavāsena dvādaśīṃ na vilaṃghayet | gurvīṇīnā gṛhasthānāṃ kṣīṇānāṃ rogiṇāṃ tathā ||79|| śiśūnāṃ valigātrāṇāṃ saṃgrāmakṣitisevinām | yajñabhogodyatānāṃ ca pātivratyāḍhyayoṣitām ||1.288.80 || yuvatīstrīpatīnāṃ ca na yuktaṃ samupoṣaṇam | kimanyairbahubhirbhūpa vākyālāpakṛtairmayā ||81|| bhojane’tra kṛte prītirekādaśyāṃ tvayā mama | na prītiryadi me chitvā śiraḥ svaṃ hi prayacchasi ||82|| na kariṣyasi ced rājan bhojanaṃ harivāsare | tadā tvasatyavacaso dehaṃ na sparśayāmi te ||83|| satyena sūryastapati śaśī satyena śobhate | satyadharmasthitā bhūmiḥ sarvaṃ dhārayate jagat ||84|| vāyurvātyapi satyena satyena jvalate’nalaḥ | satyādhāramidaṃ sarvaṃ yathākāryaṃ vyavasthitam ||85|| sindhurna calate satyād vindhyaḥ satyānna vardhate | vṛkṣāḥ satyasamācārā ṛtumāsādya puṣpiṇaḥ ||86|| aśvamedhāyutebhyo’pi satyameva viśiṣyate | asatyavacaso rājan sarvaṃ śīghraṃ vinaśyati ||87|| mā bhūt tādṛk ca te rājanśocāmi bahulābhakṛt | bahūnāṃ bhojane lābho dṛśyate’to haṭho mama ||88|| matpitrāpi tathaivoktaṃ satyenaivocyate mayā | yadi cette na viśvāso yathecchasi tathā kuru ||89|| mohinītthamabhidhāya pitṛkāryaprasādhinī | virarāma yadā lakṣmi rājā cintāṃ jagāma vai ||1.288.90|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne rukmāṃgadasya samāhātmyakārtiṃkavratecchāyāṃ mohinyā tannirodhanaṃ punaśca svapaṭahaghoṣaṇāyāṃ prabodhinīvratānumatiyācanāyāṃ mohinyā kṛtastadvirodha ityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||288||
<1.289> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha lakṣmi daśamyāṃ kārtike dharmāṃgadaḥ prage | paṭahaṃ vādayitvā vāraṇopari praghoṣayan || 1 || mā bhoktavyaṃ janaiḥ kaiścidekādaśyāṃ harerdine | sainyaṃ prajāśca nītvā sa yayau raivatatīrthake || 2 || kartuṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ raivatādreḥ sandhāvalīyutaḥ | ekādaśīṃ samārabhya pūrṇimāvadhipañcake || 3 || kartuṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ tatrāyānti tīrthāni devatāḥ | prabodhinyāṃ raivatādrau brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || 4 || ṛṣayo vasavaḥ sādhyā maruto munayastathā | pitaro nidhayaḥ kāṣṭhā grahā rudrāśca siddhayaḥ || 5 || kṛttikāścandranakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ surakoṭayaḥ | yakṣarākṣasapaiśācā bhūtapretavināyakāḥ || 6 || kūṣmāṇḍāścāpi vetālā gaṇeśāśca gaṇādayaḥ | hanūmanto mahālakṣmyaḥ paryo yoginya ityapi || 7 || durgāścaṇḍyo mānavāśca devā nadyaḥ sarāṃsi ca | samudrāḥ parvatāḥ sthalyo dvīpāḥ kṣetrāṇi kheṭakāḥ || 8 || puryo’raṇyāni divasā niśā divā vratānyapi | evamanye vyomasaṃsthāḥ pātālasthā bhujaṃgamāḥ || 9 || satyaḥ sādhvyaśca bhaktānyo nyāsinyaśca kumārikāḥ | dehakṛṣṇārpaṇaparā narā nāryaḥ prayānti ca || 1.289.10 || cāraṇyaścāpi kinnaryo gāndharvyo dāsikāstathā | vaiṣṇavāḥ śāṃkarāḥ saurā gāṇapatyāśca śaktigāḥ || 11 || cārvākā bījamārgāśca nārasiṃhāśca rāmiṇaḥ | dāttātreyāḥ kāpilāścārhatā bauddhāḥ śivāśritāḥ || 12|| mahānto guravo dharmācāryāścatuḥpumarthakāḥ | ābhīrā ūraṇavārā gopālā vāmamārgiṇaḥ || 13 || mahābhāgavātā merā nartakā naṭajātayaḥ | aghorapathalambāśca gāruḍā bhairavāśritāḥ || 14|| haṃsāḥ paramahaṃsāśca sadaṇḍāḥ kuladevinaḥ | vidyādharāśca gaṇikā bahurūpāśca nāṭikāḥ || 1 5|| gorakṣāḥ kāravaḥ sāmbāścāturvarṇyāśramānugāḥ | pradakṣiṇārthamāyānti raivatādrau tu kārtike || 16|| jalānnavastradehādyarpakā yatra tvasaṃkhyakāḥ | āyānti puṇyamokṣārthaṃ gurvarpaṇavidhāyinaḥ || 17|| śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīharirnārāyaṇāvirbhāvamūrtayaḥ | āyānti janamokṣārtha pradakṣiṇasavotsukāḥ || 18|| saurāṣṭramaṇḍalaṃ tasya tīrthakṣetrasamaṃ tathā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāllakṣmīyugatra parvate || 19 || mūrdhni saṃrājate divyaḥ sahagolokamaṇḍalaḥ | ekā pradakṣiṇā yena kṛtā tena tataḥ khalu || 1.289.20 || jīveśabrahmalokānāṃ kṛtā syātsā pradakṣiṇā | yatphalaṃ labhyate brahmadhāmnaḥ pradkṣiṇābhavam ||21 || tadatra labhyate puṇyaṃ saṃsārabhavavārakam | iti matvā rājaputro dharmāṃgadaḥ pradakṣiṇām || 22|| kartuṃ daśamyāṃ tvāyāto yoginīparvatāgrataḥ | māhīṣaparvatapārśve svarṇarekhānadītaṭe || 23 || mahodyāne tvāmravaṇe niśāṃ vyagamayat tataḥ | prātardāmodaraṃ dṛṣṭvā snātvā kuṇḍe bhaveśvaram || 24||| nṛsiṃhaṃ ca tathā dṛṣṭvā mṛgīkuṇḍaṃ vyalokayat|| dharmāṃgado janagāthāṃ śrutavām̐statra śobhanām || 25 || rājā rukmāṃgadaścātra mohinyā saha rājate | brahmaputryā prasevito dharmāṃgadapitāsti yaḥ || 26 || saḥ svapaṭahaghoṣeṇa na bhuṃkte harivāsare | nirodhayati taṃ nārī bhoktavyaṃ harivāsare || 27|| kīdṛśī sā brahmaputrī pṛthvyāṃ rājñā vadhūkṛtā | tapo’rthaṃ nirgataścāpi vadhūṃ kṛtvā ca yāṃ punaḥ || 28 || sevate khalu rukmāṃgo harerdinaṃ jahāti na | draṣṭavyā sā devaputrī tvitikṛtvā janā yayuḥ || 29|| dharmāgado’pi sainyena svamātrā sahito yayau | suvarṇarakṣāsaritaścottare sarasastaṭe || 1.289.30 || yatra divyo mahān saudho vairājasyeva rājate | grāmo divyaḥ svaḥpatīnāṃ vimānamiva rājate || 31 || brahmaṇā viṣṇunā śaṃbhunā pradattaṃ svaloṃ’kajam | divyopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ satyalokīyavastujam || 3 2|| dāsadāsyastathā divyāḥ sarvaṃ divyaṃ virājate | carmacakṣurjanaiḥ sarvamadṛśyaṃ yaddhi vartate || 33 || dharmāṃgadena tatsarvaṃ lokitaṃ pitranugrahāt | mahadāścaryamāpanno vavande caraṇau pituḥ || 34|| sandhyāvalyāpi svapatyuścaraṇau vanditau mudā | brahmaputrī vavande tāṃ jyeṣṭhā svasāramityatha || 35 || svasrā tvāśīrvādamukhyairmohinī cābhivardhitā | vṛttāntaṃ kuśalaṃ cāpi jñātvā parasparaṃ tataḥ || 36 || premamagnāśca te sarve pradakṣiṇārthaṃ niryayuḥ | mohinī tu haṭhāt pradakṣiṇārthaṃ na yayau tadā || 37 || atha dharmāgadenāsyāścaraṇau vanditau mudā | heturjijñāsito manobhagnatāyāstadagrataḥ || 38 || rukmāṃgadena tatsarvaṃ vijñāpitaṃ vratātmakam | vratanirodhayitryāstacchratvāścaryaṃ yayurjanāḥ || 39 || rukmāṃgadastadā prāha tvanunīya śubhaṃ vacaḥ | mohini kuru yātrāṃ tvaṃ raivatādreḥ pradakṣiṇam ||1.289.40 || vrataṃ harerdinasyāpi prabodhinyāḥ parātparam | ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyaṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi ||41 || akāryakaraṇejantorgosahasravadhaḥ smṛtaḥ | jānannapi kathaṃ devi bhokṣye’haṃ harivāsare ||42|| puroḍāśo’pi vedhoje samprāpte bhagavaddine | abhakṣyeṇa samaṃ proktaḥ kiṃ punaścānnabhakṣaṇam ||43|| kṣīṇānāṃ phalamūlādi payaādi prabhojanam | prakīrtitaṃ vrate devi saśaktānāṃ nahi kvacit ||44|| saśaktānāṃ vrate’danaṃ narakāyaiva kevalam | māgrahaṃ kuru satyasthe vratabhaṃgo bhavenmama ||45|| yadanyad rocate tubhyaṃ tatkarttāsmi na saṃśayaḥ | mohinyuvāca śṛṇvatsu rājñīdharmāṃgadādiṣu || 86|| ṛṣimunisurapitṛjaṃgamasthāvarādiṣu | na tvanyad rocate rājan vinā vai bhojanaṃ tava ||47|| jīvitasyāpi dānena na me kiṃcitprayojanam | na ca vedeṣu dṛṣṭo’yamupavāso harerdine ||48|| vedabāhyaṃ kathaṃ dharmaṃ bhavām̐ścaritumicchati | śṛṇvantu brāhmaṇāḥ sarve vedān kṛtvāyamagrataḥ ||49|| satyaṃ vadati rājā kiṃ nāhaṃ bhokṣye harerdine | sarvaṃ vai sthāvaraṃ yadvā jaṃgamaṃ tvannajīvanam ||1.289.50 || mṛtā api diviṣadaḥ prīyante’nnairjalairapi | pipīlikādayaścānnaṃ mukhenādāya kaṣṭataḥ ||5 1|| cāturmāsyārthamevaite śītartukṣapaṇāya ca | praviśanti bile tatra sañcinvantyadanāharṇam ||52|| anne vai prāṇināṃ prāṇā annaṃ kasya na rocate | rājā khādati nānnādi samprāpte harivāsare || 93|| tapasvināṃ tu sādhūnāṃ yujyate’nnavivarjanam | upavāsādikaraṇaṃ bhūbhujāṃ kiṃ nu vaidikam ||54|| paradharmo na cācaryo duḥkhadaśca bhayāvahaḥ | so’yamadya mahīpālo yaterdharme vyavasthitaḥ ||55|| annātprabhavati prāṇaḥ prāṇāddehabalādikam | balena nṛpadharmāśca taddhīnaḥ paribhūyate ||56|| evaṃ jñātvā mayā rājā bodhyamāno na buddhyati | atrārthe brāhmaṇāḥ sarve pramāṇaṃ na tu bhāminī ||57|| yāthātathyaṃ vadantvatra vaidikaṃ tat karomyaham | patnīvratavaśiṣṭhādyā brāhmaṇā nṛpamabruvan ||58|| ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyamiti yaḥ śapathastava | na kṛto vedadṛṣṭyā vai svabuddhyaiva prakalpitaḥ ||59|| sāgnīnāṃ prāśanaṃ proktaṃ havyasya sandhyayoḥ kila | pratyahaṃ homaśiṣṭasya bhoktṛtvaṃ vedasammatam ||1.289.60 || viśeṣeṇa nṛpāṇāṃ tu nityayajñaprakāriṇām | vadātra bhūmipālānāṃ kathamuktamupoṣaṇam || 61 || vaidiko’vaidikā vāpi yastvayā śapathaḥ kṛtaḥ | paripūrṇo bhavatvadya vākyenaiva dvijanmanām || 62 || vratabhaṃgo na te’stīha bhuṃkṣva viprādibhiḥ saha | paritāpo na te kāryo vipravākyaṃ mahattamam ||6 3 || vayaṃ hi vedadraṣṭāro brahmavākyaṃ janārdanaḥ | yo’nyathā manute viprād rākṣasīṃ yonimāpnuyāt || 64|| śrutvaitad brāhmaṇānāṃ tu vaidikānāṃ vacastataḥ | ruvamāṃgadaḥ praṇipatya vedadraṣṭṝnuvāca ha || 65|| yūyaṃ vedapradaṣṭāro vaidikaṃ vadatha dhruvam | anādṛtya paraṃ vedamupadeśo na vaḥ kvacit || 66 || nāradarṣistathā kātyāyano vaśiṣṭha ityapi | brahmācātha mahādevo ye tvanye’tra samāgatāḥ ||67|| śṛṇutaiṣāṃ tu vākyāni harerdine vratakṛte | nāradasya vacastatra prathamaṃ śṛṇuta dvijāḥ || 68|| nityaṃ bhaktisamāyuktairnarairviṣṇuparāyaṇaiḥ | pakṣe pakṣe ca kartavyamekādaśyāmupoṣaṇam || 69 || ekādaśyāṃ tu yo bhuṃkte naro’nnaṃ sa tu pātakī | viṇmūtrapūyavāhinyāṃ patatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||1.289.7 0 || anukalpo nṛṇāṃ proktaḥ kṣīṇānāṃ varavarṇini | mūlaṃ phalaṃ payastoyamupabhogyaṃ bhavecchubhe ||7 1 || natveva bhojanaṃ kaiścidekādaśyāṃ budhairmatam | śayane ca madutthāne matpārśvaparivartane ||72 || naro mūlaphalāhārī hṛdi śalyaṃ mamārpayet | daśamyādi mahīpāla | tridināni vivarjayet ||73 || gandhatāmbūlapuṣpādi strīsaṃbhogaṃ divāniśam | jāgaraṃ viṣṇupūjāṃ ca vinā tvardhaphalaṃ vratam ||74|| atastābhyāṃ yutopoṣyā vaiṣṇavena harestithiḥ | vratāni viṣṇubhaktānāṃ nityānīmāni saṃjaguḥ ||75 || ekādaśyo’khilāḥ śuddhā dvādaśī vāmanasya tu | śrīrāmādityasajjanmanavamī divyasiddhidā ||76|| kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamī cātha nṛsiṃhasya caturdaśī | śivarātriścetimukhyavratānyuktāni tattvataḥ ||77 || iti nāradavākyāni hyatha kātyāyanasya ca | sarve śṛṇvantu munayo bhavanto vedadṛṣṭayaḥ ||78 || ekādaśyāmahorātraṃ bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret | ekādaśyāmupavaset pakṣayorubhayorapi ||79|| upavāsaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ | vaśiṣṭhasyāpi vākyaṃ vai śṛṇvantu vedadṛṣṭayaḥ ||1.289.8 0 || upoṣyaikādaśīṃ rājan dvādaśīdivase tathā | tajjapyajapanadhyānatatkathāśravaṇādayaḥ ||8 1 || upavāsakṛtāmete guṇāścānye dayādayaḥ | vedhovākyaṃ tu śṛṇvantu ṛṣayo vedadṛṣṭayaḥ || 8 2|| aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca | ekenaivopavāsena prabodhinyāṃ labhennaraḥ ||8 2 || prabodhavāsare viṣṇorvidhivat samupoṣayet | tāmupoṣya harerbhaktyā durlabhaṃ na bhavet kvacit ||84|| śivavākyaṃ ca śṛṇvantu bhavanto vedadṛṣṭayaḥ | na śaivo na ca sauro’sau na śākto gaṇasevakaḥ ||85|| yo bhuṃkte vāsare viṣṇorjñeyaḥ paśvadhiko hi saḥ | vipriyaṃ ca kṛtaṃ tena duṣṭenaiva tu pāpinā ||86 || madbhaktibalamāśritya yo bhuṃkte vai harerdine | iti bhavanto vaktāro niṣeddhāro’pi te punaḥ ||87|| kathaṃ tatra suviśvāso mayā kāryo vratārdane | sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ bhavanto mārgadarśinaḥ ||88 || viparītā yadi syuste jagadāndhyaṃ samāpnuyāt | akāryakaraṇaṃ kṛtvā kiṃ jīveccharadāṃ śatam ||89|| yuṣmākaṃ tāni vākyāni brūta cāvaidikāni kim | so’haṃ kathaṃ karomyatra tvabhakṣyānnasya bhakṣaṇam || 1.289.90 || kathaṃ cāpi vrataṃ tyakṣye vimārgasthajanoktitaḥ | bhavadbhirnocitaṃ vaktuṃ pratikūlaṃ vratāpaham || 91 || devā vā dānavā daityā gāndharvā rākṣasāśca vā | siddhā vā brāhmaṇā vāpi pitā me jananī ca me || 9 2|| harirvāpi haro viṣṇurmohinījanako’pi vā | ṛṣayo’pi vadeyuścenno bhokṣye harivāsare || 93 || yo hi rukmāṃgado rājā vikhyāto haribhaktimān | vratapratijñāṃ viphalāṃ na kadācit kariṣyati ||94|| sūryastu kṛṣṇatāṃ gacchenmeruḥ sthānāccaled yadi | samudraḥ śuṣkatāṃ yāyād vahniḥ śaityānvito bhavet || 95 || viparītā bhavantaḥ syurmohinī mriyate’pi vā | tathāpi na tyaje viprā vratamekādaśīdine || 96|| āraṭyatai paṭahena prasiddhirbhuvaneṣu me | daṇḍyo vadhyo vivāsyaśca hyannādo harivāsare || 97|| evaṃ khyāte yadi bhoktānnasya syāṃ harivāsare | amedhyaliptaḥ paṭaho bhaveddhoṣo’nṛtānvitaḥ ||98 || kīrtiḥ kaluṣatāṃ gacched yāmye vāsaśca me bhavet | vṛthā sūtā janitrī syānnirāśāḥ pitaraḥ surāḥ || 99 || harṣaṃ gacched yamaścāpi vratabhaṃgaśca me bhavet | mohinī kṛtakṛtyā syād vāntyāśīva bhavāmyaham || 1.289.100 || rājā dharmadharo’haṃ so’dharmapoṣṭā kathaṃ bhavet | na vedā nāpi santaste munayaḥ ṛṣayo’pi na || 101 || ye maṇḍayanti kṛṣṇasya vāsare bhojanakriyām | ityabhidhāya natvā ca virarāma nṛpastadā || 102 || śrutvaitad brāhmaṇā devāḥ praśaśaṃsurnṛpaṃ mudā | kintu kopasuraktākṣī mohinī jvalitāntarā || 103 || śṛṇvatsu teṣu sarveṣu bhartāraṃ samabhāṣata | svakāryasādhinī viṣṇuvrataghnī ca kṣurāntarā || 104 || | iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne paṭahaghoṣaṃ kurvato dharmāṃgadasya kārtike raivatapradakṣiṇāraṃbhe svapitṛrukmāṃgadasamāgame mohinyā ekādaśīvratavināśakahaṭhena ṛṣīṇāṃ rājñā vākyasaṃvāda iti nirūpaṇanāmaikonanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 289 ||
<1.290> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tadā kruddhā sveṣṭasiddhyai tu mohinī | atyāgrahaṃ cakārāsya rājño vāgdānapūraṇe || 1 || kopasaṃraktanayanā bhartāraṃ pratyabhāṣata | karoṣi cenna me vākyaṃ dharmabāhyo bhaviṣyasi || 2 || tvayā mamārpitaḥ pāṇirvaradānāya bhūpate | cenna dāsyasi kṛtakṛtyā yāsye sarvaṃ mayārjitam || 3 || na cāhaṃ te priyā patnī na ca tvaṃ me patiḥ priyaḥ | dhik tvāṃ dvibhāṣiṇaṃ dharmavacolopakaraṃ naram || 4 || satyāccalitamadya tvāṃ tyakṣye svārthaparāyaṇam | ityuktvā satvaraṃ tanvī prasthitādhomukhī ruṣā || 5 || tadānīṃ pitṛbhakto’tra rukmāṃgadasutaḥ svayam | dharmāṃgado jananyā vai sammukho’bhūnnanāma tām || 6 || namraḥ provāca tāṃ devi kathaṃ ruṣṭā pituḥ priye | prasthānaṃ tu na te yogyaṃ mātaryogyaṃ vadāmyaham || 7 || dharmāṃgadavacaḥ śrutvā mohinī vākyamabravīt | pitā tavānṛtī putra hasto yenānyathākṛtaḥ || 8 || yena kṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ vai dhvajāṃkuśāṃkitena tu | taddhastaṃ ca mama haste vinyasya yadvaco’rpitam || 9 || na karotyeṣa te janmapitā kiṃ pravadāmyaham | na mayā tvatra vastavyaṃ hyanṛtārthapratāriṣu || 1.290.10 || na yāce kāṃcanaṃ dhānyaṃ hastyaśvaṃ grāmavāsasī | yena tasya bhaveddhānistādṛg yāce na vai suta || 11 || yenāsau prīṇayed dehaṃ patnīṃ māṃ navayauvanām | tanmayā prārthitaṃ putra so’yaṃ mohānna yacchati || 12|| tasya mamopakārāya yācito nṛpasattamaḥ | sukhahetoḥ puṣṭihetostaccāpi no karotyayam || 13|| sukhacyutaṃ cyutaṃ satyāt tyaktvā yāmi sukhālayam | tacchrutvā mohinīṃ natvā tato dharmāṃgado’bravīt || 14|| divyamātarnivartasva kariṣye’haṃ tavepsitam | yasya satye sthitā lokāḥ sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ || 15|| vaivasvatagṛhaṃ yena kṛtaṃ śūnyaṃ harerbalāt | kīrtiḥ prakāśate yasya vyāpya brahmāṇḍakoṭiṣu || 16|| matpitā sa kathaṃ mayi jīvati hyanṛtī bhavet | mamopari dayāṃ kṛtvā nivartasva śubhaṃ bhavet || 17|| etaddharmāṃgadavākyamākarṇya sveṣṭalālasā | nyavartata tataḥ prāha tātaṃ dharmāṃgadaḥ sutaḥ || 18|| tātaiṣā jananī me’dya tvāṃ vadatyanṛtī tviti | kasmāttvamanṛtī bhūpa bhaviṣyasi mayi sthite || 19|| pradehi sakalaṃ tvasyai yat tvayā samayīkṛtam | ahaṃ dāsastava rājan vikrīyatāṃ tṛṇāya mām ||1.290.20|| devyai dadasva cedicchejjīvitaṃ me ṛtī bhava | kīrtināśo mahānnāśo na nāśaḥ sutayoṣitoḥ ||2 1 || kīrtilābho mahān lābho na lābhaḥ sutayoṣitoḥ | dharmāṃgadavacaḥ śrutvā rukmāṃgada uvāca tam || 22|| kīrtirnaśyatu me putra hyanṛtī vā bhavāmyaham | yāmi vā nirayaṃ tvandhaṃ kathaṃ bhokṣye harerdine |||2 3 || yadyahaṃ kutsitāṃ yoniṃ vrajeyaṃ krimisaṃjñitām | tathāpi naiva kartā syāṃ bhojanaṃ tu harerdine ||24|| vratārthaṃ dundubhirvakti vitatho na sa me bhavet | abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā kiṃ jīveccharadāṃ śatam ||25 || asatyaṃ bhavatu proktaṃ na bhokṣye harivāsare | dhikkṛto’pi janaistvatra mohinyā rahito’pi vā ||26 || yadi cenmaraṇaṃ me’sti na bhokṣye harivāsare | kathaṃ harṣamahaṃ kuryāṃ dṛṣṭvā yāmyapuraṃ gatān ||27|| yāstu śūnyāḥ kṛtāḥ putra mayā narakapaṃktayaḥ | janaiḥ pūrṇā bhaveyustā bhukte mayi harerdine || 28 || bhojanaṃ vāsare viṣṇoḥ kārayitvāpi te prasūḥ | yācate yamarājasya kṣetraṃ pūrayituṃ khalā || 29 || tanna dāsyāmi mohinyai devaiḥ śāṭhyamidaṃ kṛtam | śaṭhā ceyaṃ śaṭhā devāḥ śaṭhe śāṭhyaṃ prakalpayet ||1.290.30 || pibedviṣaṃ viśedvahniṃ nipatet parvatāgrataḥ | svasyāḥ chindyācchiraścāpi na bhokṣye’haṃ harerdine || 31 || mohinī maraṇaṃ yātu yatheṣṭaṃ vā pragacchatu | nāhaṃ bhokṣye harerahni janmamṛtyuhare vrate || 3 2|| ekādaśyupavāsena yanmayā puṇyamarjitam | saṃcitaṃ ca yaśastadvai bhuktvā vināśaye katham || 33 || svapiturvacanaṃ śrutvā dharmāṃgado’tidhārmikaḥ | sandhyāvalīṃ tadā prāha mohinīṃ parisāntvaya || 34|| yathā na cyavate satyād yathā bhuṃkte na me pitā | tathā vidhīyatāṃ yatra kuśalaṃ tūbhayorbhavet || 35 || putravacastu sā śrutvā mohinīṃ prāha pūrvajā | anuvartasva rājānaṃ māgrahaṃ kuru pāpake || 36 || nāsvādayati rājānnaṃ saṃprāpte harivāsare | kāmaṃ varaya satyasthe varamanyaṃ sudurlabham || 37|| kaniṣṭhāyā variṣṭhāhaṃ kariṣye pādavandanam | patyurarthe pariṇītā karomi mastakārpaṇam || 38 || pariṇītā tu nāsi tvaṃ kuto’nyathedṛśāgrahaḥ | vācā śapathadoṣaiśca sannirudhyaṃ pratārya yā || 39 || kārayet patimakṛtyaṃ sā pāpā narakaṃ vrajet | cyutā ca narakātsapta pañca janmāni śūkarī ||1.290.40 || tato bhavati cāṇḍālī tataśca kāṣṭhilā bhavet | tataśchuchundarī syācca tataḥ kākī śṛgālikā ||4 1 || godhā bhūtvā tataḥ sā vai gotve naiva praśuddhyati | vipakṣasyāpi bhagini sadbuddhidānamuttamam ||42|| yena śreyaḥ paraṃ syādvai sukhaṃ sukhayituḥ sadā | sandhyāvalīvacaḥ śrutvā mohinī prāha mānavaḥ ||43 || mānanīyāsi me jyeṣṭhe karomi vacanaṃ tava | yadi cennācared rājā bhojanaṃ harivāsare ||44|| kuruṣva tvaparaṃ devi maraṇādadhikaṃ tava | mamāpi duḥkhadaṃ tvetad rāṣṭrasyāpi praśokakṛt ||45|| kasyeṣṭaṃ maraṇaṃ devi kasyāniṣṭaṃ ca jīvanam | daivāviṣṭo janaḥ sarvo’niṣṭaṃ cāpi karoti vai ||46|| caturvargacyutaṃ ghoraṃ yaśobhāgyavināśakam | karmarekhāprabhagno vai karotyaśubhakarma tat ||47|| sāhaṃ pāpadurācārā vratakāmā sanirghṛṇam | yādṛgbhāvānvitaṃ bījaṃ tādṛśī jāyate kriyā ||48 || yādṛśena tu bhāvena yonau śukraṃ samutsṛjet | tādṛśena tu bhāvena santānaṃ saṃbhavediti ||49|| sāhaṃ rukmāṃgadanāśabhāvena brahmaṇā kṛtā | duṣṭabhāvā tathā jātā duṣṭakartrī nṛpasya yat ||1.290.5 0|| na lagnaṃ na grahā devi na horā puṇyadarśinī | kintu niṣekabhāvena bhāvitaṃ bālakaḥ bhavet ||5 1 || na tatra prabalaṃ kvāpi dākṣiṇyaṃ mitratā tathā | na ca vrīḍā na ca sneho na dharmo na dayādikam ||52|| vakṣye prāṇaharaṃ te’dya nṛpasya ca sutasya ca | prajānāṃ ca vadhūnāṃ ca yadakāryaṃ hi sarvathā ||53 || kartuṃ śakyaṃ na manasā śrotuṃ karṇena nāpi yat | tat kathaṃ vai śarīreṇa kartuṃ śakyeta mānavi ||54|| karoṣi ced bhavet kīrtistava rājñaśca sadyaśaḥ | svargatistava putrasya praśaṃsā mama dhikkṛtiḥ ||55|| mohinīvacanaṃ śrutvā devī sandhyāvalī priye | dhairyamālambya tāṃ tanvīṃ brūhi brūhityacodayat ||56|| mā vadaivaṃ navavadhu bhartrarthe sakalaṃ bhavet | ātmano nidhane vāpi putrasya nidhane’pi vā ||57|| bharturarthe prakurvantyā rājyanāśe na me vyathā | yasyā bhartā bhaved duḥkhī tasyāḥ proktā hyadhogatiḥ ||58|| caṇḍike sā tavaivāstu na me bharturmamāpi na | matputrasyāpi sā māstu yā tvadīyā bhaviṣyati ||59|| saṃjāte sukhadāmpatye bhāryā mokṣavirodhinī | bhūtvā duḥkhapradā syāccenna bhāryā sā tu rākṣasī || 1.290.60 || bhāryā samuddharetpāpātpatantaṃ niraye patim | sā bhāryānyā karmavallīrūpā saṃsāravardhinī ||61 || jīvitenāpi vacasā bhartāraṃ vaṃcayettu yā | kṛmiyoniśataṃ prāpya puṣkasī jāyate tu sā || 62|| patirhi daivataṃ loke vañcanīyo na bhāryayā | sā tvaṃ brūhi pradāsyāmi bharturarthe tavepsitam ||63 || vittaṃ dehaṃ tathā putraṃ yattvanyadvā sudurlabham | kimanyad daivataṃ loke strīṇāmekaṃ patiṃ vinā ||64|| tasyārthe vā tyajet sarvaṃ jīvanaṃ kiṃ tato’dhikam | śrutveti mohinī prāha svārthamohakaraṇḍikā ||65|| yadyevaṃ tvaṃ vijānāsi bhartrarthaṃ dhanajīvanam | tadāhaṃ yācaye vittaṃ jīvitādadhikaṃ śubhe ||66|| dehi putraśiro mahyaṃ yadiṣṭaṃ hṛdayādhikam | yadi no bhojanaṃ kuryād rājā vai harivāsare ||67|| tadā svahaste saṃgṛhya khaḍgaṃ rājā patistava | dharmāṃgadaśiraśchitvā mamotsaṃge dadātu vai ||68|| etadvā kuru tadbhadre yadānnaṃ na bhunakti saḥ | tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasyā mohinyāḥ kaṭukākṣaram ||69|| pracakampe kṣaṇaṃ sandhyāvalī matvā tu rākṣasīm | śanairdhairyaṃ samālambya dharmavākyānyuvāca ha ||1.290.70 || dhanaṃ tyajet tyajed dārān jīvitaṃ ca gṛhaṃ tyajet | tyajed deśaṃ tyajedbhūpaṃ svargaṃ mitraṃ guruṃ tyajet ||71|| tyajettīrthaṃ tyajeddharma tyajetputraṃ bahupriyam | tyajedyogaṃ tyajeddānaṃ jñānaṃ puṇyakriyāṃ tyajet ||72|| tapastyajet tyajedviśvāṃ siddhiṃ mokṣaṃ tyajet param | pakṣayorubhayoścāpi na tyajeddharivāsaram ||73|| ekādaśyā vratenaiva tatsarvaṃ prāpyate muhuḥ | tatrāpi bhartṛtuṣṭyarthe sarvaṃ jahyāt pativratā ||74|| dāpaye tava tuṣṭyarthaṃ patyurvrataprapūtaye | dharmāṃgadaśiraścaṇḍe rākṣasī tvaṃ na devajā ||75|| na satyāccālaye caṇḍe patyarthaṃ ca vratārthakam | ityuktvā vinayātpādau bhartuḥ saṃgṛhya padmaje ||76|| uvāca vacanaṃ rājñī dharmāṃgadaśiraḥkṛte | mohinyā moharūpāyā nānyat saṃkocate khalu ||77|| bhojanaṃ vāsare viṣṇorbadhaṃ vā tanayasya vai | dharmatyāgād varaṃ nātha putramūrdhanikṛntanam ||78|| vyāpādya sutaṃ rājan snehaṃ tyaktvā sudūrataḥ | mā satyalaṃghanaṃ kārṣīradharmo mā spṛśet tvayi ||79|| mātṛsneho’tra bhartrarthe putre bhavati sārthakaḥ | dharmasnehasvarūpo’yaṃ gṛhīto na tu laukikaḥ ||1.290.80|| prāṇān datvā priyāṃ datvā putraṃ sarvasvameva vā | satyaṃ harervrataṃ rakṣyaṃ hṛṣīkeśārthamatra hi ||8 1 || tadalaṃ paritāpena satyaṃ pālaya bhūpate | satyasya pālanād rājan viṣṇudehena yujyate ||82|| manye bhūpāla devaiḥ sā tvadvrataparipanthibhiḥ | śikṣitā preṣitā satyavināśāya harervrate ||83|| putravyāpādanād devā bhaviṣyanti tvadhomukhāḥ | teṣāṃ mūrdhni padaṃ datvā yāsyase paramaṃ padam ||84|| viruddhā vibudhā bhūpa seśvarāstava sadvrataiḥ | mokṣamārgaprabhettārastava niścayalopakāḥ ||85|| rītirvai devatāḥ paripanthino bhaktimārgiṇām | sa tvaṃ bhūpa dṛḍho bhūtvā ghātayasva sutaṃ priyam ||86|| mohinyāḥ kuru vākyaṃ vai hyātmanaḥ satyapālanāt | pālanāya vrataṃ viṣṇoḥ kuru putrasamarpaṇam ||87|| bhāryāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā rājā rukmāṃgadastadā | sandhyāvalīmuvācedaṃ mohinyāḥ sannidhau priye ||88|| putrahatyā mahāhatyā brahmahatyādhikā bhavet | ghātayitvā sutaṃ tvatra kā paratra gatirbhavet ||89|| aprajaṃ tu sutaṃ hatvā kā gatirme bhaviṣyati | anyārthe kiṃ sutaṃ hanmi kiṃ hanmi harivāsaram ||1.290.90 || na bhokṣye vāsare viṣṇorna hanmi tanayaṃ priye | ātmānaṃ dārayiṣyāmi mohinī mriyatāṃ ca vā ||9 1|| athavā mohinīṃ samyaganunayāmi vai punaḥ | yadi śāntaṃ manastasyāḥ sāmnā syācchreyase yataḥ ||92|| iti vicārya nṛpatiḥ sandhyāvalyāḥ samīpataḥ | rukmāṃgadaḥ sāntvanārthaṃ mohinīmidamabravīt ||93|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dharmāṃgadakṛto mohinī pratyanunayo rukmāṃgadasya vratadārḍhye sandhyāvalyāpatyarthe kṛtopadeśe’pi mohinyā putraśiraso’bhyarthanaṃ sandhyāvalyāḥ śirodānānumatiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 290 ||
<1.291> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mahābhāgavato rukmāṃgado nṛpaḥ | sāmāntimaṃ samāśritya yadabravīttu mohinīm || 1 || duṣṭāgrahamimaṃ subhru parityaja sutaṃ prati | kiṃ phalaṃ bhavitā te’tra hatvā dharmāṃgadaṃ sutam || 2 || bhojayitvā dine viṣṇoḥ ko lābho bhavitā tava | anyaṃ yācasva subhage varaṃ vṛṇe tavāgrataḥ || 3 || prasādaṃ kuru cārvaṃgi putrabhikṣāṃ prayaccha me | durlabho guṇavān putro durlabho harivāsaraḥ || 4 || durlabhājñākarī patnī hareḥ sevāpi durlabhā | kathaṃ putraṃ vrataṃ vāpi hanmi te me paraṃ priyam || 5 || mohinyuvāca rājānaṃ na me tatrāsti cāgrahaḥ | dharmāṃgado na me śatrurnāhaṃ hanmi sutaṃ tava || 6 || tava putro yathā so’yaṃ mama putrastathaiva saḥ | kathaṃ hanmi svakaṃ putraṃ trātāraṃ nirayādaham || 7 || pūrvameva mayā proktaṃ bhuṃkṣva tvaṃ harivāsare | nāhaṃ vyāpādaye putramarthasiddhistu bhojane || 8 || mama bhūmipate kāryaṃ putranāśe na siddhyati | mama kāryasya saṃsiddhirbhojane harivāsare || 9 || yadarthaṃ preṣitā patnīrūpā devaistavāntigā | tataḥ putraḥ priyo’styeva bhujyatāṃ harivāsare || 1.291.10 || satyaṃ saṃrakṣa yatnena kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama | evaṃ dṛḍhāgrahāṃ dṛṣṭvā dharmāṃgado’pyuvāca tām || 11 || etadeva gṛhāṇa tvaṃ mā śaṃkāṃ kuru mohini | ityuktvā khaḍgamādāya prāha svapitaraṃ sutaḥ || 12 || na vilambaḥ pitaḥ kāryastvayā mamanipātane | manmāturvacanaṃ satyaṃ kuru bhūpa pratiśrutam || 13 || ātmā rakṣyo dhanairdāraiḥ sutābhiśca sutairapi | tvadarthe maraṇaṃ me’stu brahmalokapradaṃ bhavet| || 14|| tathāpi śāśvatī muktiḥ svargaṃ vā śāśvataṃ bhavet | satyārthe duḥkhamṛtsṛjya kuru vyāpādanaṃ mama || 15 || pitrarthe cāpi mātrarthe gavārthe ca hatāstu ye | viprasādhu surārthe ca svāśritārthe guroḥ kṛte || 1 6|| dharmārthe ca hatā rājan yānti lokāṃstu śāśvatān | jahi māṃ pālaya satyaṃ mā bhuṃkṣva harivāsare || 17|| naramedho’yamāstheyo harervāsarakāraṇāt | tatra nāsti manākdoṣaḥ paritāpaṃ ca mā vaha || 1 8|| ityetatsamaye lakṣmi devāḥ ṛṣigaṇāstathā | munayaḥ pitaraścāpi manavaśca diśādhipāḥ || 19 || svargīyā vāyavīyāśca bhaumāḥ pātālavāsinaḥ | dṛśyādṛśyaśarīrāśca sthāvarā jaṃgamāstathā || 1.291.20 || devyaḥ koṭyarbudāścāpi tīrthayātrārthamāgatāḥ | brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca viṣṇukṛṣṇanarāyaṇāḥ || 21 || raivatācalamārgasthāḥ paśyantyāścaryasaṃbhṛtāḥ | jijñāsamānāḥ śraiṣṭhyaṃ vai hanane vā hyupoṣaṇe || 22 || dharmatattvaṃ tathā kutra jīvane bhojane’thavā | tadānīṃ vyomamārgastho bhagavān kamalekṣaṇaḥ || 23 || antardhānagatastasthau bhaktadhairyāvalokakaḥ | mohinyuktaṃ bhuṃkṣva rājan putroktaṃ jahi māṃ pitaḥ || 24|| śṛṇvan devaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ satya parīkṣakaḥ | rājā praṇamya govindaṃ khaḍgaṃ jagrāha pāṇinā || 25 || dharmāṃgado’pi pitarau nītvā raivatadevatāḥ | adīnavacano grīvāṃ khaḍgamārge nyadhāpayat || 26|| hāhākāro mahānāsīccākrośastīrthayāyinām | cacāla pṛthivī sarvā sasindhunagarāṣṭrikā || 27|| nipeturulkāḥ śataśo dyaurnistejograhānvitā | kāluṣyamāpustīrthāni vivarṇābhūcca mohinī || 28 || devakāryaṃ kṛtaṃ naiva janma nirarthakaṃ kṛtam | rājñā bhuktaṃ na cānnaṃ vai tṛṇatulyā kṛtā hyaham || 29|| rājā yāsyati mokṣaṃ vai yāmyaṃ yāsyāmi pāpinī | iti śokena mūrchāyāṃ papāta dharaṇītale || 1.291.30 || rājñā pracicchide harṣāt khaḍgena putramastakam | tāvadvyaktena kṛṣṇena paśyatsu koṭidehiṣu || 31 || svakareṇa dhṛto rājā tuṣṭo’smi bruvatā muhuḥ | putreṇa tava patnyā ca tvayā sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ mama || 3 2|| madvratārthaṃ kṛtaṃ cedṃ nānyaḥ kariṣyati kvacit | vijītā mohinīmāyā yamamūrghni padṃ dhṛtam || 33 || tuṣṭo’smi cāgaccha vimānavaryaṃ saputrapatnīsuhṛdādibhiśca | trailokyapūjāṃ vimalāṃ gṛhāṇa prayāhi vāsaṃ mayi divyamūrtau || 34|| divyo rājā caturhasto divyā dārasutādayaḥ | babhūvuḥ kṛṣṇamūrtau te vilīnāḥ sucaturbhujāḥ || 35|| dharmajayapraghoṣāścākāśavāṇyo’bhavam̐stadā | puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papātāmbarasthadevavisarjitā || 36|| lokapālaistāḍitā dundubhayo nedurutkaṭāḥ | jagurgītāni nanṛturmudā yuktāḥ surāṃganā || 37|| raivatena tathā tīrthayāyibhirvardhito nṛpaḥ | sutadārādiyuktasya śāśvataṃ dhāma te’stviti || 38 || yātrālubhistadīyaiśca dehā nārāyaṇe hrade | vahninā saṃskṛtāścordhvakriyāḥ prātaḥ pravartitāḥ || 39 || dhanyavādān prabruvāṇāḥ pradakṣiṇāya te yayuḥ | abhuñjānāḥ prabodhinyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ tvekabhojanāḥ ||1.291.40 || trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ pūrṇāyāṃ caikabhojanāḥ | raivatādriṃ parikramya pūrṇāyāṃ te yayuḥ sukhāḥ ||4 1 || mohinī duḥkhamāpannā savrīḍā cāyaśasvinī | akṛtakāryā cāraṇye martukāmā babhūva ha ||42|| yamo’pi viphalaṃ sarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmāṇamāha vai | mohinī niṣphalā jātā vandhyāstrī janane yathā ||43 || lokaḥ prayāti vaikuṇṭhaṃ na māṃ kaścitprapadyate | nṛpe mṛte’pi lokānāṃ bhaktau hrāso na vartate ||44|| upoṣya vāsaraṃ viṣṇoḥ sarve yānti paraṃ padam | mohinī maraṇodyuktā nāyāti tava sannidhau ||45|| nirvyāpārastvahaṃ prāgvat ki karomi praśādhi mām | yamavākyaṃ samāśrutya brahmā provāca sūryajam ||46 || gacchāmo mohinīṃ bodhayituṃ paścāt tavārthakam | kariṣyāmo yathāyogyaṃ daivamanyad vicintayet ||47|| iti kṛtvā vane tatra samāyātā ajādayaḥ | tejohīnāṃ naṣṭakāryāṃ tvapaśyam̐stā divaukasaḥ ||48 || nirutsāhāṃ namraśīlāmūcurdevā sukālikam | mā śokaṃ kuru dharmajñe pauruṣaṃ hi tvayā kṛtam ||49 || preṣitā devakāryārthaṃ siddhaṃ tanna tathāpi vai | tvayā śoko na kartavyo yayau rājā tu mokṣaṇam ||1.291.50 || nahi śrīharibhaktānāṃ vighnaṃ kadāpi jāyate | hate putre hariṇā svavratabhaktāvanaṃ kṛtam ||5 1 || sutaḥ patnī nṛpaścaite sudṛḍhā vratapālane | viṣṇunā parituṣṭena nītāḥ svabhavane trayaḥ ||52|| teṣāṃ yogaṃ samāpannā nītāścāsaṃkhyadehinaḥ | harerbhaktiḥ sadā rakṣākarī mokṣakarī dhruvam ||53 || phalaṃ karmaṇi cārabdhe yadi devi na siddhyati | sarvayatnairapi cedvai doṣaḥ ko’tra tavādhunā ||54|| tasmād varapradānāya tava saukhyapravṛttaye | samprāptā vibudhāḥ sarve’bhīṣṭayācanikāṃ kuru |||55|| siddhau ca vāpyasiddhau vā vetanaṃ deyameva ha | bhartavyo bhṛtyavargaśca rakṣaṇīyastathā muhuḥ ||56 || surairevaṃ samādiṣṭā patihīnātiduḥkhitā | uvāca mohinī naṣṭānanda kulavināśinī ||57|| dhigidaṃ jīvitaṃ me’tra yena kāryaṃ na sādhitam | na kṛto yamamārgaśca janairgamyastvanargalaḥ ||58 || harerdine na luptaṃ ca na bhuktaṃ harivāsare | rājñā tena prabhaktena hataḥ putro mudā priyaḥ ||59 || gato mūrghni padaṃ datvā rājā viṣṇordhruva padam | sarvasvaṃ me gataṃ tvatra kinnu me jīvitaṃ phalam ||1.291.6 0 || na sādhayanti ye kāryaṃ svāmināṃ vetanārthinaḥ | bhṛtyāste doṣabhoktāro jāyante bhūtale hayāḥ ||61 || kāryasyāsādhikā cāhaṃ bhartṛputravināśinī | kathaṃ varaṃ pragṛhṇāmi bhavatāṃ nākavāsinām ||62|| maraṇaṃ sarvathā śreṣṭhaṃ bhagnamānasya dehinaḥ | iti kṛtvā rurodoccairdevā ūcustu sāntvanām ||63 || pariśramaḥ kṛto devi tvayāsmatkāryasādhane | daivādhīnaṃ phalaṃ jñātvā mā śokaṃ kuru mohinī ||64|| anṛṇāstu bhaviṣyāmaḥ kṛtvā tūpakṛtiṃ tava | saukhyārthaṃ yadbhavediṣṭaṃ dāsyāmo brūhi hṛdgatam ||65 || yatra rukmāṃgadastvāste tatra yātuṃ samīhayā | mohinī manasā yāvadvicārayati tāvatā ||66 || nṛpaterājagāmātra purodhāḥ pāvakopamaḥ | raivatādrergahvarasthasvarṇarekhāhrade vasuḥ ||67|| uṣitaḥ prāṇamāyamya nirgato jalamadhyataḥ | jñātvā yogena satsarvamuvāca varadān surān ||68|| dhigimāṃ dhik devasaṃghaṃ dhikkarma pāpakārakam | kiṃ vicintyāgatāścāsyai varaṃ dātuṃ dhigīśvarān ||69|| sutabhartṛghātinīyaṃ kiṃ pātraṃ gaṇyate surai | nāsyā loke bhavecchuddhirvahnau saṃpatane’pi hi ||1.291.70 || cāṭuvāgbhirmohayitvā bhūtvā svārthaparā priyā | sutabhartṛghātinīyaṃ svamokṣasvargaghātinī ||7 1 || nāsyā vāso niraye’pi kutaḥ svarge harergṛhe | lokāntare’thavā śānte vāsahīnā bhramatviyam ||72|| lokanindādūṣitāyā loke’pyatra na vai sthitiḥ | dhigasyā jīvanaṃ karmagarhitāyā vadāmi kim ||73 || patiṃ hatvā sutaṃ hatvā sapatnīṃ jananīsamām | hatvā dharāṃ samastāṃ ca kāṃ gatiṃ yāsyati nviyam ||74|| vacanenāpi dharmasya vidhvaṃsinī hi sarvadā | uktavatī sadā rājñe bhujyatāṃ harivāsare ||75|| ajñānād vyāhṛte vākye bhujyatāṃ harivāsare | tasyāpi niṣkṛtiḥ proktā prāṇāyāmaśatena vai ||76|| iyaṃ prasahya saṃbhoktrī harerahno vratasya hi | naiṣā spṛśyāsti deveśā kathamasyā varapradāḥ ||77|| pālanaṃ pāpayuktasya na kurvanti divaukasaḥ | devā dharmāśritā dharmo vedavākyasamutthitaḥ ||78|| vedaiḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ bhartuḥ strīṇāṃ dharmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | na pituḥ svārthakaraṇaṃ vadhūdharmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||79|| yad bravīti patiḥ kiṃcitpatnyā kāryamaśaṃkayā | śuśrūṣā sā hi vijñeyā yayā syātpatitoṣaṇam ||1.291.8 0 || bharturājñā hṛtā svasyā ājñāsthāpanavāñchayā | svakāryasādhanārthāya śapathairyantrito nṛpaḥ ||8 1 || ghātinīyaṃ vacobhiśca kriyayāpi vighātinī | kuṭumbaghātinī seyaṃ pāpadehā ca pāpinī ||82|| hatyāyutādhikādheyaṃ varayogyā kathaṃ bhavet | yo’syāḥ pakṣe’pi varteta devo vā dānavo’pi vā ||83|| mohinyā rakṣaṇe kaścit prayatnaṃ kurute yadi | taṃ cāpi bhasmasāt kuryāṃ kṣaṇena surasattamāḥ ||84|| rājā mokṣaṃ gataḥ satyāt pāpamasyāṃ visṛjya vai | asyāḥ pakṣaṃ kurvato’pi pāpaṃ tasyāḥ prasajyate ||85|| ityuktvā krodhatāmrākṣaḥ saṃgṛhya salilaṃ kare | cikṣepa mohinī mūrdhni prajajvālānalastataḥ ||86|| paśyatāṃ nākavāsānāṃ pradadāha sa mohinīm | tāvat| khe mahatāṃ vācaḥ kopaṃ saṃhara saṃhara ||87|| babhūvustāvadeveyaṃ bhasmaśeṣābhavat kṣaṇāt | nirāśā devatāḥ sarve yayurbhagnahṛdo gṛham ||88|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne rukmāṃgadenopadiṣṭasāmottaraṃ krūrāyā icchayā khaḍgena putraśiraśchinnamatha deveṣu paśyatsu sutadāranṛpāṇāṃ mokṣagatirmohinyai dhikpravādāḥ purodhaḥśāpena bhasmījātāmohinīti nirūpaṇanāmaikanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 291 ||
<1.292> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi dagdhadehā pāpisūkṣmaśarīriṇī | yāmyaistu nīyamānā saudghāṭayad yamamārgakam || 1 || vāritā sā yameśena yato yamasahāyinī | yamamārgodghāṭanārthe duḥkhamāptavatī tataḥ || 2 || yamena preṣitā svargaṃ gatā vibudhamandiram | bhartsitā devadūtaistu sthitiste’tra na pāpini || 3 || harivāsaralopinyā vāsaste na surālaye | tataḥ sā duḥkhitā lakṣmi mohinī vāsalabdhaye || 4 || pātālaṃ prayayau tatra pātālasthairnivāritā | suraiśca munibhirdaityairdānavaiḥ ṛṣibhistathā || 5 || pitṛbhirmānavairyakṣairbhūtapretapiśācakaiḥ | tīrthaiśca parvataiḥ khātaiḥ sāgaraiśca vanaistathā || 6 || tattvaiśca lokapālaiśca manubhirjalavāsibhiḥ | dṛṣṭā yairyaistīrthakṛdbhiḥ raivatādrau tu mohinī || 7 || putrahantrī patihantrī dṛṣṭā jaḍaiśca cetanaiḥ | nakṣatraiśca grahairvṛkṣairvallībhiśca tṛṇaistathā || 8 || paśubhiḥ pakṣibhiścaiṣā svasvasthānānnirākṛtā | na kaiścid rakṣitā tasmāt krośantī brahmaṇaḥ sutā || 9 || janakasyāntikaṃ gatvā duḥkhaṃ svaṃ sannyavedayat | tāta tannāsti me sthānaṃ trailokye sacarācare || 1.292.10 || yatra yatra gatā cāsmi tatra tatra kṣipanti mām | tiraskurvanti te sarve nirvāsayanti cāśramāt || 11 || pitrājñayā mayā gatvā rukmāṃgadagṛhaṃ tataḥ | dṛṣṭaṃ vyavasitaṃ caitat sarvalokaghṛṇāspadam || 12|| bhartāraṃ kleśayitvaiva mārayitvā suputrakam | sandhyāvalīṃ nāśayitvā pitaḥ prāptā daśāmimām || 13 || na gatirvidyate jaive caiśvare mokṣaṇe’pi me | viśeṣād vasuśāpena jātāhaṃ duḥkhabhāginī || 14|| yadi tvaṃ tridaśaiḥ sārdhaṃ vasuṃ taṃ śāpadaṃ dvijam | prasādayasi matprītyā tarhi me syācchubhā gatiḥ || 15|| vipraśāpapradagdhānāṃ gaṃgā muktipradā bhavet | bhāryā rukmāṃgadasyāhaṃ vidhavā pāpakāriṇī || 16 || purodhāśca vasurvipro rājñastasmācca me gatiḥ | sa māṃ nayettu tīrtheṣu kṣālayetpātakāni me || 17|| śāpaṃ nivartayeccāpi tato me sugatirbhavet | tāṃ tathāvādinīṃ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 18 || śivendradharmasūryāgnidevādyairmunibhiryutaḥ | mohinīmagrataḥ kṛtvā jagāma vasusannidhau || 1 9|| raivatādrau svarṇarekhānadyaraṇye vasuṃ bhavam | vāmanaṃ gauraveṇāpi nabhaścakre svayaṃ vidhiḥ || 1.292.2 0 || asādhyakārye samprāpte yaviṣṭhaścet karoti tat | na dūṣitaṃ bhavellakṣmi yaviṣṭhasyābhivādanam || 21 || vasurdṛṣṭvā samutthāya namaścakre tvajādikān | surāḥ sarve’rthayāmāsurmoṃ’hinyarthe sukhāvaham || 22|| kṛpāṃ kuru tapaḥśreṣṭha mohinīgatido bhava | yajamānī bhavatyeṣā te rājño gṛhavāsinī ||23 || tvayā tvasyā hitaṃ kāryaṃ mama putryāstapodhana | preṣitāyā mayaivātra devānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 24|| yamalokastathā svargaḥ śūnyo rukmāṃgadena vai | kṛtastayorvasatyarthaṃ mānasī preṣitā mayā ||25|| rukmāṃgadasya mohārthaṃ sa tu prāpa hareḥ padam | gati dharmasyātisūkṣmā lokā jānanti naiva tām || 26 || durlabhaṃ harisāyujyamanayā taiḥ samarjitam | sadāraḥ sasuto rājā prāpito harimandiram | 27|| anayā priyayātīva parīkṣya prāpito’cyutam | anyairna prāpyate dhāma prāpitaṃ tvanayā hi tat || 28 || sa vai putraśca sā patnī sutā sā janakaśca saḥ | yena vai prāpyate mokṣo bandhuḥ suhṛd guruśca saḥ || 29 || harerdine na bhoktavyaṃ vrataṃ pratīpakāgrahāt | dṛḍhīkṛtaṃ nṛpasyātra mohinyā sukṛtaṃ kṛtam || 1.292.30 || tatkāryaṃ pāparūpaṃ vai gaṇayitvā tvayā vaso | śāpadagdhā kṛtā bhasmaśeṣā sūkṣmaśarīriṇī || 31 || tatpraśāmya kṣamasvaināṃ kuruṣvānugrahaṃ mune | śamaṃ bhajasva piṣṭasya peṣo māstu sureśvaraiḥ || 32 || tyaja krauryaṃ bhaja śāntiṃ prasādaṃ kuru putraka śrutvā śāntaḥ kṣamāyukto vasū rājapurohitaḥ || 33 || prāha mayā vicāryaiva mohinyā vasatirdhruvā | nirṇītāsti yadarthaṃ sā nirmitā tatkarotvapi || 34 || yamamārgapravāhārthaṃ vratabhaṃgārthamityapi | harerdinopoṣitānāṃ brahmadhāmagamāya ca || 35 || nirmiteyaṃ mohinīti tayā tatkāryameva ha | patiḥ sapatnī putraścānayā vaikuṇṭhagāḥ kṛtāḥ || 36|| etādṛśasthale ceyaṃ vāse karotu mohinī | asyāḥ sāmīpyata ekādaśīṃ kṛtvā janāḥ sadā || 37|| muktiṃ prayāntu nirvighnāṃ haritoṣaṇasadvratān | asyā dine tu ye bhrāntā vrate mugdhā bhavanti te || 38 || yāntu pāpā yamalokaṃ yamakāryaṃ bhavettathā | eṣā yatra sthitā tadvai vrata bhagnaṃ bhavediti || 39 || tadvai vrataṃ mataṃ na syād vratabhaṃgo hi so’stu vai | evamatra vicintyārtho mayā samyaṅnirūpitaḥ ||1.292.4 0 || vidhavāyāstu mohinyā vāsaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ | sarveṣvapi vrateṣvasyā vāsena duṣṭatā bhavet ||4 1 || tasmād vratadine tvasyā vāso naiva tu yujyate | kintu vratādyadivasaprānte’syā vasatirbhavet ||42 || ādyadivasaprānto’syā vāsena yātu duṣṭatām | vedhaso’syā yato janma tasmādvai vaidhasī matā ||43 || sā yatra tiṣṭhati titheḥ prānte sa vedha ucyate | vedhāśrayā tithistvādyā duṣṭā pāpapradāyinī ||44|| vratavidhvaṃsinī bodhyā yamapuryāḥ pradāyinī | sūryodaye tu yā nāsti sāyaṃkāle tu vartate ||45 || sā tithiryadyupoṣyā syād yāmyapūryāḥ pradāyinī | vrataṃ tasyāṃ na kartavyaṃ viparītaphalaṃ yataḥ ||46 || sūryodaye ca pūrvāhṇe saptamī daśamī ca vā | caturdaśyaṣṭamī vā ca vartate kramaśastathā ||47|| parāhṇe kṛṣṇajanamāṣṭamī caikādaśī tathā | pūrṇā vāmā rāmanavamīti sāyaṃ pravartate ||48|| evaṃ kāle kramaśastu saptamyāḥ prāntake tathā | daśamyante caturdaśyāḥ prānte’ṣṭamyantake tathā ||49 || mohinī tatra vasatu tāḥ pāpāstithayaḥ sadā | ato vrataṃ kramaśastu saptamyāṃ cāṣṭamīvratam ||1.292.50 || yamalokapradaṃ proktaṃ vedhapāpāśrayaṃ hi tat | daśamyāṃ tu vrataṃ hyekādaśyāvrataṃ tu pāpadam |||5 1 || caturdaśyāṃ vrataṃ pūrṇāvrataṃ vāmāvrataṃ tathā | pāpadaṃ yamalokasya prāpakaṃ rātrikṛdvratam ||5 2 || tasmāt sūryodaye yādyā sāyaṃ rātrau tu cetarā | vratātmikā tithiścet syānnaivopoṣyā kadācana ||53 || mohinī tatra vasati saptamyādau dināntake | saptamyādyā na copoṣyāḥ sāyaṃ vratānvitāstvapi || 54|| yamamārgapravāhārthaṃ mohinyai tvarpitā hi tāḥ | tāśca vedhāśrayāḥ pāpāśrayā mohinyadhiśritāḥ ||55|| ayaṃ ca nirṇayaḥ sāyaṃvyāpinyā vratavibhrame | vrataṃ naiva prakartavyamiti devairdṛḍhīkṛtaḥ || 56 || atha sūryodayātpūrvaṃ saptamī daśamī ca vā | caturdaśyaṣṭamī vā ca vartate kramaśastathā ||57|| sūryodaye kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamī caikādaśī tathā | pūrṇā vāmā rāmanavamīti sūrye pravartate ||58 || evaṃ kāle kramaśastu saptamyāḥ prāntake tathā | daśamyante caturdaśyāḥ prānte’ṣṭamyantake prage ||5 9 || vasatu mohinī tatra tattithiyogasandhitā | sūryodaye tithiryā tu prārabhyate vratātmikā ||1.292.6 0 || vedhātmamohinīhṛṣṭā viddhā sā bhavatītyataḥ | viddhātithivrataṃ svargapradapuṇyakaraṃ bhavet ||6 1 || iti devairniścitatvād viddhāvrataṃ tu nākadam | na tu mokṣakaraṃ tatsyāt kṣayyapuṇyapradaṃ hyataḥ ||62|| ato viddhā na kartavyā bhaktaistu mokṣakāṃkṣibhiḥ | kartavyā sarvathā śuddhāṣṭamī caikādaśī tathā ||6 3 || pūrṇimā cāpyamāvāsyā hyevamanyā vratātmikāḥ | tithayaḥ sarvadā śuddhā vrate grāhyā na viddhikāḥ || 64|| na vā sāyaṃtanavyāptā nirṇītaṃ tat suraistadā | śuddhaṃ haridinaṃ bhakta upoṣya yāti mokṣaṇam ||65|| viddhātithiṃ vihāyaiva pare tūpoṣaṇaṃ dine | navamyāṃ dvādaśikāyāṃ pratipaddivase tathā ||66|| daśamyāṃ kramaśaḥ kāryaṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāstathā punaḥ | ekādaśyāḥ pūrṇimāmāvasyayoḥ rāmajanminaḥ ||67|| vrataṃ śuddhaṃ bhavet tadvai mokṣadaṃ harivāsaram | haryāśritaṃ vrataṃ śuddhaṃ viddhantu svargadaṃ matam ||68|| mohinyantaṃ yāmyadaṃ vai yathākartā tathāgatiḥ | ityevaṃ nirṇayaṃ kṛtvā mohinyai sthānamarpitam ||69|| ādititheḥ prāntabhāgaḥ sarvathā yamamārgakṛt | yadi tithidvayaṃ syācced vrataṃ kāryaṃ pare dine ||1.292.70 || titheḥ kṣaye paropoṣyā tithiḥ śuddhā vratārthinā | na tu viddhā kṣayā naiśā hyupoṣyā karhicijjanaiḥ ||71|| vedho niśīthe yamānāmupakārāya mohinī | sūryāt pūrvaṃ surāṇāmupakārāyaiva hi mohinī ||72||| śuddhāviddhāntaritā syādupakārāya mokṣiṇām | sarveṣvapi ca lokeṣu yamasya daśamī tithiḥ ||73|| tasyāḥ prānte sadā stheyaṃ mohinyeti nivāsitā | viddhāvrataphalaṃ tvardhaṃ te vai bhavatu mohini ||74|| niśāvrataphalaṃ sarvaṃ te vai bhavatu mohini | svāghanāśāya te tāvadalaṃ bhavatu mohini ||75|| bhuvi tīrthāni caiva tvaṃ svāghanāśāya sañcara | pāpināṃ pāpanāśāya tīrthāni santi mohini ||76|| hariṣyanti ca te pāpaṃ sthitāstīrthe vrataṃ vinā | avratinaśca tīrthasthā vajralepāghabhāginaḥ ||77|| tava śuddhiḥ sadā teṣu bhaviṣyati punaḥ punaḥ | yamasaṃsthāpanārthāya pāpasaṃcayanāya ca ||78|| dattaṃ te mohini sthānaṃ niśāntasamayāntikam | svargasaṃsthāpanārthāya puṇyasaṃcayanāya ca ||79|| dattaṃ te mohini sthānaṃ prātaḥ sūryodayāntikam | mokṣiṇāṃ tu kṛte tvaṃ vai sarvathā vasa dūrataḥ ||1.292.80 || mokṣivrataṃ svadṛṣṭyā tvaṃ mā nibhālaya bhāmini | tathā sati punarnāśaste bhaviṣyati śāpataḥ ||81 || evaṃ pradiṣṭā brahmādyaistuṣṭā babhūva mohinī | mene kṛtārthaṃ tvātmānaṃ sthānena tīrthayātrayā ||82|| dehe bhasmāvaśeṣe’pi sūkṣmadehena vai punaḥ | yamakāryaṃ surakāryaṃ mokṣakāryaṃ susādhitam ||83 || iti kṛtārthatāṃ dṛṣṭvā prahṛṣṭābhūdatīva sā | svakāryaṃ sādhitaṃ rājñā mohinyā sādhitaṃ svakam ||84|| yamakāryaṃ devakāryaṃ mokṣakāryaṃ pravartitam | atha sūryacandrayostu rāhugrasanakarmaṇi ||85|| rāhudṛṣṭipathe kāle vedhe hi mohinī sthitā | vedhakālo vaidhasī sājñaptā sthātuṃ sureśvaraiḥ ||86 || tasmād vedhe bhojanādi sarvaṃ pāpamayaṃ smṛtam | kṛtaṃ prayāti mohinyai kartā yamapradeśabhāg ||87|| bhavatīti yamamārgastayāpi vāhitastathā | evaṃ tithīnāṃ vedhāstu vratapūrvaṃ vyavasthitāḥ ||88 || bhavati kartari pāpaṃ mohinī phalabhāginī | iti lakṣmi vyavasthāṃ ca sthānaṃ prāpya sumohinī ||89|| devān praṇamya saṃhṛṣṭā natvā purodhasaṃ svakam | prānte sthitā daśamyāderjanamohanakāriṇī || 1.292.90 || sūryodayaspṛśā tasmād daśamī garhitā sadā | aspṛṣṭamudayaṃ cāpi mohanāyaiva kevalam || 91 || iti bruvanto deveśā yayuḥ svasvaniketanam | tadā putrī vedhase vai dagdhadehasya labdhaye || 92||| prārthayāmāsa bahudhā vasuṃ cāpi purodhasam | brahmā prāha vasuṃ cāpi sarvalokavidhānakṛt || 93 || vaso tāta nibodhedaṃ kiṃ te yājyā bravīti vai | tvayeyaṃ mohinī kopāt kṛtā bhasmāvaśeṣitā || 94|| yācate sā sthūlaṃ dehaṃ samutpādya pradehi vai | tvayā mayā ca saṃpālyā kṛtakāryā tapasvinī || 95|| kiṃcaviṣṇurdinasyaiṣā vairiṇī pāpakāriṇī | yathāśuddhyedupāyaṃ taṃ tvasyāḥ kṛte vidhīyatām || 96 || tattu śrutvā purodhāstaṃ dideśa varṣmayojane | brahmā kamaṇḍaluvārbhiraukṣanmohinikāsthijam || 97|| bhasma tataḥ punardehaḥ samutpannastu vaidhasaḥ | dehayuktābhavatsā ca vasuṃ tātaṃ praṇamya vai ||98 || prārthayāmāsa pāpānāṃ kṣālanāya punaḥ punaḥ | tadā vasustīrthayātrāṃ kārayituṃ ca mohinīm || 99 || upādideśa gaṃgāditīrthāni tadvidhīṃstathā | tato jagāma tīrthāni vasunā saha mohinī || 1.292.100 || gaṃgāṃ gayāṃ tathā godāṃ jagannāthaṃ prayāgakam | kurukṣetraṃ haridvāraṃ badrikāśramamuttamam || 101 || puṣkaraṃ tryambakaṃ rāmeśvaraṃ tathā ca nārmadam | vṛndāvanaṃ siddhasārasvataṃ dvāravatīsthalam || 102 || prabhāsaṃ kuṃkumavāpīṃ raivataṃ ceti mohinī | kṛtvā tīrthāni vasunā sahāyātā vasusthalam || 103 || nārāyaṇahrade snātvā rukmāṃgadapure gatā | raivatapaścime vastrāpathe natvā gireḥ sthalīm || 104 || yayau vedhogṛhe satye loke tenaiva varṣmaṇā | adehā vedhavāsāsti kālābhimānadevatā || 105 || mohinī vidhijā devī viṣṇujaikādaśī tithiḥ | viṣṇujātparddhayā dhātrā mohinī sā vinirmitā || 106 || sparddhantyekādaśīṃ ceyaṃ daśamyante sthitā sadā | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi viddhāyāḥ kāraṇaṃ mayā || 1 07|| tadarthaṃ nirmitā dhātrā mohinī tatra veśitā | sūkṣmadehā vratahantrī kimanyacchrotumicchasi || 108 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇāyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmāṇḍe vāsamalabhamānayā mohinyārthitena brahmaṇā vasunā ca vratapūrvatithiprānte dattavāsaṃ labdhvā sā yamalokasuralokabrahmalokādipravāhaphalavatī viddhāśuddhādiprayojayitrī ca punaḥ sadehā devatā jātetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvānavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 292||
<1.293> śrīlakṣmīruvāca māsāstu dvādaśa proktāsteṣu vratadināni ca | tebhyo’dhiko’pi trayodaśaḥ sārdhadvayavārṣikaḥ || 1 || cāndrapūrṇatvasampādyo bhavatīti tadīyakam | itivṛttaṃ vidhiṃ devaṃ sarve śrotuṃ samutsahe || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ divyāṃ puruṣottamayoginīm | cāndramāse yatra sūryasaṃkrāntirnahi jāyate || 1 || ekarāśiprabhogastho’rko na saṃkramate’pare | sūryasaṃkrāntiśūnyo’yaṃ māso’dhikatayā mataḥ || 2 || madhye’māvāsyayoścāndramāsaḥ pūrṇaḥ prajāyate | sauramāsastu saṃkrāntyormadhye pūrṇaḥ prajāyate || 3 || cāndramāse sāvanāhānyekonatriṃśadityatha | ṣaḍviṃśatighaṭikāśca pañcāśatpalikāstathā || 4 || bhujyante’tha ca saure tu triṃśadahāni vai tathā | ṣaḍviṃśatiśca ghaṭikāḥ palānyekonaviṃśatiḥ || 5 || vipalānyekatriṃśacca dvāpaṃcāśatkṣaṇāni ca | prabhujyante tayoścāndre yaḥ kālaḥ śiṣyate’rkitaḥ || 6 || teṣāṃ tu śiṣṭakālānāṃ samavāya prajāyate | pūrṇastrayodaśaścāndramāso’yaṃ tvadhiko mataḥ || 7 || dvātriṃśatsauramāseṣu ṣoḍaśāhādhikeṣu tu | trayastriṃśaccāndramāsāḥ ṣoḍaśāhādhikāḥ khalu || 8 || niṣpadyante’dhiko māsaścāndraḥ so’yaṃ mato’dhikaḥ | paṃcavarṣeṣvadhimāsau dvau cāndrau prāyaśo matau || 9 || adhimāsaḥ punaḥ so’ṣṭavarṣe vaikonaviṃśatau | ekacatvāriṃśadadhike śate vā sa eti vai || 1.293.1 0|| sa evāyāti cetyevaṃ prāyaśo niyamo’sti hi | so’yaṃ puṇyaprakāryārthaṃ niścito munibhiḥ purā || 11 || śṛṇuṣvaināṃ kathāṃ lakṣmi nau gehādyudbhavāsti sā | malamāsastvayaṃ prokto malaśeṣātmasaṃcayaḥ || 12|| puruṣottamasaṃyogāt puruṣottamasaṃśrayāt | puruṣottamamāso’yaṃ devo’sya puruṣottamaḥ || 13|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān parabrahma parātparaḥ | brahmamuktaiḥ sadā sevyo bhagavānakṣarādhipaḥ || 14|| avatārasvarūpāṇāmavatārī hariḥ svayam | yasmād vyūhāḥ prajāyante vāsudevādayo’khilāḥ || 15|| yasmād golokadhāmādyāḥ prāvirbhavanti cāśrayāḥ | yatra sarvaparākāṣṭhā yatra sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 16 || yasmāt prakāśate sarvaṃ yanmayaṃ jaḍacetanam | so’yaṃ śrībhagavān rājādhirājaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 17|| puruṣottamamāsasyādhidevaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | akṣare parame vyomni muktamaṇḍalasevitaḥ || 18|| anāthaṃ malamāsaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā kṛpāvaśaḥ prabhuḥ | svīcakāra śaraṇyastaṃ śaraṇāgatameva saḥ || 19|| adhiṣṭhānatayā tasya tato’kṣarasamānatām | prāptaḥ śrīmalamāsastu nirmalaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |||1.293.20|| sarve māsāḥ prathamaṃ tu garjanti sma muhurmuhuḥ | nāsmādṛśaṃ kiṃcidasti tārakaṃ bhuvanatraye || 21|| kintu śrīhariṇā yāvanmalamāsastvadhiṣṭhitaḥ | tato dvādaśamāsāste babhūburbhagnagarvakāḥ ||22|| kiṃ vaktavyaṃ mahālakṣmi yatra nārāyaṇaḥ svayam | prasannastiṣṭhate tasya bhāgyaṃ puṇyaṃ kathānakam ||23|| anyamāsakṛtātpuṇyājjapāddhomātpradānakāt | anantaguṇakaṃ tvatra kṛtaṃ bhavati sarvathā ||24|| māso’yamadhikaḥ sarvapuṇyādhikyaprado mataḥ | gayāgaṃgāharidvārapuṣkarādiṣu yat kṛtam ||25|| tatkṛtasyādhike māse phalaṃ bhavati śāśvatam | kurukṣetre grahaṇe yatsnānasya phalamāpyate || 26 | gayāyāṃ piṇḍadānasya pitṝṇāṃ tṛptirasti yā || tatphalaṃ tādṛśī tṛptiradhimāsasya sevanāt || 27| jagannāthapure syād yad rathayātrāphalaṃ mahat | puruṣottamamāse tatphalaṃ tvāplavanād bhavet |||28 || yatphalaṃ sarayūsnānāt sākete tīrthadarśanāt | tatphalaṃ tvadhike cādyadine snānāddhi jāyate || 29 || yatphalaṃ dvārikāyāṃ tu gomatīsāgarāplave | tatphalaṃ malamāse syāt pratipatsnānamātrataḥ || 1.293.30 || yatphalaṃ badarīkṣetre svarṇadyāṃ snānato bhavet | malamāsādyadivase’dhikaṃ syātsnānataḥ phalam || 31 || yatphalaṃ dakṣiṇe vārdhau rāmasetau jalāplavāt | malamāse’dhikaṃ snānāt tataḥ syātprathame dine || 32 || yatphalaṃ raivate svarṇarekhāyāṃ snānato bhavet | prabhāse yatphalaṃ vā sannidhāvāplavanādbhavet || 33 | tato’dhikaphalaṃ tvādyadine snāne’dhikasya ca | yatphalaṃ kuṃkumavāpyāmaśvapaṭṭasarovare || 34|| tato’dhikaphalaṃ tvādyadivase’dhikamāsinaḥ | narmadāyāṃ śuklatīrthe oṃkāreśvaratīrthake || 35 || puṣkare paścime nārāyaṇe sarasi yatphalam | taḍāge mānase cāpi prayāge cāpi yatphalam || 36 || yamunāyāṃ mathurāyāṃ gaṇḍakyāṃ cāpi yatphalam | yatphalaṃ ca hariśaṃbhukṣetre kapilavāridhau || 37 || godāvaryāṃ tathā kuṃbhalagne kṛṣṇājale ca yat | sindhau tāmraparṇikāyāṃ kāveryāṃ cāpi yatphalam || 38 | mahodaye tathā somāmāyāṃ parvaṇi paṭṭane | snānena
