yatphalaṃ yadyattvādyehni snānato’tra tad || 39 | puruṣottamamāsasya prathamāyāṃ samāhitaḥ | brāhme muhūrte sañcintya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ||1.293.40 | snāyānnadyāṃ taḍāge vā sarasi prasrave gṛhe | kūpe vāpyāṃ pravāhe vā tatpuṇyaṃ śāśvataṃ bhavet ||4 1 || nahi loke’dhikamāsasadṛśaṃ pāpanāśakam | puṇyārjakaṃ tathā tvanyat svargamokṣapradaṃ param ||42|| pūrṇimāyāṃ cādye’hani tvamāvāsyādine’pi ca | ekādaśe’ntime cāpi māse’hni puruṣottame |||43 || snānena sadṛśaṃ tvanyattvakhaṇḍapuṇyakṛnnahi | teṣu snānena vai lokā nirdhūya pāpapuñjakam ||44|| jāyante puṇyapuñjena pārāvārasamā bhuvi| snānamātreṇa vai svarge koṭikalpātmakaṃ milet ||45|| harestu pūjanāttatra vaikuṇṭhaṃ śāśvataṃ vrajet | puruṣottamanaivedyadāne mukticatuṣṭayam ||46 || labhate’tra na sandehaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo vadati svayam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvaṃ lakṣmīyuktaṃ dadāti vai ||47|| malamāsādyadivase snātuścārcayitustathā | svatvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavaddhāmni goloke’sya pravartate ||48|| pūrṇimāyāmamāyāṃ vā prātaḥ snānaṃ saritsu cet | kriyate’vabhṛthatulyaphalaṃ viṣṇukratormatam ||49|| madhyāhne cetkṛtaṃ snānamaśvamedhāntapuṇyadam | snānaṃ sāyaṃ vājapeyayajñasya phaladaṃ bhavet ||1.293.50 || snātvā vratī hariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ suvarṇajam | āvāhayet tathā paṃcāmṛtaiḥ saṃsnāpayecchanaiḥ ||51 || ekādaśīkṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ malamāse tu parvaṇi | snānamātreṇa bhavati kimanyat tatkṛte punaḥ ||5 2|| lakṣagavāṃ mahiṣīṇāmayutasya śatasya tu | vāraṇānāṃ ca dānena kurukṣetre tu yatphalam |||53|| lakṣāśvānāṃ tathā dānādyatphalaṃ kaurave sthale | prātaḥsnānānmalamāse tatphalaṃ pratipattithau ||54|| dvādaśānāṃ tu māsānāṃ pāpāni malamucyate | malaprakṣālanaśakto malamāsaḥ kṛto’sti vai |||55|| snāpayecchrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pañcāmṛtaistataḥ | śuddhodakaistailasārairmardayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ||56|| snāpayed vai tato vastrairmārjayet puruṣottamam | pītāmbaraṃ cottarīyaṃ svarṇaprāntaṃ samarpayet ||57|| kirīṭaṃ kuṇḍale cāpi candanaṃ kuṃkumaṃ tathā | kajjalaṃ kaṇṭhahārām̐ścormikāśca kaṃkaṇāni ca ||58|| puṣpahārān raśanāścābhūṣaṇānyambarāṇi ca | dravyālaṃkārabhūṣāśca samarpayya prapūjayet ||59|| dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tathāpīḍān śekharān mālikāstathā | gucchaṃ kandaṃ svarṇayaṣṭiṃ chatraṃ ca cāmare’rpayet ||1.293.60 || naivedyāni sumiṣṭānnapakvānnāni phalāni ca | mṛṣṭasvādūni peyāni tāmbūlāni jalāni ca ||61 || samarpayettato nīrājayet kṣamāṃ tu yācayet | pradakṣiṇāṃ namaskāraṃ daṇḍavacca stutiṃ caret ||62|| puṣpāñjaliṃ pradatvaiva śrīhariṃ puruṣottamam | prārthayenmalamāsasya vratasya pūrtaye muhuḥ ||63|| upoṣaṇānyekabhuktaṃ naktaṃ phalāśanaṃ ca vā | kariṣye malamāse tadvrataṃ te kṛpayā prabho |||4|| nirvighnaṃ pūrṇatāṃ yāyāditi tuṣṭo hare kuru | snānaṃ tīrthe’thavā kūpe gṛhe nadyāṃ prage’nvaham ||65|| dānaṃ pūjāṃ yathāśakti kariṣye puruṣottama | tatsarvaṃ bhajanaṃ cāpi nirvighnaṃ me bhavediti ||66|| kṛpāṃ kuru mahārājālasyaṃ nāśaya dehataḥ | mānasāni malānyatra prakṣālaya prabhāvataḥ ||67|| ātmīyāni ca pāpāni prajvālaya pareśvara | ātmamuktiṃ ca me dehi puruṣottama keśava ||68|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa svāmin lakṣmīnātha prabhāpate | pārvatīmāṇikīsvāmin sampatkuru gṛhe mama ||69|| evaṃ samprārthya deveśaṃ svāpayedvā visarjayet | madhyāhne bhojayet sāyaṃ bhojayet pūjayet tathā ||1.293.70 || nīrājayecca dolāyāṃ guruṃ tvāndolayeddharim | bālakṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harinarāyaṇam ||71|| ramayedvā jale ramye tūdyāne bhavane’pi vā | nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ savādyaṃ ca kārayet tatsamīpataḥ |||72|| annavastrajalapuṣpaphaladānāni vai dadet | bhojayed bālakān sādhūn viprān gogrāsamarpayet ||73 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇavārtā puruṣottamamāḥkathām | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāṃ vācayedavratī ||74|| mālāṃ kṛṣṇaharikṛṣṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇābhidhaiḥ | kuryājjapaṃ ca bhajanaṃ smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ muhuḥ ||75|| vandanaṃ dāsatāṃ sevāṃ pādayoścāpi mardanam | mārjanaṃ paricaryāṃ kṣālanaṃ viṣṇugrahasya ca ||76|| guroḥ sevāṃ prakurvīta vratapuṣṭikarīṃ śubhām | gurau tuṣṭe vrataṃ pūrṇe bhavedvai manasepsitam ||77|| phaletsarvaṃ prasaṃpūrṇaṃ svargamokṣādidāyakam | gaurīḥ sādhvīḥ satīrbālān bālikāḥ sadhavādhavāḥ ||78|| anāthānāśritāḥ saṃbhojayed dānāni saṃdadet | gṛhaṃ dadyājjīvikāṃ ca kṣetraṃ vāṭīṃ ca vetanam ||79|| sāhāyyaṃ vividhaṃ dadyād yathā santoṣamāpnuyāt | saṃphalet tena vai māsaḥ puruṣottamasaṃjñakaḥ ||1.293.80 || nityaṃ vai mandire dadyād devāya jalagāḥ śubhāḥ | āmānnāni ca śākāni lavaṇaṃ śarkarādikam ||8 1 || phalāni taṇḍulān mudgān dvidalā ghṛtavartikāḥ | ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ nivārām̐śca marīcakān sujīrakam ||82|| śuṇṭhīśca methikāṃ dadyād dadhi dugdhaṃ ca takrakam | patrāṇāṃ bhājikāṃ kharjūrakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ surājikām ||83|| bhūmikandān badāmām̐śca kāṣṭhāni mṛttikāstathā | iṣṭikā vaṃśapātrāṇi dhātupātrāṇi mṛddhaṭān ||84|| ghāsagrāsān gavādyarthe pārāvātebhya ityapi | kaṇān dadyātpipīlikādyarthe piṣṭādikaṃ tathā ||85|| jalasthebhyaścaṇakām̐śca śvādibhyo roṭakām̐stathā | jalaṃ tu vṛkṣavallībhyo dadyācchrīpuruṣottame ||86|| pippalebhyo barburebhyo jalaṃ dadyācchivopari | bilvebhyaḥ śrīphalebhyaśca vaṭebhyo jalamarpayet ||87|| tulasībhyaḥ kamalebhyaḥ puṣpavallībhya ityapi | jalaṃ khādyaṃ pradadyācca kuryādvṛttiṃ surakṣikām ||88|| evaṃ dānāni vastrāṇāṃ vastūnāṃ cāpi kārayet | bhūśāyī brahmacārī ca śānte bhūtvādhike punaḥ ||89|| māse vai sādhuvadbhūtvā sādhvīvacca vratānvitaḥ | aihikaṃ tvātmanaḥ kuryātpuṇyaṃ paraṃ ca mokṣaṇam ||1.293.90|| patiḥ patnī ca dāsī ca sutaḥ sutā ca bāndhavāḥ | bandhupatnyo jananyaśca pitaraśca pitāmahāḥ ||91|| mātā mātāmahī cāpi bālāśca bālikāśca yāḥ | śiṣyā svasā cāśritāśca prāghūrṇikāḥ samāśritāḥ ||92|| ye ca gṛhe janāḥ svasyābhijanāśca kuṭumbinaḥ | sarve te vai vrataṃ kuryuḥ puruṣottamamāsi tu ||93|| ekabhaktena naktena phalenāyācitena vā | jalena payasā dadhnā nivārādibhireva vā ||94|| śākena bharjitenāpi dehayātrāṃ vidhāya ca | puruṣottamamāsasya vrataṃ kuryustu śaktitaḥ ||95 || ekānnenāthavā kuryādbhikṣānnenāpi sarvathā | uñcchavṛttyāthavā kuryādājagaryāthavā caret ||96|| devānnaṃ vā grasetsāyaṃ pūjayitvā janārdanam | devānāṃ darśanaṃ nityaṃ sādhūnāṃ caraṇāmṛtam ||97|| peyaṃ dhāryaṃ mastake ca dhūlyāmāluṇṭhanaṃ tathā | hareḥ pādodakaṃ peyaṃ striyā puṃsā vrate sadā ||98|| paryaṃkāśayanaṃ kāryaṃ kāmakrodhavivarjanam | kṣauravivarjanaṃ kāryaṃ maithunasya vivarjanam ||99|| rasanāyāstapaḥ kāryaṃ tyāgaḥ prāptārjitasya ca | nāryā tu sparśanaṃ puṃsaḥ puṃsā sparśaśca yoṣitām || 1.293.10 0|| tyājyo vai sarvathā māse’dhike śrīpuruṣottame | gṛhādbahirna gantavyaṃ tīrthārthaṃ gamyameva vā || 101 || vāṭikāyāṃ samudyāne vastavyaṃ kṣetrake tathā | vane’raṇye daivabhūmau sādhumadhye satījane || 1 02|| tyāgibhūmau nivāsaśca tīrthataṭe’tha sīmni vā | parṇaśālottamāyāṃ vā vyomni vāso’dhike mataḥ || 1 03|| śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai smṛtiḥ | pādayoḥ sevanaṃ cāpi pūjanaṃ vandanaṃ tathā || 104|| dāsyaṃ cātmātmīyavastvarpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇavicintanam | evamādikriyārūpāṃ bhaktiṃ kuryānmale’dhike || 1 05|| maṃ muktiṃ lāti gṛhṇāti malo’yaṃ māsa ucyate | mā māyā līyate yena malo’yaṃ māsa īritaḥ || 106|| māṃ lakṣmīṃ māti yo māsastasmānmalaḥ prakīrtyate | puruṣottamanāmmo vai makārastvantyavarṇakaḥ || 1 07|| lakṣmyāścādyākṣaro lopi malaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śriyā yutaḥ | maṃ mala līyate yena malakṣālanako hariḥ || 1 08|| malamāse kṛtaṃ yadyaddānaṃ puṇyaṃ tadīyakam | kaṃ sukhaṃ jāyate cādhyadhikaṃ hyadhikamāssa hi || 1 09|| yatra nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pratyahaṃ tu gṛhe gṛhe | vyavasthitaḥ śubhāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇāti puruṣottame || 1.293.110 || māse’tra ramayā lakṣmyā pārvatyā prabhayā tathā | māṇikyayā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 1 11|| golokāccāpi vaikuṇṭhādavyākṛtācca dhāmataḥ | bhuvane’tra samāyāti lokānāṃ darśanāya vai || 1 12|| satkarmāṇyarcanādīni pūjanāni vratāni ca | ke kurvanti ca me māse snānaṃ pūjāṃ pradānakam || 1 13|| evaṃ devaḥ sadā prātarvyomamārgeṇa paśyati | dṛṣṭvā snātṝn bhaktikartṝn bhaktān devagrahasya ca || 1 14|| dātṝn saṃpālayitṝm̐śca niyamānāṃ narān priyāḥ | vilokya divyadṛṣṭyā śrīsahitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 1 15|| prasanno bhavati śreyaḥ kartuṃ yātuṃ ca tadgṛhe | sthātuṃ ciraṃ śriyai kṛṣṇaḥ pradiśati toṣitaḥ || 1 16|| puruṣottamamāsasya vratināṃ bhavanāni vai | sarvasmṛddhiprapūrṇāni kuru lakṣmi mamāgrahāt || 1 17|| malamāsāvamantṝṇāṃ gṛhe vāso ca mā tava | yatra nāsti mamāvāsastatra te’pi ca māstu saḥ || 1 18|| ityādiśya hariḥ prātastato madhyāhnake’pi ca | naivedyaṃ tvarpitaṃ labdhvā punaryāti svadhāma vai || 1 19|| sāyaṃ punaḥ svapatnībhiḥ samāyāti hariḥ svayam | ārārtrikādikā sevāṃ tvaṃgīkartuṃ gṛhe gṛhe || 1.293.120 || ghṛtadīpaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ subhojanam | sarvaṃ prāpya svakaṃ dhāma visarjitaḥ prayāti saḥ || 121 || nityaṃ māse’dhike hyevaṃ paśyati śrīharirvibhuḥ | bhaktānukampayā tasmāt pūjyau śrīpuruṣottamau || 1 22|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śrīpuruṣottamamāsamāhātmye tadādyadivasīyavratatapodānasnānārādhananiyamādikartavyatānirūpaṇanāmā trinavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.293 ||
<1.294> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca puruṣottamamāsasya svāmī lakṣmi kṛpānidhiḥ | puruṣottamasaṃjño vai yathā jāto vadāmi tat || 1 || ekadā pūrṇamāse śrīnaranārāyaṇāśramam | samāyātā darśanārthaṃ śrīharermunayastathā || 2 || ṛṣayo divyavijñānā vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ | patnīvato lomaśaśca mārkaṇḍeyaśca nāradaḥ || 3|| vyāsaḥ pailaḥ sumanturdevalo’sitaśca kāśyapaḥ | jābāliḥ sumatiryājñavalkyaśca pippalāyanaḥ || 4 || vāmadevaḥ sutīkṣṇaśca parvato bhuguraṃgirāḥ | āpastambaḥ śarabhaṃgaḥ kapilo raibhya āruṇiḥ || 5 || kātyāyano rathītaraḥ ṛbhurmāṇḍavya ekataḥ | dvitastrito hyagastyo mudgalaḥ kratuśca gautamaḥ || 6 || kauśiko gālavo babhruratriḥ śaktirbudho vasuḥ | bodhāyanaḥ pṛthurdhūmraḥ śaṃkuḥ saṃkṛtirārtihan || 7 || kauṇḍinyaśca śinirvibhāṇḍakaḥ paṃkaśca dhūmapaḥ | jamadagniḥ kaṇādaśca gargo maunaśca bhārgavaḥ || 8 || bharadvājaḥ karkaśaśca śatānandaśca śaunakaḥ | viśālo viṣṇuvṛddhaśca jarjaraśca tanurjayaḥ || 9 || pāraḥ pāśadharaḥ pūro jaṃgamo jaiminirmakhaḥ | uddālako mahāṣeṇa āmalakī ca piṃgalaḥ || 1 0|| śāṇḍīrakaḥ prabhuścātri karuṇaḥ śvetaketukaḥ | romapādaśca kadruśca jājaliścyavanaḥ śamaḥ || 11 || dīrghatamāḥ pṛthuśravāḥ śvetāśvatara āsuriḥ | jaigīṣavyastathāvaṭyo dharmaśca bharga aiśvaraḥ || 12|| vasiṣṭhaśca marīciśca pulahaśca pulastyakaḥ | ete cānye sahasrāṇi naranārāyaṇāśramam || 1 3|| samājagmurdarśanārthaṃ brahmiṣṭhāḥ śiṣyakoṭibhiḥ | lokānugrahakartāraḥ paropakṛtidharmiṇaḥ || 14|| nemurnārāyaṇaṃ kṛtvā daṇḍavat jayaghoṣaṇām | niṣeduḥ purataḥ sarve satkṛtā brahmapāragāḥ || 15|| te ca nārāyaṇaṃ śāntaṃ saumyaṃ valkaladhāriṇam | prasannavadanaṃ turyapuruṣārthāśrayaṃ prabhum || 16|| aśeṣadivyakalyāṇaguṇānandapayonidhim | ūrdhvapuṇḍradharaṃ divyajaṭaṃ divyaśriyāśritam ||17|| divyahārādisaṃśobhaṃ tulasīmālikādharam | parabrahma japanmālākaraṃ śaraṇyamacyutam || 18|| jitendriyaṃ tapomūrtiṃ tejaścakrānvitānanam | badarīśritasarvasvaṃ paśyanti sma samādhivat || 1 9|| tatastatra samāyātāḥ surāśca pitarastathā | nadyastīrthāni sarvāṇi kṣetrāṇi ca vanāni ca ||20|| araṇyāni nagarāṇi sarāṃsi sāgarāstathā | siddhāśca yoginaścāpi samājagmuḥ suharṣitāḥ ||21 || nirāhārāḥ phalāhārāḥ phenāhārāśca kecana | vātāmbuparṇakāhārāḥ śvāsāhārāśca kecana ||22|| nārāyaṇaṃ draṣṭukāmāḥ dṛṣṭvā śāntiṃ parāṃ yayuḥ | te sarve’pi praṇemustaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ mahāmunim ||23|| pare brahmaṇi saṃlagnaṃ prāsphuradbahulaprabham | dṛṣṭvā niṣeduste sarve purataḥ śrīharestataḥ ||24|| yugāśca sandhayaḥ saṃvatsarāśca kratavastathā | samāyayustathā māsāḥ pakṣā dināni rātrayaḥ ||25|| kalākāṣṭhāmuhūrtāni ghaṭikāḥ praharāstathā | samāyayuḥ kuṭumbāḍhyāḥ sasvāminaḥ sumūrtayaḥ ||26|| tatra vai kārtiko lakṣmīnārāyaṇādhidaivataḥ | mārgaśīrṣo ramāvāsudevādhidaivato’pi ca || 27|| pauṣaḥ saṃkrāntiśaktiśrīviṣṇavākhyādityadaivataḥ | māgho vasantavijayāmādhavādhisudaivataḥ ||28|| phālgunaśca mahārātrilakṣmībrahmādhidaivataḥ | caitrastu pārthivīśaktisītāśyāmādhidaivataḥ ||29|| vaiśākho hetiyugdurgālakṣmīnṛsiṃhadaivataḥ | jyeṣṭho gaṃgāmahālakṣmītrivikramādhidaivataḥ ||3 0 || āṣāḍhaśca mahāvidyālakṣmīvyāsādhidaivataḥ | śrāvaṇo vārṣikīdolāramākṛṣṇādhidaivataḥ ||3 1 || bhādrapado mahāgaurīvāmanabrahmadaivataḥ | āśvinaṃ śāradālakṣmīnārāyaṇādhidaivataḥ ||3 2|| rājante sma naranārāyaṇāśrame tu seśvarāḥ | na teṣāṃ kaścidapyasti hyapūrvaḥ svāmivarjitaḥ ||33 || svasvāmiyogamāhātmyātsarve saubhāgyaśālinaḥ | vartante svasvādhikāre sarvebhyaḥ phaladāyinaḥ || 34|| tataḥ paścāt samāyāto malamāso nirīśvaraḥ | adhikaḥ pucchavatyaścāllagnaḥ sarvairjugupsitaḥ || 35|| kṛṣṇavarṇo malinaśca pānabhojanavarjitaḥ | snānapūjāvihīnaścāspṛśyaḥ sarvaistiraskṛtaḥ ||36|| tamūcuḥ sakalāstatra hyanāthaṃ ca jugupsitam | anarho malamāso’yaṃ sūryasaṃkramavarjitaḥ || 37|| aspṛśyo malarūpatvācchubhe karmaṇi garhitaḥ | udyogavilayo naṣṭalābho bhāgyavivarjitaḥ || 38 || samāyātaḥ kutaścainaṃ dūre kurvantu seśvarāḥ | dakṣaścandramase prādāt saptaviṃśatikanyakāḥ || 3 9|| tataścāyaṃ samutpannastāsāṃ malo’yamasti vai | tāsāmucchiṣṭarūpo’yaṃ samutpannastridoṣakṛt ||38 || sārdhadvivarṣadoṣāntamalo’yaṃ tvapasāryatām | śrutvaitadvacanaṃ teṣāṃ cintāgrastaikamānasaḥ ||4 1 || mumūrṣurabhavattena hṛdayena vidūyatā | dūraṃ cāspṛśyavattasthau paśyanmāṃ badarīsthitam ||42|| te sarve darśanaṃ kṛtvābhavansamādhiniṣṭhitāḥ | malo dhairyaṃ samālambya madīyakarasaṃjñayā ||43 || prāpto vaikuṇṭhabhavanaṃ yatrāhamavasaṃ rame | uddhārārtha samāgatya māmasau dṛṣṭavāṃstataḥ ||44|| rudan saṃbhagnahṛdayo daṇḍavatpatito bhuvi | prāṃjalī ruddhanetro’sau babhāṣe svahitaṃ vacaḥ ||45|| api nātha kṛpāsindho dīnānāṃ śaraṇaprada | dīna tiraskṛtaṃ cānyairmalaṃ māṃ rakṣa cāgatam ||46 || nirīśvaraṃ ca malinaṃ varjitaṃ śubhakarmasu | sadaivatairbahirnītaṃ dīnavatsala rakṣa mām ||47|| satyavrato gajendraśca dharmaḥ sureśvarādayaḥ | avitā bhavitā viṣṇo rakṣa māṃ parameśvara ||48 || ityuktvāvilacakṣuṣko maunamāsthāya nimnadṛk | babhūva tādṛśaṃ vīkṣya kṛpāpūrṇo harirjagau ||49|| vatsa bhagnamanā mā bhūruddhariṣyāmi mā śucaḥ | vada duḥkhaṃ vārayāmi na vai śocitumarhasi ||5 0 || na me śaraṇyamāpanno duḥkhaleśāya kalpyate | aśokānandavaikuṇṭhaṃ prāptastvaṃ nāsi śokabhāg ||5 1 || malamāsaḥ samāśvāsaṃ labdhvovāca naman harim | sarvajño’syantarātmāsi vetsi sarvaṃ yathātatham ||52|| vacmi tathāpi te nātha duḥkhaṃ mṛtyusamaṃ mama | kalā kāṣṭhā muhūrtāśca dhaṭikā divasāḥ samāḥ ||53 || pakṣā māsā yugāḥ sarve modante svāmyadhiṣṭhitāḥ | paryuṣitānmamotpattirucchiṣṭācchiṣṭakaccarāt ||54|| mālinyaṃ malarūpatvamaspṛśyatvamasatkṛtiḥ | asvāmyatvamavamānamaśubhatvaṃ sadā mama ||55|| akāryakatvamaphalitvaṃ me nādhikṛtiḥ kvacit | ṛṣidevādhidevādyairbadaryāśramamāgataiḥ ||56 || māsādibhirbhartsitaścāspṛśyīkṛto nirākṛtaḥ | karmahīnīkṛtaścaiva tarjitaḥ sarvathārditaḥ ||57|| tasmādvinaṣṭumicchāmi varaṃ mṛtyuḥ kujīvanāt | paraduḥkhāsahiṣṇustvaṃ tūpakārī pumuttamaḥ ||58 || kuru śreyo mama nāthānyathā tu pāmaro’guṇaḥ | mariṣyāmi mariṣyāmi mariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ||59 || ityuktvā pādayoḥ śrīnārāyaṇasya papāta saḥ | pāhi pāhi jagannātha pāhi kṛṣṇa ramāpate ||6 0 || pāhi lakṣmīpate nātha śaraṇaṃ māmupāgatam | ityuktavantaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo vaikuṇṭhanilayo hariḥ ||6 1 || provācottiṣṭha bhadraṃ te śokaṃ mā kuru paśya mām | samāgaccha mayā sārdhaṃ golokādhipatiṃ prabhum ||62 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gopīvṛndasthaṃ puruṣottamam | ninādayantaṃ muralīṃ dvibāhum̐ śyāmasundaram ||6 3 || kaṃjanetraṃ pārvaṇendumukhaṃ kandarpadhāmakam | pītāmbaraṃ vanamālāmaṇikaustubhabhūṣaṇam ||64|| candanokṣitavakṣaskaṃ kastūrītilakānvitam sadratnāḍhyormikāyaṣṭikirīṭakuṇḍalānvitam ||65|| śrīvatsaśobhitavakṣaḥsthalaṃ siṃhāsanasthitam | gopagopīgaṇākīrṇaṃ purāṇapuruṣottamam || 66|| gacchāvaḥ sa hariḥ kṛṣṇastvadduḥkhaṃ vyapaneṣyati | ityuktvā taṃ kare dhṛtvā goloke gatavān hariḥ ||67 || lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān pūjāsāmagrikāyutaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇārthaṃ rādhikārthe vastūni vividhāni ca ||68 || ratnāni bhūṣaṇāni vastrāṇi śrāṃgārikāṇi ca | sugandhadravaramyāṇi peyāni bhojanāni ca ||69|| phalāni mukhavāsāni divyasvarṇādikāni ca | asaṃkhyopakaraṇāni rājayogyāni vai prabhuḥ ||7 0 || saha nītvā tu golokaṃ prāptau kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | virajāyāṃ ca tau snātau śataśṛṃgaṃ gatau ca tau || 71 || malamāsamalānyatra naṣṭāni virajāplavāt | malamāsadvitīyāyāṃ tithau snāturmalāni vai ||72|| bahujanmopārjitāni nāśameṣyanti mūlataḥ | virajāsnānapuṇyaṃ ca prāpsyante vratino janāḥ ||73 || snānamātreṇa golokaprāptiḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ | rāsamaṇḍalabhūmiṃ cālokya vṛndāvanādikam ||74|| dhūlīṃ ca mastake kṛtvākṣayabhāṇḍīrasadvaṭau | vilokya mukhyadurgaṃ ca praviśya gopikāśritām ||75|| vasatiṃ ṣoḍaśagopurābhyantaranivāsinīm | yayatuśca bhavanāntaḥ rādhākṛṣṇasamīpataḥ ||76 || vilokya divyaṃ yugalaṃ cakraturdaṇḍavacca tau | nematuḥ pādayordvābhyāṃ prasannābhyāṃ sabhājitau ||77|| susatkṛtau yathāyogyāsane tau tu niṣedatuḥ | nārāyaṇaṃ tadā kṛṣṇo hastenādāya harṣataḥ ||78 || nimimīla tu bāhubhyāṃ vakṣaḥ kṛtvā ca vakṣasi | dhvaje siṃhāsane nārāyaṇaṃ niṣādya vai muhuḥ ||79 || hāsyaprasannatāyukto jijñāsāṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ | hetuścāgamane nārāyaṇena kathitastadā ||8 0 || pūjitaśca tato nārāyaṇena bhagavān svayam | pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpitaśca rādhayā sahitaḥ prabhuḥ ||8 1 || dugdhena snāpitaḥ paścātpayasā snāpitaḥ prabhuḥ | vastreṇāvartitaḥ paścādarcitaścandanādibhiḥ ||8 2|| śṛṃgārito vibhūṣābhirdivyavastrādyalaṃkṛtaḥ | sadhūpadīpārārtrikapradakṣiṇāstavādibhiḥ ||83 || saratnamaṇisauvarṇasthālopadābhirarcitaḥ | phalaiḥ rasairbhojanaiśca vividhaistarpitaḥ prabhuḥ ||84|| rādhikādyāḥ kṛṣṇapatnyo yogyopaṭṭābhirarcitāḥ | śaktyāpi malamāsena śrīkṛṣṇaścārcitastadā ||85|| prasādaṃ labdhavān māso malaścāpyāśiṣaṃ satīm | śrīkṛṣṇo rādhayā yuktaḥ prāhānugrahapūrvakam ||86|| yathāhaṃ pūjitaścātra dvitīyādivase tvayā | tathā tava tithau loke dvitīyāyāṃ prage niśi ||87|| rādhākṛṣṇaṃ yathāśakti pūjayiṣyanti ye janāḥ | tatsarve saṃgrahīṣyāmi rādhayā sahitastadā ||88|| godugdhena dvitīyāyāṃ snapanīyo viśeṣataḥ | pañcāmṛtairjalairvāpi suvarṇamūrtikaḥ prabhuḥ ||89|| suvarṇāmbarabhūṣābhiralaṃkāryo dravādibhiḥ | śraṃgārikopakaraṇeralaṃkāryaḥ sarādhikaḥ ||9 0 || dhūpadīpādibhiḥ pūjyaḥ kaṃkaṇairmukuṭādibhiḥ | miṣṭānnaistarpaṇīyaśca ratnabhūṣādibhistathā ||91 || atyarthaṃ pūjanīyo’haṃ tṛpto bhavāmi sarvathā | dāsye pratyupadāṃ tebhyo vividhāsaṃkhyasampadaḥ ||92 || yathā santi mama loke tathā dāsye na saṃśayaḥ | ante dāsye ca golokaṃ smṛddhaṃ sukhaṃ ca śāśvatam || 9 3 || ityāśīrvādamādāya malamāso’pi bhāgyavān | nārāyaṇasamakṣaṃ vai jāto’dhikapratāpavān || 94|| uvāca tu tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tvayā bhāgyena vardhitaḥ | yathā sasvāmiko bhūyāsaṃ tathā nātha me kuru || 95 || ajñānāndhatamohartarjñānamārgapradīpaka | asaṃkhyagolakotpattivināśādiprakāraṇa || 96 || yogyadṛśya svabhaktābhirdṛśya divyasuvigraha | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmahetiścaturbhujārcita || 97|| asaṃkhyarādhikālakṣmīsamapatnīprasevita | indīvaradalaśyāma paṃkajāruṇalocana ||98 || koṭiśāradapūrṇenduśobhātirocanānana | koṭimanmathasaundaryalīlādhāmamanohara ||99|| śrīvatsavakṣaḥsaṃrājatkaustubhahārarājita | sadratnakoṭisannaddhakirīṭakaṭakojjala || 100 || bhaktamaṃgalakṛdviṣṇo kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho | nirasyāmaṃgalaṃ sarve mama maṃgalamāvaha || 101 || iti stutastadā kṛṣṇaḥ prasanno’bhūduvāca ha | etatstotraprapāṭhena satphalaṃ prāpsyate janaḥ || 10 2|| bhaktirbhaviṣyati kṛṣṇo putrapautravivardhinī | bhaviṣyatyapakīrteśca kṣayaḥ kīrtirbhaviṣyati || 103 || pūjāyāṃ yāni vastūni tvarpitāni ca tāni tu | lakṣaguṇāni bhaktāya pradāsye pravadāmyaham || 1 04|| adhimāsadvitīyāyāṃ pūjyaścāhamanantakaiḥ | dāsyetvanantakaṃ tasmai yadyadiṣṭaṃ vratārthinaḥ || 105 || jalaṃ vaṭāya dātavyaṃ bhojyaṃ viprāya sādhave | śāṭīṃ kanyāpravaryāyai dātavyā phalalabdhaye || 106 || āmānnāni ca deyāni viṣṇubhaktāya sādhave | svarṇadānaṃ pradātavyaṃ vidyārthine ca yoṣite ||107 || dvitīyāyāṃ pradātavyaṃ sarve vai dviguṇaṃ śubham | koṭiguṇaṃ prapadyeta phalaṃ cātra paratra ca || 108 || iti kṛṣṇo vadannārāyaṇaṃ prāha punaḥ punaḥ | nārāyaṇa hare lakṣmīpate vaikuṇṭhabhāskara ||109 || malamāsasya vṛttāntaṃ jāne’haṃ sakalaṃ vibho | bhavatā śrīpatinā ca kathitaṃ tadviśeṣataḥ || 110 || ayaṃ tvadhikamāso’sti vyapetaravisaṃkramaḥ | malino’yamanarho’sti śubhakarmaṇi varjitaḥ || 111 || iti matvā sṛṣṭidevaistiraskṛto’pi madgṛham | samāyāto hyataścāyaṃ malino nāsti cādyataḥ || 11 2 || divyo’sti pariśuddho’sti pūjanīyo’sti sarvathā | kintu tasya bhavet svāmī ko’dya cātra vicāryatām || 113 || anyeṣāmapi māsānāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ svāmī bhavāmyaham | bhavānapi tathā svāmī bhavatīti vicāryatām || 1 14|| tasmāttrayodaśe māsi svāmitvaṃ tvāvayornahi | tadarthe nanu gacchāmo yatra śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||115 || virājate pare dhāmnyakṣare rājādhirājakaḥ | avatārā asaṃkhyātā yasmādbhavanti mādṛśāḥ || 11 6|| golokādikadhāmāni yaddhāmāṃśā bhavanti vai | sa vicāryaiva caitasya svāminaṃ kalpayiṣyati ||1 17|| avatārī tvanādiśrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | yojayiṣyati yaṃ tvasmin so’sya svāmī bhaviṣyati || 118 || iti vicārya sahasā kṛṣṇonārāyaṇo’dhikaḥ | yayustrayo’kṣare dhāmni yatra śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 11 9|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīya saṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye badarikāśrame naranārāyaṇadarśanārthamṛṣi muni parvata nadī vṛkṣa vallī sura samvatsara māsādibhirāgatairmalamāsasyāspṛśyatvena tiraskāre kṛte malamāsasya vaikuṇṭhagamanaṃ tatratyanārāyaṇena saha golokagamanaṃ tatratya śrīkṛṣṇarādhikāpūjanottara sabhāgyatāṃ prāpyāśīrvādān saṃgṛhyākṣarabrahmalokaṃ prati sasvāmikatvārthe gamanamiti nirūpaṇanāmācaturnavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.294||
<1.295> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi yayuḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo’dhimāstathā | golokādupari divyavyomamārgeṇa vai kṣaṇāt || 1 || saccidānandasandohānvitamakṣaradhāma yat|| brahmahṛde trayaḥ snātvā puruṣottamarūpiṇaḥ || 2 || bhūtvāvalokayantaśca muktānāṃ maṇḍalāni te| dvibhujāndvyaṣṭavarṣīyān rūpānurūpavigrahān || 3 || koṭinārāyaṇatulyān rūpatejaḥsusiddhibhiḥ | golokādapi saundarye teṣu koṭiguṇaṃ ca vai || 4 || vartate tādṛśān dṛṣṭvā puruṣottamarūpiṇaḥ | traya āścaryasampannā babhūvuḥ kṛṣṭamānasāḥ || 5 || udyānāni ca saudhāni muktānāmavalokya te | vimānānyupakaraṇānyālokya vismayaṃ gatāḥ || 6 || akṣaraṃ vastu cālokya virāgo’bhūt svadhāmasu | akṣaradhāmavastūnāṃ tulanāyāṃ svadhāmajam || 7 || vastumātraṃ nirānandamivābhātaṃ tadā tu taiḥ | nītaṃ yadvastu vaikuṇṭhāt puruṣottamapūjane || 8 || golokādvā ca tatsarvaṃ nirānandamabhāsata | nistejaskamivaibhistaddṛṣṭaṃ svadhāmavastukam || 9 || tataste bhagnamanaso hyupadāviṣaye khalu | sañjātāstāvatā brahmasarastatra vyalokayan || 10 || anantayojanāyāmaṃ divyavārirasātmakam | yatra snānena vastu śrīpuruṣottamabhogyatām || 11 || labhate te trayaḥ snātā brahmasarasi vai mudā | upadāḥ prokṣitāstena yogyaṃ vastu tadābhavat || 12 || atha dṛṣṭo viśālaśca lakṣayojanavistṛtaḥ | prāsādo rakṣakān pṛṣṭvā dvāramuktām̐strayastataḥ || 13 || viviśuryatra vai rājādhirājaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | rājate’saṃkhyadivyātmamuktaiḥ saṃsevitaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 4|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇau vīkṣya tvāgatau puruṣottamaḥ | atīva jahṛṣe svāmī namantau tau punaḥ punaḥ || 15 || papraccha kuśalaṃ svasvadhāmnaḥ svasti ca śāśvatam || bhagavatkṛpayā sarvaṃ svastimatkuśalaṃ bahu || 16 || ityuktvāsanayostau saṃrājitau nṛnarāyaṇau | tatīyādhikamāso’pi kṛtvā vai pañcadaṇḍavat || 17|| dāsavat tiṣṭhate pārśve tayostāvatpumuttamaḥ | akṣarādhipatistau ca papraccha taṃ tadā prati || 18 || ko’yaṃ kimarthamāyāto yuvābhyāṃ dhāmni me tviha | manye śaraṇyamāśritya mahālābhārthamāgatam || 19 || evaṃ pṛcchati sarveśe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāvubhau | pūjayāmāsaturdivyaiḥ pāribarhairanantakaiḥ || 2 0 || brahmasarojalaiḥ pūrve samyak pādāvanejanam | pañcāmṛtairdivyarasairāplavanaṃ taduttaram || 21 || jalaiḥ rasātmakaiścābhiṣecayitvākṣarādhipam| candanādidravaiḥ samyakpūjayitvā tataśca tau ||22|| vastrābhūṣaṇa hārādi cārpayāmāsaturmudā | chatra cāmara ratnādi pādukā yaṣṭikādikam ||23|| ūrmikāṃgada mukuṭa śṛṃkhalā kalgimaṇḍanam | svarṇaphullarikā mālā raśanā kaṃkaṇādikam ||24|| bhakṣyabhojya lehya coṣya śarkarāvṛtamiśritam | bhojyānnapeyasusvādya bhogyacarvaṇakādikam ||25|| svarṇāmbarāsana pātra divyaphalarasādikam | yadyad yogyaṃ samarpyaṃ cābhūttadārpayatāṃ tadā ||26|| ārārtrikaṃ kṛtavantau stutvā niṣedatuḥ sukham | gṛhītātithyasatkārau procatuścādhimāsikam ||27|| ayaṃ māso’dhikamāso malamāso’sti dhikkṛtaḥ | sarvamāsaiḥ ṛṣibhiśca niṣiddhaḥ śubhakarmasu || 28|| tadayaṃ vai mayā kṛṣṇenāsya saubhāgyatā kṛto | kintu vinādhidevaṃ sa gaṇanāṃ teṣu nārhati ||29|| etadīyaṃ mahadduḥkhamanivārya bhavadṛte | ata enaṃ nirātaṃkaṃ sānandaṃ kṛpayā kuru ||30|| asmadarthaṃ ca kartavyamasya duḥkhanivāraṇam | śrutvaivaṃ tvakṣarātītaḥ prāha śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||3 1 || samīcīnaṃ kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇa yadatrāgatavān bhavān | nārāyaṇo’pi cātrādyāgatastadapi śobhanam ||32|| malamāse kare kṛtvā loke kīrtimavāpsyathaḥ | bhavadbhyāṃ saṃdhṛto haste sa mayaiva kare dhṛtaḥ || 33 || ata ena kariṣyāmi sarvopari mayā samam | yathāhaṃ svaguṇairyuktastathainaṃ vidadhāmi vai || 34|| sāmarthyaiścārcyabhāvena tathā varaparākramaiḥ | mama tulyaṃ vidadhāmi na to’nyat kimapekṣyate ||35|| vinaṣṭasarvapāpmatvaṃ satyasaṃkalpadāyitā | kāmanāphaladāyitvaṃ matsārūpyapradāyitā ||36|| svargādiprāpayitṛtvaṃ mokṣasthānapradāyitā | ebhiḥ sāmarthyakairyukto bhavatvadhikamāsakaḥ ||37|| mama sarve guṇāścānye’dhimāsāya samarpitāḥ | puruṣottamasaṃjñā me vastuṣṭyai cārpitā tathā || 38|| asya svāmī bhavāmyeva brahmeśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | mama nāmnā jagatsarvaṃ tannāmāpi grahīṣyati ||39|| vidhūya svāni pāpāni pāvanaṃ ca bhaviṣyati | matsvarūpo hyayaṃ bhūtvā jagatpūjyo bhaviṣyati ||40 || sarvavandyaḥ sarvamāsottamo māso bhaviṣyati | enamāśritya vai lokā vratino jāpakārcakāḥ ||4 1 || dātāraḥ snānakartāro bhojayitāra ityapi | kiṃcitpuṇyasya kartāraścāpi me tu prabhāvataḥ ||42|| duḥkhadāridyatāpādhivyādhipīḍāvidhūya ca | sukhasampaddhanadārāpatyārogyasamṛddhibhiḥ ||43|| rājamānasubhavanā bhaviṣyantyutsavānvitāḥ | śṛṃgārābharaṇānnārthapātraparicchadādibhiḥ ||44|| dāsadāsījanamitrasevakāścitabhūmibhiḥ | yogakṣemabalādainyairbhaviṣyanti mahotsavāḥ ||45|| bhojyapānopabhogyaiśca sattāvidyāprathādibhiḥ | udyānayānavāhādyairbhaviṣyanti samanvitāḥ ||46|| rasairvṛkṣaphalaiḥpuṣpairgodhanaiḥ svarṇarūpyakaiḥ | maṇiratnahīrakādyairbhaviṣyanti sadojjvalāḥ ||47|| puruṣottamamāsasya vratino madgatā hi te | mattaḥ prāpsyanti sarva te yathā cintāmaṇerjanaḥ ||48|| svarge vā vaidhasaṃ vāpi vairājaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca vā | raudraṃ bhaumaṃ ca vā kṣaira sthalaṃ prāpsyanti yanmatam ||49|| patnīḥ patīn gṛhaṃ saudhān suputrān rūpavaibhavān | akṣatānavyayān prāpsyantyadhimāsasya sevanāt ||50 || sakāmā vāpi niṣkāmāḥ prāpsyantīṣṭatamaṃ hyataḥ | sakāmaścātha niṣkāmo yathāhaṃ puruṣottamaḥ ||5 1 || tathāyaṃ vai janeṣṭasya pūrako mokṣadaḥ kṛtaḥ | yathāhaṃ paripūrṇo’smi tathāyaṃ cāvyayaḥ kṛtaḥ ||52|| evaṃ ye ceṣaṇāvanto yadveṣaṇāvivarjitāḥ | pūjayiṣyanti te sveṣṭaṃ labdhvā mokṣamavāpnuyuḥ ||93|| enaṃ prapūjya karmāṇi karmiṇāṃ yānti bhasmatām | ātmā divyo mahāśuddho māmevaiṣyati cākṣare ||54|| madarthaṃ vai mahāyatnā yatayo brahmacāriṇaḥ | sādhavaśca mahātmāno yoginastāpasāstathā ||95|| yoginyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginyaḥ sādhvyaḥ satyastathādhavāḥ | virāgāśca virāgiṇyo nirvāṇasatkṛtādarāḥ ||56|| nirmohinyastathā brahmavādinyo nyāsatatparāḥ | prayatante vatsarāṇāṃ sahasrātprāsahasrakam ||57|| tathāpi naiva yāntyete maddhāma paramātparam | puruṣottamabhaktāstu yānti maddhāma māsataḥ ||58|| anye tapasvinaḥ śāntā nirāhārā nirāśayāḥ | patrapuṣpaphalāhārā jalamātraniṣeviṇaḥ ||59|| vāyumātra kṛtāhārā bāṣpabhojina eva ca | dhūmrapānā jalāvāsāḥ śītātapasahāstathā ||6 0 || śuṣkadehā bhagnaśiśnanāḍikā brandharandhragāḥ | parakāyapraveśārhā vratadārḍhyayutā api || 61 || mama bhaktiṃ vinā naiva yānti maddhāma te khalu | puruṣottamamāsasya vratino ye tu te mama || 62|| bhaktā mama vratinaste māsamātreṇa matpadam | matkṛpayā prayāsyanti śāśvataṃ tvamṛtaṃ padam ||63 || kṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa tasmānmāso’yaṃ bhavatoḥ kṛte | kṛto mayā tu mūrdhanyaḥ sarvakāmārthasādhakaḥ ||64|| ye janāḥ sevayiṣyanti māsaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ siddhimāpsyanti te janāḥ || 65 || tasmāt saṃsevyatāṃ sarvairmāso’yaṃ puruṣottamaḥ | śreṣṭhakṣetranibho māso’dhiko bījaprarohaṇe ||66 || phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ dadāti puruṣottamaḥ | svarge bhuktvā punaryāṃti cāturmāsyaprayājinaḥ || 67|| akṣaraṃ śāśvataṃ yānti puruṣottamayājinaḥ | saptādhikasaptaśatakulānyuddhārayatyayam || 68 || anyamāsavratakartā punarjanmātigo na vai | mama māse vratakartā punarjanmagamo na hi ||69|| atra māse tvahaṃ sākṣānnivasāmyadhidaivataḥ | mannāmāpi kṛtaṃ cāsya tasmāttadātmako hyaham || 70 || tadāśritānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pūrayiṣyāmi vāñchitān | gaṇayiṣye nāparādhān bhaktāṃ tvasya sarvathā || 71 || me bhaktyapekṣayā madīyasya bhaktirmama priyā | vilambo na madīyamāsabhaktānāṃ manorathe ||72|| mama bhaktaṃ vihāyaiva teṣāṃ pūrṇaṃ karomyaham | sarvaṃ dadāmi tebhyo vai yato manmāsayājinaḥ ||73 || mamātivallabhāste vai na tathā muktakoṭayaḥ | mama māsaṃ samāsādya japadānādivarjitāḥ ||74|| snānapūjāvihīnāśca satkāryaparipanthinaḥ | kūpavāpītaḍāgādipūrtayajñavivarjitāḥ ||75 || devatīrthadvijasādhusādhvīdevālayadviṣaḥ | nindakāste bhaviṣyanti kākavarcaskabhakṣiṇaḥ ||76 || kuṣṭhinaḥ śvaśṛgālāste bhaviṣyanti nirāśrayāḥ | durbhāgyānāṃ nindakānāṃ sukhaṃ na syāddivāniśam || 77 || mama māse vratināṃ ye duḥkhaṃ kurvanti cādhamāḥ | paratāḍanapāśāste bhaviṣyanti pragardabhāḥ ||78 || tiraskurvanti me māsaṃ ye ca dharmavidūṣakāḥ | bhaktimārge’tra vighnasya kartāro ye’pyasūyakāḥ || 79 || vṛkṣavāgūrikāste tu bhaviṣyanti malādanāḥ | pratitṛtīyavarṣe ye hyāsādya puruṣottamam ||8 0 || ātmaśreyo na kurvanti te yāsyanti mamālayam | duḥkhadāmānalavyāptāścātra bhūtvā praduḥkhinaḥ ||8 1 || śrīdaḥ sampatkarastasmādatimṛtyujayapradaḥ | vyarthaścāyaṃ na netavyo māso me puruṣottamaḥ ||8 2 || kanyakā vā yuvatyaśca sadhavāścādhavāstathā | sapatnyo yoṣito vṛddhāḥ subhagā durbhagā api || 83|| asukhāḥ susukhāścāpi sveṣṭaprāptyarthameva yāḥ | mama māse kariṣyanti vrataṃ dānaṃ madarcanam ||84 || snānaṃ mālāṃ devasevāṃ puṇyakāryāṇi yānyapi | tāsāṃ sarvapradaścāhaṃ bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ ||85 || dharmaṃ kāmaṃ tathā dravyaṃ sukhaṃ mokṣaṃ dadāmyaham | bhojyaṃ pācanasāmarthyaṃ rateḥ śaktiṃ varaṃ patim ||8 6 || putraṃ pautraṃ dāsadāsīḥ tattadiṣṭaṃ dadāmyaham | bhrātṛpitṛkuṭumbasya sukhadātā bhavāmyaham ||87|| yābhirmāso yoṣitaśca śūnyo me puruṣottamaḥ | tāsāṃ śūnya bhavetsarvaṃ sadbhāgyaṃ śūnyatāṃ vrajet || 88 || dhanāḍhyā ye gṛhasthāśca vinā dānādikaṃ mama | māsaṃ śūnyaṃ yāpayanti tatkośaḥ śūnyatāṃ vrajet || 89 || brahmacārivānaprasthā yatayastyāgamārgagāḥ | māsaṃ śūnyaṃ vinā bhaktiṃ yāpayanti ca te yadi || 90 || tapasvino’pi te sarve muktiśūnyā bhavanti vai | śūdrāḥ striyastathā dāsavargāḥ śrīpuruṣottamam || 91 || gurordevasya ca sevāṃ vinā nirgamayanti cet | te’pi sampadvihīnāḥ syurduḥkhadāridryapīḍitāḥ || 92 || guruḥ sevyo hariḥ sevyaḥ sevyāḥ pitrādayo janāḥ | gauḥ saṃsevyā patiḥ sevyaḥ satī sevyā yathā hyaham || 93 || tatra tatra sthitaścāhaṃ phala dāsyāmi sarvathā | tasmāt sarvātmanā sarvaiḥ sevyaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 94 || ātmaśreyaḥ prakartavyaṃ dharmo bhaktiśca mokṣaṇam | vidhuratvaṃ ca vaidhavyaṃ malamāsasya nāvahet || 95 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamāsāḥ śṛṇvantu madvaco dhruvam | mamājñayā tu ye lokā brahmāṇḍavartinaḥ khalu || 96 || yatra yatrāstyayaṃ māsastatra tatrāpi māmakam | adhiṣṭhānasvarūpaṃ māṃ pūjayiṣyanti sarvathā || 97|| te madbhaktā mama dhāmākṣaraṃ prāpsyanti śāśvatam | golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ vāpi caiśvaram ||98|| yatheṣṭaṃ kṛpayā te te tattadbhaktāstathā tathā | yāsyanti paramaṃ sthānaṃ mama māsaprabhāvataḥ ||99|| tṛtīyāyāṃ mama māse yuvābhyāṃ pūjito’smyaham | tathā ye pūjayiṣyanti teṣāṃ pūrṇamanorathāḥ || 100 || sarvathaiva bhaviṣyanti snānadānajapādibhiḥ | yuvāṃ cintāṃ kurutaṃ mā lakṣmīśa rādhikeśvara || 101 || yātaṃ nijaṃ nijaṃ lokaṃ gṛhītvā puruṣottamam | ityādeśamadhiprāpya te praṇamya yayustrayaḥ || 1 02|| śṛṇu lakṣmi tṛtīyāyāṃ snāsyanti ye’dhike jalaiḥ | teṣāṃ brahmahade snānaṃ tathā brahmasarovare || 10 3|| kṛtaṃ snānaṃ tu yadvad vai tatpuṇyaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati | mama pūjā yathā tābhyāṃ kṛtā tatra yadarpitam || 1 24|| tathā pūjāṃ mama māse kariṣyanti ca ye janāḥ | dānānyapi kariṣyanti tatpuṇyaṃ śāśvataṃ bhavet || 1 05|| tṛtīyāyāṃ mama pūjā kṛtā tābhyāṃ yato mama | tṛtīyāyāṃ mahāpūjā kartavyā mānavairapi || 106|| nārāyaṇasya kṛṣṇasyāpi puruṣottamasya ca | kartavyā mahatī pūjā sukhamokṣādidāyinī ||1 07|| yathāhaṃ brahmadhāmnyasmi tathā māsātmako’paraḥ | brahmāṇḍe sarvathā cāsmi tathāsmyantarhṛdi sthitaḥ || 108|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāsmi rādhālakṣmyādisevitaḥ | ahaṃ sarvaṃ vijānāmi nānye jānanti māṃ tathā || 1 09|| pārvatyā prabhayā sākaṃ māṇikyā viharāmi ca | naikarūpo’pyeka evāsmīti viddhi madaṃgane || 11 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamalamāsānāmakṣaradhāmagamane brahmahradabrahmasarovarasnānottaraṃ śrīpuruṣottamasyasannidhigamanaṃ supūjanaṃ svanivedanottaramadhikamāsasya puruṣottamanāmaiśvaryasvāmikatvādiprāptistṛtīyātithikṛtpūjanadānādiphalanirūpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamāsānāṃ punaḥ svasvadhāmā gamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmāpañcanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ |||1.295|||
<1.296> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi trayaste’pi gatvā golokamityatha | viśaśramuḥ kṣaṇaṃ paścāt| kṛṣṇo dvābhyāṃ prapūjitaḥ || 1 || puruṣottamamahimā goloke bahudhābhavat | kṛṣṇaṃ natvā cāyayaturadhomāsa narāyaṇau || 2 || vaikuṇṭhaṃ cātha tatrāpi māso mahattvamāptavān | puruṣottamamāsaṃ ca vāsayāmāsa vai hariḥ || 3 || vāsamāsādya māso’pi ramate viṣṇunā saha | māsānāmadhipo bhūtvā gauraveṇa vyavasthitaḥ || 4 || athātra ca mahālakṣmyā gauraveṇa prapūjitaḥ | drutaṃ nārāyaṇenāpi pratibrahmāṇḍameva ha || 5 || tṛtīyāyāścāparāhṇe preṣayitvā svapārṣadān | samuddhoṣitamevāyaṃ malamāso mahottamaḥ || 6 || puruṣottamanāmāsau puruṣottamadaivataḥ | puruṣottamanāthena svargado mokṣadaḥ kṛtaḥ || 7 || svaguṇāścārpitā hyasmai na nyūnaḥ puruṣottamāt | pūjane vandane jāpe dāne snāne vrate’pi ca || 8 || puruṣottamatulyo’yaṃ puruṣottamayogadaḥ | naro nārī suro devī ye’pi sthāvarajaṃgamāḥ || 9 || bhāvato’pyekakāle’pi vrataṃ cātha prapūjanam | adhimāsasya sarvāṃgaṃ kariṣyanti madicchayā || 10 || prāpsyanti svepsitaṃ sarvaṃ nārāyaṇo bravīmyaham | kimu tarhiṃ trikāle ca vrate vaktavyamasya hi || 11 || māsavrate tu naivaiva vaktavyaṃ śiṣyate mama | tasmātpūjyaścaikakālaṃ dvikālaṃ samayatrayam || 12|| yatheṣṭaṃ prāpsyati nārī naro’pīṣṭamavāpsyati | kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇārdhaṃ ghaṭikāṃ sāyaṃ prātaḥ pramadhyake || 13 || yathāśakti yathāvastu pūjyo’yaṃ puruṣottamaḥ | nārāyaṇo bravīmyatra puruṣottamasākṣikaḥ || 14|| śrīkṛṣṇasākṣikaścāpi puruṣottamasaṃjñake | māse’tra māṃ kṣaṇamātraṃ pūjayiṣyanti bhāvata || 15 || svarge satyaṃ caiśalokaṃ prāpsyanti sveṣṭamityapi | prāpsyanti māṃ sukhavārdhi paraṃbrahma parātparam || 16 || nārāyaṇecchayā ye’tra pūjayiṣyanti bhāvataḥ | vaikuṇṭhasthaṃ ca te māṃ vai prāpsyantyeva narāyaṇam || 17|| śrīmatkṛṣṇecchayā ye’tra pūjayiṣyanti bhāvataḥ | golokasthaṃ ca te māṃ vai prāpsyantyeva hi mādhavam || 1 8|| puruṣottamakāmena pūjayiṣyanti ye janāḥ | brahmadhāmagataṃ prāpsyantyeva māṃ puruṣottamam || 19|| yadyadrūpaṃ ca māṃ ye’tra pūjayiṣyanti dehinaḥ | tattadrūpaṃ tatra tatra prāpsyanti te tu māṃ tathā ||20|| iti praśrāvitaṃ lakṣmi brahmāṇḍeṣu punaḥ punaḥ | mahādundubhibhirdūtaiḥ pārṣadairdivyavigrahaiḥ ||21 || malamāsastṛtīyāyāṃ niśyeva bahukoṭibhiḥ | satkṛtaḥ pūjitaḥ samyagbhojitaḥ śramamāpa vai ||22|| caturthyāṃ tu prage saptadvayalokanivāsibhiḥ | snānavratārcanadānādyairatīva pratoṣitaḥ ||23|| bahavaḥ sthāvarāścāpi cetanā vratakāriṇaḥ | samājagmurharerdhāma lakṣaśaḥ koṭiśastathā ||24|| caturthyāstu prage koṭidāsīyuktā vimānagā | ramādevī samāyātā vaikuṇṭhaṃ kṣairasāgarāt ||25|| vadhūṭīrūpatāṃ prāptā varamālāsamanvitā | lakṣmīsamā tu sarvāṃge na vai nyūnā manāgapi ||26|| nārāyaṇājñayā sā tu lakṣmyādibhiḥ susatkṛtā | sabhājitā tato nārāyaṇenāṃke niṣāditā ||27|| lakṣmyādayastadāścarye samprāpustadvilokya vai | kathaṃ patnīsvarūpeyaṃ svāmīnāṃgīkṛtā drutam ||28|| atha lakṣmyā ramā pṛṣṭā taditivṛttavittaye | kathaṃ kasmāt samāyātā kathaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ ||29|| kasya putrī kathaṃ prāptā kiṃ kṛtvainaṃ narāyaṇam | vada subhru svasaḥ sarvaṃ parivedyaṃ sukhottaram ||30|| lakṣmyā nārāyaṇenāpi bhojitā satkṛtā hi sā | samārebhe pravaktuṃ ca svakaṃ vṛttaṃ yathātatham || 31 || varamālāṃ hareḥ kaṇṭhe prasamarpyāgrataḥ sthitā | nārāyaṇāṃguṣṭhavāri pītvā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam ||36|| kuṃkumataṇḍulaiḥ kṛtvā bhāle śobhanacandrakam | varamālārdhakaṃ svasyāḥ kaṇṭhe kṛtvātha pāyasam ||33|| bhojayitvā hariṃ datvā tāmbūlaṃ tatprasādakam | gṛhītvā ca svayaṃ nārāyaṇāṃke kusumāṃjalim ||34|| sākṣatāṃ ca salājāṃ ca prasamarpyāsane sthitā | patnī bhūtvā jagādedaṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi ramoditam ||35|| śṛṇvatsu sarvabhakteṣu bhaktāsu prāha yad ramā | mama pūjye mahālakṣmi tṛtīyārātrisaṃcare ||36|| dundubhiḥ suśrutaḥ sarvairnārāyaṇasya nāmataḥ | adhimāse pūjakasya pūrayiṣye manorathān ||37|| mayāpi kanyayā kṣīrodadhergṛhe sa saṃśrutaḥ | vāñchitaśca patirnārāyaṇo lakṣmīpatiḥ prabhuḥ ||38|| malamāse tṛtīyāyāṃ sāyaṃ vai bhojanaṃ vinā | vinā jalaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā snātvā cāpūjayaṃ harim ||36|| pṛṣṭvā me janakaṃ kṣīrasāgaraṃ ca tadājñayā | maṇḍapaṃ kadalīstambhaiḥ śobhitaṃ patratoraṇaiḥ ||40 || kārayitvā ca tanmadhye dolāṃ ramyāṃ suśobhanām | lakṣmīnārāyaṇamūrtiṃ sauvarṇīṃ ratnarājitām ||41|| saṃsnāpya sarvasāmudraiḥ ratnaiḥ prapūjya bhāvataḥ | divyavastrairvibhūṣābhiścālaṃkṛtya dravādibhiḥ ||42|| sampūjya dhūpadīpaiśca bhojanairjalapānakaiḥ | ārārtrikastutipradakṣiṇābhirabhivandya ca ||43|| puṣpāṃjaliṃ pradāyaiva saṃkalpya manasā punaḥ | patirme bhava viśvātman ramāyāstvaṃ narāyaṇa ||44|| iti saṃstūya caraṇāmṛtaṃ pītvā sukomale | paryaṃke śrīhariḥ premṇā mayā prasvāpitaḥ saha ||45|| dhyāto mayā sa nidrāyāṃ sevayāmi hariṃ tataḥ | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ tasya karomīti nibhālitaḥ ||46|| kṣaṇaṃ svapne harirdṛṣṭo mayā sve śayane saha | hasanmāṃ svakaṭākṣeṇākarṣayanniva bhāvataḥ ||47|| vadan śruto vratena tvāṃ svīkaromi priyāṃ rame | prātarnetuṃ mama lokaṃ tvāgamiṣye punaḥ priye ||48|| iti drāgeva saṃśrāvya svayamadṛśyatāṃ gataḥ | so’yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī lakṣmīpatirvirājate ||49|| mayā nārāyaṇe yāte muhūrte brāhmasaṃjñake | caturthyāmadhimāsasya dhyātvainaṃ puruṣottamam ||50|| snātvā śayyāgataṃ devaṃ snāpayitvātibhāvataḥ | kṣīrādibhistathā vārbhiścandanādi pramardya ca ||51|| śrāṃgārikāṇyarpayitvā vivāhavaravat kṛtaḥ | dattaṃ pītāmbaraṃ cātimūlyaṃ pītāṃgarakṣakam ||52|| prāvāraṃ svarṇatārāḍhyaṃ cottarīyaṃ tathottamam | mastake svarṇamukuṭaḥ sakalgiḥ kuṇḍale śrutau ||53|| tilakaṃ candrako bhāle kajjalaṃ netrayorbhruvi | candanaṃ gaṇḍayorbindū cibuke svalpacandrakaḥ ||54|| puṣpaprāvaraṇaṃ bhāle varamālā ca kaṇṭhake | vakṣasi svarṇahārāśca kaṃkaṇe karayoḥ śubhe ||55|| ūrmikāścāṃguligrāme bhujabandhau bhujadvaye | tulasīpuṣpahārāśca khaṅgo haste suvarṇajaḥ ||56|| nārikelaphalaṃ cāpi kare kaṭyāṃ ca mekhalā | nupūre pādayoścāpi pāduke kānakī śubhe ||57|| kāmaphalaṃ prakoṣṭhe vai bhojane pāyasaṃ śubham | tāmbūlakaṃ jalapānaṃ phalaṃ drākṣā rasātmikā ||58|| pūgīphalaṃ tato dānaṃ dakṣiṇā varamālikā | havanāni śataṃ cāṣṭau ghṛtena vahnimaṇḍale ||59|| ārārtrikaṃ pañcavarti pradakṣiṇacatuṣṭayam | vareṇyo varadaścāsi varo me bhava sadvacāḥ ||60 || puṣpāṃjalistathārghyaṃ ca namaskāraḥ kṣamārthanā | visarjanaṃ pādavāripānaṃ ca śeṣabhakṣaṇam ||61|| svapnadṛṣṭasya saṃdhyānaṃ pratīkṣā ca kadāgamaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmnā bhajanaṃ cātiharṣaṇam ||62|| bhojanaṃ bālikābhyaśca dānaṃ kanyābhya ityapi | dhyānaṃ nārāyaṇe dehaḥ kṣīrasāgarake gṛhe ||63|| netre vyomni pare mārge hyātmā vaikuṇṭhavāsini | ityevaṃ parivārāḍhye’dhimāse pūjite harau ||64|| natvā ca janakaṃ kṛtvā pāraṇāṃ payasā manāk | yāvat tiṣṭhāmi bhavane tāvannārāyaṇo hyayam ||65|| prādurbhūto mamāgretirūpānurūparājitaḥ | prasannaścātitejasvī cāspṛśanmāṃ kareṇa vai ||66|| svasamīpaṃ samākṛṣya samāgacchetyuvāca mām | malamāse hyekakāle tṛtīyāyāṃ tvayārcitaḥ ||67|| niśi savāhitaścāpi caturthyāṃ cātipūjitaḥ | prātareva tvayā mānye cārjito’smi vratena vai ||68|| yathā bhāvanayā subhru tvayā cādya prapūjitaḥ | tathā prāpto’smi kalyāṇi subhage’si mama priye ||69|| samāgaccha mayā sārdhaṃ jātāsi śāśvatī vadhūḥ | tava vratena te dāsyaḥ sarvā api mama gṛham ||70|| samāyāntu mama dāsyo bhāvinyaḥ sarvathā rame | iti kṛtvā garuḍaṃ svaṃ darśayāmāsa sadvaraḥ ||71|| yānāni vāhanānyatra yāni santi sahasraśaḥ | mayā matpitaraṃ gatvāveditaṃ sarvameva tat ||72|| sopi tatra samāgatya dattavān māṃ hareḥ kare | pitrājñayā kṛtakṛtyā jātāruroha pakṣiṇam ||73|| pitrā prasthāpitā sainyayutā satkārapūrvakam | yautakaṃ saṃgṛhītvaiva samāyātā hareḥ puram ||74|| so’yaṃ nārāyaṇaścātra bhavane’pi vilokitaḥ | mayā sahāpi sa eva vartate paśya bhāmini ||75|| adhimāse niśi prātaḥ pūjane’sya phalena vai | prāptāhaṃ satpatiṃ nārāyaṇaṃ cātra samāgatā ||76|| nītā tenaiva kṛṣṇena prāpitāṃkamanena vai | kṛtā navavadhūścāpi patnī vaikuṇṭhavāsinī ||77|| ramāsmi te sakhī dāsī tvatkṛpākāṃkṣiṇī sadā | ityevaṃ cādhimāsasya phalaṃ prāptaṃ mayānaghe ||78|| mayā nārāyaṇapūjā kṛtā tadvat kariṣyati | kanyakā yuvatī vāpi prāpsyatyenaṃ narāyaṇam ||79|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cādhimāse saṃpūjya sarvathā | caturthyāṃ prātarevāpi madhyāhne vā niśīthake ||80 || pūjayiṣyanti yadvṛttyā pūrayiṣyatyayaṃ tathā | dhanaṃ putrān sukhaṃ dārān patiṃ dhānyāni sadgṛham ||8 1 || yānaṃ ca vāhanaṃ tejo rūpamaiśvaryamuttamam | rājyaṃ sattāṃ priyāṃ bhāryā dāsān dāsīśca vaibhavān ||82|| bhogyān bhogopasambaddhān bhojyānpeyānanantakān | padārthān divyatattvasthān yatheṣṭān suratān ratim ||83|| svargān satyaparān lokān pārameṣṭhisthalānyapi | vairājām̐ścāpi vaikuṇṭhabhūmikā dhenubhūmikāḥ ||84|| golokaṃ cākṣaraṃ cāpi divyaṃ cādivyameva yat | saṃkalpyādhikamāse vai nārāyaṇasya pūjakāḥ ||85|| narā nāryo devadevyaścaturdaśastarasthitāḥ | prāpsyanti svepsitaṃ sarve puruṣottamavāñchayā ||86|| yathāhaṃ svalpayatnena saṃjātā śāśvatīsamāḥ | susaubhāgyavatī lakṣmi tathānyāpi bhaviṣyati ||87|| vidhavāpi yadi strī vai madvat kṛṣṇasya pūjanam | kariṣyatyadhimāse sā vaikuṇṭhaṃ prāpsyati dhruvam ||88|| nārāyaṇaṃ patiṃ labdhvā syāt saubhāgyavatī sadā | vṛddhā vā rogiṇī yadvā tiraskṛtā ca bāndhavaiḥ ||89|| karmaṇā yā paribhraṣṭā paścāttāpena saṃyutā | anāthā caikalā cātyāśritā raṇḍā ca puṃścalī ||9 0|| svairiṇī kāminī vāpi yena kenāpi saṃgatā | jñātihīnā vratahīnā paśusaṃsargakāriṇī ||9 1 || jaihvye ratyāṃ sadā lubdhā madyamāṃsādinī kimu | rājasvalyādidoṣasthā sāṃkaryadoṣasaṃsthitā ||92|| śvapacādyāśrayāpannā susaṃskāravivarjitā | yā kāpi vā bhavennārī śubhasaṃskārayogataḥ ||93|| śrutvā kathāṃ vrataṃ kṛtvādhimāse tu yathābalam | hariprāptīcchayā caikabhuktaṃ naktamayācitam ||94|| phalāhāraṃ payaḥpānaṃ kṛtvāpi śrīharerbalāt | pramārjya sarvapāpātipāpāni cātipāvanī || 95|| paṃktisaṃpāvanī bhūtvā veśyā vā gaṇikāpi vā | nartakī vā prabhaṇḍā vā kuṭṭinī vā prasādhinī || 96|| yā vā kā vā bhavelloke bhūtvā pavitravigrahā | kṣetraṃ viṣṇoḥ kṛpāyāśca bhūtvā kāṃcanasadṛśī ||97|| divyā śuddhā pāpahīnā puṇyapuñjānvitā satī | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaviṣṇukṛpābhiratipāvitā || 98|| svasamānāstathānyāśca pāvayitvā svasaṃgataḥ | sanātanaṃ paraṃ dhāma viṣṇoryat tatprayāsyati || 99 || ramāhaṃ saṃsthitā nārāyaṇāṃke lakṣmi sarvathā | kathayāmi punaḥ satyaṃ sā prāpsyati hareḥ padam || 100 || ṣaṇḍho vā ṣaṇḍhatulyo vā ṣaṃḍhā vā ṣaṇḍhasadṛśī | anārtavī vicittā vā vānarīva vratacyutā || 101 || yā kāpi vā bhavet sāpi māse śrīpuruṣottame | vrataṃ kṛtvā varaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ samarjayiṣyati || 10 2|| niṣkāmo vātha niṣkāmā muktatāṃ prāpya sarvathā | harerdivyākṣaraṃ dhāma prāpsyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 103 || kimvadhikaṃ kathayāmi māyāpyamāyikī bhavet | yadyogāttarhi nārīṇāṃ kā kathā muktisaṃgame || 1 04|| tasmādvrataṃ prakartavyaṃ tvadhimāsasya sarvathā | bhuktirmuktistathā svargaṃ sarvaṃ prāpyeta yadbalāt || 1 06|| ahaṃ cātra sthitā jyeṣṭhe nibhālyānugraheṇa vā | ityuktvā praṇanāmaināṃ lakṣmīṃ vātsalyavardhinīm || 106 || nārāyaṇo’pi tāmenāṃ bhavanāni nināya ca | ramayāmāsa satkāmaiḥ pūrayāmāsa bhāvanāḥ || 1 07|| evaṃ priye ramā jātā kathaṃ nārāyaṇapriyā | kṣīrasāgaraputrīyaṃ sā tubhyaṃ kathitā kathā || 108 || asyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa paṭhanena ca pūjayā | adhimāsavratajanyaṃ phalaṃ vindettu mānavaḥ || 10 9|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīya saṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsa māhātmye nārāyaṇādhimāsayorvaikuṇṭhavasatirbrahmāṇḍeṣvadhikamāsavratārthe dundubhighoṣaṇā tāṃ śrutvā kṣīrasāgaraputrīramayā tṛtīyāsāyaṃ caturthīprātarvratapūjādikaraṇena vaikuṇṭhe nārāyaṇapatnītvaprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṇṇavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.296 ||
<1.297> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi śāradāyāḥ kathā śubhā | adhimāsasya paṃcamyāṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā ca pūjanam || 1 || aiśvaryamatulaṃ prāpa kaumāryaṃ śāśvataṃ ca sā | rājasvalyavihīnatvaṃ prasāraṇaṃ mukhe mukhe || 2 || tathā vaikuṇṭhanāthasya patnītvaṃ divyamavyayam | avāpa śāradā loke pūjyatāṃ padmajā yathā || 3 || patnītve sati kaumārye kumārītve vadhūtvakam | viruddhadharmayoścāsyāṃ sthitiḥ śrīharitoṣaṇāt || 4 || adhimāsabalopetāṃ camatkāramayīṃ kathām | śṛṇu lakṣmi mahāpuṇyāṃ puruṣottamamāsikīm || 5 || brahmadhāmasthitānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃgataḥ | brahmavidyā śāradākhyā prakaṭībhūya sundarī || 6 || vairājalokamāgatyājñayā nārāyaṇasya sā | vairāje līnatāṃ prāpya brahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraiḥ || 7 || sahotpannā kanyakā sā vairājī śāradā sutā | bahukālaṃ pitṛgehe vāsaṃ cakre kumārikā || 8 || brahmajñānātmikā nityaṃ vicārayati varṣmaṇi | yadarthaṃ brahmaṇā cāhamāviṣkṛtā tu devatā || 9 || vāṅmayī vedhasaḥ sṛṣṭau sthātuṃ pratimukhaṃ khalu | tato’haṃ vaidhasī bhūtvā gacchāmi yadi sṛṣṭiṣu || 10 || kumārī cennivatsyāmi hyaśuddhā cāpyasaṃskṛtā | aspṛśyā vai bhaviṣyāmi sarvairbahiṣkṛtā sadā || 11 || tadā tu maraṇaṃ tatra śaraṇaṃ me bhaviṣyati | kumārikāśarīraṃ vai garbhīyaṃ pāpakaṃ hi tat || 1 2|| kasyāpi karmaṇo yogyaṃ bhavatyeva na sarvathā | mūtrendriyaprajanmāsau mūtrakukṣau pravardhitaḥ || 13|| mūtrātmajalamagno’sau mūtradvāreṇa nirgataḥ | bālye’pi malamūtrātmāspṛśyāśuddhamalāvṛtaḥ || 14|| yajñopavītasaṃskārahīno dehaḥ sadāśuciḥ | aśuddhakaphaphītādivikṛtipūttalātmakaḥ || 15|| kumārikāsthitau nārīdehaḥ kathaṃ śubho bhavet | vivāhakaraṇe śuddhirnānyathā tu kadācana || 16 || vivāho’pi mahāduḥkhapradaḥ puruṣavaśyatā | mūtrendriyaparādhīnamālinyakarmakāritā || 17|| mūtrakukṣau garbhavāso garbhajanmamalāktatā | sūtakaṃ sarvathā cārte raktasrāvo malānvayaḥ || 18|| malamūtrasamutpattirapānānilasaṃsṛtiḥ | mālinyaṃ sarvathā patnībhāve maithunakarmaṇi || 19|| tasmāt parāśrayaḥ patnībhāvo’tyadhikaduḥkhakṛt | kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ nārī kṛtā parāśrayā ||2 0 || nārīdehaḥ parādhīnaḥ parabhogyaḥ parārthakaḥ | yena tādṛk kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ nārītāṃ saḥ prapadyate ||21 || tanna mayā paranāryā bhavitavyamadhīnayā | evaṃ rajasvalādharmo mālinyaṃ pāpakārakam ||22|| neṣyate yena tadapi pāravaśyaṃ na me bhavet | madiṣṭaṃ yadi naiva syānmariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ||23|| amālinyaṃ pavitratvamarājasvalyamityapi | patnīdharmavihīnatvaṃ kaumārye ca yathā mama ||24|| śāśvataṃ syād yathā yatnastathā kāryo hyataḥ param | iti nityaṃ cintayānā mārgayāmāsa sādhanam ||25|| śuśrāva dundubhiṃ viṣṇoradhimāsavratāya vai | puruṣottamamāsasya vratināṃ vai manorathāḥ ||26|| paripūrṇā bhaviṣyantītyāha śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā pūjayiṣyanti māṃ janāḥ ||27|| naro nārī ca ṣaṇḍho vā matkṛpāleśato hi saḥ | alabhyalābhavān syācca dāsye sarvaṃ tadīpsitam ||28|| kumārī śāradā vairājasya putrī praghoṣaṇām | śrupvātiharṣamāpannā manaścakre vratārcane ||29|| pañcamyāṃ sā tithau prātaḥ śīghraṃ śīghraṃ samutthitā | śrutvaivaṃ dundubhiṃ snātvā dhyātvā mūrti harestathā ||30 || pūjādravyāṇi divyāni saṃgṛhya bhavane svake | viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ||3 1|| lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ svarṇaṃ śrīhariṃ puruṣottamam | āvāhyāsanamāstīrya pādyārghyācamanāni ca ||32|| datvā paṃcāmṛtaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ snāpayitvā jalena ca | amṛtena rasenāpi sugandhidravavastubhiḥ ||33|| sammardya gātramurudhā śṛṃgāramakarottataḥ | alaṃkāravibhūṣāśca dhārayitvāmbarāṇi ca ||34|| prapūjya kastūrikābhiścandanākṣatakuṃkumaiḥ | tulasīpuṣpamandāracampakaiḥ paripūjya ca ||35|| dhūpadīpasunaivedyaiḥ phalaiḥ pānaiśca carvaṇaiḥ | tāmbūlakaistoṣayitvārārtrikaṃ tvakarottataḥ ||36|| pradakṣiṇaṃ stutiṃ kṛtvā daṇḍavat praṇanāma sā | kṣamāparādhaṃ svābhīṣṭaṃ prārthayat sā kumārikā ||37|| dundubhinā pravaktarhe lakṣmīnārāyaṇa prabho | brahmagolokavaikuṇṭhavāsin śrīpuruṣottama || 38|| satyaṃ dadāsi bhaktāya yatheṣṭaṃ vratakāriṇe | tadā mahyaṃ tathā dehi yathāhaṃ pravṛṇomi tat|| 39|| kumārītvaṃ śāśvataṃ me rājasvalyaṃ kadāpi na | aśuddhatvaṃ ca me māstu tathā satyapi me punaḥ ||40 || patimattvaṃ sumāṃgalyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ sarvadāstu me | sagarbhātvaṃ ca me māstu patnītve’pi kadācana ||41 || etadvai durlabhaṃ yāce viruddhaṃ sarvathā tanau | yadi satyapravaktā tvaṃ hyekakālavrate kṛte ||42|| adhimāse pūjite ced dadāsi dehi me tathā | anyathā dundubhiṃ deva mā pravādaya cānṛtam ||43 || chatraṃ dadāmi te nātha cāmare’pi dadāmi te | pāduke te pradadāmi śayyāṃ dadāmi komalām ||44|| pādasaṃvāhanārthāya mā dadāmi samarpitām | śaraṇāgatapāla tvaṃ bhaktavāñcchāprapūraka ||45 || puṣpāṃjaliṃ gṛhāṇaināṃ karaṃ gṛhāṇa vā na vā | dehi madarthitaṃ nātha śāśvataṃ sukhadaṃ hi tat ||46|| kumārī naiva patnī syāt patnī syānna kumārikā | patnītve bahavo doṣā mā spṛśeyuśca māṃ yathā ||47|| kumārītve’pi ye doṣā mā spṛśeyuśca māṃ yathā | tathā dehi kṛpānātha satyārtho dundubhiryadi || 48|| kartuṃ cākartumevāpyanyathākartuṃ prabhostava | kimapyaśakyaṃ nāstyevānyathā te dundubhirvṛthā ||49|| iti stutvā phalairyuktamarghyaṃ samarpya viṣṇave | akṣatairvardhayāmāsa kumārī śāradā tataḥ ||5 0 || devaṃ tu dakṣiṇāṃ svīyasamarpaṇātmikāṃ hṛdi | datvā visarjayāmāsa dhyāyamānā narāyaṇam ||5 1 || tāvannārāyaṇo lakṣmīpatiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | ramāpatirhasanmandaṃ prāvirbabhūva cāgrataḥ ||52|| dakṣadoṣṇābhayadaśca vāmena mastake spṛśan | uvāca śāradaṃ kinte manasyasti prakāśaya ||53 || pūjayā te prasanno’smi viśvāsavratacāriṇi | subhru viśvāsapāśena baddho’smi sarvadā tvayā ||54|| dātuṃ sarvaṃ samartho’smi tathāpi śṛṇu me vacaḥ | kumārītvaṃ ca patnītvaṃ naikatra kvāpi dṛśyate ||55|| anyataraṃ tayostasmād vṛṇu tubhyaṃ dadāmyatha | kumārītvaṃ kalakāya loke tvājīvanaṃ bhavet ||56|| tasmāt patnītvamevātra vṛṇu saubhāgyadaṃ dade | anyaccāpi ca te kāmyaṃ dadāmi vṛṇu kanyake ||57|| strīrājyaṃ vā mahadrājyaṃ māyārājyaṃ dadāmi te | viruddhaṃ mā vṛṇu kanye brūhi vicārya mā ciram ||58|| ityāśrutya harervākyaṃ śāradā prāha keśavam | bhakteṣṭapūraka svāmim̐stavoddhoṣānmayārthitam ||59|| svasatyarakṣaṇārthāya yathecchasi tathā kuru | nahi bhakte tvāgrahaḥ syādāgrahī nahi bhaktimān ||60 || ahaṃ tava prapannāsmi bhaktacintāṃ hara prabho | tavāsmi tava bhaktāsmi pādayoḥ patitā tava ||6 1 || nārīduḥkhāni me mā syuriti bhakteṣṭamāvaha | ityarthitaśca dṛṣṭaśca spṛṣṭo nataḥ kṛtādaraḥ ||62|| pūjito bhojitastatrātyantapremṇā vilokitaḥ | bhaktārtihā prabhuḥ svabhaktāyāḥ kṛte vyacintayat||63|| kathamasyā manobhīṣṭaṃ pradātavyaṃ bhavediti | kayā rītyā pūraṇīyo bhavenmanoratho’pi ca ||64|| dadāmyasyai mahāsiddhiṃ vyāpyavyāpakarūpiṇīm | naikarūpabhavitrīṃ ca divyāṃ siddhiṃ dadāmi ha ||65 || iti saṃkalpya bhagavān dadau śaṃkhajalaṃ mukhe | tāvatsā sarvasāmarthyanidhirūpā babhūva vai ||66|| bhagavām̐stu tataḥ prāha śārade śāradātmikā | divyarūpā mama patnī sadā vaikuṇṭhavāsinī ||67|| garbhādidoṣaśūnyā tvaṃ bhavasīti vibhāvaya | dattaṃ madīyapatnītvaṃ yaunamālinyavarjitam ||68|| malamūtrādyanāspṛṣṭaṃ divyaṃ rūpaṃ sadāstu te | atha rūpaṃ dvitīyaṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇa vāṅmayaṃ priye ||69|| kumārībhāvasampannaṃ sarasvatīsvarūpakam | dadāmi tādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ sukumāraṃ tathā bhava ||70|| gaccha tena svarūpeṇa vedhodvārā prajāsu vai | vyāpakaṃ te svarūpaṃ syāṃ vāṇīrūpaṃ mukhe mukhe ||71 || kumārītvaṃ sadā tatra svarūpe te’stu śārade | antarmukhapracāritve tvarājasvalyamastu te ||72|| sāttvikatvaṃ kumārītvaṃ sarvadā tattathāstu te | atha tṛtīyarūpega kenacitsanmiṣeṇa vai ||73|| sarasvatī nadīrūpā tvantarjalapravāhiṇī | arajaskā kumārī tvaṃ sadā tiṣṭhatu śārade ||74|| cāñcalyaṃ ca bahirbhāvo rājasvalyaṃ ca māstu te | pāvitryaṃ sarvadā te’stu ṛtudharmavivarjanam ||75|| rājasvalyaṃ vilīnaṃ te mālinyabhāvavarjitam | bhavatācchārade kāpyaśuddhirmāstu tvayi kvacit ||76 || sarvaiśvaryavatī pūjyā lokeṣu vyāpinī bhava | lokānāṃ rājasaṃ pāpaṃ māstu tvayi sarasvati ||77|| bahirbhāve tvayi rājasvalyādi lokakṛd yadi | dṛśyeta taddūṣaṇaṃ tu lokānāṃ na tu tat tvayi ||78|| rājasvalyakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vaktṝṇāṃ syādaśuddhatā | pāvitryaṃ sarvadā te’stu santu te divyasampadaḥ ||79|| kumārītvaṃ ca patnītvaṃ te’stu śuddhaṃ yathepsitam | mama patnī śāradā tvaṃ kumārī brahmaputrikā ||80 || sarvaṃ dattaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ vad tvanyat kimicchasi | ityuktā prāha sā devī mama pūjākṛtastu ye ||8 1|| sarasvatyāḥ śāradāyā nadyā vāṇyā upāsakāḥ | vaikuṇṭhaṃ te samāyāntu svāminaste pratāpataḥ ||82|| adhimāsasya pañcamyāṃ prātaḥ sampūjya vai kramāt | nārāyaṇaṃ yathā prāptāsmyahaṃ pūrṇamanorathā ||83|| tathā te pūjakāścādhimāsasya pūjakāstathā | narā nāryaḥ samāyāntu vaikuṇṭhaṃ tava pādayoḥ ||84|| janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiduḥkhadāridryavarjiṃtam | śāśvataṃ saccidānandasandohamūrtirājitam ||85|| tathāstviti prāha kurvan haridundubhighoṣaṇām | sārthakā satyaphaladāṃ tvādhimāsasya puṣṭidām ||86 || adhimāso’pi tāṃ prāha bhaktā ye yā mayi tvayi | teṣāṃ tāsāṃ samuddhartā tvahaṃ vai puruṣottamaḥ ||87|| doṣahartā sukhadātā mano’bhīṣṭapradastathā | pāvayitā siddhidātā bhavāmyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||88|| śāradāyā idaṃ prārthya śroṣyanti ye tu durlabham | paṭhiṣyanti ca vā teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ bhavet ||89|| apatarkyaṃ sutarkyaṃ syādaprāpyaṃ prāpyatāṃ vrajet | abhāvyaṃ bhāvyatāṃ yāyādaniṣṭaṃ ceṣṭatāṃ vrajet ||90 || bhuvi svarge tathānyatra durlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ bhavet | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāllabhyetānyasya kā kathā ||9 1 || nārāyaṇaḥ svakṛpayā dadātyasya vai bahu | adhimāsi kṛtasyātrāsaṃkhyaphalaṃ dadāti hi ||92|| labdha lakṣmi yathā devyā śāradāyā vicitrakam | tathā vicitrāṃ bhuktiṃ ca muktiṃ ca labhate’rcakaḥ ||93 || japo homo vrataṃ dānaṃ dhyānaṃ mālā tapaḥ śrutam | pañcamyāṃ tatkṛtaṃ sahasrādiguṇaṃ bhaviṣyati ||94|| ityuktvā śāradāṃ nītvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ harirāyayau | sarasvatīsvarūpāṃ tāṃ prāhiṇod vaidhasīṃ prajām || 95|| amālinyaṃ pavitratvamarājasvalyamityapi | patnīdharmānabhibhūtiḥ kaumārye ceti rakṣitam || 96 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīya saṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye vairājaputryāḥ śāradāyā adhikamāsapañcamyāṃ vratapūjanādikaraṇena nārāyaṇapatnītvaṃ pavitratvam arājasvalyaṃ kumārikātvam agarbhākatvaṃ sarasvatītā cetyādiprāptinirūpaṇādināmā saptanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.297 ||
<1.298> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ divyāṃ sukhasampatpradāyinīm | kāmanāpūrikāṃ daivīṃ puruṣottamayoginīm || 1 || sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe tu pitṝṇāṃ kanyā āsan susadguṇāḥ | tisro nāmnā svadhāputryo menā dhanyā kalāvatī || 2 || sarvasadguṇasampannā yoginyaḥ kāmarūpagāḥ | viharantyaḥ pitṛgehe śuśruvurdundubhiṃ hareḥ || 3 || puruṣottamamāso’yaṃ mannāmnā tu mayādṛtaḥ | ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā tadvratasthamanorathān || 4 || pūrayiṣyāmyahaṃ nārāyaṇo bravīmi vai svayam | pitṛgehe tithau ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prātarākarṇya ghoṣaṇām || 5 || tisṛbhiścintitaṃ tvadya vrataṃ kāryaṃ hareḥ khalu | yenāsmākaṃ svabhīṣṭaṃ dāsyati nārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 6 || pitṝṇāṃ nityasantoṣastṛptirvai śāśvatī bhavet | taddhetuṃ mārgayitvātra yācyaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 7 || patitvena tu viṣṇuḥ sa yācanīyo na vai kvacit | yatastasya tu patnīnāṃ bāhulyaṃ vidyate tataḥ || 8 || sāpatnyaṃ sarvadā duḥkhaṃ sukhanikṛntanaṃ hi tat | pitṛtvenāthavā bhrātṛtvenādhyeṣṭavya eva na || 9 || bālikānāṃ tadāsmākamajñānāṃ kiṃ sukhena vai | vivāhāvadhivāsastu tadgṛhe vai bhavet tataḥ || 10 || viyogo bāndhavānāṃ ca pituśca duḥkhameva tat | putratvenāpi viṣṇuḥ sa yācanīyo na vai kvacit || 11 || tāḍane śikṣaṇe’dhikṣepādau syādaparādhitā | śvaśurādisvarūpe tu maryādā duḥkhadā bhavet || 12|| aparādho’tinaikaṭye’tidūre syādasevanam | atiyoge’timaryādā vimaryādāpi duḥkhadā || 13 || viṣṇustasmād yācanīyaḥ kena rūpeṇa vai bhavet | parasparamiti kṛtvā saṃvidaṃ tisra eva tāḥ || 14|| samādadhuḥ kṣaṇaṃ maunaṃ cintayantyo narāyaṇam | tāvad vyomagatā vāṇī tā jagād punaḥ punaḥ || 15 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jāmātṛtvena vṛṇutābalāḥ | sarvaṃ sukhaṃ bhavet tasmai putrīdānena śāśvatam || 1 6|| putrī mātā svayaṃ proktā putrīmukhena nityadā | sukhitā manyate putrīdānaṃ svadānavad bhavet || 17|| jāmātā putravat syācca dānapātraṃ paraṃ mataḥ | pūjanīyastoṣaṇīyo vividhaiḥ sevanairapi || 18 || putryā sevā kṛtā yā tatphalaṃ māturbhavedapi | mātrānunītayā putryā sevanaṃ yad vidhīyate || 19 || śiṣyakṛte gurorbhāgastadvanmātrāpi labhyate | aihikī sukhasampattiryaśaḥ khyātirdhruvā bhavet ||2 0 || śreyāṃsi bahurūpāṇi loke jāmātṛvaibhavāt | bhavantyeveti niścitya jāmātāraṃ samīcchata || 21 || putrī vaikuṇṭhanāthasya dhāmni yasyā vaset sadā | tanmātāpitarau puṇyau kvacid vaikuṇṭhagau matau || 22|| saptakulaśataikānāṃ bhaveduddharaṇaṃ tathā | mātā mātāmahādyāśca bhaveyurmokṣagāstathā || 23 || pitṝṇāṃ sarvadā vāso jāmātṛbhavane bhavet | tasmādbhavatyo yācantu jāmātāraṃ hariṃ sadā ||24|| putrīṇāṃ tatra sāpatnyaṃ mā bhavedityapi dhruvam | yācantvadhikamāsasya vrataṃ kṛtvā tathārcanam || 25 || virarāmeti sambodhyākāśavāṇī tataśca tāḥ | cakitā atisaṃhṛṣṭā vinirṇīya tathaiva tāḥ || 26|| brahma bhavatājjāmātā jāmātā bhavatāddhariḥ | kṛṣṇo bhavatu jāmātetyuktvā vai cakrire vratam || 27|| ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prātaśca tāḥ snātvā vyadhustisro’pi pūjanam | tisro mūrtīḥ suvarṇasya menā dhanyā kalāvatī || 28|| vidhāya pūjayāmāsuḥ kramādāvāhanādibhiḥ | devān pañcāmṛtaistrīṃśca snapayāmāsurādarāt || 29 || candanādibhirāmardya snapayāmāsurabvaraiḥ | sammārjya vastrabhūṣābhiralaṃcakrurdravādibhiḥ || 30 || kuṃkumākṣatakastūrīsugandhivastupuṣpakaiḥ | hāramālāmukuṭādyairdhūpadīpādibhistathā || 31 || naivedyairvividhairmiṣṭaiḥ pānatāmbūlacūrṇakaiḥ | sampūjya trīn chatraśayyācāmaropānahādibhiḥ || 32|| phalaiśca śarkarābhiśca trīn devānabhivardhya ca | arghyaṃ ratnādisaṃyuktaṃ kadalīphalasaṃyutam || 33 || dadustāśca namaskṛtya tataḥ puṣpāñjalīn daduḥ | kṣamāṃ samprārthya vavarurjāmātā bhava keśava || 34|| bhavaddundubhinirghoṣādasmābhirhṛtsu saṃdhṛtaḥ | sarvathā sukhado deva putrīdvārā bhavātra naḥ || 35|| puruṣottamamāsasya ṣaṣṭhīyaṃ pālitā vrate | kariṣyāmo vayaṃ naktaṃ punaḥ pūjāṃ vidhāyate || 3 6|| tato visarjayāmāsustāndevānprātareva ha | divāvrataṃ kṛtaṃ tābhirvipradvārānale ghṛtaiḥ || 37|| madhyāhne havanaṃ kārayitvā pupūjurādarāt | pitṝn ṛṣīṃstathā devānmunīn janatapaḥsthitān || 38 || pāyasairdugdhasāraiśca piṇḍakaiḥ śākapatrakaiḥ | rasairnānāvidhairmiṣṭaistarpayāmāsurīśvarān || 39 || prasannāste śubhāśīrbhiryuyujustisṛkanyakāḥ | brahma nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo bhavadvrataphalapradāḥ ||40 || bhavantu bhavatīnāṃ ca yatheṣṭasukhakāriṇaḥ | atha sāyaṃ punastābhirdīpamālāṃ prakāśya ca ||41 || maṇḍapaṃ kadalīstambhapatratoraṇarājitam | kārayitvā svarṇapātradarpaṇollekhaśobhitam ||42 || vastravidyudvicitraṃ saccitraujjvalyamanoharam | kārayitvā ca madhye sadratnakhacitakānakam ||43 || makhamallakaśipvādyairāstṛtaṃ śobhanaṃ mahata | siṃhāsanaṃ kārayitvā brahma kṛṣṇaṃ narāyaṇam ||44|| mūrtitrayaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya gītavāditrapūrvakam | cakruḥ supūjanaṃ tatra suvarṇākṣatakuṃkumaiḥ || 45 || haridrāraktasaddravyaiḥ saubhāgyārhasuvastubhiḥ | nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ cakruḥ kiṃkiṇīnādamiśritam ||46 || ārārtrikaṃ dhūpadīpau jalamarghyaṃ vidhāya ca | pūrikā dugdhapānaṃ ca śākaṃ sarṣapapatrajam ||47|| bhojayitvā trayaṃ vāripānamarpayya satphalam | pradatvā ca kṣaṇaṃ dhyāne sthitavatyo’bhavam̐śca tāḥ ||48 || tatra dhyāne samāyātā brahmakṛṣṇanarāyaṇāḥ | etāsu menayā dṛṣṭaḥ kaṭyambaro’tipuṣṭimāna ||49 || nihāradhavalo vyāghracarmadhṛk candraśekharaḥ | sajaṭaḥ parito vyāpta brahmatejo’tibhāsuraḥ ||5 0 || yuvā manauhārimūrtirbrahma nirguṇameva yat | saguṇatvaṃ samāpannaṃ nararūpaṃ sa eva saḥ ||5 1 || nirmalāntarvṛttigamyaḥ śaṃkaro bhāvapūrakaḥ | prasannatāpravarṣā prakhyāpayan smitahāsyataḥ ||52|| tāvattadaṅkamāsīnāṃ putrīṃ svāṃ bhāvinīṃ śubhām | apaśyannāhvayantīṃ ca hyambe māmbeti vai muhuḥ ||53 || śaṃkaro brahmarūpo’yaṃ bhagavān prāha menakām | menake tvaṃ mamāṃśasya himādreḥ saṃbhaviṣyasi || 54|| patnī tatra ca kanyeyaṃ pārvatī te bhaviṣyati | tāṃ tvaṃ dāsyasi mahyaṃ vai mattaḥ sukhamavāpsyasi ||55|| puruṣottamamāsasyaikadinasya vratasya ca | taveṣṭaṃ tu phalaṃ sarvasukhadaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ||56 || ityuktvāntarhito devaḥ śaṃkaro brahma yatparam | athaiva dhanyayā dṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃ vai sadhanurhariḥ ||57|| jaṭāvalkalaśobhāḍhyaḥ punaḥ sadrājyacihnavān | yuvā manoharo devo vāsudevo guṇātigaḥ ||58 || tejaḥparidhisaṃvyāptānanahāsyānvitaḥ prabhuḥ | caturbhujo dvibhujo’yaṃ siṃhāsanavirājitaḥ ||59 || tasya pārśve surūpāṃ svāṃ kanyāṃ sītāṃ dadarśa sā | āhvayantīṃ ca mo he’mba iti miṣṭagirā muhuḥ ||6 0 || śrīrāmo bhagavām̐ścāyaṃ prasannaḥ prāha dhanyakām | dhanye tvaṃ vai janakasya gṛhiṇī bhāvinī tataḥ ||6 1 || iyaṃ tu te sutā sītā mahālakṣmīrbhaviṣyati | tāṃ tvaṃ dāsyasi mahyaṃ vai mattaḥ sukhamavāpsyasi || 62|| puruṣottamamāsasyaikasyāhnastu vratasya vai | taveṣṭaṃ tu phalaṃ snigdhaṃ bhaviṣyati sukhātmakam || 63 || ityuktvāntarhito vāsudevo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | atha dṛṣṭaḥ kalāvatyā kṛṣṇaḥ sudarśanānvitaḥ ||64|| mayūrapicchamukuṭaḥ pītavastrauṣṭhaveṇukaḥ | gopālabālakaḥ paścāt sa eva nṛpatīśvaraḥ ||65|| rājādhirājo bhagavān sarvaśobhātisundaraḥ | navajīmūtasatkāntiryuvā bhūṣāvibhūṣitaḥ ||66 || divyasiṃhāsanaśreṣṭhasthito rājādhirājakaḥ | dvibhujo mandahāsyena darśayansuprasannatām ||67|| tasya pārśve sthitāṃ divyāṃ rūpānurūpaśevadhim | putrīṃ rādhāṃ bhāvinīṃ tāṃ sā dadarśa kalāvatī || 68 || kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe nijaṃ hastaṃ dadatī premavihvalām | āhvayantīṃ ca mo ambe he’mbeti sadgirā muhuḥ ||6 9 || śrīkṛṣṇaḥ suprasannaḥ san spṛśan rādhāṃ kalāvatīm | prāheyaṃ tava vaiśyatve putrī rādhā bhaviṣyati ||70|| tāṃ tvaṃ dāsyasi mahyaṃ vai bhāṇḍīravaṭasannidhau | madīyā sā sadā patnī mūrdhanyā syāddhi śāśvatī ||71|| mattaḥ sarve sukhaṃ putrīdvārā tvaṃ samavāpsyasi | puruṣottamamāsasyaikadinasya vratasya vai ||72|| phalaṃ cābhilaṣitaṃ te bhaviṣyati sukhātmakam | ityabhidhāya kṛṣṇastatsthalādantarhito’bhavat ||73|| athācirāttu tisrastāstato dhyānātsamutthitāḥ | prasannāsyāḥ kṛtakṛtyā natvā nārāyaṇaṃ muhuḥ ||74|| vyasarjayan sukusumāṃjalīn datvātha tanniśi | pāraṇāṃ samakurvaṃstā bhojayantyo’pi kanyakā ||75|| brahmanārāyaṇakṛṣṇamūrtidānaṃ pracakrire | athācirādādyayuge pitṛbhistāḥ kramānnanu ||76|| haimajanakagopebhyo menā dhanyā kalāvatī | vivāhitā tu vidhinā tāsāṃ putryo’bhavam̐śca tāḥ ||77|| kramāttu pārvatī sītā rādhā brahmaparātmikāḥ | sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe sādhikāyāmādyāvatārarūpiṇe ||78|| śivāya rāmarūpāya kṛṣṇāya tvarpitāśca tāḥ | jāmātṝm̐stān parabrahmāvatārām̐ścābhipadya vai ||79|| sarvānkāmānavāpustā menā dhanyā kalāvatī | evaṃ lakṣmi vrataṃ naktamadhimāse prapūjanam ||80|| ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kālatraye kṛtvā purāṇapuruṣottamāt | prāptaṃ vrataphalaṃ prāptā jāmātāro hariḥ svayam ||8 1|| putryastāḥ śaṃbhunā rāmeṇa ca kṛṣṇena śāśvate | kailāse cātha vaikuṇṭhe goloke ca ramanti hi ||82|| tanmātāpitaraścāpi nityaṃ muktāstadīyakam | sukhaṃ tvatyantamāptāśca yatheṣṭaṃ kīrtimityapi ||83|| kimvadhikaṃ ca te vakṣye lakṣmi loke paratra ca | mātā svīyāṃ suputrīṃ vai sukhinīṃ kartumicchati ||84|| tadā tayā prakartavyaṃ vrataṃ cādhikamāsikam | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vrataṃ pūjanaṃ ca yathā menādibhiḥ kṛtam ||85|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jāmātaraṃ prāpsyati vai tataḥ | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ tathā cānyat sarve prāpsyaṃtyayatnataḥ ||86|| putrīdānasya satpātraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yadi | tatra prāptaṃ parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam ||87|| kartavyaṃ laukikaṃ vānyalaukikaṃ nāvaśiṣyate | sarvaśeṣī hariryatra ramate sutayā saha ||88|| sutayā tuṣyati devastasya toṣe nu kiṃ punaḥ| durlabhaṃ tvathavāprāpyaṃ bhavet kṛṣṇasya sannidhau ||89|| evaṃ te kathitā lakṣmi kṛpā nārāyaṇasya sā | adhimāse vratināṃ mānasāni pūrayatyajaḥ || 90 || yadīcchedguṇasāmarthya rūpavidyādibhiḥ samaḥ | kṛṣṇena tulyo jāmātā syāditi cettathā bhavet ||91|| yadīcchellokavikhyāto rājasattāpravartaka | jāmātā me bhavecceti tadā vai tādṛśau bhavet||92|| yadīcchedbhagavadbhakto dhanadhānyasamṛddhimān | jāmātā me ciraṃjīvī bhavediti tathā bhavet ||93|| yadīcched brāhmaṇaguṇo yadvā kṣatriyadharmavān | jāmātā me bhavedeva vratakartryāstathā bhavet ||94|| yadīcched gṛhajāmātā sukhado me bhavediti | putrapautrādimān syācca vratakartryāstathā bhavet ||95|| yathā tu yādṛśaṃ jāmātāraṃ vāñchati taṃ tathā | tādṛśaṃ samavāpnoti śvaśrūḥ śrīharyanugrahāt || 96 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottama māsamāhātmye pitṛ mānasa kanyābhiḥ menādhanyākalāvatībhiḥ adhikamāsadundubhiśravaṇena ṣaṣṭhyāṃ trikālavratena kramāt pārvatīsītārādhābhidhaputrīlābhe jāmātṛtvena śaṃkararāmakṛṣṇānāṃ sambandhopalabdhirūpaphalaprāptiprabhṛtinirūpatānāmāṣṭanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.298||
<1.299> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi dundubhestu ninādena kṛtaṃ vratam | satyalokasthitābhyāṃ tu kanyābhyāṃ viśvakarmaṇaḥ || 1 || satyasvargādilokānāṃ rājñāṃ pātālavāsinām | nagarāṇāṃ bhavanānāṃ sabhānāṃ yajñakarmiṇām || 2 || maṇḍapānāṃ vinirmātā nārāyaṇāṃśa eva yaḥ | tasya kanyā siddhināmnī jyeṣṭhā buddhiḥ kanīyasī || 3 || siddhibuddhī surūpe ca suśīle devapūjike| nityaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā prātaḥ snātvā taduttaram || 4 || pitroścaraṇayornatvā brāhmasaṃjñe muhūrtake | gṛhe devagṛhe cāpi dīpaṃ prajvālya vai tataḥ || 5 || dhūpaṃ kṛtvā sugandhaṃ ca kīrtanaṃ kurutaśca te | devaṃ natvā tu puṣpāṇi jalaṃ ca śarkarādanam || 6 || samarpya gṛhakāryāṇi kurutaścobhaye tataḥ | siddhistatra saromadhyājjalaṃ tvāharati drutam || 7 || mārjayitvā gṛhaṃ buddhirvahniṃ prajvālayatyapi | cullikāyāṃ jalapātramuṣṇīkaraṇahetave || 8 || sthāpayitvā ca pitaro prasnāpayati bhāvukā | siddhistāvadgṛhaśayyādikaṃ saṃgṛhya śayyadhau || 9 || rakṣayitvātha paryaṃkān sammārjyonnīya susthale | saṃklṛpya rātripātrāṇāṃ mañjanaṃ prakaroti vai || 10 || tāvad buddhiḥ snātayośca pitrorārdrāmbarāṇi tu | prakṣālya rajjvāṃ vinyasya gatvodyānaṃ gṛhānugam || 11 || devapūjādikāryārthaṃ puṣpāṇyānayati drutam | mātā cātha pitā yāvattūpayāṃti harergṛham || 1 2|| āsane tāvadāstīrya sandhyādyarthe dadātyapaḥ | tulasīpatrakāmbhojakundacampakamālikāḥ ||1 3|| dadāti devapūjārthaṃ pitroḥ paramabhāvataḥ | candanākṣatakuṃkumapañcāmṛtajalāni ca || 14|| pātrāṇi pūjanārhāṇi ghṛtavatīśca śarkarāḥ | drākṣādāḍimabījāni vividhāni phalāni ca || 15|| elālavaṃgatāmbūlanaivedyānyānayatyapi | pūjāsthāṃ mātaraṃ cātha pūjāsthaṃ pitaraṃ tadā || 16|| daśa pradakṣiṇāḥ kṛtvā kṛtvā daśa namaskriyāḥ | mātāpitṛcaraṇayordhautaṃ pragṛhya vai jalam || 17|| pārśve tiṣṭhati sevārthaṃ darśanaṃ prakaroti ca | tāvattatra samāgatya siddhirapi tathaiva tat || 18|| pradakṣiṇānamaskārādikaṃ kṛtvā prasādajam | jalaṃ pītvā punaryāti cullikāsannidhau gṛhe || 1 9|| mahānase tu pākārthaṃ sāmagrī sakalāśca sā | suśodhayitvā sannyasya buddhimāhūya tāmanu ||20 || karoti bhakṣyabhojyāni peyāni vividhānyapi | dugdhapānaṃ tu sā pitroḥ siddhiḥ kārayati drutam ||21 || pūjāpātrāṇi sarvāṇi mṛdā saṃghṛṣya vai tataḥ | śuddhvā prātarvidheyaṃ yat kṛtvā sarvaṃ tato hyubhe ||22|| vidyābhyāsaṃ ca kurute vaiśvadevāntakaṃ tataḥ | kṛtvā tau bhojayitvā ca vidhiṃ mādhyāhnikaṃ punaḥ || 23 || kṛtvā cātithigojantubhāgān datvāśritādanam | tataḥ sve bhojanaṃ prāsādikaṃ cakraturādarāt || 24|| mahānasapraśuddhiṃ ca pātraśuddhiṃ pramārjanam | jalāharaṇamannādiśodhanaṃ tvaparāhṇake || 25|| dehaśrāṃgārikaṃ kṛtvā virāmaṃ prāpnutaḥ kṣaṇam | tatastīrthakathādeva darśanādi vidhāya tu || 26 || sāyaṃ kṛṣṇasya saṃpūjā ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ | kṛtvā pakvānnamiṣṭāni bhojayitvātibhāvataḥ || 27|| pitarau tu tataḥ śayyādikaṃ saṃstīrya te hyubhe | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ pitroḥ kṛtvā sevanamityapi || 28 || dainaṃ tu yat svakaṃ gosevanaṃ kīrtanamaiśvaram | yannyūnaṃ tattu sampūrṇaṃ kṛtvā niḥśeṣamityubhe || 29|| kiṃcidadhyayanaṃ kṛtvā gṛhṇītaḥ svāpamalpakam | brāhmakāle samusthāyābhyastāṃ vidyāṃ vicārya ca || 30 || punaśca naityakaṃ kāryaṃ kurutaḥ kanyake hyubhe | evaṃ tu sevayā hṛṣṭau pitarau tvatibhāvataḥ || 31 || yuyujatuḥ śubhāśīrbhiḥ sukhinyau bhavataṃ hyubhe | īśvare premayuktatvānnārāyaṇahariprabhuḥ || 3 2|| yuvābhyāṃ prāpsyate kāle sevanīyatamaḥ śubhaḥ | ityāśīrvādapātre te nityaṃ hṛdi hariṃ muhuḥ || 33 || vāñchataḥ śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇamadhīśvaram | evaṃ vrate satyaloke tābhyāṃ me dundubhiḥ śrutaḥ || 34|| adhimāsasya saptamyāṃ prātarvai vratabodhakaḥ | sa tu bodhayate lokān adhimāsavratāni vai || 35|| kariṣyanti yathāśakti ye brahmāṇḍagatā janāḥ | narā nāryo’thavā tvanye teṣāmabhīṣṭadāyakaḥ || 3 6|| alabhyalābhadātāsmi hyahaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | māsikaṃ pākṣikaṃ sāptāhikaṃ dainikameva vā || 3 7|| naiśaṃ paurvāhṇikaṃ yadvā pārāhṇikaṃ ca madhyagam | upavāsān phalāhārān payaḥpānaṃ jalāśanam || 38 || kandāśanaṃ nivārādyaśanaṃ sāyaṃ niśāśanam | divāśanaṃ vaikabhuktaṃ tilabhuktamayācitam || 39 || kṛtvā yathābalaṃ puṣpaiḥ sampūjya puruṣottamam | jalena vā phalairvāpi mūlena kuṃkumena vā ||40 || akṣataiścandanenāpi sampūjya puruṣottamam | vastreṇa ca sudugdhena gūḍena miṣṭayāthavā || 41 || śarkarābhirjalapānaistāmbūlenacchadādinā | patreṇa vātibhāvena premṇā māṃ puruṣottamam ||42 || santuṣyādhikamāse te matto’rjayantu durlabham | idānīṃ kṛpayā dāsye kṛte svalpe’pi sādhane ||43 || anyamāseṣu yat kaṣṭasādhyaṃ bhavati cātra tat | svalpasyāpi dadāmyeva koṭiguṇitamadya vai ||44|| paścānnaiva pradāsye’haṃ tasmād gṛhṇantu bho janāḥ | phalaṃ pūgīphalasyāpi pārameṣṭhyapadādhikam ||45|| jalapātravratenāpi kṣīrasāgaraśāyitām | ekabhuktavratenāpi golokasyādhikāritām ||46|| naktamātravratenāpi nārāyaṇasamānatām | patrapuṣpapradāne’pi mahendrapadaśālitām ||47|| dīpamātrapradāne’pi sūryacandrādidehitām | naro vā yadi vā nārī kumāro vā kumārikā ||48|| icchati cenmamalakṣmīmapi māṃ puruṣottamam | patnīṃ patiṃ ca vā putraṃ dāsye lakṣmīṃ ca māmapi ||49|| pragṛhṇantu varānasmat prakurvantu ca sañcayam | mahākṛpāmahāvṛṣṭilabhyaṃ puṇyabalodayam ||50|| satyaṃ satyaṃ nānṛtaṃ vai ghoṣayatyeva dundubhiḥ | adhimāsavrataṃ kṛtvā gṛhṇantu svepsitaṃ prajāḥ ||51 || ityāśrutya hyubhe kanye saptamyāṃ prātareva ha | dundubhiṃ me praṇamyaiva vardhayitvāñjalidravaiḥ ||52|| pūjayitvā supuṣpaiśca harṣayukte babhūvatuḥ | punastāvaddundubheśca kṛpāvākyaṃ śrutaṃ śubham ||53|| kumārike yadīcchetāṃ patiṃ māṃ puruṣottamam | ekabhuktavratenāpi bhaviṣyāmi patistayoḥ ||54|| pūjāṃ mādhyāhnikīṃ kṛtvā yathālabdhopacārakaiḥ | miṣṭānnaṃ bhojayitvā māṃ prāpsyataḥ puruṣottamam ||55|| ityevaṃ saṃvadantaṃ taṃ matvā svayoḥ kṛte śubham | siddhibuddhī viditvā svaṃ bhāgyodayamupāgatam ||56|| pūjayitvā svapitarau bhojayitvā vidhānataḥ | gṛhakāryaṃ vinirvartya puṣpacandanavāribhiḥ ||57|| akṣataiścāpi miṣṭānnairdhūpadīpasucarvaṇaiḥ | yānyāsan svagṛhe taistairarcayitvā tu kānakam ||58|| nārāyaṇaṃ hariṃ devaṃ patiprāptīcchayā śubhe | nīrājayāmāsatuśca hyarthe kāmaphalaṃ śubham ||59|| datvā saṃprārthayāmāsatuśca nau tvaṃ patirbhava | ityuktvākṣatasaṃpūrṇāñjalī dadaturādarāt ||60 || tāvacchrībhagavān sākṣāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam | yuvā kaṭākṣabāṇena nirīkṣan prāvirāsa vai ||61 || dvayoḥ prakoṣṭhe saṃgṛhya svakareṇa hariḥ svayam | mastakayoḥ karau kṛtvā vakṣasyākṛṣya te hyubhe ||62|| priye iti ca saṃbhāṣya nibhālya ca muhurmuhuḥ | milito’smi ca jāto’smi milite vidhivat priye ||63|| ityuktvāntardadhe kṛṣṇaste hyubhe taṃ hariṃ sadā | jāgratyapi tathā svapne paśyato vai manoharam ||64|| pārvatyaṃkasthitaṃ kṛṣṇamekaśuṇḍhaṃ kvacitpunaḥ | aśuṇḍhaṃ muralīyuktaṃ golokasthaṃ vyapaśyatām ||65|| varayogyaṃ punastaṃ ca gaṇeśaṃ śaṃkarātmajam | saśuṇḍhaṃ ca surūpaṃ ca dadṛśatuḥ kṣaṇāntare ||66|| śvetavarṇaṃ sunetraṃ ca subhālaṃ yauvanānvitam | kṛṣṇātmakaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā mumūhatuḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||67|| kvacitsvapne ca te kanye kurvantyau modakān bahūn | paśyataḥ sma ca tatraitya gaṇeśaḥ phalakāsane ||68|| niṣadyārthayate laḍḍūn anye’pi dadatustadā | pārśvadvaye hyubhe sthitvā dadaturlaḍaḍūkān muhuḥ ||69|| gaṇeśaḥ svalpa śuṇḍena pārśvadvaye kṛtena ca | vāraṃvāraṃ pradattān sulaḍḍūnprāpya nije mukhe ||70|| nyasyatyatīva miṣṭām̐śca premṇā bhakṣayati drutam | praśaṃsati karau datvā kanyayoḥ pṛṣṭhayostadā ||71|| ekaikaṃ laḍaḍukaṃ tābhyāṃ datvā saṃbhojayatyubhe | hasan hāsyaṃ prakurvan rāmayan saṃramayanmudā ||72|| darśayitvaivamātmānaṃ tirobhāvaṃ pragacchati | kanye’pi jāgrate bhūtvā muhuḥ saṃsmaratuśca tam ||73|| evaṃ hṛdye gaṇapatau jāte kāle’pyupasthite | viśvaprakarmaṇā jñātvā prāgvṛttānta tadīyakam ||74|| gaṇeśaṃ tu samāhūya vidhinā lagnaśālinā | gaṇeśāyārpite kanye siddhibuddhī samāhvaye ||75|| vivāhottarakāle’traścaryaṃ jātaṃ mahacchṛṇu | gaṇeśena kṛte rūpe dve tadānīṃ gṛhāntare ||76|| ekaṃ śrīkṛṣṇarūpaṃ ca gaṇeśātma dvitīyakam | kanyayoścāpi rūpe dve dve kṛte sumanohare ||77|| rādhātulye tu rūpe dve śrīkṛṣṇo garuḍopari | nītvā yayau svakaṃ dhāma golokaṃ śāśvataṃ tadā ||78|| tatra vai ramate siddhyā buddhyā ca divyarūpayā | evaṃ tābhyāṃ phalaṃ mukyātmakaṃ dattaṃ vratasya vai ||79|| athānyena svarūpeṇa gaṇeśākhyena tena te | ubhe kṛtvā svake tvaṃke premṇā nibhālite muhuḥ ||80|| cumbite gaṇḍayoścāpi toṣite’ntargṛhe gate | navayauvanabhāvasya phalaṃ vai prāpite rateḥ ||81|| iti lakṣmi phalaṃ tābhyāṃ labdhaṃ kṛṣṇadhavātmakama | divyaṃ loke’pi vikhyātiṃ prāptaṃ rūpaṃ dvayaṃ dvayam ||82|| pūjyabhāvaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca prāpte’dhimāsa satkṛtāt | ekabhuktavratād yadvā prāptavastubhirarcanāt ||82|| evaṃ yā kanyakā kuryātpuruṣottamapūjanam | saptamyāṃ tvekabhuktaṃ ca vāñcchayā kṛṣṇasatpateḥ ||84|| sāvaśyaṃ yatra kutrāpi prādurbhūtaṃ svakaṃ patim | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ divyaṃ mānavaṃ sā tvavāpsyati ||85|| bhuktiṃ kṛtvā bahūna lokān samprānubhūya śāśvatān | tataḥ śrīkṛṣṇagolokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ vāpsyati dhruvam ||86|| tasmād vrataṃ prakartavyamadhimāsaprasaṃbhavam | anāyāsena muktiḥ syāt punarjanma na śiṣyate ||87|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye viśvakarmaṇaḥ siddhibuddhiputrībhyāṃ mātāpitṛsevayāśīrvādottaramadhikamāsavrata bodhakadundubhiśravaṇottaraṃ kṛtena saptamyāṃ ekabhuktavratena tayoḥ śrīkṛṣṇadarśanarūpadvayaprāptirgolokavāso gaṇapatyātmakakṛṣṇena saha vivāhaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonaśatādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.299||
<1.300> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi yugāraṃbhe sṛṣṭyādau yadabhūtpurā | ṣaṭkaṃ jātamapatyānāṃ brahmaṇo mānasānniśi || 1 || tapasā kleśitasyāsya lalāṭādabhavanmahān | rudraḥ so’pyājñayājasya rudrairjagadapūrayat || 2 || tāṃstu bhayaṃkarānkrūrān jagadviplavakārakān | dṛṣṭvā toṣaṃ na vai lebhe brahmājñāmakarotpunaḥ || 3 || saṃhārārthaṃ tu rudrāṇāṃ sṛṣṭestadā sutena vai | rudreṇa saṃhṛtāḥ sarve jagacchūnyamabhūttataḥ || 4 || satyalokaṃ gṛhaṃ svasya śūnyaṃ vilokya viśvasṛṅ | audāsīnyaṃ jagāmāti bālakākalikāṃ vinā || 5 || yatra gṛhe na vai bālo bālānāṃ rodanaṃ na vā | krīḍanaṃ kalaho no na śrūyate bālabhāṣitam || 6 || tadgṛhaṃ kālarātrervai pherurājagṛhopamam | vinā putraṃ vinā putrīṃ svargaṃ tu narakāyate || 7 || hīśvarāṇāṃ bhavanāni raṇāyante pragartavat | jīrṇavṛkṣāyate saudhaḥ kevalavṛddhamaṇḍalaḥ || 8 || anapatyaṃ kuṭumbaṃ ca śuṣkaparvataśṛṃgavat | anapatyaḥ pitā dagdhajvālāmukhisthalīsamaḥ || 9 || abālakākalīśabdaṃ mahāpralayavadgraham | rasā apyarasāḥ saudhe jāyante bālakaṃ vinā || 10 || bhojyānyapi kavoṣṇāni jāyante’tṛptidāni ca | utsavā yadvinā naiva bhavantyeva navā navāḥ || 11 || yadunnatikṛtotsāhā api naśyanti yadvinā | śuṣkāyante mukhacandrā grīṣme kardamapiṇḍavat || 1 2|| rūkṣāyante mānasāni tāpe barburakāṣṭhavat | tiktāyante ca peyāni jyeṣṭhe nimbarasādivat || 13 || sukhadāni tvapatyāni jāyante puṇyaśālinām | duḥkhadāni daridrāṇi jāyante duṣprakarmiṇām || 14|| ṛṇānubandha evātra kāraṇaṃ prāgvisargajaḥ | nūtanaṃ cāpi kartavyaṃ svapatyadāyakaṃ tapaḥ || 1 5|| iti saṃkalpya ca brahmā saṃyamyendriyamaṇḍalam | tapaścacāra ghaṭikāmātraṃ samādhisaṃsthitaḥ || 1 6|| apatyārthī svapatyārthī sasmāra tāni vai hṛdi | tāvat tanmānasā jātā dundubhighaṇṭakambavaḥ || 17|| trayaḥ putrāḥ sutāstisro ghaṇṭā nīrājanā tathā | jhallarī ceti mānasyaḥ paścājjātaṃ trikaṃ punaḥ || 18 || kāṃsyaṃ ca pañcapātraṃ ca dhūpadhraṃ ceti mānasam | tisraḥ putryastrayaḥ putrāstrayaṃ ṣaṇḍhaṃ prajāpateḥ || 19|| saṃkalpānnavasaṃkhyāni tvapatyāni prajajñire | niṣeke vātha saṃkalpe bhāvanā yādṛśī bhavet || 20 || tādṛśaṃ jāyate’patyaṃ tathā jātāni padmaje | tatra ṣaṭ khalu vācālānyākrośakārakāṇi hi || 21 || kamburghaṇṭo dundubhiśca ghaṇṭā ca jhallarī tathā | kāṃsyaṃ ca jātamātrāṇi cakruḥ kolāhalaṃ gṛhe || 22 || audāsīnyaṃ gataṃ tena śūnyatāpi gatā vidheḥ | gṛhaṃ krīḍadapatyaiśca sotsavaṃ samajāyata ||2 3 || brahmā tena prasanno’bhūt saṃsakto lālane’vane | gṛhaṃ sāpatyakaṃ maṃgalāyatanaṃ tvamanyata || 24|| nīrājanā pañcapātraṃ dhūpadhraṃ maunavṛttitaḥ | ṣaḍbhistāni ramante vai nartanādyaistadā kṣaṇe ||25|| nityaṃ prātastathā sāyaṃ militvā nava tāni vai | kurvanti kīrtanaṃ svasva kartavyārthaiḥ prapūjanam || 26|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaiva babhūvurbhaktimanti vai | brahmā jaharṣa cātīva svapatyalābhataḥ khalu ||27|| evaṃ prayāte samaye’dhimāsasyāṣṭamī prage | mahādundubhiretaistu śruto viṣṇupadītaṭe || 28 || prātaḥ snānaṃ prakurvadbhiḥ śrutaṃ tatra śubhāvaham | śṛṇvantu cetanāḥ sarve sthāvarāśca jaḍā api ||29|| mūrtimanto hyamūrtāśca bālā vā bālikāstathā | bālakānyapi śṛṇvantu svalpāyāsa phalottamam || 30 || puruṣottamavādyo’haṃ yāthātathyena vacmyaham | puruṣottamamāso’yaṃ puruṣottama eva saḥ || 31 || sarvamāsātigaḥ prāpayati śrīpuruṣottamam | manasā karmaṇā vācā tvādṛtaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 35|| yena sa tvādṛtaḥ syācchrīpuruṣottamaśārṅgiṇā | adya maunaṃ vidhātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ caikakālikam || 33 || prātaḥ saṃpūjanaṃ kāryaṃ madhyāhne ca tathā niśi | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyādya rūpaṃ dhyātavyamaiśvaram || 34|| prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ natvā pūjāsāmagrīrānayet | suvarṇapratimāṃ viṣṇoḥ sthāpayenmaṇḍale ghaṭe || 35|| pañcāmṛtena dugdhena dadhnā kṣaudreṇa sarpiṣā | śarkarayā śuddhavārbhiḥ snāpayet puruṣottamam || 36 || vastraiḥ sammārjya dhautrādi dhārayet puruṣottamam | ābhūṣaṇāni kaṭakakirīṭādīni dhārayet || 37||| candanāttarakastūrī kuṃkumādibhirarcayet | bhojayed dugdhapākādi tāmbūlādi samarpayet || 38 || dhūpadīpanamaskārārārtrikādyairvivardhayet | pradakṣiṇā daṇḍavadbhiḥ prārthayenmanasepsitam || 39 || jalaṃ peyaṃ tathārghyaṃ ca phalaṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ dadet | prārthayecca kṛpānātha puruṣottama keśava ||40 || vrataṃ tava kṛte cādya puruṣottamamāsikam | aṣṭamyāṃ pālitaṃ cāharniśaṃ kṛtvā hyupoṣaṇam ||41 || ekabhaktaṃ ca vā kṛtvā yathāśakti kṛtaṃ prabho | kriyate vā kariṣye vā nirvighnaṃ tat samāpyatām |||42|| yatheṣṭaṃ ca phalaṃ dehi kṛpāsindho janārdana | iti saṃprārthya deveśaṃ labhantāṃ manasepsitam ||4 3 || mahādundubhiṃ śrutvaivaṃ vedhobālāni tatkṣaṇam | snātvāścaryabharāṇyevāyayustasyāntikaṃ mudā ||44|| papraccha dundubhiḥ svalpo mahādundubhimutsukaḥ | ko’si kasmāt samāyātaḥ kiṃ pravakṣi dadāsi kim ||45|| kva te vāsaśca kiṃ kāryaṃ karoṣi tvatprabhuśca kaḥ | iti dundubhinā pṛṣṭo mahādundubhirāha tam || 46 || ahaṃ vaikuṇṭhaputro’smi vaikuṇṭhādāgato’smi ca | vaikuṇṭhe me sadā vāso nārāyaṇasya mandire ||47|| kāryaṃ nārāyaṇanīrājanakāle pravādanam | mama svāmī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||48 || yasyājñayā janako me vaikuṇṭhadhāmarūpadhṛk | bhūtvā nityaṃ vartate tu sevāyāmapi sevakaḥ || 49 || pitrājñayā tathā nārāyaṇājñayāpyahaṃ sadā | vicarāmi trilokyāṃ vai preṣyakāryakaronvaham ||5 0 || yā tvājñā jāyate tasya nārāyaṇasya tāmaham | pravadāmi ghoṣayāmi punargacchāmi tatra ca ||5 1 || svarūpe dve mama sto vai caturbāhustu pārṣadaḥ | sevāyāṃ sarvadā varte dvitīyo’smi sudundubhiḥ ||52 || ghoṣayāmi harerājñāṃ daṇḍena tāḍito mudā | anekāni svarūpāṇi dhartuṃ śakto’smyanugrahāt ||53 || sevayā matkṛpayā ca santuṣṭo bhagavān svayam | dadāti bhojanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvaṃ prāsādikantu me ||54|| udyānāni bhavanāni divyānyupaskarāṇi ca | yathā nārāyaṇasyeva me’pi santi ca tānyapi ||55 || sarve nārāyaṇatulyaṃ nyūnaṃ kiñcinna me’sti tat | ānakaḥ paṭaho bherī ḍhakkā rūpāṇi santi me ||56|| yathāpekṣaṃ nivasāmi sevāyāṃ mandireṣu vai | dundubhistaṃ samākarṇya tatsukhākṛṣṭamānasaḥ ||57|| papraccha dundubhiśreṣṭhaṃ kathaṃ vai prāpyate hareḥ | vaikuṇṭhaṃ vā tadīyaṃ ca smṛddhaṃ dhāma tu mādṛśaiḥ |||98 || mahādundubhirāhainaṃ jijñāsuṃ svalpadundubhim | adhimāse’pyekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālikam ||59 || yasmin kasmin dine kṛṣṇapūjanaṃ tasya cāptidam | upavāsāyācitādivratenaikādanena vā || 60|| naktena vā payasā vā kṛtavratena cāpyate | kṛtenālpena bahu tat phalaṃ vai labhyate janaiḥ || 61 || jalamātrapradānena haraye labhyate’pi tat | yasyāgre kiṃcana nāsti bhaktyā tenāpi labhyate ||6 2|| devāgre nartanaṃ kāryaṃ gāyanaṃ susvarānvitam | tuṣṭastenāpi bhagavān vaikuṇṭhaṃ pradadāti vai || 63 || vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāpi golokaṃ brahmadhāmākṣarāhvayam | taduttarottaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yadicchati dadāti saḥ ||64|| etacchrutvāha vai svalpadundubhirdundubhīśvaram | kiṃ vaikuṇṭhātparaṃ cāsti golokaṃ vai sthalāntaram ||65 || golokāt kiṃ paraṃ vrahmadhāmāstyanyat sthalaṃ kimu | kastatra vasati svāmī vayaṃ taṃ prāpnumo na vā ||66|| mahādundubhirāha śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | svāmī vaikuṇṭhalokasya yadīṣyetāpyate sa vai ||67|| svāmī golokadhāmnaḥ śrīrādhākṛṣṇo mahān prabhuḥ | yadīṣyetāpyate so’dhimāse kṛtavratena vai ||68|| svāmī ca brahmalokasyākṣareśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | yasmātparo na vai kaścinna ca yena samo’styapi ||69|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so’sti pareśvaraḥ | yasyājñāṃ mastake dhṛtvā ghoṣayāmi vratārcanam ||70 || adhimāsasya sa svāmī dadāti vratine hi tat | vratī yadīhate divyaṃ sarvaṃ dadātyanugrahāt ||71 || vaḥ samicchā tu yasyāsti kāryaṃ tanmūrtipūjanam | vaikuṇṭhāt koṭiguṇakaṃ sukhaṃ golokadhāmani ||72|| golokādapyasaṃkhyaṃ ca pare dhāmnyakṣare sukham | ānandānāṃ tathānantyamaiśvaryāṇāmasaṃkhyatā ||73 || nānyad vai tādṛśaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhavatītyavagamyatām | brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ lokāstannirayopamāḥ ||74|| gantavyaṃ yadi cet tatrārcayantu puruṣottamam | adyāṣṭamyāṃ yathāśakti yathābhāvaṃ sa pūjyatām ||75|| nṛtyaṃ vidhīyatāṃ cāpi gāyanaṃ ca vidhīyatām | iṣṭaṃ phalaṃ hariḥ sarvaṃ bhāvānugaṃ pradāsyati ||76|| nivāsārthaṃ yadā sarvadhāmasu golakeṣu ca |
