pratyacyutagrahaṃ cāpīṣyate so’pi dadāti tat ||77|| śrutvā tvaho hyaho kṛtvā mahāścaryayutāni vai | vedho’patyāni tatraiva nṛtyaṃ cakruśca gāyanam ||78|| pupūjurdundubhiśreṣṭhamarthayāmāsurādarāt | vayaṃ tatrāgamiṣyāmo yatra śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||79|| tvayā tasmai kathitavyamasmākaṃ vratapūjanam | vrataṃ kurmo vayaṃ tvadyāṣṭamyāmupoṣaṇānvitam ||80 || pūjanaṃ tvakṣareśasya golokeśasya cāpi vai | vaikuṇṭheśasya vai kurmo yena sarvatra no gatiḥ ||8 1|| dundubhīśaḥ satkṛtastairnītvā vedho gṛhāntare | yathā nārāyaṇaḥ pūjyaḥ sarvaistaiḥ pūjitastathā ||82|| śṛṃgāritaḥ sevitaśca vibhūṣābhiralaṃkṛtaḥ | bhojito marditaścaiva dakṣiṇābhiralaṃkṛtaḥ ||83|| pādasaṃvāhito dehe mardito viśramīkṛtaḥ | svāpitaśca kṣaṇaṃ paścād bodhitaḥ saṃvisarjitaḥ ||84|| sevayātiprasannaḥ sa parāvṛtya punaḥ punaḥ | dundubhiprabhṛtīn prāha kurvantu vratamādarāt ||85|| brahmāṇḍe ghoṣaṇāṃ kṛtvā sāyamāgatya cātra vai | militvā bhavataḥ paścād yāsye vaikuṇṭhameva ha ||86|| ityuktvā dundubhiśreṣṭho lokān bodhayituṃ yayau | dundubhiprabhṛtayaśca prātarmadhyāhnake niśi ||87|| snānaṃ kṛtvā triṣavaṇaṃ trikālaṃ pūjanaṃ tathā | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasyāpi rādhākṛṣṇasya vastubhiḥ ||88|| akṣarādhipateścāpi divyaiḥ ṣoḍaśakottamaiḥ | dugdhapākādibhirdevān bhojayitvā tato mudā ||89|| nirṇayaṃ sma prakurvanti bhagavanmūrtisannidhau | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabrahmeśvarāḥ śṛṇvantu nirṇayam ||90 || bhagavatsadane’smābhiḥ sthātavyaṃ sarvadā dhruvam | pūjāyāṃ ca prasevāyāṃ sarvasṛṣṭau hareḥ puraḥ ||91 || yathāsvābhilaṣitaṃ sa rakṣatvasmān svasannidhau | sevāmuktiḥ sadāsmābhirgrahītavyā nahītarā ||92|| dāsyaṃ vai sarvataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ tat kiṃ na rocayāmahe | niyojanaṃ harirvinimayaṃ svāmī karotu naḥ ||9 3 || iti te prārthanāṃ kṛtvā savādyanṛtyagāyanam | kurvanti sma navaivaivaṃ hāvabhāvasvarānvitam ||94|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabrahmādhipāstuṣṭā dayālavaḥ | puruṣottamamāso’pi tatra paśyati bhāvanām ||95|| tāvattatra samāyāto dundubhīśo harerniśi | dṛṣṭavantaḥ śrutavanto bhaktiṃ sarvātiśāyinīm ||96|| navānāṃ vedhaso’patyānāṃ parapremayuñjatām | prasannāścātituṣṭāśca sarve te parameśvarāḥ ||97|| sākṣād divyasurūpāste prādurbabhūvurantike | sarve divyakirīṭāste divyamālādyalaṃkṛtāḥ ||98|| koṭividyullatātulyalakṣmīrādhāprabhāyutāḥ | divyāmbaradharāḥ chatricāmaribhiḥ susevitāḥ ||99|| koṭikandarpalāvaṇyasaundaryamṛdutānvitāḥ | divyaiśvaryamahāvīryānandasaṃbhṛtamūrtayaḥ || 10 0|| prasannavadanāḥ procuḥ kimapatyāni ceṣyate | yuṣmadbhaktyā dundubhīśapūjanena ca sevayā || 101 || atituṣṭāḥ sma putrā vo yadiṣṭaṃ brūta tacca naḥ | dṛṣṭvā śrutvā tato’patyānyatihṛṣṭāni vedhasaḥ || 102|| prāhuryuṣmadgṛhāṇyasmānnayata śrīpareśvarāḥ | niyojayata sevāyāṃ pādayorvaḥ susannidhau || 1 03|| pratigṛhaṃ pratilokaṃ yuṣmākaṃ bhavanaṃ ca yat | tatra tatra sadā sevāṃ kariṣyāmo navaiva ha || 104|| vayaṃ samaprajanmānaḥ svasāro bhrātarastathā | parasparaṃ tato’smākaṃ viyogo mā bhavet kvacit || 1 05|| yatra yuṣmatsu sevāyāṃ rakṣantvasmān divāniśam | tatrāsmān saṃhatāneva rakṣantu parameśvarāḥ || 1 06|| yuṣmatsevāṃ parāṃ muktiṃ labdhvā syāmaḥ sukhālayāḥ | vijñāpitaṃ yadasmābhistadāvahata yanmatam || 1 07|| vayaṃ tu kiṃkarā dāsā dāsye tuṣṭā na cārthane | svāmī tuṣṭo yathā syāttatkartavyaṃ kiṃkarasya vai || 1 08|| iti teṣāṃ bhāvagarbhaṃ śrutvā te parameśvarāḥ | papracchurdundubhīśaṃ kimebhyo deyaṃ vadājñayā || 1 09|| mahādundubhirāhātra dāyādāḥ sulabhā nanu | kiṃkarā dāsavargāśca loke sarvatra durlabhāḥ || 11 0|| dāsavargāya sarvasvaṃ svāmino bhavati dhruvam | etādṛśebhyo dāsebhyaḥ kiṃ kiṃ deyaṃ na vidyate || 111 || deyaścākṣaraloko vai deyo goloka ityapi | deyo vaikuṇṭha evāpi dhāmānyanyāni yānyapi || 1 12|| mandirāṇi tathānyāni brahmāṇḍeṣu bhavanti ca | yatra yatra tu vo mūrtiravatārādimūrtayaḥ || 1 13|| tatra tatra tu sarvatra vāsa ebhyaḥ pradīyatām | mayāpi saha vastavyaṃ hyete bhaktā hi mādṛśāḥ || 1 14|| eṣāṃ rūpāṇyasaṃkhyāni bhavantu bhavatāṃ yathā | bhavadbhiḥ saha tiṣṭhantu jayagāyananartanaiḥ || 1 15|| ārārtrike ca pūjāyāṃ bhrāmaṇairutsaveṣu ca | ghoṣaṇairarghyadānena sugandhādyarpaṇena ca || 1 16|| sāyaṃ prātastu pūjāyāṃ pratyeke mandire tu vaḥ | nīrājanā nartanaṃ bhrāmaṇaṃ karotu sāgnikā || 117 || dundubhiḥ paṭahātmāyaṃ jayadhvānaṃ karotu vai | ghaṇṭī hyanujayaṃ tasya karotu vaśca mandire || 1 18|| kāṃsyaṃ karotu mokṣasya ghoṣaṇāṃ sumanoharām | nīrājanādivelāyāṃ bhajantāṃ dehino harim || 1 19|| abhajanto nindakāśca nāstikāśca virodhinaḥ | bhaviṣyanti yamairdaṇḍyāḥ karotvityapi ghoṣaṇām || 120|| ghaṇṭā karotu gītiṃ ca nṛtyaṃ vai susvarā kare | jhallarī gāyanaṃ lokāhvānaṃ karotu mandire || 121 || kambustīrthajalenaiva karotu bhrāmaṇaṃ puraḥ | pañcapātraṃ pādajalaṃ rakṣatvarghyaṃ dadātvapi || 122|| dhūpadhraṃ tu sugandhaṃ vai dhūpaṃ karotu mandire | dundubhīśastvahaṃ sarvān dūrasthānāhvayāmi ha || 123 || āgacchantu mahābhāgā darśanārthaṃ hareriha | mumukṣavo narā nāryo duṣṭāstu yāntu dūrataḥ ||| 124 || evaṃ sarve vayaṃ yuktāḥ kariṣyāmaḥ prasevanam | vratasyāsya phalaṃ tvebhyo dadata śrīpareśvarāḥ || 125 || kiṃ ca madvat kilaiteṣāṃ brahmākṣare dvihastatā | goloke dvibhujatvaṃ vaikuṇṭhe karacatuṣṭayam || 1 26|| tattatsvāmisvarūpaiśca sāmyaṃ bhavatu divyatā | asaṃkhyarūpadhāritvaṃ syādeṣā pratimandiram || 127 || yuṣmādṛśaṃ ca pāvitryaṃ satkāryatā bhavādṛśī | pūjyatā rakṣyatā cāpi sarvadāstu bhavādṛśī || 128 || eṣāṃ nindāprakartāro bhavantu nirayaṃ gatāḥ | eṣāṃ nāśaṃ tathā cauryaṃ bhartsanaṃ bhañjanādikam || 129 || kariṣyanti janā ye te bhavantu nirayaṃ gatāḥ | eṣāṃ tvaṃgapraghāteṣu sandhānādiprakāriṇām || 130 || eṣāṃ pratimākartṛṇāṃ pratimādānināṃ tathā | pratimāpuṣṭikartṝṇāṃ jīrṇoddhārādikāriṇām || 131 || puruṣottamalokasya prāptirbhavatu sevinām | etadvādyaninādādīn kurvāṇānāṃ tu dehinām || 132|| bhagavaddhāmasamprāptirbhavatviti vṛṇe hyaham | mahādundubhinā dundubhyādikṛte tathārthitam || 133 | bhagavadbhiśca tatraiva tathāstviti samarpitam | navāpatyāni cākṛṣya saṃśliṣya parameśvarāḥ || 1 34|| datvā divyasvarūpāṇi caturdvihastakāni vai | niṣādya vāhane naije ninyurdhāma svakaṃ svakam || 135 || nīrājanā tathā ghaṇṭā jhallarī divyarūpiṇī | tatra lakṣmīsamā jātā harisevāparāyaṇā || 136 || anyatra tu yathāpekṣākṛtayastā virejire | kamburghaṇṭo dundubhiśca kāṃsyaṃ ca pañcapātrakam || 137 || dhūpadhra ceti ṣaṭ saumyā divyarūpadharāḥ prabhoḥ | muktarūpāśca sevāyāṃ samavartanta dhāmasu || 138 || anyatra tu yathāpekṣākṛtayastā virejire | evaṃ lakṣmi pradivyā vai jātā vidhātṛbālakāḥ || 139 || puruṣottamamāsasyāṣṭamīvratena vai khalu | evaṃ ye vratakartāraste’pi yāsyanti dhāma tat || 140 || evaṃ vai malamāse’tra kṛtaṃ svalpaṃ phaled bahu | alpādānantyalābho yaḥ kṛpā sā pārameśvarī || 141 || yāvajjīviṣyati brahmā yāvat sthāsyati medinī | tāvat dundubhighaṇṭādyāḥ sthāsyantyacyutamandire || 142 || muktau tu sarvadā divyāḥ sthāsyanti keśavālaye | tasmād vrataṃ prakartavyaṃ naitādṛk syāt pravarṣaṇam || 143|| brahmā vicāramakarot putrā me muktatāṃ gatāḥ | athānyānutpādayeyaṃ gṛhaṃ śūnya na me bhavet || 144|| yogeśvarāḥ sanakādyāḥ ṛṣayaścāpi mānasāḥ | utpāditā brahmaṇā hi tato vai brahmavādinaḥ || 145|| evaṃ sṛṣṭiprakartāraścānye’pi prakaṭīkṛtāḥ | śānto’bhavatprajā vīkṣya pravāho’pyabhavattathā || 146 || etadākhyānakaṃ ye vai śroṣyanti mānavādayaḥ | paṭhiṣyanti ca te’ṣṭamyāḥ phalaṃ prāpsyanti vai dhruvam || 147|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīya saṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye brahmaṇo mānasānāṃ dundubhighaṇṭakambunāmnāṃ putrāṇāṃ ghaṇṭānīrājanājhallaryākhyānāṃ putrīṇāṃ kāṃsyapaṃcapātradhūpadhrākhyānāmapatyānāṃ ca mahādundubhighoṣaṇāśravaṇottaramaṣṭamyāṃ adhikamāse vratakaraṇenākṣareśagolokeśa vaikuṇṭheśadarśanaṃ tattaddhāmasu sṛṣṭiṣu ca pratimandiramanekarūpaiḥ sthāpanaṃ muktirāśīrvādāścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.300 ||
<1.301> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi puruṣottamayoginī | puruṣottamamāsasya kathā divyāghanāśinī || 1 || parabrahmasakāśāttu vāsudevo vyajāyata | vāsudevāt samabhavad bhūmākhyaḥ puruṣo’graṇīḥ || 2 || bhūmno’bhavad virāḍasya mukhādagnirajāyata | agnerapatyaṃ lokeṣu hiraṇyaṃ viśrutaṃ triṣu || 3 || sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe na vai kaścidagneḥ satkāramācarat | atyuṣṇatvād dāhakatvāt kṛṣṇavartmakṛtestathā || 4 || āśrayāpayiturbhasmīkaraṇaprakṛtestathā | agnimetādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmādyā api bāndhavāḥ || 5 || bhayaṃ prāptā na satkāraṃ sahavāsaṃ carantyapi | bhojane tūtsave pāne dūraṃ kurvanti cānalam || 6 || trailokye nāpa sa kvāpi viśrāntiṃ bhojanādikam | sarvadigbhyaḥ sarvadehibhyastiraskāramāpya saḥ || 7 || kebhyaścittu sthalebhyaḥ sa prāptavām̐stāḍanādikam | ato jvālādikaṃ tūṣṇaguṇaṃ jihvā nigūhya ca || 8 || anyairalakṣito vahnirlokālokācalaṃ yayau | kṣudhitaḥ śikharaṃ lokālokācalasya jagdhavān || 9 || udare pacyamānaṃ tad putrarūpaṃ vyajāyata | hiraṇyaṃ tattu saṃjātaṃ kāṃcanī bhūmikā tu sā || 10 || lokālokācalapārśve prakāśitā vyajāyata | evaṃ sa parvate pradakṣiṇāṃ kurvan prayāti vai || 1 1|| bhavati kṣudhito yatra śṛṃgaṃ tatrātti pārvatam | pacamānaṃ tu tatputrarūpeṇa jāyate tataḥ || 12|| evaṃ putrāḥ suvarṇāni samajāyanta sarvataḥ | sarvatra kāñcanī bhūmirlokālokācalaṃ tvanu || 13|| sañjātā vartulākārā paścāt śṛṃgaṃ mahattamam | brahmāṇḍasadṛśaṃ bhakṣayitvā pṛthvyāṃ samantare || 14|| madhyadeśe yayau divyānalastatrāśramat kṣaṇam | pacyamānaṃ mahacchraṃgaṃ putrarūpaṃ vyajāyata || 15|| suvarṇe tanmahāmerau vyāptaṃ cābhūt samantataḥ | merustasmāt suvarṇasya prakhyātimagamattataḥ || 16|| jaḍaṃ sugandhahīnaṃ ca khanigrāvātmakaṃ guru | yatra yatra patitaṃ tat tatra tatraiva saṃsthitam || 17|| vahneriva suvarṇasyāpi na mānaṃ kṛtaṃ janaiḥ | kalpavṛkṣajavastvādyairnirvahanti hi dehinaḥ || 18|| kiṃ suvarṇaṃ ca kau vahnirityevaṃ nābhavaddhi dhīḥ | kiṃ kāyaṃ vai suvarṇasya kiṃ kāryaṃ cānalasya vai || 19|| apyevaṃ nābhavatprajñā kalpavṛkṣabalāttadā | suvarṇaṃ cānalaścobhau mūlyahīnau śuśūcatuḥ ||20 || athātra khalu nāsmākaṃ brahmāṇḍesti parīkṣakaḥ | vinā prayojanaṃ naiva mūlyaṃ kasyāpi jāyate ||21 || tṛṇaṃ prāpte’pi samaye koṭisvarṇasamaṃ bhavet | agnirvai śaityakalahe bahumūlyo’bhijāyate ||22|| tyaktaṃ mayūrapicchaṃ tu goloke kṛṣṇasaṃdhṛtam | svasyaiva makuṭe tena pūjyatāṃ mūlyatāṃ gatam ||23|| brahmaṇā vidhṛtaṃ gaṃgājalaṃ purā kamaṇḍalau | visṛṣṭaṃ mūlyavajjātaṃ mahadbhūtaṃ hi mūlyavat ||24|| kaṃkaraḥ khalu kṛṣṇena dhṛto vakṣasi mūlyavāna| na dhṛtaḥ kardamaḥ kaiścinmūlyaṃ nāpto manāgapi ||25|| tasmādahaṃ mahānagnirmama putraḥ suvarṇakam | vinā prayojanaṃ yadvā mahadbhiḥ saṃdhṛtiṃ vinā ||26|| mūlyavantau na vai syāva duḥkhaṃ tadvai mahattamam | guṇināṃ gaṇanāraṃbhe yadyaṃgulirna tiṣṭhati ||27|| varaṃ tasyātra mṛtyurvai prāṇanaṃ kleśadaṃ vṛthā | vidyā vā rājyasattā vā siddhiraiśvaryameva vā ||28|| khyātirvā dhanitā vāpi bhaktirvā jīvane varam | tadvihīnena martavyaṃ mariṣyāvastato’dya vai ||29|| iti vicārya vahnistatputro yayaturuccakaiḥ | merostu śikhare tasmātpātena maraṇārthinau ||3 0|| tāvat tatra satyaloke ghoṣayan dundubhirhareḥ | tābhyāṃ śruto’dhike māse śokaṃ kurvantu mā janāḥ ||3 1|| nārāyaṇaṃ tu saṃsmṛtya navamyāmadya ye janāḥ | kariṣyanti vrataṃ pūjāṃ teṣāmiṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati ||32|| ekabhuktena naktena tathaivāyācitena vā | phalena payasā tvadya dvikālaṃ tvaikakālikam ||33|| vrataṃ kṛtvārcanaṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇasya śaraṇāgatāḥ | api cette mānahīnā daridrā niṣprayojanāḥ ||34|| gaṇanāhīnakāścāpi yāsyanti cottamaṃ padam | ahaṃ vai dundubhirvacmi puruṣottamadeśanām ||35|| duḥkho vā kleśasandṛbdho’titiraskṛta eva vā | asthāno vālpamūlyo vā jaḍo vā tūgra eva vā ||36|| yaḥ kaściccharaṇaṃ prāpyādhikamāse vrataṃ caret | vidhūya tasya duḥkhāni kariṣyāmyavanaṃ sadā || 37|| puruṣottamamāsasya mānakṛnmānya eva me | puruṣottamamāse vai puṇyakṛtpūtatāṃ vrajet ||38 || mamārcanaprakartātra sarvārcyatāmavāpnuyāt | yasya vai rakṣitā ko’pi bhavatyeva na vai kvacit ||39|| cet sa rakṣatyadhimāsaṃ tathā māṃ puruṣottamam | rakṣayiṣye tu tamahaṃ vadāmi puruṣottamaḥ ||40|| pūjayantu ca māṃ bhaktyā bhojayantu supāyasam | prārthayantu yatheṣṭaṃ ca matto gṛhṇantvabhīṣṭakam ||41|| anugraheṇa dātāsmi tvakṛtasyāpi ceṣṭadaḥ | alpasya bahudaścāpi gṛhṇantu puruṣottamāt ||42|| adya ye na kariṣyanti vrataṃ vā varaṇaṃ ca vā | teṣāṃ hāniralābhaśca nānyaḥ kaścidato’dhikaḥ ||43|| tasmādāyāntu gṛhṇantu varān kuvantu pūjanam | ācarantu malamāse navamyāṃ vratamuttamam ||44|| pradātāsmi samṛddho’smi samudāro’smi sarvathā | dundubhiḥ pravadāmyatra nārāyaṇāntarātmakaḥ ||45|| nārāyaṇasvarūpo’haṃ puruṣottamadeśanaḥ | prasannaṃ dāsabhaktaṃ vā karomi puruṣottamam ||46 || patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo mayi sanniyokṣyate | ahaṃ tasminniyokṣyāmi śreṣṭhaṃ ratnādikaṃ punaḥ ||47|| bhojyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ tathā lehyaṃ coṣyaṃ yo me’rpayiṣyati | tasmai koṭiguṇitaṃ tadarpayiṣye’pyahaṃ tathā ||48|| yasya draṣṭāśrayadātā poṣṭā mānayitāvitā | ko’pi nāsti tu tasyāhaṃ sarvakartāvitāsmi vai ||49|| āgacchantu mahābhāgāḥ satkṛtā vāpyasatkṛtāḥ | bālā vā bālikā vāpi yuvatyaḥ sadhavādhavāḥ ||50|| yuvāno bhāgyavanto vā bhāgyahīnā daridrakāḥ | vṛddhā palitavalyaṃgāḥ sucittā vāpyacittakāḥ ||51 || tṛtīyaprakṛtivyāptā nāmasaṃjñāvihīnakāḥ | sthāvarā jaṃgamāḥ ke’pi jaḍā vā jaḍasannibhāḥ ||5 2 || tiryañco’pi vivarasthā gartasthāḥ khanikhātajāḥ | mukhajāḥ pṛṣṭhajāścāpi malajā amalodbhavāḥ ||5 3 || malamāsaṃ samāśritya toṣayitvā pumuttamam | pārameṣṭhyapadaṃ yāntu yāntu vākṣaradhāma tat ||54|| svarge sukhaṃ paraṃ yāntu yāntu śrīpuruṣottamam | sutaṃ yāntu patiṃ yāntu patnīṃ yāntu ca padminīm ||55|| gṛhaṃ kīrtiṃ dhanaṃ yāntu yāntu śāśvatapūjanam | sarvādhikyottamasthānaṃ gṛhṇantvanugrahānmama ||56|| ityudārāṃ ghoṣaṇāṃ saṃśrutvāgniśca suvarṇakam | lebhāte sma mahādhairyaṃ śokaṃ tatyajatustataḥ ||57|| meroḥ śṛṃge satyaloke dundubhiṃ śaraṇaṃ gatau | natvā ca dundubhiṃ tasya pūjāṃ cakraturādarāt ||58|| vahninā tu sutaṃ svarṇaṃ dundubhestasya pādayoḥ | akārayannatiṃ tāvad dṛṣṭvā rūpottaraṃ sutam ||59|| dundubhinā samuttolya gṛhītvā karayonije | mastake ca tathā skandhe kṣaṇaṃ suvarṇako dhṛtaḥ ||60 || arpito vahnaye paścād vahniḥ prāha sagadgadaḥ | nāvayoḥ rakṣitā ko’pi satkartāpi na vidyate ||6 1|| mahadduḥkhamanubhūya mṛtyvarthaṃ tvāgatāvubhau | dundubhe yadi te vākyād vrataṃ kurvo’dya naktakam ||62|| pūjanaṃ ca hareḥ kurvo rakṣitā cedbhaveddhariḥ | evaṃ saṃvadatornetrādaśravo nyapatan bhuvi ||63|| rajataṃ tatsamutpannaṃ sthale sthalyāṃ samujjvalam | vīkṣyaivaṃ bhagnahṛdayaṃ dayamānaṃ mahānalam ||64|| saputraṃ dundubhistaṃ cāśvāsayāmāsa sadgirā | navamyāṃ adhimāsasya vrataṃ kuruta naktakam ||65 || pūjāṃ kuruta vai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya cādya ha | sauvarṇīṃ pratimāṃ kārayitvā nārāyaṇasya ca ||66|| pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya samarcyākṣatacandanaiḥ | vibhūṣya svarṇabhūṣābhirhārairmālābhirityapi || 67|| sadratnairambarairdravyairvibhinnairbhojanaiḥ phalaiḥ | jalaistāmbūlapānaiśca dhūpadīpapradakṣiṇaiḥ ||68 || toṣayitvārthayed devaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | asatkṛtamanādhāramanādṛtamanāśrayam || 69 || kṣudhitaṃ tṛṣitaṃ dveṣyaṃ dāhakaṃ māṃ samuddhara | jaḍaṃ nirgandhamatiṃ vai guruṃ prastararūkṣakam ||7 0 || nirguṇaṃ cetanāhīnaṃ vākiñcitkaramityapi | samuddhara kṛpāsindho gaṇanāṃ prāpaya prabho ||7 1 || evaṃ stutiṃ prakuryācca śrīphalārghyaṃ samarpayet | puṣpāṃjaliṃ pradadyācca natvā nāthaṃ visarjayet ||72 || madhyāhne’pi tathā kuryāt kuryānniśīthake tathā | savādyanartanagītairnīrājayedvisarjayet ||7 3 || evaṃ kuru kṛśāno tvaṃ hāṭaka tvaṃ tathā kuru | nārāyaṇaḥ prasannaḥ san yuvāmuddhārayiṣyati ||74|| ityāśrutya mahādundubhyuktaṃ nārāyaṇoditam | vahniścakāra sauvarṇīṃ mūrtiṃ nārāyaṇasya vai ||75|| lakṣmyā mūrtiṃ cakārātha pūjayāmāsatuśca tau | pitā putraśca vidhivad vrataṃ nakta pracakratuḥ ||76|| rātrau prārthayato yāvat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim | lakṣmīsamanvitaṃ tāvat prādurbabhūva cāgrataḥ ||77 || tejaḥparidhi saṃvyāptānanaṃ lakṣmīprasevitam | mandaṃ mandaṃ hasantaṃ taṃ vilokya puruṣottamam ||78 || vahnisvarṇau prārthayataḥ kṛpānātha samuddhara | ūṣṇasvabhāvayuktasya dāhakasya mama sthalam ||79|| nāsti kutrāpi tannātha dehi me bhojanaṃ tathā | mūlyaṃ mūrkhasya putrasya suvarṇasya tu nāsti vai ||8 0 || prastarasya na satkāro dṛśyate tadyaśaḥ kuru | sarvadā tava sevāṃ ca pradehi bhagavan vibho ||8 1 || śaraṇe te’smi patito māmuddhara saputrakam | ityarthito harikṛṣṇo vahniṃ prāha narāyaṇaḥ ||82 || śokaṃ tyaja kṛśāno tvaṃ tuṣṭo’smi tvadvratena vai | mamānanāt samutpannaḥ sadā tvastu mamānanam ||8 3 || varaṃ dadāmyahaṃ putra yajñādau bhojanaṃ tvayi | sthāpayiṣyanti ye hoṣyantyanale kuṇḍamadhyage ||84|| agnihotrasya havanaṃ tvayi nyasyanti ye janāḥ | tvaddvārā tanmayā sarvaṃ jakṣitavyaṃ na cānyathā ||85|| vahni vinā janā ye me dāsyanti bhojanādikam | tadahaṃ na grahīṣyāmi sarvathānugrahāt tvayi ||86|| adyadinādahaṃ loke’gnimukho bhagavāniti | khyātiṃ yāsye janāstena madarthe bhojanādikam ||87|| tvayi kṣepsyanti tatsarvaṃ bhakṣayiṣyāmi tvanmukhāt | śamīṣvadṛśyarūpeṇa tava vāso viśeṣataḥ ||88|| hīrakādiṣu tadvacca sarvatrāstu tavāśrayaḥ | yathā vastupradahanaṃ na syādvāsastathā tava ||89|| sarvatrāstu kṛśāno tvaṃ sukhī bhava janādiṣu | sammānaṃ sarvathā te’stu satkāraḥ sarvathā tava ||90 || kalpavṛkṣalaye kāle cūlyādau pācanāya vai | prajvālanaṃ tavaivāstu sarvathaiva gṛhe gṛhe ||9 1|| cintāmaṇyādi nāśe tu pradīpasya gṛhe gṛhe | sammānaṃ sarvathā te syād dhairyamāvaha tāvatā ||92|| dvitīyena ca divyena rūpeṇa pārṣadena me | dhāmni sevāṃ vaha nityaṃ vahne mukto’si me’nagha ||93|| prathame yugaparyāye vyatīte tvanalaṃ vinā | kāryaṃ kimapi sarveṣāṃ bhaviṣyati na vai tadā ||94|| tava mūlyaṃ ca sammānaṃ satkārādarapūjanam | parākāṣṭhāgataṃ sarve bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||95|| suvarṇo’yaṃ ca te putro mamātivallabhaḥ khalu | adyārabhya mayā svasya mastake dhārya eva ca ||96|| mukuṭo’yaṃ tu me hyastu bhavatāṃ kuṇḍale mama | mama bhūṣāsvarūpo’stu śṛṃkhalākaṭakormikāḥ ||97|| raśanāhārapātrāṇi svarṇo’stu sarvavastukaḥ | mayā dhṛtastava putro mastake mukuṭātmakaḥ ||98|| so’tha sarvatra satkāraṃ yāsyati kālanirgame | samūlyaśca sugūhyaśca saṃrakṣyaśca bhaviṣyati ||99|| kalpavṛkṣādivilaye kalpadruḥ sa bhaviṣyati | kiñca divyaṃ svarūpaṃ vai suvarṇāya dadāmi ha || 100 || mūlarūpeṇa me dhāmni seviṣyate sa māṃ sadā | hāṭakākhyaḥ pārṣado me’kṣare dhāmni nivatsyati || 101 || atha kālāntare kāryāvaśyakatve’nalātmakaḥ | mahātejomayaḥ so’yaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñakaḥ || 10 2|| pātāle ca pṛthivyāṃ ca mahādevo bhaviṣyati | mamāvatāraḥ sarvatra pūjāṃ prāpsyati madbalāt || 10 3|| bhaktānāṃ muktidātā ca bhaviṣyati maheśvaraḥ | sarvabrahmāṇḍasṛṣṭau ca khyātiṃ tvamiva yāsyati || 1 04|| yathāhaṃ bhagavān vyāptastathā vahniḥ suvarṇakam | vyāptiṃ yāsyati sṛṣṭau me satkāraṃ ca prayāsyati || 1 05|| rakṣaṇaṃ cāpi saṃsthānaṃ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati dhruvam | ityuktvā ca tayordivye rūpe kṛtvā hariḥ svayam || 1 06|| nināya svālayaṃ cānye rūpe vastuṣu vāsite | etadrūpaṃ ca vṛttāntaṃ parijñāya surādayaḥ || 1 07|| vahnidvārā bhakṣayanti tṛpyanti tatra bhojanāt | suvarṇasya vibhūṣāśca dhārayanti sthale sthale || 108 || evaṃ vahnistathā svarṇo navamīpūjanaṃ vratam | kṛtvā muktau praśastau saṃmūlyakau ca babhūvatuḥ || 10 9|| pāvitryaṃ sarvadā prāptau yatra kvāpi gatau hi tau | vṛddhiṃ ca sarvadā prāptau tathā sukhaṃ tu śāśvatam || 110 || navamyāstu vratākhyānaṃ paṭhiṣyanti tu ye janāḥ | śroṣyanti vā narā nāryo yāsyanti bhuktimokṣaṇe || 111 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye virāṭaputrasya vahnestatputrasuvarṇasya ca dāhakatvajaḍatvādidoṣānvitasya kalpavṛkṣāśritajanatābhiranādare kṛte merau maraṇonmukhasya dundubhiśravaṇe’dhimāsanavamīvratapūjanakaraṇena yajñādau sarvamānyatābhagavanmukhatā bhagavadābhūṣaṇarūpatā dhāmaprāptirdivyapārṣadatā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||1.301 ||
<1.302> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca athāpi te kathāṃ lakṣmi kathayāmi surañjanīm | adhimāse hareścānugrahānto naiva vidyate || 1 || navamyāṃ tu niśi pṛṣṭaṃ dundubhaye tu śārṅgiṇā | uddhoṣyate nu sarvatra kiṃ vā kvacitkvacitsthale || 2 || dundubhiḥ prāha sarvatra yāṃ diśāmabhilakṣya tu | prātaḥkālād ghoṣayāmi sāyaṃkālāvadhiṃ prabho || 3 || bahavaḥ khalu kurvanti dehino vratamatra vai | kṛpālābhaṃ ca gṛhṇanti bhuktiṃ muktiṃ manāk kṛtāt || 4 || tāvat tatra samāyātā pṛthvī samprārthanāya vai | bhagavan devadeveśa vaikuṇṭhanātha mādhava || 5 || asaṃkhyaprāṇināṃ mokṣo’dhimāse sāmprataṃ tvayā | vidhīyate’tikṛpayā tato’haṃ sukhinī bhṛśam || 6 || mamāpi devadevasya vrataṃ kāryaṃ samādarāt | puruṣottamamāsasya vratināṃ saṃpramokṣaṇam || 7 || svargayogastava yogo dhanadhānyādisampadaḥ | putrapautrayaśolābhā yadyadiṣṭaṃ bhavecca tat || 8 || kṛpayā dīyataṃ sarve gataṃ vaikuṇṭhatulyatām | ahaṃ tu dhanyabhāgyāsmi dundubhistava yanmayi || 9 || muktakaṇṭhena sarvebhyo vijñāpayatyudāratām | adhimāse kṛpā yā ca kṛtā tvayā dayālunā || 10 || mayi saiva kṛpā jātā jīvā yatpuṇyabhāginaḥ | pāpahīnāḥ pavitrāśca bhaviṣyanti sadā mayi || 11 || pāpabhāreṇa bhagavan kadāpi pīḍitā nahi | bhaviṣyāmi bhavadbhaktabāhulyātpuṇyaśālinī || 12|| sārdhadvayābdādhimāse’pyekāhaṃ ca vrataṃ tava | kariṣyanti janā ye ye te sarve dhūtapāpakāḥ || 1 3 || anyoddhārasamarthāśca bhaviṣyanti sadā mayi | ityahaṃ bahu tuṣṭāsmi bhāvisvāsthyapralābhataḥ || 14|| asajjanānāṃ bhāreṇa bhavāmi pīḍitā prabho | asantaśca janāḥ kāle prabhaviṣyanti bhāvini || 15 || brāhmaṇā vedahīnāśca vedamātṛvihīnakāḥ | vaidikaiḥ karmabhirhīnā bhārarūpā mayi prabho || 16 || śaucasantoṣahīnāśca tapobhirvarjitāstathā | svādhyāyeśapraṇidhānairhīnā bhārātmakā mayi || 17|| ahiṃsāvratahīnāśca piśunāḥ satyavarjitāḥ | asteyavratahīnāśca vyavāyābhiratāstathā || 18|| tṛṣṇāvṛtā parasvāpaharā bhārātmakā mayi | dayāhīnāḥ śīlahīnāḥ parāvanaticintakāḥ || 1 9|| mithyākalaṃkavaktāro nindakā dveṣiṇastathā | śraiṣṭhyaunnatyāsahā ye te bhārarūpāḥ sadā mayi || 20 || parātmaduḥkhakartāro guṇe doṣābhidhāyakāḥ | svārthamātraparā viprā bhārarūpā mayi sthitāḥ || 2 1 || snānasandhyāvihīnāśca devapūjādivañcitāḥ | ātmaniṣṭhādirahitā jaḍā bhārātmakā mayi ||22|| yajñavighnaprakartāro vaiśvadevavināśakāḥ | saṃskārabhāvanāhīnā viprā bhārātmakā mayi || 23|| sūtakānatimantāro hetuvādāśca nāstikāḥ | brahmopāsanayā hīnā viprā bhārātmakā mayi ||24|| bhaktibhāvavihīnāśca śūnyā adhyātmavidyayā | pitṛtarpaṇaśūnyāśca viprā bhārātmakā mayi ||25|| paropakārahīnāśca dānapuṇyavivarjitāḥ | jihvāśiśnakṛtādharmā viprā bhārātmakā mayi ||26|| parakaṣṭapradātāraḥ parakāryaprabhañjakāḥ | parāparādhakartāro viprā bhārātmakā mayi ||27|| ayogye bījadātāro hyayogyakṣetrakarṣukāḥ | chaladharmātighātāśca viprā bhārātmakā mayi ||28|| prasahya bhoginaḥ krūrāḥ parākrandanahetavaḥ | kūṭacārāḥ kṣveḍaguptā madhuvācaḥ pratārakāḥ || 29|| vārtayā viṣasektāro bhārarūpāḥ sadā mayi | viśvāsaghātakā ye ca kṛtaghnā bālaghātakāḥ ||3 0|| ajñapraghātakā ye ca śaraṇāgataghātakāḥ | kuṭumbaghātakā mātāpitṛnārīpraghātakāḥ ||31|| dharmaghnā mokṣaghātāśca bhārarūpā mayi prabho | abhakṣyabhakṣakā jātibhraṃśasaṃkarakārakāḥ ||32|| stryapatyanāśakā vṛttidhanaprāṇāpahārakāḥ | ātatāyikriyāduṣṭā agnidā garadāstathā ||33|| māraṇoccāṭanakṛtyā garbhaghātādikāriṇaḥ | asthānatāḍane krūrakarmāḍhyā bhārakā mayi ||34|| abrāhmaṇā brāhmaṇatve svakartavyavihīnakāḥ | parasaukhyavihantāraḥ sadā bhārātmakā mayi ||35|| anudyogāḥ sadālasyā parabhāgyopajīvinaḥ | dṛptāścaivānadhikāre sadā bhārātmakā mayi || 36|| amārgagā mṛdūnāṃ svabalenārdanakārakāḥ | adaṇḍye daṇḍakartāraḥ sadā bhārātmakā mayi ||37|| pālyānāṃ pālakā ye na pūjyānāṃ pūjakāśca na | mānyānāṃ mānakartāro na ye te bhārakā mayi ||38|| paśūnāṃ duḥkhakartāraścāśritānāmarakṣakāḥ | dāsānāṃ duḥkhakartāro bhārarūpā sadā mayi ||39|| śiṣyapratārakāḥ śikṣakāśca śiṣyā vivartinaḥ | bhṛtyapratārakā āḍhyā āḍhyaghnāḥ karmacāriṇaḥ ||40|| śiṣyāśca guravaścāpi svasvakartavyavarjitāḥ | pratārakāstathānyonyaṃ sarve bhārātmakā mayi || 41|| sevakāḥ svāmihantāraḥ svāminaḥ sevakārdanāḥ | dāsā dāsatvahīnāśca sarve bhārātmakā mayi ||42|| rājā na rakṣako yatra na prajā puṇyakāriṇī | śaṭhāḥ prajāsu ye rājñi sarve bhārātmakā mayi ||43| atrātā kṣatriyo’dātā vaiśyaḥ śūdro’pyasevakaḥ | svasvadharmahanaḥ sarve bhārarūpā mayi prabho ||44|| jananyājñākarī yā na putrī snuṣāpi tādṛśī | mātā yā hitakartrī na śvaśrūścāpi ca tādṛśī ||45|| dampatyoryatra naikyaṃ ca kalahaśca dvayoḥ sadā | patisevāghṛṇā patnī patnīduḥkhakaraḥ patiḥ ||46|| putrāḥ pitṛnideśe na pitā putravinindakaḥ | sevyasevakatāhīnāste sarve bhārakā mayi ||47|| brahmacārī brahmacarye yo na tiṣṭhati rāgataḥ | gṛhasthastyāgadharmāśca puraskṛtya pravartate ||48|| vānaprastho’pi satṛṣṇaḥ sannyāso nyāsavarjitaḥ | anyadharmagrahītāraste sarve bhārarūpiṇaḥ ||49|| dadhidugdhaghṛtatailarasasāṃkaryakārakāḥ | annapatrakaṇaśākapuṣpasāṃkaryakārakāḥ ||50|| khādyapeyasusaṃdhāryabhogyasāṃkaryakārakāḥ | jīvaghātakarā vaidyāḥ sarve te bhārarūpiṇaḥ ||51 || madyamāṃsāśanā martyāḥ parapiṇḍopajīvinaḥ | vastrabhūṣādisāṃkaryakarā vai bhārarūpiṇaḥ ||52|| kūṭapaṇyāḥ kūṭamānāḥ kūṭatulāpramāpinaḥ | kūṭasaṃkhyākarā daivajñā api bhārarūpiṇaḥ ||53|| vyāpārādeyadeyādo pratāraṇakarāḥ khalāḥ | prasahya luñcakā martyāḥ sadā bhārātmakā mayi ||54|| akarmaṭhā vyasaninaḥ śanigrahasamā bhuvi | rāhugrāsasamā ye ca sarpadaṃśasamāstathā ||55|| cipīṭakāsamā ye ca badrīkaṇṭakarūpiṇaḥ | mīnaśyenasamā ye ca bakamārjārakarmakā ||56|| bahiḥ śuklā hṛtsu raktāścātmani kṛṣṇakajjalāḥ | martyā devā dānavā vā svargyāḥ pātālavāsinaḥ ||57|| sarve te bhārarūpā vai pāpakarmāṇa eva te | pīḍayeyuśca māṃ kāle yeṣāṃ māhātmyameva na ||58|| nādhimāsavrataṃ yeṣāṃ na yeṣāṃ puruṣottamaḥ | na bhaktiścāstikabhāvaste syurbhārātmakā bhuvi ||5 9|| tasmānmayā hare kṛṣṇa kāle kāle ca tādṛśām | bhāvināṃ bhāranāśāya prārthyate parameśvaraḥ ||60 || kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā teṣāṃ bhāranāśāya keśava | yacchreyastatsamabrūhi bhāvimacchreyaicchayā ||61|| ityarthayantyāṃ kṣmāyāṃ tāṃ dundubhiḥ prāha medinīm | kiṃ tvayā na śrutaṃ pṛthvi mayoddhoṣitamiṣṭadam ||62|| adhimāse vrataṃ kāryaṃ puṇyaṃ vai śāśvataṃ bhavet | vidhāsyatyavanaṃ te ca bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ ||63|| idānīṃ śrīhariḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ paraprabhuḥ | prasannaḥ phaladaścāste daśamyāstvaṃ vrataṃ kuru ||64|| vratānte bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ dāsyati darśanam | kariṣyatyavanaṃ te ca sarvakāleṣu bhārataḥ ||65|| idānīṃ yāhi deveśi satyaloke sthitiṃ kuru | vrataṃ daśamyāstatraivādhimāsasyādhivartaya ||66|| vratānte yadi devaste darśana na dadāti cet | śvaḥ sāyaṃ vai tvayā tvatrāgantavyaṃ cārthanāya vai ||67|| ityuktā dundubhinaiva natvā devaṃ prabhuṃ tathā | dundubhiṃ ca namaskṛtya satyalokaṃ samāyayau ||68|| svanivāse pṛthivyā ca daśamyāśca vrataṃ kṛtam | prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā kṛtvā mūrtiṃ tu kānakīm ||69|| pañcāmṛtairhariṃ prārcya snapayitvā jalaiḥ śubhaiḥ | sugandhacandanādyaiśca carcayitvātibhāvataḥ ||70|| vastraiḥ svarṇairvibhūṣābhiḥ kuṃkumākṣatasaddalaiḥ | tulasīmaṃjarībhiśca kamalairdhūpadīpakaiḥ ||71 || pūjayitvā sunaivedyaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ haraye dadau | jalaṃ tāmbūlamiṣṭeṣṭaṃ phalaṃ cārghyaṃ dadau tataḥ ||72|| nīrājayitvā kusumāṃjaliṃ namaḥ stutiṃ tathā | pradakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ cārpayitvā ca tataḥ kṣitiḥ ||73|| vavande paramātmānaṃ vrataṃ vai daśamīkṛtam | adhimāsasya sampūrṇe sanaktaṃ bhavatānmama ||74|| prātarevaṃ pūjayitvā pupūja praharadvaye | bhojayitvā yathāpekṣaṃ tvarpayitvātha śārṅgiṇe ||75|| sāyamevaṃ ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ samapūjayat|| ārārtrikaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ phalam ||76|| dadau kṛṣṇāya kusumāṃjaliṃ satpāyasaṃ dadau | tataśca pāyayāmāsa vavande karuṇākaram ||77|| sajāgaraṃ nartanaṃ ca gītaṃ cakre’rdharātrikam | madhyarātrau hariścāyāt sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||78|| vada pṛthvi kimiṣṭaṃ te vratāt tuṣṭo’smi saṃvṛṇu | adhimāse vratinastu sarvamiṣṭaṃ karomi vai ||79|| iti me’sti vrataṃ tasmāt sulabhaṃ durlabhaṃ tathā | yatkiṃcit tat sarvathāhaṃ pūrayiṣye vadātra mām ||80|| ityuktā sā mahī tatra provāca parameśvaram | bhagavan yadi tuṣṭo’si satyavākyakaro’si ca ||8 1 || sarvaṃ dadāsi cenmahyaṃ sarvo me puruṣottamaḥ | vinā necchāmi cānyadvai trātāraṃ puruṣottamam |82 || ahaṃ sadā tu te nātha sevāyāṃ saṃvasāmi vai | tādṛśaṃ me divyarūpaṃ dehi bhūtrāṇakṛt prabho ||83 || anyacca bhārarūpāṇāṃ vināśāya mahāprabho | adharmāguṇanāśāya malloke vihara prabho ||84| adhimāsaṃ vinānyeṣu māseṣu prajayā kṛtam | pāpaṃ prajvālayituṃ tvaṃ mayi vāsaṃ prarocaya ||85|| yena me sarvadā deva rakṣaṇaṃ syājjanārdana | āgaccha divyarūpeṇa bhautikena ca vā prabho ||86 || bhautikaṃ yadi te varṣma kvacit sviṣṭaṃ susaṃbhavet | tadā mātā bhaviṣyāmi pālayiṣyāmi matsutam ||87|| lālayiṣyāmi govinda bhojayiṣyāmi bhāvataḥ | kariṣyāmi ca te sevāṃ yatheṣṭaṃ dehi cārthitam ||88 || ityuktvā virarāmeyaṃ nanāma puruṣottamam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrutvā pṛthivyā hṛdayodbhavam ||89|| divyaṃ rūpaṃ dadau cāsyai vaikuṇṭhe sevanārhaṇam | divyā satī surūpā ca caturhastā ramāsamā ||90 || bhūtvā vasumatī pṛthvī dīvyati smātha mādhavaḥ | nināya tāṃ vasumatīṃ vaikuṇṭhe salilopari || 91|| tatra tiṣṭhati nityā sā dāsī bhūtvātivaiṣṇavī | atha dvitīyaṃ tadrūpaṃ pṛthivyāvaraṇe stare || 92 || pṛthivyā bhavane nityaṃ vāsārhaṃ vidyate sadā | sā devī sarvabhūtānāmadhiṣṭhātrī tu bhūrmatā || 93 || nārāyaṇena sā nityaṃ satyalokopari dhruvā| pṛthivyāvaraṇe sthātumājñaptā tatra vartate || 94 | tṛtīyaṃ kāryarūpaṃ yat pārthivaṃ prastarādikam | sthalyātmakamidaṃ sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam ||95 || tatra pṛthvyāṃ yathāpekṣaṃ bhāraṃ hartuṃ bhuvo nanu| hariṇā tu samāgantuṃ pratiśrutaṃ tu vai mṛhuḥ || 96 hariḥ prāha śṛṇu kṣme tvaṃ prathame yugaparyaye| vyatīte bhārarūpā vai bhaviṣyanti prajā muhuḥ |97|| prathame’pi yuge devakāryārthaṃ tvayi sāmpratam | āgamiṣyāmi te bhaktyā varadānena vai muhuḥ |98|| avatārān grahīṣyāmi rakṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ| daśamyāmadhimāsasya vratena toṣito’smyaham ||99|| ato yugacatuṣke vai tattatkāryārthameva ha | avatārān grahīṣyāmi daśa mukhyām̐stato’pi ca || 100 || gauṇānanyāna yathāpekṣaṃ bahūn vai divyavigrahān | tena tena svarūpeṇa kariṣyāmi tavāvanam || 101 || saṃhariṣyāmyadevām̐śca nāśayiṣyāmi dānavān | daityān vipothayiṣyāmi kariṣyāmi sukhaṃ tava || 10 2 || evaṃ bhāraṃ hariṣyāmi gaccha devi yathāsukham | ityābhāṣya haristatra kṣaṇādantaradhīyata || 103 || pṛthvī tuṣṭābhavaccāpi dadau puṣpāṃjaliṃ punaḥ | vrataṃ samāpya sā devī tato natvā tu dundubhim || 1 04|| jagāma svālayaṃ pṛthvyāvaraṇe svīyamandiram | evaṃ lakṣmi daśamyāḥ sā kṛtvādhimāsikaṃ vratam || 10 5|| nāmnā vasumatī dāsī jātā vaikuṇṭhavāsinī | yuge yuge dine cāhni mamāvirbhāvavatyapi || 106 || mayā pratijñayā sarvādhilābhagāminī kṛtā | anyāyai na mayaitādṛk lābho’rpitaḥ kadācana || 1 07|| yadyad vāñchati yaḥ ko’pi svalpenāpi vratena me | tattattasmai pradadāmi nakārastatra nāsti hi || 108 || yaḥ śroṣyati vasumatīkathāṃ yaśca paṭhiṣyati | prāpsyati vratapuṇyaṃ sa daśamyā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 109 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye vaikuṇṭhe bhagavantaṃ pṛthivyāḥ prārthanā bhārarūpāṇāṃ paricayaḥ daśamīvratena pṛthivī vasumatī bhūtvā vaikuṇṭhavāsinī jātā svasyāṃ pratiyuge bhagavadavatārāṇāṃ prākaṭyārthaṃ bhagavatpratijñetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.302 ||
<1.303> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca adhimāsaikādaśikākathāṃ divyāṃ haripradām | śṛṇu lakṣmi samāraṃbhe sṛṣṭerjātā tapomayīm || 1 || brahmaṇo vakṣaso jāto dharmadevaḥ samūrtikaḥ | mūrtirdevī tirobhūtā sadāste dharmavarṣmaṇi || 2 || sā ca dharme samutpanne sahaivotpadyate’pi sā | lokarītyā tu saṃjajñe dakṣaputrīsvarūpiṇī || 3 || punardharmasya sā patnī lokarītyā tu jāyate | yadā sābhūd dharmadeve hyadṛśyā cāvivāhitā || 4 || tadā lakṣmi kumārī sā brahmacaryasamanvitā | sevate sarvadā bhaktyā svāminaṃ brahmacāriṇam || 5 || satyaloke sthitā vedhogṛhe dharmasahāyinī | brahmā jānāti vai sarvaṃ nānye jānanti tāṃ sthitām || 6 || bālā bālasvarūpādvai samārabhyaiva nityaśaḥ | snānaṃ pūjāṃ japaṃ homaṃ dhyānaṃ svāmiprasevanam || 7 || karotyeva ca vṛddhebhyo namanaṃ vandanaṃ tathā | dayāśāntiprasantoṣārjavopakārakādayaḥ ||8 || satyātimārdavakṛcchraguṇā mūrtau vasanti hi | siddhadehā tu sā mūrtistapassu vartate’ti vai || 9 || vṛṣṭau tiṣṭhati varṣāsu śaitye śītajalādiṣu | ātape pañcavahnisthā nirāhārā vrateṣu ca || 10 || ārdrāmbarānvitā nityaṃ svarṇadīto gṛhaṃ svakam | samāgatya patiṃ natvā karoti kṛṣṇapūjanam || 11 || patiṃ jalādibhiḥ pūrvaṃ snapayitvā samarcya ca | dadāti bhojanaṃ cāsmai jalaṃ khādyaṃ phalādikam || 1 2 || svayaṃ tu tulasīpatraiḥ kamalaiḥ pārijātakaiḥ | patiṃ nityaṃ pūjayati divyajñānātibhaktitaḥ || 13 || evaṃ prātaḥ sadā snānaṃ devapūjāṃ dhavārcanam | patisevā bhojanādi kārayitvā vidhāya ca || 14|| patyurdehe vilīnā sā mūrtirbhavati sarvadā | evaṃ nityānuvṛttyā sā premapātrottamottamā || 15 || dharmadevasya vai jātā sukhadāpi kumārikā | dharmadevo’pyanuvṛttisevābhaktyātitoṣaṇam || 16 || pratyahaṃ samavāpnoti dadātyasyai śubhāśiṣaḥ | patisevāparā nityaṃ sukhini mūrtike bhava || 1 7|| lokarītyāptadehena vivāhya sevikā bhava | tataḥ saubhāgyasatputrasmṛddhyādisaṃbhṛtā bhava || 18 || nityabhaktiphalarūpaḥ sādhyaste keśavo bhavet | hariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 19 || ityāśīrvādabhūmiḥ sā mahāpuṇyādhivāsanī | adhimāsaikādaśikāprātarutthāya nityavat || 20 || snātuṃ sā svarṇadī yātā tatra śuśrāva dundubhim | adyāstyekādaśī devyaḥ puruṣottamamāsagā || 2 1 || asyā vratena santuṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | yatheṣṭaṃ dāsyate saukhyamaihikaṃ pāralaukikam || 22 || yad dadāmyadhimāsasya dineṣvanyeṣu vai vratān | tataḥ koṭiguṇaṃ dāsye phalamekādaśīvrate || 23 || ekādaśīnāmanyāsāṃ vratena yatphalaṃ bhavet | tato’rbudaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ dāsye hyasyā vratena vai ||24|| ahaṃ brahmeśvaraścādhimāsasyāsmyadhidaivataḥ | tatrāpyekādaśīnātho’smyahaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||25|| māso’pi puṇyaśca dinaṃ ca puṇyaṃ devo’smi puṇyaśca vrataṃ kṛpāloḥ | mamājñayā ye’nucaranti bhaktyā tebhyo yatheṣṭaṃ vitarāmi sarvam ||26 || yathā yathā syānmanasīṣaṇātrayam vratasya kartuśca tathātathānvaham | parārdhatulyaṃ tu dadāmi tatphalaṃ lakṣmīṃ ca māṃ cāpi ca dhāma māmakam ||27|| siṃhāsanaṃ me’pi dadāmi tasmai dadāmi siddhīśca camatkṛtiṃ ca | aiśvaryasarvasvamathāpi bhūtiṃ sakaustubhaṃ me mukuṭaṃ ca bhūṣā ||28|| yathādhimāse kṛpayā pravarṣaye janārthitaṃ pūrayituṃ ca varṣitum | tathā na kutrāpi tu naijavāñcchayā pravarṣayiṣye’dhikamāsamantarā ||29|| vrataṃ prakurvantu narāḥ striyaśca bālāśca vṛddhāśca sutoṣaṇāya | phalaṃ pradāsye mama śāśvataṃ vai padaṃ sudivyaṃ tu parātparaṃ yat || 30 || golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ dhāmāvyākṛtameva vā | śvetadvīpaṃ ca vā sauryaṃ tvanye bhaumaṃ tathāparam ||3 1|| yadyadicched vrataṃ kṛtvā pradāsyāmi kṛpāvaśaḥ | alpāyāse phalānantyaṃ gṛhṇantu vratīno mama || 32|| nātra yajñāḥ pṛthak kāryā nātra tapyaṃ tapaḥ pṛthak | tīrthaṃ nātra pṛthak kāryaṃ hyekāhasya phale hi tat || 33|| payovrataṃ ca putreṣṭiyajanaṃ neṣyate pṛthak | ekādaśyā vratenātra dāsyāmi putramityapi ||34|| jyotiṣṭomena yajanaṃ pṛthak sādhyaṃ na veṣyate | svargaṃ dadāmi tasmai ya ekādaśyā vrataṃ caret || 35 || na tasya rājasūyena sādhyaṃ kimapi śiṣyate | ekādaśīvratenātra sārvabhaumaṃ dadāmyaham ||36|| agnihotreṇa kiṃ tasya dāsye vairājakaṃ padam | ekādaśyāṃ tu me yenārpitaṃ phalajalādikam ||37|| śrāddhairvividhakalpaiśca vividhairdevapūjanaiḥ | yā tṛptistviṣyate tāṃ vai dāsye caikādaśīvrate ||38|| yāṃ muktiṃ yāṃ ca sampattiṃ yāṃ siddhiṃ yogamaiśvaram | yadyad vāñcchati yat kṛtvā tad dāsye’tra dine vrate || 3 9|| yāvajjīvaṃ phalāhārairyat supuṇyaṃ samarjyate | tatpuṇyaṃ yāntu vai caikādaśīvratena me janāḥ || 40 || ekabhuktaṃ kṛtaṃ yenājīvanaṃ tatphalaṃ tvaham | dadāmyadhikamāsaikādaśīvratena meṃ’jasā ||4 1 || mastake jvaladaṅgārāṅgiṣṭhikāṃ madhyarātrike | kāle udūhya yā nārī hyekārdravastrasaṃvṛtā || 42|| anupānaccaraṇābhyāmasahāyāpyaraṇyake | gatvā kālīṃ prapūjyaiva pratyahaṃ vārṣikaṃ vratam ||4 3 || ekabhuktaṃ māṣamātrādanaṃ kuryādakhaṇḍitam | varṣāyāṃ śītakāle cātapakāle’pi sarvadā ||44|| gatvāpūjya punarāyād gṛhaṃ svaṃ madhyarātrike | tato randhitamāṣānnaṃ gṛhṇīyācca jalaṃ sadā ||45|| evaṃ kaṣṭataraṃ putraprāptyarthaṃ yanmahadvratam | tadvai pṛthaṅ na kartavyamekādaśyā vrate kṛte || 46|| mahākālīvrataṃ tad yad vārṣikaṃ pratirātrikam | yad dadāti phalaṃ putrātmakaṃ tattu vinaśvaram ||47|| ekādaśīvrataṃ tvetatputrasvargapramuktidam | ekena divasenaiva tadvratādhikapuṇyadam ||48 || sahasravarṣaparyantaṃ vāyvāhāraṃ vrataṃ tu yat | pṛthak tannāsti kartavyaṃ hyekādaśyā vrate kṛte ||49|| sahasrakanyakādānaṃ yatra kanyā vibhūṣitāḥ | pratyekaṃ svarṇasāhasramudrāśca dakṣiṇāstathā || 5 0 || pratikanyaṃ tu dāsīnāṃ śataṃ svarṇavibhūṣitam | pratidāsi ca hastīnāṃ śataṃ tvambālikāyutam || 5 1 || pratihasti turagāṇāṃ śataṃ svarṇavibhūṣitam | pratyaśvaṃ govṛṣabhāṇāṃ śataṃ dvandvaṃ rathānvitam || 52|| rathaṃ rathaṃ prati dogdhrīgavā cāpi śataṃ śatam | gāṃ gāṃ prati hyajānāṃ ca śataṃ śataṃ dadettu yaḥ ||53 || ajāṃ ajāṃ prati vṛttiṃ kṣetraṃ gṛhaṃ dadecca yaḥ | tasya dātuḥ kurukṣetre phalaṃ sūryagrahe tu yat || 54|| tasmāllakṣaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ dadāmyekādaśīvrate | ahaṃ nārāyaṇaścāsmi śāśvataḥ puṇyaśevadhiḥ ||55 || nānto’sti mayi puṇyānāṃ gṛhṇantu vṛṣṭivajjanāḥ | saṃkalpo me puṇyabhūmirbhaktirme mokṣabhūmikā ||56 || saṃkalpasya ca bhakteścākṣayavārdhirahaṃ hariḥ | dadāmyeva dadāmyeva riktatābhayavarjitaḥ ||57|| puruṣottamamāsasyaikādaśyāṃ vratakāriṇe | sarvaṃ dadāmi conmattatyāgivat kamalāmapi ||58 || ahaṃ svayaṃ tu māṃ samarpaye kimuta cāparam | vṛṇutāto yatheṣṭaṃ vai vadāmi dundubhirhareḥ ||59|| etallābhaṃ na cedīyurnedṛśaḥ śāsyate punaḥ | iti śrutvā dundubhiṃ tu puruṣottamaghoṣaṇām ||60 || cintayāmāsa mūrtiḥ sā janma lagnaṃ sutaṃ harim | dundubhīśaṃ samapṛcchannatvā namrā vidhiṃ vrate ||6 1 || dundubhistu tadā prāha mūrtiṃ tvekādaśīvidhim | snātvā brāhme muhūrte ca dhyātvā śrīpuruṣottamam ||62|| sarvopacārairanyūnaiḥ pūjayetparameśvaram | mūrtiṃ tu pauraṭīṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya śobhitām ||63 || satpātre pañcapātre vai nidhāya sopacārikām | tato vratī jalapātraṃ sthāpayejjalasaddhaṭam ||64|| pañcāmṛtādi sannyasya pūjāṃ mūrtau samācaret | prathamaṃ dehaśuddhyarthaṃ tryācamanāni kalpayet ||65 || tataḥ pūrve mukhaṃ kṛtvā niṣadya ca śubhāsane | mūrtāvāvāhayet kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ samantrakam ||66 || ghaṇṭāṃ pravādayedāvāhanakāle śubhasvarām | āsanaṃ paṭṭikāṃ sthālīṃ svarṇāṃ dadyāttu śārṅgiṇe ||67|| pādaprakṣālanārthāya pādyaṃ dadyājjalaṃ śubham | tatastīrthajalaṃ dadyādarghyaṃ pūjānimittakam ||68 || tatastīrthajalamācamanārthaṃ ca dadecchubham | punaścātha praśuddhyarthaṃ dadyād darbhajalaṃ śubham ||6 9|| tato dantapraśuddhyarthaṃ dadyādvai dantadhāvanam | jihvollekhanakāryārthaṃ dadyāt svarṇaśalākikām ||70 || tataḥ śuddhaṃ jalaṃ dadyād gaṇḍūṣārthe tataḥ punaḥ | mukhaprakṣālanārthāya jalaṃ dadyātpunarnavam ||7 1 || atha śaucaṃ prakalpyaiva dadyājjalaghaṭaṃ tathā | mṛdaṃ vāpi pradadyācca karādiśuddhihetave ||72|| jalaṃ śuddhaṃ tathā dadyāddhastaprakṣālanāya vai | tataḥ śuddhaṃ jalaṃ dadyānmukhādikṣālanāya ca || 73 || svarṇāsanaṃ śubhaṃ dadyāt snānārthaṃ paṭṭikātmakam | tailena tu sugandhena mardayetparameśvaram ||74|| āmalakaistilacūrṇaistathā saṃmardayeddharim | tata uṣṇodakenāpi snāpayetpuruṣottamam ||75|| tato dugdhena dadhnā ca ghṛtena madhunā tathā | snāpayeccharkarā vārbhiḥ samṛdya puruṣottamam ||76 || tataḥ śuddhajalairuṣṇaiḥ snāpayetparameśvaram | tato nairmalyakāriṇyā proṣṇodakena miśrayā ||77|| hariṃ gūṭikayāmṛdya snāpayedabhiṣecanam | kastūrikācandanādipuṣpasārādi lepayet ||78 || vastreṇa mārjayet kṛṣṇaṃ dhautrāmbarāṇi dhārayet | keśaprasādhanaṃ tailaṃ datvā kuryācca dantakaiḥ ||79 || lalāṭe tilakaṃ candraṃ kuryāccandanakuṃkumaiḥ | netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ dadyādoṣṭhayoḥ raṃgarañjanam ||80 || hastapādatalādīni rañjayed raṃgasudravaiḥ | svarṇakirīṭasadratnamālikākuṇḍalādikam ||8 1 || maṇimauktikahārādi raśanākaṃkaṇādikam | ūrmikāśṛṃkhalāsatkiṃkiṇīnupūrakādikam ||8 2|| ābhūṣaṇāni sarvāṇi yathāsthānaṃ pradhārayet | pādayoḥ pāduke dadyāddhastayoryaṣṭimālike ||83 || kaṇṭhe satpuṣpahārām̐śca tulasīpatramālikām | puṣpāṇāṃ śekharān gucchānarpayetparamādarāt ||84|| pavitraṃ tvarpayed yajñopavītaṃ yogapaṭṭakam | tulasīmaṇimālāṃ ca dadyānmaṃgalasūtrakam ||85|| kaustubhaṃ ca maṇiṃ dadyāt tathā rakṣāṃ prakoṣṭhake | naktakaṃ hastake dadyāt prokṣayed gandhasārakam ||86|| rājādhirājasadveṣaṃ śṛṃgāraṃ kārayetparam | chatraṃ ca cāmare dadyād vyajanaṃ vāyudaṃ tathā ||87|| darpaṇaṃ mukhalokārthaṃ dadyāt paryaṃkamityapi | gendukaṃ pracchadapaṭīṃ kaśipuṃ guptadorakam ||88|| kapolakaśipuṃ dadyāt daṃśamaśakarodhinīm | dhūpaṃ sugandhaṃ kṛtvā ca dīpaṃ prajvālayettathā ||89|| śvetacūrṇaṃ raktacūrṇaṃ kuṃkumaṃ cākṣatān dadet | naivedyaṃ laḍḍukān miṣṭaṃ vividhānnaṃ supāyasam ||9 0 || śākāni cāranālāni dadhi dugdhaṃ saśarkaram | sūpaudanādikaṃ dadyāt kvathikāṃ caṭanīṃ tathā ||9 1 || bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ lehyacośye peyaṃ dadyājjalaṃ tathā | culukaṃ kārayettāmbūlakaṃ cūrṇaṃ samarpayet ||92|| elālavaṃgadhānātvagvarīyaḥ pūgikāphalam | dadyācca phalamāmrasya jambūpanasakādalam ||93 || drākṣāśrīphaladāḍīma navaraṃgādikaṃ dadet | śuṣkaphalānyapi dadyād badāmakājukhārikāḥ ||94|| evaṃ samarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā hariṃ santarpya bhāvataḥ | kadalīstambhavaśādikṛte vastrādiśobhite ||95|| aśokāmradalapuṣpaphalatoraṇarājite | maṇḍape madhyadeśe vai saptadhānyaiḥ kṛte śubhe ||96|| sarvatobhadrake tatra maṇḍale madhyavartini | suvarṇasya ghaṭe tāmre tīrthavāriprapūrite ||97|| maṇimauktikasauvarṇarūpyatāmrādikānvite | vastreṇa veṣṭite cāmrāśokādipallavānvite ||98|| suśobhite’kṣatacandanāktakuṃkumapūjite | tatra ghaṭe sthāpitā yā sthālī tāmrā ca kānakī ||99|| khārikāmraphalaiḥ pūgīśrīphalaiḥ śarkarātilaiḥ | pūritāyāṃ tu tasyāṃ vai sthāpayet puruṣottamam || 10 0|| nīrājayennavavāraṃ ghṛtāktapañcavartibhiḥ | vastraṃ ca bhrāmayet paścācchaṃkhodakena vartayet || 10 1|| dhūpaṃ saṃbhrāmayeccāpi stutiṃ kuryād yatheṣṭadām | namecca daṇḍavat kuryāt pañcavāraṃ pradakṣiṇam || 1 02|| kṣamāṃ yāceta cārghyaṃ vai saphalaṃ punararpayet | puṣpāṃjaliṃ sākṣataṃ vai dadyācchrīharaye tataḥ || 1 03|| dakṣiṇāṃ kānakīṃ mudrāṃ rājataṃ cāpyupāyanam | iṣṭaṃ vastu pradadyācca haraye tvabhivāñcchitam || 1 04|| āndolayrecca dolāyāṃ paryaṃke śayanaṃ dadet | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kuryād daded yānaṃ savāhanam || 105|| nṛtyaṃ kuryāt tathā gītaṃ vāditraṃ vādayet tathā | caraṇāmṛtadānaṃ ca bhaktebhyastatra vartayet || 106 || athāpi jalapānaṃ ca kārayetpunarādarāt | tāmbūlakaṃ punardadyādelālavaṃgakādikam || 1 07|| milet saṃśliṣya bāhubhyāṃ samāpīḍya hariṃ mudā | prasthāpayet tato devaṃ dūraṃ gatvā visarjayet || 1 08|| āgantavyamiti brūyānnatvā tvāyātpunargṛham | ityaṣṭottaraśatakopacāraiḥ parameśvaram || 1 09|| pūjayedbahubhaktyaikādaśyāṃ prātarvratī janaḥ | yadi sampadadhikā syāddhomayajñādi kārayet || 11 0|| dvādaśyāṃ bhojayedviprān satīḥ sādhvī sato janān | tataḥ svaḥ pāraṇāṃ kuryāt saṃbhojyāśritavargakān || 11 1|| dadyācchreṣṭhāni dānāni bhajeta śrīhariṃ mudā | evaṃ madhyāhnake kuryāt sāyaṃ kuryāttathaiva ha || 11 2|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānnṛtyagītapuraḥsaram | kīrtanaṃ śrīhareḥ kuryānnirundhyādindriyāṇi ca || 1 13|| evaṃ tvadhikamāsasyaikādaśīvratamatra yaḥ| kuryāt tena kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate || 1 14|| adhimāsaścātipuṇyaḥ puṇyāḥ tvekādaśī tithiḥ | taddevaḥ pāvanaścāhaṃ kiṃ tasmādatiricyate || 1 15|| adhimāso mama śālā vasāmi puruṣottamaḥ | ekādaśī madutpannā kiṃ tasmādatiricyate || 1 16|| etat trikaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvebhyaḥ śreṣṭhatāṃ gatam | tatrāpi matkṛpā prāptā kimasmādatiricyate || 1 17|| tasmādaṣṭottaraśatavastubhirmāṃ prapūjya ca | gṛhṇantu bhavapāraṃ vā gṛhṇantu bhavasāmyatām || 1 18|| mūrte tvaṃ cādya divase tathāvidhi kuru vratam | yena te dāsyate kṛṣṇo dundubhyātmā yathepsitam || 1 19|| mūrtiḥ prāha tadā hyenaṃ dundubhiṃ vinayena vai | na madagre’sti sāmagryaḥ pracchannāhaṃ vasāmi ca || 120 || kathaṃkāraṃ tvaduktaṃ vai pūjanaṃ tu mayā bhavet | icchāmyahaṃ śubhaṃ janma vivāhaṃ ca sutaṃ harim || 121 || durlabhaṃ tadvinā pūjā tādṛśī syānna cepsitam | ityuktvā bhagnahṛdayā sāśrukaṇṭhā babhūva sā || 1 22|| ekādaśyā vrataṃ kāryamiti saṃkalpya śocati | smṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bālā tvaśrūṇi muñcati || 123|| tāvat kṛpānidhistatra harirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam | kṛpāṃ kṛtvā dundubheragrataḥ suprakaṭo’bhavat || 1 24|| pramārjyāśrūṇi kanyāyāḥ prāha mātarnamāmyaham | śokaṃ mā kuru pūjyāsi yatheṣṭaṃ pradadāmyaham || 1 25|| bhāvenāsmi sadā tuṣṭo nābhāve tu kadācana | tava bhāvena santuṣṭo dadāmi vṛṇu tadvaram || 1 26|| arcyate bhāvahīnena sahasravastubhiryadi | na santuṣṭo bhavāmyatra bhāvahīne’rthasādhake || 127|| patrapuṣpajalaiścāpi bhāvabhaktyā madarcanam | mama santoṣakṛt tatsyād bhāvasya kṣudhito’smyaham || 128|| aṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyopacārairapi hārdikaiḥ | mātaḥ sampūjaya tvaṃ māṃ dhyānamātreṇa cāntare || 1 29|| mānasaṃ pūjanaṃ te’haṃ svīkariṣye’tibhāvataḥ | phalaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ te dāsye hyadyatanavratasya vai || 1 3 0|| ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | nanāma pādayormūrtermātṛbhāvena putravat || 131 || mātā śokaṃ vihāyaiva prasannābhūt hṛdantare | provāca śanakaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ janma cecchāmi laukikam || 13 2|| dharmeṇa patinā sākaṃ lagnamicchāmi vaidikam | aṃke lālayituṃ putraṃ sutaṃ cecchāmyalaukikam || 133 || alaukikastvamevāsi vaktuṃ notsahate manaḥ | niveditaṃ hṛdayyaṃ me yathecchasi tathā kuru || 1 34|| ityādiṣṭo hariḥ svābhilaṣitaṃ priyamuttamam | mūrtermukhātsamākarṇya jaharṣa bhāvijanmadhṛk || 1 35 || uvācātiprasannaḥ san sarvaṃ mātarbhaviṣyati | iṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ kariṣye’haṃ dadāmi vacanaṃ tu te || 136 || gaccha dakṣagṛhaṃ mūrte dharmamāpṛcchya satpatim | bhava putrī tu dakṣasya sa te dharmāya dāsyati || 1 37|| ahaṃ bālasvarūpeṇa saha bhrātrā tvadaṃkake | grahīṣyāmi janu mātaḥ śvo yāhi tvaṃ vratottaram || 138 || mānasī tvaṃ hi dakṣasya putrī vai bhāvinī tataḥ | dharmo vivāhya mātastvāṃ himaśaile nivatsyati || 13 9|| ahaṃ te mānasastatra caturātmā sutaḥ svayam | naro nārāyaṇaśceti hariḥ kṛṣṇaśca te gṛhe || 140 || ramiṣye sukhado brahmavrataṃ saṃdhārayan sadā | lokakalyāṇasaṃkalpaṃ pūrayastava sannidhau || 141 || ityuktvā ca punarnatvā tiro’bhūtpuruṣottamaḥ | mūrtiścāpi vrataṃ kṛtvārcanaṃ tatra ca mānasam || 1 42|| dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kṛtvā prātaḥ kṛtvārcanaṃ hṛdi | dharmadevasya saṃgṛhya śubhājñāṃ dakṣasadgraham || 143 || yayau jajñe ca saṃkalpādasiknyāṃ mānasī sutā | śraddhāmaitryādikāścānyā dvādaśāpi prajajñire || 144|| trayodaśāpi dakṣeṇa dattā dharmāya putrikāḥ | mūrterjātā naro nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo haristathā || 145|| lokānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya kurvantastapa uttamam | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi māse vai puruṣottame || 146 || vratasaṃkalpamātreṇa pūrṇaṃ vrataphalaṃ bhavet | kiṃ punaḥ sāṃgavidhinā kartuḥ phale’vaśiṣyate || 147|| tasmādekādaśītulyaṃ vrataṃ nānyad bhaviṣyati | śāśvatākṣayasatpuṇyapradaṃ mokṣapradaṃ tathā || 148 || yathālabdhopacāraistu prātaḥ saṃkalpya pūjanam | vrataṃ cāpi kariṣyanti teṣāṃ gṛheṣvahaṃ sadā || 149|| vatsyāmyeva na sandehastadbhaktyā vaśyatāṃ gataḥ | sukhayiṣye suto bhūtvā vratinau dampatī kulam || 150|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye dharmadevasya bhāvyaṃganayā mūrtyādhimāsaikādaśyāmaṣṭottaraśatamānasopacārairnārāyaṇapūjana vrate kṛte sati mūrterdakṣagṛhe janma dharmeṇa saha vivāhastato himālaye naro nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo hariścetiputracatuṣṭayaphalalābhaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||1.303 ||
<1.304> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi paraṃbrahma sarvāvirbhāvaśaktikṛt | puruṣottamasaṃjño’sau savitā jagataḥ patiḥ || 1 || svayaṃ kṛṣṇasvarūpaśca rādhāṃ svasmāt prasṛṣṭavān | rādhā kṛṣṇātmikā śaktiḥ sādhikā bhaktakarmaṇām || 2 || kṛṣṇasya savituḥ śaktiḥ prasūte sucarācaram | sā rādhā kṛṣṇasevāyāṃ goloke nityamasti hi || 3 || svaprasūtasya lokasya prasavārthaṃ nirantaram | aicchad rūpāntaraṃ dhartuṃ tāvat kanyā vyajāyata || 4 || sā tu nāmnā kṛtā kanyā sāvitrī prasavapradā | goloke rādhayā sākaṃ ramate nijamandire || 5 || surūpā divyasāmarthyayuktā lokamanoharā | yatheṣṭasiddhisampannā guptaiśvaryādiśālinī || 6 || yadā rādhā svayaṃ kṛṣṇasevāyāṃ samavartate | tadā kanyā tu sāvitrī samādhau samatiṣṭhati || 7 || ātmani ramate nityamātmānandamayī prasūḥ | ātmasukhātisaṃmagnā dhyāyati brahma vai param || 8 || yogābhyāsabalājjanmasiddhyā tvaicchad vilokitum | brahmaṇaḥ kīdṛśaṃ rūpaṃ kati vā santi tāni ca || 9 || kutra kutra ca vartante kiṃ kāryāṇi vasanti ca | tadaiśvaryāṇi teṣāṃ ca kīdṛśyo vai vibhūtayaḥ || 10 || ityetatsarvamājñātuṃ prāṇānsaṃkucya cātmani | avātaracchanairmūlādhāracakre tu yoginī || 11 || atra sthitvā gaṇapatau saṃyamaṃ sā cakāra ha | tenāsaṃkhyagaṇeśānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇāṃśasvarūpiṇām || 12|| brahmāṇḍeṣu tvananteṣu dhāmānyālokya sundarī | gudāmūlasthitaṃ cakraṃ parityajyāgramāyayau || 13 || svādhiṣṭhānābhidhaṃ cakraṃ saṃyamārthaṃ dadhāra sā | tatra prajāpatau sthitvā saṃyamaṃ sā cakāra ha || 14|| tenāsaṃkhyaprajeśānāṃ parabrahmasvarūpiṇām | brahmāṇḍeṣu tvananteṣu dhāmāni vīkṣya sundarī || 15|| nābhikandasthitaṃ maṇipuraṃ cakraṃ jagāma sā | tatra sthitvā tu sarpiṇyāṃ saṃyamaṃ sā vidhāya ca || 16|| ūrdhvamukhyāṃ praviveśāsaṃkhyalokeṣu sundarī | tasmād yānti mahānāḍyastejomayyo’pyasaṃkhyakāḥ || 17|| kāścitpātālalokām̐śca kāścillokācalātigān | kāścitsvargādisatyāntān kāścidāvaraṇādikān || 18|| kāścidīśvaralokām̐śca kāścidbrahmagṛhānapi | yā yā yadyat sthalaṃ yānti tattanmārgeṇa sundarī || 19|| jagāma bahulokeṣu vilokya divyabhūmikāḥ | brāhmāṇḍikavibhūtīśca punarāgatya tatsthalam ||20 || jagāmordhvaṃ ca hṛdaye cakramanāhatābhidham | tatra vai praṇavaṃ śrutvā cakre brahmaṇi saṃyamam ||21|| yadātmā cāpyantarātmā brahmātmā khyāyate svayam | tatra kṛtena sāvitrī saṃyamenaiśvarīkṛtau ||22|| vairājeṣu bhaumaneṣu vaiṣṇaveṣu ca dhāmasu | prākṛteṣu tayā sādāśaiveṣvāvaraṇeṣu ca ||23|| tattaddhāmasu sāvitrī vilokya divyabhūmikāḥ | tatsthalaṃ punarāgatya yayāvūrdhvaṃ tu kaṇṭhagam ||24|| viśuddhaṃ cakrameveyaṃ cakre vai saṃyamaṃ balāt | vāsudeve’niruddhe ca pradyumne ca sukarṣaṇe ||25|| vilokya racanāsteṣāṃ dhāmnāṃ dhāmavibhūtikāḥ | kaṇṭhaṃ deśaṃ punarāyādūrdhvaṃ ca bhrūkuṭau tu sā ||26|| gatvājñācakramāsādya cakāra saṃyamaṃ śanaiḥ | dṛṣṭastatra guruḥ sākṣāt parabrahmātmakastayā ||27|| lokasaṃcālanārthāya jāto yo viśvasṛḍ vibhuḥ | parabrahmasvarūpād yaḥ prāvirbabhūva vedakṛt ||28|| sarvalokagururbrahmā prajānāṃ yaḥ pitāmahaḥ | tasyāṃke tu sthitāṃ divyāṃ svāṃ sāvitrī vilokya vai ||29|| vedhaḥpatnīṃ viniścitya jaharṣātīva sundarī | kṣaṇaṃ vicārayāmāsa yāhaṃ golokavāsinī ||30|| bhavāmyadya kathaṃ cātra māṃ paśyāmyaṃkasaṃsthitām | ajasakthigataṃ yanme rūpaṃ tatkuta āgatam || 3 1|| yadahaṃ saṃprapaśyāmi māṃ vadhūrūpiṇīṃ tviha | pitāmahīṃ ca tatsarvaṃ pṛcchāmyatraiva kāraṇam ||32|| iti praṣṭuṃ yayāvagre tāvat tirobabhūva sā | pitāmahyā samākṛṣṭā līnā babhūva sundarī ||33|| tāvatsamādhitaśceyaṃ sāvitrī bahirāyayau | kva golokasthitā kanyā kvājāṃkasthā pitāmahī ||34|| ityāścaryānvitā kanyā dṛṣṭārthasya viniścayam | sasaṃbhramā yayau kartuṃ rādhikā yatra rājate ||35|| sāvitryā svapradṛṣṭārtho rādhikāyai niveditaḥ | śrutvā rādhā tu tāṃ prāha kanye tvaṃ matsvarūpiṇī ||36|| vartase brahmaśaktiśca brahmārthe jātavigrahā | jagatprasūsvarūpā yā māyāśaktiḥ parā matā ||37|| sāhaṃ sā tvaṃ ca sāvitrī sūyamānā jagatprasūḥ | brahmapatnī brahmatanvī brahmaṇo’rthe vinirmitā ||38|| pitāmahena saṃpṛktā nityaṃ jagatpitāmahī | vartase’nādikālatvāt pratyajaṃ tu navā navā ||39|| bhavasi tvaṃ mahāmāye kanyakā matsvarūpataḥ | athārādhaya taṃ devaṃ prāpsyase tapaso balāt ||40|| ityāśrutya tu sāvitrī brahmaprāptiṃ vyacintayat | tāvattatra dvādaśikādine prātaḥ samaśṛṇot ||41 || dundubhiṃ devadevasya ghoṣayantaṃ kṛpāvacaḥ | adhimāsavrataṃ devyaḥ kurvantu mānasapradam |||42|| hṛdi dṛṣṭaṃ bahirdṛṣṭaṃ loke lokāntare’pi vā | dinaikavratamātreṇa dāsyate puruṣottamaḥ |||43|| anantaguṇakaṃ puṇyamadyāsti harivāsaraḥ | trispṛśāvratatastvadya sahasraguṇakaṃ phalam ||44|| yatheṣṭaṃ labhyate kṛtvā hyekabhuktaṃ ca naktakam | phalāhāraṃ ca vā dugdhapānaṃ dadhiprabhojanam ||45|| jalāhāraṃ ca vā ghṛtāhāraṃ tilādanaṃ ca vā | yavāhāraṃ ca vā śākāhāraṃ kandādanaṃ ca vā ||46|| bharjitādanamathavā vrataṃ patrādanaṃ tu vā | puṣpādanaṃ niradanaṃ pavanādanameva vā ||47|| dhūmrādanaṃ ca vā bāṣpādanaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ śubham | dvādaśyāmadhimāse’tra labhantāṃ śāśvataṃ sukham ||48|| brahmaparaṃ tathā brahma golokaṃ cāmṛtaṃ padam | avyākṛtaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ māyālokaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ||49|| sadāśivapadaṃ vāpi bhūmasāmrājyameva vā | śrīpuraṃ cāpi vairājyaṃ hairaṇyagārbhikaṃ ca vā ||50|| bhaumādyāvaraṇe dhāmānyarjayantu vratena vai | satyaṃ vā brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ vahnervā sauryameva vā ||5 1|| cāndramasaṃ ca vā sthānaṃ nākṣatraṃ grāhameva vā | aindraṃ ca vāruṇaṃ sthānaṃ yāmyaṃ kauberameva vā ||52|| aiśānaṃ pāvanaṃ vāpi nairṛtaṃ tārakaṃ ca vā | bhuvo rājyaṃ ca vā bhaumaṃ cātaleyādikaṃ nu vā ||53 || āvaraṇāni divyāni devarājyāni vaibhavān | kaumāraṃ brāhmacaryaṃ vā yaugaṃ vātmapadaṃ śubham |||54|| śvetadvīpādikaṃ cātha sāmudraṃ cāntarīkṣagam | rājyaṃ sārvabhaumaṃ vā sāmrājyaṃ vāpi mānavam ||55||| maunamārṣaṃ ca paitrādyaiśvaraṃ vā bahusiddhikam | strīrājyaṃ vāpi kailāsaṃ kāmarājyaṃ ca śāśvatam ||56|| pātivratyaṃ paraṃ rājyaṃ svāmisevātmakaṃ ca vā | patnīmattvaṃ patimattvaṃ putraputrīsusampadaḥ ||||57||| ārogyaṃ ca dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ rasāyanaṃ ca kāyikam | yadyadicched vratī tvadya dvādaśyāṃ harivāsare ||58|| tatsarvaṃ pradadāmyasmai vadāmi puruṣottamaḥ | adya me pūjanaṃ kuryāt prātaḥ snātvā gṛhāntare |||59||| sthitvā dhyānaṃ ca me kuryāt kuryādāvāhanādikam | pañcāmṛtaiśca me snānaṃ śuddhodāplavanaṃ tathā ||60|| nirvartayettato vastrabhūṣācandanamarpayet | yathāśakti prakuryācca dhūpadīpābhivandanam ||61|| naivedye phalamūlādyaṃ miṣṭānnānyathavārpayet | jāmbūlaṃ jalapānaṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ namaṇaṃ caret ||62|| pradakṣiṇaṃ stutiṃ cārārtrikaṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ dadet | kuṃkumākṣatatulasīphalairarghyaṃ samarpayet ||63|| punarnatvā punaḥ smṛtvā prārthayet sveṣṭavastukam | vrataṃ cāpi prapūrṇaṃ syāt tava keśavapūjanāt ||64|| kṣamāpayettathā stutyā mūrtiṃ tu kānakīṃ hareḥ | kramākramau na viditau na jñātaṃ tvadabhīṣṭakam ||65|| yathābuddhi mayā premṇā kṛtaṃ nyūne kṣamāṃ kuru | adhimāso’si deveśa hyadhivarṣākara prabho ||66|| arthināmadhikaṃ ceṣṭaṃ dadāsi puruṣottama | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo pārvatīśa prabheśvara ||67|| lakṣmīśa māṇikīnātha sāvitrīśa jagatprabhoḥ | viśvasṛḍ rādhikākānta kamalākānta keśava || 68|| dvādaśyāṃ me vratenādya mānaseṣṭaṃ prapūraya | ityabhyarthya hariṃ natvā prātarmadhye niśīthake ||69|| bhūtvā tanmaya evāpi tatsamarpitasatkriyaḥ | rañjayennṛtyagītaiśca savādyena visarjayet ||70|| iti kṛtvā vrataṃ samyagarcanaṃ vratakṛjjanaḥ | naro nārī kumārī vā kumāro devatāthavā ||7 1|| sureśvarī ca vā pitṛkoṭikā muniyoṣitaḥ | pātālavāsinī yadvā tādṛśā naravargiṇaḥ |||72||| īśvarā īśvarāṇyaśca muktā muktānya eva vā | yadicchanti tvāpnuvanti pratijāne na saṃśayaḥ ||73|| yathāśakti yathākāryaṃ vrataṃ ca pūjanaṃ mama | bāhyābhāve hṛdi me’pi bhāvabhinnaṃ supūjanam ||74|| kuryāttasyāpi bhāvena premṇā tuṣṭo dadāmyaham | adyādhimāsake tvasmi kṛpāvarṣī pareśvara ||75|| na bhūto na bhaviṣyāmi yathādya vṛṣṭikṛttathā | tasmānme kṛpayā bhaktāḥ kṛtvā kiñcidatho vratam ||76|| labhantāṃ śāśvataṃ puṇyaṃ sukhaṃ lokaṃ ca hṛdgatam | iti śrutvā tu sāvitrī jaharṣa cāti sundarī ||77|| natvā sā dundubhiṃ prāha śṛṇu daivākṛte kṛtin | mayā samādhau brahmā vai parameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ ||78|| dṛṣṭastasya ca vāmeṃ’ke sāvitrī ca niṣeduṣī | matsvarūpā mayā dṛṣṭā tasyāṃ lilye’pyahaṃ tadā ||79|| punaścāhaṃ samādherutthitāsmyatra kumārikā | viśvasraṣṭā patiḥ soyaṃ prāptavyo mānase sthitaḥ ||80 || ato’dhimāsadvādaśyāmekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ mama | pūjanaṃ devadevasyācariṣyāmi yathābalam ||8 1|| anena me śarīreṇa prāptistasya tu durlabhā | nityagolokadhāmnaśca vibhūterme’sti varṣma yat ||82|| tasyāsti tattvajaṃ vairājātmajaṃ varṣma sañcitam | tasmānme brahmaṇo yogo yathā yena ca varṣmaṇā ||83|| jāyeta tattathā brūhi karomi dvādaśīvratam | iti śrutvā dundubhiśca tāmāha puruṣottamaḥ ||84|| śṛṇu sāvitri subhage hyadya śrīpuruṣottamam | vahniputrasuvarṇasya mūrtirūpaṃ vidhāpaya ||85|| lakṣmīṃ tathā suvarṇasya mūrtirūpāṃ vidhāpaya | brahmāṇaṃ ca tathā tasya sāvitrīṃ kānakaṃ kuru ||86 || pūjayitvā yathāśakti dāna kuru supātrake | ityevaṃ vai vrate tvadya pūjanaṃ dānamityapi ||87 || kuru tena prasannaḥ sa śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | sarvaṃ vidhāsyate te’rthaṃ mā cintāṃ kuru kanyake ||88|| iti śrutvā tu sāvitryā vrate vai dvādaśīprage | yogabalena sauvarṇaṃ merorbhāgāt samarjitam ||89|| aiśvaryeṇa ca tatraiva lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ ca sā | brahmāṇaṃ cāpi sāvitrīṃ sauvarṇīṃ mūrtimeva ha ||90 || kṛtvā tvāvāhya saṃsnāpya bhūṣayitvā prapūjya ca | bhojayitvā pāyayitvā prārthya nīrājanaṃ vyadhāt ||9 1 || kṣamāpayitvā saṃstūya nivedyārthaṃ ca hṛdgatam | visarjayati yāvattāndevām̐stāvaddhariḥ svayam ||92|| prādurbabhūva sāvitryāstvagre lakṣmīyutaḥ prabhuḥ | prasannavadanaḥ sarvaśobhāḍhyo varadānadaḥ ||93|| prāhāsyai vada kalyāṇi kiṃ te manasi vartate | sāvitrī prāha deveśaṃ dehi yogaṃ tu vedhasaḥ || 94|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha jātaṃ te manasi sthitam | netre pramīlya maddhyānaṃ kuru sāvitri vai kṣaṇam ||95|| tāvatte mānasaṃ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati karāgatam | nārāyaṇena yatproktaṃ tathaivācaradādarāt ||96|| tāvannārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo vyalīyata hi tatkṣaṇam | atha prātaḥ prapūjyaivaṃ madhyāhne’pi tathākarot ||97|| sāyaṃ cāpi tathā pūjāmakarojjāgaraṃ tathā | dolāyāṃ tāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ tathā hyajam ||98|| sāvitrīṃ ca nidhāyaiva kanyakāndolayanmuhuḥ | tāvatprāha punastatrāgatya śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||99|| devi puṣpāñjaliṃ datvā datvā cārghyaṃ phalaṃ jalam | visarjanaṃ kuru me’tra gacchāmyakṣaradhāma yat || 100 || tvaṃ yāhyadyaiva vairājaṃ yasmād brahmā vyajāyata | vairāje sūkṣmarūpeṇa praviśa tvaṃ purā tataḥ || 101 || vairājamānasī putrī tannābherbhava kanyake | jātamātrā yuvatīṃ tvāṃ vairājo’jāya dāsyati || 1 02|| vidhinā tvaiśvareṇaiva karmaṇā tvāṃ niyokṣyate | kalyāṇi gaccha te svasti saubhāgyaṃ śāśvataṃ bhavet || 103|| ityuktvā śrīharirnārāyaṇastatra tiro’bhavat | sāvitrīśrīharemūrtyai puṣpāñjaliṃ pradāya ca || 1 04|| arghyaṃ ca śrīphalaṃ prārpyākarod devavisarjanam | dānaṃ dadau suvarṇasya mūrtīnāṃ brahmavarcase || 105|| patnīvratākhyagurave golokadhāmavāsine | āśiṣaṃ ca tataḥ prāpya bhava saubhāgyasundarī || 106 || brahmapatnī jagatāṃ ca prasavitrī bhaveti ca | rādhāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tato natvā drāgevādṛśyatāṃ yayau || 1 07|| vairāje praviveśāsya nābhināle samudgatā | prasavaṃ prāpya kanyā sā sāvitrī yuvatī tadā || 1 08|| jātamātrābhavattāṃ ca viditvā brahmaṇaḥ kṛte | samutpannāṃ dadau ceśasamāje vidhinā virāṭ || 109 || brahmaṇe caturāsyāya sāpi pūrṇamanorathā | jaganmātābhavatprāpya brahmāṇaṃ patimīśvaram || 110 || iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi dvādaśīvratakāraṇāt | sāvitryā brahmapatnītvaṃ yathājātaṃ tadiṣṭadam || 111 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye rādhikāyā mūrtantarasāvitryā samādhau jīveśabrahmasṛṣṭivilokane vedhasoṃ’ke svasthitiṃ dṛṣṭvā patnīrūpeṇa vedhaḥprāptīcchayā cintane dundubhiśravaṇe dvādaśīvratena vairājaputryā tayā brahmā patiḥ prāpta ityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.304 ||
<1.305> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi brahmaṇastu putrīṇāṃ prāk catasṛṇām | trayodaśyā adhimāse vratena puruṣottamaḥ || 1 || svayaṃ patirabhūt tābhyo dadau dhāmākṣaraṃ gṛham | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ dadau tābhyaḥ śāśvatīṃ kṛpayā prabhuḥ || 2 || ādye kṛte yuge lakṣmi sṛṣṭyarthaṃ brahmaṇā purā | bālāḥ sanakasanandasanātanasanadbhidhāḥ || 3 || sṛṣṭāścatvāra aiśvaryabalatejaḥsamanvitāḥ | dāmpatyarthe ca teṣāṃ vai catasraḥ śaktayaḥ kṛtāḥ || 4 || nāmnā jayā ca lalitā pāravatī prabhā śubhāḥ | sadṛśāste sadṛśyastāḥ mānasyo mānasāśca te || 5 || kṛtvā caturyugalāni prasanno’bhūdatīva saḥ | jātamātrāṇi caitāni vijñānavanti vīkṣya vai || 6 || niyoktuṃ sṛṣṭikārye tān pratyekaṃ prāha viśvasṛṭ | sanaka tvaṃ gṛhāṇaināṃ jayāṃ tvadarthakalpitām || 7 || sanandana gṛhāṇaināṃ lalitāṃ te prakalpitām | sanātana gṛhāṇaināṃ dattā pāravatīṃ ca te || 8 || sanat gṛhāṇa te dattāṃ prabhāṃ sahacarīṃ kuru | yugalaṃ yugalaṃ bhūtvā catvāri yugalāni vai || 9 || sṛjantu mānasīṃ sṛṣṭiṃ sarvā yugalarūpiṇīm | golokādīdṛśī prāptā gṛhadharmaparamparā || 10 || vaikuṇṭhe’pi tathā dṛṣṭā gṛhadharmaparamparā | vayaṃ kṛṣṇājñayā gṛhyān dharmān gṛhṇīma ādarāt || 1 1|| tathā putrā bhavanto’pi gṛhītvā pitṛsammatān | gṛhadharmān pālayitvā bhavantu sukhino’tra vai || 12|| niyujya bhavataḥ sṛṣṭikārye’pyahaṃ manāk punaḥ | sṛṣṭibhāreṇa rahito bhavāmīti kṛtārthakaḥ || 13|| gṛhadharme sadā putrā vaṃśā bhavanti tārakāḥ | gṛhadharme yoṣito’pi bhavanti sukhadāyikāḥ || 14|| gṛhadharme yajñayāgakriyā jāyanta ādarāt | atitheḥ pūjanaṃ devapūjanaṃ sādhupūjanam || 15|| satkāro’nyāśramiṇāṃ dyupradaṃ dānaṃ ca jāyate | kāmadharmo’pyavitaḥ syādarthaścopārjito bhavet || 16 || puruṣārthatrayaṃ mokṣaḥ paścāllabhyeta śāśvataḥ | gṛhadharmaṃ vinā guṇapravāhaviramo na vai || 17|| bālye vā yauvane jñānaṃ jāyate na virāmadam | tasmād bhogaṃ pradāyaiva mānasaṃ vai praśāntayet || 18|| praśāntamānasānāṃ tu mokṣo bhavati śāśvataḥ | tasmāt kurvantu kāryāṇi sṛṣṭidhrauvyāṇi putrakāḥ || 19|| iti vai brahmaṇaḥ śrutvā vaco viśvasṛjaḥ sutāḥ | catvāraḥ pūrvata eva jñānino yoginastathā ||20 || brahmavettāra evaite mokṣamarthe viniścitāḥ | na karmaṇā bhavenmokṣaḥ karma vai bandhanaṃ pitaḥ ||21|| tatrāpi gṛhyakarmāṇi bandhanānyeva santi vai | nārīdharmo vinivṛtteḥ kāraṇaṃ jāyate nahi || 22|| karmottaraṃ punaḥ karma kārayatyeva rāgataḥ | dharmārthakāmanāstatra sāntā bhavanti naiva hi ||23|| vinā jñānaṃ pitastasmād gṛhadharmo bhayāvahaḥ | gṛhadharmo bhārarūpo yathā tyaktuṃ tvayeṣyate ||24|| tathāsmābhiśca taṃ voḍhumādyato naiva ceṣyate | putrā yat tārakāḥ proktāstārakaṃ jñānameva ha ||25 || tadvai putrābhidhānaṃ syāt jñānināṃ yogināṃ tathā | karmiṇāṃ tu sutāḥ putrā na cikīrṣālayātmanām ||26 || vaṃśastu brahmavijñāni muktāḥ santo bhavantu naḥ | brahmamārgapradeṣṭāro brahmalokanivāsinaḥ ||27|| adhruvasyānvayasyārthe kariṣyāmo na gṛhyakam | yoṣitsaṃgo bahī ramyaḥ pariṇāme’ntare’sukhaḥ ||28|| kastāṃ seveta tattvajñaḥ sukhaṃ naijaṃ vihāya vai | ātmasukhaṃ paraṃ proktaṃ tadanyatsukhamantakṛt ||29 || gṛhadharme yajñayāgā ye tu proktāḥ pitāmaha | brahmārādhanakāryasya kūlayāpi samā na te ||30|| brahmārādhanamevātra kraturno jñānināṃ mataḥ | kṛte brahmārādhane tu kṛtamātithyapūjanam ||3 1|| kṛtaṃ ca devapūjādi kṛtaṃ sādhuprapūjanam | satkṛte tu harau nityaṃ satkṛtaṃ sarvameva ha ||32|| dānaṃ tu brahmavijñānaṃ kṛtaṃ syācchāśvataṃ pitaḥ | svarge tallabhyamevānyanmokṣasthānaṃ tadeva ha ||33|| yanna duḥkhādisaṃbhinnaṃ na cānte grasyate tu yat | satyasaṃkalpalabdhikṛt tatsvarge śāśvataṃ padam || 34|| kāladharmaḥ satṛṣṇasya nātmārāmasya kasyacit | arthaścānnajalavastrairnānyairarthaiḥ prayojanam ||35|| evaṃ vai vartamānasya mokṣaḥ karatale sthitaḥ | gṛhadharmeṇa guṇakṛtpravāhasya visarjanam ||36|| āśāmātraṃ praboddhavyaṃ magnā vai guṇadharmiṇaḥ | yeṣāṃ bālyaṃ na vai cāsti yauvanaṃ tvāgataṃ nahi ||37|| sarvadātmani cāstyeva virāmo bhogavarjitaḥ | mānasaṃ brahmaṇā samyag rañjitaṃ śāntivigraham ||38|| teṣāṃ mokṣaḥ sadehe vā videhe vā na śiṣyate | sadā muktaḥ sa vai proktaḥ sadā muktaḥ sa vai mataḥ ||39|| harṣāmarṣabhayodvegairaspṛṣṭo mukta eva saḥ | tasmānnārhā vayaṃ sṛṣṭau vayaṃ brahmādhikāriṇaḥ ||40|| nirdvandvā dvandva śūnyām̐śca kariṣyāmo’parānapi | ayaṃ vai pitṛtatpitṛpitṛpitṛpituḥ pituḥ ||41 || puruṣottamasaṃjñasya dharmo’styupaniṣanmayaḥ | yāsyāmo yena puratastasyaiva paramātmanaḥ ||42|| yadvai paścātprakartavyaṃ tadadyaiva vidhīyatām | yadi syāt tadvidhānasya sādhanaṃ svīyakośagam ||43|| asmākaṃ tu pituścānugraheṇātmani saṃyamaḥ | sahottha eva sukhado vartate mokṣasādhakaḥ ||44|| tasmādābālyato mokṣe vatsyāmo nānyathā pitaḥ | asmanmokṣe tava mokṣo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||45|| vayaṃ putrāstārakāḥ smo yathārthā iti viddhi vai | imāḥ kanyāstu yoginyo jñānavijñānamūrtayaḥ ||46|| brahmaiva saṃprapatsyante svalpakālena mā śucaḥ | iti saṃbhāṣya putrāste yayurviṣṇupadīṃ prati ||47|| jayā ca lalitā pāravatī prabheti kanyakāḥ | adhyātmayogasampannāḥ sasmaruḥ puruṣottamam ||48|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tvārādhayāmāsuḥ sadādarāt | japaṃ cakruḥ oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te namaḥ ||49|| evaṃ vai vartamānābhirghoṣaṇā dundubheḥ śrutā | satyaloke trayodaśyāṃ prātareva kṛpāmayī ||5 0 || yā kācid brahmasampannā yadvā brahmaviyoginī | sadyojātā kumārī vā varārohā virāgiṇī ||5 1 || sthavīrā vā subhagā vā suvāsinī vivāsinī | sarāgā vātmarāgā vā kaivalyehāvatī ca vā ||5 2 || anāthā vā sanāthā vā saṃskṛtā vāpyasaṃskṛtā | susthānā vākṛtasthānāthavā prasthānaśālinī ||53 || vāgdānā vāpyadānā vā dānārhā dānavarjitā | dānārthe nirmitā cāpi kuryāt trayodaśīvratam || 54|| tāsāmabhīṣṭadātāsmi śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | adhimāse’tra yasyai yannavaṃ navamapekṣyate ||55 || agamyaṃ vā sugamyaṃ vā labhyaṃ cālabhyamityapi | puṇyalabhyaṃ dravyalabhyaṃ labhyaṃ yatsādhanairapi ||56|| atarkyaṃ vā pratarkyaṃ vā śāśvataṃ cādhruvaṃ tathā | bhogyaṃ cābhogyamevānyad yadyad vāñchati yā hṛdi ||57 || tattatsarvaṃ pradāsye’haṃ prasannaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | trayodaśyāṃ kṛtenaikabhuktena ca vratena vai ||58|| niśīthabhojanenaiva phalāhāreṇa vā vratam | kuryādvai śraddhayā yukta mama pūjanapūrvakam ||59|| tasyā netā gamayitā trātā poṣṭā ca bhadrakṛt | āśrayadastathā tvānandayitāsmi pareśvaraḥ || 60 || narā nāryo’thavā cānye pūjayantyadhimāsake | trayodaśyāṃ candanādyairyatheṣṭaṃ vitarāmyaham || 61 || aṣṭottaraśatenāpi ṣaṭpaṃcāśadbhireva vā | dvātriṃśadbhiścopacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśādyaiśca vastubhiḥ ||6 2 || yathālabdhaiśca vā patrapuṣpajalānnataṇḍulaiḥ | mānasairvā pūjayantu premopāyanakaiśca mām ||6 3 || puṣpāṃjaliṃ ca vā premāṃjaliṃ dadatu me janāḥ | teṣāmapi kariṣyāmi mānasaṃ dānapūritam || 6 4|| mā saṃkocaṃ prakurvantu vadantu dhārayantu vā | saṃkalpayantu hṛdye vitariṣyāmyadhivrate || 65 || śrutvaivaṃ dundubhiṃ prātastrayodaśyāṃ hariśritam | jayā ca lalitā tatrāyayuḥ pāravatī prabhā ||6 6 || nemustaṃ dundubhiṃ cātha papracchuḥ kiṃ dadāsi vai | dundubhiḥ prāha nākaṃ vā dadāmi puruṣottamam || 67|| trayodaśīvratamūlyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim | dadāmi saṃpadastasya dhāmāpyakṣarasaṃjñitam ||68 || adhimāse’dhikadātā bhavāmi svalpake vrate | prakaṭo’hamadhimāsātmako’smi sṛṣṭimaṇḍale || 6 9|| svarge satyaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ vairājaṃ bhaumanaṃ dhruvam | golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ dadāmi brahmaśāśvatam ||7 0 || bhavatyaḥ kinnu vāñchanti dadāmi vratasatphalam | śrutvā tadā catasrastāḥ prāhustaṃ dundubhiṃ mudā ||7 1 || jātamātrā vayaṃ sarvā asaṃskṛtāḥ sma vai tataḥ | saṃskṛtāḥ syāma kṛṣṇena saṃgatā dhāma saṃgatāḥ ||72|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so’smānavāpnotu pareśvaraḥ | dāsyastasya bhavāmo’dya vratenecchāma eva tat ||73 || dundubhiśca tadā prāha bhavatyaścādya vai mudā | snātvā prātaścārcayantu sauvarṇaṃ puruṣottamam || 74|| yathālabdhopacāraiśca mānasairbhāvagarbhitaiḥ | premakṣudhāśrayaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo grahīṣyati ||79|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇayogyā yūyaṃ stha divyavigrahāḥ | kṛtvā vratārcane tvadya prāpnuvantu hariṃ varam ||76|| ityuktvā dundubhistasmāt sthānādanyatra vai yayau | jayā ca lalitā cakruḥ pāravatī vrataṃ prabhā ||77|| tāstu snātvā gṛhaṃ gatvā kṛtvā maṇḍapamuttamam | trayodaśyāṃ prātareva pupūjuḥ puruṣottamam ||78|| madhye siṃhāsanaṃ kṛtvā kānakīṃ pratimāṃ hareḥ | tatra vinyasya cāvāhya dadurjalādikaṃ mudā ||79|| pañcāmṛtajalaiḥ snānaṃ kārayitvāmbarāṇi ca | ābhūṣaṇāni sarvāṇi kuṃkumacandanādikam ||8 0 || dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalapuṣpaphalādikam | tāmbūlavyajanacchatracāmarārārtrikādikam ||8 1 || pradakṣiṇaṃ stutiṃ kṣāntiṃ cārghyaṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ daduḥ | devadeva hare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jagatprabho ||82|| dāsīnāṃ te karādānaṃ kuru smo dāsya eva ha | evaṃ saṃkalpya kusumāñjalīn sagadgadā daduḥ ||83 || madhyāhnepyevameveśa prapūjyābhojayan harim | sāyaṃ cāpi samarcyaiva cakrurnīrājanaṃ hareḥ ||84|| daduśca bhojanaṃ miṣṭaṃ tṛptastuṣṭau’bhavaddhariḥ | cakrustā jāgaraṃ rātrau naktaṃ kṛtvā hareḥ puraḥ ||85|| nanṛtustā jagurgītiṃ madhurāṃ tālamiśritām | tāvat prāvirbabhūveśaḥ śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ ||86|| catuḥsvarūpo bhagavān pratyekāṃ tāmupādade | catūrūpaiścatasrastā vāme nidhāya mālikāḥ ||87|| tābhirdattā nāmayitvā kaṃdharāṃ samupādade | prasannaśca muhustāśca pasparśāśliṣṭavān mudā ||88|| agamyaṃ cāvitarkyaṃ cābhūtaṃ cāvarṇyameva ca | tābhyo datvā sukhaṃ śīghraṃ nidhāya garuḍopari ||89|| natvā tu vedhasaṃ prāpya yautakaṃ cāśiṣastathā || vidhinā brahmaṇā tāśca nārāyaṇāya cārpitāḥ ||90|| vivāhayitvā prayayau kṛṣṇakāntaḥ svamandiram | yadakṣaraṃ paraṃ dhāma brahma vyāpakamuttamam ||91|| anyadhāmāni yasmādvai prāvirbhūtāni tadvaram | yayau tābhistu patnībhiḥ śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ ||92|| jayā ca lalitā pāravatī prabhāmbare pare | vyomni muktānya evaitā jātāḥ patnyo hareśca tāḥ ||93|| divyā divyapriyatulyā modante’kṣaradhāmagāḥ | evaṃ kṛtvā trayodaśyāṃ vrataṃ śrīpuruṣottame ||94|| māsi śrīkṛṣṇapūjāṃ ca kṛtvāvāpuḥ paraṃ padam | svalpasyāpi phalaṃ nityaṃ divyaṃ vai cāpyanantakam ||95|| śroṣyantīmaṃ paṭhiṣyantyadhyāyaṃ ye kṛṣṇamānasāḥ | teṣāmapi phalaṃ tadvad bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||96|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye catuḥsanakādikādyarthamutpāditānāṃ brahmaputrīṇāṃ jayālalitāpāravatīprabhābhidhānānāṃ puruṣottamamāsatrayodaśīvratenaśrīpuruṣottamadhāmni śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya patnītvaprāptiḥ sanakādīnāṃ tu vairāgyavṛttirityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.305 ||
<1.306> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pare tvādye vaikuṇṭhe prathame tu yat | sañjātaṃ vai caturdaśyāṃ caritraṃ dundubhestu yat || 1 || akṣarabrahmadhāmnastu sīmni saṃvidyate tu yat | vaikuṇṭhaṃ prathamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ gṛhaṃ golokasadṛśam || 2 || tatra yuktasvarūpā vai vasanti kalpaśākhinaḥ | tatputrī śrīḥ sadā tatra vartate vai kumārikā || 3 || divyabhūmisvarūpā ca divyā vibhūtirasti ca | cetanādhiṣṭhitā devī sarvādhārasvarūpiṇī || 4 || tasyā vibhūteḥ putrī ca māṇikyāsti kumārikā | divyadugdhāmṛtābdhiśca vaikuṇṭhe tatra vartate || 5 || tasya putrī kumārī ca lakṣmīstvadātmikāsti ca | tā etāstisra īśvaryo rājante dhāmni tatra vai || 6 || sakhyastisraḥ savayasyāḥ kumāryo’tīva komalāḥ | māṇikyā śrīśca lakṣmīśca brahmavetryo’bhavan sadā || 7 || brahmātmajñānayoginyo bhaktimatyaśca vai harau | kurvanti sevanaṃ nityaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tāḥ || 8 || tasyaiva pratimāṃ nityaṃ gṛhe dhyāyanti bhāvataḥ | divyavibhūtiḥ kalpadruḥ kṣīrābdhiśceti te trayaḥ || 9 || putrīṇāṃ dhyānasevādi dṛṣṭvā tuṣyanti vai muhuḥ | vitarantyāśiṣastābhyo bhavantyānandamūrtayaḥ || 10 || anantadhāmasu kṛṣṇapatnyaḥ santi tvanekaśaḥ | bhavatyaśca bhavantyeva parabrahmapriyāḥ parāḥ || 1 1|| rājādhirājarūpiṇyo yābhyo nānyāḥ parāḥ kvacit | iti pitrāśiṣaḥ prāptā dīvyanti nityavardhitāḥ || 12|| prātaḥ snānti hariṃ smṛtvā dhyāyanti ca hariṃ tataḥ | kurvanti maṇḍapaṃ divyaṃ vidyuttoraṇasūjjvalam || 1 3|| vicitraratnamaṇibhirnaddhastaṃbhādimaṇḍitam | kṛtrimodyānasaṃvyāptaṃ divyāmbaravibhūṣitam || 14|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtiśobhitaṃ sarvato diśi | madhye siṃhāsanaṃ ramyaṃ maṇisvarṇādirājitam || 15|| sthāpayanti ca tāstatra tūlikāśca sukhāvahāḥ | mūrtiṃ vinyasya tanmadhye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tāḥ || 16|| snāpayanti kṣīradhārābhiścādbhiḥ snāpayanti ca | sugandhaṃ candanaṃ tailaṃ mardayanti ca tā muhuḥ || 17|| snāpayitvā ca vastrāṇi divyāni dadati prage | dhārayanti vibhūṣāśca śṛgāraṃ dhārayanti ca || 18|| patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaistoyaiḥ pūjayanti muhurmuhuḥ | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ sugandhaṃ ca kurvanti kṛṣṇasannidhau || 1 9|| saṃvāhayanti caraṇau gṛhṇanti caraṇāmṛtam | jighranti tā bhaktimatyo gandhaṃ kṛṣṇaprasādajam ||20|| paśyanti tā hareḥ rūpaṃ spṛśanti kṛṣṇapatkajam | āsvādayanti pūjāyāṃ dattaṃ phalādikaṃ tu yat ||21 || śṛṇvanti bhagavatstotraṃ gītaṃ paraspareṇa yat | vadanti guṇacāritryaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tāḥ ||22|| ādadati hareḥ kārye gacchanti ca pradakṣiṇam | vilāsaṃ hāvabhāvādi tathānandaṃ ca mānasam ||23|| cintanaṃ nirṇayaṃ svatvaṃ kurvanti kṛṣṇayogajam | miṣṭānnāmṛtapātrāṇi jalapātrāṇi tatpuraḥ ||24|| svarṇasthālāni naivedyapūritāni daduśca tāḥ | bhojayanti bhāvapūrṇaṃ rāmayanti hariṃ punaḥ ||25|| vāripānaṃ kārayanti ramante tā hareḥ puraḥ | vādayanti pravādyāni kurvantyārārtrikaṃ mudā ||26|| namanti haraye tāśca praśaṃsanti ca tadguṇān | varṇayanti caritrāṇi kathayanti kathānakam ||27|| bhāvayanti kṛṣṇahṛccārpayanti hṛdayaṃ harau | puṣpāṃjalipradānaiśca toṣayanti narāyaṇam ||28|| stuvanti paramātmānaṃ smarantyapyabhidhā hareḥ | dāsyaṃ kurvanti satataṃ sakhyaṃ cātmanivedanam ||29|| evaṃ bhaktimayaṃ divyaṃ kartavyamācaranti tāḥ | madhyāhnepi prapūjyainaṃ śrīḥ phalānyarpayaṃtyapi ||30|| kalpadrukanyakā kalpapādapebhyo nayaṃtyapi | uttamaṃ cottamaṃ ramyaṃ surasaṃ miṣṭamamblakam ||3 1|| navaṃ navaṃ phalaṃ vṛkṣaputrī śrīrarpayatyapi | kadalāni supakvāni kadalībhyo’bhigṛhya sā ||32|| āhṛtya cāmravṛkṣebhyaścāmrāṇi tūttamāni ca | karmadebhyaḥ karmadāni cāmblamiṣṭānyavāpya ca ||33|| karkaṭikāśca vallībhya āhṛtya pakvasadrasāḥ | kaliṃgāni supakvāni śaityāvahāni yānyapi ||34|| kapitthāni ca taddrubhyaḥ pakvānyānīya cāpyatha | kājūphalāni miṣṭāni kājū drubhyo’bhihṛtya ca ||35|| kaṭīṅgudībhya āhṛtya kaṭīṅgundīphalāni ca | iṅgudāni mahāntyeva pakvasnigdharasāni ca ||36|| āhṛtyārpayati śrīśca bhuṃkte nārāyaṇaḥ svayam | aṃjīrāṇi sumiṣṭāni drākṣāṇi surasāni ca ||37|| kharjūrakhārikādīni tālāni śrīphalāni ca | bhūphalāni sumiṣṭāni cikkaṇāni phalāni ca ||38|| kṣīrikāṇi piśaṃgāni panasāni mahānti ca | garjarāṇi vividhāni ghṛtaghaṭāni caiva ha ||39|| śiṅgavaḥ pakvāstathā jambūphalāni rāvaṇāni ca | amṛtāni sumiṣṭāni ṭiṭīmā miṣṭasadrasāḥ ||40 || dāḍimāni cekṣudaṇḍān badarāṇi navāni ca | ṭimbūravām̐śca madhukān badāmān bahubījakān ||41|| rāmaphalāni ca sītāphalāni madhurāṇi ca | naspatīna santarām̐ścāpi jambīrāṇi ca puppinān ||42|| cirbhaṭāni ca saphalajanāni ṭimṭimāni ca | navaraṃgāni cānyāni phalānyāhṛtya śrīrdadau ||43|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya śrīpuruṣottamamūrtaye | bhagavānapi bhāvena samattiśryarpitāni vai ||44|| divyavibhūtikanyā tu māṇikyā bhagavatkṛte | samānayati ratnāni dhārayatyacyutaṃ svayam ||45|| ratnamālāstathā muktāhārān mauktikakaṃkaṇān | vajramaṇīn padmarāgamaṇīn marakatān maṇīn ||46|| indranīlamaṇīṃścāpi kaustubhān bhīṣmakām̐stathā | vaidūryānpuṣparāgām̐śca karketakān suvarṇakān ||47|| hāritān pulakām̐ścaiva rudhirān sphaṭikām̐stathā | vidrumām̐śca pravālām̐śca māṇikyān citrakām̐stathā ||48|| gomedām̐śca mahānīlān kūpyām̐ścādāya sandadau | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastāni maṇiratnamayāni ca ||49|| bhūṣaṇāni dhṛtavām̐śca prasanno’bhūdatīva saḥ | atha kṣīrābdhikanyā vai lakṣmīḥ kṣairāṇi bhāvukī ||50|| bhojanaṃ kārayāmāsa pāyayāmāsa tāni vai | dugdhasāraṃ pāyasānnaṃ dugdhapākaṃ sataṇḍulam ||5 1|| dugdhastaraṃ dugdhamanthaṃ dugdhaghaṭṭa payobalim | dugdhakvāthaṃ dugdhapiṇḍān dugdhamallayinīṃ śubhām ||52|| dadhi sarpirvṛtaṃ takraṃ navanītaṃ payaḥpuṭam | kṣīraudanaṃ payomiśraṃ payaḥpānādikaṃ dadau ||53|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastattad bhuktavān pītavām̐śca vai | kṣīrotpannāni ratnāni dadau sā vividhāni ca ||54|| śriyā māṇikyayā lakṣmyā yānyarpitāni bhāvataḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastāni jagrāha bhāvapūritaḥ ||55|| phalāni ratnāni ca pāyasāni bhuṃkte dadhātyatti ca bhāvagarbham | śriyaṃ ca maṇikyavarāṃ ca lakṣmīṃ sevāparāṃ vīkṣya haristutoṣa ||56|| sāyaṃ ca tāḥ pūrvavadeva pūjanaṃ cakruḥ samārādhanatatparāḥ sutāḥ | nīrājanaṃ bhojanamanyadarpaṇaṃ sadaiva cakrurbahubhaktibhāvataḥ ||57|| caturdaśyāmadhimāse madhyāhne pūjanottaram | śrutastābhirdundubhiśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya hi ||58|| kurvantu pūjanaṃ nityaṃ kurvantvārādhanaṃ mama | arpayantu ca me kiñcitprāpnuvantu mama gṛham ||59|| puruṣottamasaṃjño’haṃ brahmadhāmādhipaḥ pumān | adhimāsādhidaivo’haṃ vadāmi tad dadāmi vai ||6 0|| golokasthā api yāśca vaikuṇṭhasthā api vratam | adhimāse caturdaśyāṃ kurvanti yāśca ye’pi ca ||6 1 || tāsāṃ teṣāṃ manolabhyaṃ kariṣye bhagavānaham | dāsyāmi paramaṃ dhāmākṣarātītanivāsanam ||62|| phalaiḥ ratnaiḥ pāyasānnaiḥ pūjayiṣyanti māṃ janāḥ | prāpsyanti paramaṃ dhāma yatrāsmi puruṣottamaḥ ||6 3 || anyebhyo dhāmavāsibhyaḥ sthitiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ dadāmyaham | gṛhṇantu bhaktimatyo me bhaktāśca paramaṃ padam ||64|| nedṛśaṃ tvasti vaikuṇṭhaṃ golokaścāpi naiva ha | mama dhāmnā samaṃ tvanyad vidyate naiva naiva ca ||65 || na matsamo vāpyadhiko’sti kaścit na brahmaṇā sannibhamasti kiñcit | nānyatsukhe matsukhasāmyamasti svalpapradānena lihantu cāryāḥ ||66|| bhavantu dāsyaḥ prabhavantu bhaktā ānandamātrāṃ mama mūrtilabdhām | bhuñjantu nityaṃ mayi saṃramantu caturdaśīsadvratakalpanena ||67|| mānavyo māṃ samārādhya bhavantu divi devatāḥ | devyaśca māṃ samārādhya bhavantvārṣiṇya eva ca ||68|| ārṣiṇyo māṃ samārādhya bhavantvīśānya eva vā | tvīśānyo māṃ samārādhya bhavantvīśvarya eva ca ||69|| īśvaryo māṃ samārādhya nārāyaṇyo bhavantu ca | nārāyaṇyaḥ samārādhya gopyo bhavantu māṃ mudā ||70|| tāśca sarvāḥ samārādhya māṃ varaṃ puruṣottamam | bhavantu puruṣottamyo nityamuktānya eva ha ||7 1 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ vai saṃrādhya puruṣottamam | mamākṣaraṃ paraṃ dhāma gṛhṇantu madvratārthinaḥ ||72|| caturdaśyāmadhimāse vrataṃ śrīpuruṣottame | kṛtaṃ yenārjitaṃ tena māmakaṃ sarvameva ha ||73 || vacmi vacmi punarvacmi hyāgacchantu mayā saha | bhavane tvakṣare me vai nivasantu mayā saha ||74|| tuṣṭo’smi garjanāṃ kṛtvā kathayāmi punaḥ punaḥ | adhimāse caturdaśyāṃ yāntu vratena madgṛham ||75|| vaikuṇṭhe dundubhiṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tāḥ | saharṣāḥ satvaraṃ tatra yayuryatrāsti ghoṣakṛt ||76 || śrīśca hṛṣṭā ca māṇikyā lakṣmīrhṛṣṭā hṛdantare | natvā natvā punarnatvā prāhustaṃ dundubhiṃ hareḥ ||77|| nārāyaṇasya vaikuṇṭhe vasāmo’tra mahāsukhe | tato’tiśreṣṭhasaubhāgyaṃ prayacchati yadi prabhuḥ ||78|| kanyakā smo vayaṃ kurmo’rcanaṃ tasya hareḥ sadā | adya vrataṃ caturdaśyāḥ kurmo’dhimāsi nirṇayāt ||79|| kadākṣarādhipaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo miliṣyati | kadā neṣyati paramaḥ purāṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||80 || dundubhistu tadākarṇya prāha tāścādya vai prabhuḥ | niśi pūjottaraṃ tvāyāsyati kurvantu jāgaram ||8 1 || stuvantu paramātmānaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ janārdanam | bhavatīnāṃ saphalāśca prabhavantu manorathāḥ ||82|| ityuktvākṣatapuṣpaiśca pūjito dundubhiryayau | kanyāḥ pupūjuḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ niśīthe pratighasravat ||83|| jāgaraṃ tatra kurvantyaḥ śrīścakāra sunartanam | vādyaṃ tvavādayattatra māṇikyā tālasaṃyutam ||84|| lakṣmīstu gāyanaṃ cakre tisraśca militā jaguḥ | susvaraiśca naddhakiṃkiṇikā nūpurakaṃkaṇaiḥ ||85|| satya brahmākṣaraparamaparaṃ lokeśaṃ paralokeśaṃ nityaṃ jñānamanantamapāramanekākāraṃ kamaleśam | śāntaṃ bhāskarakāntamaghanutaṃ brahmānandamahānandaṃ parameśvaramabhivande prāvirbhāveśvaraparamānandam ||86|| dhāmni brahmākṣaramukteśvarapārṣadavṛndārcitacaraṇaṃ caitanyāmṛtadhāmavirājitamukteśaikasudhākaraṇam | śrīvatsāṃkaviraṃcigirīśanatāṃghritalaṃ suhṛdānandaṃ parameśvaramabhivande prāvirbhāveśvaraparamānandam ||87|| divyākhaṇḍamanantamunīśvaramaṇḍalamadhyagatākāraṃ nigamāgamapaṭalairabhivedyaṃ sākāraṃ paramākāram | divyavihāramanudbhavarūpamanādiṃ divyaguṇāgāraṃ parameśvaramabhivande prāvirbhāveśvaraparamānandam ||88|| saumyābhaṃ cinmālākuṇḍalamukuṭapiśaṃgasuceladharam sarvajñāmitaśaktiyutaṃ harikṛṣṇamacintyānandakaram| nigamāgamavanditayaśasaṃ śaṃsantaṃ dharmaṃ vedamatam parameśvaramabhivande prāvirbhāveśvaraparamānandam ||89|| lokālokavibhāsivibhūtimalokanivāsamanirvācyaṃ janmādyasya yato bhagavantamaśaraṇādhāraṃ vṛṣalālam | kṛṣṇaṃ karuṇārasamayarūpaṃ dīnadayāluṃ devavaraṃ parameśvaramabhivande prāvirbhāveśvaraparamānandam ||90 || bhāsvarakārtasvaravidyunmaṇibhāskaracandraviśeṣābhaṃ sadrūpaṃ ghanavarṇamatarkyamajaṃ hṛtsthaṃ tribhuvananābham | śyāmasaroruhadalasamanayanaṃ smerāsyaṃ sarvānandaṃ parameśvaramabhivande prāvirbhāveśvaraparamānandam ||9 1|| śyāmaṃ vyāpakamuttamapuruṣaṃ paramātmānaṃ sukhakandaṃ svāṃghrisarojasamudbhavakāntidyotitayāvajjanavṛndam | satyaṃ nārāyaṇaparameśvaramāyeśeśvaramuktavaraṃ parameśvaramabhivande prāvirbhāveśvaraparamānandam ||92|| kalpadrumaduhitā śrīrnityaṃ dhyāyati vallabhamātmānaṃ divyavibhūtisutā māṇikyā prārthayati svāmyātmānam | divyakṣīrābdhiduhitā lakṣmīrapi cecchati patimanaghaṃ puruṣottamamakṣaradhāmasthaṃ sa tvaṃ bhavasi bhavārthakaraḥ ||93|| karān gṛhāṇa cāsmākaṃ mā vai muñca kadācana | yāvadvai te’kṣaraṃ dhāma tāvatpatnyo bhavāmahe ||94|| śīghraṃ kuru kṛpānātha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho | varamālā gṛhāṇāsmaddhastebhyaścaikakālikāḥ ||95|| iti stutvā ca tāstisro viramustāvadeva tu | prāvirbabhūva bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||96|| sarvāvirbhāvaheturyaḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam | sarveśeśeśvaraḥ śreṣṭhabrahma śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||97|| śvetahastiyutaṃ yānaṃ vimānākhyaṃ cidambare | vāhayan yojanakoṭivistṛtaṃ muktapūritam ||98|| tisra āśvāsya vaikuṇṭhe kalpadrūn divyabhūtikam | kṣīrābdhiṃ ca namaskṛtya vidhinā taiḥ samarpitāḥ ||99|| pitṛbhistvarthitaḥ kṛṣṇe jagrāha tisṛkanyakāḥ | kintvasmābhirviyogo mā syāttathā kuru keśava || 100 || kare karān samādāya grahītā hariṇā tadā | śrīśca lakṣmīśca māṇikyā kṛṣṇātulyā virejire || 10 1|| tāsāṃ dvedve svarūpe ca kārayitvā pumuttamaḥ | chāyārūpa trayaṃ tāsāṃ pitradhīnaṃ surakṣya ca || 1 02|| divyarūpaṃ trayaṃ tāsāṃ puruṣottamayogyakam | akṣaradhāmavāsārhaṃ patnīrūpaṃ pragṛhya ca || 103|| tisra ārohayitvaiva vimāne puruṣottamaḥ | yayau divyākṣaraṃ dhāma patnīyuktaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ || 1 04|| evaṃ cādhikamāsasya caturdaśyā vratena tāḥ | śrīśca lakṣmīśca māṇikyā tisraḥ patnyo hareḥ sadā || 1 05|| babhūvuḥ śāśvate dhāmni kimatra khalu durlabham | śroturvaktarapi tvevaṃ phalaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye vaikuṇṭhe dundubhiśravaṇena kalpadrumaputryāḥ śriyaḥ divyavibhūteḥ putryā māṇikyāyāḥ divyakṣīrodadhiputryā lakṣmyāśca adhikamāsasya caturdaśyā vratenākṣaradhāmni parabrahmapuruṣottamaśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnītvaprāptyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.306 ||
<1.307> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi dharmapatnyā bhakteḥ putryo kathāṃ śubhām | adhimāse madhyatithau jātāṃ vai pāvanottamām || 1 || ādau kṛte yuge bhaktermānasyau dve kumārike | prāvirbhūte sute nāmnā preyasī śreyasī hyubhe || 2 || sevete pitarau nityaṃ yatra tau tatra te hyubhau | pitarau te parityajya prāṇān dhartuṃ na śekatuḥ || 3 || pitṛsevāpare nityaṃ svakartavyaparāyaṇe | prātaḥ snātvā ca te pitroḥ pādayornematuḥ sadā || 4 || pitroḥ snānādividhyarthaṃ dadatuśca jalādikam | snāpayitvā ca vastrāṇi dadaturdhāraṇāya te || 5 || candanākṣatasumanaḥ kuṃkumādyaiḥ pupūjatuḥ |
