sumiṣṭamṛṣṭanaivedyaṃ phalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ jalam || 6 || samarpya cakratuścobhe varṣmasaṃvāhanādikam | mātāpitroryadiṣṭaṃ cakratuścānyadvihāya te || 7 || śayanāstaraṇādyaṃ ca pātrāṇāṃ maṃjanaṃ tathā | gṛhasya mārjanaṃ vastrakṣālanaṃ tvannapācanam || 8 || jalasyāharaṇaṃ kāmadhenūnāṃ dohanādikam | annānāṃ śodhanaṃ pūjāpuṣpādyānayanaṃ tathā || 9 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamantrajapanaṃ devapūjanam | pitṛsantarpaṇaṃ bhūtayajñaṃ cātithipūjanam || 1 0|| dānaṃ jñānaṃ cātmabodhaṃ vijñānaṃ brāhmamityapi | evaṃ sarve gṛhakārye pitroḥ sevāṃ muhustathā || 1 1|| yathāpekṣaṃ tathānyacca cakratuśca divāniśam | tenāśīrvādapātre te babhūvaturbahupriye || 12|| yathā nāma tathā tatra guṇā vāsaṃ pracakrire | yathābalaṃ yathāśakti sarvabhāvena sundarī || 1 3|| anādṛtyaiva dehaṃ svaṃ kaṣṭaṃ yatra divāniśam | sarvasvabhogadānena sevayā preyasī sadā || 14|| atipriyā hyatipremapātraṃ pitrorbabhūva sā | preyasī tena sā bhuktiriti khyātiṃ jagāma sā || 15|| pitroḥ śreyaḥ pareṣāṃ ca śreyaḥkartrī sadāparā | kanyakārtijanānāṃ ca vidhūyārtīn muhurmuhuḥ || 16|| sukhaṃ mokṣasamaṃ samyak karotīti sukarmabhiḥ | śreyasī tena sā muktiriti khyātiṃ yayāvapi || 17|| preyasīśreyasīputryau dharmabhaktyoḥ kṛpākaṇāt | bhuktirmuktiśceti divye nāmnī dadhyaturarthavat || 18|| yayoḥ pitā svayaṃ dharmo jananī bhaktiraiśvarī | nidhānaṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ kimāścaryaṃ tayorguṇe ||19|| pitroḥ pavitrayoḥ sevā kaṃ na dhatte guṇottamam | pitarau toṣitau yena toṣitastena mādhavaḥ ||20|| toṣitāśca surāḥ sarve toṣitaṃ sakalaṃ jagat | athāputravatoḥ pitrostoṣadā syāt sutā yadi ||21|| sā vai putrasamā proktā pitarau tāritau tayā | yayā tvatra svakau vṛddhau pitarau toṣitau dhiyā ||22|| sāsti putranibhā putrī dāyabhāgādhikāriṇī | dehe yadyapi kanyā sā hṛdaye suta ātmani ||23 || sutavat sā sadā rakṣyā tayā svarge tayordhruvam | tayā dattaṃ jalaṃ cānnaṃ dānaṃ pitroḥ prayāti hi ||24|| yasya santi na vai putrāḥ putrī tasya kriyāścaret | yaśaṃ dānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ svādhyāyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam ||25|| sarvaṃ kuryād vidhiṃ putrī dhārayedupavītakam | tiṣṭhecca brahmacarye sā yāvat pitroḥ prasevanam ||26|| jāte putre’thavādatte paścāt pitrājñayāpi sā | brahmacaryaṃ prasamāpya vidhinā syād vivāhitā ||27|| brahmacaryasthitau jāte rājasvalyādyaśuddhike | brahmacaryasya tapasaḥ prābalyena na dūṣaṇam ||28|| aśuddhiḥ pālanīyā syād yāvaddinacatuṣṭayam | vārṣalyaṃ vānyadoṣo vā pāpaṃ vā nāsti tatkṛte ||29||| brahmacaryāgninā sarvaṃ daihyaṃ saṃyāti bhasmatām | brahmacaryasamo dharmo na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ||3 0|| kanyāṃ vā lagnayuktāṃ vā hyadhavāṃ vā dhavānvitām | ayogāṃ vā sayogāṃ vā pāvayed brahmacaryakam ||3 1|| brahmacarye brahmabhaktirbrahmavrataṃ ca yatra vai | tatra brahmātiriktaṃ vai bhasmasād yāti vaiśasam ||32|| bījaghnatvaṃ rajoghnatvaṃ ṛtughnatvādi dūṣaṇam | brahmacarye bhūṣaṇaṃ tad bījādi mokṣakṛddhi tat ||33 || evaṃ te kanyake pitroḥ sevāṃ cakraturādarāt | brahmacaryasthite nityaṃ dharmabhaktigṛhe śubhe || 34|| prātaste satyaloke vai svarṇadyāṃ snātumāgate | tābhyāṃ tu dundubhiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya saṃśrutaḥ || 35|| dhāmnāṃ dhāmnyavatārāṇāmavatārī pumuttamaḥ | atrādhike mahāmāse dadāmi puruṣottamaḥ || 36|| madhyatithervratakartre’kṣaraṃ dhāma ca sampadaḥ | matsānnidhyaṃ mama rūpaṃ madaiśvaryaṃ dadāmi ca || 37|| mama sāmyaṃ mama rājyaṃ mama lokaṃ dadāmi ca | mama yogaṃ mama śaktiṃ divyatāṃ me dadāmi ca ||38|| madaṃkaṃ mama mūrtiṃ ca matsamakhyātimityapi | matsamā pūjyatāṃ caiva śreṣṭhatāṃ ca dadāmi vai ||39|| madbhāvaṃ mama divyatvaṃ mama tejo dadāmi ca | mama siṃhāsanaṃ divyaṃ madvad vyāpakatāṃ tathā ||40 || madātmakatvaṃ tādātmyaṃ madhyāvrate dadāmi ca | ahaṃ pūrṇo’rdhamāse’tra vrataṃ puṣṭaphalapradam ||4 1 || śāśvataṃ satphalaṃ dāsye gṛhṇantu cārjayantu ca | puruṣottamamāso’yaṃ mama māso’sti cottamaḥ ||42|| tadekadinajaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvebhyo’pyatiricyate | aśāśvatāni cānyāni hyetatpuṇyaṃ tu śāśvatam ||43|| ahaṃ vai śāśvato devo māso’pi mama śāśvataḥ | vrataṃ ca śāśvataṃ me’sti puṇyaṃ gṛhṇantu śāśvatam ||44|| mātā santoṣitā yena bhaktyā saṃtoṣitaḥ pitā | mātāpitṛprasādena phalaṃ gṛhṇantu śāśvatam ||45|| yatheṣṭaṃ kalpayitvaiva kurvantu madhyamāvratam | pūrayiṣyāmi saṃkalpān yogyān yogyetarānapi ||46|| dundubhiḥ śrāvayitvaivaṃ kṣaṇaṃ maunaṃ dadhāra ca | kanyādattaṃ patrapuṣpaphalaṃ tvādāya niryayau ||47|| kanyake kṛtasaṃkalpe madhyātithervratāya vai | gatvā gṛhaṃ ca vidhivat pūjayāmāsatuḥ prabhum ||48|| sauvarṇī pratimāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya śobhanām | kārayitvāvāhanaṃ cakratuḥ ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ||49|| krameṇa pūjanaṃ yogyaṃ prathamaṃ payaādinā | pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya kārayāmāsatustataḥ ||50 || tīrthodakena saṃsnānaṃ mārjayāmāsatustataḥ | vastreṇāṅgaṃ ca dhautrādi dhārayāmāsatustataḥ ||5 1 || bhūṣayāmāsaturābhūṣaṇaiścandanakajjalaiḥ | śṛṃgārayāmāsatuśca puṣpahārādibhistataḥ ||52|| śobhayāmāsatuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dravottamaiḥ | nugandhayāmāsatuśca gandhasārādibhiśca te ||53|| kuṃkumākṣatatulasīpatrādi śekharādikam | arpayāmāsatustasmai puruṣottamarūpiṇe ||54|| dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ sunaivedyaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ pāyasādikam | nivedayāmāsatuśca phalaṃ tāmbūlacūrṇakam ||55|| pradakṣiṇāṃ daṇḍavacca namaskāraṃ kṣamāpanam | ārārtrikaṃ stutiṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ dadaturādarāt ||56|| arghyaṃ datvā ca saṃkalpaṃ puruṣottamalabdhikam | vijñāpayāmāsatuśca hṛdā prārthanayā muhuḥ ||57|| kumārītvaṃ sadākālaṃ yogyaṃ vai brahmadhāmani | muktatvaṃ tatra yogyaṃ vai divyāvasthādiśobhitam ||58|| brahmacaryaṃ brahmarūpaṃ brahmaiva parameśvaraḥ | āvayoḥ rakṣakaścāstu kṛṣṇanārāyāṇo hariḥ ||59|| rakṣakaḥ prerako dhātā vidhātā dhārako hi saḥ | poṣakaḥ sahajo nāthaḥ sarveśvareśvareśvaraḥ ||60 || akṣarādhipatiḥ kṛṣṇo brahmeśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | nāthaḥ pātā taṃ vinānyaḥ kaścitpātāsti nāvayoḥ ||6 1|| kṛpānātha kriyānātha yatnanātha phalaprada | varṣmanāthātmanornātha sarvanāthākṣaraṃ naya ||62|| tava svo dāsike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa hṛdisthita | antaryāmin vratapuṇyapradātarhṛdayaṃgama ||63|| hṛnnivāsa hṛdayajña bhāvajña pūrayāntaram | karau saṃgṛhya nau kṛṣṇa śīghraṃ nayākṣaraṃ prabho ||64|| iti stutvā dadatuste svakṣatān mūrtaye yadā | tāvattatra dayāluḥ sa āvirbabhūva sundaraḥ ||65|| kiśoro divyarūpaśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | gajapṛṣṭhe sthito divyarūpānuvayavaḥ pumān ||66|| yatkeśānāṃ prāntabhāgāḥ koṭividyutsamojjvalāḥ | āmūlāt snigdhakṛṣṇābhā mañjulāśca taraṃgitāḥ ||67|| camatkṛtiṃbharā bhaṃgīśobhitāstasya mūrdhajāḥ | paścāttu karṇayormadhye prānte’pyākarṣakāḥ śubhāḥ ||68|| lalāṭaphalakaṃ cordhvarekhācandravirājitam | bhrūdhanuḥkoṭikāmānāṃ śubhaṃ garvāpahārakam ||69|| bhāle’vicchinnasadrekha brahmamārgaprasūcikā | karṇayornikaṣā gatvā lokadvayavibodhikā ||70|| śaṣkulīdvayaśobhāḍhyau karṇau mohakarāvubhau | suraktapuṇḍarīkābhe netre dve sudalāyate ||71|| vidyutsamātisūkṣmābhā rekhāḥ santi manoharāḥ | ākarṇāntaṃ sakoṇaṃ ca bhāvagarbhaṃ ca kāminam ||72|| ehyāgaccheti hṛdayasthitasya vyañjakaṃ hi tat | surakta pronnataṃ hāsyabodhakaṃ netragaṇḍakam ||73|| tasyāsīnnāsikā ramyā tilapuṣpasamākṛtiḥ | oṣṭhau pakvasuraktāḍhya bimbatulyau babhūvatuḥ ||74|| sūkṣma ramyā nātigamyā śmaśrurekhā sma rājate | kambukaṇṭhaḥ puṣṭavakṣāḥ skandhau puṣṭau tathā hareḥ ||75|| bhujaṃgabhogavaddhastau nakhacandrāvaliśrayau | dhvajadhanurmahāmīnabāṇasvastikarājitau ||76|| śūlacakrābdhijarekhānvitau karāñjalī hareḥ | romarājimayau śubhraraktaraṃgau karāvubhau ||77|| śrīvatsakaustubhalakṣmīrekhāhāramuraḥsthalam | udaraṃ trivalīśobhaṃ nābhau brahmāsanaṃ śubham ||78|| kaṭiḥ kṛśā tathā guptaṃ saccidānandapūritam | hastikaropame ramye sakthinī romarājite ||79|| jānū ca vartulau tasya jaṅghe puṣṭottare kṛśe | gulphatrayaṃ pratipādaṃ madhyonnataṃ prakāśakṛt ||80|| ṣoḍaśāṃkasurekhābhī rājannakhamaṇiprabham | sarvaṃ dvyaṣṭasamaṃ puṣṭaṃ tejaḥpūritavigraham ||81|| surūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramādbhutam | apaśyatāṃ ca te kanye preyasīśreyasī hyubhe ||82|| jaharṣatuśca vai tatra prāpya śrīpuruṣottamam | puṣpamāle dhārayāmāsatuḥ kaṇṭhe harerubhe ||83 || ubhe ca sannidhau tasya sthite bhāvārdratāṃ gate | hariste prāha bhaktyā me vratenātha ca bhāvataḥ ||84|| vāṃ nayāmi mama dhāmākṣaraṃ sukhasupūritam | mayi tādātmyabhāvena vāṃ nayāmi ca varṣmaṇī ||85|| ityuktvā bhagavām̐statra tirobabhūva tatkṣaṇam | te hyubhe cāti saṃvigne hyabhūtāṃ tadviyogataḥ ||86|| madhyāhne tādṛśīṃ pūjāṃ sāyaṃ cāpi tathā niśi | cakraturvidhinā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya jāgaram ||87|| nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ divyaṃ cakraturmadhyarātrike | tāvatpunaḥ samāyāto drutaṃ rātrau mahāprabhuḥ ||88|| svajyotsnāvyāptadhavalaḥ sarveṣāṃ śreyasāṃkaraḥ | yathā prāptastathā rātrau rājate sma hariḥ svayam ||89|| gṛhe tatrotsave prāptaṃ jñātvā śrīpuruṣottamam | dharmo bhaktiśca taṃ natvā jñātvā śrīharimāgatam ||90 || putrīdvayaṃ svakaṃ dhāma netumājñāṃ pracakratuḥ | preyasī śreyasī prāpya hariṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||9 1 || kṛtakṛtye’tisampanne’kṣare dhāmni virājite | bhuktirmuktiśca te khyāte divye dhāmani tatra vai || 92|| dharmabhaktyośca sevārthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena ca | dvedhā rūpe ca te kṛtvārpite pitrorgṛhe’pi ca ||93|| yatra dharmaśca bhaktiśca tatra bhuktiśca muktikā | loke’pi dve ca vartaṃte vartete cāpi dhāmani || 94|| te’śnuvāte sarvakāmān brahmaṇā saha śāśvatān | evaṃ te prāptavatyau vai dhāma śrīparamātmanaḥ || 95|| yaścātra dharmavān bhaktimām̐śca syātparameśvare | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ sa cāsādya modate brahmaṇā saha ||96 || preyasīṃ śreyasīṃ prāpya modate’kṣaradhāmani | śrotā vaktāsya labhate pūrṇaṃ vrataphalaṃ priye || 97|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye dharmabhaktyormānasīputryoḥ preyasīśreyasyoḥ pitṛsevā māsamadhyamāyāstithervratenākṣaradhāmni śrīpuruṣottamaprāptiḥ bhuktimuktiriti khyātiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.307||
<1.308> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi brahmaviṣṇumaheśajanakasya vai | vairājapuruṣasyāpi vairājñyāptirvratādyathā || 1 || prākṛtapuruṣasyāsti putraḥ pradhānapūruṣaḥ | tasya hiraṇyagarbhākhyo mahāviṣṇuḥ suto’sti vai || 2 || tato virāḍajāyata vairājo vedhasaḥ pitā | tasyāyuḥ śatavarṣaṃ vai tasyaiva varṣasaṃkhyayā || 3 || yadā pūrṇaṃ bhavatyeva tasyāsti nidhanaṃ tataḥ | vairājo’nyaśca tatpaścād vairājyaṃ pratipadyate || 4 || evaṃ vai kramaśaḥ sṛṣṭau vairājānāmasaṃkhyatā | pāramparyapravāheṇa mahāviṣṇordine dine || 5 || ekaikasya vināśo’sti vairājasyeśvarasya vai | mahāviṣṇorvarṣamadhye pañcaṣaṣṭyadhitriṃśatam || 6 || vairājānāṃ bhavaṃtyeva krameṇa śatavarṣake | ṣaṭatriṃśattu sahasrāṇi tathā pañcaśatāni vai || 7 || vairājānāṃ bhavantyeva tatsarvaṃ vedmyahaṃ priye | asya vai vartamānasya vairājasya kathāṃ śṛṇu || 8 || mahāviṣṇostu sāmrājye aiśvarīsṛṣṭike stare | aṣṭāvaraṇapāre vai tvasmātpūrvo virāṭ pumān || 9 || svasyāntimasya varṣasyāntimāhnastvantimakṣaṇe | vartamāne’ntimavedhobrahmāṇḍe’stamanakṣaṇe || 10 || samrāḍāsītsahasrākṣābhidhaścakrapravartakaḥ | bhaktimān sa sahasrākṣaḥ satye pātālake bhuvi || 11 || vimānena sadā yāti śṛṇoti vyomatantunā | svacchadravyeṇa saṃcaṣṭe spṛśati kṣipravāyunā || 1 2 || kṣaṇena sarvalokānāṃ vyavahāraṃ karoti ca | sarvasādhanayuktasya gantavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate || 13 || sthitvaikatra gṛhe tasya prajāścaturdiśāsthitāḥ | vyavaharantīva nikaṣā vidanti karagaṃ yathā || 14|| sahasrākṣaḥ svayaṃ satyaloke saṃsadi vedhasaḥ | yātyāyāti yathākālaṃ pūritāyāṃ mahājanaiḥ || 15|| dikpālairmanubhiścāpi sūryeṇa śaśinā tathā | ṛṣibhiśca mahādevaiḥ sārvabhaumairnṛpaistathā || 16|| tatrāsanaṃ svakīyaṃ sa na lebhe prathame sthale | iti vaiṣamyadoṣeṇa preritaḥ sa hṛdantare || 17|| āhūya brahmavijñānān papracchābhyudayaṃ prati | pārameṣṭhyādadhikaṃ cottamaṃ sthānaṃ milet katham || 18 || viprā vijñāpayāmāsustamadhvaravarān kuru | agniṣṭomaṃ vājapeyaṃ rājasūyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam || 19 || mahāraudraṃ naramedhaṃ vājimedhaṃ vṛṣakratum | sautrāmaṇiṃ suteṣṭiṃ ca vahnihotraṃ japādikam || 20 || etān yajñān mahāraṃbhān śatasaṃvatsarān kuru | tena puṇyena te rājan pārameṣṭhyottaraṃ padam || 21 || bhaviṣyati dhruvaṃ rājyaṃ sthānaṃ kāraya tānmakhān | śate pūrṇe tvindrapadaṃ sahasre tu raveḥ sthalam || 22|| dhruvarājyamayute tu lakṣe tu vedhasaḥ sthalam | koṭiyajñeṣu pūrṇeṣu śatāsyabrahmaṇaḥ padam || 23 || yajñaparārdhe sampūrṇe vairājapadamāpyate | na tathāyuśca samayaḥ kasyāpyatra tu golake || 2 4|| tasmād rājam̐stena dattaṃ bhuñjīthā bhava śāntimān | tṛṣṇāyāstu piśācinyā anto bhogena nāpyate || 25 || atraivāptān prabhogām̐śca saṃprānubhūya sarvathā | rāgadveṣau mahādoṣau kṣapayitvā hitaṃ kuru || 26|| śreyaṃ matto mahānasti lakṣmyā buddhyā janaiśca vā | iti cintayiturnaiva sukhaprāptirbhavet kvacit ||27|| ahamasmi mahānātmānandena pūrito hareḥ | iti manturna vai duḥkhaṃ tṛṣṇādoṣādijaṃ bhavet ||28| anyeṣāmadhikaṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhaṃ mantavyameva na | svopārjitena yatprāptaṃ tat sukhaṃ śāntidaṃ matam ||29| yadṛcchayopapanne tu vastuni tūdyamārjite | alaṃbuddhirbhavedyasya sa sadātra sukhī bhavet || 30| trailokyāhataśāstisāmrājyaṃ tavāsti vai dṛḍham | yadi nāptā tataḥ śāntiradhikāt kā bhaviṣyati ||3 1| ayaṃ mama paraśceti draṣṭurnāsti kvacit sukham | tāratamyaṃ tu sarvatra māyāloke’sti sarvathā || 32 prakṛtau vikṛtau kārye niratikramavarjite | nahi kvāpi parā śāntirlabdhā kenāpi bhūpate ||33| na kaścillapsyate śāntiṃ yadi syātprakṛteḥ patiḥ | pradhānasya patirvāpi kānyasyātra kathā nṛpa ||34|| tasmācchāntiṃ labha rājan mā tṛṣṇāṃ vardhaya prabho | viremuśceti sandiśya brāhmaṇāḥ pāradarśinaḥ ||35|| sahasrākṣastu karṇau tānadatvaiva makhān bahūn | kārayāmāsa vidhivat pratyabdaṃ tu mahattamān ||36|| etaiḥ puṇyaṃ śatabrahmārjitaṃ prāptaṃ ca tena vai | athāyuṣo’ntime varṣe’dhimāse’parapakṣake ||37|| dine pratipadi prātarhareḥ śuśrāva dundubhim | yajñeṣu vartamānasya sahasrākṣasya bhūpateḥ ||38|| puruṣottamamāsasya dundubhiḥ śravaṇaṃ gataḥ | adhimāse dvitīye tu pakṣe vai pratipadgate || 39|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarveśvaraḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | yadiṣṭaṃ yasya tad dāsye koṭikalpairalabhyakam ||40|| koṭiyajñaiḥ koṭidānairyadalabhyaṃ dadāmyaham | atra vrate prakartavyaṃ rājñā dānaṃ yathābalam ||41| pūjanaṃ me prakartavyaṃ yathālabdhopacārakaiḥ | bhojanaṃ me ca dātavyaṃ yathāyogyānnasadrasaiḥ ||42| dakṣiṇā me pradātavyā yathāśraddhā tathā dhanaiḥ | paropakāraḥ kartavyaḥ puruṣottamatuṣṭaye ||43| yadi samrāṭ sārvabhaumaścaturdaśabhuvāṃ patiḥ | yathāvibhavaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ māṃ pūjayeduttamottamaiḥ ||44| prātaḥ snānaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā pañcaratnajalena mām | sugandhasāravārbhiśca dantaśuddhiṃ prakārayet ||45|| sugandhaṃ mañjanaṃ dadyānnūtanaṃ dantadhāvanam| sugandhajalagaṇḍūṣairjihvāśuddhyādi kārayet || 46 || puṣparasāgryasāraiśca sugandhibhirjalaiśca me | śaucādi kārayed rājā hastaśuddhyādi kārayet ||47|| candanāktasumṛdbhiścāvayavānāṃ pavitratām | sugandhavāribhiścādbhiḥ kārayet snāpayettataḥ ||48|| dugdhena dadhnā cāpyekākṣareṇa madhunā tathā | śarkarābhiścāmṛtaiśca snāpayed vāribhistataḥ ||49 || sugandhitailasāraiśca mardanaṃ kārayennṛpaḥ | tīrthavārbhiḥ snāpayecca vastraiśca mārjayejjalam ||5 0 || atisūkṣmātimūlyaiḥ satsuvarṇatāracandrakaiḥ | mṛducitraiścātisūkṣmavastrairmāṃ śobhayet tataḥ ||5 1 || rājyāsanārhasauvarṇairmukuṭaiḥ kaṭakādibhiḥ | svarṇormikā śṛṃkhalādyaiḥ kuṇḍalairhāraśekharaiḥ ||5 2|| koṭyadhikairmaṇiratnairmauktikairnaddhabhūṣaṇaiḥ | puṣparāgapravālaiśca vaidūryaiḥ sūryakāntakaiḥ ||5 3 || candrakāntairmārakatairmāṇikyaiḥ sphaṭikaistathā | vajrairgārutmatairmuktābhiśca satpadmarāgakaiḥ ||54|| indranīlaiḥ puṣparājaiḥ karketanaiśca bhīṣmakaiḥ | pulakaiḥ rudhiraiḥ svarṇai rājatairbhūṣaṇaistathā ||55 || sāmudrikaiḥ khanijaiśca vahnijaiḥ svarbhavaistathā | ratnamālāvibhūṣābhiḥ pūjayetparameśvaram ||56 || ūrṇāvastrottamaiścānyaiḥ kārpāsakaiśca kauśukaiḥ | vārkṣaiḥ suvarṇajaiścānyaiḥ rasajaistvakkṛtaiśca vai ||57|| vastraiḥ saṃśobhayet kṛṣṇaṃ tailaiḥ sugandhasārakaiḥ | kajjalairnavanītaiśca mardyadravyaiḥ sugandhakaiḥ ||5 8|| sagandhaṃ kārayet kṛṣṇaṃ kastūrīcandanādibhiḥ | karpūraiḥ kesarairmiśraiḥ pūjayet tilakādibhiḥ ||5 9 || kuṃkumākṣatapuṣpaiśca svarṇacampakakundakaiḥ | pārijātasthalapadmaiḥ kamalaistulasīdalaiḥ ||6 0 || kalpapuṣpaiḥ svarṇavallīkusumaiḥ pūjayetprabhum | svarṇākṣatairvardhayecca hāramālāḥ samarpayet||6 1 || karapādatale gaṇḍau kapolau karṇasīmakau | bhujau jaṃghe nakhānoṣṭhau raṃgaiḥ saṃraṃjayeddhareḥ ||62|| suvarṇamaṇiratnādinaddhopānadyutau padau | naktakayaṣṭikāgucchaśṛṃkhalāsahitau karau ||6 3 || śobhayet tilakaṃ pītaṃ raktaṃ candraṃ prakārayet | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ kārayecca bhojanaṃ śatamaṣṭa ca ||64|| amblaṃ madhuraṃ lavaṇaṃ kaṭu tiktaṃ kaṣāyakam | yathāruci yathāpekṣaṃ svādu sugandhi cārpayet| ||65|| bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ coṣyalehye peyaṃ cāsvādyamityapi | annaṃ śākadvidalāścaudanāni suphalāni ca ||66|| pāyasānnaṃ suvarṇaiḥ saṃskṛtāni sadrasāni ca | amṛtāḍhyāni miṣṭāni mṛṣṭāni dāpayennṛpaḥ ||67|| mukhavāsāni cūrṇāni tāmbūlaṃ cānyacarvaṇam | uttejakāni cānyāni tvarpayeddharaye nṛpaḥ || 68 || śītalānyapi peyāni cūrṇitarasavanti ca | mādakāni vividhāni tvarpayeddharaye nṛpaḥ ||6 9|| gāyanāni tu rājñībhistālavādyasvarānvitaiḥ | nartanairhāvabhāvādyavyaṃgyarasaprapūritaiḥ ||70 || sakhībhiḥ kārayedrājā vardhayed bahubhāvanaiḥ | lājābhiścandanakaṇairakṣataiḥ svarṇataṇḍulaiḥ ||7 1 || maṇiratnādibhirdevaṃ vardhayettu punaḥ punaḥ | jayakārān kārayecca nīrājayetprage niśi ||72 || śataiḥ sahasrakairvartikarpūrādibhirādarāt | ākaṭi sapta cāvartān sapta tvāmastakaṃ tathā ||73 || tataḥ saptāvartakām̐śca pratyekasaptacakrakān | tataśca saptalaharīrūrdhvādhaḥprasṛtāścaret ||74|| vyāvartānpādayoścaivāvartayet kramaśo harim | tato vastreṇa cāvartāṃstrīn hariṃ samavartayet ||75 || tataḥ śaṃkhajalenāpi vyāvartānavatārayet | ārārtrikaṃ tajjalena trivāraṃ samavardhayet ||76 || dhūpaṃ tatastrivāraṃ cāvartayetparameśvaram | ghaṇṭāvādanamanyeṣāṃ vādyānāṃ cāpi vādanam ||77|| dundubhijhallarīghaṇṭāpaṭahānativādayet | tataḥ stutiṃ namaskāraṃ daṇḍavat prārthanāṃ caret ||78 || pradakṣiṇādikaṃ kṛtvā puṣpāñjalimathārpayet | evaṃ prātaśca madhyāhne niśi samrāṭ prapūjayet ||79 || śṛṃgārayitvā satsainyaṃ vimāne ca gaje rathe | sthāpayitvā rājadhānyudyānādau bhrāmayeddharim ||8 0 || janatā vardhayet kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam | punastvānīya ca rājasaudhaṃ jalādi cārpayet ||8 1 || viśrāmayet pādasaṃvāhanādyaṃ vartayennṛpaḥ | bhagavattoṣaṇārthe ca bhūridānāni vai dadet ||82 || hastidānaṃ vājidānaṃ coṣṭraghoṭakadānakam | vṛṣabhājapradānaṃ ca gogaruḍapradānakam ||8 3 || śukadānaṃ sārikāyā menāyā dānamityapi | narāṇāṃ dāsadāsīnāṃ kanyānāṃ dānamityapi ||84|| yānānāṃ vāhanānāṃ ca paśūnāṃ dānamityapi | kambalāmbaraveṣādyutkṛṣṭavastūni dāpayet ||85 || bhavanāni nagarāṇi kṣetrāṇi parvatāṃstathā | sarovarāṇi khanijān khanīṃścāraṇyakāni ca ||86|| dadyād dāne dvijātibhyo’nāthebhyo’nnāmbarāṇi ca | vṛkṣān vallīḥ pradadyācca kṣetrāṇi vāṭikāstathā ||87|| dadyānnadīrnadām̐ścaivākhātān svargaṃ mahastapaḥ | satyaṃ lokaṃ pradadyācca pātālāntatalāni ca ||88|| deśaṃ pradeśaṃ khaṇḍaṃ ca rājyaṃ dvīpaṃ ca dāpayet | dātā brahmāṇḍanetā ced grahītāpi tathā bhavet ||89 || milennaiva grahītā cet saṃkalpya haraye dadet | viśvaṃbharo viśvapoṣṭā viśvarakṣākaraḥ prabhuḥ ||90 || gṛhṇātyeva na sandeho bhāvanākṣudhito hariḥ | sāmrājyamukuṭaṃ dadyād dadyād rājñīṃ sutāstathā ||9 1 || sarve dadyāccharmadāya kṛṣṇāya paramātmane | kośaṃ sainyāni rāṣṭrāṇi dadyācchrīkeśavāya vai || 92|| yathāśraddhaṃ pradadyācca sakāmāyādhikāriṇe | satpātrāya pradadyācca nārībhyo’pi daded bahu || 93 || bālābhyo vidhavābhyaśca sādhvībhyo jīvikāṃ dadet | satībhyo yoginībhyaśca raṃkābhyo bhojanaṃ dadet ||94|| santarpayed yajñabhāgaistrilokasuramānavān | kāśyapān prāṇinaḥ sarvāṃstoṣayedannavāribhiḥ ||95 || etatsarvaṃ pradadyādvā dadyādekaṃ ca vā nṛpaḥ | vittaśāṭhyaṃ na cet kuryād dadyācca śraddhayā yadi ||96|| kāṃsyapātrapuṭadānaṃ suvarṇapuṭadānakam | aṣṭāvaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ caturdaśadalāntaram ||97|| suvarṇaratnasaṃvyāptaṃ puṭaṃ dadyātpuṭāni ca | tatphalaṃ sarvathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yatheṣṭakam || 98 || dadāti māsyadhike vai śāśvataṃ bahutṛptidam | sakāmaṃ cāpi niṣkāmaṃ dāsyāmi puruṣottamaḥ || 99|| kurvantu dānaṃ vitarantu lakṣmīṃ kṣipantu pātre bhagavatprabuddhyā | śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa eva dātā vairājakaṃ cāpi dadāmi rājyam|| 100 || ityevaṃ dundubhirvakti māsi śrīpuruṣottame | sahasrākṣaḥ śṛṇotyeva śrīdaṃ taṃ pratipattithau || 101 || prātareva tu rājāsau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | śrutvā taṃ dundubhiṃ natvāpūjayacchuddhimānnṛpaḥ || 10 2|| dundubhinā yathāproktaṃ rājñaḥ śraddhā ca yādṛśī | tathā rājñā kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ pūjanaṃ savisarjanam || 1 03|| atha dānaṃ dadau prātaḥ patnīvratadvijanmane | āhūya brahmaṇaḥ satye loke saṃsadi taṃ dvijam || 104|| brāhmamūrte dvijaśreṣṭha tvameva puruṣottamaḥ | adhimāsādhidaivātman phaladātāsi mūrtimān || 1 05|| ahaṃ vai dundubhiṃ śrutvā karomyadya dine vratam | vairājapadalabdhyarthaṃ dānaṃ gṛhāṇa sārthakam || 1 06|| caturdaśabhuvanānāṃ rājāsmi ca dadāmyaham | svarṇadījalasākṣye’tra vedhasaḥ saṃsadi dvija || 1 07|| caturdaśabhuvanāni dadāmi phalalabdhaye | dattāni ca gṛhītāni pratyuvāca dvijottamaḥ || 1 08|| tāvatpatnīvratarūpe bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ | prāvirbabhūva sahasā koṭibhāskarakāntimān || 1 09|| prahasaṃstaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ provāca puruṣottamaḥ | dānaṃ prāptaṃ mayā rājan dvijarūpeṇa sarvathā || 11 0|| mayā dattaṃ phalaṃ tasya te vairājapadaṃ dhruvam | āyuṣo’nte tu labdhāsi vairājaṃ padamaiśvaram || 11 1|| iti kṛtvā prasādaṃ taṃ nṛpaṃ pradarśya vigraham | tirobabhūva sahasā spṛśan mūrdhni nṛpasya saḥ || 1 12|| rājñā vrataṃ tathā pūjāṃ sarvaṃ vai śraddhayā kṛtam | dadau brahmāṇḍadānaṃ sa yatra kiñcinna śiṣyate || 1 13|| svayaṃ dāso’bhavattasya kiṃkaro brāhmaṇasya vai | varṣāntaḥ pūrṇatāṃ prāptaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ samādhinā || 1 14|| paśyati svakṛte cāgre vairājaṃ padamasti yat | pūrvavairājavigame naikaṭye dṛśyate hi tat || 1 15|| ityevaṃ vartamānena rājñā tena mahātmanā | kramayogād daivayogāt tyaktaṃ dehaṃ nṛpātmakam || 1 16|| sahasrākṣaśarīraṃ ca vihāyemaṃ tu golakam | divyamārge yayau ceśasṛṣṭau yatrāsti tatsthalam || 1 17|| prāptavān sa sahasrākṣo vairājaṃ padamaiśvaram | yo’dyāsti nābhikamalaḥ pitā vai vedhasaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 18|| so’yaṃ vairājasāmrājyaṃ prāptavān pratipadvratāt | bhūmnā hairaṇyagarbheṇa tathānyairīśvarairapi || 1 19|| tatrābhiṣikto rājā saḥ yo’sau nārāyaṇo’bhavat | yatkamale’bhavad brahmā yallalāṭācchivāpatiḥ || 1 20|| yasya vai hṛdayādviṣṇuryasyodare tvidaṃ jagat | so’yaṃ vrataprabhāveṇa sahasrākṣo nṛpaḥ khalu || 1 21|| puruṣottamasadbhaktyā jāto nārāyaṇo virāṭ | evaṃ tvadhikamāsasya madhyo’rdhvapratipaddine || 1 22|| vratapūjanadānena phalaṃ te kathitaṃ priye | prasannaḥ śrīharistatra kiṃ na dadāti padmaje || 123|| asya śrāvayitā cāpi pāṭhakartāpi tādṛśam | phalaṃ saṃlapsyate lakṣmi vadāmi puruṣottamaḥ || 124|| nāstikaścāśraddadhāno mṛṣāvādī pradūṣakaḥ | na prasādaṃ phalaṃ vāpi labhate mama nindakaḥ || 125|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye prāksṛṣṭau sārvabhaumena sahasrākṣanāmakarājñā sahasreṣu yajñeṣu kṛteṣu tato’dhikamāsottarapakṣīyapratipadvratadānādinā prāptaṃ vairājanārāyaṇapadamityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.308 ||
<1.309> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ divyāṃ prāksampannāṃ manoharām | asmāttu brahmaṇaḥ pūrvo brahmā varṣaśatottaram || 1 || nidhanonmukhatāṃ prāptastadānīṃ brahmagolake | antime’jakṣaṇe rājā pṛthvyāṃ sarvahutābhidhaḥ || 2 || babhūva bhagavadbhakto mama pūjāparāyaṇaḥ | madarthe kṛtasarvasvo madarthe nyastamānasaḥ || 3 || mama kaṇṭhīṃ mama mālāṃ mamaiva tilakaṃ śubham | dadhāra bubhuje cānnaṃ me prasādātmapāvanam || 4 || cāturmāsye vrataṃ tena gṛhītaṃ bahudāyitā | saptadvīpeṣu khaṇḍeṣu sāmudradvīpabhūmiṣu || 5 || yatra yatrābhavat svasya rājyaṃ sarvatra tatra ca | mamānnaṃ vai pradātavyaṃ jalaṃ pātavyameva me || 6 || yāvattṛptirbhikṣuvargairadanīyaṃ mamaiva ha | brāhmaṇairmama bhoktavyaṃ kṣatriyarṣibhirityapi || 7 || vaiśyarṣibhistathā śūdrairbhaktikṛdbhirmamānnakam | bhoktavyaṃ sarvathā brahmacāribhirvanavāsibhiḥ || 8 || yatibhiḥ sādhubhistyāgijanaiḥ sādhvībhirityapi | anāthaiścātithiprakhyairyājñikairdevapūjakaiḥ || 9 || annārthibhiḥ kadaryaiśca kiṃkarairvṛttivarjitaiḥ | mamānnameva bhoktavyaṃ jalaṃ pātavyameva me || 10 || vastrāṇi mama dhāryāṇi nānyagrāhyaṃ tu kairapi | tadarthaṃ ca mayā rājye pratisthalaṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe || 11 || annasatrāṇi vastrāṇi prapāvārīṇi sarvathā| saṃsthāpitāni sevāsthā niyuktāśca pratisthalam || 12|| kṣudhito’nnasya pātraṃ syāt tṛṣito jalapātrakam | nagnastvambarapātraṃ syād grāhyaṃ tena mudā mama || 13 || kadarye hṛdayaṃ yasya yasya tṛṣṇāsti mānase | so’pi tṛṣṇādināśārthaṃ gṛhṇātvannaṃ jalaṃ mama || 14|| ityevaṃ ghoṣitaṃ tena kuḍyaphalakalekhitam | cāturmāsye mamānnaṃ vai phalaṃ vāri tathāmbaram || 15|| grahaṇīyaṃ puṣkalaṃ nānyagrāhyaṃ dharmabhikṣukaiḥ | ityevaṃ vartamānasya sarvahutasya bhūbhṛtaḥ || 1 6|| agnihotre’nyayajñe ca yatkiñciddhāmikaṃ matam | devānāṃ pūjane vastupradānaṃ cāpi tasya vai || 17|| vidyārthināṃ ca vidyāyā dāne vyayo gavāṃ tṛṇe | śvaprabhṛtigrāmyapaśupakṣiṇāṃ ca kaṇānnakam || 18 || jalaṃ vastraṃ tathā cānyad yathāpekṣaṃ suvastukam | āsīt sarvahutasyaivātithīnāṃ tṛptikṛttathā || 19 || grāmeṣu kheṭeṣu janasthaleṣu kṣetreṣu ghoṣeṣu nadītaṭeṣu | vaneṣvaraṇyeṣu ca parvateṣu dvīpeṣu vārdhau raṇanirjaneṣu ||2 0 || upatyakāyāṃ nagareṣu rājyaviśrāntibhūmau ca karasthalīṣu | sarvatra vai sarvahutasya rājño’bhavan susatrāṇi sudānakāni || 2 1 || grāmāntarāṇāṃ yugamārgasandhau vanāntarāṇāṃ sṛtimūlayoge | nadīnadānāṃ taraṇārthabhūmau kṛtāni satrāṇi tu tena rājñā || 22 || sīmāntareṣu prakhanisthaleṣu yānasya mārgeṣu digantareṣu | tīrtheṣu yātrālugatāgateṣu sthaleṣu satrāṇi hutasya rājñaḥ ||23 || devānāṃ pūjane nāma procyate sarvato diśi | prātaḥ sāyaṃ ca madhyāhne tasya sarvahutasya vai || 24|| satye tapasi tasyaiva jane mahari svargake | bhuvi cāpyatha pātāleṣvasya kīrtirhi gīyate || 25 || devāśca ṛṣayaścāpi daityāścānye’pi dehinaḥ | sarvahutaṃ lokituṃ vai yayurhaṃsādirūpiṇaḥ || 26|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpurdṛṣṭvā puṇyojjvalaṃ nṛpam | atitejomaṇḍalāḍhyamukhamaṇḍalaśobhitam || 27|| dūre cātipratejaskāḥ sarve śuśubhire surāḥ | kintu tannikaṭe gatvā nistejaskā babhūvire || 28 || iti puṇyapratāpo’sau sarvahutārthasārthakaḥ | agniprakhyo’bhavadbhakto devagarvaharo nṛpaḥ || 29 || devaiḥ sammānitaḥ sarvairindrārdhāsanayojitaḥ | dikpālaiḥ pūjitaḥ so’pi vismayaṃ nāpa vai manāk || 30 || rāgaśūnyasya tasyaiva patnyāsīt patisevinī| audāryaguṇasampannā nāmnā vai goṛtambharā ||3 1 || devībhyo’pyatirūpāḍhyā kāyākalpātisundarī | kāmarūpā kāmabhogā kāmakārātisāttvikī ||32|| devīṣu tiṣṭhate paścād devadevīsamājake | salajjāvāṅmukhī tatra bhavati kṣaṇamāntare || 33|| tayā svasvāmine proktaṃ mayā paścānniṣadyate | yathāpūrvaṃ tūttame hyāsane tiṣṭhāmi tatkuru ||34|| indrāṇī vāruṇī sauryā cāndradyo vānyasurastriyaḥ | praṇameyuśca māṃ svāmin yathā tatkuru bhūpate ||35|| rājā prāha satīṃ rājñīṃ mānuṣī bhavasi priye | tatrāpi devasaṃghe’smadvāso’styatimahattamaḥ |||36|| mā tṛṣṇāṃ kuru kalyāṇi mānuṣe tu na tadbhavet | tathāpi puṇyabāhulye kadācit tadvibhāvyate || 37|| kariṣye stavanaṃ yatnaṃ nārāyaṇasamīpataḥ | prāpte yoge tathā syādvai tṛṣṇāśāntistathāpi na ||38|| nityaṃ rājñī nṛpaṃ kāle prasmārayati tadvacaḥ | rājāpi samayaṃ prāptaṃ tadarthaṃ vai pratīkṣate ||39|| ekadādhikamāsasya dvitīyāyāṃ prage’site | snātvā devaprapūjāyāṃ tiṣṭhate tāvadeva vai ||40|| śrutavān dundubhiṃ ramyaṃ ghoṣayantaṃ harervacaḥ | śuśrāva sarvahutasya rājñyapi goṛtambharā ||41|| ubhau sthairyeṇa tacchabdamānasau saṃbabhūvatuḥ | śuśruvāte dundubhestu ghoṣaṇāṃ hṛdayaṃgamām ||42|| adhimāsadvitīyāyāṃ vrataṃ kurvanti ye janāḥ | teṣāmabhīṣṭadātāhaṃ māsaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||43|| ekabhuktaṃ ca vā naktaṃ phalabhuktirjalāśanam | vāyvāśanaṃ ca vā kṛtvā kariṣyanti vrataṃ tu ye ||44|| tebhyo dāsye sutadārādhanasampadgṛhādikān | yānavāhanahastyādīn vārīkṣetradharādikān ||45|| khaṇḍaṃ dvīpaṃ ca sāmudraṃ bhaumaṃ rājyaṃ bhūmaṇḍalam | svargaṃ janaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ caindraṃ sauryaṃ ca cāndrakam ||46|| sāmrājyaṃ cātalaṃ pātālakaṃ cāpi rasātalam | dāsye caturdaśalokādhipatyaṃ pārameṣṭhyakam ||47|| vāruṇaṃ vāhnikaṃ caiśaṃ yāmyaṃ tathā ca pāvanam | kauberaṃ nairṛtaṃ cāpi dikpālatvaṃ mahatpadam ||48|| lokapālapadaṃ dāsye vāsavaṃ grahamaṇḍalam | naidheyaṃ cāpi raudraṃ ca mārutaṃ nākapṛṣṭhakam ||49|| siddhīraṣṭavidhā dāsye guṇaṃ brahmāṇḍasarjanam| rakṣaṇaṃ pālanaṃ dāsye sāmarthyaṃ vratine tu me ||50 || adhimāsasya devo’haṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | svalpe’pi matkṛte kṛcchre phalaṃ dāsye tvanantakam ||5 1 || dadāmi nānyamāse yat taddadāmyatra puṣkalam | atrāhaṃ kṛpayā dātā dātāsmi svecchayā khalu ||52|| madvacodhārayatyaddhā mūrdhnā tasmai dadāmyaham | upāyanaṃ tathā pāritoṣikaṃ vā svanugraham ||53 || nātra vinimayo nyāyo nyāyastvatra kṛpā mama | kṛpayāhaṃ svayaṃ svāmī vitarāmi tvaśeṣakam ||54|| koṭiguṇaṃ vitarāmi vitarāmi tvanantakam | yathāsaṃkalpitaṃ tasmād gṛhṇantu puruṣottamāt ||55 || iti śuśruṣatuḥ sarvahutaśca goṛtambharā | tau natvā dundubhiṃ puṣpaiḥ pūjayāmāsatustadā ||56 || dundubhistu gato’nyatra dampatī dadhyatuḥ prabhum | sveṣṭalābhastathā kutra prāpsyate ceti dadhyatuḥ ||57|| sarvahutastadā rājñīṃ samprāha goṛtaṃbharām | śrutaṃ devi dvitīyāyā vrateneṣṭamavāpyate ||58 || tavāsti mānasaṃ pūjyasthāne sthātuṃ mahattame | caturdaśastarasthānāṃ sarvāsāṃ surayoṣitām ||59 || tatprāptyarthaṃ vrataṃ kāryamāvābhyāṃ phaladaṃ bhavet | dundubhinā taduktaṃ vai svalpe’pi bahulaṃ phalam ||6 0 || ahaṃ brahmā bhaviṣyāmi bhava tvaṃ sahacāriṇī | brahmāṇī mama patnī ca mātā vai surayoṣitām ||6 1 || tathā sati tavehā tu prapūrṇārthā bhaviṣyati | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo devo phalaṃ vratasya dāsyati ||62|| evaṃ kṛtvā tu saṃkalpaṃ vrataṃ cakraturādarāt | prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā kārayitvā tu kānakīm ||63 || mūrtiṃ tatrādhikadevaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam | āvāhyācamanaṃ datvāsanaṃ pādyaṃ samarpya ca ||64|| tasmai tvācamanaṃ tīrthajalasya dadatuśca tau | dugdhena picchaladadhnā ghṛtena madhunā tathā ||65|| śakarrābhiśca saṃsnāpya kārayāmāsatustataḥ | śuddhajalaiḥ sugandhaiścāplavanaṃ candanānvitaiḥ ||66|| mārjayāmāsaturvastraiḥ śobhayāmāsaturharim | suvarṇāmbarabhūṣābhirmaṇiratnottamādibhiḥ ||67|| hāraiścandanagandhaiśca dravaiḥ sāradravaistathā | kajjalaistailasāraiśca puṣpaiḥ kuṃkumataṇḍulaiḥ ||68 || pūjayāmāsatuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ kirīṭakaṭakādibhiḥ | sadratnamaṇihārādyaiśchatracāmarayaṣṭibhiḥ ||69|| dhūpadīpasunaivedyaphalatāmbūlacūrṇakaiḥ | kārayāmāsatustṛptiṃ śrīhariṃ puruṣottamam ||70|| jalaṃ datvā savādyaṃ tau nīrājanaṃ pracakratuḥ | pradakṣiṇāṃ stutiṃ namaskārāṃścakraturādarāt ||71 || prārthayāmāsaturdevaṃ vratenānena keśava | prasanno bhava viśvātman gṛhāṇārghyaṃ phalādikam ||72|| iti kṛtvā dadatustau phalārthaṃ sasuvarṇakam | puṣpāṃjaliṃ dadatuśca cakratuḥ sevanaṃ tataḥ ||73|| madhyāhne’pi tathā cobhau cakratuḥ pūjanādikam | sāyaṃ prapūjya deveśaṃ kṛtvā tvārārtrika niśi ||74|| cakraturjāgaraṃ vādyanṛtyakīrtanasūtsavam | dānaṃ kṛṣṇāya dadatuḥ siṃhāsanaṃ tu kānakam ||75|| chatracāmaravetrādiśobhitaṃ bahulojjvalam | maṇiratnasumauktikadāmabhūṣāvirājitam ||76|| bhavanaṃ cāpi dadatuścaturdaśaprabhūmikam | sauvarṇakūpyavastvāḍhyopaskarādyabhirājitam ||77|| śayyāstaraṇabhojyādibhāgabhuvanaśobhitam | puṇyasāragṛhaṃ yatra yatrāgnihotrasadgṛham ||78|| pitṛtarpaṇabhavanaṃ yatrāsti dānasadgṛham | maṇiratnādi pūrṇaṃ ca yatra kośagṛhaṃ tvapi ||79|| yānavāhanapūrṇaṃ ca gṛhaṃ cidacidātmakam | dāsadāsīvanodyāna nadīnada samanvitam ||80|| gṛhaṃ yatrāsti bhūmau ca viśrāntigṛhamityapi | suratasya gṛhaṃ caiva bhojanasya gṛhaṃ tathā ||81 || snānāgāraṃ tathā guptapātālādi susampadam | gṛhaṃ yatrāsti kalpānāṃ drumāṇāṃ ca gavāṃ gṛham ||8 2|| evamādīni sarvāṇi bhavanāni ca yatra vai | vartante tanmahatsaudhaṃ saprākāraṃ suśobhitam ||83|| dadatustau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyārpaṇameva hi | tāvattatra samāyātaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||84|| provāca tau prasanno’smi dānena ca vratena ca | dadāmyeṣaḥ kṛpāṃ kṛtvā vṛṇuta varadānakam ||85|| dampatī prāhatustatra pārameṣṭhyaṃ padaṃ prabho | dehi paścāttavadhāmākṣaraṃ mokṣaṃ ca śāśvatam ||86|| tathāstviti hariḥ prāha tathāha goṛtambharām | bhāvini puṣkare tīrthe pṛthvyāṃ vai kṣatriyo nṛpaḥ ||87|| ābhīrāṇāṃ ca gopānāṃ puṣkarāraṇyavāsinām | nṛpo bhaviṣyati nāmnā gāyatro vai virāṭsutaḥ ||88|| tasya bhāryā ṛṣīnāmnī rājñī puṣkaraputrikā | bhaviṣyati tayoḥ putrī ārṣināmnī sukanyakā ||89|| seyaṃ tvaṃ bhāvinī gopī gomatī goṛtambharā | gāyatrī gokulasevākartrī tatra bhaviṣyasi ||90|| ayaṃ rājā sarvahutastatra brahmā bhaviṣyati | ādye yuge ca yajñārthe puṣkare sa gamiṣyati ||91 || surarṣimunipitrādyairmānavaistalavāsibhiḥ | caturaśītilakṣātmadehibhiḥ saha viśvasṛṭ ||92|| yajñaṃ kariṣyati tvādyaṃ pravṛttyarthaṃ jagattraye | tatrāgniṣu proddhṛteṣu dīkṣākāle hyupāgate ||93|| adhvaryuṇā tadāhūtā sāvitrī dīrghasūtriṇī | sajjī bhūtvā yajñabhūmau tatkāle nāgamiṣyati ||94|| brahmā śakraṃ samāhūya kathayiṣyati kālikam | patnīṃ tvanyāṃ madarthe tu śīghraṃ śakra samānaya ||95|| yathā pravartate yajñaḥ kālahīno na jāyate | tathā śīghraṃ vidhehi tvaṃ nārīṃ patnyarthamānaya ||96|| evamuktastathā śakro gāyatrarājakanyakām | yajñabhūmivilokāyāgatāṃ tvāṃ sa hi neṣyati ||97|| ārṣiṇīṃ kanyakāṃ ramyāṃ gāyatrīṃ navayauvanām | gāndharveṇa vivāhena grahīṣyati sa viśvasṛṭ ||98|| prārapsyate tato hotraṃ brāhmaṇairvedapārargeḥ | yajño dinasahasraṃ vai puṣkare sa bhaviṣyati ||99|| tata ārabhya gāyatrī brahmāṇī tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi | lokamātā vedamātā sṛṣṭimātā bhaviṣyasi || 10 0|| sarvapūjyā sarvamānyā dvijajāpyā bhaviṣyasi | brahmadātrī brahmavadhūrbhaviṣyasi ṛtambhare || 101 || ayaṃ sarvahuto brahmā tvaṃ gāyatrī ca dampatī | dvitīyāyā vratenaiva kṛpayā me bhaviṣyathaḥ || 1 02|| śatavarṣottaraṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ me prāpsyatho dhruvam | mahānagaratulyasya saudhasya dānakarmaṇā || 1 03|| brahmāṇḍākhyaṃ gṛhaṃ rājyaṃ dāsye smṛddhaṃ parātparam | ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇastirobabhūva tatsthalāt || 1 04|| pūrvajasya brahmaṇo’pi laye jāte’tha dampatī | pārameṣṭhyaṃ padaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prāpatuḥ śāśvataṃ ciram || 1 05|| evaṃ sarvahuto rājā tatpatnī goṛtambharā | sañjātau daṃpatī brahmā gāyatrī pitarau sṛjeḥ || 1 06|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi prāksṛṣṭīyamudantakam | puruṣottamamāsasya dvitīyāyāstu sadvratam || 107|| pārameṣṭhyapadadātṛ śroturvaktustathā phalam | bhaviṣyati na sandeho vakti śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 1 08|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye prāksṛṣṭau sarvahutarājñā goṛtambharārājñyā ca dvitīyapakṣadvitīyāvratena nagarasamabhavanadānādinā pūjanādinā ca pārameṣṭhyapade brahmaṇo’vatāro gāyatryavatāraśca prāptaṃ ityādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||1.309||
<1.310> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi prākkalpasya kathānakam | sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe bhuvo bhāge samrāḍāsījjanādhipaḥ || 1 || nāmnā brahmasavitākhyastasya patnī pativratā | patidharmaparā bhaktā bhūriśṛṃgābhidhābhavat || 2 || sevate sā sadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakaṃ patim | dampatī bhagavadbhaktau gṛhadharmaparāyaṇau || 3 || kurvantau dānadharmādi sevayantau gurūn janān | vartayantau harermārge viṣṇusevāparāyaṇau || 4 || atithīn pūjayantau ca vṛddheṣu vinayānvitau | gavāṃ sevāṃ prakurvantau dayāvantau prajāsu ca || 5 || dīnānāṃ duḥkhahantārau nirdhanānāṃ prapoṣakau | satāṃ sevāṃ prakurvantau duṣṭānāṃ tu niyāmakau || 6 || āstāṃ dharmaparau trāṇaparau kaṣṭaharau hi tau | rājā brahmasavitrākhyo nityaṃ snātvā nadījale || 7 || sandhyāṃ japaṃ tathā homaṃ svādhyāyaṃ sma karoti vai | annadānaṃ vastradānaṃ dravyadānaṃ karoti ca || 8 || devālayeṣu devānāṃ darśanārthaṃ pragacchati | naivedyārthe sumiṣṭānnaṃ phalādyarpayati pradhīḥ || 9 || yogye tu samaye pūjāṃ kārayatyeva bhāvataḥ | bhojayatyatithīn viprān sādhūn sādhvīryatīn munīn || 10 || dadāti dakṣiṇāṃ svarṇarūpyātmikāṃ sutoṣadām | annasatreṣu cānnāni dāpayatyapi kośataḥ || 11 || dāsadāsīpravargāṇāṃ śṛṇoti prārthanāṃ muhuḥ | apekṣitaṃ pradatvaiva sukhayatyatidharmavān || 12|| rājñī cāpi tathā devān pūjayatyaniśaṃ gṛhe | darśanārthaṃ ca devānāṃ prayāti yānamantarā || 13|| anupānaccaraṇābhyāṃ yātrāṃ karoti nityadā | jalaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ candanaṃ svarṇadakṣiṇām || 14|| devāya gurave datvā samāgacchati tadgṛham | bhojayitvā janān bhuṃkte sā nṛpo’tti tathottaram || 15|| cāturmāsye vrataṃ rājñā gṛhītaṃ ghṛtadīpakāḥ | dātavyā haraye’khaṇḍāḥ sarvadevālayeṣu vai || 16|| saptadvīpeṣu khaṇḍeṣu sāmudradvīpakeṣu ca | yatra yatrābhavan devālayā rājye svake bhuvi || 17|| parameśāvatārāṇāmīśvarāṇāṃ ca yoginām | devānāṃ sarvajātīnāṃ camatkārātmanā tathā ||18|| vibhūtīnāṃ ca tattvānāṃ devīnāṃ ca citāṃ tathā | tīrthānāmadhidaivānāṃ jaḍānāṃ cetanāvatām || 19|| caityānāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ ca jaṃgamānāṃ camatkṛtām | yatra yatrābhavan surakṣmālayāstatra tatra ca ||20|| ghṛtadīpānakhaṇḍān sa sutejaskānakārayat | svarṇapātreṣu saṃśuddhagoghṛtāni suvartikāḥ ||21|| dhārayitvā prakāśaṃ vai sarvadevebhya ādadau | tasya rājye yadi kasmaicidapyarhasurāya cet ||22|| anarpitaḥ pradīpaścejjānātyayaṃ nṛpastadā | sopavāsaḥ suvarṇānāṃ sahasraṃ ca dadātyapi ||23||| uddhoṣayati sarvatra cāturmāsye vrataṃ mama | mama rājye tu sarvatra devebhyo mama dīpakāḥ ||24|| pradeyāḥ pūjakaistīrthajalebhyaścaityaśākhine | devālayeṣu sarvatra bhavantu mama dīpakāḥ ||25|| sarvaparvakārtikādau bhavantvākāśadīpakāḥ | gavāṃ ghṛtena me śreṣṭhajyotīṃṣi santu sarvathā ||26|| pañcāmṛtāplavanaṃ ca devānāṃ mama bhūyatām | miṣṭānnāni mama santu devebhyo vinivedane ||27|| upacārāstathā santu sarvathā mama ṣoḍaśa | navadhā śrīharerbhaktirjāyatāṃ matprabhojitaiḥ ||28|| cāturmāsye tu śākāni dugdhāni ca rasāstathā | viprāṇāṃ sādhusādhvīnāṃ devānāṃ bhojane mama ||29|| dīnānāthakṛpaṇānāṃ bhojanāni bhavantu me | gavāṃ grāsāḥ śunakādigrāmyādanāni santu me ||30|| kaṇānnādipradānaṃ ca pārāvatādipakṣiṇām | pipīlikāprabhṛtīnāṃ piṣṭādyannaṃ samastu me ||3 1|| yajñānāṃ karmaṇāṃ siddhiḥ sādhanairastu me tathā | ārārtrikādikaṃ devālayeṣu cāstu me’nvaham ||32|| jaladānaṃ vastradānaṃ mamāstu vaibhavāt sadā | svarṇarūpyādimudrāṇāṃ pradānaṃ cāstu me sadā ||33|| ityevaṃ brahmasavitā rājā prāghoṣayad bhuvi | bhūriśṛṃgā ca tatpatnī cakre patyā saha vratam ||34|| nityaṃ snātvārcayati sma śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamam | maṇḍapaṃ kadalīstambhaiḥ śobhitaṃ toraṇādibhiḥ ||35|| kārayitvā navaṃ nityaṃ pūrayitvā ca maṇḍalam | saptadhānyamayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvatobhadranāmakam ||36|| kārayitvā ca sauvarṇīṃ mūrtiṃ śrīpauruṣottamīm | upacārairbahuvidhaiḥ pupūja bahubhāvataḥ ||37|| madhyāhne bhojanaṃ cāpi ṣaṭpaṃcāśadvidhaṃ dadau | sāyaṃ nīrājayitvā ca nṛtyati dāsikāyutā ||38|| evaṃ karotyanudinaṃ puruṣottamasya toṣāya mānamahataṃ vigaṇayya rājñī | kṛṣṇo’pi nṛtyamavalokya sukaṇṭhamiśraṃ tuṣṭo bhavatyapi na dṛṣṭipathaṃ prayāti ||39|| dampatī tau tathāvṛttau nityabhaktau haripriyau | tṛtīyāyāḥ prage tvākarṇayāmāsaturaiśvarīm ||40|| ghoṣaṇāṃ dundubhiproktāṃ mahāścaryakarīṃ yathā | śṛṇvantu nāgarāstadvadāraṇyakā divaukasaḥ ||41|| narā nāryaśca śṛṇvantu vacmi śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | brahmadhāmeśvaraḥ sākṣādadhimāsādhidaivataḥ ||42|| parapakṣatṛtīyāyāṃ vrataṃ tu śraddhayānvitam | kariṣyanti narā nāryo mama pūjanapūrvakam ||43|| ekabhuktena naktena phalenāyācitena vā | rājāno yadi vā rājñyaḥ prāpsyanti paramaṃ padam ||44|| prāpsyanti dharmakāmārthamokṣān lokānabhīpsitān | putrapautrādivaṃśām̐śca kulavistārasadyaśaḥ ||45|| aiśvaryāṇi samagrāṇi prāpsyanti madvratena vai | gṛhṇantvekadivasasya vratena śāśvataṃ sukham ||46 || paramaudāryasampanno dāsye’haṃ puruṣottamaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvasampadāmasmi yojakaḥ ||47|| adya bhojanadānena dāsye navanidhīn dhruvān | adya suvarṇadānena dāsye kuberagaddikām ||48|| adya rasapradānena dāsye vāruṇasatpadam | adya ratnapradānena dāsye surendratāṃ śubhām ||49|| adya puṇyapradānena dāsye vai dharmarājatām | adya dhanapradānena dāsye’ṣṭavasuvigrahān ||50 || adya sarvasvadānena dāsye’ṣṭasiddhivaibhavān | adya dīpapradānena dāsye trilokanetratām ||5 1 || adya payaḥpradānena dāsye śītāmṛtātmatām | adyānnajaladānena dāsye sāmrājyamarthavat ||52|| adya rathādidānena dāsye svargavimānakam | adya vastrapradānena dāsye vārdhyambarā kṣitim ||53 || adya kanyādidānena dāsye sahasrayoṣitaḥ | adya gavāṃ pradānena dāsye pṛthvīṃ rasānvitām ||54|| adya gṛhapradānena dāsye brahmāṇḍagahvaram | adya phalapradānena dāsye kalpadrumāvalim ||55|| adya bhūṣāpradānena dāsye svargaṃ subhūṣitam | adya me pūjayā dāsye trilokipūjyatāṃ sadā ||56 || yadyadicchantu me bhaktastattad dāsye na saṃśayaḥ | dundubhistvevamākhyāya kṣaṇaṃ mauno babhūva ha ||57|| rājā brahmasavitā ca bhūriśṛṃgā ca tatpriyā | natvā taṃ dundubhiṃ pūjāṃ dadau kṛṣṇapradūtakam ||58|| adhimāse parapakṣe tṛtīyāyāstu dampatī | cakāra vratamekānnaṃ bhuktvā dyumaṇivāñcchayā ||59|| cāturmāsye dīpadāne sūryo bhavāmi keśava | sapatnīkastrilokānāṃ netrātmā saṃbhavāmyaham ||6 0 || evaṃ saṃkalpya rājāsau tatpatnī cakraturvratam | prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ smṛtvā dhyātveṣṭarūpamujjvalam ||6 1 || maṇḍape maṇḍale kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ ghaṭe śubhe | āropyānarcaturbhaktyā sauvarṇaṃ puruṣottamam ||62|| pañcāmṛtaiḥ śuddhavārbhiḥ saṃsnāpyādiśya cāmbare | bhūṣāḥ puṣpāṇi hārādyān samarpayyātha candanaiḥ ||6 3 || dhūpadīpādibhirdevaṃ saṃpūjyākṣatakuṃkumaiḥ | ṣaṭapaṃcāśadvidhaṃ tvannaṃ miṣṭaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ jalaṃ phalam || 64|| arpayāmāsatuścobhau bhaktyā śrīpuruṣottamam | nīrājayāmāsatuśca cakratuḥ supradakṣiṇam ||65 || daṇḍavannamanaṃ kṛtvā cakratuḥ stavanaṃ tataḥ | puṣpāṃjaliṃ dadatuśca prārthayāmāsatuḥ kṣamām ||66|| madhyāhne’pi tathā sāyaṃ rātrau cakraturarcanam | nṛtyaṃ sajāgaraṃ tatra cakraturbahumānavaiḥ ||67|| prādurbabhūva bhagavān sarvatejonidhirhariḥ | pūjayā ca vratenāpi cāturmāsyavratena ca || 68 || dīpadānena sarvatra prasanno’smyatibhaktitaḥ | taveṣṭaṃ yat trilokānāṃ netrasthānaṃ mahattamam ||69|| dāsye tvambarasūryatvaṃ sabhāryastvaṃ ravirbhava | ityākhyāya haristasmāt sthānādantarhito’bhavat ||70 || kṛtvā brahmasavitā ca nṛtyaṃ prajāgaraṃ tathā | bhūriśṛṃgāsahitaḥ saḥ prātardānāni sandadau ||7 1 || maṇiratnāni ca gāśca mahiṣīrgajavājinaḥ | ajāvikāstathā svarṇarūpyapātrāmbarāṇi ca ||72|| dāsadāsīśca paryaṃkān gṛhāṇi bhavanāni ca | kṣetrāṇi vāṭikāścaivodyānāni ca vanāni ca ||73 || annāni kūpavāpīṃśca bhūmiṃ kārpāsakāni ca | kauśeyāni tathaurṇāni dadau cānarghyakāṇi saḥ ||74|| brāhmaṇībhyastu śṛṃgāravastūni vividhāni ca | yatibhyastu bṛsīpātrakamaṇḍalvādikāni ca ||75|| gṛhasthebhyastu gārhasthyayogyavastūni sandadau | kṣudhitebhyo dadau bhojyaṃ tṛṣitebhyo jalaṃ dadau ||76 || tattatsukhārthikebhyaḥ sa dadau tatsukhasādhanam | arthibhyaḥ pradadau tvarthān sarvaṃ dadau tu śārṅgiṇe ||77 || evaṃ lakṣmi kṛtaṃ brahmasavitrā dānamuttamam | kṛtaṃ tathaiva ca bhūriśṛṃgayā patisammatam ||78|| bhojayitvātha sādhvādīn bhoktuṃ yāti ca dampatī | tatrāyātastadā bhikṣurūpaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||79|| svarṇarekhātmikā lakṣmīḥ rājate yasya vakṣasi | pāṇḍurāṅkamayī śrīśca rājate sakthni vāmake ||80 || kare dakṣe dhvajo matsyaḥ svastikaśca dhanustathā | rājante padmapatrākṣa tejaḥparidhikasya vai ||8 1 || dṛṣṭvā rājñī nṛpo bhikṣuṃ jñātvāṃkaistu narāyaṇam | bhojayitvā pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakraturādarāt ||82|| tāvad dvayostatra mūrtau jātaḥ samādhirāntaraḥ | dṛṣṭaṃ brahmasavitrā tu sūryākhyaṃ golakaṃ mahat ||83 || tatra hiraṇmayaṃ svasya varṣma dṛṣṭaṃ parātparam | yena tejomayaṃ sarvaṃ jagad yāti prakāśitām ||84|| dṛṣṭaṃ saṃjñāsvarūpaṃ ca svasyā vai bhūriśṛṃgayā | hiraṇmayīṃ sūryapatnīṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭiṃ jagāma sā ||85|| haristirobhavat tāvadutthitau tau samādhitaḥ | āścaryacakitau jātau menāte pūrṇamānasau ||86 || sevete sma sadā kṛṣṇaṃ pratīkṣete sma sūryatām | tāvad babhūva kalpasya nidhanaṃ kramayogataḥ ||87|| rājā rājñī layaṃ yātau prāptau sudivyavigrahau | yānena sūryakāntena yayatuśca mahasstaram ||88 || niśāṃ tu kṣapayitvā tau kalpādau sarjanānvaye | sūryarūpo babhūvāyaṃ brahmasavitṛbhūpatiḥ ||8 9|| tatpatnī bhūriśṛṃgā ca babhūva viśvakarmajā | saṃjñānāmnī sutā sā ca pitrārpitāṃśumāline || 90 || bhūriśṛṃgāsavitārau saṃjñāsūryau babhūvatuḥ | sarvanetrapradau devau ko’nyo labhed raveḥ padam || 91 || iti prāptau paraṃ sthānaṃ yāvatsvargaṃ prakāśate | dīpadānaprabhāveṇa tṛtīyāyā vratena ca || 92||| tasmād dīpāḥ pradātavyā devālayeṣu nityadā | anandhatvaṃ prakāśitvaṃ divyatvaṃ tena cāpnuyāt||| 93 || yathā brahmasavitā sa prāptavān sūryatāṃ nṛpaḥ | śroturvaktuḥ kathāyāśca lābho vai tādṛśo bhavet || 9 4|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi sūryanārāyaṇīyakam | ākhyānaṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ pāvanaṃ puṇyadaṃ hitam || 95 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye pūrvakalpīyasya brahmasavitrākhyarājño bhūriśṛṃgākhyapatnīsahitasya dvitīyapakṣatṛtīyāyā vratena dīpādivividhadānena ca sūryanārāyaṇatāyāḥ saṃjñābhidhapannīprāptisahitāyā labdhiritinirūpaṇanāmā daśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.310 ||
<1.311> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi pūrvakalpodbhavā kathā | saurāṣṭre raivatabhūmau samitpīyūṣanāmakaḥ || 1 || rājā babhūva tatpatnyo babhūvuḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ | ūrjāhutiḥ puṣkariṇī padmapatrā karīṣiṇī || 2 || viśvapriyādityavarṇā hariṇī hemamālinī | vasudhītirvahniśikhā padmākṣī padmamālinī || 3 || prabhāsā jagatī paṃktirbṛhatīḍā piśaṃginī | suṣumṇā ca purītatirviśvārciḥ padmanemikā || 4 || hiraṇyavarṇā candrā ca padmavarṇā ca vamrikā | vidyullekhā ca tāḥ sarvāḥ pātivratyaparāyaṇāḥ || 5 || kurvantyo bhagavadbhaktiṃ dānadharmaparāyaṇāḥ | atithīnāṃ ca satkāraṃ kurvantyo bhāvapūrvakam || 6 || snānaṃ dhyānaṃ devapūjāṃ japaṃ kurvanti cādarāt | homaṃ daivaṃ tathā paitryaṃ bhautaṃ kurvanti satkratum || 7 || āśritān bhojayitvaiva bhuñjanti ca pibanti ca | śatasāhasradāsīṣu satīṣvapi svahastakaiḥ || 8 || viṣṇoḥ sevāṃ dhavasevāṃ kurvanti svīyadharmataḥ | viṣṇorarthaṃ pācanaṃ ca taṇḍulādiviśodhanam || 9 || kaṇḍanaṃ vāribharaṇaṃ gṛhamārjanamityapi | pātrāṇāṃ devapūjāyā gharṣaṇaṃ kṣālanādikam || 10 || tulasīpatrapuṣpāṇāmāhṛtyādyaṃ ca tāḥ sadā | kurvantyeva mahābhaktyā nānyadvārā kadācana || 11 || haryarthaṃ khalu bhaktānāṃ kimakārye bhavennanu | sarvasvaṃ tvarpitaṃ yatra varṣmaṇā kiṃ na jāyate || 12 || anityena tu dehena nityaṃ puṇyaṃ samarjayet | yena bhuktistathā muktiḥ kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā bhavet || 13 || sa eva sarvathā vandyaḥ pūjyastoṣyaḥ pareśvaraḥ | yasmāt sarvaṃ prabhavati bhogyaṃ bhojyaṃ sukhādikam || 14|| sampat smṛddhirdhanaṃ patnī patiḥ sutasutādikam | kṣetraṃ svargaṃ mahārājyaṃ yasmāttaṃ vai bhajed budhaḥ || 15|| yāvat svāsthyaṃ bhaved dehe vaśyamindriyamaṇḍalam | jāṭharāgniryuvā paktā daihike sānukūlatā || 1 6|| tāvadātmahitaṃ sādhyaṃ kāmyaṃ vā kāmavarjitam | parameśapadaṃ nityānandapūrṇaṃ tu śāśvatam || 17|| vigame vikale bhāve na syādvai darśanādikam | śrīharestat sadā kāryaṃ darśanaṃ cakṣuṣā mudā || 18|| vikarṇe badhire bhāve na syānnāmaśravo hareḥ | sugame sānukūle’smin kāryaṃ śravaṇamācyutam || 1 9|| vṛkṇe vā vikale sevā na bhavedvai satāṃ hareḥ | subale sānukūle ca haste sevyo hariḥ svayam || 20 || prabale sugame pāde gamyaṃ mandiramaiśvaram | anudvigne’pramatte ca mānase vājasaṃbhṛte || 2 1 || mantavyo bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sukhapradaḥ | antarātmā svātmanā vai samupāsyaḥ sadā prabhuḥ || 22|| bhagne tu nagare sarve tyaktvā yāsyanti viṣṭayaḥ | dṛḍhapādātmake tatra sādhyaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 23|| evaṃ nirṇīya sarvāstāḥ samitpīyūṣayoṣitaḥ | sevante śrīhariṃ nityaṃ mandire nirmite śubhe || 24|| samitpīyūṣanṛpatiścakre triṣavaṇaṃ sadā | trikālaṃ prārcanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sandadhe || 25|| evaṃ vai vartamānānāṃ tāsāṃ kālo mahān gataḥ | tatkalpe kārtikakṛṣṇāṣṭamī kṛṣṇāṣṭamī hyabhūt || 26|| dīpotsavatitheḥ pūrvaṃ saptāhavyavadhānikī | iṣapūrṇāṃ samārabhya cakrustā ekabhuktakam ||27|| aṣṭamyāmupavāsaṃ ca cakrustā nirjalaṃ mudā | puruṣottamasaṃjñasya kṛṣṇasya pratimāṃ śubhām ||28 || kānakīṃ kārayitvā ca tathā kṛṣṇasya mātaram | kaṃbharākhyāṃ kānakīṃ ca kārayitvā ca tāstathā || 29 || gopālaṃ kṛṣṇapitaraṃ kārayitvā tu kānakam | maṇḍapaṃ kārayitvā cānarcuḥ śrīpuruṣottamam || 30 || nṛtyaṃ savādyaṃ cakrustāḥ kaṇṭhasvaravimiśritam | tāvadāvirbabhūva śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ || 31 || caturbhujaḥ kaustubhāḍhyaḥ pītāmbarādikāmbaraḥ | navīnajaladaśyāmaḥ śvetakāntivirājitaḥ || 3 2 || dṛṣṭvāścarya tu tāḥ prāpuḥ kṣaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | tatastā mumuhustatra divyamūrtau manohare || 33 || divyābhūṣādi cānīyārpayāmāsuḥ sasaṃbhramāḥ | ūrjāhutī dadau tasmai pauraṭaṃ mukuṭaṃ tadā || 34|| puṣkariṇī dadau tasmai pauraṭe kuṇḍale śubhe | padmapatrā tallalāṭe cakre puṇḍraṃ tu cāndanam || 35|| karīṣiṇī dṛśostasya cakre satkajjalāṃjanam | viśvapriyā svarṇapuṣpahārān dadau tu śārṅgiṇe || 36 || ādityavarṇā pradadau kaṭake bhujabandhakau | hariṇī tvarpitavatī hyūrmikāḥ kānakīrnavāḥ || 37|| hemamālinī pradadau raśanāṃ śṛṃkhalāṃ śubhām | vasudhītirdadau svarṇanūpurau kiṃkiṇīyutau || 38 || vahniśikhārpitavatī pāduke svarṇanirmite | padmākṣī pradadau yajñopavītaṃ yogapaṭṭakam || 39 || padmamālinī pradadau miṣṭānnaṃ śākapāyasam | prabhāsā pradadau tasmai pānāya śītalaṃ jalam ||40 || jagatī tvarpitavatī phalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tathā | paṃktirdadau sugandhaṃ ca puṣpasāraṃ ca dhūpakam ||41 || bṛhatī pradadau tasmai ghṛtadīpaṃ sumaṃgalam | iḍā chatraṃ dadhārāsya śirasi svarṇabhāsvaram ||42|| suṣumṇā piṃgalā śvete dadhyatuścāmare hyubhe | purītat vyajanaṃ dhṛtvā karoti pavanārpaṇam ||43 || viśvārcirnaktakaṃ ramyaṃ kṛṣṇahaste dadau tadā | padmanemirdadau puṣpagucchaṃ kṛṣṇakare tadā ||44|| hiraṇyavarṇā pradadau cakraṃ sahasranemikam | candrā dadau kṛṣṇahaste padmaṃ suvarṇanirmitam ||45|| padmavarṇā dadau śaṃkhaṃ vamrī dadau tadā gadām | vidyullekhā dadau cāsmai cūmbanaṃ paramātmane ||46|| sā sarvābhyo babhūvātipremapātraṃ parātmanaḥ | tatpuṇyenātyadhikaṃ sā patyuḥ premāspadā punaḥ ||47|| candrapatnī rohiṇī sā janmāntare babhūva vai | ityevaṃ tūpadāḥ datvārārtrikaṃ tāśca cakrire ||48|| anyāstu cūmbanaṃ dṛṣṭvā lajjāṃ hṛtsu prapedire | phalaṃ tāsāṃ nātimānaṃ candrāt tāstu prapedire |||49|| dāsī sarvajitānāmnī pādasaṃvāhanaṃ vyadhāt | sā tu sevāparā yasmāt snehapātraṃ tadābhavat |||50|| puṣpākṣatāñjalīn cārghyaṃ tāśca sarvā dadustataḥ | pradakṣiṇanamaskārastavanādyaṃ pracakrire ||51 || kṛṣṇastvatiprasannaśca dadau prasādapāyasam | gṛhītvā tṛptimāpannā dadhyustaṃ hṛdayāmbuje ||52|| kṛṣṇaḥ prāha tu tā devīrbhavantvamṛtabhojanāḥ | svarṇaratnamaṇihārā divyā divi kṛtagṛhāḥ ||53 || ityāśiṣaḥ pradāyaivādṛśyo babhūva keśavaḥ | tāstu pūjāṃ samāpyaiva patiṃ prāhurudantakam ||54|| atituṣṭo babhūvāpi samītpīyūṣabhūpatiḥ | nityaṃ patnīyutaḥ svargaṃ vāñchati pūjanottaram ||55|| patnyaścāpi tu vāñchaṃti kṛṣṇoktaṃ nākamaiśvaram | evaṃ kāle gate kalpaprānte kṛṣṇasya vai śrutaḥ ||56|| dundubhirghoṣaṇāṃ kurvan puruṣottamaśāsanām | śṛṇvantu vai narā nāryo devā devyopi madvacaḥ |||57|| yāsāṃ yeṣāṃ yatheṣṭaṃ yad dāsyāmi tattathāvidham | puruṣottamasaṃjño’haṃ paraṃbrahma sanātanaḥ ||58|| pravadāmi kṛpayā vai vinā puṇyasya tolanam | svalpe kṛte’pyasaṃkhyātaṃ phalaṃ dadāmi sarvathā ||59|| ye janā me phalaṃ puṣpaṃ patraṃ candanamakṣatān | arpayiṣyantyadhimāse caturthyāṃ kāmyakarmakṛt ||60 || teṣāṃ tu kāmanāḥ sarvāḥ pūrayiṣye pumuttamaḥ | sarvaṃ me’sti mayi sarvaṃ mayā vyāpta carācaram ||6 1 || nātiriktaṃ svatantraṃ vai kiñcidasti jaḍājaḍam | jaḍaṃ cāpyajaḍaṃ tattvaṃ madīyaṃ tvasti sarvathā ||62|| mokṣasthānāni sarvāṇi siddhyaiśvaryasthalānyapi | vibhūtayaśceśvarāṇāṃ devānāṃ ca padāni vai ||63|| mānavānāṃ tathā pātālasthānāṃ ca samṛddhayaḥ | sarvaṃ tvasti mamaivedaṃ yadicchantu dadāmyaham ||64|| puruṣottamamāsasya vrataṃ pākṣikamāhnikam | naiśaṃ vāpi kṛtaṃ yena tasya kiñcinna durlabham ||65|| rājā yathābalaṃ kuryād vrataṃ dānaṃ ca pūjanam | prajā yathādhanaṃ kuryād vrataṃ dānaṃ samarpaṇam ||66 || naro nārī yathādharmaṃ kuryānme’dhikamāsikam | vrataṃ te me janaṃ bāhaṃ vismarāmi kadācana ||67|| adya kālāntare vāpi yathātoṣaṃ phalaṃ bahu | dadāmyeva na sandeho na me bhakto’phalo bhavet ||68|| sakāmasya kṛte svargādayo lokāḥ kṛtā mayā | akāmasya kṛte brahmaloko’sti rakṣito mayā ||69|| sarveṣu sukhabāhulyaṃ brahmaloke tvanantakam | dadāmyāśritabhaktāya madarthe vratakāriṇe ||7 0 || nātra mūlyaṃ svakṛtasya mūlyaṃ tu vacaso mama | vaco mama dhṛtaṃ yena phalaṃ tasyāpyanantakam ||7 1 || nahi vṛṣṭiprade yajñe kṛte vṛṣṭirhi tādṛśī | yādṛśī ghanakāle syādamānā cāpyanantakā ||72 || svayaṃ varṣāmi bhagavān śrīhariḥ puruṣottamaḥ | kṛpayā ghanarūpo’haṃ puruṣottamamāsi vai ||73 || yathāpātraṃ yathāpekṣaṃ pragṛhṇantu mayārpitam | vastraphāle phalaṃ kṛtvā vikīryate’nu yāntu tat ||74|| puruṣottamamāsasya kariṣyanti praśaṃsanam | ye’pi te’pyarjayiṣyanti yatheṣṭaṃ sukhamuttamam ||75|| puruṣottamamāsasya vratārthe tvanyadehinām | anumodaṃ pradāsyanti te’pi svaḥsukhabhāginaḥ ||76|| adhimāse vratakartuḥ sāhāyyaṃ ye tu mānavāḥ | kariṣyanti ca tebhyo’pi dāsye yathepsitaṃ sukham ||77|| kimu syād durlabhaṃ cādhimāse bhaktasya me khalu | dhāma dāsye dhanaṃ dāsye dārān dāsye sutān paśūn ||78 || patiṃ dāsye sutāṃ dāsye gāṃ rājyaṃ cirajīvitām | ārogyaṃ cendriyānandaṃ dāsye’pi śāśvataṃ sukham || 79|| iti vai dundubhiṃ śrutvā samitpīyūṣabhūpatiḥ | tatpatnyaścātibhaktisthā api vai saptaviṃśatiḥ ||8 0 || dāsī ca dundubhiṃ natvākṣatapuṣpaphalādibhiḥ | sampūjya cakrire kartuṃ caturthīvratamuttamam ||8 1 || prātaḥ pūjāṃ hareḥ kṛtvā madhyāhne’pi sabhojanam | pūjanaṃ kārayitvaiva sāyaṃ cakruḥ prapūjanam ||82|| pāyasaṃ pūrikāḥ bhojayitvārārtrikamādadhuḥ | nṛtyagītapravādyaiścakrire jāgaraṇaṃ niśi ||83|| prātaḥ snātvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sampūjya bhāvataḥ | dānaṃ dadustu ratnānāṃ rasānāṃ samidhāṃ tathā ||84|| haviṣyāṇāṃ cāmṛtānāṃ miṣṭānnānāṃ ca dakṣiṇāḥ | svarṇarūpyātmikāścāpi phalavastūni vai daduḥ ||85|| candrakāntān daduḥ saumyān śītalān svarṇadāndaduḥ | tadā viprasvarūpeṇa śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||86|| samājagāma satpātraṃ bhūtvā ratnābhilāṣukaḥ | samitpīyūṣanṛpatistadā sarvapriyāyutaḥ ||87|| dadau ratnāḍhyamālāṃ ca namaścakre’tibhāvataḥ | vipraḥ prāha varaṃ rājan yācasva bhavitā tathā ||88|| samitpīyūṣa ākarṇya vavre cāndraṃ surājyakam | sudhāvarṣitvarūpaṃ vai yayāce samidhāṃ kṛte ||89|| patnyaścāpi tathā candrapatnītvaṃ vavrire divi | tathāstviti varaṃ datvā tirobabhūva bhūsuraḥ ||90 || kalpānte pralayaṃ prāpya sṛṣṭyādau sa tu bhūpatiḥ | samitpīyūṣanāmno’rthaṃ sārthaṃ kurvan haricchayā ||9 1|| amṛtāṃśuścauṣadhīnāṃ poṣakaścandramā divi | babhūva tasya patnyaśca dakṣaputryaḥ prajajñire ||92|| dakṣeṇa vidhinā dattāstasmai tāḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ | vidyullekhā babhūvāgryā rohiṇīnāmataḥ priyā ||93|| anyāścāpi mṛgaśīrṣā hyārdrā punarvasustathā | puṣyāśleṣā maghā pūrvaphālgunyuttaraphālgunī ||94|| hastaścitrā tathā svātī viśākhā cānurādhikā | jyeṣṭhā mūlā pūrvaṣāḍhottarāṣāḍhā śravātmikā ||95|| dhaniṣṭhā śatabhīṣā ca pūrvabhādrapadā tathā | uttarabhadrikā caiva revatī tvaśvinī tathā ||96|| bharaṇī kṛttikā ceti militāḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ | babhūvuśca divi candrapatnyo devyo’mṛtapradāḥ ||97|| dāsī devayutīnāmnī jātābhijitsamāhvayā | madhyāhne’syāḥ kṛto vāsaḥ sarvakāryajayapradaḥ ||98|| ākalpaṃ tāśca vartante caturthyā vratapuṇyataḥ | tasmāt kāryamadhivāso’paracaturthyupoṣaṇam ||99|| ekabhuktaṃ ca vā naktaṃ phalāhāraṃ mamārcanam | śrotā vaktā tathā cāsya caturthīvratabhāgbhavet || 100 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye samitpīyūṣarājñastatsaptaviṃśatipatnīnāṃ dundubhiśravaṇottaraṃ dvitīyapakṣacaturthīvratakaraṇena divi candrarājyanakṣatrarājyaprāptirdāsyā abhijittvaprāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekādaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.311 ||
<1.312> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi kathā prāksṛṣṭisaṃbhavā | vasudhānākhyanṛpateḥ rādhyāsāyāśca yoṣitaḥ || 1 || pūrvasṛṣṭyantime kāle nṛpo babhūva dakṣiṇe | vasudhāno mahābhakto mahādevasya sevakaḥ || 2 || rādhyāsā tasya patnī ca mahādevasya sevikā | ārādhanāṃ mahādevātmakasya svāminaḥ sadā || 3 || karotyabhinnabhāvena pātivratyaparāyaṇā | nityaṃ prātaḥ svayaṃ snātvā patiṃ snāpayati prabhum || 4 || mahādevaṃ vividhaistu jalairdugdhādibhistathā | patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ vastraṃ sarpaṃ ca śarkarāṃ jalam || 5 || ārārtrikaṃ candanaṃ ca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ samarpya sā | vasudhānasya sevāyāṃ dāsīva samatiṣṭhati || 6 || rājāpi prātarājñāya tyaktvā nidrāṃ muhūrtakam | dhyātvā śrīśaṃkaraṃ brahma snānaṃ pūjāṃ karoti ca || 7 || hṛdi dhyānaṃ tathā pūjāṃ śaṃbhoḥ kṛtvā vibhajya ca | annādikaṃ tvāśritebhyo bhuṃktennaṃ strīyuto nṛpaḥ || 8 || rājyakārye prajākāryaṃ kurutastau kṛpānvitau | devakāryaṃ dānakāryaṃ kuruto nityamātmavat || 9 || dadato’nnaṃ bhikṣukebhyo vastrāṇi tadapekṣiṇe | pātrāṇi dānapātrāya dhanāni ca phalāni ca || 10 || dānaśabdastayordvāri virāmaṃ yāti naiva ha | dānakriyāpi ca śāntā naiva bhavatyaharniśam || 11 || yajñānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ ca satāmapi | tayorgṛhe’rhaṇāṃ śaṃbhoraharniśaṃ prajāyate || 1 2 || gavāṃ dānaṃ rasadānaṃ miṣṭadānaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | kurutastau patipatnyau tuṣṭā yathārthinastathā || 13 || na tadrājye’vagrahosti vatsaro na kratuṃ vinā | na cotsavā vinā kṛṣṇaṃ vinā śaṃbhuṃ na kīrtanam || 14 || pravartayāmāsatustau rājye dharmān śivasya vai | śivālayeṣu sarveṣu pūjāṃ kārayataśca tau || 15|| grāmādhīśān samāhūya sarvām̐stau viṣayasthitān | ājñāpayāmāsatustau pūjā deyā śivālaye || 16|| anyathā satyamevedaṃ sa nau daṇḍyo bhaviṣyati | pūjādānācchivastuṣṭo bhaviṣyati śivāyutaḥ || 17|| ghṛtadīpāstvakhaṇḍā vai tatra devāḥ śivālaye | yasya yasyābhito grāmaṃ yāvantaśca śivālayāḥ || 18|| tatra tatrākhaṇḍadīpo dyotanīyo nṛpājñayā | nṛpājñābhaṃgakartustu śiraśchedo bhaviṣyati || 19|| nṛpapūjā pradātavyā ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ | nyūnakartustathā rājā śiraśchetsyatyasaṃśayam ||20|| iti sarvatra tābhyāṃ vai lakṣmi pūjā vinirmitā | tayostu bhayato dīpā dīptā pratiśivālayam ||21|| jagmatustau mahāśaṃbhu rātryāṃ darśanahetave | vyomayānena sarvatra rājye yatra śivālayāḥ ||22|| āprātastau tu sarvatra vidhāyārcanadarśanam | punarāyāta āvāsaṃ kurutaḥ snānapūjanam ||23|| cikīrṣataḥ pāraṇā tau niṣīdata sma yāvatā | tāvattatra samāyātau bhikṣukau tu śivāśivau ||24|| jñātvā vai kṣudhitau sādhū dadatastau subhojyakam | riktaṃ tulasīpatreṇa vīkṣyāhatustu tāvubhau ||25|| nārāyaṇaprasādaśced bhokṣyāvahe pavitrakam | vaiṣṇavau vaiṣṇavaśreṣṭhau śivāśivau na bhokṣyataḥ ||26|| yadi prāsādikaṃ na syācchrīpuruṣottamārpitam | vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo dharmo vaiṣṇavatvaṃ paraṃ tapaḥ ||27|| vaiṣṇavaistu kṛtaṃ dattaṃ gṛhṇīvo’tīva bhāvataḥ | yadi vaiṣṇavadattaṃ na gṛhṇīvo na tu vai kvacit ||28|| yuvābhyāmarpyate nityaṃ pūjābhojanadīpakam | paśyāvo na tu gṛhṇīvo gṛhṇīvo brahmaṇe’rpitam ||29|| ātmanivedibhaktānāṃ dharmo’yaṃ sarvadā mataḥ | brahmaṇe’narpitaṃ yat tadbhojyaṃ peyaṃ na vai kvacit ||30|| vastraṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ payaścānnaṃ tathāsanam | auṣadhaṃ kaṇamātraṃ vā cūrṇaṃ carvaṇamityapi ||3 1|| adya svādyaṃ tathā khādyaṃ bhogyaṃ dhāryaṃ mamārghyakam | mardyaṃ deyaṃ tathārpyaṃ ca sarvaṃ yad brahmaṇe’rpitam || 32|| tad gṛhṇīvo na cānyadvai dharmo’yaṃ tvāvayoḥ sadā | sarvaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ grāhyaṃ gṛhavastradhanādikam ||33 || jaḍaṃ yadvā cetanaṃ vā svakīyaṃ yaddhi manyate | tadvai bhagavate datvā śiṣṭaṃ bhuñjīta bhaktarāṭ || 34|| gṛhastaṃbheṣu vai vāri kuṃbhīṣu mañjulāsu ca | peṣaṇīṣu ca khaṭvāsu paryaṃkādiṣvapi gṛhe ||35||| tulasīkaṇṭhikāṃ baddhvā tūpayoktavyameva tat| paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ harmyaśākhināṃ śakaṭasya ca || 36|| vaiṣṇavatvaṃ vinā naiva kartavyamupayojanam | annānāṃ tvatha vastrāṇāṃ cakrāṇāṃ vāhanasya ca || 37|| jīvikālohabhastrāṇāṃ kośānāṃ paṇyakasya ca | vaiṣṇavatvamṛte naiva kartavyamupayojanam || 38|| vādyānāṃ cāpi śastrāṇāṃ hetīnāṃ vastunāminām | ātmanivedinā kāryā bhagavaccihnayogitā || 39|| sutaḥ sutā dhana dārā dāsā dāsyo gṛhāṇi ca | patnī patiḥ kuṭumbaṃ ca sarvaṃ vai haraye’rpayet ||40 || abhakṣyaṃ tadabhogyaṃ yaddharaye nārpitaṃ bhavet | bhakṣyaṃ bhogyaṃ tathā peyaṃ haraye’rpitameva yat ||41 || nibodhata yuvāṃ tadvai badaryāśramamuttamam | prāgahaṃ prāptavām̐statra nārāyaṇātsamantrakam ||42 || vaiṣṇavatvaṃ tato devyai pārvatyai ca samantrakam | vaiṣṇavatvaṃ mayā dattaṃ gaṇebhyaścāpi sarvathā ||43|| mama putro gaṇeśastu śrīkṛṣṇāṃśo’sti vaiṣṇavaḥ | skando’pi vaiṣṇavo jāto rudrā api ca vaiṣṇavāḥ ||44|| devyaśca vaiṣṇavīśreṣṭhā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ | kailāsaḥ sarvathābhīṣṭo vaiṣṇavo’sti mayā kṛtaḥ ||45|| badaryāśramayogena himālayo’pi vaiṣṇavaḥ | pitaro vaiṣṇavāsteṣāṃ kanyā menāpi vaiṣṇavī ||46|| kṣīro’pi sāgaro viṣṇudhārako vaiṣṇavaḥ sadā | tatputrī śrīḥ ramā lakṣmīścandraścaite’pi vaiṣṇavāḥ ||47|| vāmanasya padāṃguṣṭhasparśā gaṃgāpi vaiṣṇavī | vāsukiḥ śeṣabandhuśca vaiṣṇavo’sti mayā dhṛtaḥ ||48|| triśūlaṃ sūryato jātaṃ dvādaśo viṣṇurarkarāṭ | vṛṣabho gokulātprāpto goloke kṛṣṇabhaktarāṭ ||49 || siṃho nṛsiṃhavaṃśo yaḥ sa cāsti vaiṣṇavo mahān | meghā vairājakeśāśca vaiṣṇavā yajñapoṣitāḥ ||50 || mayūro meghamitraṃ ca picchaṃ mukuṭasaṃśritam | kṛṣṇayogānmeghayogād vaiṣṇavatvaṃ sadāsti vai ||51 || kimvadhikaṃ pravakṣye vai nṛsiṃhamastakaṃ gale | dadhan vai vaiṣṇavaścāsmi viṣṇubhakto’smi sarvathā ||52|| viṣṇurvai vyāpakaṃ brahma yattejo’haṃ sadāśivaḥ | bāṇarūpo’smi sañjāto dhyāyam̐staṃ mūrtimānapi ||53|| sarvātmakaṃ parabrahma nārāyaṇaḥ parātparaḥ | tasmādahaṃ tathā sarvaṃ jāyate tatra līyate ||54|| tato rājan gṛhāṇa tvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ manumādarāt | ahaṃ śaṃbhuḥ pradadāmi rājñyai dāsyati pārvatī ||55 || ityādiṣṭo vasudhāno jagrāhāṣṭākṣaraṃ manum | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’vyānmāmiti jagrāha śaṃkarāt ||56 || taṃ ca jagrāha rādhyāsā rājñī vai pārvatīmukhāt | jagṛhatuśca tulasīkaṇṭhīṃ candrārdhvapuṇḍrakam ||57|| nārāyaṇārcanavāri prasādaṃ cācyutasya vai | ādadati tu tau tatra prajātau vaiṣṇavau tataḥ ||58|| viṣṇave bhojanaṃ peyaṃ tulasīpatramiśritam | nivedayāmāsatuśca dadatuścāpi śaṃbhave ||59 || pārvatyai dadatuścātha jagṛhatuśca tau mudā | ādaturvāripānaṃ ca cakraturvai sukhānvitau ||6 0 || tṛptau babhūvatuścāti harṣitau vai śivāśivau | āśīrvādān dadatuśca dhanavantāvakhaṇḍitau ||6 1 || susmṛddhau śāśvatarājyau bhavatāṃ bhṛtyakoṭikau | iti kṛtvā kathayitvādṛśyau jātau śivāśivau ||6 2|| rājñā rātryā ca nityaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | śivātmāyaṃ ceti bhaktyā pūjyate vaiṣṇavīdiśā ||6 3 || evaṃ tābhyāṃ sadā kṛṣṇe pūjite puruṣottamaḥ | māso’tidivyasamayaḥ prāpto vyeti dināddinam ||64|| tāvat tābhyāṃ parapakṣapañcamyāṃ dundubhiḥ śrutaḥ | śṛṇvantu devatanavo rājadehāśca mānavāḥ ||65 || surā divyasamṛddhāśca sthāvarā jaṃgamāśca ye | puruṣottamamāsasyāsmi dundubhirhareḥ priyaḥ ||66 || haryājñayoddhoṣayāmi maṇiṃ kapardikāphalam | māse’traikadinakṛcchrāt prāpnuvantu vasundharām ||67|| alakāṃ hemanagarīṃ tathā bhūmiṃ ca kāṃcanīm | golokasthāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ dikpālānāṃ tu hāṭakīm ||68|| rājadhānīṃ tathā svarṇapurīṃ hiraṇmayīṃ tanum | sāmrājyaṃ cāpi vānyadvai yatheṣṭaṃ yāntu vai hareḥ ||69|| rasādhipatyaṃ sauryaṃ vā cāndraṃ gaura padaṃ ca vā | bārhaspatyaṃ tathaiśānaṃ tvāgneyaṃ vānyadeva vā ||70|| yeṣāmiṣṭaṃ tu yadvai syād dāsye tannātra saṃśayaḥ | adhimāse tu sampūrṇa pākṣikaṃ dainikaṃ ca vā ||71 || vrataṃ prapūjanaṃ kṛtvārjayantu paramaṃ sukham | parameṣṭhipadaṃ vāpi vairājaṃ satyamityapi ||72|| raudraṃ śaivaṃ ca vā brāhmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma caityapi | gṛhṇantu kṛpayā me’dya pañcamīvratamātrataḥ ||73|| ityuktvā dundubhistatra virarāmātha tāvubhau | natvā taṃ dundubhiṃ dhyātvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ||74|| pupūjatustaṃ vādyaṃ vai puṣpākṣataistu kānakaiḥ | arthayāmāsatustatra kāṃcaneyaṃ padaṃ mahat ||75|| tathāstvevaṃ dundubhiśca vicintya hṛdye tadā | anyatra prayayau tau pañcamīvrataṃ pracakratuḥ ||76|| prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā śaṃbhuṃ natvā tathādarāt | guruṃ prapūjya vidhivaccakraturnaityakārcanam ||77|| mūrtiṃ vidhāya sauvarṇīṃ puruṣottamarūpaṇīm | āvāhya tatra ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam ||78 || ācamanaṃ pradāyaiva pañcāmṛtena vāriṇā | snāpayāmāsatustau ca mārjayāmāsatustathā ||79|| mardayāmāsatuścaitau candanārdrasugandhibhiḥ | dhārayāmāsatuścaiva vastrāṇi kānakānyapi ||8 0 || bhūṣayāmāsatuścāpi mukuṭādi vibhūṣaṇaiḥ | śṛṃgārayāmāsatuśca kajjalaiḥ kesarādibhiḥ ||8 1 || sugandhayāmāsatuśca puṣpadhūpādisārakaiḥ | prakāśayāmāsatuśca dīpanīrājanādibhiḥ ||82|| prasādayāmāsatuśca stutipradakṣiṇādibhiḥ | kṣamāpayāmāsatuścāparādhānarghyakārpaṇaiḥ ||83 || santarpayāmāsatuśca miṣṭānnapāyasādibhiḥ | santoṣayāmāsatuśca tāmbūlailādicarvaṇaiḥ ||84|| evaṃ madhyāhnasamaye pūjayāmāsatustathā | bhojayāmāsatuścāpi niśyapyevaṃ pracakratuḥ ||85|| maṇḍapaṃ kadalīstaṃbhaiḥ pāllavaistoraṇaistathā | sumanohārakaiścāpi kalaśairdīpakaistathā ||86 || racayāmāsatū ramyaṃ pūrayāmāsatuśca tau | maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ madhye dhānyairnavairnavaiḥ ||87|| saṃsthāpayāmāsatuśca sauvarṇaṃ kalaśaṃ tataḥ | tatra ghaṭe pañcaratnaṃ jalaṃ phalaṃ tathāmbaram ||88 || vinyasya tilapūrṇāṃ ca sthālīṃ dadhyaturādarāt | tatra mūrtiṃ pratiṣṭhāpya pupūjatuḥ suvastubhiḥ ||89|| snānaṃ vastraṃ candanaṃ kuṃkumaṃ puṣpāṇi cākṣatān | vibhūṣaṇāni hārām̐śca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ phalāni ca || 90 || ārārtrikaṃ stutiṃ pradakṣiṇāṃ miṣṭānnabhojanam | jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ cakraturarthanām ||91 || nartanaṃ gītikāṃ vādyasahitāṃ cakratustadā | tato jāgaraṇe tatra madhyarātrau pumuttamaḥ ||92|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāllakṣmīśrīrādhikāpatiḥ | pārvatīmāṇikīsvāmī prabheśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||93|| preyasīśreyasīpātā śrījayālalitāpatiḥ | akṣarādhipatirmuktapatirgopīpatiḥ prabhuḥ ||94|| sarvapatiścāntarātmā maṃgalāyatano hariḥ | prādurbabhūva sahasā vihasan kāśayan diśaḥ ||95|| prāhāsmyatiprasanno’haṃ pañcamyā vratavartanāt | varadānaṃ prayacchāmi vṛṇuta yadyathepsitam ||96 || bhaktau me vaiṣṇavau jātau tenāsmyatipratoṣitaḥ | dadāmi mama sarvasvaṃ kimanyanyat sudurlabham ||97|| śrutvā natvā daṇḍavacca prāhatuḥ puruṣottamam | vasudhānaśca rādhyāsā prabho nāviditaṃ tava ||98|| caturdaśānāṃ lokānāṃ dhanādhipatyamalpakam | kāṃkṣāvahe na tatsvāmin raṃkatuṣṭikaraṃ hi tat ||99|| pārameṣṭhyapadaṃ svāmin kuṃbhakārakriyāmayam | necchāvastatpadaṃ tasmādaindraṃ daityaprapīḍanam || 100 || tatpadāni na kāṃkṣāvaḥ kāṃkṣāvastatparaṃ tu yat | yāvatāmīśvarāṇāṃ vairājādīnāṃ paraṃ tu yat || 10 1|| mahāviṣṇoḥ paraṃ yacca hiraṇyādhipateḥ padam| śrīpurākhyātparaṃ yacca tejo vaikuṇṭhataḥ param || 102|| viṣṇorvai sthānataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ hiraṇyādhipateḥ padam | māhākauberakaṃ puṃso bhūmnaḥ kośamayaṃ tu yat || 1 03|| īśvarāṇāṃ tu koṭau tad vartate yanmahattamam | anantāṇḍakuberāṇāṃ tṛptistasya kaṇena vai || 1 04|| jāyate tanmahārājyaṃ bhūmnaḥ kośādhipātmakam | sarveśānāṃ tu vai divyahiraṇyāttiryato’sti vai || 105|| taddhiraṇyādhipatyaṃ vai samicchāvaḥ kṛpāstu te | bhaktānāṃ tu kṛte kiñcidadhikaṃ svāmino’sti na ||10 6|| yadyayuktaṃ vāñcchitaṃ cet kṣamyatāṃ puruṣottama | nānyat kāṃkṣāvahe kṛṣṇa tuṣṭo yatpuruṣottamaḥ || 107|| ityabhyarthya pādayostau patitau śrīharestadā | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha prāhāpi punareva tau || 108|| vartamānasya hairaṇyādhipaterāyuṣaḥ kṣaye | sargāntare bhavanto vai bhaviṣyathastathāvidhau || 109|| ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇastirobabhūva tatsthalāt | anantānāṃ hiraṇyādhipatīnāṃ tatra saṃkṣayaḥ || 11 0|| jāyate vāsudevasya dine dine na saṃśayaḥ | tatraikasya hiraṇyādhipaternāśo’bhavattadā || 111 || vasudhānaṃ ca rādhyāsāṃ nināya tatpadaṃ prabhuḥ | mahākauberakaṃ caiśaṃ padaṃ tābhyāṃ dadau hariḥ || 1 12|| hiraṇyādhipatirbhūtvā rājate vasudhānakaḥ | rādhyāsāpīśvarī śreṣṭhā kuberāṇī virājate || 1 13|| yadasya brahmaṇaścaturmukhasya padmajasya vai | pitā virāṭ tasya pitā mahāviṣṇustataḥ paraḥ || 1 14|| yo nāma pūruṣaśca bhūmanārāyaṇābhidhaḥ | tasya kośeśvaro bhūtvā vasudhāno narādhipaḥ || 1 15|| vartate’yaṃ bhūmakośādhipaḥ sarvādhipo yathā | prākṛtapralayaṃ yāvad vartiṣyate dhanādhipaḥ || 1 16|| sākṣātpratyakṣadarśitvād vedmyahaṃ puruṣottamaḥ | lakṣmi priye na cānyo’sti sarvajño māṃ vinā yataḥ || 1 17|| parabrahmasvarūpo’haṃ vedmi sarvajñasarvavit | ityevaṃ vai mayā tābhyāṃ pūrvasṛṣṭyantakālikam || 1 18|| pañcamyāstu vratasyānte phalaṃ datta hi śāśvatam | idṛgvidhaṃ phalaṃ dātuṃ śaktaḥ kaḥ syāddhi māṃ vinā || 1 19|| sarve vai kālakavalāḥ ṛte nārāyaṇaṃ khalu | sarvaṃ sṛṣṭvā praviśāmi vasāmi viramāmi ca || 120 || tathāpyakuṇṭhavijñāno bhavāmyeko na cāparaḥ | tadatra kathitaḥ pūrvasṛṣṭivṛttānta eva te || 121|| pañcamyāṃ vratakarturhi narasyāpi striyāstathā | śroturvaktuḥ phalaṃ tādṛgasya vai bhavate dhruvam || 122|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye dvitīyapakṣasya pañcamyāṃ vratakaraṇena śivabhaktayoḥ pūrvasṛṣṭisthayoḥ rādhyāsārājñīvasudānanṛpayoḥ śivapradattavaiṣṇavatvottaraṃ vedhaḥpitṛvairājādapyūrdhvamīśvarasṛṣṭau vartamānasṛṣṭau hiraṇyakośādhipatitvātmakamahākauberapadaprāptivarṇananāmā dvādaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||1.312||
<1.313> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi śrīpuruṣottamāśritā | kathā sampatpradā saukhyapradā sarveṣṭadā sadā || 1 || pūrve kalpe brahmaṇo vai marudeśe’tidhārmikaḥ | dhanāḍhyo brāhmaṇo nāmnā devayavo babhūva ha || 2 || tasya patnī devajuṣṭāpyāsītpativratā śubhā | tayorbhṛtyo girikṣito bhṛtyā cādridyutistathā || 3 || babhūvatuḥ sadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaparāyaṇau | svāmikāryaṃ vidhāyaiva kṛṣṇacaryā pracakratuḥ || 4 || brahmakarmaparā nityaṃ ṣaṭkarmādiparāyaṇāḥ | catvāraste babhūvurvai kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇāḥ || 5 || brāhmaṇau svāminau cāpi viprāṇyau sevike ca te | haryarthaṃ manasā vāṇyā tanvā ninyuḥ kṣaṇātkṣaṇam || 6 || marudeśādhipatinā rājñā devasakhena vai | nagaryāṃ bhāsvatīnāmnyāṃ kāritaṃ viṣṇumandiram || 7 || saptaśikharasaṃśobhaṃ tryagragolamanoharam | svarṇastaṃbhāṃganaramyaṃ triprākāramanoharam || 8 || madhye tu śikharāntaḥsthasiṃhāsane caturbhujaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo viṣṇurlakṣmīrādhāsamanvitaḥ || 9 || dakṣaśikharagarbheṣu śrīprabhāpārvatītrikam | svasvadāsīsamājuṣṭaṃ pratyekaṃ rājate śubham || 10 || vāmaśikharagarbheṣu māṇikyā lalitā jayā | svasvadāsīsamājuṣṭā pratyekaṃ rājate triṣu || 1 1|| tatsevāyā niyuktāste catvāro vai pṛthak pṛthak | devayavo madhyabhāge pūjāṃ karoti sarvadā || 1 2|| girikṣito bahiścandanādikāryakaro’bhavat | devajuṣṭā dakṣabhāge pārvatīśrīprabhārcanam || 13 || adridyutirvāmabhāge māṇikyādyarcanādikam | karotyeva vibhāgena rājā dadāti vetanam || 14|| bhavanaṃ vāsayogyaṃ ca jīvikāṃ vāṭikādikām | vārṣikaṃ ca tathā dravyaṃ tathā svarṇasahasrakam || 15|| vastrānnabhūṣaṇādīni dadāti cotsave’dhikam | devapūjāsunaivedyādikaṃ dadāti bhūpatiḥ || 16 || evaṃ vai vartamānena vipradevayavena vai | lobhākṛṣṭena manasā gṛhyate ḍhabbukaṃ kvacit || 17|| kvacittu rūpyakaṃ svarṇamudrā yātrālubhiḥ khalu | devāyārpitamityetaddevadravyaṃ mumoṣa saḥ || 18 || tena cauryaduritena devadhanena miśritam | devayavasya saddravyaṃ dūṣitaṃ tvāsa cañcalam || 1 9|| iyeṣa gantumanyatra caṃcalā hi śriyo matāḥ | devadravyānvitaṃ yattat samūlaṃ nāśameti vai || 20 || yadyapi nyāyalabdhaṃ svaṃ devadravyaspṛśiṃ gatam | dūṣitaṃ tad vinaśyedvai lakṣaṃ nītvā pragacchati || 2 1 || annaṃ cāpi surānnādimiśritaṃ naśyati drutam | vastraṃ devāmbarayuktaṃ nāśayatyeva dehinam || 22|| vastumātraṃ cauryalabdhaṃ yanna prasādarūpataḥ | pūjakācāryagurubhirdattaṃ devasvarūpi tat ||23 || yatra kṣiptaṃ tu tat sarva mūlīyamapi dahyati | cullīkāṣṭhānalo’raṇyagato’raṇyaṃ pradahyati || 24|| gavāmannaṃ bhikṣukānnaṃ viprānnaṃ pramadānnakam | anāthānnaṃ nirādhārānnamagniḥ kupitaḥ sa vai || 25|| brahmasvaṃ vidhavāsvaṃ ca devasvaṃ bhikṣunāṇakam | anāḍhyasvaṃ mahānagniḥ pated yatra sa dahyati || 26|| devapūjākṛtā kiñcitphalaṃ cānnaṃ ca ḍhabbukam | na grāhyaṃ devatātvaṃ ced yato dahati tatkulam || 27|| pūrvaiḥ pūrvatamaiścāpi muṣitaṃ devanāṇakam | tadevānyadapi nyāyyaṃ muṣṇāti muṣakasya vai || 28 || devayavo’pi devasya mandire harisannidhau | yātrālubhistvarpitaṃ ca prakṣiptaṃ ḍhabbukādikam ||2 9|| puṣṇātyeva svake dravye nikṣipati ca vṛddhaye | yena kena nimittena tasya nāśaṃ upāgataḥ || 30 || marukosalayoḥ rājñoryuddhaṃ ghoraṃ babhūva ha | kosalasya tu sainyairvai vijito marubhūpatiḥ || 31 || sainyaistu nagarī sarvā bhāsvatī dhvaṃsitā tadā | dhanāḍhyānāṃ nāṇakāni hṛtāni vai prasahya taiḥ || 3 2|| nṛpamānyaṃ dvijaṃ jñātvā sarvaṃ tasya hṛtaṃ dhanam | niṣkāsitastataḥ sthānāt sabhāryābhṛtyamātrakaḥ || 33 || yayau sa raivatagirau hiraṇyāyāstaṭe śubhe | somanāthasya nikaṣāṃ vane mūlaphalāśanaḥ || 34|| nirgamayatyahānyeva paryaṭan bhṛtyadārayuk | sarasvatīṃ nadī prācīṃ gatvā pippalaśākhinam || 35|| niṣasāda jalaṃ pītvā viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ tadā | sasmāra ca hariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jagadgurum || 36 || cintayāmāsuranyonyaṃ śatrujanyaṃ parābhavam | girikṣitastadā bhṛtyaḥ prāha devayavaṃ dvijam || 37|| yasya vai pūjanaṃ samyak kṛtaṃ tenāpi śārṅgiṇā | rakṣitā na vayaṃ śatrorupadrave’pi sevakāḥ || 38|| sarvasvaṃ vai hṛtaṃ sainyairmandirasyāpi kāṃcanam| tatrāpi rakṣaṇaṃ naiva kṛtaṃ śrīviṣṇunā tadā || 39|| parasya rakṣaṇaṃ kasmāt kuryād yaḥ svaṃ na rakṣayet | ityukte brāhmaṇo devayavaḥ prāha svabhṛtyakam || 40 || maivaṃ vada tathā nāsti yathā tvaṃ vadasi dvija | rakṣati śrīhariḥ sarvān jīvato rakṣitā vayam ||4 1 || rakṣā kṛtā caturṇāṃ vai yajjīvāmo’tra saṃyutāḥ | devadravyāpahārasya pātakaṃ tvantavarjitam ||42|| tatkṛtaṃ vai mayā tacca dravyaṃ svadravyamiśritam | tena sarvaṃ gato no vai dravyaṃ matpātakena vai ||43|| devadravyaṃ ca devānnaṃ yasya kośe hi jīryati | tasya sarvasvanāśāya phalaṃ bhavati niścitam ||44|| sarvasvaṃ tadgataṃ yogyaṃ phalamatraiva cārjitam | yamaloko’pi bhoktavyo hyadhunā śiṣyate’pi hi ||45|| tathāpi sevanasyaitatphalaṃ rakṣati no’tra vai | yadvayaṃ ghātitā naiva rakṣitāḥ paramātmanā ||46 || devadravyaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalādikam | vastraṃ yānaṃ gṛhaṃ pātraṃ bhoktavyaṃ naiva sarvathā ||47|| anyāyenāpi lobhenājñānenāpi prasahya vā | bhuktaṃ yadi tadā tattu bhokturnāśakaraṃ bhavet ||48|| tadvayaṃ nāśitā naiva kṛpā seyaṃ harerdvija | atha yatnaḥ prakartavyo yathā yamo na saṃcaret ||49 || prapannānāṃ haristrātā yamastatra na saṃcaret | prapattau ṣaḍvidhatvaṃ vai nārāyaṇena darśitam ||5 0 || viśvāso varaṇaṃ nyāsaḥ kārpaṇyaṃ ca sthirā matiḥ | ānukūlyasya saṃkalpaḥ prātikūlyavivarjanam ||5 1 || tatra harirmadarthaṃ yat karoti sakalaṃ tu tat | madarthaṃ yogyamevāsti tvevaṃ viśvāsamācaret ||52 || tvaṃ mamāsi tavāhaṃ cetyevaṃ varaṇamarthayet | sarvasvo’haṃ pādayoste nyasto’smi nyāsamācaret ||5 3 || satyapi sārvabhaume’pi kārpaṇyaṃ dāsavaccaret | sarvanāśe’pi khedaṃ na kuryānmatiṃ sthirāṃ caret ||5 4|| tava toṣo mama toṣo nānyatheti sukalpayet | ityevaṃ tasya yadramyaṃ ramyameva mamāpi tat ||5 5 || nānyaditi prakuryādvai matvā bhaktiṃ sadā hareḥ | aparādhān kṣamāpyaiva so’smān saṃtārayiṣyati ||56 || udarārthaṃ pralobhena kṛtaṃ cauryādi pātakam | tatsarvaṃ bhagavān bhaktyā dhruvaṃ prajvālayiṣyati ||57|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ brahma vyāharam̐staṃ tvanusmaran | yaḥ prayāti tyajanvarṣma sa yāti paramaṃ padam ||5 8 || tasmādatraiva sattīrthe hyuṣitvā cirameva tu | ārādhya taṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ yāsyāma vai punaḥ ||59|| yadvāyuṣyakṣaye tasya dhāma prāpsyāma īpsitam | aparādhasahasrāṇi sa śrīhariḥ kṣamiṣyate ||6 0|| iti vicārya catvāraḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇābhidhām | japayajñaṃ pracakruste prācīsarasvatīsthale ||6 1 || prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā pupūjurnityameva te | dalaṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ kandādi yadupasthitam ||62|| arpayanti haraye te jalārthaṃ prārthanādikam | kurvanti sma prage madhye sāyaṃ niśi punaḥ punaḥ ||63|| evaṃ vai vartamāneṣu vyomamārgeṇa saṃśrutaḥ | dundubhistvadhimāsasya śrīpuruṣottamoditaḥ ||64|| ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prātardundubhestu puruṣottamamāsi vai | ghoṣaṇā mokṣadā yadvā sakāmānāṃ tu bhogadā ||65|| pravartate sma sā karṇapathaṃ prāptā manoramā | caturbhistvapi sadhyānāṃ vicārvāvadhṛtā hṛdi ||66 || śṛṇvantu mānavāḥ sarve nirdhanāḥ sadhanā api | nirāgasaḥ sāparādhāstathā nāryo narā api ||67|| pūjāyāṃ me tvaparādhā bhavanti bahavopi vai | yadi kaiścit kṛtāstān vai gaṇayiṣye manāṅ na vai ||68|| kurvantu vratamadyaiva ṣaṣṭhyāṃ dvitīyapakṣake | puruṣottamamāsyasmin kṣamayiṣye nu pātakam ||69|| vajralepādikaṃ pāpaṃ kṣālayiṣye’dya vai vratāt | ekabhuktaṃ ca vā naktaṃ vinā yāñcāṃ samāgatam ||70|| gṛhītvāpi tu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vai vrataṃ kāryaṃ mamātra hi | phalaṃ bhuktvā jalaṃ pītvā grasitvā pavanaṃ ca vā ||7 1|| vrataṃ kārya mama ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tasmai dāsye yathepsitam | prāk kṛtaṃ me viparītaṃ smariṣye tanna sarvathā ||72|| adyāhaṃ kṛpayā dāsye tadiṣṭaṃ puruṣottamaḥ | puruṣottamamāso’yaṃ vartate bhuvanatraye ||73|| īśaloke’pyayaṃ māso mamājñayā pravartate | sarvamūrdhanyamāso’yaṃ mūrdhanyapuruṣottamāt ||74|| mūrdhanyaphaladastasmād vṛṇutepsitamuttamam | ityuktvā dundubhistasmāt sthānāt sthānāntaraṃ yayau ||75|| catvāro brāhmaṇāste tu dāridryaduḥkhapīḍitāḥ | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vrataṃ pracakruste śrutvā dundubhiśabditam ||76|| dāridryaṃ naṣṭatāṃ gacchet sukhaṃ vaibhavasaṃbhavam | pūrvato’pyadhikaṃ syācca viśālā dhanasampadaḥ ||77|| yānavāhanasaudhāni dāsā dāsyaḥ samujjvalāḥ | rājyādapyadhikaṃ sarvaṃ bhavettarhi sukhaṃ bhavet ||78|| ityabhilaṣya taiḥ sarvaistūpavāsavrataṃ kṛtam | pūrvaṃ saṃbhoginaḥ paścād vāñchanti bhogasampadaḥ ||79|| svabhāvaṃ yānti bhūtāni nigrahastu durādharaḥ | yāvadvāñcchā na vai śāntā tāvajjñātā pravartate ||80|| bhaktānāmapi ceṣṭeṣu bhogyeṣvasti pravartanam | rāgaśūnyasya nāstyeva samadraṣṭuḥ pravartanam ||81 || vicārya viṣavat tyaktaṃ yadi rāgo na līyate | tarhi suyoge sampanne punarādātumicchati ||82|| tasmādindriyanairbalyaṃ sādhayanti suyoginaḥ | tapasā kṣālitapāpabalā jayanti māyikam ||83|| anāhāreṇa vijayo bahukleśena vā jayaḥ | śaithilyena ca vijayo bhavatyāhāraśālinām ||84|| ebhistu brāhmaṇairdārāyuktairna vijayaḥ kṛtaḥ | iṣṭaṃ vai māyikaṃ taistu rājyaṃ vai pūrvato’dhikam ||85|| pārameṣṭhyapadaṃ yadvā sūryacandrādikaṃ padam | indrapadasamaṃ devarājavannānyadasti tat ||86|| brahmaṇaḥ sarvadā tvasti vārdhakyaṃ svaprajāḥ prati | sūryacandrādikā vyomni bhramanti paravaśyagāḥ ||87|| pravāsināṃ sukhaṃ nāsti viśrāmo nāsti vai kvacit | aviśrāntaḥ sadā kliṣṭastasmādaindrapadaṃ varam ||88|| rājyaṃ sarvasurāṇāṃ vai dārādhāmadhanādikam | svarge lakṣmīḥ śāśvatī ca smṛddhirindrasya vartate ||89|| tasmādaindrapadaṃ grāhyaṃ bhogottamapradaṃ śubham | paścād bhaktyā samupārjya vaikuṇṭhaṃ divyasādhanam ||90 || evaṃ niścitya taiḥ sarvaiḥ kṛtaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vrataṃ śubham | prātaḥ snātvā mṛdo mūrtiṃ kārayitvā harestadā ||91 || pārśve sphaṭikapāṣāṇaṃ sthāpayitvā tataśca te | āvāhayitvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam ||92|| saṃsnāpya paṃcadugdhādyamṛtena ca jalena ca | vastrābhūṣādravaddravyākṣatapuṣpādicandanaiḥ ||93|| dhūpadīpasunevedyaiḥ phalapatrajalādibhiḥ | saṃpūjyārghyaṃ bilvaphalairyuktaṃ datvā namaḥ stutim ||94|| prārthanāṃ stavanaṃ puṣpāñjalīnsamarpya viṣṇave | āndolayāṃcakrire ca latārajjvādidolane ||95|| madhyāhne ca tathā sāyaṃ rātrau pūjāṃ sajāgarām | cakruste nṛtyagītādi tatrāvirāsa keśavaḥ ||96|| varān vṛṇuta bhaktāḥ stha gataṃ duḥkhaṃ vratena me | yatheṣṭaṃ tvarpayituṃ cāgato’smi toṣito’smi ca ||97|| dṛṣṭvā śrutvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hariṃ caturbhujam | natvā te pādayoḥ puṣpāṃjaliṃ vāri dadustadā ||98|| vavrire devasadanaṃ mahendrapadamṛddhimat | tathāstviti varaṃ datvā haristirobabhūva ha ||99|| adhimāse sarasvatyāstaṭe prācyāḥ supippale | sthale tyaktvā śarīrāṇi catvāro divamāgatāḥ || 1 00|| prāntendrasyāyuṣo nāśe daśalokikṣayottaram | catvāraste yayuḥ saumye maharloke ciraṃsthitāḥ || 10 1|| punaḥ kalpāntarāraṃbhe catvāro divamāgatāḥ | devayavo mahendro vai babhūva vratapuṇyataḥ || 1 02|| devajuṣṭā mahendrāṇī saṃbabhūva hareḥ priyā | girikṣito babhūvendraputro jayantanāmakaḥ || 1 03|| adridyutirvijayantapatnī jātā tu mānasī | viśvakarmasutā tveṣā snuṣā tvindrasya yā matā || 104|| pulomajābhavadindrāṇīti sā mānasī sutā | indrapatnī saṃbabhūva dāsīdāsārbudānvitā || 105|| ṣaṣṭhīvratena vipraistairāptaṃ tvaindrapadaṃ śubham | sukhaṃ deveśvarapadaṃ prāptaṃ śrīharyanugrahāt || 106|| imāṃ kathāṃ paṭhed yastu śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ | tasya ṣaṣṭhīphalaṃ syādvai tatheṣṭaṃ saṃlabheta ca || 1 07|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye marudeśīyadevayavagirikṣitaviprayostatpatnyordevajuṣṭārdradyutyośca devadravyacauryeṇa sarvasvanāśottaraṃ tvadhikamāsasya dvitīyapakṣasya ṣaṣṭhyā vratena mahendrajayantamahendrāṇījāyantīpadaprāptinirūpaṇanāmā trayodaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||1.313||
<1.314> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi camatkāraṃ saptamyāstu vratena vai | brahmaputryāstu sandhyāyā jāto yastaṃ vadāmyaham || 1 || sṛṣṭikartā svayaṃ brahmā sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe tu mānasān | atriṃ mariciṃ pulahaṃ pulastyāṃgirasau kratum || 2 || vaśiṣṭhaṃ nāradaṃ dakṣaṃ bhṛguṃ ceti mahāprabhūn | prasasarja jātamātrān surūpān yauvanānvitān || 3 || kāryadakṣānmanaḥkṣobhakarān divyān yadā tataḥ | tadājamanaso jātā cārurūpā varāṃganā || 4 || nāmnā sandhyā divakṣāntā sāyaṃ sandhyā japantikā | atīva sundarī subhrūrmunicetovimohinī || 5 || mānasyabhūttadā sṛṣṭirna vai kāmādigarbhajā | tato dakṣādayo dhyātā vedhasā kāmasāriṇaḥ || 6 || kāmastatrāvirbabhūva brahmaṇo mānasaḥ sutaḥ | kāṃcanīkṛtajātābho lolaścandranibhānanaḥ || 7 || āraktapāṇinayanānanapādakarādikaḥ | praphullapadmapatrākṣaḥ puṣpakodaṇḍamaṇḍitaḥ || 8 || kāntaḥ kaṭākṣapātena bhrāmayan nayanadvayam | taṃ vīkṣya puruṣaṃ ramyaṃ sandhyā dakṣādikāstadā || 9 || autsukyaṃ paramaṃ jagmuścāṃcalyaṃ rājasaṃ tathā | indriyānandabhānaṃ ca prāpuste sāpa kāmanām || 10 || harṣaṇaṃ rocanaṃ cāpi mohanaṃ śoṣaṇaṃ tathā | drāvaṇaṃ sumano’strāṇi kāmo jagrāha vai tadā || 1 1|| brahmā prāha tadā kāmaṃ puṣpabāṇaistu pañcabhiḥ | mohayanpuruṣānstrīṃśca kuru sṛṣṭisahāyatām || 12|| ahaṃ vā vāsudevo vā sthāṇurvā puruṣottamaḥ | bhaviṣyāmastvadvaśe’tra kimanye prāṇadhārakāḥ ||13|| pracchannarūpo jantūnāṃ praviśan hṛdayaṃ sadā | sukhahetuḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā sṛṣṭiṃ kuru sanātanīm || 14|| ājñāpayitvā brahmā taṃ svāsane niṣasāda ha | dakṣādayo niṣeduśca sandhyā copāviveśa ha || 15|| tāvat kāmastutānsarvānparīkṣārthaṃ prayatnataḥ | ālīḍhasthānamāsādya dhanurākṛṣya vai balāt || 16|| kāmārthe puṣpajātairvai yojayāmāsa mārgaṇaiḥ | dakṣādyā mohitāḥ sarve vikāraṃ prāpurāditaḥ || 17|| sandhyāṃ sarve nirīkṣanto vikṛtiṃ bahudhā yayuḥ | tadaiva conapañcāśadbhāvā jātāḥ śarīrataḥ || 18|| sandhyāpi vīkṣyamāṇā taiścakre bhāvānkaṭākṣagān | atha bhāvayutāṃ sandhyāṃ dṛṣṭvātivikṛtiṃ gatāḥ || 19|| sandhyā yūnaśca tāndṛṣṭvā viśiṣṭāṃ vikṛtiṃ gatā | madanaśca nije kārye śraddadhe phalabhāvanaḥ ||| 20|| yadidaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kāryaṃ mamoddiṣṭaṃ mayāpi tat | kartuṃ śakyamiti tvaddhā niścitaṃ saphalaṃ nanu ||21|| tadā tu vikṛtāndṛṣṭvā dharmadevaḥ sutaḥ svayam | pitaraṃ ca tathā bhrātṝn sandhyāṃ prāha vivekataḥ ||22|| dharmārthaṃ madano jāto nādharmārthe kadācana | kuṭumbaṃ vikṛtiṃ prāptaṃ tvanyonyaṃ madanena hi ||23|| naitadyogyaṃ prajānāṃ hi
