kṣemakṛnna bhaviṣyati | yauvane jātamātre ced yadi kāmapraveśanam ||24|| tadā mātā ca bhaginī bhrātṛpatnī tathā sutā | pitā bhrātā patiḥ putra ityāmnāyo vinaṃkṣyati ||25|| jātamātrasya tu kāmo yauvanaṃ na bhavedyathā | tathā kuru vidhātastvaṃ yena dharmāvanaṃ bhavet ||26|| dharma prāhāpi kāmaṃ ca kṛtavām̐stvaṃ hi vaiśasam | ayogye cāpyakāle ca tato bhasmī bhaviṣyasi ||27|| dharmaḥ prāha ca dakṣādīn yāta badarikāśramam | gaṃgāṃ snātvā hariṃ natvā tapastaptvā tu pāvanāḥ ||28|| bhavantyatha tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ kurvantu dharmataḥ sadā | dharmaḥ prāha ca pitaraṃ yaśaṃ kuru pitāmaha ||29|| brahmā sṛṣṭau prathamaṃ tu yajñaṃ cakāra vaidikam | tato jātāstu parjanyāstṛptidā annadāḥ sadā ||3 0|| dharmaḥ prāha tataḥ sandhyāṃ vikāradoṣayoginīm | śvapacasya bhava putrī tataḥ śuddhā bhaviṣyasi || 3 1|| sandhyā prāha tadā dharmaṃ yatiṣye tapasā yathā | jātamātrasya kāmo’yaṃ na bādheta tathā ciram ||32|| itivṛttottaraṃ sarve yathoddiṣṭaṃ yayustataḥ | sandhyāpyamarṣamāpannā tadā dhyānaparābhavat ||33|| idaṃ vimamṛśe yogyaṃ bhaviṣyatsukhadaṃ bhavet | utpannamātrā cāhaṃ suyuvatī kāmamohitā ||34|| dakṣādyāśca tathā jātā mayi kāmena mohitāḥ | sarveṣāṃ mathitaṃ cittaṃ madanena kuṭumbinā ||35|| prāpnuyāṃ phalametasya pāpasya tvagharūpiṇaḥ | kariṣyāmyasya pāpasya prāyaścittamahaṃ svayam ||36|| tacchodhanaphalaṃ śīghramahamicchāmi sādhanam | nijāṃ tapasi hoṣyāmi dharmamārgānusārataḥ ||37|| kiṃ tvekāṃ sthāpayiṣyāmi maryādāmiha sarvathā | yathā notpannamātrā vai sakāmāḥ syuḥ śarīriṇaḥ ||38|| etadarthamahaṃ kṛtvā tapaḥ paramadāruṇam | maryādāṃ sthāpayiṣyāmi tyakṣyāmi duṣṭajīvitam ||39|| mayānena śarīreṇa kuṭumbisvajaneṣu vai | udbhāvitaḥ kāmabhāvo na tatsukṛtasādhanam ||40 || evaṃ vicārya manasā sandhyā yogasamādhinā | tenaiva tu śarīreṇa chāyātmakena mānasī ||41 || sūkṣmībhūya duritasya nāśāya śvapacagṛhe | jātismarā sutā jātā jātamātrā sayauvanā ||42|| rākhālo janakastasyā mātā mātaṅginī tadā | karmacāṇḍālatāṃ prāptau vasataḥ sma himācale ||43|| yatra nāvagrahaḥ kaścinnāsti niṣphalavṛkṣatā | nāsti yatra marudeśastādṛśyāṃ vasato bhuvi ||44|| dharmaśāpaṃ pūrvajanma smṛtavatyeva nityadā | samayaṃ kṣapayāmāsa śuddhikṛttapaādinā ||45|| pitarau sevayāmāsa pāpakṣālanaśaktikau | pratīkṣamāṇā taṃ kālaṃ yena śuddhirbhaved yathā ||46|| tāvadbhūmau vicarantaḥ patitoddhārakārakāḥ | saptarṣayastato vyomnā nirjagmurbadarīṃ prati ||47|| vane tatra sthale tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā te yogacakṣuṣā | avateruśca te bhikṣāmiṣeṇa śvapacagṛham ||48|| yadyapi karmacāṇḍālo brahmaputro hyayaṃ khalu | phalādyarthe bhikṣaṇīyo yatra bādho na vidyate ||49|| apakvānne’pi na doṣaḥ kaṇeṣu nāsti sūtakam | yayācire vicāryetthaṃ bhikṣāṃ śvapacavṛkṣataḥ ||50|| śvapacastān dvijān jñātvā kanyābhijñāya sarvathā | saharṣaṃ pradadau bhikṣāṃ vāṇībandhanapūrvikām ||51 || śvapacaḥ pādayornatvā pītvā pādāmṛtaṃ jalam | prārthayāmāsa saptarṣīn jagaduddhārakārakān ||52|| bhikṣāṃ phalānnakanyāḍhyāṃ gṛhṇantu munayo’malāḥ | kanyāṃ cāsmānuddharantu kanyāṃ bhikṣāṃ dadāmi vaḥ ||53|| ṛṣīṇāmānumatyena vaśiṣṭho vedhasoṃ’śakaḥ | jagrāha bhikṣāṃ kanyāṃ ca nītvā yayuśca badrikām ||54|| tāṃ kanyāṃ te tu saṃsnāpya gaṃgāyāṃ badarīvane | kāmadhenuśarīrāntarmukhātpraveśanaṃ tu te ||55|| kārayitvā prabhāveṇa mūtradvāreṇa tāṃ tadā | bahirniṣkāsayāmāsurjanmāntaragatābhavat ||56|| babhūva pāvanī sā tu hyupavītenasaṃskṛtā | dvijatvaṃ ca tapoyogyaṃ labdhavatī tu kanyakā ||57|| athāpi sā tapasārthe maryādāṃ kāmayauvanām | sthāpayituṃ vācchati sma provāca ṛṣaye smitā ||58|| maharṣe lokamaryādā jātamātre tu yauvane | rakṣyate naiva bhūtānāṃ tasyāḥ sthāpanahetave ||59|| tapaḥ kartuṃ samicchāmi candrabhāgānadītaṭe | yadyājñā brahmadevasya vācchāmi carituṃ tapaḥ ||60|| jñātvā hārdaṃ tu gambhīraṃ bahviṣṭaṃ tu nijasya vai | omityuvāca tāṃ tatra vasiṣṭhastapasāṃ nidhiḥ ||61|| vīkṣāṃcakre sarastatra bṛhallohitasaṃjñakam | candrabhāgānadīṃ tasmātprākārād dakṣiṇāmbudhim ||62|| yāntīṃ dadarśa sā caiva tathā sānugirermahat | nirbhidya paścimaṃ sā tu candrabhāgagirernadī ||6 3|| pāvayantī janāndeśān śanairgacchati sāgaram | tasmin girau candrabhāge bṛhallohitasattaṭe ||64|| avatīrya vyomamārgād vaśiṣṭhastāmuvāca ha | kurvatraiva tapo devi rakṣāsūtraṃ gṛhāṇa ca ||65|| prakoṣṭhe dhāryamevaitad rakṣaṇaṃ te bhaviṣyati | ityuktvā te yayustasmād ṛṣayaḥ satyalokakam ||66 || tatrātapattapo ghoraṃ svayaṃ devī tvarundhatī | saubhāgyakāṃkṣamāṇā sā gaurīpūjāparāyaṇā ||67|| pāpanāśanayatnā ca kāmaniyamatatparā | tapasā svalpakālena gaurī prāvirbabhūva ca ||68|| uvāca paramārādhyorundhati puruṣottamaḥ | tamekaṃ jagatāmādyaṃ bhajasva puruṣottamam ||6 9 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya onamo’stu te | mantreṇānena sarveśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaja śubhānane ||70 || tena te sakalāvāptirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | snānaṃ maunena kartavyaṃ maunena haripūjanam ||71 || jalāhāraṃ phalāhāraṃ kandāhāramupoṣaṇam | vāyvāhāraṃ bhojanaṃ vā ṣaṣṭhe kāle samācaret ||72|| kuru tvevaṃ tapasyāṃ tvaṃ sarvābhīṣṭamavāpsyasi | mālānāṃ tu sahasre dve sahasraṃ vā japo’nvaham ||73|| uktamantreṇa kartavyo mūrtiṃ kṛṣṇasya cintayeḥ | tāmābhāṣya mahāgaurī tatraivāntardadhe tataḥ ||74|| sandhyāpi ca taporītiṃ jñātvā modamavāpa ha | tapaścartuṃ samārebhe bṛhallohitatīragā ||75 || divyajñānaṃ divyacakṣurdivyāṃ vācamavāpa sā | divyakarṇau prāptavatī tapaścacāra dāruṇam ||76 || puruṣottamamāsasya saptamyāṃ parapakṣake | śuśrāva dundubhiṃ divyaṃ prātareva tvarundhatī ||77|| śṛṇvantu tāpasāḥ sarve tāpasyaśca kṛpāmayam | puruṣottamavādyo’haṃ pravadāmyatyabhīṣṭadam ||78|| adhikamāsasaptamyāṃ nirāhāraṃ vrataṃ caret | pūjayitvā yathālabdhopacārairbhojayeddharim ||79|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātprātarvai pāraṇāṃ caret| dānaṃ dadyātphalādīnāṃ jalenārghyaṃ dadettataḥ ||80|| visarjayet kṣamāṃ prārthya sa yāyātsukhamuttamam | śrutvā tayā dundubheścārcanaṃ kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ vratam ||8 1 || patrapuṣpaphalairvārbhiḥ pūjitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | bhojitaśca phalaiḥ pakvairarthito hṛdayena ca ||82|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prātarbrāhme muhūrtake | dhyāne sthitā kṣaṇaṃ yāvattāvaddadarśa taṃ harim ||83|| pratyakṣaṃ vīkṣya sā kṛṣṇaṃ tuṣṭāva jagatāṃ patim | sthūla sūkṣmaṃ yasya vaśyaṃ naumi tvāṃ puruṣottamam ||84|| nityānandaṃ pāvanānāṃ pāvanaṃ tvāṃ namāmyaham | śrīdaṃ sveṣṭapradaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ namāmyaham ||85|| pradhānapuruṣau yasya kāyatvena vyavasthitau | tasmai kṛṣṇāya hṛdyāya vāraṃ vāraṃ namonamaḥ ||86 || tvaṃ paraḥ paramātmā ca paraṃbrahma pumuttamaḥ | striyā mayā kathaṃ varṇyo bhūyo bhūyo namo’stu te ||87|| ityāśrutya vacastasyāḥ prasannaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | arundhatyāḥ śarīraṃ tu valkalājinaśobhitam ||88|| sajaṭaṃ śāntavadanaṃ nirīkṣyāha hariḥ svayam | prīto’smi tapasā caiva vratena ca stavena te ||89 || yena te vidyate kāryaṃ varaṃ varaya sāmpratam | tat kariṣye tu bhadraṃ te prasanno’haṃ tava vrataiḥ ||90|| iti śrutvā suprasannā sandhyovāca praṇamya tam | yadi deyo varaḥ prītyā varayogyāsmyahaṃ yadi ||9 1 || yadi śuddhāsmyahaṃ jātā kāmavikṛtipātakāt | yadi kṛṣṇa prasanno’si vratena mama sāmpratam ||92|| vṛttastadāyaṃ prathamo varo mama vidhīyatām | utpannamātrāste sṛṣṭau sakāmā mā bhavantviti ||9 3 || dvitīyaśca varo me’stu prathitā sarvasṛṣṭiṣu | bhaviṣyāmi yathāhaṃ vai tathā mānyā bhavediti ||94|| tṛtīyaśca varo me’stu sandhyāyāṃ kāmanāvataḥ | pauruṣaṃ nāśamāyātu prajā piśācatāṃ vrajet ||95|| caturthastu varo me’stu mama rūpacatuṣṭayam | bhavatu prathamaṃ tatra prātaḥ sandhyāmayaṃ śubham ||96 || dvitīyaṃ tu bhavet sāyaṃ sandhyārūpaṃ supuṇyadam | tṛtīyaṃ tu vaśiṣṭhasya patnī svarge bhavāmi vai ||97|| caturthe tu tava dāsīrūpaṃ bhavatu dhāmani | iti varān samabhyarthya maunāṃ tāmāha mādhavaḥ ||98|| yadyad vṛttaṃ tvayā sandhye dattaṃ tadakhilaṃ mayā | vratena tapasā sandhye tvatpāpaṃ bhasmatāṃ gatam ||99|| prathamaṃ tu varaṃ tatra śṛṇu kāmasya rodhatām | prathamaṃ śaiśavo bhāvaḥ kaumārākhyo dvitīyakaḥ || 100 || tṛtīyo yauvano bhāvaścaturtho vārdhakastathā | tṛtīye tvatha saṃprāpte yauvane kāmanā bhavet || 10 1|| iti maryādayā sṛṣṭau ita ārabhya kāmanā | sampatsyate jātamātrāḥ sakāmā syurna dehinaḥ || 1 02|| dvitīyaṃ tu varaṃ khyātiṃ satībhāvena yāsyasi | triṣu lokeṣu nānyasyāstathā kīrtirbhaviṣyati || 1 03|| tṛtīyaṃ tu varaṃ sandhyākāle tvanaṃgasevinaḥ | piśācāḥ saṃbhaviṣyanti balapauruṣavarjitāḥ || 1 04|| caturthaṃ tu varaṃ prātaḥ sāyaṃ sandhyādvayaṃ bhava | patiryaste vaśiṣṭho’sti bhavatācchāśvataḥ patiḥ || 105|| saptakalpāntajīvī ca tapodravyastvayā saha | svarge tena saha vāso yatheṣṭaṃ te bhavediti || 1 06|| atha divyasvarūpeṇa brahmatanvā mayā saha | kuru vaikuṇṭhavāsaṃ me bhava dāsyaruṇābhidhā || 1 07|| iti te ye varā mattaḥ prārthitāste’rpitā mayā | anyacca śṛṇu kārye’smin kāyākalpaṃ samācara || 1 08|| etacchailopatyakāyāṃ candrabhāgānadītaṭe | medhātithiḥ ṛṣiyajñaṃ karoti tāpasāśrame || 109|| tapasā tatsamo nāsti na bhūto na bhaviṣyati | tasya jyotiṣṭomayajñe vahnau janairalakṣitā || 11 0|| sūkṣmarūpaṃ samāpannā kāyāpariṇatiṃ kuru | tadagnau śodhitāṃ varṣmacatuṣṭayaṃ gṛhāṇa vai || 11 1|| prātaḥsandhyā tathā sāyaṃsandhyā bhūtvā sthirā bhava | patiṃ vaśiṣṭhaṃ māṃ dhyātvā śreṣṭhaṃ kanyādvayaṃ bhava ||1 1 2|| ekā medhātitheḥ putrī vaśiṣṭhasya priyā bhava | dvitīyā mama dāsī ca aruṇākhyā priyā bhava || 11 3|| ayaṃ tu parvataste vai nāmnā syādaruṇācalaḥ | mahattīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ vai lokamānya bhaviṣyati || 1 14|| ityabhidhāya bhagavān karau datvā tu mastake | premṇā nibhālya tāṃ tatrāntarhitaḥ saṃbabhūva ha || 1 15|| sandhyāpyagacchattatraiva medhātithimakhasthale | smṛtvā kāntaṃ vaśiṣṭhaṃ ca tathā śrīpuruṣottamam || 1 16|| sā viveśa samiddhe’gnau na kenāpyupalakṣitā | śarīraṃ malinaṃ tasyā vahninā saṃskṛtaṃ tadā || 1 17|| śodhitaṃ divyatāṃ prāptaṃ devārhaṃ hrāsavarjitam | śuddhaṃ praveśayāmāsa vahnistatsūryamaṇḍalam || 1 18|| sūryastvardhaṃ vibhajyaitaccharīraṃ tu tadā rathe | svake saṃsthāpayāmāsa prītaye pitṛdevayoḥ || 1 19|| tadūrdhvabhāgo’tyaruṇaḥ prātaḥsandhyābhavacchubhā | aruṇodayavelā sā devānāṃ prītikāriṇī || 120|| taccheṣabhāgastasyāstu sāyaṃsandhyāstame ravau | sūryāstamanavelā sā pitṝṇāṃ modakāriṇī || 121 || tasyāḥ prāṇāstadā dhyātā hariṇā tattu śāśvatam | brāhmaṃ varṣma babhūvāsyāḥ sā divyā kanyakābhavat || 122|| aruṇā sā brahmadhāmagatā garuḍagāminī | atha yajñāvasāne tu muninā vahnikuṇḍataḥ || 123 || prāptā putrī vahnijanyā taptakāṃcanasannibhā | arundhatīti tasyāstu nāma cakre sa vai muniḥ || 124|| na ruddhaṇi yato dharmaṃ sā kasmādapi kāraṇāt | asya viṣṇoḥ sadā dharmaṃ ruṇaddhīti hyarudhantī || 125 || atha sā vavṛdhe kanyā guṇairvarṣairmunergṛhe | vaśiṣṭhena vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa pitā tataḥ || 126|| asyā vivāhasatkārye surāśca munayo yayuḥ | brahmaviṣṇumaheśāścābhavannāśīrvacaḥparāḥ || 1 27|| arundhatī mahāsādhvī reje vaśiṣṭhasaṃgatā | iti sandhyācaritraṃ te kathitaṃ lakṣmi pāvanam || 128|| dharmadārḍhyakaraṃ divyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam | adhimāsasya cāntasya saptamyāstu vratena vai || 129 || tapasā ca prasannaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | dadau yayeṣṭaṃ rūpāṇi tvaruṇāyai pumuttamaḥ || 13 0|| yedaṃ saṃśṛṇuyānnārī naro vā dṛḍhamānasaḥ | sarvān kāmānavāpnoti puruṣottamatoṣaṇāt || 13 1|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe dakṣādīnāṃ sandhyāyā brahmaṇaśca kāmena parābhave vikṛtibhāvottaraṃ dharmadevavacanaiḥ sandhyāyāḥ śvapacaputrītvaṃ bhikṣāmiṣeṇa vaśiṣṭhādisaptarṣibhiḥ sandhyāyā grahaṇaṃ kāmadhenumukhe nikṣipya mūtradvāreṇa niṣkāsanaṃ tapo’rthe candrabhāgātīre’vasthānaṃ gaurīprāvirbhāvaḥ saptamīvratena puruṣottamaprāvirbhāvaḥ kāmadevasya yauvane utpattiriti niyamanaṃ prātaḥsāyaṃsandhyādvayabhavanaṃ medhātithiṛṣikṛtayajñakuṇḍe’dṛśyatayā praveśanaṃ kāyāśodhanaṃ divyāruṇāyāḥ svarūpeṇa brahmadhāmagamanaṃ arundhatyākhyāyā vahnikuṇḍotpannasutātmikāyā vaśiṣṭhena vivāhottaraṃ svargagamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturdaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||1.314||
<1.315> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ te’pi me’pi jātāṃ purātanīm | puruṣottamamāsasya miṣeṇa janmabodhinīm || 1 || yadā nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaścobhau yātau parākṣare | malamāsasya sāhāyyaṃ kartuṃ śrīharisannidhau || 2 || dhāmnyakṣare tadā rājatpuruṣottamamādhavaḥ | śrutvārthyaṃ malamāsāya dattavām̐ścottamāṃ sthitim || 3 || kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ nārāyaṇasya vacanaṃ tathā | malamāsonnatidaṃ tad rakṣitaṃ paramātmanā || 4 || svayaṃ jāto’dhidevaśca māso’pi puruṣottamaḥ | tena tuṣṭaḥ paraṃ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇastutoṣa ca || 5 || malamāsasya vai dvābhyāṃ kṛtamuddharaṇaṃ mahat | tannimittaṃ tu goloke gatvā kṛṣṇaḥ śriyā yutaḥ || 6 || mahotsavaṃ cakārottamottamaṃ dhāmavāsiṣu | gopagopīgaṇāstasya pārṣadāḥ śaktayaḥ striyaḥ || 7 || koṭyarbudaparārdhāni cakrustasya mahotsavam | maṇḍapāḥ koṭiśastatra nihitāḥ svarṇasad drumāḥ || 8 || kadalī staṃbhaśobhāḍhyāstoraṇādivilāsitāḥ | kalaśairaṃgacitraiśca paṭaiśca vallikādibhiḥ || 9 || pradarśanairbahuvidhairmallakrīḍādibhistathā | anyatra bahuyantraiścānyatra vṛṣabhayodhanaiḥ ||1 0|| nāṭakaiḥ pūrvavṛttaiśca kalābhirbhūtanādibhiḥ | saṃgītairnartanaiścāpi kathānakamakhādibhiḥ || 11 || evaṃvidhe tatra jāte mahotsave tadā śriyā | rukmiṇyākhyamahālakṣmyābhihitaṃ svāmine mudā || 12|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo parātman puruṣottama | kurūtsava tu me saudhe nṛtyagāyanavādanaiḥ || 13|| omityuktvā śriyāḥ saudhe yojayāmāsa sūtsavam | yathā dhāmnāṃ mahāsamrāṭ samāyātpuruṣottamaḥ || 14|| tatsammāne prakuryādutsavaṃ tadvad yuyoja saḥ | sarvadhāmnāṃ tu yā śobhā viśiṣṭā sātra kāritā || 15|| sarvadhāmapatīnāṃ tvāsanasiṃhāsanānyapi | tatra vai maṇḍape cābhisthāpitāni yathārhaṇam || 16|| sarveṣāṃ divyavastūnāmupāyanāni tatra ca | saṃgṛhītāni sarvebhyo dhāmabhyaḥ kṛṣṇaśārṅgiṇā || 17|| citrāṇāṃ śubhadṛśyānāṃ manaḥsnigdhāḥ śubhālayāḥ | saṃklṛptāstatra tatraiva nyastapānasubhojanāḥ || 18|| vidyutāṃ tu pradīpānāṃ prakāśāḥ sarvato’bhavan | krīḍāvidyutsphaṭākāṇāṃ krīḍāpi sarvato’bhavat || 19|| anantātarkyarūpāṇāṃ yāni pradarśanāni vai | nepathyakāravidyābhirvartante sma ca tāni hi ||20 || gandharvo devagandharvā gāndharvā dhāmavāsinaḥ | gāndharvyo devagāndharvyo gāndharvyo dhāmasaṃsthitāḥ ||21|| cakruste gāyanaṃ miṣṭamadhurālāpasusvaraiḥ | gāyakāḥ svarapūrāśca pūrayanti sma nādakaiḥ ||22|| nartakāścāpi nartakyo dāsyo dāsāśca sevikāḥ | sevakāśca mahārājñyo rājñyaśca nartanaṃ vyadhuḥ ||23|| vādakā naikavādyajñā dhāmānudhāmavāsinaḥ | vādyanti sma vādyāni yatra kiṃcinna gauṇabhāk ||24|| rāse pravartamāne ca gopīnāṃ kṛṣṇayoṣitām | tadaiśvaryāṇi bhūṣāśca hetayaḥ pārṣadādayaḥ ||25|| mūrtimantastatra rāse yuyujuḥ kṛtanartanāḥ | kṛṣṇānandāplutaṃ sarvaṃ brahmānandaparaṃ hyabhūt||26|| dṛśyaṃ spṛśyaṃ tathā śrāvyaṃ rasyaṃ cādvaitatāṃ gatam | sukhaṃ sukhaṃ parānandaṃ ānandaṃ nandanaṃ hyabhūt ||27|| snigdhaṃ premātimodāḍhyaṃ jātamānandameva tat | nānyaḥ paraṃ vijānāti vinānandaṃ hi tattvakam ||28|| evaṃ samutsave rādhā lakṣmīḥ śrīśca ramādayaḥ | kṛṣṇaṃ vikṛṣya rāse taṃ ramayāmāsa nartanam ||29|| sarvasmin tanmaye jāte sarvaṃ rasamayaṃ tvabhūt | kṛṣṇo rasapravegeṇa kūrdan tadramaṇo’bhavat ||30|| patnyāḥ patnyantaraṃ yāte kūrdanena satālavat | cacāla mukuṭo’jasraṃ cakampe’timuhurmuhuḥ ||3 1 || tamadhyātvā mahānandasukhavyāpto mahāprabhuḥ | padātpadāntaraṃ nyasya reme cottolya karṣayan ||32|| tāvacchaithilyamāpannaḥ papāta mukuṭānmaṇiḥ | koṭiratreṣu yo naddha ūrdhvasthakalgimūlakṛt ||33|| maṇeḥ pāte saha tena papāta kalgicandrikā | tathāpi naiva kṛṣṇaḥ sa rāsādviramate khalu ||34|| pādamardanabhītyā tāvubhau divyasuvigrahau | babhūvaturmaṇiḥ kalgicandrikā rematuśca vai ||35|| rāse mūrtidharau jātau remāte smāti maṇḍale | na tau svaṃsvaṃ sthalaṃ prāptau yāvadrāsāntameva ha ||36|| mukuṭe na svayaṃ yātau tāvattatra tu rādhayā | jñāpito nirgatau kṛṣṇamukuṭāditi śārṅgiṇe ||37|| kṛṣṇo dṛṣṭvā tu tau prāha kimevaṃ nirgatāvubhau | svasvasthānaṃ na vai yātau mukuṭaḥ śobhate na me ||38|| nainaṃ vai dhāraye kalgimaṇiśūnyaṃ kabhūṣaṇam | dhārayiṣye’nyamukuṭaṃ māyūrapicchaśobhitam ||39|| ityucyamāne śrīkṛṣṇe’dhimāsasya mahotsave | ānarttākhyo mahān bhakto rājā golokamāyayau ||40|| kṛṣṇaprītyarthamevāyaṃ tapobhaktiṃ cakāra vai | tasmai prasannaḥ sa kṛṣṇo nava rājyaṃ tu ditsati ||41|| golokasya divyabhūmeḥ kaṇaṃ tvarpitavān prabhuḥ | kaṇaḥ sa tatra saurāṣṭro deśastvānarttasaṃjñakaḥ ||42|| trijalāvṛttasudvīpo rājyamānartabhūbhṛtaḥ | samabhūtpaścimavārdhisaṃlagno bhūmisandhitaḥ ||43|| prārthayāmāsa cānarto mama rājyasya me tathā | guptaye rakṣakaṃ dehi tava dūtaṃ pratāpinam ||44|| omityuktvā dadau kṛṣṇa ānartāya tu bhūbhṛte | mukuṭasya maṇiryaśca viyukto mukuṭāttu tam ||45|| divyaḥ sa pārṣado bhūtvā sa yayau bhūbhṛtā saha | maṇimūlakhacitā yā viyuktā kalgicandrikā ||46|| mūlaṃ vinā na vai sthātuṃ śaktā prārthayadīśvaram | vāsaṃ me dehi bhagavanna mūlā na sthitirmama ||47|| hariḥ prāha tadā tāṃ tu viyuktā mukuṭād yataḥ | yāhi tvaṃ maṇinā sākaṃ bhūtvā divyasvarūpiṇī ||48|| ānartaviṣaye stheyaṃ dvijena maṇirūpiṇā | dvijapatnyā tvayā bhāvyaṃ gururūpau bhaviṣyathaḥ ||49|| ānarto’pi hariṃ natvā nītvā kalgiṃ maṇiṃ kaṇam | kṛṣṇārpitānmukuṭāccāparān muktān maṇīṃstathā ||50|| āyayau paścime vārdhau karmamvāṃ muktavān kaṇam | sa tu drāg vistṛto bhūtvā jātaḥ saurāṣṭrasaṃjñakaḥ ||51|| tatra maṇirmukuṭasya tvavātatāra cāmbarāt | anye’pi maṇayastatrāvaterurvyomamārgataḥ ||5 2 || mukhyo maṇirdivyadeho nimbadevo’bhavad dvijaḥ | vyāghrāraṇye ramyadeśe’śvapaṭṭasarasastaṭe ||5 3 || nivāsamakarot tatra parṇakuṭyāṃ sa tāpasaḥ | yā kalgicandrikā sā tu tatraiva sarasastaṭe ||54|| divyadehā nivāsaṃ cākarod dvijaprasevanam | ānartena tadā tābhyāṃ prārthitaṃ bhāvagarbhitam ||55 || vinā laukikadehaṃ vai janānāṃ śreya icchato | darśasparśādilābhaśca nātaḥ svīkurutaṃ vapuḥ ||5 6 || bhaktaprārthanayā tau ca nṝṇāṃ śreyo vicintya ca | dehaṃ grahītumicchantau hariṃ sasmaraturhṛdā ||57|| śrīkṛṣṇa āvirāsātra saṃkalpya mānasau ca tau | dehau samarpya tatraivāntaradhīyata pūjitaḥ ||58|| athaivaṃ tau kaṇalabdhasthaulyaṃ prāptau tataḥ param | sarvagocaratāṃ yātāvaśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ||59|| tapasyantau ca tatraiva lakṣmīnārāyaṇātmikām | saṃhitāṃ vācayāmāsatuśca kālaṃ suninyatuḥ ||60|| maṇiḥ sa nimbadevākhyo babhūva khyāta eva ha | kalgiḥ sā khyātimāpannā miṣṭādevīti sarvathā ||61|| atha raivatapautro vai khaṭvāṃgadajanādhipaḥ | tapastaptuṃ samāyāto nimbadevāśramāntike ||62|| badrītale sūpaviśya jajāpa japamuttamam | oṃ śrīlakṣmīpate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa namo’stu te ||63|| tasya vai tapasā tatrāyātau lakṣmīnarāyaṇau | varadānāya taṃ bhūpaṃ rodhayāmāsatustadā ||64|| rājñā darśanalābhārthaṃ tayorvāso’bhikāṃkṣitaḥ | tathāstviti prati śrutyādṛśyatāṃ tau gatāvubhau ||65|| yā lakṣmīḥ sā rukmiṇī śrīrūpāsīd divyarūpiṇī | nārāyaṇaḥ sa vai kṛṣṇa āsa śrīpatireva saḥ ||66|| śriyā juṣṭaḥ sa vai kṛṣṇo dadhyau tu pitarau tadā | kalgimaṇisvarūpau tau dhyātau svenaiva rakṣitau ||67|| sthāpitau divyadehena cintayāmāsa tatra ha | miṣṭādevīnimbadevagṛhe kṛṣṇo babhūva vai ||68|| yatra jajñe tu gopālastatrāśvapaṭṭasannidhau | parṇakuṭyāṃ mānasaḥ sa jātamātraḥ sayauvanaḥ ||69|| divyo babhūva golokadivyavigraha eva saḥ | gāṃ tu vāṇīṃ pālayati gopālaḥ kṛṣṇa eva saḥ ||70 || goḥ pṛthivyāḥ pālakaṃ rājānaṃ lāti ca rakṣati | gopālaḥ sa prabhuḥ kṛṣṇaḥ saṃsthito nṛpasannidhau ||7 1|| āśvinakṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ gopālaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ha | kukumavāpyāṃ saṃjajñe nimbadevagṛhe prage ||72|| anye ye maṇayastvānartena tyaktāḥ surāṣṭrake | sarve’tra kṛṣṇabhaktāste jātāḥ surāṣṭrake sthale ||73|| tatra omālaye śatrūṃjitākṣetre babhūva ha | premamaṇirmahādivyavigrahaḥ sūryasannibhaḥ ||74|| premākhyatadvijakṣetre divyā saṃkalpamātrajā | phālgunakṛṣṇapaṃcamyāṃ jajñe lakṣmīstu kaṃbharā ||75|| kaṃ sukhaṃ śāśvataṃ kārṣṇaṃ bibhartīti hi kaṃbharā | jātamātrā yuvatī sā divyāsa śrīsvarūpiṇī ||76 || pitā vijñāya tāṃ śrīṃ vai kṛṣṇārhā divyacakṣuṣā | vivāhavidhināhūya gopālaṃ kṛṣṇameva ha ||77 || kaṃbharāṃ śrīṃ dadau tasmai koṭidevādisannidhau | ityevaṃ kaṃbharāgopālau śrīkṛṣṇau tu dampatī ||78 || tāpasau bhagavantau tau divyamūrtī babhūvatuḥ | sāptabhaumakaśobhāḍhye mandire sthāpitau sadā ||79|| ekadā dundubhistābhyāṃ tithyaṣṭamyāṃ prage’dhike | māse śrutastvaśvapaṭṭasarovarāntike śubhaḥ ||8 0 || śṛṇvantu maṇikalgyādyāstathā śrīpatisevakāḥ | puruṣottamasaṃjño’haṃ toṣayituṃ pareśvaraḥ ||8 1 || akṣarabrahmadhāmastho golokādhipatiṃ prabhum | vaikuṇṭhādhipatiṃ cānyadhāmādhipām̐śca keśavān ||82|| kṛtavān malamāsaṃ tu nirmalaṃ matsvarūpiṇam | tadasminnadhike māse puruṣottamasaṃjñake ||83 || ekasyāpi dinasyātra vrataṃ kṛtvā vratī janaḥ | prāpnuyāt kṛpayā me’tra sarvaṃ māṃ dhāma cāpi me ||84|| vrataṃ tvadyāparapakṣāṣṭamyāstvanantapuṇyadam | yatheṣṭaṃ tatra dāsye’haṃ vratārthine svayaṃ hariḥ ||85|| dundubhiścetyabhidhāya snātvāśvapaṭṭavāriṣu | natvā kālyāṇikaṃ nimbadevaṃ miṣṭāṃ mahāsatīm ||86|| prapūjya kaṃbharāṃ śrīṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ gopālamityapi | tābhyāṃ kṛtaṃ susatkāraṃ prāpya vai raivataṃ yayau ||87|| kṛtaṃ tvadhikamāsasya parapakṣāṣṭamīvratam | kaṃbharayā sopavāsaṃ gopālenāpi nirjalam ||88|| prātaḥ saṃpūjitaḥ samyaṅ madhyāhne’pi niśi prabhuḥ | aṣṭottaraśatasāmagrībhiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||8 9|| ṣaṭpaṃcāśadbhojyāni cārpitāni tathā kṛtam | āṣṭottaraśatavartibhirārārtrikamujjvalam ||9 0 || lakṣaśo dakṣiṇā dattā rātrau nīrājane hariḥ | āvirbabhūva bhagavān dhāmasthaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 91 || vihasan hārdikaṃ snehaṃ varṣayan rañjayannabhau | uvācāsmi prasanno’haṃ golokeśa kimiṣyate || 92 || śrīriva kaṃbharā lakṣmīḥ kimicchati vratārthinī | yuvayorvasatistvatra madicchayaiva sarvathā || 93 || vartate miṣamātraṃ tu khaṭvāṃgatapa eva ha | mukuṭānmaṇikalgyośca viyogo’pi madicchayā || 94|| rāsādikaṃ nimittaṃ ca sarvathā vai madicchayā | tasmād vāṃ varadaścāsmi vṛṇutaṃ tu yathepsitam ||95|| tadarthaṃ tvāgato’smyatra sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamaḥ | śrutvaivaṃ bhāvagarbhaṃ tu hārdaṃ sarvaparātmanaḥ ||96|| ūcatustau praṇamyainaṃ mūlarūpe’bhicintya tau | bhagavaṃste’bhilāṣā cet kāraṇaṃ cātra saṃsthitau ||97|| āvābhyāṃ prārthyase tvaṃ vai sarvadātra sthiro bhava | puruṣottamasevāyāḥ sarvadā lābha eva nau ||98|| anādikṛṣṇayogastu bhāgyahīnasya durlabhaḥ | asmanmūlasvarūpastvaṃ rakṣātra sthita eva nau ||99|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’nādirlakṣmyā śriyā prasevitaḥ | muktaiśvaryaiḥ sevitastvaṃ vasātra puruṣottama || 1 00|| lālanaṃ pālanaṃ cāpi krīḍanaṃ poṣaṇādikam | divyasyāpi yathādeśakālānuguṇameva te || 101 || kṛtvā sukhaṃ parānandaṃ prāpsyāmo’tra tava sthiram | ityabhyarthya kaṃbharāgopālau śrīpuruṣottamam || 1 02|| nematustaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | bhagavānapi sarvātmā tathāstvityabhidhāya ca || 1 03|| svapriyāṃ dhāmalakṣmīṃ cāvedayannetrasaṃjñayā | yābhigamya harerhārdaṃ tiro’bhūt puruṣottame || 1 04|| so’yaṃ parātparo brahmaparaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | bālarūpo’bhavattatra jātamātro yuvā prabhuḥ || 1 05|| babhūvatuḥ prasannau kaṃbharāgopālakṛṣṇakau | putro divyo vratalabhyaḥ svayaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||106|| vrataṃ nimittamātraṃ vai kāraṇaṃ tasya mānasam | līlaiva kāraṇaṃ tasya puṃsastu paramasya vai || 1 07|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’nādipuruṣottama eva saḥ | śrīramādipārṣadādisamaiśvaryaguṇānvitaḥ || 1 08|| svecchayā dharmarakṣārthaṃ bhaktipravartanāya ca | prādurbhūtaḥ svayaṃ patnīvratasvarūpa eva saḥ || 109|| goloke yaḥ kṛṣṇamukhātpatnīvratābhidho guṇaḥ | pātivratyābhidhalakṣmyā sahito’bhūt prakāśitaḥ || 11 0|| so’yaṃ dharmasthāpanāya svayaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | putro’bhavacchrīkṛṣṇasyādhimāse puruṣottamaḥ || 111 || devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpāṇāṃ varṣaṇaṃ hyabhūt | nṛtyaṃ tatrāpsarasāṃ ca gāyanaṃ gāyakaiḥ kṛtam || 11 2|| pratidhāmani vāsāśceśvarā devā maharṣayaḥ | avatārāśca taddevyaḥ śaktayo’bjārbudāntyakāḥ || 113 || jayakāreṇa sahitāḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram | brahmāṇḍeṣvapi sarvatra jīveśāvatarādiṣu || 1 14|| samutsavo mahānāsīdanantabrahmabhojanam | prīṇanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ sṛṣṭiprāṇināṃ saṃbabhūva ha || 1 15|| kārtikādhavalāṣṭamyāṃ punarvasau ghaṭīsthite | sūryāstottaraghaṭikāpañcake samaye gate || 1 16|| niśāpūrvapade’nādiśrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jajñe gopālakaṃbharālaye || 1 17|| prakāśaścātra sarvatra paratrānekasūryavat | tadā jātaṃ iti jñātvā vedā vidyāḥ samastuvan || 1 18|| kṛṣṇasya vallabhaścāti sarvavidyādhiśevadhiḥ | prabhālakṣmīpārvatīmāṇikīśryādipatiḥ prabhuḥ || 1 19|| camatkārānasaṃkhyāndarśayāmāsa kṛpākaraḥ | ūrjaśuklaikādaśyāṃ sa prāpa dīkṣopavītakam || 120 || māghaśuklāṣṭamīprātaḥ kāśyāmavātatāra saḥ | navamyāṃ brahmavidyānāṃ saṃcāraṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ || 121 || svapitṛmukhataḥ śrutvā vijñānaṃ svātmani sthitam | vedavidyāmayaṃ sarvaṃ lakṣmyai hyupādideśa ha || 122|| nibodha lakṣmi kiṃ vacmi yo hariḥ puruṣottamaḥ | parabrahmākṣarātīto’nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 123|| sa eva vidyate rādhādhavo golokadhāmani | rukmiṇīnātha evāsau gopālaḥ kaṃbharāpatiḥ || 124|| baikuṇṭhādhipatiḥ so’yaṃ lakṣmīpatirnarāyaṇaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so’yaṃ sarveśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 125|| so’haṃ nārāyaṇo lakṣmi sā tvaṃ lakṣmīrmama priyā | sthalabhedena rūpāṇāṃ bāhulyaṃ ceyate mayā || 126 || nigamāgamavidyānāṃ vaktāhaṃ puruṣottamaḥ | śrotṛvyaktirmama dāsī priyā śiṣyā tvamanvasi || 127|| mayā nārāyaṇenātra tubhyaṃ lakṣmi pradīyate | jñānaṃ vijñānamātmasthaṃ hyaparokṣaṃ sadā mama || 128|| sṛṣṭikalpalayapūrvapūrvataratamādijam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitātmakaṃ ślokakoṭikam || 129 || vairājāya tvayā deyaṃ pañcāśallakṣasaṃkhyakam | yatreśvarāṇāṃ vaiśeṣyaṃ varṇitaṃ ceśasṛṣṭaye || 130 || vedhase vai tvayā deyaṃ pañcaviṃśatilakṣakam | yatrāgaṇitagolādibrahmāṇḍetikathādayaḥ || 13 1|| sārdhadvādaśalakṣaṃ ca pitṛbhyo’rpya tvayā priye | yatra teṣāṃ sarvakāṇḍāḥ paramārthatayādṛtāḥ || 1 32|| pañcalakṣaṃ tvayā deyaṃ divi svargurave priye | bārhaspatyaṃ surāṇāṃ tajjñānaṃ devānusāri vai || 133|| pañcalakṣaṃ tu daityānāṃ pātālādipravāsinām | śukrāya ca tvayā deyaṃ tāmasādyanusāri yat || 134|| sapādalakṣaṃ dātavyaṃ brāhmamārṣaṃ viśodhakam | tyāgibhyaḥ paramarṣibhyo brahmāvāptikaraṃ tu yat || 135|| sapādakṣaṃ dātavyaṃ viprebhyo mānaveṣu vai | yadadhītya caturvargān sādhayiṣyanti mānavāḥ || 136|| kālāntare layaṃ yāte bhaviṣyāmi punaḥ punaḥ | tattajjñānaprakāśāya vyāsācāryarṣirūpataḥ || 1 37|| iti te smāritaṃ lakṣmi prāgvṛttaṃ te ca me tathā | pūrvaṃ pūrvā layaṃ yānti jalasthalavivartanāḥ || 138|| vairājāḥ koṭiśo naṣṭā brahmādīnāṃ tu kā kathā | puruṣottamarūpo’haṃ mahāpralayakṛttathā || 139|| sṛṣṭikṛnnityavijñāno’khilātmāntarniyāmakaḥ | na vismarāmyaṇvapi tvacintyaśaktinidhirdhruvaḥ || 140|| yatra vai parvatāstatra jalaṃ kālāntare bhavet | jalasthāne sthalaṃ dehyāvāsaṃ vāse vanaṃ tathā || 141|| raṇe’raṇyaṃ tathāraṇye pattanaṃ vivaraṃ ca vā | vivareṣu mahāsetuḥ staraṃ stare tathāmbaram || 142|| kva kadā kiṃ bhūtametajjānāmi bhāvi cāpyaham | sarvaṃ mayi bhavatyeva kiṃcinmatto na ricyate || 143 || idaṃ sṛṣṭisamāraṃbhe’smaccaritrakathāmṛtam | adhimāsāparapakṣāṣṭamīvratamiṣeṇa vai || 144|| smāritaṃ te mayā lakṣmi pāvanaṃ śrotṛdehinām | pāṭhakānāṃ svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ vrataprapuṇyadam || 145 || atrotsave vratakarturbhuktirmuktirna saṃśayaḥ | putrārthī labhate putraṃ bhāryā bhāryecchuko labhet || 146|| dhanārthī prāpnuyād dravyaṃ kṣetrārthī bhūmimāpnuyāt | dharmārthī puṇyavān syācca sakāmaḥ kāmanāṃ labhet || 147|| yaśaḥ kīrtimavāpnoti satāṃ pradhānatā labhet | aśubhaṃ nāśamāyāti prapāṭhanena sarvathā || 148|| vipro vijñānavān syācca vijayaṃ kṣatriyo labhet | dhanadhānyasmṛddhisampadyukto vaiśyo bhavettathā || 149|| śūdraḥ sarvasamṛddhaḥ syāt sukhī cāsya śraveṇa vai | śreyaḥ śriyaṃ parāṃ vindet tejovīryaṃ samāpnuyāt || 15 0|| balaṃ rūpa guṇān sampad godhanakṣetravāṭikāḥ | dārāḥ sutā dāsadāsīrgṛharājyasvarādikam || 151|| ārogyaṃ ca svatantratvaṃ nirbandhatvaṃ samāpnuyāt | nirbhīkatvaṃ nirāpattvaṃ prāpnuyānmokṣaṇaṃ tathā || 152|| ityaṣṭamīvratajanyaṃ kathitaṃ te phalaṃ priye | vrataṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā prāpnuyāt puruṣottamam || 153|| me’vatārā asaṃkhyātā hyahaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | avatārī mahārājaḥ parabrahma sanātanaḥ || 154|| yāvad brahmā virāṭ vāpi vaikuṇṭhabhūmayastathā | sarvatrādhikamāso’haṃ sthāsyāmi puruṣottamaḥ || 155|| yāvaccandraśca sūryaśca sthāsyanti medinī tathā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇatīrthe tāvat sthāsyati śāśvatam || 156|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ dhvajaśārṅgādiśobhitaḥ | lakṣmyādisevitastatra sthāsyāmi puruṣottamaḥ || 157|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye malamāsasyādhidaive puruṣottame jāte goloke kṛtamahotsavarāse kṛṣṇamukuṭamaṇikalgicandrikayoḥ mukuṭādviyoge tayorbhuvi ānartadeśe nimbadevamiṣṭādevīrūpeṇāvataraṇaṃ tayorgṛhe kṛṣṇasya gopālakṛṣṇarūpeṇāvataraṇaṃ premamaṇigṛhe rukmiṇīlakṣmyāḥ kaṃbharārūpeṇāvataraṇaṃ kaṃbharālakṣmīgopālakṛṣṇayorvivāhottaraṃ dundubhiśravaṇenāṣṭamīvratakaraṇena śrīpuruṣottamasya tayorgṛhe’vataraṇaṃ koṭiślokasaṃhitākaraṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||1.315||
<1.316> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi navamyāścādhikamāsāntitame dale | vratasya pūrvakalpīyāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || 1 || pūrvāt pūrvatare kalpe babhūvendro dyumerujit | sāyaṃ tasya laye jāte puṇyaśeṣeṇa vai punaḥ || 2 || satyaloke niśāṃ bhuktvā kalpāraṃbhe prage tu saḥ | sṛṣṭau tretāyuge cādye samrāṭ śatamakho’bhavat || 3 || dānadharmadayāyukto lokarakṣaṇatatparaḥ | devadānavamartyānāṃ mānakṛd vijitendriyaḥ || 4 || vyomayānena viharan trilokyāṃ vicacāra saḥ | gobhūtīrthadvijanyāsisatīsādhuprapūjakaḥ || 5 || yasya hastatale vajracchatrakhaṅgāṃkakāni vai | vidyotante sma divyāni devatvāvedakāni vai || 6 || tasya patnī mahārājñī dyuvarṇābhūt pativratā | patisevāparā nityaṃ devasevāparā tathā || 7 || ātithyadharmiṇī dīnānāthadāridyanāśinī | kanyānāmunnatikartrī sadā strījātirakṣikā || 8 || gāndharvyo nāgakanyāśca devyo dānavya etya ca | kinnaryaścāpi mānuṣyaḥ śikṣārthaṃ sma vasanti vai || 9 || sāvitrī cāpi gāyatrī saṃjñā svāhāpyarundhatī | mahendrāṇī satī lakṣmīḥ rohiṇī pārvatī svadhā || 10 || prabhā ca māṇikī śrīśca jayā bhaktirdiśastathā | anyā nadyaḥ kṛttikādyāstasyāḥ sakhyo’bhavam̐stadā || 1 1|| campā dayā ramā hemnī muktā godā jayantikā | śāntiḥ śāntā premapātrā dīpotsavī ca nandinī || 12|| ojasvatī suratnā ca damayantī caturmatiḥ | devikā kāntikā revā savitā mūlayoginī || 13|| kastūrikā maṃgalā ca haṃsā ruciśca maṃjulā | nirmalā cāmṛtā rālijaṭinī pānaputtalī || 14|| vanitā miṣṭikā puṣpā manuḥ kṛṣṇā ca dāsikāḥ | kāntā sarasvatī padmā śāradā upadāsikāḥ || 15|| kalpadrumāśca maṇayaḥ kāmadhenava iṣṭadāḥ | kalpavallyo’bhavaṃstasyā rājye prāgjyotiṣāhvaye || 16|| evaṃ śatamakho rājā rājñī dyuvarṇikā tathā | strīnarau rājyadharmeṇa vartete sma bhuvastale || 17|| daivayogena tadrājyamabhūcchītādridurgavat | rājadhānī kṛtā tābhyāṃ sāketā sarayūmanu || 18|| pradhānaṃ rakṣakaṃ kṛtvā yātrārthaṃ kṛtaniścayau | tatastau saṃprayātau vai badrīyātrārthamādarāt || 19|| parimeyacaracārabhṛtyadāsījanau śubhau | tīrthasya niyamānsarvānpālayantau prajagmatuḥ ||20 || prātaḥ snānaṃ brahmacaryaṃ satyavrataṃ phalādanam | bhūśāyitvaṃ parityaktaśṛṃgārāsanādikam ||21|| ahiṃsanaṃ parivādarāhityaṃ mālikājapam | rāgadveṣavihīnatvaṃ dānaṃ devādipūjanam ||22|| tīrthavṛddhārcanaṃ tīrthagurusāhāyyakāritām | godarśanaṃ hareḥ pādāmṛtapānaṃ kathāśravam ||23|| viṣayāṇāṃ parityāgaṃ sādhuvadvartanaṃ tathā | rātrau nārāyaṇadhyānaṃ divā tīrthāṭanaṃ śubham ||24|| sāyaṃ nīrājanāstotrakīrtanasmaraṇādikam | jaṃgamānsthāvarānpratyanudvejanaṃ titikṣaṇam ||25|| pālayantau tāpasau tau bhūtvā badarikā gatau | devanadyāṃ tadācamya snātvā pītvā jalaṃ tataḥ ||26|| dadṛśaturmunīṃstīrthātmakām̐stīrthāni cāṃjasā | naranārāyaṇau dṛṣṭvā pūjāṃ kṛtvopacārakaiḥ ||27|| sādhuviprānatithīṃśca bhojayāmāsatustadā | rājñā rājñyā naranārāyaṇayostoṣaṇāya vai ||28|| tatraiva tu kṛtaṃ nṛtyaṃ gāyanaṃ mūrtisannidhau | arpitaṃ kānakacchatrayugalaṃ mukuṭadvayam ||29|| yugakuṇḍalayugalaṃ cāmarāṇāṃ catuṣṭayam | yaṣṭikāyugalaṃ hārāścormikāviṃśatistathā ||30 || kaṭakadvayayugalaṃ śṛṃkhalāraśanādvayam | pādukādvayayugalaṃ tathā siṃhāsanadvayam ||3 1 || dakṣiṇā bhūyasī caiva svarṇapātrottamāni ca | valkalājinavastrāṇi phalāni daiśikāni ca ||32|| samarpitāni sarvāṇi tava sva iti śabditam | pādau spṛṣṭau jalaṃ pītaṃ caraṇāmṛtamityapi ||33|| svarṇamālāpādayoścārpitā naranareśayoḥ | candanādisuvastvādyaiḥ pūjitau parameśvarau ||34|| āśīrvādāstadā labdhā putravān bhava pārthiva | rājñī putravatī bhūyāditi śrutvā praśaṃ gatau ||35|| tāvattatrādhikamāsanavamyāṃ prātareva ha | saṃśruto dundubhiḥ samyaṅmanovācchāprapūrakaḥ ||36|| adya vrataṃ prakurvantu gṛhṇantu vāñcchitaṃ phalam | puruṣottamamāso’yaṃ phaladaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||37|| hṛdi sthitān śubhān kāmāna gṛhṇantu puruṣottamāt | māṃ ca dhāma vibhūtiṃ ca dāsye smṛddhiṃ vratārthine ||38|| agamyaṃ buddhigamyaṃ syādalabhyaṃ labhyameva ca | atarkyaṃ cāpi tarkyaṃ syānnavamīvratakāriṇaḥ ||39|| sarvasaṃkalpasiddhiḥ syāt prāptiḥ pumuttamasya ca | dundubhiścetyabhidhāya dṛṣṭvā naraṃ nareśvaram ||40 || pūjayitvā ṛṣivaryau jagāmottaradigbhuvam | dampatī prasamākarṇya dhyātvā naranareśvarau ||41 || tallīnau cābhavatāṃ drāṅ naro nārāyaṇastadā | tayorhṛdordadṛśāte divyarūpau suśobhanau ||42|| manoharau mañjuvākyau mañjulakeśasajjaṭau | puṣṭau yuvānau divyau ca tāpasau śrīniṣevitau ||43 || munibhirvanditapādau vaikuṇṭhavāsināvubhau | rājabhavanayogyau tau lālanapālanārhaṇau ||44|| padmapatrāyatanetrau sucandrāsyau guṇālayau | ghanaśyāmau hṛdayaṃgamau manojñasundarau ||45|| vīkṣya saṃkalpitaṃ putrāvīdṛśau bhavatā tu nau | atha dhyānād bahiryātau rājñīnṛpau vilokya ca ||46|| naranārāyaṇaḥ prāha saṃkalpaḥ phalatāttu vām | śrutvā tṛptau cāti jātau tīrthavidhiṃ vidhāya tau ||47|| nivartitau tataḥ sthānādāyayaturnadītaṭe | ācamya kānakīṃ mūrtiṃ snātvā pupūjatustadā ||48|| gaṃgājalairhariṃ tau saṃsnāpya pramṛjya cāmbaraiḥ | pañcāmṛtaṃ samarpyathābhiṣekaṃ cakraturjalaiḥ ||49|| saṃpramṛjya suvastrāṇyābhūṣaṇāni samarpya ca | śṛṃgāraśobhāṃ saṃklṛptvā dhūpadīpau samarpya ca ||50 || candanākṣatakuṃkumakajjaladravasārakaiḥ | sugandhayitvārārtrikaṃ kārayāmāsatustataḥ ||51 || bhojayāmāsaturdevaṃ vardhayāmāsatuḥ stavaiḥ | puṣpāṃjaliṃ samarpayāmāsatuśca phalādikam ||52|| tāmbūlacarvaṇaṃ datvā yācayāmāsatuḥ kṣamām | evaṃ sūryodayāt paścāt pañcaghaṭīgate punaḥ ||53|| samaye cāpi tau kṛtvā snānārcanastavādikam | naivedyapānatāmbūladakṣiṇādisamarpaṇam ||54|| ṛṣidevakṣitidevabhojanaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tathā | nirvartyārghyaṃ kusumānāmañjaliṃ cākṣatām̐stathā ||55|| datvā stutiṃ cakratuśca visarjanaṃ pracakratuḥ | evaṃ prapūjya deveśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamam ||56 || naraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ natvā tīrthavidhiṃ samāpya ca | pūrvaṃ madhyāhnasamayād rājadhānīṃ navīkṛtām ||57|| vimānena samāgatya sāketāṃ sarayūmanu | udyāne mahatī saudhe vṛkṣavallīsuśobhite ||58|| maṇḍapaṃ kārayāmāsatustau svarṇādiśobhitam | kalaśairhāraśṛṃgārairvastrabhūṣādhvajādibhiḥ ||59|| śobhitaṃ raṃgavallībhiḥ siktaṃ gandhajalādibhiḥ | vahnikuṇḍasamāyuktaṃ vedikāsuvirājitam ||6 0|| kaṭaparyaṃkabṛsikāsūrṇāstaraṇaśobhitam | kammānikātoraṇāḍhyaṃ kadalīstaṃbhasaṃdhṛtam ||6 1|| ādarśacandrakaḍaṃkā niśāna bherikānakaiḥ | jalataraṃgayantraiśca śītavāyupravāhakaiḥ ||62|| śobhitaṃ maṇḍitaṃ citrairavatārasurādibhiḥ | jalasthalavyatyayena dṛṣṭirjālairvilakṣitam ||63|| dūraśravaṇayantraiśca dūradarśanadarpaṇaiḥ | dūragrahaṇasiddhyādyairalaṃkṛtaṃ vimānavat ||64|| tatra maṇḍapamadhye tu sahakāratarū kṛtau | pārśvakoṇeṣu catvāro’śokavṛkṣā vinirmitāḥ ||65|| śākhāsu divyadolā ca bandhayāmāsatuśca tau | tatra mūrtimayāndevān śṛṃkhalāsu tu devikāḥ ||66|| saṃklṛptayāmāsatuśca komalāstaraṇāni ca | tatra mūrtiṃ kānakīṃ vai puruṣottamarūpiṇīm ||67|| āropyāndolayāmāsatuśca rājñī nṛpastathā | tatra devasya nikaṣā sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam ||68|| saptadhānyaiḥ sbarṇaratnahīrakādisumiśritam | racayāmāsaturmadhye suvarṇakalaśaṃ śubham ||69|| paṃcaratnajalapuṣpaphaladravyāmbarānvitam | sthāpayāmāsatustasyopari sthālīṃ tilānvitām ||70|| śrīphalamudrikāyuktāṃ dhārayāmāsatustataḥ | svarṇamūrti dvitīyāṃ śrīpuruṣottamasaṃjñitām ||71 || tatsthālyāṃ sthāpayāmāsatuśca ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ | pūjayāmāsaturārārtrikaṃ cakraturādarāt ||72|| nṛtyagītāni tatraiva kārayāmāsatustadā | homaṃ tvagnau kuṇḍamadhye kārayāmāsatustathā ||73|| bhojayāmāsaturviprāndevānsādhvīḥ satastathā | dīnānāthābalāvargāndaridrān bhikṣukādikān ||74|| dakṣiṇā dāpayāmāsatuśca puṣpākṣatāñjalīn | arpayāmāsaturyāvat tāvattatra sumaṇḍape ||75|| divyarūpo yuvā nūtnajīmūtavarṇasundaraḥ | śyāmalaḥ sajaṭo devaḥ sānujaḥ samadṛśyata ||76|| madhyāhnasamaye divyo mūrto vai puruṣottamaḥ | dibyatejaḥparidhyāḍhyānanahāsyasurañjanaḥ ||77|| divyanetrasnehapūrṇaḥ puṣṭaḥ puṣṭānujānvitaḥ | pītāmbaradhanuścarmakhaḍgaśaṃkhajaṭādharaḥ ||78|| suvarṇamukuṭāḍhyaśca suvarṇakuṇḍalānvitaḥ | āśīrvādaparahastaḥ sevākṛpāḍhyamānasaḥ ||79|| sthitivāñcchābhisaṃceṣṭaścārāmaśāntidaḥ prabhuḥ | ārāme maṇḍape jajñe madhyādityasamujjalaḥ ||80|| rāmādityetyanujenāhūtastatra muhurgirā | ramante yogino yatrādityojjvalapareśvare ||8 1 || rāmādityo hyayaṃ śātamakhī jāto’tra keśavaḥ | ayaṃ rāmāvatāro vai prathamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||82|| dṛṣṭvā taṃ jātamātraṃ ca yuvānaṃ keśavaṃ prabhum | āścaryacakitau rājñī rājā cobhau babhūvatuḥ ||83|| rāmastu bhagavān divyau pitarau prāha toṣaṇāt | prasanno’smi varaṃ yācata yatheṣṭaṃ dadāmyaham ||84|| mūrtirūpeṇa sevā vāmaṃgīkṛtā mayā tataḥ | prādurbhūya varaṃ dātuṃ pratyakṣo’smi pumuttamaḥ ||85|| yo badaryāṃ harirdṛṣṭo nareṇa saha tāpasaḥ | hṛdi yau dadṛśāte ca divyarūpī suśobhanau ||86|| so’haṃ tvatra samāyātaḥ svabhrātrā puruṣottamaḥ | narādityo mama bhrātā tāpaso’pi mayā saha ||87|| dātuṃ naijaṃ darśanaṃ cātrāgatosti kṛpāvaśaḥ | pravṛṇuta varadānaṃ mā ciraṃ nveṣa yāmyaham ||88|| iti śrutvā śatamakho nṛpo rājñī dyuvarṇikā | babhūvatuścātisaṃbhramau saṃvyagramānasau ||89|| vandantau tiṣṭhataṃ tiṣṭhataṃ mā yātaṃ na gacchatam | sarvadā dadataṃ tvatra darśanaṃ bhavane prabhū ||90|| darśanīyau kamanīyau prāpsyethe na punarharī | gṛhṇītaṃ bhojanaṃ ramyaṃ peyaṃ tāmbūlamarcanam ||91|| ramataṃ sarvadā tvatrodyāne dadatamīpsitam | vatsau kiṃ vartate śaighryaṃ yātaṃ mā putrakau mama ||92|| ityuktvā rājamahiṣī nisargasnehasaṃbhṛtā | sutau dvau nikaṭe kṛtvā spṛṣṭvā netrajalābhavat ||93|| snutadugdhastanī jātā tyaktuṃ notsahate sma sā | rājāpi premapūrṇāṃgaścānye’pi mumuhurharau ||94|| bhagavantau prāhatuśca tathāstviti sumaṇḍape | kṣaṇaṃ bālau tadā jātau stanyapānakarāvubhau ||95|| dyuvarṇā tāṃ pāyayitvā stanyaṃ prāptā kṛtārthatām | rāmādityanarādityābhidhaputravatī satī ||96|| sukhinī saṃbabhūvātrānandotsavo mahām̐stadā | rāmāvirbhāvarūpo vai madhyāhne bhūbhṛtā kṛtaḥ ||97|| brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca munayaḥ sanakādayaḥ | nāradādyāśca ṛṣayo bhaktā vaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ ||98|| satyalokādivasatiḥ svargadevāśca mānavāḥ | pātālādisthitāścānye jaḍāśca cetanāḥ prajāḥ ||99|| tīrthāni saritaḥ śailā araṇyāni vanāni ca | kalpāśca pādapāścintāmaṇayaḥ kāmadhenavaḥ || 100 || tatrotsave samāyātā mantrā vedāśca vittayaḥ | tattvāni cetarā sarve brahmaputrāśca mānasāḥ || 10 1|| pitaro devarājāśca pārthivā lakṣakoṭayaḥ | samāyātā navamyāṃ vardhayituṃ cāśiṣāśiṣā || 10 2|| adhimāsāparapakṣanavamyāṃ madhyage ravau | rāmādityajayantyāṃ te rāma vīkṣya naraṃ tathā || 10 3|| kṛtārthāścābhavan labdhvā satkāraṃ bhojanādikam | rāmaprasannatāṃ prāpya cakrurgānaṃ sunartanam || 1 04|| dānaṃ śatamakhaḥ koṭyarbudāni ca gavāṃ dadau | vardhakā lokapālāśca dikpālāśca surādayaḥ || 1 05|| yayurnijasthalaṃ sarve svasvalokān yayurjanāḥ | madhyāhnapūjanaṃ rājñyā nṛpeṇa tatra maṇḍape || 106|| samāptaṃ vai kṛtaṃ tadvat sāyaṃ niśi prapūjanam | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ cātha prātaḥ snānādikaṃ kṛtam || 1 07|| mūrteḥ saṃpūjanaṃ pātrabhojanaṃ dakṣiṇādikam | kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ suvidhinā vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tataḥ || 108|| pāraṇā ca kṛtā tena patnyā saha suputriṇā | ānandaḥ samabhūt tasyātarkyo vai navamītitheḥ || 1 09|| puruṣottamamāsasya vratena putradāyinā | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam || 11 0|| rāmādityajayantyākhyaṃ vratapuṇyaṃ mahattamam | idaṃ prāgrāmacaritaṃ paṭhet saṃśṛṇuyāttu yaḥ || 111 || śrāvayetparayā bhaktyā sa bhaved vratapuṇyabhāk | sveṣṭaṃ labhellabhedrājyaṃ labhet putraṃ dhanādikam || 1 12|| labhet tīrthaphalaṃ cāpi sāketasarayūkṛtam | labhecca balavatputraṃ puruṣottamasannibham || 1 13|| bhuktiṃ muktiṃ sukhaṃ svargaṃ dhāma vaikuṇṭhamityapi | yadyadiṣṭaṃ labhet sarvaṃ kṛpayā paramātmanaḥ || 1 14|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye sāketanagaryāḥ śatamakharājñaḥ dyuvarṇā rājñyāśca badarikāśramayātrāyāṃ naranārāyaṇadarśanottaraṃ dvitīyapakṣanavamīvratakaraṇena sāketanagaryāṃ śrīrāmādityanarādityanāmānau prathamau puruṣottamāvatārau divyaputrau babhūvaturityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣoḍaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||1.316||
<1.317> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi vikuṇṭhā yā goloke rādhikāsutā | saṃkalpamātrajā kanyā tasyā vṛttaṃ vratānvitam || 1 || adhimāsasya devo’bhūd bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ | rādhayā sahitaḥ kṛṣṇo rāsaṃ cakre tadutsave || 2 || tatrāyātā gopagopyaḥ kanyāḥ koṭyarbudārbudāḥ | kuṭumbinīḥ sakanyāśca rūpalāvaṇyasampadaḥ || 3 || gopīrvīkṣya svayaṃ rādhā tvaputrīyeṣu putrikām | gopīnāṃ kanyakā divyā āhvayanti svamātṛkāḥ || 4 || mām̐ ambe janani caivaṃ hyānandayanti mātṛkāḥ | putrīhīnā patiyuktā na pūrṇā sukhinī hi sā || 5 || putrī mātṛsvarūpāsti māturvai kāryadāsikā | sarvathā sāhacaryeṇa sevate mātaraṃ sutā || 6 || bhojane cotsave yāne rahasyāplavane gṛhe | śayane vā pravāse vā sāhāyye sevikā sutā || 7 || nārīvargasya nāryaiva śārīrasahasevikā | tatrāpi svasutā tulyā na snuṣā nāpi bhṛtyakā || 8 || na vā kuṭumbinī tadvad yathā putrī tu sevikā | tasmāt sutāṃ binā nārī tvardhasaubhāgyaśālinī || 9 || prātaḥ putrīmukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā svargādapyadhikaṃ sukham | jananī vindati loke na tathā putradarśanāt || 1 0|| pituḥ putre yathā sneho mātuḥ putryāṃ tato’dhikaḥ | abalā gosamā putrī kumārī mātṛsevikā || 11 || paścāt patiparā sā syāttasmānmāturviśeṣataḥ | pūrṇāyuṣyasukhaṃ putryāḥ kaumārye labhyameva ha || 12|| ataḥ putrī daśaguṇā preṣṭhā bhavati sarvathā | mātuḥ kalāsukauśalyaṃ gṛhakāryādiśikṣaṇam || 13|| putryātmake nijapātre vasatyeva sadā ciram | satputryā jāyate mātā yaśasvinī kuladvaye || 14|| putrī kīrtiryaśaḥ putrī putrī piṇḍastu mātṛjaḥ | svātmikāṃ putrikāṃ dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā hṛṣyanti mātaraḥ || 15|| putraḥ pitṛsvarūpo’sti putrī mātusvarūpiṇī | suputrī jananī putrīmatsu mānyā bhavatyapi || 16|| aputrī tu samājādau mlāneva dṛśyate khalu | putrīmaṇḍalamadhyasthā mātā tatra prakāśate || 17|| aputrī tu yathā nidrotthitā tadvaddhi dṛśyate | bahvayaḥ suputrikā yasyāḥ sā dhanāḍhyāsu pūjyate || 18|| putryātmakaṃ dhanaṃ tasyāḥ sarvaśrībhyo viśiṣyate | jāmātāro’pi bahavo bahuputryā dhanaṃ mahat || 19|| putrīputrāśca tatputrā dhanaṃ vistṛtameva tat| bahuśākhaśca vṛkṣasya chāyāṃ śrayanti lakṣaśaḥ ||20|| aśākhasya na vai chāyā nāśritā nahi mānyatā | paropakāro nāpyasti tathāputrī vigaṇyate ||2 1|| putrīsukhaṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā mātā toṣaṃ prayāti vai | na me putrī na vā putraḥ kathaṃ rādhā sukhāśrayā || 22|| sapatnīduḥkhamāpannā yadi putrīmatī bhavet | tadā sāpatnyaduḥkhaṃ vai putrīṃ dṛṣṭvā nivartate ||23 || virajā rukmiṇī lakṣmīḥ ramā śrīḥ pārvatī prabhā | jayā ca vijayā bhāmā maṃgalā māṇikī yamī ||24|| anyāścāsaṃkhyakoṭyaśca sapatnyaḥ sānti me sadā | saputryastāḥ sadā dṛśyā mayā putrīvihīnayā || 25|| tasmāt putrī mayā prārthyā kṛṣṇāchrīpuruṣottamāt | yayā putrīmatīnāṃ maurdhanyaṃ mama yathā bhavet ||26|| iti saṃcintya rādhā sā mahotsavottaraṃ nijam | bhāvaṃ prakāśayāmāsa rahaḥ śrīkṛṣṇasannidhau ||27|| putrī me dayitāṃ nātha vinā putrīṃ mṛtirvarā | putrīmatīṣu sarvāsu na śobhe’haṃ samutsave ||28|| apatyāni vinā nārī śobhate naiva caikalā | kadalī śobhate naiva pārśvāpatyāni yatra na ||29|| virullatā na śobhante kvacicchākhālatāmṛte | hariṇī śobhate naiva bālāpatyāni vai vinā || 30|| vidyuttu śobhate tatra yatra vṛṣṭiḥ pravartate | kulyā vinā mahattvaṃ na nadyāḥ kvāpi prasiddhyati ||3 1|| vināṅgulīḥ phaṇā naiva śobhate śobhitāpi vai | śāntiṃ vinā na vā vidyā śobhate sā mahatyapi ||32|| muktiṃ vinā parāvidyā śobhate na parāpi sā | tṛptiṃ vinā yathā bhuktirniṣphaleva prajāyate ||33|| patnīṃ vinā yathā śayyā yauvanodvegadāyinī | putrīṃ vinā tathā mātā vārdhakye duḥkhadarśinī ||34|| tasmāt putrīṃ samicchāmi sarvasadguṇaśālinīm | mātrājñāpālayitrīṃ ca kuladharmānuyāyinīm || 35|| mātṛsevākarīṃ divyāṃ gṛhakāryasahāyinīm | annavārisamitpatraśākapuṣpādirakṣiṇīm ||36|| mārjanaṃ mañjanaṃ vasturakṣaṇaṃ kṣālanaṃ tathā | pācanaṃ saṃskaraṇaṃ ca jalāharaṇaprabhṛti ||37 || kuryāt snigdhā sutā yā syānmātṛvātsalyaśobhitā | tasmānmayā suputryatra kṛṣṇa kānta guṇālayā ||38|| sarvaśreṣṭhā ca vikhyātā mātāpitṛsahāyinī | dṛṣṭvā smṛtvā ca yāṃ śāntirbhavet samiṣyate hare ||39|| yadyahaṃ te priyā patnī mayi tuṣṭo bhavān yadi | yadyahaṃ te priyā dāsī priyaḥ kānto’si me yadi ||40|| tadā rādhā vṛṇute’tra kṛṣṇātputrīṃ sulakṣaṇām | sarvaputrīmatīputrīrvismārayettu yā nu mām ||4 1 || ityabhyarthya priyā rādhā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | kṛtvā vakṣasi saṃśliṣṭaṃ sevayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ||42|| kṛṣṇastvānandayitvā tāṃ dadau tasyai suputrikām | divyāṃ rādhāsamākārāṃ rādhārūpātirūpiṇīm ||43 || saṃkalpamātrajanyāṃ ca jātamātrā suyauvanām | divyāṃ divyasahasrābjagopīrūpātirūpiṇīm ||44|| yathā rādhā tathā sāsti yathā sā rādhikā tathā | āntaraṃ naiva sarvātmatulyatayā vibhāsate ||45|| mumuhurgopikāḥ sarvāḥ kṛṣṇapatnyaśca mohitāḥ | stabdhāśca citritā yadvat tadānīmabhavan kṣaṇam ||46 || etādṛśī darśanārhā vṛttīnāṃ kuṇṭhitā parā | tatraiva putryāṃ sarvāsāṃ sarveṣāṃ cābhavattadā ||47|| kṛṣṇo’pi rūpasampannāṃ sutāṃ dṛṣṭvā jaharṣa vai | vṛttīnāṃ kuṇṭhito bhāvo jātaṃ sthairyaṃ yato’tra vai ||48|| pitrā kṛṣṇena vātsalyād vikuṇṭheti samādarāt | samāhūtā sutā tadvat samāhūtā hi rādhayā || 49 || vikuṇṭhākhyā ca sā kārṣṇī rādheyīnāmato’bhavat | golokavasatiḥ sarvā draṣṭuṃ kanyāṃ samāyayau ||5 0 || praśaṃsanti striyastāṃ tā aho rādhā mahodayā | aho putrī divyarādhārūpātirūpabhājanā ||5 1 || aho bhāgyena kasyāpi jāteyaṃ sumanoharā | kṛṣṇādapyuttamaṃ bhāgyaṃ tasya syād yasya sā bhavet ||52|| vivāhavidhinā bhāryā bhavedyasya tu kanyakā | sa vai kṛṣṇottamaḥ kṛṣṇo bhavedvai puruṣottamaḥ ||53 || ityuktvāśiṣa āyujya jagmuḥ svasvālayaṃ janāḥ | rādhā tāṃ pāyayāmāsa stanyaṃ tatkālasaṃbhavam ||54|| kṛṣṇaḥ saṃskārayāmāsa vidhinā bhojanaṃ dadau | ramayāmāsa mātā tāṃ lālanaiḥ pālanādibhiḥ ||55 || atha sā rādhikāsevāṃ karoti smātibhāvataḥ | gṛhakāryāṇi sarvāṇi nirvartayati śikṣitā ||56|| evaṃ vivartamānā sā varārohātiyauvanā | nityaṃ pitrā samaṃ yāti draṣṭuṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||57|| akṣarādhipatiṃ brahmaparaṃ śrīparameśvaram | anantakṛṣṇasaṃsevyaṃ nārāyaṇābjavanditam || 58 || yatkāntyā leśamātreṇa kāntāḥ kṛṣṇādayo matāḥ | tamanādibrahmayuktaiḥ sevitaṃ puruṣottamam ||59|| prātaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sadā yāti paraṃ pūjayituṃ prabhum | śvetadivyamahāyuktasapakṣahastisaṃsthitaḥ ||6 0 || upāyanādikaṃ nītvā bhagavān rādhikāpatiḥ | nivartate tu sampūjya tadvā kṛṣṇasutā tu sā || 61 || cakame rādhikāputrī dṛṣṭvā śrīpuruṣottamam | tasyā manaḥ samākṛṣya svasmin sthāpayati prabhuḥ ||62|| vikuṇṭhā dhyāyati dṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim | sarvakriyāsu cānādikṛṣṇānārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||63 || gāyati smarati paśyatyapi śrīṣuruṣottamam | evaṃ nityaṃ tayā sārdhaṃ samāyāti ca pūjanam ||6 4|| kṛtvā kṛṣṇaḥ svakaṃ dhāma gacchati nityameva ha | vikuṇṭhāpi tanmayābhūt sarvakriyāsu sarvadā ||65|| puruṣottamapatnītvaṃ prāptuṃ dhyāyatyaharniśam | tāvattatra tadāvādīd dundubhiḥ śrīharermahān || 66|| adyāsti daśamī ramyā puṇyadādhikamāsikī | pare pakṣe’tra vratakṛllabhate sveṣṭavastukam ||67|| api kanyā ca vā nārī naro vā dīnamānavaḥ | adya vratena vai sveṣṭaṃ prāpsyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||68 || akṣarādhipatyanādiśrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ | yadyadicchati tatsarvaṃ pradāsye vai vratārthine ||69 || mā saṃkocaṃ prakurvantu prārthanākaraṇe janāḥ | gopyaṃ rakṣyaṃ cānivedyaṃ dāsye saṃkalpitaṃ khalu ||70 || ityāśrutya vikuṇṭhā sā cakre vai daśamīvratam | puruṣottamalabdhyarthaṃ sajāgaraṃ divāniśam ||7 1 || prātastayā kṛtā pūjā śubhā ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ | puruṣottamamūrteśca bhojanārārtrikādikam ||72|| khānapānasunaivedyaphalapuṣpajalādikam | prātarmadhye tathā sāyaṃ rātrau cakāra pūjanam ||73 || kṛṣṇacandraśītaraśmitejomaye’tisūjjvale | virāmākhye niśāvācye samaye puruṣottamaḥ ||74|| samāyāt tatra mūrtyākhye svarūpe’kṣaradhāmataḥ | koṭikṛṣṇasamaḥ kānto vikuṇṭhābhāgyaniścitaḥ ||75 || prahasan tāṃ prabhuḥ prāhāgato’smi vratapuṇyadaḥ | tava bhaktyā prasanno’smi vṛṇu kṛṣṇasute’naghe || 76 || adeyaṃ nāsti te kiñcit smṛtavatyai sadā tu mām | ananyāyai bhaktimatyai kārṣṇyai deyaṃ yathepsitam ||77|| tadā prāha vikuṇṭhā taṃ prasannā lajjitā tathā | hṛdaye prāṇanātha tvaṃ vartase’viditaṃ na te ||78 || tathāpi bhaktavātsalyājjijñāsāṃ tvaṃ karoṣi vai | bhagavanmama nātha tvaṃ bhava prāṇapatiḥ prabhuḥ ||79|| iyaṃ samarpyate svāmin varamālādiśa prabho | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha tathā prāhādhikaṃ hariḥ ||8 0 || śṛṇu naikasvarūpo’haṃ vasāmi vividhāśrayaḥ | vasāmyahaṃ sadā dhāmnyakṣare śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||8 1 || dvitīyo’haṃ vasāmyeva mahāvaikuṇṭhadhāmani | tathā jalāvaraṇāntavaikuṇṭhe’haṃ tṛtīyakaḥ ||82 || śvetadvīpākhyavaikuṇṭhe caturtho’haṃ vasāmyapi | kṣīrāntaḥsthe tu vaikuṇṭhe vasāmi paṃcamo’pyaham ||83 || tasmāt tvayāpi sarvatra vastavyaṃ divyarūpayā | naikena vai svarūpeṇa sthātuṃ sarvatra pāryate ||84|| tato’nekasvarūpatvaṃ kartavyaṃ bhavati dhruvam | kiṃca mātrā tava rādhikayā sevārthamityapi ||85|| nirmitā tvaṃ tato tāṃ vai tyaktuṃ nārhasi sundari | rādhāsevārthamevāpi sthātavyaṃ sarvadā tvayā ||86 || iti rūpāṇi ṣaṭ kṛtvā sthātavyaṃ sarvathā tvayā | kṛpayā mama tasmātte rūpāṇi ṣaḍ bhavantu vai ||87|| ityuktā sā ṣaṭsvarūpābhavattasya kṛpākaṇāt | tatraikaṃ tvakṣaradhāmavāsārha sarvato’dhikam ||88 || puruṣottamayogyaṃ sababhūva nityamuktikam | patnītvena vikuṇṭhā tāṃ jagrāha puruṣottamaḥ ||89 || dvitīyaṃ rādhikāsevāyogyaṃ putrīsvarūpakam | goloke tāṃ kumārīṃ vai sthāpayāmāsa keśavaḥ || 90 || vikuṇṭhā kanyakā pūrvaṃ yathā tatraiva tiṣṭhati | tṛtīyaṃ tu vikuṇṭhāyā vyāpakaṃ mūrtimattathā || 91 || rūpaṃ dvedhābhavattatra vyāpakaṃ tattu sarvathā | vaikuṇṭhākhyaṃ dhāmarūpamadhidaivaṃ babhūva tat || 92 || mahāvaikuṇṭhasaṃjñaṃ tad vyāpakaṃ dhāma cocyate | tatra nārāyaṇapatnī mahālakṣmīrbabhūva sā || 92 || caturthaṃ tu vikuṇṭhāyā rūpaṃ dvedhābhavattathā | jalāvaraṇavaikuṇṭhaṃ tejomayādhidaivatam || 94|| vyāpakaṃ saṃbabhūvaikaṃ lakṣmīrūpaṃ dvitīyakam | vikuṇṭhā sā viṣṇupatnī sevate viṣṇumādarāt || 95|| pañcamaṃ tu vikuṇṭhāyā rūpaṃ dvedhābhavattadā | śvetadvīpākhyavaikuṇṭhaṃ tejomayādhidaivatam || 96|| vyāpakaṃ saṃbabhūvaikaṃ lakṣmīrūpaṃ dvitīyakam | vikuṇṭhā sā viṣṇupatnī sevate viṣṇumādarāt || 97|| ṣaṣṭhaṃ cāpi vikuṇṭhāyā rūpaṃ dvedhābhavattadā | kṣīravaikuṇṭhasaṃjñaṃ tattejomayādhidaivatam ||98|| vyāpakaṃ saṃbabhūvaikaṃ lakṣmīrūpaṃ dvitīyakam | vikuṇṭhā sā viṣṇupatnī sevate viṣṇumādarāt || 99|| evaṃ ṣaṇmūrtayastasyāḥ surūpā divyayoṣitaḥ | ṣaṭsthaleṣu hi vartante vikuṇṭhā bhagavatstriyaḥ || 10 0|| vaikuṇṭhāni tu catvāri dhāmāni divyabhūmayaḥ | babhūvustadadhiṣṭhātrīdevatāstā harīcchayā || 10 1|| catasro vyāpikā devyo militvā daśa tāḥ sadā | pṛthagrūpā babhūvurvai vratena haritoṣaṇāt || 10 2|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipuruṣottamasatkṛpā | kiṃ kiṃ na kurute lakṣmi sā vikuṇṭhā bhavatyapi || 102 || svātmānaṃ tvaṃ vijānīhi sa cāha puruṣottamaḥ | ityapi tvaṃ vijānīhi patiṃ te puruṣottamam || 1 04|| jñātvā māṃ bhajase tatra sarvatrātra ca matpriye | ahaṃ jānāmi tatsarvaṃ nityapratyakṣavattayā || 1 05|| tvaṃ na vetsi tathā sarvaṃ madicchā tatra kāraṇam | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi vṛttaṃ daśamikāvratāt || 10 6|| vikuṇṭhāyāstava rūpāṇyabhavan daśadhā phalam | madicchayā tathā jātaṃ mamānugrahakāraṇam || 1 07|| paṭhedvā śṛṇuyādvāpi phalaṃ tasyāpi tādṛśam | dadāmīṣṭaṃ pūrayāmi kṛpayā puruṣottamaḥ || 108|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye śrīkṛṣṇena dattāyā mānasyā rādhikāputryā vikuṇṭhānāmnyā daśamīvratena santuṣṭapuruṣottamakṛpayā ṣaṭlakṣmīrūpāṇi catvāri vaikuṇṭhadhāmādhidevatārūpāṇi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||1.317||
<1.318> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pūrvakalpe bhavāṃ vamryāḥ kathāṃ śubhām | rudraputrī kṛte cādye samabhūd vamrikā sutā || 1 || satyāḥ sā mānasī putrī vaṭe tiṣṭhati nityadā | mandare parvate rudrāvatāre vaṭapādape || 2 || pitrāśraye kṛtāvāsā tvāste śuddhā kumārikā | satyā cāprajayā dṛṣṭā vikuṇṭhā rādhikāsutā || 3 || tadā putrīmatī syāṃ cetyārthayacchaṃkarānmuhuḥ | tathāstviti prasannaḥ śaṃkaraḥ saṃkalpamācarat || 4 || yatra vai mandare’raṇye svāvatāravaṭāśraye | tatraiva ramaṇāt satyā mānasī divyarūpiṇī || 5 || jajñe koṭicandratejo’dhikatejomayī sutā | jātamātrā surūpā suyauvanā yādṛśī satī || 6 || tato’pyadhikasaundaryā sarvadivyaguṇālayā | jātamātrā divyabodhā nanāma pādayoḥ pituḥ || 7 || mātṛcaraṇayoścāpi nanāma sevikā yathā | satī cātiprasannābhūd rudro’pyatitarāṃ sukhī || 8 || anapatyastu sāpatyo bhavatyutsavavardhitaḥ | kṛtaḥ satyā śaṃbhunā cotsavastatra sumandare || 9 || devā devyo mānavāśca dikpālā manavastathā | maharṣayo’japitaro viṣṇudakṣādayo’pare || 10 || yugalāni yayustatra vamryā janmamahotsave | saṃskṛtā vidhinā saptarṣibhiryajñopavītakam || 11 || prārpitaṃ brahmavarcaskaṃ sarvatejodhikā babhau | janakaṃ brahmarūpaṃ ca tathā sā sevate satīm || 12|| pitarāviva yogasthā samādhāvapi tiṣṭhati | vaṭavāsā vaṭacchāyākṛtaśālā vaṭāśrayā || 13|| vaṭatvaksaṃskṛtavastrā nyagrodhaphalabhojanā | nyagrodhadugdhapānā ca nyagrodhaphalabhūṣaṇā || 14|| nyagrodhasya jaṭātantuśāṭikā vaṭamūlake | vedīkṛtahomakāryā vaṭapatrasukaṃcukī || 15|| vaṭakāṣṭhasuvalayā vaṭarūpā sadābhavat | tāpasī vaṭaputrī sā sarvasiddhimayī babhau || 16|| yadyadicchati tatsarvaṃ tatra samupatiṣṭhate | sampadaḥ smṛddhayo lakṣmyo rasā bhogyāni vai sudhā || 17|| amṛtāni vicitrāṇi dugdhāni vividhāni ca | sarvavṛkṣarasāstatra sarvaratnāni tatra ca || 18|| sarvabhogyopakaraṇānyupatiṣṭhanti tadvaṭe | sā tu yogabalāt sarvaṃ svasyā agre prapaśyati || 19|| mūlādhāre gude cakre gatvā gaṇapatiṃ suram | dhyāyati smāsya sāmarthyaṃ vaśīkaroti sarvathā ||20|| svādhiṣṭhāne yonimūle cakre gatvā caturmukham | dhyāyati smāsya sāmarthyaṃ vaśīkaroti sarvataḥ ||21 || maṇipūre nābhideśe cakre gatvā tu viṣṇukam | dhyāyati smāsya sāmarthyaṃ vaśīkaroti sarvathā ||22|| hṛdaye’nāhate cakre gatvā dhyātvā śivaṃ sthitam | tasyāpi sarvasāmarthyaṃ vaśīkaroti yoginī ||23 || viśuddhicakre kaṇṭhasthe svātmani saṃyamaṃ param | kṛtvātmatattvasāmarthyaṃ vaśīkaroti sarvathā || 2 4|| ājñācakre bhruvormadhye dhyātvā haṃsaṃ guruṃ tathā | vaśīkaroti brahmādi jñānaṃ sārvajñyameti yā || 25|| brahmarandhre’pi sā gatvā brahmalokaṃ gatā satī | paśyati śrīparātmānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamam || 26 || kcacitsamādhinā vamrī yāti brahmapuraṃ prati | kvacidvaikuṇṭhalokaṃ ca yāti śvetaṃ puraṃ prati || 27|| golokaṃ cāmṛtaṃ dhāma śrīpuraṃ yāti vāsavam | kvacicchaivaṃ kvacid brāhmaṃ sauraṃ cāndraṃ ca vāruṇam || 28 || kauberaṃ devalokām̐śca prakṛteḥ puruṣasya ca | lokān sāṃkarṣaṇaṃ dhāma prādyumnaṃ cāniruddhakam || 29|| caturviṃśatitattvānāṃ lokān yāti samādhinā | asurāṇāṃ ca nāgānāṃ devīnāmālayām̐stathā || 30 || bhūgole ca khagole ca brahmāṇḍe yāti yoginī | iḍāyāḥ piṃgalāyāśca suṣumṇādeśca vartmanā || 31 || sūryacandrādilokām̐śca jagāma yogasaṃśrayā | saṃyamanīṃ dharmapurīṃ jagāma yogavartmanā || 32|| naikarūpadharā bhūtvā vamrī vaṭe’pi tiṣṭhati | tiṣṭhatyaparavṛkṣeṣu vaikuṇṭhe śrīpure’pi ca || 33 || kuberasya mahākośe bhūtvā vamrī tu yakṣiṇī | tiṣṭhate sā dhanayakṣiṇīti rakṣākarī tathā || 34|| evaṃ bhūtvā bahurūpā yatheṣṭaṃ ramate hi sā | vaṭādhaḥ sūyamānatvād vaṭasāvitrikā hi sā || 35 || vaṭaṃ svarṇaṃ tasya rakṣākarī sā vaṭayakṣiṇī | vṛkṣeṣu vasamānatvād vārkṣī vamrī sadābhavat || 3 6 || vadasāvitrikākṛcchraṃ patisaṃyogadṃ sadā | vaidhavyaṃ naiva cāyāti vaṭasāvitrikārcane || 37|| dāridryaṃ naiva jāyeta vaṭayakṣiṇikārcane | lakṣmīṃ ca sampadaścaiva dhanaṃ dadāti yakṣiṇī || 38|| sasyānnakaṇadhānyādi vārkṣī dadāti pūjitā | vārkṣī sarvatra vṛkṣeṣu tiṣṭhate rasarūpiṇī || 39 || vaṭe vṛkṣe mānitā yā rāti lakṣmīṃ dadāti sā | vamrī satīsutā yogakriyādakṣā sthale sthale ||40 || yogābhyāsena gatvaiva dadarśa sarvasṛṣṭiṣu | yugalāni patipatnīkṛtāni mānasānyapi ||41 || īśvarāṇāṃ surāṇāṃ ca mānavānāṃ ca śākhinām | divyāni dehayuktāni priye puṇyātmakānyapi ||42|| dṛṣṭvā dharmaṃ vicāryaiva yauvanaṃ vai patiṃ vinā | strīṇāṃ doṣakaraṃ śuddhivihīnaṃ bhāti sṛṣṭiṣu ||43 || tasmānmayāpi yoktavyaṃ patyā saha sadharmiṇā | iti vicārya sā vamrī satīputrī susundarī ||44|| niṣasāda vaṭādhastād vedyāṃ sā mandare girau | tāvattatpārśvato yātā divyāḥ pracetaso daśa ||45|| svatulyān rūpasampannān puṣṭayauvanasaṃbhṛtān | punastatpārśvato jagmuḥ kṛtvā śaṃkaradarśanam ||46|| manasteṣu tadā vamryāḥ kiñcidvai snigdhatā gatam | tāneva saṃsmarantyatra vaṭe sā vyagramānasā ||47|| śuśrāva dundubhiṃ cādhikamāsavratabodhakam | adyaikādaśikāparva puṇyadaṃ cādhimāsikam ||48 || vratakartryā bhavetsveṣṭaṃ siddhaṃ prayatnamantarā | puruṣottama kṛṣṇo’haṃ dadāmīṣṭaṃ vratārthine ||49 || dundubhiḥ saṃvadāmyatra sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamaḥ | gṛhṇantu varadānaṃ mat yatheṣṭaṃ suramānavāḥ ||5 0 || narā nāryaḥ surā devyaḥ samāyāntu madantikam | ekādaśyā vratapuṇyaṃ dadāmi manasepsitam ||5 1 || śrutvā vamrī dundubhiṃ taṃ prati śīghraṃ samāyayau | saṃpūjya dundubhiṃ kanyā provāca daśavārakam ||52|| patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi patiṃ patim | patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi patiṃ patim ||53 || śrutvā tathāstviti procya dundubhirniryayau tataḥ | vaṭaṃ sāpi yayau śīghraṃ yathā jānāti no satī ||54|| prasannā tuṣṭahṛdayā varadānadhanānvitā | punaḥ śuśrāva taṃ vādyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ ||55 || pūjayā toṣitaḥ śīghraṃ mānasaṃ pūrayiṣyati | śrutvaivaṃ sā vaṭādhastāt pratimāṃ pauruṣottamīm ||56|| vidhāya pūjayāmāsa vaṭapatraphalādibhiḥ | āvāhyācamanaṃ kārayitvāsanaṃ samarpya ca ||57|| pādyamarghyaṃ sasamarpya dadhnā dugdhena vāriṇā | śarkarayā madhunā ca ghṛtenāsnāpayaddharim || 58 || vastreṇa mārjayāmāsa jalānyaṃgebhya īśvarī | dhautraṃ vyāghrāmbaraṃ cottarīyaṃ hastyambaraṃ tathā ||59 || vaṭatvaṅanaktakaṃ yajñopavītaṃ darbhanirmitam | samarpyābharaṇānīṣṭapauṣpāṇi phālikāni ca || 60 || sauvarṇāni ca raupyāṇi kastūrīcandanākṣatān | dhūpadīpasunaivedyatāmbūlaphalacarvaṇam ||6 1 || ārārtrikaṃ daṇḍavacca pradakṣiṇāṃ stutiṃ tathā | puṣpāṃjaliṃ samarpyātha jagau saṃkīrtanaṃ tataḥ ||62|| madhyāhne’pi tathā sāyaṃ niśi prapūjya keśavam | vamrī sajāgaraṃ nṛtyaṃ cakāra harisannidhau ||63|| ḍamaruṃ vādayamānā kiṃkiṇīśabdamiśritam | gāyanaṃ gītikāyuktaṃ madhuraṃ vai cakāra sā ||64|| vanavṛkṣāśca tacchrutvā latāstṛṇāni cāyayuḥ | stabakāśca samājagmuḥ śravaṇākṛṣṭacetanāḥ ||65|| cetanāraṇyakāḥ sarve sapakṣāḥ pakṣavarjitāḥ | api śravaṇasaṃkṛṣṭāḥ samāyātā vaṭasthalam ||66|| puruṣottamadevasya pūjāyā jalamamṛtam | prāsādikaṃ phalaṃ cānyat patraṃ puṣpādikaṃ tathā ||67|| dadau tebhyastu sarvebhyaḥ paścājjagrāha vamrikā | satī ca śaṃkaraścaitadbhāgavataprapūjanam ||68|| dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ paraṃ prāptau praśaṃsatuśca putrikām | dadatuścāśiṣaḥ putri yatheṣṭaṃ sukhinī bhava ||69|| vaiṣṇavī bhava kalyāṇi vanasaukhyakarī bhava | tāpasī brahmaśaktiśca pumuttamapriyā bhava ||7 0|| pūjyā vaṭasthitā mānyā vṛkṣarasapradā bhava | ityādyāśīrvacanaistāṃ yojayāmāsatuḥ śivau ||71|| athaivaṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā visarjanaṃ hareḥ | vaṭavedyāṃ niṣasāda samājaṃ vinivṛtya sā ||72|| tāvattatra samāyāto divyarūpadharaḥ pumān | rūpānurūpāya vayavaḥ koṭiśaṃbhusamojjvalaḥ ||73|| candrānanasuśobhāḍhyo yuvā yogyo varo yathā | prahasya tāṃ samākṛṣya priyetyāha sakaustubhaḥ ||74|| vamrī namramukhī bhūtvā jñātvā śrīpuruṣottamam | patitā pādayostasya cakrapadmadharasya vai ||75|| vad devi vratenāsmi prasannaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | varaṃ brūhi dadāmyatra yatte manasi vartate ||76|| vamrī tu pādayornatvā jalaṃ dhṛtvā mukhe tadā | rajaśca mastake kṛtvā stane kṛtvā padāmbujam ||77|| kaṇṭhopari karau sthāpya mano datvā hṛdambare | netre tu netrayoḥ kṛtvā gṛhītvā puruṣottamam ||78|| patnīṃ bhāryāṃ tava dāsīṃ gṛhāṇetyavadattu sā | paraṃ bhāvaṃ harirjñātvā tathāstvityāha mādhavaḥ ||79|| paraṃ prāha ca tāṃ vamrīṃ smara pūrvaṃ tavārthitam | sannidhau me dundubhestu daśavāraṃ patiṃ patim ||80|| eko’haṃ te patirbhāvyaḥ sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamaḥ | bhava divyasvarūpā tvaṃ samāgaccha mayā saha ||8 1 || akṣare parame dhāmni mama patnī tu śāśvatī | bhavātha mānasī putrī satīsevā parā sadā ||82|| vaṭasāvitrikā nityaṃ santiṣṭhātra kumārikā | rudraputrī vaṭayakṣiṇīti dravyādhirakṣikā ||8 3 || khaniṣvapi pṛthivyāṃ tvaṃ tiṣṭha rudrīsvarūpiṇī | smara pracetaso dṛṣṭvā manaste snigdhatā gatam ||84|| ataste patayo bhāvyā daśa pracetaso’malāḥ | kintu nānena dehena tava yogyā hi te matāḥ ||85|| tasmād vṛkṣairarthitāsi ye ye’tra pūjanāvadhau | upasthitāśca teṣāṃ tvaṃ putrī bhava priye tathā ||8 6|| mamājñayābhidhānaṃ te vārkṣī bhaviṣyati dhruvam | vṛkṣaputrī bhava devi daśadhā rūpadhāriṇī ||87|| śṛṇu tvāṃ kathayāmyatra tattadrūpāṇi saṃkuru | vṛkṣāḥ stambāśca sasyāni śākāni ca tṛṇāni ca ||88 || nalāśca vallayaścaiva daṇḍāḥ patrāṇi kandakāḥ | daśasveteṣu pitṛtvaṃ svīkṛtya daśadhā bhava ||89 || saśākhaphalamātreṣu hyaśākhapuṣpamātrake | saśākhapuṣpamātreṣu hyaśākhaphalamātrake || 90 || saśākhaphalapuṣpeṣu hyaśākhaphalapuṣpake | saśākhāphalapuṣpeṣu hyaśākhaphalapuṣpake ||9 1 || saśākhapatramātreṣu hyaśākhapatramātrake | putrī bhūtvā rasān dehi daśaputryo bhavantu vai || 9 2|| ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’tibhāvataḥ | vamrīrūpaṃ dhāmayogyaṃ kṛtvā nītvā yayau mudā || 93 || ekaṃ putrīsvarūpaṃ tu sthitaṃ vamryāḥ satīkṛte | aparāṇi ca rūpāṇi vṛkṣakanyāḥ suyauvanāḥ ||94|| niṣpannāstāstadā ninyurvṛkṣā vibhinnajātayaḥ | taiḥ pradattāḥ pracetobhyo daśabhya eva dharmataḥ || 95|| sarvatra rasadāyinyaḥ phaladāyinya eva tāḥ | nāradasyopadeśena pracetasāṃ tu mokṣaṇe ||96|| vārkṣīṇāmapi mokṣo vai bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | ekādaśīvrataṃ tvevaṃ kṛtvā vamrī satīsutā || 97|| prapede paramaṃ dhāma tanvā brāhmyā hi śāśvatam | puruṣottamapatnītvaṃ prāptā yatheṣṭasaukhyadam || 98|| devyo vamryastathā vārkṣyo jātāḥ kṛpākaṇāddhareḥ | devyo vamryastu rūdrasya vedyāṃ prathamajā vare || 99 || makhasya devajayane babhūvuḥ samidho bhuvi | śrāvaṇātpaṭhanāccāsyaikādaśyā vratajaṃ phalam || 100 || labhate vācayed yaḥ sa dhanadhānyasamṛddhimān | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca labhate puruṣottamatoṣaṇāt || 101 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye satīrudrayormānasaputryā yoginyā vamryādhikamāsaikādaśīvratakaraṇena sveṣṭabrahmākṣaradhāmayogyabrāhmītanurlabdhā rūpāntarairdaśapracetaḥpatnītvaṃ vṛkṣakanyātvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.318 ||
<1.319> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi kathāṃ vairājapādajām | joṣṭrīṃ devīṃ samudbhūtāṃ sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe tu sevikām || 1 || vairājaḥ puruṣaḥ putraṃ brahmāṇaṃ nābhideśataḥ | samutpādyārpayantasmai joṣṭryākhyāṃ sevikāṃ tataḥ || 2 || vairājacaraṇotpannāṃ juṣamāṇāṃ tu vedhasam | satyaloke sadā dāsīsamāṃ tvāvāsayaddhyajaḥ || 3 || brahmaṇā manasā dhyātā sevikā sā punaḥ punaḥ | suṣuve sevikāṃ jātiṃ naikadhā svapnajātyikām || 4 || ṛṣiṣvanaśanākhyāṃ svaputrīṃ prasūya saṃdadhe | pipāsākhyāṃ sutāṃ pitṛṣu prasūya ca saṃdadhe || 5 || aśanākhyāṃ sutāṃ deveṣu ca prasūya sandadhe | bhūtapretapiśācādau prasūya vāsanāṃ dadhe || 6 || bhūbhṛtsu ca karāyāṃ saṃprasūya putrikāṃ dadhe | mānaveṣu vyavasāyā putrīṃ prasūya sandadhe || 7 || dānaveṣu prasahyāṃ ca putrīṃ prasūya sandadhe | daityeṣu ca vilāsākhyāṃ sutāṃ prasūya sandadhe || 8 || paśupakṣiṣu viśvāsāṃ sutāṃ prasūya sandadhe | vṛkṣavallīṣu tāṃ meghāṃ putrīṃ prasūya sandadhe || 9 || kīṭapataṃgajantvādau dadhe prasūya kardamām | jalavāseṣu putrīṃ kuṃbhikāṃ prasūya sandadhe || 10 || evaṃ dvādaśaputrīḥ sā samprasūya yathāprajam | pradadau sā prajābhyaḥ sevikā pratyekamādarāt || 11 || evaṃ sevāparā joṣṭrī vedhasaḥ sevikā sadā | satyaloke vartate sma sevādharme hi nityadā || 1 2 || yathā viprasya karmāṇi santi ṣaṭ mokṣadāni hi | tathā caturthavarṇasya sevā mokṣakarī matā || 13 || yathā trāṇaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ niḥśreyakaraṃ matam| tathā sevakavargasya sevā niḥśreyasapradā || 14|| yathā dānaṃ tu vaiśyasya śreyaskṛt tūbhayatra hi | tathā tu sevikā vargaḥ śreyāṃsi sevayā labhet || 15|| yathā dāsyāḥ sadājñāyāṃ vartanaṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet | tathā sevakavargasya sevā 3 mokṣadā bhavet || 16|| brahmacaryavrate śīlaṃ yathā rakṣaṇadaṃ bhavet | tathā sevā sevikāyāḥ sadā rakṣaṇadā bhavet || 17|| yathā gārhasthyadharmasya satkāro rakṣako bhavet | yathā sevakavargasya sevā vai rakṣikā bhavet || 18|| yathā vanasthitānāṃ vai tapaḥ sukhakaraṃ matam | tathā saukhyaṃ paricaryākarturbhavati sarvadā || 19|| yathā tyāgavatāṃ tyāgaḥ paramānandado mataḥ | tathā bhāvena sevā vai sevakānandadāyinī || 20 || yathā yajñastapo dhyānaṃ japo dānaṃ havādikam | ubhayatra sukhadaṃ sevāpi sarvatra saukhyadā ||2 1 || sevayā prāpyate svargaṃ rājyaṃ lakṣmīrdhanādikam | yaśaḥ kīrtistathā puṇyaṃ śāśvataṃ mokṣaṇaṃ dhruvam ||22|| kṛṣṇasevā mātṛsevā pitṛsevātmasevanam | devasevā janasevā vṛddhasevārttasevanam ||23 || patisevā satīsevā patnīseveśvarārcanam | gobhūdharmānāthasevāśritasevā prajārhaṇam ||24|| svāmisevātithisevā parātmatoṣaṇādikam | ihāmutra sukhadaṃ ca puṇyadaṃ śāntidaṃ bhavet ||25 || puruṣottamavṛddhyā tu kṛtaṃ mokṣakaraṃ bhavet | dehasevā dhanasevā pādasaṃvāhanādikam ||26 || guṇasevā vastusevānnasevā jalasevanam | gṛhasevā rugṇasevā lokasevādikaṃ tathā ||27|| sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ brahmadṛṣṭyā sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet | sevādharmastato bodhyo’gamyo vai sarvadehinām |||28||| sarvamanyadbhavet sevā na bhavecchraddhayā vinā | vinā bhāvanayā sevā na bhaved yojitāpi vai || 29|| mokṣecchayā bhavetsevā bhavetsukhecchayāpi vā | svārthecchayāpi vā sevā bhavet phalābhikāmyayā || 3 0|| niṣkāmena kṛtā yā tu koṭiguṇārthadā hi sā | akāmasya tu kāryasya phaladaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||3 1|| iti vicārya sā joṣṭrī sarvalokasya sevanam | putrībhiḥ kārayāmāsāntarātmā yatra tuṣyati ||32|| sevayā toṣitāḥ santo dadatyāśiṣa eva ca | vṛddhā viprāḥ prayuñjanti samāśiṣastu sevine || 33|| śarīraṃ nāśamāyāti tena sevā kṛtā pare | loke sahāyatāṃ yāti tasmāt sevāṃ samācaret ||34|| paropakāraḥ kutrāpi viphalo yāti naiva ha | sevāpi viphalā naiva kālāntare’pi jāyate ||35|| adattaṃ nopatiṣṭheta dattamevopatiṣṭhate | asevā nopatiṣṭheta kṛtā sevopatiṣṭhate ||36|| dehena manasā vācā pitaraṃ gurumacyutam | seveta sarvadā prāṇī phalaṃ tacchāśvataṃ bhavet ||37|| iti joṣṭrī sadā satye sevate parameṣṭhinam | putrībhiśca prajāsevāṃ karotyanudivaṃ śubhām ||38|| ekadā tu samājo’bhūt sudharmāyāmajagṛhe | ṛṣayo munayo devāḥ pitaro mānavā drumāḥ ||39 || piśācādyāstathā kandā vallayo daityadānavāḥ | samāyātāścaturdaśabhuvanasthāstu dehinaḥ ||40 || adṛśyāśca tathā dṛśyāḥ sastrīkā samupāyayuḥ | taistaiḥ samājamūrdhanyairāyayurdvādaśāpi tāḥ ||41 || sevikā dāsikārūpā joṣṭrīputryo’śanādikāḥ | samājāḥ sevitāstābhiryogyā yeṣāṃ kṛte tu yā ||42|| tāṃ tāṃ sevāṃ vidhāyaiva toṣitāḥ sarvayonayaḥ | tuṣṭāstābhyo daduḥ pāritoṣikāṇyāśiṣastathā ||43|| sarvā bhavantu sadbhāgyāḥ śāśvatānandapūritāḥ | dhanadhānyayaśaḥkīrtisanmānaguṇapūjitāḥ ||44|| siddhyaiśvaryayutā ramyarūpadhāriṇya eva ca | joṣṭrīvaṃśapravardhinyo mahātejodharāḥ sadā ||45 || lokaprakāśakāriṇyo devyo yadyapi sevikā | bhavantu sarvadā brāhmyaḥ śāśvatasthirayauvanāḥ ||46 || iti labdhāśiṣaḥ sarvāḥ samāje tu nivartite | svasāro dvādaśamāturjoṣṭryā gṛhaṃ yayuḥ kṣaṇam ||47|| tatra tāvat satyaloke dundubhiḥ śrīharermahān | aśrūyata vadan śabdaṃ puruṣottamadeśitam ||48|| atrādhike tu me māse dvādaśyāṃ mama pūjanam | vrataṃ mamaikaśaraṇaṃ kurvantu dehino yathā ||49 || bhavanmano’bhilaṣitaṃ dāsye’haṃ puruṣottamaḥ | mātra pramaditavyaṃ vai kṛcchre svalpaṃ vrataṃ bahu ||5 0|| bhāgyaṃ yeṣāmujjvalaṃ vai gṛhṇantu te’ti tatphalam | dātāhaṃ kṛpayā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’smi sarvathā ||5 1 || siddhīrdāsye dhāma dāsye dāsye vai śāśvataṃ sukham | sarvaṃ dāsye ca māṃ dāsye na dāsye nepsitaṃ tu yat ||5 2|| ekabhuktena naktena phalāhāreṇa vā vratam | jalāhāreṇa dadhnā vā munnyannena ca bhājayā ||5 3|| patreṇa kandamūlaiśca vāyubhakṣeṇa vā vratam | mama prasādaleśena kṛtaṃ vā yadyapi vratam ||54|| takreṇa payasā vāpi tilaiśca māṣamuṣṭibhiḥ | yena kenāpi bhāvena dvādaśīvratamāhitam ||55 || tasyāhaṃ vāñchitaṃ sarvaṃ pūrayiṣyāmi sarvathā | pūjanaṃ mama kartavyaṃ prātarmadhye niśāmukhe ||56|| jāgaraṃ ca prakartavyaṃ deyāni bhojanāni ca | dānānyapi pradeyāni yathāśakti yathārjanam ||57|| mahyaṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ dadyād dadyāttathākṣatāñjalim | jalāṃjaliṃ pradadyācca dadyācca bhāvanāṃjalim ||58|| snehāṃjaliṃ pradadyācca dadyādātmāṃjaliṃ vratī | pradadyātsarvataḥ śreṣṭhāṃ sarvasamarpaṇāṃjalim ||5 9 || bhāvagamyaḥ snehagamyaḥ premagamyo bhavāmyaham | vastugamyaḥ svārthagamyo yadvā tadvā bhavāmyaham ||60 || gamiṣyati ca dīrghāyurgamiṣyati ca yauvanam | yāsyanti sampado nāśaṃ matkṛpā śāśvatī matā ||6 1 || yāsyanti śīrṇatāṃ yogāḥ puṣṭiryāsyati jīrṇatām | varṣma yāsyati bhasmatvaṃ matkṛpā śāśvatī matā ||62|| utpannaṃ tadvinaṣṭaṃ syāt puṇyaṃ rājyaṃ dhanādikam | śāśvatī me kṛpā bodhyā yannāśo naiva vidyate ||63|| kṛpāṃ gṛhṇantu kṛpaṇā dūrayāntu daridratām | madājñayā vratenaiva śāśvatāḍhyā bhavantu vai ||64|| ityevaṃ dundubheḥ śabdaṃ śrutvā tā mātṛvardhitāḥ | vrataṃ cakrurhi payasā dvādaśyā dvādaśaiva tāḥ ||65|| api joṣṭrī vrataṃ cakre vāriṇā bhāvagarbhitam | snātvā prātaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā trayodaśa ||66|| svarṇamūrtiṃ vidhāyaivāpūjayan puruṣottamam | maṇḍapaṃ kadalīstabhaṃ hyaśokāmrāditoraṇam ||67|| puṣpahārāvalijuṣṭaṃ svarṇavastrādiśobhitam | raṃgadīpasukalaśairmaṇḍitaṃ toraṇādibhiḥ ||68|| tanmadhye sarvatobhadraṃ kārayitvā sumaṇḍalam | ramyaṃ suvarṇakalaśaṃ pañcaratnasupallavam ||69 || vastraṃ phalaṃ candanaṃ cākṣatān madhye nidhāya ca | tanmūrdhni kānakaṃ nyasya pātraṃ satilaśarkaram ||70|| tatra nidhāya deveśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamam | vai ṣoḍaśapadārthaiśca pūjayāmāsurādarāt ||71|| āvāhanādikaṃ kṛtvā pañcāmṛtaiśca vāribhiḥ | saṃsnāpya mārjanaṃ kṛtvāmbarāṇyābhūṣaṇāni ca ||72|| kuṃkumaiḥ kajjalairgandhasārairakṣatacandanaiḥ | śṛṃgārayitvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ vidhāya ca ||73|| naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ pūrikādikam | phalaṃ tvāmrādikaṃ pānaṃ cāmṛtaṃ madhuraṃ jalam ||74|| tāmbūlakaṃ phalaṃ cānyad yadyattvapekṣitaṃ prabhoḥ | tattatsarvaṃ pradāyaivārārtrikaṃ dadhire ca tāḥ ||75|| daṇḍavat namanaṃ stotraṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ sumāñjalim | aparādhakṣamāyāñcāṃ cāntimārghyaṃ daduḥ prage ||76|| madhyāhne’pi tathā cakruḥ sevanaṃ niśi cāpi tāḥ | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ cakrurnartanaṃ gāyanādibhiḥ ||77|| dvādaśaiva ca tāḥ kanyā hāvabhāvasamanvitam | yathā kṛṣṇaharirnārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||78|| śṛṃgārarasabhāvena prasannaḥ syātpumuttamaḥ | ākṛṣṭaḥ san dayāluḥ sa darśanaṃ ca dadedyathā ||79|| tathā tābhirmahāharṣaiḥ kṛtaṃ nartanagāyanam | prātarharirbrāhmakāle prādurbabhūva saṃhasan ||80|| yuvā puṣṭaḥ surūpaśca yuvatīmānasāśrayaḥ | koṭikāmātisaundaryo vīryasaṃbhṛtagātrakaḥ ||8 1|| pratiromarativyāptaḥ pratyaṃgānaṃgabhāsitaḥ | prasanno’smi prasanno’smi sevayā saṃvadan muhuḥ ||82|| sevikā varadānāni vṛṇuteṣṭāni sarvathā | indrāṇītvaṃ śivātvaṃ vā brahmāṇītvaṃ tato’pi ca ||83|| kṛṣṇātvaṃ vaiṣṇavītvaṃ ca brāhmītvaṃ tatparaṃ ca vā | yadyadicchā bhavet tattad dadāmyadya na saṃśayaḥ ||84|| dvādaśātmabhavatībhirjitā lokāḥ parātparāḥ | sevayā śraddhayā bhāvanayā snehārdrayāṅganāḥ ||85|| dāsyo’pi yūyamevādyādāsyo jātā hi sevayā | mānasasthaṃ vṛṇutādya mā ciraṃ hṛdayaṃgamāḥ ||86|| sevikānāṃ sevako’haṃ śāstrīṇāṃ śāsako’smyaham | mitrāṇīnāmahaṃ mitraṃ vāmānāṃ dakṣiṇo’smyaham ||87|| snigdhānāṃ snehilaścāsmi śaraṇyānāṃ tu rakṣakaḥ | madarthatyaktasarvasvānāṃ tu sarvasvado’smyaham ||88|| tathā na toṣamāpnomi dhanairbhṛtyaiśca sevayā | yathā santoṣamāpnomi svenaiva kṛtasevayā ||89|| sevako’hamahaṃ svāmī yatra sevā na bhidyate | yatra bhaktaḥ svayaṃ māṃ vai svayaṃ bhāvena sevate ||90|| tasmāt priyāḥ pravadantu kiṃ dadāmi vadāmi kim | priyābhyaḥ kiṃ prayacchāmi sarvasvaṃ hṛdayānvitam ||91|| priyāḥ prāhurvayaṃ sarvā arpitāḥ paramātmani | sarvakānte pare kānte patyau śrīpuruṣottame ||92|| dāsīnāṃ tu tathā dharmaḥ sarvārpaṇaṃ tu śāstari | priyāṇāṃ tu tathā dharmaḥ kānte sarvārpaṇaṃ priye ||93|| svāminaśca tathā dharmo’rpitānāṃ grahaṇaṃ sadā | kāntapriyasya dharmo vai kāntānāṃ priyakāritā ||94|| priyā priyasya sarvasvaṃ priyaḥ sarvaṃ priyākṛte | priyāyāścāpi sarvasvaṃ priya eva dayānidhiḥ ||95|| iti cātra mahatyarthe yatheṣṭaṃ kuru keśava | mānasaṃ tvayi sarvasvaṃ cārpitaṃ kuru yanmatam ||96|| śrutvā prāha tadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhūttamaḥ | sarvaṃ vedmi tathā sarvāḥ svīkaromi hṛdantare ||97|| bāhyato’pi karāndhṛtvā karomi hṛdayaṃgamāḥ | bhavantu matkarasparśād divyarūpadharā mama ||98|| priyāḥ patnyo bhavantvakṣarākhye dhāmani sarvadā | joṣṭrī mama svarūpe’stu tejomayī tu śaktikā ||99|| sarvānandapradā devī cinmayī matsvarūpiṇī | saccidānandarūpe me cinmayī sā mayā kṛtā || 10 0|| anyāśca dvādaśapatnyaḥ santu śāśvatikā mama | tattannāmnā tu tāḥ patnyastatra vasantu madgṛhe || 101 || matsamākṛtayaḥ sarvāḥ patnyastā arthato yathā | māṃ vinānyasukhāderyāśanaṃ naiva karoti hi || 102|| iti sārthānaśanākhyā pipāsāṃ tvarthataḥ śṛṇu | madrasaṃ sarvadā pātumicchati nānyameva yā || 103|| sā pipāsā mayā patnī rakṣitā matsvarūpiṇī | athāśanā mama patnī yā samaśnāti māṃ sadā || 104|| sarvān kāmānaśnute sā brahmaṇā viduṣā saha | iti sārthāśanākhyā sā patnī me rakṣitā mayā || 1 05|| yā ca svātmani nityaṃ māṃ paraṃ vāsayate patim | sā mayā bhāvapūrṇā vāsanā patnī surakṣitā || 106 || yasyā nāmātra vaktavyaṃ bhāvanā bhāvitā mayā | āyāti matkaraṃ dhṛtvā karāyā me priyā hi sā || 1 07|| kaṃ sukhaṃ matparānandaṃ śaṃ lakṣmīṃ divyasaṃpadam | sevayā yāti gṛhṇāti matto yā sā karāyikā || 1 08|| madarthameva sarvasvaṃ kṛtaṃ kriyātmakaṃ yayā | iti niścayasārthakyā vyavasāyā priyā mama || 1 09|| soḍhuṃ yogyā mama sarvā kriyājñā sā priyā mama | prakarṣeṇa sahate yā madratiṃ sā prasahyakā || 110 || madarthe sarvathā divyā vilasyati madarthikā | vilāsākhyā mama patnī me’nuvilāsakāriṇī || 11 1|| yasyāḥ śvāso vinā māṃ tu sthātuṃ śakto bhavennahi | yasyā hyahaṃ ca me sāsti patirme’sti sukhāya vai || 1 12|| iti viśvāsamāpannā viśvāsā sā mama priyā | māṃ vinā jīvanaṃ śvāso nāsti yasyāḥ pratikṣaṇam || 11 3|| mehati varṣate patyau prema varṣayati prabhau | mayi snehaṃ karotyeva meghā sā matpriyā matā || 1 14|| sarvaṃ karmaṃ mayi yā svāṃ damayatibhāvataḥ | madarthaṃ damanaṃ yasyāḥ karmaṇāṃ kardamā priyā || 1 15|| kuṃ kṣetraṃ svātmakaṃ yā bhāvayati matkṛte’nvaham | kuṃbhe jalaṃ yathā tadvanmāṃ bibharti nijātmani || 116 || sā patnī kuṃbhikā me’sti yūyaṃ patnyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ | divyā yāstā dvādaśaivākṣare dhāmni vasantu me || 1 17|| athānyaistu svarūpairdvādaśaśaktyātmikāstu vai | vartantāmanyarūpiṇyo mahākālāya cārpitā || 1 18|| tato viśvaṃ saṃvyakrāmat sāśanānaśane hyabhi | pipāsayā pravāhastu dhāvatyagre’sya saṃsṛteḥ || 1 19|| vāsanayā vasatyetajjaḍacetanamiśritam | karāyayā bhavatyatra vinimayastu dehinoḥ || 12 0|| dhāryate puṣyate kālavāhayā vyavasāyayā | prasahyayā kṣamate tvārtavān dvandvām̐śca vatsaraḥ || 121 || vilāsayā śramaṃ hāpayitvā jīvān yunakti saḥ | viśvāsayā phale lobhātpravartante tu dehinaḥ || 122|| meghayā snehavṛṣṭyā vai rañjayanti prajāḥ samāḥ | kardamayā prajā bhūtā mayi tiṣṭhanti kardame || 123 || kuṃbheṣvatra golakeṣu brahmāṇḍeṣu ca sarvathā | tattatsthāne sthāpayitrī kuṃbhikā rakṣikā matā || 1 24|| evaṃ kālasya macchaktibhūtasya śaktayo’nvaham | bhavantu kāryakāriṇyo loke kālāya cārpitāḥ || 1 25|| atha yatra joṣṭrikāyāḥ putryaḥ santyuṣitā yathā | tāstathaiva tu vedhaḥ kṛdbrahmāṇḍe’pi vasantviti || 126 || vasantu śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mama vācchayā | tṛtīyaistu svarūpaiḥ svairjyoṣṭrījananya eva ha || 1 27|| evaṃ trividharūpairvai mayā samyaṅniyojitāḥ | kurvantu dāsyamevātra mahākāle tathā mayi || 128||| bhavatīnāmahaṃ svāmī patiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | ramantāṃ tu mayā sārdhaṃ svatantrā akṣare pare || 129|| tathānyā macchaktirūpamahākālasahāyikāḥ | tathāparā mama sṛṣṭau tattatkāryavahāḥ sadā || 130|| iti tredhā mayā dattaṃ bhavatībhyaḥ prasevanam | dvādaśyāstu vratasyaiva phalaṃ dattaṃ hi śāśvatam || 13 1|| ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ | divyāstāḥ saha nītvaiva vyavasthāpya tathāparāḥ || 1 32|| mahākālāya datvānyā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ hariḥ | vada lakṣmi kṛpāpārāvāraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ || 133|| kiṃ kiṃ dadāti kṛpayā svalpasyānantakaṃ phalam | iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ joṣṭrīdevyāḥ kathānakam || 134|| devī joṣṭrī vasudhitī devamindraṃ vayodhasam | prāpyāvardhata bṛhatī brāhmyāsa puruṣottamam || 1 35|| ya idaṃ śrāvayeccāpi śṛṇuyādvā paṭhecca vā | tasyāpi tādṛśaṃ syācca phalaṃ vratasya niścitam || 136|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye vairājaputryā joṣṭryā anaśanādidvādaśaputrīṇāṃ sevayā dvādaśyāvratena ca prasannasya puruṣottamanārāyaṇasya prāptistredhārūpadhāraṇādika cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonaviṃśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.319 ||
<1.320> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi rādhikāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā putrīmatīṃ varām | śrīrapi prāha deveśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ parameśvaram || 1 || kānta rādhā yathā putrīmatī saṃśobhate hare | mānyatā yāti sarvāsu putrīmatīṣu sarvathā || 2 || yathā tathā kadā putrīmatī syāṃ puruṣottama | kṛpāṃ kṛtvā tu mahyaṃ vai dehi putrīṃ śubhāśrayām || 3 || evaṃ tayārthitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śriyaṃ tadā | tathāstviti varaṃ datvā reme tayā sulīlayā || 4 || śrīkṛṣṇasyekṣaṇādeva śriyaḥ paryaṃkaśobhanā | divyā kṛṣṇasamā rūpe saundarye śrīsamā sutā || 5 || prādurbabhūva sahasā jātamātrā suyauvanā | kāmadugheva sampannā sudughā nāmataḥ kṛtā || 6 || śrīkṛṣṇena śriyā cāpyāhūtā sā sudugheti vai | pradogdhi sarvakāmān sā sudughā kṛṣṇakanyakā || 7 || śrītulyā śrīsvarūpā ca śrīrivātisamujjvalā | sarvāvayavapuṣṭā ca kānakīṃ chavimāśritā || 8 || jātamātrā nisargāt sā gavāṃ dohanakarmaṇi | vyavasāyamayī rucyā dṛśyate gopriyā tathā || 9 || sā tu jātā yadā tatra mahotsavo’pyabhūnmahān | śrīkṛṣṇasya śriyā vāse’vatārarṣisurakṛtaḥ || 10 || devīnāṃ nartanaṃ cāpsarasāṃ gītaṃ sunartanam | gandharvāṇāṃ gāyanaṃ vādanaṃ cābhavanmahotsave || 11 || munīnāmāśiṣāmāptirabhūt kanyāsurakṣikā | gopagopīgaṇānāṃ ca vāṇyo hyāsan suvardhikāḥ || 12 || tathāṃjalikusumāni nipetuḥ sudughopari | dugdhavatkāntinivahāṃ dṛṣṭvā kanyāṃ tu kanyakāḥ || 13 || vayasyā jahṛṣuścāti remire ca tayā muhuḥ | rāmayanti ramante ca viharanti tayā tu tāḥ || 14|| atha jijñāsamānā sā dughā kāryaṃ muhurmuhuḥ | mayā kimatra kartavyaṃ mīmāṃsate hi bhāvataḥ || 15|| pitrā kṛṣṇena cādiṣṭaṃ jñātvā yogabalaṃ tathā | ūrjāhuti dughe putri payasendramavardhatām || 16 || ityājñaptātisaṃhṛṣṭā sudughā pitarau tadā | praṇamyendrasya vṛddhyarthaṃ puṣṭyarthaṃ samacintayat || 17|| yatra yatra ca goleṣu brahmāṇḍeṣu ca yādṛśam | māhendraṃ tu padaṃ devasāmrājyaṃ vartate divi || 18 || tāni sarvāṇi rājyāni dhyātvā hṛdā padāni ca | teṣāṃ śāśvatapuṣṭyarthaṃ cintayāmāsa sādhanam || 19 || śrīputrī sudughā cāhaṃ dugdharūpā bhavāmi ca | divi dugdhāmṛtaṃ datvā surebhyo nivasāmi ca || 20 || maharādau sukṛtātmāmṛtaṃ bhūtvā vasāmi ca | pitṛbhyo vāripiṇḍādi pāyasādi dadāmi ca || 21 || paśumānuṣavṛkṣebhyo dugdhāmṛtaṃ rasātmakam | datvā puṣṭiṃ kārayāmi bhuve’pi surasāmṛtam || 22 || jale snehāmṛtaṃ kṛtvā pravidadhāmi poṣaṇam | vahnaye pākamādhuryaṃ dadāmi pācanāmṛtam || 2 3 || ātmane dehavāsāya dadāmi viṣayāmṛtam | indra ātmendriyāṇyasya śaktayo viṣayāśrayāḥ || 24||| tābhiramṛtabhoktāro bhavantyātmani eva hi | tattvagaṃ navanītaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ sarvakṛte’mṛtam ||25 || evaṃ bahusvarūpāhaṃ kāryātmikā bhavāmi ca | indrasya saukhyalābhāya dughā śaktirvasāmi ca || 26|| yajñe ūrjāhutī cāhaṃ bhūtvā puṣṭiṃ karomi ca | indrasya sarvathā rakṣā yathā syāttādṛśī tathā ||27|| bhūtvā bhūtvaiva sarvatrādyaiva kuryāṃ praveśanam | iti vicārya sā kanyā sudughā bahurūpiṇī ||28|| babhūva dṛśyā cādṛśyā praviveśa yathāmatam | indrasya ruciraṃ svargaṃ tataḥ smṛddhyā vyavardhata ||29 || sarvāmṛtāni dugdhāni vyavardhantātivegataḥ | lokeṣu śrīmayī bhūmiḥ sampadāsīnmanoramā || 3 0|| devā devyo vyarājanta pūrvato’pyadhikādhikam | vyayamānā bhujyamānā api sarvāḥ susampadaḥ ||3 1|| na viyanti manāṅ nāpi kṣīyante sudughānvayāt | adṛṣṭā cāśrutā sampad babhūvānandasammukhā ||3 2|| evaṃ yāte śubhe kāle yāte cādye kṛte yuge | ṛṣirmānyo’bhavannāmnā medhāvī yājñiko mahān ||3 3 || yajñān karoti vidhibhiḥ kārayatyapi vṛṣṭaye | putrādyarthaṃ sukhādyartha svargārthaṃ sukṛtāptaye ||34|| putraputrīyugalārthaṃ putreṣṭiṃ sa cakāra vai | viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo bahvāvirbabhūva ha ||35 || jagrāha svakarābhyāṃ supuroḍāśaṃ tadarpitam | uvāca ca prasanno’smi varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam || 36 || pṛthvīṃ rājyaṃ rasān miṣṭaṃ dugdhaṃ svargaṃ sutaṃ sutām | yathecchasi tathā tubhyaṃ dadāmi kuru mā ciram ||37|| śrutvā viprastu medhāvī prāha putraṃ pradehi me | yajñaḥ putreṣṭināmāsau putrārthaṃ vartito mayā ||38|| bhagavān prāha putraste saptajanmasu nāsti vai | putreṣṭyā jāyate putraścirāyuṣṭre tu saṃśayaḥ |||3 9|| janmanā yastu sukhado’nantaraṃ duḥkhado mṛteḥ | tasmād vipra vṛṇu putrīṃ yadi cet te prarocate || 40 || tava patnyā bhālarekhā putryarthā bhāti cānagha | putrādapyadhikā kīrtau sevāyāṃ sā bhaviṣyati ||4 1 || yayā śoko na vai syācca tathā kuru mahīsura | patnīmataṃ samādāya vipro jagrāha tadvacaḥ ||42|| tato bhagavatā dattaḥ prasādo bhojanāya vai | gṛhītvāha hariṃ vipraḥ putrī śrīsadṛśī mama ||43|| sukhadā nātha bhavatu śāntā kāmadugheva sā | yā śaktiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sudhāpānapradāyinī ||44|| tathāstviti hariḥ prāha prairayacchrīsutāṃ dughām | medhāvinastu putryarthaṃ sudughāpi tadājñayā ||45|| prāvirbabhūva medhāvibhāryāyāḥ śayane tadā | mānasī sābhavad divyā śobhate śrīrivāparā ||46|| jātamātrātisaṃśobhiyauvanā puṣṭisaṃbhṛtā | rūpalāvaṇyalalitā nayanāpāṃgamocinī ||47|| cāturyādiguṇopetā pitrorekaiva śaṃsthalī | ati vai vallabhā pitroḥ sarvasadguṇasundarī ||48|| lālitā putravannityaṃ nopālabdhā kadāpi tu | nītisāhityakuśalā cātmatattvaviśāradā ||49|| sevikā sarvadā pitroḥ sevayā tuṣyataśca tau | kālena gacchatā lakṣmi tanmātā nidhanaṃ gatā ||50|| pitrā sā pālitā harṣāt putrasthānāṃ kumārikām | sāpi kāle gate cāsīd yoginīva tathāpi tu ||5 1 || pārśvasthālisukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā putrapautrasukhaspṛhā | medhāvatī kumārī sā gārhasthyārthamanorathā ||52|| tarkayati ca māmeva sukhaṃ bhāgya kathaṃ bhavet | guṇabhāgyodayo bhartā sukhadāśca sutāḥ katham ||53 || tadarthaṃ kaṃ muniṃ
