yadvā kamupāsye sureśvaram | yuvatyahaṃ sakhīmadhye kumārī duḥkhavedinī ||54|| nāhaṃ svāmisukhābhijñā yathā mama sakhīgaṇaḥ | evaṃ cintākulāṃ bālāṃ vijñāyāpi ca tatpitā ||5 5 || medhāvī vicacārorvyāṃ vicinvan tatsamaṃ varam | aprāpya bhagnasaṃkalpo jvaraṃ tīvramavāpa saḥ ||5 6 || āgacchanneva bhavanaṃ harau cittamadhārayat | sasmāra śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam ||57|| gṛhāṃgaṇe papātāsau kṛṣṇadūtāḥ samāyayuḥ | kare dhṛtvā muniṃ taṃ te yayuḥ kṛṣṇasaroruham ||58|| prāṇotkramaṇamālokya hāheti sā sutārudat | aṃke kṛtvā piturdehaṃ vilalāpa suduḥkhitā ||5 9 || hā hā pitaḥ kathaṃ mātṛhīnāṃ tyaktvā nijāṃ sutām | pitṛhīnāṃ tathā kṛtvā hyanāthāṃ kva gato’si vai ||6 0 || na bhrātā naiva bandhuśca na mātā na ca rakṣakaḥ | kathaṃ tiṣṭhāmyahaṃ tāta mariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ||6 1 || ityādirodanaṃ śrutvā tāpasāstatra cāyayuḥ | mṛtaṃ muniṃ dadṛśuste saśokā dadahustataḥ ||62|| samāśvāsya ca tāṃ kanyāṃ sarve te svālayān yayuḥ| kanyā dhairyaṃ samālambyākarocchaktyaurdhvadaihikam ||63|| gate kāle bhāgyavaśād durvāsāḥ śāṃkaro muniḥ | samāyāttadgṛhaṃ lakṣmi bhaviṣyadbalanoditaḥ ||64|| tamālokya samāyāntaṃ kumārī caraṇau muneḥ | vavandārghyādibhiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayāmāsa sādaram ||65|| namaste’stvatriputrāya kuto’dhigamanaṃ mune | mama bhāgyodayo jāto bhavattīrthaniṣevayā ||66|| adya me saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ tvadya me vratam | adya me phalavatpuṇyaṃ yad bhavādṛśadarśanam ||67|| śrutvāha tāṃ tu durvāsāḥ sādhu svasti sute tava | kailāsādahamāgacchaṃ gacchāmi badarīvanam ||68|| draṣṭuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ tvayārthaścennivedyatām | medhāvatī ṛṣiṃ prāha nānāvedyaṃ prabhormanāk ||69|| ataḥ paraṃ śubhaṃ bhāvi tvaddarśanādanugrahāt | na mātā na pitā bandhurna kaścid rakṣako’sti me ||70|| na māṃ kāmayate kaścit pāṇigrahaṇahetave | brahman mumūrṣurasmyeva kiṃ karomi hitaṃ kuru ||7 1|| śrutvā munirupāyaṃ suvircāyākathayat sutām | itastṛtīyaḥ subhage māsastu puruṣottamaḥ ||72|| tatra snātā janastīrthe mucyate brahmahatyayā | etattulyo na ko’pyanyo māsottamo hi vidyate ||73|| sarve māsāstathā pakṣāḥ parvāṇi ṛtavastathā | puruṣottamamāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||74|| sādhanāni samastāni gaṃgā godāplavāni ca | sahasrāṇyadhimāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||75|| śrīkṛṣṇavallabho māso nāmnā ca puruṣottamaḥ | tasmin saṃsevite bāle sarvaṃ siddhyati vāñcchitam ||76|| tasmānniṣevayāśu tvaṃ māsaṃ taṃ puruṣottamam | mayāpi sevate putri puruṣottamavat sadā ||77|| yadi cediṣṭamāptavyaṃ yathāruci kuru vratam | ahaṃ putri gamiṣyāmi naranārāyaṇālayam ||78|| ityuktvā prayayau śīghraṃ hyatha medhāvatī tataḥ | adhimāsapratīkṣāḍhyā tatkālaphaladaṃ śivam ||79|| citte dhṛtvā tamuddiśya cacāra duścaraṃ tapaḥ | divā paṃcāgnimadhyasthā rātrau śītajalasthitā ||80|| anāhārā haradhyānā samādhāviva tiṣṭhati | santuṣṭastapasā tasyā bhagavānpārvatīpatiḥ ||8 1|| darśayāmāsa bālāyai svaṃ rūpaṃ cākṣigocaram | sā vavande haraṃ puṣpādibhiḥ pupūja mānasaiḥ ||8 2|| tuṣṭāva bhaktibhāvena hyāśutoṣāya te namaḥ | anādhārasutādhāraśaṃkarāya ca te namaḥ ||8 3 || namaḥ sūryāgnisomatrinetrāya mṛtyave namaḥ | pārvatītāpasīvāñcchāpūrakāyeha te namaḥ ||84|| kumāryāścāpyanāthāyā uddhāraṃ kuru śaṃkara | iti stutvā punarnatvā virarāmarṣiputrikā ||85 || śrutvā prasannavadanastāmuvāca sadāśivaḥ | varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te prasanno’smi dadāmi te ||86|| bālovāca dayāsindho prasannaścenmamopari | patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi patiṃ patim ||87|| ityāśrutya mahādevo jagādarṣisutāṃ tadā | pañcakṛtvastvayā yasmāt prārthitaḥ patirīśvarāt ||88 || tasmāt paṃca bhaviṣyanti patayastava dhārmikāḥ | yajvānaḥ satyasandhāśca rājanyāstvanmayāḥ sute ||8 9|| idānīṃ paṃcasaṃkhyākā indrāḥ prākkalpasaṃbhavāḥ | vasanti satyaloke te bhavantu patayaḥ sute || 9 0|| anenaiva hi dehena divyatāṃ prāpitena vai | mayā sāhāyyadenādyāgaccha satye tadantikam || 91 || ityuktvā śaṃkarastāṃ sudivyadehāṃ vidhāya ca | nināya satyalokaṃ vai mārge medhāvatīṃ divi || 92|| śuśrāva dundubhiṃ divyaṃ kurvantu vratamuttamam | trayodaśyadhimāsasya yatheṣṭaphaladā bhavet || 93 || patiprāptirmama prāptirbhavedekavratena vai | śrutvā medhāvatī prāha kṛṣṇaprāptiḥ kathaṃ bhavet || 94|| śrutvā tu dundubhiṃ cainaṃ jijñāsā jāyate mama | tathā kuru yathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo milenmama || 95 || śaṃbhuḥ prāha śubhe putri kalyāṇaṃ te’stu sarvathā | prasanno’smi tava vākyāt kṛṣṇaprāptiparāyaṇāt || 96 || rājyaṃ svargaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ caiśvaraṃ padameva vā | sarvaṃ bhavati nissvādaṃ vinā kṛṣṇaṃ pumuttamam || 97 || bhaktyā sa labhyate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ pumān | kuru vrataṃ trayodaśyā yathādundubhibhāṣitam || 98 || upavāsaṃ phalāhāraṃ kṛtvā ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ | pūjayetparamātmānaṃ bhojayellālayettathā || 99 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt sarvaṃ dadet pratoṣitaḥ | ityuktvā tāṃ satyalokaṃ gamayitvendrapañcakam || 100 || datvā patnīsvarūpeṇa punaḥ prāha sutāṃ haraḥ | puruṣottamamāsasya trayodaśyā vratena vai || 10 1 || miliṣyati haristvāṃ vai mānuṣe kṛtavigrahe | ayonisaṃbhavā tatra bhaviṣyasi tapobalāt || 10 2|| tatraite pañcabhartāro bhaviṣyanti surāṃśajāḥ | dharmamarunmahendrāśvinīkumārāṃśasabhavāḥ || 103 || śrīpatistu tadā kṛṣṇo miliṣyati ca rakṣakaḥ | bhartṛjaṃ sukhamāsādya tato gantrī paraṃ padam || 1 04|| puruṣottamabhaktāstu putrāpautradhanānvitāḥ | aihikāmuṣmikīṃ siddhiṃ yātā yāsyanti yānti ca || 105 || vayaṃ sarve’pi netāraḥ puruṣottamasevinaḥ | vadannevaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaḥ kṣipramantardadhe haraḥ || 106 || medhāvatyā patīn pṛṣṭvā śaṃkarasyopadeśanāt | trayodaśyā vrataṃ sopavāsaṃ sajāgaraṃ kṛtam || 1 07|| pañcāmṛtairjalaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ saṃsnāpya puruṣottamam | vastrālaṃkāranaivedyaphalatāmbūlakādikam || 108 || dhūpadīpasupuṣpādyakṣatāṃjali kṣamārthanam | ārārtrikādikaṃ kṛtvā yayāce parameśvarāt || 10 9|| darśanaṃ dehi me tāta bhave sāhāyyado bhava | tāvattatra samāyāto garuḍasthaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ || 110 || prāhāsmi te sute tuṣṭastrayodaśyā vratena vai | rakṣayiṣye sadā putri saha sthāsye yathāvanam || 111 || punaḥ provāca sā putrī mokṣo me syād yathā guro | tathānte me bhavettāta nānyaṃ kāṃkṣe manoratham || 11 2|| tathāstviti hariḥ prāha prāha cāpi viśeṣataḥ | śṛṇu putri dvāparānte kṛṣṇo’haṃ bhagavān svayam || 113 || bhūbhāraharaṇārthāyāvatariṣyāmi vai kṣitau | yajñasenākhyanṛpateryajñakuṇḍasya madhyataḥ || 1 14|| bhaviṣyasi tvamudbhūtā kumārī kanakaprabhā | yājñasenī ca vairājī kṛṣṇā khyātā bhaviṣyasi || 11 5|| tatraiva ca same kāle pañcendrāḥ svāminastava | bhaviṣyanti surāṃśāste patayo’mitavikramāḥ || 1 1 6|| taddvārā tvanmiṣaṃ kṛtvāsurāndaityām̐śca dānavān | nāśayitvā svakaṃ dhāma yadā yāsye tadā sute || 11 7|| nayiṣye tvāṃ yathākālaṃ yathākāryaṃ niruddhya ca | punastvaṃ prāpsyase dhāma golokaṃ yatra te januḥ || 1 18|| tadā tvāṃ sudughe putri tanvā brāhmyākṣare pare | dhāmni saṃprāpayiṣye maccaraṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ sukham || 11 9|| iti te kathitaṃ putri bhaviṣyatte kathānakam | satye sukhaṃ vasa putri yāmyahaṃ ca mamālayam || 1 20|| ityuktvādṛśyatāṃ yātastadā śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | sudughā kṛṣṇaputrī sā yājñasenī bhaviṣyati || 12 1|| adhimāsaparapakṣatrayodaśyā vratena sā | prāpsyatīyaṃ paraṃ dhāma puruṣottamavākyataḥ || 122|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi śrīputryāstu kathānakam | te dhanyā janmavantaśca te pūjyāḥ pāvanāstathā || 1 23|| vividhairniyamairyaistu pūjitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāpi vratasyātra phalaṃ labhet || 124|| labhate kṛṣṇasāhāyyaṃ puruṣottamasammatam | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheccāpi naro nārī paro’pi vā || 1 25|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīya saṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye goloke śrīputryāḥ sudughāyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇājñayā indravṛddhyarthaṃ pravṛttāyā rasāmṛtātmakatā yājñikasya medhāviviprasya gṛhe’yonijāyāstasyā janma pitrormaraṇaṃ durvāsasa āgamanaṃ puruṣottamamāsavratopadeśaḥ śaṃkaropari tapaḥ pañcakṛtvaḥ patiprārthanam satyaloke pañcendrapatiprāptiḥ trayodaśīvratena puruṣottamadarśanaṃ bhuvi pañcapatimatī yājñasenī bhūtvā mokṣaṃ yāsyasītivaradānaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā viṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||1.320 ||
<1.321> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi caturdaśyā vratena nṛpasattamaḥ | citradharmasya satputro dṛḍhadhanveti viśrutaḥ || 1 || prāpad rājyaṃ putrapautrān lalanāṃ ca pativratām | ante ca bhagavallokamavāpa yogidurlabham || 2 || sarvasadguṇasampanno dṛṣṭavān vedapāragaḥ | prajārakṣākaraḥ putro babhūveti ca tatpitā || 3 || vicārya citradharmā taṃ svarājye tvabhyaṣecayat | atha cārādhayāmīśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 4 || tadarthaṃ vanabhūmirvai yogyā bhavati sarvathā | dhruvāmbarīṣaśaryātiyayātiśaśabindavaḥ || 5 || bhagīratha śibi rantideva rukmāṃgadādayaḥ | divodāsābhayakhaṭvāṃgadarājarṣisattamāḥ || 6 || ete cānye ca kalpeṣu kalpāntareṣu bhūbhṛtaḥ | vanaṃ yayurmahāsattvāstyaktvā bhogānanekaśaḥ || 7 || adhruveṇa dhruvaṃ prāptā ārādhya puruṣottamam | ato mayāpi kartavyamaraṇye harisevanam || 8 || chitvā pāśaṃ vāsanākhyaṃ dārāputragṛhādiṣu | iti niścitya manasā citradharmā yayau vanam || 9 || pulahāśramamāsādya tapastepe hariṃ smaran | śuddho bhūtvā divyatanurharerdhāma jagāma saḥ || 10 || dṛḍhadhanvā pituścaurdhvadaihikaṃ cākarottataḥ | puṣkarāvartanagare rājadhānīṃ vidhāya saḥ || 11 || bhāryayā guṇasundaryā vaidarbhyā saha bhūpatiḥ | śaśāsa sakalāṃ pṛthvīṃ caturbhistanayaiḥ saha || 1 2|| citravākcitravāṭcitrakuṇḍalamaṇikuṇḍalaiḥ | ekadā niśi suptasya cintāsīd dṛḍhadhanvanaḥ || 13 || dānaṃ tapo japaṃ homaṃ nāhaṃ vai kṛtavān kvacit | tathāpi vaibhavā rājyaṃ kena bhāgyena me nanu || 14|| brāhme muhūrte utthāya sa rājā mṛgayāmanāḥ | jagāmāśvaṃ samāruhyāraṇye vai sarasastaṭam || 15|| samāgamadvaṭe tatra kaścinmānuṣavāk śukaḥ | sa tu papāṭha suślokamekameva punaḥ punaḥ || 16 || satyapi vaibhave rājye dehādau sukhade tathā | na cintayasi lakṣmīśaṃ kathaṃ pāraṃ sameṣyasi || 17|| śrutvā rājā kīravākyaṃ mumude bhavatārakam | kṛtvā tu mṛgayāṃ rājā kīravākyaṃ vicārayan || 18 || ājagāma gṛhaṃ tāvat tatra vālmīkirāyayau | rājā prapūjya vālmīkiṃ papraccha kīrabhāṣitam || 19 || kimuvāca kathaṃ prāha ko’sāvāsīcchuko mune | śrutvā kṣaṇaṃ ca taddhyātvā vālmīkirāha bhūpatim || 20 || śṛṇu rājam̐stava pūrvajanmanaścaritaṃ yathā | tāmraparṇītaṭe deśe draviḍe tvaṃ dvijo’bhavaḥ || 21 || sudevākhyaśca te patnīṃ gautamī gautamodbhavā | aprajā sā patiṃ prāhāpatyaṃ vinā suduḥkhitā || 22 || santatiḥ śuddhavaṃśyā syādatra paratra śarmaṇe | tamaprāpya varaṃ putraṃ jīvitaṃ tvatra niṣphalam || 23 || tasmātsatputralābhārthamāvābhyāṃ parameśvaraḥ | ārādhanīyaḥ satataṃ tapasā puruṣottamaḥ || 24|| dharmapatnyā vaco matvā tāmraparṇītaṭe śubhe | śuṣkaparṇajalāhārau paṃcame paṃcame dine || 25 || catvāryabdasahasrāṇi ceratuḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ | lokāścakampire tena prādurbabhūva mādhavaḥ ||26 || garuḍastho hariḥ prāha sudeva bhadramastu te | gautami śrīrastu te’pi kurutaṃ mā tapo bahu ||27|| śrutvā tau nematuḥ kṛṣṇamūcaturjaya mādhava | sudevaḥ prāha bhagavan putraṃ dehi hare prabho ||28|| hariḥ prāha lalāṭe te varṇāḥ sarve mayekṣitāḥ | tatra naivāsti te putrasukhaṃ saptasu janmasu ||29|| gautamyuvāca bhāgyāgre ramānātho nirarthakaḥ | daivamālaṃbanīyaṃ cet hariṇā kiṃ prayojanam ||3 0|| śrutvā hariṃ garuḍastu prāha kṛṣṇaṃ janārdanam | bhaktaduḥkhāsahiṣṇo tvaṃ haryarthaṃ sārthakaṃ kuru ||3 1 || tvadārādhanamāhātmyaṃ niṣphalaṃ naiva naiva hi | kartumakartuṃ sāmarthyaṃ mā kuru tvaṃ nirarthakam ||3 2|| garuḍasyāgrahaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathāstvityavadaddhariḥ | paraṃ tajjanitaṃ duḥkhaṃ dampatyorbhavitā dhruvam ||3 3 || ityuktvā garuḍe sthitvā golokaṃ harirāyayau | gate kāle sudevasya patnyāṃ putro’bhavacchubhaḥ ||34|| vyavardhata gate kāle copanīto’tha pāṭhitaḥ | devalarṣiḥ kvacittatra samāyāt pāpanāśanaḥ ||35|| karaṃ dṛṣṭvā chatrapadmayavacāmaracihnitam | sphuṭadāyuṣyarekhaṃ ca prāhādhunvan śirastadā ||36|| sudeva tanayo’yaṃ te dvādaśe hāyane jale | mṛtyumeṣyati tasmātte māstu śoko’nubhāvini || 37|| śrutvā śuśūcatustau ca devalo niryayau tataḥ | atha prāpte’niṣṭakāle’gacchadvāpīṃ hi tatsutaḥ || 38|| patito’gādhatoye’sau mamajja ca mamāra ca | jñātvā putrasya nidhanaṃ vayasyebhyaḥ pitā prasūḥ ||39|| yayatustatra saṃgṛhya śavaṃ rurudaturbahu | vilāpaṃ cakratuścāti tatyajaturjalānnakam ||40|| śrīkṛṣṇavallabho māsaḥ so’bhavatpuruṣottamaḥ | ajānatostayorāsītpuruṣottamasevanam ||41|| tenātyantaprasannaḥ sanprādurāsīddhariḥ svayam | sapatnīko namaścakre daṇḍavacchrīhariṃ dvijaḥ ||42|| hariḥ prāha sudeva tvaṃ bhāgyavānasi sāmpratam | dvādaśābdasahasrāyuḥ putraste’yaṃ kṛto mayā ||43|| puruṣottamamāhātmyāt prasannena mayā dvija | suciraṃ jīvito’yaṃ hi tanayaḥ sukhado’stu te ||44|| gārhasthyamatulaṃ bhuktvā saha putreṇa sarvadā | tatastvaṃ brahmaṇo lokaṃ gatvā tatra mahat sukham ||45 || divyābdavarṣasāhasraṃ bhuktvā gantāsi bhūtale | tato rājā cakravartī dṛḍhadhanvā bhaviṣyasi ||46 || samvatsarāṇāmayutaṃ rājyaṃ bhokṣyasi pārthivam | gautamīyaṃ tava patnī nāmnā tu guṇasundarī || 47 | putrāścatvāra ekā ca kanyā te tatra bhāvinaḥ | yadā viramase māṃ tvaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||48 || ayaṃ te tanayo vipra śuko bhūtvā tadā vane | bodhayiṣyati bhaktestu vākyaṃ kṛṣṇavicintakam || 49 || vālmīkistvāṃ kathāṃ sarvāṃ yathārthāṃ kathayiṣyati | tato vairāgyamāpannaḥ kṛtvā bhaktiṃ parāṃ hareḥ ||5 0 || gamiṣyasi sapatnīko mokṣaṃ paraṃ hareḥ padam | vadatyevaṃ mahāviṣṇau samuttasthau dvijātmajaḥ || 51 || dampatī taṃ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahānandau babhūvatuḥ | nanāma śukadevo’pi śrīhariṃ pitarau tu tau || 52 || garuḍo brāhmaṇaścāpi nemurhariṃ sabhāryakaḥ | kṛṣṇaḥ prāhādhimāsasyānāyāsenāpi pālanāt |5 3 || sutadārāpatipatnīkṣetrarājyasukhāni vai | bhavantyeva na sandehaḥ kimu putrasajīvanam ||54|| ekamapyupavāsaṃ yaḥ karoti puruṣottame | dagdhvānantānyaniṣṭāni labdhvā puṇyanidhīn sa tu |55 || surayānaṃ samāruhya vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti dehavān | ekataḥ sarvapuṇyāni tvekataḥ puruṣottamam ||56|| tolayāmāsa vedho’bhūd gururvai puruṣottamaḥ | īśasṛṣṭau jīvasṛṣṭau brahmasṛṣṭāvapi svayam || 57 | puruṣottamamāsastu sarvatra vartate mahān | tasya vai pālanenātra vijayaste bhaviṣyati |58 | ityuktvā śrīharirdhāma yayau garuḍavāhanaḥ | sudevaḥ saḥ sapatnīkastaṃ māsaṃ samapūjayat ||59 | bhuktvātha viṣayān sarvān sahasrābdānyaharniśam | jagāma brahmaṇo lokaṃ sapatnīko dvijottamaḥ |60 | tatratyaṃ sukhamāsādya sapatnīko bhuvaṃ gataḥ | sa eva dṛḍhadhanvā tvaṃ prathitaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || 61 || mahiṣīyaṃ tava patnī gautamī guṇasundarī | śukadevaśca te putro hariṇā yo’nujīvitaḥ | 62 || dvādaśābdasahasrāyurbhuktvā vaikuṇṭhameyivān | sa eva vai śuko bhūtvābodhayat tvāṃ smṛtiṃ hareḥ ||6 3 || punnāmanarakāt trātā putraste sārthako’bhavat | ityetat kathitaṃ rājan prāgvṛttaṃ te yathā hyabhūt ||64|| śatadhanvā tadāpṛcchat pūjāvidhiṃ muniṃ tadā | vālmīkistvāha taṃ sarvaṃ vidhiṃ vistarato nṛpam ||65 || brāhme muhūrte cotthāya paraṃbrahma vicintayet | tato vrajennairṛtāśāṃ śaucārthaṃ jalabhājanaḥ ||66 || karṇe kṛtvā brahmasūtraṃ śaucaṃ mūtraṃ visarjayet | jalenendriyayugalaṃ prakṣālya mṛjjalādibhiḥ ||67|| gandhalepakṣayaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā gaṇḍūṣakān bahūn | dantaśuddhiṃ tathā kṛtvā snāyāttīrthādivāriṣu ||68 || āyurbalaṃ yaśo varcaḥ prajā paśuvasūni ca | brahma prajñā ca medhā ca vardhante snāyino’nvaham ||69|| śuddhe vastre paridhāya prāṅmukho baddhasaṃśikhaḥ | sapavitreṇa hastena kuryādācamana tataḥ ||70 || ūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ sabinduṃ ca kuryāccandanamṛtsnayā | śaṃkhacakrādi kuryācca dhārayet tulasīsrajam ||7 1 || prāṇāyāmaṃ tathā sandhyāṃ gāyatrījapanaṃ caret | śucau deśe gomayena maṇḍalaṃ taṇḍulādibhiḥ ||72 || kārayitvā ca tanmadhye kalaśaṃ sajale nyaset | kalaśasya mukhe viṣṇuḥ kaṇṭhe rudraḥ sadā sthitaḥ ||73 || tasya mūle sthito brahmā madhye tiṣṭhanti mātaraḥ | kukṣau tiṣṭhanti bhūdvīpasahitāḥ sapta sāgarāḥ ||74|| tiṣṭhanti ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvāṇo’ṅgayutāstathā | gaṃgā godāvarī sauryā kāverī ca sarasvatī ||75|| tiṣṭhantvatra jale nadyaḥ pāpanāśavidhāyikāḥ | candanākṣatapuṣpāṇi samarpayāmi oṃ namaḥ ||76 || naivedyaṃ phalatāmbūle samarpayāmi oṃ namaḥ | ityabhyarcya tataḥ śaṃkhaṃ pūjayedakṣatādibhiḥ ||77|| ghaṇṭāṃ ca pūjayed ramyāmakṣataiḥ kuṃkumādibhiḥ | pātraṃ ghaṭopari nyasyet tilayukśarkarānvitam ||78|| pītāmbaraṃ śubhaṃ cāpi haimaṃ rādhāyutaṃ harim | puruṣottamamāsasya daivataṃ taṃ prapūjayet ||79|| analottāraṇaṃ kṛtvā kurvīta prāṇadhāraṇām | spṛṣṭvā dvau tatkapālau tu dakṣiṇena kareṇa vai ||8 0 || datvā ca hṛdaye’ṅguṣṭhaṃ prāṇām̐statra sudhārayet | asyai prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhantu cāsyai prāṇāḥ kṣarantu ca ||8 1 || asyai devatvayuktāyai svāhā nārāyaṇāya vai | dhyāyed devaṃ tata āvāhayennāthaṃ hṛdi sthitam ||8 2|| āvāhayāmi rādhāśrīsahitaṃ puruṣottamam | āsanaṃ cārpayāmyasmai śrīkṛṣṇāya tu śārṅgiṇe ||8 3 || samarpayāmi salilaṃ pādaprakṣālanāya te | arghyaṃ phalānvitaṃ caivārpayāmi paramātmane ||84|| tīrthajalānyācamanaṃ te’rpayāmi rādhikāpate | payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ śarkarā cārpayāmi te ||85|| pañcasnānaṃ jalasnānaṃ tathā te kārayāmyaham | pītadhautraṃ cottarīyaṃ samarpayāmi keśava ||86|| kaustubhaṃ brahmasūtraṃ ca bhūṣāṃ dadāmi te prabho | sugandhatailasārādi candanaṃ cārpayāmi te ||87|| kuṃkumākṣatapuṣpāṇi cārpayāni gṛhāṇa vai | dhūpaṃ divyarasopetaṃ tvarpayāmi ca te prabho ||88 || dīpaṃ ghṛtojjvalaṃ tubhyaṃ cārpayāmi hare prabho | pāyasādyaṃ ca naivedyaṃ samarpayāmi keśava ||89|| ācamanaṃ jalapānaṃ phalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tathā | karodvartanakaṃ caiva samarpayāmi mādhava ||90 || suvarṇadakṣiṇāṃ hārākṣatān dadāmi keśava | nīrājayāmi deveśaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ karomi ca || 91 || puṣpāṃjaliṃ cārpayāmi namaskāraṃ karomi ca | nyūnaṃ te pūjane kiṃcit kṣamasva puruṣottama ||92|| homaṃ kuryādakhaṇḍaṃ ca ghṛtadīpaṃ samācaret | puruṣottamatuṣṭyarthe sarvārthaphalasiddhaye || 93 || iti nityaṃ pūjayettaṃ dadyāddānāni śaktitaḥ | bhojayed bhojyapātrāṇi vṛddhām̐śca pādayornamet ||94|| haviṣyabhojanaṃ kuryād vratī devaprasādakam | godhūmāḥ śālayo mudgā yavāstilāśca śarkarāḥ ||95|| kaṅgūkharjūranīvārā drākṣāḥ kandāśca karkaṭī | mūlaṃ śākāni patrāṇi khādyapuṣpāṇi mūlakam ||96|| kāndakāni kadalāni dadhiṃ dugdhaṃ tathārdrakam | śuṇṭhī cāmraphalaṃ takraṃ panasaṃ ca harītakīṃ ||97|| pippalījīrakaṃ cāmalakaṃ tintiḍikā tathā | kramukaṃ caikṣavaṃ sarvaṃ sāttvikaṃ vratibhojanam || 98 || rājasaṃ rājikārāddhaṃ tāmasaṃ cāmiṣādikam | vātulaṃ dvidalādyaṃ ca parānnādi vivarjayet ||99 || brahmacaryamadhaḥśayyāṃ patrāvalyāṃ ca bhojanam | ekabhuktaṃ ca kurvīta nindāmātraṃ vivarjayet || 100 || upoṣaṇena dugdhena dadhnā jalena sarpiṣā | patreṇāpi phalenāpi kartavyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 101 || vratabhaṃgo yathā na syāttathā kāryaṃ prabhojanam | tulasīdalalakṣeṇārcane puṇyamanantakam || 10 2| puruṣottamamāsasya vratyapi puruṣottamaḥ | caturbhujo bhavedeva vaikuṇṭhe vasati dhruvam || 103 || akhaṇḍadīpo dātavyo māse śrīpuruṣottame | saubhāgyanagare rājā citrabāhurabhūtpurā || 1 04|| tasya candrakalā bhāryā hyubhāvāstāṃ sudhārmikau | agastyaśca munistasya bhavanaṃ tvājagāma ha || 10 5|| pūjayitvā vinayena citrabāhuruvāca ha | adya me gṛhasāmrājyajanmādi saphalaṃ khalu || 106 || yastvaṃ samāgato me’dya gṛhe śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | tubhyaṃ sarvaṃ dadāmyadya vaiṣṇavāya mahātmane || 1 07|| merutulyaphalaṃ syācca manāgapyarpitaṃ tu te | viṣṇave viṣṇubhaktāyānarpito divaso’phalaḥ || 108 || vaiṣṇavā vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ sevanārhaṇāḥ | tasya dhanyāḥ prajāḥ sarvā yadgṛhe vaiṣṇavo janaḥ || 109 || vastavyaṃ vaiṣṇave deśe rājye vaiṣṇavabhūbhṛti | amaṃgalaṃ tathā kāṇaṃ bodhyaṃ rāṣṭramavaiṣṇavam || 110 || śrīkṛṣṇāśritabhaktasya rājño rājyaṃ vivardhate | mune lakṣmīrvipulaṃ me tathā rājyamakaṃṭakam || 111 || pativratā ca me patnī kena puṇyena me vada | śrutvāgastyaśca taṃ prāha camatkārapure purā || 11 2|| tvamabhūḥ śūdrajātīyo maṇigrīvo’tināstikaḥ | surā māṃsa vyavāyāti caurya durguṇavāridhiḥ || 11 3|| patibhaktā tviyaṃ bhāryā sadā sadbhāvanāvatī | rājñā vivāsitastvaṃ tu gato’raṇyaṃ priyāyutaḥ || 11 4|| mṛgayājīvanastvaṃ tu vane saṃdṛṣṭavān munim | tṛṣitaṃ ca mumūrṣum̐ ca hyugradevaṃ dvijaṃ tadā || 1 15|| utthāyottolya salilaṃ phalaṃ datvāpramodayat | muniḥ prāha susantuṣṭo maṇigrīva sukhī bhava |116 || jīvitaṃ dattavām̐stvaṃ me brūhi kiṃ te dadāmyaham | maṇigrīvastadā prāha dāridryaṃ naśyatānmama || 1 17|| atulā vaibhavāḥ santu pūrṇā me syurmanorathāḥ | itīcchāmi tadā prāha munistathā bhavantu te || 118 || āgāminyadhimāse vai pāvane puruṣottame | dīpo deyo mandire śrīpuruṣottamatuṣṭaye || 11 9|| na te tīvradāridryaṃ samūlaṃ nāśameṣyati | tilatailena vājyeneṅgudītailena vāpi ca || 120 || māsamekaṃ sadā snātvā devaṃ natvā pradīpakam | dehi tena mahārājyaṃ pṛthvyāṃ te vai bhaviṣyati || 121 || yajñādīni tu karmāṇi kṛcchracāndrāyaṇāni ca | vedapāṭho gayāśrāddhaṃ kurukṣetragrahāstathā || 1 22|| tīrthāni sarvadānāni dharmakāryāṇi yāni ca | puruṣottamadīpasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 123 || adhimāsavrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dīpaścāntaḥprakāśakaḥ | dhanadhānyapaśuputrapautradārāyaśaskaram || 1 24|| vandhyātvanāśakaṃ nāryā avaidhavyakaraṃ vratam | rājyadaṃ ceṣṭadaṃ bhartṛpradaṃ patnīpradaṃ vratam || 125 || vidyāsiddhikośamokṣapradaṃ dīpārpaṇavratam | iti pūrvaṃ tvayā datto dīpaṃ śrīharaye vane || 126 || tena puṇyena sadrājyaṃ lakṣmīṃ patnīṃ pativratām | prāptavānasi rājendra punaḥ kuryā labhiṣyasi || 1 27|| ityuktvāgastyaṛṣirāṭ prayāgaṃ saṃjagāma ha | rājñā tenāpi vidhinā prāpte śrīpuruṣottame || 128 || kṛtaṃ dīpapradānaṃ ca tato mokṣamavāpa saḥ | ityuktvārhaṇamādāya vālmīko nirjagāma ha || 1 29|| tato māse samāyāte śreṣṭhe śrīpuruṣottame | caturdaśyāṃ prage kṛṣṇadundubhirdṛḍhadhanvanā || 130 || śrutaḥ kurvantu cādyaiva vrataṃ dīpaṃ sajāgaram | svargaṃ mokṣaṃ prāpnuvantu tena puṇyena madvarāt || 131 || iti śrutvā dṛḍhadhanvā smṛtvā sarvaṃ vrataṃ tadā | sakuṭumbo nirāhāraścakre sadīpajāgaram || 132 || mahāntamutsavaṃ cakre dadau dānāni gobhuvām | rātrau samājagāmāyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 133 || sakuṭumbaṃ garuḍena brahmalokaṃ nināya tam | kimu kathyaṃ mahālakṣmi māhātmyamādhimāsikam || 1 34|| kartā dhartā samuddhartā yatra śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | poṣṭā tuṣṭaḥ pradātā ca bhoktā śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 1 35|| ya idaṃ śṛṇuyāllakṣmi paṭhedvā pāṭhayedapi | so’dhimāsaphalaṃ labdhvā brahmalokaṃ prayāti hi || 1 36|| sakāmaḥ svargamāsādya pārameṣṭhyapadaṃ tathā | maheśādipadaṃ prāpya brahmaloke mahīyate || 137 || yaistu saṃpūjito māsaḥ sarvaṃ tairabhipūjitam | sarvaṃ prāptaṃ bhavet tena prāptaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 138 || yena nīto’dhimāso’yaṃ vandhyastasya tu sampadaḥ | vandhyāḥ puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ sarve vandhyaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 139 || ye kecit sukhinaḥ santi suramānavadānavāḥ | puruṣottamamāsasya phalaṃ lakṣmi na cetarat || 140|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye dṛḍhadhanvāraṇye śukoktaślokaṃ śrutvā tadarthaṃ vālmīkaṃ pṛṣṭvā svīyaṃ prāgbhavīyaṃ sudevadvijatvaṃ putravattvaṃ ca putranidhane ca puruṣottamamāsakaraṇena putrajīvitatvaṃ sa tvayaṃ putraḥ śukaḥ ślokavaktā tvaṃ tvidānīṃ dṛḍhadhanvā jāta iti vṛttāntaṃ jñātavān puruṣottamamāsapūjāvidhiṃ ca jñātavān adhikamāse dīpadānena maṇigrīvaśūdrasya janmāntare citrabāhunṛpatitvaṃ rājyaprāptiścāgastyena kathitā tadapi jñātavān tataśca caturdaśīvrataṃ kṛtvā dṛḍhadhanvā sakuṭumbo mokṣamavāpetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.321 ||
<1.322> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmyadhimāsānte dine tvakṣaradhāmani | kṛtamudyāpanaṃ sarvaiḥ puruṣottamamandire || 1 || rādhākṛṣṇādayaḥ sarve golokasthāḥ samāyayuḥ | vāsudevādayo vyūhāḥ svaprajābhiḥ samāyayuḥ || 2 || mahāvaikuṇṭhalokasthā vayaṃ nārāyaṇādayaḥ | tvayā saha prajābhiśca gatā abhūma cākṣaram || 3 || avyākṛtāmṛtadhāmabhūmaśrīpuratatstriyaḥ | nyāyeśvarādayaḥ sarve mudā tatra yayustadā || 4 || mahāviṣṇuprabhṛtayo hiraṇyagarbhasṛṣṭayaḥ | pravairājāścāvaraṇā īśvarā jagmurakṣaram || 5 || viṣṇorjalāvaraṇordhvavaikuṇṭhasthā yayustathā | sadāśivasya dhāmasthā mahāmāyāprajā yayuḥ || 6 || evaṃ ta īśvarāścāvatārā gatvākṣaraṃ param | cakrurudyāpanaṃ tatra puruṣottamamāsikam || 7 || brahmaṇaḥ satyaloke carṣayo munijanāstathā | mātṛgaṇāḥ pitaraśca devā jagmuśca vaiṣṇavaḥ || 8 || udyāpanaprakartāro divyā yayurnarādayaḥ | tīrthāni devatāḥ sarvā devyo jagmurdiśastathā || 9 || tattvānyapi yayustatra saritaḥ sindhavastathā | parvatāśca tathākhātā dvīpāḥ khaṇḍā yayustathā || 1 0|| grahāstārāśca nakṣatramaṇḍala vṛkṣavallayaḥ | divyā vai bhaktavaryāstu daityā dānavarākṣasāḥ || 11 || oṣadhayastathā sarpā nāgāḥ patattrayo’malāḥ | jalavāsāḥ sthalavāsā vāyuvāsā yayustadā || 1 2|| pātālasthā vivarasthā divyādivyā yayustadā | vratinaḥ sahavāsāśca bhaktā udyāpanaṃkṛte || 13 || satye paitāmahe loke sannidhau yayurādarāt | puruṣottamamāsasyodyāpanārthaṃ yayuśca te || 14|| gandharvāḥ kinnarāḥ sūtādayaśca suramānavāḥ | bhaṭṭacāraṇabhṛtyāśca raudrā api ca śāṃkarāḥ || 15|| ete cānye vratapūrtiphalārthaṃ cotsave gatāḥ | śṛṇu lakṣmi tatra tatra yathāśakti yathādhanam || 16 || kṛtamudyāpanaṃ sarvaiḥ sarveṣṭasiddhidāyakam | bhuktimuktipradaṃ dravyadānapūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ tu taiḥ || 17|| śṛṇu taistu kṛtamudyāpanaṃ saṃśrāvayāmi te | puruṣottamamāsasya yaduktaṃ hariṇā svayam || 18 || pakṣadvaye caturdaśyāmamāyāṃ pūrṇimātithau | ekādaśyāṃ navamyāṃ vā vratāhe’ṣṭamikātithau || 1 9|| yatra tithau bhavedānukūlyaṃ tatrāpi vā tithau | udyāpanaṃ prakuryādvai vratasampūrtihetave || 2 0 || puruṣottamamāsasya dundubhiśca sthale sthale | uddhoṣayati gatvaiva kurvantūdyāpanaṃ śubham || 2 1|| puruṣottamamāsasya phalaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati | śrutvāpi ḍiṇḍamaṃ cānye cakrurudyāpanaṃ gṛhe || 22|| rātrau bhūśāyino bhūtvā brahmacaryaṃ prarakṣya ca | prātarutthāya te sarve cakrurdhyānaṃ harestataḥ || 23 || kṛtvā śaucādikāḥ sarvā daihikīrbāhyataḥ kriyāḥ | divyādivyaṃ yathāvarṣma kṛtvā snānādikaṃ tataḥ ||24|| japaṃ homaṃ tathā sandhyāṃ svādhyāyaṃ tarpaṇādikam | yathālokaṃ yathāvarṣma yathāyogyaṃ vidhāya te || 25 || nityāṃ pūjāṃ vṛddhapūjāṃ kṛtvā pūjyārhaṇādikam | ācamya ca bhuvaṃ kṛtvā saṃskṛtāṃ bahuvistarām || 26||| cakruśca maṇḍapaṃ tatra bahustaṃbhasamanvitam | ratnahīrakahārādyairāmrāśokāditoraṇaiḥ || 27|| kadalīstambhapatrādyaiḥ kalpavallyāstaroḥ phalaiḥ | kalaśaiḥ raṃgavallībhiścāmbaraiḥ kānakānvitaiḥ || 28 || bandhayitvā pradīpaiśca śobhayitvā sugandhibhiḥ | vāsayitvā ca tanmadhye pañcadhānyaiśca saptabhiḥ || 2 9|| dhānyairvā kārayitvaiva sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam | sapatnīkān viṣṇubhaktān nimantrya ca yathābalam || 30 || nyasuścaturaḥ kalaśām̐ścaturdikṣu ca maṇḍale | suvastraśrīphalapūgīnāgavallīdalānvitān ||3 1 || tatrākṣatān pūrayitvā śarkarādravyamiśritān | vāsudevaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ pradyumnaṃ cāniruddhakam ||3 2|| īśānataḥ kramānnyasya madhye ca kalaśe śubhe | saphale sāmbare pūgīsvarṇamudrākṣatānvite || 3 3|| pañcaratnayute svarṇe nyadhuḥ śrīpuruṣottamam | rādhālakṣmyādisahitaṃ sauvarṇe divyarūpiṇam || 34|| evaṃ tairvratibhiḥ sarvaiḥ sthāpanaṃ śrīhareḥ kṛtam | ācāryaśca gurustatra pūjanārthaṃ praveśitaḥ || 35|| dehaśuddhiḥ kāritā ca yajamānasya tena vai | tata āvāhito devaścāsanaṃ ca pradāpitaḥ || 36|| pādaprakṣālanārtha vai dattaṃ jalaṃ sutīrthajam | caturdikṣu kṛtā dīpāḥ sugandhastatra kāritaḥ ||37|| arghyaṃ phalādibhiryuktaṃ dampatyā ca samarpitam | ācamanīyasalilaṃ dattaṃ devāya tīrthajam || 38 || dadhi dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ śarkarā cāmṛtaṃ tathā | abhiṣeka jalasnānaṃ dattāni keśavāya vai || 3 9|| vastreṇa mārjito devau vastrābhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ | gandhasārottaratailasugandhādyaiḥ suvāsitaḥ ||40 || kuṃkumakajjalacūrṇacandanādyaiḥ suśobhitaḥ | maṇihīrakamauttikahāropavītabhūṣitaḥ ||4 1 || kirīṭakuṇḍalakaṭakormikāśṛṃkhalānvitaḥ | chatrayaṣṭinaktakacāmarapattrāṇarakṣitaḥ ||42|| paryaṃka genduka kaśipvā darśādi pradāpitaḥ | puṣpatulasīpadmādyaiḥ puṇḍraiścandraiḥ suśobhitaḥ ||43 || atha tanmaṇḍape tāmrapātre homaśca kāritaḥ | caturthyantairnāmamantraistilairghṛtena satphalaiḥ ||44|| aṣṭottaraśatavāraṃ tataśca tarpaṇaṃ kṛtam | devāśca pitaraśceti tṛpyantāṃ puruṣottamaḥ ||45|| atha nīrājito devo bahuvartyanalaistathā | namaskṛtaḥ stutaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtaśca vaiṣṇavaiḥ ||46|| daṇḍavatsatkṛtaścāpi dhyātaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | kṣamāpito hariḥ puṣpāṃjalirdattaśca śārṅgiṇe ||47|| atha saṃbhojito devo miṣṭānnaistarpito’mṛtaiḥ | arpitaśca jalairmiṣṭaphalaistāmbūlacarvitaḥ ||48 || sugandhairudvartitaśca karayoḥ puruṣottamaḥ | svāsthyairviśramito devaḥ pādayorabhivāhitaḥ ||49|| evaṃ sarvaiḥ pūjitaśca bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ | āvirbhūto’dṛśyatāgre phalantvanantakaṃ dadau ||5 0 || athācāryāya saṃdattā dakṣiṇā hemarūpyakā | dhenudānaṃ kṛtaṃ cāpi svarṇaśṛṃgārabhūṣitam ||5 1 || ghṛtavastratilapātraṃ dattaṃ viprāya tatra ca | pratimā ca pradattā saṃhitāśāstraṃ samarpitam ||52 || kāṃsyāni saṃpuṭātmāni triṃśaddattāni vai tadā | tadā triṃśattriṃśadapūpaiśca madhye sampūritāni vai ||53 || etadbrahmāṇḍadānaṃ vai kalpitaṃ puruṣottame | pratyaṅgaṃ tu yāvanti chidrāṇi santi padmaje ||54|| tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi vaikuṇṭhe vasatirbhavet | tato vasatirgoloke tato dhāmnyakṣare pare ||55 || athavāpūpasāmagryapakvā deyā dvijanmane | atha saṃbhojitā viprāḥ santaḥ sādhyaśca bālakāḥ ||56|| pāyasānnaiśca miṣṭānnairvyañjanaiścāmṛtādibhiḥ | caturdhā bhojanairbhakṣyabhojyalehyasucoṣyakaiḥ ||57|| rasairdugdhādibhirvārbhiḥ śarkarailādimiśritaiḥ | tato jalaṃ mukhaśuddhistāmbūlakaṃ ca dakṣiṇā ||58|| vastrāṇyābharaṇānyuttamottamānyarpitāni vai | devībhyo devatābhyaśca gurubhyo’pyarpitāni ca ||59 || tattallokaja tattvāni dānayogyāni yāni vai | bhūtebhya āśritebhyaścātithibhyo’nnaṃ samarpitam || 60 || tato bhuktaṃ svajanaiśca saha vratibhirādarāt | phalāhārādikaṃ yogyaṃ vratabhaṃgākaraṃ hi yat ||6 1 || madhyāhne’pi kṛtaṃ tadvanniśi rātrau ca vai tathā | pūjito bhojito devo jāgareṇa yutairjanaiḥ ||62 || gītaṃ ca nartanaṃ puṇyaṃ bhajanaṃ ca kṛtaṃ janaiḥ | prātaḥ snātvā pūjitaśca kṣamāpyātha visarjitaḥ ||6 3 || ācāryāya pradattaḥ sa mūrtirūpaḥ pareśvaraḥ | evamudyāpanaṃ kṛtvā yayuḥ sarve nijālayam ||64|| phalaṃ cānantakaṃ prāptaṃ puruṣottamasevanāt | tato lakṣmi yathāśakti vratametatsamācaret || 65|| duḥkhadāridryadaurbhāgyanāśaḥ syādiṣṭamāpnuyāt | niyamānāṃ parityāgastataḥ kuryād vratī janaḥ ||66|| madhyabhojī naktabhojī brāhmaṇān bhojayed vratī | ayācite vrate labdhe svarṇadānaṃ samācaret ||67|| māsopavāsinā deyā dogdhrī gaurdakṣiṇāyutā | dhātrīvratī pradadyācca dadhiṃ kṣīraṃ ca śarkarām ||68 || phalānāṃ niyame lakṣmi phaladānaṃ samācaret | tailarodhe ghṛtaṃ deyaṃ ghṛtarodhe payo’rpaṇam ||69|| dhānyānāṃ niyame dadyād dhānyāni tāni tāni ca | bhūśāyitve tu paryaṃkagendukakaśipucchadān ||70|| phalapatrādiniyame tāni dadyād dvijanmane | maune ghaṇṭāśaṃkhavādyān dadyād devāya padmaje ||7 1|| nakhakeśadharo dadyādādarśaṃ keśakarcikām | upānahau pradadyācca hyupānadādivarjane ||72|| kṣāratyāge rasān dadyād dīpadāne tu dīpakān | ekāntaropavāsī ca kuṃbhānaṣṭau pradāpayet ||73 || rājñāṃ yāvatya iṣṭāśca smṛddhayo’tra bhavanti vai | deyā dāne ca tāḥ sarvā yathāśakti yathādhanam || 74|| ekānnena vratī yāyāccaturbāhuḥ parāṃ gatim | ekabhojyupavāsyeva sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ||75|| pūrvāhṇe bhuṃjate devā madhyāhne munayastathā | aparāhṇe pitṛgaṇā naktabhojī naro bhavet ||76|| dine dine’śvamedhasya phalaṃ naktādano labhet | dvādaśīvratakṛd yāti garuḍena hareḥ padam ||77|| yasya yasya niyamaḥ syāttattaddāne niyojayet | tena pūrṇaṃ vrataṃ syācca brahmalokapradaṃ bhavet ||78|| anityena śarīreṇa sādhyaṃ mokṣapadaṃ sadā | puruṣottamatulyaṃ tu nāsti lakṣmi trilokake ||79|| sahasrajanmataptena tapasāpi na gamyate | yatphalaṃ gamyate loke puruṣottamasevayā ||8 0|| trirātrasnānataścātra śākhāmṛgo’kṣaraṃ yayau | āsīdvai kerale deśe dvijo dhanātilolupaḥ ||8 1 || tena kadaryanāmnā saḥ khyātiṃ jagāma dehiṣu | sadannavastraṃ bhuktaṃ na svāhā svadhā kṛtā na vā ||82|| dhanaṃ pṛthvyāṃ rakṣitaṃ ca dharmakāryaṃ kṛta na ca | na vrataṃ notsavaścāpi na grahaṇaṃ na kuṃbhanam ||83|| kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ bhikṣaṇaṃ tu dhanasyāṭan vidīnavat | so’gānmālākāravāṭikāyāṃ duḥkhaṃ rudanmuhuḥ ||84|| mālākāro dayāṃ kṛtvā rarakṣa svāntike hi tam | vāṭikārakṣakaṃ kṛtvā mālī grāme gato bhavet ||85|| paścājjaghāsa pakvāni cākrīṇata phalāni saḥ | evaṃ stenakriyākarturjagmurayutavatsarāḥ ||86|| mamāra ca vane tatra nāvāpa vahnidāruṇī | yamadūtairnīyamānastāḍyamāno yamālayam ||87|| gacchannuvāca duṣkarmaphalaṃ prāptaṃ mayādya vai | mānuṣaṃ janma saṃprāpya na kiñcit sukṛtaṃ kṛtam ||88 || cauryādisañcitaṃ dravyaṃ sthitaṃ bhūmau nirarthakam | na dhṛtaṃ nāttameveti puṇyaṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ nahi ||8 9 || na kuṭumbaṃ poṣitaṃ ca bhāryā kaṣṭena yojitā | kadaryo vilapannevaṃ gato yamapuraṃ tataḥ || 90 || citragupto’vadaddharmaṃ pāpadvayaṃ bahūgrakam | phalacauryaṃ tathā viśvāsaghātitvaṃ paraṃ bahu ||9 1 || śrutvā prāha yamo dūtān pretamenaṃ vidhattha vai | tato’stu vānaro’yaṃ tu muhurnarakayātanaḥ || 92|| iti dūtaiḥ prāpitaḥ saḥ pretatāṃ nirjale vane | tataḥ kapirabhūt kālaṃjare śaile bhayaṃkare || 93 || tatrendreṇa kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ kuṇḍo mṛgasutīrthakaḥ | tatraiva vānaro jātaḥ pūrvapuṇyāt tadalpakāt ||94|| śṛṇu pūrvakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ puruṣottamaśaṃsanam | citrakuṇḍalavaiśyo’bhūt puruṣottamasadvratī || 95|| dānakṛt taṃ ca bhikṣārthaṃ kadaryo gatavān purā | praśaśaṃsa ca taṃ vaiśyaṃ dhanalobhena bhikṣukaḥ || 96 || puruṣottamamāsasya vrataṃ yad vidhinā tvayā | kṛtaṃ tādṛk kṛtaṃ naiva kenāpi tvatra bhūtale || 97|| kṛtārtho’si tvayā yatsevitaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | dhanyado mokṣadaścāyaṃ māsaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||98 || dehi mahyaṃ dhanaṃ kiñciditi māsaṃ śaśaṃsa saḥ | tena puṇyena tīrthe’tra vānaratvamupāgamat || 99|| janmatastasya vaktre’bhūtpīḍāsṛgavraṇasaṃbhavā | dantāḥ petuḥ kṣudhā vyāpto jvarātipīḍito’bhavat || 100 || patitaḥ kuṇḍanikaṭe āyānmāḥ puruṣottamaḥ | daśamīdinataḥ pañcāhāni kuṇḍajale yayuḥ || 101 || vyasustīrthajale jātastena divyavapurdharaḥ | caturbhujo’bhavad divyadevīpārṣasevitaḥ || 10 2|| tīrthamṛtestathā jātaḥ snānāt pañcāhasatkṛtān | ajñānācca tathā jātaṃ kiṃ punarvidhinā kṛtāt || 103 || te sadā subhagāḥ puṇyāsteṣāṃ ca saphalo bhavaḥ | yeṣāṃ pumuttamo māsaḥ snānadānajapairgataḥ || 104 || tāni koṭiguṇānyeva kṛtāni puruṣottame | kapirjagāma golokaṃ vimānavaramāsthitaḥ || 105 || evaṃ kadaryaścauro’pi vānaratvaṃ gato’pi ca | puruṣottamayogena prāpto gaulokameva saḥ || 106 || puruṣottamamāsasya kathāyāḥ śravaṇādapi | māsopoṣaṇapūjādiphalaṃ pūrṇamavāpyate || 1 07|| śrutvā dharmaṃ vijānāti śrutvā pāpaṃ ca naśyati | śrutvā nivartate mohaḥ śrutvā jñānāmṛtaṃ milet || 108 || lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākhyaṃ vedaṃ paṭhed vratī | śṛṇuyācchrīpuruṣottamamāse mokṣadā hi sā || 109 || yayā nāryā kṛto naiva māsaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | tatpatinādṛtaścet sā labhet tatphalaṃ varam || 110 || satī nārī sadā pātivratyadharmaparā yadi | patirūpo bhavatyasyā māsaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 111 || kurūpo vā kuvṛtto vā duḥsvabhāvo’pi madyapaḥ | rogī krodhī sthavīro vā mūko’ndho badhiro’pi vā || 11 2 || raudro dīnaḥ kadaryo vā daridraḥ kutsito’pi vā | kātaraḥ kitavo vāpi viṣayī lampaṭo’pi vā || 113 || satataṃ devavatpūjyaḥ satyā sādhvyā patirhariḥ | vidhavayā kanyayā ca patireva hariḥ sadā || 1 14|| sevanīyaḥ pūjanīyo dhyātavyo’dhyāsitavya ut | vācā ca karmaṇā dehenāpi bhāvanayā tathā || 11 5|| na patyurviṣamaṃ kāryaṃ nodvejanīya īśvaraḥ | bālā yuvatī jaraṭhā patyadhīnā priyā bhavet || 116 || kāmena lobhena balena vāpi dainyena bhāvena samāśrayeṇa | rūpeṇa vāsena dhanādinā vā satṛṣṇayā vendriyadhātupuṣṭyā || 1 17|| sadambarairyānavaraiśca vāhanairābhūṣaṇairhīrakaratnakoṭibhiḥ | sunṛtyagītairbahulāsanairapi nānyaṃ bhajet sā khalu sādhulakṣaṇā || 118 || anyasmai darśanārthaṃ śṛṃgāraṃ kurute na vai | svānurūpaṃ naraṃ yā na cintayati priyā satī || 119 || surūpaṃ taruṇaṃ ramyaṃ kāminīnāṃ ca vallabham | dṛṣṭvā na vikṛtiṃ yāti sā vai bodhyā mahāsatī || 120 || bhuṃkte bhukte yathā patyau duḥkhite duḥkhinā ca yā | mudite muditā supte suptā jāgarti jāgrati || 121 || vṛddhabhaktā patikārye’nukūlā nādhikavyayā | gṛhāgataṃ patiṃ pratyuttiṣṭhatyāsanavāribhiḥ || 122 || prasannavadanā kāle bhojanādipradāyinī | bhuktavantaṃ śrāvayennāpriyaṃ śāntiṃ dadettathā || 123 || sevārthaṃ sarvadā bhāvyaṃ prītyarthaṃ priyayā sadā | vastuvyayaṃ na cātyarthaṃ kurvīta gṛharakṣikā || 124|| śṛṃgāraścātibhūṣādi dhārayet patituṣṭaye | tretādau pramadānāṃ syādārtavāśocameva ha || 1 25|| tatra caturahānyeva gṛhakāryaṃ na saṃspṛśet | snātvā sūryaṃ patiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā paścāt kriyāparā || 1 26|| bhavet bhavetputrakāmā yugmarātriratipriyā | putrīkāmā tvayugmāsu rātriṣu svāmisevikā || 1 27|| āṣoḍaśarātrikaṃ vai garbhādhānabalaṃ bhavet | taduttaraṃ kamalasya dvāraṃ baddhaṃ prajāyate || 128 || na bibhatsā bhavet kvāpi rūkṣavāṇī bhavenna ca | śūrpavātaṃ nādadīta nopāviśettathāṃgane || 1 29||| dvāradārau cullikāyāṃ peṣaṇyāṃ niṣadīta na | guruṃ vātyuṣṇamāhāramajīrṇaṃ na samācaret || 130 || tenāpatyavatī syādanyathā garbhakṣaro bhavet| sapatnī sthānamirṣyāyāḥ sādhvīrṣyā parivarjayet || 131 || gṛhakleśaṃ na janayed rakṣayet sarvathā gṛham | nākrośet patimālakṣya bhartsayenna vimānayet || 13 2|| ratyā dadyātsukhaṃ tasmai svāmine rakṣiṇe sadā | patyājñayā bahirgacched devadarśanahetave || 13 3|| patyau deśāntaraṃ prāpte sādhvī varteta sarvathā | raṃgarāgavihīnā vai śvaśrvādyājñākarī sadā || 1 34|| vastrairaṃgaiśca malinā na bhavecchuddhimācaret | svāmiśiṣṭaṃ prasādānnajalaṃ bhuñjīta bhāvataḥ || 1 35|| snāyānna vastraśūnyā vai na nagnā syāt kadācana | nolūkhale na musale na ghaṭādau na cāśmani || 1 36|| na yantre na ca rathyāyāṃ satī tūpāviśet kvacit | patipādodakaṃ tīrthaṃ pibet tīrthaphalapradam || 1 37|| vratopavāsaniyamān patimullaṃghya nācaret | bhartuścaraṇāvabhyarcya bhoktavyaṃ priyayā sadā || 138 || patyākṣeptrī saramā syādulūkī svodaraṃbharā | sūkarī cānyapārśvasthā vāgurī guptabhakṣikā || 13 9|| avamānakarī mūkā sāpatnerṣyā tu durbhagā | patyuḥ kaṣṭapradā nārī kurūpā rogiṇī bhavet || 14 0|| bhartā brahmā haro viṣṇurgurustīrthaṃ vrataṃ japaḥ | śuddhiḥ svargaṃ śubhaṃ dānaṃ tasmātpatiṃ susevayet || 141 || jīvahīno’śucirdehā bhartṛhīnāśuciḥ satī | pativratā priyā svasyāḥ patiṃ svargaṃ nayet satī || 142||| yamadūtāḥ palāyante satīṃ dṛṣṭvā tu dūrataḥ | yāvatsvalomasaṃkhyāsti tāvatkoṭyayutāni vai || 143 || bhartrā svargasukhaṃ bhuṃkte ramamāṇā pativratā | vidhavayā patiṃ smṛtvā tarpaṇaṃ kāryamanvaham || 144|| darbhatilodakaiḥ piṣṭaphalairgogrāsakaistathā | anyaiśca dānakāryaiśca puṇyaṃ samarjayettu sā || 145 | brahmāṇḍaṃ saṃpuṭākāraṃ kāṃsyapātrakṛtaṃ dadet | madhyatriṃśadapūpapūritaṃ tantusuveṣṭitam || 146 || pūjitaṃ cākṣatapuṣpakuṃkumairarpayet satī | patnīvrato bhavet tadvanpumān patnīparāyaṇaḥ || 147|| svasya prāṇaṃ tathā dehaṃ kṣetraṃ śāntisthalīṃ śubhām | patnīṃ sammānayennityaṃ mādhuryeṇa vilokayet || 148 || miṣṭaṃ dadyācca bhāṣetākārayetpremabhāvataḥ | tiraskurvīta no patnīṃ tāḍayennākṣipenna ca || 149 || vastrabhūṣādyalaṃkārairdravacandanapuṣpakaiḥ | tailatantukajjalādyaistoṣayet svapriyāṃ sadā || 150 || nodvejayenna prasahya bhuñjīta na ca rodhayet | kṣudhayā tṛṣayā patnīṃ karmaṇā duḥkhayenna ca || 151 || na cāvigaṇayenmānahīnāṃ dāsīṃ priyāṃ patiḥ | vaṃśadāṃ ratidāṃ vallīvadāśritāṃ prapoṣayet || 152 || athecchukīṃ na pravadennetyapi noccaretpatiḥ | omityuccārya saṃdadyādapekṣitadhanādikam || 153 || bhojyakāryaṃ gṛhakāryaṃ ratikāryaṃ tanukriyām | patikāryaṃ tathānyacca kurvāṇāṃ supramodayet || 1 54|| nānyāṃ nārīṃ samīkṣeta nānyāṃ vyavāyakṛtadbhavet | nānyāṃ priyo bhavet kvāpi patnīṃ lakṣmīṃ vihāya vai || 155 || nānyāṃ puṣṭipradaḥ syācca nānyayā ca rameta vai | yānavāhanadeśādyutsavasāmājakeṣu ca || 156|| nānyāparo bhavet kvāpi yadi svargaṃ hi vāñchati | evaṃ dharmaparau tvatra dampatī mokṣabhāginau || 157|| indradyumnaḥ śatadyumno yauvanāśvo bhagīrathaḥ | kalpakalpāntare cānye vaiṣṇavā rājabhūsurāḥ || 158 || puruṣottamamārādhya yayurbhagavadantikam | puruṣottamamāsasya dundubhiryena saṃśrutaḥ || 159|| tena tena ca sarvatrotsavo’nuṣṭhita eva ha | dundubhestu prapūjā ca kṛtā nārāyaṇena ca || 160 || yadā yadādhimāso’pi samāgacchet tadā tadā | dundubhinā paṭahena kartavyājñāpraghoṣaṇā || 161 || dhāmnyakṣare rakṣitaḥ śrīpumuttamena sarvadā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena śrīpuruṣottamaśārṅgiṇā || 162 || rādhayā ca śriyā lakṣmyā pārvatyā prabhayā tathā | māṇikyayā jayayā ca ramayā sahitaḥ prabhuḥ || 163 pratyahaṃ tvadhimāse’yaṃ pūjanīyaḥ pareśvaraḥ | bhojanāya sevanīyo dhyātavyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 164|| śrotavyaṃ māsamāhātmyaṃ śloko’dhyāyaḥ prapūrṇakaḥ| gaṃgādisarvatīrthānāṃ phalaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 165 pṛthvīpradakṣiṇāpuṇyaṃ brahmāṇḍoddhārapuṇyakam | śravaṇena bhavedasya māsā muktistathā bhavet || 166|| varṇāstathāśramavantaḥ śreṣṭhatāṃ sarvathā gatāḥ | śrutvā muktiṃ samāyānti paśucaryā janā api || 167 || puruṣottamamāhātmyaṃ lekhayitvā sabandhanam | dadyādasya phalaṃ vaṃśatrayaṃ golokago bhavet || 168 || māhātmyapustakādhāre gṛhe tīrthāni sarvaśaḥ | vasanti devatāścāpi vartate puruṣottamaḥ || 169|| śrotā vaktā śrāvayitā varṇayitā praśaṃsakaḥ | rakṣako vratakṛd dātā sarve te puruṣottamāḥ || 170 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’nādiśrīhariḥ puruṣottamaḥ | saṃhitopasamādeṣṭā pūjanīyo viśeṣataḥ || 171 || lakṣmīḥ śrutvā cātitṛptā pupūja puruṣottamam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ pupūja svapatiṃ harim || 172 || tvanmukhāmṛtapānena kṛtārthāsmītyuvāca sā | vyāsaṃ patisvarūpaṃ saṃpupūja ca nanāma ca || 173 || ahaṃ nārāyaṇo vaktā lakṣmīstvaṃ ca narāyaṇī | gṛhṇāmi tvatkṛtāṃ pūjāṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi || 174|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye’kṣaradhāmni sarvasṛṣṭīśvaraiḥ kṛtaḥ puruṣottamamāsavratodyāpanāvidhiḥ niyamapūrtyarthaṃ dānāni dīpadānaphalaṃ kadaryamuktiḥ vānaramokṣaṇam pativratādharmāḥ patnīvratadharmāḥ kāṃsyasaṃpuṭātmaka brahmāṇḍadānaṃ dundubhipūjanaṃ śravaṇādiphalaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.322 ||
<1.323> śrīlakṣmīruvāca nārāyaṇa hare svāmin paramātman parātpara | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo’ntaryāmin parameśvara || 1 || puruṣottama cātmeśa prāṇeśa priya mānada | yaduktā bhavatā dharmapatnyaḥ santi trayodaśa || 2 || kāstāḥ kasmāt kadā kutra samutpannāśca hetunā | kena kāryaṃ ca kiṃ tāsāṃ vada vaktavyameva cet || 3 || tāritā pāvitā kīrtiṃ gamitāhaṃ kṛpālunā | śrāvayitvā kathāṃ devyāṃ puruṣottamayoginīm || 4 || dharmapatnīsmaraṇārthaṃ vistarād vada nātha me | svargamokṣapradā divyāṃ kathāṃ vai dharmayoṣitām || 5 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi dharmapatnīnāṃ kathāṃ mokṣadāṃ śubhām | sṛṣṭyādau khalu saṃjātāṃ kathayāmi nibodha me || 6 || akṣare tu pare dhāmni vartate puruṣottamaḥ | tasmin divyā śaktayaśca santi śatasahasraśaḥ || 7 || tadaiko’haṃ bahu prajāyeyeti kalpanā vyadhāt | nityo divyaguṇāḥ śaktyātmakā mūrtāstadābhavan || 8 || śraddhā maitrī dayā śāntistuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ samunnatiḥ | kriyā buddhiśca medhā ca titikṣā hrīśca dvādaśa || 9 || mūrtiścetyadhikā bhaktināmnā tatra sadocyate | etā hareḥ svarūpādvai jajñire śaktayaḥ striyaḥ || 10 || nityā harāvapi chāyā bhavanti lokamuktaye | dvitīyarūpamādhāya vasanti jīvajātiṣu || 11 || yadā tā rūpayuktāśca saṃbhūtā brahmarūpataḥ | tadā tāḥ prārthayat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam || 1 2 || vayaṃ bhavataḥ saṃkalpād yato hutāḥ sma keśava | samūrtāśca bhavanmūrtimayya smo nānyagā yataḥ || 13 || ājñāpaya yathāyogyaṃ kāryamasmādṛśa prabho | iti cābhyarthitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ || 14|| vicārya prāha tāḥ sarvāḥ chāyārūpā bhavantu vai | chāyātmakāni yānyatra rūpāṇi vo bhavanti vai || 15 || tāni sarvāṇi sṛṣṭau tu dehiṣu vicarantviti | ityāśāṃ śrīhareḥ prāpya sṛṣṭau jātā guṇātmikā || 16 || vyāpikāḥ śaktayastāstu śroharericchayābhavan | kintvasureṣu daityeṣu dānaveṣu ca sarvathā || 17|| sukhaṃ tāsāmabhavanna tāmasānāṃ gṛheṣu ca | tataḥ sarvā militvaiva yayuḥ śrībadarīvanam || 18 || tapastepuratiraudraṃ parameśvaravāñcchayā | gaṃgātīraṃ samāsādya nirjalāhārataḥ sthitāḥ || 19 || sahasravarṣaparyantaṃ puruṣottamamānasāḥ | āvirāsīttadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svaḥ prabhuḥ || 20 || prāha tāḥ kiṃ kathaṃ cedṛk tapyate dāruṇaṃ tapaḥ | bhavatīnāṃ tapaścaryāprabhāveṇāsmi vardhitaḥ || 21 || madguṇāḥ śaktayo me ca mama vṛddhiparāyaṇāḥ | matpuṣṭidāḥ sukhadāśca bhavatyaḥ santi sarvathā || 22|| sāhāyyārthaṃ bhavatīnāṃ samāyāto’smi vai yataḥ | nivedayantvabhimataṃ tapobhiśca kimiṣyate ||2 3 || ityāvedya haristatra kṣaṇaṃ maunaṃ sthitastataḥ | ūcustāḥ śaktayaḥ sarvāḥ prabho dānavadaityake ||24|| āsureṣu sukhaṃ naiva bhavatyasmākamīśvara | adharmasya nivāsena vayaṃ tatra hi duḥkhitāḥ || 25|| tata ākṛṣya bhagavan kuru naḥ sukhitā sadā | hariḥ prāha tadā tāstu vicintya kṣaṇamātrataḥ || 2 6 || puruṣottamamāsāntadivasasya vrataṃ mahat | kurutātra devanadītīre sveṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati || 27|| ityuktvāntarhito devaḥ tāpasyaśca yadā punaḥ | samayo’dhikamāsasya hyāyātastāstadantime || 28 || divase pūjanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vastubhiḥ | bhāvaiśca vividhaiḥ sarvāścakruḥ puṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || 29 || sāyaṃ prāvirbabhūvātra bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ | varaṃ vṛṇuta vo devyo yatheṣṭaṃ dātumāgataḥ || 30 || cakitāśca tadā tāśca vavrire dharmarakṣaṇam | dharmāśritā vayaṃ kṛṣṇa rakṣitāḥ syāma sarvathā || 31 || tvayā rakṣā prakartavyā sadā śrīpuruṣottama | iti śrutvā hariḥ prāha tathāstviti punastataḥ || 3 2|| prāha tāḥ śaktayaḥ sarvā yāntu dakṣagṛhaṃ śubhāḥ | asiknī putrikāḥ santu bhavatīnāṃ tataḥ pitā || 33 || dakṣo dāsyati dharmāya patnyarthaṃ vai trayodaśa | taireva nāmabhiḥ khyātā bhaviṣyatha yathāyatham || 34|| tato’haṃ mūrtito brahmacaryadharmo hariḥ svayam | nārāyaṇo narasakhā cotpatsye badarīvane || 35 || bhavatīnāṃ adharmāṇāṃ kariṣye rakṣaṇaṃ sadā | ityuktvā prayayau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vilīnatām || 36 || tāśca tapaḥ parityajyāsiknyāṃ praviviśustadā | dakṣasaṃkalpamātrāt tāḥ kanyakā abhavam̐stadā || 37|| jātamātrā yuvatyaśca sundaryo varaṇārhaṇāḥ | jātismarāḥ surūpāśca dharmārthaṃ kṛtavigrahāḥ || 38 || dharmakāṃkṣāvatīrdṛṣṭvā dharmārthaṃ kṛtaniścayaḥ | dakṣaḥ pratīkṣate dharmayogasya samayaṃ śubham ||39 || tāvat tīrthanimittena badaryāśramamārgagam | dakṣagṛhaṃ samālokya dharmo viśrāntaye kṣaṇam ||40 || yayau dakṣagṛhaṃ jñātvātithisatkāraśobhitam | brahmaputraṃ bhrātaraṃ ca jñātvā smṛtvā viśeṣataḥ ||4 1 || dakṣo dṛṣṭvātisantuṣṭaścātithyaṃ vidadhe bahu | dadau sampūjya tāḥ sarvā dharmāya tu trayodaśa |||42 || putryo vivāhavidhinā kṛtakṛtyo’bhavattadā | dharmo’pi tāḥ samādāya yayau badarikāśramam ||43 || gaṃgā pītvā jale snātvā dharmāraṇyaṃ jagāma ha | nārāyaṇo narasakhā dharme saṃpraviveśa ha ||44|| patnībhiḥ sahito dharmo jagāma vatsarāntare | tīrthāni saṃvidhāyaiva sarvāṇi badarīvanam ||45|| tatra kṛṣṇecchayā sākṣāt naranārāyaṇāvubhau | mūrtestu tapasā jātau puruṣottamasadvratāt ||46 || dharmaputrau mūrtiputrau jātamātrau mahattamau | yuvānau bhagavantau tau brahmacaryaparau sadā ||47|| tāpasau lokakalyāṇakarau prāvirbabhūvatuḥ | śraddhāyāmatha dharmasya kāmaḥ putro babhūva ha ||48 || kāmaḥ saṃkalpa ityukto dharmapuṇyaprabhāvavān | saṃkalpasya suto jāto vyavasāyābhidhānakaḥ ||49 || maitrī snehaṃ vijajñe copakāraṃ suṣuve dayā | śāntiḥ kṣemaṃ sutaṃ jajñe santoṣastuṣṭijaḥ sutaḥ ||50 || puṣṭyā lābhaḥ suto hyunnatestu cābhyudayaḥ sutaḥ | kriyāyāṃ tu nayaḥ putro daṇḍaḥ samaya ityapi ||5 1 || buddherbodhaḥ sutaścāpi hyapramādaśca tāvubhau | medhāputrau śubhaśrutau titikṣāyā virāmakaḥ ||52|| hriyāḥ putro niyamaśca mūrternaranarāyaṇau | kṛṣṇaharīti catvāro dharmavaṃśo hi badrike ||53 || vartate sma sukhaṃ lakṣmi sevānusevane ratam | atha vai vedhaso loke satye brahmasabhāsthale ||54|| puruṣottamamāsānte puruṣottamapūjanam | utsavena ca mahatā saṃbhārairbahukoṭibhiḥ ||55 || kṛtaṃ devarṣimunibhirmānavaiścānyajātibhiḥ | bahubhaktyāti bhāvaiśca sarvasvārpaṇapūrvakam ||56|| tena dharmaśca tatpatnyaḥ putrāśca puruṣottamaḥ | prasannāḥ saṃbabhūvuścāsīma toṣamupāgatāḥ ||57|| niśīthe’mādivasānte pūjā nīrojanottaram | tadbhaktebhyo vratibhyaśca darśanaṃ dātumicchavaḥ ||58|| samājagmuradṛśyāste vyomni gītyupalakṣitāḥ | puruṣottamabhaktānāṃ madhye tvāvirbabhūva ha ||59|| sahasā tejasāṃ puṃjaḥ sa ca drāgvyāpa cāmbare | koṭikoṭīndusadṛśaṃ ghanībhūtaṃ ca tanmahaḥ ||60|| prādurbhūtamatha sthairyaṃ prāpa vidyotayad diśaḥ | svarā grāmā mūrchanāśca nādāścāsanmanoharāḥ ||61|| tadā tatra ca paśyatsu surādyeṣu manoharā | yuvatyadṛśyataikā strī divyarūpā manaḥpriyā ||62||| divyakausuṃbhavasanā divyālaṃkāraśobhitā | rūpānurūpasaundaryā prasannā svarṇasūjjvalā ||63|| sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā | keśabhāradhṛtapuṣpā susmitabhrūvilāsinī ||64|| nirmalāmbarasaṃvītā kāñcīnūpurabhūṣitā | manāṃsi mohayamānā lāvaṇyenāpi yoṣitām ||65|| vipañcīṃ vādayamānā sakhyānupūritasvarā | gītyaiva mānahantrī ca gandharvāpsarasāmapi ||66|| anyāśca dvādaśa nāryo gānaṃ nārāyaṇasya ha | cakruḥ satālamānaṃ vai harantyo mānasānyapi ||67|| tāsāṃ putrāśca sudivyāḥ prasannāḥ kṛtagāyanāḥ | savāditrāśca tanmadhye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||68|| adhimāsastathā rādhālakṣmyādyā divyayoṣitaḥ | sarve’dṛśyanta tatraiva sabhāyāṃ vedhaso gṛhe ||69|| akṣarādhipatiḥ kṛṣṇo’nādiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | āśīrvādān vadan devo’dṛśyata padmalocanaḥ ||70|| caturhasto dharmadevo’dṛśyata śvetabhāsvaraḥ | vedavākyairvadan bhaktān darśayam̐śca prasannatām ||71|| brahmādayaśca tān dṛṣṭvā cātyadbhutaṃ tadā viduḥ | mugdhāstu kṣaṇamātraṃ te hṛṣṭāścātimudā ca tān ||72|| nemuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ viditvaiva tathā śrīpuruṣottamam | rādhālakṣmyādikāścāpi dharmaṃ mūrtiṃ sutām̐stathā ||73|| śraddhādikāstathā natvā tuṣṭuvuḥ paramādarāt | nārāyaṇa namastubhyaṃ nārāyaṇyai namonamaḥ ||74|| dharmadeva namastubhyaṃ dhārmikebhyo namonamaḥ | śraddhādibhyo namaścāstu namo’stu bhaktimūrtaye ||75|| rādhāramādiśaktibhyo namaḥ pumuttamāya ca | uddharaṇāya lokānāmasmākaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ||76|| darśanaṃ dattavantaḥ stha yūyaṃ vai parameśvarāḥ | kṛtārthāḥ sma kṛtā devā atha yuṣmābhiratra vai ||77|| kṛpāṃ kṛtvā nideśaścejjñātavyaścopadiśyatām | śrutvovāca tadā devān brahmādīn puruṣottamaḥ ||78|| puruṣottamamāse’tra bhavadbhirlokanāyakaiḥ | prajābhiśca mama bhaktiḥ kṛtāsminpuruṣottame ||79|| dharmaḥ kṛtastathātyarthe śraddhādyāḥ poṣitāstathā | sakuṭumbaḥ poṣito’haṃ bhūtvā dātuṃ svadarśanam ||80 || samāgato’smi kṛpayā bhadraṃ vo’stu mahattamam | nānyathā darśanaṃ me syātpratyakṣaṃ yogināmapi ||8 1 || varaṃ vṛṇuta tuṣṭo’smi yūyaṃ matsvābhivāñcchitam | iti kṛpāvacaḥ śrutvā praṇemuścakrurarcanam |||82|| vavruścāsmaddhṛdayeṣu vasantu sarvadā tathā | rakṣantvasmān nideśasthān pāhi kārye guro sadā ||83 || bhaktān svadhāmaṃ divyaṃ tvaṃ niṣkāmānnaya mādhava | sakāmān pūraya sveṣṭaṃ kṛpāṃ varṣaya varṣaya ||84|| iti stutvā viremuste tathāstvityāha keśavaḥ | sakuṭumbo varaṃ datvā brahmādibhyaḥ pumuttamaḥ ||85|| tirobabhūva sahasā tvāścaryaṃ janayaddhariḥ | evaṃ bhagavatā tena svabhaktānāṃ manorathāḥ ||86|| pūryante sakalā lakṣmi rakṣyante tu kṣaṇe kṣaṇe | puruṣottamabhaktānāṃ nānavāpyaṃ hi vidyate ||87|| yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyāccaitatpuruṣottamatoṣaṇam | tasya sarvamanaḥkāmān pūrayiṣyati vai hariḥ ||88|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye dharmadevasya tatpatnīnāṃ tatputrāṇāṃ ca prāvirbhāvastato brahmādikṛtapuruṣottamamāsavratena prasannaśrīhariṇā sakuṭumbena brahmādibhyo darśanaṃ varadānaṃ ca dattamityādinirūpaṇanāmā trayoviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 323|||
<1.324> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ahaṃ lakṣmi prasannaḥ saṃbhavāmyeṣā kṛpā mama | puruṣottamamāse me prāptau kṛpaiva kāraṇam || 1 || anyamāseṣvatituṣṭaṃ kartumicchati māṃ yadi | tulasīpatramātreṇāpyatituṣṭo bhavāmyaham || 2 || mañjarīsahayuktena patreṇa pūjayejjanaḥ | mañjarīyuktapatrābhyāṃ mañjarīyuktapatrakaiḥ || 3 || śatena vā daśaśatairlakṣeṇa vā prapūjayet | dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā ca tuṣyāmi tulasīṃ tvāmiva priye || 4 || śrīlakṣmīruvāca kathaṃ nārāyaṇa kṛṣṇa puruṣottama keśava | tulasīṃ manyase toṣakāriṇīṃ māmiva prabho || 5 || vada sarvaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ yadi gopyaṃ na vidyate | gopyaṃ cāpi yadi pātraṃ matāsmi cennu me vad || 6 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ pūrvavṛttāṃ vistāraśālinīm | yathā vṛndā mama toṣakāriṇī svīkṛtā mayā || 7 || saṃśayaṃ tatra kuru mā śrutvā cerṣyāṃ ca mā kuru | sarvadā tu tvayā rakṣyaṃ sauhārdaṃ vṛndayā saha || 8 || pativratāyā dharmo’sti duḥkhaṃ na gaṇyate kvacit | sapatnījaṃ sukhaṃ patiparā tu gaṇayet sadā || 9 || śrutvā śrutvā patisukhaṃ svānyanārīsuyogajam | svātmānandaṃ paraṃ matvā tuṣyati strī pativratā || 1.324.10 || sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi patnīnāṃ me bhavanti vai | vṛndāpi ca mayā patnī kṛtā sāpi ratā mayi || 11 || śṛṇvākhyānaṃ yathā jātaṃ tathā te vacmi sarvathā | kāryasiddhiṃ miṣaṃ kṛtvā vṛndā patnī mayā kṛtā || 12 || vṛndā patnī mamaivāsīd goloke rādhikāsamā | rādhikayā samaṃ dṛṣṭvā ramantaṃ māṃ patiṃ svakam || 13 || īrṣyayā hṛdaye tāpaṃ prāptā rativirodhinī | mahyaṃ vaktumaśaktā sā novāca hṛdayasthitam || 14|| tataḥ kṣaṇāntare rantuṃ mayāhūtāpi nāgatā | tena doṣeṇa duṣṭeyaṃ na mā sevitumarhati || 1 5|| iti saṃkalpitaṃ yāvanmayā tāvattu sā tataḥ | avāpa tadadholoke gatā cāsurabhāvanām || 1 6|| jalaṃdharaṃ patiṃ prāpya duritaṃ svaṃ samāpya sā | jalaṃdharamṛterheturūpāṃ bhuktāṃ mayā yadā || 1 7|| tadā pūtā punarmāṃ sā prāptā me pūrvapatnikā | śṛṇu vistarato lakṣmi tadākhyānaṃ yathābhavat || 18 || ādye kṛtayuge lakṣmi śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ | satīpatirmahādevo līlayā vyacaradvane || 19 || digambarasvarūpeṇa vanināṃ pāvanecchayā | siṃhāraṇye cacāreśaḥ siṃhavannirbhayo haraḥ || 1.324.20 || śivarātridinaṃ jñātvā mahendraśca bṛhaspatiḥ || sākṣācchivasya pūjārthaṃ svargāt pṛthvīṃ prajagmatuḥ ||21|| vyomamārgādvilokyaiva carantaṃ śivameva tau || siṃhāraṇyaṃ guruśakrāvavāteraturādarāt ||22|| tāvacchaṃbhustayorjñānaparīkṣārthaṃ vicārya ca | rūpāntaraṃ vidhāyaiva hyatiṣṭhannikaṣā tayoḥ ||23|| mārgamāruddhya tiṣṭhantaṃ jaṭāsambaddhamastakam || mahātejasvinaṃ nagnaṃ puruṣamadbhutākṛtim ||24|| mahābāhuṃ mahoraskaṃ mārgarodhakaraṃ dṛḍham | purandaro’pṛcchadenaṃ nisargānnetrabhīṣaṇam ||25|| kathaṃ mārgaṃ samāruddhya saṃsthito’si bhayaṃkara | atra dṛṣṭo’mbarapathagāmibhyāṃ śaṃkaro haraḥ ||26|| sa kvāste vada vai śīghraṃ pūjākāmau hi sevakau | itipṛṣṭaḥ pumānnaivāvadat kiṃcit tataḥ punaḥ || 27|| tathaivendreṇa pṛṣṭo’pi punarmaunaṃ samāśritaḥ | novāca sa mahāyogī tūṣṇīmāsa punaḥ punaḥ ||28|| pṛṣṭo’pi tāpaso naivovāca cukrodha vāsavaḥ || uvāca vacanaṃ śaṃbhuṃ nirbhartsyodyamya dakṣiṇam ||29|| hastaṃ kṛtvordhvamādāya vajraṃ cādhikṣipan hariḥ || re mūḍha pṛcchyamāno’pi nottaraṃ dattavānasi ||1.324.30|| eṣa tvāṃ hanmi vajreṇa kaste trāṇaṃ kariṣyati | ityudīrya krudhā hantuṃ yatate yāvadeva ha ||31|| tāvacchrīśaṃkarastasya cakāra staṃbhanaṃ tadā | savajrakarayuktaśca sadeho loṣṭakāṣṭhavat ||3|| stabdho jāto mahendro vai samadahyata manyunā || haro’pi vikarālākṣo drutameva bhayaṃkaraḥ ||33|| prajajvāla pralayāgnisamo dahanniva sthitaḥ || bṛhaspatistadā śaṃbhuṃ śātvā sattvadhiyā hi tam ||34 baddhāṃjalirnanāmeśaṃ papāta daṇḍavadbhuvi || sabhayena hṛdayena haraṃ stotuṃ pracakrame ||35|| namo’gamyasvarūpāya svatantrāya kapardine | tryambakāya maheśāya digambarāya te namaḥ ||36|| namo raudrāya devāya dīnanāthāya śaṃbhave || virūpākṣāya śāntāya bhaktatrātre namo namaḥ ||37|| virūpāyātitejasvisvarūpāya ca te namaḥ || kālāntakāya śarvāya namaste paramātmane ||38|| tvamagnistvaṃ mahāvāyurvyoma tvaṃ salilaṃ dharā || sūryastvaṃ candramāstvaṃ ca nakṣatrāṇi tvameva ha ||39|| jyotiścakaṃ tvayi cāste viṣṇurbrahmā tvameva vai || indro bṛhaspatiścānye tvadārādhanataḥ sadā ||1.324.40|| sukhinaḥ sampadāṃ bhoktāraścopadravavarjitāḥ | bhavanti tatkathaṃ nātha staṃbho’tra suranāyake ||4 1|| iti stutvā papātāsya harasya pādayorguruḥ || pātayāmāsa ca śakraṃ vinayenāha vai punaḥ ||42|| prasanno bhava lokeśa pāhīndraṃ śaraṇāgatam | krodhaṃ saṃhara śāntaśca kṛpāṃ cendropari prabho ||43|| śīghraṃ kuru śamaṃ yātu bhālanetrānalo hyayam | kṣantavyaścāparādho’syājānatā yaḥ kṛto’dhunā ||44|| śrutvā ca vinayaṃ jñātvā saḥ krodhānalabhālakaḥ | śaṃkaraḥ prāha taṃ bhaktaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ śanairvaram ||45||| krodho’yaṃ nirgato netrānalo mūrto’tidāruṇaḥ || bahiryāto na dhartuṃ taṃ manye yogyaṃ bṛhaspate ||46|| nahi sarpa ujjhitāṃ kañcukīṃ dhatte punaśca tām || tiraskurvanta mevainaṃ kariṣye bhasmasāddharim ||47|| iti śrutvā bhayaṃ prāpto dīno bṛhaspatiḥ punaḥ || provāca bhagavān bhaktā anukampyāḥ sadaiva yat ||48|| bhaktavatsalanāmāsi sārthakaṃ kuru śaṃkara | prāhīndraṃ cānalaṃ kṣeptumanyatrārhasi vai jaḍe ||49|| athavendraguruṃ māṃ tvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ bhasmasāt kuru | paraṃ devapatiṃ mā tvaṃ dagdhumarhasi śaṃkara ||1.324.5 0 iti śrutvātivinayaṃ bhaktavatsalanāmadhṛk | praṇatārtiharaḥ śaṃbhurbṛhaspatimuvāca ha ||5|| prītastavāgraheṇātra vinayenārpaṇena ca | jīvadānaṃ mahendrāya dadāmi nirbhayo bhava ||5|| indro jīveti saṃyātu tvaṃ ca jīvātviti prathām | sukhinau bhavatāṃ cobhau kurutaṃ mama pūjanam ||53|| yadarthaṃ vai samāyātau kṛtvā tatpūjanaṃ mama | prasannatāṃ samāgṛhyādāya nirbhayatāṃ prathām ||54|| yātaṃ svargamahaṃ krodhānalaṃ bhālākṣisaṃbhavam || svayaṃ kare gṛhītvaiva tyakṣyāmi lavaṇāṃbhasi ||55 || iti kṛtvākṣipannetrānalaṃ vahnayaśrurūpiṇam || paścime’pāṃnidhau pūjāṃ gṛhītvobhakṛtāṃ tataḥ ||56 tatraivāntardadhe śaṃbhurvidyullekheva bhāsvaraḥ | kṛtārthau ca guruśakrau svasvasthānaṃ prajagmatuḥ ||57|| atha kṣiptaṃ bhālanetrasamutthaṃ cātidāruṇam | jalaṃ tejomalaṃ cāvilaṃ tu yallavaṇāmbhasi ||58|| bālabhāvaṃ samāpannaṃ sadya eva vyarājata || bālaśabdaṃ prakurvan sa bālo jalataraṅgake ||59|| dolārūḍha iva prāste jalakallolasevitaḥ || jātamātro yuvā kaścid vajrāṃga iva cādbhutaḥ ||1.324.60|| prahasan sa muhuḥ śabdaṃ prakurvan divibhedinam | punaḥ punaḥ prahasam̐śca kurvan hāsyaparamparām ||61|| nāditavān diśaḥ sarvāḥ svargaṃ satyaṃ vyakampayat || prākampata kṣitiḥ sarvāḥ prajāśca badhirīkṛtāḥ ||62|| tena hāsyātiśabdena sabalenātalādayaḥ | prākampan dānavāścāpi sarve lokāśca tatrasuḥ || 63|| lokapālā vihvalāśca cacāla sacarācaram | agragaṇyā surā lokeśvarāścakampire drutam ||64|| militvā satyalokaṃ te brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ || ūcurbhayānvitāḥ sarve pitarbhayamupasthitam ||65|| mahāhāsyakṛtaścāyaṃ śabdo lokabhayaṃkaraḥ || trāsakṛtsarvathā bhāti mahākālasya kiṃ bhavet ||66|| kaścid brahmāṇḍayattuṃ vā samāyāto’suro mahān || iti bhāti prabho tasmādasmān rakṣaya pūrvaja ||67 śrutvaivaṃ surapālānāṃ vākyaṃ lokapitāmahaḥ | bhayaṃ gato’pi sarveṣāṃ sāhāyyamabhigamya ca ||68|| gantumaicchat sthalaṃ yatra raudraṃ hāsyaṃ vitanyate | śabdadiśāmabhilakṣyāvātaran vai surādayaḥ ||69|| śabdamūlamavācīsthaṃ kṣārasāgaravāriṣu | abhisandhāya jagmuste vyomni vai paścimāṃ diśam ||1.324.70|| tāvad bālayuvānaṃ prahasantaṃ cāti karkaśam | samudrasya taraṃgeṣu vicarantaṃ bhayaṃkaram ||71|| dadṛśustāvadāyāto jñātvā vārdhiḥ pumān varaḥ || brahmādīnāgatān dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ cakre’tithikriyām ||72|| hāsyaṃ vihāya bālo’pi tatrāgamat samādravan | samudrāṃke niṣasāda pitaḥ pitariti gṛṇan ||73 || brahmaṇābdhistadā pṛṣṭaḥ kuto’yaṃ kasya bālakaḥ | brahmāṇḍatrāsakṛd yasya hāsyaṃ vyāpnoti dikṣu ca ||74|| śaṃkarasya tu bālo’yaṃ vārdhiḥ prāha pitāmaham || tāvad bālaḥ samutthāya dudrāva vedhasaṃ prati ||75|| brahmāṇamagrahīt kaṇṭhe nidhanāya yathā bhavet || vidheḥ kaṇṭhavidhūnanānnetrābhyāmagamajjalam ||76|| samudreṇa samākṛṣya brahmā tasmādviyojitaḥ || evaṃ balānvito bālo haraputraḥ surādibhiḥ ||77|| vilokito jalādhāro jalaṃdharābhidhaḥ kṛtaḥ || jalaṃdharaḥ samudro’sti jālaṃdharo’pi vārdhijaḥ ||78 jālaṃdhara iti jāto jālaṃdharo jalaṃdharaḥ | rudraputro’styato raudro bhaviṣyati parākrame ||79|| śāstrajñaḥ sarvajetā ca śastrāstrajño bhaviṣyati || avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ vinā rudraṃ bhaviṣyati ||1.324.80|| ayaṃ daityaguṇaścādya lokyate’tastathāvidhaḥ || daityeśvaro daityarājo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||81|| brahmā prāha punarbhāgyaṃ tasya dṛṣṭvā tu sāgaram || kṛṇapatnī tu yā rādhādveṣiṇī tasya dhāmani ||82|| goloke rādhikākṛṣṇaratyasahābhavat khalu | sā golokādū bhagavatā bhūtale’tra nirākṛtā ||83|| kālanemigṛhe jātā putrī sāsya priyā satī | pativratā śubhā patnī bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||84 jātamātro yuvā cāsāvabhiṣikto yathā bhavet | daityānāṃ rājyakartā vai tathā sarvairvidhīyatām ||85|| ityājñāṃ brahmaṇaḥ prāpya cāhūya śukrameva ha| ādiśya saritāṃ nāthaṃ taṃ rājye tvabhyaṣecayan ||86|| punarbhayaṃkaraṃ hāsyaṃ mā kurviti praśikṣayā | śāntayantaḥ surāḥ saveṃ yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niketanam ||87|| samudraḥ sutamādāya svagehamagamanmudā | apoṣayanmahopāyaiḥ kālanemiṃ samāhvayat ||88 vṛndābhidhāṃ sutāṃ tasya tadbhāryārthamayācata | kālanemyasuro vārdheryāñcāṃ mene’tivāñcchitām ||89|| dadau sutāṃ vidhānena jālaṃdharāya tatkṣaṇam | tadotsavo mahānāsīd vivāhe ca tayostadā ||1.324.90 samudro’pi sukhaṃ prāpa putraṃ dṛṣṭvā hi sastriyam | daityāḥ pātālalokasthā jālaṃdharaṃ samāśritāḥ ||91|| bhuvamāgatya rājyāni sthāpayāmāsurīśvarāḥ || devajayāya ca sarve babhūvurdṛḍhamānasāḥ ||92|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jālandharavṛndākhyāne golokasthakṛṣṇapatnīvṛndāyāḥ rādhākṛṣṇaratiṃ vilokya sapatnīdveṣadoṣeṇa golokādapagatya kālanemiputratvaṃ śaṃkaradarśanārthaṃ samāgatābhyāṃ siṃhāraṇye śaṃkaraṃ dṛṣṭvāvātaradbhyāṃ bṛhaspatimahendrābhyāṃ kastvamitipraśnottarālabdhau śaṃkare vajraprakṣepāyottānitahastasahitendrasya staṃbhanottaraṃ śaṃbhulalāṭanetrajakrodhānalasya samudre prakṣepājjālaṃdharotpattiḥ vṛndayā saha vivāhaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||324||
<1.325> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmyekadā jālandharo vṛndāpatiḥ svayam | asuraiḥ saha śukrasya pūjanārthaṃ samāyayau || 1 || tatrāyayuḥ pūjanārthamāṣāḍhapūrṇimātithau | daityāśca dānavāḥ sarve rāhuketvādayo’pi ca || 2 || śukrācāryaḥ pūjitastairnamaskṛtaśca bhāvukaiḥ | datvāśīrvacanaṃ tebhyaḥ papraccha kuśalādikam || 3 || dattāsaneṣu sarve te niṣeduḥ saṃsadīṣṭakṛt | jalaṃdharo’tisaṃhṛṣṭo’paśyadrāhuṃ śiro vinā || 4 || papracchābdhisutastatrāścaryapūrvaṃ tu bhārgavam | kenedaṃ kartitaṃ rāhośchiro brūhi kathaṃ kadā || 5 || ityākarṇya śivaṃ smṛtvā śukrācāryaḥ uvāca tam | hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putraḥ prahlādastasya putrakaḥ || 6 || virocanastasya putro balirājo mahābalaḥ | vartate ca rasātalarājyaṃ kurvan prabhaktarāṭ || 7 || asurāṇāṃ tu sainyāni prabalānyasya saṃvaśe | vartante iti jānanti surāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ || 8 || athaikadā tu durvāsā vaikuṇṭhāt samavātarat | bhuvaṃ nārāyaṇadattapuṣpamālāṃ kare dadhan || 9 || dadarśendraṃ viharantaṃ hastinā vyomamārgake | ṛṣirdevapatiṃ jñātvendrāya mālāṃ dadau tadā || 1.325.10 || vigaṇayanniva mālāṃ kare dhṛtvā tu vāsavaḥ | sthāpitavān karikuṃbhe śuṇḍādaṇḍena tāṃ karī || 11 || dhṛtvā pattalake kṛtvā mardayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam | durvāsāḥ krodhamāpannaḥ śaśāpa garvahārakaḥ || 12 || lakṣmīnāśo bhavatvindra mālānāśaphalaṃ tava | ityukte sa papātendro hastipṛṣṭhād bhuvastale || 13 || lakṣmīḥ sarvā vinaṣṭābhūt praviveśa samudrake | sahasravarṣaparyantamaśrīkā devatādayaḥ || 1 4|| duḥkhinaste surāḥ sarve rameśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ | vinā lakṣmīṃ duḥkhitāḥ sma iti svārthaparāyaṇāḥ || 15 || viṣṇudarśitamārgeṇa sandhiṃ cakrustadāsuraiḥ | svakāryasiddhaye śūrāśchaladharmaparāyaṇāḥ || 36 || viṣṇusahāyakā devā militā hyasuraiḥ saha | lakṣmyarthaṃ cāmṛtādyarthaṃ cakruḥ sindhoḥ pramanthanam || 17|| ratnāni te pituryāni tāni sarvāṇi te surāḥ | jagṛhuryatnato dṛptāḥ papurapyamṛtaṃ chalāt || 18|| amṛtāśca surā jātā garviṣṭhā viṣṇupoṣitāḥ | amṛtapānasaṃlabdhāmṛtabhāvabalānvitāḥ || 19 || tata ārabhya daityādīn duḥkhayanti surāḥ sadā | parābhavaścāsurāṇāṃ sadā bhavati sarvathā || 1.325.20 || rāhurayaṃ tadamṛtapānārthaṃ devarūpadhṛk | sūryacandrāntare viṣṭo’mṛtaṃ saṃpariveṣitam || 21 || viṣṇunā pibati yāvat tāvattābhyāṃ niveditaḥ | drāgeva viṣṇunā cakradhārayāyaṃ niṣūditaḥ || 22 || amṛta gaṇḍūṣamātraṃ gale’sya lagnatāṃ gatam | tena nāyaṃ mṛto rāhurdvedhā chinno’pi kaṇṭhataḥ || 23 || dvau jātau rāhurityatra kabandho’yaṃ hi jīvati | keturiti śirastvasya saśikhaṃ cāpi jīvati || 24|| evaṃ tena parābhūtā viṣṇunā daityadānavāḥ | pitā te ca kṛto rikto ratnānyāhṛtya sarvathā || 25|| evaṃ śukroditaṃ rāhoḥ śiraśchedaṃ ca manthanam | ratnopaharaṇaṃ daityaparābhavādikaṃ suraiḥ || 26 || tadākarṇya mahāśakto jalaṃdharaḥ pratāpavān | cukrodha roṣaraktākṣaḥ śrutvā ca pitṛdharṣaṇām || 27 || dūtaṃ tadaiva cāhūya ghasmarākhyaṃ śaśaṃsa tat | sammānyābhayamādatvā preṣayāmāsa śikṣayan || 28 || ghasmara gaccha devendraṃ nivedaya madīritam | gṛhāṇa śaraṇaṃ yadvā yuddhārthaṃ susthiro bhava || 29 || anyadapi ca prāgjātaṃ piturme dharṣaṇādikam | jalaṃdharo na sahate vairamārjanamicchati || 1.325.30 || ityādyādāya vākyāni jagāma ghasmaro drutam | vargācca ghasmaraḥ sarvaṃ devendraṃ vākyamabravīt || 31 || jalaṃdharo mahāvīro daityeśvaro’bdhiputrakaḥ | tasya vīrasya dūto’haṃ ghasmarastannideśakṛt || 32 || preṣitastena vīreṇa cāgatastava sannidhau | yadāha śatrujidrājāvyāhatājñaḥ śṛṇuṣva tat || 33 || kasmāt tvaṃ mama pitaraṃ samudraṃ mandarādriṇā | mathitavān nītavām̐śca sarvaratnāni matpituḥ || 34|| śaraṇaṃ me gṛhāṇa tvaṃ ratnāni me prayaccha ca | anyathā te bhayaṃ prāptaṃ rājyanāśo bhaviṣyati || 35 || iti dūtavacaḥ śrutvā provāca dyusadāṃ patiḥ | yanmayā vihatā śailāstvatpitrā kukṣirakṣitāḥ || 36 || anye’pi maddviṣastena rakṣyante’ntaḥ kathaṃ vada | na me śatruvaro bhūtvā drohī sthāsyati kaścana || 37 || pūrvaṃ hṛtāni ratnāni hariṣye prāṇato’dhunā| śaṃkhāsuraṃ mama śatruṃ rarakṣa tvatpitā katham || 38 || yaṃ śaṃkhaṃ cānujo me vai hatavān viṣṇuravyayaḥ | gaccha dūta vada jālaṃdharaṃ manthanakāraṇam || 39 || nirdoṣaṃ na mahendro vai daṇḍyaṃ karoti kaṃcana | nirdoṣastvaṃ yadidveṣaṃ karoṣi mama nūtanam ||1.325.40 || phalaṃ śīghraṃ pradāsye’haṃ sajjo bhavāsureśvara | ityukto ghasmaro vai saḥ śīghraṃ tatra jagāma hi || 41 || jalaṃdharo’sti yatrābdhau tatrāveditavānidam | indroktaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā roṣatāmrākṣa eva saḥ |||42 || dṛṣṭvādharo’karod devān jenumudyogamāsuraiḥ | sarvadigbhyaḥ samājagmurāsurā daityadānavāḥ || 43 || koṭyabjārbudasaṃkhyākā divaṃ jagmurjigīṣayā | śuṃbhaniśuṃbhanāmānau kṛtvā senādhināyakau ||44|| nirjagāma svayaṃ vīro jalaṃdharo’pi vārdhijaḥ | prāpa nākaṃ nandanastho dadhmau śaṃkhaṃ raṇāya saḥ ||45 || vīradaityāḥ praṇeduścāvṛtyāmarāvatīpurīm | vijñāyendro’pi yuddhāya daṃśitaiśca surottamaiḥ || 46|| saha puryā niryayau vai koṭikoṭyabjayodhibhiḥ | tayoḥ samabhavad yuddhaṃ surāsuraprasenayoḥ ||47|| bāṇairastraistathā mantrairmāyābhiścaindrajālikaiḥ | pāṣāṇaiḥ parvatairvṛkṣairulkābhiśca śatacchadaiḥ ||48 || vajraiścakraiḥ śataghnībhirnārācaistomarairdrumaiḥ | muśalaiḥ parighaiḥ khaṇḍaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ kuntaiśca śaktibhiḥ ||49|| gadābhiḥ paraśubhiśca hastibhiśca rathaiḥ karaiḥ | pallatābhirmuṣṭibhirbāhubhiḥ kaphoṇikādibhiḥ ||1.325.5 0 || te’nyonyaṃ jaghnatuḥ sene saṃmardo’bhūdasaṃkhyakaḥ | raktanadyo’bhavan bhūmau kṛtavārdhigamormayaḥ ||5 1 || patitaiḥ pātyamānaiśca gajavājiprapattibhiḥ | vyarājata raṇe bhūmiḥ sandhyābhrapaṭalaṃ yathā |||52|| mṛtān mṛtān raṇe daityāndānavān gajavājinaḥ | saṃjīvinyājīvayadvai śukro mantritavāribhiḥ ||53 || surānapi mṛtām̐statrājīvayacca bṛhaspatiḥ | divyauṣadhairdroṇagirerānītairvividhairmuhuḥ ||54|| mṛtotthitān surān dṛṣṭvā jālaṃdharo’tiroṣavān | śukraṃ prāha kathaṃ caitā mṛtā jīvanti devatāḥ || |55 || manye sañjīvinīvidyā sureṣvapi gatā tava | śrutvā śukraśca taṃ jalaṃdharaṃ prāha suniścitam ||56 || vidyā sañjivinī naiva sureṣvadyāpi saṃgatā | kintvauṣadhīḥ samānīya droṇaśailād bṛhaspatiḥ ||57|| surān jīvayati drākca tasmād droṇādrimānaya | svādhīnaṃ taṃ kuru yadvā samudrāntaḥ praveśaya ||58|| yadalābhe surā naṣṭā jīviṣyanti na vai punaḥ | tathā kṛte vijayaste bhaviṣyatyanyathā nahi ||59|| śrutvā jalaṃdharo gatvā drutaṃ cotpāṭya parvatam | droṇācalaṃ samānīya prākṣipatsāgarāntare ||1.325.60 || tato devān jaghānāstrairjalaṃdharo mudānvitaḥ | hatāndevājjīvayitumoṣadhyarthaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ || 6 1|| jagāma droṇabhūmiṃ ca tatrādriṃ na dadarśa saḥ | nirāśaḥ sa gururbuddhyā jñātvādriṃ daityasaṃhṛtam || 62|| devānprāha samāgatya palāyadhvaṃ surā itaḥ | droṇādrirnāśito jalaṃdhareṇa vānyato hṛtaḥ ||63 || rudrajanyo hyayaṃ daityo jetuṃ kṣamo na sāmpratam | palāyadhvaṃ palāyadhvaṃ ye mṛtāste gatā yataḥ ||64|| kathaṃciccheṣapatraistān jīvayiṣye mṛtānaham | ityuktāśca surāḥ sarve raṇaṃ tyaktvā palāyitāḥ ||65|| devānpalāyitān dṛṣṭvā daityā jalaṃdharānvitāḥ | śaṃkhabherījayaghoṣairviviśustvamarāvatīm ||66|| svargaṃ tyaktvā bhayād devā devyaśca meruparvate | gahvarāṇi samāśritya nyavasan svarirakṣayā || 67|| atha daityo mahāduṣṭo jalaṃdharo’timatsarāt | devasthāneṣu rikteṣu daityān samabhiṣecayat ||68|| svargarājyaṃ vaśe kṛtvā yayau meruvanāni saḥ | devānāṃ nāśanārthāya daityasainyasamanvitaḥ ||69|| trastāstataḥ surāḥ sarve vihāya gahvarāṇyapi | anāhūtā api jagmurbrahmāṇaṃ prati duḥkhitāḥ ||1.325.70|| tāvat tatrāpi tatsthānaṃ riktaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ suraistadā | satyaloke’pi daityānāṃ rājyaṃ dṛṣṭvā pradudruvuḥ ||71 || vaikuṇṭhaṃ jalatejontarāvaraṇe sthitaṃ sthalam | jagmurdevāśca devyaśca brahmāpi tatra dṛśyate ||72|| tuṣṭuvuste hariṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ prajeśvarāḥ | surarakṣaka śāntātman daityanāśaka te namaḥ ||73 || matsyātmane ca te viṣṇo vedānnītavate namaḥ | amṛtamanthane’driṃ bibhrate kūrmāya te namaḥ ||74|| pṛthvīṃ dante bibhrate te varāhāya namo namaḥ | baliṃ chalāyate vipravāmanāya ca te namaḥ |||75|| namaḥ paraśurāmāya kāpathakṣatranāśine | rāvaṇāntakarāyāśu rāmacandrāya te namaḥ ||76|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇarādhāramāśrīpataye namaḥ | namo buddhasvarūpāya daityamohakarāya te ||77|| namaḥ kapilarūpāya tattvajñānapradāya te | namo haṃsasvarūpāya vidhātre jñānadāya te ||78|| vedavyāsasvarūpāya vidyāśravāya te namaḥ | kalidoṣavināśakṛtkalkirūpāya te namaḥ ||79|| pārvatyāśca prabhāyāśca māṇikyāḥ pataye namaḥ | kaṃbharāyāḥ suputrāya gopālasūnave namaḥ ||1.325.80|| śaraṇyāya surarakṣākartre vidyāvate namaḥ | sādhurūpāya kṛṣṇāya vallabhāya ca te namaḥ ||8 1 || jñānācāryāya daivāya dāsatrātre ca te namaḥ | daityaduḥkhitabhaktādirakṣakāya namo namaḥ |||82|| sarvanetrāya hṛtsthāya ramānāthāya te namaḥ | dhvajapadmāṃkuśavajrayavacihnavate namaḥ ||83|| svastikajāmbvaṣṭakoṇordhvarekhādhāriṇe namaḥ | dhanustrikoṇakalaśārdhacandradhāriṇe namaḥ ||84|| goṣpadavyomamatsyādidhāriṇe pattale namaḥ | dakṣapāṇau dhvajacakradhanustriśūlasvastikāḥ ||851|| mīnadaṇḍayavarekhā yasya tasmai namo namaḥ | bāhū netre jānunī ca nāsikā ca stanāntaram ||86|| dīrghāṇi santi te pañca tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ | suhṛsvajaghanapṛṣṭhagrīvājaṅghāvate namaḥ ||87|| sūkṣmakeśāṅguliparvaradāsthidhāriṇe namaḥ | kakṣā kukṣiśca vakṣaśca ghrāṇaṃ skandho lalāṭakam ||88|| yasyonnatāni ṣaṭ santi tasmai śrīharaye namaḥ | netraprāntau nakhāstālu jihvoṣṭhau pādayostale ||89|| pāṇitale ca raktāni yasya santi ca te namaḥ | uraḥ śiro lalāṭaṃ ca yasya tatāni te namaḥ ||1.325.90 || svara sattvaṃ ca nābhiśca gambhīraṃ yasya te namaḥ | vāmasakthni ramācihnaṃ yasyāsti te namo namaḥ ||9 1|| hṛdaye dakṣiṇāvartavate kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ | satrivalayaśobhāḍhyanābhiyuktāya te namaḥ ||92|| śītabhāsvararūpāyāmṛtapradāya te namaḥ | akṣarāyāvyākṛtanāmne golokāya te namaḥ ||93|| vaikuṇṭhāya badrīśāya śvetadvīpāya te namaḥ | kṣīrasthānāya jīvāya jīvātave ca te namaḥ ||94|| ātmane ca tadātmane sarvātmane namo namaḥ | vahnisthāya ravisthāya hiraṇyasthāya te namaḥ || 95|| surāsuranivāsāya bhaktārtihāriṇe namaḥ | apakṣāya vipakṣāya bhaktapakṣāya te namaḥ || 96 || bhagavam̐ste kathādhāmne vārtādhāmne ca te namaḥ | sarvavidyānivāsāya brahmaṇe te namo namaḥ || 97|| bhagavan devadeveśa pāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān | jalaṃdhareṇa vai svargaṃ nirākṛtya surām̐stataḥ || 98 || svāyattīkṛtameveti kathaṃ tvaṃ sahase prabho | sūryaścandraśca vahniśca śeṣo dharmo nirākṛtāḥ || 99|| śaraṇaṃ te vayaṃ prāptā vadhastasya vicintyatām | vayaṃ kṣudrā iva nātha vicarāmo’ṭavīsthalam || 1.325.100 || iti stutvā viremuste devā indrādayastataḥ | karuṇāsāgaraḥ kṛṣṇo jagāda nirbhayaṃ vacaḥ || 101 || bhayaṃ tyajata vo devāstaṃ gacchāmi jalaṃdharam | nāśayāmyadya taṃ śatruṃ devānāṃ duḥkhadaṃ param || 102|| ityuccārya samutthāya garuḍārūḍha eva saḥ | yāvadgantuṃ prairayat svavāhanaṃ tāvadeva ha || 103 || lakṣmīrbhrāturnidhanaṃ vai bhaviṣyatīti duḥkhitā | bāṣpanetrā prāṃjaliśca provāca vallabhaṃ harim || 104 || mama bhrātā śālakaste kathaṃ vadhyaḥ kṛpānidhe | yadyahaṃ te vallabhāsmi mā tannāśaṃ kuru prabho || 1 05|| viṣṇuḥ prāha sureśānāṃ rakṣaṇāya mayā nanu | gantavyaṃ sarvathā tatra mārayiṣye na te’nujam || 106 || rudrāṃśatvād brahmavākyāt te vākyānna mama priye | māraṇīyo’sti te bhrātā mā viṣādaṃ kuru priye || 10 7|| ityuktvā sāntvayitvā tāṃ yayau yatra jalaṃdharaḥ | devādīn saha nītvaiva kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 108 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jalaṃdharavṛndākhyāne āṣāḍhapūrṇimāyāṃ śukrācāryapūjakāsurasaṃgheṣu rāhuṃ viśirasaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatkāraṇaṃ samudramathanāmṛtapāne pakṣapātādi vijñāya suraviṣṇuprabhṛtināśārthaṃ jalaṃdharakṛtasurāsurayuddhottaraṃ suraparājaye vaikuṇṭhaviṣṇustavanādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 325 ||
<1.326> śrīlakṣmīruvāca nārāyaṇa hare viṣṇo mama bhrātrā taduttaram | viṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭvācaritaṃ kiṃ viṣṇunā kiṃ ca me vada || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi pitā putrī sutastathā | sarve’pi caṃcalā lolāstatra kiṃ kiṃ na jāyate || 2 || viṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭvātisaṃkruddho balagarvasamanvitaḥ | yuddhodyataṃ devasainyaṃ vilokyātiruṣā jvalan || 3 || daityānājñāpayāmāsa samarārthe jalaṃdharaḥ | bho bho daityavarāḥ sarve yuddhārthamamaraiḥ saha || 4 || nirgacchantu mahāśastrā yuddhaṃ kurvantu dustaram | yathā punarnāgaccheyurdevāstathāntakṛnmahat || 5 || tadā mauryā lakṣasaṃkhyā dhaumrāśca śatasaṃkhyakāḥ | asurāḥ koṭisaṃkhyākāḥ kālakeyāśca koṭayaḥ || 6 || kaṃkā lakṣāstathā śuṃbhaniśuṃbhaparirakṣitāḥ | tālajaṃghā mahādaityāḥ koṭiśastatra niryayuḥ || 7 || rākṣasā dānavāścāpi koṭyarbudapadātayaḥ | sandhībhūya tadāyātāḥ suranāśārthaniścayāḥ || 8 || raṇadhvajāstadā vyomni vyadṛśyanta tu netravat | bheryaśca raṇaśṛṃgāṇi cakruśurbhayadāni hi || 9 || jalaṃdharājñayā daityā yuyudhire suraiḥ saha | astrairbāṇaiśca bhūśuṇḍīśataghnībhiśca dūrataḥ || 1.326.10 || dhāvanto’trita āgamya gadābhiḥ śūlatomaraiḥ | paṭṭiśaiḥ paraśubhiśca khaḍgaiśca mūśalādibhiḥ || 11 || vṛkṣaiśca parvataiścāpi vajraiśca śaktibhistathā | nārācaiścārdhacandraiśca sītābhiśca parasparam || 12 || nijaghnurdaityasaṃghāste cakraiśca devatā api | yuyudhuste mahāvīrāḥ kurvantaḥ siṃhavad ravān || 13 || kecid bāṇairhatāścānye hatāḥ kṣatāśca tomaraiḥ | kecitparaśuśūlaiśca hatā raṇavanāntare || 14|| daityānāṃ kadanaṃ jātaṃ mahad dṛṣṭvā jalaṃdharaḥ | nādayitvā raṇaśṛṃgaṃ svayaṃ cākruśya vai balāt || 15 || sabalāndānavān kṛtvāvātarad raṇamūrdhani | ato daityā mahāvīryāḥ samutsāhāstadābhavan || 16 || samāpetuśca saṃgrāme tvandhā bhūtvātidāruṇāḥ | mārayantu cchedayantu dvaidhīkurvantu devatāḥ || 17|| mardayantu kūrcayantu cūrṇayantu tilāṃśavat | māpasarpantu saṃgrāmād homaṃ kurvantu cātmanām || 18 || śūrāṇāṃ raṇayajño vai punarnāyāti nāpyate | raktaṃ pibantu devānāṃ bhuñjantu tatpriyāstataḥ || 19 || ityākrośo mahānāsīttadānīṃ daityamaṇḍale | prahārā sabalā hyāsan daityānāṃ suranāśakāḥ ||1.326.20|| na prahārastadā kaścit surānāśī pravartate | yatra vai dṛśyate tatra dṛśyante devatā hatāḥ ||21 || ararāṭī tadā tvāsīdviṣṇorhṛdantare kṣaṇam | vāsavo’pi vidudrāva surāḥ śeṣā vidudruvuḥ || 22| palāyanaparān dṛṣṭvā viṣṇusteṣu viveśa ha | sabalān sarvathā kṛtvā hataśeṣān surān hariḥ ||23|| yuddhārthamāhvayāñcakre garuḍasthaḥ punaḥ punaḥ | jīvayiṣye surānsarvānnāśayiṣye tu dānavān || 24||| mā palāyantu saṃgrāmādahaṃ yotsye’grago bhavan | ityuktvā bhagavān viṣṇuḥ svasya sudarśanāttadā ||25|| sudarśanānāṃ lakṣāṇi racayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam | prerayāmāsa tānyeva hantuṃ senāṃ tu dānavīm || 26|| agnīṃśca lakṣaśaḥ kṛtvā prerayāmāsa cāsurīm | senāṃ hantuṃ hariścāpi sudarśanaṃ samairayat ||27|| agnicakrāṇyasurān saṃpradehurbhasmasādyathā | etadvilokya devāśca nijaghnurvai palāyitān ||28|| āhvayanto’tidhṛṣṭāśca jayecchavo’tidāruṇāḥ | viṣṇurjalena saṃprokṣya mṛtānutthāpayattathā || 29|| te’pi jaghnurvegiśastrairastraiśca dānavām̐stadā | viṣṇuḥ paśyati sarvatra dānavā trastatāṃ gatāḥ ||1.326.30 || chinnā naṣṭāḥ kartitāśca dṛśyante’raṇyavattadā | śeṣā vidudruvuḥ svargāt parityajya raṇāṃgaṇam || 31|| evaṃ parājayastatrāsurāṇāmabhavanmahān | asoḍhā tasya sāmudro devavṛndabhayaṃkaraḥ ||32||| yoddhumabhyāyayau śukraṃ nirdiśyāsurajīvanam | śukraśca vidyayā daityāndagdhānajīvayad drutam ||33|| jalaṃdharo mahānādaṃ cakāra karṇadīrṇakam | bhayaṃkareṇa nādena tadā cāpūritaṃ jagat ||34|| viṣṇoścāpi praṇādena cakampe sakalaṃ jagat | dhanuṣyubhau samādāya ṭaṃkāraravakāriṇau ||35|| yuyudhāte svasṛpatiśālākau hi vipakṣagau | ākāśaṃ kurvato bāṇaistadā niravakāśavat ||36|| viṣṇurbāṇairasurasya dhvajaṃ chatraṃ dhanuśśarān | ciccheda ca hṛdaye taṃ bāṇenātāḍayad dṛḍham ||37|| tāvadutplutya daityendro gadāpāṇirhariṃ prati | padbhyāṃ dhāvan balānmūrdhni garuḍaṃ hatavān ruṣā ||38|| viṣṇuṃ jaghāna śūlena hṛdaye’tiprasahya vai | viṣṇuḥ khaḍgena tīkṣṇena gadāṃ ciccheda śūlakam || 39 || tāvad daityaḥ punaścānyad dhanuḥ kṛtvā śarānvitam | viṣṇuṃ jaghāna hṛdye khaḍgaṃ cicched cāpi vai ||1.326.40 || viṣṇuścārdhena khaḍgena chitvā taṃ bāṇamāgatam | śārṅge śīghraṃ samādāya prairayad bāṇamulbaṇam ||4 1 || daityastaṃ sītayā pracyāvya ruṭchinnādharo balī | śarāntareṇa 3 śārṅgaṃ dhanuściccheda vaiṣṇavam ||42 || punarbāṇaiścātitīkṣṇairviṣṇuṃ jaghāna vakṣasi | chinnadhanvā hariḥ kaumudakīṃ cikṣepa vai gadām ||43 || sā vidyudvadapradhṛṣyā sāmudro’pi tathābalaḥ | gadayā tāḍyamāno’pi na cacāla hi kiñcana ||44|| daityastriśūlamanalāvarṣiṃ vai haraye’kṣipat | harirnandakakhaḍgena ciccheda tat triśūlakam ||45|| daityaḥ śaktiṃ vajrajanyāṃ lambāṃ yojanamātrakām | aṣṭadhārāṃ ca sahasraghaṇṭāṃ śailādināśinīm || 4 6|| samādāya prāhiṇodvai vināśāya harestadā | hāhākāro mahānāsīt sureṣu vai bhayaṃkaraḥ ||47|| daityasya cāntimaṃ vajraṃ tadabhūcchaktirūpakam | nāśayāmi yadi cedvai nāyaṃ yuddhaṃ kariṣyati ||48|| tasmād garuḍacañcvā taṃ gṛhītvā svavaśe tataḥ | dāsye prāpya vijayaṃ ca yena yuddhaṃ bhavetpunaḥ || 49 || iti vicārya hariṇā pakṣicañcvā dhṛtā hi sā | āyāntī rakṣitā svasya pakṣipakṣaikapicchake || 1.326.50 || dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ mahatprāpto’sura āgatya cāmbarāt | nipatya hṛdye viṣṇuṃ jaghāna dṛḍhamuṣṭinā ||5 1 || garuḍasya gale tadvajjaghāna pādalattayā | tadā tu viṣṇunā daityo dhṛto śirasi vai dṛḍham ||52 || garuḍena tu daityaḥ sa dhṛtaścañcvā tu pādayoḥ | uttolya kṣiptaḥ patito dūre vai śatayojanam || 53 || punarutthāya cāyāto vyomamārgeṇa cābdhijaḥ | tāvadviṣṇuścātiruṣṭo jaghāna hṛdi taṃ punaḥ ||5 4|| sa ca viṣṇuṃ jaghānaiva hṛdi muṣṭyā punaḥ punaḥ | garuḍopari tatraiva yuyudhāte mahābalau |||55|| bāhubhirmuṣṭibhiścaiva jānubhirmaraṇonmukhaiḥ | gaṇayitvā na maraṇaṃ daityastu yuyudhe balī ||56|| martavyaṃ vā vijetavyaṃ lābho dvaye’pi me’sti hi | kva vai viṣṇoḥ karānmṛtyuḥ kva vā viṣṇuvijetṛtā ||57|| dvayorlābho mahānasti yadbhāvi bhavatu dhruvam | ityālocya matiṃ tasya mṛtyuṃ śaṃbhukṛtaṃ tathā || 58 || prahasya bhagavānprāha dhanyastvaṃ raṇadurmadaḥ | mamāgre’pyavināśino vināśāya pataṃgavat ||59 || yastvaṃ jīvaṃ tathā prāṇānsamarpya raṇamūrdhani | samāyātaḥ kṣātradharmaṃ pālayan śaṃkarātmajaḥ ||1.326.60 || mamāstraistvaṃ na vai bhīto yairvīrā bahavo hatāḥ | na dṛṣṭastvatsamo vīro galagrāhaprayuddhakṛt || 61 || varaṃ varaya daityendra prīto’smi tava vikramāt | adeyamapi deyaṃ te tvādṛśāya raṇāṃgaṇe || 62 || varasya samayaṃ jñātvā jalaṃdharo’pi buddhimān | pratyuvāca hariṃ lakṣmi svavaśaṃ gamayan prabhum || 63 || yadi tuṣṭo’si bhagavan varaṃ dadāsi ced yadi | madbhaginyā mayā sārdhaṃ madgehe sagaṇo vasa || 64|| tacchrutvā ca tathāstviti jagād bhagavān hi tam | tato lakṣmyā tathā parivāreṇa sahitaḥ prabhuḥ || 65 || jalaṃdharagṛhaṃ gatvā jalaṃdhareṇa pūjitaḥ | uvāsa vacanād baddhaḥ pratīkṣan punarardanam ||6 1||| jalaṃdhareṇa medinyāṃ puraṃ jālaṃdharaṃ kṛtam | rājyaṃ ca bahulaṃ pṛthvyāmāsamudrāntamāsthitam || 67|| svargādau dānavāḥ sarve niyuktā adhikāriṇaḥ | pātālādau kṛtā daityā adhikāraparāḥ svayam ||68 || pṛthvyāṃ paścimavārdheśca madhye dvīpe hyuvāsa saḥ | devagandharvasiddheṣu yatkiṃcidratnamācitam ||6 9|| svāyattīkṛtya tatsarvaṃ bubhuje’kaṇṭakaṃ talam | devagandharvasiddheśān sarparakṣonareśvarān ||1.326.7 0 || svadvīpe nāgarān kṛtvā śaśāsa bhuvanatrayam | devā yuddhe mṛtā ye ye tānparyajīvayaddhariḥ ||7 1 || daityā ye ye hatāstām̐śca śukraḥ saṃparyajīvayat | devāḥ punargatā mervādyaraṇyādau yathā purā ||72 || phalaṃ labdhaṃ na vai kiñcittuṣāvaghātavaddhyabhūt | sarvatra bhuvaneṣvāsīd vārtā viṣṇuḥ parājitaḥ ||73 || bhaktyādhīno bhavatyeva vaśī nānyena kenacit | lakṣmyā ca śālakenāpi snehena sa vaśīkṛtaḥ ||74|| devakāryaṃ vihāyaiva śālakagṛhamāśritaḥ | devā nirāśrayā jātā duḥkhitāḥ śaraṇaṃ vinā ||75|| devyo’pi duḥkhamāpannā asurairbhūri cārditāḥ | kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ viṣṇurvṛndālatāṃ śritaḥ ||76 || atha daityavināśo vai śīghraṃ syādityacintayat | antarātmagatād devāt kṛṣgānārāyaṇātprabhoḥ ||77|| devā devyaśca ye jālaṃdharadvīpe tu nāgarāḥ | abhavam̐ste tathā cānye yathā jñāyet nāsuraḥ ||78 || tathā vicārya śreṣṭhāste jagmuḥ śaṃkarasannidhau | tuṣṭuvuḥ śaṃkaraṃ sveṣāṃ duḥkhasya vinivṛttaye ||7 9|| athāhūya mahādevo nāradaṃ kuśalakriyam | preṣayāmāsa tatpūryāṃ devakāryacikīrṣayā ||1.326.80 || nārado’pi yayau śīghraṃ jālaṃdharapure tadā | devānpūrvaṃ militvā ca jñātvā duḥkhaṃ tataḥ punaḥ ||8 1 || devakṛtaṃ pūjanaṃ ca gṛhītvātithisatkriyām | śrutvā sūryaśaśidharmavahniniḥsāraṇādikam ||82|| viṣṇoḥ parājayaṃ śrutvā jalaṃdharasya cānayam | surānāśvāsayitvā jñāpayitvā kāryasiddhaye ||8 3 || yathābuddhi devakāryaṃ kariṣye hyabhidhāya ca | natvā devān yayau jalandharasabhāmṛṣiḥ svayam ||84|| āgataṃ muniṃ jalaṃdharo natvāsanaṃ dadau | saṃpūjya vidhivad daityaḥ prahasyāha tu nāradam ||85|| kuśalaṃ te muniśreṣṭha kuta āgamyate itaḥ | yadarthamiha cāyāto vijñāpaya karomi tat ||86 || prasannātmā nāradastacchrutvā provāca cāsuram | dhanyastvaṃ balavān rājā rājendro vartase’dhunā ||87|| sarvaratnaprabhoktāsi tathāhaṃ śrutavān divi | paścācca śrutavān bhogān śaṃkarasyottamottamān ||88 || yojanāyutavistīrṇe kalpadrumamahāvane | kāmadhenuśatākīrṇe cintāmaṇisudīpite 89|| sarvarukmamaye divye sarvatrādbhutaśobhite | yānavāhanadāsaiśca dāsībhiḥ paricārite ||1.326.90 || kailāśaśikhare tatra dṛṣṭavān śaṃkaraṃ hyaham | sarvāṃgasundaraṃ gauraṃ trinetraṃ candraśekharam ||9 1 || ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣābhiryuvatībhiḥ susevitam | candrapiṇḍakṛtābhirvā sūryasvarṇaniḥsṛtābhiḥ ||92|| naikasundarībhiḥ śivo modate tatra parvate | athāvicārayaṃ paścācchrutaṃ jālaṃdharaṃ sukham ||93 || kīdṛg bhavettathā smṛrddhiretādṛśī bhavenna vā | iti vitarkya
