sāścaryaṃ samāgato’smi te gṛham ||94|| tadvilokanakāmo’haṃ tvatsānnidhyamihāgataḥ | dvīpaste subhagaścāsti hyudyānavanamaṇḍitaḥ ||95|| parīto jalakhātena śobhito’stīti sundaram | ityuktavantaṃ daityaḥ sa darśayāmāsa sarvathā ||96|| smṛddhimantargṛhā bāhyagṛhā gahvarasaṃsthitām | dṛṣṭvā śaśaṃsa munirāḍ vitarkya devalābhakṛt ||97|| viṣṇupreraṇayā prāha daityaṃ mohaṃ yathāviśet | aho tava samṛddhestu pāraṃ nāsti jalaṃdhara ||98|| trailokyādhipatigṛhe bhavedeva na citrakam | bhavanāni vicitrāṇi yānāni vāhanāni ca || 99|| upakaraṇāni ratnapūjāśca maṇiśevadhiḥ | mauktikāni hīrakāśca suvarṇaśatabhūmayaḥ || 1.326.10 0|| gajādyā vājinaścāpi nānyatra santi te yathā | śaktasyairāvataścātra sūryasyoccaiḥśravā hayaḥ || 10 1|| kalpamandāravṛkṣāśca nidhayo dhanadasya ca | brahmaṇo haṃsayānaṃ ca viṣṇoḥ garuḍa ityapi || 102|| yamasya mahiṣaścāpi viṣṇoḥ sudarśanaṃ tathā | śeṣarājamaṇiścāpi candrasya cāmṛtaṃ tathā || 1 03|| manvantarāṇāṃ chatrāṇi suvarṇayaṣṭayastathā | cāmarāṇi digīśānāṃ devīnāṃ kaṃkaṇāni ca || 1 04|| evaṃ sarvāṇi ratnāni bhānti tāni gṛhe tava | pramadānāṃ ca dāsīnāṃ śreṣṭhatvaṃ cāpi te’sti vai || 105 || kintu naikamapi jāyāratnaṃ tai bhāti tādṛśam | yādṛśaṃ śaṃkarāgre’sti tāvān nyūno’sti vai bhavān || 106 || śreṣṭhena jāyāratnena sūryacandranibhena vai | bhavanāni praśobhante rājño na smṛddhibhistathā || 1 07|| kirātībhistu lakṣābhiḥ śobhate na nṛpagṛham | yathā tvaṃ digyaśā bhāsi na tvatpatnī tathāsti vai || 1 08|| yadvā kiṃ śubhradāsībhiryaśaścenna vivāhitā | śuklāṃ jāyāṃ vinā sarvaṃ pherurājagṛhopamam || 1 09|| na vai vivāhitāṃ vinā śobhā rājño bhavetkvacit | rājyamātā bhaved devī divyā vaṃśavivardhinī || 1.326.110 || nahi dāsīpralakṣāsu kumāro nṛpatermataḥ | dāsījāḥ śataśaścāpi nābhiṣekārhaṇā matāḥ || 111 || tadānetuṃ kumārīṃ tvaṃ strīratnaṃ cārhasi dhruvam | ahaṃ gacchāmi lokeṣu ratnānāṃ yatra saṃgrahaḥ || 11 2|| śrutvaivaṃ cāha devarṣiṃ jalaṃdharo’timānavān | devarṣe ca yathāsarvaratnānāṃ śraiṣṭhyamasti me || 113 || caturdaśasu lokeṣu tādṛk śreṣṭhottamottamam | bhavitā yadi vijñātaṃ bhaved darśaya me matam || 1 14|| bhavatā sarvato dṛṣṭā nāryo rājñyaśca kanyakāḥ | vedhasāṃ śaṃkarāṇāṃ ca viṣṇūnāṃ cāpi kanyakāḥ || 115 || ṛṣīṇāṃ cāpi pitṝṇāṃ devānāṃ cāpi kanyakāḥ | mānavānāṃ ca nāgānāṃ daityadānavarakṣasām || 116 || sarvāśca kanyakā mune tvayā dṛṣṭāḥ samantataḥ | sarvātiśayasaundaryarūpayauvanasadguṇāḥ || 117 || yatra vasanti tadratnaṃ pradarśaya nayāmi tat | caturdaśabhuvanānāṃ rājñīnāṃ saṃsadi mama || 118 || patnīrūpaṃ prakāśyeta sūrya iva mahojjvalam | yatsamaṃ na bhavedanyadadhikaṃ tu kathaṃ bhavet || 119 || tādṛśaṃ darśaya vidvan nayāmi vivahāmi ca | yadagre sarvarājñyaśca pataṅgya iva sarvathā || 1.326.120 || bhaveyustādṛśaṃ kumārikāratnaṃ vahāmyaham | śrutvaivaṃ nāradaḥ prāha vartate tādṛśaṃ khalu || 121 || ekamevātra brahmāṇḍe kumārīratnamuttamam | yadagre sarvanārīṇāṃ saundaryaṃ bhasmitendhanam || 122 || mayāpi yaddināddṛṣṭaṃ taddināt tadavāptaye | prayatyate punargatvā nidrāṃ labhe na śarmadām || 123 || hṛdaye cakṣuṣorvṛttau svapne tathā ca jāgare | mastake’pi ca sā kanyā ramate smṛtimāgatā || 124 || kiṃ saundaryaṃ ca kiṃ rūpaṃ kīdṛśaṃ yauvanaṃ tathā | yannakhāgre’pi tejo’sti yatra kṛṣṇāyate śaśī || 125 || yanmukhe gaṇḍayorbhāgau tathā cāpi kapolayoḥ | klṛptāścatvāra evātra sūryāḥ kiṃ staśca tādṛśau || 126 || kiyanmadhyakaṭistasyāḥ kiyatkāmasthalaṃ tathā | kiyatprodbhinnabhāvāḍhyastanadvayaṃ kiyat kiyat || 127 || vidyullatā yathā tatra tatra vasanti vai kimu | mayā na prāpyate rājam̐stvayā kathaṃ sa cāpyate || 128 || tathāpi kuru yatnaṃ tvaṃ prāpsyate tajjayastava | prāptavyaṃ vāpi martavyamiti kṛtvā prayatyatām || 129 || nānyathā tadbhavetkāryaṃ śūrāṇāṃ kimasādhyakam | kailāse tadvartate’dya śaṃbhorhastatale sthitam || 1.326.130 || śaṃbhoḥ patnīsvarūpeṇa cākṣata tena yoginā | śaṃbhustu vartate yogī samādhau tiṣṭhati dhruvam || 131 || na spṛśati tāṃ nārīṃ kanyārūpāṃ vicintya saḥ | atyadbhutāṃ rakṣati sma sarvathā yogasiddhibhiḥ || 132 || jāyāratnena sadṛśastrilokyāṃ śaṃbhunā khalu | nāsti kaściditi manye pratyakṣaṃ dṛṣṭavān yataḥ || 133 || yasyāḥ pādāvalokena brahmā reto hyavāsṛjat | kāmo’pi tāṃ vilokyaiva mumoha bhasmatāṃ gataḥ || 1 34|| tadratnaṃ tvakṣataṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyo bhavātra vai | no cet prāṇān vihāyaiva paralokaṃ samāśraya || 1 35|| ityuktvā nārado devapūjyo devahitārthakṛt | yayau devām̐śca vijñāpya kalāṃ daityavināśinīm || 136 || devā api sutuṣṭāśca viṣṇuṃ gatvā sa nāradaḥ | sarvaṃ tadabravīnnatvā yayau satyaṃ svakaṃ sthalam || 1 37|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jalaṃdharavṛndākhyāne’surasurasainyayuddhaṃ mṛtāsurasurāṇāmujjīvanaṃ jalaṃdharaviṣṇvośca yuddhaṃ prasannena viṣṇunā jalaṃdharagṛhe vāsātmakavarapradānaṃ punardevānāṃ duḥkhaṃ śaṃkarāya nivedanaṃ nāradasya jalandharagṛhaṃ pratigamanaṃ surūpāyā bhāryāyā pārvatyā ānayanāya jalandharasya mohanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 326 ||
<1.327> śrīlakṣmīruvāca nārāyaṇa mahārāja jalaṃdhareṇa śatruṇā | nārade tu prayāte vai tato’nuṣṭhitameva kim || 1 || vada vistarato nātha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho | jalaṃdharo mahādaityaḥ pārvatyarthe kimācarat || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tato daityo nāradoktānusārataḥ | prayatnaṃ kṛtavān samyak kathayāmi yathātatham || 3 || tāmeva cintayan tanvīmanaṃgaśarapīḍitaḥ | kālādhīnālpabhāgyaḥ saḥ praṇaṣṭadhīrvimohitaḥ || 4 || sudūtamāhvayāmāsa saiṃhikeyaṃ vicakṣaṇam | āgataṃ taṃ mahārāhuṃ prāha kāryaprasādhaka || 5 || mama kāryasya siddhyarthaṃ kailāsaṃ gaccha parvatam | tatra yogī śaṃkaro’sti yo na spṛśati strīvarām || 6 || tasya hastagataṃ kanyāratnaṃ cāstīti nāradaḥ | māmuvāca ca tadratnaṃ mayā prāptavyameva ha || 7 || pārvatītyabhidhānaṃ tanmayā prāptavyameva hi | tatra gatvā tu vaktavyaṃ nirbhayena hṛdā tvayā || 8 || vanavāsinmahāyogin jāyāratnena kiṃ nu te | dehi tanme jalaṃdharanāmne ratnabhuje hara || 9 || yāni yāni tu ratnāni trailokye tāni sarvaśaḥ | mama gṛhe mayā rājñā cānītāni balāttataḥ || 1.327.10 || airāvata uccaiḥśravāḥ kalpaśca pārijātakaḥ | haṃsayuktavimānaṃ ca vajra śaktiśca cāmaram || 11 || mauktikāni hīrakāśca chatraṃ prakhyātimacca yat | tatsarvaṃ mama bhogyaṃ vai mayānītaṃ mama gṛhe || 1 2|| nidhayaśca mahāmālā pāśo daṇḍastathāmṛtam | sarvaṃ tanmadgṛhe cāsti kanyāratnaṃ vinā hara || 13 || yoginaste navakanyā na spṛśyā dīyatāṃ hi me | ityājñāṃ prāpya rāhuśca yayau yatra sa śaṃkaraḥ || 14|| nandinādiṣṭadūtatvāt sabhāmadhye praveśitaḥ | śaṃkaraṃ divyasarvāṃgaṃ divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam || 15|| praṇanāma haraṃ tatra gatavān nikaṭaṃ tathā | uvāca śaṃkaraṃ cāsmi dūto jalaṃdharasya vai || 1 6|| trailokyapatinā muktastvatsakāśamihāgataḥ | yoginaṃ tvāṃ samudiśya sa yadāha śṛṇuṣva tat || 17|| kanyāratnaṃ svarṇakāntaṃ candrapiṇḍasamaṃ tava | yogino nopayuktaṃ syād dehi me tvaṃ digambara || 18 || ahaṃ ratnaprabhoktāsmi tat strīratnaṃ na te bhavet | bhikṣāśinaḥ kuto ratnaṃ bhāryāratnaṃ tu bhūbhṛtaḥ || 1 9|| trailokye yāni ratnāni tānyāhṛtāni sarvaśaḥ | mayā ceyaṃ śubhā kanyā ceṣyate dīyatāṃ nu me || 1.327.20 || svastrīratnaṃ dehi mahyaṃ rājñaḥ sukhakarāḥ prajāḥ | trailokyāntargatatvāt tvaṃ prajā bhavasi me hara || 21 || paśya lakṣmi hatabuddhiḥ pitaraṃ prāha mātaram | pārvatīṃ me dehi ceti māyā vai kīdṛśī hareḥ || 22|| hatadhiyo’tra loke vai mātṛkāmābhicintakāḥ | sarve jalandharā bodhyā viṣṇumāyāvimohitāḥ || 23 || satīṣvapi ca dāsīṣu parāṃganāṃ samīhate | so’pi jalaṃdharo bodhyo vināśamukhamantritaḥ || 24|| śṛṇu paścāttu yajjātaṃ rāhau vadati tatkṣaṇam | samutpanno mahāraudro gaṇastīvrāśanisvanaḥ || 25 || bhrūmadhyādīśaroṣādvā sajvālanayano mahān | siṃhāsyapracalajjihvaścordhvakeśo bhayaṃkaraḥ || 26|| tālajaṃgho’bhidudrāva kṣudhayā rāhumāturaḥ | khādituṃ tu samāyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvādhāvacca rāhukaḥ || 27|| tathāpi taṃ saḥ prasahya rāhuṃ dadhāra khāditum | ākruśya śaṃkaraṃ prāha rāhuḥ pāhi prapannakam ||28|| trāhi trāhi prabho pāhi rakṣa rakṣa kṛpānidhe | khādatyayaṃ sevakaste dūtaṃ māṃ śaraṇāgatam || 29 || na khādettu yathāyaṃ māṃ tathā rakṣaya śaṃkara | brāhmaṇaṃ māṃ na khādedvai namaste’stu kṛpāṃ kuru || 1.327.30 || brāhmaṇeti vacaḥśrutvā śaṃkaraḥ svagaṇaṃ tadā | abravīd dūta mā khāda brāhmaṇaṃ rāhunāmakam || 31 || iti śrutvā dūtavaco mumoca taṃ subhojanam | śaṃbhuṃ prāha kṣudhito’smi tyājitaṃ mama bhakṣyakam || 32 || kṣudhā māṃ bādhate śaṃbho dehi bhakṣyaṃ maheśvara | śivaḥ prāha bubhukṣā te yadyatīva pravartate || 33 || kṣudhā tvāṃ bādhate’tyarthaṃ svamāṃsaṃ bhakṣayātra vai | hastapādādikaṃ svasya bhakṣayātreti cājñayā || 34 || cakhāda sa gaṇaḥ sarvaṃ svamāṃsaṃ svakabandhajam | yadābhavacchiraḥ śiṣṭaṃ prasannaḥ śaṃkarastadā || 35 || uvāca he mahābhakta madājñāpratipālaka | santuṣṭo’smi vada tubhyaṃ kiṃ dadāmi bhayaṃkara || 36 || mayā saha prapūjyatvaṃ kīrtimukhābhidhānakam | dadāmi te mahāvīra vasa dvāri mama gṛhe || 37 || tadāprabhṛti śaṃbhoścālayadvāri sa tiṣṭhati | pūjanīyo viśeṣeṇa śaṃbhoḥ santoṣahetave || 38 || atha rāhurgato yatra jalaṃdharaḥ pratiṣṭhati | svasva mṛtyuṃ nivedayāmāsa yathā ca jīvanam || 39 || jalaṃdharastu saṃkruddhaḥ śrutvā śaṃkaraceṣṭitam | dūtāvamānaṃ gaṇayan svāvamānaṃ mahat kṛtam ||1.327.4 0 || uvāca daityamūrdhanyān sajjā bhavantu vai kṣaṇāt | nirgacchantvakhilā daityāḥ kālanemyādayastathā || 41 || śuṃbhaniśuṃbhamukhyāśca koṭayo vīravaṃśajāḥ | kaṃbuvaṃśyā daurhṛdāśca kālakeyāśca kālakāḥ || 42 || mauryā dhaumrāstathā cānye dānavāścāsurāstathā | sajjāḥ samāgatāḥ sarve tānādāya jalaṃdharaḥ ||43 || nirjagāmāśu daityānāṃ koṭibhiḥ parivāritaḥ | agre rāhuśchinnaśiro’maṃgalāya kṛto’bhavat || 44|| śukraḥ kāṇo’maṃgalāya dvitīyo’pyagrago’bhavat | śuṃbhasya tu khaḍgo hastātpatito’maṃgalāya saḥ ||45 || niśuṃbhādeḥ kṣuvanaṃ ca gatau skhalanamityapi | jalaṃdharasya śiraso mukuṭo’patadityapi ||46 || amaṃgalāya tatsarvaṃ prasthāne’bhavadārtikṛt | mahānidrāsūcakāścāśakunānyabhavannapi |||47|| tadā trastāḥ surā guptā agacchan śaṃkaraṃ prati | tuṣṭuvurduṣṭanāśāya devānāṃ sukhalabdhaye ||48 || dhyānamagna mahādeva samādhistha namo’stute | jalaṃdharastava putro vināśāya samarpitaḥ ||49 || surāṇāṃ kadanaṃ kṛtvā pārvatyā dharṣaṇaṃ tathā | tavāvamānaṃ kṛtvā ca tato nāśāya kalpitaḥ || 1.327.50 || kiṃ vā pūrvaṃ kṛpānātha daityo nāśāya kalpitaḥ | kiṃ vai tvayā tathā lakṣmīpatināsti praṇiścitam ||5 1 || viṣaprāśottarāt pūrva varaṃ viṣavināśanam | duṣṭakṛddharṣaṇāt pūrvaṃ varaṃ duṣṭe pradaṇḍanam |||52 || viṣṇustasya gṛhe śete vṛndayā parisevitaḥ | śaṃkaraḥ svagṛhe śete brahmaṇi svasamādhinā ||53 || pārvatyāścātra kiṃ bhāvi vicāraya prabholaka | devānāṃ durdaśāṃ cāpi vilokaya praśaṃkara ||54|| brahmā brahmāṇḍaracane nivṛttiṃ naiva yāti ca | dikpālā lokapālāśca jalaṃdharavaśaṃgatāḥ ||55 || rakṣako vidyate naiva lakṣmīstasya sahāyinī | tvaṃ bhava rakṣako’smākaṃ sthānabhraṣṭākṛtātmanām ||56 || jahi no rakṣaṇārthāya putra te sāgarātmajam | sa cāyāti tvayā kartuṃ raṇaṃ balena garvitaḥ ||57 || hantumarhasyavilambāt taṃ viruddhārthagāminam | duḥkhitaśca surān sarvān pāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān ||58|| iti devavacaḥ śrutvā viṣṇuṃ sasmāra śaṃkaraḥ | viṣṇuḥ śīghraṃ samāyāto na jānīyād yathāsuraḥ |||59|| śaṃbhuḥ prāha hariṃ viṣṇo jalaṃdharaḥ kathaṃ tvayā | niṣūdito na cādyāpi kathaṃ vasasi tadgṛhe ||1.327.60 || viṣṇuḥ prāha mahādeva śrībhrātā ca tavātmajaḥ | itihetorhato naiva tvamenaṃ jahi śaṃkara || 61 || mayā kṛto raṇastena prāṇagrāheṇa sarvathā | lakṣmyā nivāritaścāhaṃ mārayāmāsa naiva tam || 62 || na sa vai māritaḥ śaṃbho tava gauravakāraṇāt | vareṇa svālaye cāhaṃ vāsito’smi na pakṣagaḥ ||6 3 || tasya patnī mahābhāgā kṛṣṇagolokavāsinī | vṛndā bhavati dharmāḍhyā satī pativratā sadā || 64|| tasyā balena daityo’sau mriyate neti vai mayā | hetujijñāsayā cāpi vasatistadgṛhe kṛtā ||65|| tajjñātaṃ sarvathā śaṃbho kāraṇaṃ prabalaṃ yataḥ | yuddhaṃ kuru mahādeva sāhāyye vicarāmyaham | 66 || vṛndāyāṃ tatra kāpaṭyaṃ kiṃcit kartuṃ bhaviṣyati | nyāyenaiva kariṣyāmi nānyāyena kadācana || 67|| sa ca daityastava patnīṃ kāmenādātumicchati | tatra chidre mayā kiṃcit kartavyamupatiṣṭhati || 68 || avaśyaṃ tasya nāśaḥ syānmātṛduṣṭārthagāminaḥ | nāyaṃ putraḥ kintu śatrurindraṃ dṛṣṭvā tvayā kṛtaḥ || 69 || sa evānyāyago nāśyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | etasminnantare daityo mahāsenāsamanvitaḥ || 1.327.70 || kailāsaprāntamāyāto’varudhyādriṃ jagarja ha | sainyakolāhalaṃ śrutvā cukrodha śaṃkarastadā || 71 || samādideśa yuddhārthaṃ nandyādigaṇapuṃgavān | nandībhamukhasenānīmukhā yuddhaviśāradāḥ ||7 2 || avaterurgaṇāḥ sarve kailāsāt krodhasaṃbhṛtāḥ | koṭiśaste gaṇāścaiva koṭiśo daityapuṃgavāḥ ||7 3 || kurvanto raṇaśabdām̐śca kailāsopatyakāsu vai | garjanto bhairavaṃ vīrāḥ pramatheśāśca dānavāḥ || 74|| śaktitomarabāṇaughairmusalaiḥ pāśapaṭṭiśaiḥ | vyarājanta triśūlāstravajramudgaraśastrakaiḥ ||75 || bherīmṛdaṃgaśaṃkhoghairniḥsvānairvīraharṣaṇaiḥ | gajāśvarathaśabdaiśca nāditā bhūrvyakampata ||76 || senayorubhayostatrābhavan śabdā bhayaṃkarāḥ | garjanayā samaṃ parasparaṃ hananamulbaṇam || 77|| prāvartata tadā lakṣmi nāśanaṃ cātidāruṇam | hatā nāgā hatāścāśvā hatā vīrāḥ sahasraśaḥ ||78 || pramathāhatadaityaughā daityāhatagaṇāstathā | mahānidrāṃgatāstaiśca bhūrvyarājata saṃvṛtā || 79 || vasāsṛṅmāṃsapaṃkāḍhyā bhūragamyābhavattadā | daityānajīvayacchukro mṛtasaṃjīvanībalāt || 1.327.80 || gaṇā mṛtā nottiṣṭhanti bhayaṃkaramidaṃ mahat | śaśaṃsuśca gaṇāstasmai śaṃkarāya vināśanam ||8 1 || śukrasya ceṣṭitaṃ sarvaṃ jñātvā tu cukradhe haraḥ | tanmukhāt krodhatāmrākṣo kṛtyā babhūva bhīṣaṇā || 8 2|| tālajaṃghā darīvaktrā tāḍāṃgulī giristanī | āsasāda raṇabhūmiṃ vicacārāsureṣu sā || 83 || bhakṣayamāṇā tāndaityān jagāma bhārgavo yataḥ | śukrācāryaṃ gale dhṛtvā yonimadhye’kṣipaddhi sā ||84|| svabhage dhṛtvā jagāmāntarhitā nabhaḥ | daityāḥ pramlānavadanā dṛṣṭvaitacchukranāśanam|| 85 || vinirjagmuryuddhabhūmeḥ prāṇarakṣāparāyaṇāḥ | abhajyata mahāsainyaṃ gaṇaiḥ santāḍitaṃ tadā ||86|| śuṃbho niśuṃbhanāmā ca kālanemiśca te trayaḥ | yuddhaṃ carantaḥ pramathapṛtanāṃ jaghnuraiśvarīm ||87|| muñcantaḥ śaravarṣāṇi gaṇasenāmakampayan | rurudhuśca gaṇāścāpi daityān mārgaṇavṛṣṭibhiḥ ||88|| vasantakiṃśukābhāsā jātā gaṇāśca dānavāḥ | atha dānavasainyaṃ tad vyomāśrayaṃ samācarat ||89|| rurodha gaṇasainyaṃ tad vyomavṛṣṭyātighorayā | tadā pramathasainyaṃ saṃbhagnaṃ dudrāva gahvaram || 1.327.90 || dṛṣṭvā caitad vaiparītyaṃ nandībhamukhaṣaṇmukhāḥ | anyegaṇāścātibalā ākāśamavalambya ca ||9 1 || sainyānyākāśamālambya nītvā pāṣāṇapuṃgavān | āmarṣādabhyadhāvanta saṃhartuṃ daityapuṃgavān ||92||| utplutya cotplutya vijaghnuraiśvarā jālaṃdharārakṣitadaityapuṃgavān | pāṣāṇaśastreratibhagnamastakā nipetururvyāmapare tu dudruvuḥ ||93|| evamāsurasainyaṃ tadbhagnaṃ vyoma vihāya ca | kailāsāraṇyamāśritya pracchannaṃ samabhūt kṣaṇam ||94|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jālaṃdharavṛndākhyāne jālaṃdhareṇa rāhurdūtaḥ śaṃkaraṃ pratipreṣitaḥ sa kīrtimukhena vidrāvitaḥ tato jalandharasainyamāgatam śukrācāryaḥ kṛtyayā yonau nikṣiptaḥ ghoraṃ yuddhamabhūccetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 327 ||
<1.328> śrīlakṣmīruvāca kṛtyāyonau nihitasya śukrācāryasya vai tataḥ | kimabhūt tatra yuddhaṃ ca kīdṛśaṃ ceti me vada || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca yāvajjālaṃdharanāśo bhavet tāvattu kṛtyayā | svayonau marditaḥ śukro nirgantuṃ nāśakat tadā || 2 || yogamantrabalenāyaṃ mumurṣurapi saṃyamāt | kathaṃcijjīvanaṃ dhṛtvā prasuptastatra mūrchitaḥ || 3 || jālaṃdhare vinaṣṭe ca kṛtyayā mūtrito bahiḥ | mūrchitaścirakālānte jāgaraṃ sa ca labdhavān || 4 || atha prāsaṃgikaṃ yuddhaṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi parasparam | dvandvātmakaṃ tato jātaṃ mahatormahatorati || 5 || abhyadhāvata nandyākhyaṃ kālanemirmahāsuraḥ | śuṃbho lambodaraṃ cāpi niśuṃbhastu ṣaḍānanam || 6 || niśuṃbhaḥ pañcabhirbāṇairvivyādha śikhinaṃ hṛdi | kārtikeyastato bāṇaiḥ pañcabhistvatisūlbaṇaiḥ || 7 || vivyādha vājinastasya sārathiṃ dhvajameva ca | śareṇaikena tīkṣṇena niśuṃbhaṃ prajaghāna ha || 8 || jagarja ca niśuṃbho’pi garjantaṃ tu ṣaḍānanam | jaghāna bahubhirbāṇaivivyādha varma dhāritam || 9 || kārtikeyastadā kraddhaḥ śaktiṃ jagrāha pāṇinā | prasahya balavān vegāt prāhiṇot prāṇaghātinīm || 1.328.10 || niśuṃbho’pi samayajñaḥ svaśaktyā tāṃ vyapātayat | tāvat skando dvitīyāṃ tāṃ tadā prāṇāntakāriṇīm || 11 || prāhiṇīdativegāt sā hṛllagnā tamapātayat | atha nandīśvarastatra kālānemiṃ mahāsuram || 12 || avidhyata śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ pañcabhiḥ saptabhistathā | caturbhiśca hayān dvābhyāṃ ketuṃ caikena sārathim || 13 || kālanemistato bāṇairdhanuściccheda nandinaḥ | śilīmukhaistathā nandīśvaraṃ vivyādha mastake || 14|| nandīśo’pi triśūlena jaghāna hṛdi kālakam | kālako hatasarvasvaḥ śūlabhinnahṛdantaraḥ || 15|| utpāṭya śikharaṃ cādrernandinaṃ samatāḍayat | nandiḥ śaktiṃ samādāya jaghāna kālavakṣasi || 1 6|| kālaḥ papāta mūrchāyāṃ hastapādau prasārya vai | atha hastyānanaḥ śubha vivyādha hṛdi patriṇā || 17|| aśvān vivyādhāṣṭabhiścaikena vivyādha sārathim | śubhastadātivegādvai bāṇenaikena mūṣakam || 18 || vivyādha mastake cūcū kṛtvā hyālurapāsarat | gaṇeśastaṃ parityajya padātirgaṇanāyakaḥ || 19 || śaktyā vivyādha śubha ca pṛthvyāmapātayat tadā | atha mūrchā vihāyaiva kālanemirniśubhakaḥ || 1.328.20 || ubhau gaṇeśaṃ hantu 3 samājagmaturulbaṇau | gṛhītvā pātayāmāsatuśca vivyadhatuḥ śaraiḥ ||2 1 || taṃ pīḍitamavālokya vīrabhadro’bhyadhāvata | jagrāha dvau kukṣayośca mardayāmāsa vai muhuḥ || 22 || prakṣiptau pṛthvyāṃ tau dvau mṛtaprāyau mahāsurau | kūṣmāṇḍā bhairavāstāvat pretā bhūtāḥ piśācakāḥ || 23 || vināyakāśca vetālā vīrāḥ pakṣāśca rākṣasāḥ | yoginyaḥ kṛtyakā ḍākinyaśca sainyāni saṃyayuḥ ||24|| tataḥ kilakilāśabdaḥ siṃhanādāḥ saghargharāḥ | ḍamarūjapraṇādāścākampayan pṛthivīṃ tadā ||25 || bhakṣayanti dānavām̐śca mārayanti triśūlakaiḥ | chedayanti galām̐steṣāṃ mardayanti mahāsurān ||26 || jaghnurdaityāndānavām̐śca śikharaiḥ parvatopamaiḥ | hastibhirvājibhiścaiva rathaiḥ śastrīkṛtaistadā |||27|| dānavaiścāpi daityaiśca śastrīkṛtairjaḍājaḍaiḥ | padbhyāṃ padbhyāṃ pragṛhyaiva tāḍayanti sma tām̐śca taiḥ ||28|| evaṃ bhūtādisenābhiḥ kṛtaṃ vai kadanaṃ mahat | ye yoddhāro’bhavandaityādayaste śastratāṃ gatāḥ ||22 || taireva śastratāṃ prāptairnaṣṭāḥ svasainyapuṃgavāḥ | yatra bhūtā rākṣasāśca vetālāśca vināyakāḥ ||1.328.3 0 || yoddhārastatra kiṃkiṃ na saṃbhāvyate ghaṭāghaṭam | jalaṃdharasya tatsainyaṃ chinnaṃ bhinnaṃ vināśitam ||3 1 || marditaṃ nāśitaṃ cāpi cūrṇitaṃ śakalīkṛtam | nāvaśiṣṭo yadā tatra dṛśyate’suradānavaḥ || 32|| tadātikhedamāpannaścāśrūṇi vyāsṛjanmuhuḥ | jalaṃdharo mahāvīraḥ śukranāśātiśokavān || 33|| ujjīvakasya nāśena sarvaṃ naṣṭaṃ mamādya vai | mayāpi cātra martavyaṃ kṛtvā yuddhaparākramam ||34|| iti niścitya sahasā kṛtyāṃ jagrāha pādayoḥ | vidāraṇāya tāvatsāmuñcacchukraṃ svamūtragam || 35|| rathe nikṣipya sa tatra viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ yadā | tāvacchukraḥ samavāpa saṃjñāṃ tato’tha vidyayā || 36 || saṃjīvinyā punardaityānutthāpayan jagarja ca | tāvadvai vīrabhadrastaṃ śukrācāryaṃ jalaṃdharam || 37|| rathaṃ sarvaṃ samānīya gahvaraṃ praviveśa ha | śukrācāryaṃ tu kṛtyābhyo datvā nītvā jalaṃdharam || 38|| ānīnāya harasyāgre vīrabhadro jagarja ha | tāvajjalaṃdharo rūpāṇyanekāni vidhāya tu || 39|| mūlarūpeṇa tatsthānādapāsaranmṛterbhiyā | bhūtapretapiśācaiśca kūṣmāṇḍairgaṇanāyakaiḥ ||1.328.40 || chinnā bhinnā hatā daityā ye tu śukreṇa jīvitāḥ | pravidhvastāṃ tataḥ senāṃ dṛṣṭvā jalaṃdharastadā ||41 || rathenātipatākena gaṇānabhiyayau punaḥ | meghavadbāṇavṛṣṭiṃ sa mumoca śivasainyake ||42 || jalaṃdharaśarameghaiśchannaṃ vyomābhavattadā | śailādiḥ pañcabhirviddho gaṇeśaḥ pañcasāyakaiḥ || 43 || vīrabhadraśca viṃśatyā kārtikeyastu saptabhiḥ | viddhastena tu daityena kārtikeyo’pi satvaram || 44 || śaktyā vivyādha taṃ vīraṃ pātayāmāsa bhūtale | jalaṃdharastataḥ kṣaṇāt samutthāya ruṣā jvalan || 45 || gadayā tāḍayāmāsa kārtikeyamapothayat | vīrabhadrastadā śaktyā pothayāmāsa vārdhijam ||46 || jalaṃdharaḥ samutthāya pupluve parighāyudhaḥ | abhidhāvandrutaṃ gatvā vīrabhadraṃ jaghāna saḥ ||47 || vīrabhadraḥ papātorvyāṃ jalaṃdharo jagarja ha | kolāhalo mahānāsīt bhūtānāṃ rudrasannidhau ||48 || śrutvā raudro mahārudro’bhyagāt saṃgrāmamāhasan | daityā hi bhīṣaṇaṃ rudraṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve vidudruvuḥ ||49 || jalaṃdharastadā daityo mṛtyarthaṃ kṛtaniścayaḥ | abhyadhāvat sa caṇḍīśaṃ muñcan bāṇān sahasraśaḥ ||1.328.5 0 || ye tu śukreṇa punarujjīvitā daityapuṃgavāḥ | hatāvaśeṣāste cānye’bhyadhāvan śaṃkaraṃ prati ||5 1 || śuṃbhaniśuṃbhaghasmarakālanemibalāhakāḥ | pracaṇḍakhaḍgaromāṇau roṣātsaṃdṛṣṭadacchadāḥ ||52 || bāṇaiḥ saṃchodayāmāsū rudraṃ rudragaṇām̐śca te | bāṇāndhakārasaṃchannamabhavadvyoma sarvataḥ ||5 3 || harastajjālamācchidya bāṇairāvavṛte nabhaḥ | khaḍgaromaśiraḥ kāyādacchinacchaṃkarastadā || 54|| balāhakaṃ mārayitvā ghasmaraṃ cāpyamārayat | mahāvīraṃ pracaṇḍaṃ ca cakarta triśikhena saḥ ||55 || evaṃ vai bahavastatra hatāḥ punarna cotthitāḥ | jaladharaṃ mahāśaktiṃ prāhiṇocchaṃkaraḥ svayam || 56 || sa rūpāntaramāsthāya vyalīyatāmbare kṣaṇam | śaktiḥ sā niṣphalā pṛthvyāmanyāndaityān vyapothayat || 57 || tadā śeṣā mahādaityā bhayāt pradudruvuḥ raṇāt | jalaṃdharastu tānvīkṣya provāca dhigvadan punaḥ ||58 || kiṃ yuṣmābhirmātṛdugdhapānakṛdbhiḥ palāyitaiḥ | pṛṣṭhataśca hataiḥ kiṃ vai svargo mokṣo na vāpyate ||59 || raṇamṛtyuḥ praśūrāṇāṃ svargado mokṣado’pi ca | ābhimukhye’stu nidhanaṃ śastrairamṛtadāyakaiḥ ||1.328.60 || mā vaimukhye mṛtyurastu yo dadennārakīṃ gatim | sūryasya maṇḍalaṃ bhittvā yāyād raṇī paraṃ padam || 61 || parivrāṭ sa mahāyogī yo raṇe sammukhe hataḥ | anivāryasya vai mṛtyorbhayaṃ kāryaṃ na vai budhaiḥ || 62 || utpattyā saha dehasya mṛtyurlagno’sti vai dhruvaḥ | tanmṛtyorbhayamutsṛtya yudhyadhvaṃ samare’surāḥ ||6 3 || ityuktvā api daityāste bhītā vai śaṃkarāttadā | nāyayūraṇasaṃgrāme cukrodhāti jalaṃdharaḥ || 64|| provāca śaṃkaraṃ yatte balaṃ tad darśayātra mām | ityuktvā bāṇasaptapyā jaghāna janakaṃ haram || 65 || tānaprāptān mahādevo cicched niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ | athābhyadhāvajjaladhṛggadāṃ cikṣepa śaṃkare || 66|| śivaḥ śaktyā tu tāṃ dvedhā hyakarod vyomamārgagām | tato daityo haraṃ muṣṭyā hantumabhyudyayau tadā || 67|| śaṃkareṇa triśūlena yojane sa vipothitaḥ | atha jalaṃdharo matvā rudraṃ bahubalāśrayam || 68 || māyāṃ sasarja gandharvāpsarasāṃ rudramohinīm | āvirbhūya ca gandharvā jaguḥ śrutimanoharam || 69 || apsaraso nanṛtuśca miṣṭasvarapragītibhiḥ | tālaveṇumṛdaṃgām̐śca vādayanti sma cāparāḥ || 1.328.70 || tatra śaṃbhostathā tasya gaṇānāṃ mohamāsa ha | yuddhaṃ vismṛtya śuśruvustallīnāḥ śaṃbhuśāṃkarāḥ ||7 1 || daityo līnān vīkṣya śuṃbhādīnavasthāpya tadraṇe | kāmavyāpto jagāmāśu yatra gaurī gṛhe’bhavat ||72|| daśahastaśca pañcāsyastrinetraśca jaṭādharaḥ | rudrākṣavāsukiśūlacarmāmbarādibhūṣitaḥ || 73 || āsuryā māyayā rudro bhūtvā gṛhāntaraṃ yayau | āyāntaṃ rudramālokya pārvatī bhavavallabhā ||74|| suratecchuṃ ca taṃ jñātvā gṛhe paryaṃkagābhavat | sūryacandrāgnikanakavidyudvat sūjjvalāṃ satīm || 76 || yāvad dadarśa tāvatsa vīryaṃ srāvitavān jaḍaḥ | pārvatī tādṛśaṃ vīkṣya vicārayati cāntare ||76 || nāyaṃ vai spṛṣṭavān māṃ tu na vā paryaṃkamāgataḥ | na māṃ dadarśa nagnāṃ vā kathaṃ vīryamamuñcata ||7 7 || tasmānnāyaṃ mahādevaḥ kintvanyo dānavo bhavet | stanyabindulavo jātaḥ kiṃ vāyaṃ śāṃkaro bhavet ||78 || iti vicārya sahasrā bhītevādṛśyatāṃ gatā | tāmadṛṣṭvā naṣṭavīryo’gād yoddhuṃ śaṃbhunā saha || 79 || pārvatyapi mahāviṣṇuṃ sasmāra manasā muhuḥ | kṛṣṇastatra samāyātaḥ pārvatyuvāca keśavam ||1.328.8 0 || viṣṇo jalaṃdharo rudro bhūtvāyāto’tra madgṛhe | kāmāturo vañcayituṃ tat kiṃ na viditaṃ tava ||81|| viṣṇuḥ prāha viditaṃ me kuryāmājñāpayātra tat | pārvatī prāha lakṣmīśa tādṛśāya tu tādṛśam ||82|| tenaiva darśitaṃ kṛtyaṃ kuru tasmin tathaiva hi | vṛndāsatītvadharmaṃ tvaṃ vināśaya madājñayā ||83|| anyathā sa mahādaityo mariṣyati na tadbalāt | pātivratyaṃ mahāndharmaḥ rakṣākṛnmokṣadastathā ||84|| goloke sā tathaivāsīt tadbhoge tvaṃ na doṣabhāg | sarve jīvāstava patnyaḥ kimatra tvatkṛte prabho ||85|| iti lakṣmi svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ śrutvā haraṃ nivedya ca | jalaṃdharavināśārthaṃ chalaṃ kartuṃ yayau prabhuḥ ||86|| yatra jālandhare dvīpe pure vṛndā pratiṣṭhati | patiṃ pratīkṣate yuddhe jayinaṃ darśanāturā ||87|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jalaṃdharavṛndākhyāne senāpatīnāṃ yuddhe mṛtyuḥ śukrācāryakṛtajīvanaṃ śukrācāryasya kṛtyāyonau nikṣepaḥ tato daityānāṃ nāśaḥ dvandvātmakajalaṃdharavīrabhadrayuddhaṃ jalaṃdharaśaṃkarayuddhaṃ gāndharvīmāyāmutpādya jalaṃdharo rudrarūpeṇa pārvatīṃ chalayituṃ jagāma viṣṇurvṛndāṃ chalayituṃ jagāmetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||328||
<1.329> śrīlakṣmīruvāca viṣṇo nārāyaṇa kṛṣṇa viṣṇunā kiṃ kṛtaṃ tataḥ | vṛndāyāśchalanārthāya kathaṃ jālandharo mṛtaḥ || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca jālaṃdharabalaṃ lakṣmi vṛndāsvāmivrate’bhavat | vṛndāyāḥ pātivratyasya bhaṃgāya viṣṇurācarat || 2 || viṣṇustatra gato rātrau samudyānakṛtāśrayaḥ | vṛndāṃ sa darśayāmāsa svapnaṃ vaidhavyasūcakam || 3 || jālaṃdharaśiraḥ puṃsā kartitaṃ śaṃkareṇa vai | gṛdhreṇākṛṣṭanayanaṃ chinnakarṇāgranāsikam || 4 || prayāntaṃ mahiṣārūḍhaṃ tailābhyaktaṃ digambaram | kṛṣṇapuṣpābhūṣaṇāḍhyaṃ kravyādagaṇasevitam || 5 || muktakeśī ālāsyā kṛṣṇavarṇāruṇāmbarā | kālī cakhāda kaṇṭhādho muṇḍaṃ gataṃ tu dakṣiṇām || 6 || svapuraṃ sāgare magnaṃ sahasaivātmanā saha | daityakṣayaguṇopetaṃ vṛndā svapnaṃ dadarśa ha || 7 || tataḥ prabuddhā vṛndā viprebhyaḥ svapnaṃ nyavedayat | śrutvā tu brāhmaṇāḥ prāhuratyugraṃ svapnameva tat || 8 || acintyaphaladaṃ tadvai sarvāniṣṭakaraṃ mahat | dehi dānaṃ dvijātibhyo hyacintyabhayanāśakam || 9 || dhenūrvāsāṃsi ratnāni gajām̐ścābharaṇāni ca | tayā dānāni dattāni hyaniṣṭaśāntidāni vai || 1.329.10 || athāpi dakṣiṇāṃgānāṃ sphuraṇānyabhavam̐stadā | dadarśoditamādityaṃ sacchidraṃ niṣprabhaṃ tathā || 11 || tadapyaniṣṭaṃ vijñāya śokasāgaramajjitā | kutracinnāpa sā śarma bhavanāṭṭālabhūmiṣu || 12 || viṣṇunā māyayākṛṣṭā jagāmodyānamāturā | sakhīdvayayutā tatra na prāpa kutracitsukham || 13 || vanādvanāntaraṃ bhramamāṇā dadarśa bhīṣaṇau | rākṣasau siṃhavadanau preritau viṣṇunā nijau || 14|| sevakau māyayā klṛptau dṛṣṭvā sātīva vihvalā | palāyanaparā rakṣākartāraṃ prati dhāvati || 15 || yāvat| tatra vane dṛṣṭo munirviṣṇukṛtastadā | rakṣakaṃ taṃ tu sā matvāsādya taccharaṇaṃ tadā || 16 || tatkaṇṭhaṃ bāhubhyāṃ dhṛtvā rakṣa rakṣetyuvāca tam | muninā svabalenāpi huṃkāreṇa ca tāvubhau || 17|| vidrāvitau rākṣasau ca rakṣitā tadbhayāt satī | atha vṛndā svasthacittā natvā vacanamabravīt || 18|| ārtinivāraka sādho rakṣitā khalajādbhayāt | jānāsi ced vada vipra jalandharaḥ patirmama || 19 || yuddhāya vai gato rudraṃ prati tasyādhunāsti kā | daśā sthitistathā svāsthyaṃ jayo vānyad vadātra me || 1.329.20 || muniḥ prāha bharadvājātmajo’haṃ prabravīmi te | mahānidrā daśā punaranutthānā sthitistava || 21 || patyuḥ svargagataṃ svāsthyaṃ jayaḥ paratra vai gataḥ | ityākarṇya mahāghoraṃ ruroda cātivihvalā || 22|| tāvat kapīśāvāyātau vṛndāyā agrataḥ sthitau | tasyaiva kaṃ kabandhaṃ ca gṛhītvā karayorubhau || 23 || etad dṛṣṭvā punarvṛndā rurodātīva susvanā | jalaṃdharaṃ mṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā hyākrandat kurarīva sā || 24|| aho bhagnaṃ mama daivaṃ sarvaṃ naṣṭaṃ dhanaṃ mama | yāhaṃ vaidhavyamāpannā māṃgalyaṃ vai gataṃ mama ||25|| śaṃbhunā naiva yoddhavyaṃ gamane prārthitaṃ mayā | tathāpi vīrabhāvatvāt tvayā nātha mataṃ na me ||26||| mayādyāpi ca martavyaṃ tava dehena vīraka | iti kṛtvā yadā vṛndā dagdhumicchati tacchavam ||27|| svotpāditānalenaiva tāvatsa munipuṃgavaḥ | dhairyaṃ pradāya kṛpayā tāmāha jīvayāmi tam ||28|| ityuktvā sa munirviṣṇurjīvayitvā tu tatpatim | māyāśavaṃ sajīvaṃ vai svātmakaṃ taṃ jalaṃdharam ||29|| racayitvā kārayitvā darśayitvā tataḥ sa hi | mahotsavaṃ vane tatra cakāra jīvakāraṇāt ||1.329.30 || vṛndāpi nijabhartāraṃ jīvitaṃ prāpya tatkṣaṇam | jahau śokaṃ samāliṃgya pracucumba tadānanam ||3 1 || reme tatraiva kāmena śayyāyāṃ vai punaḥ punaḥ | māyājālaṃdharo viṣṇuravarṇayad raṇāṃgaṇam || 32|| priye rudreṇa raudreṇa cchinnaṃ cakreṇa me śiraḥ | tava dūtena tacchīghramānītaṃ tava sannidhau ||33|| muninānena mantreṇa jīvitaṃ te satītvataḥ | gṛhāṇa devi tāmbūlaṃ surate rama kauśalam ||34|| ityuktvā ca mahāviṣṇuḥ reme muhurmuhustayā | vṛndāṃgasvedato bhūmyāṃ prādurbhūtātipāvanī ||35|| vṛndā sā tulasī proktā vṛndāvanaṃ ca tatsthalam | jālaṃdharasya ca pīṭhaṃ rājyaṃ jālaṃdharātmakam || 36|| evaṃ tatra prasiddhaṃ vai samabhūt prāk samudraje | atra viṣṇurvṛndayā vai reme’tisuratakriyām ||37|| satīpativratādharmabhaṃgena svāminastataḥ | jalaṃdharasya tejaśca balaṃ ca kṣīṇatāṃ yathā ||38|| yathā prayāti ramate tathā tathā tu tatra vai | jalaṃdharo bhavatyeva kṣīṇaḥ pratikṣaṇaṃ priye ||39|| yuddhaṃ pañcadinānyeva tato’pyabhūd bhayaṃkaram | viṣṇuścodyānabhavane bhuṃkte vṛndāṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||1.329.40|| garuḍaṃ guptarūpeṇa saṃpreṣayatyaharniśam | jalaṃdharo mṛto na vā vijñātuṃ keśavo hariḥ ||41|| pañcame tu dine kṛtvā surataṃ śayane yadā | nidrāṃ gatābhavad vṛndā garuḍastāvadāyayau ||42|| gṛhāntare gato viṣṇuścaturbhujo’bhavad yataḥ | garuḍaḥ sarvavṛttāntaṃ viṣṇave ca nyavedayat ||43|| nādyayāvanmṛto daityo mumurṣurasti mā ciram | adya śvo vā paraśvo vā mariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||44|| ityādyuktvā garuḍaśca yāvad yāti bahirgṛhāt | tāvattu vṛndayā dṛṣṭaḥ śīghraṃ sotthāya śaṃkayā ||45|| paśyatyantargṛhe tāvad dṛṣṭo viṣṇuścaturbhujaḥ | ko’yaṃ ko’yaṃ pumānanyo madgṛhāntaḥ samāgataḥ ||46|| ityākruśya svapatiṃ sā yāvanmārgayati gṛhe | tāvad viṣṇustadā jālaṃdharo bhūtvā samāgataḥ ||47|| vada vṛnde kathaṃ ko’tra kvāstītyuktvāpi keśavaḥ | ajānanniva saṃjāto na kaścinmilitastadā ||48|| vṛndā śaṃkānvitā jātā punarevaṃ dināntare | mṛṣā suptā suratānte kimityavagamāya sā ||49|| tāvattatra samāyāto garuḍastaṃ ca mādhavaḥ | bhūtvā caturbhujaḥ prāpto gṛhāntaraṃ tu tāvatā ||1.329.50 || tāvattayā hyayaṃ viṣṇuriti dṛṣṭastu niścitaḥ | sā nirbhartsya ruṣā yuktā viṣṇuṃ vacanamabravīt ||51 || dhigastu te paradārābhimarśin kapaṭākṛte | dharmaputro harirbhūtvā hyadharmaṃ kṛtavān svayam ||52|| phalaṃ bhuṃkṣva dadāmyatra śāpaṃ te tvaṃ tathā bhava | yau tvayā māyayā cātra darśitau rākṣasau mama ||53|| tāveva tava bhāryāṃ ca hariṣyato hi rākṣasau | tvaṃ cāpi bhāryāduḥkhārto vane kapisahāyavān ||54|| bhramānena ca sarpeṇa saha yaste’tra sevakaḥ | iti śaptastayā viṣṇurjagāmādṛśyatāṃ kṣaṇāt ||55|| vṛndā prāha sakhīṃ paśya jihmaṃ tadviṣṇunā kṛtam | pātivratyaṃ gataṃ me ca kāntaḥ sandehatāṃ gataḥ ||56|| ityuktvā snānamakarot pārśvasarovarāmbunā | tīre padmāsanaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā nirviṣayaṃ manaḥ ||57|| śuṣkakāṣṭhacayaṃ kṛtvā tatra vṛndā svayaṃ tadā | cintayānā viṣṇuśāṭhyaṃ prāviśaddhavyavāhanam ||58|| prajajvāla tadā vṛndā bhasmarūpābhavat kṣaṇāt | tacca bhasma tatra jātaṃ śyāmalaṃ tulasīvanam ||59|| vṛndāsvedastu saṃjātaṃ haritaṃ tulasīvanam | tulasyudvāhavidhinā hariṃ prāpa patiṃ punaḥ ||1.329.60|| viṣṇuṃ sā dhyāyamānā vai līneti viṣṇutanmayā | viṣṇostu vāñcchayā viṣṇuṃ punaḥ prāptā tu tulasī ||6 1 || vṛkṣarūpāpi sā devī viṣṇunā svīkṛtā sadā | goloke yā svakīyāsīt catra svarṇāpsaraḥsutā ||62|| kālanemigṛhe putrī jātā viṣṇupriyā tu sā | rādhāsāpatnadoṣeṇa jalaṃdharapriyābhavat ||6 3 || punarviṣṇuṃ samāliṅgya viṣṇupriyā hyajāyata | vṛndā tejastadā tatra viṣṇuśaktau vyalīyata ||64|| vṛndā tulasī sā vṛkṣarūpā pṛthvyāṃ hyajāyata | ante vai yādṛśī vṛttirgatiścāpi ca tādṛśī ||65 || iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi vṛndādharmapratāraṇam | jalaṃdharavināśāya viṣṇunācaritaṃ tadā ||66 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jalaṃdharavṛndākhyāne vṛndāyā viṣṇupradarśitāśubhasvapnam sūryodayādāvapaśakunāni udyāne kṛtrimarākṣasābhyāṃ bhītāyā vṛndāyā sādhurūpeṇa viṣṇunā rakṣaṇam kṛtrimajālaṃdhararūpasya mṛtasya kṛtrimamunirūpeṇa samujjīvanam kṛtrimajālaṃdharabhūtena viṣṇunā vṛndāyāṃ ratikaraṇam vṛndāsvedād vṛndāvṛkṣaḥ tato jñātvā vṛndāyāścitāpraveśena bhasmanaḥ tulasīrūpatā viṣṇoḥ rākṣasābhyāṃ hṛtastrīnimittaṃ duḥkhitvaśāpaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonatriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 329||
<1.330> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tato dūto gatvā śīghraṃ jalaṃdharam | uvāca vṛndājvalanaṃ śrutvā ruroda vārdhijaḥ || 1 || yena yat kriyate karma tathā tenaiva bhujyate | mayā tu vañcitā gaurī hariṇā vañcitā vadhūḥ || 2 || svasṛpatiṃ gṛhe naiva sthāpayetsarvathā janaḥ | dhanadārādikaṃ sarvaṃ sa gṛhṇāti śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 3 || gṛhe sthitasya jāmāturviśvasennaiva buddhimān | nūnaṃ tasmai pradatvā ca kanyakāṃ visṛjed budhaḥ || 4 || māyāmāśritya me patnī viṣṇunā vañcitā dhruvam | kiṃ prayāmi hariṃ jetumathavā haramulbaṇam || 5 || yadi yāmi hariṃ jetuṃ haraḥ pṛṣṭhe haniṣyati | upasthitaṃ parityajyānyānugo vai vinaśyati || 6 || ubhau me subalau śatrū jayaḥ sandigdhatāṃ gataḥ | ardhaḥ parājitaścāhaṃ yā patnī bhasmatāṃ gatā || 7 || tasmāt paśupatiṃ jitvā paścād viṣṇuṃ prayāmi vai | śaṃbhuṃ jitvā bhaviṣyāmi loke sarveśvareśvaraḥ || 8 || athavā śivanārācairmṛto yāsyāmi tatpadam | iti vicārya tatraiva yayau yoddhuṃ pinākinā || 9 || raṇe jālaṃdharo’paśyat kabandhacayabhīṣaṇam | śavaruciramāṃsaughamajjamedo’sthidurgamam || 1.330.10 || raṇe vilokayāmāsa vṛṣasthaṃ pārvatīpatim | bāṇām̐stīkṣṇānatisthūlām̐llohastaṃbhām̐stathā bahūn || 11 || mumoca yudhi durdharṣo varṣanmegha ivāgame | tato rudreṇa raudraiśca śaraughaistāḍito ruṣā || 12|| rudrabāṇaistadā tasya kavacaṃ bhuvi pātitam | śarīraṃ kīlitaṃ bāṇaiḥ kiṃśukavarṇatāṃ gataḥ || 13 || rudhiraṃ bahu susrāva jālaṃdharaśarīrataḥ | devāstu sabalā jātā dānavāstu cakampire || 14|| harastīkṣṇaśareṇāśu vivyādha hṛdi sindhujam | papāta śarabhinnāṃgo mūrchitaḥ sindhujo’bhavat || 15|| tāvad rudreṇa nārācairhatā jālaṃdharī camūḥ | jalaṃdharastu manasā śukraṃ sasmāra cātyati || 16 || sa tu kṛtyāvaśe cādrigahvare paratantrakaḥ | āgantuṃ nāśakattatra raṇo yatra pravartate || 17|| jalaṃdharaḥ śanairmūrchāṃ parityajyotthito’bhavat | śīghraṃ māyāmayīṃ gaurīṃ vidadhe tādṛśīṃ śubhām || 18|| rathopari gatāṃ baddhāṃ sākrandāṃ pārvatīṃ śivaḥ | niśuṃbhaśuṃbhadaityaiśca vadhyamānāṃ dadarśa ha || 1 9|| gaurīṃ tathāvidhāṃ dṛṣṭvā śivo’tyudvignamānasaḥ | śithilāṃgo viṣaṇṇātmā hyavāṅmukhastadābhavat || 1.330.20 || tato jaṃladharo vegāt tribhirvivyādha sāyakaiḥ | āpuṃkhamagnaistaṃ rudraṃ śirasyurasi codare ||2 1 || tataḥ paramasaṃkruddho rudro raudravapurdharaḥ | pralayānalavad ghoro babhūva śaṃkarastadā ||22|| tāvacchuṃbho rathāttāṃ tu vyomni māyikapārvatīm | nītvā mumoca śūlāgre śūlopari papāta sā || 23 || rudatī śaṃkarasyāgre śūlaviddhā mamāra sā | māyāgaurīṃ mṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā śokamohapluto haraḥ ||24|| śaśāpa śuṃbhapramukhān gaurī yuṣmān haniṣyati | caṇḍī bhūtvā ca tān sarvān jaghāna samarāṃgaṇe || 25|| brahmā tatra samāgatyovāca śrīśaṃkaraṃ tadā | jālaṃdhareṇa racitā māyeyaṃ pārvatī hara || 26|| satyā tu pārvatī mayā viṣṇunā cāpi rakṣitā | kamalasyāntare kośe tiṣṭhati sūkṣmatāṃ gatā || 27|| yudhyasya vairinivahaṃ jahi māyāṃ tu pārvatīm | matveti brahmaṇo vākyaṃ mahāvijño maheśvaraḥ ||28|| jñātvā tāṃ dānavīṃ māyāṃ mumoca mahatīṃ śilām | babhañja kapaṭāṃ mūrtiṃ cūrṇāṃ cakāra tatkṣaṇam ||29|| atha māyāparityaktaṃ śarvamālokya sindhujaḥ | anyadāviścakārāśu bhṛśaṃ māyāmahābalam || 1.330.30 || jālaṃdharo’yutabhujo babhūvāśmadrumāyudhaḥ | rurodha samare śaṃbhuṃ kruddho’straśastravān muhuḥ || 31 || uvāca balavadvākyaṃ tiraskurvan haraṃ tadā | paśya śaṃkara kīdṛṅame balaṃ jānāsi naiva kim || 32|| ko maheśvara madbāṇairabhedyo bhuvanatraye | bālabhāvena viṣṇustu viṣṇurgṛhe’bhirakṣitaḥ || 33 || tapasā ca svayaṃ brahmā toṣito varadānadaḥ | indrāgniyamavitteśā vāyuvārīśvarādayaḥ || 34|| madadhīnīkṛtāḥ sarve vāhānyāhṛtavānaham | parvatā dharṣitāḥ sarve niruddhā līlayāpagāḥ || 35 || divaukaso vai vijitāḥ subaddhaṃ vaḍavāmukham | airāvatādayaḥ kṣiptāḥ kṣiptaścendro rathānvitaḥ || 36|| garuḍo’pi mayā baddho devyo nītā gṛhaṃ mama | māṃ na jānāsi rudra tvaṃ trailokyajayakāriṇam || 37|| iti śrutvā vijahāsa mahādevaḥ punaḥ punaḥ | jalaṃdharo jaghānāśu hasantaṃ viśikhaiḥ śivam || 38|| tataḥ śūlena nihato rudreṇorasi dānavaḥ | dānavasya mukhāttatra niḥsasāra jvaraḥ paraḥ || 39|| siṃhamukho narākāro jambho’bhyadhāvadīśvaram | īśo huṃkāramakarot tatra śarabha ābabhau ||1.330.40 || śarabheṇa hataḥ siṃho dānavo vṛṣabhaṃ tadā | balātpucche gṛhītvā ca bhrāmayāmāsa bhūtale ||41 || tatastriśūlamatyugraṃ mumoca girijāpatiḥ | hastenādāya daityastaṃ samadhāvaddharaṃ prati ||42|| tato’yutabhujo daityo babandha samare śivam | śivaḥ svasya kṛpāṇena ciccheda karakānanam ||42|| chinnahasto’pi yuyudhe tadā tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ | uvāca varadānārthaṃ daityo vavre harāttadā ||44|| śīghraṃ prayaccha me siddhiṃ mahyaṃ dehyātmanaḥ padam | tathāstviti haraḥ prāha jagrāhānalapūritam ||45|| cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ sūryakoṭitulyaparākramam | jalaṃdharavināśāya cikṣepa bhagavān haraḥ ||46|| jahāra tacchiro vegānmahadāyatalocanam | dvidhā papāta taddeho hyaṃjanādririvācalaḥ ||47|| tasya kaṇṭhāt samudbhūtā daityāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ | te hatāstena cakreṇa jālaṃdharasamā yudhi ||48 || jālaṃdharakabandhaṃ tannanarta rudhirāruṇam | medasā sindhuputrasya pūritā sakalā mahī ||49 || tasya raudreṇa raktena sampūrṇamabhavajjagat | śoṇitaṃ yatra śuṣkaṃ tajjātaṃ vai śoṇitaṃ puram ||1.330.5 0 || atha māṃsacayān brāhmī māheśvarī ca vaiṣṇavī | vārāhī caiva māhendrī kaumārī ceti yāśca yāḥ ||5 1 || yoginyastā sarvadikṣu nītvākurvan vināśitān | tasya dehādbahiryātaṃ tejo lilye hare tadā ||52|| yoginīnāṃ gaṇā jālaṃdharasyādanti māṃsakam | pibantyasṛk tenādyāpi nottiṣṭhati raṇe hataḥ ||5 3 || jalaṃdharaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā surāḥ prasannatāṃ gatāḥ | abhūvan sādhuvādām̐śca devasiddhamunīśvarāḥ ||54|| puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ prakurvāṇāḥ śivakīrtiṃ jaguḥ śubhām | devaśca nanṛtuḥ paryo’psarobhiścābhipūjitāḥ ||55|| praseduśca diśaḥ sarvā vibandhanāḥ surādayaḥ | sūryacandrajaleśādyā nirmuktāstasya bandhanāt ||56|| viṣṇunā ca hareṇāpi brahmaṇādhikṛtāḥ punaḥ | teṣāṃ ratnāni tebhyaśca pradattāni sureśvaraiḥ ||57 || kṛtyābhiḥ śukra utsṛṣṭo yayau sthānaṃ svakaṃ punaḥ | devarājyamabhūd daityanāśordhvaṃ ca pratisthalam ||58 || bubhujuryajñabhāgāṃśca devā lokeśatāṃ gatāḥ | devyaścānye surāścāpi svasvasthānaṃ sukhaṃ sthitāḥ ||59|| droṇācalaṃ samudrāśca bahirānīya jīvanīm | oṣadhiṃ prāpya devānāṃ gururbṛhaspatistadā || 1.330.60 || yatra vai pramathāḥ śaṃbhugaṇā naṣṭā yudhi sthale | tatra prayojayāmāsāsthimāṃsaśavaprabhṛtau || 61 || sarve rudragaṇā yuddhe hatāste jīvitāḥ punaḥ | niravaśeṣataḥ sarve kailāsaṃ prayayuḥ sukham ||6 2|| parvato’pi yathāsītprāk tatsthale lokahetave | sthāpito viṣṇuvāhena kāle yogyaṃ prajāyate ||6 3 || sarvo’pi bhuṃkte svaṃ karma lakṣmi tad viddhyasaṃśayam | yāvad deho’sti karmāṇi sukhaduḥkhādi vartate ||64|| itihāsamimaṃ śrutvā na duḥkhaiḥ paribhūyate | kleśā dūre bhavantyasya jātā api punaḥ punaḥ || 65 || yādṛśo yasya saṃyogo bandhanaṃ cāpi tādṛśam | vṛndāyāṃ kṛtayogena viṣṇoścāpi subandhanam || 66|| lokarītyābhavat sarvaṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi tataḥ punaḥ | vṛndayā mohito viṣṇurvṛndāyāḥ prāptaye punaḥ || 67 || vṛndāmṛtisthalaṃ naivātyajaddevādibodhitaḥ | vṛndāpi taṃ dhyāyamānā satī jātā hyataḥ khalu ||68 || viṣṇuṃ vāñchati tatraiva punarvṛndāvane punaḥ | sūkṣmarūpeṇa viṣṇorvai śarīrāttu bahirbahiḥ ||6 9 || prākaṭyaṃ yāti vijane punarviṣṇau vilīyate | viṣṇoḥ śaktistrividhā yā gaurī lakṣmīḥ ramā tathā ||1.330.7 0 || dṛśyādṛśyasvarūpiṇyo vartante yā harau sadā | tābhirdṛṣṭā haristatra vṛndayā cāti mohitaḥ || 71 || vṛndā cāpi patidhvaṃse patyantaraṃ samicchati | viṣṇunāṃgīkṛtā ceyaṃ viṣṇumādātumicchati ||72 || nirjane sā samūrtā vai bhūtvā viṣṇuṃ prasevate | viṣṇuṃ prāha tvayā yasmādaṃgīkṛtāsmi sarvathā ||73 || tasmād gṛhāṇa hastaṃ me vivāhavidhinā prabho | pūrvaṃ golokadhāmasthā paścājjalaṃdharapriyā ||74|| punastvayā kṛtā naijā tasmād vaha nijāṃ tu mām | viṣṇuḥ prāha bhava kedārasya putrī vahāmi tām ||75. || tadvai vilokitaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ gauryā lakṣmyā ramākhyayā | tatastābhiśca śaktibhirdattāni tatra vai tadā ||76 || bījāni devatābhyaśca kṣiptāni tatsthale ca taiḥ | kṣiptebhyastatra bījebhyo vṛkṣāstrayo’bhavan śubhāḥ ||77 || dhātrī ca mālatī caiva tulasī ceti te trayaḥ | gauryaṃśā sā smṛtā dhātrī lakṣmyaṃśā mālatī smṛtā ||78 || ramā vṛndā tu tulasī samabhūd vṛkṣarūpiṇī | tāśca nāryo’bhavam̐statra divyarūpadharā api ||79 || sustrīrūpivanaspatī ndṛṣṭvā viṣṇuḥ praharṣitaḥ | viṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭvā ca tulasī vṛndāpyatipraharṣitā ||1.330.8 0 || evaṃ parasparaṃ sā sa rāgeṇaiva vyalokayat | taṃ viṣṇuṃ tulasī dhātrī rāgeṇaiva vyalokayat ||8 1 || tvayā lakṣmyā tadā bījamīrṣyayaiva samarpitam | tasmāttadudbhavā nārī viṣṇāvīrṣyāyutābhavat ||82|| ataḥ barbarītyākhyāmavāpa cātigarhitām | dhātrītulasyau tadrāgād viṣṇuprītiprade sadā ||8 3 || abhavatāṃ ca te nītvā viṣṇurvaikuṇṭhamāptavān | tatraiva te vivāhyaiva viṣṇurvṛndāyuto’bhavat ||84|| kedārasya sutā bhūtvā vṛndā viṣṇumavāpa ha | vṛndayā grathitā tatra vane mālā manoharā |||85 || mandārapārijātānāṃ puṣpāṇāṃ varavarṇinī | devyo devāḥ samāyātā śubhe vṛndāvane sthale ||86|| maṇḍapaṃ kārayitvā ca yajñakuṇḍaṃ vidhāya ca | vahniṃ prajvālya tatraiva homaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ ||87|| dehaśuddhiṃ tulasyāśca kārayitvā ca maṇḍanam | vastrābharaṇabhūṣādi sugandhasnānamaṃgalam ||88 || kārayitvā tu tulasīṃ bhojayāmāsa bhāvataḥ | viṣṇuṃ śṛṃgārayitvā ca brahmādyā devakoṭayaḥ |||89 || yānavāhanayuktāśca devībhiranuyāyinaḥ | sagāyakagaṇayuktāḥ savāditraninādanāḥ || 1.330.90 || sadivyavāhanāḥ sarve yātā gauryā gṛhaṃ tu te | gaurīlakṣmīramādyāśca viṣṇuṃ pupūjurādarāt ||9 1 || lokācāraṃ vidhāyaiva maṇḍapāntarnyaveśayan | tatrānīya navāṃ vṛndāṃ kanyakāṃ yuvatīṃ tu tāḥ || 92|| homaṃ prakārayitvaiva pradakṣiṇaṃ vidhāpya ca | analaṃ taṃ namaskṛtya bṛhaspatistayordvayoḥ || 93 || kare karaṃ pradatvaiva varamālāṃ nidhāpya ca | vṛndādānaṃ kṛtavām̐śca tadā gauryādyanujñayā ||94|| jayaśabdāśca devānāṃ devīnāṃ gītamaṃgalam | puṣpavṛṣṭivṛddhivāco jātāstatrobhayoḥ kṛte || 95|| yautakāni bhojanāni pradattāni tataśca te | vṛndāvanād yayuḥ sarve svasvadeśaṃ surādayaḥ || 96|| svargyaṃ pāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ śokamohavināśanam | ākhyānametadanaghaṃ śrutvā sajjanahṛtpriyam ||97|| brāhmaṇo jñānamāpnoti kṣatriyo rājyavān bhavet | vaiśyastu sampadā yuktaḥ śrutvā śūdraḥ sukhī bhavet || 98 || hiraṇyatilavastrādyairdhenubhūmipradānakaiḥ | santoṣayed vācakaṃ tu tasmim̐stuṣṭe phalaṃ bhavet || 99|| devatāśca prasīdeyurarcite vācake gurau | annadānaṃ pradāyātha brāhmaṇādīn prapūjayet || 1.330.10 0|| jāyate vijayī nityaṃ putrapautrasamṛddhimān | iti vyājena te lakṣmi tulasyutpattikāraṇam || 101 || prakathitaṃ ca tatchrutvā labhate puṇyamuttamam | svagṛhe ropitā cāpi tulasī pāpanāśinī || 101 || darśanād brahmahatyādi naśyati nātra saṃśayaḥ | vaiśākhe kārtike māghe tulasīṃ bahu pūjayet || 102 || tulasyā pūjayed viṣṇuṃ sahasramañjarīstathā | arpayed viṣṇave prātaḥ koṭiyajñaphalaṃ bhavet||| 1 04|| yatra vṛndā ca haritā tulasī śyāmalaprabhā | jātā vṛndāvane tatra viṣṇuścātīva mohitaḥ || 105 || vāsaṃ cakāra mohaṃ ca naiva tatyāja keśavaḥ | tadā tasyātmanastisraḥ śaktayaḥ prakaṭīkṛtāḥ || 106 || mahādbhutaiḥ svatejobhirbhāsayanti digambaram | tābhirbījāni tatraiva nyastāni svāṃśatastadā || 107|| vṛndāvane tadā dhātrī mālatī tulasī tathā | abhavan vṛkṣarūpiṇyastā dṛṣṭvā tatra keśavaḥ || 108 || mumoha tasmiṃstulasī dhātrī ca rāgamāpatuḥ | dhātrī tulasyau tadrāgāt tasya prītipade sadā || 109 || tato viṣṇuśca te nītvā vaikuṇṭhamagamat punaḥ | lakṣmīścerṣyākarī tatra barbarīti viyojitā || 1.330.110 || ya idaṃ hi paṭhennityaṃ pāṭhayecchṛṇuyāttathā | sadgatiḥ svargavāsaśca mokṣastasya tathā bhavet || 111 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jālaṃdharavṛndākhyāne jālaṃdhareṇa māyayā kapaṭagaurīnāśadarśanaṃ māyayā yuddhaṃ śaṃkaracakradvārā jālaṃdharanāśaḥ vṛndāyā viṣṇuto varaṇayāñcā vṛndāyāḥ kedārarājaputrītvaṃ viṣṇunā tulasīvivāhaḥ vṛndāvane gaurīlakṣmīramāṃśā dhātrīmālatīvṛndāvṛkṣarūpāḥ lakṣmyā barbarītvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 330 ||
<1.331> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi | tulasyāstu māhātmyaṃ viṣṇusadṛśam | yacchrutvāpi bhavenmuktirviṣṇoḥ sānnidhyadāyinīm || 1 || yā tu yasya kṛte nityā sā nānyasya bhaved dhruvā | viṣṇoḥ patnī punarviṣṇuṃ prāptā vṛndā ca vṛkṣiṇī || 2 || śrīlakṣmīruvāca nanu vṛndābhavad yatra bhasmībhūtā tu tatsthale | adṛśyā sā kiyatkālaṃ sthitā viṣṇumacintayat || 3 || strījātirvāstavī śuddhā tāśca sarvāḥ pativratāḥ | sarvā jātiścaikavidhā tvādau sṛṣṭā hi vedhasā || 4 || tāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛteraṃśāḥ pavitrāḥ paṇḍitāḥ śriyaḥ | kathaṃ dharmo vināśaṃ vai gataḥ pativratātmakaḥ || 5 || viṣṇuḥ patirhi nārīṇāṃ sa ca dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ | narā viṣṇoḥ sadaṃśāśca kathaṃ dharmaḥ kṣayaṃ gataḥ || 6 || prāk sṛṣṭau prakṛtīnāṃ hi puṃsāṃ saṃsevane tadā | dharma eva paraścāsīt kathaṃ sa vai kṣayaṃ gataḥ || 7 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ divyāṃ bahusaṃśayanāśinīm | pūrvaḥ striyaḥ sadā śuddhāḥ śuddhāntaḥkaraṇāstathā || 8 || nāryā naraḥ sadā sevyaḥ sṛṣṭivṛddhyarthameva yat | eṣa dharmaḥ purā hyāsīt sanātanatamastadā || 9 || yaṃ kamapi saṃsevya garbhavatyo’bhavan yadā | tadā nāryā naramātrasevā dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 1.331.10 || nāsīdvai kāmanā tatra tṛṣṇā rāgamayī tadā | kedārakanyāśāpena sa hi dharmaḥ kṣayaṃ gataḥ || 11 || tadā kopena dhātrā ca striyo rāgānvitāḥ kṛtāḥ | tata ārabhya dharmaḥ saḥ strīṇāmanyo’bhavat kṛtaḥ || 1 1|| sarāgaḥ kāmatṛptyarthaṃ strībhiryo gamyate naraḥ | tatra rāgo hyadharmo’bhūd yugabhedena padmaje || 13 || yadi striyā na rāgo’sti puṃso’pi naiva rāgitā | garbhārthameva yogaśced dharmo bījapradānakam || 1 4|| yadi bhogecchayā yogaḥ sa tvadharmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | yugabhedena lokānāṃ rāgatṛṣṇe babhūvatuḥ || 15 || tena kāmapravṛtiścādharmarūpābhavad yataḥ | tataḥ pativratādharmo dharmābhāsamayo’bhavat || 16 || pūrvadharmo vinaṣṭaśca dharmāntaramabhūnnavam | etatsarvaṃ tu vṛndāyā nimittenāpyabhūtpurā || 17 || kathayāmi samāsena yathābhūttannibodha me | purā tu brahmaṇaḥ putro manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo’bhavat || 18 || tasya patnī śatarūpābhavat sā tu pativratā | priyavratottānapādau tayo putrau babhūvatuḥ || 19 || uttānapādaputraścābhavad dhruvastu vaiṣṇavaḥ | tatputro nandasāvaṇiḥ kedāraśceti tatsutaḥ || 1.331.20 || saptadvīpapatiścāyaṃ kedāro vaiṣṇavo’bhavat | tadrakṣārthaṃ sadā viṣṇoḥ sudarśanamabhūd gṛhe || 21 || gavāṃ lakṣaṃ svarṇaśṛgaṃ vastrāṇi vividhāni ca | suvarṇānāṃ tathā lakṣaṃ nityaṃ dāne dadāti saḥ || 22|| maṇihīrakamuktānāṃ dānaṃ karoti nityaśaḥ | lakṣaṃ lakṣaṃ dvijānāṃ sa bhojayāmāsa nityaśaḥ || 23 || jalabhojanapātrāṇi suvarṇānāṃ dadāti saḥ | yajñasūtrāṃgulīyakāsanāni svarṇajāni ca || 24|| dāne dadāti rājāsau dīnānātha dvijātaye | lakṣaviprāḥ sūpakārā dve lakṣe pariveṣakāḥ || 25 || śatalakṣaprabhoktāraḥ pratiparvāsya santi vai | ghṛtakulyā madhukulyā dadhikulyā manoharāḥ || 26|| guḍakulyā dugdhakulyā bhavantyasya divāniśam | sādhūnāṃ pūjanaṃ nityaṃ sādhvīnāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā || 27|| karoti nityasatkāraṃ vṛddhānāṃ pūjanādikam | gavāṃ surāṇāṃ viprāṇāṃ karoti nityapūjanam || 28 || phalamūlāśano rājā madarpaṇaparāyaṇaḥ | sarvaṃ madarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā gṛhṇāti padmaje sadā || 29 || māmeva nityaṃ japati smarati śrīyutaṃ ca mām | bhajate sarvadā lakṣmīnārāyaṇamamuṃ hi mām || 1.331.30 || ekadā dvādaśīprātaḥ pāraṇāyāṃ nṛpagṛhe | viprāṇāṃ bhojanāyaiva daśalakṣamupasthitam || 31 || drāgeva yajñahavanaṃ kārayitvā nṛpeṇa hi | bhojitā miṣṭavastvādyairannairvyañjanapāyasaiḥ || 32|| pūrikābhirvividhābhirdugdhādadhyādibhistathā | saddvijaistṛptimāpannairdakṣiṇāpūrṇamānasaiḥ || 33 || śubhāśiṣaḥ pradattāste lakṣmīrvasatu vai gṛhe | atha madhyāhnahome tu havanaṃ bahudhā ghṛtaiḥ || 34|| tilaiḥ phalaiḥ pāyasānnaiḥ puṣpaiḥ patraiśca kāritam | tadā viṣṇorhi kṛpayā vṛndā vṛndavanasthitā || 25 || tapasisthā tu patyarthaṃ viṣṇorarthaṃ pativratā | jaladharavināśāddhi rūpāntareṇa saṃsthitā || 36 || nārāyaṇājñayā kedārasya yajñamupasthitā | kamalā kalayā jātā yajñakuṇḍasamudbhavā || 37 || vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā | kāmukī divyaśobhāḍhyā kanyā kamalalocanā || 38 || jātamātrā yuvatī sā vṛndādeśakarī prabhoḥ | kanyāsmi te mahārājetyuvāca nṛpatiṃ hi sā || 39 || rājā saṃpūjya tāṃ putrīṃ tasthau patnīṃ samarpya ca | sāpiprasū tu tāṃ rājñīṃ kedāraṃ janakaṃ jagau ||1.331.40 || tata ārabhya lakṣmyā vai pratāpenāsya bhūpateḥ | rājendrāṇāṃ pañcalakṣaṃ nityaṃ kedārasaṃsadi ||4 1 || amūlyaratnamāṇikyaṃ muktāhāraṃ maṇīśvaram | gajaratnamaśvaratnaṃ kedārāya karaṃ dadau || 42 || evaṃ smṛddhimayaṃ rājyaṃ sāptadvīpamayaṃ hyabhūt | kanyā tu viṣṇukāmāḍhyā tapasyeva mano dadhe ||43 || prasūṃ tātaṃ namaskṛtya yayau vṛndāvanaṃ punaḥ | yamunāntikameveyaṃ yatra prāg bhasmatāṃ gatā |||44|| tapasā varayāmāsa māṃ varaṃ ca varottamam | brahmā dadau varaṃ tasyai viṣṇuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ labhiṣyasi ||45 || athaikadā yamunāyāstīre svapiti sundarī | dharmaḥ parīkṣituṃ yāto vṛndāṃ tāṃ tāpasīṃ tataḥ ||46 || dadarśa kanyā rahasi yuvānaṃ puruṣaṃ param | yathā ṣoḍaśarṣīyaṃ kāmena kanakaprabham ||47|| sugandhāḍhyaṃ sābharaṇaṃ ramaṇīnāṃ manoharam | kāmukaṃ koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ pārvaṇānanam ||48 || padmapatranibhanetraṃ sasmitaṃ bhāvapūritam | pārśvato gāyanaṃ kurvan vīṇāṃ ramyāṃ ca vādayan || 49 || yayāvitastataḥ so’pi bhāvaṃ hṛdi pradarśayan | dṛṣṭvā tatra niṣasāda sundarīṃ mānayan bahu || 1.331.50 || vṛndāpi taṃ samutthāyātithyaṃ kṛtavatī tadā | apūjayatphalairmūlaiḥ puṣpapatrairjalādibhiḥ || 51 || pūjāṃ gṛhītvā muditaḥ sasnehāṃ tāmuvāca saḥ | bhavatī kasya kanyāsi tapaścarasi dāruṇam ||52 | kimatra kāraṇaṃ kanye kiṃ te nāma vadātra me | nirjane’tra vasasyekākinī vāñchasi kiṃ śubhe || 53 || varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yatte manasi vartate | vṛndovāca tu taṃ vipraṃ kedāranṛpakanyakā || 54|| vṛndā tapaḥ karomyatra cintayāmi hariṃ patim | yadi dātuṃ samartho’si dehi me varamuttamam ||55|| asamartho’si cedvipra pūjayāmyanyataḥ sara | dharma uvāca tāṃ vṛndāṃ paramātmānamīśvaram || 56 || kā kṣamā taṃ patiṃ kartuṃ vinā lakṣmīṃ satīṃ śriyam | rādhāṃ ramāṃ pārvatīṃ ca śāradāṃ ca prabhāṃ tathā || 57 || sarasvatīṃ māṇikīṃ ca śāradāṃ virajāṃ ca vā | caturbhujaḥ sa vaikuṇṭhe goloke tu dvibāhukaḥ |||58 || akṣarākhye pare dhāmni dvibhujaḥ sa hi vartate | tasya patnyastvasaṃkhyātāḥ santi muktānya eva tāḥ || 59 || rādhālakṣmyādayaste tu bhajante’nādiyoṣitaḥ | koṭikandarpavīryādisaṃpūrṇaṃ kāntasundaram || 1.331.60 || yannimeṣo bhaved vṛnde brahmaṇaḥ patanena vai | ekordhvasaptatisatyayugaistvindrasya pātanam || 61 || caturdaśendrāvacchinnakālena brahmaṇo dinam | niśāpi tāvatī tasya śatāyuṣṭvaṃ bhavatyapi || 62 || yāvajjīvanaparyantaṃ sevante sanakādayaḥ | kalpānāṃ koṭikoṭiṃ ca tanna sādhyo’sti yanmahān || 63 || sahasravaktraśeṣaśca sevate ca japatyapi | divāniśaṃ tu taṃ bhaktyā kalpakoṭiśataṃ śatam ||64 || tathāpi naiva cāpnoti durārādhyaḥ parātparaḥ | brahmā brahmasvarūpastaṃ bhajejjanmani janmani || 65 || tenāpyasādhyo bhagavān tvayā kathamavāpyate | saṃhārakartā jagatāṃ rudro’pyantaṃ na gacchati || 66 || sa nāpnoti tadā tvaṃ vai kathamāpsyasi bālike | brahmasvarūpā paramā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī || 67 || nārāyaṇī viṣṇumāyā vaiṣṇavī sā sanātanī | sarasvatī ca yaṃ stotumaśaktā parameśvarī || 68 || kathamicchasi kalyāṇi prakṛteḥ pāragaṃ patim | māṃ bhajasva mahābhāge nṛpāṇāmīśvaraṃ patim || 69 || bhuṃkṣva sukhāni sarvāṇi madgṛhe varavarṇini | saptasāgarapāre tu kāñcanī nagarī mama |||1.331.7 0 || tatraivāgaccha bhadraṃ te rama rāme mayā saha | ehyake mama saṃbhoktuṃ māṃ yuvānaṃ manaḥ kuru || 71 || ityuktā sā nṛpasutā kopāddharmyamuvāca tam | dhairyaṃ kuru kṣitisvāmin tapaḥ satyaṃ ca te vratam ||72|| apatnīsahayogastu tvadarthe’dharma ityayam | tenābhadraṃ bhavet| tādṛk samūlasya vināśakam ||73 || taponāśo bhavenme’tra tava nāśo bhavettathā | rahasyaṃ cāpadaṃ dṛṣṭvā māṃ tvaṃ dharṣitumicchasi ||74|| kintvatra lokapālāśca dharmo yamo hariḥ śaśī | sūryaḥ pṛthvī jalaṃ vahnirbuddhiḥ sākṣī tathāpare ||75|| sarvaprāṇiṣu tiṣṭhanti kva guptaṃ kva rahasyakam | kṣamasva gaccha bhadraṃ te hyavadhyo brāhmaṇo mataḥ ||76 || śaktāhaṃ bhasmasāt kartuṃ gaccha vipra yathāsukham | sarvāntarātmā bhagavāna viṣṇuḥ rakṣati māṃ dvija || 77 || anāthabālavṛddhānāṃ viṣṇuḥ saṃrakṣakaḥ sadā | evamukto’pi kāmena saṃbhoktuṃ yāti yāvatā ||78 || kopācchaśāpa sā dharmaṃ brahmabandho kṣayaṃ vraja | kṣayaṃ vraja durācāra he dharmahan kṣaya vraja ||7 9 || tāvat tatra samāyātā brahma viṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | dharmaṃ dṛṣṭvā praśaptaṃ taṃ rurudustridaśeśvarāḥ || 1.331.80 || niśceṣṭaṃ malinaṃ dagdhaṃ satīkopāgninā hatam | dharmaṃ kṣamasva vṛnde tvaṃ janmamṛpyujarāharam ||8 1 || dharmaṃ jīvaya pitaraṃ rakṣa dharmaṃ pativrate | iti viṣṇustadovāca tathā brahmāpyuvāca tām ||8 2 || dhvāntapūrṇaṃ jagajjātaṃ vinā dharmeṇa vṛndike | kampitau candrasūryau ca śeṣaścāpi vasundharā ||8 3 || svasti te’stu ca bhadraṃ te jīvayainaṃ vṛṣaṃ śubhe | dharme karoṣi tapasāṃ kathaṃ dharmaṃ vihaṃsi ca || 84|| dvijarūpadharo dharmastvāṃ parīkṣitumāgataḥ | brahmaṇā preritaścāyaṃ nirdoṣopi vihaṃsitaḥ || 85||| tapasopārjito dharmo dharmeṇa ca phalaṃ nṛṇām | katha phalaṃ syāt tapasā yadi dharmaḥ kṣayaṃ gataḥ ||8 6 || niṣphalaṃ karmiṇāṃ karma vinā dharmeṇa dhārmike | dharme praṇaṣṭe tapasāṃ tavāpūrvaṃ vinaṃkṣyati ||8 7 || svadharmopārjanaṃ kartumāgatāsyatra sundari | vihaṃsi dharmamajñātvā dharmaṃ jīvaya satvaram || 88 || iti śrutvā tadā vṛndā devānprāha tapasvinī | ahaṃ devā na jānāmi dharmaṃ brāhmaṇarūpiṇam || 89 || kṛtaḥ kṣayo mayā kopānmāṃ pradharṣitumicchataḥ | jīvayāmi dhruvaṃ dharmaṃ mṛtaṃ sanātanaṃ punaḥ || 1.331.90 || kintu mṛtaḥ punarnaiva sa evātra bhaviṣyati | deśakālādibhedena dharmo’nyo’yaṃ bhaviṣyati || 91 || tapaḥ satyaṃ tu cenme’tra satyaṃ ced viṣṇupūjanam | tena puṇyena tu vipro’tra sadyo bhavatu jīvitaḥ || 91 || mama satyavrataṃ satyaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ ca me yadi | tena puṇyena vipro’tra sadyo bhavatu jīvitaḥ || 93 || dharmapatnī tadā mūrtiruvāca kamalāpatim | yadyasmi dharmaparamā dharmo bhavatu jīvitaḥ || 94|| nārāyaṇapade natvā mūtirvṛndā pracakratuḥ | vandanaṃ dharmajīvārthaṃ nārāyaṇastadāha ca || 95|| mūrte vṛnde ca dharmo’yaṃ jīvatu bhavatu kṛte | catuṣpādo’tha tretāyāṃ tripādo dvāpare dvipāt || 96|| kalau tvastu tvekapādastredhā kṣayārthaśāpavān | ityuktvā sa harirdharmamāhvayāmāsa śabdataḥ || 97 || dharmastu jīvanaṃ prāpto mūrtivṛndāprasīdatām | dhruvaḥ pūjitaśca vṛndā tatra praśaṃsitā || 98 || varadānārthamājñaptā yayāce viṣṇumeva sā | viṣṇorarthaṃ tapastaptaṃ patirviṣṇuśca me bhavet || 99|| māṃ vivāhya tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ nayatād viṣṇureva ha | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha vṛndā prasannatāṃ gatā || 1.331.100 || vṛndāvivāhitā tatra viṣṇunā saha kanyakā || 101 || vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca gatā viṣṇuṃ prāpya sā rājakanyakā | atha vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ moktuṃ vṛndā na cecchati || 102 || viṣṇuḥ prāha tadā vṛndāṃ tiṣṭhātra tulasīmayī | vivāhayiṣye tvāgatya bahumānapuraḥsaram ||103 || etad vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ tyaktumahaṃ na cotsahe | nimittāntaramāsādya sthāsye tvatra tvayā saha || 104 || viṣṇostulasīvaivāhyaṃ loke khyātiṃ gamiṣsi | tathā kariṣye vṛnde’haṃ vasātra tulasīmayī || 105 || atha kālāntare rādhāchāyā tvaṃ vai bhaviṣyasi | tadā rāpāṇaputrīṃ tvāṃ vivahiṣyāmi vai punaḥ || 106 || vasudevasya putro’haṃ kṛṣṇo rādhāpatiḥ svayam kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaste’tra bhaviṣyāmi patiḥ priye || 10 7|| viṣṇustāṃ tulasīṃ kṛtvā nāṃtyā vṛndāṃ sahācyutaḥ | yayau vaikuṇṭhamevānye sugaḥ svaṃ ketanaṃ yayuḥ || 108 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jālaṃdharavṛndākhyāne vṛndāyā dhruvapautrakedāraputrītvaṃ vṛndavane tapaścaryā dharmakṛtaparīkṣā dharmeṇa dharṣitāmriyatvetidharmaṃ śaśāpa tridevāgamanaṃ dharmojjīvanam dharmasya kṣayaḥ śīlarūpāntaratā vṛndāyāstulasīrūpeṇa sthitiḥ vṛndārūpeṇa vaikuṇṭhagatiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikatriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 331 ||
<1.332> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi kathāṃ vṛndāsuyoginīm | tulasī bhagavatpatnī vṛndāvane tu vṛkṣikā || 1 || jātā yathā tathā kālāntare viṣṇuvivāhitā | yathāvṛttaṃ kathayāmi tava vṛttaṃ nibodha me || 2 || goloke mama dhāmnyevābhavad vṛttaṃ nibodha me | yasya śravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpāt pramucyate || 3 || lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī gaṃgā tisro bhāryā harerapi | premṇā samāstāstiṣṭhanti satataṃ harisannidhau || 4 || gaṃgaikadā sakāmā sakaṭākṣāpaśyadacyutam | punaḥ punastvapaśyatsarasvatyudvejanāya ca || 5 || kṛṣṇo jahāsa bahudhā mudhā gaṃgāṃ nirīkṣya vai | reme sa gaṃgayā sārdhaṃ na tu sarasvatīṃ hariḥ || 6 || ramayāmāsa kāmena vyāptāṃ cecchāvatīmapi | lakṣmīḥ kṣamāvatī naiva manute tāpamāntaram || 7 || sarasvatī caṃcalā ca na sehe tāpamāntaram | lakṣmīstāṃ bodhayāmāsa sāntvayāmāsa duḥkhinīm || 8 || tathāpi krodhamāpannā vāṇī śāntā babhūva na | kampitā kopavegena gaṃgāṃ sāha patiṃ ca vai || 9 || sarvāsu samatābuddhiḥ sadbhartuḥ kāminīḥ prati | asadbhartustu viṣamā svārthinaśca khalasya ca || 1.332.10 || jñātaḥ snehaśca te gaṃgāṃ prati lakṣmīṃ prati dhruvaḥ | mayi nyūno dṛśyate vai ramaṇe sahavāsane || 11 || niṣphalaṃ jīvanaṃ tasyā yā patyuḥ premavañcitā | śrutvā tu bhagavān kṛṣṇastūṣṇīṃ gṛhād bahiryayau || 1 2|| gate nārāyaṇe gaṃgāmuvāca śabdadevatā | re nirlajje sakāme tvaṃ hariṃ rodhayasi gṛhe || 13 || rūpayauvanagarvāḍhyāṃ tāḍayāmi phalaṃ labha | kiṃ kariṣyati te kānto mama vai kāntavallabhe || 14|| iti nirbhartsya gaṃgāyā jighṛkṣuṃ keśamudyatām | madhye gatvā tadā padmā vārayāmāsa vāṅmayīm || 15|| kruddhā padmāṃ praśaśāpa vṛkṣarūpā bhaviṣyasi | gaṃgāṃ śaśāpa sakruddhā saridrūpā bhaviṣyasi || 16 || śāpaṃ śrutvā tu te devyau vijñāya viṣṇuceṣṭitam | na śepatustu tāṃ vāṇīṃ gaṃgā padmāmuvāca ha || 1 7|| padme svabhāvataśceyaṃ caṃcalā vāgvilāsinī | vācyāvācye na jānāti śapāmyenāṃ kathaṃ na vai || 18 || saridrūpā tvaṃ ca vāṇī bhava vandhyā ṛtuṃ vinā | arājasvalyamevāsyai sadā bhavatvakāmadam || 1 9|| iti śāpaṃ tu sā prāptā tadā sarasvatī priye | etasminnantare tatra bhagavānājagāma ha || 1.332.20 || kalahaṃ sāntvayitvā ca duḥkhitāstā uvāca saḥ | madicchayaiva saṃjātaṃ śokaṃ mā kuruta priyāḥ || 21 || lakṣmi tvaṃ kalayā yāhi śubhaṃ dharmadhvajagṛham | ayonisaṃbhavā kanyā bhūtvā paścānmiṣeṇa vai || 22 || saṃbhūya tulasī paścācchaṃkhacūḍasya kāminī | bhūtvā vivāha vidhinā matpatnī saṃbhaviṣyasi || 23 || kalayā tvaṃ saritpadmāvatīnāmnā bhaviṣyasi | atha gaṃge saridrūpā pāpaghnī dehināṃ bhava || 24|| sāgarāṇāṃ tu mokṣārthaṃ sāgarasya priyā bhava | bhava sarasvati brahmasadane brahmakāminī || 25|| sarasvatīnadīrūpā rājasvalyavivarjitā | bhava mokṣakarī nityabrahmacaryaparā bhava || 26 || ahamante bhavatīnāṃ yogakṣemau yathāyatham | vahiṣyāmi na mantavyau śokamohau mama priyāḥ || 27|| tisro bhāryāstrayaḥ śālāstrayo bhṛtyāśca bāndhavāḥ | dhruvaṃ śubhaviruddhāśca na hyete maṃgalapradāḥ || 28 || strīpuṃvacca gṛhe yeṣāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ strīvaśaḥ pumān | niṣphalaṃ janma vai teṣāmaśubhaṃ ca pade pade || 29 || mukhaduṣṭā yoniduṣṭā yasya bhāryā kalipriyā | araṇye tena vastavyaṃ na striyā vai kadācana || 1.332.30 || varo vyāghrākule vāso na duṣṭapramadāgṛhe | varā vyādhiviṣajvālā na duṣṭastrīmukhānalaḥ || 31 || puṃsastu strījitasyeha jīvitaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet | bahvīnāṃ tu sapatnīnāṃ naikatra śreyasī sthitiḥ || 32 || ekabhāryaḥ sukhī kvāpi na tvanekavadhūvaraḥ | jīvanmṛto’śucirduḥkhī bahubhāryāpatiḥ khalu || 33 || gaccha gaṃge śivasthānaṃ brahmasthānaṃ sarasvati | atra tiṣṭhatu kamalā sarvaṃsahā mama kṛte || 34|| susādhyā yasya patnī ca suśīlā ca pativratā | iha svargasukhaṃ tasya dharmo mokṣaḥ paratra ca || 35|| ityuktvā virarāmaiva kṛṣṇastā rurudustadā | ūcuśca kampitāḥ sāśrunetrā viyogaduḥkhitāḥ || 3 6|| tisṛṣu nātha yad yogyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ pradehi tat | prasādaṃ kuru tvasmabhyaṃ śāpāntaśca yathā bhavet || 37 || nadīrūpā vayaṃ gatvā drakṣyāmaste padaṃ kadā | katikālaṃ sthitistatra prāpsyāmastvāṃ kadā punaḥ || 38 || lakṣmyahaṃ tulasīnāmnī dharmadhvajasutā satī | vṛkṣarūpā tathā bhūtvā kadā prāpsyāmi te padam || 39 || gaṃgā sarasvatīśāpād gaṃgāśāpātsarasvatī | śāpamukte kadā syātāṃ kadā vā tvāṃ labhiṣyataḥ ||1.332.4 0 || tasmāt kṣamasva he nātha mā preṣaya sthalāntaram | ityuktvā kamalā kāntapadaṃ dhṛtvā ruroda ha ||4 1 || uvāca tāṃ prabhāṃ kṛtvā vakṣasi karuṇākaraḥ | tisro’pi tvanyarūpaistu bhuvaṃ yāntu yathāvacaḥ || 42 || divyarūpāḥ sadā tvatra tiṣṭhantviti kṛpā mama | yannimittāni kāryāṇi kartavyāni bhavanti vai || 43 || tāni nirvartya ca tato va āniṣye’tra vai svayam | padmāvatī saridrūpā tulasīvṛkṣarūpiṇī ||44|| sarasvatī saridrūpā gacchantu bhuvanāntaram | kaleścatuḥsahasre tu gate varṣe saridvarāḥ ||45|| yuge yuge bhūyo bhūyo madgehe tvāgamiṣyatha | vipattiḥ sampadāṃ heturduḥkhaṃ sukhasya kāraṇam ||46|| vinā vipattermahimā sampadāṃ jāyate nahi | pūrve vipat prabhoktavyā tena mūlyaṃ hi sampadām ||47|| pāpināṃ pāpanāśārthaṃ mayaitāḥ saritaḥ kṛtāḥ | madbhaktānāṃ satāṃ snānād yuṣmatpāpavināśanam |48|| asaṃkhyatīrthapūtatvaṃ madbhaktasparśadarśanāt | madbhaktāḥ pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ pāvayanti padakramaiḥ ||49|| madbhaktā yatra tiṣṭhanti kṣālayanti padāmbujam | tatsthānaṃ tu mahātīrthaṃ tārakaṃ pāpināṃ bhavet ||1.332.50|| strīghno goghnaḥ kṛtaghnaśca brahmaghno gurutalpagaḥ || vrataghno nāstikaḥ pūto bhavenmadbhaktasevanāt ||5 1 || viśvāsaghno dharmahantā mithyākalaṃkadastathā | mitraghno nyāsakartā ca pūto madbhaktadarśanāt ||5 2|| adīkṣito’saṃskṛtaścāśuciranyavinindakaḥ | aniveditabhojyatra pūto madbhaktasevanāt ||53|| mātaraṃ pitaraṃ bhāryāṃ bhrātaraṃ tanayaṃ sutām | guruṃ kulaṃ ca bhaginīṃ svāśritaṃ bāndhavādikam ||54|| śvaśrūṃ śvaśuraṃ vṛddhām̐śca patnīṃ puṣṇāti naiva yaḥ | sa bhavet pātakī pūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt ||55|| devaviprādidhanahṛt vikretā duhitustathā | rasasāṃkaryakartāraḥ pūtā madbhaktasevanāt ||56 || teṣāṃ saṃgena saritaḥ pūtā bhavantu sarvadā | teṣāṃ tu pādarajasā pūtā pādodakānmahī ||57|| punanti sarvatīrthāni satāṃ snānāvagāhanāt | teṣāṃ sandarśanaṃ sparśaṃ devā vāñcchanti sarvathā ||58|| lābhānāṃ paramo lābho vaiṣṇavānāṃ samāgamaḥ | na tathā jalatīrthāni na tathā pārthivāḥ surāḥ ||59|| na vā taijasayajñādyā na vai prāṇasamādhayaḥ | te punanti ciraṃ kāle viṣṇubhaktāḥ kṣaṇādaho ||1.332.60 || gurorvaktrād viṣṇumantro yasya karṇe viśed varaḥ | vedavedāṃgaśāstrajño viṣṇubhakto’tisūttamaḥ ||61|| yasya janmani saṃjāte nārakā mokṣaṇaṃ gatāḥ | bhavanti sa mahān bhakto viṣṇoḥ sarvottamottamaḥ ||62|| tiryagādiṣu janmasaṃgrahaṇenaiva jantavaḥ | muktā bhavanti yadyogādviṣṇorbhakto mahottamaḥ ||63|| madbhaktiyukto matpūjāniyukto madguṇānvitaḥ | madguṇaślāghanīyaśca manniviṣṭaśca manmayaḥ ||64|| madguṇaśrutimātreṇa sānanda_ pulakāñcitaḥ | sagadgadaḥ sāśrunetraḥ svātmavismṛtireva ca ||65|| na vāñcchati sukhaṃ muktiṃ sālokyādi catuṣṭayam | matpādasevanaṃ ye tu vāñcchatyeva divāniśam ||66 || etādṛśāśca me bhaktāḥ santaḥ sādhvyo madarthikāḥ | pāvayiṣyanti sarito mā śokaṃ kuruta priyāḥ ||67|| yāntu sarvāśca tiṣṭhantu jalavṛkṣādirūpataḥ | sarasvatī tadā divyā svayaṃ tasthau hareḥ pade ||68 || dvitīyena svarūpeṇa brāhmī jātā sarasvatī | vāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā vedhaḥpriyātra kīrtyate ||6 9|| atha jalasvarūpeṇa brahmaṇā noditā hi sā | sarasvatī nadī jātā tīrtharūpātipāvanī ||1.332.70 || atha gaṃgāṇḍakṛcale divyarūpā jalātmikā | brahmakamaṇḍalusthānā vāmanāṃguṣṭhasaṃspṛśā ||7 1 || bhagīrathasamānītā śarvajaṭordhvasaṃginī | samājagāma kalayā sarillokasya pāvanī ||72|| divyarūpā tu yuvatī svayaṃ tasthau hareḥ pade | padmā ca kalayā padmāvatī jātā śubhāpagā ||7 3 || dvitīyena svarūpeṇa lakṣmīrdharmadhvajagṛhe | putrī jātā tulasītināmnī kanyāsvarūpiṇī ||74|| divyarūpā tu tatraiva lakṣmīrvasati nityaśaḥ | ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi prāgbhavaṃ tava ceṣṭitam ||75|| yā vṛndā sā ramā lakṣmīryā lakṣmīḥ sā ramā ca sā | yā ramā sā vṛndālakṣmīryā lakṣmīḥ sā ca vṛndikā ||76 || vṛndāvane vṛkṣarūpābhavad ramaiva saiva sā | gaṇeśenātha saṃśaptā śaṃkhacūḍapriyābhavat ||77|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tulasāvivāhākhyāne goloke śrīkṛṣṇapatnīnāṃ ratinimittakaparasparaśāpena dvedhā bhūtvā gaṃgāsarasvatīlakṣmīnāṃ saridrūpatā lakṣmyāstulasīrūpatetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvātriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 33 2||
<1.333> śrīlakṣmīruvāca kathaṃ kadā tulasī sā śaṃkhacūḍapriyābhavat | gaṇeśena kutaḥ śaptā kadā tadvada keśava || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi harerājñāmādāya padmasaṃbhavā | lakṣmīḥ padmāvatī jātā nadī tīrthasvarūpiṇī || 2 || ekadā sā surūpābhūd yauvanojjvalabhāsvarā | kanyā svargasamā varārohā kāmena vihvalā || 3 || tīrthe’ṭamānā tapasā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā | dadarśa gaṃgātīre sā gaṇeśaṃ yauvanānvitam || 4 || atīva sundaraṃ cittaharaṃ candanagandhitam | sadbhūṣābhirdīpitaṃ ca vaktraśobhātihṛcchrayam || 5 || surūpapuṣṭāvayavaṃ niṣkāmaṃ kāmanāvatī | tulasyuvāca bho vipra dhyāyasi kāṃ surūpiṇīm || 6 || kathaṃ lambamudara te karivaktraṃ kathaṃ tava | kathaṃ vaktraṃ tvekadantaṃ harerdhyānaṃ karoṣi kim || 7 || tyaja dhyānaṃ mahāpuṣṭa sāyaṃkāla upasthitaḥ | ekākinā na vastavyaṃ sāyaṃkāle niśāmukhe || 8 || ityuktvā karasaṃyogaṃ tasyodare cakāra sā | kāmabāṇaiḥ pradagdhā sā prajahāsa punaḥ punaḥ || 9 || kapolayorgaṇḍayośca vakṣasyudaramaṇḍale | tato’pyadhaḥpradeśe’pi pasparśa karamudrayā || 1.333.10 || babhūva dhyānabhaṃgo’sya tadā sā tu ratipriyā | jaghāna tarjanyagreṇa liṃgaṃ ca jaghanaṃ mudhā || 11 || dhyānanāśe gaṇeśasyābhavad roṣo’nivāraṇaḥ | netre unmīlya ramaṇīṃ tvapaśyat kāmanāvatīm || 1 2|| navayauvanasampūrṇāṃ kābhavegaprapūritām | dīnāṃ narmaparāṃ kāmadāvānalātitāpitām || 13 || lambodarastu tāṃ vīkṣyāvicārayat kṣaṇaṃ kṛpaḥ | ārtānāṃ duḥkhahāritvaṃ sajjanānāṃ hi sādhutā || 1 4|| kathaṃ mayā tiraskāryā kāmadāvānalārditā | tiraskāre mahad duḥkhaṃ phalaṃ cāniṣṭamāpnuyām || 15 || grahaṇe’pi mahādoṣaḥ sagarbhātvaṃ bhavediti | tasmādenaṃ vicāryaiva paraṃ vinayapūrvakam || 16 || sāntvayāmi śāntivākyaiḥ kāmavegaprapīḍitām | ehi kanye tāpasi tvaṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇe || 1 7|| tiṣṭha niṣīda susthāne viharātra sukhena vai | kiṃ te’pekṣyaṃ bhojanaṃ vā jalaṃ vānyad vadātra me || 18 || ahaṃ lambodaro devaḥ kurūpo’smi ca vṛndalaḥ | jale snānaṃ kuru devi viṣṇuṃ smara sthirā bhava || 19 || dhairyaṃ dhāraya bhadraṃ te mama sparśe bhaviṣyati | ehyasmin sarasi snānaṃ kurvo viharaṇaṃ tataḥ || 1.333.20 || tava tāpo bhavecchāntastathā snānādikaṃ kuru | kā tvaṃ vatse kasya kanyā lakṣmīrūpāsi kiṃ śubhe | 2 1 || pūjyā vandyā jaganmātā bhāsi me brūhi kiṃ katham | kṛṣṇapatni dhyānabhaṃgastapasvitapasāṃ kṣayaḥ || 22 || kṛṣṇaḥ karotu kalyāṇaṃ hantuṃ vighnaṃ dvayorhi nau | mā cañcalaṃ manaḥ kāryaṃ cāñcalyaṃ vratabhaṃgakṛt ||23 || dhyānināṃ vratināṃ rāgaḥ kāmanā vratabhaṃgadā | kharjanaṃ cendriyāṇāṃ tu sahanīyaṃ viśeṣata || 24|| saṃkalpo mārayitavyo viśeṣeṇa tapasvinā | tvamasi tāpasī subhru vratī cāhaṃ samādhimān || 25 || āvāṃ śakto mano jetuṃ niroddhuṃ kāmameva ca | tasmāllakṣmi kṛṣṇapatni mā kṛṣṇaṃ karma cācara || 26 || bhava dhairyavatī bāle gaṇeśo’haṃ gaṇa jaya | gaṇeśavacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca smarārditā || 27 || dharmātmajasya kanyāhaṃ patyarthaṃ ca tapasvinī | tapaḥphalaṃ svāmilabdhistvaṃ svāmī bhava me patiḥ || 28 || tulasīvacanaṃ śrutvā tāmuvāca hariṃ smaran | mātardāragrahe nāsti madicchā yaddhi duḥkhakṛt|| |29 || dāragraho mahājālaṃ bandhanaṃ kalahagṛham | kāmasevā hareḥ prāptau virodhinī na muktidā || 1.333.30 || tapasyānāśikā mokṣadvāre kapāṭikā matā | galapāśakarī garbhakārāgṛhanivāsadā || 31 || tattvajñānavināśā saṃśayādhānā janupradā | sāhasānāṃ parā mātā sarvamāyākaraṇḍikā || 32 || doṣāśrayā na kartavyā kāmasṛtivināśinī | nivartasva mahāmāye mārgayānyaṃ tu kāmukam || 33 || kāmukenaiva kāmukyāḥ saṃgamo’rthaprado bhavet | śrutvaivaṃ tulasī kanyā saṃtaptā kāmanāturā || 34|| gaṇeśaṃ prāha gṛhṇāsi bhajamānāṃ na vai yataḥ | abhajamānā te patnī bhāvinī mama śāpataḥ || 35 || gaṇeśastāṃ tadā prāhāsuragrastā bhaviṣyasi | paścād vṛkṣamayī bhaviṣyasi mamāpi śāpataḥ || 3 6 || śrutvā śāpaṃ tulasī sā ruroda prāha tāṃ gaṇaḥ | mā rodīhi mama pūjye puṣpasārā bhaviṣyasi || 3 7 || patrasārā sadā snigdhā viṣṇau kṛṣṇe bhaviṣyasi | bhaviṣyati tvayā tvarcye viṣṇurmuktipradaḥ sadā || 38 || nāhaṃ bhokṣye tava patraṃ mañjarīṃ kāṣṭhamityapi | kṛṣṇabhogyā bhava subhru kalyāṇaṃ te bhaviṣyati || 3 9|| ityuktvā sa gaṇeśastu yayau badarikāvanam | tulasyapi yayau dūyamānāntarā tu puṣkaram || 1.333.40 || tatra kṛtvā tapaḥ paścācchaṃkhacūḍapriyābhavat | tataḥ śaṃkaraśūlena sa mamārāsurādhipaḥ ||4 1 || sā kalāṃśena vṛkṣatvaṃ prāptā nārāyaṇapriyā | nārāyaṇena vidhivad vivāhitā ca kanyakā ||42 || punaḥ prāptā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ golokavāsinam | iti te kathitā lakṣmi tulasyāḥ punarāvṛtiḥ |43 || hariṇā saṃgṛhītā sā haryaṃgā vai harervadhūḥ | tulasī sarvapāpāni prakṣālayati padmaje || 44|| patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ mūlaṃ śākhā tvak skandhasaṃjñitam | tulasīsaṃbhavaṃ sarvaṃ pāvanaṃ mṛttikādikam ||45 || yasya śavasya dāho’pi tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhatraḥ | na tasya punarāvṛttirmokṣagasya kadācana ||46 || mahāpāpātipāpādisaṃbhṛto’pi naro yadi | tulasīkāṣṭhadagdhaḥ syānmṛtyuvegātpramucyate ||47|| tulasīsparśakartāpi sarvapāpātpramucyate | yasya mṛto harernāma dāhe ca tulasīsamidh || 48|| śrāddhe ca bhagavaddānaṃ na tasya punarāgatiḥ | yaddāhe kāṣṭhanicaye kāṣṭhamekamatho bhavet ||49 || tasya pāpāni naśyanti muktigo jāyate tu saḥ | gaṃgāṃbhasā sumiśrāṇi vārīṇi yānti puṇyatām ||1.333.50 || harernāmnā pramiśrāṇi vākyāni yānti puṇyatām | tulasīkāṣṭhamiśrāṇi dārūṇi yānti puṇyatām ||51 || tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃmiśrā yāvatprajvalitā citā | dahyante tasya pāpāni kalpakoṭibhavāni ca ||52|| tulasīkāṣṭhanikṣiptaṃ śavaṃ dṛṣṭvā yamānugāḥ | palāyante naraṃ tyaktvā nayanti viṣṇupārṣadāḥ ||5 3 || tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃyukto mukto yāti hareḥ padam | susvarge’psaraso devā vardhayanti kṣipanti ca ||54|| puṣpāñjaliṃ pragantāraṃ tulasīśavavāsinam | viṣṇuścāsyātisaṃtuṣṭo bhavate tulasījuṣaḥ ||55|| tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhūto’nalo yatra pravartate | sā bhūmiḥ pāpasaṃnāśakāriṇī tīrtharūpiṇī ||56 || yatra homo bhaved vṛndākāṣṭhaiḥ kvacittu parvaṇi | tuhostasya bhavet kāṣṭhe kāṣṭhe’gniṣṭomajaṃ phalam ||57|| tulasyā dhūpadānena kṛṣṇasya mandire labhet | śatayajñasamaṃ puṇyaṃ phalaṃ gośatadānajam ||58 || tulasīkāṣṭhadāhena randhitaṃ keśavāya yaḥ | naivadyaṃ dadate tasya merutulyaṃ phalaṃ bhavet |||59 || tulasīpāvakenāpi dīpaṃ dadāti viṣṇave | tasya dīpasahasrāṇāṃ puṇyamājyakṛtaṃ bhavet || 1.333.60 || tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhūtadravacandanadāyine | viṣṇupadaṃ dadātīśo viṣṇuḥ svasāmyatāṃ dadet || 61 || tulasīghṛṣṭajātena candanenārcayeddharim | tasya kṛpā harerbodhyā bhuktimuktipradāyinī || 62|| tulasīcandanairliptaḥ kurute haripūjanam | harerdhāmni tulasyā sammānito ramate tu saḥ || 63 || pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍadāne’pi tulasīdalameva yaḥ | samarpayati tasyātra puṇyaṃ bhogasukhapradam ||64|| pitṝṇāṃ cāpi santṛptirdale patre śatābdikī | tulasīmṛttikāsnānaṃ tīrthasnānaṃ hi tatsmṛtam ||65 || navīnamañjarīpatraiḥ pūjāṃ viṣṇoḥ karoti yaḥ | sarvapuṣpaiḥ kṛtā tena pūjā mokṣapradāyinī ||6 6 || gṛhe tulasī saṃrakṣyā pālyā poṣyā viśeṣataḥ | darśanātsparśanāttasyā brahmahatyādi līyate || 67|| yatra grāme gṛhe vāṭyāmudyāne tulasī bhavet | tatra sarvatra vasati kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ || 68 || tulasī vidyate yatra gṛhe tatra na rugṇatā | bhayaṃ duḥkhaṃ na dāridryaṃ na viyogaṃ kuṭumbinām || 69 || devakṣetre viśeṣaṇa tulasyāropaṇe kṛte | sarvavṛkṣāropaṇānāṃ puṇyaṃ poṣaṇajaṃ labhet ||1.333.7 0 || mandire tulasīdānaṃ lakṣmīdānādhikaṃ bhavet | tulasyāropaṇenātra sukhaṃ cānte hareḥ padam ||7 1 || utpātān bhayadān bhāgyahānidān durnimittakān | dūrīkaroti tulasī hyakasmātsamupasthitān ||72|| tulasīpatragandhādimiśrito yāti mārutaḥ | yatra yatra daśadikṣu pavitrayati dehinaḥ ||73 || yatra vṛndāmūlayogastatra brahmeśaviṣṇavaḥ | yatra vṛndāpatrayogastatra devādimaṇḍalam ||74|| yatra tanmañjīyogastatrarṣimunayaḥ smṛtāḥ | yatra vāri tulasyāśca tatra pitṛgaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||75|| yatra kāṇḍastulatyā vai tatra vaikuṇṭhameva ha | yatra maṇistulasyā vai tatra lakṣmīyuto hariḥ ||76 || yatra vai tulasīchāyā pitṛtṛptistu śāśvatī | tulasīnikaro yatra tatra dattaṃ tu śāśvatam ||77|| tasyā mūle sadā brahmā viṣṇuḥ śākhāsu tiṣṭhati | maṃjaryādau śaṃbhurasti tulasī trisurātmikā ||78 || śivālaye tulasyā ropaṇaṃ kāryaṃ janaiḥ sadā | tasyā yāvanti bījāni jāyante prativatsaram ||79 || pratibījaṃ yugamānaṃ svargaṃ teṣāmakhaṇḍitam | ekādaśyāṃ pūrṇimāyāmamāyāṃ vratavāsare ||1.333.8 0 || saṃkrāntau puṇyakāle mandire tulasīmarpayet | ropayed bahubhāvena vardhayejjalasecanaiḥ ||8 1 || pūjayed dīpadānādyairdaridro dhanavān bhavet | śālagrāmaśilā yatra yatra vā tulasī bhavet ||8 2 || tatra snānaṃ japo dānaṃ vārāṇasyāḥ śatādhikam | kurukṣetrātprayāgācca naimiṣeyācchatādhikam ||8 2 || tulasī tulasī kṛtvā nidhanaṃ yāti yo janaḥ | tulasī taṃ mahālakṣmi nayati harimandiram ||84|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tulasīvivāhākhyāne lakṣmīrūpapadmāvatīnadyā yauvanavegena yuvatīrūpadharāyā gaṇeśaṃ pratiyānaṃ kāmena patyarthamabhyarthanam gaṇeśakṛto vṛkṣarūpiṇī bhava daityapatnībhavetyādiśāpaḥ tulasīmāhātmyaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayastriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 333 ||
<1.334> śrīlakṣmīruvāca nārāyaṇapriyā kutra sambhūtā tulasī tataḥ | kasya vā sā kule jātā kasya daityasya sā vadhūḥ || 1 || kena vā tapasā prāpa punarnārāyaṇaṃ patim | vistareṇa hare brūhi matkathāṃ vismṛtāṃ mayā || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca vacmi manoḥ samārabhya śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ tava | vismṛtā praśnarūpeṇa smāritāṃ kathayāmi te || 3 || viṣṇoraṃśo manurdakṣasāvarṇiḥ saṃbabhūva ha | tatsuto dharmasāvarṇivaiṣṇavaścātha tatsutaḥ || 4 || viṣṇusāvarṇirityuktastasyāpi vaiṣṇavaḥ sutaḥ | devasāvarṇiretasya rājasāvarṇiraṃgajaḥ || 5 || tasya putro vṛṣadhvajo babhūva śivabhaktimān | putrādapi paraḥ sneho vṛṣadhvaje śivasya yat || 6 || rājā nārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ mene nāpi sarasvatīm | yajñaṃ divākaraṃ devān na mene mattavad yadā || 7 || bhraṣṭaśrīrbhava bhūpeti tvaśapat taṃ ravistadā | rājā śivasya śaraṇaṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ yayau drutam || 8 || śaṃbhustriśūlamādāya raviṃ prahartumāgataḥ | bhayāt palāyitaḥ sūryo brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau || 9 || brahmā sūryaṃ puraskṛtya vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayau drutam | nārāyaṇaṃ praṇemuste cakruḥ sarvaṃ nivedanam || 1.334.10 || nārāyaṇastu kṛpayā hyabhayaṃ dattavām̐stadā | śivastriśūlahastaśca teṣāṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ yayau krudhā || 1 1|| nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya niṣasādārpitāsane | śivaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prāha brūhyāgamanakāraṇam || 1 2||| mahādevastataḥ prāha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim | sūryaḥ śaśāpa me bhaktaṃ vṛṣadhvajamasupriyam || 1 3|| bhaktavāsalyaśokena sūryaṃ hantumahaṃ gataḥ | sa brahmāṇaṃ puraskṛtya tvāṃ śaraṇyaṃ samāgataḥ || 14|| tvāṃ ye śaraṇamāpannā dhyānena vacasāpi vā | nirāpadaste niḥśaṃkā jarāmṛtyū jitau tu taiḥ || 15|| kintu nārāyaṇa sūryaśāpena śrīhatasya vai | kiṃ me bhaktasya bhavitā tanme brūhi jagatprabho || 16 || nārāyaṇo haraṃ prāha vṛṣadhvajo’tra cāgataḥ | haṃsadhvajastu tatputro rājāpi vṛddhatāṃ gataḥ || 17|| tatputrau vaiṣṇavau tvadya dharmadhvajakuśadhvajau | vartete tau śriyā bhraṣṭau tayostu bhāryayorhara || 18|| lakṣmīrdvedhā mama patnī putrīdvayaṃ bhaviṣyati | sampadyuktau ca madbhaktau nṛpaśreṣṭhau bhaviṣyataḥ || 1 9|| vaikuṇṭhe ghaṭikārdhaṃ vai bhūmau yugaikaviṃśatiḥ | vyatīto bhavate kālastasmācchaṃbho na citratā || 1.334.2 0 || ityuktāste yayuḥ sarve yathāsthānaṃ svakaṃ svakam | vṛṣadhvajo nijaṃ rājyamāgatya nidhanaṃ gataḥ ||2 1 || haṃsadhvajo’pi kālena tato vai nidhanaṃ gataḥ | athogratapasā bhūpau dharmadhvajakuśadhvajau || 22|| nārāyaṇaṃ prasādyaiva varaṃ prāpaturīpsitam | lakṣmīrdvedhā yuvayorvai putrī bhaviṣyati dhruvam ||23 || tatpratāpena sampannau rājyaśreṣṭhau bhaviṣyathaḥ | atha tau kārayāmāsatuśca lakṣmyāḥ samarcanam ||24|| vrataṃ cāpi prasannābhūllakṣmīḥ prāha varaṃ ca tau | dhanavantau putravantau pṛthvīśeśau śriyā yutau || 25|| nārāyaṇasya kṛpayā bhavataṃ nṛpapūjitau | ityāśiṣā pariplutāvavadatāṃ tathāstviti || 26|| śriyā yutāvitivākyaṃ yathārthaṃ kuru padmaje | ityācintya ca lakṣmīḥ sā dvedhā rūpamathākarot || 27|| kuśadhvajagṛhe kanyā jātā kālena śrīkarī | kuśadhvajapriyā putrīṃ suṣuve kamalāṃśajām || 28|| jātamātrā vedavatī dhvaniṃ cakāra kanyakā | tena vedavatī nāmnā khyātimāpa tadaiva ha || 29|| pitarau sā namaskṛtya yayau tapase sadvanam | puṣkare tapasā sādhvī śuśrāva vyomabhāratīm || 1.334.30 || janmāntare tu te bhartā bhaviṣyati hariḥ svayam | iti śrutvā punā ruṣṭā cakāra tu punastapaḥ || 31 || gandhamādanamāśritya sthitā ciraṃ tatāpa ca | dadarśa puratastatra brāhmaṇaṃ rāvaṇābhidham || 32 || sā tvatithiṃ namaskṛtya pādyaṃ phalaṃ jalādikam | dadau tasmai so’pi duṣṭo manovikṛtimāpa vai || 33 || tāṃ kareṇa samākṛṣya saṃbhogaṃ kartumudyataḥ | vedavatī kopadṛṣṭyā staṃbhitaṃ ta cakāra ha || 34|| śaśāpa ca madarthe tvaṃ vinaśyasi sabāndhavaḥ | ityuktvā sā satī dehaṃ vilīyādṛśyatāṃ gatā || 35|| sā tu vedavatī pṛthvyāḥ putrī janakanandinī | sītādevī prasaṃjātā yadarthe rāvaṇo hataḥ || 36 || seyaṃ lakṣmīstvamevāsīḥ kalpāntareṣu sarvathā | sītārūpā bhavasi tvamahaṃ rāmo bhavāmi ca || 37|| rākṣasānāṃ vināśāya tathāklṛptaṃ mayāsti vai | tvāṃ vinā tāmasānāṃ tu nānyad vināśakāraṇam || 38|| mahātapasvinī lakṣmīrlebhe rāmaṃ patiṃ harim | jātismarā sma smarati viṣehe duḥkhameva sā || 39 || rāmaḥ piturvacanena śatarathasya kānanam | jagāma sītayā sākaṃ lakṣmaṇenānujena vai ||1.334.40 || saṃdadarśa tatra vahniṃ rāmo brāhmaṇarūpiṇam | vahniruvāca bhagavān rāvaṇāntakaro hyayam ||4 1 || sītāharaṇadvāreṇa samayaḥ samupāgataḥ | ahamagniḥ suraiḥ prasthāpito’smi viprarūpadhṛk || 42 || sītāṃ mayi tu sannyasya chāyāṃ sītāṃ gṛhāṇa vai | dāsyāmi sītāṃ samaye matprasū vai parīkṣaṇe ||43 || rāmastadvacanaṃ śrutvā drāgeva kṛtavām̐stathā | lakṣmaṇo naiva bubudhe gopyamanyasya kā kathā ||44|| etasminnantare rāmo dadarśa kānakaṃ mṛgam | jagāma tadvināśāya sītāyā āgraheṇa vai ||45|| lakṣmaṇo’pi yayau paścāt sītāṃ nināya rāvaṇaḥ | vijayākhyaḥ pārṣadaḥ sa mṛdhe mṛtvā yayau punaḥ ||46 || pretatvamatha ca jayaḥ savarṇo’pi raṇāntare | mṛtvā jagāma vai pretatvaṃ tṛtīyajaneḥ kṛte ||47|| rāmabāṇena laṃkāyāṃ rākṣasā bahavo hatāḥ | vibhīṣaṇo’bhavadbhaktastasmai rājyaṃ dadau hariḥ ||48|| śuddhyarthaṃ ca tato rāmo vahnau parīkṣaṇaṃ vyadhāt | tatra hutāśanastasmai vāstavīṃ jānakīṃ dadau ||49|| chāyāṃ provāca bhagavān gaccha tvaṃ puṣkaraṃ priye | tapasyāṃ tatra kṛtvātha svargalakṣmīrbhaviṣyasi ||1.334.50 || sā taptvāyutavarṣāṇi svarge lakṣmīrbabhūva ha | saiva lakṣmīryajñakuṇḍe draupadī saṃbhaviṣyati ||51 || satyayuge vedavatī kuśadhvajasutā tu sā | tretāyāṃ rāmapatnī sā sīteti janakātmajā ||52|| tacchāyā draupadī devī dvāparānte tu bhāvinī | kalau tu māṇikī devī nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā ||53 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇārohā bhavatyevaṃ yuge yuge | iti te’bhihitaṃ caikarūpaṃ śṛṇu dvitīyakam ||54|| dharmadhvajasya patnī tu mādhavīti ca viśrutā | gandhamādanaśikhare garbhavatī babhūva sā ||55 || kārtikīpūrṇimāyāṃ sā suṣāva padminīṃ sutām | pādapadmayuge tāṃ tu padmarāgavirājitām ||56 || rājarājeśvarīṃ lakṣmīṃ sarvāvayavasundarīm | rājalakṣmīlakṣmayuktāṃ rājalakṣmyadhidevatām ||57|| candrānanāṃ padmapatranetrāṃ bimbādharāṃ śubhām | karapādatalāraktāṃ nimnanābhiṃ valitrayām || 58|| śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ tulasīṃ nāmataḥ kṛtām | tulanā sīdati yatrānyāsāṃ sā tulasī sutā ||59 || jātamātrā yuvatī sā jātismerātisundarī | mama nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī bhaviteti viniścitā ||1.334.6 0 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptyai jagāma badarīvanam | tatra ciraṃ tayā cīrṇaṃ kṛṣṇadṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ || 61 || grīṣme pañcatapāḥ śīte jalasthā sā ca kanyakā | vṛṣṭidhārāṃ sahamānā varṣāsu tvakarot tapaḥ ||62|| pūrvaṃ phalāśanā paścātpatrāśanā jalāśanā | bāyvaśanā nirāhārā caikapādasthitābhavat ||63 || brahmā samāyayau dṛṣṭvā tapaścograṃ ciraṃtanam | samāgataṃ varaṃ dātuṃ tatra badarikāśrame ||64|| brahmāṇaṃ sā praṇanāma brahmā tāṃ samuvāca ha | varaṃ vṛṇuṣva tulasi yatte manasi vāñchitam ||65|| kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ ca muktiṃ vāpyajarāmaratāmapi | śṛṇu tāta pare dhāmni goloke’haṃ sthitā purā ||66|| kṛṣṇapatnī kiṃkarī ca tadaṃśā tatsakhī priyā | ramā vṛndā tathā lakṣmīrahamevābhavaṃ tadā ||67|| ramārūpāṃ tadā vṛndāṃ govindāsaktamānasām | ratisthāṃ rādhikā krodhāt śaśāpa māṃ tu sevikām ||68|| tathaiva vāṇīṃ padmāṃ māṃ śaśāpa cāpi vai punaḥ | yāhi tvaṃ mānavīṃ yoniṃ smarāmyetat purābhavam ||6 9|| tataḥ padmāvatīṃ māṃ ca gaṇeśaḥ śaptavān purā | vṛkṣatvaṃ yāhi cetyevaṃ daityapatnī bhavetyapi ||1.334.70|| śāpottaraṃ tu goloke kṛṣṇaḥ prāha mudā hasan | mamaiva pārṣado lakṣmi sudāmā yo madaṃśakaḥ ||7 1 || so’pi rādhākṛtaśāpācchaṃkhacūḍo bhaviṣyati | tasya patnī bhāvinī tvaṃ gaṇeśoktānusārataḥ ||72|| tato māṃ tvaṃ tapastaptvā labhiṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ | ahaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ patiṃ mama purātanam ||73 || sāmprataṃ labdhumicchāmi varamevaṃ pradehi me | jātismarā yathā vedmi tatsarvaṃ kathitaṃ tu te ||74|| tasmād brahman yathāśāpaṃ kuru yogyaṃ yathā bhavet | brahmovāca tadā lakṣmīṃ sarvaṃ jānāsi sundarī ||75 || jātismarā svayaṃ cāsi dharmadhvajasya putrikā | sudāmā śaṃkhacūḍo’sau jāto’sti bhūtale’suraḥ ||76 || adhunā tasya patnī tvaṃ bhava bhāvini śobhane | paścānnārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ kṛṣṇameva labhiṣyasi ||77|| tulasī tvaṃ vṛkṣarūpā vṛndāvane bhaviṣyasi | pradhānā sarvapuṣpāṇāṃ pāvanī saṃbhaviṣyasi ||78|| tvayā vinā tu sarveṣāṃ pūjā syād viphalā yathā | tathā kṛṣṇaḥ prāṇato’pi vallabhāṃ tvāṃ vidhāsyati ||79 || vṛndāvane vṛkṣarūpā vṛndā vṛndāvanīti vai | bhaviṣyasi tava dalaiḥ pūjayiṣyanti keśavam ||1.334.80|| janāstathā tena sārdhaṃ vihariṣyasi santatam | rādhāsamā tvaṃ subhagā govindasya bhaviṣyasi ||8 1 || rādhikāyāḥ prāṇatulyā kṛṣṇaprāṇā bhaviṣyasi | śrutvaitattulasī prāha śīghraṃ syāttattathā kuru ||82|| brahmā lakṣmyai tadā prāha japārthaṃ mantramuttamam | rādhākṛṣṇāya cātmānaṃ samarpayāmi oṃ namaḥ ||8 3 || iti ṣoḍaśavarṇāḍhyaṃ datvā cādṛśyatāṃ yayau | sāpi jajāpa taṃ mantraṃ puṇye badarikāśrame ||84|| svalpakālena mantreṇa tapaḥsiddhirajāyata | divyā prasannamanasā dadarśa kṛṣṇamagrataḥ ||85|| kṛṣṇa prāha tulasīṃ te tapaḥ siddhirajāyata | adyataḥ pārṣadabhāryā bhūtvā māṃ prāpsyase priye ||86 || ityuktvādṛśyatāṃ yātaḥ sāpi tatyāja tattapaḥ | bhuktvā pītvā ca santuṣṭā suṣvāpa śayane śubhe ||87|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tulasīvivāhākhyāne manuvaṃśīyavṛṣadhvajasya sūryaśāpaḥ vaikuṇṭhe prārthanayā tadvaṃśe kuśadhvajagṛhe sītākhyā laśmīrabhavat dharmadhvajagṛhe tulasyākhyā lakṣmī rabhavat badaryāṃ tulasyāstapastatsiddhiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 3 34||
