paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi tīrthasnānaphalaṃ bhavet ||1.341.90|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śālagrāmakṣetrasthasālaṃkāyanasomeśvaragaṇḍakībāṇagaṃgātriveṇīdevikābrahmaputrīgajagrāhatīrthajaleśvaratraidhārikatīrthahaṃsatīrthaśālagrāmatīrthacakrasvāmitīrthaviṣṇupadaśaṃkhaprabhagadākuṇḍāgniprabhasarvāyudhadevaprabhavidyādharaikadhāradevahradatriśūlagaṃgāhariharakṣetrāditīrthapradarśananāmaikacatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 341 ||
<1.342> śrīlakṣmīruvāca rurukṣetraṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ rurutīrthaṃ ca kīdṛśam | tanme vada kṛpāsindho śrotumicchāmi sarvaśaḥ || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca purā vipro devadatto bhṛguvaṃśodbhavo’bhavat | divyaṃ tapo’tapad yatra mṛgākīrṇāśrame purā || 2 || varṣāṇāmayutaṃ jātaṃ tapasi vartato muneḥ | vyacintayattadā tvindro vighnaṃ kartuṃ tapasyataḥ || 3 || kāmaṃ vasantasahitaṃ gandharvān sasakhīn punaḥ | pramlocāṃ preṣayāmāsa malayānilamityapi || 4 || indrasyājñāṃ samādāya yayustasyāśramaṃ prati | samīpopavane ramye kokilālāpaguñjite || 5 || rasālakusumāmodavyāpipavanaśītale | bhramaranādasaṃghuṣṭe gandharvagītagarjite || 6 || paṃkajanetrasaṃśobhajjalasthalātimañjule | praviśya sā tu pramlocā gītaṃ sumadhuraṃ jagau || 7 || munirdhyānāduparato gandharvā gītimārabhan | kāmo labdhāvasaraṃ ca vicakarṣa dhanustadā || 8 || muniḥ kṣubdha iti jñātvā sāyakān samayūyujat | munistato vicacārāśramaṃ śṛṇvan sugītikām || 9 || dūrād dadarśa tanvaṃgīṃ kandukakrīḍanānvitām | tasyāḥ samīpamagamat sāpi samīpamāgatā || 1.342.10 || sammohito munistāṃ cāpṛcchat kā tvaṃ kathaṃ vane | sā prāha munisevārthamāgatāsmi gṛhāṇa mām || 11 || atha tāṃ hasamānāṃ sa ramayāmāsa kāmataḥ | bahūnahargaṇānevaṃ ramamāṇo yadṛcchayā || 12|| nirvedaṃ prāptavān sadyastadovāca punaḥ punaḥ | aho māyābalaṃ paśya yayāhaṃ bhṛśamohitaḥ || 13 || jānannapi tapobhraṃśaṃ prāpto devabalātkṛtam | pumān strīdarśanādeva dravate tadvimohitaḥ || 14|| nāparādhastato nāryāḥ pumān yadajitendriyaḥ | evaṃ vicāraṃ kṛtvā tāṃ visasarja munistataḥ || 15|| tyaktvā vighnamayaṃ sthānaṃ gatvā bhṛgvāśramaṃ prati | kṛtasnānastu gaṇḍakyāṃ pūrvasyāṃ diśi nirjane || 16 || atapyata tapo ghoraṃ bhṛgutuṃge śivopari | śivaḥ sākṣāt samāgatyovāca taṃ munisattamam || 17|| viṣṇuśivāvabhedena paśyam̐stvaṃ siddhimāpyasyasi | etacchivasthale liṃgaṃ samaṃgamiti tatkṛtam || 18|| samaṃgeśvaratīrthaṃ tajjātaṃ vai gaṇḍakītaṭe | devadattastathā jñātvā sāyujyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 1 9|| pramlocāpi munergarbhaṃ pakvaṃ kanyāsvarūpiṇam | prāgāśrame parityajya yayau svargaṃ tataḥ priye | || 1.342.2 0|| rurubhirmṛgavaryaiḥ sā kanyā saṃpoṣitā satī | yuvabhiḥ prārthyamānāpi citte kaṃcana nādhyagāt || 21 || cintayānā hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tapasi pratitiṣṭhati | māse sā prathame bālā phalāhāraparāyaṇā || 22 || ekāntaraṃ dinaṃ prāpya dvitīye tridināntare | tṛtīye pañcamadine caturthe saptamāntare ||23|| pañcame navarātreṇa ṣaṣṭhe pañcadaśāhake | māsena saptame ceti śīrṇaparṇāśanāṣṭame ||24|| tyaktvā tānyapi sā bālā vāyvāhārā babhūva ha | evaṃ varṣaśate yāte tasyāḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ ||25|| ahaṃ viṣṇuryadāvocaṃ varaṃ yācaya durlabham | sā nanāma ca māṃ dṛṣṭvā pratyuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ || 26 || anenaiva svarūpeṇa matsthāne sthātumarhasi | mannāmnā kṣetrametacca khyātaṃ bhavatu sarvathā ||27|| maddeho’tra tīrthabhūmau rurutīrtho’stu pāvanaḥ | mama tīrthe kṛtasnāno dhūtapāpā bhavejjanaḥ ||28|| bhuktiṃ muktiṃ tathā yāyād varān dehi jagatpate | iti datvā varām̐stasyai tatraivāntarhitaḥ sthitaḥ || 29|| sāpi kālena sañjātā tīrtharūpā tathābhavat | tasyā niyamyarṣīkāṇi yataḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ || 1.342.3 0|| ṛṣīkeśa itikhyātaḥ sthānaṃ cāpi tathāvidham | rurukṣetramṛṣīkeśakṣetraṃ tīrthaṃ taducyate || 31 || atha goniṣkramaṇākhyaṃ kṣetraṃ vadāmi tacchṛṇu | aurvo nāma pūrvakalpe prajāpatirabhūt priye || 32|| atra sṛṣṭau samāgatya tapo ghoraṃ samācarat | necchati tatphalaṃ kiñcidevaṃ kālo mahān gataḥ || 33 || himādreḥ śikharāt so’pi gaṃgādvāramupāgataḥ | padmapuṣpādilabdhyarthaṃ tadā vai śaṃkaraḥ svayam || 34|| taṃ nirgataṃ ṛṣiṃ jñātvāśramaṃ cakāra bhasmasāt | tata āśramamāyātaṃ aurvo dagdhaṃ vilokya tat ||35 || uvāca krodhatāmrākṣo nirdahanniva dāhakam | yenaiṣa āśramo dagdhaḥ sopi tapto’stu sarvathā || 36 || tatkṣaṇādeva deveśi īśopi kāmadāhakaḥ | mahaddāhena santaptaḥ śaṃbhurdevīmuvāca ha ||37|| aurvasya tu tapo dṛṣṭvā bhītairdevairudāhṛtam | dahyate’tra jagatsarvaṃ sa tu kiñcinna cecchati ||38|| ko vā pratividhistatra yathā sarvasya saṃbhavet | evamukte mayā krodhādīkṣitastasya cāśramaḥ || 39|| dagdho’bhavat kṣaṇenaiva vayaṃ tasmādvinirgatāḥ | etadduḥkhena santapto manyunā ca pariplutaḥ ||1.342.40 || aurvaḥ śaśāpa roṣeṇa tena taptā vayaṃ śive | tena dāhena santapto na śaknomi viceṣṭitum ||4 1 | | ato nārāyaṇaṃ prati gacchāmaḥ śāpaśāntaye | tato nārāyaṇaṃ jñātvā nivedya sahitāstataḥ ||4 2 | | aurvaṃ gatvā samūcustaṃ śāpatāpaṃ nivāraya | aurva uvāca surabhīgaṇamānīya mādhava || 43 | | śaṃkarādīn snāpayantu dugdhaiḥ śāpaḥ praśāmyati | etasminnantare lakṣmi mayā gāvo’vatāritāḥ | |44| | saptasaptatiḥ kalyāṇyaḥ saurabheyyaḥ payodharāḥ | tenāplāvitadehāśca parāṃ śāntimupāgatāḥ || 45 | | śaṃkarādyāstadetadvai goniṣkramaṇanāmakam | kṣetraṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ puṇyamaurvakṣetraṃ jagurvaram || 46 | | tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta gālokaṃ tena cāpyate | śaṃkhacakragadāyukto mama loke mahīyate | | 47 | | mūlavaṭasya mūle’tra patanti pañcadhārikāḥ | pañcadhārākṛtasnānaṃ pañcayajñaphalapradam | | 48 || bhuktimuktipradaṃ kṣetraṃ pañcadhāraṃ prakīrtitam | atha pañcapadaṃ kṣetraṃ yatra pañcamahāśilāḥ | | 49 | | matpūrvāṃ diśamāśritya vartante sudṛḍhā yataḥ | brahmapadadvayaṃ tatra kuṇḍamadhyagatā śilā ||1.342.5 0 | | urdhvaṃ nālaparīṇāhaṃ tatra viṣṇupadaṃ mama | tatra snātāḥ śuddhalokān yānti bhāgavatapriyān | | 51 | | idaṃ brahmapadaṃ kṣetraṃ dhārā patati paścimām | tatra snātvā brahmaloke modate brahmaṇā saha | | 52 | | atha koṭivaṭaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ vāyudiśi dhruvam | tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta pañcakrośāntarasthite | | 53 || yajñakoṭiphalaṃ bhuktvā mama lokaṃ prapadyate | atha viṣṇusaro ramyaṃ pūrvottaraṃ sutīrthakam | | 5 4| | pañcakrośasuvistāraṃ parvato’pi tathāyataḥ | tasya pradakṣiṇaṃ kurvan yāvatpadāni sundari | | 5 5 || bhramamāṇasya jāyante tāvadvarṣasahasrakam | pratipadaṃ sa puṇyātmā brahmaloke mahīyate | | 56 | | tatra kṣetre mahāścaryaṃ jyeṣṭhe śukle prajāyate | dvādaśyāṃ tu gavāṃ śabdāḥ śrūyante vyomamārgataḥ | |57 | | etad gosthalakaṃ tīrthaṃ tāpapāpavināśakam | etadadhyāyavaktuśca tasya śrotustathānaghe | | 58 | | pratyakṣaraṃ sahasraṃ vai varṣāṇāṃ mama dhāmani | vāsaḥ syāccaikaviṃśatikuloddhāro bhavettathā |||59 | | gavāṃ kṣetraṃ mahābhāge pañcayojanamaṇḍalam | gaṃgāyāḥ pūrvato bhāge tiṣṭhāmyahaṃ sadātra vai ||1.342.6 0|| athāparaṃ stutasvāmināmakaṃ kṣetramuttamam | dvāparaṃ yugamāsādya tatra tiṣṭhāmi sundari ||6 1 || śāṇḍilyajājalibhṛgukapilasāyaṇādayaḥ | te māṃ saṃsthāpayiṣyanti dharmamūrtiṃ mahīṃ gatam ||62|| saṃkarṣaṇo vāsudevaḥ pradyumno hyaniruddhakaḥ | te’pi tatra sthitā bhaviṣyanti lokahitāya vai ||63|| matprasādena manujāḥ siddhiṃ yāsyanti matparām | mātsaryaṃ ye kariṣyanti maddharme mama rūpake ||64|| teṣāṃ nāyaṃ paro loko mātsaryopahatātmanām | mātsaryaṃ sarvanāśāya mātsaryaṃ dharmanāśakam ||65|| bahukarmasamāyuktā dānādhyayananiṣṭhitāḥ | tapasā jñānayuktā vā nityaṃ satkarmasūdyatāḥ ||66|| api mātsaryasaṃdagdhā na te paśyanti māṃ kvacit | na kartavyaṃ tataḥ sarvairmātsaryaṃ śāntighātakam ||67|| mātsaryābhidhadoṣeṇa bahavo nidhanaṃ gatāḥ | śṛṇu lakṣmi bhūtagirau pratimā tvāyasī mama ||68|| vārāharūpiṇī tvāste hyabhedyā dṛśyate tu sā | kecitpaśyanti kāṃsyāṃ tāṃ kecidāyasīmityapi ||69|| pāṣāṇīmapare cānye vajrāṃ paśyanti saukarīm | kecitpaśyanti tāṃ mūrti maṇipūragirau sthitām ||1.342.70 || sarvakilbiṣamuktāste yānti vai paramāṃ gatim | vārāhakṣetramevaitat pṛthivyuddhārarūpadhṛk || 71 || athānyatte pravakṣyāmi pañcārūmetitīrthakam | tatra snāturbhavet svarge vāso’psaro’bhisevite |||72|| atha tīrthaṃ bhagukuṇḍo mama dakṣiṇabhūtale | tatra snātā bhavenmukto dhruvadeśe pramodate ||73|| atha tīrtha maṇikuṇḍo’gādhavārdhiḥ surālayaḥ | maṇayo yatra dṛśyante malayaścaṃcalaḥ sthitaḥ ||74|| tatra snātvā ratnabhāgī rājā bhūtvā vimucyate | mama pūrvaṃ trikrośasthaṃ dhūtapāpetināmakam || 75|| kṣetraṃ kuṇḍe jalaṃ svarṇaprabhaṃ mārakatauojjvalam | tatra snātā dhūtapāpaścendrarājyaṃ pravindati || 76 || vartate ca camatkāro maṇipūre girau mama | tāvanna patati dhārā yāvatpāpaṃ na dhūyate ||77|| vṛkṣamaśvatthamityuktaṃ nirmalastatra gacchati | paścimāyāṃ cāmalakavṛkṣaḥ sarvaphalodayaḥ ||78|| pāpāni sparśanāccāpi kṣālayatyatipāpinaḥ | devaiḥ stuto mahākṣetre maṇipūrasthito’nvaham ||79|| stutasvāmīti me nāma devaireva viniścitam | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇām ||1.342.80 || atha lohārgalaṃ kṣetraṃ himālayasamāśritam | śreṣṭhaṃ pañcadaśāyāmaṃ samantātpañcayojanam ||8 1|| tatrottaradiśi svarṇapratimāyāṃ vasāmyaham | devānāṃ duḥkhadāstatra dānavā hyabhavam̐stadā ||82|| daityāśca mānavām̐statra pīḍayanti sma sarvadā | mayā caivāntanaraṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā māyāṃ tu vaiṣṇavīm ||83|| sīmānamargalaṃ kṛtvā kṣiptvā cakraṃ mahaujasam | śatakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ dānavānāṃ kṣayaḥ kṛtaḥ ||84|| tato devā mānavāśca sukhaṃ prāptā hi tatsthale | evaṃ lohārgalaṃ nāma kṣetraṃ taddhi mayā kṛtam ||85|| evaṃ lohārgalaḥ kuṇḍastīrthaṃ mayā kṛtaṃ śubham | tatrāśvaḥ śuklavarṇo vai dāne deyo divaḥpradaḥ ||86|| atha pañcasaraḥ kuṇḍaṃ tīrthaṃ gandharvalokadam | caturdhārāḥ patantyatra śaṃkhavarṇāśca muktidāḥ ||87|| tato nāradakuṇḍaṃ ca tīrthaṃ pañcapravāhavat | tato vasiṣṭhakuṇḍaṃ ca tīrthaṃ tisṛpravāhavat ||88|| pañcakuṇḍaṃ pañcadhārāyutaṃ tīrthaṃ supuṇyadam | saptarṣikuṇḍatīrthaṃ ca saptadhārāprapātanam ||89|| śarabhaṃgakuṇḍatīrthaṃ śarabhaṃgānadīyutam | kuṇḍamagnisaronāmatīrthaṃ vahnigṛhapradam ||1.342.90 || bṛhaspatikuṇḍatīrthaṃ dhāraikā himaniḥsṛtā | vaiśvānarakuṇḍatīrthaṃ dhāraikā himaniḥsṛtā ||9 1 || kārtikeyakuṇḍatīrthaṃ dhārāḥ pañcadaśottamāḥ | samāpatanti himaparvatāt snānāttu puṇyadāḥ ||92|| umākuṇḍamiti kṣetraṃ gaurī yatra januṃ yayau | snātvā gaurīṃ prapaśyedvai gauryā loke sa modate ||93|| maheśvarasya vai kuṇḍaṃ yatra tūdvāhitā hyumā | tatra snātā rudralokaṃ yāti raudryabhisevitaḥ ||94|| prakhyātaṃ brahmakuṇḍaṃ ca vedā yatra samutthitāḥ | catasro vedadhārāśca prapatanti himālayāt |||95|| pūrve śubhrottare svarṇā paścime nīlavarṇikā | dakṣiṇe tvindragopābhā dhārā vedacatuṣṭayam ||96|| tatra snāto brahmalokaṃ vindate nātra saṃśayaḥ | evaṃ lohārgalaṃ kṣetraṃ pañcaviṃśatiyojanam ||97|| mayā himālayo devastīrthānāṃ kāraṇaṃ kṛtaḥ | yasmād dravanti saritaḥ pāvanyo muktidā nṛṇām || .8|| devāstatra nivasanti ṛṣayo nivasanti ca | ahaṃ vasāmi lokānāṃ kalyāṇārthaṃ samudraje ||903|| tattattīrthe kṛtasnānadānadharmā janā dhruvam | svargaṃ mokṣaṃ prayāntyeva kṛpayā mama sarvadā || 1.342.100 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne rūrukṣetraṛṣīkegoniṣkramaṇapañcapadabrahmapadakoṭivaṭaviṣṇusaraḥstutasvāmivarāhakṣetrapañcāsamabhṛgukuṇḍamaṇikuṇḍalohārgalapañcasaronāradavaśiṣṭhasaptarṣiśarabhaṃgāgnibṛhaspativaiśvānarakārtikeyomāmaheśvarabrahmakuṇḍāditīrthānāṃ nirūpaṇanāmā dvicatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 342||
<1.343> śrīlakṣmīruvāca ānādijñānamārtaṇḍa sarvasākṣin sanātana | sarvalokavidhātāsi tvameva tīrthakṛtsadā || 1 || tava yogāccetanāni jaḍāni bhūjalāni ca | dehinastārayantyeva tvamevaṃ tīrthamuttamam || 2 || jīvānāṃ dehalābhe’tra mokṣalābho mahānmataḥ | vinā mokṣaṃ kṛtalābhāste sarve nidhanānvayāḥ || 3 || vṛndāvanaṃ māthuraṃ ca śālagrāmaṃ sanātanam | tulasīkṣetrapatyādyaṃ tvayā proktaṃ purātanam || 4 || tvayā tatra katiprādurbhāvā labdhā vada prabho | lapsyante cāpi ca kati kva vā bhūmau vada prabho || 5 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca are lakṣmi hyasaṃkhyātāḥ prādurbhāvā bhavanti me | mānaveṣu ca deveṣu tiryakṣu paśupakṣiṣu || 6 || jalajeṣu vanajeṣu munisādhujaneṣu ca | ṛṣiṣu satsu satīṣu sādhvīṣu santi bhūriśaḥ || 7 || praticaturyugaṃ kṛṣṇo bhavāmi bhuvi padmaje | vṛndāvaneṣu deśeṣu māthureṣu yamītaṭe || 8 || vicarāmi viharāmi daityānāmantakṛdyathā | nārāyaṇāḥ śataṃ pañcaśataṃ ca jalaśāyinaḥ || 9 || triṃśatkamaṭharūpāṇi matsyarūpāṇi viṃśatiḥ | gopālāśca śataṃ cāṣṭaṃ buddhāḥ santi sahasraśaḥ || 1.343.10 || triṃśatparaśurāmāśca rāmā ekottaraṃ śatam | anye’pi kāryavaśagā avatārā mama priye || 11 || ākasmikāstvayā sārdhaṃ kevalā vā bhavanti vai | brahmāṇḍāni hyanekāni hyanekā daityadānavāḥ || 12|| surāśca tāpasāścāpi hyasaṃkhyāḥ kāmanāyutāḥ | ārtānāmārtināśāyārthināmarthapradāptaye || 1 3|| sakāmānāṃ kāmapūrtyai saṃbhavāmi sthale sthale | kvacidaṃśaḥ kvacitpūrṇaḥ kvacit tvāveśarūpataḥ || 14|| kalayā vā kvacit kvāpi kvacid vibhūtirūpataḥ | sādhurūpastathā rājarūpaḥ sadgururūpataḥ || 15|| vyāsarūpaśca vijñānisvarūpaḥ saṃbhavāmi vai | viṣṇurūpo’smyahameko muktimaṇḍalamadhyagaḥ || 16 || vṛndāvane mathurāyāṃ bahuvāraṃ janiṃ gataḥ | tīrthānāṃ tīrthamūrdhanyaṃ mathurākṣetramasti yat || 17|| yuge yuge yamītīre saṃbhavāmi punaḥ punaḥ | kṛṣṇarūpo dāsadāsīkoṭyabjecchāprapūrakaḥ || 18 || anantasṛṣṭinārīṇāṃ kāmecchābhaktikarṣitaḥ | rājarūpaḥ koṭikāmagarvahā saṃbhavāmyaham || 19|| vasuḥ pitā ca me mātā devī bhrātā sukarṣaṇaḥ | anye santu na vā santu hyebhiḥ saha vasāmyaham ||1.343.20|| prathame tu dvāpare’haṃ saṃkarṣaṇena saṃyutaḥ | yugalo vasudevyośca prādurbhūto’bhavaṃ priye ||21|| tadā tatrāsurā hyāsan kālanemipravaṃśajāḥ | tānahaṃ hatavān sarvān kṛṣṇaḥ pṛthvīsutāpatiḥ ||22|| ratvaṃ tadāsīḥ kamalākhyā marutputrī mama priyā | prathame dvāpare cāhaṃ kamalāpatikṛṣṇakaḥ |||23 || kālanaimeyavaṃśyānāṃ nāśako mathurāpure | tadārabhya mathurāyāḥ kṣetraṃ paramapāvanam ||24|| mama pādatalaiḥ śuddha sarvadā vartate priye | taduttaraṃ mama prādurbhāvāḥ santi sahasraśaḥ |||25| tatrānyatra ca kamale tadantaṃ gaṇayāmi na | bhaviṣyantyavatārāśca tān pragāsyanti mānavāḥ ||26|| vyāsāśca tān yathāyogyaṃ varṇayiṣyanti muktaye | śṛṇu priye pavitraṃ tanmāthuraṃ kṣetramuttamam ||27|| na svarge na ca pātāle tīrthe vai mathurāsamam | sā ramyā sarvathā divyā janmabhūmiḥ sadā mama ||28|| yatra vāsena manujāstathānyaprāṇinaḥ priye | | svarge ca mokṣaṇaṃ yānti golokamiva me sthalam ||29||| prayāge māghapūrṇāyāḥ phalaṃ nityaṃ yamījale | kāśyāṃ varṣasahasrasya phalaṃ tvatra dinena vai ||1.343.30|| puṣkare kārtikīpūrṇāphalaṃ tvatra kṣaṇena vai | māyāmūḍhā mathurāṃ vihāyānyatra bhramānta hi || 31 | | mathurāśravaṇāccāpi līyante pāpakāṭayaḥ | pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni kṣetrāṇi ca sarāṃsi ca | | 32 | | nadyo nadāstathā pūryo’raṇyāni ca vanānyapi | mathurāyāṃ samāyāntyāṣāḍhe supte janārdane | | 33 || mathurāmaṇḍale śrāddhāt tṛpyanti pitaro yugam | mathurāvāsino lokā nidhane yānti matpadam || 34 | | kubjāmrake saukarave janmasthāne viśeṣataḥ | vasatāṃ tu vinā sāṃkhyaṃ yogaṃ mokṣosti niścitaḥ | | 35 | | annavastrapradātāro narā muktā na saṃśayaḥ | bhaviṣyāmi varārohe dvāpare yugasaṃsthite | | 36 || kṛṣṇo’haṃ ca yayātestu vaṃśe daityaniṣūdanaḥ | yamunā yatra suvahā vaivasvatasutā priyā || 37 | | gaṃgāṃ prāpya prayāge yā triveṇīti pravartate | sarasvatīṃ ca saṃgṛhya prathitā pāpahāriṇī | | 38 || yamī gaṃgāśataguṇā śreṣṭhā māthuramaṇḍale | tatra tīrthāni cānyāni bhaviṣyanti mama priye | | 39 || yeṣu snānājjalapānānmuktireva na saṃśayaḥ | nidhane māthure kṣetre jāyate sa caturbhujaḥ | |1.343.4 0 || viśrāntisaṃjñakaṃ tīrthaṃ viśrāntighaṭanāpradam | sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ snānād golokadaṃ nṛṇām | |4 1 || sarvatīrtheṣu yatsnānaṃ dānaṃ dhyānaṃ hutaṃ tapaḥ | tatsarvaṃ labhate lakṣmi viśrāntitīrthadarśanāt | | 42 || na tu yajñairna tapasā na dhyānena na saṃyamaiḥ | tatphalaṃ labhate snāto yathā viśrāntighaṭṭake || 43 | | kālatrayaṃ darśanācca tathā pradakṣiṇadvayāt | namaskārapañcakācca viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 44| | mayā tatra yamunāyā ghaṭṭe viśrāntirāsthitā | śāśvatī śāntiratrāsti yathā golokadhāmani | |45 || athānyanme paraṃ tīrthaṃ prayāgaṃ tatra vidyate | devānāṃ durlabhaṃ guptaṃ sarvasaṃsāramokṣaṇam | |46 || yatra snāto mama lokaṃ yātyagniṣṭomapuṇyabhāg | sakāmastu mahendraḥ syāttato yāti parāṃ gatim | |47 || athānyanye kanakhalaṃ tīrthaṃ snānāddivaḥ pradam | athānyat tindukaṃ tīrthaṃ mama golokadhāmadam | |48 || pāñcāladeśe kāmpilyaṃ nagaraṃ dhārmikaprajam | tatra tindukasaṃjño vai sadā vasati nāpitaḥ | | 49 || kālena nāpitasyaiva kuṭumbaṃ tu kṣayaṃ gatam | tataḥ sa mathurāṃ prāpto yamītīre’vasat sadā ||1.343.5 0 | | kuṭumboddhāraṇārthaṃ vai śrāddhādi tena kāritam | sa nityaṃ yamunāsnāyī kālena nidhanaṃ gataḥ | |5 1 | | mathurāyāṃ brāhmaṇasya janma tvāsādya vai tataḥ | vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo bhūtvā yayau golokadhāma saḥ | | 52|| evaṃ tindukasaṃjño’sau jātismarastu bhūsuraḥ | sarvān vijñāpya tattīrthaṃ khyāpayitvā mṛtiṃ yayau | 53| athānyat paramaṃ sūryatīrthaṃ pāpavināśanam | ārādhitā balinā vai dhanarājyasamīhayā | |54|| ūrdhvabāhurnirāhārastatāpātra paraṃ tapaḥ | tasya prasanno bhagavān sūryanārāyaṇaḥ svayam | | 55 | | samāgatya baliṃ prāha kiṃ te tapasi kāraṇam | baliḥ prāha trilokasya netraṃ sūryaṃ jagatprabhum || 56 | | nirdhano’smi na me rājyaṃ dhanārthaṃ tapa ācaram | sūryastasmai dadau cintāmaṇiṃ svāt mukuṭāt tataḥ | |57 || cintāmaṇiṃ sa saṃprāpya gataḥ pātālameva ha | sūryo yamījale snātvā hiraṇyamaṇḍalaṃ yayau | | 58 || evaṃ tīrthavaraṃ jātaṃ pāpatāpavināśakam | snātvā svargaṃ tato mokṣaṃ vindate syāccaturbhujaḥ || 59 || ravivāre ca saṃkrāntau candrasūryagrahe tithau | sūryatīrthasnānakartā rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet || 1.343.60 || athātra dhruvatīrthaṃ ca yatra tepe dhruvaḥ purā | tatra snānena sāmrājyaṃ maraṇena dhruvasthalam || 69 || śrāddhenātra pitaraśca taranti yānti mokṣaṇam | dhruvasya dakṣiṇe tatra tīrthaṃ vai tīrtharājakam | | 62 | | tatra snānena vai lakṣmi mama golokamāpnuyāt | atha taddakṣiṇe lakṣmi ṛṣitīrthaṃ paraṃ matam | | 63 | | snātvā yāyād ṛṣilokaṃ golokaṃ prāṇavarjanāt | tato’pi dakṣiṇe tīrthaṃ mokṣatīrthaṃ paraṃ mama | | 64 || yatra snānād bhavenmuktirgolokaṃ cāpnuyānmama | tatraiva koṭitīrthaṃ ca devānāmapi durlabham || 65 | | tatra snānāt tathā dānājjapāddhomācca bhojanāt | tarpaṇādupavāsācca brahmaloke mahīyate || 66 || tāritāḥ pitarastena koṭitīrthaniṣeviṇāt | tathā sapta ca saptātha sapta vaṃśāśca tāritāḥ || 67 || atha vai vāyutīrthaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ tārakaṃ param | pitṝn piṇḍapradātārastārayantyeva sarvathā || 68 || gayāpiṇḍapradānasya phalaṃ tvatra hyavāpyate | jyeṣṭhamāse viśeṣeṇa śrāddhāttaranti pūrvajāḥ | |69 || uktānyetāni tīrthāni bhuktimuktipradāni vai | snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ syuḥ sahasraguṇā hi te | |1.343.7 0 || tīrthānāṃ smaraṇāccāpi vandanād darśanāttathā | jalasya kaṇikāpānānmuktirbhavati śāśvatī | |71 | | athātra tīrthamūrdhanyamavatārasamūhakam | śrīkṛṣṇasyāvatārā ye militvā janmanaḥ kṣaṇe ||72 || samāyātāḥ kṣaṇaṃ yatra sthitā yamītaṭe śubhe | janmabhūmisamīpe tat tīrthaṃ gupta hi vartate | | 73 || snānāttatra vāripānāt prokṣaṇādapi sarvathā | pāpapradhvaṃsakaṃ golokavaikuṇṭhādilokadam ||74|| tatra vai maraṇānmuktirbhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ | ekāhopoṣaṇādvāpi koṭiyajñaphalaṃ bhavet | |75 || rajaḥkaṇā mathurāyāḥ spṛśanti dehinastu yān | te’pi muktiṃ prayāsyanti tiryakkīṭādayo’pi cet ||76 || deśāntare’pi tannāmagrahītā bhuktibhāṅ nanu | yatra sākṣātparabrahma rājate tatra kiṃ na vai | | 77 | | dhanadhāmadharādāraputraputrīsamṛddhayaḥ | kṣetrodyānādhikāritvarājyasattājaneśatāḥ | |78 || svarṇarūpyamahālakṣmīśrīsampadbhavanādayaḥ | bhavantyeva hareryogād bhaktasyātra kṛpākaṇāt ||7 9 || tārakaṃ dhārakaṃ yadvad rakṣakaṃ pālakaṃ tathā | svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ cāpi tīrthaṃ māthuramuttamam | |1.343.8 0 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mathurākṣetramāhātmye bhagavadavatārāṇāmānantyaṃ, prathamadvāpare kṛṣṇāvatāraḥ, viśrāntitīrthaprayāgakanakhalatindukasūryadhruvatīrtharājaṛṣimokṣakoṭivāyvavatāratīrthādipradarśananāmā tricatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 343 ||
<1.344> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mathurāyāṃ śivakuṇḍaṃ paraṃ mahat | tīrthaṃ śivakṛtaṃ tatra ciraṃ tepe haraḥ svayam | | 1 || tatra kṛṣṇaḥ samāgatya śivaṃ prāha ca mādhavaḥ | kathaṃ vai tapyate śaṃbho tapaḥ paramadāruṇam | | 2 | | śaṃbhuḥ prāha mahārāja daityairatyarditāḥ surāḥ | asurāṇāṃ vināśāyehāvataritumarhasi || 3 | | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha yamyāṃ snātvā harastataḥ | samāpya tu tapastasmād yayau kailāsameva saḥ || 4 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāpi yayau golokameva ha | ādye dvāparasaṃyoge jāto’sau kṛṣṇa eva tu || 5 || śivakuṇḍamidaṃ tīrthaṃ kṛṣṇāgamanakārakam | bhuktimuktipradaṃ yatra snātvā vaikuṇṭhamāpyate || 6 || śivakuṇḍottare tīrthaṃ saṃyamanaṃ supuṇyadam | snānena jāyate bhāgyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ rūpavattvakam || 7 || svargaṃ tathā paro mokṣaḥ prāpyete nātra saṃśayaḥ | saṃyamano mahātīrthe yadyad vṛttaṃ purātanam || 8 || śṛṇu lakṣmi mahāścaryakaraṃ pāpapraṇāśanam | naimiṣāraṇyavāstavyo niṣādo tuṣṭamānasaḥ || 9 || pāpācāraḥ samāyātaḥ kadācinmathurāṃ prati | nityaṃ snāti yamunāyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ taraṇena ca || 1.344.10 || prati taṭaṃ samāyāti yāti cāpi punastathā | evaṃ snāte taratyapi kṛṣṇacaturdaśītithau || 11 || tartukāmo niṣādaḥ sa jale papāta yāmune | tatāra yamunāṃ so’tha tīrthaṃ saṃyamanaṃ prati || 12 || yāvadāyātyabhitīraṃ prāpya saṃyamanaṃ śubhe | mamajjāsau śramito vai nimagno jalamāpapau || 13 || aśaktaḥ sa mahāpāpaḥ sadyaḥ prāṇairvyayujyata | tīrthaprabhāvataścāsya dhvastaṃ pāpakaraṇḍakam || 14|| puṇyaṃ jātaṃ mahattasya tena jāto bhuvaḥ patiḥ | saurāṣṭraviṣaye deśe saurāṣṭrādhipatirnṛpaḥ || 15 || bhadrāpattanasāmrājyaṃ cakāra sa dhanurdharaḥ | nāmnā yakṣmadhanurnāma kṣatriyo vasudhādhipaḥ || 16 || pālayāmāsa vasudhāṃ kṣatradharmaṃ samāśritaḥ | raivatādrinivāsānāṃ siddhānāṃ sevako hyayam || 17|| nityaṃ yānena saṃyāti darśanārthaṃ girau mudā | pūrvasyāmaśvapaṭṭasya sarasaśca taṭe śubhe || 18 || patnīvratāśrame gatvā taṃ dadarśa mahāmunim | dadarśa kaṃbharālakṣmīṃ gopālakṛṣṇamīśvaram || 19|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cāpi dadarśa nityameva saḥ | tatpratāpena rājāsau kṛṣṇabhaktaśca vaiṣṇavaḥ || 1.344.20 || jāto mahān balī yasya rakṣaṇe kaṇṭhamālikā | varmātmikā pradattā yā nṛpaṃ rakṣati sarvathā || 21 || tayā yuddhe’pi nṛpatī rakṣito vijayī sadā | iti hetorgaurjarāṇāṃ marūṇāṃ rājyamāptavān ||22|| vaihāyasena yānena kāśīyātrārthameva saḥ | yayau kāśīnṛpatinā viditvā vaiṣṇava param ||23|| vijayinaṃ kīrtimantaṃ satkṛtyāsmai nijā sutā | pradattā pīvarīnāmnī nītvā tāṃ sa yayau puram ||24|| bhadrāpattanamāgamya tenoḍhā pīvarī śubhā | patnīśatānāṃ mukhyānāṃ pravarā sā kṛtā priyā ||25|| tāṃ caiva ramayāmāsa sūdyāneṣu vaneṣu ca | prāsādeṣu ca ramyeṣu nadīnāṃ pulineṣu ca ||26|| prajāḥ pālayatastasya dānāni dadatastathā | kālo gacchati rājāsau putrapautrayuto’bhavat ||27|| bhogāsaktasya ca yayurvarṣāṇi tvayutāni vai | putrāḥ putryaḥ pañcaśatānyasyābhavan suśobhanāḥ |||28|| kanyā vivāhitā sarvā vidhinā tena sarvathā | jyeṣṭhe’rpitaṃ mahārājyaṃ madhyameṣu purāṇi vai ||29|| kaniṣṭheṣu kṣitiryogyā jīvikārthārpitātha ca | evaṃ svayaṃ sukhaṃ prāpto nivṛtto rājyakāryataḥ || 1.344.30 || rājñīnāṃ jīvikāklṛptiṃ cakre’tha śayane kvacit | pīvaryā saha suptaḥ san svapne saṃvadate jñavat ||3 1|| hāhā ohoho gacchāvaḥ kimatra jīvanena vai | smṛtvā tāṃ mathurāṃ bhūmiṃ smṛtvā tīrthaṃ tu saṃyamam ||32|| tataḥ pīvarī prāha kimevaṃ bhāṣase nṛpa | priyāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā rājā prāha priyāṃ prati ||33|| mattaḥ suptaḥ pramattaśca hyasambaddhaṃ prabhāṣate | nidrādhīnasya vacanaṃ nāvadhāryaṃ tvayā priye ||34|| pīvaryuvāca me nātha śrutaṃ punaḥ punarmayā | bahuvāraṃ yatastadvai dṛḍhasaṃskārajaṃ bhavet| ||35|| jātismaro mahārāja me tvaṃ vibhāsi tadvada | prāgbhavīyaṃ tvayā rājan procyate vada me’nagha || 36 || kathayasva mamādya tvaṃ yadyahaṃ vallabhā tava | prāṇām̐styakṣyāmyaha rājan gopāyiṣyasi me yadi || 37|| priyāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvāca narādhipaḥ | avaśyaṃ yadi vaktavyaṃ gacchāmo mathurāṃ purīm ||38|| prakāśe tvāvayormṛtyurbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | tatra gatvā prāgbhavīyaṃ kathayiṣye hyudantakam ||39||| dadasva vipulaṃ dānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sulocane | putrān saṃsthāpya dauhitrān sve sve sthāne nibhālya ca ||1.344.40 || grāmān kośāṃśca ratnāni putrān vīkṣya vitīrya ca | rājā sammānayāmāsa janānpuranivāsinaḥ ||41|| pitṛpaitāmaharājyapālanārthaṃ yathākramam | putrānāvedya ca tathā kuṭumbibāndhavān priyāḥ ||42|| kuśalārthaṃ bodhayitvā dārān niyujya rakṣaṇe | atha prāha suhṛnmitrabhṛtyadāsīpradāsakān ||43 || rājyaṃ sampāditaṃ yadvai bandhanaṃ tattu sarvathā | mamātmamokṣaṇārthaṃ vai gacchāmi mathurāṃ purīm ||44|| santoṣācca tathā tyāgānnāstyanyat paramaṃ sukham | nāsti vidyāsamaṃ cakṣurnāsti cakṣuḥsamaṃ balam ||45|| nāsti rāgasamaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsti tyāgātparaṃ sukham | yaḥ kāmān kurute sarvān yaścaitān sarvathā tyajet ||46|| prāyeṇa sarvakāmānāṃ parityāgo viśiṣyate | tasmānmayā pragantavyaṃ tīrthaṃ tu mathurāṃ purīm ||47|| ityāvedya janānsarvānputrānniyujya rakṣaṇe | yathāpekṣabalopetaḥ samprāpto mathurāṃ purīm ||48|| tena dṛṣṭā purī ramyā pīvaryā cāvalokitā | tīrthairmuktipradairyuktā puṇyā pāpaharā śubhā ||49|| ramyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ nāma viṣṇusthānamanuttamam | yad dṛṣṭvā manujo lakṣmi kṛtakṛtyo hi jāyate ||1.344.50 || śrāvaṇaśuklaikādaśyāṃ yamīsnātaḥ pramucyate | tathā saumyaṃ madhuvanaṃ mama sthānamanuttamam ||51|| dvitīyaṃ tadvanaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtakṛtyo hi jāyate | vanaṃ kundavanaṃ nāma tṛtīyaṃ caitramuttamam ||52|| bhādrakṛṣṇaikādaśikātithau snātaḥ pramucyate | caturthaṃ kāmyakavanaṃ mama dhāmapradaṃ śubham |||53|| vimalasya ca kuṇḍe vai snātaḥ pāpātpramucyate | yastatra muṃcati prāṇān mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||54|| pañcamaṃ bakulavanaṃ mama vihārabhūsthalam | tatra gatvā tathā snātvā vahnilokaṃ pragacchati ||55|| yamunāyāḥ pare pāre ṣaṣṭhaṃ bhadravanaṃ mama | tatra gatvā tathā snātvā nāgalokaṃ pragacchati ||56 || saptamaṃ me vanaṃ tatra khādiraṃ yajñasadṛśam | pavitraṃ tu naro dṛṣṭvā mama lokagato bhavet ||57|| mahāvanaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ me sarvavṛkṣasamanvitam | yatra gatvā tu manuja indraloke mahīyate ||58|| navamaṃ tu vanaṃ lohajaṃghavanaṃ vanottamam | tatra yāturjanasyaitanmahāpātakanāśakam ||59|| vanaṃ bilvavanaṃ nāma daśamaṃ devapūjitam | tatra gatvā tu manujo brahmaloke mahīyate ||1.344.60|| ekādaśaṃ tu bhāṇḍīraṃ yogadaṃ yogināṃ hi tat | yatra vai vartate vṛkṣo bhāṇḍīravaṭasaṃjñakaḥ ||61 || yatra vai rādhayā sākaṃ vivāho me prajāyate | tasya darśanamātreṇa jano garbhaṃ na gacchati ||62|| rādhākṛṣṇaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā punarjanma na vidyate | tulasīvanamevātra vanaṃ dvādaśakaṃ priye ||63 || kṛṣṇatvaṅmayavṛkṣāṇāṃ mokṣadaṃ me vivāhabhūḥ | vṛndāvanaṃ haritānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ vanameva me ||64|| tatra gatvā cāvaluṇṭhya patraṃ tvattvā dalaṃ tathā | dṛṣṭvā vṛndaṃ tulasīṃ ca smṛtvā māṃ yamunājale ||65|| snātvā ca muktimāpano goloke me mahīyate | vṛndāṃ tulasīṃ govindaṃ ye paśyanti janāḥ priye ||6 6|| na te yamapuraṃ yānti yānti golokameva me | svargaṃ sakāmā gacchanti tato vai me padaṃ param ||67|| etādṛśaṃ mahat tīrthaṃ mathurāmabhigamya tau | mudamavāpatustīrthavidhiṃ cakraturādarāt ||68 || pīvarī bhojanaṃ kṛtvā kārayitvā patiṃ tataḥ | papraccha svāpnavṛttāntaṃ yadguhyaṃ pūrvabhāṣitam ||69||| yaduktaṃ nṛparājena vakṣyāmi mathurāṃ prati | tanme vada mahārāja yadgopyaṃ pūrvabhāṣitam ||1.344.7 0 || rājāpyāha svakāṃ patnīṃ yathāprāgbhavajāṃ kathām | śṛṇu patni niṣādo’haṃ naimiṣāraṇyavāsakṛt ||7 1 || atrāgatya mṛtaḥ saṃyamane tīrthe jalāntare | tena puṇyena saurāṣṭre rājā jātaḥ pratāpavān ||72|| pannīvratākhyakṛṣṇasya pratāpenāmarukṣiteḥ | sāmrājyaṃ labdhamevāpi tvaṃ labdhā kāśīrājataḥ ||7 3 || jātismaraḥ sadā tīrthaṃ smarāmi śayane tava | kadācinnidrayā vyāptaḥ pravadāmi tu tat khalu ||74 || hāhā ahoho gacchāvaḥ kimatra jīvanena vai | ityetanme prāgbhavīyaṃ vṛttaṃ kathitamaṃgane ||75|| śrutvā sāpi svakaṃ prāha vṛttaṃ jātismarā nṛpī | ahaṃ tu pīvarī nāma gaṃgātīranivāsinī ||76|| āgatemāṃ purīṃ draṣṭuṃ kārtikadvādaśītithau | nāvamāruhya yāntīha patitā yamunājale ||77|| sadyaḥ prāṇairviyuktā ca kāśīrājasutābhavam | tvayā vivāhitā rājanna ca māṃ sājahāt smṛtiḥ ||78 || etattīrthaprabhāveṇa rājapatnī tavābhavam | dhārāpatanake tīrthe mama mṛtyurajāyata ||79 || punardṛṣṭaṃ mokṣatīrthaṃ mathurāyāṃ prapuṇyataḥ | āvayorāyuṣorantaḥ samāyāto’sti bhūpate ||1.344.8 0 || adyaiva bahudānāni deyāni svakareṇa me | ityuktvā yamunātīrthe snātvā dānāni sā dadau ||8 1 || rājāpi kṛtavān puṇyaṃ dānaṃ viprādibhojanam | godānaṃ svarṇadānaṃ ca tiladānaṃ dhanārpaṇam ||8 2|| bhūdānaṃ viprakanyānāṃ dānānyapi ca vai mudā | yajñopavītadānāni vastrānnadānamityapi ||8 3 || sarvaṃ kṛtvā tato rājā rājñī cobhau saha sthitau | yamunāyāstaṭe vai cāyātā golokapārṣadāḥ ||8 4|| vimānena sahitāste pīvarīṃ yakṣmarājakam | caturbhujau divyadehau kṛtvā ninyurhareḥ padam ||85 || evaṃ tau mathurāṃ prāpya snātvā yāmunatīrthake | māṃ paśyātau niyamatastatraiva nidhanaṃ gatau || 86 || sarvabhāvaṃ vihāyaiva gatau mama salokatām | etatte kathitaṃ lakṣmi yadāścaryamabhūnmahat ||87|| tyaktvā tanuṃ janastīrthe dhārāpātanasaṃjñake | nākalokaṃ ca golokamavāpnoti na saśayaḥ ||88 || yamuneśvaramāsādya tyaktvā jīvitamātmanaḥ | viṣṇulokamavāpnoti divyamūrtiścaturbhujaḥ ||8 9|| iti lakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mathurākṣetramāhātmye śivakuṇḍatīrthaṃ saṃyamanatīrthaṃ mṛtasya niṣādasya saurāṣṭrarājyaprāptiḥ, kāśīrājaputryā vivāhaḥ, tayorjātismarayormathurāyāṃ maraṇaṃ, yamuneśvaramāhātmyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuścatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 344||
<1.345> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā tīrthaṃ tvaparaṃ kathayāmi te | nāgatīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrtheṃ’nāgo yasmād vivāsitaḥ || 1 || atra snātvā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtāste’punarbhavāḥ | atha ghaṇṭābharaṇakaṃ tīrthaṃ vai pāvanaṃ param || 2 || tatra snātaḥ sūryalokaṃ prayātyeva na saṃśayaḥ | athānyad brahmatīrthaṃ vai vidyate yamunājale || 3 || tatra snātvā jalaṃ pītvā brahmaloke mahīyate | athānyat somatīrthaṃ vai pavitre yamunāṃbhasi || 4 || candramāstatra māṃ dṛṣṭvā pupūja bhāvatastadā | tatrābhiṣekaṃ kurvīta somaloke mahīyate || 5 || athānyat paramaṃ tīrthaṃ sarasvatīprapātanam | tatra snāto naro lakṣmi hyavarṇo’pi yatirbhavet || 6 || māthure maṇḍale yamyāṃ trirātropoṣito janaḥ | snānamātreṇa vratakṛnmucyate brahmahatyayā || 7 || atha daśāśvamedhākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ yamyāṃ tu pāvanam | mathurā paścime bhāge tatsthalaṃ cātipāvanam || 8 || tatra ye snānti niyatāsteṣāṃ svargo na durlabhaḥ | brahmaṇā mānasaṃ tīrthaṃ yamyāṃ vai nirmitaṃ purā || 9 || ṛṣibhiḥ pūjitaṃ tatra snātvā svargaṃ prayānti vai | atha vighnarājatīrthaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ śubham || 1.345.10 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ caturthyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ | tasmim̐stīrthavare snātaṃ na pīḍayati vighnarāṭ || 11 || vidyāraṃbheṣu sarveṣu yajñadānakriyāsu ca | avighnaṃ kurute tasya satataṃ pārvatīsutaḥ || 12 || athānyat koṭitīrthaṃ ca snānāt koṭigavāṃ phalam | prāṇatyāge somalokaṃ mama lokaṃ ca gacchati || 13 || ataḥ paraṃ śivakṣetramardhakrośaṃ hi vartate | tatra sthito haro devo rakṣati mathurāṃ sadā || 14|| tatra snātvā jalaṃ pītvā māthuraṃ labhate phalam | athātra muṃcati prāṇān mama lokaṃ sa gacchati || 15 || athānyat sudhanaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthānāmuttamaṃ sadā | nityaṃ vartāmi tatraiva lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 16 || māṃ dṛṣṭvā manujāḥ snātvā muktibhājo bhavanti ca | ayane viṣuve viṣṇupadīṣu grahaṇe raveḥ || 1 7|| snātvānantaphalaṃ labdhvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ | rājasūyāśvamedhotthaphalamāpnoti mānavaḥ || 18 || sudhane tīrthake snātaḥ prayāgasnānapuṇyabhāk | atrādye dvāparayuge yadvṛttaṃ tacchṛṇu priye || 19 || nāmnā tu sudhano nāma mama bhaktaḥ sadaiva hi | dhanadhānyasutadāragogṛhādisamṛddhimān || 1.345.20 || śīlasantoṣasatpūjādayādānādilakṣitaḥ | putradārasametaḥ sa madbhakto vartate sma vai || 21 || gacchanti divasāstasya māsāḥ saṃvatsarāstathā | mama bhaktyaiva sādhūnāṃ satīnāṃ sevayā sadā || 22 || karoti gṛhakṛtyāni yathālabdhadhanena saḥ | mānakūṭaṃ tulākūṭaṃ na karoti kadācana || 23 || nityaṃ trikālaṃ kurute mama pūjanamuttamam | āvāhanena dugdhādipañcāmṛtena vāriṇā || 24|| snāpanena vibhūṣābhirvividhāmbarasaddravaiḥ | puṣpadīpaistathā dhūpacandanāmṛtasatphalaiḥ || 25|| naivedyairatimiṣṭānnairjalaistāmbūlacūrṇakaiḥ | evamārātrikairnityaṃ stavanaiḥ kīrtanaistathā || 26 || pradakṣiṇairdaṇḍavadbhiḥ sadā pūjayati sma mām | ekādaśyāmupavāsaṃ kurute jāgaraṃ tathā | | 27 || nityaṃ yamyāṃ triṣavaṇaṃ snānaṃ karoti bhāvataḥ | kālindyāstīramāsādya mama mūrteḥ samīpataḥ | | 28 || rātripāde nṛtyati sma tato yāti nijaṃ gṛham | evaṃ nityaṃ karotyeva tvekādaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 29 || kārtikaśuklaikādaśyāṃ rātrau snātvā sa mandiram | prati jāgaraṇārthaṃ sa gato yamyāstaṭaṃ yadā | | 1.345.30 | | tāvatkenāpyāgatena gṛhīto brahmarakṣasā | kṛṣṇavarṇamahākāyordhvaromātibhayaṃkṛtā | | 31 | | uktaśca rākṣaso’smyatra bhakṣyārthaṃ paryaṭāmi ha | dūrāraṇyanivāso’smi bhakṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ | | 32 | | bahukālakṣudhito’smi tṛptiṃ yāsyāmi vai ciram | dṛṣṭvā śrutvā tathā kṛtvā dhairyaṃ prāha vaṇik tadā || 33 || sudhano’haṃ mahābhojyaṃ dāsye te me prasīd yat | pratīkṣasva kṣaṇaṃ me’dya dāsyāmi tava puṣkalam || 3 4| | bahumiṣṭānnasaṃmiśraṃ bhakṣayiṣyasi varṣma me | devakāryaṃ vidhāyaiva dāsye te sarvameva tat || 35 | | jāgaraṃ devadevasya karomi harivāsare | vrataṃ me sārvakālaṃ vai yajjāgarmi hareḥ puraḥ || 36 | | tatra jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prabhāte tava sannidhau | yatra kathaya tatrāhamāgamaṣyāmi taṃ vaśaḥ || 37 || kṛta jāgaraṇaṃ māṃ tvaṃ khādiṣyasi yathāsukham | viṣṇutuṣṭyairvrataṃ kāryaṃ tanme kartuṃ pradehi cet || 38 | | sarvakāmapradaṃ puṇyaṃ mokṣadaṃ vratamasti yat | mā kuru vratabhaṃgaṃ me kṛpāṃ kuru śubhaṃ bhavet || 39 | | sudhanasya vacaḥ śrutvā kṣudhito brahmarākṣasaḥ | sudhanaṃ prāha mithyā tvaṃ prabhāṣase vaṇig yataḥ ||1.345.40 | | nahi mṛtyumukhānmuktaḥ punarmṛtyumupaiti vai | mama pāśādvimuktastvaṃ punaḥ kathaṃ sameṣyasi || 41 | | rākṣasasya vacaḥ śrutvā vaṇig bhaktottamo’bravīt | jagatsarvaṃ satyamūlaṃ satye sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||42 | | sanmūlāśca prajāḥ sarvāḥ kṣudhā te’sti satī yadi | tadāhaṃ te satyabhakṣyaḥ kṣullope bhakṣyatā katham ||4 3 ||| kṣutpipāse brahmakārye brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ tu sat | tadarthe cennirmito’smi siddhiste syānna cānyathā ||44|| yadyahaṃ ca vaṇik pūrvaṃ karmaṇā nahi dūṣitaḥ | antarātmā hṛdaye me vasatyeva yathā tava ||45 || bhakto’smi satyadharmo’smi satyena pravadāmi ca | śṛṇu matsamayaṃ rakṣo yenāhaṃ punarāgamam | | 46| | kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau nṛtyaṃ kṛtvā hareḥ puraḥ | punareṣyāmyahaṃ rakṣo nāsatyaṃ mayi vartate ||47|| satyenopārjyate brahma dharmaḥ satyena rakṣyate | satyena dīyate kanyā satyavāco hi bhūsurāḥ ||48 || nṛpāḥ satyena cottīrṇāḥ satyenaṃ dhriyate kṣitiḥ | svargamokṣau pralabhyete satyavratena rākṣasa || 89 || satyena sūryastapati candraḥ satyena vardhate | kālaḥ satyena nayati vṛṣṭiḥ satyena jāyate | | 1.345.50 || ahaṃ satyena jīvāmi nāsatyaṃ kṛtavān kvacit | tatsatyaṃ mama naśyedvai yadi nāyāmi vai punaḥ | |5 1 || prasahya kāmavegena nārīṃ bhuṃkte tu yo janaḥ | tasya pāpena lipye’haṃ yadi nāyāmi te puraḥ || 52 || bhūgodānādi kṛtvā yaścāpaharati tatpunaḥ | tena pāpena lipye’haṃ nāgaccheyaṃ punaryadi ||5 3 || nārīṃ naraṃ ca vā svārthamātraṃ bhuktvā tatastyajet| | parārthaṃ na ca kurvīta tatpāpaṃ nāgame mama ||5 4|| satīṃ pativratāṃ bhāryāṃ tyajennirāgasāṃ tu yaḥ | tena pāpena lipye’haṃ punastvanāgame mama |||55 || paṃktibhedaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādekapaṃktyaśināṃ puraḥ | tasya pāpena lipye’haṃ nāgantā yadi te puraḥ || 56 || vratabhaṃgaprakarturyat tatpāpaṃ nāgame tu me | parahiṃsakapāpaṃ me nāgantā yadi te puraḥ ||57|| dvijatyāgisatīsādhudevānāṃ nindakasya yat | pāpaṃ tanme bhaved rakṣo yadi me nāgamaḥ punaḥ ||5 8 || gurumitrasuhṛddrohakṛto yatpāpameva tat | nāgaccheyaṃ yadi te’gre satyaṃ bravīmi rākṣasa || 59 || tīrthe kṛtāni pāpāni me syuranāgame punaḥ | brahmaghne ca surāpe ca caure bhagnavrate śaṭhe || 1.345.60 || viśvāsaghātake cātatāyini bālaghātake | yā gatistāṃ prapadyehaṃ yadi me nāgamaḥ punaḥ || 61 || nirāgasāṃ tu prāṇināṃ rodhane māraṇe tathā | yatpāpaṃ tad bhavenme’tra yadi me nāgamaḥ punaḥ || 62 | etajjanmottaraṃ pāpaṃ rakṣojanma prayāmyaham | yadyahaṃ satyamutsṛjya nāgaccheyaṃ pratārakaḥ | | 63 | | itivākyāni vaṇijaḥ śrutvā tuṣṭaḥ sa rākṣasaḥ | viśvāsayati cāpanno gacchetyāyāhi cāha tam || 64|| vaṇik śīghraṃ gṛhaṃ me tu samāgatya pupūja māma | mamāgre nartanaṃ kṛtvā cakre prajāgaraṃ mudā | | 65 | | prabhāte sa punarnamonārāyaṇāya vai muhuḥ | vadan kurvan muhurdaṇḍavad yayau yamunātaṭe | | 66 | | kālindīsnānakṛd bhakto rakṣomārgaṃ prayāti ha | ahaṃ dayāparo bhūtvā mārgamābadhya saṃsthitaḥ | | 67 | | divyarūpadharaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam vilokya sudhano bhakto māṃ provāca caturbhujam || 68 || oṃ namaste bhagavate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya ca | bhaktamokṣapradāyātra divyadarśanadāya ca | | 69 || sa ca pṛṣṭo mayā lakṣmi kva vaṇik prasthito drutam | pratyuvāca sa sudhano gacchāmi rākṣasāntikam | |1.345.7 0 | | mayā nivāritaḥ śrutvā na gantavyaṃ na vai na vai | jīvatā tvarjyate dharmo mṛte kiṃ mokṣasādhanam | |7 1 | | tathāpi sa na vai śrutvā natvā māṃ rākṣasāntikam | gatvovāca yatheṣṭaṃ bho rakṣo bhakṣaya mā ciram | | 72 || yathānyāyaṃ vidhānena yathā vā tava rocate | satyaṃ mayā sadā rakṣyaṃ bhuṃkṣva rākṣasa mā ciram | |7 3 | | rākṣasaścaitadāścaryaṃ samākalayya taṃ prati | tuṣṭo bhūtvo samuvāca vaṇik tvaṃ jītavānasi | |74|| tvayā satyavrato dharmaḥ pālitastena toṣaṇam | prāpto’smi me kṣudhā naṣṭā tṛptirjātā ca śāśvatī | | 75 | | aho satyavratasyātra kathaṃ drohaṃ karomyaham | kintu yāvajjāgarasya mama puṇyaṃ prayaccha vai | |76 || satyapuṇyaprabhāvena yathāhaṃ muktimāpnuyām | sudhanastadvacaḥ śrutvā tadā provāca rākṣasam | | 77 || jānāsi rākṣasa kīdṛk puṇyaṃ syājjāgarasya vai | ghaṭikājāgrateḥ puṇyaṃ māhendrapadadāyakam | | 78 | | ghaṭikādvaya jāgratoḥ vedhasaḥ padamuttamam | ardharātrijāgrato vai vairājapadamuttamam | | 79 | | ūnarātrijāgrato vai vaikuṇṭhapadameva ha | āprātarjāgrato muktirbrahmalokapradā bhavet || 1.345.80 | | ghaṭikārdhaṃ jāgratastu sāmrājyaṃ jāyate khalu | jāgrati nṛtyatastvasya goloko jāyate dhruvam | |8 1 || tasmānnahaṃ pradāsyāmi phalaṃ sampūrṇajāgrateḥ | ardhe dehi tadardhaṃ vā tadardhārdhaṃ pradehi me ||82|| mā lobhaṃ kuru bhaktendra mokṣaṃ kuru mamāpi bhoḥ | ityarthito’pi sudhano mokṣalobhī dadau na vai ||83|| punaśca prārthayāmāsa sudhanaṃ brahmarākṣasaḥ | ekanṛtyasya me puṇyaṃ dehi tvaṃ vaṇiguttama ||84| sudhanastaṃ samapṛcchad vada me tava pūrvajam | vṛttāntaṃ sakalaṃ paścād dāsye tvekanṛteḥ phalam ||85|| kiṃ tvaṃ māṃ na vijānāsi vaṇijaṃ prāha rākṣasaḥ | tava gṛhasamīpe’hamagnidattastu bhūsuraḥ ||86|| tava mitraṃ samāsaṃ sa evāhaṃ nijakarmabhiḥ | brāhmaṇaśchāndasaścāpi rākṣasatvamupāgataḥ ||87|| mayārabdhaṃ subhavanaṃ dvibhaumaṃ tava bhaumavat | tadarthamiṣṭikā rātrau parakīyāḥ sadāharam ||88|| pāpamakaravaṃ cauryaṃ gṛhaṃ pūrṇaṃ ca nābhavat | jvareṇa pīḍito madhye harmyasya vāsanānvitaḥ ||89|| cauryadoṣeṇa vipro’pi brahmarākṣasatāṃ gataḥ | so’haṃ mitraṃ vaṇigvarya tavāsmīti vibhāvya vai ||1.345.90 || mitre prāpte dayāṃ kṛtvā hyupakāraṃ kuruṣva me | ekanṛtyasya puṇyaṃ me dehi yena gatirmama ||9 1 || mokṣamayī bhaved bhakta muhuścābhyarthayāmyaham | śrutvā kṛpārdrahṛdayo vaṇig rākṣasamāha vai ||92|| sādhu rākṣasa dattaṃ te tvekanṛtyaphalaṃ mayā | ityuccārya jalaṃ yāvad dadāti rakṣasaḥ kare ||93|| tāvadrakṣaḥśarīraṃ vai patitaṃ bhūtale tadā | ātmā caturbhujo bhūtvā pārṣadaḥ śrīhareryathā ||94|| tathā bhūtvā dvyaṣṭavarṣo vyarājata vaṇikpuraḥ | taṃ netumāgato viṣṇurdivyapārṣadaśobhitaḥ ||95|| sudhanastaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā pādayordharaṇiṃ gataḥ | uvāca svaprabhuṃ tatra bhagavam̐stāritau tvayā ||96|| rākṣasasya nṛtyaleśād muktido’sti bhavān yathā | mamāpi ca tathā muktipradātā bhava mādhava ||97|| tadovāca madhuraṃ taṃ devadevo janārdanaḥ | ehi tvamapi bhaktendra viprendro’pi sametu me ||98|| sudhanāśu kuṭumbaṃ te sametu mama vāhane | vimānavaramāruhya mama lokaṃ vrajantu vai ||99|| ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvān vimānake | ārohayitvā suyayau vaikuṇṭhaṃ dhāma śāśvatam || 1.345.100 || yatrāścaryamabhūt tvaitat tīrthaṃ sudhanasaṃjñitam | kārtike dhavale tatra dvādaśyāṃ snānakāriṇaḥ || 101 || rājasūyaphalaṃ syācca dānātsvargaṃ phalaṃ bhavet | pūrṇimāyāṃ vṛṣotsargakartā kulāni tārayet || 1 02|| śrāddhakartā pūrvajām̐śca tārayedatra tīrthake | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi sudhanasya pramokṣaṇam || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mathurākṣetramāhātmye nāgatīrthaghaṇṭābharaṇakatīrthasomatīrthasarasvatīdaśāśvamedhatīrtharājavighnarājakoṭiśivakṣetrasudhanatīrthānāṃ sudhanapradattanṛtyapuṇyena brahmarākṣasasya muktiścetyādeśca nirūpaṇanāmā pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 345||
<1.346> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmimāthure tu maṇḍale’paratīrthakam | vatsakrīḍanakaṃ tīrthaṃ raktaprastaranirmitam || 1 || tatra snānena vai yāyād vāyulokaṃ tu mānavaḥ | prāṇatyāge tu paramā muktiḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 2 || atha bhāṇḍīrakaṃ tīrthaṃ dampatītvapradaṃ param | yatra kṛṣṇena rādhā vai vivāhitā vanasthale || 3 || sālatālārjunairyukte tamāleṅgudapīlukaiḥ | karīraraktapuṣpaiśca yukte bhāṇḍīrake sthale || 4 || snātaḥ pāpavinirmuktaścandralokaṃ prayāti saḥ | prāṇatyāge tu golokaṃ prāpnoti nātra saṃśayaḥ || 5 || vṛndāvanaṃ mama tīrthaṃ yatra gogopagopikāḥ | mayā sākaṃ ramiṣyanti vicitrakrīḍanaiḥ sadā || 6 || sarveṣāṃ durlabhe sthāne kuṇḍe vṛndāvanasthale | bahugulmalatāraṇye snātaḥ svarge’psarogaṇaiḥ || 7 || gandharvaiḥ sevamānaśca modate bahuvatsarān | tatra cenmuñcati prāṇān vaikuṇṭhe modate dhruvam || 8 || atha vṛndāvane keśī daityo yatra nipātitaḥ | tatra snātaḥ śataguṇaṃ puṇyamāpnotyasaṃśayam || 9 || hariviśrāmatīrthaṃ ca tato’pi śatapuṇyadam | tatra piṇḍapradānena gayātulyaphalaṃ bhavet || 1.346.10 || snānaṃ dānaṃ ca havanaṃ vahniṣṭomaphalapradam | atha dvādaśasūryāṇāṃ tīrthaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ paraṃ matam || 11 || kālindīsalile kṛṣṇaḥ kālīyasarpamastake | nanarta damanārthaṃ taṃ tatrādityā daśojjvalāḥ || 1 2|| mayaiva sthāpitā lakṣmi varārthaṃ jñāpitāstadā | ādityāśca tadā procuryadi deyo varo’sti naḥ || 1 3|| asmattīrthe’tra lokānāṃ snānena mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet | uttare haridevasya kālīyasya tu dakṣiṇe || 14|| madhye ye syurmṛtāsteṣāṃ muktirgolokadhāmani | bhavedityarthitaṃ taiśca tathāstviti mayārpitam || 15|| atha yamyāḥ pare pāre tīrthaṃ tu malayārjunam | paryastaṃ tatra śakaṭaṃ kuṇḍaṃ tatra suvidyate || 16|| tatra snānopavāsābhyāmanantaphalabhāg bhavet | dvādaśyāṃ jyeṣṭhaśuklasya snānād dānācca darśanāt || 17|| acyutasya samarcanāt prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim | upoṣitaṃ janaṃ sākṣāt kṛṣṇo netuṃ pragacchati || 18|| api cāsmatkule jātaḥ kālindīsalile plutaḥ | arcayiṣyati govindaṃ mathurāyāmupoṣitaḥ || 19|| dhanyo’sau piṇḍanirvāpaṃ yamunāyāṃ kariṣyati | dvādaśyāṃ jyeṣṭhamāse’tra tṛptirna saṃbhaviṣyati ||1.346.20|| iti gāyanti pitaraḥ paralokagatāḥ sadā | athātra subhagaṃ tīrthaṃ vanaṃ bahulasaṃjñakam || 21 || snāto rudrasya bhavanaṃ prayāti dvādaśī tithau | caitraśukladaśamyāṃ tu snāto matpadamāpnuyāt ||22|| atha bhāṇḍahradastīrthaṃ pare pāre suvidyate | dṛśyante’harahastatra tvādityāḥ supataṅgakāḥ || 23||| arkakuṇḍe tatra tīrthe snānaṃ yaḥ kurute janaḥ | sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sūryalokaṃ prayāti saḥ ||24|| athātra vimalaḥ kūpaḥ saptasāmudranāmakaḥ | tatra snātā yatheṣṭaḥ syāt sveṣṭaṃ lokaṃ prayāti saḥ ||25|| tatra prāṇaprayāṇe tu mama dhāma prapadyate | atha vīrasthalaṃ nāma tīrthakṣetraṃ paraṃ śubham ||26|| āsannasalilaṃ caiva padmotpalavibhūṣitam | tatra snātā vīralokaṃ prāpyānte dhāma yāti me ||27|| kuśasthalaṃ tathā kṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ paramapāvanam | snātvā yāti brahmalokaṃ mṛtvā golokamṛcchati ||28|| tatra puṣpasthalatīrthe śivakṣetramanuttamam | tatra snānena manujaḥ śivalokaṃ pragacchati ||29|| atha gopīśvaramūrtirmahāpātakanāśinī | mātalisthāpitā mokṣapradā gopīśatīrthake ||1.346.30|| kṛṣṇasya ramaṇārthaṃ hi gopyastatra sahasraśaḥ | samāgatāstadā kṛṣṇo jātaḥ sahasrarūpadhṛk ||3 1|| gopīṃ gopīṃ prati reme yatheṣṭaṃ sukhadaḥ prabhuḥ | mātalistatra cāgatya gopīśvaraṃ vidhāya ca || 32|| gopaveṣadharaṃ devamabhiṣekaṃ cakāra ha | ānīya saptakalaśān ratnauṣadhipariplutān ||33 || gopyo gāyanti nṛtyanti kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa vadanti ca | tatra saptakalaśaiśca sthāpayāmāsa kūpakam ||34|| sapta sāmudrikaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ golokadhāmadam | tatra śrāddhe jaladātrā piṇḍadātrā ca sarvathā ||35|| pitarastāritāstena kulānāṃ saptasaptatiḥ | somavāre tvamāyāṃ ca śrāddhakartustu pūrvajāḥ || 26 || pitarastasya tṛpyanti koṭivarṣaśatāni vai | govindasya ca devasya tathā gopīśvarasya ca || 37|| madhye mṛto jano yāti mahendrasya salokatām | tathā bahularudrasya govindasya ca madhyataḥ || 38|| tathā vai vedhasaścāpi gopīśasya ca madhyataḥ | piṇḍadānasnānakartuḥ kulānāṃ śatamuddharet ||39|| vasutīrthaṃ mathurādakṣiṇe phālgunakaṃ tathā | tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca mama loke mahīyate ||1.346.40 || tatra phālgunake tīrthe vṛṣabhāṃjanakaṃ sthalam | tatrābhiṣekamāpannaḥ suraiḥ saha pramodate ||41|| atha tālavanaṃ nāma mathurāpaścimasthitam | tatra kuṇḍe snānakartā dātā vāñcchitamāpnuyāt ||42|| asti saṃpīṭhakaṃ tīrthaṃ snātāgniṣṭomapuṇyabhāk | kṛṣṇajanmasthale lakṣmi saptamyāṃ somavāsare ||43|| vrataṃ kṛtvā pūjayenmāṃ sā tu putravatī bhavet | viṃśatiryojanānāṃ tu māthuraṃ mama maṇḍalam ||44|| yatra tatra kṛtasnāno mucyate ghorapātakaiḥ | varṣākāle’tra sthātavyaṃ yatsthānaṃ sukhadaṃ bhavet ||45|| saptadvīpeṣu tīrthāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca | mathurāyāṃ gamiṣyanti prasupte tu sadā mayi ||46|| suptotthitaṃ ca māṃ dṛṣṭvā bhavanti muktibhājanāḥ | yamunāyāṃ kṛtasnānaḥ kṛtakeśavadarśanaḥ ||587|| sarvapāpavihīnaḥ sanmamalokaṃ prapadyate | pade pade phalaṃ yāti rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ ||48|| pradakṣiṇīkṛto yena mathurāyāṃ tu keśavaḥ | pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena saptadvīpā vasundharā ||49|| ghṛtadīpaṃ tathā vastraṃ dadyāt kṛṣṇāya mandire | pañcayojanavistāraṃ dīrghaṃ ṣaṭpaṃcayojanam ||1.346.50|| dīpamālāsamākīrṇaṃ vimānaṃ labhate janaḥ | sarvakāmasamṛddhaṃ tadapsarogaṇasevitam ||5 1 || sarvakāmapradaṃ ramyaṃ sarvatejovirājitam | siddhacāraṇamagandharvā yadicchanti divaṃ gatāḥ ||52|| yadi puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ syādvai labhyetaitādṛśaṃ gṛham | ante mokṣastvapāyyeta mathurāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ ||53 || mathurāṃ rakṣati pūrvāmindro yamastu dakṣiṇām | paścimāṃ rakṣati vārīśaḥ kuberastathottarām ||54|| madhyaṃ rakṣati me bhaktaḥ śaṃkaraḥ pārvatīpatiḥ | mathurāyāṃ gṛhaṃ yo vā prāsādaṃ kurute janaḥ || 95|| caturbhujastu vijñeyo jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ | mathurāyāṃ mahatkuḍaṃ vimalodakanāmakam || 56 || hemante tu bhaveccoṣṇaṃ śītalaṃ grīṣmake bhavet | na vardhate ca varṣāsu grīṣme cāpi na hīyate ||57|| etattu mahadāścaryaṃ tasmina kuṇḍe paraṃ mama | māthure mama kṣetre tu garteṣu ca nadīṣu ca ||58|| kūpe hrade devakhāte pravāhe saṃgame tathā | snātavyaṃ yatra vā tatra tena syātparamā gatiḥ ||59 || kārtikasya tu māsasya navamyāṃ mama bhaktarāṭ | kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ yāti pṛthvīprakramaṇavṛṣam || 1.346.60 || na dānairna tapobhiśca na yajñaistādṛśaṃ phalam | bhūmeḥ pradakṣiṇāyāḥ syād yādṛśaṃ tīrthasevayā || 61 || bhūmyāḥ parikrame samyag yojanānāṃ pramāṇakam | ṣaṣṭikoṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni ca || 62|| tatra tīrthāni devāśca gaṇitāḥ pavanenavai | brahmaṇā lomaśenāpi nāradena dhruveṇa ca ||6 3 || patnāvratena vipreṇa garuḍena hanūmatā | etairanekadhā devaiḥ savārdhyāvaraṇā mahī || 64|| kramitā balibhiḥ sarvairbāhyamaṇḍalarekhayā | yogasiddhaistathā kaiścirnmākaṇḍeyamukhairapi ||65 || saptadvīpe ca tīrthānāṃ bhramaṇād yatphalaṃ bhavet | prāpyate tvadhikaṃ tasmānmathurāyāḥ parikrame ||66 || yathāvidhānakramaṇaṃ mathurāyāṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet | pradakṣiṇaphalaṃ samyaganukramavidhiṃ bruve || 67|| sarvadeveṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalam | sarvadāneṣu yatpuṇyamiṣṭāpūrteṣu yatphalam || 68 || tatphalaṃ labhyate lakṣmi māthurasya pradakṣiiṇe | devarṣimunisahitā brahmādyāḥ koṭidevatāḥ || 69 || navamyāṃ kārtike śukle cakrūmāthuraprakramam | aṣṭamyāṃ mathurāṃ prāpya snātvā viśrāntitīrthake ||1.346.7 0 || kṛtvā pitṛsurarṣīṇāṃ pūjana yamunārcanam | viśrāntidarśanaṃ kṛtvā dīrghaviṣṇuṃ ca keśavam || 71 || upavāsaṃ prakṛtvaiva svalpamedhyāśano’thavā | brahmacaryaparo bhūtvā maunamāsthāya yatnataḥ ||7 2 || tilākṣatakuśānnītvā viśrāntau dīpamādadet | navamyāṃ prātarevāsmātsthalād yātrāmupākramet ||73 || brāhme kāle raveḥ pūrvaṃ snāyād dakṣiṇakoṭike | prakṣālya pādāvācamya hanumantaṃ prasādayet ||74|| sarvamagaladaṃ siddhikartāraṃ phalasākṣiṇam | pradakṣiṇasya yātrāyāṃ yātrāsiddhiprado bhava ||71|| iti vijñāpya vidhivaddhanūmantaṃ gaṇeśvaram | dīpapuṣpopahārādyaiḥ pūjayitvāgratastataḥ ||76|| pūjayetpadmanābhaṃ ca dīrghaviṣṇuṃ sukhapradam | dṛṣṭvā vasumatīṃ devīṃ tathānyāmaparājitām ||77|| āyudhāgārasaṃsthāṃ ca natvā gacchet tato’grataḥ | kaṃsavāsanikāṃ tadvadaugrasenāṃ ca carcikām ||78 || vadhūṭī tatra natvā ca dānavakṣayakāriṇīm | jayadāṃ ca tato natvā mātṛm̐śca devapūjitāḥ ||79 || gṛhadevīrvāstudevīrdṛṣṭvānujñāpya niḥsaret | dakṣiṇakoṭikaṃ prāpya snātvā santarpya pitṛkān ||1.346.8 0 || devaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ saṃpraṇamya cekṣuvāsāṃ satīṃ vrajet | yatra bālakrīḍanakaistīrthaṃ kṛṣṇena vai kṛtam ||8 1 || vatsaputra tato gacchet tato’rkasthalameva ca | vīrasthalaṃ kuśasthalaṃ puṇyasthalaṃ mahāsthalam ||82|| pañcasthalāvalokena brahmaṇā saha modate | śivaṃ siddhamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā hayamuktiṃ ca lokayet ||8 3 || aśvo muktiṃ gataścātra sahāyasahito yataḥ | rājaputraḥ sthitastatra yānayātrāṃ na cācaret ||84|| mallikādarśanaṃ kṛtvā kadambakhaṇḍamāvrajet | carcikāṃ yoginīṃ dṛṣṭvā tato gacchettu mātaram ||85|| aspṛśyāṃ cāspṛśāṃ te dve bālarakṣākare hyubhe | varṣakhātaṃ tato gatvā kuṇḍaṃ pitṛm̐śca tarpayet| ||86 || kṣetrapālaṃ śivaṃ bhūteśvaraṃ gacchet prapūjayet | kṛṣṇakrīḍāsetubandhaṃ tato gacched balihradam ||87|| tataḥ kukkaṭakrīḍākhyaṃ sthalaṃ gacched gatipradam | stambhoccayaṃ suśikharaṃ pūjyettaṃ parikramet ||88 || mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ vrajettu saḥ | vasudevasya devakyā ekāntaśayanasthalam ||89|| gatvā nārāyaṇasthānaṃ praviśecca parikramet | vighnavināyakaṃ natvā kubjikāṃ vāmanāṃ tathā || 1.346.90|| kṛṣṇadāsyau tu viprāṇyau natvā garteśvaraṃ vrajet | mahāvidyeśvarīṃ dṛṣṭvā yātrāsiddhiphalaṃ bhavet ||9 1 || prabhāmallīṃ mahāvidyeśvarīṃ vrajecca pūjayet | siddheśvarīṃ tathā saṃketeśvarīṃ ca prapūjayet ||92|| yasyāścāgre daityanāśārthaṃ saṃketitavān hariḥ | kuṇḍe tvācamanaṃ kṛtvā gokarṇeśvaramāvrajet ||93|| sarasvatīṃ nadīṃ dṛṣṭvā vighnarājaṃ samāvrajet | gaṃgāṃ dṛṣṭvā tathā spṛṣṭvā gacched rudramahālayam ||94|| kṣetrapaṃ taṃ samānatvottarakoṭigaṇādhipam | pūjayedyatra kṛṣṇena dyūtakrīḍā kṛtābhavat ||95|| tato gacchenmahātīrthaṃ vimalaṃ yamunāmbhasi | rudramahālayākhyaṃ tat snāyāt pitṝm̐śca tarpayet ||96|| gārgyatīrthaṃ tato gacched bhadreśvaraṃ ca somakam | someśvaraṃ prapūjyaiva yātrāphalaṃ labhejjanaḥ ||97|| sarasvatyāḥ saṃgame ca devarṣipitṛmānavān | santarpya vidhivad datvā kṛṣṇasāyujyamāpnuyāt ||98|| ghaṇṭābharaṇakaṃ gatvā tathā garuḍakeśave | dhārālopanakaṃ gatvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ khaṇḍavelakam ||99|| mandākinīsaṃyamana cāsikuṇḍaṃ ca gopakam | muktikeśvaramevātha vailakṣagaruḍaṃ sthalam || 1.346.100 || gatvā sarvatra pitṝm̐śca devānsamarpya tarpayet | prārthayenmathurāyāśca yātrā me saphalāstviti || 10 1|| ityevaṃ devadeveśaṃ vijñāpya kṣetrapaṃ śivam | viśrāntisaṃjñake snātvā kṛtvā ca pitṛtarpaṇam || 102|| viśrāntiṃ ca parikramya guruṃ natvā hariṃ tathā | sumaṃgalāṃ tato gacched yātrāsiddhiṃ prasādayet || 10 3|| yātreyaṃ tvatprasādena saphalā me bhavatviti | pippalādeśvaraṃ gatvā parikramedupālipet || 104|| ekaṃ śivaṃ svasya nāmnā sthāpayed yātrikastadā | yātrāphalaṃ prapadyeta pūjayetpraṇamet tathā || 1 05|| karkoṭakaṃ tathā nāgaṃ gacched devīṃ ca caṇḍikām | vajrānanaṃ tato dhyātvā tataḥ sūryaṃ kuleśvaram || 106 || dṛṣṭvā tatraiva dānaṃ ca datvā yātrāṃ samāpayet | pratikramaṃ kulānāṃ vai sūryaloke sthitirbhavet || 1 07|| pradakṣiṇaprakartā ca viṣṇuloke mahīyate | mama pradakṣiṇakartā goloke ca mahīyate || 1 08|| brahmaghnāśca surāpāśca caurā bhagnavratāśca ye | prasahya gamakā ye ca dhanakṣetrāpahārakāḥ || 109|| hiṃsakā duḥkhadātāro nindakāḥ śaṭhadhūrtakāḥ | mathurākramaṇaṃ kṛtvā niṣpāpāste bhavanti vai || 1.346.11 0|| anyadeśāgato dūrād yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇam | tasya saṃdarśanādanye pūtā bhavanti mānavāḥ || 1 1 1|| yamunāyā vārikaṇaṃ pītvā dūranivāsinaḥ | sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim || 112|| mathurāvāsakartāro madhurātīrthasevinaḥ | madhurāvanadraṣṭāro mokṣabhājo bhavanti te || 113|| madhuvanaṃ tālavanaṃ kundavanaṃ tṛtīyakam | kāmyakavanaṃ ca bahuvanaṃ bhadravanaṃ tathā || 1 14|| khādiraṃ ca mahāvanaṃ lohārgalavanaṃ tathā | bilvavanaṃ ca bhāṇḍīraṃ vṛndāvanaṃ ca dvādaśam || 1 15|| etāni ye prapaśyanti na te yāmyābhigāminaḥ | vanayātrāprakartāra indralokaṃ vrajanti vai || 1 16|| mama bhaktāśca ye yātrāṃ madarthaṃ tvācaranti te | narā nāryaśca goloke yānti māmeva śāśvatam || 1 17|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mathurākṣetramāhātmye vatsakrīḍanakabhāṇḍīrakavṛndāvanahariviśrāmasūryatīrthamalayārjunabahulabhāṇḍahradārkakuṇḍavimalakūpavīrasthalakuśasthalapuṣpasthalagopīśvarasaptasāmudrikavasuphālgunakavṛṣabhāṃjanakatālavanasaṃpīṭhakavimalodakakuṇḍānāṃ nirdeśaḥ, mathurāpradakṣiṇe vidhiḥ, tatratyatīrthānāṃ kramanirdeśo viśrāntighaṭṭāraṃbhaṇasamāptyādi, vanāni cetyādipradarśananāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 346||
<1.347> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca athānyatte pravakṣyāmi mahālakṣmi śṛṇuṣva tat | mathurāyā uttarasthe cakratīrthe’bhavattu yat || 1 || jambūdvīpe mahāgṛhodayapattanavāsakṛt | brāhmaṇaḥ svasya kanyāṃ ca putraṃ cādāya vedavit || 2 || śālagrāmaṃ mahākṣetraṃ yayau yātrārthameva saḥ | nivāsamakarot tatra snāyī tīrthasurārcakaḥ || 3 || devatānāṃ darśane’sya siddhaḥ kaścid dṛśeḥ pathi | samāyātaḥ kalāpākhyagrāmavāsī narākṛtiḥ || 4 || siddho nityaṃ darśanārthaṃ samāyāti viyāti ca | viprasya parṇaśālāyāṃ viśrāntiṃ labhate’pi ca || 5 || varṇayati sma kalāpagrāmasyātivibhūtikāḥ | śrutvā viprasya gamane jātā buddhistato dvijaḥ || 6 || prāha siddhaṃ mama mitraṃ bhavānadya hi vartate | kalāpaṃ māṃ naya mitra te paśyāmi vibhūtikāḥ || 7 || siddhaḥ prāha tu viprendra tatra te na gatirbhavet | śarīraṃ śītavātaistu nāśaṃ yāsyati te dvija || 8 || tathāpi brāhmaṇaḥ prāha tava yogena māṃ naya | evamabhyarthitaḥ siddhaḥ kanyāṃ putraṃ ca mitrakam | | 9 | | kare saṃgṛhyotpapāta vyomni yogabalena vai | kalāpe svāśrame nyastaṃ siddhena brāhmaṇatrayam || 1.347.1 0|| tatra kālena yātena vipro rugṇo’bhavattadā | mṛtyuyogyaṃ pitaraṃ ca ninye gaṃgātaṭaṃ sutaḥ | | 1 1|| sutā cāpi svapitaraṃ sevate pathyavastubhiḥ | ekadā parṇaśālāyāṃ pitrarthe pākamācarat | | 12| | tadā kaścid brāhmaṇo’pi bhikṣārthaṃ gṛhamāgataḥ | pṛṣṭo’sau bhadrayā tayā kva bhavām̐stvamihāgataḥ || 1 3|| sa prāha kānyakubjasya vipro’haṃ siddhatāṃ gataḥ | vicarāmi mahātīrthe kalāpe’tra sukhī sadā || 14|| kanyayāveditaḥ pitre bhrātre sa siddhadehavān | pitrā dattā vicāryaiva kanyā siddhadvijāya sā | | 15|| siddho’pyayaṃ hi jāmātā vasati śvaśuragṛhe | kālena kṣaṇatāṃ prāptaṃ śvaśuraṃ paryapṛcchata | | 16|| kathaṃ rogaḥ kadā tvasya vināśo’pi bhaviṣyati | yathā rogavināśaḥ syāttathā karomi sevanam || 17|| jāmātṛvacanaṃ śrutvā śvaśuraḥ śāntimāvrajat | prāha jāmātaraṃ bhavān siddhyā jānāti ced vada || 18|| jāmātā siddhimān dhyātvā śvaśuraṃ prāha bho dvija | | kalāpe’tra nivasatā śūdrānnaṃ bhakṣitaṃ tvayā || 1 9|| ajānatārpitaṃ tena bhakṣitaṃ cāpyajānatā | tena doṣeṇa rogo’yaṃ vartate varṣmaṇi dvija ||1.347.20|| pādayorvidyate cānnaṃ jānvorūrdhve na vidyate | śūdrānnena vihīnasya vipra mṛtyurbhaviṣyati ||21|| jāmātṛvacanaṃ śrutvātmānaṃ vipro’tyagarhayat | duḥkhena pīḍitaḥ kṣīṇo martumaicchad dvijottamaḥ ||22|| atha prabhāte jāmātā sutā putraśca te trayaḥ | kāryārtha tu yayurgehād bahistāvat kṣaṇāntare ||23|| nirjanāvasaraṃ labdhvā maraṇaṃ pravicārya ca | gaṃgātīrāt samuttiṣṭhan diśaḥ sarvā vilokayan |||24|| sannidhāvupalāṃ dṛṣṭvā gṛhītvā parṇakṛdgṛhe | cūrṇayāmāsa tau pādau pīḍayā duḥkhito dvijaḥ ||25|| tataḥ prāṇān parityajya gato’sau svargamuttamam | jāmātā ca sutā putraḥ kāryaṃ kṛtvāyayurgṛham ||26|| tāvanmṛtaṃ tu taṃ vṛddhaṃ dṛṣṭvā ruruduratyati | sarpaśṛṃgihatānāṃ ca daṃṣṭriprāṇihatasya ca || 27|| ātmaghātakṛtasyāpi nāsti saṃskārayogyatā | kathamasya bhaved dāho vicāryeti punaśca te ||28|| prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyīta na dadyāccodakakriyām | iti vidhiṃ samāśritya cakrurdāhādikaṃ tataḥ || 29|| prāyaścittaṃ tathā cakruryayurgrāmaṃ kalāpakam | tatrasthaṃ mṛtaviprasya mitraṃ siddhaṃ praṇamya te || 1.347.30 || maraṇādikamāṃvedya kṣaṇaṃ cakruḥ praśocanam | kalāpasthaśca siddho’yaṃ prāha jāmātaraṃ dvijam ||3 1 || brahmahatyā tu te jātā prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kuru | vṛddhasiddhavacaḥ bhūtvā jāmātā vākyamabravīt ||32||| na mayā brāhmaṇavadhaḥ kadācidapi vai kṛtaḥ | kena doṣeṇa me pūjya brahmahatyā phalaṃ vada ||33|| jāmāturvacanaṃ śrutvā vṛddhasiddhastamabravīt | tvayā tatpādayoḥ śūdrasyānnaṃ cāstīti darśitam || 34||| tadannasya kṣaye mṛtyurityapi darśitaṃ tathā | vipreṇa tena ca tadvaccūrṇitau caraṇau svakau || 35|| mṛtyuḥ kṛtastatastatra doṣabhāk tvaṃ tathābhavaḥ | iti tvayā vadhopāyo nirdiṣṭaśca dvijottama ||36|| tena doṣeṇa viprarṣe brahmahatyāphalaṃ tava | āsannaśayanāccaiva bhojanāt kathanāttathā ||37|| pāpaṃ saṃkramate vyaktau sahasaṃcaraṇāttathā | tataḥ śuddhiḥ prakartavyā māstu vāso mama gṛhe ||38|| kalpagrāmaṃ parityajya mathurāṃ yāhi bhūsura | nānyatra tava śuddhiḥ syādityavehi prayāhi ca ||39|| śrutvā vṛddhasya tadvākyaṃ mathurāṃ te trayo yayuḥ | patnī ca śālakastena jāmātrā siddhavidyayā ||1.347.40 || utpatatā vyomamārge tvānītau mathurāṃ prati | brāhmaṇebhyo bahiḥsthāne vasatiṃ cakrurādarāt ||41 || mathurāyāṃ tadā rājñaḥ satre vai kuśikasya ca | viprāṇāṃ dve sahasre tu bhuñjete medhyamanvaham ||42 || brahmayajñakṛtocchiṣṭaṃ bhuṃjate te trayastataḥ | cakratīrthaṃ samāsādya snānaṃ ca kurvate sadā ||43 || patnī yajñaprasādaṃ svapatiṃ bhikṣāgataṃ niśi | bhojayitvā prabhuṃkte ca varṣārdhaṃ vigataṃ tathā ||44|| tato bhikṣārthamāyātaṃ siddhaṃ papracchurādarāt | viprā yajñaprakartāraḥ kutra santiṣṭhase dvija ||45|| bhojanaṃ kuruṣe kutra sthitvā vad yathātatham | siddhaśca kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ svātmano hitam ||46 || bhikṣāṃ tvatra gṛhītvāhaṃ bhāryayā śālakena ca | sahitaścakratīrthe’tra samāplāvya vibhajya ca || 47|| bhojanaṃ vai karomyatra brahmahatyānivṛttaye | tacchrutvā brāhmaṇāḥ sarve ūcuḥ śuddho’si vai dvija ||48 || cakratīrthaprabhāveṇa pāpānmukto’si sarvathā | viprāṇāṃ vacanāccaiva punaḥ śuddho’si vai dvija ||49 || iti viprakṛtāṃ śuddhiṃ cakratīrthakṛtāṃ tathā | prāyaścittakṛtāṃ cāpi prasādasyāśanāttathā ||1.347.5 0 || prāpya siddhaḥ pramumoda sabhāryāśālakastathā | cakratīrthaṃ samāgatya bhikṣāṃ bhoktuṃ vyavasthitaḥ ||5 1 || patnī hṛṣṭena manasā bhartāraṃ vākyamabravīt | bhojanaṃ kuru viprendra hatyāṃ lakṣyāmi te gatām ||52|| cakratīrthaprabhāveṇa hatyā naṣṭā dvijottama | tasmādatra mathurāyāṃ nityaṃ sthātavyameva ha ||5 3 || te vyavasya trayastatra mathurāyāṃ sadā sthitāḥ | kalāpaṃ saṃparityajya mathurā bhuktimuktidā ||||54|| bhadreśvaraṃ tu tattīrthaṃ siddhasevitamityatha | kalāpāddhi śataguṇaṃ cakratīrthaṃ hi puṇyadam ||55|| ahorātropavāsena brahmahatyā vinaśyati | kiṃ tasya tu kalāpena vārāgāsyāthavāpi kim ||56|| mathurā yadi saṃlabdhā cakratīrthaṃ ca sevitam | api kīṭaḥ pataṃgo vā jāyate sa caturbhujaḥ ||57|| kāladharmaṃ samāpannāstrayaste brāhmaṇāḥ priye | prāpurme divyagolokaṃ caturbhujā hi śāśvatāḥ ||58 || śṛṇu cānyat pravakṣyāmi balaṃ vaikuṇṭhatīrthajam | mithilāvāsino lokāstīrthārthaṃ mathurāṃ gatāḥ ||59 || vaikuṇṭhatīrthamāsādya sthitāsteṣāṃ tu bhūsuraḥ | kaścidāsīd brahmahatyāpāpena tvatipīḍitaḥ ||1.347.60 || rudhirasya tu vai dhārā sravantī tasya hastataḥ | pratyakṣā dṛśyate bahutīrthasnāne’pi no gatā ||61|| kintu vaikuṇṭhatīrthasya snānena vilayaṃ gatā | vismayo nātra kartavyo vaikuṇṭhasya phalaṃ hi tat ||62|| atra snātā pāpaśūnyo vaikuṇṭhaṃ pratigacchati | punaranyat pravakṣyāmi lakṣmi gandharvakuṇḍajam ||63 || māhātmyaṃ snānakartāsmin gandharvaiḥ saha modate | māthuraṃ maṇḍalaṃ padmaṃ yojanānāṃ tu viṃśatiḥ ||64|| karṇikāyāmahaṃ kṛṣṇo mṛtānāṃ muktidaḥ sadā | paścime’haṃ harirgovardhanadhārī vasāmi ca ||65|| govindaścottare pūrve viśrāntau devaviśramaḥ | dakṣiṇe’haṃ varāho’smi mahākāyo’tikeśavān ||66|| kṛte yuge nṛpatinā māndhātrā toṣito’smyaham | mayā tuṣṭena hi tasmai pratimā mama cārpitā ||67|| kapilena bhagavatā taijasī divyarūpiṇī | manasā nirmitā ramyā vārāhī pratimā śubhā ||68|| indro’pi dhyāyati nityaṃ kapilāt prāpya saukarīm | mūrtiṃ svabhavane samarcayati sma samādarāt ||69|| rāvaṇo’pi gataḥ śakraṃ vijetuṃ svargamityapi | śakraṃ jitvā praviṣṭastadbhavane tatra saukaram ||1.347.70 || rūpaṃ divyaṃ rāvaṇaṃ vai babandha bahuraśmibhiḥ | rāvaṇaśca stutiṃ cakre trātumarhasi mādhava ||71|| mama tvaṃ bhaktiyuktasya prasādaṃ kuru sarvathā | tadā prasanno bhagavān mumoca rāvaṇaṃ hariḥ ||72|| rāvaṇo’pi tadā mūrtiṃ laṃkāṃ netumiyeṣa yat | tāmuddhartumaśakanna tadātivismayaṃ gataḥ ||73|| neme tatpādayoḥ prāha laṃkāṃ netuṃ mamāśayaḥ | vārāhaḥ prāha rakṣastvamavaiṣṇavo’si tena vai ||74|| nāgamiṣye tato bhūyā vaiṣṇavaścennayasva mām | rāvaṇo vaiṣṇavo bhūtvā nītavānnagarīṃ tu tām ||75|| rāmeṇa rāvaṇo nāśaṃ gamitaḥ pratimā tu sā | ānītā svanagarīṃ ca pūjitā bahuvatsarān ||76|| tena śeṣasvarūpaḥ svabhrātā rakṣovināśane | yojitaḥ sa mathurāyāṃ samāgatya tu rākṣasān ||77|| nāśayāmāsa ca tatra vārāhīṃ pratimāṃ hi tām | ānayāmāsa rakṣārthaṃ sthāpayāmāsa vai vidheḥ ||78 || dhanyeyaṃ māthurī pṛthvī dhanyā lokāśca tadgatāḥ | yaiḥ sadā snāpito dṛṣṭaḥ spṛṣṭo dhyāto’nucarcitaḥ ||79|| pūjitaśca varāho’yaṃ mokṣaṃ dāsyati sarvathā | varāhasannidhau piṇḍadānānmuktāstu pūrvajāḥ ||1.347.80 || bhavatyeva gayāśrāddhaphalaṃ puṣkarajaṃ phalam | śvetaṃ vārāhamālokya viśrāntiṃ lokayettathā ||8 1 || govindaṃ ca samālokya govardhanadharaṃ tataḥ | vilokayediti lakṣmi kathito mahimā ca te |||82|| ya idṃ śṛṇuyāccāpi paṭhedvā pāṭhayettathā | tasya varṇitapuṇyānāṃ prāptiḥ syānmokṣaṇaṃ bhavet ||83|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mathurākṣetramāhātmye cakratīrthe kalāpagrāmavāstavyaviprasya brahmahatyāpātakanāśākhyānaṃ, muktiśca | vaikuṇṭhatīrthe mithilāyā viprasya brahmahatyāpātakanāśākhyānaṃ, kapilabhagavatā manasotpāditavārāhasya paramparayā mathurāyāṃ pratiṣṭhānamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptacatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 347 ||
<1.348> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mahāpuṇyaṃ sthalaṃ govardhanātmakam | mathurāyāḥ paścime tad vartate yojanadvaye || 1 || bhuktimuktipradaṃ kṣetraṃ prakramaṇena dehinām | hṛdasyatra pāpanāśakaraḥ snānena vai nṛṇām || 2 || aindraṃ pūrve yamatīrthe dakṣiṇe vartate priya | paścime vāruṇaṃ tīrthaṃ kauberaṃ tūttareṇa vai || 3 || tattattīrthe snānakartā tattalloke mahīyate | prāṇatyāge mama smartā mama lokaṃ pragacchati || 4 || annakūṭasthalaṃ prāpya tasya kuryātpradakṣiṇam | sa yāti paramaṃ lokaṃ dhanadhānyādismṛddhimat || 5 || snātvā mānasagaṃgāyāṃ dṛṣṭvā govardhane harim | annakūṭaṃ parikramya na janurjāyate punaḥ || 6 || somavāre tvamāyāṃ vai gatvāgovardhanasthalam | pitṝn santarpayed gayāpiṇḍatṛptistadā bhavet || 7 || govardhanaṃ parikramya dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | rājasūyāśvamedhānāṃ puṇyamāpnotyasaṃśayam || 8 || māsi bhādrapade śuklaikādaśyāṃ samupoṣayet | snātvā mānasagaṃgāyāṃ brāhme sūryasya darśanam || 9 || kṛtvā govardhanaṃ natvā śṛṃge natvā hariṃ sthitam | avatīrya sopavāsā kuryād gireḥ pradakṣiṇam || 1.348.10 || puṇḍarīkaṃ sthalaṃ gacchet kuṇḍe snānaṃ samācaret | pitṛdevānarcayecca puṇḍarīkaṃ prapūjayet || 11 || evaṃ vidhānakartā sa prayāti bhavanaṃ hareḥ | tataścāpsarase kuṇḍe snāyāt pitṝm̐śca tarpayet || 12 || rājasūyāśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ vindettu tena vai | tataḥ saṃkarṣaṇe tīrthe snāyāt tarpaṇamācaret || 13 || gohatyābrahmahatyādipāpānāṃ vilayo bhavet | annakūṭasya nikaṭe śakratīrthe tataścaret || 14|| makhabhaṃgo mahendrasya yatra kṛṣṇena vai kṛtaḥ | indro vavarṣa roṣeṇa sarṭanāśecchayā tadā || 15|| kṛṣṇena ca gavādīnāṃ rakṣayāya dhṛto giriḥ | tatra ca bhojitā devā devyo gāvo maharṣayaḥ || 16 || gopā gopyaḥ pataṃgādyāḥ kīṭāḥ paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ | so’nnakūṭa iti nāmnā khyāto’bhavadgiristathā || 17|| tatra bhojanadānena jalārpaṇena vai tathā | tarpaṇena ca yātrāluḥ śatayajñaphalaṃ labhet || 18 || tataḥ kadambakuṇḍe vai snātavyaṃ brahmalokade | tato devagiriṃ gacchet snāyāt paśyecca bhāvataḥ | 19| | mahādevaṃ prapaśyecca kuṇḍe pitṝnpratarpayet | vājapeyaphalaṃ prāpya svarge muktvā hariṃ vrajet ||1.348.20| | gaṃgāyāścottaraṃ yāvad devadevasya cakriṇaḥ | sthale kṛṣṇasya saṃgrāmo’riṣṭāsureṇacābhavat | |2 1 | | vṛṣāsuraṃ harirhatvā snātastatra punaḥ punaḥ | rādhayā tu samāgatya kṛṣṇaḥ saṃsnāpitastadā | |22| rādhākuṇḍamiti nāmnā khyātaṃ pāpaharaṃ śubham | tatra snānenāśvamedharājasūyaphalaṃ bhavet ||23 || gonarabrahmahatyāyāḥ pāpaṃ snānena naśyati | mokṣarājākhyatīrthaṃ ca natvendradhvajamāvrajet ||24|| indradhvajocchraye tīrthe snātvā natvā samāvrajet | pañcatīrthābhidhaṃ kuṇḍaṃ gacched yātrāṃ samāpayet ||25 | | yātrāphalaṃ śrīharaye nivedya niśi jāgaram | govardhane prakartavyaṃ dvādaśyāṃ ca tataḥ prage ||26|| snātvā piṇḍaṃ tu nirvāpya natvā gacched bhajan harim | ya evaṃ kurute yātrāṃ pitṝn sa tārayatyapi ||27|| pāpāni saṃvinirdhūya parabrahmādhigacchati | aṣāḍhe’pi prakartavyamannakūṭaparikramam ||28|| etattu śṛṇuyād yaśca paṭhecca pāṭhayettathā | yātrāphalaṃ labhet snānaphalaṃ kṛṣṇaprasannatām | | 29| | śṛṇu lakṣmi suśīlākhyo vaiśyo vai dakṣiṇāpathe | pratiṣṭhānapurāvāso bahuputraḥ samṛddhimān ||1.348.3 0 || udaraṃbhara evāsau kuṭumbabharaṇe rataḥ | snānaṃ dānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ devārcāṃ na karoti saḥ || 31 || satāṃ samāgamaścāpi kadāpi tena na kṛtaḥ | kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ dharmakāryaṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ nahi ||3 2 || devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhaktistasya na vidyate | pāpamagnasya tu buddhirdharmadānāya nābhavat ||33 || matidātāramābhartsya tiraskaroti sarvathā | evaṃ vai vartamānasya kālena maraṇaṃ hyabhūt ||34|| nirudakasthale śuṣke pretatvaṃ samupāgataḥ | marudeśe kṣudhāviṣṭo bhraman tiṣṭhati duḥkhitaḥ ||35||| marau stambe vasati sma preto raudro bhayānakaḥ | dīrghadaṃṣṭro lambahanurbiḍālāsyo mahodaraḥ ||36|| tatra gatena mārgeṇa krayavikrayakārakaḥ | nirjagāma vaṇik kaścit taṃ nṛtyannabravīttadā ||37|| bhakṣyaṃ prāptaṃ mayā tvaṃ vai kvādhunā yātumicchasi | māṃsaṃ te bhakṣayiṣyāmi pāsyāmi tava śoṇitam || 38|| pretasya vacanaṃ śrutvā dhairyaṃ kṛtvāha taṃ vaṇik | kuṭumbabharaṇārthāya gacchāmi dhanavāñcchayā ||39|| vṛddhaḥ pitā me bhavane mātā patnī pativratā | mayi saṃbhakṣite rakṣaḥ kuṭumba me mariṣyati ||1.348.40|| punaḥ pāpena yuktatvaṃ pretabhāvānna mokṣyase | ityākarṇya sa pretastaṃ papraccha kuta āgamaḥ ||41 || vaṇik prāha mathurāyāḥ samāgato’smi te vanam | govardhanaḥ śailavaro yamunā ca mahānadī ||42|| tayormadhye mathurāyāṃ vasāmi bahuvaṃśataḥ | dhanaprāptyai pragacchāmi deśāntaraṃ daridrakaḥ ||43 || pretaḥ prāha śṛṇu dīna yadi kāryaṃ kuruṣva me | samayena hi mokṣyāmi gaccha tvaṃ mathurāṃ prati ||44|| snānaṃ kṛtvā tu vidhivat cātuḥsāmudrike prahau | piṇḍadānaṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ mama nāmnā prayatnataḥ ||45|| snānasya ca phalaṃ yaccha mama muktirbhaviṣyati | tava gṛhe dhanaṃ tvasti dāridryaṃ nāsti te vaṇik ||46 || suvarṇabhāro gartastho gṛhe tiṣṭhati sañcitaḥ | nivartasva susantuṣṭaḥ kuru me mokṣaṇaṃ vaṇik ||47|| vaṇik prāha kathaṃ te’sti jñānaṃ kūpaḥ pramokṣakaḥ | rakṣaḥ prāha pratiṣṭhāne pure’gastyo mahāmuniḥ ||48|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāmavācayat | sāyaṃkāle kathāṃ śrotuṃ gato’haṃ viṣṇumandiram ||49|| śruto mayā tataḥ kūpaḥ pretānāṃ mokṣadāyakaḥ | samudrāḥ kila tiṣṭhanti catvārastatra saṃgatāḥ ||1.348.50|| itiśrutā kathā tatra vācakāya janairbahu | dānaṃ dattaṃ mayā śāṭhyād datto vai tāmraḍhabbukaḥ ||51 || tato me saṃgate kāle nidhanaṃ samapadyata | yamarājaniyogena pūrvakarmabalena ca |||52|| pretatvaṃ samanuprāpto dānahomavivarjitaḥ | tadā tīrthaṃ kṛtaṃ naiva pitarastarpitā nahi ||53 || dharmakāryaṃ kṛtaṃ naiva prāpto’haṃ pretatāṃ tataḥ | ḍhabbukasya prabhāveṇa kathāyāḥ śravaṇena ca ||54|| jñānaṃ tu vidyate’dyāpi gaccha me mokṣaṇaṃ kuru | vibhvākhyastu vaṇik prāha kathaṃ jīvasi me vada ||55|| rakṣaḥ prāha mayā naijagṛhāṃgaṇe praropitaḥ | chāyārthaṃ pippalavṛkṣo jalena vardhitastataḥ ||56|| tasya varṣe dvivāraṃ ca bhavantyeva phalāni vai | jantavastena jīvanti tatpuṇyena mamāpi ca ||57|| tṛptirbhavati me nityā jalānnavihitā yathā | śrutvā vaṇik samāśvāsya pretaṃ ca mathurāṃ yayau |||58||| dravyaṃ niṣkāsya vai bhūmeḥ pretakāryaṃ cakāra ha | catuḥsāmudrike kūpe piṇḍadānaṃ cakāra saḥ ||59|| preto’sau tatra cāgatya piṇḍān bhuktvā yayau divam | vaṇik dravyaṃ tathā prāpya modate sma gṛhe nije ||1.348.60|| tīrthe lakṣmi gṛhe’raṇye devasthāne ca catvare | yatra tatra mṛtāḥ piṇḍadānānmuktiṃ prayānti te ||61 || anyatra kṛtapāpasya tīrthe muktirhi niścitā | mathurāyāṃ kṛtapāpasyāpi kūpārṇave kṣayaḥ ||62|| mathurāyāṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatraiva tu vinaśyati | eṣā purī mahāpuṇyā yasyāṃ pāpaṃ na vidyate ||63|| kṛtaghnaśca surāpaśca cauro bhagnavratastathā | mathurāṃ yamunāṃ prāpya mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ||64|| tiṣṭhed yugasahasraṃ tu pādenaikena yaḥ kvacit | tato’dhikaṃ bhavetpuṇyaṃ mathurāyāṃ nivāsinaḥ ||65|| mathurāvāsinaḥ sarve divyā devā hi mānavāḥ | tīrthasnānaratāste’pi devā vai naramūrtayaḥ ||66|| anyatra viprasāhasrapūjanena tu yatphalam | ekena pūjitenātra māthureṇa phalaṃ bhavet ||67|| anṛg vai māthuro yatra caturvedastathāparaḥ | na tu vedaiścaturbhiḥ syānmāthureṇa samaḥ kvacit ||68|| bhavanti sarvatīrthāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca | maṃgalāni tu sarvāṇi yatra vai māthuro dvijaḥ ||6 9|| sarve mokṣāstatra bhūtā bhaviṣyanti ca dehinām | yatra vai māthuraṃ tīrthaṃ yamunāyā jalaṃ tathā ||1.348.70 || mathurāvāsino bodhyāḥ pārṣadā vai caturbhujāḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya caturbāhutvamāpnuyāt ||71 || śṛṇu tvanyat pravakṣyāmi māhātmyamasikuṇḍajam | puṇyanagaravāstavyo rājābhūd vimatiḥ purā ||72 || vimatestu gṛhe tatra tvāgato nāradaḥ kvacit | tasmai pādyaṃ tathārghyaṃ ca dattavān vimatistadā ||73 || pratigṛhya tatastaṃ ca nāradaḥ prāha dharmabhṛt | ānṛṇyaṃ te pituḥ kartuṃ samartho’si nṛpeśvara ||74|| mama mitraṃ pitā te me samāsīnmānadaḥ sadā | sumatināmakastasya nidhanottarameva tu ||75|| kṛtaṃ tvayā mahādānaṃ puṇyaṃ cāpyatipuṣkalam | tīrthayātrā kṛtā naiva tayānṛṇyaṃ bhavet pituḥ ||76|| pituranṛṇatāṃ kṛtvā putro’sya dharmabhāg bhavet | evamuktvā nāradastu yayau vai badarīvanam ||77|| rājāpi ca tato’pyaicchat tīrthayātrāṃ pituḥ kṛte | tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā gacchāmo mathurāṃ purīm ||78|| iti niścitya rājāsau tvāgato mathurāṃ purīm | caturo vārṣikānmāsānmathurāyāṃ vasāmi vai ||79|| sarvatīrthāni cātraiva cāturmāsye vasanti ca | iti vicārya rājā sa vāsaṃ dīrghaṃ cakāra vai ||1.348.80|| sahasramānavairyukto dāsadāsīprasevitaḥ | bhṛtyāstīrtheṣu sarvatra kurvanti malavarjanam ||8 1 || dāsā dāsyaḥ śūdravarṇā vratāheṣvapi maithunam | kurvanti ca tathā snāntyamaryādaṃ tīrthavāriṣu ||82|| prasahya brāhmaṇādīnāṃ nayantyupaskarādikam | nindanti sādhūn viprāṃśca kathāṃ ca bhartsayanti vai ||83|| mūtratyāgādikaṃ devabhūmau kurvantyarodhinaḥ | matsyān khādanti tānpāpān rājā daṇḍaṃ karoti na ||84|| tatpāpaṃ duṣṭatārājñaḥ śirasyeva bhavatyapi | māse gate ca tīrthāni duḥkhādūcuḥ parasparam ||85|| rājā tvasmāt sthalānniṣkāsanīyaḥ sukhahetave | yuddhaṃ vimatinā sārdhaṃ svayaṃ kartuṃ na śaknumaḥ ||86|| kalpagrāmaṃ vayaṃ gatvā varāhaṃ parameśvaram | kaṣṭaṃ nivedayāmaḥ sa yogyaṃ samyak kariṣyati ||87|| kalpagrāme gatānyeva prārthayāṃcakrurādarāt | jaya viṣṇo jaya pṛthvīpate rājapate jaya ||88|| tīrthakaṣṭavināśārthaṃ nārāyaṇa namo’stu te | śrutyā varāhabhagavān prāha tīrthāni sādaram ||89|| varaṃ vṛṇuta bhadraṃ vo yadvo manasi vartate | tīrthānyūcurhare kṛṣṇa no’bhayaṃ dātumarhasi ||1.348.90|| supāpinā vimatinā kṛtastrāsaḥ sudāruṇaḥ | taṃ niyacchasva pāpiṣṭhaṃ māṃsādaṃ pāpisevitam ||9 1 || śrīvarāhastadā prāha haniṣyāmi mahāripum | evaṃ tīrthaniyogena tvāgato mathurāṃ purīm ||92 || vārāhaḥ svāsinā rājñā yuddhaṃ cakāra dāruṇam | sūdayāmāsa rājānaṃ varāhaḥ svāsinā tataḥ ||93|| khaḍgaṃ svasya dharāyāṃ ca dhārāgraṃ nihitaṃ bhuvi | kṣaṇa viśrāntilābhāya niṣasāda bhuvastale ||94|| sā bhūmiḥ pāvanī yatra kuṇḍaṃ devarṣibhiḥ kṛtam | asikuṇḍaṃ tu tatproktaṃ tīrthaṃ paramapāvanam ||95|| dvādaśyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ kuṇḍasnānaṃ hi muktidam | tadā varāhatīrthe’haṃ tiṣṭhāmi mokṣadānakṛt ||96|| tīrthe tatra pradātavyā mūrtayo me caturvidhāḥ | ekā varāhasaṃjñā ca nārāyaṇī dvitīyakā ||97|| vāmanasya tṛtīyā ca caturthī rāghavasya ca | etāsāṃ darśanaṃ pūjā pratiṣṭhā dānamityapi ||98|| kartavyaṃ sarvathā tatra mokṣabhāk sa bhavettataḥ | etāścatasro yaḥ paśyet snātvā kuṇve’sināmake ||99|| catuḥsāgaraparyantā krāntā tena vasundharā | māthurāṇāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ phalabhāk sa bhaveddhruvam || 1.348.10 0|| suptotthito’pi dvādaśyāmasikuṇḍāpluto naraḥ | mūrtīḥ paśyati yastāstu brahmabhūyāya kalpate || 101 || nāsti tatpunarāvṛttirnārāyaṇaprasādataḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya bhuktvā muktiṃ vrajet khalu || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mathurākṣetramāhātmye govardhanānnakūṭatadanyatīrthapradakṣiṇam, pretarūpasya suśīlavaiśyasyoddhāraḥ, vārāheṇa vimaternāśe’sikuṇḍaṃ vārāhakṣetramāhātmyaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||348||
<1.349> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi yamunāyā viśrāntighaṭṭanirvacaḥ | ujjayinyāmabhūd vipro bhraṣṭācāraḥ praṇāstikaḥ || 1 || sadācāraparityāgī na tu snānaṃ karoti saḥ | sa na pūjayate devānna sa sādhūnnamasyati || 2 || kāmanāvyākulaḥ sandhyāśayanaḥ pitṛnindakaḥ | śrāddhakhaṇḍanakartā ca pāpasaṃgaḥ sudurmatiḥ || 3 || svakuṭumbodarabharaścauryādibhiḥ sadā niśi | ekadā sa niśi cauryaṃ kurvāṇaḥ pāpibhiḥ saha || 4 || rājabhaṭairvīkṣyamāṇo dravanvegādvimārgagaḥ | palāyamānaḥ sa paramandhakūpe’patattadā || 5 || mṛto’sau patitaścātha rākṣasatvamupāgataḥ | sa tu pārśvagamārgasthajīrvāvṛkṣe vasan sadā || 6 || paśūnpakṣavataḥ prāṇān raktaṃ pibati khādati | kadācittena mārgeṇa mahānsārtha upāgataḥ || 7 || tanmadhyasthena vipreṇa rakṣoghnamantrarakṣitaḥ | sārthaḥ suṣvāpa suśrānto vṛkṣādhaḥkūpasannidhau || 8 || tatrāgatya ca rakṣastu brāhmaṇaṃ prāha bho dvija | ahaṃ dāsyāmi te dravyaṃ yatte manasi vartate || 9 || bahukālena saṃprāptaṃ bhojanaṃ bahumānavam | dehi bhakṣayituṃ vipra gacchānyatra kṛpāṃ kuru || 1.349.1 0|| yenāhaṃ bhakṣaye sārthaṃ yāvat tṛptirbhavenmama | vipraḥ prāha kṛtaghno’haṃ na bhavāmi kathaṃcana || 11 || duṣṭena mama kā maitrī ko lābho rakṣasā saha | rakṣasā mitratālābhau prāṇāntāmantraṇāpradau || 1 2|| sārthena mama lābho’sti na tvayā tu kathaṃcana | ekasārthaprayāto’haṃ notsṛjāmi sahārthakam || 1 3|| tasmād rākṣasa gaccha tvaṃ vihāya mama sārthakam | nirīkṣituṃ na śakto’si mama mantrabalena vai || 14|| rakṣaḥ prāha hate bhakṣye me doṣaste bhaviṣyati | dayāṃ kuru tvaṃ viprendra bhojanaṃ mama dīyatām || 15|| evamarthamarthayantaṃ papraccha rākṣasaṃ dvijaḥ | kena karmapradoṣeṇa rākṣasatvamupāgataḥ || 16|| rakṣaḥ prakathayāmāsa cauryānācāradūṣaṇaiḥ | vipro’pi pāpakāryaiśca rākṣasatvamupāgataḥ || 17|| tadā sārthagataḥ kṣmādevo’pi śrutvā kṛpāṃ gataḥ | uvāca rakṣo vada me mārjayāmi dvijasya te || 18|| yāni kāni ca pāpāni muktiścāpi yathā bhavet | mayā kṛtopakāreṇa priyaṃ kiṃ karavāṇi te || 1 9|| śrutvāha rākṣaso vipraṃ tvayā yātrā bahukṛtā | mathurāyāṃ tu yat snānaṃ kṛtaṃ viśrāntitīrthake ||1.349.20|| tacca snānaphalaṃ dehi yena muktiṃ vrajāmyaham | vipraḥ papraccha tacchrutvā rākṣasaṃ prāgudantakam ||21 || kathaṃ jānāsi rakṣastvaṃ tīrthaṃ viśrāntisaṃjñakam | kathaṃ ca tādṛśī saṃjñā sarvaṃ kathaya vitsi cet| |||22|| rākṣasaḥ prāha viprendra ujjayinyāṃ purā mama | puryāṃ vāsaḥ sadāsīnme tatra vai viṣṇumandire ||23|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ tu bhūsuraḥ | karoti nityamevātibhāvato janatākṛte ||24|| viśrāntitīrthamāhātmyaṃ śrutaṃ dvija mayā tadā | tasya śravaṇamātreṇa mama bhaktirhṛdi sthitā ||25|| sā tu saṃjñā śrutā tatra viśrānterarthabodhikā | vāsudevaḥ paraṃ brahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||26|| viśrāmaṃ kurute nityaṃ yatra vai yamunātaṭe | tatsthānaṃ jalasānnidhye viśrāntisaṃjñakaṃ hyabhūt ||27|| tatra snātā koṭiyugānsvargaṃ bhuktvā tataḥ param | vairājasaṃjñakān lokān bhuktvā yāti paraṃ padam || 28||| tasmāt prayaccha viprendra hyekasnānasya me phalam | yena me rākṣasabhāvānmuktiḥ svargagatistathā |||29|| ante muktirbhaveccāpi kṛpāṃ kuru mamopari | rākṣasasya vacaḥ śrutvā sārthavipro’bravīttadā ||1.349.3 0|| ekasnānasya hi phalaṃ tava dattaṃ tu rākṣasa | ityabhidhāya yāvat sa jalaṃ dadāti rakṣase ||3 1 || tāvacchuddho divyatanumavāpya sa divaṃ yayau | tatra bhogānparān bhuktvā mokṣamavāpa padmaje ||32|| tataḥ sārthaḥ sa vipro hi yayau deśaṃ prati svakam | śṛṇu lakṣmi purā śaṃbhurharestoṣaṇahetave ||33||| cakārograṃ tapastena prasannaḥ sannahaṃ tadā | śaṃkaraṃ tu samāgatya datvā darśanameva me || 34|| varaṃ varaya cetyukto vavre matto varaṃ haraḥ | yadi tuṣṭo’si bhagavan mathurākṣetramaṇḍale || 35|| yatra kvāpi ca me sthānaṃ sadā kṛṣṇa pradīyatām | tadā mayā kathitaṃ tvaṃ kṣetrapālo bhaviṣyasi || 36 || tvayi dṛṣṭe mahādeva mama kṣetraphalaṃ bhavet | mama kṣetrasya saṃrakṣāṃ kuru śaṃbho sadābhitaḥ ||37|| mama kṣetrapraveśe ca saṃsāro vai nivartate | yathā vaikuṇṭhanagarī vallabhā mathurā mama ||38|| viṃśatiryojanānāṃ hi māthuraṃ mama maṇḍalam | pade pade’śvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ madyogato bhavet ||39|| atra tiṣṭhanti tīrthāni svargamokṣapradāni vai | ṣaṣṭikoṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni ca ||1.349.40 || iti śrutvā varaṃ prāpya śaṃbhustatraiva saṃsthitaḥ | kṣetrapālasvarūpo me bhaktarāḍ vaiṣṇavaḥ paraḥ ||41 || iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi māhātmyaṃ mokṣadaṃ param | ye paṭhanti ca śṛṇvanti te yānti paramaṃ padam || 42|| kulānyapi tārayanti dve śate viṃśayordvayoḥ | prāpte ca maraṇe tīrthaṃ smared yo māthuraṃ janaḥ ||43 || sa gacchet paramāṃ siddhimiha saṃsāranāśinīm | sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ māthuraṃ paramaṃ mahat ||44|| kṛṣṇena krīḍitaṃ tīrthaṃ tacchuddhaṃ hi pade pade | dakṣiṇottaravasudhāmaṇḍalaṃ māthuraṃ sadā |||45||| gṛhānniḥsṛtya maunena yāvatsnānaṃ hi vartayet | prapūjānantaraṃ brūyād dhenūrdadyātpayasvinīḥ ||46 || hiraṇyaṃ ca vasuṃ dadyād bhojayed bhūsurāna sataḥ | cāturmāsye mathurāyāṃ vased dādāni vartayet ||47|| na tasya punarāvṛttirmama loke mahīyate | māthure tu mṛtā lakṣmi mama lokaṃ vrajanti vai ||48|| anyatra ca mṛtānāṃ vai dāhe māthuramaṇḍale | kṛte svargaṃ tathā vāso mama golokadhāmani ||49|| māthurāṇāṃ tu yadrarūpaṃ tadrūpaṃ me caturbhujam | māthureṇa tu tṛptena tṛpto’haṃ vārdhije sadā ||1.349.5 0 || śṛṇu lakṣmi yathāvṛttaṃ garuḍasya mahātmanaḥ | āgatasya mathurāyāṃ kṛṣgadarśanakāṃkṣayā ||5 1 || kṛṣṇasyāgre garuḍaḥ sa stutiṃ cakre nanāma ca | jaya lakṣmīpate kṛṣṇa jayasva māṇikīpate ||52 || prabhāpate jaya rādhāpate śrīpārvatīpate | jaya viṣṇo jaya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāpate ||53 || jaya gopīpate kṛṣṇa garuḍādhipate jaya | jaya sarvapate brahma jaya kṛṣṇa namo’stu te ||54|| ityevaṃ saṃstuto devo garuḍena mahātmanā | garuḍasya puraḥ kṛṣṇa sthito’bhūt suśarīravān ||55|| uvāca pakṣirāṭ kiṃ te cikīrṣitaṃ tathāgamaḥ | vada śīghraṃ pradāsye’haṃ śrutvāha garuḍastadā ||56 || mathurāmāgataścāhaṃ tava darśanakāṃkṣayā | na dṛṣṭaṃ tava rūpaṃ ca māṃ tu mohaḥ samāviśat| ||57|| mathurāyāṃ bhavāna lokaiḥ samaṃ dhṛtvā svarūpakam | vartate na mayā jñātastato māṃ mohamāviśat ||58||| idānīṃ divyarūpaṃ te dṛṣṭvā śāntirabhūttu me | garuḍasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasyovāca mādhavaḥ ||59 || māthurāṇāṃ svarūpeṇa vartāmyahaṃ dvijottama | ye pāpaste na paśyanti madrūprān māthurān janān ||1.349.6 0|| ahaṃ vasāmi tatraiva vicarāmi kvacit pṛthak | evamuktvā tataḥ kṛṣṇastatraivāntaradhīyata ||6 1 || garuḍo’pi gataḥ kṛṣṇapade vaikuṇṭhameva ha | māthurā mathurāyāṃ vai sthitvā devatvamāgatāḥ ||6 2||| pavitrayanti sarvāṃste yathā kṛṣṇasya pārṣadāḥ | api kīṭaḥ pataṃgo vā tiryagyonisthito’pi vā ||6 3 || caturbhujā bhavantyeva śrīkṛṣṇasya pratāpataḥ | atha lakṣmi śṛṇu tvanyat camatkāraṃ tu māthuram ||64|| saurāṣṭrasya raivatādrervāstavyo brāhmaṇo hariḥ | patnīvratābhidhānaḥ svakuṭumbena purā yuge ||65|| yamunāyāstu yātrārthaṃ gato māthuramaṇḍalam | viśrāntau sa yamunāyāṃ snātaścakre pradakṣiṇam ||66 || mathurāyāstathā govardhanasyānyavanasya ca | vṛndāvanasya tulasīvanasyāpi pradakṣiṇam ||67|| bhojayitvā bahūn viprān nītvā tīrthajalāni ca | nyavartata svakaṃ deśaṃ marudeśaḥ samāgataḥ ||68|| tatrāraṇye śamīprāye śuṣke śṛṃgamaye sthale | dadarśa ḍākinīśākinīnāṃ sārthaṃ śatottaram ||69|| nṛtyantaṃ bhakṣaya khādayeti brūvantamuddhatam | vīrūpaṃ ca vivastraṃ ca kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ bhayaṃkaram ||1.349.70|| kṛtyāsārthaṃ vilokyaiva patnīvratastu tatkṣaṇam | cakre sasmāra kṛṣṇasya drāgevopasthitaṃ jvalat ||71 || pretasvarūpikāstāstaccakraṃ dadāha bāhyataḥ | rurudustāścukruśuśca prārthayāṃcakruratyati ||72|| trāhi brahman na bhakṣyāmo mariṣyāmo’tra rakṣa naḥ | vayaṃ marunṛpatervai patnyo’bhavan śatottaram ||73 || madyamāṃsāśanāḥ pāpakāriṇyo dharmavarjitāḥ | mahāmārīmahāroge rājā tu nidhanaṃ gataḥ ||74|| rājyaṃ hṛtaṃ tripureṇa bhraṣṭāstena kṛtā vayam | bhūkampe bhavane bhagne sarvāstatrārditā mṛtāḥ ||75|| ḍākinīśākinībhautiyoniṃ gatāḥ sma bhūsura | mokṣaṃ kuru tadasmākaṃ tīrthajalena keśava ||76 || śratvā patnīvrataḥ so’yaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśo brāhmaṇo jalam | yamunāyāḥ kare dhṛtvā prokṣayāmāsa tāstadā ||77|| pretarūpāṇi santyajya divyāścaturbhujāstu tāḥ | ramārūpāstadā jātā natvā tuṣṭuvurādarāt ||78|| kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ tvamevāsi hyuddhṛtā duḥkhasāgarāt| | naya dhāma svakaṃ kṛṣṇetyukte vimānamāgatam ||79|| vipraḥ kṛṣṇasvarūpaḥ sa golokaṃ tāṃ nināya vai | punaḥ kuṭumbasahitaḥ svadeśaṃ raivataṃ yayau ||1.349.8 0|| iti viśrāntitīrthasya yamunāsalilasya ca | pretoddhārakaraṃ divyaṃ māhātmyaṃ te prakīrtitam ||8 1 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ yamunājalasaṃgataḥ | yatra tatra tadā svargaṃ golokaṃ mokṣa eva ca ||82|| ya idaṃ śṛṇuyāccāpi vācayecchrāvayettathā | teṣāṃ lakṣmi bhavet svargaṃ goloke muktireva ca ||||83|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mathurākṣetramāhātmye ujayinīpurīvāsibhraṣṭācāraviprasya rākṣasatvamupagatasya viśrāntisnānaphaladānānmuktiḥ, śaṃbhukṛtakṣetrasarakṣaṇaṃ, garuḍasya māthurarūpakṛṣṇāparicaye stavanena divyadarśanaṃ, patnīvrataviprātmakakṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṛto viśrāntijalaprokṣaṇena ḍākinīśākinīśatottaramokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonapañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 349 ||
