<1.350> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca gokarṇeśvaramāhātmyaṃ mathurāyāṃ yamītaṭe | kathayāmi śṛṇu lakṣmi putrasvargapramokṣadam || 1 || āsīd vipraḥ subhadrākhyaḥ pāribhadrasya putrakaḥ | vaiśyavṛttisamāyuktaḥ krayavikrayajīvanaḥ || 2 || saurāṣṭre viṣaye śatrujitānadītaṭe vasan | kṛṣiṃ cāpi karotyatra gavādīn pālayatyapi || 3 || tasya bhāryā sadguṇāḍhyā jīvantī nāmataḥ smṛtā | bhartuḥ priyakarī sādhvī na prasūtā vayo’dhikā || 4 || śokaṃ karoti nityaṃ sā striyo dṛṣṭvā prajāvatīḥ | sā yātā kuṃkumavāpyāṃ pitṛgṛhaṃ samutsave || 5 || nāmnā kraturmahāyogī viprastasyāḥ pitāpi tām | saśokāṃ paridṛṣṭvaiva papraccha śokakāraṇam || 6 || sāpi prāha pitaraṃ cānapatyatvaṃ tu kāraṇam | kratvarṣiśca kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā prāha jīvantikāṃ sutām || 7 || āgaccha putri kṛṣṇāgre kurvastadvinivedanam | ghnanti niścitya tau patnīvratakṛṣṇasya mandiram || 8 || gatau natvā ca taṃ devaṃ cānivedayatāṃ vṛtam | asyā nāsti kṛṣṇamune durbhagāyāḥ prajāsukham || 9 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrutvā prāha tāṃ putragarddhinīm | kambharāyā mahālakṣmyāḥ prasādena suputrakaḥ || 1.350.10 || bhaviṣyatyeva te nūnaṃ kuru yātrāṃ suputradām | mathurāyāṃ yamunāyāstīre gokarṇavakeśvaram || 11 || tīrthaṃ ramyaṃ putralābhaphalaṃ bhavati suvrate | tamārādhaya śīghraṃ vai saha patyābhigamya ca || 12|| snānadīpopahāreṇa stotrairnānāvidhaistathā | prasādayānutiṣṭhaitajjīvanti sasutā bhava || 13 || ityuktā sā yadā yātā gṛhaṃ natvā patiṃ tadā | sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa yaduktaṃ hariṇā tu tat || 14|| sa tadvacanamākarṇya suprītaḥ prāha tāṃ priyām | mamāpyetanmataṃ patni yaduktaṃ hariṇā tataḥ || 15|| gatau vyomnā suyānena mathurāṃ daśamīdine | caitre sāyaṃ yamunāyāṃ snātvā natvā ca śaṃkaram || 16|| gokarṇeśvaramevaitau nidrāṃ jagrahaturbhuvi | prātarutthāya ca snānaṃ pūjāṃ cakraturādarāt || 17|| tataḥ prasanno bhagavānumāpatiruvāca tau | bhaviṣyati yuvāṃ putro guṇarūpadhanānvitaḥ || 18|| ityuktau tau tu devena snānaṃ kṛtvā sarasvatīm | yamīṃ natvā saṃgame ca kṣaṇe sthitvā dvijātaye || 1 9|| dravyaṃ bhojyaṃ dadatuśca vastrādyaṃ bahudakṣiṇam | ekādaśyāṃ māthure maṇḍale yātrāṃ vidhāya ca ||1.350.2 0 || vaihāyasā suyānenājagmatustau nijagṛham | vipraḥ patnyāṃ tu jīvantyāṃ garbhādhānamavindata ||21 || suṣuve daśame māsi sā putraṃ candramaḥprabham | gosahasraṃ tadā datvā sasuvarṇaṃ suvastrakam ||22|| bahuśaḥ sarvavarṇebhyaḥ putrajanmamahotsave | jātakarma tathā śrāddhaṃ nāmakarma cakāra saḥ ||23 || gokarṇeśvaradatto’yaṃ gokarṇo nāmato’stu vai | sa tu ṣoḍaśasaṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛtastaruṇo’bhavat ||24|| ta sa vivāhayāmāsa bhāryāṇāṃ tu catuṣṭayam | aprajā eva tāḥ sarvā ekāpi nahi putriṇī ||25|| ato dharmaḥ samārabdho bhāryāyutena tena vai | vāpikūpataḍāgāni devatāyatanāni ca ||26||| prapāmālāśca satrānnaṃ devasevārttisevanam | śatrujitātaṭe tatra gokarṇeśvaraśaṃkaram ||27||| gokṣurapattanāt pūrvaṃ sthāpayāmāsa yāmunam | prāsādaṃ kārayāmāsa paṃcāyatanakaṃ hareḥ ||28|| ārāmastatra vistīrṇaḥ puṣpajātyastathaiva ca | phalajātyastathā śākapatrakandaprajātikaḥ || 29||| prākāraṃ kārayāmāsa parikhāmaṇḍalīyakam | ghaṭīyantrāṇi kūpeṣu yaiḥ prasiñcettu vāṭikāḥ ||1.350.3 0|| puṣpāṇi ca vicinvanti sarvāstasya suyoṣitaḥ | snānaṃ pūjādikaṃ bhūmimārjanaṃ dīpakarma ca ||3 1 || kurvanti devatāgāre tasya patnyastu sarvadā | mālākāraḥ svayaṃ nityaṃ viṭapān saṃprasiñcati ||32|| jātāḥ supuṣpavantaśca drumāḥ phalasamṛddhayaḥ | dīyate bhujyate sarvaiḥ phalādyaṃ nityamutsavāt ||33|| pūjyate śaṃkarastena sarvadā bhāvapūrvakam | vyāpāraṃ saḥ kṛṣiṃ cāpi karoti kārayatyapi ||34|| ekadā manasā kṛtvā vaṇigbhāvaṃ hṛdi sthiram | kṛtvā sārthamupāgamya yayau paścimamaṇḍalam |||35|| tatra krītvā supaṇyāni vāmanasthalapattanāt | maṇiratnānyaśvaratnāni krītvā raivatācale ||36|| svarṇarekhānadītīre cakre nivāsamuttamam | tatra niveśya bhāṇḍāni śailaṃ samāruroha saḥ ||37|| bahudevādhivasatiṃ siddhagandharvasevitam | divyapuṣpaphalopetaṃ bahukandaraśobhitam ||38|| tato madhye bhuvyupatyakāyāṃ śṛṇoti gahvare | svāgataṃ tatra gatvāsau śukaṃ paśyati pañjare ||39|| tenoktaṃ bho ihāgaccha svātithyaṃ karavāṇi te | phalānīmāni svādūni śītamiṣṭajalāni ca ||1.350.40|| gṛhṇantu bho mahābhāgāḥ sārthaviprāḥ śubhaṃ bhavet | atitherāgatasyeha pūjāyā vimukho bhavet ||41 || tadgṛhasthasya pitaro vasanti narake dhruvam | pūjite pūjitāḥ svarge modante kālamakṣayam ||42|| atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhānnivartate yadi | ātmano duṣkṛtaṃ tasmai datvā tatsukṛtaṃ haret ||43 || tasmāt sarvaprayatnena pūjyo vai gṛhamedhinā | kāle prāptastvakāle vā yathā kṛṣṇastathaiva saḥ ||44|| evaṃvidhāḥ śubhā vācaḥ śrutvā gokarṇako’bravīt | ṛṣiḥ kastvaṃ sudharmajñaḥ kiṃ vā devo’tha guhyakaḥ ||45|| siddho vā raivatavāsī mānavo vad ko’tra bhoḥ | tava prasannarūpasya yasyeyaṃ vāgamānuṣī ||46|| ityuktaḥ sa śukaḥ sarvaṃ śaśaṃsātmapurākṛtam | ahamāsaṃ vāmadevaśiṣyo nāmnā śukodaraḥ ||47|| gurorvākyaṃ buddhiyuktaṃ śrutvāpyahaṃ tadagrataḥ | ūhāpohakaraṃ praśnaṃ vāraṃ vāraṃ tu pṛṣṭavān ||48|| tena muhurniṣiddho’pi na kṛtaṃ tadvaco mayā | tadā tenātikopād vai śāpitastvaṃ śuko bhava ||49|| śukatvaṃ tatkṣaṇātprāpto vasāmyatra hi raivate | jātismaro bhavāmyatra karomi bhajanaṃ hareḥ ||1.350.50|| prāptastvatra gṛhāvāsimuninā brahmasūriṇā | pañjare rakṣitastena jīvāmi sukhato gṛhe ||51 || vāmadevo’tidīnaṃ māmuvāca kṛpayārthitaḥ | mathurāyāṃ mṛteḥ paścād brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyasi ||52|| tasmānnityaṃ tu mathurāmathureti vadāmi ca | śukasya vacanaṃ śrutvā gokarṇaḥ prāha pakṣiṇam ||53|| raivatādrisamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūto na bhaviṣyati | bhuktimuktipradaṃ caitanmokṣagolokadhāmadam ||54|| etatsthānaṃ parityajya kathaṃ māthuramaṇḍalam | muktyarthaṃ te kṛtaṃ pakṣin cejjānāsi vadātra me ||55|| śrutvā śukastu taṃ prāha rekhā me tādṛśī yataḥ | tatraiva maraṇānmuktirnātra me mṛtinirṇayaḥ ||56 || tasmād vipra tvayā kāryā mamopakṛtireva sā | naya māṃ mathurāṃ śreṣṭhin yadi kvaciddhi gacchasi ||57|| evaṃ tayoḥ kathayatorbrahmasūriḥ samitkaraḥ | samāyāto vanāttatra so’pyatithīn vilokya ca ||58|| prasannastvabhavat kṛtvā phalādyairātitheyakam | kaḥ kutaḥ saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā vada kiṃ karavāṇi te ||59|| ityuktaḥ sa tu gokarṇo natvā munimayācata | śuko’yaṃ pañjarasthastu putrārthaṃ me pradīyatām ||1.350.60 || mathurāyāṃ gamiṣyāmi tasya mokṣārthameva yat | ṛṣiṇā tu prasannena śukastasmai samarpitaḥ ||61 || natvā ṛṣiṃ sa gokarṇo yayau gokṣurapattanam | sarvaratnasamupetaḥ sarvasārthasamanvitaḥ ||62| śukaḥ śatruṃjitānadyāstaṭe viprasya vāṭikām | phalapuṣpādisaṃyuktāṃ dṛṣṭvā sthātuṃ mano’karot ||63|| gokarṇenāpi vāṭyāṃ sa phalapuṣpādibhojanaḥ | rakṣitastvekadā patnīścatasraḥ prāha mātaraḥ ||64|| kathaṃ putrā na dṛśyante putryaścāpi na vo’tra kim | jalasecanakartryastā ūcustaṃ kovidaṃ śukam ||65|| pakṣin vandhyāścatasraḥ smo vada syustu sutā yathā | śukaḥ prāha kathayiṣye yāvatā tiṣṭhatā mayā ||66|| evaṃ kāle gate varṣe punarvyāpāravāñchayā | gokarṇaḥ saśuko yātaḥ kacchaṃ prati mudānvitaḥ ||67|| patnyaścāpi yayuḥ kacchaṃ svāminā sahasevikāḥ | nāvā samudramuttīrya nārāyaṇasaro yayuḥ ||68|| tatra dṛṣṭā divyadevyo rūpānurūpabhāsurāḥ | sahasraśaḥ saromadhye jalavāsātisaurabhāḥ ||6 9|| kintu śokaparimlānāḥ papracchustāḥ śukaṃ prati | kutastvāgamyate kiṃ te kāryaṃ sad vidyate vad ||1.350.70|| śukaḥ prāha mama svāmī ratnārthaṃ samupāgataḥ | bhavatīnāṃ bhavet kāryaṃ jñāpayantu hi māṃ tadā ||71 || śrutvā tāśca tadā prāhuḥ śukaṃ paramakovidam | duḥkhaṃ tasya samākhyeyaṃ yo vināśayate rujam ||72|| āste kuṃkumavāpīti nṛṇāṃ muktipradāyinī | aśvapaṭṭasaro yatra rājate surasevitam ||73|| gaurjarādhipatirvīraścaturaṃgabalānvitaḥ | rājā dharmavīranāmā kārtike raivatasya saḥ ||74|| pradakṣiṇādiyātrārthaṃ yayau gacchan śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | mārge kuṃkumavāpyāśca cakre yātrāṃ sarovare ||75|| sasnau sa śrāddhakāryāṇi cakāra brahmabhojanam | cakre suvarṇaratnaiḥ kaṃbharāgopālapūjanam ||76|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaviṣṇordarśanaṃ havanaṃ tathā | mandirasya mahodyāne saptabhūmyatiśobhinaḥ ||77|| ārāmavāṭikāḥ śubhrā nimnaprākāraveṣṭitāḥ | kūpaghaṭyāvartayuktāḥ puṣpajātisuvāsitāḥ ||78|| phalavanto drumāstatra sarvartusumanoharāḥ | tadabhyāśe sa rājarṣiścakārāvāsamuttamam ||79|| sevakairnāśitaḥ sarvaṃ ārāmaḥ saphaladrumaḥ | vayaṃ sarvāstu tā vṛkṣavallyaḥ smo devadevatāḥ ||1.350.80 || ityuktvā ruruduḥ svārttijalpiṇyo hātikṛcchrataḥ | sarvāsāṃ rudatīnāṃ tu kurarīṇāmiva svanāḥ ||8 1 || śrūyante duḥkhadāḥ tāśca sāntvayāmāsa vai śukaḥ | tāstu prāha punastatra ratnānyādāya sarvathā ||82|| gamiṣyati mama svāmī kariṣyati sajīvanāḥ || ityuktamātre vacane tāḥ sarvā labdhacetanāḥ ||83 || śukasya svāminaṃ tadvai vaktuṃ taṃ vedituṃ tathā | aikyabhāvena tāḥ sarvāḥ papracchurvaṇijaṃ prati ||84|| asmākaṃ jīvadātā tvaṃ kaḥ kutastviha saṃgataḥ | gokarṇaḥ prāha tā devīḥ bhavatyaścārulocanāḥ ||85|| sucārvāsyāḥ sucārvaṃgyaḥ kathaṃ śokapariplutāḥ | tadā jyeṣṭhā tamāhātha puṣpajātyā svalaṃkṛtā ||86 || vayamārāmasaṃsthānāḥ khādyasalilabhojanāḥ | hṛdyāśca svāminā guptāḥ puṣpavṛddhiratāḥ sadā ||87|| rājalokaiḥ pīḍitāḥ sma chedanonmūlanādibhiḥ || kūrcitā bhṛśamudvignāstena śokapariplutāḥ ||88 || phalapuṣpavihīnāśca mūlāskandhāvaśeṣitāḥ | evaṃvidhā hi saṃbhūtā naṣṭasaṃjñāḥ sthitā vayam ||89|| aśvapaṭṭasaro divyaṃ sākṣi tatrāsti bhūsuraḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo devaḥ sākṣī tvasmākamityapi ||1.350.90 || puṇyaṃ salilapūrṇaṃ cotphullakamalaśobhitam | kalahaṃsasamāyuktaṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ parisecakam ||91 || sarastat taddrumāṇāṃ tu vināśānno vināśitā | virūpatāsti tatra tvaṃ gatvā no jīvitān kuru ||92|| iṣṭāpūrttaṃ dvijātīnāṃ prathamaṃ dharmasādhanam | iṣṭena labhate svargaṃ pūrtena mokṣameti ca ||93 || vāpīkūpataḍāgāni devatāyatanāni ca | patitānyuddhared yastu sa pūrtaphalamaśnute ||94|| bhūmidānena ye lokā godānena ca kīrtitāḥ | te lokāḥ samavāpyante pādapānāṃ prarohaṇe ||95|| pippalaṃ ca vaṭaṃ nimbaṃ tulasīṃ cāpyudumbaram | āmalakaṃ tathā bilvaṃ khadiraṃ caikameva yaḥ ||96 || puṣpajātīrdaśa dve dve dāḍime cāmrapañcakam | tintiḍīmekalāṃ vātra yastu vardhayati dvija ||97|| puṣpaphaladrumaropī na yāti narakaṃ kvacit | vardhitāśca drumāḥ putrā ivoddharanti poṣakam ||98 || indhanaiśchāyayā śrāntyā pathikānāṃ sukhāvahāḥ | pakṣiṇāṃ nilayenaiva sukhadā vṛkṣavallikāḥ ||99|| patramūlatvagādyairauṣadhaiḥ sukhāstu dehinām | kāṣṭhairgṛhāṇi jāyante kṣudrajantugṛhāṇi ca || 1.350.1 00|| evaṃ paropakārāste sevante dehinaḥ sadā | phalapatradalaśākhāstambamūlairhi jīvadāḥ || 101 || svargadā mokṣadāścāpi devapūjopayojitāḥ | tasmād gokarṇaratnāni gṛhāṇeṣṭāni naḥ sthalāt || 10 2|| vaihāyasaṃ vimānaṃ ca samāruhya tathā ca naḥ | saha nītvā yāhi tatra yatrodyānaṃ tu naḥ sthitam || 103 || asmākaṃ jīvadānena syuḥ putriṇyastu te priyāḥ | bhaviṣyanti susantānāḥ śuka nītvā prayāhi vai || 104 || bayaṃ gopāśca gopyaśca golokasthā api kṣitau | kṛṣṇasevāṃ prakurmo’tra vṛkṣavalītṛṇātmikāḥ || 1 05|| vayaṃ dāsyaḥ pārṣadāśca vaikuṇṭhasthā api kṣitau | kurmo nārāyaṇasevāṃ kuṃkumavāpikāsthitāḥ || 106 || pārṣadānyaḥ pārṣadāśca muktāḥ sāketadhāmagāḥ | sāketāyāṃ vṛkṣavallyaḥ smaḥ śrīrāmārcane ratāḥ | | 10 7| | vayaṃ dūtāśca dūtyaśca kailāsasthā api kṣitau | kāśīkṣetrādisaṃsthānā vallīvṛkṣasvarūpikāḥ || 108 | | iti hārdaṃ kathitaṃ te’smākaṃ viprātra bhautikam | śrīkṛṣṇamaṇḍalaṃ kṛṣṇadāsadāsīmayaṃ smṛtam || 10 1|| ityuktaḥ sa tu gokarṇo ratnānyādāya koṭiśaḥ | devīḥ sarvāstathā patnīḥ śuka cādāya saṃyayau | | 1.350.110 || udyānaṃ kṛtavān puṣṭaṃ bījaiḥ khādyairjalādibhiḥ | vṛkṣā vallyaśca devyaśca puṣṭā jātā hi sevayā || 111 || dhanaṃ ratnādikaṃ tatra sevāyāṃ yojitaṃ bahu | mandiraṃ poṣitaṃ cāpi vṛkṣāścāpi prapoṣitāḥ || 112 || tena puṇyena ca tasya patnyo garbhadharā api | tāśca devyo divyarūpāḥ praśaśaṃsuḥ punaḥ punaḥ | | 113 || varaṃ datvā yathākāmaṃ svastītyuktvā tiro’bhavan | tatra sthitvā yathānyāyaṃ gokarṇaḥ sarvamaṃgalam || 11 4|| śukaṃ ca mātāpitarau sādhvībhāryācatuṣṭayam | samānaṃ sevayāmāsa yathāvibhavaśaktitaḥ || 115 || svayaṃ tu kṛtavāṃstatra vaiṣṇavākhyaṃ mahāmakham | bhakṣyabhojye brāhmaṇebhyo dadau dānāni nityaśaḥ || 116 || kuṃkumavāpyāṃ kṛṣṇasyālayaṃ jīrṇaṃ navottamam | kārayitvā tu tadvāpīṃ navīnāmiva vai punaḥ || 117|| aśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi tvābadhya setunā punaḥ | taṭe pratiṣṭhāṃ svanāmnā gokarṇeśvarasaṃjñayā || 118 || mahādevasya nirvartya brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ | yayau gokṣurasaṃjñaṃ vai pattanaṃ svanivāsakam | | 119 || ya idṃ śṛṇuyāccāpi paṭhedvā bhāvatastathā | tīrthayātrāṃ prakuryācca putravān dhanavān bhavet || 1.350.120 || iti lakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne māthurakṣetramāhātmye saurāṣṭradeśīyasubhadranāmakaviprasya mathurāyāṃ gokarṇeśvaradarśanādinā putraprāptiḥ, tannāma gokarṇaṃ iti, tena śatrujitānadītaṭe gokarṇeśvaraḥ sthāpitaḥ, gokarṇasya dhanārthaṃ vāmanapananaṃ gatasya raivatācale śukaprāptiḥ, punargṛhamāgatya dhanārthaṃ kacchaṃ gatasya nārāyaṇasarasi vanadevatānāṃ darśanaṃ, gaurjararājñā bhagnasyodyānasya kuṃkumavāpyāṃ navīkaraṇam, tīrthasthā vṛkṣavallikā dhāmapārṣadapārṣadānya evetimahimakathanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 350 ||
<1.351> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tatra pure gokṣure brāhmaṇaṃ śukaḥ | provāca yamunāyātrākaraṇārthaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 1 || svasya vai nidhanaṃ yamyāṃ smārayāmāsa vai śukaḥ | naya māṃ māthurīṃ bhūmiṃ kuru yātrāṃ priyātmajaiḥ || 2 || janmanastava sāphalyaṃ kuru gokarṇa sarvathā | gokarṇeśvaradevasya tvaddāturdarśanaṃ kuru || 3 || śrutvā śukavaco vipro gokarṇaḥ sakuṭumbakaḥ | vaihāyasena yānena yayau māthuramaṇḍalam || 4 || viśrāntitīrthake snātvā gokarṇeśvaradarśanam | kṛtvā ca prakramaṃ bhaktyā mathurāmaṇḍalasya saḥ || |5 || mathurāyāṃ cakārāśu viṣṇuyāgaṃ sudakṣiṇam | vinirvṛtte kratau śukodo mṛtyuṃ yayau śukaḥ || 6 || vimānavaramāsādya devo bhūtvā divaṃ gataḥ | śukaṃ hṛdi samāśliṣya praruroha sa vai vaṇik || 7 || yatra śuko mṛtastatra gokarṇena mahātmanā | śukanāmnā kṛtaṃ ramyaṃ śivasyāyatanaṃ mahat || 8 || śukeśvaraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya divyaṃ satraṃ cakāra saḥ | brāhmaṇānāṃ śate dve ca miṣṭānnavarabhojanam || 9 || prāpnutaḥ pratimadhyāhnaṃ khyātaṃ tacchukasatrakam | satrasya paritastatra phalapuṣpapradaṃ varam || 1.351.10 || mathurāvāsibhirlokairudyānaṃ so’pyakārayat | yatra tā divyarūpā vai devyo vallīsvarūpikāḥ || 11 || samāgatyāvasam̐statra gokarṇena vilokitāḥ | tāsāṃ jalaghaṭīyantraṃ jalāpānārthamāvyadhāt || 12|| gokarṇaśca sarasvatyāḥ saṃgame saṃvidhāya tu | snānaṃ prapūjanaṃ cāpi sadārasutabhṛtyakaḥ || 13 || vimānavaramāruhya samāyāti gṛhaṃ prati | madhye vai puṣkaraṃ tīrthaṃ kartuṃ vipro mano dadhe || 14|| puṣkarāraṇyamāsādya vimānaṃ tvavatārayat | susthalyāṃ puṣkarasaro’ntike vṛkṣaghaṭāsu vai || 15|| nyaṣīdattu kṣaṇaṃ yāvat sadārasutabhṛtyakaḥ | gokarṇastatra cāpaśyat pañca pretānsubhīṣaṇān || 16 || tāndṛṣṭvā vikṛtākārān trāsamutsṛjya dūrataḥ | papraccha dhairyamālambya ke yūyaṃ raudramūrtayaḥ || 17|| pretā ūcuḥ kṣutpipāsāturā nityaṃ suduḥkhitāḥ | na jānīmo diśaṃ cāpi vidiśaṃ ca divāniśam || 18|| yadetadduḥkhamāpannaṃ duṣkṛtairnijakarmabhiḥ | ahaṃ paryuṣito nāma paraḥ sūcīmukho hyayam || 1 9|| śīghramastu tṛtīyo’sti caturtho rodhako’sti ca | pañcamo lekhakaśceti karmanāmnā vayaṃ tathā || 1.351.20 || ahaṃ svādu sadāśnāmi dadmi paryuṣitaṃ dvije | tena doṣeṇa sañjāto nāmnā paryuṣitaḥ svayam ||2 1 || sūcitā bahavo’nena bhikṣukāstvannakāṃkṣiṇaḥ | etena karmaṇā cāyaṃ sūcīmukho vyajāyata ||22 || dānamadhye hyayaṃ śīghraṃ nirodhārthaṃ prayāti ca | etena karmaṇā nāmnā śīghragastvabhavat paraḥ ||23 || bahūn pratārya caikākī dvāre pidhāya vai tataḥ | bhuṃkte’yaṃ bhikṣukabhayād rodhakastena cetaraḥ || 24 || bhitukairyogyakāle’yaṃ yācito’pyalikhan mahīm | na dadāti kvacit kiñcit karmaṇā tena lekhakaḥ ||25 || paśya vipra gatiṃ no’tra kṛtena pāpakarmaṇā | madena lekhako yāti rodhakastu hyavākchirāḥ ||26 || paṅguḥ san śīghrago yāti sūcīvanmukhavān paraḥ | bṛhadvṛṣaṇalamboṣṭhaḥ paryuṣito mahodaraḥ ||27|| evaṃ vayaṃ mahāduḥkhā duṣṭabhraṣṭaprabhojinaḥ || yacchutvā nindase vipra śrotavyārhaṃ na vai tu tat ||28|| śleṣmamūtrapurīṣāṇi bālānāṃ yoṣitāṃ gṛhe | kṣetre tyaktānyaśaucāni pretā bhuñjanti tāni vai || 29|| devārpaṇavihīnāni malamūtrabhṛtāni ca | aśuddhau randhitānyeva pretā bhuñjanti tāni vai || 1.351.30 || kṣiptāni nālikāyāṃ tu bhraṣṭapātrasthitāni ca | rājasvalyādiduṣṭāni pretā bhuñjanti tāni hi ||3 1 || atithyarpaṇahīnāni kalahotpādakāni ca | ninditāni tathānnāni pretā bhuñjanti sarvadā ||3 2|| duṣkarmānnaṃ sūtakānnaṃ kledyānnaṃ no’bhitiṣṭhati | tathāpi kṣunna hi pretaṃ tyajatyapi kadācana ||3 3 || jalamaśuddhisaṃspṛṣṭamupayāti ca no’lpakam | nānyatra jalapānaṃ syādvāruṇabhṛtyapālite ||34|| bhraṣṭānnena tu bhuktena mānavo mriyate yadi | tenaiva codarasthena sa preto jāyate dvija |||35||| manuṣyādiśiraḥkapālikāyāṃ bhuṃjate tu ye | te mṛtāḥ pretatāṃ yānti paśubhiḥ sahabhojinaḥ ||36|| madyamāṃsāśano duṣṭavāsanādyatimohitaḥ | devavipragurudravyahartā preto’bhijāyate ||37|| mātaraṃ pitaraṃ bhrātṝn bhaginīśca striyaṃ sutam | aduṣṭān yastyajetpāpaḥ preto bhavati vai dhruvam ||38|| duṣṭakarmakṛtāṃ saṃgo pāpātpreto’bhijāyate | brahmahā ca kṛtaghnaśca bālaghno goghna ityapi ||39|| bhūmikanyādhanahartā gurordveṣṭā ca nāstikaḥ | sa pāpo jāyate preta stvāhārādivivarjitaḥ ||1.351.40|| tasmāt puṇyaṃ prakartavyaṃ na dveṣṭavyaṃ kadācana | paropakārakārī vai preto naiva prajāyate ||41 || sukhiteṣu sadā maitrīṃ duḥkhiteṣu dayāṃ śubhām | puṇyavatsu muditāṃ ca kurvan preto na jāyate ||42||| apuṇyaśāliṣu yo na sajjate vai kadācana | upekṣāṃ kurute teṣu na sa preto’bhijāyate ||43||| vrataṃ karoti devānāṃ tathā cāndrāyaṇādikam | rāgaśūnyaḥ svacchabuddhirna sa preto’bhijāyate ||44|| annajalapradātā yaḥ śraddhayā dharmakāryakṛt | sādhudevayatipūjākartā preto na jāyate ||45|| paropakārakartā ca parapoṣaṇatatparaḥ | sarvabhūtadayāluśca na preto jāyate kvacit ||46|| pitṛsurātithipūjyapūjāyāḥ kārakastu yaḥ | parātmatoṣako vipra na preto jāyate kvacit ||47|| kāmakrodhamahālobhamohatṛṣṇāvivarjitaḥ | kṣamādānadayāśīlo na pretaḥ saṃbhavet kvacit| ||48 || jayantīnāṃ vratakartā kathānāṃ vācakaḥ sadā | gobhūviprasatīsādhutīrthamantā sudharmavān ||49|| snānasandhyājapahomakartā preto na jāyate | mātṛsevāṃ pitṛsevāṃ guroḥ sevāṃ karoti yaḥ ||1.351.50 || gavāṃ sevā patisevā patnīsaukhyaṃ karoti yaḥ | dīnānāthādisevākṛnna preto jāyate kvacit ||51 śuddhyannaṃ śuddhikṛddravyaṃ yaḥ svārthaṃ sayunakti vai | sarvāśīrvādasaṃgrāhī na preto jāyate kvacit ||52|| pretānāṃ cābhijātānāṃ gatiṃ jānāsi ced vad | asmākaṃ kuru coddhāraṃ cet samuddhartumarhasi ||53 || iti pretavacaḥ śrutvā gokarṇaḥ prāha tām̐stadā | ye dharmavimukhā mūḍhā dayādānavivarjitāḥ ||54|| pretā jātāśca vai teṣāṃ mathurāsaṃgame gatiḥ | śravaṇadvādaśīyoge snātvā yamyāṃ tu bhādrake ||55|| vāmanārcanamevātha havanaṃ kārayettathā | chatropānatsuvarṇānnaṃ vastradānaṃ prakārayet ||56 || pitṝm̐śca tarpayet tena pretā yānti paraṃ padam | mathurātīrthake snānaṃ janaṃ dhyātvā hariṃ smaret ||57|| pretastīrthasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇuyācced gatiṃ labhet | vimānavaramāruhya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ||58|| māsi bhādrapade śuddhā dvādaśī śravaṇānvitā | tasyāṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ snātaṃ sarvaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet ||59|| yamīsarasvatīsandhau snātvā sampūjya vāmanam | kalaśaṃ vidhinā datvā pretabhāvo na vidyate ||1.351.6 0 || kapilānāṃ śataṃ datvā hiraṇyopaskarāñcitam | dvādaśyāṃ tatphalaṃ syādvai snātvā nadyostu saṃgame ||6 1 || rākṣasatvaṃ bhavennaṣṭaṃ śravaṇadvādaśīvratāt | svarge vasati tāvadvai yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ||6 2|| tataḥ svargād bhuvaṃ yāti vipro bhavati vedavit | jātismaro mahāyogī mokṣamārgaparāyaṇaḥ ||6 3 || dhyānayuktena bhāvena sevayā paramātmanaḥ | āśīrvādena pitrośca mukto yātyapunarbhavam ||64|| yathālabdhasuvarṇena kārayitvā tu vāmanam | upānacchatrasaṃyuktaṃ pūjayedvidhivattu tam ||65|| āvāhayet tathā taṃ ca snāpayet pañcakāmṛtaiḥ | jalenābhiṣecayecca vastrādi dhārayettathā ||66|| alaṃkārān sugandhisaddravyatailādikaṃ dadet | candanāni kuṃkumaṃ ca kajjalaṃ copavītakam ||67|| arpayecca tathā dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyamuttamam | phalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ vāri śrīphalaṃ cārghyameva vā ||68|| dadyānnīrājayed devaṃ chatracāmaramarpayet | dakṣiṇāṃ ca namaskāraṃ godānaṃ karakārpaṇam ||69|| stutiṃ kuryācca tasyāgre tato devaṃ visarjayet | evaṃ tu vidhinā kṛtvā pretamuktirbhaved dhruvam |1.351.70 || yastu sarasvatīyoge yamunāyāḥ susaṃgame | karoti vidhinānena tasya puṇyaṃ śatottaram ||71 || śrāvaṇadvādaśīyoge bhādre śukle vrataṃ caret | tena muktirbhaved dhrauvyā golokādinivāsadā ||72||| pretā ūcuśca taṃ gokarṇaṃ vipraṃ śaraṇāgatāḥ | bho vidvam̐stadvrataṃ kartuṃ pretānāṃ śaktireva na ||73 || tasmātpuṇyapradānena kurvasmākaṃ vimokṣaṇam | gokarṇaśca dyāṃ kṛtvā dadau snānajapuṇyakam ||74|| dade padorajaścāpi dadau padorjalaṃ tathā | tena muktāśca te sarve jātā vai pretayonitaḥ || 75|| ākāśe dundubhidhvānamabhūd devakṛtaṃ tadā | pretānāṃ tu samūhāścāgatā draṣṭuṃ samantataḥ || 76|| devadūta uvācedaṃ pretānāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tadā | asya viprasya saṃbhāṣātsnānapuṇvasamaparṇāt || || caraṇasya rajolābhājjalalābhācca sarvathā | pretabhāvavimuktaḥ stha tīrthasya śravaṇādapi ||78|| tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kartavyaṃ tīrthasevanam | sadbhiḥ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ satāṃ samyak prasevanam ||79|| tīrthaśraddhā vrataśraddhā kathāśraddhā ca mānase | kartavyā sarvathā pretāḥ muktidāsti tu sā yataḥ ||1.351.80|| tīrthābhiṣekipuruṣapādaprakṣālanaṃ jalam | pātavyaṃ cāpi muktyarthaṃ yathaiteṣāṃ vimuktidam ||8 1 || pretānāmakṣayaḥ svargaḥ sarasvatyāśca saṃgamāt | prāptaṃ tīrthaprabhāvasya pretairvai śravaṇāt phalam ||82|| āgatāni vimānāni pretānāṃ divyavarṣmaṇām | devānāṃ ca kṛte pañcāruhya te svargamuttamam ||83|| gatā lakṣmi paraṃ lokaṃ vinā sādhanasampadam | gokarṇaḥ puṣkaraṃ tīrtha kṛtvā gokṣuramāyayau ||84|| yaḥ paṭhetparayā bhaktyā śṛṇuyād bhaktitatparaḥ | śrāvayecca smaret tīrth sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||85|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne māthurakṣetramāhātmye śukoktyā gokarṇasya mathurāyātrā, śukamokṣaḥ, śukeśvarasthāpanā, mārge parāvṛtasya gokarṇasya pañcapretamilāpaḥ, puṣkare pretāpretatvakāraṇasaṃvādaḥ, bhādraśukladvādaśyāṃ vāmanapūjā, snānapuṇyadānena pretānāṃ muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikapaṃcāśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 351 ||
<1.352> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kṛṣṇagaṃgātīrthaṃ yāmunavārigam | yatra vyāsaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo bhagavān sṛṣṭibodhavān || 1 || ādye kṛte yuge snātvā vedānadhyāpayat sadā | yāvattu yamunābhūmau sthāsyati tāvadeva saḥ || 2 || snāsyati tatsthale nityaṃ kṛṣṇagaṃgājale hariḥ | somavaikuṇṭhayormadhye kṛṣṇagaṃgā tu sā matā ||3|| tatrāśramapade divye munayo divyavigrahāḥ | adṛśyāstu samāyānti cāturmāsyavratārthinaḥ || 4 || yeṣāmupari teṣāṃ vai dayālūnāṃ kṛpā bhavet | teṣāṃ te ṛṣayo dṛṣṭipathamāyānti nānyathā || 5 || cāturmāsye kṛṣṇagaṃgātīrthe vipreṇa vīkṣitam | dayāpātreṇa vasunā pāñcālyakulatantunā || 6 || śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi pāpyuddhārakarīṃ kathām | pāñcālyo’tha dvijaḥ kaścinnāmnā vasuritiśrutaḥ || 7 || durbhikṣapīḍito’tyantaṃ sabhāryo varapattanam | yayau bhadrātaṭe bhikṣāvṛttyā vāsaṃ samācarat || 8 || tatrasthasya tadā putraḥ kanyā cetyabhavad dvayam | kanyā viprāya saṃdattā dhanadhānyasamṛddhaye || 9 || kanyāpatistato vipro yauvane rogapīḍitaḥ | mamāra bandhuvidhuraḥ kuṭumbarahitastathā || 1.352.1 0|| kanyāsthīni tu saṃgṛhya mathurāmājagāma ha | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitoktaṃ tvasthiprapātanam ||1 1 || ardhacandrasthale tatra māthure maṇḍale kṛtam | yasya bhavet sa vai dehī muktiṃ yātīti vātrcchayā || 1 2|| kanyayāsthīni yamunāsrotasi vidhinā tadā | kṣiptāni viprahastena patyurmuktistadābhavat ||13|| bālaraṇḍā tu sā ramyā nīlakuñcitamūrdhajā | surūpā sukumārāṃgī nirādhārātiduḥkhitā || 14|| kadalīkāṇḍasaṃkāśe tasyā ūrū sumāṃsale | suśliṣṭāgulikāpādau nakhāstāmrojjvalāḥ śubhāḥ || 15|| gaṃbhīrā dakṣiṇāvarttā nābhistrivalimaṇḍitā | āmodarī samakukṣiḥ pīnonnatapayodharā || 16|| kambugrīvā saṃvṛtāsyā sudatī svadharāhanuḥ | sunakhī svakṣiṇī subhrūḥ supramāṇā subhāṣiṇī || 17|| sukaṭiḥ svalpamadhyā ca candrānanābjalocanā | tena tenaiva sampūrṇarūpeṇa ca tilottamā || 18|| nāmā tilottamā svarṇavarṇā yuvatī sundarī | evaṃvidhā tatra tatra tīrthasnānaparāyaṇā || 19|| yaṃ yaṃ paśyati cārvaṃgī yastāṃ cāpi prapaśyati | sa sa citra iva nyasto vicetā jāyate kṣaṇam ||1.352.20|| tathāvidhā mathurāyāṃ svakaṃ vāsamarocayat | tadaivāvasare kānyakubjadeśādhipo nṛpaḥ ||21 || mathurāyāṃ devamarteśvare’nnasatramākarot | tatra vai brāhmaṇāḥ satyaḥ sādhvyo brāhmaṇya ityapi ||21 || sādhavo bhikṣukā dīnā anāthā bhuṃjate śatam | tatreyaṃ susadā bhuṃkte suśīlā tu tilottamā ||23|| bhojanasya samaye tu saṃgītaṃ supravartate | vāditrāṇi ca gītāni śakrasya bhavane yathā || 24|| rājñastasya tu yā nṛtyakāriṇyo gāyikāstathā | dūtyaśca gaṇikāścāpi tābhiḥ sā pratilobhitā ||25|| gītanṛtyādiṣu snigdhā tāsāṃ dharmamupāgatā | alpaistu divasaiḥ sādhvī hyasādhvībhiḥ parivṛtā || 26|| rājñaḥ samāgamaṃ prāptā bhogabhogyabhṛtābhavat | yuvatī kāmadāhena navaṃ navaṃ samicchati ||27|| evaṃ sā kāmadharmeṣu vyavāyapathagābhavat | athatasyāstu yo bhrātā pāñcālo brāhmaṇātmajaḥ ||28|| gṛhe sa nirdhano bhūtvā vyavasāyaṃ vicārya ca | mathurāyāṃ gate kāle samāyāto nirāśrayaḥ ||29|| kasyacicchreṣṭhivaryasya karmacārī tadābhavat | vyāpārabuddhyā varṣānte so’pi vyāpāralābhavān ||1.352.3 0 || dhanavān vai bhāgyayogāt saṃjāto vidhuro’pi ca | yamunāyāṃ sadā yāti snānārthaṃ snāti yatra sā ||3 1 || nityaṃ paśyati cārvaṃgīṃ dṛṣṭvā mohavaśaṃ gataḥ | tatra tīrthavare snātvā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ ||32|| devādidarśanaṃ kṛtvā garteśvaraṃ samarcya ca | tilottamāyā mārgaṃ vai dhṛtvā paścād yayau śanaiḥ || 33 || yatra tadbhavanaṃ tatra dhātreyikāṃ vyalokayat | tayā cāpi yuvā mugdha iti tvākārito gṛhe ||34|| dhātreyikāyāstasyāśca bahumānapuraḥsaram | yayau prasannamanasā yuvatyā bhavanāntaram || 35|| vastrāṇi baddharūpāṇi sauvarṇakaṭakāni ca | hārān ratnamayān dravyaṃ dadau tasyai vimohitaḥ || 36 || dadāvagurusāraṃ ca sakarpūraṃ sacandanam | tasyā gṛhavare tatra vasati sma dine dine || 37|| praharārdhe dine jāte yāti svaśibiraṃ tataḥ | snātvā tīrthe samīpe ca kṛṣṇagaṃgodbhave sadā ||38|| evaṃ nityaṃ tadāsaktaḥ karoti vartanaṃ svakam | sumantumunināṃ nityaṃ gacchan sa cāvalokyate ||39||| athaikadā pragacchan vai snātuṃ vipraḥ sumantunā | svāśramasthena divyena dṛṣṭaḥ sa kṛmikīṭavān ||1.352.40 || kṛmayo romakūpebhyaḥ patamānā anekaśaḥ | dṛśyante kurute yāvatsnānaṃ tāvatpatanti vai ||41 || snāne kṛte na dṛśyante surūpaścābhijāyate | evaṃ sumantunā dṛṣṭamāścaryaṃ bahuvāsaram || 42|| sumantustvāhvayāmāsa papraccha nāma karma ca | pāñcālastaṃ tadā prāha tvahaṃ paṃcāladeśajaḥ ||43 || vipro vāṇijyamāśritya vasāmyatra nu caikalaḥ | niśāmuṣitvā śibire tilottamāsurakṣite ||44|| prātaḥ snātvā trigarteśaṃ pūjayitvā tamanvaham | divā karomi vyāpāraṃ vasāmi śibire niśi || 45|| sumantuśca tadā prāha śṛṇu vipra yathātatham | āścaryaṃ tava dehe’smin nityaṃ paśyāmi niḥsṛtam ||46|| asnāte kṛmisaṃpūrṇaṃ snāte nirmalavarcasam | asti kiñcinmahatpāpaṃ tava pracchannasaṃbhavam || 47|| asyāṃ tīrthaprabhāveṇa snānād gacchati dūrataḥ | trigarteśvarasaṃsparśāt śuddhaṃ dehaṃ tu dṛśyate ||48|| nirūpya kathayāsmān vai yatte pracchannakilbiṣam | iti muneḥ sumantoḥ sa śrutvā trikālavedinaḥ ||49|| svaśibire’ṅganāsaṃgaṃ karomīti nyavedayat | gatvā tathā tadaikānte tāṃ tu papraccha mūlataḥ ||1.352.50|| kā tvaṃ kasya sutā kaśca deśastvatrāgamaḥ kutaḥ | tyākṣyāmi hi priyānprāṇān yadi satyaṃ na vakṣyati |||51 || nirbandhaṃ tasya taṃ jñātvā duḥkhenovāca sā svakam | pañcālo brāhmaṇo deśe pañcāle varapattane ||52|| vartate vasunāmākhyastatsutāhaṃ tilottamā | vivāhitā patirnaṣṭo’sthīni tvādāya māthuram ||53 || āgatā rāgayogena kānyakubjanṛpārthitā | vyavāyadharmamāpannā vartāni kāmadharmiṇī ||54||| mama bhrātā tu pāñcālo vartate pitṛmandire | bhadrānadītaṭe tatra gṛhaṃ me hyabhavatpurā ||55|| atra vasāmyanāthāhaṃ kulaṭādharmamāśritā | vada tvaṃ svīyavṛttāntaṃ yadi māṃ vetsi pātrakam || 56 || etacchrutvā sa pāṃcālyaḥ sāśrunetro’bhavattadā | labdhasaṃjñaṃ kulaṃ tasya papraccha taṃ tilottamā ||57|| tatastena svavṛttāntaṃ kathitaṃ kulanāmakam | atyativimanā jāto hyagamyāgamanena vai ||58||| prāyaścitte matirabhūnnirviṇṇasya dvijanmanaḥ | mātaraṃ gurupatnīṃ ca svasāraṃ putrikāṃ vadhūm ||59|| gatvā tu praviśedagniṃ nānyā śuddhirvidhīyate | patyātmakaṃ tu pāñcālī jñātvā svabhrātaraṃ tu tam ||1.352.60 || dvijebhyaḥ pradadau sarvaṃ ratnavastradhanādikam | kāliṃjaratrigarteśaṃ datvā bhūṣādhanādikam ||6 1 || kṛṣṇagaṃgodbhave tīrthe citāṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ | ātmanaḥ sā viśuddhyarthaṃ prajajvāla hutāśanam ||62|| pāñcālo’pi svakaṃ dravyaṃ datvā dāne’vaśeṣitam | aurdhvadaihikabhāgārthaṃ kalpayitvā yathāvidhi ||63 || snātvā devām̐stathā natvā brāhmaṇām̐śca sumantukam | ṛṣiṃ gatvā samuvācāgamyāgamanapātakam ||64|| tatpāpasya viśuddhyarthaṃ dehatyāgaṃ karomi vai | ityuktvā ca citāṃ kṛtvā samuddīpya ghṛtokṣitām ||65|| yāvatpraveṣṭuṃ yātyenaṃ vāguvācāśarīriṇī | bhaginīṃ ca praveṣṭuṃ vai tatparāṃ tāvadeva ha ||66 || maivaṃ kārṣīḥ sāhasaṃ ca vipāpmānau yato hi vām | yatra kṛṣṇasya sañcāraḥ krīḍā jātā yathāsukham ||67|| cakrāṃkitapadanyāsāstatthalaṃ divyameva yat | brahmarūpaṃ dhāmarūpaṃ yatra pāpakṣayo bhavet ||68|| anyatra hi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tīrthamāsādya naśyati | tīrthasthāne kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vajralepaṃ bhavedapi ||6 9|| tadubhayavināśastu gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame | gomatīsāgarayoge yamunāpaṃcatīrthake ||1.352.70 || pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu snānajaṃ yatphalaṃ matam | yamunāyāḥ pañcatīrthasnānena tulyameva na ||71 || ekādaśyāṃ hi viśrāntau dvādaśyāṃ saukare tathā | trayodaśyāṃ naimiṣe ca caturdaśyāṃ prayāgake ||72|| pūrṇāyāṃ puṣkare snānāt kārtikyāṃ ca vrate vrate | tīrthe tīrthe janaḥ snātvā sarvapāpāt pramucyate || 73 || mathurāyāṃ sarvatīrthe viśrāntau pañcatīrthake | asikuṇḍe sarasvatīyoge garteśvare tathā ||74|| snānajāttu phalād daśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ sakṛdapi | kṛṣṇagaṃgāsnānato vai jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 75|| jñānato’jñānato vāpi duṣkṛtaṃ samupārjitam | kṛṣṇagaṃgājalasparśe vajrākhyamapi naśyati || 76 || mathurā hi kṛṣṇarūpā nadī kṛṣṇamayī tathā | narā nāryaḥ kṛṣṇarūpāstatra pāpaṃ na vidyate || 77|| yasya śrotraikadeśe tu hyākāśo leśamātrakaḥ | yasya nayanayoḥ prānte tejo līnaṃbhavatyapi ||78|| yasya śvāse’nilo līno jalaṃ svede vilīyate | pṛthvī yasyodare tvaṇvī bhūtvā tiṣṭhati sarvadā || 79|| yatkukṣau vārdhayaḥ sarve līnā bhavanti sarvadā | yasmād bhavanti satataṃ brahmāṇḍāni svaromataḥ ||1.352.80|| avatārā varāhādyā bhavanti yasya vāñcchayā | tasmin kṛṣṇe sthite cātra pāpaleśo na vidyate ||81 || pṛthvīrakṣākaro devo varāho yatra vidyate | tasya sandarśanāttvatra mahāpātakanāśanam ||82|| tatkṣaṇādeva viprendra nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | navamyāṃ jyeṣṭhaśuklasya kṛṣṇagaṃgodakāplavāt ||83|| sūkare tu trirātraṃ vai mānavo dīpadānataḥ | tilottame mahāvajrāpyatipāpaiḥ pramucyate ||84|| kāliṃjare tu dvādaśyāṃ snātvā sampūjya devatām | divyacaturbhujo bhūtvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate |||85||| evaṃ lakṣmi devavāṇyā pāñcālaśca tilottamā | bodhitau tau gatau divyasumantorāśrame tadā ||86 || pādayoḥ patitau tasyocatuśca tvaṃ pitā guruḥ | brūhi divyadṛśā brahmannatra kiṃ karavāvahai ||87|| muniḥ prāha vyomavāṇīṃ yathārthā nānṛtā kvacit | mayā pratyakṣato dṛṣṭaṃ bhavadgātreṣu pātakam ||88|| snānātprāgeva no paścāttato nāstyeva pātakam | pañcatīrthe trigarteśe snānaṃ saṃkuruta sadā ||89|| āśrame mama nityaṃ ca tiṣṭhataṃ kurutaṃ japam | pāpāduparamitau ca yāvatkālaṃ prajīvathaḥ ||1.352.90|| mamāśīrvādataścāpi bhrātā ca bhaginī hyubhau | vipāpmānau tu saṃbhūtau brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyathaḥ ||91 || evaṃ tatrāśrame lakṣmi suyantvādyā maharṣayaḥ | divyadehāḥ pravasanti tatastīrthottamaṃ smṛtam ||92|| saṃprāptau divyadehau tau bhrātā ca bhaginī hyubhau | ārṣau tatrāśrame jātau darśanādapi muktidau ||93|| tato vimānamāruhya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tau | śrīkṛṣṇena samaṃ yātau golokaṃ dhāma śāśvatam ||94|| evaṃ prabhāvastīrthasya mathurāyāṃ yamījale | kṛṣṇagaṃgāsthalasyāpi tathā kāliñjarasya ca ||95|| sūkarasyāpi tīrthasya mahālakṣmi vadāmi kim | pāpaṃ na pāparūpaṃ tad yadi kṛṣṇāya cārpitam ||96|| apāpaṃ pāparūpaṃ syād yadi kṛṣṇāya nārpitam | tasmāt puṇyaṃ mahādānaṃ kāryaṃ yatkiñcideva tat || 97|| mahyaṃ kṛṣṇāya dātavyaṃ nirdoṣaṃ doṣavattu yat | kāmaḥ krodho mahān lobho mānaḥ svādaśca mohitā || 98|| sarve kṛṣṇārpitā divyā nirbandhāya bhavanti vai | yaḥ śṛṇoti mahālakṣmi śraddhayā paṭhati dhruvam ||99|| saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tasya sarvaṃ vyapohati | prātarasyaikavāraṃ vai cāturmāsye tu vācanam || 1.352.100 || kariṣyati janastasya phalaṃ gośatadānajam | pāpaleśo na vai tasyāmṛtatvaṃ jāyate dṛḍham || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mathurātīrthamāhātmyaṃ saurāṣṭrīyasya varapattanavāsinaḥ pāṃcālaviprasya tilottamākhyabhaginyā saha mathurāyāmajānatorjātasyavyavāyabhāvasya vyomavāṇyā sumantunā ṛṣiṇā ca niṣpāpatā pañcatīrthakṛṣṇagaṃgātīrthaprabhāveṇa darśiteti nirūṇanāmā dvipañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 352 ||
<1.353> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi caritaṃ vai nārīṇāṃ cañcalaṃ sadā | putraṃ rūpayutaṃ dṛṣṭvā pitaraṃ vā janāntaram || 1 || kṣaṇaṃ saṃkalpavaśagā kvacid bhavati bhāminī | cañcalaṃ hi manastadvad rājasī kāmavedanā || 2 || parādhīnaṃ karotyeva yathā sāmbaṃ kariṣyati | śṛṇu śrīkṛṣṇasya putraḥ sāmbanāmā bhaviṣyati || 3 || mātṝṇāṃ tatra mohena śāpapātraṃ bhaviṣyati | sāmbasya varṣmaṇi kuṣṭharogo bhaviṣyati tadā || 4 || sa mathurāṃ samāgatyādityasyopāsanāṃ tathā | kariṣyati pratiṣṭhāṃ ca snāsyati yāmune jale ||5 || tena kuṣṭhavināśo’sya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | etādṛśaṃ tu māthuraṃ tīrthaṃ rogavināśakam || 6 || śṛṇu vistarato lakṣmi bhaviṣyat kathayāmi tat | dvārakāṃ vasamānasya putradārasutaiḥ saha || 7 || kṛṣṇasya bhavanaṃ tatra samāyānnārado muniḥ | yathāyogyaṃ svāgataṃ śrīkṛṣṇastasyākaronmudā || 8 || nāradastu tadaikānte bhijñaptimakaroddharim | kṛṣṇa kiñcidvaktukāmaḥ śṛṇu svarge śrutaṃ mayā || 9 || sāmbanāmā kṛṣṇaputro yuvā rūpātiśobhanaḥ | spṛhaṇīyaḥ strījanasya kānto nānyo hi tatsamaḥ || 1.353.1 0|| api kṛṣṇasya patnyo’pi spṛhayanti vilokya tam | devayonyaśca yāḥ santi sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa || 11 || sāmbaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu sarvāsāṃ kṣubhyanti mānasāni vai | etat svargādilokeṣu gīyate daivataiḥ katham || 12|| yaśo vai svargavāso’sti narakastadviparyayaḥ | tvatpriyārthaṃ samāyātaḥ kathayituṃ mahāprabho || 13| puṇyaṃ saṃśrūyate yāvat tāvatpuruṣa ucyate | apuṇyaśravaṇe tasya nirayo vai prakīrtyate || 14|| tasmātsatyamasatyaṃ vā lakṣayiṣyāmyahaṃ hi tat | tasmāt sāmbaṃ tathā devīgaṇaṃ saṃsadi cāhvaya || 15 || itiproktastathā kṛṣṇo devīrāhūya sarvaśaḥ | niṣādya sāmbamāhūya svapārśve’pi nyaṣādayat || 16 || dṛṣṭvā rūpamatīvāsya sāmbasyātra varastriyaḥ | cukṣubhuḥ sakalā devyaḥ kṛṣṇasyaiva tu paśyataḥ || 17|| nāradaṃ tā namaskṛtya jagmuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niketanam | sāmbastasthau tatra kṛṣṇo lajjayāvāṅmukho’bhavat || 18|| kṣaṇo nāsti raho nāsti nāstikṛtye vicāraṇā | surūpaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣaranti pramadāḥ sadāḥ || 19|| svabhāva eṣa nārīṇāṃ tatra kā parivedanā | yathā tvekena cakreṇa rathasya na gatirbhavet ||1.353.20|| vinā naraṃ tvagatatyaḥ kṣaranti nṛrasāḥ striyaḥ | puṃsvādadṛṣṭipātena manyante kṛtakṛtyatām ||21 || pradyumnaṃ vīkṣya tāḥ sarvā lajjāmāpuḥ supuṣkalām | sāmbaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu tāḥ sarvā anaṅgena prapīḍitāḥ ||22|| uddīpanavibhāvo’yaṃ sāmbastvatstrīvimohakaḥ | satyaloke pravādo yastava jāto duratyayaḥ || 23 || mayā śrutastu lokebhyo brahmarṣibhyo muhurmuhuḥ | sāmbaṃ tyaktvāyaśastatsammārṣṭumarhasi keśava | | 24|| ityuktvā nārado maunamāsthito’tha haristataḥ | taṃ tu śaśāpa sāmbaṃ vai virūpo bhava putraka || 25 | | tāvatsāmbaḥ kuṣṭhayukto’bhavad virūpa eva ha | atha sāmbaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā saśokaṃ prāha nāradaḥ | | 26 | | sāmba sāmba kṛṣṇaputra śṛṇu jāmbavatīsuta | sūryamudyantameva tvaṃ namaskuru sadānagha || 27| | kuṣṭharogo ravistuṣṭo nāśayiṣyati putraka | mathurāyāṃ ca tvaṃ gatvā ṣaṭsūryaṃ prāpsyase phalam || 28 | | prātarārādhaya sūryaṃ ṣaṭsūryatīrthake’nagha | madhyāhnepi tathā sāyaṃ sadyaḥ phalamavāpnuhi || 29 || kṛṣṇagaṃgodbhave snātvā sūryamārādhya yatnataḥ | sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ kuṣṭhādibhyo vimucyate || 1.353.30 || ityuktastu mahālakṣmi sāmbaḥ kṛṣṇājñayā yayau | mathurāṃ doṣaharaṇīṃ muktidāṃ sa dadarśa ha | | 31 | | ṣaṭsūryānpūjayāmāsa niyatasnānatarpaṇaḥ | brāhmaṃ tathodayanta ca hyūrdhvaṃ yāntaṃ ca madhyagam || 32 | | namantaṃ cāpyastagataṃ nityaṃ sāmbaḥ samārcayat | sūryastuṣṭaḥ svalpakāle sāmbasyāgre samāgamat || 33 | | varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te gataṃ kuṣṭhādikaṃ tava | ityuktvā sāmbasarvāṃge’spṛśat sāmbo’pi tatkṣaṇam || 34 || kuṣṭhahīno’bhavatsūryasamakāntirvyarājata | sūryo dvitīyarūpeṇa sāmbena saha vartate || 35|| brāhme sūryaṃ virāḍākhyaṃ sāmbaścakre pratiṣṭhitam | udayākhyaraviṃ yamyāṃ dakṣiṇe sampratiṣṭhitam || 36 || ūrdhvayāntaṃ kālapriyaraviṃ cakre pratiṣṭhitam | vaikuṇṭhapaścime cakre raviṃ mādhyandinīyakam || 3 7|| avataranta sāmbārkaṃ mathurāyāṃ pratiṣṭhitam | astamantaṃ kṛṣṇagaṃgādakṣiṇe’rka pratiṣṭhitam || 38 || cakre sāmbastatpūjādividhiṃ sāmbapure sthitaḥ | mathurāyāṃ tvabhavat tat sāmbapuraṃ kuleśvaram || 39 || māghamāsasya saptamyāṃ divyaṃ sāmbapuraṃ prati | rathayātrāṃ sāmbasūryāṃ kariṣyanti tu ye janāḥ ||1.353.40 || gaccheyustatpadaṃ śāntaṃ sūryamaṇḍalabhedakam | kṛṣṇagaṃgāṃ janāḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā ṣaṭasūryamaṇḍalam || 41 || pāparogādimuktāśca yāsyanti paramaṃ padam | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi manaḥpāpādināśakam ||42|| agamyāgamanasyāpi cāgamyagamanasya ca | pāpaṃ prajvālayatyāśu tvādityaṣaṭkatīrthakam ||43||| kāmena yanmanodauṣṭyaṃ vidhunoti tu tad drutam | aparādhānapi sarvān mathurāyāṃ hariḥ svayam ||44|| na vai gaṇayati kṛṣṇo gopījanakṛtādaraḥ | sāmbo’bhavaddhūtapāpastatraivāntaradhīyata || 45|| sūryarathe sadā tiṣṭhan bhaviṣyaṃ paripṛcchati | tatsarvaṃ tu navaṃ kṛtvā jñātavān kṛṣṇaputrakaḥ ||46|| sāmbapuraṃ mathurāyāṃ kṛtvā yāto nijaṃ gṛham | paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya ṣaḍādityārhaṇāphalam ||47|| labhate sūryalokaṃ ca prāṇānte kṛṣṇadhāma ca | śṛṇu lakṣmi bhaktakṛtānaparādhānapi priye ||48|| ajñātaḥ sarvathā śuddho vaiṣamye deśakālayoḥ | vināparādho manujaḥ sāparādho vijāyate ||49|| karmaṇā manasā vācātvaparādhā bhavanti vai | snānahīnatvamevātha hiṃsanaṃ mithunakriyā ||1.353.50|| malamūtraparityāgo bālajanmādikaṃ tathā | śavasparśādikaṃ devapūjane hyaparādhanam ||51 || mandirasya tathā mūrteḥ sānnidhye patprasāraṇam | pṛṣṭhadānaṃ mehanaṃ ca yatheṣṭabhakṣaṇādikam || 52|| malināśuddhabhakṣitvaṃ niṣiddhakusumārcanam | anuttārya tu nirmālyaṃ pūjākṣīṇe’ndhakāriṇi ||53|| kleśanaṃ devatāgāre sopānatko’pasarpaṇam | surāmāṃsāśanaṃ devasyāndhakāre prabodhanam ||54|| anamaskaraṇaṃ tadvad grāmyajalpavitaṇḍikāḥ | dhūmrapānaṃ ṣṭhīvanaṃ cetyādyāḥ karmāparādhakāḥ ||55||| adhyāna cāsmaraṇaṃ cādhāraṇaṃ śrīharestathā | anyasakalpakaraṇaṃ viṣayādivicintanam ||56|| rāgo dveṣastathā tṛṣṇā vāsanā cānyanindanam | kutarkahetusandehā bhrāntirviparyayastathā || 57|| ālasyaṃ cānanusandhānakaṃ garvo’bhimānitā | kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho mado mātsaryamityapi ||58|| īrṣyāniṣṭavicārādyā mānasā hyaparādhakāḥ | mātṛpitṛsuhṛnmitragurudvijasurādayaḥ || 59|| satīsādhvīpriyāpatnībālābālagavādayaḥ | tṛṇājantucetanādyāḥ sarve nārāyaṇāntarāḥ ||1.353.6 0|| patibhṛtyāśritā naivāparāddhavyāḥ kadācana | asatpralāpo’sadvārtā vyarthabhāṣitvamityapi ||61 || abhajanaṃ doṣadānaṃ duṣṭaśabdaprayojanam | kalahaścākrośanaṃ ca kolāhalaśca pardanam ||62|| atiśabdadhvanidhvānaṃ gālīvācanamityapi | aślīlavāk samuddhoṣaḥ sakthisphoṭādikaṃ tathā ||63|| anargalaprahāyasyādyā vāṇī kṛtāparādhakāḥ | na kartavyā vicāryaiva svāniṣṭaphaladāstu te ||64|| devatīrthaguruviprasādhusādhvīpativratāḥ | sarve ye tārakāsteṣāmaparādhān na cācaret ||65|| sāparādhastu puruṣo viṣṇuṃ naiva prapaśyati | rākṣasīṃ tāmasīṃ pūjāṃ naiva kuryāt kadācana ||66||| māṃsamadyārpiṇī pūjā rākṣasī procyate priye | hiṃsādikṛtyayuktā yā pūjā sā tāmasī matā ||67|| pāradāryaṃ paradravyaharaṇaṃ ca parārdanam | paranāśakaraṃ karma rākṣasaṃ karma kīrtitam ||68|| karmakṛtāparādhānāṃ śuddhiḥ snānādinā bhavet | tīrthasnānena pañcagavyānāṃ saṃprāśanena ca ||69|| upoṣaṇena yajñena dīrghakālagatena ca | pañcāmṛtena ca tathā brahmakūrcavratena ca ||1.353.70|| devānāṃ sevayā satāṃ sevayā śuddhiriṣyate | manaḥkṛtāparādhānāṃ śuddhirdhyānādinā bhavet ||71 || cittavṛttinirodhena tathendriyanirodhataḥ | jñānena doṣatyāgena tapasā puṇyabhāvataḥ ||72|| kathāyāḥ śravaṇenāpi mananena ca nirṇayāt | ātmanastu vicāreṇa cidacitorvivekataḥ ||73 || puṃprakṛtyordharmabodhānmānasī śuddhiriṣyate | vācā kṛtāparādhānāṃ śuddhiḥ syāttu japādibhiḥ ||74|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo hare mādhava keśava | lakṣmīpate ramānātha śrīpate pārvatīpate ||75|| gopīpate prabho māṇikīpate ca prabhāpate | satpate cākṣarapate muktapate pumuttama ||76|| golokādipate brahmapara śrīpuruṣottama | ityevaṃ nāmajapanādoṃkārādijapāttathā ||77|| kṣamāyā yācanāccāpi kathāyā vācanāttathā | kṛṣṇakīrtanakaraṇāt kṛṣṇamālādhivartanāt ||78|| satyavratapratiṣṭhānād vācikī śuddhiriṣyate | mucyate tvaparādhaistu jano viṣṇoḥ stavaṃ paṭhan ||79|| samvatsarasya mapye vai tīrthasnānena śuddhyati | kāśyāṃ tathā mathurāyāṃ dvārakāyāṃ ca puṣkare ||1.353.80 | badaryāṃ ca jagannāthapuryāṃ sāketapattane | haridvāre ca gaṇḍakyāṃ godāvaryāṃ janārdane ||8 1 | kāveryāṃ setubandhe ca padmāvatyāṃ ca raivate | svarṇarekhājale cāśvapaṭṭasarasi mānase ||82| nārāyaṇe cendradyumne kāveryāṃ padmanābhake | kāñcyāṃ ca narmadāyāṃ cāvabhṛthe paṭṭakotsave ||83 | snānātpānāttathā dhyānāt kīrtanād dhāraṇāttathā | śravaṇānmananāccāpi darśanāt pātakakṣayaḥ ||84| aṭitvā sarvatīrthāni prāyānmāthuramaṇḍalam | ātyantikī tu viśrāntirviśrāntighaṭṭake bhavet ||85| phalaṃ parārdhaguṇitaṃ mathurāyāṃ prajāyate | gateranveṣakāṇāṃ tu mathurā paramā gatiḥ ||86 | yā gatiryogayuktasya sāṃkhyajñānavatastathā | sā gatistyajataḥ prāṇān mathurāyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||87| na tīrthaṃ mathurātulyaṃ na devaḥ kṛṣṇasadṛśaḥ | na brahmadhāmabhā muktirna paraḥ puruṣottamāt ||88 yadāśraye kṛte sarvapāpānāṃ vilayo bhavet | ātmani yaddhṛte svasyātyantikī muktirāmilet ||89 iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi jñānānāṃ jñānamuttamam | śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāpi janastatphalabhāg bhavet || 1.353.90 | iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne māthuratīrthamāhātmye dvārikāyāṃ sāmbarūpadarśanena kṛṣṇapatnīnāṃ manaḥkṣobhāt kṛṣṇadattaśāpena jātakuṣṭhasāmbasya mathurāyāmādityopāsanayā kuṣṭhanivṛttiḥ ṣaḍādityasthāpanā, kāyikavācikamānasikāparādhāstannivāraṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tripaṃcāśadadhikatriśatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||353 ||
<1.354> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mathurāyāṃ dhruvatīrthaṃ sumuktidam | tarpaṇādannadānācca pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikārakam || 1 mathurāyāṃ candraseno rājāsīd dharmakāryakṛt | tasya patnī candraprabhā vīrasūrvīraputrakā || 2 tasyā dāsīśatasyaikā dāsī tvāsīt prabhāvatī | prabhāvatyāḥ pūrvajā vai pitaraḥ śatasaṃkhyayā || 3 svadoṣaiḥ patitāḥ sarve narakaṃ prati bhāmini| karoti tarpaṇaṃ nāpi kārayati prabhāvatī || 4 | | śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ ca vā kiñcit pitṝṇāṃ tṛptihetave | tasyāḥ kuṭumbinaścāpi kurvantyeva na tarpaṇam || 5 || tasyāḥ pitṛgaṇo bhraṣṭaḥ kadācid yamunātaṭe | sūkṣmaḥ prāṇisamūho vai dhruvatīrthe samāpatan || 6 || kṛṣṇavarṇāścaṃkramanto maśakākārasannibhāḥ | pitaraḥ ṛṣiṇā dṛṣṭāstrikālajñābhidhāyinā || 7 || trikalajñaḥ sadā yamyāṃ pitṝn datvā jalāñjalīn | tarpayatyeva pitarastṛptā yānti mahaḥsthalam || 8 || sa ṛṣiḥ ṣaṣṭhakālāśī payovratī sadāsti vai | sūryakiraṇapānāśī sūryagatyā gatisthitaḥ || 9 || āgataṃ pitṛsamūhaṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvaiva mohitaḥ | kṛpayā tānnirīkṣaiśca na cakre vratajāpanam || 1.354.10 | | caturthāṃśāvaśeṣaśca divasaḥ paryavartata | eke tatra samāyānti pitaro nabhaso’vanim || 11 || anye pūrvāduttarācca dakṣiṇātpaścimāttathā | lakṣaśaḥ pitarastatra dhruvatīrthe samāgatāḥ || 12 || āyānti pratiyānti ye tānpaśyan vismayaṃ gataḥ | tatraikaḥ samūho dṛṣṭo hṛṣṭapuṣṭāṃgatuṣṭimān || 13 | | putraiḥ kṛtasvadhāprāpto jalaṃ pītvā divaṃ yayau | anyaḥ samūho dṛṣṭopi tapasvī kṣāmadehavān || 1 4|| rūkṣaḥ snānarato pītvā jalaṃ bhuvaryayau sa ca | atha saṃgho’paro dṛṣṭo vastrālaṃkāraśobhitaḥ || 1 5 | | hṛṣṭapuṣṭāṃga evāsau jalaṃ pītvā divaṃ yayau | athetaraḥ samudāyo dṛṣṭo nagnaśarīrakaḥ || 16 || supuṣṭaḥ sukhasampanno jalaṃ pītvāmbaraṃ yayau | athānte bahavo dṛṣṭā vimānavaramāsthitāḥ || 17 || bahubhojanapūrṇāni yānānyuccāvacāni ca | gṛhītvā vyomamārgeṇa gacchanti maharādikam || 18 || atha pare lokitāśca tvīrayantaḥ śubhāśiṣaḥ | tṛptā haṃsagaruḍādipṛṣṭhasthā gajavājigāḥ || 19 || tadanye vikṛtā dṛṣṭāḥ kruddhāḥ kṣudhātipīḍitāḥ | pṛṣṭhalagnodarā mānahīnāḥ śāpapradāyinaḥ || 1.354.20 || tato’nye ca tathā dṛṣṭāḥ puṣpahārābhipūjitāḥ | śrāddhe bhuṃktvā mahotsāhā yathā devāstathojjvalāḥ || 21 || kecit piṇḍān kare dhṛtvā kecidattvā phalāni ca | kecit ṣoḍaśavastvādyairyuktā yānti janādikam || 22 || kecicchayyāsamāyuktā bhogabhogyasamanvitāḥ | tuṣṭāḥ prasannamanaso dṛṣṭāstapo’bhiyāyinaḥ ||23 || kecit samukuṭā rājyacchatracāmaravījitāḥ | dṛṣṭā mānayutā yātāḥ satyalokaṃ vimānakaiḥ ||24|| yamunāyāṃ navavastrairyutā bhūṣādiśobhitāḥ | paribhramanti pitaraścānye dṛṣṭāstathāvidhāḥ ||25|| kālindyāṃ dhruvatīrthe vai madhyāhnottarameva ha | āsāyaṃ pitaraścaivaṃ trikālajñarṣiṇekṣitāḥ ||26 || gate pitṛgaṇe putrāḥ sakalatrāḥ kuṭumbinaḥ | śrāddhakartāra evaite sāyaṃ svasvagṛhān yayuḥ || 27|| nirjanaṃ dhruvatīrthaṃ ca janahīnaṃ tadābhavat | trikālajño’pi munirāḍ vismitastata utthitaḥ ||28|| dadarśaikaṃ kṛśāṃgaṃ ca kṣutkṣāmaṃ gativihvalam | pratīkṣantaṃ kampamānaṃ pṛṣṭhalagnalaghūdaram ||29|| ūrucarmāsthiruktrastaṃ jṛmbhamāṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | koṭarākṣaṃ mlānavaktraṃ kṣudrasvalparavaṃ kṛśam ||1.354.3 0|| dayāluḥ sa munistaṃ vai papraccha ko bhavānatha | duḥkhito vikṛtākāro veṣṭito maśakairbahu ||3 1 || na gacchasi na te sthānaṃ nirāśrito’si kiṃ vad | mayādya bahavo dṛṣṭāḥ koṭiśaḥ pitaro’tra vai ||32|| teṣāmālokane kālo gato’dya mama sarvathā | na mamādya naityakaṃ vai karmajātaṃ vilokane ||33|| atha tvaṃ ca mayā dṛṣṭaḥ kriyā me naśyate khalu | paścāt karma kariṣye me naityakaṃ vada me ṛtam ||34|| yathāśakti kariṣye vai śaktaṃ syācceddhitaṃ tava | śrutvā janturuvācainaṃ muniṃ sarvaṃ yathātatham ||35|| bṛhannimittamadyaiva pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikārakam | dhruvatīrthe kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ dattaṃ tilodakādikam ||36 || annaṃ vastraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ śayyādikaṃ tathā | upānahau gṛhaṃ chatraṃ bhūṣā dugdhaṃ tathetarat ||37|| adya dattaṃ sutadāraputrīpatnīkuṭumbibhiḥ | sarvaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ tṛptipradaṃ pitṛpratarpaṇam ||38|| dhruvatīrthe dhruvaṃ sarvaṃ dattaṃ bhavati bhūsura | yānaṃ ca vāhanaṃ gauśca vāṭikā kṣetramityapi ||39|| dattaṃ nītvā saha yānti svarṇaṃ dravyaṃ tathetarat | tilatṛptāḥ sarvatṛptāḥ pitaro’dyātitoṣitāḥ ||1.354.40|| sarve tṛptā divaṃ yānti pitaraścādya putriṇāḥ | santānaiḥ puṣṭavapuṣo dattaśrāddhaiḥ kṛtodakaiḥ ||41 || yeṣāṃ santatirakṣayyā tiṣṭhatyevaṃ prajāvatī | te svadhāpūjitaiḥ putrairgacchanti paramāṃ gatim ||42||| adya rājñastu pitaraścandrasenasya pūjitāḥ | dṛṣṭāstvayā tathā cānye divyadṛṣṭyā divaṃgatāḥ ||43|| brāhmaṇānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ vaiśyānāṃ śūdrakarmaṇām | pratilomānulomānāṃ sarveṣāṃ śrāddhakarmiṇām ||44|| pitarastu tvayā dṛṣṭā yeṣāṃ santatiravyayā | ahantu saṃpratīkṣanvai śrāddhaṃ tvatra vyavasthitaḥ ||45|| āśāpāśaśatairbaddhastṛptyarthaśca bubhukṣitaḥ | yonisaṃkaradoṣeṇa pūrvaṃ vai narakaṃ gataḥ ||46 || nāstikairmama vaṃśyaiśca śrāddhaṃ dattaṃ na me’dya vai | pratyabdaṃ tvāgatasyātra prāptiḥ śrāddhasya me nahi ||47|| anyapitṛdāsyavṛttiṃ kṛtvā jīvāmi bhūsura | adya śrāddhasamārohe śatavarṣairmanāgapi ||48|| kuṭumbito mayā naiva labdhaṃ tṛptirna me’dya vai | agatirgamane jātā tritāpaiśca suduḥkhitaḥ ||49|| balayuktā yayuḥ sarve nirbalasya kuto gatiḥ | āgamiṣyanti vai kecit sarvapitṛpratarpakāḥ ||1.354.50|| tadā hyavāpya kiñcidvai yāsye’raṇyaṃ samīpagam | ime ye mama dehe tu bhavanti maśakāḥ kṛśāḥ ||51 || santānaprakṣayādete mama dehaṃ samāśritāḥ | ahaṃ vai pūrvajasteṣāṃ hyete me vaṃśajā janāḥ ||52|| māṃ khādanti kṣudhākāle tantuvicchedaduḥkhitāḥ | ekā tantumayī putrī mama vaṃśe’tra vidyate ||53 || mathurāyāṃ candrasenanṛpateḥ karmacāriṇī | mahiṣyāḥ sevane saktā dāsī nāmnā prabhāvatī ||54|| tasyāḥ putraḥ karmacārī virūpanidhisaṃjñakaḥ | asmākaṃ santatestantustasya śrāddhakṛte vayam ||55|| āśayā baddhahṛdayā śrāddhatarpaṇakāmanāḥ | sthitā etāvadeva tu tato yāsyāmahe vanam ||56|| narake tvapratiṣṭhe vā vārdhau vā bhagnamānasāḥ | yadi tantuḥ sa ced dadyājjalaṃ śrāddhaṃ tilāñjalīn ||57|| tadā puṣṭā vayaṃ bhūtvā yāmo divaṃ kaniṣṭhakam | śṛṇu nikṛṣṭayonyāpi dattaṃ vai prāpyate haviḥ ||58|| tayā dattena santuṣṭā vayaṃ syāmaḥ suputriṇaḥ | pūrvakarmavipākena yāṃ yāṃ gatimadhomukhīm ||59|| ūrdhvāṃ ca prāptāḥ pitaraḥ putriṇaḥ putrikāśritāḥ | śrāddhaṃ piṇḍodakaṃ dānaṃ putrīkṛtaṃ tvavāpyate ||1.354.6 0|| nānyā gatiḥ pitṝṇāṃ syāt putryā pitaraḥ putriṇaḥ | api syātsa kule’smākaṃ yo no dadyājjalāṃjalim ||6 1 || nadīṣu bahutoyāsu śītalāsu viśeṣataḥ | tīrthamadhye tilamiśraṃ phalayuktaṃ jalāṃjalim ||62|| raupyajuṣṭajalenāpi nābhidaghne jale sthitaḥ | darbhapāṇiḥ pradadyācca tena tṛptā vayaṃ sadā ||63 || darbhapāṇistristrigotre pitṛnāma samuccaran | tṛpyatāṃ hyamukanāmne svadhā ceti vadan sutaḥ ||64|| devebhyaścāṃjaliṃ dadyād ṛṣibhyastvaṃjalidvayam | pitṛbhyastryañjalīn dadyāt tṛpyantāṃ samudāharan ||65|| pitre prathamato dadyāt mātre dadyāttataḥ param | mātāmahāya ca dadyād dadyāt pitāmahāya ca ||66|| tatparebhyaśca pitṛbhyaḥ pradadyāt trīn jalāṃjalīn | pitāmahyai tathā dadyād dadyācca prapitāmahīm ||67|| anena piṇḍadānena te’sūryānnāśayāmyaham | idaṃ jalaṃ mayā dattamakṣayyā tṛptirastu te ||68|| vāryapi śraddhayā dattaṃ tadānantyāya kalpate | gṛhṇānāḥ pitaraḥ kecid bhavantyudvignarūpiṇaḥ ||69|| śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ vipra śrāddhaṃ syādviphalaṃ yathā | adeśakāle yaddattaṃ vidhihīnamadakṣiṇam ||1.354.70|| apātre malinaṃ dravyaṃ tṛptaye naiva jāyate | aśraddheyamapāṃkteyaṃ duṣṭaprekṣitamīkṣitam ||71 || tilamantrakuśairhīnamāsuraṃ tadbhavediti | aśucīni gṛhāṇyevāśuciśrāddhahavīṃṣi ca ||72|| krodhāviṣṭāni dānāni vidhipātrākṛtāni ca | adakṣiṇāni śrāddhāni rākṣasebhyo milanti vai ||73 || dakṣiṇāhīnayajñasya phalaṃ rakṣo bhunakti hi | devabrāhmaṇagurvagre vṛthāśapathakāriṇām ||74|| kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ hi pātālavāsino lakṣmi bhuṃjate | aśrotriyāṇi śrāddhāni hutaṃ dattamamantrakam ||75|| gurvabhaktasya śiṣyasya kīrtanaṃ puṇyakarmaṇaḥ | kariṣyataśca dharmasya prāgeva tu prakāśanam ||76|| sarvaṃ pātālavāsānāṃ tṛptyarthaṃ parikalpitam | alīkaṃ tu vṛthāḍambareṇa yadvai kṛtaṃ vratam ||77|| dānaṃ śrāddhaṃ tapo homo rakṣasāṃ tadbhavet kila | nopatiṣṭhanti pitṛṇāṃ nagnāḥ pitṛgaṇāstataḥ ||78|| muṣitā rākṣasādyairvai dānādiphalabhoktṛbhiḥ | aphalāste yathāhūtāstathā gacchantyabhojanāḥ ||79|| maunamāsthāya te sarve kṣudhitāstṛṣitāstathā | āyānti ca viyanti ca na vaite puṇyabhāginaḥ ||1.354.80|| etat sarvaṃ kathitaṃ te pitṛvairupyakāraṇam | navīnaṃ bahumūlyaṃ ca śreṣṭhaṃ sāraṃ dadāti yaḥ ||81 || tatpitaraḥ smṛddhimanto yānasthā yānti vai divam | jīrṇaṃ kṣudraṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ cāsāraṃ śrāddhe dadāti cet ||82|| tatpitaro daridrā vai padbhyāṃ bhramanti yānti ca | daridrāṇāṃ daridrāste smṛddhānāṃ smṛddhisaṃjuṣaḥ ||83|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau vṛddhaḥ pitṛgaṇastataḥ | trikālajño dayāklinnaḥ samuvāca hitāya tam ||84|| yāvat tṛptirna te bhūyānna bhokṣye’haṃ sthiro bhava | pratīkṣasvāgamanaṃ me tāmānayāmi putrikām ||85|| tadā śrāddhaṃ kārayiṣyāmītyuktvā saṃyayau nṛpam | rājā tamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā nanāma pādayoḥ ṛṣeḥ |||86||| dhanyo’smyanugṛhīto’smi madgṛhaṃ pāvanaṃ kṛtam | adya me saphalaṃ janma pādyamarghyaṃ gṛhāṇa gām ||87|| iti saṃvadato rājñaḥ satkāraṃ prāpya cābravīt | rājan śṛṇu kuru tacca yenāhaṃ toṣito’bhavam ||88|| ānaya rājamahiṣīṃ prabhāvatīsamanvitām | rājñānītā ṛṣiṃ natvāsanasthāṃ munirabravīt ||89|| dhruvatīrthe mayāścaryaṃ yaddṛṣṭaṃ kathayāmi vaḥ | koṭiśaḥ pitaraḥ sarve yayuḥ putrārcitā divam ||1.354.90 || eko vṛddhaḥ śuṣkadehaḥ kṣutkṣāmaḥ śuṣkamāṃsakaḥ | nirāśo niraye gantukāmo’sau dhruvatīrthake ||91 || mayā pṛṣṭhaḥ sukāruṇyāt kastvaṃ kimicchasīti ca | sa prāha māṃ mama vaṃśe dāsī prabhāvatī tathā ||92|| tantuḥ putro virūpakanidhirnāmnā hi vartate | sa kuryād yadi me śrāddhaṃ tṛptiḥ syāditi bhūsura ||93 || prabhāvatyā sutadvārā kāraṇīyaṃ hi tarpaṇam | pitṝṇāṃ tu kṛte dattaṃ dānaṃ vāri phalādikam ||94|| svadhā ca pāyasaṃ śrāddhaṃ tṛptidaṃ muktidaṃ bhavet | ityuktvā pratyayārthaṃ tāṃ prāharṣirmadavihvalām ||95|| kiṃ tvayā pitṛtṛptyarthaṃ kṛtaṃ dattaṃ jalaṃ na vā | sā naivamityuvācātha na jānāmi ca tān pitṝn ||96|| kriyāṃ karma na jānāmi na karomi kadāpi ca | ṛṣiḥ prāha samāyāntu drakṣyathādya camatkṛtim ||97|| iti kṛtvā yayuḥ sarve dhruvatīrthaṃ tu nāgarāḥ | brāhmaṇāśca tathā rājā lokāśca bahavastadā ||98|| muninā darśitastebhyo vṛddho vicetanaḥ kṛṣaḥ | maśakairveṣṭitaḥ kṣudraiḥ kṣudhayā cātipīḍitaḥ ||99|| munistaṃ prāha bho janto tava santānajā sutā | saputrā tvatra cāyātā puṣṭyarthaṃ vad vāñchitam || 1.354.10 0|| agatiśca tadovāca snātvātra vidhinā mama | karotu tarpaṇaṃ nāmnā tataḥ śrāddhaṃ karotu ca || 101 || saraupyavastraṃ satilaṃ piṇḍadānaṃ karotu ca | tathānyadvai yathāśakti dānaṃ karotu cātra vai || 1 02|| yenātraiva bhavanto hi māmīkṣatha sukhānvitam | kārayantu yathāśakti śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ hi tantunā || 103 || itiśrutvā rājapatnī śrāddhaṃ subahudakṣiṇam | dāsyā vai kārayāmāsa tatputreṇa ca sarvathā || 104|| paṭṭavastraṃ phalaṃ dhūpaḥ karpūrāgurucandanam | tilottaraṃ pāyasānnaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ ca sapiṇḍakam || 1 05|| jalaṃ tilodakaṃ sarvaṃ yaddattaṃ tena tṛptimān | sukṛtī ca sutejasvī devavad dīptimān babhau || 1 06|| tatsadṛśāstu maśakā api tṛptāḥ surūpiṇaḥ | devā iva vyajāyanta śuśubhire’tipuṣṭikāḥ || 1 07|| svargāgatairvimānaiśca chāditaṃ tatra vai nabhaḥ | te tu devā iva sarve pitarastuṣṭamānasāḥ || 1 08|| procurasmatkulatanturvṛddhiṃ yātu suvaṃśajaiḥ | ye śrāddhairvividhairasmān tārayiṣyanti sarvadā || 1 09|| śṛṇvantu vacanaṃ sarve’smadīyaṃ pitṛtuṣṭidam | tīrthāni saritaḥ kūpāḥ parvatāśca sarāṃsi ca || 1.354.11 0|| kurukṣetraṃ gayā gaṃgā sthānānyāyatanāni ca | pitṝṇāṃ muktidaṃ tvanyanna bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 111 || bhādre proṣṭhapadīṃ snātvā pratipatprabhṛti tvatha | śuklapratipadantaṃ ca tīrthaṃ prāpya sasatvarāḥ || 11 2|| pitaraḥ śrāddhapiṇḍādāḥ āśvine dhruvamāsthitāḥ | kṛtvā pretapurīṃ śūnyāṃ svargaṃ pātālamityatha || 113 || īhamānāḥ svakānputrān gotratantūn tathānujān | tiṣṭhāmastvatra sahitāḥ svasvavaṃśajapitṛbhiḥ || 1 14|| kanyāṃ gate savitari yaḥ śrāddhaṃ sampradāsyati | tarpaṇaṃ dhruvatīrthe te pitṝṇāṃ ṣoḍaśāhake || 1 15|| sutṛptāḥ smo vayaṃ śaśvad yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim | dṛṣṭo bhavadbhiḥ pitṝṇāṃ tārako vai vidhiryathā || 1 16|| dustaraṃ tāritaṃ pāpaṃ trikālajñaprasādataḥ | iti saṃśrāvya te sarve rājānaṃ ca janānṛṣim || 1 17|| rājñīṃ dāsīṃ ca tatputraṃ saṃbhāṣya śivamastu vaḥ | āruhya varayānāni gatāḥ svargaṃ vṛtāḥ suraiḥ || 1 18|| rājā rājñī suto dāsī prajā nāryo narāstataḥ | mahadāścaryapūrvāste yayurnijagṛhānprati || 11 9|| cakruśca sarvadā yogye samaye śrāddhatarpaṇam | uddhṛtāḥ pitarastaistu dhruvatīrthaprabhāvataḥ || 1.354.120|| etatte kathitaṃ lakṣmi māhātmyaṃ mathurābhavam | yatsmaraṇād vinaśyanti pāpāni pūrvūjanmanām || 121 || paṭhed yaḥ śṛṇuyāccaiva sa dhruvatīrthapuṇyabhāk | mathurāyāṃ yamunāyā jalasnānasya puṇyabhāk || 1 22|| yatra kvāpi jalapārśve sthitvā piṇḍaṃ dadāti vai | yamunādhruvasattīrthaṃ smṛtvā tvāvāhya pitṛkān || 123 || tatra yāmunajalavat pitṛtṛptiḥ prajāyate | vaṃśavṛddhistathārogyaṃ smṛddhistasya sujāyate || 124|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mathurātīrthamāhātmye dhruvatīrthe samāgatakoṭipitṛtṛptyuttaraṃ trikālajñābhidharṣiṇā kṣudhite ekasmin pitari dṛṣṭe tadvaṃśe candrasenanṛpatidāsīrūpāṃ putrīṃ vijñāya taddvārā śrāddhaṃ kārayitvā pitṛmuktidānaṃ śrāddhavidhirmahimā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥpaṃcāśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 354||
<1.355> śrīlakṣmīruvāca śrutametanmayā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jagatprabho | māthurakṣetramāhātmyaṃ saphalaṃ svargamokṣadam || 1 || śrāddhaṃ śrāddhaphalaṃ cāpi śrutaṃ te kṛpayā hare | kena tūtpāditaṃ śrāddhaṃ vistareṇa vadasva me || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu priye kathayāmi śrāddhotpattiviniścayam | sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe mama nābhipadmād brahmā vyajāyata || 3 || sa ca putrātmakānutpādayāmāsa surādikān | ādityām̐śca vasūn rudrānaśvinau ca marudgaṇān || 4 || tāraṇārthaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇān bhuvi sarvaśaḥ | kṣatriyān vaiśyavarṇāṃśca śūdravarṇāṃstathā paśūn || 5 || pakṣiṇaḥ sthāvarāṃstiryakkīṭādyān samapekṣitān | ditidvārā tathā daityāndanūdvārā tu dānavān || 6 || evaṃ vaidikavijñānānṛṣīṃścāpi tapodhanān | teṣāṃ putrāstathā pautrā jātā yaiḥ pūritaṃ jagat || 7 || vedhaso netrato jāto nimimtu mānaso nṛpaḥ | tasyāpi mānasaḥ putraḥ śrīmānnāmā hyajāyata || 8 || jātimātro yuvā jātismaro vedasmarastathā | tapaścacāra paramaṃ samādhāya mano harau || 9 || paṃcāgnirvāyubhakṣaśca hyekapādordhvabāhukaḥ | śīrṇaparṇāmbubhakṣaśca śiśire tu jaleśayaḥ || 1.355.1 0|| kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ kurvan varṣāṇāmayutottaram | mṛtyukālamanuprāptaḥ pañcatvaṃ samupāgamat || 11 || nimiḥ śokaṃ paraṃ prāptaścintayāmāsa tatkṛte | māghaśukladvādaśyāṃ sa sṛṣṭvā viṣayaṃ mānasam || 12|| śraddhayā kalpayāmāsa putrārthe kiṃ karomi vai | tāvatputro divyadeho divo vimānamārgataḥ || 13|| nimimāgatya sa prāha dehi dānāni matkṛte | jalaṃ dehi phalaṃ dehi miṣṭānnaṃ cāmbarāṇi ca || 14|| bhūṣā yānāni pātrāṇi pāyasānnāni dehi me | yāni me syātprabhojyāni mūlāni ca rasāstathā || 15|| yāni me’tīva preṣṭhāni dehi me śākabhājikāḥ | iti kṛtvoṣitastatra devadhūnītaṭe hime || 16 || nimirāmantrya saptarṣīn śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ | dakṣiṇāvartataḥ sarvamakurvan ṛṣisattamāḥ || 17|| saptakṛtvastatra tatra yugapat samupāviśan | dadustvannāni śākāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca || 18|| nimirviprān prasaṃpūjya saptakṛtvaśca sundari | kṛtvā tu dakṣiṇāgrāṃśca kuśāṃśca prayatastadā || 19|| pradadau śrīmate piṇḍānnāmagotramudāharan | jalaṃ phalaṃ dalaṃ cānnaṃ pāyasaṃ cāmbarādikam || 1.355.20 || dadau putrāya divyāya jagrāha sa ca sarvathā | pratyakṣaṃ nītavānsarvaṃ pratyakṣaṃ bubhuje papau ||2 1 || tathā saptarṣiṣu punaḥ praviśya bubhuje muhuḥ | tṛpto’smi cātitṛpto’smītyuccāryāsādya vastukam ||22|| divaṃ vimānamāruhya jagāma śrāddhatoṣitaḥ | arke tvastaṃ gate rājā bhāvasandhyāmasevata ||23 || rātrau cintayituṃ rabdhaḥ putrārthaṃ yatsamācarat | kṛtvā sa piṇḍadānādi paścāttāpaṃ cakāra saḥ ||24|| akṛtaṃ munibhiḥ pūrvaṃ kiṃ mayā tadanuṣṭhitam | nivāpakarma tvaśuci putrārthe viniyojitam ||25|| aho snehaprabhāveṇa mayā mṛtyuttaraṃ kṛtam | naitatkarma śavakarma garhyaṃ karma kṛtaṃ mayā ||26|| kiṃ vakṣyanti ca māṃ sarve ye vai pitṛpade sthitāḥ | sadevāsuragandharvapiśācoragarākṣasāḥ || 27|| ityevaṃ cintayānasya brāhma prātarabhūttataḥ | sandhyā cakāra hutvāgnīn punaścintāṃ samācarat || 28|| aho me jīvitaṃ vyarthaṃ putro yatra na dṛśyate | narakaṃ pūtikākhyaṃ vai hṛdi duḥkhaṃ samucyate || 29 || putre sati na vai duḥkhaṃ svargaṃ bhavati sarvathā | putreṇa labhate svargaṃ pautreṇa tu pitāmahāḥ ||1.355.3 0 || atha putrasya pautreṇa modante prapitāmahāḥ | putreṇa śrīmatā hīnaṃ nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe ||3 1 || etasminnantare lakṣmi nāradastvājagāma ha | tejasā bhrājamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā pupūja vai nṛpaḥ ||32|| satkṛtaścāsane tūpaviṣṭo nārada āha tam | nime śṛṇu mahāprājña śokaṃ mā kuru śokahan ||33 || anityaṃ gatvaraṃ dehaṃ kathaṃ prājña viśocasi | mṛtaṃ naṣṭaṃ gataṃ yāntaṃ nānuśocanti saddhiyaḥ ||34|| gato nivartate naiva hasanti śokinaṃ janāḥ | amaratvaṃ martyaloke paśyāmi na carācare |||35||| satyātpātālaparyantāḥ sarve kālavaśā janāḥ | jātasya sarvabhūtasya mṛtyurnirṇīta eva ha ||36 || avaśyameva gantavyaṃ tvayā mayā ca vedhasā | tava putro mahātmābhūcchrīmānnāma śriyo nidhiḥ ||37|| pūrṇaṃ tapo mahat kṛtvā yayau sa paramāṃ gatim | evaṃ muktasya tu kṛte naiva śocitumarhasi ||38|| ityuktaḥ sa nimiḥ pādau praṇamya śirasā muneḥ | savrīḍo niḥśvasan bhīto dīnavatprāha nāradam ||39|| sānvito’smi tvayā vipra kintu vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu | gataḥ sa tu gata eva na cāyāti gataḥ punaḥ ||1.355.40 || paraṃ mayā śavapaścāt kalpayitvā ca yat kṛtam | na tu śrutaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ na devaiḥ pūrvajaiḥ kṛtam ||41 || śokasyaiva prabhāveṇa śavamuddiśya yatkṛtam | tarpayitvā dvijān sapta tvannādyaiśca phalairapi ||42|| paścād visarjitaṃ piṇḍaṃ darbhānāstīrya bhūtale | udakānayanaṃ caiva hyapasavyena vāsitam ||43 || etadvai nūtanaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bibhemi tena vai | śrutvā tannāradaḥ prāha na bhetavyaṃ tvayā nṛpa ||44|| adharmaṃ nātra paśyāmi pitaraṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja | ityuktaḥ sa nimirdhyātvā pitaraṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||45|| tāvatputrastapodhanaḥ śrīmānnāmā samāgataḥ | uvāca nime tvatkṛtaṃ kalpitaṃ pitṛyajñakam ||46 || pitṛyajñātmako dharmo brahmaṇā kalpito’sti vai | sa ca karmātmakastvayā manmiṣeṇa prakāśitaḥ ||47|| śrāddhadharmaḥ pitṛyajñaḥ kratustvayā pratiṣṭhitaḥ | pūrvapūrvasṛṣṭidharmaḥ śrāddhadharmaścirantanaḥ ||48|| kṛtaḥ svayaṃbhuvā pūrvaṃ śrāddhātmā vidhireva saḥ | pretakarma śrāddhadharmaḥ kartavyaḥ sarvathā janaiḥ ||49|| jātasya vai mṛteḥ paścādavaśyaṃ kvāpi saṃsthitiḥ | tatra prāptyarthamaivātra kartavyaṃ śraddhayārpaṇam ||1.355.50 || amokṣasya bhavet tṛptirmuktau tṛptistu śāśvatī | mokṣaḥ karmaviśeṣeṇa prāyaścittena ca dhruvam ||51 || dīrghāyuṣo hyapi yānti kiṃ punaḥ svalpakāyuṣaḥ | alpāyuṣo janāḥ paścād bhaviṣyanti yugāntare ||52|| tāmasā rājasāścāpi bhaviṣyanti viśeṣataḥ | teṣāṃ tu kugatau śrāddhaṃ gatidaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati |||53 || tāmasaṃ narakaṃ vidyāt tiryagyoniṃ ca rākṣasīm | krauryaṃ bhayaṃ viṣādaśca hiṃsā nirlajjatā tamaḥ ||54|| ajñānitvaṃ ca paiśācaṃ tāmasānāṃ svabhāvajāḥ | tāmasaṃ taṃ vijānīyāducyamāno na buddhyati |||55|| durmadāśraddhadhānaṃ ca parāpakaraṇodyatam | rājasaḥ prabalo vāṇyāṃ svadhṛtātmajanaḥ sadā |||56|| śūraḥ sarvatra vyaktaśca viṣayehāprapūritaḥ | eteṣāṃ paraloke vai tṛptyarthaṃ śrāddhamarthitam ||57|| sāttviko mokṣabhāgī syāt kṣānto dānto viśuddhahṛt | śraddhālustapasā yukto svādhyāyādisamanvitaḥ ||58|| eteṣvapi yadi putreṣaṇā lokeṣaṇā tathā | dhaneṣaṇā tathā dāreṣaṇā kāmeṣaṇā ca vā ||59|| bhavettena pravāheṇa paratra pretatāṃ vrajet | tasya tṛptikṛteśrāddhadānahavanakarmaṇām ||1.355.60|| kalpanā vedhasā pūrvaṃ kṛtā tvayā prasāritā | evaṃ saṃcintayānastu na śokaṃ kartumarhasi ||6 1 || tyaja śokaṃ mahāprājña śokaḥ sarvavināśanaḥ | śoko dahati gātrāṇi buddhiḥ śokena naśyati ||62|| lajjā dhṛtiśca dharmaśca śrīḥ kīrtiśca smṛtirnayaḥ | tyajanti sarvadharmāśca śokenopahataṃ naram ||63|| evaṃ śokaṃ parityajya viśoko bhava bhūpate | mūḍhaḥ snehaprabhāveṇa yāti saṃsārabandhanam ||64|| tasmāt snehaṃ prasaṃyamya buddhiṃ dharme niyojayet | dharmo lokahitārthāya sa śrāddhaṃ dānamarcanam ||65 || satkāro havanaṃ ceti pañcadhā prāyaśo mataḥ | mṛtānāṃ tṛptidaṃ śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tu jīvatāṃ sukham ||66 || pratimāyā arcanaṃ śaṃ satkāraḥ prāṇināṃ sukham | havanaṃ dyugatānā śaṃ dātāpi phalabhāg bhavet ||67|| mṛtyukāle yadicchā syāt pūraṇīyā viśeṣataḥ | mriyamāṇasya santoṣaḥ paralokagatipradaḥ ||68|| kaṇṭhasthānaṃ gate jīve śīghraṃ niḥsārayed gṛhāt | kuśāstaraṇaśayyāsthaṃ snehabhāvena vācayet ||69|| suvarṇaṃ tanmukhe dadyājjalaṃ dadyād vratādikam | puṇyaṃ dadyācca gāṃ dadyātparalokahitāvahām ||1.355.70 || dogdhrīṇāṃ tu gavāṃ dānācchīghraṃ mucyeta kilbiṣāt | tasya karṇe harernāma śrāvayenmuktisādhanam ||71 || madhuparkaṃ madhu sarpirdadhi dadyāttadoṣṭhayoḥ | evaṃ viniḥsṛte prāṇe saṃsāraṃ nādhigacchati ||72|| tato’stha ghṛtagandhādyaiḥ kṛtvā vai dehaśodhanam | dakṣiṇāyāṃ śiraḥ kṛtvā tīrthasnānaṃ prakārayet ||73|| śreṣṭhavanaspatikāṣṭhaiścitāṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ | dakṣiṇaśirasā sthāpya kṛtvā haste hutāśanam ||74|| daha tvetasya gātrāṇītyuktvā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam | pradāpayecchiraḥsthāne bhasmībhāvottaraṃ tataḥ ||75|| gātrāṇi vāsasī caiva prakṣālya vinivartayet | mṛtaṃ nāma tadoddiśya dadyāt piṇḍaṃ mahītale ||76|| gatāyuṣastṛtīye’hni snānaṃ kuryānnadījale | piṇḍaṃ sacūraṇaṃ dadyāt trīṃśca dadyājjalāṃjalīn ||77|| caturthe pañcame ṣaṣṭhe piṇḍamekaṃ jalāṃjalim | saptame’ṣṭamanavamadaśameṣu tathaiva ha ||78|| daśame vastrasaṃśuddhirgātraśuddhiśca sarvathā | kartavyā gotrajaistilāmalakasnehatastataḥ ||79|| piṇḍadānaṃ vinirvartya kṣaurakarma tu kārayet | snānaṃ kṛtvā jñātibhiśca tata ekādaśe dine ||1.355.80|| snātvā pretaṃ brāhmaṇeṣu yojayetkārayettathā | ekoddiṣṭaṃ vipramekaṃ sudravyeṇa hi bhojayet ||81|| punaḥ snātvā ca taṃ pretaṃ preteṣu saṃniyojayet | ekoddiṣṭaṃ trivarṇeṣu kartavyaṃ pākabhojanam |||82||| apākadravyaṃ saṃgrāhyaṃ caturthavarṇakasya tu | trayodaśe dine pakvairbhojayed brāhmaṇān sataḥ ||83|| manasā vāyubhūtastvaṃ viprān sādhūn samāśraya | viprasatāṃ kṛtā sevā pretāya sukhadā bhavet ||84|| pretabhogaśarīraṃ vai viprasatoḥ prakalpitam | prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāmudite tu divākare ||85|| śmaśrukarma prakartavyaṃ viprasya tu yathāvidhi | snāpanābhyaṃjane kārye pretasantoṣadāyake ||86 || sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayed bhūmau pretakāryaṃ samācaret | yaṃ deśaṃ tu na paśyanti kukkuṭaśvānasūkarāḥ ||87|| śvā cāpohati rāveṇa garjitena tu sūkaraḥ | kukkuṭaḥ pakṣavātena cāṇḍālo darśanena ca ||88|| tatra kurvanti yacchrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ bandhanapradam | sthaṇḍile pretabhāgaṃ tu dadyāt pūrvāhṇikaṃ tu tat ||89|| kuryācca piṇḍasaṃkalpaṃ nāmagotramudāharan | tataścāśnanti gotrāṇi kulajāścaikabhojanāḥ ||1.355.90|| evaṃ dattena prīyante pretalokagatā janāḥ | chatraṃ dadyādagnibhasmaśilāvṛṣṭyādivāraṇam ||91 || dadyāccopānahau mārgakaṇṭakādinivārakau | dhūpaṃ dadyāt pradīpaṃ ca vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca |||92|| phalānyapi supakvāni pretabhogyāni vai dadet| | evaṃ sarvaṃ vinirvartya pakvānnaṃ bhojayed dvijam ||93|| prathamaṃ brāhmaṇastatra pretabhāgaṃ prakalpayet | hastaśaucaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vipro miṣṭaṃ hi bhakṣayet ||94|| jñātibāndhavamitraiśca brāhmaṇāya punaḥ punaḥ | pretabhāgaḥ pradātavyo vāraṇīyo na kenacit ||95 || nivāraṇe kṛte tatra gṛhṇanti pitaro na vai | evaṃ vilupyate dharmaḥ pretastatra na tuṣyati || 96|| tṛpte vipre salilaṃ ca dātavyaṃ śītalaṃ śubham | ucchiṣṭaṃ tu saridādau matsyebhyo deyameva hi ||97|| dadyācchayyāsanaṃ cāpi tathaivāñjanakaṃkaṇam | nivāpasthānamāgatya dadyāttilodakaṃ tataḥ ||98|| gavāṃ lāṃgūlamuddhṛtya dadyād brāhmaṇahastake | pātreṇodumbarasthena kṛtvā kṛṣṇatilodakam ||99|| mantrapūtaṃ jalaṃ dadyāt toyenābhyukṣya vai tataḥ | pretaṃ visarjayed viprād dadyād dānaṃ dvijātaye || 1.355.1 00|| pipīlikādibhūtebhyaḥ pretabhāgaṃ prakalpayet | dīnānātheṣu bhakteṣu preto bhavati tṛptimān || 101 || evaṃ śrāddhātmakaḥ sarvaiḥ pretabhāvaviśodhanaḥ | karttavya eva saṃskāro nime tvayā tu sa kṛtaḥ || 1 02|| ayaṃ śrāddhakriyākalpaḥ kraturekaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | ita āramya lokeṣu pitṛyajño bhaviṣyati || 103 || yajñakartā bhavān nime brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyati | evaṃ sarvaiḥ pradātavyaḥ pretabhāgastṛtīyake || 1 04|| māse tu saptame navame cāpyekādaśe tathā | tataḥ sāṃvatsarīṃ kuryāt kriyāṃ pretasya muktaye || 1 05|| pūrṇe samvatsare yāte pretakāryaṃ kṛte tataḥ | prayānti jantavo muktiṃ kecid bhramanti cāmbare || 106 || pitāmahaḥ snuṣā bhāryā jñātisambandhibāndhavāḥ | evamete bahavo’tra santi svapnopamāstu te || 1 07|| ruditvā tu kṣaṇaṃ sarve yānti parāṅmukhā hi te | snehapāśena baddhāste mucyante ca kṣaṇāntare || 108 || kasya mātā pitā kasya kasya bhāryā sutāstathā | dine dine vivartante mohapāśaprabandhanāḥ || 1 09|| mātāpitṛsahasrāṇi putradāraśatāni ca | saṃsāreṣvanubhūyante kasya te kasya vā vayam || 1.355.110 || svayaṃ bhuvā vidhiḥ proktaḥ pretasaṃskāralakṣaṇaḥ | snehabhāvena karttavyaḥ saṃskāro’yaṃ mṛtasya vai || 111 || pretakārye nivṛtte tu pitṛtvamupajāyate | māsi māsi hyamāyāṃ vai karttavyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam || 1 12|| pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ | brāhmaṇasya mukhe homāt tṛpyanti sādhubhojanāt || 113 || evamuktvā muniśreṣṭho nāradastu divaṃ yayau | ityevaṃ niminā rājñā kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ purā yuge || 1 14|| tataḥ prabhṛti śrāddhaṃ ca piṇḍaṃ kurvanti bhūsurāḥ | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi śrāddhapiṇḍodbhavādikam || 1 15|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne māthurakṣetramāhātmye niminṛpatinā śrīmānnāmno mṛtaputrasyārthe śrāddhaṃ kṛtam, paścāt kalpitakarmāpratiṣṭhitamiti jñātvā śokaṃ kurvate nimaye nāradena śrāddhaṃ purātano dharma ityupadiṣṭam, śrāddhakriyākramaścokta ityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcapañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 355 ||
<1.356> śrīlakṣmīruvāca śrutaṃ śrāddhaṃ pretabhojyaṃ kṛpayā tava keśava | nanu viprāḥ pretabhāgaṃ dānaṃ gṛhṇanti bhojanam || 1 || aniṣṭaṃ garhitaṃ cāpi pretāveśena bhojanam | bhuktvā pretasya viprastu mucyate kena karmaṇā || 2 || kathaṃ sa tārayed garhyo dātāraṃ puruṣottama | iti me saṃśayaṃ chindhi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca samyak pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā lakṣmi saṃśayaṃ nāśayāmi te | yastu yatirbhaved vipro mahābhāgavatastu yaḥ || 4 || mahāyogī mahājñānī siddhyaiśvaryādibhūṣitaḥ | mahattapodhano yaśca vedaśāstraviśāradaḥ || 5 || dhyānaṃ ca dhāraṇā yasya samādhiścāpi vidyate | trikālajño yamaniyamādisadgumaṇḍitaḥ || 6 || ṣaṭkarmanirato nityaṃ haryārādhanatatparaḥ | preto yatpadrajaḥsparśād divi devo’bhijāyate || 7 || sādhuśīlaḥ sadā śuddho vahnivacchodhako bhavet | sa vai pretānnamābhuktvā gṛhītvā dānamityapi || 8 || kṛtvā karmāṇi pretasya na taddoṣeṇa lipyate | puṃprakṛtyorvivekajño brahmātmaikyaparāyaṇaḥ || 9 || pāpakṣālanasāmarthyo na taddoṣeṇa lipyate | na śarvarīkṛtaṃ dhvāntaṃ sūryaṃ kvacid vilumpati || 1.356.10 || dhvāntaṃ prakāśatāṃ yāti sūryakiraṇasannidhau | pretasya pretatā tādṛgyogena devatā bhavet ||1 1 || pretatvaṃ brahmayogena devatve parivartate | pāpaṃ puṇyatamaṃ syācca samarthe nāsti dūṣaṇam ||12|| yastu nātmabalāḍhyo vā nāpi brahmaparāyaṇaḥ | nāpi brahmavrataṃ puṣṭo na ṣaṭkarmādiyogavān || 1 3|| nātmajño na vivekajñaḥ sa vipro lipyate hyaghaiḥ | pretabhojī preta eva malino jāyate bhujeḥ || 14|| sa svadehasya śuddhyarthaṃ kuryādekamupoṣaṇam | sandhyāṃ prātaḥ sa nirvartya kṛtvā caivāgnitarpaṇam || 15|| tilahomaṃ prakurvīta śāntimantrān paṭhan dvijaḥ | prāksrotasaṃ nadaṃ gatvā snātvā ca pañcagavyakam ||16|| madhuparkayutaṃ pītvā gṛhaṃ sammārjya prokṣayet | agnimukhān surām̐starpayitvā bhūtabaliṃ caret || 17|| viprebhyo bhojanaṃ dadyād godānaṃ prasamācaret | evaṃ yaḥ kurute vipraḥ sa śuddho jāyate dhruvam || 18|| evaṃ kṛte tato mṛtyau sa yāti paramāṃ gatim | anyathā kāladharmaṃ tu yāte pretānnakodare || 1 9|| preta eva bhavet so’pi niraye vāsamāpnuyāt | prāpnuyādrākṣasabhāvaṃ tato mucyeta kilbiṣāt ||1.356.20|| prāyaścittamanaḥ kāryaṃ dātṛbhoktṛsukhāvaham | gohastyaśvadhanaratnakṣetradāsīvibhūṣaṇam || 21 || pratigṛhṇan samantraṃ ca prāyaścittaṃ carettu yaḥ | sa śuddhottārayeccāpi dātāraṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||22|| daive ca janmanakṣatre śrāddhakāle praparvasu | pretakāryeṣu sarvatra vipraṃ ṣaṭkarmaśālinam ||23 || vedavidyāvratasnātaṃ dharmiṣṭhaṃ ca tapasvinam | śīlasantoṣasatyādiguṇayuktaṃ kṣamāyutam ||24|| ahiṃsādiyamayuktaṃ bhagavatsuparāyaṇam | pātraṃ prāpya prakuryādvai śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ prapūjanam ||25|| sa śuddhastārayet sarvānātmānaṃ cāpi tārayet | na hi śilā śilā kvāpi tārayet tārakaṃ vinā ||26 || na hyaśuddhaḥ kvacittvanyān tārayetpāpasaṃbhṛtaḥ | śuddho vai tārayeccānyām̐stasmāt pātre prayojayet ||27|| śṛṇu lakṣmi nṛpaḥ pūrvaṃ medhātithirabhūnmahān | avantyāṃ tvabhavaccandraśarmā tasya purohitaḥ ||28|| rājā gavāṃ śataṃ dānaṃ datvā bhuṃkte dine dine | rājñaḥ piturdinaṃ prāptaṃ vaiśākhe śrāddhakarmaṇaḥ ||29|| āhūtān brāhmaṇānnatvā śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ | piṇḍānnirvāpya ca śrāddhe kalpitānnaṃ dadau bahu ||1.356.3 0|| dānaṃ vastravibhūṣāṇāṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau tathā | tanmadhye brāhmaṇaḥ kaścidbalahīno’tipāpavān ||3 1 || vyabhicārasamutpannaḥ śūdrabījādimiśritaḥ | śrāddhānnaṃ jagṛhe tatra tena doṣeṇa bhūbhṛtaḥ ||32|| pitaraḥ patitāḥ svargād bhraṣṭā vane sakaṇṭake | kṣutpipāsārditā nityaṃ krandanti vai punaḥ punaḥ ||33|| medhātithirdaivayogād bhramaṇārthaṃ vanaṃ gataḥ | tānbhramataḥ sa papraccha ke bhavantaḥ suduḥkhitāḥ ||34|| pitarastaṃ tadā prāhurasmadvaṃśe hi vidyate | nṛpo medhātithistasya vayaṃ smaḥ pitaro vane ||35|| patitāḥ sma divo bhraṣṭāḥ śrāddhadoṣeṇa bhūbhṛtaḥ | śrāddhānnaṃ tvarthitaṃ tena pāpiṣṭhabrahmabandhave ||36|| karmabhraṣṭavyavāyotthanāmamātradvijāya vai | tenaiva karmadoṣeṇa narakaṃ gantumipsavaḥ || 37 | | tatra duḥkhaṃ mahadbhukttā punargacchāmahe divam | viprebhyastu gavāṃ dānāt tatpuṇyena punardivam || 38 || gamiṣyāmaḥ kintu tatra nāstyanna tṛptidāyakam | iti śrutvā nṛpaḥ prāha medhātithirahaṃ hi saḥ | | 39 || bhavatāṃ tāraṇārthaṃ kiṃ punaḥ kāryaṃ vadantu me | pitaraḥ prāhurenaṃ te yathā tṛptirbhaveddhi naḥ | |1.356.40 | | tathā śrāddhaṃ punaḥ kāryaṃ bhojanīyā dvijottamāḥ | teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā medhātithiragād gṛham ||41 || āhūtavān dvijān sādhūn vedapāṭhakṛtaśramān | puṇyān dharmaparān kṣāntān suśīlān sutapasvinaḥ ||42 || yamaiśca niyamairyuktānmahābhāgavatānsataḥ | rājā śrāddhaṃ cakārātha piṇḍānnirvāpya sarvathā ||43 || brāhmaṇān bhojayāmāsa dakṣiṇābhiḥ prapūjya ca | natvā visarjayāmāsa tataḥ sa bubhuje nṛpaḥ ||44 || tato vanaṃ svayaṃ yāto dṛṣṭavām̐śca svakān pitṝn | hṛṣṭānpuṣṭān balairyuktān divaṃ gantuṃ samudyatān | |45 || dṛṣṭvātimumude bhūbhṛt prāhuśca pitaro nṛpam | svasti te’stu gamiṣyāmaḥ svargalokaṃ prati nṛpa | |46 || kadāpi naiva pradātavyaṃ kupātrāyātipāpine | daivaṃ pitryaṃ ca vā tatra dattaṃ niṣphalameva yat ||47 || daive pitrye supātraṃ ced brāhmaṇo naiva labhyate | saṃkalpitaṃ tadannaṃ tu gobhyo deyaṃ yathāvidhi | |48 || gavāmabhāve nadyāṃ vā kṣipedanna prayatnataḥ | apātrāya na dātavyaṃ nāstikāya gurudruhe | |49 | | golakāya na dātavyaṃ kuṇḍāya saṃkarāya ca | ityuktvā pitaraḥ sarve gatāḥ svargaṃ vimānakaiḥ | ||1.356.5 0 | | medhātithirgṛhaṃ prāyād jñātvā pātrabalābale | tasmāllakṣmi dharmaniṣṭhe eko’pi brāhmaṇottamaḥ ||5 1 || santārayati durgebhyo viṣayebhyo na saṃśayaḥ | tasmācchrāddhe bhojanīyāḥ santo bhāgavatā dvijāḥ ||5 2 | | māse māse’thavā pitṛpakṣe pātratapodhanāḥ | devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām ||53 | | tārakā bhojanīyā vai brahmabodhaparā janāḥ | sādhvyaḥ satyo bhojanīyā brahmacaryaparāstathā |||54| | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi satpātraṃ tārayet pitṝn | asatpātra bhraṃśayedvai prāyaścittaṃ tataścaret ||55 || śrīlakṣmīḥ prāha tacchrutvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim | pretāḥ svakarmabhiryānti yonyantaraṃ śarīriṇaḥ ||56|| paśupakṣimanuṣyādyāḥ kathamāgatya bhuṃjate | ka ete pitaraḥ kṛṣṇa śrāddhaṃ bhokṣyantyupasthitāḥ ||57|| mṛtāḥ kecittu narake yamapāśavaśaṃgatāḥ | kecittu devavarge vai kuṭumbisuvaśaṃgatāḥ ||58|| kecit karmavaśālloke caturaśītiyoniṣu | dehino vaśagāstatra bandhane patitāḥ sadāḥ ||59|| śrāddhe śaktā na cāgantuṃ kathaṃ śrāddhaṃ prabhuṃjate | iti me saṃśayaṃ nātha sammārjaya virodhinam ||1.356.6 0 || vaṃśaparamparāṃ śrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ yena rakṣyate | yuge yugāntare cāpi kartavyaṃ yena rakṣyate ||6 1 || iti śrutvā mahālakṣmīvākyaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | saṃśayaṃ mārjayan lakṣmyāḥ provāca parameśvaraḥ ||62|| śṛṇu lakṣmi prabhoktāraḥ pitṛyajñeṣu sarvadā | pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ||63 || traya ete bhavantyeva śrāddhabhoktāra īśvarāḥ | pitā tu brahmadaivatyo vedhogātrādvinirmitaḥ ||64|| pitāmaho viṣṇudevo viṣṇugātrādvinirmitaḥ | prapitāmaho rudreśo rudragātrādvinirmitaḥ ||65|| śrāddhe niyojitāste’tra brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | prathamaṃ brahmaṇoṃ’śāya dadyācchrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍakam ||66|| dvitīyaṃ viṣṇoraṃśāya dadyācchrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍakam | tṛtīyaṃ rudrasyāṃśāya dadecchrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍakam ||67|| pitre pitāmahāyātha hi prapitāmahāya ca | tridevarūpatāpannaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇo vibhuḥ ||68|| yatra mṛtā januṃ prāptāstatrāntaryāmibhāvataḥ | vyāpakaḥ saṃsthitaḥ kṛṣṇastṛptiṃ tānprāpayatyapi ||69|| evaṃ vipreṣu sa kṛṣṇo’ntaryāmī satsu vartate | śrāddhakāle yaduddeśastadrūpo bhavati prabhuḥ ||1.356.70 || śrāddhaṃ piṇḍaṃ gṛhītvā ca preto yatra gato bhavet | tatra prāpayati tasmai kṛṣnārāyaṇo hariḥ ||71 || iti viddhi mahālakṣmi yonyantaragatārthadaḥ | ahameva bhavāmyatra śrāddhe pitrādirūpakaḥ |||72|| athānyacca śṛṇu lakṣmi vistarātpravadāmi te | kecid yajanti vai brahmayajñaṃ mūrtau satāṃ mukhe ||73 || kecid yajanti vai devayajñaṃ kuṇḍe hutāśane | kecid yajanti vai bhūtayajñaṃ paśau gavāṃ mukhe ||74|| kecid yajanti manujakratu nare dvijānane | kecid yajanti vai pitṝn jale’gnau bhvāṃ dvijānane ||75|| sarve te mayi vartante satyametad bravīmi te | kiñca sarvavidhe yāge vahnirmukhyo mukhātmakaḥ ||76|| vahnimukhena cāśnanti pretapitṝṣidevatāḥ | ahaṃ ca bhagavān kṛṣṇaścādmi vahnimukhena vai ||77|| kuṇḍasthāgnirahaṃ cāsmi dakṣiṇāgnirahaṃ tathā | ahaṃ cāhavanīyāgniḥ pāvanaḥ pāvakastathā || 78|| vaiśvadevāgnirahaṃ vai gārhapatyo’pyahaṃ tathā | bārhaspatyo’pyahaṃ caivāvasathyo’pyahameva ca ||79|| tanmukho’haṃ tridevātmā bhuje sarvakratuṣvapi | pitṛyajñe brahmamukhe bhuṃje’haṃ tattrayātmakaḥ ||1.356.80|| śrotriyaṃ dharmaśīlaṃ ca mahābhāgavataṃ dvijam | śrāddhe saṃbhojayejjītendriyaṃ santuṣṭameva ca ||81 || datvā hutāśanāyādau devatīrthasvarūpiṇe | paścād vipramukhe dadyāt pitre pitāmahāya ca |||82|| vai prapitāmahāyāpi smṛtvā dadyātpunaḥ punaḥ | pracchannaṃ bhojayed vipraṃ tatra pitṝn samāhvayet | |83|| piṇḍāstrayaḥ pradātavyāḥ saha vyañjanasaṃyutāḥ | apasavyena dātavyaṃ māsi māsi tilodakam ||84|| paramātmā śarīrastho devatānāṃ vahāmyaham | evaṃ dattena prīyante pitaraśca na saṃśayaḥ ||85|| trayo devāstraya eva pitaro hariniḥsṛtāḥ | pitṛdevā bhaviṣyanti bhoktāraśca yuge yuge ||86 || āyuḥ kīrtiṃ bala tejo dhanaṃ putrān paśūn striyaḥ | dadate pitarastasya tvārogyaṃ piṇḍadāyinaḥ ||87|| vipre saṃbhojite tṛpte tiryaṅnārakamānuṣāḥ | yatra kvāpi sthitāścānye tṛpyanti śrāddhatarpitāḥ ||88|| te sāttvikaṃ śuklamārgaṃ tṛptā yānti divaṃ param | punaranyat pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu tattvena sundari ||89|| ajñānatamasā vyāptāḥ pāpā bhraṣṭā mṛtā janāḥ | snehapāśaśatairbaddhāḥ pacyante narake’śucau ||1.356.90 || teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca kadācidapi vaṃśajāḥ | muñcanti jalabindūm̐śca amāṃ prāpya jalāśaye ||91 || tenaiva bhāvitā tṛptisteṣāṃ nirayagāminām | tarpaṇaṃ śrāddhamevāpi piṇḍān tilodakaṃ tathā || 92|| samarpyaṃ tārayet pitṝn dvijātirbhaktibhāvataḥ | deyo nīlo vṛṣaścāpi narakārtivināśanaḥ ||93|| nīlaṣaṇḍasya lāṃgūle toyamapyuddhared yadi | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi pitarastena tarpitāḥ ||94|| uddhṛto yadi paṃkasya piṇḍaḥ śṛṃgeṇa tena vai | uddhṛtāḥ pitarastena somalokaṃ samāpitāḥ ||95|| ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭivarṣaśatāni ca | somalokeṣu modante kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ tu vivarjitāḥ ||96|| evaṃ gṛhasthadharmo’yaṃ putrapautrādibhiḥ kṛtaḥ | śrāddhātmakaḥ satṛṣṇānāmuddhārāya vinirmitaḥ ||97|| pipīlikādibhūtāni jaṃgamāśca vihaṃgamāḥ | sthāvarāścopajīvanti gṛhastheṣu na saṃśayaḥ ||98|| māsi māsi tu ye śrāddhaṃ prakurvanti gṛhāśrame | tithau parvaṇi sadvāre svapitṝm̐stārayanti te ||99|| pitaro nirgatāste vai brahmaviṣṇuśarīragāḥ | pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ || 1.356.100 || evaṃ krameṇa te paścāt kāśyapā devatā iti | samabhavam̐stataste vai śrāddheṣu viniyojitāḥ || 101 || pitṛyajñe vipramukhe dattaṃ vai kevalaṃ tadā | tadā tvajīrṇatāṃ prāptāḥ pitaro’jīrṇapīḍitāḥ || 1 02|| somena sahitā jagmuḥ praṇamya ca pitāmaham | procurvayaṃ hyajīrṇena pīḍitā vāraṇaṃ kuru || 1 03|| yena naśyatyajīrṇaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca sukhaṃ bhavet | brahmā prāha tadā yo’sti śāṇḍilyasya suputrakaḥ || 1 04|| dhūmraketurvibhāvasustejasvī jīrṇatākaraḥ | śrāddhe tu prathamaṃ tasya dātavyaṃ mānuṣeṣu vā || 1 05|| saha tenaiva bhoktavyaṃ pitṛpiṇḍavisarjitam | tāvatsmṛto havyavāhaḥ sarvabhakṣo hutāśanaḥ || 1 06|| yojitaḥ pañcayajñeṣu brahmaṇā sarvakarmasu | bhoktavyaṃ prathamaṃ vahne pitṛpiṇḍavisarjitam || 1 07|| tvayā bhuṃkte prabhokṣyanti devatāḥ pitarastvime | śrāddhaṃ dvitīyaṃ bhoktavyaṃ sahaiva vahnipitṛbhiḥ || 1 08|| tṛtīyaṃ piṇḍadānaṃ tu somapitṛhutāśanaiḥ | militvaiva prabhoktavyaṃ hyajīrṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 1 09|| ityuktāḥ pitṛyajñe te bhuṃjate sahitā sadā | vahniḥ pitā pitāmahaḥ prapitāmaha eva ca || 1.356.11 0|| somaśceti bhuṃjate vai pitṛdevahutāśanāḥ | apāṃkteyāstadā viprā bhojanīyā na vai kvacit || 111 || apāṃkteyān pravakṣyāmi karmato hīnatāṃ gatān | napuṃsakāścitrakārāḥ paśupālā vinindakāḥ || 112|| svarṇacaurāstathā kāṇāḥ kuṣṭhino nāstikāstathā | nartakā gāyakāścāpi tathā nāṭakajīvinaḥ || 113 || vedavikrayiṇaścāpi sarvayājakayājakāḥ | bhṛtyakarmakarā rājyakiṃkarāḥ sakarāstathā || 1 14|| saṃskārahīnāḥ patitā śūdrakarmopajīvinaḥ | gaṇakā grāmyayājino lekhakā dāṃbhikāstathā || 115|| sarvakarmakarā bhraṣṭā madyamāṃsavyavāyinaḥ | anye ye dūṣitāste vai dvijarūpaistu rākṣasāḥ | | 116 | | tān bhuṃjataḥ prapaśyantaḥ pitaro duḥkhamāpnuyuḥ | prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ śīghraṃ kuryācchrāddhaṃ punaścaret | | 117 | | ghṛtaṃ tu juhuyādagnāvādityaṃ tvavalokayet | punarāvapanaṃ kṛtvā pitaraṃ ca pitāmahān | | 118 || dadyād gandhaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ dīpamarghyaṃ tilodakam | viprāya bhojayeccāpi tena pitṛpratoṣaṇam | | 119 | | yastu vipro mṛtānnaṃ na bhunakti śuddhimān sadā | tasmai dānaṃ pradātavyaṃ vaiśvadeveṣu taṇḍulāḥ | | 1.356.120 | | godhūmā ghṛtamityādi śarkarā śākamityapi | dugdhaṃ dadhi tathā vastraṃ śrāddheṣu taṃ na yojayet | | 121 || pretānnaṃ bhuṃjamānānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate | māghamāse dvādaśyāṃ tu sarpiyuktaṃ supāyasam | | 1 22|| lihedvai madhunā sārdhaṃ dehaśuddhyarthamityatha | savatsāṃ kapilāṃ dadyādātmanaḥ śuddhaye tathā | | 123 | | tīrthe snāyācca gāyatrīsahasraṃ prajapettathā | yadvā dehātmanoḥ śuddhikāmaḥ sa śrāddhamācaret | | 1 24| | snātvā bhūmiṃ pravilipya mantrayed brāhmaṇottamam | amāyāṃ vai mahālakṣmi dantakāṣṭhaṃ na gharṣayet | | 125|| hiṃsito yadbhavet somo devatāḥ pitarastathā | prabhāte tena vipreṇa śmaśrunakhādichedanam | | 126 | | kāraṇīyaṃ snānamabhyañjanaṃ pakvānnamityapi | madhyāhne samaye prāpte viprāya pādyamarpayet | | 1 27| | gṛhāntaraṃ nayed dadyādāsanaṃ cārghyamuttamam | gandhamālyairdhūpadīpaiḥ sampūjya salilaṃ tilān | | 128 | | datvā pātraṃ bhojanārthaṃ viprāgre sthāpayecchubham | bhasmanā maṇḍalaṃ kuryāt paṃktidoṣanivārakam | | 1 29|| agnau hutvā brāhmaṇāya miṣṭānnaṃ pariveṣayet | yathāsukhena bhoktavyamiti brūyād dvijaṃ prati | | 1.356.130 | | tṛptaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kṛtvā dadyādvai vikiraṃ tataḥ | uttarīyāsanaṃ datvā piṇḍapraśnaṃ tu kārayet | | 131 || ṭakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā darbhānāstīrya bhūtale | piṇḍadānaṃ prakurvīta pitrāditritaye tathā | | 13 2|| piṇḍānāṃ pūjanaṃ kuryāt tantuvṛddhyai yathāvidhi | brāhmaṇasya ca haste tu dadyādakṣayamātmavān || 133 || dakṣiṇābhiḥ pratuṣyāpi svastivācyaṃ visarjayet | piṇḍāstrayastu tatraiva yāvattiṣṭhanti bhūtale | |134|| āpyāyamānāḥ
