1.363.120 || yamunāyāśca gaṃgāyā gomatyāścāpi sarvathā | godāvaryāḥ sarayvāśca revāyāścāpi sarvathā || 1 21 || gaṇḍakyāḥ svarṇarekhāyāstapatyāścāpi sarvathā | kāveryāstāmraparṇāyāḥ samudrāṇāṃ ca sarvathā || 122 || tīrthānāṃ yāni vārīṇi tebhyaḥ sarvebhya eva yat | divyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pāvanaṃ ca sādhupādajalaṃ sadā || 1 23|| sarvakāmapradaṃ mokṣapradaṃ lakṣmīpradaṃ mahat | śravaṇātpaṭhanādasya phalaṃ sarvapradaṃ bhavet || 1 24|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne yamarājoktaṃ śubhāśubhapravṛttikāraṇaṃ, pāpamocanopāyaḥ, dhenusevaikādaśīprabhativratasādhucaraṇāmṛtapānasevanādibhiḥ paramaśreyaityādiśrutamuktvā nāciketā virarāma, ṛṣayo badrīnārāyaṇaṃ jagmurityādinirūpaṇanāmā triṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 363 ||
<1.364> śrīlakṣmīruvāca pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ mayā kṛṣṇa bhavadānanapaṃkajāt | pativratā tvayā sṛṣṭiprāraṃbhe svāt prakāśitā || 1 || sā tu bhūmau ca pātāle svarge satye tathāvṛtau | vairāje cātha vaikuṇṭhe ceśvarāṇāṃ vibhūtiṣu || 2 || jīvasṛṣṭāvīśasṛṣṭau sarvatra saṃsthitāsti vai | vyāpinī sā mahāśaktistava sāmarthyarūpiṇī || 3 || ādau sā kaṃbharānāmnī mahālakṣmīrajāyata | bhavān sākṣātparabrahā gopālaḥ samajāyata || 4 || patnīvratābhidho vipraḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | svayaṃ jāto mahārājaḥ sarvadharmapravartakaḥ || 5 || tatpatnī kaṃbharālakṣmīryadgṛhe mānasaḥ sutaḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇo jajñe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 6 || sāha lakṣmīḥ sa tvaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛpayā te smarāmi tat | pativratātmako dharmaḥ satīdharmo hi mokṣadaḥ || 7 || sukhadaḥ svargadaścāpi sarvakāmaprapūrakaḥ | tvadātmako madātmakaḥ kathaṃ na tārayejjanān || 8 || satāṃ sevātmako dharmaḥ sarvopari pravartate | satyaḥ pativratāḥ sādhvyastaranti sādhusevayā || 9 || sādhurūpo bhavānasti satīrūpo’sti vai bhavān | satīdharmaḥ sādhudharmaḥ khaḍgadhārātidustaraḥ || 1.364.10 || satīṃ rūpavatīṃ śrutvā janakasya tu bhāminīm | satībalaṃ viśeṣeṇa śrotukāmāsmi saṃvṛtā || 11 || nāryo bhogyāḥ kāmadharmāḥ satīsāmarthyasaṃśravāt | tariṣyanti bhavāmbhodhiṃ śrutvā pativratābalam || 12|| tasmācchrāvaya me viṣṇo kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho | pativratānāmaiśvaryacamatkārān sukhapradān || 13 || bhūtānmadhyānbhūyamānān śrotumicchāmi keśava | bhavacchaktisvarūpāṇāṃ satīnāṃ caritāni vai || 14 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi paraṃ jijñāsitaṃ śubham | kalyāṇaṃ yoṣitāṃ kartuṃ me vibhāsi dayāvatī || 15||| kathayāmi camatkārān satīnāṃ yoṣitāṃ bahūn | kumārīṇāṃ lagnitānāṃ naiṣṭhikīnāṃ ca yoṣitām || 16 || sadhavānāmadhavānāṃ tyāginīnāṃ suyoṣitām | yoginīnāṃ bhāgavatīsthitikānāṃ suraśriyaḥ || 17|| ārṣīṇāṃ devapatnīnāṃ brāhmīṇāṃ kṛṣṇayoṣitām | kathayiṣye camatkārān śṛṇu madvāṅmanā bhava || 18 || goloke rādhikā yāsti sāvitrī yā tadaṃśikā | nirmitā vedhaso’rthaṃ vai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena sā ||19 || sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe kṛte tvādye śvetadvīpe sthitābhavat | tasminnevānvavasare badarikāśrame nṛpaḥ || 1.364.20 || priyavratastapastepe tatropeyāttu nāradaḥ | rājā vyomni ṛṣiṃ vīkṣya samuttasthau suharṣitaḥ ||21 || tasyāsanaṃ ca pādyaṃ ca datvā papraccha sādaram | bhagavan kiñcidāścaryametasmin kṛtasaṃjñite ||22 || yuge dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ vāpi tanme kathaya nārada | nāradastu yathādṛṣṭamekamāścaryamāha tam || 23 || hyastane’hani rājendra śvetadvīpaṃ gatastvaham | tatra saṃdṛṣṭavān divyaṃ saraḥ paṃkajaśobhitam ||24| sarasastasya tīre tu kumārīṃ pṛthulocanām | dṛṣṭvāhaṃ vismayāpannastāṃ kanyāmāyatekṣaṇām ||25 || pṛṣṭavānasmi rājendra tāṃ vai madhurabhāṣiṇīm | kāsi bhadre kathaṃ vāsi kiṃ vā kāryamiha tvayā || 26 || kartavyaṃ cārusarvāṅgi tanmamācakṣva śobhane | evamuktā mayā sā hi māṃ dṛṣṭvānimiṣekṣaṇā ||27|| smṛtvā tūṣṇīṃ sthitā yāvattāvanme jñānamuttamam | vismṛtaṃ sarvavedāśca saṃhitāśca phalādikam ||28||| sarvaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva me rājan kumāryāpahṛtaṃ kṣaṇāt | tato’haṃ vismayāviṣṭaścintāśokajaḍo’bhavam |||29|| tāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatvā yāvatpaśyāmi tāṃ punaḥ | tāvad divyaḥ pumām̐stasyāḥ śarīre samadṛśyata |||1.364.3 0|| tasyāpi puṃso hṛdye tvaparastasya corasi | anyo raktekṣaṇaḥ śrīmān dvādaśādityasannibhaḥ ||3 1 || evaṃ dṛṣṭāḥ pumāṃso’tra trayaḥ kanyāśarīragāḥ | kṣaṇena te trayo līnāḥ kanyāṃ paśyāmi caikalām ||32|| tataḥ pṛṣṭā mayā devī sā kumārī kathaṃ mama | vedā naṣṭā mamācakṣva bhadre tannāśakāraṇam ||3 3 || kanyovāca tu vedānāṃ sāvitrīṃ mātaraṃ tu mām | naiva jānāsi yena tvaṃ tato vedā hatāstava ||34|| iti śrutvā nāradena pṛṣṭā ke puruṣā iti | kanyovāca hṛdi me’yaṃ ṛgvedo yo narāyaṇaḥ || 35|| viṣṇurūpo’nalo nāmoccāraṇātpāpadāhakaḥ | tasya hṛdi dvitīyastu yajurvedaḥ pitāmahaḥ ||36 || tasya hṛdi tṛtīyastu sāmavedo hi śaṃkaraḥ | etāvādityavatpāpānyāśu dahata āsmṛtau || 37|| ete trayo mahāvedā ṛṣe devāstrayastu te | gṛhāṇa vipra gāyatrīṃ vaidikīṃ japa vaiṣṇavīm ||38|| tato gṛhāṇa vedāṃśca sarvajñatvaṃ ca nārada | etasmin vedasarasi snānaṃ kuru ca putraka || 39|| kṛte snāne’nyajanmīyaṃ yena smarasi putraka | ahaṃ snātvā labdhavām̐stajjñānaṃ varṣasahasrajam || 1.364.40|| puṣkarapattanasyāsaṃ purā sārasvato dvijaḥ | so’haṃ vai vedhasaḥ putro mānaso’smi purastava ||41 || sāvitrī sā mama mātā tirobhāvaṃ gatā tataḥ | mayā sā divyadṛṣṭyā tu satyaloke vilokitā ||42|| vedhaso dharmapatnīti pratāpāḍhyā pativratā | brahmā bhūtāni saṃsṛṣṭvā tatyāja svavapurmuhuḥ ||43 | | sāvitrī tacchavāt pātivratyapratāpato muhuḥ | brahmāṇaṃ svakarasparśāt sarjayāmāsa vai tadā ||44|| bahuvāraṃ mṛtaṃ cājaṃ bahuvāraṃ sasarja sā | sṛṣṭiryatheṣṭaṃ saṃjātā nyavartata tadā mṛteḥ ||45|| brahmāṇaṃ taṃ patiṃ prāpya śāśvataṃ sā pativratā | pātivratyaprabhāveṇa vartiṣyate ca vartate ||46 || mṛtyuṃ tvāmantrya datvā ca brahmāṇaṃ mṛtyave muhuḥ | patiṃ sā jīvayāmāsa pātivratyaprabhāvataḥ ||47|| vedāṃstripuruṣān hutvā punardattavatī tu sā | pātivratyaprabhāveṇa sāvitrī jananī mama ||48|| ahaṃ rājan kṛtasnānastvāṃ didṛkṣurihāgataḥ | satyaṃ gacchāmi sampūjya naranārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||49|| ityuktvā ca hariṃ natvā satye yayau tu nāradaḥ | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi pātivratyabalaṃ mahat ||1.364.50|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye sāvitryāṃ nāradasya trivedātmakatridevadarśanaṃ, vedhasaḥ sāvitrīpātivratyabalena muhuḥ śarīravattvamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 36 4||
<1.365> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi divi devā gandharvā marutastathā | grahāśca ketavo nakṣatrāṇi dikpālakāśca ye || 1 || vasavo nidhayo rudrāḥ ṛṣayo ravayastathā | devyo’psaraso munayo dāsyaḥ paryaśca dāsakāḥ || 2 || airāvatādyāḥ kariṇo diggajā vājinastathā | uccaiḥśravaḥprabhṛtayo haṃsāśca garuḍāḥ śukāḥ || 3 || kāmadhenavo gāvaśca saramādyāḥ śvajātayaḥ | meṣāśca mahiṣāścāpi siṃhā ye devavāhanāḥ || 4 || te sarve kāmagā divyāḥ kāmarūpadharāstathā | aṣṭasiddhiyutāḥ sarve nirāvaraṇadṛṣṭayaḥ || 5 || apratighātagatayaḥ sarvabhāṣāvidaśca te | devabhāṣāvidaḥ sarve dharmapuṇyāvalambinaḥ || 6 || niyamasthā bhuṃjate svaḥsukhaṃ dīrghaprajīvanaḥ | mayūrā mūṣakāḥ sarpā ye devānāṃ gṛhe sthitāḥ || 7 || te sarve kāmarūpadhrāḥ svasvadharmaparāyaṇāḥ | vartante tatra yā tvekā śunī tvindrasya sevikā || 8 || saramā vartate nityaṃ patyadhīnā pativratā | saramāyāḥ patirnāmnā dyumeyastvindrasevakaḥ || 9 || tatparā saramā svābhibhaktā patyuḥ priyaṃkarī | patyādeśasthitā patipradattabhogakāriṇī || 1.365.10 || dyumeyamantarā kvāpi nādatte bhojanādikam | yebhyaḥ kebhyaśca devebhyo labdhaṃ samarpyaṃ svāmine || 11 || tato gṛhṇāti vai nityaṃ svāmyādeśaṃ karoti ca | ekadā divi vidyutsuvidyunnāmakarākṣasau || 12|| akasmāttu gatau yoddhuṃ sahendreṇa kṛte yuge | baliṣṭhābhyāṃ mahendrastu nirjitaḥ san palāyitaḥ || 13|| dāsā dāsyo vāhanādyāḥ saramādyāḥ palāyitāḥ | meroraraṇyadeśeṣu cakrurguptaṃ niveśanam || 14|| rākṣasāvapi māhendraṃ padṃ saṃgṛhya garvitau | modamānau vihārārthaṃ meruṃ prati gatau mudā || 15|| tatrāraṇye guhāṃ dṛṣṭvā sukhadāṃ kāmadāṃ śubhām | manoharāṃ viśiṣṭāṃ ca samadhyāsya pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 16|| indrapurīṃ samāgatya pratigatvā ca tāṃ guhām | rametesma bahudāsīsaṃśliṣṭāvubhayāsurau || 17|| devāstu duḥkhamāpannāḥ vinā rājānamindrakam | mantrayāṃcakruravyagrā aindraṃ padamabhīpsavaḥ || 18 || sarve saṃhatya sainyāni cakrustayoḥ sudaṃśitāḥ | abravīttatra devānāṃ gururbṛhaspatiśca tān || 1 9|| gomedhena yajadhvaṃ vai prathamaṃ vipṇumīśvaram | gavāṃ medhyāni dugdhāni ghṛtāni vahnimūrtaye ||1.365.20 || bhojayitvā balaṃ prāpya yaṣṭavya kratubhiḥ punaḥ | evaṃkṛte vijayo vo bhaviṣyati tu nānyathā ||2 1 || upadeśo mayā dattaḥ kriyatāṃ śīghramityayam | evamuktāstadā devāḥ pāyasādyarthameva gāḥ ||22|| kāmadhenūḥ samānīya mervaraṇye kratusthale | rarakṣuryajñakāryaṃ tvārebhire guruyantritāḥ ||23|| dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ sarpiḥ prājyaṃ gavāṃ prage ca te | kratvagnau viṣṇave nityaṃ devebhyaśca dadatyapi ||24||| divā tā dhenavaḥ sarvā yānti śādvalabhūmiṣu | āhārāya tṛṇādyartha nirbhayāsu sthalīṣu ca ||25|| indrastatra tadā devaiśakāritaśca deśitaḥ | gavāṃ saṃrakṣaṇārthāya dūtānpreṣaya nityadā || 26 || indreṇa saramā dattā śunī pativratā tadā | pātivratyaprabhāveṇa sarvarakṣākarī satī ||27|| mumucurgāścāraṇārthaṃ rakṣārthaṃ saramāṃ daduḥ | devā havanaṃ kurvanti niścintā balalabdhaye || 28|| tāstu gāvo devaśūnyā rakṣyamāṇāstṛṇasthale | tatra jagmustadā gāvaścarantyo yatra te’surāḥ || 29|| te tu dhenukulaṃ dṛṣṭvā śukramūkaḥ purohitam | paśya tvaṃ devagā brahmam̐ścāryante rakṣamāṇayā ||1.365.3 0 || indraśūnyā saramayā vada vighnaṃ yathā bhavet | devakṛte kratau śīghraṃ śādhi kurmo vayaṃ tathā ||3 1 || evamuktastadā śukraḥ pratyuvācāsurām̐stadā | gā hiyantāṃ śīvamasurā mā vilambatha kṣaṇam ||32|| gāvo mūlaṃ hi yajñasya devānāṃ puṣṭidāstu tāḥ | tadrodhe yajñarodhaḥ syād devā duḥkhamavāpnuyuḥ ||33|| evamuktāstadā daityā jahastā gā yadṛcchayā | hṛtāsu tāsu saramā mārgānveṣaṇatatparāḥ ||34|| apaśyatsā diteḥ putrairnītā gāvaḥ kratordharāḥ | daityairapi śunī dṛṣṭā dṛṣṭamārgā surakṣikā || 35|| dṛṣṭvā te saramāṃ prāhuḥ sāmapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ | sarame tvaṃ surebhyastu mā nivedya sarvathā ||36|| daityairgāvo hṛtāśceti mā brūhi te śubhaṃ bhavet | āsāṃ gavāṃ cātibhiṣṭa kṣīraṃ tva sarame śubhe ||37|| piba svairamiti proktvā tasyai dugdhaṃ dadustadā | datvā tu kṣīramatulaṃ tasyai te daityanāyakāḥ ||38|| mā bhadre devarājāya yāstvimā vinivedaya | evaṃ prāhurmuhustasyai sā śrutvā prāha dānavān || 39|| yasyānnaṃ bhuṃjate bhṛtyāstasyārthe bhṛtyavartanam | tadarthe prāṇadānaṃ ca śreyaḥkṛnna tu cānyathā ||1.365.40 || yo bhṛtyo vetanaṃ labdhvā svāmino’rthaṃ karoti na | sa yāti rauravaṃ tarhi viparītastu kiṃ labhet ||41 || nāhaṃ devaśunī devaviparītā bhavāmi vai | rakṣārthaṃ vihitā sāhaṃ kathaṃ yāmi vināśane ||42|| kathayiṣye surān daityā vaḥ kṛtyaṃ dhenulopanam | rakṣikā bhakṣikā nāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi kadācana ||43 || yasyānnakaṇikā bhuktā tadarthaṃ śiraso’rpaṇam | śūnāṃ jātisvabhāvo’sti bhayādapi na mucyate ||44|| yadannamudare jīrṇaṃ tasyāhitakara janaḥ | svāmighno dharmahantā ca hanyate sarvadaivataiḥ ||45|| na niṣkṛtirbhavett tasya svāmiviśvāsaghātinaḥ | yatprāpyate prabhuñjāmaḥ svāmino’ṅganarakṣakāḥ ||46 || tiraskāre prahāre’pi santuṣṭā guṇadarśinaḥ | svāmisevāparā nityaṃ tanvā vācā kriyādibhiḥ ||47|| etādṛśān satyabhūtyān svāmidharmaparāyaṇān | rakṣatyeva hariḥ sākṣāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||48|| nāhaṃ pāsyāmi godugdhaṃ tvājñā vai svāmino vinā | nāhaṃ rakṣyāmi guptaṃ ca prakāśayiṣye satvaram ||49|| ityuktvā sā tataḥ sthānādapāsasāra vegataḥ | tāvad daityā vihantuṃ tāṃ dudruvurhetibhiḥ saha ||1.365.50|| saramā prāha daiteyā na māṃ hantuṃ samarhatha | yatra kvāpi trilokyāṃ vai striyaṃ hanti na buddhimān ||51 || ityuktā api daiteyāḥ śvāno bhūtvātikāminaḥ | parirabdhuṃ śunīṃ tatra dadruvuratigarvitāḥ ||52|| trastā sasmāra sā devān patiṃ śvānaṃ dyumeyakam | tāvattatra samāyāto dyumeyo devasevakaḥ ||53 || saramā svapatiṃ natvā pītvā patimukhāmbujam | prāha daityān parābhāvayituṃ dharmaparāyaṇā |||54||| yadyahaṃ svāmino bhojyaṃ gṛhṇāmi tatprasādakam | tena puṇyena daiteyā dahyantu vahninātra vai ||55|| yadyahaṃ vacane nityaṃ dyumeyasyāsmi saṃsthitā | tena puṇyena daiteyā dahyantu vahninātra vai ||56|| yadyahaṃ svapatiṃ hitvā nānyaṃ gacchāmi karhicit | tena puṇyena daiteyā dahyantu vahninātra vai ||57|| yadyahaṃ svapatituṣṭā nānyatuṣṭā bhavāmi cet | tena puṇyena daiteyā dahyantu vahninātra vai ||58|| yadyahaṃ svāmikārye’pi patiprasannatāṃ sadā | gṛhītvaiva niyuktāsmi daityā dahyantu vahninā ||||59||| patyau supte prasuptāhaṃ bhukte bhuktavatī tathā | tatsukhe sukhamāpannā duḥkhe duḥkhātivartinī ||1.365.6 0|| pativratā yathājāti ced bhavāmi nirantaram | tena puṇyena daiteyā dahyantu vahninātra vai ||61 || ityuktavatyāṃ daiteyāḥ śvasvarūpāstadantike | parito vartikāṃ kṛtvā yāvat spṛśanti tāṃ śunīm ||62|| tāvadagniḥ samudbhūto dāvānalo’tidāruṇaḥ | daiteyāntamabhivyāpya bhasmīcakāra sarvathā ||63|| śunī svapatinā sārdhamindrādidevatāḥ prati | samāgamyākathayat tadvṛttāntamakhilaṃ kratau ||64|| devāḥ śrutvā gatāstatra nītvā gā āgamat kratum | śukraḥ sañjīvanīpatrairmantrairutthāpya cāsurān ||65|| nītvā yayau tu yuddhārthaṃ yajñabhūmau pradarpitaḥ | saramā patimāpṛcchya śukraṃ jagrāha mastake ||66|| mahendrādyāstu yajñasya balena puṣṭatāṃ gatāḥ | daityanāśāya sainyāni racayāmāsurādarāt ||67|| kriyamāṇena yajñena vavṛdhe devatābalam | vardhitena balenendro devasainyānyuvāca yat ||68|| sannahyantāṃ surāḥ śīghraṃ daityānāṃ vadhakarmaṇi | evamuktāstadā devāḥ sannaddhāstatkṣaṇe’bhavan ||69|| asurāṇāṃ vināśāya dudruvurudyatāyudhāḥ | te devā yuyudhustūrṇaṃ vijigyustvāsurīṃ camūm ||1.365.70|| jitāstu devairasurā hataśeṣā vicetasaḥ | jijīviṣavaḥ saṃtrastā mamajjuḥ sāgareṣu te ||71 || tridivaṃ devarājo’pi lokapālaiśca dhenubhiḥ | grahanakṣatratārābhirdevībhiḥ ṛṣibhistathā || 72|| sarvadevaiḥ sametaśca svargaṃ prāpya punaḥ svakam | paramāruhya bubhuje yathāpūrvaṃ yathāsukham ||73|| evaṃ lakṣmi saramāyā devaśūnyāḥ svadharmajā | pātivratyakṛtā siddhiḥ prajajvālāsurānbahūn ||74|| ya iṭṃ śṛṇuyālloke saramādharmasadbalam | sa gomedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti vai janaḥ || 75|| bhraṣṭarājyaśca yo rājā śṛṇotīdaṃ samāhitaḥ | sa devendra iva svargaṃ rājyaṃ svaṃ labhate janaḥ ||76|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye vidyudādirākṣasairdevarājye hṛte devakṛte yajñe merau gorakṣārthaṃ niyuktayā saramayā devaśunyā pātivratyadharmeṇa daityāḥ prajvālitā gāvaśca rakṣitā devarājyaṃ ca devairlabdhamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||365||
<1.366> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mahāsatyāḥ sāvitryāḥ paramottamam | pātivratyaprabhāvaṃ tvaṃ yena saṃjīvitaḥ patiḥ || 1 || yā vedajananī proktā brahmaṇā pūjitā purā | devavrātaiḥ pūjitā ca pūjitā viduṣāṃ gaṇaiḥ || 2 || rājñāśvapatinā tvādye satyayuge’rcitā tathā | sarvaistu mānavaiḥ paścātpūjitā sā pativratā || 3 || madradeśe mahārājo babhūvāśvapatiḥ śubhaḥ | āsīttasya mahārājñī mālatī nāma nāmataḥ || 4 || cakārārādhanaṃ sādhvī patyurnirdeśakāriṇī | sāvitryāḥ parayā bhaktyā vaśiṣṭhasyopadeśataḥ || 5 || ārādhitavatī brāhmīṃ sāvitrīṃ bahuvatsarān | sā dadarśa na sāvitrīṃ phalaṃ nāvāpa vai manāk || 6 || saṃbhagnahṛdayā jātā duḥkhitā bhogavarjitā | rājā tāṃ sāntvavacanairdhairyaṃ pradarśya nītiyuk || 7 || rājñīṃ gṛhe sanniyujya rājyabhāraṃ pradāya ca | sāvitryāḥ sādhanārthaṃ saḥ puṣkaraṃ tapase yayau || 8 || tatra samāhito bhūtvā tapaścakre śataṃ samāḥ | tataḥ śuśrāva divyāṃ sa vāṇīṃ vyomnyaśarīriṇīm || 9 || gāyatrīdaśalakṣaṃ tvaṃ jā| kuru nṛpeti vai | etacchrutvā tvaśvapatiścintayāmāsa tadvidhim || 1.366.1 0|| tāvattatra samāyāto divyadehaḥ parāśaraḥ | rājā natvā muniṃ tatra papraccha kṛtapūjanaḥ || 11 || vidhiṃ japasya gāyatryā munirnṛpamuvāca ha | sakṛjjapastu gāyatryāḥ pāpaṃ dinakṛtaṃ haret || 12|| daśavāraṃ japaḥ pāpaṃ dinarātrikṛtaṃ haret | śatavāraṃ japaḥ pāpaṃ māsakṛtaṃ vināśayet || 13 || sahasradhā japaḥ pāpaṃ vārṣikaṃ saṃvināśayet | lakṣaṃ japo janmapāpaṃ śuṣkaṃ cārdraṃ vināśayet || 14|| daśalakṣaṃ japaḥ pāpaṃ vināśayet trijanmanām | śatalakṣajapaḥ sarvajanmādyaṃ nāśayed ghruvam || 15|| daśakoṭijapo muktiṃ dadātyeva na saṃśayaḥ | karaṃ sarpaphaṇākāraṃ kṛtvā samūrdhvamudritam || 16 || anamramūrdhā hyacalaḥ prajapet prāṅmukho dvijaḥ | japetsurālaye tīrthe tulasīkāṣṭhamālayā || 17|| bījānāṃ vā sphāṭikānāṃ mālāmaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | maṇikāgrathitāṃ saumyāmaśvatthapatrasaptasu || 18|| sthāpayitvā snāpayecca pañcagavyena tāṃ tataḥ | snāpayettīrthatoyena puṇyagaṃgodakena vā || 1 9|| gāyatrīśatakaṃ japtvā japayogyāṃ hi kārayet | atha krameṇa ca tato daśalakṣaṃ japaṃ kuru ||1.366.20 || sākṣād drakṣyasi sāvitrīṃ sarvapātakasaṃkṣaye | prage madhye tathā satyaṃ nityaṃ trisandhyakṛd bhava ||2 1 || sandhyājāpavihīnastu karmaphalabhāg bhavet | yāvajjīvaṃ trisandhyākṛd bhavetsūryasamojjvalaḥ |||22|| jīvanmuktāḥ sa vijñeyo’nyeṣāṃ pāpavināśakṛt | tatpādarajasā pṛthvī sadyaḥ pūtā bhavatyapi ||23|| tīrthānyapi pavitrāṇi bhavanti tasya saṃspṛśeḥ | vaiṣṇavatvavihīnasya trisandhyārahitasya ca ||24|| ekādaśīvihīnasya gṛhṇanti nārcanaṃ surāḥ | na gṛhṇantyapi pitaraḥ śrāddhapiṇḍāditarpaṇam ||25|| haryatarpitabhojī ca śavasparśādikārakaḥ | śūdrayājanakartā ca rājasvalyagamastathā ||26 || asijīvī maṣījīvī kṛṣijīvī ca matsyabhuk | bhagajīvī sutāvidyāvikrayī nocyate dvijaḥ ||27|| vaiṣṇavo bhava rājarṣe madhyāhne ca japaṃ kuru | jyeṣṭhe kṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ śuddho bhūtvā vratī janaḥ ||28|| vrataṃ kuryāccaturdaśyāṃ sāvitrīṃ saṃjaganmuhuḥ | nirāhāraṃ vrataṃ kuryāccaturdaśasamātmakam ||29|| caturdaśaphalairyuktaṃ naivedyaṃ ca dvisaptakam | puṣpāmbaropavītaṃ ca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ prasaṃdadet ||1.366.3 0|| saṃsthāpya maṃgalaghaṭaṃ phalaratnādisaṃyutam | gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām ||3 1 || saṃpūjya pūjayenmukhyaṃ ghaṭe tvāvāhite vratī | mukhyāṃ devīṃ tu sāvitrīṃ dhyāyenmūrtau sthiro vratī ||32|| mādhyandine tu sāvitryā dhyānaṃ śṛṇu tathā nṛpa | stotraṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca mantraṃ ca sarvakāmadam ||33|| taptakāṃcanasadvarṇāṃ jvalantīṃ brahmatejasā | īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ svarṇaratnavibhūṣitām ||34|| svarṇāṃśukāṃ dayāśāntisukhamuktipradāṃ satīm | sarvasampatpradātrīṃ ca kāntāṃ śrīparameṣṭhinaḥ ||35|| vedādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ ca bījarūpāṃ tu mātaram | sarvasaṃkalpadātrīṃ ca bhaje vidyāpradāyinīm ||36|| evaṃ dhyātvā dhyānadhārya puṣpaṃ datvā svamūrdhani | ghaṭe tvāvāhayed devīṃ pūjayet ṣoḍaśārpaṇaiḥ ||37|| āsanaṃ pādyamarghyaṃ cācamanīyaṃ tathā jalaiḥ | pañcāmṛtaiśca snānīyaṃ sugandhādyanulepanam ||38 || abhiṣekaṃ tathā vastraiḥ saṃmārjanaṃ tathāmbaram | bhūṣā puṣpāṇi śṛṃgāradravyāṇi tvarpayettathā ||3 9|| dhūpaṃ yajñopavītādi saubhāgyārthaṃ dravāṇi ca | dīpaṃ naivedyakaṃ vāri tāmbūlaṃ candanādikam ||1.366.40 || ārārtrikaṃ phalaṃ patraṃ sutalpaṃ namanādikam | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ divyamanasā ca kṣamāpanam ||41 || tataḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ datvā mātaraṃ tāṃ visarjayet | upasthitāya viprāya dadyād vratī tu dakṣiṇām ||42|| japet śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ sāvitryai svāhetyaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | sakṛjjapād daśakoṭijapaparyantameva hi ||43 || yathāśakti japenmadhyaṃdine stotraṃ tataḥ param | kṛṣṇena dattā sāvitrī goloke brahmaṇe purā ||44|| brahmā rādhāsvarūpāṃ tāṃ paryaṣṭaud vedamātaram | kṛṣṇaśaktisvarūpe śrīsvarūpe parameśvari ||45|| nārāyaṇasvarūpe tvaṃ nārāyaṇi maheśvari | tejomayi parānandamayi dvijātivardhini ||46|| nitye sanātani lakṣmi sarvamaṃgalarūpiṇi sarvadevīsvarūpe mokṣade sukhade sundari ||47|| brahmatejaḥprade bhaktadurītanāśakāriṇi kāyena manasā vācā jātāghānāṃ vināśini ||48|| brahmaṇā saṃstutā yā tvaṃ satyalokaṃ gatā saha | sukhade mokṣade kanye prasannā bhava sundari ||49|| iti stotraṃ vada tvaśvapate prāpsyasi darśanam | stotraṃ cedṃ trisandhyāyāṃ yaḥ paṭhenmātaraṃ smaran ||1.366.5 0 || caturvedādipāṭhānāṃ sampūrṇaṃ labhate phalam | prabhā ca pārvatī lakṣmīrmāṇikyā kamalā satī ||51 || sāvitrī vedamātā sā dadāti darśanaṃ svakam | ityuktvā sa ṛṣiśreṣṭho yayau svargaṃ parāśaraḥ ||52|| rājā tvaśvapatiścakre satapojapanārcanam | dadarśa tāṃ sa sāvitrīṃ sahasrārkasamaprabhām ||53|| tato lakṣmi nṛpatiḥ so’pūjayad dhyeyadevatām | prāha taṃ sā prasannāsmi te jānāmi manogatam ||54|| sādhvī kanyābhilāṣaṃ te karoti mahiṣī yataḥ | vāñchitaṃ tava patnyāstat sarvaṃ dāsyāmi niścitam ||55|| tvaṃ tu prārthayasi putra bhaviṣyati kramāt sutaḥ | ityuktvā sā mahādevī brahmalokaṃ yayau tiraḥ ||56|| rājā tu tāṃ diśaṃ natvā jagāma svālayaṃ tataḥ | nāticireṇa kālena sā kanyādāvajāyata ||57|| savitṛsadṛśī rūpe sāvitrīvaradānajā | sūyamānā sukhaṃ sā vai sāvitrīnāmataḥ kṛtā ||58|| tajjanmasamaye brahmā devaiḥ sahājagāma ha | puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ tadā kṛtvā yayau dhāma svakaṃ tataḥ ||59|| nityaṃ tasyāstu bālāyā darśanārthaṃ surādayaḥ | samāyāntyadṛśyarūpā mudā tvaśvapatigṛhe ||1.366.60|| vaikuṇṭhasadṛśaṃ rājño bhavanaṃ samaśobhata | kālena yauvanaṃ prāptā divyā devī vyarājata ||6 1 || brahmāṃśa samabhūt kāle dyumatsenātmajo balī | satyavāniti nāmnā saḥ kumāro guṇavāridhiḥ ||62|| sā varaṃ varayāmāsa satyavantaṃ svayaṃvare | rājā tasmai dadau tāṃ ca ratnābhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ||63|| vivāhavidhinā tāṃ sa nītvā varo gṛhaṃ yayau | gārhasthyapātivratyādidharmāścarati sā satī ||64|| saṃvatsare vyatīte ca satyavān piturājñayā | jagāma phalakāṣṭhārthamaraṇyaṃ ghātake dine ||65|| sāvitrī pātivratākhyadharmabalena tanmṛteḥ | kālaṃ jñātvā tatpaścād yayau yatra gataḥ patiḥ ||66 || śuṣkakāṣṭhāni cādātuṃ yatate satyavān bhuvi | śirovedanayā prāṇām̐statyāja taṃ tadā yamaḥ ||67|| baddhvā sūkṣmaśarīreṇa yuktaṃ yayau yamālayam | taddehaṃ vṛkṣapatreṣu rakṣitvānuyayau satī ||68 || satīṃ dṛṣṭvā yamastāṃ vai provāca nyāyayugvacaḥ | aho kva yāsi sāvitri mānuṣī saśarīriṇi || 69 | | yadi vāñchati cāgantuṃ kāntena saha dharmiṇī | dehaṃ tyaktvā samāyāhi sadehā na gatiḥ khalu || 1.366.70 | | tava bhartuḥ samāyātaḥ pūrṇaḥ kālo’tra mānave | sa karmaphalabhogārthaṃ satyavān yāti madgṛham || 71 || karmaṇā janma jantūnāṃ mṛtyuścāpi tu karmaṇā | sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaḥ prapadyante hi karmabhiḥ || 72 || karmaṇā tu divaṃ yāti satyalokaṃ prayāti ca | karmaṇā tvīśatāṃ yāti harerdāsyaṃ ca karmaṇā || 73 | | śubhena karmaṇā yāyāt sālokyādi catuṣṭayam | indratvaṃ vaidhasatvaṃ ca munitvaṃ viprajātitām || 74|| muktatāṃ rājatāṃ rājendratāṃ gurvī tapasvitām | kṣatriyatāṃ vaiśyatāṃ ca śūdratāṃ cāntyajātitām ||75 || mlecchatāṃ jaṃgamatāṃ ca sthāvarātmakatāṃ tathā | śailatāṃ vṛkṣatāṃ cāpi paśutāṃ pakṣitāṃ tathā ||76 || kṛmitāṃ jantutāṃ cāpi gandharvatāṃ ca nāgatām | rākṣasatāṃ kinnaratāṃ kūṣmāṇḍatāṃ ca yakṣatām || 77|| vetālatāṃ bhūtatāṃ ca pretatāṃ ca piśācatām | ḍākinītvaṃ ca daityatvaṃ dānavatvaṃ surāritām ||78 || prāpnoti karmabhirjanturlokāntarāṇi karmabhiḥ | karmabhiḥ puṇyavān jīvo pāpavām̐ścāpi karmabhiḥ ||79 || sundaraśca surūpaśca nīrogī karmaṇā tathā | andhaḥ kāṇaḥ kutsitaśca mahārogī ca karmaṇā | |1.366.8 0 || satyaṃ ca nirayaṃ svargaṃ karmaṇā prāpyate tathā | śakralokaṃ sūryalokaṃ candralokaṃ tathā param ||8 1 || vahnilokaṃ vāyulokaṃ varuṇālayamityapi | dhruvalokaṃ ca kauberaṃ padaṃ śivagṛhaṃ tathā ||82 | | nakṣatralokaṃ ca janalokaṃ tapo mahastathā | pātālāni ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ golokaṃ cāpi karmabhiḥ ||8 3 || kṣaṇajīvitvamatha ca cirajīvitvamityapi | koṭikalpādijīvitvaṃ kṣīṇāyuṣṭvaṃ ca karmabhiḥ | |84|| jīvasañcāramātrāyurgarbhe mṛtyuḥ svakarmaṇā | tava bhartustathā mṛtyuḥ karmaṇā samupasthitaḥ ||85|| tasmāt sāvitri manmārgāt parāvṛtya yathāsukham | tyaktvā bharturabhilāṣāṃ prayāhi svagṛhaṃ prati ||86|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau yamo natvā satīṃ tataḥ | sāvitrī na parāvṛttā pātivratyaparāyaṇā || 87|| kintu papraccha vijñeyaṃ karmākarmādi sādaram | śubhaṃ tathāpyaśubhādi lakṣmi karmaphalaṃ tathā ||88|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye madradeśādhipatināśvapatinā sāvitryārādhanena sāvitrī sutā labdhā, sā ca satyavate dattā, satyavato maraṇe sāvitrī pātivratyabalena pretamanuyayau, yamarājasya saṃvādaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 366 ||
<1.367> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi yamaproktamanādṛtyātibhāvataḥ | yatpapraccha tu sāvitrī kathayāmi nibodha me || 1 || śubhaṃ kiṃ cāśubhaṃ karma kiṃ bījaṃ kaḥ phalapradaḥ | kena kīdṛgbhavetkarma ko hetustatra sarvathā || 2 || ko vā karmaphalaṃ bhuṃkte ko vā nirliṃpta ityapi | karma nirmūlayantyeva kathaṃ vai sādhavo janāḥ || 3 || karmakārakaḥ kaḥ proktaḥ ko deho dehavām̐śca kaḥ | kiṃ vijñānaṃ manaḥ kiṃ ca buddhiḥ kā prāṇa eva kaḥ || 4 || kimindriyaṃ devatāśca bhoktā bhojayitā ca kaḥ | ko bhogo niṣkṛtiḥ kā ca ka ātmā kaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ || 5 || etatsarvaṃ yamadeva cejjānāsi vadātra me | yamaḥ śrutvātisaṃhṛṣṭaḥ sāvitrīṃ prāha tattvataḥ || 6 || abhyudayapradaṃ śāntipradaṃ vedādidarśitam | karma śubhaṃ maṃgalakṛd viparītaṃ na vai śubham || 7 || vāsanā bhāvanā vāpi karmabījamudīryate | phalapradaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvāntarasthitaḥ || 8 || śubhecchayā śubhaṃ karmāśubhayāśubhameva tat | karmaheturbhaved yatnastaddheturvāñcchanā matā || 9 || vāñcchāhetustu vijñānaṃ jīve vastusamāśrayam | jñānahetustu saṃkalpaḥ pārameśvara āsthitaḥ || 1.367.1 0|| vibhvī śaktistatra yuktā kriyāṃ janiṃ dadāti vai | hareḥ saṃkalpaśaktibhyāṃ jīve jñānakriye mate || 11 || tābhyāṃ paramparājanyaṃ karma sarvaṃ prajāyate | antataḥ sarvathā hetuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mataḥ || 1 2|| jīvaḥ karmaphalaṃ bhuṃkte tadātmā nahi lipyate | antaryāmī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo nirlipta eva ha || 13 || sādhavaḥ sarvathā karmaphalābhisandhivarjitāḥ | viṣṇusevātmakaṃ kāryaṃ kurvantyaharniśaṃ śubham || 14|| ahaitukaṃ ca saṃkalpavarjitaṃ harituṣṭaye | tatsarvaṃ bhaktirūpaṃ vai karmanirmūlanakṣamam || 15|| harerbhaktaḥ sadā mukto muktistasya dvidhā matā | jīvanmuktirbrahmamuktirnirvāṇapadadāyinī || 16|| jīvanmuktiṃ bhaktirūpāṃ sadā vāñchanti vaiṣṇavāḥ | brāhmīṃ muktiṃ parāṃ sevāṃ dhāmni vāñcchanti sādhavaḥ || 17|| karmaprayojikā śaktiḥ sā tu kṛṣṇe vyavasthitā | antaryāmisvarūpasthā kriyāṃ janayati dhruvā || 18|| pañcabhūtātmako dehaḥ sthūla ityabhidhīyate | tadvān jīvaḥ sadā jñātā cetano jñānavānmataḥ || 1 9|| caturviṃśatitattvānāṃ jīvātmaparamātmanoḥ | svarūpairguṇakāryaiścāvagamo jñānamucyate || 1.367.20|| sarvavyavahṛtibījaṃ vijñānaṃ tvātmani sthitam | mūlamāyā sattvarajastamomayī jaḍā sadā || 21 || buddhirūpā manorūpā prāṇarūpā prajāyate | manaḥ saṃkalpakaṃ proktaṃ buddhiradhyavasāyinī ||22|| śvāsaḥ prāṇo jīvanaṃ ca vṛttistattvaiḥ saha sthitiḥ | indraśaktisamāpannamindriyaṃ tat prakīrtitam || 23|| indra ātmā sadā prokta indriyāṇi bahūni vai | śrotratvaccakṣūrasanāghrāṇāni jñānadāni hi ||24|| vākpāṇipādapāyūpasthāni karmendriyāṇi hi | digvātārkapraceto’śvivahnīndropendramitrakāḥ ||25|| devatāśca prakāśārthaṃ nirmitāḥ śaktidāstu tāḥ | bhoktā dehī bhojayitā tvantarātmā hariḥ svayam ||26|| bhogaḥ sukhasya duḥkhasya sākṣātkāraḥ samucyate | niṣkṛtiḥ śāntirityuktā nivṛttiḥ karmaṇāṃ tathā ||27|| karmanāśāya karmāṇi niṣkṛtyātmāni vai viduḥ | prāyaścittāni karmāṇi pūrveṣāṃ śodhakāni vai ||28|| sūkṣmadehādvivikto yo vāsanābalakarṣitaḥ | jīvatāṃ saṃvidan svasya jīvātmā sukhasaccitaḥ ||29|| antarniyāmakastasyākṣaradhāmni ca yaḥ sthitaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so’yaṃ paraprabhuḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||1.367.3 0|| pṛthivī vāyurākāśo jalaṃ tejastvimāni vai | pañcabhūtāni cāśritya jīvo bhuṃkte phalaṃ bahu ||3 1 || yadā bhajati kṛṣṇaṃ sa vāsanāvarjito bhavet | janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiśokādivarjito bhavet ||32|| bhaktisamaṃ na balavatsādhanaṃ tvanyadasti hi | sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaṃ sarvasampatpradaṃ param |||33|| svargamokṣapradaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvasmṛddhiprapūrṇakam | paramātmā paraṃbrahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||34|| kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ sa rādhālakṣmīprabhāpatiḥ | pārvatīmāṇikīnātho ramāvṛndāpatiḥ prabhuḥ ||35|| śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sa paraṃbrahma svayaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | tasya bhaktiḥ prakartavyā tena mokṣo bhaved dhruvaḥ ||36|| śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ smṛtiḥ kṛṣṇāsyāṅgaprasevanam | pūjanaṃ stavanaṃ bhṛtyaṃ maitryaṃ sarvasamarpaṇam ||37|| evaṃ tu navadhā yogo bhaktirūpaḥ sumuktidaḥ | dharmaḥ kāṣṭhauṣadhikvātho vairāgyaṃ tu virecanam ||38|| bodho ramyo’valehaśca bhaktistatra rasāyanam | sandhāninyauṣadhirdharmo viveko vṛṇahāriṇī ||39|| viśalyakaraṇī bhaktirjīvāturviratistathā | harau snehānubandho yo bhūrisatkārapūrvakaḥ ||1.367.40 || bhaktirbodhyā mokṣadā sā kartavyā sarvadā janaiḥ | cikkaṇatvayutasvāntaḥsāndrānandapariplutaḥ ||41 || bhāvaḥ snehaḥ sa vijñeyo harau kāryo hi sarvadā | svāntarvṛttiravicchinnā harau snehānubandhinī |||42|| bhaktiḥ prema ratiḥ sevā harau kāryā hi muktidā | vaidhī vidhivacojanyā śravaṇādinavātmikā ||43 || māhātmyajñānasaṃyukto dṛḍhīyān sarvato’dhikaḥ | rāgaḥ sneho harau bhaktirmokṣadā sarvathā matā ||44|| bhaktavātsalyamarcāyā daṃbhatyāgo’numodanam | śuddhacittena tatpūjā tatkathāśravaṇādaraḥ ||45|| aṃgakriyā tadarthaṃ ca smṛtistannāmakīrtanam | ete’ṣṭāvapi bhaktau syurabhinnāḥ phaladāḥ sadā ||46|| gurupādāśrayo dīkṣāsvīkāraḥ sevanaṃ guroḥ | viśvāsātsatpathe vṛttiḥ saddharmapṛcchanaṃ tathā ||47|| bhogatyāgaśca haryarthaṃ vāsastīrthādibhūmiṣu | yathāpekṣaṃ vyavahāro vrataṃ haridine tathā ||48|| daivivṛkṣādisatkāro daśaite bhaktivardhanāḥ | putraśiṣyādyarāgaśca kusaṃgisaṃgavarjanam ||49|| mahāraṃbhādyanudyogo durvivādādivarjanam | haryarthaṃ dravyadānaṃ ca śokamohādivarjanam ||1.367.50|| anyānudvegakāritvaṃ devagurvādyanindanam | surāparādhākartṛtvaṃ suranindāsahiṣṇutā |||51 || daśaite sādhanīyāḥ syurbhaktairbhaktivivṛddhaye | atha kṛṣṇacihnadhṛtiḥ kṛṣṇanāmasmṛtirhṛdi ||52|| puṣpamālādisaṃdhṛtirnṛtyaṃ ca daṇḍavannatiḥ | abhyutthānaṃ hareragre gamane cāpyanuvrajiḥ ||53|| pradakṣiṇaṃ tathā stotraṃ sevanaṃ kīrtanaṃ japaḥ | vijñānaṃ stotrapāṭhaśca svādo naivedyapajjale ||54|| prasādasaurabhagrāhaḥ sparśanaṃ cekṣaṇe hareḥ | nīrājanaṃ harerutsavāvalokanamityapi |||55||| dayāpratīkṣaṇaṃ dhyānaṃ smaraṇaṃ dāsyamuttamam | sakhitvaṃ cātmadānaṃ ca haryarthaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ tathā ||56 || preṣṭhārpaṇaṃ bhaktasevā śaraṇe patanaṃ sadā | tulasīśāstrasattīrthavaiṣṇavādiprapūjanam ||57|| yathādhanaṃ tathāsevā vārtādi sādhubhiḥ saha | ārtasevā janmamaho hareścaraṇasevanam |||58|| śraddhayā bhūyasīprītiḥ śāstrārthāsvādanaṃ param | satsu saṃgaḥ kīrtanaṃ me sadbhiḥ satsu sadā sthitiḥ |||59|| ātmaniṣṭheti ca catuścatvāriṃśadime guṇāḥ | bhaktyātmakā bhaktipuṣṭikarāḥ snehavivardhanāḥ ||1.367.6 0|| satāṃ saṃsevanaṃ kāryaṃ kṛpā prāpyā satāṃ sadā | saddharmeṣu parā śraddhā harerguṇaśrutistathā ||61 || premāṃkurodbhavaścāpi śrīharyāśraya uttamaḥ | harau rāgābhivṛddhiśca haryarcāsphuraṇaṃ sadā ||62|| bhakte kṛṣṇaguṇāvāsaḥ sthitirdharme hareḥ sadā | ete daśaguṇāḥ siddhāstataḥ premātivardhate ||63 || sāttvikādiprabhedaiśca mṛdumadhyādhibhedataḥ | aneke vai bhaktibhedāḥ sūkṣmā bhavanti muktidāḥ ||64|| atha premaparākāṣṭhā vidhiryatra na vidyate | sā tu sarvapramūrdhanyā bhaktirbhavati śāśvatī ||65|| yāvacchākhaṃ prematattvaṃ yādṛksvabhāvapoṣitam | dehināṃ prākṛtabhāvaṃ tāvacchākhamanantakam ||66|| prematattvaṃ bhidyate vai yatsaṃkhyā nahi pāryate | tasmādbhaktirasaṃkhyātabhedā bhavati puṣpitā ||67|| tasyā bhaktimahādevyā bhuktimuktyādisiddhayaḥ | rājñyāḥ sadānuvartante ceṭikā iva tatparāḥ ||68|| parārdhaguṇito brahmānando bhaktyaṇusadṛśaḥ | bhaktyānandāmṛtāmbhodhau brāhmāṇyapi sukhāni vai ||69|| magnasya goṣpadāyante premānandāplutasya hi | yeṣāṃ dṛḍhā bhaved bhaktiḥ premarūpā sadā harau ||1.367.70|| te svapne’pi na paśyanti kīnāśaṃ yamarādgṛham | koṭijanmakṛtaiḥ puṇyairāpyāṃ bhaktiṃ samācaran ||71 || mahāpāpātipāpām̐śca punātyeva yathā hariḥ | śatravo naiva bādhante grahā yāmyāśca rākṣasāḥ ||72|| bhūtapretapiśācādyā bhaktimantaṃ harerjanam | bhaja taṃ devapravaraṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam || 73 || tvatpṛṣṭaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ gaccha vatse yathāsukham | ityuktvā ca yamo natvā virarāma hi padmaje ||74|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye sāvitrīkṛtaśubhāśubhakarmāditatsambandhipraśnānāṃ yamarājakṛtottarāṇi bhagavadbhaktiprakāratanmāhātmyādi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 367||
<1.368> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca evamuktāpi sāvitrī na nyavartata padmaje | punarāha yamaṃ nyāyyaṃ pātivratyabharaṃ vacaḥ || 1 || tyaktvā kva yāmi kāntaṃ ca tvāṃ ca jñānārṇavaṃ gurum | jijñāsā jāyate praṣṭuṃ tannivṛttiṃ kuru prabho || 2 || kāṃ kāṃ yoniṃ yāti jīvaḥ karmaṇā kena vā yama | svargaṃ vā narakaṃ vāpi muktirvā kena karmaṇā || 3 || rogyarogī dīrghajīvī kenālpāyuśca karmaṇā | sukhī duḥkhī vikalāṃgaḥ kāṇo’ndho badhirastathā || 4 || pramattaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ kṣipto lubdhastathā ca ghātakaḥ | jāyate karmaṇā kena kena siddhīrhi vindati || 5 || svargabhogādikaṃ kena vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ tathā | golokaṃ cākṣaraṃ kena sālokyādicatuṣṭayam || 6 || narakaṃ vā katividhaṃ kaḥ kiyantaṃ tu tiṣṭhati | kena vā karmaṇā kīdṛgvyādhirbhavati mānuṣe || 7 || vada sarvaṃ yathā vetsi hyupakāro bhaviṣyati | iti śrutvā tu sāvitrīṃ yamaḥ prāha taduttaram || 8 || vismitaḥ sa yamaḥ prāha kanye ṣoḍaśavatsarā | vayasā tvaṃ kutastvetajjñānaṃ labdhavatī sute || 9 || manye tāṃ brahmaṇaḥ patnīṃ sāvitrīṃ tvāṃ samāgatām | prāptāṃ tu bhūbhṛtā tvaśvapatinā tapasā purā || 1.368.10 || jñānaṃ te pūrvaviduṣāṃ yogināṃ jñānināṃ yathā | yathā śrīḥ śrīpateraṃke lakṣmīrnārāyaṇorasi || 11 || yathā rādhā ca śrīkṛṣṇe bhavānī bhavavāmagā | dharmorasi yathā mūrtiḥ sāvitrī brahmavakṣasi || 1 2|| kardame devahūtiśca śatarūpā yathā manau | aditiḥ kaśyape yadvad vaśiṣṭhe’rundhatī yathā || 13 || yathā śacī mahendre ca yathāhalyā tu gautame | yathā ca rohiṇī candre kāmadeve ratiryathā || 14|| hutāśane yathā svāhā yathā svadhā ca pitṛṣu | yathā divākare saṃjñā yajñe ca dakṣiṇā yathā || 15|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe lakṣmīrmāṇikī pārvatī prabhā | varuṇānī ca varuṇe varāhe tu dharā yathā || 16|| kārtike devasenā cālakṣmīruddālake yathā | yathā pativratālakṣmīḥ patnīvrate ca bhūsure || 17|| yathā ca kaṃbharālakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇagopālavakṣasi | yathā jayā ca lalitākṣarādhīśe harau tathā || 18|| saubhāgyā supriyā tvaṃ ca bhava satyavati priye | iti tubhya varo dattaḥ prasannamanasā mayā || 1 9|| vṛṇu devi tato’nyaccāparamabhīṣṭamarpaye | evaṃ lakṣmi yamaṃ dṛṣṭvā prasannaṃ prāha sā satī ||1.368.20|| satyavadaurasenaiva putrāṇāṃ śatakaṃ mama | bhavediti vṛṇomyatra macchvaśurasya cakṣuṣī ||21 || rājyalābho bhaveccāpi me bhrātṛśatakaṃ bhavet | samatīte lakṣavarṣe tataḥ satyavatā samam || 22|| harerdhāma prayāsyāmi dehīmaṃ sadvaraṃ prabho | anyajjijñāsitaṃ sarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi tadvad ||23 || yamaḥ prāha ca tacchrutvā sāvitrīṃ mānayan bahu | sarvaṃ tvadīpsitaṃ devi bhaviṣyati tathāstviti ||24|| anyajjijñāsitaṃ vacmi karmapākaṃ niśāmaya | yathā vedmi ca tatsarvaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 25 || pṛthvyāṃ śubhāśubhaṃ karma bhuṃjate mānavāstviha | surā daityā dānavāśca gandharvā rākṣasādayaḥ ||26 || narāśca karmajanakā na sarve samajīvinaḥ | viśiṣṭajīvinaḥ sarve bhuṃjate karma yoniṣu || 27|| viśeṣato mānavāśca bhramanti sarvayoniṣu | śubhena karmaṇā svargaṃ nirayaṃ tvaśubhena vai ||28|| rājasena tu puṇyena jāyate mānavo bhuvi | sāttvikapuṇyapuñjena devatāḥ saṃbhavanti vai | | 29| | tāmasena ca pāpena rākṣasādyāḥ piśācakāḥ | bhūtapretāḥ paśavaśca pakṣiṇo vṛkṣavallayaḥ | | 1.368.30 | | kīṭāḥ pataṃgāḥ sarpāśca sarīsṛpāśca jantavaḥ | jāyante duḥkhabahulāścaturaśītiyoniṣu | | 31 | | ūrdhvaṃ sattvaviśālāśca madhye bhavanti rājasāḥ | nikṛṣṭayonijāḥ sarve jāyante tāmasā hyadhaḥ | |3 2 | | puṇyena jāyate svargaṃ narakaṃ pāpamātrataḥ | muktirbhaktyā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe snehaprasevayā | | 33 || rogī kukarmaṇā jīvaścārogī śubhakarmaṇā | dīrghajīvī ca kṣīṇāyuḥ sukhī duḥkhī śubhāśubhāt | | 34|| andhādayaścāṃgahīnāḥ kutsitena tu karmaṇā | anyanetravineṣṭāndhaḥ kāṇo bhavati mānavaḥ | | 35 || anyanindāśrutilubdho badhiro jāyate dhruvam | anyodvegakaraścātra pramatto jāyate sadā | | 36 || anyadravyāpahartā ca daridro nirdhano bhavet | atighṛṇastiraskartā kṣipto bhavati sarvathā | | 37| | aprāptabhogasampattiścānyaddravyādi luṇṭati | jāyate’yaṃ ghātakaśca lubdhakaścātipāpavān || 38 || ṛṇānivartako janma gṛhṇātyeva na saṃśayaḥ | siddhyādikamavāpnoti sarvotkṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 39 || svargabhogādikaṃ sarvaṃ dānena labhate janaḥ | vipṇubhaktyā tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ vidyayā cāmṛtaṃ padam | |1.368.40 || kṛṣṇabhaktyā tu golokaṃ parayā vidyayākṣaram | hareḥ kṛpayā prāpyeta sālokyādicatuṣṭayam | |41 || narakaṃ bahudhā proktaṃ karmaṇā bahuvistarāt | pāpānāṃ cāpyasaṃkhyānāṃ narakāsaṃkhyatāsti vai | |42 | yāvatpāpaṃ tatra pāpī tiṣṭhate tallaye tu na | parāntarapradāhena pareṣāṃ duḥkhadatvataḥ ||43 | vyādhayo’bhibhavantyenaṃ paraduḥkhapradaṃ janam | sāmānyaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu sundari | |44|| durlabhā mānavī jātiḥ sarvajātiṣu bhūstare | vipraḥ sādhuśca sādhvyaśca śreṣṭhāste bhaktimajjanāḥ | |45 || sakāmo bhaktimān karmayogī bhavati vai punaḥ | niṣkāmo bhaktimān brahmamuktaḥ sampadyate pare | |46 || punarāgamanaṃ nāsti teṣāṃ niṣkāmakarmiṇām | kṛṣṇabhaktāstu golokaṃ yānti divyadvihastinaḥ | |47| | nārāyaṇārcakā yānti vaikuṇṭhaṃ vai catuḥkarāḥ | bhūmabhaktā amṛtākhyaṃ yānti sahasrabāhavaḥ ||48|| tīrthasthitā janā yānti satyalokaṃ ca tāpasāḥ | sūryabhaktā raviṃ yānti kailāsaṃ śivabhāvukāḥ ||49|| yajñaniṣṭhāḥ svargaloke śakratvaṃ veṣṭabhāvanāḥ | tattallokaṃ prayāntyeva punarāyānti karmaṇā ||1.368.50|| haribhaktāstu niṣkāmā harerlokaṃ prayānti hi | yasmānna punarāvṛttirakṣaraṃ tatpadaṃ param ||51 || svadharmarahitā bhraṣṭācārā yāntyadhamāṃ gatim | nārakīṃ yātanāṃ te ca bhuṃjate tiryagātmasu ||52|| svadharmaniratāḥ sarvaṃ pṛthvyāṃ suphalabhāginaḥ | svadharmarahitāḥ sarve nirayān yānti dāruṇān ||53|| kanyādātā candralokaṃ yāvadindrāścaturdaśa | yāti sālaṃkṛtādānād dviguṇaṃ phalamucyate ||54|| gavyaṃ ca rajataṃ bhāryāṃ vastraṃ sasyaṃ phala jalam | ye dadati te prayānti tattatsmṛddhā divaṃ dhruvām ||55|| kālaṃ tu suciraṃ sthitvā pṛthvīmāyānti vai punaḥ | suvarṇaṃ gāṃ ca tāmrādi dadatyatra tu ye janāḥ ||56|| vasanti sūryalokaṃ te varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati | bhūmiṃ dhānyāni dadati śvetadvīpe vasanti te ||57|| gṛhadānapradātā ca suralokaṃ hi vindati | gṛhareṇupramāṇābdavāsastatra dhruvo mataḥ ||58|| yasmai yasmai tu devāya yo dadāti gṛhaṃ janaḥ | sa yāti tasya lokaṃ tu reṇumānābdamuttamam ||59||| saudhe caturguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ pūrte śataguṇaṃ phalam | prakṛṣṭe’ṣṭaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ divye divyaphalaṃ matam ||1.368.6 0|| taḍāgakartā varṣāṇāmayutaṃ janalokagaḥ | vāpyāṃ phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ setubandhe sahasrakam ||6 1 || dhanuścatuḥsahasreṇa dairghyamānena vāpikā | daśavāpīsamā kanyā phalaṃ dadāti pātrake ||6 2|| dviguṇaṃ ca phalaṃ tatra yadi sālaṃkṛtāṃ dadet | vāpīkūpataḍāgādeḥ paṃkoddhāre kṛte phalam ||63|| aśvatthavṛkṣasevī ca samāropaka ityapi | prayāti tapaso loke varṣāṇāmayutaṃ param ||64|| puṣpodyānaprado varṣāyutaṃ dhruve vaset sati | vimānado viṣṇuloke vasenmanvantaraṃ param ||65|| yānavāhanaśibikārathadātā caturguṇam | phalaṃ tu labhate pātre vaiṣṇave sukhadaṃ param ||66 || dolādyarpayitā yāyād viṣṇulokaṃ manvantaram | rājamārgaṃ saudhayuktaṃ karoti yaḥ sa aindrakam ||67|| padṃ varṣāyutaṃ bhuktvā pṛthvyāṃ yāti śubhaṃ gṛham | dattaṃ dātre samāyāti na dattaṃ nopatiṣṭhati ||68|| bhuktvā svargādikaṃ saukhyaṃ punarbhūmau prayānti vai | labhetottamabhavane janmottamajaneṣviha ||69|| viprāśca rakṣakā yadvopārjakāḥ sevakāśca vā | yathākarma bhavantyeva bhūmau tadvacca sarvadā ||1.368.70|| atrānyatra kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ bhoktavyaṃ bhavati dhruvam | iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ gaccha sāvitri mā ciram || 71 || ityuktvā maunamāsthāya yamaścāgre yayau śanaiḥ | sāvitryapi śanaiḥ paścāccacāla yamavāṭagā |||72|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye karmānurūpaśubhāśubhasthānagatiḥ, svasyāḥ putraśataṃ śvaśurasya cakṣuṣī, svasyā bhrātṛśatakaṃ satyavato lakṣābdāyuritivaraprāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ |||368||
<1.369> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca sāvitrīṃ pṛṣṭhamāyāntīṃ dṛṣṭvā yamastu vismitaḥ | punarnatvā satīṃ prāha kimicchasi vadātra me || 1 || iti śrutvā yamavākyaṃ sāvitrī punareva tam | papraccha taṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi nibodha me || 2 || prayānti svargamanyaṃ ca lokaṃ yena viśeṣataḥ | karmaṇā puṇyavantastu tadvadeti samāsataḥ || 3 || kṛtaṃ sāvitrikāpraśnaṃ yamaḥ prāha taduttaram | annadānapradātānnavarṣāṇyaindre mahīyate || 4 || nātra pātraparīkṣā ca na kālaniyamastathā | āsanasya pradātā ca devaviprādaye janaḥ || 5 || varṣāṇāmayutaṃ vahniloke sammodate sukhī | yāvanti tasya sūtrāṇi tāvadvarṣāyutaṃ divi || 6 || devāya gāṃ ca viprāya dadyātpayasvinīṃ tu yaḥ | vaikuṇṭhe golomasaṃkhyāyugāni sa mahīyate || 7 || caturguṇaṃ puṇyadine tīrthe śataguṇaṃ phalam | dānaṃ nārāyaṇakṣetre phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 8 || viprāya haraye godo yajñakāryārthine tathā | varṣāṇāmayutaṃ svarge candraloke pramodate || 9 || vatsaṃ prasūyamānā gāmubhayatomukhīṃ dadet | vaikuṇṭhe tallomamānasamāḥ pramodate sukhī || 1.369.1 0|| śālagrāmaṃ sabhūṣādi dadyāt tatpūjakāya vai | vaikuṇṭhe modate dātā yāvaccandradivākarau || 11 || chatradātāyutasamā modate varuṇālaye | pādukādo’yutasamā vāyuloke mahīyate || 12|| śayyādo modate cāndre loke candrāyureva saḥ | viprāya haraye dīpadātā tailaghṛtapradaḥ || 1 3|| yāvanmanvantaraṃ sopi brahmaloke mahīyate | divyadṛṣṭirbhavettasya cāndhatā naiva jāyate || 14|| gajadātā vasedindrasyārdhāsane nirantaram | aśvadātā vāruṇe vai kalpasthāyī bhavet sati || 15|| śibikādo viṣṇuloke manvantaraṃ mahīyate | cāmaravyajanaprado vāyuloke mahīyate || 16 || varṣāṇāmayutaṃ dhānyapradaḥ kaṇasamā vaset | viṣṇuloke vasatyeṣaḥ śrīharernāmajāpakaḥ || 17|| palāyate mahāmṛtyuścirajīvī sa jāyate | āndolayeddhariṃ yastu preṃkhāyāṃ mānavo bhuvi || 18|| saddolā kārayedyastu vratotsavamahotsave | jīvanmuktaḥ sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante viṣṇudhāma saḥ || 1 9|| vaikuṇṭhe nivasettatra śatamanvantarāvadhim | phalamuttaraphālgunyāṃ tatopi dviguṇaṃ bhavet ||1.369.20|| bhavet kalpāntajīvī saḥ sarvasmṛddhiguṇālayaḥ | tiladastilavarṣāṇi modate viṣṇumandire ||21 || tāmrapātre tiladāne labhedvai dviguṇaṃ phalam | kanyādātā candraloke kalpamekaṃ vaseddhruvam |||22|| dāsīdātā tu gāndharve’yutavarṣāṇi modate | janmasahasraṃ saubhāgyayuktāṃ satīṃ ca vindati |||23|| phalidrudaḥ phalasamāḥ śakraloke mahīyate | pṛthvyāṃ ca sutavān śreṣṭhī sundarīsahito bhavet ||24|| phaladātā ciraṃ svargaṃ vasatyeva sukhāvaham | dravyasasyagṛhadātā kuberabhavane vaset ||25|| manvantarāvadhi paścāddhanavān jāyate bhuvi | puṇyakṣetre puṇyapātre sasasyakṣetradaḥ sati ||26|| vaikuṇṭhe modate manvantaraśataṃ śataṃ tataḥ punaḥ | bhuvi bhūyān bhavatyeva śrīputradhanavāṃstathā ||27|| nārīgomān sukhī syācca janmanāṃ śatakaṃ param | sapraja śreṣṭhabhūmiṃ ca grāmaṃ dadyāttu śārṅgiṇe ||28|| lakṣamanvantaraṃ dātā vaikuṇṭhe sa mahīyate | pṛthvyāṃ lakṣagrāmarājā lakṣajanmasu jāyate ||29|| saprajaṃ suprakṛṣṭaṃ ca sasyekṣvādisamanvitam | vāpīkūpayutaṃ kṣetraṃ nagaraṃ ca dadāti yaḥ || 1.369.3 0|| mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe daśalakṣendrajīvanam | niyutapattanādhīśo rājendro jāyate bhuvi |||3 1 || nagarāṇāṃ śatakaṃ ca deśaṃ dadāti viṣṇave | mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe koṭimanvantarāvadhim ||32|| tato jambūdvīpapatirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | mahī taṃ na jahātyeva janmanāṃ koṭimeva vai ||33|| kalpāntajīvī ca bhavet rājarājeśvaro mahān | svādhikārapradātā ca phalaṃ caturguṇaṃ labhet ||34|| jambūdvīpapradātā ca phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ labhet | saptadvīpamahīdātuḥ sarvatīrthānusevinaḥ || 35|| sarveṣāṃ tapasāṃ kartuḥ sarvopavāsakāriṇaḥ | sarvānyadānadātuśca sarvasiddhimatastathā | |36 || astyeva punarāvṛttirna bhaktasya hareraho | asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāṃ pātaṃ paśyanti vaiṣṇavāḥ sati ||37|| golokasthāśca vaikuṇṭhavāsino’kṣaradhāmagāḥ | paradhāmasthitāścāpi paśyantyetāṃ punargatim ||38|| harermantropāsakantu vihāya mānuṣīṃ tanum | haritulyo divyarūpo bhūtvā yāti hareḥ padam ||39|| golokasthāḥ kṛṣṇabhaktā vaikuṇṭhasthāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ | labdhvā kṛṣṇasya sārūpyaṃ nārāyaṇasya cāpi te ||1.369.40|| tayoḥ sevāṃ prakurvanti hyasakhyaṃ prākṛtaṃ layam | devāśceśāśca naśyanti siddhā viśvāni yāni ca ||41 || harerbhaktā na naśyanti janmamṛtyujarāharāḥ | kārtike haraye vṛndātulasīpatradāyakaḥ ||42|| yugaṃ patrapramāṇaṃ tu modate harimandire | haraye ghṛtadīpaṃ ca kārtike yo dadāti vai ||43|| palapramāṇaṃ varṣaṃ sa modati harimandire | harīcchayā yadi yāti sṛṣṭau bhāgavato bhavet ||44|| mahādhanāḍhyaścakṣuṣmān dīptimān bhaktikārakaḥ | ācāryo vāvatāro vā tadaṃśo muktido bhavet ||45|| māghe prātastu gaṃgāditīrthasnāyī harergṛhe | yugaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi modate sa harīcchayā ||46 || brahmāṇḍeṣu deśikendro bhakto jitendriyo bhavet | māghasnāyī tu gaṃgāyāṃ prayāge prātareva yaḥ ||47|| vaikuṇṭhe modate sopi lakṣamanvantarāvadhim | nārāyaṇehayā sṛṣṭau deśikendro bhaveddhi saḥ || 48|| mānavīṃ sa tanuṃ tyaktvā punardhāma prayāti saḥ | nāsti punarāvṛttiśca harerdhāmagatasya vai ||49|| karoti sa harerdāsyaṃ labdhvā sārūpyamityatha | nityasnāyī tu gaṃgāyāṃ pade pade’śvamedhajam ||1.369.50|| phalaṃ yāti ca pūtaḥ sa sūryavajjāyate sati | tasyaiva pādarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā ||51 || modate sa tu vaikuṇṭhe yāvaccandradivākarau | nārāyaṇehayā pṛthvyāṃ tapasvī deśiko bhavet| ||52|| grīṣmādau jaladātā tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti kalpakam | vaiśākhe haraye yastu candanādi dadāti vai ||53|| yugaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi modate viṣṇumandire | vaiśākhe saktudātā ca modate viṣṇumandire |||54||| saktureṇupramāṇābdaṃ tato viṣṇostu vāñchayā | ācāryo bhavati loke tapasvyuddhārakottamaḥ ||55|| karoti yaḥ kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīṃ bhādrāsite dale | śatajanmakṛtapāpācchuddho bhavati tatkṣaṇāt ||56|| goloke modate kṛṣṇecchayā kārṣṇo bhavettathā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇajanmāṣṭamīṃ kārtikakṛṣṇake ||57|| dale karoti yo bhaktyā harerdhāma prayāti saḥ | anantasamayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sevakaḥ ||58|| sa cāśrute sarvakāmān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇārpitān | śivarātrivratakartā bilvapatraṃ dadāti yaḥ ||59|| yuga patrapramāṇaṃ ca modate śivamandire | vidyāvānputravān śrīmān prajāvān bhūmimām̐stathā ||1.369.6 0|| śivecchayā bhavatyeva saptamanvantarāvadhim | mahāsṛṣṭau sukhī bhūtvā yāyācca śivamandiram ||6 1 || caitre māghe’rcayecchaṃbhuṃ puraḥ kuryāttu nartanam | māsaṃ vāpyardhamāsaṃ vā daśa saptadināni vā ||62|| dinamānaṃ yugaṃ sopi śivaloke mahīyate | śrīrāmanavamīṃ bhakto yaḥ karoti vrataṃ vratī ||63|| saptamanvantaraṃ yāvanmodate rāmadhāmani | punā rāmasya bhakto vai bhūtvācāryapade sthitaḥ ||64|| rāmabhaktyā prayātyeva vaikuṇṭhaṃ sa dvitīyakam | śaradṛtupūrṇimāyāṃ pūjāṃ harerharasya ca ||65|| bahūpacārasampannāṃ yaḥ karoti prabhaktarāṭ | naivedyairupahāraiśca dhūpadīpādibhistathā ||66|| nṛtyagītādibhirvādyairnānākautukamaṃgalaiḥ | hareḥ śaṃbhorvaselloke saptamanvantarāvadhim ||67|| punaḥ sa nirmalo bhakto bhūtvā śriyamavāpnuyāt | mahāprabhāvayuktaśca gajavājisamanvitaḥ ||6 8| | rājarājeśvaraḥ putrapautrādimānna saṃśayaḥ | bhādraśuklāṣṭamīṃ prāpya mahālakṣmīṃ samarcayet ||6 9 || ṣoḍaśavastubhirbhaktyā vaikuṇṭhe yāti kalpakam | punaḥ pṛthvyāṃ rājarājeśvaro bhaveddhi sāttvataḥ ||1.369.70|| kārtikīpūrṇimāyāṃ yo rāsamaṇḍalamācaret | gopīrgopān śataṃ dvedhā śataṃ kṛtvā suvarṇajam ||71 || rādhākṛṣṇaṃ kārayitvā pūjayedupacārakaiḥ | yathālabdhairbahuvidhairgolokaṃ yāti pūjakaḥ ||72|| brahmaṇo vayasā tatra sthitvā sṛṣṭau prayāti saḥ | kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ punaḥ kṛtvā labdhvā mantraṃ harestataḥ ||73 || kṛṣṇasārūpyamāsādya pārṣado jāyate tu saḥ | goloke vartate nityaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitaḥ ||74|| ekādaśīvratī yāti yāvadvai vedhaso vayaḥ | vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca tataḥ kṣmāyāmāgatya punareva saḥ ||75|| haribhaktaḥ punaryāti vaikuṇṭhaṃ na patetpunaḥ | bhādraśukle dvādaśyāṃ yaḥ śakraṃ saṃpūjayejjanaḥ ||76 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi śakraloke mahīyate | ravivāre’rkasaṃkrāntyāṃ saptamyāṃ śuklapakṣake ||77|| haviṣyānnapradātārkalokaṃ prayāti kalpakam | punaḥ pṛthvyāṃ samāgatya nīrogī śrīyuto bhavet ||78|| jyeṣṭhaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ sāvitrīṃ tvāṃ prapūjayet | modate sa brahmaloke saptamanvantarāvadhim ||79|| punaḥ pṛthvyāṃ śrīsameto jñānasampattiyug bhavet | māghaśuklasya pañcamyāṃ pūjayed yaḥ sarasvatīm ||1.369.80|| mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe kalpamekaṃ punaḥ kaviḥ | gosuvarṇapradātā golomadviguṇaṃ hareḥ ||8 1 || vaikuṇṭhe modate paścād viṣṇubhakto bhavet bhuvi | rājarājeśvaro gomān vidyājñānasutādimān ||82|| bhojayed yaḥ sataḥ sādhūn sādhvīrviprām̐stathātithīn | bhoktulomapramāṇābdaṃ modate viṣṇumandire ||83 || atrāgatya sukhī śrīmām̐ścirajīvī parākramī | yo dadāti harernāma viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||84|| nāmakoṭiṃ japan bodhyo jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ | baikuṇṭhe viṣṇusāyujyaṃ prāpnoti śāśvataṃ hiṃ saḥ |||85|| śivārcakaḥ śivaṃ yāti bāṇareṇupramāṇakam | yugāyutaṃ tu kailāse sthitvā samrāṭ kṣitau bhavet ||86 || śālagrāmārcako bhakto prasādasya prabhakṣakaḥ | mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe yāyādvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam ||87|| punaḥ pṛthvyāṃ nṛpo bhūtvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti no patet| | tapovratādyanuṣṭhātā vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti kalpakam ||88 || bhūtvā pṛthvyāṃ sa rājendrastato mukto bhaveddhi saḥ | aśvamedhakratukārī śakrasyārdhāsane vaset |||89||| aśvaromapramāṇābdaṃ rājasūye caturguṇam | naramedhe’śvamedhārdhaṃ gomedhe tu tathādṛśam ||1.369.90|| putreṣṭau tu tadardhaṃ syāllāṃguleṣṭau gomedhajam | vipreṣṭau vṛddhiyāge ca phalaṃ gomedhajaṃ bhavet ||9 1 || padmeṣṭau tu tadardhaṃ ca viśokeṣṭau viśokajam | vijayeṣṭau padmasamaṃ prājāpatye’pi tatsamam ||92| ṛddhiyāge mahaiśvaryaṃ viṣṇuyāge tu vaiṣṇavam | padaṃ puṇyaṃ labhed bhakto viṣṇulokaṃ ca śāśvatam || 93 || viṣṇuyajñaḥ pradhāno’sti sarvayajñeṣu sundari | viṣṇuyajñātparo yajño nāsti śreṣṭhaphalapradaḥ || 94|| tatkartā bahukalpāntajīvī mukto bhavediha | jñānena tejasā caiva viṣṇutulyo bhavedapi || 95|| aśvamedhaśatenaiva śakratvaṃ prāpyate divi | sahasreṇa viṣṇupadaṃ saṃprāpa pṛthubhūpatiḥ || 96 || tīrthayajñatapovedavratānāṃ phalato’dhikam | muktidaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādābjasevanam || 97|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaiva varṇanaṃ dhyānamarcanam | kīrtanaṃ bhajanaṃ stotraṃ smaraṇaṃ vandanaṃ japaḥ || 98|| tatpādāmṛtanaivedyādanaṃ sarvepsitapradam | bhaja tvaṃ svāminaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ parātparam ||99|| gṛhāṇa ca patiṃ vatse sukhaṃ gaccha svamandiram | ityuktvā maunamāsthāya yamastasthau hi padmaje || 1.369.100 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye sāvitrīpṛṣṭhakarmaphalapraśnānāṃ yamakṛtāni bahuvidhaphalottarāṇi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonasaptatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||369||
<1.370> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca harerbhaktermahimānaṃ śrutvā satī yamaṃ punaḥ | papraccha kena vidhinā bhajanīyo hariḥ svayam || 1 || yamaḥ śrutvā tu sāvitrīṃ prāha rītiṃ sumokṣadām | śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi yathā prāha satīṃ yamaḥ || 2 || prātarutthāya tu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hṛdi smaret | mūrtiṃ dhyāyet saumyarūpāṃ cintayettu punaḥ punaḥ || 3 || snāne śauce kriyāyāṃ ca bāhye cāntarakarmaṇi | bhojye vihāre śayane gṛhakārye hariṃ smaret || 4 || śraddhayā parayā tatra harau sarvendriyāṇi vai | tathāntaḥkaraṇānyevaṃ yojayecchrīharau mudā || 5 || pāne niṣadane svapne nidrāyāṃ jāgrati krame | śubhe’śubhe tathā kārye smaraṇīyo hariḥ sadā || 6 || jihvā tatkīrtanaṃ kuryātkarṇastacchravaṇaṃ caret | netraṃ taddarśanaṃ kuryād ghrāṇaṃ tadgandhamāpnuyāt || 7 || carma tatsparśanaṃ kuryātkarastatpādasevanam | pādastanmandiraṃ gacched vāṇī tadbhajanaṃ caret || 8 || malamūtrendriyaṃ vighnanāśārthaṃ guṇatāṃ vrajet | ānandaṃ śrīharerlabdhvā śrīharermananaṃ caret || 9 || nirṇayaṃ mānanaṃ cāpi cintanaṃ śrīhareśca tu | evaṃ sarvaṃ harereva kuryānnānyasya kasyacit || 1.370.1 0|| na svārthaṃ na parārthaṃ ca kuryāddharyarthameva vai | tathā kṛtvā nacireṇa harerdhāmagatirbhavet || 11 || ityuktā sā tu sāvitrī yamaṃ bhaktavaraṃ param | jñātvā yamāṣṭakaṃ prāha śṛṇu lakṣmi vadāmi te || 12| sūryaṃnārāyaṇastīrthe puṣkare tapasā purā | dharmāśaṃ yaṃ sutaṃ prāpa dharmarājaṃ namāmyaham || 1 3|| sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ karmabhogāntaṃ saṃvidhāya yaḥ | śāntiṃ karoti yo devaḥ śamanāya tu te namaḥ || 14|| kṛtānāṃ karmaṇāṃ tvantaṃ nyāyarītyā karoti yaḥ | sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ so’yaṃ taṃ kṛtāntaṃ namāmyaham || 15|| pāpināṃ daṇḍakartā yo daṇḍaṃ bibharti śuddhidam | śāstre tasmai nītiyuje daṇḍine te namo namaḥ || 16 || sarveṣāṃ vastukāryāṇāṃ paricchedaṃ karoti yaḥ | sarvāyuḥkalanaṃ devaṃ kālarūpaṃ namāmyaham || 17|| jīvān daṇḍapradānairyo yamayatyeva sarvathā | karmānurūpaphaladastaṃ yamaṃ praṇamāmi vai || 18|| yathā karma tathā dātā na rāgānna ca roṣataḥ | tasmācchuddhikaraṃ mitraṃ sarvamitraṃ namāmi ca || 1 9|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrteḥ samutpannastu yaḥ purā | brahmaṇoṃ’śastato jātastaṃ brāhmaṃ praṇamāmi ca ||1.370.20|| ityuktvā taṃ praṇanāma yamastuṣṭo babhūva ha | yamāṣṭakaṃ paṭhatastu bhavennaiva yamādbhayam ||2 1 || kāyavyūhena ca śuddhiḥ karmaṇāṃ tasya jāyate | mucyate yamapāśācca satīṃ prāheti dharmarāṭ ||22|| yamastasyai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamantra pradāya ca | oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ praṇamāmi trivārakam ||23 || karmāśubhavipākaṃ ca tāmuvāca yamaḥ svayam | kukarmaṇā jano yāti narakān bahudāruṇān |||24|| narakāṇāṃ tu kuṇḍāni santi nānāvidhāni ca | vistṛtāni gabhīrāṇi bhayakleśakarāṇi hi ||25|| ṣaḍaśītiśca kuṇḍāni ghorāṇi kutsitāni ca | saṃyamanyāṃ pravidyante tāni nibodha nāmataḥ ||26|| vahnikuṇḍaṃ taptakuṇḍaṃ kṣayakuṇḍaṃ bhayānakam | viṭkuṇḍaṃ mūtrakuṇḍaṃ ca śleṣmakuṇḍaṃ tu duḥsaham ||27|| garakuṇḍaṃ dāhakuṇḍaṃ vasākuṇḍaṃ tathā mahat | śukrakuṇḍamasṛkkuṇḍamaśrukuṇḍaṃ ca kutsitam ||28|| malakuṇḍaṃ vīryakuṇḍaṃ rajaḥkuṇḍaṃ vigandhakṛt | karṇaviṭkuṇḍamugraṃ ca nakhakuṇḍaṃ ca duḥkharam || 203|| majjākuṇḍaṃ māṃsakuṇḍamasthikuṇḍaṃ ca duḥkhadam | lomakuṇḍaṃ kleśakuṇḍaṃ tāmralohaprakuṇḍakam | |1.370.3 0 || tīkṣṇakaṇṭakakuṇḍaṃ ca viṣakuṇḍaṃ ca dāhakam | gharmakuṇḍaṃ taptasurākuṇḍaṃ vṛścikakuṇḍakam ||3 1 || taptatailaprakuṇḍaṃ ca dantakuṇḍaṃ ca vighnadam | kṛmikuṇḍaṃ pūyakuṇḍaṃ sarpakuṇḍaṃ bhayāvaham | |3 2|| daṃśamaśakakuṇḍaṃ ca vajradaṃṣṭrāprakuṇḍakam | śarakuṇḍaṃ śūlakuṇḍaṃ khaḍgakuṇḍaṃ tu vaiśasam ||33 || godhākuṇḍaṃ nakrakuṇḍaṃ kākakuṇḍaṃ mahābhayam | ghṛṣṭikuṇḍaṃ cūrṇakuṇḍaṃ bandhakuṇḍaṃ nirāśrayam ||34|| taptapāṣāṇakuṇḍaṃ ca tīkṣṇagrāvāgrakuṇḍakam | lālākuṇḍamasikuṇḍaṃ cūrṇakuṇḍaṃ ca mardanam ||35|| cakrakuṇḍaṃ vajrakuṇḍaṃ kūrmakuṇḍaṃ maholbaṇam | jvālākuṇḍaṃ bhasmakuṇḍaṃ pūtikuṇḍaṃ bhayāvaham | |36 || taptasūrmīmasipatraṃ kṣuradhāraṃ sucīmukham | kṛkalāsaprakuṇḍaṃ ca jagadaṃśaṃ cipīṭakam ||37|| kuṃbhīpākaṃ kālasūtramadhaḥkandharamugrakam | pāṃśubhojyaṃ pāśakaṇṭhaṃ śūlaprotaṃ sukīlakam ||38|| ulkāmukhaṃ tvandhakūpaṃ vedhanaṃ daṇḍatāḍanam | jālabandhaṃ dehacūrṇaṃ dalanaṃ śoṣaṇaṃkaram ||39|| sarpajvālāmayaṃ kṣveḍadhūmrāndhaṃ nāgapāśanam | dvaidhībhāvaprakuṇḍaṃ ca lāvaṇaṃ kuṇḍamityapi ||1.370.40|| bhaguprapātanaṃ cāpi vaitaraṇīprapātanam | carmotkartanakuṇḍaṃ ca bhrāṣṭrakaṭāhamityapi ||41 || kuṇḍānyetāni sāvitri pāpānāṃ śodhakāni vai | pāpināṃ duḥkhadānyeva rakṣitāni yamānugaiḥ ||42|| daṇḍahastaiḥ śūlapāśaśaktitomarahastakaiḥ | madonmattaistāmasaiśca nirdayaistāmrapiṃgalaiḥ ||43 || nānārūpadharaiḥ sarvādhṛṣyairdṛśyaistu pāpinām | puṇyakṛtāmadṛśyaiśca dhārmikāṇāṃ ca yoginām ||44|| śṛṇu keṣāṃ kutra vāso daṇḍarūpo’sti kuṇḍake | kaṭuvāṇyā khalatvena dagdhān karoti bāndhavān ||45 || gātralomapramāṇābdaṃ vahnikuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ | dagdhvā vahnau pātakāni labhejjanmatrayaṃ paśoḥ ||46 || gṛhāgatātithiṃ yo na bhojayet svāśritaṃ tathā | lomamānasamāstaptakuṇḍe sthitvā tataḥ sa vai ||47|| uṣṇabhūmau marau deśe pakṣī syātsaptajanmasu | ravivārārkasaṃkrāntyāmamāyāṃ śrāddhavāsare ||48|| vrate kṣāreṇa vastrasthakīṭānāṃ nāśakastu yaḥ | kṣārakuṇḍaṃ sa vai yāti sūtramānābdameva ha ||49|| vrajecca rājakīṃ yoniṃ saptajanmasu sundari | svadattāṃ paradattāṃ ca jīvikāṃ tu hareddhi yaḥ ||1.370.50 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṭkuṇḍaṃ tu prayāti saḥ | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viḍbhojī viṭkṛmistataḥ ||51 || taḍāgaṃ nāśayed yastu mūtrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ | tadreṇumānavarṣaṃ ca mūtrapāyī tato bhuvi ||52|| saptajanmasu godhā syād bhittivāsakarī gṛhe | ekākī miṣṭabhug yāti śleṣmakuṇḍaṃ samāśatam |||53 || śleṣmābhojī bhavet preto mūtrapūyādipānakṛt | pitaraṃ mātaraṃ patnīṃ guruṃ putrīṃ sutaṃ sakhīn ||54|| anāthaṃ ca na puṣṇāti kṣveṇakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ | abdasahasraṃ tadbhojī tataḥ pretaḥ śataṃ samāḥ |||55|| atithiṃ krūrabhāvena draṣṭurjalaṃ ca piṇḍakān | pitṛdevā na gṛhṇanti kulanāśastato bhavet ||56|| teṣāṃ tu ghātakānāṃ ca malakuṇḍe prapātanam | śataṃ samā malabhojī tataḥ sa saptajanmasu ||57|| daridro jāyate duḥkhī patitaśca pade pade | datvā dānaṃ tu caikasmai tvanyasmai dīyate tu tat ||58|| vasākuṇḍaṃ prayātyeva śatavarṣaṃ vasādanaḥ | janmatrayaṃ sa cāṇḍālaḥ kṛkalāsaśca saptakṛt ||59|| daridraśca bhavedalpajīvī ca pāpakṛttataḥ | naro nārī svakaṃ śukraṃ rajo vāpi parasparam ||1.370.60|| pāyayatyeva kāmādvā śukrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ | śatavarṣaṃ ca tadbhojī yonikīṭaḥ śataṃ samāḥ ||6 1 || atha pūjyaṃ tāḍayitvā guruṃ ca pitarau tathā | raktaṃ pravāhayed yaḥ sa yātyasṛkakuṇḍamulbaṇam ||62|| śatavarṣaṃ raktabhojī tato vyādhaḥ prajāyate | saptajanmasu pāpāni kṛtvā punastathā vrajet ||63 || aśru sravantaṃ gāyantaṃ nṛtyantaṃ bhaktameva yaḥ | kṛṣṇāgre tu hasan cāśrukuṇḍaṃ prayāti narmakṛt ||64|| śatavarṣaṃ tvaśrubhojī cāṇḍālaḥ syāt trijanmasu | khalo yāti gātramalakuṇḍaṃ daśābdakaṃ tataḥ ||65|| trijanmasu kharo jambūkastrijanmasu kaṣṭavān | badhiraṃ yo hasatyeva nindatyapi ca narmakṛt ||66 || sa yāti karṇaviṭkuṇḍe tadbhojī śatavatsarān | tato badhiraḥ saptajanmasvaṃgahīnaśca saptasu ||67|| jīvikādaṃ tu yo hanti majjākuṇḍe sa gacchati | lakṣavarṣāṇi tadbhojī śaśakaḥ saptajanmasu ||68|| mīnā eṇāḥ sapta sapta tataḥ śuddhaḥ prajāyate | kanyāvikrayiṇo yānti māṃsakuṇḍe’tidāruṇe ||69|| kanyālomapramāṇābdaṃ māṃsādanā hatā yamaiḥ | svamāṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ mūrdhnaste khādanti kṣudhārditāḥ ||1.370.70|| ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi kanyāviṭsu kṛmistataḥ | saptajanmasu vyādhaḥ sa varāhaḥ kukkurastataḥ ||71 || saptajanmasu maṇḍūko jalaukāḥ kāka ityapi | kṣauraṃ yatra vidhināptaṃ na kārayettu yo janaḥ ||72 || nakhakuṇḍaṃ prayātyeva nakhabhojī nakhābdakam | romakuṇḍe tathā yāti romabhojī pratāḍitaḥ ||73 || sakeśaṃ pārthivaṃ liṃgaṃ pūjayed yo janastu saḥ | keśakuṇḍe prayātyeva mṛdreṇumānavarṣakam ||74|| tato vai yavano varṣaśataṃ prajāyate bhuvi | pitṛpiṇḍāpradātāsthikuṇḍe patati colbaṇe ||75 || tataḥ khañjaḥ saptajanmasvatinirdhana eva ca | yaḥ sevate pūrṇamāsāṃ garbhiṇīṃ prasavonmukhām ||76 || prataptatāmrakuṇḍe sa śatavarṣāṇi tiṣṭhati | rajasvalānnaṃ yo bhuṃkte śatābdaṃ lauhakuṇḍake ||77|| patitvā rājakīṃ yoniṃ carmakārī ca saptasu | mahāvraṇī daridraśca jāyate tatparaṃ śuciḥ ||78|| yaśca gharmasvedahastaṃ devadravye suyojayet | śatavarṣapramāṇaṃ sa gharmakuṇḍe hi tiṣṭhati ||79|| surāpaśca surākuṇḍe coṣṇaṃ yāti śataṃ samāḥ | tataḥ śūdraḥ saptajanmasvatinirdhana eva ca ||1.370.80|| kaṭuvāṇyā patiṃ vakti sā kuṇḍe tīkṣṇakaṇṭake | patitā tāḍyate dūtaiścaturyugaṃ ca tiṣṭhati ||8 1 || aśvinī jāyate paścāt pṛthivyāṃ saptajanmasu | viṣadātā viṣakuṇḍe sahasrābdaṃ hi tiṣṭhati ||82|| viṣabhojī nṛghātī ca vṛṇī syāt saptajanmasu | saptajanmasu kuṣṭhī ca tataḥ śuddhaḥ prajāyate ||83 || vṛṣaṃ bhṛtyaṃ tāḍayed yo daṇḍena tanniyāmakaḥ | prataptatailakuṇḍe sa tiṣṭhatyeva caturyugam ||84|| tato goromamānābdaṃ vṛṣo bhavati bhūtale | baḍiśena ca kuntena dantena kīlakena ca ||85|| lauhena hanti vṛṣabhaṃ dehinaṃ prāṇinaṃ ca vā | kuntakuṇḍe vasetso’pi varṣāṇāmayutaṃ khalu ||86|| tato jalodararogī tvekajanmani jāyate | abhakṣyabhakṣī manujo kṛmikuṇḍaṃ prayāti vai ||87|| svalomamānavarṣānte bhuvi mlecchastrijanmasu | pāpānnabhojī vrajati pūyakuṇḍaṃ śata samāḥ ||88|| tataḥ śūdraḥ saptajanmasvatiśūladharo bhavet | sarpahā sarpakuṇḍaṃ tu yāti sarpeṇa bhakṣitaḥ ||89|| sarpaviḍbhakṣaṇaḥ paścātsarpo vai jāyate bhuvi | tataḥ svalpāyurevāyaṃ dadrurogī bhavettathā ||1.370.90|| sarpeṇa tasya mṛtyuśca sarpeṇa bhakṣaṇaṃ matam | jīvān hanti sa daṃśākhye kuṇḍe patati pāpakṛt ||91 || āyurdinābdakaṃ sthitvā kṣudrajantusahasrake | jāyate ca muhuḥ paścādaṃgahīno bhaved dhruvam ||92|| madhuhā makṣikāghātī sagare kuṇḍake patet | svāyurdinātmakaṃ sthitvā makṣikāyonimāpnuyāt ||93|| adaṇḍyadaṇḍakṛt kuṇḍe vajrakīṭe pateddhruvam | tallomamānavarṣaṃ ca sthitvā kīṭo bhaved bhuvi ||94|| anyāyadhanalo rājā vṛścike kuṇḍake patet | romābdaṃ duḥkhamāsādya vṛścikaḥ saptajanmasu ||95|| tato’ṅgavikalo vyādhigrasto bhuvi bhavejjanaḥ | vipro dharmavihīno vai śarakuṇḍe patatyatha ||96|| śaraviddhaḥ svalomābdaṃ sthitvā śuddho bhavettataḥ | kārāgāre bandhayati jīvānnirdoṣakān janaḥ ||97|| taptatoye golakuṇḍe patati romavatsarān | kīṭairviddhastato nīcabhṛtyo vai jāyate bhuvi || 98|| nakramīnaprahantā ca nakrakuṇḍe patatyatha | nakrakaṇṭakamānābdaṃ sthitvā nakrastato jale ||99|| anyacchidrānveṣakastu kākakuṇḍe patatyatha | kākaprakṣuṇṇanetraśca romābdaṃ tatra vartate || 1.370.10 0|| saptajanmadaridraḥ sa trijanmāndhaśca jāyate | svarṇatāmralauhacauro vajrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti vai | | 101 || devadravyaprahartāpi romābdaṃ vajrakuṇḍagaḥ | vajairhato bhavettatra vajrabhug dehadāvavān || 102 || gavāṃ śukānāṃ mūrtīnāṃ caurastaptopalābhidhe | kuṇḍe patati svalomābdaṃ tato vakastrijanmasu || 103 || haṃsastataḥ śaṃkhacillastato raktādirogavān | saptajanmasu cālpāyuḥ kūpyacauro’pi tādṛśaḥ || 1 04|| rītikāṃsyādicauraśca tīkṣṇagrāvāgrakuṇḍake | svalomābdaṃ vasetpaścādaśvaḥ syāt saptajanmasu | | 1 05|| tato’dhikāṃgakaḥ kubjaḥ pāde rugṇaśca jāyate | puṃścalyannādatajjīvī lālākuṇḍe pated dhruvam || 106 || tallomābdaṃ lālabhojī cakṣūrogī ca śūlavān | mlecchasevī maṣīsevī maṣīkuṇḍe’titaptake || 1 07|| svalomābdaṃ vaset paścāt kṛṣṇapaśustrijanmasu | chāgaḥ sarpastālavṛkṣastriṣu triṣu ca janmasu || 1 08|| dhānyatāmbūlatalpārghyāsanasasyādicaurakaḥ | śatābdaṃ cūrṇakuṇḍe vai tato meṣaśca kukkuṭaḥ || 1 09|| trijanmasu tataḥ kāsavyādhigrastaśca mānavaḥ | vaṃśahīno daridraścāpyalpāyurduḥkhavān bhavet || 1.370.11 0|| cakraśastrādikartā tu śatābdaṃ cakrakuṇḍake | trijanmasu tailakāro rogī vaṃśahīnastataḥ || 111 || pratispardhī matsarī ca vajrakuṇḍe yugaṃ patet | saptajanmasu vakrāṃgo bhāryāvaṃśavihīnakaḥ || 112|| kūrmādimāṃsabhuk kūrmakuṇḍe patecchataṃ samāḥ | sa trijanmasu kūrmaśca sūkaro’pi mayūrakaḥ || 11 3|| mārjāraścāpi pratyekaṃ trijanmasu jāyate | ghṛtatailādicaurastu jvālākuṇḍe ca bhasmani || 114|| kuṇḍe śatābdaṃ patati tailapaḥ saptajanmasu | matsyaśca mūṣakaḥ saptajanmasvatha tataḥ śuciḥ || 1 15|| sugandhitailadhātryādidravyacaurastu kuṇḍake | durgandhe lomamānābdaṃ durgandhī jāyate tataḥ || 1 16|| durgandhikaḥ saptajanau mṛganābhistrijanmasu | saptajanmasugandhaśca tataḥ śuddho hi mānavaḥ || 1 17|| bhūmihartā taptaśūle taptataile patet tataḥ | saptamanvantaraṃ paścād viṭkṛmirayutaṃ tu ṣaṭ || 1 18|| bhūmihīno daridraśca tato vai śuddha eva saḥ | naraghātī cāsipatre vasetkalpaṃ tataḥ punaḥ || 11 9|| brahmahā cecchatamanvantaraṃ khaḍgavane vaset | chinnāṃgaḥ khaṅgadhāraiśca cāṇḍālaḥ śatajanmasu || 1.370.1 20|| sūkaraḥ kukkuro gomāyūśca vyāghro vṛkastataḥ | gaṇḍī mahiṣaḥ pratyekaṃ saptajanmasu jāyate || 121 || grāmādidāhakaḥ kṣuradhāre yugatrayaṃ patet | tataḥ preto vahnimukho’medhyabhojī tataḥ punaḥ || 1 22|| khadyotaśca saptajanau mahāśūlī ca tāvatā | saptajanmagalatkuṣṭhī tataḥ śuddhyati vahnidaḥ || 1 23|| kalaṃkado nindakaśca sūcimukhe yugatrayam | tato bhaved vṛścikaśca sarpaśca saptajanmasu || 124|| vajrakīṭaḥ saptajano bhasmakīṭastato naraḥ | gṛhabhedī stenakartā gogodhāmeṣachāgakān || 125|| pratyekaṃ saptajanmāni tato rogī naro’dhuraḥ | dravyacauro nakramukho yugaṃ paścācca rogavān || 1 26|| gogajāśvanarahantā gajadaṃśe yugatrayam | tatastattajjātijanmatrayaṃ mlecchastato bhavet || 1 27|| gojātiduḥkhado yāti gomukhe narake dhruvam | kṛmitaptodake manvantaraṃ sthitvā ca govṛṣaḥ || 1 28|| saptajanau tato rogī daridro’ntyajajātikaḥ | gobrahmasādhuhatyākṛt strīmitrabhrūṇahā tathā || 1 29|| kuṃbhīpāke patet kalpaṃ cūrṇyate yamadūtakaiḥ | vahnau kṣaṇaṃ kuṇḍake ca tapte taile jale tathā || 1.370.130 || pāṣāṇe taptalauhe ca duḥkhāni paśyati dhruvam | gṛdhrakoṭisahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkaraḥ || 131 || kākaśca saptajanmāni sarpaḥ syātsaptajanmasu | viṭkṛmiśca vṛṣalaśca galatkuṣṭhī tato bhavet || 1 32|| yakṣmagrasto vaṃśahīno bhāryāhīnastataḥ śuciḥ | śrīharau ca śrīkṛṣṇe ca nārāyaṇe ca bhūmani || 1 33|| vāsudeve śive viṣṇau brahmaṇi bhedabuddhikṛt | brahmahatyākaro bodhyo bhedo hatyāsamo mataḥ || 1 34|| akṣare rādhikāyāṃ ca lakṣmyāṃ śriyāṃ ramātanau | pārvatyāṃ ca prabhāyāṃ ca māṇikyāyāṃ ca bhedakṛt || 1 35|| brahmahatyāsamadoṣī lalitājayayorapi | bhedakṛt sve gurau sveṣṭadeve pitari mātari || 136 || haryarcāyāṃ bhedabuddhirbrahmahatyāmadūṣaṇam | viṣṇornaivedyasalilavarjito’pi tathā mataḥ || 1 37|| pitṛdevagurupūjānindako’pi tathā mataḥ | śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ śivāṃ lakṣmīṃ nindanti brahmaghātinaḥ || 138 || harerjanmatithīn śaivīṃ tithiṃ caikādaśīṃ tathā | vratāhāni ca nindanti brahmahatyākarā hi te || 139| | guruṃ ca mātaraṃ tātaṃ sādhvīṃ bhāryāṃ sutaṃ sutām | āśritān yo na puṣṇāti brahmahatyākaro hi saḥ | | 1.370.140 | | apūjakaśca devānāṃ govṛṣādeśca tāḍakaḥ | gocarādiprahartā ca brahmahatyākaro hi saḥ || 141 || gavāṃ duḥkhakaraḥ pāpaṃ gohatyājaṃ labhettathā | gavāṃ vṛttiharo gāśca padā saṃtāḍayettu yaḥ || 142|| yonijīvī trisandhyādivihīno dharmanāśakaḥ | devapitratithisevāhīno goghātako mataḥ || 143 || svabhartari ca kṛṣṇe ca bhedabuddhikarī tu yā | kaṭūktyā tāḍayet kāntaṃ sā gohatyākarī matā || 144|| gavāṃ vṛttiṃ jīvikāṃ ca jalaṃ gṛhaṃ tathāśrayam | hanyād yaḥ sa bhaveccāpi gohatyāpātakī dhruvam || 145| | devapūjākṛte yāni jalānnakusumāni tu | tāni yo laṃghayetpādairgohatyāpāpakṛddhi saḥ || 146 || mithyāvādī gurudveṣī devadveṣī ca pitṛdviṭ | gohatyāpāpavān sopi vijñeyo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 147| | pituḥ śataguṇā mātā mātuḥ śataguṇo guruḥ | vidyāmantrapradātā ca guruḥ pūjyaḥ sadā mataḥ || 148|| guruto gurupatnī ca gaurave ca garīyasī | yatheṣṭadevapatnī ca pūjyā cābhīṣṭadevatā || 149| | brāhmaṇastu surāpāṇī viḍbhojī vṛṣalīpatiḥ | harivāsarabhojī ca kubhīpākaṃ vrajet sati || 1.370.150 || gurupatnīṃ rājapatnīṃ sapatnīmātaraṃ prasūm | sutāṃ putravadhūṃ śvaśrūṃ sagarbhāṃ bhaginīṃ priyām || 151 || sodarabhrātṛjāyāṃ ca mātulānīṃ pitṛprasūm | mātuḥ prasūṃ tatsvasāraṃ bhaginīṃ bhrātṛkanyakām || 152|| śiṣyāṃ ca śiṣyapatnīṃ ca bhāgineyasya kāminīm | bhrātuḥ putrapriyāṃ caivāpyagamyāmāha padmajaḥ || 153 || etāsu gamakaḥ kāmī brahmahatyāśataṃ labhet | sa yāti kuṃbhīpākaṃ tu mahāpāpī sudustaram || 154|| hareḥ sevāṃ vinā sādhvi na labhet karmakhaṇḍanam | sarvānnabhogī saṃyāti kālasūtraṃ śataṃ samāḥ || 155|| tataḥ śūdro’tirugṇaḥ syād daridro nirdhanastathā | prakopavadanā kopāt svāminaṃ yā tu paśyati || 156 || kaṭūktiṃ taṃ ca vadati yāti colkāmukhaṃ hi sā | ulkāṃ dadāti vaktre ca satataṃ yamakiṃkaraḥ || 157|| daṇḍena tāḍayenmūrdhni tallomābdapramāṇakam | tato bhavenmānavī ca vidhavā saptajanmasu || 158|| yā brāhmaṇī sarvabhogyā sāndhakūpaṃ prayāti vai | taptaśaucodake taptvā kalpamānaṃ tataḥ param || 159|| kākī sūkarī kukkuṭī śṛgālī ca pārāvatī | vānarī saptajanmāni cāṇḍālī ca tato bhavet ||1.370.160 || rajakī tailakārī ca tataḥ śuddhyati sā sati | veśyā vased vedhakuṇḍe gaṇikā daṇḍatāḍane || 161 || jālabandhe puṃścalī ca kulaṭā dehacūrṇake | svairiṇī dalane kuṇḍe yāvanmanvantaraṃ vaset || 162|| kare dhṛtvā tu tulasīṃ pratijñāṃ yo na pālayet | mithyā vā śapathaṃ kuryāt sa tu jvālāmukhe patet || 163|| datvā tu dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ pratijñāṃ yo na pālayet | spṛṣṭvā gāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ devaṃ vahniṃ sādhuṃ satīṃ jalam || 164|| na pālayetpratijñāṃ tu sa vai jvālāmukhe patet | mitradrohī kṛtaghnaśca tathā viśvāsaghātakaḥ || 165|| mithyāsākṣyapradaścāpi sa vai jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet | kalpe vaset tato mūko badhiraśca trijanmasu || 166|| mitradrohī nakulaḥ syāt kṛtaghnaścāpi ṣaṇḍhakaḥ | viśvāsaghātī vyāghraśca mithyāsākṣī tu bhallukaḥ || 167|| vratopavāsahīnaśca sadvākyaparinindakaḥ | jihmo vasettu haime vai narake tu śataṃ samāḥ || 168|| jalajantuḥ śatajanmakrameṇa matsyako bhavet | devādidravyahārī ca dhūmrāndhe patito bhavet || 169|| caturyugaṃ vasettatra mūṣakaḥ saptajanmasu | paśau patatriṇi kṛmau vṛkṣajātiṣu jāyate || 1.370.170|| tato bhāryāvaṃśahīnaḥ śabaro vyādhimān bhavet | svarṇakāro vaṇig vaidyo vyāpārī rasavikrayī || 171 || kūṭamāno nāgaveṣṭaṃ kuṇḍaṃ yātyeva dāruṇam | tato gopo bhavecceti tataḥ śuddhyati vai sati || 172|| prasiddhāni tu kuṇḍāni kathitāni pativrate | anyānyapyaprasiddhāni yathākarma bhavanti ve || 173 || santi pāpaprakartāraḥ kuṇḍeṣu phalabhoginaḥ | tato bhramanti saṃsāre kiṃcittubhyaṃ niveditam || 174|| sarveṣṭaṃ sārabhūtaṃ tu maṃgalaṃ kṛṣṇasevanam | janmamṛtyujarārogaśokasantāpatāraṇam || 175|| bhaktivṛkṣāṃkurakaraṃ karmavṛkṣanikṛntanam | sālokyasārṣṭisārūpyasāmīpyādipradaṃ śubhe || 176|| kuṇḍāni yamadūtaṃ ca yamaṃ ca yamakiṃkarān | svapne’pi nahi paśyanti sati śrīkṛṣṇasevakāḥ || 177|| harivrataprakartāro gṛhiṇastyāginastriyaḥ | ye snānti haritīrthe ca nāśnanti harivāsare || 178|| saṃsmaranti kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ saṃpūjayanti ca | na yānti te mama ghorāṃ duḥkhāṃ saṃyamanīṃ purīm || 179|| āmnāyanyāyamārgasthāstyāgino gṛhiṇaśca te | śuddhā dharmaparā yānti kṛṣṇamandiramakṣaram || 1.370.180|| svadūtānpāśahastām̐śca gacchatastān vadāmyaham | yāsyatheti tu sarvatra haribhaktāśramaṃ vinā || 181 || harerbhaktāṃścitraguptaḥ puṣpāṃjaliṃ karoti hi | madhuparkādikaṃ brahmā teṣāṃ tu kurute sadā || 182|| mama lokaṃ satyalokaṃ vilaṃghya gacchatāṃ satām | sparśamātreṇa pāpāni naśyanti yāmyadehinām || 183|| pāvanāste bhāgavatāḥ pañcabhūtatanuṃ vinā | sūkṣmeṇaiva śarīreṇa prayānti cordhvaveginaḥ || 184|| brahmadhāmasamīpe tu snātvā brahmahṛde ca te | sūkṣmaṃ vimucya māyāyāṃ brāhmyā tanvā tu dhāmani ||185|| ātmātmikayā modante bahuśaktindriyendrakāḥ | yamalokaṃ gatā ye tu karmaphalāya dehinaḥ || 186|| bibhrati sūkṣmadehaṃ te nāśo yasya na jāyate | sa deho na bhaved bhasma jvaladagnau yamālaye || 187|| jale naṣṭobhavennaiva prahāre nāpi naśyati | śastre śāstre kaṇṭake ca śūle taptadrave tathā || 188|| tapte lohe ca pāṣāṇe pratikṛtau na naśyati | karmaphalaṃ tathā bhuṃkte sukhamātrā na vidyate || 189|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhāmni duḥkhamātrā na vidyate | tameva bhaja sāvitri gaccha kāntena mandiram || 1.370.190|| ityuktvā sā yamenāpi na yayau mandiraṃ svakam | satyavantaṃ sūkṣmadehaṃ svāyattīkṛtya sve hṛdi ||191 || jijñāsamānā papraccha kuṇḍamānādikaṃ tadā | śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayiṣye yamena yattu bhāṣitam || 192||| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye sāvitrīkṛtayamāṣṭakastotraṃ, ṣaḍaśītinirayakuṇḍāni, yathākarma tatpātaḥ, brahmahatyāgohatyāprakhyapāpāni, bhaktānāṃ yamaparābhavo cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||370 ||
<1.371> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi priye patni lokānāmupakārakam | yamaproktaṃ ca sāvitryai kuṇḍamānādikaṃ tu yat || 1 || pūrṇendumaṇḍalākāraṃ kuṇḍaṃ pratyekameva vai | gabhīraṃ nimnamatyugrakaṣṭadaṃ na tu naśvaram || 2 || tatrāgnikuṇḍakāyāmaḥ śatahastamito’sti vai | koṭiśastvagnikuṇḍānāṃ vartulāni bhavanti hi || 3 || pratyekakuṇḍabāhulyaṃ bodhyaṃ pāpibahutvataḥ | taptodakaprakuṇḍaṃ tu krośārdhamānameva ca || 4 || taptakṣārodakakuṇḍaṃ krośamātraṃ prakīrtitam | taptamūtradravakuṇḍaṃ gavyūtimānameva ha || 5 || śleṣmakuṇḍaṃ krośamitaṃ krośārdhaṃ garakuṇḍakam | netramalaprakuṇḍaṃ ca krośārdhaṃ kīṭapūritam || 6 || vasākuṇḍaṃ krośaturyaṃ śukrakuṇḍaṃ tathā matam | durgandhiraktakuṇḍaṃ ca vāpītulyaṃ dhanuḥśatam || 7 || netrāśrukuṇḍaṃ vāpyardhaṃ malakuṇḍaṃ tathaiva hi | karṇaviṭkuṇḍakaṃ vāpīturyapramāṇameva ca || 8 || majjākuṇḍaṃ vāpīturyaṃ māṃsakuṇḍaṃ dhanuḥśatam | nakhakuṇḍaṃ lomakuṇḍaṃ cāsthikuṇḍaṃ ca dantakam || 9 || pratyekaṃ vāpikāturyamānaṃ cātibhayānakam | tāmrakuṇḍaṃ taptatāmrapratimākoṭirājitam || 1.371.10 || gavyūtimānakaṃ taptalohakuṇḍaṃ tathāyatam | gharmakuṇḍaṃ surākuṇḍaṃ vāpyardhaṃ lohakuṇḍakam || 11 || adhaḥ śālmalivṛkṣasya tīkṣṇakaṇṭakakuṇḍakam | lakṣapauruṣanimna ca krośamānaṃ ca vartulam || 1 2|| dhanurmānāḥ kaṇṭakāśca bhittiṣu paritaḥ sthitāḥ | viṣakuṃḍaṃ krośamānaṃ śastrakuṇḍaṃ tathāyatam || 1 3|| prataptatailakuṇḍaṃ ca dvigavyūtipramāṇakam | śastratalpaprakuṇḍaṃ ca krośaturyapramāṇakam || 14|| krośārdhaṃ pūyakuṇḍaṃ ca dantakuṇḍaṃ tathāyatam | dvigavyūtipramāṇaṃ ca himatoyaprakuṇḍakam || 15|| makṣikādaṃśakuṇḍe ca krośārdhaṃ sammataṃ tathā | vajravṛścikakuṇḍee ca vāpyardhe samatāyate || 16 || śarakuṇḍaṃ ca vāpyarthaṃ nakrakuṇḍaṃ tathāyatam | kākakuṇḍaṃ dhanurlakṣaṃ gṛdhrakuṇḍa tathāyatam || 17|| vājakuṇḍaṃ tathā dīrghaṃ vajrakuṇḍaṃ dhanuḥśatam | taptapāṣāṇakuṇḍaṃ ca vāpīdviguṇakāyatam || 18|| lālākuṇḍaṃ krośamānaṃ taptatoyaṃ dhanuḥśatam | cūrṇakuṇḍaṃ krośamānaṃ krośaturyaṃ tu cakrakam || 1 9|| kulālacakravadghūrṇyamānaṃ ṣoḍaśadhārakam | jvālākuṇḍaṃ kacchapādikuṇḍaṃ ca krośamānakam ||1.371.2 0|| krośamānaṃ taptabhasmakuṇḍaṃ dhvāntaṃ ca krośakam | dagdhakuṇḍaṃ krośamātraṃ taptakṣāraṃ tathāyatam ||21 || taptatoyaprakuṇḍaṃ dvigavyūtimānameva ca | uttaptasūrmikuṇḍaṃ ca hyasipatravanaṃ tathā ||22|| krośārdhamānameveti raktakuṇḍaṃ tathāyatam | kṣurāstrakuṇḍakaṃ dhanuḥśatamānaṃ bhayaṃkaram ||23 || sūcikuṇḍaṃ tu pañcāśaddhanurmānaṃ vibhedakam | godhākuṇḍaṃ kuparūpaṃ dhanurviṃśatimānakam || 24|| kuṇḍaṃ naramukhākāraṃ dhanuḥṣoḍaśamānakam | gajakuṇḍaṃ gajadantairghātakaṃ vai dhanuśśatam ||25|| dhanustriṃśatpramāṇaṃ ca smṛtaṃ gomukhakuṇḍakam | kālacakraṃ bhramikuṇḍaṃ dvigavyūtipramāṇakam || 26 || lakṣamānavakuṇḍaṃ ca tailalohopalānvitam | taptaṃ ca vahninā caturgavyūtimānakaṃ hi tat ||27|| yāvantaḥ pāpinaḥ santi sarvakuṇḍeṣu sundari | caturguṇāstataḥ kuṃbhīpāke santi mahattame ||28 || sarvakuṇḍapradhānaṃ tu kuṃbhīpākaṃ prakīrtitam | kālasūtraṃ taptatoyaṃ kuṇḍaṃ kodaṇḍaviṃśatim ||29|| dhanuśśatamavaṭodaṃ vyādhirogaprapūritam | taptapāṃsuprakuṇḍaṃ ca dhanuḥśataṃ pradāhakam ||1.371.3 0 || krośārtanādakuṇḍaṃ ca dhanurviṃśatimānakam | śūlakuṇḍaṃ tathāmānaṃ krośārdhaṃ himatoyakam ||3 1 || dhanurviṃśatimānaṃ tu colkākuṇḍaṃ prakīrtitam | andhakāraprakuṇḍaṃ ca dhanuśśataṃ mahattaram ||32|| dhanurviṃśatimānaṃ tu vedhanaṃ śastrakuṇḍakam | dhanuḥṣoḍaśamānaṃ tu daṇḍatāḍanakuṇḍakam ||3 3 || dhanustriṃśatpramāṇaṃ ca jālakuṇḍaṃ prakīrtitam | lauhavedicūrṇakuṇḍaṃ koṭimānavamānakam ||34|| mūrchākuṇḍaṃ dhvāntayuktaṃ dhanurviṃśatimānakam | dhanuḥṣoḍaśamānaṃ ca dalanaṃ kuṇḍamucyate ||35|| taptavālukikākuṇḍaṃ dhanustriṃśatpramāṇakam | carmakaṣāyakuṇḍaṃ ca durgandhaṃ vai dhanuḥśatam ||36 || śūrpākāramukhaṃ kuṇḍaṃ dhanurdvādaśamānakam | agniśikhaṃ tathā kuṇḍaṃ dhanurviṃśatimānakam ||37|| jvālāmukhaṃ jihmakuṇḍaṃ vāpyardhaṃ parikīrtitam | dhūmrakuṇḍaṃ dhanuḥśataṃ viṣadhūmrādisaṃbhṛtam ||38|| dhanuśśataṃ nāgapūrṇaṃ nāgaveṣṭanakuṇḍakam | ṣaḍaśītiśca kuṇḍāni tānyuktāni mayā sati ||39|| sāvitri vad cānyadvai yadi śrotuṃ samicchasi | sāvitrī tu tadā prāha santuṣṭā dehidurlabhām ||1.371.40|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktiṃ bhāgavatavṛṣātmikām | tattvajñānavihīnā ca strījātirvidhinā kṛtā ||41 || kiṃ tajjñānaṃ mayā grāhyaṃ sārabhūtaṃ vadātra me | sarvadānaṃ hyanaśanaṃ tīrthasnānaṃ vrataṃ tapaḥ |||42|| ajñāne jñānadānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm | pituḥ śataguṇā mātā mātuḥ śataguṇo guruḥ | |43 | | iti śrutvā yamaḥ prāha bhaktiste cāstu keśave | śeṣaḥ sahasravaktraiśca nahi yāṃ vaktumīśvaraḥ ||44|| śaṃbhuḥ pañcamukhaiścāpi brahmā caturmukhaistathā | kārtikaḥ ṣaṇmukhaiścāpi nahi yāṃ vaktumīśvarāḥ ||45|| sarasvatī gaṇeśaśca sanatkumāra ityapi | dharmaḥ sanakaḥ sanandaḥ kapilaśca sanātanaḥ ||46|| sūryaḥ patnīvrataścāpi nārado brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ | na yāṃ vaktuṃ kṣamāḥ siddhā munīndrā yoginastathā ||47|| ke vānye ca vayaṃ ke ca bhagavadbhaktivarṇane | kaścit kiñcid vijānāti bhagavadguṇakīrtanam ||48|| tataḥ kiñcid vijānāti brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | tataḥ kiñcidvijānāti gaṇeśo jñānināṃ guruḥ ||49|| sarvātiriktaṃ jānāti sarvajñaḥ śaṃbhureva tu | tato’pyadhikaṃ jānāti lakṣmīreva na saṃśayaḥ ||1.371.50|| rādhā prabhā māṇikī ca pārvatī ca jayādayaḥ | jānantyeva parāṃ bhaktiṃ muktā jānantyasīmataḥ ||51 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇenaiva puruṣottamarūpiṇā | śrīkṛṣṇe svasvarūpe ca jñānaṃ sarvaṃ surakṣitam ||52|| dattaṃ tu śaṃbhave jñānaṃ kṛṣṇena paramātmanā | atīva nirjane ramye goloke rāsamaṇḍale ||53|| dharmāya kathayāmāsa śivaloke śivaḥ svayam | dharmastatkathayāmāsa puṣkare bhāskarāya ca ||54|| sūryo māṃ kathayāmāsa kṛṣṇabhaktyādikīrtanam | pūrṇaṃ sopi na jānāti tadanyasya tu kā kathā |||55|| sarvāntarātmā bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | sarvasākṣī sarvarūpī sarvakāraṇakāraṇam |||56|| rūpaṃ vidhatte yugalaṃ bhaktānugrahahetave | kamanīyaṃ sundaraṃ ca kiśoraṃ ghanarūpakam ||57|| koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ śṛṃgārarasasaṃbhṛtam | padmapatraprabhānetraṃ pārvaṇendusamānanam ||58 || bhūṣāratnadharaṃ pītāmbaraṃ rādhādisevitam | rāsamadhye ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ vaṃśikādharam ||59|| vanamālākaustubhādiśobhitaṃ sasmitaṃ varam | kuṃkumāgurukastūrīcandanādisamarcitam ||1.371.60 || cārucampakamālābjamālatīmālyamaṇḍitam | caṃcatsūkṣmātitejasvicūḍāvaktrimarājitam ||6 1 || brahmaviṣṇuśivā aniruddhapradyumnakarṣaṇāḥ | sṛṣṭiṃ puṣṭiṃ saṃhṛtiṃ ca prakurvanti yadājñayā ||62|| yatprasādād vāti vātastapataḥ sūryacandrakau | varṣatīndro mahākālaḥ karoti kavalaṃ tathā ||63|| vahniruṣṇo jalaṃ śītaṃ yatkṛtaṃ sarvameva tat | diśo rakṣanti dikpālā grahā bhramanti yadbhayāt ||64|| vṛkṣāḥ phalanti puṣpyanti ṛtavaḥ kramagrāminaḥ | sthale jale tathākāśe jīvanti jantavastathā ||65|| yadājñayā yamo nyāyapradātā dharmado vṛṣaḥ | jvaladagnau patataśca gabhīre ca jalārṇave ||66|| vṛkṣāgre tīkṣṇakhaḍgāgre sarpādīnāṃ mukheṣu ca | nānāśastrāstrasaṃgrāme raṇeṣu viṣameṣu ca ||67|| yatprasādādbhavedrakṣā yatkopānnāśanaṃ tathā | dhatte vāyuranalāgnimanalo vārisāgarān ||68|| vāri kūrmaṃ mahākūrmo’nantaṃ sarpaṃ sa medinīm | sā samudrānparvatām̐śca yatkṛpayā sa gīyatām ||69|| indrāyuścāpi divyānāṃ yugānāmekasaptatiḥ | aṣṭāviṃśacchakrapāte brahmaṇaḥ syādaharniśam ||1.371.70|| evaṃ triṃśadrātridinairmāso dvābhyāmṛtustathā | ṛtubhiḥ ṣaḍbhirevābdaṃ śatābdaṃ brahmaṇo vayaḥ ||71|| brahmaṇastu nipāte vai vairājasya dinaṃ bhavet | vairājaśatavarṣāṇi mahāviṣṇordinaṃ bhavet ||72|| mahāviṣṇoḥ śatavarṣaṃ dinaṃ prādhānapauruṣam | tasya varṣaśataṃ syāttu dinaṃ prākṛtapauruṣam ||73|| tasya varṣaśate cakṣuḥpakṣmonmelo harerbhavet | so’yaṃ hariḥ svayaṃ śrīśaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||74|| viṣṇurbrahmā haraḥ sarve kṛṣṇātmakā na saṃśayaḥ | cakṣurnimīlane tasya layaḥ prākṛtiko bhavet ||75|| prākṛtākṛtayaḥ kṛṣṇe līyante nābhipaṃkaje | viṣṇuḥ kṣīrodaśāyī ca vaikuṇṭhe yaścaturbhujaḥ ||76|| līyante vāmapārśve te kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ | śivo jñāne harerlīno durgā buddhau layaṃ vrajet ||77|| skando līno vakṣasi śrīkṛṣṇabāhau gaṇeśvaraḥ | padmā rādhā ca gopyaśca kṛṣṇaprāṇe layaṃ gatāḥ ||78|| sāvitrī tu sarasvatyāṃ sā jivhāyāṃ parātmanaḥ | kṛṣṇalomasu gopāśca prāṇeṣu pavanādayaḥ ||79|| hutāśano jaṭharāgnau jalaṃ tadrasanāgrake | vaiṣṇavāścaraṇāmbhoje bhaktidharmau hṛdantare ||1.371.80|| īśvarā yasya vai mūrteraiśvaryāṇi bhavanti hi | yasyaiva lomakūpeṣu viśvāni nikhilānyapi ||8 1 || yasya cakṣurnimeṣeṇa bhāvakāryalayo bhavet | cakṣurunmīlane sṛṣṭiryasyaiva paramātmanaḥ ||82|| evaṃ sṛṣṭilayānāṃ tu saṃkhyā nāstyeva suvrate | tadgaṇotkīrtanaṃ vaktuṃ brahmāṇḍeṣu tu kaḥ kṣamaḥ ||83 || pradhānā tu harerbhaktirmukterapi garīyasī | kartavyā sā layapāraṃ gantumicchasi cet sute ||84|| sālokyadā harerekā cānyā sārūpyadā hareḥ | sāmīpyadā tato’nyā ca sārṣṭidā ca tato’parā ||85|| ekatvaprāpikā tvanyā bhaktā vātrcchanti naiva tāḥ | sevanaṃ tu parityajya vāñcchanīyaṃ na vai kvacit ||86 || muktistu sevārahitā bhaktiḥ sevāvivardhinī | bhaktiyuktyorayaṃ bhedo bhaktiḥ kāryā tataḥ sadā ||87|| śarīreṇendriyaiḥ sarvairantaḥkaraṇaiḥ sarvathā | kriyā buddhyarpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe hi mokṣakṛt ||88|| nāryā puṃsā samarpyaiva kāryā sevā hareḥ sadā | snehena sarvathā devi jñānaṃ sārataraṃ tvidam ||89|| gaccha sāvitri patinā sākaṃ ca sukhinī bhava | ityuktvā sūryaputraśca hyarpayitvā ca tatpatim ||1.371.90|| tasyai śubhāśiṣaṃ datvā gamanaṃ kartumudyataḥ | dṛṣṭvā yamaṃ tu gacchantaṃ sāvitrī taṃ praṇamya ca ||91 || āvile cakṣuṣī kṛtvā dhṛtvā śiraḥ supādayoḥ | viyogaśokaṃ prāptābhūt sadvicchedo hi duḥkhakṛt ||92|| kṛpālustu yamaḥ prāha mā śokaṃ kuru bhāmini | lakṣavarṣaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā puṇyakṣetre ca sarvathā ||93 || naranārāyaṇakhaṇḍe golokaṃ yāsyasi dhruvam | gatvā gṛhaṃ vrataṃ bhadre sāvitryāstvaṃ tathā kuru ||94|| dvisaptavarṣaparyantaṃ nārīṇāṃ mokṣadaṃ hi tat | jyeṣṭhe śuklacaturdaśyāṃ sāvitryā hi vrataṃ kuru ||95|| śuklāṣṭamyāṃ bhādrapade mahālakṣmyā vrataṃ kuru | dvyaṣṭavarṣavrataṃ cedaṃ pratyabdaṃ pakṣameva hi ||96 || kārtikakṛṣṇakāṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇavratam | kuru bhaktyā parayā tvaṃ yāsyasyante hareḥ padam |||97|| pratimaṃgalavāre ca devīṃ maṃgalacaṇḍikām | pratimāsaṃ śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ maṃgaladāyinīm ||98|| rādhāṃ cāṣāḍhasaṃkrāntyāṃ pūrṇāyāṃ kārtike’pi tām | pratimāsaṃ sitāṣṭamyāṃ durgāṃ durgātināśinīm |||95|| yā nārī pūjayed bhaktyā kaṃbharāṃ sukhadāṃ satīm | śuklāṣṭamyāṃ tathā prītyā sā yāti paramāṃ gatim || 1.371.100 || dhanasantānalabdhyarthaṃ patiputravatīṃ satīm | pativratāsu śuddhāsu yantreṣu pratimāsu ca || 101 || pūjayamānā sukhinī bhūtvānte’kṣaramāpnuyāt | ityuktvā tāṃ satīṃ natvā yamarājo yayau gṛham || 1 02|| gṛhītvā svāminaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sāvitrī svālaye yayau | satyavānutthito drāgvai jīvito’bhūt suṣuptitaḥ || 103 || ānandaḥ sarvathā tatra samabhūt| pattane gṛhe | sāvitrī satyavantaṃ ca vṛttāntaṃ tu yathākramam || 1 04|| anyām̐śca kathayāmāsa śrutvāścarya yayuśca te | sāvitrījanakaḥ putraśataṃ prāpa yathākramam || 1 056|| śvaśuraścākṣuṣī rājyaṃ prāpadāridrathanāśakam | sā ca satyavataḥ putraśataṃ prāpa krameṇa ca || 106 || evaṃ lakṣmi pātivratyaprabhāveṇa satīvarā | mṛtyuparājayaṃ cakre pratyuta prāpa sampadam || 1 07|| pātivratyaṃ pālitaṃ cet kāmadhenusamaṃ hi tat | kalpavṛkṣasamaṃ cāpi cintāmaṇyadhikaṃ tathā || 1 08|| yogināṃ yogasampatteḥ pātivratyaṃ viśiṣyate | na caurahāryaṃ na kleśyaṃ na viyojanadharmakam || 1 09|| sadātmani dṛḍhe dharme sthitaṃ nigūḍhameva tat | sā tu bhuktvā sukhaṃ lakṣavarṣaṃ bhūmau mahāsatī || 1.371.11 0|| jagāma svāminā sārdhaṃ golokaṃ divyarūpiṇī | vaihāyasā vimānena yayau devaiḥ suvanditā || 111 || dvitīyena svarūpeṇa savituścādhidevikā | vedānāṃ cāpi sāvitrī mantrādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā || 1 12|| saiva jātānantarūpā puruṣottamabhaktitaḥ | iti te kathita lakṣmi sāvitryākhyānamuttamam || 11 3|| yā cedaṃ śṛṇuyānnārī satītvaṃ tvāpnuyād dhruvam | pātivratyaṃ vinā tvanyaṃ dharmaṃ mukhyaṃ na vai caret || 1 14|| sarvaṃ patipratimāyāṃ muktirbhaktiśca vidyate | sarvāśca siddhayaḥ patyurbhaktau tiṣṭhanti dāsikāḥ || 1 15|| aiśvaryāṇi samagrāṇi dhanadhānyāmbarāṇi ca | svarṇaraupyamaṇiratnābharaṇāni ca sarvathā || 1 16|| patyuḥ pādajale santi patyaṃguṣṭhe
