tataḥ putrīḥ svasvapatiṃ prati dhruvam | stavanaṃ cedṛśaṃ kāryaṃ sarvepsitapradaṃ tu vaḥ ||77|| tataḥ stotramidaṃ puṇyaṃ sṛṣṭyādau padmayā kṛtam | sarasvatyā ca dharayā gaṃgayā ramayā kṛtam ||78|| sāvitryātha ca pārvatyā munipatnībhirityapi | gītaṃ svasvapatiṃ prāpya sarvasāmarthyadaṃ tataḥ ||79|| pativratānāṃ sarvāsāṃ stotrametacchubhāvaham | prasādarūpaṃ caitadvai kaṃbharayā kṛte yuge ||1.377.80|| mahālakṣmyā tathā gītaṃ prabhayā jayayā tathā | māṇikyayā lalitayā mohinyā kīrtitaṃ purā ||81 || naro nārīṃ śṛṇuyāccellabhate sarvavāñcchitam | aputrā labhate putraṃ nirdhanā labhate dhanam ||82|| rogiṇī rogamuktā syāt patihīnā patiṃ labhet | pativratā patiṃ stutvā tīrthasnānaphalaṃ labhet ||83|| phalaṃ ca sarvatapasāṃ vratānāṃ ca phalaṃ labhet | svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca labhate patisantoṣaṇāt satī ||84|| yasya mātā gṛhe nāsti nāsti bhāryā pativratā | araṇyo tena gantavyaṃ narakānmuktireva sā ||85|| patiṃ dveṣṭi sadā duṣṭā viṣatulyaṃ ca paśyati | dadāti tasmai nāhāraṃ bhartsanaṃ kurute sadā ||86|| pūjanīyaṃ munitulyaṃ pāpīyasī tu māninī | satataṃ tṛṇavanmatvā nyakkāraṃ kurute patim ||87|| durvākyavahninā dagdho mṛtatulyastu jīvati | yāvajjīvanaparyantaṃ saṃprāpya kulaṭāṃ striyam ||88|| tādṛśī na gṛhiṇyuktā nirayā kathitā tu sā | gṛhiṇī tu patibhaktā devadaivatapūjitā ||89|| sā śuddhā prātarutthāya namaskṛtya patiṃ surān | prāṃgaṇe maṃgalaṃ dadyād gomayena jalena ca ||1.377.90 || gṛhakṛtye ca nirvartya snātvāgatya gṛhaṃ satī | suraṃ guruṃ patiṃ natvā pūjayed gṛhadevatām ||91 | | patiṃ saṃbhojayitvā sātithiṃ satkṛtya bhāvataḥ | putrapautrādisahitā svayaṃ bhuṃkte sukhaṃ satī |||92|| gurau pitari patyau ca mātari śvaśure’pi ca | śvaśrvā kuryānnarabuddhiṃ na kadāpi pativratā ||93|| pitā mātā gururbhāryā śiṣyaḥ putraḥ sadāśritaḥ | anāthā bhaginī kanyā śvaśrūḥ śvaśura ityapi ||94|| patistadbhrātaraścaite sevyāḥ patyājñayā sadā | strījātirvāstavī śuddhā tāśca sarvāḥ pativratāḥ ||95|| sarvā jātistvekarūpā tvādau sṛṣṭā svayaṃbhuvā | tāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛteraṃśāḥ pavitrāḥ sukhadāḥ sadā ||96|| uttamā patibhaktā sā patidharmasamanvitā | madhyamā patibhaktā sā svārthasaṃsādhikāpi yā ||97|| kaniṣṭhā patibhaktāpi patnī bhaktaṃ patiṃ śritā | tadanyā tu kāmamātraparā pare’pi saṃgatā ||98|| tisrastatra tu dharmāya caturthī dharmahānaye | boddhavyā dehinā śaśvajjñātvā yogyāṃ samudvahet ||99|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi yad rādhoktaṃ sutāḥ prati | tāśca dharmānpātivratyaparān śrutvā mudaṃ yayuḥ || 1.377.100 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye goloke rādhikayā svaputrībhyaḥ kathitapativratācāradharmapālanamāhātmyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ |||377||
<1.378> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ cānyāṃ gṛhagodhāprakīrtitām | pātivratyasya dharmasya puṣṭidāṃ prākpravartitām || 1 || rukmāṃgado’bhavad rājā raivatādrau vihāravān | aśvārūḍhaḥ paśyati sma gireḥ śobhāmanuttamām || || nikhanan svakhureṇorvīmaśvo yāti sthalīṃ sthalīm | tasya dārayataḥ pṛthvīṃ sutīkṣṇena khureṇa hi || 3 || bhūbhāgāntargatā kācid bhūmigodhā prakartitā | vidīryamāṇāṃ nṛpatirapaśyatsa dayāparaḥ || 4 || śītalena jalenābhyaṣiṃcattā sa vimūrchitām | avāpa cetanāṃ lakṣmi śītavāriprasecanāt || 5 || rājānamagrato vīkṣya godhā vacanamabravīt | rusmāṃgada mahābāho nibodha mama ceṣṭitam || 6 || śākale nagare pūrvaṃ bhāryāhaṃ tvagrajanmanaḥ | rūpayauvanasampannāpyāsaṃ na tasya supriyā || 7 || sadā vidveṣasaṃyukto mayi niṣṭhurajalpakaḥ | tato’haṃ krodhasaṃyuktā vaśīkaraṇamantrakam || 8 || sarvavaśyakaraṃ prāptuṃ gatā kācittu tāpasīm | tatrāhaṃ praṇatā bhūtvā padbhyāṃ nyasyāṃgulīyakam || 9 || nivedya mama bhartustu vimānanaṃ sthirābhavam | tayoktāhaṃ tadā rājan prayogārthaṃ samantrakam || 1.378.1 0|| cūrṇo rakṣānvito hyeṣaḥ sarvabhūtavaśaṃkaraḥ | tvayā bhartari saṃyojyo dugdhapāne ca mastake || 11 || bhaviṣyati patirvaśyo dveṣaṃ naiva kariṣyati | cūrṇarakṣāṃ gṛhītvāhaṃ prāptā bhartāramekalā || 12|| pradoṣe śirasi bhartū rakṣācūrṇaṃ prayojitam | pāne tu payasā sārdhaṃ pradoṣe tatra cārpitam || 1 3|| yadā sa pītacūrṇastu bhartā tadrātritaḥ khalu | drāgeva kṣayarogyeva jātaḥ kṣīṇo dine dine || 14|| hatatejā mama bhartā māmuvācātinirbalaḥ | śokaṃ kurvan divārātrau dāso’smi tava śobhane || 15|| trāhi māṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptaṃ maraṇaṃ nikaṭe mama | śrutvāhaṃ tāpasīṃ yātā niveditavatī punaḥ || 16|| bhartā me vaśago jātaḥ kathaṃ jīved bhavet sukhī | tayauṣadhaṃ punardattaṃ svastho’bhūttena me patiḥ || 17|| pūrvacūrṇādbhavo dāhaḥ śāntastenauṣadhena vai | tataḥ prabhṛti me bhartā vaśyo’bhūd vacane sthitaḥ || 18|| kālenāhaṃ mṛtā rājan gatā narakayātanām | tāmrabhrāṣṭre tvahaṃ dagdhā kṛtvā khaṇḍāni vai muhuḥ || 1 9|| yugakālottaraṃ jātā pṛthivyāṃ pāpajātikā | bhūmigodhā sthitā cātra gṛhagodhābhijātikā ||1.378.20|| varṣasahasraṃ tasmādyā nārī patiṃ vaśaṃ caret | vṛthādharmā vṛthācārā dahyate tāmrabhrāṣṭrake ||2 1 || bhartā nātho gatirbhartā daivataṃ gurureva ca | tasya vaśyaṃ cared yā tu sā kathaṃ sukhamāpnuyāt ||22|| tiryagyoniśataṃ yāti kṛmikuṣṭhasamanvitā | tasmād bhūpāla kartavyaṃ strībhirbhartṛvacaḥ sadā ||23|| pātivratyaṃ paro dharmastārako yoṣitāṃ śubhaḥ | sāpatnyaṃ cāpi yadvairaṃ bhartari naiva yojayet ||24|| iṣṭā yā bhūpate bhartustasyā yā duṣṭamācaret | sā patnī narakaṃ yāti yāvad vai brahmaṇo dinam ||25 || sāpatnabhāvaṃ yā kuryād bhartṛsneheṣṭayā saha | tatphalaṃ prāpyate yāmye tāpanaṃ tāmrabhrāṣṭrake ||26 || yathā sukhaṃ bhaved bhartustathā kāryaṃ hi bhāryayā | anukūlaṃ hitaṃ tasyā iṣṭāyā bharturācaret ||27|| patiṃ yathā tathā tāṃ ca saṃpaśyed vai pativratā | hīnāyāścāpi śuśrūṣāṃ kṛtvā yāti triviṣṭapam || 28|| sarvān bhogānavāpnoti bharturiṣṭaṃ karoti yā | īrṣyābhāvaparityāgāt sarveśvarapadaṃ labhet ||29 || sapalī yā sapatnyāstu śuśrūṣāṃ kurute sadā | bharturiṣṭāṃ sannirīkṣya tasyā loko’kṣayo bhavet ||1.378.3 0|| śṛṇu rājanmayā dṛṣṭā patisevāparāyaṇā | gaṇikā padminīnāmnī tatkathāṃ kathayāmi te ||3 1 || pūrve mama gṛhapārśve śūdro’bhūd bhāryayā yutaḥ | nāmnā bhāluka ityasya patnī nāmnā tu māṭulī || 32|| rūpayauvanasampannā pātivratyaparāyaṇā | bhālukasyābhavat tviṣṭā śūdrā gaṇikā piṅgalī ||33 || śūdrajāteḥ suduṣṭasya parityaktakriyasya ca | ācarad veśyayā sārdhaṃ sevāṃ pativratā satī ||34|| prakṣālanaṃ dvayoḥ pādānāmucchiṣṭāśanā dvayoḥ | ubhayorapyadhaḥ śete tūbhayorvai hite ratā ||35 || veśyayā vāryamāṇāpi sadācārapathe sthitā | evaṃ śuśrūyantyāstu bhartāraṃ veśyayā saha ||36 || jagāma su mahān kālaḥ sthitāyāḥ patisevane | athaikadā tu tadbhartā māhiṣaṃ mūlakānvitam ||37|| abhakṣayattu niṣpāvaṃ durmedhāstailamiśritam | tadapathyabhujastasya cāvamanya pativratām ||38||| abhavad dāruṇo rogo gude tasya bhagaṃdaraḥ || sandahyamāno’titarāṃ divārātrau sa bhūriśaḥ ||39|| atha veśyā tasya vittaṃ samādāya jagāma vai | anyasmai sā dadau prītyā yūne kāmaparāyaṇā ||1.378.40|| tataḥ śūdro dīnamanā vrīḍayāti pradharṣitaḥ | uvāca prarudan bhāryāṃ paripālaya māṃ priye ||41 || na mayopakṛtaṃ kiṃcit tava sundari pāpinā | veśyāsaktena duṣṭena bahūnabdān pativrate ||42|| yo bhāryāṃ praṇatāṃ pāpo nānumanyeta garvitaḥ | so’śubhāni samāpnoti janmāni daśa paṃca ca |||43 || divākīrtigṛhe tasmājjanma prāpsyāmi garhitam | tavāpamānato patni patisevāparāyaṇe ||44|| iti bhartṛvacaḥ śrutvā bhāryā bhartāramabravīt | purākṛtāni pāpāni duḥkhāni prabhavanti hi| ||45|| tāni saṃkṣamate vidvān kṣamayānto bhaviṣyati | evamuktvā samāśvasya bhartāramanuśiṣya ca ||46 || ānītavatī janakād vittaṃ karoti sevanam | nārāyaṇasvarūpaṃ taṃ manyate sma satī patim ||47|| divā divā triryatnena bhagandaraviśodhanam | karoti sevanaṃ tasya pavanaṃ ca dadātyapi | |48|| na sā rātrau svapityapi na divā ca pativratā || bhartṛduḥkhena santaptā tvapaśyajjvalitaṃ jagat ||49|| yadyasti vasudhā devī pitaro devatāstathā | kurvantu rogahīnaṃ me bhartāraṃ gatakalmaṣam ||1.378.50|| caṇḍikāyai pradāsyāmi śrīphalaṃ māhiṣaṃ tathā | navarātravrataṃ cāpi bharturārogyahetave ||5 1 || sādaraṃ tu kariṣyāmi hyupavāsān daśaiva ca | śarīraṃ sthāpayiṣye’haṃ sūkṣmakaṇṭakasaṃstare | |52|| nopabhokṣyāmi madhuraṃ nopabhokṣyāmi vai ghṛtam | bāhyābhyaṃgavihīnāhaṃ saṃsthāsye bahuvāsarān ||53|| jīvatāṃ rogahīno hi bhartā me śaradāṃ śatam | evaṃ niścayayuktā sā kṛṣṇabuddhyā prasevate ||54|| patistasyāḥ pātivatyapratāpenāpi sarvathā | rogahīnastu saṃjātaḥ sukhado yoṣite’nvaham ||55|| bahukāle gate paścād tridoṣajvarapīḍitaḥ | vyajāyata kadācittu kālagatyāntikāntakaḥ ||56 || trikaṭuṃ pradadau bhartre yatnena mahatāpi sā | śītārtaḥ kampamāno’sau patnyaṃgulimakhaṇḍayat |||57|| ubhayordantayoḥ śleṣaḥ sudṛḍhaḥ samapadyata | agulyāḥ khaṇḍamāsye’sya sthitamevāpi sundarī |||58||| siṣeve parayā prītyā prāṇām̐statyāja sopi vai | atha vikrīya valayaṃ krītvā kāṣṭhāni bhūriśaḥ ||19|| citāṃ sarpiyutāṃ cakre madhye dhṛtvā patiṃ tadā | avaruhya ca bāhubhyāṃ pādenākṛṣya pāvakam ||1.378.60|| mukhe mukhaṃ samādhāya hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ tathā | jaghane jaghanaṃ devī tvātmanaḥ sannidhāya ca ||61 | | dāhayāmāsa kalyāṇī bharturdehaṃ pativratā | ātmanā saha cārvaṃgī jvalite jātavedasi ||62|| vimucya dehaṃ sahasā jagāma svāminā saha | devalokaṃ śodhayitvā mahāpāpādisañcayān ||6 3 || itidṛṣṭaṃ mayā sākṣād rājan śūdrāṇikāvratam | svargadaṃ sukhadaṃ tasmād vidviṣenna patipriyām ||64|| svahastena priyāṃ bharturbhāryāṃ saṃbhojayet satī | sapatnīṃ tu sapatnī hi kiṃcidannaṃ dadāti yat ||65|| tadanantaṃ bhaved rājan phalaṃ cānantakaṃ bhavet | pativratā ca sā jñeyā yonisaṃrakṣaṇā sadā ||66|| nārīṇāṃ bhartṛśuśrūṣā putrāṇāṃ pitṛsevanam | śūdrāṇāṃ lokasevā ca lokarakṣā mahībhṛtām ||67|| pātivratyaṃ ca tatproktaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ svāminaścaret | yasyā duḥkhī bhaved bhartā bhāryāyā bahubhāryakaḥ ||68|| samṛddhāyāḥ sapāpāyāstasyāḥ proktā hyadhogatiḥ | sā yāti narakaṃ pāpā pūyākhyaṃ yugameva yat ||69|| tataśchunchundarī syācca saptajanmāni parvate | tataḥ kākī tataḥ śyālī godhā gotvena śuddhyati ||1.378.70|| bharturarthe tu yā vittaṃ vidyamānaṃ na yacchati | jīvitaṃ vā svadehaṃ vā viṣṭhāyāṃ sā bhavet kṛmiḥ ||71 || kṛmiyonirvinirmuktā kāṣṭhīlā jāyate tataḥ | kāṣṭhīlayā purā proktaṃ śrutaṃ mayā vadāmi te ||72|| mama kaumārabhāve tu madgrāme kāṣṭhapāṭakaḥ | cullikāyogyakāṣṭhāni ptaityaṃ pāṭayati gṛhe |||73|| tatra dṛṣṭā mayā muṇḍā kāṣṭhīlā dārunirgatā | navanītamṛdudehā kaniṣṭhāṃgulikāprabhā ||74|| mukhe tvañjanasadrūpā sthaulye tvaṃgulimānikā | tāṃ patitāṃ bhuvi dṛṣṭvā jagdhuṃ kākaḥ samāgataḥ ||75|| yāvat cañcvā pragṛhṇāti tāvanmayā tu kaṃkaraiḥ | loṣṭhakṣepaṇakaiścāpi sadyaḥ kāko nivāritaḥ ||76|| sā muktā sakṣatā tuṇḍatāḍitā na palāyitum | samarthā hyabhavad rājan vepamānātimūrchitā ||77|| siktā mayā jalenātha svāsthyaṃ jñānamupāgatā | tataḥ sā mānuṣīvācā pūrvaṃ janma jagāda mām ||78|| sumantunāmno hi muneḥ sarvajñasya sutābhavat | patnī cāsīd guṇayuktā kauṇḍinyasya sudarpitā ||79|| jananyā bandhuvargasya pituriṣṭatayā hyaham | pitrā dattaṃ yautakaṃ me śvaśureṇāpi cārpitam ||1.378.80|| ayutaṃ ca suvarṇānāmupavastubahūttamam | pitṛśvaśuravittābhyāṃ susamṛddhābhavaṃ tadā ||8 1 || gomahiṣyādisaṃyuktā dhanadhānyasamanvitā | iṣṭā śvaśurayoścāhaṃ sauśīlyena janasya ca ||82|| kālena pañcatāṃ prāptaḥ śvaśuro me’tidhārmikaḥ | mṛtaṃ taṃ patimādāya śvaśrūragniṃ viveśa sā ||83|| atha māsadvaye yāte bhartā me rājamandiram | yajñakāryaprasiddhyarthaṃ gato veśyāḥ dadarśa saḥ ||84|| rūpāḍhyā yauvanopetāstāsāṃ madhyāttu vai dvayam | veśyāratnaṃ samādāya rakṣayāmāsa vai gṛhe ||85|| tayorvittamaśeṣaṃ tu kṣayaṃ nītaṃ niṣevaṇāt | varṣatraye gate niḥsvo jātaḥ patirmamātha saḥ ||86|| prārthayāmāsa māṃ vittaṃ dehi me’ṅgavibhūṣaṇam | tanmayā nahi dattaṃ tu bhartre vyasanine tadā ||87|| kintu sarvaṃ samādāya gatāhaṃ pitṛmandiram | patinā gṛhavastvādi vikrītaṃ kṣayitaṃ ca tat ||88|| śvaśurasyāpi yaddravyaṃ yatra kvāpi sthitaṃ tvabhūt | sarvaṃ tat kṣayitaṃ tena kṣetrabhāṇḍaparicchadam ||89|| atha nāvaṃ samāruhya dravyārthaṃ kṛtamānasaḥ | gataḥ samudramārgeṇa dūraṃ yāvattadānilaiḥ ||1.378.90|| prabhaṃjanairvaśaṃ nītā naukā viśīrṇatā gatā | anye mṛtāḥ patirme tu daivāt kāṣṭhaṃ samāśritaḥ ||91 || vāyunā śubhapuṇyenāsasāda dvīpamalpakam | yatra sāmudraratnāni cābhavan koṭiśaḥ khalu ||92|| tattīraṃ sa muhūrtaṃ tu viśaśrāma kṣudhānvitaḥ | pakvavṛkṣaphalānyattvā pītvā jalaṃ sukhānvitaḥ ||93|| sālavṛkṣasya mūle sa rātrau suṣvāpa vai śramī | abhyagād rākṣaso ghoraḥ kanyāmādāya sundarīm ||94|| śubhāṃ kāśīpateḥ putrīṃ nāmnā ratnāvalīṃ satīm | jahāra rājasaudhāt tāṃ bhakṣyārthaṃ svīyayoṣitaḥ ||95|| rākṣasaḥ prāha patnīṃ ca madbhakṣya ṃtu guhāmukhe | nararūpaṃ samāste vai tamānaya ca mā ciram ||96|| ityuktā sā yayau guhādvāraṃ mama patiṃ prati | uvāca tu patiṃ me sā tvāṃ patiṃ kartumāgatā ||97|| śaktiṃ dadāmi te haste matpatiṃ hantumeva vai | yadi tvamanayā śaktyā na hiṃsasi rākṣasam ||98|| khādayiṣyati durmedhāstvāṃ ca māṃ ca na saṃśayaḥ | yā gatirbrahmahatyāyāṃ kutsitā prāpyate janaiḥ ||99 || tāṃ gatiṃ hi prapadye’haṃ vacmi cedanṛtaṃ yadi | ityuktvā brāhmaṇaṃ nītvā guhāyāṃ rākṣasaṃ prati || 1.378.100 | gatā sā prāha vipraṃ taṃ prakṣipasva suśaktikām | śratvā drāgeva tāṃ śaktiṃ mumoca rākṣasaṃ prati || 101 || kṛtvā bhasmāvaśeṣaṃ sā rākṣasaṃ gaganaṃ gatā | athovāca dvijaṃ hṛṣṭā bhogān bhuṃkṣvātra kānta me || 1 02|| kānto mayā hato naiva kintu pāpād viyojitaḥ | brāhmaṇaśca kṛtaḥ kānto brāhmaṇī ca bhavāmi vai || 1 03|| kanyātvadhvaṃsako mā syāt patiścaiva vināśitaḥ | yatra te’sti gṛhaṃ tatrāgacchāmi kanyayā saha ||1 04|| ityuktvā rākṣasī sarvaṃ saṃpragṛhya guhādhanam | kareṇurūpiṇī bhūtvā pṛṣṭhe kṛtvā patiṃ mama || 1 05|| yayāvākāśamārgeṇa kāśīrājagṛhaṃ prati | pṛṣṭhāt kareṇurūpiṇyāḥ sakanyo’vātarad dvijaḥ || 106 || kareṇuścābhavatkanyā mānuṣī dvijapatnikā | ratnāvalī yayau pitṛgṛhaṃ vṛttaṃ jagau tadā || 1 07|| talpasthā rakṣasā rātrau svapurasthā hṛtāpyaham | jīvamānākṣatā prāptā samāśvasihi matkṛte || 1 08|| aviplutāsmi ca pitaḥ rākṣasyā rakṣitānayā | brāhmaṇaḥ rakṣitaścāpi dehyasmai brāhmaṇāya mām || 1 09|| anenaikāsanā jātā sa me bhartā bhavedataḥ | sudyumnastāṃ dadau tasmai viprāya vidhinā tataḥ || 1.378.110 || kanyāṃ ca rākṣasīṃ patnīdvayamādāya vāḍavaḥ | mahodayapuraṃ prāyāt| kariṇīvāhanaḥ kṣaṇāt || 111 || bhartā pūrvaṃ parityakto yaḥ sa patnīdvayānvitaḥ | susamṛddhaḥ śrutaścādya tena cākāritāpyaham || 1 12|| bharturgṛhaṃ punaḥ prāptā tena mukhyaiva mānitā | sarvaṃ dhanaṃ tathā patnīdvayaṃ mahyaṃ samarpitam || 11 3|| ahaṃ vai svalpasamaye bhāgyahīnā mṛtābhavam | patyurdrohād yāmyakuṇḍānanubhūyāsmi vai tarau || 1 14|| kāṣṭhīlāṃ cātiduḥkhārtā jātā yāsyāmi pāśavīm | yoniṃ ca pakṣijanmāni punareva sahasraśaḥ || 1 15|| yā bharturnārpayedvittaṃ jīvitaṃ ca śubhānanā | sāpīdṛśīmavasthāṃ vai yāsyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 1 16|| evaṃ jñātvāniśaṃ rakṣetpatyurvittaṃ ca jīvitam | patirmātā pitā vittaṃ jīvitaṃ ca gururgatiḥ || 1 17|| patyau prasanne padmeśaḥ prasanno jāyate dhruvam | jīvitenāpi vittena bhartāraṃ vañcayettu yā || 1 18|| kṛmiyoniśataṃ gatvā pulkasī jāyate tu sā | surataṃ yācamānāya payevittaṃ māninī || 11 9|| yā na yacchati duṣṭā sā kāṣṭhīlā jāyate dhruvam | vittaṃ dehaṃ tathā putraṃ yaccānyadvā bhaveddhanam || 1.378.120|| nyakkāraṃ ca bhavet sarvaṃ strīṇāmekaṃ patiṃ vinā | tasyārthe vā tyajed vittaṃ jīvitaṃ ca samantataḥ || 121 || dhanaṃ tyajet tyajed dāsān dārān jīvaṃ gṛhaṃ tyajet | tyajeddeśaṃ tathā bhūpaṃ svargaṃ mitraṃ guruṃ tyajet || 1 22|| tyajettīrthaṃ tyajeddharmaṃ tyajedatyantasupriyam | tyajed yogaṃ tyajed dānaṃ yānaṃ puṇyakriyāṃ tyajet || 1 23|| tapastyajet tyajed vidyāṃ siddhiṃ mokṣaṃ tyajettathā | na tyajet svasvāmisevāṃ tatsarvebhyo’dhikāṃ satī || 1 24|| vedaiḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ bhartuḥ strīṇāṃ dharmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | yadbravīti patiḥ kiñcit tatkāryamaviśaṃkayā || 1 25|| śuklaṃ śuklamiti brūyāt śuklaṃ vai patisevanam | tadagre sarvameveti kṛṣṇaṃ pativratākṛte || 126 || kāṣṭhīlayā svakaṃ vṛttaṃ sarva me kathitaṃ tataḥ | mokṣārthaṃ prāha sā kaṣṭaṃ prāptā prāṇāntagāminī || 1 27|| dehi me puṇyamatraiva kare dhṛtvā jalaṃ svasaḥ | ekadinasya sevāyāḥ patyuḥ puṇyaṃ ca yadbhavet || 1 28|| tatpuṇyaṃ me pradehyatra yenāsmād vapuṣo mriye | prāpsye janmāntaraṃ cātha kariṣye bhartṛsevanam || 1 29|| svarga gamiṣye tatpaścānmokṣaṃ yāsye hi sevayā | ityuktāhaṃ dadau tasyai dinaikaṃ bhartṛsevayā || 1.378.13 0|| yallabdhaṃ vai mayā puṇyaṃ pūrvaṃ tenaiva sā mṛtā | sā ca labdhvā yathākarma januṃ kāle ca mānuṣī || 131 || bhūtvā yayau paraṃ śreyaḥ patisevāparāyaṇā | ahaṃ rājan bhūmigodhā moktumicchāmi varṣma yat || 13 2|| dehi rājam̐stava patnyā sandhyāvalyā kṛtaṃ tu yat| | ekasyāhnaḥ patisevājanyaṃ puṇyaṃ sukhapradam || 133|| patnīkṛte’pi puṇye vai patyurbhogo’sti sarvathā | tvayā dattaṃ tava patnyā dattameva bhaviṣyati || 1 34|| ityuktaḥ sa ca rukmāṃgadākhyaḥ puṇyaṃ dadau tadā | godhādehaṃ parityajya yayau śubhrāṃ gatiṃ tadā || 135|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi patisevanakarmaṇā | puṇyamuddhārakaṃ nāryā prāpyate mokṣaṇaṃ tathā || 136 || paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya patisevāphalaṃ bhavet | patidrohakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 137|| uddharetpāpinīṃ nārīṃ patisevaikavāsarā | kiṃ punarājīvanaṃ tu kṛtā kiṃ kiṃ na dāsyati || 1 38|| patirveśyāparo vāpi vyasanī vā vimārgagaḥ | patireva patirnāryā nānyaḥ pratinidhirbhavet || 1 39|| anyatra syātpratinidhiḥ pratinidhirna maithune | anyānyaṃgāni paśyanti mānavāścānyayoṣitaḥ || 1.378.140 || yonyaṃgaṃ darśanāyogyaṃ dṛśyaṃ nānyaiḥ patiṃ vinā | pramatto vārdhako vātha pāśavo rākṣaso’thavā || 141 || daityo’spṛśyo’tha cāṇḍālo malinaḥ pūyapūritaḥ | durgandho viṣṭayā lipto rugṇaḥ kṛmiprapūritaḥ || 142 || yādṛśastādṛśo vāpi yonidraṣṭā sa eva saḥ | nānyo devo’thavā samrāḍ yoniyogyo hi dharmataḥ || 143 || dharmato yonirūpaṃ sa līnamarthaṃ hi gacchati | līno bhūtvā dhāturūpaḥ putrātmā jāyate’pi saḥ || 144|| patirūpeṇa pātāsti putrarūpeṇa pāsyati | paraloke prapātā ca patireva mato hi saḥ || 145|| tatkṛte vartitaṃ yadyat sarvaṃ nāryāḥ pramokṣakṛt | iti jñātvā sadā lakṣmi pātivratyaṃ samācaret || 146| | hariryathārcito bhaktairbhaktānuddharati svayam | patistathārcitaḥ patnyā patnīmuddharati svayam || 147|| malinā vā vicittā vā rugṇā pūyaprapūritā | durgandhā vā kurūpā vā vṛkā jaḍā sajantukā || 148|| madyamāṃsaratā vā durvāṇī duṣṭā malānvitā | yādṛśī tādṛśī vā syād rākṣasī vā piśācikā ||149|| bhūtī pretī ca vetālī ḍākinī kālikāpi vā | patnyāṃ tasyāmeva patiḥ rantumicchati vai gṛhe || 1.378.150 || abhayaṃ ramaṇaṃ yatra sa vai dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ | sabhayaṃ ramaṇaṃ yatrādharmaḥ samparikīrtitaḥ || 151 || abhayaṃ ramaṇaṃ ramayitārau tārayed bhayāt | patnīvrataṃ tataḥ pātivratyamuddhārakaṃ sadā || 152|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye rukmāṃgadarājñe gṛhagodhayā svabhartṛvaśīkāro, bhālukamāṭulīpiṅgalīvṛttāntaḥ, sumantusutākauṇḍinyapatnīkāṣṭhīlāvṛttāntaḥ, kāśīrājaputrī vṛttāntaḥ, bhartṛsevaikadinajapuṇyadānena tāsāṃ muktiḥ, pativratānāṃ viśeṣatā patiṃ prati cetyādi nirūpaṇanāmāṣṭasaptatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 378 ||
<1.379> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi menoktān pārvatīṃ prati | pātivratyaparān dharmān bhuktimuktipradān śubhān || 1 || kṛtvā vivāhaṃ pārvatyā menā himagireḥ priyā | putrīṃ sayāpayāmāsa dharmānuktvā parān yathā || 2 || girije śṛṇu suprītyā dharmavṛddhikaraṃ vacaḥ | ihāmutrānandakaraṃ śṛṇvatāṃ ca sukhapradam || 3 || dhanyā pativratā nārī tvādṛśī śaṃkarapriyā | pāvanī sarvakāntānāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśinī || 4 || yā satī sevate premṇā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim | iha bhuktvākhilān bhogān patyānte yāti sadgatim || 9 || pātivratyena dharmeṇa patnī yāti prapūjyatām | brahmaviṣṇuharairmānyā munimānyā bhavatyapi || 6 || tvayā patiḥ sadā sevyaḥ śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ | bhuñjād bhukte priye patyau pātivratyaparāyaṇā | | 7 || tiṣṭhet tasmin sukhe nārī patyau yadā tu tiṣṭhati | svapyāt svapiti patyau sā buddhyettu prathamaṃ sadā || 8 || sarvadā taddhitaṃ kuryādakaitavagatiḥ priyā | analaṃkṛtamātmānaṃ darśayenna kvacit satī || 9 || kāryārthaṃ proṣite tasmin bhavenmaṇḍanavarjitā | patyurnāma na gṛhṇīyāt kadāpīha pativratā || 1.379.1 0|| ākruṣṭāpi na cākrośet prasīdettāḍitāpi ca | āhūtā gṛhakāryāṇi tyaktvā gacchettadantikam || 11 || tadādiṣṭā caret karma manasā karmaṇā priyā | ciraṃ tiṣṭhenna vai dvāre paragṛhe na sañcaret || 12|| gṛhatattvaṃ parasmai na kathayeccārpayettathā | pūjāvastūni sarvāṇi tvanuktāpi prasādhayet || 13 || gacchenna tīrthayātrādo patyurājñāṃ vinā kvacit | tīrthārthinī satī svasyāḥ patyuḥ pādodakaṃ pibet || 14|| patyuḥ pādodake sarvatīrthakṣetrāṇi tatkṛte | bhuṃjyātpatiprasādaṃ ca miṣṭamannādikaṃ jalam || 15|| avibhajya na vai bhuṃjyād devātithipitṛṣvapi | paricārakavargeṣu goṣu bhikṣukuleṣu ca || 16|| saṃskṛtopaskarā hṛṣṭā cātivyayaparāṅmukhī | patyājñayā vratakartrī bhavetpatiparāyaṇā || 17|| sukhāsīnaṃ ramamāṇaṃ patiṃ notthāpayet kvacit | dīnaṃ klībaṃ vyādhitaṃ ca vṛddhaṃ vāpi na tarjayet || 18|| strīdharmiṇī trirātraṃ ca svamukhaṃ naiva darśayet | susnātā bhartṛvadanamīkṣetānyasya na kvacit || 1 9|| patyau cānupasthite taṃ smṛtvā sūryaṃ vilokayet | haridrāṃ kuṃkumaṃ binduṃ sindūraṃ kajjalādikam || 1.379.20 || tāmbūlaṃ maṃgalasūtraṃ śṛṃgārābhūṣaṇāni ca | keśasādhana kabarīṃ kaṃkaṇaṃ karṇabhūṣaṇam || 21 || nāsikābhūṣaṇaṃ sūtraṃ saubhāgyadravyamityapi | bhartrāyuṣyecchukī sādhvī dūrayenna kadācana ||22|| bharturvidveṣiṇī saṃbhāṣayennaiva pativratā | yatra yatra rucirbhartustatra premaratirbhavet || 23 || hṛṣṭaṃ hṛṣṭā viṣaṇṇāsyā viṣaṇṇāsye priye priyā | vipadi saṃpadi sādhvī bhavet patyekarūpiṇī ||24|| sarpirlavaṇatailādikṣaye kaṣṭe na yojayet | vidherviṣṇorharādvāpi nārāyaṇācca sarvathā || 25|| patirekaḥ paraḥ satyāḥ parabrahmasvarūpakaḥ | bharturājñāṃ vinā copavāsavratādi nācaret ||26 || uktā pratyuttaraṃ kruddhā dadyāt sā saramā bhavet | śṛgālī ca bhavet tiraskāriṇī vānarī bhavet || 27|| uccāsanaṃ na seveta nābhimānavatī bhavet | apavādaṃ kalahaṃ ca kalaṃkaṃ na dadet priye || 28 || gurūṇāṃ sannidhau noccairvadennāpi haset satī | bāhyādāyāntamālokya bhartāraṃ tvaritā satī || 29|| jalānnaphalatāmbūlapādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ | śramanodanavākyaiśca priyaiḥ saṃprīṇayet patim ||1.379.3 0|| mitaṃ dadāti janako mātā bhrātā suto mitam | amitasya pradātāraṃ patiṃ santoṣayet sadā ||3 1 || patirdevaḥ patirdharmastīrthaṃ bhartā patirguruḥ | paratreha ca sukhadastaṃ patiṃ sevayet sadā ||32|| vinā patiṃ rahaścārā tūlūkī jāyate drume | patyustāḍanakartrī ca vyāghrī daṃśā ca jāyate ||33 || narānye cakṣuṣordātrī vakrākṣī miñjarī bhavet | patiṃ tyaktvā tu miṣṭādī sūkarī valgurī bhavet ||34|| tūṃkṛtya svāminaṃ brūte yā sā mūkālpajihvikā | sapatnīdveṣayuktā syād durbhagā guptarogiṇī ||35|| patyanyaṃ kāmanāyuktaṃ mukhaṃ darśayati svakam | kāṇā kubjā kurūpā ca kumukhī ca bhavettu sā ||36|| abhartṛkā suvarṇāpi nārī śavasamā matā | mātā dhanyā pitā dhanyo dhanyāḥ sambandhibāndhavāḥ |||37|| dhanyo grāmaḥ patirdeśo yatrāste vai pativratā | pitṛvaṃśyā mātṛvaṃśyāḥ pativaṃśyāstrayastrayaḥ ||38|| pativratāprapuṇyaiste divi devā bhavanti vai | pativratāpadanyāsā bhūmivaikuṇṭhamucyate || 39|| candraḥ sūryo’nalo vāyuḥ pāvitryātha satīpadam | spṛśatyeva jalaṃ tadvat tīrthaṃ bhavati pāvanam ||1.379.40 || bhāryā gārhasthyamūlaṃ cānandamūlaṃ prajāpradā | puṇyamūlaṃ sarvaloke jayadā gṛhameva sā ||41 || gaṃgāvatpāvanī sādhvī yā sadā bhartṛtoṣiṇī | pāpanāśakarī devī smaratāṃ sadgatipradā |||42||| satītvaṃ sati duṣprāpyaṃ nisargācchrīprasaṃbhavam | sādhvītvaṃ prāpya saddharma pramādāttaṃ na nāśayet ||43 || pātivratyaṃ sadā rakṣet prāpyāpi vipadaḥ satī | satītvaṃ puṇyataḥ prāta nāstikyād yā na manyate ||44|| sā tu dharmacyutā nārī kulaṭātvaṃ prapadyate | svadharmaniratā satyavādinī ca jitendriyā ||45|| prāpnoti vipulaṃ svargaṃ devānāmapi durlabham | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sādhvī svadharmatatparā ||46|| hetuṃ sarvapumarthasya pātivratyaṃ hi rakṣayet | gavārthaṃ brāhmaṇasyārthaṃ svāmyarthaṃ yā hi vartate ||47|| sā svamokṣamavāpnoti svāmisevāsamarjitam | śṛṇu sādhvi mama putri pañcacūḍoditaṃ tu yat ||48|| nāradaḥ pañcacūḍākhyāṃ papracchāpsarasaṃ purā | strīṇāṃ svabhāvamicchāmi tvattaḥ śrotuṃ vadātra me ||49|| pañcacūḍā prāha tatra nāradaṃ munisattamam | strīsvabhāvasya kathanaṃ nindāyāṃ parivartate ||1.379.50|| mune śakyā kathaṃ nārī nāryā tu nindituṃ vada | viditāste striyo yāśca yādṛśyaśca svabhāvataḥ ||5 1 || na māmarhasi devarṣe niyoktuṃ praśnamīdṛśam | tathāpi tvanniyogādvai kathayāmi yathātatham ||52|| tatra vāṇīkṛto doṣastvayi nārad gṛhyatām | omityaṃgīcakārarṣistataḥ prāhāpsarovarā ||53 || kulīnā nāthavatyaśca rūpavatyaśca yoṣitaḥ | maryādāsu na tiṣṭhanti strīṣu cāñcalyadūṣaṇam ||54|| cāñcalyena svakaṃ dharmaṃ pātivratyaṃ gatipradam | rakṣituṃ na prayatante tato yāntyadhamāṃ gatim ||55|| asaddharmastvayaṃ strīṇāmasmākaṃ bhavati prabho | pāpīyaso narān yadvai lajjāṃ tyaktvā bhajāmahe ||56 || striyaṃ ca yaḥ prārthayate sannikarṣaṃ ca gacchati | īṣacca kurute sevāṃ tamevecchanti yoṣitaḥ ||57|| anarthitvānmanuṣyāṇāṃ bhayātpatijanasya ca | maryādāyāmamaryādāḥ striyastiṣṭhanti bhartṛṣu ||58|| nāsāṃ kaścidamānyo’sti nāsāṃ vayasi niścayaḥ | surūpaṃ vā kurūpaṃ vā pumāṃsamupabhuṃjate ||59| | na bhayādathavākrośānnārthahetoḥ kathaṃcana | na jñānikulasambandhāt striyastiṣṭhanti bhartṛṣu ||1.379.60|| ityāha strīsvabhāvām̐śca pañcacūḍāpsarovarā | tān svabhāvān prasaṃmṛdya mano niyamya yatnataḥ ||6 1 || patiṃ paraṃ prabhuṃ jñātvā cāṃcalyaṃ tatra yojayet | patimeva paraṃbrahma patimeva ca bhājanam ||62|| sevāyāḥ paramaṃ jñātvā tathā puṇyasya bhājanam | dharmasya bhājanaṃ caiva tathā mokṣasya bhājanam ||63 || paralokasya sarvasya tathā svargasya bhājanam | bhājanaṃ sadguṇānāṃ ca paramānandabhājanam ||64|| kulakakīrterbhājanaṃ ca maryādābhājanaṃ tathā | cāñcalyaśāntipātraṃ ca dharmapātraṃ paraṃ tathā ||65|| kāmanāśāntipātraṃ ca lajjāyā bhājanaṃ tathā | manaḥśāntermārjanaṃ cānarthānutpādasādhanam ||66 || vaṃśotpatterbījapātraṃ svargamokṣādipātrakam | patiṃ harisvarūpaṃ vai bhajeddivyaṃ pativratā ||67|| antakaḥ śamano mṛtyuḥ pātālaṃ vaḍavāmukham | kṣuradhārā viṣaṃ sarpo vahnirityekataḥ striyaḥ ||68|| tadetānantakādisvabhāvān nisargajān guṇān | vartitavyaṃ vilīyaiva satyā patyau hi sarvathā ||69|| patiṃ jñātvā hariṃ nityaṃ pūjayed yā pativratā | na tasyāḥ śrīhareḥ pūjā patyarcāto’tiricyate ||1.379.70|| iti jñātvā sadā putri patiṃ sevaya dharmataḥ | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ tathā sveṣṭaṃ prāpsyasi patyanugrahāt ||71 || iti lakṣmi pātivratyadharmāścoktā hi menayā | pārvatyai ca mayā tubhyaṃ proktāstvatra prasaṃgataḥ ||72|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye menakoktān pārvatīṃ prati pativratādharmān paṃcacūḍoktānnāradaṃ prati strīsvabhāvām̐śca pradarśya pātivratyadharmanigamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikonāśītyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 379 ||
<1.380> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mṛgīṃ vanyāṃ pātivratyaparāyaṇām | puṣkare sābhavatpatnī ṛṣermṛgasya pāśavī || 1 || yathā vai mānuṣe dehe vartate tu pativratā | tathā sā mṛgadehe’pi pātivratye hyavartata || 2 || mṛgī mṛge kāmadharmā samāśliṣyattu yaddināt | tata eva dināt kāntaṃ mṛgamekaṃ patiṃ śubham || 3 || svīkṛtyaiva tamāśritya prāvartata pativratā | nānyaṃ mṛgaṃ sā smarati nānyaṃ paśyati bhāvataḥ || 4 || nānyaṃ spṛśati nānyena ramate sā kadācana | mṛgayūthe punarjātā mṛgī sā tu rajasvalā || 5 || tadā baliṣṭhāḥ sāraṃgāḥ patantyanu ca tāṃ mṛgīm | kintu sā svapatiṃ hitvā nānyayogaṃ samicchati || 6 || tadānyaiḥ krodhamāpannairmṛgairyūthād bahiṣkṛtā | sā tu patiṃ mṛgaṃ nītvā mṛgayūthaṃ vihāya ca || 7 || dharmarakṣārthamevāyānnirmṛgaṃ kānanāntaram | madhyame puṣkare tīrthe śādvale nirbhaye sthale || 8 || tatra sā sevate nityaṃ patiṃ samanuvṛttibhiḥ | śṛṃgāgraiḥ svāminaḥ kaṇḍūnāśayatyeva bhāvataḥ || 9 || lelihānā jihvayā svakāntaṃ snehamayī tathā | spṛśamānā mukhādyaiśca rañjayatyeva taṃ mṛgam || 1.380.1 0|| ghaṭṭeṣu drustabakeṣu ghāsānvitasthalīṣu ca | yatra śaityaṃ na vā vṛṣṭirna vā tāpo bhaved raveḥ || 11 || tatra chāyāmūlamadhye stambāntaḥsthalamāpya ca | rātriṃ kāntena vai sākaṃ vinirgamayya sā mṛgī || 1 2|| kāntasya jāgrataḥ pūrvaṃ nidrāṃ tyaktvā tu vai śanaiḥ | kāntānanaṃ vilokyaiva praleḍhi jihvayā satī || 1 3|| mṛgastu jāgratiṃ prāpya kāntāṃ dṛṣṭvā pativratām | śṛṃgeṇa jihvayā kāntākaṇḍūyanamathaiti hi || 14|| evaṃ parasparaṃ patnīvratasvāmivratānvitau | śayyāṃ sthalīṃ pravihāya samāyāto bahiḥsthalīm || 15|| yāvatkānto na gṛhṇāti tṛṇaṃ vā komalaṃ dalam | tāvanmṛgī na cādatte patraṃ tṛṇaṃ ca vāṅkuram || 16|| prātaḥ kāntena ceddattaṃ patraṃ tadā mṛgī hyapi | patrameva samādatte nānyat tṛṇaṃ ca vāṅkuram || 17|| yadi kāntaḥ samādatte tṛṇaṃ tadanu sā mṛgī | bhakṣayatti tṛṇameva tatra patiprasādajam || 18|| patyabhakṣyaṃ na cādatte sarasaṃ śreṣṭhamityapi | bhakṣyamāṇe tṛṇādau ca yadi prāpnoti nūtanam || 1 9|| miṣṭaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mṛdu bhakṣyaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ tṛṇam | aṃkuraṃ kandamūlaṃ vā sasyaṃ śākhādikaṃ yadi ||1.380.2 0|| tadā kāntaṃ samāhūya svāmine tad dadāti sā | jalapāne’pi pūrvaṃ vai mṛgaḥ pibati vai jalam ||21 || tadanveva mṛgī pāne jalasyācaratīti vai | prayāte yātyanu nityaṃ sthite bhavati sā sthitā ||22|| palāyamāne tu tadanu sā karoti palāyanam | tarjitā tāḍitā vāpi na sā gaṇayati vyathām ||23 || mṛgaścet sūryakiraṇe tāpe tiṣṭhati vai mudā | yāvat tāvacca sā dharmaṃ matvā tāpe pratiṣṭhati ||24|| evaṃ chāyāṃ gate patyau tataśchāyāṃ pratīcchati | sadā kāntasya sevāyāṃ kalyāṇaṃ manyate satī ||25|| evaṃ vai vartamānāyāṃ vane tatrāpyavagrahaḥ | samabhūt tena sasyāni nāprarohan jalaṃ vinā ||26|| sthalī śuṣkābhavaccāpi tatra khādyaṃ kṣaya gatam | mṛgyamāṇaṃ kvacicchuṣkaṃ śalākākāṇḍapatrakam || 27|| labhyate ca kvacinnaiva prāpyate tu tadā niśā | kṣudhitābhyāṃ yāpyate ca svadharmibhyāṃ vane vane ||28|| atha prāg yatparityaktaṃ mṛgavrātaṃ sudhānvitam | bhramadvanaṃ samāyātaṃ yatrāste sā pativratā ||29|| duḥkhaṃ kṣudhitaṃ cālokya kuṭumbiyūthameva sā | hṛṣṭā smṛtvā patiṃ tatra kṛtvā vṛddhānnatiṃ muhuḥ ||1.380.3 0|| provāca teṣāṃ bhojyārthaṃ yadyasmyahaṃ pativratā | tadaiteṣāmatithīnāṃ satkārārthaṃ vanaṃ mama ||3 1 || vṛṣṭiṃ vināpi sadalaṃ nūtanāṃkuraśobhitam | śādvalaṃ saphalaṃ sasyottamaśrīlalitaṃ tathā ||32|| satṛṇaṃ sajalaṃ cāpi bhavatvatra muhūrtakam | ityevaṃ kathite tadvai vanaṃ haritameva ca ||33 || sampannaṃ bhakṣyapauṣkalyaprapūrṇaṃ hlādakārakam | sarve kuṭumbino jagdhvā jalaṃ pītvā yayustadā ||34|| pativratāyā māhātmyaṃ gāyantaḥ smṛddhikārakam | taistu sarvatra vārtā sā kathitāścaryakāriṇī ||35|| mṛgā vanāntarebhyaśca samāyātāḥ kṣudhāturāḥ | iyaṃ pativratā nityaṃ patiṃ natvā punaḥ punaḥ ||36|| atithīnāṃ bhojanārthaṃ nityaṃ saṃkalpamācarat | nityaṃ muhūrtamātraṃ ca śuṣkaṃ bhavati cārdrakam ||37|| haritaṃ śādvalaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhakṣayanti mṛgāstataḥ | tṛptvā gacchanti bhūbhāgān punaḥ śuṣkāyate vanam ||38|| athaikadābhavattatra vane dāvānalodbhavaḥ | prāleyavahnisadṛśaḥ paśupakṣikṣayaṃkaraḥ ||39|| tadā sarvaiḥ smṛtā sā ca mṛgī vahnipraśāntaye | mṛgī patikṣuraṃ spṛṣṭvā natvā provāca vai patim ||1.380.40 || yadi nātha kṛtā sevā tava bhaktyā sadā mayā | tena puṇyena dāvo’yaṃ śāntimetu kṣayāvahaḥ ||41 || iti sakalpite tatra vahniḥ kṛṣṇamṛgo’bhavat | samāyāto yatra sāsti mṛgī svāmivratā satī ||42|| nanāma tāṃ satīṃ prāha devi śānto’smi te bhayāt| | nātaḥ prajvālaye’raṇyaṃ viharantu mṛgāḥ sukham ||43 || bibhemyahaṃ satīśāpāt kṣamasva māṃ pativrate | ityuktvā ca satīṃ natvā yayau śāntiṃ davānalaḥ ||44|| atha siṃhāstathā vyāghrā bhallukā hiṃsrakāstu ye | te’pi yātānpaśūm̐statra jñātvāyayustu tadvane ||41|| hiṃsrāḥ paśūn vihiṃsanti duḥkhākrośo’bhavad vane | paśavo’pi tu saṃbhūya trastāstatra samāyayuḥ ||46|| pativratā mṛgī yatra puṣkare vartate bhuvi | tadā teṣāṃ mahadduḥkhavināśāyārthayacchivam ||47|| mṛgīśvaro mahādevastatra sākṣāt samāgamat | prāha sā taṃ haraṃ nātha rakṣāṃ kuru vane sadā ||48|| hiṃsrāḥ khādanti te bhaktānasmānavitumarhasi | mahādevastadā rūpaṃ dhṛtvā śarabhamutkaṭam ||49|| vane cacāra hiṃsrāṇāṃ vidrāvaṇāya sarvataḥ | prahiṃsrāḥ paśavaḥ krūrā dūraṃ yānti sma tadvanāt ||1.380.50|| athainaṃ śarabhaṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭavān parśurāmakaḥ | jāmadagnyastapaḥ kartuṃ yaśca tiṣṭhati puṣkare ||51 || dhanurādāya bāṇena yāvaddhantuṃ pravartate | tāvaddeva girā prāha śaṃkaraḥ śarabhaḥ svayam ||52|| re re rāma mahābhāga bhaktarakṣākaro’smyaham | pativratāyā mṛgyā vai saṃkalpena samāgataḥ ||53 || śaṃkarastavarūpo’haṃ mā yatna tvaṃ vṛthā kuru | ityuktvā tu harastasmāyadarśayaddharaṃ tanum |||54|| devau rāmaharau ṣaṣvajāte pari parasparam | śaṃbhu pradarśya sukhadāṃ svarṇadīṃ tāpasasthalīm ||55|| tiro’bhavat tato rāmo yayau tatra phalāptaye | stotraṃ cakāra kṛṣṇasya tena tuṣṭo’bhavaddhariḥ ||56 || jagāma darśanaṃ tasya jāmadagnyasya keśavaḥ | dadāvastrāṇi śastrāṇi kṣatravargalayāya vai ||57|| tirobhavacca sa kṛṣṇo rāmo’pi prati puṣkaram | snānādyarthaṃ samāgacchad dṛṣṭavān sa mṛgīṃ satīm ||58 || yatprabhāvena haritaṃ vanaṃ tajjāyate muhuḥ | yatpratāpena śānto’bhūt tatra dāvānalo vane |||59||| yatprabhāvācca śarabhaṃ rūpaṃ vai dhṛtavān haraḥ | tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā satīṃ divyāṃ mṛgīmāścaryamāptavān ||1.380.60 || mṛgī rāmaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃśaṃ divyasaddhiyā | jñātvā nanāma tuṣṭāvātithisatkāramācarat ||61 || mṛgo’pi taṃ parśurāmaṃ nanāma praṇayānvitaḥ | tāvattatra samāyāto vyādho vai mṛgayārataḥ ||6 2 || pipāsito gharmatapto jalapānasamutsukaḥ | rāmasya paśyatastatra sarasastaṭamāgataḥ ||63 || mṛgīmṛgau tu pibatastatra vāri bhayānvitau | vyādho mṛgīmṛgau dṛṣṭvā mṛgayārthaṃ dhanurdadhau ||64|| kintu dṛṣṭvā parśurāmaṃ tasthāvakṣiptasāyakaḥ | śaṃkitaścintayāmāsa tadā bhītastu rāmataḥ |||65|| pītvā mṛgīmṛgau vāri vṛkṣachāyāsamāśritau | dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ mṛgyuvāca kāntaṃ nirbhayamānasā ||66 || kānta cātraiva tiṣṭhāvo yāvadrāmo’tra saṃsthitaḥ | asya vīrasya sānnidhye vyādho nau prahariṣyati ||67|| tadā dṛṣṭaḥ sa muninā bhasmībhūto bhaviṣyati | mṛgaścāha tathāstvenaṃ rāmaṃ jānāmi bhārgavam ||68|| śivasya nāradasyāpi śukasyāpi ca māruteḥ | ambarīṣasya ca balervibhīṣaṇasya cottamā ||69|| prahlādasya rantidevasyoddhavasyāpi cottamā | gopīnāṃ ca prabhāyāśca pārvatyāśca yathottamā ||1.380.70 || māṇikyāyāśca lakṣmyāśca bhaktiḥ kṛṣṇe yathāsti vai | tathā bhaktiṃ prakurvan vai rāmo’yaṃ tapasi sthitaḥ ||71 || jātijñānaṃ tvadya jātaṃ rāmasyāsya tu darśanāt | śṛṇu priye pravakṣyāmi yathāvāṃ mṛgatāṃ gatau ||72|| purā draviḍadeśe vai brāhmaṇānāṃ kule śubhe | jātaḥ kauśikagotro me satrāyaṇābhidhaḥ pitā ||73 || vedasūristasya putraścāhamāsaṃ subhaktimān | guruśuśrūṣaṇe rakto vedādhyayanatatparaḥ ||74|| ekadā kṛtamālāyāṃ snātvā hyuṣasi parvatam | samārūḍhastatra caikā mṛgī tvāgāt pipāsitā |||75|| vāripānaparāṃ tāṃ ca vīkṣyāhaṃ kṛpayā drutam | tasyāḥ samīpamagamaṃ sāpi viśvāsaśālinī ||76 || mama vai pādayostatrāgatya namrā babhūva vai | tāvattatra samāyātaḥ śārdūlo’tibhayaṃkaraḥ ||77|| mṛgī palāyitā trastā śārdūlo jagṛhe ca tām | ahaṃ śārdūlanāśārthaṃ kṛtavān bahuyatnakam || 78|| mṛgyāḥ prāṇāvanārtha ca sā tathāpi kṣatā tadā | kanyārūpaṃ conapañcadaśavarṣaṃ vidhāya vai ||79|| matsamīpaṃ samāgatya patitā pādayostu me | ahamāścaryamāpannaḥ pṛṣṭhavām̐stāṃ kumārikām ||1.380.80|| devi devīsamā kā tvaṃ mṛgīrūpā hi kanyakā | kasya putrī kathaṃ cādrau tvaikākinī samāgatā ||8 1 || kanyā prāha tadā māṃ sā putryahaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ | devīnāṃ brahmasarasāṃ madhye nāmnā hariṇyaham ||82|| varayogyābhavaṃ cāhaṃ brahmaṇā preṣitātra vai | sātrāyaṇiṃ vedasūrimudvahituṃ samāgatā ||83 || mṛgīrūpeṇa cāyātā māṃ yathānyo na dharṣayet | sāraṃgī cākṣatā cāpyarajasvalāsmi kanyakā ||84|| ṛtuyogyāsmi sañjātā samudvahatu māṃ bhavān | ityuktā sā mayā tatra gāndharveṇa vivāhitā ||85|| agniṃ prajvālya tatraiva hṛtvā phalādikaṃ vane | kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ puṣpamālāṃ dhṛtvā ca dampatī ||86|| gārhyaṃdharma samāpannau kāmarūpau hi yoginau | kadācidṛṣisadrūpaṃ kadācinmṛgarūpiṇau ||87|| kadācid devarūpau ca kadācidvai patattriṇau | kadācijjalamatsyau ca haṃsau ca garuḍau tathā ||88|| bhūtvā bhūtvā yatheṣṭaṃ sma vane vartāvahe gireḥ | pātivratyaparā tvaṃ ca tathā patnīvrato’pyaham ||89|| gāḍhānurāgāvanyonyamāstāṃ dharmaparāyaṇau | jātismarau trikālajñau dharmakarmaparau sadā ||1.380.90|| girau cāsan mṛgā mṛgyaścānye śatasahasraśaḥ | te yathā na vijānīyurāvāṃ mṛgātmakau tathā ||91 | | bhūtvā teṣu militvaiva viharāvaḥ sma nityadā | ekadā stambaparṇānāṃ nicaye vṛṣṭikāraṇāt ||92|| vṛkṣastambāśrayaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭhāvo nirbhayaṃ sthalam | viyujya tanmṛgavrātāt kāmadharmasukhecchayā || 93 || niśā tu kṣapitā prātarvṛṣṭirnaiva nivartate | tāvattatra ca kṣudhitaḥ siṃhaḥ kaścitsamāgataḥ || 94|| hyakasmād vidhṛtau tena kṣatau jātau mṛgau tadā | pātavratyena dharmeṇa hariṇyā rakṣitāvapi ||95|| kāladharmaṃ hi samprāptau mṛgarūpau mṛgasmṛtī | ante yā ca smṛtiryasya gatistasya tathā bhavet ||96|| iti bhāvanayā tatra vyāghravyāpādanottaram | sā mṛtā tvaṃ mṛgī jātā mṛgaścāhaṃ tvayā saha || 97| | patnīvratastathā tvaṃ ca me priyāsi pativratā | āvābhyāṃ bhārgavo rāmo duṣṭaḥ sākṣāddhariḥ svayam ||98|| gamiṣyāmaḥ śubhān lokān yeṣu gatvā na śocati | yayatustāviti procya rāmasya śaraṇaṃ hyubhau ||99|| procatuḥ paraśurāmaṃ sahasravarṣajīvitau | rāma rāma hare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jagadguro || 1.380.1 00|| jātismarau mṛgīmṛgau svasvadharmaparāyaṇau | śaraṇaṃ te ca muktyarthaṃ prāptau mocaya bandhanāt || 101 || evamuktvā parśurāmaṃ tuṣṭuvaturmṛgīmṛgau | yāvattaccaraṇau spṛṣṭau tāvatsvaryānamāgatam || 1 02|| caturbhiradbhutaiḥ siddhaiḥ kāmarūpairmanojavaiḥ | anuyātamathotplutya strīpuṃsau hariṇau tadā || 103 || rāmasya caraṇau natvā samāruruhaturmudā | divyadehadharau bhūtvā śaṃkhacakrādicihnitau || 1 04|| gatau ca vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam | śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ caitallakṣmi mokṣagatirbhavet || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye brahmaṇaḥ putryā hariṇyā vedasūriṇā saha vivāhaḥ, mṛgīmṛgadehe pātivratyapatnīvratatāpālanam, vṛṣṭiṃ vināpi vanasya haritīkaraṇam, dāvānalapraśamanam, hiṃsraprāṇināśāya śivasya śarabharūpeṇāgamanam, parśurāmadarśanam, puṣkare prāgvṛttāntakathanam, hariṇayormuktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmāśītyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 380||
<1.381> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ cānyāṃ pātivratyaparāyaṇām | reṇukā jamadagneryā patnī cābhūtpativratā || 1 || yā mṛtaṃ patimādāya saṃviveśa citānale | yatputraḥ paraśurāmo hyāsīdvane tapaḥsthitaḥ || 2 || narmadāyāstaṭe māhiṣmatyā nātipradūrake | vane śreṣṭhāśramo hyāsījjamadagnerdrumākulaḥ || 3 || jamadagniḥ kāmadhenuḥ parśurāmaśca reṇukā | ete mukhyāstathā cānye hyāsan śiṣyāḥ sutāḥ pare || 4 || sahasraśaḥ patiṃ saṃsevate bhaktyā tu reṇukā | pātivratyena dharmeṇa devatāvanditā satī || 5 || śṛṇu vistaratastasyāḥ kathāṃ lakṣmi pramuktidām | reṇukā putralabdhyarthaṃ tapaścacāra dāruṇam || 6 || śītakāle patisevā karotyaharniśaṃ satī | ārdravastreṇa ca kṛṣṇapūjāṃ karoti vai prage || 7 || ekabhuktābhavaccaiva sūryapūjāṃ karoti ca | vahnipūjāmatithīnāṃ gavāṃ pūjāṃ karoti ca || 8 || varṣamātraṃ phalāhārā varṣaṃ patrādanābhavat | varṣaṃ jalādanā varṣaṃ vāyvāhārābhavat satī || 9 || varṣaṃ bāṣpādanā varṣaṃ nirāhārābhavat satī | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmnā japati sma nirantaram || 1 0|| patyuḥ sevāṃ dvitīyena rūpeṇa ca karoti vai | evaṃ tasmai prasanno’bhūt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||1 1 || sākṣājjagāma tasyāstvantikaṃ prāha varaṃ vṛṇu | satī prāha bhavān me’tra gṛhe putro’stu rakṣakaḥ || 1 2|| tathāstviti prāha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastirodadhe | tataḥ kāle’bhavad rāmaḥ kāṣṭhārtaṃ paraśuṃ dadhan || 1 3|| paraśurāmanāmāsau khyāto’bhavad vaneṣu saḥ | ekadā pitarau natvā pitāmahagṛhaṃ gataḥ || 14|| ṛcīkaṃ taṃ pitāmahaṃ natvāsasāda cāsane | uvāsa katicinmāsān tacchuśrūṣāparāyaṇaḥ ||15|| tato yayau bhṛguṃ khyātiṃ nanāma vinayānvitaḥ | bhṛguḥ prāha hitaṃ kartuṃ lokānāṃ rāmamacyutam || 16 || gaccha putra mamādeśāddhimavantaṃ tapaḥkṛte | śaṃkaraḥ sarvathā tuṣṭastava śreyaḥ kariṣyati || 17|| natvā tau ca tato rāmo jagāma himaparvatam | sarastīre parṇakuṭīṃ kṛtvā tapaścacāra ha ||18|| bahuvarṣaṃ gate kāle mṛgavyādhavapuḥ śivaḥ | tapastuṣṭo jagāmāsyāntikaṃ prāha tu tāpasam ||1 9|| snāhi sarvatra tīrtheṣu tapo ghoraṃ samācara | tena puṇyena te rāma sarvāṇyastrāṇyavāpsyasi ||20|| ityuktvāntardadhe śaṃbhū rāmastīrthāni saṃyayau | kailāsaṃ ca yayau tasmai śaivamastraṃ dadau haraḥ ||21 || datvā ca paraśuṃ prāha suraśatrūn sadā jahi | rāmo daityān bahūn hatvā samāpede svakāśramam ||22|| śaṃbhustatra samāgatya dadāvastrāṇyaśeṣataḥ | saprayogaṃ sasaṃhāraṃmastragrāmaṃ caturvidham ||23 || asaṃvegaṃ śubhrāśvaṃ sudhvajaṃ ca rathottamam | iṣudhī cākṣayabāṇau dadau rāmāya śaṃkaraḥ ||24|| abhedyamajaraṃ divyaṃ dṛḍhajyaṃ vijayaṃ dhanuḥ | sarvaśastrasahaṃ citraṃ kavacaṃ ca mahādhanam ||25|| tapaḥprabhāvaṃ cograṃ ca pradadau bhārgavāya saḥ | athāraṇye vyāghravyāpāditaṃ dvijasutaṃ tadā ||26|| jīvayāmāsa rāmo’yaṃ cākṛtapraṇanāmakam | śiṣyaṃ kṛtvā tu śāntarṣisutaṃ rāmo yayau gṛham ||27|| jamadagniṃ reṇukāṃ ca nanāma daṇḍavadbhuvi | atha kālāntare tatrāyayau haihayabhūpatiḥ ||28|| caturaṃgabalairyukto narmadātīramāśramam | dṛṣṭvopetya jamadagniṃ nanāma śirasā nṛpaḥ ||29|| jamadagnistadātithyaṃ kāmadhenvā hyakārayat | nagaraṃ vāṭikāścodyānāni saudhāni sevikāḥ ||30 || dāsā gā upasāmagrīrbhojyapeyāni nirmame | reṇukāpi kāmadhenuṃ dogdhrīmuvāca vai punaḥ ||31 || ayaṃ rājā kārtavīryo mamātithistavātithiḥ | tasmāt sarvaṃ tavaiśvaryaṃ prakaṭīkuru me svasaḥ | ||32|| ityuktā kāmagauḥ prāha kuru saṃkalpamīśvari | pātivratyabalātte’haṃ vairājasmṛddhīrānaye ||33|| atha dvayoḥ prabhāvāttadvane suvarṇapattanam | surarājagṛhatulyaṃ tadāsīd bhaguvaṃśinaḥ ||34|| divyavibhūtibhedaiścācintyarūpaṃ tadābhavat | hemaratnojjvalamārgaṃ samudyānacatuṣkavat ||35|| rājamārgādikallolavālukāstabakānvitam | pūrṇacandrābhaśikharaiḥ prāsādaiḥ pariśobhitam ||36|| svarṇaraupyarītitāmrarasaiḥ saudhairvirājitam | ratnopalābhiḥ sphaṭikamiśraratnālirājitaiḥ || 37|| mahāmaṇipradīpānāṃ prakāśairakṣatairyutam | ratnojjvalasuvarṇāḍhyavedīsopānasadgṛhaiḥ ||38|| ratnamālāḍhyakuḍyādikapāṭārgalagopuraiḥ | svarṇāstaraṇasaṃsaktadehalyajiraśālibhiḥ ||39|| rātrigṛhānvitaṃ catuṣkikātoraṇaśobhitam | divyastambhaiḥ kuṇḍyacitraiḥ svarṇasiṃhāsanādibhiḥ ||40|| pīṭhakairbhakṣyabhojyaiśca bhāṇḍaiḥ pānairanantakaiḥ | devocitānnasampadbhirvadhūbhiśca manoharam ||41|| suvarṇaratnadurgaiśca koṣṭhakaiḥ sāptabhaumakaiḥ | parikhābhiśca divyābhirjalanālīvirājitam ||42|| vidyuddīpairdūrayantrairdūradṛśyapradarpaṇaiḥ | dūraśrāvaṇakośaiśca yānairvaihāyasairyutam ||43|| dīrghikābhirvāpikābhiḥ snānataḍāgaśobhitam | pradarśanairvividhaiśca nāṭakaiḥ śramanodanaiḥ ||44|| mallairbahusamāyāsaiḥ raṃjanairnartakairyutam | gāyakairvādyaśālābhiḥ rājasaṃsadvirājitam ||45|| śastrāgāraiścopakaraṇairmuktiśālābhiranvitam | snānasevanaśālābhirvimānaiḥ kāmagairyutam ||46| | haṃsaiśca garuḍaiścāpi menācātakasacchukaiḥ | mayūrairdevavāṇyā vai vadadbhiścānvitaṃ śubham ||47|| vṛkṣavallīphalapuṣpadivyagandhasugandhitam | kṛtaṃ vai nagaraṃ tatra dugdhekṣurasarājitam ||48|| amṛtaṃ ca kṛtaṃ tatra pratigṛhaṃ hradeṣu ca | jalāntaryānasaṃpūrṇa vahnyantaryānabhūṣitam ||49|| reṇukā gaurnirmamāte yogyayoṣitkumārikāḥ | vicitraveṣābharaṇapuṣpagandhāmbarādibhiḥ ||50|| śṛṃgāraśobhāśrīkāntihāvabhāvādiceṣṭitaiḥ | | cāñcalyaujjvalyanairmalyeṣaddhāsyākarṣaṇādibhiḥ ||51 || saundaryādiguṇairyuktā mandahāsyāsyaśobhanāḥ | kundakalikāsadṛśadantapaṃktivirājitāḥ ||52|| pratyagrayauvanabharā valgumiṣṭagiraḥ śubhāḥ | premamantharanetrāktakaṭākṣekṣaṇamaṇḍitāḥ ||53|| prītiprasannahṛdayāḥ śṛṃgāraratisatprabhāḥ | kalpavṛkṣakusumānāṃ hṛtsu hārālirājitāḥ ||54|| devāṃganādhikātyantasaubhāgyadivyatānvitāḥ | saukumāryābhirūpyāḍhyamadhurākṛtirājitāḥ |||55|| pīnavakṣoruhadvandvabharānatasumadhyamāḥ | śroṇībharānatāścāpi raktāṃghrikarasattalāḥ ||56|| hārakeyūrakaṃkaṇakaṇṭhasūtrādirājitāḥ | karṇakapolabhālādivibhūṣābhirvirājitāḥ ||57|| prakoṣṭhāṃgulikābhūṣākaṭibhūṣābhirājitāḥ | puṣpabhūṣātyabhirāmālakapāśasuśobhitāḥ ||58|| kāṃcīkalāpakiṃkiṇīpariśiñjitanūpurāḥ | narmasāntvanahāsyārghyakelīgītiviśāradāḥ ||59|| susvarā sumadhubhāṣā miṣṭagaṃbhīrabhāṣaṇāḥ | ratipragalbhā bhāvāḍhyāḥ kāmayogaviśāradāḥ ||60|| padmapatranibhanetrāḥ sampadaudāryasaṃbhṛtāḥ | gṛhakāryanipūṇāśca tādṛśyaḥ paricārikāḥ ||61 || gṛhacarān bhṛtyadāsān śataśo’tha sahasraśaḥ | pācakān mardakān pādasaṃvāhakām̐śca yāpakān ||62|| devālayān rathāśvām̐śca mātaṃgām̐śca kharoṣṭrakān | go’jāvikānuyuktānnirmamāte paśūn bahūn ||63 || sāmantāṃśca narendrām̐śca rājanyām̐śca niṣādinaḥ | sādinaśca padātīṃśca senāpatīṃśca nāyakān ||64|| viprādikām̐śca rathinaḥ sārathīn sūtabandinaḥ | māgadhām̐ścāraṇām̐ścāpi nartakām̐śca naṭām̐stathā ||65|| kinnarān bahurūpām̐śca gaṇikām̐śca napuṃsakān | cakrāhvahaṃsakurarībakasārasacātakān ||66|| kalhārakaṃjakumudotpalakundakadambakān | cūtapriyālapanasān madhūkakadalītarūn ||67|| nāgaketakīpunnāgamandārakundacampakān | karavīrān yūthikāśca phalapuṣpāṇi sarvaśaḥ ||68|| sarvartusaurabhān vāyūn mandaṃ mandaṃ prasāriṇaḥ | nirmamāte reṇukāyukkāmadhenurniyojitā ||69|| rājā tvātithyasatkāraṃ devādīnāṃ hi durlabham | jagrāha prāviśatpuṇyaṃ pattanaṃ svakṛte kṛtam ||70|| sarvopabhoganilayaṃ kauśeyāmbarakoṭibhiḥ | citraraṃgaurṇavastraiśca śobhitaṃ cojjvalaṃ puram ||71 || antaḥpraviśya puryarddhiṃ svargilokavimohinīm | sabalo vismayaṃ prāpa hetuṃ viveda gāṃ tataḥ ||72|| praveśitaṃ ca rājānaṃ nāryaścandanavāribhiḥ | prasūnalājāprakaraiścāvīvṛṣan gavākṣagāḥ ||73|| brāhmīṃ tapaḥśriyaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā mumoha sarvathā | śaśaṃsa manasā vācā mene kṣatrottarāṃ navām ||74|| asyāḥ śatāṃśatulanāṃ nopagantuṃ mama śriyaḥ | prabhavantīti matvaiva mānagarvagato’bhavat ||75|| ratnahīrakamālādisaparyāṃ labdhavānnṛpaḥ | kāmadhenukṛtasainyaiḥ sevakaiśca praveśitaḥ ||76 || kakṣāntarāṇi śanakairatītya trīṇi cārjunaḥ | sadmāviveśa sauvarṇadīpojjvalasubhāsvaram ||77|| dadhidarpaṇasaugandhyapuṣpadurvākṣatādibhiḥ | kanyābhirvardhito rājāruroha svarṇaviṣṭaram ||78|| purandhryastu pupūjustaṃ rājayogyārhaṇādibhiḥ | tābhiśca sākaṃ nṛpatirdinaṃ nināya nākavat ||79|| prapede ca sadaḥ sāyaṃ mantrisāmantanāyakaiḥ | vādyavinodaḥ pravṛtto nṛtyahāsyakathāyutaḥ ||1.381.80|| vilāsā gaṇikānāṃ ca hāsakrīḍādayo’bhavan | ardharātryuttara saudhaṃ viśrāmārthaṃ jagāma saḥ ||8 1 || rājasainyaṃ rājarūpavaibhaveṣu sameṣu vai | saudheṣu prāptavacchāntiṃ babhūva muditaṃ bahu ||82|| rājavad rājasainyānāṃ bhojyaṃ peyaṃ ca bhogyakam | sarva cābhūt samaṃ tena vasāmo’traiva te jaguḥ ||83|| svapantametya rājānaṃ sūtamāgadhabandinaḥ | prātaḥ prabodhayituṃ taṃ jaguruccairmadhusvaraiḥ ||84|| vīṇāveṇuravonmiśraistālamūrchāsumiśritaiḥ | vinidrākṣaḥ samutthāya rājā naityakamācarat ||85|| sevito vārayoṣābhiḥ samupetya taponidhim | nanāmātha ṛṣiḥ prāha vyuṣṭā rātriḥ sukhena kim ||86|| vanyā mṛgasadharmāṇo vayaṃ vanyena poṣitāḥ | rājānastu vane kleśaṃ gaṇayanti praduḥsaham ||87|| ityuktaḥ prahasan rājā muniṃ prāha vinirmadaḥ | bhavatprabhāvasaṃjātavibhavāhatacetasaḥ ||88|| ito na gantumicchanti sainikā me sukhālayāḥ | naiva citraṃ tava vibho tapaḥsiddhasya yoginaḥ ||89|| kāmadhenvāstathā pativratāyā yoṣitaśca te | svargaṃ tvatraiva sañjātaṃ kā smṛddhiḥ kṣudrabhūbhṛtaḥ ||1.381.90 || gamiṣyāmi gṛhaṃ brahmannanujānātu māṃ bhavān | tathetyuktaśca muninā saṃpratasthe purīṃ svakām ||91 || cintayāmāsa dhenuṃ tāṃ sarvakāmaduhāṃ varām | kiṃ me sakalarājyena kapardikopameva vai ||92|| ṛddhamaindrapadaṃ dhenoḥ kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm | dhenvā kṛtaṃ vane svargaṃ dhenvā kṣaṇena nāśitam ||93 || evaṃprabhāvā sā dhenuḥ rājyayogyā na tāpase | datvā mūlyaṃ gavāśvādi tvānetavyā mayā pure ||94|| iti nirṇīya rājā saḥ preṣayāmāsa mantriṇam | candraguptaḥ ṛṣiṃ prāha rājā vai bhuvi ratnabhāk ||95|| ratnānyādāya rājñe tvaṃ gāṃ ratnaṃ dātumarhasi | prāharṣirhomadhenurme dātavyā naiva kasyacit ||96|| krayavikrayornāhaṃ kartā na nṛpatervaśaḥ | prasahya haraṇe tvāyurnāśaste bhūbhṛtastathā ||97|| ityuktaḥ krodhamāpanno mantrī buddhvā tu gāṃ tadā | vicakarṣa yathāśaktirjamadagniḥ rurodha tam ||98|| mantryājñaptā muniṃ bhṛtyāḥ kaṣābhirjaghnuratyatha | dūre cakruḥ ṛṣiḥ sehe gāṃ prasahya prajagṛhuḥ ||99|| sā tu vyomagatā paścād vatsāṃ dhṛtvā yayurhi te | ṛṣirmamāra tāvattu parśurāmo hyupasthitaḥ || 1.381.1 00|| vanādāgata evāsau mātaraṃ rudatīṃ sutaḥ | śrutvākrośaṃ ca rāmeti rāmetyevaṃ puro drutam || 101 || samidbhāraṃ tvavatārya dṛṣṭvā vai pitaraṃ mṛtam | sāntvayāmāsa jananīṃ rudatīṃ sāśrulocanaḥ || 1 02|| reṇukā śokamāpannā tadā vaidhavyaśaṃkayā | triḥsaptakṛtvo hastābhyāmudaraṃ samatāḍayat| || 1 03|| tadā rāmo mātaraṃ svāmuvācāveśataḥ khalu | triḥsaptakṛtvo yadidaṃ tvayā vakṣaḥ samāhatam || 1 04|| tāvatsaṃkhyamahaṃ kṣatraṃ haniṣye mā śucaṃ vraja | atha sā reṇukā svāmivratā putrānuvāca ha || 1 05|| ahaṃ pativratā putrāḥ svargataṃ pitaraṃ tu vaḥ | anugantumihecchāmi vahniṃ prajvālya dehataḥ || 106 || yathā tena pravartiṣye paratrāpi sahāniśam | bharturmama bhaviṣyāmi pitṛlokapriyātithiḥ || 1 07|| tāvattatrātigaṃbhīrā vāguvācāśarīriṇī | pativrate’tra mā kārṣīḥ sāhasaṃ dhairyamāvaha || 1 08|| kuru patyuḥ prabodhāya saṃkalpaṃ tvaṃ pativrate | acireṇaiva bhartā te bhaviṣyati sacetanaḥ || 1 09|| ityuktā sā patidehaṃ nināya kuṭikāgṛhe | satī saṃkalpayāmāsa bharturutthānajīvanam || 1.381.11 0|| tāvattatra samāyāto bhṛgvarṣiḥ suravanditaḥ | mṛtasañjīvanīvidyāvāridhistamajīvayat || 111 || jamadagnirutthitaśca nanāma taṃ pitāmaham | papraccha rājñā pāpaṃ kiṃ kṛtaṃ yena mṛtopyaham || 11 2|| bhṛguḥ prāha vaśiṣṭhena śapto nāśāya sa nṛpaḥ | dvijāparādhato mūḍha vīryaṃ te vinaśiṣyate || 11 3|| tena putraśca te rāmo haniṣyati tamarjunam | ekaviṃśativāraṃ sa niḥkṣatrāṃ kṣmāṃ kariṣyati || 1 14|| datrātreyāddhareraṃśāllabdhaiśvaryaḥ sa jīvati | rāmaśastrairhataścādya paralokaṃ gamiṣyati || 1 15|| ityuktvārcanamādāya yayau gṛhaṃ bhṛgustataḥ | rāmaścakre pratijñāṃ cārjunaṃ nāśayituṃ tadā || 1 16|| jamadagniśca taṃ prāha satāṃ dharmaṃ smaran dvijaḥ | sādhavo ye mahābhāgāḥ saṃsārānmokṣakāriṇaḥ || 1 17|| na kasmaicitprakupyanti ninditāstāḍitā api | kṣamādhanā mahābhāgā ye ca dāntāstapasvinaḥ || 1 18|| teṣāṃ caivākṣayā lokāḥ satataṃ sādhukāriṇām | yastu duṣṭaiśca daṇḍādyairvacasāpi pratāḍitaḥ || 11 9|| na tu kṣobhamavāpnoti sa sādhuḥ parikīrtyate | tāḍayettāḍayantaṃ yo na ca sādhuḥ sa pāpabhāk || 1.381.120|| kṣamayārhaṇatāṃ prāptāḥ sādhavo brāhmaṇā vayam | tasmānnivāraye putra kṣamāṃ kuru tapaścara || 121 || iti pitrā samādiṣṭaḥ parśurāma uvāca tam | saḥ śamaḥ sādhudīneṣu na khaleṣu kadācana || 1 22|| tasmādasya vadhaḥ kāryaḥ kārtavīryasya vai mayā | ityuktavantaṃ taṃ putraṃ jāmadagniruvāca vai || 123 || ito vraja tvaṃ brahmāṇaṃ taduktakārako bhava | ityuktaḥ sa yayau vyomnā brahmāṇaṃ taṃ nanāma ca || 1 24|| vṛttāntaṃ svapratijñāṃ ca kathayāmāsa sarvathā | brahmā prāha śṛṇu putra gaccha tvaṃ śaṃkaraṃ prati || 125|| divyaṃ pāśupataṃ cāstraṃ dāsyati kṛṣṇavarma ca | paścād vijeṣyasi putra śaṃbhumārādhya sarvathā || 1 26|| ityājñayā yayau rāmaḥ śivaṃ kailāsamuttamam | nanāmovāca kāryārthī brahmoktaṃ sarvameva ca || 127|| śivastasmai dadau mantraṃ kavacaṃ vijayapradam | nāgapāśaṃ pāśupataṃ brahmāstraṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā || 1 28|| nārāyaṇāstramāgneyaṃ vāyavyaṃ gāruḍaṃ tathā | gāndharvaṃ jṛṃbhaṇāstraṃ ca gadāṃ śaktiṃ triśūlakam || 1 29|| daṇḍaṃ paraśuṃ śastrāstrajālaṃ rāmaḥ praharṣitaḥ | yayau natvā puṣkaraṃ saḥ sādhayāmāsa sarvathā || 1.381.13 0|| agastyoktena mārgeṇa kṛṣṇamārādhya bhaktitaḥ | kṛṣṇaṃ sākṣād dṛṣṭavām̐śca kṛṣṇaḥ prāha bhṛgūdvaham || 131 || mama cakrāvatāraṃ hi kārtavīryaṃ vināśaya | madaṃśāveśayuktastvaṃ kṣauṇyāṃ vicara bhārgava || 1 32|| rāmaścāhaṃ punarbhūtvā hariṣye teja eva te | ityuktvāntardadhe kṛṣṇo rāmo māhiṣmatīṃ yayau || 133 || yuddhaṃ vavre’rjunād rāmo’rjuno yuddhāya niryayau | anekākṣauhiṇīyukto dadarśāpaśakunaṃ pathi || 1 34|| sarajaskā diśo vyoma nistejastvaṃ grahādikam | muktakeśāṃ chinnanāsāṃ rudatīṃ ca digambarām || 135 || kṛṣṇavastraparīdhānāṃ vanitāṃ sa dadarśa ca | kucailaṃ patitaṃ bhagnaṃ nagnaṃ kāṣāyavāsasam || 136 || aṃgahīnaṃ dadarśāsau naraṃ duḥkhitamānasam | godhāṃ ca śaśakaṃ śalyaṃ riktakuṃbhaṃ sarīsṛpam || 1 37|| kārpāsaṃ kacchapaṃ tailaṃ lavaṇaṃ cāsthikhaṇḍakam | svadakṣiṇe śṛgālaṃ ca kurvantaṃ bhairavaṃ ravam || 1 38|| rogiṇaṃ pulkasaṃ caiva vṛṣaṃ ca śyenabhallukau | dṛṣṭvāpi prayayau yoddhuṃ kālapāśāvṛto haṭhāt || 1 39|| śataputrānarjunaṃ ca śatākṣauhiṇikāyutān | dārayāmāsa saṃgrāme rāmaḥ śastrāstramaṇḍalaiḥ || 1.381.140|| tato yayau sa kailāsaṃ darśanārthaṃ śivasya vai | gopurasthagaṇeśena ruddho dantaṃ gaṇeśituḥ || 141 || bhaṃktvā dṛṣṭvā śivāṃ śaṃbhumājagāma piturgṛham | dadarśa pitarau rāmaḥ papāta pādayostayoḥ || 142|| uvāca kārtavīryasya hananaṃ vāmanugrahāt | rāmaṃ pitā sāntvayitvā prāyaścittaṃ dadau tataḥ || 143 || mahendrādriṃ yayau prāyaścittaṃ rāmaścakāra ha | tatra kṛtvāśramapadaṃ tapastepe suduṣkaram || 144|| tataḥ kadācid vipine caturaṃgabalānvitāḥ | anye sahasrārjunajāḥ putrāstadāśramaṃ yayuḥ || 145|| jamadagneḥ śiro hṛtvā prayayuḥ svapurīṃ prati | bhartāraṃ nihataṃ bhūmau patitaṃ vīkṣya reṇukā || 146 || samudbhāvya citāgniṃ ca viveśa bhasmatāṃ gatā | bhartrā saha satī vaihāyasā yānena cāmbare || 147|| devarṣipūjitā svargaṃ yayau paścāt tadātmajāḥ | anye cakrustadūrdhvaṃ yatkartavyamanantaram || 148|| tataḥ kāle gate rāmaḥ svāśramaṃ tvāyayau vanāt | pitustu jīvaharaṇaṃ śiroharaṇamityapi || 149|| mātuśca maraṇaṃ śrutvā kṣatranāśe mano dadhe | kṣatravaṃśyānaśeṣeṇa hatvā taddehalohitaiḥ || 1.381.150|| kariṣye tarpaṇaṃ pitroriti niścitya saṃyayau | prāpya māhiṣmatīṃ rāmaḥ ṭaṃkārān dhanuṣo’karot || 151 || sahasrārjunapuṃtrāśca rājānaścaturaṃgiṇaḥ | yuyudhire samāgatya hatā rāmeṇa dudruvuḥ || 152|| udairayat bhārgavo’straṃ tadā kālāgnināmakam | purīṃ prākārasahitāṃ pradadāhāstrapāvakaḥ || 153|| bhasmāvaśeṣaṃ tadrājyaṃ kṛtvā niḥkṣatriyāṃ mahīm | mahendrādriṃ yayau rāmastapase dhṛtamānasaḥ || 154|| varṣadvayena bhūyo’pi kṛtvā niḥkṣatriyāṃ mahīm | bhūyo’pi viralaṃ pṛthvyāṃ kṣatramutpāditaṃ dvijaiḥ || 155|| jaghāna bhūmau niḥśeṣaṃ sākṣāt kāla ivāntakaḥ | yathā yathā kṣitau bhūyaḥ kṣatravaṃśaḥ prakāśitaḥ || 156|| triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthvīṃ cakre niḥkṣatriyāṃ muhuḥ | tato mūrdhābhiṣiktānāṃ ṣaṭsahasradvayaṃ punaḥ || 157|| jīvagrāhaṃ gṛhītvaiva kurukṣetraṃ jagāma saḥ | sarasāṃ pañcakaṃ tatra khānayitvā bhṛgūdvahaḥ || 158|| jaghāna tatra vai rājñaḥ śarīraprabhavāsṛjā | sarāṃsi tāni vai pañca pūrayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ || 159|| pitṝn santarpayāmāsa śrāddhaṃ pitroścakāra ha | tato nivṛttaḥ rāmo’sau gayātīrthaṃ yayau punaḥ || 1.381.160|| samantapaṃcakaṃ tīrthaṃ kurukṣetre’bhavaddhi tat | yatra snātaḥ sarvatīrthaiḥ snāto bhavati mānavaḥ || 161 || gayāyāṃ pitarastasya pitṛlokādupāgatāḥ | jagṛhustatkṛtāṃ pūjāṃ jamadagnipurogamāḥ || 162|| prāhuḥ rāma mahatkarma kṛtvā tarpitavānasi | vadhācca vinivartasva prāyaścittaṃ punaḥ kuru || 163|| śamamāpnuhi bhadraṃ te ityuktvāntardadhuśca te | rāmastīrthāni sarvāṇi jagāma śuddhikāmyayā || 164|| tato yayau mahendrādriṃ hayamedhaṃ cakāra saḥ | kaśyapāya dadau pṛthvīṃ cacāra bhārgavastapaḥ || 165|| iti te kathitā lakṣmi parśurāmacamatkṛtiḥ | pātivratyaṃ reṇukāyāḥ putrasya pitṛbhaktatā || 166|| kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca daurātmyaṃ phalaṃ vināśa ityapi | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya tattadbhaktiphalaṃ bhavet || 167|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye pativratāyā reṇukāyāḥ kāmadhenvāśca prabhāveṇa parśurāmakṛtakṣatriyanāśo mṛtajamadagnisajīvanatā reṇukājamadagnyośca svarganivāsa ityādinirūpaṇanāmā ekāśītyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||381 ||
<1.382> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi pātivratyaṃ paraṃ tava | māṃ vihāya kadāpi tvaṃ tiṣṭhase na janāntare || 1 || yatra yatrāsti meṃ’śo vai tatra tatrāsi cāṃśataḥ | pātivratyaṃ paraṃ mukhyaṃ dharmaṃ dhṛtvā hi vartase || 2 || ahaṃ cāpi hṛdi rakṣan patnīvrataparāyaṇaḥ | vartāmi ca tvayi lakṣmi sarvātmanāntare bahiḥ || 3 || madicchātaḥ purā jātā lakṣmīstvaṃ hṛdayād bahiḥ | vaikuṇṭhe tvaṃ tato jātā satī nārāyaṇapriyā || 4 || goloke rādhikārūpā kṛṣṇapriyāsi sarvadā | śrīśca tvaṃ vartase cāvyākṛte dhāmni mama priyā || 5 || śvetadvīpe’pi me patnī kṣīrābdhau tvaṃ ramāsi me | prabhā ca pārvatī cāsi mama dhāmni cidambare || 6 || māṇikī ca varārohā sarvadāsi mamāsanam | kṣīrābdhau tvaṃ tato jātā jātā kedāraputrikā || 7 || bhṛgoḥ khyātyāṃ samutpannā jātā padmā tathā priyā | anaraṇyagṛhe tvaṃ vai dharaṇyāṃ cāpi me priyā || 8 || tathā tvaṃ kambharālakṣmīrjātā saurāṣṭrake śubhe | sā tvaṃ nityā jaganmātā viṣṇoḥ śrīranapāyinī || 9 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasakthni vāme gaurasvarūpiṇī | vartase tvaṃ sadā lakṣmīradṛśyā sevikā satī || 1.382.1 0|| yathā sarvagataścāhaṃ tathā sarvagatāsi vai | na tvāṃ vinā kvaciccāhaṃ māṃ vinā tvaṃ na ca kvacit || 11 || apṛthakasiddhatādātmyaṃ vartate lakṣmi nau sadā | sadā sarvatra sarvāsi sarvaścāsmi tathāpyaham || 12|| patitvaṃ me sadā te ca patnītvaṃ sarvadā priye | karmaṇā manasā vācā varṣmaṇā guṇacintanaiḥ || 1 3|| jāgrati svāpane ghore suṣuptāvapi turyake | sthāne cātmani sarvatra viṣaye vilaye tathā || 14|| sṛṣṭau laye cidākāśe jaḍe cetanavargake | kārye vā kāraṇe lakṣmi sadā tvaṃ me pativratā || 15|| patnīvratastathājasraṃ bhavāmyeva na saṃśayaḥ | ahaṃ viṣṇuśca sarvatra vyāpako’smi satī sadā || 16 || tvaṃ tatra vyāpinī devī mama śaktisvarūpiṇī | akṣareśo’pyahaṃ tvaṃ cākṣarī bhavasi matpriyā || 17|| mukteśo’haṃ yadā lakṣmi muktānī tvaṃ hi vartase | jayā ca lalitā tvaṃ vai harikṛṣṇastadāpyaham || 18|| aha cārthastvaṃ ca vāṇī nītistvaṃ ca nayo’smyaham | bodhaścāhaṃ tvaṃ ca buddhirdharmo’haṃ tvaṃ ca satkriyā || 19 || sraṣṭā cāhaṃ tvaṃ ca sṛṣṭirbhūmistvaṃ bhūedharo’smyaham | santoṣo’ha tvaṃ ca tuṣṭiḥ kāmo’haṃ tvaṃ ca kāmanā || 1.382.20 || yajño’haṃ dakṣiṇā vai tvaṃ vedo’haṃ tvaṃ ca vedikā | ājyāhutistvamevāsi puroḍāśo’smi vai tadā || 21 | | patnīśālā tvamevāsi prāgvaṃśo’haṃ bhavāmi ca | yūpo’haṃ ca citistvaṃ ca tvamidhmā ca kuśo’smyaham || 22 | | udgītistvaṃ ca sāmāhaṃ tvaṃ svāhāhaṃ hutāśanaḥ | gaurī tvaṃ śaṃkaraścāhaṃ tvaṃ prabhāhaṃ divākaraḥ || 23 || ahaṃ pitṛṇastvaṃ ca svadhā śāśvatapuṣṭidā | ākāśo’haṃ tathā tvaṃ dyauścandro’haṃ tvaṃ ca kaumudī || 24 || vāyuścāhaṃ dhṛtistvaṃ vai velā tvaṃ sāgaro’smyaham | indrāṇī tvaṃ mahendro’haṃ dhūmorṇā tvaṃ yamo’smyaham || 25 || ṛddhistvaṃ ca kubero’haṃ gaurī tvaṃ varuṇo’smyaham | devasenā tvamevāsi senānyahaṃ ca kārtikaḥ || 26 || avaṣṭaṃbho’smyahaṃ yatra tatra śaktistvameva me | tvaṃ kāṣṭhāsi nimeṣo’smi muhūrto’haṃ kalāsi me || 27 || tvaṃ jyotsnāhaṃ pradīpo’smi drumo’haṃ tvaṃ latāsi vai | divaso’haṃ niśā tvaṃ ca vadhūstvaṃ ca varo’smyaham || 28 || nado’haṃ tvaṃ nadīrūpā patākā tvaṃ dhvajo’smyaham | lobho’haṃ tvamasi tṛṣṇā rāgo’haṃ tvaṃ ratirmatā | | 29 | | devatiryaṅmanuṣyādau māyā tvaṃ māyiko’smyaham | durvāsaḥśāpatastvaṃ tu mahendrādriṃ vihāya vai | | 1.382.30 | | samude’tīva saṃmagnā punaścāvirbabhūvitha | tvaṃ siddhistvaṃ padminī ca khyātyāṃ lakṣmīrbhṛgoḥ sutā | | 31 | | narmadāyāstaṭe tvaṃ tu bhārgavī divyavigrahā | jātamātrā yuvatī tvaṃ tepiṣe duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ | | 32 | | nārāyaṇaḥ patirme’stu caturbāhuḥ svayaṃ hariḥ | iti varṣāyutaṃ sādhvi tvayā taptaṃ paraṃ tapaḥ | | 33 | | nityaṃ ṣoḍaśavarṣīyā vṛddhihāsavivarjitā | tejomaṇḍalamadhyasthā bhṛgukṛcchocchrayasthitā | | 34| | varṣasahasraṃ pañcāgnau tapaścakartha dāruṇam | tato varṣasahasraṃ vai taṇḍulāhārakaṃ tapaḥ | | 35 | | tato varṣasahasraṃ vai phalāhāraparāyaṇā | tato varṣasahasraṃ vai kandāhāraparāyaṇā | |36 | | tato varṣasahasraṃ vai patrāhāraparāyaṇā | tato varṣasahasraṃ tvaṃ śuṣkapatraparāyaṇā | | 37| | tato varṣasahasraṃ tvaṃ jalaphenaparāyaṇā | tato varṣasahasraṃ tvaṃ kvacijjalaparāyaṇā | | 38 | | tato varṣasahasraṃ tvaṃ dhūmrabāṣpaparāyaṇā | tato varṣasahasraṃ vai vāyupānaparāyaṇā | | 39 | | ekādaśe sahasre tvaṃ sarvendriyanirodhinī | brahmaraṃdhraṃ samāsādya samādhiṃ mayi cāgatā | |1.382.40 | | tvayā stuto’pyahaṃ neti vivāhārthaṃ jagād ha | tvayā prāṇān parityaktuṃ jñāpayitvā drutaṃ tu me | |41 | | brahmarandhraṃ samuddhāṭya yāvadūrdhvaṃ gatiḥ kṛtā | tāvanmayā samāgatya punā randhre niveśitā | |42 | | tvayoktaṃ tu tadā lakṣmi yā tvaṃ me patirbhava | tadā rodhaya me prāṇānanyathā tvaṃ viyojaya | |43 | | vihasya sāśrunetro’haṃ premapulakitāṃgakaḥ | hṛṣṭaromā svedagātro’bhavamāśliṣṭavānapi | |44| | proktavām̐stvaṃ nivartasva tapasaścātidāruṇāt | yāvatsṛṣṭirbrahmalokastāvatpatnīṃ karomi vai | |45 | | gaccha tvaṃ pitaraṃ lakṣmi mātaraṃ vada sarvathā | āgacchati vivāhārthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | |46 | | ityuktā tvaṃ samutthāya natvā spṛṣṭvānanaṃ mama | sarvaṃ samarpitaṃ kṛtvā gatā svapitṛmandiram | |47| | ahaṃ yātaśca vaikuṇṭhaṃ tadā sasmāra nāradam | saptarṣīn rādhikāṃ śrīṃ ca māṇikīṃ pārvatīṃ prabhām | |48 | | te sarve tu samāgatya papracchuḥ kāraṇaṃ tu mām | mayā gadito vṛttānto bhārgavīyogasaṃbhavaḥ | |49| | narmadāyāstaṭe ramye bhagurbrāhmaṇasattamaḥ | divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu samupāste haraṃ prabhum ||1.382.50 || valmīkāvasthitaścāsau dakṣiṇaṃ ca niketanam | taṃ dhyāyati samādhistho varaṃ prārthayate tathā |||51 || āścaryaṃ tu mahajjātamumāyāḥ śaṃkarasya ca | gaurī pṛcchati śaṃbhuṃ tu valmīkastho’yamasti kaḥ ||52 || śaṃbhuḥ prāha bhṛgurnāmā ṛṣīṇāṃ pravaro muniḥ | varaṃ dhyāyati tapati prārthayatyeva śaṃkarāt |||53 || tadā prahasitā gaurī śaṃkaraṃ pratyabhāṣata | dhūmavattu śikhā jātā tato’dyāpi na tuṣyasi ||54|| durārādhyo’si me nātha kathamevaṃ tu vartase | śivaḥ prāha mahādevi bhṛguḥ krodhena ceṣṭitaḥ |||55|| darśayāmi tathā tathyaṃ priyaṃ te ca karomyaham | smārito devadevena dharmarūpo vṛṣastadā |||56 || smaraṇād devadevasya vṛṣaḥ śīghramupasthitaḥ | vadate mānuṣīṃ vācamādeśo dīyatāṃ prabho ||57|| valmīkaiśchādito vipraḥ eva bhūmau nipātaya | yogasthastu tato dhyāyam̐statastena nipātitaḥ ||58|| tatkṣaṇāt krodhasantapto hastamutkṣiptavān vṛṣam | eṣa saṃbhāṣamāṇaśca kutra gacchasi bho vṛṣa ||59|| adya tvāmatra pāpmānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ hanmyahaṃ vṛṣa | dharṣitastu tadā vipro hyantarikṣagataṃ vṛṣam ||1.382.6 0|| ākāśe prekṣate vipro hyetadadbhutamuttamam | tataḥ prahasite rudre ṛṣiragre vyavasthitaḥ ||6 1 | | tṛtīyaṃ locanaṃ dṛṣṭvā vailakṣyāt patito bhuvi | praṇamya daṇḍavat bhūmau stauti śrīparameśvaram ||62|| alīkāhaṃkārayuktaṃ kṣaṇabhaṃguravaibhavam | krūraṃ kupathapatitaṃ trāhi māṃ parameśvara ||63 || śīghraṃ harasva me tṛṣṇāṃ lakṣmīṃ dehi ca hṛcchrayām | chindhi pāśān bhavajātān samuddhāraya śaṃkara ||64|| rudravedī bhavedeṣā nārāyaṇasvarūpiṇī | yadi tuṣṭo’si viśveśa caitatsampādayasva me ||65|| tathāstviti tadā prāha śaṃbhurlokahitāya vai | nārāyaṇī mahālakṣmīḥ putrī te’tra bhaviṣyati ||66|| krodhasthānaṃ rudravedī bhṛgukṣetraṃ bhaviṣyati | na pitā putrayoścātra hyekavākyaṃ bhaviṣyati ||67|| ityuktvā ca harastasmāttirobhūcca bhṛgorgṛhe | divyā saṃkalpajā putrī lakṣmīrjātātiśobhanā ||68|| khyātiḥ putrīmatī jātā puṣpavṛṣṭirdivaukasām | babhūva cotsavaścāpi vaikuṇṭhamiva bhūrabhūt ||69|| tadā prabhṛti brahmādyāḥ sarve devāḥ sakinnarāḥ | upāsate bhṛgostīrthaṃ tuṣṭo yatra maheśvaraḥ ||1.382.70|| nityaṃ yatrābhavallakṣmīrbhārgavī vai narāyaṇī | nārāyaṇaṃ patiṃ labdhuṃ tapastepe’tidāruṇam ||71 || ahaṃ tuṣṭaśca tapasāyutavarṣottaraṃ yayau | tasyai paṇaṃ mayā dattaṃ vivāhāya tato mayā ||72|| gantavyaṃ vai bhṛgukṣetraṃ vararūpeṇa vai yataḥ | vaikuṇṭhāttu gamiṣyāmaḥ kurvantu sajjatāṃ priyāḥ ||73 || bhṛgutuṃge munivaryo bhṛguḥ khyātyā virājate | aṣṭāśītisahasraiśca brahmarṣibhistapodhanaḥ ||74|| tato dūraṃ narmadāyāstaṭe viṣṇurvirājite | pañcāśadyojane bhāge viṣṇutīrthe vayaṃ khalu ||75|| vaikuṇṭhaṃ kārayitvaiva pārthivaṃ viśvakarmaṇā | sthāsyāmaśca trayastriṃśatkoṭi devā api priyāḥ ||76|| devatīrthe taṭe tatra naḥ sthāsyanti pravāhitaḥ | ṛṣitīrthe ca ṛṣayo mānavāścakratīrthake ||77|| śuklatīrthe ca kṛṣṇādyāḥ sarve vai parameśvarāḥ | brahmatīrthe tathā muktāḥ sthāsyanti mahīmānakāḥ ||78|| evaṃ vai nārmade deśe vatsyāmo vayamādarāt | kārtikyāṃ ca kariṣyāmo vaikuṇṭhaṃ tatra nūtanam ||79|| māghyāṃ vivāhavidhaye yāsyāmo bhṛgupattanam | iti sarvān vinirdiśya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||1.382.80|| āhūya pṛthivīṃ devīṃ samājñāpayadacyutaḥ | kuru revātaṭaṃ riktaṃ śatayojanavistaram ||81 || samatalaṃ samudyānairvyavasthitaiḥ suśobhitam | sarvakhādyakhaniyuktāḥ śālāstatra ca kāraya |||82|| vastūni cāpi sarvāṇi tatropasthāpaya priye | sasyānnāni phalapatrakandamūlāni sarvathā ||83|| veṣavārāṇi divyāni gandhacūrṇāni yāni ca | miṣṭānnāni ca mṛṣṭāni śarkarādīni cāpi vai ||84|| upasthāpaya te garbhe gahvareṣu bahūni ca | bhava divyā mama yogād vaikuṇṭhābhā vasundharā ||85|| ityāśīrvādamādāya bhūmistatra samāgatā | śatayojanavistāre bhūgarbhe sarvasampadaḥ ||86|| racayitvā nidhāyaiva svasthā cāste mudānvitā | varuṇaṃ jaladevaṃ ca samāhūya narāyaṇaḥ ||87|| ādideśāmṛtādīnāṃ peyānāṃ payasāmapām | dadhnāṃ ca mādakānāṃ ca ghṛtānāṃ rasināṃ tathā ||88|| madhūnāṃ gūḍavārīṇāṃ drumāṇāṃ rasaśālinām | somavallīkalpalatākalpadrumādisampadām ||89|| rasānāṃ ca pravāhāṇāṃ peyānāṃ vipulān hradān | kartuṃ bhartuṃ dideśāpi so’pi gatvā tathākarot ||1.382.90 || sūryaṃ candraṃ vidyutaśca vāḍavāgniṃ mahānalam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścājñāpayāmāsa mahānasān ||91 || pākaśālā vividhāśca vahniśālāśca bāṣpadāḥ | kartuṃ racayituṃ tatra śītoṣṇakuṇḍavaibhavān ||92|| dīpapradīpaśobhāśca candrikāśītalaprabhāḥ | sphītālokānmahālokānandhakāraprakalpakān ||93 || kaṇḍanīḥ peṣaṇīścullīścodakuṃbhīśca mārjanīḥ | divyā divyadravopetāḥ kartuṃ dideśa keśavaḥ ||94|| vāyuṃ tathā samāhūya prāṇām̐śca marutastathā | vyajanānāṃ ca tālānāṃ mandasugandhaśālinaḥ || 95|| śītān vāyūn kvacittūṣṇān kartumajījñapaddhariḥ | ākāśaṃ ca samāhūya cidākāśamathākarot ||96 || vibhūtiṃ tatra saṃpreṣya vaikuṇṭhānyamathākarot | meghānprāha hariḥ kṛṣṇaśchatrāṇi racayantviti ||97|| indraṃ rājopakaraṇānyāhartuṃ prāha mādhavaḥ | kuberaṃ sarvaratnāḍhyayantrānayanamādiśat || 98|| yamaṃ prāha mahāsainyaṃ śobhārthaṃ kuru cāgragam | śaṃbhuṃ prāha haristatra sagaṇaṃ nartanāya vai ||99|| vādyānāṃ vādanārthaṃ tu sarasvatyai nyavedayat | maṇḍapānāṃ racanārthaṃ dideśa viśvakarmaṇe || 1.382.10 0|| śobhādhikyakaraṇārthaṃ prairayad devaśilpinaḥ | bhṛgvādiṣṭo gururlagnaṃ dṛṣṭvā vilikhya patrikām || 101 || dhāma yayau dadau bhūmne vādyānyavādayacca saḥ | nāradaṃ preṣayāmāsāhvanārthaṃ triṣu sṛṣṭiṣu || 1 02|| baliśeṣādayaḥ pātālasthā ākāritāstathā | parvatādyāḥ saritaśca tīrthāni jaḍacetanāḥ || 103 || ṛṣayo munayo devāḥ pitaro brahmacāriṇaḥ | sādhvyaśca sādhavaḥ sarve sātvatā āhutāstathā || 1 04|| īśāśceśeśvarāścāpi bhagavanto digīśvarāḥ | lokapālāḥ prajāpālāstattveśāḥ parameśvarāḥ || 1 05|| brahmāṇo viṣṇavo rudrā ādityā vasavastathā | vairājā vālakhilyāśca yāmyā grahāśca tārakāḥ || 1 06|| ketavaścāvaraṇasthā īśvarā amṛtākṣarāḥ | vaikuṇṭhasthāśca golokavāsinaḥ śvetadhāmagāḥ || 1 07|| māyālokaparāścānye tejaḥparāstathāpare | muktāśca dhāmavāsāśca śaktayo muktayoṣitaḥ || 1 08|| brahmāṇyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginyo bhagavatyaśca devatāḥ | īśvariṇyastathārṣyaśca vedā vedānya ityapi || 1 09|| avatārāstathā cāvatāriṇyo hariyoṣitaḥ | mānavyo vallikāḥ sarvā kāśyapyaḥ pramadāstathā || 1.382.11 0|| kumārikāśca sadhavāstathā haridhavāḥ parāḥ | jaḍāśca cetanāḥ sarvāḥ samahūtāśca yoṣitaḥ || 111 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyātra bhārgavyā saha lagnake | vivāhotsavavṛddhyarthaṃ mādhyāmāyāntu madgṛhe || 11 2|| akṣarādhipatiḥ sākṣātpuruṣottamasaṃjñakaḥ | ākārayāmyatipremṇaikādaśyāṃ madgṛhe śubhe || 11 3|| maṇḍapārohaṇe yāne kanyāpitṛgṛhe tathā | sahāyāḥ santu sarve vai svayaṃ tuṣyāmyahaṃ hariḥ || 1 14|| akṣare mama dhāmnyatra samāgacchantu sagṛhāḥ | sarve vayaṃ gamiṣyāmo bhuvi bhārgavapattanam || 1 15|| narmadāyāstaṭe ramye śuklatīrthe kṛtāśrame | bhārgavyāstu vivāhārthaṃ tato yāsyāma īśvarāḥ || 116 || kuṃkumapatrikāstvevaṃ brahmāṇḍeṣu pratistaram | preṣitāḥ pārṣadaiścātha maṃgalānyabhavam̐stataḥ || 1 17|| devyastu gītikāścakrurmaṃgalāyatanāḥ śubhāḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ piṣṭacūrṇamardanamācaran || 1 18|| vādakāścāruvādyāni sarvataścāpyavādayan | jagustu devagandharvā nartakyo nṛtyamācaran || 11 9|| mahīmānāḥ samājagmurakṣarākhyaṃ gṛhaṃ prati | mānaṃ satkāramācakre bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ || 1.382.1 20|| bhojayāmāsa divyāni miṣṭānnānyamṛtāni ca | pāyayāmāsa divyāni vārīṇyamṛtakāni ca || 121 || śṛṃgāraveṣaramyāṇi yānavāhanakāni ca | koṭiśo hastinaḥ śvetā garuḍāḥ koṭiśastathā || 1 22|| haṃsāḥ siṃhā vṛṣā nīlakaṇṭhāścāpi ca koṭiśaḥ | aśvāśca koṭiśo divyāḥ śarabhā gavayādayaḥ || 1 23|| arbudāḥ śeṣaśayyāśca śibikāḥ koṭikoṭiśaḥ | paryyaḥ sapakṣāścānantā īśānyaḥ pakṣacārikāḥ || 1 24|| saṃyuñjanti sma vāhinyāṃ vivāhaprotsavotsukāḥ | anantāścākṣaramuktā golokasthā anantakāḥ || 1 25|| śrīkṛṣṇena saha yātā vaikuṇṭhasthā asaṃkhyakāḥ | amṛtasthā hiraṇyasthā āvṛtisthā virāṭsthitāḥ || 126 || satyasthāśca janādisthā devāḥ sṛpāśca mānavāḥ | sthāvarā jaṃgamāḥ sarve vāhinyāmāyayurmudā || 1 27|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāsti bhārgavyā saha lagnakam | gacchāmastaddarśanārthaṃ samāyāntu kuṭumbinaḥ || 128|| iti sarve mudā yātāḥ pūjitā bhojitāstathā | ābālavṛddhāḥ saṃbhūya vāhinyāṃ miśritāstadā || 1 29|| varaḥ śṛgāritaḥ samyag yathā rādheśvaro’paraḥ | sākṣatakuṃkumapuṣpamālāmbaravibhūṣaṇaiḥ || 1.382.13 0|| ratnamauktikasauvarṇaśṛṃkhalormikakajjalaiḥ | sugandharasacūrṇādyairāśīrbhirvardhitaḥ punaḥ || 131 || bhārgavyāśca vivāhārthaṃ yayau ṣoḍaśahāyanaḥ | akṣarabrahmalokādvai vaikuṇṭhalokalambinī || 1 32|| vāhinī sābhavaddīrghā varapakṣānuyāyinī | nṛtyamaṃgalavādyādikaṇṭhaghoṣādirañjitā || 133 || arbudārbudasaṃkhyāsthā śuklatīrthaṃ samāyayau | brahmāṇḍeṣu ca sarveṣu maṃgalānyabhavam̐stadā || 1 34|| koṭibhūmikavaikuṇṭhe divye revātaṭe śubhe | śatayojanavistāre lakṣayojanasūcchraye || 135 || nārāyaṇecchayāgamyāyatocchrāyamaye śubhe | asaṃkhyavāhinīlokā yayustatra harīcchayā || 136 || aṇimā mahimā prāptiḥ prākāmyaṃ laghimā tathā | garimā vaśitā kāmāvasāyitā ca siddhayaḥ || 1 37|| bhavanti tu hareryatra tatrāścaryaṃ nu vai kimu | brahmāṇḍānyapyasaṃkhyāni yadromṇā vivareṣu vai || 1 38|| aṇumātre sthale santi tatrāścaryaṃ nu vai kimu | evaṃ samāgatā śuklatīrthe sā varavāhinī || 13 9|| viśaśrāma sukhaṃ tatra naije vaikuṇṭhake mudā | snātāśca bhojitāḥ suptā dhāmadhāmanivāsinaḥ || 1.382.140|| sarvatra maṃgalaṃ jātaṃ sotsukāḥ prāṇinastadā | āyānti śuklatīrthaṃ te vivāhaḥ padmayoriti || 141 || sāvitryā sahito brahmā bhavānyā ca bhavaḥ svayam | anantaścāpi bhoginyā dharmo mūrtyādibhiḥ saha || 142|| bhāskaraḥ prabhayā sākaṃ svāhayā tu hutāśanaḥ | smṛddhyā sākaṃ kuberaśca varuṇo vāruṇīyutaḥ || 143 || pavanaścāpi cāṃjanyā yamo dhūmyā sahāyayau | rohiṇyādiyutaścandraḥ śacīyuktaḥ sureśvaraḥ || 144|| rudrāṇyādiyutā rudrā ādityāḥ saha saṃjñayā | vasavaścāpi gandharvāḥ kinnarā devadānavāḥ || 145 || āyayuḥ śuklatīrthaṃ te vivāhaḥ padmayoriti | dṛṣṭvā tu devatādyā vai vaikuṇṭhaṃ nūtanaṃ kṛtam || 146 || ākāśācca vimānaiśca samprāpya narmadātaṭam | pattanaṃ nūtanaṃ caiva bhṛgukacchasamīpataḥ || 147|| muktāmāṇikyahīrādiratnarājivirājitam | paritaścaturasraṃ ca śatayojanasammitam || 148|| saptabhiḥ parikhābhiśca gaṃbhīrābhistu veṣṭitam | prākāraiḥ ṣoḍaśalakṣaistrayastriṃśatsarovaraiḥ || 149 || sapadmaiḥ sarvatobhadraiḥ puṣpodyānāyutāyutaiḥ | praphullapuṣpaiḥ pavanaiḥ sarvatra surabhīkṛtam || 1.382.15 0|| āmoditaṃ ca śītena mandacandanavāyubhiḥ | tarubhiḥ koṭilakṣaiśca bhūṣitaṃ cāmrabhūruhaiḥ || 151 || nārīkelaiśca panasairnavaraṃgaiśca dāḍimaiḥ | drākṣābhirnāgavallībhirelālavaṃgakaiśca ha || 152|| badarībhiśca bilvaiśca jambūbhiścampakaistathā | bakulaistintiḍībhiśca jambīrairikṣubhistathā | | 153 || kharjūrairnāgaraṃgaiśca dhātrībhiḥ phalavaddrumaiḥ | anyairudyānavaryaiśca yuktaṃ śādvalasaṃplutam | | 154|| asaṃkhyairmandirai ramyairatyuccairapi saṃskṛtam | tattaddhāmnāṃ sucitraiśca rājitaṃ kalaśānvitaiḥ | | 155|| maṇisopānanikarairdivyastaṃbhojjvalaṃ tathā | darpaṇaiḥ sūkṣmavastraiśca śobhitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ | | 156|| prāṃgaṇaiḥ padmarāgādyairindranīlapariṣkṛtam | sacatvaraiḥ rājamārgairdevadevībhirañcitam || 157|| dṛṣṭvā vaikuṇṭhanagaraṃ sarve te vismayaṃ yayuḥ | viṣṇuḥ padmaḥ śrīśca padmā śvaśurastu bhṛguḥ svayam || 158|| jāmātā bhagavān yatra kiṃ nyūnaṃ yatra vai bhavet | gāndharvāḥ kinnarā vidyādharyaḥ kinnarya īśikāḥ || 159|| nartakyo gāyikā vādyabhāṇḍakā gāyakāstathā | bhikṣukā gaṇakā bhaṭṭā bhūpā vaidyāśca sevakāḥ || 1.382.160 || naṭā mallā bahurūpā veṣadhrā mānavāstathā | sotsāhā āyayustatra vivāhaḥ padmayoriti || 161 || bhṛgukacche’pi sannyāsiyatinaiṣṭhikayoginaḥ | bhṛgvāhūtā āyayurvai vivāhaḥ padmayoriti || 162|| sanakaśca sanandaśca sanat sanātanastathā | āyayustrikoṭiśiṣyairvivāhaḥ padmayoriti || 163|| durvāsā lakṣaśiṣyaiśca lakṣyabhṛtyaiśca kaśyapaḥ | patnīvato lakṣaśiṣyairvivāhaḥ padmayoriti || 164|| gautamo’yutaśiṣyaiśca vālmīko’yutaśiṣyakaiḥ | śukraśca koṭiśiṣyo’gurvivāhaḥ padmayoriti || 165 || bhāradvājo’yutaśiṣyaiḥ koṭyā bṛhaspatiḥ svayam | aṃgiro’yutaśiṣyaiśca vivāhaḥ padmayoriti || 166 || lakṣaśiṣyairvaśiṣṭhaśca pracetā lakṣaśiṣyavān | pulastyo lakṣaśiṣyo’pi vivāhaḥ padmayoriti || 167|| agastyo lakṣaśiṣyaiśca pulaho lakṣaśiṣyayuk | kraturlakṣeṇa cātristu koṭiśiṣyeṇa cāgataḥ || 1 68|| marīcirlakṣaśiṣyaiśca śatānandaḥ sahasrakaiḥ | bhṛgorgṛhaṃ samājagmurvivāhaḥ padmayoriti || 169 || sārdhaṃ sahasraśiṣyaiśca ṛṣyaśṛṃgo vibhāṇḍakaḥ | pāṇiniḥ koṭiśiṣyaiścāyutaiḥ kātyāyanastathā || 1.382.170|| yājñavalkyaḥ sahasraiśca vyāsaḥ koṭipraśiṣyakaiḥ | gargoyutena śiṣyāṇāṃ vivāhaḥ padmayoriti || 171 | gālavo’pi sahasreṇa sahasreṇa ca saubhariḥ | koṭinā lomaśaścāpi vivāhaḥ padmayoriti || 172|| sāndīpanirdevalaśca mārkaṇḍeyaśca lakṣakaiḥ | pañcaśikhaśca gopālo voḍhuśca lakṣaśiṣyakaiḥ || 173 || svayaṃprakāśastathāhaṃ naro nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | viśvāmitraḥ koṭibhiśca vivāhaḥ padmayoriti || 174| jaratkāruśca lakṣeṇāstīkaścāyutaśiṣyakaiḥ | parśurāmaḥ sahasreṇa vivāhaḥ padmayoriti || 175| vatsaḥ śatena dakṣastriśatena kapilo’yutaiḥ | savarto’yutaśiṣyādyairvivāhaḥ padmayoriti || 176 || utathyaḥ śataśiṣyaiśca śataiścāpi ca bhāgu riḥ | samāyayustvasaṃkhyātā vivāhaḥ padmayoriti || 1 77|| bhṛgoḥ khyātyāṃ samutpannāṃ lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇapriyām | kṛṣṇaṃ lagnayituṃ yāmo vivāhaḥ padmayoriti || 178|| devau dhātāvidhātārau merorjāmātarāvubhau | lakṣmyāśca bhrātarau teṣāṃ sammānaṃ vai pracakratuḥ | | 179|| āyatirniyatiścāpi meroḥ kanye pativrate | tayordhātṛvidhātṛbhyāṃ prāṇo mṛkaṇḍuraurasau || 1.382.180|| mārkaṇḍeyo mṛkaṇḍośca prāṇod vedaśirā sutaḥ | marīcerapi saṃbhūtau pūrṇamāsaḥ sutastathā || 181 || kanyācatuṣṭayaṃ tuṣṭirvṛṣṭiḥ kṛṣṭiścāpacitiḥ | virajāḥ parvataścobhau pūrṇamāsasya vai sutau || 182|| pulahasya kṣamā patnī putrāḥ kardama ityatha | varīyām̐śca sahiṣṇuśca kanīyām̐śceti vai yayuḥ || 183 || atreḥ patnī hyanasūyā putrāḥ somaśca dattakaḥ | durvāsāścāthāṃgirasaḥ putrī nāmnā smṛtistathā || 184|| vāsiṣṭhāḥ śaktimukhyāśca vāhneyā kratuputrakāḥ | agniṣvāttā bārhiṣadā ājyapāḥ somapāstathā || 185|| vālakhilyāśca ṛṣayo dharaṇī merubhāminī | parvatāḥ saritaścāpi sarāṃsyupavanāni ca || 186|| evamṛṣīṇāṃ vistārā vaṃśāstatra mahotsave | bhṛgorgṛhaṃ samāyātā vivāhaḥ padmayoriti || 187|| matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaśca nṛsiṃhaḥ ṛṣabhastathā | kapilo vāsudevāśca pṛthurdatto munīśvaraḥ || 188|| haṃso harirvāmanaśca parśurāmaḥ kumārakāḥ | yajño rāmo hyagrīvo nārado rājarājakaḥ || 189|| vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇaśca buddhaśca kalkirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam | palīvratastathā cānye śiṣyāḥ yogiprayogiṇaḥ || 1.382.1 90|| saurāṣṭrīyā raivatādreryogasiddhāḥ samāyayuḥ | patnīyuktāḥ samāyātā vivāhaḥ padmayoriti || 191 || kanyāpakṣasya māṇḍapyā hyāsan koṭyabjakādhikāḥ | varapakṣasya vāhinyā hyāsam̐stato’pyasaṃkhyakāḥ || 1 92|| dvādaśyāṃ bhojyapānādyaiḥ satkṛtā mahīmānakāḥ | viśaśramuśca te rātrau gītanṛtyādirañjitāḥ || 1 93|| maṃgalāni vividhāni lokācārāḥ kṛtāḥ parāḥ | hṛṣṭasaddhradayāḥ sarve hyāsan prasannatoṣitāḥ || 194|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye bhṛgoḥ putryā bhārgavyā lakṣmyā kṛtatapasā tuṣṭaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhṛgukacchanikaṭe śuklatīrthe vaikuṇṭhaṃ kārayitvā vivāhārthaṃ samāgatastadvāhinībhṛgumahīmānādivarṇananāmā dvyaśītyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||382||
<1.383> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi bhṛgoḥ putrī mahālakṣmīrhiṃ kānakī | campakapuṣpavarṇābhā projjvalā divyavigrahā || 1 || atīva sundarī ramyā ramā rāmāsu pūjitā | navayauvanasampannā ratnābharaṇabhūṣitā || 2 || taptakāṃcanakāntyāḍhyā tejaḥparidhirājitā | śuddhasatyasvarūpā sā satyaśīlā pativratā || 3 || śāntā dāntā nitāntā cāpyanantaguṇaśālinī | iṃdrāṇī varuṇānī ca candranārī ca rohiṇī || 4 || kuberapatnī sūryastrī svāhā śāntā kalāvatī | anyā api tvahalyādyāḥ pārvatyādyāśca sūjjvalāḥ || 5 || bhārgavyā bhagukanyāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm | tāṃ dṛṣṭvā devanāryaśca bhagavadyoṣitastathā || 6 || śaratpūrṇenduśobhāḍhyāṃ śaratkamalalocanām | vivāhayogyāṃ yuvatīṃ lajjānamrānanāṃ satīm || 7 || mumuhustāḥ śriyaṃ sarvā rūpānurūpavigrahe | dṛṣṭvā stabdhā bhavanti sma līnāḥ kāṣṭhajaḍā iva || 8 || aho nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt patiryayābhiniścitaḥ | tatra kiṃ nāma gauṇaṃ syād guṇe rūpe ca varṣmaṇi || 9 || na kācid bhagavatsṛṣṭāvīdṛśī janitā satī | nāsti na vā ca divyāṃgī bhāvinī vā kadācana || 1.383.1 0|| iyaṃ nārāyaṇī sākṣātpadmā tvastyeva bhārgavī | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇayogyā so’pyasyā yogya eva ca || 11 || ityāścaryaṃ paraṃ procurjahṛṣurdadṛśurmuhuḥ | tṛptāścātmani tāṃ dhyātvā kanyāṃ lakṣmīṃ hi bhārgavīm || 1 2|| menire ca varaṃ yogyaṃ navayauvanasaṃbhṛtam | dharmaśīlaṃ satyasandhaṃ nārāyaṇamadhīśvaram || 1 3||| vedavedāṃgavijñaṃ ca paṇḍitaṃ sundaraṃ śubham | śāntaṃ dāntaṃ kṣamāśīlaṃ guṇinaṃ cirajīvinam || 14|| brahmakulaprasūtaṃ ca sarvatraiva pratiṣṭhitam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pūrṇaṃ brahma śrīpuruṣottamam || 15|| nirliptaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca sākṣiṇaṃ sarvakarmaṇām | yaṃ na jānanti catvāro vedāḥ santaśca devatāḥ || 16|| siddhendrāśca munīndrāśca devā brahmādayastathā | dhyāyanti dhyānapūtāśca yogino na vidanti yam || 17|| sarasvatī jaḍībhūtā vedāḥ śāstrāṇi yāni ca | sahasravaktraḥ śeṣaśca pañcavaktraḥ sadāśivaḥ || 18|| caturmukho jagaddhātā kumāraḥ kārtikastathā | ṛṣayo munayaścāpi bhaktāḥ paramavaiṣṇavāḥ || 1 9|| anye’pi yaṃ na jānanti yathā yāvacca yadguṇaḥ | tamenaṃ varamāsādya bhārgavyāptaṃ janoḥ phalam || 1.383.20|| ghṛtakulyāsahasrāṇi madhukulyāyutāni ca | dadhikulyāsahasrāṇi dugdhakulyāyutāni ca ||21 || tailahradā guḍaśailāḥ śarkarārāśayastathā | miṣṭānnānāṃ parvatāśca piṣṭānāṃ rāśayastathā ||22|| yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ pṛthukānāṃ ca parvatāḥ | vyaṃjanānāṃ rāśayaśca dṛśyanto’kṣayabhūmikāḥ ||23|| aho’smākaṃ mahadbhāgyaṃ yadaitadavalokikam | sotsāhaṃ samprapaśyāmo vivāhaṃ padmayorimam ||24|| prāsādāḥ svargatulyāścāmṛtanadyo vahanti ca | yānāni ca vimānāni vaihāyasāni sarvathā || 25|| haṃsagāruḍahastyādivāhanāni ca koṭiśaḥ | pattanāni bhṛgukacchagirau gireḥ samantataḥ ||26|| nūtanāni kāritāni bhṛguṇā mānasāni vai | yathā navaṃ hi vaikuṇṭhe nārāyaṇena kāritam ||27|| tathā vai bhṛguṇā vārdhitaṭamāyatamujjvalam | śatayojanavistāraṃ lakṣayojanasūcchrayam ||28|| divyaṃ bhṛgupuraṃ tatra kārito maṇḍapaḥ śriyaḥ | samudraśca svayaṃ tatra babhūva satkṛtipradaḥ ||29|| meruścāpi tathā cānye siddhāśca munayo’pare | kalpasiddhāstathā satyayugādyāḥ satkṛtipradāḥ ||1.383.3 0|| āsan kanyāprapakṣe vai kṛṣṇatulyā hi tāpasāḥ | tāpasyaśca śriyā tulyā yatra nyūnaṃ na vai manāk || 31 || maṃgalāni trayodaśyāṃ śiṣṭācārāstathā kṛtāḥ | lokācārāḥ kṛtāścaiva pūjitā bhojitāstathā ||32||| rātrau māṃgalyagītāni nṛtyāni kāritāni ca | nāryaḥ prātaścaturdaśyāṃ devārcanāni cakrire ||33|| devīnāṃ devatānāṃ ca lokācārakṛtāni vai | pūjanāni pracakrustā vadhūyuktāḥ striyaḥ śubhāḥ ||34|| caturdaśyāṃ bhojayitvā bhūmā nārāyaṇau niśi | suveṣaṃ kārayāmāsa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ||35|| atīva ramyamatulaṃ triṣu sṛṣṭiṣu durlabham | sampūjya kārayāmāsa yātrāṃ ca pravaraṃ varam ||36|| kṛṣṇādyāśca tathā nārāyaṇādyā avatārakāḥ | vairājādyāstathā muktā brahmasṛṣṭiprayoṣitaḥ ||37|| rādhāramāprabhādyāśca brahmā viṣṇurmaheśvaraḥ | teṣāṃ patnyo gaṇeśāścarṣayo dyuvāsinastathā ||38|| devā devyo yayuḥ sarve bhṛgupattanamaṇḍapam | tatra koṭyarbudānyāsan svarṇasiṃhāsanāni vai || 39|| sudharmā nirmitā tena samudre svarṇavāluke | nartakyo lakṣaśastatra gāndharvyo lakṣaśastathā ||1.383.40|| kinnaryo gāyikāḥ paryaḥ koṭisaṃkhyā upasthitāḥ | bhṛguṇā nirmitaṃ sarvaṃ bhagavatāṃ pratuṣṭaye ||41 || na bhūtaṃ na ca yadbhāvi klṛptaṃ siddhikṛtaṃ navam | vidyādharyo’pi lakṣaṃ cāpsaraso lakṣaśastathā ||42|| mahāpuraṃ bhaguvyāptaṃ divyaṃ tadbhṛgupattanam | vairājabhavanaṃ yadvat tato’pi tvatibhāsuram ||43|| yasya prākārakalaśe sampratiṣṭhāpito raviḥ | yadantarbhāgamadhye ca pūrṇacandraḥ sthirīkṛtaḥ ||44|| tejomayā dhruvāstvevaṃ rathyāṃ rathyāṃ prati kṛtāḥ | prakāśo’kāraṇastatra vartate bhṛgupattane ||45|| tattvāni mūrtimanti ca sevāyāṃ sthāpitāni vai | cakraḥ praveśanaṃ bhṛgupattanaṃ varayātrikāḥ ||46|| pūrṇimāyāṃ prage sūryadarśane bhṛgusatkṛtāḥ | etasminnantare cāgre buhaspatirupasthitaḥ ||47|| koṭyarbudarṣisaṃyuktaścājagāma hareḥ puraḥ | maṃgalaṃ tu phalaṃ datvā candrakaṃ sākṣataṃ tathā ||48|| puṣpamālāṃ gale datvāvākirat kusumairharim | lokācāraṃ maṃgalaṃ ca vārikalaśadarśanam ||49|| cakruḥ kanyāśca sādhvyaśca grāmagopurasannidhau | vedaghoṣāḥ śrāvitāśca munibhirabhivardhanāḥ ||1.383.50|| puraṃ praveśayāmāsa bṛhaspatirvadan ṛcaḥ | devakanyā nāgakanyā rājakanyā ṛṣeḥ sutāḥ |||51 || munikanyā varaṃ draṣṭuṃ sasmitāśca samāyayuḥ | dadṛśuryoṣitaḥ sarvā nimeṣarahitākṣibhiḥ ||52|| prasannaṃ jaladaśyāmaṃ śobhitaṃ pītavāsasā | candanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ vanamālādibhūṣitam ||53|| ratnakeyūravalayaratnamālākulojjvalam | ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirājitam ||54|| ratnendrasāranirmāṇakvaṇanmañjīrarañjitam | sasmitaṃ muralīhastaṃ paśyantaṃ ratnadarpaṇam |||55|| pārṣadaiḥ śatasāhasraiḥ sevitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ | navayauvanasampannaṃ śaratkamalalocanam ||56|| śaratpūrṇendutulyāsyaṃ ramārādhādihṛdbharam | koṭikandarpasaundarya brahmaśeṣeśavanditam ||57|| paramāhlādakaṃ rūpaṃ koṭicandrasamaprabham | kāmavīryabharaṃ puṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||58|| dūrvayā paṭṭasūtraṃ ca ratnendrasāradarpaṇam | dadhāne katṛkāsādhyaṃ kadalyāḥ sphuramañjarīm ||59|| cūḍāṃ trivikramākārāṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitām | puṣpaṃ nārīpradattaṃ ca mukuṭaṃ mastakojjvalam ||1.383.60|| dṛṣṭvā varaṃ yuvatyaśca mohaṃ prāpuḥ pareśvaram | bhārgavījīvanaṃ dhanyaṃ ślāghyamityūcurīpsitam ||61
