|| jāmātāraṃ sā dadarśa khyātirbhṛgvarṣikāminī | nimeṣarahitā tuṣṭā prasannavadanekṣaṇā ||62|| bhṛguḥ prasannavadanaḥ samuniḥ sapurohitaḥ | samāgatya hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ surān viprānnanāma ha ||63|| dadau viśrāntibhavanaṃ śatayojanavistaram | bhakṣyapūrṇaṃ pānapūrṇaṃ sevikābhirvilāsitam ||64|| bhūmā cakāra mantraiśca śubhādhivāsanaṃ hareḥ | sampūjya mātṛkāḥ sarvāḥ sākṣācca sarvadevatāḥ ||65|| pradāya vasudhārāṃ ca vṛddhiśrāddhādikaṃ tathā | sarvān saṃbhojayāmāsa pāyayāmāsa sadrasān ||66| vādyāni vādayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṃgalam | subeṣaṃ kārayāmāsa varasyāpratimasya ca ||67|| susajjaṃ kārayāmāsa narayānaṃ suśobhanam | evaṃ munirbhṛguścāpi vivāhārthaṃ sumaṃgalam ||68|| purohitena guruṇā mantrairakārayadvidhim | ratnāni ca dhanādyāni muktāmāṇikyahīrakam ||69|| bhakṣyāṇi cāmbarādīni dadau dānāni cārthiṇe | vādyāni vādayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṃgalam ||1.383.70|| suveṣaṃ kārayāmāsa bhārgavyāḥ sumanoharam | devībhirmunipatnībhirvidhānaṃ ca yathocitam ||71 || tataḥ śubhe kṣaṇe prāpte māhendre paramodaye | vivāhocitalagne ca lagnādhipatisaṃyute ||72|| sadgrahekṣaṇaśuddhe cāpyasatāṃ dṛṣṭivarjite | śubhakṣaṇe śubharkṣe ca viśuddhe candratārayoḥ ||73 || vedhadoṣādirahite śalākādivivarjite | dampatyoḥ śarmayogye ca pariṇāmasukhaprade ||74|| evaṃbhūte tu samaye bhṛgvarṣiprāgaṇaṃ hariḥ | ājagāma sureśādyairmuniviprapurohitaiḥ ||75|| īśvarairbhagavadbhiśca dharmabhaktyādibhistathā | bhūmnā lakṣmyā pārṣadaiśca muktaiśca munibhistathā ||76 || sthāvarairjaṃgamairdivyaiḥ śāstrajñairnartakairnaṭaiḥ | gāyakairmālyakṛdbhiśca vidyādharībhirapyatha ||77|| apsarobhiḥ kinnarībhiḥ sāṃkhyayoginikādibhiḥ | sthalaṃ tad dadṛśurdevā devya īśāśca tatstriyaḥ ||78|| svarṇaraṃbhāstaṃbhalakṣaiḥ paṭṭasūtrapariṣkṛtaiḥ | campakānāṃ candanānāṃ rasālānāṃ ca pallavaiḥ ||79|| mālyairnānāvidhaiścaiva pītaraktasitānvitaiḥ | parito maṃgalaghaṭaiḥ phalapallavasaṃyutaiḥ ||1.383.80|| kastūrīcandanāktaiśca kuṃkumena virājitaiḥ | parṇairlājāphalapuṣpadūrvābhirupaśobhitaiḥ ||81 || īśvarairmunibhirviprairdevaiḥ pitṛbhirāsthitam | ratnendrasāranirmāṇavedīyuktaṃ manoharam ||82|| arcitaṃ candanasnigdhaiḥ kastūrīkuṃkumānvitaiḥ | sugandhiśītamandaiśca vāyubhiḥ surabhīkṛtam ||83 || ratnānāṃ koṭibhiścāpyujjvalaṃ tejasvidīpakaiḥ | nānāprakāradhūpaiśca gandhadravyaiḥ suvāsitam ||84|| citraiśca śilpināṃ ramyaiḥ paritaḥ śobhanaṃ kṛtam | gandharvāṇāṃ susaṃgītairnartakānāṃ sunartanaiḥ ||85|| vidyādharīṇāṃ hāvādyairapsarasā sugāyanaiḥ | susvaritaṃ gabākṣaiśca badhūbhirabhivīkṣitam ||86|| maṃgalena ghaṭenāpi viduṣā supurodhasā | bhṛguṇā kuśahastena dānena dānavastunā ||87|| dṛṣṭvā suprāṃgaṇe devān bhṛgorbrahmādikeśvarān | kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vairājaṃ ca matsyādikām̐stathā ||88 || sarvān vilokya sahasā bhṛguḥ kuṭumbisaṃyutaḥ | mūrdhnā vavande devām̐śceśvarān munīn samarhaṇām ||89|| ratnasiṃhāsaneṣveva suramyeṣu pṛthak pṛthak | kramānniṣādayāmāsa satkṛtya cādareṇa vai ||1.383.90|| uvācādya janurme vai saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ mama | babhūva janmakoṭīnāṃ karmamūlanikṛntanam ||91 || avatārī svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’kṣareśvaraḥ | dātā yaḥ sampadāṃ mukterbhukteḥ svargasya sarvadā |||92|| svapne yatpādapadmaṃ vai draṣṭuṃ naiva kṣamo’smyaham | tapasāṃ phaladātā saḥ sraṣṭādya prāṃgaṇe mama ||93|| svātmārāmeṣu pūrṇeṣu śubhapraśnamabhīpsitam | yogīndrairapi siddhendraiḥ surendraiśca munīśvaraiḥ ||94|| dhyānādṛṣṭaḥ sa bhagavān śrīhariḥ prāṃgaṇe’dya me | kālakālaścākṣareśo’vatāreśeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ ||95|| mānuṣaṃ rūpamāsthāya narāṇāṃ dṛṣṭigocaraḥ | matkanyāṃ saphalīkartuṃ tvāṃgaṇe me samāgataḥ ||96 || sarvāntaryāmitā yasya sarvakāmapradaḥ prabhuḥ | nāstyanto yasya vedeṣu sa hariḥ prāṃgaṇe’dya me ||97|| īśānāmīśvaro yastu sarvāgre yasya pūjanam | sa kṛṣṇo golokapatirbhāgyādvai prāṃgaṇe’dya me ||98|| yasya lakṣyo hyanantāśca ramādyā yoṣitaḥ priyāḥ | sa matkanyāgrahaṇārthaṃ nārāyaṇo’ṅgaṇe’dya me ||99|| vairājāścāpi devādyāḥ pitaro mānavāśca ye | pātālasthā bhāgavatā dhanyo’haṃ prāṃgaṇe’dya me || 1.383.1 00|| apunarāvartanāśca muktāstvakṣaravāsinaḥ | koṭiśaḥ kṛṣṇapatnyaśca sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ tathā || 101 || sarvaṃ divyaṃ sattvakulaṃ dhanyo’haṃ prāṃgaṇe’dya me | brahmaputrāḥ prapautrāśca vaṃśajā ye na lokitāḥ || 1 02|| te sarve madgṛhe’dyaiva dhanyā kanyā ca me prabho | aho kalpāntaparyantaṃ tīrthībhūtau mamāśramaḥ || 103 || yeṣāṃ pādodakaistīrthaṃ viśuddhaṃ tadgṛhaṃ mama | pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni tāni sarvāṇi sāgare || 1 04|| sāgare yāni tīrthāni tāni satāṃ padeṣu vai | satāṃ pādodakaklinnā yāvat tiṣṭhati medinī || 1 05|| tāvaddevāśca pitarastṛptā bhavanti vai bhuvi | nikṛntanaṃ tu vipadāṃ sampadāṃ saṃpradaṃ tathā || 106 || vyādhīnāṃ nāśakaṃ māyārogahārakamauṣadham | sukhadaṃ śubhadaṃ sāraṃ devarṣicaraṇāmṛtam || 1 07|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyādya prāpsye’haṃ caraṇāmṛtam | na revāsadṛśaṃ tīrthaṃ na devaḥ keśavātparaḥ || 1 08|| sa eva bhagavānadya sākṣāt kṛṣṇo mama gahe | ityuktvā daṇḍavat kṛtvā tuṣṭāva bhṛguracyutam || 1 09|| tavāsmyahaṃ me susutāsti te prabho bhavānmamāstyeva madīyakaṃ tava | sarvaṃ bhavāneva mamāsti kāraṇaṃ paraṃ padaṃ dehi punātu jīvanam || 1.383.110 || nanāma pādayoścāpi kṛtvā kṛṣṇakarau svake | pādyaṃ padmārcite pādapadme bhṛgurmudā dadau ||1 11 || arghyaṃ ca pradadau dūrvāpuṣpākṣitajalānvitam | madhuparkaṃ ca surabhiṃ sarvāṃge gandhacandanam || 11 2|| pārijātādimālāṃ ca jāmātustu gale dadau | varaṇārthaṃ prakoṣṭhe ca bhūṣāṃ kāmaphalaṃ dadau || 1 13|| dyotitaratnamukuṭaṃ dadau kṛṣṇasya mastake | dhūpaṃ ratnapradīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ sumanoharam || 1 14|| nānāprakārapuṣpāṇi ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ dadau | saptatīrthodakaṃ tasmai dadāvācamanīyakam || 1 15|| tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ miṣṭaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam | śayyāṃ ratikarīṃ ramyāṃ pānārthaṃ vāsitaṃ jalam || 1 16|| evaṃ vai varaṇaṃ kṛtvā dadau puṣpāṃjaliṃ mudā | atha vai maṇḍape vedīsannidhau śrīnarāyaṇam || 1 17|| ānayāmāsa pūrṇāyāṃ pūrṇe candre’mbaraṃ gate | lokācāraṃ vidhāpyaiva māṇikyastaṃbhamārcayat || 1 18|| kalaśaṃ ca gaṇeśaṃ ca vahniṃ natvā guruṃ hariḥ | niṣasādāsane ramye paṭṭake kṛtamaṃgalaḥ || 11 9|| brāhmaṇairvedamantraiśca devairīśaistathātmabhiḥ | āśīrvāde pradattaṃ ca kṛtacandre harau tataḥ || 1.383.1 20|| bhṛguḥ sampūjya putrīśaṃ dehaśuddhimakārayat | vedaghoṣāḥ svastimantrā gītayo yoṣitāṃ tathā || 121 || vādyaghoṣāstathā tatrābhavan vicitrarītayaḥ | mahotsavastadā jāto bhṛgvānando na nirmamau || 122 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye śuklatīrthād bhṛgupattanaṃ prati varasya varātikājanaiḥ saha yātrā, maṃgalādisatkārāḥ bhṛgorharṣavākyāni varasya maṇḍapāgamaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryaśītyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||383 ||
<1.384> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasakāśatastu yat | vastrabhūṣādikaṃ divyamarpitaṃ tu vadhūkṛte || 1 || brahmadhāmno vibhūtervai sarvaṃ vastravibhūṣaṇam | tatsarvaṃ sandadhāreyaṃ bhārgavī divyarūpiṇī || 2 || bhūṣayāṃcakrire lakṣmīḥ śrīḥ sāvitrīramādikāḥ | pārvatī māṇikī jayā prabhā ca lalitādikāḥ || 3 || khyātyādyā mātaraścāpi tāmalaṃcakrurādarāt | vibhūṣitātyalaṃkṛtā śuśubhe divyatāyutā || 4 || vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā kabarībhārabhūṣitā | kastūrībindubhiryuktā snigdhasaccandanārcitā || 5 || sindūrabindunā śaśvadbhālamadhyasthalojjvalā | taptakāṃcanavarṇābhā koṭicandrasamaprabhā || 6 || candramokṣitasarvāṃgā mālatīmālyaśobhitā | netrayo rañjitakṛṣṇā pakvabimbauṣṭhasundarī || 7 || nāgaraṃgastanī svarṇavarṇāṃgulikaradvayā | sūkṣmaromāvalīrājattattatsthalīmanoharā || 8 || lakṣmīsthadivyacihnānāṃ rekhābhirjñātapadmajā | alaktāñcitapādābjatalā kamalavatkarā || 9 || ānītā maṇḍape vedīsannidhau varamālayā | ratnahīrakasvarṇādikusumādisuklṛptayā || 1.384.10 || karayordhṛtayā strībhiḥ śobhitā varasannidhau | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā vahniṃ natvā ca devatāḥ || 11 || sthirīkṛtā savyapārśve jayaśabdo hyabhūttadā | vādyāni ca vicitrāṇi vādayanti sma tanmahe || 1 2|| dṛśyamāṇā sasmitā sā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇānanam | praṇamya svapatiṃ lakṣmīḥ puṣpāñjalimavākirat || 1 3|| kṛṣṇasya mūrdhani bhāle’kṣatakuṃkumacandrakam | tilakaṃ cāndanaṃ cakre sugandhajalamārpayat || 14|| varamālāṃ kṛṣṇagale datvā namāma pādayoḥ | tīrthajalena cāṃguṣṭhaṃ prakṣālya tvapibajjalam || 15 | | saptapradakṣiṇāḥ kṛtvā praṇamya svapatiṃ punaḥ | siṣeca pallavaistīrthajalaṃ candanamiśritam || 16 || atha natvā vāmapārśve niṣasāda satī yadā | tāṃ siṣeca jagatkāntaḥ kāntāṃ śāntāṃ sasusmitām || 1 7|| sākṣataṃ candrakaṃ tasyā bhāle kṛtvā svayaṃ prabhuḥ | mastake ca karau datvā puṣpāṇyavākiraddhariḥ || 18 || tadā purohito bṛhaspatirmālāṃ galasthitām | nāradasya samakṣaṃ vai vadhūkaṇṭhe’pyadhāpayat || 19 || varamālānvitā lakṣmīḥ śuśubhe meghavaidyutī | atha mantrāstadā tatra prāvartantarṣimaṇḍalāt | | 1.384.2 0 || bhṛgustatra sutāhastaṃ kṛṣṇahaste dadau śubham | evaṃ bhṛguḥ pradānena vedamantreṇa vai dadau || 21 || bṛhaspateḥ kathanena svastītyāha haristadā | jagrāha lakṣmīṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ priyāṃ svakām | | 22|| atha dānāni ratnānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ ca gavāṃ tathā | gṛhāṇāṃ bhavanānāṃ ca brahmāṇḍānāmapi prabhuḥ || 23 || bhṛguścāpi dadau tatra dadau nārāyaṇo’pi ca | bhṛguḥ putryai bhṛgukacchaṃ pattanaṃ pradadau tadā | | 24|| bhūmā ca bhṛgave mokṣadānaṃ jyotiḥpravedanam | trikālābādhyavijñānaṃ cārpayat karuṇākaraḥ || 25|| hastyaśvayānavāhānāṃ dānānyapi dadau tadā | yautakaṃ hastake dravyaṃ vadhvai varāya saṃdaduḥ || 26 | | avatārā īśvarāśca munayaḥ pitarastathā | devāśca mānavā bhaumā pātālasthā yathāyatham | | 27|| yeṣāṃ vai yādṛśī smṛddhistadyogyaṃ dānamācarana | athāgniṃ saṃpradakṣiṇīkṛtya vāracatuṣṭayam || 28 || daṃpatī saṃsthitau vahnisānnidhye ca natau punaḥ | niṣedatustato homaṃ cakratustau ghṛtādibhiḥ | | 29 || aṃgulīyakamevāsyai vadhvai dadau haristadā | aṃgulyagreṣu dhṛtvā sā bhojyakavalamārpayat | | 1.384.30 || kṛṣṇāya tasyai kṛṣṇo’pi bhojyakavalamārpayat | ūrmikayākṣaṇaṃ rantvā nivṛttau tau pramoditau || 31 | | svedāktau tu karau lakṣmyāścātha nārāyaṇasya tau | pulakāṃkitaromāṇau prakoṣṭhayorbabhūvatuḥ || 32 || lagnagranthiyutau tau ca vahniṃ natvā guruṃ tathā | devatāśca tadā natvā niryātau maṇḍapāt tadā || 33 || khyātyādibhirbhojito tau viśrāntau rahasi kṣaṇam | atha hastyādibhiḥ pūryāṃ sarvatra bhrāmitau mudā ||34|| pūjitau tau prajābhiśca vanditau pitarau janaiḥ | lagnagranthiṃ narmadāyāṃ nirgranthiṃ saṃvidhāya ca ||35|| bhārgavījananī khyātirīśanībhiḥ kriyādibhiḥ | patiputravatībhiśca sādhvībhiḥ sahitā mudā ||36|| āgatya maṃgalaṃ kṛtvā kuṃkumakṣālanādikam | dampatīṃ veśayāmāsa ratnanirmāṇamandiram ||37|| anekacitrakṛcchobhaṃ hīrahāreṇa bhūṣitam | muktāmāṇikyaratnaiśca sudīptaṃ darpaṇaistathā ||3|| tatra nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo dadarśa devayoṣitaḥ | īśvarayoṣitaścāpi muktāniśca ramādikāḥ ||39|| munipatnīśca yāḥ sarvāḥ pātivratyaparāyaṇāḥ | ratnasiṃhāsanasthāstā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ ||1.384.40 || tā api śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca satparam | uttasthurvāsayāmāsū ratnasiṃhāsane mudā ||41 || stutiṃ cakrurmunipatnyo narma cakruḥ sakhījanāḥ | khyātiḥ saṃbhojayāmāsa vareṇa saha kanyakām ||42|| sakarpūraṃ satāmbūlaṃ pradadau vāsitaṃ jalam | śāradā ca dadau kṛṣṇahaste ślokādipatrikām ||43|| sarvāsāmājñayā devī paṭheti tamuvāca sā | papāṭha patrikāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’tiharṣitaḥ ||44|| lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī durgā sāvitrī rādhikā ramā | satī menā jayā khyātirmāṇakī pārvatī prabhā ||45|| tulasī pṛthivī vṛndārundhatī yamunāditiḥ | gaṃgā sītā śatarūpā devahūtiśca narmadā ||46|| devyaścaitā varavadhvoḥ kurvantu maṃgalaṃ param | papāṭha ceti śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śuśruvurjahasuśca tāḥ ||47|| navaṃ tu yauvanaṃ kānto navaḥ kāntā navā tathā | vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṃgamo’stu navo navaḥ ||48|| prauḍhā rūpavatī puṣṭā yuvā vīryabharo balī | yoge balābale cādya jñāsyāmaḥ kasya vai jayaḥ ||49|| rādhā ramā tathānyāśca tava santi suyoṣitaḥ | bhārgavī kīdṛśī ramyā rahaścāsti vadātra naḥ ||1.384.50|| iti kṣaṇaṃ varatuṣṭyai jahasuḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ | lopāmudrānasūyā cāpyahalyārundhatī tathā ||51 || kaṃbharā tā munipatnyo rabhasaṃ cakrurīśvaram | athamuktānīśvarām̐śca devān sthāvarajaṃgamān ||52|| pūjayāmāsa ca bhṛgurbhojayāmāsa cādarāt | khādyatāṃ khādyatāṃ miṣṭaṃ dīyatāṃ dīyatāmiti ||53|| śabdo babhūva nagare vādyasaṃgītamaṃgalaiḥ | atha prabhāte tvaritāḥ sajjā babhūvurīśvarāḥ ||54|| kārayāmāsa yātrāṃ ca nārāyaṇaṃ ca bhārgavīm | khyātiḥ ruroda putrīṃ svāṃ kṛtvā vakṣasi vai kṣaṇam ||55|| putri vatse vinā tvāṃ vai kathaṃ jīvāmi duḥkhinī | vada nārāyaṇaṃ śaśvan nivāsārthaṃ bhṛgorgṛhe ||96|| jāyāpatibhyāṃ dattaṃ vai yautakaṃ bhṛgupattanam | atra dvitīyarūpeṇa nārāyaṇaṃ nivāsaya ||57|| lakṣmīḥ pativratā naivaṃ cakre niyogamacyute | sajalā netrayorjātā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastadā ||58|| lakṣmīṃ prāha kathaṃ subhru jātā sajalalocanā | yathā śvaśrūrvadatyevaṃ karomyeva vasāmyaham ||59|| ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo dvedhā babhūva ha | bhārgavīsahitastatra bhṛgorgehe’vasat sadā ||1.384.6 0|| dvitīyaṃ dampatīrūpaṃ koṭiyautakasaṃbhṛtam | asaṃkhyavāhinīsaṃghaiḥ śuklatīrthaṃ yayau tadā ||61 || praviśya bhavanaṃ ramyaṃ kārayāmāsa maṃgalam | bhūmā nārāyaṇo vādyaṃ vādayāmāsa sundaram ||62|| sarvā devyaśca muktānyastathānyā yoṣito hareḥ | bhārgavīṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vilokya vai muhuḥ ||63 || gṛhaṃ praveśayāmāsuścakrire maṃgalāni hi | caturvidhaṃ bhojayitvā trisṛṣṭivāsino janān ||64|| mahīmānān raṃjayitvā parihāraṃ pracakrire | bhūmā sainyāni cādāya dhāmadhāmanivāsinām ||65|| yayau vaikuṇṭhamevādya dampatīsahitastadā | mahīmānāḥ svakān lokān yayurdhanaprapūritāḥ ||66|| pṛthvījalādayaścakruḥ klṛptavaikuṇṭhanāśanam | bhṛgorgṛhe mahīmānāḥ bhojitāḥ pūjitāśca te ||67|| yayuḥ satkāramādāya divyaratnādisaṃbhṛtāḥ | bhṛguklṛptamāsamudraṃ mahīmānanivāsanam ||68|| saṃhṛtaṃ kṣaṇamātreṇa bhṛguṇā siddhibhistadā | kaṃbharā ca mahālakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇagopāla eva tau ||69 || pitarau putrasānnidhye nivāsaṃ bhṛgupattane | cakraturbhārgavīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tuṣṭaye ||1.384.70|| divyadehau ca pitarau dampatīsavidhe sadā | yathā khyātibhṛgū pūjyau vartete bhṛgupattane ||71 || bhārgavī śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāpya rahaḥ sadā | sevate vividhaiḥ kāmaiḥ pātivratyaparāyaṇā ||72|| kathaṃ na smarasi lakṣmi tvaṃ jātā bhārgavī tadā | ahaṃ jātaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ smarāmi lagnakam ||73 || tvādṛśī me sadā dāsī patnī bhogyā ca kiṃkarī | sakhī sahyā sahavāsā surakṣikā pativratā ||74|| nāparā me sukhakartrī śāntā saubhāgyaśālinī | hṛtsthā rekhātmikā gaurātmikā śrīvatsavigrahā ||75|| ahaṃ tvaṃ ca tvamevāhaṃ na bhedo’sti manāgapi | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi bahubhāgyavatī bhava ||76|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya svargaṃ mokṣaḥ phalaṃ bhavet | nārīṇāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptirdhruvā bhavet ||77|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye bhārgavyā maṇḍapānayanaṃ kanyādānavidhirvivāhottaraṃ mahīmānānāṃ varasya ca yātrā, kṛtrimavaikuṇṭhādivilayanam, jāmāturbhagugṛhe dvitīyarūpeṇa vāsaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturaśītyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 384 ||
<1.385> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca mannāmnāṃ tvaṃ kīdṛgarthān sujānāsi pativrate | vada māṃ yena tuṣyāmi jñātvā te jñānamuttamam || 1 || ityuktā bhārgavī sā tvaṃ vyutpattiṃ pracakartha ha | kṛṣirbhūvācakaḥ śabdaḥ ṇaśca nirvṛttivācakaḥ || 2 || tayoraikyaṃ paraṃ brahma kṛṣṇa ityabhidhīyate | duḥkhānāṃ karṣaṇād dhāmni nayanāt kṛṣṇa ucyate || 3 || rāśabdaḥ saṃpadāṃ nāma mo māne procyate sadā | sampatpramāṇadaḥ kṛṣṇo rāmanāmā samucyate | | 4 || ramate ramayā sārdhaṃ tena rāmaḥ samucyate | ramāyā ramaṇasthānaṃ rāmaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sa ucyate || 5 || narātmanāṃ samudāye’yanaṃ saṃvāsameva yaḥ | karotyayaṃ prabhurnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sa ucyate || 6 || nārā pāpāni vai teṣāṃ cāyaṃ nāśo yato bhavet | nārāyaṇaḥ sa evāsti kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 7 || nārā jalāni tatrāste tena nārāyaṇaḥ sa hi | nārā tu bhārgavī lakṣmīstayāyanaṃ karoti yaḥ || 8 || kṛṣiśca prema tannetā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sa vai | bhavān mama patiḥ śrīśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ || 9 || harasi bhaktaduḥkhāni haristvaṃ bhagavān svayam | ṣaḍaiśvaryasametastvaṃ bhagavān procyate sadā || 1.385.10 || bhagaṃ bhaktastadesyāsti bhagavām̐stvaṃ tato mataḥ | aṃkuro bhaktivṛkṣasya bhaktasaṃgena vardhate || 11 || tathā harikathālāpapīyūṣasecanena ca | abhaktālāpadīpāgnijvālāyāḥ kalayāpi tu || 1 2|| aṃkuraḥ śuṣkatāṃ yāti bhaktasektena vardhate | tasmādabhaktasaṃghaṃ vai sāvadhānā tyajāmi vai || 1 3|| kṛṣisatkṛṣṭavacano ṇaśca sadbhaktibodhakaḥ | aścāpi dātṛvacanaḥ kṛṣṇastvaṃ procyase’pi ca || 14|| kṛṣiśca paramānande ṇaśca taddāsyakarmaṇi | tayordātā bhavān kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇadāsī ca bhārgavī || 15|| kṛṣiḥ kleśastasya nāśāt kṛṣṇastvayi pravartate | jalaṃ bhittvā yathā padmaṃ tathā bhaktastvadāśrayāt || 16|| uddharati kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmnā bhavārṇavāt | śriyā tvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yukto’si vai mayā || 17|| mama bhāgyaṃ mahanmanye tava yogātpareśvara | dhanyā sā kaṃbharālakṣmīrdhanyo gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 18|| yadgṛhe śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastvaṃ vartase sadā | yadvāci śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāma pravartate || 1 9|| bhasmībhavanti vai tasya mahāpātakakoṭayaḥ | divyo bhūtvā mahāmukto jāyate na punarbhavaḥ ||1.385.20|| sarveṣāmapi yajñānāṃ lakṣāṇi ca vratāni ca | tīrthasnānāni sarvāṇi tapāṃsyanaśanāni ca ||21 || vedapāṭhasahasrāṇi prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvaḥ śatam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmnaḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||22|| mā ca brāhmī vaiṣṇavī śrīrnārāyaṇī sanātanī | mahālakṣmīrbhārgavī ca tāsāṃ svāmī ca mādhavaḥ ||23|| tvayi sarveśvare bhaktistvaddāsyaṃ me sadāstu vai | tava nāmnāṃ bhajanaṃ ca sarvadāstu ca me hṛdi ||24|| dehena manasā vācā kriyayā sarvakarmabhiḥ | tavaiva sevanaṃ nātha vāñchitaṃ me sadāstu tat ||25|| tapastaptaṃ tadarthaṃ vai seviṣye matpriyaṃ patim | ānandaṃ ca tvayā dattaṃ bhokṣye śāśvatameva ca || 26|| ityuktvā bhārgavī lakṣmi virarāma hareḥ puraḥ | tāvatsakhyaḥ samāyātā bhūṣayituṃ tu bhārgavīm || 27|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jñātvāvasaraṃ cotthitastadā | narmadāyāstaṭe yāto vihārārthaṃ vayasyakaiḥ ||28 || tāvattatra divyarūpāḥ sarvā nārāyaṇapriyāḥ | ratnasiṃhāsane ramye vāsayāmāsurīśvarīm ||29|| kṛṣṇapatnī prabhādevī ratnamālāṃ gale dadau | pārvatī dakṣiṇe haste krīḍāpadma dadau śubham || 1.385.30|| padmā tasyā dadau pādapadmayugme’pyalaktakam | pradadau māṇikī patnī sindūraṃ sundaraṃ varam ||3 1 || candanena samāyuktaṃ sīmantādhastalojjvalam | sucārukabarī ramyāṃ cakāra maṃgalā priyā || 32|| manoharāṃ munīnāṃ ca mālatīmālyabhūṣitām | sthalapadmadalapuṣpagrathitaṃ dhammilaṃ vyadhāt ||33 || kastūrīkuṃkumāktaṃ ca cārucaṃdanapatrakam | stanayugme sukaṭhine cakāra lalitā priyā || 34|| cārucampakapuṣpāṇāṃ mālāṃ gandhamanoharām | sudhāsakhī dadau tasyai praphullā navamallikām ||35|| jayā ratyāṃ surasikā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām | tāṃ cakārātirasikāṃ varāṃ ratirasotsukām ||36|| śaratpadmadalābhaṃ ca locanaṃ kajjalojjvalam | kṛtvā dadau sulalitaṃ pāñcālī cāmbaraṃ navam ||37|| vijayā pārijātānāṃ kusumāni kare dadau | amṛtā ca sakhī tailaṃ sugandhaṃ pradadau tanau ||38|| ratiḥ śṛṃgāraviṣayaṃ smārayāmāsa rājasam | sudhopamaṃ sumadhuraṃ vacanādi prarañjakam ||39|| kamalānāṃ campakānāṃ dale candanacarcite | cakāra ratitalpaṃ ca kamalā cāśu komalam ||1.385.40|| cāru campakapuṣpāṇi sthalābjānāṃ dalāni ca | cakāra candanāktāni kṛṣṇārthaṃ śāradā priyā ||41 || kelikadambapuṣpāṇāṃ stabakaṃ ca manoharam | tathā mālā kadambānāṃ śrīḥ kṛṣṇārthaṃ cakāra ha |||42||| tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam | kṛṣṇā cakāra kṛṣṇārthaṃ dadau tasyai tathāparam ||42|| karṇayorbhūṣaṇe menā dhanyā lalāṭabhūṣaṇam | kalāvatī tu bhārgavyai dadau nāsāvibhūṣaṇam ||44|| siddhistvasyai dadau gandhasāraṃ coṣṭhapraraṃjanam | bruddhirdadau tu bhārgavyai gaṇḍabindu manoharam ||45|| harervasumatī patnī ratnahārān gale dadau | mūrtiścāsyai dadau ramyāṃ kaṃcukīṃ kāṃcanaprabhām ||46|| sāvitrī ca dadau yajñopavītaṃ kāṃcanaṃ varam | preyasī ca dadau tvasyāstanayoścandanaṃ śubham ||47|| śreyasī ca dadau kaṭyāṃ raśanāṃ svarṇanirmitām | ṛtambharā dadau tvasyai prakoṣṭhaśṛṃkhalā śubhām | |48| | bhūriśṛṅgā dadāvasyai bhujayoḥ kaṭake vare | rādhyāsā pradadau tantīṃ lalāṭaphalake tadā ||49 | | saṃjñā kaṇṭhīṃ suvarṇasya mudgamālātmikāṃ dadau | yatinī pradadau cāsyai yavamālāṃ suśobhitām | |1.385.50 | | aruṇā pradadau śāṭīṃ sūryavarṇāṃ suvarṇajām | arundhatī dadau tasyai svarṇormikādaśadvayam | |81 1 | | miṣṭādevī yogapaṭṭaṃ dadau suvarṇanirmitam | kaṃbharā pradadau ramyaṃ darpaṇaṃ vyajanaṃ śubham | ||52| | dyuvarṇā pradadau tvasyai svarṇaghargharikāṃ śubhām | vikuṇṭhā pradadau tasyai nūpure kānake tadā |||53 | | nakharaṃgaṃ dadau vamrī jyoṣṭrī netraprakajjalam | vārkṣī dhūpaṃ sugandhaṃ ca puṣpā gandhajalaṃ dadau ||54| | sudughā ca dadau dugdhavaṭikāṃ puṣṭidāyinīm | tulasī staṃbhanarasamapāyayattu bhārgavīm | |55| | sarasvatī dadau tasyāḥ pādayoḥ samalaktakam | campā ca mañjulā rāmā dayā śāntā jayānilā | |56 | | śāntirhaimī ca ratnā ca muktā devī ca pānikā | mauktikāmodikā kāntiḥ śivā maṇiśca vai damī | ||57| | ityādyā bhagavatpatnyo vidadhustāmalaṃkṛtām | evaṃ śṛṃgārasampannāṃ kṛtvā sakhyo’pyaraṃjayan ||58 || parasparaṃ ca vidhinā bhagavattoṣahetave | pratīkṣante tvāgamanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tāḥ |||5 9|| antaryāmī harirjñātvā vihāya narmadātaṭam | samāyayau bhavanāgre kadambadrumasannidhau ||1.385.6 0 || dauvārikakṛtaṃ śabdaṃ jayaṃ śrutvā sakhījanaḥ | satkārārthaṃ bhagavato drāgeva bahirāyayau ||6 1 || pādyaṃ cārghyaṃ jalaṃ datvā peyaṃ datvā sumiṣṭakam | nināya śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa vai bhārgavīśayam ||6 2|| tāśca sarvā vimucyaiva natvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | yayurgṛhāntarāṇyeva raho datvā vadhūṃ varam ||6 3 || pātivratyena dharmeṇa siṣeve bhārgavī mudā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patnīṃ dadarśa sthiracakṣuṣā ||64|| śvetacampakavarṇābhāmatulāṃ sumanoharām | śṛṃgāritāṃ sakhībhirvai svasyārthaṃ mohinīṃ kṛtām ||65|| sukeśīṃ sundarīṃ śyāmāṃ stanayugmonnatānanām | nitambakaṭhinaśroṇīṃ sasmitāṃ sudatīṃ satīm ||66|| koṭīndūjjvalakāntyāsyāṃ śaratkamalalocanām | kajjalojjvalanetrāṃ ca svarṇabhūṣāvibhūṣitām ||67|| citrālitanusadrūpāṃ kāmapūrṇasuvigrahām | rasikāṃ sotsukāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṅkamānasām ||68|| vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ rativegabharāntarām | cārukuṇḍalayugmena śrutigaṇḍasthalojjvalām ||69|| sunāsāsvarṇavālāṃ ca gajamuktāsumālikām | kuṃkumālaktakastūrīsnigdhacandanacarcitām ||1.385.70 || khagendracañcusannāsāṃ komalāṃgīṃ sukāmukīm | dadhānāṃ sukapolau ca kamanīyā kareṇugām ||7 1|| kāmakāmyālayāṃ tanvīṃ kaṭākṣānaṃgadrśinīm | pārijātaprasūnāni dadhānāṃ krīḍanāya vai ||72|| karmaṇā manasā vācā svapne jāgaraṇe tathā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprītismṛtyāḍhyāṃ premasaṃbhṛtām ||73 || bhāvānubhāvanāsaktāṃ śuddhabhaktāṃ pativratām | gauravarṇāṃ raktapūrṇāṃ śaśvadvakṣaḥsthalasthitām ||74|| priyāsu priyabhakteṣu bhaktāsu priyavādinīm | dṛṣṭvā tu bhārgavīṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mumoha vai ||75|| bhārgavī śayane dṛṣṭvā svāminaṃ prāṇavallabhā | kāmapūrṇaṃ śubhaveṣaṃ sundareśaṃ ca sasmitam ||76|| navīnajaladaśyāmaṃ pītakauśeyavāsasam | candanokṣitasarvāgaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ||77|| svarṇasatkalgimukuṭaṃ mālatīmālyaśobhitam | īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ||78|| rantukāmaṃ manaḥkāntaṃ kāmakāntaṃ patiṃ priyam | javena vakṣasi kṛtvā provāca parameśvaram ||79|| jātaṃ me saphalaṃ janma yasyā me īdṛśaḥ patiḥ | sujīvitaṃ jīvitaṃ me yasyāḥ kānto narāyaṇaḥ ||1.385.80 || dṛṣṭvā te mukhacandraṃ me susnigdhaṃ locanaṃ manaḥ | pañcaprāṇā dravitāśca harṣo māti na me tanau ||81 || tvaddṛṣṭyāmṛtavṛṣṭyā ca susiktānandasammukhī | virahaḥ svāmino nātha dāvānalaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ||82|| ityuktvā bhārgavī lakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim | svāsane svāpayāmāsa cakre pādādimardanam ||83 || sugandhaṃ jalasāraṃ ca tailasāraṃ ca darpaṇam | jāmbūlaṃ jalapānaṃ ca puṣpahārān sucandanam ||84|| madhu bhojya phalaṃ miṣṭaṃ cānaṃgabalagūṭikām | sudhāṃ dadau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāṃ dadau tataḥ ||85|| saphalīkṛtavān svāmī puṣpaśayyāṃ manoharām | bhārgavīṃ saphalīcakre navoḍhāṃ ratimandirām ||86|| sasmitā sasmitaṃ kāntaṃ śāntaṃ kāntamanoharā | talpe sarvātmanā lakṣmīḥ siṣeve sukhamūrchitā ||87|| santuṣṭā bhārgavī kāntaṃ santuṣṭaṃ prāha dharmataḥ | sā strī bhāvānuraktā yā, yaḥ pāti strīṃ patiśca saḥ ||88|| premasaukhyaṃ patipatnyordharmataḥ khalu durlabham | pativratā vijānāti rasikā guṇavatpatim |||85|| dūrāddhāvati padmārthaṃ madhulobhānmadhuvrataḥ | bhekastannahi jānāti tanmūrdhni pādamutsṛjet ||1.385.90 || yantrī jānāti saṃgītarasaṃ yantraṃ tu naiva hi | dugdhasvādaṃ kṣudhitaśca na darvī naiva bhājanam ||91 || paripakvaphalāsvādaṃ sukhaṃ jānanti bhoginaḥ | ekatrāvasthitāḥ śaśvanna kiṃcit phalino yathā ||92|| suśītalajalāsvādaṃ vijānanti kṛṣīvalāḥ | na vāpī na ca kalaśaścaikatrāvasthito yathā ||93 || bhogino hi vijānanti śālisvādurasaṃ param | ekatrāvasthitaṃ cāpi na kṣetraṃ bhājanaṃ na vā ||94|| bubudhe candanāghrāṇaṃ candanārthī na gardabhaḥ | saubhāgyaṃ gauravaṃ prema durlabhaṃ nityanūtanam ||95|| pativratā vijānāti sulabhaṃ patisevanāt | patnīvrataḥ patiścāpi prāpnoti sulabhaṃ hi tat ||96|| tava sevāpradaṃ me’stu pātivratyaṃ tvayi prabho | patnīvrate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe nāthe vṛṇomyaham ||97|| tathāstviti hariḥ prāha bhārgavīṃ patisevikām | darśayāmāsa rūpāṇi yāni lakṣmyā bhavanti vai ||98|| paśya tvaṃ bhārgavi te tu dhṛtāni yatra yāni vai | rūpāṇi tu mayā sākaṃ pātivratyena tiṣṭhasi || 99|| akṣare brahmaṇi cāhaṃ vartāmi puruṣottamaḥ | tatrāsi tvaṃ cidānandākṣararūpeṇa vartase || 1.385.100 || goloke gokule vṛndāvane tvaṃ rādhikāsi me | dvibhujo gopaveṣo’haṃ kṛṣṇo’smi rādhikāpatiḥ || 101 || caturbhujo’haṃ vaikuṇṭhe dvedhā nārāyaṇaḥ sadā | lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī tvaṃ ca mayā kāntena vartase || 1 02|| sindhukanyā tvaṃ tu lakṣmīrmartyo lakṣmīpatistadā | śvetadvīpe ca kṣīrode lakṣmīpatiścaturmujaḥ || 103|| ahaṃ nārāyaṇarṣiśca naro dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ | śāntirlakṣmīsvarūpā tvaṃ mayi cāsi pativratā || 1 04|| ahaṃ kapilastvaṃ siddhiḥ sarvatraivaṃ pravartase | ahaṃ patnīvratastvaṃ ca pativratā pravartase || 1 05|| vaikuṇṭhe tu mahālakṣmīrbhavatī hi sarasvatī | bhavatī mṛtyulakṣmīśca kṣīrodaśāyinaḥ priyā || 106 || dharmaputravadhūstvaṃ ca śāntirlakṣmīsvarūpiṇī | kapilasya priyā kāntā bhuvi tvaṃ bhāratī satī || 1 07|| tvaṃ sītā rāmarūpasya mama patnī pravartase | bhaviṣyasi kṛṣṇarūpe rukmiṇī tvaṃ priyā tadā || 1 08|| kaṃbharā tvaṃ mahālakṣmīrgopālakṛṣṇabhāminī | evaṃ tvaṃ bhārgavī jātā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’smyaham || 1 09|| padmā tvaṃ ca ramā tvaṃ ca prabhā tvaṃ pārvatī tathā | māṇikī tvaṃ jayā tvaṃ ca śrīstvaṃ kṛṣṇā mama priyā || 1.385.1 10|| haṃsā ca maṃjulā campā haimī devī ramā dayā | mauktikā ca jayā śāntistvaṃ tadrūpādhidevatā || 111 || yatra yadā januṃ prāptā vartase me priyā tadā | udvāhayitvā saṃgṛhya nayāmi tvāṃ mayā saha || 1 12|| nānārūpaḥ sadā cāsmi svāṃśena kalayā ca vā | tvayā sahitaḥ sarvatra virāje matpriye śubhe || 1 13|| paripūrṇatamaścāsmi tvaṃ ca pūrṇatamāsi vai | yatra yādṛg bhavet kāryaṃ tatra yāmi tvayā saha || 1 14|| pativratāsamā nānyā tvayā cānyā hi vidyate | atituṣṭo’smi deveśi caikarūpeṇa vartase || 1 15|| yāstavemāṃ patisevāṃ śroṣyanti bhāvataśca tāḥ | paṭhiṣyanti ca vā tā vai samavāpsyanti māṃ patim || 1 16|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye bhārgavyāḥ śṛṃgāraḥ, śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sevanam, pātivratyaparāyaṇatāpradarśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśītyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 385 ||
<1.386> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi kathāmanyāṃ tu mokṣadām | pativratāyāḥ svapatyuruddhārakāriṇīṃ śubhām || 1 || devarṣipitṛbhūtāni yasya niḥśvasya veśmani | prayāntyanarcitānyeva na tasmātpāpakṛnnaraḥ || 2 || hataṃ devādiniḥśvāsaiḥ śarīraṃ yasya veśma ca | bhāgyaṃ tasya hataṃ sarvaṃ nāśāya kalpate hi saḥ || 3 || patnyā pūjyāḥ sādhavaśca sādhvyo vṛddhā janāstathā | pitaro devatāścātithayaḥ sādhvyā dine dine || 4 || pativratayā svāmino vai puṇyena karmaṇā sadā | āyuṣyaṃ vardhanīyaṃ ca yajñāḥ kāryāḥ śubhāvahāḥ || 5 || anabhyarcya ṛṣīn devān pitṛbhūtātithīṃstathā | yo bhuṃkte sa svakīyaṃ sukṛtaṃ nāśayati dhruvam || 6 || śrūyate ca purā khyāto rājā śatadhanurbhuvi | patnī ca tasya śaibyābhūt svāmidharmaparāyaṇā || 7 || pativratā mahābhāgā satyaśaucadayānvitā | vṛddhasevāparā śāntā nayena vinayena ca || 8 || sa tu rājā tayā sārdhaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hi mām | vibhuṃ tvārādhayāmāsa parameṇa samādhinā || 9 || homairjapyaistathā dānairupavāsaiśca bhaktitaḥ | pūjābhiścānudivasaṃ manmanā nānyamānasaḥ || 1.386.1 0|| ekadā tau samaṃ snātau bhāryāpatī nadījale | bhāgīrathyāḥ samuttīrṇau kārtikyāṃ samupoṣitau || 11 || ekādaśyā vratinau tau dvādaśyāṃ prātareva hi | bhāgīrathyāṃ sasnatustau gṛhaṃ samāgatau tataḥ || 1 2|| pāraṇārthaṃ randhitānnaṃ vyañjanaṃ dadhi dugdhakam | devarṣipitṛbhūtebhyaścānarpya sthālarakṣitam || 1 3|| śaibyā pratīkṣate vāṭaṃ brāhmaṇasyātitherguroḥ | samāgatya gururvipro nāmnā cāpāryakaḥ svayam || 14|| vaiśvadevaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā ṛṣipitṛgavārpaṇam | dāsyati naḥ prasādaṃ tamatsyāmaḥ pāraṇātmakam || 15|| tāvatprāghūrṇikā rājño gṛhe tatra samāyayuḥ | teṣāṃ vai satkṛtau rājño rājñyāśca samayo gataḥ || 16|| guruścāpi samāgatya dṛṣṭvā prāghūrṇikān bahūn | bhāryāpatī vyavasāyaparau dṛṣṭvā kṣaṇāntare || 17|| devarṣipitṛbhūtebhyaścānivedyānnavāri ca | yayau svīyaṃ gṛhaṃ kālo madhyāhnnottaratāṃ gataḥ || 18|| randhitānnaṃ tathaivāste devarṣipitaraśca ye | samāgatāḥ kṣudhitāścāprāpya pūjāṃ jalānnakam || 1 9|| nirāśāścātiruṣṭāśca yayuḥ svasthānameva te | pativratā tu sā nārī patyau jñātvā surāśritam ||1.386.20|| patiṃ sā pārayāmāsa bhojanaṃ jalamādi ca | patnyarthaṃ tat prasādānnaṃ patiśiṣṭamabhūttadā ||21 || patibhuktaṃ tu tatpūrvaṃ nāsīd devaprasādajam | taddoṣeṇa patirliptaḥ patnī liptā na dharmataḥ ||22|| patyartha cāprasādānnaṃ patnyarthaṃ tu prasādajam | patyustaddoṣakṛjjātaṃ patnyāstu puṇyadaṃ hyabhūt ||23|| bhojayitvā mahīmānān bhuktvā bhāryāpatī tataḥ | sasmaraturgurūṃ devarṣipitṛpūjakaṃ tadā ||24|| jñātavantau ca bhuktānnamabhūd devādyanarpitam | viṣṇoḥ pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtavantau parāhṇake ||25||| athāpi jātadoṣasya yāvannāśo na vidyate | tāvadbhavati bhoktavyo bhave vā ca bhavāntare |||26 || kālena gacchatā rājā mamāra jvarapīḍitaḥ | anvāruroha taṃ patnī citāsthaṃ bhūpatiṃ patim ||27|| sahayānena tau yātau mārgaṃ svargasya tatkṣaṇam | tāvadambaramārgasya pitaraḥ krodhakāriṇaḥ ||28|| akasmād vai samāgatya vimānaṃ hyavarodhayan | krūradṛṣṭyā tu rājānaṃ bhālayāmāsurambare ||29|| tāvajjāyāpati tasmādvimānātpatitau bhuvi | rājā pūrveṇa doṣeṇa śvā jajñe vaidiśe pure ||1.386.3 0|| rājñī jātasmarā jajñe kāśīrājakumārikā | sarvavijñānasampūrṇā sarvasallakṣaṇānvitā ||3 1 || avaśyaṃbhāvino bhāvā bhavanti na nivāritāḥ | pativratāyā api pitṛroṣo rodhako’bhavat ||32|| sā tu yogyā yadā jātā varārohā pativratā | tāṃ pitā dātukāmo’bhūd varāya vāritastayā |||33|| putrīruddhaḥ sa virato vivāhāraṃbhato nṛpaḥ | divyayā yogadṛṣṭyā sā patiṃ śvānaṃ prapaśyati ||34|| pitrājñāṃ sā samādāya yātrārthaṃ niryayau sutā | vaidiśākhyaṃ puraṃ gatvā śvānaṃ patiṃ dadarśa ha ||35|| śvāpi dṛṣṭvā tu tāṃ patnīṃ tadā jātismaro hyabhūt | ruroda kṣaṇamātraṃ ca lajjāvānabhavat kṣaṇam ||36 || sāpi ruroda taṃ dṛṣṭvā tadavasthaṃ suduḥkhitam | dadau devaprasādaṃ ca satkāravacanaṃ jalam ||37|| pasparśa saśunaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ kareṇa karṇamastakam | bhuñjan dattaṃ tayā so’nnamatimiṣṭamabhīpsitam ||38|| kurvan śvajātilalitaṃ cakāra bahucāṭutām | cāṭutāṃ kurvatā tena bālā kṛtātilajjitā ||3 9|| sā sasnehā tamādehaṃ dayite paśuyonijam | smaryatāṃ tanmahārāja devādyanarpitādanam ||1.386.40|| yena śvayonimāpannaḥ pitṛkrodhasya bhājanam | vimānātpatito vyomno mayā sākaṃ janeśvara ||41 || prāpto’si kutsitāṃ yoniṃ kinna smarasi tatprabho | tayaivaṃ smārite tatra pūrvajātikṛte’vṛṣe |||42||| dadhyau ciramathāvāpya vairāgyamatidurlabham | nirviṇṇamānaso bhūtvā nagarātsa vinirgataḥ ||43|| kumāryā rakṣitaḥ sīmni jalena prokṣito muhuḥ | tāvattasya śarīrādvai pāpāni niryayurbahiḥ ||44|| ekaṃ śṛgālarūpaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ vṛkarūpakam | tṛtīyaṃ gṛdhrarūpaṃ ca caturthaṃ kākarūpakam ||45|| pañcamaṃ māyūrarūpaṃ dadṛśe vai pṛthak pṛthak | kumārī prāha tānsarvān ke yūyaṃ kathamīdṛśāḥ ||46|| te tu prāhustadā kanyāṃ śunaḥ pāpāni vai vayam | rājñā cauryaṃ pararāṣṭre kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ tadasmyaham ||47|| prajādravyaṃ vṛkavacca bhakṣitaṃ ca tadasmyaham | devasvaṃ patitaṃ cāsya kośe gṛdhrastadasmyaham ||48|| anyāyānnaṃ tvasya koṣṭhe jīrṇaṃ kākastadasmyaham | nadīgocaragīryāderdravyaṃ muktaṃ śikhī tvaham ||49|| pañcajanmāni te patyurbhaviṣyanti tataḥ param | puṇyastareṇa rājāsau janako vai bhaviṣyati ||1.386.50|| svayaṃvare patiṃ taṃ tvaṃ labdhvā svargaṃ prayāsyasi | pitaraste janakasya śrāddhairmuktiṃ gatā yadā ||51 || bhaviṣyanti tadā cāsya tvayā svargaṃ bhaviṣyati | gaccha sādhvi gṛhaṃ naijaṃ mā no nāśaya prokṣaṇaiḥ ||52|| ityuktā sā satī prāha yadi sādhvī bhavāmyaham | pativratā yathārthāsmi patyuddhāro’stu me’tra vai ||53|| yadyasmi sevikā patyuḥ pitṝṇāṃ mokṣakāriṇī | tena puṇyena ca yamastvatrāgatyopatiṣṭhatu ||54|| ityuktvā jalamādāya cikṣepa paritastadā | śuni dehe tathā yāmyadiśi tāvad yamaḥ svayam 55|| upasthitaḥ satīṃ prāha śaibye smṛtaḥ kathaṃ tvayā | vada sādhvi kuru śīghraṃ kiṃ te manasi vartate ||56|| śaibyā prāha śuno dehe yāni pāpāni santi vai | teṣāṃ nāśaṃ vidhāyaiva patiḥ prāpyo mayā saha ||57|| vadātra satvaraṃ rājan bhasmīkaromi cānyathā | yamaḥ prāha śṛṇu sādhvi bhogena karmaṇāṃ kṣayaḥ ||58|| tvayā saṃkalpyatāṃ sādhvi nyāyaścāpi vidhīyatām | yadvā pradarśayāmyatra kuru śīghraṃ tathā yadi ||59|| tava dharmapratāpena śīghraṃ cānto bhaviṣyati | ekaikasya janornityaṃ pāpabhogo’sya saṃbhavet ||1.386.60|| tathātra pañcadivasānnuṣitvā kṣapaṇaṃ kuru | satī nārī pātivratyabalena yattu dhārayet ||61 || kartuṃ śaktā tathā sātra bhavasi tvaṃ pativrate | kuru tvadya jalaṃ gṛhya saṃkalpaṃ mama sannidhau ||62| anena jalayogena patirme mucyatāṃ śunaḥ | dinaikaṃ sa pretadehaḥ śṛgālaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ||6 3||| śvaḥ prātaḥ sa śṛgālo vai bhūtvāyāsyati te’ntikam | anena jaladānena mucyatāṃ sa śṛgālataḥ ||64|| dinaikaṃ sapretadeho vṛko bhūtvā pare’hani | āyāsyati jalaṃ dehi mucyatāṃ vṛkayonitaḥ ||65|| dinaikaṃ sa pretadeho gṛdhro bhūtvā caturthake | dine cāyāsyati dehi vāri gṛdhro vimucyatām ||66 || dinaikaṃ sa pretadeho mayūraḥ saṃbhaviṣyati | pañcame’hani vārdehi mayūro’yaṃ pramucyatām ||67|| māyūraṃ tvasya varṣmāpi vājimedhamahākratoḥ | avabhṛthe janakasya nikṣipa salile sati ||68|| yajñaputro janakasya bhaviṣyati patistava | jātamātro yuvā puṣṭo divyo jñānī pratāpavān ||69|| svayaṃvare gṛhāṇa tvaṃ pātivratyabalāt sati | bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi kuru rājyaṃ tataḥ param ||1.386.70|| ityuktvāntardadhe dharmo natvā śaibyāṃ pativratām | śaibyāṃ tathā tathā sarvaṃ pratyahaṃ vidadhe mudā ||71 || śvāpi pretastathā bhūtvā nityaṃ jahāti vai tanum | evaṃ rājakumāro’sau ṣaṣṭhe’hni samajāyata ||72|| ṛtudhvajo’bhavannāmnā jātamātro yuvā balī | tataḥ sā svagṛhaṃ sādhvī samāgatyārthayat punaḥ ||73 || tameva divyapuruṣaṃ patiṃ svamanasā satī | tataśca pitaraṃ śaibyā vivāhārthamanodayat ||74|| sa cāpi kārayāmāsa śibistasyāḥ svayaṃvaram | svayaṃvare kṛte sādhvī saṃjñātaṃ patimātmanaḥ ||75| mudā vavāra bhūyo’pi bhartṛbhāvena bhāminī | bubhuje ca tayā sārdhaṃ nṛpabhogānnṛpaḥ punaḥ ||76|| pitṛparamparāprāptaṃ rājyaṃ videhabhūmiṣu | cakāra vidhivatpitṛmokṣaṇaṃ yajñakarmabhiḥ ||77|| iyāja yajñānsubahūn dadau dānāni cārthiṣu | putrānutpādayāmāsa bhuktvā rājyavasundharām ||78|| tatyājāśītisāhasravarṣānte svakalevaram | tataścitāsthaṃ taṃ bhūyo bhartāraṃ sā pativratā ||79| anvāruroha vidhivad yathāpūrvaṃ mudānvitā | tato’vāpa tayā sārdhaṃ rājaputryā sa pārthivaḥ ||1.386.80|| aindrānatītya vai lokān lokān kāmaduho’kṣayān | svargākṣayatvamatulaṃ dāmpatyamatidurlabham ||81 || satyalokātparaṃ prāpya vairājasthalameva ca | prāpa puṇyaphalaṃ tatra pativratāprabhāvataḥ || 82|| vaikuṇṭhaṃ jalatejaḥstha prāpa sā svāminā saha | śaibyā hi vaiṣṇavī rājñī ṛtudhvajanṛpānvitā ||83|| evaṃ pativratānāryā patiḥ svasya samuddhṛtaḥ | pitarastāritāścāpi vaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ kṛtāḥ ||84|| pāpāni svapratāpena nāśitāni dine dine | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya samuddhāro bhaveddhruvam ||85|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye śaibyāpatyurdevapitrādyanarpitabhojanena pāpāntaraiśca śṛgālavṛkagṛdhrakākajanmāni pañcāheṣu samāpya ṛtudhvajākhyarājaputratvaṃ vaikuṇṭhamokṣaṇaṃ ca pātivratyapratāpenetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaśītyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 386 ||
<1.387> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi ca viprāyāḥ pātivratyabalāśritām | kathāṃ vadāmi te ramyāṃ śravaṇāddharmavardhinīm || 1 || vindhyabhūmau babhūvādyayuge yogaviśāradaḥ | vedaśravā maharṣiśca japayajñaparāyaṇaḥ || 2 || bahuvṛkṣākule ramye śādvale jalasannidhau | parṇakuṭīṃ śubhāṃ kṛtvā vasati sma vane sadā || 3 || homaṃ devārcanaṃ sandhyāmatitheḥ pūjanādikam | sūryamantrajapādīṃśca kṛtvā vanyaphalādanaḥ || 4 || ātmaśreyaḥparobhāryādvitīyo’raṇyakāsanaḥ | vartate sma sadācāraḥ patnīvrataparāyaṇaḥ || 5 || kvacid yogasamādhau sa tiṣṭhatyeva dināni ṣaṭ | bhāryāpi suvratā tasya nityaṃ sevāparāyaṇā || 6 || brahmiṣṭhā yoginī nāmnā suśrutirhi pativratā | snānadhyānārhaṇādhyayanādisatkāryavartinī || 7 || brahma dhyātvā patiṃ natvā sampūjya prātareva sā | ātmānaṃ manyate śreyaḥparaṃ prāptāṃ sajīvanīm | | 8 || ātmā cāsti parabrahmakiraṇaṃ sa ca me patiḥ | patireva paraṃbrahma dharmaḥ sarvo’sti vai priye || 9 || priyasya yā priyaṃkartrī tasyāḥ priyaṃ sadā bhavet | chāyā dehaṃ yathā tadvat patnī patimanuśrayet || 1.387.10 || patnyāḥ sarvevidho dharmaḥ patyāvevāvatiṣṭhati | patyau tuṣṭe haristuṣṭo ruṣṭe patyau saruṭ hariḥ || 11 || bhogadānena bhojyādipradānena ca sevayā | mādhuryādipradānenārhaṇayā toṣayetpatim || 1 2|| saṃvāhanaṃ tadaṃgānāṃ mardanaṃ varṣmaṇaḥ sadā | śayanaṃ svāminā sākaṃ ramaṇe vigraheṇa ca || 1 3|| āplavanaṃ jalādyaiśca śobhanaṃ divyavastubhiḥ | sugandhanaṃ kusumādisāraiḥ saṃpoṣaṇaṃ phalaiḥ || 14|| rakṣaṇaṃ jāgratibhāvaiḥ rañjanaṃ sahakhelanaiḥ | toṣaṇaṃ taddhṛdi vāsairgamanaṃ caikabhāvataḥ || 15|| ānandanaṃ tanudānaistarpaṇaṃ netradānakaiḥ || 16|| havanaṃ cāpatyadānairjapanaṃ omitikṛtaiḥ | snapanaṃ ratidānaiśca dhyānaṃ cātmasamarpaṇaiḥ || 17|| dānaṃ ṛtupradānaiśca dharmaṃ saha pravartanaiḥ | yānaṃ saha vihāraiśca nidhanaṃ tatsamarpaṇaiḥ ||18|| satī sādhvī sārthakaṃ vai patyau kuryāt pativratā | iti dharmānparān svāmiparāyaṇān svamānase || 1 9|| sarvadharmottamān jñātvā sevate sā patiṃ vane | suśrutiryoginī yoge samādhau tiṣṭhati kvacit ||1.387.20 || tasyā agre’pyaraṇyānāṃ paśūnāṃ yatparasparam | vairaṃ sāhajikaṃ tadvai śāntaṃ cābhūt sahasthite ||21 || ṛṣiścāpi sadā patnī sahāyaḥ śubhadhārmikaḥ | brahmadṛṣṭyā sthitiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ prāpto bhāryātmadarśanaḥ ||22|| bhāryāṃ bhāryā na vai mene mene tāṃ parameśvarīm | parabrahmatanorjātāṃ parabrahmasvarūpiṇīm ||23|| patnīṃ tyaktvā na sa vipro bhuṃkte kandaphalādikam | svasevārthaṃ tathāyāse na yunakti mṛṣā kvacit ||24|| śarīraṃ manute kṣayyaṃ naśvaraṃ jalabinduvat | prasannaḥ sarvadā cāste matvā brāhmīṃ priyāṃ satīm ||25|| rasanāyā rase naiva karṇasya śravaṇe na ca | nāsikāyāṃ na ca gandhe tvacaḥ sparśaṃ na vai tathā ||26|| cakṣuṣorna ca rūpe’pi samāsakto virāgavān | bhāryā pativratā brāhmī rasādyātmā hyabhūt kṛtā ||27|| patnīdharmaḥ paro dharmo muktiḥ patnīprasevanāt | pativratāyāstoṣeṇa tuṣyanti devikāsurāḥ ||28|| bhojane śayane yāne pāne viharaṇe vane | raṃjane svapane kārye jñāne jape surārhaṇe ||29|| śṛṃgāre cotsavasthāne vairāgye śravaṇe rase | gāyane nartane vādye viśrānte śādvalāśraye ||1.387.3 0|| ābhūṣaṇe gṛhakārye vanakārye vinodake | hasane śravaṇe vāde vicāre brahmabhāvane ||3 1 || ārtave vikṛtau svāsthye sukhe duḥkhe ca tāpane | saṃśaye tarkaṇe khāne pāne saṃskaraṇe giri ||32||| prasādhane pavitraṇe trāṇane dinayāpane | ālasye jalpane purākhyāne sarvatra bhūsuraḥ ||33|| patnīdharmaṃ puraskṛtya vartate nānyathā kvacit | evaṃ tau dharmamāpannau parasparaṃ tadātmakau ||34|| vartete smābhinnadharmau patnīpatisamārthakau | parasparaṃ prakurvāte sevāṃ brahmamayīmubhau ||35|| kāmacārau kāmarūpau sevādharmaparāyaṇau | ātmatṛptipradau matvā brahmatṛptiṃ hi sevayā ||36|| yaddarśanāddhi pāpāni prayānti vilayaṃ khalu | tādṛśīṃ sādhutāṃ prāptau vindhyāraṇyanivāsinau ||37|| manuṣyo na yathā paśyet kvacid bhavata aiṇakau | paśurna ca yathā paśyet śukau bhavataśca kvacit ||38|| pakṣī na tau yathā paśyet matsyau ca bhavataḥ kvacit | yādaśca na yathā paśyed govṛṣau bhavataḥ kvacit ||39|| kaścitparābhavennāto vyāghrau ca bhavataḥ kvacit | siṃhau haṃsau sarīsṛpau śākhāmṛgau kvacitkvacit ||1.387.40|| bhavatastau vane tatra kvacit sajaṭatāpasau | kvacitkalpalatākalpadrumarūpau ghanāgame ||41 || kvacinmaṇisvarūpau ca kvacid vāyusvarūpiṇau | kvacid devasvarūpau ca kvacid bālasvarūpiṇau ||42|| kvacid vṛddhau yuvānau cādṛśyau dṛśyau babhūvatuḥ | kvacid viprātithiyoge guruśiṣyasvarūpiṇau ||43|| pitṛputrasvarūpau vā yathāpekṣaṃ vyajāyatām | patnīvrataṃ pativrate yathā lope na cāpnuyāt ||44|| tathā tathā svarūpaistau vartete sma vanādiṣu | atha māsikadharmānte ṛtusnātāṃ pativratām ||45|| ṛtudānapradānārthaṃ yuyuje kāmadharmataḥ | ṛṣirmānuṣadharmeṇa ratikeliparāyaṇaḥ ||46 || kāmadharmāśritayorviprayorāśramasannidhau | sphītāndhatamasi kaścinmānavo mānavīṃ giram ||47|| vadannaṭanvanaṃ tatrākasmādāgatavām̐stadā | tenādṛṣṭau dvijau tāvat kāmavighnaṃ vicārya ca ||48|| śabdena mānuṣaṃ jñātvā pracchannau mṛgarūpiṇau | babhūvatustadā tatrāviyuktau kāmanāyutau ||49|| aprāptau kāmanātṛptiṃ paśudharmaṃ samāśritau | manuṣyabhālitau cāpi kāminau paśudharmiṇau ||1.387.50|| manyete naiva lajjāṃ tau tau na nindanti mānavāḥ | kāmāsaktau paśūnaiva dhyāne kurvanti mānuṣāḥ |||51 || paśūnnagnān jñānahīnān lajjādharmādihīnakān | matvā tu mānavāḥ paśvorvighnayanti na maithune ||52|| maithunasthāḥ paśavo’pi gaṇayanti na mānavān | ṛtudānaṃ kāmatṛptiḥ paśurūpe’dya saṃbhavet |||53|| mānuṣe tu mānuṣasyātithyaṃ kartavyamāpatet | aśuddhau ca kathaṃ tat syāt parihartavyameva tat |||54||| riktaṃ parṇagṛhaṃ matvā cāvilokya ṛṣiṃ tataḥ | vanāntaraṃ mānavo’yaṃ gamiṣyati śubhaṃ bhavet ||55|| niśā tu niṣphalā na syāt syātkāle ṛtudānakam | kāmāśāntikṛto vahnirna ca patnīṃ pratāpayet ||56|| bījaṃ tvardhamathanādiprāptaṃ no vikṛtiṃ vrajet | ṛtvadānasamutthaśca yathā doṣo na cāpatet ||57|| sukhayāpyaṃ tathā sarvaṃ mṛgarūpe dhṛte bhavet | iti kṛtvā mṛgarūpau kāmārūḍhau babhūvatuḥ ||58|| kintu tathāpi tatkāle jātaṃ vai viparītakam | mānuṣaḥ sa tu bāṇena dṛṣṭvā vivyādha tanmṛgam ||59|| mṛgo mṛgī dudruvatuḥ kāmadharmaṃ vihāya vai | trāsāt pradhāvitayośca pṛṣṭhaṃ jagrāha mānavaḥ ||1.387.6 0|| tatastau mānavaṃ vyādhaṃ matvā vai paśuhiṃsrakam | paśurūpaṃ vihāyaiva ṛṣirūpau babhūvatuḥ ||6 1 || evaṃ kṛte’pi vyādhaḥ sa nivavṛte na mānavau | dṛṣṭvāpi brāhmaṇau hṛṣṭo dhartuṃ vegena saṃyayau ||62|| brāhmaṇaṃ dhṛtavām̐stūrṇaṃ bhakṣaṇārthaṃ sa rākṣasaḥ | brāhmaṇī kāmadharmā sā nirjanāraṇyavāsinī ||6 3 || kāntādhārā nirādhārā vilalāpa jagāda ca | pādayoḥ patitā te’tra māṃ vā bhakṣaya bhakṣaka ||64|| māṃ tu nirāśrayāṃ jñātvā dehi patidhanaṃ mama | śaraṇyasya śaraṇasthā nārī vai kiṃkarī tava ||65||| vilokya patidharmāṃ māṃ kāmadharmaṃ vimocaya | vittahīnaṃ pramattaṃ ca suptaṃ pṛṣṭhapradarśinam ||66|| prapannaṃ cāśritaṃ dīnaṃ tavāsmītibruvaṃ janam | guruṃ ca pitaraṃ rugṇaṃ mātaraṃ bhaginīṃ priyām ||67|| sādhuṃ sādhvīṃ bālakaṃ gāṃ stryāsaktaṃ strīṃ ratisthitām | suptaṃ niṣkalmaṣaṃ naiva mārayed ghātayenna vā ||68|| nānena te hataṃ kiñcinna vā duṣṭaṃ vicintitam | vanyadharmaparaścāyaṃ na drogdhā te kadācana ||69|| brāhmaṇo’yaṃ na hantavyo brahmahatyā tu te bhavet ||1.387.70|| ṛtuhatyā mahatpāpaṃ bālahatyākaraṃ hi te | bhakṣyārthaṃ prāṇinaḥ santi mā hiṃsi me patiṃ naram ||71 || ayaṃ me prāṇanātho’sti sarvathā jīvanaṃ mama | tannāśe syāṃ vidhavā strī sarvamāṃgalyavarjitā |||72||| mā kuru niṣphalaṃ janma vaidhavyapāpagarbhitam | dayālurbhava me vākye yāce sarvasvameva me ||73 || anena patinā sārdha svarge mokṣo’tra me’sti vai | tannāśe yamaloko’yaṃ deho me vai bhaviṣyati ||74|| muñca nāthaṃ kṛpāṃ kṛtvā svargaṃ te vai bhaviṣyati | mā jahāhi patiṃ me’tra mā jahīhi vṛṣaṃ mama |||75||| prasīdekṣvākuvaṃśyānāṃ tilaka tvaṃ patiṃ mama | tyaja rājan rakṣa dharmaṃ yayāce tvāṃ muhurmuhuḥ ||76|| kāmadharmākṛtārthāyāṃ mayi kṛpākaro bhava | na buddhyase ṛtudharmasukhābhijño’tipāpavān ||77|| evaṃ yācitavatyāḥ sa vākyaṃ karṇe cakāra na | tasyāṃ tu vilapantyāṃ sa bhartāraṃ samabhakṣayat ||78|| ruroda sā satī tatra duḥkhitātipratāpinī | atikopayutā taṃ rājāna śaśāpa duḥkhinī ||79|| tvayā mayyapratṛptāyāṃ matpatirbhakṣito yataḥ | tvamapyantaṃ priyābhogapravṛttau prāpsyasi dhruvam ||1.387.80|| ityuktvā sā patyurasthikhaṇḍaṃ nītvā kare satī | pātivratyapratāpena jīvayāmāsa taṃ patim ||81 || rākṣasaṃ dagdhukāmāpi vyomavāṇyā nivāritā | vaśiṣṭhaśāpād dagdho’sau saudāso rākṣaso bhavan ||82|| kalmāṣapādaḥ saṃbhūtvā samāḥ bhramati dvādaśa | paścācchāpavinirmukto madayantīpatirnṛpaḥ ||83|| bhaviṣyati prajāpālo mainaṃ śāpena yojaya | vaivasvato manorvaṃśe jātā nṛpatayaḥ sati ||84|| ikṣvākunṛgaśaryātinābhāgādyā hareḥ priyāḥ | sudyumnelāpurūravāgayaśatamukhādayaḥ ||85|| karandhamāvikṣimaruttṛṇabinduviśālakāḥ | śaryātyānarta raivatakakudmyambariṣādayaḥ ||86|| śaśādakakutsthapṛthuyuvanāśvamāndhātṛkāḥ | rukmāṃgadamucukundānaraṇyakatriśaṃkavaḥ ||87|| hariścandrasagarāṃśumaddilīpabhagīrathāḥ | janakabadarartuparṇasudāsasaudāsakāḥ ||88||| divodāsendradyumnatoṇḍamadrāmakayādhujāḥ | ete’bhavan harerbhaktā mahābhāgavatā nṛpāḥ ||89|| vaśiṣṭhādikṛpāpātracamatkārasamṛddhayaḥ | saudāso’yamaṭavyāṃ vai vyāghradvayamalokayat ||1.387.90|| vyāghrābhyāṃ tu vanaṃ sarvaṃ khāditvāpamṛgaṃ kṛtam | mṛgayāṃ na tato rājālabdhavāniti roṣataḥ ||91 || vyāghramekaṃ jaghānāthāparo vyāghro vidudruve | mriyamāṇaśca vai vyāghro rākṣaso bhīṣaṇākṛtiḥ ||92|| kṛtvādṛśyo’bhavattatra dvitīyo’pi tu rākṣasaḥ | pratikriyāṃ kariṣyāmītyuktvāntardhī jagāma ha ||93|| atha kālena saudāso yajñaṃ cakāra vaiṣṇavam | ācārye tu vaśiṣṭhe ca viniṣkrānte sadakṣiṇe ||94|| vasiṣṭharūpamāsthāya rākṣasaḥ sa samāgataḥ | deyaṃ me bhojanaṃ māṃsaṃ saṃskarotu drutaṃ tviha ||95|| kṣaṇādihāgamiṣyāmītyuktvā niṣkrānta eva saḥ | sūdaveṣaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā rākṣasaḥ sa mahānase ||96|| viveśa mānuṣaṃ māṃsaṃ saṃskṛtya kṣmābhṛte dadau | saudāso’pi svarṇapātre māṃsamādāya tadṛṣeḥ ||97|| vāṭaṃ vilokya bhaktimān pratīkṣātatparo’bhavat | āgatāya vasiṣṭhāya naramāṃsaṃ sa cārpayat ||98|| vasiṣṭho naiva jānāti kenoktaṃ kiṃ kṛtaṃ nvidam | iti cintāparo bhūtvā kiṃ vastviti vyalokayat ||99|| jñātvā dhyānena māṃsaṃ tanmānuṣaṃ vai samarpitam | aho rājño’sya dauḥśīlyaṃ māṃsaṃ mama prayacchati || 1.387.10 0|| tatrāpi mānuṣaṃ caitad rākṣasārhaṃ prayacchati | iti krodhaparo bhūtvā tūrṇaṃ śaśāpa bhūbhṛtam || 101 || yasmādabhojyamasmākaṃ jānannapi dadāsi me | tasmāttvaṃ naramāṃsādo bhava rājan vigarhitaḥ || 1 02|| rājñā sphuṭīkṛtaṃ kṛtyaṃ kasyedaṃ jñātavān ṛṣiḥ | nāparādhastu rājarṣeḥ rākṣasena kṛtaṃ hi tat || 1 03|| iti vijñātatattvaśca vasiṣṭhaḥ karuṇākaraḥ | saudāse dvādaśābdaṃ rākṣasatvaṃ kṛtavān muniḥ || 1 04|| na tvātyantikamityevamanugrahaṃ cakāra vai | saudāso’pi kare dhṛtvodakaṃ śaptaṃ samudyataḥ || 1 05|| vaśiṣṭhāya tadā tasya madayantī satī priyā | patiṃ rurodha sahasā guruṃ śaptuṃ dadau na sā ||1 06|| guravo na hi śaptavyā rakṣakāstārakāśca te | kalyāṇaṃ vacane teṣāṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ sarvathā hitam || 1 07|| iti prasādito rājā jalaṃ cikṣepa pādayoḥ | svapādau mantraśāpodadagdhau kalmāṣatāṃ gatau || 1 08|| tataḥ kalmāṣapādo’sau saudāso māṃsabhakṣakaḥ | ṣaṣṭhe kāle rākṣasatvamupetya paryaṭan kṣitau || 1 09|| anekaśo mānuṣām̐ścābhakṣayadvividhe vane | so’yaṃ rājāsti saudāso vaśiṣṭhasya praśāpataḥ || 1.387.11 0|| dagdho’sti rākṣase bhāve tava patyuḥ prabhakṣakaḥ | ratibhaṃgakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ strīsaṃge’syopayāsyati || 111 || mariṣyati hyayaṃ rājā mānyaṃ śāpaṃ pradehi tam | kṣamāṃ kuru sati cātra patistvayā prajīvitaḥ || 1 12|| tadoktaṃ ca vaśiṣṭhena yadā vedaśravāḥ ṛṣiḥ | suśrutayā samaṃ vane tava nāśyo bhaviṣyati || 11 3|| taduttaraṃ tvaduddhāro rakṣobhāvād bhaviṣyati | nidhanaṃ vedaśravasastava hastena vedhasā || 1 14|| likhitaṃ vai tāvadeva tasyāyurasti nādhikam | tataḥ patnyā jīvito’pi pātivratyabalena vai || 1 15|| bhūmau sthātuṃ na vai yogyaḥ svargaṃ patnyā gamiṣyati | saudāsaśca madayantyāṃ vaśiṣṭhena maharṣiṇā || 1 16|| niyojitena bījārthaṃ vāsiṣṭhān śataputrakān | labdhvā paścān madayantyāṃ kāmabhogaṃ kariṣyati || 1 17|| mṛtyunā mohitastatrālabdhakāmavinirvṛttiḥ | mṛtyuṃ prāpsyati drāgeva kālaḥ so’yaṃ samāgataḥ || 1 18|| aśmakādyāstasya putrā bhaviṣyanti hi sāttvatāḥ | khadvāṃgaśca dilīpaśca raghurdaśarathastataḥ || 1 19|| rāmacandrādayaścānye bhaviṣyanti pramuktidāḥ | tadevaṃ niścitaṃ matvā suśrute tvaṃ patiṃ svakam || 1.387.1 20|| citāṃ kṛtvātra kāṣṭhīyāṃ pātivratyavidhānataḥ | agniṃ prajvālya cāṃguṣṭhānnārīmānuṣavigraham || 121 || patyasthnā saha saṃgagdhvā jīvitaṃ svāminaṃ punaḥ | vilīyātraiva saṃghātakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ samāpya ca || 1 22|| divyā tvaṃ divyapatinā vahniśuddhā ca nākinā | śarīreṇa vimāne’tra patiṃ nītvā prayāhi vai || 1 23|| nānyā pativratā patnī te samānyā bhaviṣyati | brahmaṇo dinaparyantaṃ svarge sukhamavāpya ca || 1 24|| tato yāsyasi vaikuṇṭhaṃ tenaiva patinā saha | ityuktvākāśavāṇī sā virarāma ca suśrutiḥ || 1 25|| nanāma tāṃ diśaṃ rājā nanāma ca satīṃ tadā | yayau kṣamāṃ suyācitvā svakaṃ vai nagaraṃ prati || 1 26|| sasmāra suśrutistatra vaśiṣṭhaṃ so’pyadṛśyata | natvā dhṛtvā patiṃ kāṣṭhacitāyāṃ nijavahninā || 1 27|| bhasmīkṛtvā satī dehau divyau vidhāya ca | natvā vaśiṣṭhaṃ yānena yayatuḥ svargameva tau || 128|| devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi camatkārakaraṃ param || 1 29|| prāgvṛttaṃ divyasiddhyādipradaṃ tatpaṭhanāttathā | śravaṇācca bhaveddharmadārḍhyaṃ svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam || 1.387.13 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye vedaśravasaḥ patnyāḥ pativratāyāḥ suśruteścamatkārāḥ, kalmāṣapādātmakarākṣasasya kāmāsaktayorvedaśravaḥsuśrutyorāśramaṃ pratyāgamanaṃ, vedaśravaso rākṣasakṛtabhakṣaṇaṃ, suśrutidattaśāpaḥ, ākāśavāṇyā saudāsasya rākṣasatve nimittakāraṇākhyānakathanaṃ, vaśiṣṭhasannidhau suśrutivedaśravasoḥ satībalena svargamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 387 ||
<1.388> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi dharaṇyā nandayoṣitaḥ | pativratāyāścāritryaṃ camatkārasamanvitam || 1 || jambūdvīpasya rājābhūnnandasāvarṇisaṃjñakaḥ | samudro yasya rājyasya parikhābhūtsamantataḥ || 2 || vārāhasya prabhorbhakto rato vārāhapūjane | vārāhe ca mahākṣetre nityaṃ vijñānasatpathāḥ || 3 || samāgamya parāṃ bhaktiṃ karoti devavāñchitām | hiraṇyākṣahṛtāṃ pṛthvīmānetuṃ bhagavān svayam || 4 || vārāharūpamāsthāya hiraṇyākṣaṃ nihatya ca | pṛthvīṃ sa cānayāmāsāsthāpayattāṃ jalopari || 5 || tadākāśe vimānena bhramatā nandabhūbhṛtā | vārāhantu mahadrūpaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ brahmāṇḍanāyakam || 6 || avatīrya vimānāt saḥ stutiṃ tasyākarottadā | | namo’nantasvarūpāya puruṣottamanāmine || 7 | | svalokāvanasaṃkartre dharitryāḥ pataye namaḥ || sarvatattvanivāsāyākṣarādhīśāya te namaḥ ||8 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyāstu namaskārastu me punaḥ | tvayā pṛthvī kṛpayādya rakṣitā rakṣitā vayam || 9 || anādhārāśca rājānaḥ prajāścāpyavitāḥ prabho | rakṣaṇārthe prajānāṃ vai karoṣi nūtanaṃ vapuḥ ||1.388.10|| sarvaśaktinivāso’si sarvarūpātmane namaḥ || iti stutvā nanāmāsau rājā vārāhapādyoḥ ||11|| vārāhastu prasannaḥ san prāha rājñe varāya vai | brūhi rājan prasanno’smi kiṃ te manasi vartate ||12|| vad dāsye mano’bhīṣṭaṃ sadā bhakteṣṭado’smyahm | ityuktaḥ sa uvācainaṃ prasannaṃ parameśvaram ||13|| kiṃ vṛṇomi kṛpāsindho dharaṇiṃ dehi me punaḥ | hiraṇyākṣahṛtāṃ celāṃ tvaddatāṃ pālayāmyaham ||14|| madgṛhe dharaṇiścāstu kuru māṃ dharaṇīpatim | vinā dharaṇiṃ rājñastu jīvanaṃ niṣphalaṃ yataḥ ||15|| vārāhastu tadā prāha tathāstviti nṛpaṃ tataḥ | nandasāvarṇirātmeśaṃ vārāhaṃ samapūjayat ||16|| patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaistoyairannaiḥ kandaistathākṣataiḥ | ratnairhīrakamaṇyādihāraiścandanakuṃkumaiḥ ||17|| sauvarṇakaṭakaiścāpi kānakaiśca vibhūṣaṇaiḥ | mukuṭormikakaṭakaiḥ śṛṅkhalākuṇḍalādibhiḥ ||18|| nūpuraiḥ kiṃkiṇīyuktairvastraiḥ sugandhavāriṇā | dhūpadīpaiḥ stavanaiśca kṣamāparādhavandnaiḥ ||19|| vārāhaṃ nityamevāsau prātaḥ saṃpūjya vai nṛpaḥ | tato’nyat prakarotyeva sātvato vaiṣṇavo mahān ||1.388.20|| vārāhaḥ suprasannaḥ san rājñe vai mukuṭaṃ dadau | āāparikhaṃ tava rājyaṃ jambūdvīpe’stu sarvaśaḥ ||21|| dharaṇiśca bhavatvadya te patnī supativratā | ityuktvā bhagavānnandasāvarṇiṃ tilakaṃ vyadhāt ||22|| ānītāṃ pṛthivīṃ tasyai dadau rājyaprarekhayā | tataḥ śrībhagavān prāha dharaṇiṃ divyarūpiṇīm ||23|| bhaja devi satīrūpā rājñī bhūtvā nṛpaṃ sadā | natvā tu dharaṇī nārāyaṇaṃ tvabhyarcya bhāvataḥ ||24|| tadājñāṃ mastake dhṛtvā kanyārūpaṃ dadhāra sā | vārāhamānasī devī dvayaṣṭavarṣātisundarī ||25|| jātamātrā yuvatyeva sapuṣpamālikā śubhā | sarvalakṣaṇasampannā | svāmidharmaparāyaṇā ||26|| vārāheṇārpitāṃ mālāṃ dadhānā karayostadā | vārāhasya nideśenārpayāmāsa gale śubhe ||27|| varayāmāsa bhāvena nandasāvarṇimeva sā | vārāhaṃ dampatī pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇematuḥ ||28||l vārāhaṃ pūjayāmāsatuśca sākṣājjanārdanam | dharitrī pūjayāmāsa nityaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ patim ||29|| tathā tadājñayā nandsāvarṇiṃ patimuttamam | nityaṃ vasundharā snātvā mudā ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ||1.388.30|| vārāhaṃ prākpatiṃ samyak pūjayitvā tatastu tam | bhojayitvā ca vanditvā tato nandaṃ vadhūttamā ||31|| pūjayatyeva bhāvena bhojayatyeva bhāvataḥ | sevate bhūbhṛtaṃ nityaṃ bhūmirdvitīyavarṣmaṇā ||32|| evaṃ bhūrbhagavatsevāṃ nandasevāṃ ca bhāvataḥ | karotyeva sadā pātivratyadharmeṇa medinī ||33|| yasyāstu bhagavān svāmī rakṣakaśca niyāmakaḥ | | tasyāḥ sarve pātivratyadharmāstasya nideśane ||34|| vārāhasya vacaḥ pātivratyaṃ nandavacanastathā | bhūrūpā sā varāhasya patnī cāpi nideśataḥ ||35|| kanyārūpā vadhūḥ sābhūnnandasāvarṇibhāminī | nandaṃ prasevate nityaṃ vārāhātmānameva sā||36|| vārāhastvekadā prāha dharaṇe śṛṇu madvacaḥ | upasaṃhartumicchāmi rūpaṃ vārāhameva me ||37|| vada kiṃ te’styabhīṣṭaṃ tad dadāmyatra ca mā ciram | dharaṇistu paraṃ śokaṃ tvavāpāśrutya tadvacaḥ ||38|| vavande caraṇau tasya vavre pūjārthamuttamam | rūpaṃ bhagavatastatra darśanārthe nirantaram ||39|| bhagavān dharaṇiṃ prāha me dantaṃ te dadāmi yat | | rakṣa pūjaya saṃpaśya sevayainaṃ yathā hi mām ||1.388.40|| ityuktvā pradadau dantaṃ dharaṇyai pūjanāya vai | dante sāmarthyamatyugraṃ vartate tannibodha ca ||41|| araṇye parvate svarge pṛthvyādyāvaraṇeṣvapi | pātāleṣu samudreṣu vahniṣvapi digantare ||42|| yatra kvāpi gantumiccheḥ saha nītvā radaṃ mama || prayāhi dharaṇe yatra tavecchā syādabādhitā ||43|| gatiste syādahatā vai dantayuktā sukhaṃ vraja | vahnirjalaṃ viṣaṃ śaityaṃ śilā vāyustathāmbaram ||44|| bādhante na radaṃ me vai radayuktaṃ tathā janam | ityuktvā svaradaṃ datvā datvāśīrvādamuttamam ||45|| dharaṇiṃ nandasāvarṇiṃ nibhālyādṛśyatāṃ yayau | devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha ||46|| devāśca munayaḥ sarve vimānaistatra cāyayuḥ | tuṣṭuvurdharaṇīnāthaṃ vārāhaṃ divyarūpiṇam ||47|| gacchantaṃ vai svakaṃ dhāma ninyuste sotsavaṃ harim | athātra dharaṇiḥ patnī sā nandasya pativratā |48|| nityamarccayati dantaṃ vārāhaparamātmanaḥ | saha nītvā vimānena nandasāvarṇisaṃyutā ||49|| kvacidbhūmau kvacitsarge kvacitpātālavistare | sāmudre salile kṣīre sāgare ca kvacid yayau ||1.388.50|| evaṃ viharatoḥ rājñīnṛpayorbahumānavāḥ | upāyanāni pradaduḥ surarṣipitarastathā ||51|| pātālavāsinaścāpi svargadevā jaleśayāḥ | maṇimāṇikyaratnāni hīrakamauktikāni ca ||52|| sauvarṇaṃ raupyakaṃ tāmraṃ tadnye ca rasāyanam | dhātvāyanaṃ sudhādyaṃ ca varyaśastrāstramaṇḍalam |53|| yadyadasmai pradattaṃ sthānibhistūpāyanātmakam | nando lobhābhibhūtaśca nināya nijamandiram ||54|| yadā dravyasya kośādi dhanādibhiḥ prapūritam | tadā vicārayāmāsa koṣastvanyo hyapekṣyate ||55|| akṣayyaścāpyagamyaścāpyadṛśyaścāpyagocaraḥ | kartavyo’yaṃ mayā koṣastādṛśo bhūmigarbhake ||56|| evaṃ vicārya dharaṇiṃ patnīṃ papraccha tadvidhām | | patnī prāha nṛpaṃ rājan kopaṃ vārdhitale kuru ||57|| vārāhasya radastatraḥ sahāyo’sti gatipradaḥ | radaṃ vinā gatirnāsti te me kuto’parasya tu ||58|| iti vicārya sarado nṛpo gatvāsbdhisannidhau | tāvad dantaprabhāveṇa mūrtimānabdhirāgataḥ ||59|| dadau mārgaṃ trasan vāri saṃkucya nandabhūbhṛte | nando ratnākare kṛtvā kośaṃ viśālamadbhutam ||1.388.60|| dhanaṃ ratnādi yatkiṃcitsarvaṃ nihitavām̐stataḥ | vārdhitale kṛte kośe dantasāhāyyataḥ khalu ||61|| abādhite kṛte kośe lobhastasya vyavardhata | pṛthvīdhanāni sarvāṇi svarṇaraupyādikāni ca ||62|| āhṛtya nītvā tatraiva nikṣipatyeva sarvadā | lobhavṛtterna vai cānto bhavatyatra vinā tu śam ||63|| tāvadasyābhavad vṛttirlobhādhīnātiduḥkhadā | sarvā pṛthvī prajāḥ sarvā dhanariktā kṛtāstataḥ ||64|| mṛtānāṃ bhūgarbhagataśavānāṃ mukhagaṃ dhanam | dhātukhaṇḍaṃ ḍhabbuk vā tannikhanyāpi cāhṛtam ||65|| jambūdvīpe yatra yatra śavaṃ jñāyeta bhūgatam | khānayitvā tu tad dravyaṃ śavāsyāt prasamāhṛtam ||66|| dhṛtaṃ dantasahāyena kośe sāmudrake tale | athaikadā dharaṇyā vai bhūbhṛte sanniveditam ||67|| kuru rājanmahāyajñaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ raudramityapi | aśvamedhaṃ rājasūyaṃ pṛthvyāṃ satrāṇi kāraya ||68|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ pārāyaṇaṃ mahat | | ciraṃ satāṃ brahmayajñaṃ mokṣayajñaṃ ca kāraya ||69|| dravyaṃ tu naśvaraṃ vayaṃ naśvarā naśvaraṃ jagat | seśvaraṃ kāryamākṛtvā gacchāmaḥ paramaṃ padam ||1.388.70|| ityukto’pi mahālobhī rājā dhānyaṃ na vai dadau | rājñī sā dharaṇī divyā natvā nandaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||71|| vārāhaṃ tu tadā smṛtvā tiro’bhūttena varṣmaṇā | | rājā rurod bahudhā sāntvayitaḥ prajājanaiḥ ||72|| yajñaṃ cakāra ca patnyā vākyaṃ smaran śuśoca ha | nityaṃ dantaṃ varāhasya pūjayatyeva bhūpatiḥ ||73|| lobhavṛttyā dhanaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavadeva vai datā | sahāyena samaṃ nītvā rarakṣābdhitale tathā ||74|| rājñī kṛtā dvitīyā paṃkilā ṣoḍaśahāyanā | samudraputrī nandena kāmalubdhena bhūbhṛtā ||75|| samudrasyābhavallobhaḥ kośasyākṣayavastunaḥ | putrīṃ prāha nṛpaścāyaṃ vārāhadantahetunā||76|| kośaṃ tale me kṛtavān nityamāyāti yāti ca | | nityaṃ sevā mayā kāryā kṣobho bhavati me jale ||77|| tatsarvaṃ parihāryaṃ syāttathā kartavyamasti me | śrṛṇu putri meruputrī upalā nandabhāminī ||78|| taddvārā vai mayā rodhaḥ kartavyo’tra na saṃcaret | | gacchāmyahaṃ kuberāya viṣṇave brahmaṇe tathā ||79|| nivedayituṃ nandasya lobhavṛttāntamulbaṇam | tato yadvai bhāvi taddhi bhaviṣyati harikṛtam |1.388.80|| yatno’vaśyaṃ prakartavyaḥ phalaṃ mādhavahastagam | ityuktvā prayayau rājā kuberabhavanaṃ ca tam ||81|| nītvā yayau harerlokaṃ viṣṇave prāha tadvṛttam | śrutvā viṣṇurniyamane kṛtasaṃkalpa eva ca ||82|| sasmāra nāradaṃ tūrṇaṃ prāha vṛttāntameva tam || nāradastu tadā tarkaṃ saṃklṛptvā mānase svake ||83|| yayau śīghraṃ nandasaudhaṃ nando gṛhe na vartate | upalāṃ nāradaḥ prāha kalyāṇaṃ vāstu te sati ||84|| kvāsti nandaḥ paṃkilā ca anyāḥ sakhyaśca te sati | upalā tamṛṣiṃ dṛṣṭvā satkāraṃ namanādikam ||85|| arghyādikaṃ kṛtavatī papracchāgamakāraṇam | nāradastu tadā prāha śrutaṃ svarge mayāsti yat ||86|| ṛtaṃ vā tadanṛtaṃ vā tvāyāto’haṃ parīkṣitum | pratyakṣaṃ tu vinā vāṇīgeyaṃ mānyaṃ na vidyate ||87|| pratyakṣeṇa kṛtaṃ siddhaṃ parihāryaṃ na jāyate | vijñāninaśca samrājo nandasya cakravartinaḥ ||88|| gauṇaṃ viṣayinindyaṃ ca śravyaṃ yogyaṃ na vai yataḥ | kṛtvā pratyakṣamevāhaṃ paścād yāsye divaṃ punaḥ ||89|| devā devasabhāmadhye varṇayanti ghṛṇāmayam | nando mṛtāyā dharaṇerasthipūjāṃ karoti hi ||1.388.90|| anyāśca nūtanā nārya premapātrāṇi no tathā | yathā dharaṇiḥ pūrvāsīt premapātraṃ yadasthi ca ||91|| vadopale tvayi kīdṛk premāsti nandrabhūbhṛtaḥ | paṃktilāyāṃ tathānyāsu sneho nandsya kīdṛśaḥ||92|| upalāha tu devarṣiṃ rājā māmantarā kṣaṇam | sthātuṃ bhoktuṃ śvasituṃ ca rantuṃ ca jīvituṃ tathā ||93|| naiva śaknoti devarṣe bhuṃkte dṛṣṭvā mamānanam | anyāsu nedṛśaḥ sneho yathā mayi pravartate ||94|| devarṣiḥ prāha satyaṃ syād yadi devoktamanṛtam | devoktaṃ yadi satyaṃ vai tavoktaṃ tvanṛtaṃ bhavet ||95|| yathā tava mukhaṃ sādhvi nādṛṣṭvā cātti bhūpatiḥ | adṛṣṭvā tu dharaṇyasthi na bhuṃkte nandabhūpatiḥ ||96|| kiyat satyaṃ parīkṣasva sneho’sya kutra vādhikaḥ | dṛṣṭvāpyahaṃ gamiṣyāmi paśya pūjāsthavastukam ||97|| ityuktā hyupalā śīghraṃ yayau pūjāsthalaṃ tataḥ | pūjāvastūni saṃdṛṣṭvā pūjāpeṭīṃ dadarśa sā ||98|| tāvattatrāsthi saṃdṛṣṭaṃ dantarūpaṃ tathā tadā | bhagnaharṣā mlānamukhā tejohīnābhavat kṣaṇam ||99|| roṣatāmrānanā jātā nāradaḥ prāha tāṃ satīm | mā sma khedaṃ kuru rājñi saṃsāraḥ sāravānna vai ||1.388.100|| satyaṃ devāḥ pravadanti rājā patnyasthipūjakaḥ | sneho’dhiko dharaṇyasthi na tvaṃ nāsyasthisamāpi vai ||101|| sāpatnyaṃ sāntakṛd duḥkhaṃ dhanyāsi sahase sati | aśuddhamasthiṃ pūjāyāṃ rakṣitaṃ hi śmaśānavat ||102|| tvāṃ vai svargasamāṃ tyaktvā śmaśānaṃ sevate nṛpaḥ | dūraṃ kuru śmaśānaṃ tat kṣipāgnau bhasmatāmiyāt ||103|| snānaṃ śuddhiṃ kuru vārbhirityuktvā nārado yayau | | upalā copalātulyā sapatnīroṣavahninā ||104|| dagdhā śīghraṃ varāhāsthiṃ cikṣepāgnau tadaiva sā | nāradasyecchayā harericchāyā vahnirādahat ||105|| asthibhasmāpi sarito jale cikṣepa roṣataḥ | saśokaroṣā gṛhagā bhojanaṃ nākarot satī ||106|| rājā sāyaṃ tvājagāma novāca taṃ satī tadā | | prātaḥ snātvā tu pūjārthaṃ yāvattiṣṭhati pārthivaḥ |||107|| dadarśāsthi na pūjāyāṃ kośasya kuṃcikātmakam | hyaśoca ca kṣaṇe tvāṃ ca papraccha mṛtamānasaḥ ||108|| kvāsthi gataṃ vad devi sarvajīvanakāraṇam | upalā prāha cullikāvahnau gataṃ tadasthikam ||109|| tavānanaṃ hyanālokya bhuṃjāmi na kadāpi ca | | iti no vaṃcanārthāya mṛṣā rājan vikatthase ||1.388.110|| mṛtāyā dharaṇerasthi pūjāyāṃ rakṣyate tvayā | yadagre tṛṇavanmūlyaṃ kṛtaṃ naḥ sarvathā tvayā ||111|| mṛṣāvādī svayaṃ bhūtvā kathaṃ vañcayasi prabho | | asthi dagdhaṃ ca tadbhasma nadyāṃ pravāhitā mayā ||112|| kuru snehaṃ mayi rājan jīvatīṣu priyāsu ca | mṛtāyāṃ mā kuru snehaṃ bhavabandhanakārakam ||113|| ityuktaḥ sa dhanalobhī rājā dhanatadātmakaḥ | anityāśuciduḥkhānātmasu saṃghātakāriṣu ||114|| nityaśicisukhātmakhyātimān hā heti vai vadan| hṛdayasyātirodhena mamāra nandapārthivaḥ ||115|| patnyastaṃ ca tadā kroḍe kṛtvā tāśca satīpriyāḥ | dehān prajvālya vai svarge yayurvārāhayogataḥ ||116|| dharaṇyāśca pratāpena vārdhirdhanatalo’bhavat | dharaṇyā dhanasāvarṇistato rājyakaro’bhavat ||117|| tatputro dharmasāvarṇirveṣṇuvo’bhūd bhuvaḥ patiḥ | śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya jñānaṃ svargaṃ tathā bhavet ||118|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye nandarājño bhaktyā vārāheṇa dharaṇiḥ bhāryā kumārikā rūpāntareṇa tasmai dattā, dharaṇyāḥ pātivratyena varadānarūpaṃ dantāsthi prāptaṃ, nandena taddvārā samudre dhanakośaḥ kṛtaḥ, dharaṇinidhanottaraṃ nāradenāgatya sapatnyā asthipūjanaṃ rājā karotīti upalāyai kathayitvāsthi bhasmāyitaṃ, tadāghātena rājā nando mamāretyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāśītyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||388||
<1.389> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi merudevyāḥ kathāṃ śubhām | pativratāyā nābheśca patnyā yadṛṣabhaḥ sutaḥ || 1 || jambūdvīpādhipaḥ pūrvamāsīdāgnīdhrarājakaḥ | tasya putro’bhavannābhiranapatyo’bhajaddharim || 2 || nābheḥ patnī merudevī pātivratyaparāyaṇā | patiṃ devaṃ patiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ patiṃ nārāyaṇaṃ param || 3 || patiṃ dharmaṃ patiṃ karma varma nārāyaṇātmakam | parabrahma patiṃ matvā sevate svātmavat| sadā || 4 || sa ca brahmarṣipatnīnāṃ brahmajñā brahmavittamā | brahmatantuvedavidyāvatī homaparāyaṇā || 5 || karmakāṇḍakriyābhijñā pūjāpāṭhaparāyaṇā | brahmaśaktisvarūpā sā sarasvatyaparā yathā || 6 || vartatesma brahmaparā sati rājye’pi pāvanī | prātaḥ snātvā patiṃ natvā devān saṃpūjya vastubhiḥ || 7 || patyuḥ pūjāṃ vidhātuṃ sā prāvartate patipriyā | patiṃ saṃsnāpya vastrādyairalaṃkṛtya tataḥ satī || 8 || tadaṃguṣṭhajalaṃ pītvā mahāpūjāṃ karoti sā | suvarṇasya śubhe pīṭhe saṃniṣādya patiṃ mudā || 9 || viṣṇave patirūpāya samarpayāmi cāsanam | arghaṃ pādyaṃ cācamanaṃ matsvāmine’rpayāmi ca || 1.389.1 0|| dantaśuddhikaraṃ cāṅgaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ dadāmi rakṣiṇe | gaṇḍūṣārthaṃ jalaṃ tairthaṃ sugandhiyuk dadāmi ca || 11 || śaucādyarthaṃ jalaṃ cānyat pradadāmi madarthine | mṛttikādyaiḥ parāṃ śuddhiṃ kārayitvāmṛtāni ca || 12|| dadhi dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ miṣṭaṃ madhu dadāmi svāmine | abhiṣekārthasalilaṃ samarpayāmi svāmine || 1 3|| snapayāmi patiṃ tailaṃ mardayāmi sugandhakṛt | siñcāmi ca jalaṃ yogyaṃ snānārthaṃ mama svāmini || 14|| komalenāmbareṇāhaṃ mārjayāmi jalaṃ tanoḥ | vastraṃ suvarṇavarṇaṃ ca dhautraṃ yajñopavītakam || 15|| uttarīyaṃ yajñapaṭṭaṃ svāmine tvarpayāmi ca | keśaprasādhanaṃ puṣpasugandhatailayogataḥ || 16|| kurve matsvāminastuṣṭyai samarpayāmi candanam | tilakaṃ candrakaṃ bhāle kārayāmi suśobhitam || 17|| netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ ramyaṃ samanajmi satīpateḥ | mastake mukuṭaṃ ramyaṃ karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale śubhe || 18|| kaṇṭhe maṇigrathitātyuttamahārān dadāmi ca | hastayoḥ śṛṃkhale dve ca bhujayoḥ kaṭake śubhe ||1 9|| prakoṣṭhayoḥ kaṭake ca kaṭyāṃ ca raśanāṃ tathā | pādayornūpure ramye puṣpahārām̐śca śekharān ||1.389.20|| gale mālāḥ kare gucchaṃ pāduke pādayoḥ śubhe | samarpayāmi pataye sauvarṇasya kṛtāni vai ||21 || chatraṃ ca cāmare ramye siṃhāsanaṃ suvarṇajam | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ cākṣatām̐śca kuṃkumaṃ svarṇayaṣṭikām ||22|| samarpayāmi pataye naivedyaṃ miṣṭabhojanam | svarṇasthālyāṃ pradattaṃ ca śaṣkulīlaḍḍukādikam ||23|| pāyasānnaṃ vyañjanāni dadhi dugdhādikaṃ phalam | bhakṣyabhojye lehyacośye peyaṃ miṣṭaṃ jalādikam ||24|| samarpayāmi pataye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmane | ārārtrikaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ jalaṃ śaṃkhasya śītalam ||25|| pradakṣiṇāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ ca puṣpāñjaliṃ samarpaye | natiṃ kṣamārpaṇaṃ cāpi dāsyaṃ sarvaṃ samarpaye ||26 || pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cānyāṃ sevāṃ sarvāṃ karomi ca | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpasvāmino’haṃ pativratā ||27|| admi prasādaṃ devasya patyurme pāpanāśanam | evaṃ pūjayate nityaṃ prātaḥ patiṃ yadā satī ||28|| patyau divyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tatra caturbhujam | paśyati sma tadā pātivratyabhaktyā mahāsatī ||29|| evaṃ prātaśca madhyāhne sāyaṃ rātrau ca sevate | ekadā sā sthitā dhyāne sevayitvā patiṃ satī ||1.389.3 0|| dadarśa sā mahattejo brahmalokāvadhipratham | āviścakāra bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||3 1 || hiraṇmayaḥ pītakauśeyāmbaradhṛk śriyā yutaḥ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmacarmakhaḍgasuveṇumān ||32|| lasanmukuṭakuṇḍalakaṭakakaṭisūtrakaḥ | hārakeyūranūpurādyaṃgabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ||33|| tādṛśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cārhat pativratā | tutsīdaladūrvādbhiḥ kusumaiśca nivedanaiḥ ||34|| arhattamo’si bhagavan divyaguṇasamanvitaḥ | guṇagānaṃ sevanaṃ te bhaktāyā me’stu gocaram ||35|| rājarṣirme patiḥ śaśvatprajākāmo’sti bhaktarāṭ | tvatsamaḥ syādasya putro yenāhaṃ sukhamāpnuyām ||36|| bhagavānāha me dāsi tvanmukhaṃ manmukhaṃ sati | tvayārthitaṃ satīvākyaṃ satyaṃ bhavatu tattathā ||37|| āgnīdhrīyoṃ’śakalayāvatariṣyāmi te gṛhe | ityuktvā satkṛtiṃ labdhvā tvantardadhe pumuttamaḥ ||38|| tasmindine niśākāle merudevyāṃ narāyaṇaḥ | prāviveśātha prātaścāvātatāra tadgṛhe ||39|| jātamātro yuvā sarvajñānasiddhiprapūritaḥ | sāmyopaśamavairāgyaiśvaryavibhūtisaṃbhṛtaḥ ||1.389.40|| etādṛśaṃ sutaṃ kīrtibalaujaḥśrīguṇādibhiḥ | vīryaśauryadharmabhaktiyutaṃ taṃ ṛṣabhaṃ jagau ||41 || ṛṣabho’yaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāvatāra eva saḥ | yatspardhayā mahendraśca na vavarṣa samātrayam ||42|| yogeśvaraḥ sa ṛṣabhaḥ prahasya yogamāyayā | ajanābhe svīyarājye megho bhūtvābhyavarṣayat ||43|| nābhiḥ putraṃ tamṛṣabhaṃ rājye’bhiṣicya cātmanā | parātmani mahāyogaṃ merudevyā yuto’labhat ||44|| naranārāyaṇaṃ dhyātvā dampatī mokṣamīyatuḥ | ṛṣabhaḥ sthāpayāmāsa vidyāśikṣāpradaṃ śubham ||45|| dharmaśikṣaṇalābhārthaṃ vidyāgurukulaṃ mahat | svayaṃ rājā svayaṃ śikṣācāryo bhūtvāpyaśikṣayat ||46|| indraḥ svayaṃ samāgatya jayantyākhyāṃ svaputrikām | lakṣmīrūpāṃ bhagavate ṛṣabhāya dadau satīm ||47|| gṛhadharmeṇa ṛṣabhastasyāṃ putraśataṃ śubham | yogināṃ maṇḍalaṃ tadvai janayāmāsa sadṛśam ||48|| tatra vai bharato rājā bhāratādhipatirbabhau | kavirharirantarikṣaḥ prabuddhaḥ pippalāyanaḥ ||49|| āvirhotro’tha drumilaścamasaḥ karabhājanaḥ | mahābhāgavatāścaite brahmamārgāśca yoginaḥ ||1.389.50|| anye kuśāvartakādyā rājāno’pyabhavan sutāḥ | brāhmaṇā yajñaśīlāśca śrotrīyāścābhavanpare |||51 || ṛṣabho bhagavān kāruṇikaḥ śāntiprado nṛṇām | dravyadeśavayaḥśraddhākālojitavṛṣe’carat ||52|| ekadābhūt samālakṣāvadhibrahmarṣisaṃkulā | brahmāvarte jagāma śrīṛṣabho bodhamādadau ||53|| rājyaṃ smṛddhiḥ sukhaṃ sarvaṃ svīyaṃ ceti prakalpitam | pārthivena prapuṣṭaṃ ca dehaṃ pārakyamityapi ||54|| klidyamānairbhojanādyaiḥ kledadharmaṃ ca pāśavam | saṃjñānaṃ tattanuṃ labdhvā brahmārjanaṃ praśasyate ||55|| sattvaśuddhirdehabhāve kathaṃ syād bhogasaṃbhṛte | brahmasaukhye śāśvatike kurvantu śramaṇaṃ prajāḥ ||56 || brahmātmāno brahmarūpā brahmasaukhyā hi sādhavaḥ | yogino yatayaḥ sevyā mahābhāgavatā janaiḥ ||57|| gṛhadārāpatyavāṭīpaśukṣetrāṇi yāni ca | māṃ tu nārāyaṇaṃ tyaktvā bandhanāni tu tāni vai ||58|| tāneva māṃ puraskṛtya yojitāni pare yadi | mokṣadvārāṇi jāyante suhṛdaḥ sādhavo yathā ||59|| māṃ vihāyendriyagrāme lubdhaśca viṣayeṣviha | ramate yaḥ sadā baddho na sa sādhuḥ prajāyate ||1.389.6 0 || yasyātmendriyaviṣayāntaḥkaraṇāḍhyavarṣmaṇaḥ | ātmatattvāptyānukūlyaṃ sa vai pāśātpramucyate ||6 1 || tatsarvaṃ matprītiyuktaṃ yod syāt karmakṛd yadi | nirguṇaṃ matpadaprāptipradaṃ syādātmanaḥ priyam ||62||| svārthaṃ bandhakaraṃ sarvaṃ parārthaṃ mokṣadaṃ yataḥ | strīpuṃbhāvaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ granthirūpaṃ vicintya yaḥ ||63 || mohaṃ vihāya vijñaḥ syāttadāślatheta bandhanam | karmāśayo vilīyeta muktaḥ syādātmanātmani ||64|| icchālaye yatnalayo niṣtṛṣṇasya prajāyate | pūrṇakāmāśraye prāpte tṛṣṇā sarvā nivartate ||65|| duḥkhadoṣāntakṛtsarvaṃ nāhaṃ tathā nirīhakaḥ | iti vimṛśya vidyāvān paramahaṃsamāśrayet ||66|| mayi karmāṇi sannyasya matkathāśravaṇādibhiḥ | mama satāṃ prasaṃgena mama līlāprakīrtanaiḥ ||67|| mayi nirguṇabhāvena yuñjānā muktimāpnuyuḥ | dṛśye śravye tathā spṛśye māṃ vibhāvyātmano gurum ||68|| sādhuśīlo jano bhūtvā hyuparameta yogataḥ | bhakttyānuvṛttyā kṣamayā vitṛṣṇayā titikṣayā ||6 9|| māyāyāṃ doṣavṛttyā ca jijñāsayāpyanīhayā | matkathayā sevayā matsāmyadṛṣṭyā jihāsayā ||1.389.70|| adhyātmabuddhyā prahaṃsasevayā brahmacaryayā | śraddhayendriyajayayā yamaniyamavārtayā ||71 || bhāvanayā pramādādivarjitayā ca vidyayā | yogavṛttyā sattvabuddhyā maddayayā prasannayā ||72|| madanugrahasaṃprāptyoddharannuddhārayetparān | āśāvādagatān jīvānnisargagṛdhnasaṃvahān ||73|| avidyāyāṃ vartamānān kāmakāmānanāratān | karmamūḍhājjaḍabhāvān sukhaleśārthamūrchitān ||74|| utpathagān ruḍdviḍvyāptānnandhakūpe na pātayet | prayojayecca naiṣkarmye yena śāntirhi śāśvatī ||75|| putraḥ patnī gururmātā pitā bandhuḥ patiḥ svasā | suhṛnmitraṃ sutāḥ sārthaḥ sa eva yo vimocayet ||76|| dharmaṃ tu vakṣasi kṛtvā pṛṣṭhe vihāya cāvṛṣam | yuñjyāta sarvātmanā kṛṣṇe ṛṣabho haṃsa eva saḥ ||77|| dharmato mānavāḥ pūjyāḥ puṇyaśreṣṭhā hi devatāḥ | sattvaśreṣṭhāstu ṛṣayo brahmādyā brahmaśaktibhiḥ ||78|| ta eva brāhmaṇāḥ proktā brahmaśaktyanvitāstu ye | matparā brāhmaṇāḥ sarve mahābhāgavatāḥ priyāḥ ||79|| sādhavo hṛdayāsyā me tolaye netarat samam | yatra vai śraddhayā dattaṃ hutaṃ gṛhṇāmyahaṃ sthitaḥ ||1.389.80|| ta eva sevanīyā vai prajābhirmatsvarūpiṇaḥ | pade pade pāvakāste yatrārhaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tu me ||81 || sākṣāt so’haṃ sādhumūrtiścetanaḥ kṣmābhujāṃ guruḥ | paraḥ so’haṃ haṃsarūpo dhāvalyadaḥ śubhātmanām ||82|| mahāmohalayaṃ prāptaḥ kṛtāntapāśakartanaḥ | granthigrathitagrāmāḍhyaiḥ sukhaprāpyo’tra haṃsakaḥ ||83 || svahaṃseṣu parahaṃsaṃ gṛhṇantu haṃsakalpakāḥ | ityupadeśamādatvā śiṣyān haṃsān vidhāya ca ||84|| digvāsā brahmabhoktā sa yayāvareṇyamekalaḥ | jaḍāndhamūkabadhironmattavadvyacarad vane ||85|| ātmārpitasvaparadharmamatāhaṃvivarjitaḥ | brahmānandaparipūrṇatṛptihāsapraphullitaḥ ||86 || anantakāmasaundaryo naijatejaḥsamujjvalaḥ | vikarṣan prauḍhavanitāmanāṃsi bhagavadguṇaḥ ||87|| kṣetre vane hyaṭavyāṃ cājagarīṃ vṛttimāśritaḥ | śayāno’śnāti pibati khādatyapi ca mehati ||88|| evaṃ gomṛgakākādicaryayā vicacāra saḥ | kaivalyādhipatiścātmamahānandānuveśitaḥ ||89|| jalasthalāmbaragatiḥ siddhasarvārthasaṃbhṛtaḥ | yadṛcchāptaiśvaryasiddhīrnābhyanandat hṛdāpi vai ||1.389.90 || asthire manasi sakhyaṃ naiva kuryāddharerjanaḥ | viśvastaṃ taccirāccīrṇaṃ tapo nāśayati drutam ||91 || miṣṭaṃ miṣṭaṃ pradarśyaiva garte kṣipati yoginam | kāmaṃ krodhaṃ kaliṃ mohaṃ bhayaṃ dainyaṃ dadāti yat ||92|| so’yaṃ bhagavadrūpo’pi darśayannaiśvarīṃ prathām | avadhūtakṛtiṃ tiṣṭhan jihāsuḥ svakalevaram ||93|| pāṣāṇaṃ kavalaṃ kṛtvā dadāha veṇuje’nale | avatārā hareryāne netuṃ tatra samāgatāḥ ||94|| sādhuṃ purāṇapuruṣaṃ kalyāṇasaṃbhṛtakriyam | ninyuḥ satkāravādyādyaiḥ sthānipāvitryalabdhaye ||95|| svarga janaṃ tapo mahaḥ satyaṃ vairājakaṃ staram | hairaṇyagarbhaṃ bhaumaṃ cāmṛtaṃ kṛtvā sa pāvanam ||96 || yayau brahmaparaṃ lokaṃ saccidānandapauruṣam | yatra vai naiṣṭhikā yogā brāhmā brahmavidaḥ surāḥ ||97|| pibanti brahma paramaṃ nityatṛptā athāpi te | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi merudevyāstathā śubham ||98|| nābheścaritraṃ yasya vai putro’bhūdṛṣabho hariḥ | kṣudrajīvā yamāśritya bhaviṣyanti sajīvanāḥ ||99|| haṃsā bhūtvā brahmalokaṃ yāsyanti kevalaṃ padam | paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya kaivalyapadabhāg bhavet || 1.389.10 0|| āśrayaṇād gṛhatyāgād dīkṣāgrahād vanāsanāt | yo lābhaḥ sa bhavedasya śraddhayā śravaṇāt priye || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye nābhermerudevīkṛtayā pātivratyadharmeṇa mahāpūjayā bhagavadavatāraḥ ṛṣabhaḥ putro babhūva, tasya yogeśvarādayaḥ putrāḥ, tasyopadeśaḥ, vanacaryā, cirantanaparamahaṃsarītivivecanam, vivekajñānamityādi nirūpaṇanāmaikonanavatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 389 ||
<1.390> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi kathā vaikuṇṭhalokagā | mama janmajayantyā utsave nṛtye susaṃbhavā || 1 || kārtikasyādhavalasya pakṣasya tvaṣṭamītithau | kṣmāyāṃ prāvirabhuvaṃ kambharāgopālayo’rgṛhe || 2 || tannimittaṃ mahaṃ cakrurvaikuṇṭhe mama pārṣadāḥ | pārṣadāṇyaśca bhaktāśca vaikuṇṭhaṃ sotsavaṃ hyabhūt || 3 || maṇḍapāḥ kāritā ramyāḥ svarṇakalaśaśobhitāḥ | kadalyādistambhayuktāśokapatrāditoraṇāḥ || 4 || vidyutpradīpaśobhāḍhyāḥ śrutiyantrādirājitāḥ | raṃgānuraṃgasaccitrahārālidivyatānvitāḥ || 5 || siṃhāsanādiśobhāḍhyā bhojyapeyādiśobhanāḥ | nṛtyamaṇḍapabhāgāḍhyā nartakīgaṇasaṃśritāḥ || 6 || gandharvāśritasadvādyā devarṣigaṇamaṇḍalāḥ | gṛhāṇyapi vicitrāṇi bhavanāni kṛtāni ca || 7 || śṛṃgāritāni divyāni rathyāmārgāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ | āvāsāḥ saṃskṛtāḥ sarve narā nāryaḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ || 8 || khānabhojanapeyādisamutsavapraphullitāḥ | gāvaḥ śṛṃgāritāḥ kanyā vastrabhūṣādiśobhitāḥ || 9 || ajīrāṇi dadhiraṃgaiścūrṇairmaṇḍalitāni ca | vādyānyapi pratigṛhaṃ samavādyanta tanmahe || 1.390.1 0|| gītayaścāpi śrūyante sarvavaikuṇṭhavāsiṣu | prātaḥ savitṛsauvarṇe cāmbare’thābhikāśite ||1 1 || divyāramāprabhālakṣmīmāṇikīpārvatīśriyaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ naijaṃ svāminaṃ parameśvaram || 1 2|| saṃsnāpyāmṛtavārbhiśca sugandhasāracandanaiḥ | tailasārādibhirvāsayitvā vastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ || 1 3|| ratnahīrakamaṇyādihāraiḥ kusumavastubhiḥ | makuṭakuṇḍalahārakaṭakaśṛṃkhalādibhiḥ || 14|| ūrmikānūpurairyaṣṭikuṇḍalaistilakādibhiḥ | śobhito bhagavānnātho dāsībhiśca camatkṛtaḥ || 15|| patnībhiḥ sahitaḥ svasya pārṣadaiścāpi koṭibhiḥ | kanyābhirdāsadāsībhirmuktaiḥ sabhāṃ samāyayau || 16 || jayaśabdā hyabhavam̐ścāvākiran kusumākṣataiḥ | lājābhiḥ kusumairdravyaiḥ svarṇamudrādibhiḥ priyā || 17|| cakrurguṇadhvaniṃ vetrahārāḥ karṇamanoharam | namanti sma sabhāsaṃsthā vīkṣante vaikuṇṭhaprajāḥ || 18|| pūjayanti kramāt sarve bhāgavatāstu pārṣadāḥ | sarvā muktāśca muktānyaḥ kṛṣṇapatnyaśca dāsikāḥ || 19|| kanyakāśca prajāḥ sarvā vaikuṇṭhavāsino janāḥ | tilakena lalāṭe ca darbhadānena karṇayoḥ ||1.390.20|| puṣpāñjalyā mastake ca gucchena karayostathā | hārālibhiḥ kaṇṭhadeśe jalena kṛṣṇapādayoḥ ||21 || namanena tasya hṛdi premṇā nārāyaṇātmani | upadābhiścaraṇāgre pūjayitvā ca saṃsadi ||22|| yathāsthānaṃ sthitāḥ sarve nṛtyaṃ prāvartatādbhutam | gāndharvā gāyanaṃ cakrurvādayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ||23 || gāyikāścābhyanujagustāladāstālamācaran | nāradādyāśca tatrāsan vipracītyādikāḥ striyaḥ ||24|| ṛṣayo munayo devāḥ samājagmurmahotsave | athātra samaye kanyā sāttvatapārṣadasya vai ||25|| kanyāśatayutā śṛṃgāritā nārāyaṇasya tu | pūjāṃ kartuṃ samāyātā dvyaṣṭavarṣātisundarī ||26 || pārṣadastatra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya pārśvagaḥ | gāndharvajātīyavaryo gāndharvaḥ saliladyumān ||27|| cakame tāṃ varārohāṃ dṛṣṭvā cañcalanetrakaḥ | kanyā kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayitvā jalaṃ kṛṣṇasya pādayoḥ ||28|| dhṛtvā mukhe kṣitau śeṣaṃ smṛtvā gāndharvameva sā | śaśāpa tvaṃ kṣīṇadhano mānavo bhava cañcalaḥ ||29||| gāndharvo’pi sukanyāyāścikīrṣitaṃ dadarśa tat | śaśāpa tāṃ tvamapi prakṣīṇadravyaṃ tu mānavī ||1.390.3 0 || cañcalānuprayāhyasmāt sthānād yāvat samānavaḥ | ityabhidhāya natvā taṃ yayau nārāyaṇaṃ gṛham ||3 1 || tāvat pṛthvyāṃ patito’sau cyavano’bhūdayonijaḥ | araṇye vyacarannityaṃ salile’pi sthito’bhavat ||32|| jātismaro jaraddeho vyacaraccyavano muniḥ | vaṃśastambāśritaḥ pṛthvyāṃ tapastepe sa dāruṇam ||3 3|| valmīkastasya śirasi vaṃśastambo’pyajāyata | sukanyā sāttvataputrī mahānte bhavanaṃ yayau ||34|| pitaraṃ prāha tatsarvaṃ sāttvato haripārṣadaḥ | sāntvayāmāsa putrīṃ svāṃ prāha kanyāṃ sulocanām ||35|| śokaṃ mā kuru putri tvaṃ tvadarthaṃ cāpyahaṃ bhuvi | dvitīyena svarūpeṇa cakravartī bhavāmi vai ||36|| paścāttvaṃ tu samāyāhi tvadduḥkhaṃ nāśayāmyaham | ityuktvā sāttvataḥ pṛthvyāṃ śaryātirabhavannṛpaḥ ||37|| paramo bhaktarāḍ rājā brahmiṣṭho brāhmaṇapriyaḥ | jātismaro vaiṣṇavaśca sūryodayāstabhūprabhuk ||38|| vaikuṇṭhasya kṣaṇe yāte sukanyā bhuvamāgatā | śaryātirlakṣavarṣo’bhūccyavanastu dvilakṣakaḥ ||39|| śaryātestu gṛhe kanyā mānasī putrikābhavat | divyā divyaramātulyā yathā vaikuṇṭhavāsinī ||1.390.40|| nārāyaṇaparā nityaṃ śubhā pitrostu sevikā | pātivratyaparāsarvacamatkārātiśālinī ||41 || jātismarāvane’raṇye tīrthe bhūmau ca parvate | samudre cāmbare svarge pātāle sainyakṛdraṇe ||42|| sarvatra vyomagā divyā yayau rājño’nuyāyinī | smarati sma saliladyuṃ tapantaṃ vaṃśavistare ||43|| tayā sārdhaṃ vanaṃ yāto rājā sainyena saṃyutaḥ | sakhībhiḥ sahitā sā ca vicinvānā sumāni vai ||44|| yayau yatra tapasvyāste bhāvisevāśrayo muniḥ | yāmyāṃ dṛṣṭā caṃcalābhyāṃ netrābhyāṃ te dadarśa sā ||45|| valmīkarandhrake ramye śubhe cañcatsutārake | daivapreraṇayā bālāvidhyatkaṇṭakayojite ||46|| susrāvāsṛk tato sainyasyābhūnmūtrādirodhanam | śaryātistadvilokyāha sainikān duḥkhitān muhuḥ ||47|| daivībhūmiriyaṃ kācid devā vā munayo’thavā | tāpasā vā rākṣasā vāvaśyaṃ syuratra sadvane ||48|| kasyāpyatrāparādho vai mayā sainyena kāritaḥ | anyathā na bhaved yāvatsainyamūtrādirodhanam ||49|| yatkiṃcidvā yathā yadvā tadvā kvāpi ca kiṃcana | yadi jātaṃ kenaciccāvaśyaṃ prakāśyameva tat| ||1.390.50 || yadvayaṃ tatpratīkāraiḥ rakṣitāḥ syāma aiśvarāt | tadā jātismarā kanyā sukanyā pitaraṃ jagau ||51 || vaṃśastambe’tra yugalaṃ jyotirmayaṃ nibhālitam | mayā valmīkavivare nirbhinnaṃ kaṇṭakena ca ||52|| tato’sṛṅnirgataṃ rājan manye tadaparādhanam | etadvijñāya rājāpi sasmāra sāttvataḥ svayam ||53|| saliladyuṃ ca sukanyāṃ ca vaikuṇṭhe śāpaśāradām | duhiturvacanaṃ śrutvā rājā valmīkasannidhau ||54|| yayau prasādayāmāsa valmīkāntarhitaṃ munim | prāha dehī sukanyāṃ me mūtrarodhādi naśyati ||55|| tathāstviti nṛpaḥ prāha cyavanaścotthito mṛdaḥ | vaṃśastambena śirasi śṛṃgavatsa vyarājata ||56|| tatraiva duhitā tasmai pradattā sūryasākṣiṇā | svasthaṃ cābhūcca tatsainya yayau rājā gṛhaṃ svakam ||57|| cyavanastapasā vyāptaḥ śuṣkanāḍīśarīrakaḥ | tatrāśrame parṇakuṭyāṃ rukṣo vṛddho’vasattathā ||58|| sukanyā cyavanaṃ prāpya patiṃ paramakopanam | prīṇayāmāsa cittajñā samayajñānusevayā ||59|| śarīraṃ mardayāmāsa vṛddhasya svāminaḥ satī | tailena puṣpasāreṇa sugandhacandanādibhiḥ ||1.390.6 0|| uṣṇodakena snapanaṃ kārayāmāsa bhāvataḥ | vastrāṇi cārpayāmāsa dhārayāmāsa cānvaham ||6 1 || vanyaṃ phalaṃ kaṇaṃ kandaṃ bhojayāmāsa saddalam | pāyayāmāsa madhuraṃ jalaṃ prasravaṇāhṛtam ||6 2|| śāyayāmāsa kadalīdalakṛcchayane satī | agniṃ prajvālyāgnihotraṃ kārayāmāsa sadrasaiḥ ||6 3 || atithīn sevayāmāsa darśanārthaṃ samāgatān | devasevāṃ tulasyāśca patraiśca kamalaiḥ satī ||64|| kārayāmāsa vidhinā phalairjalaiśca śraddhayā | samidhaścānayāmāsa pārśvapavitravṛkṣajān ||65|| gītikāṃ kīrtanaṃ jñānaṃ śrāvayāmāsa kaṇṭhataḥ | evamṛṣeranuvṛttyā prīṇayāmāsa sā satī ||66 || pātivratyaṃ paraṃ prāptā vinā kāmasukhaṃ satī | ekadā cintayāmāsa vṛddhasya śuṣkavarṣmaṇaḥ ||67|| ṛṣerdehasya kalpārthaṃ sasmārāśvikumārakau | sukanyayā smṛtau sūryaputrau kṣaṇādupasthitau ||68|| vaidyau tāṃ prāhaturnamrau vada mātarnamo’stu te | sukanyāha ṛṣervarṣma mama yogyaṃ yathā bhavet ||69||| sundaraṃ yauvanopetaṃ sabalaṃ vīryavattamam | tathā dattaṃ vayo matsvāmine bhogasamarthakam ||1.390.70 || tathāstviti samuccāyīśviputrau cyavanāya vai | natvā tasmācca vavrāte somabhāgaṃ kratau sadā ||71 || ṛṣirbāḍhaṃ tu tau prāha tataścaitau rasāyanaiḥ | tatraiva nirmite kuṇḍe pūrṇe cāsnāpayadṛṣim ||72 || ṛṣirviṃśativarṣo vai yuvā devīpramohakaḥ | māṃsalaḥ sundaro ramyaḥ pūrṇasaṃbhṛtavīryakaḥ ||73 || rasāyanaistu sañjāto na dṛṣṭo na śrutaḥ purā | purā sukanyayāpi tadrūpaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ purā ||74|| kanyāyāḥ pātivratyasya parīkṣārthaṃ ca tāvapi | vaidyau rūpāntare dhṛtvā rasāyanena miśritau ||75|| yūnā muninā saṃyuktau samarūpau babhūvatuḥ | paśyantyā kanyayā kuṇḍād dṛṣṭāḥ samuttthitāstrayaḥ ||76 || puruṣāḥ sadṛśākārāḥ kuṇḍalinaḥ suvāsasaḥ | sugandhavyāptaśarīrā lāvaṇyarasavārdhayaḥ ||77|| divyasragdhāriṇastejobhiśca sūryā ivāpare | ajānatī patiṃ sādhvī dadhyau dhyānena taṃ patim ||78|| katamotra ṛṣirbodhyo yasyāsmyahaṃ pativratā | varaṇīyaḥ sa evādya tyājyau dvau ca tadanyakau ||79|| vicāryeti satī svasmāccharīrācca mahānalam | samutpādyānalavyāptā yayau tām̐strīṃ parīkṣitum ||1.390.80|| uvācāgniṃ vinā kāntaṃ prajvālaya tadanyakau | tāvadvahnirvavalge tāvanyau jvālābhireva vai ||8 1 || bhasmīkartuṃ muniṃ tyaktvā tāvaccukruśatuśca tau || jājvalyamānāvayavau vavandāte bhiṣaktamau ||82 || rakṣārthaṃ cakraturyāñcāṃ satyā vahnirnivāritaḥ | pātivratyena satyena cyavane mālikārpitā ||83 || pātivratyaṃ paraṃ jñātvā santuṣṭau tvaśviputrakau | ṛṣimāmantrya yayatuḥ satīṃ natvā triviṣṭapam ||84|| atharṣiścyavanaḥ svasya śvaśuraṃ bhūbhṛtaṃ prati | vaninaṃ preṣayāmāsākārayāmāsa tadvane ||85| | śaryātiḥ suprasannātmāyayau ṛṣivarāśramam | dṛṣṭvā yuvānaṃ dihutuḥ pārśve rūpāntarānvitam ||86 | | rājāścaryasamāpanno babhūvodvignamānasaḥ | putrī svapitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā samutthāya natiṃ vyadhāt ||87|| rājā prāha tadā putrīṃ muniṃ vṛddhaṃ vihāya kim | jāraṃ
