saṃsevase bhartuḥ piturnipātyase kulam ||88|| adhikṣiptā janakena putrī prasannamānasā | uvāca tāta jāmātā tavaiṣaścyavano muniḥ ||89|| śaśaṃsa sarvavṛttāntaṃ muniḥ prāha nṛpaṃ tataḥ | svāgataṃ te’stu sāmrājyaṃ nirvidhnaṃ cāstu sarvathā ||1.390.90|| yajñaṃ kuru mahārāja somābhidhaṃ mamājñayā | aśvinorasomapayordehi somagrahaṃ kratau ||91 || cakāra yajñaṃ rājāsau cyavanaḥ svena tejasā | akārayat somapānaṃ tvaśvinorvaidyayostadā ||92| indro vajraṃ samudyamya hantuṃ muniṃ samāgataḥ | savajraṃ staṃbhayāmāsa cyavanaḥ sa harerbhujam ||93| | anvajānaṃstataḥ sarve sadā somagrahāviti | vaidyau kaniṣṭhāviti yat pūrvaṃ matvā bahiṣkṛtau ||94|| tatastau svargatau rājā dadau bhūyasī dakṣiṇāḥ | devaviprātithibhyaśca cyavanaḥ svāśramaṃ yayau |||95|| śaryāterabhavatputrastvānarttaḥ kṛṣṇabhaktimān | golokāt sa maṇeḥ khaṇḍaṃ kṛṣṇadattaṃ samānayat ||96|| so’yamānartadeśo’sti saurāṣṭraḥ paścimābdhibhāg | ānartād revato jāto nirmame sa kuśasthalīm ||97|| tasya jātaḥ kakudmī ca yasya kanyā tu revatī | yātā pitrā saha satye loke praṣṭuṃ pitāmaham ||98|| yogyaṃ patiṃ tu kaṃ lapsye tatra prāha pitāmahaḥ | kṣaṇe kāle’tra saṃyāte pṛthivyāṃ saptaviṃśatiḥ ||99|| caturyugānāṃ cātītā mūlā ādyā nṛpādayaḥ | tadvaṃśavaṃśavaṃśyānāmapi cihnaṃ na vidyate || 1.390.100 || tasmād dehi kṛṣṇabhrātre baladevāya me matam | ityuktaḥ sa samāgatya baladevāya tāṃ dadau || 101 || kakudmī tu tapaḥ kartuṃ naranārāyaṇāśramam | badaryākhyaṃ yayau bheje kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sadā || 10 2|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi pātivratyaparāyaṇam | camatkāraṃ sukanyāyā paṭhanācchravaṇādapi || 1 03|| pāpanāśastathā muktirbhuktiśca vardhate’dhikā | kānte kṛṣṇe’tigā lakṣmi phalaṃ sevākṛtaṃ labhet || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vaikuṇṭhe śrīkṛṣṇanārāyāṇasyorjādhavalāṣṭamyāṃ jayantyutsave nṛtyādiyoge saliladyugāndharvasya sāttvatakanyāyāḥ sukanyāyāḥ cañcalanetradarśanakṛtaśāpena parasparaṃ pṛthivyāmāgatya cyavanatvaṃ śaryātikanyātvaṃ ca, tato vane cyavananetrayoḥ kaṇṭakāgreṇa sphoṭane sainyamalamūtrādinirodhaḥ, kanyāyāñcā ca, cyavanagārhasthyam, aśvinīkumāradvārā navayauvanam, pātivratyaparīkṣaṇam, vaidyayoḥ somayāge somabhāgagrāhitvam, śaryātiputra ānartastasya kakudmī tasya revatyā baladevena vivāhanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||390 ||
<1.391> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi patisevācamatkṛtim | yacchrutvā saṃśayāḥ pativratānāṃ yānti vai layam || 1 || patiḥ kṛṣṇasvarūpo’sti śrīkṛṣṇaḥ patirūpataḥ | vartate sarvathā patnyāḥ kalyāṇārthaṃ hariḥ svayam || 2 || patiḥ prākṛtajanavat karoti vividhāṃ kriyām | tathāpi puṇyarūpā sā pativratākṛte matā || 3 || pativratāyāstatraiva śreyaḥ paraṃ hi vartate | yathā yatra prasannaḥ syādadharmo’pi vṛṣaḥ sahi || 4 || bhartuḥ prītikaraṃ kuryāt sadā patnī pativratā | mahāprītimavāpnoti bhartrā saha tathākarī || 5 || yad devebhyo yatpitṛbhyo’tithibhyo yad yadātmane | tatsarvaṃ svāminaścārthe vidadhyādvai pativratā || 6 || kṛtasyārdhaṃ satī bhuṃkte bhartṛśuśrūṣayaiva sā | bhartṛpuṇyaṃ sadā bhuṃkte bhartṛloke vasecciram || 7 || yāvadādityacandrau ca tāvaddevopamā divi | atra tatra mahāsaukhyānandamagnā bhavet satī || 8 || pativratāyā brāhmaṇyāḥ patisevāṃ vadāmyaham | kauśikākhyo brāhmaṇo vai vedakarmaviśāradaḥ || 9 || pratiṣṭhānapure tvāsīd yuvā rūpaguṇālayaḥ | kathākhyānaparaścāpi bahuśiṣyapraśiṣyakaḥ || 1.391.10 || dharmaṃ karoti nityaṃ saḥ puṇyaṃ dānaṃ karoti ca | ṣaṭakarmanirataścāpi rājakāryakarastathā || 11 || antaḥpure vadhūvarge viśvāsyo yāti nityadā | rājñīnāṃ bodhakartā ca kanyānāṃ śikṣakastathā || 1 2|| kalādākṣyādisaṃśreṣṭhastattvajñāne viśāradaḥ | utsaveṣu nṛpāṇāṃ sa rājñīnāṃ yāti mantraṇāt| || 1 3|| rājajanmāhasaṃsatsu vipro yāti nimantraṇāt | nartakyo yatra vividhā vādayitryaśca gāyikāḥ || 14|| devīsamāḥ svarṇavarṇā dvyaṣṭavarṣāḥ susatkṛtāḥ | rājñādiṣṭāḥ pragāyanti nṛtyanti vādayanti ca || 15|| saṃgo hi balavān lakṣmi yasya saṃgaḥ prajāyate | tadraṃgarañjitaṃ vyaktermānasaṃ sphaṭikādivat || 16|| jāyate darśanaṃ yādṛk tādṛgicchā pravartate | pravṛttirbhogyalabdhau ca mohitasya prajāyate || 17|| purā susaṃskṛtā buddhirmohāviṣṭā tu kalmaṣā | atṛptasya satṛṣṇasya jāyate labdhikiṃkarī || 18|| asya kauśikaviprasya bhāryāsīdvai pativratā | yuvatī sevikā śaibyā patyājñāṃ pārameśvarīm || 1 9|| vidhiśrutiṃ parāṃ śreyaskarīṃ matvānuvartate | patnyā sevikayā sādhvyā sukhyabhūt sa tathāpi vai ||1.391.20|| yadā rājasabhāṃ yāti nṛtyagītivilāsitām | tadā dvyaṣṭasamānyūnāścandrāsyā gaṇikā dvijaḥ |||2 1 || vilokya hāvabhāvādikartrīḥ śṛṃgāraśobhanāḥ | svarṇacampakavarṇābhāḥ kāmanāvān babhūva saḥ ||22|| tatraikāṃ tanuśobhāḍhyāṃ bhogyāṃ vipro hyakalpayat | athāgato gṛhaṃ daivājjvarogātiparārditaḥ ||23|| asṛg jalātmabhāvaṃ vai dehe tasya vyajāyata | carmakuṣṭhaṃ tato jātaṃ galatkuṣṭhā nakhāstathā ||24|| evaṃ rogeṇa saṃkliṣṭaḥ smararogeṇa cādhikaḥ | jājvalyamānohṛdaye nidrāṃ nāvāpa vai palam ||25|| satī patnī suśīlā sā sarvabhāvena sevate | taṃ patiṃ paramātmānaṃ matvā ghṛṇāṃ karoti na ||26|| nityaṃ prakṣālayatyuṣṇasalilena nakhādikam | snānaṃ kārayati samyag vastrādhānādikaṃ tathā ||27||| atreḥ śiṣyo’bhavad vipraḥ suśīlā tu pativratā | anasūyāsuśiṣyābhūjjñānadharmādisaddhanā ||28|| ataḥ sā svapatiṃ nityaṃ dehena manasā dhiyā | karmaṇā vacasā sādhvī santoṣayati sevayā ||29|| vipro niḥśvāsamāmucyaikadā provāca tāṃ satīm | nidrā me na samāyāti mānasaṃ jvalate sadā ||1.391.3 0|| yaddinād vai mayā dṛṣṭā gaṇikā rājasaṃsadi | tāṃ bhoktuṃ me samicchāsti vada patni karomi kim ||3 1 || kāmānalo hṛdye me jvalate gaṇikāśrayaḥ | pādau kuṣṭhau karau vṛkṇau rugṇo’haṃ tāṃ kathaṃ labhe ||32 || tāṃ yadi prāpaya patni sadgatirme bhaviṣyati | anyathā vāsanāvattve nidhane’dhogatirdhruvā ||3 3|| ityuktā sā satī sādhvī natvā patyuḥ prapādayoḥ | aho bhāgyamahobhāgyaṃ patyustoṣaṃ karomi vai ||34|| gaṇikāṃ prāpnuyāt svāmī yathā tadvai karomyaham | patnī sadbhāgyayuktā sā bodhyā puṇyakarī tathā ||35|| yādiṣṭā svāminā tuṣṭyai drāk tuṣṭiṃ pradadāti sā | yayā svāmī bhavet tuṣṭaḥ sevā sā netarā kvacit ||36|| ityuktvā prayayau sādhvī pṛṣṭvā patiṃ tu tadgṛham | gaṇikāṃ pādayornatvā prāha sādhvī priyaṃ kuru ||37|| mama patyurasi mānyā smaratyaharniśaṃ svasaḥ | tvāmeva hṛdaye dhyātvā vipro nidrāṃ karoti na ||38|| ahaṃ te kiṃkarī bhūtvā kariṣye te’tisevanam | raṃjaya me patiṃ śreṣṭhe yadicchasva dadāmyaham ||39|| ityuktā sā brāhmaṇasya papraccha nāma vai dhanam | sarvamāveditaṃ tasyai sādhvyā sa gaṇikā tadā ||1.391.40|| sādhvī prāha prarugṇasya kathaṃ saṃgaṃ dadāmi vai | tathāpi dhanalobhena rañjayiṣye patiṃ tava ||41 || dehi nityaṃ śataṃ mudrā rājatīrniśithe’tra me | gṛhe tvānīya śayane kuru te tu patiṃ mama ||42|| nityaṃ kuṣṭhāktavastrāṇi kuṣṭhahastau tathetarat | tvameva kṣālaya cedvai dāsye kāmakriyāṃ tadā ||43|| dehi suvarṇabhūṣāśca kāmabhogaṃ karotu saḥ | ityādiṣṭā satī cātiprasannābhūt hṛdantare ||44|| tāvad dravyaṃ dadātyeva nītvā svaskandhayoḥ patim | saṃyojayati sundaryeṣṭayā gaṇikayā samam ||45|| bahubhirvāsaraiḥ svāmī tṛpto’bhūt kāmadevataḥ | patnīṃ prāha sati te’stu satīloko’tra śāśvataḥ||46 || adyāntimaniśāyāṃ māṃ nītvā bhogaṃ prakāraya | paścāt tṛptaḥ sadā jāto necchāmi gaṇikāgṛham ||47|| ityuktā sā satī bhāryā skandhe nidhāya satpatim | rātrāvandhatamovyāptamārgeṇa gaṇikāṃ yayau ||48|| tāvanmadhye mahadvighnaṃ samutpannaṃ priye śṛṇu | māṇḍavyākhyo maharṣirvai rātrau vṛkṣatale sthitaḥ ||49|| tatra tenaiva mārgeṇa corā rājadhanaṃ bahu | corayitvā nirgatāstān rājabhaṭāḥ samantataḥ ||1.391.50|| baddhvā rājagṛhaṃ ninyurmāṇḍavyaṃ jagṛhuśca te | pathi śūle tadā protamacauraṃ cauraśaṃkayā ||51 || māṇḍavyaṃ taṃ tathāvidhaṃ śūlamāropya kiṃkarāḥ | gatavanto gṛhaṃ naijaṃ māṇḍavyo duḥkhito’bhavat ||52|| pativratā suśīlātha skandhayoḥ kauśikaṃ patim | kṛtvā duḥkhārtamāṇḍavyaśūlaṃ spṛṣṭvā tamomaye ||53 || mārge yāvajjagāmāsau tāvatskandhagataḥ patiḥ | māṇḍavyamatiduḥkhārtaṃ cālayāmāsa sa dvijaḥ ||54|| pādāvamarṣaṇāt kruddho māṇḍavyastamuvāca ha | sūryodaye mṛtistasya yenāhaṃ cālitaḥ padā ||55|| tacchrutvā prāha tadbhāryā sūryo nodayameṣyati | yadyahaṃ syāṃ patibhaktimatī svāmiparāyaṇā ||56|| patisevāprapuṇyena sūryamārgo nirudhyatām | etayā tu yathoktaṃ vai tattathaiva pravartitam ||57|| tataḥ sūryasya vai cāśvāḥ preryamāṇā api dhruvāḥ | sthairyamāptā jaḍībhūtā gatiṃ nāgre samālabhan ||58|| tataḥ sūryodayābhāvādabhavat satataṃ niśā | sā tu satī patiṃ nītvā veśyābhogaṃ pradāya ca ||59|| patiṃ tṛptaṃ kārayitvā yayau svasyā gṛhaṃ punaḥ | patiṃ saṃsnāpya vidhinā kuṣṭhaṃ prakṣālya varṣma ca ||1.391.60 || svayaṃ snātvā patiṃ sugandhādyaiḥ sāmardayattathā | vastrabhūṣāpuṣpamālādhūpadīpādi saṃdadau ||6 1 || dugdhapānaṃ dadau sādhvī sarvāṃ pūjāṃ cakāra sā | patistṛpto gṛhasmṛddhiḥ sarvā veśyāvaśaṃgatā ||62|| satī tvacintayallakṣmīṃ lakṣmīstatrā samāgatā | vanditā pūjitā satyā dadau cintāmaṇiṃ tataḥ ||63|| āśīrvādavaco datvā yayau lakṣmīrnijaṃ gṛham | satī cintāmaṇidvāro’racayaddhanadhānyakam ||64|| gṛhopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca mudrikāḥ | rasān divyām̐stathā bhogān miṣṭānnajalavaibhavān ||65|| atha sūryānudayane tato devā bhayaṃ yayuḥ | brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmustānūce padmasaṃbhavaḥ ||66|| pativratāyā māhātmyānnodgacchati divākaraḥ | pativratātapastejaḥ sūryatejo’dhikaṃ yataḥ ||67|| sūryasyānudayānnāśo martyānāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā | sandhyāpūjārcananaivedyaṛtunāśanaṃ bhavet ||68|| devānāmṛṣivaryāṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ cāpi bhojanam | vinā sūryodayaṃ luptaṃ bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ||69|| tasmāt pativratāṃ sādhvīṃ kauśikasya hi sevikām | prasādayata vai patnīṃ bhānorudayakāmyayā ||1.391.70|| ityājñāṃ brahmaṇo labdhvā devā munijanarṣayaḥ | yayustatra yatra kuṣṭhī tvāste patnyā samaṃ gṛhe ||71 || āgatā mlānavadanāḥ satkṛtāste hi yoṣitā | arcitā vanditāścāpi pṛṣṭāścāgamakāraṇam ||72|| sarve svāsanapādyādyaiḥ pūjitāḥ sukhahetave | vavandire satīṃ hetuṃ vinivedya punaḥ punaḥ ||73|| devi māṇḍavyaśāpaste svāmine yatkṛto’dhunā | tvayā sūryānudayaścetyubhau vai lokanāśakau ||74|| kimatra devyā kartavyaṃ yathā lokahitaṃ bhavet | kṛpāṃ kṛtvā kuru sādhvi yathā kāryadvayaṃ bhavet ||75|| patyāyuḥ sūryadevasyodgamaśca sukhado bhavet | māṇḍavyavacanaṃ cāpi yathā satyaṃ bhavettathā ||76 || atreḥ patnī tadā tatrānasūyā lokavanditā | kauśikasya gurupatnī suśīlāṃ prāha sā satī ||77|| śṛṇu putri trayaṃ kāryaṃ yathā bhaved vadāmi te | devāstvatrāgatāsteṣāṃ prārthanā hitakāriṇī ||78|| kartavyā sarvathā mātrā tvayā cāpi mayāpi ca | brūhi dhṛtvā jalaṃ haste yātu sūryaḥ samudgamam ||79|| brūhi putri devavaidyau kurutaṃ nirujaṃ patim | patyuḥ rogasya nāśo’tra patināśaḥ prakalpyatām ||1.391.80|| kāyākalpaḥ svāminaste nidhanaṃ parigaṇyate | yuvā divyasvarūpo vai devavat te patirbhavet ||81 || kṛtvādityodayaṃ rugṇaṃ patiṃ kāntaṃ prajīvaya | iti prasāditā patnī sūryodayamakārayat ||82|| patiṃ sūryasya putrābhyāṃ navaṃ devamakārayat | kṛtvādityodayaṃ caivaṃ svabhartāramajīvayat ||83 || kauśikaḥ sabalovīryaśaktibhṛto’bhavat kṣaṇāt | aśvinīsukumārābhyāṃ rasāyanena saṃskṛtaḥ ||84|| apūjayata sarvadevān visasarja tataḥ satī | siṣeve kāntikāntaṃ taṃ lebhe brahmasukhaṃ mahat ||85|| māṇḍavyo yamarājaṃ ca prāha me karmaṇaḥ phalam | yamaḥ prāha tvayā bālye pañcavarṣeṇa khelane ||86|| tṛṇaśukī praviddhābhūt tīkṣṇaśūlena mohataḥ | tatphalaṃ śūlavidhyatvaṃ labdhaṃ tvayātra mā śucaḥ ||87|| māṇḍavyastu tadā dharmaṃ prāha nyāyamayaṃ vacaḥ | pañcavarṣasya bālasya kāmacārasya sarvathā ||88|| dūṣaṇaṃ pātakaṃ daṇḍaḥ sarvaṃ nāstyeva bodha me | pitrostatpātakaṃ paścādarthaṃ daśasamāvadhim ||89|| daśavarṣāttaraṃ śikṣā pātakaṃ cobhayaṃ bhavet | mama tatpātakaṃ nāsti kasmācchūle’bhiropitaḥ ||1.391.90|| tasmāt tvaṃ tatphalaṃ bhuṃkṣva bhava dharmaścaturyuge | tretādharmeṇa viddhastvaṃ dvāpareṇāpi viddhakaḥ ||91 || viddhaśca kalinā duḥkhamavāpsyasi gataḥ kṣitau | adharmaśūlaviddhasya śudratā te’stvaharniśam ||92|| iti śapto dharmarājaḥ śūlāttamavaropayat | kṣamāṃ yayāce śūlasya vṛṇaṃ dasreṇa nīrujam ||93 || sandhāya pūrayitvā ca yathāpūrvamakārayat | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi camatkāraparāyaṇam ||94|| pātivratyaṃ vrataṃ yatra pāpaṃ puṇyaṃ prajāyate | adharmo dharmatāṃ yāti yogaiśvaryādivat priye ||95|| pātivratyaṃ mahaddharmaḥ pāvanaḥ sarvadehinām | dvijenānena vai pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ dīnasya duḥkhakṛt ||96|| ghātaṃ tenaiva ghātena kuṣṭhījāto’tra janmani | purā tena kṛtaṃ dānaṃ gaurīkanyātrayasya vai ||97|| tena puṇyena viprasya gehe patnī pativratā | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktiḥ sukhaṃ bhavet ||98|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye kuṣṭhinaḥ kauśikaviprasya gaṇikātṛṣṇasya gaṇikāyojanaṃ tatpativratayā suśīlayā kāritaṃ, māṇḍavyasya śūlasthasya pādaghaṭṭanena kauśikasya ravyudayapūrvaṃ nidhanamiti śāpe suśīlayā sūryasyānudayanaṃ kṛtam, tato devānāṃ prārthanayā suśīlayā śāpādinivṛttiḥ kṛtā, dharmasya tu pratidaṃḍarūpaṃ yugeṣu tattadyugadharmaviddhatvamiti ca nirūpaṇanāmaikanavatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 391 ||
<1.392> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ākarṇaya mahāpadme lakṣmi pāpavināśinīm | kathāṃ śāntikarīṃ ramyāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ mokṣakāriṇīm || 1 || pūrve yuge mahāvīryaḥ śatrujinnāmabhūpatiḥ | babhūva yajñakṛt yatra tuṣṭā devāḥ savāsavāḥ || 2 || tasya putro mahāvīryo babhūva devavīryavān | ṛtadhvaja itikhyāto vyomacārī sa yogirāṭ || 3 || siddhibhiḥ sevitaḥ śaśvadvijñānaguṇasāgaraḥ | yasya nāviditaṃ kiñcit pāṇḍityaṃ sarvato’dhikam || 4 || tasya kīrtiṃ parāṃ śrutvā caturdaśastarādhipāḥ | ṛṣayo munayo nāgā āyānti darśanāya vai || 5 || kasyacittvatha kālasya nāgalokānmahītalam | kumārāvāgatau nāgau putrāvaśvatarasya tu || 6 || brahmarūpapraticchannau taruṇau priyadarśanau | darśanaṃ satkṛtiṃ kṛtvā yayatuścāgatau punaḥ || 7 || evaṃ nityaṃ bahuprītyāyayaturyayatuḥ sadā | sa ca tābhyāṃ nṛpasutaḥ paramānandamāptavān || 8 || vinā tābhyāṃ na bubhuje na sasnau na papau madhu | na rarāma na jagrāha kiñcittābhyāṃ vinā sutaḥ || 9 || api tau bahulaṃ kālaṃ kumārāgre hi ninyatuḥ | ekadā tatra pātāle pitā tau nāgabālakau || 1.392.1 0|| papraccha martyaloke nau mitratā kena vartate | yatra yuvāṃ bahukālaṃ yāpayathaḥ suputrakau || 11 || tāvūcatuḥ śatrujitaḥ putro nāmnā ṛtadhvajaḥ | rūpavānārjavopeto vidvānmaitro guṇākaraḥ || 1 2|| prabhorbhaktaścātitheyastena copahṛtaṃ manaḥ | tadviyogena naustāta na sukhaṃ jāyate’tra vai || 1 3|| pitā prāha sa dhanyo’sti yasyaivaṃ guṇakīrtanam | parokṣasyāpi guṇibhiḥ kriyate dhanyajīvanam || 14|| yasya mitraguṇān mitrāṇyamitrāṇi parākramam | kathayanti sabhādau vai putravām̐stena vai pitā ||15|| tasya niṣpāditaṃ putrau kiñcittoṣāya cetasaḥ | madgṛhe yatsuvarṇādi ratnaṃ vāhanamāsanam || 16|| yattvanyat prītaye tasya taddeyamaviśaṃkayā | upakārakṛto devāstasyecchanti sadonnatim || 17|| āhatuśca sutau tāta yāni ratnāni tadgṛhe | vāhanāsanayānāni bhūṣaṇānyambarāṇi ca || 18|| tāni santi na trailokye jñānaṃ nānyatra tatsamam | ekaṃ tasyāsti kartavyaṃ tattvasādhyaṃ prabhuṃ vinā || 1 9|| pitā prāha kimasādhyaṃ durlabhaṃ vyavasāyinaḥ | udyatānāṃ na tvagamyaṃ nāprāpyaṃ divi ceha vā ||1.392.20 || tasmāt kathayata putrāvavagacchāmyasādhyakam | prāhatuḥ pitaraṃ putrau kadācid gālavo dvijaḥ ||21 || samāyayau śatrujitaṃ gṛhītvā turagottamam | prāhāśrame mama kaścid daityaḥ khādati prāṇinaḥ ||22|| tathā karoti vighnāni dhyāne maune ca me’pi saḥ | bhasmīkaromi kopena yadi tarhi tapaḥkṣayaḥ ||23 || rājñā tasmāddhi daityānāṃ nāśaḥ kāryo hi dharmataḥ | ekadā sa mayā rājan daityaṃ nirīkṣya duḥkhataḥ ||24|| niḥśvāsaḥ prahitastāvadvyomnaścāyaṃ turaṃgamaḥ | sūryeṇa preṣitaścāyāt trailokyāhatasañcaraḥ ||25 || parvateṣu samudreṣu pātāleṣvanaleṣu ca | nityaṃ bhūvalayaṃ sarvamaśrānto’yaṃ cariṣyati ||26 || ataḥ kuvalayo nāmnā khyātiṃ loke gamiṣyati | daityaṃ cainaṃ samāruhya ṛtadhvajo haniṣyati ||27|| putramājñāpaya rājan yathā dharmo na lupyate | sa tasya vacanād rājā taṃ vai putramṛtadhvajam ||28 || tamaśvaratnamāropya kṛtakautukamaṃgalam | apreṣayat muninā saha munyāśramaṃ yayau ||29|| ṛtadhvajaśca vighnāni nāśayāmāsa cāśrame | daityaḥ sa śaukaraṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvā dharṣayitumṛṣim ||1.392.3 0 || āgatasta samālakṣya śīghramāruhya taṃ hayam | anvadhāvad varāhaṃ taṃ ṛtadhvajaḥ śarāsanī ||3 1 || bāṇāhato mṛgo dhāvan praviveśa mahāṭavīm | trastaḥ papāta vivare timiraughasamākule ||32|| tamanu rājaputro’pi hantuṃ papāta vājiyuk | varāho’dṛśyatāṃ prāpto rājaputrastu śobhitam ||33 || pātāle samapaśyadvai sauvarṇasaudhasaṃkulam | saprākāraṃ puraṃ riktamapaśyattad viveśa saḥ ||34|| tatra yoṣidvarā dṛṣṭā sā taṃ ninye gṛhāntaram | tasmai bhavanabhūmau vai paryaṃke sarvakāṃcane ||35|| darśayāmāsa yuvatīṃ kanyāṃ pīnapayodharām | bimbādharauṣṭhīṃ tanvaṃgīṃ nīlotpalavilocanām ||36 || raktatuṃganakhīṃ mṛdvīṃ svarṇavarṇāṃ śubhālakām | sā bālāpi rājasutaṃ dṛṣṭvā śobhānvitaṃ tadā ||37|| mumoha kṣobhamāptā sā samaicchannṛpatiṃ patim | ṛtadhvajena saṃpṛṣṭā vṛttāntaṃ naijamāha sā ||38|| viśvāvasuriti khyāto divi gandharvarājakaḥ | tasyāhamātmajā rājan nāmnā khyātā madālasā ||39|| pativratā patiprāṇā patyarthaṃ sarvadā sthitā | pratīkṣe matpatiṃ prāṇasamaṃ yogyaṃ hi mānavam ||1.392.40 || ahamudyānagā cāsaṃ puṣpārthaṃ tāvadeva mām | pātālaketurdanujo’pahṛtya nītavāniha ||41 || āgāminyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ matpāṇigrahaṇāya saḥ | samudyato’sti taṃ rājan vārāharūpamāśritam ||42|| kenāpi viddhaṃ bāṇaiśca munīnāṃ trāṇakāraṇāt | pracchannaṃ vartamānaṃ taṃ hatvā māṃ naya bhūpate ||43 || kastvaṃ ko’si vada śīghraṃ jñāto’pi tu viśeṣataḥ | svīyavṛttaprakāśena premapātraṃ bhaviṣyasi ||44|| devo daityo nu gandharvaḥ pannagaḥ kinnaro’pi vā | tat tvamākhyāhi yāvadvai yathā me’vitathaṃ manaḥ ||45|| tataḥ prasannaḥ kuvalayāśvaḥ ṛtadhvajo jagau | rājñaḥ śatrujitaḥ putro gālavāśramamāgataḥ ||46 || śaukararūpadaityasya mannārācahatasya ca | pṛṣṭhaṃ pradhāvya garte’tra pātāle patito’smyaham || 47|| ṛtadhvajo’smi nāmnāhaṃ kuvalayāśva ityapi | ityetat kathitaṃ vṛttaṃ na devo’haṃ na dānavaḥ ||48|| na pannago na gandharvaḥ kinnaro na śucismite | manuṣyo’smi tava rakṣāṃ kariṣye daityataḥ priye ||49|| ityāśrutya tu kanyā sā prahṛṣṭā pulakāñcitā | yadarthaṃ nirmitā cāhaṃ so’yaṃ prāpto mumoda sā ||1.392.50 || prāha cainaṃ hṛdayaṃ me tvayi sthairyaṃ prapaśyati | jātismarāpyahaṃ rājam̐stavaivāsmi smarāmi ca ||51 || candramevopaiti kāntiḥ samupaiti raviṃ prabhā | bhūtirdhanyaṃ dhṛtirdhīraṃ kṣāntirabhyeti sajjanam ||52|| gṛhāṇa māṃ priyāṃ kānta śīghraṃ nāśaya rākṣasam | ṛtadhvajastadā prāha paravānahamasmi vai ||53 || kiṃ karomi vinājñāṃ tu pitrornāsmi tathākriyaḥ | satī madālasā prāha sādhayāmi piturvacaḥ ||54|| ityuktvā sā jalaṃ nītvā kare sasmāra tumburum | tumbururdrāk samāyāto natvā prāha satīṃ kutaḥ ||55|| smṛto’haṃ vad deveśi sādhayāmi kṣaṇena tat | madālasā kulaguruṃ tumburumavadad guro ||56 || tūrṇaṃ yāhi śatrujitaṃ nivedaya madālasām | ṛtadhvajaṃ patiṃ kartuṃ samicchatyanumodaya ||57|| tumbarurvyomamārgeṇa tvantardhānākhyavidyayā | śatrujitaṃ prati gatvā vinivedya hyudantakam ||58|| ājñāṃ tasya samāgṛhya pragṛhītasamitkuśaḥ | madālasāyāḥ samprītyā prāptastatra punaḥ kṣaṇāt ||5 9 || prajvālya pāvakaṃ hutvā mantravit kṛtamaṃgalām | kanyāṃ vivāhavidhinā dadau ṛtudhvajāya saḥ ||1.392.6 0|| jagāma tapase tumbururmuniḥ svāśramaṃ punaḥ | kanyāha tāṃ striyaṃ śāntāṃ kṛtārthāsmi varānane ||6 1 || ājñāpaya ca māṃ mātargantuṃ patyurgṛhaṃ prati | kuṇḍalā sā tadovāca kṛtārthā syāḥ pativrate ||62|| tīrthāmbudhūtapāpāpi bhavitrī nedṛśī yathā | saṃyuktānena saṃpūtā jātā saṃsāratāriṇī ||63 || kathayāmyatha nau kiñcat snehabhārapraṇoditā | bhartavyā rakṣitavyā ca bhāryā hi patinā sadā ||64|| dharmārthakāmasaṃsiddhyai bhāryā bhartṛsahāyinī | yatra bhāryā ca bhartā ca mithomitho’nuvartinau ||65|| tatra dharmārthakāmānāṃ mokṣasyāpyasti saṃgatiḥ | bhāryā tathaiva bhartāramṛte dharmādisādhane ||66 || mokṣārthe vā divi satye vairāje vā bhuvastale | na samarthā yato dharmacatuṣṭayamubhāśritam ||67|| devatāpitṛbhṛtyānāmatithīnāṃ ca pūjanam | naikena śakyate kartuṃ dāmpatyaṃ tatra kāraṇam ||68|| prāpto’pi cārtho manujairānīto’pi nijaṃ gṛham | kṣayameti vinā bhāryā kubhāryāsaṃśraye’pi vā ||69|| etanmayoktaṃ yuvayordāmpatyaṃ śāśvataṃ tathā | vardhatāmanayā sārdhaṃ dhanaputrasukhāyuṣā ||1.392.70 || tvaṃ tu kanye madālase tyaktvā patyurmadālasā | bhavānena ca kāntena sārdhaṃ svargād garīyasī ||71 || ityuktvā virarāmaiva ṛtadhvajo madālasā | kuṇḍalāṃ tāṃ pariṣvajya samāruhya turaṃgamam ||72|| utpapātāmbaramārge daityā dṛṣṭvā vicukruśuḥ | kanyāratnaṃ yadānītaṃ hriyate hriyate divam ||73 || tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti jalpanto vavṛṣuḥ śarajālakam | ṛtadhvajo’pi ciccheda śarajālaṃ tu līlayā ||74|| tato’straṃ tvāṣṭramādāya cikṣepa prati dānavān | tena te dānavāḥ sarve sphuṭadasthicayāḥ kṛtāḥ ||75|| strīratnena saha tūrṇaṃ samāgacchat svakaṃ puram | praṇipatya ca tatsarvaṃ sa svapitre nyavedayat ||76|| pitā śrutvāha taṃ premṇā pariṣvajya suputrakam | satputreṇa tvayā putra tārito’haṃ mahātmanā ||77|| bhayebhyo munayastrātāḥ kanyāpi rakṣitāhṛtā | yadupāttaṃ yaśaḥ pitrā dhanaṃ vīryamathāparam ||78|| tadvīryādadhikaṃ kuryād vardhayed yastu śaktimān | navaṃ niṣpādayatyenaṃ pravadanti narottamam ||79|| taddhanyo’smīdṛśaṃ putraṃ prāpyāha puṇyaśālinām | suślāghyo’smyadya saṃjātastvayā saddharmaśālinā ||1.392.80|| yaḥ svaparākramairhīnaḥ prajñādānavṛṣādibhiḥ | dhigjanma tasya yaḥ pitrā loke vijñāyate janaḥ ||81 || ātmanā khyātimān śreṣṭho madhyaḥ pitṛpitāmahaiḥ | mātṛpakṣeṇa mātrā ca khyātimeti narādhamaḥ ||82|| tatputra dhanavīryaistvaṃ vivardhasva sukhena tu | gandharvatanayā ceyaṃ mā tvayā vai viyujyatām ||83|| iti pitrā ca mātrā ca priyamuktaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | gālavenarṣiṇā cāpi hyāśīrvādāḥ samarpitāḥ ||84|| putraśca bhāryayā sārdhaṃ rājyadharmān gṛhāśramam | pālayan vardhayan snehaṃ reme sādhvyā samaṃ sukhī ||85|| śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ pādau praṇipatya madālasā | pativratā satī reme jātismarā svarakṣiṇā ||86|| evaṃ kāle bahutithe gate rājā punaḥ sutam | prāha gacchāśu viprāṇāṃ trāṇāya cara medinīm ||87|| aśvamenaṃ samāruhya bhramaṇaṃ kuru maṇḍale | durvṛttebhyo dānavebhyo munīnāṃ ca satāmapi ||88|| na syād bādhā yathā putra rakṣaṇaṃ tvaṃ tathā kuru | sa tu pitruktarītyaiva cacāra medinīṃ muhuḥ ||89|| yamunāyāstaṭe daityaṃ tālaketuṃ dadarśa saḥ | vārāharūpadaityasyānujaṃ munisvarūpiṇam ||1.392.90|| sa daityaḥ prāha taṃ tatra pūrvavairamanusmaran | rājaputra muniścāsmi yakṣye yajñena tatra ca ||9 1 || hiraṇyaṃ dehi me kaṇṭhabhūṣaṇaṃ tava yadvaram | rakṣa mamāśramaṃ cemaṃ yāvadantarjale’pyaham ||92|| varuṇaṃ vaidikairmantrairabhiṣṭūyaimi cāśramam | ityuktavate munaye saḥ prādāt kaṇṭhabhūṣaṇam ||93 || prāha sthāsyāmyatra tāvad yāvadāgamanaṃ tava | ityuktaḥ saḥ kapaṭarṣirdaityo mamajja vāriṇi ||94|| madālasāyāḥ pratyakṣamudgataścoktavān rudan | vīraḥ kuvalayāśvaḥ sa mamāśramasamīpataḥ ||95|| kenāpi duṣṭadaityena bhinnaḥ śūlena vakṣasi | mṛto dadau tu me kaṇṭhabhūṣaṇaṃ bhasmitaḥ sa ca ||96 || aśvaṃ jahāra daityaḥ saḥ sarvaṃ mayāvalokitam | gṛhāṇa devi te bhūṣāṃ kriyatāṃ cottarakriyām ||97|| ityuktvotsṛjya tadbhūmau sa jagāma yathāgatam | madālasā tathānye ca śrutvā cakrurvilāpanam ||98|| nirgamya ca bahiḥsnātā daduḥ putrāya vāryapi | pativratā tu sañcintya vinā patimamaṃgalām ||99|| kṛtvā samādhiṃ hṛdye vahnimutpādya cāntaram | śarīraṃ vilayīkṛtya svargaṃ yātā hi sundarī || 1.392.100 || vicinvānā patiṃ naijaṃ nāvāpa tatra sā tataḥ | yamarājaṃ prati gatvā papraccha kvāsti me patiḥ || 101 || dharmarājastadā prāha jīvito’sti yamītaṭe | tava saṃjīvanārthaṃ ca pātāle tvatpatipriyaḥ || 1 02|| suhṛnnāgastapaścaryāṃ karoti śaṃkaropari | tāvadadṛśyarūpā tvaṃ mama dharmālaye vasa || 103 || iti sā coṣitā dharmabhavane cātra bhūtale | tālaketuḥ sa daityastu nirgatya yamunājalāt || 1 04|| rājaputraṃ samuvāca kṛtārtho’haṃ tvayā kṛtaḥ | gaccha gṛhamidānīṃ tvamiti śrutvā sa taṃ ṛṣim || 1 05|| praṇipatya samāruhya tvaśvaṃ prāyāt puraṃ svakam | janān dadarśodvignān prāk prahṛṣṭāsyām̐stataḥ punaḥ || 1 06|| aho vighnaṃ gataṃ tvasya vidyate jīvavānayam | mṛtyuvārtā mṛṣā jātā ciraṃ jīva kumāraka || 1 07|| iti śrutvā pauravācaḥ praviveśa piturgṛham | mumudire pitā mātā bāndhavāḥ suhṛdo janāḥ || 1 08|| madālasāmanādṛṣṭvā papraccha pitaraṃ sutaḥ | jñātvā vṛttāntamaghaṭaṃ śuśoca kṣaṇameva saḥ ||1 09|| punaḥ sa cintayāmāsa parisaṃstabhya mānasam | mṛteti sā mannimittaṃ tyajāmi yadi jīvitam || 1.392.11 0|| kiṃ mayopakṛtaṃ patnyā patinā pāralaukikam | ato’tra manye kartavyastyāgo bhogasya yoṣitaḥ || 111 || tasyā muktiryathā syādvai tatkartavyaṃ japādikam | anyā bhāryā na kartavyā brahmacaryadhṛtā mayā || 1 12|| yadi madālasā nātra bhāryā me’sti tato dhruvam | anyāyāśca patirnāsti patnīvrataḥ ṛtadhvaja || 11 3|| tāmṛte mṛgaśāvākṣīṃ gandharvatanayāmaham | na bhokṣye yoṣitaṃ kāciditi satyaṃ vadāmyaham || 1 14|| saddharmacāriṇīṃ patnīṃ tāṃ muktvāhaṃ pativratām | kāṃcinnāṃgīkariṣyāmītyetat satyaṃ vadāmyaham || 1 15|| iti śrutvā putrayośca vacanaṃ nāgarāṭ svayam | tapaścaryāṃ parāṃ kṛtvā varaṃ prāpya ca śaṃkarāt || 1 16|| ṛtadhvajāya dātavyā punā rājñī madālasā | yatra sṛṣṭau tu sā tvāste tasmādādāya sarvathā ||1 17|| iti pratijñāṃ kṛtavān putrāvāpṛcchya vai tataḥ | tīrthaṃ himavato gatvā tapastepe sudāruṇam || 1 18|| aśvataraḥ sa nāgendrastuṣṭāva tapasā haram | prātarniśāyāṃ madhyāhne sandhyayoścāpi tatparaḥ || 11 9|| tasya kālena mahatā prāheśo gṛhyatāṃ varaḥ | praṇamyāśvataraḥ prāha varamenaṃ prayaccha me || 1.392.1 20|| mṛtā kuvalayāśvasya patnī sādhvī madālasā | tenaiva vayasā sadyo duhitṛtvaṃ prayātu me || 121 || jātismarā yathāpūrvaṃ tadvatkāntisamanvitā | yoginī yogamātā ca madgehe jāyatāṃ satī ||122|| haraḥ prāha tathāstvetat sarvaṃ te vai bhaviṣyati | matprasādādasandigdhaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuru tadicchayā || 123|| bhakṣayethāḥ prasādaṃ ca tataste madhyamāt phaṇāt | samutpatsyati kalyāṇī patidharmā madālasā ||1 24|| sā tu sādhvī dharmarājabhavane’dya virājate | pratīkṣate punarjanma jātismaraṃ patiṃ punaḥ || 1 25|| sā ca te bhāvinī putrī ṛtadhvajasya kāminī | ityuktvā śaṃkarastatra tirodadhe’tha sarparāṭ || 126 || rasātale gṛhaṃ gatvā cakāra śrāddhamarpitam | piṇḍaṃ ca madhyamaṃ tadvad yathāvadupabhuktavān || 127|| tāvattāṃ dharmarājo’pi prāha gaccha rasātalam | tatrāśvataranāgeśaḥ smaratyeva suputrikām ||1 28|| bhava divyā manojanyā jātamātrā suyauvanā | varārohā sukanyā cāpnuhi sveṣṭamṛtadhvajam || 129|| ityuktā śrāddhataḥ paścāt sāgatā ca janiṃ gatā | śuśubhe dvyaṣṭavarṣāvadyathāpūrvā hi sundarī || 1.392.130|| pratīkṣate tu sā kāntaṃ tryavasthāsu madālasā | tadā sa nāgarāḍaśvataraḥ prāha svaputrakau || 131 || sa rājaputro yuvayorupakārī mamāntikam | kasmānnānīyate vatsau dṛṣṭavyo’sti mamāpi saḥ || 1 32|| evamuktau sutau gatvā kṛtvā kiñcitkathāntaram | abrūtāṃ praṇayopetaṃ svagehagamanaṃ prati || 133|| ṛtadhvajaḥ svakaṃ matvā samutthāya varāsanāt | pitaraṃ pādayornatvā yayau nāgapuraṃ saha || 134|| tābhyāṃ nāgakumārābhyāṃ nagarī darśitā śubhā | kumāraistaruṇairvṛddhairuragairdivyavarṣmabhiḥ || 1 35|| mohakṛnnāgakanyābhiḥ krīḍantībhiḥ suśobhitā | tataḥ ṛtadhvajastābhyāṃ praviveśa niveśanam || 1 36|| dadarśa mitrapitaraṃ maṇikuṇḍaladhāriṇam | divyamālāmbarabhūṣaṃ surūpaṃ divyadevavat || 1 37|| svacchamuktāphalalatāhārihāropaśobhitam | keyūriṇaṃ mahāśreṣṭhāsane sarvasukāñcane || 1 38|| maṇividrumavaiḍūryajālāntaritarūpake | samāsīnaṃ suputrābhyāṃ ṛtadhvajāya darśitam || 139|| rājaputro nanāmainaṃ mitrayoḥ pitaraṃ muhuḥ | rājaputraṃ balādgāḍha nāgendraḥ pariṣasvaje || 1.392.140|| mūrdhni cainamupāghrāya ciraṃ jīvetyuvāca saḥ | nihatāmitravargaśca pitroḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ kuru || 141 || vatsa dhanyasya kathyante matputrābhyāṃ tu te guṇāḥ | jīvitaṃ guṇinaḥ ślāghyaṃ jīvanneva mṛto’guṇaḥ || 142|| devatāḥ pitaro viprā mitrārthibāndhavāhitāḥ | svepare’nye tathecchanti jīvitaṃ guṇinaściram || 143 || parivādanivṛttānāṃ durgateṣu dayāvatām | guṇināṃ saphalaṃ janma tvādṛśānāṃ nṛpātmaja || 144|| evamuktvā snāpayitvā śṛṃgārayitvā bhāvataḥ | madhupānādisaṃbhogān dāpayitvādanaṃ tathā || 145|| tarpayitvānnapeyādyairviśrāntiśayanaṃ dadau | sevārthaṃ nāgakanyāśca preṣayāmāsa nāgarāṭ || 146 || pariśrānto’tha nṛpajaḥ suṣvāpa sukhanidrayā | sevayāmāsuratyarthaṃ kanyāḥ saṃvāhanādibhiḥ || 147|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye śatrujitputrasya ṛtadhvajasya aśvataranāgaputrābhyāṃ mitratā, daivivājiprāptiḥ, gālavāśrame vighnakartāraṃ daityaṃ hantuṃ pātāle praveśaḥ, sa tatra nagare madālasāmapaśyat, pātālaketuṃ daityaṃ jaghāna, madālasāmudvahat, tumburuṃ kuṇḍalāṃ cāpṛcchya svagṛhāgamanam, yamunātaṭe tālaketuṃ kapaṭinaṃ jaghāna, madālasāmaraṇam, kumāratapaścaryā, madālasāyā aśvataragṛhe’vataraṇam, ṛtadhvajamāhūya punarmadālasādānamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvānavatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||3 92||
<1.393> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha prātarnṛpaputraḥ ṛtadhvajaḥ sumaṃgalaiḥ | vādyaiśca gītibhiścāpi pātālākhyānakaistathā || 1 || nāgakanyābhiratyarthaṃ miṣṭasvaraiḥ prabodhitaḥ | snāpito’mbaritaḥ śṛṃgārito’rcito vibhūṣitaḥ || 2 || bhojitaḥ pāyitaścāpi susparśaiḥ raṃjito muhuḥ | vijñāpitaśca bahudhā ratnādigrahaṇāya saḥ || 3 || rajataṃ vā suvarṇaṃ vā vastraṃ vāhanamāsanam | yadvābhimatamatyarthaṃ grahaṇārthaṃ niveditaḥ || 4 || ṛtadhvajastadā prāhāśvataraṃ nāgayoginam | tava prasādād bhagavan ratnādyasti gṛhe mama || 5 || tāte varṣasahasrāṇi śāsatīmāṃ vasundharām | na nyūnaṃ vidyate kiñcitsvargamanyad gṛhe’sti me || 6 || tatrāpi sāttvatānāṃ tu tṛṇavanmāyikaṃ khalu | tatra lubdhā janā nūnaṃ dhātṛmāyāsuvaṃcitāḥ || 7 || tavānayā sumadhurayā vāṇyā satkṛtiśīlayā | kṛtakṛtyo’smi bhāvena saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ tu me || 8 || pitrā vai jīvanaṃ sārthaṃ mātrā ca jīvanaṃ sukham | ārogyeṇa ca rājyena vṛddhānāṃ sevayā tathā || 9 || tvādṛśānāṃ kṛpābhiśca jīvanaṃ sārthakaṃ mama | aśvatarastadā prāha gārhasthyaṃ bhāryayā sukham ||1.393.1 0|| tat tavāsti na vā saumya vada kiṃ brahmavānasi | iti pṛṣṭaḥ samuvāca bhāryā mama pativratā || 11 || sutā gandharvarājasya nāmnā khyātā madālasā | kenāpi kṛtavaireṇa vipralabdhātyajat tanum || 1 2|| tata ārabhya loke me pratijñāṃ kṛtavānaham | nānyā bhāryā bhavitrī me varjayitvā madālasām || 13 || ityārabhya sadā cāsmi brahmacaryavratānvitaḥ | brahmacaryeṇa vai lokā vairājāḥ santi nirmitāḥ || 14|| muktiloko brahmacaryaparasyāsti vinirmitaḥ | mānuṣasya janerlābhaḥ saṃhitāyāṃ prapaṭhyate || 15|| sa lābho’sti madarthaṃ vāpyekapatnīvratasya ca | aśvatarastadā prāha śṛṇu rājakumāraka || 16 || bhāgyena vardhase nityaṃ caikapatnīvratena vai | pātivratyena te patnī saubhāgyena pravardhate || 17|| yā sā madālasā rājñī śrutvā patyurvināśanam | samādhinā layaṃ prāptā gatā svaryāmyakaṃ puram || 18|| patimanveṣituṃ naijaṃ dharmarājaśca tāṃ jagau | patiste vartate sādhvi jīvito yamunātaṭe || 1 9|| yogāyāśvatarastasya yatate tiṣṭha vai kṣaṇam | ityuktā soṣitā tatra mayā taptvā harātkhalu ||1.393.20 || varadānaṃ paraṃ prāpya putrīrūpā tava priyā | āsāditā divyarūpā jātamātrā sukāminī |||21 || tādṛśī tava yogyā ca pūrvaṃ yādṛśyabhūddhi sā | tvadarthaṃ mānasī kanyā madgehe vartate satī ||22|| tubhyaṃ dānāya saumyātra mayāsti niścitaṃ yataḥ | tasmāt paśyeha vatsa tvaṃ satīṃ ced draṣṭumicchasi ||23|| anugrāhyo bhavān gehaṃ bālo’pyabhyāgato guruḥ | ityuktvā tvānayāmāsa tasya putrīṃ madālasām ||24|| prāha seyaṃ na vā vatsa bhāryā te yā madālasā | sa dṛṣṭvā tāṃ sammukhaṃ drāk hṛṣṭaromā babhūva ha ||25|| ruroda pūrvāṃ saṃsmṛtya premapūritamānasaḥ | aśvatarastadā kāmaphalaṃ baddhvā kare’sya vai ||26 || agniṃ prajvālya vidhivat kanyāratnaṃ dadau punaḥ | prāpya bhāryāṃ satīṃ so’pi yautakaṃ ca dhanaṃ bahu ||27|| nāgakanyāstathānyāśca dāsīrdāsām̐śca sevakān | maṇīn hiraṇyabhūṣām̐śca madālasāṃ navīkṛtām ||28|| pratilabhya praṇamyātha nāgeśaṃ śvaśuraṃ muhuḥ | śālakau dvau samāśliṣya śvaśrū natvā tathāparān ||29||| nirgataḥ svāyayau naijaṃ puraṃ yānena vāyunā | āgamya svapuraṃ pitrornatvā sarvamaśeṣataḥ ||1.393.3 0 || kathayāmāsa tanvaṃgī punaḥ prāptā yathā tathā | nanāma sā ca caraṇau śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ satī ||3 1 || anyāṃśca pūjayāmāsa yathānyāyaṃ yathāvayaḥ | tato mahotsavo jātaḥ paurāṇāṃ sarvathā priyaḥ ||32||| ṛtadhvajaśca suciraṃ tayā reme sumadhyayā | atha kālena mahatā śatrujinmaraṇaṃ gataḥ |||33 || ṛtadhvajo’bhavadrājā patnīvrataḥ sudhārmikaḥ | madālasābhavad rājñī rājamātā pativratā ||3 4|| śatasāhasradāsīṣu satīṣvapi madālasā | lakṣmīvat svapatiṃ nityaṃ siṣeve’ṅgakriyādiṣu ||35|| patiṃ matvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpaṃ hariṃ prabhum | sampanmokṣakaraṃ nityasambaddhaṃ sevate sma sā || 36|| bhojayitvā sadā bhuṃkte vastu samarpya sevate | yuṃkte sā ca svake kārye patiprāsādikaṃ sadā ||37|| prātardhyānaṃ hareḥ pūjāṃ dānaṃ cātmavimarśanam | atitherbhojanaṃ datvā svātmārthaṃ yukta eva sā |||38|| brahmārpaṇaṃ brahmasevāṃ brahmadhyānaṃ tu sāttvatī | mahābhāgavatī sādhvī niṣpādya vartate pare || 39|| divāniśaṃ harerlīlākīrtanaṃ sā karoti vai | anyān śrāvayati hareścamatkārān muhurmuhuḥ ||1.393.40|| evaṃ vai vartamānāyāḥ saṃjajñe prathamaḥ sutaḥ | tasya cakre pitā nāma vikrānta iti dhīmataḥ ||41 || tutuṣustena vai sarve jahāsa ca madālasā | yasyā brahmasvarūpāyāṃ harṣaśokau samau yataḥ ||42|| putraṃ tu vikramaṃ sādhvī bālamuttānaśāyinam | rudantamabhiśāntyarthamullāpanamiṣeṇa sā ||43|| smṛtvā hariṃ tathātmānaṃ nityaśuddhaṃ nirañjanam | putraṃ muktaṃ dehadharmahīnaṃ prāha madālasā ||44|| śuddhaḥ svayaṃ brahmasurūpavānasi prakalpitaṃ nāma ca te’dya kṛtrimam | apūrvadehādikamāptavānasi hyaśokano rodiṣi kasya śokavān ||45|| hānau sadā roditi dehadharmavān sā na tvayi brahmanirañjane’sti vai | sadāsi pūrṇo nijatṛptisaṃbhṛtaḥ sadā prataptasya kathe nu rodanam ||46|| āgantukā ye tu guṇāḥ sukhādayo niyojayantyeva tadiṣṭavedane | tataḥ pravṛttau ca phale śubhāśubhe asāracakre hi muhuḥ kṣipanti te ||47|| śāntāśca ghorāśca tathā pramūḍhā dehā viśeṣāḥ parivarttayanti | tadvegavegī guṇavegahīno mamatvabhāk tāpavibharjitaḥ syāt ||48|| nānena dehena tu kiṃcidasti prāptavyamarthaṃ na ca śāśvataṃ vā | yenāsti labhyaṃ sa tu nityapūrṇaḥ kathaṃ prapūrṇasya nu rodanaṃ te ||49|| labdhaṃ gataṃ sarvamanityametad dṛṣṭaṃ mayā janmani cātra tatra | gatisvabhāvaṃ puru naśvaraṃ ca śokāspadaṃ tvaṃ nahi tādṛśo’si ||1.393.50|| āste jalaṃ jāyate vardhate ca santiṣṭhati kṣīyate nāśameti | ete tu dharmā hi bhūteṣu santi na te kathaṃ kasya hānerhi śokaḥ ||51 || na te’sti vṛddhirna ca te’sti hānistādṛksvabhāve’tra na kaṃcuke tvam | śokaṃ vrajethāḥ kuru cātmavittiṃ naisargikānandamayīṃ praśastim ||52|| tāteti kiñcit tanayeti kañcidambeti kāṃcid dayiteti kāṃcit | mameti kiṃcinna mameti kiṃcid bhūtātmakaṃ mā tvayi mānayethāḥ ||53 || bhogaḥ sadā miśrita eva vartate miṣṭastathāmiṣṭa iti pratītitaḥ | vijñasya miṣṭe’pi na miṣṭatāsti vai mūḍhasya duḥkhe’pi na duḥkhatāsti ca ||54|| ahaṃmametyasti kṛtaṃ navaṃ navaṃ gataṃ gataṃ vakti na te’styahaṃmamaḥ | vṛthā mataṃ duḥkhakaraṃ hi bālyataḥ śīrṇe vikāre’pi na tad viyāsyati ||55|| cakṣuśca karṇaśca sunāsikā ca mukhaṃ radāstvak śravaṇaṃ manaśca | jihvā karau pat malamūtramārgau nābhiśca nāmāni na te hi santi ||56|| kṣetrāṇi yadvat khalu mṛttikāyāḥ sarāṃsi yadvat khalu sajalādyāḥ | svargāṇi yadvat khalu tejaādyāḥ prāṇāśca vātā na hi te tvadīyāḥ ||57|| yathātra yāne bahumārgagāmini sacetanastvaṃ surathī pragacchasi | tvadātmake divyacidambarānasi tathaiva yantāsti tamacyutaṃ smara ||58|| idaṃ vapurgatvarameva te ca me pituśca tadvad gatameva tatpituḥ | yathaivaṃ bhūtaṃ sadṛśaṃ tu bhāvinastatolabhasvāṅga vapustu śāśvatam ||59|| śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa rādhikāpate ramāpate mādhava pārvatīpate | lakṣmīpate bhaktapate prabhāpate’ raṭāṃga yacchāśvatamāpyase tanum ||1.393.60|| na te’sti nidrā na ca te’sti tandrā na te’sti mātā na ca me’stiputraḥ | na te’sti bālyaṃ na ca me’sti vṛddhiḥ kramākramau brahmaṇi te na me ca ||6 1 || ātmeti jānanparamātmasevako hṛdācitā vā manasā ca vijñayā | ānandamagno’nubhave’parokṣake kārṣṇaṃ rasaṃ cūṣati tṛptimaśnute ||6 2|| pṛthvyāṃ yathā santi sudolanāṃghrayo doloparistaṃbhagatāḥ paṭāṃghrayaḥ | paṭāntarāle caraṇau tava sthitau svadantare yaccaraṇau hi taṃ bhaja ||63|| amūrtake mūrta iva sthitaḥ prabhuḥ saṃrakṣako mokṣada īśvareśvaraḥ | sa eva mātā ca pitā viśāladṛga vikrāntanāmāpi sa eva taṃ bhaja ||64|| ātmāsi mukto’si sadīśvaro’si brahmāsi divyo’si sadāsukho’si | naro’si nārāyaṇarakṣito’si nijasvarūpo’si bhajākṣareśam | |65 || vidvijñānamityuktaṃ krāntaṃkriyā matā tataḥ | jñānakriyāyutaścātmā vikrāntaṃ tvaṃ nijaṃ vada ||66|| vipakṣī tasya vai pakṣau saṃkalpaḥ śaktirityamū | saṃkalpaśaktipakṣābhyāṃ krāntastvaṃ svaṃ nijaṃ vada ||67|| viśca jñānendriyaṃ proktaṃ kraṃ ca karmendriyaṃ tathā | tayorantargataścātmā vikrāntaṃ tvaṃ nijaṃ vada ||68|| ātmānaṃ tvaṃ vijānīhi dehagehavilakṣaṇam | saccidānandameveśaṃ śokastvāṃ na spṛśet tataḥ ||69|| ityevaṃ prathamaṃ putraṃ bodhadānena sā satī | muktaṃ kṛtavatī bālye yogirājaṃ kṛtārthakam ||1.393.70 || vardhamānaṃ sutaṃ nityaṃ navaṃ nūtnaṃ prabodhanam | ātmajñānamayaṃ mātā dadātyullāpanādiṣu ||71 || nirahaṃkāratāṃ prāpto nirmamatvaṃ ca sarvathā | ātmabalaṃ paraṃ lebhe jñānaṃ lebhe ca sanmayam ||72|| mātā sā jananī saiva yayā bālo’tibodhitaḥ | muktimārgagataḥ syācca bandhādbhavācca mucyate ||73|| mātṛbhāṣāparibodhe tvātmabodhamavāptavān | itthaṃ mātrā sa tanayo janmaprabhatibodhitaḥ ||74|| dehasaukhyātigo jāto virāgo viṣayāhataḥ | yauvane’pi na rāgātmā dveṣaścāsya na kutracit| ||75|| strīpuṃbhāve kuṇape’trānitye duḥkhe vināśini | bhogabuddhiranutpannā brāhmarūpeṇa vartinaḥ ||76 || rūpaṃ rasaṃ tathā gandhaṃ sparśaṃ ca śravaṇaṃ tathā | anātmīyaṃ paraṃ matvā na babandhāpi tatra vai ||77|| kāye puṣṭe bale jāte balaṃ pāṣāṇavanmatam | indriyāṇāṃ golakāni koṣṭhalānīva manyate ||78|| evaṃ rāgavihīnaḥ sa nirdvandvaḥ svasvarūpavān | cakāra na matiṃ prājño gārhasthyaṃ prati nirmamaḥ ||79|| svaśarīre’nahaṃkāro rājye’haṃkāravarjitaḥ | kṣetre hastini yāne ca vāhane rāṣṭrake tathā ||1.393.80 || snehabhāvavihīno’sau bandhanaṃ nāptavān kila | dāseṣu bhṛtyavargeṣu dāsīṣu nagarīṣvapi ||8 1 || bhavaneṣu vastrabhūṣātibhogyavastukeṣvapi | na vai cakre manaḥ kiñcinmuktavaryo yathābhavat ||82|| bhojane ramaṇe pāne khādye jaihvye’pi sarvathā | rasāsvādavihīno’sau yatirāḍiva lakṣyate |||83 || ratnahārādibhūṣāsu gandhasugandhivastuṣu | dravadravyeṣu tailādau kajjalādau virāgavān ||84|| pradarśaneṣu mallānāṃ krīḍāsu vārayoṣitām | gītiṣu nartakīnāṃ ca nṛtyeṣu vimanā iva ||||85||| rājñāṃ samāje cotsāhe prajotsaveṣu keliṣu | araṇyādipravāse’pi mṛgayādau virāgavān ||86 || daṇḍadāneṣu hiṃsreṣu karmasu vyāhṛtau tathā | vyavahāreṣu ca krūranirdayeṣu virāgavān ||87|| brahmacarye tathā śauce santoṣe tapasi dhruve | svādhyāye devapūjāyāṃ sadā protsāhavānabhūt ||88|| satye sarvavidhe maune cāsteye mānase bahiḥ | aparigrahaṇe cāpi dhairye kāmādivarjane ||89|| guroḥ prasevane pitroḥ sevane vṛddhamānane | atithisvāgate bhaktadarśane mukta eva saḥ ||1.393.90|| śraddhāluḥ sarvadā cāste sarvathā cāstikaḥ kṛtiḥ | vivekī ca vimokāḍhyo brahmābhyāsaparaḥ sadā ||91 || satāṃ sevāparaścāpi sadā harikriyāparaḥ | kalyāṇakṛtprāṇināṃ ca harṣodvejanavarjitaḥ ||92|| evaṃ sanakatulyaḥ sa vyajāyata śiśutvataḥ | dṛṣṭvā sutaṃ mahāmuktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ samam ||93 || mātā cātīva jahṛṣe pitāpyānandavānabhūt | prajā bhṛtyāstathā cānye menire devameva tam ||94|| aṇimā mahimā tvasya garimā laghimā tathā | prāptiḥ kāmāvasānā ca vaśiteśitvarūpiṇī ||95|| śabdaūhaścādhyayanaṃ duḥkhanāśāstrayastathā | suhṛtprāptirjñānadānaṃ tathā tārā sutārikā ||96|| sarvā āsan pādayośca siddhaḥ saḥ paramo hyabhūt| | apratihatakāmaḥ sa mukto babhau sujātavat ||97|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye pātāle kṛtadhvajasya madālasālagnitasya pitṛrājyaṃ pratyāgamanaṃ, vikramākhyaputrajanma, tasmai madālasākṛtavivekopadeśa ityādinirūpaṇanāmā trinavatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 393 ||
<1.394> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha lakṣmi dvitīyaṃ suṣuve putraṃ madālasā | abhidhānaṃ pitā tasyākarot subāhurityataḥ || 1 || madālasā jahāsāpi nāmarūpavivarjite | nāmarūpaṃ prasahyaiva svārthalokena ropyate || 2 || iyaṃ tu brahmavijñā taṃ bālamullāpanādibhiḥ | upādideśa nityaṃ vai yathāpūrvaṃ nirañjane || 3 || śṛṇu putra śarīraṃ te bālarūpaṃ vyajāyata | pūrvaṃ nāsīt tvadīyaṃ vai kathaṃ svīyaṃ pramanyase || 4 || śīryate taccharīraṃ hi muhuḥ śītoṣṇasaṃbhṛtam | parādhīnakaraṃ nityaṃ sadā viśvāsaghātakam || 5 || pitā pūrvasthitaiḥ klṛptastasya dhātuḥ śarīragaḥ | vinirgataḥ sa janmābhūd jalātmakasutasya vai || 6 || garbhavāse syitastasyāyuṣyaṃ tu daśamāsikam | yadi tatra na tiṣṭhedvai tadāyuṣyaṃ kṣaṇaṃ matam || 7 || māsikaṃ ṣāṇmāsikaṃ vā srāve nyūnāṣṭamāsikam | janmani labdhavatyeva cāyuṣyaṃ daśamāsikam || 8 || tato’syājñānasaṃyuktaṃ cāyuṣyaṃ mūrchanāmayam | tato daśadināntaṃ ca sūtakātmakamucyate || 9 || māsānte varṣataḥ pūrvamāyuṣyaṃ pāravaśyagam | varṣānte trivarṣapūrvamāyuṣyaṃ mātṛśikṣaṇam || 1.394.1 0|| tataḥ śiśuḥ kumāraścādvādaśābdaṃ sa kīrtyate | tataḥ saumyastataḥ prauḍho yuvā cintāpradhānakaḥ || 11 || vidhuro vā sadhuro bā caikalo dvau tato’dhikaḥ | śṛgālavat maṇḍalito’haṃmamatvasamāvṛtaḥ || 12|| śatrumitrakuṭumbādiyaśolābhādisaṃbhṛtaḥ | atasmim̐stadvimantābhūddharṣaśokaparāyaṇaḥ || 13 || putrapautrādisambaddhaḥ paśukṣetrādicintanaḥ | vaṃśavistārapāśena vāsanāmūlaropitaḥ || 14|| jarjaritena dehena vārdhakyaṃ samanuṣṭhitaḥ | rogāśaktyādisampannaḥ śārīrājñāvivarjitaḥ || 1 5|| vātarogādibandhuścāpathyāvamānasevakaḥ | tiraskārādisammāno gantukāmo’pi rodhitaḥ || 16 || mṛtaḥ prajvālitaḥ pretaḥ kvāsītkutra gataḥ sa vai | tasmāt svapnaṃ yathā tadvad dehāyuṣyaṃ vivartate || 17|| matvaivaṃ tvaṃ sadā putra nāmarūpavivarjitaḥ | saccidānandasaṃjño’si nityatṛpto nirāśayaḥ || 18|| vartasvānandamātrāyāṃ mā vartasva vivartane | asāre nityaśuddhastvaṃ māśuddhiṃ mastake vaha || 1 9|| śuklo’si sarvadā putra mā kṛṣṇatvaṃ vahātmani | śuddhadarpaṇatulyo’si kalmaṣaṃ mā niveśaya || 1.394.2 0 || ambeti kṛṣṇo janaketi kṛṣṇo’grajeti kṛṣṇo’hamameti kṛṣṇaḥ | bāleti kṛṣṇaḥ svapareti kṛṣṇaḥ sarvasvakṛṣṇaṃ bhaja muktimehi ||26 1 || tejaḥ paraṃbrahma tamaḥ parabrahma jñāna parabrahma cidambare’rpitam | duḥkha parabrahma sukha parabrahma svaya parebrahmaṇi vartase’rbhaka ||22|| na me’sti kiñcinna ca testi kiñcijjanūttaraṃ mānavakalpitaṃ hi tat | asaṃgabālasya na saṃgamāha tīrṇo’si nityaṃ kuru cātmani śramam ||23 || śārīrayātrā ca yathā vinirvahet tāvatparigrāhaka eva saṃbhava | tatrāpyasaṃgo bhava miṣṭayojanairhareḥ prasādāmṛtamiṣṭamāvaha ||24|| śuddhe nije saccidi saukhyasaṃbhṛte mā duḥkhayogān viniyuṃkṣva bandhadān | yathāsvarūpo viharasva vṛkṣake samānake tricchidi yāvadastike ||25|| na te’sti bhāryā na ca te’sti saudho na cāsti te hastisubhṛtyavāṭyaḥ | na cāsti sainyaṃ na ca rakṣako’nyo vinā hariṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaṃ vai || 26 || tvaṃ dehasaṃge’va satāṃ prasaṃgaṃ tathātmasaṃge’va hareḥ prasaṃgam | iṣṭe’tisaṃge’pi prabhuṃ vidhehi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamābhajasva || 27| | ityevaṃ sā mahārājñī bālamullāpanādibhiḥ | aśikṣayaccātmavidyāṃ so’pi mukto babhūva ha || 28 || so’pyamanyata govindaṃ rakṣakaṃ bāhumeva ha | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇalabdhyā subāhu sva hi manyate || 29 || natu dehasthabāhubhyāṃ subāhuḥ sa viniścitaḥ | mātāpi taṃ mahāmuktaṃ dṛṣṭvā tutoṣa vai hṛdi || 1.394.30 || amanyata mahāsādhvī mātṛtvaṃ sārthakaṃ svakam | ātmapramāṇaṃ vijñānaṃ dadau yataḥ sutāya sā || 31 || pāpāt pāti pitā bodhyo mātā pramāṃ dadāsi yā | tatsarvaṃ vartate rājñyāṃ madālasāyāṃ tṛptikṛt || 32 || atha kālāntare tasyā jajñe putrastṛtīyakaḥ | rājā prāha ca taṃ putraṃ śatrumardanameva ha || 33 || tadā cātiprajāhāsa nāma smṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ | taṃ cāpi sa satī mātā śikṣayāmāsa ciddhanam || 34|| pālane ca yadā taṃ sā hyāndolayati sādaram | dugdhaṃ stanyaṃ tathā bhakṣyaṃ cośyaṃ lehyaṃ dadāti sā || 35 || tadā tadā prasaṃgena śikṣayati sma prokṣaṇam | śṛṇu karṇena putra tvaṃ nahi karṇo’sti cetanaḥ || 36 || gṛhāṇedaṃ supeyaṃ tvaṃ mukhena jihvayā tathā | na jihvā na mukhaṃ cāsi tvaṃ sadāsi pracetanaḥ || 37 || vada śabdaṃ paśya rūpaṃ kuru hāsyaṃ manoramam | na tvaṃ śabdo na vai cakṣurna cāntaḥkaraṇaṃ hyasi || 38 || paśyedaṃ makṣikādaṃśakṛtaṃ daṃśādikaṃ tu yat | tad dehe’sti na tvayyasti dehastyadāśrito’sti vai || 39 || tatroṣṇaṃ vā paraṃ śītaṃ kharjanaṃ viddhi raktakṛt | tvaṃ na raktaṃ na vā dadrurna ca carmāsthikharjanam || 1.394.40 || tvayā sthitena tatsarvaṃ jāyate ca vilīyate | na hrāsastena jātena na vā vṛddhirbhavet tvayi ||41 || pānaṃ peyaṃ kṣudhā tṛṭ ca bhojyaṃ cośyaṃ na vai tvayi | tvayā sthitena tatsarvaṃ deho’yaṃ samapekṣate ||42 || vinā tvāṃ na tanūrnaiva kṣuttṛḍvyāpta pravartanam | sarvaṃ layaṃ sameyādvai tasmāt tvaṃ sarvataḥ paraḥ ||43|| parārthaṃ gṛhavāṭyādi parārthaṃ jaladhānyakam | parārthaṃ cākṣuṣaṃ sarvaṃ yaḥ paraḥ sa tvadātmakaḥ ||44|| jananaṃ maraṇaṃ nityaṃ vyavasthaṃ dehavāsitam | avasthābhyaḥ parastvaṃ vai paramātmasamāśritaḥ ||45|| dehe tvaṃ ca tvayi kaścid yaḥ sa bodhyaḥ pareśvaraḥ | pareśvarasamastvaṃ vai nityabuddho nirañjanaḥ ||46 || nityaśuddho nityasiddho nityavijño bhavātigaḥ | idaṃ tu pālanaṃ svapnaṃ lālanaṃ svapnamityapi ||47|| hasanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ svapnaṃ jāgrato bhava sarvathā | yoganidrā hareryoge sadā śāntipradā tava ||48|| bhoganindātmikā nidrā māyājālaṃ na sā tvayi | aviśuddhiḥ kṣayaścāpi smṛddhāvatiśayaśca yaḥ ||49|| asūyāmatsarerṣyādikalmaṣāḍhyā na vai tvayi | mukto nityaścātmasattaḥ pūrṇānando’si putraka ||1.394.50|| yathā vastraṃ navaṃ prāptaṃ tyaktaṃ jīrṇaṃ prasahya vai | dinaṃ ca nūtanaṃ prāptaṃ gataṃ pūrvaṃ prasahya vai ||51 || prātargataṃ gataṃ sāyaṃ gatā cāndramasī niśā | amāvasyāniśā māyā tāmasī cāpi te gatā ||52|| ghaṭamālānusāreṇa yadi sā te’ntikaṃ bhavet | ātmavidyunmaye divyaprakāśe’vatarātmavit ||53 || kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho moho mado’bhimānakam | śatravaste nijabodhe tānpramardaya sarvathā ||54|| gatān vai mānvaśocastvaṃ vartamānān nivartaya | anāgatāṃśca mā dehyātithyasatkaraṇaṃ manāk ||55|| ātmajñānātikhaḍgena chinnāste cāntarārayaḥ | anudbhavāśca vāpuṣṭāḥ śuṣkāyante vinā jalam |||56 || dehasya śatravo loke na vai cātmani śatravaḥ | ātmano mokṣaṇe vighnāḥ śatravaste prakīrtitāḥ ||57|| evaṃ tvaṃ cātmaśatrūṇāṃ bhūtvā sammardakaḥ pure | navadvāre praprākāre vartasva śubhavarjitaḥ ||58|| tataste sārthakaṃ nāma pitroktaṃ śatrumardanam | ityevaṃ bodhitaḥ so’pi mātrā putrastṛtīyakaḥ ||5 9 || bālyādeva sumukto’bhūd dvandvabhītivivarjitaḥ | yāne ca bhojane ramye bhogye bhoge’pyanātaraḥ ||1.394.60 || niṣtṛṣṇo nityatṛptaśca vartate sma nirantaram | gataṃ vighnaṃ gatā dvandvāḥ saṃsāro nāgataśca ke ||6 1 || hṛdye na samāviṣṭaṃ māyājālaṃ ca gatvaram | udayāstamayau nāsya bādhete muktivartini ||62|| svaprakāśe svakānande svātmatṛptau hi vartate | sanandanasamāno’yaṃ dṛśyate yogirāḍiva ||6 3|| dṛṣṭvā mātā prasannābhūnmātṛtvaṃ sārthakaṃ kṛtam | jalena rañjanāṃ naiti nodvegaṃ yāti vahninā ||64|| utsavena śamaṃ naiti viṣeṇa viṣamo na vā | sukhaduḥkhasamaḥ putraścāhaṃ dhanyā hi putriṇī ||65|| ityānandamayī nityā hariṃ bhajati sā satī | muktaṃ putraṃ samālokya muktimārgasthitābhavat ||66 || evaṃ putratrayaṃ lebhe jīvanmuktaṃ madālasā | brahmamadena jagati sālasābhūnmadālasā ||67|| evaṃ putratrayaṃ tvātmasattayā brahmatanmayam | kriyāścakāra niṣkāmaṃ na rājārthopakārakam ||68|| rājāpi bhaktarāṭ dṛṣṭvā putrān kṛṣṇāśritān śubhān | muktān brahmasvarūpām̐śca teṣu tutoṣa sarvathā ||69|| pativratāyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ tutoṣātyantameva ca | janmanā kiṃ yadi bandhāḥ putre’pi nihitāstadā ||1.394.70|| yastu bandhairāvṛtaśca kathaṃ pitṝn sa tārayet | patnī bandhanakartrī yā tayā kiṃ janmanaḥ phalam ||71 || uddhārayitrī yā bhāryā sā patnī satyatāriṇī | kuṭumbatāriṇī saiva tayā gārhasthyamuttamam ||72|| putro’pi tārakaḥ proktaḥ patnī tathaiva tārikā | satī patnī sutaḥ sādhustau matau bhavatārakau ||73 || dhanyo’haṃ dhanyarājyaṃ me dhanyā cāpi prajā mama | satsaṃgācca satīsaṃgāt tariṣyāmaḥ prajādayaḥ ||74|| yatra rājye bhaveyuśca sādhvyaḥ satyaḥ pativratāḥ | sutāśca sādhavo muktā vaikuṇṭhaṃ tatra vidyate |||75||| dhigjanaṃ dhūrtabhāryāyāḥ patiṃ tātaṃ śaṭhasya ca | dhigrājānaṃ vañcayitryāḥ prajāyāḥ pālakaṃ tathā ||76 || jayastasya satībhāryāsvāminaḥ sarvadā bhuvi | madālasāyāḥ puṇyena vijayo me’sti sarvathā ||77|| svargaṃ svargasamaṃ rājyaṃ putrā devasamā mama | divyā lakṣmīsamā patnī vaikuṇṭhaṃ me’sti sarvathā ||78|| śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sarvadā tvāste matputreṣu virāgiṣu | śrīrādhā ca sadā madālasāyāṃ vartate nanu ||79||| lakṣmīḥ sadā gṛhe cāste mama cāndhasikeṣu vai | nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ mayi nāsti nyūnaṃ ca me manāk ||1.394.80|| yasya pativratā bhāryā yasya putraśca bhaktarāṭ | tasya vaiṣṇavayajñānāṃ sahasraṃ nityameva hi ||81 || yatra nāsti satī bhāryā yatra putro na bhaktarāṭ | tasya gṛhaṃ piśācānāṃ pherurājagṛhopamam ||82|| ityevaṃ ṛtamevāsya dhvajavad dṛśyate sadā | tenārthavānnabhavat sa ṛtadhvajo’pi pārthivaḥ ||83|| athāyaṃ svasutānāha rājyapālanahetave | putrāḥ prāhuśca pitaraṃ kurmo brāhmaṃ hi rājyakam ||84|| mātuḥ pituḥ kṛpayaiva vayaṃ samuddhṛtā bhavāt | rājyaṃ tu pārthivaṃ sarvaṃ magnabhāvaṃ karoti vai ||85|| ātmarājyasamaṃ rājyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati | brahmānandasamaṃ saukhyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ||86 || nityatṛptiṃ gatasyātra rājyānando viṣopamaḥ | vitṛṣṇasyātmanaḥ saukhyātparaṃ saukhyaṃ na vidyate ||87|| ātmani paramātmānaṃ dhyāyante yogino janāḥ | santastathā prapaśyanti śrīhariṃ hṛdayāntare ||88|| tadyogaṃ tu vayaṃ prāptāḥ pitarmāturdayālavāt | tato rājyaṃ na cecchāmo bahiṣṭhaṃ naśvaraṃ kṣayam ||89|| śrutvā piteti putrāṇāṃ mumude vai muhurmuhuḥ | tārito’smi suputraiśca kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||1.394.90|| ititṛptasya rājñastu kālāntare sutaḥ śubhaḥ | caturtho’pi madālasārājñyāṃ jajñe guṇālayaḥ ||91 || athāsmai sā mahārājñī provāca suśubhaṃ vacaḥ | putra puṇyena bahunā tava janmātra saṃgatam ||92|| ajanmāsi sajanmā tvaṃ jāto’si rājyakāraṇāt | arājāsi purupuṇyād rājā bhavasi putraka ||93|| aprajo’si prajāyukto bhavasi rājyakāraṇāt | nityamukto’si tadapi baddho’si pitṛtoṣaṇāt ||94|| mā sma kleśaṃ prajākārye manyethāḥ mātṛdeśanāt | mā sma glānimasatyārthe kālakṣepe’pi savraja ||95|| pitroḥ sevā tvayā kāryā jñānaṃ saṃrakṣya vai hṛdi | vartasvājñākaro bhūtvā nirlepo lepavāniva ||96|| ityuktvā virarāmātha cikīrṣurnāma bhūpatiḥ | dadarśa tāṃ satīṃ bhāryāmīṣaddhāsāṃ madālasām ||97|| tāmāha rājā hasatīṃ kiñcitkautuhalānvitaḥ | kriyamāṇe mayā nāmni pratyeke nāmakarmaṇi ||98|| tava saṃjāyate hāsyaṃ vadātra kāraṇaṃ nu kim | vikrāntaśca subāhuśca tṛtīyaḥ śatrumardanaḥ ||99|| kṛtānyetāni nāmāni manye tāni śubhāni vai | yadvā te’tra navaṃ kiñcidūhamānaṃ prakāśate || 1.394.1 00|| vad sādhvi santyasanti nāmāni kīdṛśāni hi | asya caturthaputrasya nāma tvaṃ kuru bhāmini || 101 || madālasā patiṃ prāha karomyākhyāṃ sutasya te | alarka iti dharmajñaḥ khyātaḥ suto bhaviṣyati || 1 02|| laḥ layo raśca vivṛddhiḥ ka utpattirna yatra vai | alarkaḥ sa tu vijñeyastava putraścaturthakaḥ || 1 03|| ātmā na jāyate kaścinna vardhate na naśyati | ajanmavṛddhivilayo’larko’yaṃ tava putrakaḥ || 1 04|| ātmano nāsti śatrurvai yena mardanamācaret | evaṃ śatrumardanaṃ tu nāma nirarthakaṃ bhavet || 1 05|| kāmakrodhādiśatrūṇāṃ mardane sārthakaṃ tataḥ | bāhurbhujā nātmano’sti subāhuḥ syānnirarthakam || 106 || bahuṣu vartate yo’sau bāhuḥ kṛṣṇa udīryate | su sammato yasyāsti subāhuḥ sārthakaṃ tataḥ || 1 07|| krāntiḥ kriyā gatiryatra viśeṣeti nirarthakam | vyāpakasyātmano naiva gatistvasti kadācana || 1 08|| athāpi bhagavalloke gatirvidyata ityapi | vikrāntaḥ sārthakaṃ nāma bhavatyeva sutasya te || 1 09|| evaṃ putrāstava rājan tārakā mokṣadāyakāḥ | jātā bhāgyavaśānmuktā jīvantu śāśvatīḥ samāḥ || 1.394.11 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye dvitīyasutasubāhutṛtīyaśatrumardanacaturthālarkākhyaputrebhyo madālasākṛtopadeśanirūpaṇanāmā caturnavatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||394||
<1.395> śrīnārāyāṇa uvāca atha rājñā yojitā sā madālasā caturthakam | putraṃ lakṣmi pravṛttestu mārge hyupādideśa yat || 1 || putra vardhasva madbharturmano nandaya karmabhiḥ | devapitratithīn sarvān karmaṇā toṣamāvaha || 2 || brahmacaryaṃ vrataṃ putra gṛhāṇa sopanāyakam | tato vidyāṃ rājayogyāṃ nītiṃ gṛhāṇa sadguroḥ || 3 || rājyaṃ pitṛpradattaṃ ca dharmārthaṃ vaha putraka | prajā rakṣa kratūn śreṣṭhān kuru vahnau ghṛtādikam || 4 || juhudhi brāhmaṇasādhudīnebhyo dehi cārthitam | kṣiteḥ saṃpālanāt saukhyaṃ dharmakāryaṃ bhaviṣyati || 5 || tena svargaṃ ca devatvaṃ sukhaṃ prāpsyasi śāśvatam | parvasu tīrthake gatvā tarpayethāḥ dharāmarān || 6 || pūrayethāḥ mano’bhīṣṭaṃ bāndhavānāṃ samīhitam | cintayethāḥ hṛdi sarvajīvānāṃ hitamuttamam || 7 || nivartayethāḥ satataṃ cākāryebhyaścāpi pāpataḥ | yajñairdānaijapairhomairdevān dvijām̐śca prīṇaya || 8 || dharmārthakāmasaṃjñaiśca vijayethāḥ pumarthakaiḥ | gurun saṃsevayethāśca nandayethāḥ suhṛjanān || 9 || sādhūn saṃrakṣayethāśca yajethāḥ suramānavān | vrajethāstīrthayātrāyāṃ kārayethāḥ svamokṣaṇam || 1.395.10 || gṛhadharmān pālayethāstoṣayethāḥ suyoṣitaḥ putrānutpādayethāśca śrayethāḥ nyāsasādhutām ||11 || samarjayethāḥ muktiṃ ca tyajethāḥ pravṛttiṃ tathā | vilīyethāḥ pare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’kṣarādhipe || 12 || iti putra tavārthe vai mayā mārgo nideśitaḥ | tatra śreyaḥ śrayethāstvaṃ rāgatyāgobhayātmakam || 13 || evamullāpyamānaḥ so’larko mātrā punaḥ punaḥ | vavṛdhe vayasā bālaḥ ṛtadhvajasutaḥ śubhaḥ || 14|| kṛtopanayanaḥ prāha mātaraṃ vada me sati | mama yadatra kartavyamaihikāmuṣmikaṃ ca yat || 15 || madālasā punaḥ prāha jñānayogye vayasyatha | vatsa rājye’bhiṣiktena kartavyaṃ lokarañjanam || 16|| vyasanāni na kāryāṇi rājyanāśyakarāṇi vai | ātmā rakṣyo ripubhyaśca mantro rakṣyo viśeṣataḥ || 17|| amātyādīn vijānīyādāsanādānabhāṣaṇaiḥ | cāraiḥ sarvatra saṃdṛṣṭiṃ kārayet satyavedibhiḥ || 18|| kutrāpi bhūbhṛtā viśvasanīyaṃ naiva sarvathā | kāryasādhakatā rakṣyā viśvāsairapi karhicit || 1 9|| deśakālādivijñena rājñā bhāvya guṇādibhiḥ | ātmā prākmantriṇaḥ paścād bhṛtyā jeyastataḥ param || 1.395.20 || kāmādayo vijetavyāḥ prathamaṃ sarvathā nṛpaiḥ | kāmaḥ krodho mado lobho mānaścaite vināśakāḥ || 2 1 || kākavacceṣṭayā bhāvyaṃ kokilāvat svareṇa ca | bhṛṃgavat sāragrahaṇe mṛgavadbhramaṇe sadā || 22|| vyālavad roṣakaraṇe mayūravat samādare | haṃsavattu vivekena kukkuṭavaddhi jāgratau || 23 || lohavad dārḍhyabhāvena bhāvyaṃ rājñā hitārthinā | kīṭavat kaṭhine śatrau praviśettu śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||24|| sambhūya ca pipīlikāvadāharet paraṃ nṛpaḥ | agnivisphuliṃgavad vai camatkāraṃ pradarśayet ||25|| candravat sūryavaccāpi nītyarthe niyamaṃ caret | bandhakī tu yathā syādvai nirlepā paśupakṣiṣu ||26|| padma jale tu nirlepaṃ hyuparyupari tiṣṭhati | śarabhaḥ siṃhavargaśca phalayukpuruṣārthakaḥ ||27|| śūlī vedhe na viphalā tathā prajñāṃ samarjayet | dadhipātre prasphuṭite gopālikā na śocati ||28|| gurviṇīstanato dugdhaṃ sravate na kadācana | evaṃ rājñā vartanīyaṃ kartavyaṃ rājyarakṣaṇam ||29|| indravattoyamādāya dātavyaṃ samayāgame | sūryavattoyamādāya dātavyaṃ ṛtusaṃgame ||1.395.30|| yamavat suhṛdi śatrau daṇḍakārye samo bhavet| | candravat śāntamanasā bhāvyaṃ kvacinna sarvadā ||3 1 || vāyuvat sarvavarṇeṣu cārairgopyaṃ samāharet | na lobhe kāmavarge vā kṛṣyate sa sukhī sadā ||32|| dharmaṃ pālayati svargyaṃ sādhvāśramām̐śca rakṣati | tasya sukhaṃ pretya paratreha ca śāśvatam ||33|| prajāyāṃ dharmasarvasvasthāpanena nṛpasya tu | bhāgaprāptirbhavatyeva tena svargaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||34|| karmayajñān jñānayajñān bhaktiyajñān pravartayet | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprītyā labheta śāśvataṃ padam ||35|| satyaṃ śaucamahiṃsā cānasūyā ca tathā kṣamā | ānṛśaṃsyamakarmaṇyaṃ caite rakṣyā janairbhuvi ||36 || vatsa gārhasthyamādāya janaḥ puṣṇāti vai jagat | tatpuṇyena ca lokān sa sañjayatyabhivāñcchitān ||37|| surā daityā dānavā vā mānuṣāḥ pitararṣayaḥ | munayaḥ kīṭapataṃgā vayāṃsi paśavo drumāḥ ||38|| gṛhasthamupajīvanti tena tṛptiṃ prayānti ca | mukhaṃ tvasya nirīkṣante hyapi no dāsyatīti vai ||39|| gārhasthyaṃ poṣakaṃ sarvādhāraṃ gauḥ sā trayīmayī | yatra pratiṣṭhitaṃ viśvaṃ viśvahetuśca sā matā ||1.395.40|| iṣṭāpūrtādikāryāṇi gṛhasthenaiva sarvathā | svāhākārasvadhākārau gṛhasthādhārakau matau ||41|| vaṣaṭkāro hantakāraścāhokāro’pi tanmayaḥ | gārhasthyocchedakartā yaḥ sa tu pāpakaro’sti vai ||42|| gārhasthyaṃ poṣayed vijñaḥ saḥ svargāyopakalpyate | rājñā vā dhaninā vatsa devarṣipitṛmānavāḥ ||43|| bhūtāni cānudivasaṃ poṣyāṇi svatanuryathā | pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ kāle kuryātsamāhitaḥ ||44| sumanogandhapuṣpādyairdeśanabhyarcayet tathā | dīnānāthadaridrebhyo dadyād bhojyādikaṃ gṛhī ||45|| śvabhyaśca śvapacebhyaśca vayobhyaścāvaped bhuvi | bubhukṣumāgataṃ śrāntaṃ yācamānamakiṃcanam ||46|| bhojyaṃ peyaṃ pradadyāccātithiṃ matvā hariṃ prabhum | tasmim̐stṛpte nṛyajñotthādṛṇānmucyeta vai gṛhī ||47|| atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhasthasya nivartate | datvā sa duṣkṛtaṃ tasmai puṇyamādāya gacchati ||48|| apyambuśākadānena satkriyādatithiṃ gṛhī | bhikṣāṃ ca yācatāṃ dadyād yathāśaktiprabhikṣaṇam ||49|| āśritān bhojayitvaiva sadā bhuṃjyād gṛhādhipaḥ | evamudvahataḥ putra gārhasthyaṃ copakārakam |||1.395.50|| devāḥ pitaro munayo dīnāścātithibhikṣukāḥ | ṛṣayo bāndhavāḥ pakṣipaśavaḥ sūkṣmakīṭakāḥ ||51 || āśīrvādaparā nityāḥ sukhadāḥ saṃbhavanti vai | paraloke’pi sukhadā avighnāśca bhavanti te ||52|| evaṃvidhāṃ śubhāṃ gāthāṃ svayamatriragāyata | vaiśvadevaṃ hi nāmaitad datvā yuṃjyānna cānyathā ||53|| putrajanmani yatkāryaṃ vivāhādau ca yad yathā | tathā satāṃ tu sevāyāṃ vyayaḥ kāryo harerdine ||54|| annaprakiraṇaṃ yattu manuṣyaiḥ kriyate bhuvi | tena tṛptiṃ piśācādyāḥ paryuṣitena yāntyapi |||55|| yadambu snānavastrādvai bhūmau patati tena vai | ye ke ca tarutāṃ prāptāsteṣāṃ tṛptiḥ prajāyate ||56|| ye tu dehāṃgalagnā vai patanti jalabindavaḥ | bhūgataistaiśca devādau gatāstṛptiṃ prayānti vai ||57|| piṇḍānnakaṇikābhiśca tiryañco yānti toṣaṇam | ye tu dagdhāstathā bālāḥ kriyāyogyā asaṃskṛtāḥ ||58|| vipannāste’nnavikirasammārjanajalāśinaḥ | ācullukajalaṃ pītvā tṛptimāyānti te mṛtāḥ ||59|| tasmānmahotsave dadyāt śrāddhe dadyācca dānake | dadyādeva gṛhasthastu kule kaścinna sīdati ||1.395.6 0|| sadācāro gṛhasthena pālanīyo yathāyatham | na hyācāravihīnasya sukhamatra paratra ca ||61 || durācāro hi puruṣo nehāyurvindati dhruvam | sarvapāpaniṣedhārthaṃ dharmaḥ kāryo gṛhārthinā ||62|| brāhme muhūrte buddhyeta dharmārthau cāpi cintayet | snātvā sandhyāṃ tathā dhyānaṃ prakurvīta surārcanam ||63|| asatpralāpamanṛtaṃ vākpāruṣyaṃ ca varjayet | asadvādaṃ ca nāstikyaṃ naiva kuryātkadācana ||64|| vṛddhebhyo namanaṃ kuryāt pūjyapūjā samācaret | gurūṇāmāsanaṃ dadyādabhyutthānādi cācaret ||65|| guruṃ ca pitarau śreṣṭhaṃ patiṃ samabhivādayet | duṣkṛtaṃ na gurorbrūyāt kruddhaṃ tvenaṃ prasādayet ||66|| paranindāṃ na śṛṇuyānna ca kuryātkadācana | panthā deyo brāhmaṇānāṃ rājño duḥkhāturasya ca ||67|| satāṃ viduṣāṃ gurviṇyā bhārārtasya yavīyasaḥ | mūkāndhabadhirāṇāṃ ca mattasyonmattakasya ca ||68|| satyāśca vairiṇaścāpi bālasya patitasya ca | narmābhighātamākrośaṃ paiśunyaṃ ca vivarjayeta ||69|| daṃbhābhimānaśāṭhyāni na kuryādvai kadācana | paradārā na gantavyā dīrghāyuṣyaṃ samīcchatā ||1.395.70|| rajasvalā sadā varjyā sarvaiḥ rātricatuṣṭayam | strījanmaparihārārthaṃ pañcamīmapi varjayet ||71 || tataḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vrajed rātryāṃ putrecchuko hi sarvathā | yugmāsu putrā jāyante kanyāstvekāsu rātriṣu ||72|| āṣoḍaśarātraṃ vai garbhādhānabalaṃ matam | tata ūrdhvaṃ tu kamalaṃ pihitaṃ jāyate’phalam ||73 || kuryānmaitrī na cāśīlairna cauryādidūṣitaiḥ | na cātivyayaśīlaiśca na lubdhairnāpi vairibhiḥ ||74|| na tathā balibhirmaitrī na nyūnairnāpi ninditaiḥ | na sarvaśaṃkibhiścāpi na vā daivaparaistathā ||75||| atha maitrīṃ prakurvīta sadācāraiśca sādhubhiḥ | prājñairapiśunaiḥ śaktaiḥ karmodyogādiśālibhiḥ ||76 || patidevagurūn prati naiva pādau prasārayet | tatra putra na vastavyaṃ yatra nāsti catuṣṭayam ||77|| ṛṇapradātā vaidyaśca śrotrīyaḥ sajalā nadi | jitāmitro nṛpo yatra dharmarakṣaṇakārakaḥ ||78|| paurāḥ susaṃyatā yatra yatra sasyavatī mahī | yatrāmatsariṇo lokāstatra vāsaḥ sukhodayaḥ ||79|| tatra putra na vastavyaṃ yatraitat tritayaṃ sadā | jigīṣuḥ pūrvavairaśca janā udyamavarjitāḥ ||1.395.80|| śaucādikaṃ śṛṇu putra yathā yasyāsti sammatam | śakhāśmasvarṇarūpyāṇāṃ rajjūnāmatha vāsasām ||81 || śākamūlaphalānāṃ ca tathā vidalacarmaṇām | maṇivajrapravālānāṃ ratnamuktāphalasya ca ||82|| gātrāṇāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāmambunā śaucamiṣyate | sasnehānāṃ tu bhāṇḍānāṃ śuddhiruṣṇena vāriṇā ||83 || śūrpadhānyājinānāṃ ca muśalolūkhalasya ca | saṃhatānāṃ ca vastrāṇāṃ prokṣaṇāt sacayasya ca ||84|| valkalānāmaroṣāṇāmambunā śuddhiriṣyate | tṛṇakāṣṭhauṣadhīnāṃ ca prokṣaṇācchuddhiriṣyate ||85|| ūrṇā keśādayaḥ śuddhā vāyunā kiraṇena vā | śuci bhaikṣaṃ kāruhastaḥ paṇyaṃ yoṣinmukhaṃ tathā ||86 || yajñaśālā rasaśālāḥ stanandhayasutāḥ striyaḥ | śucinyaśca tathā hyāpaḥ sravantyo’gandhabudbudāḥ ||87|| bhūmirviśuddhyati kālāt sekāllepātsumārjanāt | ullekhanāttathā vṛṣṭermṛttikācchuddhiriṣyate ||88 || bhasmāmbugharṣaṇairkāṃsyaśuddhiśca vahninā tathā | mṛttoyaiścānyapātrāṇāṃ kṣāreṇa trapusīsayoḥ ||89||| rajo’gniraśvo gauśchāyā raśmayaḥ pavano mahī | vipruṣo makṣikādyāśca duṣṭasaṃgādadoṣiṇaḥ ||1.395.90 || ajāśvau mukhato medhyau na gorvatsasya cānanam | mātuḥ prasravaṇaṃ medhyaṃ śakuni phalapātane ||91 || āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ nāvaḥ pathi tṛṇāni ca | somasūryāṃśupavanaiḥ śuddhyanti nityameva hi ||92 || prabhūtopahatādannādagramudbhūpya saṃtyajet | śeṣasya prokṣaṇaṃ kuryād vāyunā śuddhireva vā |||93 || śavaṃ spṛṣṭvā prakuryādvai snānaṃ śuddhistato matā | malatyāge prakurvīta snānaṃ karādiśodhanam ||94|| apatyajanmani śaucaṃ māsamekaṃ hi pālayet | mṛtaśaucaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ pālayennyūnavarṣavat |||95|| ityevaṃ tvamalarkātrācāraṃ pālaya sarvathā | ātmaśuddhiḥ sadā rakṣyā māyābhramavināśanaiḥ |||96 || sa evamanuśiṣṭo 3 mātrā tvalarka ādarāt | pitrādiṣṭaśca saṃcakre dharmadāraparigraham ||97|| rājyaṃ pitrā pradattaṃ ca gṛhāṇālarka aihikam | madālasā svatanayaṃ prāhedaṃ paścimaṃ vacaḥ || 98|| yadā duḥkhamasahyaṃ te priyabandhuviyogajam | śatrubādhodbhavaṃ vāpi vittanāśādisaṃbhavam ||99 || tadāsmāt putra niṣkṛṣya maddattādaṃgulīyakāt | vācyaṃ vai śāsanaṃ tvatra paṭṭe’sti likhitaṃ mayā || 1.395.10 0|| ityuktvā pradadau mātā sauvarṇaṃ sāṃgulīyakam | āśiṣaścāpi yā yogyā dattā mātrā tataḥ param || 101 || pitrā dattā āśiṣaśca rājyaṃ cakre hyalarkakaḥ | madālasāṛtadhvajau tapase kānanaṃ gatau || 1 02|| dhyātvā tau śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tyaktvā tu bhautikam | divyaṃ dehaṃ samāsādya yayaturbrahmadhāma vai || 1 03|| evaṃ madālasā lakṣmi vaiṣṇavī vai pativratā | putrān muktān suniṣpādyākṣaradhāma gatā satī || 1 04|| etasya paṭhanādvāpi śravaṇānmuktirāpyate | bandhanāni vinaśyeyuḥ sadā saukhyaṃ bhavet priye || 1 05|| alarko’pi yathānyāyaṃ bandhanaṃ na bhaved yathā | tathākaronnijaṃ rājyaṃ sarvāḥ pramuditāḥ prajāḥ || 1 06|| pālayāmāsa dharmātmā putravad dhārmikīḥ prajāḥ | putrām̐ścotpādayāmāsa tatheyāja mahāmakhaiḥ || 1 07|| ajāyanta sutāstvasya mahābalaparākramāḥ | dharmātmāno mahātmāno vimārgaparipanthinaḥ || 1 08|| rājyaṃ kartuṃ samarthebhyo na sutebhyo dadau dhuram | vairāgyaṃ nāsya saṃjajñe bhuṃjato viṣayān bahūn || 1 09|| taṃ tathā bhogasaṃsaktaṃ bhrāntaṃ cāpyajitendriyam | bhrātaraṃ rāganāśāya hyupadeṣṭumanā vanī || 1.395.11 0|| subāhunāmako bhrātāgrajaḥ sanyāsavān yatiḥ | āyayau tadgṛhaṃ śīghramupādideśa mokṣaṇam || 111 || ātmavidyāṃ bahuvidyāṃ bhrātrāpi kathitāṃ ca tām | smāraṃ smāraṃ jagādāsmai bandhanāśārthameva saḥ || 11 2|| tathāpyalarko no mene rājyatyāgaṃ hitaṃkaram | tadā bubodhayiṣustaṃ tyājayituṃ ca bandhanam || 113 || subāhustu ciraṃ dhyātvā śreyo’manyata saṅgaram | tadvairisaṃśrayaṃ kṛtvā yuddhamutpādya colbaṇam || 1 14|| kārayāmi paraṃ śreyo bhrāturvairāgyamuttamam | audāsīnyaṃ samutpādayitvā karomi mokṣaṇam || 1 15|| vicāryetthaṃ subāhuḥ saḥ kāśībhūpālamāgamat | tena cakre balodyogamalarkaṃ prati pārthivaḥ || 1 16|| dūtaṃ ca preṣayāmāsa rājyaṃ bhrātre pradīyatām | ityuktavantaṃ taṃ dūtaṃ pratyuvāca madānvitaḥ || 1 17|| māmevābhyetya hārdena yācatāṃ rājyamagrajaḥ | nākrāntyā saṃpradāsyāmi kāśīrājabhayena vai || 1 18|| tataḥ kāśīnṛpeṇāsya yuddhaṃ ghorataraṃ hyabhūt | cintāṃ sa paramāṃ prāpya tat sasmārāṃgulīyakam || 11 9|| mātrā dattaṃ tatra patraṃ dadṛśe prasphuṭākṣaram | saṃgaḥ sarvātmanā tyājyaḥ sa cet tyaktaṃ na śakyate || 1.395.120 || saḥ sadbhiḥ saha kartavyaḥ satāṃ saṃgo hi bheṣajam | tṛṣṇā sarvātmanā heyā tyaktuṃ cecchakyate na sā || 121 || mumukṣayā parityājyā saiva tasyāstu bheṣajam | vācayitvā mumukṣāṃ ca gṛhītvālarkabhūpatiḥ || 1 22|| sādhusamparkamanvicchan rātrau mitaparigrahaḥ | dattātreyaṃ mahābhāgaṃ yayau gurumasaṃginam || 123 || praṇipatyābhisaṃpūjya yathāsarvamabhāṣata | kuru prasādaṃ duḥkhādivināśāyetyayācata || 1 24|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye’larka madālasā pravṛttidharmānupādideśa, sā sapatikā divyagatimavāpa, alarkasyātmajñānārthaṃ subāhoḥ prayāsa ityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcanavatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||395 ||
<1.396> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca samākarṇaya vijñānaṃ dattātreyād yathārjitam | alarkeṇa mahālakṣmi yogināmapi durlabham || 1 || guruḥ prāha kimarthaṃ te duḥkhaṃ brūhi yathātatham | duḥkhāpahāramadyaiva karomi tava pārthiva || 2 || śiṣyaḥ prāha subāhurme bhrātā rājyārthameva yat | kāśīnṛpeṇa sammīlya vai mayā saha yuddhyati || 3 || tadduḥkhaṃ paramaṃ śīghraṃ prāk prātareva nāśaya | guruḥ prāha tadetattu tvayi nāsti kadācana || 4 || yasyātmani na cāsti tvaṃ tasyāpasaraṇaṃ kutaḥ | vicāraṃ kuru rājendra prakāśo’stu ca te hṛdi || 5 || matkṛpāto nijaṃ viddhi hyaduḥkhaṃ hyasukhaṃ sadā | gṛhāṇedaṃ jalaṃ rājan piba gaṇḍūṣamātrakam || 6 || dehi netropari tadvanmastake brahmadarśakam | ityuktaḥ sa tathā kṛtvā hyudghāṭitahṛdantaraḥ || 7 || bhūtvā vimṛśya cātmānaṃ prahasyedamathābravīt | prakṛtistriguṇā sarvā nistraiguṇyo’smyahaṃ sadā || 8 || prakṛtermamatā jātā tayā jātāpyahaṃkṛtiḥ | tayā miṣṭāni mātrāṇi grāhakāṇi mṛdūnyapi || 9 || mātrebhyaḥ sthūlabhogyāni tebhyo deho guṇāśritaḥ | sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ tathā mohaḥ sattvaṃ rajastamaśca te || 1.396.1 0|| tatkāryāṇi tādṛśāni teṣu cāyānti tānyapi | a tādṛśe hyatasmim̐śca mayi nāyānti tāni vai || 11 || tataḥ sukhaṃ tathā duḥkhaṃ mohaḥ santi na te mayi | nāmurvī na salilaṃ na jyotiranilo na ca || 1 2|| nākāśaṃ ceti gandhādyā dharmā mayi na santi vai | nāhaṃ pṛthvīrna me gandho nāhaṃ jalaṃ na me rasaḥ || 13 || nāhaṃ jyotirna me rūpaṃ nāhaṃ vāyurna me spṛśiḥ | nāhaṃ vyoma na me śabdastaddharmāṃśca kuto mayi || 14|| pañcabhūtāni yuktāni hāniṃ vṛddhiṃ prayānti ca | sukhaduḥkhapramohānāṃ hānirvṛddhiśca dṛśyate || 15|| dṛśyavad dṛśyadharmāṃśca ghaṭo rūpādayastathā | dṛśyante cakṣuṣā yadvat sukhādyā manasāstathā || 16|| dṛśyasyaiva prakṛteste nātmanaḥ santi naśvarāḥ | anaśvarasya nityasya kathamāgantudharmitā || 17|| evaṃ hastena vai grāhyaṃ phalaṃ cāmrādikaṃ jaḍam | rūpaṃ tu cakṣuṣā grāhyaṃ raso rasanayā tathā || 18|| gandho nāsikayā grāhyaṃ unmādo manasā tathā | āsavādau guṇonmādo mattatā dhūsture khalu || 1 9|| takrādau māndyamevetyādayo grāhyā rasottarāḥ | manasā te tu gṛhyante mano’pi tadrasottaram ||1.396.20|| aṃśo muktasya cāṇīyānmana eva bhavatyatha | manasyavasthitā dharmo jñānaṃ virāgamīśitā || 21 || sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vimohaste manasyavasthitā yataḥ | nāhaṃ mano na me duḥkhasukhamohāḥ kathaṃcana ||22|| ahaṃ nāhaṃ, mama nāhaṃ, buddhirnāhaṃ, na vai manaḥ, | tatra sthitaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ tasyaiva mayi tatkatham ||23|| nāhaṃ pṛthivyādimayaṃ śarīraṃ na vā manaścāntaramindriyaṃ ca | nāpi prakarmāśayavāsanāhaṃ tanmohaduḥkhāni ca kiṃ mamātra ||24|| rājyaṃ dharitrī janatāḥ samastāstacchāsanaṃ buddhikṛtaṃ na tanme | buddhiḥ samānā triguṇasya putrī tacchāsanaṃ rājyamidaṃ na tanme ||25|| karotu tacchāsanamasya buddhiḥ subāhubuddhiśca karotu yadvā | nālarkabuddhirna subāhubuddhiryato’bhidhā dehagatā na jīve ||26 || na yasya hastādikamasti vaśyaṃ māṃsaṃ na cāsthīni śirāvibhāgaḥ | kastasya hastyaśvarathādikoṣaiḥ svalpo’pi saṃsarga ihāsti puṃsaḥ ||27|| tasmānna me’rirna ca me’sti dukhaṃ na me sukhaṃ pattanamasti mohaḥ | na kośanāgāśvadharārthadārā na tasya nānyasya na me bhavanti |||28|| yadasti tasyaiva sa me’sti śuklo yadasti me tasya tadeva cāsti | dvayoryadastyeva sa śukla ātmā duḥkhe sukhe kena kṛtaṃ vadātra ||29||| samyak prapaśyataḥ puṃso duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ na kiñcana | ātmapradarśinaḥ kvāpi rājyaṃ na harimantarā ||1.396.3 0 || buddhistathā sthitisthāpyā bahukālakṛtā sadā | yatrāsaktā tathā tadvajjāyate guṇarañjitā ||3 1 || mārjārabhakṣite duḥkhaṃ yādṛśaṃ gṛhakukkuṭe | na tādṛṅmatāśūnye cakravāke’tha mūṣike ||32|| rakṣaṇe dehaputrādau yathābuddhiḥ pravartate | na tathā dehalikṣādāvasti pratyuta māraṇe |||33 || ekasyaiva hi dehasya dhātubhirvividhāḥ prajāḥ | likṣā kīṭā matkuṇā aurasā vyavāyajāḥ sutāḥ ||34|| na sarvatra samā buddhirnakhakeśamaleṣvapi | tasmād buddhikṛtaṃ naijaṃ pārakyaṃ nātmanā kṛtam |||35|| tasmād guro satyabodhe nāhaṃ duḥkhī na vā sukhī | na ca mugdho naraḥ kaścid vedmi te’nugrahāt khalu ||36 || śrutvaitacchiṣyavākyaṃ tu dattātreya uvāca tam | evametannaravyāghra jānāsi tu yathātatham ||37|| mūlaṃ mameti duḥkhasya na mameti ca nirvṛteḥ | matkṛpātaśca te jñānamutpannamidamuttamam ||38|| ādiṣṭaṃ tava mātrā prāṅ smāritaṃ te mayādya vai | ahamametijāḍyaṃ vai kṣiptaṃ yena vivekataḥ ||39|| tasyaiva sarvathā tṛptirbhavatyeva videhinaḥ | gṛhakṣetraputradāradhanadhānyasutādayaḥ ||1.396.40|| sarve mṛṣā mṛṣābuddhyā anityāḥ śāśvatīkṛtāḥ | bhrāntijñānādigarteṣu teṣāmātyantikaṃ kutaḥ ||41 || sādhusatsaṃgahaṃsasthairjanairyairmamatādayaḥ | nikṛntitā gurorvākyaiste gatāḥ paramaṃ padam ||42|| prāpya cātmavanaṃ śuklaṃ nidvandvaṃ roṣavarjitam | mohahīnaṃ nirupādhi vartasva ca sadā sukhī ||43|| na tvaṃ sthūlo na vā sūkṣmo na cāsi kāraṇātmakaḥ | na tanmātrātmakaścāsi nāhaṃkṛtimayo’pyasi ||44|| tasmātparo’si kṣetrajñaḥ saṃghātādguṇasaṃjñitān | śaivālakardamamuñjamatsyamaśakapāthasām ||45|| yathaikatve’pi pārthakyaṃ tathā kṣetrātmanornṛpa | nityaśuddho nityabuddho nityamukto nirañjanaḥ ||46|| ātmā cāsi paro dehād deharājyādviḍambanāt | kṣiteḥ rājyānmamatāyā rājyātpāraṃ gato hyasi ||47|| mumukṣuḥ santyajet saṃgaṃ tannāśe mamatālayaḥ | tena vairāgyabhāvaḥ syād duḥkhadoṣānudarśanāt ||48|| arāge vartate yogī sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ | tadgṛhaṃ yatra vasati tadbhojyaṃ yena jīvati ||49|| aparigraha evāsau jīvanmuktaḥ prakāśate | muktaye tu bhavejjñānamajñānaṃ bandhakṛd bhavet ||1.396.50|| śṛṇvalarka paraṃ mārgaṃ paraṃ padapradaṃ tathā | ṛṣayo bahavo yātā tena mārgeṇa mokṣaṇam ||5 1 || cittavṛttinirodho hi yogo nirvāṇadaḥ sadā | pramāṇaṃ paryayaḥ kalpo nidrā smṛtirhi vṛttayaḥ ||5 2|| satyaṃ jñānaṃ pramāṇotthaṃ mithyājñānaṃ viparyayaḥ | vastuśūnyo vikalpaścāpratyayo nidrikā matā ||53 || anubhūtādisaṃskārajanyaṃ tu smaraṇaṃ matam | vastuyoge tu saṃskārairjanyate hyabhijñānakam ||54|| tadapyatra saṃskārotthāsmṛtireva prakathyate | ityevaṃ vṛttayo bodhyā jñātā ajñātakāśca tāḥ ||55|| tāsāṃ tu sarvathā rodho yoga ityucyate nṛpa | ātmano brahmaṇo yogo yogaḥ śreṣṭhatamo mataḥ ||56 || buddhermālinyanāśāya yogo niyujyate sadā | avidyā cāsmitā rāgo dveṣo bhayaṃ ca pañca te ||57|| kleśā mālinyabhāvāḍhyā tannāśe nirmalaṃ manaḥ | tannāśārthaṃ yamāḥ sādhyā niyamāśca punaḥ punaḥ ||58|| ahiṃsā pālayet prājñaḥ satyaṃ hitakaraṃ vadet | asteyaṃ sarvathā rakṣed brahmacārī bhavettathā ||59|| aparigrahavān yaḥ syātsa vai bandhāt pramucyate | śaucaṃ tu mānasaṃ kuryācchārīraṃ yogyameva ca ||1.396.6 0 || santoṣaṃ vardhayennityaṃ yadṛcchālābhamātrataḥ | tapaścendriyanigrahātmakaṃ kuryād yathāyatham ||6 1 || svādhyāyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmajapātmakam | tanmūrtau ca praṇidhānaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ sadā ||62|| evaṃ vai kurvato nityaṃ mānasaṃ doṣavarjitam | bhavenmukhyau dveṣarāgau doṣau tattyajanaṃ kuru ||63 || āsanaṃ susthiraṃ kuryātsvastikādikamuttamam | gorakṣāsanamevātra brahmacaryaprarakṣakam ||64|| prāṇāyāmān yathāpekṣaṃ kuryād yathābalaṃ sadā | prāṇāyāmairdahed doṣān dhāraṇayā ca vāsanām ||65|| pratyāhāreṇa viṣayān dhyānenānīśvarān guṇān | samādhinā hariṃ prāpyākṣare dhāmni pramodate ||66|| indriyāṇāṃ tu doṣā vai dahyante prāṇanigrahāt | laghurdvādvaśasaṃkhyaśca dviguṇaḥ sa tu madhyamaḥ ||67|| triguṇaścottamaḥ prokto nityaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ | prathamena jayet svedaṃ madhyamena tu vepathum ||68|| viṣādaṃ hi tṛtīyena jayed doṣānanukramāt | doṣān saḥ sādhito hanti khagān sādhitaśyenavat ||69|| cetaso’pakaṣāyatvaṃ prāṇāyāmena jāyate | kāmakrodhādayo doṣā dahyante prāṇarodhavat ||1.396.70 || atītānāgataprajñā jāyate doṣasaṃkṣayāt | saṃvit saṃjāyate cātmabodhinī prāṇasaṃyamāt ||71 || manaḥprasannatāsaumyabhāvitā jāyate tathā | evaṃ sthitau bhavatyāṃ ca pratyāhāramupakramet ||72|| indriyāṇi viṣayebhyaḥ prāṇānmanastathāntaram | nigṛhyāntarvartayecca pratyāhārastadātmakaḥ ||73|| ātmavṛttiḥ sadā paśyedindriyavṛttibhirnijam | ātmānamātmani tena pratyāhāro’pyupakṛtiḥ ||74|| pratyāhārottaraṃ rājan dhāraṇāṃ samupakramet | prāṇāyāmā daśa dvau ca sthitiḥ sādhāraṇātmikī ||75|| dve dhāraṇe bhaved dhyānaṃ pratyayaikaikatānakam | evaṃkṛte harermūrtau naśyanti doṣarāśayaḥ ||76 || vīkṣate ca paraṃbrahma māyāguṇān pṛthakpṛthak | svastho vibhuryathā sarvamātmanyeva prapaśyati ||77|| tathā dhyānī sadā svasthaścātmani sarvamīkṣate | nābhyāṃ hṛdaye kaṇṭhe ca tālau bhāle ca netrayoḥ ||78|| mūrdhni cātmani śrīkṛṣṇe saṃyamaṃ vidadhīta vai | evaṃ vai dhāraṇāṃ kurvan prāpnotyakṣarasāmyatām ||79|| sthānadhraiḥ kṛtasaṃskārādaiśvaryavismayāttathā | sāmarthyaṃ vilayaṃ yāti tasmāttatra nivartayet ||1.396.80 || striyaḥ kīrtirvivijñānaṃ rājyaṃ dravyaṃ samarthatā | devatvaṃ bahuyajñitvaṃ rasāyanaśarīratā ||81 || ākāśajalavahnyādāvapratihatayānatā | ete vighnāḥ prahartavyā manasteṣu na yojayet ||82|| brahmasaṃgi manaḥ kurvannupasargānna hanyate | prātibhaṃ sarvavijñānaṃ śrāvaṇaṃ divyakarṇatā ||83 || cākṣuṣaṃ divyadṛṣṭiśca sarvabhāṣāvabodhitā | dūragrāhitvamevādyāḥ siddhayo vighnamūrtayaḥ ||84|| ābhiśca siddhibhiḥ putra devatā bandhane sthitāḥ | upasargairmahāvighnairāvartante punaḥ punaḥ ||85 || tasmād yogakṛtāvāsaḥ prāvṛtya brahmakambalam | cintayetparamaṃ brahma sa yāyātparamāṃ gatim ||86 || dharitrīṃ vilayed vārdhau layed vārīṇi tejasi | tejo layettu pavane’nilaṃ layettato’mbare ||87|| tān śabde ta tvahaṃkāre taṃ mahatyāṃ pradhānake | mahatīṃ buddhiṃ viṣame vaiṣamyaṃ guṇasāmyake ||88|| guṇatrayaṃ vibhau caikadeśe layet samakṣare | akṣaraṃ brahmarūpaṃ svamātmānaṃ paramātmani ||89 || paraṃ brahmaṇi saṃyuṃjyāt tadvai tasya paraṃ padam | bhūteṣu yasya satkārastasyāsti dhruvabandhanam ||1.396.9 0 || yasmin yasmim̐śca kurute bhūte rāgaṃ jano yadā | tasmim̐stasmin samāsaktiṃ muhuḥ prāpya vinaśyati ||9 1 || punarāvartate rājan bhūtayogo vighātakṛt | bhūteṣu yasya sārvajñyaudāsīnyaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tu tat ||9 2|| aṇimā laghimā caiva mahimā prāptireva ca | prākāmyaṃ ca tatheśitvaṃ vaśitvaṃ ca tathāparam || 93 || evaṃ kāmāvasāyitvaṃ guṇānetām̐stathaiśvarān | muktiprasūcakānprāpya hanyate triguṇairna saḥ ||94|| nirdagdhadoṣastenaikyaṃ prayāti brahmaṇā saha | so’śnute hi sarvān kāmān saha tena vipaścitā ||9 5 || tathātmā sāmyamabhyeti yogīśe paramātmani | sālokyaṃ cāpi sārūpyaṃ sāyujyaṃ nityameva ca ||96 || samaiśvaryādimattvaṃ ca prāpnotyeva kṛpāvaśāt | omityekaṃ paraṃbrahma vadan māṃ ca sadā smaran ||97|| gṛhaṃ jīrṇaṃ parityajya prayāti matpadaṃ nṛpa | madāśrayaṃ sadā prāpto’larka vijñānamāptavān ||98|| madanugrahataste ca doṣānnaṣṭānavehi ca | na tu te bandhanaṃ bhūyād bhūyā nirvāṇabhāk sadā || 99|| ātmanā brahmaṇā nityānandena sukhaśāyinā | parabrahmaṇi sammīlya śāśvatānandavān bhava || 1.396.100 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye’larkarājño dattātreyapradattajñānayogavattayā muktatādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṇṇavatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 396 ||
<1.397> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca evaṃ śubhāśiṣaḥ prāpyālarko brahmasvarūpatām | svātmanyanubhavanprāha bhagavantaṃ guruṃ harim || 1 || bhagavan yoginaścaryāṃ śrotumicchāmi sarvathā | brahmavartmanyanugacchan lakṣyate kairvilakṣaṇaiḥ || 2 || guruḥ prāha śṛṇu kṣmeśa lokacaryāvilakṣaṇāḥ | caryāstasya bhavantyeva nirmaryādā nirāhatāḥ || 3 || mānāpamānau yāvetau prītyudvegakarau nṛṇām | tāveva viparītārthau yoginastu viṣāmṛte || 4 || maunamālambate prāyo harernāma gṛṇan muhuḥ | ātithyayajñayātrādau na gacchennirjanecchukaḥ || 5 || vyaste vidhūme aṃgāre sarvasmin bhuktavajjane | aṭeta devayātrārthaṃ yadṛcchālābhatoṣavān || 6 || yadvā cājagarīṃ vṛttiṃ samāśritya hi vartate | phalaṃ mūlaṃ dalaṃ kandaṃ kaṇā bhājā ca yallabhet || 7 || tatprayuñjyātsureṣvārpya satāṃ vartma na dūṣayan | sārabhūtaṃ yathāpekṣaṃ gṛhṇīyānnādhikaṃ kvacit || 8 || vāgdaṇḍaḥ karmadaṇḍaśca manodaṇḍaśca te trayaḥ | yasya vai niyatāḥ sa syāt tridaṇḍī yogirāṭ paraḥ || 9 || kṛṣṇamūrtau sadā yuñjan yogaṃ kṛṣṇeti saṃjapan | vartate nityamagno’sau sthitiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ samudvahan || 1.397.10 || tārasvareṇa bhagavannāmaraṭanamācaret | tatra yuktastu yogīśo bhagavallayamāpnuyāt || 11 || śaśāṃkaraśmisaṃyogāccandrakāntamaṇiḥ payaḥ | samutsṛjati nāyuktaḥ sopamā yoginaḥ smṛtā || 1 2|| sūryaraśmisaṃprayogātsūryakānto hutāśanam | āviṣkaroti naikākī sopamā yoginaḥ smṛtā || 1 3|| pipīlikākhunakulagṛhagodhākapiñjalāḥ | vasanti svāmivadgehe dhvaste yānti tato’nyataḥ || 14|| duḥkha tu svāmino gehadhvaṃse teṣāṃ yathā na vai | tathā tu yoginā bhāvyaṃ duḥkhānāvṛtakena vai || 15|| valmīkakīṭikā mukhāgreṇa cāpi tvaṇīyasā | karoti valmīkacayaṃ tathā yogaṃ samarjayet || 16|| paśupakṣimanuṣyādyaiḥ patrapuṣpaphalādikam | savṛkṣaṃ lupyate tadvallopyaṃ sarvaṃ tu yoginā ||17|| ruruśāvaviṣāṇāgraṃ vardhamānaṃ vilokya ca | yogī yoge vardhate ca tadā siddhimavāpnuyāt || 18|| tadgṛhaṃ yatra vasati tadbhojyaṃ yena jīvati | yena sampadyate cārthastatsukhaṃ mamatātra kā || 1 9|| bhojye miṣṭaṃ ca vāmiṣṭaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ kṣāraṃ ca vā kaṭu | na yad vedayate yogī jñātvāpi na bhaṇatyapi ||1.397.20|| sa vai jihvāṃ rasaṃ svādṃ jītavānasti sarvathā | komalaṃ kaṭhinaṃ rūkṣaṃ mṛduḥ snigdhaṃ kharaṃ pṛthu ||21 || tīkṣṇaṃ prajvālakaṃ jñātvā cāpi duḥkhaṃ na yojane | so’yaṃ tvacaṃ sukhaṃ sparśaṃ jītavānasti sarvathā ||22|| miṣṭaṃ bhadra svarayuktaṃ gītaṃ cāhlādakaṃ mṛdu | narma hāsyapradaṃ roṣakaraṃ vā mānadaṃ tathā ||23 || jñātvā śabdaṃ na vai tatra sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ hi manyate | sa ca vācaṃ tadarthaṃ ca jītavānasti sarvathā ||24|| sundaraṃ sughaṭaṃ svarṇasamaṃ tejomayaṃ śubham | dhavalaṃ karburaṃ cānyat cikkaṇaṃ tīkṣṇameva vā ||25|| rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ yo na manyeta mānase | jītavān sarvathā rūpaṃ netraṃ dṛśyaṃ sa yogirāṭ ||26 || sugandhaṃ samanuprāpya nāsā naiti vikāsatām | durgandhaṃ samanuprāpya naspuṭaṃ na ca ruddhyate ||27|| sa yogī jītavān gandha nāsikāṃ ca svabhāvataḥ | satyapi kharjane prāpte cāṃcalye vā tvaci kvacit ||28|| naiva spṛśati karṇaṃ ca karotyeva na tvagjayī | padbhyāṃ yāti harerdhāma pradakṣiṇāṃ karoti ca ||29 || tīrthayātrāṃ sādhuyātrāṃ karoti caraṇojjayī | devagurusatāṃ sevāṃ karābhyāṃ prasamācaret ||1.397.3 0|| vāṇyā saṃkīrtanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya cācaret | nṛtyaṃ karoti devāgre kathāṃ karoti sādhuṣu ||3 1 || gītaṃ karoti bhakteṣu dhyānaṃ karoti mūrtiṣu | cintanaṃ vandanaṃ stotraṃ karotyeva parātmani ||32|| namanaṃ hasanaṃ cāhvānakaṃ dikṣu karoti ca | dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ tatra tatra harṣe cāviṣkaroti ca ||33|| kvacid vādṛśyatāṃ yāti kvacid vṛkṣeṣu vartate | kvacijjalapradeśe vā kvacidraṇe’pi vartate ||34|| kvacittu gahvare garte kaṇrakādau kvacitkvacit | kheṭe nagare grāmādau vane’raṇye ca nirjane ||35|| manasā kalpite deśe bhūtale’bbhratale’pi vā | vasatyeva yathāceṣṭaṃ yathāsaṃkalpameva ca ||36|| mukhe kvacicchilākhaṇḍaṃ dhṛtvā khādati ravādyavat | kajjalaṃ kardamaṃ vāpi dhūlīṃ kṣipati gātrake ||37|| candanaṃ śītalaṃ matvā jihīrṣati muhurmuhuḥ | agamyaṃ dūradeśasthaṃ vastu hastena dhāryate ||38|| anyadeśe jāyamānaṃ vṛttāntaṃ janasaṃsadi | varṇayatyeva ca yathāyathaṃ kvacit satīśavat ||39|| kvacit svapiti mārgeṣu kvacijjaneṣu kūrdati | paśuṣvapi vinā cintāṃ bhayaṃ nidrāti mattavat ||1.397.40|| dhūlīdhūsaritāṃgaśca modate manasā kvacit | digambaraḥ kvacid yāti kvacitparṇāmbaro’pi vā ||41 || kvacid vṛkṣatvagambaraḥ kvacid bhasmāmbaro’pi vai | kvacidvṛṣṭipradhārāsu kvacidātapavahniṣu ||42|| kvacicchaityādisalile kardame tiṣṭhati kvacit | kvacinmalādiliptāṃgaḥ kvacitsvacchaśarīrakaḥ ||43|| kvacinmūtrādidurgandhaḥ ṣṭhīvanādiṣu nirghṛṇaḥ | nāsikālālasaṃlagno dehakṣālanavarjitaḥ ||44|| ātmārāmo yathā brahmasvarūpo divyavigrahaḥ | nirāvaraṇasañcāro naranārīvibhānakaḥ ||45|| paśupakṣitṛṇavallīkaṇṭakādiṣu nirbhayaḥ | harerbhānena yukto’pi dehabhānādivarjitaḥ ||46|| avismartavyamevātrātyaktavyaṃ cāpi yadbhavet | na tyajati nāpi vismaratyavadhānavānapi ||47|| vartate bālavadvāpi vṛddhavacca kadācana | kadāpi vartate kākabakamārjāraghūkavat ||48|| kvacit sa vartate premṇi mayūraśukahaṃsavat | kvacinmādhukarīṃ vṛttiṃ kvacid vṛttiṃ tu vānarīm ||49|| kvacit saiṃhīṃ kvacid dīnāṃ kvacicchyenasamāṃ tathā | kvacinmatsyasamāṃ vṛttiṃ samādāya hi vartate ||1.397.50|| śrīharau cittayuktatvaṃ cānyatra cittavarjitam | ahnāṃ nirgamanaṃ tasya bhavati brahmayoginaḥ ||51 || kvacinmānasapūjāyāṃ hariṃ bhojayati dhruvaḥ | jalaṃ datvā namaḥ kṛtvā visarjayati ceṣṭayā ||52| kvacid dhūlyāṃ tu paryaṃkaṃ kṛtvā sthāpayati prabhum | patraṃ puṣpaṃ dalaṃ parṇaṃ phalaṃ vā kaṃkaraṃ tṛṇam ||53|| tulasīṃ kamalaṃ datvā hariṃ raṃjayati kvacit | evaṃ yogijanasyaiva ceṣṭā niyantraṇāṃ vinā ||54|| divyā divyasvarūpā ca divyagatipravartikā | divyatattvamayī sarvā paraśreyaḥpradāyinī ||55|| bhavatyeva sadālarka yogī jānāti yoginam | sanakādyāḥ ṛṣabhādyāḥ śukādyāśca tathābhavan ||56|| siddhā nāthāstīrthakarā haṃsā aghoravartanāḥ | sādhavo yoginaścānye jaḍāśca bhairavādayaḥ ||57|| śaṃkaro yoginīcakraṃ cāvadhūtāstathāpare | satyaḥ sādhvyastathā dāsyo vaiṣṇavyaśca samādhigāḥ |||58|| prāpurvai brahmaparamaṃ lokavilakṣaṇakriyāḥ | kimbahunātra vācā vai yogī yogena darpitaḥ ||59|| nānyat kiṃcidvijānāti brahmabhinnaṃ hṛdantare | yasya sarvatra cātmāsti yasmin sarvātmano gṛham ||1.397.6 0|| sūtre maṇirmaṇau sūtraṃ tathā yaḥ sthitimāptavān | paripūrṇatamānandaṃ prāptavān tanmadānvitaḥ ||6 1 || tasya yoginaḥ sāmyaṃ ko vimarśayitumarhati | ceṣṭayā vartate vyagro buddhyā viśārado yathā ||62|| vācā tu vartate sādhurvṛttyā
