| pāvakāya prasannāya smṛddhidāya ca te namaḥ ||62|| śrīśāya śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya bhūdharāya ca | lakṣmīśāya prabheśāya māṇikīśāya te namaḥ ||6 3 || pārvatīśāya gopālabālakāya ca te namaḥ | kaṃbharāṃkaprajātāya sarvajñāya ca te namaḥ ||64|| cakrapadmādicihnāya pumuttamāya te namaḥ | kṣīrasāgaravāsāya śrīlakṣmīsevitāya ca ||65|| abhīṣṭasukhadātre te yajñavārāharūpiṇe | namaste kamalākāntapadmākāntāya te namaḥ ||66 || padminīpataye bhaktadāridryanāśakāya te | sādhurūpāya te kṛṣṇa bhūyo bhūyo namo namaḥ ||67|| iti śrutvā hariḥ prāha tuṣṭo’smi brāhmaṇottama | sarvabhogasamāyukto dehānte muktimāpnuhi ||68|| evaṃ varaṃ pradāyaiva tatraivāntaradhīyata | pāpanāśanatīrthe sa dvijaḥ snātvā gṛhaṃ yayau ||69|| śreṣṭhī svarṇadhanadhānyasmṛddhimānabhavat tataḥ | pṛthvīdānapratāpena mahendra iva cāparaḥ ||1.403.70 || athāparaṃ mahattīrthaṃ vartate mokṣadaṃ nṛṇām | ākāśagaṃgāvikhyātaṃ tanmāhātmyaṃ vadāmi te ||71 || rāmānujo dvijaḥ kaścid viṣṇudhyānaparāyaṇaḥ | tapastepe sa paṃcāgnimadhyastho’ṣṭākṣaraṃ japan ||72|| vṛṣṭau jale sthitaścāpi dvandvasparśavivarjitaḥ | jīrṇaparṇāśano jalāhāro vāyvadanaściram ||73 || tasthau tapasi śraddhālustuṣṭo’sya bhaktavatsalaḥ | prakṣyatāmagāttatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||74|| svarṇabhūṣāñcitadeho ramārādhādisevitaḥ | viśvaksenasunandādyaiḥ sahitaḥ śrīrameśvaraḥ ||75|| nāradādiyutaścāpi pītāmbaradharaḥ prabhuḥ | sanakādimahāyogisevitadvayapārśvakaḥ ||76 || veṃkaṭeśaṃ dayāluṃ taṃ tuṣṭāva tāpaso dvijaḥ | namo rāmāya cakrādidhāriṇe mahate namaḥ ||77|| nityaśuddhasvarūpāya namo bhaktārtihāriṇe | paravyūhavibhavāyārcādirūpāya te namaḥ ||78|| antaryāmisvarūpātmavyāpine te namo namaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇāya mahābhūmne nārāyaṇāya te namaḥ ||79|| namo hiraṇyagarbhāya vairājāya ca vedhase | sadāśivāya kāntāya viṣṇave brahmaṇe namaḥ ||1.403.80 || īśvareśāyeśvarāya puṣpavannetriṇe namaḥ | nāmajātyādipārāya nāmajātyādirūpiṇe ||8 1 || kāṃbhareyāya kṛṣṇāya gopīmaṇḍalarāsine | gopālajāya gosevāsnigdhāya te namo namaḥ ||82|| vedāntanyāyavedyāya bhāṣyāya bhāṣyakāriṇe | āgamāntaḥsugataye lokarakṣāya te namaḥ ||83 || saurāṣṭrāviḥsvarūpāya raivatācalavāsine | aśvapaṭṭakṣitīśāya puṣkarāraṇyaśāline ||84|| kāśeśvarāya raṃgādipūjitāya ca te namaḥ | iti stutvā śrīnivāsaṃ rāmānuja iyāya śam ||85|| veṃkaṭeśaḥ samāliṃgya rāmānujamuvāca ha | stotreṇa tapasā tuṣṭo varaṃ vṛṇotu satvaram ||86 || rāmānujastadā prāha śrīnivāsa hare prabho | tvaddarśanāt kṛtārtho’smi kiṃ me’dya darśanāt param ||87|| devāḥ pitaro munayo naiṣṭhikāḥ karmaṭhāśca yam | yogino jñānakuśalāḥ na paśyanti vidanti na ||88|| vedmi paśyāmi taṃ cādya kimasmādadhikaṃ nu me | etena tu kṛtārtho’smi muktibījena sarvathā ||89|| tvatpādapadmayugale niścalā bhaktirastu me | ityāśrutya hariḥ prāha mayi bhaktirdṛḍhāstu te ||1.403.90 || atra te tapasaḥ sthāne samāgatya tu ye janāḥ | snāsyantyākāśagaṃgāyāṃ yāsyanti dhāma me param ||91 || tvaṃ ca prārabdhadehānte matsvarūpamavāpsyasi | viyadgaṃgāsnātakāstu sarve bhāgavatottamāḥ ||92 || lakṣma bhāgavatānāṃ tvaṃ śṛṇu bhāgavatottama | bhagavanmayacaryā ye karmaṇā manasā girā |||93 || sarvakāryāṇi kṛṣṇārthe kurvantaḥ kṛṣṇacintakāḥ | jñānino niḥspṛhāḥ śāntāste vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 94|| sarveṣu kṛṣṇadraṣṭāraḥ kṛṣṇasya satkathādarāḥ | kṛṣṇapādāmbujabhaktā ye te bhāgavatottamāḥ ||95|| mātāpitroḥ kṛṣṇatanvoḥ śuśrūṣādiparāyaṇāḥ | devārcanaprapūjādiparāmodabharāśca ye ||96 || sādhusevāparāścāpi sādhvīmānapradāśca ye | pareśavṛttayo ye te mahābhāgavatottamāḥ ||97|| ātmavatsarvabhūtānāṃ dṛgvadbhāgavatottamāḥ | śāstrajñā dharmadhartāraḥ satyavācaḥ saduttamāḥ ||98|| kṛṣṇakathāratāḥ kathāvaktari snehabhāvanāḥ | tīrthapriyāḥ kāmadhenusevakā vai saduttamāḥ ||99 || anyodaye prasannāśca kṛṣṇanāmaparāyaṇāḥ | kṛṣṇārthaṃ jalakhātāro ye te bhāgavatottamāḥ || 1.403.100 || devālayaprakartāro devagāyatrikājapāḥ | bhaktiharṣā harau magnā ye te bhāgavatottamāḥ || 1 01 || tulasīpūjakā vṛndāṃ namanti tulasīkarāḥ | tulasīmālikādhrāśca tulasīcandanāñcitāḥ || 102 || tulasīmṛttikādehāste vai bhāgavatottamāḥ | vedādiṣu hareḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśakāḥ || 103 || ātithyādau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaiva sucintakāḥ | jñātatattveṣu vai brahmabodhakāḥ sādhuvṛttayaḥ || 1 04|| sarvaguṇādisadgrāhāste vai bhāgavatottamāḥ | ekādaśyādivratinaḥ kṛṣṇārthakarmakāriṇaḥ || 1 05|| rādhāṃ lakṣmīṃ ramāṃ śrīṃ pārvatīṃ prabhāṃ ca māṇikīm | mamāṃśāṃ yoṣitaṃ dṛṣṭvā namanti vaiṣṇavīṃ tu ye || 106 | | matsvarūpāṃ mayādhiṣṭhitāṃ paśyanti hṛdā sadā | bāle ca bālikāyāṃ ca te vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 1 07|| tathā nṛṣu prapaśyanti yāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ māṃ narāyaṇam | tā vai satyo mahābhāgavatyaḥ proktā mayānagha || 1 08|| narāḥ sarve kṛṣṇarūpā nāryo rādhāramātmikāḥ | iti bhāgavatajñānā ye te bhāgavatottamāḥ || 1 09|| saṃkṣepāttu kathayāmi madarthaṃ sarvathā sthitāḥ | narā nāryaḥ paśavo’pi sarve bhāgavatottamāḥ || 1.403.110 || rāmānuja tvamevāsi tathā bhāgavatottamaḥ | prasanno’smi tvayi dhrauvyabhaktisthiteḥ sadā priya || 111 || tīrthamākāśagaṃgākhyaṃ tārakaṃ bhavapārakṛt | snātṝṇāṃ mokṣadaṃ cāsti bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 11 2|| ityuktvāntardadhe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhustadā | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhaktimokṣaśca hastagaḥ | | 113 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye bhagavatpātivratyapālakānāṃ sumatibhadramatirāmānujānāṃ tīrthottame mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā tryadhikacatuḥśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||40 3 ||
<1.404> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi dānapātraṃ sattīrthaṃ kathayāmi te | nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃ tīrthaṃ deyamasmai tu śārṅgiṇe || 1 || sādhave dharmaśīlāya vidyājuṣe mahātmane | tyāgine brahmavetre ca dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam || 2 || sādhvyai bhogaprasaktāyai harikṛṣṇasya yoṣite | nārāyaṇyai mahālakṣmyai dattaṃ bhavati śāśvatam || 3 || satkarmaniratāyai ca sevikāyai harestathā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnyai satyai dattaṃ tu śāśvatam || 4 || anāthāyai ca bhaktāyai yoginyai dattamakṣayam | bhaktāya brahmarūpāya brahmaṇe vedavedine || 5 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtirūpāya deśikāya ca | viprāya devaśiṣyāya tathā satkarmakāriṇe || 6 || anapekṣitaśāntāya dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam | gave bālāya kanyāyai pitṛbhyāṃ dattamakṣayam || 7 || patnyai svasre duhitre ca dauhitrāya sukarmiṃṇe | svasṛputrāya śiṣyāya dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam || 8 || gurave gurupatnyai ca guruputrāya vedine | dharmapracārakartre ca datta bhavati cākṣayam || 9 || vyākhyātre jñānadātre ca śāstriṇe viduṣe tathā | vidyādhikāriṇe vidyāpātre dattaṃ hi cākṣayam |1.404.1 0|| vṛttiśūnyāya vai deyaṃ daridrāya kuṭumbine | devasya pūjakāyāpi paropakārakāriṇe ||1 1 || adhyāpakāya dātavyaṃ dātavyaṃ deśa hetave | abhyudayārthamevāpi dātavyaṃ rakṣakāya ca || 1 2|| nārāyaṇasya sāmīpye dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam | vaiṣṇavāya pradātavyaṃ yena tuṣṭo bhavāmi vai || 13 || daṃbhācārāya caurāya vidviṣe nindakāya ca | paradravyaparadārapare dattaṃ tu niṣphalam || 14|| kṛtaghnasya ca mūrkhasyāsūyāviṣṭahṛdastathā | hiṃsakasya vikrayiṇo dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam || 15 || paropatāpakartuśca nāstikasya jaḍasya ca | khalasya chaladharmasya maryādābhedakasya ca || 16 || pākhaṇḍinaḥ kitavasya śaṭhasyādharmavartinaḥ | vivāḍhaśālinaścaṇḍarūpasyāpi tu niṣphalam || 17|| tīrthe cakrapuṣkariṇītīre deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ | dāne puṇyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ cakratīrthamanuttamam || 18|| purā śrīvatsagotrīyaḥ padmanābho dvijarṣabhaḥ | cakrapuṣkariṇītīre tapo’tapyata dāruṇam || 1 9|| varṣāṇi katicitso’yaṃ jīrṇaparṇāśano’bhavat | kaṃcitkālaṃ jalāhāro vāyvāhāraḥ kiyatsamāḥ ||1.404.20|| evaṃ vai dvādaśe varṣe tuṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | pratyakṣatāmagāttasya śrīrādhākamalāpatiḥ || 21 || dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ stotuṃ samupacakrame | gopālakṛṣṇarūpāya kāṃbhareyāya viṣṇave ||22|| namaḥ śeṣādrivāsāya veṃkaṭeśāya te namaḥ | nārāyaṇādrivāsāya śrīnivāsāya te namaḥ ||23 || bhaktipriyāya lakṣmīśapadminīśāya te namaḥ | iti stuto ghanaśyāmaḥ śrīnivāsastutoṣa ha ||24|| padmanābhaṃ dvijaṃ cāha cakratīrthe’tra sarvadā | ākalpaṃ pūjayam̐stvaṃ māṃ vasa bhaktottama priya ||25|| ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇastatraivāntaradhīyata | padmanābho’vasat tatra kadācittaṃ tu bhakṣitum ||26 || rākṣasaścāgatastatra jagrāha brāhmaṇaṃ tadā | pracukrośa cakrapāṇe rakṣa rakṣeti vai muhuḥ ||27|| veṃkaṭeśa hare kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho | kāṃbhareya kṛpānātha rakṣa māṃ rakṣasā dhṛtam ||28|| iti stuvatastasyaiva rakṣārthaṃ cakradhārakaḥ | svacakraṃ preṣayāmāsa cakrapuṣkariṇītaṭam |||29|| sudarśanaṃ mahājvālaṃ dṛṣṭvā rakṣaḥ pradudruve | tasya śiraścakartedama viprastuṣṭāva cakrakam || 1.404.30 || viṣṇoścakra namaste’stu bhaktarakṣaṇadīkṣita | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇahastapadmabhūṣaṇa te namaḥ || 31 || sarvadātra pratiṣṭha tvaṃ rakṣakaṃ bhava matkṛte | nārāyaṇasvarūpāya mokṣadāya namo namaḥ ||3 2 || ityarthitaṃ padmanābhabhaktaṃ prāha sudarśanam | cakratīrthaṃ mama nāmnā bodhyaṃ bhakta tvayā kṛtam || 33 || cakratīrthe satataṃ saṃvasāmi tava vāñcchayā | itaḥ paraṃ janānāṃ na pīḍā syād rākṣasādijā || 34|| snātāro’tra dhūtapāpā yāsyanti śrīhareḥ padam | ityuktvā tāṃ cakrapuṣkariṇīṃ prāviśadujjvalam || 35|| ityevaṃ muktidaṃ bhaktapātivratyaprabhāvataḥ | tīrthaṃ cakrāśritaṃ jātaṃ lakṣmi pāpavināśanam || 36 | | śṛṇu yathābhavat so’pi rākṣaso yo mṛto’dhunā | purā śrīraṃgapuryāṃ vai vaśiṣṭhādyāstu vaiṣṇavāḥ ||37 || upāsāñcakrire śrīraṃganāthaṃ muktikāṃkṣayā | kadācit tatra gandharvaḥ sundarākhyaḥ samāyayau || 38 || salile yuvatībhirvivastrābhiḥ snānamācarat | krīḍāṃ cakāra vividhāṃ vaśiṣṭhastāvadeva hi || 39 || snātuṃ gato dadarśainaṃ nagnaṃ śaśāpa nistrapam | māṃ dṛṣṭvāpi na vai vāso dhatse tasmāddhi sundara ||1.404.40 || yāhi rākṣasatāṃ sadyastato’sau rākṣaso’bhavat | yuvatyaḥ śrīvaśiṣṭhaṃ sanatvā kṣamāṃ yayācire || 41 || dayāsindho vilokyāsmān kopaṃ mā kartumarhasi | patireva hi nārīṇāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ paramaṃ matam ||42 || patihīnā tu yā nārī śataputrāpi no śubhā | vidhavetyamaṃgalā sā tato janma nirarthakam ||43 || eko’parādhaḥ kṣantavyaḥ prasīdāsmatpriye prabho | evaṃ stuto vaśiṣṭhastāḥ prāha śāpo na me’phalaḥ ||44|| ṣoḍaśābdāvadhau rakṣaḥ paścād gandharvatāṃ vrajet | cakratīrthe padmanābhaviprayoge vimokṣyati ||45|| sudarśanena cakreṇa muktirasya bhaviṣyati | patirvastridivaṃ bhūyo ramayiṣyati sundaraḥ ||46 || ityuktvā sa vaśiṣṭho vai yayau śrīraṃgamandiram | sundaro rākṣaso jāto mahādaṃṣṭro bhayānakaḥ || 47|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayasaṃvignā jagmū rāmāstriviṣṭapam | bhramato rakṣasaścādrau ṣoḍaśābdāni niryayuḥ ||48 || tato brāhmaṇayogena sudarśanena mocitaḥ | sundaraḥ sundaro jāto vimānena divaṃ yayau ||49 || cakraṃ tatroṣitaṃ śaśvaccakratīrthamato’bhavat | yacchrutvā pāpajālānāṃ nāśo bhavati vai dhruvam ||1.404.50 | | jābālitīrthamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi vadāmi te | durācārābhidho vipraḥ kaverītīravāsakṛt ||51 | | sadābhūta pāpisaṃsargī naṣṭabrāhmaṇyasatkriyaḥ | grasto’bhavadbhīṣaṇena vetālena balīyasā ||52 | | bahukālottaraṃ so’yaṃ bhraman veṃkaṭaparvatam | nyamajjat tu jale tāvad vetālena vimocitaḥ ||53 | | yatra jale’bhavanmuktastatra jābāliko muniḥ | avasat tanmahattīrthaṃ jābālitīrthamucyate ||54 | | vetālo’pyabhavat pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇo nāstiko mahān | nindako devasādhūnāṃ tena vetālatāṃ gataḥ ||55 || so’pi tīrthaprabhāveṇa punarmānuṣyameṣyati | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi jābālitīrthamuttamam |||56 | | tumburutīrthamatrāpi kathayāmi śṛṇu priye | pāpino manujāḥ sarve hyamāsu snānti vai muhuḥ |||57 || visṛjya pāpajālāni pūtā bhavanti te janāḥ | asmākaṃ pāpajālāni kathaṃ naśyanti sarvataḥ ||58 || evamālocya tīrthāni gatāni veṃkaṭācalam | tatra svāmipuṣkariṇījale sasnuśca tumburau ||59 | | tīrthe sasnuruttarāphālgunyāṃ śukle tu parvaṇi | teṣāṃ pāpāni naṣṭāni yayustāni yathālayam ||1.404.6 0 || mahāpāparataṃ krūraṃ dānahīnaṃ kulāntakam | paśughnaṃ drohakartāraṃ piśunaṃ cānṛtaṃ janam ||6 1 || mitradruhaṃ kṛtaghnaṃ ca bhrūṇahaṃ paradāragam | parārthasūcakaṃ svāmidrohaṃ devaparāṅmukham ||62 || śaṭhaṃ ca vañcakaṃ dharmavighnaṃ kulavibhedakam | supallavaphalopetavṛkṣodyānavināśakam ||63 || agnidaṃ garadaṃ cāpi pāpaṃ viśvāsaghātakam | gurudveṣakaraṃ duṣṭaṃ dampatyorvirasāvaham ||64|| etānsarvāṃśca vai lakṣmi tumburutīrthamuttamam | punāti snānapānādyaiḥ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ dadāti ca ||65|| tumbururnāmagandharvo bhāryāmuvāca vai purā | māghatraye mayā sākaṃ snānaṃ kuru malāpaham ||66 || māghamāsyudite sūrye gomayālepanaṃ kuru | raṃgavallyādibhiḥ śubhrapadmadhātukasvastikaiḥ ||67|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapūjāsthalaṃ śuddhaṃ kuru priye | dīpaṃ kuru ghṛtavarttiprakāśitaṃ sugandhakam ||68|| dehi pākaṃ śucirbhūtvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya ca | pradakṣiṇānamaskārairmayā saha prasevaya ||69 || devasevāṃ kuru nityaṃ kathāśravaṇamācara | nityaṃ kṛṣṇaprasādānnajalaṃ gṛhāṇa vaiṣṇavi ||1.404.70|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo kāmbhareya janārdana | gopālakṛṣṇagovinda ramārādhāpate prabho ||71 || śrīlakṣmīpārvatīnātha māṇikośa prabhāpate | antaryāmin muktidātṛ ceti kīrtaya sarvadā ||72|| krodhamātsaryalobhādīṃstyaktvā vrata samācara | tenaiva jāyate muktirviṣṇuloko hyavāpyate ||73 || iti bharturvacaḥ śrutvā krodhaṃ kṛtvā tu bhāminī | pratyuvāca tadā kāntaṃ śītapīḍāmaye khalu ||74|| prāṇahāriṇi māghe vai kiṃ snānaṃ te’tisammatam | na karomi pate snānaṃ mriye ced rakṣako’tra me ||75 || dharmastāvajjanaiḥ kāryo yāvacchakyo bhavenmṛduḥ | duḥkhado nāśakṛddharmo na kāryo na karomi tam ||76|| na ca karmāṇi viṣṇvarthaṃ śakyāni ca prage mayā | tumbururityuktavatīṃ śaśāpāpriyavādinīm ||77|| veṃkaṭādrau ghoṇatīrthe pippaladrumakoṭare | tatrāmburahite mūḍhe maṇḍūkī bhava kevalā ||78|| śrutvā sāprārthayat kāntaṃ viśāpamavadat patiḥ | kadācinmunibhiḥ sārdhamagastyaste samīpataḥ ||79|| sthitvā ghoṇasya māhātmyaṃ kathayiṣyati vai tadā | śrutvā tvaṃ dūrato maṇḍūkīdehādvai vimokṣyase ||1.404.80 || punarāgatya me sthānaṃ mayā sākaṃ ramiṣyasi | ityuktvā virarāmātha dharmapatnī pativratā ||81 || bhartṛśāpānmahāghorāṃ maṇḍūkatanumāśritā | bahuvarṣe gate kāle’gastyastatra samāyayau ||82|| svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ snātvā natvā varāhamīśvaram | veṃkaṭeśaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ dṛṣṭvā pippalasannidhau ||83 || āgatya ghoṇatīrthasya māhātmyamavadajjanān | maṇḍūkī sā tadā muktā pūrvarūpavatī babhau ||84|| uvāca māṃ dayayā rakṣa pativākyavirodhinīm | patiśāpena maṇḍūkī jātāhaṃ mocitā tvayā ||85 || agastyastāṃ tadā prāha pātivratyavṛṣān śṛṇu | tava bhartā sudharmajñastvāṃ śaśāpa ṛtaṃ hi tat ||86|| pativākyavirodhinyāṃ śāpo yukto hi sarvathā | pativākyamanādṛtya yatheṣṭaṃ vartate tu yā ||87|| sā patnī narake kaṣṭe patatyākalpameva yat | nāryā vākyaṃ svapatyurvai nollaṃghyaṃ hi kadācana ||88|| pātivratyena puṇyena patiśuśrūṣaṇena ca | striyo viṣṇupadaṃ yānti na cānyairapi suvrataiḥ ||89|| patirmātā patirviṣṇuḥ patirbrahmā patiḥ śivaḥ | patirguruḥ patistīrthaṃ patirmokṣaḥ paro mataḥ || 1.404.90 || pativākyamapākṛtya yā tu sukṛtakāriṇī | na sā phalamavāpnoti naiva śuddhā bhavettathā || 91|| gurvājñāvartamānāpi patyājñāṃ na karoti cet | naiva pūtā navā puṇyā bhavata sā kadācana || 92|| patyājñayā vidadhyāt sā vrataṃ dharmādikaṃ tathā | patibuddhyā prakuryācca hareḥ sevādikaṃ sadā || 93 || patipādābjatīrthena yā snātā sā haripriyā | sā snātā sarvatīrtheṣu gaṃgādiṣu na saṃśayaḥ || 94|| tvayā bhuktaṃ phalaṃ duḥkhaṃ punarjātāsi pūrvavat | gaccha tvaṃ tumburorvāsaṃ sukhinī bhava sarvathā ||95|| tumburutīrthamevaitat tena yātaṃ prasiddhatām | atra snānti paurṇamāsyāṃ te yajñaphalabhāginaḥ || 96 || dine dine kapilāgosahasradānajaṃ phalam | dine dine ratnakoṭisahasradānajaṃ phalam || 97|| dine hastisahasradānasyāśvāyutadānajam | phalaṃ vai prāpyate subhru ghoṇatīrthāvagāhanāt || 98|| kanyākoṭipradānasya phalaṃ ghoṇāvagāhanāt | kurukṣetre suvarṇānāṃ sahasrasya pradānajam || 99|| yatphalaṃ tadāvāpnoti tumburutīrthagāhanāt | gurvarthe ca satāmarthe svāmyarthe yastyajettanum || 1.404.10 0|| pativratārthaṃ sādhvyarthaṃ haryarthaṃ yastyajet tanum | tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ghoṇatīrthāvagāhanāt || 101 || āpannārtiharāṇāṃ ca tīrthasevāparātmanām | satyavratānāṃ yatpuṇyaṃ ghoṇatīrthāddhi yadbhavet | | 10 2|| gaṃgāyāṃ narmadāyāṃ ca sarayūcandrabhāgayoḥ | svarṇavatyāṃ yamunāyāṃ yatphalaṃ tadbhavediha || 1 03|| iti śrutvā jalaṃ pītvā yayau sā tumburugṛham | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi tumburutīrthamuttamam || 1 04|| yacchrutvāpi jano yāyād vājapeyaphalaṃ mahat | viṣṇulokaṃ paraṃ svargaṃ tathā vai śāśvataṃ padam || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye dānapātraṃ, cakratīrthe jābālitīrthe ca pativratāmāhātmyaṃ, tīrthabalaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikacatuḥśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 404 ||
<1.405> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi veṃkaṭādrau mukhyatīrthāni ṣaṭ tathā | svāmipuṣkariṇī caiva viyadgaṃgā tato’dhikā || 1 || pāpavināśanaṃ cāpi pāṇḍutīrthaṃ taduttamam | kumāradhārikātīrthaṃ tumburutīrthamityapi || 2 || kuṃbhalagne paurṇamāsyāṃ maghāyogo yadā bhavet | kumāradhārikāṃ yānti tīrthāni sarvato diśaḥ || 3 || rājasūyaphalaṃ snānānmuktirviṣṇoḥ pade bhavet | annadānaṃ pradātavyaṃ śāśvataṃ phalamāpyate || 4 || uttarāphālgunīyuktadhāvalyadalaparvasu | mīnasūrye tu tīrthāni tumburuṃ yānti sarvataḥ || 5 || aparāhṇe snānamātrātpunarjanma na vidyate | yajñopavītakaṃ brahmavrataṃ vivāhalagnakam || 6 || dravyaṃ datvā kārayed yastasya puṇyamanantakam | meṣasūrye ca citrāyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ hi sarvataḥ || 7 || samāyānti viyadgaṃgāṃ tīrthāni pāvanāni vai | tatra snātvā śatakratupuṇyaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 8 || svarṇadānaṃ cānnadānaṃ kanyādānaṃ viśeṣataḥ | pradātavyaṃ paraṃ svargamicchatā gṛhamicchatā || 9 || dvādaśyāṃ vṛṣabhārke ca vratādau harivāsare | bhaumayukte pāṇḍutīrthaṃ gaṃgāyāṃ yānti sarvataḥ || 1.405.10 || snātvā ca gāṃ dogdhrīṃ datvā mucyate pāpakoṭibhiḥ | aśvinyarke śuklapakṣe saptamyāṃ sūryavāsare || 11 || uttarāṣāḍhayuksūrye tūttarābhādraśālini | dvādaśīdivase cāpi tīrthaṃ pāpavināśanam || 12|| śālagrāmaśilādānaṃ kṛtvā snātvā pramucyate | dhanurmāse site dvādaśikāyāmaruṇodaye | | 13 || svāmipuṣkariṇītīrthe tīrthānyāyānti sarvataḥ | yasya janmasahasreṣu puṇyamevārjitaṃ bhavet || 14|| tasya snānaṃ bhavet tatra nānyasyāsukṛtasya vai | yathāśaktipradātavyaṃ dānaṃ snātvā vimucyate | | 15 || śālagrāmaṃ kāmadhenuṃ dadyāt tatra viśeṣataḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā dānaṃ samācaret || 16 | | saurāṣṭre’syāḥ pradānena golokaṃ cāpnuyād dhruvam | dakṣiṇe’syāḥ pradānena vairājasthānamāpnuyāt || 17 || prāgjyotiṣi pradānena sūryalokamavāpnuyāt | jālaṃdhare pradānena vāruṇaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 18 || uttarakuruṣvasyāstu dānena brahmatāṃ vrajet | saptadvīpeṣu dānena saptadvīpapatirbhavet || 19 || ye śṛṇvanti kathāṃ viṣṇoḥ sadā bhuvanapāvanīm | jīvanmuktāstu te bhaktā mahābhāgavatā matāḥ || 1.405.2 0 || muhūrtaṃ vā tadarthaṃ vā kṣaṇaṃ vā veṃkaṭācale | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā adhyāyameva vā || 21 | | yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā mokṣaṃ śāśvatamāpnuyāt | yatphalaṃ sarvayajñeṣu sarvadāneṣu yatphalam || 22 | | sakṛt saṃhitāśravaṇāt tatphalaṃ vindate janaḥ | saṃhitāśravaṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya kīrtanam || 23 | | ubhe tveva manuṣyāṇāṃ kalpadrupuṇyadāyake | amṛtapānakṛlloke syādekaścājarāmaraḥ || 24| | kṛṣṇakathāmṛtapānāt kulaṃ syādajarāmaram | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ vasāmi vaktari sadā || 25 | | madrūpaṃ vācakaṃ vidyānmanyūrti bodhadāyinīm | vaktāhaṃ bhagavān sākṣāt śrotrī lakṣmīrmama priyā || 26 | | iti matvārcayennityaṃ śrotāraṃ vācakaṃ tathā | matpraveśaṃ vinā kaḥ syācchaktaḥ śrotā ca vācakaḥ || 27 || śrotuṃ vaktuṃ ca vā lakṣmi divyākhyānāntaraṃgakam | yatreyaṃ saṃhitā lakṣmi tatra divyasvarūpavān || 28 | | avaśyamupatiṣṭhāmi rādhālakṣmyādisaṃvṛtaḥ | pārṣadaiśca samāyuktaḥ kathāpātrairyutastadā || 29 || divyadṛśaḥ prapaśyanti na tu carmadṛśo janāḥ | kathāyāṃ vidyamānāyāṃ prāṇām̐styajanti tānaham || 1.405.30 || nayāmi divyayānena vaikuṇṭhaṃ cākṣaraṃ tathā | golokaṃ cāmṛtaṃ dhāma yathā bhaktasya vāñchitam || 31 || bālo yuvāthavā vṛddho daridro durbhago’pi vā | kathāvaktā sadā pūjyaḥ paramātmasvarūpakaḥ | | 32 | | saṃhitājñe kṣudrabuddhiṃ na kurvīta kadācana | yasyānanodbhavā vāṇī mokṣadā svargadā nṛṇām || 33 || anantajanmakṣetrepu bhūtvā bhūtvātinaśyatām | samarpayati jīvebhyo’bhayadānaṃ kathāvratī ||34|| vyāso jñānaprado vyāsāsanasthāt kaḥ paro guruḥ | āsamāpteḥ kathāyāśca na namet kasyacit guruḥ |||35|| rājā samrāṭ cakravartī mahācāryo’pi deśikaḥ | devo vā sarva evaite nimnā vyāsātprakīrtitāḥ ||36 || eteṣāmāsanād vyāsāsana tuṅga sadā matam | eteṣāmāgame vyāso nottiṣṭhet svāsanāt kvacit ||37|| devālaye catuṣkādau pañcaśravaṇabhūsthale | gṛhe tīrthe śubhe kṣetre tīrthe puṇyakathāṃ vadet ||38|| śraddhālavo bhaktimanto vāgyatāḥ sthiramānasāḥ | avyagrāścāstikā dāntāḥ śrotāraḥ puṇyabhājanāḥ ||39|| kathāṃ kathāpravaktāraṃ sāmagrībhiḥ prapūjayet | teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ śaśvallakṣmīśrīdhīpradaṃ bhavet ||1.405.40|| apradāya tu ye lobhākṛṣṭāḥ śṛṇvanti saṃhitām | teṣāṃ puṇyaṃ phalaṃ na syād dāridryaṃ syājjanau janau ||41 || kathāyāṃ vighnakartāro vāvadūkā viḍambakāḥ | anyagāthāprakartāro bālakrīḍādibuddhayaḥ ||42|| kathādhyānapravikṣepakartāraḥ śrutibhaṃjakāḥ | teṣāṃ bhogā vinaśyanti dārā dhanāni sampad || 43 || ye ca tuṃgāsanārūḍhā tathā vīrāsanasthitā | sihāsanasthitāḥ pādopari pādaniyojakāḥ ||44|| śrotāraste tu jāyante vāyasāḥ pādapāstathā | apraṇamya ca śrotāro jāyante viṣapādapāḥ ||45|| śayānāścāpi śrotāro bhavantyajagarāḥ khalu | vaktuḥ samāsanasthāśca nindakāśca duruttarāḥ ||46|| janmaśataṃ te śunakā gardabhāḥ kṛkalāsakāḥ | śūkarāścāpi jāyante vighnakartāra eva ye ||47|| praśaṃsanti kathāṃ ye te padaṃ gacchanti śāśvatam | kathānāṃ śrāvakā yānti śāśvataṃ brahmaṇaḥ padam ||48|| kambalājīnavāsāṃsi dadyādāsanamuttamam | svargalokaṃ sa vai gacched dhanado brahmaṇaḥ padam ||49|| pustakasya śubhaṃ vastraṃ dadāti sukhabhāg bhavet | mahāpātakinaḥ śuddhā bhavanti jñānalabdhitaḥ ||1.405.50 || iti śrutvā mahimānaṃ kathāśravaṇakarmaṇaḥ | devāśca munayaḥ siddhāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitarastathā ||51 || dikpālā lokapālāśca nadā nadyo vanāni ca | tattvāni pārthivā lokā veṃkaṭādrau śubhālaye ||52|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ supāvanīm | śvetavārāhavaktrāt te śuśruvuryoṣito narāḥ ||53|| teṣāṃ bhojanadānārthaṃ veṃkaṭeśvarapācakāḥ | miṣṭānnānāṃ kaṭāhāni mahānaseṣvarakṣayan ||54|| abhojayannasaṃkhyātān devān devīśca dehinaḥ | tattīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ jātaṃ yadvai kaṭāhatīrthakam ||55|| mahādevo vijānāti tasya tīrthasya vaibhavam | varṇāśramasthitā ye’nye paśupakṣyādayo’pi ca ||56|| kaṭāhatīrthavāsena prāpnoti paramaṃ padam | aprāyaścittapāpānāṃ dhvaṃsaḥ kaṭāhasevanāt ||57|| ārtānāmārtināśaḥ syādasya jalasya sevanāt | svāmipuṣkariṇīsnānaṃ varāhaśrīśadarśanam ||58|| varāhatīrthe bhojyānnaṃ pānaṃ jalasya tasya ca | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāśca śravaṇaṃ sadā ||59|| sādhūnāṃ nityasevā ca ṣaṭkaṃ trailokyadurlabham | saṃhitāyāḥ kathāraṃbhe vārāho bhagavān svayam ||1.405.6 0 || caturbhujaḥ samāyāto bhūkaṭāhāt bahirhariḥ | tattīrthaṃ bhūkaṭāhākhyaṃ tatraiva vartate priye ||6 1 || yajjalaṃ cāmṛtaṃ tena tṛptāḥ śravaṇakārakāḥ | saṃhitāyāḥ kathāmagnā na vidyaiste parābhavan ||6 2|| māsaṃ śrutvā yayuḥ sarve nijasthānāni devatāḥ | atha keśavanāmākhyo vipro brāhmaṇaghātakaḥ ||6 3|| brahmahatyāsamākrānto yayau kaṭāhatīrthake | snātvā pītvā jalaṃ śuddho’bhavattīrthapratāpataḥ ||64||| tuṃgabhadrātaṭe tasya vedagrāme’bhavad gṛham | vaidikā brāhmaṇāḥ śāstravijñā hyāsan sahasraśaḥ ||65|| agrahāraḥ keśavo’sau kulaṭāpāśavañcitaḥ | mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tyaktvā bhāryāmapi pativratām ||66|| sarvadākulaṭāsakto’bhavat tadgṛhavāsakṛt | bahukāle gate tayā rugṇastyakto hi keśavaḥ ||67|| sa ca bubhukṣitaścauryaṃ kṛtavān brāhmaṇagṛhe | khaḍgena hatavān vipraṃ dhanaṃ nītvā suvarṇakam ||68|| yayau sa kulaṭāgāraṃ tayā dhanaṃ pragṛhya ca | tāḍito niṣkāsitaśca yayau svapitaraṃ gṛhe ||6 9|| brahmahatyāpṛṣṭhalagnābhavat sovāca rākṣasī | ayaṃ vipraṃ vinihatya kulaṭāyai dadau dhanam ||1.405.70 || tayā niṣkāsito jāraḥ pitṛmātṛviḍambakaḥ | bhāryātyāgī durātmāsti pitṛgṛhamupāgataḥ ||71 || yainaṃ putraṃ hi manyethāḥ padmanāma dvijottama | tyajainaṃ brāhmaṇahanaṃ na cet tyajasi putrakam ||72|| tadbhāryāmasya bhāryāṃ ca tvāṃ ca putramimaṃ dvija | bhakṣayiṣyāmi vaṃśaṃ ca tasmānmuñca durātmakam ||73|| brahāhatyā svayaṃ cāsmi nainaṃ muñcāmi sarvathā | naikasyārthe kulaṃ sarvaṃ vināśayitumarhasi | |74|| ityuktvā brahmahatyā sā vavalge keśavaṃ sutam | prāṇānattuṃ samudyogā babhūva rākṣasīsamā ||75|| kuṭumbinastadā sarve ruruduḥ khinnamānasāḥ | tasminnavasare bharadvājastatrāyayau muniḥ ||76|| padmanābho dvijaḥ stutvā yayāce śaraṇaṃ muhuḥ | matputraṃ rakṣa kṛṣṇāṃśa yathā hatyā layaṃ vrajet ||77|| eka eva suto me’sti tanmṛto vaṃśanāśanam pitṛpiṇḍavilopaśca nārakitvaṃ dvijanmanām ||78|| samuddhāraya tad vipra bahu puṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃśaḥ sa bharadvājo’bravīt tadā ||79|| ayaṃ vipra tava putro veṃkaṭādrau mahācale | śrībhūtalīlāyutanārāyaṇāśraye manohare ||1.405.80|| kaṭāhatīrthasalile snāyāt hatyālayaṃ vrajet | iti vākyaṃ gṛhītvaiva padmanābho dvijaḥ sutam ||8 1 || nītvā yayau veṃkaṭādrau sasnau puṣkariṇījale | varāhasvāminaṃ natvā śrīnivāsaṃ dadarśa ha ||82|| natvā divyavimānaṃ tad yayau kaṭāhatīrthakam | papau jalaṃ jale sasnau saputro yāvadeva tu ||83 || tāvad hatyā layaṃ prāptā bhagavānāvirāsa ca | prāhaitattīrthamāgatya ye pāsyanti jalaṃ janāḥ ||84|| teṣāṃ bhuktistathā muktiḥ sarvadā vai bhaviṣyati | ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo māhātmyamāha tam ||85|| mayā golokadhāmno’yaṃ cānīto veṃkaṭācalaḥ | tatra tapasyato’gastyamunerbrahmā sutoṣitaḥ ||86|| prāha putra varaṃ brūhi dadāmi yanmanogatam | agastyo vedhasaṃ prāha veṃkaṭākhye mahāgirau ||87|| mayā gaṃgā samāneyā jagatāṃ pāvanī sadā | brahmaṇā ca smṛtā gaṃgā śīghraṃ tatrājagāma ha ||88|| agastyaḥ śikharādagre jagāmānusarid yayau | suvarṇavatpradeśaṃ taṃ kurvatī ghoṣakāriṇī ||89|| suvarṇamukharīnāmnā vāyunā bodhitā tadā | veṃkaṭādriṃ nimnadeśān vyāpya vārdhigatābhavat ||1.405.90|| agastyastāṃ dvitīyāṃ vai gaṃgāṃśarūpiṇīṃ nadīm | mārgaṃ pradarśya tapasaḥ sthānaṃ prāpyāvasat sukham || 91 || yatra śrīveṃkaṭeśaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | śrīrādhāpārvatīlakṣmīpadminīmāṇikīpatiḥ ||92|| prabhāramākṣitilīlāpadmāvṛndāpatiśca saḥ | nityaṃ snātijalapānaṃ karotyeva sakhīyutaḥ ||93 || devāstīrthāni muktāśca sādhvyaḥ snānti ca parvasu | agastyācalasaṃbhūtā dakṣiṇodadhigāminī ||94|| pavitrayati deśān vai nārāyaṇasamāśrayāt | jalaṃ niṣkamitaṃ pītaṃ nāśayetpāpaparvatān ||95|| nityaṃ smarennamaskuryāt kīrtayenmanasārcayet | śuddhikṣemaśivāpekṣī suvarṇamukharīṃ smaret ||96 || āhūtā brahmaṇā gaṃgāgastyena vāhitā bhuvi | mūrtā dvitīyarūpā sā suvarṇamukharīśvarī ||97|| asyāstaṭe bhuvo dānaṃ dhanadānaṃ sutārpaṇam | kṛtvā tu vidhivad dehī yāti brahma sanātanam ||98 || japo homastapo dānaṃ pitṛkarma surārcanam | kṛtaṃ bhavecchataguṇaṃ suvarṇamukharītaṭe ||99|| agastyodayamāse ye snānamasyāṃ prakurvate | taiḥ kalpaṃ tu surāvāse sthīyante puṇyabhāgibhiḥ || 1.405.100 || sauvarṇāgastyadātāro yānti vai brahmaśāśvatam | agastyaḥ kuṃbhasambhūto govardhanasya netṛkaḥ || 101 || vindhyasaṃstabhano vārdhiculukīkṛtisiddhimān | jalanairmalyasāmarthyaḥ suvarṇamukharovahaḥ || 1 02| | prītimāpnotu mahatīṃ dānenānena me prabhuḥ | ityuktvā tu dadenmūrtiṃ jaṭācarmādiśobhitām || 103 || daṇḍakamaṇḍaluyuktāṃ svastikāsanasaṃsthitām | savalkalāmakṣamālāyukkarāṃ sumanoharām || 1 04| | nārāyaṇena sahitāṃ dadyāt pāpaviśuddhaye | smaret tīrthāni sarvāṇi dānakāle śuṇu priye || 1 05|| agastyatīrthaṃ tanmūle’gastyeśvaraśca śaṃkaraḥ | yatra vai vartate tatrottarāyaṇe viśejjalam || 108 || agniṣṭomasahasrasya phalaṃ bhavati svargadam | adhaḥ krośamitaṃ tīrthaṃ devarṣipitṛnāmakam || 1 07|| tatra snātā ṛṇatrayānmukto bhavati mānavaḥ | tato yojanayugale veṇānadyāḥ susaṃgamaḥ || 1 08|| tatra daśāśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ snānena labhyate | tato yojanaturye prāgastyeśvaraṃ suliṃgakam || 1 09|| tato’rdhayojane vyāghrapadāyāḥ saṃgamo’sti vai | tatra virājate śaṃkhatīrthe śaṃkheśvaraḥ śivaḥ || 1.405.110 || śaṃkhena muninā pūrvaṃ sthāpitaḥ pāpanāśakaḥ | nimne kalyānadī tatra saṃgatā pāpanāśinī || 111 || yatra brahmaśilā ramyā sarinmadhye hi vartate | athodicyāṃ yojanārdhaṃ vaiṃkaṭādrirvirājate || 11 2|| krośocchrayasya tasyaivābhitaścānye’pi bhūdharāḥ | aṃjano’nanto vṛṣabho nīlo varāhaḥ kesarī || 113 || nārāyaṇācale śrīveṃkaṭādrau vāsamācarat | vārāhastena bhūbhṛtsa vārāhakṣetramīritaḥ || 1 14|| suvarṇamukharītīre veṃkaṭādrau śriyā yutaḥ | bhuvā yutaśca padminyā yutaḥ śrībhagavān hariḥ || 1 15|| yuktaśca jayayā lalitayā bakulayā śriyā | pārvatyā prabhayā lakṣmyā māṇikyā līlayā ca yuk || 116 || sevyate siddhagandharvamunimānavadānavaiḥ | tasya smaraṇakartṝṇāṃ siddhyanti vāñchitāni vai || 1 17|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi tīrthānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ śubham | śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya svargaṃ mokṣaśca vai bhavet || 1 18|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye veṃkaṭādrau ṣaṭtīrthāni, lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathākartṛśvetākhyavyāsasya pūjanam, keśavākhyaviprasya brahmahatyāmokṣaṇam, gaṃgākhyasuvarṇamukharyā ānayanam, anyatīrthānāmuddeśādi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcādhikacatuḥśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||405 ||
<1.406> śrīlakṣmīruvāca veṃkaṭādrau mahāpuṇye śrīramākamalāpate | kathaṃ prādurabhūḥ pūrvaṃ vada me sarvamadbhutam || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mahimānaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ | sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’smi bhūḥ || 2 || goloke’haṃ kṛṣṇanāmā vaikuṇṭhe’haṃ narāyaṇaḥ | vāsudevo’mṛte dhāmni bhūmāvyākṛtadhāmani || 3 || akṣare tu pare dhāmni bhavāmi puruṣottamaḥ | hiraṇyagarbho vairājaḥ sadāśivo bhavāmi ca || 4 || sahasraśīrṣā bhagavān mahāviṣṇurbhavāmi ca | ekaśīrṣā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhūmau bhavāmyaham || 5 || mama bhāsā jagat sarvaṃ bhāsate bhāskaro’smyaham | vidyayā mama sṛṣṭirvai vyāprīyate sa cāsmyaham || 6 || sarvahṛtsu sannihito’ntaryāmyahaṃ vasāmi vai | hariḥ sadāśivo brahmā kāṃbhareyo janārdanaḥ || 7 || ahamevāsmi paryāyāḥ sahasrāṇi bhavanti me | yadecchāmi śubhaṃ kartuṃ tadāyāmi bhuvastalam || 8 || sṛjāmi rājasenaitat sattyenāpi vahāmi ca | harāmi tāmasenaiva nidrayā svapimīti ca || 9 || gatāṃ jalatale bhūmimānetuṃ svecchayā mayā | rūpaṃ vārāhasadṛśaṃ dhṛtaṃ vai līlayā purā || 1.406.10 || kardamabhāvamāpannā mayā daṃṣṭrāgrasiddhibhiḥ | piṇḍīkṛtyāhṛtā jalopari saṃsthānahetave || 11 || jalaṃ maryāditaṃ yathā pṛthvīṃ na nāśayettathā | ādhārārthaṃ diggajām̐śca śeṣaṃ kūrmaṃ nyaveśayam || 12|| mamājñayā jagad brahmā yathāpūrvamakalpayat | kalpe kalpe ca rakṣārthaṃ viharāmi mahītale || 1 3|| varāharūpadhṛk cāhaṃ prapede veṃkaṭācalam | svāmipuṣkariṇītīrthe nyavasaṃ brahmaṇā tadā || 14|| prārthito mūlrarūpāya tadādṛśyo’bhavaṃ priye | haihayavaṃśajo rājā śaṃkhanāmā babhūva ha || 15|| vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo bhakto navadhā bhajane’niśam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāṃ śṛṇoti sadā nṛpaḥ || 16|| tathāpyasya na sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’bhavat | tenāyaṃ cātṛptamanā vicāramakaronmuhuḥ || 17|| kathaṃ nu yāyād bhagavān viṣayaṃ mama netrayoḥ | evaṃcintayatastasyovāca śrībhagavān hṛdi || 18|| gaccha śrīveṃkaṭādrau tvaṃ bhaja varṣasahasrakam | adṛśyo dṛśyatāṃ yāsye tava cāgastyakasya ca || 19| ārādhya māṃ taponiṣṭhau mama darśanamāpsyathaḥ | śaṃkho vajre sute nyasya rājyaṃ śrīveṃkaṭaṃ yayau ||1.406.20|| agastyo’pyāsasādainaṃ śailaṃ muniśatāvṛtaḥ | pradakṣiṇaṃ cakārainaṃ brahmādidevavāsitam ||21 || devāḥ sarve sanakādyā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ | pratīkṣante hareḥ sākṣād darśanaṃ kuṃbhayonivat |||22|| militvā te samājagmuryatra śaṃkho’sti bhaktarāṭ | suvarṇamukharītīre’paśyam̐ste śaṃkhabhūpatim ||23|| āsīnāstatra te sarve saṃbhāvyānyonyamutsukāḥ | govindakīrtanaparāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakāḥ ||24|| tṛtīyaniśithe cānte dadṛśuḥ svapnameva te | śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ padminīsahitaḥ prabhuḥ ||25|| varadānāya samprāpta iti te dadṛśurharim | prātaste puṣkariṇyāṃ vai snātvā tuṣṭuvuracyutam ||26 || jepuraṣṭākṣaraṃ mantraṃ oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | teṣāmagre prādurabhūdekaṃ tejo mahādbhutam ||27|| tatra dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tuṣṭuvurādarāt | jaya viṣṇo jaya kṛṣṇa jaya śrīkṛṣṇa keśava |||28||| jaya bhūdhara govinda veṃkaṭādrīśa vai jaya | kṛtārthā nu kṛtāḥ sarve divyadarśanadānataḥ ||29|| sadātra bhagavan vāsaṃ kuru bhaktakṛpākara | suvarṇamukharīṃ cemāṃ kuru trilokapāvanīm ||1.406.3 0|| sadāsminnāsthitaḥ śaile kāṃkṣitārthaprado bhava | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrutvā prāha tathāstviti priyam ||3 1 || tena kṛṣṇena suvarṇamukharī svāśrayā kṛtā | śailo vaikuṇṭhaśailaśca kṛto vāsena nityadā ||32||| dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ prado jāto hariḥ priye | śaṃkhamāha hariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prīto’smi tava bhaktitaḥ |||33|| ākalpamindralokastho hyapsarogaṇasevitaḥ | bhuktvā bahuvidhān bhogām̐stato mallokameṣyasi ||34|| evaṃ datvā varaṃ devān nityavāsaṃ pradāya ca | nārāyaṇaḥ kamaleśastatraivāntaradhīyata ||35|| evaṃ saumyavapurbhūtvā kṛṣṇo vasati veṃkaṭe | nārāyaṇaṃ veṃkaṭādriṃ svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ tathā |||36|| kaṭāhādīni tīrthāni smṛtvā śuddhā bhavanti vai | lakṣmīśrībhūpadminīśaṃ prāpnuyuḥ puruṣottamam ||37|| śṛṇu lakṣmi purā kācidaṃjanānāmataḥ satī | putrahīnā tapaḥ kartuṃ samārabdhātivaiṣṇavī ||38|| mataṃgākhyo muniḥ kaścit tāmāha tapasi sthitām | kimicchasi dāruṇena tapasā vada sundari ||39|| aṃjanāha pitā me kesarī jñātīyarākṣasaḥ | tapaścakre śivaṃ smṛtvā putrārthaṃ dāruṇaṃ tapaḥ ||1.406.40|| śivāśivau vṛṣabhasthau samāyātau kṛpākarau | śivaḥ prāha ca te nāsmin janmani putradāyakam ||41 || puṇyaṃ kintu dadāmi tvāṃ putrīṃ lokeṣu viśrutām | tasyāḥ putreṇa putrītvaṃ manyethāḥ svaṃ sukhī bhava ||42|| iti tasmai varaṃ datvā tatraivāntardadhe haraḥ | matpitā rākṣasastuṣṭo gṛhaṃ yātastataḥ param | | 43 | | jajñe’haṃ tasya patnyāṃ ca kāle vivāhitābhavam | kesaryākhyena patinā kiṣkindhākhyamahāpure | |44 | | vratāni māghamāsasya kārtikasya vratāni ca | vaiśākhasya vratānyapi cāturmāsyavratāni ca | |75 | | kṛtavatīṃ ca navadhāṃ bhaktiṃ nārāyaṇasya ca | śālagrāmānnadānāni godānaṃ dīpadānakam | |46 | | tiladānaṃ vastradānaṃ bhūdānaṃ vāridānakam | phalapuṣpapradānaṃ ca satputraphalakāṃkṣayā || 47 | | śrāvaṇasya ca yatpuṇyaṃ kṛtavatyapi sarvathā | putraṃ tathāpyalabdhvāhaṃ tadarthaṃ tapasi sthitā || 48 | | atha tāṃ tāpasīṃ sādhvīṃ mataṃgaḥ prāha putradam | ito vai dakṣiṇe ghanācalo nṛsiṃhavāsabhūḥ | |4 9 | | daśayojanadūraṃ saḥ tatpūrve daśayojane | nadī suvarṇamukharī tadudṅ vṛṣabhācalaḥ | |1.406.5 0 | | tadagre’sti svāmipuṣkariṇī sarasī śobhanā | gaccha snāhi vidhānena varāhaṃ paśya keśavam | |5 1 | | veṃkaṭeśaṃ namaskṛtvā viyadgaṃgāṃ prayāhi ca | vāyumuddiśya ca tapaḥ kuru tatra hi vaiṣṇavi |||52 | | itiśrutvā yayau sā vai veṃkaṭādriṃ tapasvinī | cakre tīrthāni vidhivat tapaścakre’tidāruṇam ||53 | | viyadgaṃgātaṭe vāyuḥ prādurāsīttu tatpuraḥ | uvāca varadānārthaṃ putraṃ dehīti sābravīt | | 54 | | putraste’haṃ bhaviṣyāmītyuktvā cāntardadhe’nilaḥ | tadā śaṃkaradhātuṃ vai samādāya maharṣayaḥ || 55 | | samājagmuśca taṃ vāyuḥ kesarīrūpadhṛk tadā | jahārāñjanīkarṇe taṃ dadau putro’bhavattataḥ || 56 | | jātamātro yuvā jātismaro vāyubalātigaḥ | hanumān so’bhavattasyāstapasvinyāḥ suputrakaḥ | | 57 | | meṣasūrye caturdaśyāṃ citrānakṣatrayogake | suvarṇamukharītīre prādurāsānilaḥ svayam | | 58 | | tadātra snānadānādi kṛtaṃ bhavati cākṣayam | annadānaṃ vastradānaṃ svarṇadānaṃ sutārpaṇam | | 59 | | śālagrāmaśilādānaṃ godānaṃ bhūpradānakam | prapādānaṃ tiladānaṃ dhānyadānaṃ gṛhārpaṇam ||1.406.6 0 | | gandhacampakapuṣpādi chatravyajanacāmaram | tāmcūlaghanasārādi gṛhopakaraṇāni ca ||6 1 | | yo dadāti janastatra divyavastrasahasrakam | bhuktvā bhogānanekām̐śca svargaloke’pi bhogavān ||62| sārvabhaumastato vipro bhūtvā muktiṃ prayāti saḥ | iti te kathitā lakṣmi veṃkaṭādricamatkṛtiḥ ||63 || śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhaved dhruvam | śruṇu tvanyāṃ kathāṃ divyāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritām ||64|| kathayāmi tava prītyā pātivratyaparāyaṇām | ekadā śrīveṃkaṭādrirmeruṃ gantumacintayat ||65 || uḍḍīya svīyapakṣābhyāṃ yāvadutpatati kṣiteḥ | tāvajjāto mahān kampo vināśo bahudehinām ||66 || cukruśuḥ prāṇinaḥ sarve varāhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ | mṛtāḥ smo bhagavannasyoḍḍayanena vināśrayam ||67|| kuru no rakṣaṇaṃ kṣmeśa yathāvat sthāpaya prabho | ityarthito varāho vai svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||68|| jīvānāśvāsayāmāsa sasmārendraṃ savajrakam | tāvadupāgataścendro vajramudyamya pakṣahāḥ ||6 9|| indraṃ dṛṣṭvā veṃkaṭādristatrāsa kampito’bhavat | jagāma śaraṇaṃ viṣṇorvarāharūpiṇastadā ||1.406.70 || tuṣṭāva maraṇād bhītastamāha bhagavān svayam | yadi kadācinmā yāhi pakṣābhyāṃ vyomamārgataḥ ||71 || tadā rakṣāṃ kariṣyāmi sthiro bhavātra bhūdhara | ityuktaḥ so’bhavannatvā niṣkampaḥ susthirastadā ||72 || adṛśyo’bhūd varāhaśca mahendraḥ svālayaṃ yayau | varāhasyāśrayeṇāsya pakṣau nendreṇa kartitau ||73 || athaikadā sa śailastu kalpayāmāsa vai hṛdi | āgato’haṃ hi golokād vasāmyatra ciraṃ samāḥ || 74|| golokadarśanārthaṃ vai gacchāmi kṛṣṇasannidhau | iti vicārya sa kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamyāṃ yaśa kṣitau ||75 || kuśasthalyāṃ hi gomatyāṃ snātuṃ tīrthāni saṃyayuḥ | ṛṣayaśca gatāḥ sarve nadā nadyaśca devatāḥ ||76 || agastyādaya evaite yayurgomatīsaṃgame | svaṃ nirjanaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā gantuṃ mano dadhe tadā ||77|| cakampe pṛthivī tatra jīvā naṣṭāśca kampanāt | tāvat tatrābhavadekā tāpasī nirdhanā satī ||78|| brāhmaṇī brāhmaṇasevāparā nityaṃ prativratā | nāmnā suvarṇarekhā ca hiraṇyā tatsvasā tathā ||71|| hiraṇyābhūnmahāsādhvī kumārikā tapasvinī | suvarṇarekhā sapatikā patirnāmnā narāyaṇaḥ || 1.406.80 | | nārāyaṇaṃ dvijaṃ prāha pītvā jalaṃ tu pādayoḥ | veṃkaṭādriḥ sapakṣo’sti prāguḍḍayane vāritaḥ | |8 1 | | punaruḍḍīyate’smākaṃ mṛtyureva bhaviṣyati | yadi patyājñayā cainaṃ jaḍīkaromi sarvathā | |82 | | tadā śrīveṃkaṭeśādyāḥ kruddhā no duḥkhadāḥ khalu | bhaviṣyanti tato nātha kartavyaṃ kiṃ vadātra me | |8 3 | | ityuktaḥ saḥ priyāmāha yatheṣṭaṃ kuru bhāmini | yadi te pātivratyaṃ vai dṛḍhaṃ cāsti janāviha | | 84| | sarve parābhavamāptā bhaviṣyanti tadagrataḥ | mā bhayaṃ kuru sādhvi tvaṃ śikṣāṃ kuru hi parvatam | |85| | iti priyasya vacanaṃ samāsādya satī tadā | prāha yadyasmi maddharmasaṃsthitā vai pativratā | |86 | | tadā parvatarājo’tra tava pakṣau bhuvo’ntare | jaḍībhūtau sadā stāṃ vai pakṣaśaktiṃ vinākṛtau | |87| | pṛthivyā caikatāṃ prāptau yathā noḍḍayanaṃ punaḥ | ityuktamātre tau pakṣī jaḍībhūtāvacaṃcalau | |88 | | abhavatāṃ śaktihīnā bhuvo’ntaraṃ niveśitau | veṃkaṭādrirnamratayā yayāce vai kṣamāṃ muhuḥ | |8 9 | | satī prāha sadā cātra nārāyaṇasya me tathā | vāso na niścitastasmād yāsyāmo raivatācalam | | 1.406.90 | | tvaṃ sadā tiṣṭha niṣkarmā mā bhūḥ caṃcalaparvata | anyathā te punardevo dhruvaṃ nāśaṃ kariṣyati || 91 || sapakṣastvaṃ sarvadaivaṃ tiṣṭha noḍḍayanaṃ bhavet| | dadāmi pakṣayorjīvaṃ kṛpayā mā śucaḥ punaḥ || 92 || śalabhānāṃ śukānāṃ ca koṭayastava pakṣayoḥ | bhaviṣyanti saśaktāstā uḍḍayiṣyanti cāmbare || 93 || śādvaleṣu vaneṣvatrāraṇyeṣu śalabhāḥ śukāḥ | oṣadhīn bhakṣayitvā te layameṣyanti pakṣayoḥ || 94| | evaṃ te pakṣayoḥ sajīvanatāṃ te dadāmi vai | ityuktvā veṃkaṭaṃ sthirīkṛtvā nārāyaṇo dvijaḥ || 95 | | pativratā svarṇarekhā yayatū raivatācalam | svarṇarekhā nadīrūpābhavannityā pativratā || 96 || nārāyaṇo hradarūpo’bhavannityo’vasad girau | evaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ svarṇarekhā ceti hi dampatī || 97 || nivāsaṃ cakratustīrtharūpau divyau hi raivate | yatra dāmodareṇāpi patnīvratena viṣṇunā |||98 || śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ parāṃ tṛptiṃ dadatustau hi cetanān | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi camatkāramayaṃ vṛttam || 99|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye veṃkaṭādrāvagastyaśaṃkhadvārā varāhaprādurbhāvaḥ, tatra tapasāṃjanyāṃ hanumatputralābhaḥ, veṃkaṭādreḥ pakṣayorjaḍīkaraṇam, tvārekhānārāyaṇahṛdayoḥ raivatācale āgamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikacatuḥśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||406 ||
<1.407> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi jayantyā vai cendraputryāḥ kathā śubhām | yā cakāra tapaḥsevāṃ śukrasya pātivratyataḥ || 1 || devadānavayuddheṣu devāstu sabalā yadā | jetumaśakyā daityaiśca tadā dānavamaṇḍalam || 2 || śukrācāryaṃ samastaut tadyathā daityajayo bhavet | tadā śukraḥ samayaṃ vai buddhvā devāśrayāvaham || 3 || sarvān daityān parityajya śukro devānaḍhaukata | tadā daityā devapakṣagataṃ śukraṃ samāhvayan || 4 || kiṃ tvaṃ no miṣataścāsmām̐styaktvā devān samāśritaḥ | sthātuṃ na śaknumo bhūmau praviśāmo rasātalam || 5 || vinā hi rakṣakaṃ tvāṃ tu guru sthāsyāmahe katham | evamukto’bravīd daityān viṣaṇṇān sāntvayan girā || 6 || mā bhaiṣṭa rakṣayiṣyāmi tatra sthitena tejasā | mantrauṣadhivasusiddhirasāstiṣṭhanti vai mayi || 7 || kṛtsnaśastaccaturthāṃśaḥ sureṣvasti ca vā na vā | madgataṃ vaḥ pradāsyāmi yūyaṃ syustena rakṣitāḥ ||8 || etadvṛtaṃ suvijñāya devāḥ sarvajighṛkṣayā | cakruḥ sammantraṇāṃ netuṃ svavaśaṃ mantraprabhati || 9 || adhyayanaṃ samārabdhaṃ devaiḥ śukrasya sannidhau | kiṃcit kiṃcid dadau tebhyastadapyapūrṇameva vai || 1.407.1 0|| yāvad daityebhya evāyaṃ śukro nādhyāpayattu tat | tāvad daityān surā hatvā pātālaṃ prāpayanti hi || 11 || atha daityā dīnabhāvāḥ kāvyamevābhidudruvuḥ | tadāpi ca surā daityānniḥśaṃkamabhisañjahuḥ || 1 2|| śukro rakṣāṃ tadā kartuṃ mantrān dātuṃ śaśāka na | kintu daityānuvācetthaṃ yuddhaṃ māstviti me matam || 1 3|| devā baliṣṭhāścedānīṃ yūyaṃ tu nirvalā yataḥ | kālapratīkṣāṃ kuruta gacchāmi tapase’pyaham || 14||| yāsyāmyahaṃ mahādevaṃ varārthaṃ vijayāvaham | apratīpān śreṣṭhamantrān prāpya devānmaheśvarāt || 15|| yuddhyāmahe yadā devām̐stadā prāpsyatha vai jayam | atha śāstrāṇi santyajyāsurāḥ prāhuḥ surām̐stadā || 16 || vayaṃ tapaścariṣyāmaḥ śāntāḥ savalkalā vane | iti śrutvā surā api nyavartanta tadardanāt || 17|| atha śukro jagau daityān yūyaṃ yāta rasātalam | tapoyuktā hi kāryārthaṃ kiñcitkālamupāsyatha || 18|| ityuktvā sa daityagururyayau śaṃbhuṃ himācalam | tapaścakre dāruṇaṃ saḥ pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasrakam || 19 || avākśirāśca bhūkuṇḍe kṛtvā pādau vihāyasi | brahmacārī tathā bhūtvā tapaścakāra dāruṇam |||1.407.2 0 || śivaṃ jajāpa manasā nirāhāro’pi niścalaḥ | atha daityāḥ kvacit kāle pṛthvyāṃ sthātuṃ samāgatāḥ || 21 || tadā devaistāḍitāste yayuḥ kāvyasya mātaram | śaraṇaṃ sābravīttām̐śca vo’stvabhayaṃ nirantaram || 22 || na bhetavyaṃ na bhetavyaṃ bhayaṃ tyajata dānavāḥ | matsannidhau vasatāṃ vo bhayaṃ na syād bravīmyaham || 23 || devāstatra gatā daityān tāḍayituṃ balātpunaḥ | khyātiḥ kruddhābravīd devānmahendraṃ nāśayāmi vaḥ || 24 || itikṛtvā vidyayā sā mahendraṃ tu jaḍīkṛtam | abhicāreṇa tastambha yoginī sā tapodhanā || 25|| prādravanta tato devā dṛṣṭvā cendraṃ vaśīkṛtam | atha viṣṇurmahendraṃ sve rūpe cākṛṣya tatkṣaṇam || 26 || nītvā yāvad divaṃ yāti tāvat khyātiḥ ruṣānvitā | viṣṇunā rakṣitaṃ dṛṣṭvā khyātistatra vaco’bravīt || 27||| eṣā tvāṃ viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ dahāmi maghavan balāt | tāvadviṣṇuḥ svarakṣārthaṃ cakraṃ jagrāha cāpadi || 28 || jñātvā tadānīṃ prāṇāntaṃ krūraṃ khyātyāścikīrṣitam | sudarśanena vai khyātyāḥ śiraściccheda tadbhiyā ||2 9|| taṃ strīvadhaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā cukrodha bhṛgureva yat | śaśāpa viṣṇuṃ bhāryāyāḥ khyātyā vadhakaraṃ tadā || 1.407.3 0 || yasmātte jānato dharmamavadhyā strī niṣūditā | tasmāt tvamapi kalpādau śirovadhamavāpsyasi ||31 || ityevaṃ śāpataḥ kṛṣṇo bhūtvā gaṇeśa eva saḥ | śaṃkarasya ca hastena cāvāpnoti śirovadham ||32 || atha bhaguṇā tvaritaṃ kāye śiro niyojitam | eṣā tva viṣṇunā devi hatā tāṃ sañjīvayāmyaham ||33|| yadi kṛtsno mayā dharmaḥ patnīvrataḥ prapālitaḥ | tena satyena jīvasya yadi satye vadāmyaham ||34|| tāṃ samprokṣya śītajalairabhijīveti so’bravīt | uttiṣṭheti vyāhṛte khyātiḥ sañjīvitābhavat ||35|| sādhu sādhviti jagadurdevādyāḥ sarvatodiśam | kintvindro nālabhata śaṃ khyātiśukrabhayāttataḥ ||36|| śukratapasi vighnārthaṃ vicāryendraḥ svakanyakām | jayantīṃ prāha putri tvaṃ mayā śukrāya cārpitā ||37|| gaccha tvaṃ tasya dattāsi prayatnaṃ kuru matkṛte | śukraḥ śaṃbhoḥ sādhanārthaṃ tapaścarati dāruṇam ||38|| devānāṃ sa vināśārthaṃ mantrārthaṃ yatate bhṛśam | gaccha saṃsādhayasvainaṃ śramāpanayanādibhiḥ ||39|| taistairmano’nukūlaiśca śayanādyupacārakaiḥ | evamuktā jayantī sā piturvacanasaṃsthitā || 1.407.40|| agacchad yatra sa ghore tapasi vartate girau | tamadhaḥśirasaṃ kāntaṃ kāvye kanyā hyupasthitā ||41 || vadhūrasmīti taṃ procya sevāyāṃ cāpyavartata | gīrbhiścaivānukūlābhirgātrasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ ||42|| kāle’pekṣitavastvādyaiḥ sevamānā tvacaḥ sukhaiḥ | vratacaryānukūlābhiruvāca bahulāḥ samāḥ ||43||| pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu pātivratyaparāyāṇā | sasmāra śaṃkaraṃ sādhvī kathaṃ tuṣṭo na jāyate || 44|| yadi śaṃbhurna vai tuṣṭastamatra pradahāmi vai | śāpeneti ruṣaṃ prāptā tāvattatrāyayau haraḥ ||45|| jayantīṃ prāha devānāṃ vināśāya ca te patiḥ | karoti tapa ugraṃ vai tasmānnāyāmi darśane ||46|| kintu tavātibalavatpātivratyena karṣitaḥ | āgato’haṃ varaṃ dātuṃ vada yat tatkaromi te ||47|| jayantī prāha pitrā me svakāryārthaṃ samarpitā | tatkāryaṃ vai prakartavyaṃ patyuḥ kāryamathāpi ca ||48|| kanyā yasmai pradattā syāttasya dharmaṃ samācaret | taddhitaṃ tasya kalyāṇaṃ tasyābhyudayameva ca ||49|| patiḥ sarvasvamabalājītānāṃ dharma ucyate | tadvirodhe kadācinna nāryāḥ śreyo bhavennanu ||1.407.50|| tasmātpatimanā bhūtvā kṛtyaṃ sarvaṃ mayocitam | piturhitakarī kanyā patyurduḥkha tu nācaret| ||51 || kuru śaṃbho yathāyogyaṃ dvayorhitaṃ yathā bhavet | mayā sevā kṛtā cāsya kāvyasya bhāvasaṃbhṛtā |||52|| kintu tattapasi brahmacarye vighnaṃ na vai kṛtam | yata indreṇa dattāsya dharmapatnī bhavāmyaham ||53|| kathaṃ karomi kāmena vighnamasya tapaḥkṣaye | tasmātkāmaṃ vinigṛhya ratiḥ kṛtā na vai mayā ||54|| tapaḥsiddhiḥ prajātāsya macchreyase’pi sā yataḥ | pātivratyaṃ pālitaṃ vai mayāniṣṭaṃ na vai kṛtam ||55|| tenaiva pātivratyena kurvasya manasepsitam | ityuktā premapātraṃ sā kāvyasya virarāma ha ||56|| mahādevaḥ prasannaḥ sannuvāca cakitastadā | śukra caitādṛśī kanyā yasyārthe dattajīvanā ||57|| pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ vai pārśve tiṣṭhati nityadā | tathāpi na tvayā tyaktaṃ brahmacaryaṃ vrataṃ tathā ||58|| tayāpi pativratayā nigrahītaṃ mano’sthiram | sarvadā ṣoḍaśavarṣā hyadyāpi sā hi dīvyati ||59|| akṣatā ca tavādhīnā dhanyeyaṃ vai pativratā | te’pi dhanyapravādo’stu pāraṃ gato’si sarvathā ||1.407.60 || etadvrataṃ tvayaikena cīrṇaṃ nānyena kenacit | tasmādvai tapasā buddhyā śrutena ca balena ca |||61 || tejasā ca surān sarvāṃstvameko’bhibhaviṣyasi | tava vadhvāḥ pātivratyabrahmacaryaprabhāvataḥ ||62|| prapatsyase’bhilaṣitaṃ sarvaṃ vācyaṃ na kasyacit | sukhaṃ yātaṃ dampatī ca prajeśatāṃ dhaneśatām ||63|| avadhyatvaṃ ca sadvidyāṃ sañjīvanīṃ gṛhāṇa ca | ityuktaḥ sa śukradevastuṣṭuve’vākśiraḥsthitaḥ ||64|| namostu brahmarūpāya bhaktecchāpūrakāya te | namaḥ sadyaḥpratuṣṭāya ciratuṣṭāya te namaḥ ||65|| namo’stu nityatṛptāya digambarāya te namaḥ | namo bhīmāya rudrāya mahādevāya te namaḥ ||66|| nama ugrāya pinākadhāriṇe śaṃbhave namaḥ | mṛgavyādhāya yataye kirātāya ca te namaḥ ||67|| namastricakṣuṣe candrabhālāya liṃgarūpiṇe | sadāśivāya śarvāya bhaveśāya namo namaḥ ||68|| saumyāya sākṣiṇe satīsvāmine te namo namaḥ | nīlakaṇṭhāya caṇḍāya sadyojātāya śūline ||69|| īśānāya piśaṃgāya carmāmbarāya te namaḥ | paśūnāṃ pataye tubhyaṃ bhūtānāṃ pataye namaḥ ||1.407.70|| namo’ṣṭavarṣmaṇe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmane namaḥ | pārvatīpataye prabhāsvāmine te namonamaḥ || 71 || namaste sarvataḥ sarvadikṣu sarvātmasu prabho | phaladāyānandakartre tai sarvatra namonamaḥ || 72 || ityuktvā virarāmāsau śaṃbhuḥ prāha tapastava | pūrṇaṃ jātaṃ samuttiṣṭha varaṃ gṛhāṇa vāñchitam | |73 || tathāpi śukro nottasthe śaṃbhuradṛśyatāṃ yayau | jayantī tadvilokyaiva prāptakālaṃ jagāda tam || 74|| kathaṃ nottiṣṭhase nātha kathaṃ copekṣase varam | avadhānaṃ kathaṃ śaṃbhorvākye naiva karoṣi vai || 75|| śrutvā patnīkṛtaṃ śabdaṃ yāvaduttiṣṭhati kṣiteḥ | tāvacchaṃbhuṃ tirobhūtaṃ na dadarśa hi tāpasaḥ ||76 || paramaṃ khedamāpanno vidadhe śokamulbaṇam | upasthitasya vai tyāge punaryogo hi durlabhaḥ | | 77|| vyomavāṇyā sa vai kāvyo vijñāpito gṛhaṃ prati | gantuṃ nītvā tapaḥpuṇyaṃ jayantīmādarāttathā || 78 || patnīṃ gṛhaṃ yayau śukro daśavarṣāṇi sarvathā | pracchannaḥ so’bhavat saudhe jayantyā saha bhogavān || 79 || tasyāṃ jātā devayānī putrī yayātibhāminī | atha kṛtārthaṃ śukraṃ tu jñātvā sarve diteḥ sutāḥ | |1.407.8 0 || abhijagmurgṛhaṃ tasya guruṃ didṛkṣavaḥ svakam | adṛṣṭvā te yayuḥ svasvagṛhaṃ tadā bṛhaspatiḥ ||8 1 || tuṣṭyarthaṃ daśavarṣāṇi jayantyā hitakāmyayā | śukrarūpaṃ samāsādya tvasurān samupāhvayan ||82|| āgatānāha vo vidyā dāsyāmi śaṃkaroditāḥ | te tu hṛṣṭā daśasamā vidyārthamupapedire ||8 3 || anyā anyā adhyāpitā vañcitā guruṇā hi te | nataḥ kāvyo daśavarṣottaraṃ draṣṭuṃ svayājakān ||84|| yayau dṛṣṭā guruṇā svarūpeṇa vañcitāstu te | vañcitān kāvyarūpeṇa kāvyo’bravīttu tām̐stadā | |85|| kāvyaṃ māṃ vo vijānīdhvaṃ nāyaṃ kāvyo bṛhaspatiḥ | bṛhaspatistadā prāha kāvyo’haṃ nāyameva saḥ ||86 || ayantu vañcanārthaṃ vo daśavarṣāttaraṃ guruḥ | samāgato’sti maddeśānmā kāvyo jñāyatāmayam ||87|| etacchrutvā dvayorvākyaṃ sarūpayostu dānavāḥ | prekṣantastāvubhau tatra saṃbhrāntāste tadābhavan ||88 || hālareṇa dhṛtaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ maraṇāntaṃ na mucyate | na śakyaṃ tvanyathākartuṃ diṣṭaṃ hi balavattaram | |8 9 || śukreṇa bodhitāścāpi naivāmanyata tadvacaḥ | yastu no daśavarṣāṇi satataṃ śāsti vai prabhuḥ | | 1.407.90 || eṣa vai gururasmākaṃ kāvyo nāgantuko hyayam | iti niścitya daityāste cirābhyāsena mohitāḥ | | 91 || prāhurgaccha drutaṃ ceto gurustu śikṣako’sti naḥ | bhārgavo vāṅgirā vāpi bhagavāneṣa no guruḥ | | 92 || tadā śukraḥ kopito’bhūt śaśāpa dānavām̐stadā | sarve praṇaṣṭabhānā vai mahadduḥkhamavāpsyatha || 93 || śukreṇa śaptā asurāḥ kṛtārtho’bhūd vṛhaspatiḥ | tirobhavat tataḥ sthānāt tataste hyasurāḥ punaḥ || 94| | vibhrāntā abhavan lakṣmi vañcitāḥ smeti cāvadan | prahlādamagrataḥ kṛtvā śukrācāryagṛhaṃ yayuḥ || 95|| ūcustaṃ naḥ kṣamasveti prasādaṃ kuru bhārgava | no cet prasādaṃ kuruṣe praviśāmo rasātalam | | 96 || kāvyo vicārayāmāsa yājyānvināpyahaṃ mṛṣā | tato mayā rakṣaṇīyāḥ śobhe’haṃ sevitaśca taiḥ || 97|| athāhaitānna bhetavyaṃ na gantavyaṃ rasātalam | bhāna praṇaṣṭa yadā vo’dya tatpunaḥ pratipatsyatha || 98 || devān jitvā tvekavāraṃ pātālaṃ pratipatsyatha | ityuktā hyasurā hṛṣṭā surān jetuṃ viniryayuḥ || 99 || surāsurāṇāṃ saṃgrāmo hyabhavad dāruṇastadā | ajayannasurā devān devāścāpi hyamantrayan || 1.407.100 || yajñe cāhūya vai ṣaṇḍāmarkau daityagurū ca tau | āśrayāmaḥ pūjayāmo bhajāmo no jayo bhavet || 101 || devairāhūya tau proktau tyajetāmasurān dvijau | vayaṃ yuvāṃ bhajiṣyāmaḥ saha jitvā tu dānavān || 102 || evaṃ sandhāya ca surāścakruryuddhaṃ hi dāruṇam | ṣaṇḍāmarkaparityaktā dānavāśca parājitāḥ || 103 || kāvyaśāpābhibhūtāśca viviśuste rasātalam | evaṃ nirudyamā devaiḥ kṛtāḥ kṛcchreṇa dānavāḥ || 1 04|| jayantī svapatiṃ nityaṃ sevate mohakāriṇī | śukrācāryo visasmāra daityābhyudayameva ca || 105|| indrasyaivaṃ kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ jayantyā vijayātmakam | daityānāṃ nirbalatvaṃ ca pātivratyārthayāpi vai || 106 || patyuścāpyapradhṛṣyatvaṃ mahendrāderjayādikam | daityānāṃ cāpakṛṣṭatvaṃ sādhitaṃ kanyayā vrataiḥ || 107 || nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃbrahmākṣaradhāmasthito’pi saḥ | karoti rakṣaṇaṃ kāle dhṛtvā dharmātmikāṃ tanum || 108 || ādye patnīvratākhyo’bhūt kṛṣṇo golokavāsakṛt | tato nārāyaṇo jajñe narayukto himācale || 109 || punaryajño dharmaputro’bhavat sa eva dhārmikaḥ | narasiṃhaḥ sa evābhūt vāmano’pi babhūva ha || 1.407.110 || dattātreyo jāmadagnyo rāmādityo babhūva ha | vāsudevo vedavyāsaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastathā || 111 || kāmbhareyastathā kalkī sa eva bhagavān svayam | jāyate yugaparyāye suradharmāvanāya vai || 112 || ahameva sa evāsmi madaṃśāśca sahasraśaḥ | dine dine prajāyante gūḍharūpāḥ sukhapradāḥ | | 113 || dhanuścakradhvajamatsyasvastikakaracihnitāḥ | gulphatrayordhvarekhārdhacandracakrapadāmbujāḥ || 114|| yatpādasevanāt santaḥ sādhvyo bhavanti dehinaḥ | mokṣadā devasadṛśā muktā eva na saṃśayaḥ || 115 || iti te kathitā lakṣmi khyāterjayantyāḥ siddhayaḥ | pātivratyakṛtāḥ pāṭhācchravād bhuktimuktipradāḥ || 116 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratākhyātikṛtamahendrādijaḍībhāvaḥ, viṣṇukṛtakhyātināśaḥ, bhṛguṇā khyātirujjīvitā, śukrasya tapaścaryā, indreṇa putrī jayantī vighnārthe śukrāya dattā, tatputrī devayānī, taponirodhaḥ, asuraparājayaḥ, pātivratyamahimetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||407 ||
<1.408> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi pātivratyamahābalam | upabarhaṇapatnyā vai mālāvatyā pradarśitam | | 1 || brahmāsṛjad yadā sṛṣṭiṃ vinirmāya tu nāradam | prāha sṛṣṭipravāhārthaṃ nāradastannyaṣedhayat || 2 || muktidātā pitā prokto mokṣagāmī suto mataḥ | bhrātā mātā patiḥ patnī bhaktipradāḥ śubhāḥ sadā || 3 || māyābandhanadātāro na bodhyāste kuṭumbinaḥ | tva ca brahmā svayaṃ jñānī niyojayasi māyike || 4 || nāhaṃ māyāṃ grahīṣyāmi na ca sṛṣṭiṃ karomyapi | bhajiṣye brahma paramaṃ tārayiṣye tvadādikān || 5 || sārthakayiṣye putratvaṃ mā khedaṃ vaha viśvasṛṭ | ityukto roṣatāmrākṣo brahmā śaśāpa nāradam || 6 | mṛtyuṃ prāpya dārayukto bhava dāsastataḥ param | jñānahīnaḥ karmabhāro bhava nārada vai muhuḥ || 7 || tadā taṃ nāradaḥ prāha pitā maivaṃ kuru prabho | tvamapyatra hi saṃsāre pūjyatāṃ mā labha kvacit || 8 || ityuktaḥ sa tadā brahmā sanakādibhirarthitaḥ | putraṃ prāha punastvaṃ vai caturthe māmavāpsyasi || 9 || brahmacaryaparastatra sadā putra bhaviṣyasi | tāvad dāragṛhavyāpto bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 1.408.10 || ityuto nārado naṣṭo mārīco hyabhavat tataḥ | gandharvarājasya viśvāvasoḥ putratvamāptavān || 11 || upabarhaṇanāmāsau gandharvo’bhūcca vaiṣṇavaḥ | śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi viśvāvasuḥ purā kila || 1 2|| tapaścacāra śaṃbhośca putrahīno hi karmaṇā | vaśiṣṭhaḥ pradadau tasmai mantraṃ tu dvādaśākṣaram || 13 || varṣaśataṃ jajāpainaṃ puṣkare tāvadeva ca | prasannāsyaṃ vṛṣabhasthaṃ dadarśa purataḥ śivam || 14|| varaṃ vṛṇuṣveti śivastamuvāca tato hyayam | yayāce śrīharerbhaktiṃ putra paramavaiṣṇavam || 15|| śivaḥ prāha prasanno’smi tathāstu tava maṃgalam | kṛtārthastvaṃ varādekādanyaccarvitacarvaṇam || 16 || yasya bhaktirharau vatsa sudṛḍhā sarvamaṃgalā | sa samarthaḥ sarvaviśvaṃ pātuṃ kartuṃ ca līlayā || 17|| bhaved yasya sukṛtinaḥ putraḥ paramavaiṣṇavaḥ | kulakoṭiṃ tasya te vai hyuddhārayanti līlayā || 18|| caritārthaḥ pumānekād varamirachurvarādaho | kiṃ vareṇa dvitīyena puṃsā tṛptirna maṃgale || 1 9|| harerbhaktiṃ harerdāsyaṃ putraṃ paramavaiṣṇavam | cirāyuṣaṃ ca guṇinaṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanam || 1.408.20|| jñāninaṃ sundaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ gurubhaktaṃ jitendriyam | labhasvemaṃ varaṃ ceti hyuktvā śaṃbhustirodadhe ||2 1 || viśvāvasurgṛhaṃ yātaḥ parvate gandhamādane | nāradastasya bhāryāyāṃ lebhe janma śubhāvaham ||22|| gururvaśiṣṭhastannāma cakāra copabarhaṇam | upaśabdo’dhikārtho’tra pūjye tu barhaṇaḥ pumān ||23 | | pūjyānāmadhiko bālastenopabarhaṇābhidhaḥ | upabarhaṇaḥ kālena tepe ca duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ || 24|| gaṇḍakītīramāsādya taṃ tadā sthirayauvanam | gāndharvyo dadṛśustaṃ ca pañcāśad vavrire patim ||25||| gṛhītvā tā yuvā reme dvilakṣavarṣa kāmukaḥ | ekadā sa yayau brahmasabhāyāṃ ca jagau kathām | | 26 || tadā raṃbhāṃ sa cālokya caṃcalo hyabhavanmuhuḥ | drutaṃ tatyāja saṃgītaṃ mūrchāṃ prāpa sabhātale || 27 || uccaiḥ prājahasurdevā brahmā kopācchaśāpa tam | vraja tvaṃ śūdrayoniṃ ca gāndharvīṃ tanumutsṛja || 28 || kāle vaiṣṇavasaṃsargānmanputrastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi | upabarhaṇagandharvaḥ sa jahau tāṃ tanuṃ tadā | | 29 || mūlādhāraṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ maṇipūramanāhatam | viśuddhamājñācakraṃ ṣaḍ bhittvā tanvā viniryayau || 1.408.30 || yogena brahmasamprāpa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ manasā smaran | patnyaśca bāndhavāḥ sarve vilapya rurudurbhṛśam || 31 || pañcāśadyoṣitāṃ madhye sādhvī mālāvatī tadā | uccaiḥ ruroda sā tīvraṃ kṛtvā kāntaṃ svavakṣasi || 32 || citrarathasya kanyāstā rurudustasya yoṣitaḥ | mālāvatī vilalāpa kṛṣṇa tvaṃ jagatāṃ patiḥ || 33 || nāhaṃ jagadbahistvasmi māṃ na pāsi kathaṃ prabho | are surā yajñabhujo ghṛtaṃ bhoktuṃ kṣamā bhuvi || 34|| kṣaṇenāyajñabhājaśca kariṣyāmi satītvataḥ | nārāyaṇa jagatkānta nāhameva jagadbahiḥ || 35|| pātivratyaṃ mama pūrṇamakhaṇḍitaṃ yadasti cet | śīghraṃ jīvaya matkāntamanyathā tvāṃ śapāmyaham || 36 || prajāpate putraśāpāt tvamapūjyo dharātale | tavaivānadhikāritvaṃ kariṣyāmyatra sarjane || 37|| he śaṃbho jñānalopaṃ te kariṣyāmi śapena vai | dharmalopaṃ ca dharmasya kariṣyāmyeva vai kṣaṇāt || 38 | | yamādhikāraṃ dūre ca kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ | satyaṃ kālaṃ śapiṣyāmi mṛtyukanyāṃ suniṣṭhurām | | 39 | | śapāmi sarvānatraiva jarāṃ vyādhiṃ vinādhunā | vyādhinā jarayā mṛtyurna hyabhūcca patermama | |1.408.40 | | ityuktvā kauśikītīre tvāgacchacchaptumeva tān | tāṃ śaptumudyatāṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmā śaṃbhupurogamaḥ | |41 | | devatāśca yayustīraṃ kṣīrābdheḥ śaraṇaṃ harim | tatra snātvā ca tuṣṭuvuḥ paramātmānamīśvaram | |42| | viṣṇuṃ brahmā jagatkāntamityuvāca ha bhītavat | upabarhaṇapatnī sā kanyā citrarathasya ca | |43 | | kāntahetośca mā devān śapet tvaṃ rakṣa mādhava | smaranti sādhavaḥ santo mahāpatsu parameśvaram || 44| | śaraṇāgatadīnārtaparitrāṇaparāyaṇa | rakṣa rakṣa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa te śaraṇaṃ gatān ||45| | adhikāravihīnaṃ māṃ mālāvatī dadhāti vai | sampat sarvā mahābrāhmī yāsyatyevādhunā mama ||46 || śaṃbhuṃ prāha tvayā dattaṃ mahājñānaṃ sudurlabham | śatamanvantaratapaḥphalena puṣkare purā ||47| | aiśvaryadhanasāmarthyaṃ prāptaṃ mayā narāyaṇa | mamaitajjñānaratnaṃ vai śāpānniryāti yoṣitaḥ | |48| | aho pativratātejaḥ sarveṣāṃ tejasāṃ param | tejo’nalena dagdhaṃ māṃ trāhi rakṣa hare prabho | |49 || dharmaḥ prāha mahāratnaṃ dharma eva sanātanaḥ | so’haṃ nāśaṃ sameṣyāmi yoṣitaḥ śāpataḥ prabho | |1.408.50 | | saptamanvantaratapaḥphalena parameśvara | prāpto dharmastvayā datto’dhunā śāpena naśyati ||51 | | devā ūcuḥ kratau ghṛtabhujo vayaṃ tvayā kṛtāḥ | yoṣicchāpena vai sarvaṃ nāśaṃ yāti dayāṃ kuru || 52|| iti stuvanti tāvadvai vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī | yūyaṃ gacchata tatraiva yāsyāmyahaṃ hi rakṣaṇe ||53 | | śrutvā hṛṣṭāḥ surā mālāvatīṃ yayurhi tatkṣaṇam | mālāvatī surān dṛṣṭvā praṇanāma pativratā ||54| | ruroda kāntaṃ saṃsthāpya devānāṃ sannidhau priye | etasminnantare kaścit tatra brāhmaṇabālakaḥ ||55 || ājagāma śuklavāsāḥ paṃcāṃgapatrasaṃyutaḥ | satilakaḥ samāgatya sabhāmadhye hyuvāsa saḥ ||56 || uvāca kathamatraite surā brahmādayo’pare | samāyātā namo vo’stu sraṣṭā svayaṃ kathaṃ sthitaḥ ||57|| aho hartā svayaṃ rudro dharmaḥ sākṣī kathaṃ sthitaḥ | kathaṃ raviḥ kathaṃ candraḥ kathamatra hutāśanaḥ ||58|| kathaṃ kālo mṛtyukanyā kathaṃ vātra yamādayaḥ | he mālāvati te kroḍe ko’ti śuklaḥ śavo’dhunā ||59 || iti bruvantaṃ taṃ natvā mālāvatī jagād ha | namo viprasvarūpāya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te ||1.408.6 0|| akasmād brahmaṇaḥ śāpāt prāṇām̐statyāja matpatiḥ | devānuddiśya vilapāmyatha jīvati matpatiḥ ||6 1 || sarvāndevānahaṃ yāce patidānaṃ mamepsitam | yadi dāsyanti devā me kāntadānaṃ yathepsitam ||62|| bhadraṃ tadānyathā tebhyaḥ saṃśapsyāmi ca dāruṇam | durnivāryaḥ satīśāpastapasā kena vāryate ||63|| brāhmaṇastāmuvācedaṃ sati kāle phalet kṛtam | kāle prāptaṃ bhaveccāpi nāgrahastatra yujyate ||64|| yatrādhikāro devānāṃ tattad dadāti nāparam | na balaṃ na ca saundaryaṃ naiśvaryaṃ na dhanaṃ sutaḥ ||65|| naiva strī na ca satkānto labhyate tapasā vinā | prakṛtiṃ sevate yaḥ sa labhet kāntāṃ guṇānvitām ||66|| śriyaṃ ca niścalāṃ putraṃ pautraṃ bhūmiṃ dhanaṃ prajām | śivārcanāt satīṃ kāntāṃ satpatiṃ labhate sa sā ||67|| vidyāṃ jñānaṃ sukavitāṃ putraṃ pautraṃ parāṃ śriyam | balaṃ dhanaṃ vikramaṃ ca mahadaiśvaryamityapi ||68|| brahmārcanāllabhet siddhīrvidyāṃ śriyaṃ prajāstathā | sūyārcanāllabhed vidyāmārogyadhanaputrakān ||69|| gaṇeśasyārcanād vighnanāśaṃ sarvāgrapūjyatām | paramānandamaiśvaryaṃ putraṃ vidyāṃ dhanaṃ prajāḥ ||1.408.70 || viṣṇostu sevayā muktiṃ tapo dharmaṃ yaśaḥ śriyam | dharmasya sevanāt śāntiṃ sukhaṃ dhanaṃ labheta ca ||71 || yo yaṃ devaṃ bhajedbhaktyā sattvādau labhate tu tam | kāle paścāttena sārdhaṃ paraṃ kṛṣṇapadaṃ labhet ||72|| bhajate śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ yaḥ prakṛteḥ param | akṣaraṃ paramaṃ brahma bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ||73 || sākāraṃ ca nirākāraṃ jyotiḥ svecchāmayaṃ vibhum | sarvādhāraṃ ca sarveśaṃ paramānandamīśvaram ||74|| nirliptaṃ sākṣirūpaṃ ca bhaktānugrahavigraham | jīvanmuktaḥ sa satyaṃ vai varaṃ nākāṃkṣati dhruvam |||75|| sa sarvaṃ manute tucchaṃ sālokyādi catuṣṭayam | brahmatvamamaratvaṃ ca loṣṭavattucchavat sati ||76|| aiśvaryaṃ loṣṭatulyaṃ ca naśvaraṃ ceti manyate | jalabudbudavatsarvaṃ jānātyeva vinaśvaram ||77|| dāsyaṃ vinā na yāceta śrīkṛṣṇasya padaṃ param | svapne jāgaraṇe vāpi śaśvat sevāṃ hi vāñcchati ||78|| paripūrṇatamaṃ brahma sevate yaḥ sthiraḥ sadā | ātmanaḥ kulakoṭiṃ sa śataṃ mātāmahasya ca ||79| śvaśurasya śataṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya svaṃ hi līlayā | dāsaṃ dāsīṃ prasūṃ bhāryāṃ putrādapi paraṃ śatam ||1.408.80 | uddhared kṛṣṇabhakto vai golokaṃ dhāma yāti ca | guruvaktrād viṣṇumantro yasya karṇe viśatyapi ||8 1 | yamastallekhanaṃ dūraṃ karoti tatkṣaṇe bhiyā | madhuparkādikaṃ brahmā tadarthaṃ viniyujya ca ||82|| satyaloke’bhito yāti mārgeṇānena yāsyati | niḥśaṃko yāti golokaṃ vihāya mānavīṃ tanum ||83 | | purātanaṃ kṛtaṃ karma yadyat tasya śubhāśubham | chinatti kṛṣṇaścakreṇa tīkṣṇadhāreṇa santatam ||84|| taṃ vihāya jarāmṛtyuryāti cakrabhiyā sati | anyathā śatakhaṇḍaṃ tāṃ kurute tu sudarśanaḥ ||85 | | gatvā divyāṃ tanuṃ dhṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sevate tadā | yāvat kṛṣṇo hi goloke tāvadbhakto vaset sadā ||86 | | nimeṣaṃ manute dāso naśvaraṃ brahmaṇo vayaḥ | vada vinā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nānyaḥ samarthakaḥ ||87|| kena rogeṇa hi mṛto’dhunā sādhvi tava priyaḥ | sarvarogacikitsāṃ ca jānāmyahaṃ cikitsakaḥ ||88 || rājamṛtyuṃ yamaṃ kālaṃ vyādhimānīya te puraḥ | nibaddhya dātuṃ śakto’haṃ vyādho badhvā paśuṃ yathā |||89 || yo vā yogena khedena dehatyāgaṃ karoti ca | tasya taṃ jīvanopāyaṃ jānāmi yogadharmataḥ ||1.408.90 || vipravākyaṃ satī śrutvā kāntabhaktā hyuvāca tam | sarvaṃ kalayituṃ śaktastvaṃ yadi brāhmaṇottama ||91 || kālaṃ yamaṃ mṛtyukanyāṃ madabhyāśe samānaya | mālāvatīvacaḥ śrutvā viṣṇustānāhvayam̐stadā ||92|| dadarśa mṛtyukanyāṃ sā prathamaṃ mālikāvatī | kṛṣṇavarṇāṃ ghorarūpāṃ raktāmbarapradhāriṇīm |||93 || ṣaḍbhujāṃ ca dayāyuktāṃ catuṣṣaṣṭisutānvitām | tataḥ kālaṃ ghorarūpaṃ dadarśa purataḥ satī ||94|| ṣaḍvaktraṃ ṣoḍaśabhujaṃ caturviṃśatilocanam | ṣaṭpādaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ ca raktāmbaradharaṃ varam ||95|| grīṣmasūryasamakāntiṃ sarvasaṃhārarūpiṇam | satī dadarśa purato vyādhisaṃghān sudurjayān ||96 || vayasātimahāvṛddhān yūno bālāṃśca ghātakān | satī dadarśa dharmiṣṭhaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ yamaṃ tathā ||97|| dharmādharmavicārajñaṃ śāstāraṃ pāpināṃ gurum | atha mālāvatī yamaṃ papraccha yuktikovidā ||98 || he dharmarāja dharmiṣṭha kāle hyanāgate’pi me | kāntamakāle tu kathaṃ harasi vada me vibho ||99|| yamaḥ prāhāprāptakālo mriyate na kadācana | īśvarājñāṃ vinā sādhvi nāmṛtaṃ vai nayāmyaham || 1.408.100 || ahaṃ kālo mṛtyukanyā vyādhayaśca sudurjayāḥ | niṣeke nirmitā yasya taṃ harāmo hi tatkṣaṇe || 101 || mṛtyukanyā sahavāsā vijñāpayati yatkṣaṇam | tatkṣaṇe’haṃ kalayāmi pṛcchaināṃ tvatpatikṛte || 102 || mālāvatī tadā prāha mṛtyukanye kathaṃ tvayā | mama kānto hṛto’kāle jīvitāyāṃ mayi priye || 103 | | mṛtyukanyā ca tāṃ prāha sṛṣṭā viśvasṛjātra vai | prāṇaviyojanakārye saṃharāmi yathāpalam || 1 04|| kālena preritā cāhaṃ niṣekeṇa sahasthitā | nityamāyurharāmyeva nātra me dūṣaṇaṃ priye || 1 05 || satī satīnāṃ madhye ca kācittejasvinī yadi | māmapi bhasmasātkartuṃ kṣamā tadā jagat khalu || 106 | | mṛtyukanyāvihīnaṃ saccāmṛtaṃ syānna tvanyathā | ahaṃ tiṣṭhāmi garbhe’pi dehināṃ dehatattvake || 1 07|| nityaṃ nityaṃ saṃharāmi jānanti naiva tajjanāḥ | adya yajjāyate śvastad vṛddhamityeva vartate || 108 || nūtanaṃ jāyate paścājjīrṇa vṛddhaṃ taducyate | nityaṃ nityaṃ hi vārdhakyaṃ sarvatra saṃpravartate || 109 || janā mūḍhāstu modante yuvāhaṃ bālako’smyaham | nāsmi vṛddha ityajñānaṃ jānantyeva na vṛddhatām || 1.408.110 || vṛddhirhi vṛddhatā proktā niṣeko vardhate sadā | garbhe ca vardhate nityaṃ bālyādau ca vivardhate || 111 || vardhate eva nityaṃ na tūno bhavati kaścana | kālapraperitā cāha matputrā vyādhayastathā | | 112 || kurmaḥ kāryaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ na no doṣo’sti vai sati | pṛccha kālaṃ mahātmānamucitaṃ sa kariṣyati || 113 || satī prāha tadā kālaṃ sākṣin vai karmaṇāṃ prabho | kathaṃ harasi matkāntaṃ jīvitāyāṃ mayi prabho || 11 4|| śrutvā mālāvatīduḥkhaṃ kālaḥ prāha satīṃ tadā | ko vāhaṃ ko yamaḥ kā ca mṛtyukanyā tathādhayaḥ || 115 || vayaṃ bhramāmaḥ śrīkṛhaṇādeśasya paripālakāḥ | mūlā prakṛtiryadvāme yatkukṣau viṣṇuśaṃbhvajāḥ || 116 || devatā yannideśasthā dharmo’pi yasya vai vaśe | grahāśca rāśayo yasya dikpālādyāśca vai vaśe || 1 17|| tasyaivāṃśo hyayaṃ kālo mṛtyurmṛtyusutādhayaḥ | ime yatpreritāḥ sarve kurmo yogaviyojane | | 118 | | pṛccha kṛṣṇaṃ śāsako tvaṃ kathaṃ svāmī mṛtastava | ityuktvā virame kālo brāhmaṇastāmuvāca ha | | 119 | | pṛṣṭaḥ kālo yamo mṛtyukanyā vyādhigaṇā api | kaste’dhunā ca sandehastaṃ pṛccha kanyake punaḥ | | 1.408.120 | | mālāvatī tadā prāha kaṃ pṛcchāmyadhunā dvija | yogena prāṇām̐statyāja matpatiḥ śāpahetunā || 121 || adhunā matprāṇakāntaṃ dehi dehi yadi kṛpā | natvā vaḥ svāminā sārdhaṃ yāsyāmi svagṛhaṃ prati || 1 22|| kṛṣṇa kva mārgayāmyatra brāhmaṇaḥ kṛṣṇa eva hi | brāhmaṇo yatkarotyeva kṛṣṇo’nusarati dvijam || 123 || iti dīnavacaḥ śrutvā brāhmaṇo devamadhyagaḥ | uvāca paramaṃ satyaṃ devānprati dayāvaśaḥ || 1 24|| upabarhaṇabhāryeyaṃ putrī citrarathasya ca | yayāce jīvadānaṃ ca svāminaḥ śaraṇāgatā | | 1 25|| tanmāṃ brūta surāścātra kimanuṣṭheyamarthakṛt | śaptukāmā surānsarvān mayā satī nirodhitā || 126 || bahubhirvākpralāpaiścādhunā kiṃ syād vilambane | yuṣmābhirarthito viṣṇuḥ śvetadīpe sa nāgataḥ || 1 27| | babhūvākāśavāṇī ca paścādāyāti keśava | viparītaṃ tu tajjātaṃ yato nāyāti keśavaḥ || 128 || brahmovāca tadā vipraṃ nārado’yaṃ mamātmajaḥ | akāle mama śāpena gandharvastūpabarhaṇaḥ || 1 29|| yogena prāṇām̐statyāja kāle’vaśeṣite’pi vai | tattu varṣasahasraṃ caivāyurasyāsti sāmpratam || 1.408.1 3 0 || dvilakṣaṃ tu gataṃ tasya yaccheṣaṃ pravadāmi tat | yathainaṃ na spṛśecchāpo devāśca nirbhayā yathā || 131 || hariḥ sarvatra cāstyeva nāyāto naiva vidyate | dṛśyādṛśyasvarūpeṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’sti saḥ || 132 || kṛṣṇaḥ kathaṃ na cāyāti viyadvāgapi vai mṛṣā | iti nindaṃ harestasya mā kuru dvija saṃsadi || 133 || kasya śiṣyo munīndrasya kastvaṃ nāmnā ca bho dvija | kva vāsaḥ kuta āyātaḥ kasya vaṃśodbhavo bhavān || 1 34|| viḍambayasi devāṃśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tathā | adhunāpi sabhāṃ viṣṇurnāyāta iti yadvacaḥ || 1 35 || tvayoktaṃ tanna śrotavyaṃ nindātmakaṃ parātmanaḥ | viṣirvyāptirnuśca yāvat viṣṇuḥ sarvatra vyāpakaḥ || 136 || evaṃ sarvatra sattve vai gamanāgamane kutaḥ | mahannindā bhavedyatra naiva sādhuḥ śṛṇoti tām || 1 37|| nindakaḥ śrotṛbhiḥ sārdha kuṃbhīpākaṃ vrajed yugam | viṣṇunindā trividhā vai mūrtikhaṇḍanarūpiṇī || 1 38|| anastitvarūpiṇī ca jīvasāmyasvarūpiṇī | tasyātra niṣkṛtirnāsti yāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam || 1 39|| gurornindāṃ yaḥ karoti piturnindāṃ narādhamaḥ | sa yāti kālasūtraṃ ca yāvaccandradivākarau ||1.408.140|| brāhmaṇastu tadākarṇya devānuvāca vai tadā | kā kṛtā viṣṇunindāho he devā dharmaśālinaḥ || 141 || nāgato hariratreti vyarthākāśasarasvatī | iti proktaṃ mayā bhadraṃ na tadvai nindanaṃ kṛtam || 142 || yūyaṃ vai bhāvukā brūta viṣṇurvyāpaka īśvaraḥ | iticet tatkathaṃ yātāḥ śvetadīpaṃ varāya ca || 143 || aṃśāṃśinorna bhedaścet parameśatadaṃśayoḥ | kalāṃ hitvā niṣevante santaḥ pūrṇatamaṃ katham || 144|| sarvāṃśānāṃ prabhuḥ kṛṣṇo bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ | ūrdhvaṃ ca sarvabrahmāṇḍād vaikuṇṭhaṃ satyameva vai || 145|| caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhe lakṣmīkāntaḥ sanātanaḥ | tasmādūrdhvaṃ ca golokaḥ pañcāśatkoṭiyojanam || 146|| goloke dvibhujaḥ kṛṣṇo rādhākāntaḥ sanātanaḥ | tato’tivyāpako loko’kṣarabrahmātmako’tigaḥ || 147|| paripūrṇatamaṃ brahmaparamaṃ tatra rājate | evaṃ tasya kathamatra nāgamo’dya bhaved brūta || 148|| dhyāyanti vaiṣṇavāḥ santaḥ sevante divyavigraham | yaṃ sevante bhāgavatāḥ santaḥ sādhvyo nirantaram || 149|| yasya vaṃśodbhavo’haṃ ca yasya śiṣyaśca bālakaḥ | so’yaṃ vakti dvijo bhūtvā devasaṃghā nibodhata || 1.408.150 || śīghraṃ jīvaya gandharvaṃ deveśvara sureśvara | vyakte jāte tataḥ kṛṣṇe vāgyuddhe kiṃ prayojanam || 151 || ityuktvā bālako vipraścaturbāhuḥ ramāyutaḥ | lakṣmīśaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmako’bhavattadā || 152|| atha brahmā kamaṇḍalujalaṃ śave dadau tadā | sañcāraṃ manasastasya cakāra sundaraṃ vapuḥ || 153|| jñānadānaṃ dadau śaṃbhurviṣṇurjīvaṃ dadau tataḥ | dharmajñānaṃ svayaṃ dharmo vahnirdadau hi jāṭharam || 154|| kāmo dadau surūpatvaṃ vāyuḥ prāṇān dadau tadā | sūryo dadau netratejo vāṇīṃ dadau ca śāradā || 155|| śobhāṃ dadau tadā śrīśca devā dadurhi tatkriyāḥ | śavastathāpi nottasthau yathā śete jaḍastathā || 156|| brahmovāca tadā sādhvīṃ vayaṃ kṛtamanorathāḥ | atha snātvā ca śrīkṛṣṇānārāyaṇaṃ hṛdi smara || 157|| taṃ vinā nojjīvanaṃ vai jīve tiṣṭhati vāstavam | brahmaṇo vacanāt sādhvī tuṣṭāva parameśvaram || 158|| vande taṃ paramātmānaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam | vinā yena śavāḥ sarve prāṇino’pi nirarthakāḥ ||159|| yadāveśāt sajīvāḥ sakriyāḥ sacetanā yataḥ | sevādhyānaṃ na tadapi ghaṭate vigrahaṃ vinā || 1.408.160 || tādṛśaṃ divyarūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vibhum | tejomaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ koṭigopīgaṇāvṛtam || 161 || atīva kamanīyaṃ ca śyāmaṃ paṃkajalocanam | mandahāsānanaṃ koṭikandarpasundaraṃ prabhum || 162|| dvibhujaṃ pītavastraṃ ca kiśoraṃ rādhikāpatim | lakṣmīśrīpārvatīpadmāpadminīmāṇikīpatim || 163|| pārṣadaiḥ sevitaṃ vande sarvarūpadharaṃ harim | prāṇarūpaṃ patiprāṇaṃ vande jīvātumīśvaram || 164|| āyāhi bhagavam̐ścātra gandharve jeḍacetane | ityuktvā sā tu gāndharvī punaḥ prāha ruṣā satī || 165|| yadi nāyāhi bhagavan kariṣye vai ramādikāḥ | matsadṛśīḥ svāmihīnāstvāṃ ca gandharvasadṛśam || 166|| pātivratyaṃ yadi me’sti satyaṃ tadeti yāvatā | vaktuṃ yāti tadā tāvat kṛṣṇastatrājagāma ha || 167|| mā mā bhetyuktavām̐stredhā satīṃ śāpe niṣidhya vai | praviveśa ca gandharve tāvatso’bhavadutthitaḥ || 168|| utthāya śīghraṃ vīṇāṃ ca dhṛtvā snātvā ca vāsasī | nanāma devān viṣṇuṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tathā || 169|| nanarta ca kṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇa hare govinda vai vadan | nedurdundubhayo devāḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ pracakrire || 1.408.170|| sarve yayuḥ svasvadhāma nārado’pi svayoṣitā | samaṃ mātrā tathā pitrā yayau gandharvapattanam || 171 || mālāvatī ratnakoṭiṃ dadau dhanāni vai satī | bhojanāni ca viprebhyaḥ svastivācamakārayat || 172||| mahotsavaṃ cakārāpi gandharva upabarhaṇaḥ | punarjīvanamāsādya pativratāpradāpitam || 173 || harerbhaktiṃ harerdāsyaṃ cakāra tūpabarhaṇaḥ | yo yā cedaṃ paṭhedvāpi śṛṇuyād bhāvataḥ priye || 174|| tasya tasyāḥ prasaubhāgyaprāptirbhavenna saṃśayaḥ | bhuktirmuktiścaturvargasiddhirbhavedakhaṇḍitā || 175|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmaśāpānnāradasya mṛtyurupabarhaṇākhyagandharvajanmani punarmṛtyustatra tatpatnyā mālāvatyā pātivratyabalena saviṣṇudevānāhūya kālādīnāhūya ca svapatirujjīvita ityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 408 ||
<1.409> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi pātivratyaparāyaṇām | kathāṃ tvāścaryaparamāṃ pūrvayugānusaṃbhavām || 1 || kanyā viśālarājasya vīrā dharmaparāyaṇā | viśālena kṛte svayaṃvare rājanyaśobhite || re || karandhamasya putro vai jigye’vīkṣit svayaṃvarām | atharājanyavargaiḥ sa bahubhirekalo raṇe || 3 || parājitaḥ kumārī sā hutā rājakulaistadā | śrutvā karandhamo yāyātsainyalakṣasamanvitaḥ || 4 || nṛpān hatvā sutaṃ snuṣāṃ nītvā gṛhaṃ yayau punaḥ | avīkṣit pitaraṃ prāha kiṃ yaśo me’vaśiṣyate || 9 || nāhametāṃ gṛhīṣyāmi na cānyāṃ yoṣitaṃ pitaḥ | parairyasyā nirīkṣantyāḥ saṃgrāmehaṃ parājitaḥ || 6 || paraiḥ parājito’haṃ yat kātareyaṃ yathābalā | kimatra mānuṣatvaṃ me pāratantrye sthitasya vai || 7 || nārīmiṣeṇa me yaśohānirjātā parairiha | tasmānnārī na voḍhavyā pāratantryapradāyinī || 8 || ityuktavantaṃ kanyā sāvīkṣitaṃ prāha sundarī | bahupārśvasahāyaistu sarve yuddhyanti līlayā || 9 || ekena bahūnāṃ yuddhaṃ śauryavyañjakameva tat | vikramaste mahān rājan bahubhiḥ saṃparīkṣitaḥ || 1.409.1 0|| ekena saha caikasya yuddhaṃ cet samajāyata | ete yamamahīmānā vyajāyanteti dhāraye || 11 || ajeyo’yaṃ mahāvīro bahubhirmilitairjitaḥ | atrārthastu sphuṭo bhāti yuddhe te’pyakhilā jitāḥ || 1 2|| śauryavikramasaṃyuktamimaṃ sarvamahīkṣitaḥ | dharmayuddhamadharmeṇa jitavanto’tra kā trapā || 13 || tasmādayaṃ nirmito me nānyo me bhavitā patiḥ | yadi rājanya cenmāṃ tve na gṛhṇāsi pativratām || 14|| kṛtvā tapaśceha divi tvāṃ sampatsye hi viddhi tat | varaṃ vṛṇomyahaṃ nātha māṃ bhavānyadi necchati || 15|| tapaso’nyo na me bhartā janmanyasmin bhaviṣyati | evamukte’pyavīkṣiti nirmanaske vyalokite || 16 || kanyā jagāma tapase vairāgyaṃ paramāsthitā | nirāhārāstrimāsā vai gatāścāsyā tataḥ punaḥ || 17|| dehatyāgāya sannaddhā jñātvā devāstadantikam | dūtaṃ saṃpreṣayāmāsurmātyājyo deha āha tām || 18|| tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi kalyāṇi jananī cakravartinaḥ | putreṇārayo hantavyā mlecchā duṣṭāśca dasyavaḥ || 1 9|| pālanīyaṃ bhūtalaṃ ca dharme sthāpyāstataḥ prajāḥ | yaṣṭavyaṃ vividhairyajñaiḥ ṣaṭsāhasraiśca saṃkhyayā ||1.409.20 || satyaṃ vinā patiṃ putraḥ kathaṃ me syāduvāca sā | avīkṣitamṛte bhartā nānyo me cātra janmani ||21 || sa ca necchati māṃ vīro bodhito’pi virāgavān | dūtaḥ prāha vane tiṣṭha dehaṃ poṣaya bhāmini ||22|| tapaḥprabhāvāt sarvaṃ te mano’bhīṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati | ityuktvā devadūtaḥ sa yayau dehaṃ pupoṣa sā ||23 || athāvīkṣitprasūḥ prāha pitā te vṛddhatāṃ gataḥ | ekastvaṃ tanayo’vīkṣit tyaktadāraparigrahaḥ ||24|| pitari svargate tyayyaputre ca pṛthivīmimām | tavāripakṣaḥ putrātra vaṃśakṣaye prabhokṣyati ||25|| vaṃśakṣaye ca pitaraḥ śrāddhapiṇḍodakakṣayāḥ | patiṣyanti niraye tat kuru pitrupakāritām |||26 || pautrasya darśaya sukhaṃ haṭhaṃ sarvaṃ parityaja | naiṣṭhikatāṃ parityaja dāradharmaṃ samācara ||27|| kulanāśe samāpanne pāpāya brahmacāritā | kuloddhārakaraṃ gṛhavrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vipadgṛhe || 28|| ityādimātṛvacanaṃ svīcakāra tathāstviti | atha yāto vanaṃ tatra mṛgayāmacarad vane ||29|| śuśrāva sahasā śabdaṃ trāhi trāhīti yoṣitaḥ | mā bhairmā bhairiti vadan rājaputraśca tāṃ yayau ||1.409.3 0 || sā covāca gṛhītā dānavena bhayavihvalā | karandhamasutasyāhaṃ bhāryā sādhvī hyavīkṣitaḥ ||3 1 || hriyate rakṣasā paśya tāpasī vanavāsinī | ityākarṇya tadāvīkṣit śaravarṣairavākirat ||32|| daṇḍairvṛkṣaiśca pāṣāṇairbhallaiścānyāyudhaistadā | yuddhaṃ tayorabhūdghoraṃ vīrā vīraṃ samāśritāḥ ||33|| tapobhāgaṃ dadātyasmai vijayārthaṃ jalena vai | pātivratyaprabhāveṇa satyadārḍhyavṛṣeṇa ca ||34|| avīkṣito’vanaṃ sādhvī karoti samare tadā | kumāro’pi balaṃ prāptaściccheda daityamastakam ||35||| sā tu hetikṣatadehaṃ siṣeve svāminaṃ satī | vane prāha tapaḥ sarvaṃ tathā svapne’pi lokitam ||36 || parahyo’haṃ sunidrāyāṃ snātuṃ gaṃgāhradaṃ gatā | vikṛṣṭā kenacit tatra jalāntarmagnatāṃ gatā ||37|| tato rasātalaṃ nītā tatra nāgāstadaṃganāḥ | sahasraśastuṣṭuvurmāṃ yayācire surakṣaṇam ||38|| aparādhaṃ kariṣyanti sarpāstava sutasya vai | kṣantavyaṃ tat nivāryaḥ saḥ prasādaṃ kriyatāmiti ||39|| tatheti ca mayā prokte pūjitā prāpitā vanam | dṛṣṭo’tra rājaputro’vīvikṣit patiryo hi manmataḥ ||1.409.40|| tāvannidrā gatā dṛṣṭaṃ vanaṃ prātaḥ sumaṃgalam | nīlakaṇṭhaḥ priyāyuktaḥ samāgatya madantike ||41 || prātarnṛtyaṃ cakārātra vāmāṃgaṃ me’sphurattadā | vāmanitambaguhyādibhāgāścāpyasphuram̐stataḥ ||42|| śukaḥ śukīsametaścāmṛtapakvaphalaṃ tadā | cañcvā gṛhītvā nyakṣipat madaṃke vyomato bruvan ||43|| gatahyaśca prage śvetahastī dṛṣṭo’tra kānane | kareṇunā ca kalabhairyuktaḥ kamaladhṛk kare ||44|| mama pāṇiṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ tavāsmi nāparasya vai | ityuktaḥ saḥ prāha bhadraṃ bhavatvevaṃ vidhikṛtam ||45|| tadā patiprāṇayā vai tayā saṃsmārito guruḥ | tumburustatra cāyāto homaṃ cakre vidhānataḥ ||46|| tasyāḥ pāṇigrahaṃ cakre cāvīkṣit vanamadhyataḥ | tadā tatra samāyātā devāḥ puṣpāṇi sasṛjuḥ ||47|| sasvanurdivyavādyāni nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ | prajagurdevagandharvāḥ prasannā vanadevatāḥ ||48|| upajahrustayostatra munigandharvakinnarāḥ | bhakṣyānulepanavastrasrakpānādikamuttamam ||49|| sa reme sahitastanvyā sā ca tena hyavīkṣitā | yayau rājyagṛhe svasya pitrorabhavadutsavaḥ ||1.409.50|| dadau dānāni sarvāṇi pautrārthaṃ pitarau tadā | atha vyomnā yayau bhāryāsahito meruparvatam ||51 || tayā ca ramatastasya bhāminyā saha śobhane | gandharvaloke vīrasya putraṃ sā suṣuve satī ||52|| babhūva putre sañjāte gandharvāṇāṃ mahotsavaḥ | jaguḥ kecittathaivānye mṛdaṃgapaṭahānakān ||53 || avādayanta vādyāṃśca veṇuvīṇāmayūrakān | nanṛtuśca tadutsāhe bahavo’psarasā gaṇāḥ ||54|| puṣpavṛṣṭimuco meghā jagarjurmṛdunisvanāḥ | dampatībhyāṃ smṛtastatrājagāma tumburuḥ svayam ||55|| atiprasanno manasā jātakarmākarottadā | cakre svastyayanaṃ tasya bālasya stutipūrvakam ||56|| cakravartī mahāvīryo mahābāhurmahābalaḥ | svastimān stāt aśeṣāyāḥ kṣiteḥ śāstā satīpatiḥ ||57|| ime śakrādayaḥ sarve lokapālāstatharṣayaḥ | svasti kurvantu te vīra vīryaṃ cārivināśanam ||58|| maruttava śivāyāstu vāti pūrvo na yo rajaḥ | marut te vimalo’kṣīṇo’vaiṣamyāyāstu dakṣiṇaḥ ||59|| paścimaste marud vīryamuttamaṃ te prayacchatu | balaṃ yacchatu cotkṛṣṭaṃ marut te ca tathottaraḥ ||1.409.6 0|| iti svastyayane gururabravīt maruttaṃ hi tam | marutto’yaṃ samabhavat khyātaḥ suto maharṣibhiḥ ||6 1 || maruttaṃ ca samādāya dampatī svagṛhaṃ gatau | gandharvadevamunibhiḥ saha rājñaḥ samīpataḥ ||6 2|| bālaṃ nyasya pitustvaṃ ke natvā vṛttaṃ ca sarvathā | nivedayāmāsatuśca rājāpi pautradarśanāt ||63 || sabhāgyo’smītyathātmānaṃ praśaśaṃsa punaḥ punaḥ | rājñī cāpi putraputraṃ dṛṣṭvā mumoda harṣitā ||64|| tataḥ pure mahānāsīdānandaḥ pauraveśmasu | rājāpi vasuratnāni go’laṃkārāndadau tadā ||65 || putraṃ rājye’bhiṣicyaiva sabhāryo vanamāviśat | tatra varṣasahasraṃ sa tepe vai dāruṇaṃ tapaḥ ||66 || vihāya dehaṃ nṛpatiḥ śakrasyāpa salokatām | patnī varṣaśataṃ sthitvā tamevāpa patiṃ divi ||67|| athāvīkṣit bahūn yajñān iyāja svāptadakṣiṇān | tasyāpratihataṃ cakramāsīd dvīpeṣu saptasu ||68||| putrastasya marutto’pi cakre yajñān śatāyutān | sauvarṇau muñjavānnāma parvataścāhṛtastataḥ ||6 9 || suvarṇaṃ sarvathā dattaṃ tṛptyā tyaktaṃ ca bhūsuraiḥ | prāsādādi samastaṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ tasya yatkratau ||1.409.70|| viprāṇāṃ pariveṣṭāro devā hyāsam̐śca tanmahe | yajñabhūmau tadā hyāsan viśve devāḥ sabhāsadaḥ ||71 || sādhyā maruto vasavo rudrā ādityakāstathā | nidhayaḥ ṛṣayaścāsya karmacārāstadābhavan ||72|| ṛtvik tasya tu saṃvarto babhūvāṃgirasaḥ sutaḥ | bhrātā vṛhaspatervipro devānāmagraṇīstadā ||73 || athaurvasya ṛṣerāśramottame nāgarāṭ tadā | upadravaṃ cakārāsya nāśārthaṃ jagṛhe dhanuḥ || 74|| tathā kopānmahadastraṃ saṃvartakaṃ dadhāra ca | marutto nāgarājānāṃ cakre tena ca mardanam ||75 || samāgacchatpunaḥ svasya rājyaṃ pṛthvyāṃ śaśāsa ca | tasya mātā satī vīrā pitāvīkṣit vanaṃ gatau ||76 || svargaṃ prāptau pātivratyapatnīvratasamuddhṛtau | maruttabhāryā vidarbhatanayā ca prabhāvatī ||77|| suvīraputrī sauvīrī dvitīyābhūt subhāminī | ketuvīryasutā keśī tṛtīyābhūt subhāminī ||78|| madrarājasutā cāsīt kekayī tu caturthikā | sindhurājasutā bhāryāṃ saurandhrī pañcamī hyabhūt ||79|| cedirājasutā cābhūd bhāryā ṣaṣṭhī sulocanā | tāsāṃ pativratānāṃ tu putrā aṣṭādaśābhavan ||1.409.80|| teṣāṃ pradhāno jyeṣṭhaśca nariṣyanto nṛpo’bhavat | ete tu vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve rājñyaḥ satyo’bhavan śubhāḥ ||81 || mahābhāgavato vaṃśaḥ svasvadharmaparāyaṇaḥ | abhajadbhagavantaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ||82|| dhanadārā na vai bhuṃkte śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamantarā | sarvaṃ svātmārpaṇaṃ cakre śrīkṛṣṇe paramātmani ||83 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ devyaḥ patirūpamupasthitam | matvā sevāṃ prakurvanti patnīrlakṣmīśca te tathā ||84|| evaṃ viṣṇusamāste vai hyāsan pṛthvyāṃ mahīkṣitaḥ | patnyo lakṣmīsamāṃścāsan vaiṣṇavyo rājayoṣitaḥ ||85 || ekadābhūnmahāviṣṇoḥ pūjāyāṃ samaruttakaḥ | rudrastatra samāyāto dhyānamagne tu rājani ||88 || satyevaṃ na ca saṃprāptaḥ rudraḥ satkāramityataḥ | cukopāsyātivegena hantuṃ śūlaṃ vicikṣipe ||87|| hṛdaye lagnamevaitad rājño’sūn hṛd vidārya tat | vijahāra tadā sādhvī vaidarbhī tu prabhāvatī ||88|| haste jalaṃ samagrāhyovāca yadyahamaṃjasā | ājīvanaṃ patisevākartrī cāsmi pativratā ||89|| tena satyena rudro’yaṃ mṛtiṃ yātu punaḥ punaḥ | yadi devāḥ pūjitāścātithayaścāpi satkṛtāḥ ||1.409.90 || prasāditaḥ patirnityaṃ śūlaṃ dūraṃ śanairbhavet | yadi śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ kṛtā sevā suśraddhayā | |91 || prasāditaṃ bhartṛkulaṃ patihṛtsandhitaṃ bhavet | gṛhadharmaparā nityaṃ patidevā bhavāmi cet ||92|| patnīvrataḥ patirme cet sajīvo bhavatu priyaḥ | sapatnyaḥ svasṛvannityaṃ mānitāstoṣitā yadi ||93 || mātṛvatpūjitāścāpi duhitṛvatsurakṣitāḥ | tena puṇyena me pāpaṃ rudranāśānna vai bhavet ||94|| ityuktavatī ca yathā tathā sarvaṃ vyavartata | hāhākāro mahānāsīd rudranāśo’tiduḥsahaḥ ||95|| maruttena tadā sādhvī cānunītāti bhāminī | rudrasyojjīvanārthaṃ vai tadā śāntāvadatpatim ||96|| samujjīvaya deveśaṃ nātha rudraṃ tu vaiṣṇavam | avaiṣṇavāśca ye rudrāste tu kalpe prakalpake ||97|| brahmamālāsamutpannā nāśameṣyanti vai dhruvam | iti śāpo mama rudre kalpādau tu punaḥ punaḥ || 18 || krūrarudrasamutsarge tān sprakṣyati muhurmuhuḥ | vaiṣṇavastu mahārudraḥ sthāsyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 99|| jalamāmantrya bhasmaiva kurvārdraṃ tata eva saḥ | marutteśvara īśo’sau samujjīvo bhaviṣyati || 1.409.100 || ityukto marutaḥ patnyā gṛhītvā jalameva ca | yadyahaṃ tvājīvanaṃ vai patnīvrataparāyaṇaḥ || 101 || prajādharmo rājadharmācyuto’smi vaiṣṇavaḥ sadā | bahucchidrakṛto’dharmo yadi spṛṣṭo na māṃ kvacit || 1 02|| tena puṇyena rudro’yaṃ vaiṣṇavo jīvatāt khalu | yadi patnī satī bhāryā prabhāvatī yathā mama || 1 03|| tathā patnyo’parāścāpi pūrṇāḥ pativratāḥ khalu | ahaṃ tāsāṃ samavartī pakṣapātaṃ na cācaram || 104|| tena puṇyena rudro’yaṃ satriśūlaḥ prajīvatu | ityuktvā pradadau vāri bhasmani yāvadeva tu || 105|| tāvat saumyo mahārudraḥ sajīvo’bhavadagrataḥ | vanditaḥ pūjitaḥ so’tha kṣamāpito muhurmuhuḥ || 1 06|| rudreṇāpi satī sādhvī prabhāvatī prasāditā | rājā prasāditaścāpi rājñārcitaḥ suvanditaḥ || 1 07|| marutteśvararūpeṇa tasthau tadbhavane haraḥ | divyarūpeṇa ca yayau kailāsaṃ śaṃkarastadā || 1 08|| māhātmyaṃ pātivratyasya viveda pārvatīṃ jagau | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi mahāpuṇyapradaṃ vratam || 1 09|| śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya sarvayajñaphalaṃ bhavet | kathāyāḥ smaraṇāccāpi bhuktimuktiphalaṃ bhavet || 1.409.110 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye’vīkṣitnṛpapatnyā vīrāyā maruttasya ca patnyāḥ prabhāvatyāśca pātivratyacamatkāre rākṣasanāśo rudranāśasajīvanate cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||409||
