patnī bhavitā ca tadā viṣṇuryāsyati te gṛham || 8 || devakāryakaro bhūtvā prayāsyati svakaṃ padam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so’yaṃ rāmanāmā bhaviṣyati || 9 || ye tu rāmasya śaraṇaṃ yāsyanti bhūtale janāḥ | te’pi muktiṃ prayāsyanti vāsudevapratāpataḥ || 1.425.10 || bhāvanā prema bhaktiśca snehaścārdratvamityapi | viśiṣyate harau kriyātmakāt kāṇḍāditi sthitiḥ || 11 || karmaṇo jñānamutkṛṣṭaṃ jñānād dhyānaṃ tathottamam | dhyānācca bhāvanā śreṣṭhā bhāvataḥ sneha uttamaḥ || 3 2|| sakāmasnehataḥ śreṣṭho niṣkāmaḥ sneha eva yat | snehācchreṣṭhaḥ prahvībhāvastadrūpaṃ tadrasātmatā || 1 3||| na tato’dhikamevāsti kiñcid vipra harau sadā | śṛṇu tatra kathāṃ ramyāṃ dānād bhāvo viśiṣyate || 1 4|| kāñcīpuryāṃ purā rājā colanāmābhavad vratī | vaiṣṇavo dānakṛd rakṣākaraḥ prajāsu vanditaḥ || 1 5|| devapūjākaro nityaṃ yadrājye sukhinī prajā | tāmraparṇītaṭe yena yajñāśca bahavaḥ kṛtāḥ || 1 6|| vimānena sa nṛpatirlokāntaraṃ prayāti ca | evaṃ vimānamāruhya yayau śvetākhyadhāma saḥ || 1 7|| tataḥ kṣīrābdhiśayanaṃ dhāma yogena saṃyayau | anantaśayanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tu nidritam || 18|| cakāra daṇḍavattāvannārāyaṇaḥ samutthitaḥ | śrīpatiṃ pūjyāmāsa maṇiyuktāphalādibhiḥ || 1 9|| supatraiśca suvarṇasya kusumairhīrakādibhiḥ | dhūpadīpasunaivedyairvastrairvibhūṣaṇaistathā || 1.425.20 || divyaiḥ ratnāyutaiścāpi pupūja parameśvaram | evaṃ sampūjya sannatvopaviṣṭaḥ sannidhau hareḥ ||2 1 || tāvattasyaiva rājyasya brāhmaṇo viṣṇudāyakaḥ | tulasīṃ ca jalaṃ puṣpaṃ nītvā pūjārthamāgataḥ| ||22|| tenāpi śrīhareḥ pūjā kṛtā patrādivastubhiḥ | hīrakādyāstayā channāḥ patrapuṣpādibhiḥ khalu |||23|| ācchādināṃ svakṛtpūjāṃ vilokya nṛpatistadā | vipraṃ prāha kathaṃ svarṇamāṇikyādisuśobhitā ||24|| pūjā kṛtā mayā vipra tvayā vai chāditā dalaiḥ | gauravaṃ naiva jānāsi na jānāsi prapūjanam ||25|| mūlyaṃ nāpi gaṇayasi śraiṣṭhyaṃ karoṣyanuttamam | patrādikaṃ nikṛṣṭaṃ tu karoṣi tūttamaṃ dvija ||26 || ityuktaḥ sa dvijastatra caulaṃ prāha subhāvavān | rājan viṣṇoḥ sadā pūjā bhāvanāsahitā priyā ||27|| garvayuktāhaṃkṛtisthā na priyā jāyate’nagha | tvayā tu kriyate pūjā ratnasvarṇādipuṣpakaiḥ ||28|| mayāpi kriyate saiva tulasīdalavāribhiḥ | mama pūjā tava pūjā bhāvanāto viśiṣyate ||29|| vada rājan nṛpalakṣmyā tvayā kiṃkiṃ kṛtaṃ vratam | mayā kṛtaṃ na vai kiñcid vad tvaṃ cet kṛtaṃ mahat ||1.425.3 0|| tadā caulaḥ sagarvastu prāha vipraṃ kṛtaṃ tu yat | mayā kṛtaṃ svarṇadānaṃ ratnahīrakadānakam ||3 1 || godānāni hyanantāni yajñāśca bahavaḥ kṛtāḥ | pūjane śrīharernityaṃ samarpayāmi hīrakān || 32|| nirdhanasya tava bhaktyā mama bhaktirviśiṣyate | tvayā yajñaḥ kṛto naiva devālayo na vā kṛtaḥ ||33 || mayā sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ vipra paśya yajñāntaraṃ punaḥ | kariṣyāmi gamiṣyāmi sākṣātkāraṃ hareḥ purā ||34|| viprā jñāsyanti ye bhaktiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ tadaiva nānyathā | pūrvaṃ sākṣātkaraṇārthaṃ viṣṇuyāgaṃ karomyaham ||35|| ityuktvā śrīhariṃ natvā yayau caulapradeśakān | caulaḥ samārabhad yajñaṃ kṛtvācāryaṃ tu mudgalam ||36 || satyalokāttata ūrdhvād vairājā brahmacāriṇaḥ | munayaḥ ṛṣayo vṛddhāḥ pitaraśca surāstathā ||37|| yajñāśca devagandharvā mānavāścāpi bhūsurāḥ | nadā nadaśca tīrthāni taravo vallikāstathā ||38|| puryaḥ kṣetrāṇi caityāni pātālabhūgatāni ca | tārakāṇi prakṛṣṭāni vaiṣṇavā devatāstathā ||39|| devyaḥ sarvāḥ sarvadhāmanivāsā muktanāyakāḥ | ākāritā nṛpatinā vaiṣṇave svakṛte kratau ||1.425.40|| svarṇaṃ dravyaṃ hīrakādi sarvaṃ tatra samarpitam | vastrānnapeyabhogyāni samarpitāni sarvaśaḥ ||41 || ṛṣīṇāṃ vedasaṃghoṣā hyāsaṃstatra mahādhvare | viprāṇāṃ mūrtayastatra santuṣṭā hyabhavanmakhe ||42|| vahnayastṛptimāpannā muktā devāḥ pratoṣitāḥ | muditāścābhavan satyo devyo brahmāṇḍayoṣitaḥ |||43 || kṛto yajño mahān sarvalokeṣu khyāta eva saḥ | kintu garvāt kṛto naiva niṣkāmabhāvataḥ kṛtaḥ ||44|| spardhayā yatkṛtaṃ cāpi matsareṇāpyatherṣyayā | tatsarvaṃ na phalavat syād yathā niṣkāmajaṃ phalam ||45|| viṣṇudāso harerdevālaye cakāra sevanam | śarīreṇa ca bhāvena hareḥ saṃsnapanaṃ tathā ||46|| prabodhanaṃ pūjanaṃ ca śṛṃgāraṃ dhūpadīpanam | tulasīpatradānaṃ ca jalābhiṣekamarcanam ||47|| puṣpapatraphalārghyānāmarpaṇaṃ candanārpaṇam | akṣatakuṃkumadānaṃ śrīphalādyarpaṇaṃ tathā ||48|| nīrājanaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ stutiṃ daṇḍavadādikam | kṣamāyācanamevāpi kīrtanaṃ śravaṇaṃ tathā ||49|| mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ guṇapragānaṃ ca nivedanam | tāmbūlakaṃ jalaṃ sugandhivaddravyārpaṇaṃ tathā ||1.425.50 || vyajanena pavanasya dānaṃ cāmaradhāraṇam | chatrasandhāraṇaṃ cāpi yathartusevanādikam ||51 || puṣpavāṭīṃ tathā kṛtvā puṣpahārādikaṃ śubham | tulasīvāṭikāṃ kṛtvā haryarthaṃ jalasecanam ||52|| evaṃ snehena bhāvena divāniśaṃ hareḥ prabhoḥ | pātivratyaparāṃ bhaktimakarod viṣṇudāsakaḥ ||53|| ekādaśyādidivasān japayuktān vratāni ca | saṃyamena mahābhaktyā kṛṣṇasaṃsmaraṇena ca |||54|| pūjayā ṣoḍaśavastukṛtayā nṛtyagītibhiḥ | bhāvātisevayā sannirgamayatyeva sarvathā ||55|| paśyan śṛṇvan spṛśan jighran rasayan saṃvadannapi | gṛhṇan gacchan śayānaśca stavan dhyāyan viniścayan ||56 || cintayan mānayam̐ścāpyanubhavan bhāvayam̐stathā | smaran saṃpratyabhijānan saṃśayāno viparyayan ||57 || tarkayan cetayan cecchan viṣṇumeva hi vartate | sarvatrātmakṛtāvāsaṃ vidan viṣṇumacintayat ||58|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya oṃ namonamaḥ | evaṃ ṣoḍaśavarṇārṇaṃ gṛṇan viṣṇumayo hyabhūt| ||59|| brāhmaṇasya sadā sevāṃ gṛhṇāti bhagavān svayam | rājño yajñaṃ hutadravyaṃ gṛhṇāti bhagavān svayam ||1.425.6 0|| brāhmaṇasyābhavad dṛśyo rājñastvadṛśya īśvaraḥ | bhāvābhāvau tathā garvāgarvau tatra hi kāraṇe ||6 1 || ekadā viṣṇudāsena nityamiva mahānase | kṛto miṣṭānnapākaścāhastvaṃ ko’pyalakṣitaḥ ||62|| pūjāvighnaṃ ca madhyāhne punaḥ pāke bhavediti | vicārya na punaḥ pākaḥ kṛto na bubhuje svayam ||63 || phalaṃ jalaṃ ca naivedye’rpitavān śārṅgiṇe hi saḥ | dvitīye’pi dine tadvat kṛtaṃ pākaṃ jahāra ha ||64|| tṛtīye’pi dine tadvat pākaṃ jahāra mādhavaḥ | evaṃ saptadinānyeva pākaṃ jahre’rpaṇaṃ vinā ||65|| cintāturo dvijastasthau rakṣārthaṃ pākasannidhau | pākaṃ kṛtvā gṛhakoṇe kāṣṭhapāṣāṇahastakaḥ ||66|| upoṣitaśca saptāhaṃ dadarśa pākahāriṇam | cāṇḍālaṃ malinaṃ kaṃcit kṣudhitaṃ śuṣkadehakam ||67|| dvijo dṛṣṭvā dayāyukto jātastasmin hariṃ smaran | uvāca tiṣṭha mā rūkṣaṃ bhuṃkṣva ghṛtaṃ gṛhāṇa vai ||68|| ityuktavantaṃ taṃ vipra dṛṣṭvā dudrāva bhītitaḥ | patito mūrchitastatra taṃ gatvā viṣṇudāsakaḥ ||69|| jalaṃ dadau pavanaṃ ca vastrāntena vyamūrchayat | tāvat sa utthito viṣṇuścaturbhujadharo’bhavat ||1.425.70|| sākṣāt śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ caturbhujaṃ harim | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakaustubhādivirājitam ||71 || pratyakṣaṃ śrīhariṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇudāso’tigadgadaḥ | babhūva premapūrṇaśca stotuṃ vaktuṃ na cāśakat ||72|| atha yajñe sthitā devāḥ kratuṃ tyaktvā samāyayuḥ | caularājñā tu te pṛṣṭhāḥ kva gamyate sureśvaraiḥ ||73 || te prāhurviṣṇudāsāya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | sākṣātkāraṃ darśanaṃ vai dadau tatra hi sannidhau ||74|| pragacchāmo darśanārthaṃ āyāsyāmaśca satvaram | ityuktvā te yayustatra yatra caturbhujo hariḥ ||75|| devāścakrustavaṃ tasya gandharvāpsaraso jaguḥ | nanṛturdevagandharvā āśiṣaḥ ṛṣayo daduḥ ||76 || gītavāditramodāḍhyaṃ sthānaṃ tattvabhavattadā | yajñāḥ sarvadevādyāścaturdaśabhuvāṃ janāḥ ||77|| sarve samāyayustatra tīrthādyā vahnayo’pi ca | yajñasthānaṃ tadā riktaṃ jātaṃ devairvinā kṣaṇam ||78|| devālayasya nikaṭe viṣṇuḥ prāheśvarādikān | bhaktyā ca sevayā snehabhāvayā premapūrayā ||79|| tuṣṭo’haṃ viṣṇudāsasyāgarvasya kiṃkarasya me | sākṣātkāro mama tasya śīghraṃ jāto’sti devatāḥ ||1.425.80 || nāhaṃ bahuvidhairdravyaiḥ sagarvasyāntikapragaḥ | sākṣātsvadarśanaprado bhavāmīti viniścayaḥ ||81 || ityuktvā bhagavān viṣṇurāśliṣya viṣṇudāsakam | samāropya vimāne sve nināya dhāma śāśvatam ||82|| caularājo dadarśainaṃ yāntaṃ śrīviṣṇumandiram | śīghraṃ tadāhvayāñcakre guruṃ mudgarameva saḥ ||83|| jagāda ca muniṃ tatra yadarthaṃ yajñamārabhe | yatspardhayā sarvadravyaṃ yajñe mayā samarpitam ||84|| sa tu pūrvaṃ hariṃ prāpya yayau vaikuṇṭhameva ha | tvayā yajñaḥ karmakāṇḍātmako naiva hi pāryate |||85||| kartavyasya phalaṃ naiva mayā prāgatra cārjitam | tasmād dhanaṃ kraturdānaṃ sarvaṃ na toṣayeddharim ||86|| haristu bhāvabhaktyaiva bhajanena japena ca | smaraṇena prasannaḥ sa bhavatīti viniścitam ||87|| kuru yajñasyetibhāvaṃ gṛhāṇa dakṣiṇāṃ guro | yāhi gṛhaṃ samāyātān prasthāpya dattadakṣiṇān ||88|| ahaṃ gacchāmi ca paścāt samārādhanahetave | bhaktyā tuṣyati bhakteśo na yajñairdānavistaraiḥ ||89|| prasādane harereṣo vipro jāto nidarśanam | ityuktvā rājyabhāraṃ ca bhāgineye visṛjya ca ||1.425.90|| yayau yajñaṃ hariṃ samārādhayituṃ janādhipaḥ | vahnikuṇḍāgrataḥ sthitvā dadau havanadravyakam ||91 || viṣṇo bhaktiṃ sadā dehi manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ | uccaistrivārametadvai samuccārya hariṃ smaran || 92|| sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ rājā vāhnikuṇḍe’patattadā | hāhākāro mahān jāto viṣṇuścāvirabhūttadā || 93 || nṛpaṃ caturbhujaṃ kṛtvā samādāya vimānake | vaikuṇṭhamanayadbhūpaṃ pārṣadatvaṃ dadau hariḥ ||94|| pātivratyaparayā ca bhaktyā tuṣṭo hariḥ svayam | mayi tuṣṭo nṛpe tuṣṭaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||95|| dharmadatta sa evāhaṃ viṣṇudāso’smi pārṣadaḥ | puṇyaśīlābhidhānaśca rājā suśīlanāmakaḥ ||96|| āvāṃ tvatrāgatau netuṃ kalahāṃ rāmakāraṇāt | vaikuṇṭhaṃ tāṃ tava puṇyānnītvā te rājajanmani ||97| daśarathābhidhāne ca kalahā kaikayī tadā | bhaviṣyati tṛtīyā te patnī dharmāṃśabhāginī ||98|| rathacakranābhimadhye hastaṃ nikṣipya yāsyati | pātivratyaparāṃ dṛṣṭvā tvaṃ tu mohaṃ gamiṣyasi ||99|| varadānāya sā coktā bhaviṣyatkālayogi tat | yathecchaṃ dānameveyaṃ nyāsavat kārayiṣyati ||1.425.1 00 || prāpte rāmasyābhiṣeke rākṣasānāṃ vināśane | preritā viṣṇunā rāme vanyatvamarthayiṣyati || 101 || rāvaṇādivināśaśca sītāchāyāmiṣeṇa vai | bhaviṣyati tatastvaṃ ca punarvaikuṇṭhameṣyasi || 1 02|| iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ bhāvivṛttāntavartanam | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya vaikuṇṭhe gamanaṃ bhavet || 103 || śṛṇu lakṣmi caularājye’bhiṣiktasya nṛpasya tu | paṭṭarājñyāśca nādyāpi putre rājyābhiṣecanam || 1 04|| svasrīyasyeva tadrājye jāyate nvabhiṣecanam | kalau prajāyāḥ śāstau ca pradhānaḥ svasṛjo bhavet || 1 05|| athāpi śṛṇu kalyāṇi bhaktaścaulanṛpo yadā | svasyaiva hananaṃ cakre viprāstadā tu mudgalam || 1 06|| jahasuśca tiraścakrurdhikkāraṃ ca dadustadā | asāmarthyaṃ jagaduśca rājahatyākaraṃ jaguḥ || 1 07|| śrutvā śrutvā mudgaro’pi kraddhaḥ prajvalitāntaraḥ | yāvatpravartate kuṇḍe patirtu tāvadeva tu || 1 08|| bhūsuraiḥ sudṛḍhaṃ samyag dhṛto nyāyena vāritaḥ | rājñyā tadyoṣitā cānyaiḥ ruddho balātprayatnakaiḥ || 1 09|| tadā krodhena hastābhyāṃ svajaṭāmudapāṭayat | śikhāṃ jaṭāṃ samutpāṭyājuhāva vahnimaṇḍale || 1.425.11 0|| tena cādyāpi tadgotre viśikhāḥ santi bhūsurāḥ | atha te niṣkṛtiṃ cakruryayuḥ sarve nijālayam || 111 | iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne harau pātivratyena colarājaviṣṇudāsayoḥ suśīlapuṇyaśīlanāmakaviṣṇupārṣadarūpatā, saurāṣṭrīyakalahāyāḥ kaikeyīrūpatā, dharmadattasya daśarathajanmādivṛtāntakathananāmā pañcaviṃśatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||425||
<1.426> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ākarṇaya mahālakṣmi gokule gopakanyakāḥ | cakrurvrataṃ pātivratyātmakaṃ kṛṣṇasya labdhaye || 1 kumārikā mahādivyā devyo dhāmādhivigrahāḥ | dṛśyante bhūtale bhūvadvigrahā vāstavaṃ na tat || 2 sarvā rādhāsamā divyāḥ śrīsamā brahmamūrtikāḥ | nāṇvapi kṛṣṇasārūpyād bhedastāsu hi vidyate || 3 || garbho janma ca bālātvaṃ gaurītvaṃ ca tataḥ punaḥ | rohiṇītvaṃ kanyakātvaṃ kārṣṇīnāṃ divyameva tat || 4 || carmanetrāḥ svavat sarve lokayanti na tattathā | tāsāṃ kṛṣṇapatiprāptikṛdviceṣṭanameva yat || 5 || kṛṣṇapativratāḥ sarvāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapriyāḥ | kṛṣṇārthakṛtasarvasvāḥ kinnu vai tāsu varṇyate || 6 || tābhirjātismarābhiścārthitaḥ kṛṣṇo hi sarvadā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastāsāṃ svapne prātaradṛśyata || 7 || vihasan bhāvamājñāya pātivratyakratuṃ dadau | tāstu kṛṣṇanideśena cakruḥ pativratākratum || 8 || mārgaśīrṣe vṛṣamāse kurvantu matpriyaṃ vratam | ahaṃ prāpto bhaviṣyāmi pūrayiṣye manorathān || 9 || svātmārthaṃ ca yathā sarvaṃ madarthaṃ sarvameva tat | priyaṃ sarvaṃ prakurvantu tūrṇaṃ bhavāmi vaḥ patiḥ || 1.426.1 0|| ityuktānāṃ tu kanyānāṃ pātivratyasya sarvathā | kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā prādurbhūtaṃ jñānaṃ tu tādṛśam || 11 || cakrurvrataṃ tu tāḥ sarvāḥ sahasraśastu gopikāḥ | tāsāṃ manāṃsi ca mayi hyāsan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe || 12|| tāsāṃ buddhirmayā dattā mārgaśīrṣāvagāhane | prātaḥkāle brāhmayoge militvā saṃghaśastu tāḥ || 1 3|| yamunāyāṃ kṛtasnānā gāyanti kṛṣṇakīrtanam | kurvanti jaladānaṃ me’kṣatadānaṃ jale tathā || 14|| dravyadānaṃ jale cāpi gṛhṇāmyantaḥsthito’pyaham | bhojyadānaṃ jale tābhiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ smṛtvā kṛtaṃ prage || 15|| kvacit kṛṣṇaḥ kvacinmatsyo bhūtvā gṛhṇāmi tajjale | patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ yadyajjale dattaṃ madātmani || 16|| mayā sarvaṃ svīkṛtaṃ tat tāsāṃ bhāvena vāriṇi | pūjā kṛtā madarthaṃ ca tābhirgatvā gṛhe gṛhe || 17|| haviṣyānnaṃ madarthaṃ ca bhuktaṃ tābhirmadarpitam | sarvaṃ mama prasādārthaṃ kṛtaṃ samyag vrataṃ tataḥ || 18|| mayā datto varaścātmā tāsāṃ tuṣṭena satpatiḥ | śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi kṛṣṇapativratāvidhim || 1 9|| prātarbrāhme samutthāya tābhiḥ śrīguravo natāḥ | smṛtaścāhaṃ kṣaṇaṃ dhyātaḥ kṛṣṇeti kīrtito muhuḥ ||1.426.20 || tato yamyāstaṭaṃ gatvā kṛtvā śaucādikaṃ tataḥ | snātāśca mukhaśuddhyādi kṛtvā yamījale ca tāḥ ||21 || tulasīmṛttikāṃ liptvā tulasīpatravāriṇā | saṃprokṣya svaśarīrāṇi sasnurnadyāṃ ca māṃ hṛdi ||22|| smarantyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti vyāharantyapi | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ || 23|| athākṣatān kusumāni patrāṇi kuṃkumādikam | dīpaṃ phalādikaṃ mahyaṃ dadustāścārdravastrakāḥ ||24|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye’rpyate | iti samarpya tāstīraṃ vinirgatyāmbarāṇi ca ||25|| paridhāya tathācamyātarpayan pūrvajām̐stataḥ | ṛṣīndevānnamaskṛtyākurvan kuṃkumacandrakam ||26|| bhāle ca kaṇṭhamadhye ca hṛdaye candanādinā | bindvīṃ rekhāṃ yathāyogyaṃ cakruḥ kṛṣṇaratāśca tāḥ ||27|| lalāṭe keśavo dhyāto nārāyaṇastathodare | vakṣasi mādhavo dhyāto govindaḥ kaṇṭhakūbare ||28|| dhyāto viṣṇurdakṣakukṣau vāmakukṣau tu vāmanaḥ | dakṣabāhau ca madhuhā vāmabāhau śriyodharaḥ ||29|| trivikramaḥ karṇamūle hṛṣīkeśastu karṇayoḥ | pṛṣṭhe dhyātaḥ padmanābho dāmodaro hyadhaḥsthale ||1.426.3 0|| sarvāṃge śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ sucintitaḥ | śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ cakrire bhujayośca tāḥ ||3 1 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ | iti ṣoḍaśakṛṣṇānāṃ mudrā dadhyuśca mānase ||32|| tulasīmālikāḥ sūkṣmāḥ kaṇṭhe dadhyuḥ kare tathā | dhātrīphalakṛtāṃ mālāṃ dadhyuḥ kāścid gale kare ||33|| evaṃkṛtvā vidhiṃ tāśca natvā gurūn gṛhaṃ gatāḥ | tata ācamya tāḥ sarvāḥ praviviśuśca maṇḍapam ||34|| kuśāsanasthitāḥ padmāsanāḥ pūrvamukhāśca tāḥ | cakruḥ prāṇasya niyamaṃ madhye tu maṇḍapasya tāḥ ||35|| karṇikāyāṃ bhāskaraṃ ca śaśinaṃ vahnimeva ca | saṃsthāpyoddeśamātreṇa taṇḍuleṣu dadhuśca tān ||36|| tato’ṣṭapatrakaṃ pa taṇḍulaiścakrurādarāt | tatra dadhyuśca māṃ divyaṃ svasvayogyaṃ varaṃ patim ||37|| samāsīnaṃ hasantaṃ ca koṭiśītāṃśusannibham | caturbhujaṃ sāyudhaṃ ca kāścid dvibhujamacyutam ||38|| padmapatraviśālākṣaṃ mahāvīryabalānvitam | śrīvatsakaustubhoraskaṃ pītavastrānvitaṃ ca mām ||39|| divyābharaṇasaṃśobhaṃ divyamaṇḍanamaṇḍitam | divyacandanaliptāṃgaṃ divyakusumamālikam ||1.426.40|| tulasīmālikāyuktavanamālādirājitam | koṭibālārkasadṛśaṃ kāntaṃ kāntamanoharam |||41 || yuvatyā tu śriyāśliṣṭatanuṃ cubantameva mām | dhyātvā tāḥ prajapurmugdhāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti mām ||42|| tatastāḥ sthāpayāmāsuḥ śaṃkhaṃ gandhodapūritam | tathā sugandhapuṣpādipātraṃ nyadhuśca dakṣiṇe ||43||| vāme nyadhurvārikuṃbhaṃ vastrapūtaṃ suvāsitam | ghaṇṭāṃ nyadhuḥ pradīpāṃśca cakrurdhūpaṃ samantataḥ ||44|| atha pātrāṇi catvāri sannyadhustatra kanyakāḥ | arghyapādyācamanīyamadhuparkārthakāni ca |||45||| sarṣapākṣatapuṣpāṇi kuśāgraṃ tilacandanam | phalaṃ yavānarghyapātre rarakṣustatra kanyakāḥ ||46|| dūrvāṃ gaṃgāṃ yamīṃ padmaṃ pādyapātre nyadhuśca tāḥ | kaṃkolaṃ ca lavaṃgaṃ ca phalaṃ mālatisaṃbhavam ||47|| ācamanīyapātre tā nyadhustīrthajalaṃ tathā | gavyaṃ payo dadhi madhu ghṛtaṃ ca śarkarānvitam ||48|| madhuparkasya pātre tā nyadhustato hareḥ pura| karanyāsān pracakruśca svāṃgeṣu kṛṣṇakāmyayā ||49|| mastake mastakaṃ cāstu kṛṣṇasya mama sarvathā | lalāṭe śrīkṛṣṇadevalalāṭaṃ cāstu me śubham ||1.426.50|| netrayoḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanetre’dhitiṣṭhatām | karṇayorme kṛṣṇakarṇau nāsāyāṃ kṛṣṇanāsikā ||51 || kapolayoḥ kapolaṃ me gaṇḍayoḥ kṛṣṇagaṇḍakau | kaṭākṣayoḥ kaṭākṣau me kṛṣṇasya cādhitiṣṭhatām ||52|| oṣṭhayorme kṛṣṇakāntoṣṭhadvayaṃ vasatu priyam | cibuke kṛṣṇacibukaṃ kaṇṭhe kaṇṭho’stu me hareḥ ||53 || skandhayoḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaskandhau pratiṣṭhatām | bhujayoḥ śrīhareḥ stāṃ subhujau karau karadvaye |||54|| hṛdaye kṛṣṇahṛdayaṃ nābhau nābhirharermama | jaghane kṛṣṇajaghanaṃ kaṭyāṃ cāstu hareḥ kaṭiḥ ||55|| gopye kṛṣṇasya gopyaṃ ca sakthnorme sakthinī hareḥ | jānvorme kṛṣṇajānūstāṃ jaṃghe me jaṃghayorhareḥ ||56|| pādayorme kṛṣṇapādau mayi kṛṣṇo’stu sarvathā | madindriyeṣu kṛṣṇasyendriyāṇi santu sarvaśaḥ ||57|| santu me’ntaḥkaraṇeṣvantaḥkaraṇāni vai hareḥ | evaṃ mamānusmaraṇaṃ cakrustā hṛdayaṃgamam ||58|| sasmarustāstadātmānaṃ matsamaṃ matpativratāḥ | maṃgalaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kāntaḥ priyaḥ kuru ||59|| prapeṭhuḥ gopakanyānāṃ patistvaṃ maṃgalaṃ kuru | atha śaṃkhaṃ pupūjuśca puṣpacandanavāribhiḥ ||1.426.6 0|| suvāsitena tailena cakrurudvartanaṃ tu tāḥ | kastūryā candanenāpi cakrurudvartanaṃ tathā ||61 || sugandhavāsitaistoyaistataḥ saṃsnāpito’pyaham | śaṃkhatoyaṃ prajagrāha snānārthaṃ tu punaḥ punaḥ ||62|| pañcāmṛtāni pradaduḥ snāpayāmāsurādarāt | tīrthajalaiḥ sukhasparśairabhiṣekaṃ daduśca tāḥ ||63|| candanaṃ gandhasārādi mardayāmāsurādarāt | vastreṇa mārjayāmāsuḥ śarīraṃ me punaḥ punaḥ ||64|| dadurarghyaṃ saphalaṃ ca pādyamācamanīyakam | madhuparkaṃ daduścātha dadurdivyāmbarāṇi ca ||65|| divyabhūṣāralaṃkārān gandhādīn saṃdadurmama | kajjalaṃ keśatailādi puṇḍrārthaṃ candanādikam ||66|| kuṃkumādi dadustāśca dravasārān dadustataḥ | alaktaraṃgarāgādi pradadustāśca kanyakāḥ ||67|| siṃhāsanaṃ tathā chatraṃ cāmare vyajanaṃ daduḥ | darpaṇaṃ keśadantaṃ ca śuklacūrṇaṃ daduśca tāḥ ||68|| tulasīmālikāṃ puṣpahārām̐śca śekharān daduḥ | gucchān svarṇavibhūṣāśca pattrāṇe saṃdadustadā ||6 9|| vaṃśī daduśca tā miṣṭasvarāṃ cāhamavādayam | dolāyāṃ māṃ samasthāpya dolayāmāsurādarāt ||1.426.70 || naivedyaṃ cārpayāmāsuḥ pāyasāpūpamiśritam | jalaṃ phalaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ śākaṃ pūgīphalādikam ||71 || pradadustā vyajanaiśca sevayāmāsureva ca | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ punaścakrurdaduḥ puṣpāṇi bhaktitaḥ ||72 || bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ prītyā tāḥ kavalairmuhuḥ | tṛpto’haṃ cāpibaṃ vāri tāmbūlakaṃ samādade ||73 || tāśca praṇamya saṃcakrurnīrājanaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | stutiṃ cakrurnamaścakruḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ punastathā ||74|| aparādhakṣamāyāñcāṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ samādadhuḥ | varaṃ ca yācayāmāsuḥ patirno bhava sarvadā ||75|| śāyayitvā ca paryaṃke paritastasthurādarāt | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakruryatheṣṭaṃ tāḥ siṣevire ||76 || mayā tāsāṃ mānasāni pūritāni tadā priye | sparśanenāśleṣaṇena bhāvenāvarṇyakena ca ||77||| tatastāḥ sukhamāpannā abhūtapūrvameva vai | ānandeṣu nimagnastā maṃgalārghyaṃ dadustataḥ ||78|| visṛjya māṃ ca tāścakrurgṛhakāryāṇi vai tataḥ | prasādaṃ bhakṣayāmāsurmamapūjāniveditam ||79|| mayā dattaṃ mahānandaṃ smṛtvā smṛtvātiharṣitāḥ | cakruḥ svagṛhakāryāṇi śramaṃ na vividuśca tāḥ ||1.426.80|| jalāharaṇakārye tā dadṛśurmāṃ ghaṭe jale | kaṇḍanīdhānyaghāte tā dadṛśurmāṃ kaṇeṣu vai ||81 || piṣṭārthaṃ peṣaṇīkārye peṣaṇyāṃ dadṛśurhi mām | mārjanīkāryakāle tā bhūtale dadṛśuśca mām ||82|| pākakāle pākapātre sthālyāṃ bhojanapātrake | dṛśye śravye tathā spṛśye māmeva dadṛśuśca tāḥ ||83|| ādarśe svamukhe netre taile vastre vibhūṣaṇe | hṛdaye sarvakāryeṣu māmeva dadṛśuśca tāḥ ||84|| divyadehā babhūvuśca bhittyāvaraṇavarjitāḥ | dehabhānaprahīṇāśca kṛṣṇarūpaṃ dadhustu tāḥ ||85|| ekā kṛṣṇo dvitīyā tu kṛṣṇā bhūtvā ca rematuḥ | ekā patnī dvitīyā tu patirbhūtvā nanandatuḥ ||86|| ekā sakhī dvitīyā tu sakhā bhūtvā cucūmbatuḥ | ekā vadhūdvitīyā tu varo bhūtvā virejatuḥ ||87|| evaṃ kṛṣṇamayaṃ tāsāmāntaraṃ ca mayā kṛtam | kṛṣṇapātivratyaraṃgaiḥ raktānāṃ bhinnatā na me ||88|| evaṃbhāvaṃ prapannāstāḥ snātuṃ yātā yamījale | kadambadrumanikaṭe tāsvahaṃ cāpyalakṣitaḥ ||89|| yayau kumārikārūpaṃ dhṛtvā snānāya vai saha | avateruśca tāstīrthe nyasya vastrāṇi tattaṭe ||1.426.90|| sasmaruśca saha snātuṃ rantuṃ māṃ kanyakā hṛdi | yathā cānyā na jānāti tathā pratyekayā saha ||91 || reme tatra jale bāhyakanyaścāntarapūruṣaḥ | pratyekaṃ sā vijānāti ramaṇaṃ nāparā tadā ||92|| evaṃ manāṃsi sampūrya tṛptāstāśca tataḥ param | jale kanyāsvarūpo’pi vanāt kṛṣṇo’hamāgataḥ ||93|| tāsāṃ vastrāṇi cādāya prāruroha kadambakam | tābhiḥ saṃkalpitaṃ tadvanmayā manaḥ prapūritam ||94|| kṛṣṇaścāsmattanū paśyediti tadvanmayā kṛtam | vratasthānāṃ varuṇasyāvadhīraṇā kṛtā yataḥ ||95|| bahirnirgatya sūryāya kuruta prāṃjaliṃ priyāḥ | iti bhāvānusāreṇa tāśca mayā vilokitāḥ ||96|| tāstu tuṣṭāstadā jātā menire kṛtakṛtyatām | dadau vastrāṇi tābhyaśca varām̐ścāpi dadau muhuḥ ||97|| rāmayiṣye ramayiṣye yatheṣṭaṃ mama vai priyāḥ | vratasya tu phalaṃ sarvaṃ cārpayiṣye navaṃ navam ||98|| nityaṃ tāḥ kāntabhāvena mayā satyaḥ pratarpitāḥ | tā eva tu divārātrau madātmikāḥ sadābhavan ||99|| kāmo divyo ratirdivyā bhāvo divyaḥ kṛto mayā | madīyadivyabhāvena tāsāṃ divyamabhūddhi tat| || 1.426.1 00|| niṣkāma karma tatproktaṃ yanmayi tvarpyate sadā | bandhaghnaṃ śāntidaṃ mokṣakaraṃ sākṣānmadarpaṇam || 101 || yathā tābhiḥ kṛtaṃ tadvannānyā kācit kariṣyati | ityahaṃ tvabhavaṃ tāsāṃ prasannaḥ kānta ekalaḥ || 1 02|| kāntāstāścābhajan māṃ ca prāpurmāṃ ca pare pade | tāśca sarvāḥ kṛṣṇakāntāḥ kṛṣṇavratā hareḥ priyāḥ || 1 03|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnyaḥ kṛṣṇapativratāḥ striyaḥ | nityaṃ māṃ pūjayāmāsuḥ ramayāmāsurantike || 1 04|| miṣṭānnāni ca tā nityaṃ bhojayāmāsuracyutam | dadhyurmāṃ hṛdaye nityaṃ śāśvatānandadāyakam || 1 05|| evaṃ yā pātivratyena patisevāṃ kariṣyati | patiṃ māṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāpya pramokṣyate || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gokulakanyānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapātivratyaparāṇāmaṣṭottaraśatopacārairvratapūjādibhiḥ śrīkṛṣṇapatiprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 426 ||
<1.427> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ tāsāṃ punaḥprāptisvarūpiṇīm | yadā kṛṣṇo dvārikāyāṃ samāgatyāvasattadā || 1 || śokāturāstu tāḥ sarvāstatyajurvāri bhojanam | śrīkṛṣṇena mayā tāśca punaḥ punastadantikam || 2 || gatvā tvadṛśyarūpeṇa sāntvayitāḥ prasāditāḥ | āpyāyitā ānanditā yatheṣṭakrīḍanādibhiḥ || 3 || adṛśyena svarūpeṇa pratigopīṃ ramāmyaham | pārśvasthā naiva jānanti yataste carmacakṣuṣaḥ || 4 || tāstu divyāḥ prajānanti vadanti yamunātaṭe | sakhyo milanti vijane māṃ stuvanti hasanti ca || 5 || māṃ vinā tāḥ kṣaṇaṃ sthātumaśaktā amilam̐staṭe | jakruśca niścayaṃ gantuṃ dvārikāṃ kāntasannidhau || 6 || divyadehāstu tāḥ sarvāḥ kṛtvā rūpaṃ dvayaṃ dvayam | ekarūpeṇa tatraiva gokule tasthire sadā || 7 || dvitīyena tu divyena militāstu sahasraśaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnyo nītvopadā yathābalam || 8 || bhautikaiścādṛśyarūpā vyomamārgeṇa saṃyayuḥ | ghaṭikābhyantare prāpurdivyāṃ puṣkariṇīṃ śubhām || 9 || ahaṃ yogena tā jñātvā pratijagāma satvaram | svāgataṃ kṛtavām̐stāsāṃ dadhe rūpasahasrakam || 1.427.1 0|| ānandaṃ pradadau śīghraṃ dadau bhojyādikaṃ tataḥ | upadā jagṛhe paścācciraṃ tāpaṃ hyapānudam || 11 || evaṃ dvīpe dvārikāyāṃ rarakṣa cirameva tāḥ | tarpitāścājñayā sarvāḥ siṣevire yatheṣṭakam || 1 2|| ekadā raivate rantuṃ mayā tāśca samarthitāḥ | āyayuśca viceruśca remire māṃ vavalgire || 13 || svarṇarekhāsarittīre sugandhipuṣpavāsite | koṭivṛkṣavane ramye kāmānandaṃ prapedire || 14|| tāstu dṛṣṭvā mahāramyaṃ sthalaṃ raivatapattalam | niścikyurmāṃ bhojayituṃ sasmarurbhojanāni ca || 15 || tatrasthā vanadevyastu yoginyo yoginīgireḥ | siddhastriyo’mbādāsyaścāninyurbhojyāni sarvaśaḥ || 16 || sauvarṇāni rājatāni pātrāṇi parṇajāni ca | brahmadrumadalapātrāṇyāninyurvividhāni tāḥ || 17|| tā api janmasāphalyaṃ manvānāśca praharṣitāḥ | bhojayāmāsuratyarthamātithyaṃ cakrurādarāt || 18|| raivatyo devatāḥ kanyā gaukulyaḥ kanyakāstathā | śrīkṛṣṇaṃ koṭirūpasthaṃ bhojayāmāsurīśvaram || 19 || kārtike yāni bhojyāni cānnakūṭe’rhaṇāni vai | mārgaśīrṣe ca deyāni tānyājahrurhareḥ kṛte || 1.427.20|| sarvāṇi bhojayāmāsurnārāyaṇahradāntike | śṛṇu lakṣmi ca nāmāni yānyahaṃ bhuktavām̐stadā || 21 || vakṣyāmi te’nnapānādivyañjanādīnyaśeṣataḥ | hiraṇmayāni pātrāṇi rājatāni sahasraśaḥ ||22|| vistīrṇāni sundarāṇi pālāśāni bahūnyapi | kacolāśca śarāvāśca kuḍavāśca sahasraśaḥ ||23|| vinyastāḥ sannidhau me ca viśāle bhūtale tadā | jalānāṃ kalaśāḥ sopapātrāstatra dhṛtāḥ śubhāḥ || 24|| pāyasaṃ kāmadhenūnāṃ kanyābhistvarpitaṃ tataḥ | saśarkaro dugdhapākaḥ sugandhibhakta uttamaḥ ||25|| mudgāḥ saugandhyayuktāśca pātrīṣu saṃdhṛtāstadā | nānāvyañjanapātryaśca nimbūrasādimiśritāḥ ||26|| phalamūlaprapākāśca karpūrādisuvāsitāḥ | śataśo vyañjanabhedā nihitāḥ pātrikāsu vai ||27|| drākṣāśca miśritāścūtakaramardakasaṃyutāḥ | marīcapippalīśūṇṭhīkarpūrailārdrakairyutāḥ ||28|| kvāthāḥ kvathikā vividhāścaṭanyastiktamiṣṭikāḥ | jambūrasānvitāḥ patravallīnāṃ bharjakāstathā ||29|| pralehanāśca vividhāḥ kusumāmodasaṃbhṛtāḥ | pātrīṣu nihitāstābhiruṣṇabhāvāḥ samuttamāḥ ||1.427.3 0 || śarkarādugdhayuktāśca maṇḍakā vartulāḥ śubhāḥ | praphullāḥ puṣpavaṭikāḥ pātrīṣu pariveṣitāḥ ||3 1 || sakesaraṃ saśarkaraṃ haiyaṃgavīnamuttamam | ghṛtaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mahiṣīṇāṃ vāṭikāsu samarpitam ||32|| puṭeṣu nihitāścūrṇāścārdrapatraphalādijāḥ | sthāleṣu cārpitāstābhiḥ saubāhlikāśca pūrikāḥ ||33 || polikāśca śataśchidrā apūpāḥ pūpakāstathā | sumiṣṭapolikāmiṣṭapūrikā yugapolikāḥ ||34|| viśālapolikāścāpi pūrṇaprapolikāstathā | roṭakā ghṛtapūrṇāśca ghṛtapūrāśca śāṭakāḥ |||35||| caṇakā naikadhā māṣā vallāśca saṃskṛtā navāḥ | sūtrapheṇyaḥ parpaṭāśca vaṭāḥ kūṣmāṇḍamāṣajāḥ ||36|| vaṭikā navadhā caiva samarpitā mudā tadā | jātīphalamarīcailākesarāḍhyā ca pāyasī ||37|| siddhānnaṃ tādṛśaṃ dugdhapakvaṃ pātreṣu cārpitam | citravarṇaṃ naikarasaṃ rājikārāddhamuttamam ||38|| kṛtaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tābhiściñciṇīdadhicūtajam | drākṣekṣurasakadalībilvarasādinirmitam ||39|| ghṛtapakvāni tailena pakvāni kandakāni ca | tathā pakvāni patrāṇi sapiṣṭoparasāni ca ||1.427.40|| piṣṭācārālībījaiśca nārīkelasya garbhakaiḥ | khasabījairlavaṃgaiśca miśritā ghṛtaśarkaraiḥ ||41 || kaṭāhe pācitā dugdhaistilataṇḍulasvalpakāḥ | snigdhā ramyāḥ pheṇikāścārpitāstābhirmuhurmudā ||42|| ghṛtapakvāḥ sakarpūrā dattāstrighāripūrikāḥ | cārālībījayuktāśca khasabījapralepitāḥ ||43 || drākṣāntarvāsayuktāśca modakā bahujātikāḥ | sagūḍāḥ saśarkarāśca sakhaṇḍā dugdhamarditāḥ ||44|| jalīyāśca ghṛtīyāśca vahnikuṇḍaprapācitāḥ | ghṛte ca pācitāścāpi svalpaghṛtāktacūrṇakāḥ ||05.||| nārīkelakusugarbhailālavaṃgakarpūrānvitāḥ | vaṃśapuṣpājapuṣpādisaṃmiśrāḥ modakāḥ śubhāḥ ||46|| vṛkṣaniryāsasaṃyuktāḥ pakvagundrādimiśritāḥ | badāmamodakāstilamodakā mauktikādayaḥ ||47|| laḍḍukā golakāścānye mudgacaṇakapiṣṭajāḥ | tāṇḍulā laḍḍukāścāpi dvātrapiṣṭādilaḍḍukāḥ ||48|| sthāleṣu cārpitāstābhirvartulāśca sugandhinaḥ | catuḥkhaṇḍāstathā dattā mahāśubhasya śobhanāḥ ||49|| mohanasthālakhaṇḍāśca parpicūrṇapaṭāstathā | bindukīlaḍḍukāścāpi māṣamodakajātayaḥ ||1.427.50|| granthakāḥ kalikāścaiva sevikāśca caturvaṭaḥ | bāṣpāṭāḥ śāṭakāścāpi śaṣkulyaḥ piṇḍakāstathā ||51 || gaṇagranthāḥ śarkapārāḥ kaṃsārāśca birañjakāḥ | dugdhamāpaḥ śrīkhaṇḍaśca pītasārāśca takrakam ||52||| saṃyāvādyāḥ pūraṇāni jāmbavaśca prasūtrakāḥ | miṣṭā amiṣṭāḥ tiktāśca lāvaṇyavyañjanāstathā ||53|| kulatthikāḥ saṃskṛtāśca rājamāṣādayastathā | tābhiḥ pātreṣu parṇeṣu yathāvastuprapūritāḥ ||54|| ārdrakasya lavaṃgānāṃ cūtānāmāranālakam | āmalakasya nimbūnāṃ garimṇaścāranālakam |||55|| marīcakānāṃ kandānāṃ śuṇṭhīnāmāranālakam | kairaṭānāṃ karmadānāṃ śigrūṇāṃ cāranālakam ||56|| mūlakānāṃ ca patrāṇāṃ kharjūrāṇāṃ rasāṃstathā | khārikāṇāṃ ca vanyānāṃ vaṃśānāmāranālakam || 57|| kṣīrikāṇāmamṛtānāṃ galakīnāṃ ca vyañjanam | ghṛtāśānāṃ ca dugdhīnāṃ paravalānāṃ vyañjanam ||58|| kunarāṇāṃ mṛdālūnāṃ raktālūnāṃ ca vyañjanam | bṛhatīnāṃ suvāsānāṃ methikānāṃ ca bhājikāḥ ||59|| ikṣurasaḥ puṣpikāpaḥ drākṣā ca kṣīrikāphalam | cūtāni navaraṃgāni kadalānyamṛtāni ca ||1.427.6 0 || āmalakāni bilvāni rasāni vividhāni ca | tābhirdattāni pātreṣu bhāvukābhirmudā muhuḥ ||61 || saśarkaraṃ payaḥprasthaṃ hyardhaṃ ghṛtaṃ manāṅ madhu | manāk śūṇṭhīrmanāṅmarīcakaṃ karpūrakaṃ manāk ||62|| gālitaṃ kvāthitaṃ tābhirdattaṃ pānottaraṃ tu me | tāmbūlakāni śreṣṭhāni śreṣṭhavastvanvitāni ca ||63|| tābhirdattāni tatraiva jalāni vidhinā tathā | dattāni bhojitaścāhaṃ sarvābhiśca pṛthak pṛthak ||64|| kavalaiḥ kaṇṭhasaṃsparśaiḥ satpeyaistarpitomuhuḥ | tāśca sarvāḥ kare kṛtvā kavalāni tu me daduḥ ||65|| mukhe gṛhṇāmi bhāvena bhunajmi cāpi satvaram | devatāścāgatā ārṣā munayaḥ pitarastathā ||66|| darśanārthaṃ mayā bhuktaṃ prasādaṃ jagṛhustu te | evaṃ tābhiḥ kāritaṃ me bhojanaṃ bahutṛptidam ||67|| mayā bhuktvā tu tāḥ sarvāḥ pratyekaṃ bhojitā mayā | kavalāni cūmbanāni sparśanāni pradāya ca ||68|| sarvābhyaḥ sarvavastūnāṃ prasādāstṛptidā mayā | pradattā bhojitāścāpi jalaṃ tāmbūlamarpitam ||69|| tadā nārāyaṇahrade matsyā bhūtvā tu devatāḥ | pakṣiṇaśca pitaro’pi bhūtvāvāpuḥ prasādakam ||1.427.70 || kanyābhiḥ sevitastatra kuṃjeṣu tṛptipūrvakam | puṣpāṇāṃ hāramālābhiḥ śṛṃgāritastathā hyati ||71 || vanditaḥ pūjitaścāpi prārthitaḥ sarvadā girau | raivate vāsalābhāya muhuḥ sukhaprade girau ||72|| mayā tāsāṃ kṛtā cājñā yāntu vai gokulaṃ prati | tāstu prāhuḥ sadā kṛṣṇa rakṣayātra girau hi naḥ ||73|| samāgaccha sadā cātra sukhadānāya mādhava | tvayyarpitā vayaṃ sarvāstanunā karmaṇā dhiyā ||74|| tvayi prāpte kva gantavyaṃ kāntasya caraṇau vinā | sadā te sevikā dehi saukhyaṃ no ramaṇena vai ||75|| naikarūpī prabhuḥ kāmaiḥ ratyā tāratyatarpayat | atha tatra tato lakṣmi brahmā kāryāya cāgataḥ | gopyaṃ nānye vijānanti jānāmyahaṃ narāyaṇaḥ ||76|| brahmā prāha tadā mahyaṃ rahasyaṃ vācyameva na | yāvat kālāt kṛtayugastretā dvāpara eva ca ||77|| pṛthvyāṃ rājyaṃ prakurvanti kalirnirāśa eva yat | sthānaṃ kvāpyalabhamāno yayau lokācalaṃ ruṣā ||78|| tapaḥ karoti tatraiva sthānasya labdhaye tu saḥ | tapaḥphalapradānāya tvayā gantavyameva hi ||79|| varadānaṃ kṛpāsindho dātavyaṃ lokarakṣakam | dvāparasya gataḥ kālaḥ kaliḥ pṛthvyāṃ bhaviṣyati ||1.427.80|| gaṃgādīni ca tīrthāni dharmaśca devatādayaḥ | pañcasahasravarṣāṇi na sthāsyanti bhuvi prabho ||81 || tāvatkālaṃ kaliḥ pṛthvyāṃ nirbalo nivasiṣyati | krameṇa tu tatastiṣyabale jāte bhuvastale |||82|| sarvamānuṣarūpeṣu prakaṭaḥ sannivatsyati | tataścādharmabījāni ropayiṣyati sarvaśaḥ ||83|| ekākāraṃ jagat kartuṃ yatiṣyate sa sarvathā | sarvaṃ jagad dharmahīnaṃ kariṣyati svapuṣṭaye ||84|| jātibhedo dharmabhedo hyaspṛśyāsparśa ityapi | agamyāgamanaṃ cāpyabhakṣyābhakṣyādikaṃ tadā |||85||| devacāṇḍālayoḥ śuddhirmanudharmādayastadā | rugṇāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti tato dharmasya guptaye ||86|| saurāṣṭre raivate deśe tadā kṛṣṇa punastvayā | aśvapaṭṭasarastīre grāhyaṃ prākaṭyameva ca ||87|| sarvavidyāsarvadharmādhiṣṭhātrā ca satā tvayā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmnā bhavitavyaṃ dhruvaṃ prabho ||88|| tavopadeśāt sarvatra dīrghakālaṃ punarbhuvi | vṛṣo bhaktyadhikaḥ puṣṭo jīviṣyati jane jane ||89|| matsyadhvajadhanuḥśūlasvastikavajracihnitam | bhagavantaṃ parijñāya śaraṇaṃ te janāstadā ||1.427.90|| āyāsyanti tariṣyanti tava darśanasevanāt | bhaktiḥ pṛthvyāṃ tadā kṛṣṇa tava divyena varcasā ||91 || puṣṭimeṣyati sarvatra janā yāsyanti mokṣaṇam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||92|| itimantraṃ guroḥ prāpya bhaktyā yāsyanti dhāma te | atha tiṣyabale jāte prajāścāṇḍālasannibhāḥ ||93|| tadā svatvaṃ paratvaṃ ca samūlaṃ saṃvinaṃkṣyati | yonibandho dhanabandhaḥ svārthanyāyo bhaviṣyati ||94|| tadā punastvayā kṛṣṇa bhavitavyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | kalernāśāya satyāya satyadharmāya vai punaḥ ||95|| śikṣādānāya prākaṭyaṃ tava kāryaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | yāvat pṛthvyāṃ pratimāyāṃ devāstīrthāni vai jale ||96|| manuṣyeṣu ca pāvitryaṃ tāvanmaitu balaṃ kaliḥ | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha brahmā natvā sthitaḥ puraḥ ||97|| brahmaṇe hariṇā sarvaṃ prāsādikaṃ prabhojitam | kṛṣṇaḥ prāha vinodena kumārikāstadottaram ||98|| ahaṃ pṛthvyāṃ punaśca śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | kaleḥ parābhavārthaṃ vai bhaviṣyāmi surāṣṭrake ||99 || tāvad yūyaṃ priyāḥ sarvāstapaḥ kurvantu raivate | prākaṭye me ca tatraiva suyogo vo bhaviṣyati ||1.427.100|| śrutvaitat tāḥ paraṃ khinnāḥ sāśrunetrāstadābhavan | tāvatkālaṃ viyoge cāsahamānā hi tāpanam || 101 || bhagavāṃśca tadā prāha sāntvayitvā śanaiḥ punaḥ | viyogāsahamānānāṃ pañcavarṣasahasrakam || 1 02|| sukṣaṇamātrakālo vai satyaloke gamiṣyati | adyaiva brahmaṇā sākaṃ yūyaṃ gacchata kanyakāḥ || 103 || brahmalokaṃ prapaśyantu kṣaṇaikamātramutsukāḥ | punaścātra samāyāntu brahmaṇā preritāḥ priyāḥ || 1 04|| ebhirdivyaśarīrairvai bhaktimatyo bhavantu me | ahaṃ cātra bhaviṣyāmi saurāṣṭre bhagavān svayam || 1 05|| satāṃ madhyagataścihnairjñātavyaḥ kṛṣṇa eva hi | yūyaṃ sarvā divyadehāḥ saurāṣṭrādau gṛhe gṛhe || 1 06|| janma prāpya tadā bhaktimatyo me vai bhaviṣyatha | bhavatīnāṃ susatsaṃgāt narā nāryo’pi koṭiśaḥ || 1 07|| mama bhaktiprakartāro bhaviṣyanti gṛhe gṛhe | ācāryo’haṃ gūḍharūpo vicariṣyāmi sādhuvat || 1 08|| mattaḥ sukhamavāpyaiva janā yāsyanti dhāma me | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ || 1 09|| iti jāpaṃ kariṣyanti yāsyanti matpadaṃ hi te | mama sevāṃ mama pūjāṃ mama nāmānukīrtanam || 1.427.11 0|| matkathāśravaṇaṃ ye vai kariṣyanti tu te janāḥ | yāsyanti paramaṃ dhāma śāśvataṃ śrīniṣevitam || 111 || ityuktāstāḥ prasannāśca bhūtvā ca brahmaṇā saha | yayuḥ satyaṃ brahmalokaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo dvārikāṃ yayau || 11 2|| ityuktā matkathāṃ tubhyaṃ pāpatāpapraṇāśinī | mayā pūrvaṃ hi yajjātaṃ saṃsmṛtyātra niveditam || 113 || tāśca sarvā mama patnyo vartante mayi cārpitāḥ | madarthaṃ tyaktasarvasvāḥ sarvā mama pativratāḥ || 1 14|| tāsāṃ vai darśanātsparśāt lokā yāsyanti mokṣaṇam | kiṃ punarmama yogena sākṣāt divyaprasevayā || 1 15|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi vṛttaṃ purābhavaṃ śubham | yuge yuge bhaviṣyāmi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hyaham || 116 || bahuvāraṃ pratiyugaṃ bhavāmi prabhavāmi ca | kṣatratejāḥ sādhutejāstapastejā munīśvaraḥ || 1 17|| śāstratejā jñānatejā dharmatejā gurorguruḥ | dharmapoṣṭā bhaktipoṣṭā bhaktapātā ca śāsakaḥ || 1 18|| satītrātā priyābhartā ratidātā ramāpatiḥ | rājyadātā yajñapātā daityahartā ca bhikṣukaḥ || 11 9|| duḥkhahartā sukhadātā śaraṇyaśca caturbhujaḥ | prabhāvān pāravāṃścāpi kaṇasthalaśarīravān || 1.427.1 20|| kṛṣṇapātivratyaniṣṭhāstariṣyanti sadā priye | iti te kathitaṃ hārdaṃ patiḥ kṛṣṇo na cāparaḥ || 121 || rakṣayiṣye rakṣayāmi rarakṣāpi dine dine | bhaktiyuktān mañjuhaṃsāna pātivratyaparāyaṇān || 1 22|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gokulīyagopīnāṃ dvārikāgamottaraṃ raivatādrau śrīkṛṣṇāya dvādaśottaraśatavidhabhojanabhogadānaṃ saurāṣṭrādau sarvatra prākaṭyavacanaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya pātivratyena punaḥ prāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatyadhikacatuḥśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||427||
<1.428> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ ramyāṃ vīrabāhoḥ satīstriyāḥ | kāmpilyanagarasyāsīd vīrabāhuriti pradhīḥ || 1 || satyavādī ca nṛpatirbrāhmaṇo mama bhaktarāṭa | bhakto bhāgavatānāṃ ca matkathāyāṃ ruciṃgataḥ 2 || dātānāthāśrayapradaḥ patnīvrataśca putravān | tasya kāntā kāntimatī mahāsādhvī pativratā || 3 || muktvaikaṃ māṃ vīrabāhurnānyajjānāti daivatam | ekadā tadgṛhaṃ yāto bhāradvājo mahāmuniḥ || 4 || rājā cakāra cātithyaṃ svāgataṃ cārghyamāsanam | praṇanāma ca taṃ bhaktyā hyuvāca supramoditaḥ || 5 || adya me saphalaṃ janma tvadya me saphalaṃ dinam | adya me saphalaṃ rājyamadya me saphalaṃ gṛham || 6 || saphalaścāśramaścāpi saphalā dhanabāndhavāḥ | yasya me brahmavijñasya darśanaṃ caraṇaṃ gṛhe || 7 || yasya hariḥ prasanno’sti tadgṛhaṃ yānti sādhavaḥ | harerbhaktā gṛhe yasya tasya koṭyaghasaṃkṣayaḥ || 8 || tīrthaṃ bhavati bhavanaṃ yatpādarajasā divam | rājyaṃ lakṣmīrgajāśvādi sarvaṃ mune tvadarthakam || 9 || bhavaddarśanalābhena jīvanmukto’smi vartitaḥ | mahābhāgavataścāsi nādeyaṃ te mamāsti yat || 1.428.1 0|| vaiṣṇavāyārpitaṃ svalpaṃ merutulyaṃ phalaṃ bhavet | yadgṛhe nāsti caraṇaṃ satāṃ kṛṣṇasya yoginaḥ || 11 || tadgṛhaṃ śavavāsārh din ca viphalaṃ bhavet | yadgṛhaṃ ca dinaṃ cāpi satāṃ prāptivivarjitam || 12|| vada me sarvadharmajña gārhasthyavartināṃ ca yat | tārakaṃ sādhan śreṣṭhaṃ bandhanaṃ haridhāmadam || 13 || bhāradvājaḥ prasannaḥ san smṛtvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | uvāca rājan bhadraṃ te yo’si bhaktajanapriyaḥ || 14|| smṛddhistu sulabhā rājan hṛdbhāvo durlabhaḥ khalu | yā tvayi bhāvanā bhakte naikajanmārjitā hi sā || 15|| yasya kṛpāluḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ | tasya vai bhāvanā satsu sudivyā mokṣadā hi sā || 16|| śrīharirhi sadā sevyaḥ sevyāśca sādhavaḥ sadā | sādhvyaḥ sevyāśca nārībhiryāśca kṛṣṇapativratāḥ || 17|| dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutaḥ kīrtiḥ rājyaṃ saubhāgyamarhaṇam | ārogyaṃ kāntiraiśvaryaṃ tvāśīrbhirlabhyate satām || 18|| sādhavastoṣitā yena tena kṛṣṇaḥ pratoṣitaḥ | kṛṣṇe tuṣṭe jagat tuṣṭaṃ sadevamunimānavam || 1 9|| atuṣṭe tu harau sarvaṃ tuṣṭaṃ cāpi nirarthakam | dhanyo’si tvaṃ mahārāja rājase vaiṣṇavo mahān ||1.428.20|| dhanyo’syadhiko rājase yatte patnī pativratā | pātivratyaṃ dvayaṃ yasyāścobhayaṃ sādhitaṃ tayā || 21 || svāmini śrīharau kṛṣṇo tathā kānte vivāhite | etallokaṃ sukhaṃ prāptaṃ prāpsyate dhāma vai tathā || 22|| nedṛśaṃ sādhanaṃ loke gārhasthyasya tu tārakam | gṛhe pativratānārī kṛṣṇe bhaktiśca śāśvatī ||23|| rājye prajā bhāgavatī vaiṣṇavī dhārmikī satī | tatra sadā pravastavyaṃ na tvavaiṣṇavarājake ||24|| varaṃ vāso vane tīrthe na tu rāṣṭre hyavaiṣṇave | yatra bhāgavato rājā praśāsti ca vasundharām ||25|| vaikuṇṭhaṃ taddhi mantavyaṃ phalaṃ vaikuṇṭhameva yat | rājā bhakto yathārtho’sti satāṃ pātraṃ sa āśiṣām || 26 || tadrājyaṃ vardhate nityaṃ dampatyoḥ pātivratyataḥ | rājannetraṃ saphalaṃ me paśyāmi tvāṃ hi vaiṣṇavam || 27|| saphalau ca tathā karṇau yacchṛṇomi pativratām | pativratā svayaṃ lakṣmīsvarūpā brahmaṇā kṛtā ||28|| patnīvrato vaiṣṇavaścoddhārako brahmaṇā kṛtaḥ | vaiṣṇavānāṃ darśanaṃ vai śāntidaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā || 29|| labdhaṃ ca darśanaṃ te’tra tava śrīsamayoṣitaḥ | svasti te’stu gamiṣyāmi sukhī bhava janādhipa ||1.428.3 0|| avaidhavyaṃ ca te patnyāḥ kāntimatyāḥ sadā śubham | patyau bhaktiḥ keśave ca niścalā bhaktirastu vām || 31 || patyau kṛṣṇe tvaikyabuddhiḥ kāntimati sadāstu te | pūrvaṃ tvayā pātivratyaṃ pālitaṃ tvatiyatnataḥ || 32|| patistavāyaṃ pūrvasmin janmanyāsīt prahiṃsakaḥ | nāstiko duṣṭacāritraḥ śūdraḥ parapriyārataḥ ||33 || kṛtaghno durvinītaśca sadācāravivarjitaḥ | karmaṇā manasā vācā tvayā nityaṃ hi devavat ||34|| sevitaḥ kṛṣṇabuddhyā ca pātivratyavṛṣeṇa ca | śūdrītve’pi tvayā kaścinnānyo naraḥ prakalpitaḥ || 35|| pativratā mahāsādhvī parasparśavivarjitā | duṣṭabhāvādihīnā ca siṣeviṣe patiṃ harim || 36 || kadācid dravyahīno’yaṃ patiste’raṇyamāgataḥ | kṣīyamāṇāpi bhāryā tvaṃ nātyajaḥ svaṃ patiṃ harim || 37|| śaśādibhirvartayantau dampatī vanavāsinau | dadṛśathuḥ kadācidvai vane bhraṣṭapathaṃ munim || 38|| brāhmaṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktaṃ suvaiṣṇavam | madhyāhne tṛṣitaṃ cāpi patitaṃ mūrcchitaṃ tathā || 39|| hṛdi kṛṣṇaṃ smarantaṃ ca devaśarmābhidhānakam | brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ siṣevāthe jalena pavanena ca ||1.428.40|| pādayormardanenāpi phalādibhojanena ca | viṣṇuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ matvā vaiṣṇavaṃ tārakaṃ dvijam || 41 || āśrame chāyayā vyāpte ramye ninyathurādarāt | yuvābhyāṃ sevitaḥ samyak snāpito bhojitastathā || 42|| sāṣṭāṃgaḥ sannataścokto bhāvabhaktyā sa vaiṣṇavaḥ | āvayostāraṇārthāyātithirviṣṇustvamāgataḥ || 43 || darśanāttava viprarṣe jāto’smatpāpasaṃkṣayaḥ | vada vipra vane kiñcitsāhāyyaṃ cedapekṣyate || 44|| brāhmaṇastu tadā prāha puṇyayogena vai vane | bhavadyogo mama jāto jīvito vai vanāntare || 45|| karavāṇi yuvayoḥ kiṃ brūta kiñcidabhīpsitam | śūdraḥ prāha yathā saurilokadarśanaṃ mā bhavet || 46|| patnyā saha pragacchāmi kṛṣṇadhāma hi śāśvatam | upadeśapradānena prasādaṃ kartumarhasi ||47|| devaśarmā tadā prāha śṛṇu prākcaritaṃ tava | pūrvajanmani viprastvamavantyāṃ dhārmiko hyabhūḥ ||48|| tava patnī tadā ceyaṃ pātivratyaparā satī | āsīddharmaparā nityaṃ hyatithīnāṃ prasevikā ||49|| tavājñayānayā tvannaṃ hyekādaśyāṃ supācitam | brāhmaṇebhyaścātithibhyo bhojanārthaṃ samarpitam ||1.428.50|| jātaṃ puṇyaṃ tvannadānād bhojanātpāpamityapi | puṇyapāpapratāpena yamādiṣṭena vai pathā ||51 || yuvāṃ śūdrakule janmāvāpathuḥ puṇyamiśritam | yāvatpuṇyamabhūt tāvaddhanadhānyādyabhūcca vām ||52|| puṇyaṃ naṣṭaṃ tato vanyo vāso’yaṃ samupāgataḥ | kintu vidarbhanagare vartate te sutāsutaḥ |||53|| kṛtaṃ tena vidhānena harerekādaśīvratam | pradattaṃ tena tatpuṇyaṃ yuvābhyāṃ yadbalācca vām ||54|| dharmopari gatirnityaṃ vartate yuvayoḥ śubhā | kāntimatyāḥ pātivratye sadā tvāsīnmatistadā ||55|| tena puṇyaprabhāveṇa yuvayoḥ saṃgatiḥ sadā | viyogo jāyate naiva na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ||56|| svalpenaiva prakālena yūyaṃ svargaṃ gamiṣyathaḥ | tatra pativratādharmabalena suciraṃ sukham ||57|| samanubhūya bhūloke śūdrajanma hyavāpsyathaḥ | tāvubhau ca yuvāṃ jātau viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇau ||58|| athottaraṃ śubhaṃ janma mama sevāprabhāvataḥ | pātivratyaprabhāveṇa dīrghaṃ rājyamavāpsyathaḥ ||59|| ityuktvā sa yayau viprastīrthārthaṃ ca yuvāmubhau | kāladharmaṃ samāpannau rājñī rājā ca vaiṣṇavau ||1.428.60|| jātau sthaḥ punarevātra satī bhāryā tavāsti ca | tvaṃ tu patnīvrataścāsi sevase mādṛśān sadā ||61 || viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śrīpatiṃ kamalāpatim | lakṣmīpatiṃ satāṃ nāthaṃ sevase pātivratyataḥ ||62|| iyaṃ sādhvī tava bhāryā kṛṣṇaṃ tvāṃ sevate sadā | tatphalaṃ dīrgharājyaṃ ca putraste’sti suvaiṣṇavaḥ ||63|| prajāste sarvadā nārāyaṇe pativratāstathā | vaiṣṇavyaḥ santi tenātra jayase mokṣaṇaṃ prati ||64|| kuru bhaktirharernityaṃ prasevaya gurūn yatīn | patnīvrataṃ sadā rakṣa pātivratyaṃ sati hyava ||65|| evaṃ vai vartane svargaṃ śāśvataṃ tvatra te’sti hi | ante dhāma paraṃ divyaṃ golokaṃ yāsyatho ghruvam ||66|| samprāptaikādaśīpuṇyād viprasyātithyasevanāt | pātivratyācca bhāryāyāḥ prāptaṃ rājyādikaṃ tvayā ||67|| bhaja viṣṇuṃ sadā tvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | bhaja sādhvi svāminaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim ||68|| ityuktvā prayayau badrīṃ bhāradvājo mahāmuniḥ | cakrāte tāvubhau bhaktiṃ yayaturdhāma me hyubhau ||69|| śṛṇu lakṣmi kṛṣṇapātivratyena nāma me japet | tasmai dadāmi vaikuṇṭhaṃ golokaṃ vākṣaraṃ padam ||1.428.70|| mama nāma pravaktavyaṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe viśeṣataḥ | rādhākṛṣṇeti vaktavyaṃ prabhākṛṣṇeti prītidam ||71 || harikṛṣṇeti vaktavyaṃ duḥkhahṛn mokṣadaṃ param | pratijñaiṣā tu me lakṣmi sarvathā śaraṇāgataḥ ||72|| sarvecchāṃ samavāpnoti vaikuṇṭhaṃ kamalāmapi | madbhaktāya dadāmyeva tatsarvaṃ yanmamāsti vai ||73 || vadati śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti saṃsmaratyapi | yathākathaṃcidbhajate tamahaṃ tārayāmi ha ||74|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ ye tu vadanti mṛtyusannidhau | mṛtyuryamaśca taddūtāstyaktvā yānti hi taṃ priye ||75|| antakāle yasya karṇe rāmarāmeti cāgatam | vaikuṇṭhe nīyate rāmapārṣadaiḥ sa na saṃśayaḥ ||76 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ | ityevaṃ gṛṇato mantraṃ nayāmi mama cākṣaram ||77|| pātivratyaparā patnī yatrāsti tulasīdalam | mahābhāgavataḥ sādhuryatrāsti tatra cāsmyaham ||78|| ahaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svāmī kṛṣṇaḥ priyaḥ sa hi | ramāprabhāmāṇikīpārvatīnāthaḥ striyāḥ patiḥ ||79|| jayālalitākāntaḥ sa nārīṇāṃ kānta eva saḥ | pativratā yataḥ sarvā lakṣāṃśasaṃbhavāḥ sati ||1.428.80 || iti te kathitaṃ sevākaraṇaṃ tvaikyabhāvataḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya pātivratyaphalaṃ labhet ||81 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pātivratye vīrabāhoḥ kāntimatyāśca dampatyorbhāradvājena vipraśūdranṛpajanmatrayottaraṃ muktiḥ kṛtetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||428||
<1.429> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi sūryaputryā mama patnyāḥ kathānakam | yābhūd golokamadhyasthā sakhīśreṣṭhātihāsinī || 1 || yadā yadā sakhīnāṃ vai samudyāne sukrīḍanam | militvā jāyate tatra hasatīyaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 2 || ekadā rādhikāyuktā gopyaśca koṭiśaḥ striyaḥ | jagmuḥ snānāya sarasi divye madarthanirmite || 3 || śaivāle rādhikā padbhyāṃ saṃsṛpya patitā tadā | yamunā rādhikāṃ dhartuṃ pradudrāva jahāsa ca || 4 || rādhā prāha yamune kiṃ sthāne hasasi narmaṇi | asthāne hasane naiva śobhate hāsyasaṃbhṛte || 5 || patitāhaṃ kardamena vyāptā pṛṣṭho śilāhatā | jalaṃ nasi mukhe netre praviṣṭaṃ narma mā kuru || 6 || evaṃ prabodhitā sāpi dhṛtvā rādhāṃ pragṛhya ca | vastrādīni tadānyāni dadau sandhāraṇāya vai || 7 || mukhaṃ keśāḥ pṛṣṭhabhāgaḥ prakṣālitāḥ susaṃskṛtāḥ | tadā rādhāṃ punardṛṣṭvā pajahāsāti sā muhuḥ || 8 || rādhā ruṣṭā tu yamunāṃ prāyaśaḥ sevikāṃ prati | prāha śaivālakeśā tvaṃ bhava kardamaśālinī || 9 || yamunā tu tadā ruṣṭā rādhāṃ prāha punaḥ punaḥ | tvaṃ priye kardame śaivāle’pi vihara madyutā || 1.429.1 0|| tvāṃ parityajya naivāhaṃ viharāmi kadācana | kṛṣṇo jñātvā hyubhe prāha maivaṃ maivaṃ priye mama || 11 || yuvābhyāṃ tu vihīno’haṃ kathaṃ sthāsyāmi śobhane | āgamiṣyāmyahaṃ tatra yatra yamunārādhike || 1 2|| yamunā sūryaputrī saṃbhūtvā nadī tu bhūtale | himādriṃ prathamaṃ sṛṣṭvā yayau vṛndāvanaṃ satī || 13 || rādhāpi gopikā bhūtvā rāpāṇasya sutāniśam | yamunāyāstaṭe tacchaivālakardamacāriṇī || 14|| jātā kṛṣṇapriyā kṛṣṇasaṃketānuprasārataḥ | yamunā kanyakārūpā sevate tu patiṃ harim || 15|| ekadā kṛṣṇapatnyo vai kṛṣṇena saha tadvane | kumārikāḥ prakrīḍanti yamunā tad dadarśa ha ||16|| sā kṛṣṇaṃ saṃvilokyaiva cakame kāntakāminī | kṛṣṇastāṃ prāha yamune bhava kanyā tataḥ param || 17|| kariṣye’haṃ vivāhaṃ te kalindarājakanyakā | bhava śīghraṃ mama patnī bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 18|| sā tu kalindarājasya dvitīyena svavarṣmaṇā | jātā vai kanyakā śrīkṛṣṇena sāpi vivāhitā || 1 9|| ekadā kṛṣṇapatnyastu śrīkṛṣṇavirahāturāḥ | kālindīṃ muditāṃ vīkṣya papracchurgatamatsarāḥ ||1.429.20|| yathā vayaṃ kṛṣṇapatnyastathā tvamapi sūryaje | vayaṃ virahadagdhāḥ sma kathaṃ tvaṃ virahaṃ vinā ||21 || tacchrutvāha raveḥ putrī kālindī kṛṣṇasevikā | divyaṃ vai śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāpnomi sarvadā |||22|| na māṃ vihāya bhagavān kadācid yāti dūrataḥ | rādhikāsti mahārājñī kṛṣṇātmā kṛṣṇarūpiṇī || 23 || asmyahaṃ rādhikāṃśā vai na bhidye kṛṣṇarūpataḥ | rādhāṃ vinā na vai kṛṣṇo nāhaṃ ca rādhikāṃ vinā ||24|| kṛṣṇaśca māṃ vinā naiva jānītaikātmyameva yat | evaṃ satyapi dāsyaṃ vai rādhāyāstu viśiṣyate || 25|| tadānandena muditā vindāmi virahaṃ na vai | pativratā satī nārī patiṃ garbhe hṛdi vrate ||26 || pārśve cātmani vijñāne rakṣatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | svapne jāgrati nidrāyāṃ ramate svāminā saha || 27|| bhedo na dehayorasti vyavasthā patimiśritā | yadecchati tadā satyāḥ patirnārāyaṇātmakaḥ ||28|| āgatyānandadātāsti viyogo nāsti karhicit | satī pativratā patnī yadyat sukhaṃ pravāñcchati || 29|| tattatsukhapradānārthaṃ patirūpaṃ dadhan hariḥ | pativratāmanaḥkāmān pūrayatyeva sarvathā ||1.429.3 0 || tasmātpativratānāryā viyogaḥ svāmino na vai | sa evāyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāsmatpatiḥ prabhuḥ ||3 1 || sarvakāmapūrako’sti viyogo nāsti me kvacit | śrutvā tā yoṣitaḥ prāhuryadi kālindi vai tvayā || 32|| sākaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sadā tvāste naḥ pradarśaya sāmpratam | ityuktā sā prahasyaiva śāṭikāṃ svāṃ kareṇa vai || 33 || dakṣapārśvāddhastamātraṃ viyuktāṃ pracakāra ha | tāvattatra sthitaḥ pārśve samāśliṣya yamīṃ hasan || 34|| tābhiśca lokitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kālindīṃ ramayan muhuḥ | mugdhāḥ sarvāstadā jātāḥ kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā patiṃ harim ||35|| śaśaṃsuḥ sūryaputryāstu pātivratyaṃ hi tāstadā | tadeva pātivratyaṃ yat patirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 36 || nārāyaṇasvarūpo’sti cāntarātmāsti sarvathā | na vimuktaḥ kadācitsa yathātmā na viyujyate || 37|| iti bhaktimatī nārī paṇḍitā vai pativratā | karmaṇā vidyate kācit satī na manasā hi sā ||38|| manasā vidyate kācit satī na karmaṇā hi sā | buddhyā kācit satī sā na manasā na ca karmaṇā || 3 9|| trībhiryā vidyate kācitsā cennaivātmanā satī | sarvaṃ tadvirahāyaiva jāyate cātmavarjitam ||1.429.40 || pātivratyaṃ tvātmanā yat tatpātivratyamuttamam | mayā tādṛk sadā prāptaṃ rādhāyāḥ kṛpayā dhruvam |||41 || dāsyaṃ svāmyaṃ pātivratyaṃ tasmāt kṛṣṇo mayi sthitaḥ | rādhākṛṣṇasyāṃśarūpā vayaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanāyikāḥ ||42|| tasyānvayena cāsmāsu nityabhogo’pi vidyate | sa eva sā saiva so’sti rādhā vai premaśevadhiḥ ||43|| tayoḥ prema sumūrte sad vaṃśīrūpaṃ dadhāra ha | rukmiṇyādisamāveśo rādhāyāṃ lokito mayā ||44|| yūyaṃ sarvāśca rādhāyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇe stha samanvitāḥ | nityānandamahāvārdhiyojitā na viyojitāḥ ||45|| kintu hyevaṃ na jānītha tasmād vyākulatāṃ gatāḥ | ātmanāṃ pātivratye tu naivaṃ vyākulatā bhavet ||46|| pātivratye’pi gopīnāṃ bhavatīnāmiva bhramaḥ | virahābhāsarūpaḥ sa āsīduddhavanāśitaḥ ||47|| uddhavasya bhavatīnāṃ bhaveccet susamāgamaḥ | virahābhāsanāśaḥ syāt kāntānandaṃ sulapsyatha ||48|| govardhanagirerbhūmau gopīnāṃ pādareṇubhiḥ | pavitratāṃ sadā vāñcchannuddhavo vallikātmakaḥ ||49|| vartate tu sadānandaḥ pātivratyaparāyaṇaḥ | yadi sumūrtaḥ prāptavyastadā saṃbhūya tatsthale ||1.429.5 0|| patnībhiḥ kīrtanagītisaṃgītairutsavo mahān | ārabdhavyastatra tasya darśanaṃ bhavitā dhruvam |||51 || tathā cātmasamīhānāṃ siddhiravaśyabhāvinī | ityuktāstāḥ kṛṣṇapatnyo gatvā vallīvane drutam ||52|| govardhanādadūreṇārebhire kīrtanotsavam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇagītirase’nanyadhiyo’bhavan |||53 || tāvatpremabharo bhaktastṛṇagulmalatācayāt | ājagāmoddhavaḥ sragvī divyaḥ pītāmbarānvitaḥ ||54|| pragāyan śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nṛtyan naman hasan | kṛṣṇarūpaṃ dadhat taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā nāryaḥ suvismitāḥ ||55|| uddhavaṃ pūjayāṃcakrustāḥ śrīkṛṣṇasvarūpiṇam | śrīkṛṣṇarūpiṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā mumuhuḥ ruruduḥ striyaḥ ||56|| uddhavena tadā jñātvā virahāgniṃ tu yoṣitām | niṣkāsya svahṛdaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tābhyaścārpitavān kṣaṇam ||57|| kṛṣṇaḥ sahasradhā tatra saṃbhūto yogamāyayā | kāntaḥ kāmaprapūro’bhūt pratikuṃjaṃ pratipriyām ||58|| āśleṣaṇaṃ cūmbanaṃ ca ramaṇaṃ snehapūritam | dadau pratipriyāyai sa nirvṛttiṃ paramāṃ dadau ||59|| śāntaṃ cakāra vai tāsāṃ virahānalamulbaṇam | ātmaśāntiṃ dadau tābhyaḥ kṛṣṇaścoddhavavat tathāḥ ||1.429.6 0 || pātivratyaṃ dadau tābhyaḥ kālindyā iva sarvadā | tāsāṃ pārśve vilīnaśca śāśvatātmasukhapradaḥ ||6 1 || vartate sma yathākāntastryavasthātmavratārthitaḥ | evaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śāṭikāsu pārśve nītvā yayurgṛham ||62|| uddhavo’pi hariṃ nītvā vallīṣu saṃjagāma ha | etadātmakṛtaṃ pātivratyaṃ proktaṃ hi padmaje ||63 || śravaṇātpaṭhanāścāsya tādṛśaṃ tadvrataṃ labhet | kṛṣṇaṃ pārśve labhennityaṃ śāṭyāṃ hṛdi na saṃśayaḥ ||64| | iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pātivratye kālindyāḥ uddhavasya pātivratyenānyāsāṃ kṛṣṇapatnīnāmātmapātivratyadārḍhyaprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā ekonatriṃśadadhikacatuḥśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||429 ||
<1.430> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca yadā viṣṇurahaṃ vaktā lakṣmīstvaṃ śravaṇe ratā | saṃhitāyāstadā śrāvo dvimāsābhyāṃ pramokṣadaḥ || 1 || yadā lakṣmīrhi saṃvaktrī viṣṇuḥ śrotā bhavāmi ca | saṃhitāyāstadā śrāvo vedamāsaiḥ pramokṣadaḥ || 2 || prāpyate śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitayā dhruvaḥ | ātmapātivratyadharmaḥ prāptastvayā mukhānmama || 3 || rādhayā śrīkṛṣṇamukhāt saṃhitāśravaṇena vai | tathānyābhirgopikābhiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇānanāt || 4 || kāśyāṃ kuṃkumavāpyāṃ ca badaryāṃ divyadhāmasu | sarvasṛṣṭau yathāyogyamasyā bhāgena vai dhruvam || 5 || pātivratyaṃ paraṃ prāptā narā nāryo narāyaṇe | muktiṃ ca śāśvatīṃ jagmurmama dhāmni ca śāśvatīm || 6 || śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ ramyāṃ bhavabandhananāśinīm | pāñcāladeśe rājābhūd vaiṣṇavo dhārmikaḥ śuciḥ || 7 || nirbhayavarmā nṛpatirnārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ | tulasīmālayā nityaṃ bhajate śrīnarāyaṇam || 8 || dhyānaṃ pūjāṃ kriyākāṇḍaṃ mudā nārāyaṇārpaṇam | cakre sarvaṃ harau nityaṃ sarvasvārpaṇapūrvakam || 9 || eko dānakasaṃjñaśca kumārastasya dhārmikaḥ | navadhā bhaktimān kṛṣṇe gopīnāthaparāyaṇaḥ || 1.430.10 || nirbhayastu tapastepe bhaktiyuktaṃ sudāruṇam | tadgṛhe tu sute jāte rādhālakṣmīkalānvite || 11 || jīvantī lāvaṇyavatī brahmacaryaparāyaṇe | nārāyaṇaṃ svāminaṃ te sevāte pātivratyataḥ || 12|| sākṣādbhaktyā hariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sevāṃ gṛhṇāti tatkṛtām | te hyubhe śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmiparāyaṇe || 13|| vratasthe tapasā yukte devakāryaparāyaṇe | yadgṛhe bhagavān kṛṣṇo virājate nirantaram || 14|| unmattā ca savid yatra kṛṣṇadāsī virājate | kumāraḥ paścime vyāghrāraṇye talasya rakṣasaḥ || 15|| vanaṃ saṃprāviśat tīrthaṃ kartuṃ śyāmasya darśanam | tatrāraṇyaṃ yoginaśca raivatācalavāsinaḥ || 16|| vyāghrasiṃhādirūpaiḥ saṃvicaranti sma ca kvacit | kumāreṇa pathi dṛṣṭāḥ siṃhā vyāghrāḥ śataṃ param || 17|| bhayena trasto vṛkṣaṃ sa samāruroha satvaram | siṃhāstu drumasānnidhye niṣedurnirbhayā yathā || 18|| tān dṛṣṭvā niścalān siṃhān kruddho hantuṃ mano dadhe | krodhena tejasā dānī vyamuñcad dāruṇān śarān || 1 9|| eko bāṇena viddhaśca prāpa mṛtyuṃ tadāpare | ṛṣirūpāstāpasāste babhūvurmānavā drutam ||1.430.20 || rājānamāhuḥ ṛṣayo vayaṃ raivatavāsinaḥ | yoginaḥ sma samāyātā yātrārthaṃ śyāmaśārṅgiṇaḥ ||21 || mā hindhi krūrarūpāṃśca paśūn jñātvā nṛpottama | iti śrutvā munīn dṛṣṭvā kumāraḥ śokamāptavān ||22|| aho mayā hato yogī vipro hyajānatā vane | tīrthapuṇyasthale pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ hatyātmakaṃ mayā ||23|| kathaṃ vai niṣkṛtistvasya bhavenme hananasya vai | vicāryāvatatāra droḥ papāta caraṇe tadā ||24|| prāharṣīn pāpanāśārthaṃ vidhyantu māṃ śarairmuhuḥ | hatyātmakaṃ pāpaṃ mama naśyenmaharṣayaḥ ||25|| dayālavastu ṛṣayaḥ śaraṇāgatameva tam | vaiṣṇavaṃ chatradharmāṇaṃ procuḥ kṛpāparaṃ vacaḥ ||26|| vayaṃ tu sādhavo dvandvasahā raivatayoginaḥ | siddhā divyā divyadehāḥ saṃkalpādhīnacāriṇaḥ ||27|| jīvayituṃ mṛtaṃ sarvaṃ samarthāḥ sma ca mā śucaḥ | ityuktvā talaśyāmasya tīrthasyoṣṇodakaṃ śave ||28|| dhārayā saṃdaduḥ sarve sajīvo bhava cocire | tāvadṛṣiḥ samutthāya nanāma tān gurūnmuhu_ ||29|| dānī cātiprasanno’bhūt pupūja tān hṛdā muhuḥ | ṛṣayastu tadādṛśyabhāvaṃ prāpto vanāntare ||1.430.30 || kintu hatyodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ vavalge dāninaṃ tu yat | tenātivihvalastatra hatyayā pīḍito vane ||3 1 || babhrāma hatyayā lagno vyādhadharmamupāśritaḥ | na kvāpi sthitimāpede hatyayābhidruto bhṛśam ||32|| sa vai bhraman yayau siṃhāraṇyaṃ yatra sarasvatī | vaḍavāgniṃ samudre sā pracikṣepa purā kṛte ||33|| tataḥ saḥ somanāthaṃ satkṣetraṃ prāpa kumārakaḥ | prācīṃ sarasvatīṃ cāpi yayau yatra mahāmuniḥ ||34|| tritonāmā divyadehaḥ parṇakuṭyāṃ virājate | tenāyaṃ satkṛtastasya pādayoḥ patito bhuvi || 35|| pādāvanejanaṃ cakre pādasaṃvāhanādikam | jalāharaṇaṃ dāsyaṃ ca phalāhārādikaṃ tathā ||36|| kuṭyāśramasya mārjanyā mārjanaṃ nirvikaccaram | patrāvalīkaraṇaṃ ca brahmavṛkṣadalādibhiḥ || 37|| cakāra sevanaṃ tasya tritasya yoginaḥ sa vai | yogyaṃ lakṣmi sādhusevā pāpaṃ dahati janmanaḥ ||38|| sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ vandanaṃ pāpanāśanam | prasannatā bhāgyadā ca tṛptiḥ putrādivaṃśadā ||3 9|| pādasevā śrīpradā ca mokṣadā tu prapannatā | santoṣaṇaṃ sarvadaṃ hi santoṣaṇīyāḥ sādhavaḥ ||1.430.40 || yeṣāṃ caraṇavāryatra brahmahatyādināśakam | yoṣāṃ pādarajaḥ pāpipāpapradhvaṃsanaṃ śubham ||41 || yeṣāṃ pūjā bhojanādi sarvaṃ rakṣati sarvadā | yadāśiṣaḥ sumūrtāśca rakṣanti deśakālayoḥ ||42|| yathāśakti yathādravyaṃ yathābhāvastathā tathā | sevanīyāḥ sadā santo divyāste harimūrtayaḥ ||43 || nirguṇā bandhanairhīnāḥ sevakām̐stārayanti vai | tritasya sevayā lakṣmi brahmahatyā layaṃ gatā ||44|| tato vismayamāpannaḥ kumāro dānako muhuḥ | sādhusamāgamastasyā vināśe veda kāraṇam ||45|| tāvattatra samāyātā netumenaṃ yamānugāḥ | yamadūtānmahāghorān dadarśa dānakastadā ||46 || sevāpuṇyena sasmāra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | gopīnāthaṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ svāminaṃ jagatāṃ patim ||47|| nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ svasya pārṣadānāha satvaram | gacchantu dānirakṣārthaṃ vārayantu yamānugān ||48|| ityādiṣṭāḥ pārṣadāste samāyayustritāśramam | dūraṃ vai vṛkṣamadhye tān dṛṣṭvā dūtān hi dāruṇān ||49|| ākrośena parābhāvya vidrāvya bhaktasevakam | dāninaṃ ninyurete vaimānikena pathā harim ||1.430.50 || hariḥ prāha muneḥ sevā kṛtānena supuṇyadā | bhakto’sti me mahāśānto dāntaścāpi cirāyuṣaḥ ||51 || tasmādenaṃ rājyabhāre sthāpayantu mahābalam | sādhūnāṃ sevako bhāvī vartate vaiṣṇavo mahān ||52|| mahābhāgavato bhāvī madarthārpitanaijakaḥ | ityuktaśca tadā dānī prāha taṃ parameśvaram ||53|| na kāṃkṣyate bhuvo rājyaṃ na janma na ca vai divam | kāṃkṣyate te sadā sevā rādhālakṣmyanvitasya vai ||54|| hariḥ prāha tathāstvetad gaccha vatsa yathāsukham | tava svasrormama rādhālakṣmyau nivatsyataḥ śubhe ||55|| ahaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī nivatsyāmi tava gṛhe | sukhayiṣye mokṣayiṣye gaccha tvaṃ pārṣadaiḥ saha ||56|| tava dūrge nivatsyāmi svastyastu te’nu sevaka | ityādiṣṭo bhagavatā yayau svanagaraṃ prati ||57|| kṛṣṇapātivratyaparān dharmāṃścakāra dādakaḥ | sādhusevāparaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprasevakaḥ ||58|| sarvotsavakaraḥ kṛṣṇārpitasarvasvadakṣiṇaḥ | pravṛddhaḥ sarvasampadbhirgolokasadṛśaṃ gṛham ||59|| kārayitvā gopikāyukkṛṣṇaṃ saṃsthāpya tatra ca | bhuktvā bhogān samastāṃśca jīvanmukto’bhavatsadā ||1.430.6 0|| satāṃ patiḥ prabhurnārāyaṇaḥ svāmī janārdanaḥ | tasya gṛhe yathoktaṃ ca nivāsaṃ pracakāra ha ||6 1 || taduttaraṃ hareḥ pātivratyayukte satī hyubhe | jīvantī lāvaṇyavatī divyaiśvarye babhūvatuḥ ||62|| jīvantyāṃ śrīrādhikāyāḥ kalāveśo babhūva ha | lāvaṇyavatyāṃ lakṣmyāśca kalāveśo babhūva ha ||63|| jīvantyā lāvaṇyavatyā dādakena nirantaram | pātivratyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe gopīśvare kṛtam ||64|| trayasya bhagavān dhārmiḥ pratyakṣo vartate’nvaham | bhojane śayane vāṭyāṃ vihāre ca samutsave ||65|| vimānena sadā yāti lokāntareṣu taiḥ saha | muktairdevaiḥ pūjitaśca samāyātyanu tadgṛham ||66|| jīvantyā lāvaṇyavatyārpitaṃ bhuṃkte hariḥ svayam | śrīhariṇā tu jīvantyai lāvaṇyāyai ca dānine ||67|| svasya mantraḥ pradattaśca saṃsārabhavanāśakaḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ||68|| iti mantraṃ samāsādya cakrustatkīrtanaṃ muhuḥ | tacchrutvā prāṇinaḥ sarve vaikuṇṭhaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ ||69|| ekadā dādako gatvā yamamārge’tidāruṇe | mantraṃ japan sthito dvāri śrāvayāmāsa nārakān ||1.430.70 || sarve’pi nārakāḥ pūtā yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ | yamakṣetramabhūd riktaṃ kṛṣṇakīrtanasaṃśravāt ||71 || gacchadbhirvaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma svakarmasthairjanaiḥ kṣaṇāt | śūnyāstu narakāḥ sarve pāpiprāṇivivarjitāḥ ||72|| vaikuṇṭhe nārado dṛṣṭvā hyakasmādvaiṣṇavāgamam | papraccha tān kutaḥ sarve samāyānti hi vaiṣṇavāḥ ||73 || te prāhuryamalokādvai tatra dādakanāmakaḥ | śrāvayitvā harermantraṃ pāyayāmāsa nārakān ||74|| āyayuste nārakā ye vayaṃ sma eva te mune | śrutvaitannāradastūrṇaṃ yamakṣetraṃ tu vīkṣitum ||75||| samāyayau dharmalokaṃ yamena pūjito muniḥ | papraccha dharmarājaṃ sa riktaṃ kṣetraṃ hi te katham ||76 || dharmarājastadā prāha dādako bhaktarāḍayam | atibhakto hṛṣīkeśe purāṇapuruṣottame ||77|| prabodhayati kṛṣṇasya nāmamantraṃ hi nārakān | te sarve tu gatā viṣṇorlokaṃ brahma tu śāśvatam ||78|| ayaṃ bhakto mayā yadvā tvayā yamasya maṇḍalāt | vinayena ca satkṛtyā dūrayitavya eva yat ||79|| iti vicārya devarṣiyamarṣī procatustu tam | bho bhaktarāṭ pāpino vai tava kīrtanasaṃśravāt ||1.430.80|| daṇḍyāṃ sthalīṃ vihāyaiva gacchanti viṣṇudhāma te | anyāyo bhavate tvatra mā kartavyaṃ tathānagha ||81 || dharmalopo bhavennaiva karmalopo bhavenna ca | tathā kāryaṃ tvayā bhakta yāhi svanagaraṃ prati ||82|| dānakaḥ saḥ tadā prāha muktirdeyā vrataṃ mama | pātivratyaṃ paro dharmaḥ kṛṣṇasarvasvameva yat ||83|| tatprāptyarthaṃ hi jīvānāṃ pāpināṃ pāpanāśanam | tannāmasmaraṇaṃ cātra karomi dharmameva me ||84|| na gamiṣye mama sthānaṃ vāso’tra rocate mama | nārakāṇāṃ praduḥkhānāṃ duḥkhamocanahetave ||85|| ityuktau niścayaṃ nāyaṃ gamiṣyati gṛhe svakam | vicārya tau vimānena yayaturyamanāradau ||86|| brahmākhyaṃ śrīharerdhāma lebhāte svāgataṃ hareḥ | pupūjaturnematuśca niṣedaturhareḥ puraḥ ||87|| tadā yamo jagādainaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ jagatpatim | nātha pāpamaye kṣetre tava bhakto hi dānakaḥ ||88|| samāgatya tava nāmnāṃ karoti kīrtanaṃ muhuḥ | yamakṣetraṃ tena jātaṃ riktaṃ sarvaṃ hi nirjanam ||89 || adhikāro nirartho me kṛtastenātikīrtanāt | karmadaṇḍasya paṭṭaste jāyate sma nirarthakaḥ ||1.430.90|| niyogi na niyogaṃ hi karoti kāryayojitaḥ | prabhorvittaṃ samaśnāti sa bhavet kāṣṭhakīṭakaḥ || 91 || lobhād vittasya hartā ca kāryasyāvinivartakaḥ | tiryagyonimavāpnoti kalpaparyantameva saḥ||92|| vetanaṃ tvarjayan kāryamālasyena karoti na | sa jāyate vanamadhye vāyasaḥ śatavatsarān ||93 || svārthī svāmikāryaloptā mūṣako jāyate vane | so’haṃ nirarthakaścāsmi dānī yāvanmama sthale ||94|| taṃ tva tasmānmama kṣetrād dūrīkuru janārdana | nigrāhyo jagatāṃ nātha bhavatā dānakaḥ śuciḥ || 95|| anyathā te daṇḍapaṭastava padbhyāṃ nivedyate | kiṃ vṛthā dhāraṇenāsya vṛthā vai vetanena ca ||96|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau hariḥ prāha yamaṃ tadā | kimāścaryaṃ bhavedatra mannāmnāmanukīrtanam || 97|| pāpināṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā | jihvāgre vartate yasya harirityakṣaradvayam ||98|| karṇayo patitaṃ yasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca | prayāti kṛṣṇasāyujyaṃ pāpyuddhārakaro hariḥ ||99|| bhaktā me pāpijīvānāmuddhārārthaṃ sthale sthale | vicaranti yatheṣṭaṃ te tārayanti prapattitaḥ || 1.430.10 0|| teṣāmahaṃ sadā tuṣṭo ye gṛṇanti mamābhidhām | tārayanti pāpinaśca kīrtayanti kathāṃ mama || 101 || pātivratyaṃ pālayanti dhārayanti ca māṃ hṛdi | vartayanti madarthe ca narā nāryaśca me matāḥ || 1 02|| matkāryaṃ te hi kurvanti madarthe tyaktajīvanāḥ | teṣāṃ cāhaṃ prasannātmā sahāye sarvadā sthitaḥ || 1 03|| yatkaroti karotyeva śreṣṭhaṃ tanmuktikṛd yama | niyogī svāmikāryeṣu yāvacchakti samīhate || 1 04|| tāvatā sa kṛtārthaḥ syānnarakānnaiva gacchati | kārye śaktiviniṣkānte svāmine vai nivedayet || 1 05|| anṛṇastāvatā bhṛtyo niyogī sukhamaśnute | smānniveditārthasya na ṛṇaṃ na ca pātakam || 1 06|| yatne kṛte svakartavye nāparādho’sti dehinaḥ | tasmādaśakyakāryesminna viśocitumarhasi || 1 07|| lakṣmīṃ vāpi parityakṣye prāṇān dehamathāpi vāṃ | śrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ mālāṃ vaijayantīmathāpi vā || 1 08|| śvetadvīpaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ kṣīrasāgarameva ca | śoṣaṃ ca garuḍaṃ caiva na bhakta tyaktumutsahe || 1 09|| visṛjya sakalān bhogān madarthe tyaktajīvitān | madātmakān mahābhāgān kathaṃ tostyaktumutsahe || 1.430.11 0|| tasmād rājan dānakaṃ te bhaktavarye svayaṃ hariḥ | dātuṃ vai darśanaṃ yāmi netuṃ yānena vai punaḥ || 111 || gaccha tvaṃ yamalokaṃ ca paścādāyāmyahaṃ yama | vada tasmai mamāyaṃ tvaṃ sa matpreṣṇāplutastadā || 11 2|| kīrtanaṃ me vihāyaiva hāsyanṛtye kariṣyati | tāvattasmai darśanaṃ me datvā dhṛtvā vimānake || 11 3|| gamiṣyāmi tava kārya kṛtvā yāmyasya maṇḍalāt | ityuktaśca yamastatra prajagāmātiharṣitaḥ || 1 14|| śrāvayāmāsa kṛṣṇasyāgamaṃ tasmai hiṃ dānine | so’pi cakāra nṛtyādi bhagavatpremapūritaḥ || 1 15|| tāvad divyaṃ vimānaṃ vai nārāyaṇahareriyāt | caturbhujaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu dānakaḥ || 1 16|| kṛṣṇājñayā vimānaṃ tu samāruhya raṭan muhuḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ || 1 17|| nṛtyan dhyāyannamana kṛṣṇaṃ premamagno’bhavattadā | dharmarājakṛtāṃ pūjāṃ saṃgṛhya bhagavān hariḥ || 1 18|| rādhāramāsamāyukto durge dānigṛhaṃ yayau | avatārya paraṃ bhaktaṃ svayaṃ sthitvā niśāṃ prabhuḥ || 1 19|| jīvantyā lāvaṇyavatyāḥ sevāṃ pativratāmayīm | svīkṛtya bhojanaṃ labdhvā datvā divyaṃ svadarśanam || 1.430.1 20|| abhayasya kuṭumbāya pātivratyāyanāya ca | jīvantyāṃ kalayā rādhāṃ lāvaṇyāyāṃ śriyaṃ tathā || 121 || kalayā vasituṃ tvājñāṃ datvā chāyātmake yathā | tathā te kanyake kṛtvā pāvayitvā gṛhāṇi ca || 1 22|| unmattāyā jale snātvā pītvāmbhastatra pāvanam | vaihāyasena divyena yānena svapadaṃ yayau ||1 23|| gopyo jñātvā tu tadvrattaṃ mathurāmaṇḍalāttathā | dvārikātaḥ kṛṣṇapalayo jagmuśca divyavigrahāḥ || 124|| rādhālakṣmīnivāsena gopīnāṃ kṛṣṇayoṣitām | vāsarūpaṃ babhūvaitat kṣetraṃ durgātmakaṃ puram | | 1 25|| śrīharestatra vāsena golokasadṛśaṃ hi tat | brahmadhāmasamaṃ divyaṃ mokṣadaṃ jātamuttamam || 1 26|| darśanātsparśanānnadyā jalapānāvagāhanāt | dhūlyāstu dhāraṇād dehe pāpakṣayaśca mokṣaṇam || 1 27|| rādhālakṣmīpratāpena prātivratyavṛṣeṇa ca | asaṃkhyānāṃ tu dāsīnāṃ sāṃkhyayogavratena ca || 1 28|| koṭiyajñaphaladātṛ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritam | śroturvaktustīrthayātuḥ parākṣarapadapradam || 1 29|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pātivratye saurāṣṭrapañcāladeśīyadādaka(dānaka)nṛpatestalaśyāmayātrāyāṃ siṃharūparṣighāte jātabrahmahatyāyāstritamunisevayā nāśottaramāgatayamadūtānāṃ bhagavatpārṣadairnivāraṇaṃ, haribhajanena yamanārakāṇāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ, dāna(da)kasya rādhālakṣmīnārāyaṇāśīrvādo durge jīvantīlāvaṇyavatyoraṃśatayā rādhālakṣmyornivāso harerapi durgakṣetre nivāsaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṃśatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||430 ||
<1.431> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi śreṣṭhaṃ pativratāvṛṣam | patirnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇastadvrataṃ tat pativratam || 1 || patyarthaṃ vṛtyate yāvad buddhisādhanakarmabhiḥ | patiryathā praśasyeta tathā patnyā vidhīyate || 2 || aguṇo vā saguṇo vā durguṇo’pi praśaṃsyate | īśavat sarvathā nāryā gīyate jihvayā dhiyā || 3 || tadvrataṃ prathamaṃ lakṣmi pātivratyottamaṃ matam | praśaṃsā sarvathā sarvaprāṇināṃ śarkarāsamā || 4 || atimiṣṭā miṣṭatamā sarvatrāpyanubhūyate | putrapraśaṃsayā pramodate tatpitarau yathā || 5 || pitṛpraśaṃsayā putrāḥ pramodante’tiharṣitāḥ | patnīpraśaṃsayā svāmī pramodate’ti cāntare || 6 || śreṣṭhipraśaṃsayā bhṛtyo rājñaḥ praśaṃsayā prajāḥ | vṛṣapraśaṃsayā vṛṣavāhako’pi pramodate || 7 || śiṣyapraśaṃsayā gururguroḥ praśaṃsayānugaḥ | deśapraśaṃsayā deśī śāstrapraśaṃsayāstikaḥ || 8 || yatprati yasya sadbhāvastatpraśaṃsā tu bhāvinaḥ | modapramodasaṃsthānaṃ samutsāhotsavāvahā || 9 || bhavatyeva sadā lakṣmi patikīrtisugarbhitā | videśasthasya kāntasya vārtā śrutvā pativratā || 1.431.1 0|| putrotsavādhikānandavatī bhavati tatkṣaṇam | tadvrataṃ mānasagamyaṃ pātivratyaṃ mudāvaham || 11 || hārdaṃ snehaṃ na cānye vai prajānanti parātmanaḥ | parātmano guṇā naiva sākṣād bhavanti sarvathā || 12|| svātmamanaḥsaṃyogasya hetostatrānupasthiteḥ | āveśādikriyāyoge paramparābhiyogataḥ || 13| pratyakṣamiva cānyeṣāmābhāsante na vāstavam | pātivratyaṃ sadā snigdhaṃ hyakāraṇaṃ sakāraṇam || 14|| svārthaṃ yadvā parārthaṃ vā svārthamevānubhūyate | mama svāmī kathaṃ khyāto bhavedityāgrahaḥ striyāḥ || 15|| pātivratyānvayitvaṃ vai satataṃ bodhyameva hi | patyuḥ kathāśrave yadvat te’sti pramoda āgrahaḥ || 16|| tadvat kṛṣṇakathābodhe yasyāstyāgraha utkaṭaḥ | kathāyāḥ śravaṇe vāpi kīrtane ca praśaṃsane || 17|| puṃso bhaktasya nāryāśca bhaktimatyāḥ sadā hareḥ | sataḥ satyāstato nityaṃ pātivratyaṃ prakāśate || 18|| dāsyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pātivratyaṃ śubhaṃ prasannatāpradam | kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ pātivratyaṃ tato’dhikaṃ matam || 1 9|| kathāyāḥ kīrtanaṃ pātivratyaṃ tato’pi cottamam | patyuḥ svasvāminaḥ kīrtergānaṃ nityaṃ hi durlabham ||1.431.20|| patyuśca śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyābhedabhāvataḥ | sarvadā guṇagānaṃ tatpātivratyaṃ paraṃ striyāḥ ||21 || hareḥ kathātmakaṃ pātivratyaṃ satpatilokadam | śroturvakturna sandehaḥ santuṣṭo’haṃ janārdanaḥ ||22|| nayāmi taṃ mahatsvargaṃ satīlokaṃ satīṃ tathā | niṣkāmānāṃ ca maddhāma matpadaṃ preṣayāmi vai ||23|| matkathābhirhi lokānāṃ hṛdayeṣu nirantaram | madbhaktirnihitā yena lakṣāṇāṃ koṭidehinām ||24|| mama dāsyaṃ kathādvāṅkuritaṃ yena dehiṣu | mama vrataṃ mama sevā mama pūjā mamārhaṇam || 25|| mama jāpo mama bhaktirmama smṛtirmamāśrayaḥ | mamecchā mama vijñānaṃ mama dhyānaṃ mamehanam ||26|| mama yogo mama vāñcchā mamārpaṇaṃ mama grahaḥ | maddhāraṇā mayi nyāso mayi vāso mamārthanā ||27|| mayyabhedo mayi sneho mayi kāmo ratirmayi | mama sarvasvadānaṃ ca madarthaṃ jīvanaṃ mṛtiḥ ||28|| upārjanaṃ madarthaṃ ca madarthamupakāritā | paropakārādi dānaṃ vrataṃ puṇyaṃ madarthakam ||29|| matpade gamanaṃ tvante matsevāgrahaṇaṃ sadā | kathābhiḥ kāritaṃ yena lokānāṃ hṛdayeṣu vai ||1.431.3 0|| tādṛśo me kathāvaktā śāstrajñānapradaśca me | manmahimnaḥ puṣṭikartā madbhaktipoṣakaśca yaḥ ||3 1 || tasya lakṣmi pātivratyaṃ mayi koṭiguṇaṃ matam | śreṣṭhācchreṣṭhatamaṃ pātivratyaṃ vakturhi śāśvatam ||32|| kathāvācanapuṇyasya pāraṃ prāpnomi nāpyaham | asaṃkhyajīvajātānāṃ kulānāṃ vaiṣṇavīdhiyā ||3 3 || uddhārako bhavatyeva kathāyā vācako guruḥ | matsyarūpo na sandehastvattaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sa padmaje || 34|| piturdaśaguṇī mātā māturdaśaguṇo guruḥ | pitā bījapradatvena jananī janmadatvataḥ ||35|| gururmokṣapradatvena śreṣṭhaḥ sarvebhya ucyate | patiḥ śreṣṭho guruḥ śreṣṭhastayoḥ śreṣṭhataro guruḥ ||36|| pitā patirguruḥ śreṣṭhāsteṣāṃ śreṣṭhatamo guruḥ | ātmā śreṣṭho hariḥ śreṣṭhastayoḥ śreṣṭhatamo hariḥ ||37|| ātmā harirguruḥ śreṣṭhāsteṣāṃ śreṣṭhatamo guruḥ | yadāśrayāddhareḥ prāptiryaṃ vinā durlabho hariḥ ||38|| pṛthvīdātā vṛttidātā jīvadātā sadottamāḥ | teṣāmapekṣayā mokṣadātā jñānad uttamaḥ ||39|| kṛṣṇajñānaṃ pātivratyaṃ tatpradaḥ supatiḥ smṛtaḥ | kṛṣṇabhaktiḥ svāmidharmastatpradaḥ supatiḥ sadā ||1.431.40|| nāmadhāraḥ patistvanyo yathārtho bhaktidaḥ patiḥ | evaṃ jñātvā hareḥ pātivratyaṃ dhāryaṃ sadā priye ||41 || harerguṇānāṃ gānaṃ ca harermūrteśca cintanam | hareḥ kathāyā vyākhyānaṃ pātivratyaṃ taduttamam ||42|| yatra kathā tatra bhaktā devāstīrthāni cācyutaḥ | devyaḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitaro muktirbhaktirvṛṣādayaḥ ||43|| siddhā yatayaḥ satyaśca sādhavo yoginastathā | yugāḥ śāstrāṇi vedāśca kṣetrāṇi ca vanāni ca ||44|| vyāsāstattvāni muktāśca kathāpātrāṇi yāni ca | āgatya tāṃ kathāṃ bhāvaplutāḥ śṛṇvanti sarvadā ||45||| kecinmūrtā amūrtāścādṛśyā dṛśyāstathāpare | pātivratyaparāḥ sarve kathāṃ śṛṇvanti vai hareḥ ||46|| svasvayaśo hareḥ kīrtiṃ bhaktānāṃ ca kathānakam | śrutvā śrutvā pramodante dadatyāśiṣa eva te ||47|| vācakāya gurave te namaskurvanti vai tathā | śrotāraḥ śiṣyavargā vai namaskurvanti vācakam ||48|| tasmācchrāvayitā śreṣṭhaḥ sarvebhyo gurubhaktidaḥ | nārāyaṇasamo bodhyaḥ pātivratyasya bodhakaḥ ||49|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā kathāṃ śrutvā hareḥ śubhām | sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti kṛṣṇapadaṃ param ||1.431.50|| purā godāvarītīre sampannaṃ sukathānakam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ pārāyaṇaṃ hyabhūt| ||51 || pāpaghnaṃ pāvanaṃ svargapradaṃ jñānadamokṣadam | durvāsaso muneḥ śiṣyo yatiḥ satyavratābhidhaḥ ||52|| brahmaniṣṭho nirapekṣo bhikṣāmātraprajīvanaḥ | guhāvāsakarastatrāparigrahavratānvitaḥ ||53|| tulasīmālikāyuktaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ japan | karotisma kathāṃ nityaṃ sāyaṃ pratidinaṃ priye ||54|| dhyātvā smṛtvā smārayitvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim | namaḥ kṛtvā kārayitvā kṛṣṇakathāṃ karoti saḥ ||55|| śrotṝṇāmapyabhāve ca vyākhyātṛṇāmanāgame | satyavratastu satataṃ karoti śrīhareḥ kathām ||56|| nityakarma svakaṃ kṛtvā karotyeva hareḥ kathām | śrotā cedasti yaḥ kaścit tasmai vyākhyātyaharniśam |||57|| yadi nāsti sthale śrotā rikte’pi kurute kathām | anyo vyākhyāti kaścidvā hareḥ puṇyāṃ kathāṃ tadā ||58|| svakarmāṇi parityajya śṛṇoti śrīhareḥ kathām | hareḥ pātivratyaparaḥ kathāyāḥ śravaṇe rataḥ ||59|| tīrthāni devatānāṃ cāgārāṇyapi vihāya saḥ | kathāvirodhakānyanyakarmāṇyapi vihāya saḥ ||1.431.6 0|| kathāṃ divyā saṃśṛṇoti sati vaktari sarvadā | vaktaryasati svayaṃ ca vyākhyāti kṛṣṇasatkathām ||6 1 || kathāṃ vinā na jānāti pātivratyaṃ paraṃ vṛṣam | catvare ca gṛhe naije svayaṃ vyākhyāti bhāvataḥ ||62|| āvaśyakāni kāryāṇi kathāto nādhikāni vai | āvaśyakottamaṃ kārya kathārūpaṃ pradhānakam ||63|| kathāyā viratau cānyakāryaprādhānyameva ha | kathāṃ lakṣmi śyāvatastu karmabandho na vidyate ||64|| jñānadīpaḥ pradīptaḥ syād viratiśca vivardhate | sattvaśuddhistathā śāntiḥ śṛṇvataḥ saṃpravartate ||65|| harau prītiḥ sadā śṛṇvatā kathāṃ dārḍhyamāpyate | kṛṣṇe prītyā mahāratyā kṛṣṇohṛdyavarudhyate ||66|| yeṣu kṛṣṇasteṣu cāsya sauhārdaṃ satsu jāyate | sādhurūpo haristvasya pratyakṣo bhavati dhruvam ||67|| tato divyaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ | pātivratyaṃ paraṃ jñātvā divyadarśanado bhavet ||68|| puṃsā nāryā tataḥ kṛṣṇakathā śravyā yathābalam | kathāṃ vinā na vai jñānaṃ tadvinā śāntireva na ||69|| duḥkhāvartte bhave tvasmin śāntikṛt kṛṣṇakīrtanam | kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ caiva kṛṣṇasya smārakaṃ param ||1.431.70|| sattvaśuddhikaraṃ cāpi śuddhyā dhyānaṃ prajāyate | bahudhā śravaṇaṃ tasya mananaṃ dhyānamuttamam ||71|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipatiprāptikaraṃ matam | yatra kṛṣṇakathā naiva yatra santi na sādhavaḥ ||72|| gaṃgātaṭamapi tyājyaṃ vinā patiṃ na tat priyam | yatra vai tulasī nāsti na yatra harimandiram ||73|| yatra hare pātivratyaparo bhakto na vartate | yatra viṣṇoḥ kathā nāsti grāmaḥ śmaśānasadṛśaḥ ||74|| tatra mṛto jano yāti yamarājatamaḥsthalīm | iti vicārya munirāṭ satyavrataḥ sa vaiṣṇavaḥ ||75|| brahmavidyāparo viṣṇusmṛtimātraparāyaṇaḥ | hareḥ kathāparo nityaṃ manute cātmakarma tat ||76|| na kiñcidadhikaṃ jātu manute śravaṇātparam | kathāyāḥ kathanādvāpi paraṃ dharmo na tasya vai ||77|| nityaṃ sāyaṃ niścite vai samaye vyāsapaṭṭikām | samāgatya niyamena kathāṃ karoti yatra vai ||78|| ekadā tatra rājñaśca sainyaṃ vai pārśvato gatam | janāḥ sarve niruddhāśca vyāso’pi ruddha eva ha ||79|| mārge kenāpi naivātra gantavyaṃ sainyamadhyataḥ | iti mārge niruddhaḥ sa kathārodho’pi tena vai ||1.431.80|| devādyā ye śravaṇārthaṃṃ tvāyātāstatsthale ca te | pratīkṣante sma vaktuścāgamanaṃ taddiśādṛśaḥ ||81|| satyavrato na cāyāto vyatyeti samayastadā | satyavratasvarūpaṃ ca dhṛtvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||82|| svayaṃ kathāṃ śrāvayituṃ niṣasādāsane tadā | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāmakaroddhariḥ ||83|| devāḥ śṛṇvanti bhāvena sainyaṃ krāntaṃ pathastadā | satyavrataḥ samāyāto dṛṣṭvā vyāsaṃ svarūpiṇam ||84|| mahadāścaryamāpanno vijñāya smarato harim | nanāmānyairyathā dṛśyo na bhaved viṣṇunā kṛtaḥ ||85|| āgatya tvāsane viṣṇormūrtau līno’bhavattadā | kathā vicchedarahitā yathā tatra pravartate ||86|| viṣṇunā sandhitastatra svasmin satyavrataḥ priyaḥ | kṛṣṇastvadṛśyatāṃ prāptaḥ kathā tadvatpravartate ||87|| satyavrataḥ samuvāca ślokaṃ viṣṇuvirāmitam | tāvatsvarasya śravaṇe mādhuryaṃ bhinnatāṃ gatam ||88|| ākarṣaṇaṃ divyatā ca pūrvato’nyavidhāṃ gatā | devādibhistadā jñātaṃ dhyānibhiryogavṛttibhiḥ ||89|| svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kathāṃ cakre satyavratānupasthitau | aho dhanyā vayaṃ kṛṣṇamukhātkathāśravaṃ gatāḥ ||1.431.90|| ityāścaryaṃ gatāḥ sarve śṛṇvanti ca kathāṃ punaḥ | tāvat tatra samāyātaḥ śiṣyo durvāsaso’paraḥ ||91 || tapovratākhyaḥ karmaṭhaḥ kathānādarakṛt sadā | kathāṃ mṛṣāṃ manyamānaḥ śrotṝn vaktṛm̐śca narmakṛt ||92|| prajahāsa kathāṃ śrutvā vitaṇḍāṃ pracakāra ha | jalpayitvā kathañcicca vyājahāra durāgrahī ||93|| vaktā pratārayatīmānime tu paśavo yathā | pratāraṇājālabaddhāḥ kathayā mṛṣayā muhuḥ ||94|| ityuktvā prayayau hitvā vācyamānāṃ kathāṃ tadā | na vyākhyāti svayaṃ kvāpi na śṛṇoti kadāpi ca ||95|| tapaḥ kāryaṃ paraṃ matvā gṛhakāryādikaṃ śubham | karotyeva sadā tadvai kathānindāṃ karoti vai ||96|| evaṃ tvāyuḥkṣaye prāpte nindāpāpena vai vane | piśāco’bhūcchamīvṛkṣe nirjale chinnakarṇakaḥ ||97|| nirāhāro mahāduḥkhī śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ | svakṛtaṃ cintayānaḥ sa mattonmatta ivābhramat ||98|| prāptaṃ jalaṃ vahnitulyaṃ phalapuṣpādikaṃ viṣam | vāyurvahnisamastvasya jāyate pāpakarmaṇaḥ ||99|| na nirvṛttiṃ na vā tṛptiṃ labhate karmaṭho vane | sādhuśūnye kathāśūnye’raṇye kṣudhākulo rudan || 1.431.1 00|| satyavratena daivādvai dṛṣṭo mārgeṇa gacchatā | pṛṣṭhaḥ kosīdṛśīṃ kasmād daśāṃ prāpto’si me vada || 101 || iti pṛṣṭhaśchinnakarṇastapovrata uvāca tam | durvāsasaḥ suśiṣyo’haṃ tapovratasunāmadhṛk || 1 02|| kathānindotthapāpena piśāco’smi suduḥkhitaḥ | adya te darśanānmokṣo bhaviṣyati mamātra vai || 103 || kṣamasva tvaṃ cāparādhān mama vaitaṇḍikādikān | ityuktvā sa rudan mokṣaṃ samicchan pṛthivīṃ spṛśan || 1 04|| papāta pādayoḥ satyavratasya trāhi māṃ gṛṇan | satyavrataḥ salilaṃ svakare dhṛtvā hariṃ smaran || 1 05|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | iti mantraṃ dadau karṇe jalaṃ cikṣepa mastake || 1 06|| datvā pādaṃ tasya pṛṣṭhe pāpaṃ prajvālya śaktitaḥ | samarpyaikadivasīyakathāyāḥ puṇyamuttamam || 1 07|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitādhyāyasya kathodbhavam | jñānaṃ pradāya ca kṛtvā muktaṃ piśācadehataḥ || 1 08|| divyadehadharaṃ kṛtvā sasmāra śrīhariṃ prabhum | tāvat kṛṣṇaḥ samāyāto rādhālakṣmīprabhānvitaḥ ||1 09|| pārvatīmāṇikīnāthaḥ padmāramājayāpatiḥ | lalitāśrīpatiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sapārṣadaḥ || 1.431.11 0|| koṭisūryātisaṃśobhivimānavarasaṃsthitaḥ | satyavratena bhagavān nato’rcitaḥ stuto muhuḥ || 111 || tapovrataṃ vimāne sve netuṃ samprārthito muhuḥ | prajahāsa haristatra bhaktecchāpūrakaḥ prabhuḥ || 11 2|| prāha golokavāsārhaṃ puṇyaṃ vai nāsya vidyate | satyavratastadā prāha gurumantreṇa dīkṣitaḥ ||1 13|| vaiṣṇavo’sti mayā tvatra kṛto’yaṃ puṇyavān kṛtaḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitaikādhyāyasya sukṛtam || 1 14|| dattamasmai mayā kṛṣṇa dadāmi tulasīsrajam | tava pādajalaṃ cāsmai punardadāmi keśava || 1 15|| tava prasādaṃ naivedyaṃ dadāmyasmai kṣaṇena ca | tena puṇyena bhakto’yaṃ tavānugrahamātrataḥ ||1 16|| golokaṃ te yātu dhāma bhaktecchāpūrako bhavān | ityuktaḥ sa hariḥ satyavrataṃ tathāstu cāha yat || 1 17|| tapovrato muniṃ natvā vimānaṃ tvacyutājñayā | samāruroha prayayau golokaṃ viṣṇunā saha || 1 18|| durvāsāśca tadā tatrājagāma divyadṛṣṭimān | praśaśaṃsa svakaṃ śiṣyaṃ satyavrataṃ kathākaram ||1 1 9|| satīrthyamokṣadaṃ śāntaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ bhavatārakam | punaḥ punastadovāca durvāsā hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ||1.431.1 20|| aho hyekena śiṣyeṇa tāritaḥ karmaṭho’paraḥ | aho hyekena śiṣyeṇa tāritaṃ sakalaṃ jagat || 121|| aho hyekena śiṣyeṇa tārito’haṃ gurustathā | ayo hyekena śiṣyeṇa śiṣyavānasmi sāmpratam || 122|| satsu daśasahasreṣu śiṣyeṣvapi suśiṣyavān | satyavratena jāto’smi kṛṣṇakathāprasevinā || 1 23|| yatra kṛṣṇakathāpūrapravāho vahate sadā | tatra vāsakṛtāṃ muktirdāsīva karapātragā || 124|| iti te śrāvito lakṣmi kathāpativratāvṛṣaḥ | śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya kṛṣṇadhāmapadaṃ labhet || 125|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne durvāsasaḥ śiṣyasya pātivratyaparāyaṇasya satyavratanāmakasyaikadivasīyakathāpuṇyadānena tapovratasya piśācatvamokṣaṇaṃ dhāmaprāptiśca, satyavratasya kathākāle’nupasthitau bhagavān satyavratarūpadhṛk kathāmavācayadityādinirūpaṇanāmaikatriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||43 1 ||
<1.432> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi pātivratyaparāyaṇām | divyāṃ camatkṛtiṃ vakṣye pāpatāpavināśinīm || 1 | pāñcāladeśe saurāṣṭre hemantākhyo’bhavannṛpaḥ | śaśāsa rājyaṃ dharmeṇa paścime puṇyalālasaḥ || 2 || pūrvaṃ dānaṃ kṛtaṃ tena ratnānāṃ kanakasya ca | jalaṃ mūlyātmakaṃ nāsti jaladānaṃ tu nākarot || 3 || tena doṣeṇa rājño vai liptasya ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | sampaddhānirjāyate sma gajāśvā rogapīḍitāḥ || 4 || gomahiṣyādi yacchreṣṭhaṃ naṣṭaṃ paśudhanaṃ hi tat | ajāvikaṃ samastaṃ ca vanyaṃ mṛgādikaṃ tathā || 5 || rogaprapīḍitaṃ sarvaṃ vināśamagamacchanaiḥ | anāvṛṣṭirabhūttasya nirmānuṣyavidhāyinī || 6 || deśaḥ śuṣkastato jātaḥ prajā deśāntaraṃ yayuḥ | rājyakośādikaṃ jātaṃ śūnyaṃ riktaṃ ca nirbalam || 7 || jñātvā tvanye nṛpāḥ pañca militvā yānamācaran | taṃ jetuṃ sulabhaṃ matvā samājagmuḥ samantataḥ || 8 || pāñcālarājaṃ yuddhena jigyurninyuśca sampadaḥ | hemantaḥ svapativratāpatnyā yuktastu raivate || 9 || dhātrībhṛtyādisahito viveśa girigahvaram | māninyā bhāryayā yukto vanyairyātrāṃ carannṛpaḥ ||1.432.1 0|| cintayāmāsa bahudhā badarījambvaraṇyake | phalakandakṛtāhāraḥ kimetad dukhaḥmāgatam || 11 || mayā dānaṃ pradattaṃ vai bahudhā pratiparvaṇi | mātṛpitṛhitaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtavānasmi sevakaḥ || 12|| guravastoṣitā nityaṃ brāhmaṇāścāpi rakṣitāḥ | dharmaḥ surakṣitaḥ śaśvad devāścāpi prapūjitāḥ || 13|| indriyāṇāṃ vaśe nāhaṃ nāhaṃ vyasanalampaṭaḥ | na cauryapāradāryādikartṛsaṃgī kadācana ||14|| tathāpi vai kathaṃ cedaṃ dāridryaṃ samupāgatam | parājayo mahān jāto viruddhā bāndhavādayaḥ || 15|| ye’nukūlāstu te sarve’dhunāptāḥ pratikūlatām | kasya vā karmaṇaścedaṃ phalamāptaṃ mayā prabho || 16|| evaṃ cintayatastasya raivatādrivane’niśam | yātrārthaṃ tvāgatastatra tadgururyājakābhidhaḥ || 17|| prāptaśca satkṛto vanyaistṛpto nataśca pādayoḥ | papraccha duḥkhaprāpteḥ sa pāñcāleśastu kāraṇam || 18|| dāridryaṃ kośanāśaśca śatrubhiḥ saṃparājayaḥ | rājyanāśo vane vāso bāndhavā vimukhāḥ katham || 19|| mama deśe’pyanāvṛṣṭiḥ kathametad guro vad | iti pṛṣṭo gururdhyātvā vijñāya pūrvajanmajam ||1.432.20|| karma tatkāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ tasmai cāha śṛṇu nṛpa | purāraṇyanivāsī tvaṃ vyādhaḥ prāṇivihiṃsakaḥ ||21 || niṣṭhuraścauryakuśalo dharmakarmavivarjitaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmno japakāryavirodhyapi ||22|| kṛṣṇasmaraṇahīnaśca praṇāmavarjitaḥ sadā | śastrajīvī mārgalabdhaprajāpīḍākaraḥ śaṭhaḥ ||23|| bālāpatyamṛgāṇāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ hatyākarasya te | apatyāni na jāyante jātasya garbhapātatā ||24|| viśvāsaghātakatvena bāndhavā naiva sodarāḥ | mārgapīḍākaratvena mitrasuhṛdvivarjitaḥ |||25|| sādhūnāṃ ca tiraskārāt śatrubhiste parābhavaḥ | kadāpyadattadoṣeṇa dāridryaṃ te hyupasthitam ||26 || pravāsināṃ kaṣṭadastvaṃ kaṣṭamudvejanaṃ tava | sarvāvamānakartā tvaṃ cāvamānaṃ gato mahat ||27|| jalādīnāmadānena vane tvaṃ jalapīḍitaḥ | nirāhāro bhavasyeva pūrvakarmavipākataḥ ||28|| atha rājam̐tvayāraṇye sukṛtaṃ rājyadaṃ kṛtam | śṛṇu kaścinmunistatra karṣaṇākhyaḥ samāgataḥ ||29|| brahmacaryavratī kṛṣṇapātivratyaparāyaṇaḥ | tadā tvaṃ dhanurādāya mārgaṃ ruddhvā puraḥ sthitaḥ ||1.432.3 0 || pṛṣṭavān ceddravyamasti dīyatāṃ me vanecara | muniḥ prāhāvyayaṃ dravyaṃ madagre vartate śaṭha ||3 1 || yadīcchasi pradāsye’haṃ pātraṃ gṛhāṇa cedasi | śrutvā taṃ viḥsmitastatra kīdṛk pātraṃ dhanaṃ ca kim |||32||| vicāryaṃ proktavānenaṃ dehi cedasmi pātrakam | karṣaṇastasya vacasā tutoṣa prāha re śaṭha ||33 || kati hatyā kṛtāścātra vada niṣkapaṭaṃ purā | vyādhaḥ prāha mayāraṇye pāre sahasra ghātitāḥ ||34|| paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścānye svalpā vai mānavā api | karṣaṇaḥ prāha pāpī tvaṃ pāpakṣālanamicchasi ||35|| tadā pāpānyahaṃ te’tra kṣālayāmi yadīcchasi | vyādhaḥ prāha samicchāmi pāpānāṃ kṣālanaṃ mama ||36|| karṣaṇaḥ prāha prathamaṃ snātvāyāhi madāntike | vyādhaḥ snātvāyayau paścāt tulasīdalamiśratam |||37|| kṛṣṇaprāsādikaṃ vāri tasmai pānārthamarpitam | apibat sa jalaṃ śiṣṭaṃ mastake dhṛtavām̐stataḥ ||38|| guroścaraṇau prakṣālyāpyapibat salilaṃ punaḥ | karṣaṇena tadā tasya karṇe dakṣe punaḥ punaḥ ||39|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | vāratrayaṃ mahāmantraḥ śrāvitastāvadeva tu ||1.432.40|| taccharīrālomakūpebhyaśca pāpāni sarvaśaḥ | nirgatāni mūrtimanti hatyādīni sahasraśaḥ ||41 || rurudustāni sarvāṇi dīnāni vikṛtāni ca | bhayaṃkarāṇi sarvāṇi prāhustaṃ karṣaṇaṃ tadā ||42|| asmākaṃ ko’styaparādhaḥ kathaṃ ca muninā tvayā | niṣkāsitānyasya dehād dayāṃ kuru kṛpāṃ kuru ||43 || dehi
