<1.446> śrīnārāyāga uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi haravākyaṃ śrutvā bṛhaspatiḥ svayam | mahābhāgavato bhakto vairāgyeṇa jagāda yat || 1 || jñānaṃ prāpya viṣaṇṇaḥ sa bhavābdhau haramāha vai | ājñāṃ kuru kṛpāsindho yāmi taptuṃ harestapaḥ || 2 || tārā tiṣṭhatu tatraiva na tayā me prayojanam | ajñānaṃ bādhate mūḍhaṃ līnaṃ me kṛpayā tava || 3 || naro bhūtvā hariṃ prāpsye nāryā kiṃ me prayojanam | amṛtaṃ dṛśyate bāhyaṃ viṣaṃ sarvaṃ vinā harim || 4 || śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ yāmi parātparam | ityuktavantaṃ taṃ śaṃbhurvihasyāha bṛhaspatim || 5 || paragrastāṃ striyaṃ tyaktvā na praśasyaṃ tapo mune | saṃbhāvitasya duścaryā maraṇādatiricyate || 6 || svastrīṃ śatrukaragrastāṃ samāsādya tataḥ param | yatkartavyaṃ tvayā kāryaṃ gārhasthyaṃ vā tapo mune || 7 || vayaṃ yāmo yatra śukrastatra sarve dhurandharāḥ | sūryo dharmo’nantaśeṣo naro nārāyaṇo hyajaḥ || 8 || kratuḥ sanatkumāraśca vasiṣṭho’pi marīcikaḥ | sanātanaḥ sanandaśca voḍhā pañcaśikhastathā || 9 || patnīvrataśca kapilastathāṅgirasa ityapi | ityuktvā prayayuḥ sarve śukrāśramaṃ śivānvitāḥ || 1.446.10 || śukraḥ praṇamya tānsarvān pūjayāmāsa sādaram | bhītāḥ praṇemustāndevān tadānīṃ ditinandanāḥ || 1 1|| śukraḥ sapulakaḥ sāśrunetraḥ provāca vai tadā | adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam || 1 2|| svayaṃ vidhātā bhagavān sākṣād dṛṣṭaḥ svamandire | sākṣād dṛṣṭāśca tatputrā bhagavantaḥ sanātanāḥ || 1 3|| tuṣṭaḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’dya mayi sarvathā | svayaṃ nārāyaṇo lakṣmīpatirmadgṛhamāgataḥ || 14|| brahmarūpaḥ svayaṃ śaṃbhurmokṣadāśca samāgatāḥ | kṛtārthaṃ kartumīśā māṃ kṛpayā nvāgatā mayi || 15|| svātmārāmeṣu kuśalaṃ praśnarūpaṃ viḍambanam | putraṃ pavitraṃ kartuṃ vai nūnamatra samāgatāḥ || 16|| aparaṃ brūtha kiṃ vāpi śāsta naḥ karavāṇi tat | śrutvaitad viśvasṛṭ prāha kuśalaṃ te sadāstu vai || 17|| udvignaściravicchedāt tvāṃ pautraṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ | kuśalaṃ sakuṭumbasya tava pautra nirāmayam || 18|| śrīkṛṣṇapūjanaṃ nityaṃ kuśalaṃ te tu vartate | svaguroḥ sevanaṃ cāpi kuśalaṃ te nu jāyate || 1 9|| guroḥ kṛṣṇasya pitrośca vṛddhānāṃ cāpi pūjanam | sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ puṇyaṃ bhāvisampatsurakṣakam ||1.446.20|| abhīṣṭadevaḥ santuṣṭo gurau tuṣṭe bhavediha | iṣṭadeve tu santuṣṭe santuṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ||21 || gururvipraḥ suro ruṣṭo yeṣāṃ pātakināmiha | teṣāṃ tu kuśalaṃ nāsti vighnastasya kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ||22|| tava tuṣṭo guruścāhaṃ tadā tuṣṭo hariḥ svayam | harau tuṣṭe sarvadevāstuṣṭāḥ kṣemaṃ bhavettava ||23|| sāmprataṃ śṛṇu me dhīmannatrāgamanakāraṇam | kṛṣṇavarajaputrasya sādhvīṃ tārāṃ bṛhaspateḥ ||24|| apahṛtya niśānāthastavaiva śaraṇāgataḥ | dehi tārāṃ nyāyamārgāt sarvaṃ te kuśalaṃ bhavet ||25|| pūrvaṃ jñātaṃ tvayā candraḥ śuddhīkṛto’sti dharmataḥ | tārā śuddhā satī cāsti nityaśuddhā yataḥ striyaḥ ||26|| candre daṇḍaṃ na yokṣyāmastadbhayaṃ tyaja sarvathā | adāne yadi yuddhaṃ syānnāśastūbhayapakṣayoḥ ||27|| tārāṃ bhuṃkte śaśī yadvā gururyadvā vināśanam | koṭisaṃkhyakamūrdhanyadevadaityādipakṣayoḥ ||28|| anyāyaṃ tu parāsūya nyāyaḥ kāryastvayādhunā | vināśakāraṇaṃ yuddhamubhayordevadaityayoḥ ||29|| susāmnācaraṇaṃ pautra sarvamaṃgalakāraṇam | tārāṃ bhikṣāṃ dehi mahyaṃ bhikṣukāya tu vedhase ||1.446.3 0|| dehi tārāṃ mahābhāga candraṃ prāṇādhikaṃ tathā | svakīrtiṃ rakṣa suciraṃ prārthayāmaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||3 1 || śukraḥ saṃprāha tacchrutvā tridevān prapitāmahān | tārā garbhavatī tvāste candrayogena sā satī ||32|| deyā vā nādya deyā vā pramāṇaṃ prapitāmahāḥ | brahmā prāha pradeyaiva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||3 3 || garbhaprasavamaiśvaryāt kārayiṣyāma eva tu | ānayātra niśānāthaṃ tārāṃ ca gurviṇīṃ suta ||34|| ityuktaḥ satvaraṃ śukrastārāṃ candramasaṃ tadā | samāhūya dadau tebhyo mahadbhyaścātilajjayā ||35|| datvā tārāṃ vidhuṃ śukraḥ praṇanāma vidheḥ pade | brahmā dadarśa tārāṃ tu praṇatāṃ svapade satīm ||36|| lajjayā namravaktrāṃ surudatīṃ gurviṇīṃ śubhām | candraṃ saṃpraṇataṃ dhātā kroḍe kṛtvābhayaṃ dadau ||37|| uvāca gurviṇīṃ tārāṃ kātarāṃ prapitāmahaḥ | saubhāgyayuktā svapatau bhaviṣyasi bhayaṃ tyaja ||38|| durbalā balinā grastā niṣkāmā na cyutā bhavet | manaḥkhedena śuddhā sā rājasvalyena vā punaḥ ||39|| tataḥ svakāntayogena na strī jāreṇa duṣyati | sakāmā kāmato jāraṃ bhajate svasukhāya yā ||1.446.40|| prāyaścittādapi śuddhā na sā svāmivivarjitā | tvaṃ tu satī sadā śuddhā vahnirivātipāvanī ||41 || bṛhaspateḥ karmayogāt tadbhāryāharaṇaṃ hyabhūt | tavāpi karmayogācca tavātra haraṇaṃ hyabhūt ||42|| kintu tattvaṃ kimatrāsti jānantyeva na devatāḥ | vinā tridevān guptaṃ tad rahasyaṃ paśya madbalāt ||43|| yadā candro’harat tvāṃ vai tadā spraṣṭuṃ śaśāka na | pativratā satīṃ devīṃ spraṣṭuṃ śaknoti ko’pi na ||44|| kintu sūryaprabhā mūrtimatī tvāgatya tatra vai | dvitīyāṃ nirmame tārāchāyāṃ tārāpratikṛtim ||45|| satyāṃ tārāṃ tirodhāya ninye sūryasya maṇḍale | sādyāvadhi mahādivyā satī śuddhā virājate ||46|| sā tvaṃ paśya nijāṃ mūlāṃ prabhānītāṃ yathātathām | imāṃ chāyāṃ tathā paśya sagarbhāṃ candrasevitām ||47|| ityuktvā viśvasṛk dvedhā darśayāmāsa tārakām | mūlāṃ tārāṃ dadau devagurave’nyāṃ tatastu te ||48|| prāhustāre tyaja garbhaṃ pakvaṃ tvasmatprabhāvataḥ | ityuktā sā drutaṃ tvantargṛhe gatvā suṣāva tam ||49|| jātamātro yuvā svarṇavarṇo’bhūt śaśinā samaḥ | jātakarmādikaṃ tatra kṛtavāṃścandramāḥ svayam ||1.446.50 || brahmājñayā tadā tārāchāyādṛśyā babhūva ha | adṛśyāṃ tāṃ sūryaprabhā jagrāha nijaputrikām ||51 || sā tu sūrye sadā kṛṣṇaṃ bhajamānā babhūva ha | prabhādāsī sadā dāsyaṃ kṛṣṇasyaiva cakāra sā ||52|| puruṣottamamāse tu prabhayā saha sā satī | yayau śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya dhāma cākṣaram ||53|| divyā nityamahāmuktā jātā kṛṣṇapriyā satī | mūlā tārā patiṃ prāpya babhūva nirbhayā punaḥ ||54|| brahmā tasyai satīdharmānāpatkālakṛtān mudā | pātivratyaparān prāha kṛte yuge pravartitān ||55|| śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi yaistu nāryo’pyadūṣitāḥ | svāminastvājñayā nārī pātivratyaparāyaṇā ||56 || anyamuktā na sā dūṣyatyataḥ svāmivaco vṛṣaḥ | patiryasmai kṣaṇikaṃ vā śāśvataṃ dānamārpayat ||17|| tena bhuktāpi sā nārī naiva dūṣyati vai kvacit | dāne grahītuḥ svatvaṃ yat tato nārī na duṣyati ||58|| nirjanādāvabalā yā bhuktā prasahya kenacit| | akāmā ca parādhīnā naiva duṣyati vai kvacit| ||59|| yogādisiddhapuruṣairbhuktā praviśya svāmini | bhuktā kṛtrimarūpeṇa sāpi naiva praduṣyati ||1.446.60|| nidrāṃ mūrchāṃ gatā yā tu vicittā mādakādane | anyabhuktāpi sā tatra naiva duṣyati padmaje ||61 || patyuḥ pituḥ sutabhrātrorāyatkāle’tidāruṇe | teṣāṃ prāṇāvanārthaṃ cet parabhuktā na duṣyati ||62| apatyārthe gavāmarthe kuṭumbārthe parādṛtā | akṣatakanyakārthe ca kumāryarthe na duṣyati ||63|| āpatkāle prāṇahare deśagrāmādiviplave | anyabhuktā parādhīnā tadā naiva praduṣyati ||64|| gāndharvavidhinā yoge parabhuktā na duṣyati | rājasvalyasya vigame patyayoge ṛtorvṛṣe ||65|| anyayogagatā nārī duṣyatyeva na vai kvacit | svāminaḥ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ parabhuktā na duṣyati ||66|| tapasvinastapasyāyā vighnārthaṃ tvapsarogaṇaḥ | svāmīndrapreṣitaścānyabhuktāpsaro na duṣyati ||67|| dāsyaḥ kṛtvā bhūbhṛtastu sevāyāṃ cārpitāstu yāḥ | parabhuktāśca tāḥ kvāpi naiva duṣyanti sevikāḥ ||68|| paṇyastrītvaṃ samāpannā vipannāśārthameva yā | parabhuktā cāgatitve tāvanmātraṃ na duṣyati ||69|| apatikā nṛtyagītikuśalā kvāpi mohitā | gāndharveṇa parāyattā parabhuktā na duṣyati ||1.446.70|| prāṇarakṣaṇakāryārthaṃ parabhuktā na duṣyati | tejasviyogamāsādya śāpādibhayakātarā ||71 || duḥkhasya parihārārthaṃ parabhuktā na duṣyati | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃśādyairbhuktā satī na duṣyati ||72|| tulasyā tu viṣṇuyogaḥ patiprāśastyabodhakaḥ | anyayoge tathā nārī patihantrī bhavecca vā ||73|| svavaṃśatantusandhātṛputralābhārthameva tu | parabhuktā satī nārī na kadāpi praduṣyati ||74|| divyadevādibhirbhuktā satī naiva praduṣyati | ahalyāyāstvindrayoge śilātvaṃ svāmiruṭphalam ||75|| svapne tvanyena yā bhuktā sā satī naiva duṣyati | bhūtapretādibhirbhuktā vāyvaṃśairnahi duṣyati ||76 || pitṛbhyāṃ saṃpradattā yā yasmai tena na duṣyati | anāthā yuvatī prāptā patnīkṛtā na duṣyati ||77|| pātivratyaṃ paro dharmo dūṣaṇaṃ svecchayā pare | patīcchayā parārthatvaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ patidharmataḥ ||78|| prasahyatve baliṣṭhasya dūṣaṇaṃ na tu tat striyāḥ | nodanālakṣaṇo dharmaścānartho na bhaved yadi ||79|| anarthe tu phalaṃ duḥkhaṃ soḍhavyaṃ bhavati dhruvam | ityevaṃ sarvadāsmābhirdevairdharmo viniścitaḥ ||1.446.80|| tasmāt tārā sadā śuddhā punarbhūvat pativratā | candraścāpi phalaṃ bhuṃjan devatā sthāsyati dhruvaḥ ||81 || rājasvalye māsike vai nāryaśuddhirvinaśyati | pavitrā pāvanī snātvā sādhvī pṛthvīsamā satī ||82|| kṣetraṃ proktaṃ bījakośo bījādhānāya nirmitaḥ | pākaṃ datvā śaityakāle grīṣme tāpāt pratāpyate ||83 || varṣāyāṃ jaladānena śuddhaḥ kaṇān dadāti saḥ | kṣetraṃ nārī bījapātraṃ bījādhānāya nirmitam ||84|| pākottaraṃ sadā śītaṃ rājasvalye pratapyate | niṣekavarṣādānena śuddhaṃ bālān dadāti tat ||85|| tasmāt kṣetraṃ prativarṣaṃ śuddhameva bhavedyathā | tadvannāryātmakaṃ kṣetraṃ pratimāsaṃ praśuddhyati ||86|| iti tasyai pātivratyaṃ datvā sarve surādayaḥ | sādhvīṃ tārāṃ tu gurave datvābhayaṃ ca sarvathā ||87|| devā yayuḥ svabhavanaṃ svagṛhaṃ ca bṛhaspatiḥ | pātivratyaṃ paraṃ dharmaṃ pālayāmāsa sā satī ||88|| patnīvrataṃ vṛṣaṃ cāpi pālayāmāsa gīrpatiḥ | atha tārāsuto budhaścandrajanmā graho’bhavat ||89|| sa eva nandanavane citrāṃ prāpya satīṃ priyām | ghṛtācīgarbhasaṃbhūtāṃ kuberasya tu retasā ||1.446.90|| tāṃ gāndharvavivāhena jagrāha candramassutaḥ | tatputrastvabhavaccaitraḥ saptadvīpakṣitīśvaraḥ ||91 || tasya putro’dhirathākhyastasya surathanāmakaḥ | putrastapasyayā jāto manvantaraḥ sa cāṣṭamaḥ ||92|| sāvarṇiritināmnā vai vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo hi saḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya pātivratyaphalaṃ bhavet ||93 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tārāyā bṛhaspataye’rpaṇaṃ, budhajanma, āpatsamāḥ strīdharmāḥ śuddhiśca, pātivratye’dūṣaṇāni cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||446 ||
<1.447> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca guravo nirmalāḥ śāntāḥ sādhavo hitakāriṇaḥ | ebhiḥ kāruṇyato datto nāmamantraḥ prasiddhyati || 1 || pātivratyaṃ paro dharmaḥ kṛṣṇanāmnā dṛḍhīkṛtaḥ | siddhīraiśvaryasarvārthacamatkāraprado bhavet || 2 || śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ rājavatyā vaiṣṇavikāstriyāḥ | yathā siddhistayā prāptā divyā bhaktyā ca sevayā || 3 || āsīd rājā mathurāyāṃ dāśārho nāma dhairyavān | vadānyaścāpradhṛṣyaśca nayavān śāstrakovidaḥ || 4 || sa vai kalāvatī kāśīrājakanyāṃ pativratām | upayeme satīṃ sādhvīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ dharmasaṃyutām || 5 || kalāvatī sadābālyāt kṛṣṇaṃ bheje sanātanam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin māmuddhara bhavārṇavāt || 6 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaviṣṇo śrīpate kamalāpate | ityevaṃ prārthanāṃ cakre nityaṃ bhaktiparāyaṇā || 7 || patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ patirnārāyaṇaḥ śrīrādhikāpatiḥ | ahaṃ rādhā hyahaṃ lakṣmīrahaṃ śrīranapāyinī || 8 || ityaikātmyaṃ harau cātmanyavāptā yogadarśinī | patyau kṛṣṇaṃ divyadṛṣṭyā paśyatyeva divāniśam || 9 || evaṃ sthitiṃ samāpannāṃ yuvatīṃ yoginīṃ satīm | kṛtodvāhastu dāśārhaḥ prāpayitvā svamandiram || 1.447.1 0|| śṛṃgāraśayane patnīṃ saṃgamāya samāhvayat | sā cāgatyanamaścakre śīghraṃ bhayād vinirgatā || 11 || yuvatīṣu ca vṛddhāsu madhye śiṣye sukhena sā | rājāyaṃ cintayāmāsa kimatra kāraṇaṃ bhavet || 12 || yuvatyapi na sā kāntaṃ yuvānaṃ māṃ samicchati | yadvā tadvā bhavatvatra śanairvai jñāsyate ṛtam || 13|| kṣamāṃ kṛtvā ca dāśārhaḥ śānto ninye niśāṃ tu tām | evaṃ nityaṃ sa dāśārhaḥ samāhvayati kāmukaḥ ||14|| sā tvāgatya namaskṛtya niniryāti tu satvaram | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaviṣṇo svāmim̐ste’stu namo muhuḥ || 15|| ityuccārya viniryāti yoṣitsu pratitiṣṭhati | naikalā tu kvacittatra pativratā sā tiṣṭhati || 16|| naikāntaṃ rocate tasyai rājā tvekāntamicchati | ratyarthaṃ yuvatī rājñā bahuvāraṃ niveditā || 17|| tataḥ svasyā manaścakre dṛḍhaṃ niṣkāmavartane | sā svabhartrā samāhūtā bahuśaḥ prārthitā satī || 18|| na babandha manastasminna cāgacchattadantikam | saṃgamāya yadāhūtā nāgatā sā vivāhitā || 19|| balādāhartukāmastāmudatiṣṭhanmahīpatiḥ | tadā sā prāha rājānaṃ mā māṃ spṛśa mahīpate ||1.447.20|| mā sāhasaṃ mayi kārṣīrvrate’smi hetugarbhite | darśayiṣye tu taṃ hetuṃ yenāhaṃ vratamāsthitā ||21 || tvaṃ ca dharmaṃ vijānāsi gūḍhādgūḍhataraṃ nṛpa | bhuktasya pariṇāmaścedapriyaḥ kaṣṭavardhanaḥ ||22|| dampatyoḥ prītiyogena saṃgamaḥ sukhavardhanaḥ | prītiryadā me jāyeta tadā saṃgo’stu te mayi ||23|| kā prītiḥ kiṃ sukhaṃ puṃsāṃ balād bhogena yoṣitām | aprītāṃ rogiṇīṃ kanyāmantarvatnīṃ dhṛtavratām ||24|| rajasvalāmakāmāṃ ca na kāmyeta balātpumān | prīṇanaṃ lālanaṃ puṣṭiṃ rañjanaṃ mārdavaṃ dayām ||25|| ākarṣaṇaṃ manaaikya śreyobhāvaṃ ca bhāvanām | kṛtvā vadhūmupagacched yuvatīṃ premavān patiḥ ||26||| tatrāpi dhārmikaḥ svāmī vyarthaṃ bhogaṃ na cācaret | bhrūṇahatyātmakaṃ pāpaṃ vyarthabījasya mehane ||27|| nāryāmṛtu samālakṣya bhogena bījamarpayet | vyarthaṃ kāmāgrahaṃ rājan mā kurvatra vṛṣaṃ cara |||28 || ityukto’pi tayā sādhvyā dāśārhaḥ smaravegavān | balādākṛṣya yuvatīṃ parirebhe riraṃsayā |||9|| sā ca oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ | ityuktvā ca patiṃ natvā kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti cāvadat ||1.447.3 0|| tāvat tasyāḥ śarīre vai nigūḍho’gnirbabhūva ha | cakṣuṣā dṛśyate yo na dahatyeva tu kevalam ||3 1|| tāṃ spṛṣṭamātrāṃ sahasā taptāyaḥpiṇḍasannibhām | nirdahantīmivātmānaṃ tatyāja bhayavihvalaḥ ||32|| rājā viveda tāṃ devīṃ camatkāramayīṃ satīm | prāhāho mahadāścaryamidaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tvayi priye ||33|| kathamagnimayaṃ jātaṃ vapuḥ kusumakomalam | kṣamasva sāhasaṃ me’tra kariṣye na punastathā ||34|| evaṃ jagāda bhītaḥ saḥ tamuvāca pativratā | rājan satī dharmavatī ṛtāvicchati saṃgamam ||35|| nānyeva kāmakāreṇa kṣudreva viṣayārthinī | prāgbhave’pi brahmacaryaṃ mayā tathaiva pālitam ||36|| asmin janmanyapi tathā samīhe vratamuttamam | agniḥ sākṣānmama rakṣāṃ karoti dharmayoṣitaḥ ||37|| akāle spṛśasi cenmāṃ tvāṃ sa bhasmīkariṣyati | pūrvapālitasauśīlyabalenaitajjanau mama ||38|| durvāsā munirāṭ kṛṣṇabhaktaḥ paramavaiṣṇavaḥ | dattavān śrīkṛṣṇamantraṃ pāvanaṃ me surakṣakam ||39|| ābālyādahamevainaṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ sadā | japāmi satataṃ cātha dvitīyaṃ tu mahāmanum ||1.447.40|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ | ṣoḍaśarṇaṃ ca tenāhaṃ guptāsmyanalaśālinā ||41 || tena mantrānubhāvena mamāṃge kaluṣojjhitam | spraṣṭuṃ na śakyate pumbhiḥ sapāpaidaivavarjitaiḥ ||42|| tvayā rājan sadā dāsyaḥ kiṃkaryaḥ kulaṭāstathā | gaṇikādyā niṣevyante madirāmiṣabhojanāḥ ||43 || tena pāpena nistejā vartase kṣatriyo’pi san | prāptāyā api yogyo na duṣkṛtaṃ kimataḥ param ||44|| vivāhitāpi yā patnī nirbhoktuṃ naiva śakyate | vyarthaṃ vai jīvanaṃ tasya pūrvapāpādribhoginaḥ ||45|| na snānaṃ kriyate nityaṃ na mantro japyate tvayā | nārādhyate patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kathaṃ māṃ spraṣṭumarhati ||46|| patnīvrataṃ tvayā rājan kadācinnahi pālitam | tena pāpena te rājan sāmarthyaṃ vilayaṃ gatam ||47|| kāmabhogena kiṃ rājan sukhaṃ yanna saha vrajet | ātmanā saha nityaṃ yatsukhaṃ tat samupārjayet ||48|| yonilubdho yonijanma labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ | kṛṣṇalubdho harerdhāma prāpnoti nātra saṃśayaḥ ||49|| ahaṃ vivāhitā kṛṣṇadharmasaktāsmi sarvathā | na cāsaktā kāmadharme tasmāt kāmaṃ sadā tyaja ||1.447.50|| kāmo nirayarūpo’tra yonau liṃge ca tiṣṭhati | kathaṃ tasmiṃstu niraye lubdhavyaṃ vai vijānatā ||51 || yonikuṇḍaṃ sadā bhraṣṭaṃ mūtradurgandhasaṃbhṛtam | śuddhaḥ kathaṃ prasajjeta tatra viṭmātrake sthale ||52|| tatra paktāstatra yānti punaḥ pācanahetave | ajñāstatra prasahyaiva yānti patanahetave ||52|| vijñaiḥ kathaṃ nu gantavyaṃ mṛtyukuṇḍe punaḥ punaḥ | tyaja lobhaṃ yonikuṇḍe brahmakuṇḍe nimajja vai ||54|| ātmakuṇḍaṃ pare kṛṣṇe samarpaya vimuktaye | bahvyo dāsyastvayā bhuktāḥ sarvāḥ samā vilokitāḥ ||55|| api tvāṃ bādhate tṛṣṇā kiṃ pāpaṃ syādataḥ param | jihvayā bhojanaṃ grastaṃ tadāntrānalabharjitam ||56|| rasātmakaṃ hyadhoyātaṃ coṣṇaṃ snigdhaṃ jalātmakam | kharjanaṃ jāyate tena smaryate mūtrakuṇḍakam ||57|| dhik tadidaṃ bhojanaṃ ca yat kṛṣṇasmārakaṃ na vai | dhik tamimaṃ kāmabhāvaṃ yastu na kṛṣṇadāsyadaḥ ||58|| dhik taṃ tāṃ ca patiṃ patnī yau na kṛṣṇāya kalpitau | bhaja rājan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vicārya ceti vai |||59|| patnīvrataṃ hi tatproktaṃ yena kṛṣṇo hyavāpyate | pātivratyaṃ ca sa dharmo yena kṛṣṇo hyavāpyate ||1.447.6 0|| ityuktaḥ sa tadā rājāvāpya jñānaṃ svayoṣitaḥ | virāgaḥ san satīṃ prāha vada mantraṃ mamāpi tam ||6 1 || japavidhvastapāpo’haṃ tvayecchāmi susaṃgatim | mamājñānakapāṭaṃ tu tvayā cotpāṭitaṃ priye ||62|| rājñī prāha patiṃ pūjya nāhaṃ yogyo’smi tatkṛte | nāhaṃ tavopadeśaṃ vai kuryāṃ mama gururbhavān ||6 3|| upātiṣṭha guruṃ rājan gargaṃ mantravidāṃ varam | itisaṃbhāṣamāṇau tau dampatī gargasannidhim ||64|| prāpya taccaraṇau mūrdhnā vavandāte kṛtāñjalī | atha rājā guruṃ prītamabhipūjya punaḥ punaḥ ||65|| saṃjagāda vinītātmā rahasyātmamanoratham | kṛtārthaṃ māṃ kuru guro samprāptaṃ śaraṇāgatam ||66|| mokṣadātrīṃ parāṃ vidyāmupadeṣṭuṃ tvamarhasi | anājñātaṃ yadajñātaṃ yatkṛtaṃ rājakarmaṇā ||67|| śuṣkaṃ cārdraṃ mahat svalpaṃ pāpaṃ māyābalodbhavam | tatsarvaṃ yena śuddhyeta tanmantraṃ dehi me guro ||68|| vinā satāṃ prasaṃgena pāpināṃ pāpanāśanam | ātmanaḥ śodhanaṃ cāpi naiva syāddhi kadācana ||69|| narā nāryaḥ sadā pāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ yuge yuge | sevante sādhupuruṣān yato mokṣo yato hariḥ ||1.447.70|| bhojitā vanditā dṛṣṭāḥ spṛṣṭāścaraṇe marditāḥ | śarīre sevitāḥ samyak prapunanti prasevinaḥ ||71 || yadyatpriyaṃ bhavet svasya deyaṃ tatsādhave sadā | sādhavo nirguṇāścaturarthāḥ śrīkṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ ||72|| kṛṣṇasevāphalaṃ sādhusevayā labhyate’dhikam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptipradāste sādhavo’naghāḥ ||73 || yathā kāmena kāminyāṃ kānte snehaḥ prajāyate | yathā jale tṛṣitasya yathānne kṣudhitasya ca ||74|| yathā śaityābhibhūtasya vahnau snehaḥ prajāyate | yathā ceṣṭau satṛṣṇasya putre pituśca sadguṇe ||75|| yathauṣadhe’tirugṇasyāpatye māturyathā tathā | sādhujane kṛtaḥ snehastārayatyeva niścitam ||76|| yathā śilādyāḥ pratimā jaḍā api sacetanāḥ | sādhurūpāstathā divyacetanāḥ pratimā hareḥ ||77|| tatra dattaṃ hutaṃ kṣiptaṃ samarpitaṃ śubhāśubham | sarvaṃ mokṣapradaṃ sampatpradaṃ sveṣṭapradaṃ nṛṇām ||78|| yeṣāṃ yāsāṃ na cādhāraḥ kaścittasya tu sādhavaḥ | ādhārāstārakāścātmarakṣakā bhagavajjanāḥ ||79|| tasmādvai garga me śuddhiṃ kuru mantrapradānataḥ | evamabhyarthito rājñā gargo vaiṣṇavapuṃgavaḥ ||1.447.80|| tau nināya mahāpuṇyaṃ yamunāyāstaṭaṃ śubham | tatra vṛndātaroḥ pārśve niṣaṇṇo’tha guruḥ svayam ||8 1 || yamītīrthajalasnātaṃ dāśārhaṃ samupoṣitam | prāṅmukhaṃ copaveśyaiva natvā kṛṣṇapadāmbujam ||82|| tanmastake karaṃ nyasya mantraṃ kṛṣṇātmakaṃ dadau | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||83|| śrīkṛṣṇāya namaśceti mantraṃ dadhāra karṇataḥ | tanmanvadhāraṇādeva tadgurorhastasaṃgamāt ||84|| niryayustasya vapuṣo vāyasāḥ śatakoṭayaḥ | te dagdhapakṣāḥ krośanto nipatanto mahītale ||85|| bhasmībhūtāstataḥ sarve dṛśyante sma sahasraśaḥ | rājā rājñī ca tad dṛṣṭvā gargaṃ gurumapṛcchatām ||86|| bhagavannidamāścaryaṃ kimetanme śarīrataḥ | nirgataṃ vāyasavrātaṃ dagdhaṃ ceti vada sphuṭam ||87|| gargaḥ prāha tvayā janmasahasreṣu pradhāvatā | sañcitāni hi pāpāni durantānyapyanekaśaḥ ||88|| puṇyavaśānnararājā saṃbhūto’si ca tatra vai | kriyante cātipāpāni tānīmānyadhunā tava ||89|| mantragrahaṇamātreṇa nirgatāni śarīrataḥ | ta ime vāyasāḥ sarve tamaḥpāpasvarūpiṇaḥ ||1.447.90|| dṛśyante sma dahyamānāstava pātakakoṭayaḥ | iti śuddho’si rājendra bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ sanātanam ||91 || tadā kṛṣṇasya tejobhiryuktastvaṃ vai bhaviṣyasi | tatastvaṃ cānayā tejasvinyā sārdhaṃ sadārtave ||92|| kāle yogye mite puṇye rantuṃ yogyo bhaviṣyasi | anyathā te satīvahniḥ kākavat pradahiṣyati || 93|| ityuktvā sa munirgargo labdhvā satkāramarcanam | yayau nijāśramaṃ rājā rājñyā svabhavanaṃ yayau ||94|| vaiṣṇavau dampatī tau ca rejatuḥ sma mahādyutī | atha mantrapratāpena lakṣajāpottaraṃ nṛpaḥ ||95|| patnīsparśasya satpātramabhūd divyaśarīravān | tadā dṛḍhaṃ samāśliṣya patnīṃ candanaśītalām || 96|| santoṣaṃ paramaṃ lebhe cārtave samaye tathā | śrīkṛṣṇasya vrataṃ satyā puṇyadaṃ varṣameva tu ||97|| pālitaṃ vai tayā rājñyā brahmacaryaṃ hyakhaṇḍitam | rājāpi vatsarānte saṃśuddho’bhūd vahnisannibhaḥ ||98|| tato dadāvṛttau bījaṃ putraprāptiphalātmakam | gateṣu navamāseṣu putraṃ prāpa suvaiṣṇavam ||99|| iti lakṣmi camatkāraḥ kṛṣṇapativratodbhavaḥ | kathitaste śravāt pāṭhāt tādṛśaṃ labhate phalam || 1.447.1 00|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dāśārharājñaḥ pāpamayyavasthāyāṃ kṛṣṇapātivratyaparāyaṇapatnyāḥ sparśe vahnidāhastataḥ kṛṣṇamantragrahaṇe pāpadāhe śuddhyuttara sparśayogyatetyādicamatkāranirūṇanāmāsaptacatvāriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||447||
<1.448> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca lakṣmi mayā sadāśivasvarūpaṃ saṃdhṛtaṃ purā | tyāgavairāgyarūpaṃ tat sarvasaṃhārakāraṇam || 1 || mama śivasya rūpasya somavāre’rcakaḥ purā | āryāvarte nṛpaścitravarmāsīddhārmikaḥ paraḥ || re || sugoptā dharmasetūnāṃ yaṣṭā yajñādikarmaṇām | puṇyānāmāśrayo dātā bhaktaḥ śivamukundayoḥ || 3 || bahuputrottaraṃ tasya patnyāṃ kanyā vyajāyata | prāgjanmanāṃ tu karmāṇi jātamātrā pravakti sā || 4 || jātismarā satī sādhvī kṛṣṇadharmaparāyaṇā | sadā śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhyānaratā śuciḥ || 5 || pātivratyaparā kṛṣṇe nānyaṃ smarati nityadā | ekadā bhūbhṛtā kṛṣṇasādhavo bhojitā gṛhe || 6 || viprāḥ sahasraśo bālā naiṣṭhikā bālikāstathā | jyotirvido bhāgyavido rekhāvidaśca yoginaḥ || 7 || teṣāṃ tāmbūladānārthaṃ kanyā sevāparā hyabhūt | daivajñāstāṃ vilokyaiva bhinnaṃ bhinnaṃ phalaṃ jaguḥ || 8 || eko’bravīt tava kanyā nāmnā sīmantinī nṛpa | pārvatīva sumāṃgalyavatī rādheva rūpiṇī || 9 || śāradeva kalābhijñā lakṣmīriva mahāguṇā | suprajā devamāteva satī kṛṣṇe dhṛtavratā || 1.448.1 0|| māṇikyeva harau lagnā prabheva kṛṣṇamāśritā | daśavarṣasahasrāṇi saha bhartrā pramodinī || 11 || aṣṭatanayamāteyaṃ bhaviṣyati sukhānvitā | athānyo’pi dvijaḥ prāha rekhābhirnirbhayastadā || 1 2|| eṣā caturdaśe varṣe vaidhavyaṃ pratipatsyati | atha kāyākalparūpaṃ patiṃ punaravāpsyati || 1 3|| rājā vajrasamaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā śuśoca sā tvapi | kintu daivakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ matvā tatyāja śocanam || 14|| bālā sīmantinīnāmnī bhāvivaidhavyaśaṃkitā | yājñavalkyamuneḥ patnīṃ maitreyīṃ paryapṛcchata || 15|| mātastvaṃ brahmaveditrī kṛṣṇātmārpaṇavaiṣṇavī | jñānādhiśevadhiśreṇī sarvāpannāśinī hyasi ||16|| mātastvaccaraṇāmbhojaṃ prapannāsmi bhayārditā | vaidhavyaṃ brāhmaṇāścāhurme’tra kiṃ bhāvi tad vada || 17|| punastasyaiva patyuśca prāptirme’stītyapyūcire | ataḥ saubhāgyavṛddhyarthaṃ sukṛtaṃ vada me’naghe || 18|| ityuktā tāṃ tu maitreyī prāha śrīpārvatīvratam | somavāre pūjayasva śivaṃ gaurīṃ śriyāḥ patim || 1 9|| upoṣitā ca susnātā virajo’mbaradhāriṇī | kṛṣṇapātivratyaparā prātaḥ pūjāṃ prakalpaya ||1.448.20|| pāpakṣayo’bhiṣekeṇa sāmrājyaṃ pādapūjanāt | saubhāgyamakhilaṃ saukhyaṃ gandhamālyākṣatārpaṇāt ||21 || dhūpadānena saugandhyaṃ kāntirdīpapradānataḥ | naivedyaistu mahābhogā lakṣmīstāmbūladānataḥ ||22|| dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca puṣpāṃjalinamo’rpaṇāt | aṣṭaiśvaryāṇi siddhyādyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇātmasamarpaṇāt ||23|| homena sarvakāmāśca saphalāḥ saṃbhavanti hi | sarve devāḥ pratuṣyanti viprāṇāṃ bhojanāt satām |||24|| itthamārādhaya kṛṣṇayutāṃ śivaśivāṃ sute | ghorāddhoraṃ bhayaṃ putri tariṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ||25|| ityuktā kanyakā tāṃ maitreyīṃ sampūjya vastubhiḥ | gṛhaṃ gatvā cakāraitad vrataṃ saubhāgyavardhanam ||26 || sā tenābhūt siddhiyuktā pārvatīśrīsamā satī | atha kanyāpitā citravarmā candrāṃgadāya tām ||27|| dadau nalasya putrāya indrasenasutāya vai | tadudvāhe mahīpānāṃ samavāyo mahānabhūt ||28|| mahotsave sunirvṛtte jāmātā śvaśuragṛhe | uvāsa katicinmāsān kanyāyāḥ snehakāraṇāt ||29|| ekadā yamunāṃ tartuṃ tarīmāruhya bālakāḥ | yayurmadhye daivayogādāvarttābhihatā tarī ||1.448.30|| mamajjuḥ salile te tu mamrire sukumārakāḥ | nādṛśyanta kumārāste majjitā hi mahājale ||3 1 || hāhākāro mahānāsīd rājā rājñī prajāstathā | sīmantinī tathā sakhyo nāyakāśca purohitāḥ ||32|| vilepurmantriṇaścendraseno’pi vilalāpa ha | yamunāyā mahāpūre śavā api layaṃ gatāḥ ||33|| citravarmā prakārayāmāsaurdhvadaihikaṃ vidhim | sā tu sīmantinī sādhvī yoginī yogivattadā ||34|| vidadhe saṃyamaṃ saudhe sthitvā patyarthameva sā | samādhau saṃgatā tūrṇaṃ jalāntare tale satī ||35|| bahurūpadharā sādhvī bahusāmarthyayoginī | yamunāṃ tāṃ tadā pītavatī svāṃjalibhiḥ satī ||36|| śuṣkābhavattadā tveṣā yamunā kṣetrasadṛśī | mṛtāḥ śavā adṛśyanta sā nināya taṭaṃ tu tān ||37|| brahmarandhragatān yām̐śca yamalokagatām̐stathā | ājuhāva muhuḥ satyaparāste’tra samāyayuḥ ||38|| jīvitā eva ye sarve patitatra bhū dṛśyate | candrāṃgadaḥ pannagībhiḥ kanyābhirdṛṣṭa eva yat ||39|| sakāmābhiḥ sujātābhiḥ pātālaṃ prāpito’bhavat | takṣakasya puraṃ nītaścendrasvargādhikaṃ śubham ||1.448.40|| rūpayauvanamādhuryavilāsagatiśobhinā | nāgakanyāsahasreṇa samantātparivāritaḥ ||41 || takṣakastaṃ rājaputraṃ dadarśa kanyakāyutam| papraccha sarvavṛttāntaṃ kanyāstvāhuryathātatham ||42|| atha candrāṃgadaścāpi śivakṛṣṇeti saṃjapan | takṣakeṇa śruto dṛṣṭaḥ preṣṇoktaśca sumānataḥ ||43 || parituṣṭo’smi bhadraṃ stāt tava bhaktiyutasya vai | bālo’pi yaṃ śivaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ japasyeva nirantaram ||44|| eṣa ratnamayo loka etāścārudṛśo’balāḥ | ete kalpadrumāḥ sarve vāpyo’mṛtarasāṃbhasaḥ ||45|| yatheṣṭaṃvihareteṣu bhuṅkṣva bhogān yathocitān | iti śrutvā rājaputraḥ provācāhaṃ vivāhitaḥ ||46 || pativratā mama kāntā satī sādhvī śivavratā | kṛṣṇapātivratyaparā matvā māṃ tu mṛtaṃ tataḥ ||47|| vaidhavyaṃ sarvacihnaistu grahīṣyati tato’thavā | agnau pravekṣyati sādhvī satī sā vidyate yataḥ ||48|| ato mayā bahutithaṃ nātra stheyaṃ kathañcana | tameva lokaṃ kṛpayā māṃ prāpayitumarhasi ||49 || ityuktavantaṃ candrāṃgaṃ takṣako nāgakanyakāḥ | bhavanāni subhogyāni vāhanānyamṛtāni ca ||1.448.5 0|| dadau kanyāpratuṣṭyarthaṃ ramaṇārthaṃ samastakam | athātra tatsatī bhāryānavalokya priyaṃ patim ||5 1 || samudraṃ tvāhvayāmāsa satyena ca vratena vai | yadyahaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktāsmi sarvathā ||52|| yadyahaṃ svapatiprāṇā pativratāsmi sarvathā | yadyahaṃ ca śivāyuktaśivatuṣṭyai vratānvitā ||53|| tadā samudrastvatraiva samāyātu samīpataḥ | ityuktvā svahastagataṃ jalaṃ mumoca sā bhuvi ||54|| tāvat samudraḥ sabhayaḥ sumūrto vai samāyayau | nanāma tu satīṃ ratnapradānaiḥ samatoṣayat ||55|| uvācaināṃ mayā naiva patiste’pahṛto’sti vai | pātāle takṣakakanyā ninyuste sundaraṃ varam ||56|| āgamiṣyati śīghraṃ saḥ toṣayitvā supannagīḥ | evamuktvā yayau tvabdhiḥ sīmantinī suharṣitā ||57|| kintvajñaiḥ rājamukhyaiḥ sā purohitādibhistathā | vaidhavyacihnayuktaiva tatra prasahya kāritā |||58|| atha kanyāstoṣayitvā rathaṃ ratnāni bhūriśaḥ | nāgakanyāḥ śubhāḥ sarvābhūṣāvastrādiśobhitāḥ ||59|| takṣakenārpitā nītvā yamunāyāṃ samāyayau | satī sīmantinī svapne tvāgataṃ yamunājale ||1.448.60|| dṛṣṭvotthāya yayau pūjāpātraṃ nītvā sakhīyutā | sā dadarśa nadītīre viharantaṃ patiṃ priyam ||61 || divyaratnasamākīrṇaṃ divyamālāvataṃsakam | divyagandhena dehenāpūrvākṛtiṃ samujjvalam ||62|| vilokya jaḍavad rājñīṃ tasthau tannyastalocanā | tāṃ ca candrāṃgado vīkṣya mumoha kṣaṇameva tu ||63|| nirmuktakaṇṭhābharaṇāṃ kaṇṭhasūtravivarjitām | asaṃyojitadhammilāmaṃgarāgavivarjitām ||64|| kiñcidvaidhavyadharmāktāṃ tāmāhūyābravīdidam | kimidaṃ dṛśyate sādhvi śokasyāvedakaṃ tava ||65|| iti snehena saṃpṛṣṭā nābravīdaśrulocanā | sakhī prāha prasahyaināṃ vaidhavyaṃ kāritaṃ janaiḥ ||66 || vinā patiṃ hi kṣantavyamanāthāyāstu sā gatiḥ | somavāravrataṃ naiva tyaktaṃ na ca pativratam ||67|| kṛṣṇasevā na vā tyaktā sarvaṃ tathaiva vidyate | munipatnīdarśitasya vratasya phalameva tu ||68|| prāptaṃ te priyayā rājan gṛhāṇaināmaninditām | ityuktaḥ sa nijāṃ patnīṃ cakre vakṣasi pīḍitām ||6 9|| atha paurajanāstatra dṛṣṭvāgataṃ nṛpātmajam | gatvā rājñe drutaṃ procuḥ rājā rājñī ca nāgarāḥ ||1.448.70 || pratyudgamya pariṣvajya tamāninyurnijālayam | rājaputraḥ śvaśurau tu vavande bāṣpamutsṛjan ||71 || prajāstaṃ mānayāmāsurvardhayāmāsurāśiṣā | teṣāṃ madhye samāsīnaḥ svavṛttāntamaśeṣataḥ ||72|| rājñe nivedayāmāsa takṣakasya sumitratām | dattaṃ ratnādikaṃ sarvaṃ divyaṃ rājñe nyavedayat ||73|| saumāṃgalyamayī vārtā patnīrāṣṭre’bhavattadā | tathā svasya pituḥ rāṣṭre mānavaiḥ kathitā kathā ||74|| pitarau ca prajāḥ sarvā niṣadhasyātiharṣitāḥ | tadutsavo mahānāsīd rāṣṭragrāmapurādiṣu ||75|| sīmantinī patiṃ prāpya tyaktavaidhavyalakṣaṇā | vahniṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya saubhāgyamaṃgalābhavat ||76|| candrāṃgadaḥ svahastena sindūrādi samārpayat | binduṃ parasparaṃ tau tu cakrāte sākṣataṃ śubham ||77|| mālāṃ parasparaṃ tau cārpayāmāsaturaiśvarīm | tāmbūlakaṃ dadatuśca dānāni vividhānyapi ||78|| athāyaṃ śvaśurau natvā patnīyuto nijaṃ gṛham | niṣadhaṃ saṃyayau pitroḥ pādayorapatat tataḥ ||79|| daśavarṣasahasrāṇi sīmantinyā svabhāryayā | sārdhaṃ candrāṃgado rājā bubhuje viṣayān bahūn ||1.448.8 0|| prāsūta tanayānaṣṭau kanyāmekāṃ varānanām | reme sīmantinī bhartrā dhyāyamānā hariṃ haram ||8 1 || dine dine tu saubhāgyaṃ prāpa caivenduvāsarāt | evaṃ lakṣmi sadā pātivratyaṃ vijayate bhuvi ||82|| svarge satye brahmaloke pātāle pramadājane | pātivratyaṃ rakṣitaṃ cet sarvasiddhikaraṃ bhavet ||83 || patiṃ kṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ tu matvā dhyātvā sadā satī | kalpavṛkṣasamaṃ dharmaṃ pātivratyaṃ samācaret ||84|| parādhīnābalānāṃ vai kāmapratimayoṣitām | dehāḥ pāpāśrayāḥ santi tato’pyadhikapuṇyadāḥ ||85|| pāpaṃ tu kāmātiśayaḥ, puṇyaṃ sevā pade pade | patisevā kṛṣṇasevā vratadānādisevanam ||86 || atitheśca satāṃ sevā gavāṃ sevā pade pade | niṣpāpānāmapatyānāṃ sevā brahmasvarūpiṇām ||87|| gṛhasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ sevā vahnāvannādipācanam | vaiśvadevātmikā sevā hyanāthaśvādibhojanam ||88|| annasatrātmikā sevā bālasya kalabhāṣaṇam | vidyādānātmikā sevā sahanaṃ sādhubhūṣaṇam ||89|| patyadhīnā nirīhā ca sadgaṇādisuśobhanam | ityeva sevayā puṇyamanantakaṃ striyāḥ sadā ||1.448.90 || bhuktimuktipradaṃ tasmāt pātivratyaṃ samācaret | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya svargo mokṣaḥ kare sthitau ||91 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne candrāṃgadasya kṛṣṇapativratayā sīmantinīnāmnyā patnyā pātivratyabalacamatkārairyamunāmagnaḥ patiḥ pātāle nāgakanyābhirnīto’pi punaḥ prāpta ityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 448 ||
<1.449> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha sīmantinīsatyāścamatkāraṃ vadāmi te | śṛṇu lakṣmi kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyāḥ patiyoṣitaḥ || 1 || pātivratyena dharmeṇa sadā kṛṣṇaḥ pratuṣyati | patnī lakṣmīsvarūpāsti patirnārāyaṇātmakaḥ || 2 || iti buddhyā praseveta parasparaṃ pramucyate | dampatyoḥ kṛtasakalpāḥ siddhyanti nahi niṣphalāḥ || 3 || vidarbhaviṣaye vipro vedamitro’bhavat sudhīḥ | tasya putraḥ sumedho’bhūddharmācāraparāyaṇaḥ || 4 || anyaḥ sārasvatākhyaśca vipro’bhūttasya pattane | tasya putraḥ somavām̐ścābhavaddharmaparāyaṇaḥ || 5 || sumedhaḥ somavām̐ścobhau mitravaryau samākṛtī | sarvavidyākuśalinau samavidyau babhūvatuḥ || 6 || tāvekadā svatanayau dvijāvavocatāṃ hitam | he putrakau yuvāṃ bālye kṛtavidyau suvarcasau || 7 || vaivāhiko’yaṃ samayo vartate yuvayoḥ samam | imaṃ vidarbharājānaṃ prasādya prāpya vai dhanam || 8 || śreṣṭhakulajakanyābhyāṃ kṛtodvāhau bhaviṣyathaḥ | evamuktau sutau gatvā samatoṣayatāṃ nṛpam || 9 || dhanārthamarthito rājā prāha tau daivanoditaḥ | mama putrī niṣadheśapatnī sīmantinī satī || 1.449.1 0|| somavāre pūjayitvā śrīpatiṃ pārvatīpatim | patnīyuktān dvijān vedavido dhanaṃ dadātyalam || 11 || ato’tra yuvayoreko nārīvibhramaveṣadhṛk | ekastasyāḥ patiśceti jāyethāṃ vipradampatī || 12|| gatvā tatra dhanaṃ labdhvā punaryātaṃ mamāntikam | yadi nyūnaṃ bhaveccet tad dāsye’haṃ tvadhikaṃ dhanam || 1 3|| ityuktau prāhatuḥ rājan kartuṃ tajjāyate bhayam | devatāsu gurau pitroḥ siddhe yogini bhūbhṛti ||14|| kauṭilyamācaran sadyo daṇḍapātraṃ vinaśyati | gopyamānaṃ tu nau chadma kadācit khyātimeṣyati || 15|| tadārjitā guṇāḥ sarve naśiśyanti kṣaṇānnṛpa | pāpaṃ nindā bhayaṃ vairaṃ tiṣṭhanti chadmani dhruvam || 16|| ato dhūrtajanācāraṃ nāśrayāvaḥ kadācana | śrutvaitannṛpatiḥ prāha devatāpitṛyoginām || 17|| nollaṃghyaṃ śāsanaṃ pālyaṃ sadgurusiddhabhūbhṛtām | śubhāśubhaṃ tadādiṣṭaṃ kartavyaṃ śreyase bhavet || 18|| ityuktau tau tathetyuktvā sāmavān rūpavām̐stadā | strīveṣaṃ śāṭikāṃ bhūṣā añjanaṃ keśasādhanam || 1 9|| aṃgarāgaṃ spṛhaṇīyaṃ dadhāra yuvatī yathā | evaṃ tau dampatī bhūtvā jagmatustāṃ sīmantinīm ||1.449.20|| sā rājñī tvarcayāṃcakre patnīyuktān yathāvratam | tau tu viprasutau dṛṣṭvā prāptau kṛtakadampatī ||2 1 || pātivratyena dharmeṇa tathā kṛṣṇasya sevayā | harabhaktyā vivedainaṃ kumāraṃ kanyakākṛtam |||22|| jñātvā kiṃcid vihasyātha pitrā saṃpreṣitāviti | mene gaurīmaheśau ca lakṣmīnārāyaṇāviti ||23|| śivakṛṣṇātmakān viprān gaurīśrīrūpayoṣitaḥ | āvāhya gandhamālyādyairdhūpadīpairapūjayat ||24|| pāyasaṃ modakān miṣṭapolikāḥ śaṣkulīstathā | śākāni bhakṣyabhojyāni viprānabhojayat satī ||25|| tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇā dhenūrhiraṇyaṃ ratnalakṣakam | pratyekaṃ vastrabāhulyaṃ datvā natvā vyasarjayat ||26 || sīmantinyā śivāṃ lakṣmīṃ tvāvāhya sāmavān dvijaḥ | pūjitaḥ kalpitā kanyā satyaṃ kanyā vyajāyata ||27|| nārīcihnāni sarvāṇi paryavartanta varṣmaṇi | tau tu dhanaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vai prāpya yayatuḥ svaṃ gṛham ||28|| sā tu vismṛtapuṃbhāvā mitre jātaspṛhābhavat | karābhyāṃ vipramābaddhya kandarpavivaśābravīt ||29|| ayi kānta kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha vane ramye supuṣpite | tvayā vihartumicchāmi priyā te’smi gṛhāṇa mām ||1.449.3 0|| pariṣvajasva māṃ kāntāṃ pāyayasva navādharam | nāhaṃ gantuṃ samarthāsmi smarāvegaprapīḍitā ||3 1 || itthamaśrutapūrvāṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā niśamya śaṃkitaḥ | papraccha stanayuktāṃ tāṃ kimevaṃ bhāṣase sakhe ||32|| narmavākyaṃ vṛthā naivaṃ vaktavyaṃ kṛtrimābale | kanyāveṣaṃ parityajya kumāraveṣamāvaha ||33|| ityājñaptā prasannā sā vastrāṇi dūrato’karot | tāvat sā satyadhammilā jaghanastanaśobhinī ||34|| yoniyuktā liṃgahīnā dṛṣṭā sumedhasā priyā | sā tu jagrāha vipraṃ taṃ suratāya navapriyā ||35|| sumedhāḥ prāha tāṃ kanyāṃ śāṭikādīni dhāraya | na praśastaṃ viduṣorvaiṃ jāradharmaniṣevaṇam ||36|| vañcayitvātmapitarau dhūrtarājānuśāsanāt | ayaṃ svayaṃkṛto’nartha āvābhyāṃ yadviceṣṭitam ||37|| yastvaṃ viprātmajo bālaḥ prāptaḥ strītvaṃ vigarhitam | kāmabhogo hyanarthāya kumārayorviṣaṃ phalam ||38|| evaṃ vivekamāśritya tūṣṇīmehi svayaṃ gṛham | devadvijaprasādena strītvaṃ nāśaṃ sameṣyati ||39|| athavā daivayogena strītvameva bhavettava | pitrā dattā mayā sākaṃ raṃsyase varavarṇini ||1.449.40 || ityuktāpi kāmadāvānalavyāptā vadhūstadā | balena taṃ samāliṃgya cucumbādharapallavam ||41 || dharṣito’pi tayā dhīraḥ sumedhāḥ sparśamātrataḥ | śāntiṃ tasyāścakāraiva bahiḥ sparśaḥ pradāya ca ||42|| akṣatā kanyakā tṛptā kāmadāho nivavṛte | śuddhiṃ kṛtvā jalādyaiśca yayaturnṛpamandiram ||43|| rājā jñātvātha tadvṛttamavāpa vismayaṃ tataḥ | āhūya pitarau viprau jagāda svaviceṣṭitam ||44|| śrutvā sārasvataḥ prāha rājānaṃ dhūrtaceṣṭitam | are rājan mama putrastavājñayā tu kānyakam ||45 || veṣaṃ dhṛtvābhavat kanyā strītvaṃ bhuṃkte jugupsitam | adya mamaikaputrasya vaṃśo naṣṭastathā mama ||46 || nirāśāḥ pitaraḥ sarve luptapiṇḍodakakriyāḥ | vadātra kiṃ mayā kāryaṃ daṇḍyo’styadya bhavān khalu ||47|| rājā sarvān samāhūya maharṣīnāha dīnavat | asyāḥ puṃstvaṃ yathā syāt kurvantu mayi prasādanam ||48|| te’bruvan śrīpateḥ satīpaterlabhyaṃ prasādanam | tadbhaktānāṃ prasādaśca labhyasteneṣṭamāpnuyāt ||49 || atha rājā bharadvājaṃ samāhūya mahāmunim | pūjanaṃ kārayāmāsa śrīpateḥ pārvatīpateḥ ||1.449.5 0|| viprā rājā tathā kanyāścaite sarve hyupoṣitāḥ | trirātraṃ pūjanaṃ cakruḥ ṣoḍaśādisuvastubhiḥ ||5 1 || akhaṇḍaṃ bhajanaṃ cakrurmahotsavamakārayan | jaya lakṣmi jaya cāmbe śrīpate pārvatīpate ||52|| iti tadbhajanaṃ cākhaṇḍitaṃ bādyasamanvitam | cakrustena susantuṣṭau śrīpatiḥ pārvatīpatiḥ ||53|| āyayaturvāhanasthau patnī yuktau kṛpālayau | tau cāhatuśca rājānaṃ kiṃ te brūhi samīhitam ||54|| so’pyāha puṃstvametasya dīyetāṃ kṛpayā mayi | tāvāhatustadā rājannasmadbhaktaistu yat kṛtam ||55|| śakyate nānyathākartuṃ varṣāyutaśatairapi | sīmantinī mahābhaktā satī kṛṣṇapativratā ||56||| naikasiddhiyutā devī yamunājalapāyinī | svabharturjīvarakṣāyāḥ kartrī yogasamādhinā ||57|| yathā saṃkalpayet sādhvī satī kṛṣṇāpativratā | tathā tatkalpanārūpaṃ vastu pariṇataṃ bhavet ||58|| kanyāveṣo’bhavad bālastayārcitā tu kanyakā | kanyeyaṃ pārvatī lakṣmīriti saṃkalpya pūjitā ||59|| sumedhasaḥ supatnīyamiti saṃkalpya sādaram | sumedhāśca patirasyāḥ somavatyāśca kalpitaḥ ||1.449.6 0|| tat tathaiva hi sañjātaṃ yogināṃ sabalā gatiḥ | nānyathā kriyate kaiściditi rājan nibodha vai ||6 1 || vayaṃ bhaktavaśāḥ sarve bhaktakṛtaṃ mataṃ hi naḥ | gacchantu ca bhavanto vai sīmantinyāḥ prapannatām ||62|| yadi kṛpāyutā rājñī yuṣmadiṣṭaṃ vidhāsyati | kanyeyaṃ kṛpayā tasyāḥ punaḥ puṃstvamavāpsyati ||6 3 || ityuktā vimanasaste yayuḥ sīmantinīgṛham | puṃstvārthaṃ prārthayāmāsuḥ prāha sīmantinī tu tān ||64|| kṛtaṃ karmaphalaṃ bhuṃkte mānavo bhuvi sarvathā | asyā mātrā vrataṃ puṇyakākhyaṃ kṛtaṃ purā yadā ||6 5|| putrecchayā kṛtaṃ cāpi varṣānte dakṣiṇāvidhau | putrī syānme tadā śreṣṭhamiti vai kalpitaṃ phale ||66 || evaṃ dvedhā vratapūrṇāhūtau saṃkalpitaṃ yataḥ | tataḥ putraḥ samutpannaḥ sa eva yauvanaṃ gate ||67|| kanyārūpā prajātāsti vratena karmaṇāpi ca | tasmānneyaṃ punaḥ puṃstvaṃ gamiṣyati kadācana ||68|| kintu punastatsvarūpastatpitroḥ susutaḥ śubhaḥ | sarvalakṣaṇasampanno dīrghajīvī ca vaiṣṇavaḥ ||69|| mameṣṭadevasaṃkalpād bhaviṣyati hi niścitaḥ | eṣā sāmavatī nāma sutā tasya dvijanmanaḥ ||1.449.70|| bhūtvā sumedhasaḥ patnī kāmabhogena yujyatām | yatsaṃkalpena yajjātaṃ prāgbhave cātra vā bhave ||71 || phalaṃ saṃskārajanyaṃ tat samāpatati kālataḥ | asminneva bhave tveṣā nārīveṣadharā satī ||72|| patiṃ matvā sumedhaṃ taṃ vāmapārśve sthitābhavat | pativratāyā hastena pūjanaṃ sarvasākṣikam ||73|| sañjātaṃ devatulyena rājñā samanumoditam | satsarvaṃ tīvrasaṃvegaṃ karma tvasyāḥ phalātmakam ||74|| pākaṃ prāptaṃ śakyate nānyathākartuṃ tu kenacit | kaṇvasya vacanāt kṛṣṇakuṭumbasya vināśakam ||75|| sāmbagarbhasamābaddhaṃ mūśalaṃ suvyajāyata | tasmācchoko na kartavyaḥ prāpte phale tu karmaṇaḥ ||76|| kanyātve’pi parau lābhaḥ putraste syād dvitīyakaḥ | evaṃ matvā sukhaṃ yāntu sarve santu nirāmayāḥ ||77|| ityuktvā sā satī putrīṃ sīmantinī śubhāśiṣā | yojayāmāsa bahudhā yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ tu te ||78|| sārasvato dvijaḥ putrīṃ dadau tasmai sumedhase | alabhad dvitīyaṃ putraṃ sutābhūtasutottamam ||79|| evaṃ satīpratāpena tvatarkyamapi jāyate | tatrāpi kṛṣṇabhaktāyā iṣṭaṃ drutaṃ vivartate ||1.449.80|| etatte kathitaṃ lakṣmi sarvaṃ tapaḥprabhāvanam | paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya yatheṣṭaṃ labhate janaḥ ||81|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sārasvataviprasya sāmavānnāmakasutasya vivāhavyayārthaṃ vidarbharājato dhanecchayā gatasya kanyāveṣeṇa bhikṣukasya sāmavataḥ pativratayā sīmantinyā kanyāṃ matvā pūjitasya sāmavatīkanyātvaṃ tatpituḥ putrāntaraprāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonapañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||449||
<1.450> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi sutārthaṃ vai pārvatyāḥ pātivratyakam | satyā svayaṃ suramadhye vratānte samprakāśitam || 1 || himālayo dadau kanyāṃ pārvatīṃ śaṃkarāya tu | saṃreme narmadātīre śayyāyāṃ śivayā haraḥ || 2 || tayorbabhūva śṛṃgāro yoginorbahuvāsarān | devā daityārditāḥ śaṃbhuputraṃ daityavināśakam || 3 || ayonijaṃ samicchanto yayustayoḥ ratergṛham | vīryasrāvasya nikaṭe prākkṣaṇe dvāri te sthitāḥ || 4 || ājuhuvurmahādevaṃ devāste ratibhaṃjakāḥ | uttiṣṭhato maheśasya bhūmau vīryaṃ papāta ha || 5 || tadvai tatra suvarṇaṃ ca rajataṃ ca vyajāyata | atha vīryaṃ na vai garbhe prāptaṃ satyāḥ śuśoca sā || 6 || yato devaiḥ kṛtaṃ vighnaṃ tato devā api sadā | rati bhaṃgakarāḥ sarve vyarthavīryā bhavantviti || 7 || ityuktvā śaṃkaraṃ prāha rativicchedaduḥkhitā | ratibhaṃgo duḥkhamekaṃ dvitīyaṃ vīryapātanam || 8 || duḥkhātirekiduḥkhaṃ tu tṛtīyamanapatyatā | tataḥ putrauo yathā me syāttathā kurvatra śaṃkara || 9 || śrutvā tāṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha harerbhaktyanvitā sadā | vrataṃ tu puṇyakaṃ nāma varṣamekaṃ kuru priye || 1.450.1 0|| tena putraphalaṃ te’tra niścitaṃ vai bhaviṣyati | vrataṃ tat sukhadaṃ puṇyaṃ vāñcchākalpadrumātmakam || 11 || jāhnavī saritāṃ madhye surāṇāṃ śrīhariryathā | ahaṃ vaiṣṇavabhaktānāṃ yathā tvaṃ devayoṣitām || 12|| lakṣmīśca sampadāṃ yadvat suvarṇaṃ dravyanāminām | śīlavrataṃ vratānāṃ ca tadvat puṇyavrataṃ tvidam || 13 || varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yadvat tīrthānāṃ badarīvanam | pārijātaṃ kusumānāṃ dalānāṃ tulasīdalam || 14|| ekādaśī tithīnāṃ ca vārāṇāṃ tu yathā raviḥ | mārgaśīrṣaśca māsānāmṛtūnāṃ ca vasantakaḥ || 15|| samvatsaraśca varṣāṇāṃ yugānāṃ ca kṛtaṃ yathā | vidyāguruśca pūjyānāṃ gurūṇāṃ jananī yathā || 16 || satī patnī yathāptānāṃ viśvastānāṃ tu hṛd yathā | yathā ratnaṃ dhanānāṃ ca priyāṇāṃ ca yathā patiḥ || 17|| yathā sutaśca bandhūnāṃ kalpadruḥ śākhināṃ yathā | āmraphalaṃ phalānāṃ deśānāṃ saurāṣṭrako yathā || 18|| vṛndāvanaṃ vanānāṃ ca rādhikā yoṣitāṃ yathā | purīṇāṃ ca yathā kāśī lakṣmīnāṃ kaṃbharā yathā || 1 9|| tejasvināṃ yathā tvarkaḥ khaṇḍānāṃ tvajanābhakam | rātrīśānāṃ yathā candro mohakānāṃ ca manmathaḥ ||1.450.20|| vidyānāṃ tu yathā vedāḥ sādhūnāṃ kapilo yathā | vānarāṇāṃ hanūmām̐śca kṣetrāṇāṃ ca satāṃmukham ||21 || netrāṇāṃ ca yathā vidyā vāsanā balināṃ yathā | manoharāṇāṃ kāvyaṃ ca vyāpakānāṃ viyad yathā ||22|| aṃgānāṃ locanaṃ yadvat sādhyānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ yathā | vaibhavānāṃ kṛṣṇakathā sukhānāṃ tṛṣṇikālayaḥ ||23|| sparśānāṃ putrasaṃsparśo hiṃsakānāṃ khalo yathā | yathā mithyā ca pāpānāṃ pāpināṃ mātṛgo yathā ||24|| puṇyānāṃ svārpaṇaṃ yadvat kāryāṇāṃ sādhusevanam | aikāgryaṃ tapasāṃ yadvallābhānāṃ harisevanam ||25|| gavyānāṃ ca ghṛtaṃ yathā vṛkṣastapasvinām | amṛtaṃ bhojyavastūnāṃ sasyānāṃ vrīhayo yathā ||26 || pavitrāṇāṃ yathā vāri śodhakānāṃ yathānalaḥ | strīrūpaṃ sarvarūpāṇāṃ miṣṭānāṃ supriyaṃ vacaḥ ||27|| vainateyaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ ca airāvataśca dantinām | sanatkumāro yogināṃ devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ ||28|| gandharvāṇāṃ citraratho gururbuddhimatāṃ yathā | kavīnāṃ tu yathā śukraḥ kāvyānāṃ saṃhitā yathā ||29|| srotasvatāṃ yathā tvabdhiḥ kṣamiṇāṃ ca kṣitiryathā | phalānāṃ ca yathā muktiḥ śāntiśca sampadāṃ yathā ||1.450.30|| pāvanānāṃ vaiṣṇāvāśca varṇānāṃ praṇavo yathā | kṛṣṇamantraśca mantrāṇāṃ poṣṭṝṇāṃ prakṛtiryathā ||3 1 || sarasvatī viduṣīṇāṃ gāyatrī chandasāṃ yathā | yathā kuberaḥ śreṣṭhistho nāgānāṃ vāsukiryathā ||32|| śayyānāṃ ca yathā śeṣo layānāṃ nidrikā yathā | niṣkriyāṇāṃ yathālasyaṃ śailānāṃ meruparvataḥ ||33|| gavāṃ ca surabhiryadvat tṛṇānāṃ ca yathā kuśaḥ | vedānāṃ sāmavedaśca mano vai vegināṃ yathā ||34|| sukhadānāṃ yathā lakṣmīrakṣarāṇāmavarṇakaḥ | hitārthināṃ yathā tāto hetīnāṃ kavacaṃ yathā ||35|| śālagrāmaśca mūrtīnāṃ paśūnāṃ kesarī yathā | dehināṃ mānavo yadvadindriyāṇāṃ tu hṛd yathā ||36|| mandāgniśca rujāṃ yadvacchaktiḥ śaktimatāṃ yathā | sthūlānāṃ ca virāḍ yadvat sūkṣmāṇāṃ paramāṇukaḥ ||37|| ādityānāṃ yathā viṣṇurdevānāmindra eva ca | daityānāṃ ca baliryadvad dātṝṇāṃ ca dadhīcikaḥ ||38|| prahlādaścaiva sādhūnāṃ cakrāṇāṃ ca sudarśanam | brahmāstraṃ ca yathāstrāṇāṃ rāmādityaśca bhūbhṛtām ||39|| dhanvināṃ ca naro yadvat kṛṣṇo hṛdayavāsinām | prasevyānāṃ gururyadvad vratānāṃ puṇyakaṃ tathā ||1.450.40 || kartavyaṃ sevanīyaṃ ca pālanīyaṃ suputradam | harermantraṃ gṛhītvā tvaṃ vrataṃ putrapradaṃ kuru ||41 || māghaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ vratāraṃbhaḥ śubhaḥ priye | upoṣya pūrvadivase dvitīye vratamācaret ||42|| śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ṣoḍaśavastusūpacāraiḥ prapūjayet | āsanaṃ svāgataṃ pādyamarghyamācamanīyakam ||43|| snānīyaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca | sugandhi puṣpadhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ naivedyacandanam ||44|| yajñasūtraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ dravyāṇyetāni ṣoḍaśa | puṣpāṃjaliṃ praṇāmādīn kṣamā cātha visarjanam ||45|| nityaṃ kuryād vrataṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ putraphalapradam | ṣaṇmāsām̐śca haviṣyānnaṃ māsān pañca phalādikam ||46|| haviḥ pakṣaṃ jalaṃ pakṣaṃ vratameva samāpayet | deyā vratasamāptī ca dakṣiṇā homapūrvikā ||47|| kṛṣṇāṃśo vai bhavetputro vratakartryā na saṃśayaḥ | priyavratottānapādau lebhe śatarūpā vratāt ||48|| devahūtirvratāllebhe kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ kapilaṃ sutam | arundhatī vratāllebhe kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ śaktikaṃ sutam ||49|| sāvitrī ca vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe vedān suputrakān | śaktikāntā vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe putraṃ parāśaram ||1.450.50|| satyavatī vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe vyāsaṃ sutaṃ harim | vratena kaṃbharā prāpa sutaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||51 || aditiśca vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe vāmanakaṃ sutam | mahendrāṇī vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe jayantakaṃ sutam ||52|| uttānapādapatnī ca lebhe dhruvaṃ vratāt sutam | kuberāṇī vrataṃ kṛtvā lalābha nalakūbaram ||53|| sūryapatnī śrāddhadevaṃ manuṃ lebhe ca raivatam | anasūyā vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe candraṃ śubhaṃ sutam ||54|| lebhe cāṃgirasaḥ patnī vratāt| sutaṃ bṛhaspatim | khyātirlebhe vrataṃ kṛtvā śukrācāryaṃ sutaṃ kavim |||55|| ete nārāyaṇāṃśā vai jātā vrataprabhāvataḥ | vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa svayaṃ gopīpatiḥ prabhuḥ ||56|| īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tava putro bhaviṣyati | ityuktvā prayayau śaṃbhuḥ pārvatyā saha jāhnavīm ||57|| tasyai dadau harermantraṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ śubham | snātvā vratasya saṃkalpaṃ kṛtvā yayā gṛhaṃ nijam ||58|| ānīya sarvadravyāṇi samārebhe vrataṃ tataḥ | sanatkumāro bhagavānabhūt tatra purohitaḥ || 59|| brahmādyā devatāḥ sarve manavo yatayastathā | ṛṣayo vālakhilyāśca dakṣādyā bhūbhṛtastathā ||1.450.60|| dikpālā lokapālāśca cirajīvina āyayuḥ | pūjitāḥ śaṃbhunā prāhuḥ karotu puṇyakaṃ śivā ||61 || śrīkṛṣṇaśca sutastasyā bhaviṣyati purā yathā | evaṃ kramo mahādeva kalpe kalpe’sti sarvathā ||62|| ityuktaḥ śaṃkaraḥ sanatkumāreṇa niveditām | pārvatīdvārikāṃ kṛṣṇapūjāṃ śreṣṭhāmakārayat ||63|| saṃsthāpya ratnakalaśaṃ śukladhānyopari sthitam | āmrapallavasaṃyuktaṃ phalākṣatasuśobhitam ||64|| candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumādisamarcitam | munīn satī pūjayitvā saṃpūjya svapurohitam ||65|| puraḥ saṃsthāpya dikpālān devān samarcya vai tataḥ | svastivācaṃ vācayitvāvāhya kṛṣṇaṃ ghaṭe tataḥ ||66 || sampūjya ṣoḍaśadravyairupahāraṃ cakāra sā | tilasarpiṣā havanaṃ trilakṣaṃ pracakāra sā ||67|| brāhmaṇān bhojayāmāsa pradadau dakṣiṇāṃ parām | purohitaḥ śivāṃ prāha dehi me patidakṣiṇām ||68|| patirūpāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tu śrutvā śuśoca pārvatī | śivaḥ prāha śive dakṣiṇayā karmaphalaṃ bhavet ||69|| yatkarma dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet | tanmuhūrte vyatīte tu dakṣiṇā dviguṇā bhavet ||1.450.70|| caturguṇā dinātīte pakṣe śataguṇā bhavet | māse pañcaśataguṇā ṣaṇmāse taccaturguṇā ||71 || samvatsare vyatīte tu karma tanniṣphalaṃ bhavet | putrapautradhanaiśvaryakṣayaḥ syāttu tataḥ param ||72|| dharmo naṣṭo bhavettasya dharmahīne tu karmaṇi | viṣṇuḥ prāha sati rakṣa phaladaṃ rakṣakaṃ vṛṣam ||73 || brahmā prāha sati dharme naṣṭe kartā vinaśyati | dharmaḥ prāha śive kāntaṃ datvā māṃ rakṣa yatnataḥ ||74|| rakṣite ca mayi sādhvi sarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati | devā ūcuḥ rakṣa dharmaṃ kuru pūrṇaṃ vrataṃ sati ||75|| vayaṃ tava vrate pūrṇe kurmastvāṃ pūrṇamānasām | ūcustāṃ munayaḥ śaṃbhuṃ dehi viprāya dakṣiṇām ||76 || sthiteṣvatmatsu dharmajñe nābhadraṃ te bhaviṣyati | prāha sanatkumārastvaṃ me śivaṃ dehi dakṣiṇām ||77|| no ced vrataphalaṃ sarvaṃ tyaja prāpsyāmyahaṃ phalam | śivā prāha patiryatra hriyate tu purodhasā ||78|| kiṃ me syāt tadvratenāpi kiṃ me dakṣiṇayā surāḥ | kiṃ putreṇa ca dharmeṇa sarvasvaṃ yatra nīyate ||79|| kutaḥ phalaṃ kuto vṛkṣo yadi bījaṃ na vidyate | bhūmiḥ sā niṣphalā bījaṃ vinā sasyapradā na vai ||1.450.80|| kṛṣiśca viphalā sarvā bījaṃ vinā tu vārṣikī | prāṇaṃ tyaktvā prayatnena varṣmaṇā kiṃ prayojanam ||81 || dṛṣṭiśaktivihīnena cakṣuṣā kiṃ prayojanam | śataputrādhikaḥ svāmī sādhvīnāṃ tu sureśvarāḥ ||82|| yadi bhartā vrate deyaḥ kiṃ vratena sutena vā | bharturvaṃśo hi tanayo bhartumūlo bhavetsadā ||83|| yatra mūlaṃ bhaved bhraṣṭaṃ tadvyāpārastu hānidaḥ | viṣṇuḥ prāha satīṃ tatra putrāt svāmī paraḥ sadā ||84|| svāminaśca paro dharmastannāśe svāmināpi kim | brahmā prāha sati putri dharmo vai svāminaḥ paraḥ ||85|| dharmātparaṃ satyakāryaṃ vrataṃ satyaṃ paraṃ matam | satyaṃ sadakṣiṇaṃ karma na tu bhraṣṭaṃ kuru vratam ||86|| śivā prāha ca vedeṣu svaśabdo dhanavācakaḥ | tad yasyāstīti sa svāmī dhanavān sa samucyate ||87|| dhanitaḥ śreṣṭha evātra dharmastato vrataṃ ṛtam | tebhyo’dhikaḥ patiḥ svāmī svāmitvaṃ tatra śāśvatam ||88|| āgantukaṃ dhanavatāṃ tasmāt| svāmī patiḥ paraḥ | tasyāhaṃ dhanamevāsmi pitrāhaṃ cārpitā purā ||89|| dānarūpā śivasvatvavatī cāhaṃ na me śivaḥ | svatvaṃ vinā kathaṃ dānaṃ vadantyatra surādayaḥ ||1.450.90|| dharmaḥ prāha sadā patnī svāmino’rdhāṃganā matā | dampatīmūrtirekaiva svena svaṃ śakyate’rpitum || 91 || satī prāha mayi svāmyaṃ svāmitvaṃ ceti cāgatam | svāmitvavigamaṃ svāmyaṃ vinivogakṣamaṃ bhavet ||92|| tato yogyā na varte’trārpayituṃ tu patiṃ mama | patirdāne striyā datta iti sṛṣṭau na vai śrutam || 93|| kanyādānaṃ śrutāvuktaṃ jāmātre jagatāṃ kramaḥ | varadānaṃ varārthinyai jyeṣṭhapitre kutaḥ kramaḥ ||14|| devāḥ prāhuḥ sati naiva buddhimanto vayaṃ tvayi | puṇyake kalpitāṃ svāmidakṣiṇāṃ dharmamācara ||95|| śrutau śrutaḥ sa vai dharmo viparīto hyadharmakaḥ | satī prāha vinā lokācāraṃ vedo’tinirbalaḥ ||96 || vede prakṛtipuṃsostu garīyān puruṣo’dhipaḥ | adhipaṃ nu kathaṃ dāsye bālāhaṃ kathayāmi kim ||97|| bṛhaspatistadā prāha sargaścobhayanirmitaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇaścobhayasraṣṭā samau prakṛtipūruṣau ||98|| satī prāha pumān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃśa eva saḥ | nāryastu mūlaprakṛteraṃśāstataḥ pumān guruḥ ||99|| pumām̐stvatra parabrahma sadāśivaḥ patirmama | mayā kathaṃ patirdeyo vadantvatra hi devatāḥ || 1.450.10 0|| itivāde pravṛtte’tra vimānaṃ svarṇabhāsvaram | āgataṃ śrīpatirnārāyaṇaścaturbhujastataḥ || 10 1|| avatīrya sabhāmadhye sthitaḥ sarvaiḥ prapūjitaḥ | prāha gaurīṃ sati tvayā nyāyyameva samucyate || 1 02|| dakṣiṇā yajñapatnī ca yajamānena dīyate | viprāya tatra mūlyaṃ vai dīyate na kratupriyā || 1 03|| parapatnī pareṇa dīyate parāya na kvacit | tannimittaṃ svarṇaraupyaṃ dīyate dhanameva yat ||1 04|| patnīdāne putradāne svasya dāne patyarpaṇe | gopradānaṃ vidhāyaiva karma pūrṇ prajāyate || 105|| viṣṇudehā yathā gāvo viṣṇudehastathā śivaḥ | viṣṇudehā dakṣiṇā ca mūlyātmikā pradīyate || 1 06|| vrataṃ pūrṇe kuru śive śivaṃ datvā tu dakṣiṇām | punaḥ samucitaṃ mūlyaṃ datvā nāthaṃ grahīṣyasi || 1 07|| ityuktā sā havanānte śivaṃ 3 dakṣiṇāṃ dadau | svastītyuktvā tu jagrāha kumāro devasaṃsadi || 108|| satī prāha gṛhāṇaitad gavāṃ lakṣaṃ dhanaṃ ca vā | dehi matsvāminaṃ vipra dāsye dānāni vai tataḥ || 1 09|| patiṃ vinā na vai karma tvanyat kartu kṣamā yataḥ | sanatkumāraścovāca me gavāṃ na prayojanam ||1.450.1 1 0|| ratnānāṃ ca dhanānāṃ ca sādhorme kiṃ prayojanam | prayojanaṃ me śiṣyasya tyāgino’vadhūtasya ca || 111 || sa tu prāpto mayā tvatto na dāsye śaṃkaraṃ tava | karturevepsitaṃ karma svasya dravye svatantratā ||1 12|| anye vadantu yatkiñcid gobhirna me prayojanam | digambaraṃ puraḥ kṛtvā bhramiṣyāmi jagattrayam || 11 3|| bālakānāṃ bālikānāṃ samūhasmitakāraṇam | ityuktvā tu śivaṃ pārśve vāsayāmāsa vai sanat || 1 14|| pārvatī tu tadottasthau jagāda śokavihvalā | punarlabdhaḥ patirnaiva na prāptaṃ tu phalaṃ vrate ||1 15|| eṣā satī bhavāmyatra vahnimutpādya dehataḥ | hāhākāro’bhavat tatra śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavān svayam || 1 16|| jhaṭityenāṃ samāśliṣya vārayāmāsa mūrtimān | satyā dṛṣṭaśca bhagavān vimānādavatīrya saḥ || 1 17|| rarāja vinivāryaiva sabhāmadhye vilokitaḥ | devauḥ supūjite kṛṣṇaṃ pārvatī tuṣṭuve hṛdā || 1 18|| tvayāhaṃ jīvitā kṛṣṇa punarjīvaya śaṃbhunā śaṃbhuṃ dehi phalaṃ dehi putraṃ bhavādṛśaṃ prabho ||1 1 9|| ityuktaḥ śrīhariḥ satyai dāpayāmāsa śaṃkaram | purodhase dadau dravyaṃ viprebhyo dakṣiṇāstathā || 1.450.1 20||| vrataṃ samāpya sā sarvān bhojayitvā tataḥ param | bubhuje svāminā sārdhaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca dadau tataḥ || 121 || devādyāḥ pūjitāḥ sarve yayuḥ svargaṃ tataḥ satī | śayyāyāṃ śaṃbhunā reme tāvad brāhmaṇarūpadhṛk || 1 22|| kṛṣṇastatra samāyāto vṛddho bhikṣuka āha ca | mātarbhikṣāṃ tu me dehi punaḥ punaruvāca ha ||123|| śaṃbhurutthāya tu śīghraṃ vīryamutsṛjya śāyane | bahiḥ śīghraṃ tvājagāma tat satyāḥ śarīre’lagat || 124|| vīryaṃ yattatkṛtaḥ piṇḍaḥ kṛṣṇastasmin vyalīyata | tūrṇaṃ bālo’bhavat satyā kṛṣṇatulyo vilokitaḥ || 125|| evaṃ prāpto gaṇeśaḥ saḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ svayameva tu | pātivratyena sā durgā patiṃ tatyāja na kvacit || 1 26|| patirdevaḥ patiḥ poṣṭā paralokapradāyakaḥ | putrapautrādivaṃśasya mūlaṃ patiḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ || 127|| prāṇānāṃ vigame cāpi na tyājyaḥ svapatiḥ priyaḥ | dakṣiṇārthaṃ gṛhīto’pi gṛhīto na visarjitaḥ || 1 28|| evaṃ patipriyā sādhvī labhate kṛṣṇasadṛśam | suputraṃ kṛpayā patyuḥ kimu vācyaṃ nu padmaje || 129|| satīvratasamākhyānaṃ patidānasamāgraham | śṛṇuyādvā paṭhedvāpi putraṃ saubhāgyamāpnuyāt || 1.450.1 30|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pārvatyāḥ puṇyakavrate śaṃbhudakṣiṇānimittapātivratyabalaṃ saṃvādo gaṇeśaputraprāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||450||
<1.451> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi śabaryāstu pativratam | camatkārabharaṃ sarvaṃ patyarthaṃ kiṃ na jāyate || 1 || yā satī sarvathā svāmisantoṣādiparāyaṇā | jayatyeva sadā loke dharmo rakṣati rakṣitaḥ || 2 || āsīt pāñcālarājasya siṃhaketostu kiṃkaraḥ | caṇḍakākhyastu śabaro yasya gehe pativratā || 3 || śabarī patibhaktāsīt patiṃ matvā paraṃ prabhum | patiṃ bheje sadā bhaktyā yathā santoṣamāpnuyāt || 4 || bhojanādau vihārādau vyavasāyādikarmasu | kaiṃkarye vā gṛhakārye kleśaṃ naiva karoti sā || |9 || sarvadā suprasannāste smitānanā ca kiṃkarī | śuṣkaṃ rūkṣaṃ paryuṣitaṃ snigdhaṃ miṣṭaṃ ca vātulam || 6 || tiktaṃ dagdhamapakvaṃ vā bharjitaṃ pācitaṃ ca vā | saṃskṛtaṃ bāṣpitaṃ yadvā yādṛk tādṛg bhavedapi || 7 || śabaro na ruṣaṃ yāti śabarī na vidūyate | śabaro nityamevāsyāḥ premapātraṃ suśāntidaḥ || 8 || śabarī svāmivaśagā datvā kāntāya khādati | kāntaṃ viṣṇuṃ sadā matvā karoti sevanaṃ satī || 9 || śūdradharmaṃ puraskṛtya vartete dampatī sadā | niṣkapaṭau śāṭyahīnau satyamārgaparāyaṇau ||1.451.1 0|| sādhūnāṃ sevakau nyāyamārgalabdhasujīvanau | kaiṃkaryeṇa ca yallabdhamannādyaṃ tatra tuṣyataḥ || 11 || kārye prāpte śabaraśca pṛṣṭvā bhāryāṃ karoti tat | śabaryapi patiṃ pṛṣṭvā kāryaṃ yogyaṃ karoti sā || 12|| yadyapi syātprāṇanāśaḥ pativākyaṃ na muñcati | śabaro’pi niṣiddhaṃ yacchabaryā na karoti tat || 1 3|| śabaryapi niṣiddhaṃ yat svāminā na karoti tat | yatra vai manasoraikyaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ svargameva tat || 14|| yatra satyaṃ niṣkāpaṭyaṃ parasparaṃ sumānanam | tatra nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo viṣṇu śivaḥ śivā śriyāḥ ||15|| smṛddhayaśca śubho lābhaḥ siddhiḥ rakṣā nirāmayam | ekadā siṃhaketuḥ saḥ kṣātradharmaṃ samāśritaḥ || 16|| jagāma mṛgayārthaṃ sabhṛtyo vanaṃ mṛgānvitam | śabaraḥ sa vane jīrṇaṃ dadarśa devatālayam || 17|| tatra liṃgaṃ bhagnapīṭhe viyuktaṃ svalpamityapi | dṛṣṭvādāya nṛpaṃ prāha paśyainaṃ ruciraṃ śivam || 18|| tamenaṃ pūjayiṣyāmi yathāvibhavamādarāt | pūjārītiṃ mama brūhi prītaḥ syācchaṃkaro yathā || 19|| iti pṛṣṭho nṛpaḥ prāha prahasyainaṃ yathātatham | kaṭhinaṃ pūjanaṃ tvasya tvayā tannahi pāryate |||1.451.20|| saṃkalpena sadā kuryādabhiṣekaṃ navāmbhasā | upaveśyāsane śuddhe śubhairgandhākṣatairnavaiḥ ||21 || vanyaiḥ patraiśca kusumairdhūpairdīpaiśca pūjayet | citābhasmopahāraṃ ca prathamaṃ parikalpayet ||22|| ātmopabhogyenānnena naivedyaṃ kalpayet sadā | punaśca dhūpadīpādīnupacārānprakalpayet ||23|| nṛtyavāditragītādīn thathāvat parikalpayet | namaskāraṃ prakuryācca prasādaṃ dhārayet tataḥ ||24|| eṣa sādhāraṇaḥ proktaḥ śivapūjāvidhistava | citābhasmopahāreṇa sadyastuṣyati śaṃkaraḥ ||25|| namaḥ śivāya ca vadet pārvatīpataye namaḥ | evamuccārayan devaṃ pūjayet sakuṭumbakaḥ ||26|| ityuktaścaṇḍako bhīlo mūrdhnā jagrāha tadvacaḥ | atha svabhavanaṃ prāpya liṅgarūpaṃ sadāśivam || 27|| catuṣke pippalamūle saṃsthāpya vaidikopari | pratyahaṃ pūjayāmāsa citābhasmopahārakṛt ||28|| yattvātmanaḥ priyaṃ vastu patnyāścāpi priyaṃ tu yat | gandhapuṣpākṣatādyaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ kaṇameva vā ||29|| nivedya śaṃbhave nityamupāyuṃkta tataḥ svayam | evaṃ sadāśivaṃ bhaktyā saha patnyābhyapūjayat ||1.451.30|| āśutoṣastutoṣāsmai dadau sukhaṃ dhanādikam | annaṃ vastraṃ gṛhaṃ dravyaṃ gauśca dogdhrī yaśastathā ||3 1 || rājyataḥ prāpyate sarvaṃ vetanaṃ dāsyadharmataḥ | satyādhāraṃ śivādhāraṃ sukhaṃ prāptaṃ kuṭumbinā ||32|| yathā yathābhavad bhīlaḥ sukhī sādhanavām̐stathā | pūjanaṃ prākaronnityaṃ niyamenārhaṇaṃ muhuḥ ||33|| svayaṃ gatvā śmaśānādāvādāya śavabhasma saḥ | śivasya pūjanaṃ cakre vṛṣṭyādāvapi nityadā ||34|| ekadā śivapūjāyai pravṛttaḥ śabarottamaḥ | na dadarśa citābhasma pātre yad rakṣitaṃ ca tat ||35|| vṛṣṭyā rātrau jaladhārā pātre papāta chidrataḥ | bhasma prakṣālitaṃ sarvaṃ pravāheṇa samaṃ gatam ||36|| iti vilokya riktaṃ tatpātraṃ yatra ca nāṇvapi | bhasma lebhe tato dūraṃ śmaśānaṃ prayayāvapi ||37|| vṛṣṭyā prakṣālitatvāttu citābhūmermanāgapi | bhasma lebhe na vai tatra paritaḥ saṃbhramannapi ||38|| tataḥ śrānto riktahasto gṛhamāgānnirāśakaḥ | kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi bhasmārtha cādya bhūtale ||39|| vṛṣṭiḥ sarvatra bahulā jātā prajāyate’tigā | grāmāntare’pi sarvatra kṣālitā pherurāṭkṣitiḥ ||1.451.40|| bhasma prāpyeta naivādya pūjā jāyeta naiva ca | bhojanādyaṃ tataḥ sarvaṃ bhavennādya tu me khalu ||41 || vṛṣṭervirāme saṃjāte kasyacinmaraṇottaram | māsānte vā miled bhasma tadā nītvā haraṃ prabhum ||42||| pūjayiṣye tato bhakṣyaṃ gṛhīṣyāmi kuṭumbayuk | itivicārya cāhūya patnīṃ bhīlo’bravīt priye ||43|| na prāpāhaṃ citābhasma kiṃ karomi vada priye | harapūjāmahāvighnaṃ jātaṃ me tvadya dustaram ||44|| prāptavānna citābhasma vṛṣṭyā dhautaṃ śmaśānakam | upāyaṃ nātra paśyāmi pūjopakaraṇārjane ||45|| pūjāṃ vinā kṣaṇārdhaṃ vā nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe | upavāsā bhaveyurme vinā bhasmaprapūjanam ||46|| itivyākulitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā satī śabarāṃganā | cintayāmāsa satataṃ śivena sukhino vayam ||47|| śivaḥ sukhaprado lakṣmīprado mokṣapradastathā | nahi śivasya bhaktānāmaśivaṃ saṃbhavet kvacit ||48|| śivārthaṃ kriyate yadyat tatsarvaṃ śivadaṃ bhavet | dhanaṃ gṛhaṃ yaśo vastraṃ bhojanaṃ jalamityapi ||49|| śivārthaṃ kalpitaṃ sarvaṃ divyaṃ śivakaraṃ bhavet | śivena sundaro dehaḥ pradattastena poṣitaḥ ||1.451.50|| patyarthaṃ ca śivārthaṃ me nārīdeho bhavecchubhaḥ | ko lābhastatparaścātra yena mokṣo bhavenmama ||51|| evaṃ vicārya śabarī mā bhaiḥ kāntamuvāca ha | idameva gṛhaṃ dagdhvā jīrṇakāṣṭhopabṛṃhitam ||52|| ahamagniṃ pravekṣyāmi citābhasma bhavet tataḥ | pūjāṃ tena kuru kānta nārī kāryāparā tvayā ||53|| ahaṃ prāpsye ca kailāsaṃ tava dehaviyojane | netuṃ cāhaṃ tvāgamiṣye śaṃbhunā saha mā śucaḥ ||54|| priyāvākyaṃ samākarṇya śabarastāmuvāca ha | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ dehaḥ paramasādhanam ||55 || kathaṃ tyajasi taṃ dehaṃ sukhadaṃ navayauvanam | adhunā tvanapatyā tvaṃ bhogayogyā punaḥ punaḥ ||56|| dṛḍhā puṣṭā baliṣṭhā ca kathaṃ dagdhumihecchasi | śabarī prāha re kānta sāphalyaṃ jīvitasya me ||57|| prāṇatyajanaṃ patyarthe śivārthaṃ kimuta svayam | kinnu taptaṃ tapo ghoraṃ kiṃ vā dattaṃ mayā purā ||58|| kiṃ vārcanaṃ kṛtaṃ śaṃbhoḥ pūrvajanmaśatāntare | kiṃ vā puṇyaṃ mama pituḥ kā vā mātuḥ kṛtārthatā ||59|| yacchivārthe samiddhāgnau tyajāmyetatkalevaram | śabaryā me prāptakālo mokṣasyāyaṃ pravartate ||1.451.60|| anekajanmabhiryo na prāpyate bhīlayoṣitā | kathaṃ taṃ niṣphalaṃ kartuṃ mohe patāmi śūdrikā ||61 || sarve yajñāḥ pradānāni tīrthāni ca tapāṃsi ca | mama jātāni manye’haṃ madbhasma śaṃkare’rpitam ||62|| itthaṃ sthirāṃ matiṃ dṛṣṭvā tasyā bhaktiṃ ca śaṃkare | śabaro’pi svasya bhasma kartuṃ dātuṃ mano dadhe ||63|| uvāca śabarīṃ patnīṃ jīva kānte śataṃ samāḥ | mama bhasma vidhāyaiva mokṣaṃ yāsye’tidurlabham ||64|| naikajanmanāṃ pāpena śabaro’haṃ mahādhamaḥ | prāptaṃ mokṣasya saddvāraṃ kathaṃ tyaktuṃ samutsahe ||65|| tvayā śaṃbhuḥ pūjanīyo sadā madbhasmanā priye | yadvā satī priyaṃ kāntaṃ jīvayapyeva bhasmataḥ ||66|| sāvitrī satyavantaṃ saṃjīvayāmāsa vai purā | yadvā satī svayaṃ vahnimutpādya svāminā saha ||67|| divaṃ vrajet tathā kāryaṃ tvayā me priyayā priye | ityuktā sā patiṃ prāha nātha te maraṇottaram ||68|| niścitaṃ maraṇaṃ me’sti satīrītyā hi sarvathā | dvayormṛtyvapekṣayātra mamaiva maraṇaṃ varam ||69|| patidṛṣṭyā satī nārī patihastena yā mṛtā | patyarthaṃ ca śivārthaṃ ca janmasāphalyamṛcchati ||1.451.70 || ekottaraśatavaṃśoddhārayitrī tu sā bhavet | tallābho me’tra saṃprāpto bhavatvevaṃ mayi kṛpā ||71 || itthaṃ sthirāṃ matiṃ dṛṣṭvā nyāyyaṃ tasyā hitaṃ vacaḥ | tatheti dṛḍhasaṃkalpaḥ śabaraḥ pratyapūjayat| ||72|| sā bhartāramanujñāpya snātvā śuciralaṃkṛtā | gṛhamādīpya taṃ vahniṃ bhaktyā cakre pradakṣiṇam ||73|| namaskṛtvātmagurave dhyātvā patiṃ tathā śivam | agnipraveśābhimukhī kṛtāṃjaliridaṃ jagau ||74|| mamendriyāṇi puṣpāṇi santu dhūpo’gururvapuḥ | hṛdayaṃ supradīpo’stu prāṇā havīṃṣi santu ca ||75|| karaṇānyakṣatāḥ santu śaṃbho tvāṃ pūjayāmyaham | na vāñcchāmi mahārājyaṃ svargaṃ vā paramaṃ padam ||76|| tava sevāṃ saha patyā saṭā tvicchāmi śaṃkara | cittaṃ tvayi sadā tvastu hṛdayeśa namo’stu te ||77|| itiprasādya deveśaṃ śabarī muditānanā | viveśa jvalitaṃ vahniṃ bhasmasādabhavatkṣaṇāt ||78|| śabaro’pi tu tadbhasma yatnena parigṛhya ca | cakre dagdhagṛhopānte harapūjāṃ samāhitaḥ ||79|| atha sasmāra pūjānte prasādagrahaṇocitām | dayitāṃ nityamāyāntīṃ prāṃjaliṃ vinayānvitām ||1.451.80|| smṛtamātrāṃ tadāpaśyadāgatāṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ sthitām | pūrvarūpāṃ yathāyogyāṃ bhaktinamrāṃ surūpiṇīm ||81 || tāṃ vīkṣya śabaraḥ patnīṃ hāsyayuktāṃ kṛtāṃjalim | tathā bhasmīkṛtaṃ dehaṃ yathāpūrvamavasthitam ||82|| kṣaṇamāścaryamāpannastarkayāmāsa vai hṛdi | agnirdahati tejobhiḥ sūryo dahati raśmibhiḥ ||83|| rājā dahati daṇḍena brāhmaṇo manasā dahet | śatrurdahati hānyādyaiḥ kulaṭā vākpratāḍanaiḥ ||84|| viṣaṃ dahati coṣṇatvād duṣṭā dahanti darśanāt | cintā dahati phalgutvāddhimaṃ dahati śaityataḥ ||85|| tṛṣṇā dahati cātṛpteḥ satī dahati śāpataḥ | sādhurdahati pāpāni sparśamātrānna saṃśayaḥ ||86|| kathaṃ ceyaṃ na vai dagdhā dṛśyate’tra yathāyatham | kimayaṃ svapna āhosvit kiṃvā māyendrajālikā ||87|| iti vismayasaṃbhrāntastāṃ patnīṃ samapṛcchata | ayi tvaṃ tu kathaṃ cāsse bhasmībhūtāpi javasi ||88|| pradagdhaṃ bhavanaṃ bhūyaḥ kathaṃ pūrvavadāsthitam | śrutvā prasannasumukhī pativratāha taṃ priyam ||89|| yadā gṛhaṃ samuddīpya praviṣṭāhaṃ hutāśane | tadātmānaṃ na jānāmi na paśyāmi hutāśanam ||1.451.90 || tadā paśyāmi pīṣūṣāktaṃ śaṃbhuṃ mama pārśvagam | pāyayantaṃ sudhāṃ me saṃspṛśantaṃ svakareṇa mām ||9 1 || na tāpaleśo’pyāsīnme praviṣṭāyā ivodakam | suṣupteva kṣaṇārdhena prabuddhāsmi punaḥ kṣaṇāt ||92|| tāvad bhavanamadrākṣamadagdhamiva susthitam | adhunā devapūjānte prasādaṃ labdhumāgatā ||93|| dehi prasādaṃ me kānta tvānayāmi suvastu kim | ityuktā jalamādāya dadau phalaṃ tathākṣatān ||94|| evaṃ pratidinaṃ tau tu pūjayāmāsurādarāt | lakṣaśo manujāḥ śrutvā camatkāraṃ tathādbhutam ||95|| darśanārthaṃ samājagmustayośca śaṃkarasya ca | evaṃ parasparaṃ premṇā dampatyorvartamānayoḥ ||96|| śaṃkarasya kṛpaleśāt sukhaṃ lakṣasamā gatāḥ | putrapautradhanāgārakṣetragodāsayoṣitaḥ ||97|| vaiṣṇavāḥ śaṃkarānmantraṃ prāpya jātāḥ kuṭumbinaḥ | dehānte tu tayorbhaktadampatyordivyamadbhutam ||98|| prādurāsīdvimānaṃ ca tatra sthitvā tu dampatī | śivadūtakarasparśād divyadehau sarūpiṇau ||99|| bhūtvā śivālayaṃ dhāma yayaturvai parātparam | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi pātivratyaṃ paraṃ vratam || 1.451.100 || patnīvrataṃ tathā śreṣṭhaṃ vrataṃ śaṃbhvārpaṇaṃ vratam | ātmārpaṇaṃ vrataṃ sarvavratebhyo vai viśiṣyate || 101 || yo’pi śūdraḥ paṭhedvāpi śṛṇuyādvā kathāmimām | śivalokaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ bhaktyā yāyānna saṃśayaḥ ||1 02|| patnīvrataṃ pātivratyaṃ vijñāyāpi tathācaret | tato’pi sarvathā bhuktiṃ muktiṃ cānte labhet priye || 10 3||| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śabaradampatīkṛtaśivapūjārthaṃ pativratāśabarīcitābhasmārpaṇe śabaryāḥ punarjīvanamityādipātivratyacamatkāranirūpaṇanāmaikapañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||451 ||
<1.452> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi camatkāraṃ pātivratyasya vai punaḥ | patirdevo gururdevaḥ śivo devastrayo yayā || 1 || pūjitāḥ sevitā nityaṃ vanditāḥ kṛṣṇakāntayā | tasyā mṛṣāpi satyaṃ syād viparītaṃ ca satphalam || 2 || duḥkhaṃ cāpi bhavet saukhyaṃ vandhyātvaṃ ca sāpatyakam | vaidhavyaṃ sadhavātvaṃ durbhāgyaṃ śreṣṭhabhāgyakam || 3 || adaivaṃ cāpi saubhāgyaṃ viruddhaṃ sānukūlakam | vipat samyatsvarūpā syāt tuṣṭe patyau gurau śive || 4 || ānartaviṣaye kaścinnāmnā vedaratho dvijaḥ | camatkārapure tvāsīt sutadārakuṭumbavān || 5 || tasya kanyā śāradākhyā kamaleva satī sadā | janmataḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ || 6 || iti prāgbhavasaṃskārāt sadā vadati vai sphuṭam | śrutvā janā mahāścaryaṃ prāptā vavandire satīm || 7 || kṛṣṇaṃ śivaṃ hāṭakeśaṃ guruṃ ca pitarau satī | nitya prātarnamaskṛtya tato’nyat prākarot sadā || 8 || evaṃ sā bhajanānandābhavad dvādaśahāyanā | tāṃ yayāce padmanābho brāhmaṇo nṛpamānitaḥ || 9 || mahādhanasya śāntasya tāṃ kanyāṃ pradadau pitā | kṛtodvāho dvijaḥ sāyaṃ sandhyāṃ kartuṃ yayau nadīm || 1.452.1 0|| mārge daṣṭo bhujaṃgena sa mamāra dvijastataḥ | cukruśurbāndhavā kṛtvā śvaśurāvasya kāminī || 11 || kṛtaṃ tu bāndhavairaurdhvadaihikaṃ śāradā tataḥ | brāhmaṇī prāptavaidhavyā piturevālaye sthitā || 12|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | vadatyeva sadā bālā namaḥ kṛṣṇāya cājapat ||13|| kṛṣṇa eva patirnānyo jñātvārcayāte mādhavam | pitarau sevate nityaṃ śivāśivasvarūpiṇau | 14|| lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ nāryāṃ nare paśyati yoginī | śivaḥ svāmī patiḥ kṛṣṇo gururdevaḥ pitā hariḥ || 15|| mātā lakṣmīḥ sakhī devī kuṭumbaṃ sādhumaṇḍalam | bhaktiḥ śayyā ratiḥ kṛṣṇe dhyānaṃ mūrtau śivā sukham ||16|| bhāgyaṃ dharmaḥ kṛtiḥ sevā viśrāntirbhagavatsmṛtau | yasyā bhāgavatī sarvā kriyā divyā satīmayī || 17|| vaidhavye’pyabhavatpūrvārjitapuṇyabalācchubhā | kṛṣṇaḥ kānto dhavo yasyāḥ sevā satāṃ ca mātṛkā ||18|| tatra saubhāgyamevāsti vaidhavyaṃ parivartate | evaṃ vai vartamānāyāstasyāḥ pituśca mandire || 1 9|| ekadā naidhruvo nāma sādhurvṛddhaḥ samāgataḥ | andhaḥ śiṣyakaragrāhī bhikṣāṃ dehīti cāvadat ||1.452.20|| sādhuṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā viṣṇuṃ dadau sāsanamuttamam | svāgataṃ te mahāpūjya pīṭhe’sminnu hyupāviśa ||21|| ityuktvā bhaktimāsthāya kṛtvā pādāvanejanam | vījayitvā jalaṃ datvāpūjayat puṣpacandanaiḥ ||22|| śreṣṭhamiṣṭavarānnaiśca bhojayāmāsa sādaram | tṛptastvandhamunistasyai suprītaḥ paramāśiṣam ||23|| vihṛtya bhartrā sukhinī labdhvā sutaṃ guṇādhikam | kīrtiṃ ca mahatīṃ prāpya bhava devakṛpāvatī |||2||| sādhūktaṃ sā samākarṇya vismitā pratyuvāca tam | sādho tvadvacanaṃ satyaṃ mandāyā me katham ṛtam ||25|| śilāgryāmiva sadvṛṣṭiḥ śunakyāmiva satkriyā | viphalā vidhavāyāṃ vai śubhāśīḥ sādhudāpi tu ||26|| ahaṃ vidhavā jātāsmi tvadāśīḥpātratā katham | sādhuḥ prāha ca tāṃ devīṃ mayoktaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet ||27|| sādhūnāṃ vacane kṛṣṇaḥ svayameva virājate | śaṃbhurdevāḥ sahāyāśca bhavanti vacane satām ||28|| balāllakṣmyā ca śivayā prerito’haṃ samāgataḥ | tava bhaktyā sati putri saubhāgyaṃ te bhaviṣyati ||29|| nahi bhaktimatī bālā duḥkhinī syāditi prabhuḥ | viṣṇuścāhaṃ sādhurūpastvadarthaṃ vai samāgataḥ ||1.452.30|| bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ śivaṃ lakṣmīṃ śivāṃ ca pitarau sadā | kuru tvekavrataṃ putri hyumāmāheśvarābhidham ||3 1 || yathoktaṃ tu mayā sarvaṃ saubhāgyaṃ te bhaviṣyati | vaidhavyaṃ mama bhaktāyāḥ kathaṃ sahe suputrike ||12| āgaccha tava pitarau kathayāmi yathātatham | ityuktvā sādhuviṣṇustāmānayat pitṛsannidhau || 33|| dattāśīrvādavṛttāntaṃ saubhāgyaṃ ca vrataṃ hariḥ | jagāda bhāvi yatsarvaṃ tataścāntaradhīyata ||34|| śṛṇu lakṣmi vrataṃ comāmāheśvaraṃ subhāgyadam | mayā tadā śāradāyai kathitaṃ cākarot tu sā ||35|| caitre vā mārgaśīrṣe vā śuklapakṣe śubhe dine | aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāmubhayoḥ parvaṇorapi ||36|| gurvājñayā vratāraṃbhaṃ prakurvīta satī śubhā | saṃkalpaṃ vidhivat kṛtvā prātaḥ snānaṃ samācaret ||37|| santarpya pitṛdevādīn maṇḍapaṃ racayecchubham | tanmadhye paṃcaraṃgānāṃ cūrṇaiḥ padmaṃ samullikhet ||38|| caturdaśadalairbāhyairdvāviṃśadbhistadantare | tadantare ṣoḍaśabhiraṣṭabhiśca tadantare ||39||| caturasraṃ tataḥ kuryādantarvartulamityapi | madhye kūrcaṃ tatparito vrīhitaṇḍularāśikama ||1.452.40|| kṛtvā kūrce vāripūrṇaṃ kalaśaṃ sthāpayettataḥ | vastraṃ citraṃ kalaśe ca tatra vinyasya vai śivam ||41 || śivāṃ ca sthāpayed dravyaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ prapūjayet | paṃcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayecca jalena snāpayettataḥ ||42|| rudraṃ tvekādaśavāraṃ samuccārya śatāṣṭakam | śivāya nama ityuktvā pīṭhe mūrtiṃ samarcayet ||43|| prāṇāyāmān yathāśakti kṛtvā saṃkalpayet tataḥ | pūrvajanmīyapāpānāṃ nāśārthaṃ tvāṃ samarthaye ||44|| saubhāgyavijayārogyadharmaiśvaryābhivṛddhaye | putrasampatsvargamokṣasiddhyarthaṃ vāṃ prapūjaye ||45|| aṃganyāsām̐stataḥ kṛtvā dhyāyedīśaṃ ca pārvatīm | yoginaṃ śaṃkaraṃ dhyāye satīṃ dhyāye pativratām ||46|| sajaṭaṃ ca sakeśāṃ ca tryambakaṃ tryambikāṃ tathā | sasarpabhūṣaṇaṃ kāntaṃ svarṇabhūṣānvitāṃ satīm ||47|| nīlakaṇṭhaṃ miṣṭakaṇṭhāṃ dvibhujaṃ dordaśāṣṭakām | dhyānamagnaṃ tvaṃkamagnāṃ śvetaṃ raktāṃ vicintaye ||48|| iti dhyātvā pratimāyāmāvāhanādi cārabhet | āvāhanaṃ tathārghyaṃ ca gandhaṃ puṣpāṇi cākṣatān ||49|| dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ dadet | śivāya namo mantreṇa juhuyādaṣṭakaṃ śatam ||1.452.50|| tato nīrājanaṃ kuryānnamaskāraṃ kṣamāpanam | athābhyarcyopacāreṇa bhojayed bhaktadampatīm ||51|| evaṃ sāyaṃ prakuryācca pūjāṃ bhuñjīta pāyasam | evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kuryāt tata udyāpanaṃ caret ||52|| śatarudrādhyāyapāṭhaṃ kārayitvā prapūjayet | vastraṃ suvarṇaṃ kalaśaṃ pratimāṃ gurave’rpayet ||53|| sādhūn viprān bhojayecca dadyācca svarṇadakṣiṇām | tataḥ prasādaṃ gṛhṇīyād godānādikamācaret ||94|| evaṃ vratasya kartā vā kartrī sveṣṭasukhaṃ labhet | vaṃśaṃ saubhāgyamarthaṃ ca sampadaṃ muktimāpnuyāt ||55|| ante mokṣaṃ śivapadaṃ kṛṣṇapadaṃ prapadyate | mahāvratamidaṃ tena sādhunoktaṃ kṛtaṃ tayā ||56|| sādhvyā saṃvatsarasyānte tadudyāpanamarjitam | upoṣitā tu sā bālā jajāpa mantramanvaham ||57|| śivā śivaḥ samāyātau divyarūpadharau śubhau | viṣṇunā kathitaṃ yadvat sarvaṃ saubhāgyameva tat ||58|| bhavatvatraiva dehe te patisaukhyaṃ labhasva ca | ityāśīrvacanairbālāṃ samarañjayatāṃ hyubhau ||59|| śaṃbhuḥ prāha priye bāle pitarau bāndhavādikān | samāhvayātra tān vaktumicchāmi te purābhavam ||1.452.60|| ityuktā śāradā sarvānāhvayat śivasannidhau | sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ śaṃbhuḥ śāradāmāha putrike ||6 1 || drāviḍe prāgbhave viprapatnyau tvaṃ cāparā hyubhe | āstāṃ tatra tvayā nityaṃ patistvayi pramohitaḥ ||62|| jyeṣṭhāyai te sapatnyai ca tvayā kāntakṛtaṃ sukham | kadācinnārpitaṃ tena jyeṣṭhā duḥkhena vai mṛtā ||63 || tena pāpena vidhavā tvaṃ tvidānīṃ pravidyase | yāḥ kurvanti striyo loke jāyāpatyostu vipriyam ||64|| tāsāṃ kaumāravaidhavyaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | tvayā tvārādhitaḥ kṛṣṇo vrataṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ śubham ||65|| tena puṇyaṃ mahajjātaṃ tena puṇyena te patiḥ | pūrvabhavīyavipro’sau svapne ratiṃ pradāsyati ||66|| tena putro viṣṇutulyaścātraiva saṃbhaviṣyati | eṣaḥ sa vipravaryo’sti śaṃbhuryāvajjagāda tām ||67|| tāvat tatra prākpatiḥ saḥ samadṛśyata vai yuvā | sarvairdṛṣṭaḥ śivavākyāt tayā mālā samarpitā ||68|| kāntena cārpito bhāle keśe sindūracūrṇakaḥ | prakoṣṭhayoḥ pradatte ca kaṃkaṇe netrakajjalam ||69|| sarvasaubhāgyadravyāṇi datvā prāgbrāhmaṇaḥ patiḥ | pāṇinā tacchirastatra pasparśa yāvadeva tu ||1.452.70|| tāvat keśāḥ kṛṣṇarūpāḥ prarohitāḥ prasādhitāḥ | dhammilaśca kṛtastena śāṭikā svarṇatārikā ||71 || kṛtā tatraiva hastasya sparśenāśīḥ prayuñjitā | evaṃ hasan kṣaṇaṃ tasthau śaṃbhurdatvā śubhāśiṣaḥ ||72|| adṛśyaścābhavatso’pi patiścādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ | utsavaḥ samabhūttasyāḥ kanyāyā vratapuṇyataḥ ||73|| śṛṇu lakṣmi vratadātā sādhurviṣṇurabhūt svayam | sa eva śaṃbhunā cātrāhūto viṣṇurvaro’bhavat ||74|| kanyāyāḥ pratyayārthaṃ ca tadvat kuṭumbināṃ tathā | prāgbhavīyasya kāntasya rūpaṃ dadhāra mādhavaḥ ||75|| sa eva bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ patirbhūtvā sadā niśi | bhaktāyā mānase nityaṃ kāmatṛptiṃ dadāti saḥ ||76|| kvacit kṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ ca kvacid viprasvarūpakam | kvacicchivasvarūpaṃ ca kvacitsādhusvarūpakam ||77|| gṛhṇāti bhagavānasyā bhavane ramate sadā | sāpi śrīriva saubhāgyatejobhirdīvyatāṃ yayau ||78|| ātmānaṃ muktigaṃ mene prakāśaṃ nākarot satī | evaṃ dineṣu gacchatsu sā bālā tu pratikṣaṇam ||79|| bhartuḥ samāgamaṃ lebhe rātrau sukhavivardhanam | śivayorvaradānena śāradā viśadavratā ||1.452.80|| dadhāra garbhaṃ svapne’pi kṛṣṇasaṃgānubhāvataḥ | ajñātāstu janāḥ kanyāṃ garbhiṇīṃ jāriṇīṃ jaguḥ ||8 1 || tairajñātaiḥ kṛtastatra samājo grāmavāsinām | daṇḍadānāya vidvāṃsaḥ pṛṣṭāstatra samāgatāḥ ||82|| teṣu madhye svayaṃ kṛṣṇo vipro bhūtvāpi cāyayau | śivastatra supaṇḍito bhūtvā kāśyāṃ samāgataḥ ||83|| śṛṇu lakṣmi śāradāyāḥ kṛte kiṃ kimabhūttadā | antarvatnīṃ samāhūya śāradāṃ vṛddhamānavāḥ ||84|| papracchuśca kuto garbhaḥ śāradāpitarau tadā | pratyūcatuḥ prāgbhavīyakāntayogād vratārjitāt ||85|| svapne bījasya lābhena garbho’yaṃ nahi doṣavān | jahasuśca tadā sarve tiraskṛtya kuṭumbakam ||86|| atarjayan susaṃkruddhāḥ kecidāsan parāṅmukhāḥ | sarve sammantrayāmāsuḥ kiṃ kurma itibhāṣiṇaḥ ||87|| kecidāhuḥ pāpinīyaṃ kuladvayavināśinī | kṛtvāsyāḥ keśavapanaṃ chitvā karṇau ca nāsikām ||88|| nirvāsayantu ca bahirgrāmāt svagotrato bahiḥ | atha viṣṇuḥ paṇḍitastu tatrāha sarvamānavān ||89|| mayā pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ comāmāheśvaraṃ vrataṃ kṛtam | anayā tena puṇyena prāptaḥ svāpnaḥ patiḥ sadā ||1.452.90|| svapne garbho na bhavati saṃśayo garbhiṇīkṛte | nāsyai daṇḍaḥ pradātavyaḥ sucaritreyamaṃganā ||91 || kucāritryaṃ tu vadatāṃ jihvā dvedhā bhaviṣyati | śrutvā prajahṛṣustasyā jananījanakādayaḥ ||92|| tataḥ kṣaṇaṃ grāmavṛddhā maunaṃ bhayāt prajagṛhuḥ | tatra kecidaviśvastā mithyā svapnamavādiṣuḥ ||93|| teṣāṃ jihvā dvidhā bhinnā vavamuste tu raktakam | bhītāḥ sarve na cocurvai viparītaṃ tataśca te ||94|| atha śaṃbhuḥ paṇḍitaśca tadāha viṣṇupaṇḍitam | svapne garbho’pi bhavati daivānāmīdṛśī gatiḥ ||95|| māyāmayamidaṃ viśvaṃ dṛśyate śrūyate ca yat | kiṃ bhāvyaṃ kimabhāvyaṃ vā saṃsāre kṛṣṇanirmite ||96|| anirūpyamabhūtārthaṃ kadācijjāyate ṛtam | śrīkṛṣṇasya vaśe sarvaṃ tasya ko veda ceṣṭitam ||97|| yūpaketostu rājarṣeḥ śukraṃ nipatitaṃ jale | saśukraṃ tajjalaṃ pītvā dāsī garbhaṃ dadhau kila ||98|| munervibhāṇḍakasyāpi śukraṃ pītvā sahāmbhasā | hariṇī garbhiṇī bhūtvā ṛṣyaśṛṃgamasūyata ||99|| saurāṣṭrasya tathā rājñaḥ karaṃ spṛṣṭvā mṛgāganā | tatkṣaṇād garbhiṇī bhūtvā muniṃ prāsūta tāpasam || 1.452.1 00|| tathā satyavatīnārī śapharīgarbhasaṃbhavā | tathaiva mahiṣīgarbho jāto vai mahiṣāsuraḥ || 101 || phalasya bhojanenāpi garbhavatyaḥ striyaḥ purā | manasā kalpitā nāryo babhūvuḥ putramātaraḥ || 1 02|| sāmbasya jaṭharājjātaṃ musalaṃ muniśāpataḥ | yuvanāśvasya garbho’bhūnmunīnāṃ mantragauravāt || 1 03|| bījaṃ nāryāṃ nare vāpi vidyate sarvathā janāḥ | pariṇāmo yogināṃ tu vacanena vijāyate || 1 04|| ahalyā copalā jātā gautamasyaiva vākyataḥ | rāmasparśena sā jātā yuvatī ceti dṛśyate || 1 05|| indrahetikṛtā jātā maruto bahavastathā | rādhāyā vacanād gaṃgā jalarūpā vyajāyata || 1 06|| samudramathanāllakṣmīḥ kṣiteḥ sītā hyajāyata | evaṃ vai bahudhā sṛṣṭiryogināṃ vai prajāyate || 1 07|| vasudevasya kṛpayā rohiṇyāṃ garbha āsthitaḥ | śaṃkarasya jaṭātaśca vīrabhadro’pyajāyata || 1 08|| nūnameṣāpi kalyāṇī vratasya balatastathā | sādhoḥ sevāpratāpena kṛṣṇasya śaraṇāgateḥ || 10 9|| āśīrvādātmakaṃ bījaṃ dhatte garbhamaninditā | ityuktastu sabhāśreṣṭhāḥ śaśaṃsurjñātibāndhavāḥ || 1.452.11 0|| sādhusādhviti jagadurmumucurnetrato jalam | kulastriyaḥ pramuditāstāmuddiśya samāśvasan || 111 || tathāpi mānavānāṃ vai sandehasya nivṛttaye | viprau tau tatra sañjāto kṣaṇamātraṃ śivo hariḥ || 11 2|| viṣṇurviprasvarūpo’bhūt kroḍe kṛtvā tu śāradām | tān sarvān darśayāmāsa kāntaṃ svaṃ śāradāṃ priyām || 1 13|| dampatīrūpiṇau dṛṣṭvāvāpurvismayamuttamam | tato vyalīyata kṛṣṇaḥ śivo’pyantaradhīyata || 1 14|| satī tāṃ pūjayāmāsuḥ śrīrūpiṇīṃ tadā janāḥ | camatkārapurāvāsā yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niketanam || 1 15|| atha kāle śubhe putramasūta śāradā satī | śāradeyābhidhaḥ so’pi vidvān kṛṣṇasamo’bhavat || 1 16|| śāradā bahuvarṣāṇi kṛṣṇasevāṃ vidhāya ca | vaṃśaṃ loke sthāpayitvā śrīkṛṣṇena samaṃ satī || 1 17|| divyayānena golokaṃ yayau padaṃ hi śāśvatam | ityetat puṇyamākhyānaṃ śāradāyāḥ pravarṇitam || 118|| paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ samyag bhuktimuktiphalapradam | strīṇāṃ maṃgalasaubhāgyasantānarddhyāyuṣā pradam || 11 9|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ānartadeśe camatkārapurīyaśāradāyā vaidhavye sādhorāśīrvādena punaḥ kṛṣṇātmakaviprarūpapatitaḥ saubhāgyaṃ putralābho janānāṃ viśvāsārthaṃ viprarūpakṛṣṇadarśanaṃ golokaprāptiścetyādipātivratyacamatkāranirūpaṇanāmā dvipañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 452 ||
<1.453> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi bhaktāyā vārayoṣitaḥ | nārāyaṇamanaskāyāścamatkāramayīṃ kathām || 1 || nandigrāme purā tvāsīnmahānandābhidhā hare | bhaktimatī tu vanitā śṛṃgāralalitākṛtiḥ || 2 || kuṭumbarahitā svecchātantrā śivasya kiṃkarī | yadyapi vāravanitā kintu kṛṣṇamayī satī || 3 || nityaṃ snāti hare viṣṇuṃ pūjayatyatibhāvataḥ | nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ cāpi karoti devasannidhau || 4 || nṛtyagāyanatālādau ye tvāyānti tu darśakāḥ | tebhyaḥ prāsādikaṃ vāri phalaṃ tulasīmiśritam || 5 || pāvitryārthaṃ dadātyeva kṛṣṇārthasarvasaṃbhavā | nityaṃ bhajati govindaṃ kṛṣṇabhāvanayā naram || 6 || kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ vidhāyaiva dehakāryaṃ karoti sā | chatraṃ pūrṇendusaṃkāśaṃ yānaṃ svarṇavirājitam || 7 || cāmarāṇi sudaṇḍāni pāduke tu hiraṇmaye | ambarāṇi vicitrāṇi paryaṃkaśca hiraṇmayaḥ || 8 || candraraśminibhāṃ śayyāṃ kṛṣṇārthaṃ parirakṣati | gāvo mahiṣyo dogdhryaśca dīpāṃgadāsadāsikāḥ || 9 || tasyā vacanaviśvastāḥ pūjayanti haraṃ harim | bhūṣaṇāni parārdhyāṇi navaratnojjvalāni ca || 1.453.1 0|| gandhakuṃkumakastūrīkarpūrāgurulepanam | citramālyāvataṃsaśca yatheṣṭaṃ mṛṣṭabhojanam || 11 || nānācitravitānākhyaṃ nānādhānyabhṛtaṃ gṛham | bahuratnasahasrāḍhyaṃ svarṇarūpyādikaṃ dhanam || 12|| sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ harārthaṃ ca haryarthaṃ ca tayā sadā | evaṃ savibhavā vāravanitā satyadharmiṇī || 1 3|| bhaktasevāparā kṛṣṇaśivapūjāparāyaṇā | sadā śāstrakathāśrotrī nāmajāpaparāyaṇā || 14|| vinodahetordevāgre nāṭyamaṇḍapamadhyataḥ | rudrākṣairbhūṣayitvaikaṃ markaṭaṃ caikakukkuṭam || 15|| karatālaiśca gītaiśca sadā nartayati svayam | rudrākṣaiḥ kṛtakeyūrakarṇābharaṇabhūṣaṇaḥ || 16|| markaṭaḥ śikṣayā tasyāḥ sadā nṛtyati bālavat | śikhāyāṃ baddharudrākṣaḥ kukkuṭaḥ kapinā saha || 17|| ciraṃ nṛtyati nṛtyajñaḥ paśyatāṃ citramāvahan | ekadā bhavanaṃ tasyāḥ kaścid vaṇik sabhṛtyakaḥ || 18|| nṛtyasya darśanārthaṃ sadbhaktaḥ sakarakaṃkaṇaḥ | tatprakoṣṭhasthitaṃ ratnakaṃkaṇaṃ vīkṣya cāha tam || 1 9|| mahāratnakhacito’yaṃ kaṃkaṇaste karasthitaḥ | mano harati me bhakta divyastrībhūṣaṇocitaḥ ||1.453.20 || iti tāṃ saspṛhāṃ vīkṣya vaṇik prāha ca tāṃ tadā | yadi te rocate cāyaṃ kaṃkaṇo mama bhūṣaṇam ||21 || bhadramādatsva madbhūṣāṃ mūlyamasya dadāsi kim | tadā vihasya sā vāravanitā sphuṭamāha tam ||22|| āgantukasya dehena sevādharmo’sti me sadā | nārāyaṇasvarūpaṃ tvāṃ matvā sevāṃ karomi vai ||23 || yadyetadratnakhacitaṃ dadāsi karabhūṣaṇam | dinatrayamahorātraṃ tava patnī bhavāmyaham |||24|| niyatasya na patnītvaṃ sarvadā vārayoṣitām | ekaniyatapatnītvaṃ yathā nāpsarasāṃ divi || 25|| tathāstviti vaṇik prāha pramāṇaṃ śaśibhāskarau | kṛtvā satyaṃ trivāraṃ ca spṛṣṭvānyonyasya vakṣasi ||26|| dinatrayamahorātraṃ bhūtvāvāṃ dampatī hyubhau | sahadharmaṃ carāvaścetyāhaturhadayaspṛśau ||27|| atha tasyai vaṇikśreṣṭhī pradadau ratnakaṃkaṇam | ninyatustau sukhaṃ rātriṃ kāmadharmeṇa dampatī || 28|| dvitīyāyāmatha rātrau nāṭyamaṇḍapikāntare | akasmādutthito vahnirdīpavarttiprasaṃgataḥ ||29|| markaṭakukkuṭau muktau bandhanānnirmatāvubhau | anye dāsāśca dāsyaśca gomahiṣyādayo’pi ca ||1.453.30|| nirbandhanā vinirgatā tau cāpi nirgatau tataḥ | śivaliṃgaṃ harimūrtirvahnau bhasmābhavat tadā ||3 1 || smṛtvā tad dampatī tau ca durantaṃ duḥkhamāpatuḥ | vaṇik prāha mama yoge sarvaṃ te jvalitaṃ priye ||32|| śivo viṣṇurmūrtirūpo jvalito mama cāgamāt | mahatpāpaṃ mayā cātrāgatyārjitaṃ durantakam || 33 || na vai śarma labhe sādhvi mriye duḥkhāsahāt priye | ityuktvā prāṇamāhṛtya papāta dharaṇau vaṇik || 34|| yuvatī tridinaṃ tasya dharmapatnī hyabhūd yataḥ | atīva duḥkhitā bhūtvā smṛtvā dharmaṃ susākṣikam || 25|| sarvānāhūya sā tatra babhāṣe karuṇaṃ vacaḥ | ratnakaṃkaṇamādāya sākṣye ca śaśisūryayoḥ ||36|| dinatrayamahamasya patnī jātāsmi dharmataḥ | yayā tasya citāyāṃ vai praveṣṭavyaṃ hi dharmataḥ ||37|| iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā vaṇigbhṛtya uvāca tām | maivaṃ maivaṃ vada saumye patirnāyaṃ vivāhitaḥ ||38|| vivāhitena patinā vahninā sākṣiṇā ca yā | gṛhītā karagrāhā ca sā patnīti prakīrtyate ||3 9|| tvaṃ tu naitādṛśī patnī vyabhicāraparāyaṇā | kaṃkaṇārthaṃ mahālobhāt patnīnāmnā prakatthase ||1.453.40|| tvayā sahāsya dahane narakaṃ jīvato yathā | vyavāyasya gṛhe naṣṭo vyavāyinīkareṇa ca ||41 || vyavāyinyā samaṃ dāhaḥ śreyasāṃ na pradāyakaḥ | gaccha dūraṃ sadā dhūrte puṃścali saṃpratārike |||42|| mama svāmiśavasyāhaṃ kariṣye dahanaṃ tathā | pravekṣye svāmicitāyāṃ mariṣye bhṛtyadharmataḥ ||43|| bhṛtyo’haṃ bahukālīnaḥ sevayāmi nirantaram | vinā vai svāminaṃ prāṇāḥ sthātuṃ śaktā na me’tra vai ||44|| annadātā vṛttidātā rakṣako jñānadāyakaḥ | niṣekī mantrado vipannāśakaḥ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ ||45|| vinā pitaraṃ loke’smin bhṛtyo mṛta iva smṛtaḥ | svāminaṃ nāśayitvāhaṃ darśayiṣye kathaṃ mukham ||46 || bhṛtyo’haṃ putratulyo’haṃ poṣyo’haṃ dharmataḥ sadā | dāhaṃ dāsye hyahaṃ paścātpravekṣyāmi hutāśanam ||47|| mama lokā bhaviṣyanti śāśvatāḥ svāminā saha | ityuktvā sa citāṃ cakre kāṣṭhānyādāya sarvathā ||48|| vaṇijastu dhanaṃ kiñcittathānyacchṛṃkhalādikam | dadau dānaṃ supātrebhyaḥ śavaṃ nyasya citānale ||49|| praveṣṭuṃ yāti yāvaddhi tāvat sā vārakāminī | pradhāvya jagṛhe hastaṃ mā mā meti jagāda tam ||1.453.50|| maivaṃ bhṛtya tvayā kāryaṃ putra jīva sadā bhuvi | ityukto’pi janaiḥ sarvairvārito’pi viveśa ha ||51 || citāyāṃ patite bhṛtye tato nikaṭadharmiṇī | satī tvāha samājasya śṛṇvato’sya gṛhiṇyaham ||52|| sadharmacāriṇī tvasya dinatrayaṃ susammatā | madgehe mama yogena mṛto’yaṃ vai patiḥ kṛtaḥ ||53|| tasmādahaṃ pravekṣyāmi sahānena hutāśanam | satyena prītimāyānti devāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ ||54|| satyātmā vai paro dharmaḥ satye sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | satyena svargamokṣau ca nāsatyena parā gatiḥ ||55|| tasmāt satyaṃ samāśritya pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam | bhaktayogena pūtāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi ca pāvanī ||56|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaviṣṇo śiva maṃgalakṛdbhava | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya
