svāmine namaḥ ||57|| namaḥ śivāya kṛṣṇāya śrīrādhāpataye namaḥ | iti śrīkṛṣṇabhajanaṃ cakre dānaṃ dadau bahu ||58|| sarvasvaṃ sādhubhaktebhyo datvā dhyātvā haraṃ harim | natvā sarvān patiṃ dhyātvā patyuścitānalaṃ satī ||59|| tadbhaktā triḥ parikramya praveśābhimukhī sthitā | tāṃ patantīṃ samiddhāgnau svapadārpitamānasām ||1.453.6 0|| vārayāmāsaturdevau prādurbhūtau śivācyutau | vīkṣya sā tau devadevau koṭisūryādhikaprabhau ||6 1 || stabdheva jāyamānā sā bhīteva jaḍavat sthitā | tāmūcatuḥ samāśvāsya bhagavantau kṛpānidhī ||62|| satyaṃ dharmaṃ ca te dhairyaṃ bhaktiṃ narātmake prabhau | śivakṛṣṇapratimāyāṃ draṣṭuṃ śivācyutāvubhau ||63|| māyayāgniṃ samutpādya dagdhavantau sumaṇḍapam | dagdhaṃ kṛtvobhapratime bhṛtyaḥ śivaḥ svayaṃ mudā ||64|| bhṛtyabhaktiṃ darśayituṃ praviṣṭo’tra hutāśanam | vaṇigrūpo’pyahaṃ nārāyaṇakṛṣṇa patistava ||65|| parīkṣituṃ samāyātaścāntimaṃ sevanaṃ tava | veśyāḥ kaitavakāriṇyaḥ svairiṇyo janavañcakāḥ ||66|| sā tvaṃ satyamanusmṛtya praviṣṭāgniṃ sahānugā | ataste vāñcchitaṃ dāsye vada śreṣṭhottamottamam ||67|| śrutvā sāha na me vāñchā bhoge tvatpādavarjite | ete bhṛtyāśca dāsyaśca ye tvanye mama bāndhavāḥ ||68|| sarve tvadarcanaparāstvayi sannyastavṛttayaḥ | sarvānetān mayā sārdhaṃ nītvā tavākṣaraṃ padam ||69|| śāśvatānandasampūrṇasevāyāṃ rakṣa sarvadā | tatheti tasyā vacanaṃ pratinandya narāyaṇaḥ ||1.453.70||| tān sarvāṃśca tayā sārdhaṃ nināya padamavyam | kālena nidhanaṃ prāptau yau tu kukkuṭamarkaṭau ||71 || kukkuraḥ kāśmīrarājyakumāraḥ puṇyato’bhavat | markaṭastatpradhānasya kumāraścābhavat tadā ||72|| śivaviṣṇumahābhaktau kṛtvā rājyaṃ ciraṃ ca tau | dehānte cākṣaraṃ dhāma yayaturyatra sā satī ||73|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi mahāpāpāpramokṣaṇam | paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya pāpapradhvaṃsanaṃ bhavet ||74|| pāpinyapi vāranārī śravaṇāt karaṇāttathā | sādhusaṃsevanāt sadyo muktānyā mucyate tathā ||75|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vāravanitāyāḥ sarvasvārpaṇabhaktyā śivācyutau bhṛtyavaṇijau bhūtvā pātivratyānalaparīkṣāṃ cakraturmokṣaṃ pradadatuścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tripaṃcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 453 ||
<1.454> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu priye mahālakṣmi pātivratyaṃ janātigam | dharmādharmau svāmivaco mukhyaṃ nānyaditi dhruvam || 1 || patyurvacasi cenmāndyaṃ satī kuryāt sudhānibham | svāmivākyaṃ bhavet hiṃsraṃ kuryāt puṇyanibhaṃ satī || 2 || kāntokte ced bhavet| stainyaṃ nyāyyaṃ matvācaret satī | bhartrājñaptaṃ vyavāyaṃ ca dharmaṃ matvācaret satī || 3 || patireva parabrahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam | śubhaṃ samādiśed yadvāśubhaṃ satī samācaret || 4 || satī tasya vacovaśyā pātivratyaphalaṃ labhet | patiścedaśubhaṃ samādiśet sa phalabhāg bhavet || 5 || nātrāśubhe vaco’dhīne kārye tadbhāginī satī | pratyutāśubhakāryaṃ sā sāmarthyāt śubhadaṃ caret || 6 || aniṣṭaṃ duḥkhadaṃ sā tu sukhadaṃ parivartayet | satyāḥ saṃkalpamātreṇa mṛtyuḥ kālo yamo bhayam || 7 || adharmaḥ kleśadāḥ sarve sukhadāḥ saṃbhavanti vai | pātivratyaṃ paro dharmaḥ pātivratyaṃ paraṃ balam || 8 || pātivratyavṛṣāgre tu pāpaṃ puṇyapradaṃ bhavet | duḥkhaṃ sukhasvarūpaṃ syāt patikṛṣṇapratoṣaṇāt || 9 || atrārthe tu purā vṛttaṃ kathayāmi śṛṇu priye | pativākyaṃ samādṛtya vyavāyasthasvayoṣitaḥ || 1.454.1 0|| sarvaṃ puṇyātmakaṃ jātaṃ devatoṣakaraṃ yathā | dakṣiṇāpathamadhye vai grāme bāṣkalanāmake || 11 || prajā asaṃskṛtā āsan jñānavairāgyavarjitāḥ | narā nāryaḥ kṛṣikāryā āraṇyakaprajīvanāḥ || 1 2|| tatraiko viduro nāma dharmācāravivarjitaḥ | dvija āsīt kṛṣigoptā śūdrādimitratāṃgataḥ || 13 || kṛṣikārye karmacāriṇībhiḥ pravartate’niśam | paranārīprasaṃgādidoṣaṃ jānāti naiva saḥ || 14|| śūdrayā saha kāryādau kāmena saṃgataḥ kvacit | viduraṃ kṛpaṇā sā ca yācate bhojanaṃ dhanam || 15 || viduraḥ kṛpayāviṣṭaḥ kāmabhāvanayā tathā | nirvāhārthaṃ tu śūdrāyai dadātyeva kvacitkvacit || 16 || sadāro’pi satīṃ bhāryāṃ bandulāṃ nātimanyate | gṛhasthitaṃ dhanaṃ cānnaṃ śūdrāyai pradadāti saḥ || 17|| bandulā sahate sarvaṃ patyarthaṃ navayauvanā | dhanaṃ cānnaṃ kṣayaṃ prāptaṃ śūdrāyai svāminārpitam || 18|| vidurastu satīṃ patnīṃ yācate dehi me dhanam | annaṃ dehyambaraṃ dehi śūdryartha dehi me priye || 1 9|| ityuktā sā satī prāha gṛhe yadyaddhi vidyate | tatsarvaṃ nīyatāṃ nātha tvadadhīnaṃ gṛhaṃ sadā ||1.454.20|| tvayi nāthe prasanne ca sarvaṃ me sukhadaṃ bhavet | madagre tu dhanaṃ nāsti yadāttha tatkaromyaham ||21 || vidurastāṃ satīmāha gacchānyasevanaṃ kuru | narān dhaninaḥ saṃsevya dhanamānaya dehi me |||22|| satī tvājñākarī patyau viśvastā ceśvare yathā | kaiṃkarya kasyacit kṛtvā dāsyaṃ patītvameva vā ||23|| dhanamānayati patyājñayā tasmai dadāti ca | patireva paro dharmaḥ pativākyaṃ sukhāvaham || 24|| itimatvā parapuṃsāṃ kāmasevāparābhavat | evaṃ tayostu dampatyordurācārapravṛttayoḥ || 25|| grāme kaścit kathākāro brāhmaṇo daivayogataḥ | samāyayau saṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ cakāra dharmataḥ ||26|| grāmīṇā śuśruvuḥ sarve prācīnāṃ dharmasaṃhitām | kumārgaṃ saṃparityajya dharmamārgaṃ samāśritāḥ || 27|| jagṛhurvaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ pūjayāmāsuracyutam | brāhmaṇaṃ tvarcayāmāsurvihāyāsatkriyāṃ janāḥ || 28|| paścāttāpaṃ svakṛtyānāṃ cakruste sasmarurharim | vidureṇa parityaktaḥ śūdrāsaṃgastataḥ param ||29|| atīva dhārmiko jātaścaikabhuktaṃ karoti ca | snānaṃ sandhyāṃ japaṃ pūjāṃ naivedyaṃ devadarśanam ||1.454.3 0|| kṛtvā bhuṃkte sadā tvevaṃ patnī cāpi tathākarot | evaṃ vai vartamānasya vidurasyāyuṣaḥ kṣaye ||3 1 || āyātā yamadūtāstaṃ netuṃ yamapuraṃ tadā | cukrośa dṛṣṭvā tāndūtān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti saḥ ||32|| patnī prāha ca taṃ śrutvā kathamākrośanaṃ priya | sa cāha tāṃ yamadūtā netuṃ māṃ vai samāgatāḥ ||33 || patnī jalaṃ kare kṛtvā samuvāca satī tadā | yadi patyuḥ priyā bhāryā patyuḥ priyakarī sadā || 34|| patyājñāyāṃ vartamānā patikṛṣṇaparāyaṇā | tena satyena dūtāste dūraṃ yāntu yamālayam || 35|| ityuktvā tajjalaṃ patyuḥ pārśve cikṣepa tāvatā | dūrātpalāyitā dūtā avaplutya sthalāttataḥ ||36 || patiḥ svasthastadā jāto vṛttāntamāha tattathā | patnī prāha punaḥ kāntaṃ svāmisevākṛtaṃ phalam ||37|| tubhyaṃ dadāmi me kānta sadgatirastu tena te | tāvadvai vaiṣṇavā viṣṇoḥ pārṣadāstvāyayurmudā ||38|| patnyā dṛṣṭā pātivratyadharmaphalena tatkṣaṇam | pūjitā vanditāścāpi patiṃ ninyuḥ paraṃ padam ||39|| bandulā tu patiṃ kṛtvā kroḍe ruroda vai kṣaṇam | atha saṃcintayāmāsa yadyahaṃ kāntarañjinī ||1.454.40|| tadā kāntena sākaṃ me prāṇāḥ prayāntu tatkṣaṇam | tāvanmūrchāṃ gatvā sādhvī prāṇām̐styaktvā tu tatkṣaṇam ||41 || svāminā divyadehena saha yātā surūpiṇī | divyadehā vimānasthā viṣṇupārṣadasatkṛtā ||42|| tattejaśca vimānaṃ ca dṛṣṭaṃ śrotṛbhirujjvalam | brāhmaṇaḥ sa tu sadbhaktaistayorvai cordhvadaihikam ||43|| kārayāmāsa vidhinā bhojayāmāsa vaiṣṇavān | dadau kṛṣṇopadeśaṃ ca dharmaṃ patnīvrataṃ dadau ||44|| pātivratyaṃ tathā dharmaṃ dadau prajāḥ svayaṃ dvijaḥ | sarve’pi vaiṣṇavāstvāsan narā nāryaḥ samantataḥ ||45|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | iti mantraṃ tu te labdhvā bhejire kṛṣṇamacyutam ||46|| kathāṃ śuśukarīśasya cakruśca bhajanaṃ sadā | kathāyā vācako vipraḥ svapne svadarśanaṃ dadau |||47|| narebhyo vanitābhyaśca nārāyaṇaścaturbhujaḥ | hārakeyūramukuṭapītāmbarasudarśanaiḥ ||48|| sahitaḥ sevito lakṣmyādṛśyata vai manoharaḥ | kathānte pūjitaḥ sarvaiḥ svīkṛtya pūjanaṃ tataḥ ||49|| upādideśa tān sarvān bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ | pātivratyaṃ paraṃ dharmaṃ bandulāyā vilokya tu ||1.454.50|| ahaṃ nārāyaṇastasyāḥ kalyāṇārthaṃ dvijātmakaḥ | samāyātaḥ kathākāraścoddhṛtā yūyamityapi ||51 || kathāṃ śrutvā vaiṣṇavāśca jātāstatsevanaṃ mama | pūjayadhvaṃ ca māṃ nityaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ ca kathāṃ hareḥ ||52|| naraiḥ patnīvrataṃ pālyaṃ nārībhiśca pativratam | ubhābhyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavrataṃ ca tārakam ||53|| satkathāśravaṇaṃ nityaṃ kartavyaṃ mokṣadaṃ param | kṛṣṇasya kathayā ceto viśuddhiṃ paramāṃ vrajet ||54|| kathayā siddhyati dhyānaṃ dhyānāt kaivalyamuttamam | sarveṣāṃ śreyasāṃ bījaṃ satkathāśravaṇaṃ matam ||55|| kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca madamānādayaḥ pare | adharmasya sutā yānti dūraṃ kathāśravāddhareḥ ||56|| gurutalpaḥ surāpānaṃ tathākāmāprasaṃgakaḥ | kāmasya tanayāstvete yānti dūraṃ kathāśravāt ||57|| pitṛvadho mātṛvadho brahmahatyā ca nāśanam | krodhasya tanayāścaite dūraṃ yānti kathāśravāt ||28|| devasvaharaṇaṃ viprasvahāraḥ svarṇamoṣaṇam | lobhasya tanayāstvete dūraṃ yānti kathāśravāt ||29|| aśraddhā cāpi durmedhā avidyāyāḥ sute hyubhe | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakathāśravād dūraṃ pragacchataḥ ||1.454.60|| kathā saṃsṛtibaddhānāṃ sadyo muktipradā śubhā | strīṇāṃ pāṃsulapādānāṃ dāsānāṃ dāsayoṣitām ||61 || ajñānatimirāndhānāṃ dīparūpā hareḥ kathā | bhavarogābhibhūtānāṃ susevyaṃ paramauṣadham ||62|| mahāpātakaśailānāṃ kathā vajranibhā matā | bharjanaṃ karmabījānāṃ sādhanaṃ sarvasampadām ||63|| śṛṇvatāṃ śrīharergāthāṃ tathā kīrtayatāṃ satām | teṣāṃ pādarajāṃsyaiva tīrthāni munayo jaguḥ ||64|| muhūrtamapi śṛṇuyādaśakto’pi dine dine | ghaṭikāṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā kṣaṇaṃ vā pāvanīṃ kathām ||65|| sthūlakāryaprasaktānāṃ sthūlabuddhimatāṃ kathā | kalpavṛkṣasamo nānyaḥ panthāḥ kathetaraḥ sukhaḥ ||66|| pibannevāmṛtaṃ yatnādekaḥ syādajarāmaraḥ | pītaṃ kathāmṛtaṃ kuryāt kulamevājarāmaram ||67||| kathāvaktā hariḥ sākṣād gurūṇāṃ yāvatāṃ guruḥ | mokṣadaḥ puṇyado jñānapradīpaḥ paro guruḥ ||68|| ye kathāṃ tatpravaktāraṃ praśaṃsanti janā api | aśṛṇvanto’pi te yānti śāśvataṃ paramaṃ padam ||69|| kathāśravaṇasāhāyyaṃ ye kurvanti janā bhuvi | kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ tiṣṭhanti brahmaṇaḥ padam ||1.454.70|| satkathābodhalābhena smaraṇaṃ me harerbhavet | sadāsmaraṇayogena vāsanānāṃ kṣayo bhavet ||71 || tathā satī virāgaḥ syād rāgābhāve paraṃ sukham | tṛṣṇākṣayasukhaṃ tvātmānandodbhave sahāyakṛt ||72|| rāge naṣṭe pratidvandvī dveṣo’pi naśyati dhruvam | rāgadveṣau yasya naṣṭau doṣau tasya pravartanam |||73 || śubhāśubhaṃ na vai janmamṛtyupradaṃ prajāyate | pravṛtterapyabhāvena bhogābhāvo bhavet sadā ||74|| nityānandaṃ cidānandaṃ sadānandaṃ nijātmakam | bhuṃkte bhaktirase magnaḥ śrīkṛṣṇātmakabhāvataḥ ||75|| nityatṛpto mama mūrtau nityamagno madātmani | brahmānandamayo dhāmni mamo’śrute’kṛtaṃ sukham ||76|| evaṃ kathāśruteḥ puṇyaṃ phalaṃ mokṣapradaṃ bhavet | ahaṃ tuṣṭo bhavāmyeva yatra me’sti kathāmṛtam ||77|| vajralepādipāpāni kathātmamatprayogataḥ | madārādhanavijñānāt bhasmībhavanti sarvaśaḥ ||78|| satyā patiguṇāḥ śravyā eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ | patiścāhaṃ parabrahma matkathāṃ śṛṇuyācchubhām ||79|| dānaṃ yajñaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ dravyaṃ vyayaiḥ samutsavam | kartumaśaktabhaktena kathā śravyā mama dhruvam ||1.454.80|| kīrtanaṃ me svāminaśca nityaṃ kāryaṃ prage niśi | pūjā kāryā madarthe ca grasitanyaṃ niveditam ||81 || patraṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ khādyaṃ sarvaṃ prāsādikaṃ graset | tena sattvapraśuddhiḥ syātsmṛtirdevasya śāśvatī ||82|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasmṛtyā dhruvo mokṣo’pyavāpyate | smṛtau tu sarvathā hetuḥ śrīkṛṣṇayaśasāṃ śravaḥ ||83|| kṣitedanijapuṇyena svargaprāptirna vai dhruvā | kathāśravaṇabhaktyā tu śāśvat dhāma gamyate ||84|| svarṇakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ dānāccāpyadhikā kathā | rājasūyasahasrebhyaścottamā śrīhareḥ kathā ||85|| vratebhyo niyamebhyaśca japebhyaḥ śreyasī kathā | yatra me mama sādhūnāṃ bhaktānāṃ yogayoṣitām ||86 || sādhvīnāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca camatkārā nirūpitāḥ | caritrāṇi sudivyāni dyumanti varṇitāni ca ||87|| tāni sarvāṇi dātṝṇi sampadāṃ mokṣaṇasya ca | bhavatāṃ mokṣaṇārthāya satyāḥ sadbhāvasevayā ||88|| yuṣmākaṃ tāraṇārthaṃ vai viprarūpo bhavāmyaham | athāhaṃ yāmi vaikuṇṭhaṃ bhavantaḥ sādhusevanam ||89|| kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ nityaṃ kurvantu dhyānameva me | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ mama sevāṃ yūyaṃ sarve gamiṣyatha ||1.454.90|| ityuktvā vācako vipro vimānena sutejasā | yayau nārāyaṇo bhūtvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ bhaktasevitaḥ || 91 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi kāntājñāpālane phalam | śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhaved dhruvam ||9 2|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pātivratyaparāyā bandulāyā vidurākhyaviprasya svasvāminaḥ ājñāpālane vyavāyasyādoṣatve bhagavatkathāprāptilābhena bhagavaddhāmaprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥpañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 454 ||
<1.455> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca agastyasya priyapatnyāḥ pratāpaṃ tvaṃ śṛṇu priye | pativratottamālopāmudrāyā divyayoṣitaḥ || 1 || kadācinnārado lakṣmi snātvā śrīnarmadāmbhasi | vindhyaṃ vilokayāñcakre vrajan śrībadarīśvaram || 2 || rasālayaṃ drumavallīstambasasyādiśobhitam | vardhamānaṃ mahākāśe lokayantaṃ samantataḥ || 3 || dṛṣṭvā kṣaṇaṃ nāradaḥ sa tasthau vyomnyeva kautukāt | vindhyo’pi sūryasaṃkāśaṃ nabhasi dyotitāmbaram || 4 || nāradaṃ dṛṣṭavān premṇā dūrāt pratyujjagāma tam | santaṃ dṛṣṭvā kaṭhino’pi dhatte mṛdulatāṃ yataḥ || 5 || natvā muniṃ dadau pādyamarghyaṃ cāsanamarhaṇam | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre babhāṣe’vanato giriḥ || 6 || adya te pādarajasā naṣṭaṃ rajastamo mama | dharādharatvaṃ kuliṣu mānyaṃ me syāttavāgamāt || 7 || śrutvaitannāradaḥ kiñciducchvasya sthitavām̐stataḥ | vindhyādrirāha munirāḍucchvāsakāraṇaṃ vad || 8 || himādrīn parvatānnāhaṃ gaṇaye bhūdharāniti | vada kāryaṃ tu te kiñcit kariṣye sevayā yutaḥ || 9 || nāradastaṃ tadā prāha merustvāmavamanyate | ityuktvā nāradastasmād yayau badarikāśramam || 1.455.1 0|| vindhyādristvāpa mahatīṃ cintāṃ dhigjīvanaṃ mama | jñātiparājitasyātrodyamavivarjitasya ca || 11 || kathaṃ bhunakti sa divā kathaṃ rātrau svapityaho | rahaḥ śarma kathaṃ tasya yasya jñātiparābhavaḥ || 1 2|| yuktamuktaṃ purāvidbhiścintā kṛtyā bhayaṃkarī | nopāyaiḥ śāmyati ghorā nidrāṃ balaṃ haratyapi || 1 3|| cintājvaro mahātīvraḥ pratyahaṃ navatāṃ vrajet | kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kathaṃ meruṃ jayāmyaham || 14|| viśveśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāyāṃ sa me buddhiṃ pradāsyati | iti vicārya mahati tvambare vardhate giriḥ || 15|| dakṣiṇe sūryamārgaṃ sa niruddhya samavasthitaḥ | sūryāśvāstvagrato gantuṃ na śekurvai tadāruṇaḥ || 16|| prāha sūryaṃ mahāvindhyo niruddhya gaganaṃ sthitaḥ | spardhate meruṇā prepsustvaddattāṃ tu pradakṣiṇām || 17|| rāhubāhugrahavyagro yaḥ kṣaṇaṃ nāvatiṣṭhati | yojanānāṃ sahasre dve, dve śate, dve ca yojane || 18|| yojanasya nimeṣārdhād yāti so’pi ciraṃ sthitaḥ | tat sūryasya gatistambhāt stambhitaṃ tannimittakam || 19 || kālamānaṃ tathā kāryaṃ rurudurdudruvuḥ prajāḥ | tato devādayaḥ sarve brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ || 1.455.20|| namaścakrustuṣṭuvuśca rakṣa rakṣeti cābruvan | vilokya duḥkhitān brahmā pratyuvāca divaukasaḥ ||21 || dāsyāmi sakalān kāmān śṛṇudhvaṃ varamuttamam | svasthāstiṣṭhata bho yūyaṃ kathaṃ satye samākulāḥ ||22|| ete vedāḥ sarvavidyāḥ satyaṃ dharmastapaḥ kratuḥ | brahmacaryaṃ bhāratīyaṃ śrutayaḥ smṛtayastathā ||23|| brahmaniṣṭhāstāpasāśca vratinaścopavāsinaḥ | pātivratyaparā nāryo ye cānye brahmacāriṇaḥ ||24|| mātāpitroḥ sadā bhaktā gobhaktā devasevakāḥ | patnīvratā atithīnāṃ pūjakā dānasukṛtāḥ ||25|| sarve me satyaloke’tra santi te sukhinaḥ sadā | vadantu bhavatāṃ ceṣṭaṃ karomi sukhakṛddhruvam ||26|| devāḥ prāhurvindhyaśailaḥ spardhate meruṇā divi | sūryamārgaṃ niruddhyaiva vardhate tvadgṛhaṃ prati ||27|| sūryādhārāḥ kriyā ruddhāstato layo bhaviṣyati | sūryamārgamato rodharahitaṃ kuru sarvathā ||28|| śrutvaitad viśvasṛṭ prāhāgastyanāmā mahāmuniḥ | kāśīkṣetre tapatyugraṃ yācadhvaṃ taṃ muniṃ surāḥ ||29|| mitrāvaruṇaputraḥ sa lopāmudrāpatiḥ ṛṣiḥ | vidhāsyati sa vaḥ kāryaṃ vātāpīlvalabhakṣakaḥ ||1.455.30|| ityuktāstu surādyāste yayuḥ kāśīmagastyakam | maṇikarṇyāṃ surāḥ snātvā dadṛśuḥ kāśikāṃ purīm ||3 1|| vidvajjanapralakṣaiḥ satsādhulakṣairadhiṣṭhitām | tīrthavāsijanavrātakoṭimaṇḍalacañcalām ||32|| devālayaistrikoṭibhirgṛhasthālayakoṭibhiḥ | sahasrodyānasatkṣetraiḥ rājasaudhasahasrakaiḥ ||33|| vāranārīpralakṣaiśca devanārīpralakṣakaiḥ | brahmacārikoṭibhiśca naikadeśīyamānavaiḥ ||34|| tīrthakoṭiśatalakṣairgaṃgādyunadikānadaiḥ | vimānairvāhanairyānairmahāpustakapattanaiḥ ||35|| dhanvantaryādiśālābhirannasatrasahasrakaiḥ | suśobhitā bhikṣukaiśca dīnānāthaiḥ sahasrakaiḥ || 36|| evaṃ tāṃ nagarīṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtvā tīrthānyanekaśaḥ | viśvanāthaṃ cānnapūrṇāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ tathā ||37|| śrībindumādhavaṃ dharmadevaṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamya te | sampūjya caraṇau prakṣālayitvāgṛhya cāmṛtam ||38|| jagmuḥ paropakārārthamagastiryatra tiṣṭhati | agastīśvaraliṃgaṃ ca kuṇḍaṃ kṛtvā tadagrataḥ ||39|| śatarudrīyasūktena japanmunirvirājate | tejasā sūryasaṃkāśaṃ dṛṣṭvā siṣmiyire surāḥ ||1.455.40|| aho ho sarvatejāṃsi śritvemāṃ brāhmaṇīṃ tanum | śīlayanti paraṃ dhāma śāntaṃ śāntapadāptaye ||41 || yasyāśrame’tra dṛśyante hiṃsrā api samantataḥ | sattvāśritāḥ sarvasattvāstyaktvā vairaṃ nisargajam ||42|| saha sarve nivasanti krūrāḥ śāntāśca rājasāḥ | paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarve mṛgāḥ sarīsṛpāstathā ||43|| ityāśramacarān dṛṣṭvā tiraśco’pi munīniva | abodhi vibudhaiḥ sarvaḥ prabhāvo’gastibhūmijaḥ ||44|| dharmārthakāmamokṣāstu mūrtā yatra caranti hi | itipaśyanto gīrvāṇā dadṛśustūṭajaṃ muneḥ ||45|| homadhūpasugandhāḍhyaṃ baṭubhirbahubhirvṛtam | brahmacaryaratābhiśca brahmādhyayanatejasā || 46 || candrābhābhirmunikanyābhiśca saumyamalaṃkṛtam | sārdravalkalakaupīnairvṛkṣaśākhāvalambibhiḥ ||47|| sūcayat sanmunivāsān sattvaprasādakāritān | pativratāśiroratnalopāmudrāṃghrimudrayā ||48|| mudritaṃ vīkṣya te nemuḥ parṇaśālāṅgaṇaṃ surāḥ | visarjitasamādhiṃ ca dhṛtakarṇākṣimālikam ||49|| adhiṣṭhitabṛsīpṛṣṭhaṃ vedhasā sadṛśaṃ śriyā | puro’gastyaṃ samālokya devāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ ||1.455.50|| prahṛṣṭavadanāḥ procuḥ proccairjaya jayeti ca | muniḥ sarvānupāveśya papracchāgamakāraṇam ||51 || devagurustamuvāca devāgamanakāraṇam | dhanyo’si kṛtakṛtyo’si mānyo’si mahatāmapi ||52|| pratyāśramaṃ pratinagaṃ pratyaraṇyaṃ tapodhanaḥ | kinna santaḥ santyagastye kācidanyaiva te sthitiḥ |||53 || tapolakṣmīstvayīhāsti brāhmaṃ tejastvayi sthiram | puṇyaśrīśca tvayi śreṣṭhā camatkārāstvayi sthitāḥ ||54|| pativrateyaṃ kalyāṇī lopāmudrā sadharmiṇī | tavāṃgacchāyayā tulyā yatkathā puṇyakāriṇī ||55|| arundhatī ca sāvitrī śāṇḍilī śrīḥ satī tathā | anasūyā mahālakṣmīḥ śatarūpā ca menakā ||56 || sunītiḥ kamalā svāhā saṃjñā ceti pativratāḥ | yā yāstāsu yathaiṣā varṇyate śreṣṭhā tathā na tāḥ ||57|| bhuṃkte bhukte tvayi mune tiṣṭhati tvayi tiṣṭhati | sunidrite tu nidrāti prathamaṃ pratibudhyati ||58|| nālaṃkṛtaṃ nijātmānaṃ tava darśayati kvacit | gate bhavati kāryārthaṃ na dhatte maṇḍanāni tu ||5 9 || tavāyuṣyavivṛddhyarthaṃ na gṛṇātyabhidhāṃ tava | kṛṣṇaṃ vinānyapunnāma naiva vadati karhicit ||1.455.60|| ākruṣṭā daṇḍitā cāpi nākrośati prasīdati | idaṃ kuru samājñaptā śīghraṃ karoti tatkṣaṇam ||6 1 || kariṣyasīti samproktāvaśyaṃ kānteti vakti ca | tvayāhūtānyakāryāṇi tyaktvā tvāyāti satvaram ||62|| ājñāpaya kṛpāsindho vakti kṛtaṃ pramanyatām | na catuṣkasya mārgasyāṅganasya dvāri tiṣṭhati ||63|| anāpṛṣṭvā bhavantaṃ sā vastumātraṃ tṛṇaṃ hyapi | tvayā nānumataṃ kiñcit kasmaicinna dadātyapi ||64|| svayamāharati pūjāsāmagrīrnoditāpi ca | jalaṃ darbhān phalapatrapuṣpāṇi cākṣatādikān ||65 || sādhayatyeva samaye vinājñāmapi sā satī | nodvignā bhavati kvāpi nodvejayati cāparān ||66 || yathākālaṃ yathāyogyamupasthāpayatīkṣate | bhuṃkte bhartuḥ prasādaṃ ca jalamannaṃ phalādikam ||67|| matvā mahāprasādaṃ tat svāmidattaṃ samīhate | devapitratithipoṣyānāthasatīsataḥ sadā ||68|| dāsagobhikṣukān datvāśnāti vibhajya naijakam | saṃyatopaskarā prātardṛṣṭā vyayaparāṅmukhī ||6 9|| yathāpekṣavyayakartrī yogyaśaśvatparigrahā | tavādeśaṃ vinā neyaṃ karotyapoṣaṇaṃ vratam ||1.455.70|| vinājñāṃ te na yātīyaṃ draṣṭuṃ samājamutsavam | pradarśanaṃ mallayuddhaṃ nṛtyaṃ nāṭya kalālayam ||71 || tīrthayātrāṃ vivāhaṃ te vinājñāṃ draṣṭumeti na | āsīnaṃ ramamāṇaṃ ca suptaṃ patiṃ sukhena sā ||72 || atyāvaśyakakārye’pi tvāṃ notthāpayati kvacit| | akāmaṃ tvāṃ ca rajasā svārthārthaṃ nāpi sevate || 73 || rājasvalye mukhaṃ naiva darśayati dinatrayam | śrāvayati svavākyaṃ na pūrvaṃ snānādiśuddhitaḥ ||74|| paśyati turyadivase bharturmukhaṃ raviṃ harim | dhyāyatīyaṃ kāntarūpaṃ kṛṣṇarūpaṃ pativratā ||75 || nityaṃ saubhāgyacihnāni dhārayatyeva tvadratā | keśasaṃskārakabarīkarakarṇādibhūṣaṇam ||76 || haridrāṃ kuṃkumacandraṃ sindūraṃ netrakajjalam | kaṃcukīṃ natthikāṃ tantrīṃ nūpuraṃ baṃgiḍīṃ tathā ||77|| śṛṃkhalāṃ cormikāṃ hāraṃ svarṇairaṇe ca śāṭikām | viṣṇutailaṃ sugandhaṃ ca dhārayatyeva tvadratā ||78|| na ca saṃgaṃ karotyeṣā nāstikāyāstu yoṣitaḥ | nāspṛśyāyā na puṃścalyāḥ pākhaṇḍinyāśca yoṣitaḥ ||79|| nāśuddhāyāśca kāminyā dharmavarjitayoṣitaḥ | bhartṛvidveṣiṇīṃ nārīṃ naiṣā saṃbhāṣate satī |||1.455.8 0|| naikākinī bahiryāti vivastrā snāti na kvacit | niṣīdati sadā nimne na same bhartṛsannidhau ||8 1 || kaṇḍanyāṃ na ca peṣaṇyāṃ na cūllyāṃ jalakuṃbhake | gargaryāṃ na kaṭāhādau mūśale na śilātale ||82|| cūrṇayantre na mārjanyāṃ caṭṭanīpeṣake na hi | na dehalyāṃ puṇyapātre kṛtvā pṛṣṭhaṃ guruṃ patim ||83 || niṣīdati kvacicchāṭīmuttāryāpi na tvadratā | stanaṃ jaghanaṃ kaścinna saṃpaśyed vartate tathā ||84|| vinā vyavāyasamayaṃ prāgalbhyaṃ samarakṣati | bharturyatra yathā tṛptiḥ rucistatra pravartate ||85|| paraṃ dharmaṃ vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ devapūjanamuttamam | pālanaṃ pativākyasya matvollaṃghanameti na ||86|| bālamaśaktamakāmaṃ vyādhitaṃ duravasthakam | klībaṃ vratasthaṃ vṛddhaṃ vā rugṇaṃ patiṃ pativratā ||87|| susthitaṃ duḥsthitaṃ vāpi vyasanāḍhyaṃ daridrakam | cauraṃ kāmātisaktaṃ vā sevate sarvadā satī ||88|| tāpasaṃ cāpi niṣkāmaṃ tvāṃ sadā sevate tviyam | hṛṣṭā sadā tvayi hṛṣṭe viṣaṇṇe śokagarbhitā ||89|| sampatsu caikarūpā te vipatsvapi tava priyā | gṛhe bhojyasya vastūnāṃ veṣavārasya ca kṣaye ||1.455.90 || sampādayati cājñayā nāstīti na bravītyapi | tīrthecchayā te caraṇāmṛtaṃ pibati nityaśaḥ||91 || viṣṇornārāyaṇācchaṃbhoradhikaṃ manute patim | bhartṛcaraṇapūjātmaniyamaṃ tu prarakṣati || 92|| satrapaṃ cāpavāde ca kaṣṭadaṃ kalikārakam | mṛṣā hasanaṃ cākrośaṃ neyaṃ gṛṇāti vai kvacit ||93|| devaṃ guruṃ vrataṃ tīrthaṃ dharmaṃ jānāti sā patim .| tava chāyāsamā ceyaṃ vartate kiṃkarī tava ||94|| dhanyo’si munivarya tvaṃ dhanyau te pitarau tathā | | asyāstu pitarau dhanyau yataśceyaṃ pativratā ||95|| pativratāyāścaraṇo yatra bhūmau spṛśatyapi | sā bhūmiḥ sarvadā tīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ tārakaṃ bhavet| ||96|| parameśvarabhaktyaiva labhate strī pativratā | gṛhasthastvaṃ yathārtho’si yasya te’sti pativratā ||97|| pativratāyā dṛṣṭyāpi pātakī pāvano bhavet | na gaṃgayā tayā bhedo yā nārī patidevatā ||98|| gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ tvetad yajjātaṃ tava darśanam | tava patnyā darśanaṃ ca jātaṃ no bahupuṇyataḥ ||99|| praṇavastvaṃ śrutiśceyaṃ kṣamaiṣā tvaṃ svayaṃ tapaḥ | satkriyeyaṃ phalaṃ tvaṃ ca dhanyo’si tvaṃ mahāmune || 1.455.100 || idaṃ pativrataṃ tejo brahmatejo bhavānparam | tatrāpyetattapastejaḥ kimasādhyatamaṃ tava || 101 || tava nāviditaṃ kiñcittathāpi pravadāmyaham | yadarthamāgatā devāstanmune’tra niśāmaya || 1 02|| ayaṃ śatamakhaḥ śrīmānayamagnirjagatprabhuḥ | dharmarājo varuṇaśca vāyuḥ śrīśaśivādayaḥ || 1 03|| samabhyarthayitāro’mī tvaṃ yācyaśca jagatkṛte | vāṅmātrodyamasādhyaṃ tat tava viśvopakārakam || 1 04|| vindhyādrirvardhate meroḥ spardhayā tvaṃ nivāraya | sūryamārgamavaruddhyedānīmūrdhvaṃ pragacchati || 1 05|| ye tu niṣṭhuranaisargā ye ca mārgāvarodhakāḥ | ye spardhante ca vṛddhyarthaṃ tadvṛddhirhānidā sadā || 1 06|| śrutvā dhyātvā kṣaṇaṃ tathetyuktvāgastirmahāmuniḥ | visṛjya devatāḥ prāha lopāmudrāmidaṃ vacaḥ || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kutayugasantāne vindhyādriṇā vardhamānena sūryamārgāvarodhe devānāmagastimuniṃ prati yānaṃ lopāmudrāyāḥ pātivratyadharmavarṇanaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā pañcapañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 455 ||
<1.456> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca dhyāne sarvaṃ samālocyāgastiḥ svasya pativratām | lopāmudrāmuvācedaṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi jagaddhitam || 1 || api paśya varārohe kimetatsamupasthitam | kva tatkāryaṃ kva ca vayaṃ munimārgāvalambinaḥ || 2 || kāśīkṣetre nivasatāṃ vighnā bhavanti bhāgyataḥ | kāśīkṣetraṃ na moktavyaṃ sarvathaiva mumukṣubhiḥ || 3 || upasthito’yaṃ kalyāṇi so’ntarāyo mahānmama | tathāpi devakāryārthaṃ yāsyāmi śrīśivo’vatāt || 4 || ityuccārya śivaṃ natvopaspṛśyāsijalaṃ śubham | lopāmudrāsahāyaḥ sa yogena tapasā muniḥ || 5 || vyomamārgeṇa divyena nimeṣārdhena vai divam | jagāmāgre dadarśādriṃ vindhyaṃ ruddhāmbaronnatam || 6 || cakampe tvacalastūrṇaṃ dṛṣṭvaivāgrasthitaṃ munim | tamagastiṃ priyāyuktaṃ vātāpīlvalavairiṇam || 7 || govardhanaṃ kare dhṛtvāsthāpayad yo yamībhuvi | tamagnisadṛśaṃ vindhyo bhūtvā kharvataro bhayāt| || 8 || ājñāprasādaḥ kriyatāṃ kiṃkaro’smīti cābravīt | agastiḥ prāha vindhya tvaṃ māṃ vijānāsi tattvataḥ || 9 || punarāgamanaṃ cenme tāvat kharvataro bhava | ityuktvā priyayā sākaṃ dakṣiṇāśāṃ yayau muniḥ || 1.456.10 || vindhyaḥ paśyati sotkaṇṭho na śapto yadagastinā | na mayā sadṛśo dhanya iti matvā tutoṣa ha || 11 || adya śvo vā paraśvo vāpyāgamiṣyati vai muniḥ | iti cintāmahābhārairgirirhrasvastathā sthitaḥ || 1 2|| no’dyāpi munirāyāti nādyāpi giriredhate | aruṇo’pi ca tatkāle kālajño’śvānakālayat || 1 3|| jagatsvāsthyamavāpoccaiḥ pūrvavad bhānusañcaraiḥ | vivardhiṣati yo nīcaḥ parāsūyā samudvahan || 14|| dūre tadvṛddhivārtāstāṃ prāgvṛddherapi saṃśayaḥ | manorathā na siddhāḥ syuḥ siddhā naśyantyapi dhruvam || 15|| avijñāyānyasāmarthyaṃ svasāmarthyaṃ pradarśayet | upahāsasamavāpnoti tathaivāyamihācalaḥ || 16|| atha godāvarītīraṃ yayāvagastirīśvaraḥ | dadarśāgre mahālakṣmīṃ sahāsyāṃ suciraṃ sthitām || 17|| tāṃ tu stutvā bhagavatīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ haripriyām | patnīyuktaḥ praṇanāma sāṣṭāṃgaṃ daṇḍavanmuniḥ || 18|| lakṣmī prāha muniṃ lopāmudrāṃ cāpi pativratām | prasannāhaṃ tvāṃ pravīkṣya vṛṇu yatte hṛdi sthitam || 1 9|| rājaputri mahābhāge tvamihopaviśāmale | koladaityavināśārthamahamatra samāgatā ||1.456.20|| tvadaṃgalakṣaṇairebhiḥ supavitraiśca te vrataiḥ | nirvāpayitumicchāmi daityāstraistāpitāṃ tanum ||21 || ityuktvā munipatnīṃ tāṃ samāliṅgya haripriyā | alaṃcakāra suprītyā bahusaubhāgyamaṇḍanaiḥ ||22|| lopāmudrāpi tāṃ lakṣmīṃ sevayāmāsa suspṛśaiḥ | dehasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre tāpaḥ śaśāma ca śriyaḥ ||23|| lopāmudrā śriyāḥ pādau dhṛtvā nanāma sādaram | vavande stavanaṃ cakre tava lakṣmiḥ tadā satī ||24|| śṛṇu tatstavanaṃ yena stāvakāḥ syurdhanāśrayāḥ | naikasampatsamāyuktāstvayā prasannayekṣitāḥ ||25|| mātarnamāmi kamale padmāyatasulocane | śrīviṣṇuhṛtkamalasthe viśvamātarnamo’stu te ||26|| kṣīrasāgarasatputri padmagarbhābhasundari | lakṣmi prasīda satataṃ viśvamātarnamo’stu te ||27|| mahendrasadane tvaṃ śrīḥ rukmiṇī kṛṣṇabhāminī | candre jyotsnā prabhā sūrye viśvamātarnamo’stu te ||28|| smitānane jagaddhātri śaraṇye sukhavarddhini | jātavedasi dahane viśvamātarnamo’stu te ||29|| brahmaṇi tvaṃ sarjanāsi viṣṇau tvaṃ poṣikā sadā | śive saṃhārikā śaktirviśvamātarnamo’stu te ||1.456.3 0|| tvayā śūro guṇī vijño dhanyo mānyaḥ kulīnakaḥ | kalāśīlakalāpāḍhyo viśvamātarnamo’stu te ||3 1 || tvayā gajasturagaśca straiṇastṛṇaṃ saraḥ sadaḥ | devo gṛhaṃ kaṇaḥ śreṣṭhā viśvamātarnamo’stu te ||32|| tvayā pakṣī paśuḥ śayyā ratnaṃ pṛthvī naro vadhūḥ | śreṣṭhāḥ śuddhā mahālakṣmi viśvamātarnamo’stu te ||33|| lakṣmi śri kamale padme rame padmodbhave sati | abdhije viṣṇupatni tvaṃ prasīda satataṃ priye ||34|| iti stutā prasannā ca śrīruvāca pativratām | lopāmudre mune jāne vāṃ yat hṛttāpakāraṇam ||35|| sacetanaṃ dunotyeva kāśīviśleṣajo’nalaḥ | yuvāṃ vārāṇasīṃ prāpya siddhiṃ prāpsyatha īpsitām ||36|| ye paṭhiṣyanti matstotraṃ tāpadāridryanāśakam | iṣṭasampatpradaṃ teṣāṃ jayasantatikārakam ||37|| mama sānnidhyadaṃ bālagrahādivyādhināśanam | bhaviṣyati mama sārūpyādipramokṣaṇaṃ tathā ||38|| iti labdhvā dampatī śrīpradāśiṣaḥ praṇamya tām | yayaturnātidūrasthaṃ śrīśailaṃ kamalāśrayam ||39|| patnīyuktaḥ sa saṃvīkṣya parāṃ mudamavāpa ha | paropakaraṇaṃ yeṣāṃ jāgarti hṛdaye satām ||1.456.40|| naśyanti vipadasteṣāṃ sampadaḥ syuḥ pade pade | tīrthasnānairna sā śuddhirbahudānairna tatphalam || 41| tapobhirugraistannāpyamupakṛtyā yadāpyate | nopakārātparo dharmo nāpakārādaghaṃ param ||42|| upakāraphalaṃ lakṣmīdarśanaṃ śailadarśanam | lopāmudrāmunibhyāṃ śrīveṃkaṭādrirvilokitaḥ ||43|| uvāca vacanaṃ patnīṃ tadā prītamanā muniḥ | ākarṇaya varārohe tattvaṃ te kathayāmi vai ||44|| muktisthānānyanekāni bhavanti bhūtale sati | prayāgaṃ tīrtharājaṃ vai kurukṣetraṃ ca naimiṣam ||45|| avantikā haridvāramayodhyā mathurā purī | dvārikā cāmarāvatī tathā kuṃkumavāpikā ||46|| sarasvatī sindhusaṃgo gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgamaḥ | kāñcī ca tryambakaṃ cāpi saptagodāvarītaṭam ||47|| kālaṃjaraṃ prabhāsaśca badrikāśramaraivatau | mahālayastathauṃkārakṣetraṃ ca pauruṣottamam ||48|| gokarṇo bhṛgukacchaśca bhṛgutuṅgaśca puṣkaram | śrīparvato mānasaṃ ca dhārātīrthaṃ ca bhautikam ||49|| ādhyātmikāni tīrthāni dayāsnehādikānyapi | etāni muktidānyeva nātrāsti saṃśayo manāk |||1.456.50|| satyaṃ tīrthaṃ kṣamātīrthaṃ tīrthamindriyanigrahaḥ | sarvabhūtadayātīrthaṃ tīthamārjavamityapi ||51 || dānaṃ tīrthaṃ damastīrthaṃ santoṣastīrthamucyate | brahmacaryaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ ca priyavāditā ||52|| jñānaṃ tīrthaṃ dhṛtistīrthaṃ tapastīrthamudāhṛtam | sarvatīrthaparaṃ tīrthaṃ śuddhiryā mānasī sadā ||93|| na jalena viśuddhirvai manaḥśuddhi satī sadā | na śarīramalatyāgācchuddhirdeho na nirmalāḥ ||54|| aihikasukhalabdhyarthaṃ vāñcchā vai mānaso malaḥ | tatra tatra virāgastu sunairmalyamudāhṛtam ||55|| bhāve tu nirmale jāte kāmādyā api nirmalāḥ | doṣāśca guṇatāṃ yānti sattvaprakarṣasaṃśrayāt ||56 || nigṛhītendriyagrāmo yatra kvāpi vasejjanaḥ | tatra tasya kurukṣetraṃ naimiṣaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca ||57|| dhyānapūte jñānajale rāgadveṣamalāpahe | yaḥ snāti mānase tīrthe sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||58|| etatte mānasaṃ proktaṃ tīrthaṃ sādhuprasevanam | bāhya bhaumaṃ jalīyaṃ ca śṛṇu tīrthaṃ kathaṃ hi tat ||59|| śārīrā brahmarandhrādyā bhāgā medhyatamā yathā | tathā bhūjalabhāgāśca medhyāstīrthāni tāni vai ||1.456.6 0|| svayaṃjātāni puṇyāni kānicid devajāni ca | kānicitsatpūruṣāṇāṃ nivāsādyaiḥ kṛtāni ca ||61 || pativratānāṃ vāsādyaiścamatkāraiḥ satāmapi | satīnāṃ cāpyanugrahaiḥ sādhvīnāṃ tapasā tathā ||62|| patnīvratānāṃ kāryādyaistīrthāni saṃbhavanti hi | ātmatīrthaṃ mahat proktaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo mahato mahān ||63|| śuddhaṃ buddhyātmakaṃ tīrthaṃ nirmalānīndriyāṇyapi | bhautikāni śarīrāṇi tapobhiḥ pāvanāni ca ||64|| asthi carmādikaṃ cāpyaśuddhaṃ satāṃ tu pāvanam | tīrthaṃ vai jāyate kṛṣṇatapoyogāt sudivyakam ||65|| kathātmakaṃ sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthottamottamam | bhāvātmakaṃ mahattīrthaṃ snehatīrthaṃ ca sukṛtam ||66|| vṛddhābhivandanaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmalokapradaṃ matam | yajñabhūmirmahattīrthaṃ gotīrthaṃ tulasīkṣatiḥ ||67|| ekādaśyādikaṃ tīrthaṃ tārayatyeva bandhanāt | śraddhātmakaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyadaṃ phaladaṃ tathā ||68|| tasmādbhaumeṣu tīrtheṣu jalīyeṣu tathā priye | yathā divyatvabuddhirvai tathā kṛtvā tu dehiṣu ||69|| devālayeṣu deveṣu mūrtiṣu pratimāsu ca | satsu sādhvīṣu satkāryaṃ sukṛtaṃ tvarjayet sadā ||1.456.70|| āntareṣu ca bāhyeṣu tīrtheṣu snāti yo janaḥ | kṛṣṇasaṃghagatau bhakto vindati paramāṃ gatim ||71|| snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homastarpaṇaṃ vapanaṃ kṛtam | hareḥ satāṃ sevanaṃ ca darśanaṃ tvakṣayaṃ bhavet ||72|| kāśī kāñcī ca māyākhyā tvayodhyā dvāravatyapi | mathurāvantikā caitā mokṣadā bhagavadbhuvaḥ ||73|| tathāpi kāśikā sarvadevavāsena yādṛśī | mānase me rocate’dya na tathānyā pativrate ||74|| tārakaṃ jñānamantrādi dadāti śaṃkaraḥ svayam | nityaṃ bhikṣukarūpeṇa bhramatyeva gṛhaṃ gṛham ||75|| mahāvaiṣṇavarājo’yaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ tathā | golokaṃ cāpi kailāsaṃ bhaktān preṣayati prabhuḥ ||76|| yamamārgaḥ sadā ruddhaḥ kāśīvāsakṛtāṃ priye | avimuktaṃ mahākṣetraṃ śivādīnāṃ parātparam ||77|| tadvāsārthaṃ rocaye’haṃ yāvastāṃ kāśikāṃ purīm | satīnāṃ kāśikāvāsād brahmalokāptireva vai ||78|| satīlokātparaṃ lokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ yānti tāḥ striyaḥ | etacchrutvā muniṃ lopāmudrā papraccha sādaram ||79|| nārīṇāṃ cāpsarasāṃ ca satīnāṃ kvāsti tatpuram | vada me jīvaneśātra syāṃ ca niḥsaṃśayā yathā ||1.456.80 || omityuktvā satīlokamagastiḥ prāha yoṣite | śṛṇu sādhvi bhūmilokātparo vāyustaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||81|| piśācādinivāsaḥ sa tato guhyakamaṇḍalam | guhyakānāṃ tu devānāṃ lokaḥ sa smṛddhisaṃbhṛtaḥ ||82||| tato gāndharvalokaśca yatra gandharvacāraṇāḥ | tato vaidyādharo loko vidyādhrā yatra santi hi ||83|| tato dharmapurī ramyā dhārmikāḥ svargavāsinaḥ | tataḥ svargaṃ mahatpuṇyabhājāṃ sthānaṃ sadāsukham ||84|| tataścāpsarasāṃ lokaḥ svarge cordhve vyavasthitaḥ | apsaraso mahāsatyo yajñabhājāṃ priyaṃkarāḥ ||85|| vasanti cāpsaroloke lokapālānusevikāḥ | yuvatyo rūpalāvaṇyasaubhāgyanidhayaḥ śubhāḥ ||86|| dṛḍhagranthinitambinyo divyālaṃkāraśobhanāḥ | divyabhogapradā gītinṛtyavādyasupaṇḍitāḥ ||87|| kāmakelikalābhijñā dyūtavidyāviśāradāḥ | rasajñā bhāvavedinyaścaturāścocitoktiṣu ||88|| nānādeśaviśeṣajñā nānābhāṣāsukovidā | saṃketodantanipūṇāḥ svatantrā devatoṣikāḥ ||89|| līlānarmasu sābhijñāḥ supralāpeṣu paṇḍitāḥ | kṣīrodasya sutāḥ sarvā nārāyaṇena nirmitāḥ ||1.456.90 || urvaśī menakā raṃbhā candralekhā tilottamā | vapuṣmatī kāntimatī līlāvatyupalāvatī ||91 || alambuṣā guṇavatī sthūlakeśī kalāvatī | kalānidhirguṇanidhiḥ karpūratilakorvarā ||92|| anaṃgalatikā vidyullatā madanamohinī | cakorākṣī candrakalā maṇiprabhā manoharā ||93|| grāvadrāvā tapodveṣṭrī cārunāsā sukarṇikā | dārusañjivanī suśrīḥ kratuśulkā śubhānanā ||94|| tapaḥśulkā tīrthaśulkā dānaśulkā himāvatī | pañcāśvamedhikā vidyā rājasūyārthinī prabhā ||95|| aṣṭāgnihomikā mādhvī vājapeyaśatodbhavā | acchodā mohinī campā lalitā ca jayā ramā || 96|| vardhinī padminī mañjukeśī hemnī ca mañjulā | miśrakeśī devikā śāntikā ṣaṣṭisahasrakam || 97|| apsarasāṃ vasatyanyā striyo loke’tra santyapi | sadāskhalitalāvaṇyāḥ sadāskhalitayauvanāḥ ||98|| divyāmbarā divyamālā divyagandhānulepanāḥ | divyabhogaiḥ susampannāḥ svecchāvidhṛtavigrahāḥ || 99 || kṛtvā māsopavāsāni skhalanti brahmacaryataḥ | sakṛdeva dvikṛtyo vā triḥkṛtvo daivayogataḥ || 1.456.100|| tā imā divyabhoginyo rūpalāvaṇyasampadaḥ | nivasantyapsaroloke sarvakāmasamanvitāḥ || 101 || kṛtvā vratāni sāṃgāni kāmikāni vidhānataḥ | bhavanti kāmacāriṇyo devabhogyā ihāgatāḥ || 1 02|| pativratadharānāryo balena balinā dhṛtāḥ | bhartṛbuddhyā ramante ta kadācittā imāḥ priyāḥ || 10 3|| bhartari proṣite yāstu brahmacaryavratāḥ sadā | viplavante sakṛd daivāt tā etā vāmalocanāḥ || 1 04|| svarṇaṃ sugandhaṃ sahasraṃ śayyāṃ bhūṣāśca bhojanam | bahukautukavastūni samarcya dvijadampatīm || 1 05|| saṃkrāntau vā vyatīpāte dadyāt yā varavarṇinī | kāmarūpadharo devaḥ prīyatāmiti vādinī || 1 06|| ko’dāt kasmā adāt kāmo’dāt kāmāya tvadāttathā | kāmo dātā kāmaḥ pratigṛhītā kāma te idam || 1 07|| itimantreṇa saṃdātrī yathāśakti sakāmanā | sā śreṣṭhāpsarasāṃ madhye vaset kalpamihāṃganā || 1 08|| kanyārūpadharā kācid vyābhuktā kenacit kvacit | devarūpeṇa taṃ kālamārabhya brahmacāriṇī || 1 09|| vṛttaṃ tad dhyāyamānā sā nidhanaṃ yāti kālataḥ | divyarūpadharā seha jāyate divyabhogabhāk || 1.456.11 0|| ityāvedya striyai kuṃbhajanmā mitrāvaruṇajaḥ | lopāmudrābhidhapatnyai tūṣṇīmāsa mahāmuniḥ || 11 1|| atha kāśyāṃ śivā durgā devyo brahmavratapriyāḥ | yayuḥ prātaragastyasyāśramaṃ devīṃ pativratām || 11 2|| devīpūjyāṃ mahāsādhvīṃ lopāmudrāṃ pravīkṣitum | adṛṣṭvā tāmanivṛttāṃ riktaṃ cāśramamaṇḍalam || 11 3|| dhyātvā jñātvā veṃkaṭādrau sthitāṃ draṣṭuṃ drutaṃ yayuḥ | nemurāśleṣayāmāsuḥ kathāḥ prāhuḥ parasparam || 1 14|| devībhirarthitā sādhvī tābhiḥ sākaṃ nijāśramam | agastinā saha sādhvī samājagāma kāśikām || 1 15|| pativratāṃ mahāsādhvīṃ satīṃ prāpya surastriyaḥ | kāśīsthā sukhamāpannā durlabhaḥ satsamāgamaḥ || 116 || iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi vindhyasyāvardhanaṃ tathā | agastyasya camatkāro lopāmudrāsatīśatā || 1 17|| yā kanyā śṛṇuyāccedaṃ paṭhedvā sā pativratā | satī sādhvī śrīsamānā bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ || 1 18|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vindhyācalasya sūryamārgamavaruddhya sthitasyāgastyena nirodhaḥ kṛtaḥ, agastyasya mahālakṣmīdarśanaṃ, mahālakṣmīstotraṃ, tīrthavividhatā, tīrthapraśaṃsā, apsarasāṃ lokaḥ, apsarobhāvaprāptikāraṇāni, kāśīdevibhirlopāmudrāgastyayoḥ kāśīṃ pratyānayanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||456||
<1.457> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca datrātreyasya sacchiṣyaḥ kārtavīryārjuno nṛpaḥ | pativratayā tatpatnyā manoramākhyayā muhuḥ || 1 || rakṣito’pi bodhito’pi na mene svapriyāvacaḥ | anādṛtya gato yuddhe jāmadagnyasya sannidhau || 2 || tadā dehaḥ parityakto manoramākhyayoṣitā | tato mṛtaḥ kārtavīryaḥ śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ tu tām || 3 || māhiṣmatyā nagaryāḥ sa rājābhūdarjuno mahān | ekadā kārtavīryaḥ sa jagāma mṛgayāṃ vane || 4 || rātrau bubhukṣitaḥ śrānto jamadagnyāśramaṃ yayau | kāmadhenupratāpena sasainyo bhojito nṛpaḥ || 5 || jamadagniṃ mārayitvā kāmadhenuṃ jahāra saḥ | yayāvanu satī vahnau praviśya reṇukā patim || 6 || parśurāmaḥ krodhamāptaḥ pratijñāṃ pracakāra ha | triḥsaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kariṣyāmi mahīmimām || 7 || brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ datvā brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha | pratijñāṃ kathayāmāsa brahmaṇe’tha tamāha saḥ || 8 || śivalokaṃ gaccha vatsa śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja | śrīkṛṣṇamantrakavacagrahaṇaṃ kuru śaṃkarāt || 9 || durlabhaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tejaḥ śaivaṃ śāktaṃ vijeṣyati | śrutvā natvā vedhasaṃ saḥ śivalokaṃ jagāma ha || 1.457.10 || nanāma mūrdhnā śaṃbhuṃ sa vṛttāntaṃ samuvāca tam | prasannaḥ śaṃkarastasmai dadau śrīkṛṣṇasanmanum || 11 || trailokyavijayaṃ varma tathā stotraṃ hareḥ śubham | trailokyavijayasyāsya kavacasya prajāpatiḥ || 1 2|| ṛṣiśchandaśca gāyatrī devo rāseśvaraḥ prabhuḥ | trailokyavijayaprāptau viniyogaḥ sadā mataḥ || 13 || praṇavo me śiraḥ pātu śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ sadā | pāyāt kapālaṃ kṛṣṇāya svāhā pañcākṣarātmakaḥ || 14|| kṛṣṇeti pātu netre ca kṛṣṇaḥ svāheti tārakam | haraye nama ityevaṃ bhrūlatāṃ pātu me sadā || 15|| oṃ govindāya svāheti nāsikāṃ pātu sarvadā | gopālāya namo gaṇḍau pātu me sarvataḥ prabho || 16|| oṃ namo gopāṃganeśāya karṇau pātu sadā mama | oṃ kṛṣṇāya namaḥ śaśvatpātu me’dharayugmakam ||17|| oṃ govindāya svāheti dantaughaṃ me sadāvatu | pātu kṛṣṇāya dantādho dantordhvaṃ klīṃ sadāvatu || 18|| oṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya svāheti jihvikāṃ pātu me sadā | rāseśvarāya svāheti tālukaṃ pātu me sadā || 1 9|| rādhikeśāya svāheti kaṇṭhaṃ pātu sadā mama | namo gopāṃganeśāya vakṣaḥ pātu sadā mama ||1.457.20|| oṃ gopeśāya svāheti skandhaṃ pātu sadā mama | namaḥ kiśoraveśāya svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ sadāvatu ||21 || udaraṃ pātu me nityaṃ mukundāya namaḥ sadā | auṃ hrīṃ klīṃ kṛṣṇāya svāhā karau pātu sadā mama ||22|| oṃ viṣṇave namo bāhuyugmaṃ pātu sadā mama | oṃ hīṃ bhagavate svāhā nakharaṃ pātu me sadā ||23|| oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya nakharandhraṃ sadāvatu | auṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ padmanābhāya nābhiṃ pātu sadā mama ||24|| oṃ sarveśāya svāheti kakālaṃ pātu me sadā | oṃ gopīramaṇāya svāhā nitambaṃ pātu me sadā ||25|| oṃ gopīramaṇanāthāya pādau sadāvatu mama | oṃ hīṃ klīṃ rasikeśāya svāhā sarvaṃ sadāvatu ||26|| oṃ keśavāya svāheti mama keśān sadāvatu | namaḥ kṛṣṇāya svāheti brahmarandhraṃ sadāvatu ||27|| oṃ mādhavāya svāheti me lomāni sadāvatu | oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ralikeśāya svāhā sarvaṃ sadāvatu ||28|| paripūrṇatamaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prācyāṃ māṃ sarvadāvatu | svayaṃ golokanātho māmāgneyyāṃ diśi rakṣatu ||29|| pūrṇabrahmasvarūpaśca dakṣiṇe māṃ sadāvatu | nairṛtyāṃ pātu māṃ kṛṣṇaḥ paścime pātu māṃ hariḥ ||1.457.3 0|| govindaḥ pātu māṃ śaśvad vāyavyāṃ diśi nityaśaḥ | uttare māṃ sadā pātu rasikānāṃ śiromaṇiḥ ||3 1|| aiśānyāṃ māṃ sadā pātu vṛndāvanavihārakṛt | vṛndāvanīprāṇanāthaḥ pātu māmūrdhvadeśataḥ ||32|| sadaiva mādhavaḥ pātu balihārī balādhikaḥ | jale sthale cāntarikṣe nṛsiṃhaḥ pātu māṃ sadā ||33|| svapne jāgaraṇe śaśvat pātu māṃ mādhavaḥ sadā | sarvātmā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo māṃ pātu sarvataḥ ||34|| iti trailokyavijayaṃ varmoktaṃ te mahādbhutam | kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau dhāraṇād vijayaḥ sadā ||35|| sa bhavet siddhakavaco daśalakṣaṃ japettu yaḥ | daśāṃśahomaḥ kartavyo yatheṣṭasiddhimicchatā ||36|| oṃ śrī namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇāya paripūrṇatamāya svāhā | siddhaḥ syāt pañcalakṣaistu mantraḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥ ||37|| atha stotraṃ śṛṇu divyaṃ sadyastuṣṭikaraṃ param | divyaṃ śrīśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vedhasoditam || 38|| sūkṣmatamaṃ cākṣareśaṃ nirguṇaṃ saguṇaṃ harim | nirākāraṃ ca sākāraṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ||39|| sarvādhāraṃ svatantraṃ ca kamanīyaṃ vibhuṃ harim | sākṣiṇaṃ karmaphaladaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ||1.457.40|| jagajjanmādikartāraṃ saccidānandamarthagam | strīpuṃnapuṃsakātmānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ||41 || tārakaṃ dhārakaṃ sarvakāraṇānāṃ tu kāraṇam | bījaṃ vipraṃ raviṃ candraṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ||42||| śaṃkaraṃ śeṣarūpaṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ kapilaṃ munim | sanatkumāraṃ rādheśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ||43|| viṣṇuṃ devīṃ manuṃ bhaktaṃ vasantaṃ mārgaśīrṣakam | ekādaśīṃ sāgaraṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ||44|| himālayaṃ kṣitiṃ vṛndāṃ candanaṃ kalpapādapam | dhānyaṃ ca pārijātaṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ||45|| airāvataṃ vainateyaṃ kāmadhenuṃ tathāmṛtam | suvarṇaṃ ca yavaṃ siṃhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ||46 || bṛhaspatiṃ kuberaṃ ca vedamindraṃ sarasvatīm | akāraṃ jāhnavīṃ manaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ||47|| sudarśanaṃ brahmatejaḥ kāntaṃ kālaṃ balaṃ gurum | mātaraṃ viśvakarmāṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham || 88|| pativratāṃ pitaraṃ ca śālagrāmaṃ sutaṃ nṛpam | sāmavedaṃ vṛṣaṃ śaityaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ||49|| gandhaṃ śabdaṃ rājasūyaṃ gāyatrīṃ pāvakaṃ payaḥ | sucitrasthaṃ stutiṃ darbhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ||1.457.50 || śāntiṃ vibhuṃ matiṃ citraṃ śyāmalaṃ gopikāpatim | divyabhūṣādharaṃ kāntaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ||51 || vihāriṇaṃ ca rasikaṃ rādhākāntaṃ manoharam | lakṣmīśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nityaṃ namāmyaham ||52|| iti stotreṇa trailokye sarvadā vijayo bhavet | gaccha sādhaya saṃkuru pratijñāntaṃ jayastava ||53|| rāmo gatvā puṣkare saṃsādhya yuddhāya nirgataḥ | dadarśa maṃgalānyeva śuśrāva jayasūcakam ||54|| hariśabdaṃ siṃhaśabdaṃ ghaṇṭādundubhivādanam | ākāśīyasvaragītiṃ jayaste bhaviteti vai ||55|| naveṅgitaṃ ca kalyāṇaṃ meghaśabdaṃ jayāvaham | dadarśa purato viprabandidaivajñabhikṣukān |||56|| puro dadarśa dīpaṃ ca patiputravatīṃ satīm | śivaṃ śivāṃ pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ cāpaṃ ca nakulaṃ tathā ||57|| kṛṣṇamṛgaṃ gajaṃ siṃhaṃ turagaṃ gaṇḍakaṃ dvipam | camarīṃ rājahaṃsaṃ ca cakravākaṃ śukaṃ pikam ||58|| mayūraṃ khañjanaṃ śaṃkhacillaṃ tathā cakorakam | pārāvataṃ balākaṃ ca kāraṇḍaṃ cātakaṃ caṭam ||59|| saudāminīṃ śakracāpaṃ sūryaṃ sūryaprabhāṃ śubhām | sadyomāṃsaṃ sajīvaṃ ca matsyaṃ śaṃkhaṃ suvarṇakam ||1.457.60|| māṇikyaṃ rajataṃ muktāṃ maṇīndraṃ ca pravālakam | dadhi lājān śukladhānyaṃ śuklapuṣpaṃ ca kuṃkumam ||61 || parṇaṃ patākāṃ chatraṃ ca darpaṇaṃ śvetacāmaram | dhenuṃ vatsayutāṃ nṛpaṃ rathasthaṃ hetisaṃyutam ||62|| dugdhamājyaṃ ca pūgaṃ cāmṛtaṃ ca pāyasaṃ śubham | śālagrāmaṃ phalaṃ pakvaṃ svastikaṃ śarkarāṃ madhu ||63|| mārjāraṃ ca vṛṣaṃ śvetaṃ meṣaṃ parvatamūṣikam | meghācchannasya ca raverudayaṃ candramaṇḍalam ||64|| kastūrīṃ vyajanaṃ toyaṃ haridrāṃ tīrthamṛttikām | siddhārthaṃ sarṣapaṃ dūrvāṃ viprabālaṃ ca kanyakām ||65|| mṛgaṃ veśyāṃ ṣaṭpadaṃ ca karpūraṃ pītavāsasam | gomūtraṃ gopurīṣaṃ ca godhūliṃ gopadāṅkitam ||66|| goṣṭhaṃ gavāṃ vartma ramyāṃ gośālāṃ gogatiṃ tathā | bhūṣaṇaṃ devamūrtiṃ ca jvaladagniṃ mahotsavam ||67|| tāmraṃ ca sphaṭikaṃ vandyaṃ sindūraṃ mālyacandanam | gandhaṃ ca hīrakaṃ ratnaṃ dadarśa dakṣiṇe muniḥ ||68|| sugandhipavanāghrāṇaṃ prāpya viprāśiṣaḥ śubhāḥ | kārtavīryārjunābhyāśe yayau śrīnarmadātaṭam ||69|| tatrākṣayavaṭādhastād rātrau nidrāṃ jagāma ha | niśātīte dadarśāyaṃ svapnāni vividhāni ca 1.457.70|| na cintitaṃ yanmanasā vāyupittakaphaṃ vinā | gajāśvaśailaprāsādagovṛkṣaphaliteṣu ca ||7 1 || āruhyamāṇamātmānaṃ rudantaṃ kṛmibhakṣitam | āruhyamāṇamātmānaṃ naukāyāṃ candanokṣitam ||72|| puṣpamālāṃ dhṛtavantaṃ pītavastraiḥ suśobhitam | viṇmūtrokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ vasāpūyasamanvitam || 73 || vīṇāṃ varāṃ vādayantamātmānaṃ sa dadarśa ha | vistīrṇapadmapatrāḍhyaṃ svaṃ dadarśa sarittaṭe ||74|| dadhyājyamadhusaṃyuktaṃ bhuktavantaṃ ca pāyasam | bhuktavantaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ labhantaṃ vrāhmaṇāśiṣam ||75|| phalapuṣpapradīpaṃ ca paśyantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa ha | paripakvaphalaṃ kṣīramuṣṇānnaṃ śarkarānvitam ||76|| svastikaṃ bhuktavantaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ śvetacūrṇajam | śarkarāyugvāripānaṃ kurvantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa saḥ ||77|| jalaukasā vṛścikena mīnena bhujagena ca | bhakṣitaṃ bhītamātmānaṃ palāyantaṃ dadarśa saḥ ||78|| tato dadarśa cātmānaṃ maṇḍale śaśisūryayoḥ | patiputravatīṃ nārīṃ dadarśa sasmitāṃ tataḥ ||79|| suveṣayā kanyayā sasmitena ca dvijena ca | dadarśa śliṣṭamātmānaṃ tuṣṭena parituṣṭayā ||1.457.80 || phalitaṃ puṣpitaṃ vṛkṣaṃ devatāpratimāṃ nṛpam | gajasthaṃ ca rathasthaṃ ca paśyantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa saḥ ||81 || pītavastraparīdhānāṃ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitām | viśantīṃ brāhmaṇīṃ gehaṃ paśyantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa saḥ ||82|| śaṃkhaṃ ca sphaṭikaṃ śvetamālāṃ muktāṃ ca candanam | suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ ratnaṃ paśyantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa saḥ ||83|| gajaṃ vṛṣaṃ ca sarpaṃ ca śvetaṃ ca śvetacāmaram | nīlotpalaṃ darpaṇaṃ ca parśurāmo dadarśa ha ||84|| rathasthaṃ navaratnāḍhyaṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitam | ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ svaṃ rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ||85|| padmaśreṇīṃ padmakuṃbhaṃ dadhi lājān ghṛtaṃ madhu | parṇacchatraṃ chatriṇaṃ ca rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ||86|| bakapaṃktiṃ haṃsapaṃktiṃ kanyāpaṃktiṃ vratānvitām | pūjayantī ghaṭaṃ śubhraṃ rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ||87|| maṇḍapasthaṃ dvijagaṇaṃ pūjayantaṃ haraṃ harim | jayo’stvityuktavantaṃ taṃ rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ||88|| sudhāvṛṣṭiṃ parṇavṛṣṭiṃ phalavṛṣṭiṃ gavāgamam | puṣpacandanavṛṣṭiṃ ca rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ||89|| sadyomāṃsaṃ jīvamatsyaṃ mayūraṃ śvetakhañjanam | sarovaraṃ ca tīrthāni rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ||1.457.90|| pārāvataṃ śukaṃ cāpaṃ śaṃkhaṃ cillaṃ ca cātakam | vyāghraṃ siṃhaṃ ca surabhīṃ rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ||91 || gorocanāṃ haridrāṃ ca śukladhānyacayaṃ śubham | jvaladagniṃ tathā dūrvāṃ rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ||92|| devālayasamūhaṃ ca śivaliṃgaṃ ca pūjitam | arcitāṃ mṛnmayīṃ śaivāṃ rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ||93|| yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca | bhuktavantaṃ muhuḥ svaṃ ca rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ||94|| divyavastravibhūṣāḍhyā nārīḥ svapne sa bhuktavān | agamyāgamanaṃ svapne cakāra paraśupradhiḥ ||95|| dadarśa nartakīṃ veśyāṃ rudhiraṃ ca surāṃ papau | rudhirokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ svātmānaṃ sa dadarśa ha ||96|| pakṣiṇāṃ pītavarṇānāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ ca padmaje | māṃsāni bubhuje rāmo hṛṣṭaḥ svapne’ruṇodaye ||97|| akasmānnigaḍairbaddhaṃ kṣataṃ śastreṇa svaṃ punaḥ | dṛṣṭvaivaṃ bubughe prātaḥ samuttasthau hariṃ smaran ||98|| manasā bubudhe sarvaṃ vijeṣyāmi ripūn dhruvam | kārtavīryārjuno rātrāvaniṣṭāni dadarśa ha || 99|| tailābhyaṃgitamātmānaṃ dadarśa gardabhopari | auḍhapuṣpasya mālyaṃ ca bibhrataṃ raktacandanam || 1.457.1 00|| raktavastraparīdhānaṃ lohālaṃkārabhūṣitam | krīḍantaṃ ca hasantaṃ ca nirvāṇāṃgārarāśinā || 101 || bhasmacchannāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ jayāpuṣpānvitāṃ bhuvam | rahitaṃ candrasūryābhyāṃ raktasandhyānvitaṃ nabhaḥ || 1 02|| muktakeśāṃ ca nṛtyantīṃ vidhavāṃ chinnanāsikām | raktavastraparīdhānāṃ dadarśa cāṭṭahāsinīm || 1 03|| saśarāmagnirahitāṃ citāṃ bhasmasamanvitām | bhasmavṛṣṭimasṛgvṛṣṭimagnivṛṣṭiṃ dadarśa saḥ || 1 04|| pakvatālaphalākīrṇāṃ pṛthivīmasthisaṃbhṛtām | karparaughaṃ dadarśāpi chinnakeśanakhānvitām || 1 05|| parvatāṃ lavaṇānāṃ ca rāśībhūtaṃ kapardakam | cūrṇānāṃ caiva tailānāṃ dadarśa kandaraṃ niśi || 106 || dadarśa puṣpitaṃ vṛkṣamaśokakaravīrayoḥ | tālavṛkṣaṃ ca phalitaṃ dadarśa saḥ patatphalam || 1 07|| svakarātpūrṇakalaśaḥ papāta ca babhañja ca | dadarśāpi ca gaganāt sampatatsūryamaṇḍalam || 1 08|| evaṃ dadarśa gaganāt sampataccandramaṇḍalam | ulkāpātaṃ dhūmaketuṃ grahaṇaṃ candrasūryayoḥ || 1 09|| vikṛtākārapuruṣaṃ vikaṭāsyaṃ digambaram | āgacchantaṃ tvagratastaṃ svapne dadarśa cārjunaḥ || 1.457.11 0|| bālā dvādaśavarṣīyā vastrabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā | saṃruṣṭā yāti svagehādevaṃ svapne dadarśa saḥ || 111 || manoramā nijapatnī yācate kānanaṃ prati | gamanāyaikalā ceti svapne dadarśa cārjunaḥ || 11 2|| ruṣṭo vipro māṃ śapate sanyāsī ca yatirguruḥ | bhittau puttalikāścitrā nṛtyantīśca dadarśa saḥ || 11 3|| gṛdhraiḥ kākairmahiṣaiśca pīḍitaṃ svaṃ dadarśa saḥ | pīḍitaṃ tailayantreṇa bhrāmitaṃ tailakāriṇā || 1 14|| dhṛtaṃ nagnaiḥ pāśahastairātmānaṃ sa dadarśa ha | nṛtyanti gāyakāḥ sarve gānaṃ gāyanti me gṛhe || 1 15|| vivāhaṃ paramānandaṃ ramato lokanāyakān | keśākeśi kurvataścārjuno dadarśa vai niśi || 1 16|| dadarśa samaraṃ rātrau kākānāṃ ca śunāṃ tathā | moṭakāni ca piṇḍāni śmaśānaṃ śavasaṃyutam || 1 17|| raktavastraṃ śuklavastraṃ dadarśa cārjuno niśi | kṛṣṇāmbarā kṛṣṇavarṇā vivastrā muktamūrdhajā || 1 18|| vidhavāśliṣyati svaṃ tat svapne’rjuno dadarśa ha | nāpito muṇḍate muṇḍaṃ śmaśruśreṇīṃ ca vakṣasam || 11 9|| nakhairvidāritaṃ vakṣaḥ svapne’rjuno dadarśa ha | pādukāścarmarajjūnāṃ rāśiṃ svapne dadarśa saḥ || 1.457.1 20|| cakraṃ bhramantaṃ bhūmau ca kulālasya dadarśa saḥ | vātyayā ghūrṇamānaṃ ca śuṣkavṛkṣaṃ samutthitam || 121 || pūrṇamānaṃ kabandhaṃ ca svapne’rjuno dadarśa ha | grathitāṃ muṇḍamālāṃ ca cūrṇyamānā tu vātyayā || 122|| atīva ghoradaśanān bhūtapretān bhayaṃkarān | hutāśanaṃ vamataśca svapne’rjuno dadarśa ha || 1 23|| dagdhajīvaṃ dagdhavṛkṣaṃ vyādhigrastaṃ naraṃ param | aṃgahīnaṃ ca vṛṣalaṃ svapne’rjuno dadarśa ha || 1 24|| kuhaparvatavṛkṣāṇāṃ sahasā patanaṃ tathā | muhurmuhurvajrapātaṃ svapne’rjuno dadarśa ha || 125|| kukkurāṇāṃ śṛgālānāṃ muhuḥ śuśrāva rodanam | adhaḥśīrṣamūrdhvapādaṃ muktakeśaṃ digambaram || 126|| bhūmau bhramantaṃ gacchantaṃ dadarśa cārjuno niśi | vikṛtadhvaniśandaṃ ca grāmāgre devarodanam || 1 27|| śrutvā prātarjajāgāra kārtavīryārjuno nṛpaḥ | kṣuvam̐śca śayanād yātaḥ praskhalan svapativratām || 128|| manoramāṃ niśi dṛṣṭaduṣṭasvapnātiduḥkhitām | satī sādhvī priyā nāthaṃ patiṃ dṛṣṭvā pativratā || 1 29|| siṣeve tvantimāṃ sevāṃ kroḍe kṛtvā patiṃ svakam | śataputrādhikaḥ premṇā satīnāṃ vai patiryataḥ || 1.457.13 0|| kintu duṣṭāpaśakunairjñātvā bhāvivināśanam | patirme śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃśena dvijena vai || 131 || yoddhuṃ yāti ca vijñāya prāṇān sarvān niruddhya sā | ṣaṭacakrāṇi bhedayitvā brahmarandhraṃ jagāma sā || 1 32|| tvaritaṃ divyarūpā sā satīlokaṃ tu prāg yayau | athārjuno yayau yoddhuṃ dadarśāmaṃgalāni saḥ || 133 || satī divyaśarīreṇa svāminā saha saṅgaram | rathamāruhya pārśvasthādṛśyā sahacarī yayau || 1 34|| dadarśa dvāri vidhavāṃ chinnanāsāṃ kurūpiṇīm | arjunaḥ kṛṣṇavastrāḍhyāṃ rudatīṃ muṇḍinīṃ khalām || 1 35|| mukhaduṣṭāṃ yoniduṣṭāṃ vyādhiyuktāṃ ca kuṭṭinīm | patiputravihīnāṃ cāparāṃ dadarśa puṃścalīm || 136 || kuṃbhakāraṃ tailakāraṃ vyādhaṃ sarpopajīvinam | kucailamatirūkṣāṃgaṃ nagnaṃ kāṣāyavāsasam || 1 37|| citādagdhaṃ śavaṃ bhasma nirvāṇāṃgāramityapi | vasāvikrayiṇaṃ cāpi kanyāvikrayiṇaṃ tathā || 1 38|| sarpakṣataṃ naraṃ sarpaṃ godhāṃ ca śaśakaṃ viṣam | śrāddhapākaṃ ca piṇḍaṃ ca moṭakaṃ ca tilāṃstathā || 1 39|| śūdrānnabhojakaṃ vipraṃ devalaṃ grāmayājakam | kuśaputtalikāṃ caiva śavadāhanakāriṇam || 1.457.140|| śūnyakuṃbhaṃ bhagnakuṃbhaṃ tailaṃ lavaṇamasthi ca | kārpāsaṃ kacchapaṃ cūrṇaṃ kukkuraṃ śabdakāriṇam || 141 || dakṣiṇe tu śṛgālaṃ ca kurvantaṃ bhairavaṃ ravam | kapardakaṃ ca kṣauraṃ ca chinnakeśaṃ nakhaṃ malam || 142|| kalahaṃ ca vilāpaṃ ca tathā kleśakaraṃ janam | amaṃgalaṃ rudantaṃ ca rudantaṃ śokinaṃ janam || 143|| mithyāsākṣyapradātāraṃ cauraṃ ca naraghātinam | puṃścalīpatiputrau ca puṃścalyodanabhakṣakam || 144|| devatāguruviprāṇāṃ vastuvittāpahārakam | dattāpahāriṇaṃ dasyuṃ hiṃsakaṃ sūcakaṃ khalam || 145|| pitṛmātṛviraktaṃ ca dvijāśvatthavighātinam | satyaghnaṃ ca kṛtaghnaṃ ca kṣataṃ viśvāsaghātinam || 146|| gurudevadvijānāṃ ca nindakaṃ svāgahīnakam | napuṃsakaṃ kuṣṭhinaṃ ca kāṇaṃ badhiramityapi || 147|| pulkasa chinnaliṃgaṃ ca khalvāṭaṃ śmaśruhīnakam | surāmattaṃ surāṃ raṇḍāmuṣṭera mahiṣagardabha1 || 148|| kṣiptaṃ vamantaṃ rudhiraṃ lūkaṃ kākaṃ dadarśa saḥ | mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ śleṣmāṇaṃ rūkṣiṇaṃ nṛkapālakam || 149|| caṇḍavātaṃ raktavṛṣṭiṃ kuvādyaṃ vṛkṣapātanam | vṛkaṃ ca sūkara gṛdhraṃ śyenaṃ kaṃkaṃ ca bhallukam || 1.457.150 || nigaḍaṃ śuṣkakāṣṭhaṃ ca vāyasaṃ gandhakaṃ tathā | abhicāropajīvaṃ kuvaidya tuṣaṃ tathauṣadham || 151 || raktapuṣpaṃ mṛtavārtā vipraśāpaṃ kṣuvaṃ tathā | yaṣṭimukuṭapatanaṃ kārtavīryo dadarśa ha || 152|| vāmāṃgaspandanaṃ dehajāḍya rathāśvapaścanam | rathacakrakrūrarāvo hṛdi trāsaśca jajñire || 153|| tathāpi rājā niḥśaṃkaḥ praviveśa raṇājiram | praṇamya paraśurāmaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau dhanam || 154|| raṇatūryāṇyavādyanta sannāho’bhūcca sainyayoḥ | parśurāmo’rjunamāha nyāyyaṃ yat sarvaśpṛṇvatām || 155|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kāmadhenuharaṇamiṣegā jamadagnināśaḥ, reṇukāyāḥ satītvaṃ, parśurāmasya śakarāt śrīkṛṣṇamantrakavacastotralābhaḥ, svapne jāgaraṇe parśurāmasya śakunāni, sahasrārjunasyāpaśakunāni, pativratāyāḥ manoramāyāḥ pātivratyena satītvaṃ, raṇāgamaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptapañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||457||
<1.458> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mādhavāṃśaḥ parśurāma uvāca tam | kārtavīrya raṇamadhye dharmabhṛtaṃ vaco yathā || 1 || śṛṇu rājendra dharmiṣṭha candravaṃśasamudbhava | viṣṇoraṃśasya śiṣyastvaṃ dattātreyasya dhīmataḥ || 2 || kathe durbuddhimāptastvamahano vṛddhabhūsuram | brāhmaṇī śokasantaptā bhartrā sārdhe gatā satī || 3 || kiṃ bhaviṣyati te bhūpa paratraivānayorvadhāt | kva gatā kapilā sā te kīdṛk kūlaṃ bhaviṣyati || 4 || yat kṛtaṃ tu tvayā rājan hāliko na kariṣyati | satkīrtiścātha duṣkīrtiḥ kathāmātrāvaśeṣitā || 5 || tvayā kṛto ghoratarastvanyāyastatphalaṃ labha | uttaraṃ dehi rājendra samāje raṇamūrdhani || 6 || kārtavīryārjunaḥ śrutvā pravaktumupacakrame | śṛṇu rāma hareraṃśastvamapyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 7 || sadbuddhyā karmaṇā brahmabhāvanāṃ karoti yaḥ | svadharmanirataḥ śuddho brāhmaṇaḥ sa prakīrtyate || 8 || antarbahiśca mananāt kurute phaladāṃ kriyām | maunī śaśvad vadet kāle hitakṛnmunirucyate || 9 || svarṇe loṣṭe gṛhe’raṇye paṃke susnigdhacandane | rāmavṛttiḥ samabhāvo yogī yathārtha ucyate || 1.458.1 0|| sarvajīveṣu yo viṣṇuṃ bhāvayet samatādhiyā | harau karoti bhaktiṃ ca haribhaktaḥ sa ucyate || 11 || tapodhanaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ munīnāṃ yogināṃ tathā | haribhaktasya viprasya tapasyāḥ kāmadhenavaḥ || 1 2|| kṣatriyāṇāṃ sadaiśvarye spṛhā ratneṣu sarvadā | kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu tapasi spṛhātīvāpraśaṃsitā || 13 || brāhmaṇānāṃ vivāde ca spṛhātīva vininditā | rāgī rājasikaṃ kāryaṃ kurute karmarāgataḥ || 14|| rāgāndho yo rājasikastena rājā prakīrtyate | rāgataḥ kāmadhenustu mayā vai yācitā mune || 15|| tava pitrā tu sainyāni kṛtānyayaṃ vyatikramaḥ | kṛta eva vada vipra ko doṣo rāgiṇo’tra me || 16 || triṃśadakṣauhiṇīsenā hatyā nāśayituṃ ca mām | udyatasya tu hanane na doṣo hyātatāyinaḥ || 17|| tvaṃ cāpi tāpaso bhūtvā vipradharmavivarjitām | pratijñāṃ kṛtavān so’yamanyāyaḥ kiṃ na me vada || 18|| pitrordvayoḥ kṛte tvaṃ tu kartuṃ pṛthvīṃ niḥkṣatriyām | triḥsaptakṛtvo yattat kiṃ nyāyyaṃ vada bhūsuraḥ || 1 9|| iti śrutvā garvavākyaṃ parśurāmātiruḍbharaḥ | kṣaṇāt ṭaṃkārayitvā svaṃ dhanurmumoca sāyakān || 1.458.20|| bāṇaughaiśchādayāmāsārjunaṃ rathaṃ tathāmbaram | manoramā sthitā divyā rathe pativratā satī ||2 1 || mahālakṣmīyutā devī rarakṣa svapatiṃ tadā | tāvad rājāpi bāṇaughām̐ściccheda nijasāyakaiḥ ||22|| rāmasya bhrātaraḥ sarve catvāro’nye praśiṣyakāḥ | nijaghnurarjunasainyaṃ tīkṣṇaśastrāsipāṇayaḥ ||23 || śarajālena rājendro vārayāmāsa tānapi | cicchiduḥ śarajālaṃ ca jamadagnisutāstadā ||24|| rājā cikṣepa divyāstraṃ munayaścicchidustu tat | divyāstreṇaiva munayaścicchiduḥ saśaraṃ dhanuḥ ||25|| rathaṃ ca sārathiṃ caiva rājñaḥ sannāhamityapi | manoramā divyarūpā rarakṣa svapatiṃ satī ||26|| nyastraśastraṃ nṛpaṃ dṛṣṭvā munayo harṣavihvalāḥ | jagṛhuḥ śūlinaḥ śūlaṃ matsyarājajighāṃsayā ||27|| śūlanikṣepasamaye vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī | śūlaṃ tyajata viprendrā śivasyāvyarthameva tat ||28|| śivasya kavacaṃ divyaṃ sarvāvayavarakṣakam | matsyarājagale’styetat kavacaṃ yācata nṛpam ||29|| śrutvā rāmo yatirbhūtvā yayāce kavacaṃ nṛpam | rājā dadau tu kavacaṃ brahmāṇḍavijaye tataḥ |||1.458.3 0|| rāmo jaghāna śūlena mūrchāṃ jagāma cārjunaḥ | manoramā satī satyavratena yogasiddhibhiḥ |||3 1 || svasvāmihastadā prāṇān mūrghni rarakṣa bhāminī | sā tadākāśavat sādhvī samuvāca nṛpān satī |||32|| bṛhadbalaṃ somadattaṃ vidarbhaṃ mithileśvaram | niṣadhādhipatiṃ cāpi magadhādhipatiṃ tathā ||33|| praśṛṇvantu prāṇatulyāḥ prāṇasya me’vanaṃ tvaham | karomi yātu bhavanto raṇaṃ kurvantu colbaṇam ||34|| kṣatriyāṇāṃ raṇo dharmo raṇe mṛtyurna garhitaḥ | raṇe svāhā brāhmaṇānāṃ loke vede viḍambanā ||35|| kṣatriyāṇāṃ balaṃ śastraṃ vyāpārastu balaṃ viśām | bhikṣābalaṃ bhikṣukāṇāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ sevanaṃ balam ||36|| bhaktirdāsyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe bhaktabalaṃ hariḥ | tapo balaṃ tāpasānāṃ duṣṭānāṃ hiṃsanaṃ balam ||37|| balaṃ veṣastu nārīṇāṃ yauvanaṃ gṛhayoṣitām | balaṃ sainyaṃ nṛpāṇāṃ vai vālānāṃ rodanaṃ balam ||38|| satāṃ satyaṃ balaṃ bhaktiḥ sādhūnāṃ tu balaṃ kṣamā | mithyā balaṃ cāsatāṃ tu dhairyaṃ sāhasināṃ balam ||39|| vidyā balaṃ paṇḍitānāṃ dhanaṃ tu dhanināṃ balam | balaṃ vivekaḥ śreṣṭhānāṃ prajānāṃ balamekatā ||1.458.40|| guṇo balaṃ tu guṇināṃ satīnāṃ patisevanam | pūjā devabalaṃ proktaṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ gurusevanam ||41 || balaṃ patnī gṛhasthānāṃ bhṛtyānāṃ svāmitoṣaṇam | tyāgināṃ nispṛhatvaṃ tu balaṃ brahmavrataṃ mahat ||42|| puṇyaṃ balaṃ sukṛtīnāṃ jalajānāṃ jalaṃ balam | śāntirbalaṃ tu viprāṇāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ balaṃ balam ||43|| sasainyāḥ kṣatriyāḥ sarve yuddhaṃ kurvantu bhūsuraiḥ | ityuktvā sā satī manoramārjunaṃ vimūrchitam ||44|| paricacāra vividhairupacāraiḥ suśaktidaiḥ | yadyahaṃ prāṇanāthasya pativratāsmi sarvathā ||45|| prāpnotu cetanāṃ svāmī samuvāca pativratā | tāvat sa cetanāṃ prāptaḥ samutthito raṇāya ca ||46|| atha rāmastriśūlena somadattaṃ jaghāna ha | bṛhadbālaṃ tu gadayā vidarbhaṃ tomareṇa ca ||47|| maithilāṃ mudgareṇāpi śaktyā tu naiṣadhaṃ tathā | māgadhaṃ tīkṣṇanārācairastrajālaiśca sainyakān ||48|| nihatya nikhilān bhūpān dudrāva cārjunaṃ prati | tāvat satī samīpasthā manoramā vyavasthitā ||49|| rāmarāmādhamavipra bhasmībhūto bhaviṣyasi | yadi tvanyāyamālambya mannāthaṃ mārayiṣyasi ||1.458.50 || śrutvā satīṃ puro dṛṣṭvā bhayād rāmo nyavartata | kānyakubjāḥ śataśastu saurāṣṭrāḥ śataśastathā ||51 || rāṣṭrīyāḥ śataśaścāpi mahārāṣṭrāśca vaṃgajāḥ | gaurjarāśca kaliṃgāśca rāmeṇa vyasavaḥ kṛtāḥ ||52|| dvādaśākṣauhiṇīḥ rāmo jaghāna tridivāniśam | tāvadrājā kārtavīryaḥ śrīlakṣmīkavacaṃ kare ||53|| baddhvā śastrāstrasampanno rathamāruhya cāyayau | yuyudhe vividhairastrairjaghāna brāhmaṇān bahūn ||54||| parśurāmaḥ saparaśurdadhāva kālarūpadhṛk | śiro nikṛntituṃ tāvad viṣṇurviprasvarūpadhṛk ||55|| mā yāhīti karaṃ dhṛtvā rurodha prāha tatkṣaṇam | kavacaṃ śrīmahālakṣmyā bāhau tena dhṛtaṃ yataḥ ||56|| na mariṣyati bhūpālo yayāce taṃ sthiro bhava | viṣṇurviprasvarūpastad yācituṃ nṛpamāyayau ||57|| vipro bhūtvā ca kavacaṃ yayāce bhagavān svayam | manoramā tadā trāsaprāpede patipakṣiṇī ||58|| arjuno ditsati tāvanmanoramā nyavārayat | rājan lakṣmīkavacaṃ te bāhau yāvaddhi vartate |||59|| tāvallakṣmīsvarūpāhaṃ śaknomi tvāṃ prarakṣitum | mā dehīti muhuḥ proktastathāpi pradadau nṛpaḥ ||1.458.60|| kṣaṇaṃ manoramālakṣmīḥ patiṃ natvā ruroda vai | athāśaktā kavacena samaṃ yātuṃ ca tatparā ||6 1 || abhūd viṣṇuparīkṣāṃ ca karoti sma tadā satī | viṣṇuḥ kavacamādāya rāmaṃ prati samāyayau ||62|| dadau samantraṃ paraśurāmāya tacchṛṇu priye | oṃ śrīkamalavāsinyai svāhā mantraṃ dadau tataḥ ||6 3 || prajāpatiḥ ṛṣiryasya chandaśca bṛhatī tathā | devī padmālayā yasya caturvargaṃ niyojanam ||64|| oṃ śrīkamalavāsinyai svāhā me pātu mastakam | oṃ śrī kapālaṃ me pātu locane śrīṃśriyai namaḥ ||65|| oṃ śrīṃśriyai svāheti vai karṇayugmaṃ sadāvatu | oṃ śrīṃ klīṃ mahālakṣmyai svāhā me pātu nāsikām ||66|| oṃ śrīṃ padmālayāyai ca svāhā dantān sadāvatu | auśrīṃ kṛṣṇapriyāyai ca dantarandhrān sadāvatu ||67|| oṃ śrīnārāyaṇeśāyai mama kaṇṭhaṃ sadāvatu | oṃ śrīṃ keśavakāntāyai mama skandhaṃ sadāvatu ||68|| oṃ śrīṃ padmanivāsinyai svāhā nābhiṃ sadāvatu | oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ saṃsāramātre mama vakṣaḥ sadāvatu ||69|| oṃ śrīṃmo kṛṣṇakāntāyai svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ sadāvatu | oṃ hrīṃśrīṃśriyai svāhā ca mama hasto sadāvatu ||1.458.70|| oṃ śrīnivāsakāntāyai mama pādau sadāvatu | oṃ śrīṃhrīṃklīṃ śriyai svāhā sarvāṃgaṃ me sadāvatu ||71 || prācyāṃ pātu mahālakṣmīrāgneyyāṃ kamalālayā | padmā māṃ dakṣiṇe pātu nairṛtyāṃ śrīharipriyā ||72|| padmālayā paścime māṃ vāyavyāṃ pātu mā svayam | uttare kamalā pātu caiśānyāṃ sindhukanyakā ||73|| nārāyaṇī ca pātūrdhvamadho viṣṇupriyāvatu | santataṃ sarvataḥ pātu viṣṇuprāṇādhikā mama ||74|| itisarvaiśvaryapradaṃ varma bāhau sudhāraya | devendraiścāsurendraiścāvadhyo bhavasi niścitam ||75|| ityuktvā kavacaṃ datvā yayau vaikuṇṭhamacyutaḥ | tāvanmanoramā lakṣmīkalārjunaṃ vihāya vai ||76|| yayau tu viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ viṣṇunā hṛtā | arjunaḥ prāha re patni tyaktvā māṃ yāhi mā priye ||77|| manoramā tu taṃ prāha sambandhaḥ sāntatāṃ gataḥ | paraśurāmaśastreṇa hato māmanuyāsyasi ||78|| śīghraṃ brāhmaṇahastena hataḥ prāpsyasi mokṣaṇam | vaikuṇṭhaṃ tvatkṛte rājan niścitaṃ yatra me sthitiḥ ||79|| ityuktvā sā yayau devī rājā yuyodha dāruṇam | dvilakṣasainyaṃ yuyudhe brāhmaṇaiḥ saha padmaje ||1.458.80|| rājā cikṣepa śastrāṇi rāmaśiṣyāḥ palāyitāḥ | cikṣepa rāmastvāgneyaṃ babhūvāgnimayaṃ raṇe ||81 || nirvāpayāmāsa rājā vāruṇena mahaujasā | cikṣepa rāmo gāndharvaṃ śailasarpādikoṭikam ||82|| vāyavenārjunastadvai vārayāmāsa dāruṇam | cikṣepa rāmo nāgāstraṃ rājā cikṣepa gāruḍam ||83|| rāmaścikṣepa māheśaṃ rājā cikṣepa vaiṣṇavam | brahmāstraṃ cikṣipe rāmo rājā brahmāstramākṣipat ||84|| tāvat dhyāto’rjunagururdattātreyaḥ samāgataḥ | dadau śūlaṃ hi rāmasya nāśārthaṃ kṛṣṇavarma ca ||85|| jagrāha rājā śūlaṃ taścikṣepa rāmakandhare | mūrchāmavāpa rāmaḥ saḥ papāta śrīhariṃ smaran ||86|| brāhmaṇaṃ jīvayāmāsa śaṃbhurnārāyaṇājñayā | cetanāṃ prāpya ca rāmo’grahīt pāśupataṃ yadā ||87|| dattātreyeṇa dattena siddhāstreṇārjunastu tam | jaḍīcakāra tatraiva stambhito rāma eva vai ||88|| śrīkṛṣṇarakṣitaṃ bhūpaṃ dadarśa kṛṣṇavarma ca | dadarśāpi bhramatsudarśanaṃ rakṣākaraṃ ripoḥ ||89|| etasminnantare tatra vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī | kṛṣṇasya kavacaṃ rājño bāhāvasti taduttamam ||1.458.90|| rakṣati tannṛpaṃ śaṃbhuryācatu bhikṣayā tu tat | tadā hantuṃ nṛpaṃ śakto bhārgavo’yaṃ bhaviṣyati ||91 || atha śaṃbhuḥ siddhamantrairdatvā cetanameva tu | apohya staṃbhanaṃ rāmo jagrāha paraśuṃ svakam ||92|| pāśupataṃ kare dhṛtvā paraśuṃ ca tathā kare | sasmāra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tāvat sa āyayau ||93|| śaṃbhurvipraḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā yayāce’rjunameva tat | kavacaṃ nṛpasaṃdattaṃ rāmāya śaṃbhurārpayat ||94|| sudarśanaṃ ca kavacaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastrayaḥ | rāmapārśve samāgatya prāhurjeṣyasi sāmpratam ||95|| śaṃbhoḥ pāśupataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ harereva sudarśanam | ete pradhāne sarveṣāmastrāṇāṃ tu jagattraye ||96 || kavacaṃ rakṣakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dhārayitvāha taṃ dvijaḥ | rājan kuru raṇaṃ śīghraṃ kālabhede jayājayau ||97|| tvayādhītaṃ bahudattaṃ śāsitā ca vasundharā | saṃgrāme’haṃ tvayā jaḍīkṛto’traiva sumūrchitaḥ ||98|| jitāḥ sarve’pi bhūpālā rāvaṇo līlayā jitaḥ | jito’haṃ dattaśūlena śaṃbhunā jīvito’smyaham ||99|| śīghraṃ kuru kṣaṇaste’yaṃ śrutvaivaṃ pratyuvāca saḥ | aho rāma kimadhītaṃ ki dattaṃ kā ca śāsitā || 1.458.1 00|| gatāḥ katividhā bhūpā macchreṣṭhāḥ kālabhakṣitāḥ | buddhistejo vikramaśca jayaśca vijayastathā ||1 01| śrīraiśvaryaṃ matirdānaṃ pratiṣṭhā paramaṃ tapaḥ | vidyā garvastathā mānyaṃ sārvabhaumatvamityapi || 1 02|| sarvaṃ manoramāsaṃge gatameva mama kṣaṇāt | sā ca lakṣmī kalā sādhvī pātivratyaparāyaṇā || 1 03|| mṛtā yāvad rakṣikā me tayā sārdhaṃ gataṃ mama | tvaṃ kiṃ vipra prathamaṃ vai yuddhaṃ paśyasi kevalam || 1 04|| mama yuddhāni pūrvāṇi nekṣitānīti śocanā | prathamātha dvitīyāpi maraṇaṃ brāhmaṇena me || 1 05|| vṛddhadampatīnāśena śocanā cātiniṣṭhurā | kāle siṃhaḥ śṛgālaṃ ca sṛgālaḥ siṃhameva vā || 1 06|| kāle vyāghraṃ hanti mṛgo gajendraṃ hariṇastathā | mahiṣaṃ makṣikā kāle garuḍaṃ ca tathoragaḥ || 1 07|| nṛpaśca kiṃkaraṃ stauti mahendro mānavaṃ tathā | sarvaṃ kālakṛtaṃ vipra kālo hi duratikramaḥ || 1 08|| brāhmaṇasya ca hananaṃ sarvaṃ nāśakaraṃ mama | pativratāyā maraṇaṃ brāhmaṇīnāśakṛtphalam || 1 09|| pativratāyā maraṇe mṛto’haṃ sarvathā dvija | lakṣmīrūpā mṛtā prāgvai saṃketo’cyutakṛddhi saḥ || 1.458.110 || yāce tvāṃ ca tathā devān gurūn sarvāṃśca bhāvataḥ | kṣamadhvaṃ cāparādhānye mā bhūnme nārakaṃ puraḥ || 111 || ityuktvā ca dhanuṣṭaṃkārayitvā sāyakān muhuḥ | kālakāla iva bhūtvā vavarṣa lakṣaśo bahūn || 11 2|| kṛṣṇakṛṣṇavadan rājā manorameti saṃvadan | ardhacandrām̐stathā śaktīrbhallān khaḍgān sahasraśaḥ || 113| cikṣepa dhanuṣā tatra brāhmaṇeṣvāyuṣaḥkṣaye | rāmo rūpadvayaṃ kṛtvā yuyudhe tena bhūbhṛtā || 1 14|| kṛtrimeṇa tu rūpeṇa dhṛtvā kuṭhārakaṃ kare | dadhāva taṃ puro gatvā ciccheda bhujamaṇḍalam || 1 15|| dvitīyena svarūpeṇa jagrāhāstraṃ maholbaṇam | pāśupataṃ samantraṃ ca cikṣepa līlayā nṛpe || 1 16|| hāhākāro mahānāsīt kārtavīryārjuno hataḥ | anye ye jīvasaṃgrāhāste’pa viprairhatā raṇe || 1 17|| vidudruvustathā cānye svasvarājyāni cakrire | māhiṣmatīṃ tadā rāmo dadau viprāya dakṣiṇām || 1 18|| anyeṣāṃ cāpi rājyāni dadau viprāya dakṣiṇāḥ | devāśca munayo devyaḥ siddhagandharvakinnarāḥ || 11 9|| sarve cakruḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ rāmamūrdhni ca padmaje | svarge dundubhayo nedurharṣaśabdo babhūva ha ||1.458.1 20|| evaṃ triḥsaptakṛtvaśca cakre pṛthvīṃ niḥkṣatriyām | yaśasā cāpi paraśurāmasyāpūritaṃ jagat || 121 || brāhmaṇebhyo dadau rāmo rājyāni virarāma ca | hatāstu kṣatriyāḥ sarve garbhasthā bālakāstathā || 1 22|| yuvāno jaraṭhā vṛddhāḥ stanaṃdhayā api priye | kāścana kṣatriyanāryaḥ pātivratyaparāyaṇāḥ || 123 || devyo divyagatikāśca guptā yayurhimālayam | kandarāsu vasantyaśca pupuṣurbālakān svakān || 1 24|| tadvaṃśāḥ kṣatriyā jātāḥ punā rājyāni cakrire | parśurāmaḥ pratijñāṃ svāṃ pūrayitvā kurusthale || 1 25|| syamantapañcakān kuṇḍān kṣatriyarudhirāñcitān | kṛtvā raktaiḥ piturmāturbrāhmaṇānāṃ jalāṃjalīn || 126 || śrāddhaṃ dadau tadā tṛptiṃ cakāra pitṛdevatāḥ | tato jalaṃ tathānnaṃ ca bubhuje śāntitaḥ svayam || 1 27|| kṣatriyāṇāṃ vināśe tu nirbalā ye hyasupriyāḥ | mṛṣā vadanto jīvānāṃ cakrurvai rakṣaṇaṃ tu te || 1 28|| anyā anyā jātayaśca jātā varṇā vibhinnakāḥ | akṣātrāste kṣātrakarmahīnā dasyava eva vai || 1 29|| vyāpārakārakāścānye dāsyakṛṣyādikārakāḥ | vartante sma bhuvi lakṣmi guptakṣatriyajātayaḥ || 1.458.13 0|| atha pratijñāṃ sampūrṇāṃ kṛtvā rāmo yayau gurum | śivaṃ pūjayituṃ divye kailāse tatra gopure || 131 || gaṇeśena niruddhaḥ saḥ krudhā gaṇapatiṃ tadā | rāmo jaghāna dante taṃ parśunā tu gaṇādhipam || 13 2|| danto bhagnastataścaikadanto gaṇeśa ucyate | āmūlād bhagnadantena kṛtvā śūṇḍhaṃ sudīrghakam || 1 33|| gaṇeśena dhṛtaḥ śūṇḍhe śūṇḍhaśca vardhito bahuḥ | trailokye bhrāmayitvā taṃ rāmaṃ cikṣepa vāridhau || 1 34|| jaḍībhūtaṃ punardhṛtvā goloke vinipātitaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāṃbhoje pātakānāṃ viśuddhaye || 1 35|| tataḥ śuddhaṃ kṛtaṃ rāmamutthāpya śrīgaṇeśvaraḥ | cikṣepa paraśurāmaṃ śaṃkarasya hi sannidhau || 1 36|| dadarśa śaṃkaraṃ prāpyāśīrvādaṃ cāpyanugraham | śaṃkarasya śivāyāśca prasādya śrīgaṇeśvaram || 1 37|| cakre stutiṃ śivaṃ śivāṃ taṃ tu śivāha maṃgalam | amaro bhava he putra vatsa susthiratāṃ vraja || 1 38|| sarvaprasādāt sarvatra jayo’stu tava santatam | sarvāntarātmā bhagavām̐stuṣṭaḥ syāt santataṃ hariḥ || 1 39|| bhaktirbhavatu te kṛṣṇe śivade ca śive gurau | śaṃbhuḥ prāha sadā śiṣya ciraṃjīvo bhava dhruvaḥ || 1.458.140 || tataḥ paraśurāmo’sau jagāma tapase bhuvam | mahendraparvate sthitvā tapaḥ karoti śāśvatam || 141 || iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi kārtavīryasya nāśanam | manoramāyāḥ kathitaṃ pativratabalaṃ tathā || 142|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya patisevābalaṃ labhet | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ kṛṣṇasevāṃ labhet kṛṣṇaprasādataḥ || 143 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne parśurāmeṇa saha yuddhe manoramayā divyayā pativratayā sahasrārjuno rakṣitaḥ, lakṣmīkavacaviyoge manoramāviyogastato’rjunasya maraṇaṃ, gaṇeśasyaikadantatvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭapaṃcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 458 ||
<1.459> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca indralokātpare tvarciṣmatīnāmnī śubhā purī | vītihotrasya nagarī svargottame’sti padmaje || 1 || jātavedasi yā bhaktāstā vasantyatra suvratāḥ | agnipraveśaṃ yāḥ kuryurdṛḍhasattvā jitendriyāḥ || 2 || vahnisnānā narā nāryaḥ sarvāstā vahnibhāsurāḥ | agnihotraratā viprāstathāgnibrahmacāriṇaḥ || 3 || pañcāgnivratino bhaktā brāhmaṇāścāgnipūjakāḥ | samididhmāgniṣṭikānāṃ dātāro vahnirūpiṇaḥ || 4 || yajñasya kāriṇo vahnerarciṣmatyāṃ vasanti vai | dhūpapradīpanaivedyapayodadhighṛtaikṣavam || 5 || vahnibhuktaṃ niṣevante sarvavidhā divaukasaḥ | viśvānarasya viprasya narmadātaṭavāsinaḥ || 6 || narmapurādhidevasya brahmayajñaratasya ca | brahmatejasaḥ śāṇḍilyagotrasyābhūt sucintanam || 7 || caturṇṇāmapyāśrayāṇāṃ ko’tīva śreyase satām | iti vicārya gārhasthyaṃ viśvānaraḥ śaśaṃsa ha || 8 || sarvādhāro gṛhastho vai dehibhirupajīvyate | paradāraparityāgāt svadāraparituṣṭitaḥ || 9 || ṛtukālābhigāmitvād brahmacārī gṛhī sadā | evaṃ niścitya sa viśvānaro vipraḥ pativratām || 1.459.10 || uduvāhavidhānena svocitāṃ kulakanyakām | agniśuśrūṣaṇarataḥ pañcayajñaparāyaṇaḥ || 11 || devapitratithyanāthagavādiparipūjakaḥ | evaṃ vai vartamānasya kālo bahutitho gataḥ || 1 2|| bhāryā śuciṣmatī nāma suvratā svāmisevikā | apaśyantyaṃkuramapi santateḥ svargasādhanam || 13 || patiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ patiṃ viṣṇuṃ matvovāca pativratā | bhagavan durlabhaṃ nāsti kiñcittava dayālavāt || 14|| maheśasadṛśaṃ putraṃ dehi vaṃśavivardhanam | śrutvā provāca tāṃ patnīmekapatnīvrate sthitaḥ || 1 5|| tathāstviti tato vipro jagāma tapase drutam | prāpya vārāṇasīṃ snātvā gaṃgāyāṃ vīkṣya śaṃkaram || 16 || yatra niścalatāmeti tapastanayakāmyayā | tatra vīreśvarabhūmau gatvā jagrāha sadvratam || 1 7|| ekāhāro’bhavanmāsaṃ māsaṃ naktāśano’bhavat | ayācitāśano māsaṃ māsaṃ tyaktāśanastathā || 18|| payovrato’bhavanmāsaṃ māsaṃ śākaphalāśanaḥ | māsaṃ muṣṭitilāhāro māsaṃ pānīyabhojanaḥ || 1 9|| pañcagavyāśano māsaṃ māsaṃ cāndrāyaṇavratī | māsaṃ kuśāgrajalabhuk māsaṃ śvasanabhakṣaṇaḥ || 1.459.20 || atha trayodaśe māse snātvā gaṃgājale dvijaḥ | pratyūṣa eva vīreśaṃ yāvadāyāti bhūsuraḥ || 21 || tāvalliṃgāntare bālaṃ dadarśāṣṭasamaṃ śubham | piṃgajaṭaṃ dīrghanetraṃ śvetaṃ vibhūtibhūṣitam ||22|| tamālokya stutiṃ cakre viśvānaro’timodavān | ekamevādvitīyaṃ yat paraṃbrahma parātparam || 23 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasaṃjñaṃ śivadaṃ śiva te namaḥ | kartṛ poṣṭṛ ca saṃhartṛ tejo vividhatāṃ gatam || 24|| yanmūrterekabhāgasthamaiśvaryaṃ jvalanādikam | saurabhyādi yato bhūmau tasmai bālāya te namaḥ | |25| | yad gṛhītṛ gantṛ draṣṭṛ dhātṛ niyantṛ cāntaram | sarvakāmapradātṛ tat tasmai bālāya te namaḥ | | 26 | | stutveti pādayostasya viśvānaraḥ papāta ha | bālo varaṃ vṛṇīhīti provāca hasitānanaḥ || 27| | viśvānaraḥ pratyuvāca bhavān sarvaprado yataḥ | putraṃ dehi tvādṛśaṃ te praṇato’smi punaḥ punaḥ | | 28 || bālaḥ prāha tathāstvityacireṇa te manorathaḥ | śuciṣmatyāmahaṃ putro bhaviṣyāmi phaliṣyati || 2 9|| khyāto gṛhapatirnāmnā śuciḥ sarvāmarapriyaḥ | tava putro bhaviṣyāmītyuktvā cāntaradhīyata || 1.459.30 || viśvānarastatastūrṇamājagāma nijaṃ gṛham | śuciṣmatyai jagādaitat svalpakālena bhāminī || 31 || garbhaṃ dadhāra suṣuve kālena putrameva sā | garbhādhānādayaḥ sarve saṃskārā guruṇā kṛtāḥ || 3 2|| putrajanmani devādyā vavṛṣuḥ kusumādikān | devadundubhayo neduḥ protsavo hyabhavanmahān || 33 || apsarasāṃ sunṛtyāni tvabhavan vipramandire | vidyādharyaśca kinnaryastathāmaryaḥ sahasraśaḥ || 34|| gandharvoragavṛkṣāṇāṃ suvāsinyaśca kanyakāḥ | maṇiratnopadā nītvā saśṛṃgārasuśobhanāḥ | 3 5|| savādyā maṃgalavastusahitāścandrasatprabhāḥ | gāyanto lalitaṃ gītaṃ jagmurviśvānaragṛham || 36 || marīcādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca śataśo’pi tu tadgṛham | lokapālā munayaśca samājagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ || 37|| viṣṇvādyāśca surāḥ sarve nāgāśca mānavādayaḥ | tīrthakṣetrāṇi sarvāṇi cājagmuḥ pitarastathā || 38 || sthāvarā jaṃgamaṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvāyātāḥ sahasraśaḥ | jātakarma svayaṃ cakre tasya devaḥ pitāmahaḥ || 39 || śrutiṃ vicārya tadrūpāṃ nāmnā gṛhapatistvayam | iti nāma dadau tasmai deyamekādaśe’hani ||1.459.40 || gṛhapatirgārhapatyaḥ prajāyā vasuvittamaḥ | agne gṛhapate āyacchasvānnaṃ me yaśo balam ||4 1 || ajo nāma itikṛtvā stutvā satyaṃ yayau tataḥ | devādyāstu yayuḥ sarve śaṃsantaḥ putramujvalam ||42 || ataḥ putraṃ samīhante gṛhasthāśramavāsinaḥ | putreṇa lokān jayati bhaktenāpi viśeṣataḥ ||43 || aputrasya gṛhaṃ śūnyamaputrasyārjanaṃ vṛthā | aputrasyānvayaśchinno nāpavitraṃ hyaputrataḥ ||44| | na putrātparamo lābho na putrātparamaṃ sukham | na putrātparamaṃ mitraṃ paratreha ca kutracit ||45|| aurasaḥ kṣetrajaḥ krīto dattaḥ prāptaḥ sutāsutaḥ | āpatsu rakṣitaḥ śiṣyaḥ putrāste tvaṣṭadhā matāḥ ||46 || viśvānaraḥ sutaṃ tvadhyāpayāmāsa yathocitam | navame vatsare vaiśvānaraṃ jagāma nāradaḥ ||87 || papraccha kuśalaṃ sarvaṃ putrasya munirāḍ yathā | viśvānara mahābhāga śuciṣmati śubhavrate || 48|| kurute yuvayorvākyaṃ kaccid gṛhapatiḥ śiśuḥ| nānyattīrthaṃ na vā devo na gururna ca satkriyā ||49 vihāya pitrorvacanaṃ nānyo dharmaḥ sutasya vai | garbhadhāraṇapoṣābhyāṃ mātā piturgarīyasī ||1.459.50 pitā vandyo yatirvandyaḥ sanyāsī vandya ityapi | taiḥ sarvaistu gururvandyasteṣāṃ vandyāḥ prasūḥ sadā ||51 idameva tapo’tyugramidameva paraṃ vratam | ayameva paro dharmo yat pitroḥ paritoṣaṇam ||52 pitṛvratamidaṃ proktaṃ kṛṣṇamiva prasevayet | mātṛvratamidaṃ proktaṃ lakṣmīmiva prasevayet ||53 vaiśvānara samabhyehi mamotsaṃge niṣīda bho | lakṣaṇāni parīkṣe’haṃ pāṇiṃ darśaya dakṣiṇam ||54| ityuktaḥ sa gṛhapatirnāradāṃke hyupāviśat | munirdṛṣṭvā bālakasya tālujihvādvijānatha ||55| ānīya kuṃkumāraktaṃ sūtraṃ ca triguṇīkṛtam | mamau samastakād bālamāpādatalamucchrayam ||56 | tiryagūrdhvaṃ samo māne yo’ṣṭottaraśatāṃgulaḥ | sa bhavet pṛthivīpālo yathāyaṃ bālako’pi ca ||57| pañcasūkṣmaḥ pañcadīrghaḥ saptaraktaḥ ṣaḍunnataḥ | tripṛthu laghugambhīro dvātriṃśallakṣaṇo’styayam ||58||| tvakkeśāṃgulidaśanaparvāṇyaṇūni pañca ca | santyasya khalu sūkṣmāṇi dikpālapadabhāg bhavet ||5 9 | bhujau netre hanurjānū nāsā dīrghāṇi cāsya vai | tenāyaṃ tu bhaved dīrghāyuṣko brahmāṇḍasañcaraḥ ||1.459.6 0 | pāṇyo stale ca netrānte tālujihvādharauṣṭhakam | saptāruṇaṃ ca sanakhamasya rājyasukhapradam ||6 1 || vakṣaḥkukṣyalakaṃ skandhaṃ karaṃ vaktraṃ ṣaḍunnatam | dṛśyate’sya bhaveccāyaṃ mahadaiśvaryabhāk khalu ||6 2|| lalāṭakaṭivakṣobhiḥ pṛthurayaṃ bhavennṛpaḥ | grīvājaṃghāmehanaiśca hrasvo’yaṃ bahubhogavān ||6 3 || svareṇa hṛdā nābhyā ca gambhīraḥ sukhabhāk sadā | kamaṭhīpṛṣṭhakaṭhinau patravatkomalau karau ||6 4|| rājyahetūśiśorasya pādau padmasukomalau | acchinnā tarjanīṃ vyāpya tathā rekhāsya vartate ||6 5 || kaniṣṭhāpṛṣṭhaniryātā dīrghāyuṣyaṃ nivedayet | pādau sumāṃsalau raktau samau sūkṣmau suśobhanau ||6 6 || samagulphau svedahīnau snigdhāvaiśvaryasūcakau | svalpābhiḥ kararekhābhirāraktābhiḥ sadā sukhī ||67|| liṃgena kṛśahastena rājarājo bhaviṣyati | utkaṭāsanagulphasphignābhirasyāpi vartulā ||68|| dakṣiṇāvarttamaruṇaṃ mahadaiśvaryasūcikā | dhāraikā mūtrayatyasmin dakṣiṇāvartinīti sā ||6 9|| gandhaśca mīnamadhunorguptavīrye’sya vartate | vistīrṇau māṃsalau snigdhau sphicāvasya sukhocitau ||1.459.70 || vāmāvartau supralambau doṣau digrakṣaṇocitau | śrīvatsavajracakrābjamatsyakodaṇḍadaṇḍabhṛt ||7 1 || tathāsya karagā rekhā yathā syāt tridivaspatiḥ | dvātriṃśaddaśanaścāyaṃ karakambuśirodharaḥ ||71|| krauṃcadundubhihaṃsābhrasvaraḥ sarveśvarādhikaḥ | madhupiṃgalanetro’sau nainaṃ śrīstyajati kvacit |||72|| pañcarekhalalāṭastu tathā siṃhodaraḥ śubhaḥ | ūrdhvarekhāṃkitapado niḥśvasanpadmagandhavān ||74|| acchidrapāṇiḥ sunakho mahālakṣaṇavānayam | tathāpi dvādaśe varṣe pratyūho vidyudagnitaḥ ||75|| asya viśaṃke bhagavan rakṣaṇīyaḥ prayatnataḥ | ityuktvārcāṃ gṛhītvaiva nārado nirjagāma ha ||76|| dampatī kṣaṇamātraṃ tu śuśucaturmumudatuḥ | atha bālaścirāyuṣko bhavitu pitarau tadā ||77|| prāha pratijñāṃ śṛṇutaṃ yadi vāṃ tanayo hyaham | kariṣye’haṃ tapastādṛk vidyunmattastrasiṣyati ||78|| mṛtyuñjayaṃ kālakālaṃ samārādhayituṃ sutaḥ | pitroranurajñāṃ samprāpya yayau sa kāśikāṃ purīm ||79 || sasnau gaṃgājale śaṃbhuṃ dadarśa cānnapūrṇikām | matsyodaryāṃ kṣitau gatvā tasthau kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ param ||1.459.80|| nirvighne tu sthale sthāpya ligaṃ cakre tapaḥ sutaḥ | saṃsnāpya pratyahaṃ śaṃbhuṃ datvā nīlotpalāni vai ||8 1 || japati sma namaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśivāya te | tapaścacāra ṣaṇmāsaṃ kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ ||82|| śīrṇaparṇāśanastadvat ṣaṇmāsām̐stapa ācarat | ṣaṇmāsaṃ vāyubhakṣo’bhūt ṣaṇmāsaṃ jalabindubhuk ||83 || evaṃ varṣadvaye yāte janmato dvādaśe gate | vighnaṃ satyaṃ kariṣyan vai cābhyagāt kuliśāyudhaḥ ||84|| varaṃ brūhīti taṃ prāha sutaḥ śrutvāha vāsavam | nāhaṃ vṛṇe varaṃ tvattaḥ śaṃkaro varado’sti me ||85|| gacchāhalyāpate’sādho śratvā kruddhaḥ svavajrakam | cikṣepa yāvacchaṃbhustajjagrāha līlayā kare ||86|| pratyakṣaḥ śaṃkaro jāto mahendraśca yayau divam | śaṃbhustaṃ tu dadau ciraṃjīveti varamuttamam ||87|| sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ mukhaṃ bhavāgnirūpakaḥ | jāṭharo bhava bhūtānāṃ digīśo rājyamāpnuhi ||88|| malliṃgaṃ tvatsthāpitaṃ tad bhavatvagnīśvarābhidham | ityuktvā prayayau śaṃbhurdatvā mantraṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ||89|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | vaiśvānaro yayau svasya gṛhaṃ mātā pativratā ||1.459.90|| arciṣmatī sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā mumude janako’pi ca | utsavaṃ tu mudā cakre samāhūya surādikān ||91 || indraṃ tatra samāyātaṃ dṛṣṭvā cukrodha vahnirāṭ | punarvajraṃ pracikṣepa vaiśvānaroparīndrakaḥ ||92|| mūrchāṃ jagāma bālastanmātā svāṃke nidhāya tam | pātivratyaṃ bhavenme cedindraḥ patatu bhūtale ||93|| pativratā dṛḍhā syāṃ cedindravajraṃ nirarthakam | sarvathā sarvathā cāstu putro me cetano bhavet ||94|| evamukte tayā vajraṃ kṛṣṇakardamatāṃ gatam | indraḥ patito dharaṇau bubudhe tvaṃkajaḥ sutaḥ ||95|| hāhākāro mahān jātaḥ pātivratyabalena vai | mahendraprārthitā devī kṣamārthaṃ karuṇāparā ||96 || uvāca taṃ mahendraṃ sā samuttiṣṭha sthiro bhava | gṛhāṇa vajraṃ mā vahnau kadācit tvaṃ niyojaya ||97|| mātṛpitṛgurukṛṣṇadrohiṣu satīdrohiṣu | vajraṃ te preritaṃ vidyudrūpaṃ bhavatu madvarāt ||98|| kṛṣṇabhakteṣu pitrośca gurorbhakteṣu tāpase | satībhakteṣu te vajraṃ kardamatvamavāpnuhi ||99|| ityuktaḥ sa satīṃ natvā natvā vaiśvānaraṃ tathā | viśvānaraṃ punarnatvā yayau svargaṃ surā yayuḥ || 1.459.10 0|| arciṣmatyāḥ prabhāveṇa pātivratyavṛṣasya ca | āsannamaraṇaścāpi rakṣitaḥ śaṃbhvanugrahāt || 101 || yāvadbrahmā bhavettāvad vaiśvānaro bhaviṣyati | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi vṛttaṃ bhuktisumuktidam || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne viśvānaraviprasya putrasya gṛhapatyākhyasyatapasā cirajīvitvaṃ, mātuḥ pātivratyabalenendrakṛtavajradvārakamṛtyuvighnavināśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonaṣaṣṭyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||459||
<1.460> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi camatkāraṃ jñānodasya vadāmi te | anādisiddhe saṃsāre purā devayuge sati || 1 || īśānākhyo diśāpālaścaran bhūmiṃ samāyayau | tadā saṃkalpamātreṇa satyadharmāḥ kṛte yuge || 2 || na varṣanti yadābhrāṇi na prāvartanta nimnagāḥ | yadā jalābhilāṣā na snānapānādikarmasu || 3 || pṛthivyāṃ munisañcāre vartamāne kvacit kvacit| | ānandakānanaṃ kṣetramūṣaraṃ praviveśa saḥ || 4 || āluloke brahmatejomayaṃ liṃgaṃ yadakṣarāt | kiraṇākhyaṃ samāyātaṃ yadā viṣṇośca vedhasaḥ || 5 || ahamahamiko bhāvaḥ śreṣṭhatvetvabhavattadā | īśānena tadā svalpamūṣare tvavalokitam || || svarṇasamaṃ surūpaṃ projjvalaṃ divyaṃ sumohakam | īśānasyābhavadicchā snāpayāmi jalaistu tat || 7 || cakhāna ca triśūlena dakṣiṇāśopakaṇṭhataḥ | kuṇḍe tatra jalaṃ divyaṃ tadā nārāyaṇāṃgajam || 8 || jalāvaraṇasambaddhaṃ prāvirāsātipāvanam | tairjalaiḥ snāpayāñcakre liṃgaṃ suvarṇasadṛśam || 9 || pīyūṣavat svādutarairaspṛṣṭairanyadehibhiḥ | adṛṣṭapūrvalokānāṃ manonayanahāribhiḥ || 1.460.1 0|| sahasradhāraiḥ kalaśaiḥ sa īśāno digīśvaraḥ | sahasrakṛtvaḥ snapayāmāsa tuṣṭastato haraḥ || 11 || proce vṛṇu varaṃ matto dadāmi te’tidurlabham | īśānaḥ prāha viśveśaṃ tvannāmnā tīrthamastviti || 12 || viśveśvarastadā prāha tathāstviti sumūrtimān | bhūtvā liṃgasvarūpaḥ sa varivarti maheśvaraḥ || 13 || līnamarthaṃ gamayati liṃgaṃ jñānapradaṃ tu tat | raśmiṃ vinā tadādhāraṃ saṃbhavenna kadācana || 14|| ādhārastu parabrahma bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ | tasya jñānapradaṃ cihnaṃ liṃgaṃ tat kiraṇaṃ matam || 15 || tasya suvarṇarūpasya vāpī snānārthameva yā | jñānavāpī jñānajalaṃ jñānodaṃ tīrthameva tat || 16 || jñānaṃ dravasvarūpaṃ ca jñānodaṃ śaṃkarālayam | asya sparśanapānācamanasnānokṣaṇādibhiḥ || 1 7|| bhuktiṃ muktiṃ pitṛtṛptiṃ yatheṣṭaṃ ca phalaṃ labhet | jñānarūpo’hamevātra dravamūrti vidhāya ca || 18|| jāḍyavidhvaṃsanaṃ kuryāṃ kuryāṃ jñānopadeśanam | iti datvā varaṃ śaṃbhurliṃge cāntaradhīyata || 19|| īśānaśca gato natvā svadiśāṃ prati padmaje | athānandavane tatra harisvāmīti bhūsuraḥ ||1.460.20|| āsīttasyābhavatputrī śīlarūpaguṇānvitā | kalākalāpakuśalā miṣṭasvarātisundarī ||21 || kṛṣṇabhaktā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipradevatā | suśīlā nāma sā nityaṃ snātvā jñānodatīrthake ||22|| viśveśvarālaye saṃmārjanādi kurute satī | kṛṣṇakṛṣṇetikṛṣṇeti śivaśaṃbho jagau mudā ||23||| sulocanāpi sā kanyā paśyatyāsyaṃ na kasyacit | suśravā hyapi sā bālā nādatte kasyacid vacaḥ ||24|| suśīlā śīlasampannā rahastadgatamānasaiḥ | prārthitāpi kṛṣṇavratā nābhilāṣāṃ babandha sā ||25|| dhanaistasyāstu janako yuvabhiḥ prārthito bahuḥ | nāśakattāṃ suśīlāṃ sa dātuṃ śolorjitaśriyam ||26|| jñānodatīrthabhajanāt suśīlā sā kumārikā | bahirantastadādrākṣīt sarvaṃ kṛṣṇamayaṃ jagat ||27|| atha vidyādharastatra śaṃbhordidṛkṣayāgataḥ | rūpalāvaṇyasampannāṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ cakame tu saḥ ||28|| gāndharveṇa vivāhena gṛhītvā sa yayau satīm | sāpi prasevate nityaṃ malayādrau tu taṃ patim ||29|| pātivratyaparā sādhvī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim | sasmāra sarvadā tatra svāmini tviṣṭadevatām ||1.460.3 0 || atha kadācinmalaye bhramantaṃ ta patiṃ mahān | nijaghāna triśūlena hyakasmād vyomamārgataḥ ||3 1 || pativratayā ca tayā śīghraṃ jalaṃ dhṛtaṃ mukhe | tatyājāsūn rākṣasaṃ ca bhasmīcakāra sā satī ||32|| athāsya śavamādāya kṛtvā citāṃ tu sundarī | kṛṣṇaṃ patiṃ tadā dhyātvā cakre citāgnisāt tanum ||3 3 || dampatī tau svargalokaṃ bhuktvā vai lakṣavatsarān | vidyādhraḥ sa januḥ prāpa rājño malayaketutaḥ ||34|| vaiṣṇavaḥ paramodāraḥ satāṃ sevāparāyaṇaḥ | suśīlā sā janurlebhe karṇāṭe nagare satī || 35|| suto malayaketostāṃ kālena pariṇītavān | jātismarau dampatī tau kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇau
