yanmālā japyate tvayā | sa me bhartā bhavennāthaḥ kāntaḥ patirvaro mama ||28|| varāṇāṃ śreṣṭhamenaṃ vai varaṃ dehi maheśvara | tathāstviti haraḥ prāha prāha cātihitaṃ tataḥ ||29|| adya rātrau svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ raṃsyate tu tvayā saha | tava bhāvaprasannaḥ saḥ tava bhartā bhaviṣyati ||1.468.3 0|| imāḥ sakhyaḥ kṛṣṇadāsyo bhaviṣyanti tvayā saha | varaṃ labdhvā tu tāḥ sarvā yayurgṛhaṃ tataḥ param ||3 1 || prāhuḥ sakhyastu tāṃ ratnāvalīṃ vihasya vai śṛṇu | yadyāyāti sa te rātrāvadya kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 32|| cauro bāhulatāpāśaiḥ pāśitavyo’tiyatnataḥ | gocarīkriyate’smābhiryathā sa rādhikāpatiḥ ||33|| aho bhāgyodayaste’dya mahānpuṇyodayastava | ekasyāste’bhavat siddhistvayā sākaṃ ca naḥ khalu || 34|| iti saṃvyāharantyastā ninyū rātriṃ yathātatham | atha prātaḥ samutthāya punarekatra saṃgatāḥ ||35 || prātaḥ kalāvatī snātvā pūjayitvā haraṃ tataḥ | nirbandhena vayasyābhiḥ paripṛṣṭā jagāda ha ||36|| guroḥ kṛpāstathā tvāśīrvādāḥ phalanti vai dhruvam | guroḥ sevā tapaḥ śīghraṃ dadātyeva paraṃ sukham ||37|| adya kṛṣṇaṃ hṛdi kṛtvāviśaṃ śayyāṃ hi satvaram | nidrādhiṣṭhitanayanā tadvilokanalālasā ||38||| kṣaṇāt svapnadaśāṃ prāptā bhāvino’rthasya gauravāt | ātmavismaraṇe hetū tato me dvau babhūvatuḥ || 39|| tandro kṛṣṇāṃgasaṃsparśau mama bodhāpahārakau | tandryāṃ paravaśā tvāsaṃ tatastatsparśanena ca ||1.468.40|| ānandaśevadhau magnā na jāne māṃ ca taṃ prabhum | sukhayitvā jigamiṣuṃ yāvaddhartuṃ samutsahe ||41 || tāvaddhastaṃ vañcayitvā vihasya satvaraṃ gataḥ | doṣṇoḥ kaṃkaṇaśabdaiśca drāgahaṃ tvavabodhitā || 42|| sukhasantānapīyūṣahṛde parinimajjya vai | kṣaṇaṃ tu tadviyogāgnau patitāhaṃ samutkaṭe |||43 || dunoti nitarāṃ sakhyastadviśleṣānalo mahān | prāṇānāṃ me yiyāsūnāṃ punarāśā mahauṣadham ||44|| aho tasya punaḥ śaktiraho tasya balaṃ kriyā | aho tasya prasaundaryaṃ ramaṇaṃ tasya cādbhutam ||45 || aho cūḍāmaṇistasya picchaṃ māyūrakaṃ śubham | lalāṭaphalakaṃ ramyaṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇe ||46|| sasmitaṃ tvānanaṃ miṣṭaṃ miṣṭaścāsaprapūritam | candrakoṭyujjvalaṃ vaktraṃ tejaḥparidhimaṇḍitam ||47|| kāmagarvaharā bhrūśca vakṣaḥ śītalapaṃkavat | karau sukomalau puṣṭau bāhupārśvau manoharau ||48|| udaraṃ jaghanaṃ yatra hṛdayaṃ me jaḍaṃ hyabhūt | ūrū netrānandakarau yathā maṇī prakāśakau ||49|| caraṇau komalau sparśaḥ svākarṣaṇakaraḥ paraḥ | aho tasya pumaṃkasya sukhadatvaṃ cirāyitam ||1.468.50|| sarvasvena mayā tatra hutaṃ varṣma pramodane | aho yogo balaṃ tasya tvaho vīryaṃ dṛḍhāṃgatā ||51 || punaḥ punaḥ prayogeṇa jitā śaktiśca me hṛtā | kālīkamālayo vakti snigdhe mugdhe sakhījane ||52|| daśamyavasthā sannahyed bādhituṃ māṃ hi taṃ vinā | iti tasyā giraḥ śrutvā mūrchā prāpustadālayaḥ ||53 || tāvat kṛṣṇaḥ samāyātastāsāṃ saubhāgyahetave | svapne surūpo bhagavān yuvā tāḥ pariṣasvaje ||54|| tāstu datvā sukhaṃ tatra tiro’bhūd vai kṣaṇāntare | śaśilekhānaṅgalekhācitralekhā jajāgaruḥ ||55|| dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇakṛtāśleṣacihnāni svakalevare | parasparaṃ vilokyaitā hrīyuktāḥ saṃvirejire ||56 || nanṛtuḥ sukhasaṃhṛṣṭāḥ sakhyo mumudire bhṛśam | śravaṇaṃ cāpi kṛṣṇasya sākṣātkārapradaṃ tvabhūt ||57|| catasrastāḥ svapitaraṃ pitṛtulyaṃ suvaiṣṇavam | vasubhūtiṃ tu gandharvaṃ prātaḥ procurhidarśanam ||58|| svapne kṛṣṇo yathā dṛṣṭo yathā kṛṣṇaḥ pratoṣitaḥ | yathā varo mahādevāt pūrvaṃ labdho’pyabhūt tathā ||59|| śrutvā sarvaṃ pitā prāha tāstu catuḥkumārikāḥ | kṛṣṇasyaiva kṛte putryo mayā jalena cārpitāḥ ||1.468.6 0 || adya kṛṣṇo yadi tvāyād vaktavyā mannatiḥ stutiḥ | vāgdānaṃ ca mahādevyo bhavatād bhagavānpatiḥ ||6 1 || jāmātā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kutra hi labhyate | śaṃkarasya varadānāllabdho yuṣmābhireva saḥ ||6 2 || dhanyo’haṃ kṛtakṛtyo’haṃ dhanyaṃ me’pi kulaṃ sadā | jāmātā yasya bhagavān śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||63 || dhanyā yūyaṃ sadā sādhvyo dhanyā yūyaṃ pativratāḥ | dhanyā yūyaṃ kṛṣṇapatnyo dhanyāḥ kṛṣṇavratāḥ striyaḥ ||64|| ityuktvā kārayāmāsa maṇḍapaṃ kanyakājñayā | śrīkṛṣṇāya pradātavyāḥ kanyakā itivāñcchayā ||65|| dvitīyāyāṃ niśāyāṃ sa samājagāma mādhavaḥ | bubhuje tāḥ kanyakā vai tābhistūktaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||66 || vivāhārthaṃ tathāstviti kṛṣṇaḥ prāha kṛpāvaśaḥ | prātareva mahābrāhme muhūrte vahnisannidhau ||67|| gavāṃ madhye dadau kanyāḥ kṛṣṇāya paramātmane | vasubhūtiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cānarca bhāvataḥ ||68|| śyāmaṃ suyauvanaṃ puṣṭaṃ pītakauśeyavāsasam | sundaraṃ sasmitaṃ śāntaṃ rādhākāntaṃ manoharam ||69|| śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitam | ratnakuṇḍalayugmābhyāṃ gaṇḍasthalavirājitam ||1.468.70|| ratnakeyūravalayaratnanūpurabhūṣitam | ājānulambitāṃ śubhrāṃ bibhrataṃ ratnamālikām ||7 1 || mālatīmālayā kaṇṭhavakṣaḥsthalavirājitam | candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumāñcitavigraham ||72|| sunakhaṃ sukapolaṃ ca pakvabimbādharaṃ varam | pakvadāḍīmabījābhaṃ bibhrataṃ dantamaṇḍalam || 73|| śikhipicchasamāyuktaṃ baddhacūḍaṃ parātparam | kadambapuṣpayugmābhyāṃ karṇamūle virājitam ||74|| samarcya sarvabhūṣāḍhyaṃ nanāma kanyakāpitā | kṛṣṇastāḥ kanyakā divyā jagrāha vidhinā prabhuḥ ||75|| śaratpārvaṇacandrābhā muṣṭavaktramanoharāḥ | śaranmadhyāhnapadmānāṃ śobhāmocanalocanāḥ ||76|| paritastārakāpakṣmavicitrakajjalojjvalāḥ | khagendracañcucāruśrīśaṃsānāśukanāsikāḥ ||77|| tanmadhyasthalaśobhārhasthūlamuktāphalojjvalāḥ | kabarīveṣasaṃyuktā mālatīmālyaveṣṭitāḥ ||78 || grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṇḍaprabhāmuṣṭakakuṇḍalāḥ | pakvabimbaphalānāṃ ca śrīmuṣṭādharayugmakāḥ ||79|| muktāpaṃktiprabhātaikadantapaṃktisamujjvalāḥ | īṣatpraphullakundānāṃ suprabhāsaṃśubhasmitāḥ ||1.468.80|| kastūrībindusaṃyuktasindūrabindubhūṣitāḥ | kapālāni ca mallikāyuktāni śrīyutāni ca ||81|| saṃdadhānāḥ kṛṣṇakāntāḥ kṛṣṇatulyasuśobhitāḥ | sucāruvartulākārakapolapulakānvitāḥ ||82|| maṇiratnendrasārāṇāṃ hāroraḥsthalabhūṣitāḥ | sucāruśrīphaladvayakaṭhinastanasaṃbhavāḥ ||83 || patrāvalīśriyā yuktā dīptāḥ sadratnakāntibhiḥ | yāsāṃ suvartulākāramudaraṃ sumanoharam ||84|| vicitratrivalīyuktaṃ nimnanābhiśca vartulā | sadratnasāraracitamekhalājālabhūṣitāḥ ||85|| kāmāstrasārabhrūbhaṃgayogīndracittamohikāḥ | sthalapadmaprabhāśobhāñcitatalapadāmbujāḥ ||86|| ratnabhūṣaṇasaṃyuktā yāvakadravaśobhitāḥ | maṇīndraśobhāsaṃmuṣṭasālaktakakaradvayāḥ ||87|| sadratnasāraracitakvaṇanmañjīrarañjitāḥ | ratnakaṃkaṇakeyūracāruśaṃkhavibhūṣitāḥ ||88|| ratnāṃgulīyanikaravahniśuddhāṃśukojjvalāḥ | cārucampakapuṣpāṇāṃ prabhāmuṣṭakalevarāḥ ||89|| sahasradalasaṃyuktakrīḍākamalaśobhitāḥ | ratnadarpaṇasaṃyuktā navavadhūḥ svayaṃ hariḥ || 1.468.90|| rañjayan bahudhā nītvā yautakaṃ cātimūlyakam | yayau prasthāpito yānairvaihāyasaiḥ paraṃ padam ||91 || tenaiva varṣmaṇā tāstu divyāḥ kṛṣṇaprasaṃgataḥ | golokayogyāḥ sañjātā rādhālakṣmīsamāḥ priyāḥ ||92|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi pātivratyaparāyaṇam | kṛṣṇaprāptyātmakaṃ puṇyaṃ śravaṇādapi mokṣakṛt ||93|| paṭhanādasya tatpuṇyaṃ kṛṣṇasaubhāgyadaṃ bhavet | anūḍho labhate kanyāratnaṃ śreṣṭhakulocitam ||94|| kanyāpīmaṃ samākarṇya kṛṣṇabhaktisamanvitā | śraddhayā satpatiṃ prāpya bhaviṣyati pativratā ||95|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kalāvatīnartakyāḥ śaṃkaradvārā kṛṣṇapativratādharmeṇa tisṛbhiḥ sakhībhiḥ saha janmāntare gāndharvītvaṃ kṛṣṇena vivāhya ca golokaprāptimattvaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 468 ||
<1.469> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu kṛṣṇakathāṃ lakṣmi dvijapatnīsamanvitām | yāṃ śrutvā pātivratyena mokṣaṇaṃ mānasaṃ bhavet || 1 || ekadā tu purā kṛṣṇo balarāmaśca bālakāḥ | vṛndāvanād yayuryamītaṭe madhuvane śubhe || 2 || vicerurgosahasraiste cikrīḍurvai parasparam | śrāntāḥ kṣudhitāstṛṣitāḥ śiśavastūcuracyutam || 3 || kṣudasmān bādhate kṛṣṇa kiṃ kurmo’tra vane’danam | śrīkṛṣṇastām̐stadā prāha bālā gacchata sannidhau || 4 || yajñasthānaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ yācatānnaṃ tu bhūsurān | āṃgirasān vaiṣṇavām̐śca mumukṣūn yajatastu mām || 5 || ajānantaśca māṃ viṣṇuṃ māyāpracchannavigraham | na ced dadati yuṣmabhyamannaṃ yajñasthitā dvijāḥ || 6 || tatkāntā yācata bālā dayāyuktāḥ śiśūn prati | śrīkṛṣṇavacanaṃ śrutvā yayurbālakapuṃgavāḥ || 7 || brāhmaṇānāṃ purastasthurbhikṣārthaṃ namrakandharāḥ | tānūcurbālakā namrā annaṃ datta dvijottamāḥ || 8 || dvijā na śuśruvustām̐stu śṛṇvanto na mano daduḥ | atastasmāt sthalād dūre gatā randhanaśālikām | | 9 || brāhmaṇyo yatra sūpādi pācayanti mahānase | gatvā namrā viprapatnīryayācire’nnamāsthayā || 1.469.1 0|| yūyaṃ vai mātaraḥ sarvā viprapatnyaḥ pativratāḥ | dattānnaṃ mātarastvasmān kṣudhitān gopabālakān || 11 || śiśūnāṃ mṛduvākyāni śrutvā dṛṣṭvā hi tān striyaḥ | papraccha sādaraṃ sādhvyaḥ ke yūyaṃ kena darśitam || 12|| yadatrānnaṃ hi labdhaṃ syād brūtātra gopabālakāḥ | dāsyāmo’nnaṃ mṛṣṭamuṣṇaṃ vyañjanādisamanvitam || 13|| śrutvā prasannāḥ śiśavo yaṣṭihastā jagustu tāḥ | preṣitā rāmakṛṣṇābhyāṃ darśitaṃ tvanmahānasam || 14|| dattānnaṃ mātaro’smabhyaṃ tūrṇaṃ yāmastadantikam | ito vidūre bhāṇḍīre’tiśobhe’tra madhauvane | | 15|| vaṭādhaḥsthitabhrātṛbhyāṃ yācitānnaṃ pradatta naḥ | śrutveti komalaṃ kṛṣṇasambandhaṃ vākyamuttamam || 16 || pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgā hṛṣṭānandāśrulocanāḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā śālyannaṃ pāyasaṃ dadhi || 17|| miṣṭānnaṃ svastikādyaṃ ca laḍḍukānnaṃ supolikāḥ | nānāvyañjanasūpādi kṛtvā pātreṣu yoṣitaḥ || 18|| pātrāṇi rājatādīni santyato vayameva tu | āgacchāmaḥ sahabālā ityuktvā prayayurmudā || 1 9|| viprāṇyo manasā hṛṣṭāḥ kṛtvā nānāmanorathān | pativratāstā dhanyāśca śrīkṛṣṇadarśanotsukāḥ ||1.469.20|| śrīkṛṣṇaṃ dadṛśurgatvā baladevaṃ ca bālakān | vaṭacchāyāsthitān dṛṣṭvā dadṛśustāḥ punarharim ||2 1 || śyāmaṃ kiśoravayasaṃ pītakauśeyavāsasam | sundaraṃ sasmitaṃ śāntaṃ rādhākāntaṃ manoharam ||22|| śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ ratnālaṃkṛtirājitam | ratnakuṇḍalayugmābhyāṃ gaṇḍasthalavirājitam ||23|| ratnakeyūravalayaratnanūpurabhūṣitam | ājānulambitāṃ śubhrāṃ bibhrataṃ ratnamālikām ||24|| mālatīmālayā kaṇṭhavakṣaḥsthalavirājitām | candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumāñcitavigraham ||25|| sunakhaṃ sukapolaṃ ca pakvabimbādharaṃ harim | pakvadāḍīmabījābhadantapaṃktivirājitam ||26 || mayūraparṇasaṃśobhadbaddhacūḍāmaṇiṃ prabhum | karṇayordhṛtakādambapuṣpagucchasuśobhitam ||27|| dhyānāsādhyaṃ yogināṃ ca bhaktānugrahakātaram | brahmeśadharmaśeṣendraiḥ stūyamānaṃ pareśvaram ||28|| koṭikandarpalāvaṇyavātsalyapremapūritam | dṛṣṭvaivamujjvalaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaktyā nemurdvijastriyaḥ ||29|| svānāṃ jñānānurūpaṃ ca tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram | tvaṃ brahma paramaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sākṣācchrīpatiracyutaḥ ||1.469.3 0|| nirguṇastvaṃ nirākāraḥ sākāraḥ saguṇaḥ svayam | sākṣirūpaśca nirlepaḥ paramātmā nirākṛtiḥ ||3 1 || akṣarātparataḥ śreṣṭhastvakṣarātīta eva ca | muktasevyaḥ śriyā sevyo rādhāramādipūjitaḥ ||32|| pārvatīmāṇikīlakṣmīprabhādyābhiḥ patiḥ kṛtaḥ | prakṛteḥ puruṣasyāpi mahāviṣṇośca vedhasaḥ ||33 || śivādīnāṃ manūnāṃ ca kāraṇaṃ paramaṃ bhavān | jaḍaṃ tattvātmakaṃ yadyaccetanaṃ ca tadanvitam ||34|| tvayā vyāptaṃ tava tejobalāttejasvitāśrayam | sarvaiśvaryāṇi śaktyādyāstavamūrteḥ samudbhavāḥ ||35|| sarvānandaḥ pareśo’si patiḥ prāṇādhikaḥ priyaḥ | adivyacakṣuṣā naiva grāhyo’si dehavānapi ||36|| maheśaḥ kārtikeyaśca śeṣo dharmo vidhirguruḥ | sarasvatī jaḍāḥ sarve stavane tatra kā vayam ||37|| pārvatī kamalā rādhā sāvitrī śāradā prabhā | māṇikī śrīrlakṣmavatī pravartante na kā vayam ||38|| prasanno bhava no deva dīnabandho kṛpāṃ kuru | iti petustu tā viprapatnyaḥ kṛṣṇapadāmbuje ||39|| abhayaṃ pradadau tābhyaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | varaṃ vṛṇuta kalyāṇaṃ bhavitā cetyuvāca saḥ ||1.469.40 || tataḥ sādhvyastu tā ūcurgṛhṇīmaḥ pravaraṃ prabho | dehi svadāsyamasmabhyaṃ dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ padāmbuje ||41 || paśyāmo’nukṣaṇaṃ vaktraṃ sevayāmaḥ padāmbuje | anugrahaṃ kuru śreṣṭhaṃ yāsyāmo na gṛhaṃ punaḥ ||42|| pativratānāṃ vākyāni śrutvā kṛṣṇaḥ kṛpānidhiḥ | omityuktvā viprapatnīdattamannaṃ sudhāsamam ||43|| bālakān bhojayitvānububhuje bhagavān svayam | etasminnantare tatra śātakuṃbhaṃ rathaṃ param ||44|| golokādāgataṃ tāstu dadṛśurdivyapārṣadam | ratnadarpaṇatejaskaṃ vastrasāraparicchadam ||45|| suvarṇakalaśopetaṃ ratnastaṃbhadharādikam | sarvataścāmarairyuktaṃ pārijātasumālikam ||46|| śatacakropariklṛptaṃ vanamālādiśobhitam | divyapārṣadavaryaiśca kṛṣṇatulyaiḥ suvāhitam ||47|| pītavastraparīdhānaiḥ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitaiḥ | navayauvanasampanneḥ śyāmalaiśca manoharaiḥ ||48 || dvibhujairmuralīhastairgopiveśadharairvaraiḥ | śikhipicchaguñjamālābaddhavakrimacūḍakaiḥ ||49|| pārṣadaiḥ sannataḥ kṛṣṇo viprapatnyastu bodhitāḥ | gamanārthaṃ tu golokaṃ tāścāsan muditānanā |||1.469.50 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā tyaktvā mānuṣavigrahān | babhūvurgopikāḥ sadyo jagmurgolokamīpsitam ||5 1 || kṛṣṇaśchāyāṃ vinirmāya tāsāṃ rūpāntarāṇi vai | gṛhān prasthāpayāmāsa viprāṇāṃ viprakāminīḥ ||52|| viprā gaveṣaṇaṃ cakruḥ kva gatāstā itibruvāḥ | dadṛśuḥ pathi cāyāntīḥ patnīḥ śāntiṃ yayustataḥ |||53 || pulakāṅkitasarvāṃgāḥ prasannavadanekṣaṇāḥ | ūcuraho’tidhanyāḥ smo yūyaṃ cāpi pativratāḥ ||54|| yāsāṃ patnyaḥ kṛṣṇabhaktā lakṣmīrādhāsamā harau | tapo japo vrataṃ jñānaṃ vedādhyayanamarcanam ||55||| tīrthasnānamanaśanaṃ saphalaṃ kṛṣṇasevayā | śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sevito yābhiḥ kiṃ tāsāṃ puṇyaparvataiḥ ||56||| prāptaḥ kalpataruryābhiḥ kiṃ tāsāṃ tarukoṭibhiḥ | śrīkṛṣṇo hṛdaye yāsāṃ kiṃ tāsāṃ karmakoṭibhiḥ ||57|| iti kṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ patnīnāṃ cāpi sarvathā | jānantaste yayuryajñaṃ tato yayurgṛhāṇi vai ||58|| tāsāṃ tato’dhikaṃ prema krīḍāsu sarvakarmasu | dākṣiṇyaṃ sevanaṃ sarvaṃ tvāsīd viprairatarkitam ||59|| prāgbhavīyottamapuṇyaiḥ prāpyate bhagavān yataḥ | āsam̐stāstu purā saptarṣīṇāṃ patnyaḥ pativratāḥ ||1.469.60|| guṇavatyo ramaṇyastā rūpeṇāpratimā parāḥ | navīnayauvanāḥ sarvāḥ pīnaśroṇipayodharāḥ ||6 1 || divyavastraparīdhānā ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ | taptakāñcanavarṇābhāḥ smerānanasaroruhāḥ ||62|| yajñasthānasthitāḥ svāmisahitāścakrurarpaṇam | vahnau dravyādivastūnāṃ cakame’gnirvilokya tāḥ ||63|| tato vahniḥ svīyajvālākaraiḥ pasparśa tā muhuḥ | agniraṃgāni tāsāṃ ca darśaṃ darśaṃ mumoha ca ||64|| haviṣyaṃ bhakṣayam̐ścāpi sparśaṃ kṛtvātikāmukaḥ | samāśliṣat karaistāstvadṛśyairbhāvaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||65|| cakāra surataṃ sūkṣmaṃ śikhābhiḥ pariṣvajya tāḥ | pativratāśca tā naiva jānanti vahnivartanam ||66|| divyadraṣṭāṅgirā vahnerjñātvā guptaṃ tu vartanam | kāmabhāvānvitaṃ vahniṃ śaśāpa śeṣamāvahan ||67|| adyaprabhṛti vahne te śikhāyāṃ ca kareṣu ca | jvālāyāṃ ca tathāṅgārādiṣu kāmau bhavenna vai ||68|| napuṃsakaḥ sadā syāstvaṃ jvālātmakaḥ supuṇyadaḥ | mūrtimām̐stvaṃ sakāmaḥ syāḥ svāhāpi tādṛśī tathā ||69|| evaṃ śaptastato vahnirniṣkāmo jvālayābhavat | yajñayāgādikāryāṇi yataḥ puṇyāni tadbalāt ||1.469.70|| athāṅgirā aśuddhāstā vahnispṛṣṭā hi kāmataḥ | śaśāpa śuddhilābhāya yāta yoniṃ tu mānuṣīm ||71 || kulajairbrāhmaṇaiḥ pāṇirgṛhīto vo bhaviṣyati | ityuktāstāḥ kṣaṇaṃ śokaṃ jagmuścakruśca taṃ natim ||72|| hitaṃ tathyaṃ prārthayāmāsuśca sarvāḥ pativratāḥ | na tyajāsmān muniśreṣṭha niṣpāpā vai pativratāḥ ||73|| ajānantyaḥ paraspṛṣṭā na vai nastyaktumarhasi | bhaktānāṃ kiṃkarīṇāṃ ca na daṇḍaṃ kartumarhasi ||74|| yuṣmākaṃ caraṇāmbhojaṃ kadā drakṣyāmahe vayam | khaḍgacchedād vajrapātāt sarvapraharaṇāttathā ||75|| dāruṇaḥ kāntavicchedaḥ sādhvīnāṃ duḥsahaḥ sadā | brahmiṣṭhānāṃ guṇavatāṃ parān kāntān mahāmunīn ||76 || patnīvratān kathaṃ tyaktvā yāsyāmaḥ pṛthivītalam | yāsyāmo yadi vipreśa kadātrāgamanaṃ vada ||77|| anyeṣāṃ tu bhayāt kāntā vrajanti śaraṇaṃ patim | svakāntabhayasaṃvignāḥ śaraṇaṃ kaṃ vrajanti tāḥ ||78|| abhayaṃ dehi dharmiṣṭha bhayayuktābhya eva yat | putre śiṣye kalatre ca ko daṇḍaṃ kartumakṣamaḥ ||79|| daṇḍaṃ datvā vāraṇaṃ ca kartuṃ tvapi na kaḥ kṣamaḥ | kāminīnāṃ vacaḥ śrutvāṅgirāḥ premṇā ruroda vai ||1.469.80 || saṃjñāmavāpya ca bhrātṝn pṛṣṭvā provāca tāstataḥ | hitaṃ satyaṃ priyaṃ yogyamanyeṣāṃ bodhadaṃ param ||81|| parabhuktāṃ svasya kāntāṃ vinā tacchodhanaṃ patiḥ | naiva bhuñjīta vai kvāpi pāpaṃ saṃkramate priye |||82 || na sā daive na sā paitrye pākārhā pāpasaṃyutā | tasyā āliṃgane bhartā bhraṣṭaśrīstejasā hataḥ ||83|| devatāḥ pitarastasya havyadāne ca tarpaṇe | sukhino na bhavantyeva kavoṣṇamupabhuṃjate ||84|| tasmād yatnena bhāryāyā rakṣaṇaṃ kāryamanvaham | pade pade sāvadhānaiḥ kāntā rakṣyāḥ supaṇḍitaiḥ ||85|| nānyādhīnā bhaved yoṣā doṣāṇāṃ hi karaṇḍikā | kalatraṃ pākapātraṃ ca sadā rakṣitumarhati ||86|| parasparśādaśuddhe te śuddhe svasyaiva hastage | aśuddhānāṃ praśuddhiścartunā vratena janmanā ||87|| tasmānnārī parairyatnādadṛṣṭā pūrvajaiḥ kṛtā | asūryaṃpaśyā yā dārā śuddhāstāstu pativratāḥ ||88|| svāmisādhyā tu yā nārī kuladharmabhiyā sthitā | kāntena sārdhaṃ sā kāntā vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti niścitam ||89|| ṛṣilokanimeṣeṇa pṛthvyāṃ viṃśativarṣakaḥ | kālo yāsyati śīghraṃ vai janmanā śuddhirarthyate ||1.469.90 || yāta yūyaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ mānuṣīṃ yonimīpsitām | kṛṣṇabhojanadānena vaḥ śāpasya hi mocanam ||91 || śrīkṛṣṇasya pratāpena rūpatrayaṃ dhariṣyatha | divyakanyāsvarūpeṇa golokaṃ yāsyatha dhruvama ||92|| devīkanyāsvarūpeṇa ṛṣilokaṃ prayāsyatha | chāyākanyāsvarūpeṇa vipragṛhaṃ prayāsyatha ||93 || yuṣmadaṃśā viprapatnyo mṛtau prāpsyatha no dhruvam | yuṣmākaṃ mamaśāpo’yaṃ vartate’dya varādhikaḥ ||94 || bhuktirmuktirgṛhaprāptistrayametadavāpyate | ityuktāstā yajñabhūmeryayuḥ pṛthvīṃ yamītaṭe || 95|| yogyagṛhe samudbhūya babhuvurviprayoṣitaḥ | datvānnaṃ haraye bhaktyā jagmurgolokameva tāḥ || 96 || tathānyarūpaiḥ kāntasya lokaṃ jagmuśca tāstadā | chāyārūpairyayurvipragṛhāṇyeva tu tāḥ striyaḥ || 97|| babhūva niścitaṃ tāsāṃ śāpo vai sampado’dhikaḥ | aho sadyaḥ satāṃ kopastūpakārāya kalpate || 98|| vinā vipattermahimā kutaḥ kasya bhavet khalu | bhūtāḥ kāntaparityāgānmuktā brāhmaṇayoṣitaḥ || 99|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi pativratāharivratam | paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya bhuktirmuktistathonnatiḥ || 1.469.100 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne saptarṣipatnīnāṃ vahnibhogena śāpād viprapatnītve śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapātivratyena yajñe yamītaṭe śrīkṛṣṇādibālānāṃ vatsacārāṇāṃ bhojanadānena mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonasaptatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 46 9||
<1.470> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi sarpajātau pativratā vṛṣaṃ śubham | yamunāyāstaṭe ramye yayau kṛṣṇo balānvitaḥ || 1 || gopālakavṛṣairgābhirvijahāra jalāntikam | gāvo vṛṣāstathā bālāḥ papurvāri tṛṣāturāḥ || 2 || viṣāktaṃ tajjalaṃ tvāsīt kālīyasarpavāsataḥ | kecinmūrchāṃ gatāstatra tvanye prāṇāṃśca tatyajuḥ || 3 || kṛpṇanārāyaṇo jñātvā jīvayāmāsa tāṃstadā | kṛṣṇaḥ kadambamāruhya kṛtvā dehaṃ mahattamam | | 4 || papāta jalamadhye sa nāgasyopari mādhavaḥ | naikahastapramāṇaṃ tu jalotthānaṃ tadābhavat || 5 || sa sarpo mānuṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā dudrāva krodhavegataḥ | baddhuṃ taṃ mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ yāvajjagrāha taṃ harim || 6 || taptalohasamaṃ jātaṃ kṛṣṇavarṣma hi tejasā | dagdhakaṇṭhodaro nāgastūdvignaḥ kṛṣṇatejasā || 7 || prāṇā yāstyevamuktvā vai cakārodvamanaṃ punaḥ | bhagnadanto raktamukhaḥ kṛṣṇavajrāṃgacarvaṇāt || 8 || raktavaktrasya bhagavānuttasthau mastakopari | nāgo viśvaṃbharākrāntaḥ papāta mūrchitaḥ priye || 9 || punaḥ sa cetanāṃ prāpya phaṇābhiḥ śrīnarāyaṇam | svapucchena muhuryuktyā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ samatāḍayat || 1.470.1 0|| bhagavān śrīhariḥ kalānidhistūnnamitāṃ phaṇām | pallatayā punaryuktyā tatāḍa ca nanarta ca || 11 || phaṇā śithilatāṃ prāptā sarpo’bhūttu mṛdurbahuḥ | mūrchitaṃ taṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā nāginyo rurudurbhṛśam || 1 2|| patiprāṇāḥ svāmidharmāḥ patyarthaṃ kṛtajīvanāḥ | tāsu śreṣṭhā surasākhyā patnī tasya śubhā satī ||1 3|| nāginībhiḥ saha premṇā ruroda purato hareḥ | baddhāñjalipuṭā tūrṇaṃ praṇamya śrīhariṃ satī || 14|| dhṛtvā pādāravindaṃ śrīkṛṣṇamāha bhayākulā | he jagatkānta me kāntaṃ dehi mānaṃ sumānada || 15|| patiḥ prāṇādhikaḥ strīṇāṃ nāsti bandhustu tatparaḥ | pativratāhaṃ nāgasya patnī svecchāsvarūpiṇī || 1 6|| nāge mṛge ca vaidhavyaduḥkhitā syāṃ tataḥ prabho | maraṇaṃ me prathamaṃ ca kuru me svāminastataḥ || 17|| tannāśe mama nāśo’sti strīhatyā te bhaviṣyati | nāgapatnīvacaḥ śrutvā śrīkṛṣṇastāmuvāca ha || 18|| uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha nāgeśi varaṃ vṛṇu bhayaṃ tyaja | gṛhāṇa kāntaṃ nāgeśi cirajīvājarāmarā || 6 || yamīhradraṃ parityajya sakuṭumbānyato vraja | khaṇḍaṃ ramaṇakaṃ gaccha tatra saṃsukhino bhava || 1.470.20|| yatpādapadmacihnena garuḍastvatpati śubhe | kṛtvā tu stavanaṃ bhaktyā praṇamiṣyati matpadam || 21 || śrutvadaṃ sā bhaktinamrā surasovāca mādhavam | tvatpādābje dṛḍhā bhaktiṃ niścalā dehi me hare || 22|| manmanastvatpadāmbhojaṃ bhramatu bhramaro yathā | svakāntaṃ mama sobhāgyaṃ sarvadā dehi me vibho || 23|| evaṃ samprārthya surasā dadarśa śrīharermukham | locanābhyāṃ papau vaktraṃ nimeṣarahitaṃ satā || 24|| sarvāṃgapulakodbhinnā sānandāśrupariplutā | uvāca purataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaktyudrekapariplutā || 25|| na yāsyāmi ramaṇakaṃ tatra me na prayojanam | sarpaḥ karotu saṃsāre kuru māṃ tava kiṃkarīm || 26|| nāgapatnyā vacaḥ śratvā śrīśa omityuvāca ha | etasminnantare tūrṇaṃ ratho divyaḥ samāgataḥ || 27|| pārṣadapravarairyukto divyavastuparicchadaḥ | avaruhya śatacakrādrathācchrīkṛṣṇapārṣadāḥ || 28|| praṇamya kṛṣṇaṃ tāṃ nītvā jagmurgolokamuttamam | kṛṣṇaśchāyāṃ vinirmāya dadau sarpāya sarpiṇīm ||29|| sarpaḥ kiñcinna bubudhe camatkāraṃ kadambinaḥ | avaruhya harirmūdhno dadau hastaṃ tu bhogini ||1.470.30 || sarpaḥ prabodhamāsādya dadarśa purato harim | nāginī sāśrunetrāṃ ca surasāṃ svapativratām ||3 1 || bālakṛṣṇaṃ namaskṛtya ruroda premavihvalaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇastaṃ paraṃ bhaktaṃ varaṃ vṛṇvityuvāca ha ||32|| tvaṃ me bhakto yataḥ sarpa sukhaṃ tiṣṭha bhayaṃ tyaja | tasyāhamanugṛhṇāmi yo me bhakto’tigārpitaḥ ||33|| kiñcittaddamanaṃ kṛtvā tatprasādaṃ karomyaham | tvadvaṃśajātān sarpāṃśca hanti yo mānavaḥ kvacit ||34|| brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ bhavitā tasya niścitam | matpādapadmacihne yaḥ karoti daṇḍaghātanam ||35|| dviguṇā brahmahatyā vai bhavitā tasya niścitā | lakṣmīryāsyati tadgehācchāpaṃ datvā sudāruṇam ||36|| vaṃśāyuryaśasāṃ hānirbhavitā tasya niścitam | dehānte tasya mṛtyuśca sarpadaṃśād bhaviṣyati ||37|| tasya vaṃśodbhavānāṃ ca tvadvaṃśād bhavitā bhayam | ye tu tvadvaṃśajān dṛṣṭvā supadāṃkaṃ madīyakam ||38|| praṇamiṣyanti bhaktyā te mokṣyante cauragād bhayāt | gaccha śīghraṃ ramaṇakaṃ tyaja bhītiṃ khagādhipāt ||39|| matpadāṅkaṃ tava mūrdhni dṛṣṭvā pakṣī namiṣyati | tava tvadvaṃśajānāṃ ca garuḍānna bhayaṃ kvacit ||1.470.40|| varaṃ cāpyaparaṃ sarpa vāñchitaṃ varayādhunā | ityuktaḥ prāha kālīyo bhaktiṃ dehi smṛtiṃ tava ||41|| dāsyaṃ dehi tvatpadābje dhruvaṃ janmani janmani | tadbhavet saphalaṃ yatra smṛtistvaccaraṇāmbuje ||42|| tanniṣphalaḥ svargavāso nāsti cet tvatpadasmṛtiḥ | tvatpādadhyānayuktasya yattatsthānaṃ tu tat param ||43|| kṣaṇaṃ vā koṭikalpaṃ vā puruṣāyuḥ kṣaṇo’stu vā | yadi tvatsevayā yāti saphalo niṣphalo’nyathā ||44|| teṣāṃ tvāyurvyayo nāsti ye tvatpādābjasevakāḥ | na santi janmamaraṇarogaśokārtibhītayaḥ ||45|| samprāptastvanmanurbrahmannanantād yāvadeva tu | tāvat tvadbhāvanenaiva tvadvarṇo’hamanugrahāt ||46|| māṃ tu bhaktamapakvaṃ vā vijñāya garuḍaḥ svayam | deśād dūraṃ ca nyakkāraṃ cakāra dṛḍhabhaktimān ||47|| bhavatā tu dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ datvāhaṃ svīkṛtaḥ svakaḥ | garuḍaśca samuktastu mā bhaktaṃ khāda coragam ||48|| anugṛhītaścāhaṃ saṃrakṣitaḥ sarvadā tvayā | he nātha karuṇāsindho dīnabandho kṣamādhamam ||49|| iti bruvantaṃ nāgendramotvityāha haristadā | nāgendrāya varaṃ datvā gacchetyāha hariḥ punaḥ ||1.470.5 0|| sarpaḥ prāha kadā viṣṇo drakṣyāmi tvatpadāmbujam | praṇamya śatakṛtvaśca yayau ramaṇakaṃ sthalam ||51 || jalaṃ jātaṃ sudhākalpaṃ prasannāḥ sarvajantavaḥ | śṛṇu lakṣmi tasya pūrvasthalatyāgasya kāraṇam |||52|| śeṣājñayā nāgagaṇā pratisaṃvatsaraṃ bhiyā | kārtikīpūrṇimāyāṃ tu kurvanti garuḍārcanam ||53|| puṣpairdhūpaiḥ sudīpaiḥ sannaivedyairbalibhistathā | puṣkare te mahātīrthe susnātāstasya pūjanam ||54|| cakrustadā tu kālīyo na cakārāpyahaṃkṛtaḥ | nāgapūjopakaraṇaṃ balād bhakṣitumudyataḥ ||55|| tāvattatra samāyāto garuḍo yuyudhe tu taiḥ | kālīyajātīyasarpaiḥ sarpāstena palāyitāḥ ||56 || anantaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmustatra gatvā tu pakṣirāṭ | yuddhaṃ cakāra tumulaṃ tvanantaṃ jitavān khagaḥ ||57|| kālīyastu vidudrāva jagāma yamunāhradam | na taṃ saubhariśāpena khagendro gantumīśvaraḥ ||58|| garuḍastvekadā pūrvaṃ matsyabhakṣaṇavāñchayā | tapataḥ saubhareryamītaṭasthasya samīpataḥ ||59|| jagrāha cañcunā mīnaṃ mīno’pi daivayogataḥ | cañcvā viyukto nikaṭe papāta saubharestadā ||1.470.6 0 || śaraṇāgatarakṣāṃ saṃkuru cetyāha mīnarāṭa | munirāha garuḍaṃ taṃ punarādātumudyatam ||6 1 || gaccha dūraṃ gaccha dūraṃ khagendra matsamīpataḥ | karomi bhasmasāttūrṇaṃ yadyāgacchasi me hradam ||62||| madīyaśāpāt tūrṇaṃ tvaṃ bhasmasād bhavitāsi vai | saubharestu vacaḥ śrutvā pracacāla khageśvaraḥ ||63 || smāraṃ smāraṃ kṛṣṇapādaṃ taṃ praṇamya jagāma ha | itihetorgaruḍaḥ sa nāyāti yamunāhradam ||64|| ato nirbhayatāmāpya kālīyastatra saṃsthitaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇasya pratāpena divyo bhakte’bhavattataḥ ||65 || gato ramaṇakaṃ khaṇḍaṃ nāginyāśchāyayā saha | mūlarūpā tu mokṣaṃ sā surasā saṃjagāma ha ||66|| nāgarūpāpi tiryañcī pātivratyaparāyaṇā | patiṃ prāptvā rakṣayitvā bhūtvā dvedhācyutārthanāt ||67|| kṛṣṇadāsyaṃ gatā dhāmni patyau chāyāpyavartayat | evaṃ rakṣā kṛtā cāpi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai ||68|| kimasti durlabhaṃ lakṣmi bhagavaddhyāyino’tra vai | paratrāpi ca daurlabhyaṃ saulabhye parivartate ||69|| tasmād dhyeyaḥ sadā kṛṣṇaḥ sukhavāñcchāprapūrakaḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya nāgabhītirna jāyate ||1.470.70|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne yamunāhradasthakālīyasarpasya pativratāyāḥ surasānāginyā bhagavatprāptiḥ patisaubhāgyasātatyaṃ, nāgabhakṣakagaruḍasya saubhariśāpāt yamunāhrade sarpasyanirbhayatā, paścād ramaṇake vāsa ityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 470 ||
<1.471> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi ca maṇḍukyāḥ kathāmuddhārakāriṇīm | ānandakānane śaṃbhormandiraṃ tvāsa śobhanam || 1 || ekā bhekī sadā tatra saṃvaste śivasannidhau | pradakṣiṇaṃ karotīyaṃ nirmālyākṣatabhakṣiṇī || 2 || ekadā sā bahiryātā vihārārthaṃ tṛṇādiṣu | kaścit kākaḥ samālokya maṇḍūkī tāmitastataḥ || 3 || saṃplavamānāmādāya cañcvā kṣetrād bahirgataḥ | varṣābhvī tena sā kṣiptā kākena kṣetrabāhyataḥ || 4 || mṛtā cañcuprahāreṇa pradakṣiṇādipuṇyataḥ | puṣpabaṭugṛhe kanyā gāndharvī sā vyajāyata || 5 || śaṃkarasya tu liṃgasya śaivālādi tu bhakṣitam | tena puṇyaprabhāveṇa śuddhā miṣṭasvarānvitā || 6 || bālyādeva nipūṇā sā saṃvyajāyata gītiṣu | nāmnā sā mādhavī sādhvī śaṃbhupativratābhavat || 7 || śubhāvayavasaṃsthānā śreṣṭhalakṣaṇalakṣitā | mahābhāgavatī jātismarā bhaktottamābhavat || 8 || samyaggītarahasyajñā nitarāṃ madhurasvarā | gāyatyeva yathākālaṃ ṣaḍjamṛṣabhaṃ vā svaram || 9 || gāndhāraṃ madhyamaṃ pañcamaṃ vā dhaivatamityapi | kvacinniṣādaṃ sā bālā gāyati pravarocchrayam || 1.471.10 || ṣaḍjagrāmairmadhyamagrāmaiśca gāndhāragrāmakaiḥ | atha tatra ṣaḍjagrāme mūrchanāḥ suyunakti sā || 11 || uttaramandāṃ ca rajanīṃ tṛtīyāmuttarāyatām | śuddhaṣaḍjāṃ matsaritāmaśvakrāntābhirudgate || 12|| evaṃ madhyamagrāmeṣu sauvīrī hāriṇāṃ tathā | aśvāṃ ca kālopatatāṃ śuddhamadhyamāṃ gīrmayīm || 13 || pauravīṃ cetyatha gāndhāragrāmeṣu tu nandikām | viśālāṃ sumukhīṃ citrāṃ citravatīṃ sukhāṃ tathā || 14|| ālāpāṃ ca yathāvāhaṃ suyunakti dhiyā satī | tānām̐stvekonapañcāśat kramātrūṭyā yunakti ca || 15|| agniṣṭomaṃ tathātyagniṣṭomaṃ ca vājapeyakam | ṣoḍaśīṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ cāśvamedhaṃ rājasūyakam || 16|| evamādīn darśayitvā karoti śubhagāyanam | tālānekottaraśataṃ dhruvaṃ sāmyaṃ tathāparān || 17|| sannipātādikān lāti gāyatyapi tathāvidhān | ṣaḍrāgān śrīṃ vasantaṃ ca paṃcamaṃ bhairavaṃ tathā || 18|| meghaṃ jaṭularāyaṇaṃ niṣkāsayati yatnataḥ | pratyekasya ca pañcāpi rāginīḥ pañca sā satī ||19|| ṣaṭtriṃśadrāgarāgiṇīḥ prakāśayati kaṇṭhataḥ | deśakālavibhedena pañcaṣaṣṭyaparāstathā || 1.471.20 || yāvanta eva tālāḥ syū rāgāstāvanta ityapi | tān sarvān nityadā sādhvī gāyati gītivedinā ||21 || mādhavī madhurālāpā oṃkāraṃ śaṃkaraṃ sadā | santoṣayati rāgādyairnartanaiḥ pūjanaiḥ stavaiḥ |||22|| prāpyāpyanarghyatāruṇyamoṃkāraṃ bahvamanyata | svabhāvacañcalaṃ cetaḥ śaṃbhau sthairyaṃ samāgamat || 23 || na vai tāṃ bādhayāñcakre kṣuttṛṇnidrāśramādikam | atandritamānasāsīnnityaṃ śaṃkarasevikā ||24|| nimeṣaṃ vighnarūpaṃ sā mene kālaṃ nirarthakam | nimeṣāntaritaḥ kālo yo yo vyartho gato mama ||25|| śivānavekṣaṇāttasya prāyaścittaṃ karoti ca | iti sañcintayantyeva sevāṃ tatyāja naiva sā ||26 || jalābhilāṣiṇī śaṃbhunāmāmṛtaṃ pibatyapi | nānyaddidṛkṣiṇī tasyā akṣiṇī śrutige hyapi ||27|| tasyāḥ karṇau śivaśabdetaraśabdagrahau na vai | atīva sundarau hastau śivārthaṃ mālikākarau |||28|| nānyatra caraṇau tasyāścarataḥ sukhavāñcchayā | nāmāntaraṃ na gṛhṇāti kvacidanyasya kasyacit || 29|| śivaṃ śaṃbhuṃ haraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ satīpatim | paraṃ patiṃ ca raṭati svāminaṃ praṇavābhidham ||1.471.30|| rasanā naiva jānāti tasyā anyada rasāntaram | sammārjanaṃ raṃgamālāḥ prāsādaṃ paritaḥ sadā ||3 1 || vidadhāti mādhavī sā pratimāpūjanaṃ mudā | pātrāṇāṃ śodhanaṃ nityaṃ mandirasya prasevanam ||32|| ye ke’pi ca hare bhaktimantasteṣāṃ samarcikā | śuśrūṣayati nityaṃ tān pitṛbuddhyātibhaktitaḥ ||33|| vaiśākhasya caturdaśyāmekavāraṃ tu mādhavī | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā divopavāsasadvratā ||34|| bhaktyā militabhakteṣu prātargateṣu vai tataḥ | sammārjanādikaṃ kṛtvā śaṃbhumabhyarcya bhāvataḥ ||35|| gāyantī madhuraṃ gītaṃ nṛtyantī nijalīlayā | dhyāyantī śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇamoṃkāreśvarabimbake ||36|| atīva dravabhāvena paśyatāṃ tu tapasvinām | anenaiva śarīreṇa pārthivena mahāmatiḥ ||37|| tatraivoṃkāramūtā sā layaṃ yātā rasātmikā | tatra jyotiṣi sā bālā jyotirmayyapi sā satī || 38|| vaiśākhaśuklapakṣasya caturdaśyā pativratā | divyabhāvaṃ gatā tatra śaṃbhustasyā vimuktaye ||39|| dadau tasyai kṛṣṇamantraṃ tulasīmālikāṃ gale | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ||1.471.40 || mantraṃ trivāraṃ tilakaṃ vaiṣṇavītvaṃ dadau haraḥ | caturbhujā satī bhūtvā yayau golokamīśvarī ||4 1 || matsyodarītaṭe kṣetre goghaṭṭaṃ ca pativratāḥ | snānti divye kṛṣṇadevālaye kurvanti darśanam ||42|| ghanaśyāmasya ye lokā akṣaraṃ te prayānti vai | pañcanade tu prāk snātvā tata oṃkārasannidhau ||43|| matsyodarīṃ tataḥ snātvā goghaṭṭe tu tataḥ param | matsyodaryudyānadakṣe śrīghanaśyāmamandire ||44|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ kāśīviśveśvaraṃ prapūjya ca | gaṇeśaṃ hanumantaṃ ca natvā mukto bhavatyapi ||45|| yadāprabhati viśveśo mandarādāgato’bhavat | kāśyāmānandavanake lakṣmīnārāyaṇo’pyaham ||46|| matsyodarītaṭe saptaśikharāḍhye sumandire | padmākāre mahāramye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāhvayaḥ ||47|| yo’haṃ golokadhāmasthaḥ kāmbhareyo’tra bhūtale | so’haṃ tatra nivasāmi pratimāyāṃ tvayā saha ||48|| mama nāma sadā viprā japanti tatra śāśvatam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tathā priye ||49 || viśveśvaraṃ tathauṃkāraṃ pūjayanti ca paṇḍitāḥ | yāvannendriyavaikalyaṃ yāvannaivāyuṣaḥ kṣayaḥ ||1.471.5 0 || yāvatsuyogaḥ puṇyasya mānasasyātibhāvanā | tāvat sevyaḥ prayatnena mokṣado bhagavān hariḥ ||5 1 || ya ānandavane śaṃbhoḥ śiśriyuḥ śrīniketanam | acalā śrīrna muñcet tānmahāsaukhyapradāyinī ||52|| imamadhyāyamākarṇya janāḥ śrīśvaramānasāḥ | vimuktāḥ sarvapāpebhyo’kṣuraṃ padamavāpnuyuḥ |||53 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne maṇḍūkyāḥ śivaprasādādane maraṇottaraṃ gāndharvītvaṃ śivapātivratyena śivālaye gāyantyā mādhavyāstasyā mokṣa ityādinirūpaṇanāmaikasaptatyadhikacatuśśakṛtayugasantāne modhyāyaḥ ||47 1 ||
<1.472> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā tvanyāṃ kathāṃ pārāvatībhavām | devālaye nivasantyāḥ pārāvatyāstu bhartari || 1 || pātivratyena dharmeṇa sevayā toṣaṇena ca | devadevaprasādena bhuktirmuktirbabhūvatuḥ || 2 || nāmnā rathantare kalpe trilocanasya mandire | pīṭhe vīrajake kṣetre ratnasātau suśobhite || 3 || dedīpyamānasauvarṇakalaśaiḥ saṃvirājite | śṛṃge pārāvatadvandvaṃ vasati sma kṛtālayam || 4 || prātaḥ sāyaṃ ca madhyāhne kurvānnityaṃ pradakṣiṇām | uḍḍīyamānaṃ paritaḥ pakṣavātairitastataḥ || |5 || rajaḥ prāsādasaṃlagnaṃ dūrīkaroti sarvadā | trilocaneti satataṃ nāma kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam || 6 || bhaktairudāhṛtaṃ tābhyāṃ tayoḥ kaṇātithīkṛtam | maṃgalārātrikaṃ tayorbhaktiṃ vardhayati dhruvam || 7 || divā bhaktajanākīrṇaṃ prāsādaṃ parito’nvaham | taṇḍulādi carantau tau prakurvāte pradakṣiṇam || 8 || prāsādikajalaṃ tā ca pibataḥ sma nalāgatam | tayoritthaṃ vicaratormahādevasamīpataḥ || 9 || agād bahutithiḥ kālo dvijayoḥ sādhuceṣṭayoḥ | atha devālayaskandhe gavākṣāntargatau kvacit || 1.472.10 || śyeno dṛṣṭvāpatad vegāt pārāvātajighṛkṣukaḥ | uḍḍīya tau gatāvantardevālayaṃ rirakṣayā || 11 || śyeno vilokayāmāsa tatra tayorvinirgamam | kathaṃ yugapadetau me grāhyau syātāmacintayat || 12|| sāyaṃ śyeno yayau sthānāntaraṃ labdhau na tau yataḥ | atha pārāvatī dakṣā patisevāparāyaṇā || 1 3|| kālaṃ pakṣiṇaṃ saṃlakṣya prāha pārāvataṃ patim | priya pārāvata prājña śyenaḥ sa prabalo ripuḥ || 14|| bhakṣayiṣyati nau nātha yāvaḥ sthānāntaraṃ prabho | vidhavātvaṃ vidhuratvaṃ yadvā dvayorvināśanam || 15|| śyenena cet kṛtaṃ syādvai mahāpattimayaṃ bhavet| | patnīvrataṃ tava svāmin mama svāmivrataṃ tathā || 16|| vilupyeta paro lokaḥ pratibadhyeta tena vai | iti śrutvā kalaravyāḥ sādhvyā prāha patistu tām || 17| durgātmamandire sādhvi nāsti cintā harāśraye | vastavyaṃ tvadyadivasāt sunipūṇatayā priye || 18|| durgastho nābhibhūyetābalo’pi kenacit kvacit | mandiraṃ durgarūpaṃ vai vartate tatra kiṃ bhayam || 19|| naitādṛśaṃ vai lapsyeta svāśrayaṃ susthalāntaram | iti pārāvatavākyaṃ śrutvā pārāvatī tadā ||1.472.20|| maunamālambya tatraiva patyuḥ pādārpitekṣaṇā | hitavartmopadiśyāpi priyapriyacikīrṣayā ||21 || sādhvyā joṣaṃ samāstheyaṃ kāryaṃ patyurvacaḥ sadā | anyedyurapyathāyātaḥ śyeno’paśyat sa dampatīm ||22|| aparicchinnayā dṛṣṭyā prāsādaṃ parito bhraman | anādhṛṣyau śṛṃgamadhye sthitau matvā yayau hi saḥ ||23|| gate’tha nabhasi śyene punaḥ pārāvatī patim | provāca preyasī nātha dṛṣṭo duṣṭo vighātakaḥ ||24|| avaśyaṃ sa kadācidvai nau vighnaṃ hi kariṣyati | tasmāt sthānāntaraṃ nātha gantavyaṃ sukhadaṃ bhavet ||25|| tasyā vākyaṃ samākarṇya punaḥ kalaravo’bravīt | kiṃ kariṣyatyasau mugdhe durge svargasamaṃ hi nau ||26|| yatra tasya praveśo na na jānāti praveśikām | devasaudhāntare vāso yogakṣemakaraḥ priye ||27|| yadi daivādgagane’pi bhavedākasmiko’bhigaḥ | tathāpi vedmi tā gatīryā na vetti mamāhitaḥ ||28|| praḍīnoḍḍīnasaṇḍīnakāṇḍavyāḍakapāṭikāḥ | sraṃsanīmaṇḍalavatī gatayo’ṣṭāvudāhṛtāḥ ||29|| bhramaṇaṃ recanaṃ syandamūrdhvayānaṃ ca vakratā | patanaṃ mūrchanaṃ baddhaṃ gatayo’ṣṭau tathāparāḥ ||1.472.3 0 || sarvā jānāmi me tatra kauśalyaṃ sarvathā priye | yathā tathāmbare nāsti pakṣiṇo’nyasya matsamam ||3 1 || sukhena tiṣṭha kā cintā mayi jīvati te priye | itipatyurvacaḥ śrutvā sā sthitā mūkavat satī ||32|| aparedyurapi śyenastatra padmaśilopari | kiyantaṃ kālamāsādyopaviṣṭo’tiprahṛṣṭahṛt ||33|| mārgaṃ tvantaḥpraveśasya bhramitvā samalokya ca | punaryayau vyomamārgaṃ dṛṣṭvā tvantaḥsthitau tu tau ||34|| atha bhītā satī pārāvatī prāha punaḥ patim | priya sthānamidaṃ tyājyaṃ śatrudṛṣṭividūṣitam ||35|| asau krūro’tivelaṃ vai samāyāti jighṛkṣayā | śrutvā priyāvacaḥ prāha kiṃ kariṣyatyasau priye ||36|| yoṣitāṃ tu nisargo’yaṃ prāyaśo bhīruvṛttitā | athetaredyurapi sa śyenaḥ prāpto jighṛkṣayā ||37|| yayorabhimukhastatra sthito yāmadvayāvadhim | punarvilokya tau śīghraṃ yayau tataśca sāha tam ||38|| nātha sthānāntaraṃ yāvo mṛtyurnau nikaṭo’tra yat | gatiste’bhihitā naikavidhātra kiṃ tavāgrahaḥ ||39|| yatra kvāpi nivatsyāvaḥ siddhirudyogasanmukhā | sopasargaṃ nijaṃ deśaṃ yo na tyajati mānavaḥ ||1.472.40|| sa paṃgurnāśamāpnoti balyapi daivavarjitaḥ | priyoditaṃ khago naiva mene bhāvidaśārditaḥ ||41 || prāha mā bhaiḥ khagāt sādhvi sthānaṃ naitādṛśaṃ param | athāparasminnahani sa śyenaḥ prātareva tu ||42|| tanmārgadeśamāsādya sāyaṃ yāvat sthito balaḥ | sūryāste tu khage yāte prāha pārāvatī patim ||43 || nātha nirgamanasyāyaṃ kālo’stīdaṃ gṛhaṃ tyaja | tyaktvā māmapi niryāhi paścād yogyaṃ bhaviṣyati ||44|| tvayi jīvati duṣprāpyaṃ na kiñcijjagatītale | punardārāḥ punarmitraṃ punarvasu punargṛham ||45|| ātmā ced rakṣitaḥ puṃsā dārairapi dhanairapi | priyo bandhurayamātmā rakṣaṇīyo mahaddhanam ||46|| dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāmayamātmārjakaḥ paraḥ | yāvadātmani vai kṣemaṃ tāvat kṣemaṃ jagattraye ||47|| ataḥ kṣemakaraṃ vākyaṃ mamaśrutvā nayānvitam | ito’nyatra vraja svāminnanyathā māṃ smariṣyasi ||48|| ityukto’pi sa vai patnyā patisevāsumedhayā | na niryayau tataḥ sthānād bhavitryā prativāritaḥ ||49|| athoṣasi samāyātaḥ śyenaḥ prāha prasahya tam | āgaccha sthānato bāhye tvadya bhakṣyo bhaviṣyasi |||1.472.50||| yadvā kṣudhitaścāhaṃ vai svārthī kaṣṭaṃ na paśyati | āgacchāmi gṛhāntaste priye vā mārayāmi vā ||51 || ityuktvāntaḥpraviśyaiva śyenena caraṇena saḥ | dhṛtaḥ khagastataścatrcvā balinā sā dhṛtā khagī |||52|| ākrośaṃ cakratustau vai na vai kenāpi rakṣitau | śyenastaṃ bhakṣituṃ sthānaṃ nirvighnaṃ cintayanmuhuḥ ||53|| vyomni saṃbhramaṇaṃ cakre tāvat khagyā sumedhayā | kathitaṃ nātha vacanaṃ tvantimaṃ me’nuvartaya ||54|| cañcvā tvātmavimuktyai tvamareḥ pādaṃ dṛḍhaṃ daśa | ityādiṣṭaścakāraivaṃ śyenaḥ pīḍāṃ jagāma ha ||55|| atyatidaṃśitaḥ śyenaścitkārān kṛtavām̐stadā | pārāvatī mukhāttasya niḥsṛtā kalayā balāt ||56|| sāpi pṛṣṭa muhuścañcvā padbhyāṃ jaghāna ghātakam | tena pārāvataścāpi muktastvākulitena vai ||57|| ubhābhyāṃ mūrchitaḥ śyeno vipadyavi samudyamāt | durbale’pyudyamavati phalaṃ bhāgyaṃ dadāti vai ||58|| praśaṃsantyudyamaṃ tasmāt sarvāvasthāsu rāgiṇaḥ | atha tau kṣatamāpannāvapi bhāgyavaśāt khalu ||59|| jīvavantau sarayvāśca nadyāstaṭe manohare | ciraṃ sāketanagare sthitvā mṛtyumupāgatau ||1.472.60|| pakṣī tatrābhavad vidyādharo mandāradāmajaḥ | anekavidyānilayo nāmnā parimalālayaḥ ||61 || kaumāraṃ vaya āsādya śivabhaktiparo’bhavat | niyamaṃ cātijagrāha brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ ||62|| ekapatnīvrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ cariṣyāmi ṛtusthitam | yāvajjīvaṃ mahādevamanarcyāśnāmi nāṇvapi ||63|| evaṃ karoti nityaṃ sa niyamaṃ tvatha sā khagī | ratnāvalīti nāmnābhūnnāgakanyā satīvṛṣā ||64|| kāmarūpadharā nityaṃ sāketāraṇyavāsinī | tasyāḥ sakhīdvayaṃ tvāsīt prabhāvatī kalāvatī ||65|| surūpe yauvanaṃ prāpte kāmarūpadhare śubhe | ratnāvalī yuvatyapi jagrāha niyamaṃ satī ||66 || śaṃbhuṃ prātaḥ saṭā dṛṣṭvā maunaṃ tyakṣyāmi nānyathā | dine dine tu sā naikavarṇagandhasupuṣpakaiḥ ||67|| mālācandanadīpādyaiḥ pūjayitvā haraṃ tataḥ | tisro’pi gītaṃ gāyanti lasadgāndhārasundaram ||68|| rāsamaṇḍalabhedaiśca lāsyaṃ tisro’pi kurvate | vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgāṃśca layatālavicakṣaṇāḥ |||69|| vādayanti mudā yuktāstisro nāgakumārikāḥ | vicitragandhamālābhiḥ sammārjanavilepanaiḥ ||1.472.70|| sevayanti haraṃ nityaṃ nṛtyagītasubhojanaiḥ | vaiśākhe tvekadā tisrastṛtīyāyāmupoṣitāḥ ||71 || cakrurjāgaraṇaṃ rātrau prātaḥ pūjāṃ pracakrire | sādhūn saṃbhojayāmāsustato madhyāhnake kṣaṇe |72|| naivedyaṃ tā dadurmiṃṣṭaṃ jalaṃ ca śaṃkarāya vai | ārārtrikaṃ pracakruśca puṣpāñjalīn daduryadā ||73|| tāvacchrīśaṃkarastuṣṭaḥ sākṣāt tāsāṃ babhūva ha | śuddhakarpūragaurāṃgo jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍalaḥ ||74|| satyadhiśritavāmorurnāgayajñopavītikaḥ | prasannavadano devaḥ kāmārirmokṣadāyakaḥ ||75|| taṃ vilokya tu tāḥ kanyā babhūvuḥ pulakāṃkitāḥ | vavandire tuṣṭuvuśca sannakaṇṭhyo’tigadgadam ||76|| jaya śaṃbho jaya bhaktavatsala prajaya prabho | jaya sādhvīpate paśupate viśvapate jaya ||77|| jaya mokṣapate bhaktapate pāvana śaṃkara | jayaste’stu namaste’stu namastubhyaṃ namo namaḥ ||78|| ityuktvā daṇḍavat bhūmau praṇipetuḥ kumārikāḥ | tāḥ samāśliṣya bhagavān samuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ ||79|| suto mandāranāmno yo nāmnā parimalālayaḥ | patirvidyādharavaro bhavatīnāṃ bhaviṣyati ||1.472.80|| ciraṃ vidyādhare loke bhogān bhuktvā samantataḥ | tato nirvedamāpannā mokṣasiddhimavāpsyatha ||8 1 || yūyaṃ tisro’pi me bhaktāḥ sa ca vidyādharo mama | catvaro’pyeta evātra prānte mokṣamavāpsyatha ||82|| janmāntare purā sevā yuṣmābhirvihitā mama | tenāpi vihitaṃ dāsyaṃ vrataṃ brahmavrataṃ tathā ||83|| tena puṇyena bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam | gururme bhavatīnāṃ ca mokṣadātā bhaviṣyati ||84|| bhavantu ca mahābhāgyavatyaḥ kṛṣṇapativratāḥ | ahaṃ japāmi sarveśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim ||85|| bhavatyo’pi bhajantyenaṃ gṛhṇantvasya manuṃ param | prasādaṃ ca jalaṃ tvetad gṛhṇantvacyutasevitam ||86|| iti kṛtvā harastābhyo dadau manuṃ sumokṣadam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa svāmine namaḥ ||87|| trivāraṃ sampradāyaiva dadau tulasikādalam | tulasīmālikāṃ cāpi kaṇṭhe kare ca sandadau ||88|| binduṃ dadau lalāṭe’tha candanasya haraḥ svayam | evaṃ datvātu vidhinā pratimāṃ maṇinirmitām ||89|| prāha svasti sadā cāstvakhaṇḍasaubhāgyamacyute | vaiṣṇavītvaṃ sadā kṛṣṇe dāsyaṃ pativrataṃ tathā ||1.472.90|| ārādhanaṃ tathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’stu sarvadā | patisevā kṛṣṇasevā vinā bhedaṃ sadāstu vaḥ ||91 || ityuktvā śirasi datvā karaṃ tvadṛśyatāṃ gataḥ | tāstu prahṛṣṭahṛdayā gatvā gṛhaṃ jagurmudā |||92|| divyabhāvaṃ samāpannā bhittyādyāvaraṇādibhiḥ | aniruddhā vyomamārgagatayaḥ kamalā yathā ||93|| pūrvajātismarāḥ satyo brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ | kṛṣṇabhaktiparāḥ śaṃbhorādeśāt sāttvatīmukhāḥ ||94|| jīvanmuktāḥ prasañjātāḥ svatantragatikā iha | lakṣmi pārāvataḥ pūrve dvijo nārāyaṇāhvayaḥ |||95||| āmuṣyāyaṇaputro’bhūt pitṛśuśrūṣaṇavrataḥ | sarpadaṃṣṭo mṛtaścātha so’yaṃ pārāvato’bhavat ||96|| cārāyaṇasya putryau dve bhavānī gautamī tathā | āmuṣyāyanaputrasya patnī nārāyaṇasya te ||97|| vaidhavyaduḥkhamāpanne dainyagraste babhūvatuḥ | atharṣeḥ kasyacid daivādāśrame paramādbhute ||98|| raṃbhāphalāni saṃgṛhya khādataḥ sma tadā muneḥ | śāpātte kanyake naṣṭe vānaryau te babhūvatuḥ ||99|| jale patitvā tatyajatuḥ prāṇām̐stīrthottame tataḥ | te jāte nāgakanye vai devālayāśramāśrayāt ||1.472.1 0 0|| kṛṣṇadharmapare sādhvyau prabhāvatī kalāvatī | parimalālayavidyādharapatnyāḥ sakhīdvayam || 101 || pitṛbhyāṃ te premavatyau jñātvā vidyādhare śubhe | parimalālaye paścāttasmai datte vivāhite || 1 02|| evaṃ patnītrayaṃ ratnāvalī prabhā kalāvatī | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe raktā pātivratyaparāyaṇā || 103 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nityaṃ bhajante sma sukhānvitāḥ | pūjāṃ japaṃ ca naivedyaṃ stutiṃ nīrājanaṃ kṣamām || 1 04|| puṣpāṃjaliṃ prakurvanti nityaṃ naimittikotsavān | kārtike kṛṣṇapakṣe tā aṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇapūjanam || 1 05|| jayantīṃ tā abhipretya kṛṣṇavrataṃ pracakrire | golokāttu svayaṃ kṛṣṇo rādhāramāprabhāpatiḥ || 106 || ājagāma vimānena netuṃ tāḥ patisaṃyutāḥ | divyaṃ svaṃ darśanaṃ datvā nītvā vimānakottame || 1 07 || yayau golokamevāsau muktiṃ dāsyātmikāṃ dadau | vad lakṣmi na kṛṣṇāgre bhaktānāṃ bhinnabhāvanā || 1 08|| yatra kvāpi prasūto’pi bhakto haripadaṃ labhet | sarve vai bālakāstasya kṛṣṇānārāyaṇasya vai || 1 09|| taṃ bhajitvā prayāntyeva paramaṃ dhāma śāśvatam | śrīkṛṣṇasya kathāmetāṃ śrutvā pāpād vimucyate || 1.472.1 10 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pārāvatadampatyau śivamandirāśrayeṇa vidyādharajanma lalabhatuḥ, parimalālayavidyādharasya ratnāvalīprabhāvatīkalāvatīpatnītrayam, kārtikakṛṣṇāṣṭamīvratena kṛṣṇapātivratyena catvāro’pi te muktiṃ jagmuritinirūpaṇanāmā dvāsaptatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||472||
<1.473> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi dharmapīṭhe kṣetre tvānandakānane | camatkāro’bhavad dharmatapasyāyā vadāmi tam || 1 || dharmapīṭhaṃ taduktaṃ vai kṣetre tvānandakānane | tatpīṭhadarśanādeva janaḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 2 || purā vivasvataḥ putro yamī dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ | tapastatāpa tatkṣetre lokānugrahakāraṇāt || 3 || śiśire jalamadhyastho varṣāsvabhrāvakāśakaḥ | tapatau pañcavahnisthaḥ kadācittvativātagaḥ || 4 || pādāgrāṅguṣṭhabhūsparśī bahukālaṃ sa tasthivān | ekapādasthitaḥ so’pi bahukālaṃ tataḥ punaḥ || |9 || samīrābhyavahartāsīt tataḥ papau jalaṃ manāk | kuśāgramātreṇa tadbindūn tataścāhāravarjitaḥ || 6 || divyāṃ caturyugīmitthaṃ sa nināya tapaścaran | caturguṇaṃ didṛkṣuḥ śrīśaṃkaraṃ vai samādhinā || 7 || śaṃkarastasya tapasā santuṣṭaḥ sthiracetasaḥ | yayau tasmai varān dātu dharmarūpāya sākṣiṇe || 8 || pratyavocattu taṃ dharma varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam | dṛṣṭvā sa māṃ praṇanāma cakāra stavanaṃ tathā || 9 || vavre saṃhārakṛdrūpaṃ mama draṣṭuṃ tadānaghaḥ | mayā pradarśitaṃ tasmai bhayānakaṃ mamaiva tat || 1.473.1 0|| mahārudrasvarūpaṃ yat saṃkarṣaṇasvarūpakam | atha tvaṃ matsvarūpo’si dharmarājo bhaveti vai || 1 1| samastadehināṃ dharmādhikāre śāsanaṃ kuru | karmasākṣī ca jantūnāṃ bhava sarvajña ityapi || 1 2|| dharmakṣetramidaṃ sarvavāñchāprapūrakaṃ tathā | mokṣadaṃ bhavatu prāṇipāpaprajvālanakṣamam || 13| dharmeśvaraṃ mama rūpaṃ tava nāmnā bhavatvapi | gṛhāṇa tvaṃ kṛṣṇamantraṃ vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo bhava || 14|| ityuktvā dharmarājāya dadau mantraṃ maheśvaraḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya brahmaṇe namaḥ || 15| mālāṃ kaṇṭhe ca vṛndāyā dadau kare japārthikām | lalāṭe candrakaṃ cakre tvāśīrvādān dadau bahūn || 16 | nyāyopadeśaṃ bahudhā dadau śrīśaṃkaraḥ svayam | sukhaṃ dharmaphalaṃ proktaṃ svecchāviṣayameva tat || 17| duḥkhaṃ tvicchāvighātau vai duṣkarmaṇāṃ tu tatphalam | svargaṃ sukhaṃ tu devānāmārādhanena jāyate || 18||| sādhanānāṃ sukhaṃ pūrṇaṃ dānenaiva prajāyate | anyātmanāṃ pratuṣṭyaivānandārthi jīvanaṃ bhavet || 1 9||| parapīḍākaraṃ sarvaṃ svasyāpi duḥkhadaṃ bhavet | paropakāraḥ kartavyaḥ kartavyaṃ tvātmadarśanam |||1.473.20||| kṛṣṇārādhanabhaktyādi kartavyaṃ mokṣaṇāya ca | loke vai sampadaḥ puṃsāṃ prāgdānena bhavanti hi ||21 | yanna dattaṃ tanna labhyaṃ tasmād dharmaṃ samācaret | kṛtasya phaladānaṃ vai sarvatra niyamaḥ kṛtaḥ ||22| śubhasya cāśubhasyāpi tvayā kāryo vinirṇayaḥ | tatra tatra phalaṃ tebhyo dāsyatyeva janārdanaḥ ||23| indriyāṇāṃ svabhāvena bhogaḥ pāpaṃ na tanmatam | anyāyena kṛto bhogaḥ pāpaṃ prasahya jāyate ||24| prasannabhāvanājanyaṃ karma santoṣakārakam | adrohaṃ naiva pāpāya puṇyaṃ santoṣadaṃ tu tat ||25| kṛṣṇe samarpaṇaṃ sarvaṃ niṣkāmaṃ mokṣadaṃ tu tat | tasmād dharmaḥ sadā kāryaḥ kāryaṃ mokṣapradaṃ vratam ||26|| parātmahiṃsanaṃ tvanyadrohastathānyanindanam | anyāpaharaṇaṃ tadvadudvejanaṃ parātmanām |||27| etatpāpapradaṃ proktaṃ tadanyatpuṇyakṛtparam | teṣāṃ phalaṃ yathāyogyaṃ dehi dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ||28| yāhītyukvā ca pāṇibhyāṃ mṛḍaḥ pasparśa taṃ vṛṣam |, sūryaputraḥ punaḥ prāha he nātha prārthayāmyaham ||29| he śaṃbho kīraḍimbhānāṃ matpuraḥprāptajanmanām | amīṣāṃ pitṛhīnānāṃ śukī mātā mṛtiṃ gatā ||1.473.3 0|| śukaḥ śyenena sahasā bhakṣitaśca tato mayā | rakṣitānāmanāthānāmitihāsakathāvidām ||3 1 || varado bhava deveśetyuktvā maunaparo’bhavat | atha śaṃbhuḥ śukānāha ko varo bhavatāṃ kṛte ||32|| deyo mayeti saṃśrutvā śukaśāvā jagustu tam | pakṣiṇāmapi deveśa darśanaṃ te mahaddhanam ||33|| etattapasviyogena janmāntarasahasrajām | kathāṃ vidmo vayaṃ nātha smarāmo devakoṭiṣu ||34|| daityeṣu bhogiṣu niśācareṣu kinnareṣu ca | vidyādhreṣu gandharveṣu manuṣyeṣu jaleṣu ca ||35|| sthaleṣvapi vaneṣvapi vivareṣu bhuvo’ntare | yācitṛṣu ca dātṛṣu rakṣakeṣu ca ghātiṣu || 36|| sukhiteṣu duḥkhiteṣu mūrkheṣu paṇḍiteṣu ca | svāmiṣu sevakeṣvanyabhūtātmakeṣu śākhiṣu ||37|| janmāni tatprakāryāṇi smarāmo’sya prabhāvataḥ | ito yonestato yonau tato yonestato’nyataḥ || 38 || pinākin kvāpi na prāpi sukhaleśo manāgapi | idānīṃ tvāṃ samīkṣyaiva kṛtakṛtyā babhūvima ||39|| athāpi cedbhaved deyaṃ varadānaṃ kṛpā tava | dehi jñānaṃ yena muktā bhavāmo bhavabandhanāt ||1.473.40|| karāmalakavat sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍagolakādikam | asmadvāggocare’styeva dharmasānnidhyasevanāt ||41 || dharmarājasya tapasā jātāḥ smo jñānabhājanam | śrutveti kīrabālānāṃ tānuvāca śivāpatiḥ ||42||| kāśyāmānandavanake dharmapīṭhe mama gṛham | mokṣalakṣmīvilāsākhyaṃ maṇiratnādinirmitam ||43|| patattriṇo’pi mucyante yatkurvāṇāḥ pradakṣiṇam | bindumādhavarūpeṇa dharmanade vasāmyaham ||44|| naye pañcanadasnātān tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam | dharmapīṭhe bālakīrā yūyaṃ vai jñānabhājanam ||45|| jātāḥ stha tat pragṛhṇīdhvaṃ manuṃ vai vaiṣṇavaṃ param | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||46|| gṛhṇīdhvaṃ tulasīmālāṃ japatānvahamacyutam | dehānte divyayānena gantāstho’cyutadhāma yat ||47|| ityuktvā ca kīrān kṛtvā vaiṣṇavān bhagavān haraḥ | antardhānaṃ jagāmātha dharmakṣetre ca te kīrāḥ ||48|| bhajante śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ rādhāpatiṃ prabhum | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāṃ vācayanti ca ||49|| nityaṃ kalpāntarakathāḥ śrāvayanti janān śukāḥ | kāmarūpadharā vijñā vidvāṃso vai dvijottamāḥ ||1.473.50|| evaṃ kṛṣṇapātivratyaparāste hyabhavan sadā | kṛṣṇapūjāṃ kṛṣṇakathāṃ cakrurnityaṃ vihaṃgamāḥ ||51 || tatraikadā samāyātā paulomī vratakāminī | manorathavrataṃ cakre tatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ ||52|| nityaṃ tāṃ śrāvayantyete kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitātmikāṃ mokṣadāyinīm ||53|| kathāṃ śrutvā śacī bhaktyārcayat kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirdharmakṣetre nadītaṭe ||54|| pañcanade pūjayitvā śivaṃ viśveśvaraṃ vibhum | śacī nityaṃ pūjayati karoti nartanaṃ tathā ||55|| gītena sarahasyena kalakaṇṭhīkalena ca | tadgānenātisantuṣṭo haraḥ sākṣād babhūva ha ||56|| uvāca tvaṃ varaṃ brūhi prasanno’smi pulomaje | śacī prāha prasannaścenmanorathaṃ prapūraya ||57|| sarvadeveṣu yo mānyaḥ sarvadeveṣu sundaraḥ | yāyajūkeṣu sarveṣu yaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ so’stu me patiḥ ||58|| yathābhilaṣitaṃ rūpaṃ yathābhilaṣitaṃ sukham | yathābhilaṣitaṃ cāyuḥ prasanno dehi me bhava ||59|| yadā yadā tu patyā me saṅgaḥ syāt sukhavāñcchayā | tadā tadā tu taddehaṃ tyaktvānyadehamāpnuyām ||1.473.60 || bharturvyaye’pi vaidhavyaṃ kṣaṇamātraṃ na me bhavet | pātivratyaṃ śāśvataṃ me patināśe’pi cāstu vai ||61|| itivṛṇomi bhagavannakhaṇḍitasubhāgyatām | etacchrutvā mahādevo jahāsa samuvāca tām ||62|| kuru vrataṃ manorathatṛtīyāyāḥ śubhe śuci | tena vratena cīrṇena mahāsaubhāgyadena tu ||63|| avaśyaṃ bhavitā ceṣṭastava caivaṃ manorathaḥ | pūjyā viśvabhujā gaurī bhujaviṃśatiśālinī ||64|| varado’bhavahastaśca sākṣasūtraḥ samodakaḥ | devyāḥ purastād vratinyā pūjya āśāvināyakaḥ ||65|| caitraśukladvitīyāyāṃ gṛhṇīyānniyamaṃ śubham | brahmacaryaṃ bhūśayanaṃ prātarutthāya vai śuci ||66|| aśokavṛkṣasya śubhaṃ kuryādvai dantadhāvanam | anyat sarvaṃ nityakarma vidhāya snānamācaret ||67|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃśaṃ taṃ gaṇeśaṃ samapūjya ca | ghṛtapūrān vinivedya gaurīpūjāṃ samācaret ||68|| aśokakusumaiḥ śreṣṭhairaśokavartidhūpanaiḥ | dīpairnaivedyakairnānāvidhaiḥ saṃbhojayet satīm ||69|| evaṃ kuṃkumaśobhāḍhyā hyekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ caret | evaṃ caitratṛtīyāyāmārabhya phālgunāvadhim ||1.473.70|| dvādaśatṛtīyānāṃ vai vrataṃ manorathapradam | yathālabdhopacārairvai pavitraiḥ pracared vratam ||71 || vratasampūrtaye kuryāt sthaṇḍile’gnisamarcanam | śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ homaṃ tilājyādibhirācaret ||72|| sadaiva nakte pūjoktā sadā nakte tu bhojanam | nakta eva hi homo’yaṃ nakta eva kṣamāpanam ||73|| namo’stu te viśvabhuje pūrayāśu manorathān | nama āśāgaṇeśāya mama dehi manoratham ||74|| ācāryaṃ pūjayed dānaṃ dadyāt yathābalaṃ vratī | dadyāt payasvinīṃ gāṃ ca vratasya paripūrtaye ||75|| prātaścaturthyāṃ caturo bhojayitvā kumārakān | yadvā dvādaśa saṃpūjya satībuddhyā kumārikāḥ ||76|| dadyād dānāni vidhinā vratametat sunirmalam | patnīṃ manoramāṃ kulyāṃ manovṛttyanusāriṇīm ||77|| tāriṇīṃ duḥkhasaṃsārasāgarasya pativratām | kurvannetadvrataṃ varṣaṃ kumāraṃ prāpnuyāt sphuṭam ||78|| kumārī patimāpnoti svāḍhyaṃ sarvaguṇādhikam | suvāsinī labhetputrān patyuḥ saukhyamakhaṇḍitam ||79|| durbhagā subhagā syācca daridrā syāddhanānvitā | vidhavāpi na vaidhavyaṃ punarāpnoti kutracit ||1.473.80|| gurviṇī tu śubhaṃ putraṃ labhate sucirāyuṣam | yo yo manoratho yasya taṃ taṃ dhruvaṃ sa vindati ||8 1 || vrataṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā caindri naiva siddhyati sarvathā | tasmād gṛhāṇa mantraṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ||82|| vaiṣṇavī bhava cendrāṇi tataḥ siddhimavāpsyasi | avaiṣṇavakṛtaṃ vyarthaṃ vrataṃ dānaṃ japastapaḥ ||83|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | japaṃ kuru sadā tanvi gṛhāṇa tulasīsrajam ||84|| kaṇṭhe dhāraya vṛndāyā mālāṃ binduṃ lalāṭake | hṛdaye śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ svasvāminaṃ patim ||85|| evaṃ kṛtvā vraja gehaṃ kuru vrataṃ phalaṃ bhavet | arundhatyā vasiṣṭho’pi labdho’triranasūyayā ||86|| sunītyottānapādācca dhruvaḥ prāpto’ṅgajottamaḥ | sunīterdurbhagatvaṃ tu punarasmād vratād gatam ||87| caturbhujaḥ patiḥ prāptaḥ kṣīrābdhikanyayā tathā | tasmād vrataṃ prakartavyaṃ vaiṣṇavyā tattathā kuru |||88|. ityuktā sā śacī jātā vaiṣṇavī prayayau gṛham | vrataṃ kṛtavatī sādhvī kṛṣṇapativratānvitā |||89|. brahmacaryaparā tvekabhuktavatī hi vatsaram | bhūśayānā saniyamā vratānte cendrakāmyayā ||1.473.90|| udvāhitā surendreṇa kṛtā kalpāyuṣī satī | yathā yathābhilaṣitaṃ tathā tasyā hyabhūt phalam || 91 || iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi vratasya phalanaṃ śubham | kīrabālāḥ śacī ceti vaiṣṇavāḥ kalpanāśane ||92|| yayurgolokadhāmābhidhyeya kṛṣṇapadāmbujam | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktiḥ subhāgyatā |||92|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sūryaputrasya tapasā dharmarājatvaṃ, kīrabālānāṃ sārvajñyaṃ, paulomyā indrapatnītvaṃ, teṣāṃ vaiṣṇavatvaṃ, tato muktiḥ, manorathavrataṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trisaptatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 473 ||
<1.474> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ ramyāmamitrajinnṛpasya vai | mayi nārāyaṇe pātivratyayuktāṃ kuṭumbinaḥ || 1 || amitrajinmahārājaḥ paramo vaiṣṇavo’bhavat | sarvarājanyaguṇadhīḥ sarvadūṣaṇavarjitaḥ || 2 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe deve cetovṛttiṃ nidhāya saḥ | cakāra rājyaṃ nirdvandvaṃ viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 3 || abhunak pracurān bhogān samastān viṣṇusātkṛtān | harerāyatanānyuccaiḥ pratisaudhaṃ pade pade || 4 || tasya rājye samabhavan gṛhāṇi mandirāṇi ca | govinda gopa gopāla gopagopīśvareśvara || 5 || guṇātīta garuḍastha kṛpālo kamalāpate | kṛṣṇa keśava kaṃjākṣa kīnāśabhayanāśaka || 6 || puruṣottama padmeśa puṇḍarīkavilocana | pītāmbara prabhānātha pārvatīśa pareśvara || 7 || janārdana jayāsvāmin janmamṛtyujarāhara | śrīvatsavakṣaḥ śrīkānta śrīprada śreyasāṃprada || 8 || dāmodara dayāsindho māṇikīśvara cakradhṛk | viṣṇo nārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narottama || 9 || akṣareśa ca rādheśa kambhareśa hṛdisthita | ityādīni pavitrāṇi nāmāni pratimandiram || 1.474.10|| strībālavṛddhagopālavadanodīritāni tu | śrūyante cāpi dṛśyante ramyāṇi mokṣadāni vai || 11 || tulasīkānanānyeva vilokyante gṛhe gṛhe | caritrāṇi sugīyante pavitrāṇi harerjanaiḥ || 12|| saudhabhittiṣu dṛśyante pratimā līlayānvitā | ṛte hareḥ kathāyāśca nānyā vārtā niśamyate || 1 3||| yadrājye naiva hiṃsāsti dveṣo nāsti parasparam | hanyante naiva cāhitāḥ kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇāḥ || 14|| api bālāstathā vṛddhāstasya rāṣṭre striyo’pi ca | payaḥpānaṃ na kurvanti samprāpya harivāsaram || 16|| paśavo’pi tṛṇāhāraṃ tyajanti harivāsare | mahāmahotsavaḥ sarvaiḥ puraukobhirvitanyate || 16|| sa eva daṇḍyo yo bhuṃkte samprāpte harivāsare | antyajā api tadrāṣṭre śaṃkhacakrāṃkadhāriṇaḥ || 17|| kṛṣṇa eva paro devaḥ kṛṣṇa eva parā gatiḥ | kṛṣṇa eva paro bandhustasyāsīdavanīśituḥ || 18|| etad draṣṭuṃ nāradarṣiḥ samāyayau tadā kvacit | rājñā samarcitaḥ prāha rājānaṃ nārado muniḥ || 1 9|| dhanyo’si kṛtakṛtyo’si mānyo’pyasi divaukasām | sarvabhūteṣu govindaṃ yastvaṃ paśyasi bhaktarāṭ ||1.474.2 0 || etādṛśaṃ vilokya tvāṃ śucitvamagamaṃ tvaham | eka eva hi sāro’tra bhaktibhāvaḥ pareśvare ||21 || kṛṣṇaṃ bhajantaṃ bhajante padārthāḥ sarva eva tu | kṛṣṇe sthiratvamāptasya yogaḥ siddho vimuktidaḥ ||22|| yauvanaṃ dhanamāyuṣyaṃ jñātvā padme tu vārivat | śāśvataṃ kṛṣṇacaraṇaṃ mokṣadaṃ prasamāśrayet ||23 || hṛdi netre ca jihvāyāṃ rakṣaṇīyo janārdanaḥ | so’pi janārdano bodhyo janārdanasamāśrayāt ||24|| niṣkāmasevayā śrīśaṃ pūjayitvā ramāpatim | puruṣottamatāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ prāpnuyānmānave bhave ||25||| rājaṃste śrīkṛṣṇabhaktyā prasanno bhagavān hariḥ | preṣayāmāsa māmatra bhaktakāryakaraḥ svayam || 26|| śṛṇu vidyādharaputrī kṛṣṇabhaktātisundarī | kṛṣṇapātivratyaparā nāmnā malayagandhinī || 27|| krīḍantī piturākroḍe hṛtā kaṃkālaketunā | dānavaścampakāvatyāṃ nagaryāmadya vartate ||28|| sa svatriśūlaghātena mariṣyanti tvayā nṛpa | adya nidrāti paryaṃke pārśve kṛtvā triśūlakam |||29|| kanyā sā dāsyati tubhyaṃ vañcayitvā triśūlakam | gaccha śīghraṃ kṛṣṇabhaktāṃ rakṣa hastaṃ gṛhāṇa ca ||1.474.3 0 || ityuktaḥ sa yayau diṣṭamārgeṇa nṛpatirgṛṇan | kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca ||3 1 || nagaryāṃ sa praviṣṭaśca yatra saudhe’sti kanyakā | praviveśa tu taṃ saudhaṃ kanyāṃ jagāda caikalām ||32|| nāradasyopadeśena tava rakṣārthamatra vai | samāgato’smi daityaṃ ca hantuṃ triśūlakena vai || 3 3|| sā vilokya samākarṇya viśvastābhūt sukanyakā | darśayāmāsa taṃ śūlaṃ rājā śūlena dānavam ||34|| jaghāna śrīhariṃ gṛṇan mṛto’sau dānavo balī | surūpaṃ rakṣakaṃ bhūpaṃ provāca madhuraṃ satī ||25|| athodāramate vīra nijaprāṇaiḥ paṇīkṛtām | gṛhāṇa māṃ varārohāṃ kulakanyāmadūṣitām ||36|| iti bruvatyāṃ kanyāyāṃ nārado’tarkito muniḥ | āyayau tau tutuṣaturdṛṣṭvā taṃ munisattamam ||37|| pāṇigraheṇa vidhinābhiṣiktau nāradena tau | jagmaturnāradādiṣṭavartmanā kṛtamaṃgalau ||38|| kāśīṃ tvāyayatustau ca manyamānau kṛtārthatām | saikadā taṃ patiṃ rājñī patibhaktā sutārthinī ||39|| raho vijñāpayāñcakre kartuṃ putrapradaṃ vratam | mārgaśuklatṛtīyāyāmabhīṣṭatṛtīyāvratam ||1.474.40 || rājñādiṣṭā bhaktanārī cacāra tadvrataṃ śubham | pativratā bhāgavatī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe ratā ||41 || kṛṣṇapativratā sādhvī tvābālyād vaiṣṇavī satī | purā kuberapatnyā vai ṛddhyākhyayā kṛtaṃ vratam |||42||| sāpi prāptavatī putraṃ samarthaṃ nalakūbaram | pūjyātra pārvatī devī stanandhayayutāsatī ||43 || mārge śukle tṛtīyāyāṃ suvarṇakalaśopari | tāmrapātraṃ nidhāyaikaṃ taṇḍulaiḥ paripūritam ||44|| nūtnaṃ saraṃgaṃ vastraṃ ca nidhāya tatra sūkṣmakam | tatra satkamalaṃ nyasya yadvā svarṇavinirmitam ||45|| brahmāṇīṃ pūjayet tatra ratnapaṭṭāmbarādibhiḥ | puṣpaiḥ phalaiśca nāraṃgaiḥ sugandhaiścandanādibhiḥ ||46 || paramānnādinaivedyaiḥ pakvānnaiśca jalādibhiḥ | dhūpairdīpaiḥ stavanaiśca nīrājanādibhistathā ||47|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt sotsavaṃ harikīrtanaiḥ | hastamātramite kuṇḍe jātavedasetyṛcā ||48|| ghṛtena madhunāplāvya juhuyān mantraviddvijaḥ | sahasrakamalānāṃ tu homaṃ kuryād vratī mudā ||49|| navaprasūtāṃ kapilāṃ dhenuṃ dadyād dvijātaye | upoṣya dampatī bhaktyā caturthyāṃ tu dvijātaye ||1.474.50|| datvā sadbhojanaṃ dānaṃ vastrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca | ācāryāya dhanaṃ mūrtiṃ dadyātāṃ gāṃ ca dakṣiṇām |||51 || bhojayitvātha taṃ paścāt stuvīyātāṃ puṭāñjalī | sutaṃ vaṃśakaraṃ dehi tuṣṭā śivā ramā hyajā ||52||| bhuktaśeṣeṇa cānnena kuryātāṃ pāraṇaṃ tataḥ | evaṃ kṛtaṃ vrataṃ tābhyāṃ dampatībhyāṃ sutapradam ||53|| pūjanānte śivā lakṣmīḥ sāvitrī tvāgatāḥ puraḥ | smerānanāḥ śubhāśiṣo datvāntardhānamāgatāḥ ||54|| tataḥ sā kāntasevābhirantarvatnī babhūva ha | tayā tu prārthito divyaḥ putro viṣṇvaṃśasaṃbhavaḥ ||95|| jātamātro vrajet svargaṃ punarāyād gṛhaṃ prati | bhaktaḥ sadā trideveṣu prasiddho bhuvanatraye ||56|| vinaiva stanyapānena ṣoḍaśābdākṛtiḥ kṣaṇāt | sarvasāmarthyasampanno vaiṣṇavānāṃ sadāgraṇīḥ ||57|| atha kālena tanayaṃ mūlarkṣe sāpyajījanat | atha ṛkṣābhividbhiḥ sā vijñaptāriṣṭasaṃsthitā ||58|| devī rājārthinī cet tvaṃ tyaja duṣṭarkṣajaṃ sutam | sā tu śrutvā mahābhaktā sarvathā patidevatā ||59|| atyākṣīt taṃ tathā prāptaṃ tanayaṃ nayakovidā | vikaṭāyā mahāgauryāḥ puro nyasya gṛhaṃ gatā ||1.474.60|| gauryārpitaḥ sa yoginyai yoginī vyomamārgataḥ | yayau yatra vasantyeva rakṣikā navamātaraḥ ||61 || brahmāṇī vaiṣṇavī raudrī vārāhī nārasiṃhikā | kaumārī cāpi māhendrī cāmuṇḍā cāpi caṇḍikā ||62|| dṛṣṭvā taṃ vālakaṃ prāptaṃ tā ūcuḥ sundaraṃ sutam | rājyayogyo bhavatveṣa mahālakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ ||63 || punastatraiva netavyo yatrāsya janma vidyate | ṣoḍaśābdo jātamātro bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ ||64|| evaṃ mātṛgaṇāśīrbhiḥ prāpito janmanaḥ sthale | ānandakānane divyaṃ tatāpa sa paraṃ tapaḥ ||65|| tapasā tu prasanno’bhūcchivastvāvirbabhūva ha | provāca taṃ varaṃ brūhi dadāmyatra tavepsitam ||66|| sa tu praṇamya śaṃbhuṃ vai parituṣṭāva bhāvataḥ | varaṃ ca prārthayāñcakre yadi deyo varo mama ||67|| mama nāmnā bhavet tīrthaṃ vīravīreśvarāhvayam | tathāstviti haraḥ prāha tato’yaṃ bālakaḥ punaḥ ||68|| varaṃ vavre mama muktirbhaved golokadhāmani | haraḥ prāha vinā kṛṣṇaṃ sā muktirnahi labhyate ||69|| gṛhāṇa kṛṣṇamantraṃ tvaṃ bhava bhakto viśeṣataḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyeti muhurjapa ||1.474.70||| tulasīmālikāṃ kaṇṭhe kare cāpi gṛhāṇa vai | ityuktvā pradadau mantraṃ kṛtaḥ sa vaiṣṇavo mahān ||71 || āha taṃ śaṃkaraḥ paścājjaneturvaiṣṇavottamāt | viṣṇoraṃśaḥ samutpanno bhavān bhakto mamāpi ca ||72|| tvaṃ tu rājyaṃ paraṃ prāpya sarvabhūpāladurlabham | bhuktvā bhogāṃśca vipulānante muktimavāpsyasi ||73|| patnīṃ pativratāṃ prāpya labdhvā putrāṃśca tatsutān | śrīviṣṇordivyayānena golokaṃ yāsyasi dhruvam ||74|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||75|| kurutaṃ saṃjapaṃ nityaṃ tvaṃ tathā bhāvinī satī | pativratāpi te kāntā mokṣamāpsyatha taṃ param ||76|| ityuktvā śaṃkarastvantardhānaṃ jagāma tatparam | vīravīro mahābāhurjajāpa taṃ manuṃ muhuḥ ||77|| bhāryā kailāsarājasya nṛpateḥ putrikāṃ satīm | nāmnā vasumatīṃ prāpya samutpādya śataṃ sutān ||78|| yayau golokamokṣaṃ sa bhāryayā saha bhaktarāṭ | divyayānena vai bhaktaprajābhiḥ saha pārthivaḥ ||79|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇam | dampatyoḥ pāvanaṃ vṛttaṃ śrotṝn vaktṝm̐śca pāvayet ||1.474.80|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne amitrajinnṛpaternāradasya kṛpayā pativratāstrīprāptiḥ tathā malayagandhinyā bhāryayā kāśyāmabhīṣṭatṛtīyāvratena vīravīro mahāvaiṣṇavaḥ sutaḥ prāptaḥ, pativratayā sahitasya rājño goloke muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥsaptatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 474 ||
<1.475> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi durvāsaso’tikaṣṭadam | kadalyāścaritaṃ paścājjñānena mokṣadaṃ param || 1 || patnīvrataṃ tu muninā vāgdānāvasare dhṛtam | kṣamāmayaṃ tathā samyag vairāgyadaṃ tapaḥkaram || 2 || baleḥ putraḥ sāhasiko vane tilottamāyutaḥ | ratiṃ cakāra vijane divā kāmena mohitaḥ || 3 || yatra durvāsaso dehe valmīkastapato’bhavat | durvāsāstvāntaradṛṣṭyā jñātavām̐staṃ baleḥ sutam || 4 || amaryādaṃ śaśāpāpi dhenuko bhava dānavaḥ | kharavad vartase yasmāt sannidhau mama cāśrame || 5 || kharo bhava vane ceyaṃ tilottamāpi bāṇajā | uṣāniruddhapatnī ca bhavatviti śaśāpa vai || 6 || uṣā śaśāpa taṃ durvāsasaṃ tvaṃ pīḍitaḥ striyā | bhavātiduḥkhitaḥ kāmamohitaśceti vai tadā || 7 || tena doṣeṇa durvāsāḥ kāmavānabhavat kvacit | tadā tatrāgamadaurvanāmarṣiḥ svasutāyutaḥ || 8 || ūrūdbhavo brahmaṇastu purā kalpe tapasyataḥ | ūrdhvaretā hi yogīndra aurvasteneti sa smṛtaḥ || 9 || tasya jānūdbhavā kanyā kadalīnāma viśrutā | durvāsasaṃ prārthayantī nānyaṃ manasi rocate || 1.475.1 0|| sutāyukto muniraurvo durvāsasaṃ nanāma ha | durvāsāśca praṇanāma samuttasthau mudānvitaḥ || 11 || aurvo durvāsasaṃ proce kanyakāyā manoratham | kadalī mama kanyeyaṃ dhyāyantī tvāṃ smaratyapi || 1 2||| sarvarūpaguṇādhārā doṣeṇaikena saṃyutā | atīva kalahāviṣṭā kopena gālikābruvā || 13 || nānāguṇayutaṃ vastu na tyajedekadoṣataḥ | aurvasya vacanaṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā kanyāṃ susundarīm || 14 || navayauvanasampannāṃ munirmumoha kāmataḥ | uvācaurvaṃ sukhayatā hṛdayena vidūyatā || 15|| nārī narasya saṃsāre muktimārganirodhikā | vyavadhānaṃ tapasyāyā mohapāśanibandhinī || 16|| kārāgārākhyasaṃsāre durvahaṃ nigaḍaṃ tu sā | ato me dhyāyataḥ kṛṣṇapādābjaṃ vighna āgataḥ || 17|| enaṃ mohaṃ phalaṃ tilottamāśāpasya vedmyaham | aurva me rocate naiva saṃsāro yadyapi kṣayaḥ || 18|| tavājñāṃ mastake kṛtvā grahīṣyāmi sutāṃ tava | upetāṃ kāminīṃ tyaktvā bhayaṃ syānnāśakārakam || 1 9|| rahasyupasthitāṃ kāmād gṛhṇīyānnāśasaṃkare | kintvatininditaḥ sa syāt strījitaścet sadā bhavet ||1.475.20|| aurva tvaṃ tu svayaṃ cātra kanyayā saha cāgataḥ | dātuṃ mahyaṃ hi te kanyāṃ tato’smi dharmasaṃkaṭe ||2 1 || vināśāpekṣayā grāhyo dharma eva sanātanaḥ | grahīṣyāmi tava kanyāṃ sahiṣye śatagālikāḥ ||22|| atireke kaṭuvākye dāsyāmi tatkṣaṇe phalam | śatagālīsahiṣṇutvaṃ patnīvrataṃ mama dhruvam ||23|| asyāḥ pativrataṃ nityaṃ śatagālīpradānakam | yādṛśo vararājo’sti tādṛśī ca vadhūḥ kṛtā ||24|| aho bhāgyasya vaicitryaṃ bhogine sarpiṇī dhṛtā | yadyahaṃ śatapūrvaṃ syāmadhairyaḥ sā pradaṇḍayet ||25|| bhāṣābandhaṃ prakṛtvaivamaurvo dadau sutāṃ nijām | svastītyuvāca durvāsā vivāhaṃ vidhinākarot ||26|| aurvastāṃ sukhakṛdvākyairbodhayāmāsa kanyakām | śṛṇu putri pravakṣyāmi nītisāraṃ sukhāvaham ||27|| hitaṃ satyaṃ ca gārhasthyapārakṛdvacanaṃ mama | svakāntastu paro bandhuriha loke paratra ca ||28|| nahi kāntāt paraḥ preyān kulastrīṇāṃ paro guruḥ | devapūjā vrataṃ dānaṃ tapaścānaśanaṃ japaḥ ||29|| tīrthasnānaṃ yajñadīkṣā pṛthvīpradakṣiṇādayaḥ | ta ete patisevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||1.475.3 0|| kimetaiḥ patibhaktāyāḥ sarvapuṇyapraśevadheḥ | duḥkhī janaḥ sukhārthaṃ vai sākāṃkṣaḥ prathamo bhavet ||3 1 || patisevā sukhārtheti tatra dattamatirbhava | patisevā paro dharmaḥ svargamokṣaprado’sti te ||32|| svaprajñānena satataṃ kāntaṃ nārāyaṇādhikam | dṛṣṭvā taścaraṇāmbhojasevāṃ nityaṃ kariṣyasi ||33|| parihāsena kopena bhrameṇāvajñayā muneḥ | kaṭūktiṃ svāminaḥ sākṣātparokṣānna kariṣyasi ||34|| striyā vāgyoniduṣṭāyā yamadaṇḍo bhaved dhruvam | sarvadharmaparītāṃ yā kaṭūktiṃ kurute patim ||35|| naikajanmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ tasyā naśyati niścitam | gālī dānaṃ na kartavyaṃ kvāpi kutrāpi kenacit ||36|| tvayā putri vadhūrbhūtvā munernaiva viśeṣataḥ | gālīdānaṃ manasāpi smartavyaṃ na pativrate ||37|| tadā saukhyaṃ ca te nityaṃ saubhāgyaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati | anyathā tatra vighno’sti vatse nibodha madvacaḥ ||38|| prāpto maṇirna hātavyo nirmūlyaḥ kaṃkaro yathā | labdhaḥ patirna dhikkāryo yathā cauraḥ śaṭho’hitaḥ ||39|| svāmī naivāvamantavyo yathā śvā markaṭo yathā | tvaṅkāryo na tvayā kāntaḥ kiṃkaro’niṣṭakṛd yathā ||1.475.40|| bhartā nāvagaṇanīyo yathā kṛttimayo mṛgaḥ | trātā vaśe na kartavyo yathā ḍitthamayaḥ karī ||41 || vaṃśadātā na vaṃśena tāḍanīyaḥ kadācana | bhojanasyārpake patyau nabhojanavadācaret ||42|| nindāyitaṃ nācaredvai priye tvānandadāyini | sevanīye gurau naiva vanīyatāṃ samācaret ||43|| sadāpāraprade patyau pāradatvaṃ na vai caret | puruṣārthapratimāyāṃ ruṣārthaṃ na caret satī ||44|| kāmanāyāṃ pravṛttāyāṃ na kiṃmanāyate priyā | patyuḥ śeṣatayā śiṣṭā varteta na śirastathā ||45|| patyau prāṇām̐ścārpayitvā tiṣṭheta prāṇahā na tu | ratiṃ dadyād yathātṛptiṃ kaṣṭadāṃ viratiṃ na vai ||46|| sarvaṃ dadyāt svāmine vai gālīdānaṃ na vai kvacit | ātmārpaṇaṃ prakuryādvai kaṣṭārpaṇaṃ vinā satī ||47|| iti kanyāṃ bodhayitvā jagāmaurvaḥ svakāśramam | durvāsāścetanārāmaḥ tvāśramaṃ strīyuto yayau ||48|| aho sukṛtināṃ kāmo vāñcchāmātreṇa siddhyati | kadalī taṃ navaṃ kāntaṃ siṣeve sa ca tāṃ satīm ||49|| tapo dhyānaṃ parityajya gṛhāsakto’bhavanmuniḥ | karoti kalahaṃ nityaṃ prātarutthāya kandalī ||1.475.50|| gālīvākyaṃ vinā naiva prabodhayati taṃ patim | tasyāṃ pituḥ kṛtā śikṣā ūṣare bījavad vṛthā ||51 || khāne pāne bhojane’rthe vihāre saṃgame’rcane | kaṭūktiṃ prāyaśo brūte sehe tāṃ krodhano muniḥ ||52|| patnīvrataṃ pratijñātaṃ śatagālīsahiṣṇutā | durvāsā bodhayāmāsa nītivākyaistu kāminīm ||53|| sā tanna bubudhe kiñcit karoti kalahe spṛhām | tātapradattajñānaṃ tu nāntaḥsthānaṃ cakāra vai ||54|| ugrā pūrvād viśeṣā sā patiputravatī yataḥ | na hīyate prabodhena svabhāvo duratikramaḥ ||55|| nityaṃ kaṭūktiṃ kāntaṃ sā karoti hetunā vinā | tatrāpi bhojane devapūjane tu viśeṣataḥ ||56|| jagat prakampitaṃ yena sa kampitastayā ruṣā | putrāḥ putryo’bhavam̐stasyāṃ viṃśatirviṃśatistataḥ ||57|| kaṭūktirvardhitā nāryā śatādhikaguṇā sadā | atha sthānaṃ parityajya lokalajjāvigarhitaḥ ||58|| yayau sthānāntaraṃ nītvā bālām̐styaktvā tu tāṃ priyām | eko bālo dhṛto mūrdhni dvau dhṛtau skandhayoḥ punaḥ ||59|| kaṭyāṃ dhṛtau dvāvṛṣiṇā pārśvayoryānti cāpare | anye tvagre pṛṣṭhataśca prayānti vānarā yathā ||1.475.6 0|| sarve mātṛsvabhāvāste pitraṃśāstāmasāstathā | mārge kīśakulāyante nāṭayanti naṭā yathā ||61 || vigṛhṇanti vinā tattvaṃ krośanti ca mṛṣā mudhā | durvāsasaḥ śirodeśe’patyaṃ mūtraṃ cakāra vai ||62|| skandhayośca malaṃ cakre kaṭyāṃ ṣṭhīvanamācarat | vinā jalaṃ na vai śuddhistata evaṃ yayau puraḥ ||63|| tatrāyayau ca devarṣirnāradaḥ śaṃkarastathā | brahmā viṣṇuḥ sanakādyāḥ saptarṣayaḥ kutūhalāt ||64|| rūpāntaraiśca te prāhuḥ kimevaṃ vahase malam | durvāsāḥ prāha gārhasthyasukhamatrānubhūyate ||61|| jīvanvai narake magno yamakuṇḍo gṛhāśramaḥ | aho kaṣṭaṃ malinatvaṃ naraka candanāyate ||66 || mūtraṃ jayati tailasya sthāne jaṭāsu me’dya vai | aho mohasya kedāro viṣaṃ yatrāmṛtāyate ||67|| dukhaṃ sukhāyate’jñānādajñānaṃ kandalīkṛtam | kaṃ sukhaṃ dalitaṃ yasmānmama sā kandalī priyā ||68|| tyajāmi vā rakṣayāmi kiṃ karomi tayā vinā | evaṃ niḥśvasya durvāsāḥ sārthamadhye sthitaḥ kṣaṇam ||6 9|| hasito bodhitaścāpi nāradādyairmaharṣibhiḥ | gṛhasthānāṃ bhavet kleśaḥ saṃsāraḥ kleśasaṃbhṛtaḥ ||1.475.70|| gaccha gṛhaṃ punarvipra maivaṃ tyaja gṛhaṃ svakam | iti sambodhito yāvat tāvat sā kandalī satī ||71 || rudatī pṛṣṭhataḥ samājagāmānayanāya tam | pādayoḥ patitā prāha gālīṃ dāsyena na vai kvacit ||72|| karotvanugrahaṃ krodhin śaṭhāpate sthavīraka | itivākyāni miṣṭāni kandalyāḥ sammatāni vai ||73|| jagāda kandalī namrā dīnā ca kātarā muhuḥ | dayāṃ kṛtvā ca durvāsā dhṛto vastre ca yoṣitā ||74|| yayau gṛhaṃ śarīreṇāpatyakardamalepinā | sasnau śuddhiṃ cakārāpi jajāpa brahma cāntare ||75|| evaṃ roṣo layaṃ yātaḥ karmavaśyasya roṣiṇaḥ | putravatī kaṭūktiṃ sā śatottarāṃ jagāda ha ||76 || jñānināṃ pravaro vipraḥ kṣamāsaṃsthāṃ cakāra ha | nityaṃ śatottarāṃ vakti bodhaṃ cakre dayānidhiḥ ||77|| maunaṃ tathāpi sā dhatte naiva vegād dine dine | evaṃ gālīpradānaiśca pradagdhaṃ mānasaṃ muneḥ ||78|| tasyāḥ kaṭūktivācinyā āyuḥ pūrṇaṃ babhūva ha | svātmārāmo’pi munirāṭ kopāveśātivegitaḥ ||79|| śaśāpa kāminīṃ roṣād bhasmarāśirbhaveti vai | muneriṅgitamātreṇa bhasmasāt sā babhūva ha ||1.475.80 || evamatyucchritānāṃ vai mattānāṃ śreya eva na | apatyāni munestasya cakruśurmātṛnāśanāt ||8 1 || atha tasyā ātmatattvaṃ jīvo’ntarīkṣago’vadat | he nātha sarvadarśī tvaṃ jñānavān yogināṃ varaḥ ||82|| sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvajña kimahaṃ bodhayāmi te | saduktirvā kaṭūktirvā kopaḥ santāpa eva vā ||83|| lobho mohaśca kāmaśca kṣutpipāsādikaṃ ca yat| | sthaulyaṃ kārśyaṃ vināśaśca śāntaghorasumūḍhatāḥ ||84|| sarve śarīradharmāste śabdo gālī ca bhautikāḥ | sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva śarīraṃ triguṇātmakam ||85|| nyūnādhikaṃ bhavet tacca saṃsārastena jāyate | rodanaṃ hasanaṃ kleśaścodvego bhayamityapi |||86 || krodhaḥ śāntiśca śāpaśca śārīrā nātmanaḥ priya | sattvodayāttu mokṣecchā karmecchā tu rajoguṇāt ||87|| tamoguṇāt kalahecchā dvayornau sadṛśaṃ tamaḥ | tamaḥ kopasya janako yathā tvayi tathā mayi ||88|| kopāt kaṭūktirgālī ca kaṭūktyā śatrutā bhavet | tayā tvapriyatā sadyaḥ śatruḥ kaḥ kasya kaḥ sakhā ||89|| ko vā priyo’priyaḥ kaḥ kiṃ kiṃ mitraṃ ko ripurbhavet | rāgadveṣau pradhānau vai sarvatra śatrumitrayoḥ ||1.475.90|| prāṇādhikaḥ priyaḥ strīṇāṃ bhartuḥ prāṇādhikā priyā | babhūva śatrutā sadyo duruktyā ca kṣaṇād ruṣā || 91 || yadgataṃ tadgataṃ sarvaṃ bhautikaṃ bhūtadoṣataḥ | śocanīyaṃ gataṃ naiva jātaṃ yattacca nānyathā |||92|| ahaṃ dagdhā tava patnī te’pi dagdhaṃ tapodhanam | dagdhayordehayoścātha guṇayornāgamaḥ punaḥ ||93|| gate tadvai gataṃ sarvaṃ naṣṭaṃ tannaṣṭameva hi | athādhunā prakartavyaṃ yathā śreyo bhavettu nau ||94|| kṣamāparādhaṃ nikhilaṃ kiṃ kartavyaṃ vadādhunā | kiṃ karomi kva yāmīti bhavitā kutra janma me ||95|| tava jāyā sadā cāsmi nānyasya kutracit kvacit| | na bhūtā na bhaviṣyāmi prāpsyāmi tvāṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||96|| iti śrutvā vacastasyāḥ śokena hṛtacetanaḥ | kṣaṇottaraṃ ca svasthaḥ sa prāṇām̐styaktuṃ samudyataḥ ||97|| strīvicchedo vidagdhānāṃ yataḥ śokaṃ karoti hi | tato yogāsanaṃ kṛtvā mumurṣurna hyuvāca tām ||98|| sā tvambare muniṃ dṛṣṭvā mumurṣuṃ śokavihvalā | sasmāra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ durgamarakṣakam ||99|| tāvat tatrāyayau bālo vipro bhūtvā janārdanaḥ | sasmitaḥ śyāmavarṇaśca durvāsasaṃ jagāda ca || 1.475.1 00|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne durvāsasaḥ aurvakanyayā kadalyā saha śatagālīsahanapūrvakapratijñayā vivāhastataḥ pātivratyātmakataddharmanirūpaṇaṃ, viṃśatiputraputrīmatvaṃ, krodhenātikrāmantyāḥ kadalyāḥ ṛṣiśāpena bhasmatā, kadalyāḥ stutiḥ, janārdanāgamaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcasaptatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 475 ||
<1.476> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi yathā prāha durvāsasaṃ dvijārbhakaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo viṣṇuḥ samayocitameva tat || 1 || durvāsasaṃ praṇamanta śocantaṃ karma vai svakam | pūjayantaṃ vāsayantaṃ kuśāsane’tibhāvataḥ || 2 || uvāca brāhmaṇabaṭustasmai datvā sadāśiṣam | sarvaṃ jānāsi durvāsargurormantraprasādataḥ || 3 || tathāpi brāhmaṇabaṭuḥ kathayāmi nibodha me | brāhmaṇānāṃ tapo dharmastapaḥ sādhyaṃ jagattrayam || 4 || vaiṣṇavānāṃ harerbhaktirdāsyaṃ ca paramaṃ tapaḥ | hareḥ kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ bhajanaṃ tasya sarvadā || 5 || sevanaṃ pūjanaṃ sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ vaiṣṇavasya vai | munestu te viśeṣeṇa śreyaḥ kāryaṃ śubhaṃ sadā || 6 || etat sarvaṃ parityajya śokaṃ ca śokakāraṇam | kathaṃ duḥkhapradaṃ buddhernāśakaṃ tvavalambase || 7 || kā kasya patnī kaḥ kāntaḥ kasyā vā bhavacakrake | mūrkhāṇāṃ vañcanāṃ kartuṃ karoti māyayā hariḥ || 8 || mithyā patnī taveyaṃ tu kṣaṇāntena gatādhunā | nahi mithyā bhavennityaṃ nityaṃ nādṛśyatāṃ vrajet || 9 || tava patnī sadā ceyaṃ kandalī nirmitā satī | nārāyaṇena te chāyā tava śikṣāpradāyinī || 1.476.1 0|| yat tvayā kalpito lokastvatkampārthaṃ tu sā kṛtā | mā śokaṃ kuru cātrārthe sā te patnī punarmune || 11 || bhaviṣyati na sandeho dvedhā bhūtvā variṣyati | vada kāntāṃ prārthanāḍhyāmākāśasthāṃ pativratām || 12|| pratīkṣamāṇāṃ te tvājñāṃ brūhi kiṃ sā kariṣyati | tāvad durvāsasā dṛṣṭā kathitā kadalī bhava || 1 3|| śubhadā phaladā kāntā sakṛtsūtā sudurlabhā | bahuputrīmatī mūlāt sadā pativratā bhava || 14|| ityuktā sā pratyuvāca tvaṃ cāpi kardamo bhava | yathā nāma tathā durvāsātmakaḥ kardamo mama || 15|| mūle kledamayo nityaṃ śaityabhāvānvito bhava | ityuktaḥ kardamo bhūtvā rūpāntareṇa vai muniḥ || 16|| durvāsaḥ kardamo nityaṃ kadalīmūlago’bhavat | kandalī kadalījātirbhūtā kadaladāyinī || 17|| sakṛtprasūtā phaladā mūlāpatyapradāyinī | saṃjātā vanamadhye ca vandhyā kadalī cetyapi || 18|| hastīnāṃ bhojanaṃ sā tu hyabhavat sarvadā vane | atha taṃ brāhmaṇabaṭuḥ punaḥ prāha muniṃ hitam || 1 9|| śṛṇu vipra tava patnī kalpe kalpe punaḥ punaḥ | kadalī śāntarūpā ca bhaviṣyati sukhapradā ||1.476.20 || ekānaṃśābhidhā kṛṣṇasvasā śrīdevakīsutā | pārvatyaṃśasamudbhūtā suśīlā cirajīvinī ||21 || kalpe kalpe tava patnī sundarī sā bhaviṣyati | mano dehi tapasyāyāṃ mudā tatkāla āgate ||22|| śāntasvarūpā sā bālā kṛṣṇadvārā miliṣyati | ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścaturbhujaḥ ||23|| datvā svadarśanaṃ tasmai so’ntardhāno babhūva ha | muniḥ sarvaṃ bhramaṃ tyaktvā tapasyāyāṃ mano dadhe ||24|| atyucchritasya damanaṃ sūcitaṃ jāyate kvacit | dviguṇābhyudayaścānujāyate damitasya vai ||25|| kandalī kadalījātirbabhūva dharaṇītale | yādṛśī sābhavattūgrā tādṛśīṃ śītatāṃ gatā ||26||| kandalyāstu pituḥ sarasvatyā nadyāstaṭe śubhe | āsīd bhavyāśramastatra kandalyāḥ pātivratyataḥ |||27|| brahmaśīlavratenāpi bhaktyā śrīmādhavasya ca | piturvastrāṇi sarvāṇi śuṣkāṇyārdrāṇi yāni ca ||28|| vāyunā dhāryamāṇāni tiṣṭhanti tvambare sadā | vinā tu kīlakaṃ lakṣmi camatkāro’yamadbhutaḥ ||29|| yāvat sā kandalī dagdhā durvāsaḥśāpatastadā | tatkṣaṇaṃ dhautavastrāṇi peturūrdhvād bhuvastale ||1.476.30|| pṛthivyāṃ patite vastre tapastyaktvaurva eva tu | dhyānena bubudhe sarvaṃ kanyābhasmādi saṃkaṭam ||3 1|| śokāviṣṭo jagāmāśu jāmāturāśramaṃ kṣaṇāt | siṣeca pṛthivīreṇūn rudan nayanabindubhiḥ ||32|| he vatse kadalītyevaṃ rurodoccārya vai punaḥ | śvaśurasya svaraṃ jñātvā durvāsā bhayavihvalaḥ ||33|| ūṭajāyā bahirbhūtvā papāta tatpadāmbuje | vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ paścāt sāntvayitvā guruṃ munim ||34|| vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa mūlamārabhya taṃ munim | śrutvā vārtāṃ punaraurvaḥ śuśoca bahudhā punaḥ ||35|| jāmātāraṃ samuvāca bhītaṃ praṇatakandharam | aye brahmannatriputra pautrastvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ śubhaḥ ||36|| svalpadoṣe bahutaraḥ kṛto daṇḍastvayā katham | tvajjanmaśaṃkarāṃśena śiṣyastvaṃ brahmaṇastathā ||37|| vedavijñaśca guṇavān jñānavām̐śca vratasthitaḥ | anasūyā mahāsādhvī kamalāṃśā tava prasūḥ ||38|| guṇavān janako yasya mātā guṇavatī satī | tayoḥ putro dayāhīnaḥ sṛṣṭeḥ sūkṣmā tyaho gatiḥ ||39|| na jāne kena doṣeṇa tava tvaitādṛśī matiḥ | hiṃsāpradhānā śaśvadvaṃśasampadvināśinī ||1.476.40|| mama prāṇādhikā tvekā kanyā tvayi samarpitā | mahāpativratā vāṇīmātradoṣasamanvitā ||41 || vāgduṣṭāyāstu daṇḍo hi parityāgo nayaḥ smṛtaḥ | parityaktāṃ punaḥ putrīṃ pitā pālayati dhruvam ||42|| madapatyaṃ svalpadoṣe yato bhasmīkṛtaṃ tvayā | parābhavaste’pi mahān bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||43|| drogdhuḥ karmaphalaṃ tūrṇe dadāti karuṇānidhiḥ | ityuktvātivilapyaiva hā putrīti vahan muhuḥ ||44|| jñātvā tāṃ kadalīvṛkṣasvarūpāṃ saritastaṭe | āmūlāttāṃ khanayitvā sahanītvā yayau gṛham ||45|| asvāminīṃ phalahīnāṃ putrīṃ kumārikāṃ tu tām | kandalīṃ kadalīrūpāṃ pupoṣa jalasecanaiḥ ||46|| kardamastanmūladeśe klidyamāno’bhavattataḥ | durgandhaḥ sa ca durvāso durvāsāḥ śāpato’bhavat ||47|| tayoryoge tvapatyāni niṣphalānyabhavanpunaḥ | vanāni tāni jātāni gajabhuktipradāni vai ||48 || durvāsasastu catvāriṃśadapatyāni yāni vai | kadalīgarbhajātāni tānyaurvāśramamāyayuḥ ||49|| aurveṇa pālitānyeva teṣāṃ vaṃśo vyavardhata | atha smṛtvā priyāṃ durvāsāstapasyāparo’bhavat |||1.476.5 0|| tataḥ kālāntare rājāmbarīṣāt sa parābhavam | śvaśuraśāpato lebhe śṛṇu lakṣmi vadāmi te ||51 || ambarīṣaḥ sūryavaṃśī rājā paramadhārmikaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhoje tanmanaḥ satataṃ hyabhūt |||52||| na rājyeṣu na bhāryāsu na putreṣu prajāsu na | na sampatsu kṣaṇaṃ cittaṃ puṇyakarmārjitāsvapi ||53|| dhyāyate’harniśaṃ bhakto jñāne svapne hariṃ sadā | mahābhāgavataḥ śānto viṣṇuvrataparāyaṇaḥ ||54|| ekādaśīvratarataḥ kṛṣṇapūjāsu tatparaḥ | sarvakarmasvaliptaśca kartā kṛṣṇārpiteṣu ca ||55|| sutīkṣṇaṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ ca hareścakraṃ sudarśanam | prabhuṇā rakṣitaṃ śaśvad rakṣāyai nṛpasannidhau ||56|| ekādaśīvrataṃ kṛtvā dvādaśī divase sati | snātvābhyarcya hariṃ dānaṃ datvā sauvarṇarājatam ||57|| sādhūn viprān bhojayitvā bhojanārthamuvāsa saḥ | tāvattatra samāyāto durvāsāḥ kṣudhito muniḥ ||58|| dṛṣṭvā natvā samutthāya datvā taṃ pādyamāsanam | papraccha rājā taṃ prītaḥ kājñā te vada kāmitam ||59|| durvāsāḥ prāha dehyannaṃ vidhinā kṣudhitasya me | kintvaghamarṣaṇamantraṃ japtvāyāmyacireṇa vai ||1.476.60|| kṣaṇaṃ pratīkṣatāṃ rājannityuktvā prayayau tataḥ | śīghraṃ nāyāti durvāsāḥ dvādaśīṃ vigatonmukhīm ||61 || vilokya rājā papraccha vaśiṣṭhaṃ dharmasaṃkaṭam | nāyāti muniśārdūlaḥ prayāti dvādaśī tithiḥ ||62|| saṃkaṭe’smin vidheyaṃ kiṃ vadeti pratyuvāca tam | vaśiṣṭho hitakṛt tathyaṃ puṇyadaṃ sarvasammatam |||63|| dvādaśyāṃ samatītāyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam | upavāsaphalaṃ hatvā vratinaṃ hanti niścitam ||64|| na bhojayitvā mūḍhaścedatithiṃ samupasthitam | sa trastaḥ kṣudhito bhuṃkte kuṃbhīpāke vrajed dhruvam ||65|| śatavarṣaṃ tatra tiṣṭhan naraścāṇḍālatāṃ vrajet | vyādhiyukto daridraśca bhavejjanmani janmani ||66|| ato’tisūkṣmaṃ te brūmo’dhunā paramasaṃkaṭe | rakṣāṃ kuru dvayordharmaṃ samālokya vadāmi te ||67|| upavāsaphalaṃ rakṣa kṛṣṇasya caraṇodakam | bhuktvā śīghramapo rājām̐stadbhakṣaṇamabhakṣaṇam ||68|| ityukto bubhuje rājā kiñcidvāri hariṃ smaran | etasminnantare tatrājagāma krodhano muniḥ ||69|| ciccheda kopāt sarvajñaḥ svajaṭāṃ nṛpateḥ puraḥ | tataḥ samutthitaḥ khaḍgahasto naro’gnisannibhaḥ ||1.476.70|| rājendraṃ hantumāyāntaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā cakramācyutam | ciccheda kṛtyāpuruṣaṃ chettuṃ durvāsasaṃ prati ||71 || gataṃ cakraṃ vilokyaiva vipro dudrāva bhītavat | brahmāṇḍakramaṇe cakraṃ paścāddhāvatsudarśanam ||72|| dṛṣṭvā trāhītyabhigṛṇan brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau | brahmā prāha harerdāsaṃ śaptuṃ gataḥ kathaṃ mune ||73|| rakṣitā yasya bhagavām̐staṃ ko hanti jagattraye | kṣudrāṇāṃ mahatāṃ cāpi bhaktānāṃ rakṣaṇāya tu ||74|| rarakṣa satataṃ cakraṃ śrīharirbhaktavatsalaḥ | yo mūḍha vaiṣṇavaṃ dveṣṭi viṣṇuprāṇasamaṃ janam ||75|| tasya dveṣṭuḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’ntamācaret | śīghraṃ sthānāntaraṃ gaccha vatsa trāṇaṃ na vādhunā ||76|| anyathā tvāṃ mayā sārdhaṃ haniṣyati sudarśanam | kiṃ brahmalokaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ dagdhuṃ śaktaṃ kṣaṇena yat ||77|| tejasā viṣṇutulyaṃ yat kenānyena nivāryate | iti śrutvā pradudrāva jagāma śaraṇaṃ śivam ||78|| kṛpānidhāna māṃ rakṣetyuvāca śaṃkaraṃ bhiyā | na taṃ papraccha kuśalaṃ kailāsastho’pi śaṃkaraḥ ||79|| saṃhartā jagatāṃ śaṃbhustūrṇamuvāca vai bhiyā | pautrastvaṃ jagatāṃ dhāturatrestu tanayo mune ||1.476.80|| mamāṃśo vedavijño’si mūrkhatulyaṃ tu karma te | vayaṃ yasmāt samutpannāstadbhaktaṃ haṃsi vai katham ||81|| ahaṃ brahmā ca kamalā durgā vāṇī ca rādhikā | prabhā lakṣmīḥ pārvatī ca māṇikī śrīḥ ramā jayā ||82|| nahi bhaktātparāḥ sarve bhakto’smabhyaḥ paro yataḥ | kṣudrām̐śca mahato bhaktān śaśvad rakṣati yatnataḥ ||83|| cakreṇa bhagavān bhaktaṃ rakṣati duḥsahena vai | durnivāryaṃ yadā cakraṃ na pratītaṃ surakṣaṇe ||84|| tadā caturbhujaḥ śrīmān svayaṃ gacchati rakṣitum | bhaktakṛte bhramatyeva chāyeva satataṃ hariḥ ||85|| kāntā prāṇādhikā śaśvannahi loke tato’dhikaḥ | bhaktān dveṣṭi svayaṃ sā cet tūrṇaṃ tyajati tāṃ prabhuḥ ||86 || sarveṣāṃ tu priyā viprāḥ svaśarīrādapi hareḥ | brāhmaṇebhyaḥ priyā bhaktāḥ sādhavaḥ prāṇataḥ priyāḥ ||87|| viprebhyaḥ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ sadācyutasugotrakāḥ | sādhudharmaśīlarakṣākarāste sarvataḥ priyāḥ ||88|| ayaṃ rājāpi sādhūnāṃ dharmān rakṣati mādhave | bhaja brāhmaṇa govindaṃ smara tasya padāmbujam ||89|| vraja śīghraṃ tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ tava | cakraṃ kailāsavāsām̐stu pradahat tatra vartate ||1.476.90|| pārvatī tu tadā prāha satyaṃ cenme pativratam | tejaḥ satyaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ yadi ceccirasañcitam ||91 || kailāsasthāstathā cāyaṃ sarve bhavantu vijvarāḥ | mamāśiṣā harerbhaktyā brāhmaṇaḥ śaraṇāgataḥ ||92||| durvāsā vaiṣṇavo bhaktaḥ śīghraṃ bhavatu vijvaraḥ | ityevamuktvā kṛpayā virarāma śivā, śivaḥ ||93 || sudarśanaṃ kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhat pratīkṣate muniṃ muhuḥ | muniḥ praṇamya tau devau vaikuṇṭhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ||94|| dṛṣṭvā sudarśanaṃ paścāt papāta pādayorhareḥ | trāhi māṃ kamalākānta trāhi māṃ karuṇānidhe ||95|| dīnabandho mahāviṣṇo trāhi māṃ saṃkaṭārṇave | bhagavannava māṃ bhītaṃ rakṣa māṃ bhavasāgare | |96|| kiṃ staumi pāhi māṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa namo’stu te | ityuktvā netranīraiḥ saṃsiseca caraṇāmbuje ||97|| nārāyaṇastu taṃ prāha samuttiṣṭha sthiro bhava | śṛṇu me vacanaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati sukhaṃ tava ||98 || anyeṣāṃ bhavati jñānaṃ śrutvā śāstraṃ satāṃ mukhāt |
