nārītvaṃ naratāṃ tathā || 144|| pretatvaṃ ca suratvaṃ ca ṛṣitvaṃ karmaṇā tathā | brahmatvaṃ surarājatvaṃ karmaṇā prāpyate’pi tu || 145|| mṛtyustu mastakasthāyī sarveṣāṃ vidyate sadā | jalabudvudavatsarvaṃ śakra naśyati nityaśaḥ || 146|| mūḍhā muhyanti loke’tra muhyanti naiva paṇḍitāḥ | ityuktvā sa viprabaṭustatatra tasthau ca sasmitaḥ || 147|| vismitastridaśādhyakṣo garvahīno babhūva ha | etasminnantare tatrājagāma tāpaso janaḥ || 148|| ativṛddho mahāyogī jaṭādhārī mṛgājinī | sarvaṃ vakṣaḥsthalaṃ tasya romacakrābhisaṃbhṛtam ||149|| madhye kiñcidromahīnaṃ samutpāṭitalomakam | mastake ca vartulaṃ saṃdadhan kaṭaṃ samāyatam || 1.486.150|| āgatya madhye tasthau sa vipraputramahendrayoḥ | mahendro vṛddharūpaṃ taṃ madhuparkādikaṃ dadau || 151 || praṇanāmātha papraccha kuta āgamyate tvayā | kinnāmā tvaṃ gṛhaṃ kutra kathamāgamanaṃ tava || 152|| karaṃ kathaṃ mastake te lomacakraṃ ca vakṣasi | madhyadeśe riktabhāgo lomotpāṭanajaḥ katham || 153|| vṛddhaḥ prāha ca vaikuṇṭhādadya tvāgamyate mayā | lomaśo’haṃ ṛṣirnāmnā tīrthārthaṃ gamanaṃ mama || 154|| alpāyuṣā mayā cendra kutrāpi na kṛtaṃ gṛham | na vivāhaścopajīvyaṃ bhikṣopajīvinādhunā || 155|| varṣaṇātapaśāntyarthaṃ mastakasthaṃ kaṭaṃ mama | vakṣoromāṇi yāvanti tāvatkalpāyurasmyaham || 156|| kalpaike’pagate cendra lomaikotpāṭanaṃ mama | utpāṭitaromasaṃkhyāḥ kalpā naṣṭā mamāgrataḥ || 157|| jātaṃ tvaṃgulamātraṃ tad vartulaṃ romahīnakam | vakṣolomāni yāvanti pratikalpaikaromakam || 158|| bhaviṣyantyutpāṭitāni tadā me maraṇaṃ bhavet | daśādhikaśate yāte brahmābdānāṃ mṛtirmama || 159|| asaṃkhyavidhayaḥ sṛṣṭau mariṣyanti mṛtā api | kalatreṇa ca putreṇa gṛheṇa kiṃ prayojanam || 1.486.160|| vairājapatane cakṣurnimeṣastu harerbhavet | śrīhareścaraṇaṃ nityaṃ cintayāmi sthale sthale || 161 || durlabhaṃ śrīharerdāsyaṃ bhaktirmuktergarīyasī | svapnavat sarvamaiśvaryaṃ tadbhaktivyavadhāyakam || 162|| evamuktvā vṛddhavipraścāntardhānaṃ jagāma ha | śiśuviprastataścendraṃ kṛtvā garvavihīnakam || 163|| adṛśyatāṃ gatastūrṇamindro vairāgyamāptavān | sarvaṃ vinyasya putre tu tyaktvā rājyaśriyaṃ śacīm || 164|| utsuko’bhūdaraṇyaṃ vai harerbhaktyarthamādarāt | bṛhaspatiḥ svakaṃ śiṣyaṃ bodhayāmāsa vai tadā || 165|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | iti nityaṃ japaṃ dhyānasahitaṃ kuru śārṅgiṇaḥ || 166|| tena muktiśca te bhāvyā mā yāhi vanamanyathā | ityukto bhajamānaḥ sa bhūtvā ca vaiṣṇavo mahān || 167|| cakāra rājyaṃ dharmiṣṭhaścānte muktiṃ jagāma ha | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya jñānavān jāyate janaḥ || 168|| śraddhā suvardhate bhakto bhaktau garvo naśyati sarvathā | vṛthā mānaṃ yāti dūraṃ yāti tvante hareḥ padam || 169|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham | vijñānaṃ garvanāśārthaṃ bhaktervṛddhyarthameva ca || 1.486.170 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne menakāṃ prati viśvāmitrapṛṣṭapātivratyapraśre’psarasāmanyadharmaparatve parasparaśāpena jarā, nāgamatīnadyāṃ snānena śāpanivāraṇaṃ cetyādi | tathā indrasya garvanāśārthaṃ prakṛteḥ śāpaḥ, guroḥ śāpaḥ, gautamaśāpaśca, gurorapamānācchāpena sampannāśaḥ, vṛtranāśaḥ, brahmahatyā, guroḥ kṛpayā brahmahatyānāśaḥ, navīnaprāsādanirmāṇaṃ, viśvakarmanirodhaḥ, nārāyaṇasya viprabaṭurūpeṇāgamanaṃ pipīlikāsamūhadarśanaṃ, lomaśasyāgamanaṃ, tadāyurlomakṣaraṇe niścityendrasya vairāgyaṃ viśvakarmaṇo nirbandhatendragarvanāśaścetinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaśītyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 486 ||
<1.487> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha dhanvantarerdarpabhaṃgaḥ pūrvaṃ yathā kṛtaḥ | tadākhyānaṃ kathayāmi śṛṇu lakṣmi sureśvari || 1 || nārāyaṇāṃśo bhagavān svayaṃ dhanvantarirmahān | purā samudramathane samuttasthau mahodadheḥ || 2 || sarvavedeṣu niṣṇāto mantratantraviśāradaḥ | garuḍasya suśiṣyo vai śaṃkarasyopaśiṣyakaḥ || 3 || śiṣyāṇāṃ sa sahasreṇa yāti vaikuṇṭhamekadā | dadarśa takṣakaṃ mārge lelihānaṃ bhayānakam || 4 || lakṣanāgaiḥ parivṛtaṃ pātālāttu samāgatam | tīrthecchayā mahīloke vicarantaṃ śubhāśayam || 5 || dhanvantarirgarvayukto viṣamantrān mumoca ha | takṣakaḥ krodhasaṃyukto bhoktuṃ dudrāva vaidyakam || 6 || tāvad dhanvantareḥ śiṣyo dambhināmā jajāpa ha | viṣamantraṃ mahāghoraṃ saṃcakre takṣakaṃ vaśe || 7 || mantreṇa jṛmbhitaṃ kṛtvā nirviṣaṃ taṃ cakāra ha | amūlyaṃ maṇiratnaṃ jahāra tanmastakasthitam || 8 || kareṇa bhrāmayitvā tu kṣepayāmāsa dūrataḥ | patito mṛtavattasthau takṣakastadgaṇāstadā || 9 || cakrurnivedanaṃ vāsukaye vāsukirāyayau | sarpān viṣolbaṇānnītvā pañcamukhān sahasraśaḥ || 1.487.10 || droṇakālīyakarkoṭapuṇḍarīkadhanañjayān | dhanvantareḥ śiṣyagaṇā bhayamāpurvilokya tān || 11 || nāgaviṣairdaṃśitāste śerate pṛthivītale | dhanvantarirmantrāmṛtairjīvayāmāsa sevakān || 12|| cakāra jṛmbhitaṃ mantraiḥ sarpasaṃghaṃ ruṣā jvalan | vāsukistu tadā gaurīṃ sasmāra manasābhidhām || 13 || manase tvaṃ samāgaccha nāgān rakṣātisaṃkaṭāt | jagattraye mahābhāge pūjā tava bhaviṣyati || 14|| manasā drāk samāgatyovāca yāmi raṇāṃgaṇe | taṃ śatruṃ saṃhariṣyāmi prajeṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 15|| gururme bhagavān śeṣo dattavān kavacaṃ mama | saṃsāraṃ bhasmasāt kṛtvā punaḥ sraṣṭumahaṃ kṣamā || 16|| śiṣyāhaṃ mantraśāstreṣu śaṃbhorbhagavastathā | śaṃbhoḥ śiṣyaṃ garuḍaṃ na gaṇayāmi manāgapi || 17|| dhanvantaristacchiṣyāṇāmekaḥ kiṃ gaṇayāmi tam | ityuktvā śrīhariṃ śeṣaṃ śaṃbhuṃ smṛtvā praṇamya ca ||18|| yatra dhanvantaristvāste tatrājagāma tatkṣaṇam | mantraiśca jṛmbhitān sarpān jīvayāmāsa līlayā || 19|| viṣamantraiḥ śatruśiṣyānniśceṣṭāṃśca cakāra sā | yatnato’pi dhanvantarirnotthāpayitumīśvaraḥ ||1.487.20|| prahasya manasā prāha tyaja siddhābhimānitām | vada jānāsi kiṃ siddha śiṣyo’si garuḍasya vai ||21 || ahaṃ ca garuḍaścāpi śiṣyau śaṃbhorhi viśrutau | adhītaṃ kalpaparyantaṃ tatra kā gaṇanā tava ||22|| mantritaṃ kamalaṃ cedaṃ prerayāmi sthiro bhava | ityuktvā prākṣipat padmaṃ mantritaṃ sūryasadṛśam ||23|| dhanvantaraistu phutkārairbhasmasāt tat tadābhavat | devī jagrāha mantrāḍhyāṃ śaktiṃ paramadāruṇīm ||24|| dhanvantaristriśūlena babhaṃja kaṇaśastu tām | manasā nāgapāśaṃ pracikṣepa mantritaṃ tadā |||25|| nāgalakṣānvitaṃ ghoraṃ dhanvantariśca tatkṣaṇāt | gāruḍaṃ prerayāmāsa tena nāgāstrabhakṣaṇam ||26|| kṛtaṃ vai līlayā tāvanmanasā śūlamādade | śivadattaṃ ca saphalaṃ pralayāgnisamaprabham ||27|| tāvad brahmā tathā śaṃbhuḥ rakṣārthamāgatau drutam | devau nanāma manasā garuḍo vaidyakastathā ||28|| brahmā prāha manasāyāḥ pūjāṃ kurviti vaidyakam | dhanvantare nahi sāmyaṃ raṇaṃ te durgayā saha ||29|| trailokyaṃ bhasmasāt kartuṃ śūleneyaṃ prabhāvatī | kuru stotraṃ manasāyāstuṣṭā varaṃ pradāsyati ||1.487.3 0|| dhanvantariḥ śucirbhūtvā śuklapuṣpairapūjayat | cārucampakavarṇābhāṃ sarvāṃgaśumanoharām ||3 1 || nāgendravāhinīṃ devīṃ sarvavidyāviśāradām | dhyātvā datvā ṣoḍaśavastūni stotraṃ cakāra ha ||32|| namaḥ siddhisvarūpāyai varadāyai namo namaḥ | namaḥ kaśyapakanyāyai śaṃkarāyai namo namaḥ ||33|| bālānāṃ rakṣaṇakartryai nāgadevyai namo namaḥ | nama āstīkamātre te jaratkārvyai namo namaḥ ||34|| tapasvinyai ca yoginyai nāgasvasre namo namaḥ | sādhvyai tapasyārūpāyai śaṃbhuśiṣye ca te namaḥ ||35|| iti stutā ca manasā bhūtvā śāntā sukhapradā | svastītyuktvā yayau natvā gṛhaṃ brahmamaheśvarau ||36|| devā vaidyo garuḍaśca sarpā yayurnijālayān | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi manasāyā balaṃ mahat ||37|| dhanvantarerdarpabhaṃgaḥ śravaṇāt sarpabhīrna vai | vaṃśajānāṃ nāgabhayaṃ nāsti śravaṇamātrataḥ ||38|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nāgeṣu dhanvantarermantraprayogāḥ, manasādevyā mantraprayogairdhanvantarergarvonāśitaścetinirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 487 ||
<1.488> śrīlakṣmīruvāca bhagavan śrotumicchāmi śāradaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇagopīlīlāmayaṃ niśāmaya || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu tatte pravakṣyāmi rāsaramaṇamuttamam | gopībhirnavalakṣābhirnavalakṣaiśca mādhavaiḥ || 2 || śaraccandrapūrṇimāyāṃ kiśoraḥ sa yuvābhavat | yuvatībhiryuvānaśca śrīkṛṣṇā remire priye || 3 || vicārya śrīharirnaktaṃ vanaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ yayau | śubho, candrodaye sarvagopīsaṃkalpapūrtaye || 4 || cakāra tatra kutukād vinodamuralīravam | tacchrutvā rādhikā viniḥsasāra ca drutaṃ gṛhāt || 5 || trayastriṃśadvayasyāśca suśīlādyā yayurmudā | samā veṣeṇa vayasā rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca || 6 || yayustvanyā navalakṣagopyastyaktvā gṛhādikam | sarvā babhūvurekatra mālāhastāstu kāścana || 7 || cārucandanahastāśca śvetacāmarahastakāḥ | kāścit kastūrikākarāḥ kāścit kuṃkumavāhikāḥ || 8 || kāścit tāmbūlapātrāśca kāścit kāṃcanabhāmbarāḥ | kṛṣṇakṛṣṇavadantyaśca dadṛśū rāsamaṇḍalam || 9 || sunirjanaṃ kusumitaṃ vāsitaṃ puṣpavāyubhiḥ | śuśruvustā dvirephāṇāṃ kokilānāṃ madhudhvanim || 1.488.10|| rādhā gopyaḥ praviviśuḥ śobhitaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam | rādhāṃ gopīśca saṃvīkṣya hasan kṛṣṇo’pyadṛśyata || 11 || navayauvanasampanno ratnābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ | kandarpakoṭilāvaṇyarūpojjvalo manoharaḥ || 1 2|| vakralocanakoṇena dadarśa gopikā muhuḥ | gopīnāṃ navalakṣāṇi kṛṣṇānāṃ ca tathaiva hi || 13|| lekṣāṇyaṣṭādaśa yugalāni vai rāsamaṇḍale | rāsaṃ reme kīrtanaiḥ sattālaiśca kūrdanairmuhuḥ || 14|| hastānāṃ melanaistālīdānairvakravibhaṅgibhiḥ | daṇḍaiśca skandhasaṃyogaiścumbanaiḥ karapīḍanaiḥ || 1 5|| evaṃ vai rāsamākrīḍya śrāntā niṣedurunmukhāḥ | pupūjustāḥ priyaṃ kāntaṃ dadustāmbūlamuttamam || 16 || jagṛhurmukhatāmbūlaṃ parasparaṃ smarānvitāḥ | kāmarūpaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo jñātvā tanmānasāni vai || 17|| kāmabhāvena tāḥ sarvā jagrāha ca cucumba ca | śṛṃgārāṣṭaprakāraṃ ca saṃyogaṃ tvaṃgayostathā || 18 || nakhadantakarāṇāṃ ca prahāraṃ vai yathocitam | cumbanāṣṭavidhaṃ cāpi cakāra rasikeśvaraḥ || 19 || aṃgairaṃgāni pratyaṃgaiḥ pratyaṃgāni yuyoja ca | cakārāśleṣaṇaṃ tāsāṃ kāmukīnāṃ sukhāvaham || 1.488.20 || navalakṣasthale kṛṣṇaḥ kāntāsakto virājate | tāsāṃ datvā ratitṛptiṃ tūrdhvaretāḥ svayaṃprabhuḥ || 21 || sthalakrīḍāṃ tathā kṛtvā jalakrīḍārthamāyayau | navalakṣayugalāni remire yamunājale || 22 || savastrāśca vivastrāśca ramante kāmatṛptaye | cucumbuḥ svāminaṃ mūrchāṃ prāpurānandavāridhau || 23 || samāśliṣurdṛḍhaṃ kāntaṃ kṛtvā vakṣasi varṣmaṇi | evaṃ tṛptiṃ dadau kṛṣṇo jale’pi suciraṃ prabhuḥ || 24|| atha nirgatya vastrāṇi dhārayāmāsurutsukāḥ | tataśca khelanaṃ cakre bhinnaṃ bhinnaṃ surañjanam || 22 || śṛṃgāraṃ ca vividhaṃ tāścakre kṛṣṇasya garvitāḥ | kṛṣṇastāsāṃ kabaryādiśṛgāraṃ tvasṛjannavam || 26 || kācit kāntaṃ puraḥ kṛtvā cakāra keśasādhanam | kācid dadau tu cūḍāyāṃ mayūrapicchamuttamam || 27|| kācid dadau cakṣuṣostu kajjalaṃ bhālakuṃkumam | guñjāmālyaṃ ca cūḍāyāṃ veṣṭayāmāsa kācana || 28 || kācid vastraṃ dadau sūkṣmaṃ svāmine cottarīyakam | kācid dadau kusumānāṃ mālāṃ kaṇṭhe manoharām || 2 9|| kāciccakāra tilakaṃ candrakaṃ kācidādadhat | kācidalaktakaṃ hastapādatalanakheṣvadāt || 1.488.30 || kācid vaṃśī dadau haste kācittāmbūlakaṃ dadau | anyā sudarpaṇe ramyaṃ darśayāmāsa cānanam || 3 1 || parā cakāra kṛṣṇasya pādasaṃvāhanaṃ mudā | anyā jalaṃ dadau kācid dadau satpavanaṃ śanaiḥ || 32 || kāciccandanalepaṃ ca cakāra kṛṣṇavarṣmaṇi | aparā hastamādāya granthisphoṭaṃ cakāra ha || 33 || itarā jaṃghayoḥ sakthnormardanaṃ pracakāra vai | nanṛtuśca jaguḥ kāścit kāściccucumburutsukāḥ ||34|| kācit kṛṣṇaṃ samādāya nikuṃje prajagāma ha | anyā taṃ śayane kṛtvādade ratisukhaṃ mudā ||35|| nartanaṃ kārayāmāsa taṃ tu kācid balena vai | so’pi kasyāścitkabaryāḥ sunirmāṇaṃ cakāra ha ||36|| sindūraṃ pradadau bhāle kastūrīṃ bindubhiḥ saha | atisūkṣmaṃ candanenduṃ kautukāt tadadho dadau ||37|| patrāvalīṃ sulalitāṃ sukapole cakāra ha | pādayormañjire datvālaktakaṃ sundaraṃ dadau ||38|| bhūṣaṇairbhūṣayāmāsa lopayāmāsa candanam | pradade nāsikāmadhye durlabhaṃ gajamauktikam ||39|| evaṃ kṛṣṇā navalakṣaṃ navalakṣaṃ ca gopikāḥ | anyonyaṃ bhūṣayāmāsuḥ rame kāmāticeṣṭitāḥ ||1.488.40|| bahumūrtīḥ saṃvidhāya yogināṃ paramo guruḥ | punaścakāra śṛṃgāraṃ gopīnāṃ kāmasaukhyadam ||41 || mūrchāmavāpuḥ satataṃ kāmānandapariplutāḥ | evaṃ rāmā ramayitvā kṛtvā ṣāṇmāsikīṃ niśām ||42|| nidrāṃ dīrghāṃ bhuvi kṛtvā kṛtvārkasya sthirāṃ gatim | kāmatṛptiṃ parāṃ datvāpyūrdhvaretāḥ pareśvaraḥ ||43|| apraskhalitaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo babhūva kāmagarvahṛt | punarjagāma rāsasya maṇḍape rāsakhelanam ||44|| cakāra bahubhramaṇairvividhaiḥ kīrtanaistadā | sarve devādayo vyomni sthitāḥ patnīprajāyutāḥ ||45|| cikṣipuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca dadṛśū rāsamaṇḍalam | kastūrīcandanādīnāṃ vṛṣṭiṃ cakrurmunīśvarāḥ ||46 || jayakāraṃ stutiṃ kṛtvā yayuste yamunātaṭe | śrīkṛṣṇo ramayāmāsa viśramya tu punaśca tāḥ ||47|| vijahārāpi sarvatra nirjaneṣu yatheṣṭakam | puṣpodyāneṣu ramyeṣu sarasāṃ sutaṭeṣvapi ||48|| kandare kandare ramye nadeṣu ca nadīṣvapi | vāñcchiteṣu pramadānāṃ trayastriṃśadvaneṣvapi ||49|| bhāṇḍīre śrīvane ramye kadambakānane tathā | tulasīkānane kundavane campakakānane ||1.488.50|| nimbāraṇye madhuvane jambīrakānane tathā | nālikeravane pūgavane ca kadalīvane ||5 1 || badarīkānane bilvavane nāriṃgakānane | aśvatthakānane vaṃśavane dāḍimakānane ||5 2|| mandārakānane tālavane cāmravane tathā | ketakīkānane’śokavane kharjūrakānane ||53 || āmrātakavane jambūvane śālasukānane | kaṭādikānane padmavane jātivane tathā ||54|| nyagrodhagahane ramye tathā śrīkhaṇḍakānane | prakṛṣṭakesaravane reme ṣāṇmāsikīṃ niśām ||55|| kāminīnāṃ yathā kāmaḥ śṛṃgāreṇa vivardhate | tathā tathā harī reme tāsāmānandadāyakaḥ ||56|| tathāpi mānasaṃ pūrṇaṃ kāminīnāṃ babhūva na | āprātarevaṃ rāseṣu dadau kāmasukhaṃ hariḥ ||57|| sarvāsāṃ ca yadā kāmatṛptirjātā mumoca tāḥ | tato yamyāṃ gatā vārṣu krīḍanārthaṃ tataḥ param ||58|| kṛṣṇastvadṛśyatāṃ yāto gopyo yayurnijālayān | etā gopāṃganāḥ sarvā neśvaraṃ menire patim ||59|| kāmukyaḥ kāmabhāvena ratiśūraṃ hi manvate | tathāpi tanmanaskāstāḥ prāpurdivyagatiṃ priyāḥ ||1.488.6 0|| divyayogājjaḍaṃ cāpi divyabhāvaṃ vrajatyapi | kṛṣṇaṃ loṣṭaṃ vahniyogād vahnibhāvaṃ hi ṛcchati ||6 1 || atha rāsasya vai śreṣṭhānmaṇḍapān kṛtrimān śubhān | viśvakarmakṛtān divyān śatayojanavistṛtān ||6 2|| navalakṣāsanān ramyānparyaṃkānnavalakṣakān | viśvakarmā tirohitām̐ścakāra kṣaṇamātrataḥ ||6 3 || athaikalaḥ kiśoro’yaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ svagṛhaṃ prati | yāvadgacchati mārge taṃ dadarśa munipuṃgavaḥ || 64|| aṣṭāvakraḥ kṛṣṇavarṇo digambaro jaṭānvitaḥ | nakhaśmaśrusudīrghaśca śāntaḥ praṇatakandharaḥ ||6 5 || sa vai praṇamya govindaṃ tuṣṭāva munipuṃgavaḥ | prāṇām̐statyāja yogena nipatya caraṇāmbuje ||66 || tattejastu samuttasthau saptatālapramāṇakam | sudivyaḥ puruṣo bhūtvā tasthau kṛṣṇasamīpataḥ ||67|| dṛṣṭvā mṛtaṃ muniṃ kṛṣṇaḥ saṃskāraṃ kartumudyataḥ | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi nirāhāro’bhavanmuniḥ ||6 8|| raktamāṃsāsthihīnaṃ tadvarṣma bhasmabhṛtaṃ hyabhūt| | taduddhṛtya dadau kṛṣṇaścitāyāṃ bhasma miśritam ||6 9 || etasminnantare vyomnaḥ syandanaḥ prasamāyayau | pārṣadapravarairyuktaḥ śrīkṛṣṇasadṛśairvaraiḥ ||1.488.70|| pārṣadāḥ śrīhariṃ natvā nītvā taṃ divyapūruṣam | aṣṭāvakraṃ muktadehaṃ jagmurgolokamuttamam ||71 || śṛṇu lakṣmi brahmaṇastu pracetāstasya cāsitaḥ | sutaḥ saputravihīnastapastepe sahasrakam ||72|| abdānāṃ sakalatro’pi na lebhe ca yadā sutam | tadā prāṇān vihātuṃ so’bhavadudyamito’tha vai ||73|| taṃ samboddhuṃ babhūvātha satyā vāgaśarīriṇī | kathaṃ tyajasi prāṇām̐stvaṃ gaccha śaṃkarasannidhim ||74|| siddhaṃ kuru gṛhītvā tu mantraṃ śaṃkaravaktrataḥ | vareṇābhīṣṭadevyāśca putraste bhavitā dhruvam ||75|| śrutvā yayau sa kailāsaṃ sakalatra uvāca tam | mahādeva kṛpāsindho dehi putraṃ namāmyaham ||76|| haraḥ prāha bhavitā te putro madaṃśamatsamaḥ | japa mantraṃ rādhikāyai śrīkṛṣṇāya namo’stu te ||77|| rādhā mantreṇa pratyakṣā śatavarṣottaraṃ hyabhūt| | putravān bhava cetyuktvādṛśyā babhūva rādhikā ||78|| asitasya tataḥ putro devalākhyo babhūva ha | suyajñanṛpateḥ kanyāṃ ratnamālāvatībruvām ||79|| jagṛhe sa vivāhena śatavarṣottaraṃ sa ca | viraktaḥ śayane tyaktvā tāṃ svayaṃ tu vanaṃ yayau ||1.488.80|| tapase parvate gandhamādane’bdasahasrakam | tapaścacāra divyo’bhūd dehena sūryavad dvijaḥ ||81 || raṃbhā taṃ devalaṃ dṛṣṭvā tvekadā kāmamohitā | tapobhaṃgārthamāgacchajjagrāha devalo na tām ||82|| ruṣṭā śāpaṃ dadau kopādantarduḥkhānvitā satī | kāmaduḥkhena duḥkhārtā yato māṃ svīkaroṣi na ||83|| bhava kubjaścāṣṭavakro jarjaro nīlavikṛtaḥ | tapohīnaḥ kurūpaśca kāminījanagarhitaḥ ||84|| rambhā śaptvā yayau svargamṛṣirnāmnāṣṭavakrakaḥ | devalaḥ sa prasiddho’bhūt prayayau malayācalam ||85|| ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapaḥ punaścakāra saḥ | so’yaṃ jñātvā rāsakhelaṃ darśanāya samāgataḥ ||86|| dhyānamagno dīrghasūtrī na prāpto rāsadarśanam | kṛṣṇayogād yayau dhāma golokaṃ bhaktimān muniḥ ||87|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo viṣṇuryayau nandagṛhaṃ tataḥ | prātaḥ smaranti sarvāstā vikṛtāḥ kṛṣṇatanmayāḥ ||88|| iti lakṣmi kathitaṃ te rāsamaṇḍalamuttamam | paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya kṛṣṇaprāptirbhaveddhruvam ||89|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne rāsamaṇḍale gopībhiḥ kāmabhāvena kṛṣṇasya caritram, devalasya raṃbhāyāḥ śāpenāṣṭāvakratvaṃ, tasya mokṣaṇaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāśītyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||488||
<1.489> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ ramyāṃ camatkārapurodbhavām | satyadharmaparāṃ tiryagyonimokṣakarīṃ śubhām || 1 || nāganadyāstaṭe tatra dakṣiṇe yojanadvaye | āste sarovaraṃ dīrghaṃ pañcayojanavistṛtam || 2 || kasyacittvatha kālasya snātvā tatra sarovare | durvāsā munirāḍ rājñaḥ kalaśasya gṛhaṃ yayau || 3 || camatkārapureśaṃ taṃ kalaśaṃ prāha satvaraḥ | cāturmāsyavratastho’haṃ pāraṇaṃ kartumutsahe || 4 || tasmād yatkiṃcidannaṃ te siddhamasti gṛhe nṛpa | tad dehi bhojanārthaṃ me bubhukṣātīva vardhate || 5 || kalaśākhyo mahārājaḥ siddhānnaṃ yadupasthitam | miṣṭānnaṃ vyañjanaṃ coṣyaṃ peyaṃ khādyaṃ tathāmiṣam || 6 || sarvaṃ bhojyakṛte tasmai pradadau svayameva vai | athāsau bubhuje vipraḥ sūpaṃ māṃsarasānvitam || 7 || ajñātabhojano vipro jñātvānnaṃ māṃsamiśritam | vratabhaṃgasya doṣeṇa cukopa taṃ śaśāpa ca || 8 || yato māṃsānvitaṃ datvā vratabhaṃgaḥ kṛto mama | tasmāttvaṃ cāmiṣāhāro bhava vyāghro vanādiṣu || 9 || rājā pradīnavacanaḥ provācānugrahaṃ kuru | ājñāṃkitasya dāsasya bhaktasya vinatasya ca || 1.489.1 0|| durvāsāstaṃ tataḥ prāha yadā dhenustu nandinī | śaṃbhorbāṇaṃ bhūtalasthaṃ darśayiṣyati te nṛpa || 11 || bhaviṣyasi tadā muktaścetyuktvā prayayau muniḥ | babhūva rājā bhayakṛd vyāghrākṛtirvanecaraḥ || 1 2||| atha kālena ca gavāṃ kulaṃ tṛṇārthamāgatam | yatrāsīnnandinī dhenurhaṃsavarṇā ghaṭasravā || 1 3|| sā tṛṇārthaṃ nikuṃjānte gatā liṃgaṃ tu śūlinaḥ | dadarśa tṛṇadhānyādicchannaṃ gulmādimadhyagam || 14|| tatastasyopari sthitvā susrāva sumahatpayaḥ | tatra daivāt sa vai vyāghro bhramam̐stvarita āyayau || 15|| dṛṣṭvā tāṃ nandinīṃ vyāghraḥ prajagrāha tatastu sā | goṣṭhe baddhaṃ svakaṃ vatsamatṛṇādaṃ payaḥparam || 16|| saṃsmṛtya duḥkhitā dīnā karuṇaṃ paryadevayat | aho’haṃ kena pāpena tyaktvā vālaṃ tu goṣṭhagam || 17|| maraṇārtha vyāghramukhe patitā śaṃkaro’vatu | yena satyena bhaktyā tai snapanāya tṛṇāya ca || 18|| āgatā tena satyena bhūyānme sutasaṃgamaḥ | vyāghraḥ śrutvā tāmuvāca tyaja vṛthā pralāpakān || 1 9|| iṣṭadevaṃ svargadaṃ tvaṃ smara saukhyaṃ tato bhavet | avaśyaṃ maraṇaṃ te’sti yato’sti vaśagā mama ||1.489.20|| dhenuḥ prāha śṛṇu vyāghra nātmānaṃ vilapāmyaham | śaṃbhupūjāṃ vidhāyaiva mṛtyurme mokṣado yataḥ ||2 1 || vatso me gokule baddhaḥ smaramāṇo madāgamam | santiṣṭhate payovṛttiḥ kathaṃ syāt sa mayā vinā ||22|| tasmānmuñca mahāvyāghra māmadya sutavatsalām | sakhījanasya taṃ datvā samāgacchāmi te’ntikam ||23|| vyāghra uvāca yā mṛtyormukhānniṣkramya yāti sā | punarnaiva samāgacchet tasmāt tvāṃ bhakṣayāmi ||24|| nandinyuvāca śapathairāgamiṣyāmi te’ntikam | yatpāpaṃ brahmahatyāyāṃ mātāpitrośca vañcane ||25|| guroḥ sādhorvañcane ca patyuḥ sādhvyāśca vañcane | tena pāpena lipyāmi nāgacchāmi punaryadi ||26|| viśvāsaghātināṃ pāpaṃ kṛtaghnānāṃ ca yadbhavet | vratabhaṃgaprakartṝṇāṃ devakhaṇḍanakāriṇām ||27|| nindakānāṃ jīvikāhāriṇāṃ pāpaṃ ca yadbhavet | tena pāpena lipyāmi nāgacchāmi punaryadi ||28|| evaṃ śapathān vyāghraḥ sa śrutvā vismayato’bravīt | yadyevaṃ tadgṛhaṃ gaccha vīkṣayasva nijātmajam ||29|| sakhīnāmarpayitvātha bhūya āgamanaṃ kuru | ityuktā raṃbhamāṇā sā yayau vatsaṃ tvarānvitā ||1.489.3 0|| athākālāgatāṃ dṛṣṭvā raṃbhamāṇāṃ svamātaram | vatsaḥ prapaccha kasmāt tvamadyākāle samāgatā ||3 1 || udbhrāntamānasāḥ kasmād bāṣpaklinnānanā kutaḥ | mātā prāha payaḥpānaṃ kuru paścād vadāmi te ||32|| vatsaḥ papau payaḥ pūrṇaṃ mūrdhnyāghrātastayā muhuḥ | ālīḍhaśca śanairukto vyāghravṛttānta eva ca ||33|| ahaṃ gatā vane tvadya vyāghreṇāsāditā balāt | sa mayā prārthito vyāghro bhakṣamāṇo nakhāyudhaḥ ||34|| śapathairāgamiṣyāmi goṣṭhe saṃvīkṣya bālakam | sāhaṃ tena vinirmuktā tavārthaṃ śapathaiḥ suta ||35|| atha tatra gamiṣyāmi datvā tvāmanyadhenave | sukhī jīva priya vatsa bhojito dṛṣṭabhāṣitaḥ ||36|| vatsāhāhaṃ ca tatraiva yāsyāmi yatra gacchasi | ślāghyaṃ hi maraṇaṃ samyaṅ māturagre mamādhunā ||37|| ekākināpi martavyaṃ tvayā hīnena vai mayā | tvadagrato hi martavyaṃ svargadaṃ me bhaviṣyati ||38|| yadi mātastvayā sārdhaṃ vyāghro māṃ sūdayiṣyayi | yā gatirmātṛbhaktānāṃ sā me nūnaṃ bhaviṣyati ||39|| athavā śapathaiścāhaṃ yāmi tvamatra tiṣṭha vai | nāsti mātṛsamo bandhurbālānāṃ kṣīrajīvinām ||1.489.40|| nāsti mātṛsamo nātho nāsti mātṛsamā gatiḥ | nāsti mātṛsamaḥ pūjyo nāsti mātṛsamaḥ sakhā ||41 || nāsti mātṛsamo devastviha loke paratra ca | evaṃ sevā sadā mātuḥ kartavyā bhaktiruttamā || 42|| mātṛsevāṃ paraṃ dharmamanutiṣṭhanti ye sutāḥ | gatiṃ te paramāṃ yānti mātrāśīrvādalakṣitāḥ ||43|| tasmādahaṃ gamiṣyāmi tvaṃ tu tiṣṭhātra goṣṭhake | ātmaprāṇaistava prāṇān rakṣayiṣyāmyasaṃśayam ||44|| putravākyaṃ dharmayuktaṃ śrutvovāca tu nandinī | mamaiva vihito mṛtyurna te putrādya vāsare ||45|| tatkathaṃ mama jīvaṃ tvaṃ rakṣasyasubhirātmanaḥ | māturvākyamanuṣṭhāya pramādaṃ mā samācara ||46 || lobhāt saṃjāyate nāśastviha loke paratra ca | lobhātpramādādviśvāsājano vai badhyate tribhiḥ ||47|| tasmāllobhastvayā putra mā kāryo gamanāya vai | ātmā putra tvayā rakṣyaḥ sarvadaiva prayatnataḥ ||48|| naikākinā pragantavyaṃ yūthaṃ tyaktvā nijaṃ kvacit | evaṃ saṃbhāṣya taṃ lakṣmi muhustamavalihya vai ||49|| śokabāṣpasamāyuktā sakhīmadhye’bhavat kṣaṇam | uvāca bahule campe vasudhāre ghaṭasrave ||1.489.50|| haṃsanāde śriyānande | śubhakṣīre mahodaye | tathānyā dhenavaḥ sarvāḥ śrutvā kurvantu madvacaḥ ||51|| adya vyāghreṇa nikaṭe bhakṣyārthaṃ gṛhītāsmyaham | prāptā yuṣmaddarśanārthaṃ sutasya darśanāya ca ||52||| śapathaiḥ kṛcchrāccāyātā duṣṭaḥ putraḥ subhāṣitaḥ | śāsito bhavatīnāṃ ca pradattaḥ putrako mayā ||53|| jñānājñānakṛtaṃ yadvai bhavatīnāṃ tu duṣkṛtam | kṣāntvānāthodugdhapo me bālo rakṣyaḥ sadā priyāḥ ||54|| mātṛśokābhisantaptaḥ pālyaḥ sarvābhireva saḥ | ahaṃ tatra gamiṣyāmi sa vyāghro yatra vartate ||55|| apaścimaḥ praṇāmo’yaṃ sarvāsāṃ vihito mayā | śrutvā tad dhenavaḥ prāhurna gantavyaṃ hi nandini ||56|| āpaddharme śapathastu mṛṣā kartavya eva yat | pāpaṃ nāsti mṛṣāvaktaḥ prāṇanāśe hyupasthite ||57|| vivāhe narmaṇi nāryāṃ prāṇāpadi dhanāpadi | anṛtaṃ nahi pāpāya dharmaḥ proktaḥ sa rakṣakaḥ ||58|| pālayasva nijaṃ putraṃ vrajāsmābhirnijaṃ gṛham | śrutvā tā nandinī prāha paraprāṇasya rakṣaṇe ||59|| pañcānṛtaṃ śubho dharmo na svaprāṇasya rakṣaṇe | sādhūnāṃ satyamevāsti dharmastāraṇakārakaḥ ||1.489.60 || satye pratiṣṭhito loko dharmaḥ satye pratiṣṭhitaḥ | viṣṇave pṛthivīṃ datvā baliḥ satye vyavasthitaḥ ||61|| pratijñāya vihanyāccet sarvaghātī bhaveddhi saḥ | dhenavo’tha tadā prāhurnamaskāryāsi sarvathā ||62|| satyadharmavatī prāṇān gaṇayasyeva naiva yat | kiṃ vakṣyāmo vṛṣe satye sthitāṃ tvāṃ devavanditām ||63|| tasmād gaccha mahāpuṇye na śocyaḥ putrakastvayā | śubhaste vijayaścāstu dharmo rakṣatu nandinīm ||64|| ityuktvā nandinī sakhījanān natvā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | vanādhidevatāḥ sarvā rakṣantu mama putrakam ||65|| evaṃ pralapamānā sā yayau vyāghrasthalaṃ tu gauḥ | vyāghro vyāttānanaścāste tasyā mārgāvalokakaḥ ||66|| nandinī prāha taṃ natvā tvāgatāhaṃ vanecara | satyamālambya dharma vai kuru tṛptiṃ prabhakṣaya ||67|| vyāghraḥ prāha sati satye sthitā vighnavivarjitā | tvāṃ dṛṣṭvāhaṃ mahāpuṇyo bhavāmyadyātipāvanaḥ ||68|| nahi satyavatāṃ kiñcidaśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit | ahaṃ bhadre durācāro hiṃsakaḥ pāpaśevadhiḥ ||69|| tvāṃ dharmiṣṭhāṃ ghātayitvā prāpsyāmi khalu kāṃ gatim | tasmāt tvaṃ me jñānadānaprasādaṃ kartumarhasi ||1.489.70|| satsaṃgaṃ saphalaṃ labdhvā gatirme śubhadā bhavet | dhenuḥ prāha tapaḥ satye, tretāyāṃ dhyānameva tu ||71 || dvāpare yajñadānaṃ ca, dānamekaṃ kalau śubham | kalyante tu harernāma tārakaṃ kevalaṃ bhavet ||72|| sarvadānottamadānaṃ hyabhayasya pradānakam | hiṃsrāṇāṃ tu bhavet tanna tasmācchrīharikīrtanam ||73|| sevanaṃ śrīharervāpi śaṃbhorvā rādhikāpateḥ | karma mokṣakaraṃ syācca tvaṃ sadā tatsamācara ||74|| gahane’tra vane vyāghra vartate’tra harasthalam | tṛṇacchannaṃ śivaliṃgaṃ nityaṃ prātaḥ prapūjaya ||75|| pradakṣiṇāṃ praṇāmādi kuru muktirbhaviṣyati | ityuktvā darśayāmāsa liṃgaṃ vyāghrasya nandinī ||76|| vyāghro dṛṣṭvā satvaraṃ vai yathā rājābhavat purā | durvāsaḥśāpamukto’bhūt smṛtvā prāha ca nandinīm ||77|| nṛpaḥ kalaśanāmāhaṃ haihayānvayasaṃbhavaḥ | durvāsaso muneḥ śāpād vyāghratve samupāgataḥ ||78|| nandinīdhenuyogena śāpamuktirbhaviṣyati | śaṃkarasya darśanena punā rājā bhaviṣyasi ||79|| ityahaṃ pūrvavṛttāntaṃ smarāmyadya śucitvade | ityuktvā sa praṇamyaiva gāṃ śivaṃ taṃ nanāma ca ||1.489.80 || pupūja parayā bhaktyā snapayāmāsa gauḥ śivam | dugdhena tu tadā śaṃbhurāvirbhūya jagāda ha ||81 || mama bhaktau sadā śuddhau muktyarthaṃ kṛṣṇameva vai | bhajatāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patiṃ hariṃ mudā ||82|| ityuktau śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | mantraṃ gṛhītvā yayaturnijaṃ nijaṃ gṛhaṃ tataḥ ||83|| kuṭumbādikamubhayorānandaṃ cāptavat tadā | kālena muktimāpanno kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritau ||84|| vimānena sudivyena yayatuḥ kṛṣṇadhāma tau | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vṛṣaṃ labhet ||85|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne camatkārapurīyakalaśākhyanṛpasya durvāsasaḥ śāpād vyāghratvaṃ, nandinīdhenuyogācchivadarśanānmuktiḥ, satyavratasya prabhāvaścetinirūpaṇanāmaikonanavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||489||
<1.490> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ tvanyāṃ sadbhāgyasampadāṃ pradām | āsīd rājā vṛko nāma somavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ || 1 || tasya bhāryābhavatsādhvī pātivratyaparāyaṇā | tayoḥ paścimavarṣeṣu kanyā tvekābhavat tadā || 2 || jyotirvido janmalagnaṃ dṛṣṭvā prāhurnṛpaṃ nṛpīm | citrāsaṃsthe ravau tithau caturdaśyāṃ niśākare || 3 || yā kanyā prāpnuyājjanma sā bhaved viṣakanyakā | tasyāḥ pāṇergrāhakaḥ ṣaṇmāseṣu nidhanaṃ vrajet || 4 || yadgṛhe janma cāpannā tat syād vaibhavavarjitam | seyaṃ rājam̐stava putrī tādṛśī viṣakanyakā || 5 || paitṛkaṃ śvaśurīyaṃ ca haniṣyati gṛhadvayam | rājam̐styaktvā tatastāṃ tvaṃ sadā rājye sukhī bhava || 6 || yadvā sā ca bhavet sādhvī yatinī sāṃkhyayoginī | tadā kuladvayoddhāraṃ kariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 7 || abhāgyānāmapi bhāgyaṃ tyāgitve parivartate | bhasmacchanno yatiścūrṇamoṣadhaṃ śreyase yataḥ || 8 || yatra kvāpi samutpanno yatirmaṇiśca mauktikam | svarṇaṃ kanyauṣadhaṃ sarve divyatāṃ yānti dīkṣayā || 9 || tasmād yatheṣṭaṃ kartavyaṃ rocate yacca te nṛpa | ityukto’pi sa rājarṣirmatvā bhāgyaṃ svapūrvakṛt || 1.490.1 0|| mārjayitumaśakyaṃ tāṃ na vai tatyāja vatsalaḥ | yena yena śarīreṇa yadyat karma karoti yaḥ || 11 || yasyāṃ yasyāmavasthāyāṃ yādṛśādvegataśca yat | tena tasyāṃ ca tadbhuṃkte nākṛtaṃ prāpyate kvacit || 1 2|| pañcaitānīha sṛjyante garbhasthasyaiva dehinaḥ | āyuḥ karma ca vittaṃ ca vidyā nidhanameva ca || 13 || yathā vṛkṣeṣu vallīṣu phalāni kusumāni ca | svaṃ kālaṃ nātivartante tadvatkarma purākṛtam || 14|| yathā dhenusahasreṣu vatso vidanti mātaram | tathaiva koṭimadhyasthaṃ kartāraṃ karma vindati || 1 5|| svena pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ karma na kaścid dehavān bhuvi | balena prajñayā vāpi samarthaḥ kartumanyathā || 16|| svakṛtānyupatiṣṭhanti sukhaduḥkhāni dehinām | ahaṃkāramamatvābhyāṃ sajjate yaḥ sa baddhyate || 17|| suśīghramabhidhāvantaṃ nijaṃ karmābhidhāvati | śete saha śayānena tiṣṭhantamanutiṣṭhati || 18|| yena yatrāpi bhoktavyaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukhaḥmeva vā | naraḥ sa baddho rajjveva balāttatraiva nīyate || 1 9|| jāgratāṃ svapatāṃ vāpi prajalpatāṃ pragacchatām | karma siṣādhayiṣūṇāṃ pratipādayitāmapi ||1.490.20|| sarvasvārpaṇakartṝṇāmavaśyamupatiṣṭhati | tailakṣaye yathādīpo nirvāṇamadhigacchati ||2 1 || karmakṣaye tvāśayānāṃ kṣaye nirvāṇamṛcchati | kleśamūlā vāsanā sā karmāśayā nigadyate ||22|| tadutpannaphalaṃ dṛṣṭādṛṣṭajanmani vedhate | na mantrā na tapo dānaṃ na tīrthaṃ na ca vāśrayaḥ ||23 || samarthā rakṣituṃ jantuṃ pūrvakarmapravāhataḥ | annapānāni jīryanti bhojanāni divāniśam ||24|| tasminnevodare garbhaḥ kathaṃ nāma na jīryate | tasmād garbhasamaṃ karma bhoge vinā na naśyati ||25|| śubhaṃ vā yadi vā pāpaṃ svakṛtaṃ prāpyate janaiḥ | tadvadiyaṃ mama putrī yathākarma samāgatā ||26|| viṣakanyā mama bhāgye likhitā pūrvakarmabhiḥ | tattathāstu daivadattaṃ helanīyaṃ na karhicit ||27|| upasthitaṃ tu bhogārthaṃ samāgacchatu māṃ prati | vaibhave bahavo bhogā tannāśe tāpasī sthitiḥ ||28|| ubhayatrāpi lābho me nirvāṇaṃ ca nisargataḥ | daivadattaṃ mileccedvai ko lābhastata uttamaḥ ||29|| putrī nimittarūpā me vairāgye’pi bhaviṣyati | mama muktau ca tasyāśca muktirapi bhaviṣyati || 1.490.3 0|| arakṣaṃ tiṣṭhati daivād daivānnaśyati rakṣitam | daivājjīvatyanātho’pi daivānnaśyati nāthavān ||3 1 || ativārdhakyasaukhyārthaṃ putrī tvālambanaṃ mama | saviṣā vā sarvanāśā kathaṃ tyajāmi cātmajām ||32|| anāthāmabalāṃ tyaktvā kathaṃ syāṃ bhrūṇahā bhuvi | poṣyatyāgaṃ vidhāyaiva bhaveyaṃ yāmyagaḥ katham ||33|| ātmā putrī putratulyā tadarthe pṛthivīṃ tyajet | saiva lakṣmī mama bālā mama bhāgyādupāgatā ||34|| ete svārthaparāḥ sarve vadantu manasepsitam | mayā putrī rakṣaṇīyā vairāgyāya nivṛttaye ||35|| kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bahusamaṃ dṛṣṭā bhogā anantakāḥ | putrīmiṣeṇa nirbandhaḥ kariṣye bhajanaṃ hareḥ ||36|| sarvaṃ naśyatu me śīghraṃ svārthā naśyantu vighnadāḥ | bhaktirmuktiḥ sutā śāntiḥ sadvṛttirmā vinaśyatu ||37|| evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā nātyajat kanyakāṃ nijām | sāpi śarmavatī nityaṃ vairāgyeṇa hi vartate ||38|| tasmāt śarmavatī nāmnā kṛtā pitrā sukhapradā | atha sā yauvanaṃ prāptā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sadā ||39|| bhajati sma prage snātvā namati sma pituḥ padam | sevate sma prasūṃ sādhvī matvā puṇyamanuttamam ||1.490.40 || atha pūrvakṛtād daivād vṛkasya nṛpateḥ purīm | śatravaḥ parito vṛttvā tvayuddhyan bahuvāsarān ||41 || vṛko yuddhe hato daivād dine tu daśame yadā | tadā lokāstadevocuranayā viṣakanyāyā ||42| | rājño rājyaṃ gataṃ sarvaṃ rājāpi nihato raṇe | ukto jyotirvidā pūrvaṃ nṛpastatyāja naiva tām ||43 || adhunā vadhyatāṃ tveṣā niryāsyatāṃ purāditaḥ | avaśiṣṭasya rakṣā syādanyathā nāśa eva hi ||44|| kanyā śrutvā prajāvāṇīṃ niryayau niśithe satī | hāṭakeśvaraśaṃbhośca kṣetraṃ gatvā kṣaṇaṃ sthitā |||45||| natvā śaṃbhuṃ śokamagnā cintayāmāsa vai mṛtim | atha tasyāḥ smṛtirjātā pūrvajanmasamudbhavā ||46|| caṇḍālatve mayā pūrvaṃ gaurekā vitṛṣīkṛtā | tatpuṇyena nṛpaputrī sañjātāsmi vṛkālaye ||47|| pūrvadehe bahuputrā tvāsaṃ caṇḍālabhāminī | vigarhitā ca dāridryakadarthitā kṣudhārditā ||48|| tṛṣārditāpyahaṃ dadau jalaṃ gave supuṣkalam | tena puṇyena saṃjātā kanyāhaṃ bhūbhṛtaḥ khalu ||49|| kintu caṇḍālaputrītve tadā gaurīṃ tu kānakīm | corayitvā ca pāṣāṇairbabhaṃja khaṇḍaśaśca tām |||1.490.50|| devālayād vinirgatya vikrayārthaṃ mahāpaṇam | yāvadgatavatī tāvaddhṛtā rājabhaṭairaham ||51 || tāḍitā daṇḍitā kārāgāre kṣiptā tato mṛtā | pārvatīmūrtibhaṃgena sañjātā viṣakanyakā ||52|| mama karma mayāvaśyaṃ bhoktavyamaghameva tu | kintu jalapradānasya puṇyaṃ prāptaṃ mayā śubham ||53 || atha tatroṭajāṃ kṛtvā karomi tapa uttamam | jaladānaṃ phaladānaṃ yathāśakti ca sevanam ||54|| satāṃ yatīnāṃ sādhunāṃ gavāṃ dharmiṣṭhayoṣitām | bālānāṃ devabhaktānāṃ sevayā mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet ||55|| iti kṛtvā tapastepe gaurīṃ saṃsthāpya bhaktitaḥ | vrataṃ kṛtavatī gauryāḥ snātvā pūjādi cācarat ||56|| ekāntaropavāsaiśca nṛtyagītairmanoharaiḥ | toṣayāmāsa nityaṃ sā grīṣme pañcāgnisādhanā ||57|| śiśire jalamadhyasthā varṣāyāṃ jalavṛṣṭiṣu | sthitā pūrvaṃ phalāhārā patrāhārā tataḥ param ||58|| śuṣkaparṇādinī paścājjalāhārā babhūva sā | vāyvāhārā tato jātā cātmārāmā tataḥ param |||59|| ākāśaśayanā tyaktakuṭīrā ca digambarā | babhūva dhūlikāmagnā bhūtale bhūtalaṃ yathā ||1.490.60| bahukālo gatastasyā yoginyā yogadharmataḥ | mukhaṃ valibhirākrāntaṃ palitairaṅkitaṃ śiraḥ ||6 1 | kanyābhāve’pi vartantyā gaurī tuṣṭā babhūva ha | atha tasyāḥ parīkṣārthaṃ śacī bhūtvā tu pārvatī ||62|| śvetaṃ gajaṃ samāruhya mahārājñī samāyayau ||. dadhatī mukuṭaṃ mūrdhni sevyamānāpsarogaṇaiḥ ||6 3|| prasannavadanā śarmavatīṃ provāca sādaram | varaṃ vṛṇu yatheṣṭaṃ te dadāmi tāpasi priye ||64|| ahaṃ bhāryā sureśasyendrāṇī bhavāmi nāmataḥ | svayaṃ prāptā dayāṃ kṛtvā dātuṃ tava tapaḥphalam ||65|| bhavānī niṣṭhurā kanye nādyāpi tvāṃ prapaśyati | iti śrutvā rajo dehāduddhūlya ca kṛtāñjaliḥ ||66|| namaskṛtyāha nāhaṃ tvatprasādaṃ cintaye śaci | varaṃ tvattastu necchāmi nānyāsāṃ devayoṣitām ||67|| yā devī śivakāntāsti varaṃ tasyā vṛṇomyaham | yayā varṣasahasrāṇi śivārthaṃ taptameva yat ||68|| kṛṣṇavāmāṃgasaṃbhūtā prakṛtiryā sadāśivā | yayā vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ tasyā varaṃ vṛṇomyaham ||69|| śacyuvāca tanayā kanyāmahaṃ vajradharī śacī | svāminyahaṃ tu devānāṃ devīnāmīśvarī satī ||1.490.70 || mayā dattairvaraiḥ sarvā devyo bhavanti kanyake | tvaṃ kathaṃ naiva gṛhṇāsi varaṃ mattaḥ kutāpasi ||7 1 || tannūnaṃ vajraghātena cūrṇayiṣyāmi te śiraḥ | iti śrutvā dhairyayuktā kanyā prāha sureśvarīm ||72|| svāminī tvaṃ surāṇāṃ ca devīnāmapi tadṛtam | yasyāḥ prāptaṃ tavaiśvaryaṃ parāṃ tāṃ toṣayāmyaham ||73|| svāgataṃ te mātṛtulyaṃ pūjye’rcayāmi satphalaiḥ | svalpamapyaparādhaṃ te na karomi maheśvari ||74|| tathāpi vadhayogyāṃ māṃ manyase nikṣipāyudham | evamuktvā śivāṃ dhyātvāvātatāra hṛdambare ||75|| cintayāmāsa ca hṛdi maraṇaṃ vā ca darśanam | ekaṃ labdhavyamevātra śacyā vā śivayoṣitaḥ ||76 || anyathā jvalanaṃ yogyaṃ sevayiṣyāmi cānalam | tāvat tvairāvato jātastadā siṃhasvarūpakaḥ ||77|| śacī jātā śivārūpā hyapsarasastu sevikāḥ | rudrāṇyo bhālacandrāśca śūlahastāḥ śubhānanāḥ ||78|| śuklāṃ śuklavṛṣasthāṃ pārvatīṃ śuklāmbarāṃ hṛdi | dṛṣṭvā śarmavatī cakṣurudghāṭyāgre vyalokayat ||79|| viṣakanyā stutiṃ cakre praṇipatya sagadgadā | namaste śāṃkari rakṣākari prāṇātivallabhe ||1.490.80 || sarvakāmaprade satye bhaktāyā hṛdayaṃgame | namasteṣṭaguṇaiśvaryavatyai satyai namo namaḥ ||8 1 || dhyāyanti yoginastvāṃ cārcayanti snehavastubhiḥ | samyagbhāvātmakaiḥ puṣpairarcayāmi maheśvari ||82|| ityuktvā praṇanāmātha pārvatī tāmuvāca ha | parituṣṭāsmi te putri varaṃ prārthaya vāñchitam ||83|| viṣakanyā tadovāca sarvaṃ jānāsi ceśvari | bharturarthe mayā sarvaḥ kṛto’yaṃ tapaudyamaḥ ||84|| tatkiṃ tena kariṣyāmi sāmprataṃ jarayāvṛtā | vasātra pārvati nityaṃ kanyānāṃ śubhadā bhava ||85|| ityuktā pārvatī tathāstviti prāha tataḥ param | pasparśa pāṇinā kanyāṃ cakāra navayauvanām ||86|| uvāconaṣoḍaśābdāṃ divyā campakasadṛśīm | vada kanye varārohe kimiṣyate tataḥ param ||87|| kanyāha mātaḥ śaṃbhorme darśanaṃ kāraya prabhoḥ | satī prāha samāgaccha kailāsaṃ siṃhasaṃsthitā ||88|| ityuktā sā śarmavatī yayau kailāsameva tu | dṛṣṭvā ca śaṃkaraṃ sādhvī labdhvā mantraṃ tu vaiṣṇavam ||89|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | kaṇṭhe ca tulasīmālāṃ gṛhītvā sāttvatī tadā ||1.490.90|| abhavad vaiṣṇavī kanyā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā | ante nārāyaṇaṃ labdhvā patiṃ muktiṃ jagāma sā ||91 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi śarmavatyāḥ śubhāvaham | tāpasyāḥ śuklacaritaṃ viṣakanyātapaḥ param ||92|| pārvatīniṣṭhayā bhaktyā labdhvā śaṃbhośca darśanam | vaiṣṇavī paramā bhūtvā yayau viṣṇostu mandiram ||93|| bhāgyahīnā gṛhahīnā karmahīnāpi yā bhavet | tapasārādhanayā ca bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheta tu ||94|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya tādṛśīṃ sadgatiṃ labhet | bhāgyarekhāṃ surekhāṃ ca kṛtvā dāsyaṃ harervrajet ||95|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne saurāṣṭrīyavṛkarājñaḥ śarmavatyā viṣakanyāyāḥ pitṛrājyanāśottaraṃ tapaḥ, pūrvajanmādismṛtiḥ, gaurīśaṃbhvorārādhanā, parīkṣā, varadānam, śivāśivadarśanam, kailāsagamanam, tato nārāyaṇabhaktyā vaikuṇṭhe mokṣaṇaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā navatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 490 ||
<1.491> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi camatkārapure nāganadītaṭe | muṇḍīre tu vare tīrthe camatkāraṃ vadāmi te || 1 || samudrakhāḍikāprānte viṭaṃkākhye pure śubhe | kuṣṭhavyādhiyuto vipraḥ śarākhyo yauvane’bhavat || 2 || śarabhāryābhavat sādhvī sudhāmnī śīlaśālinī | svāmisevāparā nityamindriyairnahi cañcalā || 3 || kuṣṭhitaṃ svāminaṃ cāpi paśyatyeva yathāsmaram | sevate dāsikārītyā patnīrītyā mudā mudā || 4 || auṣadhāni vicitrāṇi mahārghyāṇyapi cādade | tadarthamupalepām̐śca pathyāni vividhāni ca || 5 || tathā bhiṣagvarānnityamānayitvā ca sādaram | tadarthena guṇastasya yathā syāt sā hyakārayat || 6 || yathā yathā sa gṛhṇāti bheṣajāni tathā tathā | pūrvakarmavipākena rogo vyāpnoti varṣmaṇi || 7 || ekadā tasya cāyāto’tithirvipro’timārgagaḥ | taṃ śrāntaṃ ca gṛhaprāptaṃ dṛṣṭvā tasya priyā satī || 8 || ajñātaṃ taṃ gṛhibhaktyā bhojanādyairatoṣayat | kṛtāhāraṃ suviśrāntaṃ taṃ papraccha śaro dvijaḥ || 9 || kuta āgamyate vipra kutra yāsi sthalāntare | pānthaḥ prāha camatkārapurādāyāmi sāmpratam || 1.491.1 0|| yāmi kāntīpurīṃ yatra nivāso me sadā dvija | tatrāhamabhavaṃ kuṣṭhī pūrvakarmavipākataḥ || 11 || auṣadhāni vividhāni sevitānyapi sarvadā | kuṣṭho na naśyati kiṃcid vardhate tu dine dine || 12|| śrutaṃ cāpi mayā vaidyāccamatkārapure śubhe | sūryātīrthaṃ śubhaṃ tvāste kuṣṭhavyādhivināśakam || 13 || muṇḍīrasvāminaḥ sthāne sūryadevasya mandiram | tatra gacched vrataṃ kṛtvā snāyāt sūryaṃ prapūjayet || 14|| tena kuṣṭho bhavellīnaścamatkāro’sti daivikaḥ | athāha dravyamādāyāgacchaṃ tīrthaṃ ravisthalam || 15|| nityaṃ prātaḥ samutthāya snātvā paśyāmi bhāskaram | pūjayāmi yathāśakti praṇamāmi smarāmi ca || 16|| sūryavāre viśeṣeṇa nirāhāro bhavāmi ca | karomi jāgaraṃ rātrau gītavāditrakīrtanaiḥ || 17|| evaṃ pūjāṃ vrataṃ kurvan yāvatsamvatsaraṃ sthitaḥ | tataḥ samvatsarasyānte svapne mā bhāskaro’bravīt || 18|| prasanno’smi tava bhaktyā tataḥ kuṣṭhaṃ prayātu te | pūrvajanmani devasya yataḥ svarṇaṃ hṛtaṃ tvayā || 1 9|| kuṣṭhī tvamatra saṃjātaḥ pāpaṃ līnaṃ ca tat tava | oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrauṃ saḥ sūryāya namo rogavināśine | evamuktvā ravistatra jalenāsnāpayacca mām ||1.491.20|| tāvannidrā mama naṣṭāpaśyaṃ dehaṃ nirogakam | ahaṃ vai vismayaṃ prāpto dṛṣṭvā māṃ vyādhivarjitam || 21 || tasmāt tvaṃ yāhi viprendra camatkārapuraṃ śubham | sūryatīrthaṃ samāśritya vatsaraṃ sūryamarcaya | mantraṃ proktaṃ japa mālāvartanena divāniśam | | 22 || sarvavyādhipraṇāśaste sūryasevākṛto bhavet | svasti te’stu gamiṣyāmi svagṛhaṃ tvatra toṣitaḥ || 23 || ityuktvā sa yayau vipraścātha dvijaḥ sa kuṣṭhabhāg | vīkṣāṃcakre nijapatnyā vaktre dīno jano yathā || 24|| patnī pativratā sādhvī pānthoktaṃ cānvamanyata | gantavyaṃ nātha tattīrthaṃ yatra sūryo’sti kuṣṭhahā || 25||| ahaṃ tvayā samaṃ tatra śuśrūṣāniratā sadā | sthāsyāmi kaḥ paro lābhaḥ svāminaḥ sevanaṃ vinā || 26|| evamuktaḥ patirvipraḥ sādhvyā vittena saṃyutaḥ | hāṭakaśvaraje kṣetre samprāptaḥ sūryamandiram || 27|| dṛṣṭvā sūryagrahakṣetraṃ viśālaṃ tāpasānvitam | tapomanaścakārāyaṃ vairāgyaṃ puṇyato yayau || 288||| sudhāmnīṃ sa tataḥ prāha dhanyo’haṃ tvaṃ tathā priye | tīrthakṣetraṃ tāpasāśca ravirdṛṣṭāḥ supuṇyataḥ || 29|| muktirjātā priye’smākaṃ puṇyakṣetrāgamāt khalu | māyāmohād viniṣkrāntā bhajiṣyāmo hariṃ sadā || 1.491.30 || bhikṣāvṛttiṃ kariṣyāmo jīviṣyāmo yathātatham | rogo yātu ca mā yātu janmarogo bhaviṣyati || 31 || bhaja śāntiṃ hariṃ sādhvi śāntirme vartate’dhunā | tavāpi sarvadā śāntirastu mā khinnatā vraja || 32|| ahaṃ nirvedamāpannaḥ puṇyakṣetrāgamāt priye | tvaṃ yadi cecchasi kānte gṛhaṃ gantuṃ vrajādhunā || 33 || ahaṃ tīrthe svakaṃ dehaṃ tyaktvā yāsyāmi mokṣaṇam | ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa rakṣeti vai gṛṇan || 34|| vipraścakāra bhajanaṃ patnī prāha ca taṃ tadā | abhukte tvayi no bhuktaṃ kadācit kānta vai mayā || 35|| ekānte’pi mahābhāga na suptaṃ jāgrati tvayi | vinā kāntasya caraṇaṃ nāsti tvanyatra mānasam || 36 || sukhaṃ sarvaṃ kāntasevāṃ vinā nānyattu me hṛdi | kāntena sahitā kāntā sadā bhāgyavatī tviyam || 37|| kāntapuṇyena puṇyāhaṃ kathaṃ tyaktvā vrajāmyaham | paralokāya sārthaṃ tvāṃ tyaktvā yāmi kathaṃ gṛham || 38 || na gṛhaṃ vai śilājanyaṃ kintu vivāhamālayā| prāptaṃ vai paralokāya cetanaṃ tvaṃ gṛha mama || 3 9|| bhoktuṃ viśramituṃ rantuṃ tāpaṃ śamayituṃ tathā | gṛhaṃ sat kāntarūpaṃ vai satyā nāryāḥ sadāsti yat| ||1.491.40|| ātmano manasastanvāścendriyāṇāṃ sukhāptaye | gṛhaṃ krītaṃ prāṇadravyārpaṇena svāmināmakam ||41 || tatra gatāsmi nityaṃ vai gantavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate | agṛhiṇī kathaṃ yāmi tvayā hīnā gṛhāntaram |||42|| tasmāt tvayā samaṃ nātha kariṣye tīrthasevanam | dehayātrāṃ yathālabdhaiḥ kariṣye tava sevane ||43|| dharmapāśavinirbaddhāḥ satyenātmānamālabhe | sahadharmavṛtā patnī sahaiva tu gamiṣyati || 44|| evaṃ tasyā viditvā sa brāhmaṇo niścayaṃ dṛḍham | atīva tuṣṭo dhanyo’haṃ yasyedṛśī satī priyā || 45|| athaivaṃ vartamānau tau dampatī haritatparau | śrāvaṇe nāganadyāstu taṭe tatra mahotsave ||46 || lakṣādhikamanuṣyāṇāṃ samāje sūryadarśanam | kartuṃ yayatuḥ pūjāṃ ca śubhāṃ viśeṣavastubhiḥ || 47|| janānāṃ bahusammardaṃ vipro’bhūddhārṣatastadā | patito janasammarde’pyaśakto notthitaḥ punaḥ || 48 || aśaktā tvabalā netumūrdhvaṃ sammardakarṣitā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ||49 || iti jāpaṃ kṛtavatī satī sādhvī pativratā | oṃ savitre namaḥ sākṣirūpiṇe paramātmane ||1.491.50 || itijāpaṃ kṛtavān sa bhakto vipro virāgavān | tāvat tayoḥ prarakṣārthe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo raviḥ || 51|| samāyātāvekakāle hastenādāya tāvubhau | ambare divyahastena kṛtvā sammārjya tāvubhau || 52 || kuṣṭhahīnaṃ dvijaṃ kṛtvā satīṃ ca divyarūpiṇīm | kṛtvā cobhau śubhaṃ bhūyāt paśyatāṃ tīrthavāsinām || 53|| ityāśīrbhirvardhayitvā dadaturvaradānakam | sukhinau tu sadā bhūtvā ciraṃ sthitvā bhuvastale |||54|| ante dhāma tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ dampatī saṃprayāsyathaḥ | ityuktvā vai śubhāṃ pūjāṃ tābhyāṃ samarpitā tadā ||55 || gṛhītvā divyayānābhyāṃ tato nārāyaṇāvubhau | yayaturnijalokaṃ tau brāhmaṇaśca priyāyutaḥ ||56 || navayauvanarūpāḍhyaścābhavad devavattadā | jagmurāścaryamatyarthaṃ lokā nagaravāsinaḥ ||57||| lakṣaśo mānavāstatra dampatyoḥ pūjanādikam | cakruḥ pūtāḥ samabhavan tīrthaphalamavāpya ca ||58|| viprayogena sūryasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ca | labdhvā tu darśanaṃ divyaṃ camatkārapure śubhe ||59|| sūryakṣetre sūryagṛhe kṛtakṛtyā vipāpmakāḥ | saṃbabhūburharerbhaktā bhejire śrīhariṃ sadā ||1.491.6 0|| evaṃ pativratā sādhvī kuṣṭhipatiṃ prasevya ca | yātā tvante harerdhāma camatkārapure purā ||6 1|| etasya paṭhanāccātha śravaṇāt kīrtanādapi | bhuktiḥ śuddhiśca muktiśca bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||62|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne saurāṣṭrīyasya viṭaṃkapurasya kuṣṭhiśarākhyaviprasya devadravyacaurasya camatkārapure nāgamatīnadyāṃ sūryagṛhatīrthakaraṇāt sūryasya nārāyaṇasya ca darśanāt pativratāsudhāmnīpatnyā saha mokṣaṃ ityādinirūpaṇanāmaikanavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 491 ||
<1.492> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi camatkārapure pakṣau nipetatuḥ | garuḍasya pativratānindayā tad vadāmi te || 1 || punastasyāḥ prasādena saṃlagnau ca vadāmi te | purāsīd brāhmaṇo mitraṃ garuḍasya bhṛgūdvahaḥ || 2 || tasya kanyā mādhavīti nāmnābhūd guṇamaṇḍitā | atha tasyā varārthāya provāca garuḍaṃ dvijaḥ || 3 || mama kanyāsuyogyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ sāttvataṃ śubham | sadṛśaṃ varamanvīkṣa yena tasmai dadāmyaham || 4 || garuḍastu tadā prāha samastakṣitimaṇḍale | mama pṛṣṭhe sutā tvāṃ ca kṛtvā saṃbhramayāmyaham || 5 || tatastasyāḥ kumāryā vai sadṛśaṃ ca guṇānvitam | svayaṃ dṛṣṭvā varaṃ tasmai dehi bhavāmi sādhanam || 6 || evamukto’tha vipraḥ sa tatkṣaṇāt kanyayā saha | ārūḍho gāruḍaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ yayau draṣṭuṃ varaṃ śubham || 7 || yaṃ yaṃ vipraṃ kumāraṃ sā kanyā paśyati vai hṛdā | tadā na tasyāścitte sa vartate sma kathaṃcana || 8 || kulavān yo virūpaḥ sa rūpāḍhyo na kulottamaḥ | rūpakulānvitaḥ kaścid guṇahīno vilokitaḥ || 9 || guṇayukto na dhanavān sadhano na guṇādimān | sarvoktyukto’pi kaścid dṛṣṭo vyaṃgo vicittakaḥ || 1.492.1 0|| avyaṃgaścoktaguṇavān dṛṣṭo vyavāyamārgagaḥ | evaṃ kāle gate dīrghe bhramatāṃ bhūtale’nvaham || 11 || teṣāmāsīnmanovāñcchā draṣṭuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | yayuḥ śvetaṃ dvīpadhāma yayuśca badarīvanam || 12| kṣīrābdhiṃ tu yayuḥ paścād vaikuṇṭhaṃ te yayurmudā | baligṛhaṃ yayuścāpi yayuḥ kuṃkumavāpikām || 1 3|| bhṛgukṣetraṃ yayurvṛndāvanaṃ śrīraṃgaparvatam | mahendraṃ gandhamādaṃ ca meruṃ svargaṃ yayustathā || 14|| satyalokaṃ yayustaistu dṛṣṭo vai nārado muniḥ | sāntvapūrvaṃ sa ca pṛṣṭo viṣṇuṃ brahmasanātanam || 15|| kva devaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ sāmprataṃ vartate mune | viṣṇoḥ sthānāni sarvāṇi vīkṣitāni samantataḥ || 16|| asmābhiḥ saṃprahṛṣṭābhirna dṛṣṭastatra keśavaḥ | nāradaḥ prāha sarvatra vartate bhagavān sadā || 17|| aśuddhaiśca bhavadbhistu na dṛṣṭastatra keśavaḥ | yanmano vāsanāhīnaṃ nirguṇaṃ divyatāṃ gatam || 18|| taireva dṛśyate viṣṇuḥ sakāmairnahi vīkṣyate | tato mānasaśuddhyarthaṃ saṃvāsaṃ kuruta kṣitau || 1 9|| camatkārapure divye hāṭakeśvaratīrthake | tatraiva śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vaḥ sammiliṣyati ||1.492.20 || tatprāptyarthaṃ camatkāranagaraṃ yāta mā ciram | mahāsarovare tatra cāturmāsye janārdanaḥ || 21 || nāganadyāṃ jalaśāyī vartate sma narāyaṇaḥ | athāyātāstrayastatra jalaśāyisarovare ||22|| brāhmaṇaṃ ca sutāṃ kṣetre’vatārayitvā śobhane | garuḍaḥ prāha tapasā prāpsyate bhagavān svayam || 23|| kurutāṃ tapasā śuddhiṃ japena pūjayā vratāt | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ |||24|| ityevaṃ satataṃ jāpācchuddhiḥ syād vāsanākṣaye | ityuktvā garuḍastatra yayau nārāyaṇāntikam || 25|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ | japannāste jalamadhye nirāhārastathā ca tau ||26||| putrī pitā nirāhāro tepāte tapa uttamam | garuḍo bahuvarṣānte dadarśa pādasevikām || 27|| pādasaṃvāhanāsaktāṃ lakṣmīṃ tvāṃ tanmukhekṣaṇām | aparāṃ ca tathā vṛddhāṃ lakṣmīpārśve niveśitām ||28|| dhyānasthāṃ ca kṛśāṃgīṃ ca śāṇḍilīṃ brahmacāriṇīm | anyāṃ suyauvanāṃ tasyāḥ pārśve dadarśa pakṣirāṭ||29|| anekajanmapāpānāṃ hāriṇīṃ narmadāṃ satīm | aparaṃ puruṣaṃ vṛddhaṃ śāntaṃ kṛśaṃ ca tāpasam ||1.492.30 || dadarśa garuḍastatra mārkaṇḍeyaṃ mahāmunim | tāśca taṃ ca praṇamam̐staiḥ satkṛto garuḍaḥ śanaiḥ ||3 1 || dadarśa viṣṇumunnidraṃ smerāsyaṃ bhaktavatsalam | pṛcchantaṃ kuta āyātaḥ kuśalaṃ prāha pakṣirāṭ |||32|| mamāsti dayitaṃ mitraṃ brāhmaṇo bhṛguvaṃśajaḥ | tasyāsti mādhavī nāma kanyā vai brahmacāriṇī ||33|| na tasyāḥ sadṛśaḥ kāntaḥ prāptastrailokyamaṇḍale | tasyāstu puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ patiḥ sarvaguṇairyutaḥ ||34|| sadṛśaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣyā mama citte vyavasthitaḥ | tasmāt pāṇigrahaṃ tasyāḥ svīkuruṣva narāyaṇa || 35|| śrutvā nārāyaṇaḥ prāha lakṣmyaṃśā sāsti kanyakā | śṛṇu vaikuṇṭhajaṃ pūrvākhyānaṃ vadāmi te’nagha ||36|| ekadā sā mahālakṣmīrgarvaṃ kṛtavatī satī | na mayā sadṛśī tvanyā nārāyaṇo’pi naiva ca ||37|| mayā kṛtvā samṛddhyā ca sṛṣṭiḥ sarvā suśobhate | māṃ vinā ca bhavedrūkṣaṃ tasmācchreṣṭhāsmi sarvathā ||38|| adya mayā na gantavyaṃ nārāyaṇasya sannidhau | āvaśyake svayaṃ nārāyaṇaścātra mama gṛhe || 39|| āgamiṣyati paśyāmi snehamīkṣāmi kīdṛśam | iti matvā na ca lakṣmīryayau nārāyaṇagṛham ||1.492.40 || jayaṃ ca pārṣadaṃ nārāyaṇo jñātvā hyuvāca ha | lakṣmīrgarvayutā tvadya vidyate māninī yathā ||41 || yadyāgacchenmama dvāre deyaḥ praveśa eva na | atha nārāyaṇaṃ jñātvā divyadṛṣṭyā parāṅmukham |||42||| cirakāle gate lakṣmirmānaṃ hitvā samāyayau | jayastu pārṣadaḥ prāha mātarnājñāsti vai hareḥ ||43|| harerdāsastava dāsaḥ sadāsmi kintu śārṅgiṇaḥ | ājñā pālyā mayā tvatra tasya dvāre pratiṣṭhatā ||44|| yasya dvāre niyukto’smi tadājñā mukhyato matā | yathaṣṭaṃ kuru mātastvaṃ nirodhaḥ svāminā kṛtaḥ ||45|| ityuktvā patitastasyāḥ pādayoḥ praṇayānvitaḥ | nivāritā sā dvārācca tena dauvārikeṇa vai ||46 || tadātmanastiraskāraṃ matvā satī ca māninī | smṛtvā hareḥ pādapadmaṃ dehaṃ tyaktuṃ samudyatā ||47|| tadā ruṣṭā trilokyāṃ vai gṛhalakṣmīḥ sthale sthale | jñātvā brahmā maheśaśca viṣṇurdharmaśca bhāskaraḥ ||48|| candraḥ kāmaḥ kuberaśca vahnirvighneśvaro’nilaḥ | ṛṣayo munayaścāpi manavaśca maheśvaraḥ ||49|| samāyayū rudantaste padmāyā puratastadā | tuṣṭuvuśca mahālakṣmīṃ satīṃ dīnāṃ harīśvarīm ||1.492.50|| kṣamasva bhagavatyamba kṣamāśīle parātpare | śuddhasattvasvarūpe ca kopādiparivarjite ||51 || upame sarvasādhvīnāṃ devīnāṃ devapūjite | tvayā vinā jagat sarvaṃ mṛtatulyaṃ ca niṣphalam ||52| sarvasampatsvarūpā tvaṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvarūpiṇī | rāseśvaryadhidevī tvaṃ tvatkalāḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ |||53||| kailāse pārvatī tvaṃ tu kṣīrode sindhukanyakā | svarge ca svargalakṣmīstvaṃ martyalakṣmīśca bhūtale || 54|| vaikuṇṭhe tu mahālakṣmīḥ sarvānane sarasvatī | gaṃgā tvaṃ tulasī tvaṃ ca prabhā tvaṃ tvaṃ ca pārvatī ||55|| sāvitrī māṇikī tvaṃ ca padmā tvaṃ padminī satī | mañjulā tvaṃ bhārgavī ca kambharā manasā satī ||56||| vṛndā haṃsā ca rādhā ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī | kṛṣṇapriyā tvaṃ bhāṇḍīre candrā candanakānane || 57|| virajā campakavane śataśṛṃge tu sundarī | padmāvatī padmavane mālatī mālatīvane ||58|| kundadantī kundavane suśīlā ketakīvane | kadambamālā durgā tvaṃ kadambānāṃ tu kānane ||59|| rājalakṣmī rājasaudhe gṛhalakṣmīrgṛhe gṛhe | prasīda jagatāṃ mātarmā mṛtiṃ gaccha padmaje ||1.492.6 0|| iti devastutiṃ śrutvā tyaktvā tu rodanaṃ satī | uvāca suprasannāstām̐ste’pi śuśruvurādarāt ||6 1 || tyajāmi dehaṃ na krodhānna vairāgyeṇa sāmpratam | kintu nvidaṃ samālocya yadasti maraṇottaram ||62|| yasmin sadīśe mahati sarvasāmye ca nirguṇe | sarvātmani sadānande samatā tṛṇaśailayoḥ ||6 3 || bhrūbhaṃgalīlayā lakṣmīlakṣaṃ sraṣṭumalaṃ tu yaḥ | bhṛtye striyāṃ yatsamatā kiṃ kāryaṃ tasya sevayā ||64|| tatpatnīnāṃ pradhānāhaṃ nirastā dvāriṇādhunā | tadbhṛtyabhṛtyabhṛtyena paripūrṇena nepsitā ||65|| tyakṣyāmi jīvanamahamasaubhāgyā ca svāmini | vahnau tu kāmanāṃ kṛtvā yathā bhadraṃ bhavettathā ||66 || yā strī bharturasaubhāgyā sāsaubhāgyā hi sarvataḥ | śayane bhojane tasyā na sukhaṃ jīvanaṃ vṛthā ||67|| yasyā nāsti priyaprema tasyā janma nirarthakam | tatkiṃ putre dhane rūpe sampattau yauvane’thavā ||68|| yadbhaktirnāsti kānte ca sarvapriyatame pare | sā śucirdharmahīnā ca sarvakarmavivarjitā ||69|| patirbandhurgatirbhartā daivataṃ gurureva saḥ | sarvasmācca paraḥ svāmī na guruḥ svāminaḥ paraḥ ||1.492.70|| pitā mātā suto bhrātā kliṣṭā dātumidaṃ dhanam | sarvasvadātā svāmī vai mūḍhānāṃ yoṣitāṃ surāḥ ||71 || kācideva tu jānāti mahāsādhvī patiṃ prabhum | atisadvaṃśajātā hi suśīlā kulapālikā ||72|| vrataṃ cārādhanaṃ dānaṃ satyaṃ puṇyaṃ tapaściram | patibhaktivihīnāyā bhasmībhūtaṃ nirarthakam ||73|| ataḥ kiñcinna vakṣyāmi niṣṭhuraṃ patimīśvaram | bhṛtyāparādhairdevasya prāṇām̐styakṣyāmi niścitam ||74|| patidoṣe mahāsādhvī patiṃ cāniṣṭhuraṃ vadet | yadi soḍhumaśaktā ca prāṇām̐styajati dharmataḥ ||75|| patisevā vrataṃ strīṇāṃ patisevā paraṃ tapaḥ | patisevā paro dharmaḥ patisevā surārcanam ||76|| patisevā paraṃ satyaṃ dānatīrthānukīrtanam | sarvadevamayaḥ svāmī sarvadevamayaḥ śuciḥ ||77|| sarvapuṇyasvarūpaśca patirūpī janārdanaḥ | yā satī bharturucchiṣṭaṃ bhuṃkte pādodakaṃ sadā ||78|| tasyā darśamupasparśaṃ nityaṃ vāñcchanti devatāḥ | tataḥ sarvāṇi tīrthāni punanti pāpino hyaghāt ||79|| ityuktvā sā mahāsādhvī ruroda vai muhurmuhuḥ | uvāca brahmā bhītaśca bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ||1.492.8 0|| bhaviṣyati na bhadraṃ ca jayasya dvārarakṣituḥ | vijayo’pi sahayogī tavāparādhakarmaṇi ||81 || tvayā na śaptau tau mūḍhau priyāparādhabhītayā | bhaviṣyato rākṣasau tau sanakādivinindayā ||82|| sāparādhaṃ tu dharmiṣṭhaḥ kṣamayā na śaped yadi | sarvanāśo bhavettasya niścitaṃ mā ciraṃ sati ||83|| yadi śaptuṃ na śaktaśca na daṇḍaṃ kartumīśvaraḥ | sāparādhe’pi puruṣe dharmo daṇḍaṃ karoti hi ||84|| sarvaṃ kṣamasva he mātargaccha gaccha priyāntakam | māṃ ca tvatsvāmino bhaktaṃ niyojyaṃ sṛṣṭikarmaṇi ||85|| ityuktvā tāṃ puraskṛtya sārdhaṃ devairmunīndrakaiḥ | śīghraṃ jagāma saṃstotuṃ nārāyaṇāntikaṃ hyataḥ ||86|| bhagavan devadevānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ sukhāvaha | bhogasampatpradātastvaṃ gṛhāṇa kamalāṃ satīm ||87|| yayā sarve vayaṃ smṛddhā yāṃ vinā prastarā yathā | kimvadhikaṃ hi stotavyaṃ gṛhāṇa lokahetave ||88 || brahmaṇaḥ stavanaṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā lakṣmīṃ puraḥsthitām | rudatīṃ namravadanāṃ provāca kamalodbhavam ||8 9 || sarvaṃ jānāmi sarvajñaḥ sarvātmā sarvapālakaḥ | sarvaśāstā sarvakarmaphaladātāsmi padmaja || 1.492.90 | | bhakte kalatre bandhau ca sarvatra samatā mama | viśeṣato’timadbhaktaḥ kalatrātpara eva saḥ | | 91 | | madbhaktau tava putrau ca dvārapālau durantakau | kṣama māmaparādhaṃ ca tayośca bhaktipūrṇayoḥ | | 92 | | madbhaktipūrṇo balavān daityebhyo na bibheti ca | rakṣito mama cakreṇa bhaktimādhvīkadurmadaḥ | | 93 | | kintu mayā tava sraṣṭāvāgantavyaṃ tava stavāt | mayā saha prabalayormama pradāsayorapi | | 94| | jīvānāṃ guṇagānārthaṃ jayasya vijayasya ca | prajanmāvaśyakaṃ tasmānnimittaṃ hi mayā kṛtam | | 95 | | atha kālāntare sanakādiroṣād bhaviṣyati | śṛṇu tvanyat pṛthivyāmānartadeśe’bdhisannidhau | | 96 | | camatkārapure vipro nāmnā śāṇḍilyasaṃjñakaḥ | mamāśaḥ sa tapastepe putryarthaṃ bhāryayā yutaḥ | | 97| | sahasravatsarānte’hamabhavaṃ sannidhau sthitaḥ | prasannavadanastaṃ ca varadānāya prāha ca | | 98 | | tasya bhāryā sutāṃ vavre lakṣmītulyāṃ guṇānvitām | tathāstviti mayā proktaṃ tato’hamagamaṃ layam | | 99 | | śāṇḍilyaḥ sa sutāprāptiṃ pratīkṣate priyāyutaḥ | nimittaṃ tvetadevātra lakṣmīdvārā mayā kṛtam | | 1.492.100 | | seyaṃ lakṣmīmānayuktā chāyārūpā prayātu tām | pātivratye manāk doṣaṃ lakṣmyāṃ necchāmi sarvadā | | 101 | | sadoṣaṃ ca śarīraṃ vai lakṣmyāḥ chāyāsvarūpakam | yātu śāṇḍilyabhāryāyāṃ putryarthaṃ varadānakam || 10 2|| ityuktāśca surāḥ sarve lakṣmīrāścaryamāpnuyuḥ | nārāyaṇasya hārdaṃ vai naiva jānanti kecana || 103 || atha śāntāśca tacchrutvā lakṣmīstuṣṭā babhūva ha | patyājñayā yayau śīghraṃ chāyārūpeṇa mādhavī || 1 04|| seyaṃ śāṇḍilyaputrī ca mādhavīti pravartate | lakṣmīṃ divyena rūpeṇa jagrāha tatra śrīhariḥ || 1 05|| mādhavī ca brahmacaryaparā svasadṛśaṃ patim | māmevecchati lakṣmīśaṃ nānyaṃ patiṃ samicchati || 1 06|| garuḍa tvaṃ kathāṃ cemāṃ naiva jānāsi māyayā | ānaya tvaṃ tāṃ samīpe mādhavīṃ me pativratām || 1 07|| lakṣmyaṃśāṃ mānadehāṃ ca ṛṣeḥ putrīṃ mama priyām | yāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā svayaṃ paścāt prakaromi yathocitam || 1 08|| evamukto garuḍastāmānayāmāsa sannidhau | viprastūvāca natvā taṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam || 1 09|| gṛhāṇa kanyāṃ bhagavam̐stvāmevecchati sā sadā | bhagavām̐stvaṃ samāyāhītyuvāca tāṃ suśṛṇvatām || 1.492.11 0|| lakṣmīvannyaviśatpārśve kanyā prasannamānasā | śayyaikānte samāviṣṭā dakṣiṇe muravidviṣaḥ || 111 || atha kopaparītāṃgī mahiṣīdharmamāśritā | lakṣmīruvāca tāṃ kanyāṃ sapatnīti vicintya ca || 11 2|| yasmānme purataḥ pāpe kāntasya mama harṣitā | śayyāyāṃ tvaṃ samāviṣṭā lajjāṃ tyaktvā sudūrataḥ || 11 3|| tasmād vṛddhamukhī nūnaṃ vikṛtā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi | śrūtvā śokaṃ tadā kanyā tatpitāpi pracakratuḥ || 1 14|| svayaṃ viṣṇurhariḥ prāha maivaṃ lakṣmīrbhaviṣyasi | jñāne vṛddhā vṛddhamukhī matā me jñānavardhinī || 1 15|| brahmajñānaparā madhuvidyā sā mādhavī tathā | śaṇḍilyavidyādhiṣṭhātrī jñānavṛddhā bhaviṣyati || 116 || ityuktā śāṇḍilī bhūtvā mādhavī sā haripriyā | kṣīrode vartate nityaṃ lakṣmīrūpā subhāginī || 1 17|| brahmacaryaparā nārāyaṇasevāparāyaṇā | śāṇḍilyaśca sutāṃ datvā kṛtakṛtyo babhūva ha || 1 18|| garuḍaḥ śrīhariṃ tatra papraccha saṃśayānvitaḥ | nārīṇāṃ brahmacaryaṃ vai saṃśayāspadameva tu || 1 19|| viśeṣād yauvanāvasthāprāptāyāṃ śraddadhāmi na | avaśyaṃ yauvanasthena tiryagyonigatena ca || 1.492.120|| vikāraḥ khalu kartavyo nāvikārāya yauvanam | evaṃ tasya vacaḥ śrutvā śāṇḍilī brahmacāriṇī || 121 || maunavratadharā kiñcinnovāca vaiṣṇavī satī | sādhvyā nāryā nindayā ca pakṣināthasya tatkṣaṇāt || 1 22|| ubhau pakṣau gatau nāśaṃ ruṇḍhākāro’tha so’bhavat | aśaktaśca tathā gantuṃ padamātramapi kvacit || 1 23|| hariḥ prāha garuḍa tvatpakṣau naṣṭau hi nindayā | dūṣitaṃ brahmacaryaṃ yat śāṇḍilyāṃ saṃśayena vai || 124|| tasmāt tvaṃ śāṇḍilīṃ natvā prasādaya sukhī bhava | garuḍastāṃ pratuṣṭāva nanāma ca punaḥ punaḥ || 125|| tuṣṭā satī śāṇḍilī ca dvijaṃ pasparśa pāṇinā | tato’sya pakṣa sañjātau tatkṣaṇādeva yojitau || 1 26|| garuḍaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ ca śāṇḍilīm | tatratyośca praṇipatya śāṇḍilyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tathā || 127||| pṛṣṭhe kṛtvā yayau kṣetraṃ camatkārapuraṃ śubham | vinyasya taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca garuḍaḥ prayayau divam ||1 28|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi pātivratyaparāyaṇam | lakṣmyāste pūrvavṛttāntaṃ pāpatāpapraṇāśanam || 129|| ya idaṃ śṛṇuyād yadvā vācayecchrāvayettathā | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheddhāmni dāsyabhaktiṃ sudurlabhām || 1.492.1 30|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne camatkārapurīyaviprakanyāyā mādhavyā bhagavato bhāryātvaṃ, lakṣmyā avatārarūpāyāstasyāḥ śāṇḍilītvaṃ nārīṇāṃ brahmacaryavrate śaṃkitasya garuḍasya pakṣayoḥ patanaṃ, śāṇḍilīprasādena pakṣasahitatvaṃ, lakṣmyāḥ avataraṇārthaṃ bhagavatkṛtāvamānanam, evamādinirūpaṇanāmā dvinavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||4 92||
<1.493> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi payo’bdhau tu śāṇḍilī kamalā hyubhe | nārāyaṇasya me sevāṃ cakrāte pādamardanam || 1 || lakṣmyā dakṣaścaraṇo me śāṇḍilyā vāmako dhṛtaḥ | lakṣmīstu vāmapādārthaṃ jagāda śāṇḍilīṃ tadā || 2 || dehi me vāmapādaṃ vai sevikāyāḥ paraṃ dhanam | vāmā vāmāṃganā vāmaprabhāgā priyabhoginī || 3 || gṛhāṇa tvaṃ dakṣapādṃ vāmabhāgo hi me’sti yat | nāryā vāmasvarūpatvaṃ narasyārdhāṃgarūpakam || 4 || tathaiva vartamānāyāḥ saubhāgyaṃ vardhate’niśam | śāṇḍilyāha na dāsye’haṃ dakṣaḥ pūrvaṃ tvayā dhṛtaḥ || 5 || svadhṛtastvaṃ kathaṃ tyaktumarhasi dakṣapattalam | vāmasevā mayā kāryā na dāsye tvāṃ kathaṃcana || 6 || lakṣmīḥ kruddhābhavat tāṃ cāśapattvāśvamukhī bhava | śāṇḍilyapyaśapallakṣmīṃ tvaṃ vai gajamukhī bhava || 7 || tādṛśyau te hyubhe jāte kṣīrode viṣṇusannidhau | śokaṃ jagāma bhagavān kathamevaṃ kṛtaṃ priye || 8 || ayogyaśāpau saṃjātau parasparaṃ sudustarau | atha te duḥkhite viṣṇuṃ śeṣaśāyinamāhatuḥ || 9 || bhagavan śāpamokṣo nau yathā syācca tathā kuru | nārāyaṇastadā prāha jāto madicchayaiva hi || 1.493.1 0|| śāpastanmokṣaṇaṃ cāpi bhaviṣyati madicchayā | ahaṃ pṛthvyā bhāranāśārthaṃ gamiṣye bhuvastalam || 11 || tatreyaṃ śāṇḍilī me vai bhaginī saṃbhaviṣyati | aśvamukhī tvaṃ ca lakṣmīḥ hastimukhī bhaviṣyasi || 12|| tatrāhaṃ devakīputro bhaviṣyāmi prabhurhariḥ | atha yā suprabhānāmnī vasudevapriyāparā || 1 3|| tasyāṃ mādhavī jajñe’śvavaktrarūpā tu śāṇḍilī | tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtākārāṃ sutāṃ jātāṃ ja suprabhā || 14|| vasudevasamāyuktā viṣādaṃ paramaṃ gatā | sā jātā yauvanopetā sutā tādṛṅmukhānvitā || 15|| na kaścidvarayāmāsa vājivaktrāṃ vilokya tām | atha tāṃ bhagavān kṛṣṇaścamatkārapuraṃ prati || 16|| preṣayāmāsa tapase tayā taptaṃ tapastadā | tatastuṣṭiṃ gato brahmā varārthaṃ tāmuvāca ha || 17|| sā tu vavre mukhaṃ nāryā bhadraṃ saumyaṃ surūpakam | brahmā tathāstviti prāha sābhavadvai śubhānanā || 18|| subhadrā nāma vikhyātā vīrasūḥ pativallabhā | upayeme sutaḥ pāṇḍoryāṃ pārthaḥ kṛṣṇapārśvagaḥ || 1 9|| tasyāṃ jajñe suto vīro yo’bhimanyuriti smṛtaḥ | punaryātā harerdhāma kālānte vai pativratā ||1.493.2 0|| atha lakṣmīrgajavaktrā yayāvānartadeśagam | hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñaṃ satkṣetraṃ tapaścakāra sā ||21 || brahmāṇaṃ toṣayāmāsa tapasā dāruṇena vai | tāmuvāca tato brahmā varṣānte tuṣṭi māgataḥ ||22|| varaṃ prārthaya deveśi yatte manasi vartate | lakṣmīruvāca vaktraṃ me prabho pūrvānanaṃ vṛṇe ||23 || brahmā prāha tathāstvevaṃ mahālakṣmīrbhaveti ca | evaṃ varaṃ samāgṛhya yayau sā ca śubhānanā ||24|| mahālakṣmīḥ surūpā ca kṣīrodaśāyinaṃ prati | evaṃ sā mādhavī cāpi mahālakṣmīrapīśvarī ||25||| sthāpite nagarakṣetre candrabhāryābhirādarāt | pūjayiṣyati sadbhaktyā mahālakṣmīṃ ca mādhavīm ||26 || sā bhaviṣyati saubhāgyayuktā putravatī satī | yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ tāvattvekabhaktāśanāyanā ||27|| akṣāralavaṇāśā yā nārī māṃ pūjayiṣyati | na tasyāḥ patijaṃ duḥkhaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ vā bhaviṣyati ||28|| kintu saubhāgyamatulaṃ sarvaṃ samyag bhaviṣyati | dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ saudhaṃ godhanamāpyate ||29|| śucirbhūtvā paṭhedbhaktyā vācayecchrāvayecca vā | śṛṇuyādvā naro nārī susaubhāgyamavāpnuyāt ||1.493.3 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne aśvamukhyā mādhavyā gajamukhyā lakṣmyāśca kālāntare subhadrātvaṃ mahālakṣmītvaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā trinavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||493||
<1.494> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca athānyāṃ ca kathāṃ divyāṃ hāṭakeśvarabhūmijām | camatkāramayīṃ lakṣmi śṛṇu brahmavratānvitām || 1 || camatkārābhidhaścāsīnnṛpo yannāmaśobhitam | camatkārapuraṃ nāgavatīnadyāstaṭe’karot || 2 || tasya purasya rakṣārthaṃ devatāstena nirmitāḥ | sthāpitā vidhinā tāśca śubhā rakṣanti tatprajāḥ || 3 || atha tasya mahīpasya ambānāmnyabhavat sutā | anyā vṛddhābhidhā putrī hyubhe te guṇamaṇḍite || 4 || kāśīrājaścopayeme hyubhe viprāgnisannidhau | kasyacittvatha kālasya yavanaistūttarasthitaiḥ || 5 || saṃgaro’bhūnmahān kāśīrājaśca nidhanaṃ gataḥ | athāmbā cāpi ca vṛddhā vaidhavyaṃ prāpya duḥkhadam || 6 || pitṛgṛhaṃ yayatuste hāṭakeśvarabhūmigam | yāvadvarṣaśataṃ cograṃ kṛtavatyau tapaḥ param || 7 || durgāyāḥ pūjanaṃ nityaṃ cakraturhomapūrvakam | nāśārthaṃ patiśatrūṇāṃ kintu durgā tutoṣa na || 8 || tato vairāgyamāsādya vāñcchantyau svatanukṣayam | mantrairātharvaṇairvipraiḥ kṣurikāsūktasaṃbhavaiḥ || 9 || chitvā chitvā svamāṃsāni mantrapūtāni bhaktitaḥ | kāritavatyau homaṃ tu susamiddhe hutāśane || 1.494.1 0|| agnikuṇḍāttatastasmāccaturhastā śubhānanā | śvetavastrā viniṣkrāntā dhāmnā bālārkasadṛśī || 11 || tathānyā cāṣṭanetrāsyā taptahāṭakasannibhā | tasmāt kuṇḍād viniṣkrāntā dhṛtakhaḍgā bhayāvahā || 12|| aparāpi tathārūpā śaktiḥ paramadāruṇā | tāstu procurvarārthaṃ ca kāśīrājapriye tataḥ || 13 || ūcatuśca patirnau hi kāśīrājo hato raṇe | yavanairhi tatasteṣāṃ kṣayaṃ vṛṇīmahe yataḥ || 14|| tathāstviti varaṃ prāhustadā kuṇḍāt sahasraśaḥ | niṣkrāntāḥ saṃkhyayāpārā mātaro naikarūpikāḥ || 15|| ekā gajamukhā tatra tathānyā turagānanā | sārameyamukhā cānyā pakṣirājamukhā parā || 16|| tiryagvapuḥsvarūpānyā vaktrairmānuṣasaṃbhavaiḥ | triśīrṣāḥ pañcaśīrṣāśca saptaśīrṣāstathāparāḥ || 17|| jaṃghāmukhā jaghanāsyā hṛdānanā nirānanāḥ | pārśvānanāḥ paścimāsyāḥ pṛṣṭhāsyāḥ kāścanāpi ca || 18|| ekahastā dvihastāśca daśahastā vihastakāḥ | anyā viṃśatihastāśca bahupādā vipādikāḥ || 1 9|| ekapādā ūrdhvapādā ekanetrā dvinetrakāḥ | bahunetrā gajārūḍhā hayārūḍhā vṛṣasthitāḥ ||1.494.20|| naravānarasiṃhājagardabhavyāghrasaṃsthitāḥ | sarpagodhākhumakarakūrmakukkuṭasaṃsthitāḥ ||21 || vihagādisamārūḍhā nṛtyantyo hāsyaśobhitāḥ | ūrdhvakeśā vikeśāśca gātrakeśāśca bhūriśaḥ ||22|| lambakeśā vājikeśā hrasvadantyastathāparāḥ | vidantyo dīrghadantyaśca gajadantyo vibhīṣaṇāḥ ||23|| lohadantyo lambakarṇo vikarṇyaḥ śūrpakarṇikāḥ | śaṃkukarṇyaḥ kukarṇyaśca bahukarṇyaḥ sukarṇikāḥ ||24|| carmavastrā vivastrāśca romavastrāstathāparāḥ | khaḍgahastāḥ kuntahastā bāṇapāśadhanurdharāḥ ||25|| śūlamudgarabhūśuṇḍiprāśatomarabhūṣitāḥ | prayayustā vināśārthaṃ yavanānāṃ kulāni vai ||26|| bālavṛddhasamopetaṃ teṣāṃ rāṣṭraṃ durātmanām | strībhiśca sahitaṃ tābhirdevatābhiḥ prabhakṣitam ||27|.| evaṃ nirvāsya tadrāṣṭaṃ tvāgatāḥ punareva tāḥ | camatkārapuraṃ prāhuryavanānāṃ vināśanam ||28|| tābhyāṃ tā vidhavābhyāṃ ca pūjitāḥ sthāpitāśca tāḥ | athocustā dīyatāṃ naścāhāro vāsa ityapi ||29|| mahādevī tadā tābhyo dadau vāsaṃ ca bhojanam | martyaloke’tra yā nāryo garbhavatyaḥ svapanti ca ||1.494.3 0|| sandhyākāle prabhāte ca kāmāsaktā bhavanti ca | snānaṃ naiva prakurvanti tadgarbho vo’stu bhojanam ||3 1 || rudantyo yā viniryānti catvareṣu vaneṣu ca | tāsāṃ garbhastu yuṣmākaṃ sampadattaḥ prabhujyatām ||32|| ucchiṣṭā yāḥ prasarpanti ramante ca svapanti ca | tāsāṃ garbhaḥ samastānāṃ yuṣmākaṃ bhojanāya vai ||33|| na ṣaṣṭhījāgaro yasya bālakasya bhaviṣyati | sa bhaviṣyati bhojyāya yuṣmākaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||34|| na saṃyāsyati vā yatra pāvakaṃ sūtikāgṛhe | sa bhaviṣyati bhojyāya yuṣmākaṃ bālarūpadhṛk ||35||| māṅgalyaiḥ samparityaktaṃ yadbhavet sūtikāgṛham | tasminyastiṣṭhate bālaḥ sa yuṣmākaṃ prakalpitaḥ ||36|| sandhyāyāṃ bālakā ye vā svapantyākāśadeśagāḥ | te sarve bhojanārthāya yuṣmākaṃ sanniveditāḥ ||37|| yasya janmadine prāpte varṣānte kriyate na ca | māṃgalyaṃ tasya tadgātraṃ yuṣmākaṃ parikalpitam ||38|| tailābhyaṃgaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā yaśca snānaṃ karoti na | sa datto bhojanārthāya yuṣmākaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||39|| ucchiṣṭo yaḥ pumām̐stiṣṭhed yo vā catvaramadhyagaḥ | bhakṣaṇīyaḥ sa sarvābhirnirvikalpena cetasā ||1.494.40 || rajasvalāṃ vrajan yo vā puruṣaḥ kāmamohitaḥ | nagnaḥ śete tathā snāti bhakṣaṇīyaḥ sa vo mataḥ ||41 || dakṣiṇābhimukhaḥ śete niśithe dadhibhakṣakaḥ | yuṣmadamantā puruṣo bhakṣaṇīyo viśeṣataḥ ||42|| ityevaṃ krūradevīnāṃ sthānāni bhakṣaṇāni ca | teṣāṃ gṛhe pradattāni tatastāstoṣamāgatāḥ ||43 || tāśca rakṣanti nagaraṃ kṣetraṃ śrīhāṭakeśvaram | atha pitrā prajānāṃ ca camatkāreṇa bhūbhujā ||44|| mandiraṃ kāritaṃ ramyaṃ viśālaṃ saritastaṭe | ambā pādaprahāreṇa bhūmiṃ cakre guhātmikām ||45|| tasyāṃ svapāduke nyaste tvambayā rājakanyayā | vṛddhayā sthāpite tatra guhāyāṃ svakareṇa vai ||46 || ambā prāha tataḥ sarvā devīrvinayasaṃyutāḥ | ime matpāduke divye guhāmadhye gate sadā ||47|| sarvābhiḥ sevanīye ca na netavye bahiḥ kvacit | yā kācit pāduke dhṛtvā niṣkramiṣyati mohataḥ ||48|| sā divyabhāvanirmuktā śṛgālī saṃbhaviṣyati | atrāgatya pādukayorarcanaṃ yogino janāḥ ||49|| kariṣyanti tathā baliṃ bhavatībhyo mudānvitāḥ | dāsyanti ye ca te siddhimavāpsyanti sudurlabhām ||1.494.50|| tataḥ sarvāśca tā devyo guhāmadhye vyavasthitāḥ | parivārya mandire te pāduke mokṣadāyike ||51|| te prapūjya ca nāryo vā narā vā dūrataḥ śubhe | tāśca devīrnamaskṛtya prāpsyantīṣṭamanorathān ||52|| prayāsyanti parāṃ siddhiṃ janmamṛtyuvivarjitām | śaṃbhunā dhyāyamānena tṛtīyanetrataḥ purā ||53|| śvetāmbaradharā śubhrā kanyā prakāśitā khalu | sā cāmbāsthāpitapādukārcane niyatā kṛtā ||54|| ambā prāha tu tāṃ kanyāṃ tava śiṣyāparamparā | kanyakā dīkṣitā devīsvarūpaiva na mānavī ||55|| kaumārabrahmacaryeṇa yuktā syāt pūjikānayoḥ | tato dadau ratnadaṇḍacāmarau chatramujjvalam ||56|| mantraṃ pūjāvidhiṃ śāṭīṃ kaṇṭhasūtraṃ dadau satī | mantragrahaṇakartrī yā kanyakā sā paramparā ||57|| kanyāvaṃśodbhavaḥ sarvā bhaviṣyanti hi mantrataḥ | oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ ambāyai nārāyaṇyai svāhā namaḥ om ||58|| itimantreṇa śiṣyā vai kanyakāvaṃśa ucyate | tadanvayasamutthāyāḥ kanyakāyāḥ kareṇa tu ||59|| pādukayornaro nārī pūjāyāḥ kārakaḥ khalu | kanyāpūjākārakaśca bhavedatisukhānvitaḥ ||1.494.60|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne camatkāranṛpateḥ ambāvṛddhākanyayostapobhirambāvṛddhāpādukāpūjanaṃ kumārikāvaṃśakṛtamevetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturnavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 494 ||
<1.495> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayiṣye kathāṃ pātakanāśinīm | agnitīrthasamudbhūtāṃ camatkārapure purā || 1 || somavaṃśe’bhavadrājā pratīpo nāmato balī | tasya putradvayaṃ jyeṣṭho devāpiḥ śantanustataḥ || 2 || rājā ca nidhanaṃ prāpto devāpistapase yayau | prajābhiḥ śantanuḥ rājye satvaraṃ viniyojitaḥ || 3 || evaṃ vyatikrame jāte śakro vavarṣa naiva tu | tena kṛcchraṃ gato lokaḥ sarvo’pi kṣutprapīḍitaḥ || 4 || santyaktāḥ patibhirnāryaḥ putrāśca pitṛbhirnijaiḥ | mātaraśca tathā putrairlokeṣvanyeṣu kā kathā || 5 || evaṃ varṣatraye jātaṃ mriyante mānavādayaḥ | daivayogāt kvacit kiñcit kasyacid yadi dṛśyate || 6 || sasyaṃ siddhamasiddhaṃ vā hriyate balibhiḥ paraiḥ | śuṣkāḥ sarve drumā jātā āpagāśca jalāśayāḥ || 7 || vastuhīno janaḥ sarvo yajñahīno’tināstikaḥ | vratahīnā dharmahīnā narā nāryo’bhavam̐stadā || 8 || kṣudhayā pīḍitāḥ sarve ṛṣayastu viśeṣataḥ | etasminnantare’raṇye viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ || 9 || carmāsthiśeṣasarvāṃgo bubhukṣārta itastataḥ | paribhramam̐stataḥ prāpya kaṃcidgrāmaṃ vinodakam || 1.495.1 0|| mṛtamartyodbhavairvyāptamasthiśeṣaiḥ samantataḥ | mṛtānāṃ ca śavānāṃ ca māṃsādasya niveśanam || 11 || caṇḍālasya gṛhaṃ tvāsīd durgandhena samāvṛtam | tatrāpaśyatsārameyaṃ mṛtaṃ śuṣkaṃ ciroṣitam || 1 2|| samādāya tatastaṃ ca hyāpaddharmaparāyaṇaḥ | śuṣkaṃ daṇḍena santāḍya kṛtvā khaṇḍāni tāni ca || 13 || nītvā yayau yatra deśe jalaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ ca labhyate | prakṣālya salile tāni śrapayāmāsa cānale || 14|| ādāya pitṝn tarpitvā yāvadagnau juhoti saḥ | tāvad vahniraśuddhestu bhayenādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ || 15|| sarvatra pṛthivyāmagniśālāyāṃ havanasthale | citte kopaṃ tathā kṛtvā śakropari viśeṣataḥ || 16|| athāgnivigame home naṣṭe devaprabhojanam | niruddhaṃ tena devarṣibrahmaviṣṇupurassarāḥ || 17|| vahneranveṣaṇārthāya babhramurdharaṇītalam | athāraṇye gajo dṛṣṭaḥ prapacchustaṃ himālaye || 18|| vahnirhavyaprabhoktā cet tvayā dṛṣṭo’tra no vada | gajaḥ prāhātra saṃkīrṇe vaṃśastambe pravartate || 1 9|| gupto bhūtvā praviṣṭaḥ sa dagdhastenāhamāgataḥ | ityuktāste yayustatra vahniryatra hi vartate || 1.495.20 || tāvadvahniḥ śaśāpainaṃ gajaṃ nirdeśakārakam | guptaṃ me tvaṃ nivedayasyato jihvā sadā tava ||21 || viparītā bhavatvevetyuktvā stambād viniryayau | devaiḥ stambe na vai dṛṣṭo lagnāḥ pṛṣṭhe didṛkṣayā ||22|| atha dṛṣṭaḥ śuko devairbhramamāṇo himālaye | pṛṣṭaśca śuka vahniṃ tvaṃ dṛṣṭavānatra ced vada ||23 || śukaḥ prāha kulāyo me śamyāmatra hi vartate | vartante śiśavo me’pi vahnistatra samāgataḥ ||24|| tena dagdhā vayaṃ sarve kṛcchrādeva vinirgatāḥ | tatra śamyāṃ guptarūpaścāste vahnirvidantu tam ||25|| evamuktastato vahniḥ kruddhaḥ śukaṃ śaśāpa ha | ahaṃ yasmāt tvayā pakṣin devānāṃ viniveditaḥ ||26|| tasmācchuka na te vāṇī vispaṣṭā saṃbhaviṣyati | evaṃ śaptvā śukaṃ vahniḥ suraiḥ śamyāṃ sumārgitaḥ ||27|| tāvat tato’dṛśyabhāvaṃ kṛtvā deśāntaraṃ yayau | puṣkaraṃ tīrthamāsādya jalamadhye tale sthitaḥ ||28|| devā dhyānena vai dṛṣṭvā matsyaṃ papracchurutsukāḥ | vahniratrāgataḥ kutra vartate vada naḥ surān ||29|| matsyaḥ prāha tale cātra puṣkare vartate hi saḥ | tena dagdhā vayaṃ tīre tiṣṭhāmo duḥkhitā hyati ||1.495.30|| ityuktavantaṃ matsyaṃ sa śaśāpa krodhito’nalaḥ | svajñātibhakṣakā matsyā bhavantu sarvabhakṣakāḥ ||3 1 || iti śaptvā tataḥ sthānād dudrāva bahuvegataḥ | aśvapaṭṭasaraḥ prāpya saurāṣṭre cāsthito’nalaḥ ||32|| surā jñātvā dhyānavṛttyā yayuḥ kuṃkumavāpikām | sarastīragataṃ kūrmaṃ papracchuḥ vahirāgataḥ ||33|| cedatra vada naḥ kūrma sa prāhātra jale tale | praviṣṭo vahnirāgatya dagdhā vayaṃ bahirgatāḥ ||34|| devāstaṃ draṣṭumutkaṇṭhāyuktāstatra tadānalaḥ | kūrmaṃ śaśāpa te vaṃśo vṛddhiṃ naiva gamiṣyati ||35|| evaṃ śaptvā tataḥ sthānād devādarśanavāñcchayā | hāṭakaśvaraje kṣetre nāganadyāṃ yayau tataḥ ||36|| jalāśayaṃ sugambhīraṃ praviṣṭastatra cāśritaḥ | tatra vahnipraveśena dagdhā matsyāśca dardurāḥ ||37|| tīraṃ nirgatya yanti ca devā gatvā ca darduram | papracchustaṃ vahniratra vartate vā naveti vai ||38|| bhekaḥ prāhātra gambhīre jale vahnirupāgataḥ | tena vai jalamadhyasthā dagdhā bhūrijalaukasaḥ ||39|| ahaṃ kṛcchreṇa nirgatya jīvāmi devasaṃśrayāt | tacchrutvā taṃ jale devā mārgayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||1.495.40|| vahniḥ śaśāpa taṃ bhekaṃ devebhyo yanniveditaḥ | tasmāt tvaṃ bhava vai nyūnaṃ vijihvo’tra dharātale ||41 || evaṃ muktvā tataḥ sthānād yāvadvahnirvinirgataḥ | tāvat sa brahmaṇā prokto bho bho vahne sthiro bhava |||42|| kathaṃ dhāvasi guptātmā devān dṛṣṭvā pratisthalāt | tvamādyaścaiva sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ vartase mukham ||43|| tvayyāhutirhutā samyagādityamupatiṣṭhati | ādityājjāyate vṛṣṭirvṛṣṭerannaṃ tataḥ prajāḥ ||44|| tasmād dhātā vidhātā ca tvameva jagatāṃ mataḥ | santuṣṭe dhriyate viśvaṃ tvayi ruṣṭe vinaṣyati ||45|| sarve yajñā rasāḥ sarve pākāḥ sarve tvayi sthitāḥ | tavāśrayeṇa jīvāni jīvanti cāntaraścara ||46 || brūhi kasmāt praguptastvaṃ jāyase sukhado bhava | vahniḥ śrutvā hyajaṃ prāha śṛṇu guptestu kāraṇam ||47|| anāvṛṣṭyā mahendrasya sañjātaścauṣadhikṣayaḥ | tato’smyahaṃ tu māṃsena viśvāmitreṇa yojitaḥ ||48|| abhakṣyabhakṣaṇādbhīto gupto bhavāmi nānyathā | brahmākarṇyāha deveśaṃ kimarthaṃ naiva varṣasi ||49|| indraḥ prāhāgrajaṃ tyaktvā devāpiṃ bhrātaraṃ prajāḥ | cakrire’nujaniṃ pṛthvīpatiṃ śantanumutpadam ||1.495.50 || tatpāpena na varṣāmi kramalaṃghanakāraṇāt | brahmā prāha ca tatpāpaṃ bhuktaṃ śantanunā yataḥ ||51 || akālamṛtyavaḥ sarve durbhikṣamaraṇāḥ pare | śantanu kṣudhitaścāste pāpaṃ bhuktaṃ tu tena vai ||52|| vṛṣṭiṃ kuru mahendra tvaṃ mama vākyāt prajākṛte | ityuktaḥ puṣkarāvartānmeghān samādideśa saḥ ||53 || vavṛṣuśca mahāmeghāḥ pūrayāmāsurammayam | brahmā vahniṃ tataḥ prāha pratyakṣo bhava pāvaka ||54|| agnihotreṣu yajñeṣu viprāṇāṃ havaneṣu ca | varaṃ vṛṇu yatheṣṭaṃ te dadāmi hitakāmyayā ||55|| yatra yatrābhavo guptastattat tīrthaṃ tvadātmakam | vahnitīrthaṃ prasiddhaṃ ca pāvanaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ||56 || vahniḥ prāha ca bhagavan varṣatrayaṃ hi bhojanam | nāptavānasmi kutrāpi dehi me bhojanaṃ tataḥ ||57|| brahmā viprān samāhūya vahnestṛptyarthameva tu | vasordhārāpradānena ghṛtasya dhārayā mudā ||58|| tarpayantvanalaṃ cetyuvāca te cakrire tathā | vasordhārāpradānena varṣaparyantameva ha ||59|| tatastuṣṭiṃ parāṃ prāpya parāṃ puṣṭiṃ gato’nalaḥ | yasmād bhavati sampūrṇaṃ pūrṇāhutyā ca dhārayā ||1.495.60|| evaṃ vahniṃ samprakāśya vṛṣṭiṃ kratuṃ vidhāya ca | brahmādyā devatāḥ svargaṃ yayustato gajādayaḥ ||6 1 || ṛṣyāśrameṣu vanyeṣu dṛṣṭvā vahniṃ prakāśitam | yayuḥ pāvakaśaraṇaṃ prārthayāmāsurīśvaram ||62|| yatra yatrābhavad vahniryena yatrāvalokitaḥ | gajādyā analaṃ prāhuḥ prabho śāpaṃ nivāraya ||63 || vahniḥ prāha gajendraṃ te jihvā kāryakṣamāstu vai | nṛpavāhanarūpaśca miṣṭānnaṃ bhakṣayiṣyasi ||64|| śukaṃ prāha ca te jihvā nṛpapraśaṃsikāstu vai | bhekaṃ prāha ca te jihvā vṛṣṭisūcanadāstviti ||65|| matsyaṃ prāha ca te vaṃśaścaikasmācchatako’dhikaḥ | sahasrāntaścaikasmin prasave prasave’stu vai ||66 || kacchapaṃ prāha te cāyuḥ śatavarṣaparaṃ sthiram | bhavatvapi bhavadvaṃśe bhagavān śrīhariḥ svayam ||67|| kāryavaśājjanma labdhvā tārayiṣyati vaṃśajān | matsyaḥ kūrmo’bhavat sākṣādbhagavān śrīhariḥ svayam ||68|| gaṇeśaśca gajāsyo vai tathā lakṣmīrgajānanā | jātau śrīkṛṣṇarūpau tau vyāsaputrātmakaḥ śukaḥ ||69|| saṃjāto darduro rājā kāmarūpadharo hariḥ | saurāṣṭre devanagare yenāsīd vaiṣṇavaṃ jagat| ||1.495.70|| devanagararājaḥ sa babhūva vaiṣṇavaḥ paraḥ | jājaliścāgamat someśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ tu caikadā ||71 || tataśca raivataṃ tīrthaṃ kṛtvā dvāravatīṃ yayau | tato yayau camatkārapuraṃ nāganadītaṭe ||72|| suṣvāpa svapnadoṣeṇa dhātuḥ praskhalito’bhavat | kaupīnaṃ ca samutthāya tena prakṣālitaṃ jale ||73|| bheko taṃ bhakṣyarūpeṇa nigīlitavatī drutam | tasyāṃ putraḥ samabhavat tīre bhekī prapīḍitā ||74|| samāgatya mṛtiṃ prāptā dhovareṇa dhṛtā hi sā | udarasya pradeśaśca tasyā āsīt praphāṭitaḥ ||75|| tatra dṛṣṭaḥ śubho bālaḥ śvasan saṃgṛhya taṃ sutam | dhīvarastu dadau sūryasamaṃ rājavarāya tam ||76 || camatkāreṇa rājñā sa vardhito gaurjareśvaraḥ | rājābhavan mahābhakto vaiṣṇavo viṣṇurūpavān ||77|| yasya rājye’bhavan sarve vaiṣṇavā mānavādayaḥ | dardureṇa samudrasya taṭe dardurakaṃ puram ||78|| sthāpitaṃ suviśālaṃ ca rājadhānīsvarūpakam | mohamayaṃ divaḥ sāmye dakṣiṇe smṛddhipūritam ||79|| atha bhekāya vahniḥ sa dvitīyaṃ tu varaṃ dadau | cirañjīvā tava jātirbhavatvevaṃ navaṃ punaḥ ||1.495.80|| prativarṣaṃ nūtanaṃ vai śarīraṃ prāgbhavād bhavet | punarbhūstena varṣāyāṃ jāyate bheka eva ha ||81|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ sāmarthyaṃ vahisaṃsthitam | viśvāmitraśca taṃ vahniṃ luptaṃ jjva tu tatkṣaṇam ||82|| dūrīcakāra māṃsaṃ tatsārameyamaśuddhakam | upavāsaṃ tadā cakre tāvat tatra mahājanaḥ ||83|| vrīhīn traivārṣikān bhūmeḥ khanitvā bhūdarasthitān | samādāya yayau daivāt dadau tasmai maharṣaye ||84|| snātvā śuddhiṃ parāṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā homaṃ cidambare | ākāśavapuṣi kṛṣṇe bubhuje daivabhālitam |||85|| atha yātrāṃ sa nirvartya yayau tīrthārthameva ca | śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya pāpaprajvālanaṃ bhavet |||86|| dharme śraddhā bhaveccāpi vahneḥ prasannatā bhavet | pāvanaṃ mānasaṃ bhūtvā bhaktiyogyaṃ bhavet priye ||87|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne jyeṣṭhaṃ vihāyānujasya rājyābhiṣeke vṛṣṭyabhāve viśvāmitrahutamāṃsasaṃsargeṇa doṣabhītavahneranveṣakāṇāṃ devānāṃ sandeśapradagajaśukapuṣkaramatsyakūrmabhekānāṃ vahneḥ śāpaścānugrahaścetyādikathananāmā pañcanavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||495||
<1.496> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmyabhavad rājā hyajāpālābhidho mahān | sāketaviṣaye śrīmānacintat sa punaḥ punaḥ || 1 || mayā tatkarma kartavyaṃ yadanyairiha bhūmipaiḥ | na kṛtaṃ na kariṣyanti ye bhaviṣyantyataḥ param || 2 || prajānāṃ pālanaṃ śaśvat karādānaṃ vinā na vai | karādānena sainyādipoṣaṇaṃ bhavati dhruvam || 3 || karādānena rāṣṭrasya manaḥkṣobhaḥ prajāyate | tasmānmayā vinā sainyaṃ tapaḥśaktyā svarāṣṭrakam || 4 || rakṣaṇīyaṃ vicintyaivaṃ vaśiṣṭhaṃ samuvāca saḥ | mayā tapaḥ prakartavyaṃ prajānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 5 || tādṛśaṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ pradarśaya kṛpānidhe | vaśiṣṭhaḥ prāha saurāṣṭre kṣetraṃ śrīhāṭakeśvaram || 6 || śīghraṃ tapaḥphalasiddhipradaṃ tadvartate nṛpa | brahmacaryaparo bhūtvā śucirvrataparāyaṇaḥ || 7 || pārvatī tvaṃ pūjayasva tuṣṭā śīghraṃ bhaviṣyati | ऩtyuktaḥ prayayau tatra pārvatīṃ samapūjayat| || 8 || tadārādhanayā mātā tuṣṭā prāha nṛpottamam | brūhi tad yena te sarvaṃ prakaromi hṛdi sthitam || 9 || rājā prāha prajārakṣākṛte’strāṇi tadarthakān | mantrān śastrāṇi divyāni dehi me khecarāṇi vai || 1.496.1 0|| yāni jānanti sarvāsāṃ prajānāmaparādhakam | nyāyaṃ pāradāryādi cauryādi mānavā iva || 11 || matpārśvasthāni tānyeva tatra gatvāparādhinam | daṇḍayeyuḥ punaḥ pārśvamāgaccheyuryathāsthalam || 12|| mantragrāmaṃ tathā dehi vyādhīnāṃ nigrahāya ca | yena prajāḥ syurnīrogāḥ puṣṭāḥ sukhāśca nirbhayāḥ || 13|| karajīvyaṃ gajavājisainyaṃ me nāstyabhīpsitam | pārvatī prāha rājendra duṣkaraṃ tava karma vai || 14|| tathāpyevaṃ pradāsyāmi tapasaste phalānugam | jñānayuktāni śastrāṇi mantragrāmaṃ ca tādṛśam ||15|| sarve rogā stavādhīnā bhaviṣyanti mahītale | yadā tvaṃ yāsyasi svargaṃ jale sthāpaya tāni vai || 16|| nānyasmai tāni kasmaicid dātavyāni kadācana | ityuktvā pradadau devī divyāstraśastramantrakān ||17|| rājñā yathā prārthitām̐śca vyādhimantrām̐śca sarvaśaḥ | vyādhayo yena gṛhyante mucyante svecchayā tathā || 18|| sukhena paripālyante vyādhayo dṛṣṭigocarāḥ | evaṃ devīprasādena prāpya vai sakalaṃ nṛpaḥ || 1 9|| yayau sāketanagarīṃ gajadānādikaṃ dadau | sainyaṃ vyastaṃ cakārāpi karām̐ścāmocayattathā || 1.496.20||| prajānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ tāni śastrāṇyeva dadhatyapi | daṇḍaṃ yathāparādhaṃ ca prakāśaṃ guptameva vā || 21 || adṛṣṭānyapi śastrāṇi tāni kurvanti tatkṣaṇāt| | gupto’pi nāparādho’sti kasyacit prakaṭaḥ kutaḥ |||22|| evaṃ niyamitaṃ sarvaṃ rājye ca pararāṣṭrakaṃ | anyeṣāṃ ca mahīpānāṃ rājye guptyānyanekaśaḥ |||23||| kurvanti cāparādhāni teṣāṃ cakre yamagraham | sa ca vai sakalān vyādhīn mantraiḥ saṃyamya yatnataḥ ||24|| ajārūpān svayaṃ paścād yaṣṭimādāya rakṣati | rogeṣu nigṛhīteṣu sukhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ gatāḥ prajāḥ ||25|| prayātāḥ śūnyatāṃ sarve narakāśca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | na kaścinnarakaṃ yāti na ca mṛtyupathaṃ naraḥ ||26|| svargatulyāḥ satyatulyāḥ pṛthvyāṃ prajāstadābhavan | tato vaivasvato gatvā brahmāṇaṃ prārthayat sati ||27|| ahaṃ purā tvayā brahman dharmādharmadidṛkṣayā | samādiṣṭāsmi lokānāṃ nigrahānugrahau prati ||28|| ajāpālena bhūpena tatsarvaṃ niṣphalīkṛtam | tapaḥśaktyā prajānātha devīmārādhya pārvatīm ||29|| nādhayo vyādhayastena pravartante mahītale | na pāpāni cāparādhān kurvantyapi bhayāt prajāḥ ||1.496.3 0 || evaṃ dharmasya sanpanthāḥ tena kṛto hi bhūbhṛtā | tasya rodhaṃ prakurvantu brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ||3 1 || śrutvaivaṃ yamarājasya brahmā sasmāra śaṃkaram | viṣṇuṃ ca tau samāyātau śaṃbhuṃ prāha ca viśvasṛṭ || 32|| kiṃ kartavyaṃ cātra kārye vada śaṃbho vada prabho | śaṃbhurāha sudharme vai pravṛttasya śubhārthinaḥ || 33 || kathaṃ nivāraṇaṃ tatra kriyate kaśca nigrahaḥ | āyustasya kiyaddīrghaṃ vartate vada me yama || 34|| yena tatsamaye prāpte tannayāmi nijaṃ kṣayam | yamaḥ prāha tadāyuśca ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrakam || 35|| pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi gatāni tasya sāmpratam | tiṣṭhanti pañcapañcāśatsahasrāṇi bhaviṣyakam ||36|| aho dīrghaṃ tadāyuśca vilokya śaṃkaro yayau | vyāghrarūpaṃ samāsthāya tasya rājñaḥ samīpataḥ || 37||| meghagarjananirghoṣaṃ garjamāno muhurmuhuḥ | ajāścātha taṃ saṃvīkṣya dudruvuḥ sarvato diśaḥ || 38 || vyāghreṇa bhakṣitāḥ sarve tadā sa pṛthivīpatiḥ | vyāghraṃ hantuṃ mantrayuktānyastrāṇi prairayatta taḥ || 3 9|| tāni śastrāṇi mantrām̐ścāstrāṇi jagrāha śaṃka raḥ | svavaktreṇa samastāni na cāyānti nṛpaṃ prati ||1.496.4 0 || astrābhāvāt tatastūrṇaṃ dvandvayuddhaṃ cakāra saḥ | tāvadvyāghro’bhavacchaṃbhustrilocanastriśūlavān ||41 || rājā tvānandamagno’bhūt mudā tuṣṭāva śaṃkaram | ajñānādavamānaṃ te kṛtaṃ śaṃbho kṣamāṃ kuru ||42||| śaṃbhuḥ prāha mayā kṣāntaṃ parituṣṭena sarvaśaḥ | tvayā kṛtaṃ mahat karma nānyaiḥ pūrva kṛtaṃ tathā ||43 || prajānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ cātimānuṣaṃ vai kṛtaṃ tvayā | tasmād gaccha mayā sārdhaṃ kailāsaṃ pārthivottama ||44|| anayā dharmapatnyā te sahitaśca sukhī bhava | nātra loke tvayā stheyaṃ virodhena yamasya vai ||45|| devānāṃ ca virodhena tvayā stheyaṃ na bhūtale | ityuktaḥ sa nṛpaḥ prāha kariṣyāmi yathāttha me ||46 || devyā pūrvaṃ tu me proktaṃ yadā tvaṃ pṛthivītalāt | prayāsyasi tadāstrāṇi śastrāṇi sarvamantrakān ||47 || mahyaṃ datvā prayātavyaṃ tat kṛtvā yāmi śaṃkara | śaṃbhustasmai dadau tāṃśca śastrāstramantrakām̐stataḥ ||48 || rājā yayau camatkārakṣetraṃ śrīpārvatīṃ prati | dadau sarvāṇi pārvatyai jale nyasya prapūjya ca ||49|| māghaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ snātvā pārvatīkuṇḍake | yayau rājā tu sāketaṃ śaṃbhuryatra pratīkṣate ||1.496.50|| rājyaṃ putre’rpayitvaiva sabhāryo nṛpatiryayau | kailāsaṃ śaṃbhunā sārdhaṃ śaṃbhunā bhūbhṛte tataḥ ||51 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | itimantraḥ pradattaśca tulasīmālikārpitā |||2|| paramo vaiṣṇavo bhūtvā sabhāryaḥ śrīhariṃ bhajan | golokaṃ prayayau lakṣmi mukto babhūva śāśvataḥ ||53|| tasya putro’bhavad rājā daśarathaḥ sudhārmikaḥ | vimānena divaṃ yāti pātālādau prayāti ca ||54|| yasya putraḥ svayaṃ viṣṇū rāmacandro babhūva ha | kasyacittvatha kālasya daivajñaistasya bhūpateḥ ||55|| kathitaṃ rohiṇī bhedaṃ
