śanirgrahaḥ kariṣyati | tena dvādaśavarṣāṇi durbhikṣaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ||56 || tathā sampatsyate sarvaṃ bhūtalaṃ naṣṭamānavam | iti śrutvā yayau rājā tanmārgaṃ yatra vai śaniḥ ||57|| śakradattavimānena śanaiścaramupādravat | sajjaṃ kṛtvā dhanustatra śanaiścaramuvāca ha ||58|| tyajainaṃ rohiṇīmārgaṃ tvāṃ haniṣyāmi cānyathā | divyāstramantrayuktena śareṇānataparvaṇā ||59|| iti śrutvā śaniḥ prāha kastvaṃ ruṇatsi māṃ divi | rājā prāha nṛpaścāsmi ajaputro bhuvaḥ patiḥ ||1.496.60|| nāmnā daśarathaḥ prajārakṣārthamatra cāgataḥ | śaniḥ prāha tvayā sākaṃ virodho nāsti me kvacit ||61 || kathaṃ cāpena vai rājan manmārgaṃ hantumicchasi | rājā prāha śane tvaṃ rohiṇīmārgeṇa gacchasi ||62|| rohiṇīsaṃbhavaṃ tvaṃ hi śakaṭaṃ bhedayiṣyasi | tathā jāte navai vṛṣṭirannānāṃ saṃbhavo na ca ||63|| tena prajāvināśaśca yajñanāśaḥ surārdanam | tasmād ruddhastavaḥ mārgaḥ śrutvā śaniruvāca tam ||64|| tuṣṭo’haṃ tava vīryeṇa na kṛtaṃ kenacittu yat | tat kṛtaṃ vai tvayā rājan varaṃ vṛṇu dadāmi te ||65|| tasmātprajāsukhārthaṃ na bhedayiṣyāmi rohiṇīm | rājā prāha tava vāre tailābhyaṃgaṃ karoti yaḥ ||66|| tasya pīḍā cāsaptāha tvayā kāryā na vai kvacit | tiladānaṃ lohadānaṃ yaḥ karoti dine tu te ||67|| varṣamātraṃ tvayā tasya pīḍā kāryā na vai kvacit | tava gocarapīḍāyāṃ śāntikarturjanasya vai ||68|| sapta sārdhāni varṣāṇi pīḍā kāryā na vai tvayā | tathāstviti śaniḥ prāha virarāma bhuvaḥ patiḥ ||69|| idaṃ śrutvā mahendraśca śīghraṃ yayau ca tatsthalam | bhūpālaṃ prāha tuṣṭo’smi tava cādbhutakarmaṇā ||1.496.70|| varaṃ matto gṛhāṇādya śrutvā rājā hyuvāca tam | tvayā saha sadā maitrī mahendra cāstu me śubhā ||71 || indrastathāstviti prāha maitrī mayyastu te sadā | nityaṃ sāyaṃ pragantavyaṃ mamālayaṃ tvayā nṛpa ||72|| ityuktvā prayayāvindro nṛpo yāti divaṃ sadā | indrasadasi saṃśrutvā gāndharvīṇāṃ sugītikāḥ ||73|| nṛtyaṃ tālānvitaṃ cāpi kathā devarṣivaktrataḥ | dṛṣṭvā śrutvā samāyāti cāyodhyāṃ prati pratyaham ||74|| yadā niryāti śakrasya sabhātastadanantaram | daśarathānasyābhyukṣaṇaṃ kārayati sadā ||75|| athaikadā nāradastaṃ samuvāca nṛpaṃ mudā | rājam̐stvadāsaṃnasśabhyukṣaṇaṃ cendraḥ karoti hi ||76|| daśarathastato yātaḥ svāsane saṃsthitastataḥ | utthāya vīkṣayāmāsa svāsanaṃ dūramāsthitaḥ ||77|| indrājñayā tadā bhṛtyaḥ prokṣayāmāsa cāsanam | dṛṣṭvā rājā mahendraṃ ca papraccha tasya kāraṇam ||78|| indraḥ prāha bhavānadyāvadhiṃ pitṛṛṇānvitaḥ | aputrasya gatirnāsti na ca svargaṃ tataḥ param ||79|| yadā paśyati putrasya vadanaṃ puruṣo nṛpa | so’nṛṇyaṃ samavāpnoti pitṝṇāṃ ca tataḥ param ||1.496.80|| ityuktaḥ sa nṛpastarhi tanayārthaṃ suduḥkhavān | vaśiṣṭhena tataścakre putreṣṭiṃ gṛhamāgataḥ ||8 1 || jyeṣṭhā prāsūta kauśalyā rāmaṃ putraṃ narāyaṇam | kalahā kekayī putraṃ prāsūta bharataṃ sutam ||82|| śatrughnalakṣmaṇau madhyā sumitrā suṣuve sutau | kanyāṃ caikāṃ suṣuve sā lomapādā putrikā ||83|| putrīrūpā pradattā vai putrahīnāya tāriṇī | ānṛṇyaṃ tvabhavattasya yayau vaikuṇṭhameva saḥ ||84|| atha rāmo’bhavad rājā vanavāsottaraṃ tataḥ | daśavarṣasahasrāṇi daśavarṣaśatāni ca ||85|| sītādehāntakālottarakāle rājyamākarot | ekādaśasahasrānte devadūtaḥ samāyayau ||86|| tenoktaṃ devarājena preṣito’haṃ samāgataḥ | tasmācchṛṇu prasandeśaṃ kuru gṛhaṃ ca nirjanam ||87|| paścātte kathayiṣye’haṃ śrutvā rāmo jagāda ha | lakṣmaṇa nirjanaṃ kuryāḥ devadūtaṃ śṛṇomyaham ||88|| yāvadvārtā kriyate ca tāvadanye samāgatāḥ | kṛtvāto vārtikāmaunaṃ devadūta uvāca ha ||89|| yathā daṃṣṭrācyutaḥ sarpo nāgo vā madavarjitaḥ | ājñāhīnastathā rājā mānavaiḥ paribhūyate ||1.496.90|| ke ime’tra samāyātā rahasyavacane’pi te | śaṃkālāpamapi tvaṃ yannaikānte śrotumicchasi ||91 || śrutvā kopaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dṛḍhaṃ sa prāha lakṣmaṇam | niṣkāsaya bahistvanyān mā praveśaya kām̐ścana ||92|| yadi kaścinnaro mohādāgamiṣyati cāntaram | svahastena na sandehaḥ sūdayiṣyāmi taṃ drutam ||93|| na hanmi taṃ dṛṣṭicaraṃ tadā dharmagatirna me | bhavediti pratijāne bhava svastho’tra vartane ||94|| omityuktvā lakṣmaṇaśca saudhadvāri dṛḍhaḥ sthitaḥ | devadūto’pi rāmeṇa samaṃ cakre sumantraṇām ||95|| rāvaṇasya kṛto nāśo dharmaḥ saṃsthāpito bhuvi | āyuḥ pūrṇaṃ kṛtaṃ cātra vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāhi rocate ||96|| etasminnantare prāpto durvāsāḥ kṣudhayānvitaḥ | vyagraścovāca kutrāste rāmaḥ śīghraṃ nivedaya ||97|| gaccha lakṣmaṇa śīghraṃ cānyathā śāpaṃ dadāmyaham | śāpena vai kulaṃ sarvaṃ dhakṣyāmi nātra saṃśayaḥ ||98|| lakṣmaṇo vinayaṃ kṛtvā dadau śāntiṃ maharṣaye | sa na śāntaḥ pradātuṃ ca śāpamūrdhvaṃ karaṃ dadhe ||99|| tacchrutvā lakṣmaṇaḥ śīghraṃ rāmaṃ prāhāgamamṛṣeḥ | rāmaḥ prāha drutaṃ praveśaya durvāsasaṃ munim || 1.496.1 00|| lakṣmaṇastu muniṃ praveśayāmāsa drutaṃ tadā | gṛhītvā ca madhuparkaṃ rāmo yayau samīpagaḥ || 101 || nanāmārghyaṃ pradatvā ca svāgataṃ pracakāra ha | dhanyo’smyanugṛhīto’smi yattvaṃ me gṛhamāgataḥ || 1 02|| etadrājyaṃ prajāścemā vibhavo’nugrahāttava | ityukto munirāṭ prāha nirāhāro’smi vai vrate || 1 03|| cāturmāsye tadante ca samicchāmīha pāraṇām | yaccha me bhojanaṃ śīghraṃ raghūttamastataḥ ṛṣim || 1 04|| bhojayāmāsa miṣṭānnaiḥ sthitvāgrataḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | munirbhuktvā pradatvāśīrvādān yayau yathāgataḥ || 1 05|| atha rāmaṃ prāha khaḍgaṃ gṛhītvā lakṣmaṇaḥ svayam | vinipātaya khaḍgena māṃ pratijñāṃ ca pālaya || 1 06|| rāmaḥ sañcintya taṃ prāha vivāso maraṇādhikaḥ | vraja lakṣmaṇa muktatvaṃ mayā deśāntaraṃ drutam || 1 07|| tyāgo vātha vadho vātha sādhūnāmubhayaṃ samam | na mayā darśanaṃ bhūyastvayā kāryaṃ ca lakṣmaṇa || 1 08|| ityuktaḥ sa yayau tūrṇaṃ sarayūtīrameva hi | snātvā padmāsanaṃ kṛtvā brahmarandhreṇa nirgataḥ || 1 09|| tejomayo’mbare yāto dṛṣṭo rāmeṇa dehibhiḥ | yayuḥ sarve dadṛśuśca patitaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ śavam || 1.496.11 0|| vilepurbāndhavādyāśca karuṇaṃ paryavedayan | candanādicitāṃ kṛtvā dehaṃ nidadhuste tadā || 11 1|| ākāśavāgabhavacca māgniṃ dehi raghūttama | tavāyaṃ bāndhavo rāma brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ gataḥ || 1 12|| tvayā sugrīvabhaktaṃ ca vibhīṣaṇaṃ prabhaktakam | lakṣmaṇaṃ sahanītvaiva gantavyaṃ dhāma caiva ha || 11 3|| tato rāmo vimānena puṣpakeṇa tu dakṣiṇām | diśaṃ yayau saha nītvā sugrīvaṃ ca vibhīṣaṇam || 1 14|| samāgataḥ svanagarīṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ tadvimānake | kṛtvā kuśaṃ lavaṃ rājye’bhiṣicya dhāma saṃyayau || 1 15|| vibhiṣaṇaṃ dvitīyena rūpeṇa ca raghūttamaḥ | rarakṣa rājyakāryārthaṃ laṃkāyāṃ cirajīvinam || 1 16|| seturvināśito yasmād rākṣasā neyurityataḥ | etacchravaṇapāṭhābhyāṃ bhuktirmuktirbhavet priye || 1 17|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ajāpālamahārājasya rogāṇāmajāmaṇḍalarūpeṇa nigraho daśarathasya śanikṛtarohiṇīśakaṭavedhanirodho rāmakṛtapratijñayāvaikuṇṭhagamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṇṇavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 496 ||
<1.497> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca aṣṭaṣaṣṭipramāṇāni tīrthakṣetrāṇi bhūtale | kīrtayāmi śṛṇu lakṣmi pāvanāni hi dehinām || 1 || somanāthaṃ mahattīrthaṃ saurāṣṭre revatācalaḥ | kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ dvārikātīrthamityapi || 2 || camatkārapuraṃ tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇasarovaram | arbudādrirmahattīrthaṃ puṣkaraṃ tīrthamuttamam || 3 || hiṃgalājīmahattīrthaṃ haridvāraṃ tathottamam | kāśmīramaṇḍalaṃ tīrthaṃ badrikāśramamityapi || 4 || kedāranāthastīrthaṃ ca kurukṣetraṃ ca pāvanam | śālagrāmābhidhaṃ kṣetraṃ kāmākṣī kāmarūpake || 5 || nepāle ca pāśupataṃ kapilāśramamabdhike | muktināthaṃ tathā kṣetraṃ mahālakṣmīnivāsanam || 6 || tīrthaṃ hariharakṣetraṃ jagannāthapurī tathā | gayākṣetraṃ ca sāketanagarītīrthamuttamam || 7 || parśurāmaprakuṇḍāni māthuraṃ maṇḍalaṃ tathā | siddhapuraṃ mahattīrthaṃ prayāgarāja ityapi || 8 || kāśīkṣetraṃ daṇḍakāraṇyake śrītryambakaṃ tathā | oṃkāreśvaratīrthaṃ ca śuklatīrthaṃ tathottamam || 9 || bhṛgukṣetraṃ śriyāstīrthaṃ narmadābdhisamāgamaḥ | kalkibhūḥ saṃbhalatīrthaṃ candrabhāgāsthatulasī || 1.497.1 0|| aruṇādrirmahattīrthaṃ śrīśailastīrthamuttamam | kāñcīdvayaṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ cidambaraṃ ca pāvanam || 1 1|| janārdanakṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ bhūtapurīsumaṇḍalam | kumārikāsatīkṣetraṃ dharmāraṇyaṃ ca pāvanam ||1 2|| rāmeśvaraṃ mahatkṣetraṃ mallikārjunatīrthakam | malayācalatīrthaṃ ca tāmraparṇī ca pāvanī ||1 3|| ujjayinīmahākālavanaṃ naimiṣakaṃ vanam | mahendrādrirmahattīrthaṃ viśālākṣīvanaṃ tathā || 14|| kālaṃjaraṃ mahatkṣetraṃ kṣetraṃ gokarṇakaṃ tathā | amarakaṇṭakaṃ tīrthaṃ sāptagodāvaraṃ tathā || 15|| vindhyācalītrikūṭākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ ca pakṣitīrthakam | mahākailāsakaṃ tīrthaṃ tāpīsāgarasaṃgamaḥ || 16|| jāmadagnyāśramaparśurāmakṣetraṃ sutīrthakam | pulahāśramatīrthaṃ ca kāverītīrthamityapi || 17|| kṣetraṃ vārāhatīrthaṃ ca ṛṣabhakṣetramityapi | nṛsiṃhācalatīrthaṃ ca mīnākṣītīrthamityapi || 18|| padmanābhamahākṣetramaṣṭaṣaṣṭīni tāni vai | lakṣmi cānāditīrthāni santyevaitāni bhūtale || 1 9|| anyānyapi trayastriṃśatkoṭitīrthāni santi ca | tārakāḥ sādhavo devāḥ ṛṣayo munayastathā ||1.497.20|| satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ kumāryaśca pātivratyaparāyaṇāḥ | tāpasyastāpasā brahmacaryavrataparāyaṇāḥ ||21 || dharmiṣṭhāśca camatkṛtikarā yativarāstathā | gāvaścānye jātismarā bhaktāśca vaiṣṇavāstathā ||22|| śaivāḥ saurā gāṇapatyā devībhaktāśca śāṃkarāḥ | brāhmāścāndramasā īśabhaktā vahniprabhaktakāḥ ||23|| sādhakā māntrikāścāpi parakāyapraveśakāḥ | siddhimantaśca ye yatra nivasanti virāgiṇaḥ ||24|| santaḥ paramahaṃsāśca sāṃkhyayoginya ityapi | yatra vasanti puṇyāni tāni tīrthāni padmaje ||25|| bhavanti pāpanāśārthaṃ samarthāni jaḍānyapi | cetanāni tu tīrthāni jaḍatīrthakarāṇi vai ||26|| devasthānāni sarvāṇi tīrthānyeva bhavanti hi | gurvāśramāśca guravastīrthāni sarvadā priye ||27|| tārayitvā ca saṃsārāt sthāpayatyaiśvare pade | mokṣe vā tāni tīrthāni pāpakṣālanakāni vai ||28|| patistīrthaṃ pitā tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ mātā pativratā | satī tīrthaṃ ca gaustīrthaṃ santastīrthaṃ samuttamam ||29|| gurustīrthaṃ haristīrthaṃ devāstīrthaṃ ca sarvadā | jñānaṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ śuddhaṃ bhaktistīrthaṃ tataḥ param ||1.497.3 0|| dāsyaṃ tīrthottamaṃ sevā tīrthaṃ tīrthottamottamam | sevayā labhyate sarvaḥ puruṣārthaḥ sudurlabhaḥ ||3 1 || hareḥ sevā satāṃ sevā tīrthaṃ tīrthottamottamam | anyāni yāni tīrthāni tanmūlāni bhavanti vai ||32|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | evaṃ jāpaḥ paraṃ tīrthaṃ mahāvaiṣṇavakārakam ||33|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī nānyaḥ svāmī mato mama | ityevaṃ tvarpaṇaṃ tīrthaṃ cātmanaḥ parikīrtitam || 34|| sthūlasūkṣmāntarāṇāmarpaṇaṃ dāsyaṃ hi tīrthakam | yathā kṛṣṇaḥ prasannaḥ syāttatkāryaṃ tīrthameva vai || 35|| nṛtyaṃ tīrthaṃ tvapsarasāṃ tuṣyed yena janārdanaḥ | gītaṃ tīrthaṃ ca nārīṇāṃ tuṣyed yena tu mādhavaḥ ||36|| gāndharvāṇāṃ vādyatīrthaṃ tuṣyed yena narāyaṇaḥ | kāmastīrtha tu gopīnāṃ tuṣyed yena vrajeśvaraḥ || 37|| dhyānaṃ tīrthaṃ yogavatāṃ yena tuṣyati keśavaḥ | evaṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ matvā jñātvā śrīkṛṣṇamiṣṭadam ||38|| sarvaṃ tasmin samarpyaiva mokṣaṃ sañcinuyād budhaḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhavet ||39|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’ṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrthataditarādhyātmikatīrthādinirūpaṇoddeśādikathananāmā saptanavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 497 ||
<1.498> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi brāhmaṇānāṃ camatkāramayīṃ kathām | ānartādhipatirbhūbhṛt prasanno brāhmaṇān varān || 1 || samāhūya samuvāca praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ | suvarṇaṃ vā gajāśvaṃ vā saṃkrāntau makare raveḥ || 2 || yasya yadrocate dātumicchāmi pṛthivīmapi | prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mahyaṃ dīnasya praṇatasya ca || 3 || viprāstvāhurvayaṃ nityaṃ niṣparigrahadharmiṇaḥ | bhikṣāhārāstāpasāśca kiṃ gajāśvasuvarṇakaiḥ || 4 || camatkāro nṛpaḥ prāha bhavanto lokapāvanāḥ | rājyalakṣmyāḥ praśuddhyarthaṃ dānaṃ gṛhṇantu pāvanāḥ || 5 || dvāsaptatibrāhmaṇāśca vartante’tra nadītaṭe | parṇakuṭīrvidhāyaiva vyomamārgavihāriṇaḥ || 6 || tapaḥśaktyā sadā yānti nānātīrtheṣu bhaktitaḥ | japaṃ snānaṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca kṛtvā tvāyānti vai punaḥ || 7 || vārāṇasyāṃ prayāge vā puṣkare naimiṣe tathā | aśvapaṭṭasarasi prabhāse kedārake tathā || 8 || kvacit prayānti saṃkrāntau cāturmāsye’pi yānti ca | atra varṣe ca saṃkrāntau nāgavatyāstaṭe dvijāḥ || 9 || gṛhṇantu mama dānaṃ ca kurvantu pāvanān hi naḥ | ityuktā api viprāste virāgāḥ puṣkaraṃ yayuḥ || 1.498.1 0|| pañcarātrinivāsārthaṃ saṃkrāntau makare raveḥ | rājā vijñāya tatsarvaṃ damayantīṃ priyāṃ tadā || 11 || prāha tvaṃ kanakaṃ bhūṣā vastrāṇyādāya saddhanam | nāganadyāstaṭaṃ yāhi yatra brāhmaṇayoṣitaḥ || 1 2|| bhūṣaṇādīni vastūni tāsāṃ yaccha yathecchayā | na tāsāṃ patayo’smākaṃ prakurvanti pratigraham || 1 3|| striyo’vaśyaṃ grahīṣyanti dānaṃ bhūṣaṇaprabhṛti | yādṛśaṃ yādṛśaṃ vāpi nārī dhatte vibhūṣaṇam || 14|| sā tatheti pratijñāya bahūnyābharaṇāni ca | maṇimuktāpravālāni kuṇḍalāni śubhāni ca || 15|| tathā candrojjvalān hārān nūpurāṇi bṛhanti ca | indranīlamahānīlavaidūryakhacitāni ca || 16|| padmarāgaistathā vajrairmāṇikyaiśca manoharaiḥ | keyūraiḥ kaṃkaṇairdivyaiḥ śṛṃkhalāhemasūtrakaiḥ ||17|| gṛhītvā nāgavatyāṃ vai snātuṃ saṃkrāntiparvaṇi | samāyātā tilamiṣṭānnāni nītvā bṛhanti ca || 18|| snātvā tīre niveśyaitanmahābhūṣaṇaparvatam | pratīkṣate ca pātrāṇi dānasya tannadītaṭe || 1 9|| etasminnantare prāptāstāpasyaḥ kautukānvitāḥ | jñātvā dānārthamāyātāṃ damayantīṃ nṛpapriyām ||1.498.20|| kīdṛśī rājapatnī sā kiṃrūpā kiṃvibhūṣaṇā | itikautukamāpannā viprapatnyaḥ samāgatāḥ ||21 || āgatāstā namaścakre prāha rājñī manoharam | mayāyaṃ bhūṣaṇastoma uddiśya garuḍadhvajam ||22|| kalpito’dya dine dānaṃ brāhmaṇīṣu phalapradam | tasmād gṛhṇantu tāpasyo mayā dattāni vāñchayā ||23|| bhūṣaṇāni hyanekāni prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mama | tataścaikābravīt tāsāmenāṃ muktāvalīṃ mama ||24|| dehi śrutvā nṛpapatnyā prakṣālya caraṇau svayam | dattā muktāvalī tasyai vastrairdivyaiḥ samanvitā ||25|| tathānyāyai dadau hāraṃ hārākāṃkṣāṃ vibudhya sā | tṛtīyāyai kuṇḍale ca dadau jñātvā ca tanmanaḥ ||26|| tataśca śeṣāstāpasyo jagṛhurbhūṣaṇāni ca | yāni yāni dadau tasyai tasyai mudā ca tāni ca ||27|| yathā yathā pragṛhṇanti tāpasyo bhūṣaṇāni tāḥ | tathā tathāsyāḥ saṃjajñe damayantyāḥ pramodakaḥ ||28|| anyāni ca pracikṣepa śataśo’tha sahasraśaḥ | gṛhṇantviti kathayitvā maunaṃ tasthau nṛpapriyā ||29|| gṛhītāni tu sarvāṇi tāpasībhistato hyapi | na tṛptirjāyate tāsāṃ rājñī tadāha tāḥ punaḥ ||1.498.3 0 || santoṣaḥ kriyatāṃ gatvā cānayāmi punaḥ punaḥ | ityuktvā prayayau tūrṇaṃ gṛhītvā cāyayau drutam ||3 1 || anantāni bhūṣaṇāni cāmbarāṇi dhanāni ca | dadau pañcāhaparyantaṃ brāhmaṇībhyo muhurmuhuḥ ||32|| tāpasyo’pi dadhustāni vastrāṇi vividhāni hi | bhūṣaṇāni ca gātreṣu saspṛhāstoṣapūrvikāḥ ||33|| ūṭajāni dhanavastrabhūṣāpūrṇāni cakrire | atha catasro brāhmaṇyo valkalājinaśobhitāḥ ||34|| dānagrahaṇaṃ necchantyo na tasyāḥ pārśvamāgatāḥ | tāsāṃ dānasya lābhārthaṃ rājñī tu pañcame dine ||35|| bhūṣaṇāni mahārhāṇi gṛhītvā tāḥ yayau drutam | rājñī provāca tāḥ sarvāḥ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti ||36|| imāni bhūṣaṇārthāya gṛhyantāṃ bhūṣaṇāni vai | tāpasyastu virāgiṇyaḥ patīcchānugatāḥ sadā ||37|| pātivratyaparāḥ prāhuḥ patīnāṃ nāsti tanmanaḥ | patyurājñāṃ vinā patnī karoti dehaśobhanam ||38|| pāpaṃ sā prāpnuyāt tasmād gṛhṇīmo na vayaṃ tava | nāsmākaṃ bhūṣaṇaiḥ kāryaṃ bhūṣitā valkalairvayam ||3 9 || evaṃ saṃvadatāṃ tāsāṃ tayā sārdhaṃ tu tatkṣaṇam | catvāraḥ patayaḥ prāptā vyomamārgeṇa cāśramān ||1.498.40|| śunaḥśepo’tha śākreyo boddho dāntaścaturthakaḥ | śeṣāḥ sarve gatibhraṃśaṃ prāpya bhūmārgamāśritāḥ ||41 || patnīnāṃ tṛṣṇayā bhūṣādānagrahaṇadoṣataḥ | catvāraste ṛṣipatnīḥ kanyakāśca vibhūṣitāḥ ||42|| dṛṣṭvā kimidaṃ kimidaṃ procurvikṛtamāśritāḥ | kena datvābhūṣaṇāni yat tāpasyo viḍambitāḥ ||43|| dhanavastrāṇi datvā naścāśramo’yaṃ vikāritaḥ | tadā prāhustu tāpasyaścamatkāranṛpasya vai ||44|| mahiṣī damayantīyaṃ vartate sāmprataṃ tayā | sampradattāni sarvāsāṃ bhūṣaṇānyambarāṇi ca ||45|| asmākamapi saṃprāptā dātuṃ seyaṃ pratiṣṭhati | asmābhirna gṛhītāni niṣiddhā sā nivāritā| ||46 || itiśrutvā ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇāstapasaḥ kṣayāt | tāṃ śepuste śrāvayitvā śṛṇu lakṣmi tapobalam ||47|| dvāsaptatirvayaṃ rājñi snānārthaṃ puṣkare gatāḥ | vyomamārgeṇa tapasā manomārutaraṃhasā ||48|| catvārasta ime prāptā yeṣāṃ dāraiḥ parigrahaḥ | na kṛtaste’pare vyomno mārgād bhraṣṭāśca puṣkare ||49|| nārīṇāṃ ca satīnāṃ tu satītvena mahadbalam | dānagraheṇa naṣṭaṃ tad vaihāyasaṃ balaṃ yataḥ ||1.498.50|| tapaso vañcito’smākamāśramo’yaṃ tvayā dhanaiḥ | vibhūṣaṇādidānaiśca tat tvaṃ śilā bhavātra vai ||51 || atha tuṣṭāva sā rājñī muktyarthaṃ ca tadā tu te | prāhuścātra mādhavīti śāṇḍilī kamalāṃśajā ||5 2|| viprakanyā samāgatya tavoddhāraṃ kariṣyati | acireṇaiva kālena sāgamiṣyati mādhavī ||5 3 || lakṣmīrūpā śilāyāṃ sā sthāsyatyeva nadītaṭe | śilā kanyāsvarūpā sā bhaviṣyati ramā yathā ||54|| śṛṇu lakṣmi tatra kanyāṃ śilāṃ brāhmaṇasannidhau | tatkṣaṇameva sañjātāṃ jñātvā vṛttāntameva tam ||55 || rājā tatra drutaṃ prāpa patnīṃ śuśoca vai drutam | catvāro brāhmaṇā nītvā kuṭumbaṃ vyomasatpathā ||56|| yayurhimālayaṃ vighnaśūnyaṃ sthalaṃ tapasvinaḥ | rājā śilāṃ prasaṃspṛśya smṛtvā smṛtvā priyāguṇān ||57|| vilalāpa kṣaṇaṃ pativratāṃ śrāddhaṃ cakāra ha | tasyā upari saudhaṃ ca kārayāmāsa pārthivaḥ ||58|| svayaṃ karpūradhūpādyairvastrakuṃkumacandanaiḥ | pūjāṃ cakāra nityaṃ ca kārayāmāsa bhūsuraiḥ ||59|| atha padbhyāṃ mahīṃ krāntvā cāṣṭaṣaṣṭidvijāḥ śubhāḥ | āyātā nāganadyāste tīre śrāntāḥ sudūragāḥ ||1.498.60|| dṛṣṭvābharaṇayuktām̐śca jñātvā vṛttāntamityapi | vividuḥ kāraṇaṃ vyomnaḥ pātasya dānasaṃgraham ||61 || damayantyāḥ śilābhāvaṃ jñātavantaśca vai tataḥ | camatkāranṛparāṣṭranāśārthaṃ jagṛhurjalam ||62|| yataścāsmadgatirvyomni nāśitā dānalobhataḥ | brāhmaṇīnāṃ mano jātaṃ rājasaṃ rāgamiśritam ||63|| tatphalaṃ yātu rājā ca rāṣṭraṃ ceti vicintyate | śāpaṃ vaktumārabhante tāvadvai viprayoṣitaḥ ||64|| vārayāmāsuratyarthaṃ śāpo deyo na sarvathā | yato vayaṃ narendrasya bhāryayā samalaṃkṛtāḥ ||65|| suvastrairbhūṣaṇairdivyaiḥ śraddhāpūtena cetasā | vayaṃ dāridryadoṣeṇa karṣitā bhavatāṃ gṛhe ||66|| na prāptaṃ tu sukhaṃ martye vastrabhūṣādisaṃbhavam | kevalānāṃ tāpasānāṃ paro lokaḥ sukhapradaḥ ||67|| nīcānāṃ viṣayasthānāṃ tvihaiva sukhamātrakam | tapodharmagṛhasthānāmubhayatra sukhaṃ sadā ||68|| tadasmābhiḥ sukhaṃ cātra bhoktavyaṃ dharmavartibhiḥ | tā vayaṃ vastrabhūṣāṇāṃ sukhaṃ saṃsevya sarvadā ||69|| gṛhasthadharmān saṃsevya patisevāṃ surārcanam | saṃsevya sādhayiṣyāmo lokadvayamanuttam ||1.498.70|| tasmād yūyaṃ cātra viprā bhūmimādāya bhūpateḥ | vṛttiṃ cāpi gṛhītvaiva ramyāṇi ca gṛhāṇi ca ||71 || gṛhītvaivātha vīkṣadhvaṃ putrapautrasamudbhavam | saukhyaṃ cāpi kumārīṇāṃ bāndhavānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||72|| na kariṣyatha cedvākyametadasmadudīritam | sarvāḥ prāṇaparityāgaṃ kariṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ ||73|| yūyaṃ strīvadhapāpena yuktāḥ yāsyatha rauravam | śrutvaitacchāpadānārthaṃ dhṛtaṃ vāri bhuvastale ||74|| tatyajurdāravākyaiste sā bhūrūṣaratāṃ gatā | atha śrutvā ca tadvārtāṃ rājā mumoda cāyayau ||75|| brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradānārthaṃ bhuvo dhanasya sampadām | brāhmaṇānāṃ vacanena rājā puramakārayat ||76 || prākāraparikhāyuktaṃ gopuraiḥ saudhapaṃktibhiḥ | śobhitaṃ nagaraṃ nāma camatkārapuraṃ tu tat ||77|| aṣṭaṣaṣṭibrāhmaṇānāṃ vāsastatra kuṭumbinām | kārito bhūbhṛtā tebhyo jīvikāpi samarpitā ||78|| tataḥ paraṃ ca sā lakṣmīrmādhavī yā ca śāṇḍilī | nāganadyāṃ nacirādvai puraṃ draṣṭuṃ samāgatā ||79|| snātvā kṣaṇaṃ śilāyāṃ sā niṣasāda tadā satī | damayantī punarjātā nārīrūpā yathā purā ||1.498.80|| brāhmaṇībhyo namaskṛtya svapnotthitaiva harṣitā | yayau rājagṛhaṃ mahotsavaṃ cakāra bhūpatiḥ ||81|| grāmāṇāmaṣṭaṣaṣṭiṃ ca dadau dānaṃ sukhapradam | viprāṇāmatha catvāri gotrāṇyanyānyapi priye |||82||| yayurhimālayaṃ cātra catuḥṣaṣṭiśca śeṣitāḥ | taiḥ samyakkāritā yajñā bahuhavyasudakṣiṇāḥ ||83 || yajñe kṛte’bhavad rājā rogeṇātiprapīḍitaḥ | kāraṇaṃ tatra vai cāsīdekasya brāhmaṇasya vai ||84|| trijātasya spṛṣṭadravyahomaḥ krūraphalapradaḥ | trijātasya parīkṣārthaṃ vahninā divyasajjalam ||85 || kuṇḍaṃ pradarśitaṃ tatra snāne visphoṭako bhavet | yasya sa eva boddhavyastrijāta iti tatkṛtam ||86|| parīkṣyaivaṃ ca vipraḥ sa niṣkāsito vanaṃ yayau | tapaścakre haraṃ smṛtvā harastuṣṭo babhūva ha ||87|| varaṃ vṛṇu haraḥ prāha vipra uvāca śaṃkaram | trijātadoṣaṃ niṣkāsya dehi sarvottamocchratām ||88|| śaṃkaraśca dadau tasmai na garaṃ na garaṃ manum | yaduccāraṇamātreṇa sarpā nirviṣatāṃ tathā ||89|| prāpnuyurmaraṇaṃ cāpi gṛhāṇa gaccha tatsthalam | etanmantraṃ gṛhītvā sa nagaraṃ ca yayau dvijaḥ ||1.498.9 0|| nagarasthā dvijā hyāsam̐stadā sarpaprapīḍitāḥ | trijātena ca mantreṇa rakṣitāḥ sarvato dvijāḥ ||9 1 || te sthitā nāgarāḥ sarve trijātādyāḥ samuttamāḥ | kṛṣṇabhaktiparāḥ sarve hāṭakeśvarapūjakāḥ ||9 2|| hāṭakeśvaradevātte labdhavanto manuṃ tadā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ||9 3|| cakruśca bhajanaṃ jāpaṃ narā nāryaśca sarvadā | golokaṃ prayayuścānye prayānti bhajanāt priye ||94|| ityākhyātaścamatkāro brāhmaṇānāṃ tapasvinām | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya vāñcchitaṃ ca phalaṃ bhavet || 95|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne camatkāranṛpatibhāryayā damayantyā kṛtaratnasvarṇādidānagrahaṇena vyomamārgagāmibrāhmaṇānāṃ patanaṃ vipraśāpena damayantyāḥ śilātvaṃ punarmādhavīsparśena rājñītvaṃ nagaravāsādi cetinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭanavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||498||
<1.499> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi bhadrikāyāḥ kathāṃ divyāṃ manoramām | revatyāśca kathāṃ divyāṃ kathayāmi nibodha me || 1 || camatkārapure nāgā hāṭakeśvarabhaktitaḥ | āgatya khalu pātālānnivasanti kvacitkvacit || 2 || ekadā nāgabālaṃ vai rudramālābhidhaṃ dvijaḥ | kratho nāmāhanannadyāṃ laguḍena vṛthā jale || 3 || hā hato’smītyuvācāyaṃ sarpastasya prasūstadā | tathā sarpāścāyayuśca manuṣyarūpadhāriṇaḥ || 4 || prāṇām̐statyāja bālaḥ sa sarpāḥ kruddhā bhayaṃkarāḥ | dudruvurvipranāśārthaṃ vipro dudrāva cāśramam || 5 || nāgā gatvā sakuṭumbaṃ bhakṣayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ | tasya viprasya bhaginī bālavaidhavyaduḥkhitā || 6 || brahmacaryaparā sādhvī kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇā | tāpasī bhadrikānāmnī śaśāpa nāginīṃ tadā || 7 || nāgamātā revatī tvaṃ savaṃśaṃ nāśamāpnuhi | revatī śāpamāpannārādhayāmāsa pārvatīm || 8 || tataḥ katipayāhasya tasyāstuṣṭā maheśvarī | provāca varadāsmīti revatī varamārthayat || 9 || bhadrikāśāpanāśo me bhavatviti samārthayat | pārvatī prāha śāpasya nāśo naiva bhavet kvacit || 1.499.10 || kintu sarpastakṣako vai saurāṣṭre raivato nṛpaḥ | ānartaviṣaye bhāvī tasya kṣemaṃkarī priyā || 11 || bhaviṣyati tayoḥ putrī mānuṣī tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi | tava bhartā tadā śeṣaḥ svayaṃ tatra bhaviṣyati || 1 2|| tava varasya lābhārthaṃ brahmāṇaṃ prati me gatiḥ | kṣaṇamātraṃ bhāvinī vai tatra te vaṃśavistaraḥ || 13 || nāśameṣyati cetyevaṃ vaṃśanāśo bhaviṣyati | punaste balarāmeṇa vivāhaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati || 14| śrīkṛṣṇaśca svavaṃśasya nāśaṃ kariṣyati prabhuḥ | kaṇvaśāpena vai tatra hyevaṃ śāpaḥ phaliṣyati || 15|| evamuktā revatī sā yayau pātālameva ca | śeṣaṃ nivedayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ nirvṛttaṃ bhuvi ||16| atha sā brāhmaṇī nāmnā bhadrikā vidhavā satī | kathāṃ śuśrāva śāstrāṇāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇānanāt ||19|| devayātrāṃ tīrthayātrāṃ cakre bhaktiṃ narāyaṇe | athaikadā takṣakaśca samāyayau bhuvastalam ||18||| nāgavatyāstaṭe dṛṣṭvā bhadrikāṃ tu surūpiṇīm | nināya nararūpeṇa pātālaṃ bhadrikā ca tam || 1 9||| śaśāpa mānuṣo bhūtvā saha patnyā sutābhavam | duḥkhaṃ vai prāpsyase vaṃśanāśasampādakaṃ tadā ||1.499.20| takṣako bhayamāpannastuṣṭāva tāṃ tu bhadrikām | bhadrikā prāha māṃ pṛthvyāṃ naya tatra sthale punaḥ ||21 | takṣakeṇa tadānītā camatkārapuraṃ prati | atha lokāpavādena citāṃ sā praviveśa ha ||22|| paśyatāṃ janavṛddhānāṃ śuddhyarthaṃ bhadrikā yadā | na dagdhā romaśo vāji janāstvāścaryamāgatā ||23|| vahnirvai śītalo jātaḥ śuddhā sā bhadrikā yataḥ | papātātha mahāvṛṣṭiḥ kusumānāṃ nabhastalāt ||24|| devāḥ prāhuḥ paraṃ śuddhā vartase tvaṃ subhadrike | na tvayā sadṛśī cānyā kācit satī bhaviṣyasi ||25| tisraḥ koṭyo’rdhakoṭiśca yāni lomāni mānuṣe | teṣāṃ madhye na te sādhvi pāpamekamapi kvacit ||26|| tvaṃ ca sādhvī satī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapativratā | bhūtvā ca tyāginī devī sāṃkhyayogamupāśritā ||27|| satāṃ sevāṃ kuru puṇyaṃ samārādhaya keśavam | bhadrikā prārthayāmāsa śrutvā devaṃ janārdanam ||28| tāvat kṛṣṇo dvijo bhūtvāvātatāra bhuvastalam | dadau tasyai śubhāṃ dīkṣāṃ tulasīmālikāṃ gale ||29| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ | ityuktvā triḥ karṇamantraṃ yayāvadṛśyatāṃ dvijaḥ ||1.499.30|| bhadrikārādhayāmāsa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sadā | tatra paraṃ tapaścakre bhikṣānnakṛtabhojanā ||3 1 || nāganadyāṃ ca tannāmnā bhadrikātīrthamuttamam | camatkārakaraṃ jātaṃ snātvā niṣpāpatā bhavet ||32|| atha sā bhadrikā kālaṃ prāptā divyaśarīriṇī | bhūtvā mokṣaṃ yayau dhāma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ||33|| evaṃ satībalaṃ lakṣmi muktidaṃ pāpanāśanam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktyā bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||34|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya kīrtanādapi padmaje | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhet sampadvarāmārogyamīśatām ||35|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhadrikākhyabrāhmaṇyāḥ śāpena nāgamātuḥ revatītvaṃ takṣakasya mānuṣatvaṃ bhadrikāyāḥ kṛṣṇabhaktyā muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navanavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ |||499|||
<1.500> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ karṇotpalāyā brahmayoṣitaḥ | satyasandha iti khyātaḥ purāsīt pṛthivīpatiḥ || 1 || tasya karṇotpalānāmnī kanyāsīd dharmapālinī | lakṣmyaṃśarūpā cihnaiśca rekhābhiḥ kamalāsamā || 2 || yuvatīṃ tāṃ varayogyāṃ dṛṣṭvā sa pṛthivīpatiḥ | cintayāmāsa ca muhuḥ kasyemāṃ pradadāmyaham || 3 || na tasyāḥ sadṛśaḥ kaścid varo’tra dharaṇisthale | na svarge na ca pātāle tasmād yāmi pitāmaham || 4 | brahmātra viṣaye’vaśyaṃ yaṃ varaṃ darśayiṣyati | tasmai putrīṃ pradāsyāmi nānyasmai vai kathaṃcana || 5 || atha putrīṃ sahanītvā brahmalokaṃ jagāma saḥ | brahmā cāsīt kṛṣṇapūjāparaṃ kṣaṇaṃ jagatpatiḥ || 6 || pūjānte satyasandhaḥ sa rājā brahmāṇamādarāt | putryā saha namaskṛtya provāca vinayānvitaḥ || 7 || ahaṃ pitaḥ samāyāto martyalokāttavāntikam | satyasandho mahīpāla ānartadeśaviśrutaḥ || 8 || iyaṃ karṇotpalānāmnī kamalāṃśā sutā mama | asyā yogyaḥ patiḥ kaścinnānyaloke vilokyate || 9 || tasmānme brūhi bhartāramasyā yena dadāmyaham | śrutvā brahmā ca taṃ prāha śṛṇu rājan vṛṣaṃ prati ||1.500.1 0|| ātmaśreṇīprasūtāya vayojyeṣṭhāya sarvathā | kanyā deyā tu dharmāya yaśase kulavṛddhaye || 11 || seyaṃ tava sutā martye jyeṣṭhabhāvaṃ samāśritā | sarveṣāṃ bhūmipālānāṃ vārdhakyamatra tacchṛṇu || 1 2|| mamāntikaṃ prapannasya tava jātaṃ yugatrayam | atītā bhūtale martyā ye dṛṣṭā prāk tvayā nṛpa || 1 3|| anyā sṛṣṭiḥ samutpannā sāṃprataṃ dharaṇisthale | mamātra satyaloke tu ye vartante maharṣayaḥ || 14|| na vai te mānuṣīṃ bhāryāṃ kurvanti hi kathaṃcana | śleṣmamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ saṃsthānamatigarhitām || 15|| tapasā kanyakā ceyaṃ kāyāntaraṃ karoti cet | kāmadevo divyarūpāṃ grahīṣyati sutāṃ tava || 16|| nāmnā prītiṃ dvitīyāṃ vai bhāryāṃ ratyuttarāgatām | tasmād rājendra bhūlokaṃ yāhi tvasutayā saha || 17|| kāmadevāya dātavyā tvayā kālāntare sutā | ityuktaḥ sakanyakaḥ sa bhūtalaṃ prasamāyayau || 18|| yāvatpaśyati deśaṃ saḥ sthalasthāne jalāśayān | jalasthāneṣu vai jātān sthalasaṃghān vicitrakān || 1 9|| anyān lokāṃstathā dharmān deśe tatra vyavasthitān | pṛcchannapi na jānāti sambandhaṃ kenacit saha ||1.500.20|| putrāḥ pautrāstathā bhṛtyā hastyaśvādikamityapi | te sarve nidhanaṃ prāptā yugāntare ca bāndhavāḥ ||21 || atha martyānilaspṛṣṭastatkṣaṇāt sa mahīpatiḥ | sā ca kanyā jarāgrastau tāvubhau śvetamūrdhajau ||22|| śīrṇadantau balipūrṇī virūpau jarjarātmakau | amanojñāvatijātau cipiṭākṣau purātanau ||23|| sa tu rājā tathābhūto vepamānaḥ pade pade | papraccha mānavān ko’tra deśaḥ ko’yaṃ puraṃ ca kim ||24|| atha procurjanāstasya deśaścānartasaṃjñakaḥ | bṛhadbalākhyo rājātra prāptipuraṃ ca pattanam ||25|| śubhramatī sariccaiṣā gartātīrthaṃ ca nāmataḥ | iti śrutvānyanāmāni vismayaṃ tvāpa bhūpatiḥ ||26|| śuśoca vai kṣaṇaṃ paścāt snātvā nadyāṃ sa bhūpatiḥ | vidyamānaṃ bṛhadbalaṃ prati yayau sakanyakaḥ ||27|| satyasandhastamuvāca rājan vṛttaṃ nibodha me | ānartādhipatiścāhaṃ satyasandhaḥ purātviti ||28|| āsaṃ karṇotpalānāmnī sutā me guṇaśālinī | seyaṃ mayā sahaivāste lakṣmītulyā ramākalā ||29|| so’hamasyāḥ pradānārthaṃ satyalokamito gataḥ | praṣṭuṃ pitāmahaṃ devaṃ sthitastatra muhūrtakam ||1.500.3 0 || tāvadatra vyatītā vai yugā bahutarā nṛpa | satyalokāt samāyāto yāvatpaśyāmi bhūtalam ||3 1 || sarvaṃ pariṇataṃ vāri sthalaṃ vanaṃ ca pattanam | ajñātamiva me sarvaṃ lokyate kintu mānavaiḥ ||32|| tava nāma pradattaṃ tatsamāyāto’smi te’ntikam | rājā bṛhadbalo lakṣmi śrutvā vaṃśaprapūrvajam ||33|| śrutaṃ satyagataṃ cātrāyātaṃ dṛṣṭvātivihvalaḥ | harṣāśrunayano bhūtvā papāta tasya pādayoḥ ||34||| uvāca svāgataṃ rājan bhūyaḥ susvāgataṃ pitaḥ | idaṃ rājyaṃ nijaṃ bhūyo mayā bhṛtyena rakṣitam ||35|| svecchayā dehi dānāni kuru rājyaṃ nijaṃ pitaḥ | tataḥ so’pi vaṃśajaṃ svaṃ samāliṃgya nṛpaṃ nṛpaḥ ||36|| śirasyāghrāyāśrupūrṇanetrābhyāṃ taṃ siṣeca ca | prāha rājyaṃ mayā cīrṇaṃ dattaṃ dānaṃ purā bahu ||37|| vājimedhamukhairyajñairiṣṭaṃ sampūrṇadakṣiṇaiḥ | tasmāt tapaścariṣyāmi sutayā tvanayā saha ||38|| bṛhadbalastamuvāca yatheṣṭaṃ kuru pārthiva | tavaivāsti mahadrājyaṃ gṛhāṇa vā tapaḥ kuru ||39|| pāramparyeṇa rājendra mayaitatsakalaṃ śrutam | satyasandho mahīpālaḥ kanyāmādāya nirgataḥ ||1.500.40|| punaściraṃ sa nāyātastatastasya sumantribhiḥ | abhiṣiktaḥ sutastasya suhayo nāma pārthivaḥ ||41 || tasyāhaṃ kramaśaḥ saptasaptatitamavaṃśajaḥ | puruṣo’smi samuddhartā dhanyohaṃ darśanāttava ||42|| gartātīrthe kuru tapaḥ putryā samaṃ pitāmaha | yena te caraṇau nityaṃ sevayiṣye sasevakaḥ ||43|| śreyaḥ prāpnomyasaṃndigdhaṃ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti | atha prajā brāhmaṇāśca narā nāryaśca rāṣṭrajāḥ ||44|| samāyayuḥ satyasandhaṃ draṣṭuṃ kutuhalānvitāḥ | āśīrvādān prayuñjānāḥ pupūjustaṃ mudānvitāḥ ||45|| atha rājā tathā kanyā nadīṃ prāpya taṭe tadā | kṛtvā parṇāśramaṃ tatra tepāte tapa uttamam ||46|| gaurīṃ tatra pratiṣṭhāpya karṇotpalā tu nityadā | bhaktyā tvārādhayāmāsa rājā ca śaṃkaraṃ tataḥ ||47|| sākṣāttuṣṭo mahādevaḥ prasannāsyaḥ samāyayau | rājānamāha tapasā vardhate puṇyamatyati ||48|| vada kiṃ te dadāmyatra rājā vavre pramokṣaṇam | śaṃbhuḥ prāha paraṃ mokṣaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||49|| pradāsyati prabhustvāṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇa tulasīsrajam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ||1.500.50|| mantraṃ gṛhāṇa cetyuktvā dadau mantraṃ ca mālikām | śaṃbhustiro’bhavad rājā bheje jajāpa mādhavam ||51 || atha rājā vṛhadbalo hyavāpa nidhanaṃ tadā | satyasandhena viprebhyo jīvikādyāḥ samarpitāḥ |||52||| evaṃ yāte dine gaurī santuṣṭā kanyakopari | sākṣāt provāca te putri tuṣṭāhaṃ vāñcchitaṃ vada ||5 3 || karṇotpalāha tāto me madarthaṃ kaṣṭamāptavān | mama patyurmārgaṇāya rājyād bhraṣṭaḥ kuṭumbataḥ ||54|| vairāgyeṇa tapastepe kanyāhaṃ vṛddhatāṃ gatā | tataste kṛpayā gauri yathāhaṃ taruṇī navā ||55|| rūpayauvanasampannā sundarī syāṃ tathā kuru | tathā bhavatu me bhartā kaścid devottamottamaḥ ||56|| rūpasampadyauvanādiyuktaściraṃprajīvanaḥ | yathāpiturme santoṣo bhavenmātastathā kuru ||57|| gaurī provāca māghasya śuklasya tṛtīyātithau | śanaiścaradine vasudaivatyarkṣe tu yauvanam ||58|| rūpaṃ saṃkalpya nadyāṃ ca snānaṃ kurvatra sundari | tato divyaśarīrā tvaṃ navayauvanaśālinī ||59|| bhaviṣyasi na sandeho bhaja kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||1.500.6 0|| japa mantraṃ sadā tvenaṃ dhyānaṃ kuru harestathā | sarvaṃ prāpsyasi tapasā bhaktyābhīṣṭaṃ kṣaṇaṃ kuru ||6 1 || evamuktvā kṛṣṇamantraṃ datvā ca tulasī srajam | tirobabhūva gaurī ca kanyā yathoktamācarat ||62|| tṛtīyāyāṃ śaneryoge vasudevarkṣasaṃyute | dhyātvā sārūpya saubhāgyayauvanāni navāni ca ||6 3 || viveśārdhaniśāyāṃ sā jale yāvattadaiva sā | navayauvanarūpāḍhyā niṣkrāntā salilāt tadā ||64|| tāvacchrībrahmaṇājñaptaḥ kāmadevaḥ svayaṃ khalu | patnyarthaṃ prītisaṃyuktaścājagāmābravīcca tām ||65 || brahmaṇā preṣitaścāhaṃ navayauvanarūpavān | pārvatyānumataścātra tvadarthaṃ tvāgato’smyaham ||66 || asmyahaṃ kāmadevo vai ciraṃjīvī ratīśvaraḥ | prītināmnī mama bhāryā śāśvatī bhava mā ciram ||67|| karṇotpalāha me tātaṃ gatvā prārthaya māṃ svayam | kanyā nāsti kadācidvai svacchandā pitṛsannidhau ||68|| tatrāhaṃ pūrvato gatvā kanyā tiṣṭhāmi sundarī | bhavānāgatya paścācca prārthayiṣyati māṃ mudā ||69|| ityuktvā taṃ praṇipatya kanyā svapitaraṃ yayau | atha tāṃ sa samālokya pitā sutāṃ suyauvanām ||1.500.70 || āścaryamāpa papraccha kāraṇaṃ rūpayovane | kanyā prāha pitargauryāḥ prasādāt snānamātrataḥ ||71 || nadyāṃ labdhavatīrūpaṃ yauvanaṃ ca navaṃ vapuḥ | hariṃ cārādhya kāntaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tathā ||72|| sarvamāptavatī devyā brahmaṇā ca madarthakaḥ | patiḥ surūpalāvaṇyatejoyauvanaśobhitaḥ ||73 || preṣitaḥ sundaraḥ puṣpabāṇadhṛk so’pi te’ntikam | samāyāti vilokyainaṃ samarpya māṃ sukhī bhava ||74|| ityuktaśca pitā putrīṃ vilokya kamalāsamām | abravīdadya me putri saṃjātaṃ tapasaḥ phalam ||75|| etasminnantare kāmo rājño’ntikamupāgamat | natvābravīt tava kanyāṃ dehi me bhūpa sundarīm ||76|| brahmaṇātra samādiṣṭaḥ pārvatyānumatastathā | varaṇārthaṃ svayaṃ samāgato’smi kāmadevakaḥ ||77|| tataḥ samarpayāmāsa tāṃ kanyāṃ vahnisannidhau | sā ca rateranusthānā prītināmābhavat priyā ||78|| tāṃ ca nītvā yayau kāmaḥ kāmalokaṃ surājasam | satyasandho’pi hṛṣṭātmā sutāṃ dṛṣṭvā sukhānvitām ||79|| abhīṣṭapatinā yuktā kṛtakṛtyo babhūva ha | dṛḍhaṃ padmāsanaṃ kṛtvā brahmadvāreṇa yogavit ||1.500.80 || dehānniḥsārayāmāsa cātmānaṃ brahmaṇā saha | yayau yatrāsti kanyā sā kāmaloke suputrikā ||8 1 || tasmāt kanyāṃ dvitīyāṃ tu tāṃ surūpādidhāriṇīm | nītvā datvā caikarūpāṃ kāmāya tvaparāṃ tanum ||82|| rājā muktaḥ sutāṃ muktāṃ sahanītvā ca pārṣadaiḥ | harermuktaiḥ saha dhāma golokaṃ prāpa śāśvatam ||83 || evaṃ karṇotpalā lakṣmi bhaktyā ca tapasā tathā | prītirūpā kāmapatnī muktā ca mokṣagābhavat ||84|| bṛhadbalasya rājñyā ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | ārādhitaśca putrārthaṃ viprarūpeṇa mādhavaḥ ||85 || samāgatya dadau garbhaṃ mānasaṃ ca kṣaṇāntare | jātismaro’bhavatputro nārāyaṇasamudbhavaḥ ||86|| viṃśativarṣakāyuṣko nārāyaṇasamo guṇaiḥ | dhanurvidyāvedavidyācamatkārādiśevadhiḥ |||87|| aṭacandro’bhavannāmnā camatkāranarādhipaḥ | ya etacchṛṇuyādvāpi śrāvayed bhaktibhāvataḥ ||88|| caturvargasya saṃsiddhiṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ | kanyā nārī ca saubhāgyaṃ labhate prītivat sadā ||89|| bhuktiṃ muktiṃ sampadaśca putraṃ dhānyaṃ dhanādikam | saubhāgyaṃ puṇyapuñjaṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||1.500.90|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satyasandhanṛpateḥ kanyāyāḥ karṇotpalāyāḥ kamalāṃśāyāḥ patimārgaṇārthaṃ brahmalokagamanaṃ tataḥ pṛthivīmāgatya kāmadevapatnītvaṃ prītināmnātha ca mokṣaṇaṃ dvitīyarūpeṇetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||500||
<1.501> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi yājñavalkyaṛṣeḥ kathāṃ manoharām | āsīd brāhmaṇaśārdūlaḥ śākalya iti viśrutaḥ || 1 || bhārgavānvayasaṃbhūto vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ | vardhamāne pure dharmāraṇye śiṣyapraśiṣyavān || 2 || sadā vidyādānadātā yogasiddhyādiśobhitaḥ | tasya śiṣyo’bhavadyājñavalkyaḥ sevāparāyaṇaḥ || 3 || śākalyaśca vardhamānanṛpatervai purohitaḥ | paurohityaṃ karotyeva sarveṣu nṛpakarmasu || 4 || prerayati cāśīrvādān dātuṃ prabhātake | yājñavalkyaṃ śreṣṭhaśiṣyaṃ yājñavalkyo’pi nityadā || 5 || yātyāśīrvādadānārthaṃ prātaḥ snātvā mudānvitaḥ | ekadā tu vinā snānaṃ malināmbarasaṃyutaḥ || 6 || yājñavalkyaḥ prabhāte vai vartate ca tadā guruḥ | yājñavalkyamuvācedaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ nṛpaṃ prati || 7 || evaṃ taṃ yojayāmāsa śāntyarthaṃ nṛpamandire | yājñavalkyo yayau śāntipāṭhaṃ kṛtvā japottaram || 8 || śāntyudakapradānāya taṃ nṛpaṃ prati saṃyayau | pārthivo’pi muniṃ vinā snānaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca śaṃkitaḥ || 9 || na jagrāha jalaṃ cāśīrvacanaṃ cāpi taddine | asatyaṃ ca prāha rājā nāhaṃ snāto dvijottama || 1.501.1 0|| muniṃ snānavihīnaṃ tu tathyaṃ pravaktumakṣamaḥ | atra śālāgate kāṣṭhe tasmādetajjalaṃ kṣipa || 11 || yājñavalkyo’pi vijñāya svasyāsnātasya kāraṇam | jñātvāpamānaṃ svasyaiva jalaṃ cikṣepa kāṣṭhake || 1 2|| tāvat kāṣṭhaṃ pallavitaṃ śākhāphalasamanvitam | tatkṣaṇādeva sañjātaṃ jalasparśaprabhāvataḥ || 13 || rājā camatkṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā paścāttāpaṃ vidhāya ca | satyaṃ prāha punarvākyaṃ mune snāto’smi kintu te || 14|| bhayāttavaiva mālinyaṃ dṛṣṭvā jagrāha naiva tat | tato’bhiṣekaṃ me vipra kuru syāṃ putravān yathā || 15|| yājñavalkyastadā prāha rājan śaṃkāparo bhavān | mamābhiṣekadānasya tvamanarho’si sāmpratam || 16|| guravastu sadā śuddhā bhavanti brāhmaṇā nṛpa | sādhavaśca na vā snātāḥ snātā vā śrīharestanuḥ ||17|| tatrāpi yadi vidvāṃsastatrāpyaiśvaryaśālinaḥ | siddhā vā brāhmaṇā devā devavāsāḥ pratāpinaḥ || 18|| nārīsaṃgakṛtāścāpi na snātā api pāvanāḥ | mantrasiddhibrahmasiddhitapaḥsiddhiparāstu ye || 1 9|| tatra śuddhirna draṣṭavyā gurau sādhau sure harau | pitari mātari patyau satyāṃ gavi kadācana ||1.501.20|| kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobhaḥ pāruṣyaṃ vāsanā ratiḥ | sarve divyāstatra bodhyāḥ samarthe nāsti dūṣaṇam ||21 || malinā pṛthivī pādaspṛṣṭā tasya hi pāvanī | rathyāmbu gaṃgayā miśraṃ gāṃgavatpāpanāśakam ||22|| viṣṇuprasādabhojī vai jīvanmukto guruḥ smṛtaḥ | nityaṃ tapasyānirataḥ śuciḥ śāntaśca śāstravit ||23|| sarveṣāmapi tīrthānāṃ pāvanastu gururbhavet | sarveṣāmapi vandyānāṃ pitā vandyo gururmataḥ ||24|| pituḥ śataguṇairmātā mātuḥ śataguṇaiḥ suraḥ | mantradastantradaścaiva surāṇāṃ ca caturguṇaḥ ||25|| guruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pāpapuñjanāśako mokṣasampradaḥ | nārāyaṇaśca bhagavān gurureva mato bhavet ||26|| pratyakṣa īśvaraścātra tārako bhavati prabhuḥ | uddeśe dīyate tasmai surāyeti śrutau śrutam ||27|| pratyakṣabhoktā svaguruḥ svayaṃ dehī janārdanaḥ | gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgurureva svayaṃ śivaḥ ||28|| gurau ca sarvadevādyāstiṣṭhanti satataṃ mudā | gurau tuṣṭe haristuṣṭo yasmim̐stuṣṭe ca devatāḥ ||29|| vahnivāyusamaḥ pūtastejasā bhāskaropamaḥ | viṣṇumantropāsakaśca gururvai vaiṣṇavo dvijaḥ ||1.501.30 || tejasvinaṃ guruṃ dṛṣṭvā gṛhṇīyāt sarvameva ha | mantraṃ jalaṃ prasādaṃ cāśīrvādaṃ hyaviśaṃkitaḥ ||3 1 || aikāntiko gururdevaḥ pusāṃ lakṣaṃ samuddharet | kriyāḥ śubhāśubhā yasya viṣṇupāde samarpitāḥ ||32|| mantragrahaṇamātreṇa jīvanmuktastato bhavet | bhittvā brahmāṇḍamakhilaṃ prāpayate hareḥ padam ||33|| rājam̐stvaṃ vañcitaścādya māyayā śaṃkito mayi | punarjalaṃ mayā naiva dīyate śaṃkitāya te ||34|| viśeṣataśca svārthāya lābhaṃ dṛṣṭvā prayācate | dātavyaṃ naiva ṛṣibhiḥ svārthine nāstikāya ca ||35|| tasmānne’bhiṣekadānapātraṃ nāsi punarnṛpa | ahaṃ yāsyāmi tatraiva yatrasthaḥ sa gururmama ||36|| rājā prāha yājñavalkyamabhiṣekaṃ dadāsi cet | tava dāsyāmi vastrāṇi vāhanāni vasūni ca ||37|| ṛṣiḥ prāha sa vai mantro homānte sphurate na me | tasmājjalaṃ punastādṛg balavannaiva jāyate ||38|| gacchāmyahaṃ gṛhaṃ rājan taveṣṭaṃ nādya saṃbhavet | ityuktvā svagṛhaṃ tūrṇaṃ jagāma munisattamaḥ ||39|| apare’hni prabhāte ca śākalyaḥ svayameva ha | āśīrvādān pradātuṃ ca yayau bhūpaṃ tadā nṛpaḥ ||1.501.40|| praṇipatya muniṃ prāha hyastvayā yaḥ prapreṣitaḥ | śiṣyo bhūyaḥ sa śāntyarthaṃ preṣaṇīyo mama gṛham ||41 || bāḍhamityeva samproktvā pūjāmādāya vai guruḥ | yājñavalkyaṃ samāhūya punaḥ provāca sādaram | |42|| adyāpi tvaṃ narendrasya śāntyarthaṃ bhavanaṃ vraja | viśeṣātpārthivendreṇa samāhūto’si putraka ||43 || yājñavalkyastadā prāha rājāsti nāstiko dvije | garvayukto’sti tasmāttvaṃ gamiṣyāmi na vai punaḥ ||44|| mayā tasyābhiṣekārthaṃ salilaṃ codyataṃ yadā | kṣipa kāṣṭhe salilaṃ tadityuktaṃ vai kubuddhinā ||45 || mayāpi drāk jalaṃ kṣiptaṃ kāṣṭhe kāṣṭhaṃ tato drutam | navapallavitaṃ jātaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā mumoha tat ||46 || śākalyaḥ prāha sāmarthyaṃ tavālokya sa bhūpatiḥ | āhvayati punastvāṃ taṃ gaccha mānapuraḥsaram ||47|| anuvṛttā nṛpā grāhyā nāvamānyāstadā kvacit | ārohanti śanairbhṛtyā dhunvantamapi pārthivam ||48|| samo māne’pamāne ca cittajñaḥ kālavit sadā | sarvaṃsahaḥ kṣamī vijño bhavedvai rājavallabhaḥ ||49|| mamājñāpi tvayā pālyā gaccha putra nṛpaṃ prati | yājñavalkyastadā prāha na yāmi nāstikaṃ prati ||1.501.50 || caturdhā dharmanāśo’tra vidyate śṛṇu sadguro | gantuṃ yasyādya śiṣyasya kramo vai vartate guro ||51 || tadbhaṃgaḥ prathamo doṣo dvitīyo’kramadūṣaṇam | na gamiṣye ca madvākyaṃ niṣedhātmakadūṣaṇam ||52|| tṛtīyaṃ jāyate me’tra nṛpecchābhaṃgadūṣaṇam | caturthaṃ phaladoṣātma tasmāt kāryaṃ na tanmayā |||53 || evaṃ yadi balānmāṃ tvaṃ yojayiṣyasi taṃ prati | tvāṃ tyaktvānyatra yāsyāmi gamiṣyāmi na taṃ prati ||54|| ityuktaḥ krodhamāpannaḥ śākalyaḥ samuvāca tam | ekamapyakṣaraṃ guroravagatya tataḥ param ||55|| dakṣiṇāṃ nāsti pṛthvyāṃ yāṃ datvā śiṣyo’nṛṇī bhavet | tasmātpālaya cājñāṃ me madvidyāṃ vā parityaja ||56|| no ced dadāmi śāpaṃ te gacchānyatra yathāsukham | ityukto yājñavalkyaḥ sa vidyāyā vamanaṃ tadā ||57|| kṛtvovāca guruṃ natvā paśya vidyāṃ pracharditām | ekamapyakṣaraṃ nāsti tāvakīyaṃ mamodare ||58|| tasmācchiṣyo’smi te nāhaṃ na ca me tvaṃ guruḥ sthitaḥ | sāmprataṃ svecchayānyatra prayāsyāmi namo’stu te ||59|| evamuktvā siddhidaṃ vai hāṭakeśvaranāmakam | kṣetraṃ samāyayau tatrārādhayāmāsa bhāskaram ||1.501.60|| niyato niyatāhāro brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ | gāyatrīnyāsamāsādya cacāra duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ ||6 1|| sūryastuṣṭo mānavaḥ san varṣānte tamuvāca ha | yājñavalkya vṛṇu sveṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ dāsyāmi te raviḥ ||62|| yājñavalkyaḥ praṇamyaiva vavre vidyāṃ ca vaidikīm | tathānyāṃ mantratantrīyāṃ brahmavidyāṃ tathā parām ||63|| sūryaḥ prāha laghimāṃ te siddhiṃ dadāmi vai tathā | laghurbhūtvā mamāśvānāṃ karṇānte viśa tiṣṭha ca ||64|| mattobhyāsaṃ ca vidyānāṃ vaidikīnāṃ kuru drutam | evamuktaḥ sa tenātha vājikarṇaṃ samāśritaḥ ||65|| vedānapaṭhatsūryāt sa janakāyābhyapāṭhayat | brahmavidyāṃ dattavām̐śca bhāryādvayāya vai ṛṣiḥ ||66|| maitreyī prathamā jyeṣṭhā kātyāyanī dvitīyakā | patnīdvayaṃ yājñavalkyasyāsīt kātyāyanaḥ sutaḥ ||67|| kātyāyanaṃ sarvavidyāḥ pāṭhayāmāsa cāntataḥ | ekadā śāṇḍilī kātyāyanīṃ bodhaṃ dadau śubham ||68|| nāganadyāstaṭe tena vairāgyaṃ samavāpa sā | na snāti na ca bhuṃkte vā hāsyaṃ na kurute satī ||69|| kevalaṃ bāṣpapūrṇākṣī niḥśvasantī babhūva ha | śāṇḍilī tāṃ pratidinaṃ hyapadeśaṃ dadāti ca ||1.501.70|| śṛṇu sādhvi mama tātaḥ śāṇḍilyo munipuṃgavaḥ| tasyaikāhaṃ samutpannā mādhavīnāmakanyakā ||71 || pituḥ karomi śuśrūṣāṃ homakāle yathocitām | nīvārādīni dhānyāni nityaṃ caivānayāmyaham ||72|| kadācittvatha kālasya nārado munirāgataḥ | āśrame mama tātasya śrānto mayā prasevitaḥ ||73|| snāpito bhojitaḥ saṃvāhito dehe’tibhāvataḥ | niviṣṭaścāsane mātrā saṃpṛṣṭo vinayāttadā ||74|| ekeyaṃ kanyakāsmākaṃ vārdhakye vartate mune | tadasyāḥ kīrtaya kṣipraṃ bhartāraṃ susukhodayam ||75|| vrataṃ vā niyamaṃ vā tvaṃ tapo homaṃ japaṃ ca vā | mantraṃ vā yena cīrṇena bhartā syāt saumyasadguṇī ||76 || snehilaśca prasannāsyaḥ priyavāk svapriyāpriyaḥ | śrutvā śrīnāradaḥ prāha gaurīpūjanamuttamam ||77|| hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre gatvā karotu te sutā | bhartāraṃ prāpsyati gauryā āśīrvādena te sutā ||78|| tatra pūrvaṃ gatā gaurī gaṃgerṣyayā śubhasthalam | tataḥ sā cintayāmāsa kāṃ devīṃ pūjayāmyaham ||79|| saubhāgyārthaṃ yato’nyā māṃ pūjayeyuḥ sadā striyaḥ | iti vicārya sā bhaktyā pupūjātmānameva ca ||1.501.80|| svīyamūrtiṃ mṛdā kṛtvā sthāne caikatra cāsane | ātmaprāṇāgnihotraiśca mantrairātharvaṇaistathā ||81 || pṛthvīṃ jalaṃ tathā tejo vāyumākāśamityamūn | mūrtau saṃyujya cātmānaṃ tāpasī sā yatavratā ||82|| gaurīṃ saṃpūjayāmāsa puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ | tanmantrākṛṣṭacitto vai śaṃkaraḥ satvaraṃ yayau ||83 || vad devi tava śaktyā gauryākṛṣṭo’hamāgataḥ | kathaṃ tvaṃ kuruṣe caitattava rūpasya pūjanam ||84|| ākarṣayati māṃ gaurī prasahya tava sannidhau | tasmādāgaccha kailāsaṃ brūhi doṣo’sti cenmayi ||85 || pārvatī prāha mūrdhnā tvaṃ dhatse gaṃgāṃ sapatnikām | tasmānnāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi yāvanna tyajasi priyām ||86 || śaṃbhuḥ prāha nṛpo bhāgīrathastaptvātidāruṇam | tapo māṃ prārthayāmāsa gaṃgāyā dhāraṇāya vai ||87|| ākāśājjāhnavīvegaṃ patantaṃ dharaṇītale | gamiṣyantaṃ ca pātālaṃ vijñāya māṃ nyayojayat ||88|| atraiva gaṃgāsthityarthaṃ tataścaivaṃ dhṛtā mayā | sā manmūrdhnā śanairhimālayaṃ labdhvā śubhālayam ||89|| bhārate pāvanārthaṃ vai dehināṃ yāsyati dhruvam | enāṃ jalasvarūpāṃ ca kṛtvā pitre dadāmi te ||1.501.90|| āgaccha me priye kānte saubhāgyaṃ sarvadāstu te | sāpatnyaṃ naiva boddhavyaṃ sā nāsti me vivāhitā ||91 || nāpi patnī na vā dāsī nānyā bhāryātmikāpi ca | āśritāsti satī tasmādāgaccha gṛhameva me ||92|| evamuktvā mahādevo vṛṣamāropyatāṃ śivām | svayamāruhya paścācca yayau kailāsaparvatam ||93|| tāṃ gaurīṃ tava putrīyaṃ samārādhayatu drutam | prītikaraṃ yatheṣṭaṃ ca tataḥ prāpsyati satpatim || 94|| ityuktvā nāradaḥ satyaṃ lokaṃ yayau tataḥ param | mayā kumāryā ca bhaktyā gaurī prapūjitā vrate || 95|| mārgaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ naivedyagandhalepanaiḥ | tatprabhāvādayaṃ prāpto jaiminirbrāhmaṇaḥ patiḥ ||96|| tasmāttvamapi kalyāṇi pūjayaināṃ samāhitā | saṃprāpsyasi susaubhāgyaṃ maitreyyā sadṛśaṃ śubhe ||97|| śrutvā kātyāyanī sarvaṃ śāṇḍilyā yatprakīrtitam | cakāra mārgatṛtīyāvrataṃ gaurīprapūjanam ||98|| tato’syāḥ patirāgatya gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe kare | niyāya svagṛhaṃ tāṃ vai bahumānapuraḥsaram ||99|| tataḥ paraṃ tayā sārdhaṃ vartate harṣitaḥ sadā | maitreyyā sadṛśo yadvat tato’pi ca viśeṣataḥ || 1.501.10 0|| kātyāyanī suputraṃ suṣuve kātyāyanaṃ param | kātyāyanasuto vararucirjāto guṇālayaḥ || 101 || kātyāyanasya sāmarthyaṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi vadāmi te | purā pṛthvyāḥ samudbhūtaṃ kiñcitprāṇimayaṃ caram || 102 || apūrvaṃ cāndhakamugraṃ kṛṣṇadantaṃ bhayānakam | śaṃkukarṇaṃ kṛśāsyaṃ ca ūrdhvakeśaṃ bubhukṣitam || 103 || nṛpeṇa balinā mantrairākṛṣṭaṃ balavanmahat | atha devān bhakṣituṃ tat pradudrāva punaḥ punaḥ || 1 04|| balinā samparityaktaṃ devaistat tāḍitaṃ muhuḥ | tathāpi na kṣatiṃ prāpa pātitaṃ dharaṇisthale || 1 05|| upaviṣṭāstatastasya devā bhūtvā samantataḥ | tasyodare gato brahmā śakrādyaḥ pārśvataḥ sthitāḥ || 1 06|| tāvacchukreṇa sandiṣṭā daityā hantuṃ surām̐stadā | āyayuḥ pakṣamādāya tāvadviṣṇuḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ || 1 07|| prāha bhūtaṃ śṛṇu bhūta tvadarthaṃ devadaityayoḥ | saṃgrāmo’tra bhavet tadvai naiṣa śobhana eva ha || 1 08|| devā daityāstvayi bhūte tiṣṭhantu mitravad yathā | tava pūjāṃ karomyevaṃ vāstunāmā bhavānmataḥ || 109| tatra te bhojanaṃ cārpayāmi gṛhāṇa bhāvataḥ | tatastena pratijñātamavikalpena cetasā ||1.501.1 1 0| uktaṃ ca yo na me pūjāṃ kariṣyati nave sthale | kathaṃcinmānavaḥ kaścid bhakṣyaḥ sa me bhaviṣyati || 111 | bāḍhamityevamukte ca viśvakarmākarod vidhim | kātyāyano gṛhaṃ cakre vāstuṃ cāpūjayattadā || 1 12|| vāstupūjāṃ ca sakalāṃ kātyāyanaścakāra ha | hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre tataḥ pūjā pravartitā || 11 3|| tathā na prāpnuyād doṣaṃ gṛhajātaṃ kathaṃcana | śilotthaṃ kupadotthaṃ ca kuvāstujamathāpi vā || 1 14|| vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ vāstoḥ pūjābhavatpurā | tadā pūjāprakartuśca gṛhaṃ rājyasamaṃ bhavet || 115|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi tvākhyānaṃ cottamottamam | bhuktimuktisusaubhāgyapatiputrādidāyakam || 116 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṇḍilyaśiṣyasya yājñavalkyasya śuṣkakāṣṭhepallavīkaraṇatā vidyāpracchardanaṃ yājñavalkyasya tatputrakātyāyanasya ca camatkārāḥ, vāstupuruṣārcanādi cetinirūpaṇanāmaikādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 501 ||
<1.502> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi purā cāsīd hārītanāmako muniḥ | vānaprasthāśramī tasya bhāryā pūrṇakalābhidhā || 1 || sādhvī pativratā rūpaudāryayauvanaśobhitā | lakṣmīsamāṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vai kāmadevo mumoha ca || 2 || snāntīṃ vivastrāṃ saṃpaśyan tyaktvā prītiṃ ratiṃ striyau | vijanaṃ tatsthalaṃ matvā prasuptaḥ sa taṭe kṣaṇam || 3 || kautukaṃ pracakārāsau niḥśvāsān niḥśvasan muhuḥ | tiṣṭhan sandarśane tasyā rugṇo dīno yathā janaḥ || 4 || sāpi tathāvidhaṃ kaṃcidanāthaṃ bhikṣukaṃ śubham | matvā pārśvaṃ yayau kiṃcid phalaṃ dātuṃ prabhojanam || 5 || tāvat kāmo yauvanastho vahnivacca prabhāsuraḥ | kāmaprabhṛtanayanaḥ sarvāṃgasundaro dṛḍhaḥ || 6 || abhavat kṣaṇamātreṇa sānurāgaśca bhāvukaḥ | pūrṇakalā tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā sānurāgaṃ tu nirjane || 7 || jambhābhagakṛtāyāsavepamānaśarīrakam | drutaṃ tadbāṇanirbhinnā sābhilāṣā babhūva ha || 8 || pārśve sā niṣasādāsya spṛṣṭvā vihasya vai muhuḥ | hanyamānā viśeṣeṇa kāmabāṇaiḥ pativratā || 9 || bhūmiṃ lilekha cāṃgulyā paśyantī tanmukhāmbujam | sāyaṃ samayaḥ sañjāto hārītastāmanāgatām || 1.502.10 || jñātvānveṣṭuṃ ciraṃ tatrāyayau yatra tu sā satī | tiṣṭhatyeva na saṃbhogaṃ labdhavatī ca tāvatā || 11 || hārītastāṃ satīṃ pativratāṃ dṛṣṭvā tu mohitām | tāṃ vimohāṃ kārayantaṃ jalpantaṃ ca rajomayam || 1 2|| kāmasya hṛdgataṃ bhāvaṃ jñātvā kopāt samabravīt | yasmāt pāpa tvayā patnī mamaivaṃ śarapīḍitā || 13 || anabhijñā tathā sādhvī svāmidharmaparāyaṇā | pratāryate surūpaḥ san bhoktumicchati me priyām || 14|| kuṣṭhavyādhisamāyuktastasmād vipriyadarśanaḥ | svakairdāraistathā mukto bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 15 || ityuktaḥ saḥ praṇipatyovāca hārītamuttaram | mayā bhāryā tava dṛṣṭā mohamātreṇa vai mune || 16 || na ca bhuktā tathā naiva kuceṣṭāpi kṛtādhunā | tasmānnāhaṃ śāpapātraṃ kṣamāṃ kuru kṛpānidhe || 17|| pāpaṃ tredhā mānasaṃ vācikaṃ karmajamityapi | manastāpād vrajetpāpaṃ mānasaṃ tadgataṃ mama || 18|| vācikaṃ tu japenaiva yadvā stavanamātrataḥ | tasya prasādanenaiva naśyati yatra tatkṛtam || 19 || prāyaścittairyathoktaiśca karmajaṃ pātakaṃ vrajet | karmajaṃ na kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ mānasaṃ vācikaṃ ca yat ||1.502.20|| bhavatprasādato naśyet prasanno bhava sarvathā | hārītaḥ prāha taṃ kāmaṃ dehaprābalyayogataḥ ||2 1 || prathamaṃ manasā sarvaṃ cintyate tadanantaram | tataḥ prajalpate vācā kriyate karmaṇā punaḥ ||22|| prathamaṃ hi manastasmāt sarvakṛtyeṣu doṣavat | tasmātte nigrahaścātra mānaso’pi kṛto mayā ||23|| raverārādhanenaiva kuṣṭhaste vigamiṣyati | iyaṃ bhāryā mama patnī bhūtvā khaṇḍaśilā kṣaṇam ||24|| sūryārādhanapuṇyena satī patnī bhaviṣyati | ityuktvā ca yayau svasyāśramaṃ hārītako muniḥ ||25|| pūrṇakalā śilā jātā kāmaḥ kuṣṭhī tato’bhavat | nāganadyāstaṭe sūryaṃ dhyātvārādhanamācarat ||26 || māsānte ravirāgatya kāmakuṣṭhaṃ hyanāśayat | śilāṃ spṛṣṭvā satīṃ patnīṃ kṛtvā pūrvaṃ yathāsthitām ||27|| dadau nārāyaṇamantraṃ yayau sūryo divaṃ prati | kāmaḥ kāmasya bhavanaṃ satī hārītakagṛham ||28|| yayau patiṃ namaskṛtya vastutaḥ pāvanī tadā | siṣeve bhāvataḥ sādhvī bheje nārāyaṇaṃ harim ||29|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ | jajāpa nityadā mantraṃ babhūva divyavaiṣṇavī ||1.502.3 0|| atha tasyāḥ sannidhau vai dīrghikānāmakanyakā | samāgacchati nityaṃ vai sevanārthaṃ gṛhāntarāt ||3 1 || parṇaśālā ca sānnidhye vartate itibhāvataḥ | nityaṃ pūrṇakalāpārśve tiṣṭhati catvare drume ||32|| vedikāyāṃ ca śālāyāṃ japati śrīharermanum | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||3 3|| evaṃ jāpaprabhāveṇa divyadehā hi kanyakā | vabhūva vyomacārā ca nirāvaraṇasiddhikā ||34|| vīraśāntasya ca ṛṣeḥ putrī sā dīrghikā hyabhūt | atidīrghā pramāṇena janahāsyavivardhinī ||35 || na kaścid varayāmāsa dṛṣṭvātidīrghikāṃ tu tām | atisaṃkṣiptakeśīṃ ca hyatidīrghāṃ ca vāmanām ||36 || udvāhayati yaḥ saḥ ṣaṇmāsāntare mṛtiṃ vrajet | itikāraṇamālambya na gṛhṇāti janaśca tām ||37|| tato vairāgyamāpannā tapastepe sudāruṇam | cāndrāyaṇāni kṛcchrāṇi tathā cīrṇānyanekaśaḥ ||38|| pārākāṇi yathoktāni tathā sāntapanāni ca | evaṃ tasyā vratasthāyāstejo vṛddhiṃ gataṃ bahu ||3 9|| ākāśagāminī śaktirudbhūtā tapaso balāt | tato mahendrasadasi yāti samutsavādiṣu ||1.502.40|| yadā devasabhātaḥ sā prayāti svagṛhaṃ tadā | tadāsanābhyukṣaṇaṃ ca kurvantīndrasya kiṃkarāḥ ||41 || tathā dṛṣṭvābhyukṣaṇaṃ ca papraccha sā purandaram | kaṃ doṣa vīkṣya me śakra prokṣyate tvāsanaṃ mama ||42|| indraḥ prāha sute te’sti śārīro doṣa eva ha | tvaṃ kumāryapi saṃprāptā ṛtukālaṃ vigarhitam ||43 || avivāhaśca te’dyāpi tvaśuddhiṃ sā tvayi sthitā | ṛtukāle patiyogaḥ śuddhikaro hi yoṣitām ||44|| tat tvaṃ varaya bhartāraṃ yena yāsyasi medhyatām | tacchrutvā pṛthivīṃ gatvā catvareṣu trikeṣu ca ||45|| uddhṛtya dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ vakti varārthameva yat | yadi kaścid dvijo jātyaḥ pāṇigrahaṃ karotu me ||46|| mama tapasaścārdhaṃ tu tasmai dadāmi sāmpratam | jalpantī tāṃ janā hāsyaṃ cakrurnarma parasparam ||47|| ekaḥ kaścit kuṣṭharogī brāhmaṇaḥ prāha dīrghikām | ahaṃ tvāmudvahiṣyāmi kṛtvā pāṇigrahaṃ tava ||48|| tatastasyāḥ kumāryāḥ sa pāṇiṃ jagrāha sāpyatha | patiṃ prāha vada me kāṃ sevāṃ karomi te pate ||49|| patiḥ prāhāṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrtheṣu gantuṃ mayeṣyate | sahāyena tvadīyena yadi śaknoṣi tatkuru ||1.502.5 0|| aho bhāgyamiti matvā tatastūrṇaṃ pativratā | kārayāmāsa sulabhaṃ vaṃśakuṭīrakaṃ śubham ||5 1 || mṛdutūlāsanayuktaṃ tataḥ prāha nijaṃ patim | mama devāroha maṃjuṣāsaneṃsagamūrdhani ||52|| nayāmi sarvatīrtheṣu kṣetreṣu ca śubheṣu ca | tataḥ kuṣṭhī prahṛṣṭaśca niṣasāda kuṭīrake ||53|| sā tat svamastake kṛtvā sarvatīrthe yathāsukham | sarvakṣetreṣu babhrāma snāpayantī nijaṃ patim ||54|| tīrthe snānāt satīyogāt patyuḥ kuṣṭho nivartate | nityaṃ kuṣṭhasya saṃhrāso dṛśyate tejasādhikaḥ ||55|| evaṃ sā hāṭakeśasya kṣetraṃ prāptā niśāmukhe | nāgavatyāstaṭe vṛkṣacchāyāmāśritya peṭikām ||56|| sthāpayitvā viśaśrāma patistasyā nadītaṭam | prātarutthāya ca śanaiḥ snātuṃ māṇḍukyasaṃjñakaḥ ||57|| yaṣṭyā yāti sṛtau patrasamudāyaṃ vilaṃghya ca | tāvat patreṣu ṛṣirāṭ māṇḍavyo nidrito’bhavat ||58|| māṇḍukyena padā yaṣṭyā spṛṣṭaḥ patrāntarasthitaḥ | ajānatā gatermārge māṇḍavyo jāgṛto’bhavat ||5 9 || prāha ko’yaṃ mahāmūḍhaḥ padā yaṣṭyā ca māmiha | tāḍayati mama nidrābhaṃgaṃ karoti pāpavān ||1.502.60|| sūryodayāt prāgeva te mṛtirbhavatu vai dhruvā | māṇḍukyastaṃ tathā śrutvā nanāma vai muhurmuhuḥ ||61|| tathāpi toṣamevāyaṃ nāpanno māṇḍavīsutaḥ | māṇḍukyastvaritaḥ snātvā cāgatya vṛkṣasannidhau ||62|| patnīṃ prāha yathāvṛttaṃ kuru sevāṃ tathāntimām | māṇḍavyaśāpataścāhaṃ mariṣye prāk raverdṛśeḥ ||63|| dīrghikā ca tadā prāha pātivratyaṃ tu me yadi | tīrthayātrā ca vidhinā patisevā ca bhāvataḥ ||64|| sarvaṃ satyavrataṃ cenme sūryodayo’tra mā bhavet | ityukto bhāskarāśvānāṃ staṃbhanaṃ vyomamaṇḍale ||65|| babhūva sahasā tena nābhyudeti prabhākaraḥ | rātrikālo mahāñjātaḥ sarve sūryodayaṃ vinā ||66|| babhūvuścātiduḥkhasthā ruddhā yajñādikāḥ kriyāḥ | śrāddhādhyayanadānāni dharmakṛtyāni yāni ca ||67|| sūryādhārāṇi sarvāṇi ruddhāni ca viśeṣataḥ | devāḥ svargaparāḥ sarve yajñabhāgavivarjitāḥ ||68|| jātāśca duḥkhitāḥ sarve yayuryatra divākaraḥ | prāhurdeva kathaṃ naiva karoṣyudayanaṃ prabho ||69|| etat tvayā vinā sarvaṃ jagad vyākulatāṃ gatam | sūryaḥ prāha bhayāt pativratāyā nodayo mama ||1.502.70|| tasmād gatvā surāḥ sarve tāṃ vadantu kṛte mama | yena tadvākyamāsādya gamiṣyāmyudayaṃ sukham ||71 || anyathā māṃ śapet kruddhā nūnaṃ sā hi pativratā | pātivratyena tapasā vartate sā sureśvarī ||72|| kastasyā vacanaṃ śaktaḥ kartuṃ caivamato’nyathā | etasmātkāraṇād bhīto nodgacchāmi kathaṃcana ||73|| pativratātvamāpannā nārī vidanti tatphalam | aśvamedhasahasreṇa yatphalaṃ jāyate hi tat ||74|| ityuttamatapoyogādbibhemi satyayoṣitaḥ | tato devā drutaṃ yāntu yatrāsti sā pativratā ||75||| atha devāḥ samāyātā dīrghikāṃ jagaduśca te | tvayā pativrate sūryo yanniṣiddho divākaraḥ ||76|| śubhaṃ tanna kṛtaṃ bhadre kriyā naṣṭā raviśritāḥ | tasmādudgacchatu prājñe tava vākyād divākaraḥ ||77|| yajñakriyā japo homaḥ pravartante yataḥ śubhe | dīrghikā ca tadā prāha māṇḍavyena ca roṣataḥ ||78|| me patiḥ śapta evāsti ravyudaye mṛto bhavet | tato mayā niruddho’sti sūryo hyudayanaṃ prati ||79|| vinā kāntaṃ na me sūryodayenāsti prayojanam | śrāddhadānādikaiḥ kṛtyairanyairvā na prayojanam ||1.502.80|| atha te vibudhāḥ prāhurvicārya vinayānvitāḥ | udgacchatu ravirbhadre tavāyaṃ dayitaḥ patiḥ ||81 || kāyākalpaṃ samāsādya punarjīvatu tatkṣaṇam | pañcaviṃśativarṣīyaṃ kāmadevamivāparam ||82|| tvaṃ ca drakṣyasi saṃbhūtvā kanyā pañcadaśābdikī | evaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sukhaṃ loke svecchayā sādhayiṣyasi ||83 || sūryodaye tava patyuḥ śarīraṃ nidhanaṃ gatam | punaḥ sañjīvayiṣyāmo dehi sūryodayaṃ hi naḥ ||84|| ityuktā bāḍhamityaṃgīkṛtyovāca satī punaḥ | yathā devāḥ pravadanti dampatyorvai navaṃ vayaḥ ||85|| kariṣyantyāvayostena satyenodaya bhāskara | ityuktamātre prāk kāṣṭhā prabhātā cābhavad drutam ||86|| aruṇasya praveśaścādṛśyatāruṇaparvate | tāvat sūryodayo jātaḥ saṃmṛto dīrghikāpatiḥ ||87|| vibudhānāṃ karaiḥ spṛṣṭaḥ punareva samutthitaḥ | pañcaviṃśativarṣīyaḥ kāmarūpo’tisundaraḥ ||88|| dīrghikāpyabhavatpañcadaśavarṣātisundarī | divyā devīsamā devasparśena kamalāsamā ||89|| devāstāṃ sādaraṃ procuḥ sakāntāṃ vai pativratām | varaṃ vṛṇu sati sādhvi nādeyaṃ vidyate tava ||1.502.90|| sā covāca nadītīrthaṃ dīrghiketi jagattraye | adyaprabhṛti loke vai khyātaṃ me nāmato bhavet ||91 || ante dhāma harermokṣasthala labheyamācyutam | saha bhartreti tāṃ prāhustathāstviti surā yayuḥ ||52|| tataḥ sā bahukālaṃ vai sukhaṃ prāpya pativratā | uttare vayasi prāpte kāntaṃ vīkṣya mṛtaṃ satī ||93|| saha tena jagāmeyaṃ brahmalokaṃ pativratā | evaṃ te lakṣmi cākhyātaṃ dīrghikāvratamuttamam ||94|| paṭhanācchravaṇāttathāvartanāt sevanādapi | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhennārī naro’pi nātra saṃśayaḥ ||95|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne hārītapatnyāṃ pūrṇakalāyāṃ mohitakāmadevasya kuṣṭhitvaṃ pūrṇakalāyāḥ śilātvaṃ punaruddhāraḥ, dīrghikāyāḥ patisevāpuṇyena sūryastambhanaṃ patisahitāyāstasyā navayauvanaṃ mokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 502 ||
<1.503> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ munerjābālermokṣakāriṇīm | jabālāyāḥ ṛṣidāsyāḥ putro jābālisaṃjñakaḥ || 1 || brāhmaṇasya tu bījena samutpanno babhūva ha | kaumārabrahmacaryeṇa yena cīrṇaṃ tapaḥ sadā || 2 || kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādīni pārākāṇi śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | kurvatānena vai devā saṃnītā bhayagocaram || 3 || tato devā hi militāścakrurvighnasya mantraṇām | raṃbhāṃ sapreṣayāmāsurbrahmacaryavighātinīm || 4 || brahmacaryaṃ tapomūlaṃ siddhisampādakaṃ mahat | ābālād brahmacārī ca jābālistejasā mahān || 5 || kāmadharmaṃ na jānāti nārīsaṃgamavarjitaḥ | tasya kṣobhāya ca devaṃ vasanta sāyudhaṃ tathā || 6 || kāmaṃ ratiṃ tathā prītiṃ preṣayāmāsurīśvarāḥ | indrājñayā gatāḥ sarve hāṭakeśvarabhūtalam || 7 || jābāleḥ parṇaśālāyāḥ sannidhau kusumākaraḥ | cakre’kasmādaśokasya suśobhāṃ puṣpasañcayaiḥ || 8 || tilakānāṃ ca cūtānāṃ śobhāṃ mañjarikādibhiḥ | sarojāni samantācca vikāsaṃ prāpuruttamam || 9 || vavau ca surabhirvāyurdākṣiṇātyaḥ smarapradaḥ | tatrāntare tasya muneḥ raṃbhā sāmīpyamāgatā || 1.503.10|| muniḥ paśyati yāvat tāṃ sāpi vastraṃ vihāya ca | samīpavartisalile saṃsnātuṃ praviveśa ha || 11 || vivastrāṃ tāṃ samālokya kāmasya vaśago’bhavat | pulakāṃcitasarvāṃgaḥ kṣubhitaścābhavat tataḥ ||1 2|| rambhā jalād vinirgatya vastramāvṛtya cārdhakam | ārdrarūpā muneḥ pārśve gatā nanāma sasmitā || 1 3|| provāca madhuraṃ brahmannāśrame kuśalaṃ kimu | muniḥ prāha sadā me’sti kuśalaṃ ca tavāgamāt || 14|| kā tvaṃ devī mānuṣī vā mama manmathavardhinī | rambhā prāha kathaṃ gātre svedaste vikṛtistathā || 15|| muniḥ prāha tavālokāt svedo me manmathodbhavaḥ | brahmacaryaparasyāpi mahāvrate’pi vartinaḥ || 16|| rambhā prāha ca yadyeva māṃ bhajasva yathāsukham | nātra kaścid bhaved doṣo bhajamānāsmi yat svayam || 17|| apsaro’haṃ svargapatnī tava bhaktāṃ bhajasva mām | yo nārīṃ kāmasantaptāṃ svayaṃ prāptāṃ parityajet || 18|| nārīniḥśvāsadagdhaḥ sa sarvathā hīyate janaḥ | evamuktvā tayā so’pi pariṣvakto mahāmuniḥ || 1 9|| evaṃ tayā samaṃ reme sthito yāvaddinakṣayam | tato niṣkāmatāṃ prāpto visasarja ca tāṃ tataḥ || 1.503.20|| sā ca gatvā surānprāha kṣobhito vai mahāmuniḥ | tapastasya hataṃ sarvamindra tvaṃ sukhabhāg bhava || 21 || atha dadhre munergarbhaṃ suṣuve sā ca bālikām | muniryatra punaścakre tapastatra yayau ca sā ||22|| nītvā sarojapatrākṣīṃ kanyāṃ candraśubhānanām| gatvāśrame ṛṣeragre mumocedaṃ ca sābravīt ||23|| tava vīryasamutpannāṃ mama garbhe praropitām | kanyakāṃ te sutāṃ divyāṃ paripālaya te namaḥ ||24|| na svarge vidyate vāso mānuṣāṇāṃ kathaṃcana | etasmāt kāraṇāt tubhyaṃ datvā yāmi divaṃ punaḥ ||25|| evamuktvā yayau raṃbhā jābāliḥ snehapūritaḥ | kanyāṃ tāṃ pālayāmāsa rasairmiṣṭaphalodbhavaiḥ ||26|| vardhate sma mṛgaiḥ sārdhaṃ krīḍati sma ca pakṣibhiḥ | tasyarṣeḥ sarvakāryeṣu sāhāyyaṃ sma karoti ca ||27|| samitkuśādi ca vanādānayāmāsa nityadā | ekadā svāśramād dūraṃ phalārthaṃ sā jagāma ca ||28|| tadā vyomnā vimānasthaścitrāṃgadābhidho divaḥ | gāndharvo niryayau dṛṣṭvāvatīrya tāṃ jagāda ca ||29|| kā tvaṃ caikākinī bāle vane bhramasi kanyake | kanyā prāha ca jābāle kanyā phalavatī hyaham ||1.503.30|| phalapuṣpārthamāyātā samīpe me pitāsti ca | citrāṃgadastadovāca pitā te bhāryayā vinā ||3 1 || kumārabrahmacārī tvāṃ janayāmāsa vai katham | kanyovāca mama mātā rambhānāmnyapsarovarā ||32||| muniṃ saṃsevya taddvārā putrīṃ prāpa tataḥ pitā | jābālirme janako’sti poṣitā tena sadrasaiḥ |||33|| citrāṃgadastataḥ prāha varārohe bhajasva mām | ahaṃ citrāṃgado nāma gandharvastridivaukasām ||34|| kanyā prāha kumāryasmi tathā ca vaśagā pituḥ | tasmātprārthaya me tātaṃ sa māṃ tubhyaṃ pradāsyati ||35|| mamāpi rocate citte bhavān yuvā surūpavān | citrāṃgadaḥ prāha śaknomyarthayituṃ na vai tathā ||36|| ko jānāti hi taccittaṃ kīdṛgrūpaṃ bhaviṣyati | kanyā prāha ca yadyevaṃ vinājñā kiṃ karomyaham ||37|| jānīyāccet pitā me tvāṃ māṃ cāpi sampradhakṣyati | iti pravadamānāṃ tāmadhīraścitrakāṃgadaḥ ||38|| jagrāha cāṃke prabalo reme tayā vanadrume | sāpi kāmena saṃvyāptā ramayāmāsa taṃ muhuḥ || 39 || divyabhāvaṃ parityajya kāmabhāvamupāśritā | divaso nirgataḥ sāyaṃ gataṃ tad bubudhe na sā ||1.503.40|| jābāliratha taccintāmagno duḥkhasamanvitaḥ | anāyātāṃ sutāṃ vipadgatāṃ jñātvā niśāmukhe ||41 || paribabhrāma sarvatrānveṣayituṃ vane vane | aho vyāghrairbhakṣitā kiṃ vṛkṣāt sampatitā kimu ||42|| agādhajalamagnā vā nītā vānyena vai balāt | ityevaṃ ca parivadan babhrāma śokakarṣitaḥ ||43 || kaṃcicchabdaṃ samākarṇya matvā bālāṃ prayāti tam | atha vṛkṣatale śabdaṃ śuśrāva kanyakākṛtam ||44|| śīghraṃ tatra samāyāto dadarśa sanarāṃ sutām | krodhāviṣṭo gṛhītvā ca kāṣṭhaṃ dudrāva taṃ naram ||45|| dhikdhik pāpa vane putryāḥ kaumāryaṃ dūṣitaṃ tvayā | tvayā putri lāñcchanaṃ ca dattaṃ loke mamopari ||46|| tasmādenaṃ tathā tvāṃ ca nāśayāmīti saṃvadan | prahāraṃ yāvat kṣipati tāvat citrāṃgado’mbare ||47|| adṛśyo’bhūcca sā kanyā vivastrā śaktivarjitā | piturbhayācca tatraiva niṣasāda prakampitā ||48|| muniḥ kāṣṭhaprahāreṇa santāḍya patitāṃ kṣitau | mṛtāṃ matvā ca visṛjya yāvat paśyati cāmbare ||49|| tāvaccitrāṃgado dṛṣṭo vimānena divaṃ vrajan | śapto muninā drāk saḥ kuṣṭhī bhava patātra ca ||1.503.50|| gāndharvastu papātorvyāṃ kuṣṭhī jātaḥ kṣaṇāttadā | prāha kuru kṣamāṃ mahyaṃ putryai dayāyuto bhava ||51 || bhūtaṃ tad bhūtamevātra svalpaḥ kopo hi sādhuṣu | jābālistaṃ tadā prāha daṇḍapātraṃ vicārya vai ||52|| yathā putrī tathā tvaṃ ca vastrahīnaḥ sadā bhava | ubhau tvatra sadā nagnau tiṣṭhata vai vanadrume ||53|| yadyanyatrāgamiṣyataṃ śiraḥsphoṭo hi vāṃ bhavet | evaṃ śāpaṃ tu tau prāptau kṣetre śrīhāṭakeśvare ||54|| tatraiva tau tathā ruddhvā munirnijāśramaṃ yayau | caitramāse śuklapakṣe niśārdhe bhagavān haraḥ ||55|| yoginībhistatra rantuṃ daivāt samāyayau vane | tatra tadā hyubhābhyāṃ ca nagnābhyāṃ gāyanaṃ tathā ||56|| nartanaṃ ca kṛtaṃ śaṃbhoḥ prasādārthaṃ muhurmudā | śaṃbhustuṣṭaścakārainaṃ gandharvaṃ nirujaṃ tadā ||57|| vyomagāmitvasāmarthyaṃ gaṇatvaṃ ca dadau haraḥ | kanyāṃ tāṃ yoginītvaṃ ca vyomagāmitvamādadau ||58|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ | iti mantraṃ dadau tābhyāṃ dadau tulasīmālikām ||59|| bhaktau tau vaiṣṇavau jātau hāṭakeśvaratīrthake | citrāṃgadena saṃśapto jābāliśca nirambaraḥ ||1.503.60|| janahāsyāspado nityaṃ yathāhaṃ tvaṃ tathā bhava | itiśāpena saṃdagdho garhayāmāsa yoṣitam ||61 || aho pāpātmanāṃ puṃsāṃ yoṣitsaṃgo hi jāyate | sakṛd yoṣitprasaṃgena mama duḥkhaṃ hi kīdṛśam ||62|| ājanmamaraṇaṃ yāvatpāpaṃ prāptaṃ vivastrakam | tarhi strīṣu prasaktānāṃ kā gatirityacintayat ||63|| evaṃ tasya bruvāṇasya putrī prāha ca yoginī | etaccarācaraṃ viśvaṃ strībhiḥ sandhāryate śubham ||64|| kathaṃ tāṃ nindasi pitarnindako duḥkhamavāpnuyāt | pitā prāha striyaḥ śaśvat sarvāvasthāsu duḥkhadāḥ ||65|| iha loke paratrāpi tābhyaḥ saukhyaṃ na labhyate | putrī prāha pitaste vai buddhirnāsti damo na ca ||66|| kimantyajo’pi tatkarma kurute yat tvayā kṛtam | ahaṃ kāṣṭhaprahāreṇa tvayā prahāritā muhuḥ ||67|| strīhatyodbhavapāpasya cintā nābhūcca te hṛdi | viśeṣeṇa sutāyāśca kā te gatirbhaviṣyati ||68|| śapkāhaṃ sarvadā nagnabhāve tvatpātakaṃ ca te | nityaṃ navanavotthaṃ manniśvāsajaṃ mahattaram ||69|| kalpānte’pi ca te tasya naivāntaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati | tasmād bhuṃkṣva tathaiva tvaṃ gandharvaśāpataḥ pitaḥ ||1.503.70|| na bhūyo nindasi prāyo na ca saṃtāḍayiṣyasi | anindyā yoṣitaḥ sarvā naitā dūḥṣyanti karhicit ||71 || māsi māsi rajo hyāsāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ parikarṣati | pitā prāha striyaḥ pāpā naitāḥ śuddhyanti karhicit ||72|| sutā prāha na caivaṃ vai vedoktaṃ śṛṇu śāsanam | brāhmaṇāḥ pādato medhyā gāvo medhyāstu pucchataḥ ||73|| ajāśca mukhato medhyāḥ striyo medhyāśca sarvataḥ | pitā prāha tadā śāstraṃ parityajya ca kalpitam ||74|| brāhmaṇāḥ sarvato medhyā gāvo medhyāśca sarvataḥ | ājāścāpi kvacinmedhyā na medhyāśca striyaḥ kvacit| ||75|| putryuvāca gṛhe cintāmaṇiḥ kalpadrumo gṛhe | kuberaḥ kiṃkarastasya yasyāsti kāminīgṛhe ||76 || pitovācāpadastasya duḥkhaṃ tasyākhilaṃ gṛhe | narako’styatra vai tasya yasyāsti kāminī gṛhe ||77|| putryuvācātra saukhyāni bhogasthānāni yāni ca | dharmārthakāmajātāni tāni strībhyo bhavanti hi ||78|| pitovācātra duḥkhāni yāni pāpāni dehinām | yāna kaṣṭāni gaṇyante strībhyastāni bhavanti hi ||79|| putryuvāca vivāhena dharmārthakāmamokṣakān | vahnipradakṣiṇābhiśca nārī jñāpayati dhruvān ||1.503.80|| pitovāca vivāhena janmajanmāntarāṇi ca | saṃsārabhramaṇānyeva nārī jñāpayati bhramaiḥ ||8 1 || putryuvāca satīṃ patnīṃ prāpya sarvārthasādhikām | ke nāma naiva rajyante dehino jñānino’pi ca |||82|| pitovāca na rajyante virāgāścātmani sthitāḥ | mūḍhāstāsu nipatanti jvālāyāṃ śalabhā iva ||83|| putryuvāca stanau śroṇyau jaghanaṃ mukhamaṇḍalam | sevyante puṇyavadbhiśca tadanye bhāgyavañcitāḥ ||84|| pitovāca vināśasyonmukhā lekhā lalāṭajā | yasyāsti tena sevyante tānyanye puṇyaśālinaḥ ||85|| putryuvāca striyāḥ sparśo darśanaṃ racanādayaḥ | pariṣvaṃgaśca sukhadāḥ sarvathā śramanāśakāḥ ||86 || pitovāca striyāḥ sparśādayo miṣṭaviṣātmakāḥ | saṃgādyā duḥkhadāḥ sṛṣṭau sādhvāśramavināśakāḥ ||87|| putryuvāca striyā duṣṭaḥ sukhī sukṛtī ko na vai | spṛhaṇīyatamaḥ ko na strījano yasya vallabhaḥ ||88|| pitovāca striyā dṛṣṭo duḥkhabhāk pāpavānna kaḥ | tiraskāryo bhavetko na strījano yasya vallabhaḥ ||89|| putryuvācāpi kīṭasya rocate strīsamāgamaḥ | manuṣyasya ca devādeḥ kiṃ punarjñānino’pi ca ||1.503.90|| pitovācātipāpasyāmedhyasya rocate kṛmeḥ | amedhyaṃ strīśarīraṃ kāmino nānyasya vai sataḥ ||91 || putryuvāca svayaṃ brahmā pāśaṃ nārīsvarūpakam | kathaṃ vai janayāmāsa brahmā bhunakti yaṃ svayam ||92|| tvayā raṃbhā kathaṃ bhuktā pālitāhaṃ sutā katham | anyalagnā kathaṃ śaptā yadi mūlyaṃ na gaṇyate ||93 || tvaṃ ca mātrā kathaṃ labdho jabālayā hi sevayā | ṛṣīṇāmāśrameṣveva paśya mūlyaṃ striyāstadā ||94|| kasya putro’si pṛṣṭastvaṃ yājñavalkyena pāṭhane | mātaraṃ pṛṣṭhavān tvaṃ ca tadā mūlyaṃ striyāstava ||95|| idānīṃ kva gataṃ tadvai jñānaṃ nārīpradarśitam | mātṛputro’si samyak tat pitṛputro na vai hyasi ||96|| ajñātapitṛkā nārīṃ nindanti tvādṛśāḥ pitaḥ | te sadā kālasūtre vai pacyante nindakāḥ striyāḥ ||97|| pitarau sarvadā pūjyāviti matvā mayā pitaḥ | tvaṃ na śaptastathāpyatra gāndharveṇa praśāpitaḥ ||98|| svakṛtyasya phalaṃ labdhaṃ tvayā cāpi mayāpi ca | kanyā deyā yogyakāle yasmai kasmaicideva ha ||99|| daivayogādahaṃ prāptā gāndharvāya kṣatistu kā | apsaraḥkanyakā cāhaṃ gāndharvaṃ samupāśritā || 1.503.10 0|| kā hāniste’tra sambandhe śāpe vā lābha eva kaḥ | vinā vicāraṃ kṛtavān kruddhaśca jñānadurbalaḥ || 101 || kṣamasvādhikavāco me hyanuneyāsmi vai yataḥ | ityuktvā sāśrunetreyaṃ praṇanāma ca pādayoḥ || 1 02|| pitā tu lajjito jātaḥ putryā jñānaṃ vilokya ca | prāha dhanyataraṃ manye tvahamātmānamadya vai || 1 03|| yasya me tvaṃ sutā jātā īdṛkśāstravicakṣaṇā | tasmānme kopa evādya śāntaḥ putri sukhā bhava || 1 04|| ityuktvā prayayau vipraḥ parṇaśālāṃ prati drutam | putrī cakre tapastatra yoginīmadhyavartinī || 1 05|| atha kālāntare tuṣṭo nārāyaṇaḥ samāyayau | divyarūpāṃ vidhāyaiva tāṃ nināya pramokṣaṇam || 1 06|| caturbhujābhavatsādhvī nārāyaṇapativratā | citrāṃgado yayau svasya gāndharvalokagāśramam || 1 07|| jābālistapasā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhajaṃstataḥ | śāpamukto’bhavat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapratāpataḥ || 1 08|| yayau golokamutkṛṣṭaṃ dhāma kṛṣṇakṛpāvaśāt | ātmaniveditā kiṃ kiṃ na karoti sudurlabham ||1 09|| akāṭyaṃ cāvināśyaṃ cāpradhṛṣyaṃ śāśvataṃ ca yat | parāvṛtya navaṃ kṛtvā samarpayati padgatam || 1.503.110 || api vajrasamaṃ bhāgyaṃ śaithilyaṃ nayati dhruvam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktirnavaṃ bhāgyaṃ karoti ca || 11 1|| etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ lakṣmi vāñcchāprapūrakam | paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva tviha loke paratra ca || 1 12|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jābālinā rambhādvārotpāditaputryāḥ phalavatyāścitrāṃgadagandharvakṛtabhoge pitṛśāpena nagnayoginītvaṃ, piturapi samīpasthāyitvaṃ, tatastapasāmuktiḥ, saṃvādaśca padmaśilāyāṃ dvayorvāsaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 503 ||
<1.504> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau devateśvarāḥ | pūjanīyāḥ sadā lakṣmi yogakṣemakarā hi te || 1 || varuṇaśca tathā sūryo bhānuḥ pūṣā ca tāpanaḥ | indraścaivāryamā caiva dhātā caiva bhagastathā || 2 || gabhastirdharmarājaśca ta ādityā daśa dvayam | dharo dhruvaśca somaśca makhaścāpyanilo nalaḥ || 3 || pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavo’ṣṭau hi nāmataḥ | mṛgavyādhaśca śarvaśca mṛgīvyādhastṛtīyakaḥ || 4 || ajaikapādahirbudhnyaḥ pinākī ṣaṣṭha ityapi | dahanaśca kapālī ca raivato navamastathā || 5 || vṛṣākapistryambakaśca rudrā ekādaśaiva te | nāsatyaścāpi dasraśca dvāvetāvaśvinīsutau || 6 || trayastriṃśatsamākhyātā ete tu suranāyakāḥ | dānavānāṃ ca devānāṃ mānavānāṃ ca dehinām || 7 || pūjanīyāḥ sadā tena nāpamṛtyuḥ prajāyate | aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ rudrāḥ pūjyāḥ sadā priye || 8 || daśamyāṃ vasavaḥ pūjyāstatra śukle viśeṣataḥ | saptamyāmatha ṣaṣṭyāṃ ca ādityānpūjayet tathā || 9 || aśviputrau tathā pūjyau dvādaśyāṃ ṣoḍaśādibhiḥ | rudrāstuṣṭā rakṣaṇaṃ ca dadatyapi paraṃ padam ||1.504.1 0 || vilāsādīn dadatyeva svargaṃ tu vasavo’rcitāḥ | ādityāḥ pūjitāstuṣṭā aiśvaryaṃ tvarpayanti vai || 11 || devavaidyau pūjitāvaśvinau nāśayato rujaḥ | sarveṣāṃ ca surādīnāṃ guṇagānādilekhakaḥ || 1 2|| vyāsastu sarvadā pūjyo jñānamokṣaprado guruḥ | yatputraḥ śukanāmāpi śukyāṃ brahma babhūva ha || 1 3|| vedavyāsasya vai cāsīt kalatrārthaṃ matiḥ kvacit | tato vicitravīryasya kṣetre putrān dhurandharān || 14|| satyavatyāḥ samādeśājjanayāmāsa sa prabhuḥ | pāṇḍuṃ ca dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ ca viduraṃ ceti kauravān || 15|| vānaprasthe’pi santiṣṭhan cakāra vaṃśavistaram | tataḥ sa cintayāmāsa bhāryāmadya karomyaham || 16|| tataḥ sa prārthayāmāsa jābāliṃ munipuṃgavam | tasya kanyāṃ dvitīyāṃ tu ceṭikākhyāṃ śukīṃ śubhām || 17|| jābālistu dadau tasmai ceṭikāṃ svasutāṃ śubhām | sāpi garbhavatī jātā garbho yāti bahirnahi || 18|| dvādaśābdā atikrāntā na niryāti bahiḥ khalu | yatkiṃcicchṛṇute sarvaṃ garbhe garbhagataḥ sutaḥ || 19|| śukī sā garbhatejobhiḥ śuśubhe vedasūriva | garbho’pi hṛdaye sarvaṃ dadhāra jñānacintanam ||1.504.20|| vedāḥ sāṃgāḥ śrutāstena garbhe’dhitā yathāśrutāḥ | smṛtayaḥ saṃhitā mokṣaśāstrāṇi nītayastathā ||21 || brahmādhyayanamevāpi tyākhyānānyātmavanti ca | sarvaṃ garbhe śrutaṃ yadyadadhītaṃ yāvadeva tat ||22|| yathā yathā suto vṛddhiṃ yāti jaṭharamāśritaḥ | mātā tathā tathā gurvī pīḍāṃ yāti tataḥ pitā ||23|| vyāsaḥ papraccha kastvaṃ vai praviṣṭo garbharūpadhṛk | kathaṃ bahirna cāyāsi vada sarvaṃ yathātatham ||24|| garbhaḥ prāha piśāco’haṃ rākṣaso’haṃ ca mānuṣaḥ | suro’haṃ turagaścāhaṃ gajo’haṃ kukkuṭo’smi ca ||25|| chāgo’haṃ ca kumāro’haṃ vṛkṣo’haṃ bālako’smyaham | caturaśītilakṣāsuyoniṣu vai bhraman muhuḥ ||26|| āgato’smi kathaṃ vedmi ko’haṃ te vacmi kaṃ ca mām | mānuṣe jaṭhare cātra praviṣṭo’smi nirañjanaḥ ||27|| atra yogaṃ sādhayāmi prāpya jñānaṃ tu vedajam | nirviṇṇo’smi mokṣamārgaṃ pratīkṣāmi ca śāśvatam ||28|| na vai ghore’tra saṃsāre bhramaṇaṃ me prarocate | na yāsyāmi bahirgarbhādatraiva brahmacintanam ||29|| kariṣye’tha gamiṣyāmi mokṣaṃ tava kṛpāvaśāt | vyāsaḥ prāha śṛṇu cātman nirañjanasya te suta ||1.504.30 || yonikuṇḍe’tidurgandhe vastuṃ prītiḥ kathaṃ vada | niṣkrāmasva tato vidvan garhitāt mūtrakuṇḍakāt ||3 1 || bahirāgatya yogaṃ vā jñānaṃ cārjaya śobhanam | garbhaḥ prāha navaṃ jñānaṃ navo yogaśca neṣyate ||32|| tāvajjñānaṃ ca vairāgyaṃ pūrvajātismṛtistathā | yāvadgarbhasthitirme’sti mokṣecchā tāvadeva ha || 33 || jantuśced garbhaniṣkrāntaḥ spṛśyate bāhyavāyunā | sarvaṃ garbhagataṃ jñānaṃ yogo bhānaṃ vinaśyati ||34|| tasmānnāhaṃ kṛtahānerniṣkramiṣye kathañcana | garbhādeva prayāsyāmi mokṣamityasti niścayaḥ ||35|| vyāsaḥ prāha na te cātman vāyupāśo bhaviṣyati | jñānaṃ yogaśca te sarvaṃ yathārthaṃ sthāsyati dhruvam ||36|| māyā te bādhate naiva garbhe vā bahireva vā | tasmād darśaya me vaktraṃ cānṛṇyaṃ saṃvṛjāmyaham ||37|| pitaraśca sutṛptāḥ syustava janmaśravād drutam | garbhaḥ prāha yadi tvaṃ me viṣṇuṃ sākṣiṇaṃ rakṣaya ||38|| tadā bahirniḥsarāmi tatra yogyaṃ kuru drutam | vyāsaḥ sasmara tacchrutvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||39|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo devastatra kṣipraṃ samāyayau | sākṣī tatrābhavat prāha śṛṇu garbha hitāvaham ||1.504.40|| pratibhūste bhavāmyadya sarvaṃ jñānādikaṃ tava | sthāsyatyeva bahiryāhi gaccha yogārthameva ca ||41 || māyā me vāyusaṃsparśakṛtā vyāptā na te bhavet | atha garbho viniṣkrāntaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā ||42|| dvādaśābdapramāṇastu yauvanasya samīpagaḥ | jātamātro jātismaro yogirāḍiva cetanaḥ ||43 || kṛṣṇaṃ jananīṃ janakaṃ praṇamyaiva ca tatkṣaṇāt | vanaṃ sa prasthito bālo vyāsastiṣṭhetyuvāca tam ||44|| saṃskārān jātakarmādīn te karomi sthiro bhava | ceṭikāyāḥ sutaḥ prāha saṃskārāḥ pratijanmani |||45|| sahasraśaḥ koṭiśaśca jātā me bhavasāgare | yairahaṃ bandhanarūpaiḥ parikṣipto’smi yoniṣu ||46 || atha vyāsaḥ śukaṃ nāma dadhāra bhagavān svayam | śuko gantuṃ padanyāsām̐ścakre vyāsa uvāca tam ||47|| pitaraṃ taṃ parityajya yogārthaṃ yo vanaṃ vrajet | sa yāti narakaṃ putra mā vraja tvaṃ gṛhe vasa ||48|| śukaḥ prāha yathāhaṃ te sutastathā gate bhave | tvaṃ cāsīrme sutaścāhaṃ pitā te tatra śāsanam ||49|| tvayā pālyaṃ mama vyāsa yadyeṣā dharmasaṃsthitiḥ | nāhaṃ niṣedhanīyastu vrajamānastapovanam ||1.504.50|| vyāsaḥ prāha janiṃ labdhvā puṇyaprāpyāṃ dvijagṛhe | saṃskārān yaśca gṛhṇāti vedoktān sa viśiṣyate ||5 1 || śukaḥ prāha ca saṃskārādātmamuktirna niścitā | saṃskārāccedbhavenmuktistādṛgdhūrtasya sā bhavet ||52|| vyāsaḥ prāha bhavetpūrvaṃ brahmacārī tato gṛhī | atha tyāgaṃ puraskṛtya tato muktirbhavet suta |||53|| śukaḥ prāha brahmacaryānmokṣaścet ṣaṇḍha āpnuyāt | gārhasthyena ca mokṣaścejjagatsarvaṃ tamāpnuyāt ||54|| vane vāsād yadi mokṣo mṛgādīnāṃ sa vai bhavet | tyāgāccenmuktirutkṛṣṭā daridrāṇāṃ ca sā bhavet |||55|| vyāsaḥ prāha gṛhasthādikrameṇa satpathāśrayaḥ | ihāmutrānandadātā tena mokṣaḥ phalātmakaḥ ||56 || śukaḥ prāha gṛhaiḥ sakto moharāgavaśaṃgataḥ | vāsanābandhabaddhaśca yamamārgaṃ phalaṃ labhet ||57|| vyāsaḥ prāha vinā rāgaṃ paitryaṃ daivaṃ prasādhayet | śukaḥ prāha vinā bhaktiṃ paitryaṃ daivaṃ pratārayet ||58|| vyāsaḥ prāha gṛhe bhaktiṃ paitryaṃ daivaṃ sadā kuru | śukaḥ prāha nijātmā me gṛhaṃ tatra karomyaham ||19|| vyāsaḥ prāha vinā putraṃ puṃnāmanarako dhruvaḥ | putreṇa tasya taraṇaṃ tasmātputraḥ praśasyate ||1.504.60|| śukaḥ prāha tathaiva cet kharavānarasūkarāḥ | putravantastariṣyanti ko viśeṣo’tra mānuṣe ||6 1 || vyāsaḥ prāha yadi jñānaṃ teṣāmapi ca mokṣaṇam | śukaḥ prāha pitastadvai garbhādevārjitaṃ mayā ||6 2|| gamiṣyāmi samāyātaṃ mokṣaṃ bhaktyā ca keśavam | prāptaṃ cintāmaṇiṃ tyaktvā kaṃkaraṃ kathamāvahet| ||63|| prāggrāse’mṛtamutsṛjya makṣikāṃ vai kathaṃ graset | prāpte svarṇarase cāgre kardamaṃ mardayet katham ||64|| sūryasya darśanaṃ tyaktvā rāhuṃ kathaṃ vilokayet | divyadīpaṃ parityajya dhūmrolkāṃ kathamarjayet ||65|| ekakārāgāramuktau dvitīye vai kathaṃ patet | brahmamārge cāvagate kṣudrasṛtyā kathaṃ saret ||66|| śreṣṭhaṃ copasthitaṃ tyaktvā kaniṣṭhaṃ nāvalambayet | satyaṃ prāptaṃ parityajya kṛtrimaṃ cāśliṣet katham ||67|| akke cenmadhuvindeta kimarthaṃ parvataṃ vrajet | iṣṭasyārthasya saṃsiddhau ko vidvān yatnamācaret| ||68|| ityuktvā pitaraṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ hṛdi sthitam | mātaraṃ ceṭikāṃ kṛṣṇaśaktiṃ praṇamya sādaram ||69|| yayau vanaṃ sadāvanaṃ yatrātmanā bhavatyapi | vyāsaḥ śokaṃ ceṭikā ca duḥkhaṃ jagāma vai kṣaṇam ||1.504.70 || śukī vyāsaṃ tataḥ prāha cariṣyāmi tapaḥ punaḥ | putrārthaṃ yena vaṃśasya vardhako me bhavet sutaḥ ||71 || vyāsājñāṃ sā samāsādya tapastepe pativratā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||72|| iti mantraṃ dadau vyāso jajāpa sā divāniśam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatra tvāyayau hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ||73|| varado’smīti tāṃ prāha varaṃ varaya suvrate | śukī prāha sutaṃ dehi mama vaṃśavivardhanam ||74|| tathāstviti hariḥ prāha yayāvadarśanaṃ tataḥ | ceṭikā susutaṃ lebhe kapiñjalamiti śrutam ||75|| kapiñjalo mahāyogī pitroścaiva samājñayā | gārhasthyaṃ svīcakārāsau bharadvājīṃ sukanyakām ||76 || pariṇeme tato bhāradvājaḥ putro babhūva ha | bharadvājasya taittiraḥ kāmarūpadharaḥ sutaḥ ||77|| saca prāgjyotiṣadeśe yayau parvatabhūstare | tataḥ punaḥ samāgatya navalakṣābhidhe’cale ||78|| nivāsaṃ svīcakārāsau kāmākṣīṃ cābhajat satīm | kāmarūpo mahāyogī parvatīyo maheśvaraḥ ||79|| parvatīyaprajānāṃ vai guruḥ rājā tapobalāt | abhavat tena girayaḥ kāmarūpābhidhāstataḥ ||1.504.80|| abhavam̐śca narāḥ svalpā nāryo bahvyaḥ satīcchayā | bhajanti smaikapuruṣaṃ śataṃ śataṃ hi yoṣitām ||81 || atha bālavayogīndro brahmaputrātaṭe vasan | tapaścacāra kaṭhinaṃ bālavanmohavarjitaḥ ||82|| te tāḥ samprārthayāmāsurnarāṇāṃ vṛddhaye tataḥ | sarvāḥ putraprasavābhimukhyo bhavantu madvarāt ||83|| yādṛksaṃkhyāḥ kanyakānāṃ narāṇāṃ santu tāḥ samāḥ | sāmyottaraṃ sāmyabhāve kanyākumāramātaraḥ ||84|| bhaviṣyatha yathāyogyā iti tāśca tathābhavan | evaṃ te kathitaṃ lakṣmi purāvṛttaṃ yuge yuge ||85|| navaṃ navaṃ punaḥ sañjāyate nirmāṇavad bhave | kāmarūpaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ bālavākuṇḍakaṃ tathā ||86|| bhuktimuktipradaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ paṭhanācchravaṇādapi | yatheṣṭadāyakaṃ mantrasiddhipradaṃ hi vidyate ||87|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kṛṣṇadvaipāyanavyāsasya śukyāṃ śukakapiñjalau sutau, kapiñjalasya bharadvājastasya taittiraḥ sutaḥ, bālavayogivaradānāt kāmarūpadeśe narāṇāṃ nārīsamasaṃkhyākotpattirityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||504||
<1.505> śrīlakṣmīruvāca nārāyaṇa parabrahma bhagavan karuṇānidhe | dhyātvā rūpaṃ tava bhaktā bhuktiṃ muktiṃ prayānti ca || 1 || sanatkumāraḥ sanakaḥ sanandaśca sanātanaḥ | sanatsujātaḥ pañcaite tvatsamā bhuktimuktidāḥ || 2 || vaiṣṇavānāmagraṇīśca śaṃkaro lomaśastathā | mārkaṇḍeyo yājñavalkyo dharmaḥ śeṣo vṛṣastathā || 3 || vedāśca vaiṣṇavā nityā balirbāṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ | hanumān jāmbavānaśvatthāmā prahlāda āsuriḥ || 4 || voḍhuḥ pañcaśikho divodāsastathāmbarīṣakaḥ | uddhavaśca śaśī sūryo’nilaścāpi hutāśanaḥ || 5 || ete bhaktāstava nityaṃ tvājñāvahāḥ sutāstava | tava dhyānaṃ sadā kṛtvā ciraṃ tiṣṭhanti jīvinaḥ || 6 || śaṃkaraśca tava putraḥ kathaṃ pañcaśirā hyasau | tvatsvarūpādvibhinnaśca kimatra kāraṇaṃ vada || 7 || ekamastakadevasya pañcamastakaputrakaḥ | tadidaṃ mahadāścaryaṃ saṃśayaṃ me nirāsaya || 8 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca pūrvaṃ bhagavatājena kṛtvā sṛṣṭiṃ tu vistṛtām | caturvidhāṃ bahukālaṃ naranārīmayīṃ śubhām || 9 || tataḥ sa cintayāmāsa nārīrūpāṇi sarvaśaḥ | mohasthānāni ramyāṇi kṛtānyapi tato’pi ca || 1.505.1 0|| nārīṇāmapi yatra syānmohastādṛśaputtalīm | racayāmīti saṃkalpya rūpasañcayasaṃyutām || 11 || ekāmapsarasaṃ divyāṃ devībhyo’pi ca taijasīm | sarveṣāṃ dyusadāṃ tejaḥ samādāya tilaṃ tilam || 1 2|| rūparūpātirūpāḍhyāṃ camatkṛtiṃ sa nirmame | yāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣobhamāpannaḥ svayameva pitāmahaḥ || 1 3|| tatastāṃ preṣayāmāsa yoginaḥ śaṃkarasya vai | dhairyasya samparīkṣārthaṃ sāpi kailāsamāyayau || 14|| apaśyacchaṃkaraṃ kṛṣṇadhyānamagnaṃ ca nirjane | nityaṃ tatra sthitā bhaktā yathā dhyānakarī satī || 15|| samīpasthā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇajāpaṃ cakāra sā | tasyā dehāt koṭicandratulyaṃ miṣṭaṃ ca śītalam || 16|| kānakaṃ prasasārograṃ tejomaṇḍalamadbhutam | tattejo vartulākāraṃ gatvā śaṃkarapakṣmaṇoḥ || 17|| lagnaṃ prakāśarūpaṃ ca netrāntaḥ praviveśa ha | raśmidvārāgataṃ cāntarhṛdayaṃ yatra yogirāṭ || 18|| tiṣṭhatyātmani cātmānaṃ saṃyujya tejasāṃ khanau | tatra śaṃbhuśca tattejo dadarśa kamanīyakam || 1 9|| dvedhā vṛttiḥ samādhau ca jātā satyā mṛṣā samā | mṛṣāṃ lokayituṃ cehā babhūva śaṃkarasya vai ||1.505.20|| satyāṃ visṛjya cāyāto bahiḥ kimiti kautukāt | netramuddhāṭya ca yāvat puraḥ paśyati sundarīm ||21|| visasmāra satīṃ mūrtiṃ vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ | vṛttyā tallīnayā jñātvā mugdhaṃ darśanalālasam ||22|| sāpi tṛtīyanetrasyodghāṭane bhasmatābhayāt | mugdhaṃ vilokayantaṃ taṃ hitvā pūrvasthalīṃ tataḥ ||23 || pradakṣiṇāyā vyājena sā praṇamya kṛtāṃjaliḥ | dakṣiṇaṃ sā gatā pārśvaṃ śaṃbhuniścalamastakaḥ ||24|| draṣṭukāmaśca tāṃ hṛdā samīyeṣātirāgataḥ | tāvadvai dakṣiṇaṃ vaktraṃ nirgataṃ tatkṣaṇaṃ śubham ||25|| atha sā bhayasampannā yayau paścimatodiśam | śaṃbhustasyāḥ svarūpākṛṣṭāntarbhāvo’pi paścimam ||26 || vadanaṃ tṛtīyaṃ cakre darśanārthaṃ navaṃ śubham | atha sā bhayamāpannottarabhāgaṃ gatā tataḥ ||27|| tāṃ draṣṭuṃ cottaraṃ vaktraṃ nirmāya sā dadarśa tām | athākāśe gatā sā ca tāṃ draṣṭuṃ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ ||28|| vyomagaṃ śaṃkarastatra cakāra ca dadarśa tām | jahāsa ca mudhā premṇā rūpalīno babhūva ha || 21|| grīvāṃ na cālayāmāsa yogābhyāsabalānvitaḥ | etasminnantare devo nāradaḥ pārvatīṃ prati ||1.505.3 0|| sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa prāha śaṃkaraceṣṭitam | dṛṣṭvā rūpavatīṃ nārīṃ kṛtavān sa navaṃ navam ||3 1 | mukhaṃ tenābhavad vaktrapañcaka śaṃkarasya vai | ahaṃ jānāmi nāstyanyā nārī tvatsadṛśī kvacit| ||3 2 || patiste ca kathaṃ mugdho hāsyāspado bhaviṣyati | hāsyasya padavīṃ tvaṃ ca gamiṣyasyadya pārvati || 33 || yena kāmo bhasmarūpaḥ kṛto yogīśvaraḥ svayam | sa cādya māyayā viṣṇormohaṃ yāto divaḥ striyām ||34|| sarvāsāṃ devapatnīnāṃ pūjyā tvaṃ tvatpatiśca saḥ | taccittaṃ snigdhatāṃ yātaṃ devadāsyāṃ
