vilokaya || 35|| drāgeva tāṃ samādāya nijāṃke sthāpayiṣyati | tava mūlyātparaṃ mūlyamapsarasaḥ kariṣyati ||36 || kuru śīghraṃ nirodhaṃ vai yāvadaṃke karoti na | iti śrutvā nāradasya dṛṣṭvā pañcamukhaṃ patim ||37|| vikṛtaṃ taṃ samālokya netreṣu praviveśa sā | sarvanetrāṇi vai śaṃbhoḥ rodhayāmāsa yoginī ||38|| etasminnantare sarvatejāṃsyapi hatāni ca | andhakāramayaṃ sarvaṃ puṣpavantau vitejasau ||39 || pralayasya samutthānaṃ kālarātreḥ samāgamaḥ | bhūkampāśca tadā jātā bhayabhītāśca dehinaḥ ||1.505.40|| evaṃ jāte sarvasṛṣṭikṣobhe nandyādayo gaṇāḥ | sarve satīṃ namaskṛtya stutvā cāpi punaḥ punaḥ ||41 || muñca muñca suraśreṣṭhe śaṃbhornetrāṇi muñca vai | paśyantu haranetrāṇi jagadāndhyaṃ prasarpatu ||42|| evamuktāpi sā devī na netrāṇi mumoca sā| tāvaddhareṇa bhālasthaṃ visṛṣṭaṃ locanaṃ param ||43 || kṛpāviṣṭena lokānāṃ yena rakṣā prajāyate | vārayituṃ na śakto’smi devīṃ prāṇagarīyasīm ||44|| atha devī tato netrayogaṃ vihāya susthirā | harasya sannidhau tilottamāmuvāca vai ruṣā ||45|| yasmānme dayitaḥ pāpe tvayā rūpādviḍambitaḥ | tasmāttvaṃ rūpahīnā ca śīrṇakeśā mahodarī ||46|| cipiṭākṣī bṛhaddantī bhava vai bhagnanāsikā | atha jātā tatkṣaṇena tilottamā kurūpiṇī ||47|| tuṣṭāva pārvatīṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ kṣamāṃ yasma yācate | nāsti me’trāparādho vai dāsyā darśanayoṣitaḥ ||48|| devasya tava kiṃkaryāḥ prasādaṃ kartumarhasi | pārvatī ca tadā prāha samāgaccha mayā saha ||49|| śaṃkarāt tvaṃ gṛhāṇātra mantraṃ pāpaharaṃ śubham | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||1.505.50 || tato yāhi mayā sārdhaṃ tīrthaṃ śrīhāṭakeśvaram | nāganadyāṃ rūpatīrthe snāhi śāpanivṛttaye ||51 || evaṃ mantraṃ gṛhītvā ca gṛhītvā tulasīsrajam | nāgamatyāṃ yayau sasnau surūpā sā babhūva ha ||52|| pūrvamāsīd yathārūpā tathārūpā viśeṣataḥ | babhūva pārvatī natvā yayau satye pitāmaham ||53 || sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa pañcavaktrādirohaṇam | brahmā prāha pratisṛṣṭiṃ tathā bhavati putrike ||54|| tvāṃ nimittaṃ samāsādya haraḥ pañcamukho muhuḥ | jāyate ca tava kīrtiḥ sadā loke bhaviṣyati ||55|| ityuktvā tāṃ dadāvāśīrvādān sṛṣṭau sthirā bhava | devakāryakarī satyaloke vāsakarī bhava ||56|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tilottamānimittena śaṃkarasya pañcamukhavattā, tilottamāyāḥ pārvatīśāpaḥ, nāgavatyā snānena śāpanivṛttirityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||5 05||
<1.506> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi sarasvatyā raktasalilavāhitā | yathā jātā purā tāṃ te pravakṣyāmi ca pāvanīm || 1 || viśvāmitrasya ca vaśiṣṭhasyāsīd vimanaskatā | brahmaṇā brāhmaṇaiścokto viśvāmitraḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 2 || brāhmaṇo’yaṃ brāhmaṇo’yaṃ brahmarṣiḥ kṣatriyo’pi vai | vaśiṣṭhena tu naivoktaḥ śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ priye || 3 || āsīt purā ṛcīkākhyo bhṛguputro mahāmuniḥ | vratādhyayanasampannastapasvī caikadā tu saḥ || 4 || tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena yayau bhojakaṭaṃ puram | kauśikī ca nadī yatra yatra gādhirmahīpatiḥ || 5 || tasyāṃ snātvā prasantarpya pitṛdevān jajāpa saḥ | tāvat tīre tatra caikā snānārthaṃ rājakanyakā || 6 || yuvatī rūpasampannā sarvāvayavaśobhanā | samāyātā ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā munirmumoha kāmataḥ || 7 || kasyeyaṃ kanyakā ceti lokān papraccha, te janāḥ | prāhuḥ gādhisutā cāsti gaurīpūjanalālasā || 8 || īhamānā subhartāraṃ vrataṃ karoti kāntadam | atra brahma japitvā ca pūjayitvā yathākramam || 9 || naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ gauryai datvā karoti gāyanam | nṛtyaṃ ca vādanaṃ cāpi nityaṃ gaurīpratuṣṭaye || 1.506.1 0|| śrutvā sa munirāṭ gādhiṃ pratiyayau sulālasaḥ | ṛcīkaṃ tvāgataṃ vīkṣya rājā satkāramācarat || 11 || kṛtvārhaṇāṃ ṛṣiṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ papraccha bhāvataḥ | nispṛhasyāpi te vipra kimāgamanakāraṇam || 1 2|| yatheṣṭaṃ me samācakṣva prayacchāmi ca te’khilam | ṛcīko mohabhāvena yayāce tāṃ sukanyakām || 1 3|| brāhmaṇena vivāhena tāṃ me dehīti cābravīt | sā mayā vī kṣitā gaurīpūjāyāmiti cābravīt || 14|| tacchrutvā bhayasantrasto gādhirbuddhimatāṃ varaḥ | daridraṃ jaraṭhaṃ matvā provāca nītisaṃbhṛtam || 15|| asmākaṃ kanyakādāne śulkamasti dvijottama | tacced yacchasi kanyāṃ tāṃ tubhyaṃ dāsyāmyasaṃśayam || 16|| ṛcīkaḥ prāha rājam̐stvaṃ kanyāśulkaṃ vadātra me | drutaṃ yacchāmi te sarvaṃ durlabhaṃ cāpi golake ||17|| gādhiḥ prāhaikataḥ śyāmakarṇānāṃ vājināṃ dvija | śatāni sapta me dehi śvetānāṃ caiva sarvataḥ || 18|| sa tatheti pratijñāya ṛcīkastapasojjvalaḥ | gaṃgātīraṃ yayau cāpovohleti ca jajāpa vai || 1 9|| catuḥṣaṣṭiṛcāsūktaṃ vāruṇaṃ niyuyoja ha | tāvat pūrṇe jape devo varuṇastatra cāyayau ||1.506.20 || tena sārdhaṃ vājinaśca niṣkrāntāḥ salilāt tadā | sarve śvetāḥ suvegāśca śyāmaikaśravaṇāḥ śubhāḥ ||21 || śatāni saptasaṃkhyāni tāvatsaṃkhyairnarairyutāḥ | ṛcīko’pi samādāya natvā taṃ varuṇaṃ tadā |||22|| aśvān gṛhītvā puruṣairgādhiṃ jagāma vai drutam | tasmai nivedayāmāsa kanyārthe tān hayottamān ||23|| gādhistu tān samāgṛhya sarvān vājimakhasya ca | kanyāṃ tasmai dadau vipravahnisākṣye vidhānataḥ || 24|| ṛcīko dharmapatnyā ca niṣkāmaḥ samapadyata | kālāntare satīṃ prāha sevamānāṃ pativratām ||25|| ahaṃ tapase yāsyāmi varaṃ vṛṇu dadāmi te | sāpi svārthavihīnasya śrutvā vākyamṛṣestataḥ ||26|| svasyā jananīṃ provāca vṛttāntaṃ śokadharṣitā | jananī tāṃ sutāṃ prāha putrārthaṃ vṛṇu putrike ||27|| brāhmaṇyena yutaṃ putraṃ tvadarthaṃ vṛṇu putrike | kṣātreṇa tejasā yuktaṃ madarthaṃ ca sutaṃ vṛṇu ||28|| sā patiṃ sampraṇamyāha jananyuktaṃ savistaram | ṛcīko yajñadevārthaṃ pracakāra carudvayam ||29|| putreṣṭiṃ vidhivat kṛtvā caruṃ dvedhā vibhajya ca | ekasmin yojayāmāsa brāhmyatejo’khilaṃ yaśaḥ ||1.506.3 0 || anyasmin yojayāmāsa kṣātraṃ tejo’khilaṃ tataḥ | bhāryāyai pradadau brāhmyatejoyuktaṃ caruṃ hi saḥ || 31 || abravīt prāśaya tvenamaśvatthāliṅganaṃ kuru | tataḥ prāpsyasi satputraṃ brahmatejaḥsamanvitam ||32|| dvitīyaṃ ca caruṃ patnyā mātre dadau sutārthakam | kṣātratejomayaṃ datvā prāha prāśya caruṃ tvimam || 33 || nyagrodhāliṅganaṃ kṛtvā prāpsyasi kṣatriyaṃ sutam | atha mātā sutāṃ prāha rahasye bhāvinoditā || 34|| sarvalokasya vai svārthe śraiṣṭhyaṃ kṣaudryaṃ parārthake | maccarvapekṣayā putri tvaccarau śreṣṭhatā bhavet || 35|| śrutvā putrī mātṛvatsā bhrātṛśraiṣṭhyābhilāṣiṇī | akarod vyatyayaṃ vṛkṣe carau cāpi hi padmaje || 36|| tataḥ puṃsavane snāne te śubhe premavihale | dadhāte garbhamekā tu sutā kṣātreṇa tejasā || 37|| bhūtvā garbhavatī nityaṃ rājyabhoge mano dadhe | yuddhavārtāstathā cakre hastyaśvārohaṇādijāḥ ||38|| raktavastrottamabhūṣāḥ kaisaraṃ ca vilepanam | piturgṛhāt samānīya śṛṃgāraṃ ca karoti sā || 39|| dṛṣṭvaivaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ patnyāḥ ṛcīkaḥ prāha tāṃ tadā | kiṃ priye vyatyayaścarvoḥ kṛto vā vṛkṣayostathā ||1.506.40|| ceṣṭayā te jñāyate’tra bhāvinaṃ ko vilaṃghayet | dvijācāravihīnaste dhruvaṃ putro bhaviṣyati ||41 || tava mātā ceṣṭayā ca kṣātraṃ dharmaṃ vinā sadā | dṛśyate nu śamasthā ca japahomaparāyaṇā ||42|| tīrthayātrā kathāśrāve saśraddhā ten te’nujaḥ | bhaviṣyati brāhmaṇasya tejasā brahmaṇā samaḥ || 43|| yādṛśā daurhṛdāḥ santi sagarbhāṇāṃ tu yoṣitām | tādṛśāni lakṣaṇāni putre vasanti yoṣitām ||44|| pitrorniṣekasamaye sagarbhāyāṃ striyāṃ tathā | yādṛśī vartate ceṣṭā sā garbhe pratibimbate ||45|| atha patnī ṛṣiṃ prāha kṣamasva tāṃ kṣatiṃ mama | vyatyāso yaḥ kṛto nātha punardayāṃ kuru prabho ||46 || brāhmaṇo me bhavet putro manmātuḥ kṣatriyaḥ sutaḥ | ṛcīkaḥ prāha naivaṃ syād gataṃ jātaṃ tathaiva tat ||47|| kintu putragaṇāḥ kṣātrāḥ pautre yāsyanti madvarāt | ityevaṃ vai dayāṃ kurve putraste brāhmaṇo’stu vai ||48|| ityevaṃ varadānena jamadagniḥ suto’bhavat | jamadagneḥ sutaḥ parśurāmaḥ kṣātrakramo’bhavat || 49|| ekaviṃśatidhā bhūmau cakre raṇaṃ tu rājabhiḥ | atha gādhergṛhapatnī dadhe garbhaṃ tataḥ param |||1.506.50|| brāhmaṇīvat samācārā suṣuve putramuttamam | brāhmaṇaṃ karmaṇā yogasandhyādhyānaparāyaṇam ||51 || viśvāmitraitikhyātaṃ kṣātradharmavirāgiṇam | yadā rājyakṣamo jāto gādhinā yojitaśca saḥ ||52|| pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyaṃ gṛhāṇa vedamārgagaḥ | putre datvā so’pi rājyaṃ viśvāmitro vane sthitaḥ ||53|| sakalatro devaviprapūjāparāyaṇaḥ śuciḥ | tāpasaśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhyānaparaḥ sadā ||54|| ekadā vanamadhye’yaṃ mṛgayārthaṃ bhraman yayau | vasiṣṭhasyāśramaṃ ramyaṃ mṛgadruśiṣyaśobhitam ||55|| vaśiṣṭhastaṃ samāyāntaṃ pratyutthāyonmukhaṃ yayau | datvā tasmai tadārghaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ yathocitam ||56|| abravīd rājayogyaṃ ca svāgataṃ te mahīpate | vada kṛtyaṃ karomyadya satkāraṃ te yathocitam ||57|| viśvāmitrastadā prāha sainyaṃ me nikaṭe sthitam | mṛgayārthaṃ samāyāto jalaṃ pītvā prayāmi ca || 58|| bubhukṣiteṣu bhṛtyeṣu yaḥ svāmī kurute’śanam | sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ tasmād yāsyāmi vai drutam ||59|| vaśiṣṭhaśca tadā prāha sarvānānaya tāniha| asti me nandinī dhenurvāñcchitaṃ yā prayacchati ||1.506.60|| tasyā balena sarvān vai tṛptiṃ dāsyāmi cottamām | bhūtvaivaṃ tvānayāmāsa sainyaṃ mahīpatistataḥ ||61 || vaśiṣṭhaḥ kāmadhenuṃ tāmuvāca svāgatāya vai | viśvāmitrasya rājarṣeryāvadbhojanalabdhaye ||62|| kuruṣva tṛptiparyantaṃ khādyapeyādikaṃ śubham | aśvānāṃ ca gajādīnāṃ yavasādikamityapi ||63|| tato viśrāmalabdhyarthaṃ gṛhopakaraṇādikam | dhenurbāḍhaṃ samuvāca sasṛje tatkṣaṇaṃ bahu ||64|| bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ lehyacośye peyaṃ lepyaṃ ca bhogyakam | dāsāyutaṃ tathā dāsīdaśasāhasramityapi ||65|| te dāsā dāsikā viśvāmitrāya ca balāya ca | daduḥ śīghraṃ subhojyāni śarkarāghṛtavanti ca ||66|| dadhi dugdhaṃ madhu miṣṭaṃ peyaṃ suśītalaṃ jalam | evaṃ gavā nṛpaḥ sainyayutastṛptiṃ vidhāpitaḥ ||67|| viśvāmitraḥ kautukaṃ ca dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ jagāma ha | aho citraṃ gavā tṛptiṃ nītā vayaṃ sahasraśaḥ ||68|| tasmātsannīyatāmeṣā svagṛhaṃ dhenuruttamā | tataḥ prāha vaśiṣṭhāya tava dāsyāmi cepsitam ||69|| varān rathāṃśca hastyaśvān gā anyāśca sahasraśaḥ | dehi me nandinīṃ rājye yogyāṃ vaśiṣṭha sarvathā || 1.506.70|| vaśiṣṭhastu tadā prāha homadhenuriyaṃ nṛpa | asmatkāmapradā daivī hyadeyā gaudvijanmanām ||71 || sarvakāmapradā ceyaṃ tāpasānāṃ kṛte sthitā | adeyā sarvathā gauśca vikraye mātṛvikrayaḥ || 72|| na sāmnāṃ naiva bhedena na dānena prasahya na | na vikrīya na vā cānyairupāyaistvāṃ samarpaye ||73 || tasmād gaccha mahārāja svasthānaṃ ca sukhī bhava | viśvāmitrastataḥ prāha rājyasya sattayā munim ||74|| yatkiñcid vidyate ratnaṃ pārthivasya kṣitau hi tat | sarvaṃ syād rājakīyaṃ vai nītiśceyaṃ mune sadā ||75|| tasmānnayāmi dhenuṃ vai nṛpaterdhanameva tat | ityuktvājñāpayāmāsa bhṛtyavargaṃ tataśca te ||76|| bhṛtyā dhenuṃ nigṛhyaiva raśminā ninyurulbaṇāḥ | atha gacchati sā naiva tvaśrupūrṇā babhūva ha ||77|| daṇḍaprahāraiste ninyuḥ prasahyākṛṣya bhṛtyakāḥ | lokayantaṃ vaśiṣṭhaṃ sā papraccha duḥkhakarṣitā ||78|| kiṃ dattāsmi muniśreṣṭha tvayāhaṃ cāsya bhūpateḥ | vaśiṣṭhaḥ prāha dheno tvaṃ na dattāsi mayā śubhe ||79|| prāṇā yāntu mama mātarmā yāhi tvaṃ mayi sthite | tadrakṣasva svayaṃ dheno hyātmānaṃ matprabhāvataḥ ||1.506.80|| ityuktā kopamāpannā cakre huṃkāragarjanāḥ | hum̐kārebhyaśca phenebhyo romebhyaḥ svedamaṇḍalāt ||81 || niṣkrāntāḥ sāyudhā mlecchāḥ pulindāḥ śabarāḥ khasāḥ | yoddhāro vyomamārgasthā acchedyā apradhṛṣyakāḥ ||82|| asaṃkhyātā ahanam̐ste viśvāmitrasya tān mahān | tataḥ kopaparītātmā viśvāmitraḥ svayaṃ dhanuḥ ||83 || sajyaṃ kṛtvā ca maraṇe niścito’tiyuyodha ha | tathāpi sainikā aśvā gajā bhaṭāḥ padātayaḥ ||84|| viśvāmitrasya vai sarve hatā dhenūdbhavairbhaṭaiḥ | viśvāmitraṃ parityajya śeṣaṃ sarvaṃ nipātitam ||85|| kṛpāṃ kṛtvā vaśiṣṭhastu nandinīmidamabravīt | rakṣa nandini bhūpālaṃ mlecchairetaiḥ samāvṛtam ||86 || rājā hi yatnato rakṣyo rājā nārāyaṇāṃśajaḥ | sanmārge vartate sarvo rājadaṇḍabhayād yataḥ ||87|| iti śrutvā nandinī sā mlecchān vārayituṃ yayau | tāvadrājā ruṣā tāṃ gāṃ prahartumupacakrame ||88|| vaśiṣṭhaste samālokya goprahāraṃ nṛpakṛtam | taṃ bāhuṃ stambhayāmāsa saheti tasya bhūpateḥ ||89|| jaḍībhūto nṛpo lajjāyukto vaśiṣṭhamāha ca | rakṣa vaśiṣṭha māṃ mlecchairvadhyamānaṃ jaḍīkṛtam || 1.506.90 || mamāparādhānnaṣṭaṃ me sarvaṃ sainyamanantakam | tasmād yāsyāmyahaṃ harmyaṃ na yuddhena prayojanam ||91 || evamukto vaśiṣṭhaśca stambhadoṣavivarjitam | viśvāmitrasya tu karaṃ cakārāha sukhāvaham ||92|| gaccha rājan vimukto’si mā virodhaya bhūsuraiḥ | rājā yayau svabhavanaṃ pralāpamakaronmuhuḥ ||93 || dhigbalaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu dhigvīryaṃ dhikprajīvitam | ślāghyaṃ brahmabalaṃ caikaṃ brāhmyaṃ tejo hi kevalam || 94|| tacca karma mayā kāryaṃ yathā syād brāhmaṇaṃ balam | tapasārādhanayā ca cariṣyāmi mahātapaḥ ||95|| atha viśvasahaṃ putraṃ rājye saṃsthāpya bhūpatiḥ | himavantaṃ yayau tatra tapaścakre sudāruṇam ||96|| śatavarṣatrayaṃ phalāhāro babhūva kevalam | varṣāsvākāśasaṃsthaśca grīṣme pañcāgnitāpanaḥ ||97|| śaitye śītajalāvāso babhūva ca tataḥ param | śatavarṣatrayaṃ śuṣkaparṇāhāro babhūva saḥ ||98|| śatavarṣatrayaṃ tato jalāhāro’bhavannṛpaḥ | atha varṣaśate vāyvāhāro babhūva tatparam ||99|| indro bhayena saṃgamyovāca taṃ tāpasaṃ nṛpam | tuṣṭo’smi tava rājendra varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam || 1.506.10 0|| viśvāmitrastadā prāha dehi brāhmaṇyameva me | tadarthaṃ vai tapaścaryāṃ karomi nānyakāmyayā || 101 || indraḥ prāha kṣatriyasyānena dehena vai kutaḥ | saṃskārairjāyate cāṣṭācatvāriṃśadbhireva yat| || 1 02|| brāhmaṇyaṃ tad bhaved rājannanyaṃ varaṃ tato vṛṇu | rājā prāha na brāhmaṇyādanyat samprārthayāmyaham || 10 3|| parityakṣyāmyahaṃ dehaṃ prāpsye vā vipratāṃ vraja | indro divaṃ yayau śrutvā rājā tepe’tiduṣkaram || 1 04|| punarvarṣasahasraṃ vai vyatikrāntaṃ tataḥ punaḥ | ājagāma svayaṃ brahmā puṇyairdevarṣibhiḥ saha || 1 05|| brahmā prāha pratuṣṭo’smi varaṃ varaya cepsitam | rājā prāha ca vipratvaṃ dehi me nānyadīpsitam || 1 06|| brahmā prāha dharāpṛṣṭhe vipratvaṃ kṣatriyasya na | kṣatriyeṇa prajātasya vipratvaṃ jāyate katham || 1 07|| rājā prāhāsamarthaśced yāhi svaṃ bhavanaṃ pitaḥ | dehaṃ tyakṣyāmi vā prāpsye vipratvaṃ tapasā bhuvi || 1 08|| athābravīdṛcīko’tra brāhmyairmantrairmayā pitaḥ | yojitaśca carustatrāmitaṃ brāhmaṇyamarpitam || 1 09|| kṣatriyāt kṣātradharmāpi brāhmaṇo bhavituṃ hyayam | arhatyeva niṣeke brāhmaṇatvaṃ tvasya miśritam || 1.506.110 || tataścainaṃ kīrtayasva brahmarṣiṃ tvaṃ pitāmaha | brāhmyadharmasamācāro vartate’yaṃ sadā śuciḥ || 111 || śrutvā brahmā kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā jñātvā yathārthakāraṇam | brahmarṣistvamiti prāha sarve prāhustathaiva tam || 11 2|| vasiṣṭhastu ruṣā prāha nāhaṃ vakṣyāmi taṃ tathā | kṣatriyasya sutaṃ kasmād vipraṃ vakṣyāmi bodhavān || 11 3||| ityuktvā prayayau śīghraṃ vasiṣṭho hāṭakeśvaram | kṣetraṃ tepe tapastatra viśvāmitro’pi cāyayau || 1 14|| vaśiṣṭhasya vadhārthaṃ vai cintayāmāsa saṃvasan | viśvāmitro devavatīnadyāḥ sthāne’bhicārakam || 1 15|| cakāra dāruṇairmantrairjuhvāno jātavedasam | tato vahnestu niṣkrāntā śaktirvānaravāhanā || 1 16|| bhayānakāyudhahastā viśvāmitreṇa sā tadā | yojitā tu vasiṣṭhasya vadhārthaṃ sā yayau drutam || 1 17|| athāśrame vaśiṣṭhasya tatkālaṃ durnimittakam | adṛśyata papātolkā nihatya ravimaṇḍalam || 1 18|| raktavṛṣṭirasthimiśrā vyajāyata kṣaṇāntare | śivā prācīṃ samuddiśya ruroda dīrghanādataḥ || 11 9|| evaṃ jāte mahāśaktirvahneḥ parvatasadṛśī | adṛśyata samāyāntī kṛtyārūpā sacetanā || 1.506.120 || sāmavedoktamantraiḥ sā vaśiṣṭhena nirodhitā | mahāmantraiḥ punastatra stambhitātharvaṇodbhavaiḥ || 121 || tato nārīsvarūpā sā provāca munipuṃgavam | sāmavedaḥ supramāṇaṃ tavāpi jagatāmapi || 122 tenāhaṃ vidhinā sṛṣṭā preritā muninā tathā | mā kuruṣvāpramāṇaṃ taṃ prahāraṃ saha me ṛṣe || 123 || rakṣayiṣyāmi te prāṇān svalpasparśena sārthikā | vaśiṣṭhaḥ prāha yadyevaṃ kuru sparśaṃ dayāvati || 124|| mayā tvātharvaṇā mantrāḥ saṃhṛtā marma mā spṛśa | ityuktā sā vaśiṣṭhaṃ vai spṛṣṭvā papāta bhūtale || 1 25| sā ca śaktirdevadhārā nāmnā tatraiva tiṣṭhati | pūjanācchravaṇāttvasyā bhaktiṃ muktiṃ ca saṃlabhet || 126 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne viśvāmitravasiṣṭhayoḥ kāmadhenunimittakakleśaḥ, ṛcīkasya gādhisutayā śyāmakarṇāśvavinimayena vivāhaḥ, mātṛputryorvyatyāsena putrārthacaruprāśanam, pautrayorvyatyāsaguṇāḥ, gādherviśvāmitraḥ, ṛcīkasya jamadagniḥ, viśvāmitrasya tapo brāhmaṇyaṃ ca, viśvaṃsahaḥ sutaḥ, viśvāmitrapreritaśaktisahaviśvāmitrastaṃbhanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 506 ||
<1.507> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi sā ca śaktirdhārānāmnī kumārikā | brāhmaṇasyābhavatputrī devaśarmaṇa īśvarī || 1 || kanyārūpā tapastepe’rundhatīmitratāṃ gatā | arundhatyāśrame vāsaṃ tataścakāra śobhanā || 2 || ekadārundhatī prāha sarasvatyāstaṭe śubham | mamāśramapadaṃ ramyaṃ tatra tiṣṭha mayā saha || 3 || tataḥ sā kanyakā dhārā tayā sārdhaṃ yayau tataḥ | śaktirūpā sthitā devī sarasvatyāstaṭe śubhā || 4 || divyā brahmasvarūpā ca vasiṣṭho’pi mahāmuniḥ | hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ tyaktvā sarasvatītaṭe || 5 || svāśramaṃ prayayau tatra tapastepe sukhāvaham | viśvāmitreṇa vijñātaṃ śaktirme tatra saṃgatā || 6 || vaśiṣṭhasya gṛhe cāste tāpasī brahmaputrikā | vasiṣṭho’pi sarasvatyāstaṭe cāste nijāśrame || 7 || jñātvā cukopa cātyarthaṃ śaśāpa ca sarasvatīm | bhava raktajalā yatra vasiṣṭho na vaset kvacit || 8 || ātharvaṇena mantreṇa viśvāmitrābhicārataḥ | sarasvatī tadā tūrṇaṃ jātā raktajalā yataḥ || 9 || apeyaṃ tajjalaṃ jātaṃ daivānāṃ karmavarjitam | bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ peyaṃ jñātvā vihāya tat || 1.507.10 || tattīrasthā yayurdūraṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ puṣkaraṃ yayau | dhārā śaktirdevatā ca vāsaṃ cakāra sarvadā || 1 1|| sarasvatyā vasiṣṭhaścāvedito jalaśuddhaye | raktatāyā layārthaṃ ca puṣkare’rbudaparvate || 12|| vasiṣṭhaḥ prāha raktasya śuddhyarthaṃ tava sarvathā | yatiṣye gaccha deveśi sarvaṃ te sukhadaṃ yathā || 13 || vasiṣṭho yogamāsthāya cāvatīrya dharātale | plakṣavṛkṣasya mūle vai sarasvatyā jalānvite || 14|| kṛtvā samādhiṃ netrābhyāṃ lokayāmāsa cāntare | tāvatpṛthvītalācchuddhaṃ jalaṃ paramapāvanam || 15 || pravāharūpaṃ sambhūtaṃ sarasvatyāṃ yuyoja tat | tajjalaṃ sarvathā pūrṇaṃ sarasvatyāṃ babhūva ha || 16 || niṣkāsya salilaṃ raktaṃ vegena ca bahirbahiḥ | śuddhaṃ jalaṃ sarasvatyāstanmūlātsarvadāsti hi || 17|| śuddhavāryoghabalato raktaṃ niḥsāritaṃ jalam | pravāhaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ tat kṛtvā yātaṃ sthalāntaram || 18|| udvelaṃ sambhramadgacchadyātaṃ nimnasthalīṃ prati | sā tu sābhramatīnāmnī nadī jātā tadutthitā || 1 9|| athaikadā ṛṣiryājñavalkyaḥ sābhramatītaṭe | tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena niryayau bhaginīyutaḥ ||1.507.20|| kaṃsārikābhidhā sā ca bālyādvai brahmacāriṇī | tāpasī saṃyamaprāptā jñānānandamayī satī ||2 1|| yājñavalkyasya bhāginī vaiṣṇavī cārtavavṛṣā | ṛtudharmaṃ samāpannā yātrāyāṃ tena hetunā ||22|| yājñavalkyaḥ sthitiṃ cakre saptāhaṃ saritastaṭe | vṛkṣo’dhaḥparṇaśālāyāṃ bhaginī tvaparoṭaje ||23 || yājñavalkyasya daivāddhi svapnadoṣo babhūva ha | retoyuktaṃ paridhānaṃ samuttārya bahiḥsthale || 24|| sthāpayitvā punā rātrau supto nidrāṃ jagāma ha | atha kaṃsārikā mūtraśaucārthaṃ tu kṣaṇāntare || 29|| ūṭajādbahirāyātā dadarśa patitāmbaram | mūtraśaucaṃ vidhāyaivāmbaraṃ saṃgṛhya coṭaje ||26 || suṣvāpa śayane sādhvī cottānā ca tataḥ punaḥ | klinnayonyantaraṃ bhāgaṃ praveśitāmbareṇa sā ||27|| savīryakājñānavatī mārjayāmāsa vai muhuḥ | vastraretaso yogena yoniḥ klinnā viśeṣataḥ ||28 || punastenaiva vastreṇa mārjayāmāsa vai muhuḥ | svayonestu malaṃ matvā mārjayāmāsa cāntaram || 29|| evaṃ tvamogharetastad bhagamadhye’nvasaṃcarat | rajasā miśritaṃ garbharūpaṃ babhūva tattadā || 1.507.30 || atha prātaḥ samutthāya yājñavalkyo’mbaraṃ nijam | anveṣayāmāsa bahiḥ prāptaṃ naivāmbaraṃ yataḥ || 31 || papraccha bhaginīṃ dhautraṃ jñātaṃ prāptaṃ nu vā tvayā | sā prāhātra mayā bhrātaḥ rakṣitaṃ śayane mama ||32|| bhrātā prāha mayā tena snātavyaṃ dehi me svasaḥ | svasā prāha nayiṣye’haṃ kṣālanārthaṃ nadītaṭam ||3 3 || yāhi tvaṃ cāmbaraṃ nītvā cāyāmyeva kṣaṇāntare | ityuktaḥ sa yayau nadyāṃ sāpi śaṃkitamānasā || 34|| dadarśa dhautraṃ vistārya śeṣaṃ dhātuṃ tadantare | śuṣkāyamānaṃ saṃvīkṣya jātaśaṃkā babhūva ha || 35|| cintayāmāsa satataṃ mayā yonyantare muhuḥ | klinnabhāvasya nāśārthaṃ vastraṃ praveśitaṃ tadā ||36 || yonirviśeṣataḥ klinnā saṃbabhūva punaḥ punaḥ | rajo me niḥsṛtaṃ cāpi dhātuyogena vai dhruvam ||37|| idānīṃ jñātamevaitatkāraṇaṃ gopyameva tat | yadi garbho bhavenme’tra daivaṃ hi balavattaram || 38|| itijñātvā saṃvicārya śokaṃ cakāra bhāminī | gopayāmāsa māsāntaṃ tataḥ prāha sahodaram || 39 || mayā kāryaṃ vrataṃ bhrātargantavyaṃ ca nijāśramam | mithilāviṣaye yatra vrataṃ vai pūrṇatāṃ vrajet ||1.507.40 || ityuktvā prayayau nijaṃ cāśramaṃ tadvane śubhe | gaurīṃ sampūjayāmāsa vratenānaśanena vai ||41 || saptāhe saṃvyatīte tu gaurī sākṣāt samāyayau | kaṃsāriktā jagādedaṃ garbho me bhrātṛretasaḥ ||42|| manye tiṣṭhati hyudare daiva tadbalavattaram | tasya vṛddhiṃ mānasīṃ ca kuru saubhāgyasundari ||43 || yathā nānye ca jānīyustathā janma samarpaya | gaurī tathāstviti prāha pasparśa pāṇinodaram ||44|| garbhaḥ pakvaḥ kṣaṇājjāto bālaḥ sampūrṇa eva ca | suṣuve bālakaṃ gaurīsannidhau tatkṣaṇāt satī ||45|| nālacchedaṃ svayaṃ gaurī cakāra śuddhiprabhṛti | kaṃsārikā vratavyājānna niḥsasāra vai bahiḥ ||46|| gauryuktarītimāśritya rātrau śānte vane ca sā | veṣṭitaṃ sūkṣmavastreṇa bālaṃ nītvā ravidyutim ||47|| nātidūraṃ yayau śreṣṭhamaśvatthaṃ vijanasthale | tasyādhastādvimucyātha vākyametaduvāca ha ||48|| aśvattha viṣṇurūpo’si tvaṃ deveṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ | tasmād rakṣasva me putraṃ sarvatastvaṃ vanaspate ||49|| eṣa te śaraṇaṃ prāpto mama putrastu bālakaḥ | salajjāyā nirdayāyāstasmād vṛkṣa prapoṣaya ||1.507.50 || evamuktvā sutasnehād ruroda cāprakāśitam | tāvattatrāgatā ṣaṣṭhīdevī yā manasābhidhā ||5 1 || bālānāṃ rakṣikā yā sampreṣitā śivayoṣitā | prāhaināṃ mā rurodātra kariṣye tvasya rakṣaṇam ||52|| gaccha maunaṃ svāśramaṃ tvaṃ dāsye bālaṃ prapoṣitam | tubhyaṃ mā khida sādhvi tvaṃ sukhaṃ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati ||53 || tathāpi śaṃkamānā tāṃ rākṣasīṃ praruroda sā | tāvadākāśajā vāṇī sañjātā meghaniḥsvanā ||54|| mā tvaṃ śokaṃ kuruṣvāsya bālakasya kṛte śubhe | eṣa śāpādutathyasya jyeṣṭhabhrāturbṛhaspateḥ ||55|| avatīrṇo tava kukṣau bṛhaspatiḥ svayaṃ guruḥ | eṣa cātharvaṇaṃ vedaṃ śatakalpaṃ savistaram ||56|| saptabhedaṃ ca navadhā pañca kalpaṃ kariṣyati | janmayogī pippalasya rasaṃ saṃbhakṣayiṣyati ||57|| ayaṃ vai pippalādeti nāmnā khyāto bhaviṣyati | eṣā ṣaṣṭhī mahādevī rakṣāṃ tvasya kariṣyati ||18|| ityuktā prayayau tatra yatra svasyāśramaḥ śubhaḥ | atha sā cintayā nityaṃ putrapragatamānasā ||59|| samayaṃ nirjanaṃ labdhvā muhuryāti sutaṃ prati | rakṣitaṃ hasamānaṃ ca puṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā mumoda ha ||1.507.60 || cumbanaṃ stanyapānādi kṛtvā datvā prayāti vai | atha vanyajanaiḥ putraścāvalokita eva saḥ ||6 1 || ṛṣyāśrameṣu sā vārtā prasasāra bahusthale | daivaputraḥ pippalādaḥ plakṣavṛkṣe hi vartate ||62|| ṛṣisaṃghāstu taṃ draṣṭuṃ prayānti pippalasthitam | kaścicced grahītuṃ yāti bālaḥ prayātyadarśanam ||63|| ṣaṣṭhīdevī karotyevāntardhānaṃ bālakasya vai | śrutvāścaryaṃ yājñavalkyo yayau taddarśanāya vai ||64|| ekākyeva ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā svānurūpaguṇāśrayam | kathaṃ cāyaṃ mama rūpaṃ prāptavānityacintayat ||65|| bālaḥ prāha pitaste’stu namaskāro mama prabho | jātismaro’sti tvadvīryādutpanno’haṃ bṛhaspatiḥ ||66|| kaṃsārikā ca mātā me svāpnavastrasya yogataḥ | suṣuve māṃ pārvatīvākyācca pippalavṛkṣake ||67|| poṣaṇārthaṃ dhṛtavatī ṣaṣṭhī rakṣati māṃ sadā | tāvatkātyāyanī prāptā maitreyī jñānaśevadhiḥ ||68|| sakhyastvanyā vananāryaścāgatāstatra saṃbhramāḥ | kaṃsārikāpi cāyātā bālaṃ draṣṭuṃ suharṣitā ||69|| sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ bālaḥ pippalādo hi yogirāṭ | jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ pippalaskandhamāśritaḥ ||1.507.70|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | śrutvā kaṃsārikā putraṃ prārthayāmāsa mānase ||71 || mama muktiṃ kuru putra kṛtakṛtyā bhavāmi ca | vṛthā vai lokanindāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ me na yad bhavet ||72|| putraḥ sasmāra ca jñātvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim | āyayau śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vimānaśobhitaḥ ||73|| kaṃsārikā sutaṃ kṛtvā vakṣasyatha cucumba ca | stanyaṃ dadau tatastena varṣmaṇā divyatāṃ gatā ||74|| tenaiva divyadehena vimānavaramāsthitā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamantraṃ gṛhītvā vaiṣṇavī tataḥ ||75|| sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ vyomnā golokaṃ prajagāma ha | āścaryaṃ paramaṃ dṛṣṭvā yājñavalkyo mahāmuniḥ ||76|| ṣaṣṭhīdevyā mukhāt sarvaṃ viditvā vṛttameva tat | niścikāya sutaṃ svasya gopayāmāsa tadvṛttam ||77|| yayau naijāśramaṃ putraṃ dattvāśīrvādamuttamam | kasyacittvatha kālasya nārado munisattamaḥ ||78||| nirgatastena mārgeṇa dṛṣṭvā sūryābhabālakam | papraccha vismayāviṣṭa ekākī ko bhavāniha ||79|| kva te mātā pitā cāpi kimarthaṃ tviha tiṣṭhasi | nivatsyasi kathaṃ cātra sarvaṃ me vistarād vada ||1.507.80|| pippalāda uvācainaṃ kā mātā kaḥ pitā mataḥ | nāradaḥ prāha garbhasya dhāriṇī janmadāyinī ||81|| kṣetraṃ mātā matā bījādhāyakastu pitā mataḥ | bālaḥ prāhājñabālasya bhānaṃ kṣetrasya vai katham |||82|| bījasyāpi kathaṃ bhānaṃ pitrorbhānaṃ tu bāndhavaiḥ | na ca me bāndhavāḥ santi vṛkṣo’yaṃ me samāśrayaḥ ||83|| pippalo’yaṃ pitā me’sti ṣaṣṭhī manasā mātṛkā | ityevamātraṃ saṃvedmi vada māṃ ko bhavāniha ||84|| nāradastu tadā prāha yājñavalkyasya retasā | kaṃsārikāyāṃ jāto’si pitarau te tato matau ||85|| bālaḥ prāha kathaṃ cātra tiṣṭhāmīti vadātra me | nāradaścāha devānāṃ gurustvaṃ vai bṛhaspatiḥ ||86|| utathyabhāryāsaṃhartā utathyaśāpadoṣataḥ | jāto’syatra bālarūpaḥ pippalādo mahāmuniḥ ||87|| atharvavedo yaścaiṣaḥ śataśākho’sti mānave | śatakalpaśca gūḍhārtho rājñāmadhyayanāya vai ||88|| navaśākhaḥ pañcakalpaḥ prasannārthasukhāgamaḥ | tvayā samyak pariṣkṛto vyākhyātaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ||89|| tadarthaṃ te’tra janmāsti mātā te mokṣaṇaṃ gatā | pitā te yājñavalkyo’sti tatpārśvaṃ tvamito vraja ||1.507.90|| ahaṃ vai nāradaścāsmi brahmaputraḥ suvaiṣṇavaḥ | gṛhāṇa vaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ mālāṃ ca tulasīkṛtām ||91 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | ityuktvā pradadau mantraṃ mālāṃ cāpi dadau ca tam ||92|| bālaḥ prāha vane vāsaḥ kathaṃ me duḥkhahetukaḥ | kathaṃ mātṛviyogo me vadātra kāraṇaṃ mune ||93|| nāradaḥ prāha janmasthaḥ śaniste tena cedṛśīm | avasthāṃ tvaṃ gato’sīti nānyat tatra hi kāraṇam ||94|| bālaḥ śrutvā ruṣā cordhvaṃ taṃ dadarśa śanaiścaram | tasya dṛṣṭinipātena nyapatat tatkṣaṇācchaniḥ ||95|| nāradaśca śaniṃ prāha mā tvaṃ vīkṣaya bālakam | hāniṃ viśeṣataste’yaṃ kariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||96|| bālaṃ prāha prakopaṃ tvaṃ saṃharātra śanaiścare | grahā gāvo narendrāśca santaśca brāhmaṇāstathā ||97|| pūjitāḥ pratipūjyante nirdahantyavamānitāḥ | śaninā vīkṣitau svasya pādau janmakṣaṇe tadā ||98|| dagdhāvubhau tataścānyaṃ bhasmarāśiṃ karotyayam | yadi paśyati netrābhyāṃ tādṛśo raudranetrakaḥ ||99|| pūjanīyo na ca bāla hyavamānyaḥ kadācana | śrutvaivaṃ pippalādaḥ saḥ stutiṃ cakre śubhāvahām || 1.507.100 || namaste krūranetrāya piṃgalāya namo’stu te | namaste kṛṣṇavarṇāya bhasmakartre namo’stu te || 101 || namaste raudradehāya sauraye te namonamaḥ | namaste mandavārāya śanaiścara namo’stu te || 1 02|| śrutvā stutiṃ śaniḥ prāha parituṣṭo’smi sarvathā | varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te mamāpi bhadramastu ca || 1 03|| pippalādo varaṃ vavre bālānāṃ pīḍanaṃ tvayā | adyaprabhṛti vai kvāpi na kāryaṃ dehi me varam ||1 04|| yāvadaṣṭatamaṃ varṣaṃ bāle te pīḍanaṃ nahi | stotuḥ pīḍā na te’pyastu vāre pūjayituśca te || 1 05|| tathā te na ca pīḍāstu tailābhyaṃgavidhāyinaḥ | yastvāṃ lohamayaṃ kṛtvā tailamadhye tvadhomukham || 1 06|| dhārayet tena tailena tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret | tasya pīḍā na kartavyā deyo lābho mahībhuje || 1 07|| sārdhasaptī tava yasya sa tilān lohasaṃyutān | dadāti tava vāre yastasya kāryaṃ na pīḍanam || 1 08|| kṛṣṇagodānakartuśca kāryaṃ na pīḍanaṃ tvayā | śamīsamidbhirhomasya kartuste māstu pīḍanam || 1 09|| kṛṣṇapuṣpānulepaiśca kṛṣṇatilaiśca guggulaiḥ | kṛṣṇavastraiśca te pūjākarturmāstu prapīḍanam || 1.507.11 0||| evamuktaḥ śanistena bāḍhamuktvā tataḥ param | bālaṃ hyuvāca gatyarthaṃ punarna patanaṃ yathā || 111 || bālaḥ prāha yatheṣṭaṃ tvaṃ gaccha saurya nijālayam | ityuktaḥ sa yayau svargaṃ nārado bālakena ca || 112| pūjitaśca yayau satyalokaṃ tataḥ sa bālakaḥ | ṣaṣṭhīdevyā samānīto yājñavalkyasya sannidhau || 1 13|| arpitaścopanītaśca yājñavalkyena bālakaḥ | pippalādaścamatkārī yogīndro vedavidṛṣiḥ || 1 14|| samabhavanmahāvīryo lokakalyāṇakārakaḥ | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi vṛttaṃ pāpavināśanam || 1 15|| yaścaitatpuṇyamākhyānaṃ paṭhedvā śṛṇuyācca vā | agamyāgamanaṃ pāpaṃ śamaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ || 116 || upasargabhaye jāte tasya caughaḥ praśāmyati | śanaiḥ śanairasandigdhaṃ pippalādavacobalāt || 1 17|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sābhramatyā utpattiḥ, yājñavalkyasya bhaginyāṃ pippalādotpattiḥ, bṛhaspatiḥ pippalādo jātaḥ, śanaiścarapūjādicetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||507||
<1.508> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tvayā pūrvaṃ gaurī vai pañcapiṇḍikā | pūjitā tena saṃlabdhaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ || 1 || gauryā darśanamātreṇa nārī saubhāgyamāpnuyāt | jyeṣṭhe śukle vṛṣabhasthe ravau tāṃ jalamarpayet || 2 || jalamantreṇa yā nityaṃ sā saubhāgyaṃ śubhaṃ labhet | na sā vandhyā pratiṣṭheta kākavandhyāpi naiva ca || 3 || na daurbhāgyaṃ labhet kvāpi satapjanmāntarāṇi ca | pṛthivyāpaśca tejaśca vāyurākāśamityapi || 4 || pañcabhiḥ racayed gaurīṃ sā proktā pañcapiṇḍikā | sahasraguṇitaṃ puṇyaṃ pañcapiṇḍāprapūjane || 5 || kāśīrājaḥ purā cāsījjayasenaḥ pratāpavān | tasya patnīsahasraṃ tu hyāsīt tatra priyottamā || 6 || amānāmnī madrarājaviśvaksenasutābhavat | amā prage samutthāya snātvā gaṃgātaṭe śubhām || 7 || pañcapiṇḍātmikāṃ gaurīṃ kṛtvā kardamasaṃbhavām | tataḥ sampūjayāmāsa satī ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ || 8 || tato visṛjya tāṃ devīṃ datvā dānāni sā gṛham | prayātyeva sma sadā ca saubhāgyaṃ vardhate sadā || 9 || rūpaṃ ca yauvanaṃ kāntaprītiśca dhanyamānyatā | vardhante’syā vilokyaitat sapatnyo duḥkhitāstadā || 1.508.1 0|| tanmūlaṃ pūjanaṃ gauryā jñātvā draṣṭuṃ ca tā yayuḥ | yatra pūjayati gaurīṃ sā kṛtvā pañcapiṇḍikām || 11 || amā cotthāya tāstatra mānayitvāsanaṃ dadau | tāḥ papracchuramāṃ nityasaubhāgyavṛddhikāraṇam || 12| amā prasannamanasā sapatnīḥ prāha pūrvakṛt | ahamāsaṃ purā śūdrā vīrasenasya kanyakā || 13|| kusume nagare cāpi vivāho me’bhavat tadā | vipramukhānmayā gaurīpūjā saubhāgyadā śrutā || 14|| gaurīpūjāṃ vinā kvāpi pātavyaṃ na jalaṃ tvapi | yena saṃprāpyate’bhīṣṭaṃ pūjā puṇyena cepsitam || 15|| tatastatra janau pūjā kṛtā mayā tu nityadā | pūjayitvā piṇḍagaurīṃ prakṣipāmi jale sadā || 16 || atha kāntaśca me yātastīrthārthaṃ dvārikāṃ prati | saha nītvā ca māṃ prāpto nirjalaṃ marumaṇḍalam || 17|| sūryastapati raudre ca vṛṣasthe’titṛṣāprade | sārthastṛṣāturo jāto jalaṃ marumarīcijam || 18 || mṛṣā vai dṛśyate satyaṃ jalaṃ prāptaṃ na tatsthale | ahaṃ tṛṣākulā jātā smṛtā gaurī mayā tadā || 1 9|| pañcabhirmuṣṭibhistaptavālukābhiḥ sunirmitā | gaurī prapūjitā vācā hṛdā tato mṛtā hyaham ||1.508.20|| tatpuṇyena daśārṇādhipateḥ kanyābhavaṃ śubhā | bhavatīnāṃ kaniṣṭhāsmi jyeṣṭhāsmi gaurikārcanāt ||21 || jātismarāsmi saṃjātā tatsmṛtvā cātra nityadā | pūjayāmi kardamena kṛtvā tāṃ pañcapiṇḍikām ||22| tenātra vardhate nityaṃ saubhāgyaṃ vividhaṃ mama | puṇyaṃ ca vardhate divyaṃ divyabhāvapradāyakam ||23| sarvā mama bhaginyaḥ stha īrṣyādharmo na me’sti ca | pūjayantu bhavatyo’pi saubhāgyaṃ lapsyatha dhruvam ||24| satyenānena me gaurī mamābhīṣṭaṃ prayacchatu | prayacchatu bhavatīnāmabhīṣṭaṃ sā harapriyā ||25| ityuktāstāḥ sapatnyaśca pupūjurgaurikāṃ tataḥ | pūjāmantrāstayā sādhvyā dattāstābhyaśca tatkṣaṇe ||26| ye tvayā tu mahālakṣmi hyuccāritāḥ purārcane | namaḥpṛthivyai kṣāntīśi nama āpomaye śubhe || 27. tejasvini namastubhyaṃ namaste vāyurūpiṇa | ākāśarūpasampanne pañcarūpe namonamaḥ ||28 ebhirmantraistvayā lakṣmi pūjitā pañcapiṇḍikā | tena vaikuṇṭharājyaṃ tvaṃ prāptavatī sudurlabham ||29 evaṃ yā pūjayennārī gaurikāṃ pañcapiṇḍikām | ṣoḍaśopakaraṇaiḥ sā sadyaḥ syāt pativallabhā ||1.508.3 0 śṛṇu lakṣmi tataścāmā cintayāmāsa vai hṛdi | saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ labdhaṃ durlabhaṃ sarvayoṣitām ||31 na cāpatyaṃ mama jātaṃ tena dahyāmi vai muhuḥ | athaivaṃ vartamānāyāṃ durvāsāścāyayau drutam ||32 jayaseno nṛpaścake svāgataṃ cāsanaṃ dadau | datvārghaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca tataḥ papraccha taṃ munim || 33 śiṣyaṃ kṛtvā kṛpāpātraṃ pavitrīkṛtavānasi | adya dhanyatamo jātaḥ sakuṭumbastavāgamāt || 34 tad brūhi kiṃ karomyadya gṛhāyātasya te mune | durvāsāḥ prāha rājam̐ste mandire saṃvasannaham ||35 cāturmāsyavidhānaṃ saṃkariṣye sukhapūrvakam | mṛttikāgrahaṇaṃ yāvacchuśrūṣā kriyatāṃ mama ||36 || bāḍhamityevamuktvā tacchuśrūṣā kṛtavānnṛpaḥ | amā nityaṃ susevāyāṃ vartate’ti nṛpājñayā ||37|| cāturmāsyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ yadā saṃprasthito muniḥ | tadā provāca santuṣṭo rājan kiṃ karavāṇi te ||38 rājñā sa ṛṣirāṭ proktaścāmāpatyaṃ vinā mune | dahatyeva sadā tasmāt kuru tāṃ putramātaram || 39 || muniḥ prāha śṛṇu kṣmeśa tvayaṃ vai pūrvajanmani | mṛtyukāle taptavālukānāṃ gaurīṃ vidhāya tām | | 1.508.40 | | pūjayāmāsa tenātra rājyaṃ prāptavatī satī | gaurī yattāpasaṃyuktavālukābhiḥ kṛtānayā || 41 || tatphalaṃ ca vinā putramudvego’syā hi sarvadā | na devo vidyate kāṣṭhe pāṣāṇe mṛttikāsu ca || 42 | | bhāve hi vidyate devo mantrabhaktyādibhiryute | saiṣā gaurīṃ kardamena kṛtvā vai pañcapiṇḍikām | | 43 || hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre gatvā saṃpūjayed yadi | vṛṣasthe bhāskare dadyājjaladhārāmakhaṇḍitām || 44|| tataḥ kṣetrabalāccāpi puṇyodayo bhaviṣyati | yathā yathā jalād gauryāḥ śītabhāvo bhaviṣyati || 45| | tathā tathāsyā dāho’pi śāntiṃ yāsyatyaharniśam | dāhānte bhavitā garbhastataḥ putramavāpsyati || 46 || athāsti ca vrataṃ puṇyaṃ gaurītuṣṭikaraṃ param | yena cīrṇena vai nārī devatātvamavāpnuyāt || 47|| gomayākhyā mahādevī kartavyā gomayena vai | bhādre kṛṣṇe tṛtīyāyāṃ prātardantān viśodhayet ||48 || upavāsasya niyamaṃ gṛhṇīyād gaurikāṃ smaran | niśāgame mṛnmayaṃ vai kāryaṃ gaurīcatuṣṭayam || 49 || ekā gaurī prakartavyā pañcapiṇḍā yathoditā | prahare prahare prāpte tāsu pūjāṃ samācaret || 1.508.50 || himācalagṛhe jātā devi tvaṃ śaṃkarapriye | menāgarbhasamudbhūtā pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa te namaḥ | | 51 | | dhūpaṃ karpūrakaṃ raktavartikaṃ ghṛtadīpakam | jātīpuṣpāṇi naivedyaṃ modakānarghamarpayet || 5 2 || mātuluṅgakusumāḍhyamarghaṃ gṛhāṇa te namaḥ | dvitīye praharānte’rdhanārīśvarīṃ prapūjayet| || 53 || agurucandanaṃ dhūpaṃ naivedyaṃ guḍamarghakam | dadennārīkerayuktamarghaṃ vai mantratastadā || 54| | argho me gṛhyatāṃ devau pārvatīparameśvarau | tṛtīye prahare prāpte śatapatryā prapūjayet || 55 || gugguladhūpaṃ naivedyaṃ sajātīsalilārghakam | granthicūrṇena dhūpaṃ ca svarghaṃ madanajaṃ phalam || 56 || dadyātpunastataḥ prāpte caturthe prahare tvatha | gaurīṃ tāṃ pañcapiṇḍāṃ vai bhṛṃgarājena pūjayet | | 57 || pañcabhūtamayī gaurī gṛhṇātvarghaṃ mayārpitam | naivedyaṃ dhūpadīpādi puṣpāñjaliṃ samarpayet ||58|| kuryānnīrājanaṃ sveṣṭaprārthanāṃ jāgaraṃ caret | nṛtyaṃ vādyaṃ kīrtanaṃ sotsavaṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥ ||59|| prabhāte viprayugalaṃ snātvā prapūjayed vratī | kareṇuṃ vaḍavāṃ vārohayed gaurīcatuṣṭayam ||1.508.60|| savādyotsavaśabdena nadyādau tāṃ parikṣipet | āhūtāsi mayā devī pūjitāsi mayā śubhe ||6 1|| mama saubhāgyadānāya yatheṣṭaṃ gamyatāmiti | evaṃ lakṣmyā kṛtā pūrvaṃ pūjā gauryā viśeṣataḥ ||62|| bhādrakṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ caturṣu prahareṣu ca | prātargauryaṃstayā dṛṣṭā ratnaprabhāvibhūṣitāḥ ||6 3|| tāścocustāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ mā no jale pravāhaya | mandiraṃ kārayitvātra hāṭakeśvarakṣetrake ||64|| sthāpayāsmān vratārthaṃ ca nārīṇāṃ sukhakāriṇīḥ | iti tāḥ sthāpitāstatra lakṣmyā bhāgyasutapradāḥ ||65 || seyaṃ rājam̐stava patnī gaurīcatuṣṭayaṃ tathā | gaurīṃ ca gomayīṃ cāpi pañcapiṇḍātmikāṃ tathā ||66 || kṛtvā saṃpūjayet tena putrasaubhāgyamāpnuyāt | tathā prāpyeta ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ svayam ||67|| ityuktvā prayayau śīghraṃ durvāsāścātha sā satī | amānāmnī yayau kṣetraṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam ||68|| kṛtvā sarvaṃ vidhānena babhūva putramātṛkā | bahukālottare cāmā lakṣmīrūpā babhūva ha ||6 9|| divyadehā gatā viṣṇorvaikuṇṭhe dāsikābhavat | ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi tavāmāyāśca tadvratam ||1.508.70|| yā tvetatpaṭhate bhaktyā gaurīpūjāphalaṃ labhet | na sā lakṣmyā viyujyeta na ca daurbhāgyamāpnuyāt ||71 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kāśīrājapatnyā amayā kṛtaṃ pañcapiṇḍikāgaurīvrataṃ tena putrasaubhāgyaprāptirlakṣmītvaprāptiścetinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 508 ||
<1.509> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmyaikadā satye brahmāṇaṃ prati nāradaḥ | darśanārthaṃ yayau bhrāntvā lokatrayaṃ nanāma tam || 1 || brahmā papraccha ca kutaḥ putra āgamyate, vada | nāradaḥ prāha martyānāṃ maṇḍalāni vilokya ca || 2 || tava pūjāvidhānāya vijñāpayituṃ hṛdgatam | samāgato’smi ca pitaḥ śrutvā kuru yathocitam || 3 || daityānāṃ hi balaṃ loke sarvatrāsti pravartitam | yajñāśca satyadharmāśca satkarmāṇi ca sarvathā || 4 || prasahya tairvināśyante devā bhaktāśca duḥkhinaḥ | tasmād yatheṣṭaṃ bhagavan kalyāṇaṃ kartumarhasi || 5 || ityevaṃ vinivedyaiva natvā sampūjya saṃyayau | brahmā vai cintayāmāsa yajñārthaṃ śubhabhūtalam || 6 || nirvighnaṃ tatsthalaṃ kvāstītyājñātuṃ padmapuṣpakam | karasthaṃ sa samuvāca pata sthale tu pāvane || 7 || tataścikṣepa puṣpaṃ tad bhrāntvā lokān samantataḥ | hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre sampapāta supāvane || 8 || etasminnantare prāptaḥ paścāt tasya pitāmahaḥ | kṣetraṃ dṛṣṭvā prasanno’bhūd yajñārthaṃ prapitāmahaḥ || 9 || ādideśa tato vāyuṃ samānaya purandaram | ādityairvasubhiḥ sārdhaṃ rudraiścaiva marudgaṇaiḥ || 1.509.10 || gandharvairlokapālaiśca siddhairvidyādharaistathā | ye ca me syuḥ sahāyāstaiḥ samaste yajñakarmaṇi || 11 || vāyuścendraṃ devagaṇairyutaṃ samānināya ca | brahmā prāha mahendraṃ ca vaiśākhyāmagniṣṭomakam || 1 2|| yajñaṃ kartuṃ samīhe’tra sambhārānāharasva vai | brāhmaṇām̐śca tadarhān vai yogyopaskārakām̐stathā || 1 3|| indrastānānayāmāsa saṃbhārām̐śca dvijottamān | ārebhe ca tato yajñaṃ vidhivat prapitāmahaḥ || 14|| śaṃbhurdevagaṇaiḥ sārdha tatra yajñe samāgataḥ | devān brahmā samuvāca svasvasthāneṣu tiṣṭhata || 15|| viśvakarman kuru yajñamaṇḍapaṃ yajñavedikāḥ | patnīśālāḥ sadaścāpi kuṇḍānyāvaśyakāni ca || 66|| yajñapātrāṇi ca gṛhān camasām̐śca caṣālakān | yūpān śayanagartāṃśca sthaṇḍilāni prakāraya ||17|| hiraṇmayaṃ supuruṣaṃ kāraya tvaṃ surūpiṇām | bṛhaspate tvamānīhi yajñārhānṛtvijo’khilān || 18|| yāvat ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyākān śuśrūṣāṃ kuru devarāḍ | kubera ca tvayā deyā dakṣiṇā kālasaṃbhavā ||1 9|| tvayā vidhe vidhau kāryaṃ kṛtyākṛtyaparīkṣaṇam | lokapālāḥ prarakṣantu tvaindryādikā diśastathā |||1.509.20||| bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ praveśo daityarakṣasām | mā bhūdityatha yajñena dīyatāṃ dānamuttamam ||21 || ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ | bhavantu pariveṣṭāro bhoktukāmajanasya tu ||22|| yajñārhā brāhmaṇā vṛttāstiṣṭhantu yajñamaṇḍape | maitrāvaruṇaścyavano’tharvāko gālavastathā ||23|| marīcirmārkavaścaite sarvakarmaviśāradāḥ | prasthānakartā cādhvaryuḥ pulastyastatra tiṣṭhatu ||24|| raibhyo munistathonnetā tiṣṭhatu yajñamaṇḍape | brahmā bhavatu nārado gargo’stu satravīkṣakaḥ || 25|| hotāro’gnīdhrabharadvājaparāśarāstrayaḥ | bṛhaspatistathācārya udgātā gobhilo muniḥ ||26|| śāṇḍilyaḥ pratihartā ca subrahmaṇyastathāṅgirāḥ | asya yajñasya siddhyarthaṃ santvṛtvijastu ṣoḍaśa ||27|| brahmā tān pūjayāmāsa dīkṣitastaistu viśvasṛṭ | yajamāno’bhavad yajñakāryaṃ tataḥ pravartitam ||28|| brahmā ca nāradaṃ prāha sāvitrīṃ kṣipramānaya | vādyamāneṣu vādyeṣu siddhakinnaraguhyakaiḥ ||29||| gandharvairvādyasaṃyuktairuccāraṇaparairdvijaiḥ | araṇiṃ samupādāya pulastyo vākyamabravīt ||1.509.3 0||| patnīpatnītiviprendrāḥ proccaistatra vyavasthitaḥ | brahmā punarnāradaṃ saṃjñayā karasya vai drutam ||3 1 || gṛhaṃ sampreṣayāmāsa patnī cānīyatāmiti | so’pi gatvāha sāvitrīṃ pitrā sampreṣito’smyaham ||32|| āgaccha maṇḍapaṃ devi yajñakāryaṃ pravartate | paramekākinī kīdṛgrūpā sadasi dṛśyase ||33|| ānīyantāṃ tato devyastābhirvṛttā prayāsyasi | ityuktvā prayayau yajñe nārado’jamuvāca ha ||34|| devībhiḥ saha sāvitrī samāyāsyati sukṣaṇam | punastaṃ preṣayāmāsa brahmātha nārado yayau ||35|| mātaḥ śīghraṃ samāyāhi devībhiḥ parivāritā | sāvitryapi tadā prāha yāmi keśān prasādhya vai ||36|| nārado’jaṃ prāha keśān prasādhyāyāti vai tataḥ | somapānamuhūrtasyāvaśeṣe satvaraṃ tadā || 37 || pulastyaśca yayau tatra sāvitrī tvekalāsti hi | kiṃ devi sālasā bhāsi gaccha śīghraṃ kratoḥ sthalam ||38|| sāvitryuvāca taṃ brūhi muhūrtaṃ paripālyatām | yāvadabhyeti śakrāṇī gaurī lakṣmīstathāparāḥ ||39|| devakanyāḥ samāje’tra tābhireṣyāmi saṃhitā | so’pi gatvā drutaṃ prāha somabhārārditaṃ vidhim ||1.509.40|| sā māṃ prāha ca devībhiḥ sahitāyāmi vai makhe | ahaṃ yāsyāmi sahitā na tvekalā kathaṃcana ||41 || evaṃ jñātvā suraśreṣṭha kuru yatte surocate | atikrāmati kālaśca yajñapānakṣaṇātmakaḥ ||42|| śrutvā brahmā mahendraṃ ca prāha sā śithilātmikā | nāyātyevānyayā patnyā yajñaḥ kāryo bhavatviti ||43|| brahmājñayā bhramamāṇāṃ kanyāṃ kāṃcit sureśvaraḥ | candrāsyāṃ gopajāṃ tanvīṃ kalaśavyagramastakām ||44|| yuvatīṃ sukumārīṃ ca papraccha kāsi kanyake | gopakanyeti sā prāha takraṃ vikretumāgatā ||45|| parigṛhṇāsi cet takraṃ dehi mūlyaṃ drutaṃ mama | indro jagrāha tāṃ takrasahitāṃ gopakanyakām ||46|| gorvaktreṇāveśayitvā mūtreṇākarṣayat tataḥ | evaṃ medhyatamāṃ kṛtvā saṃsnāpya salilaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||47|| suvāsasī dhārayitvā nītvā dhṛtvājasannidhau | ānīteyaṃ tvadarthaṃ vai brahman sarvaguṇānvitā ||48|| gavāṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kulamekaṃ dvidhā kṛtam | ekatra mantrastiṣṭhanti havirekatra tiṣṭhati ||49|| gorudarād viniṣkrāntā prāpiteyaṃ dvijanmatām | pāṇigrahaṃ kuruṣvāsyā yajñapānaṃ samācara ||1.509.50 || rudraḥ prāha ca goyantraniṣkrānteyaṃ tataḥ khalu | gāyatrīnāmapatnī te bhavatvatra makhe sadā ||51 || brāhmaṇāstu tadā prāhureṣāstu brāhmaṇīvarā | gopajātivarjitāyāstvaṃ pāṇigrahaṇaṃ kuru ||52|| brahmā pāṇigrahaṃ cakre samārebhe śubhakriyām | gāyatryapi samādāya mūrdhni tāmaraṇiṃ mudā ||53|| vādyamāneṣu vādyeṣu samprāptā yajñamaṇḍapam | vidhiścakre svakeśānāṃ kṣaurakarma tataḥ param ||54|| viśvakarmā tu gāyatrīnakhacchedaṃ cakāra ha | audumbaraṃ tato daṇḍaṃ paulastyo brahmaṇe dadau ||55|| eṇaśṛṃgānvitaṃ carma samantraṃ pradadau tathā | patnīṃ śālāṃ gṛhītvā ca gāyatrīṃ maunadhāriṇīm ||56|| mekhalāṃ nidadhe tvanyāṃ kaṭyāṃ mauñjīmayīṃ śubhām | tato brahmā ca ṛtvigbhiḥ saha cakre kratukriyām ||57|| karmaṇi jāyamāne ca tatrāścaryamabhūnmahat | jālmarūpadharaḥ kaścid digvāsā vikṛtānanaḥ || 58|| kapālapāṇirāyāto bhojanaṃ dīyatāmiti | niṣidhyamāno’pi vipraiḥ praviṣṭo yajñamaṇḍapam ||59|| sadasyāstu tiraścakruḥ kastvaṃ pāpaḥ samāgataḥ | kapālī nagnarūpaścāpavitrakharparānvitaḥ ||1.509.6 0|| yajñabhūmiraśuddhā syād gaccha śīghramito bahiḥ | jālmaḥ prāha kathaṃ cāsmi hyaśuddho bhikṣuko vratī ||61 || brahmayajñamimaṃ jñātvā śuddhaḥ snātvā samāgataḥ | gopālakanyā nityaṃ yā śūdrī tvaśuddhajātikā ||62|| sthāpitātra nu sā śuddhā vipro’haṃ pāvano na kim | tāvat tatra samāyāto brāhmaṇo vṛddharūpavān ||63|| śrīkṛṣṇo vai tamuvāca pratyuttaraṃ śṛṇu priye | jālma naiṣāsti śūdrāṇī brāhmaṇī jātito’sti vai ||64|| śṛṇu jānāmi tadvṛttaṃ nānye jānantyatadvidaḥ | purā sṛṣṭe samārambhe śrīkṛṣṇena parātmanā ||65|| svāṃśarūpā hi sāvitrī svamūrteḥ prakaṭīkṛtā | atha dvitīyā kanyā ca pativratābhidhā kṛtā ||66|| kumāraśca kṛtaḥ patnīvratākhyo brāhmaṇastataḥ | brahmā vairājadehācca kṛtastasmai samarpitā ||67|| sāvitrī śrīhariṇaiva goloke eva sannidhau | atha yajñapravāhārthaṃ brahmā yajñaṃ kariṣyati ||68|| pṛthivyāṃ martyarūpeṇa tatra mānuṣavigrahā | patnī yajñasya kāryārthamapekṣitā bhaviṣyati ||69|| hetunānena kṛṣṇena sāvitryājñāpitā tadā | dvitīyena svarūpeṇa tvayā gantavyameva ha ||1.509.70|| prāgeva bhūtale kanyārūpeṇa brahmaṇaḥ kṛte | sāvitrī śrīkṛṣṇamāha kau tatra pitarau mama ||7 1 || śrīkṛṣṇastāṃ tadā sandarśayāmāsa śubhau tu tau | imau patnīvrato vipro viprāṇī ca pativratā ||72|| madaṃśau matsvarūpau cāyonijau divyavigrahau | pṛthvyāṃ kuṃkumavāpyāṃ vai kṣetre’śvapaṭṭasārase ||73 || sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe viprarūpau vartiṣyete’tipāvanau | vaiśvadevādiyajñādihavyādyarthaṃ gavānvitau ||74|| saurāṣṭre ca yadā brahmā yajñārthaṃ saṃgamiṣyati | tatpūrvaṃ tau gobhilaśca gobhilā ceti saṃjñitā ||72|| gavā prapālakau bhūtvānartadeśe gamiṣyataḥ | yatrābhīrā nivasanti tatsamau veṣakarmabhiḥ ||76|| daityakṛtārdanaṃ tena pracchannayorna vai bhavet | itiḥhetoryajñapūrvaṃ daityakleśabhiyā tu tau ||77|| śrīharerājñayānarte jātāvābhīrarūpiṇau | gavāṃ vai pālakau viprau pitarau ca tvayā hi tau ||78|| kartavyau gopaveṣau vai vastuto brāhmaṇāvubhau | madaṃśau tatra sāvitri tvayā dvitīyarūpataḥ ||79|| ayonijatayā putryā bhāvyaṃ vai divyayoṣitā | dadhidugdhādivikretryā gantavyaṃ tatsthale tadā ||1.509.80|| yadā yajño bhavet tatra tadā smṛtvā suyogataḥ | mānuṣyā tu tvayā nūtnavadhvā kratuṃ kariṣyati ||81 || sahabhāvaṃ gato brahmā gāyatrī tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi | brāhmaṇayoḥ sutā gūḍhā gopamadhyanivāsinoḥ ||82||| brahmāṇī ca tato bhūtvā satyalokaṃ gamiṣyasi | brāhmaṇāstvāṃ japiṣyanti martyalokagatāstataḥ ||83|| ityevaṃ jāyamānaiṣā gāyatrī brāhmaṇī sutā | vartate gopaveṣīyā nāśuddhā jātito hi sā ||84|| evaṃ pratyuttaritaḥ sa jālmaḥ kṛṣṇena vai tadā | tāvat tatra samāyātau gobhilāgobhilau mudā ||85|| asmatputryā mahadbhāgyaṃ brahmaṇā yā vivāhitā | āvayostu mahadbhāgyaṃ daityakaṣṭaṃ nivāryate ||86|| yajñadvāreṇa devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ satāṃ tathā | ityuktvā tau gopaveṣau tyaktvā brāhmaṇarūpiṇau ||87|| pitāmahau hi viprāṇāṃ paricitau mahātmanām | sarveṣāṃ pūrvajau tatra jātau divyau ca bhūsurau ||88|| brahmādyāśca tadā nemuścakruḥ satkāramādarāt | yajñe ca sthāpayāmāsuḥ sarvaṃ hṛṣṭāḥ surādayaḥ ||89|| brahmāṇaṃ mālayā kuṃkumākṣataiḥ kusumādibhiḥ | vardhayitvā sutāṃ tatra dadaturyajñamaṇḍape || 1.509.90|| vṛddho vai brāhmaṇastatra kṛṣṇarūpaṃ dadhāra ha | sarvaiśca vanditaḥ sādhu sādhvityāhuḥ surādayaḥ ||91 || jālmaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā gāyatrīpitarau tathā | dṛṣṭvā nanāma bhāvena prāha bhikṣāṃ pradehi me ||92|| bubhukṣito’smi viprendrā garhayantu na māṃ dvijāḥ | dīnāndhaiḥ kṛpaṇaiḥ sarvaistarpitairiṣṭirucyate || 93 || anyathā syādvināśāya kraturyuṣmatkṛto’pyayam | annahīno dahed rāṣṭraṃ mantrahīnastu ṛtvijaḥ ||94|| yājñikaṃ dakṣiṇāhīno nāsti yajñasamo ripuḥ | śrīkṛṣṇaśca tadā prāha jālme dadatu bhojanam ||95|| viprāḥ prāhuḥ khapparaṃ te tvaśuddhaṃ vidyate tataḥ | bahirniḥsara dāsyāmo bhikṣāṃ pārśvamahānase ||96|| etasyāmannaśālāyāṃ bhuñjanti yatra tāpasāḥ | dīnāndhāḥ kṛpaṇāścaiva tathā kṣutkṣāmakā dvijāḥ ||97|| aśuddhaṃ te kapālaṃ vai yajñabhūmerbahirnaya | gṛhāṇānyacchuddhapātraṃ dūraṃ prakṣipya khapparam ||98|| evamuktaśca jālmaḥ sa roṣāccikṣepa khapparam | yajñamaṇḍapamadhye ca svayaṃ tvadṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ||99|| sarvepyāścaryamāpannā viprā daṇḍena khapparam | cikṣipustadbahistāvad dvitīyaṃ samapadyata || 1.509.10 0|| tasminnapi parikṣipte tṛtīyaṃ samapadyata | evaṃ śatasahasrāṇi samapadyanta vai tadā || 101 || pariśrāntā brāhmaṇāśca yajñavāṭaḥ sakhapparaḥ | samantatastadā jāto hāhākaro hi sarvataḥ || 1 02|| brahmā vai prārthayāmāsa sannatvā tāṃ diśaṃ muhuḥ | kimidaṃ yujyate deva yajñe’smin karmaṇaḥ kṣatiḥ || 103 || tasmāt saṃhara sarvāṇi kapālāni maheśvara | yajñakarmavilopo’yaṃ mā bhūt tvayi samāgate || 1 04|| tataḥ śabdo’bhavad vyomnaḥ pātraṃ me medhyamasti vai | bhuktipātraṃ mama tvete kathaṃ nindanti bhūsurāḥ || 1 085|| tathā na māṃ samuddiśya juhuvurjātavedasi | yathānyā devatāstadvanmantrapūtaṃ havirvidhe || 1 06|| ato’tra māṃ samuddiśya viśeṣājjātavedasi | hotavyaṃ havirevātra samāptiṃ yāsyati kratuḥ || 107|| brahmā prāha tadā pratyuttaraṃ vyomni ca taṃ prati | tava rūpāṇi vai yoginnasaṃkhyāni bhavanti hi || 1 08|| kapālaṃ maṇḍape yāvad vartate tāvadeva ca | nātra camasakarma syāt khapparaṃ pātrameva na || 1 09|| yajñapātraṃ na tatproktaṃ yato’śuddhaṃ sadā hi tat | yadrūpaṃ yādṛśaṃ pātraṃ yādṛśaṃ karmaṇaḥ sthalam || 1.509.11 0|| tādṛśaṃ tatra yoktavyaṃ naitatpātrasya yojanam | mṛnmayeṣu kapāleṣu haviḥ pācyaṃ kratau matam || 111 || tasmāt kapālaṃ dūraṃ vai nīyatāṃ yat kraturbhavet | tvayā rūpaṃ kapālin vai yādṛśaṃ cātra darśitam || 1 12|| tasya rūpasya yajñe’smin puroḍāśe’dhikāritā | bhavatveva ca bhikṣāṃ saṃgṛhāṇa tṛptimāpnuhi || 11 3|| adyaprabhṛti yajñeṣu puroḍāśātmakaṃ dvijaiḥ | tavoddeśena deveśa hotavyaṃ śatarudrikam || 1 14|| viśeṣāt sarvayajñeṣu japyaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ | atra yajñaṃ samārabhya yastvā prāk pūjayiṣyati || 1 15|| avighnena kratustasya samāptiṃ pravrajiṣyati | evamukte tadāścaryaṃ jātaṃ śṛṇu tu padmaje || 1 16|| yānyāsam̐śca kapālāni tāni sarvāṇi tatkṣaṇam | rudrāṇyaścānnapūrṇā vai devyo jātāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 1 17|| sarvāstāḥ pārvatīrūpā annapūrṇātmikāḥ striyaḥ | bhikṣādātryo vinā yābhirbhikṣā naivopapadyate || 1 18||| tāvacchrīśaṃkaraścāpi prahṛṣṭaḥ pañcamastakaḥ | yajñamaṇḍapamāsādya saṃsthito vedisannidhau || 11 9|| brāhmaṇā munayo devā namaścakrurharaṃ tathā | rudrāṇīḥ pūjayāmāsurārebhire kratukriyām || 1.509.1 20|| sahasraśaḥ kratau devyo niṣeduḥ śivayoṣitaḥ | śivena sahitāścānyāḥ koṭiśo devayoṣitaḥ || 121 || evaṃ śaṃbhuḥ kratau bhāgaṃ sthāpayāmāsa sarvadā | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya yajñasya phalamāpnuyāt || 122|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmaṇā yajñārthaṃ hāṭakeśvarakṣetre nāgavatyāstīre devādidvārā sasāmagrīmaṇḍapādiracanā kāritā, jālmarūpeṇa śaṃkarāgamanam, gāyatryā brāhmaṇījātīyatāvṛttāntaḥ, kapālānāṃ annapūrṇādevyātmakatvaṃ, śaṃkarasya yajñe sthānaṃ, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||509||
<1.510> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi yajataśca brāhmaṇo vai kratau tadā | ṛṣīṇāṃ koṭirāyātā dakṣiṇāpathavāsinām || 1 || siṃhāraṇyasthitānāṃ ca naimiṣāraṇyavāsinām | khaṇḍāntarasthitānāṃ ca koṭayaḥ saṃgatāstadā || 2 || śrutvā paitāmahaṃ yajñaṃ kautukena samanvitāḥ | kīdṛśo bhavitā yajño dīkṣito yatra padmajaḥ || 3 || rūpatīrthe nāganadyāṃ snātvā divyasvarūpiṇaḥ | ṛṣayaste yajñabhūmiṃ gatvā nemuḥ pitāmaham || 4 || upaviṣṭāḥ pariśrāntāḥ svāgatena prapūjitāḥ | cakruste vai kathā divyā yajñakarmasamudbhavāḥ || 5 || somapānasya sambandhe vādaṃ cakruḥ parasparam | udgātuśca tathādhvaryoḥ tattvavādo babhūva ca || 6 || bhuktavantastataḥ sarve ninyurniṃśāṃ sukhena te | dvitīye divase prāpte dvādaśyāṃ makhakarmaṇi || 7 || ṛtvigbhiśca samārabdhe kautukaṃ śṛṇu padmaje | baṭuḥ kaścinnarmakārī jalasarpaṃ sadaḥsthale || 8 || cikṣepa prahasan śīghraṃ vidhātuḥ sannidhau tataḥ | ḍuṇḍubhaḥ sa bhramamāṇo hotuḥ pārśvamupāyayau || 9 || hotāraṃ veṣṭayāmāsa bhṛguṃ tathāpi vai bhṛguḥ | na cacāla nijasthānāt prāyaścittabibhīṣayā || 1.510.1 0|| tadodvegaśca sarveṣāṃ kṣobho manāk babhūva ha | muniścyavanaḥ pitaraṃ dadarśa sarpaveṣṭitam || 1 1|| sarpaprakṣepakaṃ bālaṃ śaśāpa kṣobhakārakam | yasmāt pāpa tvayā sarpaḥ kṣiptaḥ sadasi durmate || 12|| tasmād bhava drutaṃ sarpaḥ śrutvāthāha baṭustu tam | hāsyena jalasarpo’yaṃ mayā mukto’tra līlayā || 13 || na hotāraṃ samuddiśya kasmācchāpaṃ dadāsi me | iti pravadan sarpatvamāpannaḥ sa kṣaṇāntare || 14|| sanātanaṛṣeḥ putro baṭuḥ śuśoca vai muhuḥ | ḍuṇḍubhaṃ svaṃ samādāya yayau bhṛguṃ jagāda ca || 15|| sanātanasutaścāsmi pautrastu parameṣṭhinaḥ | śaptastava sutenāsmi cyavanena mahātmanā || 16|| śāpād rakṣa mune vipraṃ baṭuṃ māṃ śaraṇāgatam | śrutvā bhṛguḥ kṛpāviṣṭaścyavanaṃ prāha re suta || 17|| ayuktaṃ vihitaṃ tvetad yacchapto’yaṃ baṭustvayā | na tvāṃ dharṣayituṃ śakto viṣāḍhyo’pi bhujaṃgamaḥ || 18|| kimpunarjalasarpo’yaṃ nirviṣo rajjusannibhaḥ | śāpamokṣaṃ kuruṣvāsya viprabaṭuḥ sukhībhavet || 1 9|| cyavanaḥ prāha śāpo me mithyā naiva bhavet pitaḥ | brahmā śrutvā tadā prāha jātaṃ sarvaṃ madicchayā ||1.510.20|| purā saṃsṛṣṭukāmo’haṃ nāgānāṃ navamaṃ kulam | tadbhaviṣyati vai tvattastava vaṃśo dharātale ||2 1 || nāgaḥ karkoṭakaḥ putrīṃ nijāṃ dāsyati te priyām | tava vaṃśaḥ savistāro martyaloke nivāsakṛt |||22||| śrāvaṇaśuklapañcamyāṃ janāstadvaṃśapūjanam | kariṣyanti tava vāso nāgatīrthaṃ prathiṣyate ||23|| evaṃ pravadato’jasya yajñe nāgāḥ samāyayuḥ | nimantritāśca vāsukistakṣakaśca kṛṣīharaḥ ||24|| puṇḍarīkaḥ kambalāśvatarau kālaparo balaḥ | śeṣaścānye praṇamyocuryajñe devaṃ pitāmaham ||25 || sevākāryaṃ kratau brahman prayaccha naḥ sadocitam | brahmā prāha bhavanto’tra kāmarūpadharāḥ śubhāḥ ||26 || nāgatīrthe nivasantu yajñe yeṣāṃ ca duṣṭatā | vighnecchā ca bhavet tebhyo rakṣaṇīyaḥ kraturmama ||27|| etatkṛtyatamaṃ nāgā mama yajñasya rakṣaṇam | bhādrakṛṣṇasya pañcamyāṃ janaiḥ pūjāmavāpsyatha ||28|| bāḍhamuktvā ca te sarve nāgatīrthamupāśritāḥ | sanātanasutopetāḥ sanātanasya vaṃśakṛt ||29|| pariṇeme sutāṃ karkoṭakasya navayauvanām | tadvaṃśaḥ sarvathā bhūmau vistṛtaścābhavattataḥ ||1.510.30|| yatphaṇāsu binduyuktaṃ tilakaṃ caturasrakam | upari daṇḍaśūnyaṃ ca te sanātanavaṃśajāḥ ||3 1 || vaiṣṇavā bahurūpāśca śuklāḥ piṃgāśca pāṇḍurāḥ | raktāḥ kṛṣṇā haritāśca babhūvuḥ kālabhedataḥ ||32|| karburāśca tato jātāḥ sāṃkaryānnirviṣāstathā | jalasarpāḥ sthalasarpāḥ kāmarūpadharāstathā ||33|| atha bhojyādikaṃ cakruḥ sāyaṃ rātrau ca jāgaram | tṛtīye ca dine trayodaśyāṃ ṛtvija eva te ||34|| prātaḥ savanamāsādya saṃlagnā yajñakarmasu | yajñe pravartite śabdastatrābhūd viratiṃ vinā ||35|| dīyatāṃ dīyatāṃ tviṣṭaṃ bhujyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ bahu | nīyatāṃ nīyatāṃ dānaṃ vāñcchitādvai caturguṇam ||36|| pakvānnānāṃ parvatāśca vittānāṃ rāśayastathā | ghṛtakṣīravahā nadyo miṣṭapeyasarāṃsi ca ||37|| āsan sahasraguṇitāḥ koṭitṛptipradāstadā | etasminnantare tatra kaścijjñānī samāgataḥ ||38|| trikālajño namaskṛtya brahmāṇaṃ niṣasāda ha | kathayāmāsa sarvān sa naijaṃ paricayaṃ tataḥ ||39|| ṛtvijastaṃ papracchuḥ svabhūtakarmāṇi kautukāt | sa tāni kathayāmāsa tenāścaryānvitāśca te ||1.510.40|| papracchurvada kasmātte jñānaṃ lokottaraṃ nanu | ko guruste vada vidvan brahmā haro hariśca vā ||41 || jñānī prāha guravo me ṣaḍete piṃgalā tathā | kuraraḥ sarpo bhramaraśceṣukāraḥ kumārikā ||42|| eteṣāṃ vartanājjñānaṃ labdhaṃ mayā śubhottamam | saurāṣṭrādhipaterāsīnnārīṇāṃ śatakaṃ dvijāḥ ||43|| tasyāpyantaḥpure cāsīt piṃgalā nāma nāyikā | rātrau sukhaṃ svapityeva patihīnā nirīhiṇī ||44|| anyāstu śataśo bhāryā rajanyāṃ kāmavāñcchayā | āharanti śubhān dhūpān lepām̐śca kusumāni ca ||45|| vilepanāni mukhyāni sūkṣmāṇi cāmbarāṇi ca | manmathotsāhasaṃyuktāḥ pulakena samanvitāḥ ||46|| ekā jānāti māṃ śayyāṃ nūnamevāhvayiṣyati | anyā jānāti māṃ caiva tṛtīyā māṃ ca nāparām ||47|| spardhayanti prapaśyanti pratīkṣanti nṛpaṃ tadā | tāsāmekāmāhvayati dvitīyāṃ vā tṛtīyakām ||48|| caturthīṃ vā pañcamīṃ vā daśa vā tu kvacinniśi | śeṣāḥ śokaṃ samāsādya niḥśvasya prasvapanti ca ||49|| āśāduḥkhagatā naiva labhanti nidrikālavam | āśā hi paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ nairāśyaṃ paramaṃ sukham ||1.510.50 || āśāṃ nirāśāṃ kṛtvā ca sukhaṃ svapiti piṃgalā | na karoti ca śṛṃgāraṃ na spardhāṃ ca kathaṃcana ||51 || na vyākulatvamāpede sukhaṃ svapiti piṃgalā | antaḥpurasya sevāyāṃ niyuktena mayā sadā ||52|| vilokitaṃ tataścāhaṃ tyaktvāśāṃ prasvapimyapi | ye svapanti sukhaṃ rātrau teṣāṃ jāṭharajo’nalaḥ ||53 || idhyate bhojanaṃ pūrṇaṃ gṛhṇāti yāti puṣṭatām | tadetat kāraṇaṃ jātaṃ puṣṭatā jñānavardhinī ||54|| śrūyatāṃ kurarāllabdhaṃ jñānaṃ yathā vadāmi tat | mamāsīd draviṇaṃ bhūri pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mahat ||55|| draviṇasya kṛte māṃ ca prabādhante divāniśam | putrāḥ pautrāśca dāyādā bāndhavā jñātayastathā |||56 || yasyāhaṃ na prayacchāmi sa māṃ nityaṃ prabādhate | ekastu yatate prāṇān hartuṃ nityaṃ mamāntike ||57|| aparo daṇḍayuktaśca bhayaṃ datvā prayācate | tṛtīyo yācate sāmnā paraḥ praśaṃsayā tathā ||58 || anyo bhedena ca tathetaro jayapradānakaiḥ | yācate draviṇaṃ cānte dīno bhūtvāpi vai muhuḥ ||59|| evaṃ nāhaṃ kvacit saukhyaṃ teṣāṃ pārśvāllabhāmi vai | divārātrau sukhaṃ nidrāṃ śāntiṃ labhāmi naiva ca ||1.510.60 || athaikasmin dine dṛṣṭaḥ kuraro māṃsasaṃyutaḥ | hanyamāno vyomamārge māṃsārthaṃ paritaḥ khagaiḥ ||6 1|| māṃsaṃ cañcvā patitaṃ tadanupetuḥ khagāśca te | kuraraśca sukhī jātaḥ pakṣibhistaiḥ samujjhitaḥ ||62|| āmiṣasya parityāgāt kuraraḥ sukhamedhate | mayā putrādikān dravyaṃ vibhajyārpitameva ha ||63 || tataḥ prabhati tairmuktaḥ sukhaṃ tiṣṭhāmi puṣṭimān | arthasampad vimohāya vimoho narakāya ca ||64|| tasmādarthamanarthaṃ tu mokṣārthī dūratastyajet | yathāmiṣaṃ jale matsyairbhakṣyate śvāpadairbhuvi ||65|| ākāśe pakṣibhiścaiva tathā sarvatra vittavān | doṣahīno’pi dhanavān bhūpālairdaṇḍyate muhuḥ ||66|| daridraḥ kṛtadoṣo’pi prāyaḥ santyajyate janaiḥ | paraiḥ samāvṛtā nityaṃ yānti skhalanti vai pade ||67|| asambaddhāni jalpanti dhanino madyapā yathā | bhakte dveṣo bahiḥ prītiḥ ruciraṃ guru laghvapi ||68|| mukhe tu kaṭukaṃ nityaṃ dhanināṃ jvariṇāmiva | arthārthaṃ jīvaloko’yaṃ śmaśānamapi sevate ||69|| janitāramapi tyaktvā niḥsvaṃ yānti sutā api | tāvat niṣṭhati maitrī vai yāvannārthaprayogitā ||1.510.70 || sambandhe’rthasya saṃjāte vairaṃ sampadyate svayam | tato vittaṃ vihāyāhaṃ sukhaṃ kuraravat sthitaḥ ||71|| sarpāj jñānaṃ yathā labdhaṃ kathayāmi yathā purā | sarpaḥ parakṛtaṃ veśma praviśya sukhamaśnute ||72|| uṣitvā tatra saukhyena tyaktvā yāti digantaram | mamatvaṃ kurute naiva svayaṃ naiva karoti ca ||73|| gṛhāraṃbhastu duḥkhāya na sukhāya kadācana | gṛhārambheṇa mamatā mṛtyukāle pratiṣṭhati ||74|| gṛhe kṛte kṛtā bhāryā tataḥ putrāśca kanyakāḥ | kṛtyākṛtyaṃ tadarthaṃ ca punarbhogāya tiṣṭhati ||75|| kośakāramivātmānaṃ veṣṭitaṃ naiva buddhyate | ahaṃtāmamatāyuktāḥ saktāḥ sīdanti jantavaḥ ||76|| snehapaṃkārṇave magnāḥ putrastrīpaśusampadām | yathā mattagajā ajñāstathā naśyanti mānavāḥ ||77|| bhṛtyaḥ pāpāni kurute bhukte’rthāṃśca mahājanaḥ | bhoktā muktaśca tatpāpāt kartā doṣeṇa lipyate ||78|| mokṣamārgārgalabhūtaṃ harmyaṃ tyaktaṃ mayā tataḥ | gṛhiṇāṃ duḥkhadātrā na bhavitavyaṃ satā kvacit ||79|| yatra kvāpi vasennityaṃ sattāvarjyaṃ drumāśraye | bādhāvarjyāṃ cared bhikṣāṃ mādhukarī vidhūmake ||1.510.80|| dhyāyennārāyaṇaṃ japet kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sadā | rāgadveṣau na vai kāryau śatrutā mitratā na ca ||8 1 || loṣṭāśmakāñcanānāṃ ca tulyatāmānamānayoḥ | deśo yasya svasya nāsti paro vā nāsti sarvadā ||82|| vasudhāsti kuṭumbaṃ vā brahmakuṭumbameva vā | caturviṃśatitattvāni gṛhaṃ kuṭumbamasthiram ||83 || sahaiva tūhyate nityaṃ nānyagṛhe tu vāsanā | kulālacakravaccātra vegena bhramaṇaṃ yadā ||84|| śāntiṃ yāsyati tāvattu mokṣaghaṭaṃ samarjayet | evaṃjñānaṃ mayā sarpāllabdhaṃ vai mokṣadāyakam ||85|| tatprabhāvānmahattejaḥ sukhaṃ me vartate sadā | athāpi bhramarāllabdhaṃ jñānaṃ vadāmi sārajam |||86|| kasmim̐ścittu drume dṛṣṭo bhramaro vai mayā purā | śākhāgraṃ sa samāśritya kṛtapūrvaniketanaḥ ||87|| vasante drumapuṣpeṣu phaleṣvapi sugandhiṣu | vanyeṣu bahuvṛkṣeṣu sthitaṃ śreṣṭhataraṃ rasam ||88 || samādāya nikete sve niyojayati nityadā | anudvego madhuśreṣṭhaṃ puṭake bhṛtavān bahu ||89|| tena tṛptiṃ prayātāśca bahavo madhupāḥ pare | mayā sāraṃ gṛhītaṃ ca śāstrāṇāṃ madhuvat śubham ||1.510.90|| racitāni suśāstrāṇi tāni gṛhṇanti mānavāḥ | upajīvanti vai cānye yathā bhṛṃgāstathā janāḥ ||91 || tena puṇyena tejasvī cāsmi jñānena sarvadā | ātmārāmāśca munayo bhogatṛṣṇāvivarjitāḥ ||92|| sāramādhvīkasantṛptāḥ prabhavanti sutejasaḥ | lobhamohānvitā ye te jāyante vai vitejasaḥ ||93|| vedāḥ śāstrāṇi lokānāṃ hitārthāya mayā kṛtāḥ | sāramādāya sarvebhyo dattavānasmi vai sukhī ||94|| iṣukārād yathā labdhaṃ jñānaṃ tat pravadāmi ca | ātmāvalokanārthāya mayā pṛṣṭāḥ sahasraśaḥ ||95 || ātmadarśanaprakhyātāstadukta ca mayā kṛtam | jñānena cāpi yogena cādhyātmapaṭhanena ca ||96|| abhyāsena ca divyena cakṣuṣā tanmayā kṛtam | na vai dṛṣṭo mayātmā tu tato vairāgyavānaham ||97|| abhramad bhūtale tādṛggurvarthaṃ yaḥ pradarśayet | ātmānaṃ kintu kutrāpi nālabhaṃ tādṛśaṃ gurum ||98|| athāhaṃ rājamārgasya nirjane ca sthale sthitaḥ | kaścidabhyāsakartā ca yatra vidhyati lakṣyakam ||9 9 || iṣuṇā ca muhurlakṣyaṃ tvekāgramanasā hi saḥ | vidhyatyeva hi pārśvasthaṃ nānyajjānāti cāparam || 1.510.10 0|| tanmārgeṇa tu sainyena sahito nṛpatiryayau | mayā dṛṣṭo’tha kenāpi samāgatya kṣaṇāntare || 101 || iṣumān lakṣyaveddhāyamabhyāsadattamānasaḥ | sampṛṣṭaḥ kiyatīrvelā gatā yātasya bhūpateḥ || 102 || iṣukāro na śuśrāva punaḥ papraccha taṃ tathā | tayāpi naiva śuśrāva lakṣye tallīnatāṃ gataḥ || 103 || punaḥ spṛṣṭvā kampayitvā papraccha mānavo hi tam | tadā prāheṣumānnaiva vīkṣitaḥ ka ito gataḥ || 1 04|| netaḥ sainyaṃ gataṃ dṛṣṭaṃ pṛcchānyaṃ ced gato bhavet | śaralakṣyasamabhyāsamānaso na vyalokayam || 105 || tacchrutvā ca mayā tatra tvātmadarśanahetave | cintitaṃ tvekacittatvaṃ svātmadarśanakārakam || 1 06|| ātmajñānaṃ brahmavidyā vinā cittanirodhanam | naiva sañjāyate kvāpi vinābhyāsaṃ na darśanam || 1 07|| labdhaṃ ceti mayā jñānaṃ tatkaromi nirodhanam | cintayāmi hariṃ nityaṃ hṛtpaṃkajanivāsinam || 1 08|| viśvarūpaṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bahirhṛdi | surūpaṃ dhārayāmyeva dhyāyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ || 1 09|| tato dikṣu diganteṣu gagane pṛthivītale | nare bāle gavi vṛkṣe strīṣu vallīṣu parvate || 1.510.110 || agre pṛṣṭhe sarvatattve paśyāmyabhyāsato harim | tamekaṃ caivaṃ paśyāmi nānyat kiṃcid vinā harim || 111 || ahaṃ tattejasā caivaṃ dīpto’smyadya sadā tathā | evaṃ jñānaṃ tato labdhaṃ dhyānābhyāsasya sarvathā || 11 2|| atha kanyāsakāśācca labdhaṃ jñānaṃ bravīmyaham | mama pṛṣṭhe purā mārge mama patnī vinirgatā || 1 13|| nārī putravatī kanyāvatī prāha patiṃ ca mām | kuru yogaṃ gṛhe muktirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 1 14|| brahmacārī yatirbhūtvā saṃyatātmā bhava gṛhe | yadi māṃ tvaṃ parityajya yāsyasyanyata eva cet| || 115|| tadahaṃ tu mariṣyāmi bālaste’pi mariṣyati | mariṣyati kumārī ca tato nātha dayāṃ kuru || 1 16|| mā vrajasva paraṃ tīrthaṃ gṛhatīrthaṃ vihāya vai | hāṭakeśvarajaṃ tīrthaṃ smaraṇānmuktidaṃ yataḥ || 1 17|| itibhāryāvacasāhaṃ parṇakuṭiṃ vidhāya ca | hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre nātidūraṃ vasāmi vai || 1 18|| vānaprasthasya me kanyā krīḍati vai mamāśrame | prakoṣṭhe valayairyuktā bahubhiḥ śabdakāribhiḥ || 11 9|| kāṣṭhadyānayane kārye kāṣṭhaghātena vai kvacit| | kvacidekaikavalayaṃ bhidyate khaṇḍaśaḥ kvacit || 1.510.1 20|| evaṃ yāte tu samaye’vaśiṣṭaṃ valayadvayam | tataḥ śabdo’pi bhavati tataḥ kāle gate punaḥ || 121 || pratiprakoṣṭhaṃ tvekaṃ tu valayaṃ vidyate’dhunā | na saṃgharṣo na śabdaśca hyekalasya prajāyate || 122|| tadvicintya mayā jñānaṃ prāptaṃ tyaktaḥ sa cāśramaḥ | bahubhiḥ kalaho nityaṃ dvābhyāṃ saṃgharṣaṇaṃ tathā || 1 23|| ekākī vicariṣyāmi kumārīvalayaṃ yathā | tato dārāsutaputrīḥ parityajya bhramāmyaham || 1 24|| yatrāstamitaśāyī ca yallabdhakṛtabhojanaḥ | smarāmi sarvadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vibandhanaḥ || 1 25|| evaṃ labdhaṃ mayā jñānaṃ tebhyastebhyo vicintanāt | yasmād yasmād bhavejjñānaṃ sa syād gurustathā ca te || 126|| ebhirlokāntarajñānaṃ mayātmajñānameva ca | labdhaṃ tacchrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇānugrahato’dhikam || 1 27|| etasya śravaṇāccāpi labhate jñānamīdṛśam | ityuktvā virarāmāsau jñānī yajñātithistadā || 128|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥstho vai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam | yajñe’tithiśca satkāryaḥ ityādeśārthamāgataḥ || 129|| vijñāya śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dhyānena ṛtvijaiḥ | satkṛtaḥ śrīharirvipraḥ ṛtvikṣu niṣasāda ha || 1.510.13 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne yajñe sanātanasutasya baṭurūpeṇa sarpakṣepaṇārthamāgamanam, tataḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyātithirūpeṇa svagurvādijñānapradānārthamāgamanam, jñānanirūpaṇaṃ cetyādipradarśananāmā daśādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||510 ||
<1.511> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tataścainamatithiṃ śrīnarāyaṇam | viprarūpaṃ papracchuste brāhmaṇā maṇḍapasthitāḥ || 1 || gṛhaṃ tyaktvā gatastvaṃ kva kiyān kālo gatastava | vada yogyaṃ yajñakārye sametānāṃ tapasvinām || 2 || atithiśca tadā prāha bhrānto’haṃ bhuvanatrayam | brahmalokaṃ ceśalokaṃ jīvalokaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 3 || khaṇḍānāṃ pṛthivīnāṃ ca golokānāṃ śatāni ca | sahasrāṇi cāyutāni lakṣāṇi cārbudāni ca || 4 || yatrāstamitaśāyyasmi kṛtāptadehayātrakaḥ | nivasāmi yathādehe prāyastattveṣu vai tathā || 5 || yajñe vasāmi sarvatra pralaye’pi vasāmi ca | saṃkhyayā rahitānyeva varṣāṇāṃ me gatāni ca || 6 || yugānāṃ saṃkhyakā nāsti tvāyurme śāśvataṃ matam | yatra gacchāmi tīrthāni bhavantyeva mamāgamāt || 7 || tāni kṛtvāpyanantāni tvāgato’smi surakratau | dvīpān khaṇḍān bhramitvā ca tīrthāni sakalānyapi || 8 | dakṣiṇaṃ pūrvajyotiṣkaṃ himaśailaṃ tathottarān | śvetadvīpaṃ kṛṣṇadeśaṃ siṃhāraṇyaṃ ca raivatam || 9 || kṛtvā sārasvataṃ gāṃgaṃ vārāṇasīṃ ca puṣkaram | śrutvā kratuṃ sārvabhaumaṃ pitāmahasya paścime ||1.511.1 0|| samāgato’smi cātithyaṃ grahītuṃ dīyate yadi | brahmādyāste kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāhurvaraṃ vṛṇu || 11 || yatheṣṭaṃ ca tathātithyaṃ gṛhāṇādhyātmikaṃ ca vā | avaśyaṃ tat pradāsyāmo jñānine tvantarātmane || 12|| atithiḥ prāha me’pekṣyā nityamātmaniveditā | prapannānāṃ śaraṇyaṃ ca sarvārpaṇaṃ tathepsitam || 1 3|| adatvā me tu ye kuryurbrahmādyā api vai kratum | adatvātithaye naiva prāpnuyuḥ phalamīpsitam || 14|| yajñabhāgaṃ devabhāgaṃ divyatvaṃ prārthayāmi ca | āntaratvaṃ ca bāhyatvaṃ prayacchantu tathā mama || 15|| ityuktā devatāḥ prāhurdūrāt samāgato’tithiḥ | satyātraṃ cāsi viprendra sarvaṃ te dīyate kratau || 16|| ya eṣaḥ kriyate yajñastasya nātho hariḥ smṛtaḥ | etasmāt kāraṇāt proktaḥ sa devo yajñapūruṣaḥ || 17|| vartase kuṃkumavāpyāṃ kṣetre kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasya kambharā kamalā priyā || 18|| tapasā mānasaṃ lebhe tvātmasthaṃ cātmajaṃ tu yam | sa tvaṃ lakṣmīpatirnārāyaṇaḥ śrīpārvatīpatiḥ || 19|| prabheśo māṇikīśaśca jayeśaḥ śrīhariḥ svayam | vartase yajñakarmātman karmaṇāṃ phaladāyakaḥ ||1.511.20|| manaseśo maṃgaleśo rādheśaścākṣareśvaraḥ | rameśaścāpi mukteśaḥ paramātmāntarasthitaḥ || 21 || tava nāmnā sadā deyaṃ pūrṇaṃ yajñe phalaṃ bhavet | śrāddhe paitrye tathā daive yo vai tvāṃ pūjayiṣyati || 22|| viṣṇunāmasamopetaṃ bhaviṣyati tadakṣayam | kṛṣṇe tuṣṭiṃ gate sarve surāstuṣṭā bhavanti vai ||23|| ityuktvā brahmalakṣmīśadharmaśeṣaśivādayaḥ | dadāvatithaye sarvaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya vai ||24|| tataḥ prabhṛti sañjātā pūjā tvatithisaṃbhavā | tasmāllakṣmi sadā pūjātitheḥ kāryā śubhe kṣaṇe |||25| gṛhasthānāṃ paro dharmo nānyo’styatithipūjanāt | atitherna paro devo devaṃ nātikramet kvacit || 26|| atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhātpratinivartate | tad datvā duṣkṛtaṃ tasmai puṇyamādāya gacchati ||27|| satyaṃ vrataṃ tapo’dhītaṃ dattamiṣṭaṃ śataṃ samāḥ | tasya sarvaṃ bhavennaṣṭamatithiṃ yo na pūjayet ||28|| yasya gehe’tithayo vai sutṛptāśca bhavanti hi | sa gṛhasthastadanye tu bhavanti gṛharakṣiṇaḥ ||29|| purā sukṛtapuṇyānāṃ janānāmiha bhūtale | trīṇyetāni prapadyante śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ śubhā giraḥ ||1.511.3 0|| tuṣṭe’tithau gṛhasthasya santuṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥ | vimukhe vimukhāḥ sarvā bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||3 1 || apyātmanaḥ pradānena toṣayitavya eva saḥ | nārāyaṇo devatāśca devyaścātithayo guruḥ ||32|| sādhvī kanyā hyanāthā ca bhikṣukī hyatithirmatāḥ | pitṛśrāddhe bhojanasya samaye yo’bhiyāti ca ||3 3|| dūrādhvādita āśrānto madhyāhne yo’bhiyāti ca | kṛte tu bhojane cāhni rātrau vā yo’bhigacchati ||34|| ta ete’tithayaḥ proktā nātithiḥ pūrvamāgataḥ | priyo vā yadi vā dveṣyo mūrkho vā paṇḍito’thavā ||35|| tasya śaktyā pradātavyamannaṃ vai gṛhamedhinā | āsanaṃ ca jalaṃ bhāvaḥ suvāṇī snehavīkṣaṇam ||36|| etāni tu satāṃ gehe nocchidyante kadācana | atitheḥ svāgatāt tṛptā bhavanti pitaraḥ khalu ||37|| atitherāsanāt tuṣṭirbrahmaṇo jāyate tathā | argheṇa śaṃbhoḥ pādyena devānāṃ toṣaṇaṃ bhavet ||38|| bhojyadānena viṣṇośca tṛptirbhavati śāśvatī | yathāśakti sadā pūjyo bhojanīyo viśeṣataḥ ||3 9|| ityuktvā yajñakāryasya vidhiṃ kṛtvā surāstataḥ | parihāraṃ vidhāyaiva bhojayāmāsurīśvarān ||1.511.40|| rātriṃ ninyurutsavaiśca vyākhyānaiḥ pārameśvaraiḥ | caturthe divase yajñakarmārambhaṃ yathāvyadhuḥ ||41|| somapānādikaṃ sarvaṃ homadravyādikaṃ tathā | prāvartata yathāyogyaṃ tāvat tatra samāgataḥ ||42|| yuvā vai brāhmaṇaḥ kaścid bubhukṣitastṛṣāyutaḥ | homadravyaṃ śubhaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhakṣayāmāsa sotsukaḥ ||43|| prasthātā taṃ bhakṣyamāṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaśāpa dhig vadan | homārthadravyaṃ duṣṭa tvaṃ rakṣovadatra khādasi ||44|| rākṣasānāmidaṃ karma rākṣaso bhava mā ciram | ityuktaḥ so’bhavat tatra ūrdhvakeśo’tibhairavaḥ ||45|| lamboṣṭho vikarālāsyo rākṣasaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇakaḥ | śaṃkukarṇaśca raktākṣo dṛṣṭamātrabhayaṃkaraḥ || 46|| rākṣasaṃ taṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā bhītā vitresurīśvarāḥ | rakṣoghnāni ca sūktāni jajapuśca punaḥ punaḥ ||47|| rākṣaso’pi bhayaṃ tyaktvā pitāmahamupāgamat | uvācātmānamuddiśya kṛtāñjaliḥ praṇamya ca ||48|| pautro’haṃ vai tava brahman pulastyasya suto dvijaḥ | nīto rākṣasatāmadya prasthātrā śāpataḥ pitaḥ || 49|| ahaṃ viśvāvasurnāma paulastyo’smi kṛpāṃ kuru | bhakṣitaṃ yanmayā cātra homārthaṃ yatprakalpitam |||1.511.50|| aparādhaṃ kṣamayitvā rākṣasatvaṃ nirākuru | tadā brahmā pratiprasthātaraṃ prāha dayāyutaḥ ||51 || bālo’yaṃ mama pautrastu kṛtyākṛtye na vetti ca | tasya rākṣasabhāvo vai tvayā hartavya eva ha ||52|| śrutvā tacca muniḥ prāha pulastyasya tu vaṃśajāḥ | devakāryavirodhitvād bhaviṣyanti hi rākṣasāḥ ||53|| nāsya rākṣasabhāvo vai hartuṃ kenāpi śakyate | satyapi mānave bhāve kṛtamucchiṣṭameva yat| ||54|| yajñadravyaṃ svabhāvo’yaṃ naiṣekaḥ kena vāryate | syācca vā śītalo vahniryadi syāduṣṇaguḥ śaśī || 55|| tanme syādanyathā vākyaṃ vyāhṛtaṃ prapitāmaha | tasmādayaṃ sadā cāstu rākṣasaḥ rakṣasāṃ patiḥ ||56 || śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ tasya vidhirviśvāvasuṃ tadā | jagāda pautra cānena rūpeṇa tiṣṭha sarvadā ||57|| camatkārapurasyāsya paścimasthānamāśritaḥ | paścime rākṣasāḥ santi kūṣmāṇḍakāḥ piśācakāḥ ||58|| bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca tānnivāraya sarvathā | tadgaccha putra tatra tvaṃ sarveṣāmadhipo bhava ||59|| rākṣasānāṃ mayā dattaṃ tava rājyaṃ ca sāmpratam | rākṣasaḥ prāha rājye ca mayā bhoktavyameva kim ||1.511.60 || rājñā caiva mayā deyaṃ bhṛtyānāṃ bhojanaṃ ca kim | na karoti ca yo rājā bhṛtyaprajāprapoṣaṇam ||61 || tasyāpi narakaprāptistato dehi prabhojanam | brahmā prāha tilairdarbhaivihīnaṃ śrāddhameva te |||62|| rajasvalayā saṃdṛṣṭaṃ śūkareṇāvalokitam | śunā khareṇa ca dṛṣṭaṃ vidhihīnaṃ ca te’rpitam |||6 3 || kuṣṭhī kunakhī mahiṣo vā bhuṃkte yatra te’rpitam | asnātaiśca kṛtaṃ tailābhyaṃgavadbhirmalāmbaraiḥ ||64|| bhuṃkte ca śyāmadanto vā vṛṣalīpatireva vā | vedahīnena ca kṛtaṃ brahmacaryaṃ vinā kṛtam ||65 devakāryavihīnaṃ ca tatte sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati | pratyakṣaṃ lavaṇaṃ takraṃ vikṛtaṃ te bhaviṣyati ||6 6 yajamāno dvijo vātha brahmacaryavivarjitaḥ | bhoktāpi tādṛśo yatra tatsarvaṃ te bhaviṣyati ||67 āyasena tu pātreṇa yat pāvitryavivarjitam | dattamannaṃ sadā te’stu mantraśuddhivivarjitam ||68 ityukto rākṣaso natvā dattaṃ bhuktvā yayau tataḥ | yajñakārye ca sampanne parihāraḥ kṛtastathā ||6 9 tataśca pañcame tvahni pulastyena prabodhitāḥ | śvetadhautāmbarāḥ snātāścakruḥ karmāṇi tatkratau ||1.511.70 sāmavedasya gānena tūdgātrā karmayojitam | śaṃkubhiḥ kriyate yacca tatkṛtaṃ susamāhitam ||71 devairāgatya sānandaṃ kṛtaṃ vai somabhakṣaṇam | home pradīptavahnau ca jāyamāne punaḥ punaḥ ||72 prārabdhe somabhakṣye’tha gīte codgātṛnirmite | āgatā kanyakā tvekā sāmagītisamutsukā ||73 śaṃkukarṇaṃ nijaṃ citte vāñcchamānā vicakṣaṇā | chandogasya sutā śreṣṭhā devaśarmābhidhasya sā ||74 udumbarītināmnā sā sāmaśravaṇalālasā | udgātāraṃ ca sadasi vacanaṃ vyājahāra vai ||75 | yathā tathā pravartante śaṃkavaḥ sāmasūcitāḥ | dakṣiṇāgnau kṛte home pāpanāśo bhavediti ||76| evaṃ tayā darśitaśca homaḥ kṛto dvijairiti | tataḥ papracchurete tāṃ kuta āyāsi kanyake ||77| udumbarī samuvāca parvatasya ṛṣeḥ sutā | jātismarābhijātāsmi śāpād gandharvalokataḥ ||78 gāyane svarabhaṃgo vai nāradasyānvapadyata | tadā ca hasitastatra nārado gāyane mayā ||79| tataḥ sa kupito mahyaṃ mithyāhaṃ hasitastviti | tena nāradaśāpo’bhūnmānuṣī bhava kanyake ||1.511.80|| mayā prasāditaḥ stotraiḥ śāpāntārthaṃ tadā ca saḥ | prāha māṃ mānuṣī śreṣṭhavipragṛhe bhaviṣyasi ||8 1 || devaśarmagṛhe jātā tenāhaṃ kanyakādhunā | satyabhāmā mama mātā vartate ca pativratā ||82||| nāradena tadā coktaṃ brahmā yajñaṃ kariṣyati | tatra tadā ca samaye śaṃkoścāpi viparyaye ||83 || tadā tatra tvayā vācyaḥ sthāne śaṃkuḥ samāhitaḥ | dakṣiṇāgnau kṛte home pāpanāśo bhavediti ||84|| tāvattadā ca te mokṣo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | imā kāntiṃ mama paśya vimānaṃ tvāgataṃ tathā ||85|| ahaṃ yāsyāmi me svargaṃ gāndharvasthānamadya hi | udgātā ca tadā prāha yajñe kṣaternivārike ||86|| tuṣṭo’haṃ tvaṃ varaṃ brūhi na vṛkṣā darśanaṃ mama | udumbarī tadā prāha dehi me devasannidhau ||87|| yajñe yajñe samāje ca madhyasthā bhuktireva me | tato matpuratastatra kāryaṃ śaṃkupracāraṇam ||88|| mattejaḥkarmaṇā tuṣṭiḥ svargasthānāṃ bhavet tathā | evaṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā udgātā tāmathābravīt ||89|| yajñe sadasi madhye tvāṃ vinyasya samprapūjya ca | vastrabhūṣāgandhapuṣpalepanaiśca tataḥ param || 1.511.90 || śaṃkupracāraṇaṃ sarve kariṣyanti tvadagrataḥ | kalyāṇaṃ te sadā cāstu santoṣaṃ tvaṃ paraṃ vraja || 91 || tvayā virahitaṃ karma niṣphalaṃ bhāvi sarvathā | yā nārī sadaso madhye phalaistvāṃ pūjayiṣyati ||92|| sā phalaṃ prāpsyati pūrṇaṃ yajñasya śreya ityapi | vastrabhūṣādibhiḥ pūjākartrī te yajñapuṇyabhāg || 93|| ityevaṃ devavaryaiśca tathodgātā ca bhūsuraiḥ | uktā devī tato vyomni divyā vimānagābhavat || 94|| vimāne tvambare tasyāḥ pūjāṃ kartuṃ janāḥ striyaḥ | sahasraśaścāgatāstaiḥ pūjitā bahuvastubhiḥ ||95|| śrutvaivaṃ devaśarmāpi putrīṃ draṣṭuṃ samāgataḥ | patnīyuto namaścakre putrīṃ vimānagāṃ satām ||96|| putrī prāha pitarmā tvaṃ mā namaskāramācara | prāptā svargagatirme vai puṇyahrāsād vinaṃkṣyati ||97|| tiṣṭhātra svāṃganāyuktaḥ svargaṃ neṣyāmi vai saha | tatastau harṣitau tasyāḥ pitarau susthitau tadā || 98|| putryāṃ pūjāṃ prapaśyantau manyamānau svadhanyatām | anye kuṭumbinaścāpi dhanyān matvātra saṃsthitāḥ ||99|| tāvadbhṛguḥ samāyāto brahmāṇaṃ sadaso bahiḥ | prāha kanyāṃ yajñakārye gṛhītvā nityadā punaḥ || 1.511.10 0|| udgātrā vedamārgo’yaṃ kṛtaścāvaidikaḥ prabho | devītvaṃ cārpitaṃ tasyai mānuṣyai devasannidhau || 101 || somapānaṃ tayā sākaṃ yajñe naḥ sampravartitam | etadyogyaṃ na vai jātaṃ tasmād yogyaṃ vicāraya || 1 02|| ityukto viśvasṛṭ prāha naiṣā vai mānuṣī satī | kintu gāndharvaputrī sā devī hyudambarī sadā || 1 03|| yajñe nāradaśāpādvai muktā śaṃkumiṣeṇa sā | yajñīyā devatā ceyaṃ sarvadā sthāsyati dhruvam || 1 04|| atha tāvacca kailāsādāgatā mātaraḥ kratau | aṣṭaṣaṣṭisaṃkhyayā vai hṛṣṭāḥ procuśca vedhasam || 1 05|| āmantritāḥ pavanena tava yajñe samāgatāḥ | udumbarī yajñamadhye labdhavatī prapūjanam || 1 06|| bhāgaṃ ceti samākarṇya cāgatāstat pitāmaha | bhāgaṃ sthānaṃ yajñasadomadhye dehi ca śāśvatam || 1 07|| brahmaṇā tvaṣṭaṣaṣṭirvai sthānāni tvarpitāni hi | teṣu tāḥ susthitā yajñe pūjitā balibhistadā || 1 08|| tarpitāḥ saṃsthitā maunaṃ sāvitrī tata āgatā | dvijaiḥ sābhihitā yajñe mā gaccheti nivāritā || 1 09|| brahmaṇā pariṇītāsti gāyatrīti varāṃganā | itiśrutvā vajratulyaṃ mene śuśoca vai ruṣā || 1.511.11 0|| sūryastvastaṃgatastāvat parihāraḥ kratorabhūt | yājñikānāṃ ca viprāṇāṃ tattvavādo’bhavanniśi || 111 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’tithidattavaradānaṃ, pulastyaputraviśvāvasunā homadravyabhakṣaṇaṃ, rākṣaso bhaveti śāpaḥ, parvatarṣiputryā udumbaryā āgamanaṃ kratau pūjāsthānaṃ ca, aṣṭaṣaṣṭimātṛkāgaṇāgamaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmāekādaśādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 511 ||
<1.512> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tvaṣṭaṣaṣṭidevyo yāstatra saṃsthitāḥ | yajñakṣetre tu tāstatra pattanasthaiḥ prapūjitāḥ || 1 || kuladevyo’bhavan nivāsitā nagaravāsibhiḥ | yajñe bhūmau ca tāḥ śrutvā sāvitrī tāḥ śaśāpa ha || 2 || mamāgamanapūrvaṃ vai yajñe sthānaṃ kṛtaṃ yataḥ | sapatnyā saha militā asmām̐styaktvā tataḥ sadā || 3 || nagarasthakṛtā pūjā yuṣmākaṃ na phaliṣyati | aprāsādāḥ śītavarṣātapakliṣṭā bhaviṣyatha || 4 || ākāśagatiśūnyāśca dīnā yūyaṃ bhaviṣyatha | iti śaptāśca tāḥ sarvā udumbarī samāyayuḥ || 5 || śāpaṃ taṃ śrāvayāmāsuḥ pūjānaiṣphalyameva yat| | tataśca prārthayāmāsuḥ śāpasyāpi nivāraṇam || 6 || udumbarī ca tāḥ prāha sāvitrīvacanaṃ na vai | mṛṣā kartuṃ samarthāhaṃ kintu varaṃ dadāmi yat || 7 || aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu gotreṣu nagarasthairniyojitāḥ | pitāmahasya kṛpayā tatra pūjā phaliṣyati || 8 || bhojyaṃ pānaṃ pūjanaṃ ca gotrasthairdāsyate tataḥ | tatra tṛptirbhavatīnāṃ bhaviṣyati sukhāsanam || 9 || adṛśyahāsyakartrīṇāṃ dātrīṇāṃ ca balestathā | puradvāre pūjikānāṃ tṛptiṃ dānena yāsyatha || 1.512.1 0|| evaṃ tā nāganadyā vai paritaḥ sthāpitāḥ śubhāḥ | athodumbarījanako devaśarmā hyupasthitaḥ || 11 || patnīyuktaḥ satī divyāṃ putrīṃ dṛṣṭvā tutoṣa saḥ | sa evāsītpurānāmnā gandharvaḥ parvato divi || 1 2|| udumbaryā prārthitaḥ saḥ pitrarthaṃ bhūtale muhuḥ | nāradena yadā śaptā mātrarthaṃ ca tadaiva ha || 1 3|| mātaḥ pitaryuvāṃ pṛthvyāmāgacchata mayā saha | bhavataṃ mama pitarau mānuṣau mānuṣī tvaham || 14|| yuvayostu sutā tatra bhaviṣyāmi tataśca tau | devaśarmā ca tatpatnī jātau vai mānuṣau tayoḥ || 15|| sutā hyudumbarī jātā yā vimāne’tra tiṣṭhati | tāṃ dṛṣṭvā devaśarmāpi tanuṃ tyaktvā priyāyutaḥ || 16|| babhūva divyadeho vai yānaṃ samāruroha saḥ | patnīyuktaḥ sutāyukto niśāṃ nināya cāmbare || 17|| evaṃ yātaṃ dinaṃ rātriḥ pañcamī ca kratorgatā | pratyūṣe ca tato jāte’vabhṛthasnānamityapi || 18|| vidhibodhyaṃ sarvatīrthamayaṃ kāryaṃ bhavediti | tataḥ svargaṃ devatābhiḥ samaṃ yāsyāma eva ha || 1 9|| iti vicārya ca trayaste ca vimānasaṃsthitāḥ | dakṣiṇāṃ ca kratoḥ parihāraṃ cāvabhṛthaṃ tathā || 1.512.20 || pratīkṣante’tha vai brahmā sadaḥsthān brāhmaṇān munīn | dakṣiṇāṃ pradadau tatra puṣkaraṃ ca sarovaram |||21 || tīrtharūpaṃ pāvanaṃ ca sthāpayāmāsa paścime | kārtike dhavale pakṣe tvekādaśīta eva vai ||22|| pūrṇimāntaṃ ca pañcāhaṃ tīrthānyanyāni cāpi vai | sthāsyantyatra sarasyeva sarvayugeṣu bhūsurāḥ ||23|| pañcarātrasya madhye’tra yaśca snānaṃ kariṣyati | dānādikaṃ japaṃ cāpi tadakṣayaṃ bhaviṣyati || 24|| atha te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve puṇyadānaprapūrikām | anujñāṃ pradadustuṣṭā yajñasya phalasiddhaye ||25|| pūrṇaṃ ca havanaṃ jātaṃ dakṣiṇā bahulārpitā | tuṣṭāśca brāhmaṇāḥ santastathānye prāpya vai dhanam ||26 || pulastyaḥ prāha ca tatra yajñaḥ sampūrṇadakṣiṇaḥ | prāyaścittairvirahitaḥ sampanno jāyatāt sadā ||27|| ataḥ paraṃ karmaśeṣaṃ varuṇeṣṭiṃ japaṃ tathā | karomi ca tataḥ sarvaiḥ prakartavyaṃ phalapradam ||28|| avabhṛthākhyaṃ snānaṃ ca tvayā mayāpsu vai śubham | evamuktvā saha sarvairyayau puṣkaratīrthakam ||29|| nāganadyāṃ tu ṛtvigbhiḥ sācāryāgnīdhrahotṛbhiḥ | brahmaṇā saha vipraiśca sadasyairbahubhistadā || 1.512.30 || yathā vahnau tathā toye sarvaistatra haviḥ śubham | hūyate saṃvidhānena yajñapātraiḥ samanvitam || 31 || varuṇasya pratuṣṭyarthaṃ viviśuste tato jalam | ṛtvigbhirbrahmaṇā sarvaiḥ sarvāniṣṭapraśāntaye || 32|| avabhṛthasthale snānaṃ yaḥ kaścid vai kariṣyati | sarvatīrthamaye martyo vipāpmā sa bhaviṣyati ||33 || yāni kāni ca tīrthāni trailokye vai bhavantyapi | vāruṇīmiṣṭimāsādya tānyāyānti ca sannidhau ||34|| tasmāt sarvaprayatnena dīkṣitena samanvitaiḥ | tatra snānaṃ prakartavyaṃ jalamadhye tu sārthibhiḥ ||35|| atha brahmā mahendraṃ ca prāha lokahitāya vai | janānāṃ bahusammarde janā jñāsyanti naiva mām ||36|| snānaṃ jale kṣaṇe tatra tatastvaṃ gajamāsthitaḥ | haste vaṃśe kṛṣṇasāramṛgaṃ dhṛtvā tadāmbare ||37|| sarveṣāṃ snānakālasya jñānāya tat jale kṣipa | yena lokasamasto’yaṃ jñātvā snāsyati tatkṣaṇam || 38|| snānaṃ yaḥ kurute śreyaḥ samprāpnoti yathoditam | dūrastho’pi suvṛddho’pi bālo’pi yoṣito’pi ca ||3 9 || snānajaṃ labhate śreya indraḥ śrutvā tathākarot | tatkṣaṇe devatā viprāḥ ṛṣayo munayastathā ||1.512.40 || santaśca mānuṣā divyā gandharvā guhyakādayaḥ | caturdaśabhuvāṃ vāsakṛtaḥ sasnuḥ samāhitāḥ ||41 || brahmā śakraṃ tadā prāha varaṃ vṛṇu dadāmi te | indraḥ prāhātra vai tīrthe prativarṣaṃ tu yo nṛpaḥ ||42|| mṛgacarmavinikṣipyāvabhṛthaṃ ca kariṣyati | gaje sthitvā kratorante saḥ syātpāpavivarjitaḥ ||43 || ajeyaḥ sarvaśatrūṇāṃ snātāraḥ pāpavarjitāḥ | prajāḥ sukhabharāstadvannīrogāḥ syurmamāśiṣā||44|| kārtike pañcadivasaiḥ kṛtvā kratuṃ vratādikam | pratipaddivase prāte kutupe snāyino janāḥ ||45|| bhaviṣyanti vijayino varṣapāpavivarjitāḥ | ādhivyādhivinirmuktāste bhaviṣyantyasaṃśayam ||46|| etasminnantare prāpto yakṣmākhyo dāruṇo gadaḥ | acikitsyo’pi devānāṃ tathā dhanvantarerapi ||47|| nīlāmbaro raktajihvaḥ śuṣkapārśvaśca susvaraḥ | kṣut kurvan śleṣmaṇā śuṣkaṃ pāde’śaktaṃ uvāca ha ||48|| dūrācchrutvā tava yaśaṃ pitāmaha upāgataḥ | dakṣeṇāhaṃ purāsṛṣṭaścandrārthaṃ kupitena vai ||49|| rohiṇīpakṣapātasya phalātmako’hamasmi ca | candreṇa śaṃkaro devastapasā toṣitastataḥ ||1.512.50 || śaṃbhurmahyaṃ dadau pakṣamekaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ na cāparam | tatra bhojyaṃ mama kutra bhavellabhyaṃ pitāmaha ||51 || pūrṇimāyāṃ yajñasatre bhuktvā brūyurdvijā yadi | tṛptāḥ sma iti tena syāt pūrṇaṃ yajñaphalaṃ vibho ||5 2|| yajñasatre yadi naiva tarpitā yena bhūsurāḥ | tasmin vāso mama deyo yajñapuṇyavināśakṛt ||53 || tava yajñe mama tṛptiryathā syāt tattathā kuru | brāhmaṇo’haṃ dakṣaputro mama tṛptirvidhīyatām ||54|| brahmā prāha kṛtau vipravacanaṃ tṛptikṛnna cet | yajamāne tvayā tatra stheyaṃ puṇyakṣayātmanā ||55 || kiṃ ca viprairvaiśvadevasyānte deyo balistava | tena te dvitīyapakṣe tṛptiḥ pūrṇā bhaviṣyati ||56 || balidāturgṛhe vaṃśe tvayā stheyaṃ na karhicit | ityuktaḥ prāha yakṣmā saḥ tṛpto’smi dehi bhūtalam ||57|| vasāmi tapase cātrākalpāntaṃ vai pitāmaha | brahmaṇā ca tato dattaṃ bhūtalaṃ tvāśramāya tam ||58|| yakṣmā tūttarabhāge ca nāganadyāḥ samīpataḥ | sāmudrasaṃgamaṃ prāpya cakre naijāśramaṃ sa vai ||5||| yo dadāti vaiśvadevasyānte baliṃ tu yakṣmaṇe | tasya kuṭumbināṃ yakṣmā paśvādīnāṃ na jāyate ||1.512.6 0|| na tasya bheṣajāni syurna mantrā na cikitsakāḥ | ityuktaḥ sa yayau yakṣmā bhojyaṃ nītvābdhisannidhau ||6 1 || atha lakṣmi śṛṇu jātaṃ sāvitrīkṛtabhartsanam | kratau tu vedhasastatra vadāmi tvaṃ niśāmaya ||62|| gaurīṃ lakṣmīṃ śacīṃ medhāmarundhatīṃ ca pārvatīm | prabhāṃ ca māṇikīṃ svāhāṃ kambharāṃ ca kṣamāṃ dhṛtim ||6 3 || svadhāṃ puṣṭiṃ ca saguṇāṃ buddhiṃ haṃsāṃ ca mañjulām | padmāṃ ramāṃ satīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ nārāyaṇīṃ sarasvatīm ||64|| tathā dāsīrghṛtācīṃ menakāṃ rambhāṃ tilottamām | urvaśīṃ mohinīṃ svarṇāṃ lalitāṃ ca jayāṃ dayām ||65|| saha nītvā vādyaghoṣairyadā yātā kratusthalam | sāvitrī tu tadā tasyāḥ prāsphuraddakṣiṇā tu dṛk ||66|| dakṣiṇāni tathāṅgāni prāsphuran yoṣitāṃ tadā | gītotsavaparāḥ sarvā āyayuryajñamaṇḍapam ||67|| nāradaḥ sammukhaḥ prāyāj jñātvāgatāṃ nijaprasūm | prāha tāṃ gopakanyāyā vṛttāntaṃ sarvameva saḥ ||68|| raśanā yojitā kaṭyāṃ vivāhiteti vedhasā | śrutvā pramlānavadanā sāvitrī raktavarjitā ||69|| vaimanasyaṃ paraṃ prāptā tejorūpaprabhākṣayā | śūnyena manasā
