yātā praskhalantī pade pade ||1.512.70 || kārāgrahasamaṃ taṃ ca maṇḍapaṃ sā dadarśa ha | dṛṣṭvā nūtanayā tatra sapatnyā sahitaṃ patim ||71 || kopasaṃraktanayanā paruṣaṃ vākyamabravīt | vibudhā brāhmaṇā ārṣā ye sadaspatayastviha ||72|| mūkībhāvaṃ gatā nāryaḥ śṛṇvantu nyastamānasāḥ | kimetad yujyate kartuṃ tava vṛddhatamākṛteḥ ||73|| ubhayoḥ pakṣayoreṣā hyaśuddhā vai vivāhitā | paśudharmaparā takravikretrī malinā sadā ||74|| pāpapracurajātīyā gṛhītā garhitaṃ kṛtam | avaśyaṃ yadi te kāryaṃ bhāryayā parayā makhe ||75|| vidhe viprā tvayā kvāpi na labdhā kiṃ jagattraye | ūḍhā tvābhīrakanyeyaṃ nūnaṃ bhraṣṭo’si vai vidheḥ ||76 || tasmādetena kṛtyena na tvaṃ prāpsyasi pūjanam | tava pūjāprakartāro bhaviṣyanti hi nirdhanāḥ ||77|| putrāṇāmatha pautrāṇāmanyeṣāṃ ca divaukasām | ayogyaṃ cāpi viprāṇāṃ yadetat| kṛtavānasi ||78 || athavā naiṣa doṣaste svārthāḥ kurvanti vai tathā | na lajjanti na jānanti kṛtyākṛtyaṃ śubhāśubham ||79 || akṛtyaṃ manyate kṛtyaṃ mitraṃ śatruṃ ca manyate | śatruṃ ca manyate mitraṃ janaḥ svārthavaśaṃgataḥ ||1.512.80|| dyūtakāre na vai satyaṃ caure cāpi na sauhṛdam | maitrī nāsti nṛpe kvāpi lajjā svārthiṣu naiva ca ||81 || na me syād duḥkhametaddhi yatsāpatnyamupasthitam | samarthasya sahasrāṇi nārīṇāṃ tu bhavanti vai ||82|| kulīnānāṃ svajātyānāṃ na tu nīcajayoṣitām | etatpunarmahad duḥkhaṃ yadābhīro vigarhitā ||83 || vallavī naṣṭacāritrā kiṃ karomi mriye dhruvam | tasmād yāsyāmyaraṇyaṃ drāg viḍambitā tvayā vidhe ||84|| tava pūjāprakartā vai daridraḥ saṃbhaviṣyati | yataścābhīrasuteyaṃ mama sthāne kṛtā tvayā ||89|| bhaviṣyati na santānaṃ tava macchāpato vidhe | gāyatrīpūjikā nārī vandhyā kliṣṭā bhaviṣyati ||86 || asyā vai mānasāḥ putrā bhaviṣyanti yadi kvacit | sarve mlecchā rātriṃcarā aśiṣṭāścāpyaketanāḥ ||87|| lokanāśakarāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti yugāntare | indra tvaṃ śatrubhiryuddhe jito bandhanamāpsyasi ||88|| viṣṇo tvaṃ mānuṣo bhūtvā ciraṃ bhṛtyatvamāpsyasi | rudraṃ tvaṃ strīviyogasya duḥkhaṃ ciramavāpsyasi ||89|| agne tvaṃ sarvabhakṣo’bhūḥ, viprā yāta daridratām | kubera te dhanaṃ bhogyaṃ kadāpi no bhaviṣyati ||1.512.90 || devā yajñe tvābhīrāṇīsahāyyā anapatyakāḥ | bhavatāpi tathā daityaiḥ parābhūtā muhurmuhuḥ ||91 || gāyatryāḥ pārśvataścānyā yāyāścātra vyavasthitā | tāsāṃ parasparaṃ saṃgaḥ kadāpi na bhaviṣyati ||92|| evamuktvā devapatnīrvihāya tvekalā tadā | sāvitrī prayayau pūrvapuṣkaraṃ tvarbudācale ||93|| sāvitrīṃ pūjayet samyak pūrṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ | sarvānkāmānavāpnoti dīpanaivedyadānataḥ ||94|| yāvantastantavastasyā dahyante dīpasaṃbhavāḥ | muhūrtāni ca yāvanti ghṛtadīpaḥ pratiṣṭhati ||95|| tāvajjanmāni sā nārī bhavet saubhāgyaśālinī | putrapautrasametā ca dhaninī śīlamaṇḍanā ||96 || na durbhagā na vandhyā ca na vā kāṇā virūpiṇī | sāvitryāḥ sannidhau nṛtyaṃ karoti yā tu sundarī ||97|| gītaṃ vā kurute yā ca vaset sā divi devatā | yā miṣṭānnaṃ phalaṃ dadyāt sā vased divi devatā ||98|| camatkārapure lakṣmi sāvitrītīrthasusthale | snātvā saṃpūjya cādhyāyaṃ śṛṇuyādvā paṭhettu yaḥ ||99|| sarvapāpavinirmukto yajñasya phalabhāg bhavet | evaṃ gatāyāṃ sāvitryāṃ gāyatrī samudairayat || 1.512.10 0|| matkṛte ye’tra saṃśaptāḥ sāvitryā brāhmaṇādayaḥ | teṣāmahaṃ karomyuddhāraṇaṃ patyuḥ prabhāvataḥ || 10 1|| brahmakāryeṣu sarvatra siddhirna syādvinā hyajam | brahmā satreṣu sarvatra mukhyasthāno bhaviṣyati || 1 02|| viṣṇurdvedhā bhavan kṛṣṇo’rjunaśchāyātmakastathā | kṛṣṇo martyo’rjunasārathyaṃ bhṛtyatvaṃ kariṣyati || 103 || gopāḥ kṛṣṇaprasaṃgena kīrtiṃ yāsyanti devatāḥ | indra te bandhanaṃ brahmā nāśayiṣyati cāsurāt || 1 04|| vahne tvaṃ sarvabhakṣitve pāvakaḥ pāvano bhava | rudra tvaṃ tu satīnāśe gaurīyukto bhaviṣyasi || 1 05|| kubera tvaṃ devatānāṃ dhanado vai bhaviṣyasi | devānāṃ tvanapatyatvaṃ tvaicchikaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati || 106 || anyāḥ striyastu yāḥ śaptāstāsāṃ chāyāḥ pṛthak pṛthak | asaṃyuktā bhaviṣyanti mūlarūpāṇi naiva ha || 1 07|| uktvaivaṃ sā virarāma devāḥ sādhviti cābruvan | gāyatryāṃ pūjanaṃ nityaṃ prātarjapaṃ tathārcanam || 1 08|| kariṣyanti dvijā nityaṃ sāvitrīṃ naiva naiva ca | evamuktvā tu te sarve gāyatrīpūjanaṃ vyadhuḥ || 1 09|| svasvasthāne gatāḥ sarve koṭiśo devatādayaḥ | udumbarī vimānena pitṛbhyāṃ saha svaryayau || 1.512.11 0|| brahmā tvarbudamāsādya nītvā sāvitrikāmapi | yayau satyaṃ ca tai lakṣmi kathitaṃ kratuvartanam || 111 || śravaṇātpaṭhanāttvasya bhuktimuktirbhaveddhruvam | sampatputrapaśuvrātadravyādi vardhate’nvaham || 11 2|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’ṣṭaṣaṣṭidevīnāṃ kuladevītvaṃ yajñāntāvabhṛthasnānaṃ yakṣmarogāgamanaṃ gāyatrīvirodhāt sāvitrīdattaśāpāḥ, gāyatrīkṛtanivāraṇāni, sarveṣāṃ svasvalokagamanaṃ, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvādaśādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 512 ||
<1.513> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi camatkāre kṣattrā ca brāhmaṇīti ca | sakhīdvayaṃ samāste vai tapovṛttipare hyubhe || 1 || chāndogya iti nāmnāsīt sāmavedī purā dvijaḥ | paścime vayasi tasya kanyāpatyaṃ babhūva ha || 2 || yasminnahani sañjātā tasminneva dine tadā | ānartādhipateścāpi kanyāpatyaṃ babhūva ha || 3 || rājā cakre’bhidhānaṃ vai ratnavatīti śobhanam | ratnavatyā hyabhūnmaitrī vipraputryā śubhākṣayā || 4 || ekāsanaṃ tathā śayyā tvekānnena ca bhojanam | vipro duhituḥ samaye yogye prāpte’pyacintayat || 5 || udvāhaṃ kintu kanyā sā sakhyā viyogakātarā | gatvā nṛpateḥ putrīṃ sā jagāda bahuduḥkhitā || 6 || sakhi tāto vivāhaṃ me prakariṣyati sāmpratam | tena sakhyaṃ vinaśyecca viyogaḥ syāttadāvayoḥ || 7 || śrutvā nṛpasya duhitā kṛtvā kaṇṭhe ruroda tām | rājñī mṛgāvatī śrutvā tatrājagāma satvaram || 8 || jñātvā rodanahetuṃ ca jagāda ca śubhākṣiṇīm | putri tvāṃ mama putryāśca sakhitve niścinomyaham || 9 || mama putryai pradāsye tvāṃ sakhīrūpāṃ sadā priyām | rājñī brāhmaṇamāhūya prāha vipra sutā tava || 1.513.1 0|| mama putryāścātisnigdhā priyā sakhī hi vartate | tasmāt kuru vaco mahyaṃ kanyāṃ dehi ca me tava || 1 1|| yadvā yasya mama kanyā dīyate tannṛpasya vai | purodhāstasya yo viprastasmai deyā sutā tava || 12|| ekasthāne sthitayostu maitrīsaukhyaṃ sadā bhavet | chāndogya svasutāyāścābhiprāyaṃ tvavagamya vai || 1 3|| dadau rājñyai kumārīṃ tāṃ brahācaryaparāyaṇām | viprakanyā ratnavatyā samaṃ vāsaṃ cakāra ha || 14|| nṛpagṛhe tu sā jātā yuvatyatīva śobhanā | nṛpaḥ svāṃ kanyakāṃ dātuṃ suyogyāya varāya tu || 15|| viprairanveṣaṇaṃ pṛthvyāṃ kārayāmāsa tasya vai | daśārṇādhipatirbhūpaḥ patyarthaṃ saṃvṛtastayā || 16 || bṛhadbalaḥ sa nṛpatirvivāhārthaṃ samāgataḥ | viśvāvasorbrāhmaṇasya rājñaḥ purohitasya ca || 17|| parāvasuritināmnā kumāro’bhūt tadā yuvā | so’pi rājñā samaṃ tatra tvāyayau sa purohitaḥ || 18|| rājā lagnanamuhūrte vai maṇḍape vahnisannidhau | āgatastatra kanyā ca viprakanyāsakhīyutā || 1 9|| pitṛbhyāmanyanārībhiryuktā hedīsamīpataḥ | samānītā pradānāya tatrāścaryamabhūnmahad ||1.513.20|| kanyā jātismarā brahmacaryaparā śivāṃśajā | pārvatīkalayā jātā yoginī janmato’bhavat ||21 || kāmarūpadharā sādhvī viprakanyāpi tādṛśī | sarvasiddhimayī tvāsīd brahmacaryaparāyaṇā || 22|| tābhyāṃ gaurīpratāpena kāyavyūhaḥ prasādhitaḥ | siddhayaḥ sādhitāḥ sarvāḥ kāmadevo jitastathā ||23|| pārvatyā vaiṣṇavo mantrastābhyāṃ datto rahasyakṛt | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||24|| patiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā nānyaḥ pātivratyaṃ hareḥ sadā | pālanīyaṃ na cānyasyetyāha śrīpārvatī ca te ||25|| yogasiddhīrdadau tābhyāṃ siddhibhirdivyavaibhave | camatkārānvite jāte maṇḍape te ca kanyake ||26|| rājakanyābhavat tatra siṃhikārūpadhāriṇī | vikarālā lalajjihvā sphāranetrā sagarjanā ||27|| vipraputrī tadā vyāghrī krūrā samabhavat kṣaṇāt | trastāḥ sarvajanā dṛṣṭvā dudruvurmaṇḍapād bahiḥ ||28|| kanyake dve vinā sarve palāyitā hi maṇḍapāt | kolāhalo mahān jāto grāme rāṣṭre prajājane ||29|| bṛhadbalo vihāyaite yayau svanagaraṃ tadā | pitṛbhyāṃ vārite paścāt pārvatīrūpameva te ||1.513.3 0|| dhṛtavatyau tadā śāntirjātā prajājanasya vai | pūjitaṃ divyadehaṃ vai lokeśca pārvatīdvayam ||3 1 || śatacandrasame te’ dve kanyake śaṃkarānvite | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||32|| iti japantyau vaiṣṇavyau jāte te kanyake tataḥ | pūrvarūpānvite dṛṣṭvā santuṣṭāśca nirīkṣakāḥ ||33 || vārtā sarvatra lokeṣu pārvatīdvayameva tat | devīdvayaṃ vartate vai pravṛttaivaṃ gṛhe gṛhe ||34|| nityaṃ lokāḥ pūjayanti paśyanti ca namanti ca | ārārtrikaṃ ca kurvanti camatkārapure sadā ||35|| evaṃ kāle vyatīte’tha tīrthaṃ devīdvayātmakam | hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre sañjātaṃ pāvanaṃ param ||36 || ratnavatī prasasmāra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ muhuḥ | mayātmāstyarpitaste’taḥ kṛṣṇatvaṃ naya māmitaḥ ||37|| viprakanyāpi tat prāha yatra tvaṃ tatra cāpyaham | sakhīṃ tyaktvā sakhī nānyasthalaṃ yāti kadācana ||38|| tadā devī smṛtā tābhyāṃ durgā cāpyāgatā drutam | ājñayāmāsa tapase te cobhe prasthite yadā ||39|| tadā mṛgāvatī rājñī māyāmohasamanvitā | aśrupūrvekṣaṇā dīnā putrīmetadduvāca ha ||1.513.40|| mā putri sāhasaṃ kāryaṃ tapo’rthaṃ te kathaṃcana | bālā tvaṃ sukumārāṃgī sadaiva sukhabhāginī ||41 || kathaṃ tapaḥsamarthāsi vidhātuṃ tvamanindite | kandamūlaphalāhārā cīravalkaladhāriṇī ||42|| tasmānmukhyasya bhūpasya kasyacittvāṃ dadāmyaham | eṣā te brāhmaṇī nāmasakhī paramasammatā ||43|| yāsyati vai tvayā sākaṃ kaumārabhāvamāśritā | yasya bhūpasya harmye tvaṃ prayāsyasi vivāhitā ||44|| ratnavatī ca tāṃ prāha mātarnaivaṃ tvayā punaḥ | vācyaṃ madarthe yadi me prāṇān rakṣitumicchasi ||45|| haṭhena yadi vighnaṃ me kariṣyasi tadā tanum | tyakṣyāmi viṣayogeṇa carvayitvā ca jihvikām ||46|| analaṃ vā pravekṣyāmi prāpsyāmi śrīhariṃ patim | nānyaṃ patiṃ kariṣyāmi niścayo’yaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ ||47|| sāha tapaścariṣyāmi kaumāravratadhāriṇī | patiṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāpsyāmi satpatim ||48|| sakṛjjalpanti rājānaḥ sakṛjjalpanti ca dvijāḥ | sakṛt satyaḥ prajalpanti krīṇyetāni sakṛt sakṛt ||49|| manasā cintyate kāryaṃ vācā saṃprocyate tataḥ | karmaṇā kriyate paścād satī tadvat karomyaham ||1.513.50|| evaṃ sā procya jananīṃ virarāma hareḥ priyā | atha rājñī sakhīṃ tasyā brāhmaṇīṃ prāha vai tataḥ || 51|| mama putrī patiṃ naivodvāhaṃ vāñchati putrike | tvayā kāryo vivāhastu gaccha harmyaṃ pitustava ||52|| yadvāhaṃ kārayiṣyāmi vivāhaṃ te yathepsitam | kṣamasva yanmayoktaṃ tat kadācit kaṭukaṃ vacaḥ ||53|| tvayoktaṃ vā kadācit tat kṣāntaṃ sarvaṃ mayā sute | brāhmaṇī prāha tāṃ rājñīṃ dharmayuktaṃ vacastadā |||54|| aṣṭavarṣā bhaved gaurī navavarṣā ca rohiṇī | daśavarṣā bhavet kanyā kanyādānaṃ praśasyate ||55|| ṃ tataścordhvaṃ yāvannaiva tu dṛśyate | tāvad dānaṃ hi kanyāyāḥ pūrṇapuṇyapradaṃ śrutam ||56|| kanyātvaṃ tu praṇaṣṭaṃ me kaumārye cāpi gacchati | atīte ṣoḍaśe varṣe strīdharmiṇī bhavāmi vai ||57|| rajasvalāṃ tu yaḥ kanyāmudvāhayati tasya vai | santānaṃ pāpasaṃyuktaṃ pātayatyaparān daśa ||58|| rajasvalāṃ tu yaḥ kanyāṃ pitā yacchati so’pi ca | pātayet svakulānāṃ tu daśapūrvān daśāparān ||59|| tasmādahaṃ kariṣyāmi sakhyā sārdhaṃ tapaḥ param | pitrā mātrā tvayā cāpi na me kāryaṃ kathaṃcana ||1.513.60 || samprāptaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ | evamuktvā kanyake dve yogajñānasamanvite ||61 || natvā tvājñāṃ gṛhītvā ca pitrornatkā gaṇādhipam | yayaturvyomamārgeṇa bhartṛyajñaṃ muniṃ vane ||62|| āśramaṃ sāttvikaṃ cāvalokayāmāsatuḥ śubham | ṛṣestapaḥprabhāveṇa parasparavirodhinām ||63 || melanaṃ sarvadā tvāste vairaṃ yatra na dṛśyate | bhartṛyajñaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ saṃgatvā natvā ca tasthatuḥ ||64|| procaturvinayopete kṛtāñjalipuṭe hyubhe | āvāṃ tapo’rthe tvāyāte tad brūhi tapaso vidhim ||65|| bhartṛyajño mahāyogī jagāda tapaso vidhim | yena samprāpyate mokṣaḥ kiṃ punastridaśālayaḥ ||66|| cāndrāyaṇāni kṛcchrāṇi tathā sāntapanāni ca | tapodvārāṇi sarvāṇi kārtikeyavratāni ca ||67|| rāgadveṣavihīnatvaṃ sārvabhaumamahiṃsanam | satyaṃ ca brahmacaryaṃ cāsteyaṃ kṛṣṇaparigraham ||68|| santoṣaṃ cātmaśuddhiṃ ca prāṇanigrahaṇaṃ tathā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇādhyāyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’rpaṇam ||69|| sukhiteṣu tathā maitrīṃ duḥkhiteṣu dayāṃ śubhām | puṇyavatsu muditāṃ cāpuṇyavatsu hyupekṣaṇam ||1.513.70|| satāṃ sevāṃ sarvarītyā devasevanamityapi | prakuryācchrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārādhanamanvaham ||71 | vyavasthāsu tridehaiśca triguṇānāṃ tadarpaṇam | yātrāmātraṃ tanau snehaḥ śrīkṛṣṇe prema śāśvatam ||72|| kāryaṃ ca kalpanaṃ dhyānaṃ svapnaṃ bhānaṃ tadarpaṇam | sattvena rajasā yadvā tamasā ca tadarpaṇam ||73|| daihikaṃ mānasaṃ kāmyamakāmyaṃ vā tadarpaṇam | upādideśa japanaṃ smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ kṛtim ||74|| prekṣaṇaṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ spṛśyaṃ gamyaṃ grāhyaṃ visarjanam | sarvaṃ kṛṣṇātmakaṃ kāryaṃ tapastvetatparaṃ matam ||71|| yena vai śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāpyeta karmaṇā | pravṛttaṃ vā nivṛttaṃ vā karma tat tapa uttamam ||76|| anyat sarvaṃ hi labhyeta kṛṣṇaḥ prāpyeta naiva cet | kṛṣṇaṃ vinā nirayaḥ sa labdhastanna tapo matam ||77|| kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti grāhye dhārye tathātmani | yadā sañjāyate tvaikyaṃ tadā mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||78|| kṛṣṇadāsyaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktiḥ paramaṃ tapa ucyate | anekajanmatapasā saṃprāpya janma mānavam ||79|| kṛṣṇabhaktiryadi bhavet saphalaṃ janma mānavam | saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ tasya kurvataḥ karmaṇaḥ phalam ||1.513.80 || pitṝṇāṃ ca sahasrāṇi svasya mātuśca niścitam | mātāmahānāṃ puṃsāṃ ca śatānāṃ sodarasya ca ||81 || bāndhavasyāpi patnyāśca gurūṇāṃ śiṣyabhṛtyayoḥ | tatkarma śobhanaṃ putryau yacca kṛṣṇe samarpaṇam ||82|| tattapaḥ śobhanaṃ karma kṛṣṇasantoṣaṇaṃ yataḥ | tadvrataṃ tattapaḥ satyaṃ tadbhaktiḥ pūjanaṃ tathā |||83|| taduddeśyamanaśanaṃ yad bhaved dāsyadṃ hareḥ | samastapṛthivīdānaṃ prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvastathā ||84|| samastatīrthasnānaṃ ca samastaṃ ca vrataṃ tapaḥ | samastayajñakaraṇaṃ sarvadānaphalaṃ tathā ||85|| samastavedavedāṃgapaṭhanaṃ pāṭhanaṃ tathā | bhītasya rakṣaṇaṃ caiva jñānapradānamuttamam ||86|| atithīnāṃ pūjanaṃ ca śaraṇāgatarakṣaṇam | sarvadevārcanaṃ cāpi vandanaṃ japanaṃ manoḥ ||87|| bhojanaṃ vipradevānāṃ puraścaraṇapūrvakam | guruśuśrūṣaṇaṃ cāpi pitrorbhaktiśca poṣaṇam ||88|| sarvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇadāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm | tasmāt putryau prayatnena bhajate kṛṣṇamīśvaram ||89|| śāśvataṃ satpatiṃ divyaṃ paramātmānameva hi | nityaṃ satyaṃ parabrahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim ||1.513.90|| paripūrṇatamaṃ śuddhaṃ nirliptaṃ sākṣiṇaṃ harim | bhaktidaṃ dāsyadaṃ svasya nijasampatpadapradam ||91 || bhajataṃ paramānandaṃ svāminaṃ kāntamāntaram | kiṃvā jalaṃ sthalaṃ kimvā naktaṃ kimvā dinaṃ tathā ||92|| vrataṃ kimvā tapaḥ kimvā kiṃ bhojyaṃ peyameva kim | dehaḥ kimvā manaḥ kimvā vismṛtya bhajataṃ harim ||93|| śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kāntakṛṣṇa | śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇacāntarātmanpradehi dāsyaṃ caraṇe priyeśa||94|| premṇā nu bhaktyā stavanena pūjayā samarpaṇenāpi hṛdi sthitaṃ sute | śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamāntaraṃ patiṃ surakṣakaṃ saṃbhajataṃ sukhapradam ||95|| ramāpadmārcitaṃ lakṣmīsevitaṃ prabhayārcitam | māṇikīcumbitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ caraṇaṃ bhajataṃ sute ||96|| satataṃ śaṃbhunā gītaṃ pārvatyā cintitaṃ hṛdi | dhyātaṃ sanakasadbhiśca bhajataṃ tatpadaṃ hareḥ ||97|| śrīśrīkṛṣṇapādapadmaṃ svapne japati yaḥ sute | śatajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||98|| tadvrataṃ tattapaḥ satyaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ tacca pūjanam | saphalaṃ kṛṣṇasambandhi svajanmakhaṇḍanaṃ yataḥ ||99|| śrīkṛṣṇaṃ taṃ parityajya kiṃ bhavet tapasā sute | tapasāṃ phalamāpnoti śrīkṛṣṇasmaraṇena vai || 1.513.10 0|| yato bhaktirna ca bhavecchrīkṛṣṇe paramātmani | sa guruḥ paramo vairī karoti janma niṣphalam || 101 || te tatheti paraṃ jñānaṃ labdhā bhaktyātmakaṃ śubham | natvā gatvā sarastīraṃ cāndrāyaṇādi cakratuḥ || 1 02|| ṣaṣṭhakālādanaṃ śarattrayaṃ jagāma vai tayoḥ | hemante jalavāsinyo grīṣme pañcāgnisādhike || 103 || nirāśraye ca varṣāyāṃ babhūvaturhareḥ priye | dhyāyamāne divānaktaṃ japantyau śrīhariṃ patim || 1 04|| tato varṣaśataṃ sārdhaṃ nirāhāre babhūvatuḥ | tāvatkālaṃ śīrṇaparṇāśinyau cāpi babhūvatuḥ || 1 05|| tataścāpi jalāhāre yāvadvarṣaśatāni ṣaṭ | vāyubhakṣe sahasraṃ ca varṣāṇāṃ taṃ babhūvatuḥ || 1 06|| tatra nityaṃ ca tapasi sthite sakhyāvubhe hyapi | atha tuṣṭaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagatpatiḥ || 1 07|| yuvā surūpaḥ śyāmaśca garuḍena samāyayau | tejovyāptapratibhaḥ sa tāpasyau samuvāca vai || 1 08|| netre conmīlya vīkṣethāṃ varaṃ dātuṃ samāgataḥ | śrutveti te bahirdṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā lokayataḥ prabhum || 1 09|| satpatiṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ manoharam | rūpānurūpāvayavaṃ yogyaṃ sevyapadāmbujam || 1.513.11 0|| tapastyaktvā petatustatpādayorūcatuḥ pate | gṛhāṇa kiṃkarīdvandvaṃ dehi dāsyaṃ patirbhava || 111 || kṛṣṇaṃ kaṇṭhe vavalgāte sāśrunetre’tikarṣite | kṛṣṇaścucumba pasparśa kareṇājñāya bhāvanām || 11 2|| divyarūpe ramātulye pidhāya ca niyāya ca | garuḍe te nijāṃke dve sakthnorupari sthāpite || 113 || bhujābhyāṃ pārśvayornītvā bhartṛyajñasthalaṃ yayau | tayorguruṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ taṃ nītvā garuḍapṛṣṭhake || 1 14|| catvāraste garuḍena yayurgolokadhāma vai | śrīkṛṣṇasyāgamaṃ jñātvā ṛṣayastatsthalaṃ yayuḥ || 1 15|| vyomni yāntaṃ namaścakruḥ pūjayāmāsurīśvaram | nāganadyāhradaḥ so’pi ratnasaraḥ sunāmataḥ || 1 16|| tadānīṃ suprasiddhaṃ vai jātaṃ snānātpramokṣadam | kṛṣṇadāsyau tu te jāte śāśvatānandasevike ||1 17|| svarge devībhirāgatya prārthite sthātumeva yat | devīnāṃ śreyase svarge sthātavyaṃ ceti vai tadā ||1 18|| śrīkṛṣṇena kṛte te dve tārake sthāpite’pi ca | chāyārūpe muktide vai paṭhanācchravaṇādapi || 11 9|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne camatkārapurīyarājaputrīvipraputryorvivāhakāle siṃhavyāghrarūpadhartrītvaṃ, tato bhartṛyajñāśramavāsaḥ, tato durvahaṃ tapaḥ, tataḥ bhartṛyajñena saha tayoḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptirgolokagamanaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā trayodaśādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||513||
<1.514> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi martyaloke sarvapātakanāśanam | kṣetratrayaṃ tathāraṇyatrayaṃ purītrayaṃ tathā || 1 || vanatrayaṃ tathā grāmatrayaṃ tīrthatrayaṃ param | śailatrayaṃ tathā nadītrayaṃ sarvaphalapradam || 2 || kurukṣetraṃ hāṭakeśakṣetraṃ prabhāsakṣetrakam | yathoktavidhinā kṛtvā janaḥ pāpāt pramucyate || 3 || prathamaṃ puṣkarāraṇyaṃ naimiṣāraṇyamityapi | dharmāraṇyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca sarveṣṭaphaladāyakam || 4 || vārāṇasīpurī tvekā dvitīyā dvārakāpurī | tṛtīyāvantikāpūśca yatheṣṭaphaladāyinī || 5 || vṛndāvanaṃ dvaitavanaṃ tathā ca khāṇḍavaṃ vanam | snānādvāsāt svargamokṣapradaṃ pāpavināśakam || 6 || kālagrāmaḥ śālagrāmo nandigrāmastṛtīyakaḥ | indriyagrāmatṛṣṇānāṃ dhvaṃsako mokṣadastathā || 7 || agnītīrthaṃ śuklatīrthaṃ pitṛtīrthaṃ tṛtīyakam | tatra snānād bhuktimuktī labhate mānavo dhruvam || 8 || śrīparvataścārbudādriḥ raivatācala ityapi | yātrākartā svargabhoktā paścānmuktiprago bhavet || 9 || gaṃgānadī narmadākhyānadī sarasvatīnadī | snānād bhuktistathā muktistatheṣṭaṃ sarvadā dadet || 1.514.1 0|| jñānavāpī ca kuṃkumavāpī rohaṇavāpikā | jalapānād bhavenmuktirvāpītrayaṃ hi pāvanam ||1 1 || nārāyaṇasara indrasaro mānasakaṃ saraḥ | sarastrayaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ snānādbhavatyapi || 1 2|| pārvatī ca prabhā lakṣmīrmāṇikī ca jayā ramā | rādhā padmāṣṭanāmāni tārayed bhavasāgarāt || 1 3|| vastrāpathaścottarapatho dakṣiṇāpatha ityamī | muktidāstraya evātra yātrayā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 14|| brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ jātyantarādibhojanam | cāṇḍālagṛhavāsitvaṃ surāmāṃsāśanādkim || 16|| nāganadyāṃ kṛtasnānāt sarvaṃ śuddhyati sarvathā | nāgalīlānāmato vai śrīkṛṣṇasya tu dāsikā || 16|| rādhikākabarīgranthiṃ narmaṇā kṛṣṇasannidhau | nirbandhanāṃ vikīrṇāṃ ca cakāra svakareṇa vai || 17|| punaḥ keśān valayitvā dhammilaṃ rādhikākarot | nāgalīlā punargranthiṃ vikīrṇāṃ cākarod dhiyā || 18|| goloke ca muhurgranthirmuhurviyojanaṃ tayoḥ | narmaṇānyonyasāhacaryājjātaṃ tena tu rādhikā || 1 9|| kruddhā provāca gaccha tvaṃ nāgalīle bhuvastalam | ābhīrasya gṛhe yāhi tvābhīreṇa dhṛtā bhava ||1.514.20 || ityuktvā sā sakhī rādhāṃ tuṣṭāva śāpamocane | rādhā prāha yadā tvābhīreṇa dhṛtā bhaviṣyasi ||21 || tadā jalasvarūpeṇa pāvanī vicariṣyasi | agrāhyā tvaṃ vinā kṛṣṇaṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ||22|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī yadā tatrāgamiṣyati | tadā tvaṃ kanyakā bhūtvā golokaṃ tvāgamiṣyasi ||23 || tāvanmuktipradā pāpakṣālinī śuddhidā sadā | śvapacādijātibhraṣṭamānavānāṃ ca pāvanī || 24|| snānamātreṇa tu śuddhipradā tvaṃ vai bhaviṣyasi | ityuktā rādhayā natvā yayau sā bhūtalaṃ tadā ||25|| ānartīyābhīravaryagṛhe jātā hi kanyakā | śyāmasuraḥ pitā tasyā nāgalīletināmataḥ ||26|| jātismarā tvājuhāva mātā ca rāṇikā tathā | mumoda kanyakāṃ labdhvojjvalā divyasvarūpiṇīm ||27|| sarastīre gavāṃ śakṛdgṛhṇānā tu divā sadā | gomaṇḍale bhramatyeva tāṃ dṛṣṭvābhīrabālakaḥ ||28||| yuvā tāṃ dharṣayāmāsa yuvatīṃ rūpaśālinīm | sā smṛtvā rādhikāśāpaṃ jalarūpā babhūva ha ||29|| nāganadī tu sā jātā kṛṣṇasyaiva priyā sakhī | yasyāṃ snānena cāṇḍālagṛhiṇī brāhmaṇī bhavet || 1.514.3 0|| śṛṇu lakṣmi vardhamānapure tvantyajajātijaḥ | caṇḍālaḥ kuṃbhako nāma tasyābhūttvātmajaḥ sutaḥ ||3 1 || ghūkakarṇa itikhyātaḥ surūpastīrthayātrayā | camatkārapuraṃ prāpto dvijarūpaṃ samāśritaḥ ||32|| sa snāti sarvatīrtheṣu bhikṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ | dvijavadvartate nityaṃ sahavāsāddvijakriyaḥ ||33 || camatkārapure tatra subhadrabrāhmaṇasya vai | santāne kanyakā tvekā dviguṇaiśca radairyutā ||34|| āsīt tristanayuktā ca mahodarī bhayaṃkarā | yasyāḥ patirbhavecced yaḥ ṣaṇmāse nidhanaṃ vrajet| ||35|| nāto jagrāha tāṃ kaścidaṣṭādaśādhivatsarām | tāvat tasyā gṛhe bhikṣāṃ kartuṃ so’ntyajajātikaḥ |||36 || ghūkakarṇaḥ samāyātastaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā mumoha ca | tasyāḥ pitā surūpaṃ ca dvijaveṣaṃ vilokya ca ||37|| papraccha gotrajātyādi kulaṃ nāmādikaṃ tataḥ | ghūkakarṇo dvijaṃ prāha sthānaṃ me goḍadeśake || 38|| grāme bhojakaṭe me’sti pitā mādhavabhūsuraḥ | vasiṣṭhagotrī tasyāhaṃ candraprabhābhidhaḥ sutaḥ ||39||| aṣṭame vatsare me tu pitā vai nidhanaṃ gataḥ | vārāṇasyāmadhītyaiva kiñcinmātraṃ śubhakriyam ||1.514.40|| tīrthāni bhramamāṇo’trāyāto yāsyāmi gomatīm | prabhāsaṃ ca tataḥ śuklaṃ tīrtha tataḥ punargṛham ||41 || iti śrutvā tathā putryā vṛttiṃ jñātvā sutāpitā | prāha cenme sutāṃ tvatra gṛhṇāsi te dadāmyaham ||42|| tathetyuktvā sa jagrāha cāṇḍālo vidhinā tataḥ | vivāhottarakāle sa vilāsānakarod bahūn |||43|| khādyaiḥ pānaiḥ suvastraiśca dvijayogyaiḥ samutsavaiḥ | paraṃ sa vrajati prāyo yena mārgeṇa kenacit ||44|| sārameyā bhaṣantyenaṃ pṛṣṭhato’nuvrajanti ca | viprayoge vedavākyaṃ yadi coccarati kvacit ||45|| raktaṃ patati vaktrācca tatkṣaṇāt tasya durmateḥ | svapne ca jalpanāṃ cakre malaniṣkāsanakriyām ||46 || evaṃ cihnairayaṃ kiściccāṇḍāleti viśaṃkitaḥ | janaiḥ śaṃkāvināśāya daivī śuddhirapekṣitā ||47|| taptāyasaṃ kare dhṛtvā śuddhiśaṃkā nivartate | tathā kāryaṃ tvayā prātarna ced dagdho’si vai dvijaḥ ||48|| dagdhaścedanyajātīya iti vai niścayo bhavet | atha rātrau nijāṃ bhāryāṃ provācāhaṃ na vai dvijaḥ ||49|| asmi tvantyajajātīyo jñātaśca śaṃkito janaiḥ | deśāntaraṃ gamiṣyāmi tvamāgaccha mayā saha ||1.514.50|| patnī prāha mama bhāgye duṣṭaṃ vahnyarthameva ha | pāpasandūṣitaṃ sarvaṃ kuṭumbaṃ mama varṣma ca ||51 || gaccha rātrau bahirno cet saṃprāpsyasi mahāpadam | ityuktaḥ sa yayau deśāntaraṃ rātrau bhayāt khalu ||52|| prabhāte duhitā bāṣpanetrā provāca mātaram | mātaḥ pūrvaṃ mama pāpaṃ dattāhamantyajasya yat ||53|| sa prayāto madhyarātrau samāvedya nijaṃ kulam | mamāgnisnānamevāsti śuddhirnānyā bhuvastale ||54|| pitā jñātvā śuśocāti tvanye’pi śokamāvrajan | viprāḥ sarve militvā ca prāyaścittaṃ praśodhakam ||55 || kanyāyāśca tadā prāhurvahnipraveśanaṃ tataḥ | anyeṣāṃ tasya saṃsarge gatānāṃ tu vratāni vai ||56 || atha kāṣṭhāni cādāya vahniṃ datvā tu kanyakā | natvā pitṝn surān smṛtvā samārohati yāvatā ||57|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ | japamevaṃ prakurvāṇā dadau pādaṃ hutāśane ||58|| tāvadvahniḥ śītalaśca nādahyat tāṃ dayāvaśaḥ | nāsyā doṣo’sti tasmāt sā rājasvalyena śuddhyati ||59|| atha tāvat samāyātaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | sādhuveṣo vaiṣṇavaśca dharmaśāstrādipaṇḍitaḥ ||1.514.6 0|| trikālajñaḥ svayaṃ lakṣmīpatiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | prāha kiṃ jāyate ceyaṃ kathaṃ dahyati cānale ||61 || lokā nivedayāmāsurvṛttāntaṃ saṃgajaṃ tataḥ | prāha tān śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī dayāparaḥ ||62|| mayā pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ svarge camatkārapure nadī | nāgalīlābhidhā kṛṣṇapatnī golokadhāmataḥ ||6 3 || pāvanārthaṃ śvapacādisaṃgamādyaghakāriṇām | vartate tajjale snātvā śuddhyanti śvapacādayaḥ ||64|| tasmād gacchata tatraiva snānaṃ kuruta sarvathā | vahniḥ śrutvā tathetyāha tataḥ sarve yayurnadīm ||65 || kanyaikā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvābhisaṃyayau | natvā tvaṃ svāminaṃ prāha gṛhītvā tatkaraṃ mudā ||66|| tīrthaṃ tvantyajapāpaghnaṃ nātidūre’sti vai hradaḥ | samāyāta ca kuruta snānaṃ tatra dvijeśvarāḥ ||67|| tayoktāste tayā sākaṃ gatvā sasnuśca sāmbarāḥ | viprakanyā yadā snātā tadā tasyāḥ śarīrataḥ ||68|| śvapacī kṛṣṇavarṇā tu nirgatā snānamātrataḥ | anyeṣāmapi dehebhyaḥ kākā ghūkāḥ pīpilikāḥ ||69|| kṛṣṇavarṇā nirgatāśca yayurdeśaṃ tu paścimam | sahasrayojanātpāraṃ abrikte bhūtale tadā ||1.514.70|| ete viprā pāvanāśca brāhmaṇī śuddhatāṃ gatā | evaṃ sarve samāyātā nagaraṃ svasvakāśramam ||71 || kanyakā brāhmaṇī paścād brahmacaryaparāyaṇā | hyavartata satī sādhvī kṛṣṇasvāmipativratā ||72|| nāgavatīṃ sadā yāti snānārthaṃ tu tadā nadī | nityaṃ vai kanyakā bhūtvā brāhmaṇyā saha mandire ||73|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmidarśanārthaṃ prayāti ca | prāpte tu brāhmaṇaputryā āyuṣastu kṣaye hariḥ ||74|| nadīṃ ca tāṃ brāhmaṇīṃ ca divyarūpāṃ vidhāya ca | golokaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo nināya te hyubhe ||75|| divyaratnasunaddhena koṭisūryaprabhāvatā | vimānena patiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prāpya te yayaturmudā ||76|| golokaṃ dhāma nityaṃ yad rādhāramādiśobhitam | atha brahmāpi kulaṭāśāpādatra sutīrthake ||77|| purā vai kulaṭāśāpāt pramuktaḥ saṃbabhūva ha | ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi pāvanaṃ tīrthamuttamam ||78|| yatra snānena vai śuddhiḥ sarvā nirvāhameti hi | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya sadā śuddhyati mānavaḥ ||79|| mantraṃ prāpya guruṃ natvā nāgavatyāṃ samāhitaḥ | snāyād yaḥ sa bhavecchuddhaḥ kṛṣṇavannātra saṃśayaḥ ||1.514.80|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne goloke rādhikāyāḥ śāpād nāgalīlāsakhyā nāgavatīnadītvaṃ, yasyāṃ snānena ghūkakarṇacāṇḍālena vivāhitāyā brāhmaṇakanyayā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca śuddhirjātā, tato brāhmaṇakanyā nāgavatīnadī ca divyakanyake bhūtvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena saha golokaṃ yayaturityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturdaśādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||514|||
<1.515> śrīlakṣmīruvāca kadā brahmā kulaṭayā śaptaḥ kimarthameva ca | nāganadyāṃ tataḥ snātvā yena śuddho hi viśvasṛṭ || 1 || nārāyaṇahare kṛṣṇa me vadātra kathāṃ tu tām | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrutvā lakṣmyai saṃprāha tāṃ kathām || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi purā brahmā janayāmāsa kanyakām | mohinīṃ mānasīṃ tāṃ cāpsarasaṃ kṛtavān svayam || 3 || sarvasādhāraṇī sā tu devapatnī tato’bhavat | atha sā tvekadā dṛṣṭvā brahmāṇaṃ samumoha vai || 4 || vismṛtya pitaraṃ ceti kāmasaṃkalpamācarat | manvantare raivatasya sucandro vaiṣṇavo nṛpaḥ || 5 || tapase malayadroṇīṃ yayau varṣasahasrakam | valmīkācchāditaṃ dehaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhātā samāyayau || 6 || varaṃ vṛṇu pratuṣṭo’smītyuvāca taṃ jagatpitā | vavre sa śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktiṃ ca dāsatām || 7 || brahmā kamaṇḍalorvāri cikṣepa ca siṣeca vai | rājā samyaccharīraḥ san nanāma tu punaḥ punaḥ || 8 || tathāstviti varaṃ brahmā dadau tadā rathottamam | golokādāgataṃ divyaṃ samāruroha bhūpatiḥ || 9 || pārṣadaḥ sa divyarūpo bhūtvā kṛṣṇapadaṃ yayau | brahmā yāntaṃ satyalokaṃ dadarśa mohinīṃ pathi || 1.515.1 0|| tadā mumoha sadyaḥ sā nirjane rantumeva ca | vilokya vakranayanā jugopa sasmitaṃ mukham || 11 || pulakāñcitasarvāṃgī kāmavegena pīḍitā | niṣasāda śanairbhūmau purato brahmaṇaḥ pade || 1 2|| brahmā nirīkṣya tāṃ putrīṃ vikāraṃ nahi cāpa saḥ | brahmalokaṃ yayau tāṃ ca samāśvāsya pitā yathā || 13 || sakāmā sā tadā jātā nirāśā hatacetanā | divāniśaṃ sacintā sā svapne jñāne caturmukham || 14|| āsīnā saṃsthitā yadvā śayanaṃ kurvatī kṣaṇam | taptapātre yathā sasyaṃ bhramatyeva tathā pathi || 15|| kāmaṃ sahāyamāsādya tena sārdhaṃ hi mohinī | brahmalokaṃ yayau cājaṃ nirjane sā dadarśa tam || 16|| tameva mohitaṃ kartuṃ samārebhe puraḥ sthitā | kṣaṇaṃ nanarta suciraṃ sugānena kṣaṇaṃ jagau || 17|| vidhātā susvaraṃ śrutvā mumoha sāśrulocanaḥ | dṛṣṭvā mugdhaṃ kalāḥ sarvā darśayāmāsa nartane || 18|| datvā tathāpi vai pāritoṣikaṃ virato yayau | hatodyamā tu sā prāha kāmaṃ deva namo’stu te || 1 9|| nikṣipa tvaṃ svakān bāṇān kāmadeva vidhau tataḥ | antarīkṣe sthitaḥ kāmo mahāstraṃ prerayanmudā ||1.515.20|| babhūva cañcalo brahmā cakre nirīkṣaṇaṃ muhuḥ | mohinyāśca samāgatya prāha vicārya mohinīm ||21 || cañcalāsi mohini tvaṃ nāhaṃ yogyo’sya karmaṇaḥ | gaccha putri mamāgrāhyā tvanyatra viharasva yat ||22|| viśvaset kulaṭāṃ yaśca vipat tasya pade pade | aye vatse gaccha dūraṃ vihāya pitaraṃ hi mām ||23|| tava yogyaṃ paraṃ devaṃ yuvānaṃ paśya mohinī | mohinī prāha dhātāraṃ me mano na sthiraṃ yataḥ ||24|| bhūtaṃ tvayi viśeṣeṇa cañcalaṃ vīkṣite mayā | aho gantumaśaktāhaṃ tvayā yadyapi bhartsitā ||25|| kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpāsindho na māṃ hantuṃ tvamarhasi | santo garvaṃ na kurvanti paropakṛtiśālinaḥ ||26|| kācit satī patiṃ prāpya pātivratyaparāyaṇā | kācittu karmaṇā bhuṃkte naraṃ kṛtvāṅgavikrayam ||27|| mama dharmastathā brahmanmano’bhilaṣitaṃ naram | bhuktvā tṛptirbhavet tadvat kartavyaṃ narasevanam ||28|| tena tṛptiḥ karmaṇāṃ ca khaṇḍanaṃ dharma eva naḥ | tat tvāṃ karmānyathākartuṃ samarthaṃ cāhamāgatā ||29|| mahatāṃ sevayā śaśvad yaśasā bhānti yoṣitaḥ | gṛhī tapasvī kāmī vā tyajet striyamupasthitām || 1.515.30|| niḥśvāsahatapuṇyaḥ saḥ śāpapātraṃ bhavediha | naṣṭaśrīrbhraṣṭarūpaśca bhraṣṭabuddhirbhavettathā ||3 1 || sadyaḥ sa klībatāṃ yāti brahman śāpena yoṣitaḥ | vidhuraśca sadā śāpabalena jāyate’sukhaḥ ||32|| uttiṣṭha tajjagannātha pāraṃ kuru smarārṇave | satataṃ tvanmanaskāṃ māṃ dāsīṃ krīṇīhi sādaram ||33|| ityuktvā vedhaso vastraṃ vicakarṣa hi mohinī | brahmā dhairyaṃ samālambya sāramāha sutāṃ prati ||34|| tyaja māmambike vṛddhaṃ niṣkāmaṃ paśya cāparam | tvayā saha nibandho me kāmalekho na vidyate ||35|| pūrvakarmakṛtā rekhā patiṃ dadāti yoṣite | muñca vastraṃ mama putri dhairyamālambaya kṣaṇam ||36|| etasminnantare vighnarūpā ājagmurīśvarāḥ | atriḥ pulastyaḥ pulaho vasiṣṭhaḥ kraturaṃgirāḥ ||37|| bhṛgurmarīciḥ kapilo voḍhuḥ pañcaśikho ruciḥ | āsuriśca pracetāśca patnīvrato bṛhaspatiḥ ||38|| śukra utathyaḥ karakaḥ kaṇvo gautamakaśyapau | sanakaśca sanandaśca kardamaśca sanātanaḥ || 39|| sanatkumāraḥ pippalaḥ śaṃku śukraḥ parāśaraḥ | śātātapo lomaśaśca mārkaṇḍeyo vibhāṇḍakaḥ || 1.515.40|| mṛkaṇḍuścavano jaratkārurāstikakauśikau | bhāradvājaḥ ṛṣyaśṛṃgo bharadvājaśca nāradaḥ ||41 || vāmadevaśca durvāsāḥ svayaṃprakāśa ityamī | tatyāja mohinī dṛṣṭvā vrīḍayā vedhasaṃ tadā ||42|| brahmā cāsanamārūḍho mohinī pārśvataḥ sthitā | praṇemurmunayastaṃ ca brahmā dadau śubhāśiṣam ||43|| papracchurmunayo devaṃ kathameṣā tavāntike | brahmā prāha ciraṃ nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ cāpūrvamityapi ||44|| darśayituṃ tvāgateyaṃ kṛtvā śrāntā sthitā yataḥ | munayo jahasustatra kulaṭāṃ prati sarvathā ||45|| sadyaścukopa tūtthāya sāha viśvasṛjaṃ tadā | ete tvanigrahāḥ sarve vṛddhā hasanti māṃ vidhe ||46 || te’pi hāsyaṃ prayāsyanti lokānāṃ svasvakarmabhiḥ | tvaṃ ca māṃ bhajamānāṃ vai yato gṛhṇāsi naiva ca ||47|| naitān vārayasi brahman hāsyapātraṃ tato bhava | apūjyo bhava sarvatra nārīṇāṃ mānavarjitaḥ ||48|| tava patnī tava kārye bhartsanā vai kariṣyati | kṛtvājaṃ pūjanahīnaṃ yayau svargaṃ tu mohinī ||49|| kṣaṇaṃ brahmā ca munayaḥ śuśucuḥ śāpamokṣaṇam | brahmā vicārya ca tataścamatkārapurāntike ||1.515.50|| nāgavatyāṃ samāyātaḥ śuddhyarthaṃ śāpahānaye | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ||51 || japan mantraṃ kṛṣṇadattaṃ sasnau tīrthe’ghanāśane | jahau dehaṃ tu taṃ brahmā śaptaṃ nāganadītaṭe ||52|| tasmāt sahasraśastatra cotpannā vṛndalāstataḥ | nagaraṃ tatra saṃśritya sthitā brahmā divaṃ yayau ||53|| divyarūpadharaścaiva śāpaḥ pūrvatanusthitaḥ | vṛndalāste sadā loke hyapūjyāstvabhavam̐stataḥ ||54|| nārībhirbhartsitāḥ śaśvannārīrūpaviḍambakāḥ | mohakā mohinītulyā ratihīnā avīryakāḥ ||55|| na narā na ca nāryaste yoniliṃgavivarjitāḥ | svalpamūtrachidramātrayutāste tu tataḥ param ||56|| brahmāṇaṃ ca samuddiśya cakrurvai tarpaṇaṃ jale | brahmā tatra samāyātaścakruste prārthanāṃ vidheḥ ||57|| napuṃsakatvanāśāya brahmā prāha ca tām̐stadā | tapaḥ kuruta satataṃ samuddiśya tu mohinīm |||58|| sā nistāra hi bhavatāṃ kariṣyati hitāvahā | tataste vai taṭe nadyāstapaścakrurnirantaram ||59|| mohinīṃ te namo mātarvṛndalatvanivāriṇīm | svāhā kāmapriye tubhyamuddhāraṃ kuru nastviha ||1.515.6 0|| iti samprārthayantaste vṛndalānāṃ gaṇāstadā | dadṛśurnāganadyāstu taṭe saubhāgyasundarīm ||6 1 || bahucarāsvarūpāṃ tāṃ raktakañcukikānvitām | raktaśāṭikayā yuktāṃ vahnivarṇāṃ sabhūṣaṇām ||62|| puṣṭāṃ puṣṭastanīṃ puṣṭajaghanāṃ tanumadhyamām | surūpāṃ padmapatrākṣīṃ keśadhammilaśobhitām ||63|| kabarīsṛtisampannāṃ bhālapatrānvitāṃ satīm | valayena karayośca kaṃkaṇairūrmikādibhiḥ ||64|| śobhitāṃ raśanāyuktāṃ mañjīravaraśobhitām | karṇanāsābhujākaṇṭhabhālabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ||65|| aṃkuritastanāṃ pṛthuśroṇīṃ vṛttakapolakām | kundottamakalīdantāṃ raktabimbādharāṃ śubhām ||66|| śaraccandrānanāṃ miṣṭasvarāṃ smerānanānvitām | puṣṭāṃ premabharāṃ kanyāṃ bhaktānugrahakātarām ||67|| kāmadharmavihīnāṃ ca rājasvalyavivarjitām | kāmarūpadharāṃ vyomni dṛṣṭvā sarve napuṃsakāḥ ||68|| tasyāstu tejasā channanetrāḥ kṣaṇaṃ tadābhavan | sā tvājagāma pṛthivītalaṃ nāgavatītaṭe ||69|| sarvaiḥ saṃvanditā cāpi pūjitā toṣitārthitā | marditā ca tathā sarvāṃgeṣu saṃvāhitā satī ||1.515.70|| uvāca tān prasannāsmi varairyuṣmān madāśritān | yojayāmi vṛṇudhvaṃ vai yatheṣṭaṃ mā ciraṃ tadā ||71 || vṛndalā hi tadā prāhuruddhārāya kṛpāṃ kuru | ṣaṇḍhatvasya vināśāya tuṣṭuvuste muhurmuhuḥ ||72|| tadā devī tu tānprāha mohinyahaṃ purābhavā | prakṛteśca tiraskārād yūyaṃ brahmatanūdbhavāḥ ||73|| ṣaṇḍhā sarve hi sañjātā nārībhartsanapāpataḥ | nārīṇāṃ kāmaśāntyarthaṃ narāḥ kṛṣṇena nirmitāḥ ||74|| nārīṇāṃ māsike dharme kāmanalo vivardhate | tacchāntiṃ tvicchati bhāryā patinā sārdhameva tu ||75|| yasyā nāsti patiḥ sā tu sveṣṭaṃ gacchanti śāntaye | śāntikarma tu nārīṇāṃ dharmaḥ śāntiprado nṛṇām ||76|| bhajamānāṃ bhajante ye te tvāśīrvādabhūmayaḥ | āgatāṃ kāmasantaptāṃ tiraskurvanti ye narāḥ ||77|| ātmahanaśca te bodhyāḥ sevikāghātakāśca te | tena pāpena ṣaṇḍhatvaṃ prayānti pratijanmani ||78|| kāmakriyāsthayorvighnakartāro’pi napuṃsakāḥ | kāmānandahanaḥ sarve ṣaṇḍhā bhavanti śāpataḥ ||79|| prasahya bhogakartāraścāpi daṇḍā bhavanti vai | patiśūnyā tu yā nārī kāmataptā bhaved yadi ||1.515.80|| agṛhṇannaparādhī syāt phalaṃ ṣaṇḍhatvameva yat | tasmānnaraiḥ sadā nāryaḥ pūjyāḥ sevyāstadicchayā ||81 || bhavantaḥ ṣaṇḍhatānivṛttyarthaṃ bhavantu dīkṣitāḥ | śmaśrūhīnā nārīvastradharā nārīvibhūṣaṇāḥ ||82|| mama bhaktā mama pūjākartāro mama jāpakāḥ | mama vaṃśadharā muktāḥ ṣaṇḍhatāto bhaviṣyatha ||83|| bahucaretyabhidhāya dadau mantraṃ nijaṃ tu sā | oṃ namo bahucarāyai mohinyai kāmayoṣite ||84|| ṣaṃḍhatvaṃ hara mātastvaṃ śreyaḥ kuru paraṃ mama | itimantraṃ nāganadyāṃ snāpayitvā dadau śubham ||85|| oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ kāmadātryai svāhā daśākṣaram | mantraṃ dadau dvitīyaṃ ca kāmanāsiddhihetave ||86|| yasyāsīccaṇakāmātraṃ yonicchidraṃ tu tatsthale | devī sā citrayāmāsa yoniṃ pūrṇāṃ tu dīkṣaṇe ||87|| yasmāsīcca lavaṃgābhaṃ liṃgacihnaṃ tu tatsthale | pūrṇaṃ liṃgaṃ sāṇḍayugmaṃ citrayāmāsa rekhayā ||88|| hiṃgulārasadānena pūrṇakāmatvalabdhaye | janmāntare bhavennārī naro vā tadvirekhitaḥ ||89|| śāṭikāṃ kañcukīṃ śreṣṭhāṃ ghargharīṃ dorakaṃ tathā | dantikāṃ sindūracūrṇaṃ hiṃgulaṃ mantramityapi ||1.515.90|| jalaṃ ca mantritaṃ snigdhaṃ cumbanaṃ ca dadau tadā | sarvānnapuṃsakān devī pasparśa stanayostadā ||9 1|| gṇḍayorbhālayoḥ kapolayoḥ keśeṣu netrayoḥ | pṛṣṭhe nitambayoścāgre jaghanayostathodare ||92|| nābhyāṃ sakthnoḥ pādayośca siṣeca mastake ca tān | ṣaṇḍhatvapāpanāśovābhavatviti jagāda tān ||93 || evaṃ dīkṣāṃ gṛhītvā te pupūjurdevikāṃ tadā | sā ca pūjāṃ samagṛhya yayau vai cottarāṃ diśam ||94|| evaṃ ṣaṇḍhatvanivṛttiṃ kartuṃ dīkṣāṃ dadau satī | bahucarā hiṃgulājā bhuvi tiṣṭhati śāśvatī ||95 || brahmā tāṃ bhajamānāṃ ca yato jagrāha naiva tu | kāraṇaṃ tatra te vacmi śṛṇu lakṣmi purābhavam ||96 || brahmā svakamale taptvā śrutvā vyomagirāṃ purā | sṛṣṭiṃ sarvāṃ samārebhe sasmāra śrīhariṃ punaḥ ||97|| nārāyaṇaṃ dadarśāgre yayāce varadānakam | tava māyā yathā me na bādheta strīsvarūpiṇī ||98|| tathā cāśīrvaco dehi tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ karomi vai | nārāyaṇastathāstvityevāha tatra hi vedhasam ||99|| sṛṣṭiṃ caturyugānāṃ ca yogyāṃ nārīnarātmikām | kāle yathā yathā yogyāṃ racaya tvaṃ tathā tathā || 1.515.10 0|| kāmaṃ krodhaṃ tathā lobhaṃ mohaṃ ca kapaṭaṃ kvacit | gṛhṇantaṃ tvāṃ ca nirlepaṃ rakṣayiṣye sṛjiṃ kuru || 10 1|| dharmabhānaṃ sadā te’stu sadā te rāgahīnatā | mama smṛtiḥ sadā cāstu sadā jīvanpramuktatā || 1 02|| dharmādharmau tavecchaiva tava dehodbhavau sadā | karmaṇāṃ phaladātā ca bhava tvaṃ mama vāñchayā || 1 03|| akartā kriyamāṇe’pi hyabhoktā bhogasāgare | nirlepo lepavām̐ścāpi sadā bhavasi padmaja || 1 04|| itihetorhareranugrahād brahmā prajāpatiḥ | icchayā naiva jagrāha mohinīṃ mohavarjitaḥ || 1 05|| bhaktā bhagavato naiva gṛhṇanti viṣayān kvacit | harerbhaktiṃ vihāyaiva pāvanīṃ bandhanāśinīm || 1 06|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi mohinīkṛtamulbaṇam | śāpasya kāraṇaṃ muktiḥ ṣaṇḍhatvaṃ dīkṣaṇaṃ tathā || 1 07|| ya idaṃ śṛṇuyād bhaktyā paṭhedvā tasya dūṣaṇam | kāmabhāvakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 1 08|| nāgavatyāṃ pratāpo’yaṃ nāgalīlāsakhīkṛtaḥ | pāpānāṃ nāśakaḥ sarvajīvānāṃ tārakastathā || 1 09|| yasyāḥ sasevanāt pānāt snānāttathābhiṣecanāt | bhuktirmuktirbhavet pūrṇaṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam || 1.515.11 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne mohinyapsaro brahmāṇaṃ vīkṣya mohitā, brahmaṇā tu na gṛhītā, tataḥ taṃ śaśāpa, brahmā nāgavatīnadyāṃ śuddhaḥ, tyaktadehānnapuṃsakānāmutpattiḥ, bahucarāhiṃgulājādīkṣayā napuṃsakānāṃ mokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 515 ||
<1.516> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ ramyāṃ vṛkāsurakṛtāṃ śubhām | purā babhūva ca vṛko daityastepe paraṃ tapaḥ || 1 || śatavarṣaṃ tu kedāre kṣetre tuṣṭo harastu tam | varaṃ dātuṃ yayau nityaṃ na jagrāhāsuro varam || 2 || sarvaiśvaryaṃ sarvasiddhiṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ hareḥ padam | daityaḥ kiñcinna gṛhṇāti paritaḥ śūlapāṇinaḥ || 3 || śaṃbhuḥ ruroda taṃ dṛṣṭvā premapāśena veṣṭitaḥ | rodanaśravaṇenāsya dhyānabhaṃgo babhūva ha || 4 || dadarśa purataḥ śaṃbhuṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām | varaṃ vavre vṛkastasmānnatvā ca bhaktipūrvakam || 5|| hastaṃ dadhe ca yanmūrdhni sa bhasma bhaviteti ca | omityuktvā prayāntaṃ taṃ dudrāva daityapuṃgavaḥ || 6 | papāta ḍamaruḥ śaṃbhorvyāghracarma ca bhūtale | daityaṃ pṛṣṭhe ca dhāvantaṃ kṛpayā na ca hanti saḥ || 7 || duṣṭānusāraṃ sādhuśca na karoti kadācana | sādhavo ghnanti ghnantaṃ ca bhṛtyaṃ putraṃ priyāṃ vinā || 8 || śivo māṃ mama śaraṇaṃ tvāyayau nirahaṃkṛtaḥ | he hare rakṣa rakṣeti japantaṃ bhayavihvalam || 9 || tadā mayā dhṛtaṃ rūpaṃ nāryā daityaśca mohitaḥ | dāpayitvā nijamūrdhni hastaṃ taṃ daityapuṃgavam || 1.516.1 0|| bhasmībhūtaṃ kṛtavām̐śca śaṃkaro vijvaro’bhavat | tathāpi śaṃkaro bhakto mama garvānvito’bhavat || 11 || sadā viṣṇurmama kāryaṃ karotyeva mahāpadi | saṃhartāhamiti matvā tripuraṃ hantumudyataḥ || 12|| ko’yaṃ pataṃgavaddaitya iti matvā raṇaṃ yayau | vihāya śūlaṃ maddattaṃ madīyakavacaṃ tathā || 13|| ciraṃ babhūva samaro varṣamekaṃ divāniśam | śaṃbhoḥ rathaṃ babhaṃjāpi jahārāstrāṇi śaṃkarāt || 14|| śivaṃ śayānamuttolya pātayāmāsa bhūtale | tadāhaṃ kalayā śīghraṃ vṛṣarūpaṃ vidhāya ca || 15|| śayānaṃ śaṃkara dhṛtvā viṣāṇābhyāmurukramam | sa maddattena śūlena jaghāna tripuraṃ haraḥ || 16|| sadyaḥ papāta daityendraścūrṇībhūto hi bhūtale | tuṣṭuvurdevatāḥ śaṃbhuṃ darpaṃ tatyāja śaṃkaraḥ ||17|| tato’haṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa vahāmi bhaktaśaṃkaram | mama priyatamo nāsti trailokyeṣu śivātparaḥ || 18|| śṛṇu lakṣmi harasyātra kathāṃ ramyāṃ purābhavām | yugaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi tapaḥ kṛtvā maheśvaraḥ || 1 9|| virarāma tataścāgre māṃ dadarśa narāyaṇam | atīva kamanīyāṃgaṃ kiśoraṃ śyāmasundaram ||1.516.20|| na babhūva vitṛṣṇaśca locanābhyāṃ trilocanaḥ | paśyannimeṣarahito ruroda premavihvalaḥ || 21 || ekenāsyena vai kathaṃ staumi śrīpuruṣottamam | evaṃ caturdhā manasi kalpayāmāsa mastakam ||22|| pratikalpanaṃ ca śiro nūtanaṃ nūtanaṃ tadā | babhūva taccaturvaktraṃ pūrveṇa saha pañcamam ||23|| ekaikavaktraṃ śuśubhe locanaiśca tribhistribhiḥ | babhūva tena śobhāḍhyaḥ pañcavaktrastrilocanaḥ ||24|| stavanādadhikā prītiḥ śivasya mama darśane | tenādhikāni tasyaivaṃ babhūvurlocanāni vai ||25|| triguṇāni tu netrāṇi saṃhārakaṃ tṛtīyakam | vibhūtigātraḥ sa vibhuḥ satīsaṃskārabhasmanā ||26|| dhatte tasyāstvasthimālāṃ premabhāvena bhasma ca | anyeṣāṃ muṇḍamālāṃ ca dhatte saṃhṛtadehinām ||27|| jaṭāṃ tapasyākālīnāṃ dho’dyāpi vivekataḥ | na cecchā keśasaṃskāre svāṃgaveṣeṇa yoginaḥ ||28|| samatā candane paṃke loṣṭe ratne maṇau dhane | garuḍadveṣiṇo nāgāḥ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ||29|| bibharti kṛpayā svāṃge tāneva śaraṇāgatān | vāhanaṃ vṛṣarūpo’hamanyastaṃ voḍhumakṣamaḥ ||1.516.3 0|| pārijātādikaṃ puṣpaṃ sugandhi candanādikam | mayi sannyasya teṣvevaṃ prītirnāsti kadācana ||3 1 || dhattūre tatsadā prītirbilvapatrānulepane | gandhahīne sugandhe ca yogoṣṭhe vyāghracarmaṇi ||32|| divyaloke divyatalpe janatāyāṃ na tanmanaḥ | śmaśāne’tīva rahasi dhyāyate māmaharniśam ||33|| jñānaṃ mṛtyuñjayaṃ śūlaṃ dhatte mattejasānvitam | jalaṃ viṣapraśāntyarthaṃ dhatte śītaṃ divāniśam ||34|| pārvatīṃ ca mayā dattāṃ yoginīṃ kāryasiddhaye | lokaśikṣaṇadānārthaṃ dhatte patnīṃ pativratām ||35|| śaṃkaraḥ paramātmā me prāṇebhyo’pi paraḥ śivaḥ | tryambake manmanaḥ śaśvanna priyo me bhavātparaḥ ||36|| na saṃvasāmi goloke vaikuṇṭhe tava vakṣasi | sadā śivasya hṛdaye nibaddhaḥ premapāśataḥ ||37|| svarasiddhaṃ sutānena pañcavaktraiśca śaṃkaraḥ | śaśvad gāyati madgāthāṃ tenāhaṃ tatsamīpataḥ ||38|| mama bhaktiṃ ca dāsyaṃ ca muktiṃ ca sarvasampadaḥ | sarvasiddhīrdātumīśo na dātā śaṃkarāt paraḥ ||39|| pañcavaktraiḥ sa me nāma premṇā gāyatyaharniśam | madrūpaṃ dhyāyati śaśvanna bhaktaḥ śaṃkarātparaḥ ||1.516.40|| bhaktatvāt svapratāpādvā pātrabhedāt kṣaṇāntarāt | bhinnarūpakriyāceṣṭā dhatte manvantarāddharaḥ ||41 | | ahaṃ sudarśanaṃ śaṃbhustejasā ca vayaṃ samāḥ | brahmā sraṣṭā tu yogena nāsmābhistejasā samaḥ ||42|| sanatkumāro vaikuṇṭhamekadā prajagāma ha | dadarśa bhuktavantaṃ ca nāthaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ hi mām ||43|| mayā dattaṃ cāvaśeṣaṃ tasmai tuṣṭena cetasā | prāptamātreṇa tatraiva bhuktaṃ tenaiva kiñcana ||44|| kiṃcid rarakṣa bandhūnāṃ bhakṣaṇārthaṃ ca durlabham | kiṃcid dattaṃ śaṃkarāya bhuktaṃ sarvaṃ tu śaṃbhunā ||45|| bhaktyudrekāt prāptamātraṃ bhuktvā bhaktyā nanarta saḥ | pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgaḥ sāśrunetro mudānvitaḥ ||46|| gāyan mama guṇān bhaktyā sukaṇṭhaḥ paṃcavaktrataḥ | rāgabhedaikatānena tālamānena sundaram ||47|| papāta ḍamarurhastācchṛṅgaṃ ca vyāghracarma ca | svayaṃ nipatya paścācca rudan mūrchāmavāpa ha ||48|| atīva kamanīyaṃ tadrūpaṃ dhyātvaikamānasaḥ | sahasradalamadhyasthaṃ māṃ paśyan hṛtsaroruhe ||49|| etasminnantare devī pārvatī parameśvarī | mudājagāma śīghraṃ taṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇā ||1.516.50|| rudantaṃ mūrchitaṃ dṛṣṭvā nipatitaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ | prahasya vārtāṃ papraccha pārśvasthaṃ sarpameva sā ||51|| kāmarūpadharaṃ bhaktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ skandhavāsitam | sarvaṃ tāṃ kathayāmāsa nāgarāṭ saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ ||52|| nārāyaṇaprasādasyādanena premavihvalaḥ | īdṛśīṃ susamādheścāvasthāṃ prāpto’sti śaṃkaraḥ ||53|| śrutvā cukopa sā mahyaṃ prasādo nārpitaḥ katham | śaptaṃ cakre taducchiṣṭamabhakṣyaṃ viduṣāmapi |||54|| uvāca śaṃbhuṃ tvaṃ poṣṭā karoṣi durnayaṃ katham | sadā te paripālyāhaṃ poṣyā bhaktyā ca kiṃkarī ||55|| vañcitāhaṃ tvayā nātha hareḥ prasādabhakṣaṇe | pātraṃ hareḥ prasādasya tvaṃ bhaktaḥ prathamaṃ hareḥ ||56|| pātraṃ tava prasādasya pārvatyahaṃ tava priyā | pātraṃ harerharasyāpi prasādasyāhamīśvarī ||57|| adattvā vañcitā tvadya haranirmālyabhakṣaṇe | adatvā vañcitā cādya hareḥ prasādabhakṣaṇe |||58|| ato matto gṛhāṇedaṃ phalaṃ vañcanajaṃ śiva | adya prabhṛti ye lokā naivaidyaṃ bhuñjate tava ||59|| te janmaikaṃ sārameyā bhaviṣyantyeva sarvathā | ityuktvā pārvatī tatra ruroda purataḥ kṣaṇam ||1.516.60|| śivaḥ kareṇa tannetrajalamārjanamācarat | kṛtvā vakṣasi sadvākyairbādhayāmāsa sāntvanaiḥ ||61 || parituṣṭā tu sā devī bhartāraṃ samuvāca ha | kalevaraṃ saṃtyakṣyāmi naivedyena vinā hareḥ ||62|| bibharmi dehaṃ satataṃ tava saubhāgyavardhanam | kathaṃ vahāmi saubhāgyarahitaṃ nu kalevaram ||63|| apūrvaṃ tava naivedyaṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam | śaptaṃ mayā kṛtaṃ duṣṭaṃ sārameyajanupradam ||64|| yadi bhakṣyāmyahaṃ cāpi sārameyī bhavāmi ca | na bhakṣyāmi tadā patyuḥ prasādena tu vañcitā ||65|| pātivratyena dharmeṇa hīnā jīvāmi vai katham | tasmād dehaṃ parityajya yāmi golokameva ca ||66|| pārvatīṃ cetyuktavatīṃ dadau dhairyaṃ haraḥ svayam | śṛṇu devi kuru pākaṃ naivedyaṃ dehi viṣṇave ||67|| tatprasādamahaṃ bhuktvā tubhyaṃ dāsye sthirā bhava | liṃgaprasādastvagrāhya iti te’stu vacaḥphalam ||68|| pratimāyāḥ prasādastu grāhyaḥ sarvo bhaviṣyati | pratimāliṃgamiśro’pi sarvagrāhyo bhaviṣyati ||69|| evaṃ gṛhāṇa me śiṣṭaṃ pātivratye sthitā sadā | sārameyajanirnaiva tathā kṛte bhaviṣyati ||1.516.70|| liṃgamātraprasādādhikāre caṇḍapracaṇḍakau | niyuktau tau mayā bhaktau gaṇau mama nirantaram ||71 || ityuktā pārvatī kṛtvā pākaṃ śrīharaye dadau | śaṃkarāya dadau taṃ ca śiṣṭaṃ sā bubhuje satī ||72|| ityevaṃ liṃgaśiṣṭasyāgrāhyatvaṃ kathitaṃ rame | atha devī mahādevaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ vividhaṃ sadā ||73 || mama prasādaṃ nirvartya bhaktyā bhojayati satī | ṣaṭpaṃcāśatprasaṃkhyāni pakvānnavyañjanāni ca ||74|| nityaṃ mama prasādaṃ taṃ bhojayāmāsa sādaram | kṛṣṇajanmadine kṛtvā matprasādaṃ vidhāya ca ||75|| bhojayituṃ yadārabdhā vaiṣṇavaḥ śaṃkarastadā | devīṃ prāha śṛṇu tvadya dharmasaṃkaṭamāgatam ||76|| vratasyeṣṭasya divase bhojanaṃ grāhyameva na | kṛṣṇaprasādastyājyo na tyāge pāpaṃ śatādhikam ||77|| vadātra kiṃ prakartavyaṃ karomi cenna dūṣaṇam | pārvatī kṣaṇamātraṃ svahṛdaye’ntarviveśa ha ||78|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tatra prasasmāra hariḥ svayam | samāgatyāha deveśī paśya māṃ prati pārvati ||79|| śaṃkaro matsvarūpo’sti nātra bhedo hi vidyate | matsvarūpeṇa bhuñjīta nātra doṣo bhavettadā ||1.516.80|| bhaktarūpeṇa naivātra vrate bhoktavyameva ha | matsvarūpeṇa bhoktavyaṃ tatra doṣo na vidyate ||81|| vada tvaṃ śaṃkaraṃ devi bhaktaṃ rūpaṃ vihāya ca | bhagavadrūpamāsthāya karotu bhojanaṃ haraḥ ||82|| ityuktā sā satī tūrṇaṃ natvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | bahirāgatya kāntaṃ svaṃ yathoktaṃ prāha bhāvataḥ ||83|| bhaktarūpaṃ vihāyātra bhagavadrūpamāpnuhi | tato bhojanamādhatsva kṛṣṇe vibhau parātmani ||84|| śaṃbhuḥ prāha kathaṃ devi bhaktatvaṃ śāśvataṃ mama | tyājyaṃ bhaved vadātrārthe tattyāge dūṣaṇaṃ mahat ||85|| abhaktasya jalaṃ cānnaṃ grāhyaṃ paścānna vai bhavet | abhaktaḥ sarvathā varjyo vaiṣṇavaiśca surādibhiḥ ||86|| pārvatī prāha devāhaṃ tvabalā buddhivarjitā | tathāpi cātra vādārthe kathayāmi tathā kuru ||87|| yadi cāsmi tava bhaktā nānyabhaktā kadācana | siddhānnasya susārthakyaṃ bhavedevaṃkṛte kuru ||88|| kṛṣṇaḥ śaṃbhuśca sannyāsītyevaṃ trirūpavān bhava | kṛṣṇarūpeṇa vai sarvaṃ bhuṃkṣva siddhānnamatra me ||89|| tatprasādasvarūpaṃ tvaṃ bhuṃkṣva sannyāsirūpataḥ | sādhoḥ sannyāsinaścāpi prasādo me’rthakṛd bhavet ||1.516.90|| tavājñayā grahīṣyāmi na cennaiva spṛśāmyapi | jalaṃ phalaṃ kusumaṃ cauṣadhaṃ dugdhādiko rasaḥ ||91 || gurorvākyaṃ svāmivākyaṃ na vrataghna kadācana | ityuktaḥ śaṃkarastatra dadhāra pratimātrayam ||92|| kṛṣṇarūpo’nnasarvasvaṃ bubhuje pārvatīkṛtam | sārūpyena svarūpeṇa bhaktā bhuñjanti dhāmani ||93|| atha sannyāsanaiṣkarmye bhojane’pi na dūṣaṇam | iti kṛtvā ca bubhuje sannyāsī śaṃkaraḥ svayam ||94|| tatprasādaṃ satī devī sannyāsinīsvarūpiṇī | śaṃkarasyājñayā bhūtvā bubhuje haribhojanam ||95|| bhaktā pātramārjanādi cakre satīsvarūpiṇī | tāni rūpāṇi saṃhṛtya pārvatīparameśvarau ||96|| babhuvaturyathāpūrvarūpiṇau bhaktikāriṇau | ityevaṃ mama bhaktānāṃ lakṣmi bhaktirhi vidyate ||97|| sūkṣmaṃ vai dharmasarvasvaṃ ko nu jānāti taṃ vinā | śaṃkaraḥ sa tu sannyāsī triloke vyacaranmudā ||98|| mama bhaktiṃ cakārogrāmakārayacca vaiṣṇavān | kāle kāle tathā bhūtvā bhaktiṃ karoti me śivaḥ ||99|| śivāpi yatinī bhūtvā bhaktiṃ karoti me tathā | mama jñānāśrayaḥ śaṃbhurācāryaḥ śāstrakṛt tathā || 1.516.1 00|| tārako baddhajīvānāṃ jñānabhaktipradāyakaḥ | na hyammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilāmayāḥ || 10 1|| yajñarūpāṇi puṇyāni vratānyanaśanāni ca | tapāṃsi nānādānāni vipradevārcanāni ca || 1 02|| ciraṃ punanti sarvāṇi darśanādeva sādhavaḥ | susatāṃ viṣṇubhaktānāṃ rajasāṃ sparśamātrataḥ || 103 || pūtānāṃ pādapadmānāṃ sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā | tīrthāni ca pavitrāṇi samudrāḥ parvatāstathā || 1 04|| surā darśanamicchanti satāṃ pātakanāśinām | so’jñānī naiva bubudhe santaṃ manuṣyajanmanā || 1 05|| paramaṃ svādu dugdhaṃ vai na jānāti tathā dadhi | tathā sadbhyo jāyamānaṃ na jānāti sato janān || 1 06|| svagṛhaṃ naiva jānāti parajñānena vai vṛthā | sa eva paramo lābho vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāṃ kṛpā || 107|| bhavābdhitaraṇe taryyāṃ tatra santo hi nāvikāḥ | viprā guravo lokasya santo vipragurūttamāḥ || 108|| sanakādyā mahāsantaḥ sannyāsino’tipāvanāḥ | śodhayanti bhuvanāni vāsanā dīrghakālajāḥ || 1 09|| evaṃ sa śaṃkaro bhakto bhaktā śivā tathā mama | sādhusādhvīrūpayuktau prasādārthaṃ babhūvatuḥ || 1.516.11 0|| padmaje mama bhaktānāṃ madarthaṃ kimasādhyakam | mama lābhārthamevaite sarvaṃ tyajanti rodhakam || 111 || iti te kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ punaśca smāritaṃ śubham | mama dāsyaṃ hare devyāṃ tvayi cāpi parātparam || 11 2|| etasya śravaṇātpāṭhānmananādvartanāttathā | bhuktirmuktirmama dāsyaṃ sarvaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 113 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃkarasya garvaharaṇaṃ, bhaktyudrekatā, paramabhāgavatasarvasvārpaṇadharmavattvaṃ, sannyāsarūpadhāritvaṃ, bhagavatprasādāśitvaṃ, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣoḍaśādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 516 ||
<1.517> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi purā tvāsīd hiraṇyakaśipurmahān | tasya putradvayaṃ jajñe prahlādaścāndhakastathā || 1 || hiraṇyakaśipau prāpte paralokaṃ hareḥ karāt | amātyairabhiṣekāya prahrādaḥ sanniyojitaḥ || 2 || kintu naicchat sa rājya tad dānavairdveṣakāraṇāt | tato’ndhako’bhiṣiktaśca rājye dānavapuṃgavaiḥ || 3 || andhako’pi samārādhya brahmāṇaṃ tvamaro’bhavat | yāvatkalpa varapuṣṭastataḥ śakraṃ jigāya saḥ || 4 || amarāvatikāṃ svasya rājadhānīṃ cakāra saḥ | indraḥ śaṃbhuṃ samārādhya varaṃ vavre surārthakam || 5 || andhakena hṛtaṃ sarvaṃ devarājyaṃ makhādikam | yajñabhāgādikaṃ sarvaṃ rājyaṃ hṛtaṃ prayaccha me || 6 || śivastathāstviti prāha preṣayāmāsa taṃ prati | vīrabhadraṃ nijadūtaṃ sa gatvovāca cāndhakam || 7 || harādeśātparityajya svargaṃ gaccha dharātalam | pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyaṃ pṛthivyāṃ tvaṃ samācara || 8 || no cet tava padaṃ sarvaṃ śaṃkaraḥ saṃhariṣyati | andhakastaṃ vīrabhadraṃ samuvāca haraṃ vada || 9 || kastvaṃ śmaśānavāso’si gaṇanāyāṃ mamāntike | kailāsaṃ me samarpya tvama kāśyāṃ gaccha śmaśānake || 1.517.10 || no cet prāṇān hariṣyāmi tava sendrasya śaṃkara | śrutvā vīraprabhadrastaṃ vinirbhartsya yayau haram || 11 || kathayāmāsa tadvākyaṃ sannaddhaśca haro’bhavat | gaṇairdevaistathā cānyaiḥ sainyairyukto’marāvatīm || 1 2|| yayau tāṃ vāhinīṃ dṛṣṭvā tatrasurdaityapuṃgavāḥ | andhakena tu nidrāyāṃ dṛṣṭaṃ duḥsvapnamulbaṇam || 13 || samudvegabhayavyāptaścāhārotsāhavarjitaḥ | andhakaḥ putramitrādīnāha sarvamariṣṭakam || 1 4|| mayā dṛṣṭo niśīthe’dya duḥsvapno’tibhayapradaḥ | bibhrato raktapuṣpāṇāṃ mālā ca raktacandanam || 15|| raktāmbaraṃ tīkṣṇakhaṅgaṃ kharparaṃ ca bhayānakam | prakṛtyāṭṭāṭṭahāsaṃ ca lalajjihvā bhayaṃkarī || 1 6|| atīva vṛddhā kṛṣṇāṃgī nārī pure’tra nṛtyati | muktakeśī chinnanāsā kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇāmbarānvitā || 1 7|| vidhavā sā mahāśūdrā mamāliṃganakāmukī | malinaṃ celakhaṇḍaṃ ca bibhratī rūkṣamūrdhajān || 18|| dadhatī cūrṇatilakaṃ kapole mama vakṣasi | hasitvā krūratāṃ darśayitvā cumbati māṃ muhuḥ || 19 || kṛṣṇavarṇāni pakvāni chinnabhinnāni sarvaśaḥ | patanti kṛtvā śabdāṃśca śaśvattālaphalāni hi || 1.517.20 || kucailo vikṛtākāro mleccho hi rūkṣamūrdhajaḥ | dadāti mahyaṃ bhūṣāyāṃ chinnabhinnakapardakān ||2 1|| mahāruṣṭā ca divyā strī patiputravatī satī | babhaṃja pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ ca sābhiśapya punaḥ punaḥ ||22|| amlānāṃ muṇḍamālāṃ ca raktacandanacarcitām | dadāti mahyaṃ vipraśca mahāruṣṭo’tiśapya vai ||23|| kṣaṇamaṃgāravṛṣṭiśca bhasmavṛṣṭiḥ kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇam | kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃ raktavṛṣṭirjāyate nagare mama |||24|| vānaraṃ vāyasaṃ śvānaṃ bhallūkaṃ sūkaraṃ kharam | paśyāmi vikaṭākāraṃ śabdaṃ kurvantamulbaṇam ||25|| paśyāmi śuṣkakāṣṭhānāṃ rāśimamlānakajjalam | aruṇodayavelāyāṃ kapīṃśchinnanakhāni ca |||26|| pītavastraparīdhānā śuklacandanacarcitā | bibhratī mālatīmālāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā |||27|| krīḍākamalahastā ca sindūrabinduśobhitā | kṛtvābhiśāpaṃ māṃ ruṣṭā yāti manmandirāt satī ||28|| pāśahastām̐śca puruṣān muktakeśān bhayaṃkarān | atirūkṣām̐śca paśyāmi viśato nagaraṃ mama ||29|| nagnanārīṃ muktakeśīṃ nṛtyantīṃ ca gṛhe gṛhe | atīva vikṛtākārāṃ paśyāmi sasmitāṃ sadā ||1.517.30|| chinnanāsā ca vidhavā mahāśūdrī digambarā | sā tailābhyaṃgitaṃ māṃ ca karotyatibhayaṃkarī || 31 || nirvāṇāṃgārayuktāśca bhasmapūrṇā digambarāḥ | atiprabhātasamaye citrāḥ paśyāmi sasmitāḥ ||3 2|| paśyāmi ca vivāhaṃ ca nṛtyagītamanoharam | raktavastraparīdhānānpuruṣān raktamūrdhajān ||33|| raktaṃ vamantaṃ puruṣaṃ nṛtyantaṃ nagnamulbaṇam | dhāvantaṃ ca śayānaṃ ca paśyāmi sasmitaṃ tathā ||34|| rāhugrastaṃ ca gagane maṇḍalaṃ candrasūryayoḥ | ekakāle prapaśyāmi sarvagrāsaṃ ca tāmasam ||35|| ulkāpātaṃ dhūmaketuṃ bhūkampaṃ rāṣṭraviplavam | jhañjhāvātaṃ mahotpātaṃ paśyāmi ca kṣitiāsthitaḥ ||36|| vāyunā ghūrṇyamānām̐śca chinnaskandhānmahāruhān | patitān parvatāṃścaiva paśyāmi pṛthivītale ||37|| puruṣaṃ chinnaśirasaṃ nṛtyantaṃ nagnamucchritam | muṇḍamālākaraṃ ghoraṃ paśyāmi ca gṛhe gṛhe ||38|| dagdhaṃ sarvāśramaṃ bhasmapūrṇamaṅgārasaṃkulam | hāhākāraṃ prakurvantaṃ sarvaṃ paśyāmi sarvataḥ ||39|| snātuṃ gacchāmi ca nadīṃ sā tu śuṣkāyate kṣaṇāt | mūrtayo devatānāṃ ca dṛṣṭā vilīnatāṃ gatāḥ ||1.517.40|| gardabhaṃ ghoṭakaṃ gantrīyutaṃ yāntaṃ ca dakṣiṇām | gantryāṃ sthitaṃ ca māṃ tatra prapaśyāmi ciraṃ muhuḥ ||41 || anyatra gamanaṃ me vai bhāti lokāntaraṃ prati | mayaiva ca vivāho’pi mayā dṛṣṭo hi yoṣitā ||42|| gāgreśamastakaṃ skandhādviyuktaṃ dagdhamityapi | nadyāṃ mayeti sandṛṣṭaṃ kṣaṇājjāgaruko’bhavam ||43|| uṣṭro bhūphalinīrbhuktvā māṃ pratyetīti vīkṣitam | siddhānnāni vīkṣitāni na ca bhuktāni vai mayā ||44|| svapne cātīva kalahaḥ parasparaṃ pravīkṣitaḥ | svasyaiva muṇḍanaṃ svapne kāritaṃ ca mayā muhuḥ || 45|| haritadrumaśākhānāṃ bhaṃgā vilokitā mayā | samudre brūḍati kaścinmama bandhurvilokitaḥ ||46|| kasyacilliṃgato raktaṃ niḥsṛtaṃ vīkṣitaṃ mayā | brāhmaṇastvatiruṣṭaśca śapatītyavalokitam || 47|| jīrṇāmbaraṃ dhṛtaṃ dehe naṣṭaṃ tatpatitaṃ tathā | kukkurā māṃ vilokyaiva bhaṣantītyavalokitam ||48|| śuṣkakāṣṭhāni ca mayā dvedhīkṛtāni hastataḥ | nikṛntane yantreṇa vellaṇārthaṃ vilokitam ||49|| phaṇāphullo mahāsarpo dṛṣṭaścāpi mṛto’pi saḥ | vyomasetorbālakaścākūrdayat patituṃ jale ||1.517.50|| jalaṃ vihāya ca dūraṃ pāṣāṇe patito bhramāt | anyasya bhavane dṛṣṭaṃ goṣṭhaṃ riktaṃ vivartitam ||51 || āraṇyakaśca mārjāro vilokito mayā vane | kṛṣṇāmbaro jano māṃ dhūṣkṛtīyantreṇa vai sukṛt ||52|| alakṣayad yathā hantuṃ kṛtvā māṃ vai pradakṣiṇam | mayā riktā dhūṣkṛtī sā sphoṭitā taṃ janaṃ prati ||53 || gauḥ savatsā bahiryāti rātrau mamāśramāt tathā | bhavanasya dhvajaścāpi patitaścāvalokitaḥ |||54|| satkāryārthaṃ ca kośasya kuñcikā naiva vīkṣitā | āśīrvādaparā viprā māṃ vihāyānyato gatāḥ ||55|| evaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ mayā svapne sarvamadya niśātyaye | na jāne kiṃ daivayogād viparītaṃ bhavediti ||56|| śuśoceti varṇayitvāndhakastāvacca tatpriyā | patnī rātrau ca duḥsvapnaṃ yad dadarśa jagāda tat ||57|| śṛṇu rājan mamāpyadyārīṣṭāni hi niśātyaye | upasthitāni nidrāyāṃ taiśca bhayaṃ vrajāmi vai ||58|| aho svāminnihāgaccha tvāṃ karomi svavakṣasi | pariṇāme vidhātā me na jāne kiṃ kariṣyati |||59|| ratnasiṃhāsane’haṃ ca ratnacchatraṃ ca bibhratī | tadātapatraṃ jagrāha ruṣṭo viprastu me prabho ||1.517.60|| sāgare kajjalākāre mahāghore ca dustare | gabhīre prerayāmāsa māmeva durbalāṃ sa ca |||61 || tatra srotasi śokārtā bhramāmi ca muhurmuhuḥ | mahaurmīṇāṃ ca vegena vyākulā nakrasaṃkulaiḥ ||62|| trāhi trāhīti he nātha tvāṃ vadāmi mṛtaṃ patim | tvāṃ na dṛṣṭvā mahābhītā karomi bahurodanam ||63|| nātha tatra nimajantī paśyāmi candramaṇḍalam | nipatantaṃ ca gaganācchatakhaṇḍaṃ ca bhūtale ||64|| kṣaṇāntare śatakhaṇḍaṃ sūryaṃ paśyāmi bhūtale | ekakāle dvayorgrāhaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ cākāśamaṇḍalam ||65|| kṣaṇāntare prapaśyāmi brāhmaṇo dīptimāniti | matkroḍasthasudhākuṃbhaṃ babhañja praruṣeti ca ||66|| kṣaṇāntare prapaśyāmi mahāruṣaṃ ca bhūsuram | gṛhītvā saṃvrajantaṃ ca sannidhau vai patiṃ mama ||67|| krīḍākapāladaṇḍaṃ ca hastāddhastaṃ mama prabho | sahasā khaṇḍakhaṇḍaṃ ca babhūva saha hetunā ||68|| hastāddhastaṃ ca sahasā darpaṇo valayastathā | nirmalaḥ kajjalākāraḥ khaṇḍakhaṇḍo babhūva ha ||69|| hāro me ratnasārāṇāṃ chinno bhūtvā ca vakṣasaḥ | atīva malinaṃ padmaṃ papāta dharaṇisthale ||1.517.70|| saudhaputtalikāḥ sarvā nṛtyanti ca hasanti ca | āsphoṭayanti gāyanti rudanti ca kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ||71|| kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ bṛhacchastraṃ triśūlaṃ khe samāgatam | nipatantaṃ bhramantaṃ cotpatantaṃ tvavalokaye ||72|| prāṇādhidevaḥ puruṣo niḥsṛtyābhyantarānmama | priye vidāyaṃ dehīti tato yāmītyuvāca mām ||73|| kṛṣṇavarṇā ca pratimā māmāśliṣyati cumbati | kṛṣṇavastraparīdhānā svapne paśyāmi sāmpratam ||74|| itīdaṃ viparītaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā vai prāṇavallabha | nṛtyanti dakṣiṇāṃgāni prāṇā āndolayanti me ||75|| rudanti śokāt karṣanti samudvignaṃ ca mānasam | tava vāmāṃgakampaṃ ca lokayāmi punaḥ punaḥ ||76|| kimidaṃ kimidaṃ nātha viparītaṃ bhaviṣyati | ityuktvā taṃ samāśliṣya kṣaṇaṃ sukhaṃ lalābha ha ||77|| andhakastāṃ samāśliṣya dadau dhairyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | premṇā tvākṛṣya tanvaṃgīṃ parirebhe cucumba ca ||78|| etasminneva samaye mahendrasya śubhāni vai | susvapnānyabhavam̐stena tutoṣa hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ||79|| dadarśa prathamaṃ viprabālakaṃ padmalocanam | bhūṣitaṃ sasmitaṃ puṣpamālācandanarājitam ||1.517.80|| baddhaśikhaṃ satilakaṃ japantaṃ vedamātaram | tato dadarśa rucirāṃ patiputravatīṃ satīm ||8 1|| svarṇavastraparīdhānāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām | jvalatpradīpahastāṃ ca śukladhānyakarāṃ varām ||82|| śaraccandranibhāsyāṃ ca sasmitāṃ varadāṃ śubhām | tato dadarśa vipraṃ ca prakurvantaṃ śubhāśiṣam ||83 || śvetapadmaṃ rājahaṃsaṃ turagaṃ ca sarovaram | dadarśa citritaṃ cāru phalitaṃ puṣpitaṃ śubham ||84|| āmranimbanārikelāgurvarkakadalītarum | daśantaṃ śvetasarpa ca svātmānaṃ parvatasthitam ||85|| vṛkṣasthaṃ ca gajasthaṃ ca tarīsthaṃ turagasthitam | vīṇāṃ pravādayantaṃ ca bhuñjānaṃ miṣṭapāyasam ||86|| dadhikṣīrayutānnaṃ ca padmapatrasthamīpsitam | kṛmiviṭsahitāṃgaṃ ca śuklacandanacarcitam ||87|| śukladhānyapuṣpahastaṃ prāsādasthaṃ samudragam | tato dadarśa rajataṃ maṇiṃ śubhraṃ ca kāñcanam ||88|| muktāmāṇikyaratnaṃ ca pūrṇakuṃbhajalaṃ śubham | surabhiṃ sahavatsāṃ ca vṛṣabhendraṃ mayūrakam ||89|| śukaṃ ca sārasaṃ haṃsaṃ cillaṃ khañjanamityapi | tāmbūlaṃ puṣpamālyaṃ ca jvaladagniṃ surārcanam ||1.517.90 || pārvatīpratimāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sannidhau | śāṃkaraṃ cojjvalaṃ liṃgaṃ guruṃ devaṃ bṛhaspatim ||91 || viprabālāṃ suphalitāṃ kṛṣiṃ pakvaphalānvitām | devasthalīṃ ca rājendraṃ siṃhaṃ vyāghraṃ gajaṃ munim ||92|| dṛṣṭvā svapnaṃ samuttasthau cakārāhnikamīpsitam | śaṃkaraṃ kathayāmāsa sarvaṃ vṛttāntameva tam ||93|| śaṃkaro’pi tadā prāha mahendraṃ śakunāni vai | yāni dadarśa mārge sa maṃgalārhāṇi sarvathā ||94|| jayapradāni sarvāṇi maṃgalāsūcakāni vai | vāme vipraṃ śivāṃ pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ nakulacāṣakam ||95|| patiputravatīṃ sādhvīṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitām | śuklapuṣpaṃ ca mālyaṃ ca dhānyaṃ ca khañjanaṃ śubham ||96|| dakṣiṇe jvaladagniṃ ca vipraṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ gajam | vatsaprayuktāṃ dhenuṃ ca śvetāśvaṃ rājahaṃsakam ||97|| veśyāṃ ca puṣpamālāṃ ca patākāṃ dadhi pāyasam | maṇiṃ suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ muktāmāṇikyamīpsitam ||98|| madyaṃ māṃsaṃ candanaṃ ca mādhvīkaṃ ghṛtamuttamam | kṛṣṇasāraṃ phalaṃ lājāṃ siddhānnaṃ darpaṇaṃ tathā ||99|| vicitritaṃ vimānaṃ ca sudīptāṃ pratimāṃ tathā | śuklotpalaṃ padmavanaṃ śaṃkhacillaṃ ca korakam || 1.517.10 0|| mārjāraṃ parvataṃ meghaṃ mayūraṃ śukasārasam | śaṃkhakokilavādyānāṃ dhvaniṃ śuśrāva maṅgalam || 101 || vicitrakṛṣṇasaṃgītaṃ hariśabdaṃ jayadhvanim | evaṃbhūtaṃ śubhaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kathayāmāsa sarvathā || 1 02|| tāvad bheryo hyavādyanta śaṃkhāḥ śaṃkarasainyake | andhakaścāpi vijñāya sasainyaḥ samaraṃ yayau || 1 03|| prathamaṃ militā nagnā vidhavā khaṇḍavastrikā | malinā vikṛtākārā chinnanāsordhvamūrdhajā || 1 04|| gardabho mahiṣaścoṣṭraḥ sūkaraḥ śvā ca bhallukaḥ | kāko gṛdhro vānaraśca kaṃkaḥ śuṣkatṛṇāni ca || 1 05|| kulālastailakāraśca nāpito rajakastathā | dagdhakāṣṭhaṃ galatkuṣṭho vṛṣalo kalahadvijaḥ || 1 06|| ruṣṭabhikṣuḥ pramuṇḍā ca pramuṇḍī kṛpaṇastathā | kṣutkāraḥ śastrapatanaṃ rathātmukuṭapātanam || 1 07|| dhvajadarpaṇapatanaṃ tvaśvānāṃ jānubhugnatā | riktaṃ kalaśayugalaṃ kṛṣṇasarpo bhayaṃkaraḥ || 1 08|| ghūkasya darśanaṃ ceti samīpe mīlitāni vai | mṛtyusūcakavastūni vīkṣitānyandhakena vai || 10 9|| pavanaścātivegena sammukhaṃ vāti duḥkhakṛt | yantrīcakraṃ prabhagnaṃ ca hastiḥ pramattatāṃ gataḥ || 1.517.11 0|| viditvaivaṃ raṇe trasto bahirdhairyāvalambanaḥ | uparyāḍambarayukto mṛtyuniścitamānasaḥ || 111 || andhakaḥ koṭisainyena harāntikamupāyayau | dadarśa devasainyāni bhuvi vyomni jale’pi ca || 1 12|| dānavānāṃ ca sainyāni sannaddhāni pratikramāt | yuddhāraṃbhasya vādyāni tvavādyantāsurādiṣu || 113 || yuddhabodhakacihnātmadhvajā vyomni cakāśire daityaḥ saśaṃkaraṃ natvā mumoca śatasāyakān || 1 14|| śaṃkarastānardhacandraiśchitvā mumoca mārgaṇān | śilīmukhān śatasaṃkhyān daityastān pracakarta ha || 1 15|| evaṃ samabhavad yuddhaṃ devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha | gaṇaiśca vikṛtākārairdānavānāṃ bhayaṃkaram || 1 16|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’ndhakāsurasya tatpatnyāśca duṣṭasvapnādyapaśakunāni, indrasya suśakunāni, śaṃkareṇa sahāndhakasya yuddhaṃ ceti nirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||517||
<1.518> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tadā yuddhe senayorubhayorapi | dāruṇaścāprameyaśca saṃgrāmo jīvadakṣiṇaḥ || 1 || bhayaṃkaro’bhavad vyomni pṛthvyāṃ jale’pi sarvaśaḥ | etasminnantare tatra bhadrākhyastu mahābalaḥ || 2 || andhakasya mahāsenāpatirbalī mahārathī | nirbhartsya śaṃkaraṃ kārtikeyaṃ gaṇādhipaṃ tathā || 3 || cikṣepa śrīgaṇeśe vai bāṇaṃ pralayavahnibham | tadbāṇaṃ tvardhacandreṇa saṃciccheda gaṇādhipaḥ || 4 || bhadraścikṣepa sūryābhāṃ śaktiṃ skandaṃ prati krudhā | kārtikeyastu tāṃ vaiṣṇavāstreṇa vyahanat tadā || 5 || bhadraścikṣepa tu nārāyaṇāstraṃ raṇamūrdhani | praṇamya kārtikeyastu śete pṛthivīmāśritaḥ || 6 || ūrdhvamastraṃ tu babhrāma śatasūryasamaprabham | pralīnamastramākāśe viśvasaṃhārakārakam || 7 || astre gate kārtikeyo gṛhītvā svagadāṃ dṛḍhām | bhadrarathaṃ prababhañja jaghānāśvām̐śca sārathim || 8 || andhakasya tu senāpastadā dudrāva kārtikam | bhadraṃ taṃ kārtikeyastu śaktyā jaghāna vai krudhā || 9 || dvedhā vibhidya patito mamāra sa raṇāṃgaṇe | hate bhadre’ndhakaputro dhūmro mahāparākramaḥ || 1.518.1 0|| bāṇānāṃ śatakaṃ skande cikṣepa raṇamūrdhani | kārtikeyo’gnibāṇena bāṇaughān pradadāha ca || 11 || dhūmraścikṣepa brahmāstraṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakam | dṛṣṭvā śaṃbhvātmajaḥ śīghraṃ sabījaṃ mantrapūrvakam || 1 2|| brahmāstreṇaiva sahasā sañjahārāvalīlayā | dhūmraḥ śilīmukhairbāṇairjaghāna kārtikaṃ muhuḥ || 1 3|| kārtikeyastu tad dṛṣṭvā dhanurbāṇaughasaṃyutam | mumoca jṛmbhaṇaṃ yuddhe śīghraṃ taṃ ca mahāratham || 14|| jaḍo babhūva dhūmrastu niśceṣṭo raṇamūrdhani | punaścikṣepa nidrāstraṃ dhūmraśca nidrito’bhavat || 15|| tāvadvai tvandhakastaṃ ca bodhāstreṇāprabodhayat | skandastu śatabāṇaistaṃ jaghānāsuramandhakam || 16|| andhako’pi kārtikaṃ ca triśūlena jaghāna ha | gadayā kārtikarathaṃ babhañja ratnanirmitam || 17|| gadayā kārtikaḥ kruddho babhaṃjāndhakavāhanam | andhakaścārdhacandreṇa kṣuradhāreṇa līlayā || 18|| ciccheda kārtikadhanurbhallāstreṇa niyojitam | kārtiko gadayā gatvāndhakaṃ pṛṣṭhe jaghāna ha || 19|| andhakaḥ patito mūrchāṃ jagāmātha kṣaṇāntare | vīrabhadro gaṇeśaśca kārtiko bhairavāstathā ||1.518.20|| kālyaśca raṇacaṇḍyaśca yuyudhurdānavaiḥ saha | dānavāstu śaṃkukarṇo māhiṣākṣo vṛkānanaḥ || 21 || vindhyahanuryamaskandho vṛṣaśṛṃgo guhānanaḥ | krūrakramo vivarākṣo yuyudhuste suraiḥ saha ||22|| śaṃkarastu tadā śūlaṃ gṛhītvā cāndhakāsuram | hantuṃ cakāra yatnaṃ ca mahāśaṃkhaṃ hyavādayat ||23|| rathamadhye svayaṃ śaṃbhuḥ sthitaḥ saṃhārakārakaḥ | mahārathānāṃ lakṣaiśca rathānāṃ ca trikoṭibhiḥ ||24|| trikoṭibhirgajendrāṇāṃ mallānāṃ ca trikoṭibhiḥ | śatakoṭibhiraśvānāṃ carmiṇāṃ taccaturguṇaiḥ ||25 || khaḍgināṃ tatsaptaguṇairdviguṇaistaddhanuṣmatām | aṣṭau cāpi diśāṃpālā bhairavā devakoṭayaḥ ||26 || sānnāhikā yuyudhuśca dānavaiḥ śatakoṭibhiḥ | unmattabhairavaścāpi saṃhārabhairavastathā ||27|| asitāṃgo bhairavaśca rurubhairava ityapi | mahābhairavasaṃjñaśca kālabhairava ityatha ||28|| pracaṇḍabhairavaścāpi krodhabhairava ulbaṇaḥ | śaktibhiḥ sahitāḥ sarve yuyudhire raṇāṃgaṇe ||29|| ugracaṇḍā pracaṇḍā ca caṇḍikā caṇḍināyikā | caṇḍeśvarī ca cāmuṇḍā caṇḍī caṇḍakapālikā ||1.518.3 0|| koṭaryādyāstathā cānyā yuyudhire raṇāṃgaṇe | candrāṇī vaiṣṇavī śāntā brahmāṇī brahmavādinī ||3 1 || kaumārī nārasiṃhī ca vārāhī vikaṭākṛtiḥ | māheśvarī mahāmāyā bhairavī bhīmarūpiṇī ||32|| rathasthāstāstadā sarvā yuyudhire’suraiḥ saha | rākṣasyaḥ parvataprāyā yuddhaṃ cakruśca koṭiśaḥ ||33|| andhakaḥ śaṃkaraṃ hantuṃ divyāstreṇa niyojitam | dhanurdadhāra saguṇaṃ cikṣepa ca śaraṃ hare ||34|| aṃjanaṃ nāma divyāstraṃ grīṣmamārtaṇḍasannibham | hariścikṣepa dhāvalyaṃ divyāstraṃ candrasannibham ||35 || vahniṃ cikṣepāndhakaśca harastaṃ vāruṇena vai | prajvalantaṃ tālamānaṃ nirvāṇaṃ pracakāra saḥ ||36|| vāyuṃ cikṣepāndhakaśca cikṣepa pārvataṃ haraḥ | nārāyaṇāstraṃ cikṣepa hyandhako raṇamūrdhani ||37|| śaṃbhurbhārgavasaṃśreṣṭho nārāyaṇaṃ nanāma tam | cikṣepa cāndhako nāgamastraṃ śrīśaṃkaropari ||38|| śaṃkaro garuḍenaiva saṃjahāra kṣaṇena vai | andhakastvardhacandraṃ ca cikṣepa śaṃkaropari ||3 9|| śaṃbhurgadāṃ pracikṣepāndhakaṃ prati bhayānakām | andhakasya rathaścūrṇo babhūva sārathistathā ||1.518.40|| indro vajraṃ pracikṣepāndhakaṃ bhasmakaraṃ tadā | andhakena mukhe grastaṃ vidyudrūpaṃ jalaṃ yathā ||41|| andhakaśca tadā pracikṣependraṃ hantumeva ca | brahmāstraṃ śaṃkarastacca brahmāstreṇa nyavārayat ||582|| andhakastu tadā śaṃbhuṃ hantuṃ khaḍgena vegataḥ | dudrāvābhimukhaḥ sainye hāhākāro’bhavattadā ||43|| martukāmo maheśasya sannidhau yajjagāma ha | śaṃkaraṃ sa jaṭāyāṃ vai jaghānātibalena tu ||44|| jaṭā dvedhābhavat tūrṇaṃ khaḍgo dvedhābhavattathā | vīrabhadreṇa ca gadā tāḍitā gadayā saha ||45|| andhako bhūtale tvardhaḥ praviṣṭo vivare tadā ||46|| vīrabhadradhṛtāṃ lauhīṃ gadāmāśliṣya cāndhakaḥ | ākṛṣṭayā tu gadayā sahaiva niryayau talāt ||47|| viyuktaḥ san haraṃ hantuṃ śaktiṃ jagrāha cāyasīm | śaṃbhustriśūlamādāya cikṣepāsuravakṣasi ||48|| sa viddho’pi svayaṃ tena triśūlena mahāsuraḥ | brahmaṇo varamāhātmyānna ca prāṇairviyujyate ||49 || tasya tapaḥphalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rakṣatyeva punaḥ punaḥ | śatavarṣaṃ phalāhāraḥ śatavarṣaṃ dalādanaḥ |||1.518.5 0|| śatavarṣaṃ mūlabhakṣī śatavarṣaṃ sumādanaḥ | śatavarṣaṃ kandabhakṣī śatavarṣamayācitaḥ ||51 || śatavarṣaṃ jalāhāraḥ śatavarṣaṃ tu bāṣpapaḥ | śatavarṣaṃ vāyubhakṣī śatavarṣaṃ tvabhojanaḥ |||52|| tato varṣasahasraṃ vai jalāntavartisaṃsthitaḥ | tasya vai tapasā jātānalena vāriśuṣkatā ||5 3 || jātā tatra tu pṛthivī samadṛśyata lāvaṇī | tatra varṣasahasraṃ tu tṛtīyaṃ vyagamattadā ||54|| valmīkaḥ sumahān jāto vaṃśastambābhyadhiṣṭhitaḥ | prasanno viśvasṛṭ tasmai varaṃ vṛṇu samāha ca ||55|| sa ca vavre tava hastānna me śaṃkarahastataḥ | na vā viṣṇoḥ karādvāpi devībhyo devatādibhiḥ ||56|| tava sṛṣṭau bhavenmṛtyuściraṃjīvo bhavāmi ca | anenaiva tu dehena divyatāṃ pravrajāmi ca ||57|| itiśrutvāha vedhāstaṃ tathāstviti tathā bhava | ityevaṃ varadānena divyakāyo mahāsuraḥ ||58|| nāyaṃ nāśamavāpnoti punarutthāya vai balī | jaghāna ca samākruddho viśeṣeṇa bahūn gaṇān ||59|| śaṃkaraṃ tāḍayāmāsa gadāpātairmuhurmuhuḥ | evaṃ yuddhaṃ samabhavacciraṃ svarge pinākinā ||1.518.6 0|| triśūlabhinno daityaḥ sa yadā mṛtyuṃ na gacchati | utthāyotthāya kruddhastu prahāreṇārdayadbalī ||6 1 || śaṃkarastaṃ suvimṛśya mṛtyunā parivarjitam | tato nirbhidya śūlāgre protkṣipya gaganāṃgaṇe ||62|| chatravad dhārayāmāsa lambamānamadhomukham | kṣarantaṃ rudhiraṃ bhūmau gātrebhyo varṣmasaṃbhavam ||63 || ciraṃ taṃ sthāpayāmāsa tathaiva śūladhārayā | tataḥ kālena yuddhena carmāsthisnāyumātrakaḥ ||64|| dhātutrayayutaścāyaṃ naṣṭadhātucatuṣṭayaḥ | ato’ndhako balahīnaḥ stutiṃ cakāra dīnavat ||65|| na tvaṃ devo mayā jñāto vāgduṣṭena durātmanā | īdṛgvīryasamopetastasmād yuktaṃ bhavatkṛtam ||66|| anurūpaṃ madāndhasya vivekarahitasya ca | durvinītaḥ śriyaṃ prāpya vidyāmaiśvaryamityapi || 67|| na tiṣṭhati ciraṃ kālaṃ yathāhaṃ madagarvitaḥ | pāpo’haṃ pāpakarmāhaṃ pāpātmā pāpasaṃbhavaḥ ||68|| trāhi māṃ deva īśāna sarvapāpāni kṣālaya | duḥkhito’haṃ varāko’haṃ dīno’haṃ śaktivarjitaḥ ||69|| trātumarhasi māṃ deva prapannaṃ śaraṇe sthitam | sarvapāpakṣaṇe śaṃbho tvayi sañjāyate matiḥ ||1.518.70|| nāmamātraṃ tava kṛtvā muktimāpnoti pāpakṛt | tava pūjāvihīnānāṃ divasā vandhyatānvitāḥ ||71 || tasmād bhaktaṃ tava rūpaṃ jānantaṃ mocayātra mām | svagaṇaṃ kuru divyaṃ vai dehenānena nānyathā ||72|| gato me dānavo bhāvastyaktaṃ rājyaṃ tathā prabho | tyaktāḥ putrāḥ praputrāśca vibhavāśca mayādya vai ||73|| tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā daityaṃ vigatakalmaṣam | uttārya śanakaiḥ śūlācchaṃbhurvinayasaṃśritam ||74|| tasya nāma tadā cakre bhṛṃgirīṭiriti prabhuḥ | abravīcca sadā me tvaṃ vallabhaḥ saṃbhaviṣyasi ||75|| tiṣṭha saumyatayā sarvagaṇeṣu mama cāśritaḥ | ityevaṃ jalasaṃskārāt kṛtvā taṃ navavigraham ||76|| nināya śaṃbhuḥ kailāsaṃ devādyāḥ svagṛhaṃ yayuḥ | svargarājyaṃ yathāyogyaṃ prāptavantaḥ punaḥ svakam ||77|| atha duṣṭaḥ sutastasyāndhakasya dānaveśvaraḥ | vṛko nāma mahākrūraḥ praviveśābdhivāriṣu ||78|| indro yayau purīṃ ramyāmamarāvatīsaṃjñikām | yajñabhāgān punarlebhire sudevā dharātale ||79|| vṛko varṣasahasrāṇi tapastepe padā sthitaḥ | aṃguṣṭhamātrasaṃsthānaḥ pañcasāhasravatsare ||1.518.80|| brahmaṇo varadānaṃ ca jarāmaraṇavarjitam | lebhe tato yayāvadriṃ saurāṣṭre revatācalam ||81 || tataḥ svargaṃ yayāvindrapadaṃ jigāya vai sthitaḥ | śukrātprāpyābhiṣekaṃ ca svayamindro babhūva ha ||82|| tena yajñādayaḥ sarve devakāryāṇi yānyapi | japahomādayaḥ pitṛkāryāṇi viprapūjanam ||83|| sarvaṃ vināśitaṃ svasya kṛtaṃ karādikaṃ tathā | sva eva yajñabhāgānāṃ bhoktā nānyaḥ kadācana ||84|| yajanādividhātā ca daṇḍya eva na saṃśayaḥ | ityevaṃ śāsanaṃ cakre dharmakarmavirodhi saḥ ||85|| sāṃkṛtiṃ tapasāṃ pūrṇaśevadhiṃ sa vṛkāsuraḥ | gatvā jaghāna taṃ tatra śastrāṇi naiva sarvathā ||86|| pasparśustasya khaḍgaśca śatadhā khaṇḍaśo’bhavat | sāṃkṛtistaṃ śaśāpātha śīghraṃ nāśo’stu te’sura ||87|| śaṃkaraśca jaghānainaṃ vṛkaṃ tat kathitaṃ ca te | lakṣmi kathāprasaṃgena śṛṇu cānyatkathānakam ||88|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’ndhakāsuro yuddhe śaṃkareṇa svatriśūle ropito bhṛṃgirīṭigaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ, vṛkastatputro’pi śaṃkareṇa sūdita ityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādaśādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||518||
<1.519> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi ca rājāno devā daityastathāpare | māyāmohaṃ samālabhya ramante prāṇadevane || 1 || gantavyaṃ tvasti sarveṣāṃ pañcatve pañcavarjitaḥ | svayaṃ tvanyatra pañcatve pañcaikatvaṃ prayāti ca || 2 || nahi māyā gatā kaiścidātmabhiḥ saha naśvarī | arbudārbudavarṣāyurjīvibhirapi karhicit || 3 || śṛṇu rājā purā tvāsīdindradyumna iti śrutaḥ | brahmaṇyaśca śaraṇyaśca sādhulokaprapālakaḥ || 4 || yajvā dānapatirdakṣaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ | na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhirna ca caurakṛtaṃ bhayam || 5 || na nyūnatā prajāyāṃ vai bhogyadravyasya kasyacit | asaṃkhyātāḥ kratavaśca kṛtāḥ sampūrṇadakṣiṇāḥ || 6 || agniṣṭomo’tirātraśca ukthaḥ ṣoḍaśikastathā | sautrāmaṇyatha paśujaścāturmāsyaṃ vratakratuḥ || 7 || vājapeyo’śvamedhaśca rājasūyaśca somapaḥ | puṇḍarīkaśca putreṣṭiḥ sasyeṣṭiḥ rudravaiṣṇavau || 8 || kārīrirvaiśvadevaścetyādyān yajñāṃścakāra saḥ | na tadasti dharāpṛṣṭhe nagaraṃ pattanaṃ ca vā || 9 || tīrthaṃ śālā vanaṃ vāpī yatra satraṃ na tasya vai | sarvatraivendradyumnasyānnāni bhujyanta īśvaraiḥ || 1.519.10 || devāḥ ṛṣayo bhṛtyāśca vidyārthinaśca bhūsurāḥ | yatayaḥ sādhavaḥ sādhvyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginya ityapi || 1 1|| brahmacārī vānaprasthaḥ sannyāsī tyāgavānapi | anātho dīna ityādyā bhuṃjate tasya satrake || 1 2|| tīrthaṃ na vidyate tādṛg yatra tasya na devalam | tena kanyārbudāyutānāṃ dānamuttamam || 13|| kṛtaṃ prakāritaṃ cāpi sadā santaḥ supūjitāḥ | daśamīdivase tasya rājye vai gajapṛṣṭhagaḥ || 14|| dundubhistāḍyamānastu babhrāma sakalaṃ puram | ujjayinyāṃ ca vai prātarbhāvī śrīharivāsaraḥ || 15|| tenaiva svaśarīreṇa brahmalokaṃ svayaṃ gataḥ | tataḥ kalpasahasrānte sa prokto brahmaṇā svayam || 16|| indradyumna dharāṃ yāhi na sthātavyaṃ tvayātra vai | tava kīrtisamucchedaḥ saṃjāto’dya dharātale || 17|| yāvatkīrtirdharāpṛṣṭhe tāvatsvarge vasennaraḥ | etasmātkāraṇāllokāḥ kurvanti nāmalekhanam || 18|| vāpīkūpataḍāgādau devatāyatanādiṣu | gaccha śīghraṃ dharāpṛṣṭhaṃ svāṃ kīrtiṃ nūtanīkuru || 1 9|| kīrtau satyāṃ mama satye draṣṭā tvaṃ bhavitāsi vai | tataḥ saḥ prayayau pṛthvīṃ kāmpilyanagaraṃ prati ||1.519.20|| atha papraccha deśaḥ ko nagaraṃ kiṃ janān tadā | ūcuste’yaṃ pradeśo’sti tvānarto nagaraṃ tu vai ||21 || kāmpilyaṃ ko bhavānatrāparijñātā pravartate | rājā prāha purā cāhamindradyumno mahīpatiḥ ||22|| deśe vejahake rocakākhye vai nagare’dhipaḥ | sa deśaḥ kva puraṃ kvāste mayā stheyaṃ ca tatra vai ||23|| janāḥ prāhurna vidmastaṃ nṛpaṃ deśaṃ ca pattanam | rājā prāha cirāyuṣkaṃ pradarśayata māṃ janāḥ ||24|| yadi kaścidbhavedatra yastaṃ vetti mahīpatim | janāḥ prāhurdaśakalpajīvī saṃśrayūte muniḥ ||25|| naimiṣāraṇyake pṛccha mārkaṃḍeyo vadiṣyati | rājā gatvā vyomapathā papraccha taṃ munīśvaram ||26|| indradyumneti bhūpo’tra tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ śruto’thavā | muniḥ prāha mayā naiva dṛṣṭo vāpi śruto’pi vā ||27|| tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rājā nairāśyamāptavān | muniḥ prāha mayā sākaṃ samāgaccha himācalam ||28|| tatrāste ca bako nāma ṛṣirmattaḥ purātanaḥ | iti tau vyomamārgeṇa gatvā papracchaturnatau ||29|| indradyumnamahīpālastvayā dṛṣṭaḥ śruto’pi kim | bakaḥ prāha mama kālo viṃśatikalpako gataḥ ||1.519.30|| samaye tatra tatpūrvaṃ naiva vedmi hi taṃ nṛpam | indradyumno bakaṃ prāha cirāyuṣṭvaṃ kathaṃ tava ||31|| bakaḥ prāha purā viśvarūpo’hamabhavaṃ dvijaḥ | kasyacittvatha kālasya saṃkrāntau makarasya vai ||32|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pañcāmṛtena snāpito mayā | śaṃkaraḥ snāpitastatra hareḥ prasādavāriṇā ||33|| tato’haṃ rājaputratvaṃ prāptaḥ paścimabhūtale | jātismaraḥ sadā pañcāmṛtaiḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||34|| śivaṃ ca pūjayāmyevaṃ prātarvarṣasahasrakam | tena puṇyaprabhāveṇa jāto’haṃ vai cirasthiraḥ ||35|| kailāse śaṃbhudāsyaṃ cākaravaṃ vai tataḥ param | gālavasyāśrame gatvā vidyādhyayanamācaram ||36|| tasya patnī ṛtusnātā mayā spṛṣṭā vikārataḥ | sā tu śaśāpa māṃ dhūrta bako’raṇyagato bhava ||37|| tenāhaṃ bakarūpo’smi ṛṣiḥ kāmasvarūpadhṛk | vartāmyatra mahāraṇye bakākāraḥ sadā śuciḥ ||38|| jātismaraḥ sadā tvatra bhajāmi śrīhariṃ bakaḥ | mārkaṃḍeyastu taṃ prāha vetsi tvatto’pi pūrvajam ||39|| yadi kaṃcid darśayasva yena pṛcchāmi taṃ ca tat | bakaḥ prāha samāyāhi mattaścāpi purātanaḥ ||1.519.40|| yatrāsti dayito me’ti hyulūkarṣiścirasthiraḥ | trayaste ca gatāstatra kailāse śikhare hi me ||41 || sopi dṛṣṭvā bakaṃ mitraṃ svāgatenābhyanandayat | bakaḥ papraccha colūkam indradyumnanṛpaṃ prati ||42|| vada jānāsi cenmitra kadā jātaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ | ulūkaḥ prāha me kalpāścatvāriṃśatprasaṃkhyakāḥ ||43|| vyatītā na śruto dṛṣṭastvindradyumno mahīpatiḥ | indradyumnastu taṃ prāholūkatā vai kathaṃ tava ||44|| ulūkaḥ svakathāmāha purāsaṃ brāhmaṇo bhuvi | brahmacārī harabhakto bilvapatraiḥ prapūjakaḥ ||45|| tato varṣasahasrānte dadau svadarśanaṃ haraḥ | dadau me vaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca ||46|| śaṃbhuradṛśyatāṃ prāptaścāhaṃ bhārgavasannidhau | āśramaṃ tasya saṃprāpto virūpo’pi śubhāśrayam ||47|| bhārgavasyābhavatpatnī nāmnā sudarśanā satī | gālavakanyakā sā ca pātivratyaparāyaṇā ||48|| tasyāṃ tvāsīd bhārgavasya kanyaikā yuvatī śubhā | sā mayā yācitā cātha vivāhitāpi vai tataḥ ||49|| virūpaṃ māṃ sadā matvā kanyakā prāha mātaram | virūpāya pradattāsmi nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe ||1.519.50|| viṣaṃ vā bhakṣayiṣyāmi pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam | atha tāṃ bhārgavaḥ prāha yasmai dattā sthirā bhava ||51|| vedadharmaḥ sa evāsti patiṃ nārāyaṇaṃ smaret | saṃsevya svapatiṃ tvaṃ vai bhaviṣyasi divaṃgatā ||52|| ataḥ sevasva taṃ nāthaṃ kuru janma phalānvitam | ityevaṃ śikṣitā sāpi naiva mene hitaṃ tataḥ ||53|| na māṃ vai sevate rātrau tato mayā prasahya sā | ardharātre hṛtā tasyāḥ piturgṛhānmamāśramam ||54|| prātarvipro jajāgāra pitā tasyāstathā prasūḥ | kvāsau sā duhitetyevaṃ babhramaturmamāśramam ||55|| āgatyaināṃ dadṛśatuḥ sāpi ruroda vīkṣya tau | tataḥ kopaparītātmā māṃ provāca sa bhārgavaḥ ||56|| niśāyāṃ tu tvayā patnī mama putrī hṛtā yataḥ | niśācaro bhavānastu ulūkaśceti śāpataḥ ||57|| ulūko’smi hi sañjāto jātismaraśca sarvadā | kāmarūpadharaścāsmi vartāmi cātra parvate ||58|| patnī me svapiturharmye sthitā nārāyaṇāśritā | yayau śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadāsyapradaṃ padam ||59|| evaṃ me kauśikatvaṃ vai sañjātaṃ cātra parvate | akhaṇḍabilvapatraistu pūjanasya phalaṃ param ||1.519.60|| cirāyuṣṭvaṃ tu me divyarūpadhāritvamityapi | bakaḥ prāhetaraṃ kaṃcic cejjānāsi cirāyuṣam ||6 1 || vada tatra pragacchāmaḥ pṛcchāmastaṃ nṛpaṃ prati | ulūkaḥ prāha tu mayā sārdhamāgacchatātra vai ||62|| gandhamādanaśikhare gṛdhrarṣirvartate mahān | cirantano yadi taṃ ca nṛpaṃ jñāsyati pūrvajam ||6 3 || ityuktvā tān samādāyolūko gṛdhraṃ samāyayau | gṛdhrarṣistām̐stathā dṛṣṭvā prahṛṣṭaḥ sammukhaṃ yayau ||64|| svāgataṃ kṛtavām̐ścāpi pṛṣṭhavām̐ścāśrame ṛtam | ulūkaḥ prāha me mitraṃ nāḍījaṃgho bako hyayam ||65|| yasya mitraṃ tu mārkaṇḍastasyāyaṃ nṛpatiḥ suhṛt | ayaṃ cātrāgataḥ praṣṭuṃ purendradyumnabhūpatiḥ ||66 || āsītkaścinnavetyevaṃ vettuṃ cāsti samāgataḥ | gṛdhraḥ prāha tu me kalpā aśītiḥ prayayuḥ khalu ||67|| na dṛṣṭo na śrutaḥ ko’pi kvāpīndradyumnabhūpatiḥ | tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā so’pi rājā sudurmanāḥ ||68|| manasā cintayāmāsa maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ | papraccha gṛdhraṃ jāto’si cirāyustvaṃ kathaṃ vada ||69|| gṛdhraḥ prāha purā caityavṛkṣe’haṃ nyavasaṃ sukham | vasante ca janāstaṃ cāpūjayan phalitaṃ drumam ||1.519.70|| kāminyastatra vṛkṣe ca dolāṃ babandhuruttamām | tatra saṃsthāpya ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ||71 || sarvā āndolayāmāsuḥ kumāryaḥ sadhavāstathā | ahaṃ tu kautukāviṣṭo rātrau tatra svayaṃ sthitaḥ ||72|| karomyāndolanaṃ tābhiḥ ramāmi viramāmi ca | janairdṛṣṭastāḍitaśca pañcatvaṃ prāptavām̐stataḥ ||73 || jātismaro’bhavaṃ rājā nāmnā khyātaḥ kuśadhvajaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nityaṃ cāndolayāmi pūrvavat ||74|| śaṃbhuṃ cāndolayāmyeva śivarātrau punaḥ punaḥ | janmāṣṭamyāṃ tathānādiśrīkṛṣṇaṃ nyasya tatra ca ||75 || āndolayāmi satataṃ naranārāyaṇaṃ tathā | evaṃ prakurvato me śrīśaṃbhuḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ ||76 || bhavate varadaścāsmi vaiṣṇavāya varaṃ vṛṇu | ityuvāca haro mahyaṃ mayāpi ca tadārthinam ||77|| kailāse me dehi vāsaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ samāgame | vaiṣṇavasya ca te nityaṃ kariṣyāmi susevanam ||78|| evamukto mahādevo māṃ kailāsaṃ nināya saḥ | kadācittvatha kālasya vimānena nijecchayā ||79|| mayā ca bhramamāṇena dṛṣṭāgniveśyaputrikā | jale praviṣṭā snānārthaṃ tvālibhirbahvībhiryutā ||1.519.80 || mayāvatīrya sā bālā patnyarthaṃ yācitā tadā | kāmabhāvena sā naiva vyalokayattu māṃ prati ||8 1 || mayoddhṛtya jalāt sā ca balānnītā vimānake | tadā tadrodanaṃ śrutvā tatpitā māṃ śaśāpa ha ||82|| gṛdhravad bālikāṃ vaṃ cāspṛśaḥ sadvrataśālinīm | tasmādgṛdhro bhava cātra vimānaṃ te praṇaśyatu ||83 || ahaṃ gṛdhrastadā jāto vimānaṃ naṣṭameva me | bālā cākṛtabhogā sā yayau svaṃ pitaraṃ prati ||84|| etadvai sarvamākhyātaṃ sakhe gṛdhratvakāraṇam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprītyā cirāyuścāsmi bhūtale ||85|| indradyumnaṃ na jānāmi vada kiṃ karavāṇi te | itiśrutvā nṛpatiḥ sa nirāśaśca hutāśane ||83|| praveśaṃ cecchati tatra maraṇaṃ kartumicchati | tāvad gṛdhrastu taṃ prāha vahniṃ mā viśa bhūpate ||87|| ahaṃ te kīrtayiṣyāmi mamāpyasti cirantanaḥ | sa jñāsyati mama mitraṃ hīndradyumnaṃ purātanam ||88|| yāmastatra tu kamaṭho māntharako’sti yatra ca | mānase sarasi khyātastatraiva kṛtaketanaḥ ||89|| sarve yayustatkamaṭhaṃ sevamānaṃ śubhātapam | tīrasthaṃ sarasastatra te’vatīrṇāstato’mbarāt ||1.519.90|| tāvat sa kacchapaḥ śīghraṃ salile’ntarjagāma ha | gṛdhrastaṃ nijamitraṃ ca prāha kasmāt prayāsi bhoḥ ||91 || mitraṃ dṛṣṭvā kathaṃ yāsi bhīta iva vilokyase | sunīco’pi gṛhaṃ prāpto bhavetpūjyatamaḥ satām ||92|| atha kūrmo jalamadhye śiromātrabahirmukhaḥ | pratyuvāca paraṃ mitraṃ karomi svāgataṃ tava ||93|| tava mitrasya ca tathā mitramitrādimānanam | paraṃ tvayaṃ nṛpaḥ kaścit pañcamo yaḥ pradṛśyate ||94|| tasyendradyumnasaṃjñasya bhayād yāmi jalāntaram | anena tu purā dagdhā pṛṣṭhirme tu makhāgnibhiḥ ||95|| nādyāpi sā kṣatiḥ saṃpūryate pṛṣṭhagatā mama | enaṃ dṛṣṭvā yajñakīrtiṃ smṛtvā pṛṣṭhakṣatiṃ tathā ||96|| vidravāmi jale mitra karomi svāgataṃ tu vaḥ | indradyumnasya rājarṣeḥ kīrtisaṃśravaṇaṃ mahat ||97|| sahasrasaṃkhyayā rājñā sarve vai kratavaḥ kṛtāḥ | nādyāpi kīrtipuṇye ca naśyete’sya tu bhūpateḥ |||98|| pañcāśacca śataṃ kalpā mama tvatra jale gatāḥ | tatpūrvaṃ rocake nāmnā pattane cābhavaṃ tadā ||99|| asya bhayena tat tyaktvā vasāmyatra sarovare | ityuktvā sa bahirgatvākarot sanmānanaṃ bahu || 1.519.100 || saṃbhāṣāṃ vividhāṃ kalpāntarīyāṃ cakrire mithaḥ | kūrmo jātismaraḥ kāmarūpadhṛg devarūpavān || 10 1|| satkāraṃ bhojanādyaṃ ca kalpayāyāsa tatkṣaṇam | indradyumnaḥ prahṛṣṭo’bhūt papracchata kacchapaṃ tataḥ || 1 02|| cirāyuṣṭvaṃ kathaṃ te’sti rocakāt pūrvameva kim | kutra vāsaśca
