te tvāsīt kutra janma vrataṃ tava || 1 03|| vada me jāyate cātyānando mitrasya darśanāt | śrutvaivaṃ kacchapaḥ prāha śṛṇu rājan purābhavam || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne indradyumnarājñaḥ pṛthivyāṃ mārkaṇḍeyabakarṣighūkarṣigṛdhrarṣikamaṭharṣikṛtakīrtinavīnatvaṃ, prāgaparāddhajanyabakādijanmāni, puṇyakṛtacirajīvitvādi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekonaviṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||51 9||
<1.520> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kacchapaḥ saḥ provāca prāgbhavaṃ svakam | indradyumnamahārāja śṛṇu dṛṣṭaṃ mayā tu yat || 1 || ahaṃ vaikuṇṭhadhāmastho nārāyaṇasya pārṣadaḥ | vasuhārītanāmāsaṃ caturbāhurmanoharaḥ || 2 || suvarṇavāṭikāyāṃ tu nityāyāṃ vai sarovare | nityaṃ kamalapuṣpāṇi samāhartuṃ niyojitaḥ || 3 || lakṣmyā mālā kṛtā nityamarpyate śrīharergale | mayā tvānīya puṣpāṇi dīyate nityadā śriyai || 4 || ekadā snānamagno’haṃ vicinvan kamalāni tu | suciraṃ kṛtavām̐statra sarasyevāplavaṃ rataḥ || 5 || mālāyāḥ samayastatra vyatītaśca tataḥ param | lakṣmīḥ svayaṃ samāgatya prāha māṃ kiṃ karoṣi re ||6|| cirāyate tu pūjāyāṃ jale magno’si durmate | jale eva sadā tiṣṭha na me te’sti prayojanam || 7 || karoṣi taraṇaṃ kūrmasamaṃ kūrmaḥ sadā bhava | ityuktaḥ kūrmatāṃ prāpto vaikuṇṭhasya sarovare || 8 || sṛṣṭau tu jāyamānāyāṃ gaṃgā satye samāgatā | tasmādvai brahmasarasastenāhaṃ ca samāgataḥ || 9 || tato’nyapārṣadastatra kamalārthe ca yojitaḥ | nāmnā tvanantaśīlaḥ saḥ kadācid jalamadhyagaḥ || 1.520.1 0|| prasarpan satyalokaṃ vai jalena saha cāgataḥ | brahmaṇā sa viṣṇurūpau matvā saṃpūjito mudā ||1 1 || anantaśīlastatrāha prasanno’smi varaṃ vṛṇu | brahmā prāha mayā yāvadbrahmāṇḍānāṃ tu koṭayaḥ || 12|| kriyante sarṣapatulyāstān sadā dhāraya prabho | tathāstviti tadā prāha kintu me dehi vedikām || 1 3|| yatra sthitvā dhārayāmi sthiro brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalam | satyaloke ca gaṃgāyāṃ tadā cāhaṃ hyupasthitaḥ || 14|| āsaṃ tatraiva gaṃgāyāṃ brahmā prāha ca māṃ tadā | kacchapa tvaṃ vahānantaṃ hyabhīṣṭaṃ karavāṇi te || 15|| mayoktaṃ ca yathā lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya dāsatā | bhavenme tu tathā brahman kuru tatpārṣado’smyaham || 16|| vedhāstathāstviti prāha mayā śeṣaśca saṃdhṛtaḥ | anantākhyo mama pṛṣṭhe’nantena ca phaṇopari ||17|| brahmāṇḍāni dhṛtānyeva jāyante viramanti ca | brahmaṇā tu tapastaptaṃ mama lābhasya siddhaye || 18|| nārāyaṇasya dāsyasya prāptyarthaṃ śrīharistadā | brahmāṇaṃ ca samāgatya varṣānte prāha sanmukhaḥ || 1 9|| varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te kathaṃ smṛto’smi me vada | brahmā prāha hare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jagatprabho ||1.520.20|| pārṣadaste mayā prāpto vasuhārītasaṃjñakaḥ | lakṣmīśāpena kamaṭhasvarūpaṃ labdhavām̐stu yaḥ || 21 || mayā samprārthito’nantastava śreṣṭhaḥ supārṣadaḥ | brahmāṇḍānāṃ dhāraṇārthaṃ tenārthitaṃ śubhāsanam ||22|| tadā sa kamaṭhaḥ samyagādhāro vai mayārpitaḥ | anantāya ca kamaṭho vavre nārāyaṇāśrayam ||23|| dāsyaṃ yathā bhavet tasmād dehi dāsyaṃ ca bhaktayoḥ | pārṣadayorubhayostvaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru tathā prabho ||24|| nārāyaṇastadā prāha tathāstviti punaḥ punaḥ | andhakādyasuravrātānnāśayitvā kṣaṇāntare ||25|| pariśramavināśārth kṣīrode sāgare tadā | śeṣasya gendukaṃ kṛtvā kacchapasya tu pṛṣṭhake ||26|| śayiṣye tatra me dāsyaṃ kacchapānantayoḥ sadā | dāsye ceti varaṃ datvā nārāyaṇastiro’bhavat ||27|| āgataḥ śrīharistatra lakṣmīṃ nītvā payodadhau | yatrāhaṃ kacchapo nityaṃ pratiṣṭhāmi mahājale ||28|| śeṣo’nanto mama pṛṣṭhe paryaṃkagenduko’bhavat | tatra śete jagannāthaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||29|| dāsyaṃ dvābhyāṃ tatra labdhaṃ nityaṃ śrīharipādayoḥ | brahmaṇāṃ tu śate naṣṭe tvekadā lomaśo muniḥ ||1.520.30|| kṣīrode śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśanāya vai | samāgato mayā dṛṣṭaḥ pṛṣṭaśca kuśalaṃ prati ||2 1 || gṛhādikaṃ sukhaṃ cāste pratyuttaraṃ jagāda saḥ | brahmaṇāṃ daśakaṃ naṣṭaṃ sannidhau mama kacchapa ||32|| brahmaṇāṃ tu śate naṣṭe mariṣyāmi kṣaṇāntare | svalpāyuśca kathaṃ kuryād gṛhaṃ yannaśvaraṃ kṣaṇāt ||33|| tato’haṃ muninā sārdham ājñayā śrīharestathā | rūpaṃ dvitīyaṃ dhṛtyaiva svalpaṃ vai śatayojanam ||34|| tīrthayātrākṛte’gacchaṃ brahmāṇḍāntaḥpravīkṣitum | so’haṃ lomaśamuninā sārdhaṃ pātālabhūmitaḥ ||35|| uparyupari cāgacchaṃ tathā tathaiva vāyunā | deha me tu svabhāvena paraṃ saṃkocatāṃ gatam ||36|| pṛthvyāṃ kṛṣṇamaṇijanye saurāṣṭre tvaśvapaṭṭake | vyāghrāraṇyāntare śreṣṭhe miṣṭode vai sarovare ||37|| pañcayojanakāyāme lomaśasyāśrame taṭe | pūrvasmin raivatādbhāge viśrāntiṃ cālabhaṃ kṣaṇam ||38|| tatra kuṃkumavāpyāṃ ca kambharākṛṣṇamandire | patnīvrato brāhmaṇaśca kṛṣṇāṃśo vartate sadā ||39|| śrīḥ svayaṃ kambharālakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇo gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yatra mandire vartate sadā ||1.520.40|| ekādaśa tathā rudrā aṣṭau ca vasavastathā | ādityā dvādaśa cāpi devavaidyau ca sarvadā ||41 || trayastriṃśacca te devāḥ kalpe kalpe navā navāḥ | nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti yaddvāre tatra tīrthottame śubhe |||42||| patnīvrato mahāviṣṇusamāyurvīkṣito mayā | lomaśenārcito vipro mayāpi tvarcitastadā ||43|| brahmaṇāṃ koṭayo yasya sannidhau līnatāṃ gatāḥ | yasya vaṃśāścaturdaśalokeṣu brāhmaṇā matāḥ ||44|| sṛṣṭyantare’pi tasyaiva vaṃśāste brāhmaṇāḥ sadā | tasyāhaṃ darśanaṃ kṛtvā nyavasaṃ lomaśāśramam ||45|| tadāsīnnṛpatirindradyumno’tra bhūtale mahān | saptadvīpasamudrāṇāṃ pṛthvīnāṃ sārvabhaumakaḥ ||46|| rocakāyāṃ rājadhānyāṃ raivatācalasannidhau | pūrvasyāṃ vai diśi vyāghrāraṇyabhūmau babhūva saḥ ||47|| dvitīyā rājadhānyasya mahākālavane’bhavat | tṛtīyāsīt tathā śrīmatpuruṣottamapūrgatā ||48|| vedhaso vartamānasya catvāriṃśatsamāsu ca | gatāsu bhūtale hyāsīdindradyumno mahīpatiḥ ||49|| sa ca dṛṣṭvā svake tīrthe tvaśvapaṭṭasarovare | kacchapaṃ māṃ mahākāyaṃ yojanārdhasuvartulam ||1.520.50|| lomaśasyādhīnakaṃ ca matvā jñātvā ṛtukṣamam | vavre rājā lomaśānmāṃ yajñapīṭhārthamuttamam ||51 || lomaśena tathāstveva kṛtvā datto’hameva yat | mama pṛṣṭho bhūbhṛtā 3 bahuvarṣāṇi santatam |||2|| anena tu kṛtā yajñā lomaśena prakāritāḥ | tataḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ mama dagdhaṃ mayā saṃprārthito muniḥ ||53|| lomaśaḥ sudayālurmā prāha gacchatu mānasam | saro himagireḥ prānte tato’haṃ tvatra cāgataḥ ||54|| atra vai brahmaṇo varṣapañcakaṃ me gataṃ bhavam | kalpāstu brahmaṇo me’tra gatāni tāni vai śṛṇu ||55|| aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi tathā ca pañcaviṃśatiḥ | mānase’tra gatāḥ kalpāstān smarāmi yathātatham ||56|| dvitīyena svarūpeṇa cātra tiṣṭhāmi sarvadā | pṛṣṭhaṃ me nirujaṃ samyag jātaṃ himādrisaṃśrayāt ||57|| lomaśarṣirgururme’sti gaccha tatrāśramaṃ śubham | rājam̐stvaṃ prathamaṃ yāhi puruṣottamasatpurīm ||58|| yatra tvayā jagannāthaḥ svahastena purāhitaḥ | tato yāhi mahākālavanaṃ yatra tava gṛham ||59|| tato yāhi surāṣṭraṃ yatrāśvapaṭṭasarovaram | kuṃkumavāpikā yatra lomaśo vartate muniḥ ||1.520.6 0|| yatra vai śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo lakṣmīpatiḥ svayam | pārvatīmāṇikīrādhāprabhāsvāmī pumuttamaḥ ||61 || sāptabhaume mahāsaudhe divye saṃrājate hariḥ | gaccha rājaṃstatra sevāṃ kṛtvā yāhi tataḥ param ||62|| satyalokaṃ kalpakālaṃ punardrakṣyasi māṃ tataḥ | ebhirvai munibhiḥ sārdhaṃ yaśaste’vyāhataṃ bhuvi ||63|| śrutvā yāsyasi satyaṃ tatkalpaṃ prati dhruvam | kacchapasya hitaṃ miṣṭaṃ vākyaṃ saṃgṛhya te tataḥ ||64|| nivṛttāśca tataḥ sthānāt svasvasthāni bhejire | indradyumnaḥ samāyāto lomaśaṃ prati tatkramāt ||65|| yasya vai pārśvato dikṣu caturyojanabhūtale | māyā nāsti na vai rāgadveṣau kutastu vāsanā ||66|| brahmarūpāśramaṃ prāpya rājā tṛpto’bhavattadā | lomaśasya mukhāt sarvaṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||67|| sampūjya kambharālakṣmīṃ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakam | trayastriṃśatsurām̐ścāpyājñayovāsa sa vatsaram ||68|| śuśrāva satkathāstatra lomaśasya mukhāmbujāt | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā nityaṃ navā navāḥ ||69|| tatra śuśrāva ca yajñān svakṛtān lomaśānanāt | tathā śrīmajjagannāthapratiṣṭhāṃ svakṛtāṃ śubhām ||1.520.70|| tathā sarvatra satrāṇi tvannānāṃ bhojanāni ca | dānāni gajagovājihiraṇyaratnayoṣitām ||71 || pṛthivyāṃ santi yāvanti vastūni tāvatāmapi | dānāni japapūjādi śrutavām̐śca gurormukhāt ||72|| jñānaṃ cātmapradaṃ svargapradaṃ mokṣapradaṃ tathā | lomaśasya mukhāt sarvaṃ labdhavām̐ścātmadarśanam ||73|| lomaśena śrutaṃ yacchrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇānanāt | śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi te’haṃ bhaktaupayaugikam ||74|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mānasasarovarasthena kacchapena svasya śeṣasya ca viṣṇoḥ pārṣadatvaṃ kathitaṃ, tataḥ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre lomaśāśrame’śvapaṭṭasarovare vāsaḥ, āyuḥ, indradyumnayajñāścetyādivṛttāntakathananāmā viṃśatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 520 ||
<1.521> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi cendradyumnaḥ papraccha lomaśam ṛṣim | ṛṣe śāntikaraṃ jñānaṃ kathaṃ jāyeta tadvada || 1 || ātmaśāntiṃ vinā sarvaṃ jālaṃ codvejakaṃ matam | ātmaśāntisamo lābho nānyaḥ kaścicca taṃ vada || 2 || lomaśaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā jagāda tam | śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi śrīhareḥ smaraṇaṃ kuru || 3 || akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ dhāma vyāpakamuttamam | śāśvataṃ yatra vityaistu muktaiḥ sevyaḥ parātparaḥ || 4 || śrīharī rājate śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | divyo yuvātibalavān rūparūpānuśevadhiḥ || 5 || koṭikoṭyarkatejāṃsi sadā yasyāṇubhāgataḥ | prakāśante sarvasūṛṣṭigato muktābhisevitaḥ || 6 || anantarūpadhṛk śrīmatpuruṣottama eva saḥ | akṣarādisamastānāṃ svāmī nārāyaṇaśca saḥ || 7 || akṣarātīta evāsau dvibhujo divyavigrahaḥ | śrotavyaścāpi mantavyo dhyeyaśca śrīpatiḥ prabhuḥ || 8 || netre kajjalasaṃśobhe padmapatrāyate’ruṇe | premṇā ca nibhṛte śaśvadbhāvagarbhe’tikarṣaṇe || 9 || svarṇaromṇāṃ rājibhiśca virājite’timañjule | hṛdayasya tu sarvasvaṃ nivedayata ādarāt || 1.521.1 0|| bhrūkuṭibhyāṃ kāmakoṭiśaravedhanakārake | ātmānandabhṛte snigdhe rasikānāṃ rasānvite || 11 || tārakāpānapīyūṣaprade mīnasucañcale | ākarṇāntagataprānte koṇakauśalyasaṃbhṛte || 1 2|| raktarekhānvite śvete paritaḥ sphaṭikojjvale | sarvadṛśyapratibimbānvite dhyeye manohare || 13|| nāsikāṃ tilapuṣpābhāṃ pakvabimbasamauṣṭakau | tanurekhācamatkārakaraśmaśruvibhūṣitau || 14|| svalpanimnaṃ tataḥ samyagucchrāyaṃ cibukaṃ smaret | kapolau sūryacandrābhau bhālaṃ binduvirājitam || 15|| smaret satilakaṃ cātiprojjvalaṃ caikarekhakam | keśāṃśca mañjulān snigdhān vakrān kṛṣṇām̐śca piṃgalān || 16|| smaret mukuṭaprabhayā projjvalān dīrgharaśmikān | karṇau śaṣkulikāśobhau ratnahīrakakuṇḍalau || 17|| dhyāyet svāmini paridhivyāptaṃ mukhaṃ ca tejasām | koṭikandarpakāntyādirājitaṃ hṛdayaṃgamam || 18|| kambukaṇṭhaṃ dṛḍhapuṣṭaskandhau dhyāyenmanoharau | bhogibhogasamau bāhū svarṇacampakasūjjvalau || 19|| karihastābhakarabhau padmābhe hastayostale | nakhacandrām̐śca dhavalān yogyaraktān samunnatān ||1.521.20|| sarekhāṅgulikāḥ sarvā aṅguṣṭhau ca prakoṣṭhakau | dhyāyed vakṣaḥsthale lakṣmīcihnayuktaṃ samunnatam ||21|| viśālaṃ śrīvatsacihnaṃ romṇāṃ dakṣiṇavartanam | stanaṃ dvayaṃ tathā dhyāyedudaraṃ trivaliśritam ||22|| nimnanābhiṃ jaghanaṃ ca pārśvadvayaṃ samujjvalam | kaṭiṃ siṃhakaṭitulyāṃ dhyāyelliṃgaṃ nitambakau ||23|| urū dhyāyed gajahastasamau jānū suvartulau | jaṃghe ramye pattale ca padmapatrābhapāṇḍure ||24|| aṃgulīrnakhacandrāḍhyā dhyāyed bhūṣāmbarāṇi ca | hārarājīn dantapaktiṃ hṛdayaṃ mānasaṃ smaret ||25|| bhāvanāṃ ca guṇān sarvaiśvaryāṇi ca kriyāṃ smaret | evaṃ vai śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrterhi cintanāt ||26 || śāntirvai śāśvatī rājan jāyetaiva na saṃśayaḥ | tato dhyāyeddharau tasmin śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rādhikāṃ tathā ||27|| dhyāyennārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca sarasvatīm | sāvitrīṃ cāpi gāyatrīṃ śivaṃ durgāṃ ca pārvatīm ||28|| dhyāyed gaṃgāṃ ca viṣṇuṃ ca lakṣmīṃ vṛndāṃ ca tūlasīm | dhyāyettatrākṣarātīte vyūhām̐śca vibhavām̐stathā ||29|| arcā aṃśakalāveśān vibhūtīśca harau smaret | kṣīrasthaṃ śvetabhūsaṃsthaṃ himasthaṃ svagataṃ smaret ||1.521.3 0 || sarvadehigataṃ taṃ vai viṣṇuṃ dhyāyejjanārdanam | nare nāryāṃ sadā taṃ vai paśyet kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||3 1|| satye svarge kṣitau vyomni pātāle hṛdayāmbare | putre patnyāṃ paśau kānte jaḍe cetanavargake ||32|| dṛśye’dṛśye priye grāhye vipriye varjyavastuni | dhyāyed vai śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gopālabālakam ||33|| kambharālālitaṃ divyaṃ tvaśvapaṭṭasaro’ntikam | lomaśena sadā dhyātaṃ brahmarudrādivanditam ||34|| rādhālakṣmīramāpadmāprabhāpadmāvatīśvaram | māṇikīpārvatīnāthaṃ jayeśaṃ lalitāpatim ||35|| mukteśaṃ cāvatāreśaṃ saccidānandavigraham | śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaṃ nāthaṃ jagajjanmādikāraṇam ||36|| siddhisaṃsevitaṃ jñānānandasampatpraśevadhim | dhyāyet kāntasvarūpaṃ taṃ svāminaṃ hṛdayāmbuje ||37|| ekatānatayā dhyāyennaro nārī patiṃ prabhum | kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaprasevitaṃ pareśvaram ||38|| dhyāyetsmarejjapennityaṃ namet saṃsevayettathā | pūjayedarcayetpādapadme dhṛtāmṛtaṃ pibet ||39|| prasādaṃ saṃgrasettasya sugandhyādi samāvahet | pradakṣiṇāṃ stutiṃ kuryāddīpaṃ naivedyamarpayet ||1.521.40|| ārārtrikaṃ prakuryāśca sarvasvārpaṇamācaret | evamātmā samarpyaścārpaṇīyaḥ sarvadā harau ||41 || kāmaḥ krodhaḥ sukhaṃ sneho lobho mohādayastathā | dayā dānaṃ ca dākṣiṇyaṃ damanaṃ doṣamaṇḍalam ||42|| sarvaṃ samarpayet tasmai tatra kṣipennirantaram ||| tena vahnau yathā dhātustathā śuddhyati mānavaḥ ||43|| indradyumna phalaṃ hitvā kuryād dāsyaṃ sadā hareḥ | ahaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadāsyena divyatām ||44|| alabhaṃ cirajīvitvaṃ brahmatulyaṃ vapustathā | jīvanmuktiṃ tathaiśvaryasiddhīrvairāgyasampadam ||45|| santoṣaṃ cālabhaṃ tṛṣṇākṣayaṃ māyāvivarjitam | māyālepādirāhityaṃ tathāvaraṇahīnatām ||46|| kleśān karmāśayān dagdhvā vicarāmi hariryathā | loṣṭhaṃ kāṣṭhasya yogena taratyeva jalārṇavam ||47|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasaṃgāllomaśo lepaśātanaḥ | brahmamukto vartate’tra kalpānāṃ kālaśātanaḥ ||48|| brahmādistambaparyantamasaṃkhyaṃ viśvameva yat | sarve carācarādhāraṃ yaḥ sṛjatyeva līlayā ||49|| brahmeśaśeṣadharmāśca dineśaśca gaṇeśvaraḥ | munīndravargo devendro dhyāyati yamaharniśam ||1.521.50|| vedāḥ stuvanti yaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jagatprabhum | stauti yaṃ prakṛtirhṛṣṭā stauti bhītā sarasvatī ||51 || ṣaṇmukhaścaturāsyaśca pañcāsyaḥ stauti yaṃ harim | sahasrāsyaśca vedāsyā analāsyāḥ stuvanti yam ||52|| svecchāmayaṃ nirīhaṃ ca nirguṇaṃ ca nirañjanam | parātparataraṃ brahma paramātmānamīśvaram ||53|| nityaṃ jyotirabhivyāptaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham | nityānandaṃ ca nityaṃ ca nityamakṣaravigraham ||54|| bhaja nityaṃ guruṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhuṃ patim | so’vatīrṇo’tra bhagavān bhūbhārādyapanuttaye ||55|| gopālabālaveṣaśca vallabho māyayā prabhuḥ | sa eva rakṣitā poṣṭā saṃhartā taṃ sadā bhaja ||56 || pitaraṃ mātaraṃ vidyāmantradaṃ sadguruṃ patim | tameva śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhaja mahīpate ||57|| indradyumna nibodhedaṃ jñānaṃ mattaḥ parātparam | tyaja sarvaṃ vighnakaraṃ mudaṃ labha hareḥ param ||58|| kiṃ rājyaṃ kiṃ yaśo grāmaḥ kaḥ svadeśo’paraśca kaḥ | kaḥ kasya putraḥ kastātaḥ kā mātā kasyacit kutaḥ ||59|| āyānti yānti saṃsāraṃ paraṃ svakṛtakarmabhiḥ | karmānusārājjantuśca jāyate sthānabhedataḥ ||1.521.60|| karmaṇā jāyate kaścid viprāṇyāṃ vā nṛpastriyām | vaiśyāyāṃ vā śūdranāryāṃ paśau pakṣiṇi vṛkṣake ||6 1 || nārāyaṇapradatteṣu sānandā viṣayeṣu te | dehatyāge viṣaṇṇāśca viyoge bāndhavasya ca ||62|| māyayā tatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kanyā vadhūrvirāgiṇī | avasthāstā vibhinnā vai ekasyā eva yoṣitaḥ ||63|| prajābhūmidhanādināṃ vicchedo maraṇādhikaḥ | nityaṃ bhavati mūḍhasya viduṣo na kadācana ||64|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktastadyājī tatparāyaṇaḥ | kṛṣṇamantropāsakaśca kṛṣṇasevārato bhava ||65|| yadbhayād vāti vāto’yaṃ ravirbhāti ca nityaśaḥ | bhāti candro mahendraśca kālabhede pravarṣati ||66|| vahnirdahati mṛtyuśca caratyeva tu jantuṣu | bibharti vṛkṣaḥ kālena puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca ||67|| vyomādhāro’pi vāyuśca vāyvādhāraṃ jalādikam | jalādhāraḥ kacchapaśca tadādhāro hyanantakaḥ ||68|| anantaśeṣabhogeṣu brahmāṇḍāni ca parvatāḥ | niścalaṃ ca jalaṃ tasmājjalastheyaṃ vasundharā ||69|| saptasvargaṃ dharādhāraṃ jyotiścakraṃ grahāśrayam | aṣṭāvaraṇayuktānāṃ brahmāṇḍānāṃ mahāvirāṭ ||1.521.70|| ādhārastasya vai bhūmā mahāviṣṇuḥ sadāśivaḥ | tasyādhāraśca vaikuṇṭho golokaśca tadāśrayaḥ ||71 || golokasyāśrayo’nantākṣaradhāma paraṃ śubham | brahmalokaḥ parāt paraḥ paramaṃ dhāma tatparam ||72|| divyaṃ sarvatra saṃvyāptaṃ sīmavarjitameva tat | yatra vai sarvadhāmāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi ||73|| pādo’sya viśvā bhūtāni paraṃ tato na vidyate | tatrasthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gopālabālakam ||74|| kambharānandanaṃ rājan bhajākṣarapatiṃ harim | parame dhāmani so’yaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||75|| ananta muktamadhyastho vartate puruṣottamaḥ | akṣare ca tathā dhāmni vartate’kṣarapūruṣaḥ ||76|| rādhākṛṣṇaśca goloke vaikuṇṭhe śrīpatiḥ prabhuḥ | śivaloke śivarūpaḥ satye brahmā harirmataḥ ||77|| tejasvināṃ ca vai sūryaḥ pavitrāṇāṃ tathānalaḥ | dravāṇāṃ sa harirvāri cendriyāṇāṃ manaḥ sa ca ||78|| śīghragānāṃ samīraḥ sa daṇḍadānāṃ yamo hi saḥ | kālaḥ kalayatāṃ so’pi cākṣarāṇāmavarṇakaḥ ||79|| sāmnāṃ sāma surāṇāṃ sa indro rājñāṃ pratāpakaḥ | īśānaḥ saṃ digīśānāṃ kubero dhanināṃ hi saḥ ||1.521.80 || vyāpakānāṃ namaḥ so’pi sākṣī cāpi sa eva hi | taijasānāṃ suvarṇaṃ sa ratnaṃ dhaneṣu caiva saḥ ||81 || maṇīnāṃ kaustubhaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | śālagrāmastathārcyānāṃ patrāṇāṃ tulasī ca sā ||82|| puṣpāṇāṃ pārijātaḥ saḥ tīrthānāṃ puṣkaraḥ sa ca | vaiṣṇavānāṃ kumāraḥ sa yogīndrāṇāṃ gaṇādhipaḥ ||83 || senāpatīnāṃ skandaḥ saḥ naro dhanuṣmatāṃ hi saḥ | nakṣatrāṇāṃ śaśī so’yaṃ rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ hi saḥ ||84|| māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣaḥ saḥ vasantaḥ saḥ kratūttamaḥ | rājendrāṇāṃ ca rāmaḥ so’vatārāṇāṃ narāyaṇaḥ ||85|| śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sa bhagavatāṃ vāreṣu ravivāsaraḥ | tithiṣvekādaśīrūpaḥ pṛthvī kṣamāvatāṃ hi saḥ ||86|| apatyānāṃ sa vai mātā bhakṣyāṇāṃ tvamṛtaṃ hi saḥ | gavyeṣvājyaṃ sa vai prokto druṣu kalpadrumo hi saḥ ||87|| surabhiḥ kāmadhenūnāṃ gaṃgā saḥ saritāṃ hariḥ | paṇḍitānāṃ vāṇīrūpo mantrāṇāṃ praṇavaśca saḥ ||88|| parā vidyā ca vidyānāṃ sasyānāṃ dhānyameva saḥ | aśvatthaḥ phalināṃ kṛṣṇo gurūṇāṃ mantradaśca saḥ ||89|| kaśyapaḥ saḥ prajeśānāṃ garuḍaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ hi saḥ | anantaḥ sa ca nāgānāṃ narāṇāṃ nṛpatiḥ sa hi || 1.521.90|| brahmarṣīṇāṃ bhṛguḥ so’yaṃ devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ | rājarṣīṇāṃ janakaḥ sa maharṣīṇāṃ śukaḥ sa ca ||91 || gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilaḥ sa ca | lomaśaścirajīvānāṃ gururbuddhimatāṃ sa vai ||92|| śukraḥ kavivarāṇāṃ sa grahāṇāṃ ca śaniḥ sa vai | śilpināṃ viśvakarmā saḥ mṛgāṇāṃ mṛgarāṭ sa vai ||93 || vāhānāṃ śivavāhaḥ sa airāvataśca hastiṣu | gāyatrī chandasāṃ so’pi śāstrāṇāṃ veda eva saḥ ||94|| yādasāṃ varuṇaḥ kṛṣṇa ūrvaśyapsarasāṃ hi saḥ | jalāśayānāṃ cābdhiḥ saḥ sumerurbhūdhareṣu saḥ ||95 || himādriḥ sa ratnavatāṃ rādhikā prakṛtiṣvapi | devīnāṃ kamalā kṛṣṇaḥ śatarūpā ca yoṣitām ||96 || santaḥ priyāṇāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sa sāvitrī suśilāsu saḥ | prahlādaḥ so’pi daityānāṃ baliṣṭhānāṃ baliḥ sa ca ||97|| nārāyaṇarṣirbhagavān jñānināṃ brahmacāriṇām | hanumān vānarāṇāṃ sa vīrāṇāṃ ca naraḥ svayam ||98 manasā nāgakanyānāṃ vasūnāṃ droṇa eva saḥ | kāmināṃ kāmarūpaḥ sa raṃbhā saḥ kāmukīṣu vai ||99|| golokaḥ sa ca lokānāṃ dhāmnāṃ cākṣaradhāma saḥ | vāsānāṃ śrīramāvāso vaikuṇṭho bhagavān hi saḥ ||1.521.1 0 0|| śāntirmātṛkavarge saḥ ratiḥ sa sundarīṣu vai | dharmaḥ sākṣigaṇe so’sti sandhyā vai vāsareṣu saḥ ||1 01 || deveṣvindro rākṣaseṣu vibhīṣaṇo hariḥ svayam | kālāgnirudro rudrāṇāṃ saṃhāro bhairaveṣu saḥ || 1 02|| śaṃkheṣu pāñcajanyaḥ saḥ śarīre mastakaṃ ca saḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitātmakaḥ svakathāsu saḥ || 1 03|| svāyaṃbhuvo manūnāṃ sa vyāso vidvatsu mādhavaḥ | svadhā saḥ pitṛpatnīṣu svāhā vahnipriyāsu saḥ || 1 04|| yajñānāṃ rājasūyaḥ saḥ yajñapatnīṣu dakṣiṇā | nītivatsvaṃgīrā sūtaḥ kathakeṣu harirhi saḥ || 1 05|| śastrāstrajñeṣu ca parśurāmo daivaṃ baleṣu ca | vratānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmivrataṃ hi saḥ || 1 06|| dātṝṇāmindradyumnaḥ sa dūrvā sa oṣadhiṣvapi | tṛṇānāṃ darbharūpaḥ saḥ satyaṃ vrateṣu dhārmiṣu || 1 07|| snehapātreṣu putraḥ saḥ sa vyādhiḥ śatrumaṇḍale | sevāsu dāsyameva śrīharirvaro vareṣu ca || 1 08|| āśrameṣu gṛhasthaḥ saḥ sannyāsaśca vivekiṣu | sudarśanaṃ saḥ śastrāṇāṃ kuśalaṃ saḥ śubhāśiṣām || 1 09|| aiśvaryāṇāṃ mahājñānaṃ vairāgyaṃ ca sukheṣu saḥ | miṣṭavākyaṃ prītideṣu dāneṣu cātmadānakam || 1.521.11 0|| sañcayeṣu dharmakāryaṃ karmaṇāṃ cārcanaṃ hi saḥ | kaṭhoreṣu tapaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ phaleṣu mokṣa eva saḥ || 111 || nārīṣu cānuvṛttiḥ saḥ nareṣu vīryameva saḥ | aṣṭasiddhiṣu prākāmyaṃ kāśī kṛṣṇaḥ purīṣu ca || 1 12|| nagareṣu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya nagaraṃ hi saḥ | deśeṣu vaiṣṇavakṣetraṃ virāṭ tathāśrayeṣu saḥ || 113 || sūkṣmeṣu paramāṇuḥ sa hyauṣadhyādau rasāyanam | vaidyānāmaśvinīputrau viṣādaḥ kṣayakāriṇām || 1 14|| dhanvantarirmantravidāṃ miṣṭānāṃ ca kṣudhā hi saḥ | rāgāṇāṃ meghamallāraḥ śrīdāmā pārṣadeṣu saḥ || 1 15|| paśujantuṣu dhenuḥ saḥ vṛkṣeṣu candanaṃ hi saḥ | vaiṣṇavaḥ sarvapūteṣu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hi saḥ || 116 || vṛkṣeṣvaṃkurarūpaḥ saḥ vastuṣu cākaro hi saḥ | sarvabhūteṣu vai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’sti sarvadā || 1 17|| yathā vṛkṣe phalānyeva phale bīje tathāṅkuraḥ | sarvakāraṇarūpaḥ saḥ nānyadvai kāraṇāntaram || 1 18|| sarveśaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | tanmāyāmohamāpannāstaṃ na jānanti durdhiyaḥ || 11 9|| tamograstena durbuddhyā vidhinā vañcitena ca | svātmā saḥ sarvajantūnāṃ svāmī vai sarvadehinām || 1.521.120 || bhaja taṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ rājan prabhāpatim | svargaṃ mokṣaṃ labhasvāpi bhajitvā pārvatīpatim || 121 || imaṃ vibhūtiyogaṃ yo jñānavijñānakārakam | paṭhedvā śṛṇuyāttasyopasthitaḥ śrīharirbhavet || 1 22|| maṃjulā mañjuṣā ceyaṃ munīnāṃ manasāṃ sthirā | haṃsā paramahaṃsānāṃ mānasī saguṇā hareḥ || 1 23||| yāmabhyasya bhaved yogī dharmameghasamādhimān | sarvasiddhipramājñaptibodhānandamayo bhavet || 1 24|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne indradyumnāya lomaśoktajñānavijñānavibhūtisaṃbhṛtabhagavanmahimādinirūpaṇanāmaikaviṃśatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||521 ||
<1.522> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tataścāpi lomaśaḥ sa mahāmuniḥ | indradyumne dadau jñānaṃ līnaṃ māyikavāyunā || 1 || lomaśaḥ prāha rājastvaṃ śṛṇu vṛttaṃ purābhavam | ekadā nāradaḥ satyāllokācchrībadarīvanam || 2 || nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ draṣṭuṃ tīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ | viśālāyāṃ tadā tvāsīt svāyaṃbhuvamanoḥ sutaḥ ||3 || tapasyāṃ saṃprakurvan śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ japan | priyavratābhidhānastaṃ dṛṣṭvā śrīnārado muniḥ || 4 || yayau tasya tu nikaṭe rājā nanāma cādarāt | rājā ceṣṭvā bahuyajñairvipulairbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ || 5 || nivṛttiṃ dharmamāśritya sādhuṃ nanāma nāradam | abhyutthānena ca mudā jvaladbhāskaratejasam || 6 || dadau pādyaṃ cāsanaṃ sunaivedyaṃ badarīphalam | tataḥ papraccha kuśalaṃ papraccha lokavartanam || 7 || bhagavan kiñcidāścaryametasmin kṛtasaṃjñite | yuge dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ vāpi tanme kathaya nārada || 8 || nāradaḥ prāha dṛṣṭaṃ yacchṛṇuṣvāścaryamadbhutam | hyastane’hani rājendra śvetadvīpaṃ gato’bhavam || 9 || tatra dugdhasaro dṛṣṭvā phullapaṃkajaśobhitam | tathā tasya taṭe ramyāṃ kumārīṃ pṛthulocanām || 1.522.1 0|| dṛṣṭvāhaṃ vismayāpannastāṃ kanyāmāyatekṣaṇām | pṛṣṭavānasmi rājendra tadā madhurabhāṣiṇīm || 11 || kāsi bhadre kathaṃ vāsi kiṃ vā kāryamiha tvayā | kartavyaṃ cārusarvām̐gi tanmamācakṣva sundari || 1 2|| evamuktā mayā sā ca māṃ dṛṣṭvānimiṣekṣaṇā | kṣaṇaṃ tūṣṇīṃ sthitā yāvat tāvanme jñānamuttamam || 1 3|| vismṛtaṃ sarvavedāśca śāstrāṇi saṃhitāstathā | yogāḥ śikṣāstathā sarvā dharmanyāyāḥ kalādayaḥ || 14|| sarve dṛṣṭvaiva me rājan kumāryāpahṛtaṃ kṣaṇāt | tato’haṃ vismayāviṣṭaścintāśokākulaḥ svayam || 15||| tāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatvā hṛdā paśyāmi tāṃ punaḥ | tāvad divyaḥ pumām̐stasyāḥ śarīre samadṛśyata || 16|| tasyāpi puṃso hṛdaye tvaparastasya corasi | anyo raktekṣaṇaḥ śrīmān dvādaśādityasannibhaḥ || 17|| evaṃ dṛṣṭvā pumāṃso’tra trayaḥ kanyāśarīragāḥ | kṣaṇena līnāḥ kanyaikā prapaśyāmi na tānpunaḥ || 18|| tataḥ pṛṣṭā mayā devī sā kumārī kathaṃ mama | vedā naṣṭā mamācakṣva bhadre tannāśakāraṇam || 1 9|| kanyā prāha ca mātāhaṃ vedānāṃ tava nārada | sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ patnī jananī tava nārada ||1.522.20|| tvayā nāhaṃ samāgatya satkṛtā vā namaskṛtā | māṃ na jānāsi yena tvaṃ tato vedā hatāstava || 21 || sāvitrīṃ cāpi gāyatrīṃ yo na jānāti vai dvijaḥ | tasya jñānaṃ tu vedānāṃ jāyate na kadācana ||22|| mātṛnāśe bhavennāśaḥ putrāṇāṃ mātṛsevinām | mātṛbhaktāśca te putrā vinā kvāpi ca mātaram ||23|| nahi tiṣṭhanti pātreṣu vedā naṣṭāstatastava | mātṛpūjā na kurvanti manvate na ca mātaram ||24|| namanti mātaraṃ naiva te syurmūrkhā jaḍātmakāḥ | mātaraṃ nahi jānanti sevante na ca mātaram ||25|| āśīrvādavihīnāste jaḍā bhavanti tāmasāḥ | mātṛduḥkhaṃ kṛtaṃ yena mātā naiva ca poṣitā ||26|| garbhabhārahatā tena kṛtā mātāvamānitā | te vicittāstathonmattā daridrā duḥkhinastathā ||27|| udvejinaḥ savighnāśca rugṇā bhavanti putrakāḥ | tasmānmātā piturdaśaguṇā mānyā sutena vai ||28|| kāryārthaṃ gamane kvāpi mātāhvayati pṛṣṭhataḥ | tatkāryaṃ saphalaṃ siddhyenmātā tasmādgarīyasī ||29|| pitā bījapradātā tannavamāsān pupoṣa yā | kaṣṭaṃ prasahya sūte taṃ pañcavarṣāṇi rakṣati || 1.522.3 0|| mūtramalādi bālasya prakṣālayati sarvadā | tasmācchataguṇā mātā bālaṃ kaṭyāṃ dadhāti yā ||3 1 || udare ca tathā kaṭyāṃ hṛdye ca dadhāti yā | sadā pūjyatamā mātā sevanīyā śubhecchubhiḥ ||32|| nāradastāṃ samutthāya jñātvā mātaramityatha | natvā prapūjya papraccha ke trayaḥ puruṣā iti ||33 || mātovāca mayi dṛṣṭaḥ sarvāṃgaścāruśobhanaḥ | eṣa ṛgvedanāmā vai vedo nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||34|| vahnibhūto dahatyāśu pāpānyuccāraṇādanu | etasya hṛdaye yo’yaṃ dṛṣṭa āsīttvayātmaja ||35|| sa yajurvedarūpeṇa sthito brahmā mahābalaḥ | tasyāpyurasi saṃviṣṭo ya eṣa śucirujjvalaḥ || 36|| sāmavedo mahābhāgavatabhaktaḥ sa śaṃkaraḥ | eṣa ādityavat pāpānyāśu nāśayati smṛtaḥ ||37|| ete trayo mahāvedāstathā devāstrayaśca te | etasmin sarasi putra jñānātmake mamāntike ||38|| snātvā gṛhāṇa vedādīn sarvajñatvaṃ tathā labha | kṛte vedasaraḥsnāne prāgbhavīyaṃ smariṣyasi ||39|| evamuktvā tirobhāvaṃ gatā mātā tadā mama | ahaṃ tatra kṛtasnāno labdhvā sahasrajanmajam ||1.522.40|| jñānaṃ samāgataścātrāścaryaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ hi tanmayā | tatraikaṃ mama te janma kathayāmi purābhavam ||41 || pūrvakalpe bhavānāsīd rājā bāhudhano bhuvi | dakṣiṇe paścime deśe siṃhāraṇye ca raivate ||42|| tadāhamabhavaṃ tatra śatruṃjitānadītaṭe | brāhmaṇo vedavidyādiniṣṇātaḥ śāradābhidhaḥ ||43|| bahubhṛtyaparīvāro bahudhānyadhanādimān | kintu jñānena sampannaścāsaṃ paramabuddhimān ||44|| tato dhyātaṃ mayaikānte kimanena karomyaham | dvandvena sarvametaddhi nyasya putreṣu yāmyaham ||45|| tapase dhṛtasaṃkalpo vicārya ca rasāyanam | dāsyabhaktyā haristuṣyet pitaraḥ śrāddhakarmabhiḥ ||46 || devā yajñairjanā dānaiḥ striyaḥ kāmaiḥ ripuḥ kṣayaiḥ | tato’haṃ nirgato gehādaśvapaṭṭasaraḥ prati ||47|| lomaśo yatra vai śaśvad rājate sarasastaṭe | tatra gatvā mayā viṣṇuḥ purāṇapuruṣottamaḥ ||48|| ārādhito’tisadbhaktyā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | tato me bhagavām̐stuṣṭaḥ pratyakṣatāṃ jagāma me ||49|| stuto mayā tadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśca tadyathā | paraṃ parāṇāmamṛtaṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ prabhum ||1.522.50|| namāmyapratimaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patiṃ param | īśitāraṃ hariṃ cogratejasaṃ vīryavattamam |||51|| parabrahma pareśaṃ tvāṃ staumi nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | śrīpatiṃ kambharālakṣmībālaṃ gopālabālakam ||52|| rādhālakṣmīramāpadmāprabhāpadmāvatīpatim | pārvatīmāṇikīgaṃgālalitāmanasāpatim ||53|| satāṃ ca svāminaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ namāmyaham | prasiddhaḥ śaraṇaṃ me’stu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||54|| pradhāneśaśca dhāmeśo hyakṣareśaḥ satīpatiḥ | sahasramūrdhānantākṣo’nantabāhūrupādavān ||55|| kṣīrasthaścāmṛtasthaśca kuṃkumavāpikāsthitaḥ | triyugaśca trivedasthaḥ kṛte śvetatanuśca yaḥ ||56|| tato raktaśca pītaśca kṛṣṇaścāpi tataḥ punaḥ | vartate bahudhā yaśca viprān mukhāt sasarja yaḥ ||57|| bhujayorbahudhā kṣatraṃ corvorviśaḥ padāccarān | varṇān sasarja yo devo viśvatanuṃ namāmi tam ||58|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhanurdhvajatriśūlavān | svastikasvarṇarekhātmaśrīvatsahāraśobhitaḥ ||59|| śaraṇaṃ me sadā cāstu muktido mestu vai bhavān | itistuto mayā devaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||1.522.6 0|| varaṃ vṛṇīṣvetyasakṛt prāhāhaṃ mokṣamiṣṭavān | iṣṭadevaśca māṃ prāha bhaja tvaṃ prakṛtiṃ mune ||61 || mamājñayā ca pravṛttirmokṣa eva na saṃśayaḥ | vinājñāṃ me ca nivṛttirbandhanāya bhaved dhruvam ||6 2 || tasmāt kalpāntaraṃ yāhi sāyaṃ jāto’dya vai divā | nāraṃ pānīyamityuktaṃ nāraṃ jñānaṃ tathocyate ||63 || nāraṃ tvātmasthitaṃ viṣṇuṃ yo dadāti sa nāradaḥ | sadā te nāma caitadvai khyātaṃ samyag bhaviṣyati ||64|| evamuktaśca taṃ natvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | lomaśaṃ taṃ maharṣiṃ ca rājam̐stvadgṛhamāgataḥ ||6 5 || tvayā sammānitaścāhaṃ tvarthito mokṣaṇaṃ prati | mayāpyuktaṃ bhaja kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patiṃ prabhum ||66 || pravṛttiṃ ca harernārāyaṇasyaiva kuru nṛpa | tvayā rājyaṃ parityaktaṃ nirgatastvaṃ mayā saha ||67|| brahmalokaṃ gatau cāvāṃ rātrirjātā dinasya ca | divasaśca punaḥ sṛṣṭo brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā ||68|| tatrāhaṃ nāradī jātaḥ smṛto nṛpa bhavān mayā | priyavrataḥ sa evāyaṃ ceti tvāṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ ||69|| yasmānnārāyaṇaṃ dhyātvā prāpto’smi gurutāṃ nṛpa | tasmāt tvamapi rājendra bhava viṣṇuparāyaṇaḥ ||1.522.70|| matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaśca narasiṃho’tha vāmanaḥ | rāmo rāmaśca kṛṣṇaśca buddhaḥ kalkī ca te daśa ||71 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaviṣṇormūrtayastāḥ śubhapradāḥ | darśanaṃ prāptumicchūnāṃ sopānāni ca śobhanāḥ ||72|| yattāsāṃ paramaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭavānahameva tat | purā kalpe tadā tatra kuṃkumavāpikālaye ||73|| naranārāyaṇau cātra mūrtī tasyaiva śobhane | brahmacaryavratasthe’tra lokakalyāṇahetave ||74|| dharā mūrtistasya cādyā sarvadhāraṇapoṣikā | dvitīyā salilaṃ mūrtistṛtīyā taijasī prabhā ||75|| caturthī prāṇamūrtirvāyurvyomākhyā tu pañcamī | mana ātmā cāntarātmā harestāścāṣṭamūrtayaḥ ||76|| abhivyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagannārāyaṇena hi | ityukto nāradenāsau rājā bhāgavato mahān ||77|| nārāyaṇātmakaṃ brahmaparaṃ japtvā svayaṃbhuvaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamanāḥ paraṃ nirvāṇamāptavān ||78|| ityevaṃ lomaśaḥ sarvaṃ kathayāmāsa bhūbhṛte | indradyumnāya vijñānaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritam ||79|| śrutvā lakṣmi mahābhāgavato rājā tutoṣa ha | punastaṃ lomaśaṃ prāha sudhāṃ cātmāśritāṃ mune ||1.522.80|| pātraṃ matvā śubhaṃ śiṣyaṃ brahmāmṛtaṃ ca pāyaya | ityukte lomaśastaṃ ca brahmajñānaṃ tato’bravīt ||81 || vaidikaṃ sāmavedoktamārṣaṃ ca gahanaṃ tathā | jñānacakṣuṣmatā grāhya hṛtprakāśakṛtāṃ sthiram ||82|| dhyātṝṇāṃ pacanīyaṃ ca brahmaupaniṣadaṃ param | yacchrutvā vāsanālipto brahmabhūyāya kalpate ||83 || chidyate hṛdayagranthirbhidyate saṃśayastathā | līyate tāmaso bhāvo vardhante sukhasampadaḥ ||84|| kṣīyante sarvakarmāṇi śuṣkārdrāṇi dṛḍhānyapi | yajjñānenāntaraṃ cakṣuraiśvaryāḍhyaṃ prakāśate ||85|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre lomaśendradyumnasaṃvāde nāradasya śvetadvīpe sāvitryāṃ jñānahrāsastataḥ sāvitrīpradavedādijñānaṃ, badaryāṃ priyavratāya tatkathanaṃ, priyavratasya mokṣaḥ, bhagavaddhāmāvatārāvatārijñānaphalaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||522||
<1.523> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ekāgramānasī bhūtvā kṛtvātmani pareśvaram | kathyamānāṃ parāṃ vidyāṃ lomaśoktāṃ tu bhūbhṛte || 1 || ākarṇaya bahirvṛttiṃ tyaktvānyā mokṣakāriṇīm | yāmāśrityarṣayaḥ sarve niṣedurbrahmaṇo’ntike || 2 || lomaśaḥ prāha rājānam omityātmānamāntaram | smṛtvā dhyātvā yathoktaṃ ca kathayāmi nibodha me || 3 || oṃ namaḥ parabrahmaṇe bhrājadabhrājadvarṣmaṇe | brahmasavitre’kṣarabrahmādivāsyāya trikraṇe || 4 || divye brahmapure yo ha divyamūrtiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ | amūrtamūrteṣvantaryāmī mūrtaśca paraṃ hi tat || 5 || viprāso vidyuratrapuruṣamadvarūpamatijñam | kamanāsyaṃ kapyākṣaṃ yugagrahagaṃ puruṣottamam || 6 || parāṇakhasvaruṇimnībhirbhrājate pari ya ut yaḥ | hṛdruhadakṣabhrāṃkanaṃ yamete’tra santo biduḥ || 7 || brahmagavā vividuretamīśvarīndubhaprabhālam | tilasumanonāsaṃ nṛrūpaṃ vibhāntamāpūrṇam || 8 || hiraṇyakeśamakuṇṭhadṛśyaṃ yatte’ntarābhitaḥ | kiśorapratimaṃ saccidānandamayogaṃ preyuḥ || 9 || brahmapātrāṇi ha vai samupāsata śreyaḥkhaṇeyam | ṣoḍaśakalaṃ patkajāntarābhaṃ parasya pūṣṇaḥ || 1.523.1 0|| kalā bhavante’ṣṭāstryūllekhāsvastikādikā dakṣe | vyomārdhenduśapharādyā dakṣetare’sya caraṇe || 11 || eko hyeṣaḥ sarvayantā surūpo rūpaṃ rūpaṃ rūpyamāṇo’dhiśete | sahasradhā cāpyatha nāntadhā san samānarūpo rūpyate’kṣayyaloke || 12|| sarve jīvā īśvarāścātha muktā guṇātītaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahmamūlam | yasyānandaṃ labdhvānandībhavanti hyeṣaḥ sahajānandabhūmiḥ parātmā || 13 || sarve jīvā īśvarāścātha muktā guṇātītaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahmamūlam | yasyaiśvaryaṃ labdhvā īśā bhavanti hyeṣaḥ sahajaiśvaryabhūmiḥ parātmā || 14|| sarve jīvā īśvarāścātha muktā guṇātītaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahmamūlam | yasya vittiṃ labdhvā vido bhavanti hyeṣaḥ sahajavittibhūmiḥ parātmā || 15|| sarve jīvā īśvarāścātha muktā guṇātītaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahmamūlam | yasyā sattāṃ labdhvā santo bhavanti hyeṣaḥ sahajasatyabhūmiḥ parātmā || 16 || sarve jīvā īśvarāścātha muktā guṇātītaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahmamūlam | yasya tṛptiṃ labdhvā tṛptā bhavanti hyeṣaḥ sahajatṛptibhūmiḥ parātmā || 17|| araṃ dāso na mīhluṣe karāṇyahaṃ devāya bhūrṇaye’nāgāḥ | acetayadacitto devo aryo gṛtsaṃ rāye kavitaro junāti || 18|| veśobhagyasya śāntāteḥ kaṇe dhūmā ramannā īśanāni kat tam | stavāmanenasaṃ gṛbhaṃ taruṣema enaḥ prayuñjya tsarūpaṇīśanībhiḥ || 19|| parāñci tat khāni parātmarūpāṇyabhinnatattvānyapi bhakticārāt | pṛthagbhidheyāni haranti tajjñā rasaikaśaktīnyapṛthagbhūtaṃ hi tat || 1.523.20 || śrotrasya śrotraṃ manaso manastat vāco ha vāk cakṣuṣastaddhi cakṣuḥ | tvacastvamityeva tadīyaśaktayo muktasya khānāmuta brahmaṇastat ||21 || jñānasvarūpo’tha manaḥsvarūpo jñānasya vittirmana eva tasya | tadeva dhīrhrīśca tadeva kāmo medhā tathecchā dhiṣaṇā kṛtaśca || 22|| pumaṃkapūrṇe’pi ratirna guptā prākāmyasevye’pi na rūpataḥ strīḥ | grāhye’pi tasminna hatiḥ khavitterviyogayoge’pi na tattvavyāhatiḥ ||23|| amātṛjatvānnahi koṣaṣaṭkam anannakoṣānnahi cityacityatiḥ | prāṇaḥ svaśaktistadaprāṇakasya kāśo’pi nirāvaraṇātmabhāvaḥ || 24|| anannagrāsānnahi mehanādikaṃ tato na gurvādi kuto hi nidrā | nityaprasannasya kuto’prasannatā preṣṭyaikabhāvānna pareṣṭadhīnatā ||25|| hiraṇyakeśāśca hiraṇyavannakhāḥ sukundadantā nahi yogabhāginaḥ | cidaikarūpā ramaṇīyasyātmakāḥ sadaikamānāḥ pravibhānti tasya ||26|| ago’pi gantā manaso javīyo’ viprāṃsa enaṃ nāpnuvan prāgupāsteḥ | vipreṣṭako’nyānatyeti javīyaḥ tiṣṭhannaciti citi cāpi īśaḥ ||27|| tadabhyāśe na bhayaṃ kiṃcanāsti na tatrānyat kiṃcanāpūrvamasti | ubhau tīrtvā jīvamāyeśabhāvau dhūmrātigo modate tatsayujaḥ ||28|| śravaṇāyāpi bahubhiryo na labhyaḥ śṛṇvanto’pi bahavo yaṃ na vidyuḥ | niyāmyajñaṃ tamīḍyaṃ viditvā nicāyya tāṃ śāntimatyantameti ||29|| taṃ durdarśaṃ gūḍhamanupraviṣṭaṃ guhāhitaṃ gahvareṣṭhaṃ purāṇam | adhyātmayogādhigamena devaṃ matvā dhīraḥ puṇyapāpe jahāti ||1.523.30|| aṇoraṇīyānmahato mahīyān laghorlaghīyām̐śca gurorgarīyān | tamakriyaḥ paśyati dhūtapāpo hareḥ prasādāt prapūritasatvaḥ ||3 1 || na saḥ parātmā pravacanena labhyo na medhayā na bahunā śrutena | yamevaiṣa vṛṇute tena labhyastasya parātmā vivṛṇute tanuṃ svām ||32|| aśuklamakṛṣṇamarājasaṃ tat niyāmakaṃ nityamanantapāram | anādinaṃ brahmaparaṃ dhruvaṃ hariṃ nicāyya taṃ mṛtyumukhātpramucyate || 33|| sa brahmasat muktasadīśasadvasuravyaktasajjīvasadeva kāryasat | tathāpi na lipyate hyantarātmā alepyaśaktiḥ pratirūpako’sau ||34|| vaśyadvitīyaḥ sarvabhūtāntarātmā bījaṃ pradhānaṃ bahurūpaṃ vyākaroti | tamāntaraṃ ye paripaśyantimuktāsteṣāṃ śāntiḥ śāśvatī netareṣām ||35|| nityo nityānāṃ cetanaścetanānāmeko bahūnāṃ yo vidadhāti kalpān | tamāntarasthaṃ ye paripaśyanti muktāsteṣāṃ śāntiḥ śāśvatī netareṣām ||36|| na bhāti savitā tadagre na kaumudīśo na saudāminyo bhānti kuto’nalo’yam | tameva bhāntamanu bhāti sarvaṃ tadantastasya bhāsā sarvamidaṃ pravibhāti tat sat| ||37|| aśvatthaloke bhayādasya sūryastapatyagnirvahati cāpyanilaḥ | īśā apyaṇḍaṃ parikurvanti yadbhayāttaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ yānti tadvidaḥ ||38|| tamacchāyaṃ śubhraṃ snehamūrtiṃ śīlabhrājat nityavijñānadharmam | sveṣṭaṃ devaṃ vedayate yastu vidvān sa tatprasādāt tadvat sārvajñyameti ||39|| tamadreśyamagrāhyamagotramavarṇamacakṣuḥśrotraṃ tamapāṇipādam | nityaṃ vibhuṃ sarvagataṃ susūkṣmaṃ tamavyathaṃ kāryayoniṃ paripaśyanti muktāḥ ||1.523.40|| yathorṇanābhiḥ sṛjate gṛhṇate ca yathā kṣitāvoṣadhayo bhavanti | yathā sato narāt keśalomāni saṃbhavanti tathā pareśāt saṃbhavatīha viśvam ||41 || paraṃ brahmaivedamamṛtaṃ purastāt| paraṃbrahma paścād dakṣiṇe cottare ca | adhaścordhvaṃ vyāpakaṃ brahmakṛtyā paraṃ brahmavyāptamidaṃ viśvaṃ samastam ||42|| na cakṣuṣā gṛhyate nāpi vācā nānyairdevaistapasā karmaṇā vā | jñānaprasādena viśuddhasattvastatastu taṃ paśyati dhyāyamānaḥ ||43|| bṛhacca taddivyamacintyarūpaṃ sūkṣmācca tatsūkṣmataraṃ vibhāti | dūrāt sudūre tadihāntike ca paśyatsvihaiva nihitaṃ guhāyām ||44|| satyena labhyastapasā saḥ parātmā māhātmyajñānena brahmacaryeṇa nityam | svasya svarūpe divyarūpo hi śubhro yaṃ paśyanti yatayaḥ kṣīṇadoṣāḥ ||45|| yadā draṣṭā paśyati svarṇavarṇaṃ vidhātāraṃ puruṣaṃ brahmapāram | tadā vettā śuklakṛṣṇe vihāya niravidyaḥ kṛṣṇasāmyaṃ prayāti ||46|| samāpadehe dehī nityaṃ nimagno māyāgrāhyo muhyati śokameti | yadā svānyaṃ paśyati sarvavyāptaṃ tadā cātmā jāyate śokahīnaḥ ||47|| dvau tau sumitre caikavṛkṣaṃ śrayete’nyonyaṃ kārye protsāhanaprade staḥ | adhīraiko gradhnayā cātti miṣṭaṃ dhīraścānyaḥ taṃ sutṛpto dadāti ||48|| yathāpagā vārdhibhāvaṃ prayānti bhinnakhyātipratimāne visṛjya | tathā jñātākhyāpratimāvidhuro’ kṣarātparaṃ divyapūruṣameti ||49|| parabrahma veda yo brahma sa syānna cāvartte bhramate karmakṛṣṭaḥ | auṣṇyaṃ tyaktvodvejanaṃ vai jahāti hṛdbgranthibhistyajyate cāmṛtāya ||1.523.50|| yaścātra nityaṃ pratibodhamāptaścāsmindehe hṛdguhāyā virājan | tadantaḥsthaḥ sṛṣṭikṛt sarvahartā vyatirekī vartate divyaloke ||5 1 || vidanti santo’tha vidmo vayaṃ tamavedane syātpatanaṃ mahatkṛtam | tasyaiva vijñā amṛtāḥ sambabhūvuranye tu duḥkhaṃ cāvidyakaṃ yayurvai ||52|| evaṃ vidyānmahimānaṃ parātmano nāsyāsti vṛddhiḥ karmabhirvā kṣatiśca | tasyaiva bhūyāḥ padavit dhāmagantā tamālambya lipyate nāghakarmabhiḥ ||5 3 || sarvaṃ yasya cākṣare brahmaṇi yat sarvaṃ tasya muktavṛnde’nuṣaktam | tadvai sarvamīśvareṣu praviṣṭaṃ tadevā smin jīvabhūte tathānye ||54|| yadakṣare tad bhavatyeva kevale tathā ha vai śabale vai nirañjane | hiraṇmaye mahadviṣṇvākhye’tha viṣṇau rudre’thāpi vartamāne virāje ||55 || prakṛtyādāvaṣṭakāvṛttikāsu taleṣvatra dvisaptakeṣu virājate | atra bhūmau rājate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī taṃ viditvāmṛtaṃ vraja ||56 || tasmāddhi sūkṣmacidacidviśiṣṭāt sthūlaṃ hi cidacidviśiṣṭaṃ prajāyate | upādānopādeyayorabhedāt sarvaṃ tattvaṃ parabrahmaikameva ||57|| parātmanastasya pūrṇāvatāriṇaḥ kācicchaktirvyūhasaṃjñāmupaiti | kramānnyūnā saiva vibhavāvatārā pūrṇāṃśamukhyāveśagauṇādirūpā ||58|| tattadyogāttatsvarūpasya labdhistasmin līnālīnabhāvaṃ hyupaiti | parātmanaścopāsanayā pareśaṃ parāṃ muktimāpnuvantīti tat sat ||59|| muktādhāraṃ parabrahmavyāpyacetanamakṣaram | sarvādhāraṃ parabrahmaśarīraṃ dhāma yatra saḥ ||1.523.6 0 || tadevāstyakṣaraṃ brahmadhāma tejomayaṃ hareḥ | yāvadvedatapobrahmacaryacīrṇaṃ hi tatpadam ||6 1 || aśarīraṃ śarīraṃ ca mūrtaṃ cāmūrtamityapi | śuddhaṃ nityaṃ ca māyādiprakāśakaṃ harestanu ||62|| saccidānandavāsātma janmamṛtyujarātigam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmiśritaṃ sadvartate param ||6 3 || yadarcimatparabrahmatejo’bhinnaṃ sanātanam | rajasaśca pare pāre tatrādhyakṣaṃ hariṃ bhaja ||64|| hiraṇmayātparātkośādapi cordhvaṃ ca niṣkalam | śubhraṃ jyotirjyotiṣāṃ ca tatrādhyakṣaṃ hariṃ bhaja ||65 || yadgolomākṛtipratyaṃgānyabhinnātmaśaktayaḥ | na vai bhāgo na vai tyāgo rasaikyaṃ ca pareśavat ||66 || sārvajñyaṃ śeṣasāpekṣaṃ tatrasthaṃ śrīhariṃ bhaja | parabrahmagataṃ tejomayaṃ tatra hariṃ bhaja ||67|| muktā hyanādino nityā vasanti yatra śāśvate | tatrasthaṃ śrīhariṃ rājan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhaja ||6 8|| evamakṣaradhāmasthaṃ paradhāmasthitaṃ param | bhajitvā sāmyabhāvāptā bahavastaṃ sadā bhaja ||6 9 || yaḥ setuḥ sarvadharmāṇāmakṣaraṃ brahma yasya bhūḥ | tatrasthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jñātvā sadā bhaja ||1.523.70|| yaḥ syādasyānavajñānī bhaktidāsyavivarjitaḥ | aśuddhaḥ sa na taṃ yāyāt saṃsārāgamaveṣṭitaḥ ||71 || aparokṣānubhavavām̐stasya nārāyaṇasya yaḥ | sa ca taddhāma cāpnoti tato bhūyo na jāyate ||72|| bhaktirbalaṃ bhaved yasya jñānaṃ puṣṭipradaṃ tathā | gurusevārathārūḍhaḥ prāpnoti śrīhareḥ padam ||73 || jīvebhyastu parā īśā īśebhyaḥ paramakṣaram | akṣarātparamaṃ kāntaṃ jñātvā taddhāma cāpnuyāt ||74|| hṛdayagranthibhedāntaṃ sarvaṃ syādanuśāsanam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇagranthiṃ labdhvā gaccha paraṃ padam ||75 || pare tvayi mayi cānye yo’sti taṃ bhaja sādaram | mṛtyupāśān sa cāpnoti yastaṃ bhedena paśyati ||76 || hṛdā cāntaścakṣuṣā taṃ jñātvā nānāvivarjitam | nānābhāvakṛtaṃ mṛtyuṃ hatvā yāhi paraṃ padam ||77|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | japa mantraṃ sadā rājan sa tvāṃ pāraṃ kariṣyati ||78|| visraṃsamānadehasya bandhanaṃ nāvaśiṣyate | abandhanasya muktasya te kimatrāvaśiṣyate ||79|| ūrdhvamūlo’rvākpraśākha eṣo’śvattho mahān taruḥ | taṃ vihāyākṣaraṃ brahma paśyāmṛtaṃ hariṃ vraja ||1.523.80|| yadbhayāt sarvatejāṃsi prakāśante vidhānavat | īśā īśatvamāpannā yasmāttaṃ śrīhariṃ bhaja ||81 || hṛtsthān kāmān parihāya kṛṣṇaṃ cātra samaśnuhi | amṛtaṃ paramānandaṃ bhuṃkṣva kṛṣṇanarāyaṇāt ||82|| satyaṃ tapo brahmacaryaṃ dāsyaṃ yeṣu pratiṣṭhitam | teṣāṃ cāsti brahmaloko yeṣu jaihmyaṃ na nānṛtam ||83|| dve vidye sarvathā rājan parā vedyā tathāparā | parayā tvāpyate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’kṣare pade ||84|| tadanyāścāparāḥ sarvā yābhirbrahma na cāpyate | ye vai parātmanaḥ preṣṭhāṃ vācaṃ sad vyāharanti te ||85|| puṇye brahmapade yānti dāsyaṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ | parabrahma vijānāti sevate bhajate ca yaḥ ||86|| jāgrati cāntare svapne tryavasthottaravaibhave | so’śnute sarvakāmāṃśca brahmaṇā saha miśritān ||87|| annaṃ prāṇaṃ mano jñānaṃ cānandaṃ tamavehi ca | ātmānaṃ cāntarātmānaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhaja ||88|| kaṃbharāputrasevābhiḥ kenānandena pūryate | gopālabālasevābhirgobhiḥ saṃbhriyate nṛpa ||89|| vāṇī manaśca viṣayaṃ karotyeva na yaṃ prabhum | ānandaṃ taṃ hareryāhi kutaścana bhayaṃ na te ||1.523.90 || jñānād yajñāḥ prajāyante karmāṇyapi bhavanti ca | sampadyate suratṛptiḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇe samarpite ||9 1 || parabrahma ca yo veda yastato na pramādyati | māyāpāpmānamutsṛjya brahmabhogān samaśnute ||92|| santaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pravadantaṃ santaṃ dhyāyantameva ca | sevamānaṃ tathā santaṃ satpadaṃ sa hi karṣati ||9 3 || sa hi sṛṣṭvā tadevānuprāviśatsaḥ parātparaḥ | satyaṃ yathānṛtaṃ tena satyamityeva buddhyate ||94|| asad vyākṛtabhāvaṃ ca sukṛtaṃ tena buddhyate | so’kṣarātpuruṣadvārā naikāṇḍānyudapādayat ||95 || tasya parātmano yogāt teṣu satyaṃ ca sukṛtam | akṣare ca yathā tadvajjñātvā mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||96|| sadeva rājan bhagavānabhūtpurā tataḥ samastaṃ satsvarūpaṃ vikāsitam | rasātmako’yaṃ sarvarasapradātā labdhvā rasaṃ tasyānandībhavanti ||97|| asyānandena vai lokā bhavanti cābhayaṃ gatāḥ | mano vāco na vai yānti yatra taṃ bhaja keśavam ||98|| tasmājjāyanta imāni jīvantyapi tataḥ prabhoḥ | tatraiveme palīyante śāśvataṃ pralayaṃ vraja ||99|| paramātmā divyarūpo dhyeyaścāsītpurāgṛhe | racayitvā dvitīyaṃ ca tatrovāsa ca taṃ bhaja || 1.523.10 0|| sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ sarvaṃ prajñānetraṃ prabhāsate | prajñāne vartate yaśca taṃ netraṃ bhaja mādhavam || 101 || śāntaṃ sarvātmakaṃ brahmaparaṃ kaṃ khaṃ hariṃ bhaja | śraddhayā tapasā divyaṃ netāraṃ tvarciṣācyutam || 1 02|| divyāntaḥsthaṃ śuklapakṣāntarātmānaṃ hariṃ bhaja | uttarāyaṇamāsasthaṃ samvatsarāntarasthitam || 103 || ādityavartinaṃ candrāntarātmānaṃ ca taṃ bhaja | vidyutprakāśadātāraṃ varuṇasthaṃ jalāntaram ||1 04|| indrāntaraṃ prajāpaterāntarasthaṃ virāḍgatam | rudrahṛdayaṃ viṣṇusthaṃ mahāviṣṇupratiṣṭhitam || 1 05|| nirañjanasthaṃ śabalānvitaṃ kevalagaṃ bhaja | akṣarabrahmago bhūtvā tatpumāṃsaṃ sadā bhaja || 1 06|| dānānāṃ phaladātāraṃ dhūmrarātristhitaṃ prabhum | kṛṣṇapakṣāntarasthaṃ ca dakṣiṇāyanagaṃ harim || 1 07|| samvatsarāntarasthaṃ ca pitṛsthaṃ vyomagaṃ bhaja | candrasthaṃ ca prajāpālasthitaṃ rājan sadā bhaja || 1 08|| vāyusthaṃ cābhrasaṃvāsaṃ meghasthaṃ kaṇavartinam | bījasthaṃ kāryarūpaṃ cābhivyāptaṃ śrīhariṃ bhaja || 1 09|| ramaṇīyakhanijeṣu viprādiṣu hariṃ bhaja | dayanīyakhanijeṣu gavādiṣu hariṃ bhaja || 1.523.11 0|| eṣa devo hatapāpmā vijaro mṛtyuvarjitaḥ | viśokaḥ kṣuttṛṣāhīnaḥ satyakāmaprakalpanaḥ || 111 || tvatsvarūpastvatsamānastvādṛśaṃ taṃ prabhuṃ bhaja | tasya rūpeṇa te cābhiniṣpattistaṃ tathā bhaja || 1 12|| krīḍannṛtyan kīrtayam̐ścānandayan saṃsmaran sadā | svena rūpeṇa kurvantaṃ tvāṃ taṃ tathāvidhaṃ bhaja || 11 3|| vinā bhaktaṃ na ramate dvitīyaṃ taṃ hyakalpayat | taṃ tvayi vyāptamevainaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ sadā bhaja || 1 14|| so’yamātmā tvayā rājan draṣṭavyo hṛtsthacakṣuṣā | śrotavyo hṛcchravasā ca mantavyo divyatejasā || 1 15|| nirṇetavyastasya buddhyā na tyājyaḥ sa kadācana | evaṃ sarvātmabhāvena paśya kṛṣṇaṃ sanātanam || 1 16|| tasmin sarvāṇi bhūtāni cārpitāni ca taṃ bhaja | yaḥ pṛthivyāṃ jale vahnau vāyau vyomni ca taṃ bhaja || 1 17|| yasyemāni śarīrāṇi śarīrasthaṃ ca taṃ bhaja | ātmā santaḥ pratimā ca yasya taṃ keśavaṃ bhaja || 1 18|| yasmāt sarve samānandā jīvā cānanditā yataḥ | āptakāmaṃ mahānandaṃ pūrṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ bhaja || 1 19|| kāmān vihāya hṛdaye hariṃ sthāpaya bhāvataḥ | sthitaṃ cāvehi vai rājan yāhi taṃ śaraṇaṃ bhaja || 1.523.1 20|| nānavāptaṃ tadā te’trāvaśiṣṭaṃ nahi śiṣyate | saiṣā brāhmī parāvidyā pāṭhitā te pramokṣadā || 121|| athāyaṃ rājā santṛptaścātmanyeva janārdanam | paramaṃ puruṣaṃ divyaṃ dadarśa puruṣottamam || 1 22|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhanuḥśūlādirājim | rādhālakṣmīprabhāpadmāpārvatīmāṇikīśvaram || 123|| sarvābhiḥ sevikābhiśca sevitaṃ pārṣadaistathā | hṛdaye taṃ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vilokya ca || 1 24|| tadicchayā bahiścāpi taṃ dadarśa śriyāḥpatim | lomaśasya ca kṛpayā parāvidyāprabhāvataḥ || 1 25|| vyomnaḥ samāgataṃ divyaṃ vimānaṃ cātisundaram | brahmaṇaścājñayā devadūtena tvadhivāsitam || 126|| devadūtaḥ samuvācāgacchāgaccha vimānake | rājannayāmi te satyaṃ lokaṃ śrīparameṣṭhinaḥ || 1 27|| indradyumnaśca taṃ prāha na me satye prayojanam | yāsyāmi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya caraṇaṃ dhruvam || 1 28|| akṣarātparamaṃ dhāma lomaśasya kṛpālavāt | ityukto devadūtaḥ sa yayau lokaṃ tu vedhasaḥ || 1 29|| indradyumno virarāma lomaśasya tu sannidhau | lomaśastaṃ sarastīre tṛṇāsanaṃ dadau śubham || 1.523.1 30|| kadambadrumanikaṭe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇālaye | rājā snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā pūjayitvā narāyaṇam || 131 || lomaśaṃ pūjayitvā ca ṛṣīnnatvā tadāśrame | phalādi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya vinivedya ca || 1 32|| samarpya gurave tatra bubhuje ca papau jalam| yoganidrāṃ sukhamayīṃ lebhe rātrau hariṃ smaran || 1 33|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne indradyumnāya lomaśarṣisamupadiṣṭabrāhmīparāvidyaupaniṣadātmasmaraṇanāmā trayoviṃśatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||523||
<1.524> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ākarṇaya mahālakṣmi lomaśasya kathāṃ śubhām | prātaḥ samutthito rājā kṛtāhniko guruṃ prati || 1 || jagāma darśanārthaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | guruṇāśīryojitaḥ sa papraccha lomaśam ṛṣim || 2 || bhagavan mokṣadātastvaṃ māyātīto jitendriyaḥ | vartase ca yathā dhāmni tathaivātra karāgradṛk || 3 || vada me bhagavaddhāmni kālo nāsti tataḥ prabho | nityaḥ sevāprakārāderniyāmakaḥ kṣaṇātmakaḥ || 4 || dinātmako vyavahāraḥ kathaṃ bhaktairvidhīyate | iti pṛṣṭo lomaśastu rājānaṃ prāha bhūpate || 5 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrteḥ kiraṇaiḥ suprabhānvitaiḥ | prasaradbhirbhinnarūpaiḥ kṣaṇādyāḥ santi sarvadā || 6 || tajjñāstatkiraṇaiḥ prātarmadhyaṃ sāyaṃ vidanti ca | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasteṣāṃ sevāṃ gṛhṇāti tatra ca || 7 || mūrtau līnasthitirnidrā dāsyasevā tu jāgratī | śvetaprakāśanaṃ cāhaḥ sandhyā raktaprakāśanam || 8 || meghaśyāmāvaloke ca mūrtau sthairyaṃ niśeti ca | goloke’pi tathā kṛṣṇakiraṇairvyavahṛtayaḥ || 9 || vaikuṇṭhe’pi tathā nārāyaṇatejaḥprarītayaḥ | akṣare tu pare dhāmni parabrahmaprabhādibhiḥ || 1.524.1 0|| ityevaṃ tadgatebhyaśca śrutaṃ muktebhya eva yat | kathitaṃ te cendradyumna kimanyat praṣṭumicchasi || 11 || indradyumnastato lakṣmi papraccha lomaśam ṛṣim | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścātra kṣetre prākaṭyamicchati || 12|| yadā tadā sa kiṃ mātṛgarbhe tiṣṭhati vā na vā | bhautikaṃ kiṃ tasya varṣma utānyādṛśameva kim || 1 3|| chindhi me saṃśayaṃ jātaṃ laukikaṃ ca kṛpāṃ kuru | lomaśaḥ prāha rājarṣe kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ || 14|| nārāyaṇasya sarvasyāvatārāderyadā yadā | sṛṣṭau bhavati prākaṭye tadā garbhānusārataḥ || 15|| vāyuṃ garbhasthitaṃ tvājñāpayatyeva hariḥ sadā | garbhakukṣo tvayā stheyaṃ jalena saha tāvatā || 16|| yathā garbhavatī mātā bahirdṛśyeta vai tathā | kukṣiṃ procchrayatāṃ prāptāṃ kuru kālena yāvatā ||17|| yatra yatra yādṛśaśca samayaḥ samapekṣyate | tāvattatra darśayitvā garbhasyāpyabhivardhanam || 18|| prasavasya samaye ca vāyorjalasya kukṣitaḥ | bahirniḥsāraṇaṃ tatra darśanīyaṃ ca laukikam || 1 9|| mayā tatra tadā tatrasthitairanabhilakṣitam | bālarūpaṃ yathā garbhajanyaṃ dṛśyeta vai tathā ||1.524.20|| bhāsamātraṃ karaṇīyaṃ garbhajalābhiyojitam | māyayā channanetrāṇāmatra nāsti gatirmayi ||21 || divyadṛśaḥ prapaśyanti divyāṃ sūkṣmāṃ mama kṛtim | sthūladṛśaḥ prapaśyanti garbhājjāto hi bālakaḥ||22|| evameva hi muktāśca bhavantyayonisaṃbhavāḥ | mātāpitrorna tajjñānaṃ yato ratipriyau hi tau || 23||| kāmadevasya rītyaiva tayorbhānaṃ mamodbhave | akāmayostu divyaṃ vai tatkṣaṇānmama darśanam || 24|| tato vāyo na me garbhāgamo na dhātusaṃśrayaḥ | na ca garbhagṛhe vāso yonerniṣkāsanaṃ na hi || 25|| bālyabhāvo na me tvasti na janmamaraṇe hyubhe | na hi deho bhautiko me kintu darśaya tattathā || 26||| evamājñāpayati śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | rājam̐stadanusāreṇa vāyudarśayati kṛtim ||27|| bhojanādi tathā tasya nityatṛptasya vai hareḥ | laukikaṃ naiva bhavati bhaktāḥ kurvanti bhāvataḥ ||28|| yadyadātmana evāsti priyaṃ bhogyaṃ manoharam | tasmai samarpya bhoktavyaṃ dharmaścāyaṃ sanātanaḥ ||29 || evaṃ bhaktakṛtā sevā nityatṛptasya tṛptidā | lakṣmyai purā pradattaṃ ca varadānaṃ tu śārṅgiṇā 1.524.30|| niveditaṃ na vai nyūnaṃ kathaṃ bhavati tatra vai | hariḥ prāha mayā bhuktaṃ vardheta na kṣayaṃ vrajet ||31 || yathā yathāhaṃ bhuñje tat vardhate ca tathā tathā | jaḍaṃ cetanatāṃ yāti divyabhāvaṃ prapadyate ||32|| prasannatāṃ samāsādya yāti praphullatā tadā | navaṃ navaṃ bhavatyeva rasānvitaṃ śubhapradam || 33|| divyadṛśaḥ prapaśyanti paśyanti na bahirdṛśaḥ | ityetat kathitaṃ rājan naivedyasya pravardhanam ||34|| evaṃ kṛṣṇe pradattānāṃ hrāso nāsti kvacinnṛpa | pratyuta vardhate sarvaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi ||35|| indradyumnastato’pṛcchallomaśaṃ sadguruṃ harim | kasmāt tvaṃ groṣmakāle’pi madhyaṃ prāpte divākare || 36|| nivāsārthaṃ gṛhaṃ ramyaṃ kimarthaṃ na karoṣi vai | lomaśastaṃ nṛpaṃ prāha svalpāyuścāsmi sarvathā ||37|| kasyārthaṃ kārya āvāsastvanityaṃ jīvitaṃ yataḥ | yadi syācchāśvataṃ dīrghaṃ jīvitaṃ gṛhamābhajet ||38|| rājā prāha ca sarveṣāṃ cirāyuḥ śrūyate bhavān | tenāhamapi saṃprāpto bhavaddarśanakāmyayā ||39|| lomaśastu tadā prāha śṛṇu rājan vadāmi tat | kalpe kalpe prasaṃprāpte romaikyaṃ mama naśyati ||1.524.40|| abhāve vakṣaso romṇāṃ mama nāśo bhaviṣyati | trilakṣaṃ ca pañcaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi gatāni me ||41 || kalpāni tatra vai naṣṭā vedhaso dṛśa me puraḥ | nābheruparicākaṇṭhaṃ romāṇi santi me nṛpa ||42|| ṣaṭtriṃśallakṣapañcāśatsahasrāṇi ca tāni vai | trilakṣaṃ ca pañcaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇyadhikāni ca ||43|| tāvatkalpānuṣitvaiva brahmāṇḍeṣu tataḥ param | yāsyāmi paramaṃ lokaṃ kiṃ karomi gṛheṇa vai ||44|| paśya tvaṃ maccharīre’tra jānoradho’ṅgulāyatam | yāvatkalpaṃ pratispardhi saṃjātaṃ romavarjitam ||45|| jīvitavyaṃ dhruvaṃ nāsti jñāyate romanāśanāt | na karomi gṛhaṃ tena kāraṇena mahīpate ||46|| rājā prāha ṛṣe pūrvaṃ kiṃ karma vihitaṃ tvayā | tapo dānaṃ kṛtaṃ kīdṛg yenedṛgjīvitaṃ ciram ||47|| lomaśastu tadā prāha śṛṇu rājan ciraṃ mama | ahamāsaṃ purā sṛṣṭau śūdro dāridryapīḍitaḥ ||48|| dāsyaṃ kurvan tadāsaṃ saṃgato’haṃ badarīvanam | kṣutkṣāmaḥ supipāsārto dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ naram ||49|| jalaṃ kamalapuṣpāṇi samarpyārcanamācaram | atha pūjāṃ vinirvartya girermārgaṃ samāśritaḥ ||1.524.50|| himena kṣudhayā mṛtyuṃ gato vipragṛhe tataḥ | jātismaro’bhavaṃ tena maunaṃ rakṣāmi sarvathā ||51 || īśāna iti me nāma pitā cakre praharṣitaḥ | anyaiḥ sampreryamāṇo’pi naiva jalpāmi kiñcana ||52|| vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ prāpto dṛṣṭvā saṃsārasaṃsthitim | pitā me’yojayad vācaḥ prakāśārthaṃ tu bheṣajam ||53 || tena me jāyate hāsyaṃ kṛtamantrajanānprati | aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre nivasan bhaktibhāvataḥ |||54|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ pūjayāmi samāhitaḥ | śiloñcchavṛttimāsādya prāṇavṛttiṃ samācaran ||55|| nāraṃgairbadaraiḥ śākaiścirbhaṭaiḥ phalapatrakaiḥ | tato me śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ ||56||| uvāca parituṣṭo’smi varaṃ varaya suvrata | tato’rthitaṃ mayā kuru jarāmaraṇavarjitam ||57|| kṛṣṇaḥ prāha na vai martye’maratvaṃ kasyacidbhavet | maryādāṃ kuru tasmātte jīvitasya dadāmi tat ||58|| tataścokto hariḥ kalpe kalpe raumaikapātanam | bhavenme nābhitaḥ kaṇṭhāvadhiṃ romṇāṃ prapātanam ||59|| tāvadāyurmamaivāstu vedho’bdānāṃ daśādhikam | śataṃ yatra vilīyeta tato yāsyāmi dhāma te || 1.524.60 || tathāstviti hariḥ prāha yayau cādarśanaṃ tataḥ | tata ārabhya caivātra kuṃkumavāpikāntike ||61 || aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre nivasāmi tathāvadhim | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasevāphalaṃ me cirajīvanam ||62|| pṛthvīnāṃ pralayā dṛṣṭā jīvane’tra sahasraśaḥ | pralaye yāmi vaikuṇṭhaṃ jalasyopari saṃsthitam ||63|| tejaāvaraṇaprānte punaḥsṛṣṭau bhuvaṃ prati | āgacchāmi nivasāmi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrame ||64|| patnīvratastathā vipraḥ pativratā ca tatpriyā | bhavatastau cirajīvau pratikeśājapātanau ||65|| tathā śrīkambharālakṣmīgopālakṛṣṇabhūsurau | bhavatastau cirajīvau pratikeśājapātanau ||66|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastasya bālo’kṣarapatiḥ svayam | pratisṛṣṭi pratikalpaṃ jāyate ca tayorgṛhe ||67|| tameva śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhajāmi sarvadā | teṣāmāyurvilokyaiva mama garvo na vartate ||68|| bhajāmi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tvaṃ bhaja taṃ harim | lokasya haribhaktasya vāñcchitaṃ nāsti durlabham ||69|| ityevaṃ mama vṛttāntaḥ kathitaścendradyumnaka | tvaṃ jātaḥ kīrtimān loke gacchākṣarapadaṃ hareḥ ||1.524.70|| indradyumnastataḥ prāha sarveṣāṃ śāpamokṣaṇam | kacchapolūkagṛdhrarṣibakamārkaṇḍamokṣaṇam ||71 || kadā bhāvi vada vidvan sarvajñastvaṃ hariryathā | lomaśastu tadā prāha yadā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||72|| bhajiṣyanti ca te sarve mantragrahaṇapūrvakam | tadā mokṣo’tra vai kṣetre bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||73|| indradyumnastu tān sarvān sasmāropakṛto muhuḥ | jātismarāśca te kāmarūpadharāḥ samāyayuḥ ||74|| natāste lomaśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ samārcayan | pupūjuḥ kambharālakṣmīṃ gopālakṛṣṇamārcayan ||75|| cakāra svāgataṃ tvaśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ṛṣiḥ | lomaśaḥ pradadau mantraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ||76|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | jepuste saṃsthitāstatra lomaśasyāśrame’naghe ||77|| aśvapaṭṭasarasyete snātvā kuṃkumavāpikām | gatvā cakrurjalapānaṃ jepurmantraṃ divāniśam ||78|| teṣāṃ lomaśakṛpayā vāsanā vilayaṃ gatā | muktāste śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇānugrahato’bhavan ||79|| kacchaparṣiḥ kacchadeśe nārāyaṇasarovare | ghūkarṣiḥ śrīhāṭakeśakṣetre nāganadītaṭe ||1.524.80 || gṛdhrarṣiḥ śrīraivatādrau dattātreyatapaḥsthale | bakarṣiḥ śrīsomanāthakṣetre samudrasannidhau ||8 1 || mārkaṇḍeyastalaśyāmasthale’raṇye vasanti ca | divyāste cirajīvāśca kāmarūpadharāḥ sadā ||82|| vartiṣyante pratikalpaṃ lokakalyāṇahetave | raivate kārtike sarve tvāyānti prativatsaram ||83|| pradakṣiṇārthaṃ devānāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ca | lomaśo’haṃ pragacchāmi divasān pañca tatra vai ||84|| śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaityudāraṃ gṛṇanta evādrimanukramante | teṣāṃ pṛthivyākramaṇasya puṇyaṃ jāyeta saṃvacmi tu lomaśo’ham ||85|| athendradyumnanṛpaterbhajanena hariḥ svayam | tutoṣa parayā bhaktyā lomaśānugraheṇa ca ||86|| dadau divyāṃ parāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ nirāvaraṇikāṃ hṛdi | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vilokayāmāsa hṛdi prabhum ||87|| lomaśe dakṣiṇāṃ nyasya kṛtvātmānaṃ parātmani | brahmarandhreṇa tu pathā niryātuṃ yāvadicchati ||88|| tāvaddivyākṣarānmuktairjuṣṭaṃ vimānamāgatam | koṭikoṭyarkasaṃkāśaṃ samāruroha tat nṛpaḥ ||89|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā yayau brahmākṣaraṃ padam | lomaśo vidhivaccakre jaladānādi tatkṛte ||1.524.90|| evaṃ te kathitaṃ lakṣmi lomaśātanatodbhavam | lomaśetiṛṣernāmākhyānaṃ ciraprajīvinaḥ ||91|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhagavaddhāmni samayajñānaparicayaḥ, janmagrahaṇe divyatā, naivedye’bhipūrakatā, lomaśasya prāgvṛttāntaḥ, mārkaṇḍeyādiciraṃjīvānāṃ tataḥ saurāṣṭrādauciravāsaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturviṃśatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 524 ||
<1.525> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ekadā cāgamannāmnā khyātastvaśvaśirānṛpaḥ | lomaśasyāśrame kṣetre cāśvapaṭṭasarovare || 1 || kapilastu mahātejā darśanārthaṃ samāyayau | aśvaśirāḥ kapilaṃ tamṛṣiṃ papraccha saṃśayam || 2 || mokṣaḥ syāt karmaṇā kiṃ vā jñānena nirṇayaṃ vada | śṛṇu lakṣmi kapilarṣiryamāha nirṇayaṃ śubham || 3 || pravadāmi gṛhasthānāṃ karmiṇāṃ hitakāmyayā | yatkiṃcit karma vai dehī karoti sādhvasādhu vā || 4 || sarvaṃ nārāyaṇe nyasya kurvannapi na lipyate | śṛṇu saṃyamano vipra ātreyavaṃśajo’bhavat || 5 || tapasyabhirataḥ prātaḥ snātuṃ bhāgīrathīṃ nadīm | dharmāraṇye gatastatra hariṇānāṃ gaṇaṃ sthitam || 6 || lubdho niṣṭhurako nāma vyādho dhanuḥsamanvitaḥ | jighāṃsurāyayau tīre sajyaṃ kṛtvā sasāyakam || 7 || dhanurdṛṣṭvā tu vipraḥ sa vyādhaṃ taṃ mṛgayāratam | vārayāmāsa mā bhadra jīvaghātamimaṃ kuru || 8 || śrutvā prahasya vyādhastaṃ provāca munisattamam | nāhaṃ hiṃsāmi vai jīvān nāhaṃ karomi sarvathā || 9 || paramātmā tvayaṃ bhūtaiḥ krīḍati svīyamāyayā | māyā tasya janiḥ puṣṭirnidhanaṃ ceti vai kramāt || 1.525.1 0|| bhavantyeva hi jīvānāṃ tatra naimittikā vayam | ahaṃbhāvaḥ sadā brahmanna vidheyo mumukṣubhiḥ || 11 || prāṇayātrāmātrarataṃ karoti cenna lipyate | ahaṃkārastatra yasya sa sādhutvaṃ na gacchati || 12|| ahaṃkāraṃ parityajya gṛhṇāmyekaṃ mṛgaṃ dvija | ityākarṇya sa viprendro niṣiṣedha ca lubdhakam || 13|| hiṃsanaṃ sarvathā pāpaṃ mā kurvevaṃ kadācana | santi phalāni mūlāni patrāṇi ca jalāni ca || 14 || sasyāni śākapatrāṇi nirvāhaṃ taiḥ samācara | ahiṃsane suyātrā cennirvahet hiṃsi mā vṛthā || 15|| ahaṃkāro na kartavya iti te vāci vartate | nātmani kintu vai svārthe bhavān mṛgādano yataḥ | 16|| upadeśaṃ prakurvanti sarve’bhimānavarjane | na tyajanti cābhimānaṃ vāṅmanasoḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 17|| vadanti cānyat prakurvanti cānyat pramūṣya cānyān viharanti cānyat | svārthapravīṇāśca nijārthamāpya dūrī bhavantyeva parān vināśya || 18 || vyādhaḥ prāha ṛṣe nāhaṃ kapaṭī svārthasādhakaḥ | parīkṣāṃ me kuru tvatra pratyakṣaṃ te bhavennanu ||19|| kuru loṣṭhamayaṃ jālaṃ tasyādho vahnimāvaha | atīva tatra śuṣko jvālayatāṃ kāṣṭhasañcayaḥ || 1.525.20 || tathākṛte tu vipreṇa pradhmātaścānalo hyati | gavākṣairnirgatā jvālāḥ sahasrāṇi ca jālake ||21 || lohajālaṃ tadā raktaṃ yadā vahnirivābabhau | tadā vyādho yogasiddhiṃ samālambya nijāṃ tanum ||22|| vahnirūpāṃ tu kṛtavān sūryavaddāhasaṃcayām | vahniryasya purastatra nistejasko babhūva ha ||23|| niṣasāda samutthāya jāle tatra sa lubdhakaḥ | vahnirvai vahninā naiva dahyate ca yathā tathā ||24|| lubdhako naiva dagdho hi kāṣṭhajanyena vahninā | saṃyamano brāhmaṇaśca tathānye vismayaṃ gatāḥ ||25|| prāhuḥ kastvaṃ vada cāsmān saḥ prāhāhaṃ hutāśanaḥ | svayaṃ cāsmi na me hiṃsā pacyante mayi dehinaḥ ||26|| ahaṃ buddhiṃ vihāyaiva karomi svasvabhāvavat | ahaṃkāro mama naṣṭastapasā jñānayojinā ||27|| ahaṃkāre vinaṣṭe ca karmabhirnahi lipyate | ahaṃkāro mūlamasti stambo mamatvamucyate ||28|| śākhā rāgastathā dveṣo graghro lobhaśca mohanam | patrāṇi tatra karmāṇi rasaścāsvādanaṃ sadā ||29|| puṣpaṃ pravartanākhyaṃ ca phalaṃ miṣṭaṃ sukhaṃ tathā | amiṣṭaṃ tu bhaved duḥkhaṃ bhuñjate dehinaḥ sadā ||1.525.3 0|| vahnermūle kṣipa vāri jvālā niryānti yatsthalāt | ityukto brāhmaṇastatra toyapūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ drutam ||3 1 || cikṣepa sahasā vahniḥ praśaśāma yadā tale | jvālāḥ sarvā vinaṣṭāśca mūlanāśāt samantataḥ ||32|| lubdhakastvāha taṃ vipraṃ pratyakṣaṃ vai nidarśanam | mūlanāśe samastasya vṛkṣasya nāśanaṃ bhavet ||33|| abhimānaṃ pramūlaṃ cennaṣṭaṃ karmakṛtāṃ yadi | pāpenāpi ca puṇyena lipyate na kadācana ||34|| etasmin jvalito vahnirbahuśākhaśca sattama | mūlanāśe’bhavannaṣṭastathāhaṃ karmavān sadā ||35|| ātmā dehaṃ samāśritya piṇḍadharmaṃ samāśritaḥ | kṣudhayā tṛṣayā vyāptaḥ khādan piban pravṛttimān ||36|| kurvan sarvaṃ varjayitvābhimānaṃ lepakāraṇam | antarātmani saṃyuktaḥ kurvāṇo nāvasīdati ||37|| athāha lubdhako vipraṃ spṛśa loṣṭhaṃ dvijottama | loṣṭhaṃ coṣṇaṃ dāhakāri jñātaṃ tyaktaṃ dvijena tu ||38|| tataḥ pasparśa sa vyādhastasya dāho na cābhavat | lubdhakastaṃ tadā prāha saṃskārāścābhimānajāḥ ||39|| yathā loṣṭhe vahnijanyāḥ saṃskārā dāhakā iva | yāvadbhavanti puruṣāstāvad dahyanti sarvathā ||1.525.40 || tathābhimānasaṃskārā yāvadbhavanti dehiṣu | tāvat puṇyena pāpena lipyante nātra saṃśayaḥ ||41|| abhimānaṃ ca saṃskārāstyājyāstapasyayā tathā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktyā yogena dhyānavṛttibhiḥ ||42|| sarvasamarpaṇabhaktyā lipyate nahi karmabhiḥ | evamukte tu vai vipre vyādhasyopari cāmbarāt ||43|| papāta puṣpavṛṣṭiśca viprasyopari vai manāk | tato vyādho hariṇaṃ taṃ jaghānaikaṃ tadāpi ca ||44|| vipraḥ prāha mṛgātmā ca kutra yāti pradarśaya | vyādhaḥ saṃkalpayāmāsa vimānaṃ svargalokajam ||45|| tāvad divyavimānāni kāmagāni mahānti ca | bahuratnāni mukhyāni dadarśa brāhmaṇottamaḥ |||46||| teṣu niṣṭhurakaṃ lubdhaṃ sarveṣu samavasthitam | dadarśa brāhmaṇastatra kāmarūpiṇamuttamam ||47|| advaitabhāvanāsiddhaṃ yogādbahuśarīrakam | mṛgaṃ divyasvarūpaṃ ca devātmakaṃ vilokya ca ||48|| dṛṣṭvā vipro mudā yuktaḥ saṃyamano babhūva ha | anye cāpyabhavam̐statra dehāhaṃkāravarjitāḥ ||49|| evaṃ jñātaṃ bhavet karma kurvato’pi svajātikam | nirbandhaṃ tat pāpapuṇyavilepena vivarjitam ||1.525.50|| tādṛśaṃ naiva cātmānaṃ karoti bandhanaṃ kvacit | yathā nārāyaṇo devo nirlepo vastumātrakam ||51 || kurvan gṛhṇan kārayam̐śca grāhayan lepavarjitaḥ | pratyuta svapadaṃ prāptaṃ nirguṇaṃ prakaroti tat ||52|| tathātmā māyayā hīno na karoti na lipyate | prāptaṃ bhuktaṃ jaḍaṃ vastu karoti divyameva tat ||53|| nirliptaṃ bandhanahīnaṃ muktisthaṃ tat karoti vai | jñātvā saṃyamano vipraḥ prayayau nijamāśramam ||54|| kapilaścāśvaśirasaṃ nṛpaṃ prāha tathā punaḥ | tasmāt tvamapi rājendra devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||55|| ātmanyeva svadehe tu paśya tvārādhayanprabhum | nirlipto bhavitā śīghraṃ yathā vyādho’bhavatpurā ||56|| kapilasya vacaḥ śrutvā sa rājāśvaśirāḥ śubhaḥ | mene ca karmiṇāṃ muktiṃ kṛṣṇārpitena karmaṇā ||57|| atha tatrāgamat tāvajjaigīṣavyo mahāmuniḥ | pañcāśatkalpakāyuśca lomaśasyāśrame śubhe ||58|| ṛṣayaste tadā cakruḥ svāgataṃ ca parasparam | cakruḥ svargādilokānāṃ saṃbhāṣāṃ kṣemakāriṇīm |||59|| aśvaśirā praṇamyaiva kapilaṃ saṃsthiteṣu ca | sarveṣu ṛṣiṣu madhye saṃpapraccha praṇamya tam ||1.525.6 0 || kathamārādhaye devaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ param | kapilaḥ prāha vai rājan nārāyaṇā hyanantakāḥ ||61 || bhavanti śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇopāsanayātra vai | ka eṣaḥ procyate rājaṃstvayā nārāyaṇo guruḥ ||62|| āvāṃ nārāyaṇau dvau tu tvatpratyakṣagatau nṛpa | aśvaśirāstadākarṇya samuvāca dvijau ca tau ||63|| jaigīṣavyaḥ kapilaśca śrutau mayā purā śubhau | bhavantau brāhmaṇau siddhau tapasā dagdhakilbiṣau ||64|| kathaṃ nārāyaṇāvāvāmiti me vadatho vacaḥ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhanuḥsvastikaketubhiḥ ||65|| yuktaḥ pītāmbaro lakṣmīpatirgaruḍavāhanaḥ | nārāyaṇaḥ parabrahma kastasya sadṛśo bhuvi ||66|| itirājño vacaḥ śrutvā tau viprau siddhayoginau | jahasatuḥ paśya nārāyaṇaṃ ceti jajalpatuḥ ||67|| evamuktvā sa kapilaḥ svayaṃ viṣṇurbabhūva ha | jaigīṣavyaśca garuḍastatkṣaṇaṃ samajāyata ||68|| rājā tvāścaryamāpanno dṛṣṭvā sagaruḍaṃ harim | natvāha śāmyatāṃ viprau nemaṃ pṛcchāmi nrāyaṇam ||69|| kintu brahmā yato jāto nābhipaṃkajamadhyagaḥ | tamenaṃ brahmapitaraṃ nrāyaṇaṃ saṃvadāmyaham ||1.525.70|| śrutvā ca kapilastatra padmanābho babhūva ha | jaigīṣavyo’bhavad brahmā nābhipadmopari sthitaḥ ||71 || brahmaṇastu lalāṭādvai rudro’bhūd raktanetrakaḥ | rājā tavā vicāryaiva punaḥ prāha ca tau dvijau ||72|| nekṣyo bhavati sarvātmā sarvavyāpī narāyaṇaḥ | bhavadbhyāṃ darśitā māyā yogibhyāṃ yogasiddhijā ||73|| nārāyaṇastu bhagavān nekṣyaḥ sarvātmakaḥ prabhuḥ | tatastatra kapilena jaigīṣavyena vai tadā ||74|| sarvātmakāni rūpāṇi darśitāni nijātmanoḥ | matkuṇā maśakā yūkā bhramarā bhoginaḥ khagāḥ ||75|| aśvā gāvo dvipāḥ siṃhā vyāghrā gomāyavo mṛgāḥ | anye’pi paśavaḥ kīṭā grāmyā āraṇyakāstathā ||76|| paśavo mānavā vṛkṣā vallikādyāśca sarvaśaḥ | taddṛṣṭvā bhūtasaṃghātaṃ sa rājā vismayaṃ gataḥ ||77|| viveda jaigīṣavyasya māhātmyaṃ kapilasya ca | papraccha tāvṛṣī bhaktyā kimidaṃ dvijasattamau ||78|| tau dvijābūcaturbhūpa tvayā pṛṣṭhaṃ ca kiṃ smara | kathamārādhaye devaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ param ||79|| ārādhanāya pratyakṣo harirvai te pradarśitaḥ | kapilo’haṃ ca pratyakṣo bhavāmyatra narāyaṇaḥ ||1.525.80 || bhaja māṃ yadi te śraddhā pratyakṣaṃ prāptameva ha | sarvajñasya guṇāḥ sarve mayi santi tadaṃśataḥ ||81 || tasmāllabdhā mayā sarve bhaktyā tava pradarśitaḥ | sa tu nārāyaṇo devaḥ sarvajñaḥ kāmarūpavān ||82|| padmanābhādapi dūraṃ mahāviṣṇoḥ pare’sti ca | golokāccāpi vaikuṇṭhātpare cākṣaradhāmani ||83|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mukteṣu rājate | saumyaḥ kvāpi svecchayātra prāpyate mānavaiḥ kila ||84|| lomaśo’yaṃ prāptavām̐staṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaṃ param | atrāśvapaṭṭasarasaḥ kṣetre śrīkṛṣṇavallabham ||85|| sarveṣāmavatārāṇāmavatāriṇamacyutam | āvāṃ tasya darśanārthamāgatau svaḥ śubhāśrame ||86|| sa vai sarvaśarīrasthaḥ paramātmā jagatpatiḥ | svadehe vartate cāpi dṛśyate nijabhaktitaḥ ||87|| ato’rthaṃ darśitaṃ rūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇannārāyaṇasya ca | āvayostava rājendra pratītiḥ syādyathā tava ||88|| evaṃ sarvagato devastava dehe’pi vartate | sarvaprajāsu bhṛtyeṣu mantriṣvapi sthitaḥ sa hi ||89|| paśavaḥ kīṭasaṃghādyāḥ sarve viṣṇumayā nṛpa | bhāvanāṃ tu dṛḍhāṃ kuryād yadvai sarvamayo hariḥ ||1.525.90 || nānyat tatsadṛśaṃ bhūtaṃ sarvabhūteṣvavasthitaḥ | tamāntarasthaṃ vai devamitibhāvena sevatām ||91 || eṣa te darśitaścārādhanāmārgo’timokṣadaḥ | paripūrṇena bhāvenārcaya kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||92|| pūjopahārairdhūpādyairnaivedyārārtrikādibhiḥ | dhyānena dāsabhaktyā ca suprāpyaḥ sa pareśvaraḥ ||93|| yo’sau nārāyaṇo devaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ | tattadrūpeṇa bahudhā vartate kāryakṛt prabhuḥ ||94|| matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaśca narasiṃhaśca vāmanaḥ | rāmo rāmaśca kṛṣṇaśca buddhaḥ kalkī tathāpare ||95|| ityetāḥ kathitāstasya mūrtayaḥ kapilādayaḥ | sādhavaścāpi siddhāśca sādhvyaḥ satyaśca yoginaḥ ||96|| darśanaṃ prāptumicchūnāṃ sopānāni bhavanti vai | yattasya parama rūpaṃ tanna paśyanti devatāḥ ||97|| asmadādisvarūpeṇa pūrayatyeva bhāvanām | tasmād vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagannārāyaṇena hi ||98|| bhaja taṃ ca priye yathābhimate sthitamacyutam | bṛhaspatiḥ purā raibhyaṃ brahmaputraṃ jagāda ha ||99|| vasusaṃjñaṃ tu rājānaṃ cākṣuṣe tvāntare manoḥ | raibhya śṛṇu vaso rājan samākarṇaya cādarāt || 1.525.10 0|| yatkiñcit kurute karma puruṣaḥ sādhvasādhu vā | sarvaṃ nārāyaṇe nyasya kurvannapi na lipyate || 101 || sa ca nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān sarvaprāṇiṣvavasthitaḥ | bhaja taṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cāntaragaṃ prabhum || 1 02|| tatastau śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ saṃbhejatuḥ sadā | muktiṃ yātau pare dhāmni dāsyātmikāṃ ca śāśvatīm ||1 03|| ityetat kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kapilasya vaco’rthadam | rājā cāśvaśirāḥ putraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ sthūlaśirāhvayam || 1 04|| abhiṣicya nije rājye natvā gurūn punaḥ punaḥ | naimiṣākhyaṃ vanaṃ dūraṃ yayau tatra hariṃ prabhum || 105|| tapasārādhayāmāsa pratyakṣo’bhūddhariḥ svayam | vimānena nijaṃ bhaktaṃ nināyākṣaradhāma saḥ ||1 06|| ityetat kathitaṃ sarvamaśvaśiraḥpramokṣaṇam | karmaṇā cārpiteneśeśvare jñānānvitena vai || 107 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kapilena aśvaśirase rājñe jñānadāne saṃyamanadvijaniṣṭhurakavyādhanidarśanena karmaṇā sarvasamarpaṇātmakena mokṣaḥ pradarśitaḥ, kapilasya jaigīṣavyasya cānekavibhūtirūpatvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||525||
<1.526> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi vasoḥ pūrvavṛttāntaṃ cābhavadyathā | kathayāmi camatkāraṃ raibhyasyāpi tataḥ param || 1 || vasurāsīnmahābhaktaḥ kāśmīranṛpatiḥ svayam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya śaraṇāgataḥ || 2 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya svāmine namaḥ | itimantraṃ prajagrāha vārdhakye tu narāyaṇāt || 3 || bādarīṃ sa samāyāti pratisaṃvatsaraṃ nṛpaḥ | nārāyaṇasya sevārthaṃ darśanārthaṃ ca bhāvataḥ || 4 || kaṇṭhe ca tulasīmālāṃ sadā rakṣati śobhanām | kare’pi japanārthaṃ sarvadā rakṣati mālikām || 5 || jānan kṣaṇasthitiṃ svasya saṃsārasyāpi tādṛśīm | saṃsāre nirmitāḥ sarve saṃghātāḥ śokabhīpradāḥ || 6 || vāyuśca bhūmirākāśo jalaṃ tejaśca paṃkajam | śarīraṃ pañcabhūtaiśca nirmitaṃ sarvadehinām || 7 || mithyābhramaḥ kṛtrimaśca svapnavanmāyayānvitaḥ | ko vā kasya sutastatra kā strī kasya patistathā || 8 || karmabhirnirmitaṃ sarvaṃ karmabandhanajaṃ tvidam | sukha duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ dehayoge pragacchati || 9 || mānuṣe ca paśau deve druṣu kīṭeṣu jantuṣu | pakṣiṣvapi tṛṇe cāpi janma yāti svakarmabhiḥ || 1.526.1 0|| punaḥ punarbhramatyeva yāvatkarmalayo na vai | satyaṃ tretā dvāparaśca kaliśceti caturyugam || 11 || nimeṣasya caturbhāgastruṭiḥ syāt taddvayaṃ lavaḥ | lavadvayaṃ yavaḥ proktaḥ kāṣṭhā taddaśapaṃcabhiḥ || 12|| triṃśatkāṣṭhāḥ kalāḥ proktā kṣaṇastriṃśatkalo mataḥ | kṣaṇaiḥ ṣaṣṭyā palaṃ proktaṃ ṣaṣṭyā teṣāṃ ca nāḍikā || 1 3|| nāḍīdvayaṃ muhūrtaṃ triṃśanmuhūrtaṃ divāniśam | māsastriṃśadahorātrairdvau māsau tu ṛturmataḥ || 14|| ṛtutrayaṃ syādayanamayane dve tu vatsaram | anenaiva tu mānena mānavānāṃ kṛte’tra vai || 15|| lakṣaiḥ saptadaśākhyaiśca saurābdaiśca tathā paraiḥ | aṣṭāviṃśatisāhasrairniścitaṃ vai kṛtaṃ yugam || 16|| aṣṭaśatādhikyayuktacatuḥsāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ | ṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatakairguṇitāste kṛte matāḥ || 17|| tatra vai jāyate śuklavarṇo hi bhagavān svayam | lokāḥ pāpavinirmuktāḥ kṣāntā dāntā jitendriyāḥ || 18|| dīrghāyuṣastapomagnaḥ kāmakrodhādivarjitāḥ | na putrasaṃbhavo mṛtyurvīkṣyate janakaiḥ kvacit || 1 9|| tatastretāyugaṃ syācca lakṣairdvādaśabhistathā | ṣaṇṇavatisāhasraiḥ saurābdairniścitaṃ suraiḥ ||1.526.20|| ṣaṭśatādhikyayuktatrisāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ khalu | ṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatakairguṇitāste trike yuge ||21 || pāpenaikena pādena raudraṃ dharmaṃ tadā viśet | tato raktatvamabhyeti śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||22|| pāpāṃśena mitho lokaḥ saṃsparddhī jāyate tadā | svargārthaṃ dānayajñāśca kurvanti yāni vai divam ||23|| kecitsvalpāyuṣastatra jāyante spardhayāpi ca | janake vidyamāne tu putrāṇāṃ maraṇaṃ na vai ||24|| kāmakrodhādayastatra bhavanti na bhavanti ca | ekavāraṃ tadā kṛṣyā vāpitaṃ kṣetramuttamam ||25|| saptavārān pragṛhṇanti vaiśyāḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ | sarvā ghaṭastavā gāvo mahiṣyaśca caturguṇāḥ ||26|| śāpānugrahakṛtyeṣu samarthā mānavāstadā | na cauro jo rū śca sarve dharmaratā janāḥ ||27|| tatastṛtīyayugako dvāparo vidyate kramāt | dvau pādau tatra pāpasya dvau ca dharmasya saṃsthitau ||28|| taccāṣṭalakṣamānena saurābdānāṃ prakīrtitam | catuḥṣaṣṭibhiranyaiśca sahasraiśca yugaṃ tadā ||29|| catuḥśatādhikadvisāhasraprasaṃkhyakāḥ khalu | ṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatakairguṇitāste dvike yuge ||1.526.3 0|| kāmaḥ krodho mado lobho dambho matsara eva ca | ṣaḍete tatra jāyante īrṣyā cāpi tu saptamī ||3 1 || atha tairanvitāḥ sarve viruddhā vai parasparam | ke’pi śāntāśca dāntāśca jitendriyā bhavanti hi ||32|| tataḥ kaliyugaṃ proktaṃ sarvadoṣāśrayaṃ tadā | ekapādo vṛṣo yatra pāpaṃ pādaistribhiḥ sthitam ||33|| śvetaḥ satye raktavarṇaṃstretāyāṃ bhagavānapi | nīlaśca dvāpare kṛṣṇo’livad vai jāyate kalau ||34|| pramāṇaṃ tu kalerdiṣṭaṃ lakṣāścatvāra eva ca | dvātriṃśacca sahasrāṇi saurābdāni bhavanti hi ||35|| dviśatādhikaikasāhasrātmaprasaṃkhyakāḥ khalu | ṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatakairguṇitāste kalau matāḥ ||36|| ekadvitrīṇi catvāri sahasrāṇi daśa kramāt | kalidvītatrītasatyayugābdāni bhavanti hi ||37|| mānavāni dvicatuḥṣaḍaṣṭaśatānyanukramāt | bhavantyabdāni sāhasre dve, militvā tu tānyatha ||38|| dvādaśābdasahasrāṇi mānavānāṃ caturyugam | bodhyaṃ saurāṇi tricatvāriṃśallakṣāṇi cāpyatha ||39|| viṃśatisāhasrasaṃkhyādhikānyeva caturyugam | yugakṣayakṛtaścāyuḥkṣayaḥ sṛṣṭau mato’pi hi ||1.526.40|| yasya cāsti gṛhe vittaṃ tathā nāryo manoramāḥ | tairnaraistu samaṃ maitrīṃ kalau kurvanti mānavāḥ ||41 || svārthamātraparāḥ putrā bhūṣāsvārthaparāḥ priyāḥ | snuṣā vetti ca vittena yadi śvaśrūḥ kṣayaṃ vrajet ||42|| mama syād gṛhamaiśvarye sarve vāñchanti tattathā | alpodakāstadā meghā alpasasyā ca medinī ||43|| dhūrtā viḍambakāḥ santo guravaśca kalau yuge | alpakṣīrāstadā gāvaḥ kṣīre sarpirna vidyate ||44|| sarvabhakṣāstadā viprā nṛpā niṣkaruṇāstadā | cauryakāryaparāḥ sarve pṛthivī gatayauvanā ||||45|| atikrāntaśubhāḥ kālāḥ paryupasthitadāruṇāḥ | varṣe catuṣṭaye kanyā garbhavatī bhaviṣyati ||46|| pañcadaśanyūnavarṣe mṛtyureva bhaviṣyati | bhaviṣyanti kalau cānte janā vitastimātrakāḥ ||47|| daśavarṣāyuṣaścānte gṛhaṃ bilaṃ bhuvo’ntare | prāvaraṇaṃ tadā vai syād guptavastraṃ hi kevalam ||48|| ekavarṇā bhaviṣyanti varṇāḥ sarve mitho’nvitāḥ | mlecchībhūtā durācārā dharmakarmavivarjitāḥ ||49|| caturyugānāṃ saptatiṃ tvekādhikāṃ manustathā | mahendraśca prabhuṃkte vai dīrghamāyuḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||1.526.50|| manoḥ samaṃ mahendreṇa paramāyuḥ prakīrtitam | caturdaśendravicchittau brahmaṇo dinamucyate ||51 || evaṃ parimitā rātrirdivārātraṃ hi kalpakaḥ | brahmaṇastu varṣaśataṃ paramāyurvinirmitam ||52|| saurasāvanacandrarkṣairmānairebhiścaturvidhaiḥ | kālo niryāti sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ kṣitimaṇḍale ||53|| pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikaiścāpi dinānāṃ ca śataistribhiḥ | bhavenmānavavarṣaṃ tat pañconaistaiśca sāvanam ||54|| cāndramekādaśonaṃ tu triṃśaddhīnaṃ tu ṛkṣajam | śītātapau tathā vṛṣṭirmānavābdena jāyate ||55|| agniṣṭomādayo yajñā vivāhā utsavādayaḥ | sāvanena bhavantyeva sarvavarṇeṣu vai kṣitau ||56|| kusīdādyā vyavahārā utpannāni ca yānyapi | adhimāsaprayuktena cāndreṇaiva bhavanti hi ||57|| nakṣatreṇa tu mānena bhidyante cābhitārakāḥ | evaṃ devā mānavāśca daityāstvanye sadā kṣitau ||58|| pravartante ca jāyante mriyante cedṛśaṃ jagat | tatra māyābandhanenāvṛtaḥ pāraṃ na yāti vai ||59|| tasmānmayā sadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ | bhajanīyaḥ pūjanīyo dhyātavyaśca nirantaram ||1.526.6 0|| kālo bhakṣayati sarvān kṣaṇe varṣe yuge tathā | māṃ śikhāyāṃ dattahastaḥ kālo grasitumicchati ||61 || ityevaṃ bodhayuktaḥ sa rājā bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ | vasurdharmānumatyā ca svarājyaṃ pratyapālayat ||62|| ayajad bahubhiryajñairmahadbhirbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ | karmārpaṇena deveśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ||63|| toṣayāmāsa bahubhirdāsyabhāvaiśca vartayan | tataḥ kālena mahatā vasurvairāgyayogataḥ ||64|| nivṛttarājyabhogecchādvandvasyāntamupeyivān | nijaputraṃ vivasvantaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhrātṛśatasya ca ||65|| abhiṣicya nije rājye puṣkaraṃ samupāyayau | yatra śrīpuṇḍarīkākṣannārāyaṇaḥ saṃvirājate ||66|| vasuḥ kāśmīrabhūpaḥ sa tapobhirugrasādhitaiḥ | bhaktyā smaran hariṃ tatra divyadehaṃ dadarśa tam ||67|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ prabhum | tuṣṭāva taṃ namaste’stu puṇḍarīkākṣa te namaḥ ||68|| viśvamūrte sarvatejonivāsa kṛṣṇa te namaḥ | śaraṇyaṃ rakṣakaṃ viṣṇuṃ jiṣṇuṃ vyomanivāsinam ||69|| gopālakṛṣṇabālaṃ tvāṃ namasye cakrapāṇinam | nānyat kiñcitprapaśyāmi vyatiriktaṃ tvayācyuta||1.526.70|| evaṃ tu vadatastasya mūrtimān puruṣaḥ kila | nirgatya dehānnīlābho ghanacaṇḍo bhayaṃkaraḥ ||71 || raktākṣo hrasvakāyaścovāca rājan karomi kim | vasuḥ papraccha taṃ pāparūpaṃ ko’si vadātra me ||72|| pāparūpaḥ sa vai prāha tava pāpaṃ bhavāmyaham | na cāsmi kevalaṃ pāpaṃ pāpapreto’smi te’nagha ||73 || śṛṇu pūrvaṃ kalau rājam̐stvaṃ rājā dakṣiṇāpathe | janasthāne kadācittvaṃ mṛgayārthamupāgataḥ ||74|| tatra tvayā tu daṇḍena mṛgaveṣadharo muniḥ | prasravaṇe girau santāḍito mṛtaḥ sa satvaram ||75|| hariṇaṃ taṃ hataṃ matvā yāvad grahītumicchasi | tāvanmṛgavapurvipro vīkṣito hi narastvayā ||76 || tvaṃ cātibhayamāpanno hatyayā mānavasya vai | hatyāhaṃ tu mahāghorā pretabrāhmaṇanāśajā ||77|| ahaṃ brahmagraho rājan śarīre nyavasaṃ tava | adyāvadhiṃ pīḍayituṃ khādituṃ tava varṣma ca ||78|| rājyabhogā mayā dṛṣṭā bhuktā dehe ca te nṛpa | raktaṃ pītaṃ khāditaṃ ca māṃsaṃ te nūtanaṃ sadā ||79|| tvaṃ ca rājyaprabhāveṇa kṛśo naiva vilokyase | bahubhojanapānādismṛddhimattvānnṛpottama ||1.526.80|| atha tvayā tatpāpasya prāyaścittaṃ vicintitam | śrīharerdvādaśī śuddhā tvayā rājannupoṣitā ||81 || vratānyanyāni ca nārāyaṇo me prīyatāmiti | kṛtāni ca tathā dānaṃ gavāṃ dattaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||82|| tatastvaṃ dakṣiṇāpathe svagṛhe kukṣiśūlataḥ | rugṇo mṛtastava patnī nāmnā nārāyaṇī satī ||83|| dadau jalaṃ tavāsye ca śrīviṣṇoścaraṇāmṛtam | kintu tvayā tadā patnī smṛtā dhyātā mṛtikṣaṇe ||84|| tena tvaṃ kalpamekaṃ ca jāto viṣṇupure punaḥ | kumāro vāsanāyukto mokṣādvai vañcito yataḥ ||841|| ahaṃ tatra tvayā sārdhaṃ tava dehastha eva tu | saṃsthitaḥ kalpaparyantaṃ sadbhogān bubhuje tvayi ||86|| tatra kalpe tvayā svargaṃ bahudhā bhuktameva ca | svargasya ca tvayi rājan sthito’haṃ svena tejasā ||87|| punā rājasvarūpe ca sthito’haṃ bahuvatsarān | tato’haḥkalpanivṛttau rātrikalpe gate’pi ca ||88|| idānīmādisṛṣṭau ca satye yuge narādhipa | saṃbhūtastvaṃ mahārāja rājñaḥ sumanaso gṛhe ||89|| kāśmīradeśādhipaterahaṃ tvaṅgaruheṣu te | nivāsāmyadyaparyantaṃ bhuñjāno nūtanaṃ navam ||1.526.90 || yajñairiṣṭa tveyānekairbahubhiścāptadakṣiṇaiḥ | na cāhaṃ tairapahato viṣṇusmaraṇavarjitaiḥ ||91|| idānīṃ ca viśālāyāṃ tvayā bhaktiḥ kṛtā hareḥ | stotraṃ prahvaṇabhāvena kṛtaṃ sarvātmanātra ca ||92|| bhaktestava prabhāveṇa puṇḍarīkākṣaśārṅgiṇaḥ | sarvātmanārpaṇenāpi prasādito hariḥ svayam ||93|| kiṃkarān preṣayāmāsa viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | paśya tvetān mahāvyomni vimāneṣvabhyavasthitān ||94|| tadetairviṣṇupuruṣairmūśalaiḥ prahato’smyaham | kṣayaṃ yātaścyutaścāsmi romakūpebhya eva te ||95|| tava bhaktiprabhāveṇa vihāyāṅgaruhāṇyaham | ekībhūtaḥ punarjāto vyādharūpī tavāntike ||96|| ahaṃ bhagavataḥ stotraṃ śrutvā bhaktyā ca te nṛpa | viṣṇupārṣadadaṇḍasya sparśenāpi mahāghataḥ ||97|| mukto’smi pretabhāvācca dharmabuddhiśca me’sti ca | tato rājannijamitraṃ tvadāśritaṃ nirāśrayam ||98|| bhaktaṃ māṃ dehi sukhadaṃ varadānaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru | evaṃ śrutvā vasurvyādhāyāpi dadau varaṃ śubham ||99|| śṛṇu vyādha tvayā smārito’smi janmāntaraṃ mama | tatastvaṃ madvareṇāto dharmavyādho bhaviṣyasi || 1.526.1 00|| evamuktvā tu bhūpaḥ sa vimānavaramāsthitaḥ | pareṇa śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇenākṣaradhāma vai ||1 0 1|| yayau pārṣadayuktaḥ sa pārṣado’bhūddharestataḥ | athāyaṃ dharmakarmā ca dharmavyādho babhūva ha ||1 02|| ityetat kathitaṃ lakṣmi vasoścaritamuttamam | yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyāccāsya tīrthasnānaphalaṃ bhavet ||1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kāśmīranṛpasya vasoḥ prāgjanma mṛgarūpa brahmahatyāyā bhaktibalena niḥsṛtāyā dharmavyādhajanmatā, vasostato muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍviśatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||526||
<1.527> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu raibhyasya caritaṃ lakṣmi dehapramokṣadam | raibhyaḥ svayaṃ jagāmātha gayāṃ puṇyāṃ tapodhanaḥ || 1 || tatra pitṝn parabhaktyā piṇḍadānena tarpayan | tatāpa sumahat tīvraṃ tapaḥ paramaduścaram || 2 || caratastasya tattīvraṃ tapo raibhyasya dhīmataḥ | ājagāma mahāyogī vimānastho’tidīptimān || 3 || trasareṇusame śuddhe vimāne sūryasannibhe | paramāṇupramāṇena puruṣastatra dīptimān || 4 || so’bravīd raibhya kiṃ kāryaṃ tapaścarasi suvrata | evamuktvā divo bhūmerantarāsa ca vai pumān || 5 || tāvad vai rodasīvyāptaṃ vimānaṃ samajāyata | yatrānantāśca ṛṣayo dṛṣṭā aindreṇa dhīmatā || 6 || viṣṇulokamabhivyāptaṃ vimānaṃ sa dadarśa ha | tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo raibhyaḥ praṇayapūrvakam || 7 || papraccha taṃ mahāyogin ko bhavān prabravītu me | puruṣaḥ pañcavarṣāyurbālo raibhyamuvāca ha || 8 || ahaṃ rudrādavarajo brahmaṇo mānasaḥ sutaḥ | nāmnā sanatkumāro’smi janaloke vasāmyaham || 9 || bhavataḥ pitṛtṛptyādikarmabhistṛpta eva te | dhanyavādapradānārthamāgato’smi tavāntikam || 1.527.1 0|| dhanyo’si sarvadā vatsa brahmaṇaḥ kulavardhanaḥ | vedānāśritya ca pitṝn prīṇāsi sarvadānagha || 11 || mantravratajapyahomairgayāyāṃ piṇḍadānakaiḥ | pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidāḥ putrāstadanye sūtakā yataḥ || 12|| śṛṇu raibhya viśālākhyo nṛpo babhūva vai purā | putrārthaṃ ca dvijān śreṣṭhān papraccha matimān hi saḥ || 13 || viprāḥ prāhurgayāṃ gatvā pitṝn tarpaya bhāvataḥ | annadānairjalaiḥ piṇḍairgodānaiścānyadānakaiḥ || 14|| dhruvaṃ sutaste bhavitā sukhadātā kṣitīśvaraḥ | viśālanagareśaḥ sa viśālaḥ prayayau tataḥ || 15 || gayāṃ maghāsu pitṝṇāṃ kṛtavān piṇḍadānakam | tāvad viyati puruṣāstrayastatra samāgatāḥ || 16 || dṛṣṭvā sitaṃ ca raktaṃ ca kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ tṛtīyakam | nanāma tān samuvāca gṛhṇantvimān supiṇḍakān || 17|| upekṣyate bhavadbhiḥ kiṃ śaṃśantu me kutūhalam | tatasteṣu sitaḥ prāha putra te janako’smyaham || 18|| nāmnā vṛttena ca śvetaḥ karmaṇāpi kulena ca | ayaṃ tu me pitā rakto nṛśaṃsakṛcca viprahā || 1 9|| tasya pitā kṛṣṇavarṇo nāmnā vṛttyā ca karmabhiḥ | kṛṣṇavarṇena ṛṣayo bahavastu purā hatāḥ ||1.527.20|| etau mṛtāvavīcyākhyaṃ prapannau narakaṃ ciram | ahaṃ puṇyaiḥ samāpannaḥ śakrāsanaṃ sudurlabham ||21 || tvayā mantrairgayāyāṃ saṃdattāḥ piṇḍā vidhānataḥ | tenaitau narakāt samākṛṣyānītau suyojitau ||22|| pitṝn pitāmahām̐ścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahān | prīṇayāmīti tattoyaṃ tvayā dattaṃ suputraka ||23|| tenāsmadyugapadyogo jāto’tra tava sannidhau | gṛhṇīmaḥ piṇḍadānaṃ ca jalaṃ tṛptāḥ sma sarvathā ||24|| tīrthaprabhāvād gacchāmi pitṛlokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | atra piṇḍapradānena hyetau tava pitāmahau ||25|| durgatāvapi saṃśuddhau puṇyavantau babhūvatuḥ | tīrthaprabhāva eṣo’sti brahmaghnasyāpi tatsutaḥ ||26|| pituḥ piṇḍapradānena kuryāduddharaṇaṃ punaḥ | etasmāt kāraṇād rājan sito’haṃ janakastava ||27|| kiñcidadhikaṃ te vacmi yena mokṣo bhaveddhi naḥ | śṛṇu sāṃsārikaṃ jñānaṃ yena yāsyasi mokṣaṇam ||28|| nityaṃ ca prātarutthāya rātrivastraṃ vihāya ca | abhīṣṭadevaṃ hṛtpadme brahmarandhre guruṃ tathā ||29|| vicintya manasā prātaḥkṛtyaṃ sarvaṃ samācara | snāne śauce kriyāyāṃ ca hariṃ smara muhurmuhuḥ ||1.527.30|| dhautavastre nidhāyaiva parameśaṃ prapūjaya | śālagrāme maṇau yantre pratimāyāṃ jale’pi ca ||3 1|| saṃpūjaya gavi vipre guruṣveva viśeṣataḥ | ghaṭe’ṣṭadalapadme ca pātre candanacarcite ||32|| śālagrāme ca manasi pūjaya śrīpatiṃ sati | dehi ṣoḍaśadravyāṇi bhajanaṃ ca muhuḥ kuru ||33|| lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ durgāṃ rādhāṃ gaṃgāṃ ca tulasīm | nārāyaṇaṃ hyajaṃ śaṃbhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vināyakaṃ gurum ||34|| prapūjaya sadā prītyātithiṃ sūryaṃ hutāśanam | pitarau brāhmaṇaṃ sādhuṃ sūryaṃ pūjaya bhāvataḥ ||35|| adṛśyām̐ste kathayāmi darśanīyā na te kvacit | viṣṭhāṃ na paśyet satprājño vyādhibījasvarūpiṇīm ||36|| mūtraṃ ca vyādhibījaṃ ca tathā narakakāraṇam | liṅgaṃ yoniṃ
