pāpaduḥkhavyādhidāridryadāyinīm ||37|| nāryaṃgaṃ yad vināśasya kāraṇaṃ nāvalokayet | atibhogān varjayecca rogāṇāṃ kāraṇāni yat ||38|| astakāle raviṃ candraṃ na paśyed vyādhikāraṇam | khaṇḍaṃ samuditaṃ candraṃ na vīkṣetādhikāraṇam ||39|| jalasthaṃ ca raviṃ candraṃ dṛṣṭvā śokaṃ vrajennaraḥ | ekasya śayanasthānaṃ bhojanaṃ ca gatiṃ tathā ||1.527.40|| na kuryāt pāpinā sārdhaṃ sarvaṃ nāśasya kāraṇam | ālāpād gātrasaṃsparśācchayanāśrayabhojanāt ||41|| sañcaranti dhruvaṃ vyaktau pāpānyanyakṛtānyapi | hiṃsrajantusamīpaṃ ca na gacched duḥkhakāraṇam ||42|| khalena sārdhaṃ milanaṃ na kuryācchokakāraṇam | brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ cāpi vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāṃ tathā ||43|| na kuryāddhiṃsanaṃ hāniṃ sarvanāśasya kāraṇam | devadevalaviprāṇāṃ satīnāṃ ca satāmapi ||44|| vittaṃ vastu dhanaṃ naiva harennāśasya kāraṇam | dakṣiṇāṃ tu drutaṃ dadyādanyathā nāśakāraṇī ||45|| jīvānāṃ hiṃsanaṃ kṛtvā vaṃśahānirbhaveddhruvam | devaṃ guruṃ na named yaḥ pāpabhāṅ narakaṃ vrajet ||46|| yā strī mūḍhā durācārā svapatiṃ harirūpiṇam | na paśyettarjanaṃ kṛtvā kuṃbhīpāke patettu sā ||47|| vāktarjanād bhavet kāko hiṃsanāt sūkaro bhavet | sarpo bhavati kopena darpeṇa gardabho bhavet ||48|| kukkurī ca kuvākyenāpyandhā ca viṣadarśanāt | pativratā tu vaikuṇṭhe patyā saha vrajed dhruvam ||49|| śivaṃ durgāṃ gaṇapatiṃ sūryaṃ vipraṃ ca vaiṣṇavam | pitaraṃ mātaraṃ putraṃ satīṃ bhāryāṃ guruṃ patim ||1.527.50|| anāthāṃ bhaginīṃ kanyāṃ vinindya narakaṃ vrajet | śālagrāmajalaṃ kṛṣṇaprasādaṃ ye tu bhuṃjate ||51|| tīrthaṃ punanti te santaḥ śataṃ puṃsāṃ vasundharām | viṣṇuprasādabhojī tu labhate’śvakratoḥ phalam ||52|| pradīptaṃ śivaliṃgaṃ ca śālagrāmaṃ maṇiṃ tathā | pratimāṃ yajñasūtraṃ ca suvarṇaṃ śaṃkhamityapi ||53|| hīrakaṃ ca tathā muktāṃ gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ ghṛtam | śālagrāmaśilātoyaṃ bhūmau tyaktvā vrajedadhaḥ ||54|| daridraḥ kṛpaṇaḥ kuṣṭhī vaṃśahīno’pyabhāryakaḥ | bhūmihīnaḥ prajāhīno bandhuhīnaśca kutsitaḥ ||55|| andhaḥ paṃgurvā kharvaśca khañjaścāpyaṃgahīnakaḥ | bhavet krameṇa pāpātmā hyetān bhūmau tyajettu yaḥ ||56|| mṛdbhasmagośakṛtpiṇḍaistathā vai vālukādibhiḥ | kṛtvā liṃgaṃ sakṛtpūjya vaset kalpaśataṃ divi ||57|| yeṣāṃ ca darśane puṇyaṃ kathayāmi niśāmaya | subrāhmaṇānāṃ tīrthānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāṃ tathā ||58|| devatānāṃ tathā pitroḥ patyurdarśanamuttamam | sūryasya ca satīnāṃ ca yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām ||59|| sanyāsināṃ gavāṃ vahnergurorgajasya vājinaḥ | siṃhasya kokilasyāpi khañjanasya śukasya ca ||1.527.6 0|| haṃsānāṃ ca mayūrāṇāṃ cāṣāṇāṃ śaṃkhapakṣiṇām | vatsaprayuktadhenūnāmaśvatthānāṃ maṇestathā ||6 1|| patiputravatīnāṃ ca janānāṃ tīrthayāyinām | pradīpānāṃ suvarṇasya muktānāṃ hīrakasya ca ||62|| māṇikyānāṃ tulasyāśca śvetapuṣpasya darśanam | pāpanāśakaraṃ puṇyaṃ maṃgalasya pradaṃ matam ||63|| phalāni śukladhānyāni ghṛtaṃ dadhi madhūni ca | pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ ca lājām̐śca śarkarāṃ darpaṇaṃ jalam ||64|| mālāṃ ca śuklapuṣpāṇāṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇyaṃ vrajejjanaḥ | gorocanaṃ ca karpūraṃ rajataṃ ca sarovaram ||65|| puṣpodyānaṃ puṣpitāṃ ca śukle candramasaṃ navam | pīyūṣaṃ candanaṃ devotthānaṃ devālayaṃ dhvajam ||66|| kastūrīṃ kuṃkumaṃ devakhātaṃ vaṭaṃ ca dundubhim | patākāṃ ca devaghaṭaṃ sugandhipavanaṃ tathā ||67|| śaṃkhaṃ śuktiṃ pravālaṃ ca rajataṃ sphaṭikaṃ kuśam | tāmraṃ gaṃgāmṛdaṃ viṣṇuṃ pustakaṃ ratnamakṣatān ||68|| tapasvinaṃ ca vidvāṃsaṃ samudraṃ kṛṣṇasārakam | yajñaṃ mahotsavaṃ dugdhaṃ gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ tathā ||69|| godhūliṃ goṣpadaṃ goṣṭhaṃ pakvasasyāṃ ca bhūmikām | rucirāṃ padminīṃ śyāmāṃ suveṣāṃ kanyakāṃ satīm ||1.527.70|| karaṃ gandhaṃ ca siddhānnaṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇyaṃ labhejjayam | datvā viṣṇupade piṇḍān viṣṇuṃ yastu prapūjayet ||71 || pitṝṇāṃ svātmanaścāpi karoti janmamokṣaṇam | etatte kathitaṃ rājan sānandaṃ puṇyavardhakam ||72|| evaṃ puṇyaprabhāveṇa suśuddhā jāyate matiḥ | pitṝṇāṃ ca tathā bhaktirhṛdi tasya pravardhate ||73|| sito viśālaṃ sandiśya prāha kṛṣṇaṃ sadā bhaja | dehi tvekādaśīpuṇyaṃ kārtikasya vratāni ca ||74|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapūjāphalaṃ dehi vimuktaye | akhaṇḍamātrikāpuṇyaṃ dehi cāsmadvimuktaye ||75|| ityuktaḥ sa viśālākhyo nṛpaḥ puṇyaṃ tathā dadau | kare jalaṃ gṛhītvaiva mumoca pṛthivītale ||76||| tāvadviṣṇoḥ pārṣadāśca vimānasthāḥ samāyayuḥ | mantram oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ||77|| daduḥ prāhurvimāne’tra catvāro’pi ca vaiṣṇavāḥ | ārohantu ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ samāyāntu ca pārṣadāḥ ||78|| ityuktāste yayurdhāma pārṣadaiḥ saha tatkṣaṇam | etasmāt kāraṇād raibhya bhavān dhanyo mayocyate ||79|| sakṛt gayābhigamanaṃ sakṛt piṇḍapradānakam | durlabhaṃ tvaṃ punarnityamatraivāsi vyavasthitaḥ ||1.527.80|| kimanu procyate raibhya tava puṇyamidaṃ prabho | yena sākṣād gadāpāṇirdṛṣṭo nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||81 || sanātanarṣiścoktvaiva tatraivāntaradhīyata | raibhyaḥ stutiṃ hareścakre premagadgadayā girā ||82|| sitaṃ kṛte trītayuge’ruṇaṃ nīlaṃ tu dvāpare | kalau yuge’lipratimaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śraye ||83|| akṣare parame dhāmni goloke’tha vikuṇṭhake | yo’sti sa śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo me hṛdaye’pi ca ||84|| taṃ tvāṃ lomaśavāsasthaṃ sarvagaṃ parameśvaram | namāmi cāśrayāmyadya saṃsārataraṇāya vai ||85|| matsyādīni makhādyāśca santaste cāṅgavaibhavāḥ | tathā māṃ kuru cādyaiva siddhamaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ ||86|| evaṃ stutastadā viṣṇuḥ prādurbabhūva sundaraḥ | śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇirgaruḍastho viyadgataḥ ||87|| uvāca raibhya tuṣṭo’smi samāgaccha mayā saha | raibhyo garuḍamāruhya yatra te sanakādayaḥ ||88|| tatra gatvā ca tānnatvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ hariṇā saha | jagāma divyadehena lakṣmi tvatkāntasannidhau ||89|| etad raibhyasya caritaṃ tathā viṣṇorgadābhṛtaḥ | yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyāccāpi bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheta saḥ ||1.527.90|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne viśālarājño haribhajanānmuktiḥ, raibhyasyāpi tattvajñānena bhaktyā ca muktiḥ, gayāyāṃ raibhyasya sanatkumāradarśanamupadeśādi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 527 ||
<1.528> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi ṛṣiśreṣṭha āvaṭyastvekadā girim | raivataṃ kārtike māsi pradakṣiṇaṃ vidhāya ca || 1 || māsatrayaṃ samuvāsa lomaśasyāśrame tadā | aśvapaṭṭasarastīre kṛṣṇanārāyaṇālaye || 2 || śivarātrau niśāyāṃ ca pupūja lomaśeśvaram | prātarbrāhmamuhūrtaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ nidrābhavad yadā || 3 || svapnaṃ tatra dadarśāsāvṛṣirāvaṭyanāmakaḥ | divyayānena sa yayau satyalokaṃ tataḥ param || 4 || viṣṇulokaṃ mahāviṣṇorlokaṃ kailāsamāyayau | vaihāyasena yānena vaikuṭhaṃ sa yayau tataḥ || 5 || golokaṃ sa yayau paścād yayāvakṣaradhāma saḥ | yayau ca paramaṃ dhāmānantaṃ parātparātparam || 6 || sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ brahmalokaṃ gatvā dadarśa pūruṣam | divyaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ muktākṣareśvaram || 7 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ muktābhivanditam | sthitaḥ sa śrīharistasmāyāvaṭyāya jagāda ha || 8 || vada lokeṣu sarvatra kiṃ tvayā cāvalokitam | āvaṭyaḥ prāha bhagavan atra yadvai vilokyate || 9 || tādṛśaṃ sukhasāmrājyaṃ kutrāpi nāvalokitam | nākṣare na ca goloke na vaikuṇṭhe’mṛte’pi ca || 1.528.10 || na ca satye tathā bhūmau te sukhāṃśo na vidyate | vilakṣaṇaṃ sukhaṃ te’sti nityānandasutṛptidam || 1 1|| akṣare muktabāhulyaṃ goloke rādhikādayaḥ | vaikuṇṭhe śrīramādyāśca satye devādayaḥ sthitāḥ || 1 2|| tadanyatra tu kā vārtā sarvā vai bhogabhūmayaḥ | golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ kailāsaṃ cākṣaraṃ padam || 1 3|| catvāryetāni te kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya bhūmikāḥ | bhaktānāṃ ramaṇārthaṃ ca tvayā vai śāśvatīkṛtāḥ || 14|| ye tu bhaktā yathecchanti sevārthaṃ tām̐stathā tathā | tṛptiṃ dadāsi dāsyatve premṇā snehena kāmataḥ || 15|| ātmānandastava mūrteḥ paradhāmni viśiṣyate | sevānando’kṣare dhāmni tadanyebhyo viśiṣyate || 16 || dāsyānandaśca goloke sakhyānando vikuṇṭhake | pūjānandaḥ satyaloke yathāyogyaṃ viśiṣyate || 17|| anyatra viṣayānandaḥ kleśamiśro viśiṣyate | mayā dṛṣṭo’tra bhagavan sa evākṣaradhāmani || 18|| mayā cālokitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’kṣarādhipaḥ | goloke tvaṃ rādhikeśaḥ kṛṣṇanrāyaṇa īkṣitaḥ || 1 9|| vaikuṇṭhe tvaṃ lakṣmīśaśca dṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | kailāse tvaṃ lokitaśca vairāgyānandasaṃbhṛtaḥ || 1.528.20|| yogī jñānī yatiścāpi śivāpatiḥ svayaṃ hariḥ | satyaloke tvamevāsi sāvitrīśvara eva ha ||2 1 || so’yaṃ sūrye mayā dṛṣṭo hiraṇmayaḥ pumān bhavān | pṛthvyāṃ kuṃkumavāpyāṃ ca gopālakṛṣṇabālakaḥ ||22|| vartase kambharālakṣmīputraḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | lomaśasyāśrame tatra mandire vartase prabho ||23|| rādhāṃ kvacit kvacillakṣmīṃ kvacicca pārvatīṃ satīm | kvacicca māṇikīṃ devīṃ kvacit prabhāṃ ramāṃ kvacit |||24|| padmāṃ jayāṃ ca lalitāṃ haṃsāṃ ca mañjulāṃ kvacit | padmāvatīṃ satīṃ vṛndāṃ tulasīṃ ca sarasvatīm ||25|| śivāṃ pārśve prapaśyāmi mūlaprakṛtikāṃ kvacit | kvacinmuktāṃ devikāṃ ca campāṃ haimīṃ ca śāntikām ||26|| kvacittu yoginaṃ sādhuṃ vidvāṃsaṃ ca sanātanam | vīkṣe rūpāṇi te kṛṣṇa dṛṣṭvā pāraṃ na yāmyaham ||27|| adya me saphalaṃ janma mokṣapāraṃ gato yataḥ | anekakalpapuṇyena na te darśanamāpyate || 28|| kṛpayādya mayā labdhaṃ darśanaṃ te śriyaḥ pate | ityucyamāne nidrā sā naṣṭāvaṭayasya tatkṣaṇam ||29|| purataḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dadarśa sasmitam | praṇipatya ṛṣiḥ prāha svapnaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ mayā prabho || 1.528.30 || vada me tatphalaṃ tvadya kiṃ me syācchāśvataṃ phalam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha śṛṇu tvāvaṭya tatphalam ||3 1 || śīghraṃ te bhāvinī muktirlomaśasya tu sannidhau | aśvapaṭṭasarasaśca kṣetrasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ||32 || śivarātrervratapuṇyāttathātrāgamanānmune | gṛhāṇa mantraṃ ye tvatra sannaddhau mokṣaṇe bhava ||3 3 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | gṛhāṇa tulasīmālāṃ kaṇṭhe kaṇṭhīṃ gṛhāṇa ca ||34|| vad cānyattu te’bhīṣṭaṃ dadāmyatra na saṃśayaḥ | āvaṭyastu tadā prāha muktiṃ dehi pare’kṣarāt ||35|| sarvalokahitārthaṃ ca svapnajñānaṃ vadātra me | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||36|| prāha jñānaṃ tadāvaṭyāṃ ya svapnānāṃ śṛṇu priye | susvapnadarśanaṃ puṇyaṃ yadi nīcaṃ na vakti ca ||37|| kāśyapaṃ durbhagaṃ nīcaṃ śatrumajñāninaṃ striyam | tyaktvā rātriṃ ca divase vakti vipraṃ supaṇḍitam ||38|| devālaye ca devaṃ cāpyaśvatthatulasīvaṭam | uktvā tad dviguṇaṃ puṇyamaprakāśyaṃ caturguṇam ||39|| susvapnadarśane prājño gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet | arthaṃ vittaṃ ca bhāryāṃ ca bhūmiṃ putraṃ labheta saḥ ||1.528.40|| mokṣaṃ ca paramaiśvaryaṃ labhate sarvavāñchitam | svapnastu prathame yāme saṃvatsare phalapradaḥ ||41 || dvitīye cāṣṭabhirmāsaistribhirmāsaistṛtīyake | caturthetvardhamāsena svapnaḥ svātmaphalapradaḥ ||42|| daśāhe phaladaḥ svapno’pyaruṇodayadarśane | prātaḥ svapnastuphaladastatkṣaṇaṃ yadi bodhitaḥ ||43 || cintāvyādhisamāyukto naraḥ svapnaṃ tu paśyati | tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ divā svapnaṃ ca niṣphalam ||44|| jaḍo mūtrapurīṣeṇa pīḍitaśca bhayākulaḥ | digambaro muktakeśo na labhet svapnajaṃ phalam ||45|| svapnottaraṃ punarnidrāṃ prayāto na labhet phalam | svapnaṃ rātrau yaśca vakti na tasya jāyate phalam ||46|| uktvā kāśyapagotraṃ tu vipattiṃ labhate janaḥ | durgate durgatiṃ yāti nīce vyādhiṃ prayāti ca ||47 || rātrau bhayaṃ ca labhate mūrkhe ca kalahaṃ labhet | kāminyāṃ dhanahāniḥ syād rātrau caurabhayaṃ bhavet ||48|| nidrāyāṃ labhate śokaṃ paṇḍite vāñchitaṃ phalam | na prakāśyaśca sa svapno budhena kāśyape kvacit ||49|| gavāṃ hayānāṃ śailānāṃ prāsādānāṃ ca hastinām | drūṇāmārohaṇaṃ svapne dhanadaṃ parikīrtitam |||1.528.50|| bhojanaṃ rodanaṃ vīṇāvādanaṃ dṛśyate yadi | pratigṛhṇāti vā svapne sasyāḍhyāṃ bhūmimālabhet |||51 || śastrāstreṇa yadi viddho vraṇena kramiṇā tathā | viṣṭhayā rudhireṇāpi svapne lipto dhanī bhavet| ||52|| svapne’pyagamyāgamano bhāryālābhaṃ karoti hi | mūtrasiktaḥ pibecchukraṃ narakaṃ ca viśatyapi ||53 || nagaraṃ praviśed raktaṃ samudraṃ vā sudhāṃ pibet | sa cāpnoti śubhāṃ vārtāṃ vipulaṃ ca dhanaṃ labhet ||54|| gajaṃ nṛpaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ dhenumityapi | dīpamannaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ kanyāṃ chatraṃ rathaṃ dhvajam ||55|| dṛṣṭvā kuṭumbaṃ labhate kīrtiṃ ca vipulāṃ śriyam | pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ dvijaṃ vahniṃ puṣpatāmbūlamandiram ||56|| śukladhānyaṃ naṭaṃ veśyāṃ dṛṣṭvā śriyamavāpnuyāt | gavāṃ kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā cārthaṃ puṇyadhanaṃ labhet ||57|| pāyasaṃ padmapatre ca dadhi dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu | miṣṭānnaṃ svastikaṃ bhuktvā dhruvaṃ rājā bhavediti ||58|| pakṣiṇāṃ vā manuṣyāṇāṃ bhuṃkte māṃsaṃ naro yadi | bahvarthaṃ śubhavārtāṃ ca labhate vāñchitaṃ phalam ||59|| chatraṃ khaḍgaṃ pādukāṃ ca labdhvā dhānyaṃ ca gacchati | jale tarettu yaḥ svapne pradhāno jāyate dhruvam ||1.528.60|| phalitaṃ bhūruhaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhanaṃ prāpsyati niścitam | sarpeṇa daṣṭo manujo dhanasya lābhavān bhavet ||6 1|| sūryaṃ candraṃ ca saṃvīkṣya svapne vyādhirvinaśyati | vaḍavāṃ kukkuṭīṃ krauṃcīṃ dṛṣṭvā patnīṃ labhejjanaḥ ||62||| svapne yo nigaḍairbaddhaḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca sutaṃ labhet | padmapatre nadītīre bhuṃkte padmapuṭe tathā ||63|| dadhyannaṃ pāyasaṃ svapne sa syād rājā na saṃśayaḥ | jalaukasaṃ vṛścikaṃ ca sarpaṃ svapne papraśyati ||64|| dhanaṃ putraṃ ca vijayaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca prapadyate | śṛṃgibhirdaṃṣṭribhiḥ kolairvānaraiḥ pīḍito yadi ||65|| svapne śirasi mukuṭaṃ dhārayed bhūpatirbhavet | dhanaṃ vā vipulaṃ yadvā pradhānaṃ ca padaṃ labhet ||66|| matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ mauktikaṃ ca śaṃkhaṃ candanahīrakam | sphaṭikaṃ rajataṃ dṛṣṭvā vipulaṃ dhanamāpnuyāt ||67|| sutaṃ ca rudhiraṃ svarṇaṃ bhuktvā viṣṭhāṃ dhanaṃ labhet | pratimāṃ śivaliṃgaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā dhanaṃ jayaṃ labhet ||68|| phalitaṃ puṣpitaṃ bilvamāmraṃ dṛṣṭvā dhanaṃ labhet | jvaladvahniṃ prasamīkṣya dhanaṃ buddhiṃ śriyaṃ labhet ||69|| āmalakaṃ ca kamalaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca dhanavān bhavet | devatāśca dvijā gāvaḥ pitaraḥ sādhavo guruḥ ||1.528.70|| patnī patiśca nṛpatiḥ satī kanyāḥ pativratāḥ | yad dadāti nijaṃ svapne tadvastu prāpsyate dhruvam ||71 || śuklāmbaradharā nāryaḥ śuklamālyānulepanāḥ | samāśliṣyanti yaṃ svapne tasya śrīḥ sarvataḥ sukham ||72|| pītāmbaradharāṃ nārīṃ pītamālyānulepanām | avagūhati yaḥ svapne kalyāṇaṃ tasya jāyate ||73|| śuklaṃ sarvaṃ praśastaṃ bhasmāsthikārpāsamantarā | kṛṣṇaṃ duṣṭaṃ hastivājigodvijadevamantarā ||74|| divyā strī sasmitā viprā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā | yasya gṛhaṃ samāyāti sa priyaṃ labhate dhruvam ||75|| svapne tu brāhmaṇo devo brāhmaṇī devakanyakā | brahmacāriṇī santuṣṭā sasmitā ca pativratā ||76|| phalaṃ dadāti yasmai ca tasya putro bhaviṣyati | yaṃ svapne brāhmaṇāḥ santaḥ prakurvanti śubhāśiṣam ||77|| yadvadanti ca tadvastu tasyaiśvaryaṃ ca tadbhavet | parituṣṭo dvijo yasya gṛhamāyāti tasya vai ||78|| sampattistasya cāyāti yaśaśca vipulaṃ sukham | pade pade sukhaṃ tasya sa mānaṃ gauravaṃ labhet ||79|| akasmādapi tu svapne labhate surabhiṃ yadi | bhūmilābho bhavettasya patnī cāpi pativratā ||1.528.80|| kareṇa kṛtvā hastī yaṃ mastake sthāpayed yadi | rājyalābho bhavettasyācāryapadaṃ guroḥ padam ||81 || svapne vipraḥ pratuṣṭaḥ san samāśliṣyati yaṃ janam | tīrthasnāyī śriyā yuktaḥ susampanno bhavettu saḥ ||82|| dvijaḥ svapne tu kusumaṃ yasmai dadāti saṃhasan | jayayukto dhanayukto yaśasvī ca sukhī bhavet ||83|| svapne vilokya tīrthāni saudharatnagṛhāṇi ca | tīrthasnāyī dhanavāṃśca jayayukto bhaveddhi saḥ ||84|| svapne yaṃ pūrṇakalaśaṃ kaścit kasmai dadāti cet | putralābho grahītuḥ syāt sampadaścākṣayāstathā ||85|| haste dhṛtvā kuḍavaṃ cāḍhakaṃ vā vārasundarī | yasya gṛhaṃ samāyāti sa lakṣmīṃ vipulāṃ labhet ||86|| divyā strī yadgṛhaṃ gatvā purīṣaṃ visṛjed yadi | arthalābho bhavettasya dāridryaṃ tu prayātyapi ||87|| yasya gṛhaṃ samāyāti brāhmaṇo bhāryayā saha | pārvatyā saha śaṃbhurvā lakṣmyā nārāyaṇo’thavā ||88|| sādhuḥ sādhvī gururgurvī svapne yasmai dadāti vai | dhānyaṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ svarṇaṃ tasya śrīḥ sarvatomukhī ||89|| muktāhāraṃ puṣpamālyaṃ candanaṃ brāhmaṇo’rpayate | yasmai tasya gṛhe lakṣmīstathā śrīḥ sarvatomukhī ||1.528.90|| gorocanaṃ patākāṃ ca haridrāmikṣudaṇḍakam | siddhānnaṃ ca labhet svapne tasya śrīḥ sarvatomukhī ||91|| brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇī vāpi dadāti yasya mastake | chatraṃ puṣpaṃ śukladhānyaṃ sa ca rājā bhaved dhruvam ||92|| svapne rathasthitaḥ śuklamālyalepanaśobhitaḥ | bhuṃkte dadhi dugdhapākaṃ sa vai rājā bhavediti ||93|| svapne vipro’thavā viprā yasmai sudhāṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhi | dadāti svarṇapātrādi so’pi rājā bhaved dhruvam ||94|| kumāro cāṣṭavarṣīyā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā | yasya tuṣṭā bhavet svapne sa bhavet kavipaṇḍitaḥ ||95|| dadāti cet pustakaṃ sā sa syādvai paṇḍiteśvaraḥ | māteva cetpāṭhayati syātsārvabhaumapaṇḍitaḥ ||96 || piteva pāṭhayed vipro yaṃ so’pi syād bṛhaspatiḥ | prāpnoti pustakaṃ svapne sa khyātaḥ paṇḍito bhavet ||97|| svapne vipro yaṃ sumantraṃ dadāti pratimāṃ tathā | yasmai sa mantrasiddhimān guṇavān dhanavān bhavet ||98|| vipro viprāśiṣaṃ labdhvā kavirnṛpo dhanī bhavet | viprastuṣṭaḥ sasyayuktāṃ sadhānyāṃ pṛthvīṃ jane ||99|| svapne dadāti sa vai syādavaśyaṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ | svapne vipro rathe kṛtvā svargādikaṃ pradarśayet || 1.528.10 0|| yaṃ sa bhavetu dīrghāyuściraṃjīvī dhanādhipaḥ | viprāya vipraḥ santuṣṭo yasmai kanyāṃ dadāti ca || 10 1|| svapne sa tu bhavennityaṃ dhanāḍhya_ pṛthivīpatiḥ | svapne sarovaraṃ cābdhiṃ nadīṃ nadaṃ pravīkṣya ca || 1 02|| śvetasarpaṃ śvetaśailaṃ dṛṣṭvā śriyamavāpnuyāt | yaṃ paśyati mṛtaṃ svapne sa bhaveccirajīvanaḥ || 1 03|| arogī rogiṇaṃ duḥkhī sukhinaṃ vīkṣya syāttathā | divyā strī yaṃ pravadati mama svāmī bhavāniti || 1 04|| svapne dṛṣṭvā ca jāgarti sa ca rājā bhaved dhruvam | svapne tu kālikāṃ dṛṣṭvā labdhvā sphaṭikamālikām || 1 05|| indracāpaṃ śakravajraṃ sa pratiṣṭhāṃ labhed dhruvām | svapne viprastu yaṃ vakti mama dāso bhaveti ca || 1 06|| haridāsyaṃ sa bhaktiṃ ca labdhvā suvaiṣṇavo bhavet | svapne vipro hariḥ śaṃbhurbrahmāṇī kamalā śivāḥ || 1 07|| śuklā strī devamātā vā jāhnavī vā sarasvatī | gopālikā satī sādhvī kanyakā ca pativratā ||1 08|| dṛśyate suprasannā ca tathāśīrvādadāyinī | draṣṭā bhaved devatulyo nṛpo vācāryasattamaḥ || 1 09|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ te’trāvaṭya susvapnajaṃ phalam | dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ māṃ ca svapne mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 1.528.11 0|| āvaṭyaḥ prāha bhagavan daśa kalpā gatā mama | lomaśasya pratāpena tava yogakṛtaṃ phalam || 111 || samāsādya prayāmyadya tava dhāma sanātanam | ityuktvā divyadehena kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrayam ||1 1 2|| divyayānaṃ samāruhya yayāvakṣaradhāma saḥ | śravaṇātpaṭhanāllakṣmi jīvanmukto bhavejjanaḥ || 1 13|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āvaṭyākhyaṛṣeḥ svapne’nekadhāmadarśanottaraṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena susvapnānāṃ phalānyabhihitāni śrutvāvaṭyo muktiṃ jagāmetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||528||
<1.529> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi pāpaṃ yeṣāṃ tu darśane | duḥsvapnaṃ pāpabījaṃ ca kevalaṃ vighnakāraṇam || 1 || goghnaṃ ca brāhmaṇaghnaṃ vā kṛtaghnaṃ kuṭilaṃ tathā | devaghnaṃ pitṛmātṛghnaṃ pāpaṃ viśvāsaghātinam || 2 || mithyāsākṣipradātāraṃ tathātithyavivañcakam | devavipradravyahārikṣetrahāriṇamityapi || 3 || aśvatthaghātinaṃ vṛndāghātinaṃ devanindakam | sādhuvidveṣiṇaṃ serṣyamanācāraṃ ca devalam || 4 || chinnanāsāṃ patibhaktihīnāṃ ca vyabhicāriṇīm | vidhavāṃ krodhitaṃ duṣṭamṛṇagrastaṃ ca jārajam || 5 || cauraṃ mithyāvādinaṃ ca rāhugrastaṃ vidhuṃ ravim | dṛṣṭvā snānaṃ prakuryāccāpyaṣṭottaraśataṃ japān || 6 || naṣṭacandro na dṛśyo’sti bhādre māsisitāsite | caturthyāmuditaścandro na dṛṣṭavyaḥ kadācana || 7 || candrastārāpaharaṇaṃ kalaṃkamatidurvaham | tasmai dadāti sandraṣṭre kāmato yadi paśyati || 8 || akāmato naro dṛṣṭvā mantrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pibet | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya cākalaṃkine || 9 || candrakalaṃkasaṃhartrai tārāśuddhipravādine | itimantreṇa saṃpūtaṃ jalaṃ sādhu pibet tadā || 1.529.1 0|| śrīlakṣmīruvāca rāhugrastaḥ kathaṃ sūryo na dṛṣṭavyaḥ śaśī tathā | sandehaṃ nāśaya me’tra karuṇāvaruṇālaya || 11 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ekadā jamadagniśca mahākautūhalānvitaḥ | reṇukāsahitastuṣṭo jagāma narmadātaṭam || 1 2|| nirjane ca divā patnyāḥ kāmabhogaṃ cakāra saḥ | patnīcchayā na tu svayecchayā tasyāḥ pratuṣṭaye || 1 3|| atha sūryo dharmasākṣī ṛṣiṃ provāca dharmavit | svayaṃ jñātā dharmakartā prapautrau brahmaṇo bhavān || 14|| mahātapasvī tejasvī brahmacārī ca suvratī | divā saṃgaṃ striyāḥ kurvan dharmaṃ tyajati vai katham ||15|| ahaṃ ca dharmiṇāṃ sākṣī tena tvāṃ kathayāmi te | uvāca sūryaṃ tāmrākṣaḥ krodhamātrāṃ samāśritaḥ || 16|| tejīyasāṃ na doṣāya vahneḥ sarvabhujo yathā | tvayā saṃjñā vaḍavā sā divā cāliṃgitā katham || 17|| yena nāsāvivarāccāśvinī putrau babhūvatuḥ | kāmadagdhā bhajamānā yuvatī yadi cecchati || 18|| tasyāḥ kāmānalaḥ śāmya iti patyurvṛṣo mahān | kastvaṃ dharmapravaktā me yāhi svasthānameva ca || 1 9|| adya me nirjane sthāne kāmabhaṃgastvayā kṛtaḥ | mama śāpāt pāpadṛśyo rāhugrasto bhaviṣyasi ||1.529.20|| svatejasā kṛtagarvāt hatatejā bhaviṣyasi | meghācchannaḥ svalpatejāḥ pāpadṛśyastathā bhava ||21 || iti śapto raviḥ prāha brāhmaṇam ṛṣipuṃgavam | kṣamasva vaiṣṇavaḥ śuddhaḥ svadharmaṃ ca samācara ||22|| ahaṃ yathā tvayā śapto mayā śapto bhavām̐stathā | parābhūtaḥ kṣatriyeṇa bhaviṣyasi dvijeśvara ||23|| maraṇaṃ kṣatriyāstreṇa bhavataśca bhaviṣyati | jamadagniḥ raviṃ prāha śaṃbhunā tvaṃ patiṣyasi || 24|| śāpanistāraṇaṃ tatra cakāra viśvasṛṭ svayam ||25|| jamadagne ṛṣimadhye sthānaṃ svarge vadhe’pi te | bhaviṣyati madāyustvaṃ śānto bhava sukhī bhava ||26|| sūryaṃ prāha tato brahmā kutracid divase prage | ghanācchanno’pi sadyastvaṃ dṛśyo mukto bhaviṣyasi ||27|| nyūnātiriktavarṣe ca rāhugrasto bhaviṣyasi | astakāle ghanācchanne madhyāhnasthe jale’pi ca ||28|| ardhodite ca samaye pāpadṛśyo bhaviṣyasi | anyathā sarvakālena puṇyadṛśyo bhaviṣyasi |||29|| mālīsumālīyuddhena śaṃbhunā tvaṃ parājitaḥ | punaḥ svargaṃ gataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ jayamāpsyasi mā śucaḥ ||1.529.3 0 || jamadagniṃ punaḥ prāha maraṇe’pi ca te suta | nārāyaṇo nijāṃśena tava putro bhaviṣyati ||3 1 || tasya parākrameṇāpi yaśaste śāśvataṃ bhavet | ityuktvā tau visṛjyaiva brahmā satyaṃ samāyayau ||32|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi sūryasyādarśanaṃ tadā | candro bhādre caturthyāṃ ca tārāṃ jahāra kāmataḥ ||3 1 || śaśāpa tārā kopena niṣkāmā sā pativratā | adya tvayā gurupatnī spṛṣṭā tasmācca taddine ||34|| pāpadṛśyo hi sarveṣāṃ kalaṃkado bhaviṣyasi | rāhugrasto ghanagrastaḥ pāpadṛśyo bhaviṣyasi ||35|| kalaṃkī bhava cetyevaṃ proktvā kāmaṃ jagāda sā | tejasvinā kenacit tvaṃ bhasmībhūto bhaviṣyasi ||36|| ataścandrastadārabhya pāpadṛśyo’sti tattithau | ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi pāpadṛśyatvakāraṇam ||37|| duḥsvapnaṃ te kathayāmi yadvai duṣṭaphalapradam | svapne hasati yo harṣād vivāhaṃ yadi paśyati || 38|| nartanaṃ gītamiṣṭaṃ ca vipattistasya niścitā | dantā yasya vipīḍyante vicarantaṃ ca paśyati ||39|| dhanahānirbhavettasya pīḍā cāpi śarīrajā | kanyā ghaṭaṃ samādāya yasya gṛhāt pragacchati ||1.529.40|| svastrī vā krodhasampannā svasyālayātprayātyapi | svapne draṣṭurbhavellakṣmīnāśo dāridryamityapi ||41 || abhyaṃgitastu tailena yo gacched dakṣiṇāṃ diśam | kharoṣṭramahiṣārūḍho mṛtyustasya na saṃśayaḥ ||42|| svapne karṇe japāpuṣpamaśokaṃ karavīrakam | lavaṇaṃ paśyati tailaṃ vipattistasya vai bhavet ||43|| nagnāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ chinnanāsāṃ bhṛtyāṃ vā vidhavāṃ ca vā | kapardakaṃ tālaphalaṃ dṛṣṭvā śokamavāpnuyāt ||44|| svapne ruṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca brāhmaṇīṃ krodhitāṃ tathā | dṛṣṭvā bhaved vipattiśca lakṣmyā nirgamanaṃ tathā ||45|| vanapuṣpaṃ raktapuṣpaṃ palāśaṃ puṣpitaṃ tathā | kārpāsaṃ śuklavastraṃ ca dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamavāpnuyāt ||46|| gāyantīṃ ca hasantīṃ ca kṛṣṇavastrānvitāṃ striyam | svapne kṛṣṇāṃ vidhavāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā mṛtyumavāpnuyāt ||47|| devatā yatra nṛtyanti gāyanti ca hasanti ca | āsphoṭayanti dhāvanti tasya vai maraṇaṃ bhavet| ||48|| vāntaṃ mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca vaidyaṃ raupyaṃ suvarṇakam | pratyakṣamathavā svapne jīved draṣṭā daśāhakam ||49|| kṛṣṇavastrā kṛṣṇamālā kṛṣṇalepādimaṇḍitā | upagūhati yaṃ nārī tasya mṛtyurdhruvo bhavet ||1.529.50|| mṛtavatsaṃ ca muṇḍaṃ ca mṛgasya ca narasya ca | asthimālāṃ vindate yastasya vipattiracyutā ||51 || rathaṃ kharoṣṭrasaṃyuktamekākī yo’dhirohati | tatrastho’pi ca jāgarti mṛtyustasya daśāhake ||52|| abhyaṃgitastu haviṣā kṣīreṇa madhunāpi ca | takreṇāpi guḍenāpi tasya pīḍā bhavedati ||53|| raktavastrā raktamālā raktalepādimaṇḍitā | upagūhati yaṃ svapne vyādhistasya bhaved dhruvaḥ ||54|| nakhakeśāṃśca patitān bhasmānvitacitāṃ tathā | dṛṣṭvā nirvāṇakāṅgārān mṛtyumāpnoti niścitam ||55|| śmaśānaṃ śuṣkakāṣṭhaṃ ca loṣṭhaṃ śuṣkatṛṇāni ca | kiṃcitkṛṣṇaṃ vājinaṃ ca śamīṃ dṛṣṭvātiduḥkhabhāg ||56|| pādukāṃ phalakaṃ raktaṃ puṣpamālyaṃ bhayānakam | māṣaṃ masūra mudgaṃ vā dṛṣṭvā sadyo vraṇī bhavet ||57|| kaṭakaṃ saraṭaṃ kākaṃ bhallūkaṃ vānaraṃ gavam | pūyaṃ gātramalaṃ svapne paśyati vyādhimān bhavet ||58|| bhagnabhāṇḍaṃ kṣataṃ śūdraṃ galatkuṣṭhaṃ ca rogiṇam | raktāmbaraṃ ca jaṭilaṃ sūkaraṃ mahiṣaṃ kharam ||59|| mahāghoraṃ cāndhakāraṃ mṛtaṃ jīvaṃ bhayapradam | yoniliṃgaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā svapne vipattimāpnuyāt ||1.529.60|| kuveṣarūpaṃ mlecchaṃ ca yamadūtān bhayānakān | pāśaśastrānvitahastān dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃ labhed drutam ||61 || vipro viprā suto bālaḥ sutā bālā ruṣā yadi | vilāpaṃ kurute svapne draṣṭā duḥkhamavāpnuyāt ||62|| kṛṣṇaṃ kusumaṃ tanmālāṃ sasyaṃ śastrāstradhāriṇam | mlecchāṃ ca vikṛtākārāṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyumavāpnuyāt ||63|| tyaktaprāṇaṃ mṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā śavaṃ mṛtyumavāpnuyāt | matsyādi dhārayed yo hi tadbhrāturmaraṇaṃ bhavet ||64|| vādyaṃ ca nartanaṃ gītaṃ gāyanaṃ raktavāsasam | mṛdaṃgaṃ vādyamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamavāpnuyāt ||65|| chinnaṃ vāpi kabandhaṃ vā vikṛtaṃ muktamūrdhajam | kṣipraṃ nṛtyaṃ prakurvantaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyumavāpnuyāt ||66|| mṛto vāpi mṛtā vāpi kṛṣṇamlecchā bhayānakā | upagūhati yaṃ svapne svayaṃ tāṃ vopagūhati ||67|| svasya śavaṃ tathā vīkṣya kṣipraṃ mṛtyuṃ pradhārayet| | yasya dantāḥ prabhagnāśca keśā yasya patanti ca ||68|| dhanahānirdehapīḍā bhavettasya pade pade | upadravanti yaṃ svapne śṛṃgiṇo daṃṣṭriṇastathā ||69|| bālakā mānavāścāpi gṛhasya ca kuṭumbinaḥ | anye bhṛtyāstathā tasya bhaved rājakulād bhayam ||1.529.70|| vṛkṣaṃ chinnaṃ patantaṃ ca śilāvṛṣṭiṃ tuṣaṃ kṣuram | raktāṃgāraṃ bhasmavṛṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamavāpnuyāt ||71 || gṛhaṃ patantaṃ śailaṃ vā dhūmaketuṃ bhayapradam | bhagnaskandhaṃ naraṃ vāpi dṛṣṭvā duḥkhī bhavejjanaḥ ||72|| vṛkṣācchailādrathādgehādgorgajātturagācca khāt | bhūmau yaḥ patati svapne vipattistasya niścitā ||73|| uccaiḥ patanti garteṣu bhasmāṃgārayuteṣu ca | kṣārakuṇḍeṣu cūrṇeṣu mṛtyusteṣāṃ bhaved dhruvam ||74|| balād gṛhṇāti duṣṭaśca chatramuṣṇīṣameva kāt | piturnāśo bhavettasya gurorvāpi nṛpasya vā ||75|| surabhiryasya gehāttu yāti trastā savitsakā | prayāti gṛhatastasya lakṣmīḥ kṣitiśca māninī ||76|| yamapāśanibaddho yo yamadūtaiśca nīyate | mlecchaiścauraistathānyairvā tasya mṛtyuḥ samīpagaḥ ||77|| gaṇako brāhmaṇo vāpi brāhmaṇī vā guruḥ satī | sādhurvā śapati ruṣṭo vipattistasya bhāvinī ||78|| śatravaḥ kukkuṭāḥ kākā bhallukāśca virodhinaḥ | patantyāgatya yadgātre tasya mṛtyurhi niścitaḥ ||79|| mahiṣā bhallukā uṣṭrāḥ sūkarā gardabhāstathā | ruṣṭā dhāvanti yaṃ svapne sa rogī niścitaṃ bhavet ||1.529.80|| raktacandanakāṣṭhāni ghṛtāktāni juhoti yaḥ | gāyatryāśca sahasreṇa tena śāntirvidhīyate ||81 || yadaniṣṭaṃ bhavet svasya svapne dṛśyeta ced yadi | aniṣṭakārakaṃ tasyādiṣṭaṃ syādiṣṭakārakam ||82|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmnāṃ japānniṣpāpatāṃ vrajet | duḥsvapnastatphalaṃ dātuṃ samartho na bhavettadā ||83|| viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ ca śrīhariṃ śivam | śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ rādhikāṃ jānakīṃ prabhāṃ ca pārvatīm ||84|| japan dvādaśa duḥsvapnaḥ satphaladaḥ prajāyate | oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ duḥkhahantryai durgāyai te namaḥ svāhā ||85|| mantraṃ vai daśadhā japtvā duḥsvapnaḥ śubhado bhavet | śatalakṣajapātsiddhaḥ siddhiṃ dadāti vāñchitām ||86|| oṃ namo mṛtyuñjayāya svāheti lakṣadhā japet | dṛṣṭvāpi maraṇaṃ svapne śatāyurjāpako bhavet ||87|| pūrvottaramukho bhūtvā svapnaṃ prājñe śucau dvije | gurau deve divyajane phaladaṃ syāt prakāśayet ||88|| aśvatthe gaṇake vipre pitṛdevāsaneṣu ca | ārye ca vaiṣṇave mitre patyau svapnaṃ prakāśayet| ||89|| kāśyape durgate nīce devasadvipranindake | mūrkhe jaḍe’nabhijñe ca krūre svapnaṃ na varṇayet ||1.529.90|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi lokānāmupakārakam | dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ paṭhanāchravaṇādapi ||91 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kvacit sūryacandrayoradarśane śāpavarṇanaṃ duṣṭasvapnatatphalatannivāraṇādivarṇanamitinirūpaṇanāmaikonatriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 529||
<1.530> śrīlakṣmīruvāca mānavānāṃ vividhānāmitikartavyatāvratam | upakārāya me brūhi yathā mokṣodayo bhavet || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ahiṃsā sarvato jyeṣṭhā sarveṣāṃ puṇyadaṃ vratam | ātmane tuṣṭidānaṃ ca paraṃ puṇyapradaṃ matam || 2 || yathākathañcijjīvānāṃ deyaṃ sukhaṃ ca toṣaṇam | kāyena manasā vācā kriyayā vastubhistathā || 3 || āśīrvādāśca labhyante śreyo mokṣaśca sampadaḥ | snānaṃ dhyānaṃ mama pūjā naivedyaṃ sevanaṃ tathā || 4 || paropakāraḥ santoṣaḥ kartavyāni sadā janaiḥ | viṣṇuprasādabhojī ca jīvanmukto bhavejjanaḥ || |5 || viṣṇumantraṃ gṛhītvā ca kṛtvā vai gurusevanam | dhyātvā kṛṣṇapadāmbhojaṃ mokṣasthānamavāpnuyāt || 6 || gurūṇāṃ pūjanaṃ nityaṃ kartavyaṃ poṣaṇaṃ tathā | sarveṣāmapi vandyānāṃ pitā svasya mahān guruḥ || 7 || pituḥ śataguṇā mātā mātuḥ śataguṇaḥ suraḥ | surasya mantradaścaturguṇo gururhi mokṣadaḥ || 8 || mokṣadasya śataguṇo jñānamokṣaprado guruḥ | guruḥ pratyakṣa īśeśo gururnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 9 || uddeśe dīyate tasmai surāya gurave śruteḥ | pratyakṣabhoktā svaguruḥ svayaṃ dehī janārdanaḥ || 1.530.1 0|| gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgurureva svayaṃ śivaḥ | śrīgurau sarvadevā vai tiṣṭhanti satataṃ mudā || 11 || gurau tuṣṭe haristuṣṭastena tuṣyanti devatāḥ | vaiṣṇavaḥ śrīhareprāptikaro gururnarāyaṇaḥ || 12|| brāhmaṇo vaiṣṇavo nityaṃ gururmuktaḥ suraiḥ samaḥ | tasya pādodakaṃ pītvā śuddhyanti prāṇino hyaghāt || 1 3|| viṣṇuprasādabhojī tu pavitrāṃ kurute mahīm | vaikuṇṭhe modate so’nte pārṣado hariṇā saha || 14|| tadāśrayaḥ prakartavyo grāhyo mantrastato’pi ca | mantragrahaṇamātreṇa jīvanmuktaḥ prajāyate || 15|| puruṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ sa līlayā tūddharet śuciḥ | kriyā viṣṇupade yasya saṃkalpāśca tadarpitāḥ || 16|| sa eva śrīharirbodhyo na me tasmātparaḥ priyaḥ | mantraṃ kvāpi na gṛhṇīyāt daridrād bhaktivarjitāt || 17|| āmiṣaṃ sarvathā bodhyaṃ mama naivedyavarjitam | yadyapi syāt sudhātulyaṃ tadabhakṣyaṃ prakīrtitam || 18|| dharmavyādhena vai putrīṃ purā jñātvā śuciṃ dvijam | mataṃgaputraṃ mātaṃgaṃ tasmai dattā yataḥ khalu || 1 9|| pavitrasya gṛhe putryāḥ paraṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati | iti vicārya dattā sā kintvekasmin dine punaḥ ||1.530.20|| śvaśrūraḥ snuṣāṃ jagādedaṃ vyādhaje hiṃsakātmaje | kiṃ jānāsi dharmakṛtyamaśuddhe kalahaṃkari ||21 || iti śrūtvā tu sā kanyā yayau svajanakaṃ prati | prāha māṃ vyādhaje ceti śvaśrūḥ prāha punaḥ punaḥ |||22||| vyādho jagāma jāmāturgṛhaṃ prāha sukhodayam | bhojanaṃ pradadau śvaśrūrvinā devaniveditam ||23|| na tatra devapūjāpi nānnaśuddhirvilokitā | vaiśvadevaḥ kṛto naiva nātithiḥ pūjitastathā ||24|| jalaṃ na gālitaṃ cāpi vahnau ghṛtaṃ na cārpitam | vyāhṛtirna kṛtā tatra snānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ na vai gṛhe ||25|| gogrāso bhūtasaṃgrāso na jāmātrā kṛtopi hi | na devakīrtanaṃ cāpi na sūryanamanaṃ tathā ||26|| śvaśrṛgṛhe tadīyaistu daivaṃ paitryaṃ na vai kṛtam | tatsarvaṃ vīkṣya kanyāyāḥ pitā prabhojanāsane ||re7|| sthitvā prāha mayā tvedad grāhyaṃ naiva bhavedyataḥ | tasyānnaṃ tvāmiṣaṃ proktaṃ yad devāya na cārpyate ||28|| jalaṃ ca vāruṇītulyaṃ devapādāmṛtaṃ vinā | tasmānmayā na bhoktavyaṃ bhavadīyaṃ prabhojanam ||29|| mayā putrī yato dattā jñātvā dharmagṛhaṃ śubham | mokṣārthaṃ sā pradattā vai na tu pāpādanāya vai ||1.530.3 0|| yatra sandhyā japo dhyānaṃ devārcanaṃ samarpaṇam | kiñcinnāsti tadannaṃ cāmiṣaṃ vāri surāsamam ||3 1 || mayā tvajānatā putrī sākṣānnarake pātitā | tvadgṛhānme śuddhirasti devanaivedyajā sadā ||32|| vinā devārpaṇaṃ nāhaṃ bhunajmi tu kadācana | vyādhaputrīti vai proktā na tattathyaṃ vacastava ||33|| harenaiṃvedyahīno vai vyādhaḥ satyatayocyate | tasmādvyādho mataṃgastvaṃ brahmakarmavivarjitaḥ ||34|| ahaṃ jātyāpi cedvyādhaḥ karmaṇā naiva naiva ca | tvaṃ karmaṇā mahāvyādhatulyo bhavasi nityadā ||35|| nāhaṃ putrīṃ preṣayiṣye gṛhaṃ te punarāgame | ityuktvā prayayau vyādho vaiṣṇavo bhaktarāḍa gṛham ||36|| kṛtvā kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ sarvaṃ bubhuje’nnajalādikam | tasmāllakṣmi sarvavarṇairarpitaṃ me śubhaṃ bhavet ||37|| divyaṃ pramokṣadaṃ tvannaṃ jalaṃ patraṃ dalādikam | brāhmaṇānāṃ sadā bhakṣyaṃ haviṣyaṃ ca nirāmiṣam || 38|| āmiṣasya parityāgāt sūryavattejasā bhavet | anivedya prabhoktā tu surāmiṣāśano bhavet ||3 9|| śrāddhaṃ dadyāt sadā toyaṃ dadyādvai pitṛdaivataḥ | mātā pitā gururbhāryā śiṣyaḥ putraḥ svasā sutā ||1.530.40|| anāthā pitṛvaṃśīyā nityaṃ poṣyā gurupriyā | tāsāṃ vai poṣaṇāt kṛṣṇaścāntarātmā prasīdati || 41 || sarvaṃ kṛṣṇasya yatkiñcinnāhaṃ kartāsmi karmaṇām | karmaṇā manasā vācā satataṃ cintayettathā ||42|| sarvārpaṇaṃ bhavet karma pūrvakarmanikṛntanam | bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ vicāryaiva kartavyaṃ karmakṛntanam ||43|| ayaspātre payaḥpānaṃ gavyaṃ siddhānnamityapi | bhrāṣṭrādikaṃ guḍaṃ madhu nālikerodakaṃ tathā ||44|| phalaṃ mūlaṃ ca yatkiñcidayaḥpātre na bhakṣayet | dagdhānnaṃ cātitaptaṃ cocchiṣṭaṃ paryuṣitaṃ tathā ||45|| mādakaṃ jīvahiṃsotthamabhakṣyaṃ ca parasya yat | nālikerodakaṃ kāṃsye tāmrapātre sthitaṃ madhu ||46|| gavyaṃ ca tāmrapātrasthaṃ sarve madyaṃ vinā ghṛtam | dugdhaṃ salavaṇaṃ madhumiśraṃ tailaṃ guḍaṃ ghṛtam ||47|| pītaśeṣajalaṃ māghe mūlakaṃ bhādrake dadhi | hastāddhastagṛhītāni rasāni naiva bhakṣayet ||48|| karpūraṃ raupyapātrasthaṃ bhraṣṭaspṛṣṭaṃ na bhakṣayet| || hiṃsrakīnāṃ sūkarīṇāṃ camarīṇāṃ vanaukasām || 4 9|| hariṇīnāṃ vānarīṇāṃ bhallukīnāṃ payastathā | vājinyuṣṭrīkareṇūnāṃ kharīṇāṃ gavayībhavam ||1.530.50|| geṇḍīnāṃ citrakīnāṃ ca dugdhādi naiva bhakṣayet | agālitaṃ payo vāri takraṃ tailaṃ ghṛtādikam ||51 || anivedyaṃ hareścāpi sarvamabhakṣyameva yat | pipīlikāmiśritaṃ ca madhu gavyaṃ guḍaṃ rasam ||52||| pakṣibhakṣyaṃ kīṭabhakṣyaṃ śuddhaṃ pakvaphalādikam | kākabhakṣyamabhakṣyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ dravyamityapi ||53|| ghṛtapakvaṃ tailapakvaṃ pakvaṃ kevalavahninā | sūryapakvaṃ kālapakvaṃ bhakṣyaṃ śuddhaṃ bhaved yadi ||54|| sarveṣāmaśucīnāṃ ca jalamannaṃ parityajet | abhakṣyabhakṣaṇe śuddhiṃ kuryāt kṛṣṇajapaṃ vratam ||55|| śubhāśubhaṃ tu yatkarma vinā bhogaṃ kṣayo’sya na | na naṣṭaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kvāpi jāyate sukṛtena vai ||56 || na naśyati sukṛtaṃ ca duṣṭakṛtenāpi karmaṇā | kintu puṇyena pāpasya balaṃ kṣīṇaṃ prajāyate ||57|| utpadyate balāt puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ kvacit parasparam | śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇabhāve tu navaṃ bhogyaṃ na jāyate |||58||| svargaṃ tu sukṛtenaiva nirayo duṣṭakṛtena ca | karmaṇā nahi mokṣaśca sa tu syānmama sevayā ||59|| jñānāgnau havanaṃ yasya karmaṇastattu bhasmasāt | mayi vā havanaṃ yasya tattu mokṣaphalaṃ dadet ||1.530.60|| śṛṇu pāpena lokānāṃ yathā janma prajāyate | yāmyadaṇḍottaraṃ janma jāyate kathayāmi tat ||6 1 || goghnaḥ syād dandaśūkaśca gauśca cāṇḍāla ityapi | brahmaghno viṭakṛmirbhūtvā mlecchaścāndho bhavetattaḥ ||62|| strīghnaḥ syād yakṣmaṇā grastaḥ śvā daridraśca sarvathā | garbhaghnaḥ śvā bhavetpaścād ghoṭakaśca bhavettathā ||63|| naraghnaśca gajendraḥ syāt tato bhavet kirātakaḥ | kukkuṭaḥ kukkuraḥ syānmārjāraghno viḍālakaḥ ||64|| sarpahā ca bhavet sarpo hastī ca ghoṭako’pi ca | kṣudrajantuvadhakartā kṣudrajantuḥ prajāyate ||65|| aśvatthaghnaḥ śālmaliḥ syāt tataḥ śūdro bhavet punaḥ | mithyāsākṣyapradātā ca kṛtaghno’tikṛtaghnakaḥ ||66|| viśvāsaghātī mitraghno bhaved gṛdhraḥ punaḥ punaḥ | sūkaraḥ śvāpado bhūtvā tataḥ śūdraḥ prajāyate ||67|| vastrahārī gavyahārī raupyamuktāpahārakaḥ | bako bhūtvā śūdrajātistataḥ kuṣṭhī bhavediti ||68|| kośahārī phalahārī dravyahārī tu yakṣakaḥ | bhūtvā tu cāṣapakṣī syāttataḥ śūdro bhavediti ||69|| pakvadravyāpahārī ca kastūrīmṛgajanmabhāk | dhānyahartā kṛpaṇaḥ syāt svarṇahartā tu kuṣṭhavān ||1.530.70|| krodhī mṛtaḥ kharo maṃkoḍakaḥ sarpaśca vāyasaḥ | lauhacaurastu nirvaṃśo maṣīcaurastu kokilaḥ ||71 || śuko’pyañjanacaurastu miṣṭacauraḥ kṛmirbhavet | vipradveṣī gurudveṣī śirasāṃ sa kṛmirbhavet ||72|| raktadravyāpahārī ca raktadoṣānvito bhavet | ācārahīno mlecchaḥ syāt khañjo bhavati hiṃsakaḥ ||73 || ahaṃkārī karṇahīno badhiraḥ śāstranindakaḥ | vākyahartā tu mūkaḥ syāt hiṃsakaḥ keśavarjitaḥ ||74|| mithyāvādī śmaśruhīno durvākyo dantahīnakaḥ | jihvāhīnaḥ satyahārī granthacauro jaḍo bhavet ||75|| aśvagrāhī tvaśvacauraḥ punaścāśvaḥ prajāyate | tato vai ghoṭakaḥ kṣudro gajacauro gajo bhavet ||76|| chāgacauro bhavecchāgo dānahā mleccha eva ca | ekākī miṣṭabhoktā syānmakṣikā ca pipīlikā ||77|| tailacaurastailakāro rasacauro haridrakaḥ | asadoṣadhadātā ca vyālagrāhī bhavejjanaḥ ||78|| puṃścalī syād godhikā ca śṛgālī bhallukī tathā | taḍāgahā nakrajātiḥ kacchapo matsyako bhavet ||79|| citravastrāpahārastu mayūraḥ syād vanādiṣu | tejaḥpātrāpahārī ca bhavet kāraṇḍavaściram ||1.530.80|| surāṇāṃ pratimācauraścāndhaḥ syādvai punaḥ punaḥ | pitṛdevārcanahantā śṛgālaḥ śavabhug bhavet ||81 || gurudveṣī daridraḥ syād devadrohī ca dāṃbhikaḥ | dīpanirvāṇakartā tu khadyotaḥ syādvane vane |||82|| goṇīhartā kapotaḥ syānmālāhartā vihaṃgamaḥ | carako dhānyacauraḥ syānmāṃsacauraśca kuṃjaraḥ ||83|| viduṣāṃ dukhadaḥ syāttu maṇḍuko vai punaḥ punaḥ | kāvyadveṣī nakulaḥ syāt kṛkalāsastataḥ param ||84|| kanyāvikrayakārī ca vyādhaḥ syādvai punaḥ punaḥ | dharmahīnaḥ paśuḥ syācca tailakārastataḥ param ||85|| mithyākalaṃkavaktā ca rajako mūka ityapi | abhicāraprakartā syād hiṃsakaḥ preta ityapi ||86|| mithyāvaktā ca daivajño vānaro bhāṇḍa ityapi | ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi mukhyaṃ vipākajaṃ phalam ||87|| yasya rāgaśceṣṭabhoge dveṣo’sti viparītake | tasya janma bhavet karma punaḥ punarvipākajam ||88|| rāgadveṣau gatau yasya buddhiryasya na lipyate | dharmādharmaparityāgī karmaṇā nahi badhyate ||89|| nendriyāṇi pravartante matvā svaviṣayān prati | ātmanyevārpaṇakartā badhyate nahi karmabhiḥ ||1.530.90|| nāryahaṃ vā naro’haṃ vetyevaṃ yo nābhimanyate | ātmabhāve sadā magnastasya karma na lipyate ||91 || duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ dve yasya samatāṃ gate | parasvabhāvanālopastasya karma na lipyate ||92|| brahmarūpaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā kurvan brahmārthameva cet | pravṛtto vartate mayyacyute muktiṃ gato bhavet ||93|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi karmanirbandhanaṃ mayā | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya karmanikṛntanaṃ bhavet ||94|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne manuṣyasya kartavyaṃ, vyādhakanyāmiṣeṇa hareranaivedyabhojināṃ vyādhatvam, abhakṣyanirdeśaḥ pāpaphalātmakakarmavipākajanmādidarśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇa nāmā triṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||53 0||
<1.531> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmyekadā ramye tvaśvapaṭṭasarovare | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre ṛṣayaścāyayurmudā || 1 || ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīṃ kartuṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai | jayantyā utsave tvanye raivatācalavāsinaḥ || 2 || vyomamārgeṇa saśiṣyā jvalanto brahmatejasā | pulahaśca pulastyaśca kratuśca bhṛguraṅgirāḥ || 3 || pracetāśca vaśiṣṭhaśca durvāsāḥ kaṇva ityapi | kātyāyanaḥ pāṇiniśca kaṇādo gautamastathā || 4 || sanakaśca sanandaśca tathā ṛṣiḥ sanātanaḥ | kapilaścāsuriścāpi vāyuḥ pañcaśikhastathā || 5 || viśvāmitro vālmīkiśca kaśyapaśca parāśaraḥ | vibhāṇḍako marīciśca śukro’triśca bṛhaspatiḥ || 6 || gārgyo vātsyo vātsyāyano vyāsaśca jaiministathā | mitavāgṛṣyasaṃgaśca yājñavalkyaśca maṃkaṇaḥ || 7 || saubhariḥ śuddhajaṭilo bharadvājaḥ subhadrakaḥ | mārvaṇḍeyo bagadāda āsuriśca viṭaṃkaṇaḥ || 8 || aṣṭāvakraḥ śatānando vāmadevaśca bhāguriḥ | saṃvartaścāpyutathyaśca naraśca nāradastathā || 9 || jābāliḥ parśurāmaścāpyagastyaḥ paila ityapi | śālāyano gauramukho’pyupamanyuḥ śrutaśravāḥ || 1.531.10 || maitreyaścyavanaścāpi vararuciḥ suparṇakaḥ | svayaṃprakāśo viśvātmā sāyaṇaḥ pippalāyanaḥ || 11 || ete cānye pramūrdhanyāḥ samājagmurmahotsave | tān dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya namaskṛtya puṭāṃjaliḥ || 1 2|| kuśāsaneṣu ramyeṣu vāsayāmāsa lomaśaḥ | pūjayāmāsa vidhivat kuśalapraśnapūrvakam || 1 3|| etasminnantare vyomni tejorāśiḥ prakāśayan | diśaḥ sarvāḥ paritaścāvatatāra sanātanaḥ ||14|| tejaso’myantare ramyaḥ kumāraḥ kanakaprabhaḥ | yathaiva pañcavarṣīyaḥ sabhāmadhye samāgataḥ || 15|| praṇemurmunayaḥ sarve lomaśo nāradādayaḥ | cakruśca svāgataṃ bhrātuḥ sarvajyeṣṭhasya yoginaḥ || 16|| bhagavān śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāgatamācarat | sanatkumāro bhagavānuvāca tānṛṣīṃstadā || 17|| bhadraṃ vo munayaḥ śaśvattapasāṃ phalamīpsitam | niṣphalaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe kuśalapraśnakaḥ || 18|| sāmprataṃ kuśalaṃ vaśca darśanaṃ paramātmanaḥ | bhārāvataraṇāyaiva cāvirbhūtasya sāmpratam || 1 9|| uvāca śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastaṃ yoginaṃ munim | dehinaḥ śrīhareścāpi kuśalapraśnamīpsitam ||1.531.20|| sanatkumāro bhagavān prāha kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | śarīre prākṛte nāthākuśalasya hi saṃbhavaḥ ||21 || tatra vai kuśalapraśnaṃ yujyate dehināṃ sadā | nityadehe kṣemamūrtau sukhapraśnamanarthakam ||22|| raktabindūdbhavā dehā jīvānāṃ kṛtakarmaṇām | na tu vai śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyākṛtakarmaṇaḥ ||23|| prakṛtīśasyākṣarādhipaternityasvarūpiṇaḥ | sarveṣāmavatārāṇāṃ kāraṇasya hareḥ katham ||24|| nityānandaravanestasya kuśalapraśnamucyate | raktavīryāśrito dehastava nāsti kadāpi vai || 25|| bhaktānugrahamātreṇa dṛśyase divyavigrahaḥ | yasyāśrayeṇa jīvānāṃ kuśalaṃ sarvadā bhavet ||26|| yatsparśena ca bhaktānāṃ divyatvaṃ tvādṛśaṃ bhavet | satvaṃ dhanyo’si bhagavan mānyo’si jagatāmapi ||27|| sarveśvareśvaro’si tvaṃ tvatparo nāsti viśvataḥ | iti kṛtvā punarnatvā cārcayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ||28|| śrīpatiṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cākṣaradhārakam | etasminnantare brahmā sāvitryā saha cāyayau ||29|| pārvatyā saha śaṃbhuśca dharmo mūrtyā sahāyayau | ananto nāginīyuktaḥ sūryaḥ saṃjñāsamanvitaḥ || 1.531.3 0|| śaśī ca rohiṇīyuktaḥ śacyā yuktaḥ sureśvaraḥ | ādityā vasavo rudrā dikpālādyāśca devatāḥ ||3 1|| sahasā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścotthāya bhaktitaḥ | madhuparkādikaṃ datvā satkāraṃ susamācarat ||32|| praṇemuḥ ṛṣayaḥ sarve devānṛṣīṃstataḥ surāḥ | ānarcuḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam || 33|| athāsane sthitaḥ sanatkumāraḥ prāha saṃsadi | mayā dṛṣṭaṃ paraṃdhāma na dṛṣṭaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||34|| dhāmākṣaraṃ lokitaṃ ca na dṛṣṭaścākṣarādhipaḥ | mayā dṛṣṭastu goloko na dṛṣṭo rādhikāpatiḥ ||35|| tato dṛṣṭaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ na dṛṣṭaḥ śrīramāpatiḥ | tato dṛṣṭaśca dugdhābdhirnāsti tatra hariḥ svayam ||36|| pariśrāntaviṣaṇṇena snātaṃ kṣīrodadhestaṭe | vistīrṇe tatra kamaṭho dṛṣṭo vai naikayojanaḥ ||37|| dhanyo’sīti mayoktaḥ sa nāhaṃ dhanya uvāca mām | kṣīrodaḥ sāgaro dhanyo jantavo yatra madvidhāḥ ||38|| tato mayā sāgarāya dhanyavādaḥ praśrāvitaḥ | samudraḥ prāha māṃ nāhaṃ dhanyavādasya pātrakam ||39|| dhanyavādasya pātraṃ tu pṛthivī lokadhāriṇī | yatra saptābdhayo nityaṃ vasanti ca vitastike ||1.531.40 || tato mayā pṛthivyai ca dhanyavādaḥ pravarṇitaḥ | pṛthivyāha ca māṃ nāhaṃ dhanyavādasya pātrikā ||41|| dhanyavādasya pātraṃ tu śeṣo’nanto mamāsanam | yatrānantāni cāṇḍāni phaṇāyāṃ santyaṇuryathā ||42|| tato mayā hyanantāya dhanyavādaḥ samarpitāḥ | anantaḥ prāha māṃ nāhaṃ dhanyavādasya pātrakam ||43|| dhanyavādasya pātraṃ tu kūrmo mamāśrayo mahān | yasya pīṭhe mādṛśā vai śeṣā vasantyasaṃkhyakāḥ ||44|| tato mayā kacchapāya dhanyavādaḥ samīritaḥ | kacchapaḥ prāha māṃ nāhaṃ dhanyavādasya bhūmikā ||45|| dhanyavādasya vai bhūmirāpo yatra vasāmyaham | apsu santi mādṛśā vai kacchapāḥ koṭiśo mune ||46 || tato mayā mahādbhyaśca dhanyavādaḥ pravartitaḥ | āpaḥ prāhustu māṃ dhanyavādārhā na vayaṃ mune ||47|| dhanyavādasya pātraṃ tu mahātejo jalāśrayam | tato mayā mahātejomūrtaye dhanyatārpitā ||48|| mahātejaśca māṃ prāha mahāvāyorhi dhanyatā | yogyāsti ca mayā vāyurdhanyavādena yojitaḥ ||49|| yatrānantāni vai sṛṣṭimaṇḍalāni taranti hi | vāyuḥ prāha ca māṃ nāhaṃ dhanyavādārha īśvaraḥ ||1.531.50|| dhanyavādasya pātraṃ tu vyomākāśo hi vartate | mayā vyomne’rpito dhanyapravādo vyoma cāha mām |||51 || nāhaṃ dhanyo jaḍākāśaścotpattināśavānaham | dhanyavādasya pātraṃ tu cidākāśo yato mama ||52|| samutpattirvināśaśca sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭau prajāyate | ahaṃ yasyaikadeśe’smi mayi brahmā haro hariḥ ||53|| vairājaromabhūmisthā vartante śatavārṣikāḥ | ahaṃ tato dadau cidākāśāya dhanyatāṃ muhuḥ ||54|| cidākāśaśca māṃ prāha nāhaṃ dhanyasya pātrakam | dhanyasya pātratā śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe prabhau ||55|| akṣareśe’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇe pumuttame | yujyate parameśāne’vatārāṇāṃ vidhāyake ||56|| anantapāre sarveśe yasmātsarve pravartate | yasyaikaromakiraṇāccidākāśā anantakāḥ ||57|| yatra golokadhāmādyāḥ prakāśante sthale sthale | tādṛkcaitanyagaganavrātā yatkiraṇāt khalu ||58|| tamrānādiśrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe hi dhanyatām | dehi sanatkumāra tvaṃ sarvadhanyatamāśraye ||59|| yatra muktā nivasanti yato’vatārakoṭayaḥ | yato vyūhā vāsudevaprabhṛtayo bhavanti ca ||1.531.60|| yato dharmo yato vedā yatrāntaryāmitā sthitā | vyāpakaścānvayī yaśca sarvajñaḥ sarvaśaktimān ||6 1 || yato yajñāḥ karmakāṇḍāḥ pravṛttiścātmanāṃ yataḥ | yatra cānte nivṛttiśca karmaphalaṃ yato bhavet ||62|| phaladātā karmahetuḥ sarvādiḥ sarvakārakaḥ | dhanyavādena yoktavyo nānyo dhanyāśrayo mune ||63|| ityukto’haṃ pare loke’kṣaralokātpare sthite | yogaśaktyā gato draṣṭuṃ dātuṃ ca dhanyavādakān ||64|| kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ taṃ pravīkṣituṃ svadhāmani | so’haṃ tatratyamuktānāṃ divyatejobhirāvṛtaḥ ||65|| draṣṭuṃ śakto’bhavaṃ naiva santaṃ ca divyavigraham | gantuṃ tu śakyate yogād draṣṭuṃ śaktaṃ tvanugrahāt ||66|| adṛṣṭvā taṃ muktavṛndaṃ pṛṣṭvā kva bhagavāniti | jñātvā virājate tvaśvapaṭṭasaro’ntike śubhe ||67|| kṣetre kuṃkumavāpyāṃ vai lomaśāśramaśobhite | gehe ca kambharālakṣmyā gopālakṛṣṇamandire ||68|| divyādivyākṣibhiḥ sarvairdṛśyo’nādinarāyaṇaḥ | gaccha tvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ paśya kṣitau mune ||69|| ityājñāya samāyāto’smyahaṃ darśanahetave | dhanyavādān pradātuṃ ca tasmai yo’tra virājate ||1.531.70|| bālaḥ śrīkambharālakṣmyā gopālakṛṣṇanandanaḥ | vasanti yatra vedāśca parāvidyātra vartate ||71 || sarvānandā muktayaśca yasyākṣikoṇake sthitāḥ | sarve devāśca ṛṣaya īśvarā yanmanobhavāḥ ||72|| tasmāyanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya vai namaḥ | svāmine bālarūpāya vallabhāya ca te namaḥ ||73 || muktānāṃ pataye dhāmnāṃ pataye te namonamaḥ | avatāravṛndadhartre īśvareśāya te namaḥ ||74|| rādhālakṣmīsvāmine te jayāyāḥ pataye namaḥ | lalitāmāṇikīpadmāpārvatīśāya te namaḥ ||75|| prabhāvṛndātulasīśrīpadmāvatīśa te namaḥ | mañjulākānta haṃseśa yogīśeśa ca te namaḥ ||76|| kamalākānta siddhīśa te pratyakṣa namonamaḥ | namohṛdayavāsātha sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ || 77|| namaḥ mayūrapicchāḍhyamukuṭadhāriṇe namaḥ | namaḥ kaustubhasaṃśobhadvakṣaḥsthalāya te namaḥ ||78|| namaḥ kuṇḍalakarṇāya svarṇahārāya te namaḥ | sarvaśaktisvarūpāya kāmakāmāya te namaḥ ||79|| naikāsuravināśāya bhaktatrāṇāya te namaḥ | bhaktavāñcchitadātre te śrīkṛṣṇāya namo namaḥ ||1.531.80|| dhanyeyaṃ kuṃkumavāpī dhanyo’yaṃ lomaśo muniḥ | aśvapaṭṭasaro dhanyaṃ dhanyaṃ vyāghravanaṃ śubham ||81|| dhanyā ime ca ṛṣayo dhanyā drutṛṇabhūruhāḥ | dhanyāḥ pakṣagamā jīvā dhanyā bhūvāsakāriṇaḥ ||82|| dhanyā narāstathā nāryo dhanyaṃ carācaraṃ tvidam | yatra vai bālarūpastvaṃ vartase puruṣottamaḥ ||83|| dṛśyase sarvaviṣayo gamyase jñānibhiḥ khalu | adya naḥ saphalaṃ janma puṇyaṃ naḥ pāravarjitam ||84|| sṛṣṭisañcālakairyo na prāpyate dṛśyase’tra naḥ | anekajanmaśuddhānāṃ darśanaṃ te’tra yujyate ||85|| asmākaṃ cātra sañjātaṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam | śaraṇyaṃ yatpadaṃ labdhaṃ pratyakṣaṃ sevanocitam ||86|| ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā bālaveṣaṃ pumuttamam | pupūjuḥ parayā bhaktyā śṛṃgāritaṃ jagatprabhum ||87|| upadāḥ pradaduḥ sarve cakruśca tilakaṃ śubham | ārārtrikaṃ pracakruśca nemustuṣṭuvurādarāt ||88|| pradakṣiṇaṃ pracakruśca naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ daduḥ | devā devyaḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ cakruḥ kṛṣṇasya mūrdhani ||89|| mahotsave koṭiśo vai bhuvanānāṃ nivāsinaḥ | samāyātā jayantyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya te ||1.531.90|| darśanaṃ ca prasādaṃ ca caraṇāmṛtamityapi | śubhāśiṣaśca saṃgṛhya yayurnijālayaṃ mudā ||9 1 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaitat stavaṃ śubham | paramaiśvaryajanakaṃ sukhadaṃ sampadāpradam ||92|| nirvāṇamokṣadaṃ lakṣmi haribhaktipradaṃ param | akṣareśapadadātṛ sarvasiddhipradaṃ varam ||93 || lobhamohakāmakrodhakarmamūlanikṛntanam | balabuddhipradaṃ caiva janmamṛtyuvināśanam ||94|| dhanaputrapriyābhūmipatisampatpradaṃ nṛṇām | śokaduḥkhaharaṃ yaśca paṭhedvā śṛṇuyācca vā ||95|| bandhanānmucyate duḥkhī bhīto mucyeta vai bhayāt | rogādvimucyate rogī daridraśca dhanī bhavet ||96 || dasyugrasto ripugrasto hiṃsrajantusamāvṛtaḥ | stotreṇānena vai lakṣmi kalyāṇaṃ labhate janaḥ ||97|| sanatkumāro bhagavān dadau śrīlomaśāya yat | lomaśaśca dadāvanyaṛṣibhyo mokṣahetukam || 98|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktāya sarvathā | dāsabhaktāya dātavyaṃ viduṣe ca mumukṣave ||99|| aśvamedhasahasrācca pṛthivyāśca pradakṣiṇāt | snānācca sarvatīrthānāṃ stotrametattu puṇyadam || 1.531.100 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre lomaśāśrame’nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya jayantyāṃtithau dhanyavādāśīrvādapradānārthamāgatena sanatkumāreṇa kramaśo dhanyavādārhaparākāṣṭhāśrayānādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ṛṣivrātāya kathitamahimādinirūpaṇanāmaikatriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 531 ||
<1.532> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi camatkāraṃ munergauramukhasya vai | āsīt kṛtayuge rājā supratīko balādhikaḥ || 1 || tasya bhāryādvayaṃ vidyutprabhā kāntimatī tathā | aputrastoṣayāmāsa citrakūṭe tu sevayā || 2 || durvāsasaṃ varaṃ tasmāllebhe suputravān bhava | rājā vidyutprabhāyāṃ durjayākhyaṃ prāptavān sutam || 3 || kāntimatyāṃ sudyumnākhyaṃ dvitīyaṃ prāptavān sutam | durjayasya dadau vārāṇasīrājyaṃ nṛpastataḥ || 4 || svayaṃ tu citrakūṭādriṃ tapo’rthaṃ prajagāma ha | durjayaścintayāmāsa rājyavṛddhiṃ prati prabhuḥ || |9 || triṃśadakṣauhiṇīsainyayutaḥ sa uttarāṃ diśam | jitvā kiṃpuruṣaṃ harivarṣaṃ romāvrataṃ kurum || 6 || bhadrāśvaṃ merumadhyaṃ ca jitvā jetuṃ divaṃ yayau | meruparvatamāruhya yāvat prayāti tāvatā || 7 || nārado durjayajayaṃ devarājāya coktavān | indraḥ sainyaṃ samādāya prati yuddhaṃ cakāra ha || 8 || śaṃkarasya triśūlena durjayena parājitaḥ | indrastadvaśatāṃ yātaḥ surāḥ sarve vaśaṃgatāḥ || 9 || durjayo lokapālām̐stu vihāyaiva bhuvaṃ yayau | tatra dvāvasurau vidyutsuvidyunnāmakau tataḥ || 1.532.1 0|| āgatya durjayaṃ cobhau prāhatuḥ śṛṇu bhūpate | lokapālānavijitya sukhaṃ na syāt kadācana || 11 || āvāṃ jeṣyāva evaitān dehi svargaṃ ca nau yadi | omityuktvā dadau tābhyāṃ dyurājyaṃ tatsuhṛdvarau || 1 2|| hetuprahetṛnāmānau bahusainyaparicchadau | manoḥ svāyaṃbhuvaḥ putrau kanye dve dadaturhiṃ te || 1 3|| hetukanyā sukeśī tu miśrakeśī prahetṛjā | durjayaste hyubhe labdhvā nijaṃ rāṣṭraṃ jagāma ca || 14|| sukeśyāḥ prabhavākhyaśca miśrakeśyāḥ sudarśanaḥ | putrau dvau durjayasyāstām mahābalaparākramau || 15|| evaṃ rājā vardhamānastvekadā sa himālayam | araṇyeṣu jagāmāsau mṛgayārthaṃ sasainyakaḥ || 16|| grīṣmakālamaraṇyeṣu nināya bahusainyakaḥ | hāstine nagare yasya rājadhānī tadābhavat || 17|| araṇye vāsite tenākṣauhiṇīpañcakaṃ balam | pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyākaṃ hāstine nagare dhṛtam || 18|| durjayo himabhūmīnāmaraṇye vicaram̐stadā | dadarśāraṇyake deśe nāmnā gauramukhaṃ munim || 1 9|| anekarṣisusañjuṣṭaṃ mahābhāgavatottamam | yatra vedān pāṭhayanti kumārān vai maharṣayaḥ ||1.532.20 || kanyakābhyo munibhiśca pāṭhyante vedakāṇḍikāḥ | durjayo darśanārthaṃ vai gatastvāśramamaṇḍalam || 21|| cakāra svāgataṃ rājñastadā gauramukho muniḥ | jagāda ca yathāśaktyā te sānugasya bhojanam || 22|| kariṣyāmi pramucyantāṃ sādhu vāhā vane’bhitaḥ | rājā prasannastadbhaktyāśramasyāntikameva saḥ || 23 || pañca cākṣauhiṇīsainyaṃ vāsayāmāsa satvaram | ṛṣiḥ saṃsmṛtya manasā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||24|| kiṃ mayā bhojanaṃ cāsya deyamiti vicārya ca | gaṃgājale praviśyāyaṃ tuṣṭāva śrīnarāyaṇam ||25|| namaste śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyākṣaradhāmine | namaste cādyarūpāya vīṇādhṛkdvibhujāya ca ||26|| śaṃkhacakrānvitalakṣmīpataye’rthadhṛge namaḥ | sarvapradāya divyāya bhaktagoptre ca te namaḥ || 27|| pañcabhūtasthitāyātra hṛdayasthāya te namaḥ | āpūrakāya sarveṣāmakṣayāya ca te namaḥ ||28|| brahmavratadharāyābdhau śeṣasthāya ca te namaḥ | tvatto bhūtamidaṃ sarvaṃ sarvadātre ca te namaḥ ||29||| tvatto yajñastathā havyaṃ kavyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca vāri ca | sarvaṃ cāsti śarīraṃ te tasmai bhojyaṃ pradehi vai ||1.532.30|| mamātra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa rājā hi durjayaḥ | āgato’bhyāgatastasya cātithyaṃ kuru mādhava ||3 1 || ahaṃ ca tava dāso’smi kuruṣvannādisañcayam | yaṃ yaṃ spṛśyāmi hastena yaṃ ca paśyāmi cakṣuṣā ||32|| kāṣṭhaṃ vā tṛṇakandaṃ vā tattadannaṃ caturvidham | tathā peyaṃ jalaṃ miṣṭaṃ dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtādikam ||33|| tatsarvaṃ siddhyatāṃ mahyaṃ yaddhyātaṃ manasā mayā | tavaiva tu pratāpena bhavedātithyamacyuta ||34|| iti stutaḥ prasannātmā sākṣādbabhūva sannidhau | śrīyutaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo garuḍasaṃsthitaḥ ||35|| śaṃkhacakradhanurvajradhvajaśūlakaraṃ harim | dṛṣṭvā taṃ sa munirnatvā kṛtāñjalirathābravīt ||36|| idānīmeṣa nṛpatiryathā sabalavāhanaḥ | mamāśrame kṛtāhāraḥ śvaḥ prayātā svakaṃ gṛham ||37|| tathā kuru mahārāja kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ||38|| ityuktaḥ śrīharistasmai cittaśuddhiṃ dadau purā | tataścintāmaṇiṃ divyaṃ dadau tasmai mahāprabham || 39|| taṃ datvāntardadhe kṛṣṇaḥ sa tu gauramukho muniḥ | maṇiṃ spṛṣṭvā mahāsaudhaṃ cintayāmāsa connatam ||1.532.40|| himavacchikharākāraṃ gṛhaṃ vai śatabhūmikam | śaśāṃkaraśmisaṃvyāptaṃ svarṇarājatavastukam ||41 || tādṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi lakṣalakṣāṇi sarvaśaḥ | gṛhāṇi nirmame vipro viṣṇormaṇeḥ prabhāvataḥ ||42|| prākārāṇi tathopānte tallagnodyānakāni ca | kokilāhaṃsamenāsārasamayūravanti ca ||43|| campakāśokapunnāganāgakesaravanti ca | vṛkṣavallīstambapuṣpanānādvijayutāni ca ||44|| hastināṃ hastiśālāśca turagāṇāṃ ca mandurāḥ | uṣṭrāṇāṃ ca gavayānāṃ vṛṣabhāṇāṃ ca śālikāḥ ||45|| racayāmāsa saṃkalpāccakāra bhakṣyasañcayān | bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ tathā lehyaṃ coṣyaṃ pānaṃ saśarkaram ||46|| cakārānnādyaviṣayaṃ śākāni vyañjanāni ca | haimarājatapātrāṇi phalāni vividhāni ca ||47|| evaṃ kṛtvā sa viprastu rājānaṃ bhūritejasam | uvāca sarvasainyāni svasvanāmāṅkitagṛhān ||48|| praviśantu sukhaṃ tatra vasantu muditāni ca | daśayojanavistāraṃ triṃśadyojanadīrghakam ||49|| sainyāni viviśurdivyaṃ nagaraṃ sūryasannibham | rājā svabhavanaṃ tvadripronnataṃ praviveśaha ||1.532.50|| gauramukho’tha saṃgṛhya maṇiṃ rājānamāha yat | majjanābhyavahārārthaṃ dāsān vilāsinīstathā ||51 || preṣayāmi ca saṃprocya maṇiṃ spṛṣṭvā jagāda saḥ | dāsā dāsyo navāvasthā bhavantyasya prabhāvataḥ ||52|| niśceruryoṣitastāvad rājñastasya prapaśyataḥ | sukumārāṃgarāgādyā divyāśca navayauvanāḥ ||53|| sukapolāḥ sucārvaṃgyaḥ sukeśāntāḥ sulocanāḥ | svarṇacampakavarṇābhāḥ kumārā lakṣaśastathā ||54|| surūpāśca samārabdhayauvanā devasadṛśāḥ | kāścit sauvarṇapātrīśca gṛhītvā sampratasthire ||55|| evaṃ sarvāḥ kumāryaśca kumārāśca prasevakāḥ | rājñaḥ sainyasya ca kṛte cakruḥ siddhaṃ hi bhojanam ||56|| paridhānaṃ parāścakruḥ snāpayāmāsuranyakāḥ | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakruranyā āstaraṇaṃ vyadhuḥ ||57|| tāmbūlāni daduścānyā miṣṭaṃ jalaṃ dadustathā | vījayāmāsuraparāścakruḥ parāstu gāyanam ||58|| bhṛtyā yathābhyapekṣaṃ ca cakruḥ sevāṃ janasya vai | nānāvidhāni tūryāṇi tatrāvādyanta bhūriśaḥ ||59|| majjato nṛpatestasya nanṛtuścānyayoṣitaḥ | evaṃ divyopacāreṇa snātvā rājā mahābalaḥ ||1.532.60|| vibidhānnaṃ tu vidhinā bubhuje sainyamityapi | yathā rājñastathā bhṛtyajanasyāpi prapūjanam ||6 1|| gajāśvādipaśūnāṃ ca mānanaṃ cottamottamam | cakāra munirāṭ svīyadāsadāsībhiruttamam ||62|| atha rātriḥ samāyātā candrakāntisamanvitā | pradarśanāni ramyāṇi muninā darśitāni ca ||63|| nṛtyānyapi ca nārīṇāṃ mahotsavāśca darśitāḥ | mallānāṃ carayuddhāni darśitāni śubhānyapi ||64|| saṃgītāni ca daivāni vādyāni cottamāni ca | gāndharvarāgarāgiṇyo darśitā maṇimūlikāḥ ||65|| vyākhyānāni rañjanāni hāsyānyapi kṛtāni ca | dyūtānyapīndrajālāni naṭanartanakāni ca ||66|| dṛṣṭibandhāni cānyāni darśitāni niśārdhake | atha teṣāṃ śayaneṣu ratnasvarṇamayeṣu ca ||67|| puṣpānviteṣu mṛduṣu nāryaḥ sevāṃ pracakrire | rājā divyāṃganābhiśca sevyate śayanottame ||68|| evaṃ sumanasastasya ṛṣermaṇeḥ prabhāvataḥ | rājā sainyāni ca sukhaṃ hṛṣṭāḥ prasuṣupustataḥ ||6 9|| prātarutthānakāryārthaṃ vādyāni vividhāni ca | avādyanta kumārīṇāṃ gāyanaiḥ saha sarvaśaḥ ||1.532.70 || snātvā rājā jalapānaṃ kṛtvā bhakṣyaṃ vidhāya ca | sasainyastvarito gauramukhasya pūjanāya vai ||71 || āyayau parṇaśālāyāṃ yatrāste tu maṇirmuniḥ | tataḥ kumāryo bhṛtyāśca sarvāṇyapi gṛhāṇi ca ||72|| gṛhopaskaraṇādīni bhojyapeyāni sarvaśaḥ | antardhānaṃ gataṃ sarvaṃ kṣaṇād vanaṃ babhūva tat || 73|| sa rājā vismayāpannaścintayāmāsa vīkṣya tat | kathamevaṃ maṇirmahyaṃ bhavatīti punaḥ punaḥ ||74|| cintāmaṇimimaṃ tvasya harāmīti vicintya saḥ | natvāśramabahirbhāge gatvā tūvāca mantriṇam ||75|| virocana muniṃ yāhi yācanāṃ kuru vai maṇeḥ | sa tamṛṣiṃ samāgatya maṇiṃ yācitumudyataḥ ||76|| ratnānāṃ bhājanaṃ rājā maṇiṃ tasmai pradīyatām | amātyenaivamuktastu kruddho gauramukho’bravīt ||77|| rājā dātā bhavennityaṃ pratigrāhī tu bhūsuraḥ | tvaṃ ca rājā svayaṃ bhūtvā yācase dīnavat katham ||78|| ayogyastvaṃ maṇeḥ pātraṃ nāsi mā yācanāṃ kuru | trailokyaṃ yasya vaśagaṃ svargaṃ pātālamityapi ||79|| meruḥ ratnākarāścāpi tathāpyaho daridratā | brāhmaṇasya dhane vāñchāṃ karoṣi nyāyavarjitām ||1.532.80|| atṛptasyājñāninastu sarve syurviṣayā gṛhe | tathāpi tṛṣṇayā śāntiṃ nādhigacchati pāpavān ||81 || evaṃ brūhi durācāraṃ rājānaṃ durjayaṃ svayam | gaccha drutaṃ ca yāvatte vighnaḥ kaścinna jāyate ||82||| dūto jagāma rājānaṃ proktavām̐śca yathocitam | krudhā nīlākhyasāmantaṃ rājāha gaccha mā ciram ||83|| viprasya maṇimāhṛtya tūrṇamehi mamāntikam | nīlo yayau tathā śīghraṃ maṇeḥ kuṭyāṃ pragacchati ||84|| tāvanmaṇestu nirjagmuḥ koṭiśaḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ | yoddhāraḥ sarathāścānye sadhvajāścāsicarmiṇaḥ ||85|| sadhanustūṇīrabāṇāḥ śaktibhūśuṇḍikānvitāḥ | pañcadaśākṣauhiṇyaśca pañcadaśa ca nāyakāḥ ||86 || nāmabhiḥ suprabho dīptitejāśca śubhadarśanaḥ | sukāntiḥ sundaraḥ sundaḥ pradyumnaḥ sumanāḥ śubhaḥ ||87|| suśīlaḥ sukhadaḥ śambhuḥ sudāntaḥ soma ityapi | suraśmiśceti te sarve yodhayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ ||88|| bhūśuṇḍikāstathā śūlāḥ khaḍgāni ca dhanūṃṣi ca | patanti ca gadā vajrāḥ śaktayaśca suyodhinām ||89|| ratho rathaṃ parivārya tasthau gajo gajaṃ tathā | hayo hayaṃ padātiśca padātiṃ prasasāra vai ||1.532.90|| raṇe tvavirate tatra nadī raktasamutthitā | rājñaḥ sacivo visaṃjñaḥ sasainyaśca hato raṇe ||91 || durjayastu svayaṃ tatra maṇijaiḥ saṃyuyodha ha | avaśiṣṭasya sainyasya sarvaṃ kadanamābabhau ||92|| atha hetṛprahetṛbhyāṃ śruto jāmeḥ raṇo mahān | yudhyatastau sahāye’sya camvaḥ pañcadaśolbaṇāḥ ||93||| nāyakāḥ pañca ca daśa preṣitā raṇamūrdhani | ye punarnotthitā naṣṭā nāmatastān prakarṇaya ||94|| praghaso vighasaścāpi saghasaścāśaniprabhaḥ | vidyutprabhaḥ sughoṣaśca pronmattākṣaḥ pratardanaḥ ||95|| agnidanto’gnitejāśca bāhuḥ śakro virodhakaḥ | bhīmakarmā vipracittiḥ, daiteyāḥ paramāyudhāḥ ||96|| mahāmāyā yuyudhuste maṇijairyodhṛpuṃgavaiḥ | pañcadaśākṣauhiṇyaśca daiteyānāṃ hatāstu tāḥ ||97|| tāvat hetā prahetā cāyayatuḥ sainyakoṭibhiḥ | vidyut suvidyuśca tāvat svargeśāvasurāvubhau ||98|| triṃśadakṣauhiṇīyuktau śrutvā yuddhe sahāyadau | āyayaturhimadeśe kampitābhūdvasundharā ||99|| raktavāhā nadī tatra tvabdhiṃ prāptuṃ drutaṃ gatā | atha gauramukho dṛṣṭvānantaṃ sainyaṃ tu rakṣasām || 1.532.10 0|| sasmāra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ maṇipatiṃ prabhum | śrīhariḥ puratastasya pītavāsāḥ khagāsanaḥ || 101 || samāgatya samuvāca vada kiṃ kāryamatra me | ṛṣiḥ provāca bhagavan jahīmaṃ durjayaṃ nṛpam || 102|| daiteyām̐śceti vai śrutvā cakraṃ mumoca daityahā | koṭisūryasamaṃ cakraṃ bhasmīcakāra durjayam || 1 03|| sainyānyapi ca rakṣāṃsi naiko’pyatrāvaśiṣyate | uvāca nimiṣeṇedaṃ nihataṃ dānavaṃ kulam || 1 04|| araṇye’smiṃstatasvetannamiṣāraṇyasaṃjñitam | bhaviṣyati yathārthaṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ sanniveśanam | | 1 05|| ahaṃ ca yajñapuruṣa etasmin vanagocare | nāmnā yājyāḥ sadā ceme pañcadaśa ca nāyakāḥ || 106 || kṛte yuge kramādete syurnṛpā maṇijā ime | evamuktvā maṇiṃ nītvā devo’ntardhānamāgataḥ || 1 07|| dvijo’pi svāśrame tasthau mudā paramayā yutaḥ | sainyānyapi ca sarvāṇi śrīviṣṇau līnatāṃ yayuḥ || 1 08|| durjayaḥ śrīharau tatra līno babhūva yogataḥ | cakrahatāni sainyāni svargaṃ gatāni yogataḥ || 1 09|| evaṃ nārāyaṇasyāṃśā uktā maṇyudbhavāḥ priye | paṭhanāchravaṇāccāsya muktiḥ syāt svargamityapi || 1.532.11 0|| atha gauramukho vipra ārirādhayiṣurharim | yuddhadurītanāśārthaṃ prabhāsakṣetramāyayau || 111 || saurāṣṭre raivatī bhūmau snātvā dāmodarāhvaye | kuṇḍe nārāyaṇahrade samudre gomatīyute || 1 12|| prācyāṃ cāpi sarasvatyāṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro yayau | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre lomaśasyāśrame śubhe || 113 || tatrājagāma ṛṣirāṭ mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ | lomaśaṃ prathamaṃ natvā mārkaṇḍeyaṃ nanāma saḥ || 1 14|| maṇeḥ samarpayitāraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | pratyakṣaṃ vartamānaṃ taṃ gopālakṛṣṇanandanam || 1 15|| ātmānaṃ ca kṛtārthaṃ vai mene gauramukho muniḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ || 1 16|| itimantraṃ japan devaṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ papraccha saḥ | mṛtānāṃ mokṣaṇārthaṃ ca durītakṣayakārakam || 1 17|| mayātra kimanuṣṭheyaṃ śādhi mamātra tīrthake | mārkaṇḍeyaśca taṃ prāha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||1 18|| sarveṣāmeva devānāmādyo’tra vartate prabhuḥ| pratyakṣaṃ taṃ bhaja kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim ||1 19|| tena muktiśca sarveṣāṃ durītānāṃ ca nāśanam | bhaviṣyatyeva kṣetre’smin śrāddhāni kuru cātra vai || 1.532.120|| ityuktaḥ sa muniḥ śrāddhāni cakre mokṣakāṃkṣayā | yuddhe mṛtāśca ye teṣāmuddhāraṃ kṛtavān svayam || 121 || vimānaiste gatāḥ sarve’kṣaraṃ dhāma parātmanaḥ | ayaṃ gauramukhaḥ pūrve janmanyāsīd bhṛguḥ svayam || 1 22|| tadanvayātmajastveṣo mārkaṇḍeyo munīśvaraḥ | śrāddhena bodhayāmāsa putrastaṃ pitaraṃ punaḥ || 123|| atha gauramukhastatra jñātvā kṛtvā ca tarpaṇam | sasmāra sarvajanmāni smṛtvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe || 1 24|| sarvātmanārpito bhūtvā yayau dhāmākṣarābhidham | layaṃ jagāma sarveśe cāpunarbhavasaṃjñite || 125|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne durjayasya trilokarājyaṃ, gauramukhāśrame śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārpitamaṇinā susvāgataṃ, cintāmaṇyarthe yuddhaṃ, durjayādivināśaḥ, gauramukhasya prabhāsāgamanaṃ, muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvātriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||532||
<1.533> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi ca devānāṃ vivāde’dhyātmasaṃjñitam | jñānaṃ pūrve varāhaḥ śrībhagavānāha yad bhuve || 1 || cintāmaṇisamutpannaḥ suprabho nāma bhūpatiḥ | prajāpālo’sya nāmāpi dvitīyaṃ sārthakaṃ tvabhūt || 2 || sa tvekadā yayau ṛṣyāśramān draṣṭuṃ mudā ṛṣīn | yatra mahātapā nāma ṛṣiḥ kalpāyurasti ca || 3 || tapastapatyanāhāro japan brahmasanātanam | yatra vṛkṣāstathā vallyaḥstambāstṛṇāni pakṣiṇaḥ || 4 || paśavaśca mṛgāḥ sarīsṛpāḥ santi mumukṣavaḥ | rāgadveṣavihīnāśca ṛṣivattapaāsthitāḥ || 5 || tānpaśyan sa prajāpālo mahātapasa āśramam | praviveśa mudā taṃ ca ṛṣiṃ dṛṣṭvā mumoda ca || 6 || nanāma parayā bhaktyā cakāra daṇḍavanmudā | kuśāsanasthitasyāsya ṛṣervai darśanāttadā || 7 || matiṃ māyāmayīṃ tūrṇaṃ visasmāra jaganmayīm | muneḥ sānnidhyato rājā cakāra dharmamānasam || 8 || ātmajñānasya jijñāsāṃ mokṣopāyāgamaṃ tathā | munistaṃ ca nṛpaṃ dṛṣṭvā cakārābhyāgatakriyām || 9 || āsanaṃ svāgataṃ pānaṃ bhojanaṃ kuśalaṃ vacaḥ | tataḥ papraccha taṃ śāntaṃ muniṃ vinayavān nṛpaḥ || 1.533.1 0|| bhagavan duḥkhasaṃsāramagnaiḥ puṃbhirjigīṣubhiḥ | yatkāryaṃ tanmamāśaṃsa praṇatasya sukhāvaham || 11 || mahātapāstu tacchrutvā prāha rājannibodha me | saṃsārārṇavamagnaiśca potaḥ sthiro dhruvo dṛḍhaḥ || 12|| kāryaḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | pūjā dānāni yajñāśca dhyānaṃ sarvārpaṇaṃ tathā || 13|| dāsyaṃ cemāni divyāni sopānāni matāni vai | teṣāṃ niḥśreṇikāṃ bhaktiṃ gṛhītvārohaṇaṃ kuru || 14|| pārāvārasyāpi pāraṃ gamiṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ | nṛpaḥ prāha kathaṃ pūjā kartavyā tasya vai hareḥ || 15|| ṛṣiḥ prāha hareḥ pūjā kāryā yathā vadāmi te | dhātvādīnā pratimāyāṃ śālagrāme śive’thavā || 16|| sādhujaneṣu sādhvīṣu gauḥṣu gurau janārdanam | bhāvayet svāmini pitrāḥ pativratāyāṃ bhāskare || 17|| vahnau vipre kanyakāyāṃ bāle’nāthe nirāśrite | caityavṛkṣe tulasyā ca bhāvayet puruṣottamam || 18|| mānasaṃ hṛdaye dhyāyedindriyādau ca varṣmaṇi | devaṣu cātmāna dhyāyet pūjayecchrīpatiṃ tathā || 1 9|| puruṣāṇāṃ tathā strīṇāṃ tathā kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati | ime sarve samutpannā harereva harastanuḥ || 1.533.20|| agnistathāśvinau gaurī gaṇeśaśca bhujaṃgamaḥ | kārtikeyastathādityā mātaraścāpi durgikāḥ || 21 || diśaḥ kubero viṣṇuśca yamo rudraḥ śaśā tathā | pitaraśceti saṃbhūtā nārāyaṇasya mūrtitaḥ ||22|| ta ete pūjanīyā vai nārāyaṇasamanvitāḥ | mūrtayaste bhavantyeva nārāyaṇasamudbhavāḥ ||23|| rājā prāha mayā kutra prāptavyāstāḥ sumūrtayaḥ | yenāhaṃ pūjayāmyeva sūpacāraiśca gocarān ||24|| ṛṣiḥ prāha śṛṇu rājan teṣāṃ dvedhā hi mūrtayaḥ | divyā devasvarūpāśca pratyakṣā na bhavanti tāḥ ||25|| ādityāste śarīre’tra vasantyeva ca gocarāḥ | ta ete ca bhavantyeva sadā tattvāṃśarūpiṇaḥ ||26|| ekadā te pṛthakpṛthak prāptā garvaṃ samantataḥ | ahaṃ yogyo’smyahaṃ śreṣṭhaścāhaṃ yājyaḥ sadā tanau ||27|| nānyo matsadṛśaścātra dehe bhavati kaścana | evaṃ teṣāṃ hi tattvānāṃ vivādaḥ samajāyata ||28|| teṣāṃ vivadamānānāṃ nirṇayārthaṃ tu yuktitaḥ | hiraṇyagarbho bhagavān provāca tānprati prabhuḥ ||29|| yuṣmākaṃ yadvinā cedaṃ na syāttadvai mahattamam | evamukte prathamaṃ tu vahnirutthāya pārthiva ||1.533.30 || uvācāhaṃ mahānasmi māṃ yajadhvaṃ mamāśraye | vināśamupagacchedvai śarīraṃ madvinā kṛtam ||3 1|| evamuktvā jāṭharo’gnirvaiśvānaro viniryayau | tyaktvā dehaṃ varṣamātramuvāsānyatra vai tataḥ ||32||| nirgate’pi tu tasmim̐staccharīraṃ nahi śīryate | tadā jñātaṃ vahninā vai nāhaṃ śreṣṭhatamaḥ punaḥ ||33|| tato’śvinau mūrtimantau prāṇāpānasvarūpiṇau | āvāṃ pradhānāvityevamūcaturdevamaṇḍale ||34|| evamuktvā śarīraṃ saṃvihāya kvacidāsthitau | varṣamātraṃ śarīraṃ tu tadvināpi sthitaṃ yathā ||35|| vāyuvyāpārahīnaṃ ca susthiraṃ kuṃbhakena vai | tayorjñānaṃ tadā jātaṃ nāvāṃ śreṣṭhatamau yataḥ ||36 || tato vāgabravīd gaurī prādhānyaṃ mama vartate | sāpyevamuktvā kṣetrāttu niścakrāma bahiḥ śubhā ||37|| tayā vināpi tatkṣetraṃ vāgūnaṃ vyavatiṣṭhata | maunaṃ tena tayā jñātaṃ nāhaṃ śreṣṭhatamā yataḥ ||38|| tato gaṇapatirvākyamākāśākhyo’bravīttadā | na mayā rahitaṃ kiñciccharīraṃ sthāyi vatsaram ||39|| mahānahaṃ samuccārya so’pi niṣkramya dehataḥ | pṛthagbhūtastathāpyetaccharīraṃ nāpyanīnaśat ||1.533.40|| vināśākhyamapi tena vinā naiva viśīryate | suṣiraistu vihīnaṃ tad yathāpūrvaṃ vyavasthitam ||41 || tena vyomno’bhavad bodho nāhaṃ śreṣṭhatamo yataḥ | atha vai dhātavaḥ sarve sthūlabhūtādayopi ca ||42|| prāhurasmadvihīnasya śarīrasya na dhāraṇam | vayaṃ śreṣṭhā iti coktvā jahurdehaṃ śarīrajāḥ ||43|| tairvyapetamapi kṣetraṃ puruṣeṇa prapālyate | na ca naṣṭaṃ kintu śuṣkaṃ jātaṃ sacetanaṃ hyapi ||44|| tena jātaṃ hi dhātūnāṃ jñānaṃ śreṣṭhā vayaṃ nahi | taṃ dṛṣṭvā cābravīt skandaḥ so’haṃkārasvarūpavān ||45|| mayā vinā śarīrasya saṃbhūtirapi neṣyate | tasmācchreṣṭhatamaścāhaṃ nānyo’sti sadṛśo mayā ||46|| evamuktvā śarīrāttu sa vyapetaḥ pṛthaksthitaḥ | vatsaraṃ ca vinā tena dehaṃ muktavadāsthitam ||47|| na śīrṇaṃ na mṛtaṃ cāpi śāntaṃ tiṣṭhati pūrvavat | tena tasyābhavajjñānaṃ nāhaṃ śreṣṭhatamo yataḥ ||48|| atha cakṣurbhānurūpaṃ kupitaṃ tvarayābravīt | mayā vinā na vai kṣetraṃ kṣaṇaṃ cāpi pravartate ||49|| evamuktvātha yātaṃ tat, śarīraṃ tu na śīryate | āgatya ca yathāpūrvaṃ sthitaṃ dadarśa varṣma tat ||1.533.50|| tena tasyābhavajjñānaṃ nāhaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ yataḥ | tataḥ kāmādidoṣāṇāṃ tanmātrāṇi ca mātaraḥ ||51 || śabdādyāśca samūcurvai vayaṃ śreṣṭhatamā iti | nāsmābhirvyatiriktasya śarīrasya vyavasthitiḥ ||52||| uktvā mātrāgaṇo varṣaṃ bahiryayau tataḥ punaḥ | śarīraṃ śīryate naiva pūrvavadeva saṃsthitam ||53|| mātrāṇāmabhavajjñānaṃ na naḥ śreṣṭhyaṃ tataḥ khalu | mūlamāyā triguṇātmā durgābravīd ruṣā satī ||54|| na mayāsya vinā bhūtistasmācchreṣṭhāsmi sarvataḥ | ityuktvāntardadhe varṣaṃ punareva samāgatā ||55|| dṛṣṭvā dehaṃ yogabhāvamāpannaṃ cetanena vai | yathāpūrvamabhūnnaiva śīrṇaṃ naṣṭaṃ mṛtaṃ na vā ||56|| cetanasya pratāpena tattathaiva vyavasthitam | tatastasyāḥ samabhavajjñānaṃ śreṣṭhā na cāpyaham ||57|| tato diśaḥ samuttasthurūcuścedaṃ vaco mahat | nāsmābhī rahitaṃ kāryaṃ bhavatīti vicārya tāḥ ||58|| śrotrayuktā gatā varṣaṃ śarīraṃ na hi śīryate | yathāpūrvamabhūttattu kārṇaśravaṇavarjitam ||59|| tena tāsāmabhūjjñāna vayaṃ śreṣṭhatamā na vai | atha dhanañjayo vāyurdhaneśaḥ prāha sarvathā ||1.533.60|| prāṇe yāte’pyahaṃ sthātā tryahaṃ śaveṣu cāntataḥ | māṃ vinā na śarīraṃ syād durgandhaṃ nāśamāpnuyāt ||61 || tataḥ śreṣṭhatamaścāsmītyuktvā dūragato’bhavat | tathāpi cetanayuktaṃ yathāvadvai sutiṣṭhati ||62|| tena tasyābhavajjñānaṃ nāhaṃ śreṣṭhatamaḥ khalu | tato viṣṇurmanaḥ prāha nāyaṃ deho mayā vinā ||63|| tasmācchreṣṭhatamaṃ cāhamityuktvāntardadhe’pi ca | amananaṃ śarīraṃ tu pūrvavadeva saṃsthitam ||64|| dṛṣṭvā tasmābhavajjñānaṃ nāhaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ yataḥ | tato dharmaḥ kṛtaṃ karmābravīccāhaṃ mahattamam ||65|| ahaṃ pālitavān dehaṃ tasmācchreṣṭho’smi sarvathā | idānīṃ mayyapagate kathametad bhaviṣyati ||66|| evamuktvā gatau dharmādharmau karmātmakāvubhau | tathāpi cātmanā yuktaṃ śarīraṃ nahi śīryate ||67|| āgatya dvau niścayaṃ hi cakraturna mahattamau | athābravīnmahādevo mahattattvaṃ mahattamam ||68|| ahameva mahānasmi mayā hīnaṃ na tiṣṭhati | evamuktvā gataḥ śaṃbhurmahattattvaṃ śarīrataḥ ||69|| varṣamātraṃ tathāpyateccharīraṃ śīryate na vai | tatastasyābhavajjñānaṃ nāmamātraṃ mahān mama ||1.533.70 || vastuto na mahānasmi mṛṣā me śreṣṭhatā khalu | athātra pitaraścocurindriyārthāḥ mahattamāḥ ||71 || śabdādyāśca vayaṃ sthūlā asmābhirdehajīvanam | tato vayaṃ tu sarvebhyo baliṣṭhāśca mahattamāḥ ||72|| vināsmākaṃ ca vai śīghraṃ śarīraṃ sampraśīryate | evamuktvā tu taddehaṃ tyaktvāntardhānamāgatāḥ ||73|| tathāpi na śarīraṃ tad viśīrṇaṃ vai manāgapi | tatasteṣāmabhūjjñānaṃ vayaṃ śreṣṭhatamā na vai ||74|| atha bhujaṃgikā yā tu vāsanā samuvāca sā | ahaṃ śreṣṭhatamā māṃ tu vinā dehaṃ na tiṣṭhati ||75|| sāpi varṣaṃ gatā dūraṃ punareva samāgatā | dṛṣṭvā pūrvaṃ yathā varṣma viveda nottamāpyaham ||76|| atha sarve’pi sambhūya dehaṃ tyaktvā bahiryayuḥ | agniḥ prāṇastathāpāno vyoma sarve ca dhātavaḥ ||77|| ahaṃkāro mano bhānuḥ kāmādyāśca gaṇāstathā | kāṣṭhā vāyurviṣṇudharmau śaṃbhuścāpīndriyārthakāḥ ||78|| etairmuktamapi kṣetraṃ muktāviva susaṃsthitam | somena cātmanā yogaiśvaryeṇarakṣitaṃ yataḥ ||79|| pālyamānaṃ na viśīrṇaṃ tena teṣāṃ gaṇasya ca | garvo naṣṭo na vai śreṣṭhaḥ samudāyo’pi naḥ khalu ||1.533.80|| atha somasya jīvasya garvo’bhavanmahattamaḥ | mayā vai pālyate dehastato’haṃ sarvathottamaḥ ||81 || evaṃ vai niścite some ṣoḍaśātmanyathākṣare | tvaṃ mahāniti jānīmaḥ kintu tatsaṃśayāspadam ||82|| yadvinā na śarīraṃ vai santiṣṭheta hi tanmahat | tvaṃ cāpyatra parīkṣāṃ saṃkuru cātman nijasya hi ||83|| vijñāsyāmastatastetra śraiṣṭhyaṃ divyaṃ hi nānyathā | evamukto hi jīvātmā niryayau dehatastadā ||84|| babhrāma ca bahirvarṣaṃ sarvānādāya cāmbare | nityaṃ tyaktaṃ śarīraṃ ca paśyatyeva bahiḥ sthitaḥ ||85|| kintu nārāyaṇastatra tasthau śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | jīvātmano garvanāśaṃ kartuṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||86|| śarīraṃ cetayāmāsa rakṣayāmāsa sādaram | svaiśvaryeṇa guṇaiḥ svīyairvināpyātmānamāntaram ||87|| prāgavasthaṃ śarīraṃ tu dṛṣṭvā sarvajñapālitam | tābhiśca devatattvaiśca jīvātmā punarāyayau ||88|| tena sa jñātavānnāhaṃ śreṣṭho’tra saṃbhavāmi vai | atha tā devatāḥ prāhurvayaṃ sthāsyāma eva hi ||89|| gaccha tvamekalaścātman jīvāmo vā na vai vayam | ityukto jīvavarmāsau tāṃstyaktvā niryayau bahiḥ ||1.533.90|| jaḍatulyo’bhavattatra bahirnārāyaṇaṃ vinā | acetana iva jātaḥ suṣupta iva sarvathā ||91|| atejaska iva jāto’prakāśa iva dhūmrakaḥ | mṛta ivābhavattatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vinā ||92|| śarīre tu sthitā vahnyādayo hi jīvamantarā | api śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyānvayataḥ khalu ||93|| divyayogād divyabhāvaṃ brahmabhāvaṃ samāsthitāḥ | parabrahmaṇo yogena brahmabhāvaṃ prapedire ||94|| jaḍā api ca te jātāścetanā muktasadṛśāḥ | śrīhareranyathākartuṃ samarthasya prasaṃgataḥ ||95|| tāḥ kṣetradevatāḥ sarvā vailakṣyabhāvamāsthitāḥ | sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca śarīratrayamityapi ||96|| nārāyaṇasya yogena nārāyaṇātmakaṃ tadā | prāptaṃ nārāyaṇarūpaṃ divyaṃ brahmātmakaṃ yataḥ ||97|| tadā jīvātmano garvo naṣṭaḥ sarvastadābhavat | tasyāpi cābhavajjñānaṃ nāhaṃ śreṣṭhatamo yataḥ ||98|| śreṣṭhaḥ pūjyaḥ sadā dhyeyaḥ smartavyaḥ śrīhariṃ sadā | yena jātāni jīvanti vahnyādyāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ||99|| yenāśrito’pyahaṃ jīvo jīvāmi nānyathā kvacit | tadyogena pathā divyaścātmā bhavāmi sarvathā || 1.533.1 00|| tadyogena tathaitāni tattvānyapi ca sarvathā | divyānyeva hi jātāni yāni pūrvaṃ jaḍānyapi ||1 01|| māṃ vināpi ca divyā vai muktāḥ syuste ca dhāmasu | yadīcchenmāṃ vihāyaiva jaḍā divyā bhavantviti ||1 02|| sarvaṃ kartuṃ samarthasya vivṛtiṃ ko nivārayet | tasmānnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvaśreṣṭhatayā mataḥ || 1 03|| tato devāstuṣṭuvustaṃ sarvasthaṃ parameśvaram | svasvasthāne sthitāḥ prāhuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ muhuḥ || 1 04|| tvamagnistvaṃ tathā prāṇastvamapāno bhavasyapi | tvaṃ vāṇī cāmbaraṃ tvaṃ ca dhātavastvaṃ śarīragāḥ || 1 05|| ahaṃbhāvastvamevāsi tvamevāsi ca netrakam | tvaṃ śabdādīni mātrāṇi tvaṃ māyā triguṇātmikā || 106|| tvaṃ śrotraṃ vartase dhanaṃjayo’pi tvaṃ manastathā | tvaṃ dharmastvaṃ mahattattvamindriyārthāstvameva ca || 1 07|| tvaṃ ca sadvāsanātmā ca jīvātmā tvaṃ narāyaṇaḥ | sarvātmā tvaṃ vinā tvāṃ vai naite sattāmayaḥ kvacit || 1 08|| satā tvayā vayaṃ santaḥ sarveśastvaṃ pareśvaraḥ | svāmī patiḥ poṣakaśca jīvātuḥ rakṣakastathā || 1 09|| asmābhirapayātaistu kathametad bhaviṣyati | evamatra śarīraṃ tu tyaktamasmābhireva tu || 1.533.110 || tvayā vai rakṣitaṃ divyaṃ tatsthānnastvaṃ prapālayeḥ | sthānabhaṅgo na naḥ kāryastavādhīnā vayaṃ sadā || 111 || evaṃ stutastato devasteṣāṃ toṣaṃ paraṃ yayau | uvāca caitān krīḍārthaṃ bhavantaśca kṛtā mayā || 1 12|| bhavaddvārā prakrīḍāmi nānyadasti prayojanam | varaṃ vṛṇuta devā vai tuṣṭo’smi ca dadāmi ca || 113 || tadā devā vavrire vai dvedhā svarakṣaṇaṃ sadā | śarīreṣu yathāvasthaṃ divyabhāvena cāparam || 1 14|| śrīharistāṃ tadā prāha dve dve pratyekaśo’dhunā | rūpe dhṛtvā kṛpayā me tiṣṭhantu kathayāmi ca || 1 15|| bhūtakāryeṣvamūrtena tattvarūpeṇa sarvathā | devaloke tu mūrtena tiṣṭhadhvaṃ mama sevakāḥ || 1 16|| pralaye ca layaṃ mayi tvāviśata drutaṃ surāḥ | abhidhānāni devānāṃ yuṣmākaṃ ca karomyaham || 1 17|| agnirvaiśvānaro devaḥ prāṇāpānau tathāśvinau | vāṇī gaurī himaputrī vyoma padmāvatīpitā || 1 18|| śarīradhātavaśceme nānābhūtāni caiva ha | ahaṃkāraḥ svayaṃ skandaḥ kārtikeyo bhaviṣyati || 1 19|| netre sūryaśaśirūpe svargadevau bhaviṣyataḥ | śabdādīni ca mātrāṇi gajavaktro bhaviṣyati || 1.533.120 || śarīramāyā durgā ca kāraṇānte bhaviṣyati | śrotraṃ digbhāvamāpannaṃ devarūpaṃ bhaviṣyati ||121 || dhanaṃjayo dhaneśo vai kuberaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati | idaṃ mano viṣṇunāmā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 122|| dharmo’pi yamanāmā ca yāmyadevo bhaviṣyati | mahattattvaṃ ca bhagavān mahādevo bhaviṣyati || 123|| indriyārthāśca pitaro bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ | vāsanā ca ratirūpā bhaviṣyati tu kāminī || 124|| jīvātmā me nararūpaḥ pārśvasthaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati | kvacicca candramā bhūtvāmṛtādhāro bhaviṣyati || 1 25|| evaṃ varapradānena jātāste sṛṣṭidevatāḥ | hiraṇyagarbhatattvasthā dehe’pi tāni cāpi hi || 1 26|| parabrahma tu yaḥ proktaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | sa eva devatārūpaḥ sṛṣṭau vai vartate prabhuḥ || 127|| sa eva tattvarūpaśca śarīre’tra vasatyapi | tasmād rājan bhaja devāṃstathā tattvāni varṣmaṇi || 128|| śarīre tvaṃ pūjayaitānabhedena harau sadā | sa eva tu tvayā svasmin labdho’styanyatra mā vraja || 129|| evaṃ vedāntapuruṣaḥ prokto nārāyaṇātmakaḥ | evaṃprabhāvo devo’sau vedavedyo janārdanaḥ || 1.533.1 30|| śrīpatiḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’nādyanta eva saḥ | kathito nṛpate tubhyaṃ prajāpāla hi taṃ bhaja || 13 1|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau mahātapā munistadā | vārāhaḥ prāha pṛthivīṃ tvayyapi santi te surāḥ || 1 32|| tān devān bhaja deveśi yena mokṣo bhaved dhruvam | iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi pratyakṣākhyānamaiśvaram || 133|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya tathoktānāṃ prapūjanāt | tattvānāṃ brahmavijñānānyukto bhavati mānavaḥ || 134|| dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ parā siddhiḥ prajāyate | evamekātmatāṃ jñātvopāsate ṛṣayo harim || 1 35|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne prajāpālarājño mahātapānāmakaṛṣipradattaśārīratattvātmakavedāntapuruṣajñānopāsanādinirūpaṇanāmā trayastriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||533||
<1.534> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmyekadā śaṃbhurāsīno’bhūd varāntikam | kailāse dhyānamagnastu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smaran || 1 || kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ tīrthamuttamam | vyāghrāraṇyaṃ mahāramyaṃ siṃhāraṇyaṃ ca raivatam || 2 || aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthaṃ bhadrāṃ śatruṃjitāṃ nadīm | lomaśaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ bhaktaṃ viṣṇuṃ gopālakṛṣṇakam || 3 || devīṃ ca kambharālakṣmīṃ smaran dhyāne hyabhūt sthiraḥ | tasyotsaṃge samāgatya taptakāṃcanasaprabhā || 4 || śrīdevī pārvatī yogasiddhidā mokṣadāyinī | niṣasāda mukhaṃ śaṃbhorvilokya sasmitābhavat || 5 || uvāca devī madhuraṃ premapūritalocanā | kaṃ dhyāyase’harniśaṃ tvaṃ nāto viramase kvacit || 6 || evamuktvātibhāvena saṃjātāsrāvilekṣaṇā | śaṃbhurdhyāna parityajya prāha bhaktāṃ maheśvarīm || 7 || kathaṃ hyasrāvilanetrā premṇā śucāthavā priye | vada sarvamabhīṣṭaṃ te karavāṇi sadā priye || 8 || tvaṃ me hṛdayaṃ deveśi tathāhaṃ hṛdayaṃ ca te | ahaṃ tavāsmi sarvasvaṃ tvaṃ ca sarvasvameva me || 9 || śrutvā vai pārvatī devī babhūva svasthamānasā | punaḥ papraccha kāntaṃ taddhyānamagnasya kāraṇam || 1.534.1 0|| kimidaṃ dhyāyasi nātha vada me śāśvataṃ yadi | sanātanaṃ svarūpaṃ cellokamokṣapradaṃ tathā || 11 || śaṃbhuḥ prāha sati nāsya dhyānasthasya harermayā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyātra pāraṃ gantuṃ hi śakyate || 1 2|| sa sadālokyate dhyāne cintyate sa rameśvaraḥ | pūjyate kamalākānto’rcyate śrīmāṇikīpatiḥ || 13 || sevyate sa prabhākānto lakṣmīpatirnarāyaṇaḥ | pārvatīśvara evāyaṃ yo mayā dhyāyate sati || 14|| ahamasmātsamutpanno nātmyahaṃ tu pṛthak tataḥ | taṃ dhyāyāmi tvanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sati || 15|| tisraḥ koṭyo’rdhakoṭiśca tīrthāni yatra vai harau | sadā tiṣṭhanti sarveśi taṃ smarāmi śriyaḥ patim || 16|| tvāṃ smarāmi hareḥ pārśvasthitāṃ lakṣmīsvarūpiṇīm | ātmānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakaṃ smarāmyaham || 17|| lomaśasyāśramo yatra yadbhūmau raivatācalaḥ | prabhāsaṃ mama tīrthaṃ ca yatra deśe surāṣṭrake || 18|| yatra śatruṃjitā, bhadrā, yatra kuṃkumavāpikā | aśvapaṭṭasaro yatra tatra gopālanandanam || 1 9|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sthitaṃ smarāmyaham | asadbhāvānvitāḥ kṣetraṃ naiva jānanti śāśvatam ||1.534.20|| sadbhāvabhāvitā devi jānantyetat sanātanam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaitat prākaṭyasya sthalaṃ śubham ||21 || kṣetrasyāsyābhidhānāni kalpe kalpe pṛthakpṛthak | jāyante yugabhedena janā jānanti naiva tat ||22|| pūrvaṃ nāmnā maṇikṣetramabhūt surāṣṭramaṇḍalam | pādmakṣetraṃ tataścābhūnnāmnā khyātaṃ tadeva tu || 23 || vaiṣṇavaṃ kṣetramevaitannāmnā jātaṃ tataḥ param | tato vai lomaśakṣetraṃ nāmnābhūt khyātameva tat ||24|| tataḥ patnīvratakṣetraṃ nāmnā jātaṃ prasiddhimat | tata indradyumnanāmakṣetraṃ tatsamajāyata ||25||| tato vai nārasiṃhākhyaṃ kṣetraṃ tatsamajāyata | tato vyāghrāraṇyanāmakṣetraṃ vai samajāyata ||26||| tato rukmāṃgadakṣetraṃ nāmnā khyātamajāyata | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ tataḥ khyātamajāyata ||27|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthaṃ tato nāmnā hyajāyata | tataḥ prābhāsikaṃ kṣetraṃ nāmnā proktaṃ bhaviṣyati || 28|| tataḥ someśvaraṃ kṣetraṃ tataḥ kaṃkābhidhaṃ punaḥ | tataḥ somapadaṃ kṣetraṃ nāmnā khyātaṃ bhaviṣyati ||29|| tataḥ kṣetraṃ girināraṃ kālāntare bhaviṣyati | kalpe madhye surāṣṭraṃ ca mama yogānusārataḥ || 1.534.30 || ṛṣeryogāttathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya yogataḥ | tava yogāttathā kāle pṛthaṅnāmāni sarvathā ||3 1 || bhaviṣyanti sati tāni jānāmyahaṃ hi yogataḥ | tādṛśaṃ puṇyakṛtkṣetraṃ mokṣadaṃ sarvadehinām ||32|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavāsātmakaṃ sadā | yatra vai vāmato viṣṇuryatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||33 || talasvāmī tathā yatra gopīnātho’pi yatra ca | yatra siddheśvaraścāhaṃ yatra bhadreśvarastathā ||34|| someśvarastathā cāsmi yatra tvaṃ bhadrikā sati | yatra madhyabhuvi tvasti lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||35|| rājadhānyāṃ yatra sādhvyo bahvyo vai kṛṣṇayoṣitaḥ | yatrānartodbhavaṃ rājyaṃ yatra gopālakṛṣṇajaḥ ||36|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣād vasatyapi | tādṛśaṃ tadviśālaṃ ca kṣetraṃ vai śatayojanam ||37|| prāyaḥ samudrato vyāptaṃ tripārśve prāgbhuvānvitam | darśanādapi lokānāṃ pāpatāpanivārakam ||38|| yatra satāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ yoginīnāṃ kulāni ca | mahatāṃ sāttvatānāṃ ca bhuvāṃ rakṣaṇakāriṇām ||39|| jñānināṃ ca tapasyāyāṃ ratānāṃ brahmacāriṇām | kulāni lokakalyāṇakāriṇāṃ pravasantyapi ||1.534.40|| nārīṇāṃ sādhubhaktānāṃ sādhunāthārthadehinām | sarvasvārpaṇabhaktānāṃ svāminārāyaṇasevinām ||41|| yatra viṣṇoḥ kalāṃśāśca prajāyante vibhūtayaḥ | tatkṣetraṃ cāsanaṃ devi purātanaṃ hi me’sti yat ||42|| tat smarāmi mahatkṣetraṃ śāntiṃ yāmi purātanīm | tvāṃ smarāmi yadā devi bahiścāyāmi vai kṣaṇāt ||43|| evaṃ me vallabhaṃ kṣetraṃ kalpānte kārṣṇavāllabham | nāmnā khyātaṃ pārvataṃ ca tava yogādbhaviṣyati ||44|| tasmin kṣetre mahādevi hyekānte’bdhitaṭe sadā | nivasāmi mayā guptaṃ kṛtaṃ sthānaṃ mamārthavat ||45|| yuge yuge tu tīrthāni jāyante ca viyanti ca | aśāstravācakānāṃ tu kṣetrasaṃgopanaṃ varam ||46|| pāpā nindanti māhātmyamajñātvā bhūtale harim | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ surāṣṭrajaṃ prabhum ||47|| idaṃ tīrthamidaṃ tīrthaṃ bhramanti jñānahīnakāḥ | gṛhatīrthaṃ na jānanti mīnaśūladhanurdhvajaiḥ ||48|| vajrasvastikacakraiśca nārāyaṇaṃ hi gocaram | rādhikāpārvatīlakṣmīmāṇikīsuprabhāpatim ||49|| sarveṣāṃ khalu tattvānāṃ svāminaṃ vallabhaṃ patim | ahaṃ devi bhajāmyenaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ||1.534.50|| pare dhāmni sthitaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭasthitam | lomaśasyāśrame kāntaṃ koṭigopīpatiṃ prabhum ||51 || yasya vāsaḥ sadā tatra kalpe kalpāntare’pi ca | tato’haṃ nityadā devi taṃ smarāmi purātanam ||52|| anyeṣu tīrthavaryeṣu me mano na sthirāyate | kuṃkumavāpikātīrthe sarvātmanā sthirāyate ||53|| tato nityaṃ sahajena smaryate manasā hi tat | yāvatsmarāmi tatkṣetraṃ tāvat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ ||54|| prahasan māṃ prati tveti yathā mitraṃ purātanam | anekairdivyabhāvaiśca līlābhiḥ sa manoharaḥ ||55 || kalpāntarānurūpābhiḥ ramayatyeva māṃ priye | yathā me mānasaṃ tasmin grathitaṃ na viyujyate ||56 || tathānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo māṃ sve prakarṣati | naiva muñcati bhiyaṃ māṃ nirodhayati māṃ nije |||57|| etādṛśaṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ smara kānte maheśvari | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smara mama priye ||58|| ityuktā pārvatī devī brahmānandapariplutā | kṣetrasya śravaṇādeva babhūva brahmatanmayī ||59|| tāvattasyāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svahṛdaye’sphurat |
