divyarūpadharo bālaḥ koṭikandarpasundaraḥ ||1.534.60|| prāha mātarmama kṣetraṃ kathaṃ nāyāsi vai kvacit | ityuktvā pārvatīṃ natvā tejomaṇḍalamadhyagaḥ ||61 || koṭikāntākāntasevitaḥ sākṣād darśanaṃ dadau | yuvākṣarākhyalokasya muktairjuṣṭastataḥ param ||62|| golokastho dvibhujaśca gopīgopagaṇārcitaḥ | vaikuṇṭhasthaścaturbāhuḥ ramāśrīkamalārcitaḥ ||63|| kailāsastho nāgasūtro himojjvalo dṛḍho yuvā | jaṭājūṭaśirāścorau satī yasyāsti so’bhavat ||64|| evaṃ datvā darśanaṃ svaṃ punaścāntaradhīyata | satī tu pārvatī devī mahadāścaryamāsthitā ||65|| jajāgāra samādheḥ sā prāha śrīśaṃkaraṃ patim | dṛṣṭaṃ kṣetraṃ mayā kānta dṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||66|| idānīṃ kṛtakṛtyāhaṃ jātā dṛṣṭvācyutaṃ patim | yaśca saṃvartate dhāmni pare’kṣarāt pumuttamaḥ ||67|| sa eva śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’śvapaṭṭatīrthake | goloke cāpi vaikuṇṭhe kailāse’pi sa eva saḥ ||68|| patirme vartase caivaṃ mayā hṛdi vilokitam | vada kṣetraṃ viśālaṃ me śravānandaḥ prajāyate ||69|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ sarvatīrthottamottamam | adya jñātaṃ mayā śaṃbho māhātmyaṃ kathayasva me ||1.534.70|| japaṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ ceṣṭaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre kva kasmiṃścākṣayaṃ bhavet || 71 || kṣetrasya vartulaṃ sīma kṣetrasāraṃ ca me vada | tava hastāmalakavad dṛśyaṃ bhavati sarvathā ||72|| śaṃkaraḥ prāha deveśi saurāṣṭraṃ tu priyaṃ mama | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ kṛṣṇasya mama ca priyam || 73|| prabhāsād raivatādreśca śatruṃjitānadīmataḥ | camatkārapurāccāpi tatkṣetraṃ supriyaṃ mama || 74|| yatra sannihito nityamacyuto bhagavān svayam | yatra vai lomaśo brahmā yatrāhaṃ nivasāmi ca ||75|| śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ kṣetraṃ saurāṣṭramaṇḍalam | maṇijanyaṃ tu taddivyaṃ mokṣadaṃ prāṇināṃ sadā ||76|| paścime raivataṃ pīṭhaṃ pūrve śanuṃjidāhvayam | uttare ca camatkāraṃ dakṣiṇe somanāthakam ||77|| antaḥpīṭhaṃ tvaśvapaṭṭasaraḥ kuṃkumavāpikā | yatra bhadrā hiraṇyā ca svarṇarekhā hyujasvatī | |78|| hariṇyunmattagaṃgā ca śatruṃjitā sarasvatī | nāganadī gomatī ca kṛṣṇā divyā hareḥpriyāḥ ||79|| āpagā bhavatāriṇyaḥ saurāṣṭre santi sarvadā | nyaṃkumatī vajriṇī ca māheśvarī mahāsatī |||1.534.80| siṃhāraṇyasthitānyeva santi tīrthāni tānyapi | saurāṣṭre yāni tīrthāni kṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā ||81 |8 vāpī kūpataḍāgāni pallavāni hradādayaḥ | sarāṃsi cāpagāścāpi devānāmālayāstathā ||82| satāṃ nivāsā grāmāśca medhyāḥ pāpaharā hi te | saurāṣṭre madhyadeśe śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||83| uttare śrīvāsudevo golokādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ | paścime vāmano devo dakṣiṇe somanāthakaḥ ||84| pūrve śrīgopikānātho vartante bhavatārakāḥ | madhyabhāge vased yastu yadi naiṣkṛtiko naraḥ ||85|| yadi pāpo yadi śaṭho mucyate sarvapātakāt | madhyabhāge sadā devi tvayā saha vasāmyaham ||86|| tatra brahmādayaḥ santi nārāyaṇapurogamāḥ | yoginaḥ sādhavastatropāsate lomaśaṃ munim ||87|| yatkiṃcidaśubhaṃ karma kṛtaṃ mānavabuddhinā | tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāyātkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrayāt ||88|| gopāleśvaranāmāhaṃ madhye tiṣṭhāmi tatra vai | asaṃkhyatvāttu kalpānāṃ janā jānanti naiva mām ||89|| snehācca tava bhaktyā ca mayā te’tra niveditam | ahaṃ vai vaiṣṇavo bhūtvā madhye vasāmi sarvadā ||1.534.90|| yajñadānajapairhomaiḥ svādhyāyaiḥ pitṛtarpaṇaiḥ | cāndrāyaṇaiścopavāsaistīrthādigamanaistathā ||91|| yatpadaṃ labhyate devi tataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ padaṃ hareḥ | akṣarākhyaṃ mahaddhāma prāpyate madhyasaṃśrayāt ||92|| tiryagyonigatā ye ca paśupakṣimṛgādayaḥ | kṛmikīṭapataṃgādyā jalasthalanivāsinaḥ ||93|| sthāvarā jaṃgamāścānye bālā vṛddhā narāḥ striyaḥ | cāṇḍālāḥ puṣkasāścāpi kutsitā vimatāstathā ||94|| viyonijā dehinaśca mucyante madhyavāsataḥ | lomaśo nārasiṃhaśca sanakādyāścirāyuṣaḥ ||95|| mārkaṇḍeyaḥ pañcaśikho voḍhurāsurirityapi | dattātreyo hanumām̐śca gaṇeśo vyāsa ityapi ||96 || jāmbavān kapilaścānye yatra kṣetre vasanti ca | teṣāṃ pratāpato jīvā mucyante madhyavāsataḥ ||97|| daśārbudasahasrāṇi koṭitritayamityapi | saurāṣṭre ṛṣayo nityaṃ tiṣṭhantyadṛśyarūpiṇaḥ ||98|| meroḥ śakyā guṇā vaktuṃ samudrāṇāṃ ca bindavaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyātra divyakṣetrasya vai sati ||99|| śakyā naiva guṇā vaktuṃ varṣakoṭiśatairapi | ityāha śaṃkaro devīṃ tataśca virarāma ha || 1.534.10 0|| evaṃ lakṣmi tava patyuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya me | kṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ paraṃ śrutvā sasmāra pārvatī harim || 101 || dhyāne sthitā ca sā nityaṃ prāptaḥ smarati bhāvataḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṣetraṃ sumuktidam || 102 || śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya smaraṇādvandanādapi | bhuktimuktipradaṃ kṣetraṃ jīvānāṃ sampadāṃ pradam || 1 03|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne saurāṣṭre kuṃkumavāpītīrthakṣetramahimnaḥ pārvatīṃ prati śaṃkarakṛtaṃ varṇanamitinirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||534||
<1.535> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tato devī pārvatī śaṃkaraṃ patim | tuṣṭāva prārthayāmāsa smṛtvā svāpnaṃ harervacaḥ || 1 || prāṇeśa śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam | prāha mātarmama kṣetraṃ kathaṃ nāyāsi vai kvacit || 2 || ityevaṃ kathitā cāhaṃ svapne bhagavatā priya | tatkṣetraṃ draṣṭumicchāmi gopāleśvaramaṇḍitam || 3 || yatra śrībhagavān viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | vartate muktakoṭyādyairdraṣṭumicchāmi tatsthalam || 4 || yattantraṃ lokacakraṃ vai yattantraṃ layacakrakam | sa yatra vartate devo draṣṭumicchāmi tatsthalam || 5 || yadadhīnaṃ hi lokānāṃ gopāyanaṃ pravartate | sa kṛṣṇo vartate yatra draṣṭumicchāmi tatsthalam || 6 || mahābhūtāni sarvāṇi yena dhṛtāni varṣmaṇi | sa dhṛto yena deśena draṣṭumicchāmi tatsthalam || 7 || yasmānmatsyastathā kūrmo vārāho narasiṃhakaḥ | kapilaśca hariścāpi vāsudevaḥ pṛthustathā || 8 || dattātreyastathā haṃsaḥ ṛṣabho vāmanaḥ prabhuḥ | parśurāmastathā yajñanārāyaṇaḥ kumārakāḥ || 9 || sanakādyāstathā rāmo hayagrīvaśca nāradaḥ | vyāso buddhastathā kalkirhaṃsaśca mohinī tathā || 1.535.1 0|| viṣṇuścaite hyavatārā jāyante lokarakṣakāḥ | sa rājate yatra deśe draṣṭumicchāmi tatsthalam || 1 1|| rādhā ramā satī lakṣmīḥ padmā padmāvatī prabhā | pārvatī lalitā kṛṣṇā jayā māṇikī tūlasī || 12|| vṛndā śrīḥ kamalā sītā rukmiṇī draupadī śivā | gaṃgā sarasvatī haṃsā śāradā maṃjulā ratiḥ || 13|| mūrtiśca mānasā sandhyā gāyatrī mūlaprakṛtiḥ | sāvitrī devikā muktiḥ śāntirbhaktiśca yoṣitaḥ || 14|| yasmājjātā mātaraśca lokānāṃ sukhadāyikāḥ | sa rājate yatra deśe draṣṭumicchāmi tatsthalam || 15|| dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāmāśrayo bhagavām̐stu yaḥ | pralayasya punaḥ sṛṣṭerdraṣṭumicchāmi tatsthalam || 16|| sahasrakramaṇo devaḥ sahasrajñānaraśmivān | sahasrakaṃdharo yatra draṣṭumicchāmi tatsthalam || 17|| yannābhau kalpanāmātrājjātaṃ paitāmahaṃ gṛham | yallalāṭāddharmabindorjātaḥ śivāpatiḥ prabhuḥ || 18|| yasya vai hṛdayāllakṣmīpatiḥ sambhūta eva ca | so’pi yasmāt samutpannastasya praprapitāmahaḥ || 19|| yatra saṃrājate śaṃbho draṣṭumicchāmi tatsthalam | dugdhābdhau śayanaṃ cakre śeṣaparyaṃkamāsthitaḥ ||1.535.20|| yaḥ sa yasmātsamutpannastasyāpi cāvatāriṇam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamicchāmi vīkṣitum ||21 || havyādaiścāpi kravyādairbhāvādairamṛtādanaiḥ | anadanaistathā yo vai ramate hyanurūpataḥ ||22|| bālarūpaṃ svapnadṛṣṭaṃ draṣṭumicchāmi taṃ prabhum | trayāṇāṃ ca caturṇāṃ ca yo gatiḥ parameśvaraḥ ||23|| pañcānāṃ ṣoḍaśānāṃ ca draṣṭumicchāmi taṃ prabhum | tejāṃsi yaṃ śrayante ca tapāṃsi cārpaṇāni ca ||24|| kratavastyāgasanyāsāḥ śrayante yaṃ pareśvaram | kāntakāntaṃ ca taṃ śaṃbho draṣṭumicchāmi satvaram ||25|| ityuktaḥ śaṃkaro devo bhaktiṃ vilokya yoṣitaḥ | uvāca madhuraṃ devīṃ smaran kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||26 || dhanye mānye sadā pūjye kṛṣṇapriye pativrate | hṛṣyāmi tvadvacaḥ śrutvāpyāyitaṃ bhaktivāriṇā ||27|| dhanyo’haṃ yadgṛhe patnī nārāyaṇe dṛḍhavratā | bhaktimatī sveṣṭadeve jagaduddhārakāriṇī ||28|| na mayā sadṛśo devi bhāgyavān bhuvaneṣvapi | yatpatnī śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadāsyābhirañjitā ||29|| mamāpi vartate sādhvi draṣṭumicchā hi tatsthalam | vahukālo gato yasmātpunaryāsyāmi vai tvayā ||1.535.30|| saubhāgyaṃ vardhatāṃ kānte prasannayasi yanmanaḥ | vyomamārgeṇa yāsyāvo bahupūjopacārakaiḥ ||3 1 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vidhinārcanam | kariṣyāvaḥ kārtike vai sthāsyāvastatra śobhane ||32|| śivarātriṃ kariṣyāvastatra vai raivatācale | tato’kṣayatṛtīyāyāṃ snāsyāvaḥ somanāthake ||33|| śrāvaṇaṃ ca kariṣyāvo gomatyāṃ kṛṣṇapattane | navarātraṃ camatkāre kṛtvā kailāsameva tu ||34|| āyāsyāvo mahādevi vada nandīśvaraṃ tathā | gaṇeśaṃ kārtikeyaṃ ca yoginīmaṇḍalaṃ vada || 35|| durgānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ cāpi rudrānekādaśāpi ca | gaṃgāṃ ca vīrabhadraṃ ca caṇḍaṃ pracaṇḍamityapi ||36|| śṛṃgiṃ bhṛṃgiṃ ca rīṭiṃ kirīṭiṃ ceśānamityapi | agniṃ ca maṃgalaṃ candraṃ kālaṃ bhairavamityapi ||37|| durvāsasaṃ tathā lābhaṃ toṣaṃ siddhīśca vai vada | ṛddhiṃ ca hanumantaṃ ca tathānyān mama sevakān ||38|| tavāpi sevikā devīrvada yātrārthamutsukān | sarvān vāhanasāmagrīrupadāgṛhya yāntviti ||39|| ityevaṃ śaṃkarāllabdhvā samājñāṃ pārvatī satī | suprasannā samutthāya ghoṣayāmāsa sarvathā ||1.535.40|| sannahyantāṃ suyātrārthaṃ drutaṃ saurāṣṭramaṇḍale | yatrāste śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||41|| somanātho vāmanaśca bhaveśo gopikāpatiḥ | tatra yātrākṛte sarvairgantavyaṃ vyomagāmibhiḥ ||42|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ ca lomaśaṃ munim ||43 || mātaraṃ kaṃbharālakṣmīṃ pitṛgopālakṛṣṇakam | dṛṣṭvārcayitvā sevitvā yāsyāmaḥ kṛtakṛtyatām ||44|| evaṃ kailāsavāsāste bahuratnādisaṃbhṛtāḥ | ūrjakṛṣṇasya saptamyāṃ yātrāṃ cakrarmudānvitāḥ ||45|| dundubhayo hyavādyanta prājñāyanta jayeraṇāḥ | prāvartantāmbare sarve tvāyayurghaṭikāntare ||46|| vyomni koṭigaṇadevīvāhanaiḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ | mahādevastu taiḥ pṛṣṭhaḥ samuvāca sthale sthale ||47|| ayaṃ kedāranātho’haṃ dakṣeśvarastathā hyaham | arbude puṣkaraṃ cedaṃ siddhakṣetramidaṃ tathā ||48|| raṇeśvaraṃ ca me kṣetraṃ saurāṣṭraṃ cedamāgatam | sāleśo’yaṃ mahāviṣṇurbhadrā ceyaṃ mahāpagā ||49 || śatruñjitā nadī ceyaṃ gorakṣasya ca dhūnikā | aśvapaṭṭasaraścedaṃ paścimottarasetumat ||1.535.5 0|| madhyadvīpe mandiraṃ ca yatra kuṃkumavāpikā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇālayo’yamuttamaḥ ||2 1 || dakṣiṇe vṛkṣavistāre lomaśasyāśramo hyayam | vyāghrāraṇyaṃ tathā dūraṃ dīrghaṃ cedaṃ vilokyate ||52|| paścime raivataścāyaṃ pañcayojanataḥ paraḥ | ityuktvā śaṃkarādyaiśca pārvatīyuktatadgaṇaiḥ ||13|| sākṣatāḥ puṣpāṃjalayaścandanadravamiśritāḥ | vyomamārgādarpitāśca sāptabhaumālayopari ||54|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vijayatetarām | itiśabdairdhvanibhiśca diśo’pūryanta sarvataḥ ||55|| lomaśaḥ kaṃbharālakṣmīrgopālakṛṣṇa ūrdhvagān | ṛṣayaśca vilokyaitānabhijagmustadāmbare ||56|| jayaśabdā namaḥśabdā dhanyaśabdāstadābhavan | militvā cāvateruśca paścime setumaṇḍale ||57|| terunāmnāpradeśaḥ so’bhavatpaścimadigbhavaḥ | setunā ca kṛtaṃ tairvai pūrve gatvā pradakṣiṇam ||58|| ujjvalaḥ sa pradeśo’bhūt tataḥ pūrvaṃ gatāśca te | amarāṇāṃ gateryogādamarā bhūmikābhavat ||59|| dundubhiravayogena dunduravābhavacca bhūḥ | vyāghrāraṇyamukhe gatvā setunā te ca devatāḥ ||1.535.6 0|| dakṣiṇapaścimasetuṃ samāgatya tataśca te | vāpīdvīpaṃ sāptabhaumaṃ mandiraṃ, jagmurutsukāḥ ||61 || lomaśādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca svāgataṃ śubhamānanam | cakrurdevādhidevasya śaṃbhoḥ satyāḥ supūjanam ||62|| kauśāsanāni pradadurarghaṃ jalaṃ phalāni ca | saudhāntaḥsthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ yayustataḥ ||63|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yatra virājate | ciraṃjīviśatairyukto muktakoṭibhirarcitaḥ |64|| avatāraiḥ śobhitaśca devaiḥ saṃsevitaḥ prṝbhuḥ |. ūrjakṛṣṇasya saptamyāṃ niśāyāṃ pūjitaśca taiḥ ||65|| rādhāramādipatnībhirasaṃkhyābhirabhiṣṭutaḥ | śaṃkarādyairvedamantrairvarṇitaḥ ṣoḍaśādibhiḥ ||66|| nīrājitastataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śṛṃgāritaḥ punaḥ punaḥ | pārvatyā kastūrikayā bindurbhāle sakuṃkumaḥ ||67|| kṛtaḥ sākṣataśobhaśca śaṃbhunā tilakaṃ śubham | candanena kṛtaṃ ramyaṃ pārvatyā tu tataḥ punaḥ ||68||| koṭikandarpalāvaṇyabhṛtaṃ harikapolakam | sacandrakaṃ kṛtaṃ tvārdrakuṃkumena punaḥ punaḥ ||69|| rañjayāmāsa deveśī dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ manoharam | upadā vividhā ratnasauvarṇādīni cārpayat ||1.535.70|| daṇḍavat kṛtavantaste saṃbhāṣāṃ vidadhurmithaḥ | gopālanandano bālaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||71|| pūjottaraṃ svayaṃ svasyāsanādutthāya satvaram | nanāma pādayoḥ śaṃbhoḥ pārvatyāśca pareśvaraḥ ||72||| ātithyavidhinā pādau prakṣālya salilaṃ papau | saṃkalpena ca sainyānāṃ nivāsārthaṃ tu lomaśaḥ ||73|| cakārāraivataṃ yāvannagaraṃ vartulaṃ mahat | pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyākayojanānāṃ bhuvontare ||74|| vāsayāmāsa tān sarvān bhojyapānāśramādibhiḥ | sevayāmāsa sarvāṃśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||75|| śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaśca śaṃbhuṃ prāhāśrunetrakaḥ | dhanyo’haṃ kṛtakṛtyo’haṃ maddhāma pāvitaṃ tvayā ||76||| sarvavandyeṣu mūrdhanyaṃ padaṃ dattaṃ tvayā ca me | ete pareśvarāścānye yanmamāśramamāgatāḥ ||77|| dhanyeyaṃ pṛthivī śubhrā yāvadaṇḍaṃ bhaviṣyati | tāvacca pāvanī tīrtharūpā khyātā bhaviṣyati ||78|| kaṃbharākhyā mahālakṣmī pārvatīṃ prāha śobhanam | lokamātuḥ kimu vācyaṃ pāvitāhaṃ tvayā sati ||79|| tvayā duḥkhavihantryā ca vardhito mama bālakaḥ | tapobhiryā na dṛśyāsti sā dṛṣṭādya mayā sati | ||1.535.80|| pūrveṣāṃ saṃbhavānāṃ prasmāritaṃ puṇyamatra vai | svāgataṃ sarvathā haimi śāṃbhavi śāntimāvaha ||81|| ahaṃ dāsīsametā ca sevāṃ karomi śaṃ vaha | uktvaivaṃ kambharālakṣmīḥ pādasaṃvāhanaṃ tadā ||82|| pārvatyāstvatithirītyā cakre’nyasevanādikam | paryaṃkeṣu sudivyeṣu kailāsādadhikeṣu ca ||0||| vibhāntiṃ labdhavantaste śaṃkarādyāstu devatāḥ | bhojanāni supānāni tāmbūlakāni bhāvataḥ |||5|| daduḥ kṛṣṇajanāḥ sarve saṃjagṛhuḥ sukhāstu te | suṣupuḥ śaṃkarādyā vai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastadā ||85|| pārvatīṃ mātaraṃ prāha madvākyaṃ pālitaṃ sati | svāgataṃ te prakurvanti ramādyā mama cāṃganāḥ |||86||| iyaṃ me pārvatīnāmnī prabheyaṃ tatsahāyinī | māṇikīyaṃ mama kāntā lakṣmīriyaṃ pativratā |||87| rādheyaṃ lalitā ceyaṃ jayeyaṃ kamalā tviyam | | padminī bhārgavī ceyaṃ mukteyaṃ devikā tviyam ||88|| campeyaṃ hemabheyaṃ ca śānteyaṃ vājinī tviyam | mauktikeyaṃ maṃjuleyaṃ haṃseyaṃ saguṇā tviyam ||89|| evamanyāḥ sahasrāṇi vidyante tā ime’tra vai | tava sevāṃ prakurvantu yāmyahaṃ nijamandiram ||1.535.90|| ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagāma mandiram | suṣvāpa ca sukhaṃ prātastūryāṇi vividhāni ca ||91 || avādyanta hi divyāni prabodhaṃ lebhire janāḥ | ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamī ceyaṃ jayantī śrīharermama ||92|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāsīttataśca tai | śaṃkarādyā nityakāryaṃ kṛtvā sajjāḥ suśobhanāḥ ||93|| prātaḥ pūjāṃ cābhiṣekaṃ kartuṃ mandiramāyayuḥ | devatāḥ śaṃkarendrādyā munayaḥ ṛṣayastathā ||94|| pitaraḥ kaśyapāścānye brāhmaṇā mānavāstathā | muktā devyaḥ surakanyā nāgakanyāśca bhoginaḥ ||95|| gandharvāḥ kinnarā guhyā santaḥ kiṃpuruṣādayaḥ | sādhvyaḥ pativratā brahmavratinyo yogayoṣitaḥ ||96|| mātaro vanadevyaśca nadyaḥ puryaśca dhenavaḥ | gopyaścaitāḥ payaḥkulyā dadhikulyā ghṛtāni ca ||97|| madhukulyāḥ śarkarāḥ saṃgṛhya tīrthajalāni ca | sauvarṇakalaśānnītvā phalākṣatasamanvitān ||98|| jalayātrādividhayā kṛtvā mūrdhasu gītikāḥ | āyayuḥ sarvanāthādhiśritaṃ divyasumandiram ||99|| puṣpamālāścandanāni kastūrīścākṣatāstathā | puṣpasārarasām̐ścāpi sugandhitelakāni ca || 1.535.10 0|| mṛdyadravyāṇi ramyāṇi raktapātāni yāni ca | tā ādāya samājagmuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prati || 101 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svaṇāmbaraṃ śubham | paridhāya sarastīre svarṇasiṃhāsane vare || 1 02|| niṣasādātha daivādyairbṛhaspatyādibhistadā | bhūtaśuddhiṃ kārayitvā pradāyācamanāni ca || 103 || arghaṃ datvā jalasnānaṃ kārayitvā tataḥ param | dugdhakuṃbhe dugdhasnānaṃ kāritaṃ śubhadarśanam || 1 04|| dhanavo vyomamārgeṇa payāṃsi mumucustadā | gopyo devyādikāḥ kṛṣṇe vavṛṣurdadhi picchalam || 1 05|| devā ghṛtāni mumucurmadhūni vanadevatāḥ | pṛthvyādyāḥ pradadustasmin śarkarāsnānamujjvalam || 106 || abdhayaḥ saritastīrthottamānyadurjalāni ca | abhiṣekaṃ śubhaṃ cakrustataścandanatailajam || 1 07|| lepaṃ sammardanaṃ kṛtvā snāpayitvāmbarāṇi ca | dadurdivyāni devāśca bhūṣāśca dhanadā daduḥ || 1 08|| śrāṃgārikaṃ tathānye’nyāḥ sarvaṃ mahottamaṃ daduḥ | mukuṭaṃ kuṇḍale hārānūrmikāḥ śṛṃkhalādikāḥ ||1 09||| chatraṃ sucāmare kṛṣṇaṃ dhārayitvā tu devatāḥ | vaidikairmukhyasūktādyairnīrājanaṃ vyadhurmudā || 1.535.11 0|| kṣamāṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ datvā bhojanaṃ purato nyadhuḥ | bhagavān bubhuje pānaṃ papau dadau samāgatān|| 111 || prasādaṃ kānake pātre’kṣayyaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ yataḥ | atha tān bhojayāmāsurgālavādyā maharṣayaḥ || 11 2|| sāyaṃ praṇartanaṃ cakrurgāyanaṃ kīrtanāni ca | dānāni vividhānyevāsaṃkhyakāni dadau hariḥ || 11 3|| rātrau nīrājanaṃ cakrurjuhuvuśca hutāśane | utsavasya parihāraṃ kṛtvā suṣupurīśvarāḥ || 1 14|| sarve śāntā yoganidrāṃ gatā yugalakoṭayaḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya tadyātrāphalabhāgbhavet || 1 15|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dhyānasthaśaṃkarāt jñātvā kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ jigamiṣusagaṇaśaṃkarapārvatīśaktisatīdevadevītīrthadivyeśvarādisamastavibhūtidehibhiḥ samāgatyorjakṛṣṇāṣṭamījayantyāśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārcanaṃ kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmāpañcatriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||535||
<1.536> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha prātarnavamyāṃ prājāyanta tūryaniḥsvanāḥ | jajāgaruśca devādyāḥ snātvā veṣāṃśca dadhrire || 1 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadarśanahetave | ājagmuste pupūjuśca gopālakṛṣṇanandanam || 2 || śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaśca tathā śrīlomaśo muniḥ | patnīvratādyāścakruḥ saṃpūjāṃ teṣāṃ suvaidikīm || 3 || avatārārcanaṃ cakrurmunayastatra vāsinaḥ | tāni tīrthāni jātāni koṭiśo’tra sarovare || 4 || viṣṇoḥ śaṃbhorbrahmaṇaścārcanaṃ cakāra lomaśaḥ | śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇastu śaṃbhoḥ pūjanamācarat || 5 || śaṃbhuḥ prāha sadā cāhaṃ vasāmi kṛṣṇasannidhau | gopāleśvaranāmāhaṃ khyātiṃ yāsyāmi cātra vai || 6 || satī prāha sadā cāhaṃ kambharākamalārcitā | vatsyāmi śakarapārśve kambharākamaleśvarī || 7 || khyātā divyasvarūpeṇa bhaviṣyāmi ramecchayā | gaṇeśaḥ kārtikeyaśca mama putrau mayā saha || 8 || śukaśuṇḍho bhagavām̐śca kramānnāmnā bhaviṣyataḥ | santuṣṭā ca satī cāhaṃ brahmacaryaparāyaṇā || 9 || santoṣadurgānāmnī ca bhaviṣyāmi prabhoḥ puraḥ | evaṃ nandivīrabhadraprabhatayo gaṇāḥ sadā || 1.536.1 0|| tattannāmnā nivatsyanti śrīkṛṣṇamandirāgrataḥ | atha viṣṇorbrahmaṇaśca patnīyuktasya pūjanam || 11 || cakāra vidhinā śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇa ādarāt | tābhyāṃ tatra nivāso’pi kṛto divyena varṣmaṇā || 12|| tāni tīrthāni jātāni surāṇāṃ koṭikāni hi | devā gaṇāstathānye’pi vṛkṣā nadyaśca vallikāḥ || 1 3|| gandharvāḥ kinnarā anye kāśyapā divyadṛṣṭayaḥ | divyadehā nivāsān vai cakrire kṛṣṇasannidhau || 14|| saurāṣṭre sarvathā kṣetre kṛṣṇanārāyaṇājñayā | yeṣāṃ yatrābhavat hārde tatra te nyavasam̐stadā || 15|| atha bhojanapānāni kṛtavantaśca te surāḥ | devā devyo yayurnatvā nivāsanagare mudā || 16|| evaṃ vai devatāstatra nyuṣurmāsacatuṣṭayam | kiṃ bhāgyaṃ varṇaye bhūmerna bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 17|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāḥ kramāttadā | dattātreyo mahārājo vācayāmāsa nityadā || 18|| śuśruvuḥ parayā bhaktyā nityaṃ devyaśca devatāḥ | jaḍadāśca cetanāścāpi caturdaśabhuvāṃ prajāḥ || 19|| sendriyā māghaparyantaṃ divyanagarasaṃsthitāḥ | śivarātryāṃ yayuḥ sarve raivatācalaparvatam ||1.536.20 || dattātreyo bhagavāṃstu śṛṃge vāsaṃ vyadhād dṛḍham | ambā bhavastathā viṣṇuḥ svasvasthānāni bhejire ||21 || gaṇā devāstathā devyo yatheṣṭaṃ vāsamādadhuḥ | śivarātrivrataṃ tatra raivatādrau vidhāya ca ||22|| somanāthaṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ te yayustataḥ | taiḥ prabhāse kṛtākṣayyatṛtīyā tatra vai śubhā || 23|| pārvatī prāha bhagavan prabhāsaṃ kṣetramityapi | nāmnā samucyate kasmād vada me’rthaṃ yathārthakam ||24|| śaṃbhuḥ prāha śṛṇu kānte bhāsate mama yogataḥ| prakṛṣṭaṃ tatprabhāsaṃ vai vetraṃ nāmnā prakīrtyate ||25|| candramasaḥ prabhā āsan mamaiva varadānataḥ | kṣayasyāpagame kānte prabhāsaṃ tena kīrtyate || 26|| sūryaputrī prabhā bhūmau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapriyā | yatra tvāsa purā martyarūpā ramyā kumārikā ||27|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāptā tapasyayā | prabhāyā āsanaṃ yatra prabhāsaṃ tena kīrtyate ||28|| devairyatra prabhālabdhā tapobhirugrakairyataḥ | prathamaṃ bhāsamānaṃ tat sarvatīrtheṣu vartate ||29|| yatra śrīrbhāratī vahniṃ vāḍavaṃ sāgare’kṣipat | tadā vai bhāsamānaṃ tat prabhāsaṃ samajāyata ||1.536.30|| saurāṣṭrasya navamo yo bhāgo vibhāsate kṣitau | kīrtyā prabhāsaḥ proktaḥ saḥ prabhā jñānaṃ ca tatpradaḥ ||31 || prakṛṣṭā bhā bhāratī ca āsa vipramukheṣu yā | vedātmikāṃ prabhāsaṃ tatkṣetraṃ vai brāhmaṇapriyam |||32|| pratyakṣaṃ bhāskaraścārkadrumajanmasvarūpataḥ | yatra vai vartate tasmātprabhāsaṃ surabhāṣitam ||33|| sūryasyāsītpurā tejo duḥsahaṃ viśvakarmakaḥ | śāṇollīḍhaṃ raviṃ kṛtvā sahyatejaskamācarat || 34|| śāṇocchinnāni tejāṃsi vyabhajacchastrahetave | āyudhāni tejasāṃ ca kṛtāni viśvakarmaṇā || 35|| tathāpi śiṣyate tejastadatra sāgarāntike | sthāpitaṃ yacchanaiḥ śāntamabhavat tatprabhāsakam ||36|| tejasaḥ ṣoḍaśo bhāgaḥ sūryasya maṇḍale’bhavat | yattasya ṛṅmayaṃ tejastatprabhāse sthirīkṛtam ||37|| dyauḥ saṃpuṣṭiṃ prāpitā ca yajurmayena tejasā | svargaṃ prapoṣitaṃ sāmnā tejasā viśvakarmaṇā ||38|| anyena nirmitaṃ cakraṃ viṣṇorharasya śūlakam | dhanadasya ca śibikā daṇḍaḥ pretapatestathā ||39|| kārtikasya tathā śaktirgadā hanumatastathā | karavālaṃ tathā devyā mahākālasya pāśakaḥ ||1.536.40|| pāśupataṃ tathā nārāyaṇāstraṃ tvaṃśataḥ kṛtam | anyānyapi tathāstrāṇi yathāyogyaṃ kṛtāni hi ||41 || evaṃ sūryasya vai tejaḥ sāgarāntikamāsthitam | prabhāsaṃ tanmahatkṣetra mama devi nivāsabhūḥ ||42|| māheśvaryā dakṣiṇaṃ ca nyaṃkumatyāḥ kṛtasmaram | adriṃ vyāpya yojanānāṃ dvādaśābhiprabhāsakam ||43|| tatrārkavṛkṣatāṃ yātaḥ sūryo vaṃśānuvaṃśataḥ | arkavṛkṣaṃ pūjayet yaḥ kuṣṭhastasya vinaśyati ||44|| someśvarād vahnikoṇe siddheśvaro’hamāsthitaḥ | jaigīṣavyena siddhena tapo varṣasahasrakam |||45|| kṛtvāhaṃ sthāpitaḥ siddheśvaro bhavāmi śailaje | vālakhilyāstatra siddhiṃ jagmurvai tapasā parām ||46|| kṛtasmarāt samārabhya yāvadarkasthalaṃ sati | siddhayo’ṣṭau nivasanti mama sevāparāyaṇāḥ ||47|| brāhmī caiva hiraṇyā ca nadyau vai brahmaṇaḥ sute | maṃkīśarṣistathā santi sunandādyāśca mātaraḥ ||48|| kṛtasmaraṃ mahādriṃ ca dṛṣṭvā tu ṛṣayo dvijāḥ | asmābhiśca saha yātrākarā vāsāni cakrire ||49|| atrirvasiṣṭhaḥ pulahaḥ kraturbhṛguḥ pulastyakaḥ | marīciḥ kaśyapo bhāradvājo yamoṅgirā manuḥ ||1.536.50 || āpastambo’tha sāṃvartaḥ kāvyaḥ kātyāyanastathā | gautamaḥ śaṃkhalikhitau vācaspatistathāruṇiḥ ||51 || jāmadagnyo yājñavalkyaḥ ṛṣyaśṛṃgo vibhāṇḍakaḥ | gārgyaḥ śaunakadālbhyau ca vyāsa uddālakaḥ śubhaḥ ||52|| nāradaḥ parvataścaiva durvāsā ugratāpasaḥ | śākalyo gālavaścāpi jābālirmudgalaḥ ṛbhuḥ ||53|| viśvāmiśraḥ kauśikaśca jahnurviśvāvasustathā | dhaumyaścaiva śatānandaḥ śākaṭāyana ekataḥ ||54|| dvitastritastathā cānye ye cāsam̐śca samāgatāḥ | te yatheṣṭaṃ nijaśālāścakruścātra prabhāsake ||55|| jvalantastapasā sarve saṃsthitāḥ kṛtaparvate | somanāthaṃ somavāre pūjayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ||56|| snātvā sandhyādikaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā narāyaṇam | yogye vai maṇḍape ramye nyasya kuṃbhaṃ suśobhanam ||57|| cūtapallavaśobhāḍhyaṃ candanākṣatapūjitam | kuṃkumacandanaiḥ kṛtvā ghaṭārdhaṃ pratimānvitam ||58|| umādehārdhasaṃyuktaṃ śaṃkarārdhasamanvitam | yathābhūṣāśobhitaṃ ca yathāvastrādimaṇḍitam ||59|| umayā sahitaṃ śaṃbhuṃ pupūjustatra te dvijāḥ | dvividhairbhakṣyabhojyaiśca phalaiḥ pānairvilepanaiḥ ||1.536.60|| dhūpadīpottamairnīrājanaiḥ stutibhirīśvarāḥ | ānarcuryācayāmāsuḥ kṣamāṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ daduḥ ||61|| gāyanaṃ kīrtanaṃ cakrurnartanaṃ jāgarānvitam | yaḥ kaścit somavārāṇāṃ navakaṃ bhāvataścaret |||62|| śivatulyo bhavet so’pi jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ| samprāpte navame vāre kuryādudyāpanaṃ mahat ||63|| maṇḍalaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kuṇḍaṃ kārayet supariṣkṛtam | vedikāṃ kārayedramyāṃ caturasrāṃ sucitritām ||64|| padmaṃ ca kārayenmadhye dhānyasya maṇḍalasya ca | kalaśānaṣṭadigbhāge sahiraṇyān pṛthakpṛthak ||65|| navadurgāḥ pūjayecca madhye someśvaraṃ haram | rukmaśayyāsamārūḍhaṃ hemajaṃ pūjayed vratī ||66|| gandhasragdhūpanaivedyairvastrālaṃkāradarpaṇaiḥ | chatracāmaratāmbūlairdīpaghaṇṭāvitānakaiḥ ||67|| toṣayitvā haraṃ paścād dānaṃ śrīgurave dadet | homaṃ ca kārayed dadyātpāyasānnaṃ baliṃ śubham ||68|| rātrau ca jāgṛyāt pañcagavyaṃ pītvā haraṃ smaret | prabhāte tu tataḥ snātvā dhyāyet somaṃ kṣaṇaṃ punaḥ ||69|| tataḥ prapūjya someśaṃ kṣīrakhaṇḍādinirmitaiḥ | bhakṣyabhojyairanekaiśca naivedyaṃ śaṃbhave dadet ||1.536.70|| brāhmaṇān bhojayed devān ṛṣīn pitṝm̐śca tarpayet| | atithīn pūjayeccāpi kanyāḥ saṃbhojayettathā ||71|| vastradānaṃ kārayecca godānaṃ ca prakārayet | āśīrvādām̐śca gṛhṇīyāt parihāraṃ samācaret ||72|| evaṃ cīrṇavrataṃ samyak labhate puṇyamakṣayam | dhānyadhanādisamṛddhiṃ putradārādikām̐stathā ||73|| na vandhyātvaṃ bhavettasyā dāridryaṃ nāśamāpnuyāt | ṛṣibhiśca suraiḥ somavāravrataṃ kṛtaṃ tathā ||74|| dānāniṃ pradadustadvadudyāpanaṃ dadhustathā | śaṃkaraḥ prāha deveśi doṣām̐styaktvā svabhāvajān ||75|| tīrthaṃ kuryājjanastena labhate śāśvataṃ phalam | tīrthānugamanaṃ padbhyāṃ tapaḥ paraṃ phalapradam ||76|| chatropānadvihīnastu tairthiko’ghāni nāśayet | pārakyānnaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ bhaikṣyaṃ pārakyameva na ||77|| devatānāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca mātāpitroḥ satāṃ tathā | kuṭumbasya smaraṇaṃ ca tīrthe kāryaṃ mumukṣuṇā ||78|| tīrthe doṣānna gṛhṇīyād vajralepā bhavanti yat | luṭhillā luṇṭhayettatra nṛtyan gāyan hasam̐stathā ||79|| dhūlīdhūsarasarvāṃgo bhavettīrthe hariṃ smaret |. oṃ namaḥ somanāthāya pārvatīpataye namaḥ ||1.536.80|| japenmantraṃ somanāthe sarvapāpapraṇāśanam | dhyāyet someśvaraṃ māṃ ca tvayā sārdhaṃ maheśvari ||81 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | ityevaṃ śrāvayellokān kārayedbhajanaṃ hareḥ ||82|| vaiṣṇavān praṇamenmārge śrīpatiṃ hṛdi dhārayet | nāsti saurāṣṭrasadṛśo deśo vai jagatītale ||83|| somanāthasamaṃ tīrthaṃ me nāsti bhuvi pārvati | pāpināṃ pāpaśamanaṃ vratināmīpsitapradam ||84|| abhāgyānāṃ bhāgyakaraṃ brahmalokapradāyakam | tulāpuruṣadānaṃ ca tathā brahmāṇḍadānakam ||85|| pṛthivīkṣetradānaṃ ca kalpapādapadānakam | hiraṇyasya kāmadhenorgajāśvānāṃ ca dānakam ||86|| rathānāṃ ca gṛhāṇāṃ ca ratnānāṃ dānakāni ca | kalaśānāṃ ca kanyānāṃ vidyānāṃ dānakāni ca ||87|| kalpalatānāṃ dānāni jīvadānaṃ jalārpaṇam | vṛttidānaṃ tathodyānadānaṃ cāraṇyadānakam ||88|| samudratīradānaṃ ca parvatānāṃ pradānakam | gomahiṣīpradānaṃ ca vanavāṭīpradānakam ||89|| jñānadānaṃ muktidānaṃ svargadānaṃ phalārpaṇam | sarvasvārpaṇadānaṃ ca punaḥ prāptyai samācaret ||1.536.90|| kūpavāpīsarodānaṃ pāṣāṇakāṣṭhadānakam | yānayantraśibikādidānaṃ madhurasārpaṇam ||91 || kartavyaṃ ca yathāśakti saurāṣṭre mama tīrthake | prāsādaṃ dhavalaṃ saudhaṃ kārayejjīrṇamuddharet ||92|| tīrthamabhyuddharejjīrṇaṃ paropakṛtimācaret | paropakārakartṝṇāṃ śreyaḥ paraṃ bhavet sati ||93|| keciddānaprabhāveṇa kecit snānena mānavāḥ | kecid dhyānaprabhāveṇa kecidyogena vā janāḥ ||94|| kecijjñānena vā kecijjapena sevayāpare | kathāyāḥ śravaṇenāpi kecit kīrtananartanaiḥ ||95|| pūjanaiścāpare tīthairvandanaiḥ stavanaiḥ pare | anye sannyasanairbhaktyā dāsyenānye japena ca ||96|| sarvathārpaṇabhāvena tīrthasthā yānti sadgatim | indriyairhīna evāpi tīrthapūto bhavet priye ||97|| prabhāse nidhanaṃ prāpto bhavenmama parigrahaḥ | evaṃ prabhāsaṃ dhyātvaiva samāśrayenmamānugaḥ ||98|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi śaṃbhunā somatīrthake | pārvatyai sārarūpaṃ ca cakrurvāsāni devatāḥ ||99|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya deśāntaranivāsinaḥ | tīrthayātrāphalaṃ syācca bhuktimuktistathā bhavet || 1.536.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃkarādīnāṃ raivatācala(giranāra)tīrthe somanāthatīrthe ca yātrākaraṇaṃ, prabhāsanāmaniruktiḥ, arkavṛkṣātmakatārkasya, somanāthapūjā, dānādi, mahimā, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||536||
<1.537> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tathānyāni tīrthāni kathitāni ca | śaṃbhunā himavatputryai tānyapi kathayāmi te || 1 || vāḍavāgnikṣepatīrthaṃ samudre vartate sadā | tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta vahnivat pāvano bhavet || 2 || padmakaṃ ca tato gacched vapanaṃ tatra kārayet | hṛdi smaran somanāthaṃ keśām̐statra viniḥkṣipet || 3 || pāpāni keśasaṃsthāni vilīyante tathākṛte | sabhartṛkāṅgulamātraṃ pṛṣṭhakeśān hi chedayet || 4 || ācamanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā snāyāt sāmudrake jale | te’gniryoniriḍā deho retodhāmṛtasya nābhiḥ || 5 || tasmai te ratnagarbhāya namo’vagrahe te jale | iti snātvā tilamiśrajalaiḥ pitṝm̐śca tarpayet || 6 || purā devairdīrghasatraṃ prārabdhaṃ ca prabhāsake | sarvasvaṃ brāhmaṇendrāṇāṃ prabhāsavāsināṃ daduḥ || 7 || dānaṃ devāstadā cāyan dvijā dūratarā api | dakṣiṇādānavāñcchāśca tāvad devāḥ savāsavāḥ || 8 || sarvasvadānato riktāḥ prārthanābhaṃgabhītitaḥ | praṇaṣṭā brāhmaṇān dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇāścānuvavrajuḥ || 9 || surāḥ samudramāviśyodare tatra vyavasthitāḥ | samudro mūrtimān bhūtvā satkārārthaṃ taṭasthitaḥ || 1.537.1 0|| kṛtrimaṃ bhojanaṃ ramyaṃ viprebhyo matsyamiśritam | dadau ca brāhmaṇāḥ sarve bubhujuḥ svarṇabhājane || 1 1|| na vyajānan guptamāṃsaṃ bhakṣitaṃ ceti vai tataḥ | pūrvamākāśagantāro hyāsam̐ste brāhmaṇāḥ khalu || 12|| bhojanottaramevaite patitāḥ sahasā bhuvi | savismayāḥ samūcuste kimatra kāraṇaṃ bhavet || 13|| tatraiko yogavṛttyā ca jñātavān vāridheḥ kriyām | vañcitā iti vai jñātvā śepurviprāstu vāridhim || 14|| tvayopaguptamasmākaṃ māṃsamannena saṃyutam | dattaṃ vai bhojane tasmādaspṛśyo bhava sarvadā || 15|| tato varṣasahasraṃ tu aspṛśyo’bhūttu vāridhiḥ | tato duḥkhena cātmānaṃ śoṣayāmāsa vai jalam || 16|| sthalākāro’bhavad yāvad devā yayuḥ pitāmaham | sāmudrajalayogena vṛṣṭyā sasyāni bhūtale || 17|| jāyante ca prajāḥ sarvāḥ puṣyanti tena sarvathā | samudrasya jalaṃ rakṣa yathā śoṣaṃ na gacchati || 18|| iti te prārthayāṃcakrurbrahmā śrutvā taṭaṃ yayau | aspṛśyatāvāraṇārthaṃ prārthayāmāsa bhūsurān || 1 9|| brāhmaṇāḥ pratigṛhṇantu ratnāni vāridhestathā | vāridhiṃ śāpamuktaṃ ca prakurvantu kṣamāyutāḥ ||1.537.20|| brāhmaṇāḥ prārthayāmāsurbrahmāṇaṃ tvaṃ tathā kuru | brahmā prāha tadābdhiṃ ca tridhā medhyo bhaviṣyasi ||21 || parvakāleṣu ca nadīsaṃgameṣu tathā sadā | taṭatīrtheṣu medhyastvaṃ sparśasnānaprado bhava ||22|| pūjyaśca sarvadā tatrānyatrāpi devapūjane | abhiṣeke tava vāri sadā medhyaṃ bhavediti ||23|| evamaspṛśyatānāśaṃ cakrire brāhmaṇādayaḥ | ratnāni jagṛhuḥ sarve prayayurnijaketanam ||24|| tataḥ snāsyati yaḥ samyak sāgare lavaṇāmbhasi | aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpsyati cātra saḥ ||25|| śrīsomeśasamudrasyāntare ye tu mṛtā janāḥ | pāpino’pi gamiṣyanti svargaṃ nirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ ||26|| evaṃ vai sajalastvabdhiḥ pavitratvaṃ purā gataḥ | someśādākṛtasmaraṃ kṣetraṃ sāgarasannidhau || 27|| koṭitīrthamayaṃ sarvaṃ svargamokṣapradaṃ param | evaṃ snātvā somanāthaṃ gacched draṣṭuṃ vratī tataḥ ||28|| snāpayitvā vidhānena japettu śatarudrikām | snāpayetpayasā dadhnā ghṛtena madhunāpi ca ||29|| ikṣurasena ca tataḥ kuṃkumena vilepayet | karpūrośīramiśreṇa mṛganābhiyutena ca ||1.537.3 0|| candanena sugandhena dhūpairdīpaistathāmbaraiḥ | naivedyaistarpayitvā taṃ nīrājayennamettathā ||3 1 || stutimaṣṭāṃganatyādi gītaṃ vādyaṃ ca nartanam | pradakṣiṇaṃ kathāṃ kuryācchṛṇuyātpārameśvarīm ||32|| vipratapasvidīnāndhakṛpaṇebhyo dadet dhanam | bhojanaṃ svambaraṃ cāpi dāpayet bhāvayet vratī ||33|| evaṃ someśvaratīrth yaḥ karoti vidhānataḥ | dhanāḍhyaḥ saptajanmāni tataḥ kailāsamāvrajet ||34|| sāndhyamārārtrikaṃ kuryāttasya mokṣo bhaved dhruvam | atha lakṣmi pañcanadyastīrthaṃ tatra tu mokṣadam ||35|| hariṇī brahmiṇī nyaṃkuḥ kapilā ca sarasvatī | prabhāse saṃvartate vai pañcasrotā sarasvatī ||36|| śṛṇu lakṣmi purā sātra yathāgatā sarasvatī | purā cendrādayo jitvā daityān pṛthvīṃ samāgatāḥ ||37|| dadhīcerāśramaṃ dṛṣṭvā dadṛśurdadhīcimṛṣim | āyudhāni vimucyāgre rakṣemānīti vai daduḥ ||38|| deyāni syuḥ punastāni śatrubhiryadi no raṇaḥ | muktvāstrāṇi yayuḥ svargaṃ śatavarṣottaram ṛṣiḥ ||39|| jalena ca sahāstrāṇi pītvā yayau himālayam | pippaladrumamadhye saḥ cacāra paramaṃ tapaḥ ||1.537.40|| tato devaiḥ samāgatyāstrāṇyarthitāni sarvaśaḥ | dadhīciḥ prāha dehe me’sthirūpāṇi vasanti vai ||41 || golokād gāḥ samānīya karkaśajihvikādibhiḥ | nandāṃ subhadrāṃ surabhiṃ suśīlāṃ sumanāṃ tathā ||42|| ājñāpayantu me’sthnāṃ saṃprāptyarthaṃ lehane tu tāḥ | devā evaṃprakāreṇa prāpurasthīni vai tataḥ ||43|| devaspṛṣṭāstu tā gāvaḥ śuddhāḥ pūjyā yathāsthitāḥ | mukhamekaṃ paraṃ tāsāṃ na spṛṣṭaṃ raktalepitam ||44|| asthnāmastrāṇi kṛtvaiva devā niryayurambaram | dadhīcestu subhadrāyāṃ jāto bālaḥ suplakṣakaḥ ||45|| uvāca mātaraṃ kvāsti pitā me janani tataḥ | sā prāha nidhanaṃ prāpto devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye ||46|| bālaścacāra ca tapo himācale tataḥ khalu | tasya ūroḥ samutpannā ūruryā vaḍavābhidhā ||47|| sāpi tejomayī jātā tejo’pi niḥsṛtaṃ bahiḥ | aurvo’yaṃ vāḍavo’gnistadvanaṃ dadāha dāruṇaḥ ||48|| devāḥ sarasvatīṃ prāhurdevi hyenaṃ praśāmaya | sarasvatī tu taṃ nītvā bālarūpaṃ prabhāsake ||49|| samāgatya pracikṣepa samudre vaḍavānalam | kumārikākarabālo bubhuje lavaṇodakam ||1.537.50|| pupoṣa tatra vai tiṣṭhannādyāpyabdhiṃ pramuñcati | yatra tāpo’bhavattasyāḥ kṣaṇaṃ sādṛśyatāṃ gatā |||51 || punaḥ śītā samāgṛhya nayati sameti bhūtale | naikasthaleṣu guptā sā naikasthāneṣu gocarā ||52|| evaṃ kṛtvā yayau cābdhiṃ nikṣipyovāsa vai ciram | prācī sarasvatī sā tu prabhāse vartate sadā ||53 || tatra vai ṛṣayaścāsam̐ścatvāro viṣṇusadṛśāḥ | hiraṇyaścātha vajraśca nyaṃkuḥ kapila ityapi ||54|| pṛthakpṛthaksamāhūtāḥ snānārthaṃ taiḥ sarasvatī | sāgaro’pi tadā tasyāḥ sammukhaḥ sahasā sthitaḥ ||55|| ṛṣīṇāṃ sevanārthaṃ sā pañcarūpā babhūva ha | hariṇī vajriṇī nyaṃkvī kāpilī sāgarī tathā |||56 || pañcāpi pāpahantryastāḥ pāvanyaḥ pāpināṃ sadā | māṃsamadyastainyanārībhogadoṣādināśinī ||57|| kṛtasmaro rodhakartā dagdho’dristena vahninā | śvetopalāstu tā jātā rāsanyaḥ saudhakārikāḥ ||58|| cākṣuṣasyāntare vahnirdādhīco vāḍavānalaḥ | vaivasvatāntare aurvo bhārgavo vaḍavānalaḥ ||59|| śaṃkarasya lalāṭāgniryaḥ sa evāyamucyate | tīrthe cātra sarasvatyā gūheśvaraṃ sutīrthakam ||1.537.6 0|| āmardakīnadīyoge saṃgameśvaratīrthakam | govatsakaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ jhillītīrthaṃ paraṃ śubham ||61 || kūṣmāṇḍasya muneḥ sthānaṃ kūṣmāṇḍeśvarasaṃjñitam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatra samāgatya sarasvatīm ||62|| svāgataṃ kārayāmāsa kūṣmāṇḍamuninā tadā | śramaṃ ca nāśayāmāsa vāḍavānalabhārajam ||6 3 || tāpaṃ ca śamayāmāsa svakarasparśamātrataḥ | kumārī sārthayāmāsaikākinyā ca mayā prabho ||64|| kanyayā cātra vai kathaṃ vastavyaṃ rakṣakaṃ vinā | pātā rakṣayitā nāsti mama cātra vane hare ||65 || tasmāt pātā mama tvatra bhava tvaṃ puruṣottama | yadvā kuṃkumavāpyāṃ vā cāśvapaṭṭasarovare ||66 || tava gṛhe samāgatya tatra tiṣṭhāmi pādayoḥ | ityuktvāśrāvilanetrā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prati ||67|| dīneva cāpyanātheva kṣaṇaṃ jātā kumārikā | tataḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastāṃ gṛhya pāṇinā ||68|| śokaṃ vai dūrayāmāsa sāpi kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | kaṇṭhalagnābhavat sādhvī vavre nārāyaṇaṃ patim ||69|| sumanomālikāṃ kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe dadau sarasvatī | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagrāha bhāvataḥ ||1.537.70|| sanāthāṃ tāṃ tathā kṛtvovācātra tvaṃ sthirā bhava | nadīrūpeṇa deveśi lokoddhārasya hetave ||71 || sarasvatī tadā prāha nāthāhaṃ svāminaṃ vinā | sthātuṃ śakyā kathaṃ tasmāttvamatra mokṣado vasa ||72 || ityuktaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam | sarasvatīpatiḥ sākṣāt pippalasya drumo’bhavat || 73 || akṣayaḥ pippalavṛkṣo vartate yatra sā priyā | mūle saṃgaṃ samāsādya nityaṃ tvāste sarasvatī ||74|| yatrāhaṃ kṛṣṇarūpeṇa lakṣmi layaṃ gataḥ sadā | vartāmyeva na jānanti janā māṃ netragocaram |||75||| pitṝṇāṃ sarvadā mokṣaṃ tatra karomi piṇḍataḥ | lakṣmīḥ sadā ca mūle me tvāste’pavādamantarā |||76 || atha kālāntare cāha naikasāhasrayoṣitām | pariṇītānāṃ ca patirlayaṃ yāsyāmi tatsthale ||77|| evamuktvā satīṃ patnīṃ jalarūpāṃ vidhāya ca | dvitīyaṃ yuvatīrūpaṃ saha nītvā mama priyam ||78|| navoḍhāsahitaścāhaṃ tvaśvapaṭṭasarovaram | mamālayaṃ hyagamaṃ ca vasāmi tu tayā saha ||79|| tatra sarasvatī devī sadāste caraṇe mama | lokānāṃ vacane cāpi jayadā hi virājate ||1.537.80 || evameṣā brahmaṇastu putrī satyanivāsinī | kumārī haimaśailasthā kurukṣetre samāgatā ||8 1 || bhadrāvarte puṣkare ca śrīsthale siddhabhūtale | pāñcāle’śvapaṭṭasarovare svarṇapure tathā ||82| raivate ca prabhāse ca tathā bahusthale punaḥ | kālabhedena bhaktānāmupāsanabalena ca ||83 || prayāgādau tathā tīrthottamādau daivakāryataḥ | prasaṃgena gatā seyaṃ prabhāse ca mama priyā ||84|| svarganiḥśreṇisaṃbhūtā prācī sarasvatī satī | vartate jīvakalyāṇakarī mama vacaḥsthitā ||85|| devāste na manuṣyāste nadī tisraḥ pibanti ye | candrabhāgāṃ ca gaṃgāṃ ca tathā devīṃ sarasvatīm ||86 || yamunāṃ ca gaṇḍakīṃ ca svarṇarekhāṃ ca vā nadīm | yathā kāmadughā gāvaḥ sarvakālaphalapradāḥ ||87|| cintāmaṇisamāstisro nadyastāḥ kāmapūrikāḥ | aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi munīnāmūrdhvaretasām ||88 || yatra sthitāni tīrthe vai tasmāt kimadhikaṃ bhavet | nārāyaṇena sahito naro loke yugāntare ||89|| kalyavatārarūpasya tathā tatsahayāyinām | saṃhartā doṣanāśārthaṃ snāsyatyatra punaḥ punaḥ || 1.537.90 || prācī sarasvatī doṣān hatyājān kṣālayatyapi | trirātropoṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā snātavyaṃ doṣaśāntaye ||91 || sarasvatyuttare tīre tanuṃ tyaktvā prayāti vai | brahmalokaṃ śāśvataṃ sa hyapunarbhavamārakam ||92|| śrāddhakartuścaikaviṃśatikuloddharaṇaṃ bhavet | yaṃ yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya prāṇaprayāṇamāpyate ||93 || sa tadbhāvasamāyukto yātā bhavati mānavaḥ | purā nāmnābhavad rājā bṛhadratha iti śrutaḥ ||94|| tasya bhāryābhavatsādhvī nāmnā tvindumatī satī | ekadā tadgṛhaṃ prāptaḥ ṛṣiḥ kaṇva iti śrutaḥ ||95|| rājā tatsvāgataṃ cakre papraccha kuśalādikam | tato dharmakathāṃ cakre sa ṛṣirnṛpasannidhau ||96 || indumatī ṛṣiṃ natvā papraccha prāgbhavaṃ svakam | rājyaṃ saukhyaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ devopamaḥ patirmama ||97|| sukhaṃ mānyaṃ ca sampattiḥ kasya prāptaṃ phalaṃ mayā | kaṇvaḥ prāha śṛṇuḥ rājñi mā roṣaṃ kuru māṃ prati ||98|| tvamāsīranyadehe tu hyābhīrī śīlavarjitā | saurāṣṭraviṣaye yātā snātuṃ prabhāsake tadā ||99|| tvayā hastāt kaṃkaṇaṃ ca hemnastatrārpitaṃ śubham | tīrthe mahātmyamājñāya brāhmaṇānāṃ mukhāttataḥ || 1.537.1 00|| tena puṇyena dāśārṇanṛpateḥ kanyakā bhuvi | bṛhadrathena voḍhāsi rājñī jātāsi cottamā || 101 || iti prabhāsamāhātmyaṃ śrutvā sā punareva ca | tīrthaṃ kṛtvā samudre ca kaṃkaṇaṃ prākṣipat punaḥ || 1 02|| tato devī svargavāsā kalpāyuṣkābhavacchubhā | ityevaṃ lakṣmi māhātmyaṃ prabhāsābdhijalasya vai || 1 03|| bhuktimuktipradaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena yojitam | śaṃkaraḥ pārvatī sarvāḥ kathāḥ prāha punaḥ punaḥ || 1 04|| pārvatī kaṃkaṇaṃ tatra dadau cābdhau tu kānakam | śaṃkaro’bhūt prasannaśca devyo’pi tāni saṃdaduḥ || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vahnitīrthaṃ samudrapāvitryaṃ, dadhīcaplakṣakavaḍavānalasarasvatī vṛttāntam, pañcasrotomayīsarasvatī, pippaladrumakūṣmāṇḍatīrthaṃ, samudre kaṃkaṇadānenābhīryā rājñītvaṃ, dānamahimā, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ |||537|||
<1.538> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tataḥ śaṃbhuḥ prāha satīṃ tu pārvatīm | varāhākhyo mahāviṣṇuḥ somatīrthe pratiṣṭhati || 1 || tathā brahmā gaṇeśaśca herambanāmataḥ sthitaḥ | tathā kapardināmāpi kṣetrarakṣākaraḥ sthitaḥ || 2 || atastatra mahātīrthe kapardīśrīgaṇādhipaḥ | pūjanīyastathā viṣṇurvarāho’rcyaḥ sadā janaiḥ || 3 || āsīd rājā purā devi śaśabinduritismṛtaḥ | sa tu sākaṃ bhāryayā vaihāyasena pathaikadā || 4 || vimānena yayau tīrthaṃ kartuṃ prabhāsamuttamam | phālgune kṛṣṇapakṣe tu caturdaśyāṃ niśāmukhe || 5 || atha someśvarakṣetre vratino’tra samāgatān | apaśyanmunivaryāṃśca tadvā jāgaraṇe sthitān || 6 || somanāthaṃ munīn natvā kaṃcit kedārakaṃ prati | yayau tatra sthitaṃ liṃgaṃ pupūja paramādarāt || 7 || ṛṣayaste ca papracchuḥ kathaṃ muktvā tu somakam | kedāraṃ pūjitaṃ rājan vadātra kāraṇaṃ tu naḥ || 8 || rājā prāha purā cāhaṃ saurāṣṭre śūdravarṇajaḥ | abhavaṃ bhāryayā sākaṃ kṣetre cātra samāgataḥ || 9 || hariṇīsariti tatra kamalāni mayā tadā | dṛṣṭāni tāni nītāni vikrayārthaṃ mayā tadā || 1.538.1 0|| somanāthasamīpaṃ ca vikrayārthaṃ sthito divā | astaṃgate’pi ca ravau krītāni kenacinna vai || 11 || tato’haṃ kṣudhayā vyāpto gato liṃgasamīpataḥ | tatra kācidanaṃgākhyā śivarātrivratasthitā || 12|| svatantrā strī jāgaraṇe gītanṛtyotsave ratā | mayā dṛṣṭā tathā pṛṣṭā kimetat kriyate tvayā || 1 3|| sā māmuvāca hi tadā śivarātrivrataṃ prati | vratakartā duḥkhahīno jāyate sampadā yutaḥ || 14|| bhayarogāriṣṭanāśo jāyate’sya pade pade | atha śrutvā mama buddhirutpannā tadvrataṃ prati || 15|| upavāsaḥ sahajato jātaḥ padmasthale mama | snātvā taiḥ kamalairdevo rudreśaḥ pūjitastadā || 16|| jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtaṃ patnyā sākaṃ kalyāṇavāñcchayā | tatpuṇyena ca rājāsmi rājñī ceyaṃ mama priyā || 17|| jātismaraḥ sabhāryo’smi tato rudreśvaraṃ khalu | kedāre saṃsthitaṃ tvatra pūjayāmi purārcitam || 18|| ato rudreśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ rājyapradaṃ prapūjanāt | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ pradaṃ śāntipradaṃ sukham || 19|| svatantrā yā pramadā ca pūjayitrī tadābhavat | sā tu raṃbhānāmasvargāpsarā jātā manoharā ||1.538.20|| evaṃ kedārarudreśaṃ tīrthaṃ tatra pravartate | tataḥ saṃpūjayet tatra śvetaketvīśvaraṃ haram ||21 || śvetaketunṛpeṇātra purā kṛtvā tapaḥ param | muktirlabdhā tatra śaṃbhuḥ śvetaketvīśvaro’bhavat ||22|| athādityeśvaraṃ preyāt pūrvasyāṃ saṃsthitaṃ haram | atha śaṃbhustripurasya vināśāya svanetrataḥ ||23|| aśru mumoca krodhena sa bhaumo maṃgalo’bhavat | tena vai pūjitastatra bhaumeśvaro’bhavaddharaḥ ||24|| evaṃ navagrahatīrthaṃ tatra 3 vartate priye | jñānakriyecchāḥ śaktayastisro nārāyaṇasya yāḥ ||25|| maṃgalā ca viśālā ca catvarā tāḥ sthitāḥ sadā | tāsāṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ cātra prabhāse śāntidāyakam ||26|| viśālākṣī tathā viṣṇoḥ samutpannā purā yudhe | daityānāṃ tu vināśārthaṃ tattīrthe caṃ prabhāsake ||27|| lakṣmi sākaṃ tvayā cāhaṃ gatavān vai purā yuge | lakṣmītīrthaṃ tathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tīrthakam ||28|| vartate somasatkṣetre darśanānmuktidaṃ śubham | kāmatīrthaṃ ratitīrthaṃ vartate ca prabhāsake ||29|| gaurītīrthamiṣātīrthaṃ pāpahantu vibhāsate | nāradastvekadā cakre puṇḍarīkaṃ kratuṃ purā ||1.538.3 0|| nāradakratutīrthaṃ tad vartate tu prabhāsake | gautamo’pi munistatra purā yātrārthamāgataḥ ||3 1 || cāturmāsaṃ tapaścakre gautamaṃ tīrthamucyate | ādau kṛte yuge daityo mahān vai meghavāhanaḥ ||32|| abhūnmahāśarīraḥ sa yojanāyatavistṛtaḥ | pāduke dve samāruhya ādinārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||33|| jaghāna taṃ mahādaityaṃ pādukātīrthamucyate | pādukayā hato daityastāḍitayā tu vakṣasi ||34|| pādukāsanasaṃstho’haṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam | tiṣṭhāmi somake tīrthe mokṣado’suranāśakaḥ ||35|| iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi māhātmyaṃ viṣṇudaivatam | athaikādaśarudrāṇāṃ tīrthāni santi tatra vai ||36|| ajaikapādahirbudhno virūpākṣo’tha raivataḥ | haraśca bahurūpaśca tryambakaśca sureśvaraḥ ||37|| prāṇo’pānaḥ samānaścodāno vyānaśca vāyavaḥ | nāgaśca kūrmaḥ kṛkalo devadatto dhanaṃjayaḥ ||38|| ātmā ceti kramājjātā rudrā hyekādaśaiva te | amūrtā mūrtimāpannāstattīrthaṃ ca prabhāsake ||39|| nandināpi tapastaptaṃ mṛtyuñjayaharopari | nanditīrthaṃ tu tattatra vartate bahupuṇyadam ||1.538.40|| dhenūrbhūtvā purā pṛthvī tīrthārthaṃ tatra cāgatā | someśaṃ snapayāmāsa satī dugdhasya dhārayā ||41 || tataḥ snātvā vilīnābhūd yatra gotīrthameva tat | pāpatāpaharaṃ jātaṃ pṛthivyā yogataḥ priyam ||42|| atha pūrvaṃ samudre’bhūd virāvo nāma rākṣasaḥ | manuṣyādo hatastatra sudarśanena viṣṇunā ||43|| tadidaṃ paścime jātaṃ virāvalayanaṃ sthalam | viṣṇucakraprapūtaṃ ca tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam ||44|| cakrapāṇirahaṃ pūjyastatra virāvalīnake | pūjako me paraṃdhāma yāsyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||45|| atha dvādaśasūryāśca viṣṇordarśanahetave | prabhāsaṃ prathamaṃ yānti tato’śvapaṭṭasārasam ||46|| kṣetraṃ yānti darśanārthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya te | viṣṇurdhātā bhagaḥ pūṣā maitrendrau varuṇo’ryamā ||47|| vivasvavānaṃśumām̐stvaṣṭā parjanyo dvādaśaiva te | svasvamāsāntake kāle snātvā yānti prabhāsake ||48|| viṣṇuḥ saṃsnāti vai caitre vaiśākhe tvaryamā tathā | vivasvān jyeṣṭhamāse’tha cāṣāḍhe tvaṃśumām̐stathā ||49|| parjanyaḥ śrāvaṇe māsi bhādre tu varuṇastathā | indraścāśvayuji māsi dhātā saṃsnāti kārtike ||1.538.50|| mārgaśīrṣe tathā mitraḥ pūṣā pauṣe prayāti ca | māghe bhagastathā tvaṣṭā snāti tatra ca phālgune ||51 || ete vai naijamāsānte taptvā snātvā prayānti ca | ityādityasthalaṃ tīrthaṃ prabhāse vartate śubham ||52|| athāṣṭavarṣako brahmā somanāthasya tūtsave | āgato’bhūt pratiṣṭhāyāṃ pūrvasyāṃ tasya cāsanam ||53|| brahmatīrthaṃ tu tatproktaṃ snānātpāpavināśakam | brahmāṇamaṣṭavarṣaṃ ca rathe saṃsthāpya śobhite ||54|| sāvitrīsahitaṃ māse kārtike pūrṇimādine | vāhayet kārayed yātrāṃ somanāthaṃ prati dhruvam ||55|| pūjayed bhaktibhāvena ṣoḍaśādyupacārakaiḥ | rathaṃ tu karṣayet tasya caturmukhasya sarvathā ||56|| punaḥ saṃsthāpayettasya mandire vādyanartanaiḥ | rāṣṭrasya śreyamanvicchan rathayātrāṃ prakārayet ||57|| ahaṃ lakṣmi kathayāmi yatra yatra pitāmahaḥ | vartate bhūtale sṛṣṭau kalpe kalpāntare’pi vā || 58 || kālenāstaṃ sthalaṃ cāpi smaraṇīyaṃ sukhapradam | puṣkare sa suraśreṣṭho gayāyāṃ prapitāmahaḥ ||59|| vedagarbhaḥ kānyakubje bhṛgukacche caturmukhaḥ | sṛṣṭikartā ca kauberyāṃ nandigrāme bṛhaspatiḥ ||1.538.6 0 || aṣṭavarṣaḥ prabhāse ca kāśyāṃ surapriyo hi saḥ | caturvedo dvārikāyāṃ vaidiśe bhuvanādhipaḥ ||6 1 || pauṇḍrake puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ pītākṣo hastināpure | vijayākhyo jayantyāṃ sa jagannāthe jayantakaḥ ||62|| vādyadeśe padmahastastamolau ca tamopahāḥ | ahicchatre janānandaḥ kāñcyāṃ janapriyo hyajaḥ ||63|| karṇāṭake ca vai brahmā ṛṣyaśṛṃge munīśvaraḥ | śrīkaṇṭhe śrīnivāsākhyaḥ kāmarūpe śubhākaraḥ ||64|| uḍḍīsāyāṃ devakatāṃ sraṣṭā jālandhare tathā | mallikāyāṃ ca sa viṣṇurmahendrādau tu bhārgavaḥ ||65|| gohaste sthaviro brahmā ujjayinyāṃ pitāmahaḥ | kauśāmbyāṃ ca mahādevaḥ sākete’rkapitāmahaḥ ||66 || citrakūṭe virañciśca vandhye vārāhaviśvasṛṭ | haridvāre sureśaśca himādrau haṃsavāhanaḥ ||67|| haihikāyāṃ vedahasto’rbudādrau padmahastakaḥ | vṛndāvane padmanetro naimiṣe kuśahastakaḥ ||68|| gopakṣetre gocaro’yaṃ sucandro yamunātaṭe | gaṃgātīre padmabhūśca janasthāne jalodbhavaḥ ||69|| dakṣiṇe setupālaśca uttare haṃsavāhanaḥ | arbude vāsakṛdbrahmā utkale nāradādhipaḥ ||1.538.70|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīre parameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ | prayāge ca yajurnāthaḥ svayaṃbhūḥ raivatācale ||71 || kacche nārāyaṇamadhurbrahmavāhe asupriyaḥ | aṃkulake brahmagarbho vidarbhāyāṃ dvijapriyaḥ ||72|| nārāyaṇarṣirgomante indraprasthe durāsadaḥ | sudarśanaśca pampāyāṃ surūpe rāṣṭravardhanaḥ ||73|| virajāyāṃ mahārūpo devādhyakṣaḥ samasthale | kadambe kelanādhyakṣaḥ supīṭhe jaladeśvaraḥ ||74|| kailāse devagaṃgādhraḥ śrīśaile ca trinetradhṛk | tryambake tripurāriśca naimiṣe cakradhṛk tathā ||75|| śṛṃgaveradhure śūro nandipuryāṃ virūpakaḥ | gotameśaḥ svacchapāde mālavān hāstine pure ||76 || vācikṣetre dvijeśo’yaṃ svarge diveśvarastathā | bhūtikāyāṃ pureśaśca candrāyāṃ haṃsavāhanaḥ ||77|| campāyāṃ gāruḍo brahmā mahāyakṣo mahodaye | suyajñaḥ pūjakāraṇye dharmāraṇye vṛṣātmakaḥ ||78|| pūrvadeśe śuklavarṇo vibhāvaryāṃ supadmajaḥ | devadāruvane keśī mātṛbhūmau vināyakaḥ ||79|| alakāyāṃ dhaneśeśastrikuṭe yogirāḍajaḥ | pātāle nāgabhūrbrahmā kovidāre yugādikṛt || 1.538.80|| strīrājye suratādhyakṣaḥ saḥ paurṇādrau prabhogadhṛk | śālmalau takṣakeśaśca ambiṣṭhāyāṃ sudarśakaḥ ||8 1 || naravīthyāṃ mahāvīraḥ kāntāre durganāśakaḥ | padmāvatyāṃ padmagraho gagane mṛgarūpadhṛk ||82|| samudre meghavāhaśca raṇeṣu kṣārabhūḥ sadā | cakreṣu mūlabījaśca lalāṭe ca gurustathā ||83 || satyaloke prapitādirdarbhastṛṇeṣu vai tathā | yajñeṣu mukhyavipraśca vairāje kamalodbhavaḥ | mero cājasvarūpaśca pitṛloke ca pitṛkaḥ ||84|| camatkārapure chinnaśirāḥ kurau ca vājapaḥ | bhāgyadeveṣu vedhāśca vidhātā sṛṣṭikūṭake ||851|| śāstreṣu vaidharūpaścāṣṭottaraśatarūpakaḥ | brahma vai vartate sṛṣṭau janakaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||86|| prabhāse bālarūpaṃ taṃ pūjayet parameṣṭhinam | aṣṭottaraśataviśvasṛjāṃ pūjāphalaṃ bhavet ||87|| āgneyaṃ tu yadā ṛkṣe kārtikyāṃ ced bhavet kvacit | prājāpatyaṃ bhaveccedvā sā tithistatra puṇyadā || 88|| viśākhāsu yadā sūryaḥ kṛttikāsu ca candramāḥ | sa yogaḥ padmako nāma prabhāse kārya eva saḥ ||89|| atha lakṣmi śṛṇu cānyad dakṣo dharmāya kanyakāḥ | purā daśa dadau tāsāmekā viśvā tu nāmataḥ || 1.538.90|| sā dharmāttu mahāviśvā cāṣṭāvajanayat sutān | āyo bhavaśca sāmaśca dharaścaiva nalo’nilaḥ || 91 || pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavo’ṣṭau vṛṣātmajāḥ | teṣāṃ madhye saptamaśca putrecchayā prabhāsakam || 92 || samāyayau pratyūṣaḥ sa tape varṣaśataṃ param | somanāthaḥ prasannaḥ san sutaṃ tasmai hi devalam || 93 || dadau pratyūṣakastatra yalliṃgaṃ samapūjayat | pratyūṣeśvara ityukto mahādevaḥ sutapradaḥ || 94|| athānilo’pi tatraivārādhayāmāsa śaṃkaram | manojaveti vikhyātaṃ tasmai cāpi sutaṃ dadau ||95|| anileśvara ityevaṃ khyātiṃ jagāma śaṃkaraḥ | prabhāsena tathā liṃgaṃ prabhāseśvaramāhitam ||96|| bṛhaspatestu bhaginī bhuvanā tasya kāminī | viśvakarmābhavattasyāṃ sutaḥ prabhāsato balī || 97|| prabhāseśvarasaṃjñaḥ sa mahādevo’bhavat khalu | prabhāsena sthāpito vai phālgune tāmase dale ||018|| trayodaśyāṃ śivarātrau tīrthaṃ tatparamaṃ hyabhūt | atha tatra mahātīrthaṃ vāmanasvāmināmakam ||99|| baliṃ badhvā sarvarājyaṃ yācitvā balikhātakai | yatra pādaṃ prathamaṃ ca nyastaṃ tattīrthamuttamam || 1.538.10 0|| viṣṇutīrthamitikhyātaṃ vartate sāgarāntike | viṣṇunā vihato yatra purā śaṃkhāsurastaṭe || 101 || śaṃkhatīrthaṃ hareryogādvartate dhvānakārakam | vīrabhadreśvaraṃ cāpi tīrthaṃ tatrāsti śāṃkaram || 1 02|| athaikadā tvanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam | bahugopīsamāyukto’śvapaṭṭasaraso yayau || 1 03|| prabhāsaṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ rantuṃ raivatake tadā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeśaṃ ca gopīśvaraṃ dvitīyakam || 1 04|| bāṇaṃ saṃsthāpitaṃ tena śubhraṃ tattīrthamuttamam | athaikadā candrakalā āyayuḥ ṣoḍaśaiva tāḥ || 1 5|| kaleśvaraṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ cakruḥ snātvā prabhāsake | lambinī candrikā kāntā kūṭā śāntā mahodayā || 1 06|| bhīṣaṇī nandinī caiva suparṇā vimalākṣayā | śubhadā śobhanā puṇyā haṃsā sītā kalāḥ kramāt || 1 07|| kalādityaḥ sthāpitaśca sūryo’pi tīrthamācarat | athaikadā catuṣṣaṣṭiyoginyastatra saṃyayuḥ || 1 08|| raivatācalapaścimayoginyadrita eva tāḥ | yoginīśvaramevaitāḥ sthāpayāmāsurīśvaram || 1 09|| tāsāṃ nāmāni vai lakṣmi śṛṇu yāḥ śaṃkarapriyāḥ | ādau mukhyā mahālakṣmīrnandā kṣemakarī tathā || 1.538.11 0|| śivadūtī mahābhadrā bhrāmarī candramaṇḍalā | revatī harasiddhiśca durgā viṣamalocanā || 111 || sahajā kulajā kubjā māyāvī śāṃbhavī kriyā | ādyā sarvagatā śuddhā bhāvamānyā manotigā || 1 12|| vidyāvidyā mahāmāyā suṣumṇā sarvamaṃgalā | okārātmā mahādevī vedārthajananī śivā || 11 3|| purāṇānvīkṣikī dīkṣā cāmuṇḍā śaṃkarapriyā | brāhmī śāntikarī gaurī brahmaṇyā brāhmaṇapriyā || 1 14|| bhadrā bhagavatī kṛṣṇā grahanakṣatramālinī | tripurā tvaritā nityā sāṃkhyā kuṇḍalinī dhruvā || 115|| kalyāṇī śobhanā nityā niṣkalā paramā kalā | yoginī yogasadbhāvā yogagamyā guhāśayā || 1 16|| kātyāyanī umā śarvā aparṇā tā harastriyaḥ | yugāntare tathānyāścopāsanābalataḥ priyā || 1 17|| yoginyo’pi prajāyante koṭiśaḥ śaṃkarapriyāḥ | etāsāṃ somanāthasya sannidhau tīrthamuttamam || 1 18|| vartate pāpanāśārthaṃ pāvanaṃ sukhadaṃ sadā | etāsāṃ pūjanaṃ kāryamaṣṭakāsu sadā janaiḥ || 1 19|| devatvaṃ sāttvikā yānti sāttvikīṃ bhaktimāsthitāḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham | | 1.538.1 20|| māhātmyaṃ somatīrthasya prabhāsasya ca te puraḥ | kathitaṃ yacchaṃkaroktaṃ pārvatyai tu prabhāsake || 121 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’nekaprasiddhatīrthāni, brahmā bhinnasthaleṣu bhinno bhinno varṇitaḥ, vasavo’ṣṭau, sūryā rudrāḥ catuḥṣaṣṭiyoginyaśca kathitā iti nirūpaṇanāmāṣṭātriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 538 ||
<1.539> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi | tathānyāni tīrthāni kathayāmi te | yānyuktāni mahādevyai mahādevena vai tadā || 1 || vāmadevasya sāvarṇeraghorasya tathā param | kapilasya śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ vartate tu prabhāsake || 2 || tathā śrīmukhasaṃjñaṃ ca vanaṃ lakṣmyā virājate | yatra vai vaiṣṇavā yogisiddhā vasanti sarvadā || 3 || sagareṇa purādityaḥ sthāpito yatra bhāsakaḥ | sāgarādityatīrthaṃ tad vidyate tu prabhāsake || 4 || antyajasya sutā cākṣamālābhūd yuvatī purā | pūrvajanmani śūdrā sā rajasvalā hi śaṃkaram || 5 || pasparśa tena doṣeṇa kanyāntyajasya cābhavat | vasiṣṭhena tapoyogād gṛhītā janakārpitā || 6 || bahuvarṣe purā devo na vavarṣa tadā tu te | himabhūmau dadasvānnaṃ samayācanta cāntyajam || 7 || tena putryā sahānnaṃ vai dattaṃ tadā vasiṣṭhakaḥ| āpaddharmaṃ samālocyovāca tatrāntyajaṃ yathā || 8 || jīvarakṣārthamāgṛhṇan nahi pāpena lipyate | ajīgartaḥ sutaṃ hantumupāsarpad bubhukṣitaḥ || 9 || bhāradvājaḥ kṣudhārtastu upajagrāha gāḥ purā | kṣudhārto hyabhyagād gāṃ tu viśvāmitro’pi vai purā || 1.539.10 || ityuktvā tāmakṣamālāṃ jagrāha sa vasiṣṭhakaḥ | annaṃ bhuktvā cāyayuste prabhāse tvabdhisannidhau || 11 || akṣamālā tapaścakre’rundhatī sā vyajāyata | tayākṣamālikeśaśca sthāpitaḥ śaṃkarastadā || 12 || atha tatra siddhalakṣmītīrthaṃ vai vartate śubham | tathā tīrthaṃ mahākālīkṛtaṃ cāpi virājate || 13 || puṣkarāvartakānāmnī nadī kamaladā śubhā | vartate śubhatīrthe ca prabhāse sadgatipradam || 14|| atha mitrābhidhaḥ kaścit kāyastho’bhūd dharātale | tasya putro’bhavaccitraścitrā kanyābhavattathā || 156|| pitrormṛtyau bālakau tau prabhāsaṃ yayatustataḥ | tuṣṭuvatustatra sūryaṃ tapasā bahuvāsarān || 1 6|| citrasya tu prasanno’bhūt sūryaḥ prāha varaṃ vṛṇu | sa vavre sarvakāryeṣu prauḍhatvaṃ rucimattvakam || 17|| tathāstviti raviḥ prāha dharmarājaśca taṃ tathā | kuśalaṃ tu paraṃ jñātvā kṛtavān lekhakaṃ nijam || 18|| sūryo’pi cābhavattatra citrāditya iti prathaḥ | citrābhavaddharmarājagṛhiṇī tapasaḥ phalāt || 19 || citreśvarīti sā tatra devī saṃrājate tathā | tīrthaṃ cāpi śubhaṃ jātaṃ rogadoṣanivārakam ||1.539.2 0 || athātra śītalā devī vartate duḥkhanāśinī | visphoṭakapraśāntyarthaṃ mayūrām̐statra kūrdayet ||2 1 || visphoṭaṃ carcikā cāpi bālānāṃ praśamo bhavet || karpūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ cāpi candanaṃ kusumāni ca |||2|| navamyāṃ śuklapakṣe tāṃ naivedyaṃ ghṛtapāyasam | mālāṃ bilvamayīṃ dadyād rogā naśyanti dūrataḥ ||23 || śītalātīrthamevaitaduktaṃ bālasukhādikṛt | citrā yā yamapatnī sā citrapathā saridvarā || 24|| dvitīyena svarūpeṇa jātā prabhāsake sthale | tadvai tīrthaṃ pāpatāpapraśāntyarthaṃ samucyate || 25|| dharmarājakṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ prabhāse vartate tathā | brahmaṇā nirmitaḥ kuṇḍaḥ kāyākalpakaro’sti vai ||26|| nāradena kṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ vidyate svarabhāsitam | yajñakuṇḍo mahattīrthaṃ brahmādikasuraiḥ kṛtam || 2 7|| hiraṇyāyāstaṭe svarṇadānādi puṇyadaṃ hi tat | vainateyaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ sarpabhītinivārakam || 28|| raivantakaṃ mahattīrthaṃ sūryaputrasya vartate | aśvasya taṃ pūjayitvā ravāvāpad vinaśyati ||29|| svargavaidyakṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ sāvitrītīrthamityapi | tapasā jāyamānaṃ tad vidyate vai prabhāsake || 1.539.30 || talasvāmītitīrthaṃ ca uṣṇajalānvitaṃ tathā | siṃhāraṇye vartate ca pāvanaṃ svargadaṃ śubham || 31 || śṛṇu lakṣmi purā tatra siṃhāraṇye talodbhavam | āsīnmahendranāmā tu dānavastapaso balāt ||32|| jigye devān śaṃkarāt saḥ prārthayāmāsa saṃgaram | yuyudhe śaṃkareṇādau brahmāṇḍakṣayakārakaḥ || 3 3|| tataḥ kopācchivadehājjvālā bahvyo’bhavam̐stadā | tāsāṃ madhye talo dagdho dudrāva ca vanāntare || 34|| śivaḥ someśvaraṃ gatvā susthitaḥ sa talastataḥ | mahendraṃ pīḍayāmāsa badhāna kakubhāṃ patīn ||35|| talo vismayamāpanno harṣanṛtyamathākarot | cakampe tasya nṛtyena sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṃgamam || 36 || kṣubhitā girayaḥ sarve vidruto lavaṇārṇavaḥ | trailokyaṃ vyākulībhūtaṃ tadā vai lomaśo muniḥ ||37|| prabhāsaṃ tu samāgatya śaṃkaraṃ prāha rakṣa naḥ | talaṃ nāśaya deveśa mā ciraṃ ca drutaṃ kuru ||38|| rudra uvācāvadhyo me talaḥ putrasamaḥ sthitaḥ | kintu uṣṇavane ramye taptodakasamīpataḥ || 3 9|| durvāsā vartate taṃ ca prārthayadhvaṃ surādayaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo guptaprayāgake ||1.539.40|| śatruṃjayācale tvaśvapaṭṭasaṃjñasarovare | saurāṣṭre mahati kṣetre vartate bhagavān svayam ||41 || durvāsasā stūyamāno lomaśādibhirādarāt | devaiḥ samprārthyamānaśca talaṃ vināśayiṣyati ||42|| kalpe kalpe pūrvabhūmau vyāghrāraṇye sthitaḥ prabhuḥ | siṃhāraṇyagataṃ daityaṃ talaṃ hanti punaḥ punaḥ ||43|| evamukto lomaśaḥ saḥ uṣṇodakasamīpataḥ | gatvā durvāsasaṃ devānnītvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||44|| svasthānaṃ pāvanaṃ gatvā prāha kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | bhagavan rākṣasaścogro harāvadhyo hi vartate ||45|| bhavatā nāśanīyaḥ sa suramānuṣaduḥkhadaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo gatvā sacakrakaḥ ||46|| vyāghrāraṇye talaṃ dṛṣṭvā mumoca vai sudarśanam | talo dudrāva ca siṃhāraṇyamuṣṇodagahvaram ||47 || tatra cakreṇa tu dvedhābhavad daityo mamāra ca | durvāsasā pūjitaśca mārkaṇḍeyena cārcitaḥ ||48 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ saṃjñāṃ talasvāmīti cāpa yat | talasvāmī mahat tīrthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrayam ||49|| nityamuṣṇodakakuṇḍatrayamakṣayamasti ca | pāpakṣālanakaṃ svargapradaṃ mokṣapradaṃ tathā ||1.539.50 || tatra tīrthaṃ tu sāvitryāstapaḥsthānaṃ pravidyate | athānyadasti tīrthaṃ ca bhūtamātṛkasaṃjñakam ||51 || bhūtapretagaṇānāṃ ca sthānāni santi tatra ca | bhūtānāṃ mātaraṃ tatra pūjayed bhayavāriṇīm |||52| cākṣuṣasyāntare lakṣmi purā kṛtayuge satī | śaṃkaraṃ saṃvivāhyaiva ramate sma ca kānane ||53 || pārvatyāṃ kāmabhāvena tṛpto’bhūcchaṃkarastataḥ | pārvatī kānane tatra kailāse snānamācarat ||54|| pārvatyāḥ snānamātreṇa nirgatā jalakardamāt | mātaro bhūtikā bhīmā asaṃkhyā rūpavarjitāḥ ||55|| kṛṣṇāḥ karālavadanāḥ piṃgākṣyo muktamūrdhajāḥ | kapālamālābharaṇā baddhamuṇḍārdhapiṇḍikāḥ ||56|| kapālakhaṭvāṃgadharā muṇḍamālādharāstathā | dvīpicarmāmbaradharā raṇatkiṃkiṇimekhalāḥ ||57|| ḍimaḍḍamarukārāvāścitkārāpūritāmbarāḥ | daśakoṭyaḥ susañjātāścatasro’tra hi nāyikāḥ |||58||| raktakarṇī mahājihvā kṣayā ca pāpakāriṇī | etāsāmanvaye jātā bahavo brahmarākṣasāḥ ||59|| śleṣmāntakasta vṛkṣe te prāyaśaśca vasanti te | uttālāścapalāścaite nṛtyanti ca hasanti ca ||1.539.6 0 || vṛkṣe kaṇṭakite raudre vasantyapi vane vane | śaṃkaro’pi tadā snānaṃ cakre tajjalakardamāt ||6 1 || bhūtā asaṃkhyāḥ sañjātā vikarālā bhayaṃkarāḥ | dvau mukhyau tādṛśāveva tadrūpābharaṇau narau ||62|| kapālakhaṭvāṃgadharau jātau carmāvaguṇṭhitau | anugamyamānau bahubhūtairmahābhayānakaiḥ ||63 || siṃhaśārdūlādimukhairbhīṣaṇasvarakarmabhiḥ | tau ca kṣudhāyutau śivāṃ śivaṃ tadāhaturmuhuḥ ||64|| bhojanaṃ bhojanaṃ ceti śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā ca tau | yuvayorhastasaṃparkānmāṃsāsṛgādi jāyatām ||65|| naktāhāravihārau ca divāsvapnāvabhāginau | putravad rakṣataṃ lokān dharmaṃ pālayataṃ sadā ||66|| ityuktau tau gaṇau bhūtamātṛnāyakasevitau | ekībhūtau kṣaṇenaiva sahodarau sahāyakau ||67|| āvayoḥ khalu śaucena jātau vai malinau sadā | ābhyāṃ vāsaśca dātavyo dūraṃ paścimabhūtale ||68|| siṃhāraṇye vane vāso somanāthasamīpataḥ | sihavyāghrapaśukṣetre saurāṣṭre jāyatāmiti ||69|| yatra kaṇṭakino vṛkṣā rūkṣā raṇapradeśakāḥ | kuḍyādau citritā yatra mañjaryaśca bhavanti vai ||1.539.70|| bhāryā yatra punarbhūśca valmīkaśca śamī tathā | yatra gṛhe narāḥ pañca yatra vā strītrayaṃ bhavet ||71 || yatra vā gotrayaṃ tatra tadgṛhe vasatiśca vaḥ | andhakāre bhūvivare gahvare dhanapūrite ||72|| ekacchāgaṃ dvigardabhaṃ gotrayaṃ pañcamāhiṣam | ṣaḍaśvaṃ vā saptagajaṃ tadgṛhe vasatirhi vaḥ ||73|| yatra gṛhe ca kuddālo dātṛkaṃ peṭikā tathā | sthālyādibhājanaṃ yatra tatraivāsti viśīrṇakam ||74|| kṣiptaṃ sthale sthale nāsti vyavasthā śuddhirityapi | musalolūkhalayośca dehalyāṃ strīḥ niṣīdati ||75|| śakṛnmūtraṃ ca yatrāsti malaṃ yatra ca kaccaram | laṃghyante yatra dhānyāni pakvāpakvāni veśmani ||76|| laṃghyante yatra śāstrāṇi tadgṛhe vasatirhi vaḥ | manuṣyāsthi gṛhe yasya sevatīvallikā tathā ||77|| rohitaśca jaṭī yatrāgastyako bandhujīvakaḥ | karṇikā ca bhaved yatra sthalapadmaṃ ca yatra vai || 78|| mallikā ca yatra harmye tatra vai vasatirhi vaḥ | tālaṃ tamālaṃ bhallāvaṃ ciñcāvṛkṣāśca yatra vai ||79|| bakulaḥ kadalīṣaṇḍaṃ kadambaḥ khadiro’pi vā | nyagrodho’śvattha āmra udumbaraḥ panasastathā ||1.539.80|| aśoka oḍravṛkṣaśca tatra bhūtaniveśanam | devārcanaṃ yatra nāsti yatra nāsti japādikam ||8 1 || kṛṣṇabhaktiryatra nāsti bhūtānāṃ vasatirhi sā | malināsyāśca ye martyā malināmbaradhāriṇaḥ ||82|| maladantā gṛhasthāśca bhūtānāṃ vasatiḥ sadā | dīpo nāsti yatra gehe jano nāsti samāntare ||83|| malayuktā nālikādyāstatra bhūtādiveśanam | snānahīnā narā nāryo vasatirbhavatu dhruvam ||84|| madyamāṃsāśanā lokā vāsārhāḥ santu vaḥ sadā | catvare gocare grāmagopurāgre śmaśānake ||85|| mṛtaśāvikabhūbhāge caitye drume ca prastare | malabhūmau nālikādau bhūtānāṃ vasatiḥ sadā ||86|| mantramāntrikadehe ca mantrite ca kaṇe tathā | mantrasya viṣaye dehe bhūtānāṃ vasatirbhavet ||87|| ākasmikamṛterbhūmau taḍāgasya taṭe’nile | duṣṭe’pavitrabhūmau ca bhūtānāṃ vasatiḥ sadā ||88|| amāyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ vaiśākhe kārtike tathā | balidānāṃ pūjakānāṃ gṛhe mā nivasantu vai ||89|| nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa śiva rādhe ramāpate | viṣṇo śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīkamalāpate ||1.539.90|| prabhānātha mahālakṣmīpate śrīmāṇikīpate | pārvatīśvara padyeśa muktadhāmādhisatpate ||91 || akṣareśetyādirūpaṃ bhajanaṃ svāmino hareḥ | pūjanaṃ yatra devānāṃ tatra mā nivasantu vai ||92|| yatra śuddhistathā dharmaḥ kalaho yatra nāsti ca | mālinyaṃ yatra vai nāsti tatra mā nivasantu vai ||93|| yatra syādāntare śuddhistatra bhūto na tiṣṭhatu | upāsanābalaṃ yatra bhūtamātā na tatra vai || 94.|| vaiśākhe śuklapakṣe ca pañcadaśadineṣvapi | bhūtamātuḥ prapūjā ca kartavyā prokṣaṇīyakaiḥ || 95||| prokṣaṇairjalasecaiśca grīvāṃ sindūrakaistathā | puṣpairdhūpairarcayecca baliṃ daded yathocitam ||96|| māṣādikṛṣṇabhojyaṃ vai tena tuṣṭaḥ prajāpate | na śākinyo gṛhe tasya na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ || 97|| na bhūtādyāḥ pīḍayanti vaṃśaḥ sukhaṃ vivardhate | bhojayet kṣīrasaṃyāva kṛsaraiḥ pūyapāyasaiḥ || 98|| tena putrapaśusmṛddhiṃ śarīrārogyamāpnuyāt | ekādaśyāṃ navamyāṃ ca prakṣālya kuḍyakaṃ tataḥ ||019|| mukhabimbāni citrāṇi kārayed raktakajjalaiḥ | mātṝṇāṃ caṇḍikānāṃ ca rākṣasīnāṃ tathaiva ca || 1.539.10 0|| bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ śākinīnāṃ tathaiva ca | mukhāni kārayet tatra hāvabhāvayutāni ca || 101 || amāyāṃ pūjayettāni rātrau dīpena saṃyutaḥ | mastake ca nije dhṛtvā suhṛnmitrasamanvitaḥ || 1 02|| grāmānte ca śmaśānānte vīrabhramaṇamācaret | sa dīpaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sādhako balavān bhavet || 1 03|| nityaṃ ca bhrāmayed dīpaṃ rātrau grāme śmaśānake | pañcadaśyāṃ prakurvīta bhūtamāturmahotsavam || 1 04|| pūjayedbhojayennamet kṣamayitvā gṛhaṃ vrajet | evaṃ pūjāprakartuśca bhūtavighno na jāyate || 1 05|| atha tasyā bhūtamātuḥ śarīrāt pañcakoṭayaḥ | piśācāḥ svedabindubhyo jātāḥ sarve bhayānakāḥ || 1 06|| dhamanīsantatāḥ śuṣkāḥ śmaśrūlāścarmavāsasāḥ | ulūkhalābharaṇāśca śūrpacchatrāḥ kharasvarāḥ || 1 07|| pāṇipātrāḥ śirohārā bubhukṣitāḥ kurūpiṇaḥ | nakhajvālitakeśebhyaścāṃgārānudgiranti te ||1 08|| ākarṇadāritāsyāśca lambabhrūsthūlanāsikāḥ | pṛṣṭhataḥ pāṇipādāśca pṛṣṭhagāśca vipādagāḥ ||1 09|| ākrośantaśca dīnāsyāḥ sūtikāgṛhavāsanāḥ | taiḥ khādyaṃ cārthitaṃ śaṃbhoḥ śaṃbhurvaraṃ dadau tadā || 1.539.11 0|| antardhānaṃ prajāsveva kāmarūpatvamityapi | ubhayoḥ sandhyayoścāro bhagnagṛheṣu cāsanam || 111 || anācāragṛhāṇyeva bhagnānyāyatanāni ca | rājamārgoparathyāśca catvarāṇi ca vedikāḥ || 11 2|| upalāśca tathā koṇān rathyānāṃ nirgamāṃstathā | caityavṛkṣādikāṃścāpi śṛṃgāṇi cocchrayāṃstathā || 11 3|| sthānāni ca piśācānāṃ nivāsāya dadau haraḥ | adharmikān janām̐ścāpi madyamāṃsāśinastathā || 1 14|| malamūtrabharāṃścāpi nivāsāya dadau haraḥ | teṣāṃ vighnavināśāya baliṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ || 115|| pūpairharidrakṛśarairmadhunā tilacūrṇakaiḥ | odanaṃ sāsavaṃ dadyāt tilabhaktaṃ guḍaudanam || 1 16|| kṛṣṇāni caiva vāsāṃsi dhūmāḥ sumanasastathā | evaṃ kṛtvā ca santuṣṭā vighnān haranti sarvadā || 1 17|| evaṃ hareṇa bhūtānāṃ piśācānāṃ ca mātaraḥ | sarvaputragaṇopetāḥ preṣitāśca prabhāsakam || 1 18|| siṃhāraṇyaṃ nivāsārthaṃ dattaṃ vai śatayojanam | yatra khādyaṃ miletteṣāṃ paścime sāgare sadā || 11 9|| te kailāsaṃ parityajya siṃhāraṇyaṃ samāgatāḥ | upadravānakurvaṃśca prajāsvāgatya vai punaḥ || 1.539.120|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hantuṃ ca tām̐stadā | sudarśanaṃ mumocātrāraṇye dudruvurambare || 121 || bhūtāḥ piśācakādyāśca mātaraśceti paścimam | pāresamudraṃ jagmuste kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ piśācakāḥ || 1 22|| kadrūpā abriktadeśe vasatiṃ tatra cakrire | koṭiśaste tato jātāḥ kāmarūpā hi mānavāḥ || 123 || ye tu cakreṇa nihatāste devā malināstadā | siṃhāraṇye nivasanto dehāntarāṇi jagṛhuḥ || 124|| somanāthasya śaṃbhoste śiṣyāḥ prajāḥ suputrakāḥ | putryaḥ sutāśca śiṣyāśca siṃhāraṇye vasanti vai || 125 || uṣṇodakasya kuṇḍasyābhito’driṣu vaneṣu ca | tāmasānāṃ kṛte lakṣmi tāmasā devatāḥ sadā || 126 || tīrtharūpā bhavantyeva svabhāvaguṇabhāvanaiḥ | teṣāṃ tīrthaṃ mahattadvai siṃhāraṇye’sti tāmasam || 1 27|| bhūtamātuḥ piśācānāṃ bhūtānāṃ ca nivāsanam | cakreṇa sīdamānāḥ saṃsīdamānā hi jātayaḥ || 1 28|| paścimāyāṃ kṣitau jātāḥ piśācasadṛśāstu te | ityevaṃ kathitaṃ devyai śaṃbhunā ca prabhāsake || 1 29|| kailāsajanyaṃ vṛttāntaṃ tīrthamiṣeṇa somake | mayā te kathitaṃ lakṣmi talatvāmī tvahaṃ purā || 1.539.13 0|| talanāśārthamabhavaṃ tathānyacchruṇu pāvanam | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya pāpahāniḥ prajāyate || 131 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne prabhāsakṣetre tīrthavrātavarṇane’rundhatīpūrvajanmavṛttāntaḥ, citrāyāḥ pūrvajanmākhyānaṃ, śītalāyāstīrthaṃ, talasvāmitīrthākhyānaṃ, bhūtamātṛtīrthākhyānaṃ, bhūtānāṃ vāsasthānāni, abriktadeśādau sīdamānānāṃ vāsaḥ, ityādinirūpaṇanāmaikonacatvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||539||
<1.540> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi śaṃbhurdevyai tathottaram | tīrthe ca yad yaduvāca kathayāmi kramāttathā || 1 | puṣpadanteśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ tathā māṇḍavyatīrthakam | tapaso vai tayoḥ sthānaṃ māṇḍavyapuṣpadantayoḥ || 2 | pañcaprabhāsān saṃpaśyenmukhyaṃ prabhāsake taṭe | dakṣiṇe cāpprabhāsa ca paścimaṃ ca prabhāsakam || 3 | uttaraṃ ca prabhāsaṃ ca pūrvaṃ prabhāsamityapi | yamo varuṇo dhanado mahendraśceti sarvataḥ || 4 | bhāsayanti prabhāsaṃ ca tataścaturvidhaṃ hi tat | jāmadagnyeśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ tathā tatra hi vartate || 5 | kṛtasmaraṃ mahattīrthaṃ parvatātmakameva tat | smaraṃ dagdhvā punaḥ kṛtvā pārvatyā yuyuje haraḥ || 6 || yatra kāmaḥ śaṃkareṇa kṛtaḥ sajīvanaḥ purā | kṛtasmaraḥ sa vijñeyaḥ parvataḥ śaṃkarāśritaḥ || 7 || kāmakuṇḍaśca tatrāsti yatra kāmo hi vidyate | snātvā tatra trayodaśyāṃ subhago rūpavān bhavet || 8 || puṇyaṃ sārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ yena jīvanti somake | anyāni sarvatīrthāni śubhe sāmudrasaṃgame || 9 || puṇyakṛllabhate tatra vaiśākho somasaṃyutām | amāṃ somayutāṃ cāpi kiṃ tadā parvakoṭibhiḥ || 1.540.10 || bilvapatraṃ śamīpatraṃ karṇikāṃ mālatīṃ tathā | dhattūrakaṃ campakaṃ cāśokaṃ śrīphalamakṣatān || 11 || śarkarāṃ candanaṃ miṣṭaṃ kaṃkaṇaṃ saṃgame’rpayet | sarasvatyāṃ manuṣyaiśca dhyātavyo vai harirharaḥ || 12 || tasmai deyā supūjā ca muktidā bhuktidā ca sā | tatrāsthiṃ mṛtadehasya kṣepaṇīyaṃ vimuktaye || 1 3|| yāvadasthi manuṣyasya tiṣṭhet sārasvate jale | tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svarge loke sa tiṣṭhati || 14|| svarganiḥśreṇisaṃbhūtā prabhāsasthā sarasvatī | darśanenācamanena rājasūyaphalapradā || 15|| tatra śrāddhena pitaro muktiṃ yānti sutarpitāḥ | ahno muhūrtā vikhyātāḥ pañcadaśa ca tatra ca || 16|| prātaḥkāle muhūrtāstrīn saṃgavaṃ trimuhūrtakān | madhyāhnaṃ ca muhūrtāstrīnaparāhnaṃ tathaiva trīn || 17|| sāyāhnaṃ ca muhūrtāṃstrīn vidyāttatra ca śrāddhakṛt | sāyāhno rākṣasī velā tatra śrāddhaṃ na kārayet ||18|| divāṣṭamo muhūrto yaḥ saḥ kālaḥ kutupaḥ smṛtaḥ | sa cānantaphaladātā madhyāhnaḥ kutupātmakaḥ ||1 9|| pāpaṃ ca kutsitaṃ tasmāt kuto pālanaṃ rakṣaṇam | kutupaḥ sa samādiṣṭaḥ kutupā aṣṭarūpiṇaḥ ||1.540.20|| madhyāho geṇḍukapātraṃ rajataṃ goghṛtaṃ tathā | darbhastilāni dhenuśca dauhitraḥ kutupāśca te ||21|| ūrdhve muhūrtātkutupād yanmuhūrtaṃ catuṣṭayam | muhūrtapañcakaṃ caiva svadhābhavanamiṣyate ||22|| viṣṇordehātsamutpannāḥ kuśāḥ kṛṣṇāstilāstathā | tilodakāñjalirdeyā sadarbhā sthalavartibhiḥ ||23|| trīṇi śrāddhe pavitrāṇi dauhitraṃ kutupastilāḥ | dauhitro geṇḍukaḥ paśurlalāṭe śṛṃgavān hi saḥ ||24|| tasya śṛṃgasya yatpātraṃ tad dauhitramiti smṛtam| kṣīriṇī yā savatsā gaustatkṣīrād yadghṛtaṃ bhavet || 25|| tad dauhitramiti proktaṃ daive paitrye ca karmaṇi | duhituśca sutaḥ śreṣṭho dauhitraḥ śrāddhabhojane || 26 || darbhāgraṃ daivamityuktaṃ satilāgnaṃ tu paitṛkam | tatrāvalambino ye tu te kuśāḥ kutupāḥ smṛtāḥ || 27|| śuklanyāyārjitadrvyaistṛpyanti pitaraḥ surāḥ | anyāyārjitadravyaiśca tṛpyanti puṣkasādijāḥ || 28|| bhūkṣiptānnena ca tṛptā bhavanti ca piśācajāḥ | snānavastrajalenāpi tṛpyanti nīcayonijāḥ || 29|| sugandhāmbukaṇaistṛptā bhavanti devatāṃgatāḥ | piṇḍoddhṛtainnakaṇakaistṛpyanti ca vipadbhavāḥ || 1.540.30 || bhuktvā cācamanenaiva tṛpyanti paśuyonijāḥ | viprāḥ śrāddhe śrotriyaśca yogī sāmagavaidikau || 31 || triṇāciketaḥ pañcāgnistrisuparṇaḥ ṣaḍaṃgavit | dauhitrakaśca jāmātā svasrīyaścottamastathā || 32 || pañcāgnikarmaniṣṭhaśca taponiṣṭho’tha mātulaḥ | mātuśca pitaraścaiva śiṣyasambandhibāndhavāḥ || 33 || vedārthavit pravaktā ca brahmacārī sahasradaḥ | cirāyuścaiva vijñeyāḥ satpuruṣāśca pāvanāḥ || 34|| bhāgineyaṃ viśeṣeṇa tathā bandhugaṇānapi | nātikramennaraścaitān mūrkhānapi ca padmaje || 35 || jalaṃ dadyāt phalaṃ dadyād dadyāt piṇḍāṃśca pāyasam | miṣṭaṃ ca śarkarāṃ dadyād dadyādiṣṭatamaṃ sadā || 36 || dravyapātrādilābho ca dadyāt tṛtikaraṃ hi tat | puṇyāheṣu pradadyācca nitye naimittike tathā || 37|| nirṇītadivase dadyād vatsare vatsare dhruvam | amāyāṃ sarvathā dadyāt prāpnuvanti dhruvaṃ mṛtāḥ ||30|| mahādānāni ca dadyānnārāyaṇālaye tathā | jalāttīraṃ yāvadārdraṃ yadvā hastacatuṣṭayam || 39 || tatra nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī nānyālayaḥ sa ucyate | gāvaḥ suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ ratnāni ca sarasvatī ||1.540.40 || tilaṃ kanyā gajo’śvaśca śayyā vastraṃ tathā mahī | dhānyaṃ payaśca chatraṃ ca gṛhaṃ dānāni ṣoḍaśa ||41 || satyaṃ damastathā śaucaṃ santoṣo naiṣṭhyamārjavam | jñānaṃ śamo dayā dānametatpātraṃ praśasyate ||42 || avithipriyaśāntāya sīdate cāhitāgnaye | śrotriyāya tathaikāpi gaurdeyā mokṣadā hi sā ||43 || bahubhyo na pradeyāni gaurgṛhaṃ śaraṇaṃ striyaḥ | prāsādā yatra sauvarṇā rūpyaratnaujjvalāḥ śubhāḥ ||44 || varāścāpsaraso yatra tatra gacchanti gopradāḥ | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi svarge vasati bhūmidaḥ || 45 || evaṃ sārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ kṛtvā mārkaṇḍatīrthakam | yāyād yatra sthito dīrghaṃ yugānāṃ tapase muniḥ ||46 || tato yāyād yatra kṛṣṇakulanāśasthalī matā | golokadhāmadā divyā cādyayugaraṇāṃgaṇā || 47 || yadā raṇāṃgaṇo jātastadāpaśakunāni ca | teṣāṃ jātāni ca lakṣmi śṛṇu vināśakāni ca ||48 || kālasteṣāṃ gṛhāṇyeva parikrāmyati dṛśyate | karālo vikaṭo muṇḍaḥ puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇapiṃgalaḥ ||49 || sammārjanīmahāketurjapāpuṣpāvataṃsakaḥ | kṛtakṛkalāsahāraḥ kākaiśca kṛtabhūṣaṇaḥ ||1.540.50 || gṛhāṇyavekṣya kārṣṇānā nādṛśyata punargataḥ | suptānāṃ dadṛśuḥ keśān nṝṇāṃ yuvatayo niśi ||5 1 || bhinnakaṭakaprākoṣṭhāḥ utkocayanti sarvaśaḥ | menā cīcītikūcīti rauti gṛheṣu nityadā |||52|| kharāśca vāyavo rūkṣā vavuḥ kaṃkaravāhakāḥ | ajāḥ śivānāṃ ca rutamanukurvanti vai tadā ||53 || pāṇḍurā raktapādāśca vihagāḥ kālanoditāḥ | kapotāśca tathā yūkā gṛheṣu vicaranti hi |||54|| vyajāyanta kharā goṣu vṛṣāścāśvatarīṣu ca | śunīṣvapi biḍālāśca mūṣakā nakulīṣu ca ||55 | | bhāryāḥ patīn vañcayanti patnīśca puruṣāṃstathā| | vibhāvasuḥ prajvalito vāmaṃ viparivartate | |56 || nīlalohitamāñjiṣṭhān visṛjan svārciṣaḥ pṛthak | udayāstamane nityaṃ viparyasto divākaraḥ ||57|| vyadṛśyatāsakṛjjanaiḥ kabandhaiḥ parivāritaḥ | mahāsaneṣu siddhānne saṃskṛte’tīva bhāsure ||58|| uccāryamāṇe kṛmayo dṛśyante bhojanālaye | parasparaṃ ca nakṣatraṃ hanyamānaṃ vyadṛśyata ||5 9 || aniveditadevāgre’śrūyanta rāsabhasvarāḥ | trayodaśī rāhuṇā ca grastā nāśakarī sadā ||1.540.6 0 || kālī strī pāṇḍurairdantaiḥ praviśya nagarīṃ niśi | striyaṃ svānteṣu muṣṇāti nagarīṃ prati dhāvati ||6 1 || kurvanti bhīṣaṇaṃ nādaṃ kukkuṭāstu raṇājire | kurūpā dviśirā raudrāścaturbāhava eva ca ||6 2 || strīṇāṃ garbheṣvajāyanta rākṣasā guhyakāstathā | alaṃkārāṇi chatrāṇi dhvajāśca kavacāni ca ||63|| hriyamāṇāni dṛśyante rakṣobhiśca bhayānakaiḥ | evaṃ jātāni vijñāya viśakunāni mādhavaḥ ||64|| kulānyādāya somāḍhyaṃ prabhāsaṃ samupāyayau | sāntaḥpureṇa kṛṣṇena airakāhetibhistadā ||65|| svakulāni saṃhṛtāni parasparajighāṃsayā | kārṣṇanirvāṇabhūmiḥ sā paraṃ tīrthaṃ samucyate ||66|| airakāpatrajātāni tṛṇānyapi viparyaye | āsan muśalībhūtāni khaḍgībhūtāni vai tadā ||67|| sarvaṃ līnaṃ yatra bhūmau citā gavyūtibhūmigā | tatra yātrā prakartavyā mahāvairāgyadā priye ||68|| tato yāyād hiraṇyāṃ ca nadīṃ snāyāt supuṇyadam | tato yāyād rurukṣetraṃ yatra devī kumārikā ||69|| rurodaityasya nāśārthaṃ devānāṃ tejasābhavat | sā sthitā vartate tatra pārvatīṃ vai kumārikām ||1.540.70|| pūjayed vandanāṃ kuryācchāṭikāṃ cārpayecchubhām | tato yāyād ṛṣitīrthaṃ purā yatra maharṣayaḥ |||75||| cāturmāsye nivāsaṃ vai satrārthe cakrurīśvarāḥ | yatra trinetramatsyānāṃ vaṃśo vasati śāśvataḥ ||72|| aṃgirā gautamo’gastyo viśvāmitro bṛhaspatiḥ | saṃvartaścyavano raibhyo durvāsāḥ kaśyapo manuḥ ||73|| mārkaṇḍeyo jamadagniruśanā kaṇvagālavau | nāradaḥ parvataścāpi bharadvājo’tha bhāguriḥ ||74|| medhātithiryavakrītastathānye vaiṣṇavāḥ śubhāḥ | viṣṇuyāge pravṛtte ca vṛṣādarbhinṛpastadā ||75|| āha pratigrahaṃ matto gṛhṇīdhvaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ | mudgān māṣām̐śca vrīhīṃśca tathā ratnāni kāñcanam ||76|| ṛṣayastu tadā prāhurna gṛhṇīmaḥ pratigraham | rājyadravyaṃ mahādoṣayuktaṃ gṛhṇīma eva na ||77|| daśasūnāsamaścakrī daśacakrisamo dhvajī | daśadhvajisamā veśyā daśaveśyāsamo nṛpaḥ ||78|| rājño dānaṃ mahāghoraṃ pācayituṃ na śakyate | anyebhyo dīyatāṃ rājan kuśalaṃ te’stu sarvathā ||79|| śrutvā rājā yayau naijaṃ gṛhama paścācca guptakam | dānaṃ dātuṃ hemagarbhāṇyudumbarāṇyakārayat ||1.540.80 || vyakiran mantriṇastasya yatra te ṛṣayaḥ sthitāḥ | aṃgirāḥ prāha ṛṣayo mā gṛhṇantu phalāni vai ||81 || guptadānāni santyeva vṛṣādarbhinṛpasya vai | dhanasya sañcayastapaḥsaṃcayasya vināśakaḥ ||82|| nahi sañcayavān kaścid dṛśyate nirupadravaḥ | apratigrahaśīlānāṃ tejo nityaṃ vivardhate ||83|| akiñcanatvaṃ rājyaṃ ca tulayā saha tolane | akiñcanatvamadhikaṃ rājyādapi dhanādapi ||84|| artho hyanartharūpo’sti śreyasāṃ bhraṃśakārakaḥ | śokamohapradaścāpi taṃ sukhī dūratastyajet ||85|| dharmārthamiti matvāpi dravyasaṃgaṃ na vai caret | prakṣālanāddhi paṃkasya paṃkasyāsparśanaṃ varam ||86|| jīryanti jīryataḥ keśā dantā jīryanti jīryataḥ | cakṣuḥśrotre ca jīryaṃte tṛṣṇaikā nahi jīryati ||87|| anantapārā sā tṛṣṇā dhanāśā duḥkhadā sadā | adharmabahulā cāpi tasmāttāṃ dūrayet sadā ||88|| asantuṣṭā vinaśyanti dravyalobhena saṃkaṭaiḥ | santuṣṭamānasatvaiva sarvatra sukhaśevadhiḥ ||89|| upānadgūḍhapādasya yathā carmāvṛtaiva bhūḥ | santoṣāmṛtatṛptānāṃ śāntiḥ sukhamanantakam || 1.540.90|| lubdhānāṃ tṛṣṇayā nāśaḥ kutaḥ śāntiḥ kutaḥ sukham | kāmaḥ kāmayamānasya pūryate naiva karhicit ||91|| athainamaparaḥ kāmo bhūyo vidhyati bāṇavat | upabhogena kāmastu kadācinnahi śāmyati ||92|| pratyuta vardhate puṣṭo ghṛtayogena vahnivat | kāmānabhilaṣan janturlubdhaḥ sukhaṃ na vindati ||93|| catuḥsamudrasahitā bhuṃkte’pi pṛthivī nṛpaḥ | na tathāpi kṛtārthaśca vitṛṣṇo jāyate kvacit ||94|| apratigṛhṇatāṃ lokāḥ śāśvatānandadāyakāḥ | vināpi tapasā teṣāṃ tapo bhavati lakṣadhā ||95|| santānatantustṛṣṇāsti dehasthā raktaśoṣiṇī | dustyajā rākṣasīrūpā jīryato’pi na jīryati ||96|| tṛṣṇā prāṇāntako rogastaṃ tyajet sa sukhī sadā | lokatṛṣṇā vittatṛṣṇā putratṛṣṇā ca kāmanā ||97|| etāstṛṣāḥ prāṇabhakṣā bibhyastābhyo maheśvarāḥ | tasmādudumbarāṇyeva bhavantu nṛpateḥ sadā ||98|| ityuktvā hemagarbhāṇi tyaktvodumbarakāṇi ca| satraṃ cakruḥ svastharūpāstāpasāḥ pārameśvarāḥ ||99 || teṣāṃ puṇyasthalaṃ tīrthaṃ prabhāse vartate priye | lakṣmi tīrthaṃ tārakaṃ tat kartavyaṃ mokṣadāyakam || 1.540.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne prabhāsacatuṣṭayatīrthāni, tīrthaśateṣu sārasvatatīrthaṃ, kutupasamayādayaḥ, dauhitrādīnāmarthāḥ, mārkaṇḍatīrthakṛṣṇakulanāśatīrtham, raṇādāvaniṣṭasūcakāni, vṛṣādarbhikṛtāni guptasuvarṇagarbhodumbarāṇi, aṃgiraso dānāgraham, anyānyatīrthāni cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||540 ||
<1.541> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi nandatīrthaṃ śaṃkareṇa yathoditam | pārvatyai te kathayāmi nando bhāgavato hyabhūt || 1 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | itimantro vaśiṣṭhādvai gṛhītastena bhūbhujā || 2 || mahābhāgavato hyāsīnnārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ | na durbhikṣaṃ na cā vyādhirnākāle maraṇaṃ nṛṇām || 3 || na caurā na ca kāpaṭyaṃ na cāvṛṣṭyādikaṃ bhayam | tasmin śāsati rājendre prajāścāsan sukhāḥ sadā || 4 || vimānaṃ tasya tuṣṭena dattaṃ vai viṣṇunā svayam | vyacaran sarvalokān sa vimānavaramāsthitaḥ || 5 || ekadā vyacaran bhūmau mānasaṃ tu saro yayau | devādisevitaṃ padmasugandhaparivāsitam || 6 || divyavārisamāyuktaṃ śītatṛptipradaṃ śubham | tatrāpaśyacchubhaṃ padmaṃ vikasitaṃ ca pāṇḍuram || 7 || tatrāpyaṃguṣṭhamātraṃ ca sthitaṃ puruṣasattamam | apaśyaccākathayat svasārathiṃ gaccha vai jalam || 8 || yadidaṃ dṛśyate padmaṃ puruṣeṇa virājitam | ratnahārāliśobhena pītavastrādidhāriṇā || 9 || dvibhujena sudivyena madhyabhāge hyadhiṣṭhitam | tadidaṃ kamalaṃ śīghraṃ samānaya mamāntikam || 1.541.1 0|| dhārayiṣyāmi śirasi bhaviṣyāmi kṛtārthakaḥ | evamuktaḥ sārathistu vimānādavaruhya ca || 11 || vyomnā vāyusamādhāraścāvātatāra padminīm | adhomastakasthityaiva hastaṃ prasārya yāvatā || 12|| vyomnaiva gṛhītuṃ yāti tatpadmaṃ nālasaṃsthitam | yāvatā spṛśati tāvad dhūmrastasmādajāyata || 13|| andhakāramaye tatra vyomni mamāra sārathiḥ | nando vimānamadhye ca kṛṣṇavarṇo babhūva ha || 14|| balavīryavihīnaśca medhāśaktivivarjitaḥ | unmatta iva sañjāto mlānaśuṣkānanastathā || 15| kajjalapiṇḍavaddehaṃ dṛṣṭvā śuśoca bhūpatiḥ | kimidaṃ me tu sañjātaṃ mṛtaśca sārathirmama || 16|| kopo’yaṃ kasyacijjāto vasiṣṭho māṃ prarakṣatu | ityuktamātrastu gururvasiṣṭhastatra cāyayau || 17|| yogabalena ca yāne samāgatyāha bhūpatim | mā bhayaṃ yāhi rājendra kuśalaṃ śaṃ tavāstu vai || 18|| rājā vasiṣṭhaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca viśokaḥ samapadyata | namaskāraṃ vidhāyaiva dīnavannijagāda tam || 1 9|| eṣa me bhagavan jātaḥ kṛṣṇo dehaviparyayaḥ | sārathirmama naṣṭaśca kamalasya prabhāvataḥ ||1.541.20|| kimidaṃ vada me brahman nistāraṃ kārayāsya vai | vasiṣṭhaḥ prāha rājendra mānase’tra sarovare ||21 || etad brahmodbhavaṃ nāma kamalaṃ padmajātikam | nārāyaṇasya nābhervai yadā brahmā vyajāyata ||22| sanālakamale tadvai padmametannigadyate | tajjātīyaṃ tu kamalaṃ mānase’tra sarovare ||23 || vaṃśarūpeṇa bhagavān rakṣatyeva paramparām | etadīyasusantāne kamale sarvadā hyajaḥ ||24|| aṃguṣṭhamātrapratimo brahmā tatra virājate | yāvanti kamalānyatra tasya santānajāni hi ||25|| tāvanti brahmaṇā cādhivāsitāni bhavanti vai | nānye paśyanti caitāni puṇyahīnā hi dehinaḥ ||26|| supuṇyā mokṣagantāraḥ paśyantyetattu padmakam | dṛṣṭamātreṇa cānena dṛṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ ||27|| etadvai dṛśyate dhanyairbrahmabhāgavatairjanaiḥ | mahābhāgavatairlokairyat tvayā dṛṣṭameva hi ||28|| etasmin dṛṣṭamātre tu jalasparśe ca vai kṛte | sarvaśokavinirmuktaḥ padaṃ nirvāṇamāpnuyāt ||29|| sārathistava rājendra dadarśa kamalaṃ tathā | pasparśa ca jalaṃ nālaṃ muktiṃ jagāma tāvatā ||1.541.3 0|| ahaṃ nityaṃ darśanārthaṃ tvāyāmi vyomamārgataḥ | na spṛśāmi jalaṃ kintu natvā taṃ pitaraṃ hyajam ||3 1 || punargacchāmi me sthānaṃ puṣkaraṃ cārbudācalam | tvaṃ tu mahāvaiṣṇavo’si dṛṣṭavānasi tena vai |||32||| savedhasaṃ ca kamalaṃ tava puṇyaṃ hi śāśvatam | jalaṃ na spṛṣṭvām̐stena rājan jīvasi vardhase ||33|| kintu padmaṃ ca hartuṃ te vāñcchā jātā nṛpeśvara | tena kārṣṇyaṃ tava jātaṃ doṣeṇa nīlavarṇatā ||34|| vāñchanti devatā nityaṃ munayaḥ ṛṣayastathā | mānase brahmapadmaṃ tu drakṣyāmastat kadā vayam ||35||| prāpsyāmaśca paraṃ brahma yadgatvā na nivartanam | evaṃ tejoviśiṣṭaṃ tat hartuṃ kāmena paṃkajam ||36|| apahārapradoṣaśca tvayā labdho hyajānatā | tato rājan padmasaṃsthaṃ bedhoyuktaṃ narāyaṇam ||37|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṣetre gatvārādhaya somake | prabhāse śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ ca vedhasā yutam ||38|| svarṇapadme kārayitvā samārādhaya tāpasaḥ | tatastvaṃ nīlatādoṣānmokṣyase nātra saṃśayaḥ ||39|| vaśiṣṭhasya vacaḥ śrutvā nandabhūpo jagāma ha | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetramaśvapaṭṭasarovaram ||1.541.40|| tatra snātvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā ca lomaśam | raivatādrau vāmanaṃ ca yayau natvāprabhāsakam ||41|| tatra vai kānakīṃ mūrtiṃ padmasthāṃ brahmaṇāyutām | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpāṃ nidhāya ca ||42|| pūjayāmāsa vividhairupacārairdivāniśam | tapaścakāra bhagavatsamārādhanapūrvakam ||43|| viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ gaṇapatiṃ pārvatīṃ ca divākaram | pūjayāmāsa vidhinā śrīhariṃ pañcadevatāḥ ||44|| māheśvaryāstaṭe ramye tapaḥsthānaṃ cakāra saḥ | tasya tapastathā bhaktiṃ vilokya devatāstathā ||45|| brahmā kṛṣṇastathā lakṣmīrdarśanaṃ pradadustadā | prasannāḥ sma iti prāhurvaraṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam ||46|| rājā prāha harerbhakto naiva vāñchati caihikam | mokṣaṃ dehi satāṃ saṃgaṃ pradehi śāśvataṃ padam ||47|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha hasam̐stadā | rājan tattu tvadarthaṃ vai mayā prāgeva niścitam ||48|| na me bhaktasya vai bhuktau muktau vā rodhanaṃ bhavet | prasanno’smi ca rājam̐ste kṛṣṇatā padmadoṣajā ||49|| yā jātāsi layaṃ yātu bhava campakavarṇakaḥ | divyadehastathā bhūtvā bhaja māṃ puruṣottamam ||1.541.50|| atrāgatya jano yo māṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | vedhasaṃ pañcadevām̐śca sūryādīn pūjayiṣyati ||51 || sa ca loke nirogī syād yāsyatyante parāṃ gatim | evaṃ harirvaraṃ datvā kṛtvā suvarṇavarṇakam ||52| tatra tīrthaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā tataścāntaradhīyata | nandīghaṭṭe naraḥ snātvā bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt ||||53|| nandatīrthaṃ tathā kṛtvā na punarmartyatāṃ vrajet | nandatīrthasya pārśve ca tritakūpākhyamuttamam ||54|| pāvanaṃ vartate tīrthaṃ kartavyaṃ puṇyalabdhaye | purā saurāṣṭraviṣaye vipra ātreyasaṃjñakaḥ ||55|| babhūva tasya putrāścaikato dvitastritastrayaḥ | tritaḥ sarvaguṇopeto mūrkhau jyeṣṭhau babhūvatuḥ ||56|| gate svarge tu pitari dhuraṃ jagrāha vai tritaḥ | tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā kathaṃ yajñaṃ karomyaham ||87|| sa nimantrya dvijaśreṣṭhān yajñakarmaṇyadhiṣṭhitān | yajñārthaṃ dravyalābhāya pravāsaṃ prajagāma ha ||58|| gṛhītvā bhrātarau jyeṣṭhau gavārthaṃ prasthitastritaḥ | yasya yasya gṛhe yāti grāmeṣu bhrātṛsaṃyutaḥ ||59|| tatra tatra parāṃ pūjāṃ lebhe gāśca supuṣkalāḥ | evaṃ dravyaṃ puṣkalaṃ ca godhanaṃ vipulaṃ tathā ||1.541.6 0|| gṛhītvā gṛhamāyāti bhrātṛbhyāṃ sahitaḥ sa ca | trito gavāṃ puro yāti pṛṣṭhato bhrātarau ca tau ||61 || atha taṃ godhanaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūridānārthamāhṛtam | jyeṣṭhayostu matirjātā pāpaprāyātilobhataḥ ||6 2|| parasparamūcatustau bhrātarau pāpacetasau | trito
