yajñeṣu kuśalo vedeṣu kuśalastathā ||63|| mānyaḥ pūjyaśca sarveṣāmāvāṃ mūrkhau nirarthakau | etacca godhanaṃ sarvaṃ trito dāsyati dānake ||64|| asmākaṃ na bhavet kiñcit pratyuta yatpiturdhanam | tasmādapi pradātavyaṃ bhaviṣyati kratau tadā ||65|| yajñe lokāśca dāsyanti dhanāni ca bahūnyapi | tritasya tāni sarvāṇi nāvayorvai kapardikā ||66|| tasmādāvāṃ dhanahīnau trito dhanāḍhya eva ca | bhaviṣyati tato hetorvadhastritasya yujyate ||67|| evaṃ vicārya tau jyeṣṭhau yāntaṃ tritaṃ puraḥ puraḥ | āhvayāmāsatuḥ kūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā jalārthinau yathā ||68|| jalapānaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ samāgacchātra bho trita | tritaḥ śrutvā samāyāto dvābhyāṃ kṣipto hi kūpake ||69|| tatastau godhanaṃ nītvā dravyaṃ nītvā ca puṣkalam | prasthitau svagṛhaṃ hṛṣṭamānasau lobhakāriṇau ||1.541.70 || kūpe ca patito vipraścintayāmāsa mānase | viprā yajñārthamāhūtāḥ kraturmayā kṛto nahi ||7 1|| tasmāt yadbhāvi tajjātaṃ kūpe’tra mānasaṃ kratum | karomi yāvajjīvāmi jalena manasā tathā ||72|| iti vicintya sūktāni proktvā proktvā jalena vai | añjalinā ca havanaṃ cakāra kardamena saḥ ||73|| śraddhayā tasya dadato bhūyastṛptāstu devatāḥ | āgatya brāhmaṇaṃ procurvipra santarpitā vayam ||74|| tuṣṭāḥ sma mānasairbhāvairvada dāsyāma īpsitam | tritaḥ prāha mayā yajño bhāvayajño’tra vai kṛtaḥ ||75|| dravyayajñaṃ gṛhe gatvā karomi tattathā mama | svāsthyaṃ kuruta deveśā kūpānniḥsaraṇaṃ mama ||76 || ityuktāśca surā vipraṃ nītavanto jalādbahiḥ | gṛhe gatvā kratuṃ kṛtvā bhrātṛbhyāṃ pūjitaśca saḥ ||77|| dakṣiṇā vividhā datvā punaḥ kūpaṃ yayau tritaḥ | tapaścacāra vipulaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smaran ||78|| jagāma śrīharerdhāma divyayānena śāśvatam | sa kūpastritakūpo’sti devatīrthaṃ tu pāvanam ||79|| jalapānād bhavenmuktistritasya smaraṇādapi | śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya vaikuṇṭhaṃ labhate janaḥ ||1.541.80|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nandarājñaḥ sāratheḥ mānasasarasi brahmakamaladarśane grahaṇārthaṃ gatasya muktiḥ, nandasya manasā grahaṇapāpasya phalaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇatā, nandītīrthasnānācchubhravarṇatā, tritaviprasya bhrātṛdvayakṛtakūpanikṣepastatra jalayajñe devatābhiḥ kṛtoddhārastapaścaryāmuktiśceti tritatīrtham, ityādinirūpaṇanāmaikacatvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||541 ||
<1.542> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mahāpuṇyaṃ vṛttāntaṃ prāgbhavaṃ śubham | śravaṇātpāpahaṃ yacca dhāraṇānmokṣadaṃ param || 1 || ahaṃ tuṣyāmi bhāvena śraddhayā sevayā tathā | dāsyena premavṛttyā ca bhakteṣṭakṛd bhavāmi hi || 2 || bhāvasādhyo’smyahaṃ devi na vittairna japairaham | bhaktānāṃ tu madarthaṃ vai kāyakleśo bhavet kvacita || 3 || karmaṇā manasā vācā maccitto yo jano bhavet | ahiṃsāṃ satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ samācaret || 4 || ekabhaktaṃ tathā naktamupavāsādika caret | mama saṃkīrtanaṃ sādhusmaraṇaṃ cāpyanindanam || 5 || bhajanaṃ ca prakuryādvai mama pratuṣṭaye rame | purāsīd brahmaṇaḥ putra āruṇirnāma nāmataḥ || 6 || so’raṇyamagamat kiñcittapo’rthaṃ dvijasattamaḥ | tapastepe dāruṇaṃ cāpyupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ || 7 || nāganadyāstaṭe ramye tvāvasathaṃ cakāra saḥ | snānārthamekadā nadyāṃ yayau snātvā taṭe sthitaḥ || 8 || dadarśa tatra cāyāntaṃ vyādhaṃ dhanuśśarānvitam | taṃ dvijaṃ hantumāyāt sa vyādho valkalakāṃkṣayā || 9 || ṛṣistu jñātavān divyacakṣuṣā vyādhamānasam | śuśoca sa hṛdi yadvai vyādho’yaṃ bahupāpakṛt || 1.542.1 0|| mama hatyākṛtaṃ pāpamaho tasyādhikaṃ bhavet | evaṃ vai pāpakartuśca kadoddhāro bhaviṣyati || 11 || tasmād vinā dvijahatyāṃ gṛhṇātu valkalāni saḥ | iti kṛtvārpitānyeva yāvanti valkalāni hi || 12|| dhyāyannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ tasthau maunaṃ tu bhūsuraḥ | taṃ dṛṣṭvā suvrataṃ vipraṃ cāntargataharimṛṣim ||13|| dayāluṃ śāntahṛdayaṃ parapāpanivārakam | vyādhasya mānasaṃ tatra krūratāṃ tu vihāya vai || 14|| sāttvikaṃ dharmayuktaṃ ca vyāvartata kṣaṇāntare | vyādho vihāya cāpaṃ ca śarāṃśca vākyamabravīt || 15|| hantumicchannahaṃ vipra bhavantamiha cāgataḥ | idānīṃ darśanātte’tra hiṃsābuddhirgatā mama ||16|| brāhmaṇā bahavo nāryo mayā hatā hi pāpinā | kāṃ gatiṃ pratipatsyāmi brahmaghno’haṃ dvijottama || 17|| idānīṃ taptumicchāmi tapo’haṃ tvatsamīpataḥ | upadeśādidānena prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 18|| evamukto’pyasau vipro nottaraṃ pratyapadyata | pāpinā tu sahālāpe pāpaṃ saṃkramate yataḥ ||19|| anukto’pi sa dharmecchrurvyādhastatraiva tasthivān | yathā viprastathā vyādhastapastepe taroradhaḥ ||1.542.20|| athaikadā nadītīre siṃhaḥ kaścit samāgataḥ | bubhukṣitaśca taṃ vipraṃ dṛṣṭvā khāditumīśvaram ||21 || vipraṃ yāvat taṭe siṃho jighṛkṣati ca tāvatā | vyādhena śaraghātaiśca śīghraṃ siṃho vināśitaḥ ||22|| ṛṣiḥ oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | ityuktvā jalamagno’bhūjjalādho niṣasāda ca ||23|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nāma śrutvā siṃho mamāra ca | bhūtvā niṣpāpakastasmād divyapumān samutthitaḥ ||24|| śrutamātre jahau prāṇān divyadeho’bhavattataḥ | uvāca yāmi taddeśaṃ yatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||25|| tvatprasādād dvijaśreṣṭha vipāpmā mokṣabhāgaham | śrutvedaṃ ca jalāntaḥstho brāhmaṇo bahirāyayau ||26|| papraccha taṃ tadā siṃhapuruṣaṃ ko’si vai vada | siṃhapumān dvijaṃ prāha prāgāsaṃ vaidiko’pyaham ||27|| dīrghabāhuritikhyāto kriyākāṇḍaparāyaṇaḥ | sarvaṃ vedmi kratukāryaṃ nānyāpekṣā ca me tataḥ ||28|| ahaṃ jānāmi vedām̐śca vedmyahaṃ ca śubhāśubham | brāhmaṇairnaiva me kāryaṃ kiṃ vastu brāhmaṇā iti ||29|| mamaivaṃvādino viprāḥ sarve krodhasamanvitāḥ | ūcuḥ śāpaṃ durādharṣaṃ krūraḥ siṃho bhaviṣyasi ||1.542.3 0|| jñānaṃ te ca vinaṣṭaṃ syānmātyarthaṃ smaraṇaṃ tava | mṛtyukāle kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nāma hi śroṣyasi ||31 || tadā muktirbhavitā te hyāruṇeḥ sannidhau paśo | tvayā yadṛcchayā bhakṣyaṃ ṣaṣṭhakāle samāgatam ||32|| paśunṛpakṣijātīyaṃ yatte sthāsyati sannidhau | yadeṣughātaṃ labdhvā tu prāṇaiḥ kaṇṭhagatairbhavān ||33|| śroṣyati śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ brāhmaṇavaktrataḥ | tadā mokṣagatiste vai bhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ ||34|| paravaktragataṃ cāpi viṣṇornāma śrutaṃ mayā | kṛtadoṣo’pi vipro me mokṣadātā babhūva ha ||35|| yasya darśanamātreṇa pratyakṣo’bhavadacyutaḥ | yaḥ punaḥ svamukhenaiva gṛhṇāti śrīnarāyaṇam ||36|| prāṇaprayāṇasamaye mukto bhavati vai dhruvam | satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyamutkṣipya bhujamucyate ||37|| jaṃgamā brāhmaṇā devāstatrasthaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | brāhmaṇasyāruṇeryogād gacchāmi śāśvataṃ padam ||38|| ityuktvāruṇimāpūjya yayau brahmākṣaraṃ padam | āruṇiśca tato vyādhaṃ samuvāca prasannahṛt ||39|| jighṛkṣormṛgarājasya yat tvayā rakṣito’smyaham | tat putra tuṣṭaste dadmi varaṃ varaya suvrata ||1.542.40|| vyādhaḥ prāha varaścāyaṃ yastvaṃ māṃ bhāṣase sa hi | putratā tava santoṣaḥ kimasmādaparo varaḥ ||41 || ataḥ paraṃ vareṇāhaṃ kiṃ karomi praśādhi mām | ṛṣiḥ prāha tvayā vyādha prārthito’haṃ tapo’rthinā |||42|| mayā kiñcittadā noktaṃ yataścāsīdaghī bhavān | idānīṃ tava pāpāni tapasā mama rakṣayā ||43|| tathā me darśanenāpi kṛṣṇanāmaśrutena ca | naṣṭāni śuddhadeho’si sāmprataṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||44|| tapaḥ kuruṣva sādho tvaṃ mokṣamevamavāpsyasi | vyādhaḥ prāha bhavatoktaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||45|| sa kathaṃ prāpyate pāparatervai mādṛśairguro | ṛṣiḥ prāha tamuddiśya sarvaṃ kuryāt samarpaṇam ||46 || saḥ paraṃ tamavāpnoti bhaktyā vratena karmaṇā | evaṃ jñātvā ca tadbhaktyā sarvaṃ vrataṃ samācara ||47|| na bhakṣayedanaivedyaṃ na vadedanṛtaṃ kvacit | japaṃ kuryāt sadā tasya dhyānaṃ kuryāddharestathā ||48|| etatte vratamādiṣṭaṃ mayā vyādha tathā kuru | atraiva tapasā yuktastiṣṭha tvaṃ yāvadicchasi ||49|| evamuktvā muniḥ punaḥ salilāntarviveśa ha | vyādho guruṃ smaraṃstepe tapastvāhāravarjitaḥ ||1.542.50|| kṣudhākāle śīrṇaparṇānyabhakṣayat kvacit kvacit | śanaiḥ śanaistyaktavām̐śca parṇānāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ tadā ||51 || nirāhārastapastepe smaran gurumatandritaḥ | evaṃ tapasyatastasya durvāsā abhyagānmuniḥ ||52|| dadarśa śuṣkadehaṃ ca saprāṇaṃ vyādhameva saḥ | tapastejo’nvitaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe sthitaṃ hṛdā ||53|| jñātvā ṛṣiṃ sa ca vyādho natvā ca śirasā munim | uvāca taṃ kṛtārtho’smi bhagavan darśanāt tava ||54|| idānīṃ tvamatithirme prāpto’si daivataṃ mama | śīrṇaparṇādibhiḥ kṛtvā prīṇayāmi dvijottamam ||55|| durvāsā api taṃ śuddhabhāvapūtaṃ jitendriyam | jijñāsustattapaḥśraiṣṭhyamidamuccairuvāca ha |||56|| yavagodhūmaśālīnāmannaṃ miṣṭaṃ susaṃskṛtam | dīyatāṃ me kṣudhārtāya tvāmuddiśyāgatāya me ||57|| bhaktavyādho’yamityuktaścintāṃ paramikāṃ gataḥ | kasmādāneyametādṛk kathaṃ tat saṃbhaven mama ||58|| evaṃ cintayatastasya smarataśca narāyaṇam | gurośca kṛpayā vyomnaḥ pātraṃ saṃpatitaṃ śubham ||59|| sauvarṇaṃ siddhisaṃyuktaṃ tajjagrāha kareṇa saḥ | tad gṛhītvā muniṃ prāha pratīkṣasva kṣaṇam ṛṣe ||1.542.60 || atraiva sthīyatāṃ yāvadbhikṣāṭanaṃ karomi ca | tāvanmayi prasādaṃ tvaṃ guro vidhātumarhasi ||61 || evamuktvā sapātraḥ sa bhikṣāṃ yācitumeva ca | nātidūreṇa nagaraṃ vṛkṣavallyādiśobhitam ||62|| lakṣyīkṛtya prayāti sma mārgavṛkṣādivallayaḥ | tasya tatra prayātasya cāgrataḥ sarvaśobhanāḥ ||63|| vṛkṣebhyo niryayuḥ kanyā hemapātrāgrapāṇayaḥ | vanadevyaśca sundaryaḥ pakvānnāni śubhāni ca ||64|| vyañjanāni ca peyāni coṣyāṇi bhojyakāni ca | bhakṣyāṇi śubhalehyāni madhūni surasāṇi ca ||65|| dugdhāni ghṛtamiśrāṇi śarkarāpāyasāni ca | vyañjanāni vividhāni tiktamiṣṭāmblakāni ca ||66|| ṣaṭpañcāśadvidhānyeva dadustā vanadevatāḥ | sa ca kṛtārthamātmānaṃ matvā punarathāśramam ||67|| ājagāma ṛṣiṃ prāha bhikṣā prāptā yathepsitā | brahman kṣālaya pādau tvamupaviśyāsane śubhe ||68|| imāṃ gṛhāṇa bhikṣāṃ ca kuru māṃ puṇyabhājanam | evamuktaḥ sa jijñāsustapo balaṃ punarmuniḥ ||69|| prāha bhaktaṃ ca taṃ vyādhaṃ nāsti pātraṃ jalasya me | nadīṃ gantuṃ na śaknomi pātraṃ te’pi na vidyate ||1.542.70|| kathaṃ prakṣālanaṃ vyādha pādayorme bhavediti | ityukto vyādhabhaktaḥ saḥ punaścintāparo’bhavat ||71 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā guruṃ tathā | smṛtvā jagāma śaraṇaṃ tāṃ tu nāganadīṃ tadā ||72|| uvāca praṇato bhūtvā sarit tvaṃ śaraṇaṃ mama | vyādho’smi pāpakarmāsmi brahmahāsmi saridvare ||73|| tathāpi māṃ bhaktamatra pāhi te śaraṇāgatam | devatāṃ naiva jānāmi na mantraṃ na tathārcanam ||74|| āruṇerme guroḥ pādau dhyātvā paśyāmi vai śubham | evaṃ bhaktasya me devi kṛpāṃ kuru saridvare ||75|| ṛṣerāsannatāṃ yāhi pādaśaucārthamāpage | evamuktvā nāganadī jalapravāharūpataḥ ||76|| ājagāma yatastasthau durvāsā vṛkṣamāśritaḥ | tad dṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ durvāsā vismayaṃ yayau ||77|| prakṣālya hastapādau ca bhikṣānnaṃ śraddhayā ṛṣiḥ | vubhuje paramaprītastathācamya hasanmuhuḥ ||78|| taṃ vyādhaṃ śuṣkadehaṃ ca kṣudhā durbalatāṃ gatam | varaṃ dadau te vedā vai sāṃgā sārthapadakramāḥ ||79|| brahmavidyāstathā sarvāḥ pratyakṣā vai bhavantu hi | tvaṃ ca nāmnā satyatapā ṛṣiragryo bhaviṣyasi ||1.542.80|| vyādhaḥ prāha kathaṃ śūdro vedādhyayanavānaham | ṛṣiḥ prāha śarīraṃ te gataṃ pāpamayaṃ dhruvam ||81|| tapomayaṃ śarīraṃ te dvitīyaṃ vartate’dhunā | prāgajñānaṃ gataṃ nāśamidānīṃ jñānamāgatam ||82|| evaṃ tvaṃ śuddhakāyo’si satyametad bravīmi te | dīkṣayā tapasā bhaktyā deho vai parivartate ||83|| tena vedādhyayanādi pratibhāsyati te’dhunā | prāgavasthamadharmākhyaṃ parijñānavivarjitam ||84|| gataṃ te vyādhaśarīraṃ, paraṃ dharmavratādimat | idānīṃ vai samāpannaṃ bhaktipūtaṃ dvitīyakam ||85|| yastu bhāvaḥ purā hyāsīt prāṇino nighnatastava | tatpāpākhyaṃ śarīraṃ te pāpasaṃjñaṃ gataṃ khalu ||86|| idānīṃ śubhasadvṛtti tapaārjavabhaktimat | dvitīyāṃ dharmarūpaṃ tu śarīraṃ te vyavasthitam ||87|| vyādhaḥ prāha ṛṣiṃ nārāyaṇo vai sādhanaṃ vinā | kathamārādhanīyaścāparigraheṇa yoginā ||88|| durvāsāḥ prāha manasā pūjanaṃ sarvathācaret | na dhanaṃ vā kulaṃ tatra sampadvā samapekṣyate ||89|| bhāvena bhagavān nityaṃ tuṣyatyeva janārdanaḥ | snātvā dhyātvā hariṃ nityaṃ mānasairupacārakaiḥ ||1.542.90|| pūjayed bhāvayennīrājayet kṣamāpayettathā | puṣpāṃjaliṃ jalamarghaṃ dadyād dadyācca mānasam ||91 || ātmārpaṇaṃ prakuryācca tena tuṣyejjanārdanaḥ | sadhanainirdhanaiścāpi prāpyate parameśvaraḥ ||92|| api koṭiśreṣṭhadānairbhaktihīnairna tuṣyati | sabhaktestu patramātradānenāpi pratuṣyati ||93|| jalena candanenāpi puṣpamātreṇa tuṣyati | tritasya khalu bhāvena kardamenāpi cārcitāḥ ||94|| jalena vai surāḥ sarve santuṣṭā hi nidarśanam | prahlādasya japenaiva tuṣṭaḥ śrībhagavān hariḥ ||95|| gopīnāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastuṣṭo hṛdarpaṇāt | lakṣmyā dāsyena santuṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||96|| pārvatyāśca tvaparṇāyāḥ santuṣṭaḥ śaṃkaraḥ svayam | ambarīṣasya bhagavāṃstuṣṭo bhāvena pūjayā ||97|| evaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’kṣarādhipaḥ prabhuḥ | bhāvabhaktyā prasannaḥ syānna vinā bhāvamacyutaḥ ||98|| devatā guravaḥ santaḥ pitaro dharma īśvaraḥ | mokṣaḥ phalaṃ sadityetacchraddhāgamyaṃ hi bhāvitam ||99|| bhaktiḥ sevā vyavahāraścopārjanaṃ ca melanam | arthaḥ siddhiḥ sukhaṃ caitat kriyāsādhyaṃ tadaṣṭakam || 1.542.1 00|| mantro vidyā ca kalaho gāyanaṃ japa āhvanam | upadeśo’rthavādaśca vāṇīsādhyaṃ tadaṣṭakam || 101 || gṛhāṇi ca striyo ramyāḥ putrāścājñākarāḥ kṣitiḥ | yaśo mānaṃ patiḥ pārśvāḥ puṇyasādhyaṃ tadaṣṭakam || 1 02|| śāntistṛptirvirāgaśca śreyaḥ puṇyaṃ ca mokṣaṇam | nivṛttiścopakāraśca jñānasādhyaṃ tadaṣṭakam || 1 03|| pṛthvī prāha purā devo vārāho jalamagnikān | jalaplutāṃ mahīṃ dadyānnārāyaṇāya bhāvataḥ || 1 04|| tathāpyahaṃ prasannaḥ syāṃ pṛthvyāṃ raso’smi vai yataḥ | tvayā devi smṛtaścāhaṃ jalena pūjitastathā || 1 05|| tvadrakṣārthaṃ samāyāto vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ | evaṃ me bhāvayuktena manasā śaraṇaṃ vrajet || 1 06|| tasyāhaṃ sarvathā tuṣṭo mokṣaṃ dadāmi tadvaśaḥ | dvādaśyāṃ ca prage pūjāṃ yaḥ karoti tu bhāvataḥ || 1 07|| tasyāhaṃ brahmalokaṃ ca dadāmi śāśvataṃ kṣite | ityuktvā pṛthivīṃ kroḍa uddadhāra jalopari || 1 08|| ityevaṃ pārvatīṃ lakṣmi śaṃbhuḥ prāha prabhāsake | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya brahmalokaphalaṃ bhavet || 1 09|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āruṇeḥ sannidhau siṃhasya muktiḥ, vyādhakṛtā viprarakṣā tapaścaryā ca, vaidikasya dīrghabāhorviprāṇāmavamānāt siṃho bhaveti śāpaḥ, tapasyato vyādhasya prārthanayāruṇeḥ pādaprakṣālitavatī nāgamatī nadī, vyādhasya pāvitryaṃ satyatapānāmaṛṣitvaṃ, durvāsasā kṛtajñānopadeśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvācatvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 542 ||
<1.543> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi prabhāse vai pārvatī śaṃkaraṃ varam | saṃpapraccha tithisvāminaśca vadāmi te yathā || 1 || yathā sṛṣṭeḥ samāraṃbhe brahmā yasmai dadau tithim | tatte lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi tithīnāṃ devatādikam || 2 || brahmā sṛṣṭiṃ vidhātuṃ ca mano dadhe tu puṣkare | yadā kiñcinnādhyagacchat tadā roṣo’sya cābhavat || 3 || lalāṭād roṣarūpo vai gharmabindustadākṣarat | vahnijātiḥ sa patitaḥ kṣudhito bhojyamārthayat || 4 || brahmaṇā ca kratau havyaṃ jāṭhare bhuktamityapi | pṛthvyādau khanijaṃ khādyaṃ tredhā bhojyaṃ purārpitam || 5 || havanīyo jāṭharaścākarajaśceti vai tridhā | ādyaṃ pratipaddivase vyabhajad viśvarūṭ ca tam || 6 || sā tithiḥ prathamā tasmai cārpitā pūjanādikam | vahneḥ pratipadi brāhme muhūrte kāryameva tat || 7 || atha sūryasya vai patnī saṃjñā tejo’sahā satī | aśvinīrūpamāsthāya yayau haimottaraṃ purā || 8 || sūryastvaśvasvarūpeṇa lebhe saṃgaṃ tayā saha | aśvinībālakau jātau prāṇāpānau bhiṣagvarau || 9 || dvitīyāyāṃ ca tajjātau sā tābhyāṃ brahmaṇā purā | pūjanādau tithirdattā rogavyādhivināśinī || 1.543.10 || atha vāṇīṃ samutpādya brahmā gaurīsvarūpiṇīm | tṛtīyāyāṃ śaṃkarāya dadau vivāhakarmaṇā || 11 || sā gauryai vai tithirdattā saubhāgyādivivardhinī | atha gauryā gaṇeśastanmātrātmakaḥ suto’bhavat || 1 2|| śrīkṛṣṇastu svayaṃ prātaścaturthyāṃ gaṇanāyakaḥ | jātastasya pūjanārthaṃ tasmai caturthikārpitā || 1 3|| atha kadrvāḥ sutānāṃ tu nāgānāṃ garuḍena vai | bhakṣaṇārthaṃ vare prāpte brahmāto nijarakṣaṇam || 14|| nāgāśca prārthayāmāsurbrahmā tadrakṣaṇaṃ tathā | pūjanaṃ pañcamīdaine dadau sā nāgapañcamī || 15|| tatra dugdhatilaistṛptā daṃśanti naiva mānavān | atha vai kārtikasvāmī ṣaṣṭhyāṃ jātaḥ satīgṛhe || 16|| ahaṃkārātmakastasmai ṣaṣṭhī tithiḥ samarpitā | atha netraṃ samutpādyādityākhyaṃ prathame yuge || 17|| tejo’rpaṇaṃ vidhāyaiva lokatejaḥpralabdhaye | vyomni taṃ sthāpayāmāsa saptamyāṃ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ 18|| saptamī sā tithistasmai pradattā parameṣṭhinā | athāndhakākhyadaityasya nāśanārthaṃ suraiḥ purā ||1 9|| devyastvaṣṭau nirmitā vai mātaro yāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | śabdaḥ sparśastathā rūpaṃ raso gandho’tha kāmanā ||1.543.20 || ahaṃkṛtistathā bhrāntiramūrtā mūrtayo’bhavat | kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho moho madaśca matsaraḥ ||21|| paiśunyaṃ cānasūyā ca mūrtayastvabhavan purā | kāmaṃ yogeśvarīṃ viddhi krodhaṃ māheśvarīṃ tathā ||22|| lobhaṃ tu vaiṣṇavīṃ viddhi brahmāṇīṃ madameva ca | mohaṃ svāyaṃbhavīṃ viddhi kaumārīṃ matsarodbhavām ||23 || paiśunyaṃ yamadaṇḍīṃ cāpyasūyāṃ viddhi mātṛkāḥ | etā raktapraśoṣiṇyo bhavanti dehagehajāḥ ||24|| andhakasya śoṣitaṃ ca rudhiraṃ sarvameva yat | tena raktodbhavāścānye koṭiśo’pyandhakāstadā ||25|| naṣṭā eva hi tābhyaśca dattāṣṭamī tu vedhasā | tatra pūjyāśca tā rakṣāṃ kurvantyanudinaṃ śubhāḥ ||26|| atha tvāṣṭrasya vetrasya vināśārthaṃ tu vedhasā | śarīramāyā durgā ca svāccharīrāt prakāśitā ||27|| sāyudhā mānasī kanyā sā ca durgāṣṭasadbhajā | siṃhāsthitā jaghāne yaṃ vetrāsuraṃ tataśca sā ||28|| himālaye sthitā tasyāḥ prākaṭyaṃ navamītithau | brahmā tasyai navamīṃ ca dadau pūjādihetave ||29|| atha sarvāṇi tattvāni purā vai vedhasaṃ prati | prārthayāmāsuratyarthamāśrayaṃ nijamadbhutam || 1.543.3 0|| tadā tu brahmaṇā karṇadeśād daśa ca kanyakāḥ | utpāditā diśastāstu pūrvā ca dakṣiṇā tathā ||3 1 || paścimā cottarā cordhvā hyadhogā mukhyataśca ṣaṭ | īśā hyagnirnairṛtiśca vāyavī ceti tā daśa ||32|| tābhyaḥ kāryasvarūpābhyo’vakāśaṃ karma saṃdadau | avakāśasvarūpābhyaḥ patayaśca samarpitāḥ ||33|| pūrvāmindrāya dakṣāṃ ca yamāya kuberāya tu | uttarāṃ paścimāṃ varuṇāyordhvāṃ brahmaṇe svayam ||34|| adhogāṃ phaṇine caiśāṃ ceśāyāgniṃ tu vahnaye | nirṛti nirṛtaye ca vāyavīṃ vāyave tathā ||35|| dadau brahmā ca daśamīṃ tithiṃ tābhyo’rcanāya ca | athaikādaśikāyāṃ ca kuberamasṛjat prabhuḥ ||36|| dhanaṃ jayākhyādvāyostu tasmai tāṃ ca tithiṃ dadau | nārāyaṇasya tejobhiḥ kanyā tvekā hyajāyata ||37|| ekādaśendriyāṇāṃ sā vrataṃ tvekādaśī matam | dvādaśyāṃ ca samutpannaḥ parānnārāyaṇāt khalu ||38|| padmanābho manorūpo mūrto viṣṇuḥ prapoṣakaḥ | tasmai dadau harikṛṣṇo dvādaśīṃ mokṣadāyinīm ||39|| atha vai brahmaṇo vakṣaḥsthalād dharmo hyajāyata | yugāraṃbhe catuṣpāt sa śvetavarṇo’bhavat khalu ||1.543.40 || dravyaguṇakriyājāticatuṣpadyuk prakīrtitaḥ | triśṛṃgaśca smṛto vede sasaṃhitapadakramaḥ ||41 || tathā ādyanta oṃkāradviśirāḥ saptahastavān | dānaṃ dayā damo dharmo’rthaḥ kāmo mokṣa ityamī ||42|| hastā atha udāttāditribhirbaddho vyavasthitaḥ | kṛto vai brāhmaṇastatra catuṣpāt ṣaṭkriyātmakaḥ ||43|| tretā ca kṣatriyastatra tripādo gauṇa eva saḥ | dvāparo vaiśya evātra dvipādaśca pragauṇakaḥ ||44|| kaliḥ śūdrastatra caikāṃśena dharmo vyavasthitaḥ | sa dharmaḥ pīḍitaḥ sṛṣṭerādau kṣattreṇa pādataḥ ||45|| candreṇāpahṛtā tārā guroḥ patnī pativratā | dharmastena mahāghorāraṇyaṃ saṃpraviveśa ha ||46 || caturdaśasu lokeṣu dharmo vai līnatāṃ gataḥ | asurāśca surāścāpi hyadharmeṇāvṛtāstadā ||47|| jighṛkṣantaḥ paraukāṃsi parastrīdhanasampadaḥ | babhramuḥ parasaudheṣu nirmaryādāstadābhavan ||48|| yuyudhurapajahruśca parakīyaṃ parasparam | brahmā vināśamālakṣya dharmaṃ prāha sanātanam ||49|| tvāṃ vinā tu jagatsarvaṃ vināśaṃ prasameṣyati | candrastyajatu vai tārāṃ dharmastiṣṭhatu sarvathā ||1.543.50 || tvayaiva pālyate pṛthvī trailokyaṃ ca tvayaiva hi | janastapastathā satyaṃ tvayā sarvaṃ tu pālyate ||51 || na tvayā rahitaṃ kiñcijjagatsthāvarajaṃgamam | vidyate tvadvihīnaṃ cet sadyo naśyet tato jagat ||52|| tvamātmā sarvabhūtānāṃ satāṃ sattvasvarūpavān | rājasīnāṃ rajastvaṃ ca tāmasīnāṃ tamomayaḥ ||53|| tvayā hīnā ime devāḥ sarve tūnmārgavartinaḥ | unmārgaṃ yaccha mūḍhānāṃ tvaṃ putra paramā gatiḥ ||54|| evaṃ stuto vṛṣaḥ śāntacakṣurbhyāṃ devatādikān | apaśyad dṛṣṭamātrāste babhūvurdharmamānasāḥ ||55|| kṣaṇena gatasammohā asurā api dhārmikāḥ | samabhavan dharmayuktāḥ sarve ca ṛtavastathā ||56 || vṛkṣā vallyo narā nāryaścetanāni jaḍāni ca | sarve svadharmayuktāśca śītoṣṇādyāstathābhavan ||57|| evaṃ dharmāya ca dattā tithistasya trayodaśī | dharmo yatrābhavadgupto dharmāraṇyaṃ hi tatsmṛtam ||58|| brahmādharmaṃ samādiśya sṛṣṭeragryaṃ padaṃ tataḥ | yayau vai satyalokaṃ ca jagat svasthamabhūttathā ||59|| tato mūrtasvarūpeṇa yamarājo’bhavaddhi saḥ | atha rudro brahmaṇastu lalāṭātsamajāyata ||1.543.60|| caturdaśyāṃ tithau tasmai yajñabhāgo’pi cārpitaḥ | dakṣayajñe haradvāre ṛṣibhirmunibhistathā ||61|| sā tithiḥ śivarātryākhyā rudrāya sarvathārpitā | dharmasya śvaśuro dakṣo, dakṣakanyāśataṃ tvabhūt ||62|| tāśca sṛṣṭeḥ suvṛddhyarthaṃ surebhyaḥ pradadau pṛthak | satīṃ dadau śaṃkarāya daśa dharmāya vai dadau ||63|| śraddhā medhā dhṛtirmūrtiḥ kṣamā lajjā śuciḥ smṛtiḥ | śaktiḥ śrutistadetāsu mūrternārāyaṇo’bhavat ||64|| hariḥ kṛṣṇo naraśceti catvāro mūrtibhaktijāḥ | dve bhārye kāmadevāya ratiḥ prītistathaiva ca ||65|| ekāṃ svāhāṃ dadau vahneḥ pitṝṇāṃ ca svadhāṃ tataḥ | saptaviṃśatikanyāstu nakṣatrāṇi niśāpateḥ ||66|| aśvinī bharaṇī cāpi kṛttikā mṛgaśirṣikā | ārdrā punarvasuḥ puṣyā cāśleṣā ca maghā tathā ||67|| pūrvāphālgunikā cordhvaphālgunī hastinī tathā | citrā svātirviśākhānurādhā jyeṣṭhā ca mūlikā ||68|| pūrvāṣāḍhottarāṣāḍhā śravaṇā ca dhaniṣṭhikā | śatabhīṣā pūrvabhādrapadordhvabhādrikastathā ||69||| revatī ceti candrasya patnyo’bhavam̐śca rohiṇī | kaśyapāya dadau dakṣaḥ śubhāḥ kanyāstrayodaśa ||1.543.70|| aditiśca ditiścāpi danuḥ kāṣṭhā irāvatī | vinatā cāpi kadrūśca siṃhikā suprabhā tathā ||71 || īrṣyā māyā tathā hiṃsā nirṛtiśceti tāḥ khalu | varuṇāyārpitāḥ pañca gauḍī vastrā ca vārtikā ||72|| sādhvī sumālikā ceti varuṇānyastu tāḥ smṛtāḥ | kuberāya dadau pañca bhadrā ca madirā tataḥ ||73|| vidyā dhanyā dhanā ceti kuberāṇyaśca tā iti | rudrāya daśa kanyāstā jayā ca vijayā tathā ||74|| irāvatī madhucchandā supriyā janakā tathā | kāntā subhadrā dharmālī śubhā ca rudrayoṣitaḥ ||75|| ādityebhyo dadau dakṣo dvādaśa kanyakāśca tāḥ | prabhāvatī subhadrā ca vimalā nirmalā vṛtā ||76|| tīvrā dakṣā hmaruṇā ca vidyā ca dvārapālinī | varvasā ca prabhā ceti sūryasya yoṣitaśca tāḥ ||77|| viśvadevebhyaśca dakṣo dadāvaṣṭau hi kanyakāḥ | yoganidrā vibhūtiśca śiṃśapā śaramā guhā ||78|| mālā vaṃśā tathā jyotsnā tā viśvadevayoṣitaḥ | aśvinyāśca sutābhyāṃ dve suveṣā bhūṣaṇā tathā ||79|| ekā śvāsā vāyave ca sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇe tathā | lakṣmīṃ ca viṣṇave dakṣo dadau tāḥ śatakanyakāḥ ||1.543.80|| sṛṣṭerādau yuge caivaṃ kanyādānaṃ babhūva ha | tena kanyāpradānasya rītiḥ sarveṣu cāgatā ||81 || tābhyaḥ prapūritaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṃgamam | atha vai pitaraḥ sarve brahmaṇaścānanāt purā ||82|| dhūmrarūpāḥ samutpannā ūrdhvānanāstathordhvagāḥ | amāvāsyā ca pitṛbhyo’rpitā vai prathame yuge ||83|| candramase pūrṇimā ca kalānāṃ nidhaye’rpitā | brahmaṇo manase jāya śītadevāya vedhasā ||84|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi tithīnāmarpaṇaṃ tava | dīpotsavī tathā te’tra dhanatrayodaśī śubhā ||85|| lakṣmi samarpitā tubhyaṃ śāradāyaiva sarvathā | mūlanakṣatrayogaśca śravaṇasya tathā punaḥ ||86|| sarasvatyai pūjanārthaṃ cārpito hariṇā mayā | evaṃ vividhavārāśca tattadutpattināmataḥ ||87|| saptadevebhya evādau yuge samarpitā mayā | tatra teṣāṃ pūjanena tadīyaṃ sarvathā balam ||88|| dhanaṃ saukhyaṃ samaiśvaryaṃ dadatyeva hi devatāḥ | vighnānāṃ śamanaṃ tadvad dāridryasya vināśanam ||89|| ādhivyādhivināśādi jāyate devapūjanāt | evaṃ lakṣmi sadā deve pratimāyāṃ tithau tithau ||1.543.90|| nivasāmi svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ | bhāvena suprasanno’smi bhaktyā dāsyena sarvathā || 91 || karomi śreya eteṣāṃ śaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ | śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya phalaṃ bhavati śāśvatam ||92|| tattattithisurāṇāṃ tvarcanajaṃ ca phalaṃ bhavet | evaṃ prāha svayaṃ śaṃbhuḥ śivarātryāṃ prabhāsake ||93|| pārvatyai tanmayā lakṣmi tubhyaṃ sarvaṃ niveditam | viśeṣeṇeṣṭa devaṃ tu dhyāyedvai devatāsvapi ||94|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pañcadaśatithīnāṃ tattaddevānāṃ ca sahetukavarṇananāmā tricatvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||543 ||
<1.544> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu tīrthāni cānyāni śaṃkaroktāni padmaje | nyaṃkumatī devikā ca nadīdvayaṃ tu mokṣadam || 1 || purā saṃvarttarṣiputrāḥ pañcāśanmṛgaveṣiṇaḥ | mṛgacarmaparīdhānāḥ siṃhāraṇye nyuṣuḥ sadā || 2 || tāpasā rāgahīnāśca tapo’rthaṃ pitṛnoditāḥ | puṇye prabhāsake kṣetre tṛṇapatrādibhojinaḥ || 3 || brahmacaryaparā nityaṃ triḥsnānādividhāyinaḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ || 4 || japanta iti govindaṃ vṛkṣo’dhovāsino’bhavan | athaikadā vīradhanvā rājā prabhāsamāyayau || 5 || vane dṛṣṭvā mṛgān tām̐śca vivyādha sāyakairyadā | brāhmaṇāste mṛtā hatyā rājño jātā hi duḥkhadāḥ || 6 || rājā cintāturo yāto devarātāśramaṃ tadā | vijñāpya brahmahatyāśca rurodātīva duḥkhitaḥ || 7 || sa ṛṣirdevarātastu dayāluḥ prāha bhūbhṛtam | mā rodihi gaccha pārśve vartate devikānadī || 8 || tapaḥ kuru taṭe tasyā ārabhasva makhaṃ tataḥ | prāyaścittāni kṛtyaiva śuddho rājan bhaviṣyasi || 9 || ityāśrutya ca taṃ natvā yayau tāṃ devikāṃ nadīm | devarātaṃ saha nītvā viṣṇuyāgaṃ cakāra saḥ || 1.544.1 0|| sahasraśo brāhmaṇāṃśca bhojayāmāsa sādaram | pūjayāmāsa devāṃśca tarpayāmāsa pitṝkān || 11 || toṣayāmāsa miṣṭānnairdānaiśca bhikṣukām̐stataḥ | yajñasya parihāre’tra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 2|| lomaśaśca munistatra mṛgau bhūtvā prajagmatuḥ | maṇḍapavedikāṃ gatvā nirbhayau dhṛtadhūmrakān || 1 3|| ghrāṇena ca muhustatrākarṣayāmāsaturhyubhau | rājā devau tu tau matvā nanāmotthāya pādayoḥ || 14|| tāvat kṣuvadbhyāṃ tābhyāṃ ca nāsikāmalato nṛpaḥ | śleṣmāvṛtaḥ kṛtastatra nairmalyamāptavānnṛpaḥ || 15|| rājño dehāttadā kanyāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇā hi sarvaśaḥ | vinirjagmustadā kuṇḍe nipetustāḥ prajajvaluḥ || 16|| kimidaṃ kimidaṃ tvetajjātaḥ kolāhalāstadā | mṛgau tau nararūpau ca mānuṣau saṃbabhūvatuḥ || 17|| divyadeho lomaśaśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’pi ca | ūcatustaṃ nṛpaṃ rājan yajñena toṣitau tvayā || 18|| dṛṣṭāvatra kṛpayā nau brahmahatyāḥ pradāhitāḥ | śuddho’si devikākṣetre mama bhaktyā gurūktitaḥ || 19|| yāhi rājyaṃ kuru maivaṃ punarhiṃsāmanarthikām | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprākaṭyakālikam ||1.544.20|| ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīrūpaṃ vrataṃ kuru bhajasva mām | evaṃ kṛtvā mokṣamārgaṃ yāsyasyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||21 || kṛtaṃ tena yathoktena jayantīkālikaṃ vratam | nārāyaṇaḥ prasannaḥ sannāyātaśca punaḥ punaḥ ||22|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrādvimānena vihāyasā | mṛtyukāle’gamat svargamindralokaṃ sa pārthivaḥ ||23|| tasyendrastvarghamādāya pratyutthānena cāyayau | vimānasthāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaiva tu pārṣadāḥ ||24|| utthānaṃ ca prakurvantaṃ rājānaṃ prāhurīśvarāḥ | pratyutthānaṃ tvayā rājan naiva kartavyamatra yat ||25|| devāstvatto hīnapuṇyā bhavān puṇyena vardhate | bahupuṇyayutaḥ svalpapuṇyavantaṃ prati prabhuḥ ||26|| pratyutthānaṃ prakaroti svalpapuṇyavatastadā | svalpaṃ puṇyaṃ vinaśyettu tasmānmotthānamācara ||27|| evaṃ ye ye diśāṃ pālāḥ satkārārthaṃ samāgatāḥ | te te svalpavṛṣāścainaṃ rājānaṃ paripūjya ca ||28||| yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niketaṃ ca rājā notthita eva hi | evaṃ sa satyalokāntaṃ gato rājā vimokṣaṇam ||29|| apunarmārake loke dāhapralayavarjite | adyāpi tiṣṭhate devaiḥ stūyamāno jalopari ||1.544.30|| dvitīyarūpe vaikuṇṭhe śāśvataṃ sukhamāptavān | prasanne yajñapuruṣe durlabhaṃ kinnu cottamam |||3 1|| iha janmani saubhāgyamāyurārogyasampadaḥ | dadātyeva ramānāthaḥ parāṃ muktiṃ ca durlabhām ||32||| evaṃ muktiṃ gato rājā devikāyāstaṭe śubhe | devarātakṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ yajñanārāyaṇātmakam || 33|| mṛgatīrthaṃ tathā tatra devikāyāṃ hi vartate | snātvā dhyātvā hariṃ smṛtvāvaśyaṃ mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||34|| śivastu pārvatīṃ prāha nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe purā | cyavanaśca ṛṣiḥ patnīsahitastīrthavāñcchayā ||34|| padbhyāṃ samāgato nyaṃkumatyā sthito hi vatsaram | vatsaraṃ somanāthe ca vatsaraṃ lomaśāśrame ||36|| vatsaraṃ raivatādrau caṃ vatsaraṃ tvarbudācale | evaṃ kṛtvā sutīrthāni yayau badarikāśramam ||37|| śrīpārvatī tadāpṛcchat kā tadbhāryābhavat satī | śaṃbhuḥ prāha śṛṇu sādhvi cyavanasyāpi satkathām ||38|| pūrvataṭe hiraṇyāyāḥ kadācittapasi sthitaḥ | sūryastotraṃ cakārāsāvaṣṭottaraśatātmakam ||39|| sūryastadā prasannaḥ san samāyātastu sannidhau | uvāca tamṛṣiṃ brūhi varaṃ kiṃ karavāṇi te ||1.544.40|| cyavanaḥ prāha lokānāṃ cakṣustvaṃ parameśvara | aṣṭottaraśatarūpairaṣṭottaraśatasthale ||41|| mūrtimān vasa saurāṣṭre mandireṣu mahatsu ca | hiraṇyasiṃho rājā te kariṣyatyālayān śubhān ||42|| lokarakṣārthamevātra saurāṣṭre sarvato vasa | tathāstviti raviḥ prāha kṛtvāṣṭottaraśātakam ||43|| rūpāṇāṃ ca ravistasthau saurāṣṭre vai yathāruci | tāni nāmāni te devi kathayāmi yathāyatham ||44|| oṃ sūryo’ryamā bhagastvaṣṭā pūṣārkaḥ savitā raviḥ | gabhastimānajādityo dhātādityaḥ prabhākaraḥ ||45|| kṣityādityo vanādityaḥ prabhādityaḥ khakheśvaraḥ | prāṇādityaśca somārko gurvādityo divākaraḥ |||46|| śukrārko’ṅgārakāditya indrārko bodhabhāskaraḥ | dīpāṃśuśca vivasvām̐śca śucyarkaścarabhāskaraḥ ||47|| brahmādityaśca raudrārko viṣṇuḥ skandārka ityapi | śravaṇārko yamārkaśca vaidyutārko divaspatiḥ ||48|| vaiśvānarārkaścāgnyarkaścendhanāditya īśvaraḥ | dharmādityaśca vedārko vācārkaḥ kṛtabhāpatiḥ ||49|| tretādityo dvāparārkasturyādityaḥ kalīśvaraḥ | kalādityaśca kāṣṭhārko muhūrtāditya ityapi ||1.544.50|| cakrādityo vatsarārkastigmaraśmirvibhāvasuḥ | puruṣārko hiraṇyārko yogādityaḥ sadīśvaraḥ ||51 || lokādityaḥ prajādityo viśvādityastamonudaḥ | vāruṇārkaḥ sāgarārko jīmūtārkaḥ pratāpanaḥ ||52|| bhūtārko nirmalārkaśca lolārkastigmadīdhitiḥ | kuṣṭhahāditya īśārko bhānuḥ kāmārka ityapi |||53|| jayādityaśca bhadrārko raivatādityakāntimān | saṃjñeśaśca suvarṇārkaḥ śatruṃjidarka ādidṛk ||54|| kapilāṃśuścāṃśumālin kaṃkādityaśca bhāspatiḥ | vanādityaśca saptāśvaścāruṇārkastriviṣṭapaḥ ||55|| nārāyaṇo haritāśvaḥ sandhyeśo bhagavān prabhaḥ | grahādityaścāmareśaḥ kaṃthaḍeśaḥ karādhipaḥ ||56|| vedādityaḥ surāṣṭrarko nṛpādityaḥ satīśvaraḥ | dyumaṇiḥ savitā dhātā vidhātārketi te namaḥ ||57|| ityevaṃ khalu saurāṣṭre pṛthak pṛthagvasanti hi | sūryā lokaprarakṣārthaṃ tattīrthaṃ lokapāvanam ||58|| hiraṇyāyāstaṭe ramyaṃ vidyate kṣatrapūjitam | sūryodaye paṭhed yastu sa putraratnasaṃcayān ||59|| jātismṛtiṃ ca medhāṃ cārogyaṃ svargaṃ ca vindati | hiraṇyaṃ ca gajān rājyaṃ rāmāśca divyasampadaḥ ||1.544.60|| evaṃ cyavanasāmarthyāt sūryanārāyaṇaḥ svayam | aṣṭottaraśatadhā san samuvāsa surāṣṭrake ||61 || cyavanāśrama evāpi hiraṇyāyāstaṭe śubhe | tīrthaṃ vai vidyate tatra lokakalyāṇakārakam ||62|| cyavanasya satī bhāryā śaryāterduhitābhavat | kadācittu gate kāle tapastepe ṛṣirvane ||63|| bhagoḥ putraścyavanaḥ sa pṛthvyāṃ dīrghaṃ sthiro’bhavat | kālena mahatā devi samākīrṇaḥ pipīlakaiḥ ||64|| sarvato mṛttikāpiṇḍairabhivyāpto latādibhiḥ | valmīkena samāchannastapasyeva vyavasthitaḥ ||65|| atha kasyāpi kālasya śaryātirnāma bhūpatiḥ | vane samājagāmāsau yatra ṛṣeḥ śubhāśramaḥ ||66|| rājñaḥ kanyā sukanyākhyā sakhībhiḥ parivāritā | caṃkramyamāṇā valmīkaṃ cyavanasya samāsadat ||67|| supuṣpāṇi vicinvantī valmīke ṛṣicakṣuṣī | dṛṣṭvā kiṃ nviti sāścaryā kaṇḍakena bibheda sā ||68|| raktaṃ netravivarābhyāṃ niryātaṃ sā bhayaṃ gatā | ṛṣeḥ kopena śaryāteḥ sainyasya nṛpatestathā ||69|| samāruddhe śakṛnmūtre paryatapyata pārthivaḥ | kanyovāca pitaścātrāparāddho vai ṛṣirmayā ||1.544.70|| rājā ṛṣiṃ samavadat kanyāṃ kṣantuṃ tvamarhasi | cyavanaḥ prāha me kanyāṃ dehi doṣaṃ kṣamāmi vai ||71 || rājā dadau tadā kanyāṃ ṛṣiśca prasasāda ha | sainyaṃ svasthaṃ samabhavat siṣeve kanyakā ṛṣim ||72|| ṛṣiṃ vṛddhaṃ devavaidyau samājagmaturīśvarau | sukanyāṃ tāvūcatuśca vṛddhayogyā na sundarī ||73|| sā tvaṃ cyavanamutsṛjya varayasvaikamāvayoḥ | kanyā prāha patirdevo vṛddho vā yadi vā kṛśaḥ ||74|| devavaidyau kurutaṃ me patiṃ yuvānamīśvaram | vaidyau tau kṛtavantau taṃ svasadṛśaṃ mahāmunim ||75 || rūpatrayaṃ samānaṃ vai jātaṃ yathā pṛthaṅ na vai | kanyā vicārayāmāsa ko’tra me’sti patiḥ khalu ||76 || pātivratyena vai cāntaḥsamadhinā svakaṃ patim | vijñāya taṃ kare gṛhya pādayoḥ patitā satī ||77|| vaidyāvaścaryamāpannau satyeyaṃ vai pativratā | tau vaidyau cyavanaṃ tatrāhaturyajñeṣu sarvathā ||78|| bhāgau syātāmāvayośca tathā tvaṃ kuru bhārgava | ṛṣiryajñe bhāgavantau kṛtavām̐stau bhiṣagvarau ||79|| athaikadā tu śaryātiḥ kanyāyāḥ sukhamuttamam | draṣṭuṃ samāgatastatrāśrame kanyāṃ dadarśa saḥ ||1.544.80|| yuvānaṃ sevamānāṃ tāṃ papraccha kanyakāṃ nṛpaḥ | ko’yaṃ kanye sevito’sti paraḥ kaścicca me bhramaḥ ||81|| kanyā prāha pitarme’sti patiḥ śrīcyavano muniḥ | aśvinīsutayogena yauvanaṃ svāminārjitam ||82|| rājā śrutvā prasanno’bhūt ṛṣiṃ prāha karomi te | sevāṃ vada ṛṣe cātra ṛṣiḥ prāha makhaṃ kuru ||83|| tataḥ paramasaṃhṛṣṭaḥ śaryātistu kratoḥ kṛte | kārayāmāsa saṃbhārān yājayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ ||84|| suravaidyau bhāgavantau cyavanena kṛtau tadā | indrastaṃ vārayāmāsa naitau bhāgārhaṇau yataḥ ||85|| bhiṣajau karmaṇā caitau janmanā cāpi garhitau | ṛṣirindramanādṛtya dadau bhāgau bhiṣagdvaye ||86|| indro vajram ṛṣiṃ hantuṃ jagrāhordhvakaro’bhavat | ṛṣistaṃ staṃbhayāmāsa mahendraḥ śaraṇe’patat ||87|| bhāgaṃ tayordadau paścāt staṃbhanaṃ praśaśāma ha | evaṃ pratāpavān vipro hiraṇyāyāstaṭe śubhe ||88|| kuṭīṃ kṛtvā varṣamātraṃ bhāryayā tu sukanyayā | saha tepe tapaścograṃ saurāṣṭre vai prabhāsake ||89|| tadāśrame vaikhānasāḥ ṛṣayo’pi vasanti vai | tattīrthaṃ bhāvataḥ kuryāt sāmarthyaiśvaryasampadām ||1.544.90|| dhanaputrasutārogyasmṛddhīnāṃ sampradaṃ param | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||91 || ityevaṃ śaṃkaro lakṣmi pārvatīṃ prajagāda ha | śaryāteścyavanasyāpi kathāṃ paramapāvanīm ||92|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nyaṃkumatyāṃ devikāyāṃ ca nadyāṃ devarātatīrthe’ṣṭottaraśatanāmasahitasūryatīrthacyavanatīrthānāṃ tadākhyānasahitānāṃ kathananāmā catuścatvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||544||
<1.545> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi śaṃkaraśca pārvatīṃ prāha pāvanam | agastyādikatīrthānāṃ varṇanaṃ pravadāmi te || 1 || nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe divyamagastyāśramamuttamam | āāsīt pūrve kṛte varṣamātraṃ tapaścakāra saḥ || 2 || agastyarṣiḥ kadācidvai yayau tīrthasamīhayā | dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi tatra vātāpeirupaśāmitaḥ || 3 || ilvalo nāma tadbhrātāgrajaḥ kāpaṭyasaṃbhrataḥ | nagaryāṃ maṇimatyāṃ sa cāsa vātāpireva tu || 4 || agastyaṃ sa camatkāraṃ śrutvā taṃ prati cāyayau | prāha me bhagavan putraṃ dehi mahendrasadṛśam || 9 || agastyastaṃ cāsuraṃ tu dātuṃ naicchat sutaṃ tataḥ | cukrodha so’surastasya brāhmaṇasya tapobhṛtaḥ || 6 || tīrthayātrāṃ kurvataścāgastyasya mārgamadhyataḥ | vātāpiḥ phalarūpo’bhūt kāliṃgaraṃ supakvakam || 7 || kāmarūpastṛtīyaścātāpiḥ parṇagrahaṃ śubham | babhūva śobhanamṛṣyāśramarūpaṃ savedikam || 8 || ilvalastvāgatānāṃ vai vāṭagānāṃ samarhaṇam | phalabhojanadānādyaiścakāra nityameva ca || 9 || phalabhojī mārgagaścātithirbhuktvā phalaṃ tataḥ | jalaṃ pibati yāvadvai tāvadilvala āsuraḥ ||1.545.10|| āhvayatyudarasthaṃ taṃ vātāpiṃ satphalātmakam | he vātāpe bahiryāhityevaṃ śrutvodaraṃgataḥ ||11|| sajīvastūdaraṃ bhittvā niryātyeva hi tatkṣaṇam | trayaste bhrātaro hṛṣṭā militvā taṃ mṛtaṃ janam ||12|| khādanti nityaśastvevaṃ kurvanti ṛṣihiṃsanam | tena pathā hyagastyaśca nirgato yāvadeva ha ||13|| āātāpiḥ parṇaśālābhūd vātāpistu phalaṃ hyabhūt | ilvalastaṃ tadāgastyamatithiṃ prāha harṣataḥ || 14|| ṛṣe bhāgyaṃ mama dhanyaṃ grahāṇa phalabhojanam | abhyāgatasya sevā vai karoti mokṣaṇaṃ param ||15|| agastyastaṃ tathetyāha niṣasāda gṛhāntare | ilvalastatphalaṃ dvedhā caturdhā pravibhajya va ||16|| agastyaṃ bhojayāmāsāhvayāmāsānujaṃ punaḥ | pratyuttaraṃ na cāvāpa pācayāmāsa tam ṛṣiḥ l| 17|| bhrāmayitvodare hastaṃ pratyudgāraṃ cakāra ca | tadā bhayam̐ samāpanna ilvalastatsthalāttadā || 18|| cakre palāyanaṃ śīghraṃ dudrāvātāpirityapi | tau muniḥ krodhadṛṣṭyaiva bhasmīcakāra tatkṣaṇāt ||19|| tato’gastirdehaśuddhiṃ kartuṃ tīrtheṣu vai caran | samāgato’tra vai nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe sthiro’bhavat ||1.545.20|| varṣamātraṃ tapaścakre’gastyatīrthamidaṃ hi tat | dehaśuddhayarthamādiṣṭaṃ pāvanaṃ svargadaṃ param ||21|| atha rājā purā cāsīnnṛgo nāma janādhipaḥ | sa kadācid yayau tīrthayātrārthaṃ vai prabhāsake ||22|| svalpabhṛtyayuto mārge siṃhāraṇye dumālaye | viśaśrāma niśāyāṃ ca lebhe nidrāṃ śubhāṃ sukhām ||23|| jñātvā parvatajāścaurāḥ śataśo hetisaṃyutāḥ | svarṇādi dhanamāhartuṃ paritaḥ paryaveṣṭayan ||24|| rājñastu rakṣakāḥ svalpāścaurāstata śatādhikāḥ | kiṃ kāryaṃ prāṇanāśaḥ syāddhanahetorna tadvaram ||25|| matvaivaṃ tu nṛgaḥ prāhṛ gṛhṇantvetattu puṣkalam | ātmānaṃ rakṣayet prājño dhanairdāraistathārjavaiḥ ||26|| yadyapyasmi nṛpaścāhaṃ mayā daṇḍyā ime khalāḥ | tathāpi nāsti sainyaṃ me vane paryāptameva yat ||27|| prāṇaglahe prāṇahānau nāsti cintā yato nṛpaḥ | kintu mokṣakarī yātrā na me syāditi hānitaḥ ||28|| dravyaṃ datvā ca gantavyaṃ yātrāṃ kṛtvā tataḥ punaḥ | mārgayitvā ca tān sarvān nāśayiṣye raṇāṃgaṇe ||29|| vicāryaivaṃ nṛgo yāvad bhṛtyān āājñāṃ karoti ca | dhanaṃ dātuṃ hi caurebhyastāvadrājñaḥ śarīrataḥ ||1.545.30|| ekā nārī saśastrā vai samutpannātiroṣiṇī | hetibhistān sarvacaurān jaghāna līlayā raṇe ||31|| rājñā svāsthyaṃ gatastīvraṃ vavande tāṃ prarakṣaṇīm | sā tu śīghraṃ punā rājño dehe praveśamāsthitā ||32|| tato rājā yayau prātarmārgaṃ prabhāsakasya saḥ | vāmadevamṛṣiṃ dṛṣṭvā tapantaṃ devikātaṭe ||33|| viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ madhyāhne ca guruttamam | vāmadevaṃ ca papraccha kā kanyāsīccharīrajā ||34|| vāmadevaḥ samādhiṃ ca kṛtvā jñātvā sva pūrvajam | puṇyaṃ nṛpaṃ samuvāca pūrvaṃ taṃ śūdrako’bhavaḥ ||35|| śrāvaṇasya kṛtā śuklā tvekādaśī tathā tvayā | upoṣitā dvādaśī ca tatpuṇyaṃ tvayi saṃsthitam ||36|| puṇyarūpā tu sā kanyā tithidvayasvarūpiṇī | kanyā caikādaśī sā ca hetayo dvādaśī tithiḥ ||37|| tābhyāṃ caurāḥ śatravaste hatāstīrthavratasya te | evaṃ vātra paratrādyaṃ kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ prayāti hi ||38|| sakhā puṇyaṃ cātmani sthaṃ sahrāyaṃ sarvadāsti tat | | tasmāttīrthaṃ vrataṃ dānaṃ kartavyaṃ mānave bhave ||39|| ityukto jñātavān sarvaṃ nṛgastuṣṭo babhūva ha | vāmadevamṛṣiṃ natvā saṃpūjya copadā dadau ||1.545.40|| tattīrthaṃ vāmadevasya mṛgasyāpi prakīrtitam | saurāṣṭre somake kṣetre rakṣakaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā ||41|| somanāthaṃ prasampūjya yayau harmyaṃ nijaṃ tataḥ | athāsīd devaśarmākhyo dvijaḥ prabhāsatīrthajaḥ |42|| nyaṃkumatyāstīre vāsaṃ cakāra sa ca nirdhanaḥ | dhanārthe grāmamutsṛjya cauryaṃ kāryaṃ cakāra saḥ ||43|| tasya putro’bhavannāmnā duḥsahaścaura eva saḥ | vyasanoparato’raṇye jīrṇadevālaye vasan ||44|| cauryaṃ cakāra devasya dīpaṃ prajvālya vai tadā | janairbhṛśaṃ tāḍitaśca mṛto’bhūcca śivālaye ||45|| gāndhāraviṣaye rājā khyāto nāmnā tu durmukhaḥ | prajopadravakṛnmūrkho dharmakāryabahiṣkṛtaḥ ||46|| śivālayasya saṃskārācchivabhakto’bhavaddhi saḥ | puṣpasragdhūpanaivedyagandhādibhiḥ śivaṃ sadā ||47|| anyāṃścāpyarcayatyeva surān dīpapradānakaiḥ | yatra yatrāśrame daive prayātyeva sa pāthaiivaḥ ||48|| dīpadānaṃ karotyeva devālayeṣu sarvadā | ekadā sa ca tīrtheṣu vicaran raivatācale ||49|| somanāthaṃ samāyātaḥ siṃhāraṇye tu mārgagaḥ | nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe prāpa nidhanaṃ kālayogataḥ ||1.545.50|| dīpadānasya ca pūjāyāśca phalena durmukhaḥ | viśravasaḥ sutaḥ so’bhūt kubero yakṣarāḍiti ||51|| kuberastu tato jātismaraḥ prabhāsamāyayau | yatra pūrvaṃ mṛtastvāsīnyaṃkumatyāstaṭe hi saḥ ||52|| tatra śaṃbhuṃ pratiṣṭhāpya mandiraṃ nirmame hi saḥ | tattīrthe tu nijākhyādiyutaṃ kuberaśaṃkaram ||53|| kṛtavām̐śca śivaṃ tatra tuṣṭāva śubhramānasaḥ | śaṃkaraśca kuberāya varadānatrayaṃ dadau ||54|| sakhyaṃ dhanādhipatyaṃ ca dikpālatvaṃ divaukasām | kubereśaṃ tatra gatvā bhaktyā yaḥ pūjayiṣyati ||55|| tadgṛhe saptapuruṣāvadhi lakṣmī nivatsyati | | atha kaivartako matsyaghātī svārociṣe’ntare ||56|| samudrasya taṭe jālaṃ jalaklinnaṃ śivālaye | nītvā dhvajasya daṇḍe tajjālaṃ dorakanirmitam ||57|| sthāpayāmāsa ca yathā dhvajo dṛśyeta jālakṛt| śoṣaṇāya jalasyaivaṃ jāladhvajo’bhavaddinam ||58|| tatpuṇyena sa kaivarto janmāntare tu bhūpatiḥ | saurāṣṭre kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre kratudhvajābhidhaḥ ||59|| rājābhavat pratāpī ca lomaśasyāśrame sadā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyeti japan sadā ||1.545.60|| paramo vaiṣṇavo jātaḥ śaṃkarasya prasādataḥ | jātismaraḥ pradadau ca prabhāse somanāthake ||61|| dhvajāṃ śubhrāṃ mahādīrghāṃ prativarṣe tato dadau | daśavarṣasahasrāṇi rājyaṃ cakāra bhūpatiḥ ||62|| aśvapaṭṭasaromadhye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇālayam | jīrṇe tannūtanaṃ rājā kārayāmāsa śrṛṃgavat ||63|| tato divyavimānena yayau vaikuṇṭhameva saḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhavenmokṣapadaṃ dhruvam ||64|| devakulaṃ śubhaṃ kṣetraṃ prabhāse vartate tathā | ṛṣitoyā nadī ramyā mimiluryatra devatāḥ ||65|| ṛṣibhiḥ prārthitāścānāvṛṣṭikāle tu satrake | tarṣitā bahuyajñaiśca vṛṣṭirjātātiśobhanā ||66|| devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca kulānāṃ samavāyataḥ | ṛṣikulākhyasusaridvarā tīrthaṃ hi pāvanam ||67|| vyāghrāraṇye ṛṣayastu nyavasan ye purā yuge | brahmāṇaṃ tvekadā draṣṭuṃ satyalokaṃ yayurhi te ||68|| tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotrairbrahmāṇaṃ kamaloddhavam | brahmā tuṣṭo’vadat sarvān vṛṇudhvaṃ mānasepsitam ||69|| ṛṣayaste tadā prāhuḥ snānasandhyādi karma yat | sāmudreṇa salilena tvanantapuṇyadāyakam ||1.545.70|| jalapāne cātithīnāṃ satkārādau ca bhūjalam | kūpādīnāṃ bhavatyeva vasāmo yatra nityadā ||71|| tasmānnadyastvayā brahman preṣayitavyā kṣmāṃ prati | miṣṭāni hi jalānyāsāṃ kriyārhām̐ṇi prabhāsake ||72|| prāpsyāmo yena ca yathā tathā kuru pitāmaha abhiṣekāya no dehi nadīṃ puṇyāṃ pitāmaha ||73|| vīkṣāṃ cakre tadā brahmā kartavyārthaṃ vicintya ca | nimnagā āāhvayāmāsa gaṃgāṃ yamīṃ sarasvatīm ||74|| candrabhāgāṃ tathā revāṃ sarayūṃ gaṇḍakīṃ tathā | tāpīṃ godāvarīṃ śiprāṃ kāverīṃ devikāṃ tathā ||75|| carmaṇvatīṃ ca māhendrīṃ bhadrāṃ śatrujitāṃ tathā | mūrtimatyaśca tāḥ sarvāḥ sthitā vai brahmaṇaḥ puraḥ ||76|| brahmaṇā ca kṛtā dṛṣṭiḥ kamaṇḍaluṃ prati tadā | tāśca bhāvaṃ parijñāya viviśustatkamaṇḍalum ||77|| tāstu tebhyo munibhyaśca dattā netuṃ bhuvaṃ prati | toyarūpāḥ kamaṇḍalujalasthā hi saridvarāḥ ||78|| tadānīṃ sā ṛṣitoyā sarvasarinmayī śubhā | ṛṣitoyānāmanadī saurāṣṭre samajāyata ||79|| devadāruvane yatra jalaṃ kamaṇḍaloḥ purā | sanyastamṛṣibhistatra nadī sā saṃbabhūva ha ||1.545.80|| samudraṃ prāpitā sā hi saubhāgyādyairvivardhitā | mūlacaṇḍīśatīrthe sā prapūrvābhimukhī tataḥ ||81|| bhuktimuktipradā ramyā kathitā śaṃkareṇa vai | pārvatyai sā mayā lakṣmi kathitā te samāsataḥ ||82|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’gastyāśramasya ātāpīvātāpīlvalavināśasya vāmadevanṛgakuberatīrthānāṃ kratudhvajamokṣasya devakulaṛṣitoyāditīthīnāṃ sopākhyānavarṇananāmā pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 545 ||
<1.546> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi viśālanṛpateḥ purā | jātaṃ divyaṃ caritraṃ yat pārvatyai prāha śaṃkaraḥ || 1 || pūrvaṃ rājā viśālo’bhūt kāśīpūryāṃ mahābalaḥ | gotrajairhṛtarājyo’sau gandhamādanamāyayau || 2 || tasya droṇyāṃ badarīṃ ca śubhāṃ prāpya nṛpottamaḥ | tapaścakre bhajamānaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim || 3 || kadācidāgatau tatra purāṇāvṛṣisattamau | naranārāyaṇau devau dharmaputrau himāśritau || 4 || tau dṛṣṭvā sutapasyantaṃ badarīsthaṃ nṛpaṃ śubham | dhyāyantaṃ paramaṃ brahmaviṣṇurūpaṃ janārdanam || 5 || naranārāyaṇaṃ prītau dṛṣṭvā taṃ kṣīṇakalmaṣam | ūcaturvaradau rājan vṛṇīṣva varamīpsitam || 6 || rājā prāha bhavantau kau na jānāmi kathaṃ varam | ajñātābhyāṃ pragṛhṇāmi dātuṃ śaktau ca kaṃ varam || 7 || ārādhayāmi yaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jagadgurum | tasmād varaṃ grahīṣyāmi nānyasmāditi bhūsurau || 8 || evamuktāvāhatustau kamārādhayase prabhum | kaṃ vā varaṃ vṛṇoṣi tvaṃ kathayasva kutūhalāt || 9 || evamukto nṛpaḥ prāha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | ārādhayāmi satataṃ tatastāvūcatuḥ punaḥ ||1.546.1 0|| rājam̐stasyaiva devasya prasādādāvayorvaram | gṛhāṇa tvaṃ varaṃ brūhi kaste manasi vartate || 11 || yathā yajñeśvaraṃ devaṃ yajñairvividhadakṣiṇaiḥ | yaṣṭuṃ samarthatā me syāttathā me dadataṃ varam || 1 2|| tadā nārāyaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhrātaraṃ sampradarśya vai | naraḥ prāha ca rājānaṃ śṛṇu rājan sanātanam || 1 3|| ayaṃ me pūrvajo bhrātā lokānāṃ mārgadarśakaḥ | mayā saha tapaḥ kurvannāste badarikāśrame || 14|| ayaṃ matsyo’bhavat pūrvaṃ tataḥ kūrmo’bhavatpunaḥ | varāhaścābhavat so’yaṃ narasiṃhastato’bhavat ||15 || vāmanaśca tato jātastataḥ paraśurāmakaḥ | tato rāmaśca buddhaśca kṛṣṇaḥ kalkistato hyayam || 16 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so’yaṃ parātparaḥ | rājate kuṃkumavāpītīrthe saurāṣṭrabhūtale || 17|| so’yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāllakṣmīpatiḥ ramāpatiḥ | śrīpatiḥ kamalākāntaḥ pārvatīpatirīśvaraḥ || 18|| kṛṣṇo rādhāpatiḥ prabhāpatiśca māṇikīpatiḥ | bhaktapatirmuktapatiḥ satīpatiḥ pumuttamaḥ || 1 9|| matsyaṃ rājannupāsīta vedajñānasya labdhaye | kūrmaṃ rājannupāsīta śārīrabalapuṣṭaye ||1.546.20|| kroḍaṃ rājannupāsīta pṛthvīrājyādilabdhaye | narasiṃhamupāsīta pāpiśatrunivṛttaye ||21 || vāmanaṃ samupāsīta sārvabhaumatvasiddhaye | parśurāmamupāsīta krūraśatrunivṛttaye ||22|| rāmādityamupāsīta sadā dharmasya vṛddhaye | buddhaṃ sādhumupāsīta tvātmajñānasya labdhaye ||23|| kṛṣṇaṃ kāntamupāsīta golokādikalabdhaye | kalkiṃ rājannupāsīta rāgadveṣādihānaye ||24|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tvakṣaramuktaye | yugalaṃ samupāsīta bhuktimuktisamṛddhaye ||25|| evamuktvā narastasya harervāsarajaṃ vratam | kuru rājan sadā tvekādaśyāmupoṣaṇaṃ tathā ||26 || dvādaśyāmupavāsaṃ ca samartho yajane bhava | ityuktvā tau yayatuśca badarīṃ nṛpatistataḥ ||27|| vrataṃ cakāra vidhivat sāmarthyaṃ cāpa vai punaḥ | cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ tasmai prasannena tu viṣṇunā ||28|| arpitaṃ tat samādāya yayau rājyaṃ nijaṃ punaḥ | śatrūn vijitya ca rājā cakravartīṃ babhūva saḥ ||29|| tena ca tapasaḥ sthānaṃ himālaye kṛtaṃ purā | tatra vai nagarī parṇaśālāḍhyā ṛṣiyojitā ||1.546.3 0|| tāpasānāṃ kṛte tena rājñā nāmnā svakena vai | viśālākhyā nirmitā sā badarī cāśramātmikā || 31 || viśālanṛpaternāmnā viśālākhyābhavacchubhā | naranārāyaṇāvāsā ṛṣīṇāṃ sukhavāsadā |32|| tatra tīrthaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā paraṃ dhāmābhigacchati | tatra janmani rājāsau rājye sthitvā punaḥ punaḥ || 33|| yajñaiśca vividhairiṣṭvā prasannamakaroddharim | athaikadā satīrthārthaṃ yayāvarbudapuṣkaram |||34|| tato vai lomaśakṣetraṃ tataśca raivatācalam | prabhāsakṣetramāsādya somanāthaṃ vilokya ca ||35|| guptaprayāgaṃ gatvā ca cakāra vaiṣṇavaṃ kratum | tataḥ śrīkuṃkumavāpīkṣetre natvā tu lomaśam ||39 || yayau rājyaṃ tato hitvā saṃsāraṃ badarīṃ yayau | bhaktyā nārāyaṇaṃ prāpya yayau dhāma paraṃ hareḥ ||37|| anena rājñā yajñastu yatra guptaprayāgake | kṛtaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tārakaṃ taddhi vidyate ||38|| śṛṇu cānyaṃ ca nṛpatiṃ yannāmnā tīrthamuttamam | bhadreśvaraṃ jayantyākhye saṃbhūtaṃ bhadrikātaṭe ||39|| āsīt kṛtayuge rājā bhadrāśvo nāma bhaktarāṭ | yasya nāmnābhavad varṣaṃ bhadrāśvaṃ nāma nāmataḥ ||1.546.40 || tasyāgastyaḥ kadācittu gṛhamāgatya sattamaḥ | uvāca saptarātraṃ tu vasāmi bhavato gṛhe ||41 || taṃ rājā śirasā natvā sthīyatāmityabhāṣata | tasya kāntimatīnāmnī bhāryāsīcca pativratā ||42|| tasyāstejaḥ samabhavaccandrakāntisamaṃ bhuvi | śatāni pañca nṛpateścānyāḥ patnyo’bhavannapi ||43 || tā dāsya iva karmāṇi kurvantyasyāstapobalāt | mahābhāgā kāntimatī bhāryā sarvottamāsti ca ||44|| sapatnyaśca bhayāttasyā dāsyaṃ kurvanti nityadā | tāmagastyastadā dṛṣṭvā rūpatejonvitāṃ śubhām ||45 || rājānaṃ tatra lubdhaṃ ca harerbhaktyā vivarjitam | kāntimatīṃ bhaktihīnāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca munirabravīt| ||46 || prathame divase dṛṣṭvā lokayantaṃ priyāmukham | sādhu sādhu jagannāthetyāhāgastyaḥ praharṣitaḥ ||47|| dvitīye divase’pyevaṃ rājñīṃ nṛpaṃ vilokya ca | aho muṣṭamaho muṣṭaṃ jagadetaccarācaram ||48|| ityagastyo’vadad dhunvan śiro nṛpasya śṛṇvataḥ | tṛtīye’hani bhūpaṃ ca rājñīṃ dṛṣṭvā śucāvadat ||49|| aho mūḍhā na jānanti dātāraṃ parameśvaram | ya ekena dinenaiva rājñastuṣṭaḥ pradattavān ||1.546.50|| caturthe divase hastāvutkṣipya punarabravīt | sādhu sādhu jagannātha strī śūdrāḥ sādhu sādhviti ||51 || dvijāḥ sādhu nṛpāḥ sādhuvaiśyāḥ sādhu punaḥ punaḥ | sādhu bhadrāśca sādhu tvaṃ sādhu bho’gastya sādhu te ||52|| sādhu prahlāda sādhu tvaṃ dhruvaḥ sādhu mahāvrataḥ | evamuktvā nanartoccairagastyo rājasannidhau ||53|| evambhūtaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā patnīyukto nṛpottamaḥ | kiṃ harṣakāraṇaṃ brahman yenetthaṃ nṛtyate tviha ||54|| kiṃ ca saṃbhāṣase vidvan parānandena cetasā | agastyastaṃ ca bhadrāśvaṃ tathā rājñīmuvāca ha ||55|| aho mūrkhaḥ kurājā tvaṃ mūrkhī ceyaṃ priyā tava | mūrkhāśca mantriṇaḥ sarve aho mūrkhāḥ purohitāḥ ||56|| sarvaṃ maurkhyānvitaṃ rājan dṛśyate tava maṇḍalam | saralaṃ viditārthaṃ ca ye na jānanti me matam ||57|| evamukte punā rājā kṛtāṃjalirabhāṣata | na jānīmo vayaṃ brahman tavoktaṃ bhāvapūritam ||58|| vivecaya mahāvidvan yadyanugrahakṛd bhavān | agastyaśca tadā prāha vṛttāntaṃ prāgbhavaṃ yathā ||59|| āsīd vaiśyo haradattanāmā nagarapattane | tasya bhṛtyo bhavānāsīcchūdravarṇo’tibhaktimān ||1.546.60|| iyaṃ rājñī tava patnī vaiśyabhṛtyā tadābhavat | sa vaiśyo’śvayuji māsi dvādaśyāṃ niyataḥ sthitaḥ ||6 1 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | gṛṇan viṣṇvālayaṃ gatvā puṣpadhūpādibhirharim ||62|| abhyarcayati nityaṃ vai ciraṃ dhyānaṃ karoti ca | devālaye bhavantau ca kṛtvā sa rakṣapālakau ||63 || saṃsthāpya dvau pradīpānāṃ jvālanārthaṃ tataḥ sa vai | prayāti svagṛhaṃ vaiśyo bhavantau tu harergṛhe ||64|| sammārjanaṃ jaladānaṃ puṣpatulasīyojanam | āgatānāṃ ca satkāraṃ kṛtvā nityaṃ hareḥ puraḥ ||65|| divāniśaṃ bhavantau ca dīpānāmapyakhaṇḍatām | āstāṃ saṃrakṣayantau vai punaḥ prajvālya saṃsthitau ||66|| tena puṇyena bhavatoḥ pāpāni tvāyuṣā saha | vilīnāni prabhātāyāṃ rajanyāṃ ca yuvāṃ tadā ||67|| śrīhareḥ kṛpayā śūdradehau tyaktvā mṛtiṃ gatau | tato rājam̐stava janma priyavratagṛhe’bhavat ||68|| iyaṃ kāntimatī saiva tava patnī sahāgatā | pārakyasyāpi dīpasya jvālitasya harergṛhe ||69|| sevābhaktidāsyabhāvaiḥ prasāditasya śārṅgiṇaḥ | rājyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhavadbhyāṃ ca prasādenedamarjitam ||1.546.70 || yaḥ punaḥ svena vittena viṣṇoragre pradīpakān | jvālayet tasya yatpuṇyaṃ tat saṃkhyātuṃ na śakyate ||71 || mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ prakṣālanaṃ pātrapraśodhanam | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ vastrakṣālanaṃ stavanaṃ tathā ||72|| jīrṇoddharaṇamijyāṃ ca puṣpatulasīyojanam | naivedyaṃ salilaṃ patraṃ phalamārārtrikādikam ||73|| candanākṣatakuṃkumābīrasugandhacarcanam | nityaṃ kuryāttasya puṇyapāraṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate ||74|| tena rājam̐stava puṇyaṃ smṛtvā prākkṛtameva ca | sādhu sādhu jagannāthetyuktaṃ harṣeṇa vai mayā ||75|| kṛte varṣeṇa yatpuṇyaṃ tretāyāṃ tat ṣaṇmāsikaiḥ | dvāpare ca tribhirmāsaiḥ kalāvekadinena tat ||76|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyeti vadan janaḥ | bhaktyā saṃpūjayan kṛṣṇaṃ sarvaṃ tallabhate phalam ||77|| evaṃ sthite’piloke’smin prāpte kalau janāḥ khalu | bhajiṣyante na vai kṛṣṇaṃ dvāpare triyuge’pi vā ||78|| muṣṭāste karmabhiḥ svaiśca vañcitāḥ syuśca sarvathā | tvaṃ ca rājan rataścātra kāntāyāmeva sarvadā ||79|| na tvaṃ neyaṃ smarasyatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | etatsarvaṃ vilokyaiva mayoktaṃ cāpare dine ||1.546.80|| aho muṣṭamaho muṣṭaṃ jagadetaccarācaram | śrīharerbhāryayā muṣṭaṃ vañcitaṃ vai carācaram ||81|| bhajante na hariṃ sampaddātāraṃ puruṣottamam | atha pārakyadīpasyotkarṣādapi phalaṃ mahat ||82|| rājyaṃ labdhaṃ tathāpi śrīharernāma gṛṇanti na | na rājā na ca vā rājñī smaratyapi narāyaṇam ||83|| mamāgame’pi naivaitau bhajete puruṣottamam | satsaṃgena hi sarvatrābhaktā api kṣaṇaṃ khalu ||84|| bhaktiṃ kurvanti kṛṣṇasya na tu mūrkhāḥ kadācana | suyoge’pi bhaktihīnā mūḍhā eva na saṃśayaḥ ||85|| rājā mūḍhastasya rājñī mūḍhatameti bhāti me | atastṛtīyadivase yuvāṃ dṛṣṭvā mayeritam ||86|| aho mūḍhā na jānanti govindaṃ parameśvaram | etatsarvaṃ sukhaṃ cāpi harerdīpakriyāphalam ||87|| ekasyaiva divasasya phalaṃ rājyottamottamam | caturthe divase rājan hastāvutkṣipya vai mayā ||88|| vicāryaiva śrāvitaṃ vāṃ bhaktāḥ sarve hi sādhavaḥ | bhagavatā dvijā ye ca rājāno ye ca vaiṣṇavāḥ ||89|| yajante vividhairyajñaistena te sādhavaḥ smṛtāḥ | ye na bhajanti deveśaṃ satyapi smṛddhisādhane ||1.546.90|| nirdhano’pi tataḥ śreṣṭho yo vai bhajati keśavam | ahaṃ yadyapyaraṇyastho nirdhano niḥkuṭumbakaḥ ||91 || tathāpi sādhurevāsmi sasmṛddhīnāmapekṣayā | yamahaṃ na vismarāmi kadāpi puruṣottamam ||92|| tena sādho agastyeti mayoktaṃ māṃ prati dhruvam | sā strī dhanyā sa śūdraśca tathā dhanyataro mataḥ ||93|| śuśrūṣāṃ svāmino nārāyaṇatmakasya sarvathā | kānte ca svāmini nityaṃ parokṣo harirasti vai ||94|| matvā karoti yena syāt kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ sukarma tat | sā strī dhanyā tathā śūdro dvijaśuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ ||95|| dvijājñayā harerbhaktiṃ sādhū tau yat karoti hi | dvijāste sādhavaḥ proktā harerbhaktiyutāśca ye ||96|| nṛpāste sādhavaḥ proktā hariṃ bhajanti nityadā | āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritya prahlādaḥ puruṣottamam ||97|| muktvā cānyaṃ na jānāti tenāsau sādhurucyate | uttānapādaputraśca dhruva eva tu bālakaḥ ||98|| vane viṣṇuṃ samārādhya prāpa sthānaṃ mahattamam | tena sādhurdhruvaścāpi mayoktaṃ rājasattama ||99|| sarvaṃ sādhu bhaved rājan śrīkṛṣṇaḥ smaryate hṛdi | asādhu yāvadevaitacchrīkṛṣṇo vismṛto yadi || 1.546.10 0|| tvayā rājan paraṃ prāptaṃ rājyaṃ viṣṇustu vismṛtaḥ | tasmādbhajātra govindaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam || 101 || ityuktau dampatī natvā smṛtvā prāgbhavajaṃ phalam | bhejāte śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ phalapradam || 1 02|| ya idaṃ śṛṇuyāllakṣmi mokṣastasyāpi saṃbhavet | pārvatīṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha yattanmayeritaṃ tava || 103 || bhadrāśvaḥ sa yayau tīrthayātrārthaṃ ca prabhāsake | saurāṣṭre tena bhadrāyāstaṭe vai paścime śubhe || 1 04|| jayantākhye pattane ca śāṃkaraṃ tīrthamāsthitam | bhadreśvaraṃ ca tannāma śravaṇātpāpanāśanam ||1 05|| punā rājā dadau tatrāgastyāśramaṃ tapomayam | aśvapaṭṭasarasaśca taṭe brahmarṣisevitam || 106 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne viśālanṛpakṛtaviśālātīrthabhadrāśvanṛpakṛta bhadre tīrthāgastyakṛtopadeśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 546 ||
<1.547> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tato’gastyo bhadrāśvaṃ nṛpatiṃ śubham | ātmajñānaṃ yathā prāha vacmi te lokamokṣadamam || 1 || śaṃkareṇa prabhāse vai proktaṃ satyai purā hi tat | bhadrāśvaḥ samapapracchāgastyaṃ mokṣapradaṃ varam || 2 || jñānaṃ vada mahāprājña yena mokṣaṃ prayāmi vai | agastyaḥ prāha rājānaṃ guruṃ vinā gatirna vai || 3 || gururbrahmā svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ śaṃbhurnārāyaṇo guruḥ | gurureva parabrahma pratyakṣo bhagavān hariḥ || 4 || taṃ prasādya bhavenmokṣayogyatā dehinaḥ purā | ātmaprasādastasyaivāśībhirjāyata eva hi || 2 || vrataṃ kuryādarcanaṃ ca prasādanaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | jñānamantrapradātā ca tārayed bhavasāgarāt| || 6 || gurave bhojanaṃ dadyād vaiṣṇavo yajña ucyate | kuryāttu vaiṣṇavaṃ yajñaṃ yajed yogīśvaraṃ harim || 7 || yo hareḥ sarahasyaṃ tu sumantraṃ copapādayet | tasmai dadyāttu sarvasvaṃ priyaṃ cātmārpaṇādikam || 8 || phalaṃ tasmai pradattasya koṭikoṭiguṇottaram | sukhaṃ rājyaṃ mahānandaḥ svargaṃ mokṣaśca śāśvataḥ || 9 || gurau sati tu yaścānyamāśrayet pūjayet kudhīḥ | sa na phalamavāpnoti dattamasya tu niṣphalam || 1.547.10 || prayatnena gurau pūrvaṃ paścādanyasya dāpayet | avidyo vā savidyo vā gurureva janārdanaḥ || 11 || mārgastho vāpyamārgastho gurureva parā gatiḥ | pratipadya guruṃ yastu paścād vipratipadyate || 1 2|| gurvaparādhapātraṃ sa duḥkhī syāt puruṣādhamaḥ | gurau nārāyaṇaścāste taṃ prasādya sukhī bhavet || 1 3|| mūrtirnārāyaṇasyaiva cetanā gurureva ha | jāgarti snāti vastrāṇi dhārayatyeva candanam || 14|| kuṃkumādi sugandhādi gṛhṇāti sa janārpitam | puṣpaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ bhojyaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tathā || 15|| jalaṃ bhūṣāṃ kajjalādi gṛhṇāti sa janārpitam | āsanaṃ vāhanaṃ yānaṃ paryaṃkaṃ pādukādikam || 16 || jalaṃ saubhāgyadravyādi gṛhṇāti sa janārpitam | mano bhāvaṃ prema bhaktiṃ sevāṃ vastu tathārpitam || 17|| pādasaṃvāhanaṃ peyaṃ maitrīṃ hāsyaṃ prasannatām | namaskāraṃ dehasevāṃ gṛhṇāti sa janārpitam || 18 || śiṣyaduḥkhaṃ dayālurvai gṛhṇāti vārayatyapi | sāhāyyaṃ kurute śaśvajjñānaṃ dadāti śāntidam || 1 9|| pāpaṃ prajvālayatyeva puṇyaṃ dadāti puṣkalam | naijaṃ sarvaṃ dadātyeva gurureva janārdanaḥ || 1.547.20 || gurureva patiḥ putraḥ satī sādhvī pativratā | pitā mātā tathā bhāryā sarvasvaṃ gurureva ha || 21 || rakṣakaḥ poṣakaścāpi tārakaścāvabodhakaḥ | harerdhāmnaḥ prāpakaśca gurureva hariḥ svayam || 22|| bhrātā caikaguṇo mānyaḥ pitā daśaguṇastataḥ | mātā śataguṇā mānyā sahasraguṇako guruḥ || 23 || apāraguṇakaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ | akṣarādhipatiḥ śrīmān bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ || 24|| evaṃ pratyakṣamūrtiṃ vai guruṃ sampūjayet sadā | divyamūrtirguruḥ sākṣāddharerdivyasya yogataḥ || 25|| śiṣyasya divyatāsampādako divyahariḥ sa vai | evaṃ matvā sadā rājan guruṃ dhyāyīta cārcayet || 26 || paraṃ kalyāṇadaṃ pātraṃ śiṣyaḥ samarjayed gurum | bhadrāśvaḥ svagurorvākyaṃ śrutvā mumoda cātmani || 27 || sarvaṃ prāptaṃ guruḥ prāptaḥ pūrṇatāṃ manyate’pi ca | lokānāṃ bodhalābhāya natvā prapaccha vai punaḥ || 28 || guro prāptaṃ mayā sarvaṃ prāptavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate | tathāpi vada me mokṣadharmān lokahitāvahān || 29||| bhagavan karmaṇā kena chidyate bhavasaṃsṛtiḥ | kiṃvā kṛtvā na śocanti mūrtāmūrtopapattiṣu || 1.547.30 || kiṃ kṛtvā ca parabrahmamayo bhavati mānavaḥ | iti rājño vacaḥ śrutvāgastyaḥ prāha pramodavān || 31 || śṛṇu rājan kathāṃ divyāṃ dūrāsannavyavasthitām | dṛśyādṛśyavibhāgotthāṃ samāhitamanā bhava || 32 || āsīd rājyaṃ purā cāpi vartamāne bhaviṣyati | apāraṃ ca tathāsīmaṃ yatra sūryo na candramāḥ || 33 || na rātrirna ca divaso diśo naiva na bhūstathā | na dyaurdevā na vā cāsan divyaṃ rājyaṃ tathā hi tat| || 34|| tatra samrāṭ muktapālo rājā śāśvatajīvanaḥ | pālayāmāsa divyān vai muktān saṃkhyāvivarjitān ||39|| prajāstaṃ mānayāmāsa sarvātmabhāvanārpaṇāḥ | prajānāṃ bhojanaṃ miṣṭaṃ rājā sarvaṃ dadāti vai ||36|| na ca śaityaṃ nātapaśca siddhiyuktāśca tāḥ prajāḥ | vinindrāḥ śāśvatānandā nityatṛptā nirāśayāḥ ||37|| sarve saṃkalpasatyāśca rājānandapariplutāḥ | vartante ca prajāḥ sarvāstasyaiva cakravartinaḥ ||38|| yatra nānyat khaṇḍarājyaṃ sāmyavādaścaturvidhaḥ | sālokyaṃ sarvamuktānāṃ sārṣṭitā sarvadehinām ||39|| sārūpyaṃ sarvatattvānāṃ sāyujyaṃ sarvayoginām | bhojane ramaṇe yāne vāhane kalpane ratau ||1.547.40|| jñāne bhaktau vedane copakārye’pi samānatā | evaṃ rājyaṃ mahad yatra satyameva na cānṛtam ||41 || yatra nyāyālayo nāsti nāsti doṣādhikāritā | yatra cauryaṃ vaimanasyaṃ śātravaṃ vartanaṃ na vai ||42|| yatrāśuddhistathā nāsti kṣayo yatra na vidyate | yatra cātiśayo nāsti kuto dveṣaśca rāgakaḥ ||43|| tādṛśaṃ rājyasarvasvaṃ pratyakṣaṃ karapātravat | dūradṛśyaṃ dūraśrāvo dūracintanamityapi ||44|| sarvaṃ sākṣāccātmatantraṃ sādhanaṃ cātmajaṃ hi tat | tadrājyaṃ pāvanānāṃ tu prajānāmadhivāsanam ||45|| apāvanānāṃ yātrāpi tatra naiva hi jāyate | sīmā yā cāpāvanānāṃ tadūrdhvaṃ tadagrāhyakam ||46|| apāvanānyaraṇyāni vartante paritastataḥ | sa cātmapālako rājāraṇyaṃ vihartumāyayau ||47|| araṇyāni samudrāṃśca parvatān kṣetrabhūmikāḥ | yāni divyamahārājyādadhastaṭe bhavanti ca ||48|| dāsyai dattaṃ ca tadrājyaṃ bhṛtyāya pūrvameva ha | didṛkṣuḥ kṛpayā rājā paścimaṃ taṭamāyayau ||49|| ūrdhvaṃ tīraṃ samudrasyānantapārasya śāśvatam | bhavābdhau yatra vai dvīpe dvīpe vasanti dhīvarāḥ ||1.547.50 || kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca moho madaśca pañca te | aṣṭau drumāstathā yatra vartante kāmavarṣiṇaḥ ||51 || dharmo’dharmastathā jñānamajñānaṃ ca caturthakam | aiśvaryaṃ cāpyanaiśvaryaṃ rāgo vairāgyamityamī ||52|| nadī tīryag yatra yāti manovahābhidhāniśam | adhaścordhvaṃ babhramuśca pañca mukhyāśca nāyakāḥ ||53|| śabdaḥ sparśastathā rūpaṃ raso gandhaśca nāmataḥ | eko mukhyapradhānaśca prāṇākhyo vartate sadā ||54|| ekā strī vartate dāsī yathā rājñī balādhikā | triguṇā sā buddhināmnī rājendra sevate sadā |||55|| sā strī sve vakṣasi nityaṃ mahendraṃ rakṣati dhruvam | sahasrasūryapratimaṃ lakṣacandrasamā ca sā ||56|| tasyādharastrivikāro hāsyamāścaryamugratā | tasyā varṇastrirūpaśca śveto raktastamomayaḥ ||57|| yuvatī sarvadā ramyā nūtaneva vrajasthitā | vinā ca puruṣaṃ mlānā tūṣṇībhūtā mṛtā yathā ||58|| divyaṃ taṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā samāyāntaṃ taṭāntigam | sāśā sajīvanā yadvajjātā jaḍāpi cetanā ||59|| nṛpo’pi tāṃ kṛpayaiva vilokya ca muhurmuhuḥ | samudraṃ ca vanaṃ tasyāḥ kṣetrāṇi saṃviveśa ha ||1.547.6 0|| tasmin praviṣṭe nṛpatau strīrājyasthāḥ prajāstadā | pradhānādyāśca sambhūya tatsvāgatārthamāyayuḥ ||61 || kecinnamrā jalaṃ pātramāninyurāsanādikam | bhayādaikyaṃ gatavantaḥ kṣaṇena copadānvitāḥ ||62||| taistadādhīvarairnyāyavarjitairveṣṭito nṛpaḥ | kāmādibhistathāpyeṣastebhyo na hṛdayaṃ dadau ||63|| athāyaṃ nṛpatistām̐ścoddhatān jñātvā vaśecchayā | ekaṃ vai mānasaṃ putraṃ cintayāmāsa nāyakam ||64|| yadadhīnā ime sarve bhaveyurna ca syuryathā | tāvat sā strī nirapatyā sāpatyecchāvatī hyabhūt ||65|| prārthayāmāsa rājānaṃ kuru sāpatyakāṃ ca mām | tathāstviti nṛpaḥ prāha suṣuve strī svakaṃ sutam ||66|| trivarṇaṃ puruṣaṃ śvetaṃ raktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca sadṛśam | jātamātraḥ so’pyuvāca mama nāma pradehi vai ||67|| mahāniti tataścakre mukhyaṃ nāma sutasya saḥ | rājā tena prasanno’bhūt putro’pi taṃ nṛpaṃ tadā ||68|| dharṣayāmāsa vegena kintu nṛpo mahābalaḥ | dharṣaṇaṃ tasya nāpede tato’sau putrakāmyayā ||69|| tuṣṭāva taṃ nṛpaṃ tena dattastatsadṛśaḥ sutaḥ | so’pi tredhābhavattasya mahān prāhāhameva ha ||1.547.70|| asmītināmataḥ khyāto’haṃkāraḥ pitṛsadṛśaḥ | evaṃ putraṃ praputraṃ ca labdhvā strī cātiharṣitā ||71 || tadbalena tataḥ sā strī taṃ rājānaṃ rurodha ha | tathāpi na niruddhaḥ sa yadā vai balavattamaḥ ||72| tadā naijaṃ balaṃ matvā nyūnaṃ sainyaṃ ca sā punaḥ | vavre putrān pañca cānyān ahaṃkārasya bālakān ||73|| rājā dadau ca tān pañca tanmātrātmakabālakān | te’pi cāgatya ca sarve saṃbhūya rurudhurnṛpam ||74|| tathāpi bhūpatiḥ siddho ruddho naiva ca naiva ca | tadā vavre tu sā nārī daśa pañca ca bālakān ||75|| tathāstviti nṛpaḥ prāha dadau daśendriyāṇi ca | pañcaprāṇān dadau te ca sambhūya rurudhurnṛpam ||76|| tathāpyayaṃ na ruddho’bhūt tataste’nyāśrayaṃ yayuḥ | svarājyasthaṃ mahendraṃ te saṃveṣṭya saṃsthitāstadā ||77|| indraścātmā mahendraḥ sa ruddho dasyubhireva ha | indreṇa saha te sarve hyekībhūya hi dasyavaḥ ||78|| rājānaṃ ca tato hantuṃ baddhuṃ vā manthituṃ ca vā | udyatāḥ sahasā tatra tathāpi baddha eva na ||79|| atha sarvān vihāyaiva rājā gantuṃ samīhate | tāvat sendrāstadā sarve babhūvuśca mṛtā yathā ||1.547.80|| punaḥ sarvaiḥ prārthitaśca jīvānārthaṃ ca taiḥ punaḥ | melayituṃ maṇḍale sve vartayituṃ sadā saha ||8 1 || tadā dayālurbhagavān divyarājyakaraḥ prabhuḥ | svasthāne kāryakartāraṃ baddhamivānugāminam ||82|| puruṣaṃ janayāmāsa yathā karmānurūpiṇam | hiraṇyavarṇaṃ nirliptaṃ nṛpājñālepamāsthitam ||83|| striyā mahatāhaṃkṛtyā kāmādyairabhivāñcchitam | śabdādyaiḥ śravaṇādyaiśca prāṇādyairabhisatkṛtam ||84|| janayitvā dadau tebhyo ruddhaḥ saṃveṣṭitaśca saḥ | jaḍacetanagranthiśca hiraṇmayo naraśca saḥ ||85||| sadṛśān janayāmāsa romasaṃkhyākabālakān | suśobhamānān vairājām̐ste’pi tṛṣṇākulāstataḥ ||86|| asaṃkhyabālakān svalpān sasṛjurnābhideśataḥ | tebhyo dattā mahātṛṣṇā pratyekaṃ ca pravartikā ||87|| kāryakāṇḍaprayoktrī ca vāsanā cāparārpitā | ubhābhyāṃ ramate brahmā janayatyaparāḥ prajāḥ ||88|| etat sarvaṃ paraṃ kāryakaraṃ kuṭumbameva saḥ | striyai dattvā yayau naijaṃ deśaṃ divyaṃ nṛpaśca saḥ ||89|| tāvallīnāni sarvāṇi kuṭumbāni śubhāni vai | tairlīnairnṛpateścendro nirāśrayo babhūva ha ||1.547.90|| ruroda pāparuddhaḥ sa vāsanākramavāsitaḥ | punaḥ kṛpālurbhūpālastadarthaṃ sukhamāśrayam ||91 || dadau vyoma tato vāyuṃ tejo jalaṃ bhuvaṃ tathā | līnebhyo vyaktarūpāṇi dattavān bhūpatiḥ sa vai ||92|| sāvakāśāni pañcaikyabhāvāpannāni kāryataḥ | saṃyuktāni mahendrasyāśrayāṇyālambanāni ca ||93|| tāvattāni ca līnāni samudbhūtāni vai punaḥ | jīvitāni svakāryeṣu samāgatya sthitāni ca ||94|| mahendro dasyubhirvyāpto navadvāre pure śubhe | rājyaṃ ca kārayāmāsa pracakāra svayaṃ tathā ||95|| mahendrādyā babhramuśca digbhrame cāti pīḍitāḥ | tadā taṃ nṛpatiṃ prāhurdehi mārgapradarśakam ||96|| prārthanāṃ paramāṃ śrutvā rājā kanyāṃ subodhinīm | dadau mahendrasaṃjñāya yathā divyanṛpālayaḥ ||97|| pradṛśyate tayā sākaṃ mahendraḥ sukhavānabhūt | amūrtā iva te sarve nyūṣurāyatane śubhe ||98|| navadvāre pure tvekastambhe sarvakakubpathe | nadīsahasrasaṃkīrṇe sarvakāryasamāśrite ||99|| mahendraṃ tvekalaṃ dṛṣṭvā sakhāyaṃ nṛpatiśca saḥ | āvartamānaṃ mugdhaṃ ca naṣṭamiva sthitaṃ ca tam || 1.547.100 || saṃsūcya vācakān śabdān vedānaśikṣayacchubhān | niyamāṃśca yamām̐ścāpi śikṣayamāsa vai tadā || 101 || tena moho vinaṣṭo vai sasmāra bhūpatiṃ punaḥ | kintu bandhairveṣṭitaḥ sa na nirgantuṃ śaśāka ha || 1 02|| śastraṃ tvaicchattadā devānnṛpateḥ śīghrameva tu | bhūpaḥ śastramasaṃgaṃ ca dadāvasmai suvajrakam || 1 03|| chitvā tadā mahendraśca bandhanāni nṛpālayam | yayau nityasukhānandānvito’bhūt kṣaṇamātrataḥ || 1 04|| mahendrāḥ sarva evaite pūrvakarmānusārataḥ | kāyānagararājāno bhavanti bhavasāgare || 1 05|| caturviṃśaticauraiśca baddhyante madhyasaṃsthitāḥ | upāsanayā buddhyā ca bhaktyā dāsyena yogataḥ || 1 06|| anyatamena śastreṇa bhittvā bandhanameva ca | yāti divyanṛparājyaṃ punaryatra na bandhanam || 1 07|| āgateyaṃ kathā rājan sarvasya viṣaye sthitā | tvaddehe mama dehe ca sarvajantuṣu sadṛśī || 1 08|| māyārājyaṃ vihāyaiva divyabhūpāśrayaṃ caret | tenamuktasthitiṃ prāpya śāśvataṃ sukhamaśnute || 1 09|| pravṛttaṃ maṇḍalaṃ hitvā nivṛttaṃ padamāpnuyāt | pārvatyai śaṃkaraścaiva prāha lakṣmi mayoditam || 1.547.11 0|| agastyaśca samuvāca bhadrāśvāya nṛpāya ca | so’yaṃ rājā ca saurāṣṭre prāpya jñānamanuttamam || 11 1|| yayau rājyaṃ svakaṃ tatra samārādhya narāyaṇam | māhendramaṇḍalaṃ hitvā bhaktyā nārāyaṇasya saḥ || 11 2|| yayau mokṣapadaṃ divyanṛpatervāsarūpakam | paṭhed yaḥ śṛṇuyāccāpi labhetātmavisarjanam || 1 13|| bhavapāraṃ paraṃ pāraṃ māyābdhervāsanākṣayam | purātanaṃ mahāmitraṃ prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 14|| sakāmasya dhanaṃ putro’patyāni sampadastathā | bhaveyuśca sadārogyaṃ tattvajñānaśravāt priye || 1 15|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhadrāśvarājñe’gastyapradattātmajñānagurumahimādinirūpaṇanāmā saptacatvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||547||
<1.548> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi prabhāsasya pūrvasyāṃ śaṃkaroditam | pārvatyai sumahattīrthaṃ prāṇyuddhārakaraṃ śubham || 1 || guptaprayāgastatrāsti devo’sti mādhavastathā | jāhnavī yamunā devī sarasvatī ca tatra vai || 2 || anyānyapi ca tīrthāni vasanti tatprayāgake | śṛgāleśvaratīrthaṃ ca sannidhau vartate tathā || 3 || triḥsaṃgamo nadīnāṃ ca tīrthaṃ tatparamaṃ śubham | brahmakuṇḍo viṣṇukuṇḍo rudrakuṇḍastathā śubhaḥ || 4 || kuṇḍamadhyād vinirgatya gaṃgā yamīṃ sugacchati | anayorantare sūkṣme guptā cāste sarasvatī || 5 || atra māghe snānakartā prayāgasnānajaṃ phalam | tīrtharājaphalatulyaṃ labhati nātra saṃśayaḥ || 6 || tasmiṃstīrthe mātaraśca rakṣikāḥ saṃvasanti hi | bhūtādibhayanāśāya tā mātṛḥ saṃprapūjaye || 7 || vṛṣabhastatra dātavyo yātrāphalopalabdhaye | viṣṇukuṇḍe janaḥ snātvā yastu mādhavamarcayet || 8 || sa tu yāsyati vaikuṇṭhaṃ yatra devo hariḥ svayam | śṛgāleśvaranāmeśakṣetraṃ krośārdhamityapi || 9 || gavāhatā dvijahatā ye daṃṣṭripaśubhirhatāḥ | ātmaghātakarā ye ca sarpadaṣṭāśca ye mṛtāḥ || 1.548.10 || śayyāmṛtāḥ śaucahīnāsteṣāṃ śrāddhaṃ tadatra vai | kārayet tena muktā syurduḥkhaśokavivarjitāḥ || 11 || tatra siddheśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ devaiḥ saṃsthāpitaṃ purā | aṇimādikamaiśvaryaṃ smṛddhiṃ vindet prapūjanāt || 1 2|| tato vai nāradādityaṃ tīrthaṃ gacched ravergṛham | ekadā tu pṛthivyāṃ vai tīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ || 1 3|| nāradastvāgatastasya sūryakriyāprasaṃkramāt | śaithilyaṃ samabhūd dehe yathā jarākṛtaṃ bhavet || 14|| svargaṃ satyaṃ tato gantuṃ notsāhaṃ kurute muniḥ | yato virūpatāṃ prāpto yauvanādivivarjitaḥ || 15|| vijātīyādibhāvena satye loke vaset katham | evaṃ cintayatastasya sūryaḥ sākṣāt babhūva ha || 16|| vada nārada kā cintā jāyate tava mānase | martyaloke ca ye’pyanye bahu bhramanti te khalu || 17|| īśvarā vā ca devā vā ṛṣayo yogino’pi vai | mama kriyābhirvyāptāśca yānti vai jīrṇatāṃ dhruvam || 18|| yathā martyāstathā te’pi mama kālaprabhāvataḥ | grasyante mānavaistulyā vṛddhā bhavanti sarvaśaḥ || 1 9|| vada tvaṃ ṣoḍaśābdaśca dṛśyase satyalokagaḥ | kintu cādya kṣitau jāto jarayā grasta eva yat ||1.548.20|| mā tvaṃ cintāṃ kuru brahman yuvā san vicariṣyasi | na prabhāvaḥ kiraṇānāṃ tavopari bhaviṣyati ||2 1 || ityukto nāradastatra sudṛḍhaḥ ṣoḍaśābdikaḥ | yathāpūrvaṃ hi saṃjātaḥ sūryaścādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ||22|| nāradena tadā tatra nāradādityanāmakaḥ | sūryadevaḥ sthāpitaśca tīrthaṃ kṛtaṃ ca pāvanam ||23|| saptamyāṃ ravivāreṇa yastaṃ paśyati mānavaḥ | tasya rogabhayaṃ na syāt prasādād dyumaṇeḥ raveḥ ||24|| anyat tīrthaṃ tatra cāste’paranārāyaṇāśrayam | phālgunāmalapakṣe tu hyekādaśyāṃ vidhānataḥ ||25|| pūjayet puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇātmakam | atha gaṃgā śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ tatreśānyāṃ hi vartate ||26 || yatra trinetrakā matsyā vasanti rudracihninaḥ | śṛṇu gaṃgāgamaṃ tatra matsyānāṃ ca trinetratām ||27|| yadā rudro vivastraḥ san kadācidṛṣimaṇḍale | āśrameṣu tu bhikṣārthaṃ vicacāra tadā ca taiḥ ||28|| kruddhaistaiḥ ṛṣibhiḥ śapto hyajānadbhirmaheśvaraḥ | gajavad bhramase loke lajjāhīnaḥ paśuryathā ||29|| tasmād bhava gajastvaṃ cāraṇyavāsīti śaṃkaraḥ | drāgeva ca gajo bhūtvāraṇyaṃ viveśa śaṃkaraḥ ||1.548.30|| tatra bhṛguryogadṛṣṭyā viditvā śaṃkaraṃ ca tam | nirānandaṃ jagat sarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā cāha ṛṣīn parān ||3 1|| ayaṃ tu śaṃkaraścāsīd gajarūpo’pi so’bhavat | aparādho mahān jāta iti matvā ca śaṃkaram ||32|| dhyāyantaḥ prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ ca prabhāsake | kṣetre śṛgālanāmnyeva yatra guptaprayāgakaḥ || 33|| tatra prāptāśca te sarve taponiṣṭhāstapoghanāḥ | bhṛguratristathā maṃkiḥ kaśyapaḥ kaṇva ityapi ||34|| gautamaḥ kauśikaścāpi kuśikaśca mahātapāḥ | jātūkarṇyo vasiṣṭhaśca satyatapāḥ parāśaraḥ ||35|| śāṇḍilyaśca pulastyaśca vatsaḥ sāvastirityapi | śūkaro’pi bharadvājo bhārgavo dīrghatāpasaḥ ||36|| ete cānye’pi bahavo’gastyādyāḥ ṛṣayo hi te | tapaḥ kṛtvā haraṃ dhyātvā tallīnāste tadābhavan ||37|| śaṃbhustadā tu sākṣādvai samājagāma tānprati | uvāca varadānārthaṃ te ca sveṣṭaṃ pravavrire ||38|| yadi prasanno deveśa gaṃgāmānaya prāgiha | abhiṣekaṃ tatra kṛtvārcayitvā tvāṃ tataḥ param ||39|| ajñānātte pradrogdhāro yāsyāmaḥ pūtatāṃ tataḥ | dvābhyāṃ vayaṃ ca netrābhyāṃ na jñātaḥ śaṃkaro bhavān ||1.548.40|| tena jātaste’parādhaḥ punaḥ syānna tathā ca naḥ | dehi śaṃbho tṛtīyaṃ ca netraṃ divyaṃ yathā tava ||41|| harerharasya cānyeṣāṃ pratyakṣaḥ syāt pramāṇadhṛk | paricayastathā cakṣurāntaraṃ dehi śaṃkara ||42|| śaṃbhuḥ prāha tathāstveva yūyaṃ pāvanapāvanāḥ | trinetrāśca sadā santu gaṃgā ceyaṃ samāgatā ||43|| ityuktvā śaṃkarastūrṇaṃ tatsthānād vigato’bhavat | ṛṣayaḥ pāpamuktāśca śaṃkarasya prasādataḥ ||44|| yajñaṃ cakruvaiṣṇavaṃ ca tatra kṣetre dināṣṭakam | brāhmaṇā devatāścānye tīrthānyaraṇyadevatāḥ ||45|| samājagmustasya yajñe nārāyaṇaprasādajam | annaṃ bhuktvā parāṃ tṛptiṃ gatā vai prāṇino’pare ||46|| jalajāḥ sthalajāḥ sarve tṛptāstatra śubhe kratau | matsyāḥ prāhurmunīn sarvān yathā vai dhīvarā hi naḥ ||47|| jighāṃsavo na hanyurvai tathāśīrdīyatāṃ hi naḥ | ṛṣayaśca tadā prāhustrinetrāśca bhavantu vai ||48|| tṛtīyaṃ divyanetraṃ ca dūradarśanakārakam | śāṃkaraṃ rūpamevaitad bhavatāṃ jāyatāṃ sadā ||49|| dhīvarebhyaśca ṛṣibhiḥ śāṃkarāste pradarśitāḥ | trinetrā vai śubhā matsyā na hantavyāḥ kadācana ||1.548.50 || trinetratve kāraṇaṃ ca proktaṃ gaṃgāgame tathā | tatra kuṇḍe samāgatya snātvā matsyān vilokayet ||51 || tebhyo dadyāccaṇakādīn hemaṃ viprāya cārpayet | gāśca vastraṃ tilān dadyāt trinetraḥ sa bhaved dhruvam ||52|| ṛṣitoyājale snātvā kuṇḍe taptodake tathā | śaṃkaraṃ pūjayettatra sa bhaved bhuvanādhipaḥ ||53|| tatra caturmukhaścāste vināyako mahābalaḥ | somavāre pūjayitvā sveṣṭakāmān labhejjanaḥ ||54|| tato gacchet paraṃ tīrthaṃ gopālasvāminaṃ harim | sarvapāpaughaśamanaṃ dāridryaughavināśanam ||55|| bakulasvāminaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prapūjayet | uttarārkaṃ tato gacchet sarvarogapraṇāśanam ||56|| samudrasya taṭe tatra ṛṣitīrthaṃ hi vidyate | pāṣāṇākṛtayastatra dṛśyante ṛṣayaḥ sadā ||57|| maruddevīṃ tato yāyānmarudbhiḥ pūrvapūjitām | kṣemādityaṃ tato gacchecchabarasthānamadhyagam ||58|| tato gacchenmahādevīṃ śubhrāṃ kaṇṭakaśodhinīm | ṛṣitoyātaṭe yajñaṃ cakruḥ purā maharṣayaḥ ||59|| dhūmaiḥ samāvṛtaṃ vyoma yajñahomāgnihotrajaiḥ | ghrātvā daityāḥ samudrasya madhyāttatra samāyayuḥ ||1.548.6 0|| māyāvino mahākāyāḥ śyāmavarṇā mahodarāḥ | lambabhrūśmaśrunāsāgrā raktākṣaraktamūrdhajāḥ ||6 1|| upadravaṃ ca te cakruryajñavidhvaṃsahetave | etān dṛṣṭvā ṛṣayaśca dudruvurbhayakātarāḥ ||62|| patnīśālāṃ samāviṣṭāḥ keciddharyayutā drutam | agnihotrahaviṣyaṃ ca havirvinyasya mantrataḥ ||63|| susamiddhe juhuvuśca rakṣasāṃ nāśahetave | hutamātre samutpannā śaktiṃrlokabhayaṃkarā ||64|| khaḍgaśaktitriśūlāsicarmahastā mahojjvalā | tayā te nihatā daityāḥ samastā atha tā tadā ||65|| tuṣṭuvuḥ ṛṣayaḥ sarve prasannā sāpyuvāca tān | varaṃ vṛṇudhvaṃ munayo dadāmyatra yathepsitam ||66|| munayo vavrire devakaṇṭakānāṃ viśodhinī | kaṇṭakaśodhinīnāmnī sthāne’tra vasa rakṣa naḥ ||67|| evamastu samuvāca tatraiva ca sthitā tataḥ | aṣṭamyāṃ vā navamyāṃ ca pūjayettāṃ hitāvahām ||68|| rākṣasebhyaḥ piśācebhyo bhayaṃ tasya na jāyate | prāpnuyād yajñasiddhiṃ ca phalaṃ kratūdbhavaṃ tathā ||69|| tato gacchedunnatākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ cottarabhūsthitam | brahmeśvaraṃ pūjayecca tathā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||1.548.70 || ṛṣitoyātaṭe pūrvaṃ tepurvai brāhmaṇāstapaḥ | atyugraṃ tena bhikṣuśca bhūtvā nārāyaṇo yayau ||71 || tataḥ śaṃbhurvṛṣo bhūtvā cacāra ṛṣisannidhau | trikāladarśibhistatra dṛṣṭo nārāyaṇo haraḥ ||72|| dṛṣṭamātro virarāma śaṃkaro vṛṣarūpavān | tatra śaṃbhurliṃgarūpaḥ saṃjātaścaṇḍikeśvaraḥ ||73|| ahaṃ nārāyaṇo lakṣmi tadā taiḥ prārthito bahuḥ | rakṣaṇārthamāsurebhyastadā mayā niveditam ||74|| atra kuruta nagaraṃ nivāsāya mahāprabham | hūyantāmagnihotrāṇi devatāḥ sarvadā dvijāḥ ||75|| ijyantāṃ vividhairyajñaiḥ kriyatāṃ cāpi pūjanam | ātithyaṃ jāyatāṃ nityaṃ bhaktirmama ca niścalā ||76|| mama prasādataścānte muktirvaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati | ṛṣayaste tadā prāhurnagarāvanadurbalāḥ ||77|| nagareṇeha kiṃ kurmastava bhaktimabhīpsavaḥ | mokṣaṃ dehi mahārāja rakṣaṇaṃ naḥ sadā kuru ||78|| hariḥ prāha sadā rakṣāṃ kariṣye bhavatāmaham | sasmāra viśvakarmāṇaṃ viśvakarmā samāyayau ||79|| yatra caṇḍīśvaraḥ śaṃbhustāṃ bhūmiṃ caturasrikām | aṣṭayojanavistīrṇāṃ jagrāha nagarārthikām ||1.548.80|| pūrve tu śaṃkaraḥ śrīmān paścime nyaṃkumatyapi | uttare svarṇanandā ca dakṣiṇe sāgarāvadhim ||81 || madhye nāgnaharakṣetraṃ nagaraṃ connataṃ param | kārayitvā haristebhyo viprebhyo vāsakāraṇāt ||82|| dadau nyūṣustatra viprā homayajñakriyāparāḥ | unnato vighnarājaśca tatra rakṣaṇahetave ||83 || sthāpitaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena śaṃmusannidhau | pūjito dhanadaḥ putrasampadāṃ ca pradaḥ sadā ||84|| kāmām̐śca muktiṃ ca pradāsyati na saṃśayaḥ | vāstukārye gaṇeśaṃ ca śaṃkaraṃ śrīnarāyaṇam ||85|| pupūjurviśvakarmāṇaṃ mātṛgaṇām̐śca bhūsurān | kalaśaṃ saṃpupūjuśca tadā śaṃbhuḥ samāyayau ||86|| pratyakṣaḥ kalaśāgre vai kalaśeśastato’bhavat | yatra sthale pupūjuśca tatra sthaleśvaro’bhavat ||87|| māghamāse’bhavat sarvaṃ nagaraṃ pūjanaṃ tathā | tato jātaṃ connatākhyaṃ nagaraṃ vipratīrthakam ||88|| viśvakarmeśvaraṃ cāpi liṃgaṃ tatraiva pūjitam | brahmā bālasvarūpaśconnatākhye nyavasattataḥ ||89|| raivate vāmano bālaḥ prabhāse bālako haraḥ | unnate’jo bālarūpo vartate tat trayaṃ samam ||1.548.90|| bālarūpe na māyāsti kāpaṭyaṃ na ca vāsanā | mokṣadaṃ bālarūpaṃ vai pūjyaṃ ramyaṃ nirāmayam ||91|| kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho mohādyā bālarūpiṇi | nirmūlā eva notpannā vidyante naiva janmataḥ ||92|| saṃgadoṣācca jāyante saṃskārādvā tataḥ param | satyaṃ vrataṃ sadā tatra bālake cāpyahiṃsanam ||93 || asteyaṃ vartate tatra brahmavadvartanaṃ tathā | aparigraha evāpi viśvāso mātṛnodite ||94|| rāgeṇa hīnatā cāpi santoṣaṃ udaraṃbharaḥ | śuddhiścātmani nirdveṣṭā tapaḥ poṣakadhīnatā ||95|| vidyādhyāyaśceśabhāvaḥ sarve santi hi bālake | saṃsārasya ca yadrūpaṃ viṣayābhigatipradam ||96|| tattatra bālake nāsti tasmād viṣṇurhi bālakaḥ | sarpo’pi bālakaṃ matvā prasṛpya bālakopari ||97|| nirbhayaśca prayātyevājātaśatrukabālatā | yasya kasyāpi vāpatyaṃ sadayaṃ lokyate sadā ||98|| sarvayonigatairjīvaiḥ premṇā saṃlokyate tathā | nārāyaṇasvarūpatvaṃ tadeva bālake matam ||99|| dhruvaṃ bālaṃ ca prahlādaṃ sanakādīṃstathā śukam | bālaṃ kṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ cārādhya mokṣaṃ gatāḥ purā || 1.548.10 0|| yauvane vārdhake vāpi nare nāryāṃ napuṃsake | syād yadi bālabhāvaśced doṣāsaṃkramaṇaṃ tathā || 101 || pūjyate devavat so’pi nirdoṣo bālako yataḥ | doṣahīnaṃ ca vārdhakyaṃ doṣahīnā ca bālatā || 1 02|| dvayoḥ sāmyaṃ ca nairmalye pāvitryasya sthale hyubhe | bālaṃ namanti vai candraṃ bālaṃ paśyanti mātaraḥ || 103|| bālāṃ kanyāmudvahanti bālaṃ gṛhṇantyavaṃśinaḥ | balaṃ nārāyaṇīyaṃ ca svacchaṃ yatrāsti sargajam || 1 04|| tadvān bālaḥ sampradiṣṭastasmādbālo narāyaṇaḥ | vidyādānaṃ bālakebhyo bhojyadānaṃ sahāyatām || 1 05| samarpayanti janatāstasmād bālaḥ praśasyate | brahmacaryaṃ sadā bāle brahmaṇo rūpameva yat || 1 06| tasmād bālo brahmacārī brahmalokādhikāravān | brahmamokṣapradaścāpi yathā kṛṣṇo narāyaṇaḥ || 1 07|| gaurīṃ ca bālikāṃ saumyāṃ saṃpūjya labhate phalam | pārvatīpūjanasyāpi lakṣmyarcanasya cāpi vai || 108 || arajaskāḥ sadā devyo divi vasanti bālikāḥ | sāvitrī cāpi gāyatrī śrīśca lakṣmīśca bālikāḥ || 109|| tasya svāmī sadā bālo brahmā kṛṣṇo harastathā | lokāḥ svānugatairbhāvaiḥ kalpayanti suyauvanam || 1.548.110 || svavad vikṛtakākārān divyānapyatyadivyakān | doṣahīnān sadā śuddhān daityā gṛhṇanti doṣitān || 111 || sadoṣe vai kathaṃ mokṣo nirdoṣe vāsanā katham | tasmānnirdoṣakā devā bālā mokṣapradāḥ sadā || 112|| bālā nityāḥ sadā muktā rājante brahmadhāmani | sadā kiśorā divyāśca praśastā bālakāstataḥ || 11 3|| ityevamuktavān śaṃbhuḥ pārvatyai connatādikam | tīrthaṃ mayā ca te lakṣmi kathitaṃ mokṣadaṃ śravāt || 1 14|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne guptaprayāgatīrthaśṛgāleśvarakṣetrāparanārāyaṇatīrthatrinetratīrthonnatanagarasthāneśvarādinaikatīrthanirūpaṇaṃ bālatātparyārthanirūpaṇaṃ cetyādināmāṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 548 ||
<1.549> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tataḥ śaṃbhuḥ pārvatyai prāha vacmi tat | tīrthaṃ mokṣakara smṛddhipradaṃ connatamaṇḍale || 1 || durgādityaṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ vināyakasutīrthakam | yatra gajasvarūpadhṛg vināyako’bhavatpurā || 2 || mahākāleśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ mahat | mahodayaṃ paraṃ tīrthamṛṣitoyājalasthitam || 3 || talasvāmyabhidhe tīrthe kṣetrapaḥ kālameghakaḥ | vartate vanarakṣārthaṃ siṃhāṇyanivāsakṛt || 4 || nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe śaṃkhāvartatīrthaṃ hi śobhanam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇagṛhād dakṣiṇe goṣpadaṃ varam || 5 || tīrthaṃ cānantanāgena rakṣitaṃ viṣṇubhoginā | snātā śrāddhasya ca kartā tārayedekaviṃśatim || 6 || kulānāṃ ca svayaṃ mokṣaṃ svargaṃ samprāpnuyācchubham | pade pade’śvamedhasya phalavān syācca tīrthakṛt || 7 || guptagayāpi sā proktā viṣṇunā svayameva tat | gandhadānena gandhādi saubhāgyaṃ puṣpadānataḥ || 8 || dhūpadānena rājyāptirdīptyāptirdīpadānataḥ | dhvajadānātpāpahāniryātrayā brahmalokabhāk || 9 || goṣpadaṃ tanmahattīrthaṃ tatra vṛttaṃ purā śṛṇu | aṃgarājño’bhavatputro veno nāma prajāpatiḥ || 1.549.1 0|| sa mātāmahadoṣeṇa kālakanyāsutaḥ khalu | sudharmān pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā pāpabuddhirajāyata || 11 || sthitimutthāpayāmāsa vedaśāstroditāṃ hi saḥ | āsīdiyaṃ matistasya vināśe pratyupasthite || 12|| ahamīḍyaśca pūjyaśca sarvayajñaiśca sarvadā | mayi yajñā vidhātavyā mayi hotavyamityapi || 1 3|| ṛṣayaste tadā prāhurmā hyadharmaṃ kuru nṛpa | venaḥ prāha mayā sṛṣṭo dharmaścādharma ityapi || 14|| bhavanto māṃ mānayantu śrotavyaṃ kasya vai mayā | vīryaśrutatapaḥsatyairmayā ko’nyaḥ samo bhuvi ||15 || itibruvāṇaṃ munayo’nunetuṃ prabhavo na vai | jātāstataścātiruṣṭā jaghnustaṃ tu mahābalam || 16 || ātharvaṇena mantreṇa hatvāsya vāmabāhutaḥ | nirmathyotpādayāmāsurniṣādān kṛṣṇavarṇakān || 17|| tumbarām̐śca khasān vaindhyān dhīvarān venapāpajān | punarmaharṣayaste’tha pāṇiṃ venasya dakṣiṇam || 18|| mamanthuśca tadutpannaḥ pṛthurvai sūryasannibhaḥ | dhanurdhvajaṃ tathā śūlaṃ matsyaṃ cakraṃ kare dadhan || 19|| cihnarekhātmakaṃ cāpi bāhyaṃ khaḍgaṃ ca vartma ca | tasmin jāte nadā nadyaḥ samudrā bhūdharādayaḥ ||1.549.20|| saratnāścābhiṣekāya pṛthuṃ taṃ copatasthire | brahmā viṣṇuścāmarāśca ṛṣayo mānavā drumāḥ ||21 || sthāvarā jaṃgamāḥ sarve siṣicustaṃ narādhipam | pṛthunā tāḥ prajāḥ sarvā dharmamārgaiḥ sunanditāḥ ||22|| akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī siddhantyannāni cintayā | sarvāḥ kāmadughā gāvaḥ puṭake puṭake madhu ||23 || evaṃ pratāpinaḥ pṛthoryaśogānaṃ tu māgadhaiḥ | sūtaiśca bandibhistatra kṛtaṃ bhāvi vicārya ca ||24|| bhaviṣyatsarvavṛttāntaṃ vijñāya tu pṛthuḥ svayam | tadrītyā dhanurāgṛhya vasudhāmardayad yadā ||25 || gaurbhūtvā ca mahī tasya śaraṇaṃ tvanvapadyata | rājñā jagaddhitārthaṃ sā dugdhā naikapayaḥ prati ||26|| pṛthorduhitṛtāṃ prāptā pṛthivī sābhavat prathā | venasya sadgatiṃ kartuṃ pṛthuryajñaṃ cakāra ha ||27|| nāradaśca tadā prāha veno mleccho’dya vartate | pūrvapāpena vai janma marau deśe’sti tasya vai ||28|| tamuddhartuṃ tīrthayātrāṃ kuru mokṣo bhaviṣyati | pṛthurgato marundeśān nināya pitaraṃ gṛham ||29|| tato yayau kurukṣetraṃ mlecchaṃ tatra ca tīrthake | snāpayāmāsa vidhinā pāpaṃ tathāpi tiṣṭhati ||1.549.3 0|| tīrthaṃ prāha ca veno’yaṃ pūrvapāpātikoṭibhiḥ | vyāpto’sya pāpapuñjāni kṣālayituṃ na śakyate || 31 || eṣa ghorairmahāpāpairatīva pariveṣṭitaḥ | prabhāsaṃ tīrthamāsādya tatra śuddho bhaviṣyati ||32|| tatra sarasvatī puṇyā pañcasrotā pravartate | tasyā yat pañcamaṃ sroto nyaṃkumatī nigadyate ||33 || tasyāstaṭe sthitaṃ tīrthaṃ goṣpadaṃ nāma nāmataḥ | tatra pretaśilā cāste pretānāṃ muktidāyinī ||34|| yatra pretāḥ purā muktā aṣṭāviṃśatikoṭayaḥ | nandinī kāmadhenuryā padaṃ dhṛtvā purātra vai ||35|| pretānāṃ muktaye tatra sthitā goṣpadameva tat | sā prāha me padaṃ pretāḥ pāpahaṃ mokṣadaṃ sadā || 36 || atrāgatya jano yaśca snānaṃ śrāddhaṃ kariṣyati | gayāsaptaguṇaṃ tasya phalaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati ||37|| ityuktvā pretamokṣaṃ ca kṛtvāntardhānamāśu sā | yātā pretā api muktiṃ gatāstatra tu goṣpade ||38|| tataḥ pṛthuryayau tatra goṣpade mlecchasaṃyutaḥ | agre kṛtvā brāhmaṇān sa yayau nyaṃkumatītaṭam ||39|| vilokya goṣpade kṣetre padaṃ pretaśilāsthitam | cakāra kuṇḍān vedīśca maṇḍapān yajñasiddhaye ||1.549.40|| tatra yajñaḥ samārabdho vidhivad bhūridakṣiṇaḥ | pratyakṣaṃ
