pitarastasya babhūvurjvalanaprabhāḥ ||41 || tṛptāścāhurvayaṃ tṛptāḥ santuṣṭāḥ svargabhāginaḥ | rājan dhanyo’si puṇyo’si vayaṃ dhanyatarāstrayaḥ ||42|| pitṛṣu caivamukteṣu mleccho venastadā drutam | mlecchadehaṃ parityajya divyadeho babhūva ha ||43|| uvāca pāpanirmukto gacchāmi tridaśālayam | gaccha rājyaṃ sukhaṃ bhuṃkṣva putravācyaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā ||44|| evaṃ śrutvā pṛthuścātimumude ca nanāma tān | brāhmaṇān harṣayāmāsa svarṇabhūdhanadānakaiḥ ||45|| atha guptaprayāgaṃ ca kṛtvā someśvaraṃ tathā | raivatādriṃ parikramya yayau bhadreśvaraṃ tataḥ ||46|| kuṃkumavāpikātīrthamaśvapaṭṭasarovaram | lomaśasyāśramaṃ dṛṣṭvārcayitvā kambharāramām ||47|| dṛṣṭvā gopālakṛṣṇaṃ ca pūjayitvā pumuttamam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||48|| siddhakṣetraṃ yamīṃ snātvā nijāvāsaṃ yayau pṛthuḥ | īśvaro bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃśa eva yaḥ ||49|| pṛthuḥ sa venavanmuktiṃ yayau cānte hi śāśvatīm | śrāddhakāle kathā ceyaṃ śrotavyā saṃhitātmikā |||1.549.50|| tato gacchecchubhaṃ tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇagṛhaṃ param | goṣpadād dakṣiṇe cābdhitaṭe tiṣṭhati keśavaḥ ||5 1|| kvacijjanārdanastatra kvacicca madhusūdanaḥ | kvacit sa puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ kvacinnārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||52|| mahāsurān vinihatya viśrāntiṃ yāti tatra vai | kuberatīrthaṃ bālārkaṃ bālārkeśvaramityapi ||53|| ambikāsthānamityetat sarvapāpāni nāśayet | tato gacched devikāyāstaṭe jāleśvaraṃ śubham ||54|| śṛṇu tatra bhavaṃ divyamitihāsaṃ purātanam | nābhāgasya ca saṃvādamāpastambataponidheḥ ||55|| āpastambaḥ ṛṣiḥ pūrvaṃ vivastraḥ salile vasan | prabhāsatīrthe cograṃ vai tapaścakāra mīnavat ||56|| śaivālenābhavadvyāpto dehaḥ kāṃcanasadṛśaḥ | dhīvarā matsyasaṃgrāhā jālena jalamadhyataḥ ||57|| matsyaiḥ saha ṛṣiṃ taṃ ca jagṛhurdaivayogataḥ | vilokya taṃ maharṣiṃ ca mānavaṃ brahmanandanam ||58|| aparāddhamiti matvā nemuḥ śirobhireva tam | ūcurajñānajaṃ doṣaṃ dayālo kṣantumarhasi ||59|| sevāṃ darśaya dāśānāṃ prasanno bhava suvrata | ṛṣiḥ sa kṣamayā yukto dāśān provāca duḥkhitaḥ ||1.549.60|| eteṣāṃ jalamatsyānāṃ kadanaṃ ca kṛtaṃ mahat | kaivartaiśca militvaiva kāryaṃ matsyaprarakṣaṇam ||61|| yato jale nivāsānme matsyā vai bāndhavā yathā | svārthaṃ sarve prakurvanti parārthaḥ khalu durlabhaḥ ||62|| jñānināmapi ceccetaḥ svārthamātre rataṃ yadi | ajñānināṃ tadā kiṃ syād vailakṣaṇyaṃ tu dakṣakaiḥ ||63|| jñānino dhyānayogasthāstyajantyajñānino yadi | ajñāstu jantavo loke kva prāpsyanti sukhaṃ tataḥ ||64|| same duḥkhe samāyāto’balām̐styajati ced balī | kiṃ balaṃ svārthapoṣaṃ tadvyarthaṃ pāpaṃ taducyate ||65|| śaktaścānyasya duḥkhāni vārayed vai yathābalam | paraduḥkhavihantā vai nārāyaṇāṃśa ucyate ||66|| pāpātpāpataraṃ taṃ hi pravadanti purātanāḥ | sāmarthye sati nānyeṣāṃ duḥkhanāśaṃ karoti yaḥ ||67|| mamāgre syādupāyastu vinā matsyavimocanam | nāhaṃ bhoktuṃ samicchāmi yathā matsyāstathānvaham ||68|| khādantu māṃ sukhaṃ dāśāḥ saha matsyairyatheṣṭakam | tyajantu vā ca tān matsyān mayā saha samāvṛtān ||6 9|| jīvo yeṣāṃ ca matsyānāṃ nirgatasteṣu yogataḥ | praviśyāntarjīvayiṣye tapobhirjīvadānataḥ ||1.549.70|| yanmamāsti śubhaṃ kiñcittaddīnānupagacchatu | yat kṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ taistu tadaśeṣamupaitu mām ||71|| dhīvarāṇāṃ ca yadduḥkhaṃ me syāttadapi sāmpratam | antaḥ praviṣṭaḥ sattvānāṃ bhaveyaṃ sarvaduḥkhabhāk ||72|| dṛṣṭvāndhān kṛpaṇān vyaṃgānanāthān rogiṇastathā | dayā na jāyate yasya sa rakṣa iti me matiḥ ||73|| prāṇasaṃśayamāpannān prāṇino bhayavihvalān | yo na rakṣati śakto’pi sa pāpaṃ samupāśnute ||74|| paropakāreṇārtānāṃ sukhaṃ yadupajāyate | tasya svargo’pavargo’pi ṣoḍaśārho’pi naiva tu ||75|| tasmādetānahaṃ hīnām̐styaktvā bhītān suduḥkhitān | varjayitvā na yāsyāmi padamātramito’pi ca ||76|| dāśebhyaścaivamevaitadṛṣiṇā viniveditam | matsyānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ hitvā na me rakṣā bhaviṣyati ||77|| ahaṃ rakṣyo yadi dāśā matsyān muñcantu vai drutam | yadvā me tyajane duḥkhaṃ matsyatyāgātmakaṃ yadi ||78|| bhavatāṃ jāyate tarhi mūlyaṃ dadātu bhūpatiḥ | bhavanto dravyayuktāḥ syuḥ prayatnaphalabhāginaḥ ||79|| ahaṃ matsyaiśca sahito bandhaśūnyo bhavāmi ca | śrutvā tu dhīvaraiḥ sarvaṃ nābhāgāya niveditam ||1.549.80|| nābhāgaścāyayau tatra yatrāpastambakamatsyakāḥ | sa samyak pūjayitvā taṃ devakalpaṃ muniṃ nṛpaḥ ||81|| provāca bhagavan brūhi kiṃ karomi tavājñayā | āpastambo dayāyukto rājānaṃ prāha satvaram ||82|| śrameṇa mahatāviṣṭān kaivartān duḥkhajīvinaḥ | śramamaulyaṃ prayaccha tvaṃ madyogyaṃ yaddhi manyase ||83|| nābhāga āha dāśebhyaḥ śatasāhasramudrikāḥ | suvarṇānāṃ dadāmyatra mūlyaṃ tulyaṃ ca te yadi ||84|| ṛṣiḥ prāha tvayā nāhaṃ śatasāhasrakairnṛpa | niyamyaḥ sadṛśaṃ me’tra mūlyaṃ pradīyatāṃ param ||85|| rājāha koṭimūlyaṃ vai niṣādebhyaḥ pradīyatām | ṛṣiḥ prāha tvayā nāhaṃ niyamyaḥ koṭibhirnṛpa ||86|| sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha cintaya | rājāha rājyamardhaṃ vai niṣādebhyaḥ pradīyatām ||87|| ṛṣiḥ prāha samastaṃ vai rājyaṃ me sadṛśaṃ na vai | sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyamṛṣibhiḥ saha cintaya ||88|| maharṣaistadvacaḥ śrutvā nābhāgo’bhūd viṣādavān | etasminnantare tatra lomaśastu mahātapāḥ ||89|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrād āpastambaṃ samāyayau | jñātvā vṛttāntamāścaryakaraṃ nābhāgamabravīt ||1.549.90|| mā viṣādaṃ gaccha rājan mūlyam ṛṣerna kānakam | kintu viprāstathā gāvo divyāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayaṃbhuvā ||91 || ekasmādeva tattvād vai divyād divyāśca te ca tāḥ | divyaṃ divyasya mūlyaṃ gaurmūlyamasyai pradīyatām ||92|| śrutvā rājā saharṣo’bhūt provāca jālagaṃ munim | uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhagavan gavā krīto mayā mune ||93|| ṛṣiḥ prāha tvayā samyak krīto’smi vai gavā nṛpa | godvayaṃ mama mūlyaṃ vai pavitraṃ paramaṃ śuci ||94|| gāvaḥ pradakṣiṇīkāryāḥ pūjanīyāśca nityaśaḥ | maṃgalāyatanā divyāḥ sṛṣṭā hyetāḥ svayaṃbhuvā ||95|| sthānāgārāṇi viprāṇāṃ devatāyatanāni ca | yadgomayena śuddhyanti kimasmādadhikaṃ punaḥ ||96|| gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpistathaiva ca | gavāṃ pañca pavitrāṇi punanti sakalaṃ jagat ||97|| gāvo mamāgrato nityaṃ gāvaḥ santu ca pṛṣṭhataḥ | gāvo me hṛdaye’gre ca gomadhye ca vasāmyaham ||98|| tenāgnayo hutāḥ samyak pitaraścāpi tarpitāḥ | devāśca pūjitāstena yo dadāti gavāhnikam ||99|| saurabheyī jagatpūjyā devī viṣṇupade sthitā | sarvametanmayā dattaṃ mayā dattaṃ pratīcchatu || 1.549.10 0|| rakṣaṇād dhenuputrāṇāṃ gavāṃ kaṇḍūyanaistathā | kṣīṇārttarakṣaṇāccāpi janaḥ svarge mahīyate || 101 || ādau gāvo bahiścāpi madhye cānte prakīrtitāḥ | rakṣanti tāstu devānāṃ kṣīrājyamamṛtaṃ sadā || | 10 2|| tasmād gāvaḥ pradātavyāḥ pūjanīyāśca nityaśaḥ | svargasya saṃgamāyaitāḥ sopānamiva nirmitāḥ || 1 03|| etacchrutvā ṛṣervākyaṃ niṣādā api satvaram | gomāhātmyaṃ vidantaśca natvāpastambamabruvam || 1 04|| saṃbhāṣā darśanaṃ sparśaḥ kīrtanaṃ smaraṇaṃ tathā | pāvanāni kilaitāni sādhūnāṃ yogināṃ sadā || 1 05|| vayaṃ hi pāvitāstasmānnābhāgād godvayaṃ śubham | bhavanmūṃ gṛhītaṃ yat pūjayiṣyāma eva gām || 1 06|| bhavānmuktastathā matsyā muktā muktaṃ ca godvayam | vayaṃ muktāśca nābhāgo muktaḥ sādhusamāgamāt || 107|| bhavān pūjyastathā matsyāḥ pūjyāḥ pūjyaṃ ca godvayam | vayaṃ pūjyāśca nābhāgaḥ pūjyaḥ sādhu samāgamāt || 108|| ṛṣiḥ prāha mayā mūlyaṃ mamaiva godvayaṃ kṛtam | lomaśasyopadeśena prasanno’smi tataḥ punaḥ || 10 9|| karomi śubhasakalpa matsyā bhavantu jīvitāḥ | godvayasya pradānena matsyā yāsyanti jīvanam || 1.549.11 0|| tasmād goyugalaṃ devaṃ brāhmaṇāya mahātmane | tena matsyāḥ prajīveyuryūyaṃ syurdoṣavarjitāḥ || 111 || tadā śrutvā dhīvaraistad godvayaṃ munaye tadā | āpastambāya tatraivārpitaṃ nidoṣatārjitā || 1 12|| ṛṣiḥ prasannastānprāha paśyantu mīnamaṇḍalam | godvayasya pradānena jīvitaṃ punareva hi || 1 13|| tathokte jīvitā matsyā yayuḥ sāmudravāriṣu | vyaṃgīkṛtāśca ye matsyāstathā vai śātitāśca ye || 1 14|| teṣāṃ muktyarthamāpastambarṣiḥ prāha punarvacaḥ | eṣa vaḥ pratigṛhṇāmi gāmimāṃ tapprapuṇyataḥ || 1 15|| niṣādā gacchata svarga saha matsyairanagakaiḥ | prāṇināṃ prītimutpādya ninditenāpi karmaṇā || 1 16|| narakaṃ yadi prāpsyāmi paśyāmi svargameva tat | yanmayā sukṛtaṃ kiñcinmanovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || 1 17|| kṛtaṃ tenaiva duḥkhārtāḥ sarve yāntu śubhāṃ gatim | tatastasya prasādena niṣādāḥ sahamatsyakaiḥ || 1 18|| divaṃ gatāśca tān vīkṣya nābhāgaḥ samuvāca ha | sevyāḥ śreyo’rthibhiḥ santaḥ puṇyatīrthajalopamāḥ || 119| kṣaṇopāsanamapyatra na yeṣāṃ niṣphala bhavet | sadbhiḥ sahāsanaṃ kārya sadbhiḥ kurvīta satkathām || 1.549.120| satāṃ vṛttena varteta nāsadbhiḥ kiñcidācaret | satāṃ samāgamādeva samatsyā matsyajīvinaḥ || 121 || triviṣṭapamanuprāptā yathāśvamedhayājinaḥ | āpastambo munistatra lomaśaśca mahāmuniḥ || 122|| varaistaṃ vividhairiṣṭaiśchandayāmāsa bhūpatim | ṛṣistaṃ kārayāmāsa yajñasaṃkalpamādarāt || 1 23|| tatheti cokte vai prītyāpastambaḥ praśaśaṃsa tam | aho dhanyo’si rājendra dharme te vartate matiḥ || 124|| ājñāṃ gṛhṇāsi viprasya dhanyaṃ kuṭumbamityapi | rājānastu madāviṣṭāḥ prāyo gṛhṇanti naiva ca || 125|| brāhmaṇānāṃ vaco nityavyasanāhatabuddhayaḥ | dhruvaṃ janma dhruvo moho dhruvo narako bhūbhṛtām || 1 26|| rājyaṃ te bahumantāro viyantyāsurajaṃ kulam | manīṣiṇastu paśyanti rājyādi narakopamam || 1 27|| paralokaṃ sādhayanti śāśvatīṃ gatimātmanaḥ | evamuktvā mahātmānau jagmatuḥ svaṃ svamāśramam || 1 28|| nābhāgo’pi varaṃ prāpya yayau svaṃ nagaraṃ prati | kratuṃ cakāra vidhivat śatruṃjitātaṭe śubham || 129|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīkamalāpatim | samijya ca yayāvante brahmākṣarapadaṃ param || 1.549.130|| jālasthale tu ṛṣiṇā sthāpitau viṣṇuśaṃkarau | jāleśvaraṃ ca tatkṣetraṃ prakhyātaṃ samabhūt purā || 131 || devikāyāstaṭe tatra nābhāgo matsyajīvinaḥ | āpastambo lomaśaśca matsyā nārāyaṇastathā || 132||| smṛtamātrā muktidāste bhavanti muktigā yataḥ | caitraśuklatrayodaśyāṃ jātaṃ vṛttāntameva yat || 1 33|| śrāddhaṃ yātrāṃ dhenudānaṃ kuryāttatra jano yadi | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhetātra paratrāpi yathepsitam || 1 34|| śaṃbhuḥ satīṃ yathā prāha lakṣmi te kathitaṃ mayā | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi svargamokṣapradaṃ bhavet || 1 35|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne durgādityagoṣpadavenanṛpaśuddhimuktinārāyaṇagṛhajāleśvaratīrthanābhāgāpastambarṣicaritrādivarṇanaṃnāmaikonapañcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||549||
<1.550> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tataḥ śaṃbhuḥ pārvatyai samuvāca yat | tīrthavaryaṃ kathayāmi te’pi svargādidāyakam || 1 || devikāyāstaṭe tvāsīt tuṇḍīnāmā ṛṣiḥ purā | kūpastatrābhavattvekaḥ ṛṣeryogātsa muktikṛt || 2 || hariṇāḥ patitāstatra jalapānārthamugragāḥ | mṛtāste muninā sarve jīvitāstapaso balāt || 3 || jalaṃ hūṃkāramātreṇa pūritaṃ kūpagaṃ tadā | taṭoparito vahati camatkārakaraṃ yataḥ || 4 || tatra tuṇḍīśvaro devaḥ sthāpitastena tīrthakam | tatra tīrthaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā hyāśāpuraṃ gaṇeśvaram || 5 || gacchennaivedyamādhāya dānaṃ dadyāttu kānakam | tato gacchet kāpilaṃ tu tīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ śubham || 6 || kapilau raivataṃ gacchan yatrovāsa hi vatsaram | kapilā sā nadī tatra tīrtharūpā vyajāyata || 7 || prauṣṭhapadyasite pakṣe ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bhaumo bhaved yadi | vyatīpātaśca rohiṇyāṃ sā ṣaṣṭhī kapilā matā || 8 || kapilāsaṃgame ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kapilāyāṃ samāhitaḥ | snātvā śrīkapilaṃ viṣṇuṃ pūjayedarkabhūsthitam || 9 || kapilā kapilo viṣṇuḥ rakṣatāṃ ceti cārthayet | kapilāṃ gāṃ pradadyācca vājimedhaphalaṃ bhavet || 1.550.1 0|| hāṭakeśaṃ tatastīrthaṃ prakuryāt pāvanaṃ param | tato gacchedagastyasyāśramaṃ vatsarasevitam ||1 1 || kālakeyāḥ purā daityāḥ samudrāntarnivāsinaḥ | rātrau pṛthvyāṃ samāgamya suptān viprādikān muhuḥ || 1 2|| bhakṣayanti sma tān jñātvā kālakeyān vihiṃsakān | agastyaḥ saṃyayau tatra samudrasya taṭaṃ prati || 13 || tapaścakāra vidhivad varṣamātraṃ taṭe sthitaḥ | caturthyāṃ phālgune māsi naktāhāraṃ vidhāya saḥ || 14|| pañcamyāṃ tilapiṣṭaṃ ca bhuktvā homaṃ cakāra saḥ | evaṃ caturṣu māseṣu kṛtvaikabhojanaṃ tataḥ || 15|| nirāhāraḥ samabhavannirvighnavratamuttamam | varṣottaraṃ sa munirāṭ lokarakṣāṃ vyacintayat || 16|| paśyadhvaṃ kautukaṃ devāḥ samīnamakarādikam | añjalinā pibāmyenaṃ śoṣayāmi mahārṇavam || 17|| evamuktvā hariṃ smṛtvā kṛtvā brahmāṇamāntaram | gaṇḍūṣamakarot sarvaṃ samudraṃ saritāṃ patim ||18|| kālakeyā vinaṣṭāśca pācitaṃ jalamityapi | tataśca meghavarṣairvai samudrāḥ sajalāḥ punaḥ || 1 9|| ityāgastyāśramaṃ ramyaṃ tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam | lopāmudrāsahitaṃ māṃ yaścātrāgatya pūjayet ||1.550.20|| hāṭakeśo mayā nītastaṃ vidhinā prapūjayet | ayane cottare martyo golakṣaphalamāpnuyāt ||21|| bhadrāśvo nṛpatistatrāgastyadarśanakāṃkṣayā | samājagāma cānarca papraccha kuśalaṃ prati ||22|| āścaryaṃ yadi te kiñcid viditaṃ dṛṣṭameva vā | tanme kathaya dharmajña tato yāmi prabhāsakam ||23|| agastyastaṃ nṛpaṃ prāha śvetadvīpodbhavāṃ kathām | āścaryarūpo bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |||24|| kuṃkumavāpikātīrthe rājate puruṣottamaḥ | tasyāścaryāṇi dṛṣṭāni bahūni vividhāni ca |||25||| so’yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śete śvetadvīpe’pi sarvadā | nāradaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā surāṣṭrake ||26|| māthure śrīrādhikeśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā tataḥ param | himādrau śrīnaranārāyaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā yayau muniḥ ||27|| śvetadvīpaṃ tatra so’yaṃ dadarśa samarūpiṇaḥ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmānpuruṣām̐stigmatejasaḥ ||28|| sadṛśān sadṛśākārān sadṛśaguṇavaibhavān | kiśorān rūpasampannān sughaṭāṃśca manoharān ||29|| ayaṃ viṣṇurayaṃ viṣṇureṣa viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ | cintābhūttasya tān dṛṣṭvā ko’smin viṣṇuriti prabhuḥ ||1.550.30|| kasmai natvā tato’nyām̐śca paśyāmi khalu bhāvataḥ | nyūnasya prathame pūjye pūjyapūjāvyatikrame ||3 1 || āyuryaśojñānahāniḥ pratyavāyo’dhiko bhavet | evaṃ cintayatastasya cittaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||32|| cintā yuktaṃ mudhā jātaṃ kathamārādhayāmi tam | yena vedmi paraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ karomi kim ||33|| evaṃ saṃcintya dadhyau sa taṃ devaṃ parameśvaram | dhyātastasya kāṃbhareyaḥ paritoṣaṃ jagāma ha ||34|| uvāca sa prasannaḥ san sākṣād bhūtvā narāyaṇaḥ | varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te dṛṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ mama tvayā ||35|| ye’tra loke samāyānti sārūpyādicatuṣṭayam | teṣāṃ bhavati tvatraiva brūhi kiṃ te dadāmyaham || 36|| nāradaḥ prāha te prāptiryathā syāt tacca me vada | nārāyaṇastadā prāha pauruṣaṃ sūktameva me ||37|| sahasraśīrṣā puruṣo yatrāhaṃ varṇito mune | tadāsthāya janā ye māṃ prayakṣyanti narāyaṇam ||38|| te māṃ prāpsyanti satataṃ saṃhitādhyayanena ca | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitoktamārgeṇa ye janāḥ ||39|| pūjayiṣyanti māṃ bhaktāste prāpsyanti vai dhruvam | mama kṣetraṃ gamiṣyanti me kariṣyanti darśanam ||1.550.40|| sevāṃ satāṃ kariṣyanti te māṃ prāpsyanti niścitam | mannāma vihitaṃ bhinnaṃ sarveṣāṃ raṭanāya vai ||41|| vinā pūjāṃ nāmabhaktyāvaśyaṃ prāpsyanti māṃ janāḥ | sarvaṃ jñānaṃ tava mune prakāśaṃ yāsyati dhruvam ||42|| mama darśanayogyaṃ ca muktadarśanayogyakam | sarvaṃ vivekajaṃ jñānaṃ bhaviṣyati ca te mune ||43|| ityuktvā bhagavām̐steṣu sadṛśeṣu ca viṣṇuṣu | yayau punarnāradaśca jñātavānnaiva taṃ prabhum ||44|| matvā cādarśanaṃ viṣṇoḥ samāneṣu ca viṣṇuṣu | tāṃ diśaṃ praṇipatyaiva nāradastu divaṃ prati ||45|| yāsyan yatra surāṣṭre cāgastyo’haṃ nivasāmi vai | tatrāgatya kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā yayau vaihāyasaṃ puram ||46|| tadvai nāradatīrthaṃ ca sthalaṃ jñānapradaṃ śubham | bhadrāśvo’pi muniṃ natvā yayau prabhāsakaṃ prati ||47|| ityevaṃ śvetabhūmisthaṃ jñātvā nārāyaṇaṃ tataḥ | viśālāsthaṃ yāmunasthaṃ kuṃkumavāpikāsthitam ||48|| akṣarāt pararūpaṃ ca jñātvā mokṣaṃ hi vindati | smaran viṣṇuṃ paṭhanvedān dadan dānaṃ yajan harim ||49|| sādhūn santoṣayan bhakto mokṣabhāṅ nātra saṃśayaḥ | tīrthaṃ sādhumayaṃ sādhvīmayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pramokṣadam ||1.550.50|| tato gacched bhīmanāthatīrthe bhītinivārakam | suparṇeśīṃ tataḥ paśyet suparṇaṃ ca narāyaṇam ||51|| kaubereśīṃ tato gacchettato bhallaṃ sutīrthakam | bhallatīrthe sadā viṣṇurvartate gaṃgayā saha ||52|| gaṃgā ca vaiṣṇavaṃ kṣetraṃ pāvanaṃ mūrtimad yataḥ | vallakena niṣādena viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sanātanaḥ ||53|| bhallaṃ dhanuṣi sandhāya hṛto golokago’bhavat | vallako’pi mṛgabhrāntyā plakṣadrustambasaṃsthitam ||54|| viṣṇuṃ jaghāna bhallena gatvā paśyati mādhavam | tuṣṭāva ca tataḥ khinnaḥ prāptavām̐stadanugraham ||55|| yayau tatraiva golokaṃ viṣṇunā saha dhīvaraḥ | bhallakṣetraṃ hi tatproktaṃ viddhaḥ pādatale hariḥ ||56|| mokṣadaṃ svargadaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ janmamaraṇavedhakṛt | tato gaccheddhiraṇyāyā uttare raivataṃ prati ||57|| kauśikaṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ tato vastrāpathātmakam | dāmodaraṃ raivatakaṃ bhavamindreśvaraṃ tathā |58|| cakrodyānaṃ revatītīrthakaṃ vāsiṣṭhakāśramam | śṛṇu cāsyā bhūmerlakṣmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm ||59|| gajo nāmābhavadrājā bhāryayā saha pārthivaḥ | gaṃgājalābhiṣekārtha yayāvuvāsa tatra ca ||1.550.60|| bhadro nāma munistasyājagāma purataḥ kvacit | taṃ gajaḥ prāha mokṣārthaṃ jñānaṃ dehi mune mama ||61 || bhadraḥ prāha svayaṃ cātmā tīrthaṃ sarveṣu pāvanam | tatrāste śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastīrthottamottamam ||62|| tasya jñānaṃ smṛtirūpaṃ paraṃ jñānamihocyate | anyat sarvaṃ jñānamātraṃ medhābhārakaraṃ nṛpa ||63|| tīrthāni toyapūrṇāni devāḥ pāṣāṇamṛnmayāḥ | ātmasthaṃ yena paśyanti te na paśyanti taṃ param ||64|| santi tīrthānyanekāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca | puṇyatoyāḥ pavitrāśca sāgarāḥ saritastathā ||65|| jñānaṃ teṣāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ jñānottamottamaṃ matam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ narāyaṇam ||66|| matsyaṃ varāhaṃ nṛvyāghraṃ vāmanaṃ kacchapaṃ harim | rāmaṃ rāmaṃ ca rāmaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||67|| hariṃ śrīkapilaṃ dattātreyaṃ buddhaṃ ca raiṇukam | vāsudevaṃ pṛthuṃ haṃsamṛṣabhaṃ ca kumārakān ||68|| nāradaṃ ca kratuṃ cāśvagrīvaṃ vyāsaṃ janārdanam | mohakaṃ rājarājaṃ ca kalkaghnaṃ ca pumuttamam ||6 9|| naraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ śvetadvīpapatiṃ prabhum | śeṣasthaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca jagannāthaṃ raṇasthitam ||1.550.70|| nāmāni tasya vāsāni smṛtvā mokṣamavāpnuyāt | gaṃgā ca yamunā caiva nadī godāvarī śubhā ||71 || śatadruśca tathā vindhyā payodhā varadā tathā | carmaṇvatī ca sarayū gaṇḍakī caṇḍapāpahā ||72|| candrabhāgā vipāśā ca śoṇā brahmasutā tathā | etāścānyāśca yā bahvyo himāśrayādayo’drayaḥ ||73|| nāmoccāreṇa yeṣāṃ hi pāpaṃ yāti vināśanam | aśvapaṭṭasarasaśca mānasasarasastathā ||74|| nārāyaṇasarasaśca puṣkarasarasastathā | indradyumnasarasaśca smaraṇādeva mokṣyate ||75|| kānyakubje mārgaśīrṣe hyuṣitvā svargamāpnuyāt | arbude pauṣapūrṇāyāṃ māghyāṃ gayāsutīrthake ||76|| phālgunyāṃ himavatpṛṣṭhe caitryāṃ vaset prabhāsake | aśvinyāṃ kuṃkumavāpyāṃ vaiśākhyāṃ cāpyavantike ||77|| jyeṣṭhyāṃ trikūpake caiva śrāvaṇyāṃ pūrvasāgare | bhādryāṃ sārasvate caiva kārtikyāṃ raivatācale ||78|| kāpile ca tathā dvīpe śālagrāme’pi bhūtale | dīpotsavyāṃ cāndrabhāge śrāddhaṃ snānaṃ japaṃ caret ||79|| goloke’kṣaradhāmni vaikuṇṭhe kailāsake’thavā | yathābhaktiṃ bhaved vāso vratināṃ tīrthaśālinām ||1.550.80|| māsānāṃ kārtikaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kārtike bhīṣmapañcakam | tatrāpi dvādaśī śreṣṭhā rājan dāmodare jale ||81 || somanāthasya sānnidhye udayānto girirmahān | tasya paścimabhāge tu raivatādriḥ smṛto mahān ||82|| nadī tatra ca vahati suvarṇarekhikā śubhā | dhātavastatra tu raktāḥ śvetā nīlā vicitrakāḥ ||83|| pāṣāṇā kuṃjarākārāḥ svarṇagairikasannibhāḥ | vṛkṣā vallyaśca gulmāśca kāñcanānāṃ samudbhavāḥ ||84|| tatra nadyāṃ svarṇalekhānāmnyāṃ nārāyaṇo hradaḥ | dāmodarahradaścāpi rādhāderīti cāpi vai ||85|| tatra snātvā jalaṃ pītvā yānti muktiṃ hi dehinaḥ | hariścandreṇa balinā śibinā nahuṣeṇa ca ||86|| nalena ca mahādānānyarpitāni hi raivate | gatāste viṣṇubhavanaṃ śāśvataṃ ca nirāmayam ||87|| ityevaṃ bhadravacanaṃ śrutvā gajo janādhipaḥ | samāyayau raivatasya prabhāsasya ca tīrthake ||88|| datvā dānānyanekāni havirhutvā hutāśane | ūrdhvapādaḥ sthito bhūtvāpibaddhūmamadhomukhaḥ ||89|| anye tena sahāyātāstapaḥ kurvanti vai tathā | sarvairvrataṃ kṛtaṃ tatra dhyeyo dāmodaro girau ||1.550.9 0|| sakṛduccaritaṃ yena harirityakṣaradvayam | baddhaḥ parikarastena mokṣopagamanaṃ prati ||9 1|| sa rājā ṛṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ yāvat tiṣṭhati tatra vai | vimānānāṃ sahasrāṇi tāvattatrāgatāni vai ||9 2|| yeṣu devyo ramādāsyo nārāyaṇasya pārṣadāḥ | muktāścānye samabhavan śataśo’tha sahasraśaḥ ||93|| sarvaiścānucaraiḥ sārdhaṃ sa rājā bhāryayā saha | gato vimānamārūḍho yadakṣarapadaṃ varam ||94|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | iti mantrasya coddhoṣo vimāneṣvakhileṣvapi ||95|| satāliko’bhavad vyomni yena svargādivāsinaḥ | darśanārthaṃ vimānānāṃ muktānāṃ mārgamadhyagāḥ ||96|| avasthāya ca rājānaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram | samabhilokayāmāsuḥ pūjayāmāsurīśvarān ||97|| evaṃ pitṛmunīnāṃ ca lokān bhittvāṇḍakād bahiḥ | yayurmokṣapadaṃ sarve kṛtvā tīrthaṃ tu raivatam ||98|| śaṃkaraḥ pārvatīṃ prāha kṣetrasyaivaṃvidhāṃ kathām | mayā lakṣmi cābhihitā tubhyaṃ mokṣakarī śubhā ||99|| paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasyāḥ kathāyāḥ pāpanāśanam | svargaṃ satyaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ paraṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ labhet || 1.550.10 0|| idaṃ śrutvā tathā bhaktyā modayitvā praśaṃsayet | sarvapāparahitaḥ san paraṃbrahmādhisaṃvrajet || 101 || kā mayā procyate lakṣmi saurāṣṭrasya pavitratā | svayaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya maṇirūpiṇaḥ || 1 02|| deśaḥ saurāṣṭraityākhyo mokṣado’sti pade pade | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pūrve’sti sarvadā || 1 03|| paścime vāmano devo dakṣiṇe somanāthakaḥ | uttare ca camatkāranagaraṃ dvārikā śubhā || 1 04|| śatruṃjitā svarṇarekhā bhadrā coṣṇā hiraṇyakā | devanadī nyaṃkumatī sarito mokṣadāḥ śubhāḥ || 1 05|| yatra santi raivataśca śatruṃjayo varāṭakaḥ | śālamālo navanītaścānye parvatapuṃgavāḥ || 1 06|| maharṣayaśca bhagavatsvarūpā yatra santi hi | satyo lakṣmīsamā yatrākṣatā devyo vasanti ca || 1 07|| candro yanmukhamālokya kṣaṇaṃ stabdho bhavatyapi | tādṛśyo divyadevyaśca sūryatulyāśca bālakāḥ ||1 08|| yatra vasanti śīlasthāḥ sākṣānnārāyaṇo’pi ca | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya gopikāstathā || 1 09|| lakṣaśo yatra saurāṣṭre bhaktā vasanti sevikāḥ | sarvo brahmamayo deśo lakṣmi vaikuṇṭhavanmama || 1.550.11 0|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śaṃkaroditameva te | pāṭhakāḥ śrāvakāḥ śrotujanā muktā bhavanti ca || 111 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tuṇḍīśvarakapilātīrthāgastyanāradacamatkārabhīmanāthatīrthabhallakṣetraraivatatīrthagajanṛpamokṣādīnāṃ sopākhyānavarṇanaṃnāmā pañcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 550 ||
<1.551> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śaṃkaraḥ pārvatīṃ prāha tīrthāntarāṇi yānyapi | saurāṣṭre tāni te vacmi lakṣmi nibodha me priye || 1 || unnabillaṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ gṛhātmakaṃ ca śāṃbhavam | gaṃgeśvaraṃ paścime vai raivatād bhāti śobhanam || 2 || yakṣeśvarīmahātīrthaṃm upalāttvaṃ ca śobhanam | vastrāpathe mahākṣetre nagare vāmane purā || 3 || putraśokābhisantapto vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ | ājagāma tapastaptuṃ svarṇarekhānadītaṭe || 4 || īśānakoṇe nagarāt svarṇarekhānadījale | vāsiṣṭhaṃ tanmahattīrthaṃ vartate bhuktimuktidam || 5 || balikhātaṃ makhatīrthe kṛtasmarasya sannidhau | vartate mokṣadaṃ nāthatīrthaṃ lokasya śāntidam || 6 || vastrāpathasya vāyavye divyaṃ cāsti sarovaram | apsarasāṃ parītālaṃ devāḥ snānti vihāriṇaḥ || 7 || jālīgahanaśaṃbhuśca devī triśūlinī tathā | herambākhyo gaṇeśaśca vartante tīrthavāsinaḥ || 8 || paścime sāgare tatra makarālayapattanam | kundanākhyaṃ puraṃ cāpi maṇibhadraṃ śubhāśrayam || 9 || śrīdāmapuramutkṛṣṭaṃ dvārikākṣetramuttamam | evaṃ tīrthāni sāmudre taṭe vasantyanekaśaḥ ||1.551.1 0|| evamuktvā mahādevaḥ pārvatīṃ parameśvarīm | kṛtvā prābhāsikaṃ yajñaṃ śrāvaṇe samupasthite || 11 || yayau koṭigaṇairyukto dvārikāṃ nagarīṃ prati | śrīkṛṣṇādyāstīrthadevāḥ satkāraṃ cakrurīśvarāḥ || 12|| māsaṃ nītvā kṛṣṇabhūmau camatkārapuraṃ yayuḥ | tatra devyaścāṣṭaṣaṣṭisaṃkhyā hareṇa pūjitāḥ || 1 3|| navarātravrate sarvāḥ prāpya śrīśaṃkaraṃ patim | nimagnāḥ sukhavistāre brahmānandātmasāgare || 14|| āśvine ca yayuḥ sarve parvataṃ tvarbudācalam | gaganasthaṃ puṣkaraṃ tu yatra saṃrājate’niśam || 15|| dvitīyaṃ parvataśṛṃge tṛtīyaṃ bhūtale sthitam | vasiṣṭhādimaharṣīṇāmāśramā yatra śobhanāḥ || 16|| parvate cākacakyādirūpāśca vālukāḥ śubhāḥ | vṛkṣāśca vallikāḥ stambāstāpasā iva bhānti ca || 17|| araṇyānyapi ramyāṇi devodyānāni vai tathā | yajñānāṃ bhūmayo yatra tāpasānāṃ ca vedikāḥ || 18|| satīnāṃ sunivāsāśca sādhūnāmāśramāstathā | vidyante brāhmaṇānāṃ ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ śubhālayāḥ || 1 9|| sārasvatāni tīrthāni nadā nadyaśca pāvikāḥ | meghānāṃ śikharāvāsā vāyūnāṃ gandhamiśritāḥ ||1.551.20|| dhenūnāṃ devakoṭīnāṃ vāsā yatra bhavanti ca | yogināṃ siddhajīvānāṃ maṇḍalāni vasanti ca | | 2 1 || puṣkare śikhare vāsaṃ tatra cakruḥ śivādayaḥ | puṣkarādīni tīrthāni vasiṣṭhādyā maharṣayaḥ | | 22 || brahmādyā devatāścānye cakruḥ śaṃkaramānanam | jalaṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ cārghaṃ naivedyaṃ sevanādikam | | 23 || daduḥ śrīparameśāya pārvatīpataye surāḥ | vaśiṣṭhena kṛtā pūjā viśiṣṭā ca nijālaye | | 24| | suviśrāntiṃ tataścakruḥ śāṃkaratvarbudācale | arbudo’yaṃ divyamūrtiḥ satkāraṃ kṛtavān bahum | | 25 || śaṃkaraḥ pārvatīṃ prāha niśāyāṃ svāsane kathām | śṛṇu tvasya kathāṃ divyāṃ pāpatāpapraṇāśinīm | | 26 || gautamo’bhūnmunīnāṃ vai mānyo dhanyo mahānṛṣiḥ | śataśṛṃge nivāsaṃ sa kṛtvā tapaścacāra ha | | 27 || ahalyā tasya bhāryāpi tāpasī brahmavādinī | daṇḍakāraṇyavāstavyā gautame kiṃkarī sadā | | 28 | | atithīnāṃ pūjanaṃ sā sadā karoti bhāminī | ekadāvagrahe jāte pṛthvyāmannāni santi na | | 29 || viprā vicārayāmāsurbhojanaṃ kva miliṣyati | gautamo’sti samarthaḥ sa pūjayatyatithīn sadā | | 1.551.30 || tadgṛhaṃ samagacchāma ityāyayuḥ samantataḥ | gautamastadvilokyaiva brahmāṇaṃ prapitāmaham | | 31 || sasmāra subahu brahmā pratyakṣaḥ sambabhūva ha | varaṃ vṛṇu samuvāca gautamaḥ prāha bhūtale | | 32 | | jalaṃ godhūmadhānyāni yavāśca kaṇiśādayaḥ | prātarārabhya jāyantāṃ madhyāhne tatkaṇānvayam | | 33 || gṛhṇīyo nityamityevaṃ teṣāṃ pakvaṃ ca bhojanam | vaiśvadevaṃ śubhaṃ śrāddhaṃ naivedyaṃ devatāsu ca | | 34 | | ātitheyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ kurmo yayā tathāstu me | brahmā tvāśrutya ca tathāstviti prāha yayau tataḥ | | 39| | nityaṃ dhānyaṃ navaṃ prātarjāyate tacca pacyate | sahasrāṇāṃ nityameva viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ tathā | | 36 || bhavatyevaṃ vatsaraṃ vai brāhmaṇā bhojitāstayā | pātivratyaprabhāveṇāhalyā karoti sevanam | | 37 | | saṃkalpayati nityaṃ sā prātaḥ kāntasya pādayoḥ | natvā patitvā cāṅguṣṭhe prakṣālyārghaṃ vidhāya ca | | 38 | | yadyahaṃ svāmibhāryāsmi svāmibhaktā pativratā | tadā tvatra prajāyantāṃ lakṣapātrāṇi nityaśaḥ | | 39 || dāsā dāsyaḥ sevakāśca dhenavo rasavadaghradāḥ | khādyapeyāni sarvāṇi kriyantāṃ hutabhuk svayam ||1.551.40 || devāśca pariveṣṭāro bhavantu daṇḍake mama | evaṃ nityaṃ susaṃkalpya kṛtvā mahānasāni ca ||41 || pācayitvā navānnāni kṛtvā viśvasurārpaṇam | gogrāsān jantubhāgām̐śca vikīrya pitṛpiṇḍakān |||42 || viprān lakṣamitān nityaṃ bhojayatyadhikānapi | atha varṣottare kāle suvṛṣṭirbhūtale’bhavat ||43 || annāni sarvadeśeṣu jātānyeva samantataḥ | viprāḥ prāhurvayaṃ deśāntarāṇyeṣyāma eva vai ||44|| gautamastām̐stadā prāha vasatātraiva bhūsurāḥ | tadā te brāhmaṇāḥ prāhuḥ svatantrāḥ smo vayaṃ mune ||45 || tvayānnāni pradattāni rakṣitāśca vayaṃ sadā | yasyānnaṃ tasya vai deho’dhīnatā tasya cottamā || 86 || tadvākyaṃ sarvathā pālyaṃ kintu jigamiṣā dhruvā | ityuktvā cintayāmāsurgantuṃ te miṣamadbhutam ||47|| eko vipro rodhanākhyaḥ prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāya ca | saṃyamena viveśāntarhṛdaye gautamasya hi ||48 || anyaiścaikā tu gaustatra nirmitā māyayā śubhā | sā gatā gautamaścaiva śālāyāṃ tṛṇasannidhau ||49|| gautamo’pi sthitastatra prāṇāyāme sthiro hyataḥ | gaurgatā parṇaśālāyāṃ gautamastāṃ vilokya ca |||1.551.5 0 || rodhanāntaḥpraveśena prāṇaruddhā bhavātra gauḥ | evamuccārayāmāsa prāṇaruddhābhavattu gauḥ ||5 1 || patitā mūrchitā cāpi viprāḥ prāhustadā muhuḥ | goghno vai gautamo nāsyāśrame stheyaṃ tu bhūsuraiḥ ||52 || gautamastān muhuḥ stutyā tuṣṭāva pūjyabhūsurān | neyaṃ mṛtāsti mūrchāyāṃ mūrchā naśyettu vā katham ||53 || prāyaścittaṃ karomyatra mā yāntu bhūsurā gṛhāt | ityuktā brāhmaṇāḥ prāhuḥ prāyaścittaṃ na jīvite ||54|| mūrchite vā prakartavyaṃ mūrchā dūrīkarotu vai | gaṃgājalaṃ samānīya samāplāvaya gāmimām ||55|| vimūrchā sthāsyati drāg vai vayaṃ yāmo vanāntaram | ityuktvā prayayuḥ sarve viprā daṇḍakabhūmitaḥ || 56|| gautamo vyomamārgeṇa yayau śrīśaṃkara prati | śaṃkaraḥ svāgataṃ tatra kailāse kṛtavān purā || 57|| gautamastu haraṃ natvā yayāce gāṃgakaṃ jalam | śaṃkaraḥ svaṃ jaṭākhaṇḍaṃ samutpāṭya dadau tadā || 58|| sagāṃgaṃ taṃ nināyātra datvā godehamastake | tadutpannajalenaināṃ plāvayāmāsa gautamaḥ |||59|| gaurjātā svasthahṛdayā vimūrchā tvāśrame sthitā | gaṃgā sā gautamī jātā godānasya vareṇa hi ||1.551.6 0|| godāvarīti vikhyātā daṇḍakāraṇyavāsinī | atha tān brāhmaṇānāha gautamarṣiḥ palāyitān ||61 | sarve bhavantu kāpaṭyadharmābhāsā yugāntare | raudrāḥ kapālasaṃgāśca bhojyadānāṃ vinindakāḥ ||62| ityevaṃ sati te cāsya gautamasya prabhāvanam | kathitaṃ sucamatkāramayaṃ godāvaraṃ sthalam ||62| tatra godāvare tīrthe gautamasyābhavacchubhaḥ | śiṣyastūttaṃkanāmā yo vedānadhītya yāvataḥ ||64| gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dātuṃ prārthanāṃ pracakāra saḥ | gurupatnī tadā prāha dakṣiṇāṃ maṇimālikām ||65| saudāsasya gṛhe rājñī madayantī svavakṣasi | dhārayatyeva nityaṃ sā tvānetavyā pradehi tām ||66||| ityukto gurupatnyā sa prasthitaḥ satvaraṃ tadā | sudāsasya gṛha prāyāt sudāsaṃ vyāghrarūpiṇam ||67| dadarśa tvabhiyāntaṃ svaṃ bhakṣayituṃ sa bhūsuraḥ | vipraḥ prāha yatheṣṭaṃ tvaṃ khāda māṃ tadanantaram ||68|| atithiste samāyāto maṇimālā pradehi me | guruve’rpayya caiṣyāmi dakṣiṇāṃ tvabhivāñcchitām ||69|| rājā prāha śubhaṃ vipra yācyatāṃ mahiṣī mama | ityukto bhūsuro rājñīṃ yayāce mālikāṃ prati ||1.551.70|| rājñī prāha tvamānīhi cābhijñānaṃ nṛpasya vai | sa gatvā tvaritaṃ bhūpamabhijñānamayācata || 71 || saudāsaścāha vākyaṃ yadabhijñānaṃ yato bhavet | yairvinā sugatirnāsti durgatiṃ yena yānti ca ||72|| gatvaivaṃ brūhi tāṃ sādhvīṃ śrutvā dāsyati mālikām | sā dadau bhūsurāyaināṃ mālikāṃ divyasatprabhām ||73 | uvāca tvasurastatra raṇāntike pratiṣṭhati | atalāt sa samāgatya mālāmicchati me śubhām ||74|| ajāmṛto’suro nāmnā khātayāmāsa tattalam | bhūgarbhe vāsayāmāsa rākṣasān sa nijānugān ||75| tena vai vivaraṃ pṛthvyāṃ cātidīrghaṃ kṛtaṃ yataḥ | āharenna yathāgatya tathā rakṣa prayāhi vai ||76| ityuktaḥ so’pyutaṃkaśca maṇihāraṃ samādade | āyātaḥ svaguroḥ patnyai dadau hīrakahārakam ||77|. guruṃ papraccha vākyasya śubhārthaṃ sa jagād ha | prasāditā dvijā dānairdāsyanti sugatiṃ parām ||78|| asantuṣṭā dvijā yasya durgatistasya sarvadā | ityarthaṃ cāpi vijñāya mumude bhūsurastadā ||79|| āśīrvādān gurorgurvyāḥ samādāya mahānṛṣiḥ | uttaṃkaḥ puṣkaraṃ tīrthaṃ ramyaṃ nijālayaṃ yayau ||1.551.8 0|| uttaṃkatīrthamatrāsti pāpatāpapraṇāśanam | athaitad vivaraṃ dīrghamāyataṃ cāsuraiḥ kṛtam |||81 || tatraikadā vaśiṣṭhasya kāmadhenuḥ papāta ha | vaśiṣṭho nijayogena homadhenuṃ nijāṃ tadā ||82|| bahirniṣkāsayāmāsa tata ārabhya sarvadā | pūrtiṃ vicārayāmāsa vivarasya mahādriṇā ||83 || himālayaṃ yayau śīghraṃ vaśiṣṭho hi vihāyasā | arthayāmāsa tatputraṃ vivarasya prapūrtaye ||84|| nandivardhaṃ sutaṃ prādād vaśiṣṭhastaṃ nināya ca | vivare sthāpayāmāsa nandivardhananāmakam ||85|| arbudena ca nāgena dhṛtastatra yathāyatham | arbudācalamevaitannāmakhyātiṃ gataṃ tataḥ ||86 || bhādraśuklasya pañcamyāṃ tvāyātaḥ parvato yataḥ | tīrthānyapi vaśiṣṭhena cānītāni bahūnyapi ||87|| asya śṛṃge nāgatīrthaṃ vaśiṣṭhasyāśramastathā | śaṃkarasya tathā vāsastatra snātvā ca nirjhare ||88|| dhanasampatsukhasvargaputralakṣmyādi cāpyate | vandhyā snātvā putravatī bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ || 89|| śrāddhaṃ tatra kariṣyanti pitarastasya sarvathā | muktiṃ svargāt prayāsyanti kartāpi muktigo bhavet || 1.551.90 || vaśiṣṭhaścānayāmāsa gautamīṃ ca sarasvatīm | gaṃgāṃ mandākinīṃ tatrācaleśvaraṃ ca śaṃkaram || 91 || gautamī brāhmaṇī kācidanapatyatvaduḥkhitā | sādhvī tīrthaṃ nāgatīrthamāyayāvarbudācale || 92|| atha sā cintayāmāsa dhiṅ māṃ putravivarjitām | iti cintāparā snātuṃ nāgatīrthaṃ viveśa sā || 93 || snātvā sā nirgatā tasmāt salilād yāvadeva hi | vināpi bhartṛsaṃyogaṃ sadyo garbhavatī hyabhūt ||94|| prasannā sā ca śuśrāva gāṃ tadā cāśarīriṇīm | yo yadvāñcchati citte’tra jalamadhye vyavasthitaḥ || 95|| cintitaṃ tadavāpnoti nārī vātha naro’pi vā | tvayā tvatra jalesthitvā putravāñcchā kṛtā hṛdi ||96 || ato garbhayutā jātā putrastava bhaviṣyati | śrutvākāśagatā vāṇīṃ devadūtena bhāṣitām || 97|| dṛṣṭvā patiṃ vinā garbhaṃ vākyametaduvāca sā | aho tīrthaprabhāvo’yamapūrvaḥ pratibhāti me || 98|| yatra saṃjāyate garbhaḥ strīṇāṃ śukraṃ rajo vinā | tato gṛhaṃ gatā sā ca suṣuve sutamuttamam || 99 || sakāmā ye cātra tīrthe snānti teṣāṃ manorathāḥ | phalantyeva na sandeho yathā sā gautamī tathā || 1.551.100 || gomatī cāhṛtā kuṇḍe vaśiṣṭhena mahātmanā | tatra snātvā paraṃ svarge vindate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 101 || śṛṇu devi camatkāramacaleśvarasannidhau | śukaścāsīt kṛtanīḍaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ karoti saḥ || 10 2 || uḍḍīyoḍḍīya ca nīḍe viśrāmyati punaḥ punaḥ | kālena ca mṛto rājā veṇunāmābhavaddhi saḥ || 103 || jātismarau vabhūvāsau rājā smṛtvā śukasthitim | acaleśvaramāsādya pradakṣiṇamathākarot || 1 04|| nānyat kiñcit karotyeva karotyeva pradakṣiṇam | nāradādyāḥ ṛṣayastu dṛṣṭvā bhūpaṃ tathāvidham || 1 05|| papracchuḥ kevalaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kathaṃ vidhīyate | naivedyaṃ phalapuṣpādi kathaṃ nārpayase vad || 106 || veṇuḥ prāha purā pakṣī śukaścāsaṃ sthito’tra tu | devaṃ tatra sthitaṃ kurvan pradakṣiṇamaharniśam || 1 07|| kṛpayā tatprabhāvācca jātismaro’dhunābhavam | karomi tanmahāpuṇyaṃ smṛtvā devapradakṣiṇam || 1 08|| anantapuṇyalābhārthaṃ karomyeva pradakṣiṇam | ṛṣayo nṛpateḥ śrutvā sādhu sādhviti cābruvan || 10 9|| rājā kālena mahatā harabhaktyā tataḥ param | oṃ namaḥ śrokṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ || 110 || iti mantraṃ harāllabdhvā bhaktyā vaikuṇṭhamāyayau | satyai śaṃbhūditaṃ vṛttaṃ lakṣmi te tu mayoditam || 111 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃkarādīnāṃ dvārikācamatkārapurārbudācalādigamana, gautamavṛttāntaṃ, saudāsottaṃkavṛttāntaṃ, nāgatīrthamahimā, veṇunṛpamokṣaḥ, arbudānayanavṛttāntaṃ, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikapañcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||55 1||
<1.552> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi śaṃkaraṃ tvāgataṃ śrutvārbudācale | agastyastaddarśanārthaṃ dakṣiṇāt samupāgataḥ || 1 || natvā śaṃbhuṃ pūjayitvā sukhāsīnaḥ śubhāsane | śaṃbhunā satkṛto’gastyaḥ papraccha śaṃkaraṃ tataḥ || 2 || ciraṃjīvitvamevātra kathaṃ syānme vada prabho | śaṃbhuḥ prāha bhaja kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam || 3 || saurāṣṭre vartamānaṃ vai kāmbhareyaṃ ramāpatim | vinā bhaktiṃ hareḥ kvāpi divyatvaṃ naiva jāyate || 4 || vinā ca divyabhāvena ciraṃjīvo na jāyate | kālakṣayādikaṃ divye spṛśatyeva na karhicit || 5 || divyayogaṃ vinā divyabhāvo naiva kadācana | divyo nārāyaṇo viṣṇurbhūtabhāvana īśvaraḥ || 6 || tasmin dehe praviṣṭe ca divyatā syād viśeṣataḥ | siddhayastatra vartante yatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 7 || ahaṃ vai śaṃkaro brahmā viṣṇuścānye divaukasaḥ | divyā nārāyaṇāṃśena tasmānnārāyaṇaṃ bhaja || 8 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | japa nitya mahāmantraṃ dhyānaṃ kuru hareḥ sadā || 9 || juhudhi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | prasannaḥ san yatheṣṭaṃ te dāsyatyeva sa divyatām || 1.552.1 0|| ityukto’gastyamunirāḍ dhyānaṃ cakāra pūjanam | vandanaṃ smaraṇaṃ nityaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai || 11 || lomaśasyāśrame gatvovāsāśvapaṭṭake tadā | athaikadā sa munirāṭ tīrthārthaṃ kāśikāṃ yayau || 1 2|| vyomnā himagiriṃ gatvā prayayau mānasaṃ saraḥ | kacchapaṃ mānase divyaṃ dadarśa munipuṃgavaḥ || 1 3|| kamalāni sudivyāni dadarśa kānakāni ca | kacchapenārpitaṃ divyaṃ kamalaṃ svāgate śubham || 14|| tāvat sa munirāṭ tatra babhūva divyadṛṣṭimān | uḍḍīya kacchapaṃ natvā yayāvilāvṛtaṃ tataḥ || 15|| meroḥ pārśvasthite khaṇḍe dadarśa susarovaram | tasya taṭe śubhā tena dṛṣṭā kācinmahākuṭī || 1 6|| tatropavāsaśithilo dṛṣṭastena hi tāpasaḥ | asthicarmāvaśeṣaśca cīravalkalakāmbaraḥ || 17|| pṛṣṭaśca pratipattyarthaṃ kastvaṃ ceti mahātmanā | sa tvagastyaṃ samuvāca sthīyatāṃ sthīyatāṃ dvija || 18|| ātithyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ brahman praviśyatāṃ sthalaṃ mama | iti śrutvā saṃpraviṣṭo’gastyaḥ parṇakuṭīṃ ca tām || 19 || tāvaddadarśa puruṣaṃ vipraṃ jvalantamīśvaram | bhūmau śubhāsanasthaṃ prājapantaṃ brahma śāśvatam || 1.552.20 || svakare mālikāṃ yuñjan lalāṭe tilakaṃ dadhan | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 21 || homamevaṃ prakurvantaṃ pratyekaṃ maṇimāpya ca | vadantaṃ mālikānte ca pauruṣaṃ sūktamuttamam || 22 || etādṛśaḥ sa puruṣo lakṣmīsūktamuvāca ha | sūktottaraṃ tu tatkuṭyāṃ kuṇḍādvai pañcakanyakāḥ || 23 || niryayuḥ kāñcanaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ tvekā dadau tadā | dvitīyā jalapātreṇa pādaprakṣālanaṃ vyadhāt || 24 | | tṛtīyā vyajanaṃ dhṛtvā munaye pavanaṃ dadau | caturthī pañcamī dhṛtvā cāmare pakṣayoḥ sthite || 25 || punaḥ śrīsūktamuccārya kuṭyāṃ sa tāpaso muhuḥ | homaṃ cakāra vai tāvat kanyāstu śataśaḥ śubhāḥ | | 25 || hemakuṃbhakarāstatrotpannāḥ pārśve sarovaram | vāruṇena ca homena śīghraṃ tatraiva nirmitam | | 27 || tāstu jalāni cānīya snāpayāmāsuretya tam | vastreṇa mārjanaṃ cakruścālaṃkārān dadustataḥ | | 28 | | vastrāṇi ca dduḥ pūjāṃ cakrurnaivedyamuttamam | jalaṃ dadustatastāścāntardhāna prayayuḥ kṣaṇāt| || 29 | | athāgastyaḥ samālokyāścaryaṃ dhyānaṃ cakāra ha | netre sammīlite yāvat tāvanmerugirau nijam || 1.552.30 | | uccaśṛṃge sthitaṃ mūrdhni paśyatyātmānamātmanā | paśyati sāgarānsapta tathaiva kulaparvatān || 31 || saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ ddarśa merusaṃsthitaḥ | dṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ punardhyānaṃ cakārāgattyako muniḥ || 32 || bhuvarlokaṃ tathā svargaṃ janaṃ satyaṃ ddarśa ha | brahmasabhāṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ ddarśa tatra vai sthitaḥ || 33 | | tatra dadarśa puruṣaṃ caturbāhuṃ janārdanam | unmīlya netre yāvacca bahiḥ paśyati tāvatā || 3 4|| na vai merurna vai divyā kuṭī naiva sarovaram | mānasaṃ na saraścāpi kāśikāpi na vidyate || 35 || aśvapaṭṭasarastīre lomaśasyāśrame śubhe | agastyaḥ svaṃ dadarśaiva naije parṇagṛhe tadā | | 36 || tadārabhyātra loke cāgastyasya divyatā yathā | ciraṃjāvitvamatyarthamaiśvaryāṇyatigāni ca || 37 || jātānyeva ca taddeśaṃ kadā prāpsye punaḥ śubham | ityeva cintayāno’sau śaṃbhuṃ draṣṭuṃ himācalam | | 38 || naranārāyaṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ muhuryāti narāyaṇam | draṣṭuṃ cāpi śvetabhūmiṃ satyalokaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | | 39 | | tathāpi ca punarnaiva jāyate tasya darśanam | ityevaṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha pārvatīṃ tāvadeva ca ||1.552.40 | | punaragastirāyāto darśanārthaṃ tamārbudam | natvā śaṃbhuṃ praṇamyaivovāca jijñāsitaṃ tadā ||41 || bhagavan divyalokasya purā dṛṣṭasya vai mayā | vrataṃ tapo vā dharmo vā prātyarthaṃ sādhane vada || 42|| śaṃkaraḥ prāha tacchrutvā yatte lakṣmi vadāmyaham | anārādhya hariṃ bhaktyā tallokāptirna vai bhavet| || 43 | | ārādhite harau lokā bhaveyurvai kare’khilāḥ | yo yajñe tvijyate devo yasmāt sarvamidaṃ jagat ||44| | utpannaṃ sarvadā yasmin līnaṃ bhavati sāmaram | anādi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo devaḥ parātparaḥ | | 45 | | akṣarādhipatiḥ śrīmān pūrṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | paripūrṇatamaḥ so’yaṃ bhajanīya sadā janaiḥ ||46 | | sakāmairvāpi niṣkāmaiḥ savārthadaḥ sa vai prabhuḥ | caturdhātmābhavatpūrvaṃ sa eva puruṣottamaḥ | | 47 | | goloke śrīkṛṣṇarūpo vaikuṇṭhe sa narāyaṇaḥ | vāsudevo’vyākṛte ca haime naranarāyaṇaḥ || 48 | | punaścāyaṃ caturdhā cābhavacchrīpuruṣottamaḥ | satyalokottare viṣṇurviṣṇuśca kṣīrasāgare || 49 | | śvetadvīpe tathā vipṇurviṣṇurādityako divi | punaścāyaṃ sa bhagavān tridhātmānaṃ sasarja ha | | 1.552.50 | | sadāśivaṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ mahākālaṃ ca śāśvatam | punaścāyaṃ sa bhagavān tridhātmānaṃ sasarja ha | | 51 | | aniruddhaṃ ca pradyumnaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ ca śāśvatam | punaścāyaṃ sa bhagavān tridhātmānaṃ sasarja ha | |52 | | brahmāṇaṃ rājasaṃ rūpaṃ sāttvikaṃ viṣṇumeva ca | tāmasaṃ rudrarūpaṃ ca sṛṣṭipuṣṭivinaṣṭikṛt || 53 || eka eva hi bhagavān kalpe kalpe prajāyate | sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭau golakeṣu sa evāsaṃkhyarūpadhṛk | |54|| yo viṣṇuḥ sa svayaṃ brahmā yo brahmāsau maheśvaraḥ | catvāro vā trayaścaite tattvaṃ tvekaṃ sanātanam || 55 || mokṣadaṃ pararūpeṇa kāryarūpeṇa bhūtidam | sattvenātmā śuddhyati śrīnārāyaṇānubhāvataḥ || 56 || śuddhyā vai mucyate jantuḥ śuddhirnāryaṇāśrayā| nārāyaṇaśca bhagavān yajñarūpī vivartate ||57|| kṛte nārāyaṇaḥ śuddhaḥ sūkṣmarūpa upāsyate | tretāyāṃ yajñarūpeṇa kathābhirdvāpare’rcanaiḥ ||58|| karmabhirbahubhiḥ kalke kalpitairapi pūjyate | ijyate ced dveṣabuddhyā caiteṣu rūpadhāriṣu |||59|| bhedabuddhyā jñāyate cenna muktistasya vai kvacit | ekaṃ jñātvā bhajed yaḥ sa muktaḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ||1.552.6 0 || bhedaṃ kṛtvā bhajeccekaṃ paraṃ naiva dviṣīta cet | pātivratyaparasyāsya muktirbhavenna saṃśayaḥ ||61 || bhedaṃ kṛtvā bhajeccaikaṃ nindedanyaṃ tu yo janaḥ | sarvaṃ naṣṭaṃ bhavettasya durgatiṃ sa samāpnuyāt |||62| idaṃ ca śṛṇu me’gastya gadataḥ prāktanaṃ yathā | sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe harerbhaktā hyabhavan sṛṣṭivāsinaḥ ||63 || sarvajñā iva te sarve dharmasthā mokṣabhāginaḥ | caturdaśastarasthā vai yaṣṭvā śrīpuruṣotamam ||64|| mokṣaṃ kramāt prayānti sma tato brahmā hariṃ prabhum | sasmāra śrīhariścāpi prādurbhūto hi sarvagaḥ ||65|| uvāca brūhi kiṃ kāryaṃ brahmovāca hari tataḥ | devadeva janaḥ sarvo muktimārge vyavasthitaḥ |||66 || kathaṃ sṛṣṭirhi bhavitā svargādiṣu ca ko vaset | nārakeṣveṣu lokeṣu keṣāṃ vāse mano bhavet ||67||| evamuktastadā śrīmannārāyaṇo jagād tam | yugāni trīṇi bahavo māmupeṣyanti bhāgataḥ ||68|| antye yuge praviralā bhaviṣyanti mahāśayāḥ | eṣa mohaṃ sṛjāmyāśu yaḥ sarvān mohayiṣyati ||69|| rudraśca bahurūpāṇi tāmasāni punaḥ punaḥ | bhairavādīni cānyāni pārvatyapi parāṇi ca ||1.552.70 || daityānāṃ nāśanārthāya ghorāṇi dhārayiṣyati | madyamāṃsādilubdhāśca mohitā vai śarīriṇaḥ ||71 || tāni cāśritya vai sattvamārgahīnā vimārgagāḥ | bhaviṣyanti tathā vedaṃ tyaktvā tāmasamohataḥ ||72|| tantrāṇi tāmasānyeva hiṃsāḍhyāni yathāruci | kariṣyanti ca tānyāśritya ye dveṣaparāstadā ||73 || bhaviṣyanti na vai teṣāṃ muktirnirayagāminām | athāha brahmaṇā proktaḥ kuru mohavacāṃsi vai ||74|| yānyāśritya janā loke janmabhāgā bhavantu hi| tasmādārabhya kālāttu mayāgastya kṛtānyapi ||779 | | tāmasāni ca tantrāṇi sakāmānāṃ priyāṇi hi | teṣu cābhirato loko bāhulyena vyavasthitaḥ ||76 | | pravahatyeva saṃsāre mṛtau janmani vai muhuḥ | kalke yuge janāḥ prāya āśrayiṣyanti mānuṣān || 77 | || matvā tān paramātmānaṃ nindiṣyanti śivādikān | tena pāpena te sarve yāsyanti nirayān dhruvān ||78 || | guravo vañcayiṣyanti svayaṃ mugdhā hi mānavān | nindārāgaiśca vidveṣairmamāhaṃkāradūṣaṇaiḥ ||79 || kāpaṭyacauryaviśvāsaghātaiḥ svārthairnirantaram | tena pāpena guravo yāsyanti nirayān bahūn ||1.552.8 0 | | śvavat mānyā bhaviṣyanti lokeṣu guravo janāḥ | yamamārgā yāmyalokāḥ kāśiṣyante ca tadbalāt ||8 1 || tasmādagastya loko’yaṃ kāmyena karmaṇā mayā | bahudhā pūritaścāste mokṣagastu kvacit kvacit ||82| | ya evaṃ vetti viprarṣe paraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | sarvātmānaṃ paraṃbrahma tathā naścāparān bahūn ||83|| mukhyato guṇataścāpi mohastasya na bādhate | paśyāgastya mayi brahāparaṃ rūpaṃ sanātanam ||84|| evamukto’gastimunirdadarśa śaṃkaraṃ yadā | tatra dadarśa vrahmāṇaṃ brahmaṇyantarnarāyaṇam | |85 | | nārāyaṇe paraṃbrahmānādinaṃ puruṣottamam | jvaladbhāsvaravarṇābhaṃ koṭikandarpasundaram | |86 | | evaṃ dṛṣṭvāgastiviprastuṣṭāva parameśvaram | bhavān viṣṇuḥ paraṃbrahma kṛṣṇanārāyāga prabho ||87| | viśapraveśane dhātustatra snupratyayādanu | viṣṇuḥ sa vyāpakaḥ sarvadevādau parameśvaraḥ ||88 | | kvacid brahmā kvacid rudro bhavāneva parātparaḥ | viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ śaṃbhurbrahmā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||89 | | ebhiśca nāmabhirbrahmaparaṃ proktaṃ sanātanam | nāsti bhedo’vatārāṇāmekasminnavatāriṇi || 1.552.90 || yo’nyathā bhāvayedetat te bodhyāḥ kalidharmiṇaḥ | te yānti narakaṃ ghoraṃ nindakāḥ pāpapūruṣāḥ ||9 1 | | etādṛśā bhaviṣyanti bhedakā hi kalau yuge| | mohakā vaṃcakā loke jñānagoṣṭhyā viḍambakāḥ || 92 | | vadiṣyanti vayaṃ sujñā jānīmaḥ paramaṃ prabhum | nānye jānanti tattattvamavatārādicintakāḥ ||93 || ityeteṣāṃ nindakānāṃ haryavatāradrohiṇām | kṣetrāṇi dharmarājasya nagaryāṃ kāritāni vai ||94|| tena bāhyavrate śubhrā hṛdi kṛṣṇā vinindakāḥ | drohiṇaścāvamantāro yāsyanti narake dhruvam || 95|| brahmaṇāhaṃ purā sṛṣṭaḥ proktaśca sṛja vai prajāḥ | avijñānasamartho’haṃ nimagnaḥ salile tadā || 96 || tatrāpaśyaṃ supuruṣaṃ divyaṃ tvaṃguṣṭhamātrakam | kiśoraṃ meghasaṃkāśaṃ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇam || 97|| tamahaṃ pṛṣṭavān kastvaṃ kathaṃ jātaḥ prakathyatām | sa māmāha tvamevāhaṃ brahmāhaṃ viṣṇurasmyaham || 98|| ahaṃ nārāyaṇo devo jalaśāyī sanātanaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhavāmi dhāmani || 99|| divyaṃ te’stu netramatra paśya māṃ yatnato hara | evamuktastadā tena yāvatpaśyāmyahaṃ ca tam || 1.552.100 || tāvat pare’kṣare divye dhāmni dṛṣṭo mayā prabhuḥ | sa eva vīkṣitaścāpi goloke’pi vikuṇṭhake || 101 || mahāviṣṇurjale dṛṣṭo virāḍrūrūpo’pi vīkṣitaḥ | tannābhau paṃkajaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ brahmā tatra vilokitaḥ || 102 || tatpārśve’haṃ mayā dṛṣṭo dṛṣṭvāhaṃ harṣamāgataḥ | tapasā tadguṇān smṛtvāstauṣaṃ śrīparameśvaram || 103 || ityevaṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāhāgastyaṃ vai tvarbudācale | tanmayā te’tra kathitaṃ lakṣmi mokṣapradaṃ vacaḥ || 1 04|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya mokṣo bhavet pare’kṣare | sakāmānāṃ gṛhalakṣmīdhanaputrādikaṃ bhavet || 105 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantānegastyasya divyatā cirajīvitvādiprāptiḥ, arbudācale rudrasya camatkāraḥ, satyetarayugīyamānavānāṃ tridevaviṣayakaparasparadrohakāriṇāṃ saṃsārapravāhasajīvanatetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvipañcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 552 ||
<1.553> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tato’gastyaṃ stutiṃ nārāyaṇasya vai | śaṃbhuścakāra ca yathā prāha cāpi vadāmi te || 1 || oṃ namo’kṣaravāsāya paradhāmni virājate | pareśāya kiśārāya mukteśāya namo’stu te || 2 || śuddhāya mūlarūpāyānantāya te namo namaḥ | sarvarūpasvarūpāya sahasrabāhave namaḥ || 3 || sahasraraśmiyuktāya vedhase śuddhakarmaṇe | viśāladehavāsāya viśvārttihāriṇe namaḥ || 4 || sahasrārkasvarūpāya śaṃbhave tai namo namaḥ | samastavidyāvāsāya cakriṇe te namo namaḥ || 5 || sadā samastagīrvāṇairnute kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ | anādine bhūpataye’cyutāya śeṣavāsine || 6 || marutāṃ pataye sarvapataye te sadā namaḥ | jaleśāya kṣitīśāya viśvanetrāya te namaḥ || 7 || śaśāṃkāya ca sūryāya viśveśvarāya te namaḥ | apratarkyasvarūpāyāmṛtarūpāya te namaḥ || 8 || digantaraprakāśāya hṛdambarāya te namaḥ | nārāyaṇāyanāyeti viśvatomukhine namaḥ || 9 || devārtihāriṇe’saṃkhyavaktrāya viṣṇave namaḥ | purāṇāya maheśāya jagatprasūyate namaḥ || 1.553.10 || koṭidehiṣu kaiścit tvaṃ sanmārgibhirupāsyase | eko bhavān prakṛteśca parādakṣarataḥ paraḥ || 11 || vidāmagresaraḥ sarvavijño viśālamūrtikaḥ | sūkṣmarūpo guṇā yatra prākṛtā na vasanti hiṃ || 12 || vācā na viṣayo yaśca bhaktavāgviṣayo’sti saḥ | na ca karmābhibhūto yaḥ karoti satataṃ sṛjim || 13 || anindriyo’pi cendrādyairupāsyaścendriyādimān | asāre’pi ca saṃsāre sārarūpo’sti vai bhavān| || 14|| yajadbhiravasīyetātādṛśo’pi caturbhujaḥ | paraṃ rūpaṃ na jānīmo jānīmo dṛṣṭigocaram || 15 || avatāratanuṃ vidmastaddvārāśrayamāpnumaḥ | abjayonistava varṣma naiva veda na cāpyaham | | 16 || vedmi viśuddhatapasā purāṇaṃ kavimīśvaram | ahaṃ padmāsanādyāśca prasūtāścāsakṛd vibhoḥ | | 17|| bālenaiva mayā cānyaiḥ sambuddhyase na kīdṛśaḥ | natyā tuṣṭiṃ pragacchāmaḥ stutyā tṛptāśca vaidikāḥ || 18 || janmāntaravivekotthatvatprasādānmatiryadi | labdhalābhā bhavettena śivaṃ syād brahmapāragam || 19 || sūkṣmaḥ sthūlo bhavam̐ścādya mama netrasya bhūrabhūḥ | dṛṣṭo’si kṛtakṛtyo’haṃ sulabho me’dya bhāgyataḥ || 1.553.20 || nato’smi daṇḍavat viṣṇo’rpito’smi pādayostava | stutiṃ juṣasva bhaktasya janārdana viśeṣataḥ ||2 1 || sṛṣṭiṃ sṛjasva vai brahmā nideśamakaronmama | dehi tadvijñatāṃ sārvabhaumīṃ sṛjāmi sevayā || 22 || hṛdistho’si namaste’stu bahiḥṣṭho’smi namāmi te | sarvagasya na cātrāsti vyavasthā matpṛthak tava || 23 || iti prakāśaṃ stavanaṃ buddhvāntaraṃ ca vācikam | bhītaṃ punīhi bhagavan tavāsmīti vibhāvaya || 24|| evaṃ stuto harirdevo rudreṇāmitatejasā | uvāca viṣṇuḥ santuṣṭo varaṃ varaya cepsitam || 25 || rudraḥ prāha sadā sṛṣṭerjñānaṃ dehi janārdana | rakṣaṇaṃ sarvathā tatra kuru me saṃhṛteḥ param || 26|| devakāryāvatāreṣu mānuṣatvamupāgatam | tvāmevārādhayiṣyāmi tvaṃ sadā me’vanaṃ kuru || 27|| śrutvā śrībhagavān prāha rudra jñānī sadā bhava | sṛṣṭivijñānamūrdhvaṃ ca sadā te’stu purātanam || 28| sarvalokeṣu pūjyatvaṃ bhava matto’pyatīva vai | ityuktvā śrīhariḥ kṛṣṇo’ntardhānaṃ prajagāma ha || 29 || ahaṃ bhajāmi taṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ parātparam | evameṣa harirdevaḥ sarvagaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ || 1.553.30 | | varado’bhūt purā mahyaṃ tenāhaṃ daivatairvaraḥ | nārāyaṇātparo devo na bhūto na bhaviṣyati || 31 || etadrahasyaṃ vedānāṃ purāṇānāṃ ca sattama | mayā te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yayā sarvamayo vibhuḥ || 3 2|| ityevaṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāhāgastyaṃ vai munipuṃgavam | agastyaśca paraṃ jñānaṃ śrutvā naijāśramaṃ yayau || 33 | | atha śaṃbhuḥ pārvatīṃ ca prāhākarṇaya bhāmini | | namuciṃ daityavaryaṃ me bhadrakarṇo gaṇo mahān || 34| | hatavānatra tatsthāne bhadrakarṇahradātmakam | tīrthe me vidyate ramyamarbudādrau sukhapradam || 35|| tathā kedārakuṇḍākhyaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ sumuktidam | ajapālo mahārājo vaidehanagare’bhavat || 36|| pūrvajanmani śūdro’sau kamalena ca śaṃkaram | yena pīt ekadā pūjayāmāsa tena puṇyena bhūpatiḥ || 37| | jāto vaidehanagare jātismaraḥ smaran janum | kedāratīrthaṃ kṛtavān samāgatyārbudācale || 38| | brahmā sarvāṇi tīrthāni nītvārbudaṃ samāyayau | tadā kedāratīrthaṃ tu rūpāntareṇa cāgatam || 3 9| | himācale prabhāse cārbude kedārakaṃ tridhā | ṛṣirmaṃkaṇako nāma sarasvatyāstaṭe sthitaḥ ||1.553.40|| tapastepe sudharmātmā raktaṃ nāsti hi varṣmaṇi | siddho’hamiti vijñāya tato nṛtyaṃ cakāra saḥ ||41 || tasyaivaṃ nṛtyatastatra nanṛtustasya nartanāt | pṛthivyādīni tattvāni sarve sthāvarajaṃgamāḥ ||42|| tato devā haraṃ prāhurnartanasyāvarodhanam | śīghraṃ kuru mahādevānyathā bhūtakṣayo bhavet ||43 || śaṃbhustatra samāgamyābravīt kiṃ nṛtyase katham | maṃkaṇakastadā prāha paśya vipra kalevare ||44|| tapasā me pittarakte naṣṭe hṛṣyāmi harṣataḥ | evamukto mahādevaḥ provāca paśya maṃkaṇa ||45 || aṃguṣṭhaṃ tāḍayāmyatra tarjanyā paśya me tapaḥ | ityuktvā tāḍitoṃ’guṣṭho niṣkrāntaṃ bhasma pāṇḍuram ||46 || tad dṛṣṭvā vismito vipro garvahīno babhūva ha | jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā tuṣṭāva tāpasaṃ haram | |47|| māmuddhara mahādeva rūpaṃ darśaya śāśvatam | atra gaṃgāsarasvatyoḥ saṃgamastīrthamuttamam ||48 || maṃkaṇakamahātīrthaṃ sthātaṃ syānnityameva ha | atra snātuḥ phalaṃ svargaṃ mokṣaścānte bhavediti | |49 || śaṃbhuḥ prāha tathāstvatra tīrthaṃ tvannāmato’stu vai | ityuktvāhaṃ tataścātrāntardhānaṃ pragato’bhavam |||1.553.5 0 || athānyattīrthavaryaṃ vai koṭīśvaraṃ tu vidyate | yatra hareṇa bahudhā rūpāṇyekakṣaṇe purā ||5 1 || yātrālubrāhmaṇānāṃ tu darśanadānahetave | dhṛtāni tanmahat tīrthaṃ pāpatāpapraṇāśanam || 52|| arbude rūpatīrthaṃ ca vartate pāvanaṃ param | purāsīt kācidābhīrī virūpā vikṛtānanā ||53 || ekadā phalamānetumāgatā girinirjhare | jale’pasṛtya patitā babhūva divyarūpiṇī ||54|| padmanetrā sukeśāntā yuvatī ṣoḍaśābdikī | tāṃ vilokya tadā devā mānavā vismayaṃ yayuḥ ||55|| kadācit tadvane tvindraḥ puṣkare prasamāgataḥ | dṛṣṭvā dyuvāsinītulyāṃ divyāṃ devīmanupamām || |56|| devo’pi mānuṣo bhūtvā tāṃ papraccha kulādi kim | svasyendratvaṃ jagādaināṃ sāpi prāha sureśvaram || 57|| māṃ naya tvaṃ sahasrākṣa surāvāsaṃ sahātmanā | indrastāṃ svavimānena nītavānamarāvatīm ||58|| nāmnā vapuriti khyātāṃ tāṃ cakāra śubhāpsarām | evaṃ prabhāvavattīrthaṃ vaputīrthaṃ hi vidyate ||59|| tatra pūrve bilaṃ cāste cāste tilakapādapaḥ | vivarānnirgataṃ vāri tilakaspṛṣṭameva tat |||1.553.6 0 || pibed vandhyā bhavet putravatī rogaśca naśyati | rūpatīrthe tapastaptaṃ purādityā ciraṃ param ||61 || indre rājyaparibhraṣṭe balau rājyeśvare sthite | tasyāṃ vai tapasā jāto viṣṇurhṛsvo’surāntakṛt |||62|| evaṃ tasyāstapaḥsthānaṃ rūpatīrthamudāhṛtam | athāmbarīṣatīrthaṃ ca vidyate tvarbudācale ||63|| bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi tapastepe’mbarīṣakaḥ | nārāyaṇaścendrarūpaṃ gṛhītvā garuḍe gaje ||64|| sthitvā samāyayau prāha varaṃ gṛhāṇa bhūpate | rājā prāha vinā viṣṇuṃ tvatto varaṃ na kāṃkṣaye ||65|| muktiṃ dātuṃ na śakto’si vraja svargaṃ yathāgatam | ityuktvā tvāntare dadhyau nārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram ||66|| tāvadindro’bhavad viṣṇurgajo’pi garuḍātmakaḥ | prāha tuṣṭo’smi te bhaktyā vadepsitaṃ varaṃ nṛpa ||67|| rājā pronmīlya netre tu yāvatpaśyati vai punaḥ | nārāyaṇaṃ prasaṃvīkṣya harṣaṃ cāpa jagād ca ||68 || saṃsāratāraṇopāya vad me parameśvara | hariḥ prāha tvayā rājan prātarnidrāṃ vihāya ca ||6 9|| kartavyaṃ mama kaiśore rūpe dhyānaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | tataḥ smaraṇaṃ raṭanaṃ nāmnāṃ prakīrtanaṃ tayā || 1.553.70 || kartavyaṃ snānakāryādau manmūrtiṃ smaratā tvayā | mama pūjā prakartavyā hṛdye pratimādiṣu || 71 || snānaṃ candanapuṣpādi vastrābhūṣaṇamityapi | bhojanaṃ jalapānādi nīrājanaṃ stavādikam ||72|| puṣpāñjalyarpaṇaṃ cāpi deyaṃ mahyaṃ visarjanam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||73 || hotavyaṃ vaiśvadevādi satāmāsye hutāśane | miṣṭaṃ sveṣṭaṃ tvayā deyaṃ gopūjādikamityapi ||74|| bhajanaṃ me sadā kāryaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca | sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ sutadāradhanādikam ||79|| ātmā samarpaṇīyaśca premṇā tanmuktisādhanam | śṛṇu nityaṃ kathāṃ me’tra spṛśa māṃ puruṣottamam || 76 || paśya me pratimāṃ divyāṃ khād rasān prasādajān | gandhaṃ gṛhāṇa mūrterme karābhyāṃ mama mardanam ||77 || padbhyāṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ māṃ ca vācā me kīrtanaṃ kuru | ānandaṃ mama mūrteśca gṛhāṇa nṛpa sarvathā || 78|| viruddhaṃ sarvadā yanme vāyumiśraṃ parityaja | prāṇe dhāraya māṃ nityaṃ manane me vidhehi yat ||79|| cintanaṃ nirṇayaṃ cāpi sanmānaṃ me sadā kuru | brahmānandaṃ brahmarasaṃ sarvaṃ kāṇḍamayaṃ kuru ||1.553.80 | | yatra yatra bhavānāste sambhūya tvekalo’pi vā | tatra tatrāsmi sustho’haṃ māṃ vilokaya sarvathā ||8 1 || sarvatra saumyabhāvaṃ tvaṃ kuru rājan mayi sthite | mukteḥ susādhanaṃ tvetatparamaṃ te mayoditam ||82|| ityukto nṛpastistena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā | tataścakāra nṛpatiḥ svasthitiṃ tanmayīṃ parām ||83|| sa nityaṃ pūjayāmāsa gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ | tataḥ kālena mahatā sa rājā harimandire ||04|| avartata supūjāyāṃ saputradārabāndhavaḥ | sarvadā bhagavām̐statrāśrame sannihito’sti vai ||85|| evaṃ prāpya parāṃ bhaktiṃ yayāvakṣaradhāma saḥ | tādṛśaṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ cāmbarīṣatapaḥsthalam ||86 || vartate cārbude ramyaṃ mokṣadaṃ pāpahārakam | yastu sampūjayed bhaktyā hṛṣīkeśaṃ tathārbude ||87|| sa yāti viṣṇusālokyaṃ prasādācchrīhareḥ priye | ambarīṣeṇa yatrāyaṃ samārādhita īśvaraḥ ||88|| hṛṣīkeśasvarūpeṇa nārāyaṇo virājate | ekādaśyāṃ hṛṣīkeśasannidhau jāgaraṃ caret ||89 || darśanaṃ tasya kuryācca kapilāphalamāpnuyāt | yastatra caturo māsān hṛṣīkeśaṃ prapūjayet ||1.553.9 0 || parabrahma paraṃdhāma gacchatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | ekaḥ sarvāṇi tīrthāni karoti bhuvaneṣu vai || 91 || paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ samaṃ tasya phalaṃ matam | eko dānāni sarvāṇi satpātrebhyaḥ prayacchati ||9 2 || paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ samaṃ tasya phalaṃ matam | ekaḥ kanyāsahasraṃ tu dadyāt tīrthe vivāhataḥ || 93 || paśyatyanyo hṛṣokeśaṃ samaṃ tasya phalaṃ matam | eko dehe hariṃ paśyet paśyedanyo’bude harim || 9 4|| cāturmāsye prabhaktaḥ san phalaṃ tasyāyutāyutam | dhenudānasahasreṇa samaṃ viṣṇorhi darśanam || 95 || agniṣṭomādiyajñaiśca samaṃ viṣṇorhi darśanam | himālaye tyajed dehaṃ brahmajñānaṃ vadet sadā || 96 || paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ samaṃ tasya phalaṃ matam | prāyopaveśakṛccaiko’paro viṣṇuṃ hi paśyati || 97|| gayāśrāddhaṃ caredanyaścāturmāsye samāhitaḥ | cāndrāyaṇena vai tulyaṃ hṛṣīkeśasya darśanam || 98|| sahasrābdaṃ tapaḥkartā mukto bhavati darśanāt | vedādhyayanataścāpi hṛṣīkeśasya darśanam ||99|| vardhate puṇyadaṃ svargapradaṃ mokṣapradāyakam | bahunā kimihoktena śṛṇu saṃkṣepataḥ priye || 1.553.100 || ekato vartate sarvamekato haridarśanam | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sthātavyaṃ harisannidhau || 101 || ekatastu hṛṣīkeśastvekataḥ karṇikeśvaraḥ | tayormadhye mṛtā yānti vaikuṇṭhe harisannidhau || 1 02|| puṣpamekaṃ hṛṣīkeśe yastvāropayate hṛdā | sarvasaubhāgyayuktaḥ syādiha loke paratra ca || 103 || tasya sthāne mārjanasya phalaṃ muktiḥ prakīrtitā | śuklapakṣe’thavā kṛṣṇe dhvajamāropayettu yaḥ || 1 04|| tasya pāpāni naśyanti yāti dhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ | pañcāmṛtena yaḥ pūjāṃ kārayed bhojayeddharim || 1 05|| bhūdānaṃ dāpayed yadvā mandiraṃ kārayet punaḥ | śāśvate samaye dhāmni sadyo muktimavāpnuyāt || 106 || ityevaṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha pārvatīṃ tvarbudācale | lakṣmi mayā tu te proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ tīrthasaṃbhavam || 1 07|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhejjanaḥ | sakāmo dhanavān putrasampadvān jāyate dhruvam || 1 08|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’rbudācale śaṃkarakṛtanārāyaṇastutiḥ, bhadrakarṇahṛdatīrthaṃ kedārakuṇḍe maṃkaṇakatīrthaṃ koṭīśvaratīrthaṃ rūpatīrtham ambarīṣatīrtham hṛṣīkeśatīrthaṃ ca sopākhyānaṃ nirūpitamitināmā tripañcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||553||
<1.554> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi haraḥ prāha pārvatīṃ tīrthamaṇḍalam | viśvāvasustapastepe siddhaḥ śivaparāyaṇaḥ || 1 || tutoṣa nṛpatestasya śaṃbhurdarśanamāyayau | varaṃ vṛṇu samuvāca siddhiṃ vavre harācca saḥ || 2 || siddheśvaraṃ ca talliṃgaṃ tīrtharūpaṃ vyajāyata | śukreśvaraṃ ca śukreṇa sthāpitaṃ tīrthamucyate || 3 || śukraḥ śrīśaṃkarāt prāptastapastaptvātra duṣkaram | vidyāṃ sañjīvanīṃ mṛtyuñjayāṃ sandhāyinīṃ tathā || 4 || tatrāsti nirjharaṇaṃ ca jalasya pāvanaṃ śubham | tatra kuṇḍe janaḥ snātvālpamṛtyubhayamutsṛjet || 5 || tato gacched vālakhilyatapaḥsthānaṃ supāvanam | tatra kuṇḍe janaḥ snātvā divyarūpadharo bhavet || 6 || kirātavanitā tatra kurūpāpi tṛṣānvitā | jalaṃ pātuṃ yayau dṛṣṭvā snānārhaṃ jalamuttamam || 7 || snātvā yāvadbahiryāti divyā devī tadābhavat | tasyāḥ patistu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā papraccha kāsi sundari || 8 || mama patnī samāyātā kuṇḍe’tra jalavāñcchayā | tvayā dṛṣṭā kṛṣṇavarṇā ced yadi vada devike || 9 || sā covāca nijaṃ kāntaṃ tavaiva dayitāsmyaham | kuṇḍasnānaprabhāveṇa jātāsmi devakanyakā || 1.554.10 || svāmistvaṃ snāhi kuṇḍe’tra devatulyo bhaviṣyasi | ityuktaḥ snānamakarot tāvannaṣṭānyaghāni vai || 11 || dehaṃ tyaktvā mṛtiṃ yāto vanitāpi pativratā | punaḥ snātvā tanuṃ tyaktvā vimānena suvarcasā || 1 2|| devakanyābhirājuṣṭā svāminā saha sundarī | namaskṛtvā śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ prayayau tridivaṃ prati || 13 || maṇikarṇābhidhā yatra kirātī mokṣaṇaṃ gatā | māṇikarṇeśvaraḥ kuṇḍaṃ liṃgaṃ tīrthaṃ hi tanmatam || 14|| vālakhilyāstatra nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti kutupe śubhe | tatra sūryagrahe snānaṃ kurukṣetrasya puṇyadam || 1 5|| snāne yatsmaraṇaṃ syāt tatprāpyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | athāparaṃ paṅgutīrthaṃ paṅguvipreṇa saṃsthitam || 16 || cyavanasyānvaye paṅgunāmā vipraḥ kadācana | śanaiḥ śanaiḥ samāyāto’rbude sārthasya yogataḥ||17|| ekaṃ nirjharamāsādya tapastepe sudāruṇam | śivabhaktiparo vāyubhakṣo homajapakriyaḥ || 18|| tasya tuṣṭo mahādevaḥ sākṣāttatra samāyayau | caitraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ varadānaṃ dadau haraḥ || 1 9|| yāhi mokṣaṃ paṅgubhāvaṃ vihāya divyadehavān | sa ca mokṣaṃ gato natvā paṅgutīrthaṃ hi tanmatam ||1.554.2 0 || yatromāsahitaḥ śaṃbhū rājate nirjharāntike | snātvā pītvā jalaṃ yāti mokṣaṃ śaṃbhoḥ prasādataḥ ||2 1 || atha citrāṃgado rājā purā pāpaparo’bhavat | mṛgayārthaṃ vanaṃ yāto’rbude hradasamīpataḥ ||22|| jalapānāya ca yātaḥ snātastatra hrade tathā | akasmātsa dhṛto rājā grāheṇa bhakṣito’pi ca ||23|| cchraṣṭapucchra yamarājaśca tān prāhārbude mattīrthake sthale |||24|| mṛto’yaṃ vai hrade puṇye nāyaṃ daṇḍārha eva yat| | yātu svargaṃ sahasrāṇi yugānāṃ tvekaviṃśatiḥ ||25|| yatra pūrvaṃ mayā taptaṃ tapastatra mṛto hyasau | tatra tīrthe janaḥ snātā svargaṃ prāpsyati niścitam |||26||| yamatīrthaṃ hi tatproktaṃ citrāṃgadavimuktidam | puṇḍrodaṃ ca tatastīrthaṃ gacchet pāpapraṇāśakam ||27|| purā puṇḍrodako nāma vipro vairāgyamāsthitaḥ | arbude nirjhare ramye martukāmaḥ samāyayau ||28|| ekasminneva kāle tu tatraiva ca sarasvatī | vīṇāvinodasaṃyuktā vivikte pathi saṃsthitā ||29|| uvāca brāhmaṇaṃ devī vada kiṃ te’sti vāñchitam | sa prāha nāsti me buddhirūpādhyāyaistiraskṛtaḥ ||1.554.30|| na me sarasvatī mātā jihvāgre vartate yataḥ | martumicchāmi cātraiva yena śreyo bhaviṣyati ||31|| mātā prāha prasādānme vāṇī te’stu sadottamā | vidyā vedādijanyāste trāsantāṃ tarkaśobhanāḥ ||32|| adyaprabhṛti vāgmī tvamatra loke bhaviṣyasi | sārasvataṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ puṇḍrodākhyaṃ bhaviṣyati |||3 3|| trayodaśyāṃ snānakartā vidvān samyag bhaviṣyati | evamuktvā tu sā devī tatraivāntaradhīyata |||34||| puṇḍrodako hi sarvajño bhūtvā tvante divaṃ yayau | tato gacchennalatīrthaṃ śrīmātā yatra rājate |||25|| nalākhye śikhare tatra bāṣkalirnāma dānavaḥ | purābhavanmahāghorastadvināśāya pārvatī ||36 || śrīmātā rūpiṇī jātā hitāya jagatāṃ satī | bāṣkaliṃ ca jīvagrāhaṃ gṛhītvā mṛtyuvarjitam ||37|| parvatasya mahacchṛṃgaṃ natvā tasyopari svayam | niviṣṭā sā jaganmātā vasatyālokarakṣiṇī ||38|| tatraiva pāduke divye tayā nyaste śubhe tataḥ | karoti taddarśanaṃ yaḥ saṃsāraṃ sa na paśyati || 39|| matpādukābharākrānto bāṣkalirdaityapuṃgavaḥ | nāsmāt sthānād bahiḥ kvāpi nirgatyordhvaṃ gamiṣyati ||1.554.40 || caitre caturdaśīrātrau pādukāpūjanaṃ mama | kartavyaṃ gahvare tatra nivatsyāmyaṇurūpiṇī ||41 || atra tīrthaṃ kariṣyanti yai te kailāsavāsinaḥ | bhaviṣyanti na sandehaścetyuktvādṛśyatāṃ gatā ||42|| tato gacchecchuṃbhanāśakarīṃ vindhyācalīṃ satīm | arbude divyarūpeṇa rājate sā śivājñayā ||43|| guhāmadhyaṃ samāsādya vivikte durgame sthale | yastāṃ paśyati bhāvena sarvamīpsitamāpnuyāt |||44|| atha pūrve tapastaptaṃ maṃkinā brāhmaṇena vai | pūrvaṃ vipro mahāmūrkhaḥ parvate mahiṣīṃ śubhām ||45|| dugdhadāṃ rakṣayāmāsa tathānyā mahiṣīḥ punaḥ | tāśca vikrīya bhūkṣetraṃ vṛṣadvayaṃ ca jagṛhe ||46|| vṛṣau kvacid dhuri nyastau tāvaduṣṭraḥ samāgataḥ | āghrāya tau dhurākāṣṭhe grīvāṃ protāṃ cakāra saḥ ||47|| athoṣṭraḥ sa bhayayukto gale prālagnagodhuraḥ | goyugena hi grīvāyāṃ lambamānena vai tadā | |48|| dudrāva tena tu vṛṣau viprāṇo vai mṛtau tataḥ | maṃkirvairāgyamāpanno nirjhare cārbudācale ||49|| samāśritya tapo ghoraṃ cakāra prajapan harim | maṃkiḥ piṇḍārakaḥ so’yaṃ ddarśa śaṃkaraṃ puraḥ |||1.554.50||| tuṣṭāva taṃ tathā muktiṃ jagāma śaṃkarecchayā | maṃkeḥ piṇḍārakasyaitat sthalaṃ piṇḍārakaṃ tataḥ | | 51 || khyātaṃ piṇḍārakaṃ tīrthe snātavyaṃ tvaṣṭamītithau | deyaṃ gomahiṣīdānaṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhet tataḥ ||52|| raktābandhaṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ gacchet tato’rbudācale | purāsīt pārthivo nāmnā indraseno mahābalaḥ ||53 || tasya patnī sunandāsīt pātivratyaparāyaṇā | rājā yayau raṇe yoddha jītvā śatrūn samāgataḥ ||54|| dūtaṃ sa preṣayāmāsa rājñīṃ prati parīkṣayā | sunandāṃ brūhi gatvā tvam indraseno hato raṇe ||55| | śrutvā karoti kāṃ ceṣṭāṃ viditvākārameva tu | maraṇāya yadi yatnaṃ kuryād rakṣyā prayatnataḥ ||56|| ityuktaḥ sa gato dūtaścovācāpi yathoditam | sunandākarṇya śīghraṃ svaprāṇān jahau niruddhya vai ||57| | hatyāpāpaṃ nṛpe lagnaṃ hāsyaparīkṣayotthitam | rājño gurutaraṃ kāyaṃ sālasyaṃ samapadyata ||58|| tejohīnaṃ vivarṇaṃ ca prasannatā vivarjitam | gṛhamāgatya rājā sa jñātvā tat paryadevayat| ||59| | strīhatyāyā vināśārthaṃ tatastīrthāya niryayau | prāptau raktānubandhākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ cārbudaparvate | |1.554.6 0| | tatra snātvā viniṣkrānto yāvannijaṃ prapaśyati | tāvanna dṛśyate chāyā yā lagnā strīvadhodbhavā ||6 1 || surūpo vīryavān jātastejovṛddhiḥ parābhavat | tatra tīrthe tapastaptvā visṛjya varṣma yogataḥ ||62|| āruhya divyayānaṃ ca kailāsaṃ prayayau drutam | prāṇināmanuraktānāṃ tāraṇaṃ prakaroti tat ||63|| tīrthaṃ raktoddhārakaṃ tannāmnā khyātaṃ tataḥ sadā | vināyakaṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ kuryād vighnapraśāntaye ||64|| tataḥ pārśveśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ gacchet pāpapraṇāśanam | devalasyābhavatpatnī pārthābhidhā pativratā ||65|| tayā taptaṃ tapastatra vandhyātvanāśahetave | sātra dadarśa śaṃbhuṃ vai putravaraṃ lalābha ca ||66|| putraśataṃ tataḥ prāptaṃ śaṃkarasya varāt tayā | yatrāsti nirmalaṃ toyaṃ girigahvaraniḥsṛtam ||67|| tīrthasyāsya vidhānena dāraputrādikaṃ labhet | māṃmuñcahradatīrthaṃ ca kartavyaṃ mokṣakāṅkṣiṇā ||68|| mudgalarṣiḥ purā tatra tapastepe’tidāruṇam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti japan sadā ||69|| arbude triṣavaṇaśca babhūva kṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ | taṃ tu netuṃ mahāsvargaṃ devadūtaḥ samāgataḥ ||1.554.70|| vimānastho muniṃ prāhāruhaitad gamyatāṃ diviṃ | indreṇa preṣitaścāsmi śīghramāgaccha mā ciram ||71 || papraccha mudgalastaṃ vai guṇān doṣān divastathā | śrutvā yāsyāmi cenmanye kṣamaṃ svargaṃ śubhaṃ mama ||72|| dūtaḥ prāha svakaiḥ puṇyaiḥ prāpyate svarjanai mune | muniḥ prāha yarthārthaṃ tatphalaṃ śrāvaya me’nuga ||73|| aśrutaistairna gaccheyamiti me hṛdi niścitam | cariṣye ca tapo bhūri pūjayiṣye narāyaṇam ||74|| dūtaḥ prāha guṇān sarvān yauvanaṃ sarvathā samam | nandanādīni ramyāṇi divyadevavanāni ca ||75|| ananyasadṛśā bhogāḥ sadā tṛptipradāḥ sukhāḥ | bubhukṣā naiva na tṛṣṇā nālasyaṃ nāpi nidrikā ||76 || devyo ramyāścaikarūpā bhogayogyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ | gāndharvā gāyanaṃ nityaṃ śrāvayanti ca vādyajam ||77|| ramayanti gṛhe rāmā gītanṛtyaprahāsanaiḥ | na ca rogāḥ śarīreṣu puṣṭistvamṛtasaṃbhavā ||78|| vīryaṃ dehe pūrṇatattvaṃ hrāso yasya na vidyate | bhojyaṃ cāmṛtamevāsti bahudhā svecchayā kṛtam ||179|| vātapittakaphādīnāṃ saṃsargo devatāsu na | durgandhādi na vidyeta rūpaṃ tvekapramāṇakam ||1.554.80|| vṛddhihrāsau tvacāṃ nāsti malaṃ cāpi na vidyate | divyadṛṣṭirdivyabhogā divyāmbarāṇi santi ca ||81 || vyomamārge gatimantaḥ surādyā viharanti hi | vimānānyapyasaṃkhyāni maṇiratnāni hīrakāḥ ||82|| divyāstejomayāḥ sarve saudhe dīpā nisargajāḥ | candrakāntisamāvyāptaṃ bhavanaṃ pratidaivatam ||83|| dāsā dāsyaḥ sahasrāṇi peyarasāśca kāmadāḥ | kāmacārāḥ kāmabhogā mānasāḥ sṛjirūpiṇaḥ ||84|| sahasrayugaparyantaṃ parāyuśca tato’dhikam | puṇyānurūpaṃ svargaṃ saṃbhujyate bhogadehinā ||85|| yāvatpuṇyakṣayastāvat paścāt pātamavāpnuyāt | evaṃ guṇāḥ pravartante nodarārthaṃ hi bhṛtyatā ||86|| nūtanaṃ puṇyakaṃ svarge jāyate na kathaṃcana | tena pāto bhavet tasmāt puṇyakṣaye divaukasām ||87|| ayameva mahān doṣaḥ patanaṃ vai bhayaṃkaram | karmabhūmiriyaṃ brahman bhogabhūmirdivaṃ matam ||88|| yadatra kriyate śreṣṭhaṃ puṇyaṃ tatropabhujyate | dānavānāṃ bale jāte kvaciddharanti dānavāḥ ||89|| gṛhaṃ dārāścopavastūnyapi sarvāṇi vai balāt | tadidaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ cāpi parabhuktāḥ striyo’pi ca ||1.554.90|| tathā koṭiguṇitān vai dṛṣṭvā puṇyaprabhāviṇaḥ | bahusmṛddhānalpapuṇyaḥ paścāttāpaṃ karotyapi ||9 1|| na ca yaiḥ sukṛtaṃ bhūri kṛtaṃ te’lpāḥ suduḥkhinaḥ | yanna martye pradattaṃ tatsvarge na prāpyate kvacit ||92|| tad duḥkhaṃ tu mahat proktaṃ mānave pūrvakarmavat | etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ guṇadoṣātmakaṃ divam ||93|| āgaccha sumune śīghraṃ yadvepsitaṃ vadātra me | śrutvā vicārya tatsarvaṃ martyavat prāha mudgalaḥ ||94|| yathā cātra tathā tatra dhanadāragṛhādikam | kleśasya bhājanaṃ cāsti patanasya bhayaṃ tathā ||95|| puṇyahāniḥ sadā tvāste vardhanaṃ na hi jāyate | tena svargeṇa me dūta naiva kāryaṃ kathañcana ||96|| vācyastvayā mamādeśād devarājaḥ sphuṭaṃ vacaḥ | kṣamyatāmaparādho me na svargīyā spṛhā mama ||97|| tatkarmāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yena syāt patanaṃ na vai | sādhayiṣyāmi tān lokān ye sadā bhayavarjitāḥ ||98|| evaṃ śrutvā mudgalaṃ taṃ sa dūtaḥ svarganispṛham | yayau śīghraṃ mahendraṃ samprāha vistārapūrvakam ||99|| śakraḥ śrutvātha taṃ prāha balādānaya taṃ munim | svargabhogārthakaṃ puṇyaṃ nābhuktvā kṣayameṣyati || 1.554.1 00|| dūtaḥ śrutvā yayau tatra yatra tiṣṭhati mudgalaḥ | vilokya mudgalaḥ śīlaṃ jalaṃ viveśa yogataḥ || 101 || dūtaḥ sa jaḍavajjāto munerdṛṣṭyā viceṣṭakaḥ | indraḥ smṛto’tha dūtena samāyātaḥ sureśvaraḥ || 1 02|| vajrahastaḥ sthito vyomni muniṃ netuṃ samīhate | stambhayāmāsa cendraṃ taṃ dṛṣṭipātena mudgalaḥ || 1 03|| tadā śakraḥ stutiṃ cakre bhagnotsāhaśca muñca mām | svarge vā yadi vā martye tiṣṭha tvaṃ muñca māṃ mune || 1 04|| mudgalaḥ prāha devendra durlabhaṃ darśanaṃ tava | yāhi svargaṃ sadūtastvaṃ sthāsyāmyatraiva cānagha || 1 05|| bhajiṣye śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ yāsye’kṣaraṃ padam | māṃ muñceti tvayā proktaṃ tīrthaṃ māṃmuñcanāmakam || 1 06|| bhavatvidaṃ sadā prakhyaṃ tava śabdena vajrabhṛt | phālgune pūrṇamāsyāṃ ye snāsyantyatra hrade janāḥ || 1 07|| tarpayiṣyanti pitṝm̐śca yāsyanti mokṣaṇaṃ hi te | śrutvaivaṃ prayayau svargaṃ dūtamādāya vajrabhṛt || 1 08|| mudgalo’pi paraṃbrahma cintayam̐statra saṃsthitaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dhvātvākṣaraṃ yayau || 1 09|| ityāha śaṃkaro lakṣmi pārvatīṃ tvarbudācale | mayā te kathitaṃ tadvai mokṣadaṃ lokapāvanam || 1.554.11 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne siddhatīrthaśukratīrthamaṇikarṇatīrthapaṃgutīrthayamatīrthapuṇḍrodatīrthaśrīmātṛvindhyācalīmaṃkipiṇḍārakaraktoddhārapārthāmudgalamāṃmuñcatīrthānāṃ sopākhyānānāṃ varṇanaṃ svargasya guṇadoṣanirūpaṇaṃ cetyādināmā catuḥpañcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||554||
<1.555> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tataḥ śaṃbhuḥ pārvatīṃ prāha cārbude | tīrthānyanyāni te vacmi pāpanāśakarāṇi hi || 1 || tatrāste caṇḍikātīrthaṃ vipraiścaṇḍī samarcitā | sthāpitā vedamantraiśca mahiṣāsuranāśinī || 2 || arbude jāhnavīkuṇḍaṃ śikhare vidyate śubham | yatra gaṃgā śaṃkareṇa labhate vatsarāntare || 3 || sahayogaṃ tu sevāyāṃ varadānena cārbude | athācaleśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ śaivaṃ tatra ca vidyate || 4 || yatra pūrve pāpacāraḥ kuṣṭhakṣāmatanurnaraḥ | bhikṣārthamāgatastatra saktūbhikṣāmavāpa saḥ || 5 || kuḍave nyasya rātrau sa suptastatra kṣaṇaṃ yadā | tāvat śvā prasamāgatya bhakṣayāmāsa saktukam || 6 || anye śvānaḥ samāgatya śunā kurvanti vigraham | unnidraḥ so’bhavacchrutvā saktūnāśaṃ dadarśa ca || 7 || tato vai kevalaṃ vāri pītvā snātvā drumāntike | suṣvāpa ca tataḥ prātaśconnidraḥ sa babhūva ha || 8 || yāvat paśyati cātmānaṃ devagandharvasannibham | jalasnānaprapānādeḥ pratāpaṃ jñātavām̐śca saḥ || 9 || atha kālāntare daivavaśāt sa nidhanaṃ gataḥ | tato jātismaro jāto vidarbhādhipatergṛhe || 1.555.1 0|| bhīmo nāma nṛpaśreṣṭho damayantīpitā hi saḥ | śune saktūpradānasya phalaṃ rājyamavāpa saḥ || 11 || gatvā tatra dadātyeva saktūn vai prativāsaram | papracchurgālavādyāstaṃ kathaṃ saktūn dadāsi vai || 12|| hastyaśvarathadānāni dīyante na kathaṃ tvayā | sa tadā kathayāmāsa prāgbhavasyādbhutaṃ phalam || 13|| saktūdānaprabhāveṇa rājyaṃ prāptaṃ yato mayā | saktavo mama vai tīrthe śvabhistatra hi bhakṣitāḥ || 14|| mayā snānaṃ tathā pītaṃ jalaṃ puṇyapradaṃ tataḥ | kṣīṇapāpo’bhavaṃ rājā karomi saktudānakam ||15|| jñātvā dānena saktūnāṃ phalaṃ me śāśvataṃ bhavet | tīrthe’tra muktisaṃyukte bhaktyā saktūn dadāmi hi || 16|| śrutvā te munayaḥ sarve vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ | sādhu sādhu paraṃ rājannityabruvan punaḥ punaḥ || 17|| etasya paṭhanādvāpi śravaṇādapi bhūpatiḥ | bhavedatra paratrāpi śāśvataṃ sukhamāpnuyāt || 18|| kulasantāraṇaṃ tīrthaṃ vartate cārbudācale | purā tvāsīt pāpakarmarataścāprastutābhidhaḥ ||1 9|| nṛpaḥ satkāraśūnyaśca jñānadānavivarjitaḥ | nyāyato’nyāyato vāpi karoti dhanasaṃgraham ||1.555.20 || tato vārdhakyamāpanno vṛddhairanyaiśca bodhitaḥ | kuru rājan dharmakāryaṃ maraṇādau śubhaṃ bhavet ||21 || rājā prāha balaṃ dharmo balena ca kṛtaṃ mayā | dhanaṃ rājyaṃ dāragṛhaṃ tathānyattvarjitaṃ bahu ||22|| nāsmāccāsti paro dharma indriyatṛptidāt paraḥ | ityuktā maunamādāya yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niketanam ||23|| athānte tasya pitaro duḥkhitā ūcureva tam | vayaṃ śuddhasamācārā dānadharmaparāḥ purā ||24|| puṇyaiḥ svargaṃ gatāścādya kuputreṇa nipātitāḥ | tvaṃ tu kuputraḥ sañjāto dharmakāryavivarjitaḥ ||25|| tataścoddhara naḥ sarvān kṛtvā kiñcicchubhārjanam | karmabhistava pāpātman vayaṃ narakamāśritāḥ ||26|| narakaṃ daśa yāsyanti bhaviṣyāśca tvayā yutāḥ | śrutvā rājā paraṃ duḥkhamavāpa prāha yoṣitam ||27|| patnī prāha tathā śrutvā pitṝnuddhara śobhanaiḥ | rājā viprān samāhūya pitṛmedhaṃ cakāra ha ||28|| tīrthayātrāṃ tathā cakre cārbude’pi samāgataḥ | kulasantāraṇaṃ prāpya snānaṃ tatra cakāra saḥ || 29|| jalāñjalīn dadau smṛtvā pitṝn pitāmahādikān | vimuktāḥ pitaro raudrānnarakātsupraharṣitāḥ ||1.555.3 0|| tato divyavimānasthā divyamālāmbarānvitāḥ | tamūcustāritāḥ sarve vayaṃ putra tvayādhunā ||3 1 || yasmāt kulaṃ tvayā putra tīrthe’smim̐stāritaṃ tataḥ | kulasantāraṇaṃ nāma tīrthametad bhaviṣyati ||32|| āgaccha tvaṃ svaputrāya vasave’rpayya bhūdhuram | divaṃ pratīti saṃśrutvāprastutaṃ svadhuraṃ sute ||33|| datvā pitṛvimānaṃ ca samāruhya gato divam | eṣaḥ prabhāvastīrthasya mayā te kathitaḥ priye ||34|| tato gacchet paraṃ tīrthaṃ parśurāmāśramātmakam | tapastaptaṃ yatra tena prāptānyastrāṇi śaṃkarāt ||35|| rāmatīrthamiti khyātaṃ pāpatāpapraṇāśanam | tatra vārihrade snātvā bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt ||36|| tato gacched brahmapadaṃ tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | purā brahmārthito viprairmokṣadaṃ dehi vastu naḥ ||37|| brahmā prāha dadāmyeva padaṃ me tasya pūjanāt | janānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ syāccaraṇāravindasevanāt ||38|| spṛśantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve devāścāpi padaṃ mama | pūjayiṣyanti saṃprāpte kārtike pūrṇimādine ||39|| toyaiḥ phalaiśca kusumairgandhabhojyānulepanaiḥ | te yāsyanti na sandeho mama lokaṃ sudurlabham ||1.555.40|| pitāmahapadaṃ cārcya bhuktimuktipradaṃ hi tat | tatra vai vartate mukhyaṃ puṣkaraṃ trividhaṃ priye ||41 || padmajasya sadābhīṣṭaṃ brahmaṇā ca purā kṛtam | vaśiṣṭhādyā ṛṣayo vai purā satraṃ samācaran ||42|| brahmā tu satyalokādvai yajñe tatra samāgataḥ | trisandhyārthaṃ pragantavyaṃ satyaloke punaḥ punaḥ ||43 || brahmaṇā munibhiścāpi vicāryaiva ca lāghavam | satyalokāt samānītaṃ puṣkaraṃ cārbudācale ||44|| yāvat satraṃ cārbude vai sandhyā teṣāṃ babhūva ha | tatrānyāni puṣkarāṇi samājagmustadā bhuvi || 45|| uttamaṃ puṣkaraṃ vyomni madhyamaṃ śikharopari | tṛtīyaṃ tu pṛthivyāṃ vai sarovaramabhūttathā ||46|| kārtike pūrṇimāyāṃ ye snānaṃ kurvanti bhāvataḥ | teṣāṃ lokāḥ śāśvatāśca svargādyā api bhogadāḥ ||47|| tatrottare ca sāvitrīkuṇḍaṃ vai pāpanāśanam | brahmaṇaḥ pratimā ramyā darśanānmokṣadāyinī ||48|| dhundhumāro’bhavat pūrvaṃ bhaktaḥ śrīśaṃkarasya ha | umāmaheśvarastena sthāpito bhavanāśanaḥ ||49|| taṃ devaṃ paripūjyaiva nimitīrthaṃ samācaret | yatra vai niminā rājñā vārdhakye cārbudācale ||1.555.50|| lomaśo’pi tadā tatra bahvarṣibhiḥ samāgataḥ | brahmayajñaḥ kṛtastatra viṣṇuyāgaśca vartitaḥ ||51 || rudrayāgaḥ kṛtaścāpi saṃhitāyāḥ kathā kṛtā | mahotsave samastāni jambūdvīpagatānyapi ||52|| tīrthāni tvāyayustatrāvabhṛthārthaṃ jalāśaye | jambūtīrthaṃ tu tajjātaṃ pratyayārthaṃ drumastathā ||53|| jambūvṛkṣo’bhavattatra divyo drāk saṃvyajāyata | tatra snānaṃ nimiścakre sarvatīrthamaye tataḥ ||54|| sadehaḥ sa gataḥ svargaṃ divyo bhūtvā suropamaḥ | etat sarvaṃ tvarbudasya māhātmyaṃ pārvati tava ||55|| samākhyātaṃ mama sthānamayaṃ puṇyapradaṃ priye | arbudastu svayaṃ tīrthaṃ tatra tīrthāni koṭiśaḥ ||56|| vasanti ca nivatsyanti guṇakarmādibhiḥ satām | pārvati te prasaṃgena śraddhayā ca mayāpi vai ||57|| kṛtāni bahutīrthāni dhanyo’haṃ vai tvayā priye | yasya patnī devaparā bhaktimatī pareśvare ||58|| dharmakārye samutsāhā saśraddhā puṇyakarmaṇi | ātithye’tiprasannā ca satsevāyāṃ śubhādarā |||59||| ātmakārye’tivegā ca jñāne premavatī sadā | yaśasyevānusandhānavatī japaparāyaṇā ||1.555.60|| tapaḥśaucādisaṃyuktā homayajñaparāyaṇā | bhartṛdevā pitṛdevā bhṛtyarakṣākarī tathā ||6 1 || gobhūbrāhmaṇasādhūnāṃ sādhvīnāṃ mānakāriṇo | sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya nārāyaṇasya kiṃkarī ||62|| kṣamayā pṛthivītulyā vairāgye vṛkṣasadṛśī | sauśīlye brahmatulyā ca sevane snehapātrikā ||6 3 || sahāye stambhavannityaṃ dāne cātmasamarpiṇī | paraloke sahāyā ca dhanyastasya gṛhāśramaḥ ||64|| sa eva sādhuratrokto yasya patnī pativratā | yasya nāsti tathā patnī na sa sādhuḥ sa pāpavān ||65|| yasya patnī kaṭu vakti krūraṃ cakṣuḥ karoti ca | karoti roṣavad vaktraṃ mānasaṃ na dadātyapi ||6 6|| dhik tasya jīvanaṃ loke nirayaścātra tasya vai | yasya gṛhe na vai puṇyaṃ nāsti sevā tu śārṅgiṇaḥ ||67|| nāsti bhojyasamutsāho nāsti vastrādi śobhanam | nāsti premamayī vāṇī nāsti snehāvalokanam ||68|| nare nāryāṃ ca vāpatye tasya janma nirarthakam | dhanyo’haṃ kṛtakṛtyo’haṃ yasyedṛśī satī priyā ||69|| tvayāsmi sarvadā dhanyo virakto raktayā saha | udvegaṃ strīkṛtaṃ labdhvā yānti tvanye vanāntaram ||1.555.70|| na teṣāṃ vanavāsena siddhirbhavati tādṛśī | yādṛśī strīprasādena gṛhasthasyāpi saṃbhavet ||7 1|| abalānāmanāthānāṃ bālānāṃ rogiṇāṃ tathā | daridrāṇāṃ kṣudhitānāṃ tṛṣitānāṃ vivastriṇām ||72|| nirāśrayāṇāṃ lokānāṃ satāṃ satīnāṃ yoginām | āśīrvādāḥ phalantyatra drutaṃ siddhipradā hi te ||73 || yatra devyo ramaṇyaśca modante gṛhamedhinām | tatra lakṣmīḥ sampadaśca svargaṃ mokṣo’sti dharmiṇām ||74|| yatra sarvavidhā śāntirnirvṛttirvidyate’niśam | tatra mokṣo bhavatyeva dhanyo’haṃ tādṛśo gṛhī ||75|| yo gṛhastho divārātraṃ dhanaṃ tvarjayati dhruvam | bhāravāhī na jānāti rakṣaṇaṃ strīkuṭumbinām ||76|| bhojanaṃ cāsanaṃ vastuyojanaṃ tūtsavādikam | dhanaṃ tasya nirarthaṃ vai niḥśvāsadagdhameva tat ||77|| yaddhanaṃ naiva devānāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ kuṭumbinām | vaṃśyānāṃ ca nijānāṃ ca bhogyaṃ tanmṛttikāsamam ||78|| yaḥ patirna prasanno’sti hāsyānano na dṛśyate | prasannaśabdaḥ premāḍhyaḥ snehanetro na dṛśyate ||79|| samānahṛdayo nāsti nāsti bhāvayutastathā | nānugrahaṃ vidhatte ca na cāvaśyakatāṃ caret ||1.555.80 || na rameta ramayedvā na ca dhyānaṃ karoti ca | na cāhvayati miṣṭena nākārayati vai hṛdā ||81 || na vā miṣṭaṃ bhojayedvā pāyayenmadhuraṃ na ca | madhu sammelayennaiva milatyeva na nirjane ||82|| na ca spṛśati saukhyārthaṃ smarennaiva śubhasthale | na pṛcched gṛhiṇībhāvaṃ mānasaṃ na ca rañjayet ||83|| kiṃ tena patinā loke vṛthā tasyā janurbhuvi | tasmād devi tvayā rakṣyo vairāgye saṃsthito’pyaham ||84|| tvayaiva mama gārhasthyaṃ prakāśameti sarvathā | tvayā pūrvaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā mama mūlyaṃ pravardhitam ||85|| tvayā dagdhvā satīdehaṃ devatvaṃ mama vardhitam | tvayā daityām̐stathā hatvā svāmiśraiṣṭhyaṃ prakāśitam ||86|| tvayā putrau gaṇaskandau dattvā me pūjyatā kṛtā | tvayaiva devi gārhasthyaṃ svarge mokṣo vane’pi me ||87|| tvayaiva devi tīrthāni kṛtānyadya mayā bhuvi | gamiṣyāmo’dhunā naijaṃ kailāsaṃ vada kiṃ param ||88|| yadyat te rocate haimi vada sampādayepsitam | ityuktvā virarāmāsau śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ||89|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi tubhyaṃ cārbudatīrthakam | pāpatāpaharaṃ mokṣakaraṃ śāntikaraṃ param ||1.555.90|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’rbudācale caṇḍikātīrthajāhnavīkuṇḍācaleśvarabhīmatīrthakulasantāraṇatīrthaparśurāmatīrthabrahmapadatīrthatripuṣkarasāvitrīkuṇḍanimitīrthānāṃ sopākhyānaṃ varṇanaṃ, śivakṛtā satīpraśaṃsā cetinirūpaṇanāmā pañcapañcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 555 ||
<1.556> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi śaṃkarādyāḥ kṛtvā tīrthāni cārbude | vyomayānairyayurvyomni paśyanto bhūtalādikān || 1 || satī ca pārvatī dṛṣṭvā suśobham ṛkṣaparvatam | papraccha śaṃkaraṃ namrā ko’yaṃ prakāśate giriḥ || 2 || śaṃbhuḥ prāha mahānāste ṛkṣākhyaḥ parvato hyayam | yatra vai ṛṣayaḥ santi tāpasā vanavāsinaḥ || 3 || oṃkārākhyo vasāmyatra tvayā sākaṃ hi ṛkṣake | śrutvaivaṃ pārvatī prāha śaṃbho’tra bhūtale punaḥ || 4 || himālayāt samārabhya samudraṃ prati parvatāḥ | kati tvadāśrayāḥ santi kati nadyaśca me vada || 5 || śaṃbhuḥ prāha śṛṇu haimi saptātra kulaparvatān | mahendro malayaḥ sahyaḥ śuktimānṛkṣaparvataḥ || 6 || vindhyaśca pāriyātraśca hyete vai kulaparvatāḥ | anye tu mandaraḥ śāraḥ kailāso dardurastathā || 7 || maināko vaidyuto vārandhamaḥ pāṇḍurakastathā | tuṃgaprasthaḥ kṛṣṇagirirjayanta ṛṣyamūkakaḥ || 8 || airāvataśca gomantaścitrakūṭaḥ śrīparvataḥ | cakorakūṭaḥ śrīśailaḥ śatruṃjitaḥ kṛtasmaraḥ || 9 || raivatādrirbaradādaḥ śālamālādayo’pi ca | vartante pāvanāstīrthabhūmayastārakāḥ śubhāḥ || 1.556.1 0|| himācalo mahānāste pitā te’yutaśṛṃgavān | tasmānnadyo nirgatā yāḥ svasārastava tāḥ śṛṇu || 11 || gaṃgā sindhuḥ śatadruśca vitastā ca sarasvatī | vipāśā candrabhāgā ca sarayūryamunā tathā || 1 2|| irāvatī devikā ca kuhūrgomatī bāhudā | dhūtapāpā dṛṣadvatī nisvīrā kauśikī tathā || 1 3|| cakṣuṣmatī gaṇḍakī ca lohitā brahmaputrakaḥ | yāḥ samudraṃ yathānimnaṃ mimīluḥ puṇyapāvanāḥ || 14|| pāriyātrodbhavāścāpi samākarṇaya śobhane | | vedasmṛtirvedavatī sindhuparṇā carmaṇvatī || 15|| candranābhā rohipārā nāśadācāranāmikā | vedatrayī vidiśā ca vapantī tāḥ samudragāḥ || 16 || nadīḥ ṛkṣaprasūtāśca śṛṇu tvaṃ pāvanīḥ śubhāḥ | śoṇo jyotīrathā cāpi narmadā surasā tathā || 17|| mandākinī daśārṇā ca tamasā pippalā tathā | citrakūṭā karatoyā citrotpallā piśācikā || 18|| viśālā vaṃjukā vāluvāhinī virajā tathā | śuktimatī paṃkinī ca rātrī tāḥ ṛkṣaputrikāḥ || 19|| vindhyapādodbhavāścāpi śṛṇu pāpavināśinīḥ | śubhā tāpī payoṣṇī ca maṇijālā kumudvatī ||1.556.20|| veṣṇā pāśā vaitaraṇī śīghrādāntyā girā tathā | durgā toyā vaidipālā vindhyaparvatajāśca tāḥ ||2 1 || sahyapādodbhavāścāpi śṛṇu nadīḥ samudragāḥ | godāvarī bhīmarathī kṛṣṇā veṇī ca vañjrulā ||22|| tuṃgabhadrā suprayogā bāhyakāverīti smṛtā | malayācalajā nadyastāmraparṇyutpalāvatī ||23|| puṣpāvatī śatamālā etāścāpi samudragāḥ | mahendratanayā nadyastriyāmā ikṣulā tathā ||24|| ṛṣikulyā trivindālā vaṃśavarā ca mūlinī | atha śuktimatī nadyaḥ palāśinī ca lūtasī || 25|| ṛṣikā mandagāmā ca samudragāstu tā api | etā mahattamā nadyastathā gomatī bhadrikā ||26 || ojasvatī svarṇarekhā nāganadī ca devikā | sābhramatī hiraṇyā ca nyaṃkumatī śatruṃjitā ||27|| manoramā candrakalā nārāyaṇī māheśvarī | etāścānyā bhavantyeva pāpaghnyo mokṣadāyikāḥ |||28|| śrutvā caivaṃ satī śaṃbhuṃ samuvāca tataḥ param | etāsu nātha kutra tvaṃ samūrto vartase vad ||29|| śaṃbhuḥ prāha ca revāyāṃ varte’haṃ liṃgamūrtikaḥ | narmadākaṃkarāḥ sarve śaṃkarā iti me sthitiḥ || 1.556.30 || pārvatī prāha me vāñchā jāyate narmadātaṭam | draṣṭuṃ darśaya revāṃ me yasmāt sā nirgatā tathā ||3 1 || yatra praviṣṭā cābdhau sā sarvāṃ darśaya me śiva | tathāstviti haraḥ prāha ṛkṣe cāvātarat tadā ||3 2|| pārvatyā sahitaḥ śaṃbhustathā svagaṇakoṭibhiḥ | revā yasmānniḥsasāra tatraivāvātatāra ha ||3 3 || ṛkṣe ca parvate sarve nyūṣu sasnurviśaśramuḥ | jalaṃ papurbhojanāni cakrustataśca pārvatī ||34|| gaṇānāṃ tu sabhāmadhye śaṃkaraṃ samapṛcchata | revodbhavaṃ mama brūhi tathā tīrthāni cāṃjasā ||35 | śaṃkarastāṃ narmadāyā āgamaṃ nijagāda ha | śṛṇu haimi purā daityo hiraṇyakaśipurmahān ||36 || devādīnardayāmāsa devā nārāyaṇaṃ yayuḥ | viṣṇuṃ vijñāpayāmāsurdaityaduḥkhaṃ sudāruṇam ||37|| viṣṇurnṛsiṃharūpeṇa hatavān dānaveśvaram | tato devairarthiteyaṃ pāvanārthaṃ harergṛhāt ||3 8|| vaikuṇṭhātpāvanī mūrtiḥ revā divyasvarūpiṇī | nārāyaṇasya bhaktā yā divyā dāsī susevikā ||3 9 || jalarūpā svayaṃ bhūtvā devaiḥ saha samāyayau | svarge sā devaloke vai tasthau ca vahuvatsarān ||1.556.40 || atha rājābhavat pṛthvyāṃ hiraṇyatejānāmataḥ | somavaṃśodbhavaḥ so’yaṃ tvekadā tapase vane ||41 || yayau tapaścacārāti brāhmaṇānāṃ samājñayā | mahādevasya tuṣṭyarthaṃ hitāya dehadhāriṇām
