||42|| narmadāyā bhuvi tvānayanārthaṃ sa janādhipaḥ | mahādevaṃ cāparokṣaṃ dadarśa nṛpatistadā ||43|| vavre varaṃ narmadāyāḥ pṛthvyāmāgamanaṃ śubham | sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ yena samuddhāro bhavediti ||44|| śaṃbhuḥ prāha tathāstvetat tvayā samyag vicāritam | sasmāra narmadāṃ sāpi śaṃkarāgre hyupasthitā ||45|| śaṃbhuḥ prāha bhuvaṃ yāhi reve mokṣasya hetave | janakalyāṇadā tatra bhava pāpapraṇāśinī ||46|| revā prāha nirādhārā kutra tiṣṭhāmi śaṃkara | śaṃbhuḥ prāha nagaścāste tūdayācalanāmakaḥ ||47|| sa tvāṃ dhārayituṃ śaktastacchṛṃge’vatara priye | tataḥ sā narmadā svargādavātatāra vai śanaiḥ ||48|| hiraṇyatejāstasyāstu salilaiḥ samatarpayat | pitṝn pitāmahādīṃśca tilodakāni vai dadau ||49|| uddhṛtāḥ pitaraḥ sarve yayuḥ svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam | so’yaṃ nārmadavārbhiśca pavitro’sti pade pade ||1.556.50|| narmadā varṇyate seyaṃ saptakalpānugāminī | te deśāḥ parvatāḥ puṇyāste grāmāste’pi cāśramāḥ ||5 1|| yatra yātrā saricchreṣṭhā narmadā saptakalpagā | tribhiḥ sārasvataṃ puṇyaṃ saptāhena tu yāmunam ||52|| sadyaḥ punāti gāṃgeyaṃ darśanādeva narmadā | revātaṭeṣu ye vṛkṣāḥ patitāḥ kālaparyaye ||53|| narmadātoyasaṃspṛṣṭāste yānti paramāṃ gatim | revāyā yatra kutrāpi saṃgame ca taṭe’pi vā ||54||| snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛpūjūnam | devabhaktirmahādīkṣā nyāso dehavisarjanam ||55|| yatkiñcit syānmanuṣyāṇāmanantaphaladaṃ bhavet | nārmade mūlatīrthe tad vājimedhaphalapradam ||56|| kulānāṃ śatamāgāmi samatītaṃ tathā śatam | uddharedātmanā sārdhaṃ revātīrthāvagāhanāt ||57|| bhūdānasya pradātrātra rājyaprāptiṃ labhed dhruvam | narmadātoyapānasya snānasya prekṣaṇasya ca ||58|| api cāndrāyaṇaśatādadhikaṃ phalamasti vai | prātaryo narmadāṃ puṇyāṃ smarenmokṣaṃ labhettu saḥ ||59|| udayādristhitāṃ tāṃ cānināya bhūtale punaḥ | purūravākhyarājarṣiḥ somavaṃśe babhūva yaḥ ||1.556.6 0|| candrapurīmahārājyaṃ sārvabhaumaṃ cakāra saḥ | nirābādhāḥ prajāstasya bhavaddāridryavarjitāḥ ||61 || cirāyuṣo janāścāsan kāmadughāśca dhenavaḥ | kauśeyapaṭṭavastrāśca narā nāryo vibhūṣitāḥ ||62|| vṛkṣe vṛkṣe rasadhārā dharaṇiḥ sasyaśālinī | evaṃ rājñā kṛte rājye sarvaṃ siddhimayaṃ hyabhūt ||63|| tena sūryagrahe hastivājigobhavanāni ca | svarṇarūpyakaratnāni dāne dattāni bhūriśaḥ ||64|| atarpayat pitṝm̐ścāpi havyakavyena bhūpatiḥ | tadāścaryamabhūd rājño pitṝṇāṃ darśane śṛṇu ||65|| atikaṣṭena pitaro jalaṃ pibanti vīkṣitam | kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhatālvoṣṭhān kaśmalām̐śca mṛdaṃbhasā ||66|| nagnān malinavastrām̐śca śataśo’tha sahasraśaḥ | dṛṣṭvā purūravā rājā natvā pitṝnuvāca ha ||67|| ke yūyaṃ vikṛtākārāḥ pretabhūtā bubhukṣitāḥ | kathayadhvaṃ yathā mokṣo bhavetpretasvarūpataḥ ||68|| pitarastu nṛpaṃ prāhurvayaṃ vai tava pūrvajāḥ | sadiddhīnamidaṃ kṣetraṃ dharmakarmavivarjitam ||69|| na vai tīrthaṃ vinā muktistīrthaṃ cānaya bhūmiṣu | ityuktvā te yayuryāmyāṃ diśaṃ rājāpi tatkṣaṇāt ||1.556.70|| putre rājyadhuraṃ nyasya yayāvudayaparvatam | kandamūlaphalāhāraḥ śivapūjāparāyaṇaḥ ||71 || bhaktiṃ cakāra paramāṃ tayā tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ | pratyakṣo’bhūduvācainaṃ bhūpaṃ varaṃ vṛṇu nṛpa ||72|| rājā vavre saptakalpavahāṃ śrīnarmadāṃ nadīm | pitṝṇāṃ tāraṇārthaṃ vai bhūmiṣu tvavatāraya ||73|| śaṃbhunā bhaktatuṣṭyarthamāhūtā narmadā nadī | makarāsanamārūḍhā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā ||74|| projjvalā yuvatī kanyā nārāyaṇāṃgasaṃbhavā | sarvasaubhāgyasampannā kṛṣṇakuntalaśobhanā ||75|| āgatya śaṃkaraṃ natvovāca kathaṃ nu saṃsmṛtā | śivaḥ prāha tvadarthaṃ vai caturdaśasahasrakam ||76 || varṣāṇāṃ nṛpatistepe hiraṇyataijaso nṛpaḥ | bhāvāt pitṛpramokṣārtham ṛkṣādrau tvaṃ prayāhi vai ||77|| pretarūpān sarvapitṝn narakasthān samuddhara | ityuktvā vyomamārgeṇa revā ṛkṣādrimāyayau ||78|| śaṃbhustasyai dadāvagryaṃ sudṛḍhamṛkṣaparvatam | gaganāt pracyutā revā papāta parvatopari ||79|| purūravāḥ sa rājarṣirnarmadāṃ tvidamabravīt | anugrahaḥ kṛto devi pitṝṇāṃ tāraṇāya me ||1.256.80|| rājñā tatastatra nadyāṃ snātvā surāḥ sutarpitāḥ | pitarastarpitāścāpi piṇḍādyaistoṣitāstathā ||81 || narakāduddhṛtāḥ sarve devayānapathe sthitāḥ | kṛmikīṭapataṃgādyāḥ pakṣiṇaścāṇḍajāśca ye |||82|| eṣo’vatāraśca puna ādikalpe kṛte yuge | evaṃ sā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavāmāṃgajā satī ||83|| kanyā śrīnarmadādevī devaiḥ svargaṃ samāhṛtā | svargādudayaśikharaṃ nītā hiraṇyatejasā ||84|| udayādreḥ ṛkṣaśailaṃ purūravā nināya ca | tato bhūbhāgamāpannā pāvanī cābdhigābhavat ||85|| snānāvagāhanātpānātsmaraṇātkīrtanādapi | anekabhavajaṃ ghoramaghaṃ sarvaṃ vinaśyati ||86|| atha prāpte prathame ca kalau nadyaśca sarvaśaḥ | pañcasāhasrasaurānte yayuḥ svargaṃ tadā punaḥ ||87|| prāpte kṛte’bhavad rājā purukutsaḥ pratāpavān | tapastepe narmadāyā avatārāya vai punaḥ ||88|| mayā tuṣṭena tasmai ca varo’rpitastatastu sā | smṛtā revā samāyātā mamājñayā bhuvaṃ prati ||89|| paryaṃkaparvate ramye veṇustambe hyavātarat | paryaṃkānniḥsṛtā vegād vāruṇīṃ diśamabdhigā ||1.556.90|| purukutsaṃ patiṃ kṛtvā śāpāt samudratāṃ gatā | vartate pāvanī loke svargasopānapaddhatiḥ ||91 || ye’pyadharmaratā loke narmadāyāṃ mṛtā yadi | te’pi rudratvamāyānti revātoyaprasaṃgataḥ ||92|| tatra vaiṇyeśvaraṃ devaṃ veṇumūle vyavasthitam | ādyaṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ taddhi pāpatāpapraṇāśanam ||93|| revodgamottare bhāge’nantapuraṃ supattanam | ṛṣyāśramātmakaṃ tvāste divyaṃ muktipradaṃ sadā ||94|| vyāsāśramaṃ purā tatra sadāsītpāvanaṃ param | śaivakṣetraṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ vidyate śāśvataṃ śubham ||95|| utpalāvarttanāmā ca mādhavo yatra tiṣṭhati | sahasramastako viṣṇurvartate pāvane sthale ||96|| krośamātraṃ harikṣetraṃ narmadāyāṃ prakathyate | revāyā uttare kūle kapilātīrthamuttamam ||97|| tripurītīrthamatrāsti śaṃkarastatsvarūpadhṛk | krośadvayapramāṇaṃ tad vidyate svargadaṃ śubham ||98|| tripuraṃ vinihatyaiva viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ haraḥ | tīrthaṃ tatpāvanaṃ svargamokṣadaṃ snānamātrataḥ ||99|| ityevaṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha pārvatīṃ narmadāsakhīm | mayoktaṃ tu purā vṛttaṃ lakṣmi te manasepsitam || 1.556.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne narmadāyā brahmalokādudayācalāgamastataḥ ṛkṣādryāgamastato bhūtalāvatarastato veṇutīrthānantapuratīrthādītihāseṣu purūravaso nṛpasya revāvatāreṇa pitruddhārādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭapaṃcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ |||556||
<1.557> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tataḥ śaṃbhuḥ pārvatīṃ prāha pāvanam | ākhyānaṃ tat kathayāmi tvādikalpe kṛte yuge || 1 || manurnāmābhavadrājā sūryavaṃśo mahābalī | sāketā tasya nagarī pradhānāsīttadā bhuvi || 2 || avadhyā dānavaistasmādavadhyā nāmato’bhavat | saptaprākārarakṣāḍhyā parikhāsaptavartulā || 3 || daśayojanavistīrṇā sarayūmanusaṃsthitā | navakhaṇḍāṃ medinīṃ sa śaśāsaikapriyāvrataḥ || 4 || ekadā sa mahārājo vasiṣṭhaṃ pratyabhāṣata | yajño mayā prakartavyo dūraṃ cāraṇyakasthale || 5 || pāvanaṃ tādṛśaṃ sthānaṃ pradarśaya yathāruci | vasiṣṭhaścāpi tacchrutvā gṛhītvā viprasammatim || 6 || ṛkṣe vai parvate’raṇye yato revā pravartate | tatra yajñaṃ kuru rājannityājñāṃ pradadau purā || 7 || hayamedhaṃ mahāyajñaṃ gatvā tatra cakāra saḥ | bhūgosuvarṇaratnāni yajñe dadau sa bhūpatiḥ || 8 || daśayojanaparyantaṃ yajñakāryārthamaṇḍapam | akārayacca revāyāstīre yajñaparo nṛpaḥ || 9 || āhūya devatāḥ sarvā devendram pākaśāsanam | atarpayat tvarghapādyairmadhuparkaiśca viṣṭaraiḥ || 1.557.1 0|| atarpayad bhūmidevān sādhūṃśca bhojanādibhiḥ | hārakeyūrakaṭakaiḥ kaṇṭhābharaṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 1 1|| bhojanānāṃ praśālāsu paṃktiṣvapi samāgatāḥ | vayāṃsi pakṣiṇaścānye kīṭā vā vanacāriṇaḥ || 12|| yajñocchiṣṭeṣu lulitā jātāḥ sarve hiraṇmayāḥ | evaṃ nivartito yajño narmadāyāstaṭe mahān || 1 3|| avabhṛthe stutā revā rājñā toṣaṃ gatā nadī | svargasopānabhūtāsi pitṝṇāṃ mokṣakāriṇī || 14|| pāpahā sarvalokānāṃ mātā cātigarīyasī | divaṃ naya mahāsādhvi pāpatāpapraṇāśini || 15|| stotraṃ śrutvā mahābhāgā manornṛpasya sā tataḥ | pratyuvāca nṛpaṃ tuṣṭā makarāsanasaṃsthitā || 16|| sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyā candrakāntinibhānanā | kanyārūpā hāsyayuktā varaṃ vṛṇu hṛdīpsitam || 17|| rājā prāha sadā loke tīrtharūpāsi tāriṇī | tārayātra śubhe tīrthe yajñabhūmau sadā sati || 18|| mama rājye tathā nadyo vasantu bhavatārikāḥ | yugāni śāśvatānīha prajākalyāṇahetave || 19|| āgaccha ca mayā sākaṃ rūpāntareṇa narmade | sāketāyāṃ nagaryāṃ me sarayvā saha saṃvasa ||1.557.20|| tathāstvityāha taṃ revā yayau rūpāntareṇa sā | sāketāyāṃ nagaryāṃ ca revākuṇḍe’vasattataḥ ||2 1 || yajñabhūmau mahattīrthaṃ yajñasthānaṃ tu ṛkṣake | snānāt tatra divaṃ yānti dehinaḥ puṇyaśālinaḥ ||22|| athāste bhagavān viṣṇurbrahmakuṇḍaṃ supāvanam | revā cottaravāhātra snātvā mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||23|| haṃsatīrthaṃ tataścāste haṃsā yatra divaṃ gatā | tataścāgre siddhatīrthaṃ siddhā vasanti tāpasāḥ ||24|| tato gaṃgāyamunāsaṃgamo revājale śubhaḥ | mataṃgarṣiḥ purā gaṃgāṃ yamunāṃ ca samāhvayat ||25|| ṛṣīṇāṃ mahīmānānāṃ snānārthaṃ prātareva ha | mūrtā gaṃgā yamunā ca samāyayau jale tadā ||26 || jalarūpābhavat tīrthaṃ trisaṃgamātmakaṃ śubham | atha ramyaṃ yogatīrthaṃ tathā ṛkṣeśvaraṃ param ||27|| tīrthamāpsarasaṃ nāma vartate śāpavārakam | purā tvindrasabhāyāṃ cāpsaraso nṛtyamācaran ||28|| kāmaḥ svayaṃ paraṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvā tatra samāyayau | nartakyastaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā mumuhurvismayānvitāḥ ||29|| tālagītisvaranyāsanṛtyakramān visasmaruḥ | tadā tvindraścukopāti nartakīstāḥ śaśāpa ha ||1.557.3 0 || campake sīmapanāme keśini cāpi bhāmini | kaumudi suprabhe tathotpale mahodaye’sime ||3 1 || lokapālā virājante sabhāyāmatra ceśvarāḥ | yathāṃgaṃ nartanaṃ prāptaṃ vikramaṃ ca pramādataḥ ||32|| tato niṣādayoniṃ saṃyāntu tacchikṣaṇaṃ hyalam | narmadāyāṃ tataḥ snātvā kuṃbhayoge punaḥ punaḥ ||3 3|| māghe māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ nirāhārāśca nirjalāḥ | gaurīṃ śaṃbhuṃ tvarcayitvā divaṃ punaravāpsyatha ||34|| ityuktāstā niṣādyaśca tathā bhūtvā tu nārmade | jale snātvā yayurmuktiṃ tīrthaṃ cāpsarasaṃ hi tat ||35|| atha tīrtha paraṃ dattātreyānadī ca revayā | saṃgatā tatra saṃsnātvā pūjayitvā ca keśavam ||36|| nirdhūya sarvapāpāni yātyante śrīhareḥ padam | tato gāṃjālabhedākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ kāryaṃ pramokṣadam || 37|| somavaṃśe nṛpaścāsīd devānīka itiprathaḥ | tadātmajaścakravartī harikeśaḥ sa nāmataḥ ||38|| kanyāpure’bhavat tasya rājadhānī parātparā | tuṃgabhadrātaṭe tena makhāśca bahavaḥ kṛtāḥ ||39|| harikeśo dadau dānaṃ dogdhrīṇāmekalakṣakam | sūryagrahe ca niṣkāṇāṃ sahasraṃ pratibhūsuram ||1.557.40|| dadāvatha punarvedavidyāyāṃ vijayāya vai | brāhmaṇānāṃ sabhā tatra cakāra mahatīṃ punaḥ ||41 || yo vai tatra vijayeta tasmai gaurekavatsikā | dogdhrī suvarṇabhūṣāḍhyā hīrakasraksuśobhitā ||42|| dātavyeti viniścitya praśnaṃ rājā cakāra ha | atra rāhusūryayoge snāne prayāgajaṃ phalam ||43|| snānaṃ prārabdhajaṃ kiṃ vā vinā prārabdhamīyate | sumukhyaṃ kāraṇaṃ kinnu kiṃ bhavedvā prayojakam ||44|| prayāgabhūmirnātrāsti saṃyogo nāsti tadbhuvaḥ | kathaṃ tajjaṃ phalaṃ syācca hetuṃ vinā na janyatā ||45|| iti praśne kṛte rājñi paṇḍitāḥ ṛṣayastadā | kecidāhustvarthavādaṃ tadā prāśastyabodhakam ||46|| anye prāhurvinā bhūmiṃ prayāgasya na tatphalam | apare ca tadā prāhuḥ prayāgasadṛśaṃ phalam ||47|| snānaṃ prayāgasnānena sadṛśaṃ jagaduḥ pare | snānaṃ prārabdhajaṃ cānye pare prārabdhamantarā ||48|| prayatnena bhavatyeva snānaṃ puṇyaṃ vināpi ca | mukhyaṃ tu kāraṇaṃ tatra mumukṣā vā bubhukṣatā ||49|| icchāsti kāraṇaṃ mukhyaṃ yā kācidvā bhaveddhi sā | sārthavāhastadecchāyā uttejako bhavatyapi ||1.557.50|| prayojikā tu jijñāsā śāstrajanyā punaḥ punaḥ | śāstrayoge kāraṇaṃ tu kṛpā guroḥ sadā matā ||51 || evaṃvidhā bhaveyuśca hetavo bhinnarūpiṇaḥ | evaṃ vādaḥ pravṛttaśca naikenāpi nirūpitam ||52|| mukhyaṃ tu kāraṇaṃ tatra puṇyadaṃ yad hṛdi sthitam | parabrahma svayaṃ dātṛ phalasyaiveti vismṛtam ||53|| tena kaiścinna vijitā dhenuḥ svarṇamayī tadā | vivāde vijayārthaṃ ca pravṛtte’pi na nirṇayaḥ |||54||| brāhmaṇānāṃ vivāde ca tatrāsīdekabhūsuraḥ | nāmnā raudrāyaṇo’tharvamantravid vādakārakaḥ ||55|| vivāde jāyamāne’pi vijayaṃ naiva labdhavān | ruṣṭaḥ sa cānale rājñā kārayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ||56|| homaṃ raudrairmahāmantraiḥ sutejasairajānatā | rājñā kṛtena homena yugāntāgnisamaprabhaḥ ||57|| tatkuṇḍādutthito vahnirjvālāmālābhayaṃkaraḥ | dagdho hi maṇḍapastena maṇḍapasthāśca pūruṣāḥ ||58|| bhasmībhūtaṃ tathā cānyat sāmagryupasuvastukam | rājā prāhātra hatyānāṃ dagdhānāṃ niṣkṛtistu me ||59|| yathā bhavettathā viprā dīyatāṃ tvācarāmi tām | brāhmaṇāśca tadā prāhuḥ kalpagrāmaṃ prayāhi vai ||1.557.60|| bhṛgvādyāḥ ṛṣayastatra praṣṭavyā niṣkṛtau tvayā | evamukto yayau rājā pādacārī sukalpakam ||61 || maharṣīn sa praṇamyaiva sambhāṣāṃ pracakāra ha | tato nivedayāmāsa kratau hatyāghamulbaṇam ||62|| śrutvā tam ṛṣayaḥ prāhurgāyatrīdaśalakṣakam | tīrthe tīrthe japa rājan yāhyaṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrthakam ||63|| gohiraṇyapradānaṃ ca kuru homāyutaṃ tathā | dehi sadbhyaśca viprebhyaḥ sahasraśatadakṣiṇam ||64|| evaṃ pāpasya muktiḥ syāt kuru tīrthāni bhāvataḥ | ye mṛtā vahnidagdhāśca teṣāmasthipravāhaṇam ||65|| narmadāyāṃ kuru rājam̐stena muktirbhaviṣyati | narmadodakasamparkād divi devatvamāpyate ||66|| tilodakapradānena teṣāṃ muktirbhaved dhruvam | narmadāyāstaṭe ramye śubhaṃ yajñaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ||67|| samācara punaryatra mokṣaṇaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati | ityuktaḥ sa tu rājarṣiḥ punaḥ śrīnarmadāṃ prati ||68|| yayau yajñaṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca cakre tatra taṭe śubhe | pravāho nirgatastatra narmadāyāṃ samāviśat ||69|| sa gāñjāletivikhyāto narmadāsaṃgamo’bhavat | harikeśena pitaro mṛtā dagdhāśca ye kṛtau ||1.557.70|| sarve te tāritāstatra tṛptāḥ procurnṛpaṃ tataḥ | tvatprasādānmahābhāga vayaṃ devatvamāgatāḥ ||71|| divyayānasamārūḍhā yāsyāmo vaiṣṇavaṃ padam | harikeśo nṛpaḥ śrutvā parayā ca mudā yutaḥ ||72|| saptakalpasthirāṃ revāṃ natvā cakre stutiṃ tataḥ | namastestu saricchreṣṭhe saptakalpanivāsini ||73|| snātvā tvayi janaḥ kvāpi sarvatra muktimṛcchati | tvatprasādānmahādevi muktirjātā bhavārṇavāt ||74|| pitṝṇāṃ vahnidagdhānāṃ jaya devi dayāvati | narmadā tadvacaḥ śrutvā mūrtā kanyā babhūva sā ||75|| varaṃ vṛṇu nṛpaṃ prāha rājā vavre varaṃ tadā | yadi me varadā sādhvi pūtaṃ māṃ kuru pāvani ||76|| snānāvagāhanātpānātsmaraṇātkīrtanādapi | saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sadya eva vinaśyatu ||77|| revovāca tathāstveva tataścāntaradhīyata | harikeśaścakravartī natvā punaśca tāṃ diśam ||78|| kāmikaṃ yānamāruhya yayau sāketapattanam | tattīrthaṃ nārmadaṃ hatyānāśakṛnmokṣadaṃ śubham ||79|| harikeśaṃ ca gāñjālaṃ hatyāpāpavināśanam | dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham ||1.557.80|| atha yāmyāṃ diśi nāmnā tīrthaṃ vālukaśāṃkaram | yatra kanyānarmadāsaṃgamo jāto hi mokṣadaḥ ||81 || tataścāgre samākhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ pūrṇamanoratham | harivarmā purā cāsīd virāṭanagarādhipaḥ ||82|| kṛtastena kratustatra golakṣaṃ tatra saṃdadau | devāḥ sutarpitāstatra viprāḥ santaśca pūjitāḥ ||83|| athānyadapi sattīrthaṃ revāmatsyāsamāgamaḥ | yatrāpo nirmalāḥ pānāt snānānmuktipradāḥ sadā ||84|| revāyā uttare kūle kapilāsaṃgamātparam | narmadāpuramatrāste yatra viprāstu tāpasāḥ ||85|| koṭiśo vai virājante jamadagnyāśramāntike | jamadagnirmahograṃ ca tapaścacāra śāṃkaram ||86 || sākṣādabhūcchivastasya varaṃ vṛṇu jagāda tam | ṛṣirvavre kāmadhenuṃ golokāt sā samāyayau ||87|| dharmakarmaśubhārthe ca śivapūjāsutarpaṇe | pitṛkārye devakārye gāvaḥ puṇyatamāḥ sadā ||88|| kāmadhenoḥ sakāśācca jamadagniravāpa ha | sarvān kāmān dharmarūpānsampatpradān divaḥpradān ||89|| ṛṣīṇāṃ ca sahasrāṇi nityaṃ bhojayate dvijaḥ | jamadagnermahākīrtiḥ pṛthvyāṃ vyāptā gavā tadā ||1.557.90|| vipracittyākhyadaityasya kanyā māhiṣmatī tu yā | tasyā nāmnā sa nagarīṃ māhiṣmatīṃ vinirmame ||91 || yatsannidhau mahāraṇye jamadagnirnyuvāsa ha | yayau sakhībhirvyomnā sā vīkṣituṃ mandarācalam ||92|| tapantaṃ cāsvarasaṃjñaṃ tatra dadarśa tāpasam | dṛṣṭvāśramapadaṃ ramyaṃ cintayāmāsa bhāminī ||93|| bhīṣayitvāhamenaṃ tu tiṣṭhāmyatrāśrame svayam | kāmarūpadharā sāpi bhūtvāraṇyanivāsinām ||94|| ṛṣīṇāṃ sannidhau yātā mahiṣīrūpadhāriṇī | ṛṣibhiḥ khalu śaptā sā mahiṣyastu śataṃ samāḥ ||95|| mahiṣaṃ putramāsādya tataḥ svasthā bhaviṣyasi | evaṃ śaptā yayau sā tu narmadātīrthamuttamam ||96|| yatra tepe tapo ghoraṃ sindhudvīpo mahātapāḥ | sindhudvīpasya vai vīryaṃ pracaskanda śilātale ||97|| jalānvitaṃ sugandhaṃ tat papau sā mahiṣī tadā | tataḥ sā suṣuve vipravīryajanyaṃ sutaṃ dṛḍham ||98|| mahiṣākhyāsuraṃ krūraṃ yaṃ jaghāna hi śāṃkarī | nārāyaṇī mahāśaktistato māhiṣmatī nijām ||99|| māhiṣmatīṃ purīṃ gatvā jamadagnyāśramāntike | kālena sā mṛtā prāptā svargamṛṣeḥ pratāpataḥ || 1.557.100 || tīrthaṃ tajjāmadagnyaṃ vai māhiṣmataṃ suśobhanam | viśokairaṇḍikā caiva tṛtīyā pāvanī matā || 101 || caturthī narmadā tāsāṃ saṃgame kapilā śilā | tīrthaṃ puṇyatamaṃ tvāste yatra piṇḍapradānataḥ || 102 || pitaro mokṣaṇaṃ yānti parśurāmeṇa tāritāḥ | etatte kathitaṃ lakṣmi purā satyai śivoditam || 103 || śravaṇātkīrtanāccāsya divi devatvamāpyate | bhuktirmuktirlabhyate’pi jāmadagnyāśrame śubhe || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ṛkṣaparvate manukṛtayajñatīrthaṃ viṣṇubrahmakuṇḍahaṃsatīrthaṃ trisaṃgamayogatīrthaṃ āpsarasatīrthaṃ dattātreyāsaṃgamaḥ gāṃjālabhedatīrthaṃ vālukaṃ pūrṇamanorathatīrthaṃ kanyānarmadāsaṃgamaḥ matsyāsaṃgamonarmadāpuraṃ jāmadagnyatīrthamityādīni sabījāni nirūpitānītināmā saptapañcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 557 ||
<1.558> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi mahādevena bhāṣitam | pārvatyai nārmadaṃ cānyat tīrthaṃ tat kathayāmi te || 1 || matsyāyāśca tathā tāpyāḥ saṃgamo mokṣadāyakaḥ | kalahaṃsābhidhaḥ pūrvaṃ devarṣirdhyānatatparaḥ || 2 || tatra kṛtvāśramaṃ ramyaṃ tapastepe sudāruṇam | śākamūlaphalāhāro hyatiṣṭhattvekapādataḥ || 3 || śivadhyānaparasyāsya tapasā devarāṭ svayam | bhīto brāhmaṇarūpeṇa vañcayituṃ samāyayau || 4 || uvāca kalahaṃsa tvaṃ kimarthaṃ kuruṣe tapaḥ | ṛṣiḥ prāha kathaṃ cendra māṃ viḍambayase dvijam || 5 || jānāmi tvāṃ turāṣāḍhaṃ nendrarājyaṃ prakāmaye | ārādhayāmyahaṃ śaṃbhuṃ kuru rājyaṃ yathepsitam || 6 || indraḥ prāha varaṃ vipra vṛṇu drakṣyasi śaṃkaram | kalahaṃsastadovāca nānyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇomyaham || 7 || śaṃbhau bhaktiḥ sadā me syāditi śakto’si dehi cet | tathāstviti sureśaśca yayāvuktvā triviṣṭapam || 8 || śaṃkarastu drutaṃ tatra sākṣāt hasan samāyayau | kalahaṃso namaścakre stotuṃ samupacakrame || 9 || namo bhaktakṛpāyukta mahādeva namo’stu te | namaḥ śivāya bhaktānāmiṣṭapradāya te namaḥ || 1.558.10 || bhavasāgaramagnānāmuddhārakāya te namaḥ | parabrahmasvarūpāya vaiṣṇavāgryāya te namaḥ || 11 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakāya te namaḥ | pārvatīpataye prabhāsvāmidevāya te namaḥ || 12| nārāyaṇīśarūpāya jayādhyakṣāya te namaḥ | sarvabījasvarūpāya kāraṇāya namo namaḥ || 1 3|| śaṃbhuḥ stotraṃ śubhaṃ śrūtvā varaṃ vṛṇu jagāda tam | kalahaṃseśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ vavre ca ṛṣisattamaḥ || 14|| tatra prāṇairviyuktānāṃ mokṣaṃ vavre śubhaṃ varam | śaṃbhuḥ prāha tathaivāstu cānte muktistavāstu ca || 15|| antardhānaṃ yayāvuktvā kalahaṃso’pi sarvathā | bhajitvā nārmadaṃ tīrthaṃ cānte brahmapadaṃ yayau || 16|| matsyātāpīsaṃgame tatkalahaṃsaṃ sutīrthakam | pāpaghnaṃ svargadaṃ mokṣapradaṃ vartata aiśvaram || 17|| anyat tīrtha bṛhatyāśca narmadāyāśca saṃgamaḥ | vindhyaparvataśobhāḍhyaṃ vidyate tāpasāśritam ||18|| raktadharmābhidhaḥ kaścinniṣādastatra cāyayau | bharaṇāyātmavargasya vanyakandaphalādibhiḥ || 19|| prātaḥ sa revāsalilaṃ śivāya vai samāharat | ajñānabhaktigarbhastu snāpayitvā phalaṃ dadau ||1.558.20|| athottarāyaṇe prāpte pupūja kusumaiḥ sadā | bilvādi cārpayāmāsa śaṃkarāya sa bhāvataḥ || 21 || niṣādaḥ sa dadarśaikasmin dine śaṃkaraṃ gṛhe | tṛtīyamīkṣaṇaṃ tatra mūrternaiva sa paśyati ||22|| tadā tu cintayāmāsa kenāpyapahṛtaṃ hi tat | vicārya vāmanetraṃ svaṃ tīkṣṇabāṇena tatkṣaṇam ||23|| lalāṭe devadevasya samutkṛtya nyavedayat | na kampo na ca kārpaṇyaṃ na viṣādo na devanam ||24|| tena tuṣṭo mahādevo niṣādaṃ prāha saṃhasan | varaṃ vṛṇu mahābhakta yadiṣṭaṃ manasepsitam ||25|| niṣādo vacanaṃ śrutvā sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatya ca | varaṃ vavre niṣādāstu sarve pakṣigaṇaiḥ saha ||26|| saputradārapaśavo ye cānye pāpadehinaḥ | tvatprasādādvaradānānmuktilokaṃ prayāntu te ||27|| evaṃ varaṃ vṛṇe yogyaṃ bhūtānāṃ mokṣakāmyayā | śaṃbhuḥ śrutvā prasannaḥ sannuvācāstu tathā varaḥ ||28|| sarvasaṃkalpakāmāptiṃ matprasādāt tvamāpsyasi | sarve muktiṃ prayāsyanti yathā saṃkalpitaṃ tvayā ||29|| ityuktvā sa mahādevastatraivāntaradhīyata | tataḥ kāle vimānastho niṣādo’nucarādibhiḥ ||1.558.30|| dhṛtasvarṇātapatrastu vījyamāno’psarogaṇaiḥ | divyābharaṇavastrāḍhyo divyacandanapūjitaḥ ||3 1 || paśupakṣigaṇaiḥ sākaṃ yayau muktipadaṃ yataḥ | tadidaṃ kathitaṃ haimi śivanetrahradātmakam ||32|| tīrthaṃ vai pāvanaṃ sarvasmṛddhidaṃ muktidaṃ tathā | athānyatparamaṃ tīrthaṃ nārmade cottare taṭe ||33|| vidyate kratavo yatra tīrthayātrāgatena ca | janakena kṛtāstatra dakṣiṇātoṣitā dvijāḥ ||34|| dharmarājastathā cānye diśāṃ pālāḥ samāyayuḥ | dharmarājo janakaṃ saṃprāhārghādi dadan nṛpam ||35|| tapasā dhyānayogena dānadevārcanairapi | śivarevāprasādena jitā lokāstvayākhilāḥ ||36|| janako dharmarājaṃ ca papraccha vinayena vai | ke deśāḥ parvatāḥ puṇyāḥ kā nadyaścāśramāśca ke ||37|| kāni tīrthāni loke’smin yatra dattaṃ hutaṃ tapaḥ | na kṣīyate manuṣyāṇāṃ tanme kathaya tattvataḥ ||38|| dharmaḥ prāha śṛṇu rājan śaṃkarasya mukhācchrutam | kalmāṣapādo rājāsīnmāthure maṇḍale purā ||39|| nābhāgākhyaśca rājāsīt sāketamaṇḍale purā | nābhāgasya vimānaṃ tu vyomni copari gacchati ||1.558.40|| kalmāṣapādayānaṃ tu bhūtale yāti nāmbare | iti hetoḥ śivaṃ natvā kalmāṣapādabhūpatiḥ ||41 || papraccha śṛṇvatāṃ sarvagaṇānāṃ saṃśayaṃ svakam | puṣkare daśayajñāśca vidhattāśca mayā hara ||42|| gaṃgāyāṃ naimiṣāraṇye prabhāse śaśibhūṣaṇe | prayāgarāje kāśyāṃ ca pratyeke śatakaṃ tathā ||43|| iṣṭaṃ sāgraṃ kratūnāṃ tu mayā tatra maheśvara | adho yāti vimānaṃ me nābhāgasyāmbaropari ||44|| kathamevaṃ nyūnatā me puṇye’haṃ yena nimnagaḥ | śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā taṃ vai kalmāṣapādabhūpatim ||45|| lakṣamedhaṃ nāmatīrthaṃ revāyā uttare taṭe | śaṃkaro lakṣamedheśo rājate tatra nityaśaḥ ||46|| cakāra tatra nābhāgo yajñamekaṃ suvaiṣṇavam | tena puṇyena yānaṃ vai nābhāgasyāmbare sthitam || 47|| tvayā revātaṭe naiva yajñaḥ kṛto mahāphalaḥ | tena nimnapradeśe te vimānaṃ yāti nāmbare ||48|| narmadāyāḥ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tato naiva hi vidyate | iti śrutvā ca kalmāṣacaraṇo nṛpatistataḥ ||49|| prayayau narmadātīraṃ daśayajñān cakāra ha | vaiṣṇavaṃ cātha raudraṃ ca vājimedhaṃ ca vai kratum ||1.558.50|| kārīriṃ vājapeyaṃ ca viśvajitaṃ mahākratum | puṇḍarīkaṃ naramedhaṃ gomedhaṃ vaiśvadaivatam ||51 || evaṃ yajñām̐ścakārāyaṃ jñānayajñaṃ tathā punaḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyajñaṃ pracakāra saḥ ||52|| tato yānaṃ svayaṃ vyomni samutthāya samūrdhvagam | yathākāmaṃ satyalokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca yayau tataḥ ||53|| nābhāgasya vimānādvai hyuparyupari yāti tat | evaṃ kalmāṣapādo vai kṛtvā brahmasamarpaṇam ||54|| jīvaddehena vaikuṇṭhaṃ gantuṃ yogyo’bhavattataḥ | yasya kratau svayaṃ viṣṇurlakṣmyā sākamupasthitaḥ ||55|| viṣṇunā cārpitā mālā divyā kaṇṭhe’sya bhūbhṛtaḥ | tena yogena vaikuṇṭhaṃ yātyāyāti kvacit kvacit ||56|| evaṃ rājā samartho’bhūt śrīviṣṇoḥ samprasādataḥ | tattīrthaṃ jānakaṃ cānyat kālmāṣapādikaṃ tathā ||57|| vidyate narmadākūle pāvanaṃ mokṣadaṃ param | athānyad vidyate ramyaṃ saptasārasvataṃ śubham ||58|| saptasārasvato nāma gandharvaḥ śivakiṃkaraḥ | kailāse gāyanaṃ kṛtvā prayayau raivatācalam ||59|| vinājñāṃ śaṃkarasyātha tvāyayau sucireṇa saḥ | nandī śaśāpa taṃ kopād vraja cāṇḍālatāṃ kṣitau ||1.558.60|| narmadāyāṃ vyatipāte snātvā yāsyasi mokṣatām | ityevaṃ sa tu gāndharvaścāṇḍālayonitāṃ gataḥ ||61|| jātismaro’bhavat pṛthvyāṃ babhrāma nārmade taṭe | snātvā revājale śaṃbhuṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ||62|| cāṇḍālayonisammukto gāndharvatāṃ yayau punaḥ | saptasārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ mokṣadaṃ tatprakīrtitam ||63|| narmadādakṣiṇe tīre tvaśokavanikāsu ca | aśokajananākhyaṃ sattīrthaṃ tvaparamuttamam ||64|| aghamarṣaṛṣestatrāśramo brāhmaṇaśobhitaḥ | ṛṣayo yatra brahmiṣṭhā vicinvanti pramokṣaṇam ||65|| aghamarṣāśramaṃ dharmo vaiśyarūpeṇa cāgamat | jijñāsārthaṃ kīdṛśā vai ṛṣayo’tra vasanti nu ||66|| sa vaiśyo’tra tapaścakre brāhmaṇātiśayaṃ tataḥ | brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sa pradadau mṛgacarmāṇi sarvaśaḥ ||67|| kaupīnāni tathā bhikṣāṃ tato nāśikamāyayau | varṣamekaṃ vyatītaṃ ca vaiśyasya tāpasaiḥ saha ||68|| na bhogo na ca kārpaṇyaṃ na māno na ca matsaraḥ | na doṣā dveṣarāgādyā jitaṃ sarvaṃ viśā tataḥ ||69|| saptasārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ nārmadaṃ tvāgamaddhi saḥ | snātvā pupūja viṣṇuṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ||1.558.70|| tathā śaṃbhuṃ bāṇarūpaṃ pūjayāmāsa sādaram | hariḥ pratyakṣatāṃ prāpya prāha tvaṃ vṛṣa eva yaḥ ||71 || tathāpi siddhatāṃ prāptastapasā ca viśeṣataḥ | idaṃ vimānamāruhya divyabhogasukhaṃ kuru ||72|| putradārasnuṣopeto viṣṇulokamito vraja | dharmaḥ prāha tadā viṣṇo ṛṣayo narmadātaṭe ||73|| atra daśasahasrāṇi vidyante ye tapodhanāḥ | te sarve mama tapasā viṣṇulokaṃ prayāntu vai ||74|| imaṃ varamahaṃ manye śrīharereva nānyataḥ | śrutvaivaṃ ṛṣayaḥ sarve sābhimānāhamānvitāḥ ||75|| tiraścakrurhi taṃ vaiśyaṃ procuścāpi parasparam | mahatāṃ bhūsurāṇāṃ vai vaiśyaḥ karoti lāghavam ||76|| vaiśyasya tapasā viprā yātā vaikuṇṭhamityapi | loke darśayituṃ so’yaṃ varaṃ vṛṇoti śāṭhyataḥ ||77|| vaiśyasya śreṣṭhatāṃ loke jñāpayan sa vṛṇoti hi | na vayaṃ tapasā tasya gacchāmo vai divaṃ prati ||78|| brāhmaṇasyāvamānena vaiśyo’yaṃ va tariṣyati | ityuktvā ṛṣayastaṃ ca vaiśyaṃ prāha prayāhi bhoḥ ||79|| vaiśyadharmaṃ gṛhāṇāpi kṛṣiṃ kuru gṛhe sthitaḥ | na yogyastvaṃ tapaḥ kartuṃ jātyabhimānavānasi ||1.558.80|| gaccha gaccha gṛhaṃ mā cāyāhi tvaṃ vai dvijāntikam | ityuktaḥ sa dvijān dṛṣṭvā sābhimānakrudhānvitān ||81 || vimuktanāmakaṃ vipraṃ prajagāda sa karṣukaḥ | brāhmaṇānāṃ paro dharmaḥ krodhābhāvaḥ praśāntatā ||82|| ahaṃmamatārāhityaṃ tadvān yaḥ sa ca bhūsuraḥ | krodhāhaṃmamatāyukto brāhmaṇo naiva vidyate ||83|| tādṛśasya tapaḥ sarvaṃ śrāddhaṃ vāpi ca niṣphalam | daivatairapi durjñeyo gahano jātinirṇayaḥ ||84|| brahmakarmasamācāraṃ vaiśyaṃ brāhmaṇamucyate | vrahmakarmavihīnaṃ ca vipraṃ vaiśyaṃ samucyate ||85|| niṣṭhuraṃ nirghṛṇaṃ krūraṃ kṛtaghnaṃ dīrghakopinam | dvijaṃ vivādaśūraṃ ca dūrataḥ parivarjayet ||86|| ityuktvā vaiśyavaryaḥ sa virarāma kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ | viprāḥ papracchurenaṃ tvaṃ ko’si vaiśyasvarūpadhṛk ||87|| vaiśyaḥ prāha ca dharmo’smi parīkṣārthaṃ samāgataḥ | kīdṛśā brāhmaṇā yūyaṃ narmadātaṭavāsinaḥ ||88|| ahaṃmamate visṛjya tapaḥ kuruta cottamam | roṣaṃ tu sarvathā tyaktvā bhajadhvaṃ parameśvaram |||89|| evaṃ vrahmavratenātra yūyaṃ muktiṃ gamiṣyatha | atha te śamayāmāsurdharmād doṣānnijām̐stataḥ ||1.558.90|| dharmaṃ prapūjayāmāsurnirdoṣāḥ ṛṣayo’bhavan | atha divyavimānāni tvāgatāni vṛṣāntike ||91 || vṛṣājñayā hi te sarve samāruhyāghamarṣaṇaḥ | api dharmeṇa sārdhaṃ ca viṣṇunā ramayā saha ||92|| saptasārasvataṃ natvā yayurvaikuṇṭhameva ca | śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāpi bhuktimuktipradaṃ hi tat ||93|| ityuktvā śaṃkaro devyai virarāma ca padmaje | mayā tubhyaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ saptasārasvatātmakam ||94|| kathitaṃ muktidaṃ mokṣapradaṃ snāturviśeṣataḥ | anekayajñaphaladaṃ putradāradhanapradam ||95|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne matsyātāpī saṃgamakalahaṃseśa bṛhatīnarmadāsaṃgamaśivanetrahṛdalakṣamedhaḥsaptasārasvatāditīrthāni setihāsacamatkārabhūtāni nirūpitānītināmāṣṭapañcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 558 ||
<1.559> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tataḥ śaṃbhuḥ pārvatīṃ prāha cottamam | śāṇḍilyākalpagāyogaṃ tīrthaṃ cānyad vadāmi te || 1 || yatra janma sahṛsrārjunākhyasya bhūpaterabhūt | tatra śāḍilyakauṇḍinyamāṇḍavyā nyavasan mudā || 2 || śāṇḍilyasyāśramastvāste śāṇḍilyārevikāyuji | śāṇḍilyapuramityevaṃ prasiddhaṃ tatpurābhavat || 3 || niśāyāṃ mūṣakaḥ kaścidaṭamāna itastataḥ | prabhakṣito biḍālena tāvad vṛkaḥ samāgataḥ || 4 || kiñciccheṣaṃ mūṣakaṃ taṃ tyaktvā dudrāva cākhubhuk | tadā meghe prasañjāte pravāhastatra nirgataḥ || 5 || asthipravahaṇaṃ svākhoḥ prasaṃjātaṃ jale tataḥ | tīrthasyāsya prabhāveṇa yakṣo’bhavat sa unduruḥ || 6 || bṛhadvṛndasamākhyāto yakṣāyutasamāvṛtaḥ | haṃsayuktavimānena yakṣeśvaro divaṃ yayau || 7 || yakṣaloke’dhipo jātastīrthasyaiva prabhāvataḥ | tato gacchenmahātīrthe kubjārevāsamāgamam || 8 || rantidevena vai yatra yajñaḥ kṛto’tiśobhanaḥ | avadhyāyā nṛpaścāsīd rantidevābhidhaḥ purā || 9 || vasiṣṭhasyānumatyā sa revātīre kratuṃ śubham | kartuṃ cājñāpayāmāsa bhṛtyāmātyapurodhasaḥ ||1.559.10|| yajñopaskārasaṃbhāraḥ śīghrameva vidhīyatām | dhenūśca daśalakṣāṇi savatsāḥ supayasvinīḥ ||11|| hemabhārairbhūṣitāśca kāmadughāḥ sumaṃgalāḥ | ānayantu lakṣamaśvānāmayutaṃ sudantinām ||12|| maṇimāṇikyaratnānāṃ yatrānantyaṃ yathā bhavet | anekāni sahasrāṇi vimānānāṃ syurambare ||13|| pṛthvīyānānyanekāni cānayantvatra tīrthake | ājñāpyaivaṃ svayaṃ yāne vyomage sanniṣadya vai ||14|| narmadāyāstaṭe gatvā sāntaḥpuraparicchadḥ | viśaśrāma suvarṇasya yūpān kuṇḍām̐śca maṇḍapān ||15|| kārayāmāsa bhakṣyām̐śca bhojyān pakvānnaparvatān kṛtavān ratnabhūṣābhirbrāhmaṇān samalaṃkṛtān ||16|| yajñadīkṣāṃ prajagrāha patnyā saha narādhipaḥ | yajñe pravartite havyavāhanaḥ sarvagocaraḥ ||17|| pratyakṣo jagṛhe havyaṃ mūrtimān svāhayā saha | brahmaśakrādayo devā lokapālā marudgaṇāḥ ||18|| viśvedevāśca sādhyāśca vasavaścandrabhāskarau saritaḥ sāgarāḥ śailāḥ sarvatīrthāni cāpagāḥ ||19|| mātaraḥ siddhagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ | umayā sahito rudro viṣṇurnārāyaṇīyutaḥ ||1.559.20|| āyayuryajñabhāgām̐śca teṣāṃ pṛthagakalpayat | vedadhvaniṃ pravṛttaṃ ca śrutvā dānavapuṃgavāḥ ||21|| mahābāhusubāhvādyāḥ krauṃcapuranivāsinaḥ | āyayurnarmadātīre sabhṛtyabalavāhanāḥ ||22|| pracakrire kratau vighnaṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi sthitāḥ | uvāca rantidevaṃ tu brahmā bhayāt pravihvalaḥ ||23|| vighnaṃ vāraya rājendra yajñaḥ kramād yathā bhavet | brahmiṣṭho rantidevastacchrutvovāca hariṃ smaran ||24|| yadi me vidyate satyaṃ brahmabhaktau parā matiḥ | daityarākṣasaduṣṭādyā layaṃ yāntu vinā mṛdham ||25|| evamuktvā sa rājarṣiḥ sasmāra viṣṇumīśvaram | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhārī sākṣādupāgataḥ ||26|| viṣṇoścakraṃ kuśāgre’tra tiṣṭhatu rākṣasārdanam | evamuktvā nārmade sujale tvāplāvya taṃ kuśam ||27|| preṣayāmāsa rakṣārthaṃ dakṣiṇasyām̐ diśi dhruvam | uttare’pi tathā cānyat preṣayāmāsa darbhakam ||28|| devamantreṇa ghoreṇa rakṣāṃ vidhāya sarvataḥ | pūrvasyāṃ paścimāyāṃ ca preṣayāmāsa vai kuśau ||29|| mūrtimantastu te jātāścakrurdurgān samantataḥ | agninā jvalamānāśca rākṣasānāṃ pradāhakāḥ ||1.559.30|| durgāste vyomacārā vai yatra yatra ca rākṣasāḥ | tatra tatrābhigatvaiva dadhustān sahṛsraśaḥ ||31|| athāgnau ca juhāvāyaṃ rājā bilvāmravetasam | tasmāt samutthitaṃ liṃgaṃ jvalatkālānalaprabham ||32|| nemuryajñīyabhūmisthāḥ sarve kuṇḍasthamīśvaram | rantidevasya vai sarve camatkāraṃ vilokya ca ||33|| dhanyavādān dadustatra devādyā api bhāvataḥ | dānavā dudruvuḥ sarve bhayād darbhānalotthitāt ||34|| krauṃcadvīpaṃ yayuryajñaḥ saṃpūrṇatāṃ gatastathā | liṃgaṃ bilvāmrakaṃ natvā pūjayitvā surādayaḥ ||35|| yayuḥ svargaṃ praśaṃsanto nṛpaṃ tīrthe camatkṛtim | sāketaṃ va yayau yānaṃ samāruhya ca bhūpatiḥ ||36|| tatra tīrthe kṛtasnānā yānti brahma sanātanam darśanādapi pāpānāṃ prajvālakaṃ pramokṣadam ||37|| kubjāyāṃ cāparaṃ tīrthaṃ hārikeśākhyamastyapi | harikeśa iti khyātaḥ śālagrāme dvijo’bhavat ||38|| śiloñcchavṛttirdhamātmā tasya patnī pativratā | suvratākhyābhavad yasyāṃ śataṃ putrāḥ prajajñire ||39|| kapilāpuramāśritya harikeśo divāniśam | śilānāmarjanenaiva prasthamannaṃ samṛcchati ||1.559.40|| bālā api ca te putrā yathākathaṃcideva tu | vartayanti prabhikṣādyaiḥ pūrṇamannaṃ na yanti hi ||41|| sthitiṃ tu tādṛśīṃ dṛṣṭvā mātā śuśoca vihvalā | patiṃ prāha suduḥkhārtā garhamāṇāṃ nijāṃ daśām ||42|| vṛddhau ca mātāpitarau sādhvī bhāryā sutaḥ śiśuḥ | bharaṇīyāḥ prayatnena dharma eṣaḥ sanātanaḥ ||43|| tasmāt pratigrahaṃ kṛtvā bhartavyaṃ svakuṭumbakam | putreṇa lokaṃ jayati putreṇa sukhamedhate ||44|| putreṇa sukhamāpnoti pitṝṇāṃ ca suto gatiḥ | ambarīṣo mahṛārājaścāyodhyādhipatiḥ kila ||45|| prakaroti kratuṃ yāhi kurukṣetre dvijottama | gatāśca brāhmaṇāstatra pratigrahajighṛkṣayā ||46|| gāḥ kāñcanaṃ dhanaṃ labdhaṃ śālagrāmanivāsibhiḥ | śrutvaivaṃ bhāminīvākyaṃ gṛhītvā ca kuṭumbakam ||47|| kurukṣetre yayau yajñe praviṣṭaścādhvare dvijaḥ | ambarīṣo vilokyainaṃ cārghapādyairapūjayat ||48|| uvācātithyarūpeṇa yācayasva yathepsitam | vipraḥ prāha dhanaṃ varṣaśataṃ yāvadbhavenmama ||49|| paryāptaṃ sakuṭumbasya tāvad dehi nṛpottama | dhenūrdehi pratiputra hemabhārapariṣkṛtāḥ ||1.559.50|| ābharaṇāni vastrāṇi kṣetrodyānagṛhāṇi ca | dāridyaṃ me yathā na syāttathā bhikṣāṃ pradehi me ||51|| ambarīṣaḥ prasanno’ti dadau sarvaṃ yathepsitam | śālagrāme śubhe kṣetre vipro rājeva modate ||52|| kālāntare tataḥ prāpte vipro mṛtyuvaśaṃ yayau | marudeśe nirudake brahmarakṣastvamāgataḥ ||53|| rājapratigrahāccāpi tathā brāhmaṇyalopataḥ || viṣayavāsanāvattvād dhanādivāsanādinā ||54|| iha vṛkṣāḥ prarohanti dāvadagdhā ghanāgame | rājapratigrahadagdhāḥ prarohanti na karhicit ||55|| narake raurave ghore tasya vai patanaṃ bhavet | vipro’yaṃ rākṣasaḥ preto bhūtvā sutān priyāṃ tathā ||56|| āgatyāgatya ca grahe rudan prāha punaḥ punaḥ | mamoddhāraṃ prakurvantu rākṣaso’haṃ pratigrahāt || 97|| jāto’smi me mahānārāyaṇabaliṃ dadatvapi || tatastasya sutairnārāyaṇabaliḥ prasaṃkṛtaḥ ||58|| vyomavāṇyā sutebhyaśca kathitaṃ yāntu narmadām | kubjāyāḥ saṃgame tatra bilvāmrake sutīrthake ||59|| | tatra snātvā bhavatyeva brahmarakṣovimokṣaṇam | labhate brahmalokaṃ ca pāpatāpapraṇāśanāt ||1.559.60|| śrutvā sādhvī sutairyuktā yayau bilvāmrakasthalam | rākṣaso’pi kuṭumbena sahādṛśyo yayau tadā ||61|| samprāptaḥ sumudāyuktaḥ kubjārevāsamāgamam| snātvā śaṃbhuṃ prapūjyaiva nārāyaṇaṃ samarcya ca ||62|| dhyāne tasthustadā vyomnā vimānaṃ tvāyayau śubham | viṣṇupārṣadayuktaṃ ca samāruhya mahojjvalam ||63|| tatkṣaṇād divyadehāste brahmalokaṃ tadā yayuḥ | evaṃ kubjāsaṃgamasya revāyāṃ pāpanāśanam ||64|| mokṣaṇaṃ harikeśasya jātaṃ kuṭumbinastadā | sarve yayurhi te muktiṃ tathā yāsyanti mānavāḥ ||65|| atha suvarṇanāmnaśca gandharvasya priyā satī | hemagarbheti vikhyātā putrī tasyāḥ prasundarī ||66|| sukāmā nāmataḥ sā ca dhanadena vivāhitā | tasyāṃ putraḥ ketumālī rājā vaidyādhare pure ||67|| babhūva tasya patnī ca śaśirekhetināmataḥ | dve kanye janayāmāsa ratiṃ prītiṃ manorame ||68|| dadau sa kāmadevāya pāṇigrahaṇapūrvakam | anyāśca kanyakā bahvīrdāsīrūpā tadā dadau ||69|| tāśca kanyā niyamaṃ vai jagṛhuḥ śivapūjanam | kṛtvā jalādikaṃ grāhyaṃ nānyathā tu kadācana ||1.559.70|| athaikadā yayuḥ sarvā devanadyāṃ vigāhitum | citrāṃgadaśca gandharvo dṛṣṭvā tāstatra cāyayau ||71|| kāmarūpadharo bhūtvā rūpānurūpaśobhitaḥ | sasnau jale yadā tasmin mohitāstāstu kanyakāḥ ||72|| remustenaiva sākaṃ ca visasmarurharārcanam | evaṃ vai divase yāte sāyaṃ saṃsmṛtya śaṃkaram ||73|| āāyayuḥ pūjanārthaṃ ca bhuktvā pītvānnavāri ca | pārvatī kupitā dṛṣṭvā śaśāpa sāyameva tāḥ ||74|| dharmasya niyamaṃ hitvā cāpūjya śaṃkaraṃ ca mām | jalānnaṃ bhuktavatyaśca tato doṣānvitāḥ khalu ||75|| mama śāpena vai sarvā bhavantu kubjikāstathā | vāmanyaśca martyaloke hīnāṃgā vanabhīllikāḥ ||76|| evaṃ śaptāstu tāḥ sarvā martyalokaṃ samāgaman | babhramustā vane’raṇye bhīlikāḥ śāpaduḥkhitāḥ ||77|| ekadā ca kubero vai tena mārgeṇa cāmbare | nirgato divyayānena dṛṣṭvā tā duḥkhitāstataḥ ||78|| yayau śīghraṃ pārvatīṃ ca prati kailāsameva saḥ | natvā ruroda ca tadā satī prāha kathaṃ tviha ||79|| rodiṣi vada me tvatra kāraṇaṃ prakaromi yat | kuberaḥ kanyakāśāpanirvṛtiṃ prārthayat tadā ||1.559.80|| śrutvaitat pārvatī prāha yāntu sarvā hi narmadām | yajñapākāśramaṃ gatvā bilvāmrakaṃ sutīrthakam ||81|| kṛtvā śāpāttato muktā bhaviṣyanti drutaṃ tu tāḥ | yatra vai saṃgame kubjā gāndharvyo bhīllayonitaḥ ||82|| muktāḥ khātvā jalaṃ pītvā kubjātīrthaṃ taducyate | kubjānadī ca sā proktā narmadāsaṃgatā ca yā ||83|| tatra snātāḥ śāpamuktā gāndharvyo yānasaṃsthitāḥ | yayuḥ sarvāḥ kuberoktyā svarge punarnijālayam ||84|| aneke jalapānādyaistatra siddhiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ | śravaṇāt kīrtanād vāpi mucyante bhavabandhanāt ||85|| athānyattatra vai tīrthaṃ māheśvarapurātmakam | raudraṃ vāruṇamāsādya krośamātrapramāṇataḥ ||86|| śivakṣetre’tra ye snātāḥ paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo’pi ca | api kīṭapataṃgādyā mṛtā yānti divaṃ param ||87|| sālaṃkāyanamuninā kṛto yajño mahān purā | ayodhyādhipatiḥ sālaṃkāyanākhyo nṛpo’bhavat ||88|| anāvṛṣṭau prajātāyāṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ mahāmunim | paryapṛcchat kāraṇaṃ ca mārkaṇḍeyo jagād tam ||89|| gaṃgāsāgarasaṃbhede tava rājye narādhipa | adhikāravihīnā vai sakāmā phalavāñcchanāḥ ||1.559.90|| sāmprataṃ saptacāṇḍālā ūrdhvapādā adhaḥśikhāḥ | kaṇadhūmaṃ pibantyeva tapaḥ kurvanti tena vai ||91|| tapasyanadhikārāṇāṃ pāpaṃ tapasi jāyate | taddaśāṃśastvayi rājannāste tato’pyavagrahaḥ ||92|| tasmāttān daṇḍaya rājan taporodhaṃ ca kāraya yajñe ca nārmade kṣetre samācara mahāmakham ||93|| vṛṣṭistena va sarvatra bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | mucyatāṃ pāpadoṣeṇa rājyaṃ svargamavāpsyasi ||94|| śrutvā rājā tvādideśa bhṛtyān sambhārasiddhaye | saptarātrābhyantarato yathā yajñaḥ pravartate ||95|| rājā rājyaprajāścāpyamātyā rājakumārakāḥ | | ṛṣayo munayo viprā rājñyo devāḥ sureśvarāḥ ||96|| āyayustatra vai tīre revāyāśca nimantritāḥ | | arbudārbudasaṃkhyākāḥ svarṇamudrāśca saṃdadau ||97|| koṭigogajavājyādidānaṃ cakāra bhūpatiḥ | hiraṇmayā mahāstambhāḥ sruvādyā api kānakāḥ ||98|| bhakṣyabhojyarasādyāścāpūrvā divyarasānvitāḥ | | vartante tatra bhūbhāge viṣṇuḥ sākṣāt samāyayau ||99|| rudraścāgniḥ svayaṃ brahmā tattaddevyaḥ samāyayuḥ | | yajño nirvartitaḥ pūrṇo’vabhṛthaṃ narmadājale ||1.559.100|| cakruḥ sarve mahāvṛṣṭiḥ saṃjātā kṣitimaṇḍale | devādyāḥ pūjitā rājñā brāhmaṇāśca pratoṣitāḥ ||101|| tādṛśaṃ tanmahattīrthe yajñīyaṃ nārmadaṃ śubham || sañjātaṃ tāpasā rājñā niruddhāstapasastathā || 102|| ye cāṇḍālāstapasyāsan tena vṛṣṭirbabhūva ca | ityevaṃ ca kratuṃ kṛtvā yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niketanam || 103|| tata ārabhya tattīrthaṃ yajñatīrthaṃ hi kathyate | ityevaṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha pārvatīṃ tīrthamaṇḍalam || 104|| mayoditaṃ ca te lakṣmi pāpatāpapraṇāśanam || paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi muktidaṃ nārmadaṃ jalam || 105|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śāṇḍilyākalpagātīrtha rantidevatīrtha harikeśatīrthāmbarīṣatīrtha bilvāmrakatīrtha sālaṃkāyanatīrthādīni sacamatkāra nirūpitānīti nāmaikonaṣaṣṭayadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ||559||
<1.560> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tathānyāni yāni tīrthāni śaṃbhunā | pārvatyai cābhidhattāni kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 1 || camatkārapure nāganadītīre purāruṇiḥ | ṛṣirāsa tadā tatra kaścidvyādhaḥ samāgataḥ || 2 || ṛṣeryogācchuddhamanā vyādhastapaścacāra ha | dvijatvaṃ karmaṇā prāpto nāmnā satyatapā hyabhūt || 3 || sa tu satyatapā durvāsasā cāśīḥsuyojitaḥ | yayau kubjānarmadāyāḥ saṃgamaṃ snānakāraṇāt || 4 || snātvā pītvā jalaṃ puṇyayuto himācalaṃ yayau | himādreruttare pāde puṣpabhadrānadītaṭe || 5 || citraśilāṃ samadhyāsya bhadranyagrodhasannidhau | tapaścakāra tatrāpi bhajan vai śrīnarāyaṇam || 6 || sa kadācit kuṭhāreṇa ciccheda samidhaḥ kila | ciccheda cāṃgulīmekāṃ vāmatarjanikāṃ tataḥ || 7 || bhasmacūrṇaṃ viniṣkrāntaṃ na māṃsaṃ na ca lohitam | aṃgulī sandhitā tena pūrvavaccābhavattadā || 8 || etadāścaryamekena kinnareṇa vilokitam | ākāśe gacchatā tena kinnareṇa divaṃ tataḥ || 9 || gatvā tvindrasabhāyāṃ cāpūrvamāścaryamīritam | tadyathā dṛṣṭamāścaryaṃ mayā tāpasadarśitam || 1.560.1 0|| puṣpabhadrānadītīre satyatapāstu tāpasaḥ | tapasā śuṣkadehaśca dehe bhasmaiva vartate || 11 || tacchrutvā sahasā śukro’nujaṃ viṣṇuṃ samabravīt | āgaccha viṣṇo gacchāmo himavatpārśvamuttamam || 12|| tatrāścaryamapūrvaṃ me kathitaṃ kinnareṇa vai | evamuktastato viṣṇurvārāharūpamagrahīt || 13|| mṛgayuśca tathaivendro jagmatustamṛṣiṃ prati | viṣṇurvārāharūpeṇa ṛṣidṛṣṭipathe sthitaḥ || 14|| bhūtvā dṛśyopyadṛśyo’bhūtpunareva ca dṛśyate | tāvadindro dhanuṣpāṇistīkṣṇasāyakadhṛg vane || 15|| āgatya satyatapasamṛṣimenamuvāca ha | bhagavanniha dṛṣṭaste varāhaḥ pṛthulo mahān || 16 || yena taṃ hanmi bhṛtyānāṃ poṣaṇāya mahāmune | śrutvā muniścakitaḥ san cintayāmāsa tatkṣaṇāt || 17|| yadi taṃ darśayāmyasmai varāhaṃ sa haniṣyati | no cet kuṭumbaḥ kṣudhayā sīdatyasya na saṃśayaḥ || 18|| ubhayathāpi me pāpaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | varāhaḥ śaraṇaṃ yāto mamāśrame’vanāya vai || 19|| vyādhaścāpi hi māṃ prāpto vīkṣya māṃ satyavādinam | asatyavacane doṣo viśvāsaghātanaṃ param ||1.560.20|| anyatarasya hiṃsā ca dūṣaṇaṃ sarvathā bhayam | evaṃ gate’tra kiṃ vācyamathāsau cintayan harim ||21|| kṣaṇaṃ sākṣiṇi dhairyaṃ ca sthairyaṃ prāpa tadā drutam | rakṣātmikā subuddhiśca kṣaṇāttasya vyajāyata ||22|| netraṃ paśyati no vakti vakti jihvā na paśyati | paśyatyanyo vadatyanyo dvayornāstyekakāryatā ||23|| draṣṭā mūko vaktā cāndhaḥ ko dadyāduttaraṃ vada | evaṃ śrutvā paraṃ tuṣṭāvindraviṣṇu kṣaṇāntare ||24|| svarūpe darśayantau ca vākyametat samūcatuḥ | brūhi tuṣṭau ca nau te’tra vṛṇu caikaṃ varaṃ param ||25|| tacchrutvāsau satyatapā uvāca saṃprasannahṛt | nānyo varaḥ pṛthivyāṃ me paro viṣṇostu darśanāt ||26|| yena kṛtārthatā me’sti durlabhaṃ tava darśanam | tathāpyatra puṣpabhadrājale vaṭāntike tu ye ||27|| snātvā dhyātvā hariṃ smṛtvā vaseyurmāsamekakam | teṣāṃ pāpāni naśyantāṃ muktiṃ tebhyaḥ pradehyapi ||28|| tathetyuktvā tu tau devau datvā tasya varaṃ tathā | vimānasthau vyomamārge tiṣṭhatastāvadeva ca ||29|| gurustasya samāyātaścāruṇiḥ samadṛśyata | durvāsāśca samāyātaḥ smṛtau satyena vai tadā ||1.560.30 || pūjitau satyatapasā jñātvā śiṣyaṃ kṛtārthakam | siddhaṃ ca tapasā dagdhakilbiṣaṃ purataḥ sthitam ||3 1 || āruṇiḥ prāha siddho’si brahmabhūto’si sarvathā | idānīmātmanā sārdhaṃ muktikālo mato’sti te ||22|| uttiṣṭhāgamyatāṃ putra mayā sārdhaṃ vimānake | nārāyaṇena cendreṇa tathā durvāsasā saha ||33|| yāsyāmo nārmadaṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ kubjāmrakaṃ śubham | evamuktvā cāruṇiścātreyaḥ satyatapāstrayaḥ || 34|| dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ cāruruhurvimānakam | bhaktānāṃ vāñcchayā nārāyaṇaścendro’pi nārmadam ||35|| yājñīyaṃ tīrthamāsādya snātvā svargaṃ yayustataḥ | tato muktiṃ jagāmāsau satyatapāḥ paraṃ padam ||36|| anye ciraṃjīvinaśca svasvasthānāni vai yayuḥ | durvāsādyāstu kailāsādikaṃ yacchāśvataṃ matam ||37|| athānyatte pravadāmi tīrthaṃ vai nārmade jale | maṇḍapeśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca tīrthaṃ tatra hi rājate || 38|| yatra snātvā tanuṃ tyaktvā rājā vaidyādhare pure | daśavarṣasahasrāṇi bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||39|| mānasau brahmaṇaḥ putrau bādarāyaṇaśākaṭau | vanasthau ca prati rājā hyajāpālo yayau kvacit ||1.560.40 || avadhyādhipatirnatvā papraccha madhuram ṛṣī | pitṝṇāṃ tāraṇārthāya dānaṃ deyaṃ mayātra vai ||41 || ke grahīṣyanti ṛṣayaḥ samāyāntu madantikam | tadā dvau varjayitvā tu bādarāyaṇaśākaṭau |||42|| anye rājñā pradattāni dānāni jagṛhustadā | gajānāṃ daśasāhasraṃ ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitam ||43|| prādād viprebhyaśca dhanaṃ maṭhān hemamayām̐stathā | kalaṃjaragiriṃ rājā cakāra triḥpradakṣiṇam ||44|| namaskṛtvā ṛṣīn sarvān jagāma svapuraṃ prati | gate tasmin mahīpāle ṛṣayo dhanamohitāḥ ||45|| sukhaṃ ca paramaṃ prāptā rājadravyeṇa rājasāḥ | tapasaḥ patitā bhoge saktā babhūvureva te ||46|| puṇyakṣayeṇa ca mṛtāḥ ṛte bādaraśākaṭau | rājapratigraho ghoro raudraḥ pāpo bhayāvaraḥ ||47|| ṛte brahmasvarūpaṃ vai kaḥ soḍhuṃ śaktimān bhavet | kāmakrodhaparā bhūtvā mṛtāste brāhmaṇāstataḥ ||48|| śvayoniṃ samanuprāptā jātā amedhyabhakṣakāḥ | atha pratigrahayuktavipreṣu vāsakāraṇāt ||49|| saṃgadoṣeṇa jātau śvamukhau bādaraśākaṭau | dṛṣṭvānanaṃ śvatulyaṃ ca cintayāmāsatuśca tau ||1.560.50|| saṃgadoṣeṇa vai pāpaṃ lagnaṃ rājapratigrahe | iti sañcintya tau satyaṃ yayatuḥ parameṣṭhinam ||51 || abhivādya prāhatuśca vṛttāntaṃ vikṛtānanau | śrutvā brahmā niṣkṛtiṃ ca prāha vai nārmade jale |||52|| snānena śuddhirbhavitā yāntu vai maṇḍapeśvaram | pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā bādarāyaṇaśākaṭau ||53|| śvabhiḥ ṛṣibhiḥ sahitau narmadā yayatustadā | snātvā pītvā jalaṃ tatra pāpahīnāstu te’naghāḥ ||54|| yayuḥ svargaṃ divyayānairevaṃ tīrthaṃ taduttamam | śravaṇātkīrtanāccāpi hayamedhaphalaṃ bhaveta ||55|| tato gacchet paraṃ tīrthaṃ śvetakiṃśukasaṃjñakam | narmadādantivanikāsaṃgame snānamācaret ||56|| tīrthaṃ kapiśilākhyaṃ ca kuryāt tataḥ śubhapradam | śaśabhīnarmadāyogaṃ tīrthaṃ gacchet tataḥ param |||57|| rājatīrthaṃ tato gacched rāmalakṣmaṇasevitam | uttīrya narmadāṃ rāmo yayau vanāntare purā ||58|| daśāśvamedhatīrthaṃ ca tato gacchetparaṃ śubham | pipīlikoddhāratīrthaṃ tato gacchet pramuktidam |||59|| vandhyārevāsamāyogaṃ tato gacchecchubhapradam | śuklatīrthaṃ tato gacchet svargamokṣapradaṃ varam ||1.560.60|| rāsabhīnarmadābhede snātvā mokṣo bhaved dhruvam | havirdhānastu rājarṣiḥ samartho’bhūt purā yuge |||61 || ātreyasya sutaścāsīt harikeśābhidhānakaḥ | agniputrī sutejāśca pāṇigrahaṇadharmataḥ ||62|| havirdhānāya dattā sā sutejānāmikā tataḥ | havirdhānastu rājarṣiḥ ṛtuṃ buddhvā gato hi tām ||63|| kadācittu yuvā tatrāyayau vai harikeśakaḥ | so’pi vai kāmabhāvena tasyā jagrāha vai karam ||6 4| agnihotrasya śālāyāṃ jagrāha kāmadharmataḥ | harikeśastayā sākaṃ reme yatheṣṭakāmataḥ ||65|| havirdhānaśca dadṛśe yugalaṃ surate sthitam | āsīd viṣaṇṇavadano hyavadhyo brāhmaṇo yataḥ ||66|| patnī cāpi hyavadhyā vai yataḥ strījātireva sā | vicāryetthaṃ śanairvipraṃ havirdhāna uvāca ha ||67|| mātaraṃ gurupatnīṃ ca svasāraṃ ca sutāṃ tathā | gatvā tu praviśedagniṃ tataḥ śuddhyati mānavaḥ ||68|| guruṃ ca guruputraṃ ca gatvā strī saṃviśeccitām | evaṃ kartuṃ samarthau na bhavantau bhavato yataḥ |||69|| gardabhastvaṃ bhava vipra sutejā gardabhī bhava | varṣaśataṃ tathāraṇye jātau tau gardabhau tataḥ ||1.560.70|| jātismarau kadācittāvagastyāśramamīyatuḥ | papracchatuśca śāpasya nivṛttyarthaṃ tapo vratam ||71 || agastyaḥ prāha yātaṃ vai havirdhānaṃ prati hyubhau | tau tataśca havirdhānāśramaṃ yayaturādarāt ||72|| kṣamāṃ yācitavantau ca nematuḥ pādayostadā | havirdhānaśca tau prāha yātaṃ vai narmadātaṭam |||73 || snātvā pītvā jalaṃ tasyāstapasā kṣīṇakalmaṣau | yāsyathaḥ paramāṃ muktiṃ phalaṃ mānuṣajanmanaḥ ||74|| evamuktau yayatuśca narmadāṃ ceratustapaḥ | śuddhau tau gardabhīṃ yoniṃ tyaktvā divyau babhūvatuḥ ||75|| kāmikaṃ yānamārūḍhau sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitau | yayatustau divaṃ tatra nyuṣaturyugasaptatiḥ ||76 || athānte yayatuḥ śrīmannārāyaṇapadaṃ ca tau | tatra tīrthaṃ harikeśa sutejaskaṃ pramokṣadam ||77|| havirdhāneśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ revāgardabhīsaṃgame | vartate paramaṃ puṇyaṃ darśanāt pāpanāśanam ||78 tato gacchet karamardātīrthaṃ puṇyapradaṃ param | maitreyasyāśramaṃ rājā kuśadhvajaḥ samāyayau ||79 narmadāyāstaṭe ramye śrāddhaṃ cakāra bhāvataḥ | tatra dānaṃ dadau rājā gavāṃ daśāyutāni vai ||1.560.80 savatsānāṃ suvarṇānāṃ ghaṇṭābharaṇaśobhinām | bhojayitvā tataḥ śrāddhe brāhmaṇām̐stānnṛpottamaḥ ||81 yayau rājā nijaṃ gehaṃ viprāstatra vyavasthitāḥ | tān dhenūścāgatā jagdhuṃ rākṣasāścaikadā vane |||82 dhenavo viviśurvārau kāściddivaṃ yayustadā | viprān vai bhakṣituṃ tatra dudruvū rākṣasāstataḥ ||83 sasmarurbrāhmaṇāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam | lakṣmīpatiṃ prabhānāthaṃ pārvatīśaṃ narāyaṇam |||84 māṇikīśaṃ ca haṃseśaṃ mañjuleśaṃ hṛdisthitam | tāvad viṣṇuḥ samāyātaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ |||85 cakreṇa karamardena nāśayāmāsa rākṣasān | brāhmaṇān saṃrarakṣāpi gāvastatrāgatāḥ punaḥ ||86 karamardeśvaraḥ śaṃbhurviṣṇucakrādvinirgataḥ | karamardeśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ rakṣākaraṃ matam ||87|| atha kālāntare viṣṇurviprān gāśca vimānake | ārohayitvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ nītavānmokṣamālayam ||88| tatra snātā divaṃ yānti mṛtāśca na punarbhavāḥ | śravaṇāt kīrtanāccāpi gosahasraphalaṃ bhavet ||89| ityāha pārvatīṃ śaṃbhurmayā lakṣmi ca te puraḥ | uditaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇacakrapratīrthakam ||1.560.90 | iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āruṇiśiṣyasatyatapaso mokṣaḥ, maṇḍapeśvaratīrthaṃ, bādarāyaṇaśākaṭāyanayoḥ śvamukhatānivṛttiḥ, narmadādantivanikāsaṃgamaḥ, rāsabhīnarmadātīrthavṛttāntaḥ, karamardatīrthaṃ cetyādisetihāsanirūpaṇanāmāṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 560 ||
<1.561> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi śaṃkaraśca pārvatyai prāha tīrthakam | jvāleśvaraṃ suvikhyātaṃ kathayāmīha te’naghe || 1 || baleḥ putraṃ tripuraṃ vai bāṇaṃ bāṇena śaṃkaraḥ | nijaghāna tataścāstraṃ jvālāmālāsamanvitam || 2 || patitaṃ kalpagāvārṣuṃ jvālā śāntā tadābhavat | jvāleśvaraṃ hi tatproktaṃ pāparākṣasanāśanam || 3 || atha revācarusaṃgaṃ tīrthaṃ vai rājate param | naimiṣāraṇyake kṣetre purāsīnnagarī śubhā || 4 || hiraṇyānāmataḥ svarṇasāptabhaumairgṛhairyutā | hiraṇyavegānāmnī ca nadī cāste purīyutā || 5 || hiraṇyabāhusaṃjñaśca rājā ceyeṣa vai kratum | naimiṣe sa ṛṣīn sarvān papraccha yajñabhūmikām || 6 || te tu prāhurmahākṣetraṃ puṣkaraṃ makhayogyakam | tasminniṣṭaṃ hutaṃ sarvaṃ puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet| || 7 || rājā prāha kraturme puṣkare niṣpādyatāṃ śubhaḥ | tato jagāma rājarṣiḥ puṣkaraṃ sarvasaṃbhṛtaḥ || 8 || gavāṃ ca daśalakṣāṇi sārdhaṃ lakṣaṃ tu vājinām | dvipañcāśatsahasrāṇi gajendrāṇāṃ rathāyutam || 9 || maṇimāṇikyaratnāni vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca | teṣāṃ saṃkhyā tvasaṃkhyaiva kuberasya dhanaṃ yathā || 1.561.1 0|| bhakṣyabhojyāni pānāni pravartante divāniśam | pravartitastato yajñaścāhūto yatra viśvasṛṭ || 11 || śukraścāpi tadāhūto nānye devā hi bhūsuraiḥ | anyadevaiśca kiṃ kāryaṃ dvābhyāṃ sarvaṃ prapūjitam || 1 2|| na viṣṇuśca na cādityā na candro varuṇo na ca | na rudro na marutaśca nānye diśyā na pālakāḥ || 1 3|| yajñe pravartite yajñacchidrānveṣaṇatatparāḥ | vighnaṃ kartuṃ samāyātā hyasurā devakaṇṭakāḥ || 14|| sarvaśo dānavā daityā bhūtavetālarākṣasāḥ | pibanti somaṃ yajñāṃgaṃ bhakṣayanti sma bhūsurān || 15|| agnirvināśito yajñayūpaśca maṇḍapo hataḥ | brahmā śakro devatāśca vīkṣyākasmikanaṣṭatām || 16 || adṛśyatāṃ gatāstasmāt sthānād vighnamayāttataḥ | hiraṇyabāhuḥ kupito brāhmaṇān prati vai tadā || 17|| yajñe jyeṣṭhānanāhūya devān viprā hi bhikṣukāḥ | apalāyanta me yajñaṃ tyaktvā svārthaparā yataḥ || 18|| atha daityāḥ prasaṃgṛhya saṃbhārān prayayurgṛhān | rājāvicārayannāyaṃ pauruṣasya kṣaṇo mama || 19|| na kopasya na yuddhasya ruṣṭe devādimaṇḍale | ekākī hayamāruhya sahapatnyā vrajāmyaham || 1.561.20 || yatrādityā na na viṣṇurna rudro na ca candramāḥ | tathānye na diśāpālāḥ kathaṃ yajñaḥ susiddhyati ||2 1 || lolupā brāhmaṇāḥ sarvajihirṣavo na rakṣakāḥ | kintu te dhvaṃsakā jātā lobhamūlā aśaktakāḥ ||22|| yadi me vidyate satyaṃ bhavantu brahmarākṣasāḥ | sakaṇṭake nirudake pradeśe naṣṭacetanāḥ ||23|| śāpaṃ śrutvā ca vai vipraiḥ śapto rājāpi dūrataḥ | arakṣitā tvaṃ yajñasya kṣatriyādhama eva ca ||24|| anaghānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ śāpado bhava vai kharaḥ | vane dvādaśavarṣāṇi babhūvuḥ khararākṣasāḥ ||25|| atha kāle gate’raṇye devarṣirnārado muniḥ | ājagāma dadarśaitān kharaṃ ca rākṣasām̐stathā ||26|| kharo nanāma devarṣiṃ papraccha mokṣakāraṇam | nāradastu tadā prāha nārmadaṃ jalamuttamam ||27|| revācarukasambhede snātvā muktiṃ prayāsyasi | brāhmaṇā rākṣasāścāpi snātvā yāsyanti mokṣaṇam ||28|| ityuktāste yayū revāṃ revācarukasaṃgame | snātvā muktiṃ gatāḥ sarve narmadājalasaṃgamāt ||29|| brahmayānasamārūḍhāḥ stūyamānāśca bandibhiḥ | yayurdivyaṃ brahmalokaṃ narmadāvārisaṃgamāt ||1.561.30|| yatra viṣṇustathā rudro sūryo nārāyaṇastathā | tatra śrīrvijayaścaiva bhuktirmuktiśca śāśvatī ||3 1|| yatra bhaktirgurau cāste yathā deve tathā gurau | tasya kāmāḥ prasiddhyanti gurvātmakaharerbalāt ||32|| śravaṇāt kīrtanādasya smaraṇāt sevanādapi | vandanāddhāraṇādvāpi mucyate bhavabandhanāt ||33|| athātiśreṣṭhatīrthaṃ cāmarakaṇṭakamucyate | tadārabhya giriśreṣṭhaṃ sarvaṃ puṇyatamaṃ smṛtam ||34|| yāvadvai saṃgatā revāṃ caturnāmnī mahānadī | uttare vartate yajñaparvataḥ pāvano mahān ||35|| svayaṃbhuvā purā tasminnaṣṭaḥ sautrāmaṇirmakhaḥ | tatraiveṣṭaṃ maghavatā hayamedhena vai purā || 36|| dadhīcinātha devaiśca tatraiveṣṭaṃ mahāmakhaiḥ | sa yāvat sagamo nadyāḥ sa yāvadyajñaparvataḥ ||37|| rajaḥ sarvaṃ pavitraṃ vai vartate mokṣadāyakam | brahmaputraḥ suparṇaśca ṛṣiryatrābhavatpurā ||38|| saṃgame vāsakṛd vidvān sarvaśāstravicakṣaṇaḥ | puruhūtā tasya bhāryā dharmapatnī pativratā ||39|| ekadā tvabravīd vākyaṃ saṃprasādya nijaṃ patim | ṛtukāle yathāyogye māṃ bhajasva mahāmune ||1.561.40|| jāyate me yathāputraḥ sarvasantānapāvanaḥ | putreṇa lokān jayati tṛpyanti pitṛdevatāḥ ||41 || aputrasya gatirnāsti tasmātputramajījanaḥ | brāhmaṇastu tadā prāhāmāvāsyā varjitā priye ||42|| nātra saṃgaḥ prakartavyaḥ pitṝṇāmapi bādhakaḥ | divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu taptaṃ me duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ ||43|| tadvināśo yathā syānna tathānyatra dine tava | garbhalābhāya ca priye yatiṣye mā śucaṃ vraja ||44|| ityuktā sā tadovāca patnī ṛṣiṃ suparṇakam | paśyātra nārmade tīrthe snānamātreṇa pāpataḥ ||45|| mukto bhūtvā hi cāṇḍālo vimānena divaṃ yayau | na taptaṃ na hutaṃ tena na japtaṃ na yamāḥ kṛtāḥ ||46|| niyamān sa na jānāti tathāpyasau divaṃ gataḥ | vrataṃ naiva kṛtaṃ tena rājasvalyaṃ na pālitam ||47|| na kṛtāni vratāhāni tathāpi sa divaṃ gataḥ | tīrthasyāsya tu māhātmyaṃ paramaṃ tādṛśaṃ mune ||48|| snānamātreṇa pāpānāṃ nāśo bhavati sarvathā | tasmād bhogaṃ bhajasvātra māṃ gṛhāṇa kṛpānidhe ||49|| bhāryāvākyaṃ kvacit pālyaṃ tadā dharmo na lupyate | ṛtusnātā yadā bhāryāpatyecchā prabalā yadā ||1.561.5 0|| bhāryāyā jāyate tatrāvaśyaṃ pālyaṃ striyā vacaḥ | putro’vaśyaṃ prajāyeta ṛtudānena vai tadā ||51 || tatra vrataṃ vihātavyaṃ parvāpi cotsavo’pi ca | anutsāhahate kāle na garbho’patyadāyakaḥ ||52|| vatsarāṇāṃ sahasre ca vinā saṃgena vai gate | etādṛśe sthale dharmaḥ priyāvākyaṃ na cetaraḥ ||53|| nāpavādo na vā bādho na vā doṣo’tra vidyate | dāvānale mahāraṇye kiyanmātraṃ tṛṇādikam ||54|| amṛtānāṃ samudreṣu kiyanmātraṃ viṣatṛṇam | madhyāhnasūryavelāyāṃ kiyanmātraṃ gṛhe tamaḥ ||55|| puṇyaparvatasaṃsthāne kiyanmātraṃ hyamādinam | tasmādadyaiva māṃ nātha bhajātipremabhāvataḥ ||56 || agrahe yadbhavetpāpaṃ nāmāpuṇyaṃ hi tatsamam | ityuktaśca patistatra bhāryā jagrāha kāmataḥ |||57|| dadau putrasya garbhaṃ saḥ putro’bhūd bhāskaropamaḥ | amāśrāddhe ca pitaro bhuktvā ye tṛptimāgatāḥ ||58| tairāgatya niśāyāṃ ca prahasya kathitaṃ tadā | adya garbhapradānasya prāyaścittaṃ drutaṃ kuru |59 narmadāyāṃ punaḥ snātvā homaṃ japaṃ punaḥ kuru | vayaṃ tṛptāḥ prasannāḥ sma santānasandhihetave ||1.561.6 0|| bhāryayā cārthitastvaṃ tāṃ putrārthaṃ yad gṛhītavān | nārmadaṃ salilaṃ cātra pāvanaṃ pāpanāśanam ||6 1 || brahmahatyābālahatyāgurustrīhananodbhavam | vratanāśādijaṃ pāpaṃ vyavāyādisamudbhavam ||62|| snānamātreṇa revāyāṃ naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | ityuktvā pitarastasya yayuḥ prasannamānasāḥ ||63 || anapatyaviniśvāsahatā garbheṇa jīvitāḥ | atha kālāntare tatra suparṇauo bhāryayā saha ||64|| vimāne cojjvale sthitvā yayau brahmapuraṃ param | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ gatastatra suparṇaḥ saṃgamottame ||65|| atha vai paścime nīlagaṃgāyā narmadottare | vyatīpāteśvaraṃ nāma tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam ||66|| sāvitryāśca tapastaptaṃ sāvitrīkuṇḍamasti ca | indradyumno’bhavad rājā yajñaṃ kartuṃ samīhate ||67| | papraccha ca maharṣīn sa dharmāraṇyasthitām̐stadā | mārkaṇḍādyāśca taṃ prāhurnārmadaṃ kṣetramuttamam ||68|| rājā tūdghoṣayāṃcakre gantuṃ revāṃ prajājanam | gavāṃ ca trīṇi lakṣāṇi savatsānāṃ payomucām ||69|| aśvānāṃ śyāmakarṇānāṃ sapādaṃ lakṣameva ca | dantināmayutaṃ cāpi ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitam ||1.561.70|| sahasrāṇi ca catvāri yānānāṃ kāmacāriṇām | lakṣaṃ tu karabhāṇāṃ vai maṇimāṇikyalakṣakam ||7 1 || agniśaucāni vastrāṇi pātrāṇi kānakāni ca | nānābhakṣyāṇi bhojyāni pānāni vividhāni ca ||72|| lakṣaṃ karmakarāṇāṃ ca tiladarbhādikaṃ tathā | saṃgṛhya brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ rājā vimānamāśritaḥ ||73 || mudā paramayā yuktaḥ sāntaḥpuraparicchadaḥ | dharmāraṇyaṃ yayau rājā yatra sā narmadā nadī ||74|| yātrādrirvartate ramyo vaidūryamaṇiśobhitaḥ | oṃkāreśastathāśaṃbhurvirājate mahāprabhaḥ ||79|| oṃkārasannidhau revākoṭitīrthaṃ virājate | atra dattaṃ hutaṃ ceṣṭaṃ tapastaptaṃ hyanantakam || 76|| sarvadā sarvakāryeṣu narmadā koṭipuṇyadā | triṃśadyojanaparyantaṃ yajñayūpām̐śca maṇḍapān ||77|| kārayāmāsa rājāsau kuṇḍāni vividhāni ca | vedadhvanitanirghoṣā divaṃ bhūmiṃ samaspṛśan || 78|| nirdhūmaścābhavad vahnirjagrāha ghṛtahavyakam | brahmāṇaṃ ca tathā viṣṇuṃ śaṃkaraṃ ca samāhvayat ||79|| rudrā ekādaśa tatra tathādityāśca dvādaśa | viśvedevā stathā sādhyā maruto vasavastathā ||1.561.80 || lokapālāḥ samudrāśca nadyaḥ śailāḥ supādapāḥ | dikpālā bhūtapālāśca tīrthāni pitarastathā ||8 1 || siddhakinnaragandharvā nāgarākṣasaguhyakāḥ | vidyādhrāścāraṇāścāpyāyayustatra kratūtsave ||82|| ghṛtakṣīravahā nadyo dadhipāyasakardamāḥ | babhūvurjalapānāni rasapānāni sarvaśaḥ ||83||| bhakṣyabhojyaiśca vividhaiḥ kāmyayānādibhistathā | tṛptā devāśca munayo bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham ||84|| evaṃ nirvartito yajño’vabhṛthaṃ narmadājale | babhūva dakṣiṇātṛptiḥ sarveṣāṃ yajñabhāginām ||85|| oṃkāreśaṃ svayaṃ rājā pupūja hemaratnakaiḥ | maṇimāṇikyahīrādyaiḥ karpūrāgurucandanaiḥ ||86|| gandhapuṣpaiśca vividhairdhvajacchatravimānakaiḥ | cāmarairvyajanaiścāpi pūjayitvā haraṃ harim ||87|| tuṣṭāva mokṣadātre te oṃkārāya namonamaḥ | sākṣād rudro babhūvātha mūrtimān tasya sannidhau ||88|| prāha varaṃ vṛṣṇīṣveti cendradyumna uvāca tam | āvāsaṃ kuru droṇyāṃ vai sarvadā yajñaparvate ||89|| mṛtānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ syācca pāpināmapi cātra vai | parvataṃ veṣṭayed yastu sūtreṇaikena parvaṇi ||1.561.90|| pṛthivī veṣṭitā tena saśailavanakānanā | tena puṇyena tasyātra mokṣo brahmapadaṃ bhavet| || 91 || tathāstviti haraḥ prāha tatraivāntaradhīyata | brahmā prāha ca rājānaṃ varadānārthameva ca ||92|| rājā prāhātra vai brahman liṃgamūrtidharo bhava | tathāstviti procya tatra brahmā cāntaradhīyata ||93|| rājā viṣṇuṃ pratuṣṭāva sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatya ca | keśavaṃ mādhavaṃ viṣṇuṃ govindaṃ madhusūdanam ||94|| padmanābhaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ śrīdharaṃ ca trivikramam | dāmodaraṃ vāsudevaṃ śrīhariṃ kambharāsutam ||95|| gopālabālaṃ rādheśaṃ śrīśaṃ rameśvaraṃ prabhum | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||96|| maṃjuleśaṃ pārvatīśaṃ prabheśaṃ māṇikīpatim | lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ haṃsājayānāthaṃ namāmyaham ||97|| śakhacakragadāśārṅgavanamālāvibhūṣaṇam | lokanāthaṃ jagannāthaṃ śrīnātha praṇamāmyaham ||98|| akṣareśa ca mukteśa laliteśa namo’stu te | avatāreśa deveśa vyūheśa ca namo’stu te ||99|| īśvareśa ca māyeśa durgeśa jāhnavīpate | jīveśānantayajñeśa yajñādhipa namo’stu te || 1.561.100 || vedātmakāya kāntāya dharmaputrāya te namaḥ | brahmavratadharāyātriguṇāya ca namo’stu te || 101 || prakṛtīśāya śāntāya vaikuṇṭhasthāya te namaḥ | nṛsiṃhamatsyavārāhakūrmarūpāya te namaḥ || 1 02|| sādhuveṣadharāyādikāraṇāya ca te namaḥ | sahasraśirase vedyapuruṣāya ca te namaḥ || 1 03|| asurāṇāṃ damanārthaṃ dhṛtarūpāya te namaḥ | hiraṇyagarbharūpāyāmṛtadhāmne ca te namaḥ || 1 04|| sarvagarbhāya kṛṣṇāyāntarātmane ca te namaḥ | sraṣṭre’vitre ca saṃhartre kāryarūpāya te namaḥ || 1 05|| sarvadikpālarūpāya lokapālātmane namaḥ | ardhanārīsvarūpāya tridevāya ca te namaḥ || 1 06|| anantānandanidhaye brahmadhāmne ca te namaḥ | karmaphalapradātre te cāntaḥsthāya namo namaḥ || 1 07|| saurāṣṭrakṛtavāsāya śrīkṛṣṇāya parātmane | koṭigopīkānta tubhyaṃ sukhadāya namo namaḥ || 1 08|| brāhmatejase kṣatrāṇāṃ vīryarūpāya te namaḥ | viśāṃ sampatsvarūpāya śaraṇyāya ca te namaḥ || 10 9|| pātivratyasvarūpāya patnīvṛṣāya te namaḥ | sadordhvaretase kṛṣṇa mokṣadāya ca te namaḥ || 1.561.11 0|| sādhuṣu sarvadā sthātre bālarūpāya te namaḥ | namo bhaktamanaḥkāmapūrakāya namo namaḥ || 111 || jñānadāya tathecchāsaṃpradāya yatnadāya ca | kriyādātre phaladātre bhoktre bhogyāya te namaḥ || 11 2|| prakāśāya pareśāya jīvasthāya ca te namaḥ | sarvadehinivāsāya śaktiyogyāya te namaḥ || 113 || acintyaguṇadhāmne te divyadehāya te namaḥ | apāraiśvaryadhātre te dṛśyarūpāya te namaḥ || 1 14|| adṛśyarūparūpāya nityajñāya ca te namaḥ | sarvatattvasvarūpāya maṇḍapāya ca te namaḥ || 1 15|| pañcāgnikṛtarūpāya vratasthāya ca te namaḥ | puṇyadāya maheśāya sarveśāya ca te namaḥ || 116 || sarvaduḥkhavināśitre vahnirūpāya te namaḥ | namo’stu sruksruvādyātmayajñapātrāya te namaḥ || 1 17|| dakṣiṇāpataye tubhyaṃ cāśīrvādāya te namaḥ | tṛptaye śāntirūpāya rasarūpāya te namaḥ || 1 18|| sarvendriyanivāsāya satyakāmāya te namaḥ | ādityādisvarūpāya vṛṣarūpāya te namaḥ || 11 9|| namaskārasya pātrāyārpaṇapātrāya te namaḥ | tvatprasādāt kṛpāsindho yajñasiddhirmamābhavat 1.561.120 || karaṃ gṛhāṇa me viṣṇo yathā patnīkaraṃ varaḥ | dehi me caraṇe vāsaṃ nānyaṃ vṛṇomi keśava || 121 || viṣṇuḥ śrutvā paraṃ stotraṃ prasannaḥ prāha bhūpatim | varaṃ vṛṇu varaṃ rājan yatte manasi vartate || 1 22|| dadāmi te na sandeho yajñasiddhirbhaviṣyati | indradyumnastadovāca oṃkāranāthasannidhau || 1 23|| vaidūryaparvate kṛṣṇa nivāsaṃ kuru sarvadā | yena mokṣo bhavettatra cāgatānāṃ tavārcanāt || 1 24|| darśanād vandanāccāpi sevanādavagāhanāt | prāṇatyāge dehināṃ ca gamanaṃ te pade bhavet || 1 25|| pitṝṇāmannadānena yāntu te vaiṣṇavaṃ padam | api kīṭapataṃgādyā yāntvatra paramāṃ gatim || 126 || tathāstviti hariḥ prāha cāvātatāra tatra ca | tīrthānyapi sthitānyatra nārāyaṇapadāmbuje || 1 27|| avateruśca tīrthāni narmadāyāṃ kratukṣitau | nīlagaṃgāsaṃgame ca vartante mokṣadāni vai || 128|| rājā revāṃ pratuṣṭāva saptadhārāmayī bhava | ityevamarthayāmāsa sāpi saptapravāhiṇī || 129|| sañjātā mokṣadā revā sarvatīrthamayī satī | dānaṃ hutaṃ japastaptaṃ sarvamatrākṣayaṃ bhavet| || 1.561.130 || ityevaṃ vai kratuṃ kṛtvā cendradyumno hi narmadām | viṣṇuṃ devān tathauṃkāraṃ namaskṛtya yayau gṛham ||1 31 || devādyā mānavādyāśca yajñe tṛptā yayurgṛham | śravaṇātkīrtanādasya gosahasraphalaṃ labhet || 1 32|| śaṃkaraḥ pārvatīṃ prāha mokṣaścātra bhavet priye | lakṣmi tīrthaṃ mayoktaṃ te bhuktimuktipradaṃ param || 1 33|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jāleśvaratīrthaṃ hiraṇyabāhurājño gardabhatāmuktiḥ, revācarukasaṃbhedatīrtham, amarakaṇṭakatīrthaṃ, yajñaparvataḥ, suparṇakathā, oṃkāratīrthamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikaṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||561||
<1.562> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi śaṃbhunā kīrtitāṃ kathāmaghāpahām | pārvatyai ṛkṣakādrau tāṃ kathayāmi prapāvanīm || 1 || vasudāno’bhavad rājāvadhyāyāḥ sārvabhaumakaḥ | īje yāgasahasreṇa hayamedhena mādhavam || 2 || sapādalakṣamadhikaṃ sarvā jīvanti tatprajāḥ | tadā daityāśca revāyāstaṭe vai dakṣiṇe śaṭhāḥ || 3 || ketumālī suketuśca sumukho dundubhistathā | dharmavighnaprakartāro’bhavan yajñavibhaṃjakāḥ || 4 || amarakaṇṭake yajñān kartuṃ vāñcchati ko’pi na | tadā rājā yayau revāṃ yajñaṃ kartuṃ mahābalaḥ || 5 || brāhmaṇaiḥ sahito vidvān ṛtvigbhirvedapāragaiḥ | gavāṃ ca pañcalakṣāṇi savatsānāṃ payomucām || 6 || sapādalakṣamaśvānāṃ dantināmayutaṃ tathā | maṇimāṇikyaratnāni hemarūpyavasūni ca || 7 || vividhaṃ bhakṣyabhojyaṃ ca ājyaṃ vrīhitilāṃstathā | maṇḍapān yajñayūpām̐śca samādāya sa bhūpatiḥ || 8 || gatvā saṃśodhayāmāsa bhūmiṃ cakāra maṇḍapān | vedikā yajñakuṇḍām̐śca sthāpayāmāsa cānalam || 9 || juhāvājyāni havyāni toṣayāmāsa mādhavam | devān pitṝnṛṣīn viprām̐starpayāmāsa bhojanaiḥ || 1.562.1 0|| dakṣiṇādipradānaiśca jīvān kaṇatṛṇādibhiḥ | asurāṇāṃ samavāyo vighnārthaṃ cāyayau tadā || 11 || rājñā divyāstrasandhānairhato vidrāvitaśca saḥ | evaṃ pravartito yajño nirvighno vāsudānakaḥ || 1 2|| āvabhṛthyodakaiḥ klinnā vasudhā hemanirmitā | babhūvurlulitā ye tu kardame mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ || 13 || te hemavarṇakāstatra babhūvuḥ puṇyayogataḥ | yugapajjaladhārābhirbrahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || 14|| pūjitāstajjalaṃ caikībhūya prasravaṇātmakam | tathā snānodakaṃ sarvadevānāmṛṣibhiḥ kṛtam || 15 || tatpravāho’pi militastatra prasravaṇe tadā | gavāṃ mutrapravāhāśca lakṣāṇāṃ tatra saṃgatāḥ || 16 || bhakṣyabhojyādiśiṣṭānāṃ kṣīrājyānāṃ ca nirjharāḥ | homaprasādabhūtānāṃ dugdhānāṃ ca pravāhakāḥ || 17|| militā yajñanimne te pravāhā āpagātmakāḥ | kapilā nāma vai citrajalā saritprapāvanī || 18|| narmadāṃ saṃgatā so’yaṃ rudrāvartaḥ pradeśakaḥ | devarṣimunibhiścitrajalānyālokya sā nadī || 1 9|| kapileti kṛtā nāmnā dakṣiṇātoṣaṇottaram | varaṃ daduste rājñe vai kapilāsaṃgame ca ye ||1.562.20 || narmadāyāṃ prasnāsyanti drakṣyanti ca maheśvaram | viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇa te’tra divyānaiḥ paraṃ padam ||2 1 || yāsyanti cāpi kīṭādyā ye mariṣyanti cātra vai | evaṃ varaṃ paraṃ datvā sarve yayurnijālayān || 22|| vasudānaḥ kratuṃ kṛtvāvadhyāyāṃ samupāgataḥ | śravaṇāt kīrtanādasya mucyate bhavabandhanāt ||23 || athābhūd viśravā rājā mathurāyā mahābalī | arundhatīprasūtāyā dākṣāyaṇyāḥ suto hi saḥ ||24|| tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena yayāvamarakaṇṭakam | snātvā dhyāne sthito rājā narmadāyāstaṭe yadā ||25|| tāvat paśyati madhyāhne pratīcyādityamaṇḍalāt | dvau sūryau pūrvadigbhāge gatau dvau dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ||26|| dvau pātālaṃ tathā cordhvaṃ dvau sūryau caṇḍarūpiṇau | kālaḥ saṃvartako vahniḥ prajajvālāmbare tadā ||27|| raudrāśca dāruṇā vātā vavurvikṣobhakāriṇaḥ | digdāho bhūmikampaśca ulkāpātāśca dāruṇāḥ || 28|| samabhavan tadā pṛthvyāṃ rājā dhyānādajāgarīt | tṛṣārto dāhasantapto jalaṃ pātuṃ tu narmadām || 29|| yayau yāvattu tāvadvai jalaṃ kiñcinna vidyate | pravāho vilayaṃ yāto jalaṃ lebhe na kutracit ||1.562.3 0|| jalaṃ vinādya maraṇaṃ dhruvaṃ me cetyacintayat | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sasmāra vai tadā || 31 || oṃkāranāthaṃ sasmāra tāvad dadarśa puṣpitam | phalitaṃ patraśobhāḍhyaṃ kalpavṛkṣaṃ suśākhinam ||32|| taddṛṣṭvā śītalāṃ chāyāṃ prāpya rājā sthiro’bhavat | śarīramamṛtaṃ jātaṃ tṛṣātāpo nyavartata ||33|| jīvitāśābhavat tasya tato rājā dadarśa ha | śayānaṃ puruṣaṃ divyaṃ chāyāyāṃ dīptatejasam || 34|| kubhāḥ pārśve ca catvārastasya tiṣṭhanti sodakāḥ | taṃ praṇamya sthito rājā viṣṇurūpaṃ dadarśa tam ||35|| suptaṃ dadarśa puruṣaṃ dvitīyaṃ tryambakaṃ śivam | tāvad dadarśa rājānyān surān devān munīṃstathā ||36 || tato dadarśa nārīṃ codvignāṃ rudhirasaṃplutām | vikīrṇamūrdhajāṃ kaṭyāṃ kanyāṃ bālaṃ nidhāya ca ||37|| sā covāca nṛpaṃ rājan stanyaṃ piba tṛṣāṃ tyaja | asmyahaṃ pṛthivī devī bālo me viśvasṛṭ hyajaḥ ||38|| kanyeyaṃ narmadā cāste ghaṭāste santi sāgarāḥ | kalpavṛkṣo vaṭaścāste vayaṃ sarve ciraṃsthirāḥ ||3 9|| akṣayāḥ pratikalpasthāḥ piba pānīyamādarāt | ityuktvā vilayaṃ yātā rājā dadarśa narmadām ||1.562.40|| sajalāṃ ca papau vāri viśravāstṛptimāgataḥ | kṛtvā tīrthaṃ yayau naijāṃ nagarīṃ mathurāṃ punaḥ ||41 || evaṃvidhaṃ nityatīrthaṃ vidyate nārmadaṃ jalam | śravaṇāt kīrtanāccāsya mucyate bhavabandhanāt ||42|| narmadādakṣiṇe tīre kapilāyāśca paścime | viṣṇostatra purī ramyā tīrthaṃ mokṣakaraṃ śubham ||43|| daityā vināśitāḥ pūrve viṣṇunā ca tataḥ param | tatrāgatya purī ramyā nirmitā viṣṇunā śubhā ||44|| kapilā paścimāyāṃ tu nīlagaṃgā pravidyate | tadantarā cakratīrthaṃ vāmanaṃ ca yugandharam ||45|| sudarśanaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ daityasūdanamityapi | viṣṇvāvartaṃ śivāvartaṃ lakṣmyāvartaṃ tathaiva ca | |46|| tatra snānena dānena hyanantaphalamaśnute | krośamātrapramāṇaṃ tad viṣṇukṣetraṃ prakīrtitam | |47|| tatra śrāddhena pitarastṛpyanti yānti mokṣaṇam | tatra japtaṃ tapastaptaṃ sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam ||48|| śravaṇe dvādaśī puṇyā rohiṇyāmaṣṭamī śubhā | tatropoṣya jano bhakto viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||49|| kārtike vātha vaiśākhe hyupavāsaṃ karoti yaḥ | daśakoṭyupavāsānāṃ phalaṃ tatra labhejjanaḥ ||1.562.50 || pativratā tu yā nārī bhaktā nārāyaṇasya vai | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tatra prapūjayet ||5 1 || tasyāḥ śrībhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ saubhāgyaṃ śāśvataṃ divi | dhāmni dadāti lakṣmyāśca samaṃ tvānandapūritam |||52||| atra tīrthe dharmarājastairthikānāṃ samādare | arghadānāya cāyāti dharmatejovapurdharaḥ ||53|| pativratānāṃ caivāgre sthitvā pādau pravandate | pradṛśya vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ tataḥ paścānnivartate ||54|| dharmarājaṃ tadā pratyāgataṃ satye ca tāpasāḥ | brahmaṇo mānasāḥ putrā apṛcchannṛṣayaḥ khalu ||55|| kasmācca kāraṇāddharmapādacārī gataḥ svayam | prahasya dharmarājaśca prāha tān paramādbhutam ||56|| pativratānāṃ dīptiṃ ca dīptiṃ māsopavāsinām | vartate devatābhyaśca viśeṣā tena vai svayam ||57|| darśanārthaṃ gataścāsam aśaktāḥ kiṃkarā mama | sthātuṃ ca sannidhau teṣāṃ tataścāsaṃ gato’pyaham ||58|| evaṃ nārāyaṇasthalaṃ pāvanaṃ mokṣadaṃ sadā | vartate tatra deveśi śravaṇādapi mokṣadam ||59|| śākalyasyāśramaṃ yajñaparvatānnārmadaṃ taṭam | abhivyāpya vartate ca niḥsṛtā carukā nadī ||1.562.60|| tatrākhyātaṃ dāruvanaṃ gīyate sarvadaivataiḥ | śakreṇeṣṭaṃ purā tatra bṛhaspatipurodhasā ||6 1 || liṃgaṃ vyāghreśvaraṃ tatra vartate pāpanāśanam | babhrurnāma purā cāsīd rājā paramadhārmikaḥ ||62|| puṇḍravardhanavāsī ca cintayāmāsa vaiṣṇavaḥ | pituḥ kṣayāhe samprāpte śrāddhakāle tu vaiṣṇavam ||63|| śrāddhānnabhojinaṃ vipraṃ nāvāpa sa ca bhūpatiḥ | saṃcintya viprabhojyārthaṃ pākamapsu vyanikṣipat ||64|| ṛgvedo mūrtimān vākyaṃ tadā prāha ca bhūpatim | gaccha rājan bharadvājaṃ yācasva brāhmaṇaṃ śubham ||65|| rājā yayau ca tacchrutvā bhāradvājāśramaṃ param | so’bhivādya namaskṛtya muniṃ prāha manogatam ||66|| maharṣe śrāddhakālo’yaṃ pitṝṇāṃ mama vartate | bhojaye’haṃ yathā vipraṃ tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi ||67|| tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhāradvājo’bravīd vacaḥ | maharṣīṇāṃ sahasrāṇi tuṣṭānāmūrdhvaretasām ||68|| haṃsalomaśamukhyānāṃ yadi bhojayituṃ kṣamaḥ | kuru śrāddhaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vai bhojayiṣyāma eva ca ||69|| dadyā hemamayaṃ pīṭhaṃ dadyā dhānyaṃ tathā vasu | madhudhenuṃ tathā divyāṃ payodhenuṃ tathaiva ca ||1.562.70|| dadhidhenuṃ ghṛtadhenuṃ śarkarādhenumityapi | guḍadhenuṃ vastradhenuṃ dhānadhenuṃ tathāpi vai ||71 || jaladhenuṃ svarṇadhenuṃ dvidalādhenumityapi | kārpāsadhenuṃ ca kapilāṃ savatsāṃ dhenumityapi ||72|| kaupīnaṃ cāgniśaucasya vastrasyāpi pradehi ca | bhāradvājavacaḥ śrutvā svīcakāra ca bhūpatiḥ ||73|| patnyai sarvaṃ gṛhe gatvā nyavedayacca bhāvataḥ | āmiṣaṃ kalpayitvā tu pitṛkāryaṃ pravartaye ||74|| śuddhena cāmiṣeṇaiva tarpayāmāsa tān pitṝn | āmiṣam ṛṣayo dṛṣṭvā kupitāścābruvaṃstadā ||75|| abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā karīṣāgnau viśed dvijaḥ | āmiṣasya prasaṃgena mūlanāśastvayā kṛtaḥ ||76|| babhruruvāca vedoktaṃ mayā kṛtaṃ na cānyathā | gomedho hayamedhaśca naramedhastathāparaḥ ||77|| kṣatriyāṇāṃ bhaved yajño mayā dharmeṇa vai kṛtam | rājñastadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhāradvājo’bravīdidam ||78|| pitṝṇāṃ bhojane rājam̐stvayā viprā nimantritāḥ | viprāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ santyāmiṣaṃ draṣṭuṃ ca notsukāḥ |||79|| tasmāt tvayātra vai śrāddhe yogyaṃ naiva kṛtaṃ yataḥ | māṃsādo bhava pāpena vyāghro vyāghrī ca te priyā ||1.562.80|| vane varṣasahasraṃ tu vasudhāṃ vicariṣyathaḥ | evaṃ śrutvā rājapatnī sudharmākhyābravīd vacaḥ ||8 1 || kṣatradharmānugantā me yataḥ śaptaḥ patistvayā | pativratā ca nirdoṣā dharmiṣṭhāhaṃ tathaiva ca |||82|| tato mayāpi viprebhyo dīyate śāpa ulbaṇaḥ | bhaviṣyatha mahāghorā yūyaṃ vai brahmarākṣasāḥ ||83|| nirjale marudeśe ca tṛṣākṣudhātiduḥkhitāḥ | bhāradvājastadā śīghraṃ yayau brahmāṇameva ca ||84|| sarvaṃ nyavedayat tatra śāpakāraṇamityapi | brahmā prāha ca vedoktaṃ jātyuktaṃ cāpi karma yat ||85|| na syāccellokasammānyaṃ naiva kuryāt kadācana | vedoktaṃ lokasammānyaṃ hṛdgamyaṃ cāpi yadbhavet ||86|| tatkāryaṃ sukhadaṃ syādvai na tvekānugataṃ sukham | astu jātaṃ tu tajjātaṃ nistāraṃ vacmi putraka ||87|| vyāghrarūpo’pi rājarṣiḥ rājñī viprāśca rākṣasāḥ | prayāntu narmadātīraṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ muniṃ prati ||88|| ityukto munirāḍ bhāradvājo nītvā ca bhūsurān | vyāghraṃ vyāghrīṃ rākṣasāṃstān yayau mārkaṇḍakaṃ munim ||89|| tuṣṭuvuḥ parayā prītyā jagaduḥ śāpakāraṇam | muktyarthaṃ prārthayāmāsustaṃ muniṃ pitaraṃ yathā ||1.562.90|| tvaṃ pitā no guruścāpi harirdhātā svayaṃ śivaḥ | pāpāduddhara ghorācca janmato ghorayonitaḥ ||9 1 || mārkaṇḍeyastadovāca śākalyasyāśramo’sti vai | vaidūryātpaścime bhāge yatra yajñāstvanekaśaḥ ||92|| jātāstatra ca pāvanyāṃ bhūmau yāntu maheśvaram | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cāpi pūjayantu vratasthitāḥ ||93|| japadhyānaparā nityaṃ tapaścograṃ tapantvapi | kandamūlaphalāhārāḥ santiṣṭhantu tathā sati ||94|| narmadāsnānaniratā devapūjāparāyaṇāḥ | śīghraṃ śāpavinirmuktā bhavantaḥ saṃbhavantviti ||95|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | japantu cākṣaraṃ mantraṃ śīghraṃ bhavantviti ||96|| ityuktāste yayustatra jāpaṃ cakrurmuhurmuhuḥ | sasnuste narmadātoye papustepuḥ paraṃ tapaḥ ||97|| māsāntare ca tatraiva divyayānasthito hariḥ | āyayau śāpanāśārthaṃ divyalakṣmīyutaḥ prabhuḥ ||98|| vyāghrarevāsaṃgame ca viprān vimucya śāpataḥ | vyāghraṃ vyāghrīṃ tathā śāpād vimucya bhagavān svayam ||99|| yayau naijaṃ paraṃ dhāma rājā rājñī ca bhūsurāḥ | yayurnaijān gṛhān paścāt kālāntare ca te yayuḥ || 1.562.10 0|| vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ dhāma muktā mantraprabhāvataḥ | śravaṇātkīrtanādasyāpyaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kapilārevāsaṃgamaviśravātīrthaviṣṇupurīcakratīrthadāruvanavyāghreśatīrthānāṃ setihāsaṃnirūpaṇanāmā dvāṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 5.162 ||
<1.563> śrīlakṣmīruvāca bhagavan madhudhenvādi kathaṃ deyaṃ ca me vada | kiṃ puṇyaṃ ko vidhistatra godānaṃ ca kiyad bhavet || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi purā rājābhavanmahān | vinītāśveti vikhyāto bahuyāgakaraḥ prabhuḥ || 2 || sa sarvamedhamārebhe tena gāvo dvipā vasu | svarṇaṃ sarvaṃ ca viprebhyo dattāni bhavanāni ca || 3 || nānnaṃ tena tadā dattaṃ svalpaṃ matvā jalaṃ tathā | atha gaṃgātaṭe mṛtvā sa kālena yayau divam || 4 || tasya deho mṛttikāyāṃ nikṣipto gahvare dvijaiḥ | puṇyāṃ gaṃgāmṛdaṃ jñātvā pṛthvyāṃ nihita eva ha || 5 || athāyaṃ bhūpatiḥ svarge kṣudhitastṛṣitastathā | divyavimānavāso’pi pṛthvyāṃ bhojyārthamāyayau || 6 || yatra kalevaraṃ naijaṃ tat khanitvā cakhāda saḥ | hotānāmnā tadā rājñaḥ purohito dadarśa tam || 7 || khādantaṃ nijadehaṃ ca papraccha kiṃ karoṣi vai | rājā prāha na me svarge bhojanaṃ copatiṣṭhati || 8 || vadātra kāraṇa me kiṃ śrutvā hotā hyuvāca tam | hotā prāha tvayā pūrvaṃ jalānnānāṃ pradānakam || 9 || svalpaṃ matvā kṛtaṃ naiva tenāmṛtaṃ na cāpyate | atra karmakṣitau yadyat kṛtaṃ dattamavāpyate || 1.563.1 0|| na dattaṃ nopatiṣṭheta tasmād dehi jalānnakam | tiladhenuṃ śubhāṃ dehi jaladhenuṃ ca satama || 11 || ghṛtadhenuṃ rasadhenuṃ dadhidhenuṃ pradehi ca | dugdhadhenuṃ madhudhenuṃ śarkarādhenumityapi || 12|| annadhenuṃ vrīhidhenuṃ svarṇagāṃ ca pradehi vai | vastradhenuṃ kapilāṃ ca savatsāṃ saṃpradehi ca || 1 3|| evamanyāni dānāni dehi tatphalamāpnuhi | annadānena ca svarge kṣudhayā varjito bhaveḥ || 14|| vidhānaṃ tiladhenośca tvaṃ śṛṇuṣva narādhipa | caturbhiḥ kuḍavaiścātra prastha ekaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 15|| dhenuḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kāryā caturbhirvatsikā bhavet | nāsā gandhamayī tasyā jihvā guḍamayī śubhā ||16|| pucchaṃ sūtramayaṃ tasyā vastrayugmaṃ tu śullarī | netre muktāmaye dantā phalātmakāśca kambalam || 17|| galakambalarūpaṃ ca navanītamayāḥ stanāḥ | svarṇaśṛgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitām || 18|| kāṃsyadohāṃ caturthāṃśavatsikāsahitāṃ śubhām | kṛṣṇājīnayutāṃ sarvaratnayuktā ca nanditām || 1 9|| sarvauṣadhisamāyuktāṃ mantrapūjāṃ tu dāpayet | annaṃ me jāyatāmanyatpānaṃ sarvarasāstathā ||1.563.20|| sarvaṃ sampādayāsmākaṃ tiladheno namo’stu te | śarkarāsahitāṃ tvāṃ pradadāmi vipramūrtaye ||21|| evaṃ dattāṃ vidhānena gṛhṇīyād brāhmaṇottamaḥ | haste pucchaṃ jalaṃ cāpi puṣpaṃ tandulamityapi ||22|| gandhaṃ gṛhītvā netre ca saṃspṛśya gā samarpayet | gomayaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā dātā dadyād vidhānataḥ ||23|| pradakṣiṇaṃ namaskāraṃ kṛtvā dadyād dvijātaye | dvijo’haṃ tvāṃ pragṛhṇāmi kuṭumbārthaṃ subhaktimān ||24|| bhajasva kāmān māṃ devi tiladheno namo’stu te | dātre sarvaṃ bhakṣyabhojyaṃ pānādi dehi yatra saḥ ||25|| evaṃ dhenuḥ pradātavyā tena bhuktiśca mokṣaṇam | hotā prāha tathā dehi jaladhenuṃ vidhānataḥ || 26|| gocarmamātraṃ bhūbhāgaṃ gomayenopalepayet| | tatra vāripūritaṃ taṃ ghaṭaṃ pūjyākṣatādibhiḥ ||27|| taṃ dhenuṃ kalpayitvaiva durvāsragbhirvibhūṣitam | pañcaratnayutaṃ kṛtvā saptadhānyayutaṃ tathā || 28|| godhūmāstaṇḍulāścāpi yavāśca caṇakāstathā | māṣā mudgāśca kaṃgvaśca saptadhānyamiti nyaset || 29|| ghṛtapātraṃ dadhipātraṃ madhupātraṃ ca śarkarām | sthāpayedvai caturdikṣu tathā cāsye suvarṇakam ||1.563.3 0|| muktāphale cakṣuṣī ca śṛṃge candanakāṣṭhaje | tāmrapṛṣṭhaṃ kāṃsyadohaṃ darbhān romāṇi kalpayet ||3 1|| tāmrapatraśravaṇe ca pucchaṃ sutramayaṃ tathā | kambale puṣpamālāṃ ca guḍāsyāṃ śuktidantikām ||32|| jihvāṃ śarkarayā kṛtvā navanītena ca stanān | ikṣupādām̐stathā kṛtvā gandhapuṣpopaśobhitām ||33|| kṛṣṇājinopari nyasya vastreṇācchāditāṃ tu tām | gandhapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya pūrvamukhāṃ samarpayet ||34|| sādhuviprāya rājendra śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye | tapovṛddhāya pātrāya dātavyā ca kuṭumbine || 35|| yo dadāti naro rājan yaḥ paśyati śṛṇoti ca | pratigṛhṇāti yo vipro mucyate sarvapātakāt ||36|| brahmahā pitṛhā goghnaḥ surāpo gurutalpagaḥ | vimuktaḥ sarvapāpaistu viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ||37|| jaladhenvā vatsikāṃ ca kalaśe kalpayecchubhām | jalāhārastvekadinaṃ tiṣṭhedvai jaladhenudaḥ || 38|| grāhako’pi trirātraṃ ca tiṣṭhejjalena dharmavān | yatra kṣīravahā nadyo madhupāyasakardamāḥ ||3 9|| yatra tvapsarasāṃ gītaṃ tatra yānti jalapradāḥ | yadvā pāpavinirmuktā viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyuḥ ||1.563.40|| atha dadyād rasadhenumaikṣavasya rasasya vai | ghaṭaṃ prapūrya saṃpūjya pūrvavad vatsikāṃ tathā || 41 || caturthāṃśā kalpayitvā saptavrīhisamanvitām | sarvopaskarasaṃyuktāṃ tilapātrādisayutām ||42|| dātā ca grāhakaścāpi tvekakālayabhojanaḥ | somapānaphalaṃ tasya paśyato’pi tathā phalam ||43|| daśa pūrvān parāṃścāpi svātmānaṃ caikaviṃśakam | prāpayetparamaṃ sthānaṃ svargānnāvartate punaḥ ||44|| dadasva ca mahārāja paraṃ sthānamavāpnuhi | guḍadhenuṃ tathā kṛtvā savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohinīm ||45|| sauvarṇaṃ mukhaśṛṃge ca dantāśca maṇimauktikaiḥ | grīvā ratnamayī tvasyā ghrāṇaṃ gandhamayaṃ tathā ||46 || śṛṃge tvagurukāṣṭhena pṛṣṭhaṃ tāmramayaṃ tathā | pucchaṃ kṣaumamayaṃ tasyāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām ||47|| ikṣupādāṃ raupyakhurāṃ kambalaṃ paṭṭasūtrakam | ācchādya paṭṭasūtreṇa ghaṇṭācāmaraśobhitām ||48|| praśastapatraśravaṇāṃ navanītastanīṃ vratī | phalaiḥ saṃśobhayitvā ca dadyād viprāya bhāvataḥ ||49|| gandhapūṣpaiḥ pūjayitvā dattvā chatraṃ ca pāduke | guḍadheno pradattā tvaṃ sarvasampatpradā bhava |||1.563.50|| dānādasmācca me mātarbhakṣyabhojyaṃ prayaccha vai | vācā kṛtaṃ karmakṛtaṃ manasā yad vicintitam ||51 || mānakūṭaṃ tulākūṭaṃ kanyāgo’rthe hyudāhṛtam | anṛtaṃ nāśamāyātu guḍadheno dvijārpitā ||52|| guḍadhenoḥ pradānāttu saubhāgyamakhilaṃ labhet | daśa dvādaśasāhasrā daśa cāṣṭau ca janmasu ||53|| na śokaduḥkhadaurgatyaṃ tasya saṃjāyate kvacit | tadvaśca śarkarādhenuṃ dehi bhāracatuṣṭayam ||54|| savatsikāṃ vibhūṣāḍhyāṃ prapūjya pūrvavad vratī | gāṃ pūrvābhimukhīṃ kṛtvā vatsāmuttarato nyaset ||55|| haste tu dakṣiṇāṃ datvā gandhapuṣpāḍhyacandanām | dhenuṃ samarpayet tasya mukhaṃ ca na vilokayet ||56 || ekāhaṃ śarkarāhāro brāhmaṇastridinaṃ vaset | sarvakāmasamṛddhastu jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||57|| madhudhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi sapātakanāśinam | dhenuṃ madhumayīṃ kṛtvā sampūrṇaghaṭaṣoḍaśām ||58||| caturthena tathāṃśena vatsikā parikalpayet | pūrvoktāṃgaiḥ samāyuktāṃ saptadhānyānvitāṃ tathā |||59|| tilapātracatuṣṭyenānvitāṃ puṣpapūjitām | dravyabrāhmaṇasampattiṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ pratipādayet ||1.563.60|| prīyantāṃ pitaro devā madhudheno namo’stu taie | ahaṃ gṛhṇāmi tvāṃ devi kuṭumbārthe namo’stu te ||6 1 || datvā dānaṃ pāyasena madhunā ca dinaṃ nayet | yatra nadyo madhuvahāstatra gacchanti dhenudā ||62|| daśapūrvān daśa parānātmānaṃ caikaviṃśakam | nayate viṣṇusāyujyaṃ madhudhenupradānataḥ ||63|| kṣīradhenuṃ ca te vacmi tāṃ nibodha pradehi ca | gomayairliptabhūbhāge kuśeṣu mṛgacarmaṇi ||64|| gorekhāṃ paritaḥ kṛtvā kṣīrakuṃbhaṃ nyasecchubham | vatsākhyaṃ kalaśaṃ cāpi pūrvoktāṃgāni sarvathā ||65|| vastūni nyasya dhānyāni tilapātrāṇi dikṣu ca | vinyasya pūjitāṃ dadyāt kṣīradhenuṃ dvijāya vai ||66|| dīyamānāṃ prapaśyanti te’pi yānti parāṃ gatim | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasraṃ tu cendraloke mahīyate ||67|| pitrādibhistu sahito brahmaṇo bhavanaṃ vrajet | tato yāti paraṃdhāma viṣṇurūpadharo bhavan ||68|| dadhidhenuḥ pradātavyā dadhikuṃbhātmikāṃ śubhām | saptadhānyānvitāṃ vatsāyutāṃ śṛṃgāritāṃ tathā ||69|| pūjitāṃ maṇḍitāṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāya daded vratī | ekāhārī vratī syāt tridinaṃ tiṣṭhettu vai dvijaḥ ||1.563.70|| dadhnā tena paraṃ lokaṃ yāti dātārthitāpi ca | navanītamayīṃ dhenuṃ dadyād vatsāyutāṃ śubhām ||7 1 || pūrvavatsarvaśobhāḍhyāṃ sarvāṃgaparikalpitām | pūjitāṃ dhānyayuktāṃ ca brāhmaṇāya samarpayet ||72|| purā devāsuraiḥ sarvaiḥ sāgarasya tu manthane | utpannaṃ divyamamṛtaṃ navanītamidaṃ śubham ||73|| āpyāyanaṃ tu bhūtānāṃ navanīta namostu te | lavaṇadhenuṃ vakṣyāmi dātavyā śubhamicchatā ||74|| ṣoḍaśaprasthamānāṃ gāṃ vatsāṃ caturthapādikām | sarvaśṛṃgārasaṃyuktāṃ pūrvoktāṃgaprapūritām || 75|| grahanakṣatrapīḍāyāṃ brāhmaṇāya pradāpayet | imāṃ gṛhāṇa bho vipra rudrarūpāṃ namo’stu te ||76|| kāmaṃ pūraya me devi rūdrarūpe namo’stu te | dinaṃ vratī lavaṇāśī trirātraṃ brāhmaṇo bhavet ||77|| atha kārpāsakīṃ dhenuṃ dadyāt sukhapraśāntidām | grahapīḍāsu cogrāsu duḥsvapne’riṣṭadarśane ||78|| puṇyeṣvāyataneṣveva dadyāt prāgvat subṛṃhitām | caturbhāramitenaiva kalpitāṃ vatsikāyutām ||79|| pūjitāṃ sopakaraṇāṃ sarvāṃgāṃ vai samarpayet | rakṣāṃ kuru mahādevi paratrātra namostu te ||1.563.80 || dhānyadhenuḥ pradātavyā vrīhidhenustathā śubhā | aṃgāni pūrvavat kṛtvā pūjāyitvā ca tāṃ tataḥ ||8 1 || dīpaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā prīyatāṃ madhusūdanaḥ | sarvalakṣmīmayīdheno dhānyarūpe namo’stu te ||82|| evamuccārya tāṃ dhenuṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet | yāvacca pṛthivī sarvā vasuratnāni bhūpate ||83|| tāvatpuṇyaṃ samadhikaṃ vrīhidhenośca tatphalam | iha loke ca saubhāgyamāyurārogyavardhanam ||84|| vimānenārkavarṇena cānte yāti harergṛham athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi kapilāṃ dhenumuttamām ||85||| yatpradānājjano yāti brahmalokaṃ sanātanam | pūrvoktena vidhānena dadyād dhenuṃ savatsikām ||86|| sarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktāṃ sarvaratnādimaṇḍitām | kapilāyāḥ śiro grīvā sarvatīrthāni bhūpate ||87|| kapilā śiraso vāri prātaryo vandati sa ca | dagdhatriṃśajjanmapāpo bhavatyeva supuṇyavān ||88|| kalya pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryād bhūpradakṣiṇapuṇyadam | pradakṣiṇaikyaṃ nirdahed daśajanmotthapāpakam ||89|| kapilāmūtrasaṃsnāto yāvattīrthāpluto bhavet | gosahasreṇa tulyaṃ vai kapilādānamucyate || 1.563.90|| mṛtabhasma ca jighrāti kapilā yāvadeva ha | tāvatpreto mahāpuṇyaiḥ pūryate divivāsakṛt || 91 || gavāṃ kaṇḍūyanaṃ rakṣā gośatārpaṇasadṛśam | tṛṇodakādikaṃ dattaṃ gomedhaphaladaṃ matam || 12|| suvarṇakapilā caikā dvitīyā gaurapiṃgalā | tṛtīyā cāpi raktākṣī caturthī guḍapiṃgalā ||93|| pañcamī bahuvarṇā syāt ṣaṣṭhī ca śvetapiṃgalā | saptamī
