śvetapiṅgākṣī tvaṣṭamī kṛṣṇapiṃgalā ||94|| navamī pāṭalā bodhyā daśamī pucchapiṃgalā | ekādaśī kṣuraśvetā tvetāsāṃ cottamā matā ||95|| kapilā hyagnihotrārthe yajñārthe ca surakṛte | uddhṛtya sarvatejobhirbrahmaṇā nirmitā purā ||96|| dānānāmuttamaṃ dānaṃ nidhīnāṃ hyetadakṣayam | hotavyānyagnihotrāṇi sāyaṃ prātardvijātibhiḥ || 7|| kapilāyā ghṛteneha dadhnā kṣīreṇa sarpiṣā | nirvṛtyante’tithipūjādīni hūyanta iṣṭakāḥ ||98|| agnihotrāṇi mantraiśca vividhairbrahmavedibhiḥ | kapilā yā piṃgalākṣī sarvasaukhyapradāyinī ||99|| siddhibuddhipradā dhenuḥ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā | sarvāstāstārayantyeva dattā nadyoḥ samāgame || 1.563.1 00|| agnipucchā cāgnimukhī cāgnilomānalaprabhā | tathāgnāyī śvetakhurā suvarṇā nāma sā matā || 101 || āsannaprasavāṃ dhenuṃ dānārthaṃ pratipālayet | jāyamānasya vatsasya mukhaṃ yonyāṃ pradṛśyate || 1 02|| tāvat sā pṛthivī jñeyā yāvadgarbhaṃ na muñcati | kapilārdhaprasūtā sā dātavyā vaiṣṇavāya vai || 1 03|| dhenvā yāvanti romāṇi savatsāyā bhavanti ca | tāvatyo varṣakoṭyastu brahmaloke vasanti te || 1 04|| brāhmaṇasya kare datvā suvarṇaṃ pucchamityapi | udakaṃ ca kare datvā vācayet pradadet tathā || 1 05|| samudravasanā tena saśailagrāmaśobhanā | ratnapūrṇā kṣitirdattā bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 1 06|| dātā prayāti pitṛbhirviṣṇvākhyaṃ ca paraṃ padam | yaścobhayamukhīṃ dadyāt sarvapāpanivṛttaye || 10 7|| taddine pāyasāhāro jalāhāro’thavā vaset | dadyādvai sudhanaṃ cāpi vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet || 1 08|| imāṃ gṛhṇobhayamukhīmubhayatra śamastu vai | dade vaṃśavivṛddhyarthaṃ sadā svastikarī bhava || 10 9|| pratigṛhṇāmi tvāṃ dheno kuṭumbārthe viśeṣataḥ | śubhaṃ bhavatu me nityaṃ devadhātri namo’stu te || 1.563.11 0|| me nityaṃ svasti bhavatu viṣṇurūpe namo’stu te | oṃ dyaustvāṃ dadātu bhūmiṃ svayaṃ pratigṛhṇātvapi || 11 1|| oṃ ka idṃ kasmai adāt brahma idaṃ brahmaṇe’dāt | ityuktvā vidhinā vipraṃ goyuktaṃ vai samarcayet| || 11 2|| praṇamedanuyāyācca tāṃ dhenuṃ tadgṛhaṃ nayet | evaṃ dānena pṛthivīdānaṃ bhavenna saṃśayaḥ || 11 3|| śrāddhakāle paṭhettasya pitaro’śnanti bhāvataḥ | amāyāṃ paṭhane varṣaśataṃ tṛpyanti pūrvajāḥ || 1 14|| śrotuścāpi varṣakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ naśyati dūrataḥ | māghaśukladvādaśyāṃ ca dvādaśyāṃ śrāvaṇe site || 1 15|| kātikyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ vā dvādaśyāṃ vā viśeṣataḥ | sarvadā vā yathāyogyaṃ dānaṃ śrīgurave’rpayet || 1 16|| brahmāṇḍodarabhūtāni tāni dattāni tena vai | athavā pīḍyase’tyantaṃ kṣudhayā tṛṣayā nṛpa || 1 17|| vada te vaṃśajaṃ yaśca dānaṃ dadyāt tathāvidham | annānāṃ ca jalānāṃ ca rasānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 1 18|| dhenūrdadyācca teneva svargaṃ te bhojanaṃ bhavet | hotā caivaṃ tamuktvā ca badaryāśramamāyayau || 1 19|| rājā nāmnā vinītāśvaḥ svavaṃśaṃ vaktumudyataḥ | yayau tataśca dānādi vaṃśajena kṛtāni vai || 1.563.1 20|| tena muktiṃ gato rājā śāśvate brahmaṇaḥ pade | śaṃkareṇa tathā lakṣmi pārvatyai kathitā kathā || 121 || mayā te’troditā samyag bhuktimuktipradā yataḥ | paṭhanāchravaṇāccāsyā gopradānakṛtaṃ phalam || 122|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvādaśarasādidhenukapilādhenudānādividhiśravaṇaṃ vinītāśvenarājā kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā triṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 563 ||
<1.564> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi śaṃkareṇoditāni narmadātaṭe | kapilāmarayormadhye narmadoṃkāramadhyataḥ || 1 || koṭitīrthāni santyeva yatra kvāpi janaścaret| rājānaste prajāyante śubhe vaidyādhare pure || 2 || dīyate koṭitīrthe yad guṃjāmātraṃ hiraṇyakam | tasya saṃkhyā na vidyeta yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 3 || sūtreṇa veṣṭayed yastu yajñaśailaṃ ca parvasu | sūtrayugasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate || 4 || putriṇī bhartṛsaṃyuktā nārī tadveṣṭinī bhavet| kauśeyaṃ paṭṭasūtraṃ ca kārpāsaṃ va mahojjvalam || 5 || navatantuṃ ca yaḥ kuryād daśadvādaśatantukam | aṣṭādaśaguṇaṃ vāpi caturviṃśatitantukam || 6 || nyagrodhe bandhayet sūtram ṛṇāpākaraṇaṃ bhavet | oṃkāraṃ veṣṭayedvā yaḥ kailāsaṃ vindate hi saḥ || 7 || saphalaḥ sūtrayāgaḥ syād yatīn saṃbhojayet tataḥ | yaḥ śārīreṇa kaṣṭena paryaṭecchivaparvatam || 8 || pade pade yajñaphalaṃ tasya syācchaṃkaro’bravīt | kariṇīrūpamāsthāya svayaṃ sarasvatī sarit || 9 || snātumāyāti tu koṭitīrthe snātvā prayāti ca | kāverīsaṃgamād yāvadudadheḥ saṃgamo’sti hi ||1.564.10|| atrāntare tīrthakoṭyo narmadāyāṃ vasanti vai | kāverīparyaṃkaśailamadhye tu daśalakṣakam || 11 || narmadāyāṃ samāsādya jamadagnermahāśramam | śrīkaṇṭhaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ ca kanyātīrthe pravartate ||12|| sūryapiṃgalaliṃgaṃ ca nārāyaṇasya mandiram | lakṣmītīrtha satītīrthe vartate pāpanāśanam ||13|| mokṣado vai giriḥ puṇyaḥ sarvato’marakaṇṭakaḥ | kāveryāṃ snānamātreṇa janā yānti parāṃ gatim ||14|| kuberatapasā yā vai kauberī nāmato’bhavat | sā kāverīti saṃproktā pitruddhārakarī nadī ||15|| nānāmukhasahasraistu kāverī tāriṇī matā narmadā dakṣiṇe kūle vārāhe vindhyaparvate ||16|| payoṣṇī nirgatā candraputrī śītātipāvanī | vārāhaśarīrājjātā somagaṃgā ca tāriṇī ||17|| tatra snātvā jano bhaktyā bhave vai na punarbhavat | payoṣṇīsaṃgame tatra somāvarttaḥ pradeśakaḥ ||18|| tatra snānasya dānasya saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ na śakyate | tāpīpayoṣṇīsaṃbhedaḥ kurukṣetrācchatādhikaḥ ||19|| phaladaḥ śrīhrariryatra śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | virājate praśastaṃ tadviṣṇukṣetraṃ prakīrtyate ||1.564.20|| kārtikyāṃ dīpadāne tu cakravartī bhavennṛpaḥ | revāṃ bhittvā caṇḍavegānāmnī nadī viniḥsṛtā ||21|| tatra snātvā brahmahatyādikapāpaṃ vinaśyati | caṇḍeśvaro mahādevastatra tiṣṭhati pāpahrā ||22|| candrasenaḥ somavaṃśī purāsīt pāpakṛnnṛpaḥ | paradārarataścauro madirāpānakṛddhi saḥ ||23|| naimiṣāraṇyavāsasya śāṇḍilyasya tu bhāminīm | nāmnā saudāminīṃ rūpayauvanādyanvitāṃ satīm |24|| candraseno dadarśaināṃ jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇīm | uvāca me bhava patnī bhuṃkṣva bhogāṃśca puṣkalān ||25|| śrutvā saudāminī prāha yācasva me patiṃ nṛpa | śāṇḍilyaṃ paripapraccha rājā tasyāṃ sumohitaḥ ||26|| yauvanasthāṃ ca patnīṃ te cedadya tvaṃ dadasva me | maulye dadāmi te dravyamasyāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ ||27|| ṛṣiḥ prāha striyo rājan chalamūlā hi sarvaśaḥ | na ca tāsāṃ priyaḥ kaścid yathecchasi tathā kuru ||28|| kāmāndhaśca tadā rājā kare jagrāha tāṃ satīm | sā tu kopānnṛpaṃ prāha bhavāmyadya rajasvalā ||29|| mama sparśādadya dine caṇḍālastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi | prathame’hani cāṇḍālīsamā rajaḥplutā matā ||1.564.30|| ityukto’pi haṭhāttāṃ vai pasparśa sva kare punaḥ | tāvāccāṇḍālatāṃ prāpto rājā sarvabhayāvahaḥ ||31|| rūparaṃgavihīnaśca kṛṣṇavarṇo’bhavat kṣaṇāt | rājā tāṃ ca satīṃ tyaktvā yayau svanagaraṃ prati ||32|| avadhyāvāsinaścāhuḥ rājaputraḥ kathaṃ vane | gataścāṇḍālatāṃ prāpta ityāścaryaparā mithaḥ ||33|| vasiṣṭhastu nṛpaṃ prāha yāhi tāṃ prati vai punaḥ | kṣamāṃ yācasva gatvaiva sarvaṃ śāntaṃ bhaviṣyati ||34|| rājā jagāma tāṃ natvā ṛṣiṃ natvā punaḥ kṣamām | yācayāmāsa ca muhustadā cāhaturdampatī ||35|| rājan śīghraṃ prayāhi tvaṃ caṇḍavegāsamāgamam | caṇḍeśvaraṃ hariṃ tatrābhyarcya snātvā hyavāpsyasi ||36|| pāpasya mokṣaṇaṃ ceti śrutvā rājā yayau nadīm | caṇḍavegāṃ ca rekhāṃ va tatra snātvā haraṃ harim ||37|| pupūja parayā bhaktayā niṣpāpaśca babhūva saḥ | ante mukto babhūvāpi caṇḍavegāprabhāvataḥ ||38|| divyayānasamārūḍho yayau vaikuṇṭhamuttamam | śravaṇāt kīrtanāñcāpi ghorapāpaṃ vinaśyati ||39|| atha tīrthaṃ paraṃ cānyaderaṇḍīnarmadāgamaḥ | eraṇḍīśvaraliṃgaṃ ca vartate pāpanāśanam ||1.564.40|| kuṃkumena samālipya gandhapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet | divyavarṣasahsraṃ tu modate śivasannidhau ||41|| bhadrarudrau purā kalpe sugandharvau babhūvatuḥ | tamabhyarcya vidhānena gatau vaidyādharaṃ puram |42|| bhadreśvaraṃ tathā rudreśvaraṃ saṃsthāpya svargatau | atha pitṛpratṛptyarthe durvāsā munirāṭ kvacit ||43|| babhrāma sarvatīrthāni tato gayāmupāyayau | piṇḍān dadau tathā vāri dadau phalāni vai rasān ||44|| dadau kuśatilaॉstatra kintu vai pitarastadā | na dṛṣṭā tena muninā tadā prāha munīn svayam ||45|| kare grahṇanti pitaraḥ piṇḍānīha mayā śrutam | tadadya bho na paśyāmi tīrthayātrā nirarthikā ||46|| śrutvā tanmunayaḥ prāhuḥ pratīkṣāmādinaṃ mune | kare grahṇanti pitaraḥ piṇḍān darśe prakalpitān ||47|| durvāsā darśaparyantaṃ tasthau tatra hi śraddhayā | avāsṛjattataḥ piṇḍām̐stathāpi pitaraḥ khalu ||48|| mūrtimanto nāyayuśca durvāsāstu tadā punaḥ | eraṇḍanāmakaṃ tatra tapantaṃ prāha vai munim ||49|| nātra te syādarthasiddhirāgaccha vai mayā saha | ityuktvā munimeraṇḍaṃ saha nītvā ca nārmade ||1.564.50|| tīre tasthau samāgatya ऑkāre’marakaṇṭake || tatra sasmāra ca pitṝn brahmā sākṣāt samāyayau ||51|| gṛhāṇārpitamevātra piṇḍaṃ tuṣṭo’bhavattadā | dadau vāri svayaṃ brahmā tṛpto nārmadvāriṇā ||52|| brahmāṇārpitavārthaiva durvāsā| eraṇḍako muniścāpi dadhāra śirasā tadā ||53|| brahmakamaṇḍaluvāri eraṇḍamastakād bhuvi | patitaṃ tatpravāhaśca narmadāyā jale gataḥ ||54|| amāyāṃ somavāre cairaṇḍarevāsamāgame | tīrthe parva mahajjātaṃ pitruddhārakaraṃ param ||55|| brahmā tuṣṭo varadānaṃ dadāveraṇḍikātaṭe | adṛśyāḥ pitarastṛptiṃ darśe yāsyanti śāśvatīm ||56|| gayāyāmapi cādṛśyāstṛptiṃ yāsyanti śāśvatīm | vaiṣṇavebhyaḥ pavitrebhyo brahmavratebhya ityapi ||57|| niṣpāpebhyo mānavebhyaḥ śuddhahaddhayastu sarvadā | dṛṣṭipathaṃ prayāsyanti pitarau nānyathā kvacit ||58|| evameraṇḍikātīrtha revāsaṃgamagaṃ hyabhūt | śravaṇāt kīrtanādasyoddhāraḥ syāt pitṛtīrthinaḥ ||59|| tatastīrthaṃ paraṃ cānyad revāśakhyaviśalyayoḥ | bharatena kṛto yajño yatra śalyā viśalyakā ||1.564.60|| nadīdvayaṃ samudbhūtaṃ viveśa nārmadaṃ jalam | āsurā vighnakartāro yuyudhurbharatena vai ||61|| bharatenāsurā bāṇairnāśitā bahavastadā | bharatasya bhaṭānāṃ ca śalyapīḍānivṛttaye ||62|| yūpamūlānnadī jātā viśalyā śalyakarṣiṇī | tatra snātvā bharatādyā yajñanārāyaṇehayā ||63|| vipīḍāste viśalyāśca babhūvuḥ sarvaśo’naghāḥ | tena śalyā viśalyā ca nadīdvayaṃ prakīrtyate ||64|| pravāhadvayarūpaṃ tannarmadāyāṃ samāhatam | etattīrthaṃ paraṃ puṇyaṃ pāvanaṃ nārmade taṭe ||65|| svāyaṃbhuve’ntare prāpte tvādikalpe kṛte yuge | dānavairnirjitā devā narmadātīramāśritāḥ ||66|| te devā brahmasahitā īśvaraṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | bṛhaspatistataḥ prāha brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam ||67|| iṣṭiṃ kuru mahāraudrīṃ dānavānāṃ kṣayaṃkarīm | etasminnantare devā yayuste nārmadaṃ taṭam ||68|| bhitvā bhuvaṃ tadā liṃgaṃ samutthitaṃ mahojjvalam | auṃkāraṃ saṃvadat tatra bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca kīrtayat ||69|| parvatādutthitaṃ so’pi auṃkāragirirucyate | uvāca vacanaṃ śaṃbhuḥ sākṣād bhūtvā pitāmaham ||1.564.70|| iṣṭiṃ kuru mahāraudrīṃ daityānāṃ prakṣayaṃkarīm | tato brahmā cakāreṣṭiṃ devānāṃ śāntikāriṇīm ||71|| ityādyāstadbhayād bhagnā jagmuste tu rasātalam | oṃkārasya prabhāveṇa devā jātāśca nirbhayāḥ ||79|| oṃkāraṃ śaṃkaraṃ prārcya yayurdivaṃ surādayaḥ | kalpāntagaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ parvatāgre virājate ||73|| pañcabrahma pañcavaktraṃ navaśaktisamanvitam | śaṃkhakundendusaṃkāśaṃ sadyo vaktraṃ tu paścimam ||74|| ṛgvedo nirgato yasmād brahmā tatrādhidevatā | uttaraṃ vāmadevaṃ tu pītābhaṃ sumanoharam ||75|| yajurvedodbhavaṃ viddhi viṣṇustatrādhidevatā | aghoraṃ meghavarṇābhaṃ yāmyāṃ diśi samasthitam ||76|| sāmavedodbhavaṃ viddhi sūryakālādaivatam | pūrve tatpuruṣaṃ jñeyaṃ kuṃkumāruṇasannibham ||77|| atharvaṃ nirgataṃ turyamāpastatrādhidevatāḥ | īśānestavavaktraṃ tu pañcavarṇaṃ mahātanum ||78|| śrutisiddhāntasaṃgītaṃ somaṃ tatrādhidevatā | ṣaṣṭhaṃ sadāśivaṃ nāma nirbhāgaṃ ca nirāmayam ||79|| etatte kathitaṃ sarvamoṃkārasya tu varṇanam || oṃkāradakṣiṇāmūrtiṃ pūjayenmokṣamāpnuyāt ||1.564.80|| dadyād gṛhasya sāmagrīḥ pūjopakaraṇāni ca | jīrṇoddhārādikaṃ dhvajadaṇḍaghaṇṭādi kārayet ||81|| vastrabhūṣāmṛdaṃgādi dadyādoṃkāramūrtaye | udyānavāṭikākṣetrādīni tasmai nivedayet ||82|| tasya dānaphalasyeha saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ na śakyate | dātā bhuktiṃ tathā muktiṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||83|| dhundhumāro’bhavadrājā devatātithipūjakaḥ | yayau vindhyācalaṃ revāvanaṃ viveśa tatra ca ||84|| vārāhaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ sa garjantaṃ pradadarśa ha | hantuṃ taṃ yāvad yatate tāvat kroḍo’pi tatkṣaṇam ||85|| viveśa jalamadhye ca koṭitīrthe’tha taṃ tathā | praviśyantaṃ pṛṣṭhato’nujagāma so’pi bhūpatiḥ ||86|| tāvat kroḍo divyadeho bhūtvā vimānamāsthitaḥ | taṃ ca tathāvidhaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā papraccha kāraṇam ||87|| divyarūpadharo devo varāhaścāha bhūbhṛtam | aham̐ śaṃbhugaṇo nāmnā hyaṃgado’smi sugāyakaḥ ||88|| dṛṣṭvorvaśīṃ ca raṃbhāṃ cāpyabhūvaṃ kāmamohitaḥ | vyāharan śūkarīṃ vāṇīṃ kāmakrīḍāmayo’bhavam ||89|| nandī śaśāpa māṃ dṛṣṭvā śūkaro’raṇyake bhava | mayā prasādito nandī śāpāntaṃ varamādiśat ||1.564.90|| darśanād dhundhumārasya koṭitīrthaniṣevaṇāt | tyaktvā tu saukarīṃ yoniṃ kailāsaṃ cāgamiṣyasi ||91|| evamuktvā svasti te’stu samucārya yayau gaṇaḥ | rājā śilātale tatra niṣasād kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ||92|| rājño hayo narmadāyā jalapānaṃ samākarot | tāvat so’pyabhavad divyo vimānastho’mbare’bhavat ||93|| dvijo bhūtvābravīd bhūpaṃ gālavo’haṃ purābhavam | brahmarṣiḥ kaurave kṣetre vājidānapratigrahāt ||94|| dagdho vājitanuṃ prāpya revāyogena mokṣaṇam | prāpto’smi yāmi vai satyaṃ brahmalokaṃ mamālayam ||95|| mayā rājan purā rājño dumatsenāt pratigrahaḥ || gṛhītaḥ kāraṇavaśācchṛṇu tatkathayāmi te ||96|| rājā madhyapradeśasya gajavājirathādikam | svarṇaratnāmbarābhūṣādikaṃ nītvā ravigrahe ||97|| kurukṣetraṃ samāyāto dānārpaṇāya sarvathā | kintu viprā vimṛśyaiva rājño ghoraṃ pratigraham ||98|| na jagṛhustadā rājā sthānaṃ viprān nininda ca | abrahmaṇyamidaṃ sthānaṃ brahmahīnaṃ na yājanam ||99|| līnaṃ brahmabalaṃ sarvaṃ dānapātraṃ na vidyate | āākarṇya nṛpatervākyaṃ mayā balaṃ pradarśitam ||1.564.100|| gālavo’haṃ dehi dānaṃ grahīṣye vidyate balam | rājā rājyopayogyāni dadau vastūni me tadā ||101|| ahaṃ rājasamo jāto rājyabhogasamanvitaḥ | rājā yayau tataścāhaṃ tyaktvāgnihotra prabhṛti ||102|| vyacaraṃ bahubhogeṣu mṛtvā vāśvo’bhavaṃ tava | so’haṃ revājalenādya mukto’smyastu ca te śubham || 103|| evamuktvā gālavastu yayau satyaṃ nijālayam | rājā vicārayāmāsa vināśvaṃ yāmi kutra vai ||104|| tāvat trinetrā yuvatī sākṣādāgatya cāha tam | asmyahaṃ kapilā nāmnī sarinnārmadavārigā ||105|| tvaṃ ca rājan mama vārṣuṃ snātvā jalaṃ pibātra me | rājyaṃ kṛtvā divaṃ yāhi sāntaḥpuraparicchadaḥ |106|| yaṃ yaṃ cintayase kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ prāpnoṣi suvrata | evamuktvā yayau cāntardhānaṃ sā kapilā nadī ||107|| praṇipatya ca bhūpastāṃ svapuraṃ prati saṃyayau | śravaṇāt kīrtanādastha mucyate bhavabandhanāt || 108|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ tīrthamāhātmyaṃ śaṃkareṇa vai | śivāyai tanmayoktaṃ te lakṣmi mokṣapradaṃ param || 109|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne koṭitīrthe sūtraveṣṭanaṃ sūryapiṃgalaliṃgaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇālayaḥ, kāverīpayoṣṇīsomagaṃgācaṇḍavegāsaṃgamāḥ, candrasenasya caṇḍālatāmuktiḥ, eraṇḍīsaṃgamaḥ, śalyāviśalyāsaṃgamaḥ, dhundhumārasya vārāhatāmuktiḥ, gālavasya vājitāmuktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.564 ||
<1.565> śrīlakṣmīruvāca kena kena vidhānena janaḥ karmāṇi kārayet | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ gṛhastho’pi yena sāphalyamāpnuyāt || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu sarvaṃ kathayāmi gṛhastho’pi kriyāparaḥ | kāmalobhādiyukto’pi janmasārthakyamāpnuyāt || 2 || mayi cittaṃ samāsthāya mamatāhaṃvivarjitaḥ | māṃ pradhārya sadā bhogye bhoktaryapi kṣamāparaḥ || 3 || phalamūlāni śākāni payovratādi sañcaran | ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamī hyamāvāsyā tūbhayatra caturdaśī || 4 || vratāhāni parvakālo dvādaśī śrāddhapūjanam | maithunaṃ nābhiseveta teṣu nimittakeṣvapi || 5 || sarvaṃ kuryācca māṃ smṛtvā madarthaṃ cetkaroti vai | mayi yogavidhānena karma kuryād dṛḍhavrataḥ || 6 || pūtātmā dharmasaṃyukto mayi snehaparāyaṇaḥ | na mlānirna jarā tasya na moho rāgamatsarau || 7 || vyavadhānakarā yasya mamalokaṃ sa gacchati | ājīvanaṃ mama pūjāṃ kṛtvā dhāmni mahīyate || 8 || etacchrutvā punarlakṣmīḥ papraccha puruṣottamam | kasmin kāle tava pūjā kathaṃ kāryā vadātra me || 9 || kāle kāle ca deveśa kīdṛśaṃ karma te kṛte | kathaṃ saṃsthāpanaṃ te’trāvāhanaṃ ca visarjanam || 1.565.1 0|| dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ kīdṛśaṃ ca gṛhṇāsi vada me hare | kathaṃ pādyaṃ sthāpanaṃ ca gṛhṇāsyapi vilepanam || 11 || āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ kandamūlaphalāni ca | kathaṃ gṛhṇāsi bhagavan kīdṛśaṃ cārpitaṃ śubham || 12|| śaradi kīdṛśaṃ karma śiśire karma kīdṛśam | vasante kīdṛśaṃ karma grīṣme kiṃ karma te matam || 1 3|| prāvṛṭkāle ca kiṃ karma varṣānte kīdṛśaṃ caret | yāni tatropabhogyāni puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca || 14|| arcāyāḥ kiṃ pramāṇaṃ te sthāpanaṃ kīdṛśaṃ matam | parimāṇaṃ kiyat tasyā upavāsaśca kīdṛśaḥ || 15|| pītaṃ raktaṃ pāṭalaṃ vāmbaraṃ gṛhṇāsi kīdṛśam | teṣāṃ hitakaraṃ vastraṃ kiṃrūpaṃ tava sammatam || 16|| keṣu dravyeṣu sammiśraṃ madhuparkaṃ ca te matam | madhuparkasya dānasya puṇyaṃ guṇāśca kīdṛśāḥ || 17|| keṣu lokeṣu gacchanti madhuparkasya bhakṣakāḥ | kimpramāṇaṃ pradātavyaṃ madhuparkādikaṃ purā || 18|| kāni śākāni cānnāni peyānyapi priyāṇi te | kena mantravidhānena prāśanaṃ te pradīyate || 19|| vrate tvāṃ pūjayitvā ca yathā syānnāparādhakaḥ | kathaṃ tathā vartitavyaṃ pūjāyāṃ sparśane tathā ||1.565.20|| kāni karmāṇi kurvīta tava bhaktasya bhojane | prāpaṇaṃ te kathaṃ kāryaṃ pātraṃ kīdṛśamucyate ||21 || prasādaṃ te ca ke loke bhuñjanti pāvanaṃ param | ye ca ekāśino bhaktā arcayanti ca keśavam ||22|| smaranti satataṃ tvāṃ ca tava bhakteṣu vāsinaḥ | teṣāṃ tu kā gatirdeva tava bhaktiṃ prakurvatām ||23|| kṛcchrasāntapane raktā vāyvāhārāśca vā vrate | kṛṣṇasparśaṃ prakurvanti prapadyante ca kāṃ gatim ||24|| akṣāralavaṇā ye ca tava kāryaparāyaṇāḥ | payovratāśca ye bhaktāste prayānti ca kāṃ gatim ||25|| godugdhādisamāhārā gavāṃ sevāparāyaṇāḥ | uñcchavṛttiparā bhaktāḥ prayānti kīdṛśīṃ gatim ||26|| bhikṣopajīvino ye ca gṛhasthadharmamāśritāḥ | mādhave sarvadā saktāḥ kāṃ prayānti gatiṃ tu te ||27|| tava kṣetreṣu tīrtheṣu prāṇān muñcanti ye janāḥ | pañcāgnīnāṃ prataptāraḥ kāṃ gatiṃ nātha yānti te ||28|| pañcātape mṛtā ye ca bhṛgupāte mṛtāstathā | kaṭaśayyāprasuptāro vyomaśayanamāsthitāḥ ||29|| govraje śāyinaścāpi tava bhaktipathe sthitāḥ | tava darśanakartāraḥ kāṃ gatiṃ yānti keśava ||1.565.3 0 || śākāhāraṃ kaṇāhāraṃ gavyāhāraṃ yavādanam | saktvāhāraṃ ca kurvanti bhajante tvāṃ nirantaram ||3 1|| payaḥpānaparā vāpi kāṃ gatiṃ yānti te’nugāḥ | śirasā dīpakaṃ dhṛtvā ye’bhiyanti tavālayam ||32|| patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ dhṛtvā ca mastake | tava sevāṃ prakurvanti kāṃ gatiṃ yānti te’nugāḥ || 33|| aśmāśanaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā prapadyante tu nityaśaḥ | patrāhārāḥ pradakṣiṇaparāyaṇāśca te janāḥ ||34|| svadharmacāriṇaḥ sādhvīsādhusevāparāyaṇāḥ | jānubhyāṃ ca prasarpantastava kṣetraṃ prayānti ye ||35|| daṇḍavannamanaiścāpi ye prayānti tavālayam | teṣāṃ tu kā gatirdeva tava loke bhaviṣyati ||36|| uttānaśayanaṃ kṛtvā dīpaṃ te dhārayanti ye | avāṅmukhāstu bhūtvā vā prayānti tava mandiram ||37|| putradāragṛhān muktvā ye tvāṃ śaraṇamāgatāḥ | teṣāṃ tu kā gatiḥ siddhā kathayasva narāyaṇa ||38|| tvāṃ bhajam̐śca gate jīve madhuparkasamanvite | vahnidāhe jalavāhe kṣityāśraye ca varṣmaṇi ||39|| sāṃkhyayogasuvijñānaḥ prapadyate ca kāṃ gatim | tvatkṣetrārpitadehāśca tyāgamārgamupāśritāḥ ||1.565.40 || tava nāmaparā nityaṃ namo nārāyaṇāya ca | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||41 || iti jāpaparā ye ca narā nāryo’pi sarvathā | tava dharmaparāsteṣāṃ kīdṛśī tu gatirmatā ||42|| raṇe śastrahatā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa gṛṇanti ca | nāmaprakīrtanātteṣāṃ kīdṛśī tu gatirbhavet ||43|| akasmānmaraṇaṃ prāptā āveśena mṛtā api | tava smṛtiparā ye ca kāṃ gatiṃ yānti mādhava || 44|| ahaṃ śiṣyā ca dāsī ca tava bhaktyā vyavasthitā | bhāṣito’si mayā hyevaṃ sarvalokasukhāvaham |||45||| rahasyaṃ dharmasaṃyuktaṃ tava bhaktisamanvitam | sañcintya lokalābhārthaṃ tadbhavān vaktumarhati ||43 || nārīṃ vinā narā ye ca yāśca nāryo narān vinā | kāmatṛptiṃ gatā naiva tava bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ||47|| atṛptāśca mṛtā loke bhogyecchāsahitā janāḥ | kāṃ gatiṃ te prapadyante tyāgino vidhavādikāḥ ||48|| aprāptakāmabhogāśca kumāramaraṇānvitāḥ | tava dāsyaparā nāryo narā yānti ca kāṃ gatim ||49|| tava dīkṣāparāścāpi tava bhikṣādanāḥ sadā | tava bhakteṣu bhaktāsu ratāḥ kāmāvasāyinaḥ ||1.565.50|| tavaiva premapātreṣu premamātraparāyaṇāḥ | nānyatra gamanā ye ca narā nāryaśca vaiṣṇavāḥ |||51 || tava prāptīcchayā nānyaṃ vāñcchanti hṛdye kvacit | evaṃvidhā mahābhaktāḥ sarvasvārpaṇakārakāḥ ||52|| gatiṃ kāṃ te prapadyante tanmamācakṣva mādhava | guravo lokarājāno gṛhasthā bhogasaṃvṛtāḥ ||53|| viṣayeṣu nimagnāśca kāṃ gatiṃ yānti te’nugāḥ | yadyapi paramaṃ guhyaṃ mama prītyā vadasva tat ||54|| ityukto bhagavān viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ | lakṣmīmuvāca tān dharmān nijadharmaparāyaṇaḥ ||55|| yat tvayā pṛcchyate lakṣmi tacchṛṇuṣva sukhāvaham | yathākathaṃcid vṛttirme bhakto duḥkhaṃ na yānti vai ||56|| nāhaṃ dānasahasreṇa nāhaṃ yajñaśatairapi | nāpi vittena tuṣyāmi tuṣyāmi premamātrataḥ ||57|| mayi cittaṃ samādhāya yo māṃ bhajati mādhavi | nityaṃ tuṣyāmi tasyāhaṃ bhaktaṃ me bahudoṣakam ||58|| ye namasyanti māṃ bhaktyā nāryo narāśca madratāḥ | ardharātre’ndhakāre vā madhyāhne vāparāhṇake ||59|| yaccittaṃ nānyamādhatte mama mūrtau vyavasthitam | matprāṇā madratau saktā mallomāmatkṣudhāparāḥ ||1.565.6 0|| mattṛṣā matsahavāsā madanaṃgaparāyaṇāḥ | mama tāmbūlabhogāśca mama cūmbanakāriṇaḥ ||6 1 || mama pārśve prasūptāśca mamārohaṇatatparāḥ | madaṃgasaṃgakṛddhyānā mama nirvṛttidhāraṇāḥ||62|| te māmeva prapaśyanti mayi karmaparāyaṇāḥ | labdhalābhā guṇajñāśca mama bhaktau vyavasthitāḥ ||63 || mama loke vasantyete mama pārśve mamāśritāḥ | macchayyāyāṃ ramante te narā nāryo mamānugāḥ ||64|| svalpakena na gamyante mamānandā mama priye | kṣaṇabhaktakṛte lakṣmi duṣprāpyo’haṃ narāyaṇaḥ ||65|| mama karmāṇi kurvanti māṃ prapaśyanti mādhavi | vyavasthitāśca me bhaktau svārthe’pi tādṛśāśca ye ||66 || tebhyo dadāmi bhogārthaṃ lokān svargādikān priye | dvādaśyāmupavāsaṃ ca kṛtvā bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ||67|| tīrthajalāñjaliṃ prātaścādityāya samarpayet | namo nārāyaṇāyeti sūryaṃ vyomni vilokayet ||68|| yāvanto bindavaḥ sūkṣmāḥ patantyevāñjalerjalāt | tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ||6 9|| śvetapuṣpaiḥ pūjayanti dvādaśyāṃ māṃ tu ye janāḥ | mṛṣṭairdhūpairdhūpayanti hṛdi kṛtvā smaranti mām ||1.565.70|| namo’stu viṣṇave gṛhṇa prīyatāṃ bhagavanmama | namo’stu bhojanaṃ gṛhṇa prīyatāṃ ca jalaṃ piba ||71 || evaṃ māṃ pūjayetpremṇā śāstrāṇi śṛṇuyānmama | mama lokaṃ sa gacchedvai jāyetāpi caturbhujaḥ ||72|| śyāmākaṃ godhūmakaṃ ca mudgaṃ śāliṃ yavaṃ tathā | nīvāraṃ kaṅgukaṃ caitanmunnyannaṃ sāttvikaṃ sadā ||73 || mama naivedyakaṃ kṛtvā bhuñjīta matparāyaṇaḥ | yāni karmāṇi kurvīta mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ||74|| ṣaṭkurmanirataścāpi mamāhaṃkāravarjitaḥ | lābhālābhau parityajya bhikṣāhāro jitendriyaḥ ||75|| mama karmasamāyuktaḥ paiśunyena vivarjitaḥ | śāstrānusārimadhyastho na vṛddhaśiśucetanaḥ ||76 || brāhmaṇo’pi tathābhūto yāti māṃ parame’kṣare | mama sārūpyamāpyaiva bhogān bhuṃkte mayā saha ||77|| kṣatriyo dānaśūraśca yathādharme vyavasthitaḥ | yajñeṣu kuśalaḥ śuddho mama karmasu yogavān ||78|| mamāhaṃkāraśūnyaśca guṇajñau madhyasaṃsthitaḥ | alpabhāṣī guruvidyo’nasūyo nindyavarjitaḥ 79|| abhyutthānādikuśalo nityaṃ bhāgavatapriyaḥ |. paiśunyaśāṭhyarahito yo māṃ smarati nityaśaḥ ||1.565.80|| bhajate māṃ ca yo nityaṃ mama dhāma pragacchati | vaiśyo’pi mama bhaktistho nityakarmaparāyaṇaḥ ||81 || lābhālābhasamaḥ śānto mamāhaṃmohavarjitaḥ | ṛtukālābhigāmī ca sadā bhakteṣu vatsalaḥ ||82|| gurusampūjako nityaṃ mama pūjāparāyaṇaḥ | tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati ||83 || śūdro dāso mama bhūtvā karoti karma kiṃkaraḥ | dampatī mama bhaktau sto mama karmaparāyaṇau ||84|| ubhau bhāgavatau bhaktau madbhaktau karmaniṣṭhitau | deśakālau ca jānīto rajasā tamasojjhitau || 85|| ahaṃmamatāśūnyau ca śraddhāvinayaśobhitau | pūtātmānau lobhamohahīnāvatithipūjakau ||86|| namaskāraparau nityaṃ mama sevāparāyaṇau| bhajamānau ca māmeva devadarśanakāriṇau ||87|| mama dhyānaparau nityaṃ dāsyabhāvānvitau mayi | evaṃ śūdraśca vā śūdrī mama karma samācaret| ||88|| tyaktvā ṛṣisahasrāṇi śūdraṃ bhaktaṃ bhajāmyaham | tyaktvā lābhamalābhaṃ ca mohaṃ kāmaṃ visṛjya ca ||89|| śītoṣṇābhyāṃ viprayukto nityaṃ māṃ yo vicintayet | na tikte ca kaṭau miṣṭe cāmble kṣāre kaṣāyake ||1.565.90|| spṛhā rasye lehyacoṣyabhakṣyapeyādiṣu kvacit | bhāryāṃ putraṃ kuṭumbaṃ ca poṣayan matparāyaṇaḥ ||91 || dhṛtiśraddhāparo nityamanyakāryajugupsakaḥ | bālyayauvanavārdhakyavāsanāvarjitaḥ sadā || 92|| svalpabhogī dehayātrānirvāhamātrasadgrahaḥ | kāruṇyaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ pratyutthānaparastathā ||93|| maunaṃ viśeṣato dhṛtvārcayatyeva ca māṃ sadā | anyabhojanadānādyuttaraṃ bhojanavān vratī ||94|| anuṣṭhānaparaścāpi mama pārśve manaścaraḥ | kāle mūtrapurīṣāṇi visṛjya snānatatparaḥ ||95|| puṣpe dhūpe ca gandhe ca mama kārye sadā rataḥ | kandamūlaphalāhāro yavasaktuparāśanaḥ ||96|| ṣaṣṭhakāle navakāle daśame pakṣake’danī | evaṃ madarthaṃ karmāṇi saptajanmāni vindati ||97|| madarthaṃ tyaktasambandhāstyāgamātraparāyaṇāḥ | santaḥ sādhvyastyāgaraktā mama sevārthajīvanāḥ ||98|| ye bhavanti mahādīkṣāvanto narāśca yoṣitaḥ | tānprapaśyaṃti prātaśca nityaṃ yogijanā api ||99|| evamuktavidhānena yastu karmāṇi vartayet | tamahaṃ mama pārśve vai rakṣāmi tvāṃ yathā priyām || 1.565.1 00|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sarveṣāṃ mahābhāgavatīkriyābhiḥ lakṣmīkṛtapraśnānusāreṇa taduttarakarmanaiṣkarmyātmikābhiḥ śrīharidhāmavāsādikathananāmā pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 565 ||
<1.566> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ pūjā kāryā kathaṃ kadā | ityādisarvapraśnānāṃ kathayāmi vidhānakam || 1 || prātarbrāhme muhūrte ca madhyāhne sāyamityapi | mama pūjā prakartavyā ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ || 2 || snapanaṃ bhojanaṃ cārārtrikaṃ vibhūṣaṇādikam | jalapānaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ puṣpāñjalyādikaṃ caret || 3 || śītakāle kambalādi coṣṇodakādi cārpayet | mṛṣṭāni bhojanādīni balapuṣṭikarāṇi ca || 4 || varṣākāle hyanuṣṇaṃ cāśitaṃ jalaṃ tathāmbaram | madhyapuṣṭikaraṃ bhojyaṃ dātavyaṃ me priye tadā || 5 || ātapasya ca samaye śītaṃ sugandhavajjalam | sūkṣmavastrādi dātavyaṃ pacyaṃ bhojyaṃ phalādikam || 6 || sthāpanaṃ ca tadā vācyaṃ samāgaccha prabho priya | svarṇādyāsanamāsādya gṛhāṇa mama pūjanam || 7 || āgaccha bhagavan svāmin nārāyaṇa pate prabho | pūjāṃ gṛhītvā gantavyaṃ nijāvāse na cānyathā || 8 || kāṣṭhādicūrṇasampādyaṃ sugandharasamiśritam | dhūpaṃ gṛhāṇa bhagavan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho || 9 || ghṛtadīpaṃ saumyaguṇaṃ gṛhāṇa parameśvara | ghṛtadīpaṃ candanasya dhūpaṃ gṛhṇāmi bhāvataḥ || 1.566.10 || tīlatailasya dīpaṃ ca guggulasya ca dhūpanam | yadvā gṛhṇāmi kāle’pi puṣpasāraṃ sugandhakam || 1 1|| tīrthajalāni saṃgṛhya kṣālanaṃ pādayormama | kartavyamṛtvanusāraṃ gṛhṇāmi pādaśodhanam || 12|| snapanaṃ tīrthasalilairdadhnā dugdhena sarpiṣā | madhunā śarkarayā ca tailena ca pramardanam || 1 3|| nairmalyāpādakaṃ cūrṇaṃ snigdhaṃ śāntikaraṃ sitam | dātavyaṃ mañjanaṃ me ca gātre yogye viśeṣataḥ || 14|| candanaṃ puṣpasārādi viṣṇutailādi lepanam | gṛhṇāmi nityadā bhaktapradattaṃ bhāvataḥ priye || 15|| svarṇasiṃhāsanādyaṃ ca gṛhṇāmi kambalāsanam | paṭṭikāṃ kāṣṭhasaṃbhūtāṃ cādhyāsya cābhiṣecanam || 16|| gṛhṇāmi bhāvato lakṣmi dattaṃ nareṇa yoṣitā | paryaṃke genduke ramye mṛdau sāstaraṇe pṛthau || 17|| pārśvakābhyāṃ yute gaṇḍamaśrukābhyāṃ samanvite | kaśipuśobhite daṃśavārācchadanasañcite || 18|| guptadorakayukte ca svapimi kamale sadā | yānaṃ haṃsayutaṃ cāśvayutaṃ gajādiśobhitam ||1 9|| svarṇanirmāṇarūpaṃ ca vyomagāmi mahattamam | garuḍaṃ vā māṇikīṃ vā rathaṃ divyaṃ vahāmi vā || 1.566.20|| kandamūlaphalādīni sugandharasavanti ca | pakvāni ṛtujātāni gṛhṇāmi bhaktabhāvataḥ ||21 || svarṇapātre premapātre saṃskṛtaṃ cārpitaṃ śubham | śaratkāle yathā svasya śiśire’pi yathā svakam ||22|| vasante ca yathā svasya grīṣme cāpi yathā svakam | prāvṛṣyapi ca varṣānte yathā svasyaiva rocate ||23|| bhogyaṃ dhāryaṃ tathā peyaṃ khādyaṃ vastraṃ vibhūṣaṇam | jalaṃ yānaṃ vāhanādi vāyurdolā vanādikam ||24|| bhavanaṃ svapanaṃ vāri śayanaṃ sevikādikam | tathā sarvaṃ mama kalpyaṃ tathā deyaṃ na cānyathā ||25|| yathā dehe tathā deve kartavyaṃ cārpaṇaṃ priye | arcā ṣaḍaṃgulādūrdhvapramāṇā ca śubhā matā ||26|| catuḥṣaṣṭyaṃgulaṃ yāvat tato dīrghā na śasyate | pratiṣṭhānaṃ mandire ca netravṛttiḥ samā bhavet ||27|| dvāre ūrdhvaṃ caturthāṃśai netrarekhāsamasthalī | yathā bhavet tathā mūrteḥ pratiṣṭhānaṃ mataṃ mama ||28|| mūrtyadhaḥ svarṇaratnādi sthāpyaṃ siṃhāsanāntare | garbhe tatra ca saṃsthāpyā pratimā śrīhareḥ priye ||29|| dakṣiṇe tu patiḥ sthāpyo vāme śrīḥ rādhikā śivā | lakṣmīśca māṇikī haṃsā prabhā pārvatī maṃjulā ||1.566.30|| jayā ca lalitā śāntā manasā ca sarasvatī | durgā gaṃgā ca kamalā sāvitrī virajā tathā ||3 1 || anyā api yatheṣṭā syād bhaktasya śrīhareḥ priyā | saṃsthāpyā karṇanimnā vai yathāśobhaṃ tu darśanam ||32|| pūrve’hani bhavennaktaṃ naktaṃ sūryāstapūrvakam | dvitīye’hani kāryaṃ na prāśanaṃ ca divāniśam ||33|| patrapuṣpaphalānnāderupoṣaṇaṃ ca tatsmṛtam | ekahāraḥ phalāhāro jalāhāro na bādhakaḥ ||34|| vasante śvetavastrāṇi phālgune kesarāṇi ca | kausuṃbhāni tathāṣāḍhe svarṇavarṇāni cāśvine ||35|| citravarṇānyutsavādau caikavarṇāni nityadā | svarṇatārādiśobhāḍhyaṃ dhāryate ca mayā priye ||36 || lohatāraṃ vinā vastraṃ sarvaṃ śreyaskaraṃ matam | raktaṃ sampatkaraṃ vastraṃ pītaṃ lakṣmīpradaṃ matam ||37|| śvetaṃ jñānakaraṃ śaśvaccitraṃ bhogapradaṃ matam | nīlaṃ niṣiddhamevātra dhāryaṃ naiva kadācana ||38|| madhuparko guḍājyasva śarkarājyasya vāpi ca | śarkarākṣīramiśrasya khaṇḍādadhnostathā mataḥ ||39|| madhumiṣṭādipeyasya miṣṭapeyasya vā mataḥ | yadgṛhe jāṭhare śāntirbhavet tat madhuparkakam ||1.566.40|| āmrarasādau sarpiśca śarkarā cetyapi trayam | miṣṭaphaleṣu miṣṭaṃ ca miśritaṃ madhuparkakam ||41 || mahyaṃ deyaṃ yathāyogyaṃ śītalaṃ guṇakṛnmama | madhuparkapradānena svarge cātra vibhūtayaḥ ||42|| dāturbhavanti satataṃ cānnapānādipuṇyadāḥ | ghṛtakulyā madhukulyā dadhikulyāśca tadgṛhe ||43|| kṣīrakulyāstakrakulyā jalakulyā bhavanti ca | yatra loke ca tāḥ kulyāstatra yānti madhupradāḥ ||44|| yāvajjāṭharaśāntiḥ syāttāvatpramāṇakaṃ madhu | deyaṃ tṛptipradaṃ miṣṭaṃ yena lokāḥ sanātanāḥ |||45||| dāturamṛtadāḥ sarve rasadāśca bhavanti vai | sāttvikānyeva śākāni kūṣmāṇḍādīni sarvathā ||46 || vṛntākāni dugdhavatīgillikādīni yānyapi | tāndūlādīni patrāṇi sārṣapādidalāni ca ||47|| karkaṭīkāravellāni cirabhaṭṭāni yāni ca | saumyāni kandamūlāni santi priyāṇi me priye ||48|| śrīkhaṇḍapāyasādīni kvathitāni śubhāni ca | kvathikā rājikārāddhamāranālāni yānyapi ||49|| garmarīmarcikātiktakaravīrāmrakāṇi ca | evaṃvidhāni ramyāṇi santi priyāṇi me sadā ||1.566.50|| bhuṃkṣva kāmaṃ miṣṭamiṣṭaṃ śanaiḥ pūrṇaṃ praśāntidam | yathāruci prabho bhuṃkṣva pakvānnādīni keśava ||51 || ityevaṃ bhojayenmāṃ ca vījayetpavanaṃ tadā | punaḥ premṇā mama pātre bhaktaḥ sampariveṣayet ||52|| evaṃ vai bhojayennityaṃ svarṇāsane nidhāya mām | svarṇapātre jalaṃ bhṛtvā svarṇasthālyādipātrake ||53|| premṇā sarvaṃ pariveṣayitvā jalaṃ ca pāyayet | tāmbūlakaṃ śubhaṃ dadyāt kuryācca pādamardanam ||54|| pūjāyāṃ cāparāddhā me yathā na syustathā bhavet | māmaśuddhaśarīro na spṛśet snānaṃ vinā kvacit ||55|| mūkavannaiva yāyācca mandirasthaṃ ca māṃ prati | prabodhayenna vai mūko vinā ghaṇṭādivādanam ||56|| akāle cāniyamena prabodhayenna māṃ kvacit | śreṣṭhimānuṣarājārthaṃ jāgaraṃ kārayenna mām ||57|| svārthārthaṃ pūjayennaiva pṛṣṭhaṃ naiva pradarśayet | kṣuvanaṃ vādakaraṇaṃ maryādātyajanaṃ na vā ||58|| aśuddhavastrasahito na yāyānmama mandiram | aśuddhavastu saṃspṛśya vinā prakṣālya vai karau ||59||| na māṃ spṛśenna māmakīnāni vastūni saṃspṛśet | kaṇḍūyanaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā na māṃ spṛśet kadācana ||1.566.60|| duṣṭasaṃkalpamevāpi madgṛhe na hi kārayet | matpūjāyāṃ svayaṃ nādyānna peyāśca jalādyapi ||61 || mūkavatpūjayennaiva vinā me raṭaṇaṃ tadā | manmālyaśiṣṭasāmagrīdūrīkṛtya punaḥ karam ||62|| aprakṣālya spṛśennaiva nūtanāni ca vastūni | thūtkārāpānavāyvādi visarjayenna mandire ||63|| mūtrādikaṃ kriyāccedvai snānaṃ kṛtvā spṛśettu mām | mama pūjāmadhyavartī nānyakāryaparo bhavet ||64|| anyamanā bhavennāpi durgandhibhakṣako na ca | aśuddhapāno na syācca na ca hiṃsāparo bhavet ||65||| vastrabhūṣādyarpaṇe māṃ prasahya naiva dhārayet | śītoṣṇādau yathā svasya tathā syānme’nukūlakṛt ||66||| mukhaprakṣālanaṃ tailamardanaṃ candanārpaṇam | yathāyogyaṃ prakuryācca nādhikaṃ duḥkhakṛd yathā ||67|| śaitye vahnerupasthānaṃ nātyutkṛṣṭaṃ kriyānmama | vastrāṇāṃ dhāraṇe nityaṃ kuryād vinimayaṃ mama ||68|| bhūṣāṇāṃ dhāraṇe cāpi kuryādvai parivartanam | na gālīṃ pravadennānyanindāṃ grāmyakathāṃ vadet ||69|| na svapenmandiramadhye nagno bhavenna mandire | niṣīdenna ca māṃ kṛtvā pṛṣṭhe janamukhaṃ prati ||1.566.70 || vinā pādau samprakṣālya na gacchenmandirāntare | ārātrivartikāṃ dīpaṃ spṛṣṭvā vinā jalena ca ||71 || karaprakṣālanaṃ māṃ vai spṛśennaiva ca vastukam | nānyaṃ praveśayet kaṃcit kāṃcicca mandirāntare ||72|| ucchiṣṭānanahastādi praviśennaiva mandire | mālāpuṣpādi cottārya vinā cottāraṇakṣaṇam ||73|| dadyānnānyajanāyeti yadyapi syānmahīpatiḥ | pūrvadinasya cottārya rakṣayecca dadettadā ||74|| haste samarpya vā dadyāt tātkālikaṃ prasādanam | āvaraṇapaṭaṃ naiva punarmadhye samucchrayet | na pātayettathā madhye darśakānāṃ hyapasthito ||75|| śaṃkhaṃ jalena bhatvaiva dīpaṃ prajvālya vai śubham | vastraṃ mārjanayogyaṃ ca dhṛtvā pātre sugandhibhṛt ||76|| ghaṇṭāṃ saṃvādayitvaiva tataścārārtrikaṃ caret | nagnamūrteḥ samaye me dvāraṃ noddhāṭayet kvacit ||77|| vastrabhūṣādhāraṇādau dvārapidhānamācaret | dhūlīṃ rajo jantujālaṃ dūrayedvai pratikṣaṇam ||78|| rātrau ca śayanādūrdhvaṃ cāprātarmadhyakālikam | mandiroddhāṭanaṃ naiva kuryādāpadamantarā ||79|| madhyāhne’pi tathā naivoddhāṭayet kaṣṭamantarā | bhojyakāle vaded bhojyakīrtanaṃ vādyasaṃyutam ||1.566.80 || asaṃskṛtamaśuddhaṃ cāsāttvikaṃ cāmbarādikam | vibhūṣaṇaṃ ca hārādyanirmalaṃ cānnamityapi ||81 || jalaṃ cānyadāyudhādi na dhārayenna cārpayet | bhāvanāṃ śailaviṣayāṃ dhāturūpāṃ na cācaret ||82|| divyo’haṃ sarvathā varte vyāpakaścāntarātmakaḥ | sarvajñaḥ sarvasaṃsthaśca paśyāmi mūrtisaṃsthitaḥ ||83|| cittaikāgryaṃ hi pūjāyāṃ rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnataḥ | sarvendriyāṇāṃ vṛttīnāṃ mama mūrtau viśeṣataḥ ||84|| bhaktasya bhojane deyaṃ miṣṭaṃ prāsādikaṃ mama | yathā mamātisatkārastathā kāryo janasya me ||85|| bhojanīyo viśeṣeṇa tatra bhuñjāmyahaṃ priye | prāpaṇaṃ godhūmakaṅkuyavādīnāṃ saduttamam ||86 || madarthaṃ śubhapakvānnaṃ nirmāya deyameva ha | pātraṃ svarṇādidhātūnāṃ nūtanaṃ deyameva me ||87|| matkṛpāpātratāmāptā bhaktā bhāgavatā mama | prasādāśanayogyāste tulasīmālikāyutāḥ ||88|| mahāmantrayutāścāpi dīkṣitā narayoṣitaḥ | ātmanivedibhaktāśca naivedyaprāśane’rhakāḥ ||89|| mamaikāntikabhakteṣu vāsināṃ bhaktiyoginām | mama loke gatiḥ sāmyā caturbāhusvarūpiṇī ||1.566.90|| kṛcchrādivratakartāro yadi bhogecchavo janāḥ | te tu yānti mahatsvargaṃ vairājaṃ lokamityapi ||91 || akṣāralavaṇā ye ca vratino matkriyāparāḥ | satyalokaṃ prayāntyeva yadi bhogecchavaḥ sadā ||92|| gavāṃ sevāparā bhaktā mahābhāgavatā yadi | tadā yānti ca golokaṃ śāśvataṃ dhāma me janāḥ ||93 || uñcchavṛttiparā bhaktāḥ paraṃ vaikuṇṭhameva te | prayānti rāgahīnāśca yātrāmātraparāyaṇāḥ ||94|| bhikṣāhārā gṛhasthāśca madratāḥ sādhavaśca te | yānti me śāśvataṃ dhāmākṣaramamṛtamavyayam ||95|| mama gṛhe’ntike kṣetre cālaye mandire’pi ca | prāṇairviyujyate yaḥ sa yātyakṣaraṃ padaṃ mama ||96|| agnitāpā mama bhaktāḥ sākāṃkṣā yānti vai divam | sauralokaṃ tāpasāste prayāntīndrabhuvaṃ tathā ||97|| śākādyāhārakartāro mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ | mama lokaṃ tvamṛtākhyaṃ prayāntyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||98|| dīpadānaparā ye ca tapaḥparā mamāśritāḥ | patrapuṣpādidātāro yānti me paramaṃ padam ||99|| dharmiṣṭhāśca satāṃ sevāparā yānti hi madgṛham | jānuyānā mama bhaktā yānti dhāmākṣaraṃ param || 1.566.10 0|| uttānaśayanādyāśca yānti divyaṃ paraṃ padam | sarvatyāgā mama santo matsvarūpā bhavanti vai || 101 || yatra kvāpi dhṛte dehe mayi sandhṛtamānasāḥ | ātmanā yānti mallokaṃ rādhālakṣmyāśritaṃ padam || 1 02|| tyāginaḥ sāṃkhyayogāśca caturbhujā hi viṣṇavaḥ | bhavantyeva na sandeho muktā madrūpadhāriṇaḥ || 1 03|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyetijapānvitāḥ | narā nāryo’kṣarādūrdhvaṃ paraṃ dhāma prayānti me || 1 04|| śastrahatā api nāmaparā me bhaktisaṃyutāḥ | pārṣadā mama jāyante’kṣare dhāmni hi śāśvatāḥ || 1 05|| akasmānmaraṇaṃ prāptā yadi maccittavarttinaḥ | kṣaṇamātraṃ smaranto māṃ prayānti paramāṃ gatim || 1 06|| atṛptā naravargā vā nāryo vā me’nuvartinaḥ | prayānti caiśvarān lokān koṭikanyāprasevitān || 1 07|| mama dīkṣāparā yānti pare dhāmni mahātmatām | gṛhasthāḥ kāmabhogāḍhyā bhaktāśced yānti vaikṛtam || 1 08|| māyāyāśca pradhānāyā lokeṣu vigatajvarāḥ | tyāgino vidhavādyāśca bhaktāḥ kāmābhilāṣiṇaḥ || 1 09|| jāyante viṣṇurūpāśca ramārūpāśca dhāmani | koṭikalpāni saukhyāni bhuñjate te vikuṇṭhake || 1.566.110 || mayi snehaparā bhaktā narā nāryo’tikāmukāḥ | mama patnyo bhavantyeva śāśvatīṃ muktimāśritāḥ || 111 || guravo’pi gṛhasthāśca kṛṣṇarūpā bhavanti te | goloke sarvabhogāśca śāśvatānandamodinaḥ ||1 1 2|| ityetat kathitaṃ lakṣmi tava pṛṣṭaṃ mayānaghe | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya labhedvai śāṃkarīṃ gatim || 1 13|| brāhmīṃ vā vaiṣṇavīṃ vāpi sthitiṃ labhenna saṃśayaḥ | kathayiṣye’nyadevāpi pārvatyā śaṃkarāya yat || 1 14|| narmadāmūlake ṛkṣe pṛṣṭaṃ yat tacchubhāvaham | duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ ca bhaktānāṃ manomātravikalpanam || 1 15|| mayā dhāmānyasaṃkhyāni golokādīni cākṣare | prānte bhaktāprabhogārthaṃ nirmitāni sukhāni hi || 1 16|| bhaktabhaktāyugalāni mama bhaktiparāṇi ca | madicchayaiṣu tiṣṭhanti yāvadbhogavirāmitā ||1 17|| bhogatṛptisukhānāṃ vai virāme’kṣaradhāmani | yānti tāni yugalāni matsvarūpaparāṇi hi || 1 18|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śrīlakṣmīkṛtānāṃ vividhapraśnānāṃ bhaktikṛjjanagatisamādhānādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 566 ||
<1.567> śrīnārāyāṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi ca duḥkhāni vinā bhaktiṃ janasya vai | tathā sukhāni vakṣyāmi mama yogena sarvathā || 1 || anekacittavibhrānto mamāhaṃkārasaṃvṛtaḥ | ajitendriya āśāsthastato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim || 2 || asantuṣṭaścātitṛṣṇa udvegakleśakārakaḥ | vāsanākṛṣṭahṛdayastato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim || 3 || apūtātmā dharmahīno dayādānavivarjitaḥ | lakṣmībhogavihīnaśca tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim || 4 || rogo moho jarā glāniḥ saśastraḥ paravañcakaḥ | paraduḥkhapradātā cet tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim || 5 || mamārcanakriyāhīnaḥ satāṃ sevāvivarjitaḥ | gṛhe kleśakaraḥ syāccet tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim || 6 || nāsti devo na vai dharmo paraloko na vidyate | manyate na punarjanma tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim || 7 || ucitenopacāreṇa dravye satyapi mānavaḥ | yo māṃ naiva prapadyeta tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim || 8 || sarvabhakṣī sarvavastuvikretā nativarjitaḥ | yo na māṃ pratipadyeta tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim || 9 || abhyāgataṃ cātithiṃ cādatvā bhuṃkte nijānapi | pākabhedaprakartā cet tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim || 1.567.10 || paropatāpyasantuṣṭo mandātmā devadūṣakaḥ | karmahīno hrāsamūle tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim || 11 || ātmaśreyo hyanāsādya cākṛtvā pāpadāhanam | mṛtyukālavaśaṃ prāptastato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim || 1 2|| rājye satyapi yāmyānāṃ haste gatvā prasahya vai | dūtaduḥkhaṃ samāpnoti tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim || 13|| hastyaśvarathayānāni sainyāni bhṛtyavargakān | vihāyānyavaśo yāti tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim || 14|| aśnanti mādakaṃ kecit kecicchālighṛtādikam | śuṣkānnaṃ kecidaśnanti kecit kandaphalānyapi || 15|| varavastrāvṛtāṃ śayyāṃ sevante samabhūṣitām | tṛṇeṣu śerate kecit kurvanti nātmasādhanam || 16 || maraṇaṃ sarvasāmānyaṃ naikaṃ tyajati nāparam | jñātvaivaṃ na bhajante māṃ tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim || 17|| surūpo dṛśyate kaścit kaścid virūpakubjakaḥ | saguṇo nirguṇaḥ kaścit sāmyaṃ codarapoṣaṇam || 18|| vidvān mūkastathā kaścinna kaścicchāśvato’tra vai | jñātvaiva māṃ na bhajate tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim || 19|| vidyamāne dhane kecit kṛpaṇā bhogavarjitāḥ | dātā satyapi dāridrye bahuvyayaparāyaṇaḥ ||1.567.20 || evaṃ satyapi varṣānte riktaṃ gṛhaṃ dvayorapi | kiṃ phalaṃ dhaninastasya kiṃ phalaṃ nirdhanasya ca || 21 || dānayajñādirāhitye tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim | dvibhāryo bahubhāryo vā tadā sampadyate janaḥ ||22|| yadā caikatrāsantuṣṭaścāparāṃ sa praśaṃsati | ekā tu durbhagā tatra sadā śāpaparāyaṇā ||23 || bhoge śāpānulepaśca paralokavināśakṛt | jñātvaivaṃ bhajate māṃ na tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||24|| sadgṛhe dhṛtajanmāno sarvasādhanasaṃbhṛtāḥ | kurvanti pāpakarmāṇi tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||25|| labdhvā tu mānuṣīṃ saṃjñāṃ sarvajñānasamanvitām | māmeva na prapadyante tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||26|| kṛtvā tu vipulaṃ karma svārthamātraparāyaṇaḥ | viparītamatiṃ yāti sa duḥkhāyopajāyate ||27|| duḥkhaṃ svecchāviruddhaṃ syāt sukhaṃ svecchānukūlatā | ātmanaśca paraṃ duḥkhaṃ nityānandavihīnatā ||28|| mṛtyuttaraṃ ca yallabhyaṃ mānavena hi varṇyate | karmaṇā śāśvataṃ saukhyaṃ taccennāptaṃ vṛthājanuḥ || 29|| jīvan duḥkhasamāyukto mṛto’pi duḥkhabhāk punaḥ | tasya vyarthaṃ gataṃ janma tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||1.567.3 0 || māṃ pūjayitvā naivedyaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ parikalpya ca | śeṣamannaṃ samaśnāti tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim || 31 || trikālaṃ me prepadyante paśyanti pratimāṃ mama | bhaktiṃ kurvanti me premṇā tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||32|| devatātithimartyānāṃ gavāṃ cānnaṃ vibhajya ca | āśritānāṃ tataḥ paścāt samaśnāti gṛhādhipaḥ ||33|| te nirāśā na gacchanti santuṣṭā yānti dānataḥ | yasyaivaṃ vartamānasya tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||34|| māsi māsyekadivasastvamāvāsyeti yocyate | pitaro yasya tṛpyanti tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||35|| bhojanādau ca sādhubhyaḥ pāyasānnaṃ dadāti yaḥ | abhinnamukharāgeṇa tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||36 || bahvīṣvapi svapatnīṣu yasya buddhirna bhidyate | samaṃ saukhyaṃ dadātyeva tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||37|| ahiṃsanaṃ vrataṃ śuddhāntaro rakṣed ruṣaṃ tyajan | surūpaṃ bhogyavastvādi dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭiṃ dadāti na ||38|| śāntātmā kāmanāhīno mohahīnaḥ samantataḥ | loṣṭhavat paśyati svarṇaṃ tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||39|| pūjāyāṃ vartamāne ca yadi prāṇaḥ pragacchati | devārthaṃ maraṇaṃ syāccet tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||1.567.40 || kutsitaṃ naiva kuryācca kuryādevātmamokṣaṇam | lābhālabdhāvapi tuṣṭastataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||41|| bhartā vrataṃ sadā strīṇāṃ sākṣānmūrtaṃ pravidyate | bhartāraṃ samanusṛtya vartate yā pativratā ||42|| patnīvrataṃ tathā patyuḥ sākṣānmūrtiḥ pativratā | patnīṃ santuṣya ca patirvartate sukhadāyakaḥ ||43 || dampatī premapūrṇau cet tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim | vibhavāḍhyo jano yaśca vidhāvinayavām̐stathā ||44|| nigṛhītendriyaḥ syāccet tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim | sahate cāvamānāni vyasane durmanāḥ sadā ||45|| mama bhaktau cātisaktastataḥ sukhataraṃ nu kim | jalaṃ milati nirmūlyaṃ bhikṣayā cānnamāpyate ||46 || na cintā dravyarakṣāyāstataḥ sukhataraṃ nu kim | śarīraṃ rogahīnaṃ ca pācanāgniḥ samujjvalaḥ ||47|| pakvāpakvaṃ pacatyeva tataḥ sukhataraṃ nu kim | śītaṃ na bādhate cāti auṣṇyaṃ nābhibhavatyapi ||48 || vṛkṣavāyukṛtāvāsastataḥ sukhataraṃ nu kim | lokāḥ kuṭumbaṃ sarvatra ādhāraḥ parameśvaraḥ ||49|| cintanaṃ śrīharernityaṃ tataḥ sukhataraṃ nu kim | gṛhaṃ yasya tu pārakyaṃ guhāprakhyaṃ nirāmayam ||1.567.50|| poṣaṇaṃ parabhṛttulyaṃ bhojanaṃ śukavattathā | bhajanaṃ sahajaṃ yasya tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||51 || sakāmo vā hyakāmo vā mamālayanivāsakṛt | yastu prāṇād viyujyeta tataḥ sukhataraṃ nu kim ||52|| mātaraṃ pitaraṃ bhāryāṃ guruṃ devaṃ ca bālakān | devatāmiva paśyed yastataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||53|| śāntirjñānaṃ vicāraścānudvegaśca vivekitā | dhairyaṃ sthairyaṃ nispṛhatvaṃ tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||54|| pūjayed devadeveśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim | nipated daṇḍavad bhūmau jñānī bhāgavataḥ śuciḥ || 55|| śirasā cāṃjaliṃ kṛtvā prasīdeti vadeddharim | kṣamāpayeddhariṃ nityaṃ tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||56|| abhyañjanaṃ ca me dadyād dadyād vā tailamardanam | sarvaṃ śarīraṃ cābhyajyād ghṛtenāpi ca mastakam ||57|| ājyamānamapi tathā yāvantastailabindavaḥ | tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ||58|| tataḥ puṇyakṛtām̐llokān sukhān vindati mānavaḥ | tataḥ paraṃ pumāṃsaṃ māṃ vindatyakṣarasaṃjñake ||59|| udvartanaṃ ca me dadyācchuddhyantyaṃgāni yena me | pippalikā madhukaśca aśvaparṇaśca karkaṭaḥ ||1.567.60 || eteṣāṃ tu śubhaṃ cūrṇaṃ mama gātrasukhāvaham | evamudvartanaṃ kṛtvā gharṣayitvā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||6 1 || nairmalyaṃ me prakuryācca bhaktaḥ kareṇa sarvathā | tata āmalakaṃ caiva sugandhacūrṇamuttamam ||62|| tena me sarvagātrāṇi mardayitvā dṛḍhavrataḥ | yadvā kṣārasnehagandhagūṭikābhiḥ pramārjanam ||63|| snapanaṃ jaladhārābhiḥ kārayenmāṃ sukhāvaham | paścād gandhaṃ pradadyācca puṣpasārādikaṃ tathā ||64|| karmaṇyānyapi mālyāni puṣpāṃñjaliṃ pradāpayet| | paścād dhūpaṃ ca me dadyāt sugandhadravyamiśritam ||65|| paścād vastraṃ ca me dadyāt kṣaumaṃ śuklaṃ ca pītakam | paścād bhūṣāṃ mama datvā tvāsanaṃ copakalpayet ||66|| paścādvai bhojanaṃ datvā prasādaṃ saṃgraset tataḥ | paścājjalaṃ sutāmbūlaṃ dadyānme śayanādikam ||67|| evaṃ bhaktiṃ prakuryānme pādasaṃvāhanaṃ caret | rañjayenmāṃ kathālāpairhāsayecca hasettathā ||68|| ānandaṃ kārayenmāṃ ca tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim | bhakto bhaktā ca vā kṛṣṇe sarvasvārpaṇamācaret ||69|| phalaṃ tasya ca goloke kṛṣṇaḥ sarvaṃ dadāti vai | evaṃ mukteḥ pare lābhe tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||1.567.70|| rādhāvat sevane kṛṣṇaṃ lakṣmīvacca narāyaṇam | pārvatīvacchaṃkaraṃ ca prabhāvadbhāskaraṃ prabhum ||71 || māṇikyāvat svāminaṃ cānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | sevate sarvathā dhāmni tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||72|| ya etena vidhānena yakṣyante khalu māṃ priye | prāpsyanti te parāṃ siddhiṃ mama dhāmagatāṃ dhruvām ||73|| ahameva varārohe sarvabhūtasanātanaḥ | adhaścordhvaṃṃ ca tiryak ca koṇeṣūpari saṃsthitaḥ ||74|| nare nāryāṃ kumāryāṃ ca vidhavāyāṃ jarāyute | dehe dehinyapi cāsmi bāle yuni ca garbhage ||75|| evaṃ māṃ yo vijānīyād bhajanmāṃ sarvabhāvanaḥ | saṃsāre vijayastasya tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||76|| yena garbhaṃ na gacchedvai tacchṛṇuṣva samudraje | kṛtvāpi vipulaṃ karma cātmānaṃ na praśaṃsati ||77|| karoti sarvakarmāṇi śuddhenaivāntarātmanā | aiśvaryayukto bhavati samartho’nugrahādike ||78|| kāryākārye vijānāti kṛṣṇadharme viniṣṭhitaḥ | śītoṣṇavātavarṣādikṣutpipāsāsahastathā ||79|| kṛṣṇadhano nirālasyaḥ satyavāganasūyakaḥ | brahmacaryaparo nityaṃ svadāraniratastathā ||1.567.80|| satyācāro viśuddhātmā nityaṃ ca bhagavatpriyaḥ | saṃvibhajya viśeṣajñaḥ sādhubhaktasuvatsalaḥ ||81|| priyabhāṣī prabhaktānāṃ mama sevāparāyaṇaḥ | evaṃ yo me bhavedbhaktaḥ kuyoniṃ nahi gacchati ||82|| nābhilaṣati svargādīn mama lokaṃ sa gacchati | jīvahiṃsānivṛttaśca sarvabhūtahitakaraḥ ||83|| sarvatra samatāyuktaḥ samaloṣṭhāśmakāñcanaḥ | bālye sthito’pi vayasi kṣānto dāntaḥ śubhe rataḥ ||84|| pareṇāpakṛte naiva gaṇayatyeva mānase | mama sevāṃ saṃsmarecca mama satyaṃ ca jalpati ||85|| vyalīkād vinivṛtto yastathyetikṛtaniścayaḥ | nityaṃ maunaviśeṣasthaḥ parokṣe’pi na cākṣipet ||86 || ṛtukāle striyaṃ gacchedapatyārthī na kāmataḥ | īdṛśāstu janā bhadrā mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ||87|| garbhavāsaṃ na te yānti yanti vāsaṃ mamāśraye | ātmanā niścitaṃ kuryāt sākṣiṇaṃ māṃ pradiśya ca ||88|| paravādaṃ na kurvīta śāṭhyadhaurtyaṃ vivarjayet | na nindeddharmakāryāṇi mama dharmapathe sthitaḥ ||89|| ebhirguṇaiḥ samāyukto mama sevāṃ karoti cet | māmeva sa samāpnoti tataḥ saukhyatamaṃ nu kim || 1.567.90 || punaranyattu vakṣyāmi kamale śṛṇu me priye | taranti puruṣā yena garbhasaṃsārasāgaram ||9 1|| jitendriyā jitakrodhā lobhamohavivarjitāḥ | ātmopakārakā nityaṃ devātithigurupriyāḥ ||92|| kapilāpūjakā nityaṃ tīrthayātrākarāstathā | sādhusādhvīpūjakāśca vṛddhasanmānakārakāḥ ||93|| anāthān pālayed yaśca bhedabhāvaṃ karoti na | sarveṣāmapi putrāṇāṃ viśeṣaṃ na karoti yaḥ ||94|| saṃkruddhaṃ svaguruṃ dṛṣṭvā yastu tatra prasādayet| | pūjayet kapilāṃ bhaktyā pālayet strīṃ pativratām ||95|| agniṃ nahi kramet padbhyāṃ mehayenna jale kvacit | gurubhakto bhavennityaṃ jñānavānna ca jalpakaḥ ||96|| evaṃ dharmeṇa saṃyukto yo nu māṃ pratipadyate | sa ca garbhaṃ na gacchedvai mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||97|| bhuktvā parasya cānnāni yaścaiva na vikutsati | bālye vayasyapi ca yo mama nityamanuvrataḥ ||98|| yena kenāpi santuṣṭo mātāpitṛprapūjakaḥ | dātā bhoktā nyāyataśca svatantro nityasaṃyataḥ ||99|| vikarma nābhikurvīta kaumāravratamāsthitaḥ | sarvabhūtadayāyuktaḥ sattvena ca samanvitaḥ || 1.567.10 0|| matyā ca nispṛho’tyantaṃ parārtheṣvaspṛhaḥ sadā | īdṛgbhakto mama śiṣyo mama lokaṃ pragacchati || 101 || imaṃ guhyaṃ varārohe devairapi durāsadam | tvaṃ me śiṣyā ca dāsī ca bhaktā patnīti kīrtitam || 1 02|| ityevaṃ śaṃkarastatra pārvatīm ṛkṣaparvate | mama bhaktiṃ purā prāha tairthabhāve ca nārmade || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sukhabhāvo duḥkhabhāvaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapūjā sarvakarmasamarpaṇatādiphalaṃ janmābhāvaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||567||
<1.568> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mama bhaktiparāṇāṃ cottamāṃ matim | yadyapi syānmama tīrthe dhūlīdhūsaratā yadi || 1 || tathāpyahaṃ mahārājyaṃ pradadāmi mṛtasya vai | pūrvaṃ kokābhidhe tīrthe vārāhāvatarāśraye || 2 || kaścillubdho vihiṃsan vai cāyayau kokamaṇḍale | tatra dṛṣṭvā jale matsyaṃ baḍiśenājahāra saḥ || 3 || tasya hastāttu balavān matsyastūrṇaṃ vinirgataḥ | atha śyenaśca taṃ vīkṣya padbhyāṃ jagrāha satvaram || 4 || uḍḍīno’pi mahābhāraṃ voḍhuṃ nirbala eva saḥ | tataḥ padbhyāṃ viyuktaḥ san matsyaḥ kokāmukhe’patat || 5 || mamāra rajasā spṛṣṭo rājaputro’bhavacchuciḥ | atha kālena tasyaiva mṛgavyādhasya cāṃganā || 6 || gṛhītvā mūrdhni māṃsāni padbhyāṃ prayāti tatra vai | ekā cillī māṃsakṣubdhā māṃsaṃ hartuṃ samāyayau || 7 || vyādhapatnyā tāḍitā sā śareṇa patitā mṛtā | jātā candrapure rājñaḥ kanyā tīrtharajaḥśrayāt || 8 || yuvatyapi naraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jugupsati na cecchati | saumyaṃ surūpaṃ puruṣaṃ sarvānapi jugupsati || 9 || atha kāle gate tayoḥ sambandho’bhūdvivāhataḥ | tathā ca dampatī nityaṃ dharmaṃ pālayataḥ sthitau ||1.568.1 0 || madhyāhne jāyate patyuḥ śirorugatipīḍinī | vaidyauṣadhaiḥ sahasraiḥ sā pīḍā naiva nyavartata || 1 1|| kadācid dayitā naijaṃ bhartāramidamabravīt | kā nviyaṃ vedanā svāmin cikitsābhirna gacchati || 1 2|| punaḥ punaḥ pṛcchyamānaḥ priyāmuvāca vai patiḥ | muñcatvaṃ mānuṣaṃ bhāvaṃ tāṃ jātiṃ smara paurvikīm || 13 || yadi jñātuṃ tavecchāsti gṛhāṇājñāṃ tu vṛddhayoḥ | mātāpitrormama gantuṃ tīrthaṃ kokāmukhaṃ prati || 14|| tatra gatvā kathayiṣye mā mohaṃ kuru bhāmini | tataḥ prasādayāmāsa śvaśrūśvaśurakau vadhūḥ || 15 || prāha kokāmukhe gantumicchāvastīrthayogataḥ | kāryagauravabhāvena na niṣiddhau kathaṃcana || 16 || adya yāvat kimapi vāṃ yācitaṃ na mayā kvacit | purastād yuvayostanme yācitaṃ dātumarhataḥ || 17|| śirovedanayā yuktaḥ sadā tava suto hyayam | madhyāhne mṛtakalpo vai jāyate cātipīḍitaḥ || 18|| kokāmukhaṃ vinā kaṣṭaṃ na nivṛttaṃ bhaviṣyati | tvaritaṃ gantumicchāvo viṣṇostatparamaṃ padam ||19|| iti snuṣāvacaḥ śrutvā rājā prāha śubhaṃ vacaḥ | gṛhāṇa putra ratnāni dāsān dāsīḥ rathādikān ||1.568.20|| dānārhāṇi ca vastūni dhanāni vipulāni ca | kuru tīrthaṃ sukhātputra putri rakṣa patiṃ tava ||21 || anujajñe śako rājā dampatī vaṇijādibhiḥ | yayatustatra gatvā ca kokāmukhaṃ hariṃ tathā ||22|| devān dṛṣṭvā jale snātvā dānāni dadatustataḥ | rajanī saṃvyatītā ca prātaḥ snātau tu dampatī ||23|| praṇamya śirasā viṣṇuṃ patiḥ patnīṃ mṛdantare | asthīni darśayāmāsa mīnasya pūrvajanmanaḥ ||24|| etāni mama cāsthīni pūrvadehodbhavāni hi | ahaṃ purābhavaṃ matsyaḥ kokeṣu vicaran jale ||25|| vyādhena nigṛhīto’haṃ baḍiśena jalecaraḥ | taddhastānnirgatastatra balena patito bhuvi ||26 || śyenenāmiṣalubdhena nakhairviddho’bhavaṃstadā | nītaṃ ākāśamārgeṇa tasmācca patito’tra vai ||27|| tena cātiprahāreṇa jātā śirasi vedanā | ahameva vijānāmi smarāmi vedanāṃ hyati ||28|| tena duḥkhaṃ na me śāntaṃ madhyāhne jāyate hyati | śrutvaivaṃ tasya bhāryāpi prāha pūrvabhavaṃ svakam ||29|| ahaṃ pūrvabhavaṃ ca cillī kṣuttṛḍyutā drume | samāsīnā tadā bhakṣyaṃ vicinvānā tadantare ||1.568.3 0 || atha kaścinmṛgavyādhaḥ priyayā saha taddrume | hatvā mṛgān samāyāto māṃsān rarakṣa bhūtale ||3 1 || tāvanmayā māṃsapiṇḍo viddho vajrasamairnakhaiḥ | vyādho dadarśa māṃ tatra jaghāna ca śareṇa mām |||32||| apātayacca bhūmau māṃ patitāhaṃ mṛtiṃ gatā | etatkṣetraprabhāveṇa jātāsmi tvatpriyā nṛpī ||33|| etāni yasya cāsthīni śeṣāṇi ca mamāpi ca | galitānyalpaśeṣāṇi smarāmi sarvameva tat ||34|| atha cātra prakartavyaṃ dharmakāryaṃ pramokṣadam | itiniścitya tau tatra viṣṇuloke sukhāvaham ||35|| cakraturbhajanādyaṃ ca dravyaratnādidānakam | dadatuḥ paramaprītau pātrebhyaḥ svāni śeṣataḥ ||36|| tatra sthitvā varārohe mama sevāvyavasthitau | tasmāt sthānād vapustyaktvā śvetadvīpamupāgatau ||37|| śuklāmbaradharau divyabhūṣaṇaiśca vibhūṣitau | divyarūpadharau bhaktau mama bhāgavatau sadā ||38 || dīptimantau surūpau ca svarṇavacchubhadarśanau | caturbhujau yathā lakṣmīviṣṇū sāmarthyaśobhitau ||39|| tayoryo’bhūtparijanaścamatkāraṃ pravīkṣya saḥ | mama sevāparaścābhūt mama karmavyavasthitaḥ ||1.568.40| mānuṣaṃ bhāvamutsṛjya mama lokamupāgataḥ | sarvaśo dyutimām̐statra matsānnidhyamupāgataḥ ||41 || mama bhaktāḥ striyo lakṣmi tvatsvarūpo bhavanti vai | tejasā dīptimatyaśca śuddhasattvavibhūṣitāḥ ||42|| navayauvanapūrāśca sarvāścotpalagandhikāḥ | cārucampakavarṇābhā muktāḥ sarvāḥ priyavratāḥ ||43|| prasādānmama suśroṇi nityayauvanapūritāḥ | nityānandabhṛtāḥ sarvāḥ sarvasiddhisamanvitāḥ ||44|| eṣa dharmaśca kīrtiśca śaktiścāpi mahadyaśaḥ | karmaṇāṃ paramaṃ karma tapasāṃ ca mahattapaḥ ||45|| kathānāṃ paramaṃ cāpi kṛtīnāṃ paramā kṛtiḥ | vṛṣāṇāṃ paramo dharmo yanmamāśrayaṇaṃ param ||46 || mama dharmaṃ samāśritya rajo dhṛtvā ca mastake | prasādaprāśanaṃ kṛtvā mama loke mahīyate ||47|| mama pādajalaṃ pītvā snātvā mattīrthavāriṣu | mama sādhoranuvṛttiṃ pālayitvā muhurmuhuḥ ||48|| satāṃ sevāṃ sadā kṛtvā kṛtvā bhāgavatārcanam | śrutvā ca saṃhitāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃjñitām ||49 || janā yānti parāṃ muktiṃ cillīmatsyau yathā purā | etanmaraṇakāle’pi smṛtvā mucyeta bandhanāt ||1.568.50|| viśeṣeṇāpi te lakṣmi kathayāmi śubhakṣaṇam | kumudaṃ mārgaśīrṣaṃ ca vaiśākhaṃ śrāvaṇaṃ tathā ||51 || mamātimodapātrāṇi māsāścaite mamārcane | kārtike dvādaśīkāle navānnairnavapuṣpakaiḥ ||52 || pūjayennavavārbhiśca sa me lokāya kalpate | gate meghāgame kāle prasannaśaradāśraye ||53|| ambare vimale jāte vimale śaśimaṇḍale | nātiśīte na cātyuṣṇe kāle haṃsavirāviṇi ||54|| kumudotpalakalhārapadmasaurabhanirbhare | kumudasya tu māsasya bhavedyā dvādaśī śubhā ||55|| tasyāṃ māmarcayed yastu vrataṃ kuryāttathā mama | prabodhinīṃ pālayecca sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||56|| śiśire’pi mārgaśīrṣe dvādaśyāṃ kusumairnavaiḥ | mamārcanaṃ prakuryād yaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||57|| māsaṃ mārgaśiraṃ yadvad vaiśākhaṃ cāpi me priyam | tatra puṣpādibhiścāhamarcanīyo vrate dine ||58|| navavarṣasahasrāṇi navavarṣaśatāni ca | tiṣṭhate mama loke sa yo dadāti ca me’rcanam ||59|| ekekagandhapatrasya dānametanmahatphalam | kaumudasya tu māsasya mārgaśīrṣasya vai tathā ||1.568.60|| vaiśākhasya tu māsasya dvādaśyāṃ dhavale dale | ekabhaktiparo bhūtvā vanamālāṃ vibhūṣitām ||6 1 || puṣpāṇāṃ ca vibhūṣāśca gandhapuṣpāṇi yo nyaset | varṣāṇi dvādaśaiveha tena pūjā kṛtā bhavet ||62|| śālapuṣpaṃ sugandhi kaumudyāṃ candanamarpayet | utpalaṃ candanaṃ cāpi dadyānmārgaśire śubham ||63|| vaiśākhyāṃ sthalakamalaṃ jalaṃ śītaṃ saśarkaram | ikṣurasaṃ pradadyānme śāntidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ tathā ||64|| prāpnoti pradadānastu mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ | divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ vai vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca tataḥ param ||65|| paraṃ padaṃ sa me yāti puṇyasyānto na vidyate | na janmamaraṇe tasya na glānirna kṣudhā tṛṣā ||66 || evaṃvidhaṃ paraṃ lokaṃ prāpnuyānmama pūjakaḥ | phālgunasya tu māsasya śukladvādaśikātithau ||67|| ramyavāsantikaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayenmāṃ subhāvataḥ | śvetaṃ pāṇḍurakaṃ cāpi sugandhaṃ śobhanaṃ bahu ||68|| na sa gacchati saṃsāraṃ mama lokaṃ sa gacchati | vaiśākhyāṃ śālapuṣpāṇi śubhāni taruṇāni ca ||69|| datvā mahyaṃ ca bhaktebhyo jano mokṣāya kalpyate | prapūjya śrībhāgavatān sthāpayitvāgrataśca mām ||1.568.7 0|| pūjayet parayā prītyā naro nārī subhāvataḥ | sastuvantyṛṣayo mantrairbhaktāḥ stavaiḥ striyo hṛdā ||71 || gandharvāpsaraścāpi gītanṛtyaiḥ savādanaiḥ | stuvanti devalokāśca purāṇaṃ puruṣottamam ||72|| siddhā vidyādharā yakṣāḥ piśācoragarākṣasāḥ | stuvanti devaṃ sarveṣāṃ māṃ śrīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||73|| ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau ca marudgaṇāḥ | stuvanti devadeveśaṃ yugānāṃ saṃkṣaye’pi ca ||74|| pṛthvī vāyuśca viśve ca tejaḥ sūryādayo grahāḥ | samanvitāḥ stuvantyenaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ||75|| svayaṃ brahmā ca somaśca śakraścāgniścidambaram | stuvanti śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ lokamaheśvaram ||76|| nāradaḥ parvatāścāpyasitaśca devalo muniḥ | pulahaśca pulastyaśca bhṛguścāṃgira ityapi ||77|| ete cānye ca bahavo mitrāvasuparāvasū | stuvanti māṃ rameśaṃ vai yogināṃ paramaṃ gurum ||78|| satyalokanivāsāścāṣṭāvaraṇadhṛtāśrayāḥ | vairājā īśvarāścāpi māṃ bhajante hiṃ mādhavi ||79|| pitarastvaryamādyāśca yāmyāḥ śravaṇasaṃjñakāḥ | saṃvatsarāśca kālākhyā māṃ stuvanti tu nityaśaḥ ||1.568.80|| ṛṣayo munayaḥ sarve dikpālā lokapālakāḥ | nidhayaḥ kṛttikāḥ kāṣṭhā anaṃgo manavastathā ||8 1 || kalāśca tithayaḥ sarvāstattvānyapi stuvanti mām | nakṣatrāṇi surāḥ sarve guṇā varṇā bhajanti mām ||82|| bhogāśca bhoginaḥ sarve yoginyaścāpsarogaṇāḥ | tīrthāni ca nadā nadyo nāḍikāḥ khanikāstathā ||83 || vālakhilyāḥ piśācādyā bhūtāḥ pretāḥ stuvanti mām | kūṣmāṇḍāścaṇḍikāḥ sarvā vetālāśca vināyakāḥ ||84|| ḍākinyaścāpi śākinyastathā kṛtyā bhajanti mām | jarāyūjā aṇḍajāśca svedajāḥ pārthivāṃkurāḥ ||85|| mānavā jalajāścāpi sthalajā dehinaśca mām | stuvanti duḥkhyavasthāyāmāśramasthā nirantaram ||86|| gṛhadevā grāmadevā vanāraṇyādidevatāḥ | vanāni parvatādyāśca taḍāgāni sravāṇi ca ||87|| akhātāni ca khātāni cābdhayo’pi stuvanti mām | ālayā grāmasaṃsthānāścetanā vai bhajanti mām ||88|| yamalokakṛtāvāsāḥ karmiṇastu muhurmuhuḥ | māṃ smaranti kṛpānāthaṃ samuddhārāya duḥkhataḥ ||89|| ārtāḥ stuvanti māṃ śaśvajjijñāsavaḥ kvacit kvacit | arthārthī yāvadarthasya lābho bhavati tāvatā ||1.568.90|| majjñā nityaṃ smarantyeva stuvanti ca bhajanti ca | sūtāśca māgadhāścāpi bandinaścāraṇādayaḥ ||91 || stāvakāḥ kathakāḥ sarve paṇḍāvanto bhajanti mām | nyāyadāḥ śāsakāścāpi caurāścāpaharāstathā ||92|| tāmasāḥ sāttvikā yadvā rājasāśca stuvanti mām | bhāṭṭā gāndharvakuśalāḥ kinnarāḥ kiṃpumarthakāḥ ||93 || sādhyāḥ sādhvyastathā satyo brahmacāriṇya ityapi | ābhicāriṇya evāpi māṃ stuvanti bhajanti mām || 94|| nāgāḥ sarpā uragāśca sarīsṛpā mṛgādayaḥ | dharme nije vartamānāḥ sarve bhajanti māṃ khalu ||95|| yathābhāvaṃ dadāmyebhyaḥ phalaṃ karmānusāri vai | muktā bhajanti satataṃ hṛdi vāsaṃ pradāya me ||96|| tebhyo dadāmi hṛdayaṃ bhaktebhyo mama te yathā | evaṃ lakṣmi sadā sarve jīvāḥ protā mayi dhruvam ||97|| māṃ vinā naiva tiṣṭhanti kampante naiva māṃ vinā | prakāśaṃ naivāpnuvanti māṃ vinā hṛdayasthitam ||98|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ pareśvaraḥ | kāmbhareyo mahārājaḥ saṃrāje sarvadehiṣu ||99|| mama bhāsā prabhāsante sarveṣāṃ hṛdayāni vai | mama śaktyā prakurvantīndriyāṇi grahaṇāni ca || 1.568.100 || mamānvayena saṃsāro yāti viyāti vartate | mamopasthānahetvaitat sarvamānandabhūmikam || 101 || ato lakṣmi sadā sevyo nārāyaṇaḥ parātparaḥ | sarvartujanyasaddravyairmānasairbhavanaistathā || 1 02|| teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya jāgrato na svapimyapi | na me nidrā hi bhaktārthaṃ naudāsīnyaṃ madāśrite || 1 03|| na cālasyaṃ svāvanārthe na mūrtiḥ premaśūnyake | iti jñātvā ye bhajanti stuvanti ca smaranti mām || 1 04|| ta eva mokṣabhāgā vai narā nāryaḥ priye’bdhije | pāṭhakāḥ śrāvakāścāpi śrotāro mananārthinaḥ ||1 05|| sarve bhāvabharāḥ syuścet prayānti paramaṃ padam | sarvayajñaphalaṃ teṣāṃ mama vākye’nuvartinām || 1 06|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne viṣṇostīrtharajomāhātmyaṃ śvetadvīpamuktāḥ kārtikamārgaśīrṣavaiśākhādidvādaśīṣu kṛtabhagavatpūjāphalaṃ sarvabhūtaprāṇimātrakṛtastutyādibhirbhagavatprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||568||
<1.569> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi śaṃbhuḥ paramavaiṣṇavaḥ | pārvatīṃ prāha māhātmyaṃ mama tīrthādisaṃbhavam || 1 || candradvīpaḥ prabhāsetustāmrapārṇeya ityapi | gabhastimān nāgadvīpaḥ saumyo gandharva ityapi || 2 || vāruṇaḥ kaumārikeyaścaite deśā hi nārmadāḥ | narmadājalasiktāste tadvāripānakāriṇaḥ || 3 || dehinaḥ puṇyayogena svarge mokṣe prayānti ca | jīvāḥ karmaphalaṃ sveṣāṃ prāpnuvanti śubhāśubham || 4 || śreyo’rthaṃ ca tapo homaṃ dānaṃ dhyānaṃ ca pūjanam | kāruṇyaṃ narmadāsnānaṃ kartavyaṃ śubhalabdhaye || 5 || ākhyānaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yathāvṛttaṃ purātanam | kuvalayāśvo rājarṣiḥ purā kṛtayuge’bhavat || 6 || anekāni sahasrāṇi dānāni vividhāni ca | dattāni tena rājñā vai sarvatīrtheṣu bhāvataḥ || 7 ||| iṣṭāśca kratavastena varjayitvā tu narmadām | rājā kuvalayāśvaḥ sa dānadharmaparāyaṇaḥ || 8 || rāhusūryasamāyoge kurukṣetraṃ yayau kila | lakṣamekaṃ hayānāṃ ca dantināmayutaṃ tathā || 9 || hemamāṇikyaratnāni vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca | śraddhayā parayā yukto brāhmaṇebhyo dadau grahe || 1.569.1 0|| śeṣaṃ dravyaṃ ca tatkṣetre sarvaṃ kaṃkaravannṛpaḥ | añjalinā pratisthalaṃ vikīrya snānamācarat || 11 || tato jagāmāvadhyāyāṃ nije rājye’bhajaddharim | atha rājā mucukundo viṣṇubhakto jitendriyaḥ || 1 2|| daityānāmadhipaścāsīt sa ca sūryagrahe yayau | narmadāmoṃkāranāthaṃ vaidūryasiddhaparvatam || 1 3||| narmadākapilāyoge koṭitīrthe’vasacca saḥ | lakṣamekaṃ tu dogdhrīṇāmayutaṃ vājināṃ tathā || 158|| sahasraṃ dantināṃ caiva rathānāṃ ca sahasrakam | kāmikānāṃ tu yānānāṃ sahasraṃ hemamālinām || 15|| dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ suvāsāṃsi ratnāni vividhānyapi | snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāyogyaṃ viprebhyaḥ pradadau tadā || 16|| dadāvoṃkāranāthāya dakṣiṇāṃ ca śatāyutam | yo yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ taṃ tasmai sa prayacchati || 17|| evaṃ kṛtvā paraṃ tīrthe svālayaṃ punarāyayau | atha kālāntare bhūpau svasvapuṇyaprabhāvataḥ || 18|| svargaṃ prāptau cāpsarobhiḥ sevitāvindrasadṛśau | mucukundarathastūrdhvaṃ sadā prayāti vai divi || 1 9|| kuvalayāśvayānaṃ tu tadadho yāti sarvadā | ubhau niveditau dūtairdharmarājasya dhīmataḥ || 1.569.20 || kuvalayāśvo rājarṣirmucukundo mahābalaḥ | lokāntaramubhāvetau vimānasthau samāgatau ||21 || tāvadutpatitaṃ yānaṃ mucukundasya copari | yojanānāṃ sahasreṇa hyuparyupari vartate ||25|| avadhyādhipateryānamadhobhāge pravartate | śrutvā taddharmarājo’pi papraccha citraguptakam ||23|| kataraṃ pūjaye rājñorvad me’rghādikarmabhiḥ | puṇyabalaṃ dvayorvīkṣya prāha vai citraguptakaḥ || 24|| mucukundaṃ prathamaṃ prārcaya revāpratāpataḥ | saptarṣīnapi papraccha te’bruvan citraguptavat || 25|| mucukundaṃ samāsādya tvarghapādyena pūjaya | dānena kāpilenejyo dānavendro’tipuṇyavān ||26|| evamukto dharmarājo dānavendramupāśrayat | añjaliṃ tu tato baddhvā yānasyāgre vyavasthitaḥ ||27||| kuśalaṃ te’dya daityendra sarvadharmānvitau bhavān | nirjitāste trayo lokā dānenānena bhūtale || 28|| oṃkāradakṣiṇasyānte mūrtau kāpilasaṃgame | saptakalpavahātīre puṇyasaṃkhyā na vidyate ||29|| evamuktvā pūjayitvā darśayāmāsa mārgakam | viṣṇorvaikuṇṭhalokasya mucukundo jagāma ha ||1.569.30|| athāsādya tato bhūpaṃ kuvalayāśvameva tu | dharmarājaḥ svayaṃ prāha svāgataṃ te karomi vai ||3 1 || rājā prāha virodho vai devadānavayoḥ sadā | tvaṃ devo vai kathaṃ daityaṃ prāk prapūjitavānasi ||32|| māṃ tyaktvā dānavendraḥ sa pādyārghyeṇa tvayārcitaḥ | viparītaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ dharmarāja kṛtaṃ katham ||33|| yamaḥ prāha yathākarma kartavyaṃ me’vaśiṣyate | viṣādaṃ tyaja rājendra gahanā karmaṇāṃ gatiḥ ||34|| kurukṣetrādadhikaṃ vai puṇyaṃ syānnārmade sthale | kalāṃ nārhanti tīrthāni sārdhaṃ kalpagayā kvacit ||35|| karmasākṣī tu sarveṣāṃ yathānyāyaṃ karomi hi | sa rājā vismayāpanno drutaṃ natvā yameśvaram ||36|| narmadāṃ snātukāmaśca kapilāsaṃgamaṃ prati | āyayau saṃgame sasnau divyayānaṃ hi bhūbhṛtaḥ ||37|| tadā tūrdhvaṃ gataṃ pūrṇe viṣṇulokaṃ sanātanam | etādṛśaṃ paraṃ puṇyapradaṃ tīrthaṃ hi nārmadam ||38|| bhuktimuktipradaṃ pāpakṣālakaṃ kamale priye | janā pāpā api yānti muktiṃ revājalāplavāt ||39|| tīryate viṣṇudharmeṇa saṃsārābdhiḥ sudustaraḥ | raktā mūḍhāśca lokā vai pravartante’tipāpake ||1.569.40 || te nātmānaṃ vijānanti na kṛṣṇaṃ nahi devatāḥ | na śṛṇvanti paraṃ śreyaḥ sati cakṣuṣi nekṣate ||41 || same pathi śanairyānto plavante sma pade pade | yamamuktā api jīvā na jānanti prabodhitāḥ ||42|| kliśyante te vṛthā nānārāgalobhavaśā narāḥ | dṛṣṭvā garbhakhaniṃ kaṣṭāṃ pratyakṣāṃ trāsabodhinīm ||43 || mokṣamārgaṃ na buddhyanti teṣāṃ revā vimuktidā | pretabhūtā prajāḥ sarvā yamalokādhikārikāḥ ||44|| śivaḥ prāha śaṇu śaile purākhyānaṃ vadāmi te | sūryeṇa kathitaṃ tvāsītpurākhyānaṃ tu nārmadam ||45 || yamāya nijaputrāya lokatāraṇahetave | āśrayennarmadāṃ devīṃ saptakalāvahāṃ satīm ||46 || snānāvagāhanātpānāt tathā dānakriyādibhiḥ | dhāmadā mokṣadā svargapradā śreyaḥpradā hi sā ||47|| dhyāyamānā narmadā pāpināṃ pāpavināśinī | saṃsmṛtā kīrtitā nāmnā svargadā yāmyavāriṇī ||48|| narmade narmade coktvā pāpo yāmyaṃ na paśyati | narakastho’pi revāṃ sa hariṃ haraṃ smared yadi ||49|| mucyate yamadūtaiḥ sa tatkṣaṇānnātra saṃśayaḥ | vaidūryaparvataḥ ṛkṣastathā cāmarakaṇṭakaḥ || 1.569.5 0 || oṃkāro narmadā caite bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ | siddheśvaraṃ ca yajñeśaṃ madhyasthaṃ śaśibhūṣaṇam ||5 1 || kapileśaṃ caturthaṃ tacchivakṣetraṃ pramuktidam | teṣāṃ pūjāṃ prakurvanti puṣpadhūpārttitarpaṇaiḥ || 7| 2 || śivalokaṃ tu ye yānti śāśvataṃ padamaiśvaram | godānaṃ hemadānaṃ ca tiladānaṃ tathaiva ca ||23 || annadānaṃ payodānaṃ sarvopaskaramityapi | prāsādārāmadānaṃ ca dadānā yānti mokṣaṇam ||54|| yamalokaṃ na te yānti bhaktā bhagavato nanu | loko vicāraṇīyo’yaṃ miśrito vartate sadā || 515|| sanmānaṃ cāpamānena viyoge neṣṭasaṃgamaḥ | yauvanaṃ jarayā grastaṃ saukhyaṃ kaṣṭādupadrutam ||56 || balibhiḥ palitaiścāpi jarjarīkṛtavigrahaḥ | strīpuṃsoryauvanaṃ rūpaṃ yadanyonyaṃ priyaṃkaram || 57 || tadeva jarayā grastamubhayorapi na priyam | apūrvavattathātmānaṃ śaithilyena samanvitam ||58 || yaḥ paśyanna virajyeta ko’nyastasmādacetanaḥ | jarābhibhūtaḥ puruṣaḥ patnīputrādibāndhavaiḥ ||59|| aśaktatvād durācārairbhṛtyaiśca paribhūyate | dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ na jarayā yutaḥ ||1.569.6 0 || śaktaḥ sādhayituṃ tasmācchīghraṃ dharma samācaret | vātapītakaphādīnāṃ vaiṣamyaṃ vyādhimaṇḍalam ||6 1 || dehe tiṣṭhati nityaṃ vai bahuduḥkhakaraṃ muhuḥ | duḥkhāni svātmavedyāni kiṃ tatra vedyate paraiḥ ||62|| ekottaraṃ mṛtyuśataṃ he nityaṃ pravartate | tatraikaṃ kālarūpaṃ ca śeṣāstvāgantukāḥ smṛtāḥ ||63 || kālaḥ pratikṣaṇaṃ dehaṃ kṣapayatyeva śāntimān | āgantukāḥ kṣapayanti tattvāni hi pratikṣaṇam ||64|| āgantukā mṛtyavastu nātyantaṃ mārayanti vai | bheṣajādipratisparddhisādhanairvidravanti te ||65|| kālamṛtyuḥ kṣaṇādyātmā mahākālātmakastathā | japahomapradānādyairbhaiṣajaiśca na śāmyati ||66 || apamṛtyustu dehasya viṣamadyādisaṃbhavaḥ | sarveṣāṃ jalapātādivahnipātādisaṃbhavaḥ ||67|| kṣayaṃ karoti vṛṣṭyādi kīṭānāṃ jalapūrataḥ | jñātāyaṃ puruṣo nityamapamṛtyorbibheti ca ||68|| vividhā vyādhayaḥ kaṣṭāḥ sarpādyāḥ prāṇino’pi ca | viṣāṇino’bhicārāśca mṛtyordvārāṇi dehinām ||69|| āvṛtaṃ rogasarpādyairapi dhanvantariḥ svayam | svasthaṃ kartuṃ na śaknoti kālagrastaṃ hi dehinam ||1.569.70 || nauṣadhaṃ na tapo dānaṃ na mitrāṇi na bāndhavāḥ | paritrātuṃ samarthā no kālagrastaṃ pravāsinam ||71 || nāsti mṛtyusamaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsti mṛtyusamo ripuḥ | nāsti mṛtyusamaḥ kālo dehināṃ sukhamāninām ||72 || sadbhāryāsutamitrāṇi rājyaiśvaryasukhāni ca | mṛtyuśchinatti sarvāṇi vāryamāṇo’pi vegataḥ ||73 || idṃ tai kathitaṃ putra dharmarāja mayārthavat | pariṇāme bhavet sarvaṃ sarvathā kālabhojanam ||74|| tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sevyā nārāyaṇī sṛtiḥ | sarvaduḥkhaharā revā sarvaśokavināśinī ||75|| yān yān kāmayate kāmān tāṃstān revā prayacchati | jñānaṃ dhyānaṃ cādhyayanaṃ revāsevanameva tat ||76|| yajño dānaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ lakṣmi revāmbusevanam | brahmakūrcasahasrāṇi revātoyasamāni na ||77|| godānaṃ tatra vai dattaṃ gomedhāyutapuṇyadam | śaśāṃko’bhūt purā rājā narmadātīramāśritaḥ ||78|| dānaṃ yajñaṃ tapaścakre parvate’marakaṇṭake| dadau cārdhaprasūtāṃ gāṃ brāhmaṇāya mahātmane ||79|| dānasyāsya prabhāveṇa divyūrdhvayāyānago’bhavat | yāvadvatsasya pādau dvau mukhaṃ yonau pradṛśyate ||1.569.80 || tāvadgauḥ pṛthivī jñeyā saśailavanakānanā | svarṇaśṛṃgī rūpyakhurī savatsā kāṃsyadohanā ||8 1 || narmadāsnānayuktā ca sakuśā tilasaṃyutā | oṃkārāmarayormadhye koṭitīrthe śaśāṃkakaḥ ||82|| etāḥ sahasrasaṃkhyākā brāhmaṇebhyo hyakalpayat | sa rājā dānapuṇyena divyayānena vai divi ||83 || rājate tu tadā nedurdevadundubhayo divi | tatkṣaṇe yānamārūḍho hariścandro’pi bhūpatiḥ ||84|| kurukṣetre gosahasraṃ datvā yānena cāyayau | dhṛtasvarṇātapatrastu vījyamānaśca cāmaraiḥ ||85|| yojanānāṃ sahasreṇa hariścandro hyadhaḥsthitaḥ | evaṃ dṛṣṭvā nimnabhāvaṃ jagāmājaṃ sa satvaram ||86 || viṣaṇṇavadano’pṛcchat pitāmahaṃ tu kāraṇam | mayā tu kaurave kṣetre dānaṃ dattamanantakam ||87|| śaśāṃkena tu revāyāṃ dānaṃ dattamanantakam | kathaṃ puṇyaṃ nārmadaṃ tu kurukṣetrād viśiṣyate ||88|| yenāhamasmi nimnastho hariścandraḥ samūrdhvagaḥ | śrutvā brahmā hariścandraṃ prāha mā khedamāvaha ||89|| śaśāṃkena purā sūryagrahe’dryamarakaṇṭake | anekāni sahasrāṇi kṛtānīṣṭāni bhūpate || 1.569.9 0|| anyataḥ sarvatīrthāni caikato’marakaṇṭakam | tolitaṃ ca mayā pūrvamamareśo viśiṣyate || 011 || sevyatāṃ kalpagā devī yadicchetparamaṃ padam | hariścandrastato natvā yayāvamarakaṇṭakam || 92|| narmadāyāstaṭe dravyaṃ dhanaṃ gāśca dadau tadā | atha puṇyodayenāsya vimānaṃ cordhvagaṃ hyabhūt || 93 || tadā santoṣamāpannaḥ kṛtvā rājyaṃ ciraṃ tataḥ | yayau vaikuṇṭhamevāyaṃ narmadāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ || 94|| yadyapyanena dattāni kaurave ca bahūnyapi | dānāni tatphalaṃ naiva nārmadena samaṃ hyabhūt || 95|| evaṃ vai nārmadaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvaśreyaskaraṃ param | bhuktidaṃ mokṣadaṃ cāpi koṭitīrthasamanvitam || 96|| etatsarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ śivāyai śaṃkareṇa ha | mayā tubhyaṃ mahālakṣmi proktaṃ tannārmadaṃ phalam || 97|| yaḥ śṛṇoti jano lakṣmi gosahasraphalaṃ labhet | paṭhanācchravaṇātsmṛterlabhedvai tādṛśaṃ phalam || 98|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kuvalayāśvamucukundavimānavaiṣamye hariścandraśaśāṃkavimānavaiṣamye narmadāmarakaṇṭakamāhātmyādhikyādikathananāmaikonasaptatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||569 ||
<1.570> śrīlakṣmīruvāca śrutaṃ vai nārmadaṃ puṇyaṃ māhātmyaṃ cāmareśvare | koṭitīrthodbhavaṃ kṛṣṇa kurukṣetrāt sahasragam || 1 || kathamevaṃ tvayā nātha racitaṃ māyayā purā | kvacitpuṇyaṃ kṛte sāmye kvacinnyūnaṃ tathādhikam || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca sarvaṃ me racanālabhyaṃ narmadā saptakalpagā | sāptakālpikadevānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca satāṃ tathā || 3 || yogānmamāvatārāṇāṃ narmadā sarvato’dhikā | nityaṃ ca pralaye revā kṣīrode ca mamāntikam || 4 || pādasevāparā bhūtvā tiṣṭhate mama bhāminī | mama yogānmama māyā divyā bhavati cottamā || 2 || śṛṇu māyāmayaṃ sarvaṃ mayā yādṛk prakalpitam | tat sṛṣṭvānupraviśāmi mama yogena śiṣyate || 6 || śṛṇu māṃ na vijānanti rudrendrāḥ sapitāmahāḥ | mayā nārāyaṇenaiva kṛtā api sureśvarāḥ || 7 || sarve tīrthamayāḥ santi mama vāsena sundari | parjanyau varṣati deśe deśo jalena pūryate || 8 || vyoma nirjalatāṃ yāti māyā matkṛtirūpiṇī | punarjalaiḥ samāvṛttaṃ vyoma vai dṛśyate kṣaṇāt || 9 || punarvṛṣṭiḥ punā riktaṃ māyaiṣā nirmitā mayā | pāvanaṃ tu jalaṃ sarvaṃ mama vāsena bhāmini || 1.570.1 0|| saṃkalpitaṃ viśeṣeṇa pāvanaṃ vai viśeṣataḥ | nirjharāṇāṃ jalaṃ sādhusevitaṃ pāvanaṃ yathā || 11 || tato devaiḥ sevitaṃ pāvanataraṃ bhavatyapi | mayā prasevitaṃ tatpāvanatamaṃ prajāyate || 1 2|| kiṃ muhuḥ sevitaṃ tacca tatrāpi pratikalpagam | mayā prasevitā revā kṣīrode matsamā tataḥ || 1 3|| pāvanī pāvanānāṃ ca māṃgalyānāṃ ca maṃgalā | mokṣadānāṃ paramokṣapradā manmāyayā hi sā || 14|| somo yatkṣīyate pakṣe pakṣe punarvivardhate | amāyāṃ dṛśyate naiva māyeyaṃ madvinirmitā || 15|| hemante salilaṃ kūpe coṣṇaṃ bhavati sundari | jāyate śītalaṃ grīṣme māyeyaṃ ca mayā kṛtā || 16|| bhāskaraścaikamārgeṇa sadā yāti na cānyathā | udeti pūrvato nityamastameti ca paścime || 17|| nimnatāṃ mṛdutāṃ śaitye cordhvaṃ tu tigmatāṃ tataḥ | prayāti klṛptivaicitryānmāyeyaṃ mama sundari || 18|| śukraṃ ca śoṇitaṃ bhinnaṃ bhinnadehe prajāyate | tayoryoge bhavedgarbho nānyathā tu kadācana || 1 9|| sajātīye ca jāyeta na vaijātye prajāyate | garbhe praviśya jīvastu sukhaduḥkhe hi vindati ||1.570.20|| vinā dehaṃ na vai duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ vā cātmanaḥ kvacit | jātaśca vismared garbhaṃ māyaiṣā nirmitā mayā ||21 || yathākarma bhavejjanturbhinnadeho’pi jīvati | yathākarma bhavenmūṛtyurdehasthito’pi gacchati ||22|| śukraśoṇitasammiśre garbhe karkandhusadṛśe | aṅgulyaścaraṇau cāpi bhujau śīrṣaṃ kaṭistathā ||23 || pṛṣṭhaṃ tathodaraṃ cāpi dantauṣṭhapuṭanāsikāḥ | karṇau netre kapālau ca lalāṭaṃ jihvikā tathā ||24|| māyayā me bhavantyete jāyante jantavastataḥ | tasyaiva jīryate bhuktamagninā pītameva ca ||25|| adhastu sravate mūtraṃ māyaiṣā nirmitā mayā | śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhastathāpare ||26|| bhūtādyā mānasādyāśca prāṇādyā dhātavo’pi ca | pravartante’nnatattvādvai māyaiṣā nirmitā mayā ||27|| sarvartuṣu sahasreṣu gateṣvapi ciraṃ sthitaḥ | navartuṃ naiva jānāti svāsthyānukūlamityapi ||28|| bhojanādīni vastūni naiva jānāti tattvataḥ | kasmāt kīdṛgbhavellābho māyaiṣā mama sundari ||29|| āpo divyā mayā sṛṣṭā adṛśyād dṛśyarūpikāḥ | bhaumā nadyo bhavantyeva dṛṣṭau bahūdakāśca tāḥ ||1.570.30|| grīṣme śuṣyanti sarvāstāḥ punaścakraṃ tathaiva tat | udbhavanti praśuṣyanti māyaiṣā prativatsaram ||3 1 || ākāśaṃ śūnyarūpaṃ vai vāyuścāpi pravāhakaḥ | himālayaṃ samāsādya himātmako bhavatyapi ||32|| śilātmakaṃ himaṃ śṛṃgād dravatyeva śanaiḥ śaneḥ | gāṃgatā jāyate sā tu gaṃgā deśasukhāvahā ||33|| meghā vahanti salilamuddhṛtya lavaṇārṇavāt | varṣanti madhuraṃ loke kṣaraṃ vārdhau kṛtaṃ mayā ||34|| kvacittu kaṭurūpaṃ tat kvacinmiṣṭaṃ jalaṃ matam | bhinnaguṇaṃ jāyate tanmāyaiṣā mama padmaje ||356|| roganāśakaraṃ vīryamoṣadhe nikṣipāmyaham | oṣadhe dīyamāne vā kālo bhūtvā harāmyaham ||36|| garbho bālo yuvā vṛddhau jaraṭhaḥ śaktivarjitaḥ | bījamaṃkurakaṃ patraṃ kāṇḍaṃ nālaṃ ca puṣpakam ||37|| phalaṃ rasādi tṛptiśca bījād bījasahasrakam | kvacittu niṣphalaṃ bījaṃ māyaiṣā matkṛtā priye ||38|| matsṛṣṭāstu narā nāryo bhavanti śataputrakāḥ | mama te ca na putro’sti māyaiṣā mama padmaje ||39|| ekasmādeva dehācca jāyante jantukoṭayaḥ | mastake kīṭakā likṣā vastreṣu matkuṇādayaḥ ||1.570.40 || romakūpeṣu kīṭāśca svedād yūkādayastathā | aṃge chinne māṃsamadhye kṛmayaśca bhavantyapi ||41 || mūtre kīṭāḥ sūkṣmarūpā bhavantyeva nalādiṣu | vīryajanyāstathā garbhā jāyante’patyarūpiṇaḥ ||42|| ekasmādeva dehādvai jāyante bhinnasṛṣṭayaḥ | sarve putrāḥ svasya bālāḥ svasmājjātāstu te yataḥ || 43 || visadṛśāstu kīṭādyāsteṣu sneho na vidyate | sadṛśe piṇḍake putre sneho bhavati dehinām ||44|| sarveṣu jantuṣu tveṣā mayā māyā nidhāpitā | ekatra śatrutā kīṭe’nyatra putre’tiraktatā |||45||| kīṭāraktapibā eva putrāḥ sarvapibā api | garbhe raktapibā mātuścāṃke dugdhapibāstathā ||46|| bālye dravyapibāścāpi yauvane sampadāmpibāḥ | vicittatve mṛtau śāntipibā asupibā api ||47|| evaṃ sarvapibe sneho māyaiṣā mama bhāmini | nare nāryā bhavet sneho nāryā sneho narasya ca ||48|| nāryośca narayorvā na tādṛṅa māyā mamedṛśī | jale pṛthvyāṃ rase dehe vṛṣṭau bīje ca bhakṣite |||49|| tatrāmṛtaṃ visṛjāmi kṣudhāyāṃ tadvibhāvyate | akṣudhāyāṃ viṣaṃ tatsyānmāyaiṣā mama sundari ||1.570.50|| loka evaṃ vijānāti garuḍo vahate’cyutam | kintvahaṃ garuḍaṃ nītvā prayāmi cāntarasthitaḥ ||51 || lokāḥ sarve vijānanti devā nityaṃ makhāśinaḥ | kintvahaṃ makharūpeṇa yakṣyāmi tridivaukasaḥ ||52|| sarvelokā vijānanti gururdadāti dīkṣaṇam | kintvahaṃ tu gurau dīkṣārūpastiṣṭhāmi māyayā ||53|| sarve lokā vijānanti varuṇaḥ pāti sāgaram | kintvahaṃ varuṇe sthitvā rakṣāmi sāgarān sadā ||54|| sarve lokā vijānanti kubero dhanarakṣakaḥ | kintvahaṃ dhanarūpeṇa rakṣāmyasya kuberatām ||55|| sarve lokā vijānanti vṛtraḥ śakreṇa sūditaḥ | kintvahaṃ māyayā śakre sthitvā vṛtraṃ vyanāśayam ||56|| evaṃ lokā vijānanti sūryo nārāyaṇo mahān | kintvahaṃ sūryamāviśya prakāśayāmi yogyataḥ ||57|| dhruve dhrauvyaṃ mayā dattaṃ merau mādhyasthyamityapi | abdhau vāḍavarūpo’smi megheṣu vāyurūpavān ||58|| ākāśe tiṣṭhate vāri naiva paśyanti vai janāḥ | devā api na jānanti hyamṛtaṃ kutra tiṣṭhati ||59|| auṣadhaṃ māyayā sṛṣṭaṃ vane tiṣṭhati sarvathā | vīryaṃ tatrādadhāmyeva roganāśakaraṃ sadā ||1.570.6 0|| loko hyevaṃ vijānāti rājā pālayati prajā | kintvahaṃ nṛpamāviśya pālayāmi prajā mama ||6 1|| sṛṣṭau sāyaṃkālarūpo rātrau pralayarūpavān | prātargarbhasvarūpo’haṃ māyayaiva bhavāmi ca ||62|| sūryaḥ pācayati sarva māyayāhaṃ ravau sthitaḥ | vahniḥ pācayati sarvaṃ māyayā cānale sthitaḥ ||63|| sūryāśurūpavānasmi prakāśayāmi golakam | māyāṃ pralayakālinīṃ kṛtvā saṃhṛtya vai jagat ||64|| śeṣe śaye’pi śeṣaśca śete me māyayā tadā | paśya māyābalaṃ me tvaṃ strīrūpā vartase sadā ||65|| kathaṃ na jāyase lakṣmi puṃsvarūpā vadātra me | seyaṃ māyā mama lakṣmi strīrūpe te’sti ceṣṭatā ||66|| mamāsti puṃsvarūpe ceṣṭatā māyā mamāsti sā | prajāpatiṃ haraṃ viṣṇuṃ sṛjāmi jalamadhyataḥ ||67|| te’pi māṃ nahi jānanti mama māyāvimohitāḥ | ṛṣirvipraḥ purākalpe somaśarmābhidho mama ||68|| bhakto’pi māyayā channo na viveda nijaṃ param | māyā mama viśālākṣi rohiṇī lomaharṣiṇī ||69|| kvacidindriyalaulyena prabadhnātyapi yoginam | somaśarmā māyayā me karśitaḥ strītvamāpa ha ||1.570.70|| nāsīt tādṛk tasya karma nāparādhaḥ kṛtastathā | mamārādhanayukto’pi niṣādījanma cāptavān ||71|| nityaṃ cintayate mūrtiṃ mama lakṣmi manoharām | atha dīrghena kālena tuṣṭo’haṃ bhaktikarmabhiḥ ||72|| tapobhiścāpi satataṃ pratyakṣatāmahaṃ gataḥ | varārthaṃ sa mayā proktastuṣṭo’smīṣṭaṃ dadāmi te || 73 || ratnāni kāñcanaṃ gāśca sāmrājyaṃ cāpyakaṇṭakam | athavecchasi svargaṃ ca yatra saukhyaṃ varāṅganāḥ ||74|| dhanaṃ yānaṃ vāhanāni sainyānyapi ca sampadaḥ | hemabhāṇḍāni saudhāni kānakāni dyumanti ca ||75||| akṣayāni ca pātrāṇi vividhānyamṛtāni ca | bhogān divyānaiśvarāṃśca vadārpayāmi te dvija ||76 || dadāmi te varaṃ vipra yāvatte cittacintitam | śrutvā madvacanaṃ vipro natvovāca śanairhi mām || 77|| cenna prakupyate nātha varaṃ samanuyācate | yat tvayā bhāṣitaṃ deva sarvaṃ deyaṃ mama tvayā ||78|| evaṃ lakṣmi subhakto’pi yayāce lālasānvitaḥ | mayoktaḥ kathametadvai sarvaṃ vai yācase’nagha ||79|| bandhanaṃ mama bhaktasya mama khedāya jāyate | tadāścaryadarśanecchurmama māyādidṛkṣukaḥ ||1.570.80 || māṃ prāha madhuraṃ vākyaṃ virāgaṃ rāgamiśritam | nāhaṃ svarṇaṃ gāśca ratnaṃ rājyaṃ svargaṃ varāṃganāḥ ||81|| aiśvaryaṃ cākṣayaṃ pātraṃ cāmṛtaṃ yānavāhanam | bhoktumicchāmi bhagavan necchāmi divyatāṃ prabho ||82|| tathā svargasahasrāṇāmekaṃ vāpi na rocaye | kintu me vartate cecchā kathaṃ kṛtvā vikrīḍasi ||83|| nidarśanārthaṃ deveśa svalpaṃ draṣṭuṃ vṛṇomyaham | māyā vai dṛśyate satyā mithyocyate maharṣibhiḥ ||84|| kīdṛśīyaṃ veditavyā dṛṣṭāntārthaṃ pradarśaya | tatastasya vacaḥ śrutvā sa mayā tatra bhāṣitaḥ ||85|| te kiṃ me māyayā vipra bhaktiṃ kuru sukhaṃ labha | devā api na jānanti māyayā me vimohitāḥ ||86|| tvaṃ tu naiva vijānāsi māyāyāṃ patito’pi san | jijñāsasi hyayogyaṃ vai kṛtakāryo’pi vai punaḥ ||87|| bhavituṃ cākṛtakāryaḥ kathaṃ cecchasi śocanam | evamukto’pi mugdhaḥ sa māyayā māmuvāca ha ||88|| yadi tuṣṭo’si me kṛṣṇa bhaktyā vā tapasā mama | māyāṃ darśaya me svalpāṃ yathā jānāmi tādṛśam ||89|| sarva saṃsāracakraṃ vai punarbaddho bhavāmi na | tato mayoditaṃ tasmai yāhi kubjāmrakaṃ sthalam ||1.570.90|| gaṃgātīraṃ mahādivyaṃ tatra sarvamavāpsyasi | śrutvā madvacanaṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ ca māṃ tataḥ ||9 1 || yayau kubjāmrakaṃ tīrthaṃ prātarmāyābhilāṣukaḥ | tataḥ kanthāṃ vaṃśadaṇḍaṃ jalapātraṃ ca kañcukam ||92|| pātheyaṃ ca taṭe nyasya natvā gaṃgāṃ punaḥ punaḥ | jalamādhāya śirasi kṛtvācamanamityatha ||93|| pītvā jalaṃ ca māṃ smṛtvā snātuṃ viveśa vāriṣu | tāvanme māyayā vipro jale cādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ||94|| pārśve niṣādasadane tatstrīgarbhagato’bhavat | hṛdaye’cintayattatra garbhakleśena pīḍitaḥ ||95|| aho kaṣṭaṃ mayā prāptaṃ kasyacid duṣkṛtasya ha | yo’haṃ niṣādikāgarbhe vasāmi narakātmake ||96|| dhik tapo dhik ca me karma dhik phalaṃ dhik ca jīvitam | yo’haṃ niṣādagarbhe’tra tiṣṭhāmi mūtrasaṃkule ||97|| durgandhe duḥsahe vātapittaśleṣmarajovahe | alaṃ kiṃ bhāṣaṇenātra naṣṭe kiṃ rodanena vai ||98|| māyājijñāsayā mūtrakedārikāṃ praveśitaḥ | kuto viṣṇuḥ kutaścāhaṃ kvāste gaṃgājalaṃ hi tat| ||99|| kvāyaṃ niṣādikāgarbhaḥ kvāyaṃ mūtrahradastathā | garbhasaṃsāraniṣkrāntaḥ paścādāpsyāmi śāntatām || 1.570.10 0|| evaṃ cintayamānasya navamāsātmakaṃ kṣaṇam | vyatītaṃ daśame māsi pūrṇe garbhādbahirgataḥ || 101 || bhūmyāṃ tu patatastasya naṣṭaṃ garbhe vicintitam | ajāyata ca sā kanyā niṣādaputrikā tataḥ || 1 02|| vipratvaṃ vismṛtaṃ sarvaṃ tayā māyāvimugdhayā | atha pitrā kṛtodvāhā yuvatī dhīvarapriyā ||1 0 3|| ṣaṭ putrān suṣuve kanyā sapta varṣadvayāntare | bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ khādati sma peyāpeyaṃ pibatyapi || 1 04|| śaśādīn ghātayitvā cāmiṣāhāraṃ karotyapi | kāryākāryaṃ na jānāti vācyāvācyaṃ na vetti sā || 1 05|| gamyāgamyaṃ na jānāti māyājālāvṛtā yataḥ | pañcāśadvarṣake kāle mayā sā preritā hṛdi || 106 || ghaṭaṃ gṛhītvā viṭliptavastrakṣālanakāraṇāt | yayau snātuṃ tu tatraiva yatra nyastaṃ purāmbaram || 1 07|| tīre niḥkṣipya vastrāṇi ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya sā taṭe | prasvedagharmasantaptā saśiraḥsnānamicchukī || 1 08|| snātuṃ viveśa gaṃgāyāṃ tāvajjātaḥ sa bhūsuraḥ | somaśarmābhidho vipraḥ sasmāra pūrvavṛttakam || 1 09|| bahistvāgatya vai kūle prātaḥkāle dhṛtām̐śca yān | vastradaṇḍakalaśām̐ścāpaśyanmadhyāhnake kṣaṇe || 1.570.11 0|| pārśve tatraiva nāryā ca dhṛtā viḍvastragargarīḥ | apaśyattu mahāścaryaṃ prāpa madhyandine tadā || 11 1|| vipraḥ sa dhīvarīvastrādikaṃ tyaktvā tataḥ purā | tyaktaṃ dhautraṃ ca jagrāha dhārayāmāsa lajjayā || 11 2|| śuśocāti tadā smṛtvā niṣadya samavāluke | mayā kiṃ karma pāpena kṛtaṃ nindyaṃ suduḥkhadam || 11 3|| yenācārāt paribhraṣṭo gataścaitādṛśīṃ daśām | niṣādī hyabhavaṃ bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ naivāvicārayam || 1 14|| jīvānaghātayaṃ sarvāñjalasthalādivāsinaḥ | peyāpeyaṃ kṛtavām̐ścāgamyāgamanamācaram || 1 15|| vācyāvācyaṃ na vai dṛṣṭaṃ cauryādikaṃ muhuḥ kṛtam | putrā duhitaraścāpi niṣādājjanitā mayā || 1 16|| vartante bālakāḥ stanyapānārhāśca gṛhe mama | pratīkṣante tvāgamaṃ me jātaścāhaṃ naro’tra vai ||1 17|| kiṃ kāryaṃ kimakāryaṃ vai māyāmohaṃ tarāmi na |
