apatyaśokasaṃvyāpto vipratāsmaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 1 18|| vipro bhūtvātilajjāvān maunaṃ ca niṣasāda saḥ | etasminnantare tatra niṣādo bālakāstathā || 11 9|| cirakālagatatvena mārgayituṃ tadāyayuḥ | tatra tāṃ te mṛgayanti bhārye mātaśca rodinaḥ || 1.570.120 || pṛcchati sma ca taṃ vipraṃ niṣādo bālakairyutaḥ | tvayā dṛṣṭāsti me patnī dvijātra snātumāgatā || 121 || bālā duhitarastasyā rudanti karuṇaṃ gṛhe | stanyapānaṃ vinā cāpi madhyabhojanamantarā || 1 22|| kinnu paśyatha bho viprā anye narāśca yoṣitaḥ | mama bhāryāṃ jalaṃ netuṃ vastraṃ kṣālayituṃ tathā || 123 || snātuṃ samāgatāṃ cātra yadi ced vadathātra me | ghaṭamādāya hastena tvāgatā bhālitā yadi || 1 24|| kintu pratyuttaraṃ nāptvā ruroda sa tadā punaḥ | janāḥ paśyanti taṃ vipraṃ daṇḍakalaśasaṃyutam || 1 29|| na paśyanti ca tāṃ nārīṃ dadyuḥ pratyuttaraṃ katham | bhīlo duḥkhena santapto dṛṣṭvā kuṃbhapaṭādikam || 1 26|| apaśyaṃśca svakāṃ patnīṃ karuṇaṃ paryavedayat | api grāheṇa kenāpi snāyamānā dhṛtā kimu || 1 27|| na cāpriyaṃ mayāstyuktā kadācittvapi karmasu | svapne’pi noktapūrvāsti nātmaghātaḥ prasaṃbhavet || 1 28|| kintu krūrapiśācena bhakṣitā vāpi rakṣasā | yadvā prasahya kenāpi nītā deśāntaraṃ bhavet || 1 29|| kiṃ kṛtaṃ duṣkataṃ pūrvaṃ mayā karma hi kaṣṭadam | yena matpurato bhāryālpāyuṣye vigatiṃ gatā || 1.570.130 || ehi me subhage kānte mama cittānuvartini | paśyaitān bālakān kanyā rudataḥ kṣudhitāṃstathā || 131 || kāmaṃ māṃ kṣudhitaṃ cāpi jñāsyase tvaṃ pipāsitam | yadi daiva śṛṇoṣyatra dharmeṇa dehi me priyām || 1 32|| eva vilapamānasya niṣādasya tvitastataḥ | savrīḍaṃ bhāṣate vipro niṣādaṃ gaccha nāsti sā || 1 33|| yathā karma gatā sā te sarvathā hyanivṛttaye | bālām̐stān parirakṣasva gaccha kiṃ kliśyase vṛthā || 1 34|| kāruṇyātte kathayāmi tavāhaṃ sā priyābhavat | snānamātreṇa tu muniḥ pūrvavanmāyayābhavam || 1 35|| niṣādaḥ prāha taṃ vipraṃ strītvaṃ prāpto’si vai katham | puṃstvaṃ cāpi kathaṃ prāpta etadācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 1 36|| vipraḥ prāha harirbhaktyā mayā sākṣātkṛtastadā | vareṇa chandayāmāsa mayāpi cepsitaṃ tadā || 1 37|| māyāṃ me darśaya nātha kīdṛśī sā bhavediti | tato’haṃ tena cāpyukto gaccha kubjāmrake jale || 1 38|| tatra drakṣyasi cetyuktvā tvantardhānaṃ jagāma saḥ | ahamāgatya gaṃgāyāṃ snātvā niṣādabālikā || 139 || niṣādīgarbhasaṃbhūtā tava patnyabhavaṃ tataḥ | adya snātvā punarjāto brāhmaṇo vai yathāpurā || 1.570.140|| śrutvaivaṃ sa niṣādaśca bālakāśca tiro’bhavan | ahaṃ tvāsaṃ ca tadrūpo lakṣmi māyāpradarśakaḥ || 141|| madhyāhne cāgatā viprāḥ snātuṃ te somaśarmakam | prāhuḥ kathaṃ nu pūrvāhṇaścādya tīre prayāpitaḥ || 142|| prātarārabhya caivātrāmadhyāhnaṃ tiṣṭhase katham | dinārdhe darśitā māyā pañcāśadvārṣikī priye || 143|| athāha darśayitvā svaṃ tamavocaṃ purākṛtam | bhavāntare tvayā bhaktāḥ sādhavo nābhivāditāḥ || 144|| tatpāpādīdṛśo bhogo māyāmiṣeṇa te’bhavat | gaccha vipra paraṃ dhāma śvetadvīpaṃ sukhī bhava || 145|| vipro yayau tato dhāma nārāyaṇastiro’bhavat | māyātīrthamidaṃ lakṣmi mokṣadaṃ vartate bhuvi || 146|| śravaṇāt kīrtanāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhavet khalu | pārvatyai śaṃkaraḥ prāha nārmade kṣetrake purā || 147|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhagavatkṛtamāyāracanā, somaśarmaviprasya māyādarśane niṣādīstrītvaṃ, dvādaśāpatyamātṛtvaṃ, punarjalanimajjane vipratvaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ, māyātīrthamāhātmyaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā saptatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 570 ||
<1.571> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi jaṃgamaṃ tīrthamuttamam | ye tu bhāgavatāḥ śuddhāste nūnaṃ mama mūrtayaḥ || 1 || tānsādhūnye namasyanti te māmeva namanti vai | vidito’smīha kamale tairahaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 2 || mama darśanakāmā ye te me bhaktā dvijādayaḥ | śuddhā bhāgavatāḥ pūjyā draṣṭavyāḥ sarvadā nṛbhiḥ || 3 || viśeṣeṇa kṣitau sādhudvijarūpeṇa cāsthitaḥ | tasmāt sādhusevakā ye te me bhaktā na saṃśayaḥ || 4 || yo māṃ prāptamihecchedvai paraṃ mokṣaṃ tataḥ sa ca | ananyamānaso bhūtvā sa madbhaktān pratoṣayet || 5 || māṃ yathā ca tathā sādhūn sādhvīḥ pratoṣayet sadā | sevayā cānuvṛttyā ca yatheṣṭasampradānataḥ || 6 || śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi purākalpakathāṃ yathā | raibhyo nāma maharṣirvai jalamadhye tale vasan || 7 || mamaivārādhane yukto nirvāṇakarmaniṣṭhitaḥ | yogī jitendriyaścāsīt tāpaso divyavigrahaḥ || 8 || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi cordhvabāhuḥ sthito’bhavat | sahasraṃ cāmbubhakṣo’bhūt tāvacchaivalabhakṣaṇaḥ || 9 || bhūmivāsaṃ tatastyaktvā jale’yutamuvāsa saḥ | bhaktyā tu parayā tenarṣiṇā cārādhito hyaham || 1.571.1 0|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | mantraṃ japan ca māṃ dhyāyan sa cāste jalamadhyagaḥ || 11 || tena prīto’bhavaṃ tasya raibhyasya sannidhau jale | gaṃgāyāmagamaṃ sākṣājjalaṃ śuṣkāyitaṃ mayā || 1 2|| raibhya utthāya ca tīre āmradruṃ samupāyayau | viśālo’pi tadā cāmraḥ kubjabhāvaṃ gato’bhavat || 13 || ṛṣimācchādya tu yathā chatravat tiṣṭhate drumaḥ | ahaṃ kubjastathā bhūtvāpyāmrasyādho gato’bhavam || 14|| kubjāmrakaṃ hi gaṃgāyāṃ tīrthaṃ tatkathyate bhuvi | māṃ vīkṣya śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pratyakṣamāgatam || 15|| jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā māṃ tuṣṭāva rameśvaram | namaskṛtya sthitaṃ taṃ ca mama bhaktaṃ purātanam || 16|| vareṇa chandayāmāsa tvahaṃ tasya dayākaraḥ | so’pyuvācātra he nātha nivāsaṃ kuru sarvadā || 17|| tvayi bhaktiḥ sadā bhūyānmamāpyatra sthale prabhau | anyabhaktirmama vibho rocate na kadācana || 18|| nityaṃ tvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi drakṣyāmyatrāpi bhāgyataḥ | nivatsyāmi tvayā sārdhaṃ yathā hyakṣarasaṃsthitaḥ || 1 9|| upendra yadi tuṣṭo’si mamāyaṃ dīyatāṃ varaḥ | mayā bāḍhaṃ varo datto nivāsaṃ tatra cālabham || 1.571.20 || evaṃ bhaktavaśaścāsmi bhakto’haṃ mayi bhaktarāṭ | abhedastvāvayorlakṣmi yathā śrīśrīśayoḥ sadā ||2 1 || tatra kubjāmrake bhadre sthānaṃ tu mama rocate | puṇḍarīkākṣanāmāhaṃ tatra tiṣṭhāmi sundari ||22|| mama vāsālaye vṛttaṃ purāścaryaṃ mahādbhutam | mama nirmālyotkare vai vyālī tiṣṭhati nirbhayā |||23||| gandhamālyopahārāṇi bhakṣayantī yadṛcchayā | athaikadā nakulo vai sthalāntarāt samāgataḥ ||24|| tena dṛṣṭā sarpiṇī sā tayoryuddhaṃ tadābhavat | māghe śukle dvādaśyāṃ tu madhyāhne mama mandire ||25|| vyālyā daṣṭo nakulaḥ sa nakulenāpi sarpiṇī | ubhau kṣataistīvravaraistadā pañcatvamāgatau ||26|| vyālī prāgjyotiṣe jātā rājaputrī tu roṣiṇī | kosalādhipateḥ putro’bhavattu nakulaḥ saruṭ || 27|| avardhatāṃ ca tau pūrvasaṃskārasaṃyutāvubhau | sā kanyā nakulaṃ dṛṣṭvā sadyo hantuṃ pradhāvati || 28|| vyālīṃ dṛṣṭvā rājaputraḥ sahasā hantumeti ca | tayorvivāho bhāgyācca pūrvabandhānusārataḥ ||29|| sañjātaśca dvayoḥ prītirabhūdvai jatukāṣṭhavat | evaṃ tayorgataḥ kālo varṣāṇāṃ saptasaptatiḥ ||1.571.3 0|| viharantau samudyāne tvekadā śādvale sthale | dṛṣṭvā vyālīṃ rājaputrastāṃ vihantumupādravat ||3 1 || patnyātivāryamāṇo’pi vyālī jaghāna jīvataḥ | tadā sā roṣagā rājñī hṛdi duḥkhamavāpa ha ||32|| tasyāmeva ca velāyāṃ rājaputryagrato bilāt | nakulo daivayogādvai vinirgatya prayāti hi ||33 || dṛṣṭvā taṃ rājaputrī sā nakulaṃ śubhadarśanam | krodhājjaghāna daṇḍena vāritāpyatibhūbhṛtā ||34|| nakulaṃ ghātitaṃ dṛṣṭvā māṃgalyaṃ rājabhūṣaṇam | kupito rājaputraśca rājaputrīmabhāṣata || 35|| strīṇāṃ bhartā sadā mānyastaṃ māmullaṃghya niṣṭhure | darśanīyaḥ priyo rājñāṃ māṃgalyaḥ śubhasūcanaḥ ||36|| ghātito nakulaḥ kasmānmayā vai vāryamāṇayā | iti bhartṛvacaḥ śrutvā pratyuvāca nṛpātmajā ||37|| asakṛd vāryamāṇo’pi vyālī ghātitavān yataḥ | tasmānmayāpi nakulo ghātitaḥ sarpaghātakaḥ ||38|| rājaputraśca tāṃ prāha yuktiyuktaṃ hi tarjayan | sarpastīvraviṣaḥ patni yaddaṃśānmriyate janaḥ ||39|| tasmānmayā hato duṣṭo’hitakārī viṣoddhataḥ | prajāpālo nṛpaḥ prokto daṇḍayāmyapathe sthitān ||1.571.40|| sādhūn ye cāpi hiṃsanti hyaparādhavivarjitān | striyaṃ caivāpi hiṃsanti te daṇḍyā rājadharmataḥ ||41|| mayaivaṃ rājadharmo vai kartavyastena sā hatā | vada tvaṃ cāparāddhaṃ kiṃ nakulena tavātra kim ||42||| darśanīyaśca māṃgalyo rājñāṃ yogyo gṛheṣvapi | dyūte’pi kuśalaḥ so’yaṃ nakulaḥ kiṃ tvayā hataḥ ||43|| mayā nivāryamāṇāpi prāṇānnītavatī yataḥ | tato mama na bhāryāsi na cāhaṃ te patiḥ sthitaḥ ||44|| kiñca tena na hanmi tvāṃ striyo’vadhyāḥ sadaiva yat | ityuktvā tāṃ tadudyāne tyaktvā gṛhaṃ yayau nṛpaḥ ||45||| evaṃ krodhaṃ samādāya naṣṭasnehau babhūvatuḥ | atha vārtā prajāyāṃ sāprasarat karṇakarṇataḥ ||46|| śrutvā rājakumārasya pitarau kosaleśvarau | vṛddhau snuṣāṃ kumāraṃ cāhvayāmāsaturantike ||47|| vadhūputrau tato dṛṣṭvā pitā vacanamabravīt | putra kutra gataṃ prema yuvayoḥ kāraṇaṃ nu kim ||48|| atisnigdhau sadā yuvāṃ viruddhācaraṇau katham | putra dakṣo’si dharmiṣṭhāṃ naināṃ tyaktuṃ tvamarhasi ||49|| apriyaṃ noktapūrvaṃ tu yayā neṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ tava | sadā tvattoṣaṇe dakṣā tvayā tyaktuṃ na yujyate ||1.571.50|| gṛhadharmo rājadharmaḥ sadā yoṣitkṛtaḥ khalu | vaṃśadharmo yajñadharmaḥ strībhya eva pravartate ||51 || evaṃ pitṛvacaḥ śrutvā kumāraḥ pratyabhāṣata | doṣo na vidyate tāta snuṣāyāṃ ko’pi kutracit ||52|| kiṃ mayā vāryamāṇāpi nakulaṃ me’grato’hanat | tato’bhavanmama krodho mayeyaṃ paribhāṣitā ||53 || mama bhāryā na bhavatī na cāhaṃ tava vai patiḥ | putrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vadhvāḥ śuśrāva bhūpatiḥ ||54|| śirasā praṇatiṃ kṛtvā sedaṃ vacanamabravīt | aparādhavihīnā ca bhītā sā sarpiṇī nṛpa |||55|| mayātivāryamāṇena rājaputreṇa ghātitā | tato’haṃ krodhasantaptā maunamāsthāya saṃsthitā ||56 || tāvaddṛṣṭo nakulaśca mayā krodhena tāḍitaḥ | vāryamāṇā kumāreṇa punardaṇḍena tāḍitaḥ ||57|| anyonyapratispardhitvānmayā vai nakulo hataḥ | atra nyāyaṃ kuru rājan dehi daṇḍaṃ karomi tat ||58|| vadhūputravacaḥ śrutvā rājāha nipuṇaṃ vacaḥ | tiryañcoḥ kāraṇe kasmād yuvāṃ viśleṣamāpnuthaḥ ||59|| hate tu nakule putra kiṃ te krodhasya kāraṇam | rājaputri hatāyāṃ sarpiṇyāṃ krodhaṃ karoṣi kim ||1.571.6 0|| alpahetorbahunāśaṃ kathaṃ svīkurutho vṛthā | piturvacaḥ śubhaṃ śrutvā jātismaraḥ kumārakaḥ ||61 || pratyuvāca hi pitaraṃ prāksvabhāvaḥ pravartate | prakṛtiṃ yānti bhūtāni nigraho’tra na vidyate ||62|| svalpe’pi kāraṇe vairaṃ prāgjanmīyaṃ pravartate | evaṃ śrutvā putravākyaṃ pitā prāha sutaṃ tadā ||63|| brūhi putra yathānyāyaṃ prītivicchedakāraṇam | prāgjanīyaṃ bhaved yad tadubhayoriha kathyatām ||64|| pitṛpṛṣṭaṃ tu ced guptaṃ na gopāyanti satsutāḥ | satyaṃ vāsatyamevāpi cenna bruvanti putrakāḥ ||65|| patanti narake te vai raurave taptavāluke | pitrā pṛṣṭhaṃ tu ye brūyuḥ śubhaṃ vāśubhameva ca ||66|| divyāṃ tu te gatiṃ yānti yā gatiḥ satyavādinām | śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ putraḥ pitaraṃ prāha sādaram ||67|| kubjāmrakaṃ ca yattīrthaṃ tatra gatvā mahīpate | tadguptameva vaktavyaṃ prītivicchedakāraṇam ||68|| bāḍhaṃ tvāha tadā rājā rājñī prāha tathaiva ca | athāmātyān gurūn rājā cāhūya samuvāca tān ||69|| kubjāmrakaṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ gacchāmastasya sādhanam | śīghraṃ sampādyatāṃ cāpi yujyantāṃ gajavājinaḥ ||1.571.70|| gajāśvapaśuyānādikārṣāpaṇakadhenavaḥ | suvarṇaratnavastrāṇi tvannāni vividhānyapi ||71 || atha rājā sutaṃ prāha deśakālocitaṃ tadā | rājyaṃ śūnyaṃ kathaṃ tyaktvā gamiṣyāmo vayaṃ suta ||72|| jyeṣṭhaputraḥ sa covāca kanīyase pradehi tat | rājā prāha tathā syācced dharmalopo bhaved yataḥ ||73|| kathaṃ deyaṃ kaniṣṭhāya vidyamāne’graje sute | jyeṣṭhaḥ prāhānujānāmi tātāsmai dehi medinīm ||74|| na syād dharmavilopo’tra mamāstitvaṃ na vai bhavet | nāhaṃ kubjāmrakaṃ gatvā nivartiṣye punargṛham ||75|| etatsatyavaco matvā kanīyāṃsaṃ pradehi vai | śrutvaivaṃ bhūpatiḥ rājye kaniṣṭhamabhyaṣecayat ||76|| rājā tīrthaṃ yayāvantaḥpuravargādinā saha | tatastīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā dadau dānāni bhūriśaḥ ||77|| annavastrasuvarṇāni gohastyaśvagṛhāṇi ca | tato rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ jyeṣṭhaḥ sutaḥ snuṣāyutaḥ || 78|| snātvā tīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā natvā gurūn punaḥ punaḥ | pituḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā mātaraṃ cābhivādya ca ||79|| nirmālyakūṭaṃ yatrāsīnmandirasyāntike dhruvam | gatvā tatrāha pitaraṃ nakulo’haṃ purābhavam ||1.571.80|| kadalīnāṃ samudyāne cātra vāso’bhavanmama | atra cāśīviṣā sarpī mayā dṛṣṭā hi sannidhau ||8 1|| māghaśukladvādaśikādine prātastadāvayoḥ | yuddhyatorjātivaireṇa tīkṣṇaṃ sandaśatordvayoḥ ||82|| samakāle’bhavanmṛtyuḥ kubjāmrake sutīrthake | devāśraye ca tatpuṇyādahaṃ tava suto’bhavam ||83|| snuṣā te sarpiṇī seyaṃ prāgjyotiṣasutābhavat | evaṃ prāgbhavasaṃskārāt sarpyāṃ ca nakule dvayoḥ ||84|| vairaṃ pravartate nau ca tacca vicchedakāraṇam | athāvayormahārāja pūrṇamāyuḥ kṣayaṃ gatam ||85|| tīrthe’tra spaṣṭavāṇyā vai vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāva eva ca | ityuktvā tau hariṃ natvā puṇḍarīkākṣameva ca ||86|| pitarau ca tathāmātyān dehaṃ tyaktvā kṣaṇāntare | divyau bhūtvā vimānena caturbhujadharāvubhau ||87|| śvetadvīpaṃ yayaturvai viṣṇupārṣadayānagau | rājādyā vismayaṃ prāpuḥ rājāpi bhaktimām̐stadā ||88|| putraśokena santapto vrataṃ tapaścakāra ha | svalpakālena saṃsādhya siddhiṃ vai tāpasīṃ parām ||89|| yayau patnyā saha dehaṃ tyaktvā vaikuṇṭhameva ca | divyaṃ vai paramaṃ dhāma yatra devo janārdanaḥ ||1.571.90 || mamātīva prasādena tapasaśca balena ca | kṛtvā madbhajanaṃ tatra mamākṣarapadaṃ yayau ||91 || yo’sau parijanastasya kṛtvā so’pi ca sukṛtam | kubjāmrake parāṃ siddhiṃ prāptvā maddhāma saṃyayau ||92|| evaṃ kubjāmrakaṃ tīrthaṃ raibhyena tu vivardhitam | puṇḍarīkākṣa vāsāḍhyaṃ rājaputravimuktidam ||93|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛtṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | japan snānaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā pānaṃ saṃskaraṇaṃ tathā ||94|| darśanaṃ mama mūrteśca kṛtvā nārī naro’pi vā | prakṣālya sarvapāpāni prayāti paramāṃ gatim ||95|| uktamantraḥ paro jāpyaścāturvarṇyena sarvadā | sarvakarmasu mukhyārthaḥ kāmbhareyo’tra devatā ||96 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo rādhāprabhāpatiḥ | pārvatīmāṇikīnātho lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||97|| mañjuleśaśca haṃseśaḥ saguṇeśaḥ svayaṃprabhuḥ | dayānāthaḥ śāntināthaścampāhaimījayāpatiḥ ||98|| tejasāṃ yo mahattejastapatāṃ yo mahattapaḥ | taṃ bhajitvā bhavenmukto golokādhipateḥ puraḥ ||99|| śāśvatena sukhenātra pūryate kṛṣṇavattadā | ya etatpaṭhati lakṣmi kalyamutthāya mānavaḥ || 1.571.10 0|| tārayet sa svakulajān daśapūrvān daśāparān | etattu paṭhamāno vai yastu prāṇān vimuñcati || 10 1|| caturbhujaḥ sa jāyeta mallokeṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ | śravaṇādapi muktaḥ syācchaṃbhuḥ prāha satīṃ tadā || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kubjāmrake haridvāre bhaktamāhātmye raibhyasya camatkāraḥ, nakulasarpiṇyoḥ rājakule janmottaraṃ mitho vaireṇa prāgjanmasthale gatvā muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikasaptatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 571 ||
<1.572> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mahātīrthaṃ kubjāmrakaṃ pramokṣadam | narmadāyāṃ samāgatya kubjārevāsamāgame || 1 || vyavasthitaṃ dhruvaṃ sāptakalpaṃ vai śaṃkaro’vadat | pārvatyai tīrthayātrāyāmṛkṣaparvatasaṃsthitaḥ || 2 || athānyānyapi tīrthāni kathayāmi niśāmaya | māhiṣmatyāḥ paścime vai tīrthaṃ śokavināśanam || 3 || aśokavanikākhyātaṃ mātaṃgāśramaśobhitam | tatra yā pūjayed gaurīṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ pativratā || 4 || kanyā labhet patiṃ sveṣṭaṃ dravyarūpabalānvitam | mātaṃgo nāma devarṣistapastepe’tra duṣkaram || 5 || prāgjanmani niṣādaḥ sa jātismaro hyabhūt sadā | pāpanāśakare sthāne maharṣīṇāṃ samāgamāt || 6 || dharmajñātābhavacchreṣṭho rāgahīnaśca bodhavān | narmadāsevanāccāpi puṇyavānabhavaddhi saḥ || 7 || nirviṇṇaśca jaṭāvalkalāmbaraḥ śvapaco’pi ha | aśokavanikāsaṃsthaḥ kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ || 8 || varṣāṇāṃ sa sahasraṃ vai tapastepe’tidāruṇam | evaṃ vai tapatastasya jaṭāgrebhyo viniḥsṛtāḥ || 9 || yakṣiṇyaḥ śyāmavarṇāśca tejasvinyo vibhūṣitāḥ | ekāśītisahasrāṇi sasnustā narmadājale || 1.572.1 0|| snānamātreṇa tāḥ prāpuryakṣalokān suvāhanaiḥ | mantrayantravihīno’pi namaḥ śivāya saṃgṛṇan || 11 || siddhimānabhavattasya puraḥ śaṃkara āyayau | bhaktaṃ prāha varaṃ sveṣṭaṃ vṛṇīṣva śaṃkaro’smyaham || 12|| mātaṃgaḥ prāha mannāmnā tīrthaṃ khyātamidaṃ bhavet | cāṇḍālāḥ śvapacāścarmakārā ye pāpayonayaḥ || 13 || atrāgatya pavitrāśca muktimāpnuyureva ca | mātaṃgeśvaraliṃgaṃ ca natveyurmokṣaṇaṃ tathā || 14|| enaṃ varaṃ pradehyatra yadyahaṃ te’smi bhaktimān | śrutvā tacchaṃkaraḥ prāha tathāstviti punastataḥ || 15|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | ityenaṃ japa mātaṃga muktiste vaiṣṇavī parā || 16|| bhaviṣyati na sandehastathā tvajjātivartinām | asya mantrasya yogena vaikuṇṭhe mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 17|| dehi mantraṃ mayoktaṃ ca kuru sarvāṃśca vaiṣṇavān | ityuktvā śaṃkaraścāntardhānaṃ yayau tataḥ param || 18|| mataṃgo nijavarṇebhyo dehibhyaḥ pradadau manum | preṣayāmāsa sa bahūn cāṇḍālān vaiṣṇavān purā || 19|| golokaṃ śrīharerdhāma svayaṃ yānaṃ ca kāmikam | samāruhya yayau caitre mokṣaṃ vai paramaṃ śubham ||1.572.20|| aśokavanikaṃ caitanmātaṃgatīrthamucyate | tilapiṣṭādidānena saktūdānena tarpaṇe |||21||| pitaro jalapānena muktiṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ | tatraiva dakṣiṇe bhāge tīrthaṃ mṛgavanābhidham ||22|| tatra snātvārcayed viṣṇuṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam | ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ pūjayet parameśvaram ||23||| pativratā patiṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prapūjayet | snānadānaprabhāveṇa lokaṃ prāpnoti vaiṣṇavam ||24|| vyādhaḥ kaścid durācāro nirdayaśca purābhavat | sadhanuṣko mṛgām̐statra jaghāna ca tṛṣākulaḥ ||25|| vinā jala drumacchāyāmāśritya kṣaṇamāsthitaḥ | nidrāṃ yayau ca tatpaścād vanasaṃgharṣajo’nalaḥ ||26|| utthitaśca dadāhāsau vanaṃ vyādhamṛgānvitam | atha māsāntare varṣā jātā bhasmāsthikhaṇḍakāḥ ||27|| narmadāyāṃ gatāḥ sarve vṛṣṭipūreṇa vāhitāḥ | mṛgāste narmadāyogād gāndharvā devakoṭayaḥ ||28 || abhavam̐śca sa vai vyādho rājābhavaddhi bhūtale | tadanye prāṇinaścāpi narmadājalayogataḥ ||29|| yakṣādyā abhavan devā daśavarṣasahasrakam | svargaṃ bhuktvā tataste’pi tathā rājāsya gāyakāḥ ||1.572.3 0|| vaiṣṇavenaiva yānena saṃprāptā vaiṣṇavaṃ padam | avaśaḥ svavaśo vāpi prāṇām̐styajati nārmade ||3 1 || divyavarṣasahasraṃ sa viṣṇuloke pramodate | aṅgārāvartasaṃbhedo gosahasraphalapradaḥ ||32|| aṅgāreśvaradevaśca tatra tiṣṭhati saṃgame | snānamātro narastatra gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt ||33|| caturthyāṃ maṃgale vāre hiraṇyapuruṣaṃ śubham | kṛtvā raktena vastreṇa veṣṭayet saghṛtaṃ tathā ||34|| gūḍhaṃ dadyād brāhmaṇāya maṃgalaṃ puruṣaṃ dadet | dānatīrthaprabhāveṇa śakrārdhāsanabhāgbhavet ||35|| yuvanāśvaḥ purā rājā kosalāyā hyabhūnmahān |, cakravartī kṛtayuge sarvadharmaparāyaṇaḥ ||36|| abhivādya vaśiṣṭhaṃ sa samuvāca purohitam | kasmin sthāne yajed yajñaṃ tīrthe deśe surālaye ||37|| vaśiṣṭhastaṃ samuvāca naimiṣaṃ tīrthamuttamam | saphalo hayamedhaśca koṭikoṭiguṇottaraḥ ||38|| matsyena viṣṇunā coktaṃ sūryeṇāpi tathoditam | manuputrāya yajñārhaṃ yuvanāśva tavoditam || 39|| śrutvā rājā gurorvākyaṃ samādideśa mantriṇaḥ | yajñopaskaramādāya samāgacchata satvaram ||1.572.40|| ghoṣaṇā ca kṛtā loke āhūtāśca surāḥ kratau | brahmā viṣṇuḥ sureśaśca skando vaiśravaṇastathā ||41 || śaṃbhuśca vasavaścāpi rudrā ādityakāstathā | aśvinau ca diśāṃ pālā lokapālāśca sarvaśaḥ |||42|| dhenūnāṃ daśalakṣāṇi hemaratnānvitāni hi | lakṣamekaṃ vājināṃ saddantināmayutatrayam ||43|| maṇimāṇikyamuktāśca hiraṇyaṃ cāpyanantakam | nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi bhakṣyabhojyāni sarvaśaḥ ||44|| yajñadravyaṃ ca yaccānyat tatsarvasahito nṛpaḥ | nānāsahasrayānaiśca nānāvādyasahasrakaiḥ |||45|| vedaghoṣeṇa mahatā gītikairnādayan divam | viveśa naimiṣaṃ tīrthaṃ yatra śrīharidarśanam ||46 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā tato nṛpaḥ | dīnānāmayutāyāsau dadau suvarṇalakṣakam ||47|| bhūṣaṇāni dadau snātvā rūpyakāṇyamitāni tu | oṃ namo viṣṇave proktvā jaladarbhau nidhāya vai ||48|| saṃkalpya svarṇapātre sa yajñavāṭamakārayat | daśakośamitāṃ bhūmiṃ yajñayūpamayīṃ nṛpaḥ ||49|| hemayūpasuśobhādyāmakārayacca maṇḍapān | vedikā yajñakuṇḍāni mukhyakuṇḍānvitāni ca ||1.572.50|| tato nirvartito yajño vaśiṣṭhapramukhairdvijaiḥ | muditā devatāḥ sarvā jayaśabdān vadanti vai ||51 || yajñaṃ samāpya ca rājā sāntaḥpuraparicchadaḥ | yāvad yānaṃ samāruhya niḥsṛto naimiṣād vanāt ||52|| tāvat kaścid vānarastvāgatyovāca nṛpaṃ muhuḥ | tiṣṭha tiṣṭha śṛṇu rājan mithyāhaṃkāravān bhavān ||53|| kiṃ te yajñavidhānena phalaṃ manye na cādhikam | purāmareśvare yajñe satyadharmasya bhūpateḥ ||54|| varjayitvā mukhaṃ me’bhūt kaṇṭhādho hemavarṇakam | asmākaṃ śiśavaḥ sarve tatrābhavan hiraṇmayāḥ ||55|| kapilānarmadāyoge yajñatoyaprabhāvataḥ | snānāvagāhanātpānālluṇṭhanātkardame kratoḥ ||56 || gandharvalokaṃ samprāpto bhūtagrāmaścaturvidhaḥ | athāhaṃ lulito yajñe tava naimiṣasaṃbhave ||57|| paṃkena liptaṃ gātraṃ me kṣālitaṃ yajñavāriṇā | na kiñcit phalamāsīnme na gātraṃ svarṇatāṃ gatam ||58|| ahaṃkāragato yajñastava sarvo nirarthakaḥ | gavāṃ tvayāyutaṃ dattaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyamanantakam ||59|| svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ tathā dattaṃ kintu sarvaṃ nirarthakam | etatte kathitaṃ rājan kratuste nahi tādṛśaḥ ||1.572.60 || satyadharmasya nṛpateryathābhūnnarmadātaṭe | svasti vo’stu gamiṣyāmi narmadāṃ svarṇarūpadām ||6 1 || śrutvā tvadīyaṃ yajñaṃ vai naimiṣāraṇyamāgataḥ | nirāśo’haṃ pragacchāmi nābhūnme kāṃcanaṃ mukham ||6 2|| vānarasya vacaḥ śrutvā yuvanāśvo’bravīt tadā | ko’si vānararūpastvaṃ vada me śreyasāṃ nidhe ||63|| kapiḥ prāha kadambākhyo jābāliputra ātmavit | jātismaraḥ phalacauryād vānaratvamupāgataḥ ||64|| kṛtāni sarvatīrthāni veṣeṇānena bhūpate | na śreyo me’bhavat kiṃcittīrtheṣu tvalpamityapi ||65|| kevalaṃ nārmade kṣetre satyadharmamakhottame | vapurhiraṇmayaṃ sarvaṃ mukhavarjaṃ mamābhavat ||66|| vānarasya vacaḥ śrutvā rājā tu naimiṣaṃ punaḥ | yayau śrīparameśaṃ taṃ hyādidevaṃ vibhuṃ harim ||67|| tuṣṭāva parayā prītyā bhagavantaṃ narāyaṇam | bhagavannaimiṣe kṣetre mayā yajñaḥ prasādhitaḥ ||68|| atrānte śrāvayāmāsa hyeko vānararūpadhṛk | na yajñe te mama lābho vṛthā yajñastatastava ||69|| sa tvicchati mukhaṃ svasya hiraṇmayaṃ kratūttaram | hiraṇmayaṃ mukhaṃ tasya yathā syāt tat tathā kuru ||1.572.70|| śrutvā śrībhagavānāha mūrtistho yuvanaṃ nṛpam | narmadāyāṃ punaryajñaṃ satyadharmaḥ kariṣyati ||71 || tatra tasya mukhaṃ svarṇaṃ bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ | vadainaṃ vānaraṃ yāhi rājam̐stvaṃ kosalāṃ purīm ||72|| rājā śrutvā tu naimiṣaṃ hariṃ natvā purīṃ yayau | vānaraśca yayau revākapilāsaṃgamaṃ punaḥ ||73|| tatra gatvā satyadharmaṃ naimiṣākhyānamāha saḥ | satyadharmaśca tacchrutvā harervacaḥ pramāṇayan ||74|| pracakāra punaryajñaṃ vānaro’vabhṛthottaram | kardame svamukhaṃ luṇṭhan prāveśayanmuhurmuhuḥ ||75|| hemībhūtavapurjāto mukhaṃ sarvaṃ ca kānakam | abhavacca tadā tyaktvā śarīraṃ vānarasya saḥ ||76|| devadundubhinādena satkṛtaścāpsarāṃ gaṇaiḥ | haṃsayuktena yānena yayau vaikuṇṭhameva saḥ ||77|| tatra yajñe śvāpadādyāḥ kaṇaṃ bhuktvā divaṃ gatāḥ | evaṃ vai nārmadaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvopari pravartate ||78|| śravaṇātkīrtanāccāsya gosahasraphalaṃ bhavet | śaṃkaraḥ pārvatīṃ prāha mayā lakṣmi tavoditam ||79|| svadravyeṇa tu yo yajñaṃ karoti nārmade taṭe | bhuktvā sa puṣkalān bhogān viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||1.572.80 || dhātrīṃ hiraṇmayīṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāya prakalpayet | narmadātīramāśritya viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||8 1|| pratyakṣadhenuṃ yo dadyāddhemaratnavibhūṣitām | ghṛtadhenuṃ guḍadhenuṃ śarkarādhenumityapi ||82|| revākapilayoryoge viṣṇuloke mahīyate | śṛṇu cānyāṃ kathāṃ cāpi pāpatāpapraṇāśinīm ||83|| vīraṇasya tu rājarṣermaitreyo’bhūtpurohitaḥ | tena cāyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ha ||84|| kāritaṃ narmadātīre svargakalaśaśobhitam | tadāyatanapuṇyena narmadāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ ||85|| modate vaiṣṇave loke maitreyo vai caturbhujaḥ | athāyaṃ vīraṇo rājā śuśrāva devadūtataḥ ||86 || rājam̐stava guruḥ svargaṃ nimnīkṛtya gato hareḥ | vaikuṇṭhaṃ tvaṃ kathaṃ naiva yāsyasi darśanāya vai ||87|| devadūtasya tacchrutvā papraccha ca kathaṃ gatiḥ | devadūtastadā prāha yajñamācara nārmade ||88|| taṭe ramye hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ toṣayitvā prayāsyasi | vīraṇo’pi kratuṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ pracakāra ha ||89|| devāstatra samāyātā maitreyo’pi narāyaṇaḥ | lakṣmyādyā mātaraścāpi rājā sarvā hyatoṣayat ||1.572.90|| athāvamṛthakaṃ snānaṃ kṛtvā dattvā ca dakṣiṇāḥ | vīraṇo divyayānena bhūtvā divyo hi vaiṣṇavaḥ ||91 || caturbhujābhiḥ kanyābhirvījyamāno’tisundaraḥ | caturbāhudharaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ raṭan muhuḥ ||92|| devaiśca pārṣadairmārge vardhitaḥ svāgatīkṛtaḥ | yayau viṣṇoḥ paraṃ dhāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ nityaśāntidam ||93|| rantidevo’pi rājarṣiḥ kṛtvā yajñām̐śca nārmade | kṣetre bilvām̐stathāmrām̐śca samarpya parameśvaram ||94|| toṣayitvā hariṃ devān tīrthaṃ bilvāmrakaṃ tadā | kṛtvā cājñāṃ samādāya nārāyaṇasya śārṅgiṇaḥ ||95|| prajāśca vaiṣṇavīrbhaktāḥ kāścinnītvā sahāpi ca | taṭe cānte harerdhāma yayau sakulabāndhavaḥ ||96|| dadhīcirnāma rājarṣiravantīnṛpatiḥ purā | narmadāyāstaṭe gatvā datvā cendrāya pṛṣṭhagam ||97|| vaṃśāsthi ca tato bhaktyā yayau nārāyaṇaṃ padam | yadasthijātaśastrairvai devā jigyurmahāsurān ||98|| amāsomasamāyoge snātvā bilvāmrake priye | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ janā yānti nārmadakṣetrayogataḥ || 99|| viśve devāḥ parāṃ siddhiṃ bilvāmrake samāpnuyuḥ | pāṭhakāḥ śrāvakāścāpi yāsyanti paramāṃ gatim || 1.572.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’śokavanikāyāṃ mātaṃgāśramaḥ, aṃgāreśvaram, satyadharmasya yajñe nakulasya svarṇarūpatā, vīraṇasya mokṣaḥ, ityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāsaptatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 572 ||
<1.573> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ākarṇaya mahālakṣmi śaṃkaroditamuttamam | suvarṇadvīpatīrthaṃ ca narmadājalamadhyataḥ || 1 || hārīto vai maharṣistu purā kṛtayuge’tapat | tatra haritavarṇasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ha || 2 || darśanaṃ jāyate ramyaṃ tapatāṃ yogināṃ tathā | atha revottare kūle paryaṃko nāma parvataḥ || 3 || tatra pāpaharo viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ tiṣṭhati mādhavaḥ | krośamātrapramāṇaṃ tat harikṣetraṃ prakīrtitam || 4 || tatra snātā mṛtāścāpi prayānti paramāṃ gatim | narmadāyāmyabhāge ca māṇḍavyāśramamuttam || 5 || vibhāṇḍakaḥ ṛṣyaśṛṃgastathānye nyavasanpurā | viśokānarmadāsaṃgo’śokeśvaraśca śaṃkaraḥ || 6 || śobhane nimnage tatra narmadāvindhyasaṃgamaḥ | nivasanti mokṣadāśca devyastatra samāgame || 7 || harṣasiddhā ca sāvitrī devamātāditistathā | devayānī brahmatanvī rohiṇī kambharāyaṇī || 8 || lopāmudrā tathendrāṇī dākṣāyaṇī prabhā dhruvā | ratnāvalī tathā saṃjñā tārā siddhiśca pārvatī || 9 || lakṣmīḥ rādhā maṇikī ca haṃsā ca maṃjulāmṛtā | maṃgalā saguṇāśokā svasvasvāmiyutāstu tāḥ || 1.573.1 0|| dayā jayā ca lalitā mauktikī hemacampikā | kastūrikā ca savitā vasanti vindhyanārmade || 11 || saṃbhede’śokavanikākṣetre gauryā varaḥ kṛtaḥ | āśvine dhavale caturdaśyāṃ vratavatī ca yā || 1 2|| aputriṇī tathā vandhyā durbhagā bhartṛvarjitā | pañcaratnaphalaiḥ snātā divyavastubhirarcayet || 13|| snāpayecca jalaiḥ saṃbhojayet kumārikāstathā | akhaṇḍasaubhāgyayutā putriṇī mānitā bhavet || 14|| ādau kṛte raviścandraḥ kāñcīpurapatirnṛpaḥ | somavaṃśasamudbhāvo narmadātīravāsinam || 15|| maitrāvaruṇikaṃ vipramagastyaṃ prati saṃyayau | śāṇḍilyena samaṃ rājā purohitena tena vai | nanāmāgastikaṃ vipraṃ pādau jagrāha tasya ca || 16|| agastiḥ kuśalaṃ sarvaṃ papraccha cāsanaṃ dadau | rājā prāha tapataste darśanāt kilbiṣaṃ gatam || 17|| adya me saphalaṃ janma rājyaṃ jīvanamityapi | kasmin sthāne yaje yajñaṃ yathā saṃsiddhyate kratuḥ || 18||| surāṇāṃ cākṣayā tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet | muniḥ prāha kratoryogyā narmadā saptakalpagā || 19 || aśokavanikā yajñabhūmiḥ khyātā surārcitā | tatra yajñaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tvaṃ vidhehi pārameṣyasi ||1.573.20 || rājāgastiṃ saha nītvā yayāvaśokikāṃ sthalīm | revāyā dakṣiṇe kūle yajñayūpām̐śca maṇḍapam ||21|| daśakrośānābhivyāpya kārayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ | saptarṣayastathā vālakhilyāścānye’pi bhūsurāḥ ||22|| brahmadṛśyo lomaśaśca kuṃkumavāpikāsthitaḥ | surāśca brāhmaṇāścānye yayuryajñaḥ pravartitaḥ ||23|| tṛptāstu devatāḥ sarvā viprāḥ saṃlabdhadakṣiṇāḥ | tatastatra samāyāto durvāsā munirāṭ krudhā ||24|| uvāca nātra me sthānaṃ vaivasvatasya nāsti ca | nāradaḥ parvato nāsti kālo mṛtyurna vidyate ||25|| citraguptastathā nāsti kathaṃ yajñaḥ pravartitaḥ | durvāsasaṃ raviścandro natvā prāha tadā vacaḥ ||26 || ko me samartho vighnāya surāsuragaṇeṣvapi | aśokeśvaradevasya narmadāyāḥ prasādataḥ ||27|| mayā nirvartito yajño yajñe pūjyāḥ samāgatāḥ | bhavanto’pi mama pūjāṃ gṛhṇantu dakṣiṇāstathā ||28|| dadāmi vo na sandeho durvāsā nāradādayaḥ | yo yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ taṃ tasmai pradadāmyaham ||29|| āgatāḥ prastutāstatra nāradādyā maharṣayaḥ | toṣitā bhūbhṛtā te ca yatheṣṭādipradānataḥ || 1.573.30 || durvāsasā tataḥ punastvarthitaṃ śṛṇu padmaje | pūrvaṃ pārvatīśāpena pāṭalīputravāsinaḥ ||3 1 || śaptā vai brāhmaṇāḥ śvāno bhūtvā bhramanti vai kṣitau | teṣāṃ muktiṃ ca rājam̐stvaṃ kuru puṇyapradānakaiḥ ||32|| rājā prāha kathaṃ te vai śāpaṃ prāptā vadasva me | durvāsāḥ prāha te viprāḥ purā valkaladhāriṇaḥ || 33 || nepāle vai paśupatiṃ pūjayituṃ yayustadā | pupūjuḥ śaṃkaraṃ bhaktyā gauryā virahitaṃ ca te ||34|| ardhanārīśvare nārībhāgaṃ hitvā puṃmātrakam | candanādyaiḥ samānarcuḥ pārvatī krodhatastadā ||31|| śaśāpa brāhmaṇām̐stām̐śca nāryardhabhedakāriṇaḥ | varṣasahasraṃ sarve vai śvayoniṃ tu gamiṣyatha ||36 || atha śāpena te sarve śvayoniṃ pragatāstadā | vartante tānmocaya tvaṃ vanādāhūya cātra vai ||37|| atha rājñā preṣitāśca kiṃkarāstadvanaṃ prati | śvāno jātismarāḥ śīghraṃ kiṃkaraiḥ saha cāyayuḥ ||38|| aśokavanikābhūmiṃ prāha tānnṛpatirmudā | aśokeśvaradevasya narmadāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ ||3 9 || mama dānaprabhāveṇa maharṣīṇāṃ prasādataḥ | tyaktvā śvayoniṃ munayo brahmalokaṃ prayāntu vai || 1.573.40 || yuṣmatpāpaṃ śāparūpaṃ mayi sarvaṃ viśāmyatu | tatkṣaṇānmuktaśāpāste kāmikaṃ yānamāsthitāḥ ||41 || bhūtvā maharṣayo divyā raviścandraṃ pratuṣṭuvuḥ | tvaṃ mātā tvaṃ pitāsmākaṃ tvaṃ gururmokṣadāyakaḥ ||42 || evamuktvā yayuḥ svargaṃ satyalokātmakaṃ śubham | durvāsādyāḥ ṛṣayo’pi praśaśaṃsurnṛpaṃ tadā ||43 || sādhu sādhu mahābhāga tvaṃ tu yajñataponidhiḥ | nānyastvayā samaḥ kaścit somavaṃśodbhavo nṛpaḥ ||44|| prāṇatyāgo hi sukaraḥ puṇyatyāgo’ti duṣkaraḥ | puṇyaṃ pradāsyasi kṣmābhṛt phalaṃ tvasyāsti śāśvatam || 45 || varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yatte manasi vartate | rājāha mama puṇyena janā durbuddhayo’pi ca ||46 || prāpnuvantu paraṃ lokaṃ vara eṣa mama priyaḥ | durvāsādyāḥ ṛṣayo’pi tathāstvityabhidhāya vai ||47|| antardhānaṃ yayuḥ sarve tato dharmaḥ samāgataḥ | prasannaḥ san dharmarājo varaṃ dadāmi cāha tam ||48|| yamaloko jito rājan devaloko jitastvayā | yajñapuṇyapradānena śvāno muktāḥ kṛtāstvayā ||49|| pṛthivyāṃ duṣkaraṃ karma yajñapuṇyapradānakam | varayogyo’si rājendra vṛṇuṣva ca yathepsitam ||1.573.50|| raviścandrastadā prāha yamalokagatāśca ye | pāpino duḥkhabhoktāro nārakā yātanārditāḥ || 51 || mama yajñaśatenaiva dānena tapasā tathā | prayāntu tvatprasādena svargaṃ satyaṃ sukhāvaham | | 52 || yamaḥ prāha tathaivāstu puṇyaṃ te vardhate bahu | paroddhāre’rpitaṃ puṇyaṃ sahasraguṇitaṃ bhavet || |53 || tena puṇyena rājendra yāhi tvaṃ brahmapattanam | śāśvataṃ dhāma yannityānandabhṛtaṃ parākṣaram | | 54 | | yatastvayā kaśmalādvai mocitāḥ pāpayonayaḥ | kṣatriyāḥ śataśo rājan anye cāpi sahasraśaḥ ||55 || evamuktvā dharmarājo datvā rājñe japāya vai | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | | 56 || ṣoḍaśākṣaramantraṃ ca yayau svabhavanaṃ mudā | rājā kālena divyo’bhūd yayāvakṣarataḥ param | | 57 || brahmadhāmottaraṃ dhāma paraṃ pumuttamasya yat | śravaṇāt kīrtanādasya gosahasraphalaṃ bhavet | | 58 || atha tīrthaṃ vāgurevāsaṃgamākhyaṃ tataḥ param | brahmadatto’bhavad rājā kośalānāṃ praśāsakaḥ | | 59 || sūryavaṃśī kratuṃ revāvāguyoge cakāra ha | daśayojanaparyantā yajñabhūmirabhūttadā | | 1.573.60 || asya yajñe cātitṛptāḥ pretā muktiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ | śṛṇu pretāḥ kathaṃ jātāḥ ke’bhavam̐ste purā yathā | | 61 || kārtikyāṃ puṣkare tīrthe purā maharṣayo yayuḥ | ayogandhaḥ svayaṃbhūśca puṇḍarīkākṣa ityapi || 62 || brahmā kāvyastathā hotā sadano vedagarbhakaḥ | kṛtadhvanaḥ svastikaśca sāvitro vāmadevakaḥ ||6 3 || aghamarṣo brahmatejāstathānye brāhmaṇā yayuḥ | sarve gārhasthyadharmasthāstṛṣṇāhīnā hi vaiṣṇavāḥ || 64|| teṣāṃ bhāryāḥ patidharmā bhartṛśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ | cīravalkaladhāriṇyaḥ śākaśyāmākabhakṣikāḥ || 65 || dāridryadoṣasantaptā viṣaṇṇāścaikadā tu tāḥ | viprasthitiṃ yajanaṃ yājanaṃ cādhyāpanaṃ tathā | | 66 || adhyayanaṃ tathā dānaṃ pratigrahaṃ vyagarhayan | ṣaṭsveteṣu viprakarmasvatikaṣṭaṃ vilokyate | | 67 || bhūṣaṇaṃ rājasaṃ kiñcinnāpyate brāhmaṇagṛhe | evaṃ vyagarhayam̐stāsāṃ śrutvā viprā maharṣayaḥ || 68 || viṣaṇṇavadanāstāsāṃ pūrayituṃ manogatam | sastrīputrā yayuḥ sūryagrahe kṣetre ca kaurave ||6 9 || yatra dānaṃ dadāti sma hariścandro ravergrahe | pratigrahecchayā samāgatān dṛṣṭvā sa bhūpatiḥ ||1.573.70|| prasannavadano dānasāphalyaṃ praśaśaṃsa ha | dhanyā me saphalā yātrā kurukṣetre’dya vartate ||71 || kṣudhārtā duḥkhitāścāpi bālā vṛddhāḥ kṛśāturāḥ | valkalājinavastrāśca durbalā me hyupāgatāḥ ||72|| evamuktvā namaskṛtyaikaikasya ca pṛthakpṛthak | lakṣaṃ lakṣaṃ hiraṇyasya tathā gāvaḥ sahasraśaḥ ||73|| sahasraṃ turagāṇāṃ ca dantināṃ śatamityapi | sāptabhaumān gṛhānramyān hemaprākāratoraṇān ||74|| yānavāhanadāsām̐śca dāsīstathā samārpayat | rājapratigrahaṃ prāptāḥ pāpabhoktāra eva te ||75|| ṣaṭkarmāṇi parityajya vilāseṣvabhavan hṛtāḥ | kālāntare mṛtā jātāḥ pretarūpā bhayāvahāḥ ||76|| pratigrahaprabhāvo’yaṃ viprasya patanaṃ yataḥ | te ca jātismarāḥ sarve dānadagdhāḥ sabāndhavāḥ ||77|| duḥkhinastvāgatāstīrthaṃ puṣkaraṃ yatra nāradaḥ | badarīṃ prati saṃyāsyannirgatastatpradeśataḥ ||78|| pretarūpān munīn dṛṣṭvā viṣādaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ | papraccha ca kathaṃ pretā jātā iti tataśca te ||79|| ūcurvayaṃ hariścandranṛpatervai pratigraham | kurukṣetre labdhavanto lobhena tatphalaṃ gatāḥ ||1.573.80|| pretabhāvaṃ samāpannā mokṣo’smākaṃ vidhīyatām | śrutvā tānnāradaḥ prāha narmadāṃ yāta pāvanīm ||8 1 || vāgīśaṃ ca puraṃ tatra narmadātaṭamāśritam | adhvare brahmadattasya mokṣaṇaṃ vo bhaviṣyati ||82|| ityuktvā nārado nārāyaṇāśramaṃ yayau tataḥ | pretā yayustamuddeśaṃ vāgīśapuramuttamam ||83|| snātvā sūryaṃ hariṃ śaṃbhuṃ pūjayitvā yayurmakham | makhaprāsādikaṃ prāśya pāpahīnāḥ surūpiṇaḥ ||84|| babhūvustān vilokyaitān vimalān sūryavarcasaḥ | brahmadattādayo natvā papracchuryūyamatra ke ||85|| kathaṃ pretatvamāpannā babhūva muktatā katham | atha tairnijavṛttāntastebhyastatra niveditaḥ ||86|| cakruścopari rājñaste puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ divaṃgatāḥ | brahmayānaṃ samāruhya brahmalokaṃ yayustataḥ ||87|| rājānaṃ śaṃśamānā vai makhaṃ ca nārmadaṃ jalam | devā viprā yayurnaijaṃ deśaṃ yajñe pratoṣitāḥ ||88|| śravaṇātkīrtanādasya gosahasraphalaṃ bhavet | anyaccāpi sahasrāvartakaṃ tīrthaṃ pravidyate ||89|| tatra snātasya vidhivad vṛṣotsargaphalaṃ bhavet | karāvanaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ saugandhikaṃ vanaṃ tathā || 1.573.90|| tatra sarasvatī cāste pitruddhārakarī śubhā | triśūlākhyaṃ tathānyacca tīrtha gaṇeśatāpradam || 91|| brahmodaṃ cāparaṃ tīrthaṃ saptarṣisnānakāritam | kapiñjalo muniśreṣṭho havyavāhaśca devatā ||92||| bhagavān devayānaśca viśvāvasurmahāmuniḥ | asya tīrthasya māhātmyād brahmalokamupāgatāḥ ||93|| vasvāśramaṃ tathā ramyaṃ tīrthaṃ paramamasti ca | saptasārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ yatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||94|| sākṣād virājate brahmā stutiṃ tasya cakāra ha | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhavatu me gatiḥ ||95|| akṣarādhipatirmuktapatiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | rādhāpatiśca lakṣmīśaḥ pārvatīśo’stu me gatiḥ ||96|| jayāpatirlaliteśo māṇikīśo’stu me gatiḥ | vāsudevaḥ svayaṃ svāmī nārāyaṇo’stu me gatiḥ ||97|| bhūmā viṣṇurmahākṛṣṇo vairājeśo’stu me gatiḥ | upendro haṃsanāthaśca bhūśrīśo’stu ca me gatiḥ ||98|| prabhāpatirmaṃjuleśo haṃseśaḥ saguṇāpatiḥ | kāṃbhareyaśca bhagavān harikṛṣṇo’stu me gatiḥ ||99|| hṛṣīkeśo mādhavaśca devīnātho’stu me gatiḥ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmāyudhaḥ śrīgaruḍāsanaḥ || 1.573.10 0|| sarvāvirbhāvamūlaṃ ca janārdano’stu me gatiḥ | paramātmā parabrahma gopālabālakaḥ prabhuḥ || 10 1|| viśvātmā cāntarātmā ca hṛdayastho’stu me gatiḥ | bhaktasya bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ prīyatāṃ savitāpatiḥ || 102|| sītāramāprapuṣpeśo bhaktapatiḥ prasīdatu | janmaprabhṛti yatkiñcidarjitaṃ me tvadarpitam || 103 || nānyaḥ puṇyataro devo nāsti viṣṇuparaṃ tapaḥ | nāsti svāmiparaṃ jñānaṃ sarvaṃ svāmimayaṃ jagat || 1 04|| etatstavaraveṇāpi janā yāsyanti mokṣaṇam | śravaṇātkīrtanādasya hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 105 || brahmā stutvā jale snātvā kārtikyāṃ yānamāsthitaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ raṭan yayau divam || 106 || etat tīrthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇodaṃ mokṣadaṃ smṛtam | śaṃbhūditaṃ ca yatsatyai mayā lakṣmi tavoditam || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne suvarṇadvīpatīrthaṃ viśokānarmadāsaṃgamaḥ, aśokeśvare raviścandrayajñe pretoddhāraḥ, vāgurevāsaṃgamaḥ, śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇatīrthādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā trisaptatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||573||
<1.574> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tato gacchettīrthaṃ devamayaṃ śubham | satīṃ śaṃbhurjagādaivaṃ nārmade codbhave sthitaḥ || 1 || sahasrayajñaṃ tīrthaṃ ca janārdanādhivāsitam | kṛtvā yāmyāṃ ca nagarīṃ naiva paśyet kadācana || 2 || śuklatīrthaṃ tato gacchet sarvatīrthamayaṃ param | tena śuklīkṛtā devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || 3 || tīrthānāṃ koṭayastatra śuklatīrthe vasanti vai | indraḥ śaṃbhuṃ snāpayitvā bilvapatraiḥ samārcayat || 4 || dikpālaiḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatraiva pūjitaḥ | kaśyapasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ yatrāyutarṣimaṇḍalam || 5 || munīnāṃ koṭayaścāpi śukleśvaramupāsate | sarvatīrthamayaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ hi tat || 6 || pitāmahena yatreṣṭo yajñe yajñeśvaraḥ purā | sarvapāpāni naśyanti tasyā bhūmerniṣevaṇāt || 7 || agatyā tu mṛtānāṃ tanmuktidaṃ śuklatīrthakam | yayātirnāma dharmātmā cakravartyabhavannṛpaḥ || 8 || iyāja sa mahāyajñaiḥ revāmadhumatīyujau | yatra madhyeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ mādhavo’haṃ narāyaṇaḥ || 9 || tatra snātā divaṃ mokṣaṃ yānti te na punarbhavāḥ | yayātinā brāhmaṇaiścaikadā yajñaḥ pravartitaḥ || 1.574.1 0|| yatra nāsti hareḥ sthānaṃ śaṃbhoḥ sthānaṃ na vai tathā | jaṭāsurastadā daityaśchidraṃ dṛṣṭvā hyupāyayau || 11 || asurairdhvaṃsito yajño yūpāśca vinipātitāḥ | bhukto hutapuroḍāśaḥ somapānaṃ ca taiḥ kṛtam || 1 2|| aṣṭottaraśataṃ devā mṛgarūpeṇa nirgatāḥ | rājāstraṃ pratijagrāha smṛtvā hariṃ haraṃ tadā || 13 || jaghāna dānavān yuddhe āhūtāśca punaḥ surāḥ | punaḥ pravartito yajño haraviṣṇuprasādataḥ ||14|| hariṇā śaṃbhunā tatra pratyakṣeṇa svatejasā | śuklīkṛtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ yathā golokamakṣaram || 15|| yayātinā vareṇāpi chanditau tu haro hariḥ | tiṣṭhataṃ nityamatraiva divyarūpeṇa ceśvarau || 16|| tāvadārabhya tau śvetau dīpyamānau haro hariḥ | vartete bhaktakalyāṇakarau tīrthe hi śuklake || 17|| yajñadānādikaṃ sarvamakṣayaṃ tatra jāyate | ye ke’pi dehinastatra jalaṃ pāsyanti vā kvacit || 18|| te sarve dhāma yāsyanti śuklatīrthaprabhāvataḥ | kāmayante tu yān kāmān tām̐stān prāpsyanti mānavāḥ|| 1 9|| yayātistu gṛhaṃ tatra kārayitvā sumandiram | tatra devau pratiṣṭhāpya nijarājyamupāgataḥ || 1.574.20|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | japan dhāma yayau cānte śrotā vaktāpi mokṣagaḥ || 21 || dvīpeśvaraṃ tathā tīrthaṃ narmadāyāstaṭe sthitam | tato gacchettu kārtikyāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tīrthamuttamam ||22|| nābhāgena stuto viṣṇuryatra pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ | tato gacchenmeghanādābhidhaṃ śrīśaṃkaraṃ priye ||23|| purā vai rāvaṇo rakṣaḥ paryaṭan pṛthivīmimām | yayau devagirau yatra mayo nāmāsti dānavaḥ ||24|| paulastyastaṃ mayaṃ prāha keyaṃ kanyāsti kasya ca | kinnāmadheyā tapati tapa ugraṃ tavāśrame ||25|| mayaḥ prāha mama patnyāṃ tejovatyāṃ suputrikā | janma prāpa ca patyarthaṃ tapate dāruṇaṃ tapaḥ ||26|| nāmnā mandodarīṃ viddhi gṛhāṇa svāgataṃ śubham | rāvaṇastu tadā prāha rājāhaṃ dehi me’tra tām ||27|| mayo dadau sutāṃ tasmai vidhinā rāvaṇastataḥ | yayau svaṃ siṃhalaṃ dvīpaṃ yatra sā suṣuve sutam ||28|| jātamātreṇa bālena ravaḥ kaṇṭhāt prakāśitaḥ | meghavat tena nāmnāsau meghanāda itikṛtaḥ || 29|| meghanādaḥ śaṃkarasya bhakto’bhavad yathā pitā | bhāvayāmāsa deveśaṃ pārvatyā saha śaṃkaram ||1.574.30|| tapobhiścopavāsādyaiḥ kliśyate tatkalevaram | meghanādastvekadā vai yayau kailāsaparvatam || 31 || liṃgaṃ pāṣāṇakaṃ nītvā prayayau nārmadaṃ taṭam | meghanādena salile sthāpitaṃ pūjitaṃ tathā ||32|| meghāravākhyo grāmaśca garjanākhyastathāparaḥ | meghanādasamākhyātaṃ kṣetraṃ taccābhavattataḥ ||33|| śaṃkarastapasā tasya tatra pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ | tato muktiṃ gataḥ kālāntareṇa viṣṇughātitaḥ || 34|| atha dāruvanaṃ tīrthaṃ vartate puṇyadāyakam | mātaliśca mahendrasya dārukākhyaḥ purābhavat ||35|| sa cāgatya jale tatra revāyāṃ sutapo’tapat | abhajatparayā bhaktyā śaṃkaraṃ dārukeśvaram ||36||| śaṃbhustutoṣa pradadau varaṃ mantraṃ ca vaiṣṇavam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 37|| aṃśāvataraṇe viṣṇoḥ sārathistvaṃ bhaviṣyasi | toṣayitvā jagannāthaṃ tato yāsyasi sadgatim ||38|| tataḥ śaṃbhustirodhānaṃ yayau divaṃ ca mātaliḥ | vāsudevasutaḥ kālāntare’bhavatsa mātaliḥ || 29|| kṛṣṇayogena vai muktiṃ gato golokadhāmani | athānyad vartate tīrthaṃ karañjeśvaramuttamam ||1.574.40|| kaśyapāttu danoḥ putraḥ karañjastvabhavatpurā | tapaścacāra yatrāyaṃ karañjeśvarameva tat ||41 || mahādevaḥ prasanno’bhūd dadau tasmai varaṃ śubham | atra karañjaśaṃbhurvai nivatsyāmi sutīrthake ||42|| tato yayau divaṃ so’pi karañjaḥ śaṃbhvanugrahāt | atha vai pippaleśasya tīrthaṃ muktipradaṃ śubham ||43|| pippalādakṛtaṃ cāste gantavyaṃ tatra vai tataḥ | guhyatīrthaṃ tato gacched bālahatyāvināśanam ||44|| govindākhyo’bhavadviprastasya bhāryā pativratā | tasyāṃ sa janayāmāsa putramekaṃ susundaram ||45|| kadācid brāhmaṇaḥ so’pi kāṣṭhānyānetumutsukaḥ | vanaṃ yātastato nītvā kāṣṭhabhāraṃ gṛhāgataḥ ||46|| gṛhe tamasi bālastu supto’bhūd yatra pārśvake | kāṣṭhabhāraṃ nicikṣepa vipraścājñāta eva saḥ ||47|| bālo mamāra bhāreṇa dvijo jānāti naiva tat | brāhmaṇyapi kṣaṇādūrdhvaṃ jñātavatī tathāpi tam ||48|| na śaśaṃsa bhayāttasya so’pi punarvanaṃ gataḥ | tataḥ sā vilalāpātha govinde tvāgate punaḥ ||49|| maunamāsthāya ca dadau bhojanaṃ śayanaṃ dadau | rātrau svapantaṃ kāntaṃ sā kṛmivyāptaṃ dadarśa ha ||1.574.50|| bālahatyātmakāḥ sarve kṛmayastaṃ vavalgire | brāhmaṇī svapatiṃ rātrau pāpakṛmisamāvṛtam ||51 || śuśoca vīkṣya manasā bahirnaivāprakāśayat | atha prātarbrāhmaṇo’pi śīghramutthāya narmadām ||52|| pratyaraṇyaṃ yayau kāṣṭhānyānetuṃ tṛṣito’bhavat | jalaṃ pītvā vanadāruṇyādāya niśithe gṛham ||53|| āyayau bhojanaṃ jagdhvā śayane nidrito’bhavat | punarviprā kṛmiśūnyaṃ dṛṣṭvā dehaṃ svasvāminaḥ ||54|| kathanīyaṃ svāmine me sutasya maraṇaṃ prage | vicāryetthaṃ ca suṣvāpa prātaścāha patiṃ tataḥ ||55|| putro’yaṃ ghātitaḥ kāṣṭhabhārairnātha tvayā tu tat | gatehni pātakaṃ ghoraṃ kṛmirūpaṃ tanau tava |||56|| lokitaṃ pūrvaniśithe nātra rātrau kva tadgatam | vada puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ kiñcit kiṃ vā jātaṃ śubhaṃ prabho ||57|| vipraḥ prāha mayā pītaṃ jalaṃ nārmadamatra yat | tadā mayāpi te dṛṣṭāḥ kīṭā dehādviniḥsṛtāḥ |||58||| kimidaṃ kimidaṃ caitanmatvā cāhaṃ mumoha ca | kintu nātyavadhāryaṃ tanmatvā tubhyaṃ na voditam ||59|| īśvarecchā sukhaduḥkhapravāhe kāraṇaṃ priye | ehi putraṃ nidhāyaiva gacchāvo narmadātaṭam ||1.574.60|| snāpayitvā kariṣyāvaḥ saṃskāraṃ jalavāhanam | iti nirṇīya tau putraśavamādāya maunataḥ ||6 1 || yayaturnarmadātīraṃ snāpayāmāsatuḥ śavam | sasnatuśca tadā tau dvau tāvatputraḥ sacetanaḥ ||62|| saprāṇastvabhavacchīghraṃ brahmahatyāpi bhūsurān | vinirgatya drutaṃ naṣṭā jajvāla vahninā tadā ||63|| ityāścaryaṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā tutuṣaturdvijau sutam | gṛhītvā svagṛhaṃ tuṣṭau yayaturnārmadād balāt ||64|| jīvanākhyaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ bālahatyāpraṇāśanam | tatra snātvā parāṃ siddhiṃ labhennātra vicāraṇā ||65|| atha tīrthaṃ viśvarūpānarmadāsaṃgamātmakam | tatra pūrvaṃ mahendrasya śāpādapsarasāṃ varā ||66 || viśvarūpā sārikā cābhavaccūtanivāsinī | śaṃkaraṃ sā samupāsya pratyakṣaṃ prākaroddharam ||67|| yatra prādurbhūta īśastatra sā mokṣaṇaṃ gatā | sārikārūpamutsṛjyāpsaro rūpavatī śubhā ||68|| jātā tatra nadī cāpi viśvarūpābhidhānikā | śaṃkarasya prasādena saṃjātā narmadāṃgatā ||69|| tattīrthe śāpanāśārthaṃ snātavyamṛddhimicchatā | śāpasya kāraṇaṃ citrāṃgadaṃ gandharvamuttamam ||1.574.70 || nartane devasadasi kāmayāmāsa vai hṛdā | nṛtyaṃ kṣatiṃ tadā prāpat tena doṣeṇa śāpitā ||71 || sā ca svargaṃ punargatvā yayau kailāsamityapi | atha rājā dharmasenaḥ sārikātīrthamāyayau ||72|| kailāsādhipatirbhakto vaiṣṇavo vājirājitaḥ | narmadāyāṃ jale svāśvaṃ samāplāvya jalaṃ papau ||773 || tāvadaśvo’bhavattatra caturbhujo manoharaḥ | divyayānasamārūḍho yayau vaikuṇṭhameva saḥ ||74|| viṣṇudūto nṛpaṃ prāha rājam̐ste pṛṣṭhamāgatā | śunī ceyaṃ jalaṃ pītvā snātvā cāyāti paśya tām ||75|| ityukto nṛpatiryāvacchunīṃ paśyati tāvatā | śvadehaṃ sā parityajyāpsarovarā babhūva ha ||76|| vimāne tatra saṃruhya yayau vaikuṇṭhameva sā | vyomavāṇī ca rājānaṃ tadovāca dhṛtiṃ vaha || 77|| śarīrajena kaṣṭena tapaḥsādhyā vibhūtayaḥ | pādacārī hi gaccha tvaṃ parapādaiḥ samāgataḥ ||78|| pādacārī samāyād yastasya muktirdhruvātra bho | bhūyo yātrāṃ prakuruṣe padbhyāṃ svanagarānnṛpa ||79|| tadā muktistu te syādvai puṇyamādāya yāhi bho | śrutvā rājā dharmaseno yayau tataḥ punargṛham ||1.574.80|| trayodaśyāṃ pādacārī narmadāyāmupāgamat | caturdaśyāṃ prage snātvā sārikeśaṃ dadarśa ha ||8 1 || viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sākṣāt kṛtvā smaran harim | yayau vimānamāruhya vaikuṇṭhaṃ pārameśvaram |||82|| atha tīrthaṃ candramatyā narmadāyāṃ samāgamam | candreśvaraḥ sadāśaṃbhurvirājate’tra sarvadā ||83 || atha tīrthaṃ hāriṇaṃ ca lubdhakena mṛgaḥ purā | hato madhyandine śreṣṭhaḥ kuraṃgo narmadātaṭe ||84|| patito gatajīvaśca divyadehadharo’bhavat | vimānena tu divyena brahmalokaṃ jagāma saḥ ||85|| dṛṣṭvā vairāgyamāpanno lubdhako maraṇāya ha | nirṇayaṃ kṛtavām̐statra salile nimamajja ha ||86 || tatkṣaṇād divyadeho’sau gandharvapuramāyayau | hariṇeśvaramevaitalliṃgaṃ lubdheśvaraṃ tathā ||87|| tīrthaṃ bāṇeśvaraṃ cāpi dhanurīśvaramityapi | rameśvaraṃ pañcamaṃ ca tīrthaṃ muktipradaṃ hi tat| ||88|| tatra devāya bhāvena pradadyādaṣṭapuṣpakam | vārijaṃ saumyamāgneyaṃ vāyavyaṃ pārthivaṃ tathā ||89|| vānaspatyaṃ prājāpatyaṃ śivapuṣpaṃ tathāṣṭamam | vārijaṃ salilaṃ jñeyaṃ saumyaṃ madhuyutaṃ payaḥ ||1.574.90|| āgneyaṃ dhūpadīpādi vāyavyaṃ candanādikam | pārthivaṃ kandamūlādi vānaspatyaṃ phalādikam ||91 || prājāpatyaṃ śubhānnādi śivapuṣpamupāsanam | ahiṃsā prathamaṃ puṣpaṃ dvitīyamindriyagrahaḥ |||92|| tṛtīyaṃ tu dayāpuṣpaṃ caturthaṃ smaraṇaṃ hareḥ | pañcamaṃ sadguroḥ sevā ṣaṣṭhaṃ vai pitṛpūjanam ||93|| saptamaṃ svāminaḥ sevāṣṭamaṃ nārāyaṇāśrayaḥ | ebhirvai prāpyate’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||94|| rādhā vai prathamaṃ puṣpaṃ lakṣmīḥ puṣpaṃ dvitīyakam | tṛtīyaṃ pārvatī puṣpaṃ prabhā puṣpaṃ caturthakam ||95|| pañcamaṃ māṇikī puṣpaṃ jayā puṣpaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhakam | lalitā saptamaṃ puṣpaṃ maṃjulā puṣpamaṣṭamam ||96|| etā me puṣparūpā vai santi puṣpeṣu saṃsthitāḥ | vinā tā naiva gṛhṇāmi puṣpāṇi padmaje kvacit ||97|| haṃsā puṣpaṃ ca saguṇā puṣpaṃ campā supuṣpakam | dayā puṣpaṃ devikā saṃpuṣpaṃ muktā supuṣpakam ||98|| ṣoḍaśeṣūpacāreṣu sahasrāṇyapi ṣoḍaśa | kalā me saṃpraviṣṭā hi santi gṛhṇāmi tāṃstadā ||99|| vastunā matsvarūpeṇa pūjāṃ gṛhṇāmi nityadā | evaṃ viṣṇumayo bhūtvā pūjayet sa gatiṃ labhet || 1.574.1 00|| kṛtvā vai hariṇaṃ tīrthaṃ tato yāyāttu bhārgavam | tīrthottamaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ yatra kailāsavāsinaḥ || 101 || andhakāsuramāhatya śaṃkareṇa samaṃ surāḥ | narmadāyāṃ yadā snātuṃ tīrthārthaṃ samupāyayuḥ || 1 02|| uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ kūlamavagāhya prayatnataḥ | gatvā tu dakṣiṇe kūle parvataṃ bhṛgusaṃjñitam || 1 03|| haro bibheda śūlena tena bhinnaṃ rasātalam | pātālānniḥsṛtā gaṃgā nāmnā bhogavatī hi sā || 1 04|| tatra tīrthaṃ samutpannaṃ śūlabhedābhidhaṃ tathā | tatra brahmā svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ śivastiṣṭhanti sarvadā || 105|| yatra gaṃgā ca yamunā narmadā ca sarasvatī | saṃgatā divyarūpeṇa śūlabhede vyavasthitāḥ || 1 06|| cakratīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tatra vai vartate sadā | sarvatīrthamayaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvatīrthādhikaṃ param || 1 07|| sarvapuṇyādhikaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam | bhṛgutīrthaṃ paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yatra lakṣmīrhi bhārgavī || 1 08||| viṣṇave bhṛguṇā dattā vivāhavidhinā purā | vaikuṇṭhasadṛśaṃ tīrthaṃ bhṛgutīrthaṃ taducyate || 1 09|| kanyādānaṃ pūjanaṃ śrīhareḥ kāryaṃ hi tatsthale | śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya dānapūjāphalaṃ labhet || 1.574.110 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sahasrayajñatīrthaśuklatīrthadvīpeśvaratīrthameghanādatīrthadāruvanatīrthakaraṃjeśvaratīrthajīvanatīrthaviśvarūpārevāsaṃgamacandrāvatīnarmadāsaṃgamahariṇeśvarādiśūlabhedabhṛgukṣetrāditīrthanirūpaṇa nāmā catuḥsaptatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 574 ||
<1.575> śrīlakṣmīruvāca kanyādānaṃ kīdṛśaṃ dātavyaṃ mama pituḥ sthale | vada me śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin kṛpāṃ kuru || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca svavittenānukartavyaṃ kanyodvāhanamuttamam | yasyāgre naiva vittaṃ syāttena kanyā suśobhitā || 2 || vastrādyaistulasīpatraṃ saṃspṛṣṭvā vahnisannidhau | kanyā deyā jalasākṣye viprasākṣye ca maṇḍape || 3 || varamālāṃ gṛhītvā ca kanyā taṃ varayed varam | bhojanādyaṃ yathāśakti protsāhaśced dadecchubham || 4 || yogyaṃ hṛdyaṃ varaṃ labdhvā pradadyād vikrayaṃ vinā | vikrayo dhanamāhṛtya dīyate pātakaṃ mahat || 5 || abhigamya pradātavyā cottamaṃ tārakaṃ tu tat | āhūya tu pradātavyā madhyamaṃ tārakaṃ tu tat || 6 || prasahya ca pradātavyā tvadhamaṃ dānameva tat | kiṃkarīvatpradātavyā niṣphalaṃ dāsikāsamam || 7 || kanyādāne jāyamāne kuryuḥ śrīharikīrtanam | nāryaḥ kuṭumbināṃ tatra maṇḍape vādyaghoṣite || 8 || nirvartite ca taddāne pūjanaṃ darśanaṃ hareḥ | kuryātāṃ dampatī paścād viśetāṃ nijamandiram || 9 || pūjanādi prakuryātāṃ nityaṃ prātaḥ suvastubhiḥ | upacāraiḥ śreṣṭhatamaiḥ kuryātāṃ nāparāddhakam || 1.575.1 0|| pūjāparādhakartṝṇāṃ pāpamevopajāyate | śṛṇu lakṣmi vacmi doṣān prāyaścittayutān yathā || 11 || mama bhakto mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ sadā bhavet | gṛhe devagṛhaṃ svalpaṃ pṛthak kṛtvārcayennu mām || 1 2|| mūrtiṃ yathepsitāṃ nyasya snānāmbarasucandanaiḥ | patrapuṣpajalairbhojyairdhūpadīpanivedanaiḥ || 1 3|| pradakṣiṇārtikaraṇaiḥ stutikṣamāvisarjanaiḥ | nityaṃ prapūjayed datvā dhyānaṃ vai matparāyaṇaḥ || 14|| kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ kuryāt kīrtanaṃ copadeśanam | nartanaṃ vādanaṃ kuryādutsavaṃ sumanoharam || 15|| śṛṇu tattvena me lakṣmi mama dharmaṃ sanātanam | devā etanna jānanti yogajñāḥ sāṃkhyavedinaḥ || 16|| vinā bhāgavatīṃ dīkṣāṃ pūjanaṃ me nirarthakam | lakṣeṣu labhate kaścid dīkṣāṃ mama sukhāvahām || 17|| mayi śāntaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā tvabhigacched guruṃ prati | tadājñāṃ tu puraskṛtya prārthayet śādhi māṃ guro || 18|| guruṇā darśitān dīkṣādravyādīn samupāharet | lājā madhu kuśām̐ścāpi ghṛtaṃ cāmṛtamityapi || 1 9|| dugdhaṃ dadhi gavāṃ mūtraṃ śakṛccāpi suśarkarām | yajñopavītaṃ gandhaṃ ca kuṃkumaṃ cākṣatāṃstathā ||1.575.20|| puṣpāṇi tulasīṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyakaṃ phalam | jalaṃ mālāṃ ca kaṇṭhīṃ ca kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca dhotrakam ||21|| daṇḍaṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ vāsaṃ uttarīyaṃ ghaṭaṃ tilān | pāduke’rghapātraṃ carusthālīṃ vrīhīṃśca darvikām ||22|| yavāṃśca guḍadhānām̐śca phalāni bhojanāni ca | bhakṣyabhojyānnapānāni karmaṇyāni ca sarvaśaḥ || 23|| yāni kāni ca bījāni ratnāni vividhāni ca | kācapātrāṇi kalaśaṃ cāmrapātrāṇi dorakam ||24|| aśokasya supatrāṇi paṭṭikāsanamityapi | tribhāṇaṃ cācamanīyaṃ homapātraṃ sruvādikam ||25|| homakāṣṭhāni sarvāṇi pippalodumbarāṇi ca | khādiraṃ bilvakāṣṭhaṃ cāpāmārgaṃ cārkamityapi ||26 || āmalakaṃ ca tulasīṃ candanaṃ ca vaṭaṃ tathā | śālaṃ ca madhukaṃ ceti kāṣṭhāni samupāharet ||27|| snātvā maṃgalasaṃyukto vediṃ kuryāt suśobhanām | brāhmaṇaścaturasrāṃ ṣoḍaśahastāṃ samantataḥ || 28|| tatra dhānyairmaṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ prakārayet | navaṃ jalaghaṭaṃ madhye puṣpapallavaśobhitam ||29|| sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ sthāpayed ratnagarbhagam | tasyopari tilaiḥ pūrṇāṃ sthālīṃ nyasya vidhānataḥ ||1.575.3 0|| pūjayenmāṃ parabrahma guruṃ cāpi suvastubhiḥ | vedimadhye sudravyāṇi sthāpayet saṃskṛtāni vai ||3 1 || caturaḥ kalaśān dadyāccatuḥpārśveṣu sundari | vāripūrṇānnūtnapatrayuktān phalairvibhūṣitān ||32|| sarvataḥ śuklavastraiśca veṣṭitānāmraśobhitān | upaspṛśyāvasathe ca maṇḍape gurusannidhau ||33 || pūrvamukhād gurormantraṃ śiṣyaścottarasanmukhaḥ | vāmakarṇena gṛhṇīyānmantraṃ bhāgavataṃ param ||34|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu śaraṇaṃ mama | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||35|| etau mantrau guruḥ sarvān śrāvayet strīrnarānapi | dīkṣāṃgo mantra evāsti jñānātmako harirhi saḥ ||36|| eṣa bhāgavato jātaḥ śiṣyo mantraprabhāvataḥ | etān bhāgavatān dṛṣṭvā cābhyutthānaṃ prakārayet ||37|| mānanīyā yathāhaṃ vai tathā bhāgavatā janāḥ | yastu bhāgavatān dṛṣṭvā svayaṃ bhāgavataḥ śuciḥ ||38|| abhyutthānaṃ na kurvīta tenāhaṃ tu prahiṃsitaḥ | kanyāṃ datvā tu bhaktāya punastāṃ preṣayenna yaḥ ||3 9|| aṣṭau pitṛgaṇāstena hiṃsitā nātra saṃśayaḥ | bhāryāṃ priyasakhīṃ yastu sādhvīṃ hinasti nirghṛṇaḥ ||1.575.40|| satīṃ ca vaiṣṇavīṃ lakṣmīrūpāṃ gṛhasya devatām | punastenaiva pāpena nāpnoti sa striyaṃ kvacit ||41 || strīṇāṃ duḥkhaprakartāro bhavanti duḥkhinaḥ sadā | bilvavṛkṣodumbarau tūlasī cchakṣastathāmrakaḥ ||42|| aśoko bakulaścāpyāmalakī karṇikā tathā | daivataravaḥ karmaṇyā na chettavyā hi mūlataḥ ||43|| dīkṣitena tathā lakṣmi tvabhakṣyaṃ varjyameva ha | apeyaṃ ca tathā varjyaṃ nindā varjyā ca hiṃsanam ||44|| paiśunyaṃ stainyamāvarjyaṃ kāryaṃ cātithyapūjanam | vyavāyaḥ sarvathā tyājyo brahmacaryaṃ ca nigrahaḥ ||45|| rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnena guroḥ sevanamityapi | dṛṣṭvā parasya bhāgyāni dravyāṇi sampadādikam ||46 || dāridryaṃ cātmano dṛṣṭvā kāryaṃ nodvejanaṃ kvacit | evaṃ vai niyamān dadyānmātāpitrośca sevanam ||47|| niyamena pradadyācca śrīharerbhajanaṃ sadā | atha vedyāṃ sthāpayedaudumbarasya daladvayam ||48|| jalapātraṃ kṣuraṃ cāpi tata āvāhayecca mām | āgaccha bhagavam̐ścātra mūrtau vedyāṃ ca sannidhau ||49|| arghyaṃ pādyaṃ gṛhāṇaitat tataḥ svavapanaṃ śubham | kārayenmaṇḍapapārśve romapāpāni yānti yat ||1.575.50|| nīromaṃ ca śikhāyuktaṃ śoṇitena vivarjitam | kṣauraṃ prakārayitvā ca snātvā vastraṃ ca dhautrakam ||51 || uttarīyaṃ tathā dhṛtvā namaskuryād guruṃ harim | prajvālya vahnidevaṃ ca homapātreṇa cānale ||52|| ghṛtena madhumiśreṇa lājākṛṣṇatilādibhiḥ | datvā homaṃ saptavārān viṃśatiṃ ca tilodanam ||53|| tataḥ satyasvarūpaṃ tvāṃ vahniṃ namāmi saṃvadet | tisraḥ pradakṣiṇāḥ kṛtvā devaṃ bhāgavataṃ gurum ||54|| gurupādau prasaṃgṛhya prārthayet sadguruṃ tadā | gurudevaprasāden labdhā dīkṣā yadṛcchayā ||55|| yaccaivāpakṛtaṃ kiñcid gururmarṣayatāṃ mama | ityuktavate śiṣyāya dadyād yajñopavītakam ||56|| kamaṇḍaluṃ tathā dadyājjalapātraṃ tu śuddhaye | candanaṃ viṣṇave cāpi gandhaṃ tailaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ||57|| madhuparkaṃ tathā dadyācchiṣyaḥ pūjākramāgatam | vastraṃ bhūṣāṃ puṣpamālāṃ nārāyaṇāya cārpayet ||58|| tataḥ kaṇṭhīṃ taulasīṃ ca śiṣyakaṇṭhe gururdadet | tilakaṃ candrakayutaṃ lalāṭe’sya dadettathā ||59|| nāma nārāyaṇanāmnā kuryādācāryatānvitam | dāsyānvitaṃ ca vā kuryāttathā veṣaṃ yathocitam ||1.575.60|| yathāvyakti pradadyācca dānaṃ cāpi yathābalam | homavahniṃ tathā devaṃ guruṃ natvā ca vaiṣṇavān ||6 1 || dakṣiṇāṃ bhojanaṃ vastraṃ tebhyo datvā gṛhaṃ saret | kṛṣṇasārasya carmātrāsanaṃ vipraḥ samarthayet ||62|| pālāśaṃ daṇḍamevāyaṃ brāhmaṇo rakṣayet sadā | kṣatriyastvāyudhaṃ tyaktvā dīkṣāṃ proktavidhānataḥ ||63 || gṛhṇīyācchāgacarmāpi plakṣadaṇḍaṃ viśeṣataḥ | vedikāṃ dvādaśahastāṃ kārayitvā ca pūrvavat ||64|| sarvamanyat pragṛhṇīyād dīkṣāyāṃ gurutaḥ śubham | niyamān dhārayennāhaṃ śastraṃ spṛśāmi hiṃsakam ||65|| dīkṣāṃ pūrvoktavidhinā prāpya bhāgavatīṃ tataḥ | śuddhān bhāgavatān sarvān bhojayed dānamarpayet ||66 || atha vaiśyaḥ sarvavastūnyāhṛtya vedikāṃ śubhām | daśahastāṃ kārayecca lepayed gomayena tām ||67|| chāgacarma dhārayecca daṇḍamaudumbaraṃ tathā | anyat sarvaṃ pūrvavacca kārayed dīkṣito bhavet ||68|| devābhivādanaṃ kṛtvā puro bhāgavateṣu ca | sādhūbhyo bhojanaṃ dadyādaparādhān kṣamāpayet ||69|| śūdro’pi gṛhṇīyād dīkṣāṃ bhāgavatīṃ śubhāvahām | sarvasaṃskāradravyāṇi mayā pūrvoditāni vai ||1.575.70|| tāni prakalpayed vedyāṃ vedī cāṣṭakarānvitā | kartavyā tatra vidhinā pūrvavat pūjayeddharim ||71 || carma nīlasya chāgasya daṇḍaśca vaiṣṇavo’sya vai | evaṃ dīkṣāṃ ca gṛhṇīyācchūdro bhāgavato bhavet ||72|| bhojayed vaiṣṇavān sādhūn sādhvīścāpi yathā ghanam | caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ chatramācāryavedakam ||73 || brāhmaṇe pāṇḍuraṃ chatraṃ kṣatriye raktameva ca | vaiśye pītaṃ tathā śūdre nīlaṃ guruḥ pradāpayet ||74|| dīkṣitānāṃ prakartavyaṃ lakṣmi vadāmi te’tra vai | sarvathā cintanīyo’haṃ gomukhyāṃ mālayā priye ||75||| gaṇanā kārikā mālā taulasī sā gaṇāntikā | eṣā gaṇāntikā nāma dīkṣāṃgabījarūpiṇī ||76|| tayā me bhajanaṃ kāryaṃ dīkṣāyāḥ syānmahāphalam | guptāṃ guṇāntikāṃ kṛtvā cintayenmāṃ budhottamaḥ ||77|| kārtike mārgaśīrṣe ca vaiśākhe śuklapakṣake | ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro dvādaśyāṃ prātareva ha ||78|| dīkṣāṃ pragṛhṇīyāccedvai mucyate bhavabandhanāt | keśaprasādhanārthaṃ me dadyādvai kaṅkatīṃ śubhām ||79|| aṃjanaṃ darpaṇaṃ dadyāt tathā dadyācca mālikām | nocchiṣṭaḥ saṃspṛśenmālāmākāśe sthāpayeddhi tām ||1.575.80|| sandhyāṃ kuryānmama bhaktaḥ samyag dhyānātmikā tu sā | muhūrtaṃ dhyānamābadhya mama mantraṃ japenmuhuḥ ||81 || mamāgre dīpakaṃ kuryāttejorāśivivardhanam | mallalāṭe tilakaṃ sacandraṃ vai kārayettathā ||82|| dhūpaṃ sugandhaṃ me dadyādimaṃ ślokamudīrayet | sugandhāni tavāṅgāni svabhāvenaiva keśava |||83 || amunā śubhadhūpena dhūpitāni gṛhāṇa tam | dīpaṃ dadyād ghṛtajanyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tārakaṃ śubham ||84|| sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ kāṃsyaṃ pātraṃ mama praśasyate | tāni tyaktveha sarvāṇi tāmraṃ hi mama rocate ||85|| śṛṇu tattvena me lakṣmi yena tāmraṃ mama priyam | pūrvaṃ kamalapatrākṣi guḍākeśo mahāsuraḥ ||86 || tāmrarūpaṃ samādāya mamaivārādhane rataḥ | varṣāṇāṃ tu sahasrāṇi caturdaśa suniścalaḥ ||87|| tasya tāmrāśramaṃ cāhaṃ yayau prasannatāyutaḥ | caturbāhuṃ sa māṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇanāma sa vai muhuḥ ||88|| mayoktaṃ te prasanno’smi varaṃ brūhi hṛdīpsitam | guḍākeśastadā prāha viśuddhenāntarātmanā ||89|| janmanāṃ tu sahasrāṇi tvayi bhaktirdṛḍhāstu me | cakreṇa vadhamicchāmi tvayā muktena mādhava ||1.575.90 || mama cakrahatasyaitadvasāmāṃsādikaṃ ca yat | tāmraṃ nāma bhaved deva pavitrīkaraṇaṃ śubham ||91 || tāmrapātre’rpite te’stu prītiḥ sarvādhikā prabho | bāḍhamiti mayoktaḥ sa yāvallokasya saṃsthitiḥ ||92|| tāvattāmrasvarūpastvaṃ mama pātraṃ bhaviṣyasi | tattāmrabhājane mahyaṃ dīyate yat supuṣkalam ||93 || maṅgalyaṃ ca pavitraṃ ca mayā tāmraṃ kṛtaṃ tadā | vaiśākhaśuklapakṣasya dvādaśyāṃ madhyage ravau ||94|| cakrādvadhamabhīpsan vai śubhaṃ kurvan madarthakam | viṣṇusaṃstho bhaviṣyāmi kadāhamiti cintayan || 95|| mama pūjāṃ tadā kṛtvā prārthayāmāsa māṃ prati | muñca muñca prabho cakramapi vahnisamaprabham || 96 || ātmā me nīyatāṃ śīghraṃ nikṛttyāṅgāni sarvaśaḥ | mayā cakreṇa ca hataḥ prāpto māṃ parameśvaram ||97|| tāmraṃ tanmāṃsamasrakva kataṃ mayā yathoditam | tāmre prāpaṇakaṃ dadyāt pūjābhojanaprabhṛti ||98|| sikthe sikthe phalaṃ tasya śatāśvamedhajaṃ bhavet | tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi divyāni mama dhāmani ||99|| modate sa tato dhāma paraṃ yāti paraṃ padam | evaṃ māṃ bhojayitvaiva tāmrapātre ca kānake || 1.575.100 || rājate’pi ca tāmbūlaṃ datvā visarjanaṃ caret | ityevaṃ mama bhakto vai dīkṣito’rcanamācaret || 101 || nityaṃ nityaṃ priye lakṣmi satyaitacchaṃbhunoditam | śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāpi mama dhāmagato bhavet || 1 02|| naro nārī tathānyaśca dīkṣāṃ labdhvā vidhānataḥ | māṃ bhajedātmano mokṣaṃ labhejjanmaphalaṃ hi tat || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛyugasantāne kanyādānaṃ bhāgavatīdīkṣāvidhānaṃ guḍākeśākhyāsurasya cakreṇa nāśottaraṃ tadvasāsṛkprabhṛtīnāṃ tāmradhātutvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcasaptatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 575 ||
<1.576> śrīlakṣmīruvāca ahaṃ dīkṣāṃ śubhāṃ śrutvā nārāyaṇa mukhāttava | tava māhātmyabodhā ca jātāsmi vimalā prabho || 1 || aho devasya māhātmyaṃ cāturvarṇyasukhāvaham | dīkṣādānena vai jñātaṃ tathānyad bhaktakāraṇāt || 2 || pṛcchāmi cāparādheṣu kiṃ phalaṃ kiṃ nivāraṇam | tava pūjāparāṇāṃ tvaṃ śuddhiṃ vada janārdana || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi cāparādhaviśodhanam | śuddho bhāgavato bhūtvā mama pūjāparāyaṇaḥ || 4 || āpadgato’pi rājānnaṃ bhuṃkte yaḥ pāpasaṃbhṛtam | niraye tena pāpena vāsastasya prajāpate || 5 || rājā pravartate kurvan karma tāmasarājasam | dāruṇaṃ garhitaṃ tasya cānnaṃ pāpabharaṃ mahat || 6 || dhārmikena na bhoktavyaṃ rājānnaṃ narakapradam | yadvā rājñāṃ tu bhoktavyaṃ bhojyaṃ bhāgavatairnaraiḥ || 7 || sthāpayitvā tu māṃ lakṣmi nivedya māṃ ca sarvaśaḥ | dhanyadhānyasamṛddhāni datvā māṃ svīkaroti cet || 8 || siddhaṃ bhāgavatairbhaktairmama śeṣaprasādikam | bhuñjānasya na vai pāpalepastatra prajāyate || 9 || aprasādaṃ ca rājānnaṃ bhuṃkte tasya tu padmaje | cāndrāyaṇena śuddhiḥ syānmama bhaktasya vai tathā || 1.576.1 0|| dantakāṣṭhamacarvitvā cākṛtvā mukhaśodhanam | snātvā spṛśati māṃ cet sa durgandhimukhavān yataḥ ||1 1 || puṇyahīno bhaved bhakto mamāparādhatastataḥ | manuṣyaḥ kilbiṣī lakṣmi kaphapittamalānvitaḥ || 12|| pūyaśoṇitadurgandhi mukhamasya yataḥ sadā | śuddha vāyuṃ samācamya durgandhaṃ ca vimuñcati || 1 3||| tena me mūrtisāmīpye’parādhastasya jāyate | dantakāṣṭhena śuddhiḥ syātsugandhyadhadravyayojanāt ||14|| aparādhe tathā jāte vyomaśāyī dinadvayam | bhavet mamātibhajanaṃ kuryāt kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ || 15|| śatamālājapaṃ kuryādaparādho na vidyate | atha kṛtvā maithunaṃ cāsnātaḥ śavātmako hi saḥ || 16|| tadaparādhapākaśca lālākhye niraye patet | manuṣyasya paro dharmaḥ snānaṃ dhyānaṃ ca pūjanam ||17|| asnāto malamūtrāḍhyo malākhye niraye patet | prāyaścittaṃ tasya kāryaṃ bhaktiyuktena cetasā || 18|| yāvakaṃ vā ca piṇyākaṃ bhakṣayedvai dinatrayam | turyaṃ copavaset tena śuddhirbhaktasya jāyate ||19|| atha spṛṣṭvā śavaṃ gatvā śmaśānaṃ snāti naiva yaḥ | tasyāśuddhasya pitaraḥ patanti so’pi vai patet ||1.576.20|| śmaśāne jambukā bhūtvā bhavanti śavabhakṣakāḥ | prāyaścittaṃ tasya kāryaṃ mama bhaktena cāṃjasā ||21 || ekāhāro dinaikyaṃ ca dinaikyaṃ cāpyupoṣitaḥ | pañcagavyaṃ tataḥ pītvā śuddhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||22|| nārīṃ rajasvalāṃ spṛṣṭvā yo māṃ spṛśati nirghṛṇaḥ | tena pāpena bhakto’pi yāmye yāti rajomaye |||23|| andhastataḥ prajāyeta daridro buddhivarjitaḥ | śuddhistasyāparādhasyopoṣaṇaṃ tvekameva ha |||24||| ākāśaśayanaṃ snānaṃ savastraṃ gavyaprāśanam | kṛtvā mucyedaśuddheḥ sa mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ |||25|| spṛṣṭvā tu mṛtakaṃ lakṣmi yo matkṣetreṣu tiṣṭhati | na snāti māṃ spṛśatyeṣaścāṇḍālajanma cāpnuyāt ||26|| andhaḥ sa jāyate paścānmaṇḍuko makṣikā bhavet | ṭiṭṭibho vā maśakaśca kṛkalāsaḥ kharo’thavā ||27|| mārjāro vānaro vāpi jāyate tvaparādhavān | śudyarthaṃ tādṛśo bhakto mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||28|| ekāhāraṃ pañcadaśadināni vartayettataḥ | pañcagavyaṃ prāśayecca śuddhyatyevāparādhataḥ ||29||| spṛśamānena māṃ laśmi muñcatyapānavāyukam | tena doṣeṇa jāyeta makṣikā mūṣakastathā ||1.576.3 0|| śvā vā kūrmaḥ prajāyeta tataḥ sa mānavo bhavet | ato naktaṃ trīṇyahāni vartayet tena śuddhyati ||31 || śatamālājapaṃ kuryāt snāyād bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ | purīṣaṃ mucyate yastu vātena saha doṣataḥ |||32|| mama pūjāsthito vāpi mamānyakarmatatparaḥ | purīṣanarake yāmye patet tena tataḥ param ||33|| manuṣyo jāyate lakṣmi mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ | prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ jale śayanamityapi |||34|| ākāśaśayanaṃ cāpi dinaikyaṃ prasamācaret | śatamālājapaṃ kuryādaparādhātpramucyate ||35|| snātvāpi yadi mārgeṣu malineṣu pragacchati | aprakṣālitapādādyo yo hi māmupasarpati ||36|| so’pyaśuddhaḥ pāpavān syānmama vipriyakārakaḥ | tena dattaṃ gandhamālyaṃ na vai gṛhṇāmi bhāvataḥ ||37 tena prakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā pādayoḥ karayostathā | ācamya ca yathānyāyaṃ śuddhaḥ san māmupaspṛśet ||38 malatyāgaṃ tathā kṛtvā saptavāraṃ tu mṛttikām | prakṣālanendriye datvā karayośca tathā dadet || 39 pādayoḥ pañcavāraṃ ca tataḥ pātraṃ parimṛjet | gaṇḍūṣān sapta kṛtvā ca tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret ||1.576.40 madbhakto vai bhavecchuddhaḥ pūjako nānyathā priye | gandhāṃśahastayuktaścetspṛśenmāṃ doṣabhāgbhabet ||41 | prāṇāyāmaṃ cācamanaṃ kṛtvā prakṣālayet karau | evaṃ śuddhirbhavellakṣmi nāparādhastadā bhavet ||42 yastu krodhasamāyukto mama bhakto’pi mānavaḥ | praspṛśenmama gātrāṇi sa tadā doṣabhāgbhavet ||43 tena pāpena cillī syāt tataḥ śyeno bhavet sa ca | mṛtkaṭiko bhavet kīṭaḥ krodhena kṛṣṇavarṇavān ||44 kruddhena na ca kartavyaṃ lobhena tvarayā na ca | matpūjanaṃ vidhānena kartavyaṃ mokṣadaṃ hiṃ tat |||45 snātvā mālāśataṃ kuryāt krodhaśuddhistato matā | akarmaṇyena puṣpeṇa yo māmarcayate bhuvi ||46| mūrkho bhāgavataścāpi vānaro jāyate tataḥ | mārjāro vā balīvardaḥ chāgo bā grāmakukkuṭaḥ || 47. mahiṣo vā bhavet puṣpadātā yanme na rocate | tacchuddhyarthaṃ caikabhojī bhavedvai dinasaptakam ||48| sarvapāpapramuktaḥ syānmama loke gatirbhavet | rudhirāktāmbarayukto yadi māmupasarpati ||49| rajasvalārajoyuktavastrāḍhyo māṃ ca sarpati | tena doṣeṇa jāyeta śvapaco nātra saṃśayaḥ ||1.576.50|| māsamekānnabhojī syānmālāsahasrakaṃ japet | antime tu dine kuryādupavāsaṃ sa śuddhyati ||51|| andhakāre vinā dīpaṃ spṛśate māṃ sa doṣabhāk | andhajanma bhavet tasya prāyaścittaṃ vadāmi ca ||52| ekāhāraṃ pañcadinaṃ netrācchādanapūrvakam | kuryānmālāśataṃ cāpi japecchuddho bhavettadā ||53|| kṛṣṇavastraṃ na vai dhāryaṃ pūjāyāṃ mama sarvathā | tena doṣeṇa nakulaḥ kacchapo vā bhavettataḥ ||54|| pārāvato bhavedvāpi prāyaścittaṃ vadāmi te | saptāhaṃ caikabhojī syānmālāśataṃ prakārayet ||55|| tataḥ śuddhirbhavettasya mama lokagato bhavet | vāsasā cāpyadhautena yo me karmāṇi cācaret ||56|| sa ca hastī tathoṣṭro vā hayo vā jambuko’thavā | sāraṃgo vā bhavettasmācchuddhiḥ kāryā prayatnataḥ ||57|| upavāsaṃ caredekaṃ japecca śatamālikāḥ | athocchiṣṭaṃ śunau yattad dadyāccenme ca karmaṇi ||58|| sārameyo bhavetso’pi gomāyurghūka eva vā | śuddhiḥ kāryā śākamūlaphalāśinā dinatrayam ||59|| pañcagavyaṃ caturthe ca pibedupavasettathā | aparādho vinaśyedvai mama lokagato bhavet ||1.576.60|| dīpaprakāśane kṛṣṇakajjalā cāṅgulirbhavet | dagdhavartigandhayuktā kṣālanīyā prayatnataḥ ||61 || karasyākṣālane sparśe mama syādaparādhanam | kuṣṭhī tena bhavedrogī tasmāddhastaṃ viśodhayet ||62|| aparādhe saṃjāte śatamālājapaṃ caret | sopavāsaṃ tena śuddhirbhavet karmaṇyako bhavet ||6 3|| śmaśānaṃ yo jano gatvā tvasnātvaiva tu māṃ spṛśet | jambuko gṛdhrako vā sa jāyate vā piśācakaḥ ||64|| tataścopavaseccaikadinaṃ mālāsahasrakam | japettena bhavecchuddhirnānyathā snānamātrataḥ ||65|| śrīlakṣmīruvāca śmaśānaṃ tvapavitraṃ cecchaṃbhurbhāgavatottamaḥ | tava bhaktaḥ kathaṃ cāste śmaśāne doṣabhāgyathā ||66 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi purāvṛttaṃ śaṃbhoste kathayāmyaham | śmaśānaṃ nāsti śuddhaṃ vai yadaśuddhaṃ sadā matam ||67|| kenacittu nimittena śaṃbhurvāsamarocayat | prāyaścittasvarūpaṃ taṃ vāsaṃ na manute sadā ||68|| yadyapi śaṃkaro bhaktottamo me vartate mahān | śmaśāne vasatastasya gṛhṇāmi nārcanādikam ||69|| prāyaścittottaraṃ sarvaṃ gṛhṇāmi nānyathā kvacit | śaṃkaro nāśayāmāsa tripurāṇi tathāsuram ||1.576.70|| bālān vṛddhām̐stathā strīśca tripure vāsinastataḥ | tena pāpena saṃlipto naṣṭaiśvaryaśca śaṃkaraḥ ||71 || naṣṭayogabalo naṣṭamāyābalo babhūva ha | vivarṇavadano bhūtvā na śaknoti viceṣṭitum ||72|| mṛtaprāyo’bhavacchāpairāsurastrīsamarpitaiḥ | naṣṭasaṃjño hatajñāno naṣṭānando yathābalaḥ ||73 || tato’haṃ taṃ samāpanno vilokya śaṃkaraṃ tataḥ | avocaṃ mā śucaḥ śreyaḥ kariṣye tava vai drutam ||74|| mayā dṛṣṭaḥ śaṃkaraśca tadā divyena cakṣuṣā | tāvadrudrasya sāmarthyaṃ prakāśamagamatpunaḥ ||75|| mayoktaṃ tava pāpasya nāśārthamahamāgataḥ | śrutvovāca haro māṃ ca pāpasantaptalocanaḥ ||76 || he viṣṇo tvatprasādena hatastripurakāsuraḥ | nihatā dānavāstatra garbhiṇyaśca nipātitāḥ ||77|| bālavṛddhā hatāścāpi dagdhāni tripurāṇi ca | tatpāpasya prabhāveṇa na śaknomi viceṣṭitum ||78|| praṇaṣṭaiśvaryamāyaśca naṣṭajñānātmasadbalaḥ | kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā viṣṇo pāpāvasthena sāmpratam ||79|| viṣṇo tattvena māṃ brūhi pāpasyāsya viśodhanam | evaṃ prārthayamānasya mayā rudrasya bhāṣitam ||1.576.80|| kapālamālāṃ sandhārya samalo vihara kṣitau | śaṃbhuḥ papraccha māṃ kīdṛk samalatvaṃ prakīrtyate ||81 || mayoktaṃ vai śmaśānaṃ ca malaṃ pūtikamucyate | śmaśāne vāsa evātra samalatvaṃ prakīrtyate ||82|| tatrādāya kapālāni rama tatraiva śaṃkara | bhūtapretādibhṛtyaiśca sārdhaṃ vasa samāśatam ||83|| tāvatpūjā mama naiva kartavyā bāhyataḥ kvacit | mānasaṃ pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ nāparādho bhaviṣyati ||84|| pūrṇe varṣaśate yāte gautamasyāśramaṃ vraja | prasādād gautamamunerbhavitā gatakilbiṣaḥ ||85|| tataḥ pāpavināśena śarīraśuddhimācara | varṣamātraṃ vrataṃ payovrataṃ gṛhāṇa śuddhikṛt ||86 || brahmakūrcaṃ ca vā śreṣṭhaṃ vrataṃ māsikamityapi | kariṣyasi tathā śuddhaḥ pūjanārho bhaviṣyasi ||87|| paścāt tvayā śmaśāne na vastavyaṃ karhicicchava | yadīcchasi mama pūjāyogyatvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vṛṣam ||88|| rudrāyaivaṃ varaṃ datvā tatraivāntarhito’bhavam | rudropi bhramate varṣaśataṃ śmaśānake sthale ||89|| vinā tu kṛtasaṃskāro mamādeśaparāyaṇaḥ | varṣaśate gate rudro yayau vai gautamāśramam ||1.576.90|| gautamena tadā tasyopadeśaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ | rūpadvayaṃ sadā rudra pradhāraya kriyāvaśāt ||91|| pāpaṃ sarvaṃ gataṃ te’tra śuddho’si vaiṣṇavo mahān | mahābhāgavataṃ rūpaṃ sadā gṛhāṇa sāttvikam ||92|| kailāse sarvadā tiṣṭha bhakteṣvapi ca sāttvikaḥ | chāyātmakaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca rūpaṃ dhāraya bhairavam ||13|| bhūtapretapiśācānāmupāsyaṃ samalaṃ ca tat | śmaśānavāsayogyaṃ ca tāmasānāṃ sadāśrayam ||94|| ityuktaḥ śaṃkaro dhṛtvā rūpadvayaṃ tataḥ punaḥ | śmaśānastho na me bhakto na vā vaiṣṇava ityapi ||95|| kailāsastho hi me bhaktaḥ pūjārho vaiṣṇavottamaḥ | ityetat kathitaṃ lakṣmi śmaśānaṃ samalaṃ sadā || 96|| śmaśānasthāḥ samalā vai na vai śuddhāḥ śavasthale | paścād rudrasya bhūtādyaistāmasaistādṛśairjanaiḥ ||97|| śaṃkarasya tu kailāsaṃ śmaśānaṃ ceti varṇyate | vastuto naivamevāsti śmaśānaṃ śaṃkarapriyam ||98|| śmaśānaṃ naiva kasyāpi lakṣmi vai bhavati priyam | devānāṃ tu kathaṃ tat syāt priyaṃ sattvakriyāvatām ||99|| iti te kathitaṃ tattvaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vadāmi te | pañcagavyaṃ prāśanīyaṃ sopavāsaṃ dinaikake || 1.576.1 00|| savastraṃ snānamāptavyaṃ tulasīpatrabhojanam | vimuktastena pāpena mama karmārhaṇo bhavet || 101 || madyapānaprakartā tu bhraṣṭo bhavati dehataḥ | brahmakūrcavratenāsya śuddhirbhavati sarvathā || 102|| ulūkaḥ syādanyathā saḥ kīṭo bhavati vai punaḥ | brahmakūrcavrataṃ vacmi śṛṇu lakṣmi praśodhakam || 1 03|| māsaṃ vā pakṣakaṃ vā tat kartavyaṃ dehadhāriṇā | payasyāmalakaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ palāśapatramityapi || 1 04|| śarkarāṃ tulasīpatraṃ kvāthayecca pibed dine | yathāpacyaṃ bhavet tadvad vikṛtaṃ na yathā bhavet || 1 05|| anyat kiñcid bhakṣayenna jalaṃ pibettu śāntaye | brahmakūrcavrataṃ tvetat pākṣikaṃ māsikaṃ ca vā || 1 06|| yāni kāni ca patrāṇi pāvanāni hi śākhinām | kvāthayecca pibennityaṃ pālāśaṃ tatra niścitam ||1 07|| pañcagavyaṃ pibedvāpi pākṣikaṃ māsikaṃ ca vā | brahmakūrcasamaṃ tacca sarvapāpapraśodhakam || 1 08|| kāyākalpakaraṃ tvetanmokṣadaṃ maraṇe sati | śarīradhātuśuddhyarthaṃ recanaṃ kvāthanaṃ tu tat || 1 09|| brahmabhaktyā kṛtaṃ tadvai mokṣaṇārthaṃ prakalpyate | prāyaścittīkṛtaṃ tadvai pāpakṣālanakaṃ bhavet || 1.576.11 0|| roganāśakṛte cettaddhātuśuddhikaraṃ bhavet | apacyaṃ cet kvacittadvai maraṇāya prakalpyate || 111 || palāṇḍuśākapatrādibhakṣakaḥ syāddhi sūkaraḥ | śvā bhavejambuko vāpi mamāparādhakṛnnaraḥ || 1 12|| brahmakūrcavrataṃ kṛtvā śatamālājapāṃścaret | tena śuddhirbhavettasya mama karmārhaṇo bhavet || 11 3|| yaḥ pārakyena vastreṇa na dhautenāpi māṃ spṛśet | mṛgajanma hyavāpnoti hīnapādaikako bhavet || 1 14|| māghamāse jale tiṣṭhetpraharadvayameva ha | tena śuddhiḥ śatamālā japed bhavati nirmalaḥ || 1 15|| navānnaṃ yo nārpayenme svayaṃ bhuṃkte rasāhṛtaḥ | pāpabhoktā bhavettena kartavyaṃ samupoṣaṇam || 1 16|| śatamālājapaścāpi tena śuddhyati mānavaḥ | adattvā gandhamālyāni yo me dhūpaṃ prayacchati || 1 17|| yātudhāno bhavettena kartavyaṃ samupoṣaṇam | śatamālājapaścāpi tena śuddhyati vaiṣṇavaḥ || 1 18|| vahannupānahau padbhyāṃ yastu māmupasaṃkramet | carmakāraḥ sa jāyeta tataḥ śvā sūkaro bhavet || 1 19|| pākṣikaṃ caikabhuktaṃ ca śatamālāḥ samācaret | tena śuddhirbhavet tasya mama bhaktasya padmaje || 1.576. 120|| vinā ghaṇṭādiśabdaṃ tu yo vai māṃ pratibodhayet | badhiro jāyate tena kartavyaṃ samupoṣaṇam || 121 || śatamālājapaścāpi mama bhaktaḥ sa śuddhyati | annaṃ bhuktvā bahutaramajīrṇena pariplutaḥ || 122|| udgāreṇa samāvṛtto’snātaścāpyupasarpati | vānaro vā śṛgālaḥ śvā chāgo vā jāyate hi saḥ || 123|| tridinaṃ copavāsī syānmālāśataṃ ca vartayet | ya etena vidhānena prāyaścittaṃ samācaret || 1 24|| na sa lipyeta pāpena mama lokaṃ sa gacchati | yastu bhāgavato nityaṃ kalyamutthāya vācayet || 1 25|| paṭhedvā śṛṇuyāccāpi mama lokaṃ sa gacchati | śaṃbhunoktaṃ hi yat satyai mayoktaṃ tava padmaje || 1 26|| ārogyāṇāṃ mahārogyaṃ mokṣāṇāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ param | śodhanānāṃ parā śuddhiḥ prasannānāṃ ca pātratā || 1 27|| tapaḥ paramaṃ tapasāṃ bhaktyātmakaṃ mayoditam | mama bhaktena kartavyaṃ rakṣasāṃ na vicāraṇā || 1 28|| mumukṣūṇāṃ yogināṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ ca satāmapi | mama bhaktiyutānāṃ ca kṛte mayātra kīrtitam ||1 29|| garbhaviṣaprasaktānāṃ vāsanāsaṃhṛtahṛdām | nāstikānāṃ kṛte naitanmayoktaṃ lakṣmi śodhanam || 1.576.1 30|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhagavatpūjane’parādhā ye te teṣāṃ śuddhiḥ śarīrāntarayonyantarāptirvā cetyādi, śaṃkarasya śmaśānapriyatvākhyānamaśmaśānavāsitā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭasaptatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 576 ||
<1.577> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi śṛgālyāśca gṛdhrasya ca mṛteranu | tīrthasparśaprasaṃgena rājyalabdhiśca mokṣaṇam || 1 || akāmā yā mṛtā tīrthe babhūva rājaputrikā | śṛgālyapi viśālākṣī catuḥṣaṣṭikalānvitā || 2 || tatra mṛtastathā gṛdhraḥ so’pi rājā babhūva ha | aho tīrthaprabhāvo vai tiryañcau divyatāṃ gatau || 3 || haimadeśe brahmadatto’bhavat kāmpilyabhūpatiḥ | tatkumāraḥ somadattaḥ śrāddhārthaṃ pravicintya ca || 4 || pitrarthe mṛgayāṃ yāto mṛgalipsurvane tadā | na tatra labhate kiñcicchṛgālī tena vīkṣitā || 5 || śareṇa tena viddhā sā gaṃgājalamupāgatā | tīre pītvā jalaṃ śīghraṃ tīrthe prāṇān mumoca ha || 6 || tāvad vaṭe kumāraḥ sa gṛdhraṃ dadarśa saṃsthitam | śareṇa pātayāmāsa gṛdhraṃ rājakumārakaḥ || 7 || mṛtaḥ so’pi jalatīre patitvā puṇyamāptavān | somadatto dvayaṃ nītvā yayau gṛhaṃ tataśca tau || 8 || gṛdhraḥ kaliṃgarājasya suto babhūva śobhanaḥ | sṛgālī sā tathā jajñe kāñcīrājasya putrikā || 9 || dvayostīrthaprabhāveṇa sambandho’jāyata svataḥ | vivāhitau sukhaṃ kālaṃ ninyatuścātibhāvukau || 1.577.1 0|| premṇā vyāptau na cānyonyaṃ sehāte virahaṃ kvacit | athaikadā vadhūḥ prāha svāminaṃ praṇayānvitā || 11 || mayaikaṃ hi vrataṃ kāryaṃ deyānujñā tvayā priya | mama snehāt priyaṃ cet te’nujñāṃ dātumihārhasi || 1 2|| satyaṃ mūlaṃ prajānāṃ ca viṣṇuḥ satye pratiṣṭhitaḥ | satyamūlaṃ sadā rājyaṃ vrataṃ satyena vardhate || 13|| ityuktastu patiḥ prāha vijñāpaya kuru priye | yayeṣṭaṃ cara sarvaṃ tad dāsye sāhāyyamuttamam || 14|| sāpi bhartṛvacaḥ śrutvā saviśrambhā hyuvāca tam | ekā svapitumicchāmi madhyāhnehaṃ tathāvidhā ||15|| yathā kaścinna māṃ paśyet svalpakālaṃ tu nityadā | śvaśuro yadi vā śvaśrūḥ patiścānyo’pi vā janaḥ || 16 || suptāṃ māṃ naiva paśyet sa vratametanmuhūrtakam | śrutvā bāḍhamuvācaināṃ patnīṃ rājakumārakaḥ ||17|| saudhaṃ svataṃtraṃ tasyai sa dadau yatra na vai janaḥ | kaścidapi drakṣyate na śayanīye mahāvratām ||18|| evaṃ vai samayaṃ kṛtvā vartate sa kumārakaḥ | pitrā dattaṃ tu tadrājyaṃ bubhuje praśaśāsa saḥ || 19|| tasyābhavan pañca putrā jyeṣṭhāya rājyamādadat | atha svayaṃ yathā patnī tathā vratamupāśritaḥ ||1.577.20|| ekākī svapate yatra kaścijjano na paśyati | saptasaptativarṣāṇi vyatītānyasya vai tataḥ ||21|| aṣṭasaptatike varṣa hyekānte sa narādhipaḥ | tameva cintayannarthaṃ madhyasaṃsthe divākare ||22|| vaiśākhasya tu māsasya śukle dvādaśikādine | buddhiḥ pravartitā tasya priyādarśanalālasā ||23|| ko’rcyastat kiṃ vrataṃ tvasyā eṣā svapiti nirjane | na suptāyā vrataṃ kiñcit sampadyate supuṇyakṛt ||24|| na kenacit kṛto dharmaḥ suptavyaṃ vratameva tat | bhuktvā tu kāmabhogān vai bhuktvā tu piśitodanam ||25|| tāmbūlaṃ kṣaumavastrādi vibhūṣaṇāni mālikāḥ | śṛṃgārādikasarvāṇi sugandharañjanāni ca ||26|| vrataṃ kasmād bhavedatra suptā karoti yadvratam | avaśyameva draṣṭavyā kīdṛśaṃ carati vratam ||27|| kupyetāpi tu sandṛṣṭā kupyatveva tathāpi vai | yadvā gacchati kruddhā sā yatra gacchatu rocate ||28|| yadvā hānirbhavet kācit sāpi cāstu tathāpi sā | draṣṭavyaivaṃ cintayato vyoma prāpto divākaraḥ ||29|| snātaḥ sa vidhinā cātha kṣaumābhyāmupasaṃvṛtaḥ | bhūtvā cotsārayāmāsa sarvān bhṛtyān samīpataḥ ||1.577.30|| adya vrate mayā stheyaṃ nāgantavyaṃ janairgṛham | rājabhavanadvāraṃ vā nareṇāpi ca yoṣitā ||3 1|| yadyāgamiṣyati kaścinmama vadhyo bhaviṣyati | evamājñāpayitvā tu rājā saudhāntaraṃ gataḥ ||32|| paryaṃkasya tale rājñyā gupto babhūva chādanaiḥ | rājñī madhyāhnavelāyāṃ samāyātā tadāsane ||33|| rujārtā rurude tatra śirovedanapīḍitā | kiṃ mayā tu kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ yatphalaṃ vedanātmakam ||34|| bhartāpi māṃ na jānāti pīḍāyuktāṃ svamastake | kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ me martavyaṃ bhavet khalu ||35|| bhartā pṛcchati naivātra kiṃ vrataṃ kīdṛśaṃ ca te | mayā tasmai kathitavyaṃ nānyathānto bhaviṣyati ||36|| kathane maraṇaṃ me syād vaktavyaṃ nāśakṛd bhavet | akathane sadā duḥkhaṃ soḍhavyaṃ na nivartate ||37|| tasmānmayā pragantavyaṃ bhartrā saha ca tatsthalam | yatrāhaṃ duḥkhamāpannā kathayiṣye tataḥ patim ||38|| iti priyāvacaḥ śrutvā samutthāya tato nṛpaḥ | dorbhyāmāliṃgya vai bhāryāṃ dhairyeṇovāca sundarīm ||39|| kimidaṃ bhāṣase bhadre svātmānaṃ pīḍitaṃ prati | bhiṣajaḥ santi bahavo nāśayiṣyanti pīḍanam ||1.577.40|| tvayā pūrvaṃ vratamiṣād vedaneyaṃ sugopitā | yena vai kliśyase bhadre śirasyasukhapīḍitā ||41 || yā tvaṃ ca bhāṣase bhadre yatra vai duḥkhapīḍitā | pūrvaṃ jātā tatra gatvā kathayiṣye ca me patim |||42|| bhadre kiṃ tat sthalaṃ brūhi yātrāṃ te rocate yadi | avaśyaṃ tatra saṃyāhi mayā sākaṃ sukhaṃ labha ||43|| kimidaṃ gopyate devi patyagre tvaṃ pativrate | bhartā dharmo yaśo bhartā bhartaiva priyamātmanaḥ ||44|| bhartre vācyaṃ gopyamapi dharmaḥ pativratoditaḥ | ityuktā sā patiṃ prāha kathane’tra vināśanam ||45|| bhavettasmānna vaktavyaṃ tava pīḍākaraṃ prabho | sukhe hi vartase nityaṃ mahārājo’si sundaraḥ ||46|| bahvyo matsadṛśībhāryāstiṣṭhantyantaḥpure tava | sukhaṃ bhuṃkṣva mahārāja māmekāṃ parihāya ca ||47|| gacchāmyahaṃ mama sthānaṃ tato mṛtyurhi me dhruvaḥ | rājase devavad rājan na māṃ tatpraṣṭumarhasi ||48|| tvaṃ me devo guruḥ sākṣād bhartā yajñaḥ sanātanaḥ | dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca yaśaḥ svargaśca mānadaḥ ||49|| pṛṣṭayā me hitaṃ vācyaṃ tathyaṃ satyaṃ priyaṃ tava | pativratānāṃ sarvāsāmeṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||1.577.50|| na saṃśaye niyoktavyaḥ sukhastho hi patiḥ striyā | etanniścitya me pīḍāṃ na praṣṭuṃ tvamihārhasi ||51 || patiḥ prāha śṛṇu bhadre śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham | avaśyameva vaktavyaṃ pṛṣṭayā patinā striyā ||52|| api guptānyaguptāni gopayanti na satstriyaḥ | gopāyanti tu yā guptaṃ bhartragre sā na vai satī ||53|| patnī prāha priyaṃ vākyaṃ sārthaṃ dharmānvitaṃ nṛpam | devo rājā gurū rājā somo rājeti paṭhyate ||54|| rājāgre nānṛtaṃ vācyaṃ gacchāvaḥ saukaraṃ sthalam | tīrthe tatra kathayiṣye kṛpāṃ viśeṣataḥ kuru ||55|| bāḍhamāha tato rājājñāpayāmāsa mantriṇaḥ | tīrthaṃ saukaravaṃ gantuṃ badaryāśramanimnagam ||56|| hastyaśvarathalakṣāṇi gāvo dogdhryo’yutāni ca | dhanadhānyāni ratnāni bhūṣāmbarāṇi vai tathā ||||57|| dānārthaṃ saha nītvā ca prajayā vṛddhayā yutaḥ | yayau gaṃgātmakaṃ tīrthaṃ nyuvāsa māsaṣaṭakkam ||58|| atha tīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā dadau dānāni sarvaśaḥ | upoṣya tau trirātraṃ ca dampatī niyamānvitau ||59|| praṇamya bhūṣitau viṣṇuṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim | sthitau cāgre harestatra patiṃ prāha satī priyā ||1.577.60|| ehyehi nātha gacchāvaḥ paśya gopyaṃ manīṣitam | sṛgālī pūrvamevāhaṃ tiryagyonivyavasthitā ||61|| viddhātra somadattena bāṇena mastake purā | yasya doṣeṇa me’pyeṣa rujā śirasi saṃsthitā ||62|| kāñcīrājakule janma pitrā dattā tava priyā | kṣetraprabhāvānme saiṣā jātā siddhirnamo’stu te ||63|| śrutvā rājāpi sasmāra pūrvajātamudantakam | ahaṃ gṛdhro mahābhāge vaṭe’tra vanacāriṇā ||64|| somadattena viddhaśca mṛto’tra tīrthapuṇyataḥ | jāto’smi ca kaliṃgānāṃ rājā tava patiḥ priye ||65|| akāmamaraṇenāpi paśya kṣetrasya satphalam | te ca bhāgavataśreṣṭhāstathā nārāyaṇapriyāḥ ||66||| paurajānapadāstatra hyāsan ye sahasaṃgatāḥ | sarve’pi vismayaṃ prāptāścakruste bhajanaṃ hareḥ ||67|| rājā rājñī śarīre sve vihāya divyamūrtikau | bhūtvā vimānamāruhya brahmalokaṃ caturbhujau ||68|| yayaturdevapūjyau tau nedurdundubhayo divi | prajāḥ sahagatāstāśca sarvasaṃgaṃ vihāya ca ||69|| tatraiva maraṇaṃ prāpurnārāyaṇaprasādataḥ | caturbhujāśca te sarve brahmalokaṃ yayurmudā ||1.577.70|| sarve śaṃkhagadāpadmamaṇidhrāḥ pārṣadā narāḥ | nāryaścaturbhujāyuktāḥ sarvabhogasamanvitāḥ ||71|| pārṣadāṇyo brahmaloke pramodante harergṛhe | evaṃ tīrthaprabhāveṇa muktiṃ te śāśvatīṃ gatāḥ ||72|| janmāntarakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ yatsvalpamapi vā bahu | tatkadācit phalatyeva yena tīrthāgamo bhavet ||73|| yadalpamapi jāyeta tanmahattvāya kalpate | ya etatpaṭhate subhru śṛṇuyācchrāvayecca vā ||74|| tena dvādaśavarṣāṇi pūjanaṃ me kṛtaṃ bhavet | śaṃbhuḥ satyai purā prāha lakṣmi te kathitaṃ mayā ||75|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārāhatīrthamahimnā śṛgālyā gṛdhrasya ca maraṇottaraṃ rājagṛhe janma, vṛttāntaprakāśottaraṃ muktirmastakarogādikāraṇakathanaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 577 ||
<1.578> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ tvanyāṃ tīrthānāṃ pāpanāśinīm | śaṃkaroktāmṛkṣakādrau pārvatyai te vadāmyaham || 1 || gāyamānasya me kṣetre mandire mama sannidhau | puṇyaṃ vādayamānasya nṛtyato jāgratastathā || 2 || godāturannadātuśca jaladātuśca yatphalam | mārjayiturlepayiturgandhapuṣpapradāyituḥ || 3 || dhūpadīpasunaivedyapradātuścāpi yatphalam | japayajñādikartuśca yatphalaṃ caihikaṃ tathā || 4 || pāralaukikamevāpi jāyate tad vadāmi te | śṛṇu pūrvaṃ khañjarīṭaḥ pakṣī gaṃgātaṭe’bhavat || 5 || kīṭān bahūn prabhuktvā sa hyajīrṇātiprapīḍitaḥ | gaṃgāyāṃ patitastatra jale mṛtyumupāgataḥ || 6 || tena puṇyena vaiśyasya koṭyadhisvāmino gṛhe | dhanaratnamahāsmṛddhe’jāyata pravibhaktimān || 7 || mānaṃ karoti satataṃ devāgre mandire mama | ekakīrtanajaṃ puṇyaṃ saptajanmāghanāśanam || 8 || iti matvā karotyeṣo gāyanaṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau | dvādaśābde gate varṣe pitarau prāha harṣataḥ || 9 || matpriyaṃ yadi kartavyameko me dīyatāṃ varaḥ | na cāhaṃ vāraṇīyo vai pitrā mātrā kathaṃcana || 1.578.1 0|| satyaṃ vrataṃ samāsthāya tīrthayātrā mayeṣyate | śrutvā taṃ pitarau tuṣṭāvūcaturvada cepsitam || 11 || gāvastriṃśatsahasrāṇi sarvā vai śubhadohanāḥ | yadyatra
