rocate dānaṃ dehi tvamavicāritam || 12|| lakṣakoṭyātmakaṃ dravyaṃ dāne pradīyatāṃ dhanam | dhanadhānyāni ratnāni dehi putra hyavāritaḥ || 1 3||| kanyā vai ramaṇīyāḥ su samudvaha vidhānataḥ | yajñairyaṣṭaṃ samicchā te yaja devaṃ janārdanam || 14|| yāvadbhojanatṛptān vā sādhūnicchasi tarpitum | sarvaṃ nijecchayā putra kartumarhasi sāmpratam || 15|| naya sārdhaṃ tvayā putra tīrthayātrākṛte’pi ca | śubhaṃ vai cintitaṃ putra tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇāśramam || 16 || adya mātṛstanau dhanyau tvayā putreṇa sārthakau | āyānti ca punaryānti gatā gacchanti cāpare || 17|| dṛśyate ca kṣaṇe naṣṭo punarbhavati naśyati | tasmādbhaktirharestīrthaṃ kartavyaṃ vai suputrakaiḥ || 18|| mātāpitṛsahasrāṇi putradāraśatāni ca | janmajanmani vartante kasya te kasya vā vayam || 1 9|| tasmāt putra tvayā cādya śubhakāryeṇa tāritāḥ | pitaraḥ pitaraścāpi vayaṃ dhanyāḥ suputrataḥ ||1.578.20|| kintu vada viśeṣaṃ ced guptaṃ rahasyamasti cet | vairāgyaṃ vā gṛhaudāsīnatā te vartate kimu || 21 || guptaṃ cennaiva goptavyaṃ pitarau prati putraka | iti śrutvā dvayorvākyaṃ natvā prāha śubhaṃ sutaḥ ||22|| tatrāhaṃ kathayiṣyāmi tīrthe śrīharisannidhau | bāḍhamityeva taṃ putraṃ dampatī procatustadā ||23 || gamane kṛtasaṃkalpā yayuḥ saukaravaṃ prati | yattu kiṃcidgṛhe cāsti kṛtaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prati || 24|| vaiśākhadvādaśikāyāṃ tīrthakṣetramupāgatāḥ | snātāḥ santṛpya viṣṇuṃ vai dadurdānāni bhūriśaḥ ||25|| ṣaṇmāsā vigatāsteṣāṃ kṛṣṇalagnahṛdāṃ tataḥ | kaumude kārtike śukle hyekādaśyāṃ vratānvitāḥ ||26 || dvādaśyāṃ ca sutaḥ pṛṣṭhaḥ pitṛbhyāṃ smārakaṃ prati | putrastaccaraṇau spṛṣṭvā pitarau samabhāṣata ||27|| khañjarīṭo hyahamāsaṃ pakṣī cātra sthale purā | ajīrṇena mṛtastvatra tena puṇyena vāṃ sutaḥ || 28|| jāto’smi bhaktimān jātismaraścātha namāmi vām | prakāśe gopanīyasya mamāyuryāti pūrṇatām ||29|| gamiṣye bhagavaddhāma gāyamānasya me phalam | ityuktvā ca jalaṃ pītvā natvā ca pitṛpādayoḥ ||1.578.3 0|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | ityevaṃ gāyamānaḥ sa bhūtvā divyavapurdharaḥ ||3 1 || caturbāhuḥ pārṣadaiśca vimāne sandhṛtaśca saḥ | mukto bhūtvā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ prakṛtipāragam ||32|| tato mātā pitā cānye dṛṣṭvāścaryamanuttamam | te’pi bhaktiṃ parāṃ cakruścānye ye ca samāgatāḥ ||33|| svalpenaiva ca kālena mama muktimupāgatāḥ | sarve hi yoginastatra dhāmni cotpalagandhinaḥ ||34|| modante tu yathābhāvaṃ prasādāt kṣetrajānmama | evaṃ vai gāyamānasya muktirbhavati me’nadhe ||35|| śṛṇu tattvena me dehi limpamānasya yatphalam | mṛttikāyuggomayena mama veśmopalepayet ||36|| nyastāni tatra yāvanti padāni tu vilimpatā | tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi divyāni divi modate ||37|| sakāmaśced bhaved rājā divyavarṣasahasrakam | bhaktau vyavasthitaḥ paścānmama dhāmābhigacchati ||38|| samīpe vā yadi dūre gatvā nayati gomayam | yāvanti tatpadānyasya tāvadvarṣasahasrakam ||39|| gomayānāṃ ca netā sa svargaloke mahīyate | tataśca rājā bhavati padavarṣasahasrakam ||1.578.40|| mama bhaktiṃ sadā kṛtvā tvante maddhāma yāti hi | upalepane snāne vā salilaṃ yo dadāti saḥ ||41 || yāvanto bindavastatra pānīyasya bhavanti hi | tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ||42|| tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi rājā bhūtvā tataḥ param | māṃ prasādya guṇairbhakto mama dhāmābhigacchati ||43|| sammārjanaṃ mandirasya karoti strī naro’pi vā | yāvantaḥ pāṃsavo bhūmeruḍḍīyante tu mārjitāḥ ||44|| tāvadvarṣaśatānyāśu svargaloke mahīyate | tāvadvarṣaśatānyatra rājā bhūtvā tataḥ param ||45|| mama bhaktyā mama dhāma prayāti matsvarūpavān | gāyanaṃ ye prakurvanti mama sevāparāyaṇāḥ ||46|| pratyakṣaraṃ tu varṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ divi modate | sarvasevāguṇayukto nityadā mama pūjakaḥ ||47|| tato bhūmau bhaved rājā vaiṣṇavo vaiṣṇavaiḥ saha | gāyanmama yaśo nityaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ ||48|| matprasādādāyuṣo’nte mama dhāmābhigacchati | cāṇḍālo hyabhavat kaścid vane manmūrtisannidhau ||49|| gāyati sma sadā gītiṃ dūramāgatya caikadā | dhṛtaḥ sa rakṣasā tūrṇaṃ khādituṃ tu tadā hi saḥ ||1.578.50 || uvāca rākṣasaṃ gītyuttaraṃ māṃ khāda nirbharam | idānīṃ tu kṣaṇaṃ muñca vratapuṇyaṃ karomyaham ||5 1|| viṣṇorvai toṣaṇārthaṃ ca mayā gītiḥ pragīyate | jāgaraṃ caryate rātrau prātarbhukṣvāgataṃ ca mām ||52|| asnātānāṃ gatiṃ yāsye yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ | brahmaghnānāṃ surāpānāṃ stenānāṃ piśitāśinām ||53|| vyavāyināṃ gatiṃ yāsye yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ | śrutvaivaṃ rakṣasā mukto gītiṃ ca jāgaraṃ tathā ||54|| caṇḍālaḥ pracakārātha prātarharistu bhūsuraḥ | bhūtvā samāyayau prāha mā gaccha rākṣasaṃ prati ||55|| jivitārthāya satyasya tyajane dūṣaṇaṃ na vai | śrutvā taṃ śvapacaḥ prāha satyaṃ me niścitaṃ vratam ||56 || satyamūlaṃ jagatsarvaṃ hyātmā satye pratiṣṭhitaḥ | nāhaṃ mithyā cariṣyāmi gaccha vipra namo’stu te ||57||| evamuktvā śvapākastu gato yatra sa rākṣasaḥ | prāha śīghraṃ khāda māṃ ca mokṣo te me bhaved drutam ||58|| rakṣaḥ prāha prasanno’smi satyādhāraṃ ca pālitam | brahma satyadhṛtiḥ proktaṃ tvayā tadrakṣitaṃ yataḥ |||59|| necchāmi bhakṣituṃ tvāṃ ca dehi me gītijaṃ phalam | yena mokṣaṃ pragacchāmi tvayā sākaṃ subhaktiman ||1.578.60|| caṇḍālena tadā dattaṃ rakṣase gītikāphalam | rakṣo dehaṃ parityajya yayau vaikuṇṭhamuttamam ||61 || caṇḍālo’pi harerbhakto yayau yānena dhāma ca | tatra caturbhujo bhūtvā siṣeve parameśvaram ||62|| evaṃ vai gītikāpuṇyaṃ svargamokṣādidāyakam | pāpaghnaṃ divyatāsampādakaṃ kīrtanameva me ||63|| vādyavādayituḥ puṇyaṃ vadāmi yaddhi jāyate | pratisvaraṃ śatavarṣaṃ svarge loke mahīyate ||64|| paścāt saṃjāyate rājā daśavarṣasahasrakam | tato yāti mama bhakto mama dhāma parātparam ||65|| nṛtyato matsannidhau ca lakṣmīsthānaṃ hi niścitam | narasyāpi yoṣito’pi yatheṣṭaṃ pradadāmyaham ||66|| dhāmni me nartako mukto bhavatyeva caturbhujaḥ | nṛtyaṃ vai śāśvatānandaṃ dadāmyasmai hi dhāmani ||67|| jāgrato mama mūrteśca sannidhau divyamuttamam | sārvajñyaṃ cāparokṣyaṃ ca dadāmi ca yathā mama ||68|| godātre mama golokaṃ dadāmi muktimaṇḍalam | annadātre’mṛtaṃ svargaṃ dadāmyakṣatabhojanam ||69|| jaladātre’mṛtalokaṃ dadāmyakṣatatṛptidam | gandhapuṣpapradātre ca dadāmi divyavarṣma yat ||1.578.70|| śāśvataṃ cāpūrakaṃ ca tattvānāṃ sukhalabdhaye | lakṣaiśvarībhiḥ ramate īśvaro bhogapūritaḥ ||71 || dhūpadasya ca saugandhyaṃ manmūrteriva jāyate | dīpadasya sadā divyaṃ cakṣurbhavati sūryavat ||72|| ante svargādikaṃ bhuktvā mukto maddhāma yāti ca | naivedyasya phalaṃ tasmai vaikuṇṭhaṃ pradadāmyaham ||73|| brahmarājyaṃ sadā bhuṃkte sadā naivedyado mama | japayajñādikartre ca sārvabhaumasthalaṃ mahat ||74|| pradadāmi pṛthivyāṃ vai tataḥ svargaṃ tataḥ param | vairājaṃ padamevāpi tato mokṣaṃ dadāmi ca ||75|| sakāmānāṃ kāmapūrān lokān yacchāmi sarvathā | akāmānāṃ mama dhāma prayacchāmi ca śāśvatam ||76|| narāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ vāpi yatheṣṭaṃ pradadāmi vai | devatvaṃ vāpi devītvaṃ svargādau vitarāmyaham ||77|| īśatvaṃ ceśvarītvaṃ vā vairājādau dadāmi ca | muktānītvaṃ ca muktatvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ prakaromyaham ||78|| brāhmītvaṃ brahmatāṃ cāpi dadāmi tadabhīpsitam | kṛṣṇatvaṃ cāpi kṛṣṇātvaṃ dadāmi ca tadīpsitam ||79|| nārāyaṇītvaṃ ca yadvā nārāyaṇatvamityapi | avatāratvamevāpyavatāriṇītvamityapi ||1.578.80|| yathābhakti yathādāsyaṃ yathāpuṇyaṃ dadāmyaham | parameśvaratā me’sti sā tu nānyasya kasyacit ||8 1 || so’haṃ cānādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’smi cākṣarāt | dhāmnaḥ pare mama dhāmni vartāmi puruṣottamaḥ ||82|| ityetat kathitaṃ lakṣmi tava jijñāsitaṃ mayā | śaṃbhunā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ satyai tīrtheṣu tiṣṭhatā ||83|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhavettathā | mama dāsyaṃ durlabhaṃ bhaktānāṃ dadāmi śāśvatam ||84|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gāyamānasya khañjarīṭasya muktiḥ, vādayamānasya nṛtyato jāgrato godāturannadāturjaladātuḥ sammārjayiturlepayiturgandhapuṣpādidāturdhūpadīpasunaivedyadāturjapayajñādikartuśca phalaprāptyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭasaptatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||578||
<1.579> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi ravitīrthasya yatphalam | pārvatyā prārthitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ samuvāca satīpuraḥ || 1 || ekadā ṛṣayo yājñavalkyādyāḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ | ādityeśaṃ samāyātā narmadākacchake purā || 2 || praviśya ṛṣayaḥ sarve vane puṣpaphalākule | vanānte dadṛśuḥ śubhrāṃ striyaṃ raktāmbarānvitām || 3 || raktamālyāṃ suśobhāḍhyāṃ raktacandanacarcitām | raktābharaṇasaṃvyāptāṃ śaśihastāṃ bhayapradām || 4 || tasyāḥ samīpataḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ vṛddhaṃ ca nirdayam | mahākāyaṃ pāśahastaṃ piṃgākṣaṃ dīrghajihvikam || 5 || tīkṣṇadṛṃṣṭātikruddhaṃ ca vikarālasvarūpiṇam | ṛṣibhiśca vīkṣitau tau saṃpṛṣṭau pāpakarmiṇau || 6 || kau bhavantau vikṛtau vai tīrthasthau pāparūpiṇau | tāvūcatustadā viprān jarāhaṃ kālaputrikā || 7 || ahaṃ yamaḥ svayaṃ daṇḍapradātā pāpināṃ sadā | yūyaṃ dharmacarā viprā dharmaṃ carata nārmade || 8 || kacche tīrthe sampraviśya sukhaṃ tiṣṭhata vaiṣṇavāḥ | na cāvāṃ tān pīḍayāvo ye tu nārmadasevakāḥ || 9 || narmadānindakānatra hariṣyāmo yamālayam | te śrutvā vacanaṃ tatra kacche ca nārmade drutam || 1.579.1 0|| bhṛguṇādhyasite cakrurvāsaṃ mokṣapradaṃ śubham | tāvattatra narāścānye pañca dṛṣṭā maharṣibhiḥ || 11 || snānadevārcanairyuktāḥ puruṣāste mahābalāḥ | tairuktaṃ bhūsurebhyaḥ prasnātaṃ tīrtheṣu vai kṣiteḥ || 1 2|| na tatpāpaṃ tu no naṣṭaṃ yannaṣṭaṃ tvatra cāplavāt | ekenāsmatsu ca gurordārāḥ pūrvaṃ pradūṣitāḥ || 13 || dvitīyena suvarṇaṃ vai mitrasya saṃhṛtaṃ purā | tṛtīyena brahmahatyā kṛtā ghorā bhayaṃkarī || 14|| caturthena kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ surāyā madyapānakam | pañcamena gavāṃ hatyā kṛtā te ca vayaṃ nvime || 15|| narmadāyāṃ bhṛgukṣetre snātvā śuddhāśca nirmalāḥ | natvānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrībhārgavīpatim || 16|| kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ bhaktyā tyaktvā prāṇān divaṃgatāḥ | brāhmaṇaiste tadā dṛṣṭā ravitīrthe vimānagāḥ || 17|| yamena kālaputryā ca na niruddhāśca te tadā | pratyuta vai namaskārāḥ kṛtā dvābhyāṃ hṛdā muhuḥ || 18|| athānyatte pravakṣyāmi tvagastyeśvaratīrthakam | ānandeśvaratīrthaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ vartate tathā || 19|| līneśvaraṃ tathā tīrthaṃ tṛtīyaṃ cāpi vartate | ekadā kālabāṣpākhyo dānavo duścaraṃ tapaḥ ||1.579.20|| ādau kṛtayuge revājale cacāra tasya tu | prasannaḥ śaṃkaraḥ sākṣād babhūva ca jagāda ha ||21 || varaṃ brūhi yatheṣṭaṃ te dadāmīti ca vai tataḥ | dānavaḥ sa parivavre dehi me’tra maheśvara ||22|| hastaṃ śirasi yasyaiva dāsyāmi sa mṛtiṃ vrajet | śaṃbhuḥ prāha tvadiṣṭaṃ yattattathaiva bhaviṣyati ||23|| itiśrutvā vaco daityaḥ śaṃbhumevābhidudruve | hastaṃ te mūrdhni dāsyāmi na tatsatyaṃ vacastava || 24|| rudraḥ palāyitastena keśavaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ | nivedya keśavaṃ śaṃbhustatra jale nyalīyata ||25|| bhaktaduḥkhavināśāyānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | strīrūpaṃ tatra dhṛtvaiva daityasammukhamāgataḥ ||26|| kumārīṃ yuvatīṃ ramyāṃ candrojjvalāṃ ca nirjane | dṛṣṭvārebhe parirabdhuṃ dānavo mohavihvalaḥ ||27|| uvāca bhava me patnī tadā pratyāha keśavaḥ | yadi māṃ manyase bhāryāṃ pratyayaśced bhavenmama ||28|| nṛtyaṃ kuru mayā sārdhaṃ jaye te syāṃ hi kāminī | tathāstviti dānavaḥ sa nṛtye samyagavartata ||29|| hastāvuddhṛtya śirasi mayūrakalayā tadā | nṛtyaṃ cakāra bhagavān dānavo’pi tathākarot ||1.579.30 || śanairhastau sammilitau paspṛśatuḥ śiraḥ svakam | dānavaḥ sa nṛtyamohādbhasmībabhūva tatkṣaṇāt ||3 1 || śaṃkarastatparijñāya jalād bahirbabhūva ha | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā sthiro’bhavat ||32|| tattīrthaṃ narmadāyāṃ vai līneśvaraṃ samucyate | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeśaṃ ca tīrthaṃ tad vaiṣṇavaṃ param ||33|| kṛtvā yayau ca bhagavānadṛśyatāṃ haro’pi ca | snātvā tatra labhenmartyo bhuktiṃ muktiṃ tathonnatim ||34|| dakṣiṇe narmadātīre tīrthaṃ gopālakeśvaram | kāmadhenustapastatra putrārthaṃ pracakāra ha ||35|| dhyāyamānā parābhaktyā devadevaṃ maheśvaram | tuṣṭastasyā jagannāthaḥ kapilāyā maheśvaraḥ ||36|| kapilādehamadhyādvai niḥsṛtaḥ śaṃkaraḥ svayam | tuṣṭo’smīti samuvāca varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam ||37|| surabhiḥ prāha putraṃ me dehi divyaguṇairyutam | tathāstviti haraḥ prāha dharmaḥ putro babhūva ha ||38|| catuṣpād vṛṣabhātmā vai vṛṣo lokasya rakṣakaḥ | gopāleśaḥ śaṃkaro’yaṃ surabhyā samudīritaḥ ||39|| tattīrthe kārtike cāpi vaiśākhe pūrṇimātithau | vṛṣotsargaṃ kārayecca śaṃkarasya pratuṣṭaye ||1.579.40 || vṛṣabhe romasaṃkhyā tu sarvāṃgeṣu ca yāvatī | tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate ||41 || tato yāyād brahmalokaṃ mahābhāgavato yadi | yadvā rājā bhaved bhūmau punarmokṣamavāpnuyāt |||42||| atha tīrthottamaṃ ramyaṃ parāśarābhidhaṃ tathā | yatra taptaṃ tapaścograṃ parāśareṇa vai purā ||43|| tasya tuṣṭā mahālakṣmīrvaraṃ dadau sutārthakam | parāśaraḥ sutaṃ lebhe nārāyaṇāṃśamuttamam ||44|| atha tīrthaṃ bhayaghnaṃ vai bhīmeśvaraṃ śubhaṃ tathā | tadvat tīrthaṃ nāradeśaṃ yatra yogopalabdhaye ||45|| nārado vai tapastepe śaṃbhuṃ nidhāya cāntare | śaṃbhuḥ sākṣād babhūvāsmai yogasiddhiṃ dadau parām ||46 || hanūmadīśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ tato gacchet sukhāvaham | rāvaṇaṃ tvajayadrājā sahasrārjunasaṃjñakaḥ ||47|| kārtavīryaṃ vijigāya jāmadagnirmahāprabhuḥ | jāmadagniṃ jitavośca dāśarathirmahāprabhuḥ ||48|| dāśarathiṃ labdhatī sītā pūrvābhipuṇyataḥ | sītāṃ nītavatastasya rāvaṇasya vadhaḥ kṛtaḥ ||49|| rāmeṇa tasya bhaktaśca hanūmān vānarottamaḥ | laṃkādāhottaraṃ hatyādoṣaśāntyarthameva saḥ ||1.579.50|| narmadāyāṃ bhṛgukṣetre samāgatya sthiro’bhavat | hanūmadīśvaraṃ nāma tīrthaṃ tatparamaṃ smṛtam ||51 || camatkāraṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi purā tatrābhavatparam | suparṇo nāma rājarṣirbabhūva vasudhātale ||52|| śatabāhurbabhūvāsya kumāro vaiṣṇavottamaḥ | vicaran sa yayau vindhyācalaṃ yadṛcchayā kvacit ||53|| vane dṛṣṭvā kumāro’yaṃ piṃgalaṃ caikalaṃ dvijam | papraccha tvaṃ kathaṃ cāste bhramase’tra sapustakaḥ ||54|| vipraḥ prāha samāyātaḥ kānyakubjādito vane | preṣito rājaputryā ca śreṣṭhavarābhikāṃkṣayā ||55|| rājā nāmnā śikhaṇḍī yastvaputraścākarottapaḥ | kanyāṃ sa prāptavān tasyā vivāhaṃ sa samīhate ||56|| kanyā sā pitaraṃ prāha narmadāyāstaṭe purā | mayūrī cābhavaṃ tatra mayūreṇa samanvitā ||57|| tatrāgataḥ kadācittu vyādhastena śarairmuhuḥ | hatā nipātitā sārdhaṃ svāmināhaṃ mṛtā tadā ||58|| pracchidya mastakaṃ me sa dehaṃ vahnau prapacya ca | bhakṣayāmāsa cārdhaṃ tu cārdhaṃ cikṣepa vai jale ||59|| narmadāyāstena puṇyabalenāhaṃ tava gṛhe | jātāsmi rājaputrīti saśikhā dehasundarī ||1.579.60|| jātismarā smarāmyetatsthalaṃ puṇyapradaṃ pitaḥ | tatra preṣaya vipraṃ ca hanūmadīśvare sthale ||61|| piśaṃgapatratriśākhavaṭasyādhaḥ piśaṃginī | śilā vai vartate tatra patrāṇyasthīni me tadā ||62|| kṣiptāni santi pāṣāṇakūṭe jīrṇāni santi ca | narmadāyā jale tāni nikṣiptavyāni sarvathā ||63|| tena muktirbhavenme vai nārāyaṇaṃ patiṃ prati | ityājñayā nṛpateśca mārgaṇāya dvijo’pyaham ||64|| samāyāto’smi likhitaṃ vācayāmi sthalaṃ hi tat | ityuktvā tatsthalaṃ labdhvā prāpyāsthīni yathātatham ||65|| nicikṣepa jale viprastāvat kanyā mṛtābhavat | śatabāhustu tatraiva smṛtvā nijāṃ mayūratām ||66|| śuśoca tatra vai tīrthe mṛtaḥ so’pi ca tatkṣaṇam | divyaṃ yānaṃ samāyātaṃ sthitastatra tataḥ sa ca ||67|| yayau mṛtā ca sā yatra rājaputrī ca tatsthalam | sāpi divyasvarūpā ca devī bhūtvā vimānakam ||68|| samāruroha ca tadā yānaṃ yayau ca narmadām | tāvad vipraḥ prasasmāra vyādhaṃ svaṃ pūrvajanmani ||69|| jalaṃ pītvā narmadāyā mamāra tatra tīrthake | divyadehasvarūpaḥ san samāruroha yānakam ||1.579.70|| yayuste ca trayaḥ svargaṃ natvā śrīhanumantakam | narmadāyāḥ pratāpo’yaṃ hanūmattīrthake’bhavat ||71 || svargamokṣaprado lakṣmi pāpatāpapraṇāśanaḥ | mayūrī ca mayūraśca vyādhaśceti trayaḥ khalu ||72|| revājalaṃ prapītvā ca yayurmuktiṃ tataḥ param | ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi puṇyākhyānaṃ haroditam ||73|| pārvatyā śrūyamāṇaṃ tat paṭhanācchravaṇādapi | bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyaṃ saṃsārabhramavārakam ||74|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ādityeśatīrthaṃ līneśvaratīrthaṃ gopāleśvaratīrthaṃ parāśaratīrthaṃ hanumadīśvaratīrthaṃ cetyādisopākhyānatīrthanirūpaṇanāmaikonāśītyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 579 ||
<1.580> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca bhṛgukṣetre somatīrthaṃ yatrāścaryamabhūt purā | śambaro nāma rājābhūttasya putrastrilocanaḥ || 1 || trilocanasutaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ pāpaniṣṭho babhūva ha | vane vibhramatastasya mṛgayūthamadṛśyata || 2 || śaraistān hatavām̐steṣu dvijo mṛgasvarūpadhṛk | hatastena ca pāpena brahmahatyātmakena saḥ || 3 || kaṇṭhaḥ kṣitiṃ bhramanprāpto narmadānāgasaṃgamam | snāto revājale vāri papau cātha mṛgādanaḥ || 4 || vṛkṣacchāyāṃ samāśritya suptastataḥ kṣaṇāntare | tatra someśvaraṃ bāṇaṃ samānarca jalādibhiḥ || 5 || tāvat kaścid brāhmaṇo vai samāyāti ca mārgagaḥ | raktavastradharā nārī mārge tamāha bho dvija || 6 || mama bhartā somatīrthe tiṣṭhatyenaṃ ruṣā vada | tava patnī tvadarthaṃ sā vaṭasthā tvāṃ samīkṣate || 7 || ityuktaḥ sa brāhmaṇastu kaṇṭhamāgatya cāha tat | mayā vaṭe sthitā dṛṣṭā pāśahastā bhayaṃkarā || 8 || tava bhāryā tvāha māṃ tvaṃ bhartāraṃ preṣayātra me | saṃgamādardhakrośe sā dūre tiṣṭhati bhāminī || 9 || kaṇṭhaḥ svaṃ preṣayāmāsa bhṛtyaṃ yatra sthitā hi sā | gatvā bhṛtyaḥ papracchaināṃ kāsi kathaṃ ca tiṣṭhasi || 1.580.1 0|| stryuvāca taṃ kaṇṭhabhṛtyaṃ brahmahatyā mṛgodbhavā | mṛgaghnaṃ sampratīkṣe’tra tadarthaṃ codbhavo mama || 11 || gururātmavatāṃ śāstā rājā śāstā durātmanām | iha pracchannapāpānāṃ śāstā vaivasvato yamaḥ || 12|| narmadānāgasaṃge’tra taṭe krośārdhamātrake | na saṃviśed brahmahatyā tena tiṣṭhāmi cātra vai || 1 3|| gaccha tvaṃ preṣayeḥ śīghraṃ mayā muktaṃ patiṃ mama | bhṛtya āgatya rājānaṃ kaṇṭhamāha tathaiva ca || 14|| rājā śokaṃ jagāmāśu papāta dharaṇitale | uvāca prāṇasantyāgaṃ karomyatra tu saṃgame || 15|| śīghramānīyatāṃ vahnirindhanāni bahūnyapi | ānītaṃ yatkṣaṇāt sarvaṃ bhṛtyaiḥ rājā tu saṃgame || 16 || snātvā vahniṃ prasaṃjvālya natvā śrīsomanāthakam | triḥpradakṣiṇakaṃ kṛtvā hṛdi kṛtvā janārdanam || 17|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | japan viveśa viṣṇuṃ śrīpatiṃ dhyāyan caturbhujam || 18|| smarannārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sugatiṃ me kuru tviti | tāvad vimānaṃ divyaṃ vai viṣṇupārṣadasevitam || 1 9|| āgataṃ taṃ camatkāraṃ dṛṣṭvā bhṛtyā api dhruvam | kṛtvā ca niścayaṃ mokṣe viviśuste hutāśanam ||1.580.20|| vimānasthā divyarūpā bhūtvā te pārṣadottamāḥ | yayurdivyaṃ hareḥ sthānaṃ lakṣmīmāṇikyaśobhitam ||21|| prabhāpārvatīsaṃjuṣṭaṃ haṃsāmaṃjulikāśritam | campādayāramāhaimīmuktādevīsamarcitam ||22|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tāstu sevante brahmadhāmagāḥ | somatīrthaprasaṃge deyāni dānāni bhāvataḥ | pitarastasya tṛpyanti vaṃśo muktiṃ prayāti ca ||23|| brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ gurudāraniṣevaṇam | bhrūṇahā śuddhyati tatra hyevameva na saṃśayaḥ ||24|| ṛṇamocanasaṃjñaṃ ca tīrthaṃ gacchettataḥ param | divyaiḥ paitryairmānuṣaiśca ṛṇairātmakṛtairiha ||25|| mucyate tatsthale snātvā svarge devaḥ pramodate | athottare taṭe vārau vaiṣṇavaṃ tīrthamuttamam ||26|| jalaśāyīti vai nāmnā viṣṇurāsa purātra vai | nalameghaḥ purā daityo babhūva surakaṣṭadaḥ ||27|| devā jagmurhariṃ prāhurdaityanāśāya mādhavam | bhagavān garuḍārūḍhaścakraṃ nītvā samāyayau ||28|| nalameghasakhā dhundhumāro yuddhāya nirgataḥ | himālayasya vai droṇyāṃ viṣṇunā ghātitaśca saḥ ||29|| athāyayau mahāruṣṭo nalamegho hariṃ pratiṃ | yuyudhe bahudhā tatra viṣṇunā so’pi ghātitaḥ ||1.580.3 0|| sudarśanena cakreṇa dṛṣṭastatra tadālayaḥ | mahāguhāntare kanyā divyā daityeṇa rakṣitāḥ ||3 1 || mānuṣyaścātha devyaśca gāndharvyaḥ śailya ityapi | caturdaśasahasrāṇi hatvā hatvā janān bahūn ||32|| tā dṛṣṭā viṣṇunā tatra daityasya kāminī tathā | nāmnā sā maṃgalādevī rurodāti muhurbhṛśam ||33|| śrutvā daityavadhaṃ bhaktā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim | vavre ca vavrire kanyāḥ sarvāḥ śrīmāṇikīpatim ||34|| akṣarādhipatiṃ satāṃ patiṃ tā garuḍasthitāḥ | samānītā narmadāyāṃ snāpitā viṣṇunā tataḥ ||35|| tīrthaṃ kṛtvā jalaśāyisvarūpaṃ bhagavān svayam | narmadāyāṃ svīcakāra tāḥ sarvāḥ śayane kṣaṇam ||36|| atha kuṃkumavāpyāṃ sa bhagavān garuḍasthitaḥ | sarvābhiḥ saha patnībhiḥ samāyayau nijasthalam ||37|| lomaśena ca tāḥ sarvā upanītavatīkṛtāḥ | nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti tā viṣṇoḥ pārśve dhāmni kṣitāvapi ||38|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthe prāsādeṣu haripriyāḥ | muktāḥ syuste ca śṛṇvanti ya imāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ kathām ||39|| te dhanyā mānuṣe loke puṇyāḥ puṇyatamāḥ khalu | yeṣāṃ bhavati saṃyogaḥ sākṣāt kṛṣṇasya bhūtale ||1.580.40 || divyāste vai prajāyante narā nāryaḥ sthiraṃ caram | brahmāśraye jale divye snātvā divyā bhavanti te ||41|| atha tīrthaṃ paraṃ candrādityākhyaṃ pāvanaṃ caret | caṇḍamuṇḍau purā tvāstāṃ dānavau narmadātaṭe ||42|| sutapaśceratustatra dhyāyato bhāskaraṃ ca tau | sūryaḥ pratoṣitaḥ prāha vṛṇutaṃ sadvaraṃ tadā ||43|| ajeyau sarvadevānāṃ varaṃ vṛṇvaḥ pradehi tat | tathāstviti raviḥ prāha tābhyāṃ saṃsthāpito raviḥ ||44|| candraḥ saṃsthāpitaścāpi candrādityaṃ tattīrthakam | vyāsatīrthaṃ tato gacched vyāsamūrtiṃ prapūjayet ||45|| siddhaśaṃbhuṃ pūjayecca dvīpeśvaraṃ samarcayet | mārkaṇḍeyeśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ saṃkarṣaṇeśvaraṃ tathā ||46|| śrīkṛṣṇo rādhayā sārdhaṃ balenāpi virājate | eraṇḍīnāmakaṃ tīrthaṃ tato gacchettu pāvanam | atreḥ patnī cānasūyā hyaputrā tvāsa bhāminī ||47|| tapastepe yatra revātaṭe eraṇḍisaṃgame | gate varṣaśate tasyā viṣṇurudrapitāmahāḥ ||48|| dadurāgatya ca varaṃ nijatulyasutārthakam | putrāstasyā atritulyā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ||49|| babhūvuste candradattadurvāsaśca vai trayaḥ | tattīrthaṃ pāpatāpānāṃ śāmakaṃ putramokṣadam ||1.580.50|| dhūmapātaṃ tato gacchet tataḥ sāgarasaṃgamam | arghaṃ dadāti revāyai nityadā saritāṃ patiḥ ||51 || narmadā vadati tatra madīye saṃgame janāḥ | snātvā pitṝn tarpayiṣyantyeṣāṃ saptakulānyaham ||52|| tārayiṣyāmi bhaktām̐śca mokṣayiṣyāmi saṃkaṭāt | ahaṃ vai narmahāsyādi dadāmi śārṅgiṇe muhuḥ ||53|| ramayāmi hariṃ nityaṃ mamotsaṃge tadātmikā | nṛnarāṇāṃ mamokṣa ca dadadāmīti narmadā ||54|| evaṃ sā narmadā devī mokṣadā vartate parā | narmadāyāstava sakhyā lakṣmi māhātmyamuttamam ||55|| ṛkṣādrāvuditaṃ satyai śaṃbhunā tanmayoditam | bhaktyā śrutvā janaḥ sarvo mama dhāma prayāti ca ||56|| satī śrutvā śaṃkarātsā vimānavaramāsthitā | koṭiguṇaiḥ sevitā ca śaṃkareṇa samanvitā ||57|| śastāni ca tīrthāni kartuṃ yayau mudānvitā | āsamudraṃ gatā śailī pupūja tīrthadevatāḥ | |58 || koṭiratnādidānāni dadau paścāt svayaṃ satī | bhārgavīṃ ca bhṛgukacche militvā vyomamārgataḥ ||59|| kailāsaṃ prayayau sādhvī śaṃkarānumatā priyā | tīrthajalāni pradadau kailāsavāsino’pi ca ||1.580.6 0 || evaṃ yātrā kṛtā caiṣā śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā | lokānāṃ pāvanārthaṃ vai svayaṃ brahmātmako yataḥ ||6 1 || mahābhāgavato bhaktaḥ śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ | sarveṣāṃ śaṃpradātā sa kailāse haimaparvate ||62|| vartate mama pūrve sa yatra tapaḥ karomyaham | badarīvṛkṣamāśritya bahuvarṣavyatikramāt ||63|| ekaikena phalenaiva badaryāṃ nirvahāmyaham | tatrāhaṃ daśa koṭyaśca daśavarṣaṃ daśārbudam ||64|| daśa bhūmestathānyāni padmāni tapasi sthitaḥ | daivā māṃ naiva paśyanti kathaṃ ca manujāḥ khalu ||65|| ahaṃ paśyāmi tānsarvān tapaḥsthitaḥ samāgatān | toṣayantastataḥ stotrairmadicchayaiva te ca mām ||66|| puraḥsthitaṃ prapaśyanti yāvatkāryaṃ ca tatkṣaṇam | śrībadaryāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ yatra bhaktaḥ sthitaḥ smaret ||67|| sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma rādhālakṣmyādisevitam | mama yogarato bhakto me muktiphalabhāg bhavet ||68|| yo’vagacchati tīrtheṣu māṃ prabhuṃ sa ca mucyate | lakṣmīḥ prāha vacaḥ śrutvā nārāyaṇasya vai tadā ||69|| dāsyāṃ me praṇayaṃ kṛtvā vijñāpyaṃ śṛṇu keśava | mṛdunā susvabhāvena vakṣyāmi tvāṃ janārdana ||1.580.70 || alpaprāṇabalā nāryo bhogakṣetrāṇi yoṣitaḥ | mālinyena sadā yuktā dharmācāravivarjitāḥ ||71 || parādhīnā patyadhīnā apatyavaśavartikāḥ | malamūtrakṣālanādāvaśuddhāḥ sarvadā striyaḥ ||72|| aśuddhau tava pūjādi kathaṃ syāttacca me vada | rājasvalye tava pūjā kathaṃ syāttacca me vada ||73|| nārāyaṇastadā prāha sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayānaghe | bhaktānāṃ yoṣitāṃ saukhyapradaṃ mokṣapradaṃ tathā ||74|| bālakṣālanasaktānāṃ saktānāṃ vastrakṣālane | patisevāparāṇāṃ ca sthitānāmṛtudharmake ||75|| gṛhāśuddhyādisaṃskāraśodhanādikakarmasu | prasaktānāṃ na vai nityaṃ śuddhiryasmād vilokyate ||76|| tāsāṃ vai mama bhaktānāṃ yoṣitāṃ tu kṛte mayā | manomūrtirmayā coktā mānase nivasāmyaham ||77|| striyaḥ svabhāvataḥ śuddhā nirmitā brahmaṇā purā | kṣetraṃ vai sarvathā śuddhaṃ tena bhettavyameva na ||78|| śuddhatve’pi nimitteṣvaśuddhakāryeṣu satsvapi | kṛteṣu snānamātreṇa striyaḥ śuddhā bhavanti vai ||79|| yadvā sucitramūrterme darśanaṃ dūrataḥ sadā | yāvadrajasvalādharmastāvaddinacatuṣṭayam ||1.580.80 || kartavyameva nānyattu cānyaccenmānasaṃ caret | tenāhaṃ saṃpratuṣṭo’smi nāryuddhāraparāyaṇaḥ ||81 || dahakāryaṃ sadā śuddhāvaśuddhāvapi sundari | cittaṃ nyasya mayi kuryānmama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ||82|| na sā lipyati doṣeṇa mamānugrahakāraṇāt | śṛṇu lakṣmi tathānyaccaśuddho’haṃ sarvadā prabhuḥ || 83|| na cāśuddhirlaukikī māṃ spṛśatīha kadācana | madyogāddivyatāṃ yānti sarvāścāpi hyaśuddhayaḥ ||84|| kintvācāraprarakṣārthaṃ śuddhyādikaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā | puruṣā vā striyo vāpi na pumāṃso na vā striyaḥ ||85|| indriyāṇi nigṛhyaiva cittaṃ mayyanuveśya ca | mayi sannyāsayogena śuddhyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||86 || mama mūrtau sadā nyastaṃ cittaṃ yena vivekataḥ | yasyāṃ kasyāmavasthāyāṃ puṃsā ṣaṇḍhena vā striyā ||87|| sa ca śuddho bhavatyeva pūjādi svayamācaret | svātantryeṇācaretpūjāmaraṇye nirjane’thavā ||88|| asahāye caretpūjāṃ gaṇayāmi na dūṣaṇam | mano buddhiśca cittaṃ ca ātmādhīnāḥ śarīriṇām ||89|| mayi saṃyujya satpremṇā na vai limpanti mānavāḥ | cittaṃ manaśca buddhiśca matsaṃsthaṃ ca samaṃ yadi ||1.580.90|| yatkiñcitkurvataḥ karma padmapatramivāṃbhasi | saṃyogānna ca lipyeta samatvādeva nānyathā ||91|| bhaktā divāniśaṃ cātra kurvantaḥ karmasaṃkaram | te’pi yānti parāṃ siddhiṃ yadi cittaṃ mayi sthitam | |92|| jāgrataḥ svapato vāpi śṛṇvataḥ paśyato’pi ca | yo māṃ citte cintayati maccittasya tu kiṃ bhayam | |93 || durvṛttamapi cāṇḍālaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vāpi tādṛśam | manmānasaṃ praśaṃsāmi nānyacittaṃ kadācana ||94|| yajantaḥ sarvadharmāṇaṃ māṃ ca jñānena saṃskṛtāḥ | mayi sanyastacittāśca mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ||95|| ye matsevāṃ prakurvanti hṛdi māṃ rakṣayanti ye | te cet svapanti bhuñjanti ramante kāmayantyapi || 96|| pravartante nivartante te sarve lakṣmi me priyāḥ | yataḥ praśāntacittāste mayyeva kṛtaniścayāḥ || 97|| cittanāśo hi lokasya saṃsārasya ca mokṣaṇam | tasmāccittaṃ mayi nyasya māṃ spṛśantu striyaḥ sadā ||98|| maccittaḥ satataṃ yo māṃ bhajeta premapūritaḥ | manṛpārśvaṃ prāpya paramaṃ madbhāvāyopapadyate ||99|| rājasvalye pañcame’hni ṛtudānena śuddhyati | śuddhyarthaṃ ca sutārthaṃ ca dātavyamṛtudānakam || 1.580.1 00 || ṛtukālābhigamanaṃ brahmacaryaṃ mayā kṛtam | evaṃ sthite’pi gacchenna syānnaiṣphalyamṛtostadā || 10 1|| viraktayoḥ kṛte nāyaṃ niyamaḥ saṃgamārthakaḥ | sakāmayoḥ kṛte yogaḥ ṛtau gamaḥ praśasyate || 1 02|| mahābhāgavato bhaktaḥ śuddhiṃ rakṣan yathoditām | mama sevāṃ prakurvīta dāsyabhāvena bhāmini || 1 03|| dāsībhāvena bhaktā ca yā me sevāṃ karoti ca | narā nāryaśca te snigdhā nityaṃ te me hṛdi sthitāḥ || 1 04|| ajñāte rajaso doṣe mama sparśādikaṃ bhavet | tadā snātvā ca māṃ snāpayitvāpi pañcame dine || 1 05|| yadvā cānyaḥ snāpayenmāṃ mālāśataṃ japenmama | rajasvalā kṣamāṃ tatra prārthayed bhagavan prabho || 106 || ajānantyā kṛtaḥ sparśaḥ kṣamyatāṃ karuṇākara | ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ namet praśuddhyati || 1 07|| evaṃ duṣyati no lakṣmi nārī vā puruṣo’pi vā | tataḥ kurvanti karmāṇi te yathāvanmama priyāḥ || 1 08|| parvāṇyanudinaṃ bhadre mama cittānusāriṇaḥ | karmāṇi mama sevāsu kurvantu narayoṣitaḥ || 1 09|| avaśyaṃ tānnayiṣye’haṃ mama lokaṃ parātparam | mātāpitṛsahasrāṇi putradāraśatāni ca || 1.580.11 0|| cakravatparivartante yanmohānmāṃ na jānate | ajñānenāvṛto loko mohena ca vaśīkṛtaḥ || 111 || saṃgaiśca bahubhirbaddhastena māṃ na ca vindati | gacchatyanyatra mātā vai pitā cānyatra gacchati || 1 12|| putrāścānyatra gacchanti pramadānyatra gacchati | jāyate cātmanāṃ sthāne svasvakarmasamudbhave || 11 3|| jñānamūḍhā janā lakṣmi saṃsāre santi mohitāḥ | alpakālaṃ paraṃ matvā baddhyante naśvare’pi ca || 1 14|| bhaviṣyanti punaste tu na me mūrtyā sahāsate | yasyaitadviditaṃ lakṣmi brāhmaṃ jñānaṃ madātmakam ||1 15|| mayi nyasya svamātmānaṃ mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | ya etacchruṇuyānnityaṃ kalyamutthāya mānavaḥ ||1 16|| puṣkalāṃ labhate siddhiṃ mama lokānuyāyinīm | lakṣmirūpāḥ sarvanāryo narā madvad bhavanti ca || 1 17|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne somatīrthe kaṇṭhasya brahmahatyānāśaḥ, jalaśāyitīrthe nalameghadānavanāśaścaturdaśasahasrakanyānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnītvaṃ, candrādityatīrtham, āsamudrāntatīrthāni, śaṃkarasya kailāsagamanam, aśuddhanaranārīṇāṃ mokṣopāyakathanamityādinirūpaṇanāmāśītyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 580 ||
<1.581> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mama mūrtirmanmayī cāhameva sā | etadātmyamidaṃ sarvaṃ mūrtiścāhaṃ pumuttamaḥ || 1 || puruṣottamasaṃjño’haṃ vasāmi puruṣottame | kṣetre vai jagatāṃ nātho divyarūpadharaḥ pumān || 2 || puruṣottamākhyaṃ divyaṃ kṣetraṃ paramapāvanam | yatrāsmi dāravatanuḥ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 3 || jyotiḥprakāśo bhagavān sākṣānnārāyaṇaḥ svayam | lokānāṃ cākṣuṣo bhūtvā divyo’pi dṛśyatāṃ gataḥ || 4 || śrīlakṣmīruvāca kathaṃ dārupratimastvaṃ vartase tatra mādhava | śrotumicchāmi bhagavan lokānāṃ hitakāraṇāt || 5 || kadā kasmāt kathaṃ tatra bhavānāste ca kīdṛśaḥ | kṛpayānugraheṇāpi bhaktāṃ śrāvaya te kathām || 6 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mahāpuṇyapradaṃ rahasyamuttamam | yasya saṃkathanāccāpi kṣīyate cāntaraṃ tamaḥ || 7 || ahaṃ cāsmi jagannāthaḥ sarvabhūtaguhāśayaḥ tathāpyetanmama kṣetraṃ vapurbhūtaṃ ca me param || 8 || svayaṃ vapuṣmām̐statrāsmi mannāmnā khyāpitaṃ mayā | daśayojanavistāra vālukārāmaṇīyakam || 9 || nīlācalena mahatā parvatena virājitam | sṛṣṭvā carācaraṃ brahmā cintayāmāsa vai purā || 1.581.1 0|| dehināṃ mokṣaṇārthaṃ vai viṣṇuṃ stoṣye pareśvaram | ahaṃ tu mama mokṣārthaṃ bhajiṣye puruṣottamam || 11 || vicāryetthaṃ pratuṣṭāvānādiśrīkṛṣṇamacyutam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ || 1 2|| akṣareśāya muktānāmadhipāya namo namaḥ | rādhālakṣmīprabhāhaṃsāmāṇikīśāya te namaḥ || 1 3|| pārvatīśāya saguṇāmaṃjuleśāya te namaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇastvaṃ parabrahma nārāyaṇastvameva ca || 14|| bhūmā viṣṇurmahāviṣṇurvairājastvaṃ pravartase | antaryāmī prakāśaśca gocaro’gocarastathā || 15|| tattvātmakaśca prakṛtivikṛtijñastvameva ca | kośasaṃsyaścāṇusūkṣmo mahīyānmahatāṃ bhavān || 16|| dravyaṃ guṇaśca karma tvaṃ bhāvo’bhāvastvameva ca | māyā ca kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ tvamevāsi namo’stu te || 17|| saṃsāre tvātmalubdhānāṃ sāramātmā tvameva ca | asāraścāpi te dṛṣṭyā sārarūpaḥ prajāyate || 18|| so’haṃ rāgaṃ parityajya bhaviṣye tvāṃ pareśvaram | kimasārasvarūpāṇāṃ tuṣāṇāmavaghātanāt || 1 9|| yatra cānte bhavecchūnyaṃ tannārabheta buddhimān | mayā sṛṣṭiḥ śūnyakāntā kartavyā naiva keśava ||1.581.20|| prasīdādya pramokṣaṃ ca pradehi mama cecchataḥ | evaṃ vai brahmaṇā cāhaṃ stutaḥ śrīgaruḍadhvajaḥ ||21|| caturbhujaḥ koṭisūryaprakāśaḥ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ | āvirāsaṃ vivikṣustaṃ prahasya coktavām̐stataḥ ||22|| kathaṃ brahman jātamātro vairāgyaṃ labdhavānasi | kuru cājñāṃ vaha sṛṣṭiṃ dhyānaṃ mama vidhehi ca ||23|| anādyavidyā sudṛḍhā duśchedyā karmabandhanaiḥ | tvayā pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ karma parameṣṭhitvadāyakam ||24|| vinā bhogaṃ na naśyettannūtanānāṃ prasaṃjakam | tasmin sati kathaṃ sṛṣṭau hriyete mṛtijanmanī ||25|| tathāpi bhaktimārge te yadyasti mānasaṃ dṛḍham | yatra me mānasaṃ cāsti tatra te’stīti dhāraya ||26|| evaṃ matvā hyabhinnaṃ māṃ kuru sarvaṃ mayoditam | hṛdaye’haṃ tava brahman pratiṣṭhāmi ca sarvadā ||27|| nirdiśāmi mama karma tathā kuru hṛdoditam | sāgarasyottare tīre mahānadyāstu dakṣiṇe ||28|| sarvatīrthaphalade tvaṃ pradeśe yāhi vai kṣitau | tatra janmāyutalabdhapuṇyapuñjāstu mānavāḥ ||29|| prapadyante nivāsaṃ vai nābhaktā nālpapuṇyakāḥ | ekāmrakānanād yāvad dakṣiṇodadhitīrabhūḥ ||1.581.30|| padātpadātparo divyaḥ pradeśo vartate mama | tatra matkaṇṭhasaṃsthaśca maṇirnīlamasaṃjñitaḥ ||3 1|| samuttārya mayā saṃsthāpitaḥ sa nīlaparvataḥ | brahmovāca tadā śrutvā kathaṃ nīlamaṇistadā ||32|| tvayā saṃsthāpitastatra vada me kāraṇaṃ prabho | hariḥ prāha śṛṇu brahman purā tu madhukaiṭabhau | |33|| brahmāṇḍanāśakau daityo mayā cakreṇa nāśitau | mama bhaktau mayā sārdhaṃ yuddhamugraṃ pracakratuḥ ||34|| gadayā tūgrayā māṃ ca tāḍayāmāsaturhṛdi | mayā dhṛto maṇiśreṣṭho hṛdayādapahāya saḥ ||35|| yāvadyuddhamabhūt tāvat tatpradeśe nidhāpitaḥ | tatra bhaktā mama cogrā pṛthvī bhītā sthitābhavat ||36|| kanyakā trāsamāpannā maṇyādhārā pratiṣṭhati | rakṣitānena maṇinā pratīkṣate mamāgamam ||37|| hatvā daityau tadā cāhamagamaṃ netumeva tam | tadā tu kanyayā pṛthvyā stuto’haṃ parameśvaraḥ ||38|| tvaṃ rakṣākārakaścāsi pātā dhātāsi me prabho | pṛthvīpatistvamevāsi prāṇado’si mama prabho ||39|| sadaiva rakṣa māṃ svāminnārāyaṇa hare prabho | pāpanāśaṃ ca me bhāraṃ nāśaya tvaṃ hare prabho ||1.581.40|| ityukto’hamavocaṃ tāṃ varaṃ brūhi dadāmi te | sāha nīlamaṇiṃ cātra sadā rakṣitumarhasi ||41|| yena muktirbhaved dehipāpanāśena cātra vai | mama rakṣā bhaveccāpi kṛṣṇābhūṣaṇadhāraṇāt ||42 || śrutvaivaṃ bhagavām̐ścāha tāmuktavām̐stathāstviti | bhūṣārūpo maṇiścāyaṃ nīlo mayā samarpitaḥ ||43|| pṛthvyā dhṛtaḥ sa vai kaṇṭhe nityaṃ dhārayati dhruvam | kaṇṭhātmakaṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣottamātmakam ||44|| punaścāhaṃ yadā tasmātsthānājjigamiṣustadā | punaḥ sā prārthayāmāsa tvayāgantavyamatra ca ||45|| stheyaṃ cātra maduddhārapareṇa prabhuṇā sadā | tathāstviti mayā coktaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ gatavānaham ||46|| tatrājñā ca tadā prāptā mayākṣarapateḥ prabhoḥ | nīlaparvatabhūmau vai samicchāmi pumuttamaḥ ||47|| puruṣottamasaṃjño’haṃ vāsaṃ bhaktakṛpāvaśaḥ | evaṃ vai bhagavām̐statrānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |||48|| svayaṃ vasati sarvātmā puruṣottamabhūtale | sindhutīre rājate sa nīlādrirdyotayan diśaḥ ||49| | pṛthivyāṃ gopitaṃ sthānaṃ tava cāviditaṃ śubhe | surāsurāṇāṃ durjñeyaṃ māyayā chāditaṃ mama ||1.581.50|| sarvaiśvaryasamāyuktastatra tiṣṭhāmi dehavān | kṣarākṣarāvatikramya varte’haṃ puruṣottame ||51 || layena na samākrāntaṃ kṣetraṃ me puruṣottamam | yathāhaṃ cāsmi me dhāmni sarvāyudhadharaḥ pumān ||52|| pārameśvaracihnāḍhyastatra māṃ drakṣyase tathā | tatra nīlācalabhūmau kalpavaṭasya mūlake ||53|| rauhiṇākhyakuṇḍataṭe vasantaṃ drakṣyase tu mām | tatra yāhi prakāśaṃ māṃ dhyāyataste hi yāsyate | |54|| ityādiśya ca brahmāṇaṃ tataḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | paśyato brahmaṇastasya tatraivāntaradhīyata | |55|| brahmā cābhyāyayau tatra yatrāste puruṣottamaḥ | adrākṣīttaṃ tathārūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ||56|| pratyabhijñānasaṃhṛṣṭo babhūva jñānasāgaraḥ | neme tuṣṭāva ca brahmā tadā śrīpuruṣottamam ||57| | tāvattatra vāyasastu kaścid vyomnaḥ samāyayau | jalaṃ pātuṃ papātaiva kuṇḍe mamajja daivataḥ | |58|| kuṇḍāttu brahmaṇā tena bahirniṣkāsitaśca saḥ | pṛthvyāṃ luṇṭhan vilokyāpi nīlakāntiṃ pareśvaram | |59|| kākadehaṃ parityajya śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ | divyadeho babhūvātra kṛṣṇapārśve vyavasthitaḥ ||1.581.60|| kākasya tu gatiṃ divyāṃ dṛṣṭvā yogīndradurlabhām | brahmāścaryaṃ jagāmātha cintayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ||6 1 || aho kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ vināpi sādhanaṃ gataḥ | tāmaso’pi nikṛṣṭo’pi caturbhujatvamāptavān ||62|| manuṣyo’dhikṛto muktau khago’pi muktimāpa ha | na kiṃcid durlabhaṃ tatra yatra śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | |63| | pātrāpātre na vai tatra yatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | purāṇapuruṣo yatra nāmnā saṃkīrtyate janaiḥ ||64| | tacchrotāro’pi vai muktiṃ yānti draṣṭustu kā kathā | dhyātuḥ sevayituścāpi muktistatra karaṃgatā ||65|| sākṣātkṛto hi bhagavān datte bhaktāya muktikām | puruṣottamasaṃjñakasya mahimā cādbhuto’sti yat ||66 || yatra kāko’pi tu hariṃ sākṣātprāptaścaturbhujaḥ | kiṃ punaḥ satataṃ kṛṣṇadhyānayogaparāyaṇāḥ ||67|| tatra nīle divyaśaile puruṣottamakṣetrake | api kīṭapataṃgādyā muktiṃ prayānti sarvaśaḥ ||68|| tad dṛṣṭvā yamarājo vai tūrṇaṃ tatra samāgataḥ | brahmā dadarśa taṃ vaivasvataṃ dharmaṃ hatāśakam ||69|| niḥśvasantaṃ ca dīnaṃ ca svādhikāranirarthakam | yamarājāpi nīlādrau śrīhariṃ praṇipatya ca ||1.581.70|| tuṣṭāva śrījagannāthaṃ svādhikāradṛḍhasthitau | namaste caikatattvāya dvaitāyānantakāya ca ||7 1 || svaprotasarvarūpāya dhṛtipuṣṭikarāya ca | sarvābhāsādhidevāya namaste sarvayonaye ||72|| viśvāsāya gurave sākṣiṇe te namonamaḥ | kāruṇyasindhave tubhyaṃ parātītāya te namaḥ ||73|| janmamṛtyuprahartre te namo’stu dīnabandhave | māyādhiṣṭhātrātmane te pītakauśeyavāsase ||74|| māyācakrakartanāya cakriṇe te namonamaḥ | daṇḍadātre’dhikartre te parameśāya vai namaḥ ||75|| nīlameghasuvapuṣe nīlādrivāsitāya ca | namaste puṇḍarīkākṣiśobhitāya gadābhṛte || 76|| śrīvatsakaustubhaśobhābhāsatsamūḍhavakṣase | nīlavarṇaṃ nīlaśailaguhāvāsaṃ kṛpālayam ||77|| āśritānāṃ tu duḥkhaghnaṃ praṇamāmi parātparam | yatpādayorāśraye saṃllubdhā śrīranapāyinī ||78|| vartate śāśvatī lakṣmīrbhaktaiśvaryapradāyinī | yā prakṛtiḥ parādhīnā pareśa tava vāñcchayā ||79|| tvāmāvṛttya vikāsaṃ samprayāti bandhamuktaye | bhuktabhogāya cārpayati nirvāṇatāṃ tvadicchayā ||1.581.80|| tvameva tu parabrahma brahmarūpeṇa vartase | bhūmarūpeṇa ca vyūharūpeṇa vartase tathā ||81 || yamarūpeṇa ca rudrarūpeṇa vartase vibho | lakṣmīnārāyaṇa viṣṇo kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho |||82 || kāmbhareyamahārāja kṛpālo te namo muhuḥ | prabhānārāyaṇa pārvatīśanārāyaṇa prabho | haṃsanārāyaṇa maṃjūnārāyaṇa namo’stu te ||8 3|| saguṇeśa tava patnīṃ duḥkhahartrīṃ namāmyaham | putracintāvārayitrīṃ dhārayitrīṃ namāmyaham ||84|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau yamastāvattu padmajā | dharmastavapratuṣṭena nārāyaṇena deśitā | kṛpāmayī svayaṃ bhūtvā lakṣmīrdharmamuvāca ha ||85|| yamarāja yadarthaṃ tvaṃ saṃstauṣi tattu durlabham | kṣetraṃ caitacchrīharervai puruṣottamaśārṅgiṇaḥ ||86 || sarveṣāṃ mokṣadaṃ cāsti yāmyaṃ paśyanti naiva te | darśakāścāsya tīrthasya na yāsyanti yamālayam ||87|| atyājyaṃ ca tathā kṣetramāvayoḥ puruṣottamam | brahmādisarvapālānāṃ svāmitvaṃ nātra śasyate ||88|| neha karmaparipākā dehināṃ saṃbhavanti hi | atra vāsena kīṭānāmapi karma suduṣkṛtam ||89|| vilayaṃ yāti māhātmyātpuruṣottamapādayoḥ | karmapāśaprabaddhānāṃ bandhanaṃ nātra vidyate || 1.581.90 || duṣkarmiṇāṃ daṇḍadātā tvaṃ yamo vihito’si yat | puruṣottamabhūvāsidehināṃ tvaṃ na śāsakaḥ || 91 || atra śrīmān parabrahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam | svāmī me rājate sākṣānnīlādrikṛtaketanaḥ ||92 || dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ taṃ vai mucyante pāpino yataḥ | tava daṇḍo na vai teṣu tvanyatra tvaṃ prabhuryama ||93 || mā samiccha jagannāthāśritānāṃ śāsanaṃ yama | brahmāpyayaṃ vāyasasya muktiṃ vīkṣya smayaṃ gataḥ || 94|| garvaṃ jahau hi karmotthadehisaṃsārasaṃbhavam| tvaṃ cāpi ca tathā garvaṃ parityajya praśādhi tān ||95|| puruṣottamatīrthātiriktasthān sarvadehinaḥ | atra sthitā na te’dhīnā mama svāmivaśā hi te ||96|| atra vasanta evaite jīvanmuktāścaturbhujāḥ | tasmātteṣāṃ tava hastagatatvaṃ naiva naiva tu ||97|| yāhi kuru manaḥsvāsthyamadhikāraṃ nirvartaya | etadvāsasvahastānāgatatvaṃ mā śuco yama ||98|| evaṃ lakṣmīsvarūpeṇa viṣṇunā bodhito yamaḥ | khidan lakṣmīṃ punarnatvā smṛtvā hariṃ jagāda tām ||99|| mātaryatra bhavecchrīmānanādiśrīnarāyaṇaḥ | tatkṣetrasya mahimānaṃ nāśṛṇavaṃ purā hyaham || 1.581.10 0|| abhāgyahatadevo’haṃ kathaṃ vedmi harerbalam | parameśvaravāñcchā vai niraṅkuśā pravartate || 101 || anyatra bandhadā saiva yātra mokṣapradaiva sā | etatkṣetraṃ kiyaddīrghaṃ yajjīvā na mamaspṛśāḥ || 1 02|| etatkṣetrasthiteḥ kīdṛk phalaṃ tadapi me vada | yenāhaṃ samanujñāya vicarāmi pṛthakpadam || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śrīpuruṣottamakṣetre nīlamaṇirūpanīlaparvatakathā, rauhiṇakuṇḍataṭe śrīpuruṣottamamūrtiḥ kākasya vedhasaḥ paśyato muktiḥ, yamarājasya tatrāgamanaṃ, lakṣmīkṛtanīlasthalīyajīvānāṃ yamadūtāsparśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikāśītyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 581 ||
<1.582> śrīlakṣmīruvāca yamarāja śṛṇu tattvaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ hitakaraṃ tava | kṣetraṃ phalaṃ ca kathaye tathānyanmokṣadaṃ śubham ||1 || yathāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapārśvagatā purā | āsaṃ tataśca pralaye tadvakṣaḥsthalamāsthitā || 2 || dadṛśe ca jagatyasmin pralīne mama sarvathā | ahaṃ caitat sukṣetraṃ ca puruṣottamasaṃjñakam || 3 || dvayaṃ tvāsīd divyarūpaṃ tadā mārkaṇḍako muniḥ | saptakalpāyurevātra nimagno pralayārṇave || 4 || jalārṇave bhramamāṇaḥ puruṣottamakṣetrake | puruṣottamarūpe sa nīlādrestu samāśraye || 5 || sāmudre sutaṭe kṣetre divyaṃ vaṭaṃ samaikṣata | tatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dadarśa sūjjvalam || 6 || hasantaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ ca śoḍaśābdaṃ caturbhujam | yasya vakṣasi kṣetraṃ tat kṣetre taṃ cāpi miśritam || 7 || vadantaṃ kiṃ jale snāsi mārkaṇḍeya sthiro bhava | ehi cātra vaṭacchāyāsthale pārśve mamāntikam || 8 || tacchrutvā vismayaṃ lebhe dṛṣṭvā kṣetraṃ vaṭaṃ harim | vāribhiḥ klidyate naitad dahyate na ca vahninā || 9 || saṃvartakādibhiścaitacchośuṣyate na cālyate | ekārṇave yathā nauśca kṣetraṃ tathā hi dṛśyate || 1.582.10 || īkṣyate ca vaṭo divyo viśāla īśitustanuḥ | mahāpralayavātena patraṃ tvasya na kampate || 11 || tatrāyaṃ bhagavānāste nyagrodhe pralaye’pi ca | kathaṃ bhuvaḥ pradeśo’yaṃ pralaye’pi sthiro’sti vai || 12|| cintayanniti munirāṭa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prati | yayau māṃ tasya vakṣasthāṃ dṛṣṭvā svaṃ prajagāma ha || 1 3|| namo namaste puruṣottamāya lakṣmīdvitīyāya namo namaste | jalārṇave me’kṣisugocarāyanyagrodhavāsāya namo namaste || 14|| divyādhivāsāya jagannivāsakṛte’travāsāya namo namaste | laye kṛpāleśasamanvitāya nimagnatārāya muhurnamo’stu || 15|| paraṃ padaṃ cākṣaradhāma cāmṛtaṃ vaikuṇṭhagolokahiraṇmayādikam | sarvaṃ bhavān yatra kṛtāśrayo bhuvi divyaṃ na caitatpralayo’pi khādati || 16|| sarvatragaṃ śrīpuruṣottamasthaṃ bṛhatsvarūpaṃ vaṭarūpasaṃsthitam | māyāparaṃ brahmaparaṃ layotthaṃ layasthitaṃ tvāṃ praṇamāmi viṣṇum || 17|| ekārṇave jagatyatra keyaṃ bhūḥ pārameśvarī | yatra sākṣāt trāṇakartā rājase matkṛpākaraḥ || 18|| trāhi viṣṇo jagannātha ghorātsaṃsārasāgarāt | na tvaṃ pṛthag yathākāle mārkaṇḍeyād vilokyase || 19|| yathā lakṣmīstathā cāyaṃ mārkaṇḍeyastavānugaḥ | kathaṃ māṃ tyaktavānāste bhavān bhavārṇave laye || 1.582.20 || māṃ gṛhāṇa prabho tvatra dehi vāsaṃ vaṭāśraye | tava sevāṃ kariṣye’tra śāśvatīṃ cānapāyinīm ||2 1 || ityukto bhagavānāha samāgaccha mune iha | tiṣṭha cātra vaṭe lakṣmyā sākaṃ sārdhaṃ mayā tathā || 22|| prātaḥ sarvā mama sṛṣṭīḥ punaḥ pūrvāḥ pradrakṣyasi | mayā te darśitaṃ kṣetraṃ divyaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam || 23 || kuru parṇapraśālāṃ saṃvasātra vaṭamaṇḍale | ahaṃ tava nimittena vasāmyatra yataḥ sthiraḥ |||24||| mārkaṇḍeyena muninā śrutvājñāṃ pārameśvarīm | kṛtā vaṭajaṭājūṭe parṇaśālā śubhā tadā ||25|| viveśa cāntastāvat sa dadarśāntarhariṃ sthitam | tanmūrtau sa pralīnaśca dadarśāṇḍāni koṭiśaḥ ||26|| atrāṇḍe dadṛśe vipro bhuvanāni caturdaśa | brahmaviṣṇumaheśādīn dikpālān lokarakṣakān ||27|| siddhagandharvadaityāṃśca rākṣasān suramānavān | nāgān pitṝm̐śca śailām̐śca sāgarān saṃstarām̐stathā ||28|| jagatāṃ dhāriṇaṃ śeṣaṃ sahasraphaṇaśobhitam | śeṣādhāraṃ kacchapaṃ ca jalaṃ tejo dadarśa ca || 29|| vāyuṃ vyoma mahākāśottaraṃ sarvaṃ dadarśa ca | cidākāśe ca golokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ sa dadarśa ha ||1.582.3 0|| atha divyaprakāśaṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāma dadarśa saḥ | yatrāste śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo lakṣmīpatiḥ svayam ||3 1 || tatra vaṭaṃ dadarśātha parṇaśālāṃ svanirmitām | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tatra dadarśa saḥ ||32|| nijaṃ mṛkaṇḍatanayaṃ kṣetraṃ ca puruṣottamam | divyābdhiṃ nīlaśailaṃ ca dadarśa munirāṭ param ||33|| tato drāgeva bhagavadvāñacchayā tu kṣaṇāntare | punarmayābhisaṃkocaṃ gamitaścāntare tadā ||34|| harau svaṃ parṇaśālāyāṃ hṛdi lakṣmīyutaṃ prabhum | śrīhariṃ pūrvavad vīkṣya paramaṃ vismayaṃ gataḥ ||35|| tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamam | parameśa mameṣṭo’si kimāścaryaṃ pradarśitam ||36|| tvayā cātra sthale kasmād vada me śrīhare prabho | bhagavām̐staṃ tadā prāha puruṣottamabhūtalam ||37|| mama dhāmaiva bhūmo vai mayā saṃsthāpitaṃ sadā | divyaṃ dvitīyarūpaṃ tat savaṭaṃ puruṣottamam ||38|| mandiraṃ parṇaśāleyaṃ rājate sādhuvāsinī | tvaṃ me tvakṣaradhāmāsi mārkaṇḍeyo’paraḥ pumān ||39|| nityatvaṃ cāsya dhāmno me darśitaṃ te kṣitāvapi | puruṣottamasaṃjñaṃ vai kṣetraṃ dhāma mamāsti tat ||1.582.40 || tasmāt kṣetramidaṃ ramyaṃ śāśvataṃ me vibhāvaya | na sṛṣṭipralayāvatra vidyete na ca saṃsṛtiḥ ||41 || nityaṃ pumuttamaṃ cātra māṃ jñātvā puruṣottamam | kṣetraṃ viśati śuddhātmā sa yāti mama dhāma vai ||42||| nāsya janma punarbhāvi sāndre sukhe gato yataḥ | śrutvaivaṃ mṛkaṇḍatanayastatra vāsamarocayat ||43 || prahṛṣṭahṛdayaḥ prāha śraddhābhaktiprapūritaḥ | anugṛhṇīṣva bhagavan kṣetre’smin puruṣottame ||44|| yathā sthito mṛtyuvaśaṃ na vraje puruṣottama | tava dhāmni śāśvate te sukhe magno bhavāmi yat ||45|| yamarāja tadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśca taṃ munim | provācāhaṃ tvayā sākaṃ lakṣmyā sākaṃ vasāmi ca ||46|| nivatsyāmi na sandeho lokakalyāṇahetave | yāvadābhūtanāśaṃ ca punaśca pralaye’pi ca ||47|| pralayānte punaḥ sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭyante’pi vasāmi ca | nivatsyāmi sadā cātra vasa tvaṃ parṇapattane ||48|| atra vai parṇanagarī prasiddhā sā bhaviṣyati | puruṣottamapuryākhyā jagannāthapurī tathā ||49|| kalpe kalpe nāmakhyātiṃ gamiṣyati nivatsyati | tvaṃ ca mṛtyuharo bhūtvā sthāsyasyatra na saṃśayaḥ ||1.582.50 || ityuktvāntardadhe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagatpatiḥ | mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmunistatrāvāsamarocayat ||51 || vaṭavāyavyakoṇe ca gartamāsthāya pāvanam | taptena tapasā mṛtyuṃ jitavān cākṣaraḥ svayam ||52|| mārkaṇḍeyāśramastatra vartate pāvano yataḥ | pañcakrośamidaṃ kṣetraṃ samudrāntarvyavasthitam ||53|| abdhitīre dvikrośaṃ ca militvā krośasaptakam | nīlaparvataśobhāḍhyaṃ svarṇavālukasaṃstṛtam ||54||| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavāsāśritaṃ param | sarvatīrthaḥ samudro’pi tīrtharājatvamāptavān ||55 || tattīre bhagavān lakṣmīrvirājaṃte yameśvara | sāhaṃ ca kambharādevī brahmānandapariplutā ||56|| yā vai kuṃkumavāpyāṃ ca saurāṣṭre’pi virājate | gajānanā camatkāre kāśyāṃ sā kārṣṇavāllabhī ||57|| jayā sā tvakṣare dhāmni goloke rādhikā hi sā | vaikuṇṭhe sā ramā hiraṇyaye prabhā vinodinī ||58|| śvetākhye māṇikī lakṣmīḥ kailāse pārvatī ca sā | satye haṃsā maṃjulā mervadrau bhvāṃ saguṇā priyā ||59|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnyaḥ saha sthitāḥ | pūrvasmin śrījagannāthaḥ paścime dvārikādhipaḥ ||1.582.6 0 || uttare tu naranārāyaṇo dakṣe janārdanaḥ | svāmino me svarūpāṇi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ||61 || jagannāthe tvahaṃ lakṣmīrdvārikeśe prabheśvarī | nārāyaṇe māṇikī ca janārdane tu pārvatī ||62|| sarveṣāmādikalpe’tra babhūvāhaṃ pativratā | kalpāntare tathā prāvirbhāvāntare’pi sāpyaham ||63|| anekanāmarūpāḍhyā bhavāmi kṛṣṇavāñcchayā | svābhīṣṭaṃ mama dharmaḥ sa pātivratyaṃ tathā mama ||64|| bahūni mama nāmāni rūpāṇi ca vibhūtayaḥ | avatāriṇya evāpi bhaviṣyanti striyo hareḥ ||65|| lakṣārbudāni vai nāryo mama patyurbhavanti vai | apraskhalitavīryasyākhaṇḍitabrahmacāriṇaḥ ||66|| avyayasattvayuktasya saṃkhyāvarjyāḥ striyo hareḥ | tasyāprameyakāntasya kṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||67|| śaṃkhākāraṃ pūrvapaścaṃ paścime vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | pūrve śaṃkhamukhe nīlakaṇṭho devo virājate ||68|| śaṃkhasyodarabhāgastu samudrodakasaṃplutaḥ | abdhikulīnamārabhya divyanyagrodhakāvadhim ||6 9|| dṛśyate bhagavām̐statra bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ | yasyāyaṃ bhagavān dṛṣṭipathaṃ yāti sa muktibhāg ||1.582.70|| maraṇānmama dhāmasthaḥ snānātsvargagatastathā | smaraṇātpātakairhīno jāyate mānavo’sya vai ||71|| nābhideśe tu śaṃkhasya sthitāḥ kuṇḍo vaṭo hariḥ | vimalā tu mahāśaktirvartate tatra muktidā ||72|| pralayasya bhakṣayitrī mahāpralayarodhinī | tāṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamed yaḥ sa bhogānaśnāti śāśvatān ||73|| vaṭābdhimadhyamaṃ kṣetraṃ kīṭāderapi muktidam | antarvedī bhāgavataḥ kṣetraṃ madhyagataṃ hi sā ||74|| tasyāṃ sthitā bhavantyeva śaṃkhacakrābjadhāriṇaḥ | sārdhatrikoṭisaṃkhyānāṃ tīrthānāṃ puruṣottamaḥ ||75|| rājā vai muktido yasmāt tīrtharājo’yamucyate | rohiṇākhye divyakuṇḍe kāruṇyākhye jale janāḥ ||76|| ye snāsyanti narā nāryaste syurnārāyaṇā dhruvam | tasmād yameśa te cintā māstvetasya sthalasya vai ||77|| mokṣādhikāriṇāmatra neśvarastvaṃ paretarāṭ | evamādiśya dharmeśaṃ lakṣmīrbrahmāṇamāha ca ||78|| kāmākhyaḥ kṣetrapālo’tra sadā nārāyaṇājñayā | vartate tapasā yukto bhajate śrīnarāyaṇam ||7 9|| nṛsiṃho’yaṃ ca bhagavān dakṣiṇe vartate hareḥ | nṛhareḥ sannidhau prāṇatyāge mokṣo bhaved dhruvaḥ ||1.582.8 0 || darśanādapi nṛharerbhuktimuktī karaṃgate | dānaṃ japādikaṃ cātra koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet ||8 1 || nṛsiṃhaśca vaṭaścaitāvubhau nārāyaṇau yataḥ | tacchāyā mokṣadā tasyāmavidyā nāśameti ca ||82 || vārāṇasyāmavimukte mumukṣoḥ karṇamūlake | śaṃbhurdiśati bodhasyopāyāṃ mantraṃ tataḥ param ||83|| samabhyasya kramānmokṣo jñāna tasya bhaved yadi | atra tu prāṇahānau tatkṣaṇaṃ eva tu mokṣaṇam ||84 || sārūpyaṃ labhate yo’pi ko’pi vijñānamantarā | snāyādabdhidṛśā kṛṣṇacchāyāyāṃ vaṭavṛkṣake ||85|| kṣetre dhūlyābdhivārbhiryastanmuktirmaraṇe’tra vā | antarvedīrakṣaṇārthaṃ śaktayo’ṣṭau mayā kṛtāḥ ||86|| maṃgalā vaṭamūle tu paścime vimalāsti ca | śaṃkhasya pṛṣṭhabhāge tu saṃsthitā sarvamaṃgalā ||87|| uttare lambikā dakṣe kālarātriśca saṃsthitā | kālarātryā pṛṣṭhabhāge caṇḍarūpā vyavasthitā ||88|| pūrve marīcikā tvāste vaiṣṇavyo nāthadāsikāḥ | aṣṭānāṃ darśanātpāpadhvaṃso’śvamedhajaṃ phalam ||89|| atha bhaktaśca rudro’pi mahābhāgavataḥ prabhuḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||1.582.90 || mantraṃ japan bhavam̐ścātrāṣṭadhopāste pumuttamam | ārādhya tapasā kṛṣṇaṃ prārthayad varamuttamam ||9 1 || yatra tvaṃ nātha tatrāhaṃ vaseyaṃ tvāṃ bhajan sadā | tvāmṛte kamalākānta nānyannirvāṇakāraṇam ||92 || antaryāmī prabhurme tvaṃ tvāṃ vinā vigrahaḥ kutaḥ | nirmalāmbarasaṃkāśaṃ tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||93 || ityuktau bhagavān kṛṣṇo bhaktaṃ rudraṃ vinirmame | kṣetrapāleśvaraṃ tatrāṣṭadhā bhaktottamottamam ||94|| kapālamocaneśaṃ ca kṣetrapeśaṃ yameśvaram | mārkaṇḍeśaṃ tatheśānaṃ bilveśaṃ nīlakaṇṭhakam ||95|| vaṭeśaṃ ceti tānaṣṭau sthāpayāmāsa mādhavaḥ | etān dṛṣṭvā tathā spṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā vimucyate ||96|| atra kṣetre mṛtānāṃ taddhetoryamo na śāsakaḥ | tadarthaṃ tvāgataścettvaṃ tadanyatra prasādhaya ||97|| sudarśanaṃ hareścakraṃ māyāyāḥ kartanaṃ param | nātra māyā bhaved yena dehī tvaddhastago bhavet ||98|| ityukto yamarājastu bhagavantaṃ prapūjya ca | lakṣmīṃ natvā yayau yāmyālayaṃ tuṣṭo hariṃ bhajan | |99|| śrīruvāca tataścājaṃ parameṣṭhipadasthitam | indradyumno mahārājo yajñāhartā suvaiṣṇavaḥ || 1.582.100 || bhaviṣyatyacireṇaiva satyayuge sa bhaktagaṭ | atrāgatya mahābhaktiṃ kariṣyati divāniśam || 101 || bhagavatprītaye tvatra vājimedhasahasrakam | kariṣyati tathā brahmam̐stava prītyarthamityapi || 10 2|| tadā kṛpālurbhagavān tadanugrahakāraṇāt | ekadārusamutpannaścaturdhā saṃbhaviṣyati || 1 03|| dāravīpratimā viśvakarmā praghaṭṭayiṣyati | pratiṣṭhāpayitā tvaṃ ca indradyumnaprasāditaḥ || 1 04|| bhaviṣyasi tadā brahmannatra śrīpuruṣottame | asmādṛśyaḥ pratimāstā nāṇumātramapi prabho || 1 05|| visadṛśya iti tāśca tvaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayiṣyasi | gacchedānīṃ satyalokaṃ brahman kṣetraṃ pumuttamam || 1 06|| punaścāyāhi ca mayā devenāpi smṛto yadā | ityukto viśvasṛṭ satyaṃ yayau lokaṃ prapūjya tau || 1 07|| nārāyaṇo’pi bhagavān lakṣmīṃ prāha dayānidhiḥ | evameva tvaduktaṃ vai sarvamatra bhaviṣyati || 1 08|| carmacakṣuṣmatāṃ kāṣṭharūpaṃ bhāsiṣyate mama | divyacakṣuṣmatāṃ divyo bhāsiṣye ca tvayā saha || 1 09|| nīlācalaguhāntaḥstho nīlajīmūtasannibhaḥ | bibhrad dārumayaṃ varṣma śaṃkhacakragadādimān || 1.582.11 0|| saṃkarṣaṇo mayā sākaṃ subhadrā tvaṃ mamāntike | sudarśanaṃ tathā cakraṃ nivatsyanti mayā saha || 111 || bahavo hyavatārā me divyā jaḍāśca mānuṣāḥ | tiryañco jalajātāśca teṣāṃ divyāḥ kriyottamāḥ || 11 2|| tadvadatra dārumayo me’vatāro mato mama | dyati saṃsāraduḥkhāni dadāti sukhamavyayam || 113 || tasmād dārumayaścāhaṃ parabrahma vasāmi ca | nahi kāṣṭhamayī mokṣaṃ dadāti pratimā kvacit || 1 14|| kṛtenākṛtatā lakṣmi kadācinnopalabhyate | akṛto hyapavargaḥ sa kṛtādvā dārutaḥ katham || 1 15|| adhiṣṭhānaṃ vinā brāhmyamaiśvaryaṃ na prakāśate | adhiṣṭhānaṃ pratimānaṃ mama nārāyaṇasya tat || 1 16|| alaukikamapi kṛtvā laukikaṃ tatra vartaye | kutra śrutaṃ ca vā dṛṣṭaṃ pratimā vyāharediti || 1 17|| indradyumnāya sa varaṃ dadau kāṣṭhavapurdharaḥ | dīnānāthaikaśaraṇaṃ taraṇaṃ bhavavāridheḥ || 118 || mokṣaṇaṃ sarvapāpānāṃ nīlādriśaraṇaṃ harim | māmeva śaraṇaṃ lakṣmi ye tvāyāsyanti mānavāḥ || 11 9|| teṣāṃ doṣānanālakṣya hyaparādhaśatānyapi | kṣamiṣye svalpabhaktyāpi divyadāruvapurdharaḥ || 1.582.1 20|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau vaṭe śrībhagavān svayam | lakṣmyā sākaṃ nijaṃ rūpaṃ dhyāyan nīlādrimaṇḍale || 121 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mārkaṇḍeyāya śrīpuruṣottamakṣetrasya śāśvatikatāpradarśanaṃ tatkṣetrapramāṇaṃ śaṃbhoraṣṭarūpaiḥ pārvatyāścāṣṭarūpaiḥ kṣetrapālatvādi, vaṭasya divyatā, indradyumnena bhāvimūrtipratiṣṭhāpanādi, cetinirūpaṇanāmā dvyaśītyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 582 ||
<1.583> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha te’tra camatkāraṃ kathayāmi śṛṇu priye | mūrtirūpo’smyahaṃ divyo mokṣadaḥ sukhadaḥ śubhaḥ || 1 || yathā pṛthvyāditattvāni jīvātmano hi mūrtayaḥ | amūrtasya gṛhaṃ mūrtaṃ tathā me pratimā gṛham || 2 || ekatattvātmakaṃ cātmasvarūpaṃ carmacakṣuṣā | vīkṣyate na tataścāhaṃ mūrtyātmā dṛśyatāṃ gataḥ || 3 || pṛthvīśarīrakaścāhaṃ vāriśarīrakastathā | tejaśarīrakaścāpi vāyuśarīrakastathā || 4 || ākāśamūrtikaścāhaṃ tanmātrāmūrtikastathā | manobuddhyādiśarīraścātmeśvaraśarīrakaḥ || 5 || brahmaśarīrakaścāhaṃ muktaśarīrakastathā | sarvaśarīrakaścāhaṃ sarvaṃ divyaṃ madāśrayāt || 6 || divyatve vedamantrādikarmakāṇḍaḥ prayojakaḥ | pratiṣṭhā kāraṇaṃ tatra mukhyaṃ mama praveśane || 7 || tato’haṃ taccharīreṇa sarvaṃ karomi dehivat | yadyevaṃ māṃ vijānīyānmukto bhavati macchritaḥ || 8 || niśceṣṭo dāruvarṣmāpi divyalīlāvilāsakṛt | kṣame’haṃ svalpabhaktyāpi bhaktāparādhakoṭikam || 9 || kurukṣetre purā tvāstāṃ brāhmaṇakṣatriyāvubhau | sakhāyau dharmahīnau ca vṛttacyutau vimohitau || 10 || paṇyayoṣitsahavāsau svadhāsvāhāvivarjitau | pāralaukikacintā tu tayoḥ svapne’pi nāgatā || 11 || ekadā tu kurukṣetre viṣṇuyāgo vyavartata | agacchatāṃ yajñavāṭamapaśyatāṃ kriyāvidhim || 12 || śṛṇvānau vaidikān mantrān pāpaṃ tayornyavartata | dharme matistayorjātā puṇḍarīkāmbarīṣayoḥ || 13 || viveko’pi samudbhūtastarituṃ vai bhavārṇavam | kṛtapāpaprapuñjānāṃ kṣālanārthaṃ ca bhūsurān || 14|| apṛcchatāmabhivādya vijñāpya kalmaṣaṃ nijam | surāmiṣavyavāyādi cauryaṃ nāryādihiṃsanam | | 15 | | tacchrutvā vaiṣṇavaśreṣṭho mahābhāgavato dvijaḥ | divyakriyāparaścaitāvuvāca bhaktisaṃbhṛtam | | 16 | | bho dvija kṣatradāyāda pāparāśeḥ sudāruṇāt | muktiṃ ced vāñcchatastūrṇaṃ gacchataṃ puruṣottamam || 17 || kṣetrottamaṃ dārumayo yatrāste puruṣottamaḥ | tamārādhya jagannāthaṃ lakṣmīrādhāprabhāpatim | | 18 || pāpakṣayaṃ tathā muktiṃ prayasyathākṣare pade | tanmā vilambaṃ kuruta prayātaṃ tatra satvaram | | 19 || utkale nīlaśaile ca vāridheḥ sannidhau taṭe | ityuktau tau ṛṣīnnatvā yayatuḥ puruṣottamam | | 1.583.20 | | dhyāyantau manasā viṣṇuṃ śuddhāhāravratāvubhau | gatvā snātvā sarvatīrthāśrayābdhau mandiraṃ prati | | 21 || dvāri kṛtvā daṇḍavacca tiṣṭhantau darśanecchayā | bhagavantaṃ nirīkṣantau nāpaśyatāṃ yadā hi tau || 22 | | nirāśau tu tadā bhūtvārabhete’naśanaṃ vratam | kīrtayantau harernāmābhavatāṃ līnamānasau | | 23 | | atha tṛtīyarātrau tau jyotirekamapaśyatām | punarlayaṃ gataṃ jyotistau copavasatāṃ sthirau | | 24|| madhye saptamarātreśca tau śrīharimapaśyatām | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam || 25 || caturbhujaṃ sāyudhaṃ ca ratnāḍhyapādukāsthitam | kamalākṣaṃ hāsyamukhaṃ vāme lakṣmīṃ svabāhunā || 296 | | pārśve cākarṣayantaṃ ca gṛhṇantaṃ śrīkarācchubham | tāmbūlakaṃ mukhe cākṣṇoḥ premapravāhapūritam || 27 || tejaḥparidhisaṃvyāptaṃ sakhībhiḥ parivāritam | ratnavetrakarābhiśca tathā cāmarapāṇibhiḥ || 28 | | dhṛtagandhapradīpābhirbhūṣitābhirvibhūṣaṇaiḥ | ratnachatraṃ dhṛtavatyā śobhitaṃ puruṣottamam || 29 | | dhūpapātraṃ dhṛtavatyā dhūpitaṃ puruṣottamam | kāṃcit sahāsāṃ paśyantaṃ hasantaṃ sumanoharam || 1.583.30 | | tathā stuvato devāṃśca siddhāṃśca sanakādikān | nāradādyām̐śca gandharvān prahlādādīṃśca vaiṣṇavān | | 31 || nṛtyantaṃ ca prasādārthamagrato’psaraso gaṇam | evaṃ sarvaṃ ca tau dṛṣṭvā divyajñānau babhūvatuḥ | | 32 || triḥ parikramya taṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kṛtāñjalī | tuṣṭuvāte muhustau ca hṛdayasthaṃ dṛśoścaram || 33 || āvāṃ kāmārthalubdhau ca pāpamātrābhicāriṇau | ṛṣīṇāṃ kṛpayā cātra śaraṇaṃ te hyupāgatau ||34|| anukampaya nau nātha sudīnau śaraṇāgatau | mūḍhau duṣkṛtakarmāṇau patitau bhavasāgare ||35|| ko’nyastvatsadṛśo bandhurmahābhayanivārakaḥ | svārthaśūnyaḥ parāthaikadhyeyo’nāthapatiḥ prabhuḥ ||36 || nārāyaṇeti tvannāma caturvargaikasādhanam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||37|| mantraste mokṣadaścātipāpināṃ pāvako’sti hi | japto bhavān paraṃ pāraṃ prāpayatyeva tena hi ||38|| tannau prasīda deveśa dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ pradehi nau | ghorād dustarakhātācca samuttāraya keśava ||39|| indriyāṇi mano buddhistava mūrtau vasantu naḥ | ātmā saṃskārasahitaścārpitastava pādayoḥ ||1.583.40 || prasīda deva sarvātmannasaṃkhyeyaśirobhuja | asaṃkhyaghrāṇanayanapāṇipāda namo’stu te ||41 || ṣaṅviṃśastvaṃ cāntarātman niṣprapaṃcaḥ pravartase | catuṣpumarthamūrtistvaṃ jagannātha namo’stu te ||42|| tvadārādhanayā kṛṣṇa bhavanti sarvasiddhayaḥ | yogābhyāsaṃ vinā cāsmai kṛṣṇāya te namonamaḥ ||43 || bhaktiṃ dṛḍhāṃ pradehyāvāṃ nāstyanyatprārthanīyakam | yāvatprāṇāndhārayāvastāvadbhaktirdṛḍhā tvayi ||44|| tataḥ pāre’pi te bhaktiṃ dehi nārāyaṇaprabho | agādhabhavapaṃke’tra nimagnayoḥ parāyaṇam ||45|| dāsyaṃ nātha sadā dehi cānukampaya nau vibho | itistuvantau tau bhaktau petaturdaṇḍavat kṣitau ||46|| prasīdeti vadantau ca muhuścakraturdarśanam | divyadṛṣṭyā vilokyaivaṃ nematuśca muhurmuhuḥ ||47|| tāvadadṛśyatāṃ yāto lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ | tāvubhau carmanetrābhyāṃ puṇḍarīkāmbarīṣakau ||48 || māyayā darśanaṃ divyaṃ svapnadṛṣṭamabudhyatām | tataḥ siṃhāsanasthaṃ śrīpatiṃ dadṛśatuḥ punaḥ ||49|| kāṣṭharūpaṃ divyakalgiśobhāḍhyamukuṭānvitam | lalāṭaphalake svarṇavarṇabindūrdhvapuṇḍrakam ||1.583.50 || navajīmūtasaṃkāśaṃ phullapadmāyatekṣaṇam | sadratnasārajaḍitasauvarṇakuṇḍalojjvalam ||51 || raktādharaṃ tilapuṣpanāsikaṃ vanamālinam | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmāyudha cāyatavakṣasam |||52|| mandahāsyānanaṃ divyasvarṇakaṭakabāhukam | śrīvatsakaustubhamauktikādihārāḍhyavakṣasam | | 53 | | ājānuyugalaṃ svarṇaśṛṃkhalāḍhyaprakoṣṭhakam | sadratnakhacitormikāśobhitāṅgulikākaram | | 54 | | abhayaṃ darśayantaṃ ca kareṇa mālikānvitam | kṣaumapiśaṃgadhautraṃ ca divyacandanacarcitam | | 55 | | puṣpahārālisaṃśobhadvakṣaḥsthalasthitaśriyam | puṣpagucchānvitakaraṃ suvartulakapolakam | dhanuḥkammānikākārādharadvayamanoharam | | 56| | īṣadgocaraśmaśrusatsūkṣmarekhādharānvitam | kāmakoṭipralāvaṇyapremābdhikaṃjalocanam | | 57 | | āhvayantaṃ kaṭākṣeṇa jñāpayantaṃ ca hṛcchrayam | saptaviṃśatihārālisauvarṇaraśanākaṭim | | 58 | | mañjīrakiṃkiṇījālaśabditacaraṇadvayam | alaktakādisaṃlagnaśoṇarūpāḍhyapattalam | | 59 | | sūkṣmacandrakṛtāvāsonnatavartulasannakham | dhanurdhvajatriśūlasvastikamatsyādihastakam | | 1.583.60 | | ūrdhvarekhārdhacandrādivajrākuśādipattalam | navayauvanapūrasthaṃ cittacauraṃ patiṃ prabhum | | 61 | | adrāṣṭāṃ ca tau subhaktau śrīsvāmipuruṣottamam | tau śrīharerdakṣabhāge dadṛśāte halāyudham | | 62 | | saṃkarṣaṇaṃ prabhuṃ śeṣaṃ naikabrahmāṇḍasatphaṇam | taṃ balaṃ yatsahasrādiphaṇāmaṇḍalabhūṣitam | | 63 | | dhavalaṃ samukuṭaṃ ca sauvarṇakuṇḍalāñcitam | divyamālādharaṃ nīlāmbaraṃ paṃkajanetrakam | | 64 | | pronnatapīnavakṣaḥsthamaṇihārālirājitam | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmamūśalahaladhāriṇam | | 65 | | atha madhye tayoḥ saumyāṃ bhadrāṃ campakasūjjvalām | dadṛśāte ca tau ramyāṃ samārabdhasuyauvanām | | 66 | | kuṃkumāruṇabindvāḍhyalalāṭaphalakojjvalām | sauvarṇatantikārājadbhāvakesaracandanām | | 67 | | kabarībhāraśobhāḍhyāṃ dhammilākarṣaṇānvitām | karṇanāsāgalabāhuprakoṣṭhakaṭibhūṣaṇām | | 68 | | vidyutprabhojjvalaśāṭīkañcukīghargharīyutām | sarvalāvaṇyasahitāṃ lakṣmīṃ kṛṣṇapriyāṃ dhruvām | | 69| | tāmbūlakamalādyaiśca śobhitāṃ vyajanānvitām | divyanepathyasaundaryasauratānandavāsinīm | | 1.583.70 | | adrāṣṭāṃ ca śatasūryasamaikārasudarśanam | sahasrāra ca bhaktānāṃ rakṣākaraṃ pramuktidam || 71 || dārvagranirmitaṃ cakraṃ hariṃ bhadrāṃ balaṃ tathā | caturdhāvasthitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā tau viprabāhujau ||172 || vismayaṃ jagmatuḥ prātaḥ śraddadhatuśca divyatām | na dārupratimā ceyaṃ sākṣād brahma prakāśate || 73 || dārumiśreṇa bhagavān tīrtharājataṭe sthitaḥ | vaṭamūle divyarūpo yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate janaḥ ||74|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | kṣitau yadāvatarati catūrūpaḥ prakāśate ||75 || jagannāthasya nikaṭe cāvāṃ sthāsyāva eva tu | iti niścitya bhaktau dvau kṛṣṇe bhaktiparāyaṇau ||76 || tatra sthitau ciraṃ saṃprajayantau kṛṣṇamānasau | divyau bhūtvā yayau śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇākṣaram ||77|| muktipadaṃ paraṃ dhāmāpunarāvṛttilakṣaṇam | evaṃ ye bhajamānāstamanādiśrīnarāyaṇam ||78 || vāsaṃ yāsyanti puruṣottamapuryāṃ narāḥ striyaḥ | divyāścaturbhujā bhūtvā prayāsyanti mamākṣaram ||79 || api kīṭapataṃgādyā viyujyante’subhiśca ye | te’pi kṛṣṇasya sāmarthyāt prayāsyanti paraṃ padam ||1.583.8 0 || sakāmāḥ svargameṣyanti lokān vairājasaṃjñakān | aiśvarām̐steṣu vai divyān bhogān bhuktvā tataḥ param || 81 || prayāsyanti mama lokaṃ cākṣarādapi tūttamam | ityāha bhagavān lakṣmīṃ cotkale puruṣottame || 82 || dakṣiṇasyodadhestīre vasanti vaiṣṇavā mama | narā nāryo dharmayuktā mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ||83 || ṛṣikulyāṃ samāsādya dakṣiṇodadhigāminīm | svarṇarekhāmahānadyormadhye deśaḥ sa utkalaḥ ||84|| bhūsvarga eṣa evāsti deśaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ prado nārāyaṇāśrayāt ||85|| nāryaḥ pativratā yatra narā patnīvratasthitāḥ | sadā kṛtayugo yatra madbhakteṣu pravartate ||86 || teṣāṃ tu darśanāllakṣmi muktirbhavati śāśvatī | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhejjanaḥ ||87|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śrījagannāthapuryāṃ viprakṣatriyayorbhagavatsākṣātkāreṇa muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā tryaśītyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 583 ||
<1.584> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ mama purātanīṃ yathodbhavām | pūrve kṛte babhūvāsāvindradyumno mahānṛpaḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeyo na jānāti taṃ kālaṃ yatra cāsa saḥ | na bakarṣirna gṛdhrarṣirna cendrādyā vidurhi tam || 2 || kintu kūrmo mānasastho jānāti taṃ purātanam | lomaśo’pi vijānāti cendradyumnaṃ purābhavam || 3 || sraṣṭuḥ sa pañcamo vaṃśo vaiṣṇavāścāsa bhūtale | adhyātmavidbhāgavataḥ sarveṣu brahmadarśanaḥ || 4 || sarvavidyaḥ suśīlaśca yaṣṭā brahmaṇya ityapi | rājasūyaṃ vājimedhasahasrakamiyāja saḥ || 5 || mahākālavane’vantīrājadhānīsthito’bhavat | manovākkarmabhiḥ kṛṣṇasvāmibhaktiṃ cakāra saḥ || 6 || kuṃkumavāpikātīrthasthitaḥ śrībhagavān svayam | śrīsvāmiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣānnṛpasya tu || 7 || pūjāvasaramāsādya gatvā gṛhṇāti pūjanam | naivedyaṃ samprabhuktvā ca nṛpaṃ bodhayati svayam || 8 || yāhi rājanmama kṣetraṃ puruṣottamasaṃjñakam | tatra kāraya me saudhaṃ prāsādaṃ raivatopamam || 9 || ityuktaḥ sa ca bhūpo’pi omityāha narāyaṇam | haristasyārpitāṃ pūjāṃ prāpyādṛśyo bhavatyapi || 1.584.1 0|| atha rājñā sabhāyāṃ svapurohito niveditaḥ | yatra sākṣājjagannāthaḥ kṣetraṃ didṛkṣurasmi tat || 11 || vimānena ca yāsyāmo vidvadbhiḥ kavibhiḥ saha | daivajñaiḥ śrotriyaiḥ sārdhaṃ dāsadāsyādibhistathā || 1 2|| ityabhideśamādāya purohitasya pārśvagaḥ | tairthiko brāhmaṇastatra rājānaṃ pratyabhāṣata || 13 || yo’bhūt patnīvratākhyo vai nāmnā brahmāṇḍagocaraḥ | sa prāha rājan jānāmi paśyāmi karagaṃ yathā || 14|| kṣetra tadvai jagannāthāśrayamoḍhrapradeśake | utkale nīlaśailasyābhito dakṣiṇasāgare || 15 || jale sthale ca tatkṣetraṃ nāmnā śrīpuruṣottamam | yatrāste kalpakavaṭo yatra rauhiṇakuṇḍakam || 16 || tatrāste prāgdiśi harernīlendramaṇinirmitā | tanuḥ kṛṣṇasya divyā sā sārūpyamuktidāyinī || 17|| paścime śabarāṇāṃ vai grāmaḥ śabaradīpakaḥ | vartate tasya mārgo’pi yena viṣṇvālayaṃ vrajet || 18|| tatra nīlamaṇimūrtiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’sti vai | tatroṣitaṃ mayā rājan varṣaṃ śrīpuruṣottame || 19|| tuṣṭyarthaṃ devadevasya vratinā divyacakṣuṣā | dṛṣṭvā devāśca munayaḥ pratirātraṃ samāgatāḥ ||1.584.20|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśanāya ye | mahimaiṣa na kutrāpi purā dṛṣṭo mayā nṛpa || 21 || saṃhitānāṃ kathāstatra śrutā kalpāntarārthagāḥ | tatsthānaṃ darśanārhaṃ vai vidyate nṛpasattama || 22|| yathā vai raivatībhūmistathā nīlagiristhalam | kṣetradvayaṃ purā paścānna bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ||23|| tvaṃ yasmād viṣṇubhakto’si tadgatvā śrīdharaṃ bhaja | evamuktvā sa vai vipraścāntardhānaṃ jagāma ha ||24|| avāpya vismayaṃ rājā purohitamuvāca yat | amānuṣamidaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvedānīṃ purohitaḥ ||25|| buddhistvarayate tatra gantuṃ yatra jagatprabhuḥ | mama dharmārthakāmāśca tvadāyattāḥ purohita ||26 || idānīṃ tvaṃ puro yāhi mameṣṭaṃ sādhitaṃ bhavet | śrutvā bāḍhaṃ vipra āha rājan drakṣyasi keśavam ||27|| yayā tvaṃ tattathā cāhaṃ kariṣyāmi tavārthakam | tatra vayaṃ tataḥ sarve vatsyāmaḥ puruṣottame ||28|| sāphalyaṃ kimato loke paraṃ yaddharidarśanam | tatra kṣetre bhagavataḥ sannidhiṃ rocate mama || 29|| prathamaṃ me’nujo yātu taddeśaṃ cārasaṃyutaḥ | vidyāpatirjagannāthaṃ nīlādriṃ ca vaṭaṃ tathā ||1.584.30|| bhūpradeśaṃ prasamīkṣya pramīya ca vasundharām | samāyātu vijānan tatkṣetraṃ nārāyaṇāśrayam ||3 1 || śrutvaivaṃ cendrako rājā tathāstviti dideśa tam | purohito’pyanujaṃ svaṃ kathayāmāsa tattathā ||32|| prasthāpayāmāsa taṃ ca kṛtasvastyayanaṃ dvijaiḥ | vimāne puṣpake sthitvā provāca sahayāyinaḥ ||33 || aho naḥ saphalaṃ janma sukalyā śarvarī ca naḥ | drakṣyāmo yadbhagavato mukhapadmaṃ pramokṣadam ||34|| yaṃ paśyanti hṛdi nityaṃ yoginaḥ pārameśvarāḥ | taṃ nīlācalavāsaṃ śrīpatiṃ drakṣyāma eva ca || 35|| adṛśyaṃ saṃvilokyaiva tariṣyāmo bhavāmbudhim | yatsmṛtiḥ pādarajakī drakṣyāmastaṃ janāyanam ||36|| sarūpamuktidaṃ nāthaṃ kariṣyāmo dṛśāṃcaram | adyāho prākpuṇyapuñja utthito bhagavatpradaḥ ||37|| vayaṃ sarve carmadṛbhirlokayiṣyāmahe harim | itthaṃ vadan yayau vyomnā dinārdhe puruṣottamam ||38|| oḍhradeśaṃ samudraṃ ca vaṭaṃ ca nīlaparvatam | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇo dadṛśe janān ||39|| atyadbhutāṃ suvasatiṃ sākṣāttanubhṛto hareḥ | atha nīlādrinikaṭe sthale divye’tiśobhite ||1.584.40 || vimānaṃ svaṃ kṣitau tatrāvatārayat samasthale | upatyakāyāmārūḍho mukundālokanotsukaḥ ||41 || tatra śuśrāva bhagavadbhaktyālāpān girau muhuḥ | abhiyātaśca vai tatra dadarśa śabarālayān ||46 || śabaradīpakaṃ cāpi viṣṇubhaktāṃśca cihnitān | dṛṣṭvā praṇamya śirasā tasthau yāvat savidyakaḥ ||43|| tāvad viśvāvasurnāma śabaraḥ parameśvaram | pūjayitvā samāyātastaṃ papraccha savidyakaḥ ||44|| atrāste bhagavān viṣṇurjagannātho mahāprabhuḥ | tadarthaṃ cāgato dūrād darśanaṃ kārayātra me ||45|| indradyumnasya nṛpateravantīpuravāsinaḥ | purohitānujaścāhaṃ vidyāpatyabhidhānakaḥ ||46|| preṣitastena rājñātra jijñāsunā yiyāsunā | hariṃ didṛkṣuṇā mārgaṃ draṣṭuṃ prāṅanīlamādhavāt ||47|| dṛṣṭvā sarvāṃ narapatervārtāṃ neṣyāmi so’pyaham | nirāhāro dhruvaṃ sādho tanmāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pradarśaya ||48|| śrutvaivaṃ śabaraḥ so’pi prāk śrutāṃ saṃhitākathām | sasmāra tatra yadrājā cendradyumno hi vaiṣṇavaḥ ||49|| samāgatyātra deveśaṃ caturdhā sthāpayiṣyati | vājimedhasahasraṃ ca bhūmāvatra kariṣyati ||1.584.50|| pṛthivyantargate līne mādhave nīlamādhave | punā rājā tamāgatya dāravaṃ sthāpayiṣyati ||51 || so’yaṃ kālaḥ samāyāto gāthā satyā bhaved yadi | nīlamaṇimayo nāthaścādṛśyatāṃ gamiṣyati ||52|| antardhānaṃ bhagavataḥ sannidhāne upasthitam | tadenaṃ darśayāmyeva nīlendramaṇimacyutam ||53|| iti vicārya śabaro brāhmaṇaṃ prāha hṛdgatam | asmābhiḥ śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā saṃśrutā ||54|| tatrodantaḥ samāyātaścendradyamno mahīpatiḥ | jagannāthe mahākṣetre vāsaṃ naijaṃ kariṣyati ||55|| nīlapāṣāṇamūrteste darśanaṃ vipra jāyate | bhāgyavām̐stvaṃ tataścendradyumnasyāpekṣayātra vai ||56|| rājñastvasya nīlamaṇiprabhorna darśanaṃ bhavet | cakṣurbhyāṃ paśya taṃ nīlamādhavaṃ nīlaśailagam ||57|| nīlamaṇivapuṣaṃ tamehi yāmo hyadhityakām | ityuktvā taṃ kare dhṛtvā gahanena ca vartmanā || 58|| uparyuparyupāruhya śilākaṇṭakaśālini | ekaikanaragamye ca durgame nirjane sthale ||59|| vṛkṣacchāyātamaḥprāye samānīya sa śābaraḥ | darśayāmāsa rauhiṇaṃ kuṇḍaṃ tīrthaṃ supāvanam ||1.584.6 0|| tasyātra pūrvabhāge’sau kalpachāyāvaṭo mahān | etayorantare brahmannikuṃjābhyantare sthitam ||6 1 || paśya kṛṣṇaṃ jagannāthaṃ sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamam | ityevaṃ darśayāmāsa nīlapāṣāṇakaṃ harim ||6 2|| sa tu viprastatra kuṇḍe snātvā sarvātmanā harim | praṇamya dūrataścaikamanāstuṣṭāva cāntare ||63|| akṣarātītabhagavattakṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho | mukteśajīvahṛdayaparātpara namo’stu te ||64|| sarvakarmasamārādhyayogasādhya namo’stu te | premapāśaviṣayātmam̐stīrthātmam̐ste namonamaḥ ||65|| namastejaḥsvarūpāya pāvanāya namonamaḥ | hutāśanāya devāya hṛcchrayāya ca te namaḥ ||66|| mantrasthāya jīvanāya nirvāṇāya ca te namaḥ | sarvānandapradātre te brahmeśāya namonamaḥ ||67|| māyine tattvine mūrtimate viśvāsasākṣiṇe | jiṣṇave bahuśirase kamaleśāya te namaḥ ||68|| māmuddhara kṛpāsindho trāhi vāsanayānvitam | indradyumnanṛpasyāpi kuru saṃkalpapūraṇam ||69|| iti vidyāpatiḥ stutvā omityevaṃ jajāpa ha | tataḥ sa śabaraḥ prāha kṛtārthastvaṃ tu sāmpratam ||1.584.70|| gṛhaṃ yāvaḥ kṣudhito’si vāso’raṇyena cocitaḥ | hiṃsrāṇāṃ pādacāro’yaṃ pradeśo’sti bhayapradaḥ ||71 || ityuktvā śabaro naijaṃ gṛhaṃ nināya bhūsuram | mārge’pi viṣame nāsya śramo yat kṛṣṇadarśanam |||72|| śabaro bhojyapānādyairatiyiṃ samapūjayat | uvāca kaccit tṛpto’si śābarairvastubhirdvija ||73|| tava pratoṣaṇādindradyumnastuṣṭo bhaviṣyati | vipraḥ prāhāścaryametat tvadgṛhe divyavaibhavāḥ ||74|| rājyātivartinaścaite kuta ete vadātra mām | śabaraḥ prāha devādyā nityamāyānti vai hareḥ ||75|| divyopacārānādāya pūjanāya jagatpateḥ | stutvā samarcyārpayitvā nartayitvā prayānti ca ||76|| tānīmāni hi divyāni sarvopakaraṇāni vai | tairvayaṃ kṣīṇarogāśca nivasāmo’rbudāyuṣaḥ ||77|| viṣṇuprasādabhogena pāpakṣayaṃ ca divyatām | śrutvāścaryaparo vipraḥ kṛtārthaṃ svamamanyata ||78|| aho tvatraiva vastavyaṃ bhagavaccharaṇe sadā | yādṛśo vipṇubhakto’yaṃ mayā bhāvyaṃ tathaiva ca ||79|| kiṃ gatvā svagṛhe me’sti vicāryetthaṃ jagāda tam | kṛṣṇadāsye mayā vṛttyaṃ mayi te cedanugrahaḥ ||1.584.80 || kimanyasevayā loke vidhāsye svāmisevanam | yadi puṇyaṃ bhavetpaurvaṃ labhate svāmisevanam ||8 1 || sādhu mitra tvayā sārdhaṃ puṇyānme saṃgamo’sti yat | sādhusaṃgena saṃsāraṃ tariṣye dustaraṃ viṣam ||82|| sārātsārataraṃ puṇyaṃ vaiṣṇavena sahāsanam | śabarastu tadā prāha tathāstviti paraṃ śṛṇu ||83|| indradyumnaṃ samādāya vāsaṃ cātra kuru dvija | nīlaśailakṛtā mūrtistāvatā layameṣyati ||84|| imāṃ prācīnamūrtiṃ ca naiva drakṣyati bhūpatiḥ | hariracirādbālukāsvantardhānaṃ gamiṣyati ||85|| sa cāgatya nṛpo’dṛṣṭvā śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam | prāyopaveśanasthaśca svapne drakṣyati mādhavam ||86 || haryādeśād dārumayaṃ harermūrticatuṣṭayam | vedhodvārā pratiṣṭhāpya pūjayiṣyati bhaktitaḥ ||87|| kārayiṣyati devasya prāsādaṃ gaganocchrayam | āvayoḥ sthāsyati vaṃśo yāvanmūrtistu dāravī ||88|| nīlendrāśmamayaṃ smṛtvā snātvā sindhau tataḥ param | indradyumnaṃ prayāhi tvaṃ samānayātra taṃ nṛpam ||89|| ityukto brāhmaṇaḥ snātvā natvā vimānamāsthitaḥ | sāyaṃ jagāma cāvantīṃ nṛpaṃ dṛṣṭamavarṇayat ||1.584.90 || jagannāthe tadā kṣetre vāyuścaṇḍagatirvavau | sāyāhne’rcanavelāyāmabhitaḥ svarṇavālukāḥ ||9 1 || uḍḍīyante sma pavanāt tābhiśchannaḥ sa mādhavaḥ | rauhiṇakuṇḍaśchanno’pi vālukāparvato’bhavat ||9 2|| devādyā vālukārāśiṃ dadṛśuste na mādhavam | rauhiṇaṃ ca tathā kuṇḍaṃ na dadṛśuḥ kṣaṇāntare ||9 3 || sarve te prārthayāmāsuḥ svāparādhakṣamāṃ prati | kathaṃ naḥ sevakām̐styaktvā yugapannahi dṛśyase ||94|| yeṣāmarthe’tra dhṛtavān mūrtirūpaṃ kalevaram | tānanāthān parityajya kathaṃ pṛthvyāṃ tirohitaḥ ||95|| na prāsādo na ca sthānaṃ na mārgo na bhavānapi | na kuṇḍaṃ dṛśyate cātra kathaṃ kopastavedṛśaḥ ||96|| asmām̐ścāpyatra pralaye vikarṣaya tvayā saha | surāṇāṃ śocatāmevaṃ vyomavāṇī babhūva ha ||97|| bho surā mā praśocantu madicchā vilaye dhruvā | tato me darśanaṃ līnaṃ parivartanamiṣyate ||98|| brahmā vadiṣyati sarvamavatārāntaraṃ mama | śrutvā devā yayuḥ svargaṃ śabarāḥ śokamāpnuvan ||99|| nīlādrirvālukāvyāpto babhūva dṛśyate’bhitaḥ | nīlamādhavavāñccheyaṃ yatastiro’bhavat svayam || 1.584.10 0|| amanyanta ca śabarā atha vidyāpatirdvijaḥ | vimānenāvantikāyāmindradyumnālayaṃ yayau || 10 1|| nirmālyamālāṃ nīlākhyamādhavasya dadau nṛpe | rājā tutoṣa nirmālyamālāṃ śirasi dhārayan || 1 02|| mālātmakaṃ prapaśyāmi nīlamādhavamatra vai | namāmi mālikāṃ divyāṃ bhaktamānasapūraṇīm || 103 || ityuktvā viprahastena mālāṃ kaṇṭhe hyadhārayat | mālātmikāṃ śriyaṃ rājā tuṣṭāva pārameśvarīm || 1 04|| naya māṃ tvaṃ mahālakṣmi yatrāste bhagavān patiḥ | ityuktvā nyaṣīdadrājā samāje’vantivāsinām || 1 05|| vipraḥ pṛṣṭo’tha vṛttāntaṃ puruṣottamakṣetrajam | saprakāśaṃ hi sadasi varṇayāmāsa vistarāt || 106 || bhilladvīpāvalokaṃ ca samudrasnānamityapi | nīlādrirohaṇaṃ nīlamādhavasyābhidarśanam || 1 07|| susnānaṃ rauhiṇe kuṇḍe divyavaṭasya darśanam | śabarāṇāmāvasathān varṇayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ || 1 08|| nīlendramaṇimūrteśca varṇanaṃ ca yathātatham | nīlendramaṇipāṣāṇamayī mūrtiḥ purātanī || 1 09|| āraseyī cākacakyamayī prapūjitā suraiḥ | mālā tasyai cārpiteyaṃ surairmlāyati yā na hi || 1.584.11 0|| ricyate na ca gandhena seyaṃ tvatkaṇṭhagā nṛpa | tatratyaṃ te varṇayiṣye pūjanādi pradivyakam || 111 || bhuktirmuktiśca vai rājan dve tatra yugapatsthite | na jarārogaśokādiduḥkhaṃ tatra hi vidyate || 1 12|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne indradyumnasya sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamadarśanaṃ, purohitabhrāturvidyāpaterjagannāthakṣetre preṣaṇam, āgatya yathāvilokanatadvarṇanam, jhanjhāvātena vālukāsu nīlamādhavalayaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturaśītyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 584 ||
<1.585> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tato vidyāpatiḥ prāha sabhāsthale | divyatāṃ tasya kṣetrasya yathāvat kathayāmi te || 1 || vipraḥ prāha ca madhyāhne divyagandho vavau marut | surā naivedyadānārthaṃ vyomamārgātsamāyayuḥ || 2 || vādanāni gāyanāni surastrīṇāṃ tadābhavan | sahasramupacārāṇāṃ devaistasmai samarpitam || 3 || sampūjya jayapūrvāste yayuḥ svargaṃ surāstataḥ | viśvāvasuḥ śabaro me mādhavasya prasādanam || 4 || bhojyaṃ mālyaṃ dadau pūtaṃ yadatrāpahṛtaṃ mayā | prasādaḥ śarkarātmā ca dīyatāṃ sadase nṛpa || 5 || samantād gahanākīrṇaṃ kṣetraṃ nīlādrināmikam | tīrtharājasya velāyāṃ svarṇavālukayā vṛtam || 6 || vicitradṛśyaṃ devānāṃ mānavānāṃ tu kā kathā | adreḥ śṛṃge kalpajīvī mahānucco vaṭo’sti ca || 7 || dīrghāyataḥ puṣpaphalavarjitaḥ pallavojjvalaḥ | tatpaścād rauhiṇaṃ kuṇḍaṃ tatpūrve vedikāsthitaḥ || 8 || nyagrodhacchāyayā śītaścendranīlamayo hariḥ | cakragadādharaścāste svarṇapadmopari prabhuḥ || 9 || ekāśītyaṅgulamito mandahāsyasphuranmukhaḥ | rājīvasaumyanetraścāmṛtapūrṇānanaḥ prabhuḥ || 1.585.1 0|| vapuṣo’śmamayatve’pi candrojjvalaḥ smitādharaḥ | hāsasaṃphullagaṇḍābhyāṃ ruciraṃ cibukaṃ hanuḥ || 1 1|| karṇayoḥ kuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca rājad vakṣaśca mālayā | graiveyakaiśca sauvarṇaiḥ ratnāñcitaiḥ samujjvalaiḥ || 12|| pīnāyataskandhayugajānudīrghacaturbhujaḥ | ākarṇāntāyatakoṇavakranetrakaṭākṣakam || 1 3|| sakaustubhaṃ kaṃkaṇormikāṅgulīyakabhūṣitam | nimnanābhidharaṃ cādhastanuromālimañjulam || 14|| suratnamekhalārājatkaṭikauśeyadhautrakam | sakiṃkiṇīmañjirāḍhyaraktatalāśripatkajam || 15|| jaghanaṃ sundaraṃ divyaṃ kāmāśrayaṃ ca sundaram | liṃgaṃ tejomayaṃ ramyaṃ sarvākarṣaṇabhājanam || 16|| sarvāśādyotako devo nīlādrerupari sthitaḥ | vāmapārśvagatā lakṣmīrāśliṣṭā padmapālinā || 17|| vallakīvādanaparā bhagavanmukhalocanā | sarvalāvaṇyaśobhāḍhyā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā || 18|| sarvālaṃkṛtitejaskā prodbhinnanavayauvanā | chatrībhūtaphaṇāvṛndaḥ śeṣaḥ paścād vilokitaḥ || 1 9|| agre vyavasthitaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ vapurbibhratsudarśanam | kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ tasya paścād garuḍamāsthitam ||1.585.20 || sajīvā iva te bhaktānugrāhakā vilokitāḥ | tatra ceto mama rājannatyantamabhidhāvati ||2 1 || anekajanmasāhasrapuṇyapāko hi paśyati | sarvasādhanalabhyaṃ taddarśanātprāpyate’kṣaram ||22|| tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ mokṣasādhanaṃ yena vīkṣitaḥ | tvaṃ ca rājam̐stvarayaiva vilokaya jagatprabhum ||23|| na jāne śvaḥ sūryadraṣṭā bhaviṣyasi na veti ca | śvaḥ kāryamadya kartavyaṃ mokṣārthaṃ pārameśvaram ||24|| ityuktaścendradyumnastu harṣamavāpa puṣkalam | kṛtakṛtyo’smīti cāha prasādamālikāgrahāt || 25|| tayā darśanapātratvaṃ prāptaṃ cādya mayā hareḥ | sarvātmanā ca rājyena saha gantavyameva ca || 26 || tatrāvāsaṃ sadā kṛtvā kariṣye hayamedhakān | sarvopacāraiḥ śrīnāthaṃ pūjayiṣye dine dine ||27|| dāsyena sevayā kṛṣṇaṃ prīṇayiṣye ramāpatim | evaṃ rājā samuvāca tāvadāyāddhi nāradaḥ ||28|| pūjito vandito rājñā rājānaṃ samuvāca saḥ | avatīrṇau naraṃ draṣṭuṃ badaryāṃ ca narāyaṇam ||29|| tava kīrtiṃ devatābhyaḥ śrutvā satye samāgataḥ | śrījagannāthagamane vyavasāyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||1.585.30|| tava jñātvā prasanno’smi jātastaṃ yāhi sevaya | sahasrajanmābhyāsaiśca bhaktirbhavati mādhave ||3 1|| brahmā cārādhya taṃ nāthaṃ lebhe paitāmahaṃ padam | tatputro’haṃ tadvaṃśastvaṃ bhaktyā śobhā sadā hi naḥ ||32|| anādyavidyānāśāya samarthā bhaktiruttamā | tarirbhaktibhavābdhau sā janmarogasya bheṣajam ||33|| māṃteva rakṣati bhaktān santaḥ puṣyanti vai tayā | brāhmyaṃ padaṃ tayā muktirlabhyate tadanugrahāt ||34|| bahvyānāṃ śalabhānāṃ dāvatulyā haripriyā | sarvatīrthaphaladātrī tārayitrī nimajjatām ||35 || tapāṃsi yajñā dānāni vratāni dharmasatkriyāḥ | eṣāṃ sāhasrakoṭyaśca na bhakterayutāṃśakaḥ ||36 || sā tridhā guṇabhedena turīyā nirguṇā matā | svārthābhicārayuktā sā tāmasī bhaktirīritā ||37|| svārthaparārthasammiśrā rājasī bhogavāñcchayā | parārthamātrasandheyā sāttvikī sukhabhājanā ||38|| phalehārahitā sā nirguṇā śrīpuruṣottame | nirguṇā muktaye proktā premasevātmikā hareḥ ||39|| sāttvikyā brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ rājasyā śakralokatām | tāmasyā pitṛlokādīn yānti punaśca bhūjanum ||1.585.40|| uttamāmuttamāṃ kuryāt tena muktirbhavet kvacit| | kulācārādihīno’pi bhaktimān saṃpraśasyate ||41 || sarvavidyādhivāso’pi bhaktihīno vinindyate | yayā vetti parabrahma parā vidyā tu sā matā ||42 || yena prīṇāti bhagavān satkriyā sā prakīrtitā | tābhyāṃ yukto bhaved bhakto bhāgavatottamo hi saḥ ||43|| tatpādapāṃsunā viśvaṃ pūyate sacarācaram | vāsudeve tathā bhakte sāmyaṃ sañjāyate sadā ||44|| tayoraiśvaryarūpādibhedo naiva ca naiva ca | śāntacittastathā saumyo jitendriyo hyahiṃsakaḥ || 45|| adrogdhā kṛpayāyuktaścāste yaścāvinindakaḥ | guṇagrāhī sadācāraḥ parasaukhyasukhānvitaḥ ||46|| sarvatra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadraṣṭā vimatsaraḥ | dīnānukampo hitakṛddharau koṭyadhipremavān ||47|| satāṃ sevāparo devapūjakaḥ pitṛtarpakaḥ | sarvaṃ viṣṇumayaṃ jānan samaṣṭivyaṣṭimityapi ||48|| abhedenaiva paśyam̐śca dāsyaṃ karoti vai hareḥ | svāmisevakabhāvena sevako vartate ca yaḥ ||49|| hariṃ bhāvayati kīrtayati namaḥkaroti ca | bhajatyeva prabhuṃ nityaṃ nānye’vadhānamācaret ||1.585.50|| śilāsvarṇadravyaloṣṭastrīkūṭakaṇṭakādiṣu | mitraśatrubandhubhinnādiṣu sāmyasamādhimān ||51 || nāmadhyānaparo viṣṇorjayavāṇīrataḥ sadā | devacihnapriyaḥ khyāto bhakto bhāgavatottamaḥ ||52|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmacandratilakaśobhitaḥ | kaṇṭhīmālāyuto vṛndādalamālyavibhūṣitaḥ ||53|| rāgadveṣamadamānavihīnastṛṣṇikākṣayaḥ | bhakto bhavati kāmādivarjito vāsanākṣayaḥ ||54|| ityuktaścendradyumnaśca prītimān nāradaṃ prati | uvāca sādhusaṃgo me bhāgyādadya upasthitaḥ |||55|| tadāvāṃ yānamāsthāya paśyāvo nīlamādhavam | evaṃ niścitya pañcamyāṃ budhe jyeṣṭhasya cārjune ||56|| pakṣe puṣye cendradyumnaḥ kārayāmāsa ghoṣaṇām | yathāvibhavataḥ sainyaiḥ prajābhirbāndhavādibhiḥ ||57|| nīlādrigamanaṃ kāryaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ samarpya ca | yā vṛttidīryate cātra tayā tatrāpi jīvatu ||58|| rājānaḥ sāvarodhāśca sāmātyāḥ saparicchadāḥ | rathairgajaisturagaiśca koṣaiḥ saha padātibhiḥ ||59|| sajjā vrajantu vai tatra brāhmaṇāḥ sāgnihotriṇaḥ | vaṇijaḥ sahabhāṇḍaiśca sapaṇyāḥ paṇyajīvinaḥ ||1.585.60 || nṛtyagāyanavāditrajyotirvidyāsubuddhayaḥ | vaidyāśca kathakā bhaṭṭāḥ santaśca vārayoṣitaḥ ||61 || gāvaḥ śakuntapāścāpi śākunikāśca sevakāḥ | dāsā dāsyastathā yāntu kṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||62|| ṣaṣṭhyāṃ svayaṃ ca māṃgalyaṃ kārayāmāsa yātrikam | snātvā tīrthajalaiḥ rājā nāndīmukhānakārayat ||63 || havanaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā cakre vahniṃ pradakṣiṇam | tato māṃgalyanepathyavidhānamupacakrame ||64|| hemapīṭhe hariṃ prārcya tatprasādasya mālikām | dadhāra prathamaṃ rājā dhyāyan śrīpuruṣottamam ||65|| yātrārthaṃ ca vinirdiśya dakṣiṇaṃ pādamuddadhau | dakṣiṇāḥ pradadau viprebhyo vāme gaṇikeḍitaḥ ||66|| śvetāśvakuṃjarapārāvatahaṃsasumālikāḥ | sacūtapallavaṃ pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ paśyan yayau nṛpaḥ ||67|| nṛsiṃhamandiraṃ gatvā pūjayitvā hariṃ satīm | dvāramāgatya ca yānaṃ vaihāyasaṃ mahattamam ||68|| samāruroha samuniḥ sāntaḥpurastathāpare | anyaiḥ sahasrairyānaiśca pratasthire purīṃ prati ||69|| jayaśabdāstūryaśabdā babhūvuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭayaḥ | nānāyānasamārūḍhāḥ koṭiśaśca janāstataḥ ||1.585.70|| sasaṃbhārāḥ sakuṭumbā yayuḥ śrīpuruṣottamam | divasārdhena te sarve prāpurutkalabhūmikām ||71 || sīmni sthito carcikākhyāṃ devīṃ pupūjurīśvarīm | citrotpalāṃ nadīṃ gatvā jalapānādi cācaran ||72|| svādubhojyāni ca bubhujire sarve yathārhataḥ | viśaśramurnadītīre sainyāvāsādi tatra ca ||73|| cakruḥ sāyaṃvidhiṃ cāpi rātrau vinodamādadhuḥ | prātaḥ snātvā nityapūjāṃ jalāhārādikaṃ tathā ||74|| kṛtvā tasthustadā tāvadoḍhrarājasya sevakaḥ | indradyumnaṃ samāyātaḥ samuvāca namo’nvitaḥ ||75|| utkaleśanṛpaścātra bhavantaṃ draṣṭumicchati | vijñāya sārvabhaumaṃ ca devaṃ bhavantamāgatam ||76 || sopāyano nadītīre pratīkṣate nideśanam | śrutvā tadvacanaṃ rājāhvayāmāsoḍhabhūpatim ||77|| vaiṣṇavaiḥ sacivairyuktaṃ papraccha kuśalaṃ śubham | oḍhrapatirnanāmainamupadāḥ purato nyadhāt ||78|| parasparaṃ sukuśalaṃ svāgataṃ cakratustataḥ | praśaṃśaturvaiṣṇavau yajjanmasāphalyamityapi ||79|| athoḍhrarājastaṃ prāha dakṣiṇābdhitaṭe hariḥ | nīlādrau kānane cāste lokasañcāravarjite ||1.585.80 || dvitīye’hni vātyayā vālukāchannaḥ sa parvataḥ | channaśca rauhiṇakuṇḍaśchannaśca nīlamādhavaḥ ||8 1 || chinnabhinnāni jātāni śabarāṇāṃ gṛhāṇyapi | kopo’yaṃ cintanādūrdhvaṃ jāto’parādhataḥ kvacit ||82|| mama rājyaṃ bhavato’sti yathājñāṃ prakaromyaham | svāgataṃ bhojanādyaṃ ca preṣayāmi janādibhiḥ ||83|| ityuktvā cāśiṣo labdhvoḍhrapatirmaunamāsthitaḥ | indradyumno nāradaṃ ca prāhāgamastu niṣphalaḥ ||84|| nīvyādhavadevasya darśanaṃ naiva ced yadi | kariṣye’naśanaṃ tvatra mariṣye mokṣaṇaṃ prati
