||85|| nāradastaṃ tadā prāha vaiṣṇavecchāṃ na niṣphalām | karoti bhagavāṃstaṃ tvaṃ prekṣase pārthivaṃ prabhum ||86|| dhairyamāvaha bhagavān svatantro’stīti viddhi bhoḥ | kevalo bhaktivaśago bhaktyā te vaśameṣyati ||87|| vaiṣṇavastvaṃ padmayoneḥ pañcamaḥ puruṣo’si vai | pitāmaho’pyatra kārye bhavato māṃ niyuktavān ||88|| sarvaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi nīlaparvatasannidhau | śrutvā rājā prahṛṣṭaśca mene bhāgyaṃ pravardhitam ||89|| yanmāṃ pitāmahaścāpi sahāyaṃ pradadāti vai | atha sarvān nīlaśailaṃ gantuṃ tvājñāṃ cakāra ha ||1.585.90|| oḍhradeśādhipo yāne niṣasāda ca bhūbhṛtā | saha sarve vyomamārgairmahānadīṃ vihāya ca || 91 || ekāmravanakaṃ kṣetraṃ prāpuḥ kṣaṇāntare tataḥ | gandhavahāṃ nadīṃ tyaktvā koṭiliṃgeśvaraṃ haram || 92|| pūjāvāditranirghoṣānvitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa nāradam | papracchāraṇyakaṃ vīkṣya manyamāno hi mādhavam || 93 || nīlādriśikharāvāsaḥ prāptaḥ kiṃ parameśvaraḥ | muniḥ prāha sa nīlādrirvartate yojanatraye || 94|| ayantu śaṃkarāvāsaḥ koṭiliṃgeśvarātmakaḥ | śaṃbhurbhītaḥ śaraṇaṃ śrīhareḥ purātra cāgataḥ || 95 || pārvatīṃ saṃvivāhyeśo haimavāsaṃ cakāra saḥ | menakāṃ pārvatīṃ prāha bahukāle gate śubham || 96 || patiste nirguṇaḥ putri gṛhadvāravihīnakaḥ | kiyanmama gṛhe vāsaṃ kariṣyati vinā gṛham || 97| | vinā bhūṣā samṛddhiṃ ca śobhase naiva putrike | vada saudhaṃ tu nirmātuṃ pṛthak sthātuṃ svakālaye || 98 || ityuktā śaṃkaraṃ prāha pārvatī namramānasā | bhagavam̐ściravāso vai śvaśurasya gṛhe’guṇaḥ || 99 || parādhīnanivāsastu vivāsasadṛśastataḥ | kṣaudrīyasāmapi tadvanmahatāmapi dukhadaḥ || 1.585.100 || ityuktaḥ śaṃkarastūrṇaṃ kāśīṃ vāsāya nirmame | pūrvasāgaragāminyā gaṃgāyā uttare taṭe || 101 || vārāṇasyāṃ pañcakrośamitāyāṃ ratnamaṇḍape | tayā reme paśupatirbahukālaṃ pure svake || 102 || atha rājā divodāsaḥ sarvān devān hi kāśitaḥ | visarjayāmāsa rājyaṃ cakāra vaiṣṇaveṣu ca || 103 || koṭiliṃgāni saṃsthāpya śaṃbhuḥ kailāsakaṃ yayau | rājāno bahavaḥ paścājjātā vārāṇasībhuvi || 1 04|| kāśīrājetināmāpi śaṃkaropāsako’bhavat | tapasā śaṃkarāllebhe varaṃ cāsaṃbhavaṃ purā || 105 || jetāsi kaṃsahartāraṃ saṃgrāme tvamarindama | tavārthe’haṃ tadā yotsye viṣṇunā saha sarvathā || 106 || śrīharistadvaraṃ jñātvā cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ raṇe | kāśīrājasūdanāya prāhiṇot tacca cakrakam || 1 07|| kāśīrājaśiraśchitvā purīṃ dadāha sarvathā | tacchrutvā kupitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ pāśupatāstrakaṃ harau || 108 || mumoca niṣphalaṃ tacca cakāra bhagavān hariḥ | tadā bhayaṃ samāpannastuṣṭāva śaṃkaro harim || 109 || aparādhaṃ kṣamasvādya te bhaktasya hare prabho | sṛṣṭo’haṃ tāmaso nātha trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam || 1.585.110 tadā cakraṃ nivṛttaṃ śaṃkarāt kṛṣṇo babhūva tat | prasannavadanaḥ prāha lakṣmīyuto hasan hariḥ || 111 | kālenaitāvatā śaṃbho durbuddhiḥ kathamāgatā | hetornṛpatikīṭasya mayā yoddhumupasthitaḥ || 11 2| tvāṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca me cakraṃ nāśayet krodhamantritam | dayāṃ karomi me bhakta yāhi śrīpuruṣottamam || 113 | yadi vāñcchasi rantuṃ vai ciraṃ satyā samaṃ tadā | daśayojanavistīrṇe tatra virajamaṇḍale || 1 14|| citrotpalāṃ nadīmārabhya yāvaddakṣiṇodadhiḥ | śreṣṭho nīlācalastatra caturdhāhaṃ vyavasthitaḥ || 1 15|| nīlamaṇipratimohaṃ taduttare vanaṃ mahat| | ekāmrakāhvayaṃ tatra nivāsaṃ nirbhayaṃ kuru || 1 16|| me puruṣottamakṣetraṃ tvameva paripālaya | ityādiṣṭo yayau śaṃbhustatra vai vāsamācarat || 1 17|| brahmaṇā sthāpitaḥ koṭiliṃgeśvaro’yamasti saḥ | śrutvā rājā vimānāccāvātatāra haraṃ prati || 1 18|| pūjayāmāsa vidhinā dadau dānāni bhūriśaḥ | bindutīrthe tatra snātvā śrīśaṃ sampūjya tatra ca || 11 9|| tasthau dadhyau ca taṃ śaṃbhuṃ śaṃbhuḥ sākṣāduvāca tam | indradyumna mahābhāgavato na tvādṛśo bhuvi || 1.585.120 || durghaṭāpi ca te vāñcchā śīghraṃ pūrṇā bhaviṣyati | nārade punarādehaṃ yadādiṣṭaṃ svayaṃbhuvā || 121 || tat kalpaya pratiṣṭhānaṃ vājimedhapuraḥsaram | antarhitaḥ khalvidānīṃ nīlaratnatanurhariḥ || 122 || tatra śrīnarasiṃhasya kṣetraṃ kuru ca sannidhau | vājimedhasahasreṇa yajatāṃ bhūpatirdhruvam || 123 || tadante kalpanyagrodhaṃ pradarśayāsya bhūpateḥ | brahmarūpatarostasmāccatasraḥ pratimāḥ śubhāḥ || 1 24|| ghaṭiṣyate viśvakarmājaḥ pratiṣṭhāpayiṣyati | brahmaṇo varadānācca prayāte’bdasahasrake ||1 25 || indradyumno hariṃ sākṣānmūrtau vilokayiṣyati | dāravīṃ tanumāsthāya sthitaṃ divyaṃ narāyaṇam || 126 || bhaja nārada rājāsau bhajatāṃ svāminaṃ harim | ityuktvāntardadhe śaṃbhū rājā vināmago’bhavat || 1 27|| yayau puraḥ kapoteśasthalīmāsedivānnṛpaḥ | senāniveśayogyāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā senāṃ nyaveśayat || 128|| bilveśvarakapoteśau pūjayitvā ca nāradam || 1 29|| papraccha tau kathaṃ jātau bilveśvarakapotakau | vada naḥ śrīpatiprāptikarīṃ kathāṃ suśāntidām || 1.585.130 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇāyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne indradyumnasya vidyāpativarṇitaśravaṇottaraṃ jagannāthaṃ pratigamane nirṇayaḥ, nāradāgamaḥ, prayāṇam, citrotpalātaṭe utkaleśābhigamaḥ, ekāmrakavane koṭiliṃgeśapūjanam, ityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśītyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 585 ||
<1.586> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi nāradastaṃ nṛpaṃ prāha kathāṃ śubhām | bilveśasya kapoteśvarasya te kathayāmyaham || 1 || purā kuśasthalī sāsīt tīkṣṇakuśaiḥ samāvṛtā | tatra taptvā tapaḥ śaṃbhuḥ pūjyaḥ syāmiti vāñcchayā || 2 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | japan sa toṣayāmāsa hariṃ śrīpuruṣottamam || 3 || kapota iva sūkṣmo’bhūdaṣṭamūrtirapi dvijaḥ | kapoteśvaratāṃ yātastatra sampūjyatāṃ gataḥ || 4 || tasya saṃpūjakā yānti śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam | athaikadā dānavāstu bhakṣayanti janān bahūn || 5 || pātālādvai samāgatya tatra śrīnīlamādhavaḥ | vivaraṃ pūrayāmāsa bilvaphalaṃ tadantare || 6 || nikṣipya drumamakarot sthāpayāmāsa śaṃkaram | tena dānavarodhaśca jātastatra bileśvaraḥ || 7 || śaṃkaraḥ samabhūttasyārcanād yāti paraṃ padam | atha rājā vimānena yayau śrīpuruṣottamam || 8 || tadābhūd durnimittaṃ ca spando vāmākṣihastayoḥ | papraccha nāradaṃ rājā cāpaśakunakāraṇam || 9 || nāradaḥ prāha tṛtīye sāyaṃ vālukayāvṛtaḥ | nīlamādhavadevo’trādṛśyatāṃ ca gato bhuvi || 1.586.10 || śrutvā rājā śokamagno babhūva tu kṣaṇottaram | prāha purohitaṃ yāhi matsutaṃ cābhiṣecaya || 1 1|| mālaveṣu sadāthātra nivatsyāmi yugāntaram | prāṇānna dhārayiṣyāmi na drakṣyāmi yadā harim || 1 2|| āyuḥśeṣaṃ kariṣyāmi saphalaṃ kṣetramāsthitaḥ | iti dravantaṃ rājānaṃ nāradaḥ prāha dhairyataḥ || 1 3|| harermāyā tādṛśī vai mā mohaṃ yāhi tatra vai | māmuvāca svayaṃ brahmā gacchendradyumnakaṃ prati || 14|| jagannāthaḥ prayātyeṣaḥ na ca drakṣyati mādhavam | na śokastatra kartavyo vācya evaṃ sa bhūpatiḥ || 15|| tatkṛte paramātmānaṃ prasādya puruṣottamam | śvetadvīpānnayiṣyāmi sahasrānte mahākratoḥ || 1 6|| indradyumno’śvamedhānāṃ sahasreṇa yajan harim | tiṣṭhatu ca tadante sa drakṣyati dāravīṃ tanum || 17|| so’vatāro hareḥ punastena khyātiṃ gamiṣyati | purā sma maṇimūrtistu caturdhāvasthito hariḥ || 18|| divyadāruvapurbhūyaścaturdhāvatariṣyati | āyāhi rājan paśyāvo vālukādiśamaiśvarīm || 1 9|| nīlādrau vartate devo nṛsiṃho vighnanāśakaḥ | paśyāmastaṃ mahograṃ sa vighnanāśaṃ kariṣyati ||1.586.20|| nīlamādhavaśailaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā yāsyāva eva tām | kapoteśasthalīṃ tasyāṃ śālāṃ sahasravārṣikīm || 21|| vinirmāyāśvamedhena yaja śrīpuruṣottamam | nṛsiṃhapratimāṃ tatra yajñe pūjaya nityadā ||22|| vighnanāśo bhaved yena taveṣṭaṃ sa kariṣyati | ityuktaścendradyumnastāṃ diśa natvā yayau puraḥ ||23|| tadā nāradasaṃsargād viditvā tu gireḥ śiraḥ | divyasiṃhavapuścāste kṛṣṇāgurutaroradhaḥ ||24|| vyāttāsyo bhīmadaśanaḥ piṃgasaṭākulo hariḥ | hiraṇyakaśiporvakṣo dārayan nakharaiḥ prabhuḥ ||25 || aruṇābho lalajjihvaḥ śaṃkhacakradharo hariḥ| | kirīṭamukuṭāḍhyaśca sphāranetrabhayaṃkaraḥ ||26 || dṛṣṭvā rājā prajāḥ sarve ānarcustaṃ harīśvaram | tato yayurnīlamaṇimādhavasya sthalaṃ śubham ||27|| nyagrodhaṃ vipulāyāmaṃ śailasānnāhamucchritam | vālukābhiḥ pūritaṃ ca drumaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam ||28|| tathā sthānaṃ yatra devaḥ svarṇasaikatasaṃvṛtaḥ | nārado darśayāmāsa naman smaran muhuḥ prabhum ||29|| vaṭamūlāt pratīcyāṃ hi nṛsiṃhasyottare nṛpa | atiṣṭhan mādhavo yatra caturmūrtidharaḥ prabhuḥ ||1.586.3 0 || anugrahītuṃ tvāmeva punaratrodbhaviṣyati | pure paureḥ sthāpitānyā mādhavasya pratikṛtiḥ ||3 1 || sāpi muktipradā cāste kā kathā brahmasthāpitā | āvirbhāvatirobhāvau prajāyete yuge yuge ||32|| anugrahārthaṃ bhaktānāṃ sthito’tra karuṇālayaḥ | iti sandarśitaṃ sthānamindradyumno nanāma tat| | | 33 || tuṣṭāva parayā prītyā dhyātvā bhūgarbhasaṃsthitam | sarve’pyupāyā bhagavan bhavanti tava darśane || 34 || tvayi dṛṣṭe prabhidyante vāsanākulakoṭayaḥ | tvameva śaraṇe dīnamanugṛhṇīṣva māṃ vibho || 35 | | carmakṛccakṣuṣā paśyāmīśa tvāṃ tatprayojanam | itibruvantaṃ cākāśavāṇī jagāda taṃ nṛpam || 36 || mā cintāṃ vraja bhūpāla vrajiṣye tvaddṛśoḥ patham | paitāmahaṃ vacaḥ prāha nārado yatkuruṣva tat| || 37|| athāha nāradastaṃ ca śraddadhānaṃ nṛpaṃ tadā | vyavasāye sukṛtīnāṃ devā yānti sahāyatām || 38 || tad gaccha rājaṃstatraiva nīlakaṇṭhasya sannidhau | sthāpayāmi nṛsiṃhaṃ ca yāgaṃ kuru ca tatpuraḥ || 39 || dakṣiṇe nīlakaṇṭhasya dhanuḥśatāntare drumaḥ | candanasya vartate’sya paścime bhūmikā śubhā | | 1.586.40 || vājimedhasahasrasya kṣetraṃ divyaṃ bhaviṣyati | viśvakarmasutastatra prāsādaṃ ghaṭṭayiṣyati ||4 1 || gaccha tvamahamatraiva sthāsyāmi dinapañcakam | ārādhyainaṃ divyasiṃhaṃ sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamam | | 42 || pratyarcāyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya prāṇendriyamanoyutam | nayiṣye tatra vai rājam̐ścandanadrumasannidhau || 43 || sannidhāvasya yāgastu phalātiśayavān bhavet | ityukto nṛpatistatra yayau dhyāne muniḥ sthitaḥ || 44| | tāvanmanuṣyarūpeṇa putro vai devaśilpinaḥ | samāyayau tvaṣṭṛsuto viśvakarmā tu satvaram || 45 || prāsādaṃ narasiṃhasya paścimānanamuttamam | caturthe divase śīghraṃ pūrṇaṃ cakāra śobhanam || 46 || tataḥ prabhāte vimale nāradaḥ suramaṇḍalaiḥ | devībhiḥ saha nṛtyaiśca vāditrairjayaghoṣaṇaiḥ || 47 | | suśobhitāṃ vimānasthāṃ maṇiratnādyalaṃkṛtām | mālāsugandhaliptāṃ ca tejaḥparidhiśobhitām | | 48 || ramyāṃ pratiṣṭhitaprāṇāṃ devībhirabhivāritām | ādāya narasiṃhasya pratyarcāṃ pratyupasthitaḥ | | 49 || rājādyāstaṃ praṇipatya sthāpayāmāsa mandire | dharāramābhyāṃ sahitāmindradyumno’tituṣṭuve || 1.586.50 || hayamedhasahasrānte yathā tvāṃ carmacakṣuṣā | divyarūpaṃ prapaśyāmi tathānukrośaya prabho | | 51 || yathā cejyasahasraṃ me nirvighnaṃ tatsamāpyate | yajñeśa tvatprasādānme tathā sānnidhyamastu te || 52 || iti stutvā virarāmārārtrikaṃ pracakāra saḥ | jyeṣṭhaśukladvādaśī yā svātīnakṣatrasaṃyutā | |53 || tasyāṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ kṣetre divyasiṃho maharṣiṇā | pūjayitvā vājimedhasahasraphalamāpnuyāt || 54|| pañcāmṛtairvā kṣīreṇa nārīkelarasena vā | sapāyasairupacārairjapāpuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet ||55|| sarvopacāraiḥ santuṣya nṛsiṃhadhāma cāpnuyāt | vaiśākhasya caturdaśyāṃ śanerdine svātyṛkṣake || |56 || ādyāvatāro nṛhareḥ sandhyāyāṃ taṃ prapūjayet | atha yajñe samāyātāḥ surāḥ ṛṣayo vaiṣṇavāḥ | |57 || pitaro vedayajñādikuśalā bhūsurāstathā | trailokye ye ca rājānaḥ siddhā vidyādharādayaḥ || 58 || kinnarā devagāndharvāścāraṇā vaiṣṇavāśca ye | samāyātā maṇḍapaśca yojanadvayabhūtale || 59 || kṛtaśca vedikā krośe kuṇḍo madhye viśālakaḥ | kṛtaḥ krośadvaye viprā yajñīyāstatra saṃsthitāḥ ||1.586.6 0 || madhye nṛpāṇāṃ devānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca śacīpatim | purodhasā samaṃ pūrvamarcayāmāsa ṛddhibhiḥ ||6 1 || tataḥ siddhān devamunīndevān rājñaśca vaiṣṇavān | viprādīn pūjayāmāsa prāha yāntu prasannatām || 62 || mahendra cānujānīhi prayakṣye yajñapūruṣam | hayamedhasahasreṇa yāvattatpūrṇatāṃ vrajet ||6 3 || tāvattvaṃ tridaśaiḥ sārdhaṃ sadomadhyagato vasa | nīlamādhavaprāptyarthaṃ yajāmi nendratāptaye || 64|| punaḥ prakāśite kṛṣṇe śreyo vo’pi bhaviṣyati | śrutvā devāstadā prāhurvayaṃ sānumatāstava ||65|| sukhaṃ yajasva rājendra vaikuṇṭhaṃ bhaktavatsalam | vayaṃ tāvannararūpā bhajiṣyāmo’tra vai harim | |66 || atha yajñasamārambhe bhagavantamapūjayat | pitṝn viprān varayitvā sapatnīka upasthitaḥ ||6 7|| svastivācyaṃ dvijān śuddhān puṇyāhaṃ vṛddhikarma ca | nirvartya varayāmāsa ṛtvijaste’pi taṃ nṛpam || 68 || sapatnīkaṃ dīkṣayitvā vedyāmāhavanīyakam | prajvalantaṃ praṇīyātha mumoca prokṣitaṃ hayam ||6 9 || tataḥ sa dīkṣito rājā vāgyato rauravīṃ tvacam | adhiṣṭhāya sadaḥsthaśca bhuktyarthaṃ sandideśa ha ||1.586.7 0 || sarvān sarvavidhānyeva bhojyāni samadāpayat | caturdaśasu lokeṣu yāni bhojyāni santi ca ||71 || yajñārhāṇi vicitrāṇi sātvikāni hyadāpayat | kāmagāvaḥ kalpavṛkṣāścintāmaṇayaḥ sarvaśaḥ ||72|| kalpalatāḥ siddhyaśca yatheṣṭaṃ racayanti tat | lakṣmīḥ svayaṃ sthitā tatra sarvasmṛddhisubhogadā ||73|| na nyūnaṃ cābhilaṣitaṃ tadyajñe cābhavattadā | caturdaśanivāsānāṃ vaibhavāḥ sadṛśāstadā ||74|| vairājānāṃ yathā tadvad āsan svāmipratāpataḥ | yatrakriyāstathā mantrā viṣayaśca kramāḥ svarāḥ ||75|| yathārthā eva tatrāsan na vai karmopaghātakam | evaṃ pravartate yajño viratau tu hareḥ kathāḥ ||76 || pravartante brahmavidyāḥ sadbhiḥ satībhirīḍitāḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathā prajāyate ||77|| agnimukhāḥ surāstṛptā nāsmarantāmarāvatīm | pātālavāsinaḥ sarve tṛptāstadbhojanaiḥ sadā ||78|| sarve cetanamūrtāśca tattadbhojanapānakaiḥ | yathā tṛptāḥ punargantuṃ gehaṃ necchāṃ vyadhurnijam ||79|| itthaṃ pravartito yajñaścendradyumnasya bhūbhṛtaḥ | trailokyatṛptidaḥ kṣetre hyapūrvaḥ puruṣottame | |1.586.80|| jagadīśaprasādāya pitāmahanideśataḥ | ekonaṃ kramaśaḥ saṃsthā avāpa pṛthivīpatiḥ ||81|| sahasraṃ hayamedhasya, nṛpatirdivyatāṃ vrajet, | somābhiṣekataḥ pūrvaṃ saptamī yā ca rātrikā ||82|| tasyāsturīyaprahare svapne rājā dadarśa ha | pratyakṣaṃ śvatadvīpaṃ ca kṣīrasāgaramadhyagam ||83|| tatra sanmaṇḍape divye varasiṃhāsanasthitam | dadṛśe śaṃkhacakrādidharaṃ śrīparameśvaram ||84|| meghavarṇaṃ vanamālādharaṃ lāvaṇyaśobhitam | saundaryaśrīniketaṃ ca sarvadivyavibhūṣaṇam ||85|| dakṣapārśve sthitaṃ śeṣamanantaṃ śvetavarṇakam | phaṇāsahasrakaiśchatrīkṛtā yena vitānikā ||86|| sakuṇḍalaṃ nīlavastraṃ halādiyukcaturbhujam | hārakeyūravalayamudrikābhiralaṃkṛtam ||87|| dakṣapārśvasthitāṃ bhadrāṃ lakṣmīṃ dadarśa vai tadā | varābhayābjahastāṃ ca kuṃkumābhāṃ sulocanām ||88|| trailokyayuvatīvṛndadṛṣṭāntādbhutavigrahām | padmāsanāṃ lāvaṇyādiguṇāḍhyāṃ suvibhūṣitām ||89|| pitāmahaṃ ca dadṛśe purato’sya kṛtāñjalim | vāmapārśvasthitaṃ cakraṃ nānāmaṇivibhūṣitam ||1.586.90|| sanakādyairmunīndraiśca stūyamānaṃ vilokya saḥ | svapnād bahiḥ samāgatya namaścakāra vai muhuḥ ||91 || mene sahasraṃ saphalaṃ yajñānāṃ svakṛtārthatām | śaśaṃsa nāradasyāgre yathā svapno’nvabhūyata ||92|| tatphalaṃ nāradaḥ prāha daśāhe haridarśanam | pratyakṣaṃ syāt tato yajñaṃ pūrṇaṃ kuru yathārthataḥ ||93|| tataḥ pravavṛte sutyā nṛpatervājimedhikā | dīyante sarvadānāni sutyābhūt kalpavallikā ||94|| tanmadhye’vabhṛthe snātuṃ kṛto yatra hrado mahān | dakṣiṇe taṭabhūdeśe bilveśvarasamīpataḥ ||95|| niyuktāḥ sevakāstatra dṛṣṭvā vaṭaṃ sasaṃbhramāḥ | nyavedayanta nṛpatiṃ dṛṣṭo vṛkṣastaṭe mahān ||96|| sāmudre ca jale mūlaṃ śākhāḥ snānagṛhābhigāḥ | śaṃkhacakrāṃkitaḥ so’sti sarvatra sūryasannibhaḥ ||97|| sugandho devabhūvṛkṣo vipṇurvyājena cāgataḥ | nāradaḥ prahasan prāha pūrṇāhutiḥ prajāyatām ||98|| svapne viṣṇustvayā dṛṣṭo dṛṣṭo vaṭastathānugaiḥ | samāpyāvabhṛthaṃ snānaṃ kṛtvotsavaṃ taṭe tathā ||99|| mahāvedyāṃ sthāpayātra yajñeśaṃ tarurūpiṇam | vicāryetthaṃ yayatuśca drumaṃ bhūpatināradau || 1.586.100 || dṛṣṭvā vṛkṣaṃ catuḥśākhaṃ caturbhujaṃ jalād bahiḥ | ākarṣayitvā manujaiḥ pūjayāmāsatuśca tau || 101 || gītavāditranirghoṣairvedamantrādibhiḥ saha | sraggandhālaṃkṛtaṃ vṛkṣaṃ mahāvedīṃ vininyatuḥ || 1 02|| sahasrairupacāraiśca vedyāṃ pupūja bhūpatiḥ | kena mūrtiḥ kathaṃ kāryetyuvāca nāradaṃ nṛpaḥ || 1 03|| tāvadākāśavāṇī cābhavattatra śubhāvahā | pracchādyatāṃ mahāvedī taruyuktā śubhāmbaraiḥ ||1 04|| pañcadaśadinānyeva svayaṃ mūtirbhaviṣyati | nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ tatra vṛddhavardhakirūpadhṛk || 1 05|| upasthitaḥ sa vai vṛddhaḥ śastrapāṇiḥ kalānvitaḥ | enamantaḥpraviśyaiva dvāraṃ badhnantu yatnataḥ || 1 06|| bahirvādyāni kurvantu yāvattu ghaṭanā bhavet | śruto hi ghaṭanāśabdo bādhiryāndhatvadāyakaḥ ||1 07|| santānanāśakaścāpi rāṣṭrasya nāśako’pi ca | nāntaḥpraveśanaṃ kuryānna paśyecca kadācana || 1 08|| niyuktadanyaḥ paśyecced rājño rāṣṭrasya caiva ha | draṣṭuścāpi mahābhītirandhatā cakṣuṣordvayoḥ || 1 09|| tasmānnāvekṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ yāvatpratimanirmitiḥ | nirvyūḍhastu svayaṃ devaḥ kṛtyānte saṃvadiṣyati || 1.586.11 0|| varddhakirghaṭayiṣyāmītyuktvā cāntardadhe tadā | vedyāṃ nārāyaṇaḥ kāṣṭhe vastrādho na vyadṛśyata || 111 || vedīṃ rājā bandhanaiśca rakṣayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ | yaduvāca girāṃ devī tadvatparicacāra ha || 1 12|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bilveśakapoteśakathā, rājño’paśakunāni, divyanṛsiṃhādidarśanam, kapoteśasthalyāṃ yajñamaṇḍapādikaraṇam, avabhṛthānte vyomavāṇyā kathitavaṭavṛkṣasya vedyāmācchādanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaśītyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 586 ||
<1.587> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca tato lakṣmi yathājātaṃ śṛṇu mūrtipraghaṭṭanam | evaṃ dine dine yāte divyagandho’nubhūyate || 1 || pārijātaprasūnānāṃ vṛṣṭiryā martyadurlabhā | divyasaṃgītanādāśca gītikā rucirāstathā || 2 || śvetavāribindavaśca candanānāṃ ca bindavaḥ | airāvatādivāraṇendrāṇāṃ madā babhūvire || 3 || adṛśyadevatāsaṃghaiḥ pūjyate vyomamārgataḥ | upāsāṃcakrire devā divyacihnāni jajñire || 4 || prāpte pañcadaśāhe ca svayaṃ pūrṇo babhūva ha | divyasiṃhāsanasaṃstho vedikāyāṃ vyadṛśyata || 5 || caturmūtirjagannātho balo bhadrā sudarśanam | sarvābharaṇaśobhādisampūrṇaṃ vai catuṣṭayam || 6 || bhadrā ceyaṃ svayaṃ lakṣmīḥ sarvacaitanyarūpiṇī | tvamāsīḥ me priye bhedastava kvacinna yujyate || 7 || kṣaṇaṃ na sahase tvaṃ māṃ moktuṃ līlāvatāriṇam | evaṃ tu mūrtayastena catasro vai prakāśitāḥ || 8 || vyomavāṇyabhavattatra rājan raṃge prakāraya | nīlaṃ viṣṇuṃ, balaṃ śvetaṃ, raktaṃ cakraṃ, pracitraya || 9 || bhadrāmaruṇāṃ ca nānālaṃkāraśobhitāṃ tathā | vinā vai citrakāraṃ tu nānyaḥ kaścid vilokayet || 1.587.1 0|| gopanīyā prayatnena paṭaniryāsavalkalaiḥ | varṣe varṣe’pi saṃskāryāḥ pūrvasaṃskāramocanāt || 11 || valkalalepasahitā mūrtirdivyā cirantanī | valkalalepanāśe tu durbhikṣaṃ maraṇaṃ tathā || 1 2|| santateśca kṣayaḥ syādvai nekṣyāstā apavāraṇāḥ | pramādānmānavaiścāpi dṛṣṭāḥ syurbhayahetavaḥ || 1 3|| tasmāt sacitrā draṣṭavyā bahuśṛṃgāracitritāḥ | nīlādrau kalpavṛkṣasya vāyavyāṃ śatahastataḥ || 14|| uttare ca nṛsiṃhasya sahasrakaramucchrayam | prāsādaṃ śikharāḍhyaṃ ca sudivyaṃ sudṛḍhāyatam || 15|| kārayitvā pratiṣṭhāpya tatraitā viniveśaya | nīlamādhavasevākṛcchabaro vaiṣṇavottamaḥ || 16|| viśvāvasuḥ purā mitraṃ purohitasya te’bhavat | śabarasya tathā tvapurohitasya ca santatiḥ || 17|| niyujyatāṃ ca pūjāyāṃ sadā sarvotsavādiṣu | itiśrutvā vyomavācaṃ bhūpastvāvṛtivastrakam || 18|| kṣaṇaṃ cottārya mūrtīstāḥ pūrṇā dadarśa śobhanāḥ | ratnasiṃhāsasthāśca tejovyāptāḥ suvartulāḥ || 1 9|| kṛṣṇaṃ padmasthitaṃ nīlaṃ pārśve ca dhavalaṃ balam | phaṇāmaṇḍalavistīrṇaṃ madhye bhadrāṃ tayoḥ śubhām ||1.587.20|| viṣṇorvāmasthitāṃ kṛṣṇahaste sudarśanaṃ tathā | kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭāstathā sarvaiḥ punarvastreṇa cāvṛtāḥ ||21 || sarve nemustataścitraśilpī raṃgādi cākarot | tataśca vedavidhinā pūjāṃ sūktairakārayat| ||22|| pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena kṛṣṇaṃ rājā hyapūjayat | lakṣmīsūktena ca bhadrāṃ dvādaśārṇena vai balam ||23|| sudarśanaṃ saudarśanyāṃ tato dānānyadāpayat | aśvamedhāṅgabhūtāśca koṭiśo gā dadau dhanam ||24|| tāsāṃ khuroddhṛteryogād garto’bhūtpāvanaḥ paraḥ | dānāmbunāpi saṃsṛṣṭastīrthaṃ cendrasaro hi tat ||25|| babhūva tārakaṃ pitruddhārakaṃ jaladānataḥ | snānātsvargapradaṃ pānādvaikuṇṭhadhāmadaṃ tathā ||26|| dānātsmṛddhipradaṃ vāsānmokṣadaṃ maraṇādapi | tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ khyātaṃ sara indradyutikṛtam ||27|| tataḥ prāsādaghaṭanāmupacakrāma bhūpatiḥ | pūrṇe tu mandire jāte sauvarṇakalaśānvite ||28|| śubhe kāle muhūrte ca viprān prapūjya devatāḥ | svastivācaṃ ca karmarddhiṃ vācayitvā nṛpastataḥ ||29|| arghyaṃ dadau jagannātha saudhasthityai ciraṃ kṣitim | samprārthya śilpino’bhyarcya vāstuyāgaṃ vidhāya ca ||1.587.30 || kṛtvā mahotsavaṃ pūjāṃ dadau dānāni bhojanam | rājā sabhāyāmagadad yanmayopārjitaṃ dhanam ||3 1 || jagannāthālayārthaṃ tatsarvaṃ dadāmi muktaye | kalevaramidaṃ kṣetraṃ yatrāhaṃbhāvavān vibhuḥ ||32|| tatsevayā ca rājyarddhiḥ saphalā me’stu tatpade | eṣa dāruvapurviṣṇuḥ sukhado dhāmabāndhavaḥ ||33|| atha mūrteḥ pṛṣṭhadeśādāgatyācyutanāmakaḥ | vipro jagāda rahasi tejomaṇḍalaśobhitaḥ ||34|| paradhāmākṣaradhāmāmṛtadhāmāvyākṛtam | goloṃ’ka cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ kṣīrodaṃ śvetadvīpakam ||35|| badarīṃ cānyadhāmāni yadi gantuṃ samiṣyate | atra stheyaṃ tadā kṣetre divye śrīpuruṣottame ||36|| parabrahmākṣarabrahmamuktabrahmāvatārakān | vyūhān divyān vibhavām̐śca tadaṃśān draṣṭumiṣyate ||37|| puruṣottamamūrteśca kartavyaṃ darśanaṃ tu taiḥ | īśalokān satyalokān vairājān svargasaṃjñakān ||38|| mānuṣān divyapātālān yadi bhoktuṃ samiṣyate | dānaṃ snānaṃ pūjanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ tvasya tairiha ||39|| aiśvaryāṇi samagrāṇi vidyāśca sakalāḥ kalāḥ | gugān sāmarthyasattādi yadi prāptuṃ samiṣyate ||1.587.40|| tadāyaṃ śrījagannāthaḥ sevyatāṃ yāvadarpaṇaiḥ | idaṃ dārumayaṃ brahma bhuktimuktipradāyakam ||41 || saccidānandakaivalyamuktidaṃ darśanādapi | nāṇvapyatra prabhedo’sti dhāmni śrīpuruṣottame ||42||| tasmād rājannatra vāsaṃ kuru mokṣaṃ prasādhaya | vidvattamo’si bhaktaśca sāṃgopāṃgamamuṃ bhaja ||43|| patrapuṣpajalakandakaṇavastrasucandanam | jalamaṇvapyarpitaṃ syādabjaguṇa jagatprabhau ||44|| lakṣmīrmātā ṛddhidā sā bhogān dāsyati bhaktake | dātre dāsyāmi sarvaṃ me nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||45|| ityuktvādṛśyatāṃ yāto vipro mūrtau harestataḥ | sarveṣāṃ samabhūd divyamāścaryaṃ gocaro hariḥ ||46|| ātmanā vartate mūrtau premṇāśrūṇi hyavāsṛjan | nāradaḥ sthiratāṃ yāto dhyānamudrāmanaimiṣīm ||47|| kurvan samādhiprajaḍaḥ premamagno’bhavat kṣaṇam | ānandaḥ prāsarattatra goloke iva tatkṣaṇam ||48|| kāryaṃ pūrṇaṃ tvadya jātaṃ proktvā nārada āha tam | enamārādhya tiṣṭhātra bhūpa yāmi pitāmaham ||49|| prāsādaṃ kuru bhūpāla dhanena mahatā tataḥ | nṛsiṃhaṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpya vimucyase sukhī bhava ||1.587.50|| kṛtaṃ nivedayiṣyāmi brahmāṇaṃ tava dāsatām | indradyumnaśca taṃ prāha nivasātra mayā saha ||51 || mandiraṃ kārayitvā ca yāsyāvo nau pitāmaham | āvāṃ vijñapayiṣyāvaḥ saḥ samāgatya vai svayam ||52||| mahotsavaṃ bhagavataḥ prāsāde’tra kariṣyati | omityaṅgīcakāraiva nāradaścātha bhūpatiḥ ||53|| yiyāsustvaritaṃ karma mandirasyānvacālayat | sahasraśastataḥ śilpivaryāṃstatra nyayojayat | vittavyayastu koṭīnāṃ na saṃkhyātuṃ praśakyate ||54||| nṛpateḥ śraddhayā bhaktyā sattvabhāvena śrīrapi | prasannā mandiraṃ kartuṃ tadā sāhāyyamācarat ||55|| garbhapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhivat kṛtvā dhṛtvā ca tāmrajām | vajrapātādivighnaghnāṃ nyasya pārśve supaṭṭikām ||56|| śikharasya ghaṭṭanārthaṃ cājñāpyāmātyakottamān | giriśṛṃgopamaṃ kartuṃ śikharaṃ gaganaṃgamam ||57|| rājā śṛṇvan devagāthāṃ prāsādaviṣayāṃ śubhām | bhūpaterdurlabhaṃ kiṃ syātsahāyo yasya nāradaḥ ||58||| brahmā viṣṇustathā lakṣmīḥ kā cātra nimnatā bhavet | prāsādaḥ kāryate tādṛṅ na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ||59|| nedṛg vai vartate cordhvaṃgamaḥ pṛthvyāṃ sthalāntare | iti śṛṇvannanāmāsau nāradaṃ cāha nāradaḥ ||1.587.60|| tīrthairmantrairjapairdānaiḥ kratubhirbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ | vratairadhyayanairbhūpa tapobhiśca yadarjitam ||6 1 || na śakyaṃ tava rājendra bhaktyā tatkaramāgatam | ataḥ paraṃ na śocasva bhaktiyoge’tirekiṇi ||62|| pitāmahaṃ draṣṭukāmo gantā cedantikaṃ vibhoḥ | upadekṣyati so’pyasya yātrāstāstā mahotsavāḥ ||63|| svayaṃ ca bhagavāneva tubhyaṃ varaṃ pradāsyati | pratiṣṭhāpite prāsāde tasmin kāle svayaṃbhuvā ||64|| ahamapyāgamiṣyāmi tadā saptarṣibhiḥ saha | tadāvāṃ tatra gacchāvo brahmalokamakalmaṣam ||65|| ityuktvā nārado bhūpo natvā kṛṣṇaṃ balaṃ satīm | anujñāṃ prārthayāmāsa brahmalokagatiṃ prati ||66|| ubhau divyavimānena brahmāṇaṃ prati jagmatuḥ | nārado bhaktiyogena cendradyumno’pi vaiṣṇavaḥ ||67|| caturdaśabhuvanāni jigyatuḥ kṛpayā hareḥ | rājāpyacintayad yāne brahmaloke kṣaṇaṃ ca yat ||6 8 || pṛthvyāṃ yugaśataṃ yāti prāsādasya tu kiṃ bhavet | punarāgamane me tu layaṃ yāsyati matkṛtam ||69 || kathaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ saṃvīkṣya gamiṣyāmi kṛtārthatām | iticintāparaṃ bhūpaṃ nāradaḥ prāha mā śucaḥ ||1.587.7 0 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī kālasya dairghyakārakaḥ | hrasvatādhāyakaḥ so’pi kṣaṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kariṣyati ||7 1 || satyabhūlokayoḥ kāle tvadarthaṃ samatāṃ prabhuḥ | svecchayā saṃvidhāyaiva nijakāryaṃ kariṣyati ||72 || yasya kāryeṣu bhagavān sahāyo’sti caturmukhaḥ | tatra kālakṛtaṃ dravyakṛtaṃ vighnaṃ na jāyate ||73 || paśyāgrataścandrakoṭyāhlādakaṃ tejasāṃ cayam | vijānīhi brahmaṇaśca sadmanastaṃ samāgatam ||74|| paśya brahmapuraṃ tvetat sabhāṃ paśya suśobhanām | tataḥ paraṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ jalopari hi vartate ||75 || tataḥ paraṃ ca vairājaṃ dhāma tasmātpare’mṛtam | paravaikuṇṭhakaṃ cāpi golokaṃ cāpi tatparam ||76 || tatparaṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāma tatparaṃ paramaṃ padam | puruṣottamadhāmāsti yatparaṃ nānyadasti vai || 77|| indradyumnaṃ vadannitthaṃ nāradasya vimānakam | brahmasabhottaradvāraṃ samāsādya sthiraṃ hyabhūt || 78 || nṛpaṃ ca nāradaṃ dṛṣṭvā nanāma dvārapālakaḥ | brahmājñāṃ ca samāgṛhya prāveśayacca tau sabhām ||79 || brahmāṇaṃ praṇaman dūre sāvitrīśāradānvitam | rājā tasthau kṣaṇaṃ tāvad brahmā bhūpaṃ samāhvayat ||1.587.8 0 || ehi rājan svāgataṃ te sākṣāt tvaṃ bhagavatpriyaḥ | nāradasya tu yogena samāyāto’si durgame ||8 1 || gṛhāṇa cāmṛtaṃ bhojyaṃ piba svādvāmṛtaṃ rasam | vada kiṃ cāgamane te kāraṇaṃ hṛdayaṃgamam ||82|| ityukto nṛpatiḥ prāha prāsādaḥ kṛpayā tava | jāto’sti tatra cāgatya pratiṣṭhāpaya mādhavam ||83 || āgatya śrījagannāthaṃ sthāpayiṣyasi cet pitaḥ | tvadanugrahaḥ saphalo bhavenmayi pitāmaha ||84|| prasīda māṃ kuruṣvedaṃ jagannāthastvameva yat | itistutastadā brahmā prāha bhūpaṃ tu sādaram ||85|| rājan kṛtastvayā satyaṃ prāsādo bhagavatsthitau | nāsmin kāle tava rājyaṃ na vā tvatsantatirnṛpa ||86|| atrāgatasya te kālaḥ pṛthvyāṃ bhūyān gato nṛpa | manvantarādhikaḥ kālo yugānāṃ śatakaṃ gatam ||87|| tava vaṃśo’pi vicchinnaḥ koṭiśaḥ kṣitipā gatāḥ | kintu rājan divyakṣetre nāmnā śrīpuruṣottame ||88|| kālasya hrāsaśaktiryā kālaśca saṃhṛtau mayā | śrīkṛṣṇasya nideśena yāvanmandirapūrṇatā ||89|| satyalokasamāstatra kṣaṇā deśāśca tatprajāḥ | kṛtā mayājñayā harestatra santi ta eva vai ||1.587.90|| śrīsvāminā mukuṭasya maṇirvyomni raviḥ kṛtaḥ | satyalokasamaṃ cāharnirmāti divyatāṃ nayan ||9 1 || tasmād gaccha mahārāja tavānupadameva ha | āyāmyeva pratiṣṭhārthaṃ saṃbhārān kuru cocitān ||92|| pūrve parārdhe bho rājan kṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | nīlāśmavapurāsthāya na tatyāja janārdanaḥ ||93 || sāmprataṃ me dvitīyaṃ tu parārdhaṃ samupasthitam | dārumūrtirayaṃ devo madāyuḥ sthāsyate punaḥ ||94|| śvetadvīpasthakṛṣṇasya romāṇi kalpapādapāḥ | tanmadhyād vaṭavṛkṣastu dārumūrtyarthamāhṛtaḥ ||95 || svayamutpatitaḥ sindhoḥ salile satyapūruṣaḥ | ghorasaṃsāranāśārthaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ prayācitaḥ ||96 || anekabhaktabhaktyā ca dāruvarṣmā janārdanaḥ | śrutvaivaṃ brahmavacanaṃ praṇipatya pitāmaham ||97|| vimānena nāradenājagāmendradyutirbhuvam | mandiraṃ subhagaṃ divyaṃ pūrṇaṃ vīkṣya jaharṣa saḥ ||98|| nanāma daṇḍavadbhūmau śrīnṛsiṃhaṃ nanāma ca | śilpyādīn prāha bhūpaśca svayaṃ brahmā pitāmahaḥ ||99|| etatpratiṣṭhānavidhau suraiḥ sahāgamiṣyati | tāvat padmanidhistatra brahmaprerita āgataḥ || 1.587.10 0|| rājā satkārapūjādi cakre svāgatamācarat |5 nāradaḥ sarvavastūnyālikhya sañcayapatrake || 101 || pratiṣṭhārthaṃ dadau padmanidhaye so’pi satvaram | sampādanaṃ suvastūnāmakārayattathā śubhām || 1 02|| śālāṃ svarṇamayīṃ tadvannagaraṃ naikayojanam | maṇḍapaṃ ca tathā kuṇḍaṃ kārayāmāsa satvaram || 103 || kārayāmāsa ca rathatrayaṃ sauvarṇamuttamam | rathaṃ ṣoḍaśacakraṃ ca viṣṇorvai garuḍadhvajam || 1 04|| padmadhvaje subhadrāyā varaṃ dvādaśacakrakam | balasya ca caturdaśacakrakaṃ darpaṇadhvajam || 105|| athavā sīriṇaḥ kāryaḥ sīradhvajaḥ samuttamaḥ | sthito hastatale nityaṃ nirmalastasya darpaṇaḥ || 106 || talasthatvādasau tālastena tālāṅkito balaḥ | hastaṣoḍaśavistāro rathaścakradharasya vai || 1 07|| caturdaśa balasyāpi subhadrāyāstu dvādaśa | na vāsitavyo devo’sāvapratiṣṭhe rathe yataḥ || 1 08|| prāsāde maṇḍape vāpi pure tanniṣphalaṃ bhavet | rājā rathapratiṣṭhāṃ ca kārayāmāsa satvaram || 1 09|| rathasyeśānadigbhāge śālāṃ kṛtvā suśobhanām | tanmadhye maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā vedīṃ tatra ca nirmalām || 1.587.110 || caturasrāṃ caturhastamitāṃ hastocchritā tathā | prakārayet pūrvarātrāvuttarataḥ śubhe kṣaṇe || 111 || svasti pravācya cāṃkurārpaṇaṃ prakārayettataḥ | dvātriṃśaddevatābhyaśca baliṃ dadyād yathāvidhi || 11 2|| prātarvedyāṃ maṇḍale svastike kuṃbhaṃ nidhāpayet | pañcapādapakvāthena puṇyatoyaiśca pallavaiḥ || 113 || ratnagandhauṣadhigaṇaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ prapūrayet | pūjayed veṣṭayed vastrāmāvāhayecca taṃ harim || 1 14|| taṃ pūjayecca vidhinā vāyavyāṃ samidhastathā | ājyaṃ caruṃ mantrayitvāṣṭasāhasraṃ hunet tataḥ || 11 5|| sampātānprāpayet kuṃbhe rathaṃ śaṃgārayettataḥ | sugandhayed dhūpayecca dhvaje nyasya samīraṇam || 1 16|| prapūjya garuḍaṃ prārthya rathamūrdhni niveśayet | taṃ kuṃbhaṃ secayet plāvayedrathaṃ garuḍopari || 1 17|| tataḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ datvā dakṣiṇāṃ bhūyasīṃ dadet | bhojayecca janān balarathaṃ prapūjayettataḥ || 118 || dvādaśākṣaramantreṇa lakṣmīsūktena śrīratham | prārthayet kamalaṃ kṛṣṇanābhestvaṃ cāsanātmakam || 11 9|| jātaṃ cāsi ca devānāmābodhārthaṃ sthiraṃ bhava | iti padmadhvaje cordhvaṃ samucchrayennamettataḥ || 1.587.120 || rathe pratiṣṭhite caivaṃ devānāropya sarvaśaḥ | manuṣyaiśca naraiḥ strībhirgajāśvavṛvabhādibhiḥ || 121 || netavyāste rathā grāme bhrāmayitvā surālayam | rathe sthitvā vipravaryairbalirdātavya uttamaḥ || 122|| baliṃ gṛhṇantu bho devā ādityā vasavo grahāḥ | marutaścāśvinau rudrāḥ suparṇāḥ pannagādayaḥ || 1 23 || asurā yātudhānāśca rathadevā vināyakāḥ | dikpālā lokapālāścarṣayaḥ kurvantu svasti ca || 1 24|| avighnamācarantvete mā santu paripanthinaḥ | saumyā bhavantu tṛptāśca daityā bhūtagaṇādayaḥ || 1 25|| tato vaidikasūktaiśca cālayet tān rathān śanaiḥ | tatrotpātān śṛṇu lakṣmi hānidā ye bhavanti 3 || 126|| īṣābhaṃge dvijabhayaṃ bhagne’kṣe kṣatriyakṣayaḥ | tulābhaṃge vaiśyanāśaḥ śamyā śūdrakṣayastathā || 127|| dhurābhaṃge tvanāvṛṣṭiḥ pīṭhabhaṃge prajābhayam | cakrabhaṃge pararājyaṃ dhvajapāte’nyabhūpatiḥ || 1 28|| mūrtibhaṃge maraṇaṃ ca paryaste deśaviplavaḥ | adhomukhe rathe jāte sarvajānapadakṣayaḥ || 129|| evaṃ jāte balikarma śāntihomaṃ prakārayet | pūrvottare ca digbhāge rathasyāgniṃ prakalpayet || 1.587.130 || samidbhirghṛtamadhvājyamūlāgrābhiśca homayet | śāntivācaṃ svastivācaṃ bhagnāṃge havanaṃ caret || 131 || svasti bhavatu bhaktebhyaḥ svasti puṃstrībhya ityapi | gopaśubhyaḥ svasti cāstu jagataḥ svasti cāstu vai || 1 32|| śāntirastu śivaṃ cāstu sarvataḥ svasti cāstu naḥ | svāminātha jagannātha rakṣāṃ śāntiṃ karotu naḥ || 133 || iti lakṣmi kārayettu śāntigrahārcanādikam | rājñā tatkāritaṃ sarvaṃ nāradenarṣiṇā tadā || 1 34|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne catuḥpratimānāṃ sampūrṇatā, pūjanaṃ, mūrtyarthaṃ prāsādanirmāṇam, indradyumnanāradayorbrahmāṇaṃ prati gamanam, pratiṣṭhārthaṃ padmanidherāgamanam, rathānāṃ nirmāṇaṃ, pūjā, dhvajādiḥ, rathe vighnaphalam, śāntikarmādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 587 ||
<1.588> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi yadā cendradyumnaḥ satyaṃ jagāma ha | tadā khaṇḍeśarājā vai niyukto’bhūnnirīkṣaṇe || 1 || gālo nāma mahīpālaścotkalelāprabhūpatiḥ | oḍhrarājaḥ sa vai proktastena mādhavamūrtikā || 2 || sthāpitā svalpakālārthaṃ nityadarśanahetave | apasārya ca tāṃ mūrtiṃ siṃhāsanavarāṇi ca || 3 || kārayāmāsa nṛpatiḥ prāsāde madhyame sthale | tāni saṃśobhayāmāsa rājā cendradyutistadā || 4 || tāvadvyomni sandadṛśe vimānaṃ brahmaṇaḥ śubham | haṃsavāhyaṃ sāvitryādiśobhitaṃ tejasānvitam || 5 || brahmā cāvātatārāsmād gaṃgājalasamanvitaḥ | jayaśabdā harṣaśabdā namaḥśabdāstadābhavan || 6 || caturdaśabhuvanānāṃ dehināṃ darśanecchayā | sammardaśca mahānāsīdahaṃpūrvikayā tadā || 7 || brahmāṇaṃ vardhayāmāsurlājākusumakākṣataiḥ | brahmā kṛṣṇarathaṃ gatvā nanāma ca dadarśa ca || 8 || tato balarathaṃ paścād bhadrārathaṃ jagāma ca | nanāma ca pratuṣṭāva pupūja divyavastubhiḥ || 9 || namaḥ kṛṣṇāya śeṣāya lakṣmyai cakrāya vai namaḥ | viṣṇurāmasubhadrāṇāmabhedāya namo namaḥ || 1.588.10 || ajñānanāśakartre ca sudarśanātmane namaḥ | evaṃ praṇamya vivṛtya nāradādiṣṭapatsṛtiḥ || 11 || nīlācalasthaprāsādaṃ vīkṣituṃ samupāgamat| | mandiraṃ maṇḍapaṃ vedīṃ śālāṃ dṛṣṭvā tutoṣa ha || 12|| brahmāsane kānane ca hyupaviṣṭaḥ svayaṃ hyajaḥ | devā ṛṣayo viprāśca niṣedustatra maṇḍape || 13 || ṛtvigādyā yathāsthānaṃ sthitā brahmājñayā tataḥ | bhāradvājaḥ samārebhe kartuṃ śāntikapauṣṭike || 14|| trailokyavāsināṃ pūjā cakāra nṛpatistadā | kalevaraṃ bhagavataḥ prāsādaṃ ca manoharam || 1 5|| pratiṣṭhāpya bharadvājaḥ samucchritamahādhvajam | vyajñāpayat pratiṣṭhāyai prāṇānāṃ tu pitāmaham || 16|| kṛtasvastyayano brahmā ṛṣibhirbrāhmaṇāribhiḥ | saha gatvā rathān vādyaghoṣairjayaravaiḥ saha || 17|| stutvāvatārayāmāsuḥ rathāt sopānavartmanā | bhaktā bhāgavatā ninyuḥ śanaiḥ prāsādasannidhim || 18 || tūlikāsu sthitāsvāsu puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūnmuhuḥ | jaya tvaṃ jagatāṃ nātha jaya kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa || 1 9|| jaya saṃkarṣaṇa bhadre jaya saukhyaṃ vidhehi naḥ | ityuddhoṣaiḥ samāninyuḥ prāsādadvāri maṇḍape || 1.588.20 || vāsayitvābhiṣekāya sammukhādarśamaṇḍale | adhivāsitakuṃbhaiśca tīrthavāryupasaṃbhṛtaiḥ ||2 1 || sūktābhyāṃ śrīpuruṣayoścakārājo’bhiṣecanam | tato hyalaṃkṛtān devān gandhamālyopaśobhitān || 22|| viprā stān saṃpracakruvaiṃ siṃhāsanagatān prabhūn | brahmā śalākayā netre tvaṃjayāmāsa nimnadṛk || 23 || nyāsām̐ścakāra vidhivad divyaśṛṃgāraśobhitān | bhāvayāmāsa divyāṃstān mūrtisthān saṃpracetanān || 24|| tato nīrājayitvā tān prārthayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ | sarvajagatpratiṣṭha tvaṃ mūrtāvatra sthiro bhava || 25|| tvayi pratiṣṭhite devā vayaṃ cāpi pratiṣṭhitāḥ | divyamūrtimayo bhūtvā prāsāde’tra sthiro vasa ||26|| tvadājñayā pratiṣṭheyaṃ pūrṇāstāṃ tvatprasādataḥ | ityuktvā hṛdayaṃ spṛṣṭvā jajāpa mantramācyutam || 27|| bhogān nivedayāmāsa bhojayāmāsa dehinaḥ | dāpayāmāsa dānāni parihāraṃ cakāra saḥ ||28|| vaiśākhasyāmale pakṣe cāṣṭamyāṃ puṣyayogataḥ | kṛtā pratiṣṭhā ca gurau brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā || 29|| taddine ca kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ snānaṃ dānaṃ japādikam | tapo vrataṃ pūjanaṃ ca sarvamakṣayatāṃ vrajet ||1.588.3 0|| taddine tatra gatvā ca kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ ca bhadrikām | sudarśanaṃ ca paśyanti muktāste mama dhāmagāḥ || 31 || atha lakṣmi dine tasmin kṛṣṇamūrtāvadṛśyata | sāyaṃ nṛsiṃho bhagavān sarvairadbhutadarśanaḥ ||32|| atha kṣaṇāntare matsyastathādṛśyata kacchapaḥ | vārāho’dṛśyata kṣaṇāntare haṃso’pyadṛśyata ||33|| hayagrīvo’dṛśyatāpi kapilo’dṛśyatāpi ca | hariścāpyadṛśyatāpi vāsudevo’pyadṛśyata ||34|| pṛthuradṛśyata tatra dattātreyo’pyadṛśyata | ṛṣabho’dṛśyata paścād vāmano’thāpyadṛśyata ||35|| paraśurāmo’dṛśyata yajñanārāyaṇastataḥ | rāmādityo’dṛśyatātha kumārāḥ sanakādayaḥ ||36|| adṛśyanta nārado’dṛśyatāpi rājarājakaḥ | vyāso buddhastataḥ svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ punaḥ ||37|| vairājo’dṛśyata tatra lakṣmīnārāyaṇo’pi ca | naranārāyaṇaścaite’dṛśyantāpi kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ||38|| atyāścaryaṃ gatāḥ sarve jñātavantaśca vai tadā | avatārā hareḥ sarve puruṣottamasaṃbhavāḥ ||39|| asmādeva prajāyante bhaktānurūpadarśanāḥ | prajahṛṣurnṛpādyāśca dṛṣṭvā hariṃ hi tādṛśam ||1.588.40|| saṃśayā nāśamāpannā avatārāvatāriṇoḥ | sarvarūpamayo mūlaṃ sākṣāt yat puruṣottamaḥ ||41 || ārādhyate yathā yena tathā tasya phalapradaḥ | yasya yāvām̐stu viśvāsastasya siddhistu tāvatī ||42|| atha brahmā jagannāthaṃ prārthayāmāsa gadgadaḥ | bhagavan indradyumnasya sahasrāṇi tu janmanām ||43|| tava bhaktiṃ kurvato’tra vyatītāni purā purā | adya janmani bhakteśca phalaṃ prāptastavecchayā ||44|| bhaktiyogena rājā tvāṃ samarcayitumicchati | upadeśaṃ pradehyenaṃ vratotsavān samādiśa ||85|| ityarthito brahmaṇāha kāṣṭhamūrtirhasan hariḥ | indradyumna prasanno’smi tava bhaktyātibhāvayā ||46|| varaṃ dadāmi te bhūpa mayi bhaktiḥ sthirāstu te | utsṛjya vittakoṭīstu yanmamāyatanaṃ kṛtam ||47|| bhaṃge’pyetasya rājendra naitat tyakṣye kadācana | anena dāruvapuṣā sthāsyāmyatra parārdhakam ||48|| dvitīyaṃ padmayonestad yāvatparisamāpyate | atha nyagrodhottarasthakūpasya ye jalena mām || 49|| rāmaṃ bhadrāṃ snāpayeyuste mallokamavāpnuyuḥ | snānasthitaṃ tu māṃ paśyet sa yāyāt paramaṃ padam ||1.588.5 0|| caturdaśyāṃ svarṇakuṃbhairuddhareyurdvijā jalam | jyeṣṭhyāṃ prātarmañcake māṃ rāmaṃ bhadrāṃ tu maṇḍape ||51|| aiśānīsthe sthāpayitvā snāpayitvā punarnayet | dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ yāntaṃ saṃpaśyenmāṃ sa mucyate ||52|| tataḥ pañcadaśāhāni sthāpayitvā tu māṃ nṛpa | virūpamabhirūpaṃ vā na paśyettu kadācana ||53|| jyeṣṭhasnānamidaṃ datvā kṛtvā mucyaieta bandhanāt | atha māghasya pañcamyāmaṣṭamyāṃ caitraśuklake ||54|| guṇḍicayātrāṃ kuryācca mokṣadā sukhadā hi sā | āṣāḍhasya dvitīyā puṣyarkṣayutāpi mokṣadā ||55|| ṛkṣābhāve tithau yātrotsavaḥ kāryoḥ mama nṛpa | tasyāṃ rathe samāropya rāmaṃ māṃ bhadrikāṃ tathā ||56 || guṇḍicāmaṇḍapaṃ nāma yatrāhamajanaṃ sthalam | aśvamedhasahasrasya vedī yatra tvayā kṛtā ||57|| tatra yātrā prakartavyā mama sthāne dharāgate | dināni nava yāsyāmi taḍāgaṃ cendradyumnakam ||58|| tataḥ paraṃ mama devālayaṃ yāsyāmi vai punaḥ | tadā draṣṭuḥ pratipadaṃ tvaśvamedhaphalaṃ bhavet| ||59|| mamotthānaṃ mama svāpaṃ matpārśvaparivartanam | mārgaprāvaraṇaṃ cāpi puṣyasnānamahotsavam ||1.588.6 0|| phālgunyāṃ krīḍanaṃ kuryād dolāyāṃ sumahotsavam | caitre sitatrayodaśyāṃ kuryāt karmaprapūraṇam ||6 1 || caitre śuklacaturdaśyāṃ damanairme prapūjanam | vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīye lepayeccandanaiśca mām ||62|| ityutsavāḥ prakartavyāstvayendradyumna sarvadā | bhuktimuktipradā me te prasādasanmukhā yataḥ ||63|| brahman satyaṃ yāhi devāḥ svargaṃ yāntu nṛpo’tra ca | tiṣṭhatu cātra sthāsye’haṃ brahmāyuḥpūrṇimāvadhim ||64|| ityuktāḥ prayayuḥ sarve kṛṣṇo mūrtirbabhūva ha | brahmā satyaṃ yayau paścād rājā cakāra cotsavān ||65|| śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi jyeṣṭhasnānaṃ śubhāvaham | jyeṣṭhaśukladaśamyāṃ ca vrataṃ saṃkalpya vāgyataḥ ||66|| ekādaśe prage yāyānmārkaṃḍeyāvaṭaṃ tataḥ | ācamya śaṃkaraṃ natvā snātvā vṛṣaṇayorvṛṣam ||67|| spṛṣṭvāṅguṣṭhena liṃgaṃ ca muṣṭinā śaktimityapi | pūjayitvā tato yāyānnārāyaṇamanāmayam ||68|| nyagrodhaṃ praṇamet kuryāt pradakṣiṇaṃ namettataḥ | garuḍaṃ praṇameccātha praviśet kṛṣṇamandiram ||69|| taṃ triḥpradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvārcayet kuryācca darśanam | upadāḥ sampradāyaivograsenamanujñāpya ca ||1.588.70 || svargadvārasya mārgeṇa yāyāt snātuṃ samudrakam | ācamya prāṅmukho likhenmaṇḍalaṃ nyāsamācaret ||71 || prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā baghnīyātkavacaṃ dṛḍham | pūrve māṃ pātu govindo vārijākṣastu dakṣiṇe ||72|| pradyumnaḥ paścime pātu hṛṣīkeśastathottare | āgneyyāṃ narasiṃhaśca nairṛtyāṃ madhusūdanaḥ ||73 || vāyavyāṃ śrīdharaḥ pātu aiśānyāṃ ca gadādharaḥ | ūrdhvaṃ trivikramaḥ pātu tvadho vārāharūpadhṛk ||74|| sarvatra pātu māṃ svāmī manaḥ kṛṣṇo narāyaṇaḥ | cittaṃ pātu garuḍastho buddhyahaṃ tu janārdanaḥ ||75|| indriyāṇi sadā pātu śrīmān patiḥ prabhāpatiḥ | iti varma dhārayitvā ṣoḍaśādyupacārakaiḥ ||76 || maṇḍale pūjayettatra śrīsvāmipuruṣottamam | antaḥśuddhyarthamācāmed bāhye darbhajalaṃ kṣipet ||77|| samudre ca triḥsnāyācca sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet | tilakaṃ bindukaṃ kuryād vastre dhṛtvārcayeddharim ||78|| maṇḍale śrīdharāyuktamāvāhayed bṛsīṃ dadet | pādyamarghyamācamanaṃ madhuparkaṃ tathāplavam ||79|| vastraṃ yajñopavītaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ gandhānulepanam | puṣpamālāṃ dhūpanaṃ ca dīpaṃ miṣṭānnapānakam ||1.588.80 || tāmbūlaṃ cārārtrikaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ stavanādikam | kṣamāparādhanaṃ visarjanaṃ kuryāt kramārcanam ||81 || dhyānaṃ dānaṃ tapo jāpyaṃ śrāddhaṃ ca surapūjanam | sindhurāje kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet ||82|| abdhiṃ ca mandiraṃ natvā yāyādindradyuteḥ saraḥ | narasiṃhamanuprārthya tatra snāyād yathāvidhi ||83|| paścimābhimukhaṃ tato yāyānnṛsiṃhamarcayet | samudre snapanaṃ kṛtvā prapaśyet puruṣottamam ||84|| evaṃ kuryāt pañcatīrthī dhruvaṃ mokṣamavāpnuyāt | jyeṣṭhaśuklapūrṇimāyāṃ jyeṣṭhāgaśca śaśī guruḥ ||85|| tadā tīrthāni gacchanti kṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | jyeṣṭhapaṃcakasaṃjñaṃ ca vratamudyāpanaṃ caret ||86|| kṛṣṇaṃ balaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ ca bhadrāṃ cakraṃ prapūjayet | nīlamādhavaṃ garuḍaṃ pūjayet puruṣottamam ||87|| svarṇakalaśe daśamīdine’rcayettu mādhavam | nārāyaṇaṃ tvekādaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ yajñasūkaram ||88|| trayodaśyāṃ ca pradyumnaṃ caturdaśyāṃ tu nṛharim | pūrṇimāyāṃ sarvadevān pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ||89|| nityaṃ vā pūrṇimāyāṃ vā naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ dadet| | miṣṭānnāni supeyāni phalādyāni samarpayet ||1.588.90 || homaṃ cāṣṭottaraśataṃ hunet sādhūn prabhojayet | gavāṃ dānāni kuryācca yatheṣṭaphalabhāgbhavet ||91 || evaṃ yātrādikaraṇānmokṣamavāpnuyād dhruvam | paṭhanācchravaṇāllakṣmi tadyātrāphalabhāg bhavet ||92|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmaṇa āgamanaṃ, jagannāthādiprāṇapratiṣṭhā, svamūrtau avatārāṇāṃ darśanam, utsavāḥ, rathayātrā, rathayātrāphalāni, pañcatīrthī, tadvidhirityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāśītyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||588||
<1.589> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mahāvedīmahotsavaṃ vadāmi te | vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīyātithau tu varayed dvijam || 1 || takṣāṇaṃ vṛṇuyāccāpi vanayāgāya vai vanam | gatvā vṛkṣamadhyabhuvi vahnāvaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 2 || hutvājyaṃ vṛkṣamūle’pi baliṃ datvā ca kṣetrape | vṛkṣamūle dvijaḥ kiñcicchindyāt tatastu vardhakiḥ || 3 || kāṣṭhānyādāya ca rathaṃ kuryād gaṇeśamarcayet | dvāviṃśatikarocchrāyaṃ caturdvāraṃ rathaṃ hareḥ || 4 || ṣoḍaśacakrasaṃyuktaṃ garuḍadhvajaśobhitam | caturdaśāraṃ śeṣasya bhadrāyā dvādaśārakam || 5 || evaṃ sāṃgān kārayitvā cākacakyāyecca tān | bṛṃhayet satpaṭaiḥ śṛṃgārayet sadratnakaiśca tān || 6 || āṣāḍhaśukladvitīyoruṇodaye’rcayeddharim | tato yātrāṃ kārayecca guṇḍikāmaṇḍapaṃ prati || 7 || rājyopacāraiḥ racayedutsavaṃ lakṣamānavaiḥ | nātaḥ parataraṃ viṣṇoryāntrātaramavekṣyate || 8 || cāturmāsye sthāpayecca kārtike’nnāni cārpayet | viṣṇoḥ prasādaṃ bhuñjīta tatpāvitryaṃ śriyā kṛtam || 9 || naivedyānnaṃ jagadbharturgāṃgaṃ vāri samaṃ dvayam | api kukkuracāṇḍālaspṛṣṭaṃ divyaṃ jalānnakam || 1.589.10 || yātrā dvādaśa vai kāryā mokṣadā jagadīśituḥ | vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīye rathanirmāṇayātrikā || 11 || jyeṣṭhe yātrāṃ pañcatīrthī padbhyāṃ gatvā samācaret | jyeṣṭhe kāryā guṇḍikābhigatirvai rathayātrikā || 1 2|| jyeṣṭhe prāsādābhigatisturyā dakṣiṇayātrikā | āṣāḍhe śayanīyātrā kartavyā māścatuṣṭayī || 13 || bhādra pārśvaparivṛttiryātrā pūjanarūpiṇī | kumude bodhinīyātrā mahotsavasvarūpiṇī || 14|| mārge prāvaraṇayātrā aurṇavastrādidhāraṇam | pauṣe puṣyasnānayātrā tapaḥsnānātmikā śubhā || 1 5|| pauṣe sūryottarayānayātrā puṇyātmikā matā | māghe vasantayātrā ca pūjotsavātmikā matā || 16 || phālgune puṣpadolāyā dolāyāḥ śrāvaṇe’thavā | evaṃ mahotsavāḥ kāryā mokṣadā jagadīśituḥ | | 17|| jagannāthapure divye jātibhedo na vidyate | naranārīprabhedo’pi tatra kāryo na sarvathā || 18|| sarve caturbhujā divyā dṛśyante tu dvihastakāḥ | vasanti sarve muktā me puṇyapuñjapradāyakāḥ || 1 9|| sarvaṃ prāsādikaṃ me’sti divyaṃ doṣavihīnakam | golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ mayā pṛthvyāṃ samāhitam || 1.589.20 || nāryo lakṣmyo narā nārāyaṇā me jagadīśituḥ | kṛpayā ca pratāpenānugraheṇa matā mama || 21 || bhojyānnapānavastrādi nāśuddhaṃ tatra vidyate | ekādaśīmayā tatrānnāśane tu vaśīkṛtā || 22|| matprasādānnabhojyairna dūṣaṇaṃ kintu bhūṣaṇam | sādhusevā gurusevā mama sevātra muktidā ||23|| mayā gopīvihārairdīyate śaśvaddhi darśanam | divyā krīḍā kāmarūpā saṃśayātmavināśinī ||24|| divyabhāvātmanāṃ mokṣānandasandohadāyinī | evaṃ svātmani vijñāya divyatāṃ yānti dehinaḥ || 25|| ahaṃ gopīpatirvṛndāvane kuṃkumavāpike | puruṣottamabhūmau ca durgabhūmau prasiddhimān ||26|| yasmai yasmai prasannaḥ syāṃ nānyattasyāvaśiṣyate | ānandadātā vai cāsmi yathā yairmatta iṣyate ||27|| lakṣmi kṣetre mokṣade me sthāpanaṃ jagadīśvare | darśanaṃ sparśanaṃ dūrasmaraṇaṃ cāpi mokṣadam ||28|| tubhyaṃ mayā kathito’yaṃ kṛtasantānakhaṇḍakaḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ prathamakottamaḥ ||29|| atrārambhe nāradasya vaikuṇṭhe dravatā harau | muktādīnāṃ dravamuktiḥ sākāratvaṃ pare’kṣare ||1.589.3 0|| golokasya pranirmāṇaṃ rādhārthaṃ kṛṣṇarūpataḥ | vaikuṇṭhasya ca nirmāṇaṃ lakṣmyarthaṃ cākṣareśituḥ ||3 1 || vāsudevātsamārabhya parameṣṭhyantasarjanam | brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāmanekatvaṃ tataḥ param ||32|| avyākṛtasya ca badrikāśramasya ca divyatā | brahmaṇā vīkṣitā sṛṣṭirnārāyaṇatanau dhiyai ||3 3 || brahmaviṣṇvormahattve ca vivādaḥ kavacādikam | brahmatejomayaśaṃbhuliṃgāvirbhāvakīrtanam ||34|| liṅgāntavīkṣaṇe mṛṣāvādī brahmā ca ketakī | apūjyatāṃ sadā prāptau viṣṇośca pūjyateti ca ||35|| aṇvaṇḍānāṃ samutpattirāvaraṇeṣu vāsinaḥ | kṣaṇādikamahākālagaṇanā ca tataḥ param ||36|| brahmaṇā ca guṇājñānādharmādyā mānasāḥ kṛtāḥ | dharmarudrakṛtāntānāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ rudralayastathā ||37|| sāttvikarudrarudrāṇīdāsadāsīprasarjanam | sanakādiśāntasṛṣṭirvedaprākaṭyamityapi ||38|| māhātmyaṃ ca satāṃ divyagītādisṛṣṭirityapi | upaniṣatkanyakānāṃ sṛṣṭirvidyāprasarjanam ||39|| brahmapriyādigāyatrīsarasvatīprasarjanam | ekādaśījayantyādibhaktyārādhanasarjanam ||1.589.40|| mahālakṣmīramārādhāsatīgaṃgādisarjanam | sādhvīnāṃ divyanārīṇāṃ divyacihnaguṇādikam ||41 || nārāyaṇāvatārātmanaranārīpracihnakam | pativratāyā utpattiḥ sāmarthyaṃ ca tataḥ param ||42|| kuṃkumākṣatatāmbūlanārikelarasādikam | raktagairikadhātvādi yathotpannaṃ tathoditam ||43|| kāmadhenusamutpattiḥ kāmadevādisarjanam | patnīvratadvijotpattiḥ pitṛsevāmahattvakam ||44|| patnīvratasya māhātmyam ṛṇānubandhiputratā | garbhe niṣeke prābalyaṃ kāladeśādijaṃ tathā ||45|| niṣekasamayo rajodoṣāpaharaṇaṃ vratam | ādye dine brahmaṇastu brāhmaṇānāṃ prasarjanam ||46 || satyaloke mānasī carṣīṇāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ prakāśitā | maharjanatapaḥsveva pitṝṇāṃ sarjanaṃ tathā ||47|| pitṛbhyo deyamannādi havyavṛkṣādikaṃ tathā | sūryotpattirhiraṇyādi dhāma candrodbhavastathā ||48|| rohiṇyāṃ pakṣapātena candrasya kṣayarugṇatā | saurāṣṭre somanāthasya sthāpanāt kṣayahīnatā ||49|| devamānuṣabhūtādidaityadānavajaṃgamāḥ | yathā sṛṣṭā uditāste yugavarṣādisiddhayaḥ ||1.589.5 0|| siddhihrāso nagarādyauṣadhivarṇāśramādikam | viśvarūpasya hatyāyāścaturdhādānamityapi ||5 1 || dadhyañcāsthikṛtavajraṃ vṛtranāśo’śvamedhakaḥ | varāhasyāvatāraśca pṛthoścāvatarastathā ||52|| mithunīsṛṣṭisañcāraḥ svapnaṃ mṛtyupradaṃ tathā | cakravartipracihnāni hiṃsāpakṣiprapātanam ||5 3 || dvāparasya svabhāvāśca raivataṃ nāradāgamaḥ | tattvoddeśo vivaraśca bhuvo vivarapūraṇam ||54|| raivatasya candrabhāvo maṇyaṃśo raivataḥ svayam | khadvāṃgasya tapaścāśvapaṭṭasarasi varṇitam ||55|| kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ gopālakṛṣṇakodbhavaḥ | kambharāyā mahālakṣmyāḥ prādurbhāvaḥ samīritaḥ ||56 || lakṣmīnārāyaṇajanma barhiṣāṃgadakodbhavaḥ | pannīvratarṣeśca gale mṛtasarpaprasañjanam |||57||| ṛṣeḥ putrasya śāpena kuhakadaṃśa ityapi | prāyopaveśanaṃ rājñaḥ kathāyāḥ sthāpanaṃ tathā ||58|| mūrtidhyānaṃ vratadāyāstaṭe dhanvantarergamaḥ | sarpasatre rakṣaṇaṃ ca sūryasyāpi vivāhanam ||5 9 || sūryapatnyāstu saṃjñāyā rūpadvayasya dhāraṇam | śrāddhadevayamayamījananaṃ ca tataḥ param ||1.589.6 0|| chāyāyāmaśvinīvaidyādyutpattiśca tataḥ param | yāmyamārgapurāṇāṃ varṇanaṃ nārakavarṇanam ||6 1 || nārakāṇāṃ phalaṃ karma janmacihnādikaṃ tathā | śārīradaivacihnāni śriyāścihnāni yoṣitām ||62|| śavaurdhvadaihikaṃ pretapīḍā tasyā nivāraṇam | pretatā pretabhojyādi sūtakaṃ piṇḍakārpaṇam ||63 || dānaphalaṃ piṇḍabrahmāṇḍaikyaṃ niṣekanirmitiḥ | mṛtānāṃ dānakāryādyairgatayo muktisādhanam ||64|| nārāyaṇabaliścāpi dhanvantareḥ kathā tathā | somajanma gurupatnyā apahṛtirbudhodbhavaḥ ||65|| dhanvantaritrayajanma divodāsakathānakam | śaṃbhorvārāṇasītyāgo divodāse savighnatā ||66 || yoginyarkavidhātṛśrīgaṇeśasvapnavartanam | viṣṇornāstikyakaraṇaṃ rājñaḥ pratāpanāśanam ||67|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ saptāhavācanam | viśveśvarapratiṣṭhā ca rājño bhaktivivardhanam ||68|| indrasadasi ca guroravamānaṃ durvāsasaḥ | mālāyā avamānaṃ ca śrīhrāso’bdhipramanthanam ||69|| ratnotpattiramṛtārthe daityānāṃ vañcanaṃ tathā | surāsuraraṇaḥ paścāt pārvatyai mantrayojanam ||1.589.70|| puṇyavrataṃ ca putrārthaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanamityapi | kārtikeyasamutpattirdevasenāpatitvakam ||71 || tārakāsuranāśaśca tārakākhyānamityapi | bhikṣārthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇagatirgaṇeśotpattirityapi ||72|| śironāśo gajamastakasya sandhānamarcanam | śanerdṛṣṭeḥ phalaṃ ceti gaṇeśakārtikeyayoḥ ||73|| pṛthvīpradakṣiṇaṃ cāpi vivāho mallikārjunam | naranārāyaṇaprādurbhāvaḥ pitroḥ prasevanam ||74|| śaṃbhovaiṣṇavadīkṣāyā grahaḥ satyā api grahaḥ | taptacakrāṃkanapuṇyaṃ mantrārthāstilākāni ca ||75|| dhāmnāṃ nāmāni ca parabrahmadhāmnaḥ pravarṇanam | akṣaravarṇanaṃ cāpi golokavarṇanaṃ tathā ||76|| sthānānāṃ gopurādīnāṃ paṭṭāṃganānāṃ varṇanam | mahāvaikuṇṭhakathanaṃ saptavyūhādivarṇanam ||77|| dāsadāsībhavanānāṃ pārṣadānāṃ ca varṇanam | dvitīyavaikuṇṭhakasya varṇanaṃ ca jalopari ||78|| tṛtīyaśvetadvīpasya varṇanaṃ sopabhūtikam | caturthakṣīravārdhisthavaikuṇṭhavarṇanaṃ tathā ||79|| śaṃbhorbhasmāvaguṇṭhādiśaṃkāyā vāraṇaṃ tathā | hayagrīvāsurotpattirmatsyāvataraṇaṃ tathā ||1.589.80 || naukāyā dhāraṇaṃ hiraṇyākṣanāśo varāhataḥ | jayasya vijayasyāpi vaikuṇṭhāttu vivāsanam ||81 || vārāheṇa yathāsthānaṃ pṛthivyāḥ sthāpanaṃ tataḥ | tapo hiraṇyakaśipoḥ rudrācca varadānakam ||82|| prahlādasya tato dveṣo nṛharerudbhavastataḥ | hiraṇyakaśipornāśaḥ prahlādasya prarakṣaṇam ||83 || raivatādrau vāmanasya pratāpaśca pradakṣiṇam | mayarājasya yajñaśca tīrthāni vividhāni ca ||84|| aditeśca tapaścaryā vāmanotpattirityapi | baleryajñe yācanā cendrāya trilokadānakam ||85 || payovrataṃ mṛgīkuṇḍakathā śakunakāni ca | tīrthavidhirvratādīni cendreśvarakathānakam ||86 || śivarātrimahimādi mandarādyāgamastathā | anekatīrthāgamanaṃ mahālakṣmīprapūjanam ||87|| alakṣmyāśca samutpattirvāsasthānāni yānyapi | dvādaśyāṃ harivāsatvaṃ sthānaṃ lakṣmyāḥ samarcanam ||88|| revatījanma ca durdamena saha vivāhanam | revatasya tathā janma kṛtavāco gṛhe punaḥ ||89|| revatījanma ca vivāhanaṃ balena pa punaḥ | tīrthe dāmodarakuṇḍe śrāddhādikaphalaṃ tathā ||1.589.90|| patnīvratadvijasyātra sarvadhāmapradarśanam | dvayornārāyaṇayośca śrāddhakarmapravartanam ||91 || vastrāpathasya tīrthāni rādhālakṣmyādisaṃbhavaḥ | maghukaiṭabhanāśārthaṃ mohinībhavanaṃ hareḥ ||92|| mahiṣāsuranāśārthaṃ kātyāyanīprakāśyatā | brahmaṇo vīryato janma maharṣīṇāṃ puroditam ||93 || satījanma dakṣajanma punarnāradajanma ca | śuṃbhaniśuṃbhayorjanma kālīcāmuṇḍikājanuḥ ||94|| raktabījādināśaśca devīsainyodbhavastathā | śuṃbhādīnāṃ vināśaśca satīprākaṭyakotsavaḥ ||95|| gopagopīgaṇotpādo devyutpattiśca naikadhā | śaṃbhorvairājabhālotthā satyāstapasi vartanam |||96 || vivāhaśca vālakhilyādyutpattirvedhaso’pi ca | kailāsapuranirmāṇaṃ śivasyātmaniveditā || 97|| dakṣayajñe dvijānāṃ ca śāpāḥ satyā vināśanam | vīrabhadrakṛtayajñabhaṃgo dakṣasya vai tapaḥ ||98|| śaṃbhorbhasmāsthidhāritvaṃ pārvatījanma ityapi | pitṛkanyāstisra etā menā dhanyā kalāvatī ||99|| tāsāṃ putryaḥ śivā cāpi sitā rādhā haripriyāḥ | kālīmantrotsavaścāpi pārvatīguṇavarṇanam || 1.589.100 || pārvatītapa evātha maṃgalotpattireva ca | śaṃbhorgolokadhenvāṃ vai vṛṣarūpodbhavastathā || 101 || brahmavīryādbrahmaparyo brahmasarasa ityapi | śaṃbhorvīryācca hanumān vāyudvārā samudgataḥ || 1 02|| śanaiścaraḥ pannatiśca kāmadāho varastataḥ | gaurītapaḥ śaṃkarasya darśanaṃ ca gṛhaṃ gatiḥ | 1 03|| śaṃbhośca nartanaṃ śivanindā lagnavinirṇayaḥ | maṃgalaṃ maṇḍapaśobhā patrikā varayātrikā || 1 04|| menāśokanivṛttiśca varasyāpi prapūjanam | kuladevīpūjanaṃ ca śivasya maṇḍapāgamaḥ || 105 || vivāhaḥ kālikāyāśca gaurī jātā tataḥ param | liṃgapāto dvādaśajyotirliṃgānāṃ samudbhavaḥ | | 106 || gurupūjāmahimādi sandhyāpitrādikodbhavaḥ | svarṇotpattirnāradasya tathā gandharvaputratā || 1 07|| maraṇaṃ jīvadānaṃ ca vaiṣṇavatvaṃ mṛtistathā | punarnāradajanmāpi kailāsagamanam ṛṣeḥ || 1 08|| śaṃkarād brahmajñānaṃ ca badaryāgamanam ṛṣeḥ | tīrthāni mārkaṃḍakasya cirajīvitvakāraṇam || 1 09|| pañcaśilāditīrthāni somakuṇḍādayastathā | urvaśyāśca samutpattitīrthādīni śubhāni ca || 1.589.11 0|| nāradasya vivāhaśca tathāgnivaṃśavarṇanam | kāśyapīyaprajoddeśaḥ kalpādīnāṃ ca varṇanam | | 111 || kalerdharmā athānartānītasaurāṣṭrdeśatā | dvārikāvarṇanaṃ cāpi gomatyādikavarṇanam | | 1 12| | nṛgarājasamākhyānaṃ durvāsaso rathe sthitiḥ | gopītaṭākamāhātmyaṃ brahmakuṇḍāditīrthakam || 11 3|| kuśādidaityanāśaśca paṭṭarājñīsthalāni ca | kṛṣṇārcanaṃ somaśarmapitṛpramokṣaṇaṃ tathā ||1 14|| śaṃkhapiṇḍārakatīrthaṃ godāvaryāstathāgamaḥ | vajralepāghanāśitvaṃ māyānandakathānakam || 1 15|| trispṛśaikādaśī daityamuranāśādikaṃ tathā| unmīlanī pakṣavardhā tathānyāsāṃ vratāni ca || 1 16|| svarṇāṃgadasya ca vaiśvānarasya luṃbhakasya ca | ketumataḥ kapilāyā gāndharvayoḥ kathāstathā ||1 17|| parśurāmajayo dhātrīkathā medhāvinaḥ kathā | lalitayoḥ kathā varūthoddhārādiprakīrtanam || 1 18|| dhṛṣṭabuddhervimuktiśca śalabhāmokṣaṇaṃ tathā | kratvākhyānaṃ hemamālyākhyānaṃ vāmanakṛcchrakam || 1 19|| śrāvaṇānāṃ mahāsiddhiḥ rateḥ kāmābhiprāpaṇam | pururavopākhyānaṃ ca hariścandrakathā tataḥ || 1.589.120|| māndhātṛkathanaṃ śūdratapo dharmasya nāśanam | candrasenakathā vedaśiraḥkathānakaṃ tathā || 121 || indrasenacandrabhāgākathā cāṇḍālamokṣaṇam | kṛcchravratāni ca śākaṭāyanasyarddhivardhanam || 1 22|| puṇḍarīkakumudvatyorakṣarākhyapade gatiḥ | udyāpanaṃ ca pratipadvratāni ca bahūnyapi || 1 23|| dvitīyāyāstṛtīyāyāścaturthyāśca vratānyapi | pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhikāyāḥ saptamyā vratāni yānyapi || 124|| aṣṭamyā navamyāśca daśamyāśca vratānyapi | ekādaśyā dvādaśyāśca trayodaśyā vratāni ca || 1 25|| caturdaśyāḥ pūrṇimāyā amāyāśca vratāni ca | dolāvrataṃ rathayātrā dhanurmāso vasantakaḥ || 1 26|| saṃkrāntiholikāpuṣpadolāśca śāradotsavaḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇavrataṃ sumateśca kathānakam || 1 27|| haripañcakasaṃjñaṃ ca vrataṃ vāravratāni ca | rukmāṃgadasamākhyānaṃ viddhākhyamohinīkṛtam || 1 28|| yamasya śocanaṃ mohinyāśca janma tataḥ param | rukmāṃgadasya patnītvaṃ vratabhaṃgakaraṃ vacaḥ || 129|| dharmāṃgadākhyaputrasya śiro’rpaṇādikaṃ tataḥ | mohinyā dāhanaṃ paścād viddhātithitvamityapi || 1.589.130 || puruṣottamamāsasya vratadānamahattvakam | badaryāṃ malamāsasya tiraskāre tataḥ param || 131 || akṣaraṃ dhāma gamanaṃ puruṣottamanāmitā | tṛtīyārcāphalaṃ ramākṛtaṃ caturthikāvratam || 1 32|| śāradā śrīhareḥ patnī jātā vai pañcamīvratāt | menādhanyākalānāṃ tu ṣaṣṭhīvratena īśvarāḥ || 123|| jāmātaro’bhavan śaṃbhurāmakṛṣṇāḥ pareśvarāḥ | patayaḥ pārvatīsītārādhānāṃ parameśvarāḥ || 1 34|| saptamīvratataḥ siddhibuddhibhyāṃ śrīgaṇeśvaraḥ | patiḥ prāptaśca golokeśvaraḥ śrīkṛṣṇa eva yaḥ ||1 35|| aṣṭamīvratato ghaṇṭākambudundubhiprabhṛteḥ | vādyagaṇasya devānāṃ sannidhau vasatiḥ sadā ||136|| navamīvratato vahnisuvarṇayoḥ prapūjyatā | daśamīvratataḥ pṛthvyāmavatāro hareḥ sadā || 1 37|| ekādaśīvratānmūrtyā naranārāyaṇodbhavaḥ | dvādaśīvratataḥ sāvitrī brahmāṇamavāpa ha || 1 38|| trayodaśīvratājjayālalitāpārvatīprabhāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāpuḥ patiṃ mudā || 139|| caturdaśīvratāllakṣmīrmāṇikī cāpatuḥ patim | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāminamīśvaram || 1.589.140 || pūrṇāvratātpreyasīśreyasyoḥ patirnarāyaṇaḥ | anyapakṣe pratipadi vratāt sahasranetrakaḥ || 141 || rājā hyavāpa ca padaṃ vairājaṃ caiśvaraṃ śubham | dvitīyāyā vratāt sarvahuto nṛpaḥ ṛtambharā || 142|| patnī jātau parameṣṭhī gāyatrī ceti daivatau | tṛtīyāyā vratād brahmasavitā nṛpatistathā || 143|| bhūriśṛṃgā ca tatpatnī sūryasaṃjñe babhūvatuḥ | caturthīvratakaraṇāt samitpīyūṣabhūpatiḥ || 144|| saptaviṃśatipatnībhiḥ saha candro babhūva ha | pañcamīvratakaraṇād vasudānanṛpastathā || 145|| rādhyāsā tasya patnī ca hiraṇmayau babhūvatuḥ | ṣaṣṭhīvratena ca devayavagirikṣitau purā || 146|| patnībhyāṃ saha māhendrapadamavāpaturdivi | saptamīvratakaraṇātsandhyā jātā hyarundhatī || 147|| sandhyā dvedhā samutpannā kāmasya yauvane gatiḥ | aṣṭamīvratakaraṇād gopālakṛṣṇasadgṛhe || 148|| kambharālakṣmīsuto’bhūt śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ | navamīvratakaraṇāt śatamakhanṛpagṛhe || 149|| dyuvarṇāyāṃ rāmādityanarādityau babhūvatuḥ | daśamīvratakaraṇād vikuṇṭhāyāḥ svarūpataḥ || 1.589.150|| ṣaṭśrīrūpāṇi catvāri vaikuṇṭhānyabhavanpurā | ekādaśīvratenāpi vamrī daśapracetasām || 151|| patnī jātā vṛkṣaputrī brahmatanuvirājitā | dvādaśīvratakaraṇāj jyoṣṭrī tredhā hareḥ priyā || 152|| trayodaśīvratena sudughā pañcapatipriyā | caturdaśīvratād dṛḍhadhanvā mokṣamavāpa ha || 153|| amāyā vratakaraṇāt kadaryamokṣaṇādikam | dharmapatnyaśca tatputrāḥ brahmādyā brahmadarśakāḥ || 1 54|| vratārādhanayā jātā harerdarśanakāriṇaḥ | jālaṃdharasamākhyāne vṛndāyā rādhikāśapāt ||155|| kālanemisutā tvaṃ ca jālandharodbhavastathā | devaparājayo jālaṃdharagṛhe’vasaddhariḥ || 156 || jālaṃdharo yayau netuṃ pārvatīṃ kailakāsanam | vṛndāpātivratyabhaṃgo jālandharavināśanam || 157|| vṛndādatto dharmadeve śāpo vṛndā tu tūlasī | lakṣmyāstulasīrūpatvaṃ gaṃgādyāḥ saritastathā || 158| | padmāvatyāstūlasītvaṃ sītā kuśadhvajodbhavā | sudāmā śaṃkhacūḍo’bhūt yuddhaṃ tasya ca śaṃbhunā || 159|| tulasīśilabhaṃgaśca viṣṇuḥ śālaśilātmakaḥ | pūjāmāhātmyaṃ tulasīviṣṇvorvivāhanaṃ tathā || 1.589.160 || gaṇḍakīviṣṇusālaṃkāyanākhyānāni cakrakam | śālagrāmāt hariharakṣetre tīrthāni vai tataḥ || 161 || ruruṛṣīkeśatīrthaṃ lohārgalādikaṃ tathā | māthurakṣetramāhātmyaṃ kṛṣṇāvataraṇaṃ purā || 162|| niṣādasya rājajanma rākṣasasya ca mokṣaṇam | bhāṇḍīrādikatīrthāni prakramaṇaṃ vanāni ca || 163 || viprasya brahmahatyādināśanaṃ kapilāttataḥ | vārāhamūrtidivyatvaṃ pratiṣṭhānādikaṃ tataḥ || 164|| viśrāmaghāṭasnānena rākṣasatvanivāraṇam | ḍākinyādimokṣaṇaṃ ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṛtam || 165|| subhadrasya sutaprāptirgaukarṇaṃ tīrthamityapi | kuṃkumavāpikodyāne vṛkṣavallyādidivyatā ||166|| śukamokṣaśca gokarṇadvārā pretapramokṣaṇam | pāñcāladvijamuktiśca bhaginīratināśikā || 167|| sāmbe kṣobhajapāpānāṃ kṣālanaṃ kṛṣṇayoṣitām | dhruvatīrthe koṭipitruddhāro dāsīkṛtaḥ purā ||168|| niminā putratṛptyarthaṃ śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ vidhānataḥ | medhātitheḥ kathā śrāddhe pitaraśca pradarśitāḥ ||169|| nāciketaḥkathā yāmyapurīprākāravarṇanam | nārakāṇāṃ darśanaṃ ca phalodayasamīraṇam || 1.589.170|| pativratāyā māhātmye janakastrī vane purā | sampadvatī ca sañjātā pātivratyakathā tathā || 171 || dhenusevā sādhusevā sāvitryāṃ vedadarśanam | saramā gorakṣayitrī daityān dadāha śāpataḥ ||172|| aśvapatigṛhe putrī sāvitrī tapasābhavat | karmaphalānāṃ kathanaṃ satyavataśca jīvanam || 173 || padmāyāḥ pippalādena vivāho dharmaśāpanam | mahālakṣmyāḥ kathā divyā nahuṣasya ca sarpatā || 174|| ahalyayā kāśirakṣendrasya bhagāṃgatā tathā| sītārāmavanāvāso rāvaṇādivināśanam || 175|| pātivratye rādhikāyā upadeśapraśaṃsanam | gṛhagodhākathā cāpi kāṣṭhilāyāḥ kathānakam || 176|| strīdharmāṇāṃ varṇanaṃ ca hariṇyā vanarakṣaṇam | reṇukāyāḥ kathā divyā bhārgavyāśca kathā tathā || 177|| bhārgavyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena ca vivāhanam | cyavanarṣikathā tena sukanyāyā vivāhanam || 178|| māṇḍavyasya kauśikasya kathā sūryodayādikam | madālasāvivāhaśca putrāṇāmupadeśanam || 179|| alarkasyātmavijñānaṃ dattātreyasya śiṣyatā | padminyā janma ca tathā nārāyaṇavivāhanam || 1.589.180|| veṃkaṭādrau toṇḍamānakṛtavārāhamandiram | ṛkṣaviśvāsasya hantuḥ dharmaguptādikasya ca || 181|| muktiśca sumatibhadrarāmānujapramokṣaṇam | jābālitumburutīrthaṃ vyāsasya pūjanādikam || 182|| brahmahatyānivāraśca suvarṇamukharyāgamaḥ | vārāhodbhava āñjanyāstapaḥ pakṣajaḍībhavaḥ || 183|| mahendrādijaḍībhāvaḥ khyāterujjīvanaṃ tathā | jayantī devayānī ca śukrakathā tathoditā || 184|| nāradasya punarujjīvanaṃ mālāvatīkṛtam | vīrāyāśca prabhāvatyāścamatkārau tathoditau ||185|| śaktipatnyā śilārūpā jātāḥ śaptā yamādayaḥ | ambarīṣasamutpattiḥ śrīmatyāścāpi mokṣaṇam || 186|| daridratābubhukṣākalahādīnāṃ nivāsanam | dāsīkiṃkarīpaṇyastrīdānadharmanirūpaṇam || 187|| pātivratyaṃ harau kṛṣṇe bāle nāginīsaṃdhṛtam | lakṣmyādisatyudbhavaścāsaṃkhyapatnīsamudbhavaḥ || 188|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśanaṃ purā | śrīmacchrīkambharālakṣmīgopālakṛṣṇayostapaḥ || 189|| caturyugānāṃ dharmāśca tato vai sannirūpitāḥ | triveṇyā nūtanaṃ svargaṃ bharadvājagṛhe kṛtam || 1.589.1 90|| śabarīpampayoḥ rāmayogena mokṣaṇaṃ tathā | citralekhācamatkārā mahīsāgarasaṃgame || 191 || kalahāyā rākṣasītvaṃ tataśca mokṣaṇaṃ param | colarājaviṣṇudāsakathā kaikayījanma ca || 1 92|| gokulakanyakāmokṣo gopīnāṃ kṛṣṇamelanam | vīrabāhoḥ kāntimatyāḥ muktirjanmatrayottaram ||1 93|| kālindyā uddhavasyāpi cānyāsāṃ pativartanam | dānakanṛpateryātrā nārakāṇāṃ ca mokṣaṇam || 1 94|| saṃhitāyāḥ kathāśrāvāt piśācatvavimokṣaṇam | hemantasya pātivratyād rājyaprāptiḥ pramokṣaṇam || 1 95|| patidveṣṭryāḥ śunītvaṃ corvaśītvaṃ ca tataḥ param | vidhūmasyālambuṣāyā mokṣaṇaṃ parikīrtitam || 1 96|| vidyādharasudarśasya vetālatvanivāraṇam | jaratkārvīcamatkāraḥ sumitrāyāḥ prabhāvanam || 1 97|| puṇyanidheḥ sutā lakṣmīḥ nārāyaṇakṛpādikam | tapato dharmadevasya vardhinī sevikābhavat || 1 98|| gāndharvīṇāṃ kuladevītvādikaṃ vipragotrakam | strīṇāṃ mokṣaḥ tulasyādivṛkṣāṇāṃ devatātmatā ||1 99|| suyajñarājasūye ca kṛtaghnānāṃ vivecanam | suyajñasya tatpatnyāśca golokagamanaṃ tathā ||1.589.20 0 || tārāyā haraṇaṃ candrarakṣaṇaṃ dharmabodhanam | dāśārhanṛpateḥ kṛṣṇamantragrahaṇe yogyatā ||201 || sīmantīnyā jale magnaḥ svapatiścopajīvitaḥ | kanyāveṣasya putrasya putrītvaṃ samajāyata ||202|| puṇyakena vratenāpi gaṇeśaputralābhanam | śabaradampatībhasma punastayośca jīvanam ||203|| śāradāyāḥ kṛṣṇabhaktyā kṛṣṇapatipramelanam | śivācyutau cakraturvāravanitāpramokṣaṇam ||204|| bandulāyāḥ samuddhāro vindhyādrervardhanaṃ tathā | lopāmudrāpātivratyaṃ kāśīyātrādikaṃ tataḥ ||205|| jamadagnervināśaśca reṇukāyāḥ satīvratam | manoramāsatītvaṃ ca sahasrārjunanāśanam ||206|| gaṇeśasyaikadantatvaṃ gṛhapatyasya rakṣaṇam | suśilāyā rājyalābho mokṣaṇaṃ patibhaktitaḥ ||207|| strīṇāṃ pavitratā śreṣṭhacihnānyapi bahūnyapi | draupadyā kṛtadurvāsobhojanābhyāgamādikam ||208|| kadrūvinatāsamvādaḥ sūryāśvaviṣayastathā | vinatāyāśca dāsītvaṃ garuḍena vināśitam ||209|| līlāvatyāstathā mokṣo dhūtapāpā pativratā | dharmadevaṃ patiṃ prāptā kalāvatyāścamatkṛtiḥ ||1.589.21 0|| gāndharvī kṛṣṇayogena golokadhāmagābhavat | saptarṣipramadāḥ kṛṣṇayogena divyatāṃ gatāḥ ||21 1 || surasā nāminī kṛṣṇabhaktyā saubhāgyamāgatā | maṇḍukī śivabhaktyā ca gandharvī samajāyata ||212|| pārāvatadvayaṃ bhaktyā muktimavāpa śāśvatīm | yamasya dharmarājatvaṃ paulomyā indrabhāryatā ||21 3 || abhijinnṛpateḥ putraprāptirgolokamokṣaṇam | durvāsasaḥ kadalyāśca vivāhaḥ kadalīdrumaḥ || 214|| ambarīṣādbhayaṃ tasya vāraṇaṃ bhaktasevanam | tvāṣṭrasya tu catuḥṣaṣṭikalāpatnīpralābhanam ||215|| kāśyāṃ vyāsacamatkāraḥ pārvatīmahimā tathā | agniśarmā vālmikī cābhavanmuktiṃ tato gataḥ ||216|| avantyāṃ lakṣmaṇasyāpi manomālinyamityapi | vahnispṛṣṭāḥ ṛṣipatnyaḥ śuddhā vai pañcamīvratāt || 217|| vyāsajanma narmadāyāḥ pātivratyādikaṃ śubham | anasūyātapaḥsiddhyā tridevāḥ putratāṃ gatāḥ ||218|| puruhūtāmokṣaṇaṃ ca ṛṣyaśṛṃgavighātanam | lomaśena kṛtaṃ cendragarvasyāpi vināśanam ||21 9|| dhanvantarergarvabhaṃgaścāṣṭāvakrasya mokṣaṇam | kalaśasya tu vyāghratvaṃ dhenuyogācca mokṣaṇam ||1.589.220|| śarmavatyā mokṣaṇaṃ ca kuṣṭhiviprasya mokṣaṇam | mādhavyāḥ kṛṣṇapatnītvaṃ śāṇḍilyāśca camatkṛtiḥ || 221 || ambāvṛddhākanyayoḥ pādukāpūjanamityapi | jyeṣṭhe rājyābhiṣikte ca vṛṣṭyabhāvena cānale ||222|| viśvāmitrakṛtaścāmiṣahomo’gnistiro’bhavat | gajamatsyādiśāpāśca ajāpālacamatkṛtiḥ |||23|| daśarathasya ca śaneḥ rohiṇīvedharodhanam | aṣṭaṣaṣṭipratīrthāni damayantyā samarpitam ||224|| dānaṃ jagṛhurviprāśca vyomno nipetureva te | bhadrikāyāścamatkāraḥ karṇotpalākathānakam ||225|| yājñavalkyacamatkāro vāstupuṃsaḥ kathānakam | pūrṇakalācamatkāro dīrghikāyāścamatkṛtiḥ ||226|| phalavatyā yoginītvaṃ vyāsaputrasya yogitā | tilottamānimittena śaṃbhoḥ pañcāsyatoditā ||227|| viśvāmitrasya tapasā brahmarṣitvamathābhavat | sābhramatyāḥ samutpattiḥ pippalādodbhavastathā ||228|| pañcapiṇḍikātmagaurīvrataṃ saubhāgyadaṃ śubham | hāṭakeśvaraje yajñe gāyatryā vipratā tathā ||229|| śrīkṛṣṇasyāgamastatra viśvāvasuśca rākṣasaḥ | aṣṭaṣaṣṭimātṛgaṇāgamaśca kuladevatāḥ ||1.589.230|| rājaputrīvipraputryormokṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇayogataḥ | devalīlā nāganadī vipraputryāśca mokṣaṇam ||231|| brahmā śaptaśca mohinyā śuddho nāganadījale ṣaṇḍhotpattirhiṃgulājādīkṣayā mokṣaṇaṃ tathā || 232 śaṃbhorgarvavināśaścāndhakanāśo hareṇa ca | indradyumnasya ca kathā lomaśāśrama ityapi ||233. kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ nārade vedaveditā | brāhmīvidyā janmadivyaṃ lomaśasya purābhavaḥ ||234| kapilasya ca vijñānaṃ naikāvatārarūpatā | vasośca dharmavyādhatvaṃ vaiśālaraibhyamokṣaṇam || 235|. āvaṭyasya camatkāraḥ svapnādiphalavarṇanam | sūryacandrādarśanaṃ sahetukaṃ vyādhatodbhavaḥ || 236|. jayantyāṃ mahimā proktaḥ sanatkumārakeṇa ca | yuddhaṃ maṇikṛte durjayasya gauramukhasya ca || 237| mahātapābhihitaṃ ca vedāntajñānamityapi | kuṃkumavāpikāśraiṣṭhyaṃ pārvatyai śaṃbhunoditam ||238|. ūrjakṛṣṇajayantyāṃ kailāsavāsisamāgatiḥ | raivate somanāthe ca talaśyāme prabhāsake ||239|. uṣṇagrāme ca tīrthāni siṃhamuktistathoditā | nyaṃkumatyāṃ devikāyāṃ sūryatīrthāni rāṣṭrake || 1.589.240 || cyavanāgastivaiśālabhadrāśvatīrthakāni ca | guptaprayāgonnatādibhīmanāthādayastathā ||241 || dvārikā ca camatkārapuraṃ cārbudamityapi | agastyadivyatā maṃkaṇakatīrthādi cārbude ||242|| narmadā ṛkṣakaḥ śailaḥ kanyābhedāditīrthakam | matsyātāpīsaṃgamaśca tathānye saṃgamā api || 243 || bilvāmrakāditīrthāni satyatapaso mokṣaṇam | amarakaṇṭakajāleśvarauṃkārādayastathā ||244|| dhenudānaṃ candrasenamuktirgālavamokṣaṇam | eraṇḍīsaṃgamo dhundhumāramuktyādivarṇanam ||245|| sukhaduḥkhādibhāvāśca kārtikādipraśaṃsanam | mucukundādidṛṣṭāntairnarmadāyāḥ praśaṃsanam ||246 || somaśarmākhyaviprasya māyāniṣādinījanuḥ | raibhyasyāpi camatkāro nakulasya suvarṇatā || 247||| yajñatīrthaśuklatīrthabhṛgukṣetrādikāni ca | dīkṣā bhāgavatī guḍākeśāsurasya tāmratā ||248|| pūjāparādhāḥ śamanaṃ śṛgālagṛdhrayoḥ kathā | khañjarīṭasya muktiśca sevayituḥ phalāni ca ||249|| nalameghavināśaśca samudrasaṃgamādayaḥ | śrīpuruṣottamakṣetre nīlaparvatasatkathā ||1.589.250|| vaṭasya divyatā viprakṣatriyayoḥ pramokṣaṇam | indradyumnasya ca sākṣāddarśana gamanaṃ purīm ||25 1 || bilveśādikathā yajñāvabhṛthādinirvartanam | pūrṇatā pratimānāṃ ca prāsādasya ca nirmitiḥ ||25 2 || brahmaṇaścāgamastatra pratiṣṭhā rathanirmitiḥ | avatārādikabhāvastathā yātrotsavādayaḥ ||25 3 || granthavaktuḥ prapūjādi kṛtasantānagāḥ kathāḥ | saṃkṣepātkathitāścānyā gauṇyaścāvāntarāśca yāḥ ||254|| ākhyānāni copavyākhyānāni santi hyanekaśaḥ | dharmārthakāmanāsvāpamokṣadāni nisargataḥ ||255|| pūrvakalpopakalpādisaṃvṛtāni ca santi vai | tapatāmṛṣimānyānāṃ munīnāṃ bhūbhṛtāṃ tathā ||256 || kanyakānāṃ ca bālānāṃ nārīṇāṃ bhaktayoṣitām | sādhūnāṃ vṛkṣavallīnāṃ tīrthānāṃ saritāṃ tathā ||257|| devādīnāṃ paśūnāṃ ca pakṣiṇāṃ rakṣasāṃ tathā | ākhyānāni prakīrṇāni prasaṃge kathitāni vai ||258|| asurāṇāṃ vināśārthaṃ devodyogāśca varṇitāḥ | pāpyuddhārakathā divyā devānugrahataśca yāḥ ||259|| bahvyastāḥ kathitāścātra vaidikyaśca tathāvidhāḥ | adhyāyānāṃ vācanena viditāḥ syuḥ samantataḥ ||1.589.26 0|| tīrthākhyānacamatkārā avāntaropadeśanāḥ | tattatprakaraṇālokād viditāḥ syuḥ samantataḥ ||26 1 || samudrasya taraṃgāṇāṃ saṃkhyāḥ kartuṃ na śakyate | saṃhitāyā viṣayāṇāṃ gaṇanā śaktivarjitā ||262|| ityevaṃ kramaṇādhyāyaḥ kṛtasantānakasya vai | kathitaḥ sugamārthāya tattatkathāsumārgaṇe ||263|| kathārthānāṃ vācanena smaraṇena śraveṇa ca | saṃhitāphalabhāk syācca kramaṇādhyāyaśīlanāt || 264|| sarvatīrthaphalaṃ sarvayajñaphalaṃ prajāyate | sarvadānaphalaṃ mokṣaphalaṃ tasya prajāyate ||265|| āsya khaṇḍasya yaḥ pārāyaṇaṃ māsena kārayet | tasyāśvamedhasahasrayajñajaṃ jāyate phalam |||266 || sarvatīrthaphalaṃ syācca sarvadānaphalaṃ bhavet | patre patre kṛṣṇanārāyaṇayogo’tra varṇitaḥ ||267|| yogināṃ yogajaṃ puṇyametasya śravaṇādbhavet | ātmā brahmadaśāpannaḥ śrotṝṇāṃ jāyate’nayā ||268|| vaktustatra kathā kā vai vaktā nārāyaṇaḥ svayam | śrotrī yatra svayaṃ lakṣmīrvedo’yaṃ sāmasaṃbhavaḥ ||269|| divyasāmāni santyatra pratyadhyāyaṃ padāni vai | yaduccārayitāraṃ vai prama dhāma nayāmyaham ||1.589.270 || yathā tvaṃ me priyā lakṣmi tatheyaṃ saṃhitā priyā | lekhayitvā gṛhe rakṣyā sampanmokṣapradāyinī ||271 || divyo’haṃ divyarūpā tvaṃ divyeyaṃ saṃhitā mama | nānyaśāstreṇa tulyatvaṃ sthitā sarvocchrayā yataḥ ||272|| tvaṃ dvitīyasvarūpeṇa saṃhitātmatayāsi me | śrotavyā sāvadhānena maṇḍape toraṇānvite ||273|| svarṇasiṃhāsane sthāpyā svarṇavastrādiśobhitā | nityaṃ candanapuṣpādyaiḥ phaladhānyadhanādibhiḥ ||274|| ārārtrivādyaghoṣādyairdhūpadīpākṣatādibhiḥ | kuṃkumāgurugandhādyaiḥ pūjanīyā jayāravaiḥ ||275|| tataḥ saṃpūjayed vyāsaṃ svāmiśrīkṛṣṇavallabham | lakṣmīnārāyaṇarūpaṃ dhanānnāmbarabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||276 || dugdhaghṛtaśarkarādyaistoṣayed bahusevanaiḥ | matto nyūno nāsya vaktā praveśastatra me tadā ||277|| tadāśīrvādavacanaṃ saphalaṃ vyāsapīṭhajam | tatpādajalapānena dhvaṃsante pāparāśayaḥ ||278|| tatpuṣpahāralābhena mahendrasmṛddhimāpnuyāt | tasya darśanamātreṇa kṛṣṇadarśanajaṃ phalam ||279|| tasya sparśanamātreṇa kṛṣṇasparśanajaṃ phalam | tasya sevanalābhena kṛṣṇasevāphalaṃ labhet ||1.589.280|| divyayogād bhaved divyo naro vā pramadāpi vā | enāṃ kṛtvā pramūlaṃ ca vadiṣyanti kathā janāḥ ||28 1 || vyāsā granthān kariṣyanti hyetadādhāravistṛtān | purātanāni bhāvānāṃ hṛdayānyatra santi hi ||282|| tatprakāśaprakartre vai vyāsapīṭhādhivāsine | ācāryaśrīkṛṣṇasvāmisvarūpāya mahātmane ||283 || rājñā deyāni govājigajagrāmadhanāni ca | anyaiścāpi yathāsmṛddhiṃ deyaṃ santoṣakāri yat ||284|| brahmāṇḍadānajaṃ puṇyaṃ bhaved vācakapūjanāt | yānodyānabhavanāni dāsadāsīkulāni ca | rājyopacārayogyāni deyāni vācakāya vai ||285|| yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ svasya deyaṃ vyāsāya śārṅgiṇe | kṛtasantānakaścāyaṃ satyakālīnaceṣṭikaḥ ||286|| satyadharmaiḥ pūritaśca sarvadharmairviśiṣyate | śṛṃgārayitvā bahudhā gaje yāne ca mastake ||287|| dhṛtvā cāmarachatrādyairvardhayitvā mahotsavaiḥ | gītakīrtananṛtyaiśca vādyavaidikasaṃstavaiḥ ||288|| sahasraśo janairgrāme pattane nagare gṛhe | rājadhānyāṃ rājagṛhe śreṣṭhibhiśca nijālaye ||289||| nidhanairbhāvayuktaiśca pūjanīyo viśeṣataḥ | kumārikābhiḥ kalaśairjalapatraphalānvitaiḥ ||1.589.290 || svāgatena vardhayitvā kuṃkumādyaiśca bhāvanaiḥ | vandanīyo maṃgalātmā saubhāgyavaralabdhaye ||291 || sapatikābhiranyābhiḥ sveṣṭasaukhyādilabdhaye | janairdārasutādyarthaṃ strībhiḥ saubhāgyavṛddhaye || 292|| vidyādhanasamṛddhyarthaṃ cārogyarddhyādilabdhaye | kṛtasantānakaḥ khaṇḍaḥ pūjanīyo’tidānakaiḥ || 293|| pūgīphalaṃ dhanaṃ svarṇaṃ sparśayitvā svakaṃ tadā | svakośe rakṣaṇīyaṃ yad dhanavṛddhikaraṃ bhavet ||294|| sādhanāni ca sarvāṇi nānena tulanāni vai | atulyaṃ pūjayitvainaṃ bhrāmayitvā supattanam ||295|| aśeṣaṃ niyatasthāne sthāpanīyo’tibhāvukaiḥ | paraṃdhāmākṣaraṃdhāmāmṛtaṃ golokamuttamam ||296|| vaikuṇṭhaṃ śvetadvīpaṃ ca śrīdhāmecchettadāpnuyāt | svargaṃ māhendrarājyaṃ vā pārameṣṭhyaṃ padṃ ca vā ||297|| vairājaṃ vā nāgarājyaṃ yadicchettallabheta ca | ahaṃ divyasvarūpo’smi kṛtasantānamūrtikaḥ ||298|| adhyāyairnavatiyuktapañcaśatamitairayam | ślokaistu pañcapañcāśatsāhasraiḥ keśarūpibhiḥ ||299| | mastakaṃ me hi boddhavyaḥ kaṇṭhordhvaṃ cāyameva hi | brahmarandhraṃ mama lakṣmi vidyate, tvayi cātra te |||1.589.3 00 || saubhāgyapuṇyamūrdhāsti sarvathā sarvamaṃgalaḥ | tvāṃ māṃ kṛtaṃ bhajeta yaḥ sarvārthānāpnuyāddhruvam ||3 01 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mahāvedī(sthanirmāṇa)mahotsavaḥ, dvādaśayātrāḥ, kṛtasantānoktakathānirdeśāḥ, granthavaktṛpūjādimahimetinirūpaṇanāmaikonanavatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||589||
<1.590> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ataḥ paraṃ mama vakṣo lakṣmi tavaiva vakṣasi | vartamānaṃ divyaṃ tretāsantānakaṃ hi vidyate || 1 || mayā śrīkṛṣṇarūpeṇa rādhāyai te kathāḥ śubhāḥ | goloke kathitāstāśca santi tretāpratānake || 2 || purāyuge’vatāro me tvayā sākaṃ surāṣṭrake | ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīrātryāṃ babhūva prathame dale || 3 |. saurāṣṭre tvāśvinakṛṣṇadalaṃ jānanti tat sadā | pūrvārdhakāle tatsarvaṃ vyavartata mama priye || 4 || kṛtadevāḥ kṛtapālāḥ kṛtabhaktāḥ kṛtapriyāḥ | kṛtadharmāḥ kṛtātmānaḥ pāntu kṛtādhivāsinaḥ || 5 || satyasatyaḥ satyadevyaḥ satyavratāḥ satīstriyaḥ | satyāntarātmavidhṛtāḥ pāntu satyasamarpitāḥ || 6 || yaścāsekṣaṇakaḥ svavidrutimanu drāvaṃ gataścātmavān | yuksaṃjñāmabhigṛhya lakṣmapadharo dvedhābhavannarāyaṇaḥ || rālakṣmādhipatirgirāṃ manujanau kṛṣṇārabhṛd gāṃgataḥ | so’haṃ jyarthamavaimi bhaktisubhṛtaiste yantu maddvyarthakam || 7 || pūrṇabrahmatadīyadivyatanavo nārāyaṇāḥ śrīḥ śriyaḥ | īśā īśanikāśca tattvavibhavo devarṣipitrāsurāḥ || caityācaityavibhūtayastaligaṇāstiryagbhavāḥ santvamī | kṛtsantānakṛte madarpaṇavidhau pṛthvyo mithaḥ śreyasām || 8 || ye vai kāśyapagotrajāstaditare maddhastasaṃsparśagā, ye vā maddhṛdayaṃgamā mama satāmāśīrvacobhūmayaḥ || yā māmarpaṇayājikā nijaguṇaiḥ sampadya sarvātmanā | brāhmīṃ bhūmimitāstadīyakulajānmokṣaṃ nayāmyakṣare || 9 || kecinmāṃ prayajanti yajñanikarairanye prasevādibhirnityaṃ saṃsmaraṇaiḥ pare taditare sarvārpaṇaiḥ saṃyamaiḥ || raktā māṃ ratimārgaṇairapi ruṣā ruṣṭā vṛṣasthā vṛṣaiste kānte mayi divyaśāśvatapade majjantu cānanditāḥ || 1.590.10|| atha lakṣmi kuru śāntiṃ kathayiṣye punaḥ kathāḥ | dharmārthakāmamokṣāḍhyāḥ satyottaramupasthitāḥ | 11 || satye satyavidhānajñe satyavratadhare sati | satyasantānakaścātra tvayi satyāṃ samāpyate || 12|| śvetavyāsaścādimo’haṃ vyāso vyāsāśraye harau | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitādyasantānamarpaye || 13 || pratyakṣaḥ śrīhariḥ svāmisvarūpaḥ śreyase nṛṇām | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo nityapratyakṣo jayatīha vai || 14|| dehendriyāntaḥkaraṇātmasu guṇeṣu karmasu | vyāpako mūrtirūpaḥ śrīharirjayatu sarvadā || 15|| pañcapañcāśatsahasrāṇyapi pañcaśatānyapi | saptaviṃśatiścaślokā ādyakhaṇḍasya santi hi || 16|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tretāsantānaprastāvaḥ, āśīrvādāḥ, stutiścetikathananāmā navatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 590 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇasahitāyāṃ prathamaḥ kṛtasantānakhaṇḍaḥ samāptaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmyarpaṇamastu yaḥ, īkṣaṇakaḥ āsa, svasya vidrutiṃ vivṛttirūpāṃ sṛṣṭim, anu drāvaṃ praveśaṃ gataḥ | ātmavān antaryāmī | yuk saṃjñām yugalasaṃjñām | abhigṛhya | lakṣmapadharaḥlakṣmīpatināmadhṛk | śrāyaṇaḥrādhāpatināmabhāk | rālakṣmādhipatiḥ rādhāpatiḥ lakṣmīpatiḥ | giram manubhāve | kṛṣṇārabhṛtkṛṣṇaḥ nārāyaṇaśceti | gāṃ vāṇīṃ gataḥ | sa evāhaṃ bhaktibhṛjjanaiḥ | jyarthamjaya jayeti prāpnomi | te bhaktāḥ | matto’pi dvyarthaṃ dviguṇaṃ jayaṃ yantu || 7 ||
<2.1> śrīrādhikā uvāca oṃ namaḥ śrīparabrahmapareśaparamātmane | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyākṣaraśāsine || 1 || tretāsantānasatpitre rādhākāntāya yogine | lakṣmīnārāyaṇāya śrīmāṇikyāvāhine namaḥ || 2 || svaprabhāsvāmine mañjulālakāyātmavāsine | īśāpāravatīśāya namaḥ saguṇamūrtaye || 3 || haṃsajyotisvarūpāya śaktyaiśvaryādisaṃbhṛte | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraprakaṭāya namo namaḥ || 4 || sarvadhāmādhipeśāya namo’ntaryāmiṇe muhuḥ | svargamokṣādidātre te namaḥ śrīharaye namaḥ || 5 || niravadhisamaiśvaryaguṇavaibhavaśāline | asaṃkhyamuktasevyāyākṣarādhipataye namaḥ || 6 || eko’pi bahudhā dṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇādimān | īśeśānyādirūpaśca tasmai śrīsvāmine namaḥ || 7 || paravidyādhidevāya brahmapriyādhiśāyine | gītopaniṣatpataye jayantīpataye namaḥ || 8 || ekādaśīpriyāyārādhanākāntāya śārṅgiṇe | mahālakṣmīśvarāyāpi bhaktīśāya namo namaḥ || 9 || mukteśāya rameśāya gaṃgeśāya namo namaḥ | pativratādhipataye rukmiṇīśāya te namaḥ || 2.1.10|| kāmadughādhināthastvaṃ pṛthvīśastvaṃ ratīśvaraḥ | vibhūtīśo’si saṃjñeśaḥ śaṃ karotu prasevinām || 11 || kamalākānta devīśa mohinīdhava siddhipa | urvaśīśvara buddhīśa pārvatīśa vidhehi śam || 1 2|| dīkṣādhīśa ca līleśa nārāyaṇīpate prabho | virajākānta bhagavan vṛndānātha vidhehi śam || 13 || sarasvatīpriya svarṇarekhāpriya sitāpate | devikeśvara tulasīvihāra pravidhehi śam || 14|| vibhāvaryadhināthastvaṃ mūrtīśvaro jayeśvaraḥ | gomatīśo mauktikeśo bhavān bhavatu rukmadaḥ || 15|| premasakhīpate godāvarīśa kapileśvara | dhātrīpate svarṇagaurīpate sarvaprado bhava || 16|| laliteśvara raṃbheśa kumudvatīpate prabho | śītalādhipate umākānta vidhehi śaṃ sadā || 17|| hemanteśvara nandeśa śāntisvāmin kalāpate | nandinīnātha durgeśa vijayeśa vidhehi śam || 18|| sandhyādhinātha kastūrīpriya dhanyādhināyaka | sāvitrīvara dolādhiroha puṣpāsugandhabhāk || 19|| savitādhipate citralekheśvara namo’stu te | pūrṇimādhipate brahman śāradākānta mādhava ||2.1.20 || mañjarīśvara yoginīcakrakānta vidhehi śam | preyasīśa śreyasīśa vikuṇṭheśāruṇāpate |||21 || joṣṭrīśvara śabarīśa pampeśa gālavīpate | yājñasenīpate vasumatīśa vijayo’stu te ||22|| sudughānātha ca padmāvatīpālaka keśava | bhārgavīpāṇisaṃgrāha padminīvara cācyuta ||23 || śrīmatīśa jaratkārvīpate līlāvatīśvara | kalāvatīprāṇanātha kadalīśa jayo’stu te ||24|| kāntimatīpate kālindīśa revāpate prabho | vardhinīśa sumitreśa puṇyanaidheyikāpate || 25|| banduleśa suśīleśa mānaseśa janārdana | śarmavatīśvara kṛṣṇa mādhavīśa namo’stu te || 26 || karṇotpaleśa dīrghikāpate’kṣamālikāpate | udumbarīpate ṛtambharādhīśa jayo’stu te |||27|| badarīśa ca kubjeśa haimīśa maṃgalāpate | mahāvedīpate kṛṣṇāpate tvāṃ cintaye hṛdi ||28|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca yaścāsti divye’kṣaradhāmni divyo hyanantamuktābhisusevyamānaḥ | pare’kṣarāddhāmni virājamānaḥ so’yaṃ pṛthivyāṃ samavātatāra ||29|| śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmadheyo hyanādikṛṣṇaḥ parameśvaraśca | golokavaikuṇṭhanivāsibhiśca prage’rcane vai hṛdi cintyamānaḥ ||2.1.3 0|| so’yaṃ kṛpābhiḥ pṛthivītale kuṃkumākhyavāpyāṃ hi surāṣṭradeśe | śrīkambharālakṣmisatīgṛhe’tra gopālakṛṣṇātmajatāmavāpa ||3 1 || yasmādahaṃ pūrṇatamo’pi kṛṣṇo rādhāpatiścāpyabhavaṃ purāṇaḥ | lakṣmīpatiścāpyabhavad yato vai vaikuṇṭhadhāmādhipatirmahātmā ||3 2|| kailāsavāso’pi yato’bhavaccāmṛtādhivāso’pi yato’bhavacca | avyākṛteśo’pi yato’bhavaccāhiraṇyagarbho’pi yato’bhavacca ||3 3 || śrībadrikeśo’pi yato’bhijātaḥ kṣīrodavāsī ca yato’sti jātaḥ | śvetākhyadhāmeśa narāyaṇo’pi yato’sti jātaḥ kamalāpatirvai ||34|| asaṃkhyadhāmādhipareśvarāśca yato bhavantyeva harestu rādhe | tasyātmadevasya guṇānukīrtiṃ vadāmi rādhe parameśvarasya ||36|| tvayā stutaḥ śrīpuruṣottamo yaḥ parātparaḥ kāraṇakāraṇaṃ ca | sarvāvatārādhipatiḥ purāṇaḥ smarāmi taṃ śrīpuruṣottameśam ||36 || dviṣaṭkayuktaṃ kathitaṃ ca yat śataṃ tvayā pareśasya tu mukhyayoṣitām | divyāṃganānāṃ caraṇānyahaṃ sadā namāmi tāsāṃ pataye namo namaḥ ||37|| ahaṃ purodbhāvya vilokitastvayā sākaṃ pareśena nivāsanāya vai | golokasaṃjñaṃ mama dhāma cārpitaṃ rādhe vihārārthamanena te namaḥ || 38|| tataḥ paraṃ yena narāyaṇaḥ kṛto lakṣmyā suyuktaśca vilokitaśca saḥ | vaikuṇṭhasaṃjñaṃ pradadau ca dhāma yat| tasmai pradātre paramātmane namaḥ ||39|| athāpi rūpaṃ ca vidhāya śāṃbhavaṃ satyā samaṃ yatpravilokitaṃ punaḥ | kailāsasaṃjñaṃ pradadau ca dhāma yat nivāsadātre guṇadhāriṇe namaḥ ||2.1.40 || śrīrādhikovāca kṛṣṇa kānta dayāsindho parameśvara śāśvata | parameśvarasaṃjño yaḥ paramātmā parātparaḥ ||41 || guṇaiśvaryavibhūtyādikāntāpārṣadabhūṣaṇaiḥ | sevito yatra mahyāṃ vai hyavātatāra dharmadhṛk ||42|| tanmūrtiṃ tadguṇām̐stasya rūpamaiśvaryamityapi | līlā mokṣapradāḥ sarvā vada lokahitapradāḥ ||43|| ahaṃ golokasaṃsthaiva śrotumicchāmi taṃ prabhum | yatrāvayośca jananaṃ bhaviṣyati bhuvastale ||44|| tad brahmāṇḍaṃ ca tallokaṃ tatsthalaṃ pāvanaṃ param | sarvābhiḥ svasṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ śrotumicchāmi tadvada ||45|| śrīharestasya patnīnāṃ tanmūrtīnāṃ prasevinām | āvirbhāvasvarūpāṇāṃ kathā mokṣāya dehinām ||46|| svaṃ rūpaṃ yo vijānāti mūlaṃ jānāti naiva ca | na sa kiñcid vijānāti tasmāttaṃ vada kānta me ||47|| ahaṃ māyāsvarūpāsmi tava dehārdhadhāriṇī | tvayyadhiśāyinaṃ kṛṣṇa vad me puruṣottamam ||48|| tava mūrtau sadā prātastaṃ paśyāmi pareśvaram | hṛdye te nivasantaṃ hasantaṃ te’tiśāyinam ||49|| mānasaṃ me vikarṣantaṃ rūpasaundaryavāridhim | tvayi kṛṣṇe śvetavarṇaṃ vada me puruṣottamam ||2.1.50|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rādhe pravakṣyāmi śrīhariṃ puruṣottamam | koṭikṛṣṇā mādṛśā yatsvarūpe’ntarbhavanti hi ||5 1 || koṭinārāyaṇā yasya mūrtau līnā bhavanti ca | tādṛśaḥ śrīmahārājādhirājaparameśvaraḥ ||52|| abjarādhāramādyāśca yadromāt prabhavanti hi | asaṃkhyā avatārāśca yanmūrteḥ saṃbhavanti ca ||53 || anantā vyūhasaṃjñāśca līnāstiṣṭhanti yaddharau | bhūmānaścāpyanantāśca yadaiśvarye vasanti ca ||54|| yasya tejasi dhāmāni golokādīni rādhike | vasanti ca samānābhihāra kṛtāni sarvadā |||55|| yasyaikakiraṇātsarve prāvirbhāvā bhavanti ca | tadrūpaṃ kimahaṃ rādhe varṇaye’kṣiprasākṣikam ||56|| yasyaikamukto’pi ca me dhāmni cāyād yadṛcchayā | mayā sākaṃ ca golokaṃ sarvaṃ tejohataṃ bhavet || 57|| tasyaikā lalitā patnī jayā vā muktamāṇikī | prabhā lakṣmīḥ pārvatī vā samāyāttava sannidhau ||58|| tasyāstejasi me patnyo yūyaṃ syustejasā hatāḥ | tādṛśaṃ rūparūpāṇāṃ rūpātirūparūpiṇam ||59|| kiṃ varṇaye rādhike’tra cakṣuścaraṃ na vākcaram | maṇiryasya mukuṭasya svenaivodbhāvitastanoḥ ||2.1.6 0|| eka eva samartho’sti tejo dātuṃ hi dhāminām | tamahaṃ cintaye nityamanādikṛṣṇamacyutam ||61|| anye dhāmanivāsāśca cintayanti hi taṃ prabhum | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipumuttamam ||62|| rādhe’haṃ taṃ cintayāmi mahānandapayodadhim | pitaraṃ kāraṇaṃ sarvāvatārāṇāṃ parātparam ||63|| yasyaikanetrakoṇe tu kaṭākṣe vauṣṭhamadhyame | sarve rasāḥ sarvakāmāḥ sarvānandā vasanti ca ||64| | yasya kukṣau tu dhāmāni parameśā maheśvarāḥ | vyūhā vibhavā āveśā nivasanti sukhāśrayāḥ ||65|| guṇā niravadhayaśca niratiśayaśāyinaḥ | samūrtā yasya vai mūrtau vartante hṛdayādiṣu || 66|| sṛṣṭistu pannakhe yasya mahāmāyā nakhāntare | īśvarāḥ karagā yasya cintayāmi hariṃ ca tam ||67|| cintaya tvaṃ sadā rādhe kāntādhikāntameva tam | mama kāntastava kāntaḥ sa eva bhagavān patiḥ ||68|| dhyātvānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ saubhāgyadā bhava | saṃsevya taṃ pareśaṃ cākhaṇḍasaubhāgyadhā bhava ||6 9|| prapūjya taṃ ca saṃsevya nijarūpabudhā bhava | tvaṃ tasyāsyakṣaraṃdhāma paradhāmātmako’smyaham ||2.1.70|| mayi vāsaḥ sadā tasya tena dṛṣṭastvayā mayi | sa eva hṛdye me’sti te hṛdi nivasāmyaham ||71 || tvaṃ cecchā śāśvatī rādhe sarveṣāṃ hṛdayeṣvasi | tasmātsarvamayī tvaṃ vai procyase tvanmayo’pyaham ||72||| manmayaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’nādiśca varṇyate | ekaṃ tattvaṃ
