cāpi nidrāyāṃ suṣuptāvapi tā harim | patiṃ śrīsvāminaṃ hṛtsu dhārayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||98|| kambharānandanaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ hṛdbhiḥ pravavrire | bhejustaṃ cātmani cātmāntarātmānaṃ priyaṃ prabhum ||99|| evaṃ tā rādhike divyā jātāstāmasajā api | parameśvarayogena kimāścaryaṃ vadāmi te || 2.15.10 0|| kṛpāmātradhṛtajanmā kṛṣṇo’nugrahavānayam | pāpipāpāni cogrāṇi nāśayitvākaronnijān || 10 1|| narānnārīḥ paśūn vṛkṣān vallīdaityādikām̐stathā | pāṭhakān śrotṛvargāṃśca naijān karoti vai tathā || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne nūtnakanyakānāṃ lomaśadarśitaikādaśīvratapātivratyagogurvādisevanamāhātmyanirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 15||
<2.16> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike na tvayā pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ divyakathānakam | kathayāmi camatkāraṃ sāvadhānā nibodha me || 1 || āṣāḍhe kanyakāḥ sarvāścāturmāsyavratāni vai | cakrurlomaśadiṣṭāni bālakṛṣṇasya tuṣṭaye || 2 || āṣāḍhaśuklapakṣasyaikādaśyāṃ prātareva tāḥ | snātvā dhyātvā kṛpānāthaṃ natvā samarcya lomaśam || 3 || candanākṣatapuṣpāṇi kuṃkumāmbaramālikāḥ | gokṣīraṃ śarkarailākesarāḍhyaṃ kvāthitaṃ tathā || 4 || nītvā bhūṣāmbarahāraśṛṃgāraśobhitāḥ prabhum | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ draṣṭumupāgatāḥ || 5 || gāyanti gītikā miṣṭasvaraiḥ śrīsvāmimānasāḥ | mauktikanaddhahindhānīdhṛtakalaśamastakāḥ || 6 || hastadhṛtaphalapūjāpātrā netrāgramādhavāḥ | hṛdayeṣu dhṛtakṛṣṇāḥ kṛtakautukamaṃgalāḥ || 7 || smaranti śrīpatiṃ cāhamahamikayā tvagragāḥ | camatkārastadā prātarbālakṛṣṇena darśitaḥ || 8 || mama pūjākṛte koṭikanyāścāyānti me gṛham | sammardo’tra mahān bhāvī mayā gamyaṃ sarastaṭe || 9 || grāhyā pūjā ca yugapat sammardo na yathā bhavet | iti nirṇīya bhagavān koṭirūpāṇi tatkṣaṇam || 2.16.1 0|| dhṛtvā hasan kiśorātmā tāsāmabhiyayau pathi | ekayā dṛśyate tveko nānyayā dṛśyate’paraḥ || 11 || ekā jānāti māmeva hasannāyāti māṃ prati | nānyāḥ prati yayau nātho mama premṇātirekiṇā || 12 || anyā jānāti māmevābhiyāti netarāḥ prati | parā paśyati cāyāntaṃ svāṃ pratyeva kṛpākaram || 13 || evaṃ sarvā hi pratyekaṃ kāntaṃ paśyanti vai nijam | matvā saubhāgyamatulaṃ drutaṃ milanti vakṣasi || 14|| lomaśaṃ śrīharirneme lomaśo’pi hariṃ mudā | atha tatkoṭiyugalairbhūtalaṃ dyaurivābhavat || 15|| kṛṣṇo vārtāṃ kuśalāḍhyāṃ pṛcchan prayāti cāgrataḥ | pārśve pārśve manāk pṛṣṭhe vāme prayāti kanyakā || 16|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīre viśāle bahuyojane | meghacchatrasamacchāye puṣpitadrumavallike || 17|| śubhakomalasasyāse śītagandhyanilānvite | pūjāpātrāṇi sannyasya kāntaṃ kṛtvāsane puraḥ || 18|| sarvāḥ sampūjayāmāsurbhāvabhṛddravyavastubhiḥ | lalāṭe patrikāścakruścandanena sugandhinā || 19 || netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ dadustilakaṃ ca lalāṭake| dakṣagaṇḍe raktabindvīṃ datvā cucumburutsukāḥ ||2.16.20|| mastake puṣpamukuṭaṃ mayūrapatrakalgikam | karṇayoḥ puṣpagucchau ca śekharān vividhān daduḥ || 11 || puṣpahārān taulaseyān kaṭakān raśanāstathā | puṣpapracchadavastrāṇi dhārayāmāsurīśvaram ||22|| alaktakuṃkumaṃ tasya pādayoḥ karayordaduḥ | sakiṃkiṇīnupūrau ca pādaprakoṣṭhayordaduḥ |||23|| pītāmbarāṇi kṣaumāṇi kauśeyakāni tā daduḥ | muralīṃ cāpyaṃkurāṇi karṇayorgucchakau daduḥ |||24|| padmapatraṃ kare dakṣe sugandhiprokṣaṇaṃ daduḥ | śītaṃ miṣṭaṃ jalaṃ bhojyaṃ phalaṃ rasān payo daduḥ ||25|| elālavaṃgabījāni mukhaśuddhiṃ dalaṃ daduḥ | evaṃ sampūjya taṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 26 || ārārtrikaṃ kambujalaṃ vastramārjanamādadhuḥ | namaḥ stutiṃ daṇḍavacca pradakṣiṇaṃ ca dakṣiṇām ||27|| ātmanāṃ cārpaṇaṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣamārthanaṃ vyadhuḥ | pādayoḥ kṣālanajalaṃ papurnyadhuśca mastake ||28|| vakṣaḥsu kṛṣṇacaraṇau nidhāyānandamāgatāḥ | prasannāḥ prārthayāmāsurvratāni nijanāthataḥ ||29|| kāciccaturṣu māseṣu yayāce phalabhojanam | kācitkandādanaṃ kācitpatrādanaṃ payo’danam ||2.16.3 0|| kācidekānnabhakṣyaṃ ca kācinmunyannabhakṣaṇam | kācidyavādanaṃ kācidgodhūmādanamātrakam ||3 1 || kācit taṇḍulakavalān kācidrasavivarjitam | kācidakṣārabhojyaṃ ca kācinmiṣṭavivarjitam ||32|| kācit tiktavihīnaṃ ca kācit kaṭuvivarjitam | kācidanagnipakvaṃ ca kācicchuṣkaṃ tu bharjitam ||33 || kācinnirannamevāpi kācicchākavivarjitam | kācittu dvidalāvarjyaṃ kācidanāranālakam ||34|| kācittakravihīnaṃ ca kāciddugdhavivarjitam | kācidadhṛtabhojyaṃ ca kācidatailamityapi ||35|| anyā naktaṃ caikabhuktaṃ kācitkālacaturthakam | ṣaṭkālādanamityanyā saptāhādanamityapi ||36 || pakṣādanaṃ tathā māsādanaṃ cāndrāyaṇādikam | kṛcchraṃ bahuvidhaṃ cāpi ekadvitridinādijam ||37|| evaṃ vratāni jagṛhuḥ kṛṣṇaprasannatecchayā | śrutvā śrīlomaśaḥ prāha śṛṇuta kanyakā hitam ||38|| yena kṛṣṇaḥ prasannaḥ syāt tadvrataṃ cottamottamam | vratena tapasā vāpyārādhanena yamādibhiḥ ||3 9|| toṣaṇīyaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sādhanakoṭibhiḥ | avrate’pi prasannaḥ syādavrataṃ vratameva tat ||2.16.40| vrate nāsti prasannaśced vrataṃ cāvratameva tat | tasmāt putryo hariryena tuṣyet praṣṭavyameva tat ||41 | jñātvā toṣapradaṃ cāturmāsye kuruta tadvratam | ityuktāḥ sukumāryastā hariṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam |||42|| papracchuḥ sukhamāsīnā yena tuṣyasi tad vad | śrutvā hasan hariḥ prāha bhaktyā tuṣyāmi nānyathā ||43| na vratairnaiva dānaiśca na yamairniyamaistathā | na yajñairdakṣiṇābhiśca na dehakṣapaṇaistathā ||44|| na vicārairna ca dhanairna saukumāryabhāvanaiḥ | kintu premṇā prasannaḥ syāṃ nirvyājenānivartinā ||45||| premavataṃ madarthaṃ ca kāryaṃ yuṣmābhireva yat | premṇā pūjyo vandanīyaḥ premṇā smartavya eva ca ||46 || premṇā dāsyaṃ prakartavyaṃ kaiṃkaryalakṣaṇaṃ mayi | snāne dhyāne bhojanādau dehakārye’pi sarvathā ||47|| ahaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prayoktavyastadvrataṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet | abalānāṃ balaṃ cāhaṃ bālānāṃ balabhāgaham ||48|| kanyānāṃ kaṃ sukhaṃ kurve nārāyaṇo’smi mokṣadaḥ | cāturmāsye madarthaṃ vai pradakṣiṇaṃ namaskriyā ||49|| mama mālājapo dhyānaṃ mama nāmnāṃ sukīrtanam | mama gāthā mama kathā madarthaṃ jīvanaṃ priyāḥ ||2.16.50|| sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ tadvai vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mayā kṛtam | bhavatīnāṃ kṛte divyaṃ sākṣānmadyogasaṃbhṛtam ||51 || naitattulyaṃ vrataṃ tvanyattena mokṣasukhaṃ bhavet | vrateryaḥ khalu cāptavyaḥ so’haṃ prāpto’smi sarvathā ||52|| tadvrataṃ kiṃ vrataṃ cānyat tiṣṭhataivaṃ vrate mayi | ityuktvā bhagavām̐stāsāṃ jagrāhārcanavastukam ||53|| darśasparśasukhaṃ tābhyo dadau koṭisvarūpabhāk | tāḥ sarvāśca hariṃ natvā tadocuḥ parameśvaram ||54|| nātha nityaṃ tava pūjāṃ kariṣyāmo’tra saṃgatāḥ | evameva sukhaṃ dehi pūjāgrahaṇānugrahāt ||55|| tathāstviti hariḥ prāha tāvadāścaryamatra yat | jātaṃ tad rādhike te’tra kathayāmi śṛṇu priye ||56|| śatrūñjayākhyaśailo vai vartate tvagnidigbhavaḥ | saurāṣṭre tatra daityā vai samāsan kaṃkatālakāḥ ||57|| sahasraśaḥ kaṃkatālā madyamāṃsaparāyaṇāḥ | adriśṛṃgasamākārā halavaddantamūrdhajāḥ || 58|| taptatālocchrayā meghamārgamastakasaṃspṛśāḥ || sāmudramatsyabhakṣāśca naramāṃsādanāstathā ||59|| panāraṇyapaśubhakṣāḥ pakṣiprāṇiprabhakṣiṇaḥ | āyayuste tadā jñātvā kṛṣṇapūjanakotsavam ||| 2.16.60|| vrataghnāste’surāḥ sarve khalāḥ śastrāstradhāriṇaḥ | nipetturvyomamārgātte haṃtuṃ bālanarāyaṇam ||61 || mārayainaṃ ghātayainaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ virodhinam | asurāṇāṃ mahāśatruṃ lakṣāṇāṃ ghātakaṃ param ||62|| tatpatnīnāṃ hārakaṃ ca mārayata drutaṃ prabhum | lomaśaṃ nāśayata kṣipraṃ badhvā rajjvā gale punaḥ |||63|| viprāṇaṃ tvatra kuruta dhvaṃsadhvaṃ ca tadā śrayān | ityuktvā tvambarād yāvannipeturhananāśayāḥ ||64|| lomaśaḥ stambhayāmāsākāśe tān vai tathāvidhān | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam ||65|| naijāni sarvarūpāṇi saṃgṛhya kṣaṇamātrataḥ | vairājarūpamāsthāya babhau girivaropamaḥ ||66|| sasmāra garuḍaṃ divyaṃ samāyayau kṣaṇāddhi saḥ | pakṣābhyāṃ vivṛtābhyāṃ ca kanyakāścāśramaṃ tathā ||67|| aśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi sa rarakṣa vitānavat | daśayojanavistāraṃ kṣetraṃ saṃrakṣya pakṣirāṭ ||68|| vyāttapakṣaśca tasthau sa nirbhayaścācyutājñayā | bhagavān drāk tasya pṛṣṭhaṃ samāruroha hetimān ||69|| sudarśanaṃ tathā cakraṃ mumoca līlayā vadan | śatrūñjayāḥ kaṃkatālāḥ kathaṃ tiṣṭhatha niṣkriyāḥ ||2.16.70|| prayatyantāṃ prāṇaglahairbhavadbhirnaṣṭabhālakaiḥ | eṣa cāste lomaśo’tra jaḍabhāvaṃ vikarṣati ||7 1 || evamukte jaḍabhāve saṃhṛte te’surāstadā | śrīkṛṣṇamāyayā dagdhā hatabhāgyā punarbalam ||72|| cakruḥ kṛṣṇavināśārthaṃ dudruvurvegato hyabhi | śrīkṛṣṇe garuḍe yāvat śastrāṇi prathamaṃ tu te ||73|| yojayanti prahārārthaṃ tāvaccakraṃ sudarśanam | pralayāgnisamākāraṃ bhramattīkṣṇāraduḥsaham ||74|| kaṃkatālāsurāṇāṃ tu mastakānyabhyakartayat | nipetuścārdhabhinnāstaddehā vyomnaḥ samantataḥ ||75|| śirāṃsi cāpi galataśchinnānyapi tadāpatan | hastau pādau kaṭibhāgā nyapatan bhūtale’bhitaḥ ||76 || hastaśastrā api cakrakartitā nirbalā yathā | hantuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ garuḍaṃ vā lomaśaṃ nāśakaṃstadā || 77|| sahasraṃ tu tadā teṣāṃ śastracchinnaṃ layaṃ gatam | śeṣā vidudruvustām̐śca gadā kaumodakī svayam ||78|| mūrtimatī cādritulyā bahuśastrakarānvitā | mārgamāruddhya parito dhāvamānā hyupasthitā ||79|| yatra yatra diśi daityā dudruvustatra taddiśi | gadā naikasvarūpā sā bhayaṃkarī mahāsatī ||2.16.80|| samutplutya purastasthau mamārāti tu tām̐stadā | gadayā te hatāścānye pañcaṣaścāvaśeṣitāḥ ||8 1 || kanyārūpāṇi dhṛtvaiva garuḍasyāśrayaṃ gatāḥ | kanyakāsu praviśyaiva rakṣaṇaṃ cakrurīśvarāt ||82|| atha nārāyaṇaścakraṃ gadā ca garuḍastathā | daityān hatvā ca naijaṃ vai sūkṣmaṃ rūpaṃ dadhustataḥ ||83 || garuḍaḥ śrīhariṃ tatra samarcya parameśvaram | vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayau śīghraṃ sudarśanaṃ karāgatam ||84|| bhagavānapi caikaikaḥ kanyādhairyapradastadā | jahāsa lomaśaṃ prāha nūtnāḥ kanyāstu paṃcaṣaḥ ||85 || vartante kanyakāstvatra paśya guro mṛterbhayāt | daityāḥ samabhavan prāṇahetoḥ kapaṭayoṣitaḥ ||86 || tāsāṃ prāṇaparitrāṇaṃ kāryaṃ mayā dayālunā | ityuktāstā ruruduśca praṇemuśca yayācire ||87|| rakṣaṇaṃ pālanaṃ cāpi nityaṃ dāsīpadaṃ tathā | kṛṣṇaḥ prāha tathāstvetannārīrūpaṃ sadā ca vaḥ |||88|| śāśvataṃ kanyakārūpaṃ bhavatvatra mamālaye | lomaśasyāśrame tāsāṃ vāsaṃ tvakārayaddhariḥ ||89 || lomaśaśca dadau mantraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ galamālikām | taulasīṃ tilakaṃ nāmamantraṃ ca divyarūpatām ||2.16.9 0|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | jagṛhurmantramavyagrāḥ sādhvyaḥ kanyāstu nūtanāḥ ||9 1 || vaiṣṇavyastāśca sañjātā bhejire śrīhariṃ tataḥ | prārthayāmāsurīśeśaṃ mokṣārthaṃ mṛtayodhinām ||9 2|| daityā yuddhe mṛtā ye te kṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā | sahasraśaḥ samāyātāḥ sūkṣmadehā vikalmaṣāḥ ||93 || āsuratvaṃ vināśyaiva śrīkṛṣṇena parātmanā | divyatvaṃ tu tadā datvā vimānairdivyapārṣadaiḥ ||94|| vaikuṇṭhaṃ prāpitāḥ sarve śatrūñjayanivāsinaḥ | evaṃ muktiṃ prapannāste caikādaśyāṃ hariśritāḥ || 95|| atha tāḥ sarvakanyāśca nītvā śrīlomaśo muniḥ | nijāśramaṃ yayau kṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇo babhūva ha ||96 || tattīrthaṃ kaṃkatālākhyaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovare | jātaṃ khyātaṃ dakṣapārśve yatra pūjā hareḥ kṛtā ||97|| bālakṛṣṇo vidhāyaivamānandaṃ vratiyoṣitām | tiro’bhavat kṣaṇānte vai gṛhaparyaṃkikāṃ gataḥ ||98|| etaccaritraṃ subhagaṃ rādhike devadevinaḥ | jñātvā śrutvā paṭhitvāpi smṛtvā muktiṃ labhed dhruvam ||99|| dhanavān putravān śrīmānanantasvargavān bhavet | nārī saubhāgyakīrtyāḍhyā vaṃśasantānadā bhavet || 2.16.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āṣāḍhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ bālakṛṣṇasya prabhoḥ kanyakākṛtapūjanaṃ bahurūpadhāraṇaṃ vratāni, śatrūñjayaparvatasthakaṃkatālānāṃ daityānāṃ yuddhaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ, śeṣāṇāṃ kanyārūpadhāriṇāṃ lomaśāśrame vāsaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣoḍaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 16 ||
<2.17> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rādhe ca te daityā yadā gṛhaṃ na cāyayuḥ | tatpatnyo daityasainyasyānveṣaṇārthaṃ samāyayuḥ || 1 || ayutaṃ śrāvaṇe māse varṣānvite sthale tadā | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre jalādisaṃplute śubhe || 2 || samāgatya hi daityānāṃ patnyo vyomapradeśataḥ | vyapaśyan ramaṇīyaṃ cāraṇyasthaṃ mahadāśramam || 3 || koṭikanyāśrayaṃ cāpi lomaśarṣiniṣevitam | kecid vaikhānasāstatra kecidāsannirāsanāḥ || 4 || yāyāvarāstathā cānye vānaprasthāstathāpare | śālīnāśca tathā kecit kāpotīṃ vṛttimāśritāḥ || 5 || tathā cānye śritā vṛttiṃ sarvabhūtadayāṃ śubhām | śilocchāśca tathaivānye kāṣṭhapātrādanāḥ pare || 6 || apākapācinaḥ kecit pākinaśca kvacitpunaḥ | nānāvidhidharāḥ kecijjitātmānastu kecana || 7 || sthānamaunavratāḥ kecittathānye jalaśāyinaḥ | tathordhvaśāyinaścānye tathānye mṛgacāriṇaḥ || 8 || pañcāgnayastathā kecit kecit parṇaphalāśinaḥ | abbhakṣā vāyubhakṣāśca tathānye śākabhakṣiṇaḥ || 9 || ato’nye’pyatitīvrāṃ vai tapaścaryāṃ prapedire | yatrāraṇye sādhavaśca sādhvyo vasanti koṭiśaḥ || 2.17.1 0|| yatrāśrame hareḥ patnyaḥ koṭikanyā vasanti ca | yatra mokṣapradā tvāste divyā kuṃkumavāpikā || 11 || yatra divyaṃ tvaśvapaṭṭasarovaraṃ pravartate | sa deśo divyatāsampādako yatra harermahān || 12|| prāsādo vidyate ramyo golokādadhikojjvalaḥ | yatra śrīkambharālakṣmīryatra gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 13|| rājante śrībālakṛṣṇānvitāḥ samantataḥ prajāḥ | tādṛśaḥ sa mahādivyo nandanopavanadyutiḥ || 14|| pradeśo vīkṣitastābhirdaityābhirvyomamārgataḥ | vajrasphaṭikapāṣāṇaḥ pravālāṃkuraśarkaraḥ || 15|| nīlāmalamṛttikāḍhyo jalanirjharaśobhitaḥ | vicitrakusumopetairlatāmañjarīdhāribhiḥ || 16|| reje yaḥ prāṃśubhirvṛkṣairullikhadbhirivāmbaram | sthalyastatrādhikaṃ rejurnānādhātuparisravaiḥ || 17|| vicitrakusumopetāścitritā iva sarvataḥ | tāsu ketakikhaṇḍāśca kundaṣaṇḍāśca puṣpitāḥ || 18|| unmīlitā ivābhānti dhātakīvanarājibhiḥ | bhinnendranīlavimalairdhautaiḥ prasravaṇāmbubhiḥ || 19|| citraiḥ kusumasaṃchannairdhātuprastaravistaraiḥ | krīḍadbhirdevamithunairnṛtyadbhiścāpsarogaṇaiḥ ||2.17.20 || kūjadbhiḥ śikhibhirmattaiḥ śobhito deśa ujjvalaḥ | kalhārakusumopeto haṃsasārasasevitaḥ ||21 || prasannasalilākīrṇaḥ sarobhiḥ phullapaṃkajaiḥ | siṃhayūthānukīṇābhirjuṣṭābhirmṛgapakṣibhiḥ ||22|| sevitābhirmunigaṇaiḥ sthālībhirupaśobhitaḥ | kinnarodgītalalitaḥ parapuṣṭānināditaḥ ||23 || vidyādharaśatākīrṇo devagandharvasevitaḥ | dhārāpātaiśca meghānāṃ visphulliṃgaiḥ sahasraśaḥ ||24|| prakāśito muhurmṛduramyaharitaśādvalaḥ | sarvartukavanodyānaḥ puṣpākarasuśobhitaḥ ||25 || yajñakimpuruṣāvāso guhyakānāmathāśrayaḥ | muktānāṃ pārṣadānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ vāsaśobhanaḥ ||26|| varado yatra bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | sarvāmaragururdevo nityaṃ sannihito hariḥ ||27|| bhaktānukampī sa śrīmān cādhyāste pārṣadaiḥ saha | vimānayāyinaḥ sarve yaṃ devaṃ parameśvaram ||28|| āyānti sevituṃ devā vareṇyamajamacyutam | anye devanikāyāśca sevituṃ prapatanti yam ||29|| tadadhiṣṭhānarūpo’yaṃ deśaḥ strībhirvilokitaḥ | daityābhirvīkṣito deśaḥ śrāvaṇe’timanoharaḥ ||2.17.3 0|| vṛkṣaśākhāsu kanyābhiścāndolito hariḥ patiḥ | pratidrulambidolāyāṃ vīkṣitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||3 1|| āścaryaṃ tā gatā dṛṣṭvā patināśakaraṃ harim | cukrudhuścāti taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hantuṃ peturdrume drume ||32|| yadyaddrumasya śākhāyāṃ preṃkhā kṛṣṇasya lambate | sa sa vṛkṣo’bhavad devo vṛkṣarūpī prasevakaḥ ||33|| sa sa vṛkṣo’bhavat drāk ca śastradhṛk devapūruṣaḥ | rakṣituṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ hantuṃ tā daityayoṣitaḥ ||34|| ākāśe eva rākṣasyo yuddhaṃ devairvyadhustadā | bhindīpālaistomaraiśca mūśalairasthihetibhiḥ ||35|| vṛkṣaśākhābhirugrābhirvaṃśaiḥ prastarakaṇṭakaiḥ | pāṣāṇairyaṣṭibhiścāpi keśākeśi tataḥ punaḥ ||36|| devā vṛkṣā rākṣasībhiryuyudhurna ca jīvataḥ | na jaghnurmarmabhāgeṣu komalāṃgeṣu naiva ca ||37|| strījātiṃ na vihanyādvai matvaivaṃ prāṇato na tāḥ | nāśayāmāsurugrāstāstataḥ kanyābhireva ca ||38|| smṛtaḥ kṛṣṇaprabhurjñātvā nārīryuddhapramardinīḥ | drāgeva bhagavām̐statra dvedhā bhūtvā samāgataḥ ||39|| kālalakṣmīrūpadharaḥ sarvaśastrānvitaḥ prabhuḥ | sahasrabhujavān hastisthito vyomnā samāyayau ||2.17.40|| śveto hastiḥ pakṣayukto jagarja tvambare yadā | pratidhvanyā sphuṭakarṇā rākṣasyo vihvalāstadā ||41|| mūrchāmavāpurākāśe nipeturvanabhūtale | anyāstu dudruvurhastinaṃ tu nāśayituṃ hariḥ ||42|| kālalakṣmīsvarūpastā jaghāna jīvatastadā | mriyamāṇā dvidhā chinnā bhinnāḥ peturmṛtāḥ striyaḥ ||43 || tāsāmātmā kālalakṣmyā layaṃ yāto muhurmuhuḥ | kiśoraścāpararūpaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastadā ||44|| kanyakāmadhyavartī ca vireje lomaśāśrame | kāścid daityayūthapatnyo hastinā śuṇḍhayā hatāḥ ||45|| anyāḥ śastrairhatā lakṣmyā niḥśeṣā naṣṭatāṃ gatāḥ | mṛtāstā divyatāṃ prāptā yathā devyo virejire ||46|| mubhuhuḥ śrīkṛṣṇānārāyaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā kiśorakam | arthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ parameśvaramīśvaram ||47|| kānto bhava sadāsmākaṃ hyanāthānāṃ prarakṣakaḥ | mṛtā daityaguṇairhīnā jātāstava pratāpataḥ ||48|| kanyakāsu ca no vāsaṃ dehi lomaśasannidhau | sevāṃ kartuṃ samīhā naḥ sadā te’sti kṛpākara ||49|| tathāstviti hariḥ prāhāyutadivyāstu kanyakāḥ | ūnadvādaśavārṣikyo’bhavan kṛṣṇapratāpataḥ ||2.17.50|| rūpānurūpāvayavā priyā rādhāramāsamāḥ | tābhyo dadau lomaśaśca mantraṃ śrīvaiṣṇavottamam ||51||| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | taulasīṃ mālikāṃ kaṇṭhe lalāṭe tilakaṃ śubham ||52|| pītaśāṭīrdadau haste mālikāṃ japasādhanīm | jñānaṃ vidyāṃ dadau tābhyo vāsaṃ dadau nijāśrame ||53|| tāśca sarvā bālakṛṣṇacaraṇau dugdhadhārayā | prakṣālya ca papustasya prasādānnaṃ phalādikam ||54|| bhakṣayāmāsuratyāptapremṇā dāsyena tāstadā | lomaśaśca tatastābhyaḥ sarvābhyaḥ śaraṇāgatim ||55|| bodhayāmāsa vai ṣoḍhā sarvasamarpaṇātmikām | kanyāḥ śṛṇuta sarvā vai kṛṣṇārthakṛtaniścayāḥ ||56|| nārīdehaḥ parārtho’sti paraḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | tadarthaṃ sarvathā bhāvyaṃ nārībhiḥ patibhaktibhiḥ ||57|| patireva parabrahma tārako mokṣadāyakaḥ | śatajanmakṛtapuṇyāt kanyā bhavati dhārmikī ||58|| sahasrajanmapuṇyaistu bhavet kṛṣṇārpitā tu sā | lakṣajanmārjitapuṇyaiḥ kṛṣṇapatnī bhavet satī ||59|| yūyaṃ sarvāḥ kṛṣṇapatnyaḥ kṛpayā stha na saṃśayaḥ | kasmāt kutaśca tāvadvai puṇyamupārjitaṃ bhavet ||2.17.60|| hareryogātpuṇyavārdhiḥ śevadhiriva vardhate | kāmāt krodhācca saṃyogāllobhānmohādapi prabhau ||61 || tallīnāstadadhīnāścet sarvaṃ puṇyamupārjitam | evaṃ yūyaṃ cādya jātā lakṣmīhastagatāḥ striyaḥ ||62|| vaireṇāpi hareryogāt puṇyaṃ prāptā hi śāśvatam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyānugrahānmama ||63|| āśrame parito māyā naivāviśati kācana | māyāparo’yaṃ deśo’sti lomaśasya mamāśrayaḥ ||64|| kāmakrodhādidoṣāstu doṣiṇāṃ prajvalanti vai | ye mamāśramabhāgasyopari vyomni prayānti tu ||65|| uparito’pi gacchanti teṣāṃ naśyanti vai hṛdaḥ | doṣā rāgādayaścāpi paśūnāmapi pakṣiṇām ||66|| devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca daityānāṃ cāpi yoṣitām | saṃsāriṇāṃ ca saṃsāro mithyāvidvāsanātmakaḥ ||67|| āmūlato layaṃ yāti mamāśramaniṣevaṇāt | atrāśrame kṛtavāsā divyā bhavanti dehinaḥ ||68|| śāntisteṣāṃ sadā dāsye śrīkṛṣṇasya pratāpataḥ | yūyaṃ sarvā hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhajathātra tadāśritāḥ ||69|| hareḥ prāptiṃ vinā nānyad vāñcchanīyaṃ viśiṣyate | tasya bhaktiṃ hi kuruta dhyānaṃ carata tasya vai ||2.17.70|| sevāṃ labhadhvaṃ tasyaiva nityaṃ nityamatandritāḥ | gataṃ pāpaṃ gato bhāvo daityatā vṛddhatā gatā ||7 1 || gatā bhīrmaraṇaṃ cāpi gataṃ yuṣmākamārttidam | sarvaṃ labdhaṃ ca labdhavyaṃ prāptavyaṃ prāptamityapi ||72|| kṛtaṃ kṛtyaṃ ca yāvadvai nāto’nyadavaśiṣyate | sevadhvaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ dāsyaṃ hṛdi kṛtvā tu kanyakāḥ ||73|| viśvāso mādhave kāryo yathāpatyasya mātari | varadānaṃ varaṇaṃ ca tasmin kāryaṃ tvameva me ||74|| sannyāsaḥ sarvathā tasmin kṛṣṇe dehasya dehinām | kārpaṇyaṃ cāpi kaiṃkaryaṃ bhṛtyavat paramātmani ||75|| sadā sthairyaṃ sukhe duḥkhe pātivratyaṃ na cetarat | mama kāntasyānukūlyaṃ tadicchecchā tu māmakī ||76 || prātikūlyaṃ na me tasya tadaniṣṭaṃ tu neṣyate | ityevaṃ svāmisaukhye svasaukhyaṃ manyeta māninī ||77|| svāmiduḥkhe tu yāśāntā duḥkhinī bhavati dhruvam | svātmavad vartate tasmin kānte deve parātmani ||78|| sarvaṃ tasmai pradātavyaṃ śaraṇaṃ yā samicchati | sa evātra pitā pātā sa eva jananī januḥ ||79|| kṛṣṇa eva mahān bandhurbhrātā svasā hariḥ svayam | kṛṣṇa eva kaniṣṭho’pi cānujo duhitāpi saḥ ||2.17.80|| kṛṣṇa eva patiḥ patnī snuṣā vadhūrharirmama | kṛṣṇa eva śvaśuraśca śvaśrūrnanāndā cātmajā ||81 || putraḥ putrī sakhī mitraṃ kṛṣṇa eva sadā mama | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhrātā rājā bhatyaśca kiṃkaraḥ |||82|| sevakaśca guruḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śikṣakaśca purohitaḥ | darśakaḥ sārtha evāyaṃ gṛhaṃ gṛhapatiḥ prabhuḥ ||83|| āśrayaḥ phaladaścāpi mama śreṣṭhoṃ sa mādhavaḥ | mama kṣetraṃ vāṭikā ca mama dravyaṃ hariḥ svayam ||84|| sambandhī me keśavaḥ sa bālaḥ sa bālikā mama | mama hṛdyo mahīmānaḥ prāghūṇiko mama prabhuḥ ||85|| sapatnī me sadā kṛṣṇaḥ sapatno māyike mama | mayi draṣṭā mayi śrotā mayi spraṣṭā janārdanaḥ ||86 || ghrātā rasayitā kṛṣṇo mayi mantā hariḥ sa vai | gantā mayi grahitā sa vaktānandayitā mayi ||87|| visarjayitā kṛṣṇaḥ sa boddhā cintayitā mayi | nirṇetā saḥ prāpayitā vettā vidvān sa vai mayi ||88||| tarpayitā modayitā ratnā mayi hariḥ sa ca | goptā cākarṣayitā ca garbhe kukṣau sa me hṛdi ||89|| prāṇayitā jīvayitāntarātmā me pumuttamaḥ | sākṣī cetā patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvāhaṃ tanmayī vadhūḥ ||2.17.90|| tasya sarvaṃ mayi cāhaṃ tasmin śrīparamātmani | ityevaṃ putrikā yūyaṃ bhavatāsminniveditāḥ ||9 1|| yanmiṣṭaṃ yacca me hṛdyaṃ yanmādhuryaṃ yacchītalam | tatsarvaṃ me bālakṛṣṇaścaivaṃ bhavata dāsikāḥ ||92|| gopāyanti yathā gopyaṃ prabhurgopyatamo hariḥ | kāntaḥ so’yaṃ gopanīyaḥ kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||93|| kāntārthaṃ gopanaṃ sarvaṃ kāntāgre naiva gopanam | kāntavad bhāvyate kṛṣṇastataḥ kāntāyate hi saḥ ||94|| kāntāyate yathā kāntā kāntaṃ pratyabhikāmukī | kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇāyate kṛṣṇāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pratyabhikāmukīm ||95|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yuṣmāsu vartate | abhinnastiṣṭhati dravyaṃ śāśvataṃ cāvyayaṃ hi saḥ ||96|| sa eva militaścātra gopālakṛṣṇamandire | kambharāśrīnandanaḥ sa prāpto yuṣmadvrataṃ hi saḥ ||97|| bhojane śayane snāne dhyāne yāne samāsane | vihāre ramaṇe pāne viśrāme ca pravartane ||98|| vikṛtau sukṛtau saumye juṣadhvaṃ taṃ viṣādane | nivartane ca nidrāyāṃ juṣadhvaṃ taṃ priyaṃ patim ||99|| evaṃ kriyākalāpaṃ svaṃ samarpayata tatra vai | etāvacchāstravistāraścaitāvattvanuśāsanam || 2.17.10 0|| oṃ śāntirastuviratirbhavatīnāṃ narāyaṇe | sarvakāmalayaścāstu bhavatīnāṃ parātmani || 101 || ityupādiśya munirāṭ māyākṣālanasadbalaḥ | kanyābhyaḥ sa ca saṃvāsān dadau parṇālayeṣu vai || 1 02|| svayaṃ dhyāne nimagno’bhūt kanyābhirbhojitāśca tāḥ | pūjitā vanditāḥ svāgatādibhiścābhiyojitāḥ || 103 || tatastā api nityaṃ vai śuśruvuḥ paramāḥ kathāḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ prātaḥ sāyaṃ dine dine || 1 04|| prātarnityaṃ pūjayanti sma śrīkṛṣṇaṃ patiṃ priyam | janmanaḥ saphalatvaṃ ca kurvantyeva divāniśam || 1 05|| ityevaṃ rādhike te’tra kathitāṃ divyatāpradām | patyarthaṃ prāṇadātrīṇāṃ kathāṃ kṛṣṇanivedinīm || 1 06|| yāsu nāsti sadācāro yāsu nāsti ca sevanam | bhaktirārādhanā yāsu nāsti kṛṣṇasya bhāvanam || 1 07|| tāsāṃ tuṣṭo hariścāyaṃ tvanugrahaparāyaṇaḥ | kṛpāsādhyo mahārājo vavarṣa sīmato’tigaḥ || 1 08|| kartumakartumanyathākartuṃ śaktaḥ parātparaḥ | daityajātīn devajātīn brahmajātīn karoti vai || 1 09|| pāpātpāpatamaścāpi paṭhanācchravaṇādapi | devavanmuktavat kṛṣṇapatnīvat saṃprajāyate || 2.17.11 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kaṃkatāladaityapatnīnāṃ yuddhe kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre kṛṣṇakāntātvaṃ lomaśakṛtabālakṛṣṇātmaniveditopadeśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||
<2.18> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rādhe bhādrapade pitṛpakṣe harergṛham | aryamādikapitṝṇāṃ haraye’rpayituṃ sutāḥ || 1 || kanyāḥ samāgatā miṣṭapāyasānnatilānvitāḥ | phalapuṣpāgurukastūrikākuṃkumataṇḍulaiḥ || 2 || karpūrādyairyuktasauvarṇādipātrasamanvitāḥ | purāṇadevapūjārthaṃ sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhitāḥ || 3 || vimānairdivyasāmagrīsaṃbhṛtaiḥ premasaṃplutāḥ | amāvāsyādine sarvāścāyayurlomaśāśramam || 4 || lomaśaṃ prathamaṃ natvā guruṃ ca pitaraṃ param | sasmaruśca hariṃ tatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hi tāḥ || 5 || tāvattatra bālakṛṣṇaścāyayau lomaśāśramam | kanyāpradattapūjādigrahaṇārthaṃ dayāvaśaḥ || 6 || pitṛkanyāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamāyāntamujjvalam | manoharaṃ kiśoraṃ ca vilokyotthāya satvaram || 7 || abhijagmuḥ pramodena nemurlājākṣatādibhiḥ | vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ nipetuḥ pādayorhareḥ || 8 || abhibhāṣya ca kuśalaṃ parasparamanāmayam | puṣpahārān dadustasya gale sahasrakanyakāḥ || 9 || padrajo mastake dhṛtvā mūrtiṃ nyadhuśca mānase | nyadhū rūpaṃ netrayośca snehaṃ nyadhustadantare || 2.18.1 0|| svayaṃ nyadhuścārpaṇe’tha militvāśramamāyayuḥ | brahmasarobhiḥ kanyābhiḥ satyalokīyamuttamam || 1 1|| divyamarpitamevādau haṃsāsanaṃ vimānavat | śatacandrābhinaddhaṃ ca svarṇavarūthaśobhitam || 12 amṛtasrāvi paritaḥ sugandhanirjharānvitam | svayaṃ dolāyamānaṃ ca gītisvaramanoharam || 13|| yathākāmaṃ ca gatimaccaitanyastambabhūṣitam | maṇisopānasaṃrājat sphāṭikapārśvaghaṭṭitam || 14|| mṛduvibhūtigaddīkātulikāpaṭṭarājitam | adhyāruroha bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśca tat || 15|| siṃhāsanācchataguṇā śobhā harestadābhavat | athāpsarobhiḥ kanyābhirupānahau sukomale || 16|| makhamallakṛte mṛdvyau vidyuccandrikatārakaiḥ | svarṇarājatasantānairbharatena virājite || 17|| indragosannibhe ramye cārpite pādayorhareḥ | niryātaste yathākāmaṃ yathākāmaṃ dhṛtikriye || 18|| kṛṣṇena ca pramodena dhṛte tūpānahau yadā | ākṣaraṃ divyamevābhyāṃ tejaḥ prakaṭitaṃ bahu || 19|| yadavyāpnod digantāṃśca koṭicandranibhaṃ tadā | athāryamādisūryāṇāṃ kanyābhiśchatramarpitam ||2.18.20 || suvarṇakaṭavastrāḍhyaṃ rājatīkiṃkiṇīyutam | suvarṇakalaśaṃ ratnadaṇḍaṃ bhāsuramujjvalam ||21 || kauśeyamañjarīyuk ca ādityacitrarājitam | atha kuberakanyābhiḥ pādapīṭhaḥ samarpitaḥ ||22|| mṛdusuvarṇakhacitaścandanadrumanirmitaḥ | siṃhapādasuśobhāḍhyaścāṣṭakoṇasamanvitaḥ ||23|| padmapatramiva svacchaḥ śītalastejasānvitaḥ | ādarśakhacitaḥ pārśve madhye candravirājitaḥ |||24|| tatra nyadhāccaraṇau śrīpatiḥ svāmipumuttamaḥ | atha śailasya kanyābhiścāmarau śvetagobhavau ||25|| ratnasuvarṇadaṇḍau cārpitau kṛṣṇāya tuṣṭaye | athendrakanyakābhiścārpitaṃ vetraṃ tu kānakam ||26|| vedhomastakasaṃśobhaṃ kambukaṇṭhaṃ ca vakṣasi | valayairvividhairyuktaṃ tato vallyudaraṃ śubham ||27|| pītapaṭakabaddhaṃ ca prānte śeṣaphaṇāyutam | madhye mauktikahīrakamaṇinaddhaṃ samantataḥ ||28|| atha ca dharmarājasya kanyābhiryaṣṭirarpitā | kānakī saṃhṛtiśaktimastakā jīvanīpadā ||29|| samādhiśaktimadhyā ca dharmamūrtimukhānvitā | madhye yāmyasabhāyuktā prānte dūtagaṇānvitā ||2.18.3 0|| atha vāyośca kanyābhirvyajane ratnayaṣṭike | sauvarṇakaṭakairnaddhe kauśeyaprāntajhallare ||3 1|| sauvarṇapaṭavākṣepe sūryacandrobhayānvite | vartule taijasamaṇinaddhe rautyanisargaje ||32|| athartukanyakāḥ kṛṣṇe daduḥ śekharagucchakau | puṣpāṇāṃ kandukaṃ hārān torān sugandhisaṃbhṛtān || 33|| amlānān divyarūpāṃśca miṣṭasveṣṭasugandhikān | atha viśvakarmakanyā dadurmukuṭamujjvalam ||34|| ābhūṣaṇāni ca svarṇanirmitāni ca mālikāḥ | ūrmikā raśanāścāṅgulīyakāni ca mekhalām || 35|| kaṭakānaṃgadān śṛṃkhalāśca nupūrakiṃkiṇīḥ | kaṇṭhabhūṣā vicitrāśca dadurnārāyaṇāya tāḥ ||36|| atha drukanyakāstasmai dadurvastrāṇi bhāvataḥ | aṃgarakṣakaṃ dhautraṃ cottarīyakaṃ śiraḥpaṭam ||37|| skandhavastraṃ kaṭipaṭaṃ sauvarṇatārasaṃhitam | naktakaṃ karavastraṃ ca paṭṭakaṃ satpaṭīṃ daduḥ || 38|| atha śravaṇapitṝṇāṃ kanyāḥ śrāvaṇya ityapi | daduḥ śrīharaye vāribhṛtān svarṇaghaṭān śubhān ||39|| atha saṃvatsarapitṛkanyāḥ pakvānnapūrikāḥ | pāyasāni ca śākāni bhojyāni haraye daduḥ ||2.18.40|| kālakanyā dadurdivyaṃ kare tvabhayacakrakam | vahnipitṛkanyakāśca daduḥ pātrāṇi bhūriśaḥ ||41 || sthālīśca vaṭakīścāpi kalaśān tāpalīnikāḥ | camacān jalapām̐ścāpi sauvarṇān rājatādikān ||42|| atha pretapitṛputryo dadustāmbūlakāni ca | khanijanmapitṛkanyā dadurmāṃgalyavastukam ||43|| dravām̐śca vividhān dhātuvikārotthān suraṃgiṇaḥ | evamanyāśca pitryaśca nyadhuryogyaṃ hareḥ puraḥ ||44|| vārkṣyo daduścaṭanyādi tiktāmblakaṭumiśritam | evaṃ bhādre hyamāyāṃ tu pitryaḥ sarvā hariṃ prabhum ||45|| arcayāmāsuratyarthaṃ naijāsāmānyavastubhiḥ | tarpayāmāsuratyarthaṃ bhojayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ||46|| pāyasādīni cānnāni phalāni vividhāni ca | miṣṭapānāni śītāni svādyāni rasavanti ca ||47|| viśvaṃbharo hi bhagavān bubhuje bahurūpadhṛk | sarveṣāṃ pitṝṇāṃ lakṣakanyānāṃ bhāvanānugaḥ ||48|| lakṣarūpo harirbhūtvā śrāddhaṃ jagrāha tatkṛtam | atha śrībhagavān tatra sasmāra pitṛdevatāḥ ||49|| brahmādi mukhyadevāṃśca brahmordhvaretaso’pi ca | munīnṛṣīn surām̐ścāpi lokapālān digīśvarān ||2.18.50|| śrāvaṇān yāmyapitam̐śca pretapitṝm̐śca kālikān | sāmvatsarikapitṝm̐śca khāneyām̐ścāpi sarvaśaḥ ||5 1|| ājyapān somapām̐ścāpi barhiṣadām̐stathā pitṝn | agniṣvāttān karmavaśān sarvānatarpayaddhariḥ ||52|| jalaistilaiḥ phalairājyaiḥ pāyasairmiṣṭabhojanaiḥ | śākairmadhubhirdadhyannairvividhairbhojyavastubhiḥ ||53 || annavastravāripānairmukhacūrṇādibhistathā | āgatān sarvapitṝm̐śca tarpayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ||54|| koṭiśaḥ pitṛdevān sa tarpayāmāsa keśavaḥ | prāsādikaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ bhojayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ||55|| tato dānāni ca dadau koṭiratnāni vai tadā | kanyābhyaḥ koṭyarbudebhyaḥ sarvābhyo bhagavān svayam ||56|| bhojayāmāsa vidhinā pāyasādīni sarvathā | miṣṭānnāni ca bahūni peyāni vividhāni ca ||57|| svaprāsādikatāmbūlādīnyapi pradadau prabhuḥ | tṛptāstāḥ kanyakāḥ sarvāḥ prācyo’vācyaśca pitṛjāḥ ||58|| atha sāyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pupūjurādarāt | ārārtrikaṃ tataścakrurvandanaṃ ca yathepsitam ||59|| arthayāmāsuretā yāḥ pitṛkanyāḥ samāyayuḥ | kṛṣṇasevanalābhaṃ vai dātuṃ yāvacca jīvanam ||2.18.60|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha tathāstviti | sarvāstāstasthurautsukyāllomaśasyāśrame sadā ||6 1 || bālakṛṣṇājñayā kṛṣṇasevāparāḥ sadābhavan | pitaro ye ca tṛptāśca gatā naijaṃ svarādikam ||62|| bhagavān bālarūpaśca lomaśaṃ susamarcya ca | bhojayitvā pūjayitvā tvekarūpo hariryayau ||63|| naijaṃ saudhaṃ kaṃbharāśrīnivāsaṃ sampadāśrayam | atha sandhyāsamaye śrīhariḥ sasmāra sūryajam ||64|| nārakiṇāṃ tu jīvānāṃ vimokṣārthaṃ hi pāpinām | tathā pramuktaśeṣāṇāṃ bhujyamānaśarīriṇām ||65|| dharmarājyasya yāmyānāṃ tvabhayaṃ kartumeva ca | dharmarājaḥ samāyātastatkālaṃ harisannidhau ||66|| jarayā vyādhibhiścāpi mahākālena mṛtyunā | citraguptena sahito dvitīyarūpadhṛk nayaḥ ||67|| etānāha prabhuścādya pitṝṇāṃ divaso mahān | tṛptipradastataścāhaṃ tvājñāpayāmi sarvathā ||68|| yamalokagatāḥ sarve bhojanīyāstu pāyasaiḥ | mama prasādaśākādyaiḥ pāvanīyā madicchayā ||69|| sarve śuddhā bhavantvadya yāta svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam | ityuktvā pradadau kṛṣṇastebhyaḥ prasādapāyasam ||2.18.70|| yamādyā jagṛhustatra bhakṣayāmāsurādarāt | jalapānādikaṃ kṛtvā kṛtakṛtyān hi menire ||71 || atha kṛṣṇo dadau tebhyaḥ pāyasānnaṃ supuṣkalam | yāmyebhyaśca pradānārthaṃ yamādyā jagṛhuśca tat ||72|| śrīharerājñayā dharmarājādyāḥ paripūjya tam | natvā stutvā pādayośca patitvā ca yamakṣayam ||73|| yayuḥ samyak prasannāśca yāmyānāhūya nāṭakān | yathājñāṃ bhojayāmāsuḥ prasādaṃ pāyasaṃ hareḥ ||74|| bhuktvā pāpāni tūrṇaṃ te kṣālayitvāntarāṇyapi | nirmalāste ca sañjātā dharmarājājñayā tataḥ ||75|| svargaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ lokaṃ mokṣaṃ cāpi yayustadā | hareḥ pratāpādevaṃ vai pretādyāḥ pitaro gaṇāḥ ||76|| tāritā hariṇā lokapitaraḥ karmavartinaḥ | avagatiṃ gatāścāpi tāritāste dayālunā ||77|| anugrahārthaṃ jīveṣu yato janmāsti bhūtale | evaṃ vai rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ parātparaḥ ||78|| paraṃ dhāma janān jīvānnayatyeva kṛpāvaśaḥ | nijayogaṃ dadātyeṣa bhaktasaṃkalpatatparaḥ ||79|| paṭhanāchravaṇāccāsya pitṛmokṣo bhaveddhruvam | tathaiva yoṣitaḥ pitryo muktiṃ prayānti vai śruteḥ ||2.18.80|| śrīrādhikovāca pitarastu śrutā devapitaraḥ śrāvaṇāstathā | pretā yāmyāḥ sāmvatsarāḥ kālā khāneyakāstathā ||8 1|| agniṣvāttā bārhiṣadā ājyapāḥ somapāstathā | aryamādyā ṛṣirūpā ūrdhvaretasa aiśvarāḥ ||82|| brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca mānavā rākṣasāḥ khagāḥ | yakṣā dūtāḥ piśācāśca bhūtāḥ kūṣmāṇḍakāstathā ||83|| vaināyakāśca vetālā adhogatiṃ gatāśca ye | ta ete pitaraḥ sarve śrutāstvattaḥ prasaṃgataḥ ||84|| kintu putryastvayocyante yāstu kṛṣṇena tarpitāḥ | kāstāḥ pitryo bhavantyatra śrāddhabhojanavāsanāḥ ||85|| rāseśvara kṛpāsindho tanme kṛṣṇa pradarśaya | yāstā nāryo pitryībhūtāḥ kva kathaṃ nivasanti tāḥ ||86 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca samyak pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā rādhe lokānugrahakāmyayā | tvaṃ tu jānāsi vai sarvaṃ nibodha kathayāmyapi ||87|| nārīvargo mayā sṛṣṭo goloke mama vāmataḥ | rādhā lakṣmīḥ satī gaṃgā sarasvatī tathāparāḥ ||88|| virajā śrīryamī durgā sāvitrī ca tathetarāḥ | tāḥ pitryaḥ pūrvajāḥ śrāddhe bhuñjate tarpitāḥ priyāḥ ||89|| pitāmahī tu sāvitrī śrīśca vai prapitāmahī | praprapitāmahī durgā śrāddhe cāyānti tāstadā ||2.18.90 || mātā lakṣmīśca vai mātāmahī sarasvatī tathā | satī pramātāmahī ca śrāddhe cāyānti sarvathā ||91 || yāśca vadhvaḥ snuṣā bālā vidhavā vā kumārikāḥ | adhavāpyadatī cākṣatā jaraṭhāḥ savāsanāḥ ||92|| vicittāḥ kṛtavāgdānā vivāsitāḥ svatantrikāḥ | nirvaṃśā niṣkuṭumbāśca nirādhārā nirāśrayāḥ ||93|| akṛtodakaśrāddhāśca tathāpradattavahnikāḥ | atīrthavāhikā yāścasambandhispṛṣṭayacchavāḥ ||94|| akālamṛtyumāpannā ākasmikamṛtiṃ gatāḥ | garbhaprasūtidoṣeṇa mṛtā yāścābhicārikāḥ ||95|| abhicāramṛtāścāpi prasahyāpi ca yā mṛtāḥ | prasahya maithune mṛtā yakṣarākṣasasaṃhṛtāḥ ||96|| yoniduṣṭā mṛtā yāśca vaidhavyadharmavarjitāḥ | bahuyogaṃ gatā yāśca parādhīnamṛtiṃ gatāḥ ||97|| bhūtapretapiśācādicchāyāvaśamṛtiṃ gatāḥ | paścātpuṇyavihīnāścākṛtapuṇyavratotsavāḥ ||98|| etā nirvaṃśajāḥ sarvāḥ pitryo bhavanti rādhike | yāmye vasanti nirvaṃśāḥ kumāryaḥ satyalokake ||99|| maharjanatapassveva tadanyāścāpamṛtyujāḥ | svarge puṇyakṛtāścāpi nirvaṃśā apsarogaṇāḥ || 2.18.100 || bhūvarloke nivasanti bhūtī pretī piśācinī | ḍākinī śākinī kūṣmāṇḍinī vaināyakī tathā || 101 || vaitālī bhairavī raṇḍā kṛtyā ṣaṇḍhā ca sūtakī | śavī citā nanāmnī ca śmaśānī ceti rādhike || 1 02|| etāḥ pitryo bhavantyeva bhuvarbhūlokasaṃsthitāḥ | nāginī bhikṣukī pipīlikā matsyī ca rākṣasī || 1 03 || kākī gṛdhrī ca makarī pātāle ca jale sthitāḥ | etā nirvaṃśamṛtijāḥ pitryo bhavanti rādhike || 1 04|| mātaro devatā yāśca sāttvikyastā api striyaḥ | krūradṛśo’thavā vaṃśayutā api mṛteḥ param || 1 05|| bhavanti pitryaḥ pāpena yathākarmanivāsikāḥ | tābhyaḥ śrāddhaṃ pradātavyaṃ jānatā viduṣā sadā || 1 06|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena tābhya eva ca | jalānnādi tadā dattaṃ viśvaṃbhareṇa tṛptaye || 107|| tāḥ sarvā api saṃgṛhya prasādamadhigamya ca | yayuḥ svargādikaṃ saukhyānandasthalaṃ vṛṣānvitāḥ || 1 08|| śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tatra camatkāro mahānabhūt | niśithe rākṣasā gurormandiraṃ samupāyayuḥ || 1 09|| śirohīnasteṣu caiko’paro netravihīnakaḥ | tṛtīyo nāsikāhīnaścaturthaḥ karṇaśūnyakaḥ || 2.18.110 || pañcamaḥ pādahīnaśca ṣaṣṭhaḥ kaṭitṛṇopamaḥ | saptamaḥ pādapṛṣṭhaścāṣṭamaḥ pṛṣṭhānanastathā || 111 || navamo’ndho badhiraśca paṃgurmūkaśca kuṣṭhavān | caturdaśo vātarogī jalodarī napuṃsakaḥ || 1 12|| saptadaśo malinaśca parito lagnamakṣikaḥ | aṣṭādaśo galapāśaḥ saśūlaśca tathetaraḥ || 1 13|| viṃśaḥ śvaphāṭitaḥ kroḍatroṭitaśca tathāpare | evamādyā gaṇāścāśvapaṭṭasaraḥ samāyayuḥ || 1 14|| krośanto bahudhākrośān nivedayanto duṣkṛtān | annahīnā jalahīnāḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukāḥ || 1 15|| channodarāśca vai pretāścāyayurbahudhā tadā | rurudurlomaśasyāgre svoddhārārthaṃ bhṛśaṃ tataḥ || 1 16|| lomaśaḥ paripapraccha kathaṃ vai pretatāṃ gatāḥ | tatraikaḥ prāha ca mayā chinnaṃ dvijaśiraḥ purā || 1 17|| tena pāpina vai jātaḥ śirohīno’tra rākṣasaḥ | aparaḥ prāha ca mayā cauryakārye gṛheśituḥ || 1 18|| netre prasphoṭite tena netrahīno’bhavam ṛṣe | tṛtīyaḥ prāha ca mayā patnyāśchinnā tu nāsikā || 1 19|| tenāhaṃ nāsikāhīnaḥ preto bhavāmi duḥkhavān | caturthaḥ prāha ca mayā karṇau chinnau dvijasya vai || 2.18.120|| bhūṣāyuktau bhūṣaṇānāṃ mayāpaharaṇaṃ kṛtam | tena jātaḥ karṇahīnaḥ preto bhavāmi duḥkhavān || 121 || pañcamastu tadā prāha mayā pravāsinaḥ purā | hatau pādau vane dravyaharaṇārthaṃ tato’pyaham || 1 22|| pādahīnaḥ samabhavaṃ gacchāmyadhomukhaḥ sadā | ṣaṣṭhaḥ prāha mayā yaṣṭyā māreṇa ghātitā kaṭiḥ || 1 23|| goḥ pūrvaṃ tena pāpena bhagnakaṭirbhavāmyaham | saptamaḥ prāha ca mayā pādau badhvā mama striyāḥ || 124|| kleśitā sā vinā doṣaṃ tena doṣeṇa rākṣasaḥ | pṛṣṭhapādo bhavāmyatra gatiśaktivihīnakaḥ || 125|| aṣṭamaḥ prāha ca mayā tvajābālāsya kaṇṭhataḥ | mastakaṃ mroḍitaṃ paścānmāritaṃ cājabālakam || 126|| tena doṣeṇa jāto’smi pṛṣṭhānanaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ | navamaḥ prāha ca mayā mṛgayākaraṇe purā || 1 27|| cakṣuḥ prasphoṭitaṃ caikamṛgasya jīvatastataḥ | jāto’smi tena doṣeṇa jātyandho duḥkhaduḥkhitaḥ || 128|| daśamaḥ prāha ca mayā nindā viṣṇoḥ purā śrutā | tenāhaṃ janmabadhiraścaikādaśo’pyuvāca tam || 129|| mayā pāde hataḥ śvā ca tenāhaṃ paṃgutāṃ gataḥ | dvādaśaḥ prāha sādhūnāṃ nindayā mūkatāṃ gataḥ || 2.18.13 0|| agamyāgamanāt kuṣṭhī trayodaśo’vadattadā | caturdaśo vātarogī viśvāsaghātako’bhavam || 131 || matsyādo’yaṃ jalodarī nāto’stīti jagāda ca | ṣoḍaśo’yaṃ vyavāyī ca napuṃsako’ṇḍanāśakaḥ || 1 32|| vṛṣabhāṇāṃ tato jātastathā caṇḍālakarmakṛt | makṣikāsamabhivyāptaḥ saṃjāto’yaṃ tathāvadat || 1 33|| galapāśapradaścāyaṃ galapāśo’bhavattathā | śūlapradaśca jīvānāṃ śūlarogī tato hyayam || 134|| viṃśaḥ prāha mayā pūrvaṃ śaśādyāḥ śvāpadādibhiḥ | vidāritā bahupāpo bhavāmyadya vidāritaḥ || 135|| atikaṣṭaṃ ca bhuñjāmo bhojanaṃ nopalabhyate | tṛṣitā duḥkhitāḥ smo’dya kṛpālurbhagavān yadi || 136|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa uddhārayettu naḥ | muktiṃ gatā bhaviṣyāmo vipra muktiṃ pradāpaya || 1 37|| ityukto lomaśastebhyo dadau mantraṃ jalānvitam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 1 38|| sasmāra bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca kṛṣṇo drāk tatra cāyayau | nijapādajalaṃ tebhyo pāyayitvā hariśca tān | | 139|| vidhāya divyadehām̐śca caturbhujasvarūpiṇaḥ | vimānaiḥ preṣayāmāsa vaikuṇṭhaṃ dhāma śāśvatam || 2.18.140|| evaṃ muktiṃ pradatvaiva harirnaijālayaṃ yayau | pāpināṃ muktidātāyaṃ jayate parameśvaraḥ || 141 || paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya pitruddhāro bhaveddhruvam | yaśaḥ kīrtirdhanaṃ dhānyaṃ gāvaścārogyamityapi || 142|| putraḥ pautrāḥ sutāḥ svarṇaṃ mokṣo lakṣmīrvibhūtayaḥ | bhaveyuḥ sampadaḥ sarvāḥ śroturvakturna saṃśayaḥ || 143|| namastasmai bhagavate sarvoddhāradayālave | karmāṇi pāpināṃ cāvigaṇayya mokṣadāyine || 144|| daityadānavapāpānāṃ rakṣasāṃ pāvanāya ca | bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ mokṣakartre namonamaḥ || 145|| dayāloḥ śrīharernāsti dayāyāḥ pāra ityapi | pāpināṃ tu kvacinnāsti doṣāṇāmanta ityapi || 146|| ityevaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram | jñātvā bhajanti satataṃ te mokṣasthā na saṃśayaḥ || 147|| citte kṛṣṇo hṛdi kṛṣṇaścakṣuṣoḥ kṛṣṇa ātmani | brahmarandhre yasya kṛṣṇaḥ sa bhavenmokṣago dhruvam || 148|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pitṛpakṣe pitṛkanyākṛtaharipūjanaṃ, harikṛtapitṛtarpaṇādi, nārakāṇāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ, pitṛstrījātiparicayaḥ pretānāṃ muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 18 ||
<2.19> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca athāsya vatsare yāte dvitīye vatsare śubhe | prārabdhe kārtikakṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ janmotsavaṃ pitā || 1 | | pracakāra tadā gurorlomaśasyāpi pūjanam | brāhmaṇān bhojayāmāsa dadau dānāni bhūriśaḥ || 2 || sarva tad rādhike tubhyaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapumuttamasya vai || 3 || saptamyāṃ prātarutthāya śrīmadropālakṛṣṇakaḥ | smṛtvā kṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ rādhe snātvā prapūjya keśavam || 4 || patrikāṃ lekhayāmāsa vārṣikādyamahotsave | varṣaṃ me nandanasyaurjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīprage śubham || 5 || pūrṇa prajāyate cātha dvitīyavatsarakṣaṇe | śubhe dine ca tatraiva mahotsave mudāvahe || 6 || kriyamāṇe mayāgatya bhavadbhirupabṛṃhite | svātmāyamiti matvaiva śobhāvṛddhirvidhīyatām || 7 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāśīrnidhiḥ svayam | nīyantāṃ cāpi dīyantāṃ yathāsnehaṃ śubhāśiṣaḥ || 8 || matvā gṛhaṃ svakīyaṃ cāgantavyaṃ prārthayāmi vaḥ | kuṭumbabhṛtyasujanasuhṛtsambandhisaṃhitān || 9 || devarṣipitṛvṛddhānāṃ satāṃ brahmānuśīlinām | pativratānāṃ sādhvīnāṃ devīnāṃ brahmayoṣitām || 2.19.10 || vipradharmavatāṃ bhaktasatsaṃgakāriṇāṃ tathā | śubhāśīrbhiḥ śiśuḥ śyāmo ghanaśyāmo harirbhavet || 11 || kuṃkumavāpikātīrthe cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe | saurāṣṭre bhūtale sarvairāgantavyaṃ mama gṛhama || 12 || bhadrā yasyottare cāsti pūrvaṃ śatrujitā nadī | dakṣiṇe vartate vyāghrāraṇyaṃ ca paścime giriḥ || 13 || madhye sarovaraṃ divyaṃ daśakrodhādivartulam | madhye dvīpo mahānasti prāsādo lomaśāśramaḥ || 1 4| | tatra gopālakṛṣṇasya mamālayo virājate | āgantavyaṃ mahābhāgairdvitīyavārṣikotsave | | 1 5 | | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ | dhanyo’haṃ kṛtakṛtyo’haṃ bhaviṣyāmyāgamāttu vaḥ | | 16 | | vaikuṇṭhena sameyaṃ bhūrbhaviṣyatyāgamāttu vaḥ | putrasya janmasāphalyaṃ bhaviṣyatyāgamācca vaḥ | | 17| | vāraṃ vāraṃ praṇamyāmantrayāmyāgamanāya vaḥ | caturdaśastarasthānāṃ samājo’tra bhaviṣyati | | 18 | | parasparaprasaṃgena lābho’labhyo bhaviṣyati | seviṣye ca yathāśakti mahīmānān samāhitaḥ | | 1 9| | kṛpaṇo’yamiti matvānugrāhyo dāsa eva yat | kambharāśrīstathā cānugrāhyā nārībhirāgamāt || 2.19.20 | | sarvamānasayuktāṃśca tattvāni cārthayāmyapi | dravyaguṇakriyājātisaṃsargānarthayāmyapi | | 21 | | cetanācetanān sarvānāmantrayāmi bhāvataḥ | mama putro bhavatputro vardhanīyaḥ śubhāśiṣā || 22| | anāgame tu cintā me sarvadānāgamātmikā | utthitā syācca sā mābhūt kṛpā mā khaṇḍitā bhavet || 23| | śāśvatikatā saṃrakṣyā śāśvatikamahotsave | ityabhyarthya virame’tipratikṣan ṛtayācanām | | 24| | ityevaṃ rādhike pitrā prabhoḥ kuṃkumapatrikā | likhitā bhāvagarbhā ca preṣitā vai digantare ||25 | | kṛṣṇāyudhāni sarvāṇi yayurnītvā divaṃ prati | īśalokān guṇā yayurdhāmānyaiśvaryamaṇḍalam ||26| | pātālādau bhūṣaṇāni yayurnītvā ca patrikāḥ | rādhike mūrtimantaste kṛṣṇadūtā yathā yayuḥ | |27| | āmantritāśca te yātuṃ prayāṇe cakrire mudā | svasvalokasyavastūni śreṣṭhapreṣṭhāni sarvathā ||28|| divyānyupadāyogyāni sauvarṇarājatāni ca | tāntavāni rāsanāni vimānādau dadhuśca te || 29| | ānandaṃ menire kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamahotsavam | iṣṭaṃ bhāgyaṃ samāyātaṃ matvā babhūvurutsukāḥ ||2.19.3 0 || kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre gopālakṛṣṇalomaśau | saptamyāmeva sāmagrīsamavāyaṃ pracakratuḥ ||3 1 || ghṛtakulyā dadhikulyā guḍakulyāśca śarkarāḥ | madhūni ca vicitrāṇi miṣṭānnānyapi sarveśaḥ | |32 || peyāni mukhacūrṇāni kārayāmāsaturmudā | kāndivikāśca devānāṃ tayā lakṣmyādiyoṣitaḥ || 3 || kanyakāśca harerbhaktāścakrurmāhānasīyakam | pātheyaṃ jāṭharārpyaṃ ca yatkiñcidbhinnajātikam | |34 || sarvaṃ vyañjanasāhāyyaṃ cāranālādibṛṃhitam | lehyaṃ coṣyaṃ bhojyamiṣṭaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bharjitamityapi || 35|| kvāthitaṃ pācitaṃ pratāpitaṃ cārdrīkṛtaṃ tathā | pepitaṃ kūrcitaṃ dagdhaṃ sārīkṛtaṃ prapecetam | |36 || chūṃkāritaṃ vāṣpitaṃ ca miśritaṃ mathitaṃ tayā | yadyad yogyaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ cakrurvai niśi sarvathā | | 37 || darvī cullī kaṭāhī ca sthālī kuṃbhī mahānasī | cipiṭī gargarī bhrāṣṭrī cāgaminī ca vardhinī | | 38 || mūśalī vallarītyādyā devyaḥ pākasahāyadāḥ | kuśalinyo ramādīnāṃ kaiṃkaryaṃ cakrurādarāta || 39 || dvādaśa rāśayaścāpi tadā sarvapradeśataḥ | niyojitāḥ samānetuṃ vastūnyāninyurādarāt ||2.19.40 || rāśīnāṃ yatra saṃcārā yatra yatra vasanti ca | tattadvastūni cādāya samāyayustadotsukāḥ || 41 || meṣī rāśirnivasati dhānyaratnākarādiṣu | navaśādvalasaṃchannavasudhāyāṃ na sarvaśaḥ || 42|| nityaṃ carati phulleṣu sarasāṃ pulineṣu ca | ajāvikadhanādau ca sasyeṣu vividheṣu ca ||43 || sā ca naijanivāsebhyo dhānyāni rasavanti ca | ratnāni mīktikādīni hīrakāṃśca maṇīṃstathā ||44|| pādatrāṇe śirastrāṇaṃ varma caurṇaṃ samujjvalam | hastatrāṇaṃ kaṭitrāṇaṃ kambalikāśca kambalān ||45 || vasūn vamumatīgarbhāt śākapatrāṇi sarvataḥ | phullapuṣpāṇi hārām̐śca pakvāmakaṇikām̐stathā ||46 || phalakandān mukhacūrṇānānināya supuṣkalān | divyā ca meṣadevī sārpayāmāsa tu śārṅgiṇe ||47||| atha rāśirvṛṣīnāmnī carate gokulādiṣu | nivāso vartate tasyāḥ kṛṣīvaladharādiṣu ||48|| śaṃkarasya gṛhe cāpi dharmadevīsvarūpiṇī | goloke vartate cāpi sāpi divyā tadutsave ||49 || ānināya ca golokāt kāmadhenūḥ sahasraśaḥ | dhānyānyakṣatagodhūmādīni dugdhājyakāni ca ||2.19.50 || bhūrīṇi navanītāni dadhitakrāṇi sarvaśaḥ | yānavāhanaśibikā bhogyavastūni yāni ca ||51 || ānināya ca kailāsādasaṃkhyaratnakāni ca | dadau śrīharaye tatrotsavārthe vastupuṣkalam ||5.|| mithunīnāmikā rāśirgītanartanaśilpiṣu | vartate cāpi dampatyoḥ śayyāsanaparigrahe |||53 || vīṇāvādyādiṣu cāpi krīḍāyāṃ ca ratau tathā | adhvādau ca vihāro’syā vartate gṛhamedhiṣu ||54|| rāśi gurau mahāloke mahājane ca sarvathā | sāpi divyā divyavastūnyānināyopadātmikāḥ ||55||| gītikānṛtyaśilpādikalāścatuḥpraṣaṣṭikāḥ | kanyakāḥ sā samānīyotsave śrīharaye dadau |||56|| dugdhaphenanibhāḥ śayyāścāsanāni dyumanti ca | gṛhasāhāyyasāmagrīḥ sarvāścānāyya vai dadau ||57|| vīṇāvādyāni sarvāṇi rājabhogyasuvaibhavān | guruyogyān devayogyānānāyya vaibhavān dadau ||58|| martyayogyām̐stathā sarvadehiyogyām̐śca vaibhavān | nijāśramasthalebhyaścānāyya śrīharaye dadau |||59| | karkināmnī ca yā rāśiḥ kṛkalāsī hi devatā | salilasthā ca kedāravāpipulinavāsinī ||2.19.60 || viviktāvanisaṃsthā cānināya jalamauktikān | kamalāni vicitrāṇi rasāṃśca vividhām̐stathā ||6 1 || nūtnakedārasasyānāṃ supakvāḥ śimbikāstathā | ānināya dadau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya cotsave ||62| siṃhī tu parvatāraṇyadurgakandarabhūmiṣu | vasati vyādhapallīṣu gahvareṣu guhāsu ca ||63|| sā ca naijāvāsabhūmerānināya sucāmarau | kastūrīdhātusaugandhyaṃ karpūracandanāni ca ||64|| kauśeyakāni vastrāṇi gajamauktikakāni ca | aurṇakambalavastrāṇi mṛduni śītahāni ca ||65|| mṛgacarmāṇi ramyāṇi siṃhacarmāṇi vai tathā | vyāghrahastipracarmāṇi karidantām̐śca hīrakān ||66|| svargarasān kupyarasān khāneyakān rasām̐stathā | gūṭikāścauṣadhīn divyastambānakṣayakṛllatāḥ ||67|| divyagandhān divyaphalānyapi kalpadrumām̐stathā | divyapradīpapatrāṇyānināya haraye dadau ||68| | atha vai kanyakārāśiḥ sarvasaubhāgyasundarī | sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyā svarṇacampakasūjjvalā | |69|| kalpakanyāsvarūpā ca bhāvanāphaladā sadā | vrīhipradīpakakarā vasati dampatīśaye | |2.19.7 0 | | tāmbūladā ganadharasasāradānandadāyinī | naḍvaleṣu cāmareṣu puṇyeṣu kalikādiṣu ||71 || nagareṣu ca devānāṃ gṛheṣu vasati tathā | svarge satye martyaloke pātālādau harergṛhe ||72| | sarvatra vasati kanyā cānināya śubhadravān | kuṃkumākṣatasaubhāgyavibhūṣā ratnajhullarīḥ ||73|| kaṃcukān candrasannaddhān ṭopīṃ cāndrīṃ ca śāradīm | hiraṇyagarbhopaskārān pātrāṇi kaṭakām̐stathā | |74| | asaṃkhyānantapātrāṇi kānakāni mahotsave | kalaśān gargarīrhāṇḍān vaṭikāḥ sthālikāstathā ||75| | hārān vicitrān pramaṇīn sūryakāntān manoharān | candrakāntān vahnikāntān devakāntān nināya sā ||76 || cāmarān ratnadaṇḍām̐śca chatrāṇi kānakāni ca | vetrān yaṣṭīn vellaṇādīn vardhanīḥ kaṇḍanīstathā ||77| | tāmbūlāni vicitrāṇi gucchān cāmpakakaisarān | kādambakām̐śca kaundām̐śca kalpayaṣṭīṃśca kānakīḥ ||78| | miṣṭānnasthālikā dīrghā naisargikapradīpakān | gandhān rasān gandhasārān nināya haraye dadau ||79|| tulārāśiśca vai divyā tulānāmnī tu sundarī | bīthyāpaṇakrayaśālānagarādhvagṛhādiṣu ||2.19.80 | | dhanāḍhyavyāpṛtisthāne vasati carate tathā | sāpi divyā kṛṣṇakāntakṛte nināya cotsave ||81 | | annānāṃ veṣavārāṇāṃ pauṣkalyaṃ hrāsavarjitam | tulāṃ divyāṃ dadau yatra dhṛtaṃ tvakṣayameva hi ||82| | dhanāni svarṇaraupyāṇi mudrāḥ pāśān dadau tu sā | kuberabhavanānnītvā bahvīḥ smṛddhīrdadau tadā |||83 || vṛścikī yā ca vai tīvrā rāśiḥ śvabhre ca bhūstare | valmīke gomaye dīrṇe sthale bhūgarbhake tathā ||84|| pāṣāṇādau ca vasati carati drutvagādiṣu | gṛhabhittau vane kṣetre’raṇye kaccarake truṭau ||85|| divyakanyā ca sā kṛṣṇakṛte nināya śailajān | śilārasān drumarasān bhūmikandām̐śca mūlakān ||86|| raṇajanyān bhūmijanyān rasān lāvaṇasaṃjñitān | kaṭvamblamadhurām̐ścāpi viṣahām̐śca rasān dadau ||87|| dhanūrāśirdivyakanyā turaṃgarūpadhāriṇī | dhanuryuktā śaratūṇā śūrāstraśastravidvarā ||88|| gaje rathe turage ca yāne vimānake kṣitau | śakaṭe śibikāyāṃ ca tiṣṭhati carate tathā ||89|| tattatsthalāni yānāni gajavājirathādikān | vyomayānāni divyāni vyomodyānayutāni ca ||2.19.90 || haṃsaturagahastyādiśobhitāni navāni vai | vimānāni dadau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya cotsave || 91 || makarīnāmato rāśirmṛgāsyā divyakanyakā | nadīṣu vasati vārdhau mahāsarovarādiṣu || 92|| khāteṣu devaparikhādiṣu sañcarate tathā | tattatsthānaprajātāni ratnāni haraye dadau ||93 || kuṃbhikārāśirityākhyā puruṣaskandhavāsinī | riktakuṃbhātmikā kanyārūpā śauṇḍikasadmasu || 94|| dyūtagṛheṣu śālāsu vasati carate tathā | sā ca dadau koṭikuṃbhān sauvarṇān haraye tadā || 95|| mīnarāśiryugalaṃ saprema tīrthābdhisañcaram | vasati puṇyatīrtheṣu devabrāhmaṇasadmasu || 96 || mīnī kanyātmikā divyā cāgatya haraye dadau | pūjāpātrāṇi sarvāṇi pūjādravyottamāni ca || 97|| upacārān ṣoḍaśa saṃpradadau haraye mudā | evaṃ rāśirdvādaśātmā divyakanyāgaṇastadā| || 98|| satyapātālaparyantān sārān śrīharaye dadau | viśvakarmāhūta evāgato maṇḍapamadbhutam || 99|| cakāra śatabhaumaṃ ca kṣetragarbhaṃ digantagam | vyomavāṭaṃ yānavāṭaṃ samudyānasuśobhitam || 2.19.10 0|| dharmasabhā cendrasabhā sabhā cāpi bṛhaspateḥ | śukrasabhā brahmasabhā sabhā viṣṇoḥ śivasya ca || 101 || yatra vai maṇḍape tatra samāveśagatāstadā | siṃhāsanāni divyāni ketavaḥ kānakāstathā || 1 02|| kalaśāḥ svarṇanirmāṇāḥ śataikasaṃkhyayā sthitāḥ | sahasraikaśikharāḍhyo naisargikadivākaraḥ || 103 || naisargikaśaśibhrājattejaḥpuñjavirājitaḥ | vidyuddīpārbudaśobhaḥ koṭitārakarājitaḥ || 1 04|| vāpīkūpataḍāgādigṛhasādhanamaṇḍitaḥ | bhośrayapānapramṛdyādidivyadravyavirājitaḥ || 1 05|| divyamaṇḍanamālādyairdivyamāṇikyabhittikaḥ | divyamauktikamaṇyādyairhārakādyaiḥ subṛṃhitaḥ || 1 06|| naikagopuravāṭaiśca sahasradhruvaśāśvataḥ | madhyevedīmahādivyānalanaisargikājyavān || 1 07|| lakṣalakṣātilakṣāṇāṃ stambhānāṃ rājirājitaḥ | sarvadevarṣimunibhirjagatāṃ pālakaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 1 08|| stambhoparikṛtasthāno divyakīramayūrakaḥ | divyaśravaṇavīkṣādidivyabhojyagṛhādibhiḥ || 109 || divyārāmavihārādidivyabhojyagṛhādibhiḥ || divyāplavanabhāgaiśca varāṃgaṇairvirājitaḥ || 2.19.11 0|| vyomagaḥ kāmagaḥ koṭyarbudakanyābhiśobhitaḥ | divyapradarśanavyāpto divyamallaraṇāṃgaṇaḥ || 11 1|| divyagāndharvavidyaśca divyanāṭakarañjitaḥ | daivīvādyakṛtālāpasvaramiṣṭādyamaṇḍitaḥ || 1 12|| gajasiṃhādipratimaḥ sarvadevavirājitaḥ | brahmāṇḍe caiśvare loke dhāmni nāsti ca yat khalu || 1 13|| tattatra nāsti vai viśvakarmanirmitamaṇḍape | jīvasṛṣṭau ceśasṛṣṭau brahmasṛṣṭau pare sthale || 1 14|| yat kiñcid vidyate khyātaṃ tadatra maṇḍape kṛtam | viśvakarmākarocchailpyaṃ brahmākarod vidhānakam || 1 19|| vāsudevo’karod vasturūpāṇi khyātimanti ca | akṣaraṃ brahma rūpāṇāṃ vyaktatāmakarottadā || 1 16|| rādhike tvaṃ mahāmāyā nyūnatāmaharaḥ svayam | lakṣmīḥ pūrṇatvamātiṣṭhajjayā jayamakārayat || 1 17|| ityevaṃ saptamīsāyaṃ maṇḍapaḥ śobhano’bhavat | rātrirna dṛśyate tatra śāśvate dhāmni cāgate || 1 18|| nidrā kuṃkumavāpyāśca kṣetrāt krośagataṃ gatā | ānandinī mahābrāhmī śaktiḥ saurāṣṭrake sthitā || 1 19|| sūryasyodayanaṃ pūrvaṃ bimbadarśanamātrakam | rātryāgamo digantānāṃ kārṣṇyamātrābhiveditaḥ || 2.19.1 20|| vigamaśca digantānāṃ prabhādhāvalyaniścitaḥ | bālakhilyāgamenaiva sūryodayastu tarkitaḥ || 121 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kārtikakṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ bālakṛṣṇasya prabhordvitīyavarṣārambhotsave sarvalokeṣvāmantraṇapatrikāpreṣaṇaṃ rāśikṛtavastūpasthāpanaṃ mahāmaṇḍapanirmāṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonaviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 19 | |
<2.20> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca evaṃvidhe kṛte tatra maṇḍape kuṃjalakṣakaiḥ | śobhite raṃgaraṃgolīsvastikavallarīyute || 1 || dadhyaṃkuśakṣatalājāstambamaṇḍanamaṃgale | parito jhallarīmadhye nyastaślokābhibodhake || 2 || kammānikoparinyastamukhyadevābhidhānake | tattaddhvajeṣu vinyastatattatpradhānavāhane || 3 || tattadgopurapālānāmambare kaṃdhraveṣṭane | tattatpradhānadevānāṃ nāmabhiścittarañjane || 4 || saptarūpābhirūpāḍhyāmbaraveṣṭitayaṣṭike | divyasauvarṇavastraiśca veṣṭitastambhamaṇḍale || 5 || divyadevīpratimābhiḥ stambhaśiromanohare | sthale jalaṃ jale sthalaṃ cobhayoranalekṣaṇe || 6 || anale nalavadrājaccāmarairupaśobhite | vidyullatābhiḥ paritaḥ pāradarśananirmale || 7 || madhyolloceṣu vartule rāsamaṇḍalarājite | ajñātamūlato niryannavaraṃgasukāntike || 8 || vidyutpaṭeṣu nāṭyānāṃ navadarśanarañjane | vyūhāvatāradevānāṃ camatkāraiḥ sucitrite || 9 || kṛṣṇakāntārbudānāṃ ca līlālalitatāmaye | sarvasmṛddhe kāmayāne kāmage kāmagahvare || 2.20.10 || kāmopasthitasatye ca satyasaṃkalpamaṇḍape | etādṛśe’ṣṭamīprātaḥ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 11 || candanādijalairbhūmiṃ secayāmāsa śītalaiḥ | dhūpaiḥ sugandhayāmāsāmodairvividhajātikaiḥ || 12|| svastikān sarvatobhadrān cakrāṇi vartulāni ca | maṇḍalāni vividhāni kārayāmāsa raṃgakaiḥ || 13 || akṣataiḥ kusumaiścāpi kuṃkumairdadhipallavaiḥ | bhadrām̐stān śobhayāmāsa gopurām̐ścāpi toraṇaiḥ || 14|| āmrāśokādipatraiśca kadalīstambhapatrakaiḥ | saphalaiḥ kadalīstambhaiḥ śākhāprāntaiḥ phalāñcitaḥ || 15|| puṣpitaiḥ stabakaiścāpi śobhayāmāsa vāṭagān | dhvajānārohayāmāsotsavabodhakaśabditān || 16|| patākāścāpi sarvatra bandhayāmāsa maṇḍape | divyakācādiyantrāṇi vidyuddīpādibhistathā || 17|| samyak prabhāsayāmāsa maṇḍapādau samantataḥ | maṇḍapasyātiramyasya stambhe stambhe’ṣṭasiddhayaḥ || 18|| iṣṭāpūrakarūpiṇyaḥ pūrayāmāsurīhitam | dhruvayantraṃ kālayantraṃ vedhayantraṃ mahattaram || 19|| dūradarśanayantrāṇi dūraśrāvaṇakāni ca | pratibimbaprayantrāṇi pratisthalaṃ pratigṛham ||2.20.20|| pratistambhaṃ ca naddhāni vidyante divyamaṇḍape | sudīrghaurṇāstaraṇāni śādvalādinibhāni vai ||21 || bṛsyaḥ kaṭāni cāsyāni siṃhāsanāni vedikāḥ | gajāsanāni haṃsāsyā gāruḍāsyāni catvarāḥ ||22|| suvarṇavālukādīni maṇinaddhāsanāni ca | dolā bahuvidhāścāpi mañcā dīrghāḥ samantataḥ || 23|| vidyante bahumūlyāni tathā sopānatūlikāḥ | svarṇaratnamaṇismṛddhāḥ śobhante ca samantataḥ || 24|| mṛnmayāstatra kedārāstūlasīdrumaśobhitāḥ | anagaśārṅgasañjātā jātyādipuṣpajātayaḥ ||25|| campakādyāḥ śubhāḥ kharvā drumāstiṣṭhanti maṇḍape | suvarṇavālukābhūmiḥ kāśate vai samantataḥ ||26 || mṛdvī mṛdukumārīṇāṃ pattalārhātikomalā | yajñavāṭāḥ khaṇḍarathyāḥ sṛtayaśca pradakṣiṇam ||27|| mārgāḥ pallavavallyādyaiḥ śobhante yatra maṇḍape | darśakānāmāsanāni paryaṅkamañcavanti ca ||28|| paritaścordhvamūrdhvaṃ ca klṛptāni vyomagāni vai | bhṛtyacāraṇabhāṭṭānāṃ bhaṭamāgadhabandinām ||29|| vipravidvadviduṣīṇāṃ kavivācālagāyinām | śobhante cāsanānyuccasthāni vidyullatā yathā ||2.20.3 0 || manuṣyāṇāṃ tataścāntarbhāgeṣvāsanapaṃktayaḥ | parito bahuvistārāḥ śobhante candrikā yathā ||3 1 || tato’ntaḥsthā yakṣarakṣobhūtapretapiśācakāḥ | kūṣmāṇḍā vaināyakāśca vetālāḥ kinnarāstathā ||32|| kiṃpuruṣāśca vidyādhrā yoginīnāṃ gaṇāstathā | tato’ntaḥsthā divyadehā mukuṭakaṭakojjvalāḥ ||33 || devā devyo devapālā deveśvarāḥ surānugāḥ | sthale sthale catuṣkaśca paṭṭikā nihitāstathā ||34|| catuṣpādyaścāṣṭapādyastathā ṣoḍaśapādukāḥ | tatra tiṣṭhanti devānāṃ mūrdhanyā devabhūbhṛtaḥ ||35|| atha siṃhāsanānyāsan saphaṇāchatrakāni ca | sauvarṇānyatidivyāni hyadhiṣṭhitāni pitṛbhiḥ ||36|| athāntaḥ ṛṣayaścāsan jāpakā brahmacintakāḥ | vedapāṭhakarā lakṣmīsaṃhitāpāṭhakāstathā || 37 || rudrasya brahmaṇaścāpi saṃhitayoḥ prapāṭhakāḥ | agastyasya saṃhitāyāḥ pāṭhakāścāpi kecana ||38|| aurṇāsaneṣu paṭṭikānihiteṣu sthitāstadā | tato’ntarmaṇḍapasyādhaḥpīṭhikāyāṃ maharṣayaḥ ||39|| satyalokanivāsā ye tathā vairājavāsinaḥ | brahmacaryaparāścāsan brahmajāpaparāyaṇāḥ ||2.20.40|| yajñakarmaparāścāsan ṛtvijo brahmavittamāḥ | brahmā hotā tathodgātādhvaryuśceti pratikramāḥ ||41 || sāmagā gītigāścānye mantraprayogiṇastathā | āsan svakarmakuśalā bhārgavādyāḥ saśaktikāḥ ||42|| yajñapātrāṇi caravaḥ sruksruvādyāstathā dravāḥ | yajñiyāni ca kāṣṭhāni vrīhyādīnyabhavat sphiram ||43|| ājyaṃ havyaṃ samagraṃ ca vividhaṃ vartate tadā | yajñakuṇḍo viśālaśca vaiṣṇavo yajñadevatā ||44|| vahniśca vaiṣṇavo yatrāhavanīyo virājate | svastivācanapūrvaṃ ca yajñakarma pravartate ||45|| mātā śrīkambharālakṣmīḥ pitā gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ | yajamānasthale tatra rājete lomaśāgrataḥ ||46|| lomaśo vidhivattatra nārāyaṇasya pūjanam | kārayāmāsa ca tato havanaṃ sampravartate ||47|| dakṣiṇe kuṇḍatastatrākṣaramuktāḥ sthitāḥ śubhāḥ | pārśve golokamuktāśca pārśve vaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ ||48|| tato’nye vaikuṇṭhavāsāḥ kṣīrodaśvetavāsinaḥ | badrīsthāścāpi kailāsasthāścānyadhāmagāstathā ||49|| tiṣṭhanti dakṣiṇe bhāge pūrṇabrahmaparāyaṇāḥ | vedikāyāṃ parabrahma svayaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||2.20.50|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | sākṣādvirājate bālaḥ svāmī kiśorarūpadhṛk||51 || yadyapyāste lokarītyā dvitīyavarṣasañcaraḥ | tathāpi dhāmarūpāḍhyo rājate parameśvaraḥ ||52|| vedyāṃ siṃhāsane ramye vimāne bhagavān svayam | tatpārśve rādhike cāhamāsaṃ kṛṣṇastava priyaḥ ||53|| matpārśve śrīpatiścāste tatpārśve nṛnarāyaṇaḥ | tatpārśve śvetavāsī ca kṣīravāsī tatastathā ||54|| bhūmādyā vāsudevādyāḥ kapilādyāstataḥ param | āsate vedikāsiṃhāsaneṣu ca vimānake ||55|| tatpatnyastatkumāryaśca tanmuktā vetradhāriṇaḥ | chatradhrāḥ pārśvavāsāśca tiṣṭhanti tatsamantataḥ ||56|| avādyanta ca tūryāṇi vedikāyāśca pṛṣṭhataḥ | koṭidevyo virājante samanyūnāsaneṣu ca ||57|| gāyanti gītikā ramyā kṛṣṇamahotsavapriyāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇalīlāgarbhā divyamanoharāḥ ||58|| homo vai jāyate tatra tṛpyanti ceśvarādayaḥ | devāśca pitaraḥ sarve’vatārā muktakoṭayaḥ |||59|| śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇenārpitaṃ havyaṃ navaṃ navam | sākṣād gṛhṇanti te sarve vahnivyājena vai punaḥ ||2.20.60|| pāyasāni vicitrāṇi phalapuṣpamadhūnyapi | hūyante vrīhayaścāpi nārikelānyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ ||6 1|| parihāre kṛte cātha pūrṇāhutau tathotthitaḥ | samājo maṇḍape tatra juhoti divyasadrasān ||62 || rudro viṣṇustathā brahmā grahā gaṇapatistathā | mātaraḥ kalaśaścāpi dikpālā devateśvarāḥ ||63|| ye ye saṃsthāpitāstatra tattadāyatanātmakāḥ | pūjitā mūrtimantaste havane samavāyinaḥ ||64|| sākṣātkṛtvā havanaṃ ca gṛhṇantyagnimukhaistadā | tṛptirjātā yajñakāryaṃ samāptaṃ dakṣiṇāyutam ||65|| anantadakṣiṇādānaistṛptāste brāhmadevatāḥ | athānādibālakṛṣṇapūjanaṃ kartumudyatāḥ ||66|| avatārāstathā muktā brahmarṣayo maharṣayaḥ | tattallokanivāsāśca sopadāḥ sampratasthire ||67|| vāditrāṇi ca tūryāṇi tārapāvanakāni ca | mṛdaṃgapaṭahādyāścāvādyanta jalayantrikāḥ ||68|| sutantryo murajāḥ śaṃkhā ghaṇṭā jhallarikāstathā | vīṇā bheryaśca śṛṃgāṇi tvavādyanta ca tumbirāḥ ||69|| gālavādyāḥ svaravādyāḥ phudvādyāḥ sparśavādanāḥ | avādyanta tadā miṣṭānyaśrutāni purā yathā ||2.20.70|| svarā vaidikamantrāṇāṃ pravartante dvijaistadā | āśiṣāṃ ca pravāhāśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’vahan ||71 || abhyukṣito hariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sāmudratīrthavāribhiḥ | brahmahradajalairgaṃgāvirajāyamunājalaiḥ ||72|| sarasvatīsvarṇarekhāgaṇḍakīsalilaistathā | kiśoro rājate kṛṣṇastadā tejobhirudyataḥ |||73 || mastake rājate yasya mukuṭaḥ koṭisūryavat | koṭicandraiḥ praṇaddhaśca kalgidharmavirājitaḥ ||74|| divyamāyūrapicchānāṃ pāridheyapramaṇḍitaḥ | kuṇḍale śravaṇākāre sauvarṇe naddharatnake ||75|| virājete karṇayośca bālakṛṣṇasya śobhane | tailena sādhitakeśajaṭāgranthiyutaṃ śiraḥ ||76 || lalāṭaṃ cordhvapuṇḍreṇa kaisareṇa virājitam | candanena tathā candraḥ kuṃkumena śubhāvahaḥ ||77|| virājate tathā bhāsvatkajjalaṃ netragolayoḥ | candanenākṣatenāpi carcanaṃ lambadaṇḍitam ||78|| surekhaṃ madhyabindvībhiḥ śobhate’sya lalāṭake | dakṣagaṇḍe sūkṣmabinduḥ pāṇḍuro’tidhruvāyate ||79|| cibuke tilabinduśca kaṇṭhe’pi tilabindukaḥ | rājate tejasā yuktaḥ kapolau vartulau śubhau ||2.20.80|| rājīvabhāvamāpanne premapūritanetrake | raktapravālarekhābhiḥ śobhete sumanohare ||8 1 || ākarṇāntāyatakoṇe, karṇau dūraśravau samau | kambukaṇṭhakṛkāṭaśca raktāvoṣṭhau pramohakau ||82|| dhanuḥkammānikākārāvanudbhūtaruhānvitau | rājete ratibījau tau hṛdākarṣaṇakau hareḥ ||83|| puṣṭaskandhau pūrabāhū baliprakoṣṭharājitau | viśālatalasampannau trisandhiśākhaśobhitau ||84|| akṛtālaktakaraktau sūkṣmacandrāgrarājito | cakramīnadhanuḥśūlaiḥ svastikavajrarājitau ||85|| anāmikārūḍhadhārāyuṣyarekhāmanoharau | ādarśavat sadā svacchau pratibimbābhidhāyakau ||86|| uparyupari romṇāṃ vai sūkṣmagrāmāṃgulipriyau | bhujau pārśvābhimukhataḥ pāṇḍurau śāradopamau ||87|| pārśvau kāmanivāsau ca vakṣaḥ śrīvāsi śobhanam | madhye romṇāṃ dakṣiṇāvartena kāntena rājitam ||88|| svarṇarekhāparicañcanmaṇiśreṣṭhavirājitam | asūtrahāratatibhyāṃ kāmalībhyāṃ prakāśate ||89|| nīladvitārakaśobhaṃ rājate hi stanadvayam | suvarṇatanturomālistabakena yutaṃ tathā ||2.20.90|| akāpaṭyaguṇāvedi romodyānaṃ virājate | ubhayornalayormadhye sandhau dīrghā ca kānakī ||9 1 || romāvalī jaghanagā lakṣmīcitrapraveśitā | rājate yasya nābhestu nimrageya kamaṇḍaloḥ ||92|| liṅgaṃ sūjjvalaṃ vāme tilaśobhāvirājitam | sakthinī candrakadalīgarbhaśobhau ca romabhiḥ ||93|| prāntasvarṇasvarūpaiśca rājete’kṣarayāyinau | cārucampakavarṇābhau puṣṭau vīryabharau śubhau ||94|| pārṣṇito piṇḍikāṃ vyāpya sakthnoḥ pṛṣṭhe tathordhvage | vilakṣaṇe romarekhe jaghanaśrāntimāgate || 99|| vartete golokavaikuṇṭhayoḥ sṛtī manohare | vāmasakthno mūlabhāgādaṃguladvayanimnagam ||96|| kīlakakṣatacihnaṃ ca vartate’ṅgulato’dhikam | vāmajānūparibhāge sakthni pāṇḍuravarṇakam || 97|| cihnaṃ śrīkamalāvāsaṃ kamalaṃ cāṣṭapatrakam | vartate bahuśobhāḍhyaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kamalāśrayam ||98|| akṣayavīryakośau dvau maṇī bāhyau vṛṣāśrayau | anyau cāntarnigūḍhau dvau liṅgapārśvasthitāvapi || 99|| triguṇāvalisaṃrājannābhikūpaḥ praśobhate | nitambau candradhavalau komalau navanītavat || 2.20.1 00|| kariḥ sauvarṇaraśanānibhacarmavirājitā | pṛṣṭhaṃ devālayaṃ cāgraṃ kāmālayaṃ prakāśate || 101 || jaṃghe vartulagole ca kānakī romaśobhite | dakṣāyāṃ nalikāpārśve jaṃghāyāṃ kṛṣṇabindukaḥ || 1 02|| dakṣabhuje tathā binduḥ rājate ghūṭikātrayam | kammānikākṛtitale pādayoḥ kamalaspṛśe || 1 03|| ūrdhvarekhānvite saudhaśikharādripracihnite | padmakalaśavajrādiyavādibhiralaṃkṛte || 1 04|| ṣoḍaśadvātriṃśadaṣṭacihnarekhābhirājite | nakhacandrāśritamṛdvaṃgulikāśobhite śubhe || 1 05|| puṇḍarīkanibhe saumye koṭidevaprapūjite | koṭikanyākṛtasparśe koṭyaiśvaryanivāsite || 1 06|| nupūrahārapiśaṃgadhṛtadhautrābhirañjite | vijayete svarṇapīṭhe sthāpite caraṇe hareḥ || 1 07|| kaṭiḥ sauvarṇaraśanālakṣitā rājate śubhā | hārāṃgulīyormikādibhūṣābhūṣitavigrahaḥ || 1 08|| madhyāṃgulyoḥ kambucihne’ṣṭāsu cakrāṇi santi ca | vāmahastatale cordhvagatā rekhā mahatyapi || 1 09|| madhyāṃgulimūlataścāprakoṣṭhaṃ lambate tu sā | pauṣpagucchasukandukamālāmālitamūrtikaḥ || 2.20.11 0|| sauvarṇamaṇiratnādimauktikamālikādibhiḥ | tathā śṛṃgārabhūṣābhirvirājate’tisundaraḥ || 11 1|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo naijamahotsave | virājitaḥ sabhāmadhye maṇḍape’ntargajāsane || 11 2|| śrīḥ ramā kamalā lakṣmīḥ padmā bhinnasvarūpiṇī | tadā kānte harau sarvā vidyotante samanvitāḥ || 1 13|| evaṃvidho’yaṃ bhagavān śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | rādhike vārṣike janmadine samrājate vibhuḥ || 1 14|| śobhāḍhye sarvaśobhāḍye lokaśobhābhivardhite | maṇḍape caiśvare ramye madhye saṃrājate hariḥ || 1 15|| brahmajalaiḥ sugandhaiśca prokṣitaḥ sa maharṣibhiḥ | sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ kṛṣṇobālaścaikala eva hi || 1 16|| cakṣuṣāṃ viṣayaścāsīnmanasāṃ ca hṛdāmapi | antarbahiḥ sa evāsīd yathā brahmapade’tige || 1 17|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mahāmaṇḍapasya śobhāvarṇanaṃ samājāsanāni śrībālakṛṣṇasya prabhormūrtiśṛṃgārādi cetinirūpaṇanāmāviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 20 ||
<2.21> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike dhāmni pare yathā virājate | paramātmāvatārī sa tathārūpo’bhavaddhariḥ || 1 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇārbudādhikaḥ | rūpānurūparūpāḍhyaḥ sarvoparisvarūpavān || 2 || sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ cakṣurviṣayaścaika eva saḥ | mano’haṃbuddhiviṣayaścātmaviṣaya ekalaḥ || 3 || divyarūpadharo nyūnaṣoḍaśābdo yuvā yathā | bhrājamāno’titejasvī bhrājadvahnisamāmbaraḥ || 4 || kacchanī svarṇavarṇāsya mañjulaṃ kaṭikañcukam | svarṇabuṭṭābharatāḍhyaṃ tathā dhautraṃ ca kaisaram || 5 || svarṇatārāvalivyāptaṃ kāṭeyaṃ paṭamuttamam | sthitaṃ kaṭyāṃ tathā skandhe cottarīyaṃ sutaijasam || 6 || mukuṭo mastake tvasya sthitaḥ śrīparamātmanaḥ | sarvasaugandhyasaṃvyāpto divyāmodasamanvitaḥ || 7 || maṇḍape nijayogye sa niṣasādocchraye śubhe | mahāvedīsthitāstatra candanānāṃ supaṭṭikāḥ || 8 || catasro dṛḍhapādāḍhyāḥ svarṇakuṃbhīpadāḥ śubhāḥ | sahasramallasantolyā hyekaikā paṭṭikā hi sā || 9 || gāruḍī nārasiṃhī ca śārabhī kācchapī tathā | pādeṣu śaktayastāsāṃ rājante balamaṇḍitāḥ || 2.21.1 0|| catuṣpaṭṭyaścaturhastyadhiṣṭhitāḥ ṣaṣṭihāyanāḥ | kariṇastatra śobhante cotthitāścāmbaraspṛśaḥ || 11 || sarvabhūṣāmbaradharā dyotante svarṇavarṇijaḥ | śvetodarāḥ śvetaśuṇḍhāḥ śvetadantāḥ payonibhāḥ || 1 2|| hastipṛṣṭhe sthitāḥ siṃhāḥ kānakā bhūṣitāḥ śubhāḥ | catvāraḥ kesariṇaste saśuṇḍhā gaganaspṛśaḥ || 13 || catuḥkesariṇāṃ pṛṣṭhadeśeṣu kacchapo mahān | rājate ca haridvarṇāṃ lambavartulamaṇḍalaḥ || 14|| tatpṛṣṭhe māṇikī śaktiraśvinī divyavigrahā | sarvopaskaraśobhāḍhyā niṣaṇṇā samapṛṣṭhikā || 15|| tasyāḥ pṛṣṭhe svarṇavarṇaṃ mṛdu cāstaraṇaṃ śubham | tulikā rājata tatra kauśeyī citravarṇinī || 16 || pārśvapṛṣṭhasthitadivyakaśipūttamasundarī | makhamallāstaraṇaiḥ śobhitā sāptapadī śubhā || 17|| upari vartate chatraṃ śeṣabhogiphaṇātmakam | ṭivyahīrakacakṣurbhirdivyatejaḥpradaṃ śubham || 18|| tulikāyāṃ haristatra pādau pīṭhe nidhāya ca | niṣasāda mahārājo rājarājādhirājakaḥ || 1 9|| śrīkṛṣṇo’haṃ tathā nārāyaṇaḥ pārśve sthitāvubhau | cāmarābhyāṃ ca sahitau pādāgre cākṣaraḥ sthitaḥ || 2.21.20 || lomaśaḥ pādapārśve ca pūjāsthālīkaraḥ sthitaḥ | mātā pitā niṣaṇṇau ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāntikam || 21 || evaṃ sthite tadā vyomni vimānānāṃ tu koṭayaḥ | draṣṭuṃ devabhṛtā divyā vartante yugalāśritāḥ || 22|| pūjārthaṃ bhūmitalataścāroḍhuṃ śobhanocchritā | niḥśreṇikā kṛtā sopānānāṃ paramparāyutā |||23 || bhūmibhāge tu paṭṭīnāṃ kṛtaṃ sopānasaptakam | tato hastilambaśuṇḍhādvayaṃ paṭṭīspṛśaṃ ca yat || 24|| sopānādhāratāprāptaṃ niḥśreṇīdaṇḍavat sthitam | śuṇḍhayoḥ kuṃbhaparyantaṃ klṛptānyāruṇakāni ca |||25||| sopānāni śṛṃkhalābhirbaddhāni sudṛḍhāni ca | kuṃbhasthalayostatraiva klṛptā viśrāmaśālikā ||26 || tata ūrdhvaṃ kesariṇoḥ śuṇḍhayordaṇḍabhāntayoḥ | sopānāni suramyāṇi klṛptāni cāparāṇyapi ||27|| kesarimastakaṃ yāvat sā niḥśreṇī kṛtā tataḥ | catuṣkī siṃhaśirasordhṛtā kacchapalagnikā ||28|| kacchapasya galapārśve sthitaṃ haṃsadvayaṃ śubham | tayorantarbhujayośca klṛptā niḥśreṇikā parā ||29|| māṇikīmukhasaṃsparśā pārśvayorgaruḍadvayam | pakṣābhyāṃ vivṛtābhyāṃ ca haṃsapṛṣṭhe tu picchikāḥ ||2.21.3 0|| spṛṣṭāḥ kramād yathā sopānāni pakṣātmakāni vai | māṇikīpārśvayorlagnānyeva copari picchake ||3 1 || sthitvā pūjā hareryatra nirvartyate surādibhiḥ | evaṃ divye cāyate cocchrite ramyāsane prabhuḥ ||32|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇānārāyaṇaḥ sarvaiḥ prapūjyate | na śrutaṃ nāpi sandṛṣṭaṃ cāsanaṃ śrīprabhoḥ purā |||33|| tatra taṃ rājamānaṃ śrīrājādhirājaśobhayā | pūjayituṃ kambharāśrīḥ prathamaṃ samupasthitā ||34|| dhṛtvā haste svarṇapātraṃ kuṃkumākṣatacandanaiḥ | kastūrikābiradravyaistulasīmañjarīyutaiḥ || 35|| gulālāṃkuralājābhiḥ puṣpamālāvibhūṣaṇaiḥ | phalairjalaiḥ śarkarādyairgandhasāraiḥ prapūritam || 36|| lomaśaḥ prāha vai cāśīrvacanāni tadā kṣaṇe | oṃ svasti bālakṛṣṇasya muktāḥ svasti carantu ca ||37|| karotu cākṣaraṃ brahma svasti dīrghāyureva ca | oṃ svasti taṃ vitanvantu śrīśrīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇāḥ ||38|| vāsudevādayaḥ svasti svasti kurvantu ceśvarā | svasti kurvantvavatārā deveśāḥ śaṃkarādayaḥ ||39||. ṛṣayaḥ pitaraḥ siddhāḥ sādhavaḥ sāṃkhyayogikāḥ | svasti kurvantu bālasya harerdevāśca mānavāḥ ||2.21.40|| sarvatīrthāni cādityā rudrāḥ svasti bhavantu ca | vasavo nidhayo vaidyo svasti kurvantu vai hareḥ ||41 || satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ kumāryaśca pativratāśca yoṣitaḥ | devatā vanavāsinyaḥ svasti kurvantu vai hareḥ || 42 vṛkṣā vallyaścāraṇāśca kinnarādyāśca sūtakāḥ | bhṛtyā dāsā nadā nadyaḥ svasti kurvantu vai hareḥ ||43|| yakṣāḥ ṛkṣāśca gandharvā māgadhāḥ kimpumaṃśakāḥ | vidyādharāstathā sādhyāḥ svasti kurvantu vai hareḥ ||44|| parvatāḥ khanayo yūpāḥ khātā raṇā vanāni ca | pātālāḥ sarpadaityāśca dānavā āsurāstathā ||45|| rākṣasā bhūtakūṣmāṇḍāḥ pretāḥ piśācakāstathā | mātaraḥ kṛtyakāścāpi jaleśayāḥ sthaleśayāḥ ||46 || vaneśayā viśayāśca svasti kurvantu vai hareḥ | caityā mantrā divyadehāḥ śastrāstrādyā vibhūtayaḥ ||47|| bālāśca bālikāvargā vṛddhā viprā jarāyujāḥ | aṇḍajāḥ svedajāścāṃkurajāḥ svastidharāśca ye ||48|| vināyakā gaṇeśādyā hanumān garuḍastathā | pārṣadā nandamukhyāśca svasti bhavantu vai hareḥ ||49|| rādhā ramā ca lalitā padmā jayā sarasvatī | māṇikī śrīḥ kamalā ca pārvatī ca prabhā ratiḥ || 2.21.50 || śāradā virajā gaṃgā lakṣmīḥ satī ca narmadā | sāvitrī maṃjulā haṃsāmṛtā durgā ca maṃgalā ||51 || saguṇā dvādaśa svasti śataṃ kurvantu supriyāḥ | anyāḥ ṣoḍaśasāhasrāḥ koṭyarbudābjaśaktayaḥ ||52|| sūryacandragrahādyāśca svasti bhavantu vai hareḥ | tattvāni bhūtajā bhāvā māyā māyāpare sthitāḥ ||53|| yogino brahmacaryasthā vairājā guṇamūrtayaḥ | ābhūṣaṇāni divyāni svasti bhavantu vai hareḥ ||54|| śṛṃgārā vividhākārāḥ svarāśca gītayastathā | divyavādyāni vai svasti kurvantu śrīhareḥ sadā ||55|| saṃkarṣaṇo’niruddhaśca pradyumno dharmarājakaḥ | dharmadevo bhaktiyuktaḥ svasti kurvantu te hareḥ ||56|| janakaḥ kambharāsvāmī svasti karotu vai hareḥ | antarātmā paramātmā svasti svasya karotu saḥ ||57|| muktā campā jayā haimī ramā śāntā vrajā dayā | bhānurdīpāvalī corjā svasti kurvantu vai hareḥ ||58|| oṃ suśāntiḥ sadā cāstu dīrghāyuścāntavarjitam | ārogyaṃ nityasaukhyaṃ ca śāśvataṃ cāstu vai hareḥ ||59|| ityevaṃ lomaśaḥ svastivāgbhiḥ prokṣya jalādinā | yavāṃkuraiśca kusumaistilakaṃ candrakaṃ śubham ||2.21.60|| mātrā saṃkārayāmāsa pūjana sāṃgakarmabhiḥ | miṣṭaṃ mukhe dadau mātā duḥkhahā cāṃjaliṃ muhuḥ | śirasyāvātārayaccāśīrvaco jananī dadau ||6 1 || śāśvatāyuryutastvaṃ vai bhava sarveśvaraḥ prabhuḥ | ityuktvā divyapuṣpāṇāṃ kalpamālāṃ gale dadau ||62|| vikīrya mastake tasyākṣatān nīrājanaṃ vyadhāt | puṣpāṃjaliṃ dadau mātā natvā svāsanamāgatā ||63 || pitā pūjāṃ cakāraivaṃ svastimān bhava putraka | santānatantusandhātā śāśvatāyuryuto bhava ||64|| atha śrīlomaśo deveśvaraṃ samarcayanmudā | sarvopacārakairmantrairāśīrvādṃ dadau śubham ||65|| buddhyā guṇairvicāraiścātmanā bhaktyā ca vidyayā | dharmairyogaiśvaryavaryaiḥ śāśvatābhyudayo bhava ||66|| āyuṣācaraṇairdivyaistejasā ca balena ca | kāruṇyena virāgeṇa śāśvatābhyudayo bhava ||67|| mātāpitroḥ sevayā śrīguroḥ śuśrūṣayā tathā | śaraṇāgatarakṣākṛt śāśvatābhyudayo bhava ||68|| brahmamārgaparo nityaṃ mānaseṣṭaprapūrakaḥ | samadṛṣṭirmahāśreṣṭhī dānadharmaparāyaṇaḥ | sarvasantoṣadātā ca śāśvatābhyudayo bhava ||6 9|| ityāśīrbhirlomaśena vardhito bālanandanaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo lājāvikīritaḥ ||2.21.70|| athānyebhyastataḥ pūjāvasaraḥ sampradāpitaḥ | paradhāmagatāḥ patnyaḥ pūjārthaṃ śrīharipriyāḥ ||71 || divyasādhanasampadbhirgandhacandanavāribhiḥ | ratnahārasumālābhiḥ puṣpaiḥ saṃhṛdayaistathā ||72|| pūjāṃ cakrustata ārārtrikaṃ cakruśca duḥkhahām | añjaliṃ śiraso nītvā caraṇodakamityapi ||73 || pītvopadāḥ samarpyaiva dhṛtvā prasādakuṃkumam | gāle spṛṣṭvā muhuḥ premṇā nirīkṣya prāṇavallabham ||74|| yayurnaijavimānāni tatastatrākṣarādayaḥ | akṣarasthāstathā muktā muktānyo’pyarcayan patim ||75|| śrīkṛṣṇo rādhikāyuktaḥ śrīyuktaśca narāyaṇaḥ | golokavāsinaḥ sarve tathā vaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ ||76|| caturvaikuṇṭhavāsāścāmṛtāvyākṛtavāsinaḥ | anyadhāmanivāsāśca muktā vyūhāstathā pare ||77|| avatārā īśvarāśca sadāśivaprabhūttamāḥ | mahāviṣṇusamakakṣā māyāpradhānapūruṣāḥ ||78|| vairājā brahmadeveśā munayaḥ ṛṣayastathā | pitaraḥ surakoṭyaśca bhuvarlokanivāsinaḥ ||79|| bṛhaspatipurogāśca śukrācāryapurogamāḥ | nadā nadyo mānavāśca parvatā drulatādayaḥ ||2.21.80|| stambāstīrthāni caityāśca mānavāḥ sūtabandinaḥ | tṛṇāni raṇavāsāśca paśavaḥ pakṣiṇastathā ||8 1 || nāgā gandharvavaryāśca saurāṣṭrā bhūnivāsinaḥ | sāmudrā vyomayānāśca koṭyarbudāśca kanyakāḥ ||82|| lokapālāstathā sarve diśāmagresareśvarāḥ | rājāno divyarājāśca brahmakṣatrā divaukasām |||83 || sarve pupūjuratyarthaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ pumuttamam | tilakaṃ candrakaṃ cakrurdaduścopāyanāni ca ||84|| bhava śāśvatajīvaścetyāśīrvādān dadurmuhuḥ | sarvabrahmāṇḍadevyaśca militvā koṭivartikam ||85|| ārārtrikaṃ hareścakruḥ śataikavārabhrāmitam | puṣpāñjaliṃ daduścātha pādavāri papustataḥ ||86|| duḥkhahāṃ cāñjaliṃ prāpya yayurnaijavimānakam | evaṃ vai pūjane cāśīrvacane vinivartite ||87|| lomaśaḥ sarvasatkāraṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ vidadhe tataḥ | svāgataṃ śrīharikṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ karoti vaḥ śubham ||88|| bhavatāṃ śrīmatāṃ sarvapūjyānāṃ cāśiṣāpyaham | śāśvatābhyudayaścāsmīpyevaṃ cārthayate hariḥ ||89|| kṛtakṛtyo’smi sañjāto bālakṛṣṇo bhavatsutaḥ | punaścāpi nibhālyo’haṃ pratyabdaṃ ca prativratam ||2.21.90|| pratyutsavaṃ prakarṣeṇa yojanīyaḥ śubhāśiṣā | eṣo’haṃ vālaputro vai namaskaromi sādaram || 9 1|| kṣatiḥ tvāgatakarmādau kṣantavyā mama vai pituḥ | lomaśasya maharṣeśca māturme’pi tatheśvarāḥ || 92|| ityuktvā lomaśaḥ prāha bhojanasya kṣaṇaḥ śubhaḥ | vartate bhojanaṃ yuṣmannivāseṣvāgamiṣyati || 93|| sadasaḥ parihāraśca jāyate vijayo’stu vaḥ | ityukte protthitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samājo’pi tadotthitaḥ || 94|| yayurnaijānnivāsām̐ste bhojanaṃ tattadarhakam | naikarūpaṃ tathā pānaṃ kanyāḥ parārdhasaṃkhyakāḥ || 95|| naikarūpadharā dāsyo bhūtvā ninyustadālayān | tarpayitvā samājām̐śca viśrāntiśayanāni ca ||96|| daduḥ sevāṃ tathā cakrurmadhyāhnottaramuttamām | vidāyaṃ prāpya ca yayurnaijadhāmāni sotsukāḥ || 97|| pitā dadau tadā viśvakarmaṇe pāritoṣikam | kalpahāraṃ kalpasūtraṃ kalpavallīṃ trayaṃ tvidam || 98|| anyebhyaḥ karmacārebhyo dadāvupāyanāni ca | lomaśāya dadau kalpakanyāṃ śāśvatasūtrajām || 99|| hareḥ prasādaṃ sarvebhyo dadau yāsyadbhya uttamam | maṇḍapasyopasaṃhāraṃ kārayāmāsa vai tataḥ || 2.21.100 || vastūni yāni sarvāṇi tvavaśiṣṭāni tatra tu | tāni dattānyanāthebhyo bhikṣukebhyaḥ samantataḥ || 101 || nṛtyantībhyaścāpsarobhyo dadau śṛṃgārakottamam | hārān bhūṣāḥ kalpavṛkṣādīnyamūlyāni yāni ca || 1 02|| śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaśca saṃhṛtya sāyamutsavam | rātrau śāntiṃ parāṃ lebhe bhagavān bālarūpadhṛk ||1 03|| āste dolāsamārūḍho lokarītyanusārataḥ | lomaśaḥ kanyakāścāpi lomaśasyāśramaṃ yayuḥ || 1 04|| ityevaṃ rādhike’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai | kṛto mahotsavo divyo dvitīyavatsarādyake || 1 05|| divase sarvasaubhāgyavardhano mokṣadastathā | smartṝṇāṃ pāṭhakānāṃ ca śrotṝṇāṃ cāsya bhāvataḥ || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrībālakṛṣṇasya prabhordvitīyavarṣārambhe mahotsave maṇḍape mahadāsanavarṇanaṃ sarvakṛtapūjāśīrvādāścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikaviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 21 ||
<2.22> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike tvekadā pūrve mahān vai tapasāṃ nidhiḥ | ṛṣivaryaścyavanākhyo bhārgavendro mahātapāḥ || 1 || kurvan tīrthāni pātālaṃ yayau yadṛcchayā svayam | tato rasātalaṃ prāpa tatra dadarśa śobhanam || 2 || mahat puraṃ dānavānāṃ praviveśa sa tatpuram | cacāra nāgakanyābhiḥ pūjyamānaḥ samantataḥ || 3 || tamenaṃ cyavanaṃ vīkṣya prahlādākhyo rasādhipaḥ | bhṛguputrasya sampūjāṃ cakre tvagryāṃ yathārhataḥ || 4 || parasparaṃ sukuśalaṃ papracchaturnirāmayam | upaviṣṭaṃ muniṃ natvā prahlādaḥ prāha bhārgavam || 5 || adya te darśanādasmi samprāptaḥ kṛtakṛtyatām | sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ pāpaharaṃ puṇyapradaṃ śubham || 6 || sādhavastvādṛśā lokām̐stārayanti ca mādṛśān | kṛpālavaḥ paryaṭanti pāpināṃ tāraṇāya te || 7 || maduddhāraparaḥ sādho tvamatra yadupāgataḥ | pāvito’smi ṛṣe cāhaṃ daityadānavamadhyagaḥ || 8 || vasātra cara dharmaṃ ca kratuṃ cāpi japādikam | tavaivedaṃ mama rājyaṃ sevayiṣyāmi dāsavat || 9 || ṛṣiḥ prāha tava bhakta śobhate vaiṣṇavo yataḥ | tvayi śāsati bhaktendre devabrāhmaṇapūjake || 2.22.10 || makhān bhūmau nṛpatayo yajante vidhivat sadā | brāhmaṇādyāstapo dharmaṃ tīrthaṃ yātrāṃ ca kurvate || 11 || devāḥ santi ca niścintāḥ santi dharmāḥ prajāsu ca | tvayi rājye sthite daitya dharmasthe tiṣṭhate vṛṣaḥ ||12|| rasātale’thavā bhūmau svarge vā samatā mama | yatra bhaktastatra sarvaṃ svargaṃ me sammataṃ nṛpa || 13 || tavecchāpūraṇārthaṃ vai sthāsyāmyatrottarāyaṇam | tato yāsyāmi vai darśanārthaṃ bālaprabhordhruvam ||14|| prahrādastu tadā prāha yadyapyetanmayā śrutam | daityamukhāddharistatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 15|| pṛthvyāṃ saṃrājate bālastathāpi vada me’dhikam | kaḥ kathaṃ kīdṛśaścāste pāvanaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 16|| draṣṭumicchāmyahaṃ tvenamanādipuruṣottamam | camatkārān vada tasya tīrthānyanyāni me vada ||17|| śreṣṭhāni kāni tīrthāni pṛthivyāṃ kāni cāmbare | rasātale ca kāni syuretad vada tato’pyaham || 18|| tīrthayātrāṃ gamiṣyāmi kartuṃ kartuṃ ca darśanam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ ||19|| cyavano hi tadā prāha prahlādaṃ bhaktapuṃgavam | saurāṣṭre paramaṃ tīrthaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ||2.22.20 || pṛthivyāṃ naimiṣāraṇyaṃ cāntarīkṣe tu puṣkaram | rasātale cakratīrthaṃ pātāle hāṭakeśvaram |||21 || parvate badarītīrthaṃ cāraṇye nārasiṃhakam | jale kṣīrodaśāyi svarge ca merau harergṛham ||22|| ityevaṃ santi tīrthāni pāvanāni tu pāpinām | śratvaivaṃ bhārgavavākyaṃ daityarājastu rādhike ||23|| tīrthāni gantukāmo’bhūd dānavānidamabravīt | uttiṣṭhadhvaṃ gamiṣyāmaḥ snātuṃ tīrthāni vai bhuvi |||2||| drakṣyāmaḥ paramātmānaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | ityuktā dānavā daityā āsurā rākṣasāstathā ||25|| cakrurudyogamatulaṃ nirjagmuśca rasātalāt | sahitāste cyavanena yayuḥ śrīhāṭakeśvaram ||26|| vidhinā snānapūjādi kṛtvā śrīhāṭakeśituḥ | pātālādūrdhvamāyātāḥ saurāṣṭre vivarairbhuvam ||27|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre cāśvapaṭṭasarovare | lomaśasyāśramapūrve snānaṃ cakrurmudānvitāḥ ||28|| sa cyavanaḥ sa prahrādaḥ sarvadaityasamanvitaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bālasvarūpiṇam ||29|| sarvāvatārasaṃjuṣṭaṃ muktakanyādisevitam | dadarśa pūjayāmāsa dadhyau sarvamanoharam ||2.22.30|| tataḥ śrīkambharālakṣmīṃ natvā gopālakṛṣṇakam | lomaśaṃ pūjayitvā ca saro vai puṣkaraṃ yayau ||3 1|| sarasvatīṃ cāvagāhya dharmāraṇyaṃ gato’bhavat | meroḥ kṛtvā sutīrthāni tataḥ śrībadarīṃ yayau |||32|| naranārāyaṇau yatra tepāte tapa uttamam | samunnatajaṭābhārau tapasyāsaktamānasau ||33|| atisaumyastharūpau ca kṛṣṇājinadharau munī | dadarśa vimalau devau pupūjātīva bhāvataḥ ||34|| snātvā gaṃgāṃ śālavṛkṣaṃ naimiṣāraṇyasannidhau | yayau daityendra evāsau dadarśa tatra tau punaḥ ||35|| śāladrumakṛtāvāsau tāpasā tau narottamau | tayośca pārśvayordivye dhanuṣī lakṣaṇānvite ||36|| śārṅgamājagavaṃ cāpyakṣayyāvapi maheṣudhī | śālavṛkṣaṃ mahāśākhaṃ śaraiścitaṃ ca hetibhiḥ ||37|| dadarśa bāṇānaparān mukhe lagnān parasparam | tatastānadbhutākārān bāṇānnāgopavītakān ||38|| dṛṣṭvātulaṃ ruṣaṃ cakre daityo dvirūpadarśanāt | tāpasau tau saśastrau ca dṛṣṭvāmanyata dāmbhikau ||39|| balagarveṇa ca vyāptaḥ provāca puruṣottamau | kiṃ bhavadbhyāṃ samārabdho dambho dharmavināśanaḥ ||2.22.40|| kva tapaḥ kva jaṭābhāraḥ kva cemau pravarāyudhau | athovāca naro daityaṃ kā te cintā parakṛte ||41|| sāmarthye sati yat kuryād ghaṭate tasya tattathā | āvāṃ vai tāpasau rakṣākarau daityaniṣūdanau ||42|| ubhayaṃ kurvo daityendra yāhi mā vaha garvakam | athovāca ditīśastau kā śaktiryuvayoriha ||43|| daityanāśakarī dharmarakṣake mayi tiṣṭhati | naraḥ prāha ca daityendra āvābhyāṃ śaktirarjitā ||44|| na kaścicchaknuyājjetuṃ naranārāyaṇau yudhi | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmānau pareśvarau ||45|| prahlādastu tato garvāt pratijñāmakarot puraḥ | yathākathañcid jeṣyāmi naranārāyaṇau raṇe ||46|| cyavanastaṃ tadā prāha mā vocaḥ śrīhariṃ prati | nāyaṃ jayyo hi bhagavān kṣayyena tu tvayā kvacit ||47|| daityaḥ prāha pratijñā sā mayoktā nānyathā bhavet | kariṣye sarvathā yatnaṃ vijeṣyāmi dhruvaṃ hi tau ||48|| ityuktvā cyavanaṃ natvā sajyaṃ cāpaṃ vitatya ca | cakāra garjanaṃ jyāyāstaladhvaniṃ cakāra ca ||49|| saṃkṣiptaṃ svabalaṃ sthāpya vane yuddhārthamudyataḥ | tato narastvājagavaṃ cāpamānamya vai śarān ||2.22.50|| mumoca tān pṛṣatkaiśca ciccheda daityapuṃgavaḥ | chinnān samīkṣyātha naro bāṇān daityena tatkṣaṇam ||51|| mahābāṇān mumocāpi kramaśo daityanāśakān | naraścaikaṃ ditijo dvau narastrīn caturo’suraḥ ||52|| naraḥ pañca ditijaḥ ṣaḍ bāṇān mumoca nāśakān | naraḥ sapta ditijo’ṣṭau naro mumoca trīṇi ṣaṭ ||53|| daityo daśa naraścaikādaśa daityaśca ṣoḍaśa | naro dvātriṃśatpṛṣatkān daityaḥ ṣaṣṭiśarām̐stadā ||54|| śataṃ naro mumocāpi daityaḥ śatadvayaṃ punaḥ | naraḥ śatatrayaṃ daityaḥ ṣaṭaśatāni sasarja vi ||55|| naraḥ sahasraṃ daityaśca pāresahasramāhinot | evaṃ cāsaṃkhyabāṇām̐stau mitho garvānmamocatuḥ ||56|| naroṃ’sakhyaśaravrātairavāstarat khadigbhuvaḥ | daityo’pyasaṃkhyabāṇaistān chiccheda bahuyatnataḥ ||57|| tadā varāstrairyudhyetāṃ samantrernaradānavau | vahniṃ naro jalaṃ daityo vāyvastraṃ parvatāstrakam ||58|| nāgāstraṃ gāruḍāstraṃ ca dhūmāstraṃ taijasāstrakam | nāryastraṃ ca narāstraṃ ca ṣaṇḍhāstraṃ yauvanāstrakam ||59|| evaṃ parasparaṃ tau ca cikṣipaturjighāṃsayā | brahmāstraṃ daityavaryaḥ sa mumocātibhayaṃkaram ||2.22.60|| nārāyaṇāstramagraṃ ca naro mumoca tatkṣaṇam | saṃhṛte te hyubhe cātha pralhādaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ ||6 1|| gadāṃ pragṛhya tarasā pracaskanda rathottamāt | nārāyaṇaśca taṃ vīkṣya samāyāntaṃ gadāyutam ||62|| naraṃ svapṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā yoddhumagragato’bhavat | daityo bhrāntvā gadāṃ vegānmūrdhni kṛṣṇamatāḍayat ||63|| tāḍitasya harernetradvayād vāryapatad bahu | gadāpi śatadhā bhinnā nyapatad bhuvi khaṇḍaśaḥ ||64|| daityastūrṇaṃ rathe sthitvā kārmukaṃ prasamādade | bāṇān śilīmukhān tīkṣṇān mumocārdhaśaśiprabhān ||65|| harivicched tān bāṇairnirbibheda ca dānavam | dānavo’pi hariṃ bāṇairvivyādha ca śilīmukhaiḥ ||66|| evaṃ parasparaṃ cāvidhyetāṃ marmasu roṣataḥ | tadāmbare didṛkṣūṇā devānāṃ dehināṃ tathā ||67|| sannipāto’bhavad vyomni dundubhayo mahāsvanāḥ | avādyanta tathā puṣpavarṣaṃ cābhūt tayoḥ kayoḥ ||68|| athaivaṃ balamāpannau daityanārāyaṇāvubhau | babandhatustadākāśaṃ sutīkṣṇaśaravṛṣṭibhiḥ ||69|| sarvadiśo’cchādayatāmayudhyetāmasuglaham | nārāyaṇastu daityaṃ taṃ śarairbibheda marmasu ||2.22.70|| daityo bibheda hṛdaye bāhvormukhe narāyaṇam | nārāyaṇo’rdhacandreṇa ciccheda daityakārmukam ||71 || dānavaścāparaṃ sajyaṃ dhanuḥ kṛtvā śarairharim | vavarṣa tān hariśchitvā daityaṃ bāṇairavākirat ||72|| kārmukaṃ ca kṣurapreṇa ciccheda cāparaṃ tataḥ | tṛtīyaṃ ca caturthaṃ ca ciccheda pañcamaṃ dhanuḥ ||73 || atha daityo lohamayaṃ jagrāha parighaṃ dṛḍham | bhrāmayāmāsa yāvattaṃ ciccheda bhagavān śaraiḥ ||74|| prahlādo mudgaraṃ bhrāntvā cikṣepa ca narāyaṇe | harirdaśabhirnārācaiściccheda mudgaraṃ yadā ||72|| daityaḥ pāśayutastūrṇaṃ dudrāva śrīhariṃ prati | hariḥ pāśaṃ tu bāṇena ciccheda bahukhaṇḍaśaḥ ||76|| daityaḥ śaktiṃ saptatāladīrghāmādāya mādhavam | prati cikṣepa ca haristāṃ ciccheda kṣuraprakaiḥ ||77|| daityaśca parvataśṛṃgaṃ cikṣepa mādhavopari | hariḥ śaktyā vidāryaitad dānavasya tu vakṣasi ||78|| śūlaṃ śaktisamaṃ vegāt prāhiṇod dānavastadā | prabhinnahṛdayo rādhe papāta rathamadhyagaḥ ||79|| visaṃjñaṃ sārathirjñātvā tamapovāha vai raṇāt | nārāyaṇo viśaśrāma tāvat saṃjñānvito’suraḥ ||2.22.80|| sudṛḍhaṃ cāpamādāya bhūyo yoddhumupāgataḥ | tāvat sāyaṃ harirdṛṣṭvā pratyuvāca mahāsuram ||8 1 || gaccha daityendra yotsyāmaḥ prātastvāhnikamācara | evamukto yayau natvā naimiṣaṃ cāhnikaṃ vyadhāt ||82|| evaṃ nityaṃ mahāyuddhaṃ pravavṛte tayordine | rātrau viśrāntisamaye cintayatyapi dānavaḥ ||83 || kathaṃ jeṣyāmi taṃ vīraṃ dāmbhikaṃ sādhyamīśvaram
