| athaivaṃ dānavastenāyudhyata bahuvatsarān ||84|| na cājayat tadā varṣasahasrānte’jitaṃ harim | nārāyaṇaṃ samabhyetya dānavo vākyamabravīt ||85|| kimarthaṃ devadeveśa tvāmahaṃ sādhyamīśvaram | vijetuṃ nātra śaknomi tasya me kāraṇaṃ vada ||86 || nārāyaṇaśca taṃ prāha durjayo’haṃ surāsuraiḥ | api koṭyastraśastrādyairbalaiḥ sarvavidhairapi ||87|| prahlādastu tadā prāha yadyasādhyaśca durjayaḥ | pratijñātaṃ mayā jetuṃ tadasatyaṃ bhavediha ||88|| khyāto hatapratijño’haṃ kathaṃ jīveyamīśvara | tasmātte sannidhau viṣṇo santyakṣye jīvanaṃ mama ||89|| ityuktvā niṣasādāgre gṛṇan brahmasanātanam | hariḥ prāha kṛpāluḥ svaṃ bhaktaṃ śraddhānvitaṃ param ||2.22.90 || gaccha jeṣyasi bhaktyā māṃ na yuddhena kadācana | prahlādaśca tadā prāha trailokyaṃ vijitaṃ mayā ||9 1 || paraṃ na vijito’si tvaṃ lokarakṣākaro yataḥ | dharmapravartanārthāya tapaścaryāṃ samāsthitaḥ ||92|| tattvāṃ jetuṃ parāṃ bhaktiṃ kariṣye jayadāṃ śubhām | śuśrūṣāṃ tava deveśārādhanāṃ sevanādikam |||93 || kariṣye yena yuddhena tvaṃ parājayamāpnuyāḥ | tad yuddhaṃ vai pratijñātaṃ phaladaṃ me bhaviṣyati ||94|| śastraṃ bhaktyātmakaṃ kṛṣṇe yojayiṣye hyataḥ param | ityuktvā daityavaryaḥ sa hiraṇyākṣasutāndhakam ||95||| samāhūyābravīt hṛṣṭaḥ sādhyaṃ sādhayituṃ vratī | daityāśca dānavāścāpi paripālyāstvayāndhaka ||96 || mayotsṛṣṭamidaṃ rājyaṃ pratīccha paripālaya | ahaṃ yuddhena tapasā bhaktyārādhanayā tathā ||97|| vijeṣye śrīhariṃ deveśvaraṃ dāmbhikamīśvaram | ityukto’ndhakadaityaśca jagrāha rājyamuttamam ||98|| prahlādaḥ prayayau puṇyaṃ harerbadarikāśramam | yāvāstāṃ naimiṣe kṣetre śālagrāme ca yau prabhū ||99|| tāveva vīkṣya devau sa naranārāyaṇāvubhau | kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā vavande caraṇau tayoḥ || 2.22.100 || nārāyaṇaśca taṃ prāha māmajitvā mahāsura | kimarthaṃ praṇato’syatra vada yatte samīhitam | | 101 || prahlādaḥ prāha bhagavan kastvāṃ jetuṃ prabhuḥ pumān | kastvatto’sti pumān śreṣṭhastvameva puruṣottamaḥ || 1 02|| tvameva tapasā dyotajjaṭājūṭadhanurdharaḥ | tvāṃ yoginaścintayanti cārcayanti manīṣiṇaḥ || 103 || japanti snātakāstvāṃ ca yajante tvāṃ ca yājñikāḥ | rāmayanti ca rāmāstvāṃ pūjayanti pativratāḥ || 1 04|| aindriyikastaparyanti tvāmeva parameśvaram | tvamamartyo hṛṣīkeśaścakrapāṇirdharādharaḥ || 1 05|| mahāmīno hayaśirāstvameva kacchapākṛtiḥ | kroḍarūpaḥ kesarī tvaṃ brahmā śrīśaḥ satīpatiḥ || 1 06|| kubero varuṇastvaṃ ca samīro bhāskaraḥ śaśī | sarvabhūtātmabhūtastvaṃ kastvāṃ jeṣyati mādhava || 1 07|| bhaktyā cet tvaṃ vaśaṃ yāhi bhaktiṃ kartuṃ samāgataḥ | ityuktvā ca punastasya pādayoḥ praṇanāma saḥ || 1 08|| nārāyaṇaśca taṃ prāha parituṣṭo’smi te’nagha | bhaktyā tvananyayā cāhaṃ tvayā cādya parājitaḥ || 1 09|| parājitaśca puruṣo jetre daṇḍaṃ prayacchati | daṇḍārthaṃ te pradāsyāmi varaṃ vṛṇu yamicchasi || 2.22.110 || prahlādaḥ prāha me pāpaṃ śārīraṃ mānasaṃ ca vā | vāgbhavaṃ nāśamāyātu yanmayā yudhyatā kṛtam || 111 || yā yā jāyeta me buddhiḥ sā sā viṣṇo tvadāśritā | devārcane’tiniratā tvaccittā tvatparāyaṇā || 11 2|| tvatpādapadmayornityaṃ ratiścāstu parā mama | nārāyaṇaśca taṃ prāha tathaivāstu sadā tava || 11 3|| aparaṃ cāstu bhaktendro nityamevākṣayo’vyayaḥ | ajaraścāmaraścāpi matprasādādbhaviṣyasi || 1 14|| ito gaccha paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre yatrāste puruṣottamaḥ || 1 15|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ | taṃ dṛṣṭvā śrīhariṃ dhyātvā nidhāya hṛdi taṃ prabhum || 116 || lomaśācca mahāmantraṃ gṛhītvā pāvanastataḥ | gaccha tvaṃ bhaktaśārdūla svamāvāsaṃ kriyārataḥ || 1 17|| praśāsayan sarvadaityān rājyaṃ pālaya śāśvatam | svajātisadṛśaṃ dambhaṃ kuru bhaktiṃ ca śāsanam || 1 18|| na karmabandho bhavato maccittasya bhaviṣyati | hitopadeṣṭā daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ gururbhava || 11 9|| evamukto hariṃ natvā kṣamāpya śrīhariṃ naram | yayau cyavanasaṃyuktaḥ saurāṣṭre lomaśāśramam || 2.22.120|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre dadarśa puruṣottamam | aśvapaṭṭasarovārisnānaṃ kṛtvārcya keśavam || 121 || auṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | mantraṃ prāpya māsamātramuṣitvā prayayau gṛham || 122|| aśmakaṃ nāma nagaraṃ śaśāsa ca rasātalam | dṛṣṭaḥ sabhājitaścāpi dānavairandhakādibhiḥ || 123 || bhaktiṃ cakāra navadhā dhyānamārādhanādikam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtiṃ prapūjayan || 1 24|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ rādhe bhaktyā jayyo janārdanaḥ | daityenāpi parābhaktyā vijitaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 1 25|| dvitīye’bde harerdaityaścyavano mārgaśīrṣake | nyūṣatustanmahattīrthaṃ cyāvanaṃ dakṣiṇe taṭe || 126|| aśvapaṭṭasaraso vai prāhlādikaṃ tathocyate | prahlādo daityadanujān bodhayāmāsa tanmanum || 127|| rasātalamatāste’pi bhaktā babhūvuraiśvarāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhejuraharniśam || 128|| ityetat kathitaṃ rādhe sarvapātakanāśakam | paramaṃ sādhanaṃ daityoddhārakaṃ cākṣayaṃ dṛḍham | | 129 | | jayadaṃ śāntidaṃ smṛddhipradaṃ śāśvatamodadam | hareścaraṇadaṃ pāṭhaśrutibhyāṃ mokṣadaṃ param || 2.22.130 | | iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne cyavana yogena prahlādasya rasātalāttīrthārthaṃ bhūmāvāgamanaṃ naranārāyaṇena saha yuddhaṃ bhaktyā nārāyaṇaparājayaḥ, prahlādacyavanayorlomaśāśramāgamaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ | | 22 | |
<2.23> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca atha te dānavāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭumicchanti satvaram | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bālaṃ hi rādhike || 1 || yatpratāpādayaṃ daityeśvaro jigye hariṃ prabhum | tāṃ bhaktiṃ kartumicchanti prahlādenopabodhitāḥ || 2 || śṛṇu rādhe kathāṃ tāṃ ca yathā te dānaveśvarāḥ | samāgatā harerbhaktā jātāścārādhanānvitāḥ || 3 || andhakasya ca vaṃśīyāḥ prahlādasya ca vaṃśajāḥ | kujambhasya ca jambhasya śaṃkukarṇasya vaṃśajāḥ || 4 || mayasya vaṃśajāścāpi dundubheḥ śambarasya ca | ayaḥśaṃkośca vṛtrasya vaṃśajā dānavādayaḥ || 5 || sasmaruścyavanaṃ vipraṃ prahlādamārgadarśakam | cyavanaḥ śīghramevaiṣāṃ purataḥ samupasthitaḥ || 6 || vanditaḥ pūjitaścāpi pṛṣṭaśca śreyasaṃ prati | vidyutkeśisuto jyeṣṭhaḥ sukeśiḥ samuvāca tam || 7 || praṣṭumicchāmi bhavataḥ saṃśayo’yaṃ hṛdi sthitaḥ | kiṃsvicchreyaḥ pare loke kimu ceha dvijottama || 8 || kena pūjyo bhavet satsu kenāsau sukhamedhate | iti pṛṣṭaścyavanastān daityasantānajām̐stadā || 9 || vimṛśyovāca śreyo’rthamiha loke paratra ca | śreyaḥ puṇyaṃ tathā dharmaḥ paratreha ca sarvathā || 2.23.10 || dharme samāśrite satsu pūjyaḥ sukhī sadā bhavet | dharmaḥ svasya sadācāraḥ parātmaśāntidaḥ sukhaḥ || 11 || svātmaśāntipradaścāpi puṇyaṃ tatsukhadaṃ sadā | mānavānāṃ paro dharmaḥ sadā yajñādikāḥ kriyāḥ || 1 2|| svādhyāyastattvaveditvaṃ viṣṇupūjanamityapi | kenārjitena manujāḥ sukhino’mutra ceha ca || 13 || devānāṃ bhaktarakṣā ca pūjāgrahaṇamityapi | prajāpālanamityādi tenārjitena te sukhāḥ || 14|| daityānāṃ bāhuśālitvaṃ yuddhaṃ vandanamityapi | nītirbhaktiḥ prapattiśca tenārjitena te sukhāḥ || 15|| siddhānāṃ yogasiddhiśca svādhyāyo brahmacintanam | bhaktiścopāsanā śāntistenārjitena te sukhāḥ || 16|| gāndharvāṇāṃ gītanṛtye vādyaṃ vāṇī madhusravā | upāsanaṃ ca mahatāṃ tenārjitena te sukhāḥ || 17|| vidyādhrāṇāṃ śubhā vidyā vijñānaṃ pauruṣaṃ matiḥ | nārāyaṇyāṃ sadā bhaktistenārjitena te sukhāḥ || 18|| kinnarāṇāṃ sūryabhaktīrgāndharvaṃ gāyanādikam | kauśalyaṃ hāsyabhāvādau tenārjitena te sukhāḥ || 19|| śilpināṃ śilpakauśalyaṃ nārāyaṇābhicintanam | paropakāraśālitvaṃ tenārjitena te sukhāḥ ||2.23.20|| pitṝṇāṃ cendriyavṛttinigraho mānahīnatā | parameśe sadā bhaktistenārjitena te sukhāḥ ||2 1|| ṛṣīṇāṃ śīlatā satyaṃ japyaṃ jñānaṃ kṣamā dayā | nirmalāntaḥkaraṇaṃ ca tenārjitena te sukhāḥ ||22|| tyāgināṃ ca satīnāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ svāmisevanam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārpaṇamarāgitā ||23|| harerbhaktiḥ sadā kāryā tenārjitena te sukhāḥ | dhanarakṣā bhogadānaṃ sevakatvaṃ parārthakam ||24|| harau bhaktirguhyakānāṃ tenārjitena tai sukhāḥ | parāvamarṣitā pārakyārthe laulyaṃ hi rakṣasām ||25||| harau bhakte ca vā bhaktistenārjitena te sukhāḥ | avivekaḥ piśācānāṃ śaucahānirasatyatā ||26|| bhaktaprasādibhakṣyaṃ ca tenārjitena te sukhāḥ | tiraścāṃ parasevitvaṃ tenārjitena te sukhāḥ ||27|| ityevaṃ kathitāḥ puṇyā dharmāḥ ṣoḍaśa mokṣadāḥ | svasvajātyanusāreṇa dharmasthāḥ sukhinaḥ sadā ||28|| sarvadharmeṣu cotkṛṣṭāḥ sarvasādhāraṇā vṛṣāḥ | tīrthayānaṃ prabhoḥ pūjā paropakaraṇaṃ tapaḥ ||29|| ahiṃsanaṃ ca santoṣo nītilabhye japo hareḥ | etān dharmān samāśritya ye ke’pi syuśca dehinaḥ ||2.23.3 0|| avaśyaṃ brahmaśaraṇā muktimāyānti śāśvatīm | nyāyyacaraṇāḥ sukhino duḥkhinasvapanītayaḥ ||3 1|| śrutvaivaṃ cyavanasyārthī vācaṃ daityāḥ sukhārthinaḥ | prahlādapādasaraṇāstīrthaṃ śreyo hi menire ||3 2|| cyavanaṃ te papracchuśca sarvatīrthottamottamam | cyavanastām̐stadā prāha tīrthaṃ śrīhāṭakeśvaram ||33|| tīrthottamaṃ ca badarīvanaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | kṣetraṃ śrīgaṇḍakītīrthaṃ māthuraṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā ||34|| tīrthottamottamaṃ tvāste cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ lomaśasyāśramastathā || 35|| saurāṣṭraṃ sarvataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ parameśvaraśobhitam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bālasvarūpavān ||36|| vartate bhagavān yatra parameśaḥ pumuttamaḥ | sarvadhāmādhipasvāmī sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ||37|| sarvāvatāranāthaśca sarvalakṣmyādisatpatiḥ | sarvamokṣarddhidātā ca sarvatulyadayālayaḥ ||38|| tattīrthaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ tīrthāttamottamottamam | yatkṛtvā sveṣṭamāsādya modate sarvaśāntiṣu ||39|| etacchrutvā cyavanasya daityāstīrthecchavastadā | cyavanaṃ saha nītvaiva cāśvapaṭṭasaro yayuḥ ||2.23.40|| daityāśca dānavāścāpi teṣāṃ nāryaḥ sutādayaḥ | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre tīrthārthaṃ prayayurmudā ||41|| cyavanasya prasaṃgena prahlādādyupadeśataḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ draṣṭumupāgatāḥ ||42|| lomaśasyāśramaṃ vyomnaścāvatīrya ca dānavāḥ | cyavanena samaṃ nemurlomaśaṃ te kuṭumbinaḥ ||43|| dānavānāṃ parāṃ bhaktiṃ saṃvīkṣya lomaśo muniḥ | cyavanena saha teṣāṃ svāgataṃ kṛtavān param ||44|| madhuparkaṃ cāsanādi jalapānādikaṃ dadau | āvāsān pradadau ramyān kalpitān kalpavṛkṣajān ||45|| aśmakākhyanagaryāśca śatottarān suśobhanān | susmṛddhān sarvavastvāḍhyān prāsādān candramonibhān ||46|| snānabhojanaśayyāḍhyān sabhāśālāvirājitān | udyānakuṃjasaṃvyāptān śītaramyasukhānilān ||47|| candanāgurukastūrīgandhāmodapramoditān | sarvopakaraṇādyuktān sevābhaktān dadau muniḥ ||48|| cyavanaḥ suprasanno’bhūllomaśasyārtibhāvataḥ | daityām̐śca dānavānāha ṛṣayastvaparigrahāḥ ||49|| pakṣapātādiśūnyāśca rāgadveṣavivarjitāḥ | sarvajīvahitāḥ śāntā mocayanti hyaghājjanān ||2.23.50|| yasya śatrau ca mitre ca samabhāvo vilokyate | sa eva mokṣado bodhyaḥ pāvanaṃ tīrthamuttamam ||51|| lomaśasya prasādena vāriṇā pūrvajanmajāḥ | ghorapātakapuñjā vai layameṣyanti vo’khilāḥ |||52|| tasmācchrīlomaśaṃ vipraṃ prasevadhvaṃ mudānvitāḥ | kaṃcitkālaṃ vasatātra samarjayata deśanām ||53|| sthāvarebhyastu tīrthebhyo jaṃgamaṃ drāg viśodhakam | sādhavaḥ paramaṃ tīrth sparśanāt pāpanāśakam ||54|| vandanāt sevanāt pādasaṃmmardanāt pratoṣaṇāt | yayeṣṭavastudānācca tārayantyapi pāpinaḥ ||55|| mahāpāpātipāpānāṃ dāhakaṃ sādhusevanam | bhojanīyā vandanīyā darśanīyā hi sādhavaḥ |||56|| sparśanīyā namanīyāstoṣaṇīyā hi sādhavaḥ | sarvārpaṇena ca paricaraṇīyā hi sādhavaḥ ||57|| saṃgatiḥ sulabhā sarvā durlabhā sādhusaṃgatiḥ | kāyena manasā vaicā toṣaṇīyā hi sādhavaḥ ||58|| dhyānaniṣṭhāparāḥ puṇyaśevadhayastapaḥprabhāḥ | parabrahmaparāḥ śiṣyaśreyaḥparāyaṇāḥ priyāḥ ||59|| sarvakalyāṇadāḥ santaḥ sevanīyāḥ svamuktaye | dānavatvaṃ ca daityatvaṃ mānavatvaṃ sureśatā ||2.23.60|| na naityikī cātmanāṃ vai dehajanmādijaṃ hi tat | dehasya vigame sarvaṃ cāgantukaṃ vinaśyati ||61|| mamedaṃ ca kuṭumbādi rājyaṃ me mama bāndhavāḥ | sutāḥ patnī patiśceti cāhaṃkārakṛtaṃ mṛṣā ||62|| ahaṃkārātmake bīje yāte yāsyati vāsanā | karmāśayavināśe ca kva daityatvaṃ kva śiṣyatā ||63|| ātmā tu māyikavarṣmayogānnāmaniruktimān | diterjāto yato daityo danorjātastu dānavaḥ ||64|| ajāto yaścetanaḥ sa jātena jāta ucyate | jātaṃ dehaṃ na vai cātmā tataścātmā na nāmabhāka ||65|| yatra sthāne tu yo jātastatraivāsya prajāyate | mūṣā tvabhiniveśo’tra māyāyāṃ mamatāvaśāt ||6 6 || tasmād yūyaṃ na pātālarasātalādivāsinaḥ | na ca daityā na vai śūrāstatsarvaṃ dehabhāg yataḥ ||67|| satāṃ yogena ca santo jātāścātra sarovare | snātvā pītvā jalaṃ cātra lomaśasya rajodharāḥ ||68|| pūtāḥ stha tīrthayogena manuṃ gṛhṇata cottamam | pūjayata guruṃ cainaṃ paścāt kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||69|| yāsyāmo darśanārthaṃ vai śreyaḥ prāpsyatha niścitam | ityuktā dānavā daityā daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ ||2.23.70|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthe snātvā prāhlādikaṃ sthalam | natvā ca lomaśaṃ vipraṃ pūjayāmāsurādarāt ||7 1 || pādapūjājalaṃ pītvā nemustaṃ lomaśaṃ munim | candanādyaiḥ puṣpahārairarcayāmāsurādarāt ||72|| jagṛhuśca mahāmantraṃ pāvanaṃ sarvasaukhyadam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||73 || enaṃ gṛhītvā mantraṃ ca gṛṇanto vaiṣṇavāśca te | mālāṃ ca taulasīṃ bhāle sabinduṃ tilakaṃ tathā ||74|| gṛhītvā paṃktiśo bhūtvā lomaśārpitamuttamam | bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca lehyaṃ ca coṣyaṃ bhojanamuttamam ||75 || pānaṃ miṣṭaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ jagṛhurlomaśāśrame | cyavano’pi kṛtasandhyāvandano bubhuje mudā ||76 || tataḥ sarve nijāvāsān yayurviśrāntilabdhaye | atha sāyaṃ tu te sarve gṛhītvopāyanāni vai ||77|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadarśanakāṃkṣiṇaḥ | yayuḥ śrīkambharālakṣmīprāsādaṃ saptabhūmikam ||78|| yatra śrībālakṛṣṇo’sau dolāyāṃ rājate prabhuḥ | śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaśca pitā putraṃ kare svake ||79|| dhṛtvā siṃhāsane cāyāt niṣasāda tadocitaḥ | lomaśaścyavanaścobhau śiṣyadaityagaṇānvitau ||2.23.80|| āyayatuśca tābhyāṃ vai dattāsanaḥ pitā svayam | daityānāmapi satkāraṃ svāgataṃ kṛtavām̐stadā ||81 || dattāsanāstu te daityāḥ prahvībhāvapariplutāḥ | ātmano menire dṛṣṭvā kṛtakṛtyān prabhuṃ harim ||82|| kṣaṇaṃ sthairyaṃ prajagmuste sthiranetrāḥ sthavṛttayaḥ | āścaryaṃ paramaṃ te ca lokayāmāsuraiśvaram ||83|| kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā bālakṛṣṇaṃ tataḥ kiśorarūpiṇam | divyarūpānurūpābhirūpamujjvalamuttamam ||84|| tatra mūrtau ca prahlādaṃ śukrācāryaṃ tataḥ param | tataśca kaśyapaṃ ditiṃ dānu dakṣaṃ prajāpatim ||85 || hiraṇyākṣaṃ ca hiraṇyakaśipuṃ ca pitāmahān | brahmāṇaṃ ca tathā rudraṃ viṣṇuṃ tataścaturbhujam ||86|| tato vairājarūpaṃ ca caturdaśa ca bhūmikāḥ | tatra rasātalaṃ tatrāśmakapattanamuttamam ||87|| tatra naijanivāsām̐śca tatra naijakuṭumbinaḥ | naijarūpāṇi ca sarve lokayāmāsuraḍutam ||88|| tatra pañcasahasrāṇi kanyānāṃ bhāvitātmanām | varaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ ca kiśoraṃ vavrire patim ||89|| evaṃ vilokayāmāsustataśca bālarūpadhṛk | harirjātaḥ punaścātra kaiśoraṃ rūpamāptavān || 2.23.90 || ityevaṃ te vilokyaiva paramāścaryasaṃplutāḥ | pupūjuḥ śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jagatpatim | | 91 || upadāḥ sannyadhustvagre pādaprakṣālanāmbu ca | papuḥ sarve tadā daityadānavāstatstriyo’pi ca || 92 || teṣāṃ kanyā divyarūpāḥ pañcasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ | mumuhuḥ śrīharau lagnā dhyānamagnāstadā sthirāḥ || 93 | | babhūvuśca tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ varayāmāsuricchayā | tava pādāmbuje dehi bhaktiṃ dehi jagatprabho || 94|| muktiṃ dehi śāśvataṃ ca sukhaṃ dehi jagatprabho | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha tathāstu vaḥ || 95|| dattaṃ padaṃ pradattā ca bhaktirmuktiḥ sukhaṃ tathā | ityuktastā divyarūpāstadā jātā hi tatkṣaṇam || 96|| pañcasāhasrasaṃkhyāstā patnyo jātā drutaṃ hareḥ | pādau dhṛtvā tatra tasthuḥ patiṃ prāpya prabhuṃ harim || 97|| lomaśasyāśrame tasthuḥ śrīkāntarakṣitā hi tāḥ | lomaśaścyavanaścobhau sampūjya śrīhariṃ tataḥ || 98 || kanyāḥ saṃrakṣayāmāsaturvai naijāśrame mudā | śrīharerājñayā tāścārbudakanyāsu saṃsthitāḥ || 99 | daityā daśādhisāhasrāḥ śrīhareḥ kṛpayā drutam | vaikuṇṭhaṃ gantumicchanto vavrire dhāma tatra ca | | 2.23.100 | hariṇā prāpitāste tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ divyarūpiṇaḥ | athopadāḥ samastā yāḥ kanyābhyaḥ pradadau prabhuḥ | | 101 || ṛṣibhyāṃ ca dadau yogyavastūni śrīhariḥ svayam | tato bālasvarūpaḥ sa bhūtvā datelāgato’bhavat || 102 | cyavano lomaśaṃ natvā kanyābhyaśca śubhāśiṣaḥ | datvā yayau tīrthayātrāṃ puṣkarāraṇyamuttamam || 103 | prahlādaścirajīvī vai rasātalamupāyayau | ityevaṃ rādhike tasya pareśasya jagatkṛtaḥ || 1 04| atīva divyamāvedyaṃ caritaṃ śrāvaṇe’bhavat | varṣe dvitīyake pāṭhācchravaṇānmokṣadaṃ param || 105 | smṛddhidaṃ cāyuṣyadaṃ ca putrapautradhanapradam | akhaṇḍasaubhāgyakaraṃ kṛpāsādhyo yato hariḥ || 106 | iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne rasātalādisthitadaśasāhasradaityadānavānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ pañcasāhasrakanyakānāṃ bālakṛṣṇavaraṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayoviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 23 ||
<2.24> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rādhe tṛtīye’sya varṣāraṃbhe mahotsavam | pitā cakāra vidhivat śreṣṭhaṃ dvitīyavarṣavat || 1 || mārgaśīrṣatrayodaśyāṃ caulasaṃskāramācarat | kṛtvā tu maṃgalasnānaṃ mātṛkāpūjanādikam || 2 || nāndīśrāddhaṃ svastipāṭhaṃ homaṃ sabhyānale tathā | pātrāsādanamādhatya vahnestu dakṣiṇe sthale || 3 || śubhaikaviṃśatidarbhapiñjulīrnyasya vai tataḥ | vahnervāmasthale nyasya raktagogomayādi ca || 4 || kṛśarasthālikāpākaṃ nyadhāt pitā tataḥ param | kṛtvā vyāhṛtihomādi kṣuramādāya cāyasam || 1 || dakṣiṇottarabhāgasthasvalpaśikhāvatāraṇam | kṛtvā pitā tato garbhakeśānāṃ muṇḍanaṃ śanaiḥ || 6 || saśikhaṃ kārayāmāsa nāpitena sutasya ca | godānādi dadau viprān bhojayāmāsa yoginaḥ || 7 || caturdaśabhuvanānāṃ tarpayāmāsa vāsinaḥ | lomaśaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhojayāmāsa kanyakāḥ || 8 || sādhūn sādhvīścātithīṃśca bhojayāmāsa taddine | gogrāsān dāpayāmāsa jantubhyaḥ piṣṭakaṃ kaṇān || 9 || evaṃ vai caulasaṃskāraṃ cakārāghavināśanam | yadyapi śrīhareḥ pāpanāśakasya kathaṃ hyagham || 2.24.10 || tathāpi lokarakṣārthaṃ vedamārgasya guptaye | saṃskāraṃ tādṛśaṃ yogyaṃ kṛtavān vai pitā śubham || 11 || rādhā śrutvā tadā kṛṣṇaṃ papraccha vinayānvitā | bālānāṃ bālikānāṃ vā prodbhūyācchaṃ hi vartatām || 1 2|| viśuddhānāṃ nātividāṃ svacchadarpaṇavaddhṛdām | kāmacārakāmabhakṣyakāmavihārasañjuṣām || 13 || kinnāma pātakaṃ teṣāṃ yaccaulena vināśyate | śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prāha bālānāṃ rādhike tvamaghaṃ śṛṇu || 14|| pūrvakṛtādi pāpāni janmāntare’bhiyānti vai | svargādvā narakādvāpi śeṣaliptiḥ prayāti tam || 15|| garbhe mūtrāśaye vahneḥ pātātmake rajo’nvite | dhātau vāsaścātmano yaḥ sa evāghena jāyate || 16|| śarīrodbhavanaṃ tatra puṇyapāpena jāyate | mūrchāyāṃ ca jale vāsaḥ pāpāyaiva prajāyate || 17|| janmadukhaṃ mahadvai yat pāravaśyaṃ ca pāpataḥ | jīvanaṃ dugdhapānādi puṇyapāpena jāyate || 18|| malamūtrādisaṃsargā daṃśādidaśanaṃ tathā | avāktvaṃ cāpyaśaktatvaṃ pāpamātreṇa jāyate || 19|| ityetāni tu pāpāni tena pūrvakṛtāni vai | janmabhāve prapadyante duḥkhadānyeva sarvathā ||2.24.20|| yeṣāṃ pāpaṃ na vai cāsti sa cātmā rudravat priye | sanakādisamaḥ syānmānaso vijño na garbhajaḥ ||21 || athāśuddheḥ parihāraḥ saṃskāreṇaiva jāyate | asaṃskṛtaśarīrasya śuddhiḥ kāryā svabhāvataḥ ||22|| pūrvajanmanaḥ pāpāni hyaśuddhyā saha mastake | rohanti romarūpaistu kṛṣṇavarṇāni tāni vai ||23 || garbhakeśāḥ pāparuhastannāśe pāpanāśanam | tasmādvai bālakānāṃ tu caulasaṃskṛtiriṣyate || 24|| cūṃ pāpaṃ līyate yena caulaṃ tanmuṇḍanaṃ smṛtam | athānyacchṛṇu rādhe tvaṃ keśā vai kṛtachedanāḥ ||25|| jaṭārūpāḥ pravardhante vegādityasti kāraṇam | nūtaneṣu ca keśeṣu mūlāni kāraṇāni vai ||26|| punaśca karmaṇā śuklasaṃjñena sā jaṭā bhavet | tasmājjaṭā sadā rakṣyā śikhā vā śuklasaṃhitā ||27|| yathā yathā ca bālo vai vardhate tu tathā tathā | karmaṇā jāyate puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ vā miśrakarma ca ||28|| āpañcavarṣaṃ bhogyaṃ tatpituḥ samprocyate’tra vai | pañcottaraṃ svabhogyaṃ tad romasveva niṣīdati ||29|| tasmātkeśāśca romāṇi pāpāśrīṇi bhavanti hi | kaccarasya pitrāḥ sarve vyarthakardamaśodhakāḥ ||2.24.3 0|| tīrthe vai vapanaṃ tasmāt kāraṇīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ | pāpāvatāraṇaṃ tadvai boddhavyaṃ keśakartanam ||3 1 || evaṃ keśāvapanīyāstṛtīye vatsare tataḥ | yatheṣṭaṃ vapanīyāste brahmarandhraṃ vinābhitaḥ ||32|| yadvā puṇyā jaṭā rakṣyā saṃskṛtā śobhanānaghā | kṛṣṇāḥ keśā janānāṃ tu yāvad dṛśyanta eva te ||33 || tāvat pāpāni viṣayāḥ kārayanti tu dehinaḥ | ākarṇaśuklaromāṇo vṛddhā lipyanta eva na ||34|| tasmād vṛddhasya naivāsti tvāmnāyaḥ puṇyapāpayoḥ | madhyāvasthasya tat sarvaṃ viśeṣeṇa nigadyate ||35|| ityevaṃ rādhike caulasaṃskāraḥ śodhakaḥ kṛtaḥ | rādhikā prāha bhagavan pūrvajanmāghasañcayaḥ ||36|| kathaṃ romasu garbhasthabālakasya pratiṣṭhati | śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prāha ca rādhe śṛṇu tatkathayāmi te ||37|| purā hyadharmaḥ puruṣo brahmapṛṣṭhasamutthitaḥ | hiṃsāpatnīsusaṃyuktaḥ pāpaputrastato’bhavat ||38|| pitṛbhaktaśca pāpaḥ svaṃ mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tathā | na muñcati kṣaṇaṃ dūraṃ sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā ||3 9|| yatrādharmaśca hiṃsā ca tatra pāpaḥ pravartate | yatrādharmo na hiṃsā na tatra pāpo na vartate ||2.24.40|| ātmāno ye tu garbhasthā apakvā niṣkriyā vaśāḥ | aguṇāścolbasaṃvṛttāsteṣāṃ nādharmahiṃsane ||41 || kathaṃ pāpena vai tatra stheyaṃ pūrvakṛtādhini | pāpinaṃ cet parityajya pāpaṃ vināvamarṣaṇam ||42|| dūraṃ yāti tadā tena kutra stheyaṃ vināśrayam | anyakṛtaṃ na cānyatra tiṣṭhatyeva ca gacchati ||43 || yena kṛtaṃ tu tat tasminneva tiṣṭhati sarvathā | bhogottaraṃ vināśaḥ syād yāvattvena vinirṇayaḥ ||44|| itinyāyāt pāpasaṃjñaḥ sutaḥ pitre nyavedayat | yatra garbhe gate bāle nādharmo na ca hiṃsanam ||45|| tābhyāṃ vinā mayā tatra kathaṃ stheyaṃ tadātmani | adharmastaṃ ca pāpākhyaṃ sutaṃ prāha vicārya vai ||46|| putrāgaccha mayā sākaṃ cārthayāmi pitāmaham | sa tadā te nivāsārthaṃ yad dadet tatra saṃvasa ||47|| ityuktvā taṃ sutaṃ nītvā sahādharmo hyajaṃ yayau | pitaraṃ ca namaskṛtya niṣasāda purastataḥ ||48|| brahmā papraccha taṃ putraṃ saputraṃ cāgame kṛtim | kathaṃ kimarthamāyātaḥ saputro vada me’ciram ||49|| adharmaḥ prāha bhagavan putro’yaṃ pāpasaṃjñakaḥ | yatra hiṃsā tathā cāhaṃ tatra vāsaparaḥ sadā ||2.24.50|| garbhasthānāṃ tu jīvānāṃ vidyete na tu tābubhau | tatra teṣāṃ pūrvapāpaiḥ kathaṃ stheyaṃ vadātra me ||5 1 || brahmā vicārya ca tathā prāha garbhagatasya vai | keśarūpeṇa pāpena sthātavyaṃ vai mamājñayā |||52|| tataḥ pāpaḥ parāṃ tuṣṭiṃ jagāma svāśraye sthitaḥ | vināpi pitarau tatra varṣatrayaṃ pratiṣṭhite ||53 || atha brahmā svasaṃkalpān putrān ṣoḍaśa pāvanān | saṃskārān janayāmāsa pāpanāśanahetave ||54|| tatra caulaśca saṃskāraḥ keśātmāghavināśanaḥ | vihitaścaivamevānye pāpanāśakarāḥ kṛtāḥ ||55|| ityevaṃ rādhike sṛṣṭipālanāya tu vedhasā | pūrvasṛṣṭyanurūpeṇānuṣṭhitaṃ varṇitaṃ tathā ||56|| tathārītyaiva lokānāṃ śikṣaṇārthaṃ harerapi | pitrā caulākhyasaṃskāraḥ sampāditaḥ śubhāvahaḥ ||57|| atha tatra camatkārastadā jāto vadāmi te | adṛṣṭaścāpyaśrutaśca pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraistathā ||58|| mayā gatavatā rādhe tadānīṃ tatra vīkṣitaḥ | nāpitena tu ye keśā mastakādavatāritāḥ ||59|| te sarve’śvapaṭṭasarojale kṣiptā yadā tadā | divyāḥ sahasraśo nārāyaṇāścaturbhujāḥ śubhāḥ ||2.24.60 || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharā bhukuṭaśobhitāḥ | suvarṇakuṇḍalā vahnivastrā ramāniṣevitāḥ ||6 1 || vinatātanujārūḍhāḥ koṭisūryasamaprabhāḥ | sakaustubhāḥ satilakā bhagavanto virejire ||62|| sarve samānāḥ sadṛśāste’dṛśyanta tadā tataḥ | aṣṭabhujāstata eva tataḥ ṣoḍaśabāhavaḥ ||63|| dvātriṃśadbāhavaḥ paścācchatasāhasrabāhavaḥ | sahasraśo divyarūpā adṛśyanta narāyaṇāḥ ||64|| evaṃ lakṣaṃ śiroromṇāṃ nārāyaṇātmakaṃ hi tat | adṛśyata tadā hrasvāḥ keśāścaturbhujā hi te ||65|| adṛśyanta tato lambā aṣṭabhujā narāyaṇāḥ | tato lambatarāḥ keśā ye te ṣoḍaśabāhavaḥ ||66|| tato lambatamāḥ keśā dvātriṃśadbāhavo hi te | evaṃ dīrghātidīrghāśca keśāḥ śatādibāhavaḥ ||67|| sahasrabāhavaśceti vyadṛśyanta narāyaṇāḥ | taiḥ saha yāḥ śriyastāśca vyadṛśyanta tathābhujāḥ ||68|| yugalāste lakṣasaṃkhyāstuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram | tava mūrtau sthitā nārāyaṇā vayaṃ śiroruhāḥ ||69|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaro bhavān | aprasaṃkhyāvatārāṇāmavatārī parātparaḥ ||2.24.70|| vayaṃ līnāstava mūrtau vasāmastava vācchayā | nirgacchāmaśca vai kāle kāle brahmāṇḍarakṣakāḥ ||71 || bhavāmo bhagavantaśca yāvattava nideśanam | layecchayā ca te kṛṣṇa hyupasaṃhāramāpnumaḥ |||72|| pūjayāmo namāmastvāṃ vahāmaste nideśanam | pṛthag jātā vayaṃ kṛṣṇa tava mūrtirataḥ prabho ||73 || kva gantavyaṃ coṣitavyamasmābhirdehi deśanām | tathā kurmo hare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇākṣarādhipa ||74|| tava mūrtau ca ye tvanye hyapi romagaṇā hi te | anādino hi te muktāstathā cāgantukā api ||75|| muktā bhavanti muktānyo brahmāṇyo brahmapūruṣāḥ | tava mūrtau ca ye divyā guṇā vasanti te hare ||76 || sarve ca viṣṇavaḥ santi lakṣmīdāsīniṣevitāḥ | tava mūrtau ca ye bhūṣāḥ santi te tava śaktayaḥ ||77|| rādhāramājayālakṣmīpārvatīlalitāprabhāḥ | māṇikīmañjulādyāstāḥ premarūpā vasanti hi ||78|| ābhūṣaṇasvarūpāstā muktā muktānya eva ha | tava śṛṃgāratattvāni vāsudevādayaśca te ||79|| vyūhāḥ santi hare kṛṣṇa nakhādyā īśvareśvarāḥ | tvadabhinnā avatāryapṛthagasiddhaviśeṣaṇāḥ ||2.24.80 || tava mūrtyātmakāḥ sarve nigūḍhā nivasanti te | vayaṃ keśasvarūpāste pṛthagbhūtāstavecchayā ||8 1 || caulasaṃskāramāsādya te’vatārasvarūpiṇaḥ | tata ājñāṃ nivāsāya dehi naḥ kurmahe tathā ||82|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścaivaṃ prabhāṣitaḥ | prārthitaścājñayārthaṃ ca prasannastānnijāntike ||83 || samāhūya ca tilakān bindūn kuṃkumakaisarān | teṣāṃ bhāleṣu kṛtvaiva samuvācākṣareśitā ||84|| yūyaṃ mamāvatārāśca mamaiśvaryabharāḥ śubhāḥ | nibodhata mayā nityamutpādyante’ṇḍarāśayaḥ ||85|| adyotpāditagoleṣu lakṣeṣu caikadeśiṣu | yāta madājñayā tatra bhavata śrīnarāyaṇāḥ ||86|| caturdaśatalāṇḍeṣu tathā yāta caturbhujāḥ | aṣṭāviṃśatibhūgoleṣu tathā yātāṣṭabāhavaḥ ||87|| ṣaṭapañcāśatstarāṇḍeṣu yāta ṣoḍaśabāhavaḥ | śatāṣṭrabhūmikāṇḍeṣu yāta dvātriṃśabāhavaḥ ||88|| śatādibāhavo yāta pañcaśatastarāṇḍake | sahasrabāhavo yāta sahasrabhūmikāṇḍake ||89|| ekaikāṇḍe mayā caikaika evātrādhikriyate | tathā tathā navaṃ nūtnaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ yāta caikaśaḥ ||2.24.90 || paśyata svakaredakṣe yasya yad dṛśyate’ṇḍakam | sa ca tattad viśatveva mama yogapratāpataḥ ||91 || ityuktāste yayurnatvā śrīnārāyaṇamūrtayaḥ | svasvabrahmāṇḍamālokya yāvadāyurviśaśramuḥ ||92|| teṣu gateṣu sarveṣu lomaśaḥ prāha keśavam | mahyaṃ darśaya tānyeva brahmāṇḍāni ca yeṣu te ||93|| śrutvā vihasya ca harirlomaśaṃ netrayostadā | aṃgulyā jalayogenāspṛśad divyo’bhavattadā || 94|| divyanetro dadarśaitānavatārām̐śca golakān | paramāścaryamāpanno mahimānaṃ viveda ha ||95|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya yādṛśaṃ tataḥ | caulākhyasaṃskāravidheḥ parihāraṃ cakāra saḥ ||96|| datvā dānāni bahūni prāsādaṃ harirāyayau | pitā mātā camatkāraṃ dṛṣṭvopāyayaturmudam ||97|| lomaśaḥ kanyakāvṛndasahitaścāśramaṃ yayau | ityevaṃ kathitaṃ rādhe’nādikṛṣṇasya ceṣṭitam || 98|| agamyaṃ sarvathā lokairdivyānugrahavedyakam | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktimuktipradāyakam ||99|| paśuputrapradaṃ dhānyadhanadaṃ pāpanāśakam | kṛṣṇabhaktipradaṃ nārāyaṇapadapradaṃ tathā || 2.24.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrībālakṛṣṇasya prabhoścaulasaṃskāre romasu pāpānāṃ kathānakaṃ hareḥ romṇāṃ tu nārāyaṇarūpatetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 24 ||
<2.25> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rādhe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakathāṃ prapāvanīm | tṛtīyavarṣe sañjātā phālgune pratipattithau || 1 || phālgunasya śuklapakṣe puṣpadolamahotsavam | cakāra kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 2 || vasante tatra samprāpte kiṃśukā jvalanaprabhāḥ | niṣpatrāḥ satataṃ rejuḥ śobhayanto dharātalam || 3 || śiśiraṃ nāma mātaṃgaṃ vidārya nakharairiva | vasantakesarī prāptaḥ palāśakusumaiḥ priye || 4 || kundā hasanti satataṃ kalikādantakaistadā | vanāni karṇikārāṇāṃ puṣpitāni virejire || 5 || raktāśokavanā bhānti puṣpitāḥ sahasojjvalāḥ | bhṛṅgavṛndāḥ piñjaritā rājante gahane vane || 6 || mañjarībhirvirājante nadīkūleṣu vetasāḥ | raktāśokakarā tanvī rādhike kiṃśukāṃghrikā || 7 || nīlāśokakarā śyāmā vikāsikamalānanā | nīlendīvaranetrā ca madhyabilvaphalastanī || 8 || protphullakundadaśanā mañjarīkaraśobhitā | bandhujīvādharā śubhrasinduvāranavāṅkurā || 9 || pum̐skokilasvanā divyā kaṃkolavasanā śubhā | barhivṛndakalāpā ca sārasasvaranūpurā || 2.25.1 0| prāgvaṃśaraśanā ramyo mattahaṃsagatistathā | putrajīvāṃśukāsaṅgaromarājivirājitā || 1 1|| vasantalakṣmīḥ samprāptā cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe | padmāni jalacakṣūm̐ṣi paśyanti premavanti ca || 1 2|| taraṃgā jalahastāścāhvayanti snāyino muhuḥ | jalasya garjanāhāsyaṃ vedayanti pramodanam || 13|| śukāḥ pārśvacarāḥ kṛḍhagāgamaṃ cāvedayanti ca | śītaśīkarapavanāścākarṣayanti mānasam || 14|| jalahaṃsāstārakāḍhyāṃ nimantrayanti dyāmapi | matsyāśca rohiṇāḥ sādhūn smārayanti jalaplutān || 15|| ṭiṭṭibhadhvānamevātra bālān snānābhilāṣukān | karoti rañjayatyapi nṛtyaṃ māyūramuttamam || 16|| kokilāḥ puṣpaśākhāsu kūjanena muhurharim | snānārthaṃ cāhvayantīva prāpte vasantayauvane || 17|| evaṃvidhaṃ prasannaṃ ca vanaṃ vikasitaṃ ca tat | vilokya brāhmaṇāḥ sarve cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe || 18|| sahasraśastadā bālā bālikāśca striyastathā | puṣpadolotsavaṃ kartuṃ yayuścotsukamānasāḥ || 19|| kadambānāṃ ca śākhāsu dolā baddhvā sukhāvahāḥ | āndolayanti bālāṃśca bālikāḥ kanyakādikāḥ || 2.25.20|| kesaraiśca tathā pālāśakaiḥ pītaiśca raktakaiḥ | haritaiḥ kapiśai raṃgairbhṛtvā gargarikādikāḥ ||21|| raṃgaiḥ saṃremire setau narā nāryo vasantake | dhūlīkṣepairjalakṣepai raṃgakṣepairgulālakaiḥ ||22|| kuṃkumai raktacūrṇaiśca remire sarasastaṭe | prātaḥ parasparaṃ dhṛtvā prasahya vinipātya ca ||23|| gargarīraṃgasalilaṃ siñcantyabhīkṣṇamutsukāḥ | saraso mṛttikāṃ puṇyāṃ lepayanti mukhādiṣu ||24|| jaladhārāḥ prasiñcanti śirasyupari yantrakaiḥ | puṣpagucchān karṇayośca dhṛtvā nṛtyanti kecana || 25|| pragāyanti kṛṣṇagītīḥ kāścana modasaṃbhṛtāḥ | anye kadarmitaṃ dehaṃ veṣaṃ prakṣālayanti ca || 26|| vidhunvanti śiraḥkeśān rajodhūlitadhūsarān | pramṛjanti netradhūlīḥ praviśanti sarojale || 27|| taranti naikataraṇaiḥ sambhūya snānti vāriṣu | vastrāṇi raṃgaraktāni kṣālayanti narāḥ striyaḥ || 28|| stabakānāṃ nikuñjeṣu ramante bālabālikāḥ | narā nāryaḥ svayūtheṣu ramante varṣayanti ca || 29|| vādyāni vādayitvā ca vasantaṃ prārcayantyapi | pratimāṃ kānakīṃ kṛtvā pītāmbaravibhūṣitām ||2.25.3 0|| raktapuṣpairañcitāṃ ca sakalgimukuṭānvitām | raśanāmañjīrayutāṃ sakañcukāṃ suśobhanām ||3 1 || kiśorabhāvamāpannāṃ sakaṭākṣāṃ manoharām | puṣparathasthitāṃ saumyāṃ mañjarīkṛtaśekharām |||32|| gucchastabakakarṇāḍhyāṃ sugandhadravacarcitām | keśajūṭalasatskandhāṃ svarṇachatravirājitām ||33|| naddhasūryamaṇiprāntamadhyacandrottarīyakām | hīraratnasumauktikāñcitamukuṭaśobhitām | |34|| puṣpottaṃsāṃ puṣpakaṭiṃ puṣpāvaraṇasaṃbhṛtām | kadambapuṣpamālāḍhyāṃ cāmpakeyalalāṭikām ||35|| karṇikāraprakoṣṭhāṃ ca pālāśabāhuśobhitām | japāpuṣpauṣṭhalalitāmaindīvāraśmaśrūlikām ||36 || citrakusumanetrāntāṃ kundadantavirājitām | tilapuṣpasunāsāḍhyāṃ kādambagaṇḍamaṇḍitām ||37|| kadalīpuṣpabhālāḍhyāṃ kadalīstambhasakthinīm | kālhārajaghanabhrāmāṃ kāmalābhasunābhikām ||38|| hastiśuṇḍhasamajaṅghāṃ padmapādatalānvitām | candrasūkṣmākṛtinakhāṃ pāṇḍurāṃ mandahāsinīm ||39|| mūrtiṃ vasantadevasya pupūjuḥ sarvamānavāḥ | supuṣpaiḥ kuṃkumādyaiśca sasyaśukaiḥ suśigrubhiḥ ||2.25.40|| kuṃkumābilacūrṇaiśca gulālairvimaladyubhiḥ | mañjarībhiḥ raktapatraiḥ phalairvividhakaistathā ||41 || dugdhapākaiḥ sudravaiśca pupūjuḥ śrīvasantakam | ragairbahuvidhaiścāpi saṃsnāpya śrīvasantakam |||42|| vāsantikairambarādyairbhūṣābhiḥ puṣpapaṭṭakaiḥ | puṣpahāraiśca pupūjurvasantaṃ kalikāpatim ||43|| mañjarīpallavānāthaṃ cāṃkurādhipatiṃ prabhum | puṣpādhipaṃ nālikeśaṃ kāṇḍikādhipatim ṛtum ||44|| śādvaleśaṃ sukiśoraṃ pupūjuḥ sarasastaṭe | vasantasya priyāścānyāḥ kokilāṃ haṃsikāṃ tathā ||45|| sārasīṃ sumanāṃ menāṃ māyūrikāṃ ca bhāsikām | śukīṃ ca gāruḍīṃ caiva pupūjuḥ ṣoḍaśapriyāḥ ||46|| sarvā lakṣmīsvarūpāstā vicitraraṃgaśobhanāḥ | kanyakāḥ kāñcanabhāsāścandrakāntibharānanāḥ ||47|| śvetāmbarāḥ piṃgavastrā haritāmbaradhārikāḥ | kapiśāmbarayuktāśca citrāmbaradharāstathā ||48|| kānakābhāmbaradharāḥ kapiśāmbaradhārikāḥ | nīlāmbarāḥ payovastrāḥ karburāmbarādhikāḥ |||49|| kaisarāmbarayuktāśca pāṇḍurāmbadhārikāḥ | yāvacchṛṃgāraśobhāścānarcurvasantayoṣitaḥ ||2.25.50||| candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumākṣatavāribhiḥ | dugdhapākādibhiścāpi tāmbūlakairapūjayan |||51 || atha śrībhagavām̐statrānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | kaiśorarūpamāsthāya cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ||52|| dolāyāṃ śrīvasantākhyaṃ ṣoḍaśāryāyutam ṛtum | saṃsthāpayitvā vividhairupacārairapūjayat ||53 || ārārtrikaṃ ca kṛtavān tatastatra vasantakaḥ | bhāryāṣoḍaśayuktaḥ saḥ pratyakṣo hyabhavattadā || 54 || yathāvarṇitarūpaśca jagād pūjakaṃ prabhum | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ manoharam ||55|| parameśvara pūjāṃ me laukikīṃ rītimāśritaḥ | karoṣi sarvadevādyaiḥ pūjyatvaṃ puruṣottamaḥ ||56|| adyāhaṃ pāvano jātaḥ sastrīkastava sevakaḥ | tvāmarcayitumicchāmi niṣīda tvaṃ varāsane ||57|| ityuktvā śrīvasantaśca sapriyo hi nijāsanāt | avatīrya bhuvi sthitvā svāminaṃ puruṣottamam ||58|| dolāyāṃ prasamāropya pūjayāmāsa bhāvataḥ | ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ sarvabhāryābhiḥ sahitaḥ ṛtuḥ ||59|| ānarca śrīhariṃ tatra kaiśoraṃ rūpamāsthitam | rūpānurūpāvayavaṃ vilokya puruṣottamam ||2.25.60|| mumuhurdivyarūpe te vasantādyā janāstathā | vasantayoṣitaḥ sarvā mugdhā babhūvurīśvare ||6 1|| ṛṣayaḥ ṛṣipatnyaśca mumuhuḥ parameśvare | evaṃ kṣaṇaṃ ca niśceṣṭāḥ stabdhāḥ samabhavan sukhāḥ ||62|| śrīkṛṣṇasya kaṭākṣeṇa hāsyaprasannatābhṛtā | atha kṣaṇānte bubudhurnaijātmānaṃ ca te tadā ||63 || tuṣṭuvuḥ śrīhariṃ kāntaṃ parameśvaramiṣṭadam | tvameva bhagavānāsse sarvalokeśvareśvaraḥ ||64|| sarvaiśvaryayutaḥ sākṣādanādipuruṣottamaḥ | dehi padṃ sadā nātha sevārthaṃ caraṇaṃ tava ||65|| vinā tvāṃ sarvamevāsti niṣphalaṃ sukhavarjitam | ityuktvā ca janā nāryo nipetuścaraṇe hareḥ ||66|| hariḥ prāha tathāstvevaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | tataḥ punaścamatkāraṃ darśayāmāsa keśavaḥ ||67|| vasantadehe naijaṃ cābhivyāptaṃ rūpamaiśvaram | sarvavasantakāntābhirdṛśyate śrīhariḥ svayam ||68|| vasante svāmini nāthe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | tadā mumuhustaṃ dṛṣṭvā kalikādyāḥ patiṃ prabhum ||69|| varayāmāsurevainaṃ kiśoraṃ puruṣottamam | priyāḥ ṣoḍaśa evaitāḥ pupūjustuṣṭuvuḥ punaḥ ||2.25.70|| mālāḥ samarpayāmāsurvidadhuścandrakaṃ tataḥ | ātmārpaṇaṃ harirjñātvā mānaseṣṭaṃ subhāvitam ||71|| tathāstviti hariḥ prāha kiśorarūpadhṛk prabhuḥ | ṣoḍaśakanyakānāṃ śrīprabhuścaivākarottadā ||72|| rūpadvayaṃ tu pratyekaṃ divyaṃ cādivyamityadaḥ | adivyaṃ devatulyaṃ yat ṣoḍaśaṃ rūpameva tat ||73|| vasantāya dadau cātha divyaṃ ṣoḍaśarūpakam | kanyakānāṃ surūpaṃ tat nijapriyāsvarakṣayat ||74|| lomaśāya dadau tatrāśrame kanyāsu koṭiṣu | nivāsārthaṃ tataḥ kṛṣṇo bālarūpo babhūva ca ||75|| raṃgaklinnaṃ hariṃ snāpayituṃ mātā sarastaṭe | yayau tāvanmahādaityo mīnarūpo jalasthitaḥ ||76|| jagrāha bālakaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ triṃśaddhastapramāṇavān | mātātra vihvalā jātā putranāśābhiśaṃkayā ||77|| śrīrādhikovāca ko’sau kṛṣṇa mahāmīno daityarāṭ tatra cāgataḥ | yo’nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhakṣayituṃ sthitaḥ ||78|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca sālamālo mahādaityo hiraṇyakūrcacarmajaḥ | sālemālavane tiṣṭhannāsīllokabhayaṃkaraḥ ||79|| saurāṣṭrapūrvadigbhāge vanyabhakṣyo mahāsuraḥ | saptatālocchrayaścaikatālāyato’driśṛṃgavat ||2.25.80 || gadāmudgaradhārī ca pitṛvairaṃ smarannaṭan | aśvapaṭṭasaromadhye timirūpo’bhavattadā ||8 1 || kāmarūpadharo daityastriṃśaddhastatimiḥ sa vai | pucchena pracakarṣainaṃ bālaṃ snāntaṃ taṭe tadā ||82|| mātṛpārśve ca sopāne sthitaṃ ramyaṃ manoharam | bālo jñātvā kṛpāvārdhirāsuraṃ damanocitam ||83|| hantuṃ samāgataṃ śīghraṃ nayantaṃ ca jale talam | bālakṛṣṇastadā dvedhābhavad bālaśca nakrakaḥ ||84|| bālo bhūtvā drutaṃ sarastaṭe sopānamāsthitaḥ | nakro bhūtvā jalamadhye pañcāśaddhastamānavān ||85|| mahāmatsyaṃ grasituṃ vai śīghraṃ pṛṣṭhe babhūva saḥ | maraṇasya bhayānmatsyo dudrāva jalabhūtalam ||86|| nakro jagrāha taṃ matsyaṃ matsyarūpaṃ vihāya saḥ | sālemālo mahādaityo naro bhūtvā gadākaraḥ ||87|| nakraṃ jaghāna tarasā nakrastāvallayaṃ gataḥ | gadādhārī tu puruṣaḥ saptatālo’pi so’bhavat ||88|| sālemālasya ca nārāyaṇasya samaro mahān | balātibalinostatra gadābhyāṃ samajāyata ||89|| sālena tu harermūrdhni tāḍitā balato gadā | babhaṃja śatakhaṇḍā sā harirvajradṛḍhastadā ||2.25.90|| pratijaghāna taṃ daityaṃ gadayaiva mahāprabhuḥ | vakṣasyeva hataḥ śīghraṃ nipapāta vimūrchitaḥ || 91|| punarutthāya ca naijaṃ mudgaraṃ prāhiṇod balāt | gadayā hariṇā tattu muṣṭidaṇḍe prabhañjitam ||92|| aśastraḥ sālamālo’sau khamutpapāta śṛṃgavat | mudgalāgraṃ samādāya pātayāmāsa ke hareḥ ||93|| bhagavāṃśca svagadayā pothayāmāsa mudgaram | sudarśanaṃ mumocainaṃ nāśayituṃ mahāprabhuḥ || 94|| śatasūryasamaṃ vahnijvālāmālākulaṃ bhramat | śīghraṃ nyapatat śālasya mūrdhni cakarta tacchiraḥ ||95|| hāhākāro’bhavattatra prasannāḥ sarvadevatāḥ | sālemālo mṛtaścāyaṃ krośadehapramāṇavān ||96|| nyapatad bhūtale vṛkṣān nāśayan kampayan mahīm | ātmā tasya hareścakrayogena muktatāṃ gataḥ ||97|| vimānena sudivyena vaikuṇṭhaṃ prāpa sālakaḥ | garuḍastasya dehantu cāśvapaṭṭasarovarāt ||98|| padbhyāṃ dhṛtvā nināyainamatyajad vyomamārgataḥ | yaśodānottaraṃ śaile sālemālāhvaye vane ||99|| tatra ye daityavaryāḥ saṃvartante tasya jātijāḥ | prāpuḥ śokaṃ paraṃ tasya nāryo’pi śatamipyapi || 2.25.10 0|| rurudurvai bhṛśaṃ vyomnaḥ patitaṃ vīkṣya vallabham | aurdhvadaihikamevāsya cakrurjātyanusārataḥ || 10 1|| pañcaśatāni daityānāṃ śataṃ ca tasya yoṣitām | sahasraṃ cāpi putrāṇāṃ sukhaṃ na lebhire śucā || 1 02|| satataṃ cintayāmāsuste sarve vairayāpanam | athātra bhagavān bālo bhūtvāśvapaṭṭasannidhau || 1 03|| puṣpadolotsavaṃ kṛtvā pitṛbhyāṃ gṛhamāyayau | kanyakāḥ śrīlomaśasyāśramaṃ yayustadājñayā || 1 04|| ṛṣayastallalanāśca svasvālayān yayustataḥ | pitā hareḥ kare rakṣāsūtraṃ babandha caurṇakam || 1 05|| evaṃ dolotsave nārāyaṇena paramātmanā | rādhike darśitaścamatkāro daityo niṣūditaḥ || 1 06|| paṭhanācchravaṇādvāpi sarvasaubhāgyamāpnuyāt | naro nārī kanyakā vā bālo yatiryuvāpi vā || 1 07|| prāpnuyāt paramaṃ dhāma śrutvā bhāvena tatkathām | kṛpāsādhyahareḥ rādhe pāravatīśituḥ priye || 1 08|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vasantavikāsaḥ, puṣpadolotsavaḥ timiṃgilarūpasālamālāsurasya harirnāśārthamāgatasya harikṛtanāśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 25 ||
<2.26> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ākarṇaya vṛṣabhānusute camatkṛtiṃ hareḥ | anyāṃ tṛtīyavarṣotthāṃ kathayāmi sukhapradām || 1 || śrāvaṇyāṃ brāhmaṇāḥ sarve kuṃkumavāpikāśrayāḥ | aśvapaṭṭasarastīre brahmasūtrakratūtsave || 2 || militā brahmasūtrasya nava saṃskāraśuddhaye | sahasraśaste ṛṣayo lomaśādyāḥ sadarbhakāḥ || 3 || sapātrā havyakavyādisahitā dehaśodhanam | saṃcakruḥ pañcagavyādyaiḥ snānaiḥ pitṛpratarpaṇam || 4 || devānāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi cakruśca havanādikam | navaṃ yajñopavītaṃ ca dhārayāmāsurujjvalam || 5 || tannimittaṃ mahārudraṃ viṣṇuyajñaṃ ca naityakam | cakrurmahotsavaṃ tīre gītavādyapranartanaiḥ || 6 || lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathopadeśanaiḥ | āndhasikāḥ sarastīre vaṭādhastānmahānase || 7 || cūrṇamauktikalaḍḍukān pūrikāpūpapāyasān | śrīkhaṇḍakvathikāphullavaṭīvyañjanabhājikāḥ || 8 || sūpodanāni ca tathā miṣṭatiktadravāṇi ca | rājikārāddhacaṭanīścāranālāni polikāḥ || 9 || pācayāmāsuratyarthaṃ koṭyarbudadvijārthakam | pakvānnānāṃ parvatāśca ghṛtānāṃ payasāṃ hradā || 2.26.1 0|| takrāṇāṃ saritaścāpi pāyasānāṃ sarāṃsi ca | kṛtāni karitānyeva kalpavṛkṣairmaharṣibhiḥ || 11 || madhyāhne havane tatra pravartite makhānale | tāvad vyomnaḥ samāyātaṃ sainyaṃ daityajanātmakam || 1 2|| krośamātraṃ tu tad dūramabhavad yajñabhūmitaḥ | tāvadākrośanaṃ teṣāṃ śrutvā vai lomaśo muniḥ || 13|| śīghraṃ cālokayāmāsa divyadṛṣṭyā tu dānavān | dānavībhiḥ sahitām̐śca dhṛtaśastrāstrabandhanān || 14|| sālemālasya tu vairaniryātanārthameva tān | samāgatān mahākrūrān yoddhukāmānavasthitān || 15|| eṣaḥ pradeśaḥ śatrornaḥ kṛṣṇasaudho’yameva ca | dvijāgryo lomaśaścāyaṃ ghnantu tānmārayantu ca || 16|| anena bālakṛṣṇena mārito’smatpitā prabhuḥ | mardayantu bālakṛṣṇaṃ tatpitarau ca lomaśam || 17|| eṣa āśramagrāmaśca brāhmaṇānāṃ drumeṣvapi | bhidyatāṃ chidyatāṃ prajvālyatāṃ vināśyatāṃ kṣaṇāt || 18|| sālaputrāḥ sahasraṃ ca bhṛtyā nāryaśca dāsikāḥ | bāndhavāḥ sālamālasya nipetuḥ sarasastaṭe || 19|| anye cākāśamārgeṇa samāpatanti vegataḥ | kanyakā daityapatnyaśca bālā vṛddhāḥ suyauvanāḥ || 2.26.20|| yāvadyajñakṣitiṃ naite cāyātāstāvadeva ca | lomaśaḥ staṃbhayāmāsa tvātharvaṇairvihāyasi ||21 || taṭasthān taṭapārśve ca stambhayāmāsa tatkṣaṇāt | pakvānnāni tathā yajño yathā gacchenna bhraṣṭatām ||22|| tathā vai lomaśaḥ kṛtvā sasmāra śrīpatiṃ prabhum | bālakṛṣṇaḥ kiśoraḥ sannupāyayau kṣaṇāt kratum ||23||| vipraiḥ sammānitaḥ kṛṣṇo’rcitaḥ sudarśanānvitaḥ | prārthitaḥ sagaruḍaśca daityānīkanivāraṇe ||24|| śīghraṃ natvā ṛṣibhyaśca śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ | āruhya garuḍaṃ śīghraṃ vyomamārgaṃ jagāma ha ||25|| sainyasya sannidhau gatvā dadhmau śaṃkhaṃ hariḥ svayam | lomaśaścātharvamantrān vārayāmāsa tāvatā ||26|| sainyaṃ sacetanaṃ yoddhuṃ nyapatat śrīhariṃ prati | gadayā śrīhariḥ sainyaṃ pothayāmāsa sarvataḥ ||27|| pakṣābhyāṃ ca nakhābhyāṃ ca cañcvā ca garuḍastadā | tāḍayāmāsa bahudhā pātayāmāsa bhūtale ||28|| drāvayāmāsa śeṣāṃśca rakṣayāmāsa yoṣitaḥ | atha vidrāvitā daityā dhṛtvā śilā drumām̐stathā ||29|| pratyāvṛttya nijaghnuśca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam | tataḥ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ mumoca bhagavān svayam ||2.26.3 0|| kartayāmāsa tān sarvānasurān sālavaṃśajān | teṣāṃ tejāṃsi ca harau samāgatya viśaśramuḥ ||3 1|| nāryasteṣāṃ kanyakāśca tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram | vaṃśavaṭe sthitāḥ sarvā vavuśca varadānakam ||32|| eteṣāṃ kṛṣṇa daityānāṃ mokṣaṃ kuru tathā ca naḥ | rakṣa rakṣa kṛpāsindho śaraṇaṃ te pradehi naḥ || 33|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīgaruḍasthitaḥ | cakrasya tejasā tāsāṃ pāpānyadāhayattadā ||34|| kāyākalpān vidhāyaiva divyarūpadharāśca tāḥ | śaraṇyo bhagavām̐stābhyaḥ śaraṇaṃ svaṃ dadau mudā ||35 || lomaśasyāśrame sthātuṃ niyuyoja pareśvaraḥ | lomaśastā jalenāpi saṃprokṣyāplāvya vāribhiḥ ||36 || pañcagavyena ca śuddhiṃ kārayitvā tataḥ param | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||37|| datvā mantraṃ ca tulasīsrajaṃ ca tilakādikam | tāḥ sarvā dīkṣayāmāsa vaiṣṇavīḥ pracakāra ha ||38|| tatastā bhojayāmāsa śataṃ pañcaśatāni ca | mātṝśca kanyakāścāpi preṣayāmāsa cāśramam ||3 9|| lomaśādyā ṛṣayaśca kṛtvā kratuvidhiṃ tataḥ | yajñasūtrāṇi sandhṛtvāntimaṃ homaṃ vidhāya ca ||2.26.40 || bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ kanyakāḥ koṭisaṃkhyakāḥ | kuṭumbinastathātithīn bhojayāmāsuraiśvarāḥ ||41 || dadurdānāni ca tathottamāni vividhāni ca | gokṣetrāraṇyaratnāni vastrabhūṣāgṛhāṇi ca ||42|| sopaskarāṇi yānāni vāhanānnajalānyapi | evaṃ dānāni datvaiva yajñakāryaṃ samāpya ca ||43 || vadantaḥ paramāścaryaṃ svasvagṛhaṃ yayurmudā | gopālakṛṣṇakaścāpi bālakṛṣṇayutastataḥ ||44|| nijālayaṃ yayau pakṣī vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayau tataḥ | lomaśādyā yayurnaijāśramān sukhānvitāstadā ||45|| evaṃ vai rādhike sālemālīyā daityapuṃgavāḥ | hatāḥ śrīhariṇā sarve yayurvaikuṇṭhameva te ||46|| tatkanyakā hariṃ vavrurlomaśasyāśramasthitāḥ | tanmātaro daityapatno yāśca vaidhavyamāśritāḥ ||47|| ātmaśreyaḥ papracchustā lomaśaṃ munipuṃgavam | kenātra karmaṇā vidvan śreyaḥ syādubhayatra naḥ ||48|| tadvadātra daityapatnīḥ kṛpayā munipuṅgava | lomaśaśca tadā tābhyastatsutābhyaśca sarvathā |||49|| sadāśreyaskarān dharmānuvācābhyudayapradān | ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ dānaṃ kṣamā damo dayā |||2.26.5 0|| amānitvaṃ ca śaucaṃ ca tapaśca brahmacāritā | śubhā vāk sādhusevā ca paraśreyaḥpradāyakāḥ ||5 1 || trayodaśāṃśo dharmo’yaṃ naranārīprapālitaḥ | aihikaṃ sukhadaṃ śreyo dadāti śāśvataṃ hyapi ||52|| śrīkṛṣṇabhajanaṃ cāgnisevanaṃ snānamityapi | bhikṣādanaṃ guroḥ sevā guroḥ prītyupapādanam ||53 || aihikaṃ sukhadaṃ śreyo dadāti hyapi śāśvatam | gurorgehe vasennityaṃ tatpatnīṃ tatsutādikam ||54|| devānmatvā tathā devīrmatvā saṃpūjayet sadā | śuśrūṣayecca nirmānā sā mṛtyuṃ jayati dhruvam ||55|| ātmabhāvanayā sādhvī pitṛdevātithīnapi | samyaka samprīṇayed bhaktyā sā mṛtyuṃ jayati dhruvam ||56|| sadācāraḥ sadā rakṣyo daityairdevaiśca mānavaiḥ | na cācāravihīnāyā bhadramatra paratra ca ||57|| yajñadānatapāṃsīha sadā bhavanti bhūtaye | sadācāravihīnāyā niṣphalānyeva tānyapi ||58|| durācārā hi vāmāṅgī neha nāmutra nandati | kāryāṃ yatnaḥ sadācāre sa tvabhadrasya nāśakaḥ ||59|| sadācārastaruścāsti nārīdehe hi vartate | sa cāpatyaśarīre’pi hyavātarati saukhyakṛt ||2.26.60 || dharmo mūlaṃ tarostasya hyarthaḥ śākhāḥ susampadaḥ | kāmaḥ puṣpāṇi ramyāṇi mokṣaḥ phalaṃ rasānvitam ||6 1 || so’yaṃ prasevito nāryā bhadrado’tra paratra ca | brāhme muhūrte prathamaṃ budhyedanusmareddharim ||62| devānṛṣīn satīścāpi vadet prabhātamaṃgalam | śaṃkaro vaiṣṇavaśreṣṭhaścoktavān maṃgalaṃ param ||63|| prabhāte yat paṭhanmartyo mucyate pāpabandhanāt | prābhātikaṃ maṃgalaṃ tatkathayāmi nibodhata ||64|| śrutvā smṛtvā paṭhitvā ca sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate | etanmaṃgalaraṭanād bahavo mokṣaṇaṃ gatāḥ ||65|| sarvāvatārajanako’kṣarataḥ paraścānādiścakṛṣṇabhagavān parameśvaraśca | muktāstathāgaṇitasṛṣṭiṣu vartamānāḥ kurvantu mokṣaphalakaṃ mama suprabhātam ||66|| rādhāyuto’gaṇitagopasugopikābhiḥ saṃsevito hṛdayapadmagataśca kṛṣṇaḥ | lakṣmīramāpatirathāsya ca pārṣadādyāḥ kurvantu mokṣaphalakaṃ mama suprabhātam ||67|| śrīvāsudevasahitāḥ parameśvarāśca nārāyaṇā vividhadhāmagatāśca muktāḥ | māṇikyapāravatikākamalāprabhāśca kurvantu mokṣaphalakaṃ mama suprabhātam ||68|| hairaṇyagarbhahariśaṃkarasūryacandrāḥ pṛthvīsutaḥ śaśisuto guruśukradharmāḥ | ārṣāḥ śaniḥ pitara aiśagaṇeśvarāśca kurvantu mokṣaphalakaṃ mama suprabhātam ||69|| raibhyaśca gautamapulastyamarīcayaśca bhṛgvaṅgiraḥpulahalomaśagālavādyāḥ | vāsiṣṭhabhārgavaribhucyavanādikāśca kurvantu mokṣaphalakaṃ mama suprabhātam ||2.26.70|| śrīpārṣadāḥ sanakanandanasatkumārāḥ saujātapiṅgalasanātananāradādyāḥ | indrādayo digadhipāḥ surakoṭayaśca kurvantu mokṣaphalakaṃ mama suprabhātam ||7 1 || saptasvarāḥ kṣititalāśca susūkṣmabhūtāḥ sthūlāśca tattvanikarā girivārdhayaśca | tīrthāni cāpagavarāśca pativratāśca kurvantu mokṣaphalakaṃ mama suprabhātam ||72|| rukmāgado dhruvasuyajñakapuṇḍarīka prahlādasūtaśatasuvratakāmbarīṣāḥ | śrīkṛṣṇavallabhadivodaśukādikāśca kurvantu mokṣaphalakaṃ mama suprabhātam ||73|| itthaṃ prabhāte paramaṃ pavitraṃ śṛṇuyātpaṭhet | smared bhaktyā suprabhātaṃ bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ||74|| hariṃ smṛtvā dehaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā snātvā vidhānataḥ | tarpaṇaṃ ca tathā sandhyāṃ kuryācchrīharipūjanam ||75|| tilakaṃ candrakaṃ kuryād devapūjanamityapi | sūryāya namanaṃ kuryāt praṇamet pitarau patim ||76 || guruṃ natvā satīṃ natvā gāṃ natvā homamācaret | paśyet prātardadhi dūrvāṃ sarpirdhenuṃ savatsikām ||77|| udakuṃbhaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ suvarṇaṃ svastikaṃ madhu | gomayaṃ cākṣatān lājā mṛdaṃ brāhmaṇakanyakāḥ ||78|| śvetapuṣpāṇi sasyāni vahniṃ candanamarkakam | aśvatthaṃ sādhupuruṣaṃ darpaṇaṃ pratimāṃ hareḥ ||79|| atithiṃ pūjayedbhāvāt sādhusaṅgaṃ samācaret | arke’bhyaṅgaṃ na vai kuryānmaṃgale kṣīrameva na ||2.26.80|| budhe na yoṣitaṃ gacchen patiṃ gacchenna parvaṇi | udakchirāḥ svapennaiva pratīcīmastako na ca ||8 1 || devālayaṃ caityataruṃ vidvāṃsaṃ ca catuṣpatham | guruṃ vṛddhaṃ prakuryāttu pradakṣiṇaṃ vṛṣapradam ||82|| anyadhṛtaṃ ca malinaṃ vastraṃ naiva hi dhārayet | snāyānnityaṃ grahādau ca devadānādikaṃ caret ||83|| satsu vasenna tvasatsu puṇyadeśeṣu saṃvaset | baddhavaire vasennaiva dharmahīne jane’pi ca ||84|| abhojyāḥ sūtikāḥ ṣaṇḍo mārjārākhū ca kukkuṭāḥ | patitāpaviddhanagnāścāṇḍālā adhamāśca ye ||85|| brāhmaṇī brāhmaṇaścāpi bhikṣukau vyabhicāriṇau | tāvubhau sūtiketyuktau tayorannaṃ vigarhitam ||86|| na juhotyucite kāle na snāti na dadāti ca | pitṛdevārcanāddhīnaḥ sa ṣaṇḍaḥ parigīyate ||87|| daṃbhārthaṃ japati yaśca tapati paṭhatītyapi | na paratrārthamudyukto mārjāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||88|| vibhave sati naivātti na dadāti na juhoti na | tamāhurākhu tasyānnaṃ bhoktavyaṃ naiva dharmiṇā ||89|| sabhāgatānāṃ yaḥ sabhyaḥ pakṣapātaṃ samāśrayet | tamāhuḥ kukkuṭaṃ tasya jalānnaṃ bahu garhitam ||2.26.90 || svadharmahāḥ paradharmagrāhakaḥ patitaḥ smṛtaḥ | devapitṛgurutyāgī goviprastrīvighātakaḥ ||9 1 || apaviddhastadannaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ pāpadūṣitam | yeṣāṃ kule na vedo’sti na kathā naiva ca vratam ||92|| te nagnāḥ kīrtitāsteṣāmannaṃ saṃskāradūṣitam | āśārttānāmadātā ca dātuśca pratiṣedhakaḥ ||93 || śaraṇāgatasantyaktā sa cāṇḍālo’dhamo janaḥ | teṣāmannaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ doṣabhāganyathā bhavet ||94|| yaccāpi kurvato nātmā jugupsāmeti sarvathā | tatkartavyamaśaṃkena yat syāt kalyāṇadaṃ param ||95|| evamācāravatyāśca satyā gṛhe vane’pi vā | dharmārthakāmamokṣā vai bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||96 || bhūmau śayyā brahmacaryaṃ tapobhiścātmadarśanam | sarvasaṃgaparityāgaḥ śrīkṛṣṇasmaraṇaṃ sadā ||97|| sarvārpaṇaṃ harau kṛṣṇe gurau sarvāntarātmani | yayā kṛtaṃ na lipyeta dehajaiḥ karmabhiḥ kvacit ||98|| bhavatyaḥ sarvathānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim | bālarūpaṃ prasevantām paro mokṣo bhaviṣyati ||99|| atra cātmaniveditvaṃ kṛtaṃ yayā tu yoṣitā | tasyā dhāmni parā muktirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 2.26.10 0|| nidrāyāṃ jāgrati svapne sthūle sūkṣme hṛdantare | rājase tāmase satvabhāve smarantu mādhavam || 101 || ātmanā cendriyairvāpi dehena sevayā harim | antaḥkaraṇaiḥ karmabhiḥ prasādayantu taṃ patim || 1 02|| ityuktāstāśca jagṛhurnāmamantraṃ hi lomaśāt | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā || 1 03|| ityasya raṭaṇaṃ cakrurdivārātramatandritāḥ | śataṃ tā divyatāṃ prāptāḥ satataṃ japakāraṇāt || 1 04|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bālo vimānagaḥ | śatena tu vimānānāṃ sahitaḥ samupāyayau || 1 05|| tāḥ samārohayāmāsa vimānāgryeṣu mādhavaḥ | nināya tāḥ paraṃdhāmākṣarādapyuttaraṃ hi yat || 1 06|| atha yāḥ kanyakāstāstu gṛhītvā lomaśād guroḥ | upadeśaṃ ca taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bālaṃ matvā patiṃ nijam || 1 07|| bhejustatraiva kanyāsu sthitvā sahasraśastadā | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bālakṛṣṇaṃ labhet satī || 1 08|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrāvaṇyāṃ sarasastaṭe yajñasūtrotsave sālamālavaṃśīyadaityānāmāgamanaṃ yuddhaṃ prabhuṇā teṣāṃ nāśo mokṣadharmā lomaśopadiṣṭāścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 26 ||
<2.27> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu vai rādhike devā daityā dānavakoṭayaḥ | mānavāḥ ṛṣayaḥ santo hareḥ putrāḥ samānakāḥ || 1 || nāpriyo na priyaḥ kaścittasya bhavati rādhike | bhaktaḥ priyo na tvabhakto bhaktipriyo hi mādhavaḥ || 2 || ātmano nāsurā devā daityā vā mānavāḥ priye | svabhāvā guṇajā daityā devāsuśca mānavāḥ || 3 || svabhāvāścāgamāpāyāḥ prayojanavaśānugāḥ | prayojanaṃ sukhaṃ tacca dehajātyanusāragam || 4 || deho nārī naraśceti ṣaṇḍhaśceti tridhā mataḥ | bālo yuvā ca vṛddhaśca gṛhī tyāgī vratī vanī || 5 || kriyā dehānukūlā ca vāñcchā dehānusāriṇī | bālye krīḍati vārdhakye śamaṃ yāti yuvā tu na || 6 || nārī narāśrayā sarvā naraḥ svātantryayantritaḥ | brāhmaṇo bhikṣukaḥ kṣattraṃ prasahya balavat sadā || 7 || śvādau sahanatā nityā sarpe sā naiva vidyate | vṛkṣe paropakāraśca vānare svārtha eva ca || 8 || sādhau dayā dhanāḍhye tu garvo raṃke tu namratā | mātari vatsalo bhāvaḥ śatrau nirdayatā sthitā || 9 || caure nirghṛṇatā vidyāvati vicāryakāritā | lajjā yuvatīvarge ca bālāyāṃ doṣahīnatā || 2.27.1 0|| digambaratvaṃ vairāgye sarāge navavastritā | vyomavad vidyate cātmā dehaḥ sandhyā divā niśā || 1 1|| āyānti ca viyantyasya guṇavegāḥ prayojanāt| | tadguṇā māyikī māyā jaḍā karmamayī sadā || 12|| sā na cātmani saṃlagnā nātmā tatra ca janmitaḥ | dvayoḥ panthā vibhinno’sti nityabaddhātimuktayoḥ || 13|| ityevaṃ rādhike jñātvā pumānnaiva vilupyate | ajñāne jāyate rāgo dveṣaścetyubhadūṣaṇe || 14|| rāgādbhavati pravṛttirvāsanāpracurā dṛḍhā | dveṣānnivartate yadvā pravartate’tidāruṇam || 15|| aniṣṭaṃ vahate ceṣṭacchannaṃ cāsurabhāvanam | ta ete daityadehāśca viyanti paramātmanaḥ || 16 || abhiyanti yadā te ca surā bhavanti daivinaḥ | ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ śaucamindriyasaṃyamaḥ || 17|| dānaṃ dayā ca kṣāntiśca brahmacaryamamānitā | śubhā satyā ca madhurā vāṅ nityaṃ sakriyāratiḥ || 18|| sadācāraniṣevitvaṃ dharmā daivatvadāyakāḥ | sukeśyabhūt purā daityo lomaśasyāśramaṃ gataḥ || 1 9|| dharmān papraccha kuśalān śrutvā caitān trayodaśa | lomaśāttu maharṣeḥ sa yayau naijaṃ puraṃ tataḥ ||2.27.20|| samāhūyābravīt sarvān rākṣasān dhārmikaṃ vacaḥ | ahiṃsādyānmahādharmān pālayantu sadāsurāḥ ||21|| so’hamājñāpaye sarvān kriyatāmavikalpitam | tataḥ sukeśivacanāt sarva eva niśācarāḥ ||22|| trayodaśāṃśato dharmaṃ cakrarmuditamānasāḥ | tataḥ pravṛddhiṃ sutarāmagaccham̐ste niśācarāḥ ||23 || prāsādavāṭikākṣetrodyānayānamaharddhayaḥ | putrapautrārthasaṃyuktā hyabhavan sukhasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||24|| niśācarāṇāṃ nagaraṃ tejomayaṃ hyabhūttu khe | yatra sūryasya candrasya tejopekṣā na cābhavat ||25|| tatastu tejasā teṣāṃ rākṣasānāṃ mahātmanām | gantuṃ nāśaknuvan sūryā nakṣatrāṇi ca candramāḥ ||26|| evaṃ dharmaprabhāvo’sti rādhike tejasorjitaḥ | tatastribhuvane dīptaṃ niśācarapuraṃ hyabhūt ||27|| divā sūryasya sadṛśaṃ rātrau candrasamaṃ hyabhūt | yatra sūryasya candrasya tejo’pekṣā na vidyate ||28|| pratyuta tatpureṇaiva pṛthvyāṃ sarvagraheṣu ca | divasaḥ sarvadā cāste tejovaibhavakāraṇāt ||29|| na jñāyate gatirvyomni bhāskarasya tato’mbare | candrasyāpi gatirnaiva jñāyate’nyagatiḥ kutaḥ ||2.27.3 0|| kauśikādyāstu mumuhurvinā rātriṃ niśācarāḥ | gṛhasthā duḥkhamāpannāḥ strīdharmā rātrimantarā ||3 1 || tarkayanti tadā kecinnūnaṃ rātrau suduḥkhitā | patiyogaṃ vinā kāntā satī pativratā sakhī ||32|| paradeśagate kānte viyogaduḥkhitā hi sā | tapasā sūryāstamanaṃ rurodha yāvatā bhavet ||33|| priyasya darśanaṃ yogastāvatāyānna vai niśā | yajvāno homaśālāsu sahartvigbhirathādhvare ||34|| prāvartayanta karmāṇi rātrāvapi ca rādhike | mahābhāgavatāḥ pūjāṃ viṣṇoḥ kurvanti bhaktitaḥ ||35|| raveḥ śaśinaścāpyanye brahmaṇo’nye harasya ca | kurvanti pūjanaṃ matvā divā rātrāvapi prajāḥ ||36|| vivekinastu jānanti vikasitairhi paṅkajaiḥ | sūryasyodayanaṃ candrodaye tu kumudotkacaiḥ ||37||| evaṃ pratāpamāpanne niśācarapure vṛṣaiḥ | sūryastvasahamānastat tadvighātamacintayat || 38| sa bhānunā tadā dṛṣṭaḥ krodhādhmātena cakṣuṣā | sukeśī grāmasahitaḥ prajajvāla tadāmbare ||3 9| sūryaścakraṃ ca sauraṃ svaṃ mumocāsmai drutaṃ ca tat | cakraṃ vai bhedayāmāsa puraṃ niśācarasya tat ||2.27.40| nipapātāmbarād bhraṣṭaṃ keśinā saha rākṣasaiḥ | sukeśī śaṃbhave nama idamuccairudairayat ||41| tadākranditamākarṇya kailāse śaṃkaraḥ prabhuḥ | jñātvā dhyānena sūryeṇa pātitaṃ bhaktapattanam ||42| kruddhastṛtīyanetreṇa sūryaṃ śaṃbhurapaśyata | sūryo vyomnaḥ paribhraṣṭo nipapāta bhuvastalam ||43| yogiśāyinamārabhya yāvatkeśavadarśanam | prayāgāt keśavaṃ yāvat vistṛtaṃ bhūtalaṃ śubham ||44|| etat kṣetraṃ hareḥ puṇyaṃ nāmnā vārāṇasī purī | varaṇāyāstathaivāsyāstvantare nipapāta saḥ ||45||| bhānurdahan kṣaṇaṃ cāsyāṃ lulan hrade tataḥ punaḥ | varaṇāyāṃ ca gaṅgāyāṃ lulan lolārkanāmavān ||46|| abhavaccātha sūryaḥ sa kṣamāṃ harādayācata | haro’pi bhānumādāya pāṇināropayad ratham ||47|| sukeśinaṃ puraṃ cāpyāropayad diviṃ daivavat | evaṃ dharmeṇa balavān jāyate rākṣaso’pi hi ||48|| śaṃbhuryasya sahāyo’bhūt sūryo’vāpa ruṣaḥ phalam | evaṃ vai lomaśo daityakanyābhyastu vṛṣān śubhān ||49|| prāha śreyaskarān tāśca punaḥ papracchurādarāt | kasya pūjā kathaṃ kāryā vada no gururāṭ prabho ||2.27.50|| lomaśastāḥ samuvāca nārāyaṇaḥ śriyāḥ patiḥ | āṣāḍhaikādaśīprātarbhogibhoge svapityataḥ ||51 || śeṣāhibhogaparyaṃkaṃ kṛtvā sampūjya keśavam | prāsvāpayedanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kṣaṇam ||52|| trayodaśyāṃ svapityaiva kāmaḥ svaśayane śubhe | kadambānāṃ sugandhānāṃ kusumaiḥ parikalpite ||53|| tatra tadā suśṛṃgāraiḥ kāmaḥ prītiratiprabhuḥ | pūjanīyo viśeṣeṇa kṛṣṇamūrtau sukhapradaḥ ||54|| caturdaśyāṃ tato yakṣāḥ svapanti sukhaśītale | sauvarṇapaṅkajakṛte sukhāstīrṇopadhānake ||55|| yakṣeśo yakṣayuktaśca maṇibhadrādibhiryutaḥ | pūjanīyo’nnapānādyaistarpaṇīyo viśeṣataḥ |||56|| pūrṇamāsyā svapityumānāthaḥ svacarmasaṃstare | vaiyāghre ca jaṭābhāraṃ samudgrathyānyacarmaṇā ||57|| śaṃbhustatrārcanīyaśca dhattūrasya sumādibhiḥ | tato divākaro rāśiṃ samprayāti tu karkaṭam ||58|| tenāmarāṇāṃ rajanī bhavate dakṣiṇāyanam | brahmā tataḥ pratipadi nīlotpalamaye priye ||59|| talpe svapiti lokānāṃ śubhacintanakāmyayā | viśvakarmā dvitīyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ tu pārvatī ||2.27.60 || vināyakaścaturthyāṃ ca pañcamyāmapi dharmarāṭ | ṣaṣṭyāṃ skandaḥ prasvapiti saptamyāṃ bhagavān raviḥ ||6 1 || kātyāyanī tathāṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ kamalālayā | daśamyāṃ bhujagendrāśca svapanti vāyubhojanāḥ ||62|| ekādaśyāṃ tu kṛṣṇāyāṃ sādhyā devāḥ svapanti ca | tattattithau tatsurāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ prācaret satī ||63|| tena śreyaḥ sarvavidhaṃ tvānuyād vratinī satī | dvitīyāyāṃ prasvapiti viśvakarmā prajāpatiḥ ||64|| tasya mūrtirvidhātavyā yadā lakṣmyā yuto hariḥ | sauvarṇasya vidhātavyaḥ śrīvatsāṃkaścaturbhujaḥ ||65|| paryake taṃ samaṃ lakṣmyā gandhapuṣpādibhiryute | śayyāyāṃ pūjayet kṛṣṇaṃ prakṣipet satphalāni ca ||66|| surabhīṇi nivedyetthaṃ prārthayet śrīyutaṃ harim | aśūnyaśayane nātha yathā tvaṃ rājase śriyā ||67|| tathā cāśūnyaśayanaṃ rakṣa me sarvadāstu ca | lakṣmyā yuktaṃ śayanaṃ te yathā śūnyaṃ kadāpi na ||68|| tathā mamāpi bhagavān gārhasthyaṃ māstu śūnyakam | lakṣmīdharaḥ prasanno’stvityuccārya vratamācaret ||69|| cāturmāsye prabhuñjīta tailakṣāravivarjitam | lakṣmīdharaḥ prīyatāṃ me ityuccārya dvijātaye ||2.27.70|| phalaṃ svarṇaṃ vastraśayyāṃ gāṃ dānaṃ vitared vratī | vratinastena puṇyena gārhasthyaṃ modate sukham ||71 || ravirāṣāḍhamāsādya mithunābhimukho bhavet | tata ārabhya yāvatsa vṛścikastho vibhāti hi ||72|| cāturmāsyaṃ cāntare vai kāle bodhya vratārthinā | surāstato vibudhyante kramaśastatra rādhike ||73|| tulāsthe ca ravau pūrvaṃ hariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prabudhyate | tasya pūjā prakartavyā mahādānārpaṇādibhiḥ ||74|| kāmadevastatra tataḥ prabudhyate tamarcayet | dvitīyāyāṃ suvarṇasya mūrtirlakṣmīdharasya tu ||75|| śayyā cāstaraṇopetā yathāvibhavamātmanaḥ | dātavyaitadvratenātra dampatyorna viyogitā ||76 || atha bhādrapade kṛṣṇāṣṭamī kālāṣṭamī matā | yuktā mṛgaśireṇāsyāṃ liṃge svapiti śaṃkaraḥ |||77|| gomūtreṇa jalenāpi snāyāt saṃsnāpayecchivam | tataḥ sampūjayetpuṣpairdhattūrasya ca candanaiḥ ||78|| dhūpaṃ kesaraniryāsaṃ naivedyaṃ madhusarpiṣī | prīyatāṃ me virūpākṣastviti kuryāttadarthanām ||79|| āśvine snāpayet snāyād gomayenātha pūjanam | paṃkajairdhūpayet sarjaniryāsairmadhumodakān ||2.27.80|| bhojayet prīyatāṃ hiraṇyākṣo me ceti cārthayet | kārtike payasā snānaṃ karavīreṇa cārcanam ||8 1 || dhūpaṃ śrīvāsaniryāsaṃ naivedyaṃ madhupāyasam | prīyatāṃ sthāṇuruccārya deyaṃ rajatadānakam ||82|| mārgaśire dadhisnānaṃ naivedyaṃ madhunaudanam | dhūpaṃ śrīvṛkṣaniryāsaṃ prīyatāṃ śarva ārthayet ||83|| pauṣe snānaṃ tu haviṣāṃ pūjā bilvaistathā phalaiḥ | dhūpo madhukaniryāso naivedyaṃ madhusaktukaiḥ ||84|| prīyatāṃ tryambaka ityabhyarthayenmudrikāṃ dadet | māghe kuśodakasnānaṃ kumudena śivārcanam ||85|| dhūpaḥ kadambaniryāso naivedyaṃ satilaudanam | prīyatāṃ me mahādeva ityabhiprārthayennamaḥ ||86 || evaṃ ṣāṇmāsikaṃ caitadvrataṃ saubhāgyadaṃ sadā | atha ca phālgune pañcagavyasnānaṃ prakārayet ||87|| pūjayet kundakusumairdhūpayeccandanena ca | naivedyaṃ saghṛtaṃ dadyāttāmrapātre guḍaudanam ||88|| prīyatāṃ rudra me procya vastrayugmaṃ pradāpayet | caitre caudumbarajalaiḥ snānaṃ mandārakārcanam ||89|| dhūpaṃ ca guggulakṛtaṃ modakān vinivedayet | mṛgacarmapradānaṃ prīyatāṃ nāgeśvaro mama ||2.27.90|| vaiśākhe gandhakusumaiḥ snānaṃ pūjābhrapuṣpakaiḥ | dhūpaḥ sarjasya niryāso naivedyaṃ saphalaṃ ghṛtam ||9 1|| śālaghnaḥ prīyatāṃ ceti jalakuṃbhapradānakam | jyeṣṭhe snānaṃ cāmalakaiḥ pūjārkakusumaistathā ||92|| dadhisaktūbhojanaṃ ca chatropānatpradānakam | dhūpaṃ tu cāndanaṃ bhaganetraghnaḥ prīyatāṃ mama || 93|| āṣāḍhe śrīphalaiḥ snānamarcanaṃ kānakaiḥ sumaiḥ | dhūpayet| sallikayā ca pūpā naivedyamuttamam ||94|| prīyatāṃ dakṣayajñaghno dānaṃ yavakaṇādikam | śrāvaṇe bhṛṃgarājena snānaṃ śrīdrudalārcanam ||95 || agurudhūpanaṃ naivedyaṃ dadhi modakāstathā | svarṇagovastradānaṃ me gaṃgādharaḥ prasīdatu ||96|| ebhiḥ ṣaḍabhistathā māsaiḥ pūjana vratapuṣṭidam | navamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kuryāt pūrṇe saṃvatsare tataḥ ||97|| dvādaśakṛṣṇapakṣīyāṣṭamyupavāsanaṃ sadā | tata udyāpanaṃ kuryānmaheśvaravaco yathā ||98|| akṣayaṃ labhate saukhyaṃ dampatī puṇyakavratāt | dharmārthakāmamokṣakṛt tattathā na tadanyathā ||99|| padmaṃ prajāpaternābhyā niryātaṃ cāśvine yataḥ | brahmaṇaḥ pūjane padmaṃ deyaṃ prītivivardhanam || 2.27.1 00|| kāmakare kadambaśca yakṣakare vaṭadrumaḥ | dhattūraśca śivahṛdi vedhomadhyāddhi khādiraḥ || 10 1|| viśvakarmamadhyadehāt kaṇṭakī samajāyata | girijāyāḥ karatale kundagulmastvajāyata || 1 02|| gaṇādhipasya kuṃbhastho rājate sinduvārakaḥ | yamasya dakṣiṇe pārśve pālāśo vai vyajāyata || 103 || yamasya dakṣiṇottare jātaḥ kṛṣṇa udumbaraḥ | skandasya bandhujīvaśca raveraśvattha eva ca || 1 04|| kātyāyanyāḥ śamī jātā bilvo lakṣmyāḥ kare’bhavat | nāgamukhe śarastambā dūrvā vāsukipṛṣṭhake || 1 05|| sādhyahṛdi candanaśca vyajāyata ca rādhike | kalpāntarakathā ceyaṃ sṛṣṭyādau samajāyata || 1 06|| taiḥ pūjane tatsurāṇāṃ prītiḥ sarvādhikā bhavet | dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca dīyante taiḥ prasāditaiḥ || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne daityanārīṇāṃ dharmopadeśe sukeśisamākhyānam, aśūnyaśayanavrataśivapuṇyakavratādi, devānāṃ bhinnatithiṣu svāpāḥ, pūjā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 27 ||
<2.28> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca evaṃ vai rādhike daityakanyābhyo lomaśo muniḥ | upādideśa ca vṛṣān vratāni vividhāni ca || 1 | tāśca cakrurvṛṣācārān vratācaraṇamityapi | aśūnyaśayanaṃ cāpi cāturmāsyavratāni ca || 2 || vatsarīyaṃ śivakālāṣṭamīvrataṃ ca puṇyakam | cakruḥ śrīgurusevāṃ ca bhejuḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam || 3 || bhūtvā pāvanadehāśca pāvanātmāna ityapi | vimānaiḥ pārṣadavarairvāhitairdhāma cākṣaram || 4 || gatvā dṛṣṭvā divyarūpāścāyayurlomaśāśramam | prapūjya kanyakāḥ sarvā lomaśaṃ ca guruṃ hareḥ || 5 || jñātvā pūrṇaṃ mahimānaṃ bālakṛṣṇasya śārṅgiṇaḥ | paraṃ kāntaṃ harikṛṣṇaṃ bhejustaṃ patimīśvaram || 6 || evaṃ tu vatsare yāte tṛtīye sumahotsave | caturthavarṣārambhe ca kṛtajanmamahotsave || 7 || pitā subhojayāmāsa koṭiśo dehinastadā | dānāni dāpayāmāsa ratnasauvarṇajāni ca || 8 || tatrābhūdekamāścaryaṃ rādhe śṛṇu vadāmi te | pātālānnāgadehaśca tathā mānavamastakaḥ || 9 || kṛtahastāñjalirnāgastālamāno’tiduḥkhitaḥ | svastikākhyo rudan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasamīpataḥ || 2.28.1 0|| trāhi trāhītyarthayaṃścāyayau kuṭumbaśūnyakaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāste gajāsane || 11 || tatrāgatya ca patitaḥ pādayoḥ śrīharermuhuḥ | uvāca bhagavam̐strāhi māṃ nāgaṃ śaraṇāgatam || 12|| tvāṃ vinā rakṣako me na vidyate bhuvanatraye | śrīhariḥ prāha kiṃ duḥkhaṃ tvāgataṃ te nirūpaya || 13 || nāgaḥ sarveṣu śṛṇvatsūtsave samāgateṣu ca | varṇayāmāsa duḥkhaṃ svaṃ pātāle yuddhajaṃ yathā || 14|| pātāle bhagavannāgā vasanti bahujātayaḥ | śeṣasya jātimanto ye te rājāno bhavanti ca || 15|| vāsukerjātimantaśca mantriṇaste bhavanti ca | takṣakasya ca jātīyā rājamānyā hi nāgarāḥ || 16|| ahaṃ svastikajātīyo brāhmaṇo’smi gurukriyaḥ | dhṛtarāṣṭrāḥ kṣatriyāste karkoṭakā bhaṭakriyāḥ || 17|| kuhakasya tu jātīyā vyāpāriṇo bhavanti ca | suṣeṇasya tu jātīyāḥ śākādikṛṣikāriṇaḥ || 18|| hāritā vanavāsāścāraṇyarakṣākarā hi te | kārburakāḥ sadā dāsyaṃ kurvanti rājamaṇḍale || 1 9|| kṛṣṇajātīyanāgāśca sainyādhipatyabhoginaḥ | puṇḍīkāstathā nāgā bhavanti vāṭikākarāḥ ||2.28.20|| ambarīṣāḥ sūtakāryakarā vāhanarakṣiṇaḥ | godhūmīyāśca te nāgāścāraṇā vaṃśabodhakāḥ ||21|| bhadrajātīyanāgāśca paṇḍitā brāhmaṇā ime | vācayanti kathākāṇḍān bālānadhyāpayanti ca ||22|| kumudā bhogino dāsā bhavanti pāravaśyagāḥ | piśaṃgāḥ sūdakarmāṇo bhṛtyā bhavanti sarvathā ||23|| keśīyā nāṭyakuśalāḥ śailūṣā nṛtyakāriṇaḥ | āmṛtikā gītikārā ḍāṃḍikā vṛddhasammatāḥ ||24|| bhūphālāstu samudyānakarāḥ śukāḥ kathārthinaḥ | kapardajātīyakāste grāmaśuddhikarāḥ sadāḥ ||25|| evamanye bahusaṃjñā bhavanti tatra vāsinaḥ | teṣāṃ rājā vartate’dya nāmnā kāraṇḍavo mahān ||26|| mantrī tasya sumadhvākhyo vidyate sarpamaṇḍale | mānyaḥ pūjyo buddhimāṃśca mahābalaparākramaḥ || 2 7|| anyāyī svārthamātre’pi parārthakṛddhi vartate | prajānāṃ hitakartāsti śaraṇāgatamānakṛt ||28 || ataḥ prajāstu ta samyaṅmānayanti yathā nṛpam | rājā mahotsavaṃ tatra hāṭakeśvaraśūlinaḥ ||29|| karoti śrāvaṇe māsi bilvādibhiḥ prapūjanam | dānaṃ ca dakṣiṇāyuktaṃ dadāti dvijatṛptaye || 2.28.3 0|| asmin varṣe sumadhunā mantriṇā tannṛpasya vai | āhūtā brāhmaṇāstatra śatarudrīyajāpane || 31 || sahasraśo’bhavam̐statra jāpakāḥ pāṭhakāstathā | pūjakā homakartārastatrāhaṃ jāpako’bhavam ||32|| mama putrāḥ śataṃ santi kanyakā viṃśatistathā | te ca tatra pāṭhakāścābhavan mantrikṛpāvaśāt ||33 || kanyakā brāhmaṇaputryaścāyānti yānti nityaśaḥ | hāṭakeśasya pūjārthaṃ darśanārthaṃ viyanti ca || 34|| mama viṃśatikanyāśca surūpāḥ prāptayauvanāḥ | ekagarbhaprasūtāśca sarvā urvaśīrūpitāḥ || 35|| vilokitāḥ sumadhunā sarvāvayavaśobhanāḥ | rūpe campakavarṇābhāḥ śrītulyādīrghalocanāḥ ||36|| piṃganetrāśca śirasaḥ paritaḥ kāntimaṇḍalāḥ | pāradṛśyācchadehāśca tejomaṇinakhānvitāḥ || 37|| kāmarūpadharāḥ sarvāstanumadhyāḥ sukeśikāḥ | vahnivastradharā miṣṭakaṇṭhā mādhuryasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||38|| sugandhapūrṇadehāśca pavitrā dvijakanyakāḥ | padminīlakṣaṇāḥ sarvā vilokya sumadhuśca mām || 39|| provācāhūya nilayaṃ dehi viṃśatikanyakāḥ | mama yogyā rājayogyā bhavantyetāḥ pradehi me ||2.28.40|| mayā vicārya tu tadā prokto mantrivaraḥ prabho | kanyakā me yadīccheyurdāsyāmyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||41 || tāsāṃ mānasamiṣṭaṃ yat kartavyaṃ tanmayā sadā | tataḥ pṛṣṭā mayā sarvāstanmātrā cāpi bodhitāḥ ||42|| varayogyā bhavatyo vai vadantvicchanti kaṃ varam | tāḥ prāhurvai śrutaṃ tāta mātarmānavabhūtale ||43 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvapatiḥ prabhuḥ | vartate śrīkambharāyā gṛhe gopālabālakaḥ ||44|| rūparūpānuvayavaścātikāntamanoharaḥ | śrutaṃ cāsmābhiratraiva sakhībhya sarvathā hi saḥ ||45|| varayogyo’si bhagavān śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | anyā api ca nāgānāṃ kanyakāstaṃ pareśvaram ||46|| vivāhena patiṃ kartuṃ samicchanti sahasraśaḥ | tato vayaṃ śeṣapatiṃ śrīpatiṃ śrīdharaṃ vinā ||47|| nānyaṃ varitumicchāmo yadi naḥ śreya icchasi | ityuktaḥ kanyakābhiśca svastiko’haṃ ca tatpitā || 48||| mantriṇe coktavān kanyābhiprāyaṃ mantrirāṭ tataḥ | kruddhāha māṃ pituḥ kanyāstvadhīnā na svatantrikāḥ ||49|| tvaṃ dehi me vadāmyevaṃ sarvasaukhyamavāpsyase | no ced duḥkhaṃ bhavette’tra sarvasvaṃ te hṛtaṃ bhavet ||2.28.50 || yadvā rākṣasavidhinā hariṣye tava kanyakāḥ | tato namratayā kanyāścānusarantu māṃ tava ||51 || vada tā yadi necchanti śvo hariṣye śubhe dine | ityuktavānahaṃ paścāt punastā mama kanyakāḥ || 52|| akathayaṃ ca tatsarva tathāpi tā na menire | tato’haṃ gatavān bhūpaṃ pratyanivedayaṃ ca tat ||53 || bhūpo’pi tatpakṣapātītallābhaṃ prajagāda me | dehi tvaṃ kanyakāstasmai mantriṇe prasukhī bhava ||54|| mama śrutaṃ na vai rājñā me’numodanamāhitam | mayā śrutvā punaḥ sarvaṃ kanyakābhyo niveditam ||55|| tāḥ prāhuḥ sapratijñaṃ vai varayāmo hariṃ prabhum | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bālasvarūpiṇam ||56|| anyathā maraṇaṃ tāta cāśrayāmastathaiva tat | mayā niveditaṃ tattu jñātivargāya sarvathā ||57|| jñātijanaiścāpi tathā dehīti cānumoditam | na rājñā tajjanenāpi virodhaḥ śreyasāṃ padam ||58|| tasmād deyā mantriṇe vai kanyakā vighnanāśanam | athāhaṃ prāvadaṃ sarvaṃ mama patnyai tadā tu sā ||5 9 || provāca māṃ na vai deyā mantriṇe kuṣṭhine tvayā | yad bhavet tad bhavatveva na deyāḥ kuṣṭhine pate ||2.28.6 0 || mayoktaṃ sa kathaṃ kuṣṭhī jñāyate tu tvayā priye | priyā provāca māṃ dāsī tasya nāmnā karaṇṭikā ||6 1 || sumadhoḥ sevikā bhṛtyā tasya sevāṃ karoti yā | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ snānaṃ tailamardanakādikam ||62|| karoti nityaśo mantrivaryaṃ paśyati sā rahaḥ | taccharīre guptabhāge vartante raktakuṣṭhakāḥ ||63 || rogavārtāpralāpe sā mantrikuṣṭhānavarṇayat | tato na kanyakā deyāstasmai vai kuṣṭhimantriṇe ||64|| ityuktvā virarāmeyaṃ bhāvikaṣṭaśucaṃ gatā | svastiko’haṃ śokamāpto vaiparītyaṃ bhaviṣyati ||65|| sahitavyaṃ ca tatkaṣṭaṃ daivāccet samupāgatam | daivaṃ tu bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||66|| yasmāccāyaṃ hāṭakeśaḥ samutpannaḥ sa cāvatu | evaṃ vicārya cāhaṃ vai dakṣiṇāṃ pratigṛhya ca ||67|| gṛhaṃ gato’pi nidrāṃ na lebhe na strīrna kanyakāḥ | prātarjātaṃ tadā mantribhaṭāstatra samāgatāḥ ||68|| viṃśatikanyakāḥ sarvā mantriṇā vāñchitā yataḥ | ārohantu rathān divyān udvāhārthaṃ hi mantriṇā ||69|| ityevaṃ rājavacasā mantrivākyena vai vayam | rājabhaṭāḥ kathayāmo’nyathā neṣyāma āgrahāt ||2.28.70|| kanyāḥ pitā ca mātā ca putrā dīnajanā yataḥ | ruruduśca punaryoddhuṃ kṛtādarāstadābhavan ||7 1 || praharaṃ tatra yuddhena bhaṭaiḥ sarvairdhṛtā vayam | pāśitāḥ kanyakāḥ putrā nītvā kārāgrahe dhṛtāḥ ||72|| mocito’haṃ mama patnyā sahito bhādramāsi vai | kanyā necchanti varituṃ kārāgrahe vasanti tāḥ ||73|| trāhi vai bhagavan patnyā preṣito’tra samāgataḥ | tvadarthaṃ kṛtajīvāstāḥ samuddhāraya keśava ||74|| ityukto bālakṛṣṇastaṃ cābhayaṃ pradadau hasan | prasasmāra ca garuḍaṃ bhayānakasudarśanam ||75|| tāvubhau drāk samāyātau koṭisūryasamakramau | ājñāpitau yayatuśca nītvā svastikameva tam ||76|| pātālaṃ yatra te sarpāḥ kṛtarājyā vasanti ca | garuḍaḥ prāha rājānaṃ nyāyaṃ karotu sarparāṭ ||77|| prasahya kanyāharaṇaṃ mantriṇā dharmaviplavaḥ | kṛto rājan viprakanyāḥ prayaccha svastikāya vai ||78|| sāmnā sarvaṃ prakartavyaṃ vairaṃ durantameva yat | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena bhūtalādiha ||79|| preṣitaścāgato’smyatra garuḍaḥ sarpabhakṣakaḥ | nārāyaṇena me dattaṃ prāyudhaṃ vai sudarśanam ||2.28.80|| yadi no muñcasi kanyā yuddhaṃ kuru mayā saha | ityevaṃ bodhito rājā kāraṇḍavo ruṣā jvalan ||8 1 || mantriṇaṃ ca samāhūya yuddhārthaṃ tatparo’bhavat | śeṣā vāsukayaścāpi takṣakāḥ kuhakāstathā ||82|| dhṛtarāṣṭrāḥ suṣeṇāśca hāritāḥ karburādikaḥ | kṛṣṇāśca puṇḍarīkāścāmbarīṣā bhadrakāstathā ||83 || kumudāśca piśaṃgāśca keśīyāścāmṛtāstathā | śailūṣāśca kapardāśca bhūphālā ḍāṇḍikāḥ śukāḥ ||84|| ete’nye nṛpatervākyāt sainyānyādāya saṃgaram | kartuṃ samāyayuḥ sarve mṛdhe śastrāstrahetibhiḥ ||85|| jñātvā tu pakṣiṇaṃ svalpaṃ cakraṃ svalpabalaṃ tadā | kintu śrīgaruḍastatra sasmāra parameśvaram ||86|| rūpaṃ dadhāra vipulaṃ digantavyāptimattadā | pakṣābhyāṃ sarvapātālaṃ cacchāda picchakairatha ||87|| dehenāpūrayad vyoma padbhyāṃ pātālakaṃ talam | cañcvā nakhābhyāṃ pakṣaiśca saṃhāramakarottadā ||88 || yuddhārambhaṃ prakartṝṇāṃ nāgānāṃ hetighātinām | cañcvā rājā dhṛtastūrṇaṃ bhakṣito mantriṇā saha ||89|| sainyāni ghātitānyasya tīkṣṇatuṇḍena pakṣiṇā | tīkṣṇanakhaistathā pakṣairghātitānyapi lakṣaśaḥ ||2.28.90|| anye pradudruvuḥ pāre kṣīrodasya taṭasya vai | śeṣaṃ nivedayāmāsuranantasaṃjñakaṃ mṛdham ||91|| śeṣastatra samāyāto dṛṣṭavān garuḍaṃ tathā | sudarśanaṃ vilokyeva neme paramabhāvataḥ ||92|| sarpānnivārayāmāsa yoddhṝn tathāpi te yadā | na nyavartanta vai cakraṃ mumoca garuḍo mṛdhe ||93|| prajajvāla ca pātālaṃ sarvasarpakulānyapi | hāhākāro mahānāsīt sammardo’bhūnmahām̐stadā ||94|| śeṣastuṣṭāva taccakraṃ garuḍaṃ cātibhāvataḥ | garuḍena kṛtaṃ śāntaṃ cakraṃ śeṣasya tuṣṭaye || 15|| samarpyānantaśeṣāya pātālarājyamityapi | svastike tanmantripadaṃ sannyasya garuḍastataḥ ||96|| svastikasya sutān putrīrmocayāmāsa bandhanāt | śeṣasvastikagaruḍāścakraṃ sasmarurīśvaram || 97|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bālasvarūpiṇam | tāvat kiśorarūpo’yaṃ bhūtvā śrībhagavān hariḥ ||98|| brāhmaṃ gajaṃ samāruhya pātāle cājagāma ha | svāgataṃ kṛtavantaste bhaktāḥ kṛṣṇasya vai tataḥ ||99|| hariṇā tilakaṃ tatrānantaśeṣakapālake | kṛtaṃ pātālarājyābhiṣecanaṃ tasya sarvathā || 2.28.1 00|| mantriṇā svastikenāpi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya vai | arpitāḥ kanyakāḥ svasya mudā viṃśatisaṃkhyikāḥ || 10 1|| cakraṃ ca garuḍaṃ nītvā gajasthāḥ kanyakāstadā | nītvā śrībhagavān śīghraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram || 1 02|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ yogataḥ prasamāyayau | snāpayitvā kanyakāstu cāśvapaṭṭasarovare || 103 || lomaśasyāśrame sthātuṃ samādideśa taṃ munim | tābhyo mantrān dadau mālā lomaśaścāśrame tathā 1 04|| rarakṣa garuḍaścājñāmāpya vaikuṇṭhakaṃ yayau | cakraṃ śāntaṃ harerhaste kanyāstasthustathāśrame || 1 09|| evaṃ śrībhagavām̐ścakre camatkāraṃ hi rādhike | caturthavatsarārambhe divyasadguṇaśevadhiḥ || 1 06| atha pātālake tatra śeṣapatnī sunandinī | bālakṛṣṇaṃ prasasmāra kārtike darśanāya vai || 1 07|| śrīharistanmano jñātvā yayau kiśorarūpavān | tayā sampūjitaścāyaṃ dadau tasyai manuṃ nijam || 1 08|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | mālāṃ ca tilakaṃ prādād bhaktābhajaddhariṃ tu sā || 1 09|| mṛtānāṃ bhogināṃ kanyāḥ sahasrāṇi daśābhavan | tābhyo manuḥ sunandinīṃ dadau mālādikaṃ dadau || 2.28.11 0|| tāḥ sarvā vaiṣṇavīśreṣṭhatamā jātā hareḥ priyāḥ | śrīhariṇā samaṃ sarvāścāyayurbhūtalaṃ śubhāḥ || 111 anantenārpitā vyomayānasthāḥ sopadā hi tāḥ | lomaśasyāśrame tāśca rakṣitāḥ paramātmanā || 1 12|| dhanyāstā yoṣito rādhe yāḥ kṛṣṇāya prakalpitāḥ | parabrahma svayaṃ yāsu ramiṣyate sumuktikṛt || 1 13|| sarvasvaṃ yatra vai deyaṃ dātavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate | avāptavyaṃ ca yat proktaṃ tena ced yadi gṛhyate || 1 14|| ko lābho’smātparo loke tanvā prīṇāti ceddhariḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsyānandaprado bhavetprabhuḥ || 1 15|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhoścaturthavarṣārambhotsave pātālanāgasya svastikasya garuḍadvārā pātālarājamantriṇaḥ sumṛdhoḥ sakāśādāgatakaṣṭamokṣaṇam, nāgakanyānāṃ lomaśāśramānayanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 28 ||
<2.29> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike varṣe caturthe māghamāsi ca | niyamaṃ jagṛhurmāghasnānasyāśvasarojale || 1 || brāhmaṇā ṛṣayaḥ kanyāstathānye tatra vāsinaḥ | brāhmamuhūrtamārabhya janāḥ snānti sarovare || 2 || nityaṃ jale nimajjanti pañcaṣo bālabālikāḥ | akasmātte na dṛśyante snānakṛdbhirjalasthitaiḥ || 3 || janairapīti tīrasthairvīkṣyate naiva kāraṇam | kalpayanti janāstatra makarāḥ santi ghātakāḥ || 4 || anye vadanti ca grāhā vidyante’tra samāgatāḥ | pare tu tarkayantyevaṃ piśācāḥ santi vāsinaḥ || 5 || rākṣasā bhakṣayantyetān bālān ghātakinaḥ khalu | kimidaṃ kāraṇaṃ tattu pratyakṣaṃ jñāyate nahi || 6 || ākrośo’bhūttadā deśe saurāṣṭre sarvatodiśi | aśvapaṭṭasarovāri jīvān grasati pañcaṣaṭ || 7 || snānaṃ tatra na kartavyaṃ mriyante bālakā yataḥ | kenacidvai jale bālā hriyante’śvasarovare || 8 || śrīrādhikovāca ko’yaṃ bālaprahartā vai jale tatrābhavattadā | vada me kāraṇaṃ tasya bālānāmabhavacca kim || 9 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tad rādhike sarvaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ | paścime āraktadeśe rājābhūt śāvadīnakaḥ || 2.29.10 || śave dehe bhavaścātmā śāvastatraiva dīnavat | vartate jñānavṛttyeti śāvadīnābhidhānavān || 11 || tasya bhāryāśataṃ cāsīt kintu putro na cābhavat | putryastasya sahasraṃ vai vidyante putra eva na || 12|| tataḥ śokaṃ gato rājā papraccha svaguruṃ yatim | kathaṃ putraḥ prajāyeta kāraṇaṃ me vadātra nu || 13 || yatidīno gurustasyovāca dhyātvā kṣaṇaṃ ca tam | ṛṇānubandhanātputro jāyate ṛṇakāmyayā || 14|| anirvṛtte ṛṇe mṛtyuryasya loke prajāyate | ṛṇaṃ dātuṃ gṛhe tasya putro vṛṣo’śva eva vā || 15|| uṣṭro’jaḥ khara evāsau jāyate karmabandhanāt | adhamarṇagṛhe yadvā uttamarṇaḥ suto bhavet || 16|| pūrvaṃ dattaṃ dhanaṃ nītvā mṛtyuṃ gacchati nirṛṇaḥ | rājam̐stvaṃ kasyacinnāsse hyadhamarṇaḥ purā bhave || 17|| tena ko’pi tava nāsīduttamarṇo dhanapradaḥ | tadṛṇaṃ te ca naivāsti kaste suto’tra saṃbhavet || 18|| ānṛṇyaṃ sarvathā śreṣṭhaṃ ceṣṭaṃ muktipradaṃ bhavet | tathāpi cettavecchāsti putrārthaṃ kuru pūjanam || 19|| śāvadīnā mahākālī pūjitā balidānataḥ | putraṃ te dāsyati sārvabhaumaṃ ciraprajīvinam ||2.29.2 0|| śāvadīnāmahākālyai bālasya balidānataḥ | bālalābho bhavettatra baliḥ śreṣṭha udāhṛtaḥ || 21 || pañcamād vatsarānnyūno bālaścecchubhalakṣaṇaḥ | dīyeta yadi śāvinyai tadā sāpi dahet sutam ||22|| rājā prāha kathaṃ kīdṛglakṣaṇo bālako’rpyate | vad tallakṣaṇaṃ yena sārvabhaumo bhavet sutaḥ ||23|| yatidīno’vadattaṃ ca śṛṇu rājan vadāmi tat | yasya haste matsyarekhā dhanuṣyaṃ jyāśarānvitam ||24|| dhvajaḥ śūlaṃ svastikaṃ ca cakraṃ yavo bhavecca vā | yasya pāde trigulphāni ca vā prāsādalekhanam ||25|| yallalāṭe tvekarekhā kaṇṭhe śyāmatilaśca vā | yadrūpaṃ campakābhaṃ ca netraprānte dalāyate |||26 || yajjaghane puttalī ca rekhārūpā virājate | yadvā vāme sakthini yat pāṇḍuraṃ kamalaṃ bhavet ||27|| sa bālo vai mahākālyai deyo baliṃvidhānataḥ | tena te bhavitā putraścakravartīmahānṛpaḥ || 28|| yatidīnāttathā śrutvā śāvadīno nareśvaraḥ | tādṛgbālānveṣaṇārthaṃ siddhayatīn yuyoja ha ||29|| vyomagāḥ siddhayatayo hastarekhāparīkṣakāḥ | nīlāmbaradharā urvyāṃ vicerurbālalabdhaye ||2.29.3 0|| paśyanti bālarekhāste tathā jyotirgrahādikān | sarvakhaṇḍeṣu yatayaścaranti sma tadā priye ||3 1|| tatraikaḥ kāsadīnākhyaḥ saurāṣṭraṃ tvāyayau tadā | aśvapaṭṭasarastīraṃ cāyayau lomaśāśramam ||32| uktalakṣaṇabālaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāhvayam | śrutavān lomaśāt so’pi kambharānandanaṃ tadā ||33 || vīkṣya lakṣaṇasampannaṃ sarvarekhānvitaṃ śubham | yayau vyomnā drutam āraktadeśe nṛpatiṃ prati ||34|| uvāca vidyate deśe saurāṣṭre bālakastathā | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre gopālakṛṣṇaputrakaḥ || 35|| śrutvā sveṣṭaṃ tadā rājā yataye grāmapañcakam | dadau cātha yatīn pañca tvindrajālavidastadā ||36|| preṣayāmāsa saurāṣṭraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram | māghe snānaparā lokā yatra snānti jale śubhe ||37|| tatra te yatayo nityamacakṣurgocarāstaṭe | bhramanti sma ca tadbālaṃ hartuṃ yatnapuraḥsarāḥ ||38|| pañcaṣaḍ bālakān nityaṃ jale’ntarbhāvayanti te | nayanti tān drutaṃ cāraktadeśaṃ bhūmipālaye ||39|| jīvatastān prarakṣanti rājabhṛtyāḥ sukhapradāḥ | yatayo’śvapaṭṭataṭe kurvantyevaṃ divāniśam ||2.29.40|| rekhānvitasya bālasya lābhārthaṃ cāvido hi te | rekhānabhijñāste sarve haranti bahubālakān ||41 || yatidīnastu rekhāṇāṃ vīkṣaṇaṃ prakaroti hi | dṛśyate naiva rekhā sā tāvannaiva vimuñcati ||42|| hriyante bālakāstatra hāhākāro hi vartate | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ snāti gṛhāntare ||43|| yatīnāṃ karago nābhūdaśṛṇod bālanāśanam | tato’sau bhagavān mātrā samaṃ prasahya vai gṛhāt ||44|| vinirgatya yayau tvaśvapaṭṭasaro’vagāhitum | mātā snāti taṭe bālo vartate sannidhau yadā ||45|| taṃ jighṛkṣuryatistatrādṛśyaḥ śīghramupāyayau | jalamānavarūpo’sau bhūtvā jagrāha bālakam ||46|| rūpadvayadharo bālastasya hastagato’bhavat | dvitīyena svarūpeṇa ramate mātṛsannidhau ||47|| mām̐ mām̐ māī paśya ammām̐ jalamānuṣamulbaṇam | bālakaṃ pratigṛhṇantaṃ māṃ paśyantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ||48|| aparaṃ bālakaṃ nītvā yāntaṃ jalatalaṃ ca mām̐ | paśya paśya sabālaṃ taṃ jale viśantamāyatam ||49|| tritālamānaṃ candrābhaṃ piśaṃgakeśamastakam | siṃhacakṣuḥsamabhrājaccakṣuḥpiśaṃgatārakam ||2.29.50|| rajjuvaddīrghikāḥ sarvāṃgulayo bhujayordvayoḥ | śākhāvallambamānau ca bhujau pīnau ca śuṇḍhavat ||51|| mukhaṃ vānaratulyaṃ ca raktaśmaśrusamanvitam | daṃṣṭrācatuṣṭayaṃ pārśve dṛśyate barhirulbaṇam ||52|| śṛṃgaṃ cāṃkuśavattasya kapālordhve ca vidyate | skandhe pucchadvayaṃ pucchadvayaṃ tasya nitambayoḥ ||53 || rajjucatuṣṭayatulya vidyate’sya sudīrghakam | hṛdye pṛṣṭhake cāsya dīrgharogāḍhyatāsti ca |||54|| hastapādāṃgulimadhye jālacarmāṇi santyapi | nābhau cāsya pataṃgo’sti dīpavadvai prakāśate ||55|| sajālapādāṅgulikā dīrghā vidyanta eva ca | udare koṣṭalī cāste bālaśālāsamāsya tu ||56 || pādau kurutaḥ karayoḥ karau kāryaṃ ca pādayoḥ | astanaścāpyakarṇaśca vahniromā bhayapradaḥ ||57|| ciṃciṃhuk ciṃciṃśabdaṃ kurvan jalatale gataḥ | paśyainaṃ bālakānatra harantaṃ daityasannibham ||58|| paśyantu ca janāḥ sarve mārayantu ca taṃ yataḥ | ghātinaṃ hiṃsakaṃ śīghraṃ nāśayet sarvayatnakaiḥ ||59|| ityuktvā taddhastagato harirviniryayau jalāt | darśakāśca janāstatra narā nāryaśca saṃhatāḥ ||2.29.6 0| abhavan trāsamāpannāḥ śuśucurbahubālakān | hṛtān bālāṃśca saṃsmṛtya hananopāyamācaran ||6 1 | śataghnī rakṣitā tīre kṛtrimābālaputtalāḥ | netuṃ tān puttalām̐ścāyād yadā tīre jale’pi ca ||6 2||| śataghnyā nāśayitavya ityevaṃ nirṇayaṃ vyadhuḥ | athāyaṃ vāyurūpeṇa jhaṃjhāvāte vidhāya ca ||63|| siddhadīno’haradvegāt śataghnīṃ puttalīstathā | trastāśca divase lokāḥ svasvagṛhamupāyayuḥ ||64|| puttallyaśca śataghnī ca sarvaṃ naṣṭaṃ tadābhavat | āścaryaṃ hi janāḥ prāptā lomaśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ||65|| jalamānavanāśārthaṃ ki kāryamṛṣisattama | bālān harati duṣṭātmā saṃhāro’yaṃ bhayaṃkaraḥ ||66 || śrutvā vai lomaśaḥ prāha saṃvicārya kṣaṇaṃ hṛdi | ete cāraktadeśīyāḥ yatayaḥ pañca santi te ||67|| indrajālamahāvidyā bahurūpadharāstathā | mlecchā mlecchakriyā mlecchanṛpājñayātra cāgatāḥ ||68|| āsurāḥ kārmaṇakāśca hiṃsakā nirdayāstathā | teṣāṃ vināśanaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ svayameva kariṣyati ||69|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jānāti tadvidhām | āsurāṇāṃ vināśārthaṃ prākaṭyaṃ śrīhareryataḥ ||2.29.70|| rākṣasānāmauṣadhaṃ ca svayameva kariṣyati | evamuktvā lomaśo’tra sasmāra bālakṛṣṇakam ||71 || harirhasan samāyācca prabhuḥ kaiśorarūpadhṛk | garuḍasthaḥ sacakraśca provāca lomaśādikān || 72|| kathaṃ saṃsmṛtavānasmi vadantu śīghrameva me | lomaśādyāstadā natvā prāhurbālādyupadravam ||73 || jalamānuṣarūpeṇa rākṣasānāṃ saraḥsthitim | śrutvā sarvaṃ hariḥ prāha matsyaśūladhanurdharam ||74|| sadhvajaṃ bālakaṃ te ca mārgayanti jale sthitāḥ | madarthaṃ te yatante ca śāvadīnāprapūjane ||75|| arpaṇīyo bālakaḥ samatsyaśūladhanurdhvajaḥ | balidānena rājā ca sutaṃ vai tādṛśaṃ labhet ||76|| ahaṃ hastagatasteṣāṃ nābhavaṃ cāta eva te | vyāpārayanti bālānāṃ haraṇe śikṣayāmi tān ||77|| ityuktvā bhagavān bālo yayāvaśvasarastaṭam | tāvat sa dhṛtavān kṛṣṇaṃ jalamānuṣarūpadhṛk ||78|| sahasreṣu ca lokeṣu paśyatsveva hi rādhike | atha hāhākṛtaṃ sarvaṃ cāsīt tatra sarastaṭe ||79|| harirjale sacakraśca praviṣṭo divyarūpavān | asureṇa dhṛtastena yuyudhe ca jalāntare ||2.29.80 || cakreṇa bhagavām̐stasya rajjubandhacatuṣṭayam | chedayitvā śiraḥśṛṃgaṃ hastapādaprakoṣṭhakān ||81 || tālatrayasamaḥ kṛṣṇaścābaddhya taṃ ca rajjubhiḥ | ānayāmāsa ca bahirjalājjīvantameva ca |||2|| tālatrayapramāṇaṃ ca śvetaṃ taṃ jalamānuṣam | dṛṣṭvā janā mahāścaryamavāpurvismayaṃ gatāḥ ||83|| athānye yatayastatra catvāro ye jale sthitāḥ | te’pi vārimanuṣyāṇāṃ rūpairbahiḥ samāyayuḥ ||84|| prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ prāṇarakṣaṇahetave | bālakā māritā naiva sarve jīvanti te jaguḥ ||85|| ānayiṣyāma evātra prāṇadānaṃ tu dehi naḥ | ityukto bhagavān viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||86|| jīvadānaṃ dadau tebhyaḥ samuvāca prabhuḥ punaḥ | āgacchantu mayā sārdhaṃ vyomnā garuḍagāminā ||87|| yatraite bālakāḥ santi rakṣitā jīvinaḥ khalu | mlecchā vārimanuṣyāste śrutvā kṛṣṇavacastadā ||88|| vyomnā yayurhariṃ nītvā deśamāraktamujjvalam | raktavarṇaṃ raktajalaṃ raktamānavamaṇḍalam ||89|| yatrāste sarvamāraktaṃ prāyaśo bhūstaraṃ tathā | śāvadīno mahārājo yatidīno gurustathā ||2.29.90|| śāvadīnā mahākālī yatrāste bhūmipālaye | tatra kṛṣṇo yatayaste yayuḥ rājñā susatkṛtāḥ ||9 1 || bālakā darśitāstatra pañcāśat sukhino’vyathāḥ | sundaraṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā nṛpādayaḥ khalu ||92|| jñātvā siddhayatibhyaśca camatkāraṃ paraṃ śubham | rājapatnyo rājakanyāḥ śrīhariṃ puruṣottamam ||93||
