sammṛdya cottaratailaiḥ sugandhicūrṇakaistathā | snapayāmāsuratyarthaṃ kavoṣṇairvāribhistadā ||94|| rūpānurūpāvayavaṃ mīnaśūladhanurdharam | sadhvajaṃ ca karaṃ dṛṣṭvā mumuhurmumudustathā ||95|| aho’yaṃ baliyogyo’sti sa diṣṭyātra samāgataḥ | evamāvedayāñcakruḥ rājānaṃ satvaraṃ striyaḥ || 96|| rājā vicārya tūrṇaṃ hi bhaṭān senāpatīṃstathā | kārāgāre tu taṃ dhartumājñāṃ dadau prahasya vai || 97|| rūpamugdhāśca tāḥ kanyā necchanti maraṇaṃ hareḥ | rājñyaḥ putrecchayā tatra balimicchanti vai harim ||98|| bālarūpadharaḥ kṛṣṇo dhṛto bhaṭaistu tatkṣaṇam | avādyanta ca vādyāni rājā mene kṛtārthatām ||99|| sudarśanaṃ ca garuḍo bālau bhūtvā śubhāsyakau | bāleṣu ca militvaiva dhairyaṃ dadatuḥ rakṣakau || 2.29.1 00|| atha kṛṣṇo nigaḍasthaḥ kārāgāre kṛto bhaṭaiḥ | kanyakā mohamāpannāḥ sahasrasaṃkhyakāstadā || 10 1|| śāvadīnāmahākālīniyamaṃ jagṛhurmudā | yadi bālo vimucyeta bhaveccāsmatpatistadā || 1 02|| kariṣyāmo vrataṃ māsaṃ kevalaṃ hi payovratam | śāvadīnāpūjanaṃ ca kariṣyāmo divāniśam || 103 || adyatastyajyate miṣṭaṃ madhu śṛṃgārakādikam | śāvadīnādevikāyāḥ kurmo mālādvipañcakam || 1 04|| ityevaṃ niyamaṃ tāśca jagṛhurbālarakṣakam | atha rātrau prasuptāśca prajā rājā bhaṭādayaḥ || 1 05|| śrīharirbandhane supto lokalīlāpradarśakaḥ | dvitīyena svarūpeṇa vartate svagṛhe prabhuḥ || 1 06|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre sarvānandakaro hariḥ | vakti cāraktadeśotthāṃ vārtāṃ śrīlomaśarṣaye || 107|| śṛṇvanti sarve sāścaryaṃ manvate dūrabhūmijam | evaṃ rātrirvyatītā ca prabhātaṃ samajāyata || 1 08|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āraktadeśīyarājñā putrārthaṃ śāvadīnākālyai bālabalidā nārthakabaddhabālānāṃ mokṣaṇārthaṃ śrīharestatra gamanaṃ sahasrakanyakānāṃ harau mugdhatā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekonatriṃśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 29 ||
<2.30> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ rādhike vṛttaṃ tatratyaṃ prātarāgate | yajjātaṃ tadvadāmyatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya te || 1 || śāvadīno nṛpa udghoṣayāmāsa prajājane | putrārthaṃ balidānārthaṃ bālaḥ prāptaḥ sulakṣaṇaḥ || 2 || kare mīnadhvajadhanuḥśūlacakrādirekhitaḥ | māghyāṃ ca pūrṇimāyāṃ ca balidānaṃ bhaviṣyati || 3 || pañcadaśadinānyatra vartante śuklapakṣake | pratipattaḥ samārabhya nityaṃ devīprapūjanam || 4 || kartavyaṃ putrakāṃkṣārthijanairnityaṃ mahotsavam | śvaḥ pratipaddine prātarbālamādāya mandiram || 5 || ahaṃ rājā gamiṣyāmi devyagre guruṇā saha | apākasya ca bālasya devyagre pākatāṃ guruḥ || 6 || mlecchakāṇḍairmadyadānaiḥ surāsaṃskārakaistathā | kariṣyati vidhānena bālo devīpaśustataḥ || 7 prajāyate devarūpastasya sevā janaiḥ sadā | bhojanaiḥ sevanairvastrairjalaiḥ pānaiḥ pramardanaiḥ || 8 || yānakhelanakrīḍābhiḥ kartavyā sarvamānavaiḥ | bālārcane mahādevī prasannā saṃbhaviṣyati || 9 || tasmāt paśuḥ pūjanīyo dānamānārhaṇādibhiḥ | evamudghoṣitaṃ rājñā prajāsvaprasarat kṣaṇāt || 2.30.1 0|| prātaḥ pratipadi kṣmeśaḥ snātvā sainyena śobhitaḥ | sotsavo bālamādāya svāṃke devīgṛhaṃ yayau || 1 1|| mlecchamantraistu guruṇā bālo devīpaśuḥ kṛtaḥ | saṃskṛtaḥ pūjitaścāpi mahānmahotsavaḥ kṛtaḥ || 1 2|| śāvadīnā mahākālī dṛṣṭvā śrīpuruṣottamam | lajjāmavāpa śīghraṃ sā mūrterdūraṃ gatābhavat || 1 3|| śuśoca paramaṃ devī sarvān hantuṃ samicchati | kintu kṛṣṇasya kartavyaṃ pālanīyaṃ bhavediti || 14|| vicāryājñāṃ vinā naiva kiṃcit kartuṃ samicchati | iti maunābhavaddevī yāvatpūjā nivartitā || 15|| atha dānāni bahūni rājā prādānmahotsave | bālakṛṣṇo’pi paravat pāravaśyo’bhavattadā || 16|| prākṛto bālasadṛśo bālo’bhavannijecchayā | devīgṛhe dṛṣṭisaudhe rakṣito niśi kevalaiḥ || 17|| bālakaiḥ kanyakābhiśca saha tatra prasannahṛt | bhavet tathā sevyate ca sarvairapyupacārakaiḥ || 18|| ardharātre gate sarve nidrāmāpustataḥ satī | śāvadīnā mahākālī śrīhareḥ sannidhau śubhā || 19|| kanyā bhūtvā cājagāma vepamānā ca kiṃkarī | pādayormastakaṃ dhṛtvā vimuñcyāśrūṇi jihvayā ||2.30.20|| pravilihya hareḥ pādau kṣamasveti jagāda sā | neme muhustathājñāṃ cārthayāmāsa harerhi sā ||21|| nāthāparādhinaścaite rājādyāḥ putralālasāḥ | hantavyāste mayā sarve dehyājñāṃ me karoti tat ||22|| yatidīno gurustasya śāvadīnaśca bhūpatiḥ | kāsadīnaśca saurāṣṭrasarovārṣvavamārgakaḥ ||23|| mlecchāśca siddhayatayo hantavyāste mayā prabho | anye’pi cet sahāyasthā hantavyāste mayātra vai ||24|| omityāha haristasyai śāvakālyai pumuttamaḥ | khaḍgaṃ bhallaṃ tathā śaktiṃ paraśuṃ pāśamityapi || 25 || daṇḍaṃ vajraṃ carmāsiṃ mudgaraṃ gadāṃ triśūlakam | aṃkuśaṃ mūśalaṃ cakraṃ saśaraṃ dhanuṣaṃ tathā || 26|| śaṃkhaṃ ceti tadā hetīnaṣṭādaśakareṣu sā | dhṛtvā prātarnṛpagehe praviveśa ruṣānvitā ||27|| kesaristhā krūrarūpā vahninetrā viṣolbaṇā | nṛpaṃ jagrāha keśeṣu śiraściccheda cāsinā ||28|| guruṃ dvedhā vibhidyaiva śūlena ca tataḥ param | hatvā kāsaṃ siddhayatīn mlecchāṃśca tatsahāyadān ||29|| kārāgṛhapatīn hatvā mocayāmāsa bālakān | hāhākāro mahānāsīdantaḥpurajaneṣu vai ||2.30.30|| kupitā rājapūjyā sā kuladevīti vai jaguḥ | nāśayāmāsa rājānaṃ guruṃ yatīn tathāparān || 31 || bālānāṃ vadhapūrvaṃ vai pāpaṃ rājñaḥ samāgatam | bālā naiva kadācidvai pīḍanīyā yato janaiḥ |||32||| bālatrāsapradātṝṇāṃ sarvanāśo bhavediha | bālā nirdoṣapuṣpāṇi na hantavyāni vai hṛdā ||3 3 || bālā īśanivāsāste jvālanīyā na vai kvacit | kāyādidoṣahīnāste brahmasādhusvarūpiṇaḥ ||34|| arcanīyā rañjanīyāstoṣaṇīyā hi bālakāḥ | dātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ teṣāṃ sarvadābhayadānakam || 35|| dātavyastvāśrayasteṣāṃ mā dātavyaṃ mṛterbhayam | apakvaphalarūpāste parādhīnaprajīvanāḥ ||36|| mātāpitṛsamādhārā na hantavyāḥ kadācana | bālodvegaphalaṃ tatra maraṇaṃ jāyate hi tat ||37|| udvejayitā bālānāmapahartā jano’dhamaḥ | rājāvāpa phalaṃ tūrṇaṃ maraṇaṃ dharmaghātakaḥ ||38|| atha kesaripṛṣṭhasthā yayau bālagṛhāṇi sā | yatra kārāgṛhavāse te hi tiṣṭhanti bālakāḥ ||39|| yatrāste garuḍaścakraṃ tathā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | tatreyaṃ sahasā yātā yuddharūpadharā satī ||2.30.40|| krauryaṃ tyaktvātisaumyābhūd dvibhujā kanyakā śubhā | hasamānā ca tān bālānāha paśyata māṃ prati |||41|| bālaistvālokitā sāpi svasvamātṛsvarūpiṇī | drāgeva tadgalaṃ dhṛtvā remire’ṅke hi bālakāḥ ||42|| ati prasannatāṃ prāptā menire rakṣaṇaṃ nijam | atha sā bālakṛṣṇaṃ vai neme kṣamāmayācata ||43|| payaḥ phalāni pradadau sarvabālebhya aiśvarī | arbhakā bhakṣayāmāsurbabhūvuḥ sukhinastathā ||44|| atha śmaśānayātrāṃ ca prajāścakrurnṛpasya vai | rājñastu vidhavāḥ sarvā devīmāgatya cukruśuḥ ||45|| kanyāstā ruruduḥ sarvā gurvādīnāmapi striyaḥ | devī mūrtervinirgatya kanyārūpā vyajāyata ||46|| sākṣād bhūtā hi sarvāsāmuvāca madhuraṃ vacaḥ | mā śokaṃ kuruta śreṣṭhāḥ rājñā prāptaṃ phalaṃ nijam ||47|| ahaṃ bhavāmi yatpatnī taṃ rājā hantumudyataḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kānto’sti me prabhuḥ ||48|| mīnadhvajadhanuḥśūlacakradhārī janārdanaḥ | bālarūpo bhavatyeva kārāgāragato’tra saḥ ||49|| me patirmatpaśuḥ rājñā kṛtaḥ putre hayāpi tu | tatphalaṃ maraṇaṃ tasya mayā dattaṃ mahāghine ||2.30.50|| bhavatīnāṃ mahāśreyo bhaviṣyati harikṛtam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ stuvantu muktaye ||5 1 || ityuktā rādhike sarvā yayurnārāyaṇaṃ prati | tuṣṭuvuḥ parayā prītyā pāpamokṣaṇahetave ||52|| haristābhyo nijaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa dhāmagam | pārśve lakṣmī svarūpā ca śāvadīnāṃ satīṃ priyām ||5 3 || garuḍaṃ bālakaṃ cāpi cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ tathā | tato vai darśayāmāsa cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ||54|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ lomaśasyāśramaṃ tathā | koṭyarbujābjakanyāśca divyatāṃ pārameśvarīm |||55|| dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ paraṃ prāptā mātaraḥ kanyakāstathā | yayācire varaṃ śīghramasmākaṃ tvaṃ patirbhava ||56 || atha kṛṣṇastu sarvābhyo yatheṣṭaṃ vai varaṃ dadau | garuḍaṃ prāha yāsyāmaḥ śrīmadbadarikāvanam ||57|| sudarśanaṃ saha nītvā garuḍastho haristadā | sasmāra divyayānaṃ ca yojanāyatamujjvalam ||58|| sauvarṇaṃ nijadhāmasthaṃ śīghraṃ copasthitaṃ hi tat | sapārṣade vimāne ca sarvāḥ strīḥ kanyakāstathā ||59|| śāvadīnāṃ mahākālīṃ niṣādya śrīhariḥ svayam | prātaḥ rājamukuṭaṃ ca bhaktaṃ jallāuddīnakam ||2.30.6 0|| tṛtīyāṃ cārpayitvā vyomnā badryāśramaṃ yayau | gaṃgāyāṃ snāpayitvā ca dehaśuddhiṃ vidhāya ca ||6 1|| sarvābhyaḥ pāyayāmāsa śrīhareścaraṇāmṛtam | naranārāyaṇapūjāṃ kārayitvā tato hariḥ ||62|| kurukṣetraṃ tvāyayau ca daśakrośaviśālakam | pāvanaṃ paramaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ himādreḥ pādamāśritam ||63|| śrīrādhikovāca kurukṣetraṃ kadā kena kṛtaṃ tad vistarād vada | kathaṃ vai pāvanaṃ taddhi praśastaṃ gaṇyate sadā ||64|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca somavaṃśodbhavo rājā ṛkṣo nāma mahābalaḥ | kṛtasyādau samabhavad ṛkṣātsaṃvaraṇo’bhavat ||65|| sa tu pitrā nije rājye’bhiṣikto bāla eva saḥ | bālye’pi dharmanirato madbhaktaḥ sa sadābhavat ||66|| purohitastu tasyāsīd vasiṣṭho varuṇātmajaḥ | sa taṃ tvadhyāpayāmāsa sāṃgānvedānudāradhīḥ ||67|| anadhyāye dine rājā yayau vanāni vīkṣitum | vaibhrājaṃ suvanaṃ ramyaṃ viveśa bahuvistaram ||68|| dvaitavanaṃ viveśāsau ruḍrāgau dvau gatau yataḥ | sa vanāntaṃ dadarśātha phullakokanadāvṛtam ||69|| tatra dadarśa devānāṃ kanyakāstāsu madhyagām | sūryaputrīṃ tapatīṃ sa dadarśa sarvato’dhikām ||2.30.70|| tatra lagnamanā rājā yayau meruṃ prati prabhuḥ | pratiṣṭhānapuraṃ ramyaṃ tiṣṭhatyeva ca tāṃ smaran ||71 || yadā nāyaṃ gṛhaṃ pratyāyātastathā purohitaḥ | jñātvā taṃ merusaṃsthaṃ ca tapatīlagnamānasam ||72|| samutpatya vasiṣṭhaḥ prāyayau bhāskaramaṇḍalam | nanāma bhāskaraṃ sūryo nanāmainaṃ pupūja ca ||73|| papracchāgamane hetumṛṣiḥ sūryamuvāca ha | samāyāto’smi deveśa yācituṃ tvāṃ mahādyute ||74|| sutāṃ saṃvaraṇasyārthe tvaṃ tāpīṃ dātumarhasi | tāpīṃ pṛṣṭvā tataḥ sūryo dadau tāpīṃ jaharṣa ca ||75|| ṛṣirnītvā rājyamāyāt samvaraṇo’pi cāyayau | taṃ dṛṣṭvā cakame tāpī tasmai maharṣiṇārpitā ||76|| tasyāṃ putro’bhavat kāle kururnāmnā sa vai kṛtaḥ | ṣoḍaśābdaḥ samuvāha sudāmno nṛpateḥ sutām ||77|| kīrtināmne dhuraṃ datvā rājyasya vanamāviśat | saudāmnyā saha patnyā vai tepe dvaitavane nṛpaḥ ||78|| tatra devīṃ harijihvāṃ sa dadarśa sarasvatīm | sudarśanasya jananīṃ brahmaputrīṃ ca plakṣajām ||79|| snātvā tatra jalaṃ pītvā brahmavedīmupāyayau | uttarā sā brahmavedirucyate yajñabhūmikā ||2.30.80 || madhyamā brahmavedistu prayāgarāja ucyate | prāgvedikā gayāvedirvirajā dakṣiṇā tu vai ||8 1 || pratīcī puṣkarā vedistribhiḥ kuṇḍairalaṃkṛtā | syamantapañcakaṃ dharmasthānaṃ cottaravedikā ||82|| āsamantād yojanāni pañca pañca ca sarvataḥ | tadamanyata rājarṣiḥ kṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ mahāphalam ||83|| hradaṃ kṛtvā parṇaśālāṃ vidhāya vāsamācarat | kṛtvā sīraṃ rudravṛṣaṃ yamasya mahiṣaṃ tathā ||84|| voḍhāraṃ saṃvidhāyaiva svayaṃ kṛṣṭuṃ samudyataḥ | karṣantaṃ taṃ mahendraścāgatya papraccha kāraṇam ||85|| rājan kimidaṃ kārṣeyaṃ bhavān kartumihodyataḥ | rājābravīt tapaḥ satyaṃ śaucaṃ dānaṃ dayā kṣamā ||86|| yogaśca śīlavṛttiścetyaṣṭakaṃ cātra vidyate | indraḥ prāha tathā rājan bhūyāttavābhivāñcchitam ||87|| indre gate tu rājāsau karṣati sma nirantaram | saptakrośādhikāṃ bhūmiṃ sīrakṛṣṭāṃ cakāra saḥ ||88|| tato’haṃ rādhike vipro bhūtvāgacchaṃ nṛpāntikam | apṛcchaṃ ca tvayā rājan kathaṃ vai kleśa uhyate ||89|| tadāṣṭāṃgo mahādharmaḥ samākhyāto nṛpeṇa me | tato mayāsya gaditaṃ nṛpa bījaṃ kva vartate ||2.30.90|| sa cāha mama dehe’tra mānasaṃ bījamasti hi | tamabruvaṃ dehi mahyaṃ bījaṃ niṣkāsya dehataḥ ||9 1 || vāṭikāṃ khalu vapsyāmi sīraṃ karṣatu vai bhavān | tato nṛpatinā bāhurdakṣiṇaḥ prasṛtaḥ kṛtaḥ ||92|| mayā cakreṇa chinnaḥ so’bhavattatra sahasradhā | evaṃ vāmabhujaḥ pādau kaṭitaśca dvidhā kṛtāḥ ||93|| tāni bījāni jātāni koṭyadhikāni sarvataḥ | atha sa me śiraḥ prādāt tena prīto’smi tasya ca ||94|| varado’smītyathetyukte kururvaramayācata | yāvadetanmayā kṛṣṭaṃ dharmakṣetraṃ tadastu te ||95|| snātānāṃ ca mṛtānāṃ ca mahāpuṇyaphalaṃ tviha | upavāsaśca dānaṃ ca snānaṃ jāpyaṃ ca pūjanam ||96|| homayajñādikaṃ sarvamatrākṣayaṃ bhavet prabho | tathā bhavān suraiḥ sārdhaṃ brahmaṇā śaṃbhunā tathā || 97|| vasātra puṇḍarīkākṣa mannāmavyañjake’tra vai | ityevamuktastenāhaṃ tadā bāḍhamuvāca tam || 18|| tathā ca tvaṃ divyavapurbhava bhūyo’pi svastimān | antakāle cirakāle layameṣyasi mattanau || 99|| śāśvatī tava kīrtiśca bhaviṣyati madāśrayāt | atra tvaṃ yājako yajñān yajiṣyase sahasraśaḥ || 2.30.10 0|| kṣetrasya rakṣakān candrayakṣaṃ pannagavāsukim | vidyādharaṃ śaṃkukarṇaṃ sukeśaṃ rākṣasaṃ tathā || 10 1|| ajāvanaṃ ca nṛpatiṃ mahādevaṃ ca pāvakam | dadāmi te’tra balino’ṣṭasahasrāṇi dhanvinām || 1 02|| kurujāṃgalamadhye ca pṛthūdakaṃ saro mahat | nadī sarasvatī cāpi vartate pāvanī śubhā || 103 || sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyorantare kurujāṃgale | brahmasaraḥ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ samantādardhayojanam || 1 04|| ādyaiṣā brahmaṇo vedistato rāmahradaḥ smṛtaḥ | kurukṣetraṃ tataḥ proktaṃ dharmakṣetraṃ hi pāvanam || 105 || tarantukārantukayorantaraṃ yattu vidyate | rāmahradapañcakācca yadantaraṃ hi vidyate || 106 || kurukṣetraṃ viśālaṃ tat samantapañcakāhvayam | tatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vyomnā samāyayau || 1 07|| sarasvatyāṃ dṛṣadvatyāṃ brahmasarasi yoṣitaḥ | snāpayitvā ca yānena kṣaṇamātreṇa rādhike || 1 08|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre lomaśāśramamāyayau | bālakāḥ kanyakā nāryo devī ca garuḍo hariḥ || 1 09|| avateruḥ kṣitiṃ tatra jayaśabdāstadābhavan | avādyanta ca vādyāni devīśaṃkho’pyavādyata || 2.30.11 0|| lomaśādyā ṛṣayaśca prajāḥ śīghraṃ samāyayuḥ | ābhāṣya maṃgalācāramakurvan brāhmaṇādayaḥ || 11 1|| sasnuḥ sarovare bhuktavanto bhojyāni sarvaśaḥ | ārāmaṃ kṛtavantaśca pravāsādāgamaśramāḥ || 1 12|| jayotsavaḥ kṛto rātrau rājño nāśaḥ pravarṇitaḥ | bālakā nijapitṛbhyaścārpitā hariṇā tadā || 11 3|| kanyakā yoṣitaḥ sarvā lomaśāya niveditāḥ | āśrame rakṣaṇārthaṃ ca mantradānārthamityapi || 1 14|| lomaśaśca pavitrābhyo dadau matraṃ ca mālikāḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā || 1 15|| vaiṣṇavyastā divyarūpā abhavan brahmatejasā | mātarastā bhajanaṃ ca cakruḥ kṛṣṇakṛpāvaśāt || 116|| divyadehā vimānaiśca yayurvaikuṇṭhameva tāḥ | kanyakāstatra tasthuśca śrīharericchayā sadā || 1 17|| ityevaṃ rakṣitā bālā mlecchā vināśitāstathā | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya svargamokṣaphalaṃ bhavet || 1 18|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhoḥ rājakṛtadevīpaśusaṃskāraḥ, devyā rājādisaṃhāraḥ, badrīṃ kurukṣetraṃ kuṃkumavāpikāṃ pratyāgamanam, bālakānāṃ tajjanakebhyo’rpaṇam, mātṝṇāṃ muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṃśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 30 ||
<2.31> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ rādhike devī śāvadīnā tu kālikā | aśvapaṭṭasarastīre divyovāsa vaṭāśritā || 1 || kṣetrarakṣāṃ karotyeva cāṣṭādaśabhujā priyā | siṃhavāhanayuktā ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃganā || 2 || kanyakānāṃ sadā rakṣāṃ karoti divyavigrahā | pratyakṣā dṛśyate lokaiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā || 3 || tattīrthaṃ kālikātīrthaṃ vartate’śvasarovare | paścime tatra setau vai kṛtaprāsādasannidhau || 4 || māghasnānasamāptau ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | pūjayāmāsuratyarthaṃ prajā viprāśca kanyakāḥ || 5 || mahotsavo mahān jāto divyo mokṣaprado hi saḥ | atha sarvatra vārtā sā prāsarad vāyuvegataḥ || 6 || jalamānavavīkṣārthaṃ janāstvāyānti dūrataḥ | dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā mahāścaryaṃ manyante śrīharerbalam || 7 || hariṇā sa vārinaro vāriṇā prokṣitastadā | divyarūpo hastapādāvayavaḥ samapadyata || 8 || tuṣṭāva śrīhariṃ sevāmārthayatpādayoḥ sadā | śrīharistaṃ sarasyeva kṣetrapālaṃ vyadhātsadā || 9 || tava vaṃśo mānasaśca sarvatra prasariṣyati | jalamānuṣasṛṣṭiḥ sā bhaviṣyatīti cāha tam || 2.31.1 0|| jaḍadehaṃ tadā tasya jalamadhye vyasarjayat | tato divyā jalanarā jalanāryo’bhavan śatam || 1 1|| atha lokā mahākālīṃ paśyantyatha vrajanti ca | kathayanti pratāpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya te || 1 2|| bhajante śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīparameśvaram | muktiṃ yānti bahavaśca śrīśasvāmipratāpataḥ || 13||| payovrataṃ tāḥ kanyāśca cakrustatrāśrame yataḥ | hariḥ kāntaḥ prabhuḥ prāptastadarthaṃ mānitaṃ tu prāk || 14|| rādhike vratapuṣṭyarthaṃ gāvaḥ kāmadughāstadā | payo dadati nityaṃ vai vrataṃ kurvanti kanyakāḥ || 15|| śrīhariṃ nirmaladugdhaiḥ snapayanti prage ca tāḥ | paścādvārbhiḥ snāpayitvā vastrabhūṣādibhiḥ prabhum || 16|| śṛṃgārayanti bhāvena sugandhayanti saddravaiḥ | mardayanti prabhordehaṃ rañjayanti sugītikaiḥ || 17|| hāsayanti sumādhuryaistoṣayanti sunartanaiḥ | ānandayanti susparśaistarpayanti subhojanaiḥ || 18|| stuvanti vardhayantyeva nīrājanakṣamāpanaiḥ | evaṃ kṛṣṇavratakartryaḥ pibanti dugdhameva tāḥ || 1 9|| māsapūrṇaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā cakruḥ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ ca tat | dānahomotsavamudyāpanaṃ kṛtvā ca pūrṇatām || 2.31.20|| tasthustatraiva saṃbhejuḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāṇapatiṃ prabhum ||2 1 || śrīrādhikovāca kathaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mleccharākṣasakanyakāḥ | jātinikṛṣṭabhāvotthā jagrāha pāvanaḥ prabhuḥ ||22|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rādhe kathayāmi mama divyāṃ kathāṃ tava | pareṇa brahmaṇā cāhaṃ purā svāṃśaḥ prakāśitaḥ ||23|| mayā rādhā tadaṃśā ca patnīrūpā kṛtā tadā | sāhaudaryaṃ rodhate na tejasvināṃ tadatra vai ||24|| pareṇa brahmaṇā nārāyaṇaścaturbhujaḥ kṛtaḥ | parabrahmasamutthā ca lakṣmīstena priyā kṛtā ||25|| sāhaudaryaṃ bādhate na nārāyaṇāvatārake | brahmaṇā svasya vaṃśīyā sāvitrī saṃvivāhitā ||26|| gāyatrī vaṃśajā putrī brahmaṇā svapriyā kṛtā | sarasvatī tathā putrī patnītvena sumānitā ||27|| brahmapautrasya putryaśca dakṣajāḥ kulajāśca tāḥ | brahmaputraiḥ praputraiśca sarvā eva vivāhitā ||28|| kaśyapena purā tiryagjātīyāḥ svapriyāḥ kṛtāḥ | danuśca ditireveme rākṣasyau kaśyapastriyau ||29|| arundhatī śvapacī ca vasiṣṭhena vivāhitā | kālī ca bhairavī durgā tāmasyaḥ śaṃkarapriyāḥ ||2.31.3 0|| vṛndā tulasī daityasya patnyau viṣṇuvivāhite | mlecchā goromato jātā gavāṃ vaṃśāstu te smṛtāḥ ||3 1 || samartho bhagavān sarvān pavitrayati tatkṣaṇāt | na tasyāgre jātibhāvo noccatā nīcatā na ca ||32|| bhāvagamyo hi bhagavān bhāvito bhāvayatyapi | sarvaṃ tasya saḥ sarvasmin tadātmakaḥ sa eva ha ||33|| sarvabhoktā sarvakartā sarvapatiḥ patīśvaraḥ | tasyājñayā purā brahmā yugalāni samasṛjat || 34|| tadyugalaṃ bhrātṛsvasṛrūpaṃ sahasramāsa ha | tataḥ sṛṣṭiḥ kṛtayuge bhavatyeva na dūṣaṇam || 35|| tadā kanyāḥ parasmai vai dātuṃ prathā na cābhavat | atha kanyāvihīnānāṃ vaṃśasantānasiddhaye ||36|| kanyādānaṃ pradātavyamanyasmai niyamo’bhavat | paragotre pradātavyā kanyeti niyamastvanu || 37|| asapiṇḍe pradātavyā sājātye niyamo’bhavat | evaṃ sarvairlabhyate vai kanyā vaṃśapradā tataḥ ||38|| anye dharmāḥ purā sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe’pi cāparāḥ | anye dharmāḥ kṛte tvādye tretādāvapare vṛṣāḥ ||35|| kalau dharmā adharmāste tadānīmabhavan priye | kṛtadharmāḥ kalau sarve na tu dharmatayā matāḥ ||2.31.40|| tejobhedād bhinnadharmāḥ pravartante yuge yuge | tasmāt kṛṣṇasya doṣo na tatkriyā dharma eva saḥ ||41 || tatkṛtaḥ saḥ parāmnāyaḥ śāsti sarvaṃ jagat sadā | sa cāmnāyo naiva kṛṣṇaṃ śāsituṃ kṣamate kvacit |||42|| āmnāyasya mahāmātā kriyā kṛṣṇasya vartate | tasmāt kṛṣṇakriyāḥ sarvā ātmāmnāyasvarūpiṇī ||43|| na saḥ kāmo na saḥ krodho na vyavāyo na hiṃsanam | na taccauryaṃ na sāṃkaryaṃ kṛṣṇakṛtaṃ tu yadbhavet ||44|| kāmo divyastathā krodho vyavāyo divya eva saḥ | hiṃsā cauryaṃ ca sāṃkaryaṃ divyaṃ kṛṣṇakṛtaṃ sadā ||45|| rādhā divyā ratirdivyā divyā vaibhavabhogyatā | sarvaṃ divyaṃ parabrahmamayaṃ tatra na dūṣaṇam ||46|| yatrāsti tejasāṃ rāśistamastatra na vidyate | tamastu dūṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ tejasviṣu na saṃbhavet ||47|| alpadṛṣṭyā vilokyante dūṣaṇāni tamo’dhikaiḥ | brahmadṛṣṭyā tu tānyeva bhūṣaṇāni bhavanti hi ||48|| yādṛk snehaḥ striyāṃ putre sutāyāṃ janakādiṣu | sa eva sādhuṣu kṛto mokṣaṃ dadāti nirguṇaḥ ||49|| satsu sādhvīṣu ca doṣā bhasmatāṃ yānti yogataḥ | hareryogād divyabhāvāḥ santaḥ sādhvyo bhavanti hi ||2.31.50|| yathā rādhe tava putrāḥ kṣārodā api sarvathā | pāvanāstīrtharūpāste divyarūpā bhavanti hi |||5 1 || yathā liṃgaṃ kāmamūlaṃ doṣātmakaṃ jagatsu vai | śaṃkarasya tu yogena brahmavatpūjyate hi tat ||52|| pāṣāṇādyā brahmayogāt pūjyante pratimātmakāḥ | tyā sarvaṃ tvayā rādhe pūjanīyaṃ madanvayāt ||53|| mlecchatā kṛṣṇayogena vrajatyevācchatāṃ priye | bhagaṃ vai brahmayogena yajñakuṇḍe pradṛśyate |||54|| patnīhaste tvaśvaliṃgaṃ tvaśvamedhe pradīyate | sarvatra brahmayogena pāvitryaṃ kalpate priye |||55|| tasmācchaṃkā na kartavyā mlecchakanyāḥ kathaṃ priyāḥ | yatpriyaṃ śrīharestattu śuddhameva na saṃśayaḥ ||56|| atha tvidaṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmatattvaṃ nibodha me | prāgbhavam ṛṣibhirdṛṣṭaṃ dharmavidbhirmahātmabhiḥ ||57|| anāvṛtāḥ purā kila striyastvāsan varānane | kāmacāravihāriṇyaḥ svatantrāścāruhāsinī |||58|| tāsāṃ vyuccaramāṇānāṃ kaumārāt subhage patīn | nādharmo’bhūd varārohe sa hi dharmaḥ purābhavat ||59|| taṃ caiva prācīnadharmaṃ tiryagyonigatāḥ prajāḥ | sarvadānuvidhīyante ṛtudharmamanusṛtāḥ ||2.31.60|| pramāṇadṛṣṭo dharmo’yaṃ pūjyate ca maharṣibhiḥ | uttareṣu ca deśeṣu kuruṣvapi pravartate ||61|| parvatīyaprajāsveṣaḥ dharmo bahupatitvakaḥ | devīṣvapi ca svargādau vartate dharma eva saḥ ||62|| dāsīṣvapi ca sarvatra vartate dharma eva saḥ | strīṇāmanugrahaprāptaḥ sa vai dharmaḥ sanātana ||63|| athoddālakaputreṇa kadācit śvetaketunā | maryādā sthāpitā tena kopāttāmapi saṃśṛṇu ||64|| śvetaketoḥ kila purā samakṣaṃ mātaraṃ pituḥ | jagrāha brāhmaṇaḥ pāṇau gacchāva iti cābravīt ||65|| ṛṣiputrastadā kopaṃ cakārāmarṣanoditaḥ | mātaraṃ tāṃ nīyamānāṃ balād dṛṣṭvā pituḥ puraḥ ||66|| kruddhaṃ putraṃ pitā dṛṣṭvā śvetaketumuvāca ha | mā putra kopaṃ kārṣīstvameṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||67|| anāvṛtā hi sarveṣāṃ varṇānāmaṃganā bhuvi | yathā gāvaḥ sthitāḥ sve sve bhoktari pramadāstathā ||68|| śvetaketustu taṃ dharmaṃ sarvathā vai na cakṣame | cakāra caiva maryādāmimāṃ strīpuṃsayorbhuvi ||69|| mānuṣeṣveva nānyeṣu śṛṇu tāṃ rādhike priye | vyuccarantyāḥ patiṃ nāryā adyaprabhṛti pātakam ||2.31.70|| bhrūṇahatyāsamaṃ ghoraṃ bhaviṣyatyasukhāvaham | bhāryāṃ tathā vyuccarataḥ kaumārabrahmacāriṇīm ||71|| pativratāmetadeva bhavitā pātakaṃ bhuvi | patyā niyuktā yā caiva patnī putrārthameva vā || 72|| na kariṣyati tasyāśca bhaviṣyati tadeva hi | uddālakasya putreṇa dharmyā vai śvetaketunā ||73 || maryādā sthāpitā tasmāt sa vai dharmo vyavasthitaḥ | ṛtau ṛtau striyā bhartā nātivartavya eva ca ||74|| śeṣeṣvanyeṣu kāleṣu svātantryaṃ strī kilārhati | saudāsena nijapatnī niyuktā putrajanmani ||75|| madayantī jagāmarṣiṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ gurumeva tu | tasmāllebhe ca sā putramaśmakaṃ nāma viśrutam ||76|| athotathya iti khyāta āsīddhīmān ṛṣiḥ purā | mamatā nāma bhāryāsīttasya paramasaṃmatā ||77|| utathyasya yavīyām̐stu purodhāstridivaukasām | bṛhaspatirmahātejā mamatāmanvapadyata ||78|| uvāca mamatā taṃ tu devaraṃ vadatāṃvaram | antarvatnī tvahaṃ bhrātrā tava tasmāttu devara ||79|| amogharetāstvaṃ cāpi dvayorgarbhe na saṃbhavaḥ | evamukto’pi sa kāmaṃ niyantuṃ na śaśāka ha ||2.31.80|| reme sārdhaṃ tayā cāthotsṛjantaṃ reta eva tam | abhyabhāṣata garbhastha autathyo’tra na saṃbhavaḥ ||8 1|| dvayoḥ kṛte nāvakāśo na pīḍāṃ kartumarhasi | aśrutvaiva tu tadvākyaṃ garbhasthasya bṛhaspatiḥ ||82|| śukrotsargaṃ cakāraiva tacchukraṃ garbhaśabālakaḥ | padbhyāṃ hataṃ papātorvyāṃ tataḥ kruddho bṛhaspatiḥ ||83|| śaśāpa garbhaṃ mūrkha tvaṃ tamo dīrghaṃ pravekṣyasi | sa vai dīrghatamā ṛṣirjātyandhaḥ samajāyata ||84|| kintu vidvānataḥ patnīṃ pradveṣīṃ nāma labdhavān | sa putrān janayāmāsa gautamādīn tapasvinaḥ ||85|| dīrghatamā vṛṣavacca prakāśe maithunakriyām | janānāṃ sannidhau cakre maryādānāśakṛd yathā ||86|| ṛṣayastaṃ tiraścakrurbhinnamaryādameva ca | pradveṣī taṃ sevate na tatastāmabravīnmuniḥ ||87|| bhārye tvaṃ māṃ kathaṃ naiva sevase vada kāraṇam | pradveṣī tu patiṃ prāha bhartā tu bharaṇānmataḥ ||88|| patiśca pālanāccāpi tvayi dvayaṃ na vidyate | pratyutāhaṃ bharaṇe te sasutā kleśabhāginī ||89|| bhavāmyaśaktā ca tato bhartrantaraṃ karomi ca | yatheṣṭaṃ kuru viprendra gacchāmyahaṃ janāntaram || 2.31.90|| dīrghatamā uvāca adyaprabhṛti maryādā mayā loke vitanyate | eka eva patirnāryā yāvajjīvaṃ parāyaṇam ||9 1 || mṛte jīvati vā patyau nāparaṃ prāpnuyānnaram | pare prāpte patitā sā bhavediti niyamyate ||92|| śrutvā kopayutā putrānuvāca pitaraṃ prati | badhvoḍupe kṣipantvenaṃ cāndhaṃ vipriyavādinam ||93|| putrā badhvā pitaraṃ taṃ coḍupe samavāsṛjan | gaṃgāyāṃ sa cānusrotaḥ plavamānaḥ pravāhake ||94|| naukā pravāhapatitā dūradeśaṃ gatā yadā | naukāsthamekalamandhaṃ śrīśanāmajapānvitam ||95|| apaśyadvai baliḥ rājā jagrāhainaṃ nināya ca | gṛhaṃ jñātvā ṛṣiṃ patnyāṃ niyuyoja sutārthakaḥ ||96|| sudeṣṇā rājapatnī sā na svīcakāra taṃ munim | svāṃ tu dhātreyikāṃ tasmai vṛddhāya prāhiṇottadā ||97|| tasyāṃ kākṣīvadādīṃścaikādaśa putrakān muniḥ | janayāmāsa ca tataḥ sudeṣṇā taṃ hyarocayat ||98|| tato jātāḥ sudeṣṇāyāṃ kumārāḥ pañca tatsutāḥ | aṃgo vaṃgaḥ kaliṃgaśca puṇḍraḥ suhmaśca te balāḥ ||99|| teṣāṃ deśā bhaviṣyanti tattannāmabhireva te | evaṃ baleḥ purā vaṃśaḥ prakhyāto vai maharṣiṇā || 2.31.10 0|| parāśaro mapsyagandhāṃ dhīvarīṃ samapadyata | evaṃ pūrvataro dharmo nārāyaṇasya kā kathā || 101 || sarvaṃ nārāyaṇabhogyaṃ nārāyaṇasya varṣma ca | sarvaṃ nārāyaṇapatnīrūpaṃ patirnarāyaṇaḥ || 1 02|| mā śaṃkāṃ tvaṃ kuru rādhe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prati | māyāyāṃ garbhado yaḥ sa māyikyāmapi garbhadaḥ || 1 03|| sraṣṭā pātā ca saṃhartā sa eva parameśvaraḥ | sarvakanyāśca gṛhṇīyād yogyaṃ tasya sadā hi tat || 1 04|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya dharmatattvaṃ purābhavam | jñāyeta ca vilīyeta saṃśayaḥ puṇyabhāg bhavet || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kanyakānāṃ payovrataṃ, purādharmatattve śvetaketukṛtamaryādā, saudāsapatnyāṃ vasiṣṭhaputre’śmakaḥ, utathyabhāryā bṛhaspatispṛṣṭā, dīrghatamā balerdāsyāṃ rājñyāṃ ca putrānutpādayāmāsa, tato maryādākaraṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 31 ||
<2.32> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike māghe jātavighnanimittakam | grahādipūjanaṃ cakre svayaṃ gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 1 || phālgune viṣṇuyāge ca kārayāmāsa bhūsuraiḥ | kṣetravighnapraśāntyarthaṃ grahaśāntyarthamityapi || 2 || saurāṣṭravartibālānāṃ yogakṣemau yathā śubhau | bhavetāṃ ca yathā dānānyasaṃkhyāni hyadāttadā || 3 || devānāṃ ca vibhinnānāṃ pūjāṃ pitā hyakārayat | mātrādīnāṃ tathā pūjāṃ baliṃ śreṣṭhamadāpayat || 4 || śrīrādhikovāca grahā bālagrahāḥ ke te ye’rdayantīha bālakān | kathaṃrūpā grahā hyete vadātra kṛṣṇakānta me || 5 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca purā skando’bhavatputro rudrasya vīryasaṃbhavaḥ | pārvatyāśca tathā vahneḥ gaṃgāyā darbhakasya ca || 6 || ṣaṇṇāṃ ca ṛṣipatnīnāṃ bālaḥ skandastadābhavat | devasenāpatirjāto lakṣmīstamāśrayattataḥ || 7 || śrījuṣṭaḥ pañcamīṃ skandastasmācchrīpañcamī smṛtā | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kṛtārtho’bhūd yasmāt tasmāt ṣaṣṭhī mahātithiḥ || 8 || śriyā juṣṭaṃ mahāsenaṃ devasenāpatiṃ kṛtam | saptarṣipatnyaḥ ṣaḍdevyastatsakāśamathāgaman || 9 || ṛṣibhiḥ samparityaktā ūcuḥ putraṃ tu kārtikam | vayaṃ putra parityaktā bhartṛbhiścālpakāraṇāt || 2.32.1 0|| asmābhiḥ kila jātastvamiti brāhmyamudāhṛtam | tena doṣeṇojjhitāḥ sma tasmānnastrātumarhasi || 1 1|| svargasthānāccyutāḥ praśaṃkitā vai ṛṣibhirvayam | tadakṣayo bhavet svargastvatprasādāddhi naḥ kuru || 12 || tvāṃ putraṃ cāpyabhīpsāmaḥ kṛtvaitadanṛṇo bhava | etatkāle mahendraśca skandaṃ prāha mahāmatiḥ || 13 || abhijinnāmabhaginī tapastaptuṃ vanaṃ gatā | rohiṇyāstu kaniṣṭhā sā jyeṣṭhatāṃ tapasecchati || 14|| tatsthānaṃ vartate riktaṃ skanda pūraya tatsthalam | kṛttikābhiśca nakṣatrasaṃkhyāpūrtiṃ vidhehi vai || 15|| skandastāḥ kṛttikārūpā mātṝḥ ṣaḍ paryayojayat | nakṣatraṃ kṛttikākhyaṃ tad bhāti vai vahnidaivatam || 16 || nanu ṣaṭkṛttikāstatra saptaśīrṣāmatā katham | iti cecchrūrayatāṃ tatra kāraṇaṃ tadvadāmi ca || 17|| vinatā cābravīt skandaṃ māmapi tatra sannaya | skando dadau saptamaṃ ca sthānaṃ tasyai tadā śubham || 18|| evaṃ tat kṛttikānakṣatraṃ mataṃ saptaśīrṣakam | atha tāḥ kṛttikāḥ procuḥ skandaṃ punaryathepsitam || 1 9|| brāhmī māheśvarī caiva vaiṣṇavī ca narāyaṇī | gāyatrī durgikā māyā yāścaitāḥ saptamātaraḥ || 2.32.20|| anādikālataḥ pūrvaṃ yā lokasya prakalpitāḥ | asmākaṃ tu bhavet sthānaṃ tāsāṃ caiva na tadbhavet ||2 1 || bhavema pūjyā lokasya na tāḥ pūjyā hi kārtika | tābhiścoktvā viyogo naḥ ṛṣibhyaḥ kārito yataḥ ||22|| icchāma āsāṃ mātṝṇāṃ prajā yāḥ pitṛdevatāḥ | tā asmākaṃ bhogakartryo bhavantu ṛṣivat sadā || 23 || skandaḥ prāha pradattaṃ taccandrapatnyo bhavantu vai | parirakṣata cānyāṃśca putratulyān sadā tu naḥ ||24|| kṛttikāśca tadā prāhuḥ putra kurmastathā vayam | kintu ṣoḍaśavarṣīyā bhavanti taruṇā prajāḥ || 25 || bhoktuṃ dehi ca no martyaprajā rūpaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ | skandaḥ prāha tathāstvetat sukhayuktā bhavantu ca || 26 || ahaṃ tu vaḥ pradāsyāmi raudramātmānamavyayam | paramaṃ tena sahitāḥ sukhaṃ svarge vasantu vai || 27|| ityuktvā kārtiko dehāt puruṣaṃ pāvakaprabham | utpādya graharūpaṃ taṃ dadau tābhyaḥ sukhāptaye ||28|| taṃ nītvā raudrarūpaṃ tā yayuścāndramasīṃ bhuvam | skandāpasmāramityāhurgrahaṃ taṃ tattvavedinaḥ || 29 || vinatā tu mahāraudrā kathyate śakunigrahaḥ | pūtanāṃ rākṣasīṃ prāhustaṃ vidyātpūtanāgraham ||2.32.3 0|| kaṣṭāṃ dāruṇarūpeṇa ghorarūpāṃ niśācarīm | piśācī dāruṇākārā kathyate śītapūtanā ||3 1 || garbhān sā mānuṣīṇāṃ tu harate ghoradarśanā | aditiṃ revatīṃ prāhurgrahastasyāstu raivataḥ || 32|| so’pi bālān mahāghoro bādhate vai mahāgrahaḥ | daityānāṃ yā ditirmātā tāmāhurmukhamaṇḍikām || 33|| atyarthaṃ śiśumāṃsena saṃprahṛṣṭāṃ durāsadām | kumārāśca kumāryaśca yā jātāḥ skandasaṃbhavāḥ ||34|| tāste garbhabhujaḥ sarve krūrakāryā mahāgrahāḥ | kumārāṇāṃ striyo yāśca kumārīṇāṃ narāśca ye || 35|| te jāyamānān gṛhṇanti bālakān raudrakarmiṇaḥ | gavāṃ mātā tu surabhiryā vidyate surālaye ||36|| śakunistāmathāruhya saha bhuṃkte śiśūn bhuvi | saramā nāma yā mātā śunāṃ devī tu rādhike ||37|| sāpi garbhān samādatte mānuṣīṇāṃ sadaiva ha | pādapānāṃ tu yā mātā karañjanilayābhidhā || 38|| saikā tu varadā rakṣākarī bhūtānukampinī | tāṃ karañjadrume putrārthino’rcayanti mānavāḥ || 39|| athāpyanyā mātaraśca grahā māṃsamadhupriyāḥ | divā ca rātrau tiṣṭhanti satataṃ sūtikāgṛhe ||2.32.40|| kadrūḥ sūkṣmavapurbhūtvā garbhiṇīṃ praviśatyatha | tatra bhuṃkte ca taṃ garbhaṃ nāgatulyaṃ prasūyate ||41 || gandharvāṇāṃ ca jananī garbhaṃ nītvaiva gacchati | tena vilīnagarbhā ca mānuṣī dṛśyate janaiḥ ||42|| apsarasāṃ janitrī tu garbhamāste pragṛhya tu | upanaṣṭo garbha iti janā vadanti tādṛśi ||43 || raktodadhestu yā kanyā dhātrī skandasya yā smṛtā | sā lohitāyanī nāmnā kadambe pūjyate janaiḥ ||44|| puruṣeṣu yathā rudrastathāryā pramadāsu sā | āryā mātā kumārasya pṛthakkāmārthamijyate |||45||| ete sarve kumārāṇāṃ bhakṣakā vai mahāgrahāḥ | yāvatṣoḍaśavarṣāṇi śiśūnāmaśivā hi te ||46|| ye tu mātṛgaṇāścāpi ye ca naragaṇā grahāḥ | sarve skandagrahā nāma loke bodhyā duḥkhapradāḥ ||47|| teṣāṃ praśamanaṃ kāryaṃ snānaṃ dhūpamathāñjanam | balikarmopahārāśca skandasyejyā viśeṣataḥ ||48|| evamabhyarcitāḥ sarve āyurvīryabalapradāḥ | athordhvaṃ ṣoḍaśādvarṣād ye bhavanti nṛṇāṃ grahāḥ ||49|| tān vadāmi śṛṇu rādhe māheśvarā hi te matāḥ | yaḥ paśyati naro devān jāgrat vā śayito’pi vā ||2.32.50|| unmādyati tadā kṣipraṃ taṃ tu devagrahaṃ viduḥ | āsīnaśca śayānaśca yaḥ paśyati naraḥ pitṝn ||51 || unmādyati tadā kṣipraṃ sa tu pitṛgrahaḥ smṛtaḥ | avamanyate yaḥ siddhān śaptaḥ krodhena sādhubhiḥ |||52|| unmādyati ca kṣipraṃ yaḥ sa tu siddhagrahaḥ smṛtaḥ | sañjighrāti ca yo gandhān rasām̐ścākhādayatyapi ||53 || samunmādyati kṣipraṃ ca sa jñeyo rākṣaso grahaḥ | gandharvāścāpi yaṃ divyāḥ saṃviśanti naraṃ priyam ||54|| unmādyati sa tu kṣipraṃ graho gāndharva eva saḥ | adhirohanti yaṃ nityaṃ piśācāḥ puruṣaṃ prati |||55|| unmādyati sa tu kṣipraṃ grahaḥ paiśāca eva saḥ | āviśanti ca yaṃ yakṣāḥ puruṣaṃ kālaparyaye ||56|| unmādyati sa tu kṣipraṃ jñeyo yakṣagrahastu saḥ | doṣo grahaśca vaiklavyaṃ bhayaṃ ca ghoradarśanam ||57|| kaścit krīḍitukāmo vai bhoktukāmastathāparaḥ | abhikāmastathaivānya ityeṣaḥ trividho grahaḥ ||58|| yāvadvārdhakyasaṃveśo bhavantyete grahā nṝṇām | ataḥ paraṃ dehināṃ tu grahatulyo bhavejjvaraḥ ||59|| saṃyamitendriyaṃ bhaktaṃ śuciṃ nipyamatandritam | āstikaṃ śraddadhānaṃ ca varjayanti grahāḥ sadā ||2.32.60|| na spṛśanti grahā bhaktān satīḥ sādhūn praśīlinaḥ | atha svāhābravīt skando mama putro’si vai priyaḥ |||61|| dehi me śāśvataṃ vāsaṃ vastuṃ putra sahāgninā | skandaḥ prāha dvijairmantraiḥ stutaṃ havyaṃ ca kavyakam ||62|| hoṣyatyagnau sadā svāhetyuktvā vāsaḥ sadāstu te | yatra gṛhaṃ na havanaṃ tatra tvaṃ graharūpiṇī ||63|| bhaviṣyasi na sandehaḥ pañcake pañcakhādinī | ityuktā vahninā sārdhaṃ svāhā vasati nityadā ||64|| ityevaṃ te grahāḥ proktā vināśakāḥ kvacit kvacit | tasmātte pūjanīyā vai santuṣṭāḥ sukhadāḥ smṛtāḥ ||65|| gopālakṛṣṇaḥ phālgunyāmaṣṭamyāṃ tatsamarcanam | kārayāmāsa mantraiśca tattadbalipradānakaiḥ ||66|| pāyasaiḥ polikābhiśca śākairbharjitasatkaṇaiḥ | havyaiḥ kavyairgrahān sarvān tarpayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ||67|| atha skandastathā kṛtvā vinatā pūtanādikāḥ | dityaditipiśācyaśca surabhiḥ śakunistathā || 68|| saramā kadrukī gandharvāpsarasāṃ ca mātaraḥ | dhātrī raktāyanī devapitṛsiddhagrahāstathā |||69|| paiśācarakṣogāndharvā yakṣāḥ kāmā jvarāstathā | svāhāścetyapare vaṃśāḥ ṣaḍviṃśatigaṇāśca te ||2.32.70|| pratyakṣāścāyayurvyomnā cāvateruḥ sarovare | yatra pūjā bhavatyeṣā saumyarūpadharāśca te ||71|| pūjāṃ prāpya baliṃ dugdhapākādi prāpya sarvathā | tṛptāśca tuṣṭuvurnārāyaṇaṃ śrīparameśvaram ||72|| vayaṃ nārāyaṇa viṣṇo duṣṭakāryakarā grahāḥ | pāpapāraṃ na yāsyāmastathaiva nirmitā yataḥ ||73|| tarema tu yathā māyāsāgaraṃ tatkṛpāṃ kuru | kṣamasva duṣṭabhāvānāmaparādhān sadā hi naḥ |74|| yatra nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇastatra nāsmatprapīḍanam | nātra kṣetre praviśāmaḥ pīḍanārthaṃ kadācana ||75 || kurvasmānpāvanān kṛṣṇa caraṇāmṛtadānataḥ | tvaṃ grahāṇāṃ graho devo niyāmakaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||76|| vāsaṃ tvaccaraṇe dehi pāvayitvā sadā śubhān | prapannāḥ smastava cāṃke gṛhāṇa naḥ svakiṃkarān ||77|| ityabhyarthya nipetuste pādayoḥ śrīharestadā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇenādbhiḥ susaṃskṛtāḥ ||78|| prokṣitāḥ pāvitāścāpi jalapānena tarpitāḥ | spṛṣṭāśca bhojitāḥ sarve divyabhāvaṃ tadā gatāḥ ||79|| ujjvalā devarūpāste yathā vai pārṣadā hareḥ | tataḥ prāha haristām̐śca divyarūpaiḥ sarastaṭe ||2.32.80 || nityaṃ vasantu cātraiva nirātaṃkā nirāmayāḥ | nirupadravarūpāśca sadā śreyaskarāḥ surāḥ ||8 1|| grahatīrthaṃ dakṣiṇe’tra taṭe khyātaṃ bhaviṣyati | sadā vaḥ pratimāścātra pūjayiṣyanti ye janāḥ ||82|| deśāntarasthitānāṃ vai teṣāṃ vaṃśajabālakāḥ | mā pīḍyantāṃ bhavadbhirvai deśāntaragatairapi ||83 || atha dvitīyarūpaiśca vicarantu mahīmimām | yathākāryaṃ prakurvantu grahakṛtyaṃ niyāmitam ||84|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ daśayojanavistṛtam | vihāyānyatra vai chidre sati kurvantu dharṣaṇam ||85|| tatrāpi mama bhaktānāṃ mā kurvantu pradharṣaṇam | brahmaśīlavratānāṃ ca mā kurvantu pradharṣaṇam ||86|| satāṃ satīnāṃ viprāṇāṃ brahmiṣṭhānāṃ na dharṣaṇam | kurvantu tapatāṃ cāpi vratināṃ puṇyakarmaṇām ||87|| gobhūdevasatāṃ sevāṃ prakurvatāṃ ca nāpi vai | śucīnāṃ yogināṃ cāpi bhaktijuṣāṃ kuṭumbinām ||88 pradharṣaṇaṃ pīḍanaṃ vā kurvantu naiva sarvathā | nāstikānāṃ nindakānāṃ piśunānāṃ tu dharṣaṇam ||89 hiṃsakānāṃ matsariṇāṃ duṣṭānāṃ tvācarantu tat | adaivānāṃ cāpitṝṇāmanagnīnāṃ pradharṣaṇam ||2.32.90 caurāṇāṃ madyapānāṃ ca paraduḥkhapradāyinām | khalānāṃ dharmahīnānāṃ kurvantu dharṣaṇaṃ muhuḥ ||9 1 anyāyināṃ paranyāsabhakṣiṇāṃ bhedināṃ tathā | bhavatyo dharṣaṇaṃ kurvantu satkāryavirodhinām || 92 kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ mahādivyaṃ sukhātmakam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇatulyaṃ puṇyapāpavivarjitam ||93 brahmārpaṇamayaṃ mokṣabhūmikaṃ mannivāsanam | tatra muktasvarūpāśca nivasantu madāśraye ||94| gururme lomaśastvatra mantraṃ dāsyati me tu vaḥ | yāntu tatra manuṃ prāpya tiṣṭhantu vaiṣṇavā grahāḥ || 95| ityuktāste grahāḥ sarve dvedhārūpāḥ śubhāśubhāḥ | babhūvuḥ kṛṣṇasaṃkalpāt chāyātmāno hyasaukhyakāḥ || 96|| mūlarūpāstu te divyāḥ prayayurlomaśāśramam | lomaśaḥ pradadau mantraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakam ||97| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | srajaṃ ca taulasīṃ kaṇṭhe dadau tebhyaḥ supuṇḍrakam || 98|. evaṃ te vaiṣṇavā bhūtvā tasthuścāśvasarastaṭe | chāyātmāno yayurdeśāntarāṇīṣṭāni yāni vai || 99|| ityevaṃ bhagavān sarvagrahaśāntiṃ cakāra ha | bhaktānāṃ sukhadāste ca muktāḥ śreyaskarāḥ sadā || 2.32.10 0|| ityevaṃ rādhike divyaścamatkāra udāhṛtaḥ | śṛṇuyāttaṃ paṭhedvā yastasya mokṣo bhavet sukham || 10 1|| dhanadhānyapaśupakṣidhanāni ca bahūnyapi | putrapautrasutāputratadvaṃśāśca nirāmayāḥ || 1 02|| bhaviṣyanti devatulyāḥ sarvānandapariplutāḥ | sarvetivarjitā dvandvavarjitāḥ svargavigrahāḥ || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bālagrahādīnāṃ pūjane teṣāṃ pratyakṣāgamanaṃ teṣāṃ nāmarūpādibhirvarṇanaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā dvātriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 32 ||
<2.33> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca caturthe vatsare bhādrapade’ṣṭamyā dine kṛtam | rādhike śrīharikṛṣṇacaritraṃ kathayāmi te || 1 || kuṃkumavāpikānāryaḥ kanyakāścāpi koṭiśaḥ | vrataṃ ca ṛṣipañcamyāścakrurvai ṛṣipūjanam || 2 || rājasvalyasthitau sparśadoṣasaṃsargahānaye | vratāṃgaṃ pūjanaṃ dānaṃ cakruḥ sarvāstataḥ param || 3 || ṣaṣṭhyāṃ gaurīvrataṃ cakrurāvāhya pupujuśca tām | saptamyāṃ bhojayāmāsuḥ pāyasādinivedanaiḥ || 4 || aṣṭamyāṃ dūrvayā gaurīṃ pūjayāmāsureva ca | aṣṭavarṣīyakanyānāṃ gaurīrūpeṇa pūjanam || 5 || candanādyaiḥ kuṃkumādyairakṣatādyaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ | śṛṃgārairvividhairvastrairalaṃkārairvibhūṣaṇaiḥ || 6 || phalaiḥ puṣpaiśca miṣṭānnaiḥ pānaistāmbūlakaistathā | iṣṭavastupradānaiśca cakrurnīrājanādikam || 7 || gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ tathā cakruratha gaurīvisarjanam | kartuṃ sarvāḥ striyaḥ kanyā yayuścāśvasarovaram || 8 || gauryāḥ pratimā sarvābhirvṛtā skandheṣu pārthivī | sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyā divyakesaripṛṣṭhagā || 9 || divyāyāṃ śibikāyāṃ ca dhṛtā cāmaracchatriṇī | evaṃ nītvā pratimāṃ śrīgaurīṃ gāyanti yoṣitaḥ || 1 0|| vāditrāṇāṃ ninādāśca bhavantyutsavabodhakāḥ | darśakāśca narā nāryo yayuḥ sahasraśaśca tām || 1 1|| gaurīṃ cānte vīkṣituṃ vai tvaśvapaṭṭottare taṭe | yayau sākaṃ gopikābhiḥ kambharāśrīrhareḥ prasūḥ || 12|| hariṃ bālaṃ saha nītvā gaurīvisarjanotsave | tīre gatvā striyo gaurīṃ sthāpayāmāsurutsukāḥ || 13|| nāvyāropya tadā pūjāṃ pracakruḥ prārthanāṃ tathā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śaṃkaravattu naḥ || 14|| taveva kāntimān kānto bhūyāditi prasīda naḥ | evaṃ samprārthya ca puṣpāñjaliṃ dadustataḥ param || 15|| vāditrāṇāṃ ninādeṣu cakrurjale visarjanam | jayaśabdāstadā svargadvāramāsādya yoṣitām || 16|| devān saṃharṣayāmāsuḥ pitṝm̐ścarṣivarām̐stathā | kṛte visarjane gauryāścamatkāro’bhavattadā || 17|| vyāghraḥ kaścinmahāpuṣṭo vaṭavṛkṣocchrayāyataḥ | akasmādāgatastatra yatra śrībālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 18|| netre prasphārya ca mukhaṃ vyādāya vāsanāṃ sṛjan | karṇāvutthāpya pucchaṃ ca dhunvan romāṇi carma ca || 19|| krodhaṃ pradarśayan pūrvapādāgreṇa mahīṃ likhan | kūrdanaṃ kṛtavān śīghraṃ dhartuṃ śrībālakṛṣṇakam || 20|| stabdhāḥ sarvā narā nāryo niśceṣṭā bhītito’bhavan | garjanayāntarīkṣaṃ ca kampamānaṃ tadābhavat || 21 | vṛkṣāścakampire vāyuḥ kṣaṇaṃ nirgatiko’bhavat | kṣitiḥ kampamayī jātā hṛdayāni cakampire || 22| hāhākāro mahān jāto vyāghre cotpatite tadā | dudruvuḥ parito lokā mṛpyurūpavilokanāḥ || 23| mātā tu kambharālakṣmīḥ prāha gaurī prarakṣatu | anyāśca kanyakāstatra cakrurvai niyamaṃ tadā || 24| rakṣite kṛṣṇakānte’tra pūjāṃ kurmo niśāmukhe | gauryāścāpi ca durgāyāḥ punaḥ sarvopacārakaiḥ || 25| ityevaṃ niyamaṃ cakrurjepurvai śrīnarāyaṇam | tasthurnetre karābhyāṃ ca prāvṛtya draṣṭumakṣamāḥ || 26 | śrīrādhikovāca ka āsīt sa mahāvyāghraḥ sāyaṃ kasmāt samāgataḥ | anyān tyaktvā hi taṃ bālaṃ dhartumeva samudyataḥ || 27|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca raktadeśajaścāsīt śāvadīnasya cānujaḥ | mleccho vai rākṣaso bhrāturvairaniryātanecchukaḥ || 28 || kāmarūpadharo vyomni jale pragatimānapi | araṇye’pi kṛtāvāso vyāghrāyate kvacit kvacit || 29 || janāyate manuṣyeṣu pakṣiṣu vihagāyate | evaṃvidho hi malino malināśaya eva saḥ || 30 | | yadā śrīhariṇā tasya bhrātā cāraktadeśake | hatastadā samudre’yaṃ gata āsīt pravāsakṛt || 31 || abriktadeśe sarito nāvilāyāstaṭādati | viprakṛṣṭe sthale kretuṃ suvarṇādikhanimṛdaḥ || 3 2|| svarṇamṛdaḥ samādāya svagṛhaṃ sa samāgataḥ | śrutavān svāgrajamṛtyuṃ kanyānāṃ haraṇādikam || 33 || gurormṛtyuṃ viplavaṃ ca rājyaṃ jallāvaśaṃ tathā | bālotsavād vaiparītyaṃ balyutsave’pyanarthadam | | 34|| vilokya vaiśasaṃ sarvaṃ cukrodhātiśuśoca ha | rājyaṃ sainyaṃ vyomagatirgururdevī yatiprathāḥ || 35 || samartheṣu satsu nāśo balīyo bhālalekhanam | samarthe bhrātari dravye vipule’bdhiprarakṣite | | 36 || deśe bhaṭairyute nāśo gṛhe eveti śocanam | asainyo’pi samāgatya hatvā videśajo janaḥ || 37|| pakṣiṇā nāśayitvā cākṣatasya tasya sarvathā | kanyakāmātṛharaṇaṃ yatkāryaṃ taddhi śocanam || 38 | | aho śrutvā na me mṛtyurna vā śauryaṃ pravardhate | kiṃ vṛthā jīvanenaivaṃ parābhūtasya dehinaḥ || 39|| ghātayiṣyāmi taṃ śatrumānayiṣyāmi putrikāḥ | yadvā prāṇān pradāsyāmi dhigbalaṃ yad vṛthābalam ||40 || vicintyaivaṃ svarṇanāvaṃ parityajya gṛhādikam | saha nītvā janān naijān bahurūpadharān yatīn | | 41 || saurāṣṭre cāyayau hantuṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram | | 42 || viśālaṃ ca dadarśāsau lomaśasyāśramaṃ śubham | sarvaṃ dadarśa ca muhuśchidraṃ hantuṃ samīkṣate || 43 || nityaṃ carati drugulme vasatyapi drumeṣu ca | sagaṇo bhramati kṣetre naikarūpadharaḥ khalu | |44 | | tatra kecana vṛkṣeṣu kākāyante kvacit kvacit| | gṛdhrāyante tathā cānye vṛkāyante saro’ntike ||45|| śukāyante cāpare tu gavāyante tathetare | kecittu vṛṣabhāyante mārjārāyanta ityapi ||46 || maśakāyante kecicca chidraṃ draṣṭuṃ punaḥ punaḥ | labdhuṃ cāvasaraṃ hantuṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhum ||47|| mīnāyante jale tvanye bālāyante ca kecana | kanyārūpadharāścānye bhavante tatsahāyinaḥ ||48 || evaṃ kṛte’pi kṛṣṇaṃ taṃ hantuṃ chidraṃ na cāpnuvan | tadā nirāśāḥ satataṃ bhūtvā rājānujaṃ krudhā ||49 || prāhurnaiva hi labhyeta chidraṃ varṣaśatairapi | tasmāt prasahya hantavyo yadbhavet tadbhavediti | ||50 || evaṃ tu saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā tvāyayuḥ sarasastaṭe | śataṃ vīrā militvaiva hanmastaṃ rājaghātinam || 51 1 || ekaikena kramād bhāvyaṃ vyāghrarūpeṇa vai śanaiḥ | prathamaṃ kanyakārūpairviśantu strījaneṣu hi || 52 || ityevaṃ tu śataṃ kanyāḥ kanyāsu viviśustadā | hantuṃ śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ taṃ sandhyāyāṃ krūravṛttayaḥ | | 53 || dṛṣṭvā hantuṃ susāralyaṃ strīṣu madhye narāyaṇam | ekalaṃ cārakṣakaṃ ca matvā rājānujaḥ svayam || 54|| vairaniryātanārthāya vyāghraḥ sa prathamo’bhavat | utplutya bālakaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yāvaddhartuṃ gato’suraḥ |||6 5 | | tāvat kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ tatra śarabho’bhūjjanārdanaḥ | jagrāha vyāghrarūpaṃ taṃ vallīdīnaṃ nṛpānujam | | 66 | | gale dhṛtvā harirvyāpādayāmāsāsuraṃ drutam | jayaśabdā harestatrābhavan puṣpapravarṣaṇam ||57|| devaiḥ kṛtaṃ duḥkhahānaṃ strībhiḥ śiro’vatāritam | śāvadīnā mahākālī kanyā gaurīsvarūpiṇī ||58|| svayaṃ śarabhacaraṇe samāgatya nanāma tam | bhagavām̐stu tadā bālo’bhavat strīṣu yathā purā ||19|| vyāghro vyāghrān samutpādya tato mamāra tatra ha | tattīrthaṃ śārabhaṃ tatra jātamaśvasarovare ||2.33.6 0|| yatra snātaṃ ca kṛṣṇena hatvā taṃ tvasuraṃ tadā | atha devī mahākālī kṛṣṇaṃ tuṣṭāva kiṃkarī ||6 1 || mayā jñātaṃ na bhagavan vighnaṃ te yadupasthitam | kṣetrapālena na jñātaṃ kathaṃ kasmādidaṃ nviti ||62|| śrīhariḥ prāha subhage madicchāsīttathāvidhā | hantavyo’yaṃ mayā duṣṭo jānīyānna yathā satī ||63|| kṣetrapālo na jānīyāttathā kāryaṃ mayā yataḥ | tvayā ca kṣetrapālena na jñātaṃ tatpraveśanam ||64|| idānīṃ paśyataṃ kanyāścaitāḥ śataṃ sunūtanāḥ | tatsahāyā asurāste channarūpā bhavanti vai ||65|| hantuṃ māṃ tvāgatāste’tra kramād vyāghrabhavecchavaḥ | hato’yamagraṇīstena trastāśchannā bhavanti te ||66|| devyā ca kṣetrapālena yāvad dṛṣṭāśca kanyakāḥ | abhavan vyāghrarūpāste militā vyāghrajeṣu ca ||67|| devīṃ kanyā hariṃ hantumutpeturyugapattadā | martavyaṃ vā māraṇīyāśceti kṛtvā viniścayam ||68|| tāvat kṛṣṇo yuddhaśaṃkhaṃ dadhmau śīghraṃ bhayaṃkaram | siṃho devīvāhanaśca drāgeva prasamāgataḥ ||69|| vyāghrāṇāṃ ninadāstatra babhūvurviśvabhañjakāḥ | vyāghrāraṇyaṃ samagraṃ tu ninādaiścābhipūritam ||2.33.70|| grahāḥ prakampire vṛkṣā bhūścacāla sarastathā | siṃho’pi garjanāṃ cakre phenāni nyapatad bhuvi || 71 || uḍḍīyante sma ca vyomni phenajālāni garjanāt | tebhya siṃhā vyajāyanta kṣaṇāt pañcaśatāni hi ||72| | siṃhān dṛṣṭvā balivyāghrāḥ kecit siṃhāstadābhavan | siṃhānāṃ vai tadā tatra saṃgrāmo’bhūd bhayaṃkaraḥ ||73 || siṃhasainyobhayayośca ghātanaṃ mukhapannakhaiḥ | āntrāṇāṃ karṣaṇaṃ kaṇṭhacoṣaṇaṃ bahvajāyata ||74|| nārī naiva hi hantavyā cetyabhūd dharmasaṃgaraḥ | siṃhāḥ patanti saṃgrāme hanyante kṛtrimāśca te ||75|| mūlabhūtāstu hanyante śātravāḥ keśarāśrayāḥ | nyūnā bhavanti saṃkhyāyāṃ mṛtāste sarvathā mṛtāḥ ||76 || vardhante ca tadā devīsiṃhā mṛtodbhavāḥ punaḥ | vīkṣituṃ siṃhasaṃgrāmaṃ nṛsiṃho bhagavānapi ||77|| tvāyayau dhāmatastatra garjayan svargamaṇḍalam | krośāt krośaṃ samutpatya vyomni yuddhyanti siṃhajāḥ || 78 || dadarśa bhagavām̐ścāpi jagarjāmbarasaṃsthitaḥ | devīsiṃho yayau cābhi cakre svāgatamambare ||79|| siṃhajāstu tadā siṃhā nijaghnuḥ śeṣato’surān | nipeturvyasavaḥ sarve mṛtāḥ śataṃ puro hareḥ ||2.33.8 0 || tadātmāno hareścānugrahācchrīnṛsiṃhātmani | prayayurvilayaṃ tatra niṣpāpā kṣetrayogataḥ ||8 1 || kṛtrimāścākṛtrimāśca mṛtāste narasiṃhake | layaṃ yātā yayurdhāmni nṛsiṃhena samaṃ tadā || 8 2|| ye devīsiṃhajāścānye śiṣṭāḥ phenodbhavā api | śrīharistannivāsārthaṃ dadau dakṣiṇagaṃ vanam ||8 3 || siṃhāraṇyaṃ tu tajjātaṃ siṃhavāsamayaṃ sadā | vaṃśastvavicalasteṣāṃ bhavediti harirdadau || 84|| varadānaṃ tathā bhojyaṃ vanyaṃ paśukulaṃ dadau | atha vyāghro mṛto yaśca vallīdīnastadā tataḥ ||85|| jātā vyāghrā hyabhavan ye siṃharūpāvidhārakāḥ | hatā api mṛtā naiva tebhyo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||86 || stuvadbhyaḥ pradadau jīvadānaṃ svāsthyaṃ nirāmayam | vāsāraṇyaṃ dadau nityaṃ vyāghrāraṇyaṃ tu taddhyabhūt ||87|| vyāghrāṇāṃ vanayogyānāṃ vaṃśāḥ siṃhairhi miśritāḥ | vyāghrāraṇye tathā siṃhāraṇye syustaddharirdadau ||88 || varadānaṃ ca saurāṣṭre’raṇye vasanti te’niśam | vyāghrāste cāsurā mlecchāḥ siṃhāstu daivikā hi te ||8 9 | | evaṃ vasanti saurāṣṭre dakṣiṇāraṇyakeṣu vai | aśvapaṭṭasarastīre siṃhavyāghramahāmṛdham || 2.33.90 | | yatrābhūnnarasiṃhaśca vyomno yatrāyayau tadā | siṃhavyāghramahātīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ tatprakathyate | | 91 | | yuddhottaraṃ niśārambhe babhūva vṛṣṭiruttamā | bhūtalaṃ svacchatāṃ prāptaṃ sarve svaṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ yayuḥ | | 92 || kanyakāstāstataścakrurvrataṃ pūjāṃ ca jāgaram | durgāyāśca tathā gauryā kṛṣṇarakṣānimittakam | | 93 | | rātryante pūjitāṃ durgāṃ gaurīṃ kṣamāpya vai jale | cakrurvisarjanaṃ durgāgauryostato hariṃ prati || 94|| yayuḥ sarvā darśanārthaṃ menire kṛtakṛtyatām | atha dānāni dattvaiva sampūjya lomaśaṃ gurum | |95 || pitarau pūjayitvā ca cakrurvai pāraṇāṃ tataḥ | yayau kālī svanilayaṃ siṃho’pyadṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ||96|| svasthaṃ cābhūttu saurāṣṭraṃ nirbhayaṃ rādhike tataḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaiṣā camatkṛtiḥ || 97|| śrūyate paṭhyate yena tasya śreyaḥ paraṃ bhavet | aihikaṃ cāpi saubhāgyaṃ bhavet santānatantujam || 98|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne gaurīpūjanavisarjane, vallīdīnākhyavyāghrāsurasya śatena vyāghrasiṃharūpadhāriṇāsuravrajena saha vināśanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā trayastriṃśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 33 ||
<2.34> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ākarṇaya mahāprājñe rādhike pañcamābdikam | camatkāraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyātmātmanaḥ param || 1 || pañcame vatsare prāpte prabhorjanmotsavaṃ pitā | kārayāmāsa vidhivat sarvadevaprapūjanam || 2 || gāndharvāṇāṃ samājaṃ ca yojayāmāsa gāyane | maṇḍapaṃ kārayāmāsa sauvarṇāmbarabhūṣitam || 3 || naikaputtalikāśobhaṃ sarvadṛśyavirājitam | viśvakarmā svayaṃ tatra racayāmāsa devatāḥ || 4 || mayaśca śambaraścāpi dadhatustatsahāyatām | jale sthalyāḥ sthale cāpāṃ pṛthvyāṃ cābdheśca darśanam || 5 || bhittau sabhāsadāṃ cāpi parṣadi yoṣitāṃ tathā | vyomni starasya koṇeṣūdyānānāṃ darśanaṃ yathā || 6 || rājamārge nadīnāṃ ca niḥśreṇyāṃ gartadarśanam | gopure dīrghakoṣṭhānāṃ koṣṭhe gopuradarśanam || 7 || evaṃ vilokane bhrāntā api vaijñānikeśvarāḥ | aśaktāścābhavan gantuṃ mārgadarśakamantarā || 8 || praveśe gamane sthāne niṣadane vilokane | kuṇṭhitavṛttayaścāsan sabhyā vinā tu darśakān || 9 || evaṃvidhe maṇḍape’tra bālakṛṣṇaṃ niṣādya ca | divye siṃhāsane ramye pupūjuḥ parameśvarāḥ || 2.34.1 0|| upadāste dadurdivyāḥ pitā tāḥ pratigṛhya ca | prāsādikaṃ dadau tebhyaḥ putrotsave’tiharṣitaḥ || 11 || evaṃ samarcanaṃ kṛtvā pūruṣāḥ sadasi sthitāḥ | atha devyaḥ samāyātāḥ pūjanārthaṃ harestataḥ || 1 2|| kuṃkumākṣatagandhādyaiḥ puṣpadarbhādibhistathā | aṃkurairvividhaiścāpi navadhānyādibhistathā || 13 || vastrālaṃkārabhūṣādyaiḥ rāmaṇīyakavastubhiḥ | nīrājanairdukhahārāvatāraiḥ samapūjayan || 14|| upadāḥ pradadustāśca bhojyasthālīrnyadhuḥ puraḥ | śarkarāphalabījāni nyadhuḥ rasān purastriyaḥ || 15|| atha pattanavāstavyāḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram | pupūjuḥ kanyakāścāpi hyāśīrvādān dadurdvijāḥ || 16|| yatayo munayaścānyāḥ satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ pativratāḥ | āśīrvādān dadustasmai kṛṣṇāya paramātmane || 17|| atha pūjottaraṃ tatra tasthire gāyakā janāḥ | gāndharvā vādakāścāpi devamānavajātijāḥ || 18|| hāhā hūhūrnāradaśca parvataścitradarśanaḥ | sudarśanastumburuśca viśvāvasuḥ parāvasuḥ || 1 9|| meghasvanastāranādo dharaṇidhro’nugālavaḥ | vaṃśadharastaraṇiko jalaghoṣaśca vaiṇikaḥ || 2.34.20|| āmramañjuścālaṃbuṣo rāṃbheyaḥ śaṃkhakarṭakaḥ | ityete devagāndharvāścūḍavarmapurogamāḥ ||21 || cakrurvai gāyanaṃ tatrotsave maṇḍapavartinaḥ | savāditraṃ tālamānagrāmamūrchādiśobhitam ||22|| athaibhyo bhagavāṃstuṣṭo hīrakamauktikasrajaḥ | dadau tato manuṣyāṇāṃ gandharvā āyayuḥ sabhām || 23 || citrarathaḥ pratolaśca sāraṃgo maṇirañjakaḥ | tāramerustānasainyo jagannātho harītakaḥ || 20|| bāṣpavarṣī dhūmramedhā śaśakundaḥ kapardakaḥ | ete cānye ca gandharvāścakrurgāyanavādane ||25|| tebhyo harirdadau ramyaṃ vibhinnaṃ pāritoṣikam | svarṇarūpyābhūṣaṇāni svarṇamudrāmbarāṇi ca ||26|| atha dānavadaityānāṃ gāndharvā āyayuḥ sabhām | kambukīrtirgālavādo nassvano bhujaghoṣaṇaḥ || 27|| khātadhvāno golabhūpaścaite cakruḥ pragāyanam | tebhyo dadau harirmuktāmaṇipravālamālikāḥ ||28|| atha nāgāścāraṇāśca sūtamāgadhabandinaḥ | brahmabhaṭṭāśca vidyādhrāḥ kinnarāḥ kiṃpumaṃśakāḥ ||29|| āyayuḥ kāvyaracanaiḥ sahitāḥ parṣadi drutam | kauśalyaṃ darśayāmāsuḥ svasvakṛteḥ samājake ||2.34.30|| varṇayāmāsuratyartha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | pitā tebhyo dadau yogyaṃ pāvitoṣikavastukam ||3 1 || nartakyo gāyikāścāpi sagītinṛtyavartanam | cakrurhareḥ pratoṣārthaṃ haristuṣṭo dadau dhanam || 32|| bhūṣāḥ śṛṃgārapātrāṇi dravyāṇi vividhāni ca | mālāmvarāṇi divyāni strīyogyaṃ pāritoṣikam || 33 || evaṃ santoṣitāstatra janmotsave’rthino janāḥ | gateṣu teṣu sarveṣu muktā dhāmanivāsinaḥ || 34|| akṣarāmṛtagolokavaikuṇṭhādinivāsinaḥ | āśīrvādān dadustasmai sveṣṭāya paramātmane || 35|| tān sarvān śrīharikṛṣṇaḥ utthāyotthāya cāsanāt | kṛtvā vakṣasi yugapannaikadhā pariṣasvaje || 36 || bahurūpadharaḥ kṛṣṇo jagrāha puṣpamālikāḥ | candanākṣatacandrāṃśca pūjāṃ taiḥ paritaḥ kṛtām || 37|| tebhyaḥ prāsādikaṃ datvā parihāraṃ cakāra saḥ | sabhāyāḥ parihārānte pitā tebhyastu bhojanam || 38 || dadau naikavidhaṃ pānaṃ tāmbūlaṃ toṣikaṃ tathā | sarve tadutsavaṃ kṛtvā yayurnaijaṃ sthalālayam || 39 | | evaṃ mahotsave jāte jayakāro’bhavanmahān | sarvalokeṣu jayatāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’rbhakaḥ ||2.34.40 || ityevaṃ janavācastvaśrūyanta sarvato bhuvi | mahādāneśvarastvāste śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||4 1 || arthināmarthanāṃ cātikramyārpayati cepsitam | annaṃ pānaṃ bhojanaṃ ca dravyaṃ vastraṃ ca vāhanam ||42|| yadyadiṣṭamādatte’rthī śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇataḥ | ityevaṃ bhuvane jātaṃ yaśo vyāptaṃ janeṣu ca ||43 || śrutvā himagirau dālbhyo bako gavāyanastathā | sālāyanaḥ svastidharmā ṛṣayo vanavāsinaḥ ||44|| sahasraṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tat tapatāṃ vedapāṭhinām | sādhudharmasthitānāṃ tvagjaṭāvalkaladhāriṇām ||45 || siṃhavyāghramṛgahasticarmāmbarapradhāriṇām | āgataṃ tīrthayātrārthaṃ kṛtvā kurusthalāplavam ||46 || puṣkaraṃ siddhabhūmiṃ ca kṛtvā saurāṣṭramāyayau | kecanātrābhavan divyāḥ sādhavo brahmacāriṇaḥ ||47|| vānaprasthāstathānye ca gṛhasthāḥ sādhusadṛśāḥ | tapodharmaratāḥ śāstraviśāradāśca yoginaḥ ||48 || kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ tvāyayuḥ pāvanaṃ param | viśrutaṃ triṣu lokeṣu mokṣadaṃ bhagavatsthalam ||49 || aśvapaṭṭasaro ramyaṃ naikakrośasuvistaram | devakhātaṃ mahāmiṣṭajalaṃ ramyaṃ śaśiprabham || 2.34.50 || sarvatīrthanivāsaṃ ca viśvaṃbharasamāśritam | vilokya sundaraṃ pūrve vanaṃ puṣpaphalānvitam ||5 1 || sarvartusmṛddhamamlānaṃ śāntiṃ te lebhire sthirām | lomaśasyāśramadeśe māyā yatra na vidyate | ||5 2|| āmravaṇe tu ṛṣayaḥ svāsanāni pracakrire | sasnuḥ pūjādikaṃ kṛtvā bubhujire phalāni ca ||53 || atha pradakṣiṇaṃ cakruraśvapaṭṭasarovaram | āyayurlomaśaṃ draṣṭuṃ mahābhāgavataṃ munim ||54|| āśrame sthitavantaṃ ca jambūvṛkṣatalāśrayam | natvā sahasramunayaścātmānaṃ dhanyamāpnuvan ||55 || lomaśaḥ svāgataṃ cakre’rghyāsanavandanādibhiḥ | phalaiḥ pānaiḥ svarṇakadalyādiphalaiḥ subhojanaiḥ ||56 || evamṛṣikṛtaṃ sarvaṃ svāgataṃ jagṛhuśca te | athāyayurhareḥ saudhaṃ draṣṭuṃ śrīparameśvaram ||57|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bālasvarūpiṇam | sahasrarūpadhṛk kṛṣṇo yugapattān suṣasvaje ||58|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpurdālbhyādyāḥ ṛṣayastadā | caturbhujaṃ tathā cāṣṭabhujaṃ sahasrabāhukam ||59 || dadṛśuḥ kecana bālaṃ brahmadhāmagataṃ prabhum | pūjanaṃ pādasalilaṃ vandanaṃ saṃvidhāya te ||2.34.6 0|| yayuḥ pūrvadiśāṃ naijāsanaṃ tvāmravaṇaṃ tataḥ | atha dvitīyadivase bhikṣārthaṃ kṛṣṇamandiram ||6 1 || āyayuste tu ṛṣayastadā śrībālakṛṣṇakaḥ | ghṛtapātraṃ godhūmānāṃ piṣṭapātraṃ ca śarkarām ||62| vyañjanāni tathā tailapātraṃ ca veṣavārakam | dvidalāṃ taṇḍulām̐ścāpi pārśve nyasya haristataḥ ||63 || svahastābhyāṃ dadau tebhyo vipulaṃ ca yatheṣṭakam | ekaikasmādapi pātrād dattaṃ na nyūnatāṃ gatam ||64||| sahasrādhikasādhūnāmṛṣīṇāṃ bhojanāya ca | tadāścaryaṃ tu te jagmuḥ kṛṣṇapratāpavedinaḥ ||65 || gatāste saṃgṛhītvā cāmānnāni subahūnyapi | pācayitvā bubhujire śāntimāpustadāmṛtīm ||66 || atha sāyaṃ hariḥ pitrā sākaṃ sādhusamājakam | draṣṭuṃ tatra gato yatrarṣayaḥ kesaricarmasu ||67|| kṛtāsanā virājante brahmadhyānaparāḥ śubhāḥ | bālakṛṣṇaśca pitaraṃ samuvāca tadā haṭhāt ||68|| sihacarma ca tāta pradāpayāsanāya me | ityuktvā cāṃguliṃ dīrghā kṛtvā tātaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 69 || siṃhacarmaṇaḥ prāptyarthamanurodhaṃ cakāra saḥ | tad dṛṣṭvā ca ṛṣirdālbhyaḥ pitaraṃ prāha vai hasan ||2.34.70 || kimayaṃ cecchati bālaḥ kiṃca vakti punaḥ punaḥ | pitā prāha vṛthā bālaḥ karoti haṭhameva vai ||71 || icchatyayaṃ siṃhacarma yatprāpyaṃ naiva jāyate | dālbhyaḥ prāha kumāra tvaṃ siṃhamāroḍhumicchasi ||72|| siṃho’yaṃ vidyate nainamāroḍhuṃ śakyate’nyakaiḥ | kumāraḥ prāha ca ṛṣe dehi me tvāsanāya tat| ||73 || dālbhyaḥ prāha vanasthānāmṛṣīṇāṃ yogyameva tat | nānyayogyaṃ tataḥ putra dātavyaṃ naiva vidyate ||74|| śrutvā śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha pradehi me | naitad deyamṛṣiḥ prāha tadā śrīmannarāyaṇaḥ ||75|| siṃhaśabdaṃ cakāroccaigarjinārūpamulbaṇam | tacchrutvā carmarūpāste siṃhā vyāghrā mṛgādayaḥ ||76 || sarve sajīvatāṃ prāptāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā | carmoparisthāḥ ṛṣayo nipeturbhūtale’bhitaḥ ||77|| trāsaṃ prāpuḥ satyasiṃhān vyāghrān dṛṣṭvā bhayaṃkarān | dudruvuste tu parito vyāghrāstu garjanādibhiḥ ||78|| araṇyaṃ cāntarīkṣaṃ ca pūrayāmāsurucchritam | āsamudrāntamevaiṣāṃ śabdāścākampayan mahīm ||79|| dhāvamānāḥ śataśaste siṃhāstathā mṛgādayaḥ | yeṣāṃ yeṣāmabhavam̐śca carmāṇyete sajīvakāḥ ||2.34.80|| bhūtvā kṛṣṇapade natvāraṇyaṃ siṃhādayo yayuḥ | dālbhyādyāḥ ṛṣayo yogaistānniroddhaṃ na śekire ||81 || ityevaṃ tu tadā vīkṣya camatkāraṃ hareḥ punaḥ | prapannāḥ pādayorviṣṇornārāyaṇasya te’stuvan ||82|| ekamevādvitīyaṃ yad brahmottamaṃ pracakṣate | taṃ tvāmātmeśvaraṃ viṣṇo praṇatāḥ sma prasīda naḥ ||83|| ekarāṭ saddharmasindho’nādisaṃbhava hṛtsthita | viśvaksena vṛṣāvarta praṇatāḥ sma prasīda naḥ ||84|| śuciśravo’mṛtavārdhe sanātanākṣayākṣara | havyabhuṅ mañjukeśāja praṇatāḥ sma prasīda naḥ ||85|| hṛṣīkeśāgraja puṣpahāsa bāla janārdana | carācaraniyantastvāṃ praṇatāḥ sma prasīda naḥ ||86|| savitustvaṃ vareṇyo’si hiraṇyagarbhasaṃsthitaḥ | vāsudeva kṛpāsindho praṇatāḥ sma prasīda naḥ ||87|| anantāsyānantapādānantaśaktiguṇāśraya | hotaḥ potarhomaheto praṇatāḥ sma prasīda naḥ ||88|| nārāyaṇa parabrahma śrīmadgopālabālaka | kambharāśrīgṛhajanma praṇatāḥ sma prasīda naḥ ||89| | puruṣottama viśvātmannūrdhvakarmana divaspate | sarvasākṣin surāṣṭreśa praṇatāḥ sma prasīda naḥ || 2.34.90 | | sarvebhyaḥ śreyasāṃ dātā devānāṃ daivataṃ mahat | trātā bhartā ca poṣṭā ca śaraṇaṃ bhava naḥ prabho || 91 || yaṃ na paśyanti paśyanto’smādṛśāḥ ṛṣayo’pi ca | tān paśyan bālarūpastvaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhava naḥ prabho || 92|| bhūmādistambaparyantaṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaram | māyājālaṃ kṛtaṃ yena namāmastaṃ śubhārbhakam || 93 || yasyākṣiṇī sūryacandrau yadbāhū bhūmaśaṃkarau | yatpādau kṣīraśukleśau namāmastaṃ kṛpārbhakam | | 94| | āsanāni vinaṣṭāni kesariṇo vanaṃ yayuḥ | āsanārthaṃ bālakṛṣṇa pūryantāṃ no manorathāḥ | |95| | evaṃ stuto’tha bhagavān rādhike prāha vai ṛṣīn | āgacchantu mahābhāgāḥ spṛśantu mama pannakham || 96 || bhavatāṃ tvāsanānyāvirbhaviṣyanti dadhatviha | ityuktāste ṛṣayastu dālbhyabakādayastadā || 97 || paspṛśuḥ śrīharervāmapādāṃguṣṭhaṃ kramāttataḥ | aṃguṣṭhasya nakhāttatra siṃhacarmādi yasya yat || 98 || tattadāvirbabhūvaitajjagrāha munirāṭ tu tat| | sarveṣāṃ tāni carmāṇi śrīhariṇārpitāni vai |.| 99|| tataḥ sarve hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ samarcayan mudā | jagṛhuśca manuṃ tatra gopālakṛṣṇato’khilāḥ | | 2.34.100 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | tilakaṃ tolasīṃ mālāṃ nāma kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam || 101 || vaiṣṇavāḥ ṛṣayo bhūtvā divyadṛṣṭiyujastataḥ | tīrthayātrā samāpyaiva himaśailaṃ punargatāḥ || 10 2|| tattīrthaṃ dālbhyatīrtheti nāmnā pūrvataṭe’bhavat | śrāvaṇātpaṭhanāccāpi bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 103 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhoḥ pañcamābdike mahotsave vividhagandharvāṇāṃ gāyanāni dālbhyabakādisahasrarṣīṇāṃ siṃhavyāghrādicarmabhyaḥ siṃhādīnāṃ sajīvīkaraṇaṃ aṃguṣṭhāttattaccarmāvirbhāvaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 34 ||
<2.35> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya śobhanām | camatkāramayīṃ līlāṃ bhuktimuktipradāyinīm || 1 || ekadā tu naṭāstatrāyayuḥ kailāsadeśajāḥ | naikanāṭyakriyāvijñāḥ samājastabdhatākarāḥ || 2 || bahusādhanasampannāścaindrajālikabodhinaḥ | sahasramānavāstatra pañcaśatāni kanyakāḥ || 3 || śataṃ gajāḥ śataṃ cāśvāḥ śataṃ ca gavayāstathā | śatamuṣṭrā gardabhāśca śataṃ kesariṇo daśa || 4 || vyāghrāśca viṃśatisaṃkhyā bhallukā daśa ityapi | vānarāḥ śatamevāpi haṃsāḥ śukāḥ śataṃ śatam || 5 || śvānastrīṇi śatānyeva gaṇḍakā daśa ityapi | mallāśca viṃśatistatra saṃhatya bahuvistaram || 6 || nāṭyamaṇḍalamūrdhanyaṃ khyātaṃ tad bhūmimaṇḍale | ardhanārīśvarākhyena naṭena paripālitam || 7 || śataṃ tu garuḍāstatra śataṃ cānalapakṣiṇaḥ | kāmarūpadharāḥ sarve kalpadrulabdhabhojanāḥ || 8 || antarīkṣagatayaśca vyomanagaradarśakāḥ | vidyutkalāprayoktāro bahurūpapradarśakāḥ || 9 || vidyante kṛtaśikṣāśca yatra nṛpaśupakṣiṇaḥ | saurāṣṭre kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre tannāṭyamaṇḍalam || 2.35.1 0|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīre cottare samuvāsa ha | kṛtasthānaṃ jalapānaṃ snānaṃ cakāra vāriṣu || 11 || pauṣamāse pūrṇimāyāṃ nāṭyaṃ rātrau cakāra tat | viśālo maṇḍapastatra ramyaḥ krośamito’bhavat || 1 2|| lakṣaśo mānavāstatra draṣṭuṃ saurāṣṭravāsinaḥ | āyayuḥ paritastatra niṣedurdṛṣṭihetave || 13 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśca lomaśo muniḥ | mātā pitā kanyakāśca niṣedurnarayoṣitaḥ || 14|| vidyuddīpā nisargāśca maṇḍapasthitaraśmiṣu | cakāśire candratulyā divābhrāntistadābhavat || 15|| tāvannisargavādyāni tvavādyanta ca maṇḍape | stambhaśirassu miṣṭāni brahmaparṣannibhāni vai || 16|| stambhakumbhīṣu ca tatra babhūvurgītikāḥ śubhāḥ | vyomavāṇīsvarūpiṇyo gāyakairvādakairyutāḥ || 17|| stambhamadhyeṣu lokyante kanyānāmayutāni ca | śrīramākamalāgaurītulyarūpāṇi sarveśaḥ || 18|| vitāneṣu tadā svargaṃ sudharmā cāpi vīkṣyate | alakā cāmṛtā svarṇā hiraṇyā cāśmakā ca pūḥ || 1 9|| kalpaparṣat vilokyante śobhottaravirājitāḥ | vastrabhittiṣu lokyante surā daityāśca dānavāḥ ||2.35.20|| ṛṣayaḥ pannagāśceśāḥ pitaro mānavottamāḥ | nisargadarśanāścaite vilokyante samantataḥ || 21 || kṛtrimaṃ sarvamevedaṃ tvaindrajālikadarśanam | maṇḍape saṃvilokyaiva parṣat stabdhābhavat kṣaṇam || 22|| atha gītiḥ svastivācya nāndīvodhakamaṃgalam | aśrūyata kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastutyātmakaṃ tadā ||23 || jaya jaya jagadiṣṭo jaya jaya jagadiṣṭaḥ | jaya janavandita nanditavadanaḥ kṛtamadaripudamanaḥ | jaya jaya jagadiṣṭaḥ || 24|| jaya puruṣottama muktasuvandita nanditanijaśaraṇaḥ | jaya rādhādhipa jaya kamalādhipa, jaya mādhava dhavagaḥ || 25|| jaya jaḍacetanamadhyakṛtāśraya pāravatīvaraṇaḥ | jaya nārāyaṇa cāmṛtanivasana, brahmaparaṃ hṛdayaḥ ||26 || jaya māṇikyapate’kṣarapālaka suramunipitṛdharaḥ | jaya cātman jaya prabhāpate jaya, kambharāśrītanujaḥ ||27|| jaya gopālatanūdbhavabālaka jaya brahmāṇḍadharaḥ | jaya śaṃkaracaritātmanivedana, vaiṣṇavakaṣṭaharaḥ || 28|| jaya kanyārbudapadmapate priya lakṣmīśvara sukhadaḥ | jaya kuṃkumavāpīdhṛtacaraṇa jaya, cāśvasarastaraṇaḥ ||29|| jaya dhāmādhipate’dhipate jaya mañjulamūrtidharaḥ | jaya cānandanidhe saguṇeśvara, svastikaraḥ sukaraḥ ||2.35.3 0|| jaya saurāṣṭramaṇe hyavatārin haṃsaga janalīlaḥ | jaya sarjaka rakṣaka hāraka jaya, jaḍacetanatanugaḥ || 31 || ityaśrūyanta māṃgalyavācastatra tataḥ param | prastāvakṛt kṛṣṇaveṣo raṅgamadhye hyupasthitaḥ || 32|| nemuḥ pāriṣadā māṃ ca praṇamantaṃ sabheśvaram | avocaṃ ca tadā cāhaṃ nāṭyamādyantagarbhitam || 33 || parabrahma jagadyonirjagadādirajaḥ prabhuḥ | parāvarāṇāṃ paramaḥ sarvalokagurorguruḥ || 34|| kṛpayā lokaśreyo’rthaṃ kambharāgarbhago hyayam | prabhuḥ prabhūṇāṃ paramaścāvatīrṇo’sti bhūtale ||35|| so’yamāyāti bālātmā paśyantu taṃ pareśvaram | ityuktvāhaṃ ca tiṣṭhāmi rādhe bālaṃ pradarśayan || 36|| tāvadbālaḥ kṛṣṇaveṣastatra raṅge samāyayau | dadarśa ca samājastaṃ koṭikoṭyarkasannibham ||37|| athāsya varṣmaṇaḥ koṭikṛṣṇarāmanarāyaṇāḥ | niryayurvāsudevādyā vyūhāścāpi tathārbudāḥ ||38|| bhūmānaśca mahāviṣṇuvairājavedhaso’pi ca | sadāśivo’vatārāśca niryayurbāladehataḥ ||39|| pitaraḥ ṛṣayo devāstattvāni mānavāstathā | nāgā daityā dānavāśca vṛkṣāḥ śailāstathāpagāḥ ||2.35.40|| niryayurjaṅgamā devyo sthiramānasasṛṣṭayaḥ | sarvaṃ pradarśitaṃ bāle kṛṣṇe nārāyaṇe tadā ||41 || samājastaṃ vilokyaiva svaṃ svalokān narāyaṇe | āścaryaṃ paramāpanno jayaśabdānuvāca ha ||42|| athopahāraṃ kṛtvāhamavocaṃ darśakām̐stadā | so’yaṃ bālaḥ paramātmā bhavanmadhye virājate ||43|| śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasya pārśve śrīparameśvaraḥ | ityukto hi mayā yāvajjanastāvannarāyaṇaḥ ||44|| paṭapṛṣṭhe yayau nītvā pāriṣadanamaḥkriyām | athāyayuḥ pāravatī lakṣmīḥ rādhā prabhā puraḥ ||45|| tāvat kiśorarūpo’sau bālakṛṣṇaḥ samāyayau | catasro vandanaṃ cakruḥ patyuḥ pumuttamasya tāḥ ||46|| pādaprakṣālanaṃ cakruḥ papuścaraṇavāri tat | tatastaṃ pūjayāmāsuścakrurnīrājanaṃ tathā ||47|| rājate śrīharistatra svarṇāsane’rpitāñjaliḥ | atha tāḥ śrīharermūrtau catasro’pi layaṃ yayuḥ ||48|| janāḥ punaśca dadṛśuścodbhūtāḥ śrīharestanoḥ | śataṃ ca dvādaśa cāpi codbhūtāḥ śrīhareḥ priyāḥ ||49|| tathā ca dadṛśurlokā lomaśasyāśramaṃ mahat | kanyakāyā hareḥ patnyaḥ koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyakāḥ ||2.35.50|| niryayuḥ śrīharermūrte’rnāṭyavedyāṃ lulophire | raṅgasthāstāḥ svakaṃ rūpaṃ nāṭye dṛṣṭvā tu vismitāḥ |||5 1 || brahmasaraso devyaścāpsaraso niryayurhareḥ | raṅge dṛṣṭvā pāriṣadāḥ satālajayaghoṣaṇām ||52|| cakruḥ prasannāḥ paritaḥ parihārastato’bhavat | athāyayau raṅgapīṭhe śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||53 || kambharāśrīmahālakṣmīsahito bālakṛṣṇavān | datvā devebhya āśīrvādān saputro gṛhaṃ yayau |||54 || evaṃ pradarśya raṅgeśaḥ paṭapṛṣṭhe yayau punaḥ | ityevaṃ rādhike sarvamavatāritvabodhakam ||55|| caritraṃ sampradarśyaiva tatparihāramācarat | athānyad dṛśyamāpede maṇḍape vyomamārgake ||56 || rajjujāleṣu baddheṣu naṭā dṛḍhasuveṣiṇaḥ | śatasaṃkhyāścāvateruḥ pratirajjuṃ vihaṃgamāḥ ||57 || uḍḍayante śatahastān raśmeḥ raśmyantaraṃ prati | chatrābhyāṃ cāpi gacchanti sahasrahastakāmbaram ||58 || rajjuprāntaṃ samādāya kṣipto yāti śatottaram | dhanuṣā śaravat kṣiptaḥ sahasrottaramāyayau |||59|| padbhyāṃ kṣiptaḥ prayātyeva śatahastocchrayaṃ punaḥ | nirālambo’vatarati rajjumadhye’valambate ||2.35.6 0 || vaṃśādvaṃśāntaraṃ yāti sthalāt sthalāntaraṃ ca khe | ekaraśmau ca bahūnāṃ parasparābhiyāyinām ||6 1 || sthālyāṃ dattapadānāṃ ca madhye sannihitātmanām | aspṛṣṭvānyonyamevātra raśmau tvagre pravāsanam ||62 || tata uḍḍayanaṃ prānte prāntāntare’valambanam | madhye vyomnyavalambantaṃ cūmbayitvā janāntaram ||63 || atha rajjuniṣadanoḍḍayanaṃ sarvato diśam | anālambaṃ kareṇāpi padbhyāṃ vānyena carmaṇā ||64 || evamuḍuyanaṃ nāṭye darśayitvā tataśca te | cakruśca gopuraṃ ramyaṃ pañcāśannāṭyaśikṣitāḥ ||65 || dvitīyaṃ gopuraṃ cakruḥ śataṃ caikordhvagaṃ tataḥ | tṛtīyaṃ gopuraṃ cakrustriśataṃ dvitīyopari ||66 || pañcāśatpuruṣā madhye staṃbhadṛśyāstatadābhavan | ityevaṃ ca sudharmāyā gopuraṃ ramaṇīyakam ||67|| kammānikātrayayutaṃ pañcāśanmānavā vyadhuḥ | tatra pārśve sthitāḥ kanyāḥ puttalya iva sarvaśaḥ ||68 || divyarūpadharāḥ sarvāḥ paryo devyaḥ suśobhanāḥ | hastacāmaraśobhāśca saptakalaśamastakāḥ ||69 || śobhante gopure tatra sarvasiddhiparāyaṇāḥ | ityevaṃ gopuraṃ rādhe kārayitvā naṭeśvaraḥ ||2.35.70 || sāmbālikaṃ gajasainyaṃ nyaveśayattadantaram | gataṃ punarnirgataṃ ca yadā pratyekatogajam || 71 || gajaṃ gajaṃ prati tatra gopuramānavastriyaḥ | ūrdhvamutplutya ca śanairavaterurgaje gaje ||7 2 || gajasainyaṃ sāntameva gopurā api santi na | evaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāyatnaṃ mahākauśalyameva ca ||73 || jayakāro’bhavannaṭeśvaranaṭanaṭīkṛte | naitādṛśaṃ purā dṛṣṭaṃ gopuraṃ drakṣyate na vā || 74|| kuṃbhakaṃ tu vināyāmaṃ kaiścit kartuṃ na śakyate | vihāyasagatīnāṃ tu saralā gopurakṛtiḥ ||75|| atha hastyuṣṭrakāśvānāṃ prāsādāstatra nirmitāḥ | sāptabhaumā yatra narā nāryo dolāsu sarvataḥ ||76 || āndolanaṃ prakurvanti sthiraprāsādabhūmiṣu | madhye sopānamārgāśca gavayājavṛṣādijāḥ ||77|| bhūmikāścānalapakṣigāruḍapakṣikalpitāḥ | chatraṃ pannagavaryāṇāṃ raśmayaḥ pannagāśca vai ||78|| śukā haṃsāḥ kūjanaṃ ca kurvanti rajjusaṃsthitāḥ | udyānāni ca paritastadendrajālakāritāḥ ||79|| araṇye vahnijālāni vṛṣṭijālāni cāmbare | vāyuvegāstathā saudhe sūryacandrau ca kṛtrimau ||2.35.80|| saudheṣu vānarāstatrodyānaphalāni bhuñjate | evaṃ pradarśya prāsādān parihāraṃ tadākarot ||81 || atha mallāḥ samāyātā mallayuddhārthamutsukāḥ | vividhaṃ mallayuddhaṃ te narā nāryastadā vyadhuḥ ||82|| parihāraṃ tasya kṛtvā tadā hāsyakaraṃ param | susainyaṃ vānarāṇāṃ vai bhallukānāṃ mahattaram ||83|| mānuṣaveṣayuktānāṃ bhaṭānāṃ śastradhāriṇām | siṃhagardabhagaṇḍakavyāghravāhanayāyinām ||84|| āgataṃ raṅgamadhye tad yatra śvānaḥ śṛgālakāḥ | yuddhavāditrasaṃvādā mahiṣārohiṇastadā ||85|| senāpatiśca śarabhastatsainyaṃ ca parasparam | dvedhā bhūtvā paṭapṛṣṭhe samārebhe mahāraṇam ||86|| yuddhe hatāstadā tatra prāyaśaḥ ṛkṣavānarāḥ | bhallukā gardabhāḥ śvānaḥ śṛgālāḥ siṃhanāśitāḥ ||87|| aindrajālikamevāsīt hataṃ yadyat tadābhavat | satyāstu vānarāḥ ṛkṣā bhallukādyā hatā na vai ||88|| atha tasya parihāraṃ cakre naṭeśvarastataḥ | vyomayuddhaṃ kumārīṇāmabhūttadindrajālakṛt ||89|| hatā bhinnāḥ patantyeva vyomnaḥ kumārikā bhuvi | sarvaṃ kumārikāsainyaṃ hataṃ suptaṃ bhuvastale || 2.35.90|| tadā nārīśvaraḥ senāpatiḥ ruroda vai bahu | aho me kanyakā naṣṭāḥ sarvaṃ sainyaṃ hataṃ mama || 91 || tadā bālaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo jīvayāmāsa kanyakāḥ | rudracchāyā svarūpāstāḥ kanyā raudryaḥ sahasraśaḥ || 92|| navīnā eva bhagavānnirmame aindrajālikāḥ | nārīśvaro mahāścaryaṃ prāpto garvaṃ vimucya ca || 13|| papāta pādayostatra bālakṛṣṇasya vai tadā | parihāraṃ cakārātha dṛśyasyāsya naṭādhipaḥ ||94|| aindrajālikakanyāstāḥ sahasraṃ rudrasannibhāḥ | mumuhuḥ śrīharau tatra vavruśca varadānakam || 95|| tvaṃ nāthāsmatpatiḥ prāṇarakṣako bhava sarvadā | hariḥ prāha tathāstveva lomaśāya nyavedayat || 96|| lomaśasyāśrame tāśca rarakṣa bhagavān svayam | atha siṃhā raṅgabhūmau samānītāstu paṃktiśaḥ || 97|| tasya śikṣakavaryeṇa mukhavyāpādānaṃ tadā | kāritaṃ tanmukhamadhye narā nāṭyakarāstadā ||98|| daduḥ śirāṃsi naijāni tadāścaryaṃ mahaddhyabhūt | atha tatparihāraṃ ca kṛtvā nārīśvaraḥ svayam ||99|| kārayitvā kesariṇo mukhavyāpādanaṃ tadā | svasyaiva mastakaṃ mukhe dadāvāścaryakṛd yathā || 2.35.10 0|| atha tasya mahāgarvaṃ jñātvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | garvavināśanārthāya matiṃ kesariṇe dadau || 101 || ayaṃ me rakṣakastvāste pīḍāṃ nityaṃ karoti hi | tasmādya śirastasya bhakṣayāmi prasahya vai || 1 02|| iti nirṇīya ca ruṣā mukhe dhṛtaṃ tu mastakam | acūrṇayat balānmukhaṃ dṛḍhaṃ pidhāya kesarī || 1 03|| hāhākāro mahānāsīd dṛśyanti śokasāgaraḥ | ruruduśca naṭā naṭyaḥ śataśo’tha sahasraśaḥ || 1 04|| yadyapi ca svayaṃ rudrastvardhanārīśvaraḥ prabhuḥ | naṭeśvaro dadau svasya śiraḥ kālamukhe tadā || 1 05|| nirbhayo’bhūt siddhimām̐śca tathāpi paravaśyatā | devairjñātā svayaṃ tatra cātha kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 106 || bālakaḥ svāsanācchīghramutthāya harasannidhau | jagāma tu satī śaṃbhumaṃke nidhāya śocati || 1 07|| satīmāha pradehyetanmastakaṃ kūrcitaṃ tu yat | hastasparśena vai svasthaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ karomi vai || 1 08|| ityuktvā vāmahastena pasparśa śrīnarāyaṇaḥ | rādhike satvaraṃ śaṃbhoḥ śiraḥ pūrvavadābhavat || 1 09|| śaṃbhurutthāya ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram | praṇanāma prasannaḥ san garvaṃ jahau haraḥ svayam || 2.35.11 0|| atha bālo haraṃ prāha darśanaṃ dehi vai hara | ardhanārīśvaro bhūtvā pāriṣadebhya eva tu || 111 || śaṃbhustadābhavat tatra cārdhanārīśvaraḥ svayam | ardhaṃ nārīsvarūpaṃ cānakhakeśaṃ suśobhanam || 11 2|| keśā jaṭāḥ śmaśrvaśmaśrūḥ stanāstanaṃ tadābhavat | yoniliṃgaṃ vṛṣaṇaikaṃ lomālomaṃ tadābhavat || 113| śāṭīcarma bhūṣaṇābhūṣaṇaṃ rūpaṃ tadābhavat | raṅge taṃ tādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadantaḥ śrīhariṃ tathā || 1 14|| dṛṣṭvā samājaḥ sahasā tutoṣātīva tatkṣaṇe | naṭeśvaraḥ svayaṃ śaṃbhurnaṭāstasya gaṇā ime || 11 5|| paśvādyāstasya bhaktāśca hariṃ toṣayituṃ nanu | āyātā nāṭayavidhaye tuṣṭo hariḥ svayaṃ tataḥ || 11 6|| dadau vāsaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarasyevottare taṭe | divyadehān pracakre tān sarvān naṭān naṭīḥ prabhuḥ || 117 || pāritoṣikamiṣṭaṃ ca paradhāmagatiṃ dadau | tīrthaṃ tannaṭanāṭyākhyaṃ sarvoddhārakaraṃ param || 118 || pāpināṃ tārakaṃ svargapradaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ babhūva ha | śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāpi bhuktirmuktiḥ prajāyate || 11 9|| parihāraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā hariḥ svasyālayaṃ yayau | saurāṣṭramānavā devāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitarastathā || 2.35.120 || anye ca darśakāḥ sarve yayuḥ svasvālayān mudā | ityevaṃ rādhike kṛtvā nāṭyaṃ śrīśaṃkaraḥ svayam || 1 2 1 || nivāsamakarottatra gaṇaiḥ paśupatattribhiḥ | prāṇibhiḥ sarvathā cāśvasarasaścottare vane || 1 22|| vaṭabilvakadambānāmaraṇye vāsamācarat | yāvat pṛthvī sthirā syācca tāvat tatra nivatsyati || 123 || kṛṣṇaveṣastvayā sākaṃ rādhike’dṛśyatāṃ gataḥ | kṛtrimo nāṭyasaudhaśca tadānīṃ vilayaṃ gataḥ ||1 24|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīśaṃkarāya vai | jagādānugrahaṃ kurvan nāṭye ye dehino’tra ca || 1 25|| bhavān gaṇā narā nāryaḥ kanyakāḥ paśupakṣiṇaḥ | sarve bhavantu ca dvedhā kṛpayā mama sarvathā || 126 || divyarūpā mama muktā mama dhāmnyakṣarābhidhe | divyayānaiḥ prayāntyeva caturdhāmuktimāsthitāḥ || 127 || etad dadāmi kṛpayā pāritoṣikamuttamam | anyarūpairvasantvatra vaṭabilvavane sadā || 1 28|| ityevaṃ śrīhariḥ prāha nyūṣurharādayaḥ sadā | vasati śrīhariḥ saudhe śaṃbhoḥ saudhaṃ ca nirmame || 129 || ityevaṃ śaṃkaro devaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim | toṣayituṃ kṛtavāṃśca divyaṃ nāṭyotsavaṃ param || 2.35.130 | | bhagavānapi sarvātmā śaṃbhuṃ toṣayituṃ tadā | bhūtvā tu darśakastatra nāṭyabhūmau sthito’bhavat || 131 || pūrayāmāsa bhaktasya śaṃbhormanorathaṃ hariḥ | bhaktādhīno yataḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’sti rādhike || 1 32|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kailāsīyārdhanārīśvaranāṭyamaṇḍalena kuṃkumavāpyāṃ kṣetre kṛtālaukikānekanāṭyaiḥ prabhuḥ santuṣṭaḥ san śaṃkaragarvagañjano mokṣadaścābhavat, naṭanāṭyatīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 35 ||
<2.36> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca athānyatte pravakṣyāmi camatkāraṃ hareḥ śṛṇu | pañcame vatsare māghe gurorbalaṃ vilokya tu || 1 || gatvā śrīlomaśasyāgre bālakṛṣṇasya śobhanam | pitā hi vidhivad vidyāraṃbhaṃ tenāpyakārayat || 2 || lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ sarasvatīṃ vedānapūjayat | gaṇeśasyārcanaṃ kṛtvā ghṛtahomaṃ cakāra saḥ || 3 || viprān saṃbhojayāmāsa godānāni cakāra ca | sarasvatī prasannā vai sākṣāttadā samāgatā || 4 || mayūrāsanaśobhāḍhyā haste vīṇāṃ nidhāya ca | caturdaśasvarūpābhirvidyākanyābhirarcitā || 5 || sarvābhūṣaṇavastrālaṃkāraśobhāsamanvitā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ samarcya śāradā || 6 || bālakṛṣṇe’dṛśyabhāvamupāgatā hareḥ priyā | tatastasyāstu yāḥ sakhyaḥ śrutayaḥ smṛtayastathā || 7 || ākhyāyikāśca kavitāstarkaśaktiśca kāṇḍikāḥ | mimāṃsāśca samādhiśca viviktiśca kathāstathā || 8 || māntrikī tāntrikī cāpi yāntrikī bhautikī tathā | kalāśca gaṇanāścāpi vinyāsāśca kriyāstathā || 9 || rāsāyanī kalpanā ca sāṃgrāmikīndrajālikā | jyotirmayī ṛcaḥ sāmnī cātharvī ca yajurmayī || 2.36.10|| śābdī chāndasī nairuktī kārṣeyī lekhinī tathā | sāmudrī vāyavī cāpi svāpnī mohinī śākunī || 1 1|| śārīrikī mānasī ca jaiveyī sāmarī tathā | sañjīvanī ca vaivartī cārtavī dhātavī tathā || 12|| cikitsāstramayī divyā saṃhāriṇī ca poṣaṇī | śilpinī bhūstarī tattvaśodhinī khanimārgiṇī || 13|| vaidyatī bahubhavanī sīvanī garbhavedinī | drāviṇī mūrchinī caivamādyā vidyāśca kanyakāḥ || 14|| dhāvalyakāntidhāriṇyaścampakābhāḥ kiśorikāḥ | sarasvatīmanu kṛṣṇe viviśuḥ pratimātmikāḥ || 15|| evaṃ bāle gurodvārā vidyāprāptirabhūttadā | tathāpi lokarītyaiva rekhābhyāsaṃ tadākarot || 16|| akṣarāṇāṃ ca śabdānāmabhyāsaṃ ca tathākarot | vedaśāstrādividyānāṃ nidhānaṃ dṛśyate janaiḥ || 17|| atha tāḥ kanyakāḥ sarvāḥ sevante bahireva tam | antarhitāstu vartante sevante cāntare sadā || 18|| prāvirbhūtāśca vartante sevante kāntameva tam | śāradāyāstu tāḥ sakhyo vavrire śrīnarāyaṇam || 1 9|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇabālaṃ parameśaṃ patiṃ prabhum | samūrtāstāḥ sadā nyūṣurlomaśasyāśrame śubhāḥ || 2.36.20||| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaivājñayā vidyāḥ suśobhanāḥ | nityaṃ bālaḥ prayātyevābhyasanārthaṃ guruṃ prati |||1 || lomaśastaṃ sadā prātaradhyāpayati sārthakam | gṛhṇāti lokavat kṛṣṇo gurustutoṣa cāpyati ||22|| sevāṃ gṛhṇāti kanyāyāṃ tato yāti gṛhaṃ nijam | athaikadā devaguruḥ samāyāllomaśāśramam ||23 || bālakṛṣṇo nanāmainaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ sureḍitam | vṛhaspatistadā buddhiparīkṣārthaṃ hareḥ khalu ||24|| sannidhau lomaśasyaiva papraccha tarkasammitam | guñjābhārasuvarṇasya kati mūlyaṃ bhaved vada ||25|| bālaḥ prāha sthiraṃ cet syād guñjaikamātramūlyakam | yadi syān naikadhā nityaṃ krayavikrayayojitam || 26|| svatvāni parivartante yāvatsaṃkhyāni tatra tu | tāvadguṇaṃ dadātyeva vastu bhinnaṃ vibhinnakam || 27|| lakṣavarṣaṃ koṭivarṣaṃ yāvaddhastagataṃ bhavet | tāvadguṇaṃ bhavenmūlyaṃ tasmādanantamūlyakam || 28|| guñjāmātraṃ suvarṇaṃ tat tadeva parivartate | tatkrītaṃ nūtanaṃ vastu nūtanaṃ nūtanaṃ milet ||29||| evamanantamūlyaṃ tat suvarṇaṃ mīyate guro | śrutvaivaṃ cottaraṃ gurustutoṣa tārkikaṃ ca tam ||2.36.30 || āśīrbhiryojayāmāsa sarvajñaḥ sarvavid bhava | kaumāraṃ pañcāmābdāntaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhavatu puṣṭidam || 31 || vidyodayayutaṃ stātte paugaṇḍaṃ daśamāvadhim | kaiśoramāpañcadaśānmahodayaparaṃ tava ||32|| tataḥ paraṃ yauvanaṃ te tvanantānandabhṛd bhavet | śāśvataṃ jīvanaṃ te’stu sanātanasvarūpatā ||33|| ityevamāśiṣo datvā prāpya pūjāṃ tadā kṛtām | papraccha śrīhariṃ yāsyan varāṭakaṃ mahāsuram || 34 || paścimābdhitaṭasthaṃ ca tapantaṃ tapa uttamam | ahiṃsantaṃ vadan satyaṃ vratamasteyamāsthitam || 39|| brahmacaryaparaṃ sarvaparigrahavivarjitam | śocānvitaṃ ca santuṣṭaṃ svādhyāye ca rataṃ sadā || 36 || brahmaparaṃ samicchantaṃ rājyaṃ saurāṣṭrabhūmayam | samudrotthaṃ sālamālāsuraputraṃ balādhikam || 37|| bhagavannatra saurāṣṭre paścimābdhitaṭāntike | tapatyugraṃ rājyalabdhyai sālaputro varāṭakaḥ || 38 || pañcāgnīm̐stapati grīṣme śiśire tiṣṭhate jale | varṣāsveva tathā cāste vāyvāhāro nirantaram || 39|| śiro bhūmau cāmbare ca pādau kṛtvā divāniśam | omitivyāharannāste rājyārthaṃ sa mahāsuraḥ || 2.36.40 || indreṇaitattapo jñātvā preṣito’haṃ vrajāmyataḥ | upadekṣyāmi taṃ tādṛg yatastapo nivartate ||4 1 | | upadeśaya māṃ tādṛk tannivṛttiryathā bhavet | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’si parameśvaraḥ ||42|| devānāṃ rakṣakaścāsi daityānāṃ damanapradaḥ | tadyathā devaśūlo’yaṃ rājyaṃ nāsādayettathā ||43 || śādhi māṃ bhagavan gatvā kariṣyāmi ca tattathā | śrutvaiva bhagavānāha śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 44 || icchāmyahaṃ ca daityasya taporodho yathā bhavet | sāmnā daityo vāraṇīyo guro tadyogyabodhinā ||45|| kathayāmi daityadharmān daityajñānakriyādikam | tvayā brāhmaṇarūpeṇa hyupadeśaḥ pradīyatām || 46|| prāyo daityā āsurāśca dānavā indriyatṛpāḥ | dehātmavādamāśritya vartante kāmakārataḥ ||47|| daityānāṃ tu balaṃ dharmo yuddhātsampatsamarjanam | prasahya haraṇaṃ kṛtvā svāyattīkaraṇaṃ tathā ||48 || parākramaṃ daityadharmastapo dharmo virāgiṇām | tasmāttapasaḥ pracyāvya dehadharmānnibodhaya ||49|| devadharmavirodhaṃ ca nāstikyaṃ pāpaśūnyatām | hiṃsanaṃ ca puraskṛtya daityadhamānnibodhaya ||2.36.50 || pratyakṣaṃ ca pramāṇaṃ vai paraloko na vidyate | tapaḥphalaṃ sadā phalgu tathā taṃ vai nibodhaya ||5 1 || īśvaraḥ pakṣapātī ca devānāṃ hitakārakaḥ | daitye kāpaṭyamādāya viruddho’stīti bodhaya ||52|| varadāne’pi rājye’pi cānte daityavināśakaḥ | parameśaśca daityena ghātya eveti bodhaya ||53 || ityevaṃ ca samādiṣṭo gururvṛhaspatiḥ svayam | natvā kṛṣṇaṃ hṛdi kṛtvā lomaśaṃ saṃpraṇamya ca ||54|| yayau varāṭakaṃ daityaṃ paścimābdhitaṭasthitam | vipro bhūtvāmbarādevāvatatāra mahāmuniḥ ||55|| tejasā prajvalan saumyaḥ prasādena samanvitaḥ | dhyānamagno’bhavad daityo bhūmiko’mbarapādavān ||56|| vipro vilokayāmāsa śraddhākaṣṭasahaṃ kṣaṇam | tataḥ śanairjagādainaṃ varāṭaka prapaśya mām || 57|| tava kāmaprapūrtyarthaṃ samāgato’smi cāmbarāt | paśya varaya bhadra te kimicchasi vadādhunā ||58|| tvayi sarvaṃ balavati vartate paśya māṃ dvijam | kimanena mahāghorakaṣṭadena tava priyam ||59|| kartavyaṃ tapasā taddhi yadasādhyaṃ balāt kila | balasādhyaṃ balenaiva cāptavyaṃ baladharmiṇā || 2.36.60|| ityuktaḥ sa dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā manasā praṇanāma ha | uvāca vada me sarvaṃ dehi tathepsitaṃ varam ||6 1 || vṛhaspatistadā taṃ tu rādhike samabodhayat | kimicchasi vada kaṣṭaṃ kathaṃ samuhyate nvidam ||62|| āgato’smi varaṃ dātuṃ brāhmaṇo’haṃ sanātanaḥ | śrutvā varāṭakaḥ prāha svāgataṃ dvija te’stu vai ||63|| rājyārthaṃ tu karomyetattapaḥ paramadāruṇam | śādhi māṃ pratapantaṃ ca varaṃ dehi tathāvidham ||64|| yathā saurāṣṭrarājyaṃ ca pravindāmi sukhapradam | śrutvā bṛhaspatiḥ prāha śṛṇu daitya balī bhavān ||65|| kathaṃ kaṣṭaṃ hi sahase tapo dharmo virāgiṇām | rājñāṃ dharmastu samaro nirbalānāṃ vṛṣastapaḥ ||66|| sabalastvaṃ tapastyaktvā samācara parākramam | udyamena prasiddhyanti balināṃ vai manorathāḥ ||67|| tapasā nirbalānāṃ ca dharmeṇa yajvināṃ tathā | sainyena tu nṛpāṇāṃ vai vidyayā viduṣāṃ tathā ||68|| rodanena tu bālānāṃ mohanena tu yoṣitām | kṛcchreṇa tu parādhīnavṛttīnāṃ sevanādibhiḥ ||6 9|| prāyopaveśanenaiva prajānāṃ nṛpatiṃ prati | śatrūṇāṃ ghātanenaiva siddhirbhavati vai dviṣām ||2.36.70|| evaṃ sarvaṃ samālokya yatnaṃ tvaṃ balavān kuru | anyaḥ kaścitpradātā me tapaseti matiṃ tyaja ||7 1 || bhūtvā vai balināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ kṛcchraṃ sahase yadvṛthā| | śarīraṃ balahīnaṃ syād bhogayogyaṃ na vai bhavet | |72|| paradattaṃ prabhuñjānaḥ praśasyate na sarvathā | kṣudhayā tvindriyagrāmaḥ śaithilyaṃ vindati drutam || 73 || vārdhakyaṃ jāyate śīghraṃ yadvā nāśo’pi jāyate | tasmāt kṣudhāṃ parityajya dehapuṣṭiṃ vidhatsva vai || 74| | puṣṭireva paro dharmo bhogā mokṣaḥ paro’tra vai | ānandaḥ sukhavaipulyaṃ svargaṃ vai jīvataḥ smṛtaḥ | | 75 || bhogahīnaṃ gataṃ cāyurdinaṃ vā vyarthameva tat | dehanāśe kathaṃ saukhyaṃ vigataṃ na hi lābhakṛt | | 76 || mṛtyuttaraṃ na cāyāti vāṅmātrakalpitaṃ phalam | anena yanna vai dṛṣṭaṃ pareṇa dṛśyate katham || 77|| atra yogye’pi bhuktaṃ na cāyoge bhujyate katham | grahakāle parityāgaṃ mūrkho mukhyaṃ samīhate || 78 || śarīraṃ cendriyaṃ jīvamanādṛtya svakaṃ sukham | kaṣṭaṃ sahate pāpātmā svaghātī sa tu gīyate ||79|| sukhaghātaścātmaghāto narakaṃ duḥkhavedanam | narakaṃ tvaṃ parityajya nivartasvātmaghātanāt ||2.36.80 || kenāyaṃ dorakaste’tra pragrāhitastapomayaḥ | ātmahiṃsāmayo vyarthaḥ pāpodvegādyaśevadhiḥ || 81 || dehinā dehasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ mantavyaṃ satyameva ca | dehasaṃsargahīnaṃ tu sarvamasatyameva yat ||82|| rāgotsavāśca bhogāśca dehe satyeva santi hi | bhogābhāvastapastattu jaraṭhānāṃ svabhāvajam ||8 3 || balena prāpyate lakṣmīḥ pṛthvī yuddhena cāpyate | bhāgyena cāpyate nārī sampadudyamato matā ||84|| janmato maraṇāntaṃ ca jīvanaṃ na punarbhavaḥ | dṛṣṭaḥ kenāpi tasmāt tvaṃ tapo hitvā sukhaṃ vraja ||85|| janmato jīva ityukto maraṇe mokṣa ucyate | dvayormadhye sukhaṃ svargaṃ dehaścātmāśrayo mataḥ ||86 || vividhā viṣayāstatra bhoktavyā nityadāsura | vinā bhogaṃ gataṃ cāhastadeva hānikārakam ||87|| gataṃ tattu gataṃ naitat punarāyāsyati kvacit | abhuktaṃ ca gataṃ dāne gataṃ tad viphalaṃ nijam ||88|| nijasaukhyapradaṃ yattatsaphalaṃ svasya saukhyadam | na karoti svayaṃ yatnaḥ ko’nyastasmai pradāsyati ||8 9|| tasmāduttiṣṭha dukhāttvaṃ yatnaṃ kuru varāṭaka | puṇyaṃ tu sukhadaṃ karma bhogātmakaṃ ca tanmatam || 2.36.90 || kuru karma sukhadaṃ vai mā tapo duḥkhadaṃ kuru | prasuptasya mukhe naiva kavalaṃ jāyate svataḥ ||91 || prayatasya kare’vaśyaṃ samāyāti dhanādikam | nahi kaścitphaladātā na ca kaścitpareśvaraḥ |||92|| ātmano na paraḥ kaścit kaṃ paraṃ tvaṃ pratīkṣase | tyaja sarvaṃ cendrajālaṃ kuru sannāhamulbaṇam ||93 || bahusainyānvito bhūtvā svāyattīkuru medinīm | ko nijaḥ kaḥ paraśceti yadbhogyaṃ tannijaṃ matam ||94|| yadabhogyaṃ paraṃ tattu tad balādarjayed budhaḥ | abhyudaye’nukūlā ye te dharmā vastuto matāḥ ||986|| tatra ye pratikūlāste parihāryāḥ prayatnataḥ | anukūlān daityavaryān saṃgṛhya rājyamarjaya ||96 || sukhaṃ bhukṣva paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ daityām̐śca sukhinaḥ kuru | yadi te rocate vākyaṃ damanaṃ daitya cintaya ||97|| śukrācāryaṃ tathā cānyān militvā balamāpya ca | īśamanyān vijayasva dānavīyaṃ vṛṣaṃ cara || 98|| mṛṣā pūjā mṛṣā dhyānaṃ saṃyamo’pi mṛṣaiva ca | mṛṣā vrataṃ mṛṣā pāpaṃ mṛṣā svānupayogi ca ||99|| mṛṣā ceśo mṛṣā cāsthā mṛte sarvaṃ mṛṣā mṛṣā | mṛṣā cāśā niṣphalā yā mṛṣā vāṇī hyanarthikā || 2.36.100 || mṛṣā balaṃ vinā śauryaṃ mṛṣā śauryaṃ vinā matim | mṛṣā matirduḥkhaphalā mṛṣā sarvaṃ napuṃsake || 10 1|| yadi cettvaṃ pumānāsse
