maitanmṛṣānugo bhava | yatnasādhyaṃ kuru śīghraṃ mā mṛṣā madvacaḥ kuru || 1 02|| pipīlikāśca kīṭāśca yatante ṛtumāśritāḥ | kaṇān saṃgṛhya balato bhuñjate śītapīḍitāḥ || 1 03|| siṃhā vikramamāsādya labdhvā vanyagajādikam | balena bhuñjate medaṃ medinīṃ bhuṃkṣva tattathā || 1 04|| bhūmirnārī ca sampacca yatnaṃ vinā na labhyate | yaśaḥ śaucaṃ sādhutā ca tapo vinā na labhyate || 1 05|| anyasādhanata tattvaṃ sādhanāntarato na vai | vicārya tvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vai kuru dānavapuṃgava || 106 || haṃsā mānasarastyaktvā samudraṃ yānti yatnataḥ | mauktikānāṃ bhojanāni labhante ca viyanti ca || 1 07|| kākā api paryuṣitaṃ labhante yatnanoditāḥ | nīḍe gatā nāpnuvanti cālasā iva mānavāḥ || 1 08|| karṣukā yatamānāstu labhante sasyajaṃ phalam | nahi tattapasā labhyamannaṃ rājyaṃ ca kāmanā || 10 9|| mukhe dhṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ miṣṭarasaṃ puṣṭiṃ dadāti hi| nahi vahnau ghṛta tṛptiṃ dadāti bhasmatāṃ gatam || 2.36.110 || tvaṃ kathaṃ yauvanaṃ vīryaṃ balaṃ śūnye juhoṣi vai | kiṃ phalaṃ lapsyase tatra coṣare tapaātmani | | 111 || tasmāduttiṣṭha vijñānaṃ mayā dattamupāśraya | dharmaṃ dānavavaryāṇāṃ gṛhāṇa tyaja rogiṇām || 112 || ityukto dānavastena guruṇā rādhike kṣaṇam | vicārya ca tapastyaktvā kṛtārtho’smītyabhāṣata || 113 || yadahaṃ bodhitaḥ satye nirāśāparipanthini | varaṃ dehi yathāhaṃ syāṃ bhūbhṛt tathā kṛpāṃ kuru || 114 || tathāstviti guruḥ prāha tapastatyāja dānava | vipro bṛhaspatistuṣṭastaporodhanasatphalaḥ || 115 || jagāda dānavairyuktaḥ samārabhasva medinīm | svāyattīkartumevāsmāt sthānād rājyaṃ yathā bhavet | | 116 || śubhaṃ bhūyācca sarveṣāṃ tava bhūyād yatheṣṭakam | mama varānusāreṇa bhūbhṛttvaṃ te bhaviṣyati | | 117 || ityuktvā prayayau vipraḥ pūjāṃ nītvā divaṃ prati | varāṭako’pi daityendrān saṃgṛhya mantraṇāṃ vyadhāt | | 118 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhorvidyārambhe sarvavidyāprāptiḥ, buddhiparīkṣā, bṛhaspatikṛto varāṭakadaityāya yatnaśīlatopadeśaḥ, daityasya tapastyāgaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭtriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 36 ||
<2.37> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca atha daityastato rādhe daityānāha mahattamān | pāvadurgaṃ makhkhanaṃ ca saiṃhikeyaṃ ca coṭilam || 1 || dhāreyaṃ ca viśvasanaṃ yoddhṛmukhyānmahābalān | airakaṃ thūrakaṃ nīmbaṃ cairakaṃ barburaṃ tathā || 2 || śālmaliṃ jhimpaṭaṃ kūrciṃ karkaśaṃ gṛñjakaṃ tathā | tamalākaṃ ca laśunaṃ palāṇḍukaṃ ca bhaṃgakīm || 3 || ahiphenaṃ mahājihmaṃ vatsanāgamaphenakam | hirakaṃ viṣakandaṃ ca hyetān daityadhurandharān || 4 || saurāṣṭrarājyalabdhyarthaṃ yuddhārthaṃ samuvāca saḥ | karkaṃ ca kṛkalāsaṃ ca śillakaṃ godhakaṃ tathā || 5 || ghorakhādaṃ vṛkaṃ dvīpaṃ śītadhāraṃ ca nāyakān | mantrāṇārthaṃ ca yuddhārthaṃ prāha varāṭako balī |6 || vipraḥ kaścittu māṃ prāha tapaḥ kaṣṭaṃ mahattaram | niṣkiñcanānāṃ dharmaḥ sa nirbalānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 7 || sabalānāṃ tu samaro dharmo rājyaṃ yato labhet | tasmāt saurāṣṭradeśānāṃ svāyattīkaraṇaṃ yathā || 8 || asmākaṃ daityavaryāṇāṃ tathā syāt kuruta drutam | vinā raṇaṃ na vai bhūmirvinā yūthaṃ na vai jayaḥ || 9 || vinodyogaṃ na vai sampad yūthodyogaraṇāḥ sukhāḥ | asmābhiśca prakartavyaṃ haraṇaṃ sampadāṃ balāt || 2.37.1 0|| saurāṣṭrasya tu deśasya tathā rājyamakaṇṭakam | sarve prāhustadā magnā oṃ bāḍhaṃ vijayo’stu te || 11 || atha paścimavārdhestu samārabhyāsurāstu te | grāmasthān pīḍayāmāsurjahruśca gṛhasampadaḥ || 12|| grāmāṇāṃ tu sahasraṃ vai paścimodadhisannidhau | prasahya daityaiḥ svāyattīkṛtaṃ bhūśca tathottarā || 1 3|| khāḍikāsannidhau svāyattīkṛtā prāyaśaśca taiḥ | śuśrāva rājā khaṭvāṃgaḥ sārvabhaumo’suraiḥ kṛtam || 14|| prajānāmardanaṃ sampaddharaṇaṃ brāhmaṇārdanam | rājyasaṃsthāpanaṃ ceti vijñāya nṛpatīśvaraḥ || 15|| vyomamārgeṇa tu sainyaṃ preṣayāmāsa bhūri saḥ | parito vyūhamāracya yuyudhire ca tadbhaṭāḥ || 16|| daityā api tadā vyomni yuyudhire ca taiḥ saha | astraiḥ śastraiḥ śaraiḥ kuntairbhallaistomaraśaktibhiḥ || 17|| prāsairbāṇaiḥ khaḍgavaryairasibhirmudgarādibhiḥ | parighaiśca gadābhiśca vahnigolaiḥ suraṃgakaiḥ || 18|| jalagolairviṣagolairaśrubāṣpairviṣānilaiḥ | kṣveḍānalaiḥ śītavṛṣṭyā vidyudvṛṣṭyā vihāyasi || 1 9|| jhaṃjhāvātairdhūmavātaiḥ śilāvṛṣṭyā ca pāṃsubhiḥ | parasparaṃ subahvībhiḥ kṛtendrajālasṛṣṭibhiḥ ||2.37.2 0|| māyāprayogakairvyomakṛtrimaputtalaistathā | kṛtrimayānagabhaṭaiḥ sainyāni yuyudhustadā ||21 || naṣṭāstatrāsurāścānye mānavā bahudehinaḥ | parājitā asurāste nirāśā abhavan yadā ||22|| abdhiṃ praviṣṭuṃ cecchanti dhāvamānā itastataḥ | kintu khaṭvāṃgadasainyānyabhitaḥ paritastathā ||23 || bhūmau vyomni jale kṛtvā prākārāṇi samantataḥ | vidyante’to na nirgantuṃ śekurdeśād bahirhi te || 24|| atha mugdhā hi te daityā jīvanecchāparāstadā | aśvapaṭṭasaro divyaṃ viśālaṃ cāpyagādhakam || 25|| vicārya sampradhāvyaiva viviśustajjale talam | manasā te tu rakṣārthaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram ||26|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | kambharānandanaṃ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇabālakam ||27|| karuṇāśevadhiṃ devaṃ śaraṇyaṃ śrīpatiṃ prabhum | uddhārārthaṃ jagatyasmin prādurbhāvagataṃ harim ||28|| dinānātha kṛpāsindho duḥkhoddhārakara prabho | śaraṇāgatarakṣākṛjjīvadānaṃ pradehi naḥ ||29||| khaṭvāṃgadasya sainyāni nāśayantyabhito hi naḥ | aparādhaprakartṝṃstannaḥ prapannānava prabho ||2.37.3 0|| yuddhadharmaṃ samāśritya baladharmaṃ tathāparām | daityadānavarītiṃ ca rājyamāptuṃ kṛtodyamāḥ ||3 1 || tatraiva yadyaparāddhaṃ tava keśava rakṣaya | kṣamāṃ kuru kṛpāsindho śādhi daṇḍaṃ vidhehi ca ||3 2|| ityevaṃ jalamadhyasthāḥ stutiṃ cakruryadāsurāḥ | bālakṛṣṇastadā śaṃkhaṃ dadhmau svasya raṇāṅgaṇe ||3 3 || koṭirūpo’bhavattatra vyomni bhūmau jale’pi ca | vīkṣya sainyāni tatraiva vigarvā hyabhavan kṣaṇāt ||34|| atha senādhipatayo vyomnā taṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ | hariścājñāpayat tām̐śca, mā ghātyāḥ śaraṇāgatāḥ ||35||| jīvagrāhān gṛhītvaiva dāsyāmyetānahaṃ bhaṭāḥ | yathāparādhadaṇḍaṃ vai kariṣyāmi prayāntu śam ||36 || svāgataṃ cāpi satkāraṃ bhojanaṃ pānamityapi | gṛhṇantu lomaśāttvatra guroryogivarācchubhāḥ ||37|| ityuktāste tu sainyānāṃ parihāraṃ vyadhurdrutam | lomaśena yathājñaṃ ca satkṛtā bhojanādibhiḥ ||38|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | iti mantrapradānena vaiṣṇavāste bhaṭāḥ kṛtāḥ || 39 || atha teṣāṃ sannidhau ca lomaśasyāśrame śubhe | niśi daityān samāhūya bālakṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ||2.37.40|| cakre’parādhavaddaṇḍaṃ teṣāṃ vai rādhike yathā | tatra varāṭakaṃ daityaṃ daṇḍaṃ giriṃ vyadhāddhariḥ ||41 || paścime tvabdhitīre sa varāḍo nāma parvataḥ | samabhūcchrīharṣadevīsevitaśca bṛhaspateḥ ||42|| varadānād bhūbhṛdayaṃ parvataḥ samajāyata | pāvadurgaṃ hariścāpi pāvādurgaṃ tu parvatam ||43 || nirmame daṇḍarūpaṃ tatsaurāṣṭrapūrvato diśi | makhkhanaṃ parvataṃ cāpi nirmame makhkhanābhidham ||44|| saiṃheyakaṃ ca siṃhādriṃ coṭilaṃ cāpi parvatam | coṭīlakaṃ nirmame ca dhāreyaṃ dhārarūpiṇam | |45| | viśvasanaṃ ca vai viśvāmitraṃ nāma tu parvatam | cakre śrībhagavām̐steṣāṃ tīrthāvāsena puṇyatā ||46| | śrīnārāyaśaraṇāgateḥ prāptaṃ śubhaṃ phalam | yatra vai munayaḥ santaḥ sadvā vasanti pāvanāḥ | |47|| atha yāsyanti muktiṃ te kalpānte brahmaṇā samam | atha ye’nye’pi daityā vai yoddhārastebhya ityapi | | 48 || dadau daṇḍaṃ vadāmyatra rādhike tūdbhidudbhavam | airakaṃ tu samudre vai stambaṃ patrānvitaṃ tadā | | 49 || kṛtvā dadau varaṃ kuṣṇaprāptiḥ kvacidbhaviṣyati | cairakācāpi 3 vārdhau vāsaṃ stambātmakaṃ dadau | |2.37.50 || thūṭakaṃ kaṇṭakaṃ hastānvitaṃ prākāravad bhuvi | rakṣākaraṃ cakārāpi cirajīvitvamipyapi | | 51 || nimbaṃ kaṭuṃ kṛtaṃ vṛkṣaṃ taṃ rarakṣa nṛpāṃgaṇe | barburaṃ kaṇṭakavyāptaṃ dantadhāvanapādapam | | 52 || nadīśailāditīrtheṣu nyavāsayacchubhāśrayam | śālmaliṃ parvate’raṇye mṛduruphalabhūṣitam ||53 | | vṛkṣaṃ kṛtvā dadāvasmai ruphalaṃ caupadhānikam | tūlairbhavati sarvatra sukhadaṃ śreṣṭhināṃ hi tat ||54|| atha vai jhimpaṭaṃ stambaṃ śalākāḍhyaṃ cakāra saḥ | dīrghā mārjanikā yeṣāṃ bhavanti hyupakārikāḥ | |55|| kūrciṃ kharjanikāvallīṃ cakāra bhagavān vane | karkaṭaṃ cātikaṭukaṃ vallīrūpaṃ vyadhātprabhuḥ |||56|| gṛñjakaṃ ca tamālaṃ ca dhūmrapānārthakaṃ vyadhāt | laśunaṃ ca palāṇḍuṃ ca kandarūpe vyadhātprabhuḥ ||57 | | ahiphenaṃ mahājihmaṃ bhaṃgāṃ ca vatsanāgakam | viṣarūpān vyadhāt kṛṣṇo’phenakaṃ kṣārakaṃ vyadhāt | |58 || hīrakaṃ khanijanyaṃ tu viṣāktaṃ kaṃkaraṃ vyadhāt | viṣakandaṃ bhūmigarbhaṃ vyadhātkandaṃ vināśakam || 99|| kṛkalāsaṃ śillakaṃ godhakaṃ karkaṃ sarīsṛpān | ghorakhādaṃ vṛkaṃ dvīpaṃ śitadhāraṃ paśūn vyadhāt || 2.37.60 || tānsarvānasurān kṛṣānārāyaṇaḥ pṛthak pṛthak | āvāsayad vane bhūmau jale vṛkṣe ca bhittiṣu ||6 1 || ete sarve hyasurāśca vaṃśavistāravardhitāḥ | tīrthayogena tu muktiyogyāḥ kṛtā hi śārṅgiṇā | |62 | | tataḥ prajānāṃ kṣemaṃ ca kuśalaṃ ca vyajāyata | bṛhaspatirmahendraṃ ca yayau prāha varāṭakaḥ | |6 3 | | tāpasā cyāvito yuddhabuddhimāropitastadā | yuddhaṃ cakāra rājyārthaṃ prāpitaḥ śailatāṃ sa hi ||64|| anye’pi ca tathā daityā daṇḍena yamitā dṛḍham | śrutvā śāntiṃ jagāmātha saurāṣṭramabhavat sukham ||65|| evaṃ prabhoḥ śubhaiśvaryaṃ rādhike kathitaṃ tava | satāṃ tīrthaprasaṃgena te vai yāsyanti mokṣaṇam ||66| | athānyatte kathayāmi caritraṃ pāpiśodhakam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya rādhike śṛṇu ||67| | mlecchā ḍaphpharajātīyā aṭavīmanusṛtya ca | samudrayānamārgaiśca nyūṣurgatvā surāṣṭrake ||68|| pāpāḥ pāpasamācārāḥ paśumāṃsādanāstathā | pakṣimatsyāśanāḥ patnīpatidharmavivarjitāḥ ||69|| pāśavīṃ vṛttimārūḍhāḥ parasampatprajīvanāḥ | cauryakarmakarāḥ śaśvat dānadharmādivarjitāḥ ||2.37.70|| yatra kvāpi nivāsāśca parakṣetrānnahārakāḥ | astraśastradharāḥ śvādikrūraprāṇiprapoṣakāḥ ||71 || vyādhadharmaparāḥ śaśvadaṭavyāṃ vāsinaḥ khalāḥ | luṇṭakā mārakāḥ sarvahārakāḥ krūracāriṇaḥ ||72|| śakaṭoṣṭrakharavāhāḥ parabhāgyodaraṃbharāḥ | sasyavināśakāḥ kṛṣikarmakāraprapīḍakāḥ ||73|| sahasramānavāḥ sākṣād yamadūtabhayaṃkarāḥ | madyapānakarāḥ kvāpi manuṣyajñātināśikāḥ ||74|| nirdayā dhūrtatāyuktā devadharmādinindakāḥ | saurāṣṭravāsinaḥ sarvān pīḍayanti sma sarvataḥ ||75|| hāhākāro’bhavad deśe dikṣu vidikṣu tatkṛtaḥ | janāstu pīḍitāstaiśca svaśvapaṭṭasarovaram ||76 || āyayurnijarakṣāyāḥ prārthanārthaṃ hariṃ prati | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||77|| nyavedayan svakāṃ pīḍāṃ tajjātāṃ sarvaghātinīm | śrutvā śrībhagavānāha karomi tasya cauṣadham ||78|| ityuktvā sa prasasmāra cakraṃ svasya sudarśanam | tathā tatkṣetrapālām̐śca kālīṃ mlecchavināśinīm ||79|| ardhanārīśvarasainyaṃ sarvaśastrāstramaṇḍitam | garuḍaṃ ca gajaṃ divyaṃ prasasmāra haristadā ||2.37.80|| āyayuḥ śīghramevaite nemuśca pādayorhareḥ | jñāpayāmāsurājñārthaṃ śrīharistānuvāca ha ||8 1 || mlecchā daphpharajātīyāḥ pīḍayanti surāṣṭrakam | corayanti dhanānnāni kṛṣivastūni sarvathā ||82|| kṛṣeścāpyupakaraṇānyaṭavīsthāni yāni tu | chedayanti suvallyādi vṛkṣān stambān latādikāḥ ||83 || gulmān puṣpaphalāḍhyām̐śca śākakandān haranti ca | patrasasyādidhānyāni cārayanti paśūn nijān ||84|| pakvakaṇiśaśūkām̐śca haranti kṣetrasasyataḥ | ghnanti kvacinmanuṣyām̐śca haranti vṛṣagodhanam ||85|| hariṇām̐śca śaśādīm̐śca mārayanti hi pāpinaḥ | prajājanān prasahyāpi badhvā nayanti vai kvacit ||86|| narān nārīrbālakām̐śca pīḍayanti prajājanān | sahasraśo’tra vartante hyaṭavyāmita uttarām ||87|| diśaṃ yāntvaparādhibhyo daṇḍaṃ dadatu tān yathā | yathā naivaṃ punaḥ kuryuryadvā ghnantu samantataḥ ||88|| ityuktā mūrtimat cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ ca kālikā | ardhanārīśvaraṃ sainyaṃ garuḍaśceti sevakāḥ ||89|| militvā prayayuḥ śīghraṃ dikpharān śāsituṃ tadā | dikpharāste vilokyaitān śikṣakān hantumudyatāḥ ||2.37.90|| prāsatomarabhallaiśca gadāmudgarakhaḍgakaiḥ | bandhūkībhiḥ śaraiścāpi cakrādibhirvyadhurmṛdham ||91 || tadā sainyaṃ tvardhanārīśvarasyaitān jaghāna ha | prāsaistomarabhallādyairgadādaṇḍāsimudgaraiḥ |||9 2|| śarairbāṇaiḥ kṣepaṇaiśca prastarairgolikādibhiḥ | śaktibhiḥ pāśabhedaiśca yuyudhe daphpharaiḥ saha ||9 3 || prāṇaglahaṃ samabhavad yuddhaṃ paramadāruṇam | ubhayoḥ pakṣayorvirā nidrāṃ gacchanti śāśvatīm |||94 || vilokyaivaṃ tadā cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ svayaṃprabham | vahnicakraṃ svayaṃ bhūtvā ḍaphpharānīkamāpatat ||95|| kabandhebhyo mastakāni nikṛntati sma vegataḥ | yasya yasya gale lagnaṃ dvedhā kṛtvā pragacchati ||9 6 || ḍaphpharāste bahavo vai hatāstvanye vidudruvuḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ te śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ||9 7 || śaraṇāgatarakṣā saṃkartavyā prabhuṇā yataḥ | jīvato na hatāḥ śeṣā deśapāraṃ nivāsitāḥ || 98|| śatāni pañca jīvanto yayurnatvānyataḥ sthalam | kintu svakṛtapāpaiste samudre nauprabhañjanāt ||9 9 || jale magnā yayurmṛtyuṃ dapaphanā mlecchajātayaḥ | saurāṣṭraḥ sukhavānāste śrīkṛṣṇasya pratāpataḥ || 2.37.100 || pīḍāḥ sarvā gatā lopaṃ prajāḥ saukhyaṃ samāśritāḥ | sudarśanādyāstatkāryaṃ kṛtvā śrīharisannidhau || 10 1|| sajīvanāḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā divyā ye yuddhamarditāḥ | te’pyāgatya namaścakrustato mūrtau layaṃ gatāḥ || 102| ardhanārīśvarasainyaṃ sarastīre tiro’bhavat | jayakāro’bhavat pṛthvyāmāyudhānāṃ harerapi || 103 || ityetad rādhike bālakṛṣṇasya caritaṃ tava | kathitaṃ śrāvapāṭhābhyāṃ svargamokṣapradaṃ śubham || 104 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne varāṭakākhyāsurasainyādiparājayadaṇḍādikā ḍaphpharajātīyamlecchanāśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 37 ||
<2.38> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hi pañcame | varṣe vaiśākhamāse ca dhavale pūrṇimātithau || 1 || sāyaṃ brahmavāṭikāyāṃ pūrvasyāṃ diśi saṃyayau | kundakusumasaugandhyānilodyāne vayasyayuk || 2 | | itastato viharati ramate yāti bālakaiḥ | prāyaḥ sāyaṃ samayasya sannidhau parameśvaraḥ || 3 | | vāṭikāyāṃ samudbhūtāṃ makāyīṃ jārikāṃ tathā | paśyan haridrasapatrāṃ ḍoḍikākaṇaśobhanām || 4 || gṛhṇana taḍḍoḍikāstāsāṃ vahnau sekaṃ vidhāya ca | bālakaiḥ saha saṃbhukte ḍoḍikānāṃ kaṇām̐stadā || 5 | | atha pārśve pavanaiśca pakvānyāmraphalānyapi | patitāni samādāya bhuṅkte vayasyakaiḥ saha || 6 || nāraṅgisantarāmiṣṭamusambikharjurādakān | bhuṃjate bālakāḥ sarve vāṭikāyāṃ mudānvitā || 7 || athāyayustadā tatra trayo ve rākṣasāḥ khalāḥ | bālarūpā babhūvuste sahacoṣyaṃ pracakrire || 8 || remire bubhujustatra vahante vāhayantyapi | dhāvanti cāpi kūrdanti hasanti hāsayanti ca || 9 | | dhyenādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hantuṃ samicchukaḥ | eko vai rākṣasastatrābhavacchakaṭarūpadhṛk || 2.38.10 || vāṭikāyāṃ plakṣavṛkṣasyādho vāsaṃ vidhāya saḥ | bālakṛṣṇaṃ nāśayituṃ samīkṣate’tirāgataḥ || 11 || dvitīyo rākṣasastatra vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ | bālakā yatra vai kṣetre krīḍāṃ kurvanti tatpuraḥ || 1 2|| gatvā dantaṃ viniṣkāsya ghūṇaṃ krūraṃ pradarśayan | pucchaṃ vidhunvan naijāṃ sa garjanāṃ sampravartayan || 1 3|| dhāvam̐stataścātivegānmārayituṃ samāyayau | bālāste vikarālaṃ vai dṛṣṭvā gantrīṃ vilokya ca || 14|| plakṣaṃ pratyeva śīghraṃ tu dhāvanti sma bhayānvitāḥ | cakruśuḥ śīghramevaitāḥ śakaṭaṃ prāpya vai drutam || 15|| cakrād dhurād yathāmārga gantrī tvāruruhustadā | kṛṣṇastatra prasasmāra kālīkesariṇaṃ drutam || 16|| kālyāḥ śrīkṣetrapālinyā vāhanaṃ siṃha eva saḥ | tūrṇaṃ tatrāyayau divyo diśo ninādayan dṛḍhaḥ || 17|| garjanāṃ paritaḥ kṛtvā śakaṭasthān praṇamya ca | utplutya sūkara taṃ ca rākṣasaṃ dhṛtavān balāt || 18|| sūkaro’pi tu siṃhena yuyudhe balatastadā | siṃharūpaṃ dadhārātha kṣaṇena garjayan muhuḥ || 19|| ninādayan diśaḥ sarvāḥ pūrayan yuyudhe bhṛśam | kṛtrimasyāsya siṃhasya kiṃ balaṃ kṛtrimaṃ mṛṣā || 2.38.20 || kālīsiṃhena sahasā līlayā vidhṛto gale | kaṭyāṃ ca nakharaistīkṣṇairudare bheditastadā || 21|| vyāpāditaḥ samantāccākrośanmṛtaḥ kṣaṇādanu | tadātmā śrīkālikāyāḥ siṃhe cābhinnatāṃ gataḥ || 22|| athātrāvasare jñātvā śakaṭaṃ ca nirāśrayān | svādhīnān bālakān sarvānambare cocchritaṃ hyabhūt || 22 || ākāśapathamāśritya bālānnāśayituṃ tadā | prakṣiptuṃ bhūtale vyomacaraṃ bhūtvā yayau drutam ||24|| tāvacchrībālakṛṣṇena gurutvaṃ svasya vardhitam | atibhāreṇa śakaṭaṃ bhūtalaṃ pratyavātarat| || 25|| yathā bālā na naśyeyuḥ kṛṣṇastathāvatārayat| | bālakāścāvatīryaiva plakṣamūlaṃ samāśritāḥ || 26||| bālakṛṣṇastato gantryāstriveṇīmūlataḥ kṣitau | pādaṃ vāmaṃ pralambaṃ ca kṛtvātha dakṣiṇaṃ padam || 27|| triveṇyupari saṃsthāpya karābhyāmavalambya tām | yāvat samāvatarituṃ yatate tāvadeva tu || 28||| śakaṭākhyāsureṇādhastriveṇyāḥ kīlako mahān | śaṃkuvad vardhitaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ prahantuṃ tūdarāntare || 29|| triśaṃkukīlakaścātitīkṣṇo dīrgho hariṃ prati | lambamānastīkṣṇadhāro dṛṣṭo vai bālakaistadā ||2.38.3 0 || hariṃ prāhustu te bālā bālakṛṣṇo’pi līlayā | nāvātarad yato yāvadudaraṃ svaṃ rarakṣa vai || 31 || lambamāne vāmapade sakthinī mūlasannidhau | śaṃkustīkṣṇaḥ śakaṭena prasahya sampraveśitaḥ ||32|| sakthimadhyāttadā raktadhārā susrāva rādhike | bālakṛṣṇastadā śīghraṃ samutplutya tu gantrikām || 33 || punaścāvārurohātha jñātvā duṣṭaṃ mahāsuram | hantuṃ punargurutvaṃ ca śailatulyaṃ dadhāra ha || 34|| tena bhāreṇa namitaṃ śakaṭaṃ bhagnameva ca | patitaṃ condhikā ceṣā coṣṭraścakre dharo’rditāḥ ||35|| adṛśyaśailabhāreṇa śakaṭaścūrṇatāṃ gataḥ | visismire’rbhakāḥ sarve’suraśca jīvato hataḥ || 36|| tattejo niḥsṛtaṃ gantryā bālakṛṣṇe tiro’bhavat | athaivaṃ śakaṭaṃ naṣṭaṃ vīkṣya naṣṭaṃ ca sūkaram || 37|| tṛtīyo rākṣaso bālasvarūpastrāsamāvahat | maraṇaṃ tvantikaṃ jñātvāvicārayaddharermṛtim ||38|| kathaṃ bālaḥ prahantavyaścaivameva mayātra vai | vinā śailasvarūpaṃ na bālasyāsya vighātanam || 3 9|| tasmācchailo bhavāmyeva nipatāmi drutaṃ tathā | ityadhyavasya sahasā vyomamārgaṃ gato’bhavat ||2.38.40 || tatra śailasvarūpo’bhūd yāvatpatitumicchati | tāvat kṛṣṇo garuḍaṃ svaṃ prerayāmāsa vegataḥ ||41 || garuḍo divyarūpaśca saprakāśaṃ vihāyasā | uḍḍyamānaḥ padbhyāṃ taṃ śailaṃ jagrāha yatnataḥ ||42|| tāvaddhariṇā cakraṃ svaṃ sudarśanaṃ bahūlbaṇam | jvālāmālābharaṃ śailadāhakaṃ saṃvidhāya ca ||43|| muktaṃ bhūbhṛdadhobhāge śailastena drutaṃ mahān | vidyujjvālānibhacakravahninā dagdhatāṃ gataḥ ||44|| tadbhasma bhūtale vahniyogāt sahāyivāyunā | uḍḍīyoḍḍīya patitaṃ viprakīrṇāsu bhūmiṣu ||45|| gauramṛd sā babhūvāpi pāṇḍurā bhūtalasttare | garuḍaḥ sūkṣmatāṃ prāpya cakraṃ bhūtvā ca śītalam ||46|| svasthānaṃ tu samāyāte kṛṣṇo bālā nirāmayāḥ | nirvighnāḥ sukhinau jātā bālakṛṣṇasya sakthini ||47| | raktaṃ ca niḥsṛtaṃ yattu tatra pṛthvyāṃ svayaṃ tadā | nīrujīkaraṇāyāścoṣadhyāḥ patraraso’rpitaḥ ||48|| śīghraṃ śāntistadā jātā śaṃkucihnaṃ tu sarvadā | dhyānināṃ dhyānayogārthaṃ kṣatarūpaṃ prarakṣitam || 49|| sarvadā rādhike bālakṛṣṇasakthnaḥ śubhāvaham | cihnaṃ tad vidyate mūrtau dhyānāya netravanmahat |||2.38.50||| ārdhanārīśvarabhāvavyañjakaṃ vāmasakthijam | cihnaṃ vai śāśvataṃ dṛṣṭvā kanyā devyastadarcayat ||5 1|| pṛthvī pūjāṃ cakārāsya cihnasya candanādibhiḥ | lomaśādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca dhyāne cihnaṃ dadhustataḥ ||52|| bālāḥ sāyaṃ gṛhaṃ yātāḥ kālī siṃhādisevitā | svasthānaṃ cottarabhūmau sarasastatra saṃyayau ||5 3 || kālikātaśca bālebhyaḥ śrutvā rākṣasaghātanam | pitrādyā vismitāḥ sarve vighnaśāntiṃ vyadhustadā || 54|| dadṛśuḥ sūkaraṃ gantrīcūrṇaṃ ca gaurabhasma ca | rākṣasāste mṛtā yatra tatra gatvā hi mānavāḥ ||55|| āścarye lebhire sarve krośadehaṃ tu sūkaram | gantrīcūrṇaṃ krośalagnaṃ gaurabhasma dviyojanam ||26 || mahāsāmarthyavān bālaḥ kṛṣṇo yena mahāsurāḥ | vighātitāstrayastvete ghātakā bālaghātinaḥ ||57|| samyakkṛtaṃ nihananaṃ tveteṣāṃ bāladehinā | putrāstu rakṣitā naśca vardhantāṃ bālakāḥ sadā ||58 || evamāśīrvacaḥ prāhuḥ prasannā bhejurīśvaram | rādhikā prāha bhagavan rākṣasāḥ ke trayo’pi te ||59|| āsan yairiha cāgatya harernāśo vicintitaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prāha rāśeśi śṛṇu tāṃ puṇyapāvanīm ||2.38.6 0 || kathāṃ dharmavatī ramyāṃ devadrohotthitāṃ parām | pūrvaṃ cintayataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ brahmaṇastvaṇḍajanmanaḥ || 61 | | vālakhilyāḥ samutpannā mānasāḥ śuddharūpiṇaḥ | aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi babhūvuścordhvaretasaḥ ||62|| tatra vanaspatirnāma sarvaśreṣṭho’bhavanmuniḥ | punaścintayatastasya prajākāmasya vedhasaḥ ||63|| sahasraṛṣayo jātā gṛhasthāḥ skannadharmiṇaḥ | sadārā vanavāsaśca rāgadveṣādimānasāḥ | |64|| tatra nabhaspatirnāma gṛhiśreṣṭho’bhavanmuniḥ | punaścintayatastasya rajasā mohitasya tu ||65|| vālakhilyāḥ punarjātāḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrasaṃkhyakāḥ | sarve vai dārasahitāstapaḥsvādhyāyatatparāḥ ||66 || kāmakrodhādihṛdayāḥ snānapūjāparāyaṇāḥ | mahāraṇyanivāsāśca kailāsaśailasannidhau || 67|| ārādhayanti trinetraṃ kṛśā dhamanisantatāḥ | vratopavāsaniratāḥ sahasravarṣatāpasāḥ ||68| teṣu saraspatirnāma vrataśreṣṭho’bhavanmuniḥ | gṛhidharmaparaścāpi yajñasvādhyāyatatparaḥ ||69|| tān samārādhayato’pi naiva tuṣyati śaṃkaraḥ | tadā śrīpārvatī devī sadayā prāha śaṃkaram ||2.38.7 0 || teṣāṃ kleśakṣayaṃ śaṃbho vidhehi kuru me dayām ||7 1 || kathaṃ na dīyate siddhirgate’pyabdasahasrake | śuṣkasnāyvasthidehānāṃ tapatāṃ gṛhadharmiṇām |||72| tacchrutvā śaṃkaraḥ prāha dharmasya gahanāṃ gatim | devi tvaṃ naiva jānāsi na te kāmavivarjitāḥ ||73 || na ca krodhena nirmuktāḥ kevalaṃ mūḍhatāpasāḥ | naite dharmaṃ vijānanti tato na dīyate phalam ||74| | satī prāha kathaṃ hyete kāmakrodhādidūṣitāḥ | me pradarśaya tacchaṃbho paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ||75| | śaṃbhuḥ prāha sati cātra tiṣṭha paśya kutūhalam | ahaṃ gacchāmi tapatāmāśrameṣu kuceṣṭayā ||76|| ityuktvā vastrarahito nagno bhūtvā hi śaṃkaraḥ | vanamālāsugandhāḍhyo yuvā sarvāṃgasundaraḥ ||77| | bhikṣākapālabhṛd dehi bhikṣāmuktvāśramān yayau | taṃ vilokyāśramaprāptaṃ yoṣito brahmavādinām ||78 || surājasasvabhāvaistaṃ nagnaṃ dṛṣṭvā pramohitāḥ | nītvā mūlaṃ phalaṃ bhikṣāṃ gṛhāṇetyantikaṃ yayuḥ ||79|| śaṃbhurbhikṣākapālaṃ tatprasārya bahusādaram | datta bhikṣāṃ śivaṃ vo’stu bhavatīnāṃ tapaḥpriyāḥ ||2.38.8 0 || muhurhasan ceṣṭamānaḥ kurvāṇo liṅgajāgratim | manāṃsi prajahārāsau babhūvustāḥ smarāturāḥ ||8 1 || nāryaḥ prāhustvayā ko’yaṃ vratadharmaḥ prasevyate | nagnena bhikṣuveṣeṇa hṛdyo’si tva subhikṣuka ||82|| ehi tvasmadgṛhān kurmaḥ sevanaṃ mardanaṃ tava | ityūcustāḥ śivaḥ prāha rahasyaṃ me vrataṃ khalu ||83|| na prakāśyaṃ vrataṃ me’tra yūyaṃ yāta gṛhānnijān | nāryaḥ prāhurgṛhānasmākamehi rañjano’si yat ||84|| ityuktvā taṃ jagṛhustāḥ sakāmāḥ pāṇipallavaiḥ | kāciddhaste’parā kaṇṭhe’nyā jānvoritarā hanau ||85|| parā keśeṣu kaṭyāṃ ca pādayoḥ pārśvapṛṣṭhayoḥ | evaṃ viceṣṭitaṃ śaṃbhuṃ tathā kṣobhaṃ ca yoṣitām ||86 || dhyāne te tāpasā vīkṣya tapo vihāya dudruvuḥ | hanyatāmiti saṃbhāṣya kāṣṭhapāṣāṇayaṣṭayaḥ ||87 || nijaghnurvarṣmaṇi śaṃbhostatra trayastu mūrdhajāḥ | vanaspatirmaharṣistu kāṣṭhamādāya satvaram ||88|| nabhaspatistu pāṣāṇaṃ samādāya tadā drutam | saraspatistu saṃgṛhya loṣṭhasya dātrakaṃ drutam ||89 || liṅgaṃ śaṃbhorjāgrataṃ tatpātayāmāsurīśvarāḥ | anye darbhaistathā yaṣṭyā nijaghnuḥ kaṭipārśvataḥ || 2.38.90 || liṅge tu patite śaṃbhustvantardhānaṃ jagāma ha | satīṃ prāpya tadā tasthāvadṛśyaḥ śaṃkarastataḥ || 91 || liṅgaṃ tūtpatya tūtpatya jagatkṣobhaṃ cakāra ha | brahmāṇḍaṃ kṣobhamāpannaṃ śrīśaṃbhurduḥkhito’bhavat || 92|| satī liṅgavihīnaṃ saṃvīkṣya śaśāpa tān dvijān | vanaspatiḥ kāṣṭhabhāvaṃ nabhaspatiḥ śilātmatām || 93 || saraspatirdatrarūpaṃ prāpnuvantu hi nirdayāḥ | mama patyustvaparāddhaṃ bhavadbhistvatiniṣṭhuram || 94|| tato yūyaṃ rākṣasāḥ svaliṅgahīnā bhavantvapi | iti śaptāstrayaste hi pradhānāḥ ṛṣayo drutam || 95|| vanaspatiḥ sarjavṛkṣo’bhavattatra vanāntare | kāmarūpadharaḥ kāṣṭharūpavān rākṣaso’pi saḥ || 96|| nabhaspatirbabhūvāpi śailo dāruvane tadā | kāmarūpadharaḥ kṛṣṇaśilārūpo’pi rākṣasaḥ || 97|| saraspatistadā jāto datrayukto hi sūkaraḥ | liṅgahīno rākṣasaḥ saḥ kāmarūpadharo’pi hi || 98|| trayaste rākṣasā jātā dārudrumavanāntare | anye śaptā vālakhilyāḥ stabakāste jalopari || 99|| samūlā api nirgranthāḥ patramātrasamṛddhayaḥ | aliṅgā jalavāsāste babhūvurjalamastake | | 2.38.100 || apṛthvībhojanāḥ sarve brahmaputranadādiṣu | vālakhilyāḥ stabakāste jalamātraprajīvinaḥ || 101 || śāpakāle duḥkhamagnā manasā tuṣṭuvuḥ satīm | samuddhāro yathāsmākaṃ bhavettat saṃvidhīyatām || 102 || na vayaṃ vidmaḥ sadbhāvaṃ śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ | aparāddhaṃ tato’smābhiḥ śāpānto no vidhīyatām | | 103 || ṛṣipatnyastu rurudustuṣṭuvurmātaraṃ satīm | tadā prāha satī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapareśvaraḥ || 1 04|| saurāṣṭre paścimedeśe kambharāśrīsutaḥ prabhuḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān hariḥ || 1 05|| vartate tasya yogena va uddhāro bhaviṣyati | ṛṣīṇāṃ prasamuddhāraṃ sa prabhuḥ saṃkariṣyati || 106 | | ityuktvādṛśyabhāvaṃ sā gatā suduḥkhitā satī | atha ye ṛṣiputrādyā aparādhavivarjitāḥ || 1 07| | anye’pi carṣayastatra darśakā brāhmaṇādayaḥ | te tu dṛṣṭvā mahākṣobhaṃ brahmāṇḍasya layapradam || 1 08| | brahmāṇaṃ sasmarustatra brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ | devādyāḥ prārthayāmāsurliṃgavahnipraśāntaye || 1 09|| brahmaṇā bodhitāste ca brahmadharmaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ | tejasvinaṃ brahmaniṣṭhaṃ brahmarūpaṃ sanātanam || 2.38.110 || kāmadharmairabaddhaṃ te vijñāya grāmyadharmiṇam | aparāddhaṃ kṛtavantastataḥ kṣobho mahānayam || 111 || liṃgapūjanadharmeṇa śāntimeṣyati nānyathā | aho mugdhāḥ ṛṣayaste krodhasya vaśatāṃ gatāḥ || 112|| dehe cātmani yadbrahma niyataṃ nirmalaṃ ca tat | tapasā karmaṇā vāpi śuddhahṛdo’pi cīyate | | 113 || kāmakrodhādibhāvānāṃ niṣkāsanaṃ hi śuddhatā | tanmanaḥ śodhayeddhīmān jñānayogamupakramaiḥ | | 1 14|| śuddhimāpnoti puruṣaḥ saṃśuddhe yasya vai manaḥ | ṛṣayaḥ krodhakāmābhyāmabhibhūtāśrame sthitāḥ || 115 || kāmakrodhābhibhūtānāṃ yajño dānaṃ vṛṣastapaḥ | vrataṃ kṛcchra dhṛtirdhyānaṃ sarvaṃ niṣphalatāṃ vrajet | | 116 || tasmāt prayāntu tatsthānaṃ kāmakrodhau vihāya ca | ārādhayantu taṃ devaṃ śaṃkaraṃ kāmabhāsinam || 1 17|| liṃgaṃ prapūjayantveva tataḥ śāntirbhaviṣyati | ityuktāḥ prayayuḥ sarve liṅgaṃ pupūjurādarāt || 1 18|| yathāsthānaṃ ca tallagnaṃ saliṃgaḥ śaṃkaro’bhavat | yatraitat patitaṃ tatra jyotirliṃgāni jajñire || 11 9|| dvādaśadhā tu tadbhinnaṃ divyaṃ mokṣapradaṃ hi tat | ityeva śāntimāpede jagat sarvaṃ hi rādhike || 2.38.12 0| | atha te’pi trimunayaḥ śāpajā rākṣasāḥ khalu | jātismarāḥ svamokṣorthe saurāṣṭraṃ tvāyayustataḥ || 121 || vanaspatiḥ kāṣṭharūpaḥ śakaṭātmā vyajāyata | nabhaspatiḥ śilārūpaḥ parvataḥ samajāyata || 122 || saraspatirdantamām̐śca sūkaraḥ samajāyata | hareḥ kṛṣṇasya yogena muktāḥ śāpāttadābhavan || 123 || astuvam̐ste hariṃ divyāḥ ṛṣayo vai tapodhanāḥ | śeṣarṣīṇāṃ tu sarveṣāmuddhārārthaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 1 24|| tadā śrībhagavānāha yāntu tatrāpyahaṃ śubham | dāruvanaṃ samāgatyoddhārayiṣyāmi śāpataḥ || 125|| garuḍaṃ tu samāruhya bhagavān bālakṛṣṇakaḥ | vālakhilyastambarūpānuddadhāra hariḥ svayam || 1 26|| sarve te dāruvanajāstapaḥ kurvanti rādhike | tataḥ śāntārayaḥ sarve’bhavan ṛṣisvarūpiṇaḥ || 1 27|| tadvaṃśā vālakhilyāśca stambā bhavanti vāriṣu | hariruddhārayitvā tān prāpya pūjanamādarāt || 1 28|| āyayau kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ svaṃ garuḍānvitaḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇād rādhe śāpapāpaṃ praśāmyati || 129 || āścaryaṃ bhaktiyukteṣu rākṣasatve hyupasthite | dveṣabhāvena muktirvai devamāyā hi tādṛśī || 2.38.13 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vanaspatinabhaspatisaraspatimaharṣīṇāṃ satīśāpād rākṣasabhāvamāpannānāṃ vāṭikāyāmupadravaḥ, prabhuṇā śāpamokṣaṇaṃ, nagnaśaṃkarasya tāpasāśrameṣu bhramaṇaṃ ṛṣikṛtāparādhaḥ liṃgapātanaṃ śāpakāraṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 38 ||
<2.39> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike jñānaṃ tapo yasmānna śiṣyate | pūrvamekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame || 1 || bṛhadaṇḍamabhūdekaṃ prajānāṃ bījasaṃbhṛtam | mahāviṣṇoḥ samudbhūtaṃ yasmin virāḍ virājate || 2 || aṇḍaṃ vibhidya bhagavān vairājaṃ bahirānayat | vairājāt triguṇā devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || 3 || sattvavān vai tadā brahmā śūnyaṃ lokamapaśyata | tato rājasabhāvena pravṛttiṃ svīcakāra ha || 4 || sasmāra darśakaṃ divyaṃ nārāyaṇamatīndriyam | guṇātītaṃ bhagavantaṃ vyāpakaṃ puruṣaṃ param || 5 || yenedaṃ sakalaṃ vyāptaṃ sthiracetanasaṃjñitam | yastaṃ veda mahātmānaṃ sa sarvaṃ ved niścitam || 6 || guṇātītaṃ ca puruṣaṃ parabrahma sanātanam | yastaṃ veda parātmānaṃ sa sarvaṃ veda mokṣavit || 7 || kiṃ teṣāṃ sakalaistīthaiṃrāśramairvā prayojanam | yeṣāṃ tvanantakaṃ cittamātmanyeva vyavasthitam || 8 || ātmā nadī śīlatīrthā satyajalā śamānvitā | tatsnātaḥ śuddhyati puṇyo vāriṇātmā na śuddhyati || 9 || śreṣṭhaṃ janasya kartavyaṃ cātmavodhasukhe sthitiḥ | jñeyaṃ satāṃ tadevāsti yatprāptau kāmanākṣayaḥ || 2.39.1 0|| naitādṛśaṃ paraṃ vittaṃ brahmalagnasya vidyate | samatā satyatā śīlaṃ cārjavaṃ viratistathā || 11 || tallābhe brahma paramaṃ prāpnotyeva na saśaṃyaḥ | viditvā taṃ prabhuṃ rādhe dharmasya phalamāpnuyāt || 1 2|| yo’sāvāpmani dehe’smin vibhurnityo vyavasthitaḥ | so’nādiḥ śrīpatiḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ parātparaḥ || 12 || kambharāśrīnandanaḥ saḥ śrīmadgopālabālakaḥ | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre vartate bālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 14|| pañcame vatsare pūrṇe yāvastaṃ vīkṣituṃ priye | ityuktā rādhikā devī sotsāhā veṣamujjvalam || 1 5|| dadhāra sarvaśobhāḍhyaṃ svarṇamāṇikyasaṃbhṛtam | mauktikairhīrakaiḥ ratnaiḥ khacitaṃ śobhanaṃ śubham || 1 6|| śṛṃgāraṃ vividhaṃ dhṛtvā sugandhasāramiśritam | bindvīpatrīraṅgarekhālaktakajjalabṛṃhitam || 17|| tantutantīśṛṃkhalormikāmbarābhūṣaṇānvitam | svarṇacūrṇapuṣpagucchakabarībhāraśobhitam || 18 || sanaktakārcanavastubhatapātrakarā patim | kṛṣṇaṃ śṛṃgārayāmāsa suśobhaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ śubham || 1 9|| vimānaṃ vṛṣayānaṃ ca vāhayāmāsa satvaram | phalapuṣpaiḥ svādubhojyairamṛtairbhṛtapātrakam || 2.39.2 0 || svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sārathiśca śrīrādhā rathinī svayam | śrīmadgolokadhāmnastāvīśalokān vilaṃghya ca || 21 || brahmādistaramullaṃghya bhūtale tu surāṣṭrake | vyomno’vataret rādhākṛṣṇau kuṃkumavāpikām || 22|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīre bālakṛṣṇālayāṅgaṇe | śrīkṛṣṇasya rathasyādau brahmāṇḍe vyāpa tanmahaḥ || 23 || sūryacandrau na dṛśyete tejasābhibhavaṃgatau | rādhāyāstejasā pṛthvī diśaścātyupabṛṃhitāḥ || 24|| lomaśasyāśramaścāpi cāndraloka ivābhavat | sarvāśca kanyakā rādhārūpātirūpakānvitāḥ || 25 | | rājante rādhikāṃ dṛṣṭvā śatarādhādhikaikakā | rādhā dṛṣṭvā tu tāḥ kanyā garvahīnā babhūva ha || 26|| galitaṃ rūpasaundaryamānaṃ tasyāstadā kṣaṇāt | uttha kṛṣṇaṃ prati prāha bālakṛṣṇaṃ vilokya sā || 27|| aho me vyaktisāphalyaṃ kāritaṃ hi tvayā prabho | mayāsya darśanaṃ prāptaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya yat || 28 || ṣaṣṭhavarṣasamāraṃbhe prātaraṣṭamikātithau | bālakṛṣṇaṃ rā dhikā saṃpūjayāmāsa vastubhiḥ || 29 || golokapayasā bālaṃ snāpayāmāsa rādhikā | sarvatīrthādisalilairabhiṣekaṃ cakāra sā || 2.39.30 || candanāgurukastūrīrasasāradravādibhiḥ | sampūjyābharaṇairvastrairalaṃkārairaśobhayat || 31 || ārārtrikaṃ cakārātha mayūrapicchaśobhanam | mukuṭaṃ dhārayāmāsa bālakṛṣṇasya mastake || 3 2|| muralīṃ sā dadau haste dakṣabāhuṃ dadau gale | hāsayitvā sutilakaṃ candrakaṃ sākṣataṃ śubham || 32 || bhāle datvā rādhikā sā nīrājanavidhiṃ vyadhāt | puṣpāñjaliṃ pradatvaiva namaskāraṃ cakāra sā || 34 || āśīrvādān dadau kāntakānta tvaṃ kāntavadbhava | duḥsahāṃ cāñjaliṃ rādhā samuccārya ca mastakāt || 35|| dadau bhojyaṃ ca golokādānītaṃ pāyasādikam | dugdhapiṇḍān baraphīṃśca dugdhasārasya pūrikām || 36 || miṣṭāṃ divyāṃ dadhi śreṣṭhaṃ dadau nānyat tadiṣṭakṛt || bhojayitvā tato ramyaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ dadau śubham || 37 || athaivaṃ samprapūjyaiva virarāma tataḥ svayam | śrīkṛṣṇastaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pupūja sādaram || 38 || suravālaṃ pītapaṭaṃ kañcukaṃ svarṇatārakam | śirastrāṇaṃ sakalgiṃ cāvataṃsakau kausumau śubhau || 3 9|| puṣpahārān pārijātakṛtān dadau gale’rbhakam | upānahau svarṇasādhyau komalau pradadau tathā ||2.39.40 || chatraṃ sucāmare ramye raśanāṃ kuṇḍale dadau | maṇiṃ kaustubhajātīyottamaṃ mālāṃ ca mauktikīm || 41 || dadau śrībālakṛṣṇāya vaṃśī dadau mṛdusvarām | yaṣṭiṃ siddhimayīṃ cāpi dadau siṃhāsanaṃ varam ||42|| evaṃ bālaprabhuṃ kṛṣṇaḥ pūjayitvā stutiṃ vyadhāt | sarvasākṣinnamaste’stu sarvāvatārakāraṇa | | 43 || puruṣottama mukteśa paradhāman namo’stu te | vartamānaṃ ca bhūtaṃ ca bhaviṣyatsarvathā yataḥ ||44|| anvitaṃ rājate saumyaṃ suvyavasthaṃ kramānugam | ananvitaḥ praśāstā tvaṃ tasmai devāya te namaḥ ||45|| anantāḥ śaktayaste’tra kuṣṇanṛsiṃharūpiṣu | rādhāramāśrīsvarūpāstaṃ namāmi pareśvaram ||46 || ahaṃ me dhāma golokastathā nārāyaṇo ramā | śrīrvaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ satpadaṃ yasmātpravartate ||47 | | akṣaraṃ dhāma yasyāgre samūrtaṃ sevakaṃ sadā | īśvarā avatārāśca yadaṃśaguṇabhūṣaṇam ||48|| vyūhāśceśvarapālāśca lokapālā maharṣayaḥ | kratūcchrayāḥ surā yasya guṇaikaikāṃśamūrtayaḥ || 49|| bhavantīha tu saṃsāre taṃ namāmi pareśvaram | antarātmannanantātmanmadātmam̐ste namo namaḥ ||2.39.50|| tvaṃ parātman lokasākṣinnananteśa namo’stu te | sarvajña tvaṃ parameṣṭhin jñānajñeya namo’stu te ||5 1 || ādideva durārādhya parameśvara te namaḥ | mahāyogeśvara sādho dayālo te namo namaḥ ||52|| parajyotirvaṣaṭkāra svāhākāra namo’stu te | sarvadarśana savartāgniṣomātmannamo’stu te ||53|| mahārājika siddhārcya hiraṇyavāha te namaḥ | mañjukeśin bālakeśin dayādeśinnamo’stu te ||54||| vibho yājñika yajñeśa bhaktānukampa te namaḥ | prasīda śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ ||55|| ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇadevo natvā rādhā tathā prabhum | yayatuḥ śrīkambharāyāḥ sannidhau bhuvanāntare ||56|| natvā tāṃ ca tathā natvā śrīmadropālakṛṣṇakam | tatkṛtaṃ svāgataṃ prāpya putrotsavaṃ praśasya ca ||57|| vimānena yayatuśca golokaṃ kṛṣṇarādhike | athāyayau ca vaikuṇṭhānnārāyaṇo ramāpatiḥ ||58|| garuḍasthaḥ prabhurbālakṛṣṇapūjārthamityatha | vāsudevastathā bhūmā cāyayaturmudānvitau ||59|| mahāviṣṇustathā nārāyaṇo naraḥ samāyayuḥ | śeṣanārāyaṇaścāpi matsyaḥ kūrmaḥ samāyayuḥ ||2.39.60 || vārāhaśca kapilaśca hariḥ pṛthuḥ samāyayuḥ | dattātreyastathā haṃso nṛsiṃhaśca samāyayuḥ ||61|| ṛṣabhaśca vāmanaśca parśurāmaḥ samāyayuḥ | yajño rāmaḥ kumārāśca hayagrīvaḥ samāyayuḥ ||62|| nārado rājarājaśca parameśāḥ samāyayuḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jayeti te jaguḥ ||63||| pañcāmṛtairamṛtaiśca bālāṅguṣṭhābhiṣecanam | cakruḥ paścād darbhajalairamṛtaiḥ prokṣaṇaṃ vyadhuḥ ||64|| candanaṃ sākṣataṃ bhāle tvarcayāmāsurādarāt | tilakaṃ kukumāḍhyaṃ ca cakrurdaduḥ sugandhakam || 65|| puṣpahārān daduḥ kaṇṭhe mukuṭaṃ puṣpamālikāḥ | dadustulasīpatrāṇi vibhūṣaṇāni cāmare ||66|| chatraṃ copānahau divye’mbarāṇi vividhānyapi | karpūrādyairvartikābhirnīrājanaṃ pracakrire ||67|| dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ sunaivedyaṃ cāmṛtānnaṃ phalāni ca | daduḥ sarve’vatārāśca jalaṃ tāmbūlakāni ca || 68|| arpayāmāsuratyarthaṃ svasvalokabhavāni ca| ityevaṃ pūjanārthaṃ taddhāmavāsāḥ striyo’pi ca ||69|| āyayurbahubhirvastūttamaiḥ pupūjurīśvaram | evaṃ samarcayitvā tāḥ prayayurnijadhāma te ||2.39.70 || tato devāśca pitaro munayaḥ ṛṣayastathā | mānavā brāhmaṇādyāścāyayuḥ kṛṣṇārcanāya vai ||71 || divyavimānamāruhya cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram | abhito vyomamārgeṣu viśramya kṛṣṇamandiram ||72|| āyayuḥ pūjayāmāsurvividhaiścopadādibhiḥ | rañjayāmāsuratyarthaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram ||73 || tato’nye bhūmayaḥ śailā nadyaḥ sarāṃsi sāgarāḥ | tīrthāni devataravo vallikāḥ stabakāstathā ||74|| vanadevyaśca gulmāśca tattvāni vividhānyapi | āyayuḥ śrībālakṛṣṇapūjārthaṃ cārhaṇāṃ vyadhuḥ |||75|| tato yakṣā guhyakāścāraṇā kiṃpuruṣāstathā | bhāṭāśca kinnarāścāpi gandharvā devayoṣitaḥ ||76|| māgadhā bandinaḥ sūtā vidyādhrāḥ pannagādayaḥ | āyayuḥ śrībālakṛṣṇotsave pūjārthameva te ||77|| pūjanaṃ te pracakruśca nartakā nṛtyamācaran | avādyanta suvādyāni gāyakāḥ saṃjagustadā ||78|| kathakāstatkathāṃ cakrurnāṭyadhrā nāṭyamācaran | yājñikāścācaran yajñaṃ sādhavo japamācaran ||79|| satyo nāryo daduścāśīrvādān vṛddhāḥ śubhāśiṣaḥ | śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaśca lomaśo’pi munistadā ||2.39.80|| tathānye ṛṣayastatra sthitāśca brahmakanyakāḥ | śrīhareḥ pūjanaṃ cakruryojayāmāyurāśiṣā ||8 1 || tataḥ pitā tu tān sarvān mahīmānān samantataḥ | dugdhapākādisadbhojyaistarpayāmāsa laḍḍukaiḥ ||82|| bhojayitvā ca tān sarvānāgatān tatparaṃ hariḥ | dāpayāmāsa dānāni viprān dāsīśca sevakān ||83 || pātrebhyaśca yathāyogyaṃ yathābhikṣukabhikṣitam | ratnaṃ hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ miṣṭānnaṃ cāmbarāṇyapi ||84|| mudrikāśca vibhūṣāśca pātrāṇyapi dhanāni ca | dadau yatheṣṭaṃ sarvebhyaścāgatebhyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||85 || tato gateṣu sarveṣu svasvadhāmagṛhāṇi ca | lomaśaḥ kanyakāyukto yathā naijāśramaṃ mudā ||86|| athānye kuṃkumavāpīkṣetrīyā brāhmaṇādayaḥ | premṇā pupūjurāgatya parameśaṃ hariṃ prabhum ||87|| yayuḥ svasvagṛhaṃ paścānmahāścaryaṃ vabhūva ha | śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tatra yugalaṃ caikamāgatam ||88|| nārī kajjalavarṇīyā naraḥ kuṣṭhāḍhyavigrahaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvāha bālaka ||89|| pāpoddhāraṃ kuru kṛṣṇa patitayorvivaṃśayoḥ | harirjānannapi tau tu papraccha dīnamānasau ||2.39.90 || kau yuvāṃ vadata pāpaṃ kiṃ kṛtaṃ ca kathaṃ ca ruk | naraḥ prāhābhavaṃ vipro devāyano hi nāmataḥ || 91 || gaurjare śrīpattane ca tatreyaṃ mama bhāminī | devapūjāparau cāvāṃ nityakarmaparāyaṇau ||92|| śaityābhipīḍitau snānaṃ vinā pūjanatatparau | samabhūva tato doṣādāyuṣyaṃ tvantatāṃ gatam ||93 || mṛtau jvareṇa ca śīghraṃ sahaiva śvapacagṛhe | jātau tatraiva nagare vivāhitau punastathā || 94|| jātismarau kuṣṭhikṛṣṇau duḥkhitau pāpanāśaka | jñātvā svapnaprabhāveṇa nārāyaṇo’si mādhavaḥ || 95 || pāpaṃ vidhūya nau mokṣaṃ kuru nārāyaṇaprabho | adya te divaso nātha baddhamuktipradāpane || 96 || pāpināṃ pāpahartā tvaṃ vartase ceti lokataḥ | samākarṇya ca vai padbhistvāyātau śaraṇaṃ tava ||97|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrutvā dayāparaḥ | tāvuvāca kṛpāsindhū rādhike pāpanāśanaḥ ||98|| aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva snātvā pītvā jalaṃ ca tat| | pradakṣiṇāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pibataṃ caraṇāmṛtam ||9 9 || śuddhau bhūtvā brahmalokaṃ vrajiṣyatho’timānavau | evaṃ śrutvā tatastābhyāṃ yathoktaṃ cānuvartitam || 2.39.10 0|| drāg bhūtvā divyadehau tau divyayāne sthitau punaḥ | lakṣātilakṣayajñānāṃ phalaṃ prāpya gatau divam || 101 || śrīpattanāt samārabhya kuṃkumavāpikāvadhim | yāvanti caṃkramaṇāni tāvad yajñaphalaṃ hyabhūt || 10 2|| evaṃ śrīkāntasādhūnāmapyabhigamane phalam | jāyate ki punaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sannidhau || 1 03|| rādhike śrīhariḥ sevyaḥ sevyāśca sādhavo’sya ca | tīrthaṃ kṣetraṃ vrataṃ sevyaṃ koṭiyajñaphalapradam || 1 04|| pade pade’śvamedhasyābhigame jāyate phalam | ityevaṃ tau kṛtau muktau nārāyaṇena śārṅgiṇā || 1 05|| ṣaṣṭhavarṣasamārambhāṣṭamīdine śubhotsave | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi mokṣo muktistathā bhavet || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhoḥ ṣaṣṭhavatsarasyāṣṭamyāṃ śrīrādhākṛṣṇāvatāravyūhadevamānavādikṛtamahotsavapūjanaṃ devāyanadvijasya tatpatnyāśca śvapacajanmamokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 39 ||
<2.40> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tatra cāśvapaṭṭasarovare | bālakṛṣṇaṃ prapūjyaiva nivāsaṃ prabhusannidhau || 1 || pracakruḥ sarasastīre paścime setukocchraye | dattātreyaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tathā vārāhatīrthakam || 2 || kūrmatīrthaṃ matsyatīrthaṃ kapilaṃ tīrthamityapi | haritīrthaṃ pṛthutīrthaṃ vāsudevābhidhaṃ tathā || 3 || haṃsatīrthaṃ dattātreyatīrthaṃ nṛsiṃhatīrthakam | tīrthamṛṣabhasaṃjñaṃ ca yogeśvarākhyatīrthakam || 4 || tīrthaṃ ca vāmanaṃ parśurāmatīrthaṃ śubhaṃ tataḥ | yajñatīrthaṃ rāmatīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ hayaśiro’bhidham || 5 || sanatkumāratīrthaṃ ca tīrthaṃ nāradasaṃjñakam | vyāsatīrthaṃ kṛṣṇatīrthaṃ buddhatīrthaṃ tathā param || 6 || tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ viṣṇutīrthaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | mahāviṣṇukṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ naranārāyaṇābhidham || 7 || ardhanārīśvaratīrthaṃ lakṣmītīrthaṃ paraṃ śubham | rādhike ca tvayā sākaṃ snātaṃ yatra mayā ca tat || 8 || rādhātīrthaṃ kṛṣṇatīrthaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovare | pāpatāpakṣayakaraṃ mokṣadaṃ dhāmavāsadam || 9 || evametāni tīrthāni jātāni tatra rādhike | atha ṣaṣṭhe mārgamāse mahākālavanasthitāḥ || 2.40.1 0|| ṛṣayastvāyayuścāśvapaṭṭakṣetre hi tairthikāḥ | samīraṇaḥ pavamānaḥ santāraṇaśca barburaḥ || 1 1|| voḍhuśca ghanabhedaśca dyuviśrāmaśca paṅkilaḥ | nīlakarṇastathālarkaḥ puṇḍarīkaḥ kalāyanaḥ || 12|| vītihotraśca camasaḥ parṇakutso’śvapāṭalaḥ | bhāllaveyaścorjavrataścāśvalāyana ityapi ||13|| pārṣṇiradaḥ sumantuśca hyaśokākṣo’bhayākṣakaḥ | brahāstambaḥ kūpyavālaścetanabrahma ityapi || 14|| devyaḥ śrīḥ kamalā pṛthvī rāṇikāmaraputrikā | dhanyeśvarī satīśā ca devānikī ca kṛṣṇikā || 15|| pampā nārāyaṇī gaṅgā yamunā gaṇḍakī kuśā | sarasvatī hiraṇyā ca svarṇarekhā ca gomatī || 16|| gautamī vallayo vṛkṣāstattvānyapyāyayustadā | mārgamāse site pakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ samāhitāḥ || 17|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥsnānaṃ cakruḥ prātaśca devatāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nemurgṛhaṃ gatāḥ || 18|| lomaṣarṣiṃ tato nemurnemustebhyo’pi kanyakāḥ | sakṛtā bhojitāḥ sarve vanditāḥ pūjitāstathā || 19|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīraṃ paścimaṃ kundaśobhitam | kuñjanikuñjarahitaṃ viśālasthalagauravam |||2.40.2 0|| pārijātavanāḍhyaṃ ca sugandhidrumamañjulam | yayurmadhyāhnakāle te nityakarmaparāyaṇāḥ || 21 || tatra gundrakadāḍīmatintiḍīdrumaśobhite | chāyite bhūtale ramye bālakṛṣṇālayāntike ||22|| viśrāmaṃ paramaṃ cakruḥ sāyaṃ kathāmavācayat | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā ūrjavrato muniḥ || 23 || mārkaṇḍeyaḥ kālajitaḥ pañcaśikhaśca lomaśaḥ | āsurirjamadagniśca hanumān jāmbavām̐stathā ||24|| vibhīṣaṇaśca vyāsaśca prahlādaśca baliḥ ṛbhuḥ | gālavaśca kṛpaścānye śatakalpāyuṣaśca ye ||25|| saptakalpajīvanāścāyutakalpaprajīvanāḥ | kathāśravaṇamūrdhanyā niṣeduḥ sadasi sthitāḥ ||26|| kambharānandanastatra pitṛbhyāṃ sahitaḥ prabhuḥ | madhyāsane brahmavidbhirniveśito virājate ||27|| devāḥ surāḥ sagandharvāḥ savidyādharamānavāḥ | devīsamūhasahitāḥ śṛṇvanti sma kathāṃ śubhām ||28|| ūrjavrato maharṣiśca lakṣakalpāyurīśvaraḥ | prapyakṣasya harerādyaṃ maṃgalaṃ prajagāda ha ||29|| nāsīdakṣaramekalaṃ nahi gavāṃ dhāmāpi cāsīd yadā, vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca yadāpi nāmṛtapadaṃ dhāmāpi nābhūd yadā | jīveśādikasarjanaṃ ca tu yadā nāsīttadāsīcca yaḥ, so’nādirharikṛṣṇabālasurūpo me stānnamo bhūmikā ||2.40.30|| yo naije paradhāmni muktapuruṣaiścānyeṣutacchaktibhimūrtairgrāhyaguṇairvibhūtibhirajaiḥ saṃsevyate cārthibhiḥ | yo dvedhābhirato’pi caikala iha prālokyate bālavacchrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇo’stu mama vākprasthānabhūmiḥ prabhuḥ ||3 1|| yadiha ṛṣikathāyāṃ vartate tvantarātmā, manutanujanibho’yaṃ bālakaḥ kaṃbharāyāḥ | akalakalavilāso viśvabhārodaro’yaṃ, saphalayatu janān gopālakṛṣṇālayasthaḥ ||32|| sa jayatu bhuvi ramyā kuṃkumī vāpikeyaṃ jagadaghaharamagryaṃ cāśvapaṭṭaṃ saraśca | vijayatu munimānyo lomaśaḥ sādhuvaryaḥ pravijayatu ca lakṣmīsaṃhitā mokṣadātrī ||33 || ādau madhye cāvasāne’nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | gīyate’tra parabrahma so’yaṃ tanotu maṅgalam ||34|| jyeṣṭho bhrātā ca bhagavān santuṣṭā ca svasā satī | śuko bhrātā tato vijño’nujaḥ śrīvallabhastathā ||35|| mātā ca kaṃbharālakṣmīḥ pitā gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ | śataṃ dvādaśa kāntāśca vijayantu sabālakāḥ ||36|| svayaṃprakāśaḥ śiṣyaśca mūrdhanyaḥ śiṣyamaṇḍale | koṭiśiṣyagaṇāścānye koṭyarbudābjayoṣitaḥ ||37|| lomaśo gurumukhyaśca ṛṣayo’nye hariṃvidaḥ | namasyāmo brahmavaṃśyā jaṃgamāstairthikārcitāḥ ||38|| aparokṣaḥ parokṣo’yaṃ bālo’bālabṛhatparaḥ | karotu śreya iṣṭaṃ naḥ śrīhariḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||39|| lakṣmīśo māṇikīśaśca pārvatīśaḥ prabhāpatiḥ | śrīrādhārukmiṇīkāntaḥ karotu maṃgalaṃ sadā ||2.40.40|| jānantu ṛṣayaścainaṃ parameśaṃ parātparam | anādinidhanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ svāminaṃ parameśvaram ||41|| anena hi purā vedā uddhṛtāḥ sāgarāttathā | uddhṛtā pṛthivī devī dantāgreṇa purā tathā ||42|| anena pṛṣṭhabhāge ca śeṣo dhṛto hi vidyate | anena nijaparyaṃke dhṛto nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||43|| anena sāṃkhyavijñānaṃ svaprakāśāya cārpitam | anena brahmaṇe jñānaṃ purā śrīhariṇārpitam ||44|| daityā niṣūditāścāpi vāsudevena śārṅgiṇā | janmarakṣālayām̐ścakre so’yaṃ vyūhātmako hariḥ||45|| pṛthvī prapālitānena rājarājo’pyayaṃ hyabhūt | tapastaptaṃ tathānena haṃsaḥ so’yaṃ purābhavat ||46|| keśarī so’yamevāsīt hiraṇyakośakāntakaḥ | sādhuceṣṭo vanyavāso’bhavat so’yaṃ dayāparaḥ ||47|| hrasvarūpo bhūmihartā mahendrānuja eva ca | atrātāraḥ kṣatāḥ parśughātenānena sūriṇā ||48|| vahnāvājyapibo’yaṃ vai vṛṣṭiyogaprado’pyayam | dakṣiṇāpathagān daityān yāmyaṃ prāpayitā hyayam ||49|| brahmaputraḥ sādhuśreṣṭho bālarūpaḥ purā tu yaḥ | sa evādya bālaveṣo vartate’tra narottamaḥ ||2.40.50|| vīṇāmagno maharṣiśca vedavidyāvibhājakaḥ | rādhākāntaḥ satīsevyo bodhavārdhirayaṃ hi saḥ ||51|| svāmī kāntaḥ patiḥ pātā rakṣako janakaḥ pitā | rājā draṣṭāntarātmā ca bālo’yaṃ ṛṣisammataḥ ||52|| bhajadhvaṃ bhāvato bhaktyā śāśvatālayado yataḥ | prapadye parameśānaṃ taṃ hyajaṃ vaiṣṇavapriyam ||53|| parabrahma mahātmānaṃ viśvasya jagataḥ patim | namastasmai devadaityeśvaramuktādisevine ||54|| sarvākṣāya sarvavyāptātmane’ntaryāmiṇe namaḥ | gāyanti yaṃ gāyatriṇo’rcayantyenaṃ samarpitāḥ ||55|| yatra sarvaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca kāryaṃ kriyā ca sādhanam | daivataṃ sadasaścāpi namastasmai vilāsine ||56|| namaḥ śāntāya variṇe śaṃkhacakradhvajābjine | śūline śārṅgiṇe cāpi vajriṇe śariṇe namaḥ ||57|| svastimate mīnavate namaste prabhaviṣṇave | namo’stvapratirūpāya svarūpadhvajadhāriṇe ||58|| namo nānābhirāmāya namaḥ paṭutarāya ca | namaḥ sāṃkhyapravaktre te yogavaktre ca te namaḥ ||59|| namaḥ śrutipravaktre te nyāyavaktre namo namaḥ | namo muktipravaktre te namaḥ śikṣāpradāya ca ||2.40.60|| namo mīmāṃsanavaktre namo’mṛtapradāya ca | namo hiraṇyavapuṣe namaścampakavarcase ||61|| namaḥ stutyāya mantrāya sarvabhūtaśarīriṇe | namo hotre namaḥ śīlavratasthāyātirūpiṇe ||62|| namo dīrghākṣiṇe tubhyaṃ sarvakāmapradāyine | nabhaścāntaranetrāya sarvanetrāya te namaḥ ||63|| bhedābhedaprabhinnāya namaste vyatirekiṇe | chāyātapanarūpāya śāntasattvāya te namaḥ ||64|| yajñabhāgapriyāyaikamūrtaye brahmaṇe namaḥ | pañcālaputrīrakṣāya bhaguputrīpravāhine ||65|| anaraṇyasuteśāya namo nārāyaṇīśine | annadāyānnapataye kośātmakāya te namaḥ ||66|| bālānurūpagotre ca bālalīlāvilāsine | namo bālāya vṛddhāya mañjukeśāya te namaḥ ||67|| namaḥ ṣaṭkarmatuṣṭāya sahasrābharaṇāya ca | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāmāśrayāya ca te namaḥ ||68|| namo’nantaguṇaiśvaryavibhūtyāśrayiṇe namaḥ | meghaśobhāya candrārkatārāprabhāya te namaḥ ||69|| tvamannamannabhoktā ca pakvabhuk pāvano’nalaḥ | vāri tvaṃ tvaṃ tathātṛptiḥ sukhamānanda te namaḥ ||2.40.70|| jarāyujāṇḍajāścāpi svedodbhijāstvayā kṛtāḥ | tvameva cāvatāreśa bhūtagrāmaścaturvidhaḥ ||7 1|| sraṣṭā carācarasyāsya pātā hantā tvameva ha | tvāmāhurbrahma vidvāṃsaḥ paraṃ brahmavidāṃ gatiḥ ||72|| manasaḥ paramaṃ jyotirjyātistvaṃ jyotiṣāmapi | haṃso vṛkṣo madhukaraḥ prāhustvāṃ brahmavādinaḥ ||73 || yajñeṣṭakṛt phalanaratvaṃ tvāmāhurmunayastathā | paṭhyase stutibhirnityaṃ vedopaniṣadāṃ gaṇaiḥ ||74|| narā nāryaḥ sthāvarā jaṅgamāstiryañca ityapi | tvameva vidyase kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jagatprabho ||75|| tvameva meghasaṃghāśca vidyuto’śanigarjitam | saṃvatsarastvamṛtavo māso māsārdhameva ca ||76|| yugānimeṣāḥ kāṣṭhāśca nakṣatrāṇi grahāstathā | tvaṃ śarī tvaṃ gadī cakrī khaḍgī vajrī śarāsanī ||77|| chettā bhettā prahartāsi mantā netā sanātanaḥ | samudrāḥ saritaḥ śailā vṛkṣāḥ sarāṃsi bhūstarāḥ ||78|| latātṛṇauṣadhivallīpaśavo mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ | pṛthukarmaguṇārambhaḥ kālaḥ puṣpaphalodayaḥ ||79|| madhyaṃ bījaṃ cāṃkuraṃ ca patraṃ kāṇḍaṃ ca granthikā | nālaṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ cāpi raso gandhastvameva ca ||2.40.80|| piṣṭaṃ miṣṭaṃ sadeṣṭaṃ ca tvameva parameśvara | pavitraṃ ca pavitrāṇāṃ maṃgalānāṃ ca maṃgalam ||8 1|| udayānāmudayāgryaṃ tvameva paramā gatiḥ | prāṇā nimeṣā jṛmbhaśca kṣutaṃ cābhyāhatistathā ||82|| brahmakālayamāgnīnāṃ śāstā bodhayitā bhavān | canuryugaścanurvedaścātuhotrapravartakaḥ ||83|| cāturāśramyanetā ca cāturvarṇyakarastathā | praśilpī gaṇako mātā sarvaśilpapravartakaḥ ||84|| svāhā svadhā vaṣaṭkāro namaskāraḥ stutistathā | prārthanā prārthanīyaṃ ca tvameva te namonamaḥ ||85|| gūḍhavrato guhyatapāstārako bhūmisandharaḥ | dhātā vidhātā sandhātā tvameva te namonamaḥ ||86|| brahmā śaṃbhustathā viṣṇurvirāḍ bhūmā tvameva ca | tapaḥ satyaṃ brahmacaryamārjavaṃ tvaṃ pratoṣaṇam ||87|| bhūrbhuvaḥ svaṃ jīvasṛṣṭirīśasṛṣṭistvameva ca | brahmasṛṣṭiḥ ṛtaṃ dīkṣā damanaṃ tvaṃ janārdanaḥ ||88|| kāntaḥ priyaḥ patiḥ svāmī nārāyaṇastvameva ca | bindurnādo dhvanirbrahma vimarśaḥ sphoṭa ityapi ||89|| paśyantī ca parā madhyā viśiṣṭā vāk tvameva ca | gaurbhūmirbrāhmabhaktaśca sādhuḥ satī ca kiṃkarī ||2.40.90|| vaśyaḥ sarvaṃ tvamevāsse tvāṃ vinā nāsti nāstyapi | śaśāṃkānalaśītoṣṇakṣuttṛṣāśca jarāmayāḥ ||9 1 || ādhayo vyādhayaḥ śāntirbheṣajaṃ tvaṃ janārdana | somapāstvaṃ ca mādhuṃrya marutpatirjagatpatiḥ ||92|| amṛtāśī jagannāthāḥ kuṃkumeśastvameva ca | akṣateśo gaṇeśaśca mukteśastvaṃ pareśvaraḥ || 93|| viṣāgnipāḥ somapāśca kṣīrapā navanītapāḥ | ājyapā madhupāḥ sarvabhoktā tvaṃ ca pitāmahaḥ ||94|| hiraṇyaretāḥ puruṣaśreṣṭhastvameva caikalaḥ | tvaṃ strīpumān tvaṃ tṛtīyo bhāvadvayavivarjitaḥ || 95|| bhāvatrayātigaścāpi bhāvatraye pravartase | bālo yuvā sthaviraśca jīrṇadaṃṣṭro’si viśvakṛt| ||96 || candrādityau cakṣuṣī te jihvā te ca sarasvatī | ahorātre nimiṣobhe ātmānaste gṛhālayāḥ ||97|| na brahmā na śivo viṣṇuḥ paurāṇā ṛṣayo na te | māhātmyaṃ vedituṃ śaktā yāthātathyena bālaka ||98|| puṃsāmīśeśvarāṇāṃ muktānāṃ koṭyarbudāni ca | tiṣṭhase tvaṃ samāvṛtya cāntarbahistvameva saḥ || 99 || mahatastamasaḥ pāre’kṣarasyāpi pare sadā | pare dhāmni pareśastvaṃ rājase so’tra mūrtimān || 2.40.10 0|| yaṃ vinidrā jitaprāṇāḥ sattvasthā brahmavartinaḥ | paraṃ paśyanti yuñjānāstasmai yogātmane namaḥ || 101 || yā yā mūrtayaḥ sūkṣmāste śakyā darśayituṃ na tāḥ | tābhyaḥ sarvābhya evātra tvadrūpābhyo namo namaḥ || 1 02|| bhaktānukampī bhagavān bhakteṣu vartase sadā | keśā meghā yasya nāḍyo nadyaḥ kukṣau mahābdhayaḥ || 1 03|| śayānāya jale haime tapasyate ca te namaḥ | ye’ṅguṣṭhamātrāḥ puruṣāścidaḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ || 1 04|| ye nadīṣu samudreṣu parvateṣu guhāsu ca | vṛkṣamūleṣu goṣṭheṣu kāntāragahaneṣu ca || 1 05|| catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu catvareṣu sabhāsu ca | hastyaśvarathaśālāsu jīrṇodyānālayeṣu ca || 1 06|| ye’pi pañcasu bhūteṣu diśāsu vidiśāsu ca | candre sūrye satyaloke vaikuṇṭhākhyacatuṣṭaye || 1 07|| rasātalagatā ye ca ye ca tasmāt paraṃgatāḥ | tava bhaktāstava dāsāḥ kiṃkarāstava keśava || 1 08|| dāsyaḥ satyastava bhaktāḥ kiṃkaryastava mādhava | namastebhyo namastābhya ubhābhyāṃ ca namo’cyuta || 109 || yeṣāṃ na vidyate saṃkhyāḥ pramāṇaṃ rūpameva ca | asaṃkhyāste muktagaṇā namastebhyo’stu nityaśaḥ || 2.40.11 0|| prasīda bālarūpa tvaṃ svakaṃ bhāvaṃ pradarśaya | tvayi no hṛdayānyatra bhavantu satkathāphalam || 111 || ityevaṃ rādhike tena stutaḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | kathārambhe prasannaḥ sannātmano darśanaṃ dadau || 11 2|| divyakoṭyarkabhāpūrṇaṃ romaikaikaṃ tu yasya vai | sarve’vatārā yanmūrtau sarvadhāmāni yatra ca || 113 || sarveśvarāḥ ṛṣayaśca devā mānavakoṭayaḥ | daityā brahmāṇḍasannāhā yadromṇyeva caranti ca || 1 14|| koṭimuktāḥ koṭikāntāḥ koṭipālā maheśvarāḥ | yatkukṣau bhāsamānāśca sarvatejāṃsi yatra ca || 1 15|| sarve vai pralayā yatra yatra sarvāśca sṛṣṭayaḥ | yatra sarve ātmavargā bhāsante divyadṛṣṭitaḥ || 116 || tādṛśaṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ mūrtaṃ kaiśoraśobhanam | darśayāmāsa bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 1 17|| vihasyābhāṣya kuśalaṃ divyadṛṣṭiṃ ca sandadau | vilokya ṛṣayaḥ sarve tathānye śravaṇe ratāḥ || 1 18|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāste dadṛśuḥ prabhum | adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ hṛdyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā nyadhurhariṃ hṛdi || 1 19|| evaṃ pradarśya ca punaḥ parihāraṃ cakāra ha | yathā bālo vartate’tra tathā bālo’bhavatpunaḥ || 2.40.120 || tathā dṛṣṭvā kṛtakṛtyān matvā svān munipuṅgavāḥ | ānandaṃ paramaṃ prāpuḥ śaśvannirvāṇagā yathā || 121 || evaṃ sākṣāt saṃhitāyāḥ pātraṃ śrīparameśvaram | sākṣātkṛtya tato nityaṃ śṛṇvantyeva kathāmṛtam || 122|| evaṃ māsatrayaṃ jātaṃ pārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ śubham | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre rādhike mokṣadaṃ tadā || 1 23| kathānte phālgunīṃ kṛtvāsthāpya tirthāni sarvathā | svasvanāmnā ṛṣayaśca vāsaṃ tatraiva cakrire || 124|| tadetat saṃhitātīrthaṃ koṭitīrthaṃ pragīyate | ṛṣitīrthaṃ kathātīrthaṃ divyatīrthaṃ tadeva ca || 125|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mārgaśīrṣe ūrjavratarṣikṛtāyālakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāyāḥ śravaṇaprasaṃge prabhordivyadarśanam, ṛṣīṇāṃ stavanāni, ṛṣīṇāṃ nivāsāttīrthāni cetinirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 40 ||
<2.41> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai | kathāṃ divyāṃ pāvanīṃ ca camatkāramayīṃ parām || 1 || āsīd rājā dhārmikaśca bhaktaṃ kanthādharābhidhaḥ | saurāṣṭre vai naijarājye śāsanaṃ pracakāra ha || 2 || sa hi rājā śaṃbhubhakto’bhavat sthāṇuprapūjakaḥ | siṃhāraṇye vasan koṭīnārādhipaḥ pratāpavān || 3 || śaṃbhuṃ prasādya tapasā kāladaṇḍamavāptavān | daṇḍo yatra bhavettatra yāmyapāśo na vidyate || 4 || yamadūtastathā kālo daṇḍaṃ dṛṣṭvā nivartate | nityaṃ sahasrakamalaiḥ pārthivaṃ śaṃkaraṃ nṛpaḥ || 5 || pūjayitvā prage caikapādena śatamālikāḥ | oṃ namaḥ kālakālāya saṃkarṣaṇāya śaṃbhave || 6 || mṛtyave yāmyavārāya nirbhayaṃ padamarpaya | evaṃ japati mantraṃ sa āvartayati nityaśaḥ || 7 || tata ekāvartanena juhotyaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | parāhṇe tu phalaṃ śākaṃ pakvaṃ nirbījameva saḥ || 8 || gṛhṇāti dehayātrārthaṃ rātrau bhūśayanaḥ sadā | satyapi yauvane bhāve nārīṃ vāñchati naiva saḥ || 9 || ityevaṃ vartamānasya pratāpinastu bhūbhṛtaḥ | rājye cauryaṃ bhayaṃ vyādhiḥ pāradāryaṃ na cābhavat || 2.41.10|| madyamāṃsābhakṣyavarjyaṃ havyaṃ prajānusevate | trayodaśyāṃ cobhayāyāṃ somatīrthasya sevanam || 11 || bhavanāthasya ca tathā darśanaṃ sevanaṃ śubham | aśvapaṭṭasarasaśca snānaṃ lomaśadarśanam || 12|| yātrāṃ karoti cetyevaṃ tato gṛhaṃ prayāti saḥ | tīrthayātrājalaṃ koṭīnārīyajanatāsu saḥ || 13|| prāpayatyaiva ca prajākalyāṇārthaṃ muhurmuhuḥ | māse māse pūrṇimāyāṃ prajābhyo miṣṭabhojanam ||14|| dadātyābālavṛddhebhyaḥ paśupakṣibhya ityapi | matsyakīṭapataṃgebhyo vṛkṣebhyaḥ salilaṃ tathā || 15|| evaṃ dharmaparasyāsya rājyaprajā ca nirbhayā | svayamanyatra tu gate bhayaṃ rājye na vidyate || 16|| akālamaraṇaṃ nāsti nāsti cetibhayaṃ tathā | evaṃ kāle gate tvasya vāñcchābhūt puṣkaraṃ prati || 17|| tīrthaṃ kartuṃ yayau cāpi māsastatra gatastadā | vasiṣṭhaṃ tatra rājā cāprasādayat susevayā || 18|| cirañjīveti tenoktaṃ tathāstvityāha vai nṛpaḥ | dīrghāyuṣṭvaṃ paraṃ labdhvā śreyo labdhvāpyanantakam || 19|| tīrthadānāni sandatvā snātvā sampūjya vedhasam | tataḥ sarasvatīṃ snātvā siddhān sampūjya bhūpatiḥ ||2.41.20|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥ snātvā śīghraṃ svagṛhamāyayau | svapne sa dṛṣṭavān mārge vipraputrastu nīyate ||21|| kenacit kṛṣṇavarṇena rakṣayāmīti bhūpatiḥ | vicārya yāvat tvarayā dhāvatyenaṃ prarakṣitum ||22|| tāvannidrā vilīnā ca kiñcinnāstītyalokayat | śaṃkitaḥ sa śīghrameva rājyaṃ prati samāyayau |||23|| grāmasīmāgate sarvaṃ svapnaṃ satyaṃ vyajāyata | yato’sya rājye viprasya grāmapurohitasya tu ||24|| putro mṛtyuṃgataścāyuṣo’nte pitari jīvati | yāmyadūtairdhṛto nīto yāmyalokaṃ kṣaṇāntare |||25|| tāvad rājā tvāyayau vai yātrāṃ kṛtvātra tatkṣaṇam | rodanaṃ śocanaṃ jñātvā rājā duḥkhamavāpa ha ||26|| udantaṃ samparijñāya jñātvā mṛtyumṛtaṃ tataḥ | daṇḍaṃ ca śaṃkaraṃ nītvā samāśvāsya ca taṃ dvijam ||27|| yayau pṛṣṭhe mṛtaṃ putraṃ vipraṃ cānetumiṣṭakṛt | daṇḍaṃ nītvā yatra yāti tatra mārgo’sya vidyate ||28|| pṛthvyāṃ jale’nale vāyau cāmbare tamasi grahe | caturdaśasu lokeṣu sadaṇḍasya gatiryataḥ ||29|| vinā daṇḍaṃ tu naivāsya gatiḥ syādbhūtalaṃ vinā | śivadaṇḍena rājāsau yayau vyomnā yamālayam || 2.41.3 0|| niruddho mānavadeho yamadūtena vai yadā | daṇḍena rājñā saṃspṛṣṭo yāmyo dūraṃ papāta ha ||3 1|| vinipatya samutthāya bhayavyāpto yamānugaḥ | dadhāva yamarājānaṃ jagāda svaparābhavam ||32|| āyāto’sti yamapūryāṃ kaścinmānavadehavān | sadaṇḍo vartate deva mayā ruddho’tivegataḥ ||3 3||| tathāpi naivaruddho’bhūt sa māṃ pasparśa daṇḍataḥ | tāvatparājitaścāhaṃ yathā vajrahato’bhavam || 34|| pṛthvyāṃ nipatya cotthāya tvāyāmyatra yameśvara | nivedayituṃ tadvṛttaṃ ko’yaṃ kasmāddhi cāyayau ||35|| na jānāmi mahārāja yatheṣṭaṃ tatra cintaya | ityukto yamadūtena dharmarājastadānugam ||36|| mṛtyunāmānamāhūya vivāsayituṃ cādiśat | mṛtyurgatvā kareṇainaṃ nṛpaṃ dadhāra vegataḥ ||37|| yāhītyuvāca rājānaṃ na cenmṛtyustavātra vai | śrutvaivaṃ nṛpatirdaṇḍaṃ yojayāmāsa mṛtyave ||38|| mṛtyuḥ papāta bhūbhāge samutplutya yayau drutam | balaṃ nivedayāmāsa yamarājāya mānavam ||39|| tato yamo mahākālaṃ preṣayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam | ko’yaṃ kasmāt samāyāto mamāntikaṃ samānaya ||2.41.40|| ityuktaśca svayaṃ kālastasyāntikaṃ samāyayau | natvovāca bhavān ko’tra dharmarājo jijñāsati ||41 || nṛpaḥ prāha ca saurāṣṭre koṭīnārasya bhūpatiḥ | asmyahaṃ tu samāyāto viprabālaṃ pravīkṣitum ||42|| sa tu kvāste kathaṃ cātrānīto’sti yamacāriṇā | iti jijñāsituṃ tvatra samāyāto’smi mānada ||43|| kālaḥ prāha samāgaccha yamarājaṃ nivedaya | sa te dāsyati pratyuktiṃ nāhaṃ yogyo’smi tatra vai ||44|| ityuktvā saha nītvā ca yamarājaṃ prati nṛpam | kāla āvedayāmāsa yamarājo’pyamānayat ||45|| papraccha svāgataṃ kṛtvā kimāgamanakāraṇam | rājā nanāma dharmaṃ ca provāca viprabālakam ||46 || mārgayituṃ samāyātaḥ kvāste sa dvijabālakaḥ | pitā tasyātikaruṇaṃ rauti putrasya kāraṇāt ||47|| eka evāsya putro’sti mṛtyustasyābhavattathā | tacchokaṃ tvapanetuṃ ca mayoktaṃ bhūsurāya vai ||48|| tasya bālaṃ punarnītvā dātumicchāmi dharmarāṭ | tacchavaṃ rakṣitaṃ cāste yāvaccāhaṃ na yāmi tam ||49|| tasmād dehi dvijaputraṃ yāñcāṃ me pratipālaya | yamaḥ prāha ca tatrasthaṃ dūtaṃ yamaṃ ca satvaram ||50|| citraguptaṃ salekhaṃ ca brāhmaṇārthe samāhvaya | ākāritaścitraguptaḥ salekhastatra cāyayau ||51 || paśyāsya viprabālasya kiyadāyurbhavediti | citraguptaḥ pūrṇamāyuḥ samāptaṃ sa mṛto yataḥ ||52|| vipradehe’sya nāstyeva bhogāyurvai manāgapi | yamarājastu tacchrutvā rājānaṃ cābhyavedayat ||53|| nāstyāyustasya taddehe sthātuṃ bhoktuṃ tato nṛpa | mṛto’yaṃ lapsyase naiva karmanyāyo’tra vidyate |||54|| yatkṛtaṃ yena vai yādṛk yaṃ yasmai yasya vai yataḥ | yatra yadarthaṃ tatsarvaṃ tathaiva syānna cānyathā ||55|| rājā prāhāsya bālasya kiṃ karma pāpakṛddhyabhūt | yenāsya prāṇavāhaśca yamadūto hyajāyata ||56|| citraguptastadā prāha yamarājānudeśataḥ | vipraścāyaṃ pūjakaśca devasyāsīnnirantaram ||57|| mandire vāsudevasya śaitye snānaṃ vinā hyayam | devamutthāpayāmāsa tena pāpena cāsya vai ||58|| yamaloko niścito’sti daṇḍaṃ vinā na śuddhyati | puṇyaṃ nāsti mānavārthe āyurnāsti tathottaram ||59|| kathaṃ neṣyasi rājendra vinā karma dvijārbhakam | rājā prāha dadāmyasya tvāyurme nūtanaṃ, mayā ||2.41.60 || vasiṣṭhasyāśiṣā labdhā puṣkare cirajīvitā | tanmadhyato’yutavarṣaṃ dadāmyasya tu mānavam ||61|| ityuktvā salilaṃ hastāddvisṛjya jīvitaṃ dadau | citragupto lilekhāsya varṣāyutaṃ sujīvanam ||62|| dharmarājau dadau bālaṃ cāyutābdaprajīvanam | tataḥ papraccha rājānaṃ balaṃ labdhaṃ kutastvayā ||63 || yadatra naradehena samāyāto vihāyasā | yamo mṛtyustathā kālo’pradhṛṣyo dharṣitastvayā ||64|| vada kena pratāpena prāptamaiśvaryamuttamam | śrutvā rājā tadā prāha śaṃkarasya pratāpataḥ ||65|| prāptaṃ balaṃ dharmarāja yenāhaṃ cātra vīkṣitaḥ | bālo’pi ca mayā prāpto mahatāṃ kṛpayā nvidam ||66|| dharmarājastadā prāha yaṣṭiṃ me dehi bhūpate | rājā prāhātra vai yaṣṭyāṃ sarvaṃ tattvaṃ mamāsti hi ||67|| yaṣṭilope na me cāsti gatirvaihāyasī vṛṣa | tasmād yaṣṭiṃ na dāsyāmi yaṣṭiḥ sāṃkarṣiṇī nviyam ||68|| kālasaṃhāriṇī tvāste tadānyasya tu kā kathā | tvayi ced yojaye yaṣṭiṃ tava nāśo bhaved dhruvam ||69|| ityuktvā dharmarāje tāṃ yaṣṭiṃ yojayituṃ nṛpaḥ | hastaṃ svaṃ lambayāmāsa tāvat kṣobhaṃ yayau vṛṣaḥ ||2.41.70|| kṣubdhaṃ tasyāsanaṃ cāpi dharmo nanāma taṃ nṛpam | balaṃ devabalaṃ dīrghaṃ sattābalaṃ na vai balam ||71 || mene tadā dharmarājastatastvasāntvayat nṛpam | mā maivaṃ kuru rājendra mānyo’si devadarśitaḥ ||72|| kālakālasya kṛpayā sarvaṃ te vartate kare | tasmād dadāmi rājendra kanyāṃ me hṛḍḍakāyinīm ||73|| yauvanodbhinnasarvāṃgāṃ ramaṇīṃ dehasundarīm | tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā cecchamānāṃ saṃgṛhāṇaināṃ tava priyām ||74|| ityuktvā ca balaṃ jñātvā pradadau hṛḍḍakāyinīm | kanyāṃ patnīsvarūpāṃ tāṃ tathā viprārbhakaṃ nṛpaḥ ||71|| nītvā vaihāyasā dharmārpitena vāhanena vai | samāyayau sa saurāṣṭe koṭīnārākhyapattanam ||76|| vimānamambarāttasya dvijasyaiva gṛhāntikam | avātārayacchanakaiḥ sūryatulyaṃ samṛddhimat ||77|| divyanārīyutaṃ divyopaskaraṇasuśobhitam | anekaiśvaryasiddhyādivāsitaṃ yamanirbhayam ||78|| dṛṣṭvā lokāḥ satīṃ patnīṃ tathā viprasya bālakam | nṛpaṃ prati harṣanādān jayanādān vyadhurmudā ||79|| rājā putraṃ dadau tasmai viprāya praṇanāma ca | sa vai nāmnābhavattatra vṛṣaparvā ṛṣistadā ||2.41.80|| vṛṣaparvā samuttasthau mṛte dehe viveśa ha | vipraḥ prajāḥ prasannāścābhavam̐stasyāśiṣo daduḥ ||8 1|| vipraputraḥ samattasthau neme vṛddhān punaḥ punaḥ | pitarau nṛpatiṃ cāpi rājā yajñaṃ cakāra ha ||82|| yamaputrīṃ nijarājñīṃ kṛtvāgre hṛḍḍakāyinīm | homaṃ dānaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ ca bhojanāni dadau nṛpaḥ ||83|| yadyad dattaṃ ca tad dṛṣṭvā prajajvālāntare nṛpī | tāmasī garvamanyā ca svārthamātraparāyaṇā ||84|| svavarcasvātilubdhā paropakāravirodhinī | dāne prabhojane home rājānaṃ hṛḍḍakāyinī ||82|| punaḥ punaḥ samuvāca mā vidhehi vyayaṃ nṛpa | tvaṃ brahma paramaṃ cāste tvaṃ vai nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||86 || tvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ śivo brahmā tvaṃ prajāpatirasyapi | tvaṃ bhoktā tvaṃ vidhātā ca tvamagnistvaṃ divaspatiḥ ||87|| tvaṃ pātraṃ tvaṃ paraḥ śāstā tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ parāyaṇam | tvaṃ svāheśaḥ svadheśaśca tvaṃ vaṣaṭkārabhūmikā ||88|| tvaṃ hotā tvaṃ yajamānaḥ ko’nyo devastvaduttamaḥ | tasmātsarvaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ tvameva vidyase prabho ||89|| prabhuṃ pratyakṣamevātra tvādṛśaṃ ca vimānagam | yamarājasya ca putryāḥ patimaiśvaryavardhitam ||2.41.90|| parityajya ca ko loke yajanīyo maheśvaraḥ | tasmāttvaṃ tvāṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ vijānīhi makheśvaram ||9 1 || kālaṃ hantuṃ tathā hantuṃ mṛtyuṃ tvaṃ śaktimānasi | mṛtaṃ jīvayituṃ tvaṃ ca samartho vidyase prabhuḥ || 92|| nendro varuṇaḥ pavanaḥ kubero’gniśca nirṛtiḥ | dikpālā lokapālā vā tvādṛśāḥ kānta santi na ||93|| sarvaṃ te saṃvaśe loke copāsse cetare tu kam | tyaja yajñaṃ tathā dānaṃ tyajāsthāṃ pāralaukikīm ||94|| bhaja svaṃ ca sukhaṃ viddhi mayā dattaṃ hi sevayā | puṇyaṃ nijātmasevā ca pāpaṃ nijātmapauḍanam ||95|| miṣṭaṃ svakāntāvacanaṃ viddhyanyat kaṭu nāśakṛt | evaṃ jñātvā paraṃ rājyaṃ kuru svamānasaṃbhṛtam ||96|| evaṃ nityaṃ rādhike sā vakti taṃ hṛḍḍakāyinī | so’pi tasyāḥ saṅgadoṣācchanairnāstikatāṃ gataḥ || 97|| śayane bhojane yāne sparśe śvāsagrahe tathā | vilokane ca karaṇe pārśvaste kramate guṇaḥ ||98|| sahavāse ca vārtāyāmadhyayane ca cūmbane | śiṣṭabhakṣye manuṣyāṇāṃ pāpaṃ saṃkramate jane ||99|| upari vāyugrahaṇe dhṛtavastrasya dhāraṇe | pradattajalapāne ca vrajet tadguṇitāṃ matiḥ ||2.41.10 0|| kṣudhāyogāt krūratāṃ ca śatruyogād vināśitām | kāntāyogād bhogyatāṃ ca yāyād buddhirvivartinī || 101 || sādhuyogāt sattvabhāvaṃ śāstṛyogāttu dīnatām | bhṛtyayogāt svāmibhāvaṃ vrajatyeva matiḥ sadā || 1 02|| evaṃ vai rādhike rājño matiḥ samaparyavartata | svārthamātraparā jātā yathāha hṛṅkukāyinī || 103 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyāgīyasaṃhitātā dvitīye tretāsattāne kaṃthādharanṛpateḥ śaṃkarabhaktyā kālayaṣṭiprāptiḥ, tataḥ puṣkare sevayā vaśiṣṭhāśīrvādena cirajīvitā, vipraputrasya yamapuragatasyānayanam, svāyurdānam, yamarājaputryā hṛṅkukāyinyā vivāhaḥ, tatprasaṃgena nāstikatā cetinirūpaṇanāmaikacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 41 ||
<2.42> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike rājā kanthādharo hi nityaśaḥ | nārīyogādabhavacca nāstikaḥ svārthatatparaḥ || 1 ||| ghoṣayāmāsa nagare durātmā vedanindakaḥ | na dātavyaṃ na yaṣṭavyaṃ na hotavyaṃ kadācana || 2 || ahameko’tra vai vandyaḥ pūjyo’haṃ bhavatāṃ sadā | mayā vai pālitā yūyaṃ nivasadhvaṃ prajāḥ sukhe || 3 || tanmatto’nyo na devo’sti yuṣmākaṃ yapparāyaṇam | mahyaṃ deyaṃ ca havanaṃ havyaṃ dānaṃ ca dakṣiṇā || 4 || rājāhaṃ lokapālo’haṃ prajāpālo’hameva ca | dātā dhātā vidhātā ca prajānāmahameva ca || 5 || prāṇadātā sasyadātā dhanyadātāhameva ca | sukhado daṇḍadaścāpi rakṣāprado’hameva ca || 6 || manmukhaṃ vahnirevāsti deyaṃ tatraiva nānatṭhe | matkara1 pātramūrdhanyau dānaṃ tatraiva yujyate || 7 || karo dānaṃ na tu bhikṣā karo deyo hi nītijaḥ | vastrāṇi paśavo gāvo mahiṣyo’jāvikādikam || 8 || dhanaṃ sarvaṃ pradeyaṃ me yatpunaśca prajākṛte | durbhikṣādau prayujyeta prajānāṃ sukhahetave || 9 || etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ brāhmaṇā brahmadarśinaḥ | prajāvṛddhāśca vidvāṃso vedanetrā viduttamāḥ || 2.42.1 0|| parasparaṃ susambhūya rājaśikṣārthamāyayuḥ | praṇipatya ca rājānaṃ satkṛtā vākyamabruvan || 1 1|| śrutiḥ pramāṇaṃ dharmasya tato yajñaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ | yajñairvinā priyante na devāḥ sasyapradā divi || 12|| aprīteṣu ca deveṣu durbhikṣaṃ samprajāyate | prajānāśo bhaved rājan deśaviplava ityapi || 13 || tasmād rājan bhūtaśāntirgrahaśāntistathā sadā | devatṛptiḥ pitṛtṛptirvidhātavyā mahādhvaraiḥ || 14|| yajño naiva niroddhavyaḥ śrutimūlo yato makhaḥ | vahnimukhāḥ sadā devāstarpaṇīyāḥ sukhapradāḥ || 15 || ityukto’pi nṛpaḥ kanthādharo’manyata naiva ca | vedān vininda bahudhā pratāraṇaparā iti || 16 || viprāḥ svārthaparā dhūrtakalpitā vedarāśayaḥ | dvijā miṣṭānnalubdhāśca vahimuddiśya devatāḥ || 17|| kiṃcitprakṣipya vahnau ca svayaṃ miṣṭāni bhuṃjate | dakṣiṇādhanapātrāṇi govājikariṇaḥ svayam ||18|| gṛhṇanti tannimittena tasmātsvārthaparā hi te | mūrtistho naiva devo’sti na bhuṃkte nāsya rocate || 1 9|| vipro devastu pratyakṣaḥ sarvaṃ yadasya rocate | devaṃ nimittamudbhāvya miṣṭānnaṃ miṣṭavāri ca ||2.42.20|| ābhūṣaṇaṃ puṣpāmālāṃ bhuṃkte gandhaṃ ca bhūsuraḥ | godānaṃ dugdhapānaṃ ca śayyādānaṃ gṛhārpaṇam ||2 1 || vāṭikā devatārthaṃ yā bhuṃkte sarvaṃ ca bhūsuraḥ | yānaṃ pātrāṇi ramyāṇi chatraṃ cāmaravāhanam ||22|| mṛdvāstaraṇaṃ bhogyāni bhuṃkte sarvaṃ tu bhūsuraḥ | rasān phalāni pakvānnānyuttamāni ca ||23 || dāsān dāsīśca bhṛtyām̐ścopabhuṃkte pūjako dvijaḥ | tasmāt svārthaparā viprā makhamuddiśya bhuñjate ||24|| ato naiva hi yaṣṭavyaṃ dātavyaṃ naiva naiva ca | ityājñā hṛḍḍakāyinyā rājñyā me vartate dṛḍhā ||25||| ullaṅghyaitā kāmakāro maddaṇḍabhāgbhaviṣyati ityevaṃ ḍiṇḍimā rājñā rāṣṭre sarvatra kāritā ||26|| tata ārabhya devānāṃ pūjā makhā na cābhavan | durbhikṣaṃ cābhavattena prajāśca duḥkhapīḍitāḥ ||27|| prasahya prabalā dravyaṃ nirbalānāṃ haranti ca | rājā ca viṣayāsakto rakṣākāryaṃ karoti na || 28|| kālavegāt tadā rāṣṭraṃ viparītamabhūt khalu | daṇḍaḥ siddhipradaḥ śaṃbhostyaktvā bhūpaṃ tiro’bhavat ||29|| tadā rājā śuśocāti mama naṣṭaṃ hi jīvanam | aiśvaryaṃ vigataṃ cāpi devānāmavamānanāt || 2.42.30 || prajā ruṣṭāśca dhānyārthaṃ rurudhurbhūbhṛdaṅgaṇam | dhānyaṃ gṛhītvā prayayustato dravyaṃ gavādikam ||3 1 || rājyasmṛddhiṃ prajahruśca prajāścātīva nirdhanāḥ | atha kanthādharastasya patnī ca hṛḍḍakāyinī ||3 2|| ubhau bhayāt prayayaturaraṇyaṃ cātiduḥkhitau | tayoścāsīt kumārastu varṣamātro’tikomalaḥ || 33 || brāhmaṇāstaṃ prajahruśca rakṣaṇārthaṃ nijālayam | vimānaṃ divyadaṇḍaśca divyopakaraṇāni ca ||34|| vigatāni nijaṃ sthānaṃ rājyaṃ śūnyamabhūttadā | puṇyapuñje vardhite tu vardhante vai vibhūtayaḥ ||35|| puṇyanāśe vinaśyanti devānāmasya kā kathā | rādhike sa nṛpo’raṇye kāladharmamupāgataḥ ||36|| annaṃ jalaṃ parityajya mṛtāpi hṛḍḍakāyinī | vārdhestīre mlecchajanmāvāpatustau ca nāstikau ||37|| nikaṭe tau bhāgyayogādutpannau duḥkhabhāginau | kumāro dvādaśavarṣo’bhavad raṇaṃgamābhidhaḥ ||38|| sopavīto vipravākyairjñātvā pitṛviceṣṭitam | asadgatiṃ vane cāpi cintayāmāsa vai muhuḥ ||39|| vidyābhyāsaṃ vidhāyaiva rājyabhāravaho’bhavat | taṃ yogyaṃ ca paraṃ matvā dharmakāryaparāyaṇam ||2.42.40 || abhyaṣiñcan brāhmaṇāstaṃ rājānaṃ bhūmipālakam | tataḥ sa rañjayāmāsa prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ||41|| yajñaṃ cakāra dharmātmā devapūjāmavartayat | tato brāhmaṇamadhyastho jagāda praṇipatya tān ||42|| pitā mama tathā mātā yajñavicchedakārakau | mṛtau vane kriyā tayoḥ kathaṃ kāryā mayā dvijāḥ ||43|| āvedayata ityevaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sannidhau | tejasā bhāsamānaśca svayaṃprakāśanāmakaḥ ||44|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśiṣyo vihāyasā | somakṣetraṃ prayāsyan vai koṭīnāramavātarat ||45|| viprān vilokya sahasā tānpratyabhyājagāma ha | tasmai te tvāsanaṃ datvā papracchuḥ praṇipatya ca ||46|| dhanyā vayaṃ samaye ca prāptā maharṣidarśanam | lokānāṃ duḥkhanāśārthaṃ śreyo’rthaṃ caraṇaṃ tava ||47|| bhagavan sarvalokasya jānāsi tvaṃ śubhāśubham | sākṣādanādikṛṣṇasya śiṣyo’si hṛdayaṃgamaḥ ||48|| pitāsya rājño duṣṭātmā devabrāhmaṇanindakaḥ | svadharmarahitaḥ patnisahito’raṇyamāśritaḥ ||49|| vane mṛtyuṃ gato bhāti kvāste vā pāpakarmaṇā | kathaṃ tasya bhavenmuktirvada bālo’sya pṛcchati ||2.42.50|| svayaṃ prakāśo divyātmā jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā | kuṃkumavāpikāsthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ smṛtvābravīdidam ||5 1|| paścimābdhitaṭe cāste rājā rājñīyutaḥ khalu | mlecchamadhye samutpannaḥ kṣayakuṣṭhasamanvitaḥ ||52|| tasyoddhāraśca kartavyaḥ putreṇānena sarvathā | putraḥ sa kathyate loke yaḥ pitṛm̐strāyate bhayāt ||53|| gacchatu tatra putro’yaṃ mlecchaṃ nītvā sabhāryakam | aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrite ||54|| tasya dehaṃ tīrthajale karotu nirmalaṃ tataḥ | niṣpāpaḥ sapriyo muktiṃ prayāsyati na saṃśayaḥ ||55|| svayaṃprakāśavacanaṃ śrutvā viprā prajājanāḥ | raṇaṃgamaṃ kumāraṃ taṃ prāhuryāhīti taṃ prati ||56|| kumāraḥ sa ca vipraiśca parimeyapuraḥsaraiḥ | sahitaḥ prayayau cābdhitaṭaṃ yatra pitā sthitaḥ ||57|| sa gatvā paścimaṃ sthānaṃ mlecchāśrayaṃ drumānvitam | makarālayanāmāḍhya mārgayāmāsa kiṃkaraiḥ ||58|| dadṛśuḥ kiṃkarāstaṃ ca kuṣṭhinaṃ kṣayarogiṇam | dadṛśustāṃ hṛḍḍakinīṃ sakuṣṭhāṃ kṣayarogiṇīm ||59|| ubhau jātismarau cāstāṃ pratīkṣamāṇau putrakam | uddhārakaṃ cāgataṃ saṃśrutvātimuditau tadā ||2.42.6 0|| mleccho mlecchī sotsukau ca kiṃkaraiḥ saha satvaram | āyayaturyatra cāste kumārastu raṇaṃgamaḥ ||6 1 || rurudatuśca taṃ vīkṣyoddhāraṃ prati punaḥ punaḥ | prārthayāmāsatustatra tasthatustasya sannidhau ||62|| putrastau kuṣṭhinau vīkṣya tathā kṣayasamanvitau | svayaṃ śokena mahatā santapto vākyamabravīt ||63 || ājñāṃ pitrostu yuvayoḥ samādāya nayāmyaham | aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthaṃ kariṣyāmi nirāmayau ||64|| athānayoḥ pitṛvarge gatvā rājābravīdidam | hā mlecchā naumi vaścātra kuṣṭhinau dvāvimau janau ||65|| cikitsārthaṃ kṣayasyāpi svagṛhaṃ ca nayāmyaham | tatrāhametau nirujau kariṣye, ced bhavanmatam ||66|| tatheti sarvato mlecchāḥ kumāraṃ taṃ dayāparam | ūcuḥ praṇatasarvāṃgā yathā jānāsi tat kuru ||67|| tata ānīya puruṣān śibikāvāhanānvitān | dvau pūrvapitarau rājā śivikāyāṃ nyaṣādayat ||68|| rājā cānucarāścāpi viprāśca prātareva ha | prayayuḥ satvaraṃ sāyaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro yayuḥ ||69|| ṛṣiḥ svayaṃprakāśo’pi cāśvapaṭṭāśramaṃ yayau | nṛpādyāstu nijaṃ sthānaṃ vidadhurvaṭasannidhau ||2.42.70|| paścime tu taṭe cāsya saraso vāyudigbhuvi | rātrau sarve tīrthabhūmau cakrurviśrāntimuttamām ||71|| rājā viprāśca tau prātaḥ snāpayituṃ sarovare | samudyatāstadā vāyurantarīkṣe’bravīdidam ||72|| mā rājan sāhasaṃ kārṣīstīrthaṃ rakṣa prayatnataḥ | imau pāpena ghoreṇa sarvavidhena veṣṭitau ||73|| vedanindākarau devadrohiṇau yajñanāśakau | dharmanāśakarau pāpau pāpānto naiva vidyate ||74|| pāte sarasyanayostu saraḥ śuṣkaṃ bhaviṣyati | imau snātau mahattīrthaṃ nāśayiṣyata ulbaṇau ||75|| tasmānnaitau sarastīre jale samavagāhaya | etad vyomavacaḥ śrutvā duḥkhena mahatānvitaḥ ||76|| uvāca śokasantapto vyomavāṇīṃ prati prabho | yadyetau ghorapāpiṣṭhau snānārhau naiva naiva ca ||77|| prāyaścittaṃ kariṣye’haṃ tayorarthe vada prabho | tato vāyuśca devāśca tīrthānyapi samantataḥ ||78|| abhilakṣya ca rājānaṃ sarve vacanamabruvan | snātvā snātvā ca tīrtheṣu aśvasaraḥsthiteṣu ca ||79|| muhustvamabhiṣiñcasva tīrthakalaśavāribhiḥ | āgasāṃ lumpanaṃ yāvat tayoḥ syāt tāvadeva ha ||2.42.80|| svārthapoṣayiturdevadūṣayiturjanasya vai | sakṛt snānena śuddhirna jāyate kutracitkvacit ||8 1|| tasmādetau samuddiśya snātvā tīrtheṣu bhaktitaḥ | abhiṣiñcasva toyena muhuḥ pūtau bhaviṣyataḥ ||82|| ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā kṛtvā tatrāśramaṃ tataḥ | tīrthe tīrthe muhuḥ snātvā samānīya ghaṭe jalam ||83 || dine dine ca tīrtheṣu kṛtvā cāplavanaṃ nṛpaḥ | abhyaṣiñcat svapitarau tīrthatoyena nityaśaḥ ||84|| evaṃ tīrthajalaiḥ sarvairabhiṣiktau punaḥ punaḥ | aśvatīrthasya māhātmyāt tau putreṇa ca pāvitau ||85|| niṣpāpau tu yadā jātau tīrthānyāhustadā nṛpam | etau pavitrau paramau sarasi cāvagāhaya ||86 || ityukto raṇago rājā vaiśākhe tāvagāhayat | niyatau tatkṣaṇājjātau divyadehasamanvitau ||87|| mlecchatā layamāpannā divyaprabhā pravardhitā | kanthādharo vimānastho sastrīko devatābhavat ||88|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | tuṣṭāva parayā prītyā vimānastho’tiharṣitaḥ ||89|| parabrahma paroddhārakṛpānugrahavigraha | tava śiṣyeṇa ṛṣiṇā tāritau pāpinau prabho ||2.42.90|| putreṇa tāritau cāpi tvayāpi tāritau hare | toyaiśca tāritau duṣṭau paropakṛtiśālibhiḥ ||9 1 || vipraiśca tāritau ghorāttamaso’jñānavaibhavāt | nārakī tāritau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa tavāśrayāt ||92|| pareśvarāya hṛtsthāya viprasthāya ca te namaḥ | svayaṃprakāśarūpāya tīrthātmakāya te namaḥ ||93|| namaḥ śaraṇyadevāya pāpiprāṇahitāya ca | śritamokṣāya bālāya bālakṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||94|| tvappratāpāt tarantyeva yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ | daityāśca dānavā duṣṭā āsurāstāmasāstathā ||95|| māyikā vāsanāyuktā garviṣṭhāścābhimāninaḥ | vyavāyinaḥ piśitādāḥ stenā āsavapāyinaḥ ||96 || varṇasaṃkarakārāśca gostrīhatyākarāstathā | tvatpratāpāttarantyeva kṛpānugrahaśevadheḥ ||97|| āvāṃ ca tāritau yāmastava dhāmāmṛtaṃ prabho | ityuktvā praṇipatyaitau putra svasti tavāstu ca ||98|| datvāśiṣo yayatuśca lomaśasyāśramaṃ prati | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||99|| itimantraṃ lomaśācca gṛhītvā tulasīsrajam | paramau vaiṣṇavau bhūtvā yayaturvaiṣṇavaṃ padam || 2.42.100 || āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptāstairthikāśca kuṭumbinaḥ | yadatra snānamātreṇa muktirjātā hi śāśvatī || 101 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyeyaṃ dayā parā | rādhike prabalecchā ca karuṇā prabalā hareḥ || 1 02|| yatra muktāvabhavatāṃ kanthādhro hṛḍḍakāyinī | kanthādhraṃ tatparaṃ tīrthaṃ khyātimāpaddharātale || 103 || rūpadvayaṃ dadhārātha devī sā hṛṅḍakāyinī | chāyārūpā yayau naijaṃ pitaraṃ yamarājakam || 1 04|| yamarājājñayā sā cābhavat hikkāsvarūpiṇī | sarvaprajāsu niyatāvāsaṃ cakāra yoginī || 1 05|| dvitīyena svarūpeṇa divyā hṛcchāyinī satī | muktimārgaṃ gatā divyapatinā sākameva sā || 1 06|| muktibhāvaṃ gatā sāpi pitṛmārgānugāminī | hikkārūpā vāsanayā chāyārūpā babhūva ha || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kanthādharasya hṛḍḍakāyinīpatnīyogena nāstikyaṃ, vedakarmādinirodhenaiśvaryanāśe vane maraṇaṃ mlecchajanma, putreṇa raṇaṃgamenāśvapaṭṭasarastīrthe kṛtoddhāraścetinirūpaṇanāmā dvācatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 42 ||
<2.43> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike bhaktakathāṃ paramapāvanīm | tato’yaṃ nṛpatiḥ raṇaṃgamastīrthe’tra nityaśaḥ || 1 || cakāra vidhivattūrdhvadaihikaṃ śrāddhatarpaṇam | bhojayāmāsa viprāṃśca sādhūn sādhvīśca kanyakāḥ || 2 || bālān ṛṣīṃśca devām̐śca bhikṣukān kiṃkarām̐stathā | dadau dānāni bahudhā svarṇarūpyāṇi bhāvataḥ || 3 || jagrāha lomaśānmantraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ drutam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 4 || vrataṃ cakāra vidhivat tīrthavidhiṃ cakāra ha | jagrāha tulasīmālāṃ pratimāṃ pārameśvarīm || 5 || bheje kṛṣṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ lomaśasyāśrame tataḥ | uvāsa paramaprītyā viprabhṛtyādibhiḥ saha || 6 || samāgamaṃ ca sādhūnāṃ karotyeva divāniśam | saṃsmṛtya pūrvajām̐statra yajñaṃ kartumiyeṣa ca || 7 || śrīrādhikovāca ko’yaṃ rājā kasya vaṃśe’bhavat ke tasya pūrvajāḥ | kathaṃ yajñaṃ cakārāsau kadā kutra vadātra me || 8 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca candraputro’bhavadṛkṣo’rbudāyurdharmayogavit | tasya putraḥ saṃvaraṇo babhūva sārvabhaumapaḥ || 9 || sūryaputrīṃ sa tapatīṃ samudvāha sukanyakām | tābhyāṃ kālāntare jātaḥ kururājā virāgavān || 2.43.10 || pitṛrājyaṃ tvagrajebhyo pitrā dattamato hyayam | svabhāgaṃ prāpya ca dvaitavane gatvā kṛṣiṃ śubhām || 11 || cakāra paramāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ brahmadṛṣṭyā halena vai | viṣṇuṃ sākṣāt kratau kṛtvā mokṣalokaṃ jagāma ha || 1 2|| kuroḥ kaniṣṭho bhrātā yaḥ kanthādharābhidhaḥ śubhaḥ | saṃvaraṇasutaḥ so’pi dāyabhāgaṃ surāṣṭrakam || 13|| āptavān khaṇḍarājyaṃ vai jīvanārthakamātram | siṃhāraṇye koṭinārapattane samuvāsa saḥ || 14|| evaṃ so’pi candravaṃśastasya putro raṇaṃgamaḥ | sasmāra pūrvajānaśvapaṭṭasarasi tairthikaḥ || 15|| brahmāṇaṃ ca marīciṃ kaśyapaṃ candraṃ ca ṛkṣakam | saṃvaraṇaṃ ca kanthādhraṃ tilavārbhiratarpayat || 16|| sāvitrīṃ ca kalāṃ cāpyaditiṃ tathā ca rohiṇīm | ghaṭikāṃ tapatīṃ hikkāṃ tilādbhiḥ samatarpayat || 17|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥpārśve paścime bhūstare kratum | kartuṃ ceyeṣa nṛpatiḥ raṇaṃgamo’tidhārmikaḥ || 18|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ṣaṣṭhavarṣake | cāturmāsye vaiṣṇavaṃ sa mahāyāgaṃ cikīrṣati || 1 9|| nijarājyāttu sāmagrīrānayāmāsa satvaram | kuśān sampādyāmāsa samidhaśca pṛthagvidhān ||2.43.20| maṇḍapāgryaṃ maṇḍapām̐śca racayāmāsa śobhanān | parṇaśālā vāsayogyāḥ kārayāmāsa śilpibhiḥ ||21 || kuṇḍaṃ kuṇḍān vedikāśca paṭṭikā āsanāni ca | yajñapātrāṇyuttamānyaudumbaraṃ pātramuttamam ||22|| kauśeyāni suvastrāṇi kārayāmāsa satvaram | rasaśālāḥ pākaśālā bhojyaśālā drumādiṣu ||23|| klṛptayāmāsa subhagāḥ peyaśālāḥ prapādikāḥ | gauśālā hayaśālāśca patnīśālā vratasthalīḥ ||24|| kārayāmāsa vidhinā tvānayāmāsa cākṣatān | godhūmakān yavān vrīhīn tilān phalāni śarkarāḥ ||25|| havyadravyāṇi sarvāṇi raṅgadravyāṇi yāni ca | pūjādravyāṇyuttamāni dakṣiṇā bhūyasīstathā || 26|| japajāpyopakaraṇānyakhilānyambarāṇi ca | kalaśān raṅgapaṭakān patrāṇi pañcadhā tathā ||27|| ghṛtapātrāṇi ca caruṃ devānāṃ sthāpanāni ca | kārayāmāsa vidhinā svastivācyāni maṃgalam || 28|| nāndīśrāddhaṃ ca saṃskārān śuddhiṃ prokṣaṇakādikam | śatamaṣṭottaraṃ cātha sahasraṃ brāhmaṇāstathā ||29|| yājñeyāḥ samatiṣṭhanta brahmādyāścāpare tathā | hotodgātā pratyudgātā sāmajñā yantravedinaḥ ||2.43.3 0|| āhartā pratihartā ca yajamānāśca jāpakāḥ | pāṭhakā brahmacintāśca guṇakāryakarāstathā ||3 1 || mṛgaśṛṃgādiyuktāśca nyadīṣan maṇḍapeṣu ca | prāvartata kratukāryaṃ vahnirnyadhāyi havyabhuk ||32|| viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ | caturviṃśatyavatāraiḥ sahitaḥ pūjitaḥ puraḥ ||33|| brahma muktā rādhikādyā muktānyo viṣṇuyoṣitaḥ | pārvatī ca prabhā lakṣmīḥ śrīḥ satī kamalādikāḥ ||34|| haṃsā paramahaṃsā ca saguṇā mañjulā priyāḥ | pūjitāḥ mātaraścāpi śaṃbhurdevā gaṇādhipaḥ ||35|| brahmacarāḥ ṛṣayo’nye pārṣadāḥ śaktayastathā | paṭṭakanyāśca durgādyā grahā devāśca kṣetrapāḥ ||36|| dikpālā lokapālāśca siddhayo yoginīgaṇaḥ | sāttvikāḥ pitṛvargāśca sthāpitā devamaṇḍale ||37|| brahmasṛṣṭirīśasṛṣṭirjīvasṛṣṭirvarīyasī | maṇḍape pūjitā tatra yajñabhāgārthinī ca yā ||38|| rājasāstāmasāścāpi devakiṃkaravādinaḥ| pūjitā lomaśenātra viṣṇuyajñe mahotsave ||39|| raṇaṃgamo yajamāno gururvai lomaśo muniḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yajñāgryadevatā ||2.43.40|| sarvaṃ tatra susampannaṃ cāturmāsye’nvahaṃ kratau | vidhivannityamevaitadādyantaṃ karma puṣkalam ||41 || āṣāḍhe tu samāraṃbhaḥ kārtike’sya samāpanam | nityaṃ ca havanaṃ tatrāyutavipraprabhojanam ||42|| anyeṣāṃ naiva pāro’sti koṭikanyādibhojanam | koṭibālādibhojyāni vastradānāni nityaśaḥ ||43|| ghṛtakulyā dadhikulyāḥ payaḥkulyāḥ sahasraśaḥ | rasakulyā madhukulyā madhuparkādivaibhavāḥ ||44|| miṣṭapānāni miṣṭānnottamānyagaṇitānyapi | dīyante bhojane tatra tṛptā bhavanti dehinaḥ ||45|| vahnirnityaṃ mūrtimān svakarābhyāṃ grasate haviḥ | svayaṃprakāśo bhagavān juhoti ghṛtadhārayā ||46|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vahnirgṛhṇāti mukhapaṃkaje | yajñātmānaḥ parāṃ tṛptiṃ prāpnuvanti kratūttame ||47|| koṭidānāni dīyante raṇaṃgamena nityaśaḥ | evaṃ nityaṃ jāyamāne yajñe trailokyavāsinaḥ ||48|| darśanārthaṃ havanārthaṃ samāyānti viyanti ca | nityaṃ sahasrakamalaiḥ pūjayanti surā harim ||49|| yatra sā kambharā lakṣmīstathā gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ | virājete ca janakau pūjopakaraṇapradau ||2.43.50|| yajñadravyapradau cāpi tatra kā nyūnatā khalu | patnīvrato maharṣiśca sarvādhyakṣo’tra vartate ||5 1|| tatra kā nyūnatā sarvasatkāre pānabhojanaiḥ | ityevaṃ rādhike yajñaḥ prāvartata dine dine ||52|| vṛṣṭiḥ prajāyate nityaṃ modante sasyajātayaḥ | kanthādharanimittena kṛto yajñaḥ sutena vai ||53|| kanthāṃ vinā sarvamadād dāne raṇaṃgamaḥ sutaḥ | kṛṣṇastuṣyatu pratyakṣaścetyuktvādāt supātrake ||54|| devāḥ svargāt samāgatya ghrātvā dhūmān ghṛtasya vai | śukarūpāścābruvam̐śca divyavāṇyā parasparam ||55|| dhanyo raṇaṃgamo loke dhanyaḥ kanthādharo’pi ca | dhanyaścandrādayo vṛddhā yadvaṃśe yajñavistaraḥ ||56|| yatkratau viṃśatitamo’kṣaro lupto’nunāsikaḥ | sarvaṃ pradīyate yatra kanthāṃ kaupīnamantarā ||57|| kṣudhā devī yatra yajñe parājayaṃ gatāsti vai | tṛptirvijayate cātra dhanyo vai lomaśo muniḥ ||58|| dhanyaḥ patnīvrato vipro dhanyaḥ svayaṃprakāśakaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yeṣāṃ sahāyakṛt ||59|| cāturmāsye sadā devā vastavyaṃ tvatra sarvathā | gamanāgamane nityaṃ vṛthā yatno na ceṣyate ||2.43.6 0|| durlabhaṃ puṇyatīrthaṃ durlabhā satsaṃgatistathā | durlabhaṃ cārhaṇaṃ nityaṃ durlabhaṃ śaraṇaṃ hareḥ||6 1 || durlabhā puṇyakīrtiśca durlabhaśca kathāśravaḥ | durlabhaṃ priyamitrāṇāṃ nityamevānudarśanam ||62|| durlabhā śrīharerbhaktirdurlabhaṃ caraṇāmṛtam | durlabhaṃ tatprasādasya nityamevāśanaṃ tathā ||63 || durlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ sarvaṃ dhanyā kuṃkumavāpikā | dhanyaṃ tvaśvasarastīrthaṃ yatra yajñaḥ pravartate ||64|| trailokyatṛptido devāḥ sākṣācchrīpatisannidhau | nedṛg brahmasaraścāpi nedṛgvai puṣkaraṃ saraḥ ||65|| saraśca mānasaṃ nedṛṅ nedṛṅ nārāyaṇaṃ saraḥ | nedṛṅa pampāsaraścāpi na yatra parameśvaraḥ ||66|| atra vṛkṣāśca vallyaśca muktāḥ sarve vasanti hi | stambā gulmāstṛṇātmānaḥ sarve muktā vasanti hi ||67|| paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo vāricarāḥ pataṃgajātayaḥ | pārthivāḥ kīṭamaśakāḥ sarve muktā vasanti vai ||68|| dhanyaṃ rajo’sya deśasya yatsparśaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | dhanyaṃ jalaṃ ca saraso yadbindurmokṣadāyakaḥ ||69|| vayaṃ yajñabhujo dhanyā yeṣāṃ lābho’yamuttamaḥ | raṇaṃgamo’yaṃ dhanyaśca devadeho bhavatvayam ||2.43.70 || devasiddhiyutaścāstu devasmṛddhibharo’stu ca | devo devagatimām̐śca bhavatvayaṃ raṇaṃgamaḥ ||71 || ityāśīrbhiryojito’yaṃ raṇaṃgamo hi bhaktarāṭ | tāvat smṛddhaṃ divyayānaṃ smṛddhaṃ tadarthamāgatam ||72|| kāmadaṃ kalpalatikāyuktamānandasaṃbhṛtam | saṃsthitaṃ nityasevāyāmindrārpitaṃ sasārathi ||73 || dāsadāsībhṛtyayuktaṃ bhojyāmṛtahradānvitam | saprakāśaṃ sarvaśayyābhogyavastusamanvitam ||74|| evaṃ raṇaṃgamo rājā devānāṃ suprasādataḥ | prāpyākṣayaṃ vimānaṃ tvakṣayavastupradaṃ sadā ||75|| dadau dānāni saṃkalpya nityaṃ koṭyarbudāni ca | āhūya viśvakarmāṇaṃ śambaraṃ ca mayaṃ tathā ||76 || kārayāmāsa tattīrthe tvaśvapaṭṭasarontike | parito devavāsanāmayutaṃ sāptabhaumakam ||77|| svargavacchobhayāmāsa devānasthāpayattathā | pūjanārthaṃ ca viprebhyo gṛhadānāni vai dadau ||78|| kalpavallīṃ ca pratyekabrāhmaṇāya dadau tadā | sarvaṃ phalati vallyāṃ ca bhogyamiṣṭaṃ ca nityaśaḥ ||79|| na kṣetrasya na sasyānāṃ gavāṃ nāpi prayojanam | dhānyārthaṃ ca kaṇārthaṃ ca vasārthaṃ ca tadātra vai ||2.43.80|| alparājyo’pi rājāsau cāndrīṃ kāntiṃ sunirmalām | kīrtiṃ cāpyabhajalloke sārvabhaumādikāṃ tadā ||8 1 || rādhike mama bhaktasya nāpūrṇaṃ vidyate kvacit | mahyaṃ dadāti sarvasvaṃ tasmai sarvaṃ dadāmyaham ||82|| evaṃ yajñe jāyamāne
