devālayāyuteṣu ca | jāyamāneṣu ca tato raṇaṃgamo divaṃgamaḥ ||83|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya saptame śubhe | āgate vatsare’ṣṭamyāṃ harerjanmotsavaṃ vyadhāt ||84|| tatra ratnāsane’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | upāveśayārcayat tu naikadivyopadādibhiḥ ||85|| brāhmaṇān bhojayāmāsa lakṣaśo bālakānapi | surān saṃpūjayāmāsa gāpayāmāsa gītikāḥ ||86|| maṃgalāni vividhāni kārayāmāsa bhāvataḥ | sādhūnṛṣīn satīḥ sādhvīḥ pūjayāmāsa vai nṛpaḥ ||87|| dānāni dāpayāmāsa svarṇarūpyakahīrakān | vastrabhūṣāgomahiṣīrgajāśvarathakiṃkarān ||88|| atha rātrau kathāṃ ramyāṃ vācayāmāsa lomaśaḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā dvitīyakhaṇḍagām ||89|| kathānte koṭikanyābhiḥ kṛtaṃ kāntasya pūjanam | niśāyāṃ rāsaramaṇaṃ koṭirūpairhariḥ svayam ||2.43.90|| kāntābhiḥ koṭibhiḥ sākaṃ cakāra parameśvaraḥ | sthalapadmavāṭikāyāṃ vistṛtāyāṃ hariḥ svayam ||9 1 || parihāraṃ cakārātha sukhayitvā sakhīgaṇān | prātaryajñe havanaṃ ca rājā cakāra nityavat ||92|| āgatānāṃ ca devānāṃ janmotsavajuṣāṃ nṛpaḥ | sevāṃ cakāra bahudhā visarjanaṃ cakāra ca ||93|| kārtikyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ ca yajñahomottaraṃ nṛpaḥ | parihāraṃ cakārāsya kratordadau ca dakṣiṇāḥ ||94|| ratnahīrakamāṇikyasvarṇaraupyavibhūṣaṇam | vastrānnayānavāhādīn dadau dānānyanekaśaḥ ||95|| avabhṛthaṃ cakārāsau saharṣibhiḥ sarovare | avatārāstathā muktā muktānya īśvarāstathā || 96|| devāśca pitaro martyāḥ sarve sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ | yajñānte prayayurnaijaṃ naijamālayamutsukāḥ | | 97 || rājānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhajan sanātanam | viprairbhṛtyaiśca sahito divyayānasthito’bhavat | | 98 | | ṛṣīn kṛṣṇaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ devān surālayān | tīrthāni vṛkṣavallīśca praṇamya prayayau gṛham || 99 || koṭīnārākhyanagaraṃ prajābhirabhivanditaḥ | viveśa nagaraṃ naijaṃ viśaśrāma nijālaye | | 2.43.100 || atha yakṣaścitramālābhidhaḥ śuśrāva taṃ nṛpam | pratāpinaṃ mahābhaktaṃ kīrtimantaṃ suyauvanam || 101 || ājagāma ca saurāṣṭraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram | dadarśa bhūpatiyajñabhūmiṃ prāsādavaibhavān | | 102| | nṛpeṇa kāritān jñātvā jñātvā māhātmyamuttamam | kṛtamālāṃ nijakanyāṃ dātuṃ yayau raṇaṃgamam || 103 || raṇaṃgamena ca kalpavallyā navīkṛtaṃ puram | nagaraṃ devanagaraṃ dadarśa yakṣapuṅgavaḥ | | 1 04|| avātarad vimānācca rājño nivāsamambarāt | kanyāṃ dāsīstathā dāsān dadau raṇaṃgamāya saḥ || 1 05|| rājā vivāhavidhinā pāṇigrahaṃ cakāra ha | jāmātā yakṣavaryasya devavad rājate bhuvi || 106 | | yakṣaḥ putrīṃ pradāyaiva yayau kauberapattanam | rādhike jāyate śrotā vaktāsya bhuktimuktibhāk || 107 | | iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne raṇaṃgamakṛtayaśaḥ, prabhoḥ saptamo janmotsavaḥ, yakṣakanyayā raṇaṃgamavivāho vimānādilābhaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tricatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ | | 43 | |
<2.44> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścād rājā siddhisamāśritaḥ | pattanaṃ racayāmāsa somavelāhvayaṃ mahat || 1 || yatra sauvarṇasaudhām̐śca daśasahasrasaṃkhyakān | raupyasaudhām̐stāvataśca maṇisaudhān sahasraśaḥ || 2 | | udyānāni vicitrāṇi vāṭikāḥ padmasārasīḥ | kārayāmāsa bahudhā vāsayāmāsa devatāḥ || 3 || kalpavallīṃ dadau tatra pratyeke cālaye tataḥ | yakṣān kiṃpuruṣān bandīn cāraṇān bhūsurāṃstathā || 4 || mānavān vāsayāmāsa koṭiśo devasadṛśān | evaṃ kṛtvā somavelābhidhaṃ dvādaśagopuram | | 5 || nagaraṃ paścime bhāge somatīrthānmanoharam | tataḥ śrīsomanāthasya sauvarṇaṃ mandiraṃ punaḥ | | 6 || kārayāmāsa jīrṇaṃ cottārya vai nūtanaṃ mahat| | sahasrahastocchrāyaṃ ca sāptabhaumaṃ ca gopuram | | 7 || pañcāśaddhastavistāraṃ śikharaṃ parvatopamam | tatra devaḥ somanātho vyomastho rājate’śritaḥ || 8 || suvarṇaśṛṃkhalābodhyo ghaṇṭo yatra virājate | daśayojanasaṃśrāvaḥ śatabhāragurutvavān || 9 || śatamānavasaṃbodhyo yantramātreṇa śabditaḥ | yasya śikharakalaśaḥ sauvarṇaḥ saptabhāgavān || 2.44.10 || pañcāśaddhastakocchrāyaḥ sūryasannibhabhāsuraḥ | pañcāśaddhastakadhvajo daṇḍo’sya śatahastakaḥ || 11 || yatrābhrāṇi pratiṣṭhanti cāturmāsye nirantaram | yatra sthito manuṣyaśca haṃsavat pravilokyate || 12 || tatra bhogān brāhmaṇām̐śca yojayāmāsa pūjane | viśeṣataśca rājāsāvannasatraṃ babandha ha || 13 || yatrāyutaṃ ca nārīṇāṃ narāṇāmayutaṃ tathā | pañcāyutāni bālānāṃ bālikānāṃ tathaiva ca || 14|| bhuñjate miṣṭamiśrāṇi ghṛtānnāni ca nityaśaḥ | evaṃ raṇegamo rājā yajñapuṇyaprabhāvataḥ || 15|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyopāstivaibhavāt | lokapāla ivāsīdvai pṛthvyāṃ vimānago’bhavat || 1 6|| athāyaṃ pauṣapūrṇāyāṃ yayau vai dakṣiṇāṃ diśam | pāresamudraṃ yānena vaihāyasā pravīkṣitum || 1 7|| dakṣiṇaṃ tu dhruvaṃ draṣṭuṃ yayau cāgre mahābalaḥ | bhojyapānaṃ dāsavargaṃ veṣaṃ kalpalatāṃ tathā || 18 || sādhanāni saha nītvā yayau vimānago’mbare | saurāṣṭrād dakṣiṇaṃ deśaṃ siṃhāraṇyaṃ vilokya ca || 1 9|| śatayojanakaṃ deśaṃ krāntvā cāgre yayau nṛpaḥ | samudraṃ ca dadarśāsau dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritam || 2.44.20 || tatra dadarśa ca lākṣādīpadvīpaṃ suśobhanam | tataścāgre yayau vyomnā māladvīpaṃ dadarśa saḥ || 21 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā prayayau vyomnā sveṣṭadvīpaṃ dadarśa saḥ | taṃ vilokyābhitaḥ paścānmuraśeṣābhidhaṃ śubham || 22 || dvīpaṃ cālokayāmāsa yatrābhavanmurāsuraḥ | sa ca yoddhuṃ samāyāto vyomnā raṇaṃgamena vai || 23 || kalpavallyā samutpādya vāruṇaṃ pāśamulbaṇam | rājñā cābaddhya ca daityaḥ prakṣiptaḥ sāgare tadā ||24|| yathākañcit prāṇena sahitaḥ svālayaṃ yayau | atha rājā yayau cāgre dvīpe kurujaṭaṃ tadā ||25|| dadarśa paritastatra jaṭāyūmānavān tataḥ | yayāvagre vimānena dadarśāntarabījakam ||26| dvīpaṃ śītamayaṃ yatra makarāsyā hi mānavāḥ | prāyaśo jalavāsāśca rājñā tenāvalokitāḥ ||27|| tato yayau vimānena vaihāyasena dakṣiṇām | diśaṃ tatra dadarśāyaṃ pṛthvīṃ śvetāṃ suvartulām ||28|| apkarakāṃ saśaivālāṃ rūpavacca prabhānvitām | yatra cāpomayībhūśca dehinaḥ śvetabhāsvarāḥ ||29|| apkarakādanāḥ sarve jale śailanivāsinaḥ | narā nāryo jhaṣākārā jalapāṃśusahāḥ sadā ||2.44.30|| pibantaśca jalaṃ śītaṃ khādanto jalaśarkarām | śaivālaṃ jalapākām̐śca bhuñjanto nirvahanti te ||3 1 || gṛhāṇi jalapāṣāṇaiḥ kṛtānyatra vasanti ca | śītacandrasamābhāsā jalotthāmṛtabhojanāḥ ||3 2|| evaṃvidhān janān paśyan dadarśa dakṣiṇaṃ dhruvam | prathamaṃ kārakīṃ bhūmi tato draṣṭuṃ vyavartata ||33|| vimānasthena rājñā sā vartulā vīkṣitā kṣitiḥ || jalarūpyamayī sarvā vṛkṣahīnā vasundharā ||34|| yatra meghāḥ sadā santi sūryatāpo na vidyate | sāmudraprastarāḥ santi dhātavaḥ karakāmayāḥ ||35|| rasaścāmṛtamiṣṭo vai jalīyaḥ karakodbhavaḥ | jalaṃ śaivālapuṭikā jalapatrāṇi vallayaḥ ||36|| śvetavarṇāḥ śvetaphalācandrakhaṇḍanibhāśca tāḥ | jalaśākāni bhojyāni jalapāṣāṇajā gṛhāḥ ||37|| sāmudrakṣārakarakā jalānāṃ miṣṭaśarkarāḥ | jalapāṣāṇakandāśca bhojyāstanmānavaiḥ sukhaiḥ ||38|| etat sarvaṃ vilokyaiva vāruṇaṃ bhavanaṃ tathā | dakṣiṇadhruvagolasya madhyabindvāśrayaṃ sthalam ||39|| vilokya punarāyācca rājā raṇaṃgamastaṭam | tatra kampapradeśaṃ ca tataḥ kaṭisaraṃ puraḥ ||2.44.40|| vilokya sarvataḥ paścād rājasaṃ ca pradeśakam | dadarśa cāgrato gatvā deśaṃ tu kanyakālayam ||41 || tataścāgre dadarśāsau kāṇākṣaṃ supradeśakam | tato’pyagre dadarśāyaṃ sagrīvaṃ deśamuttamam ||42|| adrighnaṃ ca tato deśaṃ dadarśa jalaśailajam | yātadeśaṃ ca vīkṣāripradeśaṃ sa dadarśa ha ||43|| grīṣmaśūnyakadeśaṃ ca kusthadeśaṃ tataḥ param | dhruvabinduṃ vilokyaiva dadarśāntārkivartulam ||44|| evaṃ bhūgṛhyadeśaṃ taṃ śītamātrakṛtāspadam | śītalaṃ saṃvilokyaiva tasmād yāvannivartate ||45|| tāvad bhūtalagarbhācca śvetaparvatasadṛśaḥ | pumān kaścit samāyāto rādhike vyomamārgagaḥ ||46|| anantavīryo brahmāṇḍodaravāsaḥ kuṭumbavān | śvetavarṇaḥ śvetavastraḥ śvetatejaprabhānvitaḥ ||47|| śvetaśmaśruḥ śvetarasaḥ śvetaśailagadāyutaḥ | yanmastake’lagan meghāḥ pādayoḥ śvetaparvatāḥ ||48|| yatkaṭyāṃ śvetaśaivālā yanmukhe stanayitnavaḥ | yacchabdo dakṣiṇadhruvamabhivyāpya pravartate ||49|| vidyudvegā gatiryasya śvāsaḥ samudrakampanaḥ | aṭṭahāsaṃ diśāmanteṣvabhivyāpya nivartate ||2.44.50|| raṇaṃgamaśca taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayaṃ cāvāpa vai kṣaṇam | tāvatsa śuklapuruṣaścājuhāva raṇaṃgamam ||51 || ehyehi divyadeva tvaṃ vaihāyasavihārakṛt | kiṃ te bhayaṃ nu matto’sti kalpavallīśritasya vai ||52|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yasya hṛdi sthitaḥ | tādṛśastvaṃ mahābhakto balavān rājase bhuvi ||53|| dhanyo’si rājanparameśvarāśrayastvaṃbhautiko’pīśvaranāthadṛṣṭitaḥ | virājase devavadīśvaraḥ svayaṃ pāraṃgatastvaṃ bhavasāgarasya yat ||54|| āgaccha maddhāma punīhi māmakaṃ gṛhaṃ sadā bhūmisugarbhavāsitam | mayā sadārādhyata eva yastvayā raṇaṃgamārādhyata īśvareśvaraḥ ||55|| ahaṃ hi śeṣasya suvaṃśajo jano vasāmi garbhe’tra hi lakṣmaṇābhidhaḥ | anādinārāyaṇakṛṣṇabālakaṃ bhajāmi nityaṃ sasamastabāndhavaḥ ||56|| gṛhāṇa satkāramanuttamaṃ mayā kṛtaṃ tathā cārpaya darśanaṃ tava | nivedayiṣye’rcanayogyakopadāstābālakṛṣṇāya ca dātumarhasi ||57|| namo namaste mama nāthabhakta namo namaste paramātmavedin | namo namaste parameśabhakta mahākratukṛd bhavate namo’stu ||58 || ityevaṃ rādhike tena lakṣmaṇena susatkṛtaḥ | vāgbhirviśvāsamāpanno raṇaṃgamaḥ sthiro’bhavat ||59|| tāvacchrīlakṣmaṇastatra rūpaṃ kṛtvā tu mānavam | saumyaṃ surūpaṃ bhaktasya viśvāsyaṃ tilakānvitam ||2.44.60|| vaiṣṇavaṃ tulasīyuktaṃ gṛṇantaṃ kṛṣṇanāma ca | nanāma parayā prītyā raṇaṃgamo’tibhāvataḥ ||61 || lakṣmaṇaścāha paśyātra viśvāsārthaṃ ca me hṛdi | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo virājate prabhuḥ ||62|| raṇaṃgamo dadarśāsya hṛdaye parameśvaram | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cāśvasaraḥsthitam ||63|| rādhāpatiṃ prabheśaṃ pāravatīśaṃ sumañjulam | lakṣmīśaṃ haṃsanāthaṃ ca śrīmadgopālanandanam ||64|| saguṇeśaṃ kambharālālitaṃ bhaktavinodakam | divyakaṭakamukuṭormikāhāravibhūṣitam ||65|| koṭikandarpaśobhādhirūparūpānurūpitam | ujjvalaṃ mandahāsyasthaṃ paśyantaṃ tu raṇaṃgamam ||66 || evaṃvidhaṃ taddhṛdaye vilokya sveṣṭamādhavam | raṇaṃgamo mahābhakto viśvāsamagamatpunaḥ || 67|| tataḥ sa lakṣmaṇaṃ nāgaṃ naramānavarūpiṇam | vimāne hastamādāyārohayāmāsa satvaram ||68|| tena darśitamārgeṇa vimānaṃ vāhitaṃ nijam | prāptaṃ pṛthvīguptabinduṃ jalapāṣāṇabhūgatam ||69|| dakṣiṇadhruvagolasya mukhasya sannidhau mahat | vivaraṃ tatra cāyātaṃ bhūgarbhaṃ gantumeva ca ||2.44.70|| vartulaṃ yojanamānaṃ śvetanāgaiḥ surakṣitam | śītapāṣāṇasopānaṃ śītaprākārarakṣitam ||71 || lakṣmaṇādiṣṭamārgeṇa vimānaṃ vivarāntare | viveśa kṣaṇato yatra jayaśabdāstadābhavan ||72|| dvārapānāṃ mahāśabdairbhūgarbhe cāntarāmbare | vidyunmaṇiprakāśānāṃ candraprabhāsamujjvale ||73 || kanyābhirvardhitaṃ lājaiḥ pūjitaṃ puṣparatnakaiḥ | vimānaṃ cāntare deśe gatvā pṛthvyāmavātarat ||74|| tatra vai pṛthivī ramyā śvetā kṛṣṇā ca pāṇḍurā | oṣadhayaśca vividhā drumāḥ phalasuśobhitāḥ ||75 || sasyānāṃ smṛddhayaścāpi svarṇavarṇā vilokitāḥ | nadyo nadā vāṭikāśca dīrghikā jalapūritāḥ ||76 || amṛtaiḥ saṃbhṛtāḥ kūpā raṇaṃgamena lokitāḥ | gāvaḥ śvetāḥ pāṇḍurāśca sapakṣā vyomagāstathā ||77|| kāmarūpadharāścānye paśavo dugdhadāstadā | vilokitā narā nāryaḥ sarve bhūṣāvibhūṣitāḥ ||78|| ujjvalāścandrasadṛśā maṇihāravirājitāḥ | śītāścandranibhāḥ sarve padmapatranibhekṣaṇāḥ ||79|| surūpāḥ piṅganetrāśca raktanakhoṣṭhapattalāḥ | vahiśuddhāṃśukāḥ sarve dṛḍhāḥ śvetānnabhojanāḥ ||2.44.80|| yathā bhūpari bhāge’smin vartate sarvathātra ca | tathā tatrāpi rājā sa vibhūtīn sandadarśa ha ||8 1|| prāsādāḥ śvetavarṇāśca sarvopakaraṇāni ca | nagarāṇi surājyāni parvatā jalabhūmayaḥ ||82|| śvetāḥ sarvā manuṣyāścetyālokya vismayaṃ gataḥ | lakṣmaṇena vimānaṃ tanmahānagarasammukham ||83|| cālitaṃ yatra puṣpāḍhyodyānāni subahūnyapi | paritaḥ santi saudhāśca prāsādāḥ parvatopamāḥ ||84|| tatrāsyocchrayabhūbhāge prākārāntaraśobhitaḥ | lakṣmaṇasya tu rājño vai prāsādaḥ parvatopamaḥ ||85|| lakṣmaṇābhidhavarṇāṅko’ntarīkṣe dhvajaśobhitaḥ | śatabhaumo rājate yo dṛṣṭo raṇaṃgamena vai ||86 || vimānaṃ lakṣmaṇenātrodyānāṃgaṇe’vatāritam | tadā vādyānyavādyanta rājarītyā hi rādhike ||87|| jayaśabdāḥ sainyapālā rājyavaccopatasthire | rājadhānī svargasamā raṇaṃgamena lokitā ||88|| bhūgolasyāntare bhāge sṛṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭvātimānuṣīm | āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpa raṇaṃgamo jaharṣa ca ||89|| atha vai lakṣmaṇo ninye raṇaṃgamaṃ sabhāntare | yatra vai śatarājñyaśca kanyakādvisahasrakam ||2.44.90|| kumārāḥ pañcasāhasrā vartante lakṣmaṇasya ha | lakṣmaṇena sabhāmadhye puṇye siṃhāsane sthitaḥ ||91|| pratiṣṭhito devaharmye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | svarṇapratimāsvarūpo darśito bhagavān hariḥ || 92|| raṇaṃgamāya ca tato’rghyaṃ madhuparkamuttamam | dadauvamṛtapānaṃ supuṣpahārādikaṃ dadau ||93|| atha siṃhāsane saumye nyaṣādayacca taṃ tataḥ | kanyaikā puṣpamālāṃ saṅgṛhya tatra nideśataḥ ||94|| samāyātā dadarśainaṃ raṇaṃgamaṃ śubhāspadam | svāgatārthaṃ lalāṭe’sya kuṃkumākṣatacandrakam ||95|| cakre dadau puṣpamālāṃ kaṇṭhe’sya ca kare dadau | gucchaṃ sugandhapuṣpāṇāṃ cakre sugandhakokṣaṇam ||96|| yuvānaṃ vaiṣṇava raktavarṇaṃ dṛḍhaṃ ca sundaram | dṛṣṭvā sā kanyakā nāmnā mālinī yauvanodbharā || 97|| mumoha manasā śreṣṭhaṃ varaṃ mene’nurūpakam | athāyaṃ lakṣmaṇo jñātvā dadau raṇaṃgamāya tām ||98|| sāpi bhaktaṃ patiṃ labdhvā mumude hṛdi sarvathā | athāyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamantraṃ jagāda tām ||99|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | lakṣmaṇāryastadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ punarmudā || 2.44.10 0|| prasasmārātibhāvena dhanyaṃ matvā nijaṃ gṛham | tāvacchrībhagavām̐statrānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 90 1|| viditvā bhaktasadbhāvaṃ pratyakṣaḥ saṃbabhūva ha | divyakiśorarūpaśca sarvalāvaṇyaśevadhiḥ || 1 02|| yugapatsūryasāhasrādhikatejovirājitaḥ | rūpānurūpāvayavaḥ sabhāyāṃ prakaṭo’bhavat || 102 || utthitāḥ sahasā sarve nemurnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | tejasā channanetrāste kṣaṇaṃ tasthurjaḍā iva || 1 04|| śīghraṃ tejovimalatve dattāsanaḥ prabhurhariḥ | lakṣmaṇāryakṛtāṃ pūjāṃ jagrāha divyavastubhiḥ || 1 05|| niveditānnaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tathā | jagrāha suhasan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastu tatkṣaṇam || 1 06|| svastītyuktvā kuśalaṃ te kalyāṇaṃ śāśvataṃ tava | vadam̐stiro’bhavacchīghraṃ kanyakāstu sahasraśaḥ || 1 07|| mugdhāstaṃ śrīhariṃ dṛṣṭvā vavrire manasā patim | abhiprāyaṃ pitā jñātvā manasā haraye’rpayat || 1 08|| atha yātrā nimittena prayāṇaṃ pracakāra saḥ | lakṣmaṇāryaḥ kumāraiśca kanyābhirmātṛbhiḥ saha || 1 09|| gṛhītvā koṭiratnāni svarṇarūpyadhanāni ca | maṇimāṇikyamuktāśca raṇaṃgamavimānakam || 2.44.11 0|| adhyāruroha sukhataḥ kṛtvā rājyamamātyasāt | kāmage saṃkalpamātrād vistṛte yojanāyate || 111 || bhūdvāranirgamayogye raṇaṃgamo ruroha ca | sabhāsthānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ yatra śrībhagavān svayam || 1 12|| pratyakṣo’bhūtparaṃ tīrthaṃ natvā tūrṇaṃ vihāyasā | deśaṃ visṛjya bhūdvārānnirgamyāntārkivartulam || 113 || jalapāṣāṇadeśaṃ taṃ samullaṃghyāntarīkṣake | samadropari dīrghaṃ tadvimānaṃ vegavaddhyabhūt| || 1 14|| yathā sūryaḥ samāyāti yadvā candraḥ prayāti ca | dṛṣṭaṃ jalasthalāvāsaiḥ rādhike dyotayad diśaḥ || 1 15|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne raṇaṃgamasya dakṣiṇadhruvadarśanārthaṃ vimānena gatasya antārkivartuladeśamadhye bhūvivare praviṣṭasya lakṣmaṇāryakṛtasvāgataṃ prabhordarśanaṃ lakṣmaṇasya rājñaḥ sakuṭumbasya tadvimānena yātrārthaṃ pṛthvyāgamanaprayāṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuścatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 44 ||
<2.45> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike tadvimānaṃ ca samudropari cottarām | diśaṃ prati prayātaṃ kampayaccānilamaṇḍalam || 1 || jalaṃ cukṣobha sāmudraṃ dṛṣṭvā candranibhaṃ tadā | ghaṭikāmātratastattu dvīpaṃ kurujaṭātmakam || re || samullaṃghya samāyātaṃ dvīpaṃ rūpyāyanāhvayam | tathā pārśvasthitaṃ dvīpaṃ muraśeṣaṃ parākramīt || 3 || śrutvā tu paścime daityo mātrāgaskaranāmakaḥ | śailatulyaḥ svagadayā sahitaḥ sanmukho’bhavat || 4 || kruddho mlecchasvarūpaśca kaṭimātrasamudrakaḥ | mājāmbikāyā rākṣasyāḥ putrastimiṃgilāśanaḥ || 5 || śrīrādhikovāca kathaṃ cāsīdayaṃ mātrāgaskaro rākṣaso mahān | ko’parādhaḥ kṛtastena māturme vada mādhava || 6 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca saurāṣṭre tu talājāyā rākṣasyāḥ kiṃkarī śubhā | moṃ ajā nāmataḥ khyātā kāmarūpadharā satī || 7 || āsīdaraṇyavāsā cāraṇyavihārakāriṇī | paśvadā ca phalādā ca surūpā dṛḍhayauvanā || 8 || ekadā sā mahāraṇye bhakṣyārthaṃ samupāgatā | paścime somatīrthe’syā gatiryadṛcchayābhavat || 9 || sā hi tatra pavitrām̐śca tairthikān vīkṣya śobhanān | tairthikaiḥ saha saṃgatya mānavīrūpadhāriṇī || 2.45.1 0|| samuvāsaikadivasaṃ kathāṃ śuśrāva pāvanīm | kathāyāṃ rādhike cādhyātmikaṃ tattvaṃ samāgatam || 1 1|| jaḍānāṃ cetanānāṃ ca rakṣako’sti pareśvara | paramātmā pare dhāmni divyairmuktaiḥ prasevitaḥ || 12|| sarvānandanidhiḥ sarvasaukhyasamṛddhibhājanaḥ | tasya nārāyaṇanāmnā bhajanena sukhaṃ bhavet || 13 | sa tu nārāyaṇanāmno bhaktyā tuṣyati sarvadā | nārāyaṇeti satataṃ japanīyaṃ tato’niśam || 14|| kīrtanīyaṃ ca satataṃ nārāyaṇa hare prabho | prāṇasvāmin sukhadātaḥ sarvasaubhāgyado bhava || 15|| evaṃ vai bhajitaḥ samyak sarvaṃ dadāti vāñchitam | nāryaḥ saukhyaṃ susaubhāgyaṃ rājyaṃ dhānyaṃ dhanādikam || 16 || patiṃ yaśasvinaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ putrapautrādikaṃ tathā | āpnuvanti na sandeho vimānavāhanānyapi || 17|| jagat sarvaṃ tasya vaśe sa ca samrāṭ virājate | tasya rājyaṃ hi trailokye tadāśrayī sukhī bhavet || 18|| kaiṃkaryaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ puruṣeṇa vijānatā | yadicchet paramaṃ svargaṃ kāmabhogasamanvitam || 1 9|| tasyāśrayeṇa sadbhāgyaṃ vardhate nityamuttamam | durbhāgyā subhagā syācca rājñī syād dāsikā hyapi ||2.45.20|| pṛthvī ca nirmitā yena jalaṃ yena kṛtaṃ tathā | agniryena kṛtaścāste vāyuryena vinirmitaḥ ||21 || tebhyo dehāḥ kṛtā yena yenātmā varṣmaṇi dhṛtaḥ | yena vṛkṣaphalānyatrotpāditāni ca bhuktaye ||22|| annāni śarkarā dugdhaṃ rasā yena vinirmitāḥ | yena nārī kṛtā ramyā yena vai nirmito naraḥ || 23 || indriyāṇi prabhogārthaṃ kṛtāni yena dehinām | yena buddhiḥ pradattā ca vicāro yena nirmitaḥ || 24|| yena nidrā virāmaśca kṛtā yena divā niśā | yena kṣudhā tṛṣā tṛptiḥ kṛtā yena sarasvatī ||25 || snehaḥ putraḥ sutā lakṣmīḥ smṛddhiryena divaṃ kṛtam | svargaṃ bhūstārakāḥ sūryaścandro yena vinirmitāḥ ||26 || samudrāḥ ṛtavo meghāḥ suvarṇaṃ yena nirmitāḥ | taṃ bhajeccet prasannaḥ sa jāyeta parameśvaraḥ || 27|| dadāti bhajate nityaṃ rājyaṃ dhanaṃ priyaṃ sukham | mumukṣavo bhajantyenaṃ śrīpatiṃ bahudhā muhuḥ || 28|| bubhukṣavo’pi naijārthaṃ bhajantyenaṃ priyaṃ prabhum | nārāyaṇe bhavet snehaḥ puṣpaistu bahujanmanām || 29 || snehavanto bhaveyuśca devāścānye tu rākṣasāḥ | madyamāṃsapriyā hiṃsāparāḥ paravighātakāḥ || 2.45.30 || sukhino na bhavantyete nātihīnāḥ parārtidāḥ | ātmā na rākṣasaḥ kaścinna vā devo bhavatyapi || 31 || karmaṇā rākṣaso devaḥ kathyate viśado’pi saḥ| nārīdehaḥ sadā mlāno duḥkhadaḥ paravaśyagaḥ ||3 2|| nārāyaṇāśrayātpāpaṃ duḥkhaṃ tarati bhāminī | udarasya tu poṣārthaṃ pāpaṃ kvacinna cācaret ||33 || na vai mokṣasya janmedaṃ punaḥ punaravāpyate | kathaṃ tatra samunneyā pāpadā pāśavī kriyā ||34|| pāpī cātmā yadārabhya parameśaṃ samāśrayet | tata ārabhya evāsau puṇyavān saṃprajāyate || 35|| kathāyāḥ śravaṇenāsya saṃkalpaśca śubho bhavet | tato matiśca satsaṃge jijñāsā mokṣadāyinī ||36|| tataścāsya daivaguṇāḥ sāttvikāḥ saṃbhavanti vai | dharmakāryaṃ puṇyakāryaṃ parakāryaṃ śubhapradam ||37|| svabhāvājjāyate tena yaśaḥ kīrtiḥ pravardhate | śāntiśca vardhate nityaṃ bhāgyarekhā prakāśate ||38|| paropakāro dānaṃ ca satyaṃ cāhiṃsanaṃ vratam | śīlaṃ santoṣaṇaṃ śaucaṃ tapo vṛddhasya sevanam ||39|| antaryāmiśravaṇaṃ cāsteyaṃ cānindanaṃ tathā | guṇāstvasya bhaveyurvai bhāgyarekhāpraṇoditāḥ ||2.45.40|| taistu lakṣmīrdhanaṃ dhānyaṃ gṛhaṃ kṣetraṃ suvāhanam | kuṭumbaṃ sutapautrādi sarvaṃ svargaṃ pravartate ||41 || śāśvataṃ susukhaṃ loke pare loke prajāyate | tasmādvai mānavaṃ dehaṃ labdhvā mā rākṣaso bhavet ||42|| karmaṇā rākṣasaḥ paścād dehe’pi rākṣaso bhavet | deharākṣasakarmāsau kadāpi naiva mucyate ||43 || rākṣaso’pi tyajeddhiṃsākarma cānyāyabṛṃhitam | tena śuddhiḥ śanaistasya jāyate sattvagāminī ||44|| dehaḥ śuddhyati tīrthena satsamāgamatastathā | antaḥ śuddhyati tapasā ātmā guṇaiḥ suśuddhyati ||45|| daihyaṃ rākṣasabhāvaṃ sa vihāya mānase’pi ca | viśārado bhavecchīghraṃ tataścātmāpi śuddhyati ||46|| nityaśuddho’pyasatsaṃgapāśaṃ tyajati śuddhyati | tena daivo bhavetpaścānmokṣamārge prayāti vai ||47|| tasmātpāpāni sandahya gurvāśrayaṃ samācaret | gurvāśrayeṇa ca hareḥ prāptirbhavati naityikī ||48|| tasmānnaro’thavā nārī pāpaṃ tyaktvā prabhuṃ śrayet | daśajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ naradehaṃ dadāti vai ||49|| śatajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ nārīdehaṃ dadāti vai | punaḥ pāpaṃ punarjanma nārī vai nārakī vyathā ||2.45.50|| malamūtrabharā śaśvanmalamūtrakriyāguṇā | malamūtrāpatyavatī malamūlarajasvalā ||51 || malamūtrāśrayagarbhā malamūtrādivāṭikā | malamūtraphalotpādā malamūtrāvahā sadā |||52|| kathaṃ pāpād vimucyeta yadīśaṃ bhajate na sā | tasmānnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo bhajanīyaḥ sadaiva ha ||53|| yadā jñānaṃ gurorlabdhaṃ tadaiva gurumāśrayet | gataṃ dinaṃ kṛtaṃ karma na cāyāsyati vai punaḥ ||54|| gataṃ kṛtaṃ sarāgaṃ yajjñāne sati tataḥ param | virāgāya bhavatyeva śocyaṃ tyaktvā śubhaṃ śrayet ||55|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | japenmantraṃ sadā yaḥ sa pāpāya naiva kalpate ||56|| gṛhṇāti tulasīmālāṃ sarvapāpāt pramucyate | sevate sādhuvaryān sa muktaye jāyate sadā ||57|| bhajate śrīhariṃ yaḥ sa śāśvatānandamṛcchati | śvaḥ kartavyaṃ caredadya cādyatanaṃ kṣaṇe’tra ca ||58|| kālo naiva vipaśyettu kāryaṃ yadasya śiṣyate | sā hāniryo gataḥ kālaścātmaśreyo vinā kṣaṇaḥ ||59|| sa lābho yaḥ kṛtaḥ kālaḥ svātmaśreyo’rthakaḥ kṣaṇaḥ | śāstraṃ dadāti panthānaṃ yāntu śreyo’rthakā janāḥ ||2.45.60|| nityaṃ prāptastathā madhye sāyaṃ niśi kṣaṇe kṣaṇe | mriyante cātha jāyante kīravanmānavādayaḥ ||6 1 || jīvantaste prapaśyanti garbhe nāśaṃ mṛtodbhavam | jīvodbhavasya māse vā nāśaṃ varṣe vināśanam ||62|| bālye kaumārake nāśaṃ kaiśore yauvane layam | vārdhakye nirjane nāśaṃ naṣṭe kiñcinna śiṣyate ||63 || naṣṭe śreyaḥ kathaṃ syācca jīvanneva prasādhayet | janmahāniṃ ca maraṇaṃ mṛtyuśūnyaṃ ca jīvanam ||64|| arjayantu mahābhāgāḥ kālaṃ mṛtyuṃ tyajantu ca | kālakālādhikālaṃ ca parameśaṃ śrayantviha ||65|| svārthamātraparā lokāḥ paralokanirodhakāḥ | mṛṣā snehaṃ pradarśyaiva śreyovighātakāḥ sadā ||66|| mātā mokṣe janmadātrī pitā śreyaḥprapālakaḥ | patnī patitaṃ rakṣecca patiḥ pātīndrajālataḥ ||67|| bhrātā bhāsāṃ harerdadyānputraḥ pūtastu tārayet | svasā supuṇyaṃ dadyācca śvaśuraḥ śāntimarpayet ||68||| yadyete na guṇāsteṣu te mṛṣāsnehadarśakāḥ | sambandhaḥ sarvathā loke pratāraṇaphalodayaḥ ||69|| jñātvā caivaṃ mṛṣā sarvaṃ cāniṣṭaphaladaṃ tathā | vicāryaiva hariṃ śritvā bhajeta kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||2.45.7 0 || dehena manasā vācā karmaṇā snehatastathā | saṃsevya śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ gatiṃ labhet ||7 1 || ityādikāṃ kathāṃ rādhe śrutvā mumukṣutāvatī | mām̐-ajārākṣasī bheje kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tataḥ ||72 || somanāthaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ kṛtvā bhaktābhavattadā | tasyai sonāyanarṣirvai dadau mantraṃ ca tūlasīm ||73 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | iti jagrāha mantraṃ sā tato yātā nijālayam ||74|| talājāyāśca sā dāsyaṃ sakhyaṃ karoti nityadā | vane ca parvate nityaṃ vanyaphalārthayāyinī ||75 || bhramate nirbhayā nāmajapaṃ karoti sarvadā | atha tāṃ nirjane dṛṣṭvā surūpā yauvanānvitām ||76 || sāmudro rākṣaso ninye nāmnā jhāṃjhīvaro nṛpaḥ | nairṛtyāṃ vai dvisāhasrakrośebhyo’ti murālaye ||77 || muraśeṣo jhāṃjhīvaro bhrātarau dvau babhūvatuḥ | dvīpatraye murasyaiva rājyaṃ hyabhūttadālpakam ||78 || tato sākṣīvaro naije rājye tasmāttu paścime | pṛthvyāṃ cābdhitaṭe mo’jā ninye mahotsavāt nṛpaḥ ||79 || tasyāṃ jātaḥ suto daityaścotatpannamātrayauvanaḥ | kāmago vyomagaścāpi māyāchālādivedanaḥ ||2.45.8 0 || sarvanāśakaraḥ sarvadveṣī lokārttivardhanaḥ | sadodvegakaro mātuḥ pituvīkye tvanādaraḥ ||8 1 || parakanyāharo naijaṃ rākṣasaṃ dhārpamāśritaḥ | paradravyaharo yuddhe rucimān nityayodhanaḥ ||82 || ekadā sa samudrasyarajalamānavaputrikām | prasahya cānināyātha patnīṃ tāṃ vidadhe nijām ||83 || jalasthāyāḥ sthale vāso rogārtha hi vyajāyata | rogagrastāṃ durbalāṃ ca jvaravyāptāṃ kṣayānvitām ||84|| iti tenāramamāṇāṃ paśumāramamārayat | ākrośanaṃ tu sā cakre kranditaṃ jananī tadā ||85 || mījā śrutvā samāyātā dayayā bhatamānasā | śikṣayāmāsa putraṃ svaṃ mā putra hiṃsanaṃ kuru ||86|| abalāyā balaṃ nāsti rugṇāyāstu viśeṣata | nirbalā tāḍyate tatte śreyo naiva bhaviṣyati ||87|| patnyāṃ pratāraṇaṃ patyustathā krodhena tāḍanam | prasahya bhogakaraṇaṃ patyāyuṣyavināśakam ||88|| sagarbhāyāṃ ca rugṇāyāṃ śramitāyāṃ tathā suta | skanditāyāmaraktāyāṃ na gāntavyaṃ kadācana ||8 9|| akālagamane hānirlābho naiva ca naiva ca | patnī svāṃgaṃ nijātmā ca kathaṃ tāṃ pīḍayet sudhīḥ || 2.45.90 || ahiṃsāṃ kuru śaucaṃ ca dayāṃ rakṣa sukhāya vai | satye vartaya cāsteye vrate tiṣṭha sukhāya vai || 91 || guṇe śīle ca santoṣe niyame saṃyame vraja | parameśe bhava bhaktaḥ śraddhāvān viṣayām̐styaja || 92|| ātmā pāpairyadā channastadā rākṣasatāṃ gataḥ | parātmaduḥkhakāritvaṃ rākṣasatvaṃ sphuṭaṃ suta || 93 || madyamāṃsādanaṃ nītivarjyaṃ rakṣaṣṭvameva tat | nītiḥ pavitrabhojyaṃ ca parasantoṣavartanam || 94|| vrataṃ śāntiprayogaśca daivatāpādakaṃ hi tat | tasmād daivo bhava putra mā guṇānāsurān vraja || 95|| mṛte dehe punarnaiva śubhalābho bhaviṣyati | tasmācchreyaḥ pare loke yathā syāttatprasādhaya || 96 || bhajānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ svātmani saṃsthitam | mayā kathā śrutā pūrvaṃ tenāhaṃ sukhinī sadā || 97|| rājyasampatsamṛddhyādyaiḥ paripūrṇāsmi putraka | tvaṃ nītyā kṛtakarmā san puṇyaṃ vardhaya śāśvatam || 98|| mātraivaṃ tu samādiṣṭo rākṣaso duṣṭamānasaḥ | krodhena yaṣṭimādāya mātaraṃ cāpyatāḍayat || 99|| evaṃ nityaṃ tu putreṇa tāḍyate jananī tathā | patnī ca śātravī ceti matvā santāḍyate muhuḥ || 2.45.100 || nahi vai śarkarāvāri nimbe karoti miṣṭatām | kupātre sūpadeśo’pi kāluṣyamupagacchati || 101 || jananī jalakanyāyāḥ pakṣaṃ karoti nityaśaḥ | rākṣaso jananī tena tāḍayatyeva nityaśaḥ || 10 2|| athāyaṃ janakenāpi bodhito’pi na cādade | sūpadeśaṃ ca janakaṃ tāḍayituṃ samudyataḥ | | 103 || ekadā mātaraṃ patnīṃ rajjubhyāṃ sudṛḍhaṃ sa ca | babandha cāpi cikṣepa samudre puṇyavarjitaḥ || 1 04|| mātrā smṛtastadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃprabhuḥ | śīghraṃ tatra samāgatya rarakṣa karayośca te || 109 || uddhṛtya mātaraṃ cāpi snuṣāṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | bhaktāṃ svagaruḍe nītvā tadgṛhaṃ pratyapādayat || 1 06|| tāvad deśāntaraṃ yāto jhaṃjhīvaraḥ samāyayau | dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca vṛttāntaṃ krodhaṃ tvavāpa duḥsaham || 1 07|| muraśeṣaṃ bhrātara sa samāhūya tato’nayam | putrasyāvedayāmāsa bhrātā bodhayituṃ yayau || 1 08|| bhrātaryevamanayena vartanaṃ sa samācarat | tataḥ kruddho muraśeṣo jhaṃjhīvarastathānugāḥ || 1 09|| matvā duṣṭaṃ ghātanīyaṃ ghātayituṃ samudyatāḥ | mātrāgaskaraduṣṭo’yaṃ pitrādidveṣakārakaḥ || 2.45.11 0|| mṛtyubhayena dudrāva sāmudre tu jalāntare | tatra vai dharṣayāmāsuḥ jāmātāraṃ tu taṃ ripum || 111 || krūraṃ duṣṭaṃ cānayasthaṃ sarve’pi jalamānavāḥ | dvīpe nikṣipya taṃ sarve paśumāreṇa roṣataḥ || 1 12|| pitrādyairmilitā daityaṃ tāḍayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ | tatyajurdayayā taṃ ca tatra dvīpe ca te janāḥ || 1 13|| tatra vivāsitaścāyaṃ vāsaṃ namraścakāra ha | mātrāgaskaranāmāsau yatra dvīpe uvāsa ca || 1 14|| so’pi balī ca mahatā valena cānayena ca | asthāpayannijaṃ rājyaṃ tato dvīpaḥ samudrake || 1 15|| mātrāgaskaranāmnaiva khyātiṃ jagāma laukikīm | jhaṃjhīvarasya rājyaṃ ca jhaṃjhīvārābhidhaṃ hyabhūt || 116 || mām̐jā ca rakṣitā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena sasnuṣā | bhaktā sā kīrtimāpannā nārāyaṇapratāpataḥ || 1 17|| mām̐jāmbiketināmnā sā prasiddhimagamattataḥ | tannāmnā rājyabhūmiśca māṃjāmbiketi cābhavat || 1 18|| tannāmnā tvālayastatra devī tatra ca rājate | daityā mlecchā rākṣasāśca dānavāstāmupāsate || 1 19|| ityetatkathitaṃ rādhe mātrāgaskaraceṣṭitam | mātrāgaskaradaityo’yaṃ raṇaṃgamavimānakam || 2.45.120 || lakṣmaṇāryakuṭumbena saṃyuktaṃ vyomnyarodhayat | aṭṭahāsaṃ muhuḥ kṛtvā yoddhuṃ samupacakrame || 121 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne madhye rodhayato mātrāgaskararākṣasasya svastrīmātṛprabhṛtitāḍanātmakaduṣṭavṛttāntaḥ, māṃjāmbikāyāḥ sasnuṣāyāḥ samudre kṣiptāyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṛtarakṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 45 ||
<2.46> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścād yadvṛttaṃ tadvadāmyaham | vimānaṃ staṃbhayāmāsa khe mātrāgaskarastadā || 1 || lakṣmaṇāryasya ca raṇaṃgamasya sannidhau sthitaḥ | gadayā tau vijetuṃ ca kartuṃ vimānamātmasāt || 2 || aicchanmadāvaliptaḥ sa garjanā bahudhā vyadhāt| | galitāstena meghāśca vārdherjalāni cukṣubhuḥ || 3 || sahasrayojanānte ye sthitāte’pyāvahan bhayam | cakampe pṛthivī vāyurvimānaṃ kampamāvahat || 4 || kanyakāśca kumārāśca trāsamāpuḥ kṣaṇaṃ tadā | athāyaṃ bhagavadbhakto raṇaṃgamo mahābalaḥ || 5 || sāntvayāmāsa sarvāṃśca sasmāra bālakṛṣṇakam | drāgeva tu haristatra vimāne prādurāsa ha || 6 || yuddhaṃ kuru vijayaste cetyuktvā sa tiro’bhavat | vaimānikānāṃ sarveṣāṃ tadā dhairyamabhūnmahat || 7 || athāsuraḥ punaḥ prāha vaimānika vihaṃgama | dehi yuddhaṃ ca vā datvā vimānaṃ svagṛhaṃ vraja || 8 || raṇaṃgamastu taṃ prāha yuddhaṃ dadāmi vīra te | bāhuyuddhaṃ gadāyuddhaṃ śarayuddhaṃ dadāmi te || 9 || śastrayuddhaṃ mantrayuddhaṃ prāṇayuddhaṃ dadāmi te | omityuktvā rākṣasaḥ sa gadayā taṃ raṇaṃgamam || 2.46.10 || nijaghāna vimānasthaṃ muktayā vegatastadā | raṇaṃgamaḥ samutplutya padbhyāṃ gadāṃ pratāḍya ca || 1 1|| adhaḥpatantīṃ daṇḍe tāṃ bāhubhyāṃ jagṛhe tadā | tāṃ gadāṃ śatabhārāṃ saṃgṛhya raṇaṃgamo nṛpaḥ || 12|| bhūtvā vyomni mahāśailanibho jaghāna taṃ hṛdi | utplutya rākṣasastāmāpatantīṃ vyomamārgataḥ || 13 || jagrāha pāṇinā yāvat tāvad raṇaṃgamena vai | prahitā śatabhārā ca gadānyā tvanalānvitā || 14|| lagnā skandhāgrabhāge sā kaṇṭhajatruṃ babhañja ha | atha kruddho mahāśailo bhūtvā sahasrabhārikām || 15|| gadāṃ dhṛtvā mahāvegānmumoca raṇagopari | raṇago’pi mahāśailo bhūtvā sahasrabhārikām || 16|| kalpavallīsamutthāṃ ca gadāṃ dhṛtvā kṣaṇāntare | tayāpatantīṃ śatadhā cūrṇayāmāsa vai balī || 17|| atha mātrāgaskaraśca vīkṣyāścaryamavāpa ha | kruddho dudrāva raṇagaṃ bāhubhyāṃ dhṛtavām̐śca tam || 18|| raṇagaśca mahadrūpaṃ dadhāra taccaturguṇam | bāhubhyāṃ rākṣasakaṇṭhaṃ dadhāra pāśavattadā || 1 9|| rākṣaso’pi tadā sūkṣmaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtvāpyapāsarat | raṇaṃgamastadā vyomni sthito’bhūnnirbhayaḥ kṣaṇam || 2.46.20|| tāvad daityo vyomamārgānmahāśaktiṃ pragṛhya ca | raṇaṃgamasya śirasi prāhiṇodanalānvitām ||21 || raṇaṃgamastu tvarito lohākarṣaṇakāriṇīm | śaktiṃ naijāṃ mumocaināṃ samākṛṣyāsurodare ||22|| lagnābhavattu sā bhittvāntreṣu sthirābhavattataḥ | asuro balavān bhinnamudaraṃ śṛṃkhalādinā ||23|| baddhvā śaktiṃ viniṣkāsya kṣaṇaṃ mūrchāmavāpa ha | vyomnyeva saṃsthito vidyunmantreṇa dīrghasāyakam ||24|| abhimantrya prāhiṇocca nāśayituṃ raṇaṃgamam | raṇagaḥ preṣayāmāsa vajraṃ kalpalatodbhavam ||25|| śaraṃ vināśya daityasya hṛdi lagnaṃ viveśa ha | daityo mūrchāṃ gato vyomno vārdherjale papāta ha ||26|| kaṭidaghnaḥ samudro’syābhavanmūrchānvitasya vai | atha śaityaṃ samāsādya vimūrchaścābhavattadā ||27|| namrāsyo lajjayā bhūtvā dhikkāraṃ svātmane dadau | tato vai racayāmāsa māyāṃ ghorāṃ tu rākṣasīm ||28|| sahasradhābhavad daityaḥ sainyaṃ raṇaṃgamaṃ tataḥ | abhitastāḍayāmāsa bāṇairdaṇḍaiśca mudgaraiḥ || 29|| gadābhirmūśalaiḥ prāsaistomaraiḥ prastarādibhiḥ | śaktibhiścāsibhiścāpi hetibhirbahurūpibhiḥ || 2.46.30 || raṇaṃgamastadā kalpalatābalāt kṣaṇāntare | adṛśyatāṃ gato madhyād vimānāgre sthito’bhavat ||3 1 || daityo ruṣānvito bhūtvā tyaktvā raṇaṃgamaṃ tadā | dharṣayituṃ vimānaṃ lambayāmāsa karau yadā ||32|| tāvatkalpalatotthavahninā dagdhau hi tatkarau | dagdhahasto’suro yānaṃ grahītuṃ na śaśāka ca ||3 3|| hetīṃścāpi grahītuṃ na śaśākāpi tu garvavān | jvālāmukho’bhavacchailo vahnidāvasamākulaḥ ||34|| raṇaṃgamaṃ pradagdhuṃ sa mano’karottathāpi vai | kalpalatāmṛtavarṣī raṇaṃgamo vimānakam ||35|| rarakṣa ca nijātmānaṃ vimānasthān sudhājalaiḥ | prajvalatyasurastatra vimānaṃ naiva dahyati ||36|| lakṣmaṇaḥ svīyarakṣārthaṃ svastipāṭhān jajāpa ha | yat tatsvastyayanaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvamāṃgalyamaṃgalam ||37|| oṃ svasti kurutāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ | kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo brahmā svasti naḥ kurutācyutaḥ ||38|| svasti naḥ śaṃkaraścāpi śivāyuktaḥ karotvapi | īśvarā lokapālāśca grahā maharṣayastathā ||39|| viśve’śvinau sādhyamarudgaṇāgnayo divākarāḥ | yakṣāśca vasavaḥ svasti kurvantu kinnarādayaḥ ||2.46.40|| nāgāḥ suparṇāḥ saritaḥ sarāṃsi cābdhayastathā | cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ mantrā āyudhāni harestathā ||41|| bhaktāśca pitaro muktā rādhāramādiśaktayaḥ | bhūtāni svasti kurvantu tejasvino’nalādayaḥ ||42|| svasti dvipādikebhyaśca catuṣpādebhya ityapi | svasti no bahupādebhyastvapādebhyastvanāmayam ||43|| vimānasya svasti cāstu svasti raṇaṃgamasya ca | vaimānikānāṃ kalyāṇaṃ svasti cāstvapi maṃgalam ||44|| jvālāmukhebhyaḥ svastyastu māyājvālebhya ityapi | āsurebhyastathā svasti cāntarātmā karotu naḥ ||45|| ityevaṃ lakṣmaṇastatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim | sasmāra svastimāṃgalyapradaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||46|| pratyakṣo’bhūdbālakṛṣṇo vihasyānalaparvate | śāntiḥ śaityaṃ vimānasyānāmayaṃ vo’stviti bruvan ||47|| asurasya tu bhasmārthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | ājñāpayanmahātejaḥpuruṣaṃ pārṣadaṃ nijam ||48|| mahātejaḥpuruṣo’sau jvālāmukhaṃ hi dānavam | prājvālayat prasahyaiva pataṃgaṃ tvanalo yathā ||49|| vimānaṃ bhaktasahitaṃ rarakṣa bhagavān svayam | bhasmīcakāra ca daityaṃ jvālāmayaṃ mahānale ||2.46.50|| daśayojanavistīrṇo bhasmadeśo’bhavattadā | daityasya tatra vai dvīpe mātrāgaskaranāminaḥ ||51|| evaṃ vināśya daityaṃ ca vimānena surāṣṭrakam | āyayuḥ śrīharilakṣmaṇāryaraṇaṃgamādayaḥ ||52|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram | vilokya lomaśaṃ cāpi nagaraṃ svargasadṛśam ||53|| avateruḥ pṛthivyāṃ te nārāyaṇayutāḥ sukhāt | lomaśaṃ prathamaṃ natvā yayurgopālamandiram ||54|| satkṛtāstatra ca pitrā bālakṛṣṇena vai mudā | mātrā kambharayā cāpi mudamāpuḥ supūjitāḥ ||55|| dattāsanāḥ kṛtāvāsā kṛtabhojanaviśramāḥ | kṛtābhāṣāptavṛttāntāstato vai lakṣmaṇādayaḥ ||56|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | pūjayituṃ copadābhirāyayuḥ kambharāgṛham ||57|| siṃhāsane harirbālo vyarājata tadicchayā | prathamaṃ cāmṛtavārbhiścaraṇau sukhadāyinau ||58|| pupūjuḥ śrīhariṃ sarvāḥ kanyakā divyavigrahāḥ | lakṣmaṇasyājñayā tāśca jagṛhuścaraṇāmṛtam ||59|| puṣpahārān ratnahārān mauktikīrmālikāstathā | mukuṭaṃ kuṇḍale kalgiṃ candanākṣatahīrakān ||2.46.6 0|| kaṭakān raśanā bhūṣāścāmbarāṇi samārpayan | phalāni cāmṛtapānānyapi pātrāṇi kaisarān ||6 1 || padārthān vividhām̐ścāsmai bālakṛṣṇāya tā daduḥ | ārārtrikaṃ tathā cakruścakruḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ namaḥ ||6 2 || caraṇau vakṣasi kṛtvāvāpuḥ parāṃ sunirvṛttim | evaṃ kanyāḥ prasaṃpūjya śrīkāntaṃ hṛtsu sandadhuḥ ||6 3 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kāntastāsāṃ hṛtsu viveśa ha | svasmin jahāra sarvāsāṃ hṛdayāni ca mādhavaḥ ||64|| jñātvā śrīlakṣmaṇo bhāvaṃ kṛṣṇe kānte tu kānyakam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pradadau ca tāḥ ||65 || yautakaṃ bahuratnādi dadau kṛtārthatāmagāt | tataḥ kumārāḥ sarve ca kṛṣṇapūjāṃ samācaran ||66|| lakṣmaṇāryastataḥ pūjāṃ cakāra pārameśvarīm | raṇaṃgamo mālinī ca cakraturharipūjanam ||67|| tataḥ śrīkambharālakṣmyāḥ pūjanaṃ te pracakrire | śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasyārcanaṃ divyaṃ pracakrire ||68|| yayuḥ śrīlomaśaṃ vipraṃ tatpūjāṃ ca pracakrire | bālakṛṣṇo dadau kanyā rakṣituṃ lomaśāya ha ||6 9|| lomaśaḥ svāśrame’rakṣad vaiṣṇavīḥ kṛṣṇayoṣitaḥ | evaṃ kṛtārthatāṃ sarve prapedire hareḥ puraḥ ||2.46.70 || pānabhojanasatkārairānandaṃ lebhire’tigam | atha tīrthavidhiṃ cakrurmāghapūrṇāprage ca te ||7 1 || dadau dānāni divyāni svarṇaratnāmbarāṇi ca | parihāraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā lakṣmaṇo nijarāṣṭrakam ||72|| gantumiyeṣa ca tadā raṇaṃgamo’vadattu tam | lomaśo’yaṃ mahāyogī kumārebhyo dadātyapi ||73 || mantraṃ mokṣakaraṃ rājan pradāpaya tadagrataḥ | lakṣmaṇāryastato mantraṃ dāpayāmāsa putrakān ||74|| lomaśaḥ śrīhariṃ smṛtvā pañcaśatakumārakān | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||75|| mantrapūtān prasampādya cakre tulasīsragyutān | divyaṃ jñānaṃ dadau tebhyo vāsanākṣayakārakam ||76 || putrāḥ śṛṇuta loko’yaṃ karmabandhanajo mataḥ | satāṃ sevā śubhaṃ karma śrīharerbhajanaṃ śubham ||77|| ātmaśreyaḥ śubhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tṛṣṇānāśaḥ paraṃ sukham | dehendriyādiprābalyaṃ vāsanodbhāvakaṃ matam ||78|| jñāne baliṣṭhe gauṇaṃ tajjāyate nigrahātmakam | nigraho vāsanādāhakaro bhavati yoginām ||79|| dehendriyabalaṃ tasyākiñcitkaraṃ prajāyate | deho nārī tadantaḥstho jīvo naro bhavatyapi ||2.46.80 || bhuṃkte dehaṃ naro jīvo bhogo’sya sukhaduḥkhadṛk | tasmājjīvena vai bhāvyaṃ brahmarūpeṇa sarvathā ||8 1 || parabrahmāśrayaścāsya brahmatāpādako mataḥ | parabrahma svayaṃ cāste kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’tra ha ||82|| tadyogo bhavatāṃ jātaḥ kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate | koṭijanmārjitapuṇyairayaṃ kṛṣṇo hyavāpyate |||83 || satāṃ samāgamenātra tatprāptirjāyate drutam | sādhurūpo hyayaṃ rājā raṇaṃgamo bhavatsuhṛt ||84|| ānīyātra ca vaḥ śreyaḥ paramaṃ pratyapādayat | tato bhaktiṃ cāsya nārāyaṇasya kurutānaghāḥ ||85|| sarvārpaṇātmakaṃ tatra naiṣkarmyaṃ kurutānaghāḥ | pratyakṣaṃ tu vinā naiva siddhyantyatra pumarthakāḥ ||86 || paraḥ pumartho yuṣmākaṃ siddhaḥ prapyakṣayogataḥ | yeṣāṃ kṛṣṇe parā bhaktiryathā kṛṣṇe tathā gurau ||87|| teṣāṃ sarve pumarthāśca siddhyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ | te brahmajñāḥ paraṃ preyurbhuktvā bhogān supuṣkalān ||88|| sarvārpaṇaṃ ca viśvāso māhātmyaṃ bhāvanā smṛtiḥ | ātmīyasnigdhatā ceti ṣaṭ parabrahmadāyakāḥ ||89|| śāntirāstikyamatṛṣṇānudvego nirbhayā sthitiḥ | apāravaśyaṃ ca ṣaṭ te mahānandapradāyakāḥ ||2.46.90 || vṛddhābhivandanaṃ sevotsāhaḥ kartavyadharmatā | nyāyābhisaraṇaṃ mamatārāhityaṃ ca mārdavam ||9 1 || ṣaḍete sarvathā loke janānāṃ puṇyavardhakāḥ | sahanaṃ sarvathā rujāṃ dehābhimānavarjanam ||92|| kīrtyādyananusandhānaṃ cāparigrahavartanam | alālasā kutracicca rāgakriyāvivarjanam ||93 || ṣaḍete sarvathā loke jīvanmuktivivardhanāḥ | devānāṃ darśanaṃ nityaṃ tathā vivekadarśanam ||94|| lakṣyabindordarśana ca phalgupradarśanaṃ tathā | avighnadarśanaṃ cāpi darśanasya ca darśanam ||95|| ete ṣaṭ muktidāḥ santi vijayasya pradāstathā | akāmāśca tathāsvārthāḥ ātmasvārthāḥ parārthakāḥ ||96|| avinaṣṭasadācārā vijñāḥ ṣaṭ te hyanandhakāḥ | guṇamātragrahā ye ca guṇamātrapradāśca ye || 97|| guṇadṛṣṭiprayoktāro guṇeṣvanyān prayuñjate | tattvajñānapramodāśca udāsate guṇetarāt || 98 || ta ete ṣaṭ nirmalāśca videhāḥ santi varṣmasu | garbhaṃ bālyaṃ yauvanaṃ ca cetyādinirūpaganāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 46 | |
<2.47> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike kanyā lakṣmaṇasya hareḥ priyāḥ | sahasre dve lomaśaśca bodhayāmāsa tattvataḥ || 1 || kṣaṇaṃ vittaṃ kṣaṇaṃ cittaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ varṣmajīvanam | kṣaṇikāścāpi saṃkalpāścākṣaṇiko hariḥ prabhuḥ || 2 || ātmā tasya gṛhaṃ proktaṃ cātmanyeva sthito hariḥ | gṛheśaḥ śrīkṛṣṇānārāyaṇaḥ pātā patirhi saḥ || 3 || jalaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ kalalaṃ ca karkandhuḥ peṣikā tataḥ | puttalaṃ ca tataḥ pūrṇāvayavaṃ tena nirmitam || 4 || bālyaṃ ca yauvanaṃ cāpi tainaiva nirmitaṃ sutāḥ | vārdhakyaṃ ca viyogaśca pañcatvaṃ tena nirmitam || 5 || nirmeyānāṃ tu mātāraṃ samāśrameddhi meyagaḥ | tadā cāmeyayogāddhi bhavatyātmāpyameyavat || 6 || ameyo dṛśyate cātra meyavad bālavat sutāḥ | bhavatīnāṃ hṛdaye yaḥ kṛtāvāso virājate || 7 || sa vai sevyaḥ sa vai pūjyaḥ sa vai dhyeyo nirantaram | prāptaḥ prāptavya evāsau prāptavyo nāvaśiṣyate || 8 || anityena śarīreṇa nityaṃ mokṣaṃ prasādhayet | anityābhiḥ kriyābhiśca kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ prasādayet || 9 || vrataṃ kṛṣṇo japaḥ kṛṣṇo dānaṃ kṛṣṇe prakārayet | tapaḥ sevā harereva saṃyamo niyamo harau || 2.47.10 || yajñaḥ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ sarvaṃ śāśvataṃ dhanameva saḥ | samādhiḥ kṛṣṇarasatā yogaḥ kṛṣṇena yojanam || 11 || bhajanaṃ tana cālāpaḥ kīrtanaṃ tadguṇānuvāk | darśanaṃ tasya sākṣādvai sparśanaṃ tatsuyojanam || 12 || tadicchayānusaraṇaṃ nigraho mokṣado mataḥ | tasya prasannatā puṇyaṃ śāśvataṃ netarat sutāḥ || 13 || śravaṇaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ mananaṃ cāpi vai hareḥ | svapanaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ prabodhanaṃ sadā harau || 14|| ramante yogino yasmin ramaṇaṃ rāma eva saḥ | śramitānāṃ virāmo’yaṃ virāmo’nyo nirarthakaḥ || 15 || rasikānāṃ rasaścātra rasayatyāniśaṃ hariḥ | tadvinā rasanaṃ cānyannirarthakaṃ suputrikāḥ || 16 || putrībhiḥ sarvathā bhāvya bālābhiḥ pañcavarṣake | śiṣyābhiḥ sarvathā bhāvyaṃ bālābhirdaśavarṣake || 17|| kumārībhistato bhāvyaṃ caturdaśasamāntare | patnībhiśca tato bhāvyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhau | | 18|| tatra śṛṇuta putrītvaṃ śiṣyātvaṃ ca yathārthakam | kumārītāṃ tathā yogyaṃ patnītvaṃ sārthakaṃ sutāḥ || 19|| punnāmno narakāt trātrī puttrī teneha gīyate | śeṣapāpaharā śiṣyā śirṣṇaḥ pāpaharā hi sā || 2.47.20 || pañcavarṣādūrdhvamasyāḥ pāpaṃ saṃkramate kṛtam| pitroḥ śirasornaivāsti yadabhūtpañcapūrvajam ||2 1 || kuṃsūtraṃ, māṃ ca gāyatrīṃ, rāti, yā sā kumārikā | sūtraṃ yajñopavītaṃ gāyatrīṃ vidyāṃ tu tattvajām ||22| sampādayati yā kanyā kumārikā prakīrtitā | vidyāsnātā ca saivoktā saivoktā brahmacāriṇī |23||| patiṃ nīyate garbhaṃ yā garbhātmānaṃ tu patnikā | patidharmeṇa yā nītā sā patnī pannamaḥpriyā ||24|| śṛṇuta punnāmakāni narakāṇi ca yāni vai | anapatyasthitāvudvejanaṃ yad dampatīgatam ||25|| tadduḥkhaṃ narakaṃ cādyaṃ sāpatyatve vilīyata | pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍadānādi jalatarpaṇamityapi ||26||| anapatyakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kavoṣṇamupajāyate | tad duḥkhaṃ narakaṃ pitṛbhogya dvitīyamucyate ||27|| sāpatyatve tu pitṝṇāṃ tadduḥkhaṃ vai vilīyata | anapatyagṛhe naiva saṃskārāścotsavāstathā ||28|| ṣoḍaśādyā na jāyante tṛpyanti devatā na ca | ṣaṣṭhyādyā naiva pūjyante dānāni na bhavanti ca ||29|| tadidaṃ devatāduḥkha puṇyapratinirodhanam | tṛtīyaṃ narakaṃ proktaṃ sāpatyatve nivartata ||2.47.3 0|| anapatyasya samṛddhirvaṃśadāyādavarjitāḥ | lakṣmīrviśvāsavihatā nirutsāhā na modate ||3 1|| tadidaṃ kamalāduḥkha saubhāgyapratirodhakam | caturtha narakaṃ proktaṃ sāpatyatve nivartate ||32|| anapatyagṛhe naiva jāmātā na tathā snuṣā | maṇḍapo na ca māṇikyastaṃbho nāgnipradakṣiṇam ||3 3|| gārhapatyo na vai tuṣyed vahnistadaṃgadevatā | tadidaṃ yajñaduḥkhaṃ vai vaṃśavistārarodhakam || 34| | pañcamaṃ narakaṃ proktaṃ sāpatyatve nivartate | anapatyagṛhe nāsti kāmadharmaphalaṃ manāk || 3 5| | ṛtudharmaphalaṃ nāsti ṛtudānaphalaṃ na ca | aphalaṃ bījahananaṃ pāpasampādakaṃ bhavet || 3 6| | pāpaṃ duḥkhapradaṃ syācca puruṣārthanirodhakam | ṣaṣṭhaṃ tannarakaṃ proktaṃ sāpatyatve nivartate ||37| | anapatyagṛhe naiva tuṣyantyatithayo’pi ca | anapatyamukhaṃ naiva prātaḥ paśyanti mānavāḥ ||38|| anapatyanivāsaṃ ca pārśve necchanti putriṇaḥ | etadvai mānavaṃ duḥkhaṃ janatādararodhakam || 39|| saptamaṃ narakaṃ proktaṃ sāpatyatve nivartate | anapatyau priyākāntau pretāvivātigarhitau ||2.47.40 || jīvantāvapi tau pretau viśeṣo nātra vidyate | maraṇe parahastena yayorvai aurdhvadaihikam ||41 || yadbhavenna gatidaṃ ca pretagatinirodhakam | aṣṭama narakaṃ proktaṃ sāpatyatve nivartate ||42|| anapatyagṛhe doṣāśceme bhavanti bodhata | anyeṣāṃ saṃkramastatra pāpināmupasevanam |||43||| pāruṣyaṃ dānadharmādau nirarthakamapārjanam | asantoṣaḥ sadā cāste bhavabhūtivināśanam ||44|| bhraṃśanaṃ nijadharmāṇāṃ māraṇaṃ bhayamityapi | miṣṭaikāśanamevāpi mithyābhiśaṃsanādikam ||45|| parajāyāparapuṃsaṃsevana lubdhatā tathā | lolupatvaṃ putravatāṃ nindanaṃ śiṣṭalaṃghanam ||46|| śiṣṭācāravināśaśca satkriyādivilopanam | saṃskāraparihīnatvaṃ paranāśe prasannatā ||47|| hānirdharmārthakāmānāmapavargasya dūratā | sarvasya cātatāyitvaṃ narakāya nigadyate ||48|| etaiḥ punnāmakaiḥ pāpairnarakairāvṛtaḥ sadā | anapatyo jano ghorān narakān vai niṣevate ||49 || apatyaṃ narakaṃ ghoraṃ vināśayati sarvaśaḥ | etasmāt kāraṇāt putrīputravattvaṃ divaṃ matam ||2.47.50|| śiṣyaḥ śiṣyā ca pāpāni haratyeva ca tadyathā | śiṣṭānāṃ tu bhavecchiṣyo dāso bhṛtyaśca sevakaḥ ||5 1 || yadvā śiṣyā sakhī dāsī bhṛtyā vā sevikā tathā | śiṣṭānāṃ vā gurūṇāṃ sā sa ca sāhāyyakārakau ||52|| devasevā pitṛsevā ṛṣisevātitherapi | sevanaṃ chidyate kvāpi vinā śiṣyamupaplave ||53 || tadvighnaṃ pāpakṛtproktaṃ śiṣyastasmāddhi tārayet | agṛhasthasya ca śiṣyavarjitasya janasya tu ||54|| sarvakāryāṇi naiveha siddhyanti narakaṃ hi tat | vidyā kalāśca kauśalyaṃ mantro rītiśca śāśvatī |||95|| śikṣaṇaṃ ca kramaścāpi paddhatiśca paramparā | sājātyaṃ ceti tatsarvaṃ vinā śiṣyaṃ vilīyate ||56 || tannāśo narakaṃ proktaṃ saśiṣyatve nivartate | vijñāne yujyate śiṣyo dāyabhāge tu putrakaḥ |||57|| ardhakāryakarī patnī narakasya vināśakāḥ | vinā patnīṃ na kutrāpi sthitirmānyaṃ gṛhādiṣu ||58|| na viśvāso nāvakāro na śāntirnarakaṃ hi tat | na homādi na vai śuddhistatpāpaṃ narakaṃ sadā ||59|| neha loke ca kācidvai siddhiḥ paratra naiva ca | narakaṃ tatsarvadṛśyaṃ sapatnītve nivartate || 2.47.60 || ajñānaṃ narakaṃ proktaṃ sarvadānakṣarajñatā | savidyatve vinaśyattu kumārabrahmacāriṣu || 61 || saṃsāro’yaṃ kṛtastādṛg yatra sāhāyyamantarā | kāryaṃ siḥddhyati naiveha varṇeṣu cāśrameṣvapi ||6 2|| asāhāyyaṃ ca narakaṃ kāryahānikaraṃ yataḥ | sasāhāyyaṃ tu ca svargaṃ kāryasiddhikaraṃ yataḥ ||6 3|| putro hi bahukāryeṣu bahukāryeṣu śiṣyakaḥ | vahukāryeṣu patnī ca narakatrāḥ sahāyadāḥ ||64||| kāyikaṃ vācikaṃ vāpi mānasaṃ ca svabhāvajam | asahāyakṛtaṃ cāpi pāpaṃ bahuvidhaṃ ca yat ||65||| tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti sutaśiṣyapriyādibhiḥ | tasmācca putraśiṣyau hi vidhātavyau vipaścitā ||66 | | dāyādā bāndhavāḥ ṣaṭ ca ṣaṭ ca prajāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | śiṣyāstrayastathā patnyastisraśceti prakīrtitāḥ || 67| | patayaśca trayaḥ proktā yathākarmānubandhinaḥ | śṛṇuta putrikāścātra saṃkṣepāt tān vadāmi vaḥ ||68|| aurasaḥ kṣetrajaścāpi dattaḥ kṛtrima ityapi | gūḍhotpannastathānīto dāyādā bāndhavāstu ṣaṭa ||69|| amīṣu ṣaṭsu satsveva ṛṇapiṇḍadhanakriyāḥ | gotrakhyātiḥ kule vṛttiḥ pratiṣṭhā vaṃśavistaraḥ | 2.47.70 | | tatrauraso nijajātaḥ pratibimbaṃ nijātmanaḥ | patnyāmanyena sañjātaścājñayā kṣetrajastu saḥ ||7 1 || mātāpitṛbhyāṃ yo dattaḥ dattakaḥ sa hi gīyate | mitrādiputraṃ putraṃ yo manyetāyaṃ tu kṛtrimaḥ | |72| | na jñāyate gṛhe kena jātastviti tu gūḍhakaḥ | bāhyato yaḥ samānītaścānīto gadyate hi saḥ | |73 || kānīnaśca sahoḍhaśca krītaḥ paunarbhavastathā | svayaṃdatto nimnavarṇājaścaite nāmadhārakāḥ ||74| | kanyājātassu kānīnāḥ sagarbhoḍhaḥ sahoḍhajaḥ | mūlyairgṛhītaḥ krīto vai punarbhvāstu punarbhavaḥ | |75 || dattāpyekasya yā kanyā bhūyo’nyasya pradīyate | sā punarbhūrnārī ceti paunarbhavastu tatsutaḥ | |76 || durbhikṣādau svayaṃprāpto’raṇye tyakto’thavā svayam | arakṣako vane prāptaḥ svayaṃdatta udāhṛtaḥ || 77|| śreṣṭhavarṇanarānnimnanārījo nimnavarṇakaḥ | amīṣām ṛṇapiṇḍādikathā nāstyeva vaṃśajā ||78 || śiṣyāstrayo dīkṣitaśca sevako bhṛtya ityamī | dāyādastatra yo yasyājīvanaṃ cātmasātkṛtaḥ ||79 || patnyastridhā ca vidhyūḍhā punarvyūḍhā nigūḍhikā | vyavahāre cottamā madhyamādhamā kramāddhi tāḥ ||2.47.80 || patayastraya ūḍhaśca dvyaḍhūścopapatistathā | uttamo madhyamo’dhamo vyavahāre kramādamī ||8 1 || upadeśo yajñasūtraṃ dātavyaṃ tebhya eva ca | saṃskārāścāpi kartavyā anapatyatvahānaye |||82||| dāyādā bāndhavā yadvad bāndhavyo’pi tathāvidhāḥ | kānīnādyā yathā putrāḥ putryaścāpi tathāvidhāḥ ||83 || śiṣyā narāstrayo yadvat tisrastathaiva kanyakāḥ | vyavahāro’pi tatrāsti cottamo madhyamo’dhamaḥ ||84|| bhavatyo mama śiṣyāśca bhavantyatra hi mantrataḥ | śiṣyapatnyaḥ snuṣāścāpi jñānapātryo bhavanti ca ||85|| tasmājjñānaṃ pradātavyaṃ dāyabhāgātmakaṃ mama | guruto dāyabhāgo vai prāptavyaḥ śiṣyakoṭibhiḥ ||86 || jñānaṃ muktistathā bhaktiḥ sevā devārcanādikam | ātmayogo hareḥ prāptiḥ puṇyaṃ tīrthādisevanam ||87|| ityete dāyabhāgā vai śiṣyavargasya pāvanāḥ | athānyacca pravakṣyāmi ṣoḍaśāraṃ sudarśanam ||88|| yajjñātvā na paraṃ kiñcijjñātavyamavaśiṣyate | sudarśanaṃ parabrahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||89|| bhavatīnāṃ hṛdayastho bahiḥsthaḥ kānta uttamaḥ | kāntātmakaṃ paraṃ yogaṃ svadehe pravadāmi vaḥ || 2.47.90 || āgacchantu jalaṃ haste gṛhṇantu kanyakottamāḥ | mantraṃ gṛhṇantu sarvāśca kṛṣṇakāntasya manmukhāt ||9 1 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | iti tā rādhike mantraṃ jagṛhurlomaśānanāt ||92||| tadarthe ca tataḥ prāha yogaṃ ṣoḍaśapatrakam | oṃkāro vartate keśeṣvayaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 93 || nakāro brahmarandhre ca nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | makāro mukhamāpanno māṇikyāpatirīśvaraḥ || 94|| śrīkāraścakṣuṣorāste śrīpatiḥ kamalāpatiḥ | kṛkāraḥ kṛṣṇa evāsau kṛkāṭikākṛtasthitiḥ || 95|| ṣṇakāro hṛdaye cāste bālakṛṣṇo’yamīśvaraḥ | makāro vartate nābhau naranārāyaṇātmakaḥ ||96|| rākāro vartate romasthāneṣu rādhikāpatiḥ | yakāro vartate yonipīṭhe yogajalāśayī ||97|| ṇākāro vartate nāḍīmaṇḍale hi narottamaḥ | yakāro vartate iṅgitārthado mānase hariḥ ||98|| pakāraḥ pādayorāste prabhuḥ pāravatīpatiḥ | takāraḥ piḍikāsaṃsthaḥ prabhākāntaḥ prabhuḥ svayam ||99|| yekāro vartate jānvoraiśvaryādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ | svākāraḥ sarvagātre me mañjulātmā virājate || 2.47.1 00|| hākāro haṃsajātmā ca kaiṃkarye homamāptavān | saguṇeśaḥ pañcadaśasvahaṃ vai ṣoḍaśī kalā || 10 1|| kalāvān śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvakalāpatiḥ | mama nāthastvevamarthaṃ paraṃ jñātvā na janmabhāk || 1 02|| evaṃ tāḥ kanyakā rādhe jagṛhurmantramālikāḥ | jepurbhejuḥ patiṃ kāntaṃ nijābhinnapareśvaram || 103|| imaṃ tvarthaṃ paraṃ jñātvā svadehe śrīnarāyaṇam | virājamānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ ye bhajanti narāḥ striyaḥ || 1 04|| te paraṃpadagāścānte bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhaveddhruvam || 1 05|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lakṣmaṇakanyakābhyo lomaśakṛtaputraśiṣyapatnyādirūpopadeśādinirūpaṇanāmā saptacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 47 ||
<2.48> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike ramyāṃ camatkāramayīṃ kathām | caitre śrībālakṛṣṇasya pūjātmikāṃ vadāmi te || 1 || pitāmahasutā nityayauvanā vratasaṃsthitāḥ | brahmacaryaparā nity sāmavedasya pāṭhikāḥ || 2|| sūryavadrūpasampannāḥ suṣumṇeḍā ca piṅgalā | tisraḥ kanyāḥ kumāryaścānujñayā vedhaso bhuvi || 3 || mānasyastā manovegāścāyayustīrthavāñcchayā | śrutaṃ tābhiḥ purā satye nāradasya mukhānnanu || 4 || pṛthvyāṃ nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo rājate kamalāpatiḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpārvatīpatiḥ || 5 || tato jijñāsayāmāsuḥ papracchurnāradaṃ tu tāḥ | kīdṛgguṇaḥ sa bhagavān yatpraśaṃsāparo bhavān || 6 || nārado hi tadā prāha bhaginyo bhagavān hi saḥ | asmatpituḥ pitā yaśca vairājastasya yaḥ pitā || 7 || mahāviṣṇustasya pitā pradhānapuruṣastu yaḥ | tasya pitā prakṛtīśastatpitā śrīhariḥ svayam || 8 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so’sti kumārakaḥ | pṛthvyāṃ śrīkambharāputraḥ śrīmadgopālanandanaḥ || 9 || asmallokaḥ sapyalokastatparo dharaṇistaraḥ | tasmātparaṃ jalasyāstyāvaraṇaṃ ca tataḥ param || 2.48.1 0|| vaikuṇṭhaṃ rājate tasmātparaṃ tejaḥkaṭaṃ matam | vairājā nāma lokāśca yatra vairājanāmakaḥ || 1 1|| īśvaro rājate tasmād yanmahāvaiṣṇavaṃ padam | mahāviṣṇustatra cāste cātha pradhānadhāma vai || 1 2|| tatrāvyākṛtasaṃjñaṃ ca yatra bhūmā virājate | tadvai vaikuṇṭhamaparaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇāśritam || 1 3|| tataḥ prakṛtisātloke dhāmagolokamuttamam | śrīkṛṣṇo’tra, vāsudevo’vyākṛte, rājate prabhuḥ || 14|| tatparaṃ tvakṣaraṃ dhāma yatra brahma virājate | anantamuktasahitaṃ divyaiśvaryavirājitam || 15|| tasmātparaṃ bṛhatproktaṃ paraṃ dhāma hareḥ śubham | śāśvataṃ sarvaśobhāḍhyaṃ sarvadhāmaparaṃ mahat || 16|| paradhāmasthito’nādiśrīkṛṣṇaśrīnarāyaṇaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yo bhagavān svayam || 17|| yasmād bhavanti vai vyūhā vāsudevādayastathā | avatārā īśvarāśca devā ṛṣivarāstathā || 18|| anantāḥ śaktayo yasya rādhāramāprabhāśriyaḥ | lakṣmīpāravatīhaṃsākṛṣṇāvṛndājayādikāḥ || 19|| śataṃ ca dvādaśa caiva śreṣṭhāstatrāpi pārśvagāḥ | prabhāpāravatīrādhālakṣmyaścatasra eva tāḥ ||2.48.20|| sadā svamūrtyabhinnāstā rādhā hṛdantare sthitā | lakṣmīḥ rekhāsvarūpeṇa vakṣasyupari saṃsthitā ||21 || prabhā kṛṣṇānane tejaḥparidhirūpiṇī sthitā | pāravatī padmacihnātmikā vāme’sya sakthini ||22|| vartante evamanyāśca śarīrāvayavātmikāḥ | koṭyarbudāśca yāstvanyāstāstu romasu sarvaśaḥ ||23|| tanmūrtau saṃsthitā devyo mugdhā bhajanti taṃ patim | sarvalāvaṇyasaundaryānandasaubhāgyaśevadhim ||24|| bhajante brahmavāsinyaḥ koṭyarbudakumārikāḥ | nālamedhyaścaturdaśasahasrāṇi bhajanti tam || 25|| dīpāvalyaḥ koṭiśaśca ṣaṣṭistatkanyakāstathā | talājā daityakanyā ca gokanyāścārcayanti tam ||26|| ārjantyādyāḥ śatasaṃkhyā bhajante taṃ pareśvaram | kanyā krodhanikānāmnī bhajate taṃ narāyaṇam || 27|| kandarāḥ kanyakāścāpi bhajante koṭisaṃkhyakāḥ | brahmaputrī tathā sūcī vanadevaśca lakṣakam ||28|| rākṣasīkanyakā lakṣasaṃkhyā bhajanti taṃ patim | kaṃkatālīyajātīyāḥ paṃcaṣāścāyutaṃ tathā ||29|| brahmasaraso’psarasaḥ kanyakā devakoṭikāḥ | aryamṇaḥ kanyakāścāpi kuberakanyakāstathā ||2.48.3 0|| indrakanyā yamakanyā vāyukanyāḥ sahasraśaḥ | ṛtukanyā viśvakarmakanyāśca drumakanyakāḥ ||3 1|| daityadānavakanyāśca pañcasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ | bhajante śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ taṃ parameśvaram ||32|| vasantasya tathā patnyo bhajante taṃ ca ṣoḍaśa | pañcaśataṃ sālamālakanyakāśca bhajanti tam ||33|| nāgakanyāyutaṃ śāvadīnakanyāsahasrakam | aindrajālikaraudryaśca kanyāḥ sahasrasaṃkhyakāḥ ||34|| ṣaṣṭikanyāḥ kiśoryaśca vidyātmikāścaturdaśa | vahneḥ putryaḥ śravaṇānāṃ putryaḥ saṃvatsarātmajāḥ ||35|| vārkṣīkanyāśca khanijāstaṃ bhajanti pareśvaram | dvesahasre kanyakāśca lakṣmaṇasya bhajanti tam ||36|| yogīśaṃ cāsaṃkhyarūpaṃ kiśoraṃ śāśvataṃ prabhum | tasya yogena muktiścānandavārdhisamarjanam ||37|| sarvadā vartate yasmāttaṃ bhajanti mumukṣavaḥ | ahaṃ taddarśanaṃ kartuṃ nityaṃ prātaḥ prayāmi ca ||38|| tasya guṇān pragāyāmi gāyatyenaṃ sarasvatī | ityuktā nāradenaitāḥ svasārastisra eva tu ||39|| tadgatamānasāḥ satyād vimānena samāyayuḥ | mandākinyā panthānaṃ tvanusṛtya himālayam ||2.48.40|| avateruḥ śrībadarīpatiṃ dṛṣṭvā prapūjya ca | kurukṣetraṃ puṣkaraṃ cārbudaṃ sarasvatīṃ tathā ||41|| dṛṣṭvā catuṣṭilādriṃ ca aśvapaṭṭasarovaram | āyayustā vimānena kṛṣṇadarśanalālasāḥ ||42|| ākāśamārgād bhāminyo dadṛśurujjvalāṃ kṣitim | caitrasya pūrṇimāsāyaṃ candrodayakṣaṇe hi tāḥ ||43|| vyomnā tat kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ sūryamivāparam | bhrājamānaṃ vyapaśyam̐śca timiraṃ na manāgapi ||44|| tatastāstarkayāmāsuḥ kṣetraṃ tatpauruṣottamam | sarovaraṃ ca nagaraṃ viśālaṃ dadṛśuśca tāḥ ||45|| madhye tu kānakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prāsādaṃ sūryavarculam | sūryabimbamivātmānaṃ khyāpayantaṃ ca dadṛśuḥ ||46|| udyānāni vicitrāṇi devapuṣpamayāni ca | devagṛhāṇi ramyāṇi ṛṣyāśramān sahasraśaḥ ||47|| divyāśca devatāścāpi dadṛśurvanadevatāḥ | avatārāśramām̐ścāpi tatheśvaragṛhāṇi ca ||48|| lomaśasyāśramaṃ divyaṃ śubhaṃ candravadujjvalam | divyauṣadhipravitataṃ dadṛśuḥ kanyakāśritam ||49|| tīrthasetuṃ ca parito dadṛśuśca vihāyasā | catuḥpradakṣiṇānyasya kṣetrasya saṃvidhāya tāḥ ||2.48.50 || pratarkya sūryasadṛśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇālayam | jayaśabdena sahitāḥ puṣpāṇāṃ varṣaṇaṃ vyadhuḥ |||51 || jayaśabdastu devīnāṃ vyomno’vyāpnot samantataḥ | śrutvā śabdān jayamiśrān lokā vyomni vyalokayan ||52||| candravatkaumudīvyāptaṃ cākṛtyā padmasannibham | netrānandakaraṃ gandhasugandhāḍhyaṃ vimānakam ||53|| tejobhūtaṃ vicitraṃ ca raṃgānuraṃgaśobhitam | antaḥpraviśya ca cakṣurdṛśyaṃ kanyāśritaṃ śubham ||54|| samṛddhaṃ divyavastvāḍhyaṃ vastratoraṇavardhitam | sauvarṇakalaśairyuktaṃ triśṛṃgaṃ tryāsanānvitam ||55|| dadṛśurmānavādyāśca paramāścaryamāgatāḥ | vimānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadevālayopari ||56|| sthiraṃ cābhūdambare ca tatra tisrastu kanyakāḥ | śuśruvuḥ sarvato jātān nīrājanasamudbhavān ||57|| ninadānnaikasaṃghoṣān stotrottamānasaṃkhyakān | tallīnāstāstadā jātā āpuḥ śāntiṃ parāṃ tadā ||58|| atha jñātvā śrīkṛṣṇastā bhaktā brahmasutā ratāḥ | svayaṃ kiśorarūpaśca vimāne prādurāsa ha ||59|| divyadarśanajaṃ saukhyaṃ sparśānandaṃ parātparam | dadau kṣaṇaṃ ca tābhyaśca saṃśleṣajaṃ mahāsukham ||2.48.60|| vimānaṃ śrīharistatrāvatārayat nijālaye | adṛśyo’bhūttadā yāne svarṇasaudhe gato’bhavat ||61 || kanyakāstā vimānāccāvateruḥ kṛṣṇamandire | candraśālopari kṣaṇaṃ tasthurvimānasannidhau ||6 2|| upadāstā vimānācca saṃgṛhya divyabhāsurāḥ | candraśālopari nyadhuḥ pratīkṣantyo’bhimārgadam ||63 || kiṃkaraṃ kiṃkarīṃ cāpi jānatī cāvarohaṇam | antaḥpraveśanārthaṃ ca pratīhārīpratīkṣakāḥ ||64|| tasthustāścandraśālāyāṃ tāvacchrīkambharāsutā | santoṣānāmikā tūrṇaṃ sakhyā suśīlayā saha ||65|| bhrāturbhagavataḥ pratnyāmṛtayā ca sahāyayau | candraśālāsthitā divyāḥ kanyāstejaḥśarīriṇīḥ ||66|| nemurvilokya ca śīghraṃ svāgataṃ jagaduḥ sukham | āgacchata mahābhāgāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prati ||67|| mātaraṃ pitaraṃ cāpi saptamabhvāṃ virājitam | ityuktāstāḥ suṣumṇā ca iḍā ca piṅgalā tathā ||68|| puṣpahārān candanāni karpūraṃ cākṣatām̐stathā | kuṃkumaṃ gandhasārām̐śca kaisarāṇyuttamāni ca ||69 || ratnahārān ratnabhūṣā makuṭaṃ kuṇḍale tathā | divyatāmbūlakaṃ divyaphalānyapyavalepanam ||2.48.70|| divyaṃ ca kajjalaṃ ramyaṃ tailaṃ brāhmaṃ samattamam | saugandhikavārisārān vahniśuddhāṃśukāni ca ||71 || sadratnahīrakahārān pātrāṇi kānakāni ca | ādarśān divyadṛśyām̐śca divyasammardacūrṇakān ||72|| divyanaivedyayogyām̐śca miṣṭabhojyānnapācitān | amṛtān dugdhasārām̐ścāsaṃkhyabījaphalāni ca ||73 || divyapeyāḍhyapātrāṇi samādāya tathā punaḥ | divyaśayyāstaraṇāni divyadhāryāmbarāṇi ca ||74|| gṛhītvā pātrahastāstāścāvateruḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | bhavyasopānāvarohamārgairbhūmyantaraṃ ca tāḥ ||75|| santoṣā kanyakā cāgre madhye tisro’jakanyakāḥ | pṛṣṭhe cāpyamṛtā bhrātṛjāyā suśīlikā tataḥ ||76 || ekāṃ bhūmimavatīrya viśāle bhūmisaṃstare | viviśuḥ saptamabhūmau yatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||77|| tathā śrīkambharālakṣmīrmātā virājate satī | mātaraṃ tāḥ sampraṇamya bālakṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca ||78|| divyāsaneṣu datteṣu niṣedustā yathocitam | ābhāṣitāśca tā mātrā maṃgalaṃ kuśalaṃ prati ||79|| prayojanaṃ tathā tāsāṃ janakaṃ jananīṃ prati | ūcuḥ paricayaṃ sarvaṃ brahmaṇastu sutā vayam ||2.48.80|| suṣumṇā ca iḍā cāpi piṃgalā nāma kanyakāḥ | kumārikā nijabhrāturnāradasyopadeśataḥ ||8 1 || vijñāya śrīmatīputraṃ tvanādiparameśvaram | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cainaṃ kiśoraṃ kāntamacyutam ||82||| draṣṭuṃ vayaṃ samāyātā dhanyāḥ smo’syādya darśanāt | adya naḥ saphalaṃ janma kaumāryaṃ saphalaṃ ca naḥ ||83 devītvaṃ saphalaṃ cāpi mātaste’pi ca darśanāt | ityuktvā cāmṛtāṃ pṛṣṭvā santoṣāṃ ca suśīlikām ||84|| pūjāṃ cakruḥ keśavasya bālakṛṣṇasya sammatāḥ | prathamaṃ kṛṣṇacaraṇau pupūjurgāṃgavāribhiḥ ||89|| nyadhurmukhe ca śirasi śrīkāntacaraṇāmṛtam | tataścandanabindvādi bhāle cakurharestataḥ ||86|| sugandhilepanaṃ cakrurdaduḥ sugandhavāri ca | gandhasārāndaduścāpi kajjalaṃ kuṃkumādikam ||87|| puṣpahārān ratnahārān vibhāṣā mukuṭaṃ tathā | kaṭake kuṇḍale cāpi daduścānyavibhūtikam ||88|| ambarāṇi śayanāni phalānnapeyakāni ca | upadāśca nyadhustasya purataścāmarādikam ||89|| naivedyāni daduścāpi miṣṭapeyāni yāni ca | tāmbūlakaṃ daduścāpi cakrurnīrājana tataḥ ||2.48.90|| pradakṣiṇaṃ pracakruśca mālikāṃ mahatīṃ gale | daduścāntarabhāvānāṃ jñāpayitrīṃ tu śāśvatīm ||9 1 || kāntaḥ kāntākṛtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhītvā pāṇinā ca tāḥ | pasparśa tatkarān kṛṣṇo bhāvajño bhāvi bodhayan ||92|| vihasan lokayan tāsāmānanāni muhurmuhuḥ | tāścāti jahṛṣuḥ rādhe bālakṛṣṇāptihetunā || 93|| atha tā mātaraṃ tadvat santoṣāṃ cāmṛtāṃ tathā | amlānāḥ puṣpamālāścārpayāmāsurgalāntare ||94|| nemustābhyo vinamrāśca bhojitā viśramīkṛtāḥ | pāyitāḥ śāyitāścāpi saṃvāhitāśca varṣmasu ||95|| sakhībhiḥ kiṃkarībhiśca sevitā nidritāśca tāḥ | prātarutthāya ca snātvā tvaśvapaṭṭasarovare ||96|| tīrthavidhiṃ paraṃ kṛtvā gatvā śrīlomaśāśramam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||97|| mantraṃ mālāṃ taulasīṃ ca gṛhītvā vīkṣya koṭyarbudam | kanyakānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ ca prasannāḥ pūjyabhāvataḥ ||98|| natvā śīghraṃ punaḥ kṛṣṇakāntaṃ prati samāyayuḥ | darśanaṃ prāpya tṛptāstāḥ kṛṣṇavaśyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 99|| atṛptā iva paśyanti hṛdi kṛtvā patiṃ prabhum | śrīkṛṣṇena hṛdā cāṃgīkṛtāstāḥ svagṛhaṃ prati || 2.48.10 0|| gantuṃ necchāṃ yadā cakrustadā prāha narāyaṇaḥ | punarājñāṃ piturnītvā samāyātātra satvaram || 101 || bhavatīnāṃ mānasāni pūrayiṣye na saṃśayaḥ | ityuktāstā hareragre samarpya sarvavastukam || 1 02|| vimāna vastuśūnyaṃ ca kṛtvā gopālakṛṣṇakam | pūjayitvā tato natvāgṛhyājñāṃ bhojanottaram || 1 03|| prasādya śrīhariṃ kāntaṃ natvā rādhe punaḥ punaḥ | prasādajaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ prāpya vimānamāsthitāḥ || 1 04|| aśvapaṭṭasaro natvā natvā kuṃkumavāpikām | kāntadevālayaṃ natvā vyomnā yānena cāmbare || 1 05|| tiro’bhavan kṣaṇānmuktvā jayaśabdān punaḥ punaḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya kṛṣṇasaubhāgyavān bhavet || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vedhasastisraḥ putryaḥ suṣumṇeḍāpiṃgalā vimānenāgatya prabhuṃ patiṃ matvā saṃpūjya yayurityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 48 ||
<2.49> śrīrādhikovāca kathaṃ kānta suṣumṇādyāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai | lomaśasyāśrame sthātuṃ nājñaptāḥ svīkṛtā api || 1 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi kanyāścānyāstu vedhasaḥ | tā mānasyaḥ samicchanti kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ pareśvaram || 2 || satyaloke vasanti sma pratīkṣante sma bhāvataḥ | tisro’grajāḥ sameṣyanti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam || 3 || vayaṃ tābhiḥ samaṃ tatra gamiṣyāmo vilokitum | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ seviṣyāmahe’nādimādhavam || 4 || itipratīkṣamāṇānāmānayanārthameva tāḥ | na niruddhā idānīṃ vai sthātuṃ śrīlomaśāśrame || 5 || brahmaṇā preṣitāḥ kṛṣṇo rakṣayiṣyati tāḥ punaḥ | atha tāḥ svavimānena paścimāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam || 6 || samudraṃ ca tathā dvīpānabriktān supradeśakān | paśyantyo vyomamārgeṇa pradakṣiṇecchayottaram || 7 || yāntyaḥ pradadṛśurdeśaṃ cābriktaṃ sumahattaram | punaḥ punaḥ parāvṛtya vyomnā yānena nirbhayāḥ || 8 || ārabījaṃ mahādvīpaṃ raṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā tato’grataḥ | raktaṃ ca vāridhiṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūmau nārāyaṇīṃ nadīm || 9 || vīkṣya dakṣiṇabhāge ca rudrabāṣpaṃ sarovaram | tathā vijñaturīyākhyaṃ dṛṣṭvā śreṣṭhaṃ sarovaram || 2.49.1 0|| tuṅgānīkasaraścāpi tathā nyāsasaro’pi ca | dṛṣṭvā liṃgarasādriṃ ca drākṣābījaṃ ca parvatam || 1 1|| kālahariṃ raṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā umāśaṃbhugiriṃ tathā | karmāṅgīṃ ca nadīṃ dṛṣṭvā karmaghnaṃ parvataṃ tathā || 12|| caṇḍasarastato dṛṣṭvā vīkṣya naṣṭajarāṃ nadīm | sahariharasaṃjñaṃ ca raṇaṃ vilokya vai tataḥ || 1 3|| ataleṣṭaṃ parvataṃ ca tanmukhaṃ parvataṃ tathā | trirāśiparvataṃ dṛṣṭvā līlābījaraṇaṃ tathā || 14|| śrīramāyā raṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā tururājyaṃ vilokya ca | kaśyapāyanavārdhi ca dṛṣṭvā coralaparvatam || 15|| paścime ca kukeśādriṃ nīlābdhiṃ pravilokya ca | nīparāṃ ca nadīṃ kārpanthāyanaṃ cāpi parvatam || 16|| dīnayūpāṃ nadīṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā ca ailaparvatam | īpīnāsanaśailaṃ ca śāradīdvīpamityapi || 17|| madhyavādhiṃ vilokyaiva pitṛnijaṃ ca parvatam | tegirāṃ ca nadīṃ vīkṣya deśān samudramadhyagān || 18|| lukvārāṃ ca nadīṃ senānadīṃ vīkṣya ca khāḍikām | jarāmaunapradeśaṃ ca bālayamapradeśakam || 1 9|| īṅgadvīpaṃ tathā cāyadvīpaṃ vilokya khāḍikām | koṭadvīpaṃ svedadvīpaṃ phenadvīpaṃ tataḥ param || 2.49.20|| piṣṭavargān vilokyātha girīnapṛthivīṃ tathā | ālīśāmṛtapṛthivīṃ divonadvīpakādikān ||2 1 || vilokya khāḍikādvīpān vikturīyabhuvaṃ yayuḥ | khāḍīmuttīrya ca tato viviśuścottarān kurūn ||22|| teṣu mahābṛhatsaro mahatsulvabhidhaṃ saraḥ | ayābāṣkaṃ saro dṛṣṭvā vinipāgacchakaṃ saraḥ ||23||| haṭṭāsanaṃ samudraṃ ca dviphenadvīpamityapi | lambodarādipṛthivīṃ sūparyuparikaṃ saraḥ ||24|| santaluyīpradeśa ca atalāntapradeśakam | mākṣikākhātamullaṃghya kyubādvīpaṃ vilokya ca ||25|| vargidvīpān vilokyātha grīyānāmapyalokayan | āmārjunāṃ nadīṃ vīkṣya śāntārāmapradeśakam ||26|| brāhmīlāṃ pṛthivīṃ vīkṣya samaikṣanta parainasām | ārjayantīpradeśām̐śca kokadvīpau vyalokayan ||27|| grāhāmaṃ cārakoṭaṃ ca vīkṣya cāntārkivartulam | jalaprastaradeśām̐śca vīkṣya bhūguhyabindukam ||28|| parāvṛtya tirodevaṃ paṭṭogānāṃ vyalokayan | cīllikāṃ perukāṃ pṛthvīṃ pannāmnīṃ nirjharāṃ tathā ||29|| mākṣikaṃ bhūtalaṃ vīkṣya nimnaphornāṃ vilokya ca | kvīṭanādriṃ rokiśailam ilāsanaṃ ca parvatam || 2.49.30 || raṅgilaṃ parvataṃ vīkṣya alāṃśukāṃ ca bhūmikām | dviriṅgaṃ cābdhimuttīryālokayan kāmacāṭakam ||3 1 || kālimāṃ saritaṃ yāmāṃ bīnāṃ tandrāpradeśakān | yāneśīṃ ca nadīm obīṃ nadīṃ vīkṣya tataḥ param ||32|| uralaṃ parvataṃ vīkṣya nāvadvīpaṃ vilokya ca | phiyojānāsanadvīpān sphītavargān vilokya ca ||33|| skandanābhamahāśailaṃ śvetavārdhiṃ vilokya ca | devīnāṃ saritaṃ valgāṃ nadīṃ valgākhyaparvatān ||34|| uralaṃ ca saro dṛṣṭvā bālakṛṣṇasarastathā | śvetaraktapradeśāṃśca dṛṣṭvā sāvariyāraṇam ||35|| dṛṣṭvā kimpuruṣaṃ deśaṃ dvikalaṃ ca sarovaram | vīkṣya prabhālunādriṃ ca stenāvāsaṃ ca bhūbhṛtam||36|| akṣoḍhāvārdhimālokya jalapānādibhūmikāḥ | piśaṅgavārdhimālokya akṣigaṃ parvataṃ tathā ||37|| gopīraṇaṃ vilokyātha āpatāyikaparvatam | triyānāsanaśailaṃ ca kunalīnaṃ ca parvatam || 38|| kārukoraṃ parvataṃ ca cipiṃgadeśamujjvalam | aṃgaśikṣāṃgasaritaṃ vīkṣya śikṣāṃgikāṃ nadīm ||3 9|| phullipānadvīpān dṛṣṭvā dvīpām̐śca vāraṇīyakān | vīkṣya dvīpaṃ navagītiṃ vīkṣya dvīpān samudrajān ||2.49.40|| uṣṇālayābhidhāṃ pṛthvīṃ vyalokayan vihāyasā | cāṭadeśaṃ divādikparvatān vīkṣya tataśca tāḥ ||41|| okadvīpaṃ navajīvadvīpaṃ vīkṣya samudragau | vīkṣya dvīpaṃ trāsamānam uṣṭrālaye murānadīm ||42|| turunadīm aitanadīṃ mekadāneyaparvatam | maśakagrīvaśailaṃ ca mahāraṇaṃ vanaṃ tathā |||43|| pañcasarāṃsi ca dṛṣṭvā dārāliṅgaṃ ca parvatam | bālādriṃ hemaśālādrim ārnahemapradeśakān ||44|| dṛṣṭvā yāvān sumātrām̐śca malāyāṃ pṛthivīṃ tataḥ | annadāmadvīpān śyāmadeśān mikāṃganāṃ nadīm ||45|| īrāvatīṃ nadīṃ cārākarṇādriṃ brahmadeśakān | sundarākhyavanaṃ dṛṣṭvā hutalīnāṃ mahānadīm ||46|| gaṃgāṃ ca brahmaputrāṃ ca khāsīnāparvatāṃstathā | patatkāryamahāśailaṃ himālayapradeśakān ||47|| dṛṣṭvā mānasaraścāpi śrīdeśaṃ ca trivartanam | sindhum indukuśaṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā kṛpāluparvatam ||48|| thararaṇaṃ ca kacchaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā sābharakaṃ saraḥ | āravallībhūbhṛtaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā mahīṃ ca narmadām ||49|| saptapuṭākhyaśailaṃ ca tapatīṃ ca mahānadīm | mahābaleśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā tathā ca malayaṃ girim ||2.49.50|| sahyādriṃ saṃvilokyaiva dakṣiṇām̐śca pradeśakān | samudrasthaṃ siṃhalākhyaṃ dvīpaṃ vīkṣya parāvṛtāḥ ||51 || kāverīṃ saritaṃ kṛṣṇāṃ godāvarīṃ mahānadīm | jagannāthapuraṃ kṣetraṃ kapilāśramamityapi ||52|| vaṃgaṃ cāṃgaṃ vihāraṃ ca bhūtānaṃ nipalaṃ tathā | gaṇḍakīṃ ca kurukṣetraṃ gaṅgādvāraṃ vilokya tāḥ ||53 || rādhike badarīṃ gatvā nyūṣustatra niśāṃ sukham | nārāyaṇaparāsevāṃ kṛtvā sampūjya taṃ prabhum ||54|| gaurīśṛṃgaṃ śivaśṛṃgaṃ vilokya svardhunīṃ tathā | vyomagaṅgānumārgeṇa svarlokāt satyalokakam ||55|| yayuḥ śrībrahmaṇaḥ pārśve mahānandapariplutāḥ | vavanduḥ pitaraṃ ceḍā suṣumṇā piṃgalā tathā ||56|| mahāharṣaplutāstīrthavidhiṃ prāhuryathākṛtam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya caraṇāmṛtam ||57|| puṣpahārān daduścāpi mantraṃ jaguḥ punaḥ punaḥ | nāradasyopakāraṃ ca samūcuśca parasparam ||58|| āgatāḥ kanyakāścāpi tisraḥ śrutvānyakanyakāḥ | dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi vṛttāntaṃ vedituṃ tathā ||59|| svāgatārthaṃ cāyayuśca brahmaṇaḥ sannidhau tadā | yaśasvinī hastijihvā pūṣā viśvodarā kuhūḥ ||2.49.60|| alambuṣā ca gāndhārī śaṃkhinī ca payasvinī | sarasvatī vāruṇī ca tejasvinī ca raktinī ||6 1|| purītat vīryavāhā ca prāṇavāhā tathārdrikā | ityādyāśca dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi hyupasthitāḥ ||6 2|| kanyakāḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣanyūnā divyāḥ kumārikāḥ | svāgataṃ snehataścakrustisṛṇāṃ vai muhurmuhuḥ ||63 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādajalaṃ papuḥ | prasādamālāpuṣpāṇi jagṛhuścādarānvitāḥ ||64|| śuśruvuḥ śrīharervārtāṃ rūpasaundaryamāśritām | camatkāramayīṃ sarvāṃ tathā vai pattanasya ca ||65|| lomaśasyāśramasyāpi bālakṛṣṇālayasya ca | koṭyarbudānāṃ kanyānāṃ sevābhāvaṃ ca śuśruvuḥ ||66|| yaśasvinyādikā nāḍīsaraso brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ | dadṛśustisṛsvasṝṇāṃ rūpaṃ saubhāgyamuttamam ||67|| divyatāṃ kṛṣṇakāntena dattāṃ tathā ca laukikīm | cintayāmāsuratyarthaṃ kṛṣṇasaubhāgyamuttamam ||68|| amanyanta nijābhāgyaṃ darśanaṃ na vyajāyata | darśanārthaṃ gatā naiva kuto vai darśanaṃ bhavet ||69|| pitrājñayā hyavaśyaṃ vai gantavyaṃ draṣṭumacyutam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ pareśvaram ||2.49.70 || ityevaṃ cintayāmāsuḥ pitaraṃ prāhurutsukāḥ | pitaścāsmān darśanaṃ tvaṃ kārayābhiryathā kṛtam ||71|| variṣyāmastameveśeśvareśvaraṃ pumuttamam | ityuktaṃ brahmaṇe tābhirbrahmā tutoṣa mānase ||72|| ko’nyo lābhaḥ paraścāsmād yajjāmātā harirbhavet | dhanyāstāḥ kanyakā loke kaumāryaṃ saphalaṃ tathā ||73|| pitā dhanyo jananī ca dhanyā dhanyaṃ kuṭumbakam | dhanyo bhṛguḥ samudraśca kedāraścānaraṇyakaḥ ||74|| sūryo nārāyaṇo nānyo yatputryaḥ kṛṣṇayoṣitaḥ | dhanyā loke bhaviṣyanti te janā yatsutāḥ śubhāḥ ||75|| kṛṣṇapatnyo bhaviṣyanti rādhālakṣmīprabhādivat | bhaktyā jñānena tapasā vairāgyeṇa makhādibhiḥ ||76|| yaḥ prāptavyaśca kṛcchrairvā yogairdānādibhistathā | sevayā vā satāṃ cet sa snehena yadi labhyate ||77|| mohena yauvanenāpi vāsanayecchayātha vā | rūpeṇendriyavegena mileccetpuruṣottamaḥ ||78|| sa moho yauvanaṃ cecchā vāsanā rūpamindriyam | sarvaṃ dharmātmakaṃ bodhyaṃ kāmaḥ krodho’pi tanmayaḥ ||79|| kṛṣṇe kāmastathā lobho moho mokṣakaraḥ sadā | mokṣastu śāśvatānandaḥ sa ca kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe ||2.49.80|| garhyaṃ stutyaṃ ca vā kiñcit kṛtaṃ cet kṛṣṇatuṣṭaye | sarvaṃ vandyaṃ hi tad bodhyaṃ pāvanaṃ tārakaṃ hi tat ||81 || aho putryaḥ sadā dhanyo bhāgyavān vai bhavāmyaham | yat kṛṣṇāya pradāsyāmi dānaṃ pātrāya śārṅgiṇe |||82|| kṛṣṇecchā kīdṛśī cāste jñātvā dāsye śubhaṃ bhavet | ityuktvā ca svayaṃ brahmā sasmāra nāradaṃ munim ||83 || upatasthau kṣaṇāttatra praṇamya cāsane sthitaḥ | brahmā prāha bhaginyaste tisro yatra narāyaṇam ||84|| suṣumṇādyāḥ pūjayitvā punaratra samāgatāḥ | tatraitāścaparāḥ kanyā draṣṭuṃ gantuṃ samutsukāḥ ||85|| vidyante’tastvayā tatra netavyā vai vimānakaiḥ | samāyāte’vasare’haṃ dāsye kṛṣṇāya kanyakāḥ ||86|| dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi draṣṭumicchanti keśavam | yaśasvinyādikāḥ sarvā nāḍikāsarasaḥ śubhāḥ ||87|| daśabhaumaṃ sahasraikaśikharaṃ kāmacāri ca | gṛhāṇaitanmahāyānaṃ yojanāyatavartulam ||88|| kāmavallīḥ kāmavṛkṣān cintāmaṇīn dhanapradān | amṛtamiṣṭabhojyādipradānatra niveśaya ||89|| śastraśālāḥ sainyaśālā bhojyaśālāstathātra vai | mantraśālāścauṣadhādisamūhāḥ santi cātra vai ||2.49.90|| rasaśālā vastraśālā rakṣāśālāstathātra ca | siddhayaḥ śaktayo dāsyaḥ kiṃkaryaḥ santi lakṣaśaḥ ||91 || astrāṇi cāpyanekāni vedāścatvāra ityamī | maraṇādiprayogāśca samūrtāḥ santi cātra vai || 92|| indrajālavināśārthaṃ māyānāśārthamityapi | daityadānavanāśārthaṃ santyatra mantramūrtayaḥ || 93|| antato’haṃ svayaṃ brahmā śaṃkaro’pi narāyaṇaḥ | mūrtyātmakā yathā sākṣānnivasāmo’tra cetanāḥ ||94|| acchedyaṃ cāpyabhedyaṃ cāvilepyaṃ cāpyanāśyakam | adāhyaṃ śāśvataṃ caitadvimānaṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇa ca ||95|| suṣumṇeḍāpiṃgalābhiḥ sahitābhiḥ svayam ṛṣe | dvāsaptatisahasrābhiḥ kanyābhiḥ saha putraka ||96|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhūsthaṃ prayāhi vai | upadā vividhā nītvā kanyeṣṭān divyavaibhavān ||97|| śṛṃgārahārabhūṣādyānupakārakarān śubhān | nayasva saha yāne’tra sukhaṃ cārpaya śārṅgiṇe ||98|| ityukto nāradastatra sanatkumāramārthayat | sādhurūpaṃ brahmarūpaṃ rakṣakaṃ brahmavarcasam ||99|| tathā rudraṃ dharmarājaṃ cārthayad rakṣaṇāya vai | brahmā sanatkumāraṃ ca rudraṃ dharmaṃ dadau tadā || 2.49.1 00|| divyavastubhṛtaṃ yānaṃ cāruruhuśca kanyakāḥ | sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyā jayaśabdān pracakrire || 101 || maṅgalānyabhavam̐statra yātrārambhe punaḥ punaḥ | sāvitrī cāhvayāmāsa gamane pṛṣṭhatastadā || 1 02|| yāta putryaḥ sāvadhānāḥ pātheyāni srajastadā | gṛhṇateti dadau tābhyaścaitanmaṃgalamuttamam || 103 || devaśivā tadā vāme susvareṇāvahajjayam | devahārītamevāpi parāṅmukhaṃ puro’bhavat || 1 04|| yānasya gamane vīṇā nāradasyāpatat karāt | amaṅgalaṃ tu tajjātaṃ dvedhā bhinnābhavaddhi sā || 1 05|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | ityevaṃ nāradaḥ prāhāmaṃgalasya praśāntaye || 1 06|| vimānaṃ satyalokāt tat lokālokācalaṃ hyanu | avātarat paścimāyāṃ diśi bhuvaṃ prati kṣaṇāt || 107 || kāñcanyāṃ bhūmikāyāṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ viśrāntimāpya ca | pūrvābhimukhamābaddhya digbhāgaṃ vyomamārgataḥ || 1 08|| śanaiḥ śanai samāyāti kanyāḥ paśyanti bhūstarān | abdhin deśān vicitrāṃśca modante’nyonyamityapi || 1 09|| ityevaṃ rādhike yānaṃ cābriktopari cāgatam | paśyanti sūryatulyaṃ tad rākṣasāḥ krūramānasāḥ || 2.49.1 10|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne suṣumṇādikā vimānena pṛthvīkhaṇḍān vilokya satyalokaṃ yayuḥ, punardvāsaptatisahasrakanyakā vimānena vyomnā śrīharyarthaṃ prasthitāścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 49 ||
<2.50> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike divyaṃ camatkāraṃ harestathā | vīṇābhaṃgasya ca phalaṃ yānasthāsvabhavattadā || 1 || abriktadeśavāsā ye mlecchā rākṣasayonayaḥ | āraṇyakāśca grāmasthā vanaparvatavāsinaḥ || 2 || sahasrayojanasthāste vyalokayan tadāmbare | śatasūryasamaṃ tattu vimānaṃ bhāsvarāmbaram || 3 || sūryatejo’titejobhirdaśaguṇān prabhāvataḥ | kiraṇān vyasṛjad vyomni anuṣṇāśītasaṃsahān || 4 || sudṛśyān suspṛśaścāpi maṣṭāmodabharām̐stathā | ānandotpādakān śāntipradān vicitrabhāsurān || 5 || brahmaṇā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārthaṃ cārpitaṃ tu yat | ki nyūnaṃ tatra vai rādhe vimāne mānavad bhavet || 6 || ghṛtadugdhadadhikulyā amṛtavārisaddhradāḥ | gandhasāradravasāracūrṇasārādigūṭikāḥ || 7 || rasasārāmodasāracarvaṇottamavīṭikāḥ | vidyante yatra satataṃ kalpastambeṣu śāśvatāḥ || 8 || ratnadvīpā darśanārhā naikaraṅgādibhāsurāḥ | svarṇacampakavarṇābhakanyakāhṛdayaṃgamāḥ || 9 || hāratoraṇakuñjādiharidvarṇanikuñjakāḥ | ramyastheyodyānamadhyāsanaśādvalarājitāḥ || 2.50.1 0|| sthalyo yatra prabhāsante candrabhūmisamāḥ śubhāḥ | vimānarūpaṃ kanyānāṃ rūpaṃ rūpaṃ ca cāndrikam || 1 1|| prabhārūpaṃ ca sarvaṃ vai rūpapradīpajaṃ tathā | maṇiratnādirūpaṃ ca bhinnaṃ cāpi paramparam || 12|| anyonyotkṛṣṭatāṃ prāptaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vyabhāsata | keṣāṃ manāṃsi lokānāṃ sasparddhacaṃcalāni vai || 13| nākṛṣṭāni bhaveyurvai divyaitādṛśaraśmibhiḥ | divyābhiḥ kanyakābhiśca divyasmṛddhibhireva ca || 14|| tābhiruttejitā mlecchā daityā cābriktavāsinaḥ | māyāmantrakarā vyomni rurudhustadvimānakam || 15|| āśāvahālābhavahā iṣṭaṃmanyāśca veginaḥ | avicārya patantyugrā prāṇāntaduḥkhade’pi ca || 16|| dṛṣṭvānalaṃ pataṃgāśca gṛhṇīma iti vāñcchayā | patanti rūpabhogārthaṃ prajvalante’titejasā || 17|| apātrāṇyapi kurvanti prayāsaṃ bahule phale | aśaktigamye nikṣipyātmānaṃ mṛtiṃ prayānti ca || 18|| asurāste kālasīdā mlecchā matvā balaṃ nijam | adhikaṃ tvaritaṃ ruṣṭāḥ sannahya raṇamāgaman || 1 9|| raktavārdhiḥ raudrabāṣpo vijñaturīyakastathā | tuṃgānīko nyāsasāro liṅgaraso’tidāruṇaḥ ||2.50.20|| dhvākṣabījo mūśalāmbaḥ karmāṃgaḥ karmahāstathā | caṇḍasāro naṣṭajaraḥ sahāraścātaleṣṭakaḥ ||2 1 || tuṅgamukhastrirāśaśca līlābījo bhayaṃkaraḥ | phalgubījo gambikāyaḥ senāgolaḥ sphuṭārdanaḥ ||22|| jīvalaśca kedaṇḍaśca kumeruḥ sthānalistathā | tumbāsuro’tha līnāpaścāliviṣṭaḥ kimūṣakaḥ ||23|| tūnāyaśca tathābālo rukvāsanaśca māvuraḥ | bāṃgivalirdinolūkaḥ kuvaṃśajaḥ kurenṛkaḥ ||24|| dhodhasādā bahavaśca ambikāsaśca śirvamaḥ | deṣalaśca kakralaśca ījyāpāto nabījakaḥ ||25|| sudānaśca sumāliśca kāṇimaśca trigoṇikaḥ | rudraśirāśca triṣvālaḥ pilipaśca namākuvaḥ ||26|| dinameraścāṅgulādaḥ phenagaḥ kāmanāruṇiḥ | nimnajharo lālavāro hrīyoḍho mārakarkaśaḥ ||27|| alijīraśca roṇḍegaḥ śāhudaḥ phakarāṇakaḥ | pārṣṇiḥ kṛkāṭakaḥ piṇḍanalo randhrapramoṣakaḥ ||28|| bhujahā jatruśamano lāmako mūrddhabhāmakaḥ | prakoṣṭhakaḥ pṛṣṭhavaṃśo nitambaveṇukastathā ||29|| āsavāpaścāmīṣapaḥ kukkuṭāśaḥ kṛkāśakaḥ | ityete balavantaśca māyayā vyomacāriṇaḥ ||2.50.3 0 || vidyudvegena vai sarve sannahyopasthitā raṇe | tatra rājā jumāsemlā dūtaṃ vai raktavārdhikam ||3 1 || preṣayāmāsa ca vimānāgre vaktuṃ nijeṣṭakam | rājā prāha vimānāgre gatvāvedaya raktaka |||3 2|| vimānaṃ tvastu naścātra kanyā bhavantu naḥ striyaḥ | vimānasthā narāḥ svargaṃ yāntu cānyatra vai sukham ||33|| anyathā tu prasahyaiva hariṣyāmastu kanyakāḥ | haniṣyāmaśca vastasmād yatheṣṭaṃ kurutātra yat ||34|| dūto natvā vimānāgre gatvā prāha tathaiva tat | nāradaḥ prāhaḥ taṃ dūtaṃ vadāsuranṛpaṃ mama ||35|| yāścātra santi kanyāstā brahmaṇaḥ putrya eva tāḥ | yūyaṃ ca brahmapautrasya kaśyapasya hi vaṃśajāḥ ||36|| daityo hiraṇyacakṣuryastasya putrāḥ sukālikaḥ | añjanaḥ kālameghaśca jāsuśeṣo malīnasaḥ ||37|| hāvuko bhāvukaścāpi dāuko dhāvukastathā | kvāśmakaścājamālaśca saireyādyāḥ śatādhikāḥ ||38|| hiraṇyākṣe hate daitye viṣṇunā sūkareṇa ha | tadbhayād dravamānāste cābriktaṃ raṇaparvataiḥ ||39|| vyāptaṃ deśaṃ samāgatyākurvan nivāsamatra te | tadvaṃśyā vai bhavantaśca bhavantyeva gatavṛṣāḥ ||2.50.40|| asaṃskṛtā mlecchavṛttā mama bhrātrādivaṃśajāḥ | ahaṃ ca nāradaścāsmi tathātrāste sanatṛṣiḥ ||41|| dharmarājastathā cātra virājate hi daṇḍadhṛk | rudro’tra rājate lokasaṃhārakṛtparaḥ prabhuḥ ||42|| aputreṇa purā rudro hiraṇyākṣeṇa vai vane | ārādhito haro devaḥ putrārthāya purā kila ||43|| tatpratāpena sāpatyo’bhavad bhavatpitāmahaḥ | taṃ rudraṃ mātra rundhantu mā rundhantu yamādhipam ||44|| kanyakā mātaraḥ sarvā bhavatāṃ tā bhavanti vai | ajitvā tu yamaṃ rudraṃ bhavatkāmo hi durlabhaḥ ||45|| yastaret sāgaraṃ dorbhyāṃ pātayed bhuvi bhāskaram | merumutpāṭayedvāpi sa jayed yamaśaṃkarau ||46|| kiṃ na śrutaṃ tvayā rājan pūrve vai cāndhakāsuraḥ | pārvatīkāmanāmūḍhaḥ sadaityo nāśamāptavān ||47|| mahīṣaśca tathā jambhaḥ kujambho nāśamāgatāḥ | śaṃkhacūḍastathā jālaṃdharo’pi nāśamāgatau ||48|| bhasmo murastathā cānye vinaṣṭā mohamāritāḥ | parastrīkāmanāmūḍhaḥ purā daṇḍo mahīpatiḥ ||49|| śukraputryāṃ ratiṃ kṛtvā sarāṣṭro nāśamāptavān | śṛṇu dūta tataḥ śrutvā śrāvaya tvaṃ narādhipam ||2.50.50|| daṇḍo rājā mahānāsīt prabhūtabalavāhanaḥ | īje sa vividhairyajñairnṛpatiḥ śukrapālitaḥ ||51 || śukraścāsyābhavad yajñe purohitaḥ punaḥ punaḥ | śukraḥ kadācidagamat pātālaṃ daityamantritaḥ ||52|| śukrasyāsīttu duhitā arajā nāmato gṛhe | ekākinī parṇakuṭyāṃ śuśrūṣantī makhānalam ||53|| rājā tu darśanaṃ kartuṃ cāyāto parṇaje gṛhe | agniṃ praṇamya ca kanyāmekākinīṃ surūpiṇīm |||54|| sandṛṣṭvā kāmasantaptastatkṣaṇādeva pārthivaḥ | neme tāṃ tu guroḥ putrīṃ pūrṇayauvanaśālinīm ||55|| sāpi tamāgataṃ kanyā pratyutthāya tapodhanā | bhrātṛbhāvena satkṛtya mālāṃ prāsādikīṃ dadau ||56|| tatastāmāha nṛpatirbāle kāmāgnitāpitam | māṃ samāhlādayasvātra svapariṣvaṃgavāriṇā ||57|| sā taṃ prāha tadā me tu pitā tvāṃ nirdahecca mām | yaḥ samartho jīvayituṃ devān mārayituṃ hyapi |||58|| bhavān bhrātā dharmato’sti śiṣyo yataḥ piturmama | tvaṃ maivaṃ mānasaṃ rājan ekānte kartumarhasi ||59|| so’bravīd bhīru māṃ śukraḥ kālena paridhakṣyati | kāmāgnistvadya māmatra dahatyeva praśāmaya ||2.50.60|| sā prāha daṇḍaṃ nṛpatiṃ muhūrtaṃ paripālaya | guruṃ tameva yācasva sa te dāsyatyasaṃśayam ||61 || daṇḍo’bravīt arajo me kālakṣepo na vai kṣamaḥ | kṣaṇe kṣaṇe nu vighnānāṃ paṃktiḥ sarvatra vidyate ||62|| virajā prāha nātmānaṃ dātuṃ śaktā narādhipa | kāmabhoge tu sutarāmasvatantrā hi yoṣitaḥ ||63|| kiṃ vadāmi tava rājannevamutpathavartinaḥ | rāṣṭraṃ rājyaṃ kuṭumbaṃ ca svayaṃ cānyacca yat tava ||64|| sarvaṃ tvayā yutaṃ nāśaṃ śukraśāpena yāsyati | maivaṃ vahnau pata rājannaitad dharmyaṃ hi vidyate ||65|| rājā prāha balāttvāṃ vai bhokṣye cennaiva manyase | arajā yajñavahniṃ svahaste kṛtvā nṛpopari ||66|| cikṣepa gaccha duṣṭātmannito vibhraṣṭamānasa | ityuktvā parṇaśālāṃ ca tyaktvā gantuṃ bahirhi sā ||67|| yāvaddhāvati tāvattāṃ dhṛtvā kṛtvā svavakṣasi | kāmopahatacittātmā vyadhvaṃsayata mandadhīḥ ||68|| tāṃ kṛtvā cyutacāritrāṃ niścakrāma yayau gṛham | sāpi śukraplutā bālā arajā rajasā plutā ||69|| āśramādatha nirgatya bahistasthāvadhomukhī | cintayantī svapitaraṃ rudatī ca muhurmuhuḥ ||2.50.70 || asnānā cābhojanā ca tasthau vṛkṣaṃ samāśritā | praharānte pitā tasyāḥ śukraḥ prāgamadāśramam ||71|| dadṛśe kanyakāṃ naijāṃ sandhyātulyāṃ rajasvalām | papraccha putri kenāsi dharṣitā vā kathaṃ nvidam ||72|| kva sa duṣṭo yayau pāpī vidhvaṃsayati kanyakām | rudatī sā vrīḍayā svapitaraṃ prāha cārajāḥ ||73 || rājñā daṇḍena cāgatya vāryamāṇena cāsakṛt | balādanāthā rudatī nītāhamīdṛśīṃ daśām ||74|| etacchrutvā hyupaspṛśya śuciḥ śukraḥ śaśāpa tam | yasmāttenāvinātena mamājñāṃ mama gauravam ||75|| tiraskṛtya śubhācārā cyutadharmārajāḥ kṛtā | tasmāt sarāṣṭraḥ sabalaḥ sabhṛtyo vāhanaiḥ saha ||76|| satarātrāntarād bhasma daṇḍo bhavatu sānugaḥ | śukraḥ putrīṃ tataḥ prāha śuddhācārāṃ tapasvinīm ||77|| māsānte tvāgate rājasvalye śuddhā bhaviṣyasi | tāvat tapaḥ kuru putri yatheṣṭaṃ cocitaṃ tava ||78|| na te doṣo’sti vai putri garbhaste na bhaviṣyati | piba coṣṇaṃ pañcagavyaṃ mā bhayaṃ kuru putrike |||79|| atha daṇḍo’pi nṛpatiḥ sarāṣṭrabalavāhanaḥ | bhasmībhūto’bhavat śāpātsaptarātrāntare’sura ||2.50.80 || evaṃ bhasmasthalaṃ jātaṃ daṇḍakāraṇyamulbaṇam | evaṃ parakalatrāṇi dharṣayanti tu ye janāḥ ||81|| bhasmībhavanti te sarve sarāṣṭrabalavāhanāḥ | dharmaśīlā vinītāśca nyāyamārgā hi nirbhayāḥ ||82|| prasahya paradārasthāścehāmutra na nirbhayāḥ | dharmānvito ravirdharmaḥ patnīvrataśca bhūsuraḥ ||83|| agastyaśca manuḥ svayaṃprakāśo’nye munīśvarāḥ| tejasvinaḥ śāpamokṣavarakṣamāḥ surārcitāḥ ||84|| adharmasthāścandradevendrāndhakā duḥkhino’bhavan | tasmāddharmo na santyājyo dharmo hi paramā gatiḥ |||85||| tāraṇaṃ paramo dharmaḥ patanaṃ tvanayād bhavet | tasmāt tyājyaṃ balānnityaṃ paradāropasevanam ||86|| nayanti paradārāstu mahāpattīrhi dāruṇāḥ| parārthaparadārasthā narakārhā sadā matāḥ ||87||| tasmādvai dūratastyājyāḥ paradārā vicakṣaṇaiḥ | paradārahataprajñā na bhavanti vibhūtaye ||88|| śṛṇu dūta kathāṃ cānyāṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ | ityuktvā nāradaḥ prāha kathāṃ divyāṃ purātanīm ||89|| viśvakarmasutā sādhvī nāmnā citrāṃgadābhavat | rūpayauvanasampannā kamalā padminī yathā ||2.50.90 || sā snātuṃ naimiṣe kṣetre sakhīyuktā jagāma ha | snāntī dadarśa surathaḥ sudevatanayo nṛpaḥ ||9 1|| sāpi tvabhūt sakāmāti svapradānamiyeṣa ca | sakhyastāmabruvan bāle naitad yogyaṃ hi jāyate |||92|| asvātantryaṃ tavāstyatra pradāne svātmanaḥ pare | pitā kuryāt sutādānaṃ sutā pitṛvaśe yataḥ ||93|| na te yuktamihātmānaṃ dātuṃ narapateḥ svayam | etasminnantare rājā surathaḥ kāmapīḍitaḥ ||94|| uvācenāṃ madirākṣi mugdhe mohayasīva mām | tanmāṃ kucatale talpe’bhiśāyayitumarhasi ||95|| tataḥ sā kāmasantaptā prārthitā bhūbhṛtā muhuḥ | vāryamāṇā sakhībhistu prādādātmānamātmanā ||96|| ātmā pradattaḥ svātantryāt tatastā tādṛśīṃ sutām | pitaraṃ cāvamanyaiva kāmagāmaśapat pitā ||97|| yato dharmaṃ parityajya śrībhāvāt mūrkhabhūbhṛte | ātmā pradattastasmātte vivāho na bhaviṣyati ||98|| vivāharahitā naiva sukhaṃ lapsyasi bhartṛtaḥ | na ca putraphalaṃ naiva patinā yogameṣyasi ||99|| utsṛṣṭamātre śāpe tu hyapovāha sarasvatī | akṛtārthaṃ narapatiṃ yojanāni trayodaśa || 2.50.10 0|| apakṛṣṭe narapatau sāpyanirvṛttakāmanā | mūrchāyāṃ patitā tatra tadā sakhyo jalena tām || 10 1|| siṣicuḥ śaityamāpannā kṣaṇāntare’tiduḥkhitā | mṛtakalpā hatotsāhā saṃjñāṃ lebhe śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 1 02|| apaśyantīṃ narapatiṃ dudrāva vegatastadā | nipapāta sarasvatyā muhyamānā taraṃgakaiḥ || 103 || nirgatā sā mahāraṇye siṃhavyāghrasamākule | tāmapaśyad guhyakaśca ninye śrīyamunātaṭe || 1 04|| tatra cikṣepa ca bhuktvā jale śrīkṛṣṇasannidhau | sā nirgatya śironamrā madhyāhne saṃsthitābhavat || 1
