raktabījā hi rākṣasāḥ | nāvamāruhya te sūkṣmabījānyabhakṣayaṃstadā || 16|| tadbhakṣaṇāt samutpannā bālakā ārabījakāḥ | bālikāśca tathā jātā ārabījyaḥ suyauvanāḥ || 17|| teṣu sarveṣu jāteṣu naukāpyadṛśyatāṃ gatā | raktabījaprajāḥ sarvā ārabījāhvayāśca tāḥ || 18|| kāmarūpadharā vyomavihārāśca nirāśrayāḥ | uḍḍīya jaladheḥ pṛthvyāṃ nivāsām̐ścāpyamārgayan || 1 9|| yatrāsmākaṃ bhaved vāso jalaṃ ca parito bhavet | tatparitaśca pṛthivī bhaveccāpi vanādikam ||2.58.20|| raṇamaraṇyamanujā bījapuṣpaphalāni ca | gahvarāṇi vicitrāṇi bhaveyuryatra sarvataḥ ||21 || tatra vastavyamasmābhiriti matvā ca tādṛśam | bhūtalaṃ raktabījairhi tatprajābhiśca sarvathā ||22|| ārabījaiḥ svīkṛtaṃ sadbhūtalaṃ dvīpakalpakam | raktabījo mahān rājā matsyabījodbhavaḥ purā ||23 || tatprajānāṃ tadā jātastatastadudbhavo nṛpaḥ | ārabījo mahān rājābhavad devavirodhakṛt || 24|| taṃ hatvā yamarājastu rājyaṃ nijānugāya vai | aravāya dadau samyagṛṣīṇāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca ||25|| raktabījo hato yuddhe yamalokaṃ jagāma ha | tatra karmabhogān kaśyapasyaurasaḥ sutaḥ ||26|| danorgabhasamudbhūto dhundhunāmā bhaviṣyati | brahmāṇaṃ tapasārādhya surāvadhyatvameṣyati ||27|| svargaṃ vijeṣyati drāk ca svayaṃ śakro bhaviṣyati | āsuraṃ tu tadā rājyaṃ bhaviṣyati triviṣṭape ||28|| tridaśā brahmalokaṃ ca gamiṣyantyasya vai bhayāt | dhundhurvakṣyati daityām̐śca bho daityā hi kathaṃ vayam || 29||| vrajema satyalokaṃ saṃvijetuṃ tridaśādikān | daityā niśamya vakṣyanti na no gatirhi tatra vai ||2.58.3 0|| ito loko mahaścāste maharṣigaṇasevitaḥ | yoṣāṃ dṛṣṭryā ca dahyanti daityāḥ saroṣakekṣaṇaiḥ ||3 1 || tataḥ paro janaloko janā devā vasantyatha | tatastapastataḥ satyo yatra brahmaparā sthitāḥ ||32|| yoṣāṃ vedadhvaniṃ śrutvā vikasanti surādayaḥ | saṃkocamasurā yānti ye ca teṣāṃ sadharmiṇaḥ ||33|| tasmānmā tvaṃ mahābāho tatra gantuṃ samādadhaḥ | vairājyabhavanaṃ kṣubdho durārohaṃ tu dānavaiḥ || 34|| teṣāṃ tu vacanaṃ śrutvā dhundhurdaityān pravakṣyati | gantukāmaḥ sa sadanaṃ brahmaṇo jetumīśvarān || 39|| kena tu karmaṇā, kathaṃ gamyate, tatra dānavāḥ | indraḥ kathaṃ prayātyeva daivāḥ prayānti vai katham ||36 || vadatātra ca me daityāḥ kurmā vayaṃ tu tattathā | tato daityaguruḥ śukraḥ kathayiṣyati sādhanam ||37|| sahasrākṣaḥ śataṃ caikaṃ yajñānāmayajat purā | śreṣṭhānāṃ vājimedhānāṃ tena brahmasadogatiḥ ||38|| śukravākyaṃ niśamyātha yajñān sa vai kariṣyati | śukramāmantrya ca daityān dānavān vasudhāṃ prati ||39|| gamiṣyati saricchreṣṭhā devikāṃ siddhidāṃ tataḥ | saṃvidhāsyati yajñāṃśca bhārgavaiḥ śukraśiṣyakaiḥ ||2.58.40|| yajñabhāgabhujastatra svarbhānupramukhāstadā | bhaviṣyanti hayatrātāgnidhūmāsura eva ca ||41|| vicariṣyati pṛthvyāṃ ca gandho yāsyati vai divam | ghrātvā devā viṣaṇṇāśca pravakṣyanti tu vedhasam ||42|| savedhaso gamiṣyanti kṣīrasthaṃ parameśvaram | vijñaptiṃ ca kariṣyanti śrūyatāṃ vai janārdana ||43|| dhundhunāmāsurapatirbalavān balasaṃvṛtaḥ | trailokyādhipatiścāste nastrātā naiva vidyate ||44|| sāmprataṃ brahmalokasthānapi jetuṃ samudyataḥ | śukrasya matamādāya yajate ca śatakratūn ||45|| āroḍhumicchati satyalokaṃ jetuṃ ca vedhasam | tasmādakālahīnaṃ ca cintayasva pareśvara ||46 || upāyaṃ yajñanāśe ca yena syāma sunirvṛtāḥ | śrutvā vakṣyati bhagavān yūyaṃ gacchatha ketanam ||47|| gacchāmyahaṃ vijetuṃ tamityuktvā ca gamiṣyati | bhagavān vāmano bhūtvā snāsyati devikājale ||48|| patiṣyati devikāyā jale yajñasya sannidhau | kṣaṇānmajjam̐stathaunmajjan jalaceṣṭāṃ kariṣyati ||49|| yajñīyāśca nimajjatītyevaṃ matvā drutaṃ ca tam | uddhartuṃ ca prayāsyanti samuddhārya taṭasthitam ||2.58.50|| vāmanaṃ taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca prakṣyanti dhundhuṛtvijaḥ | kastvaṃ kasmāt samāyātaḥ kathaṃ kiṃ te prayojanam ||5 1 || tadā vakṣyati vipraḥ sa duḥkhyahaṃ gṛhavarjitaḥ | mama pitā prabhāsākhyo gotreṇāpi tu vāruṇaḥ ||52|| mama bhrātā netrabhāso gatibhāso’hameva ca | ramyaṃ cāvasathaṃ tyaktvā pitā nau ca mṛtastataḥ ||53|| varṣānte cāgrajaścokto vibhajāma gṛhaṃ ca nau | tenoktau naiva bhavato vidyate bhāga ityaham ||54|| kubjavāmanakhañjānāṃ klībānāṃ śvitriṇāmapi | unmattānāṃ tathāndhānāṃ dāyabhāgo na vidyate ||55|| priyaṃ vākyaṃ gṛhe vāso bhojanācchādanādikam | etāvad dīyate tebhyo dāyabhāgaharā na te ||56|| tataḥ kleśena mahatā niṣkāsito’smi tadgṛhāt | yajñaṃ śrutvā samāyāto snātuṃ jale praveśavān ||57|| nimajjito yataścāhaṃ na jāne hyavatāraṇam | ke bhavanto’tra samprāptāḥ sasnehā bāndhavā yathā ||58||| ko’yaṃ śakrapratikāśo yuṣmanmadhye vibhāsate | anukampāṃ prakurvantu yadyāśrayo’tra labhyate ||59|| iti vai vāmanavākyaṃ śrutvā viprāśca dhundhukam | pravakṣyanti ca dānārthaṃ dhundhurdāsyati śobhanam ||2.58.60|| śrīmadāvasathaṃ dāsī ratnāni vividhāni ca | sarvopaskarayogām̐śca dāsān gā vāhanāni ca ||6 1 || hiraṇyaṃ syandanānaśvān gajān tathāpi vāmanaḥ | na grahīṣyati vibhavān sādhudharmaṃ vadam̐stadā ||62|| dāsīrdāsām̐śca bhṛtyām̐śca gṛhaṃ ratnaṃ paricchadān | tyaktvā padatrayaṃ bhūmyāsanaṃ setsyati vai tadā ||63|| dhundhurdāsyati bhūbhāgaṃ padatrayaṃ yadā tataḥ | vairājarūpamāsthāya padaikena mahīmimām ||64|| dvitīyena kaṭāhaṃ ca tṛtīyena ca dānavam | grahīṣyati haristaṃ ca pātāle’dho nayiṣyati ||65|| devebhyaśca nijaṃ rājyaṃ datvādṛśyo bhaviṣyati | punarbalervardhitasya rājyaṃ kharvo hariṣyati ||66|| atha dhundhurandhakasya sāhāyyaṃ ca kariṣyati | andhakasya mahāyuddhaṃ śaṃkareṇa bhaviṣyati ||67|| śukrācāryaṃ tadā śaṃbhurmukhe prakṣipya codare | dhṛtvā punaśca śiśnena tadā niṣkāsayiṣyati ||68|| śukrarūpaḥ śukranāmnā śaṃbhoḥ putro bhaviṣyati | athendhakena yoddhu ca mahendro’pi gamiṣyati ||69|| mūrdhni vajraṃ paribhrāmyāndhakaṃ yadā haniṣyati | andhakasya śirasyeva vajraṃ cūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati ||2.58.70|| vahnistasmai tadā śaktiṃ dāsyatyeva bhayaṃkarām | tathā ca devagandharvā rathaṃ dāsyanti svastikam ||71|| śamīkasya ṛṣeḥ patnī bālaṃ tadā tu bhūtale | pṛthivyāṃ kampamānāyāṃ sthāpayiṣyati vai tadā ||72|| bālau dvāvekataścaiva bhaviṣyatastadā tayoḥ | eko vai mātalirnāmā gamiṣyati mahendrakam ||73|| tadā sa sārathirbhūtvā sāhāyyaṃ ca kariṣyati | rudrastadā mahendraśca tathānye devatāḥ saha ||74|| mārayiṣyantyaṃdhakaṃ ca śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ | śaṃkarasya lalāṭordhvād gadāghātena bindavaḥ ||75|| raktasyāpi patiṣyanti bhaviṣyanti ca bhairavāḥ | vidyārājo rudrarājaścaṇḍaḥ pracaṇḍa ityapi ||76|| kapālyekakapālī ca tathā lalitarājakaḥ | vighnarājo’ṣṭamaścāpi bhairavāste tadodbhavāḥ ||77|| lalāṭaphalakācchaṃbhoḥ kanyāścaikā bhaviṣyati | carccikā nāmataḥ sādhvī hiṅgulādrinivāsinī ||78|| athāndhakaṃ mārayitvā bhṛṃgināmagaṇaṃ svakam | kariṣyati śaṃkarastaṃ tato dhundhurbhayānvitaḥ ||79|| pātālaṃ yāsyati śīghraṃ tataḥ kālāntare punaḥ | baleḥ sāhāyyatāṃ yadā kariṣyati tadā hariḥ ||2.58.80 || sudarśanena ca dhundhuṃ mārayiṣyati jīvataḥ | ityevaṃ kathitaṃ rādhe raktabījakathānakam ||8 1 || śrīrādhikovāca kathaṃ kṛṣṇa jalamatsyo viṣṇucakreṇa ghātitaḥ | pavitratāṃ gato naiva yadvaṃśe rākṣasā yataḥ ||82|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca viṣṇucakraparicchinno jalamatsyastu rādhike | gatapāpo’bhavacchīghraṃ svarge mahendratāṃ gataḥ ||83|| ādyaḥ sa eva saṃkalpajanyo’bhūd devatāpatiḥ | ādyayugapravṛttyarthaṃ tataḥ pṛthvyāmavātarat ||84|| viṣṇubhakto’bhavalloke suvarṇāṃgadaviśrutaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto’timānavaḥ ||85|| tato dhāma yayau divyaṃ paraṃ kṛṣṇasya rādhike | atha ye raktabījāśca ārabījādayastathā ||86|| te sarve bījahantāraḥ sṛṣṭyādau cābhavan yataḥ | satyavratasya śāpena rākṣasatvamapāgatāḥ ||87|| ādibījaprahantāraścālabhyavastunāśakāḥ | mahāpāpātipāpāste yato vaṃśavināśakāḥ ||88|| vicāryetthaṃ tadā rājā śaśāpaitān vighātakān | bījaghātaprakartāraścāsurā vai bhaviṣyatha ||89|| ityevamāsurā jātā yataścāsurabhāvanāḥ | pakṣyaṇḍānāṃ kalalāderbhakṣakā rākṣasā hi te || 2.58.90|| paśubījaprahantāro rajovīryavināśakāḥ | bījakośaprahantārastāmasāste’surā matāḥ ||91|| alabhyabījaghāte tu mahat pāpaṃ prajāyate | prathamaṃ pārvatī devī śaṃkarasya samāgame ||92|| bījalabdheravasare devairvighnavatī kṛtā | śaśāpa dayitā sādhvī duḥkhitenāntarātmanā ||93 || devā me garbhavāñcchāyā ghātakāḥ svārthasiddhaye | bījadāne ghātakā vai yato jātā haraṃ prati ||94|| aputrāhamagarbhāhaṃ kṛtā yuṣmābhirityataḥ | bhavanto’pi hyaputrāśca bhavatpatnyo’pyagarbhikāḥ ||95|| anapatyāḥ sadā santu iti devān śaśāpa sā | tasmādvai rādhike pāpaṃ prathamaṃ bījaghātanam || 96|| tato’pyadhikapāpaṃ ca striyā vai ṛtughātanam | tato’pyatyadhikaṃ pāpaṃ garbhahatyā prakathyate ||97|| sarvebhyaścolbaṇaṃ pāpaṃ bālakasya vināśanam | sadyo vivāhitayośca ghātanaṃ pāpakoṭikam ||98|| sagarbhāghātanaṃ pāpaṃ pāpakoṭyarbudādhikam | asamāpte tu mithune ghātanaṃ sṛṣṭighātajam ||99|| pāpaṃ vai jāyate tasmād bījaghnā noddharanti vai | brahmacārivrataṃ tasmāt puṇyadaṃ mokṣadaṃ matam || 2.58.100 || yatra bījaṃ na hanyeta rakṣyate tu svabhāvataḥ | rakṣaṇasya mahatpuṇyaṃ dharmeṇāpi pradānakam || 101 || mahat puṇyaṃ svayaṃ brahmā viṣṇuḥ śivo jaguḥ sadā | ityevaṃ rādhike coktaṃ rākṣasatve hi kāraṇam || 1 02||| bījaghnānāṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo dṛṣṭeḥ pathaṃ prayāti na | yamadvārā vināśaśca teṣāṃ karitavān prabhuḥ || 1 03|| ṛtudānaṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ suroditam | vaṃśadānaṃ cātipuṇyaṃ vaṃśakṛtāṃ prakīrtitam || 1 04|| nirvaṃśā noddharantyeva saṃsārābdhi taranti na | savaṃśāḥ pitarastṛptāḥ samuddharanti sāgarāt || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne raktabījārabījādyasurotpattirdhundhudaityotpattirbījanāśātmakapātakamityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || |58 ||
<2.59> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike caitre vyatīte’tha dvitīyakam | caritraṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaiva pramokṣadam || 1 || bhālladeśa iti khyāto deśo vaiṣṇavasatkṛtaḥ | dhavalaṃ nāma nagaraṃ khyātaṃ sthānīyamuttamam || 2 || tasmin vipaṇivṛttistho godhanākhyo’bhavad vaṇika | dhanapūrṇo buddhimām̐śca kalākauśalyapāragaḥ || 3 || sa kadācinnijād rāṣṭrāt saurāṣṭraṃ gantumudyataḥ | viśālasārthasampanno bahupaṇyādisaṃbhṛtaḥ || 4 || gacchatastasya vai rātrau caurāṇāṃ saṃgamo’bhavat | jalahīne śuṣkabhāge jālikaikatarau sthale || 5 || tataḥ sa hṛtasarvasvo vaṇik śokāturaḥ sadā | bhramannitastato yāyājjālikāvṛkṣasannidhau || 6 || mṛgaiśca pakṣibhiḥ kīṭairvarjitāṃ vīkṣya jālikām | kṣāntaḥ kṣuttṛṭśuṣkakaṇṭho vṛkṣapārśvamupāgamat || 7 || upāviveśa ca supto viśrānto viśramo’bhavat | madhyāhne cotthito yāvattāvat pretaṃ dadarśa saḥ || 8 || śataiḥ pretairvṛtaṃ pretairuhyamānaṃ sukhāsane | āgacchadbhirjālikāyāstaruṃ pretaiḥ samantataḥ || 9 || yatrāsīt sa vaṇikputrastaṃ ca vṛkṣaṃ samāgataḥ | pretarājo dadarśainaṃ vaṇikputraṃ sthirāntaram || 2.59.10 || svāgataṃ kṛtavān preto vaṇik cāpi tathākarot | kuśalaṃ sarvamābhāṣya cābhivādya parasparam || 11 || vaṇikpretau copaviṣṭau chāyāyāṃ sukhatastataḥ | pretādhipatinā pṛṣṭaṃ kuta āgamyate vaṇik || 1 2|| kva vāso vidyate kutra gamiṣyasi sthalāditaḥ | kathaṃ cedaṃ nirjanaṃ ca sthalaṃ tvayā samāśritam || 1 3|| itipṛṣṭo vaṇik prāha dhanayukto’pyahaṃ vane | caurairhṛtadhano jātaḥ paryaṭāmyatiduḥkhitaḥ || 14||| vaṇigduḥkhena tu pretaḥ kṣaṇaṃ vai duḥkhito’bhavat | svabandhumiva vaṇijaṃ prāha śokaṃ tu mā kuru || 15|| bhūyo’pyarthā bhaviṣyanti yadi bhāgyabalaṃ tava | bhāgyakṣaye’rthāḥ kṣīyante bhavantyabhyudaye punaḥ || 16 || kṣīṇasyāsya śarīrasya cintayā nodayo bhavet | abhyudayaśca patanaṃ ravernityaṃ prajāyate || 17|| vṛkṣāṇāṃ śuṣkatā cāpi punaḥ pallavitāpi ca | pakṣe tejasvitā candre pakṣe tejaḥkṣayastathā || 18|| nadīnāṃ śuṣkatā grīṣme varṣāyāṃ jalapūrṇatā | kṣetrāṇāṃ sasyasampattiḥ kvacit sasyavihīnatā || 1 9|| netraṃ mlānaṃ sanidraṃ tu kvacitpadmadalotsavam | gaganaṃ cāvilaṃ kāle kāle nirmalamujjvalam ||2.59.20 || pradīpo rātrau jvalati divā tejaḥ karoti na | kvacid rājā kvacicchreṣṭhī kvacit kaiṃkaryavān bhavet || 21 || kvacicchāstā kvacicchāsyaḥ kvacit koṭidvayojjhitaḥ | kvacillakṣmīpatiḥ śrīmān kvacillakṣmīvivarjitaḥ || 22|| bālye tu dehinaḥ sarve naisargādaparigrahāḥ | yauvane tṛṣṇayā vyāptā vārdhakye śaktivarjitāḥ ||23|| kālavegena jāyante karmaṇā prāktanena ca | pūrvaṃ yasmād dhanaṃ prāptamṛṇātmakaṃ yato yataḥ ||24|| tebhyo dattaṃ na paścādvai tadṛṇaṃ saha gacchati | dātāraste sutāḥ putrāḥ patnyaḥ kuṭumbinastathā ||25 || rājā bhṛtyāḥ sevakāśca bhavantyevarṇabandhanāt | caurarūpāśca vā bhūtvā prasahya praharanti ca ||26 || na dattaṃ na ca bhuktaṃ vai paryāptaṃ cāpi cārjitam | vardhayate prayatnena tadvilopaṃ samīhate ||27|| dravyaṃ hasati dravyeśaṃ mṛṣā dravyeśatā tava | yogye vinimayaḥ sattā sā kṛtā na tvayā yataḥ ||28|| maraṇaṃ sannidhau cāste śreṣṭhin tyaktvā gamiṣyasi | tatastaveśatā dravye dravyeśatā na vai tvayi ||29|| aho lobhasya māhātmyaṃ saptavaṃśottaraṃ dhanam | vidyate yasya keśe’pi punaḥ sañcetumicchati ||2.59.30|| arjane tu paraṃ duḥkhaṃ kaiṃkaryādisamudbhavam | rakṣaṇe’pi paraṃ duḥkhaṃ cintā vyāghrī pravalgati ||3 1 || vyaye’pi kṣayaduḥkhaṃ ca bhoge duḥkhaṃ ca rogitā | garve duḥkhaṃ ca yuddhādi mṛtyurdravye prajāyate ||32|| tasmād duḥkhaṃ dhanaṃ proktaṃ yad dharmārthaṃ na yujyate | dhane dharme niyukte tu dharmāt sukhaṃ na duḥkhitā ||33 || dharmācchāntirdharmayogāt tṛṣṇānāśo vivekitā | yathālabdhe ca santoṣo devasevādivartanam ||34|| kuṭumbe sattvabhāvaśca rāgadveṣādiśūnyatā | caurādibhayaviraho nidrāpi sukhato bhavet ||35|| evaṃvidhā guṇāḥ śreṣṭhin nirdhanatve sukhāvahāḥ | sadhanatve duḥkhadoṣāḥ prajāyante punaḥ punaḥ ||36|| tatra nāsti mahāścaryaṃ gatāgatābdhivārivat | dhanaṃ tu cañcalaṃ sarvaṃ lakṣmīḥ sadā hi cañcalā ||37|| jīvanaṃ cañcalaṃ cāpi mā śokaṃ kuru vaibhave | bhāgyāt sarvaṃ punaścāpi yatato vai bhaviṣyati || 38|| ityuccārya samāhūya preto bhṛtyān samabravīt | adyātithirayaṃ śreṣṭhī gṛhesmākamupāgataḥ ||39 || bālamitraṃ mama pūjyaḥ sahajo deśajo mama | asmin dṛṣṭaṃ ca manye’haṃ dṛṣṭavānnijabāndhavān ||2.59.40 || asmin samāgate jātā prītirmamātulādya vai | ityuktvā ca prasasmāra preto bhojanamuttamam ||41 || tāvattasya samāyātā sthālī navā dṛḍhā śubhā | miṣṭānnena tu sampūrṇā dadhyodanayutāpi ca ||42|| śākasūpāranālādisampūrṇā bhojanāya vai | tathā navā dṛḍhā śītajalabhṛtā ca hāṇḍikā ||43|| vāridhānīṃ tathā sthālīṃ vīkṣya preteśvarastadā | prāhottiṣṭha vaṇigvarya prakṣālaya karau mukham ||44|| ityuktvā salilaṃ dattvā nyaveśayacchubhāsane | pretarājo dadāvasmai miṣṭānnaṃ dadhi vāri ca ||45|| odanaṃ cāranālaṃ ca śākaṃ ca bubhuje vaṇik | prektebhyaḥ sa dadau sarvavidhaṃ pātreṣu patriṣu ||46|| pretā miṣṭānnamādyaṃ ca bhakṣayāmāsurādarāt | jalaṃ papustataḥ preteśvaro’pi śeṣameva tat| ||47|| bubhuje ca papau vāri tṛptāḥ sarve’bhavam̐stataḥ | sthālī ca vāridhānī ca śeṣānnamapi sarvathā ||48|| adṛśyatāṃ gataṃ tūrṇaṃ paśyato vaṇijastadā | etadadbhutamāścaryaṃ dṛṣṭvā papraccha vai vaṇik ||49|| eṣā sthālī cānnapūrṇā vāridhānī ca pūritā | araṇye’tra kathaṃ prāptā vada me pretapuṃgava ||2.59.50|| tathāpi tava bhṛtyāstu kṛśāḥ kathaṃ hi sarvathā | tvaṃ tu naivātipuṣṭo’si kathaṃ durbalatā vada ||91 || tāvat tatra śvetavastraṃ samāyātaṃ śubhaṃ navam | tadattaṃ ca vaṇije’tra pretena bhāvatastadā ||52|| āścaryaṃ cāpi tad dṛṣṭvā kuto vastraṃ samāgatam | papraccha ca vaṇik pretaṃ pretaḥ prāha yathātatham ||53|| ahamāsaṃ purā śreṣṭhin nagare dhavalāhvaye | vipro nāmnā prabhānāthaḥ sūpakāro’bhavaṃ sadā ||54|| mamāsti ca vaṇik śreṣṭhī dhanāḍhyo dharmavardhanaḥ | viṣṇubhakto yajamānaḥ svāmī dhanaprado mama |||55||| dharmavardhananāmāsau dharmakārye sadā sa mām | ājñāpayati dharmārthe vyayārthaṃ ca yathepsitam ||56|| dānārthaṃ copakārārthamakuṇṭhājñāṃ dadāti ca | so’haṃ kadaryo lubdhātmā dhane’pi sati puṣkale ||57|| na dadāmi tu devebhyo na viprebhyo na dānakam | nopakāraṃ kasyacicca karomyanāthadehinaḥ ||58|| yatīn sādhūn dharmaniṣṭhān gaṇayāmi na sarvathā | na cāśnāmi tṛptipūrṇaṃ lubdho’nyasya tu kā kathā ||59|| apuṇyasya hi nāśāntā vaibhavā iti niścitam | mamāpi na tathā puṇyaṃ tadāsīd bhuktavānnahi ||2.59.60|| pramādād yadi bhuñje’haṃ dadhikṣīraghṛtādikam | miṣṭānnaṃ vā miṣṭajalaṃ tadā śokaḥ prajāyate ||6 1 || aho’dya tu mayā vyartho vyayaḥ kṛto hi hānikṛt | nidrā rātrau na cāyāti vyayacintāparasya me ||62|| prātarbhavati caivaṃ me yadvā tadvā kathaṃcana | evametādṛśo lobhī nivasāmyatitṛṣṇakaḥ ||63|| tandūlatilapiṇyākatuṣaśākādibhojanaiḥ | kṣapayāmi kadānnādyairātmānaṃ kālanirgamaiḥ ||64|| evaṃ dravyayutasyāpi vinā dānaṃ ca puṇyakam | mahān kālo gato me tu sūryagrahaṇamāgatam ||65|| śravaṇadvādaśī prāptā māsi bhādrapade tathā | lokāḥ prayānti tīrthārthaṃ sābhramatyāṃ dine dine ||66|| ahaṃ ca śreṣṭhinā sākaṃ hyekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ | gatavān sābhramatyāṃ tu snātuṃ tvekādaśīdināt ||67|| yāvat sūryagrahaḥ syācca tāvat tīrthe sthiro’bhavam | ekādaśīdināttena śreṣṭhinā koṭiśo dhanam ||68|| vastrāṇi śreṣṭhapātrāṇi gāvaścetyapi dānakam | dattaṃ yathābalaṃ tatra mayā dṛṣṭvātilajjayā ||69|| dhautraṃ caikaṃ navaṃ dattaṃ viprāya vedavedine | navā sthālī cānnapūrṇā miṣṭapūrṇā samarpitā ||2.59.70|| dadhyodanāranālādyaiḥ śākena saṃyutā tathā | jaladhānī tadā dattā yānaṃ dattaṃ tu kāṣṭhajam ||71|| chāyārthaṃ tu tadā chatraṃ dattaṃ viprāya vai tadā | śreṣṭhino bhṛtyavargāśca viprārthaṃ yojitā mayā ||72||| etāvanmātrakaṃ mayā vaṇigvarya tadārpitam | nānyat kiñcit pradattaṃ tu mayāyutasamāsvapi ||73 || atha kālāntare mṛtyugato’haṃ pretatāṃ gataḥ | amī cādattadānā vai maddattānnopajīvinaḥ ||74|| bhṛtyāstasya godhanākhyavaṇijo madvaśānugāḥ | kāṣṭhayānamidaṃ prāptaṃ prāptā bhṛtyāśca te mayā ||75|| prāptā miṣṭānnasaṃyuktā sthālī jalasya hāṇḍikā | dattaṃ tadidamāyāti madhyāhne’pi dine dine ||76|| yāvannāhaṃ tu bhuñje’nnaṃ na tāvallayameti ca | mayi bhukte ca pīte ca sarvaṃ līnaṃ prajāyate ||77|| chatradānādayaṃ vṛkṣo nityaṃ prāpto’sti vai mayā | vāsārthaṃ nivasāmyatra pretāḥ kurvanti sevanām ||78|| idaṃ tavoktaṃ sarvaṃ ca dāne nirodhakṛd yathā | ahaṃ purābhavaṃ tena pāpena pretatāṃ gataḥ ||79|| lobhena tṛṣṇayā cāpi vipro’haṃ pretatāṃ gataḥ | ekavārapradattena jalānnena hi bhujyate ||2.59.80|| pratyahaṃ tvekavāraṃ hi datvā bhuñje hi nityadā | nityadānapradātustu svargaṃ vai śāśvataṃ bhavet ||81| atha śreṣṭhin tava me’pi hitaṃ karomi sarvathā | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre cāśvapaṭṭasarovare ||82|| lomaśasyāśrame tatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇālaye | yāhi śīghraṃ vaṇik tatra snānaṃ ca havanaṃ kuru ||83|| mama nāma samuddiśya piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kuru | tatra piṇḍapradānena pretabhāvādahaṃ kṣaṇāt ||84|| muktaḥ san dāna kartṝṇāṃ prayāsyāmi salokatām | tithistvekādaśī puṇyā śuklā bhādraprade śubhā ||85|| budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā sātiśreyaskarī mama | athavā kartikakṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ śrāddhaṃ kuruṣva me ||86|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprākaṭyavāsare | avaśyaṃ ca tadā mokṣo mama bhāvī vibhāvaya ||87|| ityuktvā pradadau tasmai suvarṇaṃ hīrakādikam | skandhe kṛtvā vaṇijaṃ taṃ tatyāja ca surāṣṭrakam ||88|| ekādaśyāṃ bhādrapade yayāvaśvasarovaram | piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ tatra pretānāmanupūrvakam ||89|| cakārātha svabandhūnāṃ pitṛṇāṃ tadanantaram | ātmanaśca tathā samyaṅ mahacchrāddhaṃ tilairvinā ||2.59.90|| piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ cakre tathānyānapi gotrajān | mokṣayāmāsa sarvān vai śrāddhadānādibhirvaṇik ||9 1 || karmamuktāstu tai sarve āyayustatra sannidhau | divyarūpā divyaveṣāḥ sūryatejo’tivarculāḥ |||92|| vaṇik tebhyo jalaṃ tatra dadau miṣṭānnabhojanam | tatastān divyadehām̐śca nināya lomaśāśramam ||93|| lomaśastām̐stadā mantraṃ śrāvayāmāsa vaiṣṇavam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||94|| dadau tebhyaśca tulasīsrajaśca ca caraṇāmṛtam | tato vaṇig yayau nītvā saha sarvān pramocitān ||95|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasaudhaṃ sukānakam | te’pi sarve natā nārāyaṇaṃ pupūjurādarāt || 96|| kṛṣṇapādajalaṃ pītvā babhūvurmuktakoṭikāḥ | divyayāne samāruhya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇājñayā || 97|| yayurgolokasaṃjñaṃ ca tato dhāmākṣaraṃ param | athāyaṃ tu vaṇig rādhe nijasthānaṃ tato gataḥ ||98|| dhavalākhye pure tatrābhajat kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | bhaktiṃ tu navadhā kṛtvā kāladharmamupeyivān || 99|| devo bhūtvā ca gandharvo guhyakaścāpi vai tataḥ | virāḍ rājā tato bhūtvā paro bhāgavato hi saḥ || 2.59.100 || bheje’nādiparabrahmaśrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | dehānte sa harerdhāma yayau stutvā punaḥ punaḥ || 10 1|| ityevaṃ kathito rādhe camatkāro hareryathā | darśanānmuktimāpannāḥ pretā divyaśarīriṇaḥ || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bhādraikādaśyāmaśvapaṭṭasarovare śrāddhena pretānāṃ muktiḥ pretavaṇiksaṃvādaścetinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 59 ||
<2.60> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca api rādhe śṛṇu tvanyaṃ camatkāraṃ harestadā | udayākhyo’bhavad rājā dhārmiko devapūjakaḥ || 1 || aravalyadribhūbhāge rājyaṃ yasya mahattamam | udayākhyaṃ pattanaṃ ca rājadhānī hyabhūcchubhā || 2 || rājā vrataṃ paraṃ cakre cāturmāsyaikabhojanam | nityaṃ dānaṃ viprasādhubhojanaṃ dhenusevanam || 3 || anāthabālasādhvībhyaścānnavastrasamarpaṇam | vidyādāne tathā dravyaṃ devālayeṣu saddhanam || 4 || havanaṃ sarvadā prātarbrāhmaṃ sāyaṃ jalāplavam | evaṃ vrate sukurvāṇe śrāvaṇe māsi sarvathā || 5 || icchā tasyābhavat snātuṃ māsamekaṃ sarovare | yathāvāṣāḍhamāse’sau dhīravīrasarovaram || 6 || parimeyānugo rājā āryāyanaṛṣervane | āśrame ca nijāvāsaṃ cakāra saritastaṭe || 7 || śrāvaṇe nityamevāsau prātarutthāya satvaram | nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya dhyātvā śrīviṣṇumacyutam || 8 || snātvā sampūjya ca lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ prabhāpatim | pārvatīsvāminaṃ rādheśvaraṃ sampūjya bhāvataḥ || 9 || tataścāryāyanaṛṣeḥ pūjāṃ karoti nityaśaḥ | atha paścāt sadāyāti tīrthāni draṣṭumeva saḥ || 2.60.1 0|| satītīrthaṃ śaṃbhutīrthaṃ cakratīrthaṃ tataḥ param | kṛṣṇatīrthaṃ svāmitīrthaṃ mañjulātīrthamityapi || 11 || sūryatīrthaṃ cendratīrthaṃ brahmatīrthaṃ tataḥ param | muktatīrtham ṛṣitīrthaṃ dharmatīrthaṃ jalāśrayam || 12|| evamādīni tīrthāni kṛtvā sarovare’bhitaḥ | pradakṣiṇaṃ saraḥ kṛtvā datvā dānāni sarvaśaḥ || 1 3|| svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ cāmbarāṇi pātrāṇi vividhāni ca | bhojyāni cānnadānāni tato yāti nijāśrayam || 14|| evaṃ kṛtvā tato homaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ karoti ca | viprānṛṣīn satīḥ sādhvīḥ sādhūn bālānanāthakān || 15|| vibhajyānnānyatithīm̐śca bhojayitvānugānapi | tato bhuṃkte svayaṃ rājā natvā tvāryāyanamṛṣim || 16|| evaṃ puṇyapratāpena rājñaḥ pūrvakṛtāni ca | yāni kānyapi pāpāni dagdhānyeva samantataḥ || 17|| puṇyapuñjo’piṃ ca mahānasya kṛṣṇe’rpitastataḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaiva prasannatāsya śiṣyate || 18|| prasannatā mahat puṇyaṃ nānyat puṇyaṃ sa manyate | harikṛṣṇaḥ prasanno’bhūdāryāyanarṣihṛdgataḥ || 1 9|| ṛṣiḥ prāha ca rājānaṃ rājannehi mamāntike | gṛhāṇa paramaṃ mantraṃ yaddevaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 2.60.20|| rājā tadā ṛṣeragre upāviveśa tam ṛṣiḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 21 || iti mantraṃ dideśāpi srajaṃ ca taulasīṃ tathā | tato’nugānapi mantramāha cāryāyano muniḥ || 22|| mantraṃ labdhvā ṛṣiṃ natvā rājā sahānugo gṛham | yayau tatra nadītīre svoṭajāyāmupāviśat ||23 || tāvat tatrāgato bālo muralīkaraśobhitaḥ | rādhayā prabhayā lakṣmyā pāravatyā ca sevitaḥ ||24|| rūparūpānurūpādhimūrtiḥ śrībhagavān svayam | hasan muhustathā kāntā hāsayan raṅgapūritaḥ ||25|| divyo divyasvarūpābhiḥ patnībhiḥ parivāritaḥ | mayūrapicchakalgyāḍhyahaimamukuṭaśobhitaḥ || 26|| vahniśuddhāṃśukadharo divyabhūṣāvirājitaḥ | kare mīnadhvajasvastidhanuḥśūlādilakṣitaḥ || 27|| tatpārśve ca manāk dūraṃ lakṣmīśrīkambharā satī | pārśvāntare manāk dūraṃ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 28|| anyā dāsyastathā dāsāḥ parṇakuṭyāṃ samāgatāḥ | koṭikoṭayarkabhātulyaṃ tejastatra babhau sukham ||29 || rājā vilokya ruciraṃ mūrtau tatra sthiro’bhavat | neme netre ca sammilya tejovyāhataraśmiṇī ||2.60.3 0|| kṣaṇāntare samuddhāṭya yāvat paśyati keśavam | tāvadeko’bhavat kṛṣṇastanmūrtau śrīhariḥ svayam ||3 1|| darśayāmāsa saurāṣṭraṃ tathā kuṃkumavāpikām | aśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi tathā śrīlomaśāśramam || 3 2|| tathā śrīkambharālakṣmīṃ tathā gopālakṛṣṇakam | koṭyarbudābjakanyāśca tīrthānyapi ca sarvaśaḥ || 33 || evaṃ pradarśya bhagavān sarvaṃ līnaṃ cakāra ha | tataḥ svapādayostasmai darśayāmāsa vai kṣaṇāt || 34|| pātālaṃ ca tadūrdhvaṃ ca rasātalaṃ tataḥ param | mahātalaṃ jaṃghayośca jānvostalātalaṃ tataḥ || 35 || sutalaṃ corvadhobhāge sakthnośca vitalaṃ tataḥ | sakthimūle cātalaṃ ca tatratyān daityadānavān || 36 || sarpānnāgānanyajīvān nadīparvatabhūstarān | vibhūtīn darśayāmāsa śeṣaṃ ca kacchapaṃ tathā || 37|| kaṭyāṃ bhuvaṃ jaghane ca bhuvarlokaṃ tataḥ param | nābhyāṃ svargaṃ maharlokaṃ hyudare hṛdaye janam || 38 || tapolokaṃ mukhe satyaṃ lalāṭe’smai vyadarśayat | carmaṇi saptakānyevāvaraṇāni vyadarśayat || 39 || evaṃ pradarśya ca kṣaṇāllīnaṃ cakāra tattadā | athainaṃ darśayāmāsa vaiṣṇavaṃ rūpamātmanaḥ ||2.60.40 || sahasraśirasaṃ ramyaṃ sahasrakarapādakam | tatra vai pādayorenaṃ darśayāmāsa vai jalam ||4 1 || tejo vāyuṃ cāmbaraṃ ca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān | pādayorjalavaikuṇṭhaṃ vairājaṃ jaṃghayostathā ||42 | | jānvoścātha mahāviṣṇuṃ sakthnorbhūmānamityapi | sakthimūle pradhānaṃ ca puruṣaṃ śiśnake tathā ||43 || prakṛtiṃ jaghane nābhau vāsudevamadarśayat | kaṭyāṃ kālaṃ ca puruṣaṃ pārśve saṃkarṣaṇaṃ tathā ||44|| pārśvāntare ca pradyumnaṃ hyudare tvaniruddhakam | kukṣyorvaikuṇṭhagolokau vakṣasyanantadāsikāḥ ||486 | | rādhāramādiśaktīśca darśayāmāsa keśavaḥ | kaṇṭhe brahmasvarūpām̐śca muktān koṭyarbudābjakān ||46 || mukhe tvamṛtalokaṃ ca netrayorakṣaraṃ tathā | brahma pradarśayāmāsa lalāṭe tejasāṃ cayam ||47|| tatra śrīkambharālakṣmīṃ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakam | brahmarandhre paraṃ dhāma naijaṃ prādarśayaddhariḥ ||48 || tatra siṃhāsanaṃ divyaṃ sthitaṃ tasmin hariṃ tathā | sevamānaṃ ca taṃ tatra svaṃ rājā saṃvyalokayat ||49 || tataḥ punaśca tatsarvamadṛśyaṃ samajāyata | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre sthitaṃ taṃ bālarūpiṇam || 2.60.50 || dadarśa rājā śrīmantaṃ sevitaṃ koṭidehibhiḥ | tatrātmānaṃ nṛpaḥ punardadarśa nikaṭe sthitam ||5 1 || atha sarvaṃ kṣaṇāt līnaṃ nṛpastvāścaryamāptavān | tataḥ kṣaṇāntare naijoṭajāṃ dadarśa śobhanām ||52|| svastho bhūtvā diśo natvā tuṣṭāva dhyānasaṃsthitaḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīnivāsāya mūlaprakṛtiyāmine ||53 || ajitāya ca devāya mahātmane namo’stu te | anāśritāya śāntāya niḥspṛhāya namostu te ||54|| nama ādyāya devāya sarvadevamayāya ca | ārṣāyādisvarūpāya śrīkṛṣṇāya ca te namaḥ ||55|| anantarāya caikāya sadā vyaktāya te namaḥ | namo guptāya kāśāya guṇeśvarāya te namaḥ ||56|| atarkyāyāprameyāya cātulāya ca te namaḥ | niścintāya ca pūrvāya sanātanāya te namaḥ ||57|| purāṇāya namastasmai nirguṇāya namo’stu te | namo jagatpratiṣṭhāya brahmaniṣṭhāya te namaḥ ||58|| padmanābhāya yogāya govindāya namo namaḥ | namo’stu sāṃkhyavedyāya viśveśvarāya te namaḥ || 59 || haraye śivarakṣāya nārāyaṇāya te namaḥ | parātmane’mitadātre’mitakramāya te namaḥ | |2.60.6 0 || śārṅgacakragadāpadmaśāline te namo namaḥ | mahoragāya siṃhāya namo’stu vedavāsine || 61 || mahāmatsyāya kāntāya kacchapāya ca te namaḥ | vāmanāya ca dīrghāya caturbhujāya te namaḥ | |62 || siddhacāraṇagandharvasaṃstutāya namo namaḥ | acyutāya sakalāya nāgendraśayanāya ca ||6 3 || dugdhavarṇāya kṛṣṇāya hemābhāya namo namaḥ | pītāmbarāya daityādināśanāya ca te namaḥ ||64|| akṣarāyākṣareśāya nābhipadmāya te namaḥ | caturmukhāya devāya pañcavaktrāya te namaḥ || 65 || kṣīravāsāya yaśase kāntaye varadāya ca | sarveśvarāya kāntāya kāminīśāya te namaḥ ||66|| vareṇyāya vighnahartre bhaktipriyāya te namaḥ | padmāyatasunetrāya śukanāsāya śārṅgiṇe ||67|| yogeśvarāya vṛkṣāya śākhine te namo namaḥ | devāyanāya munaye sādhave te namo namaḥ ||68 || mohinīrūpabhāsāya jīvavāsāya te namaḥ | vārāhāya nṛsiṃhāya śarabhāya ca te namaḥ ||69|| kūṭasthaṃ sarvahetuṃ ca puruṣaṃ ca purātanam | māyākāntaṃ ceśakāntaṃ sarvakāntaṃ namāmyaham || 2.60.70 || kṣetrajñaṃ kālamāyeśaṃ vyūheśaṃ muktajīvakam | vāsudevaṃ satīkāntaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||7 1 || kambharānandanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gopālakṛṣṇabālakam | paradhāmanivāsaṃ taṃ pumuttamaṃ namāmyaham ||72|| brahmarṣayo brahmarūpaṃ yaṃ vadanti sanātanam | akṣareśaṃ ca mukteśaṃ prapadye śaraṇaṃ harim ||73 || śrīvatsāṅkaṃ śvetapadmarekhaṃ viguṇahārakam | ṣoḍaśādicihnaśobhaṃ prapadye śaraṇaṃ patim | 74|| yatra viśvaṃ yaśca viśve sarvaṃ yatra pratiṣṭhate | prabhavaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ divyaguṇaṃ pareśvaram ||75|| prapadye muktasaṃgānāṃ sādhūnāṃ paramāṃ gatim | bhagavantaṃ cātmavāsaṃ strīvāsaṃ puṣkarekṣaṇam ||76|| śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhaktyā prapadye bhaktavatsalam | antakāle samāgatya pradarśyātmānameva yaḥ ||77|| naijaṃ dhāma nijaṃ bhaktaṃ nayatyeva prabhuḥ paraḥ | taṃ namāmi paraṃ devaṃ mokṣadaṃ puruṣottamam ||78 || pātālāntaṃ ca satyādi sarvaṃ māti tu yatra vai | mahāmāyāntakaṃ sarvaṃ yasmin māti janārdane ||79|| dhāmāni muktakoṭyaśca yasmin mānti pareśvare | taṃ prapadye paraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim ||2.60.8 0 || na tvāṃ stotuṃ tathā vedmi yathā tvaṃ vartase prabho | svarūpaṃ na yathārthaṃ ca vedmi vedmi taṭasthakam ||8 1 || tvayā yat kṛṣṇa kṛpayā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakam | rūpaṃ pradarśitaṃ mahyaṃ tapaḥ phalaṃ kṛpāphalam ||82|| dhāma pradarśitaṃ cāpi tathā kuṃkumavāpikā | aśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi darśitaṃ lomaśāśramam ||8 3 || sarvaṃ punaḥ punarnātha draṣṭumicchāmi sevayā | prasannatāṃ samicchāmi tathā me varado bhava ||84|| ityevaṃ saṃstuto’nādiśrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | sānnidhyaṃ cājagāma drāk cakrapadmadharaḥ prabhuḥ ||85|| prītimān puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ śaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ | provāca madhuraṃ tasmai udayāya mahātmane ||86|| tava stotreṇa ca rājan prasanno’smi punaḥ punaḥ | sarvamiṣṭāṃ ca te rājan āryāyanaprasaṃgataḥ ||87|| bhaviṣyatyacirāt kṣetre mama vāso’pi te bhavet | sanneṣye tvāṃ mama kṣetraṃ vāruṇena pathā nṛpa ||88 || te yogānmama yogācca nadītīrthaṃ bhaviṣyati | idaṃ stotraṃ tu ye rājan paṭhiṣyanti gṛhe vane ||89|| prāpsyanti paramāṃ siddhiṃ mama prāptisvarūpiṇīm | atra tīrthe dhīravīrasarovare tu ye janāḥ ||2.60.90|| paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ kīṭā vṛkṣavallyādikāstathā | jalapānaṃ kariṣyanti muktiṃ yāsyanti pāvanīm ||9 1|| śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ tarpaṇaṃ bhojanaṃ jalam | ye’tra dāsyanti vidhinā teṣāṃ muktirbhaviṣyati ||92|| ityuktvā bhagavān bhūpaṃ cādṛśyabhāvamāsthitaḥ | rājā jajāpa bahudhā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||93|| jagau nanarta dadhyau ca jahāsa ca ruroda ca | tasthau siṣeve pupūja dadarśa taṃ yathā tathā ||94|| bhṛtyān vai preṣayāmāsa naijamudayapattanam | nāgadevaṃ sutaṃ rājyadānaṃ samādideśa ca ||95|| sādhuvadvartate smātra rājā bhāgavatottamaḥ | rātrau suptaḥ śrāvaṇasyāṣṭamyāṃ vavarṣa megharāṭ ||96|| sarovaraṃ nadī kūpā jalākārāḥ samudravat | ativṛṣṭyā tadā jātā parṇaśālā jalāntare ||97|| layaṃ yātā janāścāpi jale magnāḥ śatādhikāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sasmaruratyati ||98|| drāgeva rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo dayānidhiḥ | yayau rakṣaṇakartā sa nāvamādāya śāśvatīm ||99|| sahasrarūpadhārī ca yatra yatra jale janāḥ | nimagnā bālavṛddhādyā narā nāryaḥ paśūttarāḥ || 2.60.10 0|| sarvānuddhārayāmāsa naiko’pi mṛtimāptavān | āryāyanaṃ maharṣiṃ ca samādhisthaṃ gataṃ jale || 10 1|| udgṛhya nāvi bhagavān dadhāra karuṇālayaḥ | nadyāṃ mahyāṃ tu sā naukā sthāpitā paramātmanā 1 02|| śatadvayādhikān tasyāṃ magnān dhṛtvā rarakṣa saḥ | paśūn pakṣigaṇām̐ścāpi rarakṣa jīvatastadā || 10 3|| rājā ca mānavā sarve jīvantaḥ śrīnarāyaṇam | bhejire’nanyabhāvāśca naurāste jalamastake || 1 04|| jalopari vahatyeva śanaiḥ kṛṣṇena vāhitā | rādhike rakṣitā kṛṣṇastatra kā nāma vedanā || 1 05|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne udayapuranṛpateḥ cāturmāsye dhīravīrasarovarataṭasthitasya prabhordarśanaṃ cātivṛṣṭyā jalamagnatvaṃ prabhuṇā nāvā rakṣā kṛtetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 60 ||
<2.61> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike nauśca kṛṣṇānārāyaṇānvitā | śatadvayamanuṣyādhivāsitā ca mahījale || 1 || pūravegena vahati bhagavām̐stāṃ prarakṣati | śanaiḥ śanairmahānadyāṃ militāni jalāni ca || 2 || saṃgame tu mahānadyā bhramareṣu tu naustadā | majjanapravaṇā jalopari kṛṣṇena rakṣitā || 3 || gurjare sā nadī dīrghā hyagādhā ca bhayaṃkarī | pūravegena ca yātā śatakrośaṃ gatā tadā || 4 || lūnāpaṭākhyanagaraṃ nātidūre hi cāgatam | dadṛśurnaugatāḥ sarve mahāścaryaparāstadā || |9 || vanaṃ cāgre tu dadṛśustato nauḥ pūravegataḥ | pañcāśat krośadūraṃ ca uhyamānā gatā yadā || 6 || devīkoṭamahattīrthaṃ dadṛśurnaugatā janāḥ | bhadrāyanaṃ ca pañcāśatkrośadūre tataḥ param || 7 || samāyātaṃ tataścāgre kaṭhinaṃ pattanaṃ tathā | stambhapuraṃ mahātīrthaṃ kāvyatīrthaṃ ca sannidhau || 8 || madhye samudrasadṛśī rājate sunadī mahī | tatra nauḥ sā janairyuktā jale yātā tvakhātake || 9 || śrīhariṇā rakṣyamāṇā sābhramatīmahījale | miśrite’khātavārdhau sā samudraṃ prati yāti ca || 2.61.10 || akhāte cāgragā naukā dardurikābdhisaṃgamam | ullaṃghya paramaṃ dvīpaṃ prāptā tadā tu sābhavat || 11 || viśālā śrīprabhoḥ śaktyā sahasramānavāśrayā | narmadākhātamullaṃghya saurāṣṭrataṭamāgatā || 12|| śatrujitānadīsaṃge samudre sā sthirīkṛtā | tatra bhojyānnapānāni cakruḥ sarve sukhena vai || 1 3|| athāgre gopanāthaṃ ca yayau nauḥ kṛpṇavāhitā | tataścāgre mādhukaṃ ca yayau jāphalitaṃ tataḥ || 14|| tato divaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇāvatīṃ purīṃ yayau | tato yayau somanāthaṃ makarālayamapyataḥ || 15|| bhadrābdhisaṃgamaṃ dṛṣṭvā svarṇavatīṃ purīṃ yayau | kacchākhātaṃ praviśyātha camatkārapurāntikam || 16|| yayau tatastu sā naukā vimānarūpatāṃ gatā | ākāśe śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā samauḍḍayat || 17|| vyomnā śīghraṃ samāyātā cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram | divyaṃ candrasamaṃ yānaṃ sūryaprabhāsubhāsuram || 18|| suvarṇajaḍitaṃ devaiḥ pūjitaṃ kṛṣṇarakṣitam | śatadvayajanairyuktaṃ cāvātarat saro’ntikam || 1 9|| jayaśabdāḥ svastiśabdāstanābhavan muhurmuhuḥ | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ sotsāhaṃ samadṛśyata ||2.61.20|| sarvairvilokitaṃ kṣetraṃ dṛṣṭaṃ ca kānakālayam | mahābhāgavataṃ śṛṃgaṃ mandirasyocchritaṃ śubham ||21|| dṛṣṭā ca kambharālakṣmīrdṛṣṭo gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ | lomaśarṣistathā dṛṣṭo nagaraṃ ca vilokitam ||22|| vimānādavateruśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇānvitāḥ | udayākhyastathā cānye bhaktā nārīnarātmakāḥ || 23|| tāvadvimānaṃ ca tiro’bhavat kṛṣṇavinirmitam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāpi tiro’bhavattu sārthagaḥ ||24|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā dṛṣṭvā cādṛśyarūpatām | yātrākarāśca te sarve janān pṛṣṭvā punaḥ punaḥ || 25||| yayurdevā yatra bālakṛṣṇo virājate | kṛtvā saṃdarśanaṃ sarve kṛṣṇenānena rakṣitāḥ || 26|| smṛtvaivaṃ harṣanibhṛtāḥ premāśrūṇi hyavāsṛjan | bālakṛṣṇo dadau tebhyo nivāsārhaṃ mahālayam || 27|| sarvopaskarasaṃyuktaṃ dāsadāsīvirājitam | sarve tīrthāni vidhivaccakruścāśvasaro’bhitaḥ ||28|| tato miṣṭānnapānāni dadau śrībhagavān svayam | bhakṣyabhojyāni lehyāni coṣyāṇi ca rasām̐stathā || 29|| mukhavāsādicūrṇāni upamṛdyāni yāni ca | dāpayāmāsa bhagavān kṛpayā bhaktavatsalaḥ || 2.61.3 0|| rarakṣa bhagavān sarvān cāturmāsyāntameva ca | lomaśo’pi dadau tebhyo mantraṃ srajaśca taulasīḥ || 3 1|| prāpya te vaiṣṇavaṃ divyaṃ tejaḥ śrīpatisannidhau | divyā divyaguṇopetā babhūvuḥ kṛṣṇavīkṣitāḥ || 32|| jñātvā pratyakṣamevainaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ mahāprabhum | parabrahma sukhāvāsaṃ bhejustaṃ parameśvaram ||33|| lomaśastān pratyahaṃ copādideśa muktaye | prāha śṛṇvantu ruciraṃ śreyaḥsādhanamuttamam || 34|| sarvaṃ yasyāsti śarīraṃ sarveṣu vartate ca yaḥ | tasya stotreṇa saṃsārād rakṣā bhavati śāśvatī ||35|| tamenaṃ kathayāmyadya stavaṃ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇam | bālakṛṣṇo’stu me prācyāṃ cakrahetiḥ pareśvaraḥ ||36|| gadādharo bālakṛṣṇo dakṣiṇe me’stu sarvadā | paścime śārṅgadhṛka kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu me sadā || 37|| uttare khaḍgadhṛk kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu me sadā | koṇeṣvastu hṛṣīkeśo madhye madhye janārdanaḥ ||38|| pṛthvyāṃ varāharūpo’stu vyomni narahariḥ prabhuḥ | kṣuradhārātitīkṣṇaṃ ca sudarśanaṃ samantataḥ ||39|| pretabhūtān prahantveva rākṣasām̐śca niśācarān | gadā sahasradhārordhvaṃ hantu vṛkān piśācakān ||2.61.40|| śārṅgaṃ dhanurharestiryakkuṣmāṇḍādīn prahantu ca | yakṣān daityān jṛmbhakām̐śca khagān krūrān vināyakān ||41 || śaṃkho viṣṇorninādena hantu duṣṭām̐śca pannagān | siṃhān vyāghrān śarabhām̐śca dandaśūkān paśūm̐stathā ||42|| viṣṇoḥ padmaṃ mama śatrūn saumyān dadhātu gandhataḥ | cittavṛttiharān smṛtyāharān balaujasāṃ harān ||43|| sampadbhogaharām̐ścāpi śubhalakṣaṇahārakān | strīputradhanasadanaharān praśāmayatvapi ||44|| hareḥ saṃkīrtanāccāstu svāsthyamaindriyakaṃ mama | buddhisvāsthyaṃ manaḥsvāsthyaṃ dehasvāsthyaṃ sukhāvaham ||45|| pṛṣṭhe cāgre pārśvayośca koṇeṣvastu harirmama | śikhāyāṃ me nakheṣveṣaḥ carmasvastu harirmama ||46|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | ityevaṃ rādhike rakṣāstotraṃ śrīlomaśo muniḥ ||47|| dadau sarvebhya evādau tataḥ prāha nidarśanam | vaṭāsīnapure rājā krūrasiṃho’bhavatpurā ||48|| devadvijasatīdrogdhā piśunaḥ kṣatriyādhamaḥ | parapīḍākaraḥ kṣudro naisargeṇa ca nirdayaḥ ||49|| dharmadānavihīnaśca satāṃ sevāvivarjitaḥ | āyuḥkṣaye sa vai jajñe vane ghoraniśācaraḥ |||2.61.50|| yo yo milati cāraṇye paśuḥ pakṣī ca mānavaḥ | bhakṣaṇīyo māraṇīya iti krauryaṃ karoti saḥ ||51|| yaṃ yaṃ paśyati paśvādiṃ taṃ tamādāya sa drutam | khādatyeva dayāhīno bāhugocaramāgatam ||52|| evaṃ yāte dīrghakāle vārdhakyaṃ samabhūttataḥ | aṭamānasya duṣṭasya narmadāyāstaṭe kvacit ||53|| tasya dṛṣṭyāṃ tāpaso vai ṛṣiryogaparāyaṇaḥ | nāmnā jitaśravā vipraścāgataḥ saṃjitendriyaḥ ||54|| dṛṣṭvā taṃ khādituṃ tūrṇaṃ dudrāva rākṣaseśvaraḥ | uktāṃ rakṣāṃ dvijastūrṇaṃ samuvāca punaḥ punaḥ ||55|| śrutvā stabdho’bhavattūrṇaṃ jaḍībhūto hi rākṣasaḥ | nāgre yātuṃ cāpasartuṃ śaśāka stotradharṣitaḥ ||56|| nirdhūtavegaḥ sahasā tasthau tatraiva rākṣasaḥ | yāvad dvijasya japato dināntaḥ samapadyata ||57|| tato japyāvasāne ca taṃ dadarśa niśācaram | dīnaṃ hatabalotsāhaṃ kāndiśikaṃ hataujasam ||58|| kṛpāpūrṇo dvijo daityaṃ samāśvāsya punaḥ punaḥ | papraccha kāraṇaṃ rakṣobhāve cāgamane tathā ||59|| rākṣasaḥ pūrvavṛttāntaṃ rakṣobhavanamityapi | bhakṣaṇārthaṃ cāgamaścetyevaṃ sarvamuvāca ha ||2.61.60 || prasīdetyabravīd vipraṃ nirviṇṇaḥ sukhavarjitaḥ | bahupāpāni kṛtavān hatavām̐śca bahūn sataḥ ||6 1 || bahvīrnārīḥ prasahyaiva bhuktavān vidhavā api | anāgasāṃ ca sattvānāṃ prakṣayaṃ kṛtavān bahum ||62|| madyamāṃsāni bahudhā bhuktavānapi sarvadā | tasmāt pāpādahaṃ mokṣamicchāmi tvatprasādataḥ ||63 || tatpāpapraśamāyālaṃ kuru me dharmasādhanam | pāpasyāsya kṣayakaraṃ mokṣadaṃ kuru satvaram ||64|| niśāṭasya vacaḥ śrutvā jitaśravā uvāca tam | mama rakṣā kṛtā cātra mayā te’pi pavitratā ||65|| mumukṣutā kṛtā rakṣo yāhi kuṃkumavāpikām | saurāṣṭre śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāśvasarovare ||66|| snātvā śrīlomaśaṃ gatvā prārthanāṃ kuru sarvathā | uddhāraṃ te lomaśo vā vipraścānyaḥ kariṣyati ||67|| evamuktvā yayau vipro rākṣaso vyomamārgataḥ | āgataḥ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre cāmravaṇe’vasat ||68|| kathaṃ mokṣo bhavenme’tra cintayā dīnamānasaḥ | na cakhāda sa sattvāni kṣudhāsaṃbādhito’pi san ||69|| daśame daśame kāle jantumekamabhakṣayat | vyāghrāraṇye hyaṭitvā ca punaścāmravaṇe’gamat ||2.61.70|| sa kadācinmahāvṛṣṭau vane’ṭan kṣudhito’bhavat | dadarśa phalalābhārthamāgataṃ brahmacāriṇam ||71 || brahmaprakāśanāmānaṃ dharṣayāmāsa rākṣasaḥ | brahmacārī tadā tvenaṃ rākṣasaṃ prāha sāmataḥ ||72|| vada kiṃ kāraṇaṃ tvatra dharṣaṇe me vanecara | rākṣasaḥ prāha bhojyaṃ me kāle bhavati cāṣṭame ||73|| sa tvaṃ prāptaḥ kṣudhitasya niṣṭurasyātra me vane | brahmacārī tu taṃ prāha śṛṇu me vacanaṃ śubham ||74|| phalāni gurave dātuṃ gacchāmyahaṃ niśācara | taddatvācāgamiṣyāmi bhakṣyaścedasmi te nvaham ||75|| sa tvaṃ muhūrtamātraṃ māmatraivānuprapālaya | nivedya gurave yāvadihāgacchāmi bhakṣaya ||76|| niśācarastadā prāha yāhi kintu hitaṃ śṛṇu | gurave vada me mokṣo yathā syāt tat karotu cet| ||77|| tvāṃ na vai bhakṣayiṣye’haṃ yadartho’haṃ samāgataḥ | guroryanna viruddhaṃ syānna ca dharmoparodhakam ||78|| yanna vrataharaṃ te’pi tathā manmokṣaṇaṃ kuru | mayā nisargato brahman jātidoṣādviśeṣataḥ ||79|| viṣayāḍhyena cittena pāpakarma sadārjitam | ābālyānmama dharme tu mana āsīnna vai manāk ||2.61.80 || adhārmikāni karmāṇi kṛtānyeva viśeṣataḥ | narmadāyāstaṭe prāptavipreṇa preṣito’tra vai ||8 1|| pāpakṣālanakāmārthaṃ samāgato’smi bhāvataḥ | tatra tvaṃ milito me’tra pāpānmokṣaya me’nagha ||82|| ityukto brāhmaṇaḥ prāha guroryogādahaṃ tava | prajvālya sarvapāpāni kariṣye mokṣaṇaṃ dhruvam ||83|| yadi śuśrūṣito vahnirguroḥ śuśrūṣūṇādanu | vratāni vā sucīrṇāni mokṣo bhavatu rakṣasaḥ ||84|| yadyahaṃ pitaraṃ devaṃ guruṃ ca mātaraṃ harim | gauraveṇābhivandāmi mokṣo bhavatu rakṣasaḥ ||85|| yadyahaṃ manasā vācā karmaṇā ca guruṃ harim | nāvamāne yojayāmi mokṣo bhavatu rakṣasaḥ ||86|| japa rākṣasa deveśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam | harikṛṣṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ vāsudevaṃ janārdanam ||87|| praṇato’smi jagannāthaṃ sa ca mokṣaṃ dadhātu me | carācaraguruṃ nāthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||88|| śaṃkhinaṃ cakriṇaṃ śārṅgadhāriṇaṃ dhvajinaṃ harim | praṇato’smi patiṃ lakṣmyāḥ sa ca mokṣaṃ dadhātu me ||89|| dāmodaraṃ puṇḍarīkanetraṃ ca śeṣaśāyinam | praṇato’smi ca govindaṃ sa ca mokṣaṃ dadhātu me ||2.61.90|| nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ pṛthvīdharaṃ dhāmādhivāsinam | praṇato’smi prabhānāthaṃ sa ca mokṣaṃ dadhātu me ||91|| śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ śrīśaṃ śrīmatpāravatīpatim | praṇato’smi ramākāntaṃ sa ca mokṣaṃ dadhātu me ||92|| yatayo yaṃ cintayanti rādhā rañjayati prabhum | samastālambanamūrtiṃ tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||93|| parabrahmāsaṃkhyagopīpatiṃ śrīkambharāsutam | sarvādhāraṃ sarvagaṃ ca tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||94|| paramātmānamātmasthaṃ karmakṣālanaśaktikam | punarbhavaprabhettāraṃ tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||95|| īśān devānṛṣīn pitṝn mānavām̐śca sarīsṛpān | pādapān jalajān svedodbhavān sṛjati rakṣati ||96|| brahmarūpadharaṃ jagadyoniṃ trātāramacyutam | gopālakṛṣṇabālaṃ ca tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||97|| yajñeśa cāntakaṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ pareśvaram | yasmānnānyatparaṃ kiñcit tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||98|| śubhāśubhāni kāryāṇi janmāntarakṛtāni me | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastāni vyapohatu ||99|| yanniśāyāṃ ca yatprātaryanmadhyāhnāparāhṇayoḥ | sandhyayośca kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tanme sarvaṃ praṇaśyatu || 2.61.1 00|| yat tiṣṭhatā yad vrajatā yacca śayyāgatena vai | kṛtaṃ duḥkhakaraṃ karma kāyena manasā girā || 10 1|| ajñānato jñānato vā madāt calitacetasā | tat kṣipraṃ vilayaṃ yātu bālakṛṣṇasya kīrtanāt || 102|| paradāraparadravyavāñcchādrohodbhavaṃ ca yat | mahātmanāṃ pranindāṃ ca kurvatā paraduḥkhadām || 103|| kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ marmabhedivacasā tat praṇaśyatu | yacca bhojye tathā peye bhakṣye coṣye vilehane || 1 04|| yadvālye yacca kaumārye yatpāpaṃ yauvane mama | vayaḥpariṇatau yacca yacca janmāntare kṛtam || 1 05|| tadanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇetijapakīrtanāt | prayātu vilayaṃ sadyo mokṣadasya prabhāvanāt || 1 06|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya haraye namaḥ | kambharāśrīnandanāya bālakṛṣṇāya te namaḥ || 1 07|| śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasya bālakāya namo namaḥ | etadbhadra mayākhyātaṃ tava pātakanāśanam || 108|| svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ divyaṃ stotraṃ yadguruṇoditam | anena bālakṛṣṇaṃ tvaṃ samārādhaya rākṣasa || 1 09|| pratyahaṃ tvaṃ stavenānenāpi smṛtvā ca lomaśam | guruṃ tathā parabrahma śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamam || 2.61.11 0|| stutvā bhaktiṃ dṛḍhāṃ kṛtvā tataḥ pāpāt pramokṣyase | stuto bhaktyā bhaktavaśaḥ sarvapāpaharo hariḥ || 11 1|| śrutvaivaṃ rākṣasaḥ prāha naya māṃ lomaśāśramam | pradarśaya guruṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pramokṣadam || 1 12|| ityukto brahmacārī taṃ krūrasiṃhāya rakṣase | dadau rakṣākaraṃ stotraṃ tena pāpavivarjitaḥ || 11 3|| jātastato yayau sākaṃ tenaiva brahmacāriṇā | mamāśramaṃ lomaśākhyaṃ cātrāgatya sa rākṣasaḥ || 1 14|| pāpahīno hyabhūt tūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāntikam | gatvā ca darśanaṃ labdhvā prapītvā caraṇāmṛtam || 1 15|| kṛtvā tīrthāni sarvāṇi divyadeho babhūva ha | divyaṃ yānaṃ samāruhya yayāvakṣaradhāma saḥ || 1 16|| yūyamāryāyanādyāśca jalapralayarakṣitāḥ | bhajata śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam || 1 17|| maraṇāttāritā yena saṃsārāt tārayiṣyati | tārakaṃ cāśrayatāsmācchrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam || 1 18|| ityuktvā śrīhariṃ smṛtvā maunaṃ tasthau hi lomaśaḥ | āryāyanodayādyāśca śāntiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ sulebhire || 1 19|| stotrapāṭhaśravaṇādyairbhuktiḥ rakṣāpadāṃ kṣayaḥ | mokṣaśca rādhike śāntiḥ sarvaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 2.61.120|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne jalamagnān śatadvayamānavān nāvi gṛhītvā prabhurmahīnadīdvārā staṃbhākhātamullaṃdhya somanāthaṃ svarṇapuraṃ camatkārapurādi ca pradakṣiṇīkṛtya naukātmakavimānadvārā kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ prāpayāmāsa, lomaśopadiṣṭarakṣāstotraṃ, krūrasiṃhasya rakṣaso vipradvārā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptyā muktiścetinirūpaṇanāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 61 ||
<2.62> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike te narā nāryaḥ dveśate vai śrīlomaśam | natvā sampūjya bhāvena koṭyarbudābjakanyakāḥ || 1 || kṛṣṇakāntāśca sampūjya yayurvāsālaye śubhe | bhejuḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam || 2 || koṭikanyāpate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jagatprabho | sarvapate sadā pāhi nirādhārān tvadāśritān || 3 || ityevaṃ tu militvaiva bhajanaṃ tā vyadhurmudā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo bālakṛṣṇa prabhāpate || 4 || rādhālakṣmīpate mañjūpate śrīpārvatīpate | evaṃ satāladhūnyaṃ ca cakruste nauprarakṣitāḥ || 5 || cāturmāsyaṃ tatra cakruḥ kṛṣṇabhaktisamanvitāḥ | athorjakṛṣṇapakṣīyāṣṭamī samāgatā tithiḥ || 6 || iṣṭadevasya prākaṭyotsavaścāṣṭamavarṣajaḥ | devairīśaiśca munibhiḥ kṛtaḥ svargātiśobhitaḥ || 7 || vīkṣya taṃ harṣamāpannāḥ pūjāṃ cakrurharestu te | tadāścaryaṃ paraṃ jātaṃ rādhike śṛṇu vacmi te || 8 || rājādhirājo bhagavān prātareva prapūjitaḥ | dadau dānāni bahūni svajanmāṣṭamavarṣake || 9 || bhojayāmāsa viprām̐śca sādhūn sādhvīśca bālikāḥ | bālān kanyāśca dīnām̐ścānāthān kumārakām̐stathā || 2.62.10|| khañjān kāṇām̐śca badhirān vṛkṇānandhān jaḍām̐stathā | vicittān kuṣṭhinaścāpi deśebhyo tīrthamāgatān || 11 || rogiṇo dehino vīkṣya dayālurbhagavān svayam | prāha khañjādikān vyaṃgān madhyāhne bhojanottaram || 1 2|| āyāntu vyaṃgadehāśca rogiṇo duḥkhinastathā | āyāntu cāṃgavikalāścendriyairvikalā api || 1 3|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ me janūtsave | apūrvaṃ sukhadaṃ vo’dya dadāmi pāritoṣikam || 14|| ityuktvā śarkarādroṇīṃ pārśve kṛtvā tu kānake | gajāsane niṣasāda pradātuṃ śarkarāstataḥ || 15|| āyayuḥ khañjalokāśca tebhyo datvā suśarkarāḥ | khañjabhāge harikṛṣṇaḥ pasparśa vāmapāṇinā || 16|| khāñjyaṃ teṣā gataṃ tūrṇaṃ babhavuḥ pūrṇapādinaḥ | atha kāṇāḥ prāyayuśca tebhyo datvā tu śarkarāḥ || 17|| netre pasparśa vāmena pāṇināndhavimuktaye | kāṇatvamāndhyamālpyaṃ dṛgdoṣā naṣṭā drutaṃ tadā || 18|| pūrṇaraśmibharāṇyeva cakṣūṃṣi vartitāni vai | athāyayurbadhirāśca tebhyo datvā ca śarkarāḥ || 1 9|| karṇe pasparśa hastena samājuhāva nāmabhiḥ | bādhiryaṃ vigataṃ teṣāṃ babhūvuḥ śrutiśaktayaḥ ||2.62.20|| atha vṛkṇāḥ samāyātāstebhyo datvā ca śarkarām | kuṇikāsu prakoṣṭheṣu cāṃgulīṣu narāyaṇaḥ ||21 || pasparśa pāṇinā teṣāṃ vṛkṇatvaṃ vyanudat kṣaṇāt | yathānisargahastāste’bhavan prasannamānasāḥ || 22|| atha jaḍā vicittāśca samāyayuśca sannidhau | tebhyo dattā śarkarā ca spṛṣṭā dehāḥ kareṇa vai || 23|| mastakāni tathā spṛṣṭvā jāḍyaṃ vaicityamityapi | vātarogādikaṃ cāpi vainidryaṃ nāśitaṃ kṣaṇāt ||24|| athāyayuśca kanyāśca kuṣṭhinaśca samāyayuḥ | tebhyo datvā śarkarāśca tathā ca caraṇāmṛtam ||25|| jalena prokṣya cāṃgāni rogān kuṣṭhān vyanīnaśat | athāyayuśca pakṣādighātino bhagnadehinaḥ || 26|| tebhyo datvā śarkarāśca pasparśa ca kareṇa tān | ghātarogaṃ kṛpayā ca nāśayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ||27|| bhagnabhāgaṃ ca tūrṇaṃ saṃrohayāmāsa yogataḥ | galatkuṣṭhāstato lokāścāyātāḥ parameśvaram ||28|| haristebhyaḥ pradāyaiva śarkarā jalasecanam | galatkuṣṭhapradeśe ca svayaṃ cakāra tena vai ||29|| galadbhāvo gataḥ sarvaḥ śvaityaṃ śvaitryaṃ gataṃ kṣaṇāt | arogāste tu sañjātāḥ prasannāḥ puṇyaśālinaḥ ||2.62.3 0|| atha ṣaṇḍhāstadā prāhurbahupāpena ṣaṇḍhatā | jātāsmākaṃ kṛpāsindho bhavān śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||3 1 || kartumakartuṃ cānyathākartuṃ śaktaḥ pravartate | bhagavadyogamāptānāṃ cenno’smākaṃ sabījatā ||32|| jāyeta bhagavam̐starhi ko lābhastava darśanāt | śrutvā tebhyaḥ pradāyaiva śarkarāḥ śrīhariḥ svayam ||33|| aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva snātumājñāṃ dadau tataḥ | sarve ṣaṇḍhā yayustūrṇaṃ sasnuścātha viniryayuḥ ||34|| naraprakhyā narāḥ puṃstve nārīyogyā balānvitāḥ | naracihnā narāḥ pūrṇāḥ sabījā babhūvustadā || 35|| nārīprakhyāḥ striyaḥ strītve narayogyā rajo’nvitāḥ | nārīcihnāḥ striyaḥ pūrṇā babhūvuśca rajobharāḥ ||36|| evaṃ vai kṛpayā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svaśaktibhiḥ | ṣaṇḍhāni vidadhe puṃso yoṣitaśca sadhātukāḥ ||37|| evaṃ dṛṣṭvā camatkāraṃ paramāścaryamāgatāḥ | yatra snātāśca tat tīrthaṃ ṣaṇḍhoddhāraṃ samucyate ||38|| atha nāryo narāḥ stotraṃ sarve cakrurharestadā | premapūrṇahṛdayāśca sthiramānasavṛttayaḥ ||39|| namo’stu te pare dhāmni rājate vai parātmane | namo’saṃkhyasatīsādhvīsādhumuktābhiśāsine ||2.62.40|| namo’kṣarādhipataye’kṣaramuktābhiśāsine | namo golokavāsāya gopagopyabhiśāsine ||41 || gavāṃ nāthāya kṛṣṇāya śrīrādhāpataye namaḥ | namo vaikuṇṭhavāsāya śrīramāpataye namaḥ ||42|| bahuvaikuṇṭhanāthāya lakṣmīśrīpataye namaḥ | śrīprabhāmaṃjulāhaṃsāsaguṇāsvāmine namaḥ ||43|| vṛndātulasīkamalāpārvatīpataye namaḥ | namaste’stu jagannātha vāsudeva namo’stu te ||44|| śrīnivāsa namaste’stu viśvaksena namo’stu te | garuḍadhvaja gopīśa viṣṇo vaikuṇṭha te namaḥ ||45|| puruṣottama deveśa sarveśvara namo’stu te | anādyādyantamadhyānta namaste padmajapriya ||46|| sṛṣṭigarbha namastubhyaṃ śatruñjaya namo’stu te | namo hiraṇyarūpāya kālanetrāya te namaḥ ||47|| mahānābha mahāmūla mūlāvāsa namo’stu te | dharmāvāsa hṛdāvāsa śuciśravaḥ pṛthuśravā ||48|| dharmādhyakṣa prajādhyakṣa kālādhyakṣa namo’stu te | gadādhārin padmadhārin śrutipraśna namo’stute ||49|| śriyodhara vanamālādhara kṛṣṇa namo’stute | puruṣṭata mahākalpa sarvātmam̐ste namo vibho ||2.62.50 || dvādaśātmaka kālātman sāmātman parameśvara | vyomārkātmaka candrātman sarvasūkṣma namo’stu te ||51 || nīlakeśa guḍākeśa mahākeśa namo’stu te | mañjukeśa hṛṣīkeśa sarvakeśa namo’stu te ||52|| śveta rakta tathā pīta citra kṛṣṇa namo’stu te | kuśeśaya prītikartargovinda haṃsa te namaḥ ||53|| namaste dharmanetrāya sahasrāṃgāya te namaḥ | namaste viśvarūpāya dhāmarūpāya te namaḥ ||54|| nyagrodhāya pippalāya mahāśākhāya te namaḥ | skandhapatrāṃkuralatāpallavāya namo’stu te ||55|| tvaṃ vai vedamayo viṣṇustīrthadevamatī vibhuḥ | bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥsvarūpastvaṃ yajñabhāgabhuje namaḥ ||56|| parabrahma namaste’stu śabdabrahma namo’stu te | vidyā tvaṃ vedyarūpastvaṃ vandanīya namo’stu te ||57|| nārīvāṇīsvarūpastvaṃ nare dayāsvarūpakaḥ | putre vātsalyabhāvastvaṃ tvāṃ vayaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ||58|| uddhāraṃ kuru saṃsārād bhagavan parameśvara | ityuktvā maunamāsedustataścāryāyano muniḥ ||59|| tuṣṭāva parayā prītyā śrīkāntaṃ puruṣottamam | matsyaṃ namasye kūrmaṃ ca namasye hayaśīrṣakam ||2.62.60|| trivikramaṃ namasye ca namasye mādhavaṃ prabhum | īśānaṃ ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ namasye ca kumārilam ||61 || nārāyaṇaṃ namasye’haṃ namasye garuḍadhvajam | narasiṃhaṃ namasye ca namasye kāmapālinam ||62|| puṇḍarīkanibhanetraṃ namasye śrīnarāyaṇam | namasye dhvajacakrābjadhanurmīnasuśūlinam ||63 || gopatiṃ kambharāputraṃ vibhuṃ gopālanandanam | namasye ca gadāpāṇiṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaraḥsthitam ||64|| ardhanārīśvaraṃ nāthaṃ nārīvṛndasukhapradam | namasye padmahastaṃ ca padmasakthinamityapi ||65|| namasye padmakiraṇaṃ tathordhvarekhapattalam | lakṣmīpratimajaghanaṃ namasye vanamālinam ||66|| namasye dharaṇināthaṃ namasye’haṃ śriyaḥ patim | anāthanātha naukāstha vimānastha ca te namaḥ ||67|| hṛtstha bhaktavihārastha dīnarakṣāstha te namaḥ | triṇāciketaṃ brahmāṇaṃ namasye ca mahaujasam ||68 || sarvāmayavināśaṃ ca namasye ghrāṇatarpaṇam | namasye rukmakavacaṃ namasye puruṣottamam ||69|| vanaspatiṃ madhupatiṃ namasye ca sudhāpatim | vāsudevaṃ cakrapāṇiṃ namasye ca yaśodhanam ||2.62.70|| sarvabhūtagataṃ śāntaṃ dharmamūrtiṃ pareśvaram | namasye mokṣadaṃ nāthaṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje ||7 1 || evaṃ tuṣṭāva deveśaṃ śrīmān āryāyano muniḥ | tataḥ pūjāparihāraṃ cakruḥ sāyaṃ surā narāḥ ||72|| āryāyano munistatra samuvāca taṭe sadā | nāvā cottaritā ye ca narā nāryaśca te harim ||73|| prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ nijadeśān vilokitum | kārtikānte haristatra sasmāra yānamuttamam ||74|| divyaṃ divyaguṇopetaṃ vimānaṃ tatra cāgatam | niṣādya tatra sarvāṃstān vyomnā kṣaṇena vegataḥ ||75||| prāpayāmāsa bhagavān dhīravīrasarovaram | aravallīśailabhūmau yatra yatra ca janmabhūḥ ||76|| tatra tatra prāpitāste narā nāryaḥ sukhāttadā | svasvagṛhaṃ gatāḥ sarve kuṭumbaṃ jagadurvṛttam || 77|| sāścaryāste hariṃ bhejuranādiśrīnarāyaṇam | atha śrībhagavām̐stūrṇaṃ tiro’bhavat sayānakaḥ ||78|| samāyayau cāśvapaṭṭasaro naijālayaṃ śubham | udayākhyaśca rājarṣiraśvapaṭṭasarovare |79||| japayajñaṃ cakāraiva harernāmaparāyaṇaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāha hṛdā punaḥ ||2.62.80|| mokṣaṃ dehi kṛpāsindho śāśvataṃ padamāpnuyām | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha rājā dhyānaṃ cakāra ha ||81 || līnanāḍīprāṇavegaḥ śanaiḥ prāṇān jahau tadā | divyamukto babhūvātha vimānena suvarcasā ||82|| yayau śrīmatparaṃ dhāma saccidānandalakṣaṇam | evaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastānuddhadhāra ha ||83|| khañjabadhirakāṇādyā ye ye jātāḥ sudehinaḥ | te te gatvā nijaṃ deśaṃ gṛhaṃ sukhena saṃsthitāḥ ||84|| tān dṛṣṭvāścaryamāpannāḥ prajā janāśca darśakāḥ | pratāpaṃ paramaṃ matvā bhejire puruṣottamam ||85|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo parabrahma śriyaḥ pate | ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ cakruḥ svāmin rakṣaya sarvadā ||86|| śrīharistān dūragāṃśca svapne svaṃ samadarśayat | kiśoraṃ sundaraṃ rūpaṃ dadṛśuste’tibhāsuram ||87|| tatra līnāḥ kṣaṇamātraṃ cābhavam̐ste tataḥ punaḥ | prabuddhāḥ sasmarurnārāyaṇaṃ gopālabālakam ||88|| āyayurdarśanārthaṃ ca kuṃkumavāpikālayam | sahasraśo narā nāryaḥ samājagmuḥ samantataḥ ||89|| dadṛśuryādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ svapne rūpaṃ tu tādṛśam | arcayāmāsuratyarthaṃ sarvabhāvena śrīpatim ||2.62.90 || tīrthaṃ vidhāya bahudhā prāpya mantraṃ ca lomaśāt | yayurnaijān pradeśāṃśca vaiṣṇavā bhagavatpriyāḥ ||91 || cāturmāsyavratino ye tatrāyānti sarovaram | snātuṃ tebhyo hariḥ sākṣād darśanaṃ svaṃ dadāti vai ||92|| vṛddhān pūrṇāyuṣo divyān kṛtvā vimānasaṃsthitān | prahiṇoti nijaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ ca paramaṃ padam ||93||| evaṃ vai rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena rakṣitāḥ | prāpitāśca nijān deśān jalamagnoddhṛtā janāḥ ||94|| nirugṇāśca kṛtāḥ puṣṭadehāḥ ṣaṇḍāḥ savīryakāḥ | pratāpaścātulaścaivaṃ khyāpitaḥ pṛthivītale ||95|| kīrtanāt smaraṇādasya camatkārasya śaṃsanāt | śravaṇādapi duḥkhāni bhavanti vigatāni vai ||96|| rogā naśyanti śīghraṃ ca naśyantyapi mahāpadaḥ | āpatkālāḥ praṇaśyanti sadā kṛṣṇakathāśravāt || 97|| stotrāṇāṃ vācanād rādhe rakṣā bhavati sarvathā | tīrthasya karaṇād rādhe cābhīṣṭaṃ prāpyate janaiḥ || 98|| aniṣṭaṃ līyate sarvaṃ saubhāgyaṃ ca vivardhate | dhanadhānyaprajāputraparīvārādimān bhavet ||9 9|| bhuktiṃ prāpyātra ca svarge tato mokṣe mahīyate | parabrahmaṇo bhaktasya kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate || 2.62.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne jaloddhṛtajanaiḥ kṛtā stutiḥ, rugṇavyaṃgādīnāmaṣṭamavatsarotsave svāsthyakaraṇam, tatkṛtastavanam, āryāyanakṛtastotram, jaloddhṛtānāṃ svadeśaprāpaṇam, udayananṛpasya mokṣaścetinirūpaṇanāmā dvāṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 62 ||
<2.63> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike śrīmadbālakṛṣṇasya ceṣṭitam | bhaktarakṣākaraṃ cānyadaṣṭame’bde samudrajam || 1 || revātaṭe tu nagaraṃ candrodayāhvayaṃ śubham | sarvabhaktāśritaṃ dharmaparāyaṇaprajāśritam || 2 || āsīttatra mahāśreṣṭhī dhanadhānyasamṛddhimān | vasumedha itināmnā vaiṣṇavo manasā śuciḥ || 3 || satāṃ sevāparo nityaṃ devapūjāṃ karoti ca | sūryaṃ viṣṇuṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca satīṃ śaṃbhuṃ śriyaṃ harim || 4 || prātaḥ snātvā copacāraiḥ sampūjayati sādaram | vibhajya bhuṃkte satataṃ dānaṃ dadāti nityaśaḥ || 5 || gavāṃ sevāṃ satāṃ sevāṃ pitṛtṛptiṃ karoti ca | vyāpāraḥ paṇyaviṣayo bahulābho’sya vardhate || 6 || putrāḥ pañca ca kuśalāḥ patnī dharmaparāyaṇāḥ | suśīlākhyā caikabhuktaṃ vrataṃ carati sarvadā || 7 || śālagrāmaṃ samabhyarcya tulasīdalamiśritam | patipādodakaspṛṣṭaṃ bhuṃkte bhojyaṃ prasādajam || 8 || putrāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve mālādhyānajapārthinaḥ | mokṣabhilāṣukāḥ samyak kṛtaśāstrakathāśravāḥ || 9 || atha tatra maharṣiśca śatānandābhidho’bhavat | uddālakasya putraḥ sa vane kṛtāśramo’bhavat || 2.63.1 0|| śatānando nātidūre candrodayasya sannidhau | viprāśrame sadā sāyaṃ samāyāti yadṛcchayā || 1 1|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāṃ ca vācayati prage | kathāṃ kṛtvā gṛhītvā ca bhikṣāṃ yāti nijāśramam || 12| grāmaṃjanāḥ samāyānti kathāṃ śṛṇvanti nityaśaḥ | tatra śrutaṃ tu saurāṣṭre cāśvapaṭṭasarovare || 13 || kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre kambharāśrīgṛhe hariḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo gopālanandanaḥ || 14|| vartate bālarūpo vai bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmamīnadhvajatriśūlavān || 15|| dhanuḥsvastikavajrādicihnacihnitahastavān | pratyakṣo vartate sarveśvaraḥ śrīpatiravyayaḥ || 16|| koṭikoṭyabjagopīnāṃ prāṇeśaḥ parameśvaraḥ | śrutvaivaṃ ca kathāṃ citrāṃ śrutvā śrīsomatīrthakam || 17|| śrūtvā svarṇapurīṃ puṇyāṃ camatkārapuraṃ tathā | tīrthārthaṃ kṛtasaṃkalpaḥ sakuṭumbaḥ sahānugaḥ || 18|| annavāriphalakandakaṇādikṛtasaṃgrahaḥ | viśālāṃ nāvamāruhya dhanadhānyasamṛddhimān || 19|| triṃśadvyaktikṛtasārtho narmadāsalilānugaḥ | nāvikaiścālyamānāyāṃ naukāyāṃ sa sthito yayau ||2.63.20 || yātrārthaṃ tvāyayau nāvā revāsāgarasaṃgamam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo parabrahma pareśvara ||2 1 || kīrtayati satataṃ sasārtho japati mālikām | māghe viśramya revāyāḥ saṃge sasnau sahānugaiḥ ||22|| dadau dānāni vastrānnasvarṇarūpyāṇi bhāvataḥ | atha nāvaṃ samāruhyākhātaṃ vārdheḥ samāgamat ||23|| kiṃnadīsaṃgame snātvākhātamullaṃghya cāyayau | śatruñjitābdhisaṃyoge sasnau tu vidhinātra saḥ ||24|| tasmād yayau gopanāthaṃ tīrthaṃ hariharāśritam | tato mūlāṃ yayau svarṇapurīṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇīm ||25|| somanāthaṃ yayau snātvā sarasvatyabdhisaṃgame | hiraṇyāsaṃgame snātvā kṛtvā tīrthavidhiṃ tataḥ ||26|| makarālayatīrthaṃ ca kṛtvā bhadrābdhisaṃgamam | yayau tīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇasvarṇapurīṃ yayau ||27||| dvīpaṃ dṛṣṭvā tataḥ kacche nārāyaṇasaro yayau | parāvṛtya ca naukāyāṃ camatkārapuraṃ yayau ||28|| tatastvakhātamārgeṇa parāvṛtya ca sāgare | svarṇapurīṃ parityajya jalamārgeṇa gacchati ||29|| somanāthaṃ tadā madhye sāmudraṃ vighnamāgamat | jhaṃjhāvāto’tivegācca vavau kṣobhakaro mahān ||2.63.3 0|| sāmudralaśobhaśca prāleya iva cābhavat | nauḥ samākṛṣyate madhye pratikūlena vāyunā ||3 1 || taraṃgair vīcikallolaistālavṛkṣocchrayaistadā | bahvyo naukā nimagnāśca bhagnā naṣṭāśca mānavāḥ ||32|| vasumedhasya naukāpi samutpatati vakragā | pārśvayoḥ patamānā ca kallolairjalapūritā ||33|| abhavat nāvikāścāpyaśaktā vai rakṣaṇe’bhavan | vasumedho vaṇigvaryastatpatnī ca sutādayaḥ ||34|| sasmaruḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | śokaṃ cakruśca bahudhā yadarthaṃ vayamāgatāḥ ||35|| śrutvā śatānandakathādvārā taṃ bālakṛṣṇakam | avilokya mṛtāḥ syāma sāmudre’tra jale’balāḥ ||36|| naukāyāṃ pūryate vāri niṣkāsādhikamatyati | vāyunā hanyate cāpi jalena tāḍyate muhuḥ ||37|| pārśvabhāvena cāvartān karoti jalatāḍitā | imāścānyā jananāvo vyāpāriṇo layaṃ gatāḥ || 38|| asmannaukāpi sānnidhye talavāsaṃ samicchati | smarantu taṃ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram || 39|| yadarthaṃ vayamāyātāḥ sa no rakṣatu hṛcchrayaḥ | naukāvyāptaḥ sa bhagavān naukā sthirīkarotu ca ||2.63.40|| jhaṃjhāvātagataḥ kṛṣṇo vātaṃ śāmayatu kṣaṇāt | jalasthaḥ śrībālakṛṣṇo jalasthairyaṃ karotu ca ||41 || yadvā cenmṛtyumāpannān svātmānaṃ darśayatviha | sarvathā vai vayaṃ nātha te smaḥ śaraṇamāgatāḥ ||42|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa gopālanandana | kambharāśrīkumāra tvaṃ rakṣa gopīpate prabho ||43|| evaṃ kṛṣṇaparāḥ sarve hatotsāhāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ | nirāśā jīvane jātā naukāyāṃ vāyuvegataḥ ||44|| jalaṃ prapūritaṃ bhūri vāyutāḍanavakritā | gatā jalatalaṃ tūrṇaṃ tāvacchrībhagavān svayam ||45|| drāgeva tatra cāyātastale kūrmasvarūpataḥ | pṛṣṭhe cakāra naukā tāṃ jalopari samānayat ||46|| dvitīyena ca rūpeṇa naukāvāho’bhavat prabhuḥ | anyairdaśasvarūpaiśca jalaniṣkāsako’bhavat ||47|| anyairviṃśatirūpaiśca jale magnām̐stu mānavān | uddhṛtyoddhṛtya ca naukāmadhye sarvānavāsṛjat ||48|| naukāgatāni vastūni jalāntaḥpatitāni ca | yāni tānyapi hastaiścoddhṛtya nāvi samākṣipat ||49|| jhaṃjhāvātaśca kṛpayā ruddho jalaṃ sthiraṃ hyabhūt | naukā sthirābhavaccāpi bhaktā bhagavatāvitāḥ ||2.63.50|| jhanjhāvātena ye cānye bhaktā naukāntare’pi ca | āsan magnāśca salile tānuddadhāra līlayā ||51|| evaṃ rakṣāṃ svabhaktānāṃ kṛtvā bhūtvaikarūpadhṛk | kiśoraḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatra tiro’bhavat ||52|| nāvikaiḥ sā śanaiḥ śanaiścālitā tvagragā yayau | prāptā śrīsomanāthaṃ sā tatra pakṣasthirīkṛtā ||53|| nauvāhām̐statra saṃsthāpya vasumedhaḥ sasārthakaḥ | śakaṭaistvarito bhūtvā prācīṃ sarasvatīṃ yayau |||54|| tatra snātvā pitṛdevām̐starpayitvā tataḥ param | arkatīrthaṃ tathā balimakhasthalaṃ yayau śubham ||55|| tataścāgre vāmanasya sthalīṃ vastrāpathaṃ tathā| svarṇarekhākṛtasnāno yayau rāṣṭrasarovaram ||56 || vaṭasthalīṃ yayau paścād yayau kuṃkumavāpikām | dūrād vilokya tatkṣetraṃ cakāra bhuvi daṇḍavat ||57|| aśvapaṭṭasaro gatvā snātvā tīrthavidhiṃ tathā | kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ sarvatīrthāni sampraṇamya ca || 58|| mahāsaudhaṃ yayau draṣṭuṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram | kānake mandire divyasiṃhāsanagataṃ harim ||59 || madhyasūryaprabhaṃ candrānanaṃ śītalakāntikam | rūpānurūpāvayavaṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukānvitam ||2.63.6 0|| sauvarṇamukuṭaṃ ratnahīramauktikamālinam | devamānavagāndharvaiḥ stutaṃ saṃpūjitaṃ janaiḥ ||61|| natvā tuṣṭāva ca premṇākuṭumbasahito vasuḥ | netrāśrūṇi pramuktvā vihvalo gadgadayā girā ||62|| bahujanmārjitapuṇyaiḥ prāpyate puṇyaśālibhiḥ | yaḥ pareśaḥ sa mayāpto rakṣa māṃ parameśvara ||6 3|| yogibhiryogayatnaiśca prāpyate bahuvatsaraiḥ | sa mayādya prabhurlabdho rakṣa māṃ parameśvara ||64|| bhaktaiḥ samprāpyate bhaktyā sarvasvārpaṇayā tu yaḥ | so’yaṃ śrīkāntabhagavān mayāpto rakṣa māṃ hare ||65|| tapatāṃ cirakāle’pi kaṣṭasādhyo haristu yaḥ | prāpto mayādya jīveśo rakṣa māṃ puruṣottama ||66|| tārito’bdhau pramajjan vai kuṭumbasahitastvayā | samuttāraya deveśa saṃsārābdheśca māṃ punaḥ ||67|| tvāṃ vinā jīvanaṃ nāsti santi prāṇā na śāśvatāḥ | tvāṃ vinā sampadaḥ sarvā vipadaḥ sambhavanti vai ||68|| tvaṃ hṛdi tvaṃ cakṣuṣośca tvamātmani virājase | tvaṃ kuṭumbe ca naukāyāṃ jale sthale virājase ||69|| adya me saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ tīrthacāraṇam | saphalaṃ me kuṭumbaṃ ca sarvaṃ saphalatāṃ gatam ||2.63.70|| yadarthaṃ tu gṛhaṃ tyaktvā nirgatastīrthavāñcchayā | tāni tīrthāni sarvāṇi nirvṛttānyatra te pade ||71|| prāptaṃ prāptavyamevātra kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate | rakṣa nātha kṛpāsindho tavāsmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||72|| ityuktvā pūjayāmāsa papāta caraṇe muhuḥ | ratnabhūṣāmbarādyaiśca sugandhacandanādibhiḥ ||73|| kuṭumbaṃ tasya sarvaṃ ca pūjayāmāsa taṃ harim | tiṣṭaṃśca śrīhareragre nīrājanamathākarot ||74|| śrīharerājñayā miṣṭaṃ bhojyaṃ phalajalādikam | arpayāmāsa ca tatra sthālyāṃ tvagre harestataḥ ||75|| bhagavān bubhuje premṇā prasādaṃ śeṣamamṛtam | dadau ca vasumedhāya kuṭumbine’tyanugrahāt ||76|| vasumedhādayaḥ sarve bubhujire papurjalam | nyūṣurviśrāntisaudhe ca datte bhagavatā tataḥ ||77|| evaṃ te daśadivasān yāpayāmāsureva tu | ekādaśe dine prātarvasumedhastathā priyā ||78|| suśīlā prātarevainamapaśyatāṃ narāyaṇam | svapne vimānamāruhya dhāma netuṃ samāgatam ||79|| athāsau dharmamedhastu suśīlā ca drutaṃ tadā | putrādīṃśca samudbodhya svāpnaṃ vṛttāntamuttamam ||2.63.80|| tebhyo’kathayatāṃ sarvaṃ mokṣalābhātmasūcakam | putrā harṣaṃ paraṃ prāptāḥ snātvā sampūjya devatāḥ ||8 1 || tūrṇaṃ yayuśca te sarve bālakṛṣṇālayaṃ tadā | haristebhyo dadau naijaṃ darśanaṃ nijagāda tān ||82|| lomaśādvai pragṛhṇantu mantraṃ dīkṣāṃ srajaṃ tathā | tato’dya sāyaṃ pitrorvo mokṣagatirbhaviṣyati ||83|| ityuktāste satvaraṃ ca yayuḥ śrīlomaśāśramam | jagṛhuśca manuṃ dīkṣāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ taulasīṃ srajam ||84|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | gṛhītvā ca manuṃ bhojyaṃ dānaṃ bahuvidhaṃ daduḥ ||85||| āyayuśca nijāvāsaṃ bhejuḥ śrībālakṛṣṇakam | aparāhṇe dhyānamagnau tvabhūtāṃ pitarau tadā ||86|| putrāḥ kṣamāmayācanta sevāṃ cakruryathocitām | kṣaṇāntare samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ divyapārṣadam ||87|| vasumedhaṃ suśīlāṃ ca divyadehau vidhāya ca | nītavacca brahmadhāma putrā dhanyaṃ vyadhustadā ||88|| aurdhvadaihikamevāsya kṛtavantaḥ samāhitāḥ | evaṃ mokṣagatiṃ prāptau bhaktau nārāyaṇāśritau ||89|| putrāścakruḥ śrāddhakarma tathānyacca yathocitam | yayuḥ śakaṭamārgeṇa yatra naukā pravartate ||2.63.90|| nāvamāruhya ca sarve naijaṃ deśaṃ yayurhi te | prāpya deśaṃ camatkāraṃ prāhurnārāyaṇasya vai || 91 || śrutvā janā hariṃ bhejuḥ sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamam | evaṃ te kathitaṃ rādhe caritraṃ pāvanaṃ hareḥ || 92|| bhuktimuktipradaṃ śroturvaktuḥ rakṣākaraṃ sadā | tīrthaphalapradaṃ svargapradaṃ sampatpradaṃ śubham ||93|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne candrodayapattanavāsino vasumedhaśreṣṭhino narmadādvārā naukayā tīrthārthaṃ saurāṣṭrasamudre yātasya jhaṃjhāvātena jalamagnasya sakuṭumbasyottāraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena kṛtaṃ, muktidānaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 63 ||
<2.64> śrīrādhikovāca parabrahma kṛpāsindho gopanāthāhvayaṃ śubham | tīrthaṃ saurāṣṭrasāmudratīre proktaṃ tvayā hare || 1 || kathaṃ kadā tu tajjātaṃ kathaṃ tannāma sārthakam | vada mahyaṃ yathāvattu kṛṣṇa kānta pareśvara || 2 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvācaśṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike divyāṃ kathāṃ tu mama gocarām | pūrvapūrveṣu kalpeṣu śrīkṛṣṇā bahavo’bhavan || 3 || pūrvāhṇe brahmaṇastatra prātarevādyavatsare | ādye dine tu golokādahaṃ rādhe tvayā saha || 4 || utpannaṃ tvetadaṇḍaṃ vai prārthanayā tu vedhasaḥ | draṣṭuṃ samāgatastatra yatra mayā maṇirmama || 5 || nikṣiptaścātra gole sa saurāṣṭraviṣayo’bhavat | tatrāgatya mayā divyavimānaṃ svarṇanirmitam || 6 || gopagopīgaṇairjuṣṭaṃ gobhiryuktaṃ manoharam | vistṛte ca maṇerdeśe vyomno mayāvatāritam || 7 || gopā gopyaśca rādhe tvamahaṃ nyūṣurjalāntikam | bhuktavantaścāmṛtāni dugdhāni ca gavāṃ tathā || 8 || gāvastatra viharanti gopāḥ krīḍanti tadvane | gopyo gopā ramante ca divye mannirmite sthale || 9 || tatrāhaṃ tu tvayā sākaṃ rādhe vṛkṣeṣu sarvataḥ | gobhirgopairgopībhiśca vyacaraṃ vāsamācaran || 2.64.1 0|| tadā sanatkumārādyāḥ ṛṣayastatra cāyayuḥ | jñātvā śrīśaṃkaro bhakto viṣṇuścāyayatustadā || 11 || gopairmayā tvayā cāpi gopībhistau susatkṛtau | pūjitau vandito miṣṭaṃ bhojitau sevitau mudā || 12|| yatra sthāne kṛtāvāsau śrīviṣṇuśaṃkarau surau | gopaiḥ sampūjitau tatra surau hariharātmakau || 13|| tāvat tatra samāyāto brahmā vijñāya satvaram| so’pi saṃpūjito gopairmayā tvayā ca satkṛtaḥ || 14|| athānye pārṣadā jñātvā viṣṇorharasya vedhasaḥ | devyo dāsyaḥ samāyātāstasthustatra same sthale || 15|| tato’haṃ pṛṣṭavām̐stebhyo mayā pṛthvyāṃ śubhe sthale | prākaṭyamiṣyate śīghraṃ lokakalyāṇahetave || 16|| tāvat tatra samāyātau dharaṇimeruparvatau | prārthayāmāsatustau māṃ putrārthaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ satām || 17|| mayā tathāstviti proktaṃ tau tadā brahmaṇaḥ śubham | mānasaṃ yugalaṃ jātaṃ mānavaṃ tu surāṣṭrake || 18|| nāmnā merudharo gopaḥ kṣamādevī ca gopikā | somanāthasamīpe tau divyaṃ vāsaṃ pracakratuḥ ||19|| gopā gopyastathā gāvaḥ sampūjya tu hariṃ haram | yayuḥ sarve kṣamādevyā sākaṃ ca meruṇā saha ||2.64.20|| siṃhāraṇye kṛtāvāsāstiṣṭhanti sma ca moditāḥ | śaṃbhuḥ śrīgopanāthaśca viṣṇurgopīśvarastathā ||21 || yatsthāne pūjitau tatra mūrtyātmānau babhūvatuḥ | tatra gopāśca gopyaśca nityamāyānti yānti ca ||22|| gopanāthaṃ tu tattīrthaṃ jātaṃ hariharātmakam | pāvanaṃ paramaṃ rādhe tava me pādapāvitam ||23 || yatra meruḥ svayaṃ cāste kṣamā ca jananī mama | tatrāhaṃ rādhike jātaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo mānasaḥ sutaḥ ||24|| tvaṃ mayā saha gopyaśca mānasyaścetarā api | vyajāyanta ca tatraiva merukoṭītipattane ||25|| hiraṇyā vidyate yatra yatra prācī sarasvatī | someśo vidyate yatra sā bhūmirmerukoṭikā ||26|| pradeśaḥ sa ca me līlāmayaḥ pūrvaprage’bhavat | rādhe tvaccaraṇavyāpto mokṣadvāramapāvṛtam ||27|| sanatkumāro bhagavān gururme tatra cābhavat | gopā gopāṃganā gāvastatra nyūṣuḥ sadā mama ||28|| gopālo’haṃ tadā cāsaṃ mūlamādyaṃ sthalaṃ mama | mūlā sā dvārikā me’tra merukoṭītiviśrutā ||29|| pūrve śatruṃjitā yāvat paścime tu sarasvatī | uttare tu mahābhadrānadī kṣetraṃ purā mama ||2.64.3 0 || kṛtasmaraḥ parvataśca siṃhāraṇyaṃ mahadvanam | vyāghrāraṇyaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaraśceti ca bhūrmama ||3 1 || vihārasya parā bhūmiścāsīd rādhe vinodinī | yatra gopāśca gopyaśca gāvaśca vyomamārgagāḥ ||32|| viharanti sma nityaṃ vai merudevapratāpataḥ | tatra me pārṣadā devā devyaśca kṛtaketanāḥ ||33|| nyūṣuḥ sthale sthale sarve mama sevecchayā sadā | saurāṣṭraṃ kṛṣṇabhaktābhirgopībhiḥ pūritaṃ tadā ||34|| āsīd rādhe ca gopaiśca golokaṃ dhāma tattathā | gāruḍī saṃhitā cāsīnmamaiśvaryavivecinī ||35|| madhuvatyāstaṭe tatra mamāsīt kuñjabhūmikā | siṃhāraṇyasya madhye ca divyālayaḥ purā mama ||36|| parikhāveṣṭitaścāsīdakhātamadhyaśobhitaḥ | yojanadvayavistārodyānamadhye vyavasthitaḥ ||37|| yatra patnyo mama sarvā rājñyaścāsan suśobhanāḥ | vaihāyasā vimānena sarvayātrākarāḥ priyāḥ ||38|| pārṣadā mama vai sarve saurāṣṭre vividhe sthale | devā devyastadā nyūṣurmamājñayā ca rādhike ||3 9|| ādityā dvādaśa rudrā ekādaśāśvināvubhau | vasavo’ṣṭau nidhayo’pi navāṣṭasiddhayastathā ||2.64.40|| saptarṣayo daśabāṇā manavastithidevatāḥ | kalāstattvāni nakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ guṇakoṭayaḥ ||41|| maruto yoginīcakraṃ kalā nāḍyaśca dāsikāḥ | vālakhilyāḥ pūrvasṛṣṭibhavā nyūṣurmamāśraye ||42||| virajā kamalā gaṃgā ramā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī | durgā rādhā padminī ca pārvatī mañjulā prabhā ||43|| saguṇā śāradā haṃsā suśīlā subhagā śriyaḥ | ityādyā mama golokādāgatya ca mamālaye ||44|| vāsaṃ cakrustathā nadyastīrthāni divyabhūmikāḥ | kalpavṛkṣāḥ kalpavallyaḥ kalpastambatṛṇādayaḥ ||45|| kalpayānāni ca kalpamaṇayaḥ kalpamālikāḥ | kalpapātrāṇi ca kalpopaskaraṇāni yānyapi ||46|| kalpapāvaṭikāḥ kalpagūṭikāḥ kalpakaṇṭhikāḥ | kalpormikāśca divyāstā mūrtimatyo vasanti hi ||47|| evaṃ vai rādhike tubhyaṃ smāritaṃ prāgudantakam | gurjare ca marau kacche dakṣiṇe cottare tathā ||48|| pūrve’pi mama janmāni hyanantāni bhavanti hi | kvacid deve kvacit| tvārṣe kvacicca mānave kule ||49|| dvije vānyakule cāsmi saṃjātaḥ kāryakāṃkṣayā | tvaṃ māṃ naiva kadācicca tyajasyeva hṛdi sthitā ||2.64.50 || yatra kvāpi sthitaścāsmi tvayā sahaiva rādhike | goloke gomaṇḍale ca gopījane’pi sarvadā ||51 || gopeṣvapi ca rādhe tvāṃ jahāmyeva na karhicit | yathātmāhaṃ tathā tvaṃ ca mama śaktiḥ parā matā ||52|| evaṃ māṃ bhajamānāstu saśaktikaṃ pareśvaram | yānti dhāma tu golokaṃ mama pārśve vasanti te ||53|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ rādhe mama janmādi prāgbhavam | smaraṇācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktirmuktiḥ prajāyate ||54|| jīrṇoddhāraṃ kariṣyanti kārayiṣyanti matsthale | te malloke mama pārśve nivatsyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||55||| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne gopanāthamāhātmye saurāṣṭre śrīkṛṣṇasya sarvādikṣetratīrthakṣetranirūpaṇanāmā catuḥṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 64 ||
<2.65> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca athāpi tvaṃ śṛṇu rādhe sarvapāvanapāvanam | ārṣaṃ vidhānaṃ kṛṣṇasya lokaṃ cānusṛtasya ha || 1 || svayaṃ vedapraṇetā yo brahmāṇaṃ śāsti vai purā | so’yaṃ lokaṃ samāśritya pālayitvā vidhiṃ nijam || 2 || gṛhṇāti brahmasaṃskāraṃ prākṛto brahmapā yathā | dvijatvaṃ yena sṛṣṭyādau nirmitaṃ śreyase sadā || 3 || sa tu sūtraṃ samagṛhya dvijo bhavati cādvijaḥ | yasya saṃsparśanānnāryo narā vṛkṣāśca vallayaḥ || 4 || paśupretapiśācādyāḥ śuddhyanti cātmadarśinaḥ | yasya yogena kāmādyā bhajante divyatāṃ sadā || 5 || yadyogaṃ prāpya yakṣā vā rākṣasā mlecchayonayaḥ | divyā bhavanti ca kṣaṇāt so’yaṃ brahmagraho’bhavat || 6 || rādhike lomaśaḥ prāha pitaraṃ mātaraṃ hareḥ | yajñopavītayogyo’yaṃ vartate yajñapāvanaḥ || 7 || deyaṃ cāsmai brahmasūtraṃ sūtrayitre parātmane | śrutvaivaṃ śobhanaṃ vākyaṃ lomaśasya mukhāttataḥ || 8 || prasannau pitarau yogyaṃ praṇematurmuniṃ tadā | bhaktyā gopālakṛṣṇaśca divyaṃ gajāsanaṃ dadau || 9 || madhuparkaṃ dadau hārān miṣṭānnaṃ salilaṃ dadau | tāmbūlaṃ pradadau cāpi phalaṃ vastraṃ śubhaṃ dadau || 2.65.1 0|| uvāca lomaśaṃ śubhotsavakṣaṇaṃ kuru prabho | vaiśākho’yaṃ samāyāti bhavate rocate yadi || 11 || kartavyaścotsavastatra mama bhātyeva sarvathā | yajñopavītayogyaṃ ca dinaṃ śasyaṃ pradarśaya || 12|| lomaśastu tataḥ prāha śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakam | akṣayā cottamā cāste tṛtīyākṣayadāyinī || 13|| candrarkṣabalaśuddhyādi sarvaṃ śubhaṃ pravartate | āmantraṇaṃ ca trailokye sarvebhyo dehi tattathā || 14|| saṃbhārān divyabhogāṃśca sañcinuhyatidurlabhān | bhinnalokanivāsānāṃ yogyān sevyottamottamān || 15|| lomaśasya vacaḥ śrutvā śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ | preṣayāmāsa sarvatra divyā maṃgalapatrikāḥ || 16|| aśvapaṭṭasarovāsaiḥ pārṣadaiḥ sevakaistathā | vimānasthairdivyayānaiḥ preṣayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ || 17|| janmāṣṭame’bde vaiśākhe śukle’kṣayatithau mama | putrasya śrīhareryajñopavītaṃ vai bhaviṣyati || 18|| avatāraistathā muktairmuktābhirdhāmabhiḥ saha | brahmabhiḥ pārṣadaiḥ pārṣadānībhiḥ saha sarvathā || 19|| satībhiḥ sevikābhiścāvatāriṇībhirityapi | īśābhirīśvaraiścāpi ṛṣibhiśca kuṭumbibhiḥ ||2.65.20|| sādhubhiryatibhiścāpi bhaktairbhāgavataiḥ saha | bhāgavatābhirbhaktābhiḥ samāgantavyamādarāt ||21 || pitṛbhiḥ patnikāyuktairdevairdevīsamanvitaiḥ | dikpālairlokapālaiśca grahanakṣatramaṇḍalaiḥ ||22|| tārābhiśca tathā tattvairbhuvarvāsibhirityapi | mānavairdrumavallyādyaiḥ kalpapādapavaṃśajaiḥ ||23|| tṛṇaiḥ stambaiḥ samudbhijjairaṇḍajairgāyakairjanaiḥ | vidyādhraiḥ kinnaraiścāpi kimpuṃbhirnṛtyavedibhiḥ ||24|| nartakībhiścāraṇaiśca dharmādharmādivaṃśajaiḥ | surāsurakuṭumbaiśca digīśvaraiḥ samantataḥ ||25|| āgantavyaṃ yajñasūtrotsave madbālakasya vai | tīrthairnadanadībhiścāraṇyairvanaiḥ sarovaraiḥ ||26|| samudrākhātakūpādyairnagaiḥ khagaiḥ samantataḥ | vasundharāsthitaiḥ sarvairāgantavyaṃ ca pakṣibhiḥ ||27|| guṇairguṇāśrayaiścāpi mūrtāmūrtaiḥ samādarāt | kālaiḥ ṛtubhirādyābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ sahavatsaraiḥ ||28|| kāmadhenubhirevāpi vasubhiḥ siddhibhistathā | nidhibhirviṣṇurudrādyairbrahmādyairbahumastakaiḥ ||29|| indrādirājavaryaiśca mānavairmunibhistathā | vipraiḥ kṣatriyavaryaiśca vaiśyaiśca sevakaistathā ||2.65.3 0|| sāttvikaiḥ rājasaiścāpi tāmasairmāyikaistathā | māyābhiḥ prakṛtibhiścāgantavyaṃ copavītake ||3 1 || atalādisthitairdaityairdānavaiścāsurairapi | nāgaiḥ sarpaiḥ sahabandhumitrakuṭumbidehibhiḥ ||3 2|| āgantavyaṃ vāhanaiśca sādhanaiśca rasaistathā | divyādivyābhirevātra vidyābhiśca kalādibhiḥ ||33 || bhavatāṃ tejasā sārairāśīrbhirmama bālakaḥ | vardhito yajñavat puṇyarāśiḥ sampatsyate dhruvam ||34||| ityevaṃ preṣayitvā ca patrikāḥ sevakaistataḥ | śuddhasattvavibhūteśca yāni bhojyāni dhāmasu ||35|| pare brahmaṇyakṣare ca goloke ca vikuṇṭhake | amṛte ceśvaraloke satyaloke’mṛtāni ca ||36|| brahmajalāni divyāni lehyacoṣyāṇi yānyapi | teṣāṃ ca sañcayām̐statra kārayāmāsa satvaram ||37|| bhuvarmaharjanalokādiṣvapi yāni yāni ca | khādyapeyopakāryāṇi teṣāṃ ca sañcayām̐stathā ||38|| svarge tapasi mervādau pṛthvyāṃ pātālasaptake | bhojyakhādyaprapeyāni copakāryāṇi yāni ca || 39|| mṛdyasevyopabhogyāni dehiyogyāni yāni ca | calasthāvarayogyāni mūrtāmūrtārthakāni ca ||2.65.40|| teṣāṃ sarvapravastūnāṃ sañcayānavyayām̐stathā | kārayāmāsa bahudhā śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||41 || brahmahadān kalpahradān kalpavṛkṣarasādikān | akṣayāṇi ca pātrāṇi āpūrakadalām̐stathā ||42|| avyayān kośapadmām̐śca siddhipātrottamāni ca | sañcayāmāsa paritaḥ siddhayaṣṭīśca gūṭikāḥ ||43|| sahasrapradapātrāṇi cintāmaṇīn bahūm̐stathā | camatkārakṛtām̐ścāpi brahmapuṣpottamāni ca ||44|| devamāyāprakāṇḍāni devīsūtrāṇi yāni ca | aindrajālikapāśām̐śca maṇikān lakṣadām̐stathā ||45|| mantrayantrāṇi tantrāṇi camatkārakaṇām̐stathā | yogaiśvaryāmṛtanālīḥ sañcayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ ||46|| yogacullīryogadarvīryogakaṭāhavāṭikāḥ | yogasthālīryogadīpān sañcayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ ||47|| yogāsanāni sarvāṇi sārvabhaumāmṛtāni ca | kalpartūn kalpakaṇṭhīśca kalpavalayakormikāḥ ||48|| sañcayāmāsa bahudhā yāvadātithyahetave | bhautikāni ca bhojyāni peyāni bhautikāni ca ||49|| sūkṣmabhūtajabhojyāni peyāni sūkṣmajānyapi | vyaktajanyāni bhojyāni peyāni vyaktajāni ca ||2.65.50|| avyaktajāni bhojyāni peyānyavyaktajāni ca | māyājanyāni sarvāṇi tathā brāhmāṇi yāni ca ||51|| ākṣarāṇyapi divyāni ātmamayāni yāni ca | snehajānyapi sarvāṇi puṇyatattvodbhavāni ca ||52|| sarvāṇyapi ca bhogyāni sañcayāmāsa sarvataḥ | rasakulyā ghṛtakulyā dadhikulyā manoharāḥ ||53|| madhukulyā guḍakulyāḥ śarkarākhaṇḍikāhradān | ikṣukulyā amṛtānāṃ hradān miṣṭasarāṃsi ca ||54|| sañcayāmāsa paritaḥ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ | upahārasahasrāṇāṃ parvatān pracakāra saḥ ||55|| ratnānāṃ ca maṇīnāṃ ca mauktikānāṃ samucchrayān | suvarṇānāṃ rūpyakāṇāṃ hīrakāṇāṃ ca parvatān ||56|| māṇikyānāṃ ca muktānāṃ vibhūṣāṇāṃ ca parvatān | vastrālaṃkārarāśīṃśca kārayāmāsa vai tadā ||57|| cūrṇānāṃ gandhasārāṇāṃ tailānāṃ ca sugandhinām | lepānāṃ kajjalānāṃ ca raṃgānāṃ sañcayām̐stathā |||58|| candanānāṃ kuṃkumānā kesarāṇāṃ ca saṃcayān | kastūrīṇāṃ cauṣadhānāṃ rāśīn cakāra cāvyayān ||59|| darpaṇānāṃ kaṃkatīnāṃ śuddhidravyamṛdāṃ tathā | śayanānāṃ ca dolānāmāsanānāṃ ca cakriṇām ||2.65.60|| yānānāṃ vāhanānāṃ cāsaṃkhyasañcayakān vyadhāt | evaṃ sarvopabhogyādau sampanne pūrṇatāṃgate ||61 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sasmāra vai kramāt | paradhāmasthamuktām̐śca muktānīrapi sarvaśaḥ ||62|| akṣarasthān muktavargān muktānīrapi cākṣaram | avatārānavatāriṇīśca pārṣadapuṃgavān ||63|| pārṣadānīśca vai bhaktān bhaktānīrapi sarvaśaḥ | caturviṃśativiṣṇūm̐śca caturvyūhām̐stathā kramāt ||64|| parameśānīśvarām̐śca īśvarāṇīśca sarvaśaḥ | vairājān brahmaśaṃbhūm̐śca rudrān viṣṇūn ṛṣīṃstathā ||65|| sādhūn sādhvīḥ satīḥ patnīḥ priyā devī ramādikāḥ | rādhāṃ lakṣmīṃ pārvatīṃ ca prabhāṃ haṃsāṃ ca māṇikīm ||66|| dvādaśottaraśatamukhyāśca patnīrnijāḥ parāḥ | koṭidāsīstathā dāsān golokasthān gavādikān ||67|| caturvaikuṇṭhasaṃsthām̐śca badaryāśramavāsinaḥ | satyasthān svargavāsām̐śca parasvargagatām̐stathā ||68|| pitṛn siddhān cāraṇām̐śca munīndrān suramānavān | sasmāra ca diśāṃ pālān nṛpatīn surapālakān ||69|| bhuvaḥsthān pṛthivīsthām̐śca saptapātālavāsinaḥ | jalasthalasthitān sarvān sthāvarān jaṃgamām̐stathā ||2.65.70|| brahmasarasastathā cāpsarasaḥ kanyakottamāḥ | bhāṭacāraṇagandharvān kiṃpuṃkinnaramāgadhān ||71|| cāraṇān vādakām̐ścāpi gāyakān nartakāṃstathā | naṭān nāṭakakartṝṃśca nāṭyasaṃghapradarśakān ||72|| mallān kalākarām̐ścāpi mahendrajālikām̐stathā | svādakarām̐stathā sūdān pākinaḥ pariveṣakān ||73|| yajñīyān yajñavetṝm̐śca karmakāṇḍaparām̐stathā | brāhmaṇām̐śca maharṣīṃśca kṣetradvārādipālakān ||74|| sasmāra divyatattvāni divyāmūrtikamānavān | jalasthalanivāsām̐śca daityadānavarākṣasān ||75|| dīnān raṃkān sataḥ sāṃkhyayoginīśca pativratāḥ | kanyā devīśca kulajāḥ kulapūjyāśca yoginīḥ ||76|| kailāsabadarīvāsān kṣīraśvetanivāsinaḥ | pṛthvīsthakhaṇḍavāsām̐śca sasmāra śrīharistadā ||77|| bhaktān gopān gopikāśca koṭyarbudābjaśevadhīn | sasmāra vālakhilyām̐śca yatīn jñānāśrayān nijān ||78|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāminarāyaṇaḥ | sasmāra divyamanasā bhaktāṃśca bhaktavatsalaḥ ||79|| akṣayāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ prātaḥ sarve samāyayuḥ | brahmavadgatikā yānairvaihāyasaiśca mānasaiḥ ||2.65.80|| ātmayānairyogayānaiḥ samādhivāhanaistathā | vāyuvāhaiścāmbarātmavāhanaiśca samāyayuḥ ||8 1 || garuḍaiśca tathā haṃsaiḥ śukairmayūramūṣakaiḥ | vināyakā gaṇeśāśca vighneśāstatra cāyayuḥ |||82||| gajairaśvairanalaiśca kuṃjakaiḥ sārasādibhiḥ | meghairgrahaistathā vidyullatābhiḥ kiraṇaistathā ||83|| sūryacandrādayastūrṇaṃ tejovāhāḥ samāgatāḥ | manovāhāḥ kalpavāhā vegavāhāḥ samāyayuḥ ||84|| muktāścāpyavatārāśca vyūhāścāpīśvarāstathā | brahmadhāmagatāḥ sarve īśadhāmagatāstathā ||85|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo lakṣmīrādhāramādikāstathā | koṭikoṭyarbujābjādiśevadhiśrīsakhīyutāḥ ||86|| koṭikoṭyarbujābjādisevakaiḥ sahitāstathā | rāmamādhavagovindā gopālā gopikāstathā ||87|| viṣṇavo vaiṣṇavīśaktipramukhā bhūmadevatāḥ | vairājā brahmarudrādyāḥ śatakoṭipramastakāḥ ||88|| satyasthāḥ sādhavo devā yataya brahmacāriṇaḥ | vedā vidyāstathā mantrā yajñā havīṃṣi yāni ca ||89|| samāyayurdivyarūpā vahnayo marutastathā | tejāṃsi cāpi sarvāṇi pitaraḥ ṛṣayo’marāḥ ||2.65.90|| pramunīndrāḥ satpuruṣāḥ satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ pativratāḥ | brahmapriyāḥ kṛṣṇapriyā devapriyāḥ samantataḥ ||91|| caturdaśabhuvanānāṃ rājñyo rājāna ityapi | brahmakanyāḥ ṛṣikanyā jalakanyāḥ samudrajāḥ ||92|| devakanyā nāgakanyā rājakanyāśca koṭiśaḥ | kumārikāśca gāndharvyo vidyādharyaśca sarvaśaḥ ||93|| vādikā vādakāścāpi yaśogāyāḥ samāyayuḥ | bhāṇḍakāścāraṇādyāśca bhāṭā naṭāśca nartakāḥ ||94|| caiṣṭikā aitihikāḥ kathakā hāsakā api | brāhmaṇā bhikṣukāḥ sanyāsārthā muṇḍadharāstathā ||95|| avadhūtā brahmacārā yogacārāḥ samāyayuḥ | svastrībāndhavabālādyairyutā dvitīyaviśramāḥ ||96|| patnīvratasya vaṃśāśca pativratākuṭumbinaḥ | bandhubāndhavayogāśca tadyogāstatsuyoginaḥ ||97|| naikakṣityudbhavāḥ sarve varṣmadhrā hi samāyayuḥ | viṣṇugaṇā rudragaṇā brahmagaṇā asaṃkhyakāḥ ||98|| dīpāvalyo nālamedhyaḥ ṣaṣṭhīdevyastalājikā | gokumāryastathārjantyā yuvatyaḥ śatakanyakāḥ ||99|| koṭiśaḥ kandarā kanyāstathā krodhanikā satī | lakṣaṃ ca rākṣasīkanyāḥ kaṃkatālyaśca pañcaṣaḥ || 2.65.10 0|| kaṃkatālikakanyāśca sahasraśo hyupasthitāḥ | brahmakanyā jalakanyāryamakanyāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 10 1|| kuberakanyakāścendrakanyā yamasutāstathā | vāyukanyāḥ ṛtukanyā viśvakarmasutāstathā || 1 02|| drumakanyā dānavādikanyāpañcasahasrakam | vasantasya tathā patnyaḥ ṣoḍaśāpi hyupasthitāḥ || 1 03|| vahnikanyāstathā sālamālakanyāsahasrakam | śravaṇakanyakāḥ śāvadīnakanyāsahasrakam || 1 04|| aindrajālikaraudryaśca sahasrakanyakāstathā | vidyākanyāḥ kiśoryaśca ṣaṣṭikanyā hyupasthitāḥ || 1 05|| samvatsarasya kanyāśca vārkṣyaḥ kanyā asaṃkhyakāḥ | khanijāḥ kanyakāścāpi sopakuṃbhā hyupasthitāḥ || 10 6|| upasthitā lakṣmaṇasya sahasradvayaputrikāḥ | upasthitā viśvāvasostadā triśataputrikāḥ || 107 || dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi vedhaḥkanyā upasthitāḥ | jumāsemlānṛpasyāpi tasthuḥ sahasrakanyakāḥ || 1 08|| kārṣṇyaḥ kumārikāḥ śatottaradvādaśasaṃkhyakāḥ | māgalyārthaṃ harestasya kāntasyārthamupasthitāḥ || 1 09|| cakrustāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya kīrtanāni vai | āgatebhyaśca saṃghebhyaścāvāsān pradadau pitā || 2.65.11 0|| satkārān madhuparkādi yathārhaṃ bahudhā dadau | athāpi rādhike tatra samāyānti maharṣayaḥ || 11 1|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhoraṣṭame varṣe vaiśākhe yajñopavītamahotsave āmantraṇapatrikādvārā sarveṣāmāgamanādinidarśananāmā pañcaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 65 ||
<2.66> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike divyamaharṣayaḥ samāyayuḥ | samīraṇaḥ pavamānaḥ santāraṇaśca barburaḥ || 1 || voḍhuśca ghanabhedaśca dyuviśrāmaśca paṃkilaḥ | nīlakarṇastathālarkaḥ puṇḍarīkaḥ kalāyanaḥ || 2 || vītihotraśca camasaḥ parṇakutso’śvapāṭalaḥ | bhāllaveyaścorjavrataścāśvalāyana ityapi | | 3 || pārṣṇiradaḥ sumantuśca hyaśokākṣo’bhayākṣakaḥ | brahmastambaḥ kūpyavālaścetanabrahma
