ityapi || 4 || mṛtadaṇḍaścopatasthustatratyāstanmahotsave | sadāraputrakanyādyāḥ sabhṛtyadāsadāsikāḥ || 5 || kauṇḍinyaḥ kauśikaḥ pautimāṣyo gaupavanastathā | śāṇḍilyo gautamaścāgniveśyaścāmlāna ityapi || 6 || saitavaḥ prācīnayogyo dhārāśaryaśca maindavaḥ | bhāradvājo vaijavāpāyanaśca kauśikāyaniḥ || 7 || ghṛtakauśikayāskau cāsurāyaṇaśca traivaṇiḥ | jātūkarṇya aupajaghanyāsurī māṇṭivātsyakau || 8 || kaiśoryaḥ kāpya ātreyaḥ kumārahāritastathā | vaidarbhī vatsanapāto gālavaḥ saubharistathā || 9 || panthā ayāsya ābhūtistvāṣṭro’śvinau dadhīcakaḥ | viśvarūpo vipracitiḥ prādhvaṃsana ātharvaṇaḥ || 2.66.10 || sanārurvyaṣṭirekarṣiḥ sanagaśca sanātanaḥ | uddālakāyano jābālāyanaḥ parameṣṭhikaḥ || 11|| mādhyandināyanaḥ kāṣāyaṇaśca saukarāyaṇaḥ | aupajaṃghaniryāskaśca sāṃkṛtiḥ sāyakāyanaḥ || 12 || ete cānye vālakhilyāstathānye ṛṣipuṃgavāḥ | āyayuḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasūtramahotsave || 13 || śauṅgī sukṛtirālambī jāyantī maṇḍukāyanī | śāṇḍilī pautimāṣī ca kātyāyanī ca gautamī || 14|| dhārāśarī aupasvatī bhāradvājī ca kauśikī | kāpī vaiyāghrapadī cālambī vātsī ca saubhagī || 15|| vārkāruṇī prajāyantī cātreyī cārtabhāginī | kāṇvī ālambāyanī ca māṇḍukī bhālukī tathā || 16|| rāthītarī krauṃcikī ca vaidabhṛtyā surāyaṇī | sāñjivī prācīnayogī prāśnī ca kārśakeyikā || 17|| satīśāmaraduhitā dhanyeśvarī ca rāṇikī | ityetāḥ ṛṣipatnyaśca tatrotsave samāyayuḥ || 18|| divyā divyavibhūṣāśca vahniśuddhāṃśukānvitāḥ | tapastejobhirāpūrṇāḥ puṇyapuñjanibhāḥ śubhāḥ || 1 9|| atrirvaśiṣṭhaścyavano bharadvājo mahātapāḥ | gargo gārgyo yājñavalkyaḥ śvetavyāsaśca bhīmakaḥ || 2.66.20|| dharmo vatsaḥ pulahaśca jaigīṣavyaḥ pulastyakaḥ | agastyaḥ saubhariścāpi sanakaśca sanātanaḥ || 21 || sanandaśca sanaccāpi sujātaśca kumārakaḥ | ketuḥ pañcaśikhaścāpi durvāsāścāṃgirāstathā || 22|| śuko rāmaḥ kuśikaśca ṛṣyaśṛṃgo vibhāṇḍakaḥ | vāmadevastathā śṛṃgī kraturyatistathāruṇiḥ || 23 || śukro bṛhaspatiścāpi vāmanaḥ pāribhadrakaḥ | aṣṭāvakraśca pailaśca vālmīkī madhujittathā || 24|| pracetāḥ purujiccāpi bhṛgurmarīcirekakaḥ | dvītaścāpyatha trītaśca kātyāyanaḥ sumantukaḥ || 25|| mārkaṇḍeyaḥ kaśyapaśca dakṣaḥ sūryaḥ śaśī tathā | saṃvarttaścāpyutathyaśca naro nārāyaṇastathā || 26| viśvāmitraḥ śatānando jābālistaitilastathā | upamanyurgauramukho maitreyaśca kaṭhaḥ kacaḥ || 27|| aditiśca ditiścāpi kṛttikāśca pativratāḥ | kuṭumbaśiṣyasahitāḥ śrīkṛṣṇasyāśramaṃ yayuḥ || 28|| śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇastān vavande daṇḍavat bhuvi | atha haṃsasthito brahmā sāvitrīsahito yayau || 29|| divyayānasthitaḥ śaṃbhurvyomnā satīyuto yayau | nandī kālo vīrabhadraḥ subhadramaṇibhadrakau ||2.66.3 0 || pāribhadro gaṇeśaśca skando rudraḥ samāyayuḥ | kuberaśca varuṇaśca mahendro’gnistathānilaḥ | | 31 || yamaśca grahavasava ādityāḥ śeṣabhoginaḥ | evaṃ sarve mahadbhāvāḥ pūjyā mānyāḥ samāyayuḥ |||32|| gopālakṛṣṇo bhaktyā tān vavande śirasā bhuvi | tuṣṭāva parayā prītyā tattatsṛṣṭīśvarām̐stadā || 33|| śrīgopālakṛṣṇa uvāca parabrahma pare dhāmni rājamānaḥ pareśvaraḥ | parātparaḥ svayaṃmuktaiḥ sahitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||34|| adya vai madgṛhe cāste jagatāṃ parameśvaraḥ | aho bhāgyaṃ mama kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo’tra cāgataḥ ||35|| aho bhāgyaṃ mama vāsudevādayaḥ samāgatāḥ | aho bhāgyaṃ cāvatārāḥ parameśāḥ samāgatāḥ ||36|| īśvarā dhāmamuktāśca muktānyaśca samāgatāḥ | bhūmā virāṭ svayaṃ viṣṇurvidhātā viśvasṛṭ prabhuḥ || 37|| patnīvrato mahāvipraścāpi madgṛhamāgataḥ | siddhasādhvīyatiyogipūjyo gurorguruḥ svayam ||38|| brahmā mama gṛhe tvāste mahābhāgyaṃ mamādya vai | yaṃ prapūjya jano yāti bhuktermukteḥ salokatām .|| 39|| sarvasaṃkaṭanāśaśca yatpratāpād bhavedapi | śrīmatkṛṣṇasvarūpo’yaṃ gaṇeśo mama cālaye ||2.66.40 || devānāmagragaḥ pūjyo dhanyo’haṃ bhuvi sarvathā | śaṃkaro bhagavām̐ścāpi viṣṇurlakṣmīsamanvitaḥ ||41 || jagatāṃ jananī rādhā pārvatī cādirūpiṇī | mūlaprakṛtirādyā ca parabrahmasvarūpiṇī ||42|| yatpādau samparipūjya vāñchitaṃ labhate vratī | sā sākṣānmadgṛhe cādya vidyate jananī śubhā ||43 || dhāmakanyā dhāmamuktottamāḥ sādhyo mama gṛhe | dhanyeyaṃ kambharālakṣmīryasyāścaitadvilokanam ||44|| sampannaṃ cādya sākṣādvai brahmasṛṣṭestu yoṣitām | īśasṛṣṭeśca sādhvīnāmīśānāmapi darśanam ||45|| dhanyaṃ saraścāśvapaṭṭaṃ dhanyā kuṃkumavāpikā | dhanyaḥ saurāṣṭradeśaśca yatra śrīparameśvarāḥ ||46 || pitaraḥ ṛṣayo devā devyastattvāni madgṛhe | sarvapātālavāsāśca mūrtāmūrtaṃ gṛhe mama ||47|| adya me saphalaṃ janma saphalo’yaṃ kṛto yugaḥ | saphalaṃ sarjanaṃ cādya saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ mama ||48 || yadgehe ca mahīmānāstrisṛṣṭivāsino’dya vai | brahmasṛṣṭirīśasṛṣṭirjīvasṛṣṭirgṛhe mama ||49|| evaṃ sarvānabhivandya yogyakiṃhāsaneṣu tān | vāsayāmāsa vidhinā śātabhaume mahālaye ||2.66.50 || pūjayāmāsa vidhivat krameṇa daśayojane | kāmarūpadharaḥ koṭyarbudarūpadharaḥ pitā ||5 1 || pratyekaṃ varayāmāsa parameśān surādikān | munivargān ṛṣīn sādhūnmuktāndevāndvijāṃstathā |||52|| lomaśaṃ ca muniṃ bhaktyā vavre naijaṃ purohitam | ratnaiḥ pravālaihāraiśca kalpamuktāvibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||53 || vasanairgandhamālyaiśca maṇimāṇikyahīrakaiḥ | gandhasāraiścandanaiśca ratnasiṃhāsanasthitam ||54| | sarvamadhye śrīgaṇeśaṃ varayāmāsa pūjane | śubhakārye sthitaṃ devaṃ gajānanaṃ tu vāribhiḥ ||55|| brāhmahṛdāhṛtaiścāpi virajāhṛtavāribhiḥ | jalāvaraṇavārbhiśca svargagāmeruvāribhiḥ ||56|| saptasāmudravārbhiśca sarvatīrthajalaistathā | puṣpacandanasaugandhyāmṛtayuktaiḥ praśītalaiḥ ||57|| tathā dugdhena dadhnā ca ghṛtena madhunāpi ca | śarkarābhiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ snapayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ ||58||| gaṇeśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇarūpaṃ sarvavighnavināśakam | sarvamāṃgalyadṃ devaṃ pūjayāmāsa vastubhiḥ ||69|| pārijātasya puṣpaiśca brāhmaiśca kamalaistathā | vaikuṇṭhasya tu durvābhistathā ratnendrabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||2.66.60 || vahniśuddhāṃśukaiścāpi brāhmasindūrakaistathā | gandhacandanapuṣpaiśca sauvarṇāṅgulabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 61 || evaṃ sampūjya vidhivad gaṇeśaṃ ca tataḥ param | rādhāṃ lakṣmīṃ pārvatīṃ ca prabhāṃ śrīṃ māṇikīṃ ramām | mañjulāṃ saguṇāṃ haṃsāṃ jayāṃ ca lalitāṃ dayām |||62|| tathānyāḥ śrīsatīḥ sādhvīrdhāmadhāmanivāsinīḥ | kārṣṇīścāpi mahālakṣmīḥ sāvitrīṃ ca sarasvatīm ||63 || gaṃgāṃ ditiṃ cāditiṃ ca ṛṣipatnīḥ pativratāḥ | devīścāpīśvariṇīśca pitṛpatnīśca bhāminīḥ ||64|| yoginīḥ sāṃkhyayoginīrlopāmudrādikāstathā | pativratā mahīmānīḥ pūjayāmāsa kambharā ||65|| tathārbudābjakanyāśca saubhāgyaśobhitā api | kambharārbudarūpaiśca samāśliṣya punaḥ punaḥ ||66|| parasparaṃ ca sambhāṣya sarvāḥ saṃśliṣya vai mithaḥ | tāḥ sarvāḥ kambharālakṣmīrveśayāmāsa mandire ||67|| varayāmāsa mālyaiśca vāsobhiḥ ratnabhūṣaṇaiḥ | brahmavṛkṣasya puṣpaiśca pārijātasya puṣpakaiḥ ||68|| sindūrabindukaiścāpi sīmante śobhitaistathā | bhāle sucandrapatraiśca bindubhiścāndanaistathā || 69 || kastūrīkuṃkumālaktaprabhṛtibhiḥ sugandhikaiḥ | sampūjya bhojayāmāsa miṣṭānnaistattadarhakaiḥ ||2.66.70|| amṛtaṃ vāri tāmbūlaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam | pradadau kambharāśrīśca munipatnīḥ krameṇa tu ||71 || pūjayāmāsa vidhivat patiputravatīḥ satīḥ | dhāmakanyā īśakanyāḥ pitṛkanyā manoharāḥ ||72|| devakanyā nāgakanyā manukanyā vṛṣāśritāḥ | bandhukanyā bhaktakanyā gāndharvāsurajāstathā ||73 || pūjayāmāsa vidhinā bhojayāmāsa sādaram | vāsayāmāsa saudheṣu mahodyānānviteṣu ca ||74|| vādyāni vādayāmāsurvādakā maṃgalāni hi | maṃgalaṃ kārayāmāsa bhojayāmāsa bhūsurān ||75|| śrīdevī pūjayāmāsa kuṃkumavāpikeśvarīm | sarvaiḥ sa vastubhiḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ tathā maṃgaladevatām ||76|| grāmadevān sarodevān pūjayāmāsa bhāvataḥ | mahīmānān sarvabhāvaiḥ pūjayāmāsa vai pitā ||77|| tataḥ puṇyaṃ svastyayanaṃ kārayāmāsa maṃgalam | vedāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa gāpayāmāsa gītikāḥ ||78|| suvarṇakalaśasthaiśca gāṃgavāribhiracyutam | snāpayāmāsa mātā ca śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||79|| vastracandanamālyādyairveṣaṃ ramyaṃ cakāra sā | divyāmbaravibhūṣābhirdivyalepanacandanaiḥ ||2.66.80|| tataḥ sabhāvatārāṇāmīśvarāṇāṃ tapasvinām | ṛṣīṇāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca mānavānāṃ ca dehinām ||81 || sṛṣṭitrayāgatānāṃ ca sampannā tatra vai hariḥ | āyayau ca yadā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ sapitṛkaḥ ||82|| tadāvatārā īśāśca devā manavo mānavāḥ | ṛṣayo’nye samuttasthurvavandire pareśvaram ||83 || tvaṃ parabrahma sākṣādvai bālakṛṣṇo virājase | avatāradharastvaṃ vai sākṣī kṛpāptavigrahaḥ ||84|| nirlepaścātmaśayanaḥ sarvasṛṣṭayādikāraṇam | mahāviṣṇurvirāḍ bhūmā brahmā śeṣādayastvayi ||89 | | vartāmaḥ śrīpate kṛṣṇa brahmāṇḍe maśakā iva | tvadaṃśāśca vayaṃ santo devāḥ sma sarvasṛṣṭiṣu ||86|| brahmāṇḍāni hyasaṃkhyāni śeṣabhoge vasanti ca | śeṣastiṣṭhati kūrme ca kūrmo jale pravartate ||87|| jalaṃ tejobalādūrdhvaṃ tvabhravad vartate sadā | tejo vāyukṛtādhāraṃ vāyurākāśavartanaḥ ||88 || ākāśo’yaṃ cidākāśe cidākāśaśca cākṣare | akṣaraṃ brahmabhāve ca parameśe virājate ||89 || ayaṃ śrīparameśastvaṃ vartase kambharāsutaḥ | gopālabālakaḥ sākṣādasmadtagocaro hyasi || 2.66.90 || ityevaṃ vandito bālasvarūpaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ha | sabhāmadhye’tiśuśubhe rādhāramāprabhāpatiḥ || 91 || dvibhujaḥ śvetakāntyāḍhyaḥ svarṇavarṇo manoharaḥ | īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyo vibhūṣābhirvirājitaḥ || 92|| dehaśuddhyarthamevādau kṛtakṛcchratrayo’cyutaḥ | atha maṃgalasamaye śubhalagne samāgate || 92 || saumyagrahaiḥ paridṛṣṭe jāgrallagnādhipe sthite | asaumyagrahadṛṣṭyādyaviṣaye karma cārabhat ||94|| kāmacārāśanapānadoṣaśuddhyarthameva saḥ | dhenutrayaṃ dadau dāne svastivācamavācayat ||91|| lomaśasyājñayā svarṇasahasraṃ maṇiśevadhim | dadau dāne brāhmaṇebhyo namaścakāra devatāḥ || 96 || viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ gaṇeśaṃ pārvatīṃ sūryaṃ prapūjya ca | vahniṃ sampūjya vidhinā śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 97|| putrādhivāsanaṃ cakre vedamantraiśca saṃsadi | devān grahān diśāṃ pālān sampūjya mātṛkāstathā || 98|| nāndīśrāddhaṃ mahāśāntiṃ vidhāpya tadanantaram | sthaṇḍile ca samudbhavānale homaṃ cakāra saḥ || 99|| pradatvā vasudhārāṃ ca saptavāraṃ ghṛtaistataḥ | vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ daivaśrāddhaṃ cakre pitṛpratarpaṇam || 2.66.10 0|| kṣauritasnātamuktāyālaṃkṛtabrahmacāriṇe | kaṭisūtraṃ ca kaupīnaṃ yajñasūtraṃ dadau pitā || 101 || mauñjīṃ badhvā triraśanāṃ kaṭyāṃ karṇe ca lomaśaḥ | mantraṃ dadau ca gāyatryāstrivāraṃ dakṣiṇaśrutau || 1 02|| ājyahomaṃ kārayitvā munirdharmānupādiśat | tato bhikṣāṃ dadāvasmai śrīramārādhikāprabhāḥ || 103 || īśvarāṇyaśca muktānyaḥ sādhyo devyaśca kanyakāḥ | mahālakṣmīḥ prakṛtiśca haṃsā lakṣmīśca pārvatī || 1 04|| mañjulā saguṇā dhāmakanyā īśasutāstathā | devanāganṛpakanyāḥ sṛṣṭitrayasutādikāḥ || 1 05|| kārṣṇyaḥ sarvā lomaśasyāśramasthā divyavigrahāḥ | kaṃbharāśrīścāmṛtā ca devadaityādimātaraḥ || 1 06|| munipatnyo brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ ca yoṣitaḥ | kāminyodikprapālānāṃ dadurbhikṣāḥ pṛthak pṛthak || 107 || amūlyaratnasannaddhadivyasvarṇasupātrake | bhikṣāṃ gṛhītvā bhagavān lomaśāya dadau manāk || 108 || āmaulibrahmadaṇḍaṃ cājinamuttaravastrakam | pūjāṃ sandhyāṃ dadau kamaṇḍaluṃ śīlaṃ ca lomaśaḥ || 109 || anye sarve bhagavanto dadustasmai mahārhaṇām | bhikṣāṃ ratnāvalihārān maṇīn kāñcanavikṛtīn || 2.66.110 || amṛtāni vicitrāṇi copabhogyāni yāni ca | daduścāsmai nijalokāhṛtāni devayonayaḥ || 111 || athaivaṃ karma nirvāpya dakṣiṇāṃ lomaśāya ca | svarṇahīrakaratnāni dadau gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 112|| putrāya hīrahāraṃ ca dadau rakṣākaraṃ pitā | devyaḥ saubhāgyavatyaśca kanyāśca mātarastathā || 113 | | śubhāśiṣaṃ pradaduśca śuklapuṣpaiśca durvayā | ye ye samāyayuryajñe tai tai śubhāśiṣo daduḥ || 1 14| | gītikāścāpyagāyantāvādyanta tūryakāṇi ca | gotraṃ ca pravarān vedaṃ śākhāṃ cāśikṣayat pitā || 1 15|| parabrahmātmakaṃ gotraṃ pravarāstraya ityamī | akṣarabrahma śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīnārāyaṇa eva te || 1 16|| vedaḥ sarvātmakaścaikaḥ sāmaḥ śrīmukhanirgataḥ | śākhā patnīvratīyā ca śākhī tvaṃ parameśvaraḥ || 1 17|| ityevaṃ rādhike karma samāpya mahīmānakān | saṃsadaḥ parihāraṃ ca cakre gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 118 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya yajñopavītapradānavidhipūjādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 66 ||
<2.67> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śrīmatkṛṣṇasya ca rādhe yajñopavītakottaram | mahīmānā nivāseṣu yayustasmāt sabhāsthalāt || 1 || tato gopālakṛṣṇo vai tathā śrīkambharāsatī | guṇātītāstathā muktāstathā kanyā hyasaṃkhyakaḥ || 2 || ṛṣayastannivāsāśca tīrthāni mūrtavallayaḥ | tattvānyapi ca divyāni śrīmukhyāḥ śaktayastathā || 3 || bhojanāvasare jāte dvārapaṃ brahmanādakam | sūcayāmāsurevātra āhvānārthaṃ kṣaṇācca saḥ|| 4 || brahmaghaṇṭāṃ miṣṭaravāṃ sṛṣṭitrayāptanādinīm | nādayāmāsa madhurasvarāṃ bhojanabodhikām || 5 || avatāreśvarāṇāṃ ca bhagavatāṃ ca paṃktayaḥ | muktānāṃ dhāmasaṃsthānāṃ muktānīnāṃ tadābhavan || 6 || vāsudevaprabhṛtīnāṃ vairājāntakadehinām | divyānāmīśvarīṇāṃ ca paṃktayaḥ śataśo’bhavan || 7 || divyārbudābjapadmāni kanyānāṃ vidadhustadā | dhāmānītātmabhojyādyamṛtānāṃ pariveṣaṇam || 8 || bhakṣyabhojyāni divyāni lehyacośyāni tattathā | miṣṭapeyāni cānyāni pākaśākāni tāni ca || 9 || rasān divyān cāranālān dravān divyān tathāvidhān | yogyān brahmahradodbhūtān brahmavāṭīsamudbhavān || 2.67.1 0|| brahmapriyābhiḥ pakvāśca tābhiḥ susaṃskṛtān śubhān | apārāṇi ca tāḥ pariveṣayāmāsurādarāt || 11 || sthāleṣu svarṇapātreṣu copapātreṣu vai śubham | ghṛtaṃ dadhi payo dugdhapākaṃ madhu ca śarkarām || 1 2|| odanāni dvidalāśca sūpaṃ miṣṭānnakāni ca | pāyasānnāni sarvāṇi meśubhānyapi sarvathā || 13|| mohasthālāni miṣṭāni tathāpūpāni mauktikān | sūtraphenīṃ laḍḍukām̐śca catuṣkān śaṣkulīṃstathā || 14 || śāṭakān ghṛtapūrām̐śca miṣṭāntaḥpolikāstathā | phulavaṭīḥ rājatṛptān kvathikā bharjikāstathā || 15 || kalikā sevikāścāpi saṃyāvaṃ bhājikāstathā | caṭanīrvividhāścāpi tiktalāvaṇyasaṃbhṛtān || 16 || rukṣasaṃskṛtabhakṣyām̐śca bhojayāmāsurādarāt | jalāni miṣṭapeyāni takrāṇi navanītakam || 17|| phalāni phalabījāni saugandhikadalāni ca | dadustato’timagnāśca cakrurbhājanamīśvarāḥ || 18|| īśvarāṇyatha tā muktā muktasya parameśvarāḥ | brahmasakhyaḥ prasahyaiva dadurbhojyādikāni tu || 19|| ākaṇṭhaṃ bhojayāmāsustṛptāśculukamādadhuḥ | jalapānaṃ pracakruśca tāmbūlāni ca jagṛhuḥ || 2.67.20 || mukhamiṣṭāni cūrṇāni jagṛhuste tataḥ param | yayurnaijanivāsām̐śca brahmasṛṣṭīśasṛṣṭikāḥ ||21 || atha brahmāṇamārabhya viṣṇuśaṃkaratatprajāḥ | devā devyaḥ pitaraśca satyādibhuvarāntakāḥ ||22| sādhyā viśve ca dikpālā sureśvarādayastathā | surāṇyaḥ kanyakā sarvā niṣedustatra paṃktiṣu ||23|| tebhyastābhyo brahmakanyāḥ kārṣṇyaścāpi mudā muhuḥ | āsanāni daduḥ pariveṣaṇaṃ vidadhurmuhuḥ ||24||| satyodbhavāni miṣṭānnapānapātrāṇi vai daduḥ | miṣṭānnānyamṛtānnāni bhakṣyabhojyāni tāni ca || 25|| lehyacoṣyāṇi sarvāṇi svādyapeyāni vai tathā | annaśākarasacūrṇaprabhṛtīni dadau muhuḥ ||26|| bhuktavantaśca te devā jalaṃ papustataḥ param | tāmbūlādimukhāvāsaṃ jagṛhuścālayaṃ yayuḥ |||27|| atharṣayo manuṣyāśca pārthivāsanadehinaḥ | catuḥkhanisamutpannā niṣeduḥ paṃktiṣu drutam |||28|| divyādivyāstathā mūrtāmūrtāścarācarāstathā | niṣedurbhojanapaṃktivartuleṣu mudānvitāḥ ||29|| lomaśāśramakanyāśca pātrāṇi cāsanāni ca | dadustebhyo’pi pariveṣayāmāsuḥ samutsukāḥ ||2.67.3 0|| aṣṭakalpasya daivasya sargasya kanyakāstadā | aṣṭadaivaprasargāśca cakrurbhojanamutsukāḥ ||3 1|| amṛtāni hyanantāni miṣṭānnāni dyumanti ca | rasān bhojyān bhakṣyacoṣyānlehyān peyān rasānvitān |32| tattaddevanikāyebhyo yogyān daduśca tāstadā | tṛptā bhuktvā tu te pānaṃ papuśca mukhavāsakam ||33|| tāmbūlakādi jagṛhuryayuścāvāsamutsukāḥ | athātalādilokānāṃ vāsināṃ paṃktayastadā ||34|| daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ cāsurāṇāṃ rakṣasāṃ tathā | nāgānāṃ bhogināṃ jaleśayānāṃ paṃktayo’bhavan ||35|| tattallokārhabhojyāni bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca | lehyānyapi ca coṣyāṇi āsvādyānyapi sarvathā ||36|| vyañjanāni ca peyāni rasasārāṇi kanyakāḥ | yogyapātrādiṣu pariveṣayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||37|| mūrtānāṃ cāmūrtatattvottamānāṃ guṇaśālinām | guṇānāṃ karmaṇāṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ pāvanārthinām ||38|| dīnāndhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca naranārīnapuṃjuṣām | śreṇyaścarācarāṇāṃ cābhavan yogyāśca dāsikāḥ ||39|| dāsā viprāśca tān pariveṣayāmāsuratyati | bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ peyaṃ daduḥ suśītalam ||2.67.40|| vanasārān jalasārān vahnisārān kṣiteḥ rasān | dhenusārām̐stṛṇasārān kandasārān pramedakān ||41|| dehasārān paṃkasārān puṣpasārān rasādikān | patrasārān mūlasārān kṛtisārān samudbhavān |||42|| jarāsārān kośasārān bījasārān phalottamān | mañjarīsārakān stambasārān nālodbhavām̐stathā ||43|| khanisārān vyomasārān meghasārān ṛtūdbhavān | vṛṣṭisārān puṇyasārān śraddhāsārān hṛdudbhavān ||44|| svāpnasārān kālasārān dravyasārān guṇodbhavān | karmasārān yogasārānaiśvaryakṛtavigrahān ||45 sarvavidhān bhojyasārān yogyebhyaḥ kanyakā daduḥ | lakṣmīḥ śrīḥ kamalā haṃsā ramā yatra pradāyikāḥ ||46|| tatra kā nyūnatā rādhe bhojyapānopakāriṣu | satrī yatra svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ lakṣmīryatrābhidāyinī ||47|| kalpavallyaḥ samāhartryastatra kā nāma nimnatā | sarvadhāmāni lokāśca mūrtā bhajanta eva ca ||48|| yatra tattvāni tiṣṭhanti tatra kā nāma nimnatā | yatra vahniḥ svayaṃ paktā tṛptiryatpariveṣikā ||49|| amṛtākṣarabhojyāni tatra kā nāma nimnatā | nityānandamahātṛptā yanmahe parameśvarāḥ ||2.67.50|| sarvaiśvaryacamatkārasiddhayaḥ kalpapādapāḥ | cintāmaṇayo vartante tatra kā nāma nimnatā ||51 || ityevaṃ rādhike bhojyaparihārottaraṃ svayam | lomaśo bhojanaṃ cakre tataśca bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||52|| sūdāśca pariveṣādikartryaśca bubhujustataḥ | kārṣṇyastato’tha bubhujustato gopālabāndhavāḥ ||53|| bubhoja ca tataḥ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇa eva tu | tataśca bubhuje śrīmatkaṃbharāśrīḥ sutānvitā ||54|| dāsebhyaḥ pradadau mātā bhojanānyuttamāni ca | kīṭamatsyapataṃgebhyo bhāgyajīvibhya ityapi ||25| | aniścitādanebhyaśca dadau bhojyāni kambharā | suvarṇarūpyaratnāni koṭiśo dakṣiṇā dadau ||56|| kṣaṇaṃ viśramyāparāhṇe sabhā tu mānavardhinī | parameśvaradevānāṃ samastadehināṃ hyabhūt ||57|| suvarṇāsanasaṃdiptā koṭiktavādipūritā | madhye śrīśaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo virājate’mbare |||58||| ucchraye gajaśobhāḍhyāsane pārśve pitā tathā | mātā kṛṣṇastathā rādhā śrīśca nārāyaṇastathā ||59|| hemanto bhagavām̐ścobhau sthitau dhṛtvāsya cāmare | avatārā avatāriṇya īśā īśanīgaṇāḥ ||2.67.60|| devā devyaḥ pitaraśca pitryo munaya ārṣikāḥ | asurā asurāṇyaśca mānavā yoṣitastathā ||61|| paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ stambā nāgā daityāśca tastriyaḥ | rājante sā sabhā dīrghā viśālā jaḍacetanaiḥ | tattvairuccāvacairyuktā divyādivyaiḥ sudehibhiḥ ||62|| tato nṛtyaṃ nartakīnāṃ prāvartata suśobhanam | apsarasāṃ gītayaśca gandharvāṇāṃ suvādanam ||63|| prāvartata śubhaṃ gandharvīṇāṃ nṛtyaṃ samuttamam | nṛtye parihṛte mallā yuddhakauśalyamāvahan ||64|| darśayāmāsuratyarthaṃ samarāṃgaṇabhūmikāḥ | tato dṛśyā naṭānāṃ ca nāṭyayogena khelitāḥ ||65|| prāvartantāmbararajjukauśalyālambanādayaḥ | uḍḍayanaṃ svargayuddhaṃ cendrajālikadarśanam ||66|| vidyudvaibhavadṛśyāni nirvartitāni vai tataḥ | gāyanāni samabhavan kṛṣṇayaśobharāṇi ca ||67|| vidyādhrāṇāṃ samabhavan vyākhyānānyuttamāni ca | siddhānāmupadeśāścābhavam̐statrātihṛdgamāḥ ||68|| bhāṭacāraṇabandijñāḥ praśaṃsakāḥ kaviprathāḥ | varṇayāsurevainamutsavaṃ prajaguḥ striyaḥ ||69|| nāradaḥ śrīsanatkumārājñayā praśaśaṃsa ha | utsavaṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ na bhūtaṃ bhāvi naiva ca ||2.67.70|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yatra pareśvaraḥ | yajñasūtrasya pātraṃ cāvatārā mahīmānakāḥ ||71 || sṛṣṭitrayaṃ yanmahe’sti sambhūtaṃ satkṛtipradam | sarvarasāḥ sarvagandhā yatrānandāśca sarvaśaḥ ||72|| sarvasatyo yatra santi śrībhūlīlāvibhūtayaḥ | naitādṛśo maho bhāvī maho’yaṃ sarvato’dhikaḥ ||73|| kartavyaṃ smaraṇaṃ cāsya śravaṇaṃ mananaṃ tathā | nididhyāsanamasyaiva sākṣānmuktirhareḥ pade ||74|| tadeva loke kartavyaṃ yatkṛte mokṣamāviśet | kṛtena yena saṃsāre bandhanaṃ naiva jāyate ||75 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaite mahotsavāḥ | kartavyāḥ sarvadā bhaktairyena bandhād vimucyate ||76 || bhavajaladhimagnānāṃ kuṭumbibhāramajjatām | śaraṇaṃ śrīhareratra tārakaṃ nausvarūpakam ||77|| saṃśritā ye hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ guruṃ pareśvaram | kamaleśaṃ na te yānti dharmarājapradeśakam ||78|| sā jihvā yā hariṃ stauti taccittaṃ mādhave’rpitam | tau ślāghyau tu karau bodhyau yau śrīkṛṣṇārcane ratau ||79 || anyathā stambaśākhākhyau śuṣkau sevāvivarjitau | kaṇṭhaḥ sa jambukakaṇṭho yo na gāyati mādhavam ||2.67.80 || rogo mahān sa evāsti yatra nāsti hareḥ smṛtiḥ | sa eva śocyaḥ sajīvo na yo’rcayati keśavam ||81 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’yaṃ parameśvaraḥ | sarvāvatārapūjyo’yaṃ pūjanīyaḥ pumuttamaḥ ||82|| pūjakā nahi śocyāste mṛtā api hi muktigāḥ | sarvaṃ carācaraṃ cātra bālakṛṣṇe virājate ||83|| asya pūjā kṛtā yena tenārcitaṃ carācaram | ratnākaraguṇā yadvadasaṃkhyāḥ śrīharerguṇāḥ ||84|| rādhāprabhāpāravatīlakṣmīpatiṃ śriyaḥ patim | samāśritā na saṃsāre duḥkhitā mokṣagā yataḥ ||85|| śūladhvajadhanurbāṇamīnasvastikacakravān | pūjyate yena bālo’yaṃ kare saptakacihnitaḥ ||86|| ūrdhvarekhādhikaiścihnaiḥ ṣoḍaśākhyaiḥ padābjayoḥ | sahitaḥ pūjyate yena bālakṛṣṇo’yamīśitā ||87|| sarvāyudhadharaḥ sarvakalākauśalyavāridhiḥ | pūjyate yena bālo’yaṃ mokṣabhāk sa na saṃśayaḥ ||88|| yadantaḥkaraṇe kṛṣṇo yadātmani narāyaṇaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇavyāpto na mṛtyorbhayavān kvacit ||89|| parāyaṇaṃ prapannānāṃ bālakṛṣṇajuṣāṃ kvacit | nimnāyanaṃ na caivāsti paradhāmno’dhikāriṇām ||2.67.90|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktāḥ parātparam | satāṃ mokṣaṃ cāpnuvanti rādhāramādiśaṃsitam ||91 || saṃgrāmiṇāṃ dhārmikāṇāṃ sāttvikānāṃ mahātmanām | gateḥ parā gatiścāste bhagavadvedināṃ śubhā ||92|| sūkṣmaṃ sarvagataṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaktāḥ paśyanti netare | tathā paśyanti taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ mahātmānaḥ kṛpālayāḥ ||93|| sarvāḥ kriyāḥ kṛṣṇaparā yasya bhavanti cārpitāḥ | sarvakartāpyakartā sa na badhyate pramucyate ||94|| hariryeṣāṃ priyo nityaṃ te priyāśca hareḥ sadā | hariṃ dhyāyecca yastaṃ dhyāyati hariḥ padāśritam ||95|| kalyamutthāya bhaktyāyaṃ smartavyo bālakṛṣṇakaḥ | śravaṇīyaḥ śrāvaṇīyo durgāṇāṃ tārako hi saḥ ||96|| asya kṛṣṇasya tu kathāmṛtapānāstaranti hi | atra śrībālakṛṣṇe ye bhaktiravyabhicāriṇīm ||97|| kariṣyanti gamiṣyanti te yatrāste hariḥ svayam | kṛṣṇasevāprasaktānāṃ yā gatiḥ paradhāmani ||98|| sā tu janmasahasreṇa tapobhirnahi labhyate | kiṃ japaiḥ kiṃ mantravāgbhiḥ kimāśrayaiḥ prayatnakaiḥ ||99|| kiṃ yajñaiḥ kiṃ pradānaiśca kiṃ dharmaiḥ kīrtibhiśca kim | kiṃ tasya bahubhiścānyairyenāptaḥ śrīhariryadi || 2.67.10 0|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | mantraḥ sarvārthadātā cejjaptaḥ kiṃ tasya vidyayā || 101 || hariryeṣāṃ jayasteṣāṃ mokṣasteṣāṃ parātparaḥ | lābhasteṣāṃ ca māṃgalyaṃ yeṣāṃ hṛtsthaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ || 1 02|| tīrthakoṭisahasrāṇi dānakoṭiśatāni ca | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanateḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 1 03|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmnā sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhavet | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhyānād yogito gatiruttamā || 104|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapūjāṃ kurvanti jalamātrataḥ | te’pi yāsyanti sādhūnāṃ sthānaṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ param || 1 05|| trisandhyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smaranti yāḥ patim | tāsāṃ dehasthitānāṃ ca mokṣa eva na saṃśayaḥ || 106 || narā nāryaḥ surā devā īśā īśānya ityapi | sevamānā bālakṛṣṇaṃ parāṃ gatimavāpsyatha || 1 07|| dhanyā rādhāramādyāśca dhanyāḥ kāruḥ kumārikāḥ | dhanyā kuṃkumavāpī ca yatkānto bhagavān svayam || 1 08|| dhanyā vayaṃ mahīmānā yanmahe’sya samāgamaḥ | ityukatvā nāradaḥ śrīmān praṇanāma punaḥ punaḥ || 1 09|| bhagavantaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ śukaṃ śrīvallabha tathā | mālā ratnamayī kaṇṭheṣvārpya nanāma nāradaḥ || 2.67.11 0|| punarvilokya ca sabhāṃ dirghakaṇṭhena nāradaḥ | hastamutkṣipya ca prāha śṛṇvatāṃ yāvatāṃ punaḥ || 111 || mahīmānāḥ praśvṛṇvantu satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham | loke kṛṣṇāvatārāstu bhaviṣyanti sahasraśaḥ || 1 12|| paraṃ tvetādṛśaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvara | avatārī paripūrṇatamottamottamaḥ kvacit || 11 3|| adya jātaḥ samārambhe punarnaiva bhaviṣyati | anye kṛṣṇā asya līlāmāśrayiṣyanti bhaktitaḥ || 1 8|| ānaravāttu śikhāṃ yāvat asya mūrtau sthale sthale | sahasraśastu cihnāni vidyante paramātmanaḥ || 1 15|| śataikaṃ pādayorasya daśake jaṃghayostathā | viṃśakaṃ ca tathā sakṣmolige ca pañcakaṃ tathā || 1 16|| triṃśattu jaghane cāsyodare tu pañcaviṃśatiḥ | vakṣasi śatakaṃ cāsya pṛṣṭhe pārśve śatatrayam || 1 17|| kaṇṭhe skande dviśataṃ ca mukhe śataṃ gale trayam | hastayoḥ śatacihnāni pachāśattalayostathā || 1 18|| prakoṣṭhe daśakaṃ cāpi netrayoḥ pañcaviṃśakam | gaṇḍayoḥ ṣoḍaśa bhāle pañca ṣaṭ karṇayostathā || 1 19|| jihvāyāṃ coṣṭhayoścāsya kramād daśa ca viṃśatiḥ | nāsikāyāṃ daśarekhā bhrukuṭī śatasadguṇāḥ || 2.67.120|| keśeṣu viṃśatiścāpi cibuke tu catuṣṭayam | romasu sarvataḥ santi hairaṇyaguṇarāśayaḥ || 121 || yāvadguṇāḥ svabhāvāśca rekhāstilāśca sandhayaḥ | saṃyogāścāpi saṃsthānā ghaṭanāḥ suvyavasthitiḥ || 122|| ekaikāṃgasya ca mayā varṇayituṃ na śakyate | sarvaṃ sarvātmakaṃ śraiṣṭhyaṃ vidyate’tra samantataḥ || 123|| etanmūrteḥ samādāya khaṇḍāṃśān mūrtayaḥ parāḥ | bhaviṣyantītare devā īśvarāḥ parameśvarāḥ || 124|| nāsmānmayādhikaṃ vācyaṃ pramāṇaṃ sadasi sthitāḥ | avatārāstathā muktā bhavantaḥ parameśvarāḥ || 125|| vāmane viśvarūpe tu madhye romṇordvayordvayoḥ | koṭicihnāni tiṣṭhanti naiṣāṃ syād gaṇanārhatā || 126 || sṛṣṭitrayasvarūpaṃ hi mūrtau bhagavataḥ sthitam | sarvasṛṣṭestu cihnāni vartante’syaiva varṣmaṇi || 127|| kaṇṭhopari cottamāṃge sūkṣmasūṣṭiḥ pratiṣṭhitā | kaṇṭhādadhaḥ karerūrdhva kāryasṛṣṭirvyavasthitā || 128|| kaṭeradho nikṛṣṭā ca ānakhāntaṃ vyavasthitā | koṭyarbudābjacihnāni vartante’sya tu varṣmaṇi || 1 29|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau nāradaḥ sanadājñayā | rādhike ca tataḥ pāritoṣikānyarpayat pitā || 2.67. 13 0|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mahīmānānāṃ bhojanadānaṃ, tataḥ sabhāyojanā, nāradoktaparāvidyopadeśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 67 ||
<2.68> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca kubero vasavaḥ kalpapādapā medinī ramā | nidhayaścintāmaṇayaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāgrataḥ || 1 || tasthustu rādhike dātuṃ sampāritoṣikāṇi vai | muktebhyo mālikā divyā dadurdivyavibhūtijāḥ || 2 || avatārebhya evaite dudurmukuṭakuṇḍale | divyahārānīśvarebhyo daduḥ kṛṣṇājñayā tadā || 3 || brahmādibhyo daduḥ siṃhāsanāni kānakāni hi | pitṛbhyaścākṣayāṇyeva pātrāṇi pradadustadā || 4 || ṛṣibhyo yajñapātrāṇi pradaduścāsanāni ca | surebhyo ratnahārām̐śca daduryogyān yathāyatham || 5 || dānavebhyo’surebhyaśca daityebhyo’pi dadustadā | yānavāhanabhūṣāśca mānavebhyo dhanaṃ daduḥ || 6 || nāgebhyo maṇayaścāpi paśubhyo bhojanāmṛtam | pakṣibhyo phalapuṣpādirasadravyāṇi te daduḥ || 7 || mūrtāmūrtacidacidbhyo yathāyogyaṃ dhanāni ca | viprebhyaḥ svarṇarūpyādi rājabhyo hīrakādikam || 8 || sādhubhyo vastrakanthādi satībhyo bhāgyavardhanam | bhūṣāmbarādi śṛṃgāraṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ tadā daduḥ || 9 || ātṛpti saṃdadustatra dehīti nocyate punaḥ | daduryathā ca te voḍhuṃ śekurnaiva yatheṣṭakam || 1 0|| yad yeṣāṃ vāñchitaṃ tattattatra drāgeva cārpitam | naśabdo yujyate naiva gṛhṇaśabdaḥ prayujyate || 11 || evaṃ vai dakṣiṇāścātha pāritoṣikamityapi | dadustebhyaśca yogyebhyo viprādibhyo dhanaṃ bahu || 12|| sūdebhyaścāndhasikebhyo dadurdhanaṃ vipūlakam | karmacārebhya evāpi hārahīrakamityapi || 13 || bhāṭebhyaścāraṇebhyaśca śilpibhyaśca dadurdhanam | mallebhyo nartakebhyaśca nāṭikābhyo dhanaṃ daduḥ || 14|| gāyikābhyo dāsikābhyo hārabhūṣāmbarādikam | dāsebhyo’nāthadīnebhyo vastrabhūṣādikaṃ daduḥ || 16|| sṛṣṭitrayasya kanyābhyo bhūṣāmbaradhanāni ca | svarṇarūpyakapātrāṇi daduḥ kṛṣṇājñayā tadā || 16|| yāsāṃ yeṣāṃ yathā yena paritoṣo’bhijāyate | tattat tadā pradattaṃ ca saṃkoco naiva vidyate || 17|| sādhvībhyaśca satībhyaśca pativratābhya ityapi | adhavābhyaśca vṛddhābhyo mātṛbhyaścāpi sarvathā || 18|| svasṛduhitṛkanyābhyo devībhyaśca yathāyatham | bhūṣāmbaradhanānyeva daduḥ kṛṣṇājñayā tataḥ || 19|| mahīmānebhya ityeva kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam | dāpayāmāsa ca pāritoṣikānyuttamāni ca ||20 || kuberavasukalpādidvārānarghyāṇi sarvathā | kaṃbharāśrīrdadau sarvayoṣidbhyo bhūṣaṇāni vai ||21 || kānakāni ratnahīramaṇihārān dadau tathā | gopālaśca dadau sarvajanebhyo hāṭakātmakam ||22|| dhanaṃ sadratnahārādi yathāpekṣaṃ tathorjitam || evaṃ sarvamaharṣibhyastadā śrīlomaśo dadau ||23|| kalpātmagūṭikā yasyā jāyeteṣṭaṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe | santoṣā bhaginī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya cāgrajā ||24|| dadau saubhāgyasūtrādidravyarañjanakaṃkatīḥ | kānakīśca vibhūṣāśca kañcukī śāṭikāstathā ||25|| ghargharīścolikādyāśca dadau natthīśca baṃgiḍīḥ | raśanā valayām̐ścāpyūrmikāḥ santoṣadāyikāḥ ||26|| evaṃ dānāni ca pāritoṣikāṇi pradāya ca | anugrahaṃ mahe samāgatānāṃ prāha vai pitā ||27 || śrīgopālakṛṣṇa uvāca mama putrasya kṛṣṇasya yajñasūtramahotsave | samāgatānāṃ bhavatāṃ śobhāvṛddhijuṣāṃ sadā ||28|| ṛṇyahaṃ svāgataṃ kurve dhanyavādān dadāmi ca | vinayena vadāmyatra nyūnasevā mayā kṛtā ||29|| bhavet kṣantavyaviṣayāṃ matvā kṣamyo’hamīśvaraḥ | muktānāṃ cāvatārāṇāṃ brāhmīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām ||3 0|| īśānāmīśvarīṇāṃ devānāṃ ca devayoṣitām | mānavānāṃ mānavīnāṃ daityānāṃ daityayoṣitām ||3 1 || nāgānāṃ nāgapatnīnāṃ jaḍacetanadehinām | dikpālānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ carṣīṇām ārṣīprayoṣitām || 36|| sānnidhyenābhavatkāryaṃ cotsavīyaṃ subṛṃhitam | sarveṣāṃ yaśasāṃ pātraṃ kṛto’haṃ bhavadāgamaiḥ ||33||| putro me vardhitaścāpi tejobhirnijagocaraiḥ | punarevāvagantavyaṃ kṣantavyā ca kṣatirmama ||34|| ityuktvā kāryakartṛbhyo dhanyavādān dadau muhuḥ | āśīrvādān samicchāmi sakuṭumbaḥ samārthayat ||35|| tadānīṃ jayakāraśca sabhājanakṛto’bhavat | atha rādhākṛṣṇa ādau bālakṛṣṇasya vai tadā ||36 || pūjārthaṃ tvāyayau divyopacāraiḥ samapūjayat | mukuṭaṃ gopaveṣādi vaṃśīṃ cintāmaṇīn dadau ||37|| kāmadhenūrdadau cāpi candanādyairapūjayat | lakṣmīnārāyaṇaścāthāpūjayacchrīhariṃ tadā ||38 || mukuṭaṃ kuṇḍale śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ tathābjakam | garuḍaṃ ca vimānaṃ ca divyakaustubhamālikāḥ ||39 || dadau śrībālakṛṣṇāya kesarādyairapūjayat | vāsudevastathā cānye’vatārāḥ prakṛtīśvaraḥ ||40|| pradhāneśastathā bhūmā mahāviṣṇurvirāṭpumān | sadāśivastathā teṣāṃ śaktayaścāyayurmudā ||41 || tilakaṃ kajjalaṃ binduṃ datvā ca mukuṭāni vai | karṇabhūṣāḥ kaṇṭhahārān muktāmauktikanirmitān ||42|| urmikā raśanā yaṣṭīn daduste tā dhanānyapi | svasvadhāmakṛtān divyān haṃsasiṃhagajātmakān ||43|| āsanottamabhaumām̐śca dadurbālāya dehine | aṣṭāvaraṇasaṃsthāśceśvarāḥ saptarṣayastathā ||44|| brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyā munayo brahmacāriṇaḥ | svarṇahārān puṣpahārān svarṇapātrāṇi pāduke ||45|| kamaṇḍalūn kalaśām̐śca prāvaraṇānyanekaśaḥ | daduḥ śrībālakṛṣṇāya dhanaṃ divyaṃ navaṃ navam ||46|| pitaro munayo devāśchatraṃ ca cāmare tathā | vimānāni ca yānāni haṃsān dāsām̐śca dāsikāḥ ||47|| yaṣṭiṃ sauvarṇavikṛtiṃ darpaṇaṃ śukamenakāḥ | vāditrāṇi vicitrāṇi cāmṛtānāṃ ghaṭām̐stathā ||48|| kāmakalpalatādīṃśca sūryacandramaṇīm̐stathā | digīśvarādiveṣām̐śca vibhūṣā ratnamālikāḥ ||49|| daduḥ śrībālakṛṣṇāya divyānyapi dhanāni ca | daityāśca dānavāścāpi asurā vaibhavān daduḥ ||2.68.50 || nāgāḥ sarpā bhoginaśca maṇīn māṇikyamauktikān | hārān vibhūtivaiśeṣyaṃ dadurdravyāṇi vai tadā |||5 1 || ratnākarāstu ratnāni mauktikāni dadustadā | nadyo nadā varuṇādyā dadurdravyarasānapi ||52|| parvatāḥ khanayaścāpi dadurmaṇiviśeṣakān | ratnāni vajramaṇikān muktāśca padmarāgakān ||53 || mārakatānindranīlān vaidūryān puṣparāgakān | karketanān bhīṣmakām̐śca pulakān rudhirākhyakān |||54|| sphaṭikān vidrumān puṃkharājān dadurviśeṣataḥ | mānavāstu dadustasmai svambarāṇi śubhāni vai ||55|| dyumataḥ kambalām̐ścāpi pātrabhūṣopavārtikāḥ | gajāśvavṛṣabhām̐ścāpi dhenūśca mahiṣīstathā ||56|| dravyāṇi svarṇarūpyāṇi dadurbālāya bhāvataḥ | vṛkṣavallyo madhurasān dadurmālyādipūjanam ||57|| paryaṃkān subṛsīścāpi kaṭān catuṣkikādikāḥ | khaṭvā yantrīstathā gantrīrdaduḥ peṣaṇikāstathā ||58|| cullikāḥ kaṇḍanikāśca jalakumbhīrdadustathā | mārjanikā guptadoradhānīśca pradadurmudā ||595|| muśalaṃ tantucakraṃ cānarghyapeṭimañjuṣāḥ| vāridhānīścātha payodhānīstakrapramanthanīḥ ||2.68.60|| droṇaśca dadhidhānīśca kusulāni karṇārdinīḥ | piṣṭikāṃ ca śilāṃ ghaṇṭīṃ rasayantrīṃ dadurmudā ||61 || dolāṃ preṃkhāṃ ghoṭikāṃ ca catuṣpādāṃ ca khaṭvikām | kauśeyānyambarāṇyeva aurṇānyapyambarāṇi ca ||62|| buṭṭāḍhyaveṣavaryāṇi daduśca śarkarādikāḥ | phalāni phalahārām̐śca śuṣkailādisrajastathā ||63 || candanāni vicitrāṇi śītalāni dadustadā | pattrāṇāni varṣmatrāṇān śirastrāṇāni vai daduḥ ||64|| pātrāṇi yugahāṇḍīśca sthālīśca kalaśādikān | bhaṃgārakāṇi pātrāṇi puṭapātrāṇi yāni ca ||65|| jalasecanapātrāṇi sthālāni bhojyavāṭikāḥ | paṭṭiśaṃ pāṭhikāścāpi śastrāstrāṇyapi saṃdaduḥ ||66|| dhanāni svarṇarūpyāṇi cāsaṃkhyāni dadustadā | candanābīrakuṃkumākṣatagulālakairdravaiḥ ||67|| puṣpaiśca kesarairgandhaiḥ kastūrikābhirityapi | karpūrairvividhaiḥ raṃgaiḥ rañjanairhārapatrakaiḥ ||68|| tulasyā mañjarībhiśca dalaiśca kundaketakaiḥ | campakairmṛdyatailaiścārcayāmāsuḥ prabhuṃ patim ||69|| ekottaraśataśreṣṭhopacārairdevatādikāḥ | avatārā īśvarāśca cakrurārārtrikaṃ hareḥ ||2.68.70|| āśīrbhiryojayāmāsuḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ pracakrire | tuṣṭavuśca praṇemuśca niṣeduścāsaneṣu ca ||71 || tato’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’nugrahavān kṣaṇāt | darśanaṃ naijamūlātmasvarūpasya dadau tadā ||72|| prathamaṃ paramaṃ dhāma dadṛśuśca sabhājanāḥ | tanmuktām̐ścāpi muktānīstatraiva dadṛśuśca te ||73|| brahmadhāmākṣaraṃ tasya muktān muktānīrityapi | bālakṛṣṇasya vai mūrtau mastake dadṛśuśca te ||74|| avatārān harerbhāle sahasraśaśca dadṛśuḥ | golokaṃ dakṣiṇe netre vaikuṇṭhaṃ vāmacakṣuṣi ||75|| amṛtaṃ nityakailāsaṃ karṇayoścāpi dadṛśuḥ | mahāviṣṇuṃ nāsikāyāṃ bhāle kālaṃ ca dadṛśuḥ ||76|| bhālasya prāntayoḥ pradhāneśaṃ ca prakṛtīśvaram | vāsudevādikān vyūhān nāsāmūle pradadṛśuḥ ||77|| vairājaṃ mukhamadhye ca dadṛśuste sabhājanāḥ | daṃṣṭrāsvasya dadṛśuśca śatānanādivedhasaḥ ||78|| śatanetrādirudrām̐śca danteṣvasya pradadṛśuḥ | śmaśrurekhāsthitān sahasrādihastakaviṣṇukān ||79|| oṣṭhe cordhve mahāmāyāṃ pradhānaṃ cādhare tathā | śrīṃ lakṣmīṃ cibuke tvasya dadṛśuste sabhājanāḥ ||2.68.80|| hanūromasu dadṛśurmāyāṣṭāvaraṇeśvarān | kapolayośceśvarāṇīrdadṛśuḥ koṭiśaḥ satīḥ ||8 1 || keśamūleṣu vai satyaṃ lokaṃ brahmādyadhiṣṭhitam | keśamadhyeṣu ca svargān keśānte cātalādikān ||82|| śiraḥpṛṣṭhe mānavām̐śca dadṛśuste sabhājanāḥ | evaṃ sarvāṃ brahmarūpāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ vai kāraṇātmikām ||83 || sūkṣmāṃ ca śāśvatīṃ nityāṃ bījarūpāṃ hi dadṛśuḥ | atha kāraṇasṛṣṭeśca samudbhūtāṃ ca vaikṛtām ||84|| sthūlāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ kaṇṭhabhāgādadhaḥ punaśca dadṛśuḥ | kaṇṭhe’sya paramaṃ brahma hṛdaye brahma cākṣaram ||85|| stanayoścāpi golokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ dakṣavāmayoḥ | amṛtaṃ nityakailāsaṃ skandhayośca pradadṛśuḥ ||86|| mahāviṣṇuṃ ca hṛdaye kaṇṭhe kālaṃ pradadṛśuḥ | kakṣayośca pradhāneśaṃ prakṛtīśaṃ pradadṛśuḥ ||87|| vāsudevādikān vyūhān hṛdayordhve pradadṛśuḥ | vairājaṃ hṛdayādhastāt pārśvāsthiṣu ca vedhasaḥ ||88|| agrasandhiṣu viṣṇūm̐śca rudrām̐śca pṛṣṭhasandhiṣu | udare ca mahāmāyāṃ nābhau pradhānameva ca ||89|| śrīṃ lakṣmīṃ pārśvayornābherjaghaneṣṭāvṛtāni ca | jaghanādhaśceśvarāṇīrliṃgamūle satīstathā ||2.68.90|| romasu satyalokādīn guptādho’talaprabhṛtīn | tattatsthāneṣu cābdhīṃśca parvatān dadṛśuśca te ||9 1 || athāpi ca tataḥ kaṭyāṃ śeṣaṃ ca kacchapaṃ tathā | dadṛśuḥ sīvanīnāḍyāṃ mahājalaṃ ca dhātuṣu |||92|| liṃgāgre kāmadevaṃ ca sakthnordaityām̐śca dānavān | romasu ca ṛṣīn pitṝn devān dadṛśureva ca ||93|| jānvośca mānavān jaṃghādvaye’surān pradadṛśuḥ | pādayornāgasarpādīn dadṛśuḥ punareva ca ||94|| sṛṣṭitrayātmikāṃ mūrtiṃ bālakṛṣṇātmikāṃ punaḥ | vilokyaitanmahāścaryaṃ jñātavantaḥ svakāraṇam ||95|| sarve’vatārā yasmāt saṃbhavantyeṣaḥ pumān paraḥ | matvā cakrustato dhyānaṃ bālakṛṣṇasya te kṣaṇam ||96 || atha sabhāsamāpteśca ghaṇṭānādo’bhavattadā | jayaśabdaiḥ saha sabhyā uttasthuḥ svālayaṃ yayuḥ ||97|| miṣṭapānādibhistāmbūlakairmadhurabhāṣaṇaiḥ | satkṛtāśca vimānādyairmahīmānāstu sarvaśaḥ ||98|| yayurnaijān gṛhān deśān paradeśān sukhānvitāḥ | tattvāni dehinaścaityā jaḍā guṇā rasādayaḥ ||99|| anye’pi dāsavargādyā yayuḥ sammānitā gṛham | ṛṣayaḥ pitaraścaite svargādikaṃ yayustataḥ || 2.68.100 || parameśā brahmalokān īśā īśanivāsakān | daityāśca dānavā naijān pātālādīn yayustataḥ || 101 || parvatā vṛkṣavallyaśca nadāstīrthāni cāpagāḥ | sarāṃsyapi ca kṣetrāṇi vanānyupavanāni ca || 1 02|| yayuḥ praṇamya ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | maṇḍapasya mahāprāsādasya kalpakṛtasya ca || 1 03|| upasaṃhāramakarot kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | sanatkumāro bhagavānnārado’pi praṇamya ca || 1 04|| badarīṃ yayatuścātha kanyakā lomaśāśramam | evaṃ ca rādhike brahmasūtrotsavo mahattamaḥ || 1 05|| sampannaścāṣṭame varṣe vaiśākhe paramātmanaḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇānmuktibhāgbhavet || 1 06|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mahimānebhyaḥ pāritoṣikadānaṃ, prabhoḥ pūjanam, upadārpaṇam, divyadarśanaṃ, parihāraścetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 68 ||
<2.69> śrīrādhikovāca kathaṃ kṛṣṇa tava sevā kartavyārādhanā tathā | kenārcanena te kṛṣṇa prītiḥ samupajāyate || 1 || kāni dānāni deyāni prīṇanāya harestava | kāni puṇyāni śastāni kṛṣṇatuṣṭikarāṇi ca || 2 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca sarvadānāni śastāni śrīkṛṣṇasya pratuṣṭaye | bhaktyā samarcanenāyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ parituṣyati || 3 || yapsveṣṭaṃ tatpradeya vai kṛṣṇāya prīṇanārthakam | puṇyaṃ tatrārpaṇaṃ sarva kṛṣṇatuṣṭikaraṃ priye || 4 || śraddadhānairbhaktiparaiḥ samuddiśya śriyaḥ patim | dīyante yāni dānāni tāni yānti na vai kṣayam || 5 || tā eva tithayaḥ śreṣṭhā yatra kṛṣṇo hyavāpyate | yāsu satāṃ kṛtā sevā tadnyāstithayo’dhamāḥ || 6 || pūjiteṣu ca sādhuṣu pūjitaḥ parameśvaraḥ | yastān dveṣṭi sa hīnātmā hīnāṃ yoniṃ prayāti ca || 7 || sato’rcayan jano bhaktyā nārī vā kṛṣṇatatparā | māmakī sā tanuścāsti hyahaṃ vaiṣṇavadehavān || 8 || sādhavo nāvamantavyā budho vāpyabudhā api | santo divyāstanavo me tatastānarcayet sadā || 9 || karmaṇā manasā vācārpaṇena sevayāpi vā | bhojanenārcanenāpi santoṣaṇīyāḥ sādhavaḥ || 2.69.10 || prātarutthāya māṃ smṛtvā snātvā ca śubhavastubhiḥ | manmūrteḥ pūjanaṃ kuryāt satāṃ sevā hi pūjanam || 1 1|| ārādhanā tu me bhaktirdāsyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sadādhikam | dhyānaṃ me mama sādhūnāṃ kartavyaṃ mokṣahetave || 12|| pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kāryaṃ sādhūnāṃ sarvadā priye | tadindriyeṣvahaṃ tvasmi tattuṣṭau toṣaṇaṃ mama || 1 3|| rasagandhayutaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjanīyāsta eva tu | campakaḥ kunda āmraśca dhavalaḥ khadirastathā || 14|| śatagoṭastathāśoko bakulaḥ karavīrakaḥ | tilakaśca japā jātī yūthikā padminī tathā || 15|| kamalī sthalapadmā ca tulasī kaumudī tathā | sūryamukhī cammilikā pārijātaḥ sukesaraḥ || 16|| ketako hāraśṛṃgāraḥ kadambo devadārukaḥ | sarjataruḥ kalpavallī caitatpuṣpāṇi rādhike || 17|| pūjāyāṃ me pradeyāni varjayitvā tu ketakīm | bilvapatraṃ śamīpatraṃ bhṛṃgapatraṃ ca taulasam || 18|| tamālamālatīpatraṃ praśastaṃ mama pūjane | vīrudhāṃ supravālaiśca darbhaiḥ samarcayecca mām || 1 9|| pravālairbīsatantvādyairdurvāṅkuraiḥ samarcayet | kuḍmalaiścandanaiḥ kuṃkumośīrakesaraistathā || 2.69.20|| sugandhakāṣṭhadhūpaiśca pṛṇomyahaṃ sadā priye | haviṣā saṃskṛtā ye ca yavagodhūmaśālayaḥ ||21 || tilamudgādayo māṣā vrīhayaśca priyā mama | godānāni pavitrāṇi bhūmipradānakāni ca ||22|| vastrānnasvarṇadānāni prītaye mama rādhike | māghe tilāścendhanāni deyāni priyatāṃ hariḥ ||23|| phālgune vrīhayo vastraṃ mṛgacarmādi śasyate | caitre susūkṣmavastrāṇi śayanānyāsanāni ca ||24|| vaiśākhe gandhayuktāni deyāni surabhīṇi ca | udakumbhāḍhyadhenuśca tālavṛntaḥ sucandanaḥ ||25|| deyāstena bhavetputro dhanaṃ bhāryā sutā ca gauḥ | śṛṇuyācca kathā nityaṃ bhaktyā saṃpūjayeddharim ||26|| tasyāśvamedhayajñasya dakṣiṇāsahitasya ca | suvarṇabhūmidānasya śvagonāgarathasya ca || 27|| dānasya puṇyamagryaṃ vai jāyeta nātra saṃśayaḥ | nārī naraḥ pādamekaṃ kathāṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyāt hareḥ || 28|| sa śuciḥ puṇyavān loke sarvatīrthāśrito hi saḥ | gaṃgāyāṃ naimiṣāraṇye puṣkare mānase tathā || 29|| nārāyaṇe’śvapaṭṭe ca kokāmukhe prayāgake | māghe yatpuṇyamagryaṃ ca tat kathāśravaṇād bhavet ||2.69.3 0|| rājasūyaphalaṃ yacca svarge yacca mahat phalam | bhūmiloke phalaṃ yattat kathāyāḥ śravaṇād bhavet || 31 || sautrāmaṇeḥ phalaṃ yacca miṣṭānnadānajaṃ ca yat | sūryacandragrahe ratnapradānasya ca yatphalam ||32|| durbhikṣe rakṣaṇād yacca phalaṃ jñāterjanasya ca | devāgnisādhuviprāṇāṃ pālane rakṣaṇe ca yat ||33|| pitroḥ śvaśurayoḥ sevādharme bhrātuśca yatphalam | jyeṣṭhe’patyau gavi sevājanyaṃ yacca phalaṃ bhavet| ||34|| tatphalaṃ rādhike me’tra kathāyāḥ śravaṇe bhavet | upānadyugalaṃ chatraṃ lavaṇāmalakādikam ||35|| jyeṣṭhe jalaṃ praśītaṃ ca sūkṣmāmbaraṃ ca takrakam | dadhi copānahau chatraṃ deyaṃ me prītaye priye || 36|| āṣāḍhe vyajanaṃ dugdhaṃ śarkarā cāmbarāṇi ca | deyāni rādhike yānaṃ vāhanāni harergṛhe ||37|| śrāvaṇe sarvadānāni dadyānmatprītaye priye | annavastropakaraṇarasādīni samantataḥ ||38|| bhādre dadyātpāyasāni lavaṇaṃ saguḍaudanam | navakaṇām̐stathā me prītaye ca madhusarpiṣī ||39|| āśvine navadhānyāni vṛṣaṃ cāśvaṃ suvarṇakam | tāmrapātrāṇi vastrāṇi dīpādīni samarpayet| ||2.69.40|| kārtike svarṇarajate maṇimuktāphalādikam | dīpān navānnamiṣṭānnaṃ dadyādvai prītaye mama ||41 || mārgaśīrṣe vāhanāni kharoṣṭrāśvatarān dadet | nāgānajāvikān gantrīṃ śakaṭān prītaye mama ||42|| pauṣe deyaṃ prabhaktyā ca gṛhaprāvaraṇādikam | prāsādanagarādīni cānnaṃ ṣaḍrasasaṃyutam ||43|| dāsīdāsamalaṃkārān dadyādvai mama tuṣṭaye | yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ kiñcit yacchakyaṃ ca gṛhe śuci ||44|| puruṣottamatuṣṭyarthaṃ deyaṃ tat sārvakāmikam | yaḥ kārayet śrīkṛṣṇasya mandiraṃ so’kṣaraṃ vrajet ||45|| dadetpuṣpaphalāḍhyām̐ścārāmān yaḥ so’kṣaraṃ vrajet | pūrvajāni paścimāni kulānyaṣṭotarāṇi saḥ ||46|| tārayedātmanā sārdhaṃ viṣṇormandirakārakaḥ | imāśca pitaro devā gāthā gāyanti sādhavaḥ ||47|| api naḥ svakule kaścit kṛṣṇabhakto bhaviṣyati | harermandirakartā yaḥ sukhaṃ dāsyati no hi saḥ ||48|| api naḥ santatā syād vai kṛṣṇālayavilepakaḥ | mandire mārjanakartā bhakto yenoddhṛtā vayam ||49|| api naḥ santatau jāto dhvajaṃ śrīkṛṣṇamandire | dāsyati ca pradīpaṃ sudhūpaṃ puṣpānulepanam ||2.69.50|| api naḥ sa kule bhūyādekādṛśyāṃ kariṣyati | udyāpanaṃ mama pūjāmupavāsaṃ ca dānakam ||51 || mahāpātakayukto’pi kṛṣṇāvasathacitrakṛt | vimuktapāpo bhavati dhanyaṃ janmāsya yo’sti me |||52||| dhanyo rājā manuḥ pūrvo yo loke mānavān vṛṣān | pravartayāmāsa nityaṃ viṣṇubhaktiparān parān ||53|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre devālayānakārayat | vibhūtibhiḥ śrīkṛṣṇasya nārāyaṇasya cālayān ||54|| citrayāmāsa śucibhiḥ pañcavarṇaiḥ sucitrakaiḥ | dīpapātrāṇi satataṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇālaye ||55|| sauvarṇāni ca pātrāṇi ghṛtapātrāṇi vai dadau | nānāvarṇā vaijayantīrmālā hārān dadau mudā ||56|| srajaśca kaṇṭhikā divyā mahāraṃjanarañjitāḥ | mañjiṣṭhā navaraṃgīyāḥ śvetapāṭalikāśritāḥ ||57|| ārāmān vividhān ramyān puṣpāḍhyān phalaśālinaḥ | latāpallavasaṃkhyāptān devadārubhirāvṛtān ||58|| hradān manoharān divyāsanakuṃjavirājitān | kārayāmāsa parito mandirāya dadau ca tān ||59|| mañcānalaṃkṛtām̐steṣu kuśalaiḥ samadhiṣṭhitān | gandharvavidyārāgajñaiḥ ratnajaḍitakāsanān ||2.69.60|| kārayāmāsa subhagān divyān devālayopamān | yeṣu nityaṃ prapūjyante yatayo brahmacāriṇaḥ ||6 1 || śrotriyā vipravaryāśca ṛṣayaḥ sādhavo’malāḥ | satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginyaśca brahmaparāḥ striyaḥ ||62|| itthaṃ tenaiva manunā kṛtā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe | bhaktiśca bhāryayā sārdhaṃ yayāvante hareḥ padam ||63|| evaṃ rājā jyāmagho’pi kṛtavān manuvad bhuvi | pareśasya parāṃ bhaktiṃ yayau brahmapadaṃ param ||64|| tasmādvai rādhike tvaṃ ca kuru devālayaṃ mama | māmarcayasva yatnena sādhūn sādhvīrmadāśritāḥ ||65|| sadācārān kathāvaktṝn lokakalyāṇakārakān | mama bhaktipradān samyaksaṃprapūjaya rādhike ||66|| vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaiḥ ratnairgobhirbhūkanakādibhiḥ | bhojanairjalapānādyairaṃgasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ ||67|| vibhave sati devasya prīṇanaṃ kuru sarvathā | ityuktā rādhikā cāpi kṛṣṇadevālayaṃ param ||68|| kārayāmāsa goloke mandiraṃ candraśobhanam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya pratimāṃ śubhām ||69|| sampratiṣṭhāpya ca rādhā cakāra sevanādikam | sammārjanaṃ lepanaṃ ca śṛṃgāraṃ bhojanādikam ||2.69.70|| śarkarādipradānaṃ ca dīpaṃ dhūpaṃ pradakṣiṇam | nīrājanaṃ cotsavaṃ ca cakāra rādhikā svayam ||71|| āyatākṣī pātrasammārjanaṃ kṛṣṇālaye’karot | gītaṃ ca kīrtanaṃ cāpi svayaṃ rādhā hyavākarot ||72||| evaṃ rādhākarod bhaktiṃ patyurvākyena sarvadā | patyurvākyaṃ vṛddhavākyaṃ satī cet prakaroti vai ||73 || duruktaṃ vā samuktaṃ vā snigdhaṃ tad ghṛtavad bhavet | āpadbhujaṃgadaṣṭasya mantrahīnasya sarvathā ||74|| vṛddhavākyaiṣadhānyeva kurvanti viṣaśūnyatām | vṛddhavākyāmṛtaṃ pītvā taduktānyanumanya ca ||75|| yā tṛptirjāyate puṃsāṃ somapāne na vai tathā | yeṣāṃ vṛddhā na śāstāraste jīvanto’pi vai mṛtāḥ ||76|| śocyāsta eva naṣṭāśca bhaviṣyanti pade pade | āpadgrāhagṛhītānāṃ vṛddhā yatra na mārgadāḥ ||77|| na vā mocayitāraśca teṣāṃ śāntirna vidyate | āpatsamudramagnānāṃ majjatāṃ vyasanormiṣu ||78|| vṛddhavākyairvinā teṣāmuddhāro na kathaṃcana | tasmād yo vṛddhavākyāni śṛṇuyād vidadhāti vā ||79|| sa sadyaḥ siddhimāpnoti vṛddhāśīrbhiḥ punaḥ punaḥ | rādhike yena tuṣṭaḥ syāṃ tathā kāryaṃ tvayā sadā ||2.69.80|| ahaṃ dhyāyāmi me mūlasvarūpaṃ puruṣottamam | māṃ dhyāyanti kapilādyāḥ kapilaṃ mānavāḥ pare ||81 || vāsudevādayo vyūhā dhyāyanti puruṣottamam | vāsudevaṃ vikuṇṭhastho dhyāyatyapi narāyaṇaḥ ||82|| nārāyaṇaṃ dhyāyati śrīviṣṇurviṣṇuṃ prajājanaḥ | evaṃ pravartitaṃ dhyānaṃ guroḥ paramparāgatam ||83|| gurau viṣṇurvartate ca viṣṇau bhūmā virājate | bhūmni bṛhad bṛhatyeva parabrahma virājate ||84|| evaṃ svātmavicāreṇa dhyāyet kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | seveta taṃ pareśānaṃ vandetārādhayedapi ||85|| sarvaṃ samarpayedasmai parātmane’ntarātmane | māyikātmāntarātmāno yogena syāt parātmavān ||86|| māyāyāṃ sthitajīvasya dīrghakālena tadguṇāḥ | māyākṛtā bhavantyasya kāmakrodhādayo malāḥ ||87|| janmajanmāntarāyātāstairmalino’yamucyate | svabhāvo māyayā vyāpto bahujanmagateṣvapi ||88|| anvavartata ātmānaṃ satāṃ yogena jīryati | parameśāśrayeṇāpi jīryatyeva tataḥ prabhoḥ ||89|| kṛpayā mokṣamārgasya bhaktyātmakasya cārjanam | tena yāti parabrahma jyāmaghastu yayau yathā ||2.69.90|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇācchrāvaṇādapi | svargamokṣau bhavetāṃ vai rādhike nātra saṃśayaḥ ||9 1|| yathā rādhā tathā nārī kṛṣṇasaubhāgyamāpnuyāt | yathā ca garuḍastadvannaro dāsyamavāpnuyāt ||92|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhoḥ sevārcanadānapūjādiphalamāhātmyādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 69 ||
<2.70> śrīrādhikovāca kathaṃ rājā jyāmaghastu pūrvasvabhāvapūritaḥ | paścādārādhanalābhānmuktimavāpa tadvad || 1 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rādhe kathāṃ purātanīṃ vairāgyadāyinīm | jyāmaghasya kathayāmi bahujanmasamudbhavām || 2 || dhanurmaghasya tu ṛṣeḥ putro’bhūt kauśikābhidhaḥ | tasya putro’bhavannāmnā jāḍyamagho jaḍākṛtiḥ || 3 || na brūte mūrkhavaccāsau nāsau paśyati cāndhavat | enaṃ mātā gṛhadvāri dyoṭikāyāṃ prarakṣya ca || 4 || yayau jalaṃ samāhartuṃ grāmakūpāt tadā khalu | kākākṣī rākṣasī bālaṃ preṃkhāto vijahāra ha || 5 || surūpaṃ komalaṃ bālaṃ nītvā svarakṣase dadau | rākṣaso vīkṣya papraccha kimānītaṃ tvayā priye || 6 || sābravīt bālakaścāyaṃ kauśikasyāhṛto mayā | rākṣasaḥ prāha ca bhadre tvayā bhadraṃ na vai kṛtam || 7 || samarthaḥ kauśikaścāsmān tūrṇaṃ śapsyati kūpitaḥ | tasmādenaṃ tu dolāyāṃ tadgṛhe prāpaya drutam || 8 || yadvā jalāharaṇārthaṃ tanmātrā yatra gacchati | tatra sthāpaya gatvaiva mātā dṛṣṭvā grahīṣyati || 9 || rākṣasī tūrṇamevainaṃ gṛhītvā vāpikāṃ yayau | tatrāgatāṃ satīṃ dṛṣṭvā bālaṃ tvavāsṛjat puraḥ || 2.70.1 0|| sāpi satī sutaṃ prāpya jalaṃ bhṛtvā gṛhaṃ yayau | bhāgyaṃ matvā sutasyeyaṃ grahapūjāṃ vyadhāpayat || 1 1|| vighnaśāntiṃ ca dānāni kārayāmāsa bhāvataḥ | rākṣasīkarayogena rākṣasīdugdhapānataḥ || 12|| bāle vai rākṣasabhāvo vartate sparśatastataḥ | vardhito bālakaścāyaṃ yajñasūtramavāpa ha || 13|| vedādhītyai jāḍyamagho pitrā gṛhe niyojitaḥ | mūrkhatvānna papāṭhāsau pitā śikṣāṃ karoti ca || 14|| tāḍanādibhayenāsau kūpe sīmni papāta ha | tatrāstyāmalakīvṛkṣaḥ poṣāya phalito’bhavat || 15|| bhakṣayitvāmalakāni kūpe gatvā jalaṃ śubham | pibatyeva sadā vṛkṣamūlenāyāti yāti ca || 16|| vṛkṣavallīsamāchanne kūpe mūlāvarohaṇe | sukhenāyaṃ vartate ca bālako’jñātavartanaḥ || 17|| evaṃ puṣṭo’bhavaccāpi rātrau sasyādijānyapi | kaṇakandaphalādīni bahirgatvātti nityaśaḥ || 18|| pitrādibhistato jñātaṃ mṛto vā naṣṭa eva ca | kintu mātā kadācidvai yajñakāṣṭhābhilāṣukī || 19|| yayau tvāmalakīkāṣṭhānyānetuṃ sīmni tatra vai | vṛkṣaśākhāḥ samāgṛhya tīre karoti sañcayam ||2.70.20|| tāvat kūpe mūlamadhye kṣuto’kasmāddhi bālakaḥ | kṣuvanaṃ mānuṣaṃ śrutvā yāvad draṣṭumupāyayau ||21|| tāvat putraṃ nijaṃ vīkṣya cātiharṣamupāgamat | kūpāntaḥsthaṃ sutaṃ mātā vihvalā tvājuhāva ha || 22|| sutaḥ premṇā mātaraṃ saṃdṛṣṭvā gadgadatāṃ gataḥ | kūpāduttīrya mūlaiśca mātuḥ pādau vavanda ca || 23|| sā svaputraṃ samāsādya nītvā kāṣṭhāni satvaram | putrayuktā yayau naijaṃ gṛhaṃ patiṃ nanāma ca ||24|| kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ svasutasya tu| tato’pṛcchacca vipro’sau prasannaḥ prāpya putrakam || 25|| kathaṃ tvaṃ nirgato gehāt kathaṃ cādyāpi jīvasi | kathaṃ na vadasi putra hetuṃ kathaya sarvathā ||26|| jāḍyamaghastataḥ prāha vṛttāntaṃ pūrvajaṃ nijam | śrūyatāṃ kāraṇaṃ tāta yena mūkatvamāśritam ||27|| andhatvaṃ ca jaḍatvaṃ ca kathayāmi yathātatham | pūrvamāsamahaṃ vipro jyotirviddhastarekhavid || 28|| nārīṇāṃ hastarekhāṇāṃ parīkṣayā prasaṃgataḥ | mohamāptaḥ paradāraruciścāsaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||29|| kadācicca janaiścāhaṃ kaṭubhāṣātiraskṛtaḥ | mṛto hyudbandhanenāhaṃ yamapurīṃ tato gataḥ ||2.70.3 0|| tasmād varṣasahasrānte bhuktaśiṣṭe tadāgasi | araṇye prāptavān janma vyāghrasya naradehavat || 31 || rājñā tu bālato dhṛtvā pañjare pūritastataḥ | baddhasya pañjarasthasya vyāghratve’pi sthitasya ca ||32|| pūrvajñānaṃ na me naṣṭaṃ kāmanāpi vyavardhata | vyāghro’haṃ na ca hiṃsāmi na ca krauryaṃ karomyapi || 33 || rājñā rājñyā samaṃ nityamudyāne viharāmi ca | siṃhāsanāgre tiṣṭhāmi cānugacchāmi pṛṣṭhataḥ ||34|| ramayāmi bālavacca tadudyāne vasāmi ca | evaṃ yāte dine cāhaṃ yauvanaṃ prāptavān yadā ||35|| śānto bhūtvā niṣīdāmi rājñyāḥ snānahradāntike | rājā rājñī yadā snātastadā paśyāmi bhāvataḥ ||36|| rājñī snāntīṃ viharantīṃ vivastrāṃ ca jale muhuḥ | tena me kāmanā pūrvasaṃskārotthā hyabhūnmuhuḥ ||37|| rājā sudarśanaḥ snātvā rājyakāryārthameva tu | yayau svanagare rājñīmudyāne parihāya ca ||38|| sakhībhiḥ sahitā ceyaṃ māṃ vyāghraṃ ruciraṃ śubham | pālitaṃ putrasadṛśaṃ rāmayāmāsa vai muhuḥ ||3 9|| udyāne’haṃ vyacaraṃ ca tābhiḥ sākaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | ārohanti sma tāḥ kvāpi mama pṛṣṭhopari drutam ||2.70.40|| ahaṃ kadācit pārśvastho mukhena sakthicumbanam | karomyevaṃ kāmanā me rājñyāṃ vyavardhata drutam ||41|| rātrau sakhīṣu sarvāsu nidritāsu tadālaye | rātryāḥ paryaṃkapārśvasthaścintayāmi nṛpapriyām ||42|| tāṃ prati vavṛdhe citte pūrvābhyāsānmanobhavaḥ | tasyā api mama sparśād rajobhāvo vyavardhata ||43|| mayoktā rājaputri tvaṃ navayauvanaśālinī | cittaṃ harasi me rājñi vada kāmavaśaṃ gataḥ ||44|| sābravīttu manuṣyāyāṃ paśudehasya te priya | kathamatrāvayorvyāghra ratiyoga upaiṣyati ||45|| tato’vocamahaṃ rājñi kauśalyena bhaviṣyati | atha sā māṃ samāśliṣya pravṛttā rantumeva ca ||46|| tāvat kayācid sakhyā cāvalokito’hameva ca | dvārapālān śanairgatvā saśastrān sā śaśaṃsa ha ||47|| evaṃ pravartitāṃ vārtā śrutavān nṛpatiḥ svayam | rājñā tu māritaścāhaṃ yamalokaṃ gato’bhavam ||48 || tato varṣaśatānte’haṃ tvabhavaṃ śvetagardabhaḥ | bhāravāhī janānāṃ tu kuṃbhakāreṇa yojitaḥ ||49|| tatrāpi pūrvavijñānaṃ sarvaṃ me pratyabhāsata | ekadā tu mahīmānāḥ kuṃbhakārasya cāgatāḥ ||2.70.50|| kanyāḥ striyaḥ surūpāśca dinadvayaṃ sthitāstataḥ | tāsāmekā surūpā ca yuvatī ca gṛhe pituḥ ||5 1 || gantumaicchatpārśvasaṃsthe grāme krośavidūrake | tāmuvāca patirgaccha āruhyainaṃ sugardabham ||52|| śva evāgamanaṃ kāryaṃ na stheyaṃ paratastataḥ | ityevamuktā sā bhartrā tanvī tvāruhya gardabham ||53|| yayau śīghraṃ tvardhapathi nadī tatra samāgatā | sajalā tatra sā snātuṃ matpṛṣṭhāt samavātarat ||54|| kuṃbhakāro’pi ca sārthaḥ śaucārthaṃ prayayau taṭam | sarvairaṃgaiḥ rūpavatīṃ caikalāmārdravastrikām ||95|| dṛṣṭvāhaṃ jalapānasya miṣeṇa sannidhau gataḥ | snāntīṃ tāmupari gatvā patitvāśliṣya kāmataḥ ||56|| pūrvasaṃskāravaśagoliṅgasparśamakārayam | dṛṣṭo’bhavaṃ tadā tasyāḥ sārthajanena vai tadā ||57|| tāḍitaśca bhṛśaṃ yaṣṭyā patito’haṃ jalāntare | kṣaṇādutthāya ca bhayāt pradruto dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ||58|| tato’bhidravataḥ kaṇṭhe rajjudārḍhyaṃ gatā bahu | galapāśenārdharātrādabhūnme jīvitakṣayaḥ ||59|| tato’smi narake bhūyastasmānmukto’bhavaṃ śukaḥ | mahāraṇye tato baddhaḥ śabareṇa durātmanā ||2.70.60|| pañjare nyasya vikrīto vaṇikputrāya tatra ca | gṛhe vasāmi satataṃ yuvatīnāṃ samīpataḥ ||6 1|| tāstaruṇyaḥ poṣayanti phalaudanādibhiḥ sadā | ekadā tu vaṇikputrī yuvatī candrikābhidhā ||62|| karābhyāṃ māṃ prajagrāha reme vācā punaḥ punaḥ | śayane vakṣasi kṛtvā māṃ vācayati gītikām ||63|| tato’haṃ stanayoḥ sparśāt pūrvasaṃskāravegataḥ | kāmabhāvena tāṃ guhye pasparśoḍḍīya vai muhuḥ ||64|| pannakhaiḥ kṣatamāpannaṃ jaghanaṃ sā cukopa ha | tatāḍa māṃ sūkṣmayaṣṭyā bhayācca pradrutastataḥ ||6 5|| daivāttasyā dṛḍhaṃ nīvīdorakaṃ me gale’bhavat | granthirjātā dṛḍhā tena kṣaṇānmṛto’bhavaṃ tataḥ ||66|| yamaloke mahākaṣṭaṃ bhuktvā tu vṛṣabho’bhavam | cāṇḍālasya gṛhe tvāsaṃ kāṣṭhaśakaṭavāhakaḥ ||67|| vane kāṣṭhāni cānetuṃ dampatī yayatustadā | madhyāhne jalamānetuṃ cāṇḍālastu nadīṃ yayau ||68|| cāṇḍālī yuvatī cāste chāyāyāṃ śakaṭāntike | ahaṃ tāmalihaṃ kāmāt pūrvasaṃskāravegataḥ ||69|| nadītīre sadā tvevaṃ kāṣṭhādānārthameva tau | prayātaḥ pratiyātaśca varṣartustatra cāgataḥ ||2.70.70|| ekadā tu jvaravyāpto’bhavaccaṇḍālako gṛhe | cāṇḍālī tadvane yātā kāṣṭhānayanahetave ||71 || pūrvasañcitakāṣṭhāni bhṛtvā gantryā tatastu sā | jalaṃ pāyayituṃ māṃ ca nadyāṃ tatrānayat tataḥ ||72|| sā snātā rūpasampannā mayā dṛṣṭā digambarā | pūrvasaṃskārabhāvena kāmo me hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ ||73 || sā vastrāṇi paridhāya baddhaṃ raśanayā ca mām | dhure śakaṭyā yuyuje yoktreṇābadhya yāvatā ||74|| dhurasyāgre sthitā cāste kṣaṇaṃ tāvadahaṃ tadā | uḍḍīya sadhuraścāhaṃ tasyā upari cāpatam ||75|| sā madagrapadāghātāt patitā dūratastadā | ahaṃ yoktreṇa saṃyukto gantryā nimnena karṣitaḥ ||76 || cakrābhyāṃ nimnagābhyāṃ ca prakṣipto gartake tadā | śakaṭyā saha patito’gādhe gartevaśastataḥ ||77|| yoktreṇa baddha evāsmi pañcatvamagamaṃ tataḥ | sāpi cotthāya tu śanairgṛhaṃ gatā hi bhāminī ||78|| tato nimagno narake dharmarājānuśāsanāt | jātastava gṛhe tāta jātismaro’smi sarvathā ||79|| tāvantyevādya janmāni smarāmi tvānupūrvaśaḥ | pūrvābhyāsācca duḥkhāni prāptānyati mayā tataḥ ||2.70.80 || janmanyatra na vai vacmi na śṛṇomi na kāmaye | yena pāpaṃ bhavet tattu nācariṣye kathaṃcana ||81 || mūkatve ca badhiratve hetuḥ pūrvasmṛtirmama | jaḍatve’pi ca vijñānaṃ heturevāsti netarat ||82|| pāpāni ghorarūpāṇi manasā karmaṇā girā | śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ vāpi bandhanaṃ vā vadho’pi vā ||83|| pūrvābhyāsena jāyante kāmanādikamityapi | tasmādvijñānavān jānan tatra muhyati naiva tu ||84|| paurvikīṃ tu yadā jātiṃ smaratyatra tu mānavaḥ | tadā sa tebhyaḥ pāpebhyo nivṛttiṃ hi gamiṣyati ||85|| dānaṃ tapo’dhyayanaṃ ca steyaṃ pāpaṃ yaśo vṛṣaḥ | artho jñānaṃ cāgnidāhaḥ pūrvābhyāsavaśā hi te ||86|| ahiṃsā bhagavadbhaktiḥ sthairyaṃ śāntiśca kāmanā | kleśastāpo mithunāptiḥ pūrvābhyāsavaśā hi te ||87|| snehaḥ prakṛtirāstikyaṃ sevā vidyā kalā dhanam | kuṭumbitā guruḥ śiṣyaḥ pūrvābhyāsavaśā hi te ||88|| tasmād yāmi vanaṃ tāta śubhārthaṃ pāpanuttaye | ityuktvā ca yayau natvā vanaṃ jāḍyamaghastataḥ ||89|| kurukṣetraṃ gataḥ pūrvaṃ tato badarikāśramam | tapaścakāra bahudhā rādhike pāpanuttaye ||2.70.9 0|| kālena nidhanaṃ prāpto gaṃgāyāṃ tu tadā punaḥ | tapobhiḥ kṣīṇapāpaḥ sa puṇyavārdhiḥ savāsanaḥ ||9 1|| gaurjare śrīnagare’yaṃ rajiputro’bhavattataḥ | karkamaghasya rājñaḥ sa jyāmagho dhārmikaḥ śuciḥ ||92|| paśujātīyasaṃskārāstāpasī prakṛtistathā | nārāyaṇasya bhaktiśca jyāmaghe’pi tadābhavan ||93 || jātismaro’bhavad rājaputro vakti na kiṃcana | na śṛṇoti na hasati na cittaṃ vidadhāti ca ||94|| nirmanasko bhojanaṃ ca bhuṃkte pāti jalaṃ tathā | vastrālaṃkārabhūṣādi dhatte nirmānaso yathā ||95|| rājyaṃ ca rājyabhogāśca dravyaṃ bhṛtyāśca kiṃkarāḥ | dāsā dāsyo gajāśvāśca sarvaṃ tvasya samaṃ hyabhūt| || 96 || śayyā puṣpamayī cāpi pṛthvī rūkṣāsya vai samā | miṣṭaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ sugandhāḍhyaṃ bhojyaṃ rūkṣaṃ ca vā samam ||97|| praśaṃsā cāprasaṃśā vā mānaṃ tiraḥ samaṃ tathā | namaskāro’thavā pṛṣṭhakāro’sya samatāṃ gataḥ ||98|| evaṃ vai vartamānasya yauvanaṃ samupāgatam | pitrā suyojitaścāyaṃ vivāhena gṛhāśrame || 91|| kā patnī kaḥ patiśceti jijñāsāsya na vidyate | kaḥ kāmaḥ kaśca saṃkalpaḥ kā ratirviratistathā || 2.70.100 || samaṃ cāsyābhavat sarvamekadā dayitā patim | prapaccha kāraṇaṃ tasmai audāsīnye niśāntare || 10 1|| tataḥ sa rādhike smṛtvā patnīṃ jagāda śāntitaḥ | yatka rtavyaṃ bhavedatra mānave durlabhe śubham || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pūrvasvabhāvānuvartanaṃ jāḍyamaghadṛṣṭāntena ṣaḍbhirjanmabhirvivecitamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 70 ||
<2.71> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike yacca jyāmaghaḥ prāha bhāminīm | sarvamokṣapradaṃ jñānaṃ yatkṛtvā nāvaśiṣyate || 1 || jyāmaghaḥ svapriyāmāha śṛṇu devi dhanālase | śrīkṛṣṇasya parā śaktirmāyā mohakarī matā || 2 || śrīkṛṣṇarūpiṇī māyā yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat | anayaiva jagat sarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam || 3 || sṛjati poṣayatyeva grasati śrīpatiḥ svayam | asyāstvaṃśānadhiṣṭhāya śaktimanto’bhavan surāḥ || 4 || brahmeśānādayaḥ sarve’nayā śaktyā sureśvarāḥ | saiṣā sarvajagatsūtiḥ prakṛtistriguṇātmikā || 5 || nālaṃ devā na pitaro mānavā vāsavo’pi ca | māyāmetāṃ samuttartuṃ ye cānye bhuvi dehinaḥ || 6 || tadāśīstannamaskārastanniṣṭhastatparāyaṇaḥ | ārādhayan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tarati tāṃ janaḥ || 7 || ekadā paramo bhakta indradyutiśca bhūsuraḥ | sadā viṣṇuparo bhūtvā māyāṃ draṣṭuṃ mano’karot || 8 || tasyaivaṃ cehamānasya kadācitparamā kalā | svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa divyaṃ nārāyaṇodbhavam || 9 || dṛṣṭvā praṇamya śirasā nārāyaṇapriyāṃ satīm | tuṣṭāva tu tato devīṃ papraccha vinayānvitaḥ || 2.71.1 0|| kā tvaṃ mātarviśālākṣi viṣṇucihnāṃkite śubhe | yāthātathyena rūpaṃ svaṃ vadedānīṃ kṛpāmayi || 11 || śrutvāsya sāvadallakṣmīḥ śrīrahaṃ śrīhareḥ priyā | na māṃ paśyanti munayo na devā mānavāḥ kutaḥ || 1 2|| nārāyaṇātmikā tvekā māyāhaṃ tanmayī parā | na me nārāyaṇād bhedastanmayyahaṃ parameśvarī || 1 3|| sa ca sarveśvaraḥ parabrahma kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | tanmayāstatkṛtārhāśca puruṣottamasevakāḥ || 14|| jñānena karmayogena ye bhajanti pareśvaram | te tasya paramā bhaktā na teṣāṃ prabhavāmyaham || 15|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sarvasamarpaṇaiḥ | jñānenārādhayan bhakto’vaśyaṃ mokṣamavāpsyati || 16|| śrutvā papraccha ca punarindradyatiḥ śriyaṃ tadā | kathaṃ sa bhagavānīśo jñātavyaśceti me vada || 17|| evamuktā tu sā māyā karābhyāṃ taṃ tu bhūsuram | saṃspṛśyāha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vakṣyati te’nagha || 18|| ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe cāntaradhīyata | vipraḥ sa śrīhariṃ draṣṭuṃ tasthau tatra samādhinā || 19|| tadbhaktyānugrahaṃ kurvan sākṣāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ | prādurāsīt pītavāsāḥ kiśoraśca jaganmayaḥ ||2.71.20|| indradyutirhariṃ vīkṣya neme tuṣṭāva taṃ prabhum | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo puruṣottama keśava ||21 || anādiśrīhare svāmin hṛṣīkeśa ca te namaḥ | viśvātman sṛṣṭikṛtkṛṇānantaśakte ca te namaḥ ||22|| nirguṇānantadivyānāṃ guṇānāṃ pūrṇamūrtika | jñānagamya kṛpālabhya puruṣottama te namaḥ ||23 || anantamūrtaye tubhya namo’spvānandarūpiṇe | namasta parameśāya brahmaṇe paramātmane |||24|| tvaṃ pitā sarvabhūtānāṃ mātā bandhuḥ suhṛt sakhā | tvamakṣaraṃ paraṃ dhāma cinmātraṃ vyoma 3 bṛhat ||25||| sarvatyādhāramavyaktamanantaṃ tamasaḥ param | tvāṃ paśyanti parātmānaṃ jñānadīpena sevakāḥ ||26|| prapadye taṃ bhavedrūpaṃ saccidānandavigraham | yatrāste bhagavaustadvai śrīhareḥ paramaṃ pakṣa ||27|| tvameva nayasi śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho | śānaṃ dehi padaṃ dehi tvanmāyā mā pradehi me ||28|| ityuktvā prapatantaṃ taṃ pādayoḥ svakareṇa ha | pasparśa prahasan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||29|| spṛṣṭamātro bhagavatā divyacakṣustadābhavat | yathāvapparamaṃ tattvaṃ jñātavām̐statprasādataḥ ||2.71.30|| uvāca tvatprasādānme cāsaṃdigdhaṃ ca śāśvatam | jñānaṃ brahmaikaviṣayaṃ jātamānandasiddhidam || 3 1|| śādhi māṃ bhagavannatra kathaṃ sevyo’si sarvathā | kiṃ kārya ca mayā loke tvadbhaktena pareśvara || 32||| śrutvā bhaktaṃ hariḥ prāha bhaktānāṃ dharmaśālinām | jñānena bhaktiyogena pūjanīyo’hameva tu ||33|| vijñāya māṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ vibhūtiṃ kāryakāraṇam | pravṛttiṃ me parāṃ jñātvā mokṣārthī māṃ samarcayet| || 34|| sarvasaṃgān parityajya jñātvā manmāyikaṃ jagat | ekaṃ māṃ svātmani dhyāyet sa paśyenmāṃ parātparam || 3 6|| trividhāṃ bhāvanāṃ kṛtvā bhaja māṃ tvaṃ sadā dvija | ekā madviṣayā tatra parabrahmasugocarā || 36 || vyatirekeṇa bhagavān pare dhāmni virājate | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmipatiḥ prabhuḥ || 37|| svarāṭ sarvāvatārāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ sarvaśaktimān | dvitīyā bhāvanā tatra sarvācicciccharīriṇī || 38 || jaḍaṃ ca cetanaṃ sarvaṃ vyāpyaṃ śrīparamāpmanaḥ | adhīnaṃ ca niyāmyaṃ ca sarvaṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ || 39 || teṣu sarveṣu tattveṣu cāntarātmā virājate | so’yaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ || 2.71.40 || tadvināṇurapi nāsti tadātmakaṃ ca tanmayam | taṃ vyatiricya na cāsti jaḍaṃ cetanamityapi ||41 | | tasmāt sarvā tasya mūrtirmūrtimānata eva saḥ | divyo divyo yathā cāste tathā jaḍe’pi divyakaḥ ||42|| nirbaddho niṣkalaṃkaścāsam̐go’ntaryāmisaṃsthitaḥ | tvayi mayi tathānyatra sarvatrāyaṃ virājate ||43 || ityevaṃ māṃ sarvatattve vilokya parisevaya | tṛtīyā bhāvanā cātha naije brahmasvarūpiṇī || 44|| brahmasvarūpaḥ svayaṃ cāsmītyevaṃ manyeta dehavān | sā brāhmī nijarūpasya guṇātigā pravartate | |45|| ahaṃ brahmāsmi jīvātmā jīvatvaṃ karmayuktatā | karmāṇi brahmaṇi naiva santi brahmātmatā hi sā ||46 || sarvaṃ karma prakartavyaṃ brahma tena na lipyate | evaṃ tredhā bhāvayitvā paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt ||47|| aśakto mūḍhavaccāpi hareḥ śaraṇamāśrayet | tataḥ sarvaprayatnena tanniṣṭhastatparāyaṇaḥ ||48 || ārādhayet parabrahma tena mokṣo bhaved dhruvam | tasya śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ ||49|| aiśvaryāṇi samastāni nityā vibhūtirucyate | prabhvārādhanayā bhakte vibhūtiḥ pratipadyate || 2.71.5 0 || kārye jagati cāvyakte vyaktāvyaktātmake’pyaham | kāraṇaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahma viśiṣṭaṃ cāsmi sarvathā ||5 1 || ahaṃ nārāyaṇastatrāntaryāmīśvarapūjitaḥ | sargasthityantakartāsmi vijñāyaivaṃ bhajasva mām ||52|| tatastvaṃ jñānakarmabhyāṃ māmupaiṣyasi yogataḥ | ahaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī pūrvamāsaṃ mahān virāṭ ||53||| caturmukhastato brahmā mayā sṛṣṭaḥ pitāmahaḥ | rudraḥ sṛṣṭastathā viṣṇustato mayā mamāṅgataḥ ||54|| sṛṣṭā śrīrviṣṇuśaktiśca kamalāyatalocanā | surūpā saumyavadanā mohinī sarvadehinām ||55|| śucismitā suprasannā divyakāntiḥ suśobhitā | divyamālāmbarabhūṣādhāriṇī mahimāspadā || 56|| nārāyaṇī mahāmāyā mūlaprakṛtivaiṣṇavī | tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tu tadā brahmā māmuvāca punaḥ punaḥ ||57|| mohāyāśeṣabhūtānāṃ niyojaya surūpiṇīm | yeneyaṃ vipulā sṛṣṭirvardheta mama keśava ||58|| tathokto’haṃ śriyaṃ devīmavocaṃ prahasam̐stadā | devīdamakhilaṃ viśvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam |||59|| mohayitvā mamādeśāt saṃsāre vinipātaya | kevalāṃ tvāṃ ye bhajeran tān tvayi sannirodhaya |||2.71.6 0|| jñānayogaratān dāntān brahmiṣṭhān brahmavādinaḥ | akrodhanān satyaparān dūrataḥ parivarjaya ||6 1|| vedavijñānavedāntajñānaśamitasaṃśayān | brahmayajñaparān viprān dūrataḥ parivarjaya ||62|| ye yajanti japairhomairbhajanaiḥ parameśvaram | svādhyāyenejyayā dūrāttān prayatnena varjaya ||6 3 || bhaktiyogasamāyuktānīśvarārpitamānasān | mayi sarvārpaṇakartṝn dūrātpariharāmalān ||64|| mannāmāsaktamanaso manmūrtidhyānaparāyaṇān | matsādhusevakān bhaktān dharmiṣṭhān parivarjaya ||65|| bahunātra kimuktena sādhūn sādhvīrvivarjaya | madārādhanasaṃmagnān manniyogānna mohaya ||66 || evaṃ mayā mama māyā preritā mama vallabhā | yathādeśaṃ karotīyaṃ na badhnāti mamānugān ||67|| tāṃ madbhaktaḥ pūjayecca lakṣmīṃ śriyaṃ samarcayet | śriyaṃ dadāti vipulāṃ puṣṭiṃ medhāṃ yaśo balam ||68|| arcitā bhagavatpatnī dadāti sampadaḥ śubhāḥ | kṛṣṇasevāṃ dadātyeṣā tasmāllakṣmīṃ samarcayet ||69|| vinā karma na vai dehī tiṣṭhate ca nisargataḥ | pravṛttaṃ ca nivṛttaṃ ca dvividhaṃ karma jāyate ||2.71.70|| jñānapūrvaṃ nivṛttaṃ syāt pravṛttaṃ yadato’nyathā | nivṛttaṃ sevamānastu yāti tatparamaṃ padam ||71 || kṣamā damo dayā dānamalobhastyāga ityapi | ārjavaṃ cānasūyā ca tīrthānusaraṇaṃ tathā ||72||| satyaṃ santoṣamāstikyaṃ śraddhā cendriyanigrahaḥ | devatābhyarcanaṃ pūjā sādhūnāṃ vai viśeṣataḥ ||73||| ahiṃsā priyavāditvamapaiśunyaṃ sunamratā | sarvamanuṣyajātīnāṃ dharmo’yaṃ mokṣado bhavet ||74|| prājāpatyaṃ tu viprāṇāṃ svargasthānaṃ kriyāvatām | sthānamaindraṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tathādharmaiḥ pravartatām ||75|| vaiśyānāṃ mārutaṃ sthānaṃ tathādharmeṣu vartinām | gāndharvaṃ śūdrajātīnāṃ tathādāsyeṣu vartinām ||76|| aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇāṃ yatīnāmūrdhvaretasām | yatsthānaṃ tattu vairājaṃ sthānaṃ vai gurusevinām ||77|| saptarṣīṇāṃ tu yatsthānaṃ tat sadharmivanaukasām | prājāpatyaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ tathādharmeṣu vartatām ||78|| yatīnāṃ nyāsināmūrdhvaretasāṃ tyāgināṃ satām | satīnāṃ brahmasādhvīnāṃ vairājaṃ sthānamucyate ||79|| yogīnāmamṛtaṃ sthānaṃ bhūmnaścāvyākṛtaṃ tu yat | bhaktānāṃ tu tadūrdhvaṃ ca vyomākhyaṃ paramakṣaram ||2.71.80 || ānandamaiśvaraṃ dhāma yasmānnāvartate punaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmyarpitātmanām ||8 1 || paramaṃ dhāma evāsti parameśvararājitam | sarvaibrahmamayairyuktaiḥ saccidānandalakṣaṇaiḥ ||82|| śṛṇu cānyat pravakṣyāmi mokṣadaṃ jñānamuttamam | sarveṣāmāśramāṇāṃ tu dvaividhyaṃ cāntare matam ||83|| brahmacāryupakurvāṇo naiṣṭhiko brahmatatparaḥ | yo’dhītya vidhivad vedān gṛhasthāśramamāviśet ||84|| upakurvāṇako jñeyo naiṣṭhiko maraṇāntikaḥ | sādhakaścāpyudāsīno gṛhastho dvividho mataḥ ||85|| kuṭumbabharaṇāyattaḥ sādhako’sau gṛhī bhavet | ṛṇāni trīṇyapākṛtya niḥsaṃgaḥ syādudāsavān ||86|| vānaprasthastāpasaśca maukṣikaśca dvidhā mataḥ | tapohomayajanasvādhyāyaniṣṭhastu tāpasaḥ ||87 || tataścāgre dhyānaniṣṭho kṛṣṇasevastu maukṣikaḥ | sannyāso jñānabhāk cādyo dvitīyo bhaktibhāgapi ||88|| jñānāya vartate bhikṣurdehātmanorvivekavān | ātmaratiścātmatṛptaḥ sanyāso jñānabhāgayam ||89|| samyagdarśanasampannaḥ kṛṣṇasevāparāyaṇaḥ | kṛṣṇaratiḥ kṛṣṇatṛptaḥ sanyāsau maukṣikaḥ sa hi ||2.71.90 || yogī tu cāśramaḥ sarvāśrameṣu vidyate sadā | gṛhe’nāsakta evādyo vivekī sa tu yogirāṭ ||9 1 || ahaṃ brahmākṣararūpo nirlepaḥ sa tu yogirāṭ | parabrahmaṇa evāhaṃ prapannaḥ sa tu yogirāṭ ||92|| evaṃ tredhā bhaved yogī mokṣamārgānuyogavān | evaṃ mayā prajābhyaścārpitaṃ vai mokṣasādhanam || 93|| brahmaṇe śikṣitaṃ sarvaṃ brahmā dadau tataśca tat | ṛṣibhyo nijaputrebhyastairmārgairmokṣamāpnuvan ||94|| guṇāstrayo gṛhītāśca mayaiva jagato hitāḥ | anyonyamanuraktāste hyanyonyamapajīvinaḥ ||95|| anyonyapraṇatāścaiva līlayā pārameśvarāḥ | sattvarajastamoyogānmamaiva paramātmanaḥ ||96|| tisrastumūrtayaḥ proktā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | ahaṃ brahmā, mahādevo, na bhinnāḥ paramārthataḥ || 97|| vibhajya svecchayātmānamantaryāmī sthito’pyaham | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena vandyastredhāpi mādhavaḥ ||98|| yadīcchedacirātsthānaṃ yattanmokṣākhyamavyayam | varṇāśramasya dharmeṇa bhaktyā māṃ sevayet dvijaḥ || 99|| pūjayed bhāvayuktena yāvajjīvaṃ pratijñayā | āśrame vaiṣṇave brāhme śāṃbhave vā sthito’pi mām || 2.71.10 0|| taccihnadhārī niyatastadbhaktajanavatsalaḥ | dhyāyenmāmarcayed devān parāvidyāparāyaṇaḥ || 101 || yastu nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ prapannaḥ śaraṇāgataḥ | dhārayedūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ tu lalāṭe candanādibhiḥ || 102|| agre śaṃbhurmadhye viṣṇurmūle brahmā pratiṣṭhati | prapanno yā jagadbījaṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam || 1 03|| dhārayet sa mahābinduṃ lalāṭe bhālamadhyagam | ūrdhvarekhā śāṃbhavī ca madhye viṣṇurvyavasthitaḥ || 1 04|| adhorekhā tu sā brāhmī tridevāḥ santi tatra ca | śaṃbhuṃ prapanno bhaktastu bhasmanā vai tripuṇḍrakam || 1 05|| lalāṭe candramastulyaṃ cārdhabhāgena dhārayet | upari vartate śaṃbhurmadhye viṣṇuradho hyajaḥ || 1 06|| saṃvartate tataścaitad brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakam | sūryatulyaṃ rudrabhālaṃ candratulyaṃ tu vaiṣṇavam || 1 07|| vahnitulyaṃ brahmabhālaṃ tilakenojjvalaṃ sadā | bhavatyeva surasthānamaiśvaraṃ tilake kṛte || 1 08|| evaṃ cihnaṃ paraṃ dhṛtvā kṛtvā vivekamātmanaḥ | datvātmānaṃ prabhoḥ pāde śāśvataṃ padamāpnuhi || 1 09|| ityevaṃ rādhike śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrayam | jñānaṃ vijñānasampannaṃ svapatnyai jyāmagho dadau || 2.71.11 0|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī purendradyutaye dadau | mokṣadaṃ sarvamevaitad vijñānaṃ karmiṇāmapi || 111 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne jyāmaghanṛpaḥ svapatnyai dhanālasāyai bhagavatā indradyutiviprāya pūrvamuktaṃ sarvamuktavānityādinirūpaṇanāmaikasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 71 ||
<2.72> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca nibodha rādhike caitad vijñānaṃ paramādbhutam | brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho yatistathā || 1 || āśramāḥ kramasampannāḥ kāraṇādanyathāpi te | utpannajñānavijñānī vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 2 || pravrajed brahmacaryāttu gṛhasthādvā yathocitam | dārānāhṛtya vidhivad yajecca vividhairmakhaiḥ || 3 || dharmeṇotpādayet putrān vairāgye sati sannyaset | atha vairāgyavegena sthātuṃ notsahate gṛhe || 4 || vānaprastho bhavet pūrvaṃ paścāt sanyāsamāśrayet | ativairāgyavegastu sanyāsameva cāśrayet || 5 || vānaprasthāśramaṃ gatvā yadvā sanyāsamityapi | punarna gṛhamāgacchet na viśed dārasaṃgame || 6 || sarveṣāmeva vairāgyaṃ sanyāse tu vidhīyate | aviraktastu sanyāsāt patatyena na saṃśayaḥ || 7 || ekāśrame’thavā samyag vartetāmaraṇāntikam | taddharmijñānibhaktastu so’mṛtatvāya kalpate || 8 || dharmārthaṃ dattasarvasvo brahmavidyaḥ praśāntimān | jñānavijñānasampanno brahmabhūyāya kalpate || 9 || brahmaṇyarpayya karmāṇi kāmasaṃgādivarjitaḥ | prasannāraktamanasā kurvāṇo yāti tatpadam || 2.72.1 0|| brahmaṇā dīyate deyaṃ brahmaiva dīyate hi tat | dīyate brahmaṇe dānaṃ brahmārpaṇamidaṃ param || 11 || nāhaṃ kartā sarvametad brahmaiva kurute tathā | etad brahmārpaṇaṃ karma brahmaṇi paridhīyate || 12|| pṛṇotu śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī svakarmaṇā | evaṃ matvā kriyate tad brahmārpaṇamidaṃ param || 13 || phalānāṃ cāpi sanyāsaṃ prakuryātparameśvare | evaṃ phalapradānaṃ ca brahmārpaṇamanuttamam || 14|| kāryamityeva yatkarma niyataṃ saṃgavarjitam | kriyate viduṣā karma tadbhavedapi mokṣadam || 15|| karmaṇāṃ phalasannyāso yadi brahmaṇi neyate | tadā phalena badhyeta mokṣarodho bhavettataḥ || 16|| arpaṇāt kṣīyate pāpaṃ puṇyaṃ vā mokṣabodhakam | aihikaṃ paurvikaṃ vāpi manaḥprasannatā bhavet || 17|| ātmavittvaṃ bhaveccāpi brahmavijjāyate tataḥ | karmaṇā sahitāj jñānāt samyag yogo’bhijāyate || 18|| yogāt śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasānnidhyamīyate | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena yatra tatrāśrame rataḥ || 1 9|| karmāṇīśvaratuṣṭyarthaṃ kuryānnaiṣkarmyamāpnuyāt | samprāpya brahmavijñānaṃ naiṣkarmyaṃ tatprasādataḥ ||2.72.20|| nijātmātmaparabrahmānande magno jitendriyaḥ | ekākī nirmamaḥ śānto jīvannapi samuktavat || 21 || vīkṣate paramātmānaṃ parabrahma pareśvaram | nityānandī nirupādhiḥ śrīharau līnatāṃ vrajet| ||22|| tasmāt seveta ca rādhe naiṣkarmye tvarpaṇātmakam | tṛptaye parameśasya tena yāyāt paraṃ padam ||23|| evaṃ kṛtā tu yā niṣṭhā siddhiṃ dadāti śāśvatīm | na tvetāṃ samatikramya siddhiṃ vindati mānavaḥ ||24|| evaṃ sarvaṃ jyāmagho’pi vicārya cātmano hitam | uktvā patnyai samastaṃ tu vijñānaṃ jñānapūrvakam ||25 || kṛtvā jñānena ca nijāṃ kāntāṃ tu brahmarūpiṇīm | datvā rājyaṃ svānujāya śrīmaghāya haripriyaḥ || 26 || jyāmaghaḥ strīsahitaśca pitroḥ pādau praṇamya ca | bhrātaraṃ ca samāśliṣya kṣemamāvedya sarvataḥ ||27|| prajāśīrvādamādāya sābhramatīnadītaṭe | āśrame tu satāṃ nityaṃ satsaṃgaṃ pracakāra ha ||28|| bhrātrā svanāmasahitaṃ tacchrīnagaraṃ khyāpitam | jyāmaghastu tato yajñaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ śubham ||29|| kārayāmāsa svabhrātṛdvārā sābhramatītaṭe | tadbhaktyā homasamaye śrīyutaḥ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ||2.72.3 0|| mūrtimām̐statra cāyāto yajñamaṇḍapamacyutaḥ | vahniḥ svayaṃ mūrtimām̐śca brahmā śaṃbhustathāgatāḥ ||3 1|| devatā bubhujarhavyaṃ jyāmaghena samarpitam | śrīḥ prasannā ca taṃ prāha tava bhaktyā janārdanaḥ ||32|| prasanno māṃ tava rājye sthātuṃ cājñāṃ karoti hi | nāhamekākinī vāsaṃ kariṣye prattane tava ||33|| yajñatṛptāsmi sañjātā sākaṃ matpatinā suraiḥ | kārayātrālayaṃ ramyaṃ yatra vasāmi nityadā ||34|| śrutvā ca jyāmagho bhrātrā saha mumoda bhaktarāṭ | evamuktvā punaḥ prāha yāhi kuṃkumavāpikām || 35|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetraṃ tatra vasāmi nityadā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasevāparāyaṇā ||36|| dampatyostatra tu punaḥ sevayā dāsyayuktayā | darśanaṃ me svāminaśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||37|| ityuktvā ca tirorāsa sadevā sanarāyaṇā | yajñaḥ samāptimagamannagare śrīrvyavardhata ||38|| śrīmaghaṃ pitarau natvā jyāmagho dattadakṣiṇaḥ | sābhramatyāṃ naukayā ca sapatnīko viniryayau ||3 9|| śrīmaghaḥ kārayāmāsa mandiraṃ saptabhūmikam | meghasparśaṃ saśikharaṃ nārāyaṇākhyaghaṭṭake ||2.72.40|| tatra lakṣmīyuto nārāyaṇo vaidikakarmabhiḥ | pratiṣṭhāpita evādau rājñāsmai vāṭikārpitā ||41 || pūjānaivedyaśṛṃgārotsavāścāpi niyojitāḥ | evaṃ bheje śrīmagho’pi śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||42|| lakṣavarṣaṃ tu tadrājyaṃ bhuktvā dhāma paraṃ yayau | jyāmagho’pi nadīmārgādāyayau staṃbhavāridhim ||43|| tataḥ śrīgopanāthaṃ ca kṛtvā tīrthaṃ tataḥ param | nāvaṃ visṛjya yānena yayau kuṃkumavāpikām ||44|| aśvapaṭṭasaro dṛṣṭvā vīkṣya śrīlomaśāśramam | bhūmikāṃ divyaśobhāḍhyāṃ vīkṣyānandaṃ paraṃ yayau || 45|| dṛṣṭvā śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāsādamucchritam | vyomacumbiśikharāṇi dhvajān vīkṣya sagadgadaḥ ||46 || daṇḍavat praṇanāmādau pradakṣiṇaṃ cakāra tam | tāvat tatra samāyāto vipro bālasvarūpavān ||47|| ramaṇīyaḥ śrīnivāsaḥ sarvasaundaryabhājanam | padmapatrāyatanetraḥ sūkṣmacakrānvitāṅguliḥ ||48|| vakṣodhṛtojjvalamaṇistejaḥparidhiśobhitaḥ | svāgataṃ pracakārāsau tīrthasthalāni darśayan ||49|| nināya mandire yatra śrīkāntaḥ saṃvirājate | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gajāsanasthitam ||2.72.50|| darśayāmāsa vipraḥ sa tatra cāntaradhīyata | jyāmaghastasya rājñī ca paramāścaryamāgatau ||5 1|| sākṣānmānavanāṭyasya darśanaṃ prāpya tatparam | bālakṛṣṇasya ca tatra darśanaṃ prāpya vai punaḥ ||52|| dvayoraikyaṃ svarūpe ca svabhāve guṇavartane | mūrterapīti vijñāyāmanyatāṃ ca kṛtārthakau ||53 || aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ jyāmaghasya ca tatstriyāḥ | sākṣād viprabaṭurūpo bālakṛṣṇo’bhavattadā ||54|| ānināya gṛhaṃ naijaṃ bālakṛṣṇe tiro’bhavat | anekajanmapuṇyānāṃ sevayā tatprasannatā |||55||| jāyate yena bhagavān svayaṃ svagṛhamāyayau | tato gopālakṛṣṇaṃ ca mātaraṃ kambharāsatīm ||56|| bhagavantaṃ ca santoṣāṃ dadṛśatustataḥ param | śukaṃ dṛṣṭvā vallabhaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā vai suramaṇḍalam ||57|| mumudatustāvatyarthaṃ pupūjatū parameśvaram | candanākṣatakuṃkumośīragulālavāribhiḥ ||58|| puṣpatulasīkalhārapuṇḍarīkasukesaraiḥ | hārabhūṣāmbaradravyaiḥ pūjayāmāsaturhi tau ||59|| upadāḥ svarṇapātrādi nyadhātāṃ puratastadā | miṣṭapakvānnapātrādi tāmbūlakaṃ jalādikam ||2.72.6 0|| dadatustau śrīharaye mātre ca janakāya ca | ārārtrikaṃ cakratuśca daṇḍavacca namaskṛtim ||6 1 || bālakṛṣṇastu papracchāgamane kṣemamityapi | kuśalaṃ ca pravāse’pyapīḍāṃ sukhāgamaṃ tathā ||62|| tata ātithyakāryārthaṃ nināya dampatī hariḥ | bhojanaṃ kārayāmāsa jalaṃ tāmbūlakādikam ||63|| nivāsārthaṃ svatantraṃ ca saudhaṃ hariḥ samārpayat | dampatībhyāṃ dāsadāsīrdadau vastūni sarvaśaḥ ||64|| viśaśrāmātha rājāsau sāyaṃ tvaśvasarovaram | snātuṃ prayayau vidhinā snātvā sandhyāṃ cakāra ha ||65|| aśvapaṭṭasarasaśca tīrthakoṭyanvitasya ca | aṣṭottaraśatavartiyuktaṃ nīrājanaṃ vyadhāt ||66|| jalaṃ pītvā nijaṃ saudhaṃ samāyayau ca sānugaḥ | rātriṃ nināya sukhataḥ prātaḥsnānottaraṃ nṛpaḥ ||67|| pūjayitvā svāminaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim | ārārtrikādikaṃ kṛtvā dadau dānāni sarvaśaḥ ||68|| svarṇabhūṣāmbaradravyamuktāmaṇīn dadau bahūn | bhojayāmāsa tīrthasthān viprān ṛṣīn sukanyakāḥ ||69|| sarveṣāṃ cāpi devānāṃ tīrthayātrāṃ cakāra ha | aśvapaṭṭasaraḥpradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā gṛhaṃ yayau ||2.72.70|| dhanyo vai gundrako vṛkṣo dhanyā tintiḍikā śubhā | dhanyo dāḍimavṛkṣaśca dhanyau jambudvayadrumau ||71|| dhanyā sā badarī yatra bhagavān saṃvirājate | dhanyā sā kuṃkumavāpī tīrthottamottamottamā ||72|| dhanyo’haṃ jyāmaghaścāpi dhanyā dhanālasā priyā | yeṣāmanādidevaśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśraye ||73 || vāso vai vidyate te tu brahmaloke vasanti hi | evaṃ cintayamānaṃ taṃ rājñī prāha tvarānvitā ||74|| mandiraṃ śrīdarśitaṃ tat kārayātra mahattamam | yatra nārāyaṇo devaḥ sadā naḥ pūjyatāṃ vrajet ||75|| śrutvā rājā mandiraṃ ca kīdṛg viśālamucchritam | kārayitavyamevetyacintayat kṣaṇamātrakam ||76 || tāvattejaḥ paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śvetaṃ dadarśa cāyatam | tatra dadarśa śikharaṃ caikaṃ viśālamantare ||77|| tatra madhye śubhāṃ mūrtiṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmikām | vāme rādhāṃ śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ pāravatīṃ prabhāṃ tathā ||78|| māṇikīṃ ceti patnīstā dadarśa divyadarśanāḥ | dakṣe pitaraṃ jananīṃ santoṣāṃ bhaginīṃ tathā ||79|| bhagavantaṃ śukaṃ cāpi vallabhaṃ haribāndhavān | dadarśa maṇḍalaṃ caitat svaṃ rājñīṃ pradadarśa ca ||2.72.80 || sevāyāṃ ceti tatsarvaṃ tataścāntaradhīyata | rājā śilpivaraṃ tatra cāhūyākathayattadā ||81 || śilpivaryaścitrapaṭaṃ cakāra tadyathoditam | tato vai mandiraṃ ramyaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasya paścime |||82|| kārayāmāsa sampūrṇaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ vidhināpi ca | trayodaśapratimānāṃ kārayāmāsa bhūsuraiḥ ||83 || svasaudhaṃ kārayāmāsa samāhūya ca lomaśam | dīkṣāṃ jagrāha ca sāṃkhyayogadharmānvitāṃ śubhām ||84|| nijasaudhe mandire taṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | bheje bhaktyā sapatnīkaścottamo vaiṣṇavo mahān ||85|| pūrvajanmasvabhāvān sa kṣapayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ | vratena tapasā nityaṃ dhyānena dāsyabhāvataḥ ||86|| mahābhāgavato bhūtvā sarvaṃ cakāra bhāvataḥ | caturviṃśatitattvāni haryarthaṃ pracakāra saḥ ||87|| nṛpaḥ śrīkṛṣṇadevāya cārpayāmāsa cetanam | sattvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇadevasya prakāśane nyayojayat ||88|| rajastasya pravṛttyarthaṃ yathā tuṣṭo bhaveddhariḥ | tamo bhūtau pralayārthaṃ nyayuṅkta śrīharestadā ||89|| mahattattvaṃ buddhirūpaṃ tannirṇaye nyayojayat | cittaṃ tu cintane cāhaṃ tasyābhimānane’karot ||2.72.90|| manastu manane tasya śrotraṃ kathāśrave hareḥ | tvagasya sparśane’rakṣat cakṣustaddarśane’karot ||9 1|| rasanā tatprasādasya svāde jihvāsya kīrtane | nāsā tatpuṣpasaugandhye vāgasya guṇavarṇane || 92|| hastau dāsye ca kaiṃkarye sevāyāṃ sarvadākarot | pādau tamabhigamane prādakṣiṇye’karottathā ||93 || pādyaṃ cāsanabandhe’sya liṃgamānandane’sya ca | balaṃ tadbhāravahane kalāstatsevane’karot ||94|| daihikaṃ sarvamevāyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya samārpayat | rājñī cāpi tathā sarvaṃ bālakṛṣṇāya cārpayat ||95|| tanmātrāṇi viṣayām̐śca śubhaṃ cāśubhamityapi | sarvaṃ dadau tu haraye svayaṃ prāghūrṇikābhavat ||96 || kriyā sarvā varṣmaṇastu śrīkṛṣṇāya tathārpayat | pūjanaṃ smaratāṃ tasya vandanaṃ stavanaṃ sadā ||97|| pādasammardanaṃ viṣṇorarcanaṃ dāsyamityapi | sakhyaṃ kelirnarmavākyaṃ hasanaṃ hāsyamityapi ||98|| kīrtanaṃ cārpaṇaṃ sarvaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇe’karot sadā | rājñī cāpi mahābhāgavatī bhaktā babhūva ha ||99|| mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ pakvanaivedyakaraṇaṃ tathā | jalāharaṇamevāpi vastrāṇāṃ kṣālanādikam || 2.72.10 0|| pātrāṇāṃ mañjanaṃ cāpi puṣpānayanamityapi | mālikāgrathanaṃ cāpi tulasyānayanaṃ tathā || 101 || vāyorāndolanaṃ cāpi dolāndolanamityapi | sarvaṃ cakāra hastābhyāṃ śayyāstaraṇamityapi || 1 02|| pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sarvadā | kiṃkarīva vidadhāti sarvārpaṇaṃ tadākarot || 1 03|| evaṃ saṃsevamānau tau divyapuṇyāśritau śubhau | prakṣīṇakalmaṣau jātau bālakṛṣṇābhyanugrahāt || 1 04|| lomaśena prāpito ca mantraṃ śrīvaiṣṇavaṃ param | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ || 1 05|| labdhvā mantraṃ pūjayitvā hariṃ cāṣāḍhaśuklake | ekādaśyāṃ ravyudaye dhyānamagnau sthirau kṣaṇam || 1 06|| abhavatāṃ tadā divyaṃ vimānaṃ tvakṣarācchubham | sapārṣadaṃ samāyātaṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham || 1 07|| dehau tyaktvā jyāmaghaśca dhanālasā vimānake | pārṣadānāmājñayā cārohatāṃ divyavarṣmaṇau || 108|| yayau vimānaṃ tvaritaṃ cākṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam | jayaśabdāścābhavam̐śca śrīnārāyaṇamandire || 1 09|| ityevaṃ rādhike tau tu bhaktyā mokṣamavāpatuḥ | pāṭhako vācakaḥ śrotāpyasya mokṣapadaṃ vrajet || 2.72.11 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne jyāmagharājñastatpatnyā dhanālasāyāḥ kuṃkumavāpyāṃ tvātmaniveditabhaktyā mokṣaṇamitinirūpaṇanāmā dvāsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 72 | |
<2.73> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ hareḥ śubham | gaurjare vartate ramyā nadī dhrādharasaṃjñikā || 1 || tattaṭād dakṣiṇe cāste āmodanagaraṃ śubham | bahuśreṣṭhijanāvāsaṃ devasevāparāyaṇam || 2 | vyavasāyaparairloṃkairadhiṣṭhitaṃ dhanānvitaiḥ | mānavā bahudhā yatra dhrādharātīravāsinaḥ || 3 | nyūṣurbhaktāstatraśaṃbhoḥ śaṃbhubhaktiparā varāḥ | dhrādharāyāstaṭe cānye pūjāpāṭhaparāyaṇāḥ || 4 | yāntyāyānti ca nagaraṃ kṛtvā śaṃbhośca darśanam | vaiṣṇavaṃ mandiraṃ tatra dhrādharāyāstaṭe śubham || 5 |. śriyā yukto hariryatra nārāyaṇo virājate | pratimārūpadhārī sa pūjyate cārcyate janaiḥ || 6 | vandyate sevyate cāpi vaiṣṇavaiḥ sarvadā prage | mandirasyābhitastatra vasanti sādhavo’malāḥ || 7 | tatprasaṃgādabhavacca vaiṣṇavaḥ sudhano vaṇik | sudhanākhyo nityamādau snātvā samarcya devatāḥ || 8 | natvā ca vaiṣṇavān sādhūn yāti śaṃbhvālayaṃ tataḥ | udyānavaryasaṃkulaṃ vṛkṣavallyādirājitam || 9 | phalapuṣpādisaṃśobhattaruvaryavirājitam | jalavāpīyutaṃ stambasasyasmṛddhisuśobhitam || 2.73.10| nirābādhaṃ ca bhaktānāṃ śāntidaṃ darśanādapi | āmodeśvaraliṃgaṃ ca tadudyāne mahālaye || 11 | virājate susphaṭikadyuti divyaṃ manoharam | tatsevāyāṃ vipravaryo maharṣirvarcakāyaniḥ || 12| brahmacaryaparo yajñahomakāryaparāyaṇaḥ | phalamātrāśano vyomaśayano divyadṛṣṭimān || 13 | vaiṣṇavaḥ paramaḥ śaṃbhau sevādharmaparāyaṇaḥ | vedavedāṅgavidyādhiḥ kathākhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 14 vratena kṛtakārśyāptiśuṣkanāḍīkadehavān | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāparāyaṇaḥ || 15| nityaṃ sāyaṃ śivodyāne tarumaṇḍapasaṃśritaḥ | kathāṃ karoti devāstāṃ śṛṇvanti mānavādayaḥ || 16 || narā nāryaḥ pakṣiṇaśca dehinastannivāsinaḥ | tacchrotuṃ nityadā yāti sudhano bhaktibhāvanaḥ || 17|| tatra vai śrutavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim | saurāṣṭre kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre śrīkambharāsutam || 18|| bālakṛṣṇaṃ parabrahma gopālakṛṣṇabālakam | sarvasāmarthyayuktaṃ śrīrādhāramādisevitam || 1 9|| virājantaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro’ntikaṃ mahālaye | lomaśasyāśramaṃ cāpi tīrthāni ca bahūnyapi ||2.73.20 || tato’sya vaṇijo jātā sudhanasya śubhāśrayā | sākṣādanādidevasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tu ||2 1 || dhṛtamānavanāṭyasya didṛkṣā mokṣadāyinī | nityaṃ cintayate ramyaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ divāniśam ||22|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | mantraṃ jagrāha ca tasmādṛṣeḥ śrīvarcakāyaneḥ ||23|| jajāpa taṃ paramaṃ mantraṃ dadhyau mūrtiṃ hṛdantare | satyāṃ cāpi didṛkṣāyāṃ dūradeśaṃ
