vicārya saḥ ||24|| gṛhe’rcāyāṃ tu santoṣaṃ hyamanyatārcanādibhiḥ | nityaṃ pūjayate’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ||25|| naivedyaṃ dadate prātarmadhyāhne ca niśāmukhe | ārārtrikaṃ ca dadate stavaṃ jāpaṃ karotyapi ||26|| utsavān kurute cāpi nyāyāgatadhanaiḥ śubhān | tatpatnīputrapautrādyā vaiṣṇavāḥ śrīhariśritāḥ ||27|| devasevāparā hyāsan sādhusevāparāyaṇāḥ | kathāśravaparāścāsan kṛṣṇārpaṇātmabuddhayaḥ ||28|| sevante satataṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sādhūn sādhvīrdhanādibhiḥ | yānavāhanabhojyādyaiḥ pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ ||29|| evaṃ vai vartamānasya sudhanasya gṛhe sadā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtau hariḥ svayam ||2.73.30|| prakaṭībhūya sākṣāttu gṛhṇātyannādi cārpitam | prasādaṃ dadate cāsmai bhaktāya prahasaṃstataḥ ||3 1 || bālakṛṣṇastiro yāti mūrtau nityaṃ tathākarot | ekadā sudhanaḥ śreṣṭhī pautravivāhakāraṇāt || 32|| svavāhinīṃ pariṣkṛtya dhanabhūṣāmbarādibhiḥ | naranārīvararājayuto gantryādivāhanaiḥ || 33 || āmodāttu yayau kanyānagaraṃ jāmbusārasam | nāvānadīṃ samuttīrya gatvā ca jāmbusārasam ||34|| vidhiṃ vaivāhikaṃ kṛtvā pratyāvartata vai yadā | dhrādharākhyanadītīre taskarā viṃśatiprathāḥ ||35|| āpeturugrarūpāstu saśastrā vṛkṣasaṃkule | tāḍayāmāsurugrāste śakaṭīvāhakām̐stathā ||36|| vāhinīrakṣakām̐ścāpi nijaghnuryaṣṭikādibhiḥ | suvarṇaṃ ca vibhūṣāśca rūpyaṃ tathāmbarādikam ||37|| śreṣṭhaṃ dhanaṃ samājahruścāśvavārā hi taskarāḥ | bhojyādikaṃ cāpi jahruḥ sudhano duḥkhito’bhavat ||38|| kuṭumbaṃ cāpi tatsārthastadābhavad dhanojjhitaḥ | bhūṣāhīnā yoṣitaśca śṛṃgārāmbaravarjitāḥ ||39|| abhavan śokasaṃmagnāḥ sambandhibāndhavāstathā | mahīmānā dhanahīnā nistejaskā ca vāhinī ||2.73.40|| śokodvegaparo jāto vadhūjanaḥ sakhījanaḥ | snuṣā cāmaṃgalagrastā vivāhe sati cābhavat ||41 || lakṣmīnāśo’bhavadbhāvidāridryasūcakaḥ khalu | evaṃ vicārya sudhanaḥ kṛtvā sthairyaṃ hṛdi sthitaḥ ||42|| ātmanātmānamālambya sasmāra bālakṛṣṇakam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sveṣṭaṃ pareśvaram ||43|| tuṣṭāva parayā prītyā sveṣṭadevaṃ pumuttamam | kṛpānātha dayāsindho saṃsārārṇavatāraka ||44|| śaraṇāgatarakṣākṛt rakṣayātra vanāntare | tvayā gajasya vai pūrvaṃ kṛtā rakṣā jalāntare ||45|| tvayā prahlādarakṣā ca kṛtā dānavamaṇḍale | tvayā ca marutāṃ rakṣā kṛtā garbhagṛhāntare ||46|| tvaṃ pātā tvaṃ vidhātā ca paramātmā sanātanaḥ | rakṣa rakṣa kṛpāvārdhe caurāṇāṃ trāsataḥ prabho ||47|| sarvasvaṃ saṃhṛtaṃ caurairjīvanaṃ gṛhamedhinām | svarṇarūpyavibhūṣādi tataścoddhara duḥkhataḥ ||48|| gṛhasthānāṃ dhanaṃ dravyaṃ bhūṣā dravyaṃ tu yoṣitām | śāntirdravyaṃ ca sādhūnāṃ bhaktadravyaṃ hariḥ svayam ||49|| vinā dravyaṃ tu loke’tra pratiṣṭhā naiva vidyate | dhānyaṃ vastraṃ vyavahāro nātha dravye pratiṣṭhati ||2.73.50|| dravye doṣā bahavo’pi guṇā jīvanasampradāḥ | dravye bhavanti satataṃ tataścālambanaṃ dhanam ||51 || tatrāpi vaṇijāṃ kṛṣṇa suvarṇabhūṣaṇādikam | sarvasvaṃ vidyate tacca caurairhṛtaṃ samastakam ||52|| tava bhaktimatā nātha parābhavo’yamutkaṭaḥ | abhaktānāṃ hāsyapātratāyā āspadatāṃ gatāḥ |||53 || āpadbhyaścoddhara kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapareśvara | bhaktarakṣākaraśceti nāmasārthakamāvaha ||54|| anyathā tu janā āśābhaṃgena tvāṃ janārdana | tyakṣyanti bhajanaṃ te te matvā cārakṣakaṃ prabhum |||55|| ārtā ārtiharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yāvadārtā bhajanti vai | arthārthī cārthadaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yāvadarthaṃ bhajanti ca ||56|| jijñāsavaśca yāvat syājjijñāsā tāvadeva ha | bhajante śrīhariṃ jñātuṃ jñāte te viramanti hi ||57|| teṣā svārthaparāṇāṃ tu yathoddhāro bhavedapi | yathākathaṃcidāśāvān tvāṃ yathā cāvalambate |||58|| tathā nātha svabhaktānāṃ vāñcchāṃ prapūrya cāpi vai | bhaktiṃ kārayituṃ cāpi mama rakṣāṃ kuru prabho ||59|| ityabhyarthya vane tatra mumocāśrūṇi duḥkhitaḥ | śrutvā tvabhyarthanāṃ svāmī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||2.73.60|| vipraveṣeṇa vai śīghraṃ yatra caurāḥ samāyayau | caurā nadyāstaṭe vṛkṣacchāyāyāṃ sanniṣadya ca |||61 || bhāgān cakruḥ suvarṇasya rūpyasya ca dhanasya ca | bhūṣādīnāṃ vibhāge tu jāyamāne’tha bhikṣukaḥ ||62|| vicitto brāhmaṇo bhūtvā bālakṛṣṇaśca dīnavat | aṭan dhūlisamavyāptadeho digambaro yathā ||63|| kaupīnamātravasano bhojanaṃ yācituṃ yayau | bhikṣati bhojanaṃ me’tra bubhukṣitāya rocate ||64|| bhavanto bhāgyavanto me dadantāṃ śreṣṭhinaḥ śubhāḥ | na me dravyaṃ vāñcchanīyaṃ bhojanaṃ samapekṣyate ||65|| caurāḥ prāhurdravyamatra vartate tadgṛhāṇa bhoḥ | yadi te rocate tarhi dadmaste rūpyakaṃ vada ||66|| bhikṣukastu tadā prāha na me dravyaprayojanam | dhane doṣā hi bahavo duḥkhadā vairakārakāḥ ||67|| dhanaṃ tyājayate dharmaṃ hiṃsāṃ kārayati drutam | ākasmikī cāpadaṃ ca samāhvayati vai dhanam ||68|| dhanārjane prayāso’pi rakṣaṇe cintanaṃ mahat | bhoge kṣayasya tu cintā caurahāryādidūṣaṇam ||69|| tasmāddhanaṃ na ceṣṭavyaṃ bhikṣukeṇa sukhaiṣiṇā | bhavanto dhanavantaśca dadantāmatra bhojanam ||2.73.70|| rūpyako’pi yadagre’sti sukhaṃ nidrāṃ na yāti saḥ | yena kena nimittena viyogasya bhayāt sadā ||7 1 || dhanahīnāḥ pakṣiṇaśca phalamātrasya bhikṣukāḥ | bhuktvā śākhāsu tatraiva vibhramanti nirāmayāḥ ||72|| bālāśca bhojanaṃ bhuktvā sukhaṃ svapanti bhūtale| cintā tu grasate vṛddhān yūno dhanina ityamūn ||73|| ratnāni mauktikādīni hīrakādyāḥ svabhāvataḥ | pāṣāṇā api mṛtyostu nimantraṇakarā hi te ||74|| suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ bhūṣāścāmbarāṇi dhanāni ca | pārthivāstaijasā vāpi cintodvegakarāḥ sadā ||75|| ahaṃmamatvabaddhāśca rāgadveṣavidhāyakāḥ | janmamṛtyupradāścānte vāsanālobhabhāvakāḥ ||76|| tanmayā neṣyate dravyaṃ paradravyaṃ vināśakṛt | kasmāddhane’tra bahulaṃ dravyaṃ labdhaṃ mahājanāḥ ||77|| iti pṛṣṭāstathoktāśca yāhi yāhīti roṣataḥ | prāhuste tatra kaścittu yaṣṭimādāya cāyasīm ||78|| tāḍayituṃ protthitaśca bhikṣukaṃ dīnavat sthitam | tāvattu bhikṣukastasmāt sthānādadṛśyatāṃ yayau ||71|| vilokya caitadaiśvaryaṃ vismayaṃ te paraṃ yayuḥ | kintu bhūtaṃ piśācaṃ vā menire māyayā hatāḥ ||2.73.80|| tāvat kākaḥ samāgatya drumopari jagāda ha | śuṣkaśākhāsthitaścaitadamagalaṃ tadābhavat ||81 || atha te saṃvibhajyaiva svarṇadravyāṇi vai tataḥ | hāramālādiratnāni vibhajante yadā tadā ||82||| śrīhariśca turagasthastathānye rājasevakāḥ | aśvavārāḥ saśastrāśca pañcāśatsaṃkhyakā drutam ||83 || rājadūtādiveṣāste paritastatra cāyayuḥ | kurvanto dhūṣkṛtīśabdān dharṣayantviti vādinaḥ ||84|| mārayantu pragṛhṇantu caurā ime bhavanti ca | ityevaṃ vadamānāste cakruḥ prākāravat tadā ||85 || parito vyūhabandhaṃ ca tadāśvavāraśobhitam | caurā bhayamavāpuste dudruvuḥ paritastadā ||86|| svarṇarūpyāmbarahīrahārān vihāya tatkṣaṇam | kintu mārgamanāsādyāśaktāśca vyūhamabhyataḥ ||87|| nirgantuṃ te hastagatā bhaṭānāmabhavan khalu | paravaśā hastakaṭā rajjupāśāḥ kṛtāśca taiḥ ||88|| yaṣṭibhistāḍitāḥ kecit kecit kaśābhirāhatāḥ | kecid daṇḍena hastena pallatābhiśca tāḍitāḥ ||89|| kṛtadaṇḍā bhaṭaiste ca prārthayāmāsurīśvaram | tṛṇānyādhāya danteṣu bhūsparśīkṛtamastakāḥ ||2.73.90|| dīnā gadgadahṛdayā doṣakṣamā yayācire | dayālurbhagavām̐stebhyaḥ punardoṣanivṛttaye ||91 upādideśa te sarve pratijñāṃ ca tadā vyadhuḥ | vayaṃ cauryaṃ kadācinna kariṣyāmo’dya kālataḥ ||92|| kuru kṣamāṃ mahārāja vimocaya ca bandhanāt | ityevaṃ yācamānān śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||93|| haste jalaṃ pradāyaiva pratijñāṃ stenakarmaṇaḥ | stainyaṃ naiva hi kartavyaṃ kārayāmāsa tādṛśīm || 94|| tatastān dhrādharānadyāstaṭe ramye manohare | mocayāmāsa bhagavān jagrāha cāhṛtaṃ dhanam ||95|| suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ ratnāmbarabhūṣādi yaddhyabhūt | tatsarvaṃ ca gṛhītvaiva sudhano yatra tiṣyati ||96|| sasaṃghastaṃ samāsādya sāśvavāraśca keśavaḥ | sudhanāya dadau sarvaṃ caurahastāhṛtaṃ dhanam ||97|| sudhanastasya sārthāśca jahṛṣurdhanalābhataḥ | rājabhaṭā daduḥ sarvaṃ sārthāya svarṇarūpyakam ||98|| bhūṣaṇānyambarādīni ratnamauktikahīrakān | yeṣāṃ yānyabhavam̐stāni tebhyo dadurharerbhaṭāḥ ||99|| sudhanaśca dadātyebhyo dhanaṃ tu pāritoṣikam | bhaṭādhipastadā prāha dharmo’sti pāritoṣikam || 2.73.10 0|| bhaktiṃ kuru sadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mokṣadām | pāritoṣikamevātra vidyate na tato’nyathā || 101 || sudhanaḥ saṃśayaṃ prāptaḥ śrutvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe | bhagavāneva rakṣārthaṃ tvāyāto vidyate kimu || 102| iti sandihya cotthāya papāta pādayoḥ khalu | anye’pi ca praṇemurvai gatānugatikā iti || 1 03|| aśvavāraiśca sahito bhaṭādhipastu vāhinīm | saha nītvā nadīpāraṃ kārayāmāsa nirbhayām || 1 04|| prāpayāmāsa ramyaṃ tamudyānaṃ śaṃkarasya vai | tataścādṛśyatāṃ prāptā bhaṭādhipabhaṭāstadā || 105 || na aśvā no rājabhaṭā nāsti bhaṭādhipastathā | sudhanaśca janāstasya paramāścaryamāgatāḥ || 106 || sudhanastu tadā śīghraṃ samājuhāva taṃ prabhum | vyomanādaṃ mahāntaṃ vai kṛtvā sarvabalena ha || 1 07|| he hare he kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin dayādhara | kṛtā rakṣā tvayāraṇye madbhāgyaṃ tvadya vardhate || 1 08|| te didṛkṣāsti me kṛṣṇa darśanaṃ dehi me punaḥ | ityevaṃ vyāharan pṛthvyāṃ dhūlikṣetre’luṭhanmuhuḥ || 1 09|| nṛtyan tālī vādayam̐śca punardhūlyā samāluṭhat | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhaktiṃ vilokya ca || 2.73.110 || bālakṛpṇo’bhavacchīghraṃ divyamūrtiḥ surūpavān | koṭisūryāgnicandrāditejo’dhikaprabhāsvaraḥ || 111 || divyasvarṇavibhūṣaśca divyamukuṭakuṇḍalaḥ | divyamālāmbaradharo divyavimānavāhanaḥ || 112|| rūpānurūpāvayavaḥ kaustubhādivirājitaḥ | śrīrādhāmāṇikīpāravatīprabhādisevitaḥ || 113 || mañjulāsaguṇāhaṃsālalitāsujayārcitaḥ | evaṃ bhūtvābhavat sākṣāddarśanīyo hariḥ svayam || 1 14|| sudhanādyairvīkṣitaścovāca yūyaṃ vimānake | tiṣṭhatātreti tān kṛtvā vimāne kṣaṇamātrataḥ || 15|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ prāsādaṃ pitarau ṛṣim | sarastīrthāni sarvāṇi pradarśya kṣaṇamātrataḥ || 1 16|| vimānenāprāpayacca tamudyānaṃ tiro’bhavat | sudhanādyāḥ sukhaṃ prāpuḥ parameśvarayogataḥ || 1 17|| divyadṛṣṭimayā jātā divyabhaktiparāyaṇāḥ | bhādre śukle kṛtāḥ sarve kṛtārthā hariṇā hi te || 1 18|| ekādaśyāṃ madhyadine dhrādharāyāstaṭe śubhe | atha kālāntare tebhyaḥ paraṃdhāma dadau prabhuḥ || 1 19|| ityevaṃ rādhike bhaktarakṣā śrīhariṇā kṛtā | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhaved dhruvā || 2.73.120 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āmodanagarasthasudhanākhyabhaktasya varcakāyanimaharṣiyogena prāptabhāgavatabhāvasya caurebhyo rakṣā bhagavatkṛtā, prabhordivyadarśanādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā trisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 73 ||
<2.74> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rāseśvari śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇotsave | navame vatsare’ṣṭamyāṃ samājo’bhūt trilokinām || 1 || muktāstathāvatārāśca muktānyo’dhīśvarāstathā | īśvariṇyaḥ surā devyaḥ pitaro munayastathā || 2 || ārṣyaḥ kāśyapavaṃśāśca kāśyapyo mānavāstathā | nāgā daityādayo vṛkṣā vallayaḥ paśupakṣiṇaḥ || 3 || jalajāḥ sthalajāścāpi sthāvarā jaṅgamā api | āyayuḥ sādhavaḥ sādhvyaḥ kalā nadyaśca sāgarāḥ || 4 || ṛtavo vasavaścāpi parvatāstīrthakoṭayaḥ | digīśvarāśca rājāno dīnāndhakṛpaṇādayaḥ || 5 || samāyayurbālakṛṣṇaṃ pūjayāmāsurādarāt | āśīrvādān daduścāpyupadā nyadhuḥ puro hareḥ || 6 || lomaśena kṛtā pūjā tathānyairmunibhiḥ śubhā | āgatānāṃ ca satkāraṃ cakre gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 7 || dadau miṣṭāmṛtabhojyabhakṣyalehyāni kambharā | pānāni madhuparkādi jalatāmbūlakāni ca || 8 || sarvairnīrājanaṃ cāvartitaṃ śataikavartibhiḥ | stutaḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī pareśvaraḥ || 9 || dadau prasādametebhyo viśramyāśīrvidhāya ca | yayurvimānakairnaijān deśān lokān digantakān || 2.74.1 0|| athāścaryamabhūt sāyaṃ śṛṇu nīrājanottaram | gurjare kimanadyāstu taṭe cottarataḥ śubhā || 1 1|| kuśāmbānāma nagarī cāturvarṇyajanāśritā | āsīd yatra maharṣiśca kauśikāmbo mahāmuniḥ || 12|| devadhyānaparo yajñaparo yogakriyāparaḥ | ākāśagatimām̐ścāpi kumbhakāyāmaniṣṭhitaḥ || 13|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhyānaparaḥ sa tu | dadāti mokṣajñānaṃ ca śaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ || 14|| brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścāntyajajātayaḥ | ye kecittu samāyānti svāśramaṃ tānabodhayat || 15|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | iti mantraṃ sadā prāptaśiṣyebhyaḥ pradadāti ca || 16 || ekadā tvantyajo nāmnā tryaṣṭakārustu nirdhanaḥ | strīsaṃyuktaḥ samāyāto darśanārthamṛṣeḥ prage || 17|| anapatyo’bhavaccāpi jalodaraprapīḍitaḥ | patnītasyābhavat kuṣṭharogavyāptātiduḥkhitā || 18|| kauśikāmbo maharṣiśca kathāṃ nityaṃ karoti hi | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā yatra sabhāsthale || 1 9|| tatra gatvāntyajo vṛkṣacchāyāyāṃ niṣasāda ha | kathāṃ śṛṇoti tatraiva bhāryayā saha bhāvataḥ || 2.74.20 || śrutaṃ tatra tu saurāṣṭre’nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | paradhāmapatiḥ sarvasvāmī śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||21 || vartate bālarūpeṇa śrīmadgopālanandanaḥ | aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre parabrahma pumuttamaḥ |||2|| yasya vandanamātreṇa nāmamantragraheṇa ca | rogā dainyaṃ ca dāridryaṃ cānapatyādikaṃ tathā || 23|| sarvaṃ layaṃ prayātyeva saubhāgyaṃ ca vivardhate | iṣṭaprāptirbhavecchīghraṃ taccharaṇāgatasya vai ||24|| iti śrutvā kathānte ca prayāte śrotṛvargake | āmadhyāhnaṃ cāśramānte vaṭo’dhaḥsaṃsthito’bhavat ||25|| cintayatyeva tadvākyaṃ kathaṃ pṛcchāmi taṃ munim | antarveditvaśaktyā vai jñātvā tanmānasaṃ muniḥ |||26|| kauśāmbikastvantyajaṃ tam āhvayāmāsa cāstikam | brahmabhaktaṃ sujijñāsuṃ jñātvā svāśramamāgatam ||27|| tīrthāgataṃ dadau tasmai bhojyaṃ jalaṃ phalādikam | svāgataṃ cāpi satkāraṃ kṛtavān sarvamitrakaḥ ||28|| viśrāntaṃ taṃ tvantyajaṃ ca papraccha kuta eva ha | kathaṃ cātrāgato bhakta vada yanmānase sthitam ||29|| bhaktaḥ sa tryaṣṭakāruśca prāha vinayamāvahan | kṛtvātha daṇḍavat gṛṇan maharṣervijayo’stu vai ||2.74.30 || kṣemaṃ cāstu kuśalaṃ ca saukhyamṛṣeḥ sadāstu vai | ciraṃ jīvatu cittajña dayālo devadevate |||3 1|| bhavādṛśaḥ sādhavo’tra tārakāḥ pāpināṃ guro | pāpakṣālanakāryārthaṃ yadahaṃ cātra saṃgataḥ ||32|| kāryaṃ me saphalaṃ jātaṃ tīrthaṃ me paramaṃ tathā | sākṣād devasvarūpasya darśanāt kṛtakṛtyatā ||33|| kathālābhena me janmasāphalyaṃ tvadya vartate | anugraheṇa bhavato bhāgyaṃ me’dya vivardhate || 34|| ahaṃ pāpī cāntyajo’smi tārito’haṃ tvayā guro | ityuktvā cāśramadhūliṃ mastake dhṛtavān muhuḥ ||35|| paścāduvāca ca muniṃ yadyājñā bhavato’sti cet | pracchāmi mānasaṃ yatra ramate me kathāśravāt || 36|| ṛṣiḥ prāha sukhaṃ pṛccha te jānāmi mumukṣutām | nāyamāpmāntyajaḥ kvāpi śuddhaḥ sattvamayaḥ sadā ||37|| śarīraṃ cāntyajaṃ pūrvakarmaṇā jāyate’sya vai | evaṃ śrutvāntyajaḥ prāha kathaṃ cāhaṃ tathābhavam || 38|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kathamavāpyate | kiṃ mayā mokṣasiddhyarthaṃ kartavyaṃ cātra daivikam || 39|| anapatyatvanāśārthaṃ roganāśārthamityapi | kiṃ mama syādanuṣṭheyaṃ vada me kṛpayā prabho ||2.74.40|| iti pṛṣṭho muniḥ prāha śṛṇu cāntyaja karma te | purā tvamabhavo vipraḥ saptapurādrivāsakṛt ||41 || nāmnā devapriyaśceyaṃ patnī te dyumatī tadā | tatra viṣṇormandiraṃ ca lakṣmīnārāyaṇānvitam ||42|| vartate tatra pūjāṃ tvamakarordāsavat sadā | patnī te pākaśālāṃ ca naivedyārthaṃ tadākarot ||43|| śaitye snānaṃ vinā tvaṃ ca malino malināmbaraḥ | mamārcanaṃ sparśanaṃ cākarostvaṃ ca tava priyā ||44|| agālitasalilena pākādikaṃ tadākarot | asnātā cādhautavastrā naivedyaṃ cārpayattadā ||45|| agālitaṃ jalaṃ cāpi matpānārthaṃ samārpayat | aśuddhadehā māṃ nityamaspṛśadbhāminī tava ||46|| rājasvalyādikaṃ ceyaṃ tadā nātīva manyate | evaṃ tvaśuddhijaṃ pāpaṃ bhuktavantau yuvāṃ ciram ||47|| yamaloke vaitaraṇyāṃ tato mārjāratāṃ gatau | tataścāntyajadehasthau stha idānīṃ daivasevayā ||48|| puṇyaśeṣeṇa ca sādhusaṃgatiṃ kurutho’naghau | kālāntarakṛtā sevā pitrordevasya vā guroḥ ||49|| janmāntare tu sā śreyaskarī samupatiṣṭhati | hutaṃ dattaṃ kṛtaṃ japtaṃ sarvaṃ yāti bhavāntare ||2.74.50|| hiṃsā pīḍā kṣatirnindā kāpaṭyaṃ chalamugratā | vañcanā ghātanā sarvaṃ pratyāyāti bhavāntare ||51 || puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ svabhāvaśca saṃskāro vāsanā manaḥ | indriyāṇi dveṣarāgau prayāntyeva bhavāntare ||52|| abhyāso japanaṃ bhaktiḥ sevā paropakāritā | śīlaṃ vrataṃ prapattiśca prayāntyeva bhavāntare ||53|| jñānaṃ vijñānamāstikyaṃ viveko devapūjanam | āśīrvādastathā śāpaḥ prayāntyeva bhavāntare ||54|| ṛṇaṃ pativratā patnī patiḥ patnīvratastathā | śatravaścātirūḍhāśca prayāntyete bhavāntare ||55|| bhāgyaṃ ca sañcitaṃ karma paścād dattā jalāñjaliḥ | śrāddhaṃ tapaśca santoṣaḥ prayāntyeva bhavāntare ||56|| yuvābhyāṃ tu kṛtā sevā bhaktirmālinyasaṃbhṛtā | kālāntare phalaṃ tasyā labdhaṃ yajjanma mānuṣam ||57|| mālinyadoṣajaṃ janma cāntyajaṃ cābhavattataḥ | rājasvalyādidoṣasya phalaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ hi yoṣitaḥ ||58|| agālitāmbhasaḥ pānaṃ yadarpitaṃ tu mādhave | jalodaraṃ tava jātaṃ sadā duḥkhataraṃ tava ||59|| asaṃskṛtānnanaivedyaṃ yadarpitaṃ tvayā harau | tatphalaṃ tava loke’tra dāridryaṃ cātivartate ||2.74.60|| aśraddhāyāḥ phalaṃ pāpaṃ nāstikyamupajāyate | nāstikyena ca te tatra śrāddhādihīnatābhavat ||6 1 || tena te’trānapatyatvaṃ vartate cāntyajottama | kathitastava vṛttāntaḥ pūrvago’trāpi saṃśṛṇu ||62|| antyajo’pi satāṃ sevāṃ tīrthayātrāṃ karoṣi yat | kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ cāpi bhajanaṃ ca karoṣi yat ||63|| tena puṇyapratāpena gurvāśīrvādatastathā | rogo’napatyatā cāpi dāridryaṃ duḥkhitā tathā ||64|| pīḍāścānyā drutaṃ nāśameṣyanti śrīpateḥ smṛteḥ | āśrayaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya kuruta drutam ||65|| rājate kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre cāśvasarastaṭe | kambharāśrīgṛhe bālaḥ kṛṣṇo gopālanandanaḥ ||66|| sarvāvatāradhartā ca sarvakāraṇakāraṇam | sarveśānāṃ niyantā ca sarvāntaryāmisaṃsthitiḥ ||67|| sarvakarmaphalānāṃ sa pradātā mokṣadāyakaḥ | kartumakartumanyathākartuṃ samartha eva saḥ ||68|| jñānaśaktikriyāśaktikāryakāraṇaśaktimān | rādhālakṣmīprabhāpāravatīmāṇikyaśaktipaḥ ||69|| saguṇāmañjulāhaṃsālīlābhūdharaṇīśvaraḥ | vṛndātulasīpadmeśaḥ śaktyaiśvaryavibhūtipaḥ ||2.74.70|| nandanāradaśaṃkarasanakādisatāṃ prabhuḥ | dhātā nidhātā saṃhartā jagatāṃ bhaktamokṣakṛt ||71 || sarvakāmaḥ sarvarasaḥ sarvagandhaḥ samastadṛk | sarvānandaḥ sarvapātā sarvapatiḥ satīpriyaḥ ||72|| sādhvīnāthaḥ sādhumitra tyāgivaryo gurorguruḥ | śāśvataṃ paramaṃ tattvaṃ parabrahma sanātanaḥ ||73|| brahmacaryaparā devā nyāsino yoginastathā | saṃyamino nirodhācca yaṃ prapaśyanti sūrayaḥ ||74|| taṃ prabhuṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ tvaṃ bhaja patnyā sahānvaham | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīsvāminaṃ patim ||75|| ādyaṃ vai mānavaṃ rūpaṃ pārameśvarasaṃjñitam | yuge yuge jāyamānaṃ tato bahusvarūpiṇam ||76|| kṛpārūpaṃ cograrūpaṃ jñānarūpaṃ vṛṣātmajam | vidyārūpaṃ rājarūpaṃ śāsakaṃ tāpasaṃ ca vā ||77|| vyūharūpaṃ vibhavaṃ vā prātimaṃ cāntarasthitam | svarūpaṃ sādhurūpaṃ vā bhaja taṃ puruṣottamam ||78|| aṃśarūpaṃ kalārūpamāveśātmakamityapi | vibhūtiṃ vā pūrṇarūpaṃ paripūrṇaṃ pareśvaram ||79|| avatāraṃ caiśvaraṃ vā viṣṇuṃ mahāpraviṣṇukam | ākṣaraṃ vā parabrahma paripūrṇāttamottamam ||2.74.80|| evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ cainamanādiśrīnarāyaṇam | bhaja patnyā sahitastvaṃ tato nirvāṇameṣyasi ||81 || ehyāgaccha gṛhāṇedaṃ jalaṃ taccaraṇāmṛtam | piba dhāraya śirasi dehe prokṣaṇamācara |||82|| pāpāni te vinaśyeyuḥ sastrīkasyātra satvaram | evamuktvā dadau vāri pūjāprasādajaṃ śubham ||83|| tryaṣṭakāruḥ papau tasya bhāryā papau ca kuṣṭhinī | jalapānādṛṣerātmabalāt kṛṣṇakṛpālavāt ||84|| jalodaraṃ ca dāridryaṃ kuṣṭhitā cānapatyatā | catvāraste mahārogā niṣkrāntā dehato’bhavan ||85|| pārśve sthitvā ruruduste nemustaṃ kauśikāmbakam | kva yāsyāmo vayaṃ vipra jīvanaṃ dehi cārthayan ||86 || ṛṣirjalodaraṃ pṛthvyai kadalyai śrīphalāya ca | dadau vibhāgataścāpyapeyapānakṛte’pi ca ||87|| satṛṣṇakāya lubdhāya dānasnānaviyogine | dadau vyasanine cāpi dāridryaṃ lampaṭāya ca ||88|| viyonisaṃgalubdhāya varṇasāṃkaryakāriṇe | dharmavidveṣiṇe stainyakāriṇe kuṣṭhitāṃ dadau ||89|| parāpatyādihantṛbhyo garbhapātādikāriṇe | śāpitebhyo’napatyatvaṃ dadau śrāddhavilopine ||2.74.90|| ityuktāste caturdoṣā yayustādṛśapātrake | antyajo nirmalo jātaḥ sastrīko rogavarjitaḥ ||9 1 || ṛṣistasmai dadau mantraṃ pāvanaṃ pārameśvaram | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||92|| japaṃ kurvan tatastasthāvāśrame sevako yathā | yathāyogyaṃ mārjanādi cakārodyānasevanam ||93|| kathāṃ śrutvā babhūvāsau prakṣīṇakleśavāsanaḥ | cāndre tu kārtike māse tadā kṛṣṇāṣṭamītithau ||94|| ṛṣirjanmotsavaṃ cakre kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai | tatra divyaṃ vimānaṃ tu śatasūryasamaprabham ||95|| samāyātaṃ yatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo virājate | pārṣadāstatra divyāśca rādhādyā yoṣitastathā ||96|| virājante haristasmāt sahasā samavātarat | ṛṣikṛtāṃ mahāpūjāṃ jagrāha bhagavān svayam || 97|| dadau prāsādikaṃ tasmai tryaṣṭakāruṃ ca tatstriyam | ṛṣiṃ dhṛtvā vimāne ca kuṃkumavāpikāṃ yayo ||98|| hariścādṛśyatāṃ prāpto vimānaṃ vyomamaṇḍale | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetravāsibhiḥ samalokitam ||99|| avātarad vimānaṃ taccāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe | sāyaṃ snānaṃ cāvatīrya tryaṣṭakārustadākarot || 2.74.10 0|| tatpatnī cāpi vai snānaṃ sarasyeva tadākarot | tayordehau tu patitau, divyadehau caturbhujau || 101 || babhūvatustau tatkālaṃ divyālaṃkārabhūṣaṇau | divyadṛṣṭī divyagatī divyavijñānasaṃbhṛtau || 1 02|| tūrṇaṃ tau śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tathā | lomaśaṃ ca muniṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtvā pūjāmalaukikīm || 103 || yayatustadvimānena brahmalokaṃ paraṃ padam | ṛṣiḥ kṛṣṇecchayā tasthau kārtikāvadhimatra ca || 1 04|| paścāt kṛṣṇājñayā yātaḥ kuśāmbāṃ kimasannidhau | bhaktānupadiśan lakṣavarṣāṇi vāsamācarat || 1 05|| pratisamvatsaraṃ cakre harerjanmotsavam ṛṣiḥ | kimanadyāstaṭe gatvā tattīrthe śrīnarāyaṇaḥ || 106 || ṛṣikṛtāṃ samarhāṃ ca gṛhītvā tu sarijjale | snātvā cāyāti divyena vimānena kṣaṇāntare || 1 07|| evaṃ tīrthaṃ kauśikāmbaṃ kimanadyāṃ virājate | rādhike śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāvataraṇodbhavam || 1 08|| ṛṣistato yayau dhāma paramaṃ pārameśvaram | akṣarātparataścāpi paraṃ muktajanāśritam || 109|| ityevaṃ kathito rādhe camatkāro harestava | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya paraṃ mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 2.74.110 || apatyadhanadārādeḥ phalaṃ mokṣo mahottamam | tallabdhaṃ tena bhaktena kimapatyādibhiḥ khalu || 11 1|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kimanadyāstaṭe kuśāmbāpattanasthakauśikāmbarṣiyogenāntyajasya rogiṇastryaṣṭakāro sastrīkasya prabhorbhaktyā muktipadalābha ityādinirūpaṇanāmācatuḥsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 74 ||
<2.75> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca evamanyaṃ camatkāraṃ kathayāmyapi rādhike | sūryaputryāstapatyāstu taṭe kāmapure purā || 1 || āsīt santāpano nāma daityo daityagaṇeśvaraḥ | mahābalena yukto’sāvaṭate tapatītaṭe || 2 || saptapaṭṭādrivāsaṃ ca kṛtavān māṃsakhādakaḥ | prāṅdiśi dūraparyantaṃ gatvā gatvā ca bālakān || 3 || tāpīmūlāvadhiṃ gatvā haratyalpatarānapi | daityā mānuṣamāṃsādā militvādanti sotsavāḥ || 4 || bhūśāvālayapūrve tu tāpītīre’bhavan mahān | vidyālayo’bhavattatra munirhiraṇyakeśakaḥ || 5 || kṛṣṇayajurvidāṃśreṣṭhaḥ ṛṣīṇāṃ pravaro’bhavat | tasyāśrame kṛtāvāsā vidyābrahmacarāstadā || 6 || viprā hiraṇyakeśīyaśāstrīyāstu sahasraśaḥ | āsam̐ścānye’pi hiraṇyakeśākhyagurusannidhau || 7 || āśramasthāśca te brahmādhyetārastapatījale | snātuṃ yānti brāhmakāle tatra santāpano’suraḥ || 8 || supracchannaḥ samāgatya harate viprabālakān | nityaṃ dvau vā pañca vā ṣaṭ kadācid daśa vā nava || 9 || sahasreṣu tu bāleṣu kṣayaṃ yānti tu ye’rbhakāḥ | na jñāyante cāśramasthaiḥ kva prayāntīti vai tadā || 2.75.1 0|| yatra vai gaṇanā nāsti tatra na jñāyate kṣayaḥ | evaṃ yāte bahutithe kāle pañcaśatāni vai || 11 || brāhmaṇānāmapatyāni kṣayaṃ nītāni rākṣasaiḥ | śatāpatyāni cānyāni kṣatraviṭdāsajāni ca || 12|| evaṃ kumārabāhulye kṣayaṃ yāte taduttaram | bhojanādhyayane saṃkhyā nyūnā vijñāyate janaiḥ || 13|| bālā hrāsaṃ nityameva yānti tāpītaṭe khalu | jale majjanti makarairhiyante’vaśyameva ca || 14|| evaṃ sandehamāpannāḥ saha snātuṃ prayānti te | rākṣasā bālakā bhūtvā viśanti bālakeṣu hi || 15|| śaucārthaṃ yānti ye dūraṃ tān gṛhītvā prayānti te | na cāyānti parāvṛttya tadā jñātaṃ janaiḥ khalu || 16|| haranti makarā naiva kintu haranti rākṣasāḥ | śokastvatitaraścāsīdāśrame bālakeṣu ca || 17|| hiraṇyakeśanāmarṣiḥ śuśoca bahudhā tadā | aho me bālakā naṣṭā adhikāḥ ṣaṭśatādapi || 18|| na jñātaṃ tvadyaparyantaṃ pitṝṇāṃ kā gatirbhavet | tatsambandhijanānāṃ ca kāḥ śrotavyā duruktayaḥ || 19|| aho dhyānaṃ mayā dattaṃ naiva tvadyāvadhiṃ kṣaye | kathaṃ jīveyurevaite māritāḥ syurhi rākṣasaiḥ ||2.75.20|| bhakṣitāḥ syuraho daivaṃ durbalānāṃ vighātakam | iti dhṛtvā mastake dvau karau ruroda raudrakam ||21 || anye tadāśramavāsā ruruduścātikaṇṭhataḥ | āśramaḥ kaśmalo jāto mānavāḥ śuddhabuddhayaḥ ||22|| nistejāstu ṛṣirjātaḥ śoko druṣvapyajāyata | paśapakṣigaṇāścāpyarudanta jñātatatkṣayāḥ ||23 || mṛgādyā nāgrasan ghāsaṃ śukā nādadire phalam | api pipīlikā naiva kaṇān jagṛhurucchucaḥ ||24|| vallikā na papurvāri kedāreṣvarpitaṃ hyapi | vavau vāyurna subhago vahniḥ kuṇḍe na cājvalat ||25|| mayūrā nāvadan kekāmṛṣayo’pi śavā iva | abhavannāśrame nāryo vidhavā iva niṣprabhāḥ ||26|| hāhākāro mahānāsīdāśrame deśamaṇḍale | daityāḥ saptapuṭādristhā haranti viprabālakān ||27|| mārayanti ca khādanti hā kaṣṭaṃ kālanoditam | aho trātā na cāsmākaṃ ghātayitā na rakṣasām ||28|| kaścidāste vinā kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇastiṣṭhati kutra vā | śrutaṃ pūrvaṃ kathāyāṃ vai cāśvapaṭṭasaro’ntike ||29|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre rājate bhagavān svayam | kauśikāmbarṣimukhataścāpi śrutaṃ tathaiva ca ||2.75.30|| tathānyebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ śrutaṃ kṛṣṇo virājate | mūrtimān mānavo bhūtvā śrīmadgopālanandanaḥ ||3 1 || lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāṃ śruto hariḥ svayam | rājate’nādidevaḥ sa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||32|| sa kuryād rakṣaṇaṃ nastu mahāpatkālataḥ khalu | ityevaṃ śokasammagne hiraṇyakeśakāśrame ||33 || tatra tāvat samāyāto maharṣiḥ kauśikāmbakaḥ | yogadharmeṇa vijñāya cārtanādān ṛṣikṛtān ||34|| pauṣamāse tu pūrṇāyāṃ hiraṇyakeśakāśrame | ādṛtaḥ satkṛto madhuparkādyairarcanairmuniḥ ||35|| dattāsano nyaṣīdacca papraccha rodanodbhavam | hiraṇyakeśakaḥ prāha rākṣasairviprabālakaiḥ ||36|| brahmādhyāyaparāstāpītaṭe brāhmamuhūrtake | snātuṃ yātāśca bahavo rākṣasaiḥ saṃhṛtā mune ||37|| ṣaṭśatāni hatāścaivaṃ jñāyate hi vicārataḥ | daśasāhasravipreṣu guroḥ kule vasatsu vai ||38|| āsurāṇāṃ mahānevamupadravo vyajāyata | kiṃ kurmaḥ kva prayāmaśca kimabhūt kva gatāśca te ||39|| yadyevaṃ viprabālānāṃ hrāsatantuḥ pravartate | kā gatiścāśramasyātra bhavediti vipannanu ||2.75.40|| yadi kaścidupāyo’tra vināśarodhako’sti cet | bālānāṃ labdhihetuśca vada yogin prakurmahe ||41|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau hiraṇyakeśako muniḥ | kauśikāmbaśca taṃ prāha rādhike saṃsmaran harim ||42|| mā viṣādaṃ yāhi vipra sarvaṃ jānāmi yogataḥ | pūrvaṃ mamāśrame’pyeṣāmupadravo mahānabhūt ||43 || mayā tu rākṣasā daityā nāśitā vai muhurmuhuḥ | punaste nūtanā jātāstāṃ diśāṃ na prayānti te ||44|| tavāśrame prakurvanti tāpītaṭe hyupadravam | mānavānapi khādanti saptapaṭṭādrivāsinaḥ ||45|| ahaṃ yogabalenaiva jñātvā tadvaiśasaṃ mahat | smarāmyanādidevaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||46|| vasantaṃ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre sarvahṛdi sthitam | gacchāmaḥ śaraṇaṃ tasya rakṣaṇaṃ sa kariṣyati ||47|| kṣemaṃ ca kuśalaṃ tasya hastagaṃ vartate ca naḥ | vinānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śakto na cāparaḥ ||48|| avituṃ duḥkhasaṃsārādāpadbhyaśca bhavāmbudhau | ityuktvā śrīhariṃ smṛtvā vyomamārgeṇa yogirāṭ ||49|| nītvā hiraṇyakeśaṃ ca sahaivāśvasaro yayau | sūryacandrasamau jyotsnāgolakāviva bhāsurau ||2.75.50|| vyomamārgāllomaśasyāśramāgre cāvateratuḥ | prathamaṃ lomaśaṃ natvā prasampūjya parasparam ||51 || aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva snātvā kuṃkumavāpikām | gatvā tajjalapānaṃ ca kṛtvā natvā ca devatāḥ ||52|| yayatuḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāntikaṃ tu mandire | rājate yatra bhagavān parameśaḥ parātparaḥ ||53 || gajāsane tu sauvarṇe maṇiratnasamañcite | tīrthaiśca munibhirdevairlakṣmyādibhiḥ prasevitam ||54|| divyatejomayaṃ divyabhūṣāmālāmbarānvitam | pūjitaṃ cārusaugandhyaiḥ prasannavadanāmbujam ||55|| bālakṛṣṇaṃ parabrahma dṛṣṭvā praṇematurmuhuḥ | sāśrū snehabharau saumyau pracakratuśca daṇḍavat |||56|| satkṛtau hariṇā tūrṇaṃ prāpitau madhuparkakam | dattāsanau sukhaṃ pṛṣṭau niṣedatuḥ samīpataḥ ||57|| āgame kāraṇaṃ pṛṣṭāvūcatuḥ parameśvaram | vipragodharaṇisādhusādhvīdharmaprapālaka ||58|| dīnārttakṛpaṇānāthanirāśrayasamāśraya | brāhmaṇā bahavo naṣṭā vidyārthibrahmacāriṇaḥ ||59|| rākṣasairnīyate nityaṃ yadyaddhastagato bhavet | tebhyo rakṣāṃ bālakṛṣṇa parabrahma vidhehi naḥ ||2.75.60|| mṛtānāṃ jīvanaṃ kṛṣṇa tava saṃkalpajaṃ bhavet | yathāsaukhyaṃ yathāyogyaṃ bhavet tat tvaṃ tathā kuru ||6 1 || rākṣasānāṃ paraṃ daṇḍaṃ vidhehi pratipālaka | tvaṃ dhātā tvaṃ vidhātā ca tvaṃ durdhātā pumuttama ||62|| tvadāśrayā vṛṣo yajño vedo vidyā ca bhūsurāḥ | āśramā yogayatayastvadadhīnaprajīvanāḥ ||63|| śrutvaivaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇaścakraṃ sudarśanaṃ nijam | sasmāra śaṃkaraṃ devīṃ pārvatīṃ vīrabhadrakam ||64|| mṛtasañjivanīṃ vidyāṃ sandhinīṃ prāṇadāyinīm | kalpavallīṃ vimānaṃ ca vaihāyasaṃ sadāvyayam ||65|| lakṣmīṃ siddhiṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca tūrṇaṃ te samupasthitāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nemuśca daṇḍavat ||66|| prabhuḥ prāha mahādeva gaṇeśa siddhi pārvati | lakṣmi vidye kalpavalli vīrabhadra sudarśana ||67|| hatā bālāstu bahavaḥ santāpanādirākṣasaiḥ | vartante rākṣasāḥ saptapuṭṭakādrau sahasraśaḥ ||68|| hantavyāste’dya yuṣmābhirjīvanīyāśca bhūsurāḥ | tadarthaṃ ca vayaṃ tatra gacchāmo hetibhiryutāḥ ||69|| ārohantu bhavanto’tra vimāne vai mayā saha | ityuktāste cāruruhuḥ sākaṃ śrīpatinā tathā ||2.75.70|| kauśikāmbena sahitā hiraṇyakeśinā yutāḥ | vimānaṃ dhyātamātraṃ tad gataṃ tatra vihāyasā ||71|| saptapaṭṭakaśailordhve vyomni bhramaṇamāvahat | tad dṛṣṭvā divyayānaṃ tu rākṣasā niryayurbahiḥ ||72|| hartuṃ vimānaṃ divyaṃ ca saśastrā vyomagāminaḥ | kecidvai parvataprāyāḥ kecidgahvaranāsikāḥ ||73|| kecittāḍasamāṃguṣṭhāḥ kecittaṭākakarṇakāḥ | kecidvidyunnibhanetrāḥ kecitsūryanakhāstathā ||74|| apare vaṃśavatkeśā abbhrabāṣpānanāḥ pare | naikarūpadharā naikaveṣā māyāpravedinaḥ ||75|| nirjagmurdaśasāhasrāḥ śailagahvaravāsinaḥ | tān dṛṣṭvā śrīharistūrṇaṃ śaṃkhaṃ dadhmau sudāruṇam ||76|| yuddhasyāvedakaṃ dhvānaṃ prāduścakāra bhīpradam | tāvatte parito vṛttvā mumucuścāṭṭahāsanam ||77|| vimānaṃ dhartumudyuktā vineduḥ prabalonmadāḥ | tāvacchrībhagavānāha kalpavallīṃ satīṃ priyām ||78|| samutpādaya sainyāni yuddhārthaṃ śaktimanti vai | śrutvā kalpalatā yoddhṛn daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakān ||79|| prāviścakāra sahasā yoddhāro yuddhamācaran | vimānānniryayuḥ sarve’bhito rākṣasasannidhau ||2.75.80|| kālpānāṃ rakṣasāṃ vyomni yuddhaṃ ghorataraṃ hyabhūt | parasparaṃ vihanyante vijayārthaṃ raṇāndhakaiḥ ||81 || gadābhirasibhiḥ khaṅgaistomaraiḥ parighaistathā | staṃbhairvṛkṣaiśca pāṣāṇairmuśalaiḥ śūlaśaktibhiḥ ||82||| nārācaiḥ paṭṭiśairbhallairnijaghnuste parasparam | akasmādvai samāpannaṃ yuddhaṃ tad rakṣasāṃ bhuvi ||83 || śirāṃsi rakṣasāṃ tatra pṛthvyāṃ patanti vṛṣṭivat | bhinnānyaṃgāni daityānāṃ patanti śṛṃgavad bhuvi ||84|| keciddhastavihīnāścāpare pādavivarjitāḥ | kaṭicchinnāḥ pare dvedhā skandhacchinnāstathāpare ||85|| nipeturbhūtale ghorā rākṣasāḥ prāṇato hatāḥ | vihatebhyastu dehebhyo jāyante nūtanā navāḥ ||86|| te samāgatya cākāśe yodhayanti mahābalāḥ | evaṃ sainyaṃ rakṣasāṃ tu vardhamānaṃ hi koṭibham ||87|| vyadṛśyata tadā vyomni bhayaṃkaramasīmakam | kalpabhaṭāśca tān dhṛtvā dhṛtvā keśeṣu cāsibhiḥ ||88|| dvedhā kurvanti bhinnām̐ścāskandhāccākaṭi pāragaiḥ | nipatanti śirohīnā yuddhyanti cotthitāśca te ||89|| koṭiśo vyāhatāḥ kalpalatotthaiḥ raṇamūrdhani | hastapādādayasteṣāmutthāyotthāya roṣataḥ ||2.75.90|| tāḍayanti kalpabhaṭān vyomni coḍḍīya jīvavat | hanyante kālayoddhāro divyāścidyanta eva na ||91|| śastrāṇi yeṣu cākāśe yathā rodhaṃ na yanti hi | atha daityāstataścakrurmāyāṃ pārvatasarjinīm ||92|| parvatāścābhavan vyomni nipetuścoparisthitāḥ | vimānopari vegādvai vināśārthaṃ tathāpi ca ||93|| vimānaṃ divyamevāsīd devā divyāśca devikāḥ | aspṛśyā vyomavat sarve tān dharṣituṃ na śekire ||94|| vimānaṃ vyomavad vyomni yathāvasthaṃ sthirāyate | patanti parvatāstasmād abhivyāpyāpi bhūtale ||95|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā dṛṣṭvā daityāśca rākṣasāḥ | naitaddhartuṃ ca vā hantuṃ yogyaṃ vimānakaṃ nu vai ||96|| naite devāśca yoddhāro hantuṃ yogyā bhavanti hi | iti matvāpareśauryavarjitā dudruvū raṇāt ||97|| te hatāścāpi nārācaiḥ kālpayoddhṛpramuktakaiḥ | bhinnadehāśca te bhinnamastakāḥ prāṇavarjitāḥ ||98|| nidhanaṃ hi tadā prāptā utpannā api sarvaśaḥ | anye mohācca yuddhyanti kālpabhaṭaiḥ samantataḥ ||99|| kalpalatotthavahnistān bhasmīcakāra sarvaśaḥ | koṭikoṭyātmakaṃ sainyaṃ rakṣasāṃ bhasmatāṃ gatam || 2.75.10|| mūlāstu pañcasāhasrāḥ kṣayaṃ yātā hi rākṣasāḥ | pañcasāhasramātrāśca praśiṣṭā yuddhakāriṇaḥ || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne hiraṇyakeśarṣigurukulasthānāṃ ṣaṭśatabālānāṃ rākṣasairnāśe kṛte śrīhariṇā rākṣasānāṃ nāśārthaṃ kṛtodyamayuddhādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 75 ||
<2.76> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ākarṇaya tato rādhe tvavaśiṣṭāni yānyapi | pañcasahasrarakṣāṃsi mahābalāni vegataḥ || 1 || vyomayuddhaṃ pracakruśca tarupāṣāṇaparvataiḥ | prajagmuḥ rākṣasāste ca vimānaṃ paritastadā || 2 || śaṃbhuṃ gaṇapatiṃ sudarśanaṃ ca vīrabhadrakam | vimāne sampraviśyaiva prajaghnustomarādibhiḥ || 3 || tato vīro gaṇeśaśca sudarśanaṃ śivastathā | vimānāntargatān daityān dhṛtvā dhṛtvā triśūlakaiḥ || 4 || nijaghnuḥ prāṇataḥ sarvān vīrabhadro mukhe ca tān | nikṣipya carvayāṃcakre jīvato rakṣasāṃ gaṇān || 5 || mṛtebhyo ye ca jāyante mṛṣārūpāśca tān haraḥ | mahāmāyotthavaḍavānalairbhasmīcakāra ha || 6 | catuḥsahasradaityāste naṣṭā vai bhasmatāṃ gatāḥ | atha sahasrasaṃkhyāste dudruvurvyomamārgataḥ || 7 | viviśuḥ saptapuṭake parvate gahvarādiṣu | kalpalatāsamutpannā yoddhārastadanukramāḥ || 8 | viviśurgahvarādau ca jagṛhustān samantataḥ | sudarśanaṃ mahācakraṃ kakarta kaṇṭhadeśataḥ || 9 | agnistān parito vīkṣya bhasmīcakāra sarvathā | evaṃ hatā mahādaityāḥ saptapaṭṭādrivāsinaḥ || 2.76.10 | tato bhītā daityapatnyaḥ sāpatyāḥ śaraṇaṃ hareḥ | āyayurvai rudantyastāḥ prāṇarakṣārthamityatha || 11 | dayāluḥ śrīharistatra cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ svakam | vārayāmāsa tābhyaśca dadau jīvapradānakam || 1 2| mṛtānāṃ viprabālānāṃ khāditānāṃ tu rākṣasaiḥ | asthīni darśayāmāsurgartakṣiptāni tāstadā || 1 3| ṣaṭśatānāṃ dvijānāṃ ca tathā sahasrayoṣitām | daśasāhasrasaṃkhyākapuruṣāṇāṃ ca pakṣiṇām || 14|| paśūnāṃ bālakānāṃ ca nāsthisaṃkhyā pravidyate | krośasaṃsthe mahāgarte tāni vīkṣya samantataḥ || 15|| lakṣmīmājñāpayāmāsa tatrasthāṃ kalpavallikām | sañjivanyādividyāśca jīvayituṃ tadasthitaḥ || 16|| tato lakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādajalaṃ śubham | jagrāha svaghaṭe svarṇanirmite tvakṣaye svayam || 17|| haṃsasthātha vimānāt sā sāmṛtakalaśā yayau | gartaṃ sarvaṃ bhramitvā tu vyomnāsthīni punaḥ punaḥ || 18|| cakre saṃprokṣaṇaṃ tasya jalasyāmṛtabindubhiḥ | asthīnyāpyāyitānyeva saprāṇāni tadābhavan || 19|| kalpavallī tato yātā rasān bhṛtvā ghaṭe’kṣaye | cakre saṃprokṣaṇaṃ tasya rasasyāmṛtabindubhiḥ ||2.76.20|| tena dehāḥ samutpannā māṃsamajjātvaganvitāḥ | bālakāśca narā nāryaḥ paśavaḥ pakṣiṇastathā ||2 1|| ye ye mṛtā bhakṣitāśca lakṣādhikā hi dehinaḥ | tān sajīvān tataḥ kartuṃ vidyā saṃjīvanī svayam ||22|| ājñaptā vṛṣṭirūpā sā papāta sarvadehiṣu | vṛṣṭikaṇā jīvarūpāścetanā viviśustataḥ ||23|| utthitā ghoranidrātaḥ sarve gartāsthisaṃbhavāḥ | yathā dehasvabhāvāśca yathāvatsaraśālinaḥ ||24|| yathāyonisvabhāvāśca narā nāryo’nyayonayaḥ | sañjātā jīvavantaste tadāścaryamabhūnmahat ||25|| paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarve yayurvanāntaraṃ prati | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā muhurmuhuḥ ||26|| mānavāśca narā nāryo bālā kanyāśca te tataḥ | gartānnimnoccadeśena niryayurbahirāyayuḥ || 27|| śrīharistatra vai deśe vimānaṃ cāvatārayat | dadau bhojyaṃ tatastebhyo jalaṃ sutṛptikārakam ||28|| vastrāṇyapi dadau tebhyo’pekṣyavastūni yāni tu | pradadau smaraṇaṃ tebhyo yajjanmagrāmabāndhavāḥ || 29|| yeṣāṃ yatra bhavantyeva teṣāṃ prasphuritaṃ tu tat | śrībhagavānāha kauśāmbikāya yogine ||2.76.30 || ebhyaḥ pradehi me mantraṃ paramaṃ vaiṣṇavam ṛṣe | kauśāmbiko dadau mantraṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya tadājñayā ||3 1 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | hiraṇyakeśo mantraṃ taṃ jagrāha ṛṣitastadā || 32|| atha śrībhagavān sarvān samagṛhya vimānake | viśāle śaṃkaraṃ prāhu śaṃbho hyetān nijaṃ sthalam ||33 || anenaiva vimānena prāpaya kṣaṇamātrataḥ | śabhurdhyānaparo bhūtvā dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ tu bhūmikāḥ ||34|| lakṣagaṇān samutpādya tattadvyomavicāriṇaḥ | sarvān vai kṣaṇamātreṇa prāpayāmāsa tadgṛhān || 35|| kuṭumbinaśca te jātā hṛṣṭāḥ svajanalābhataḥ | camatkāraṃ paraṃ śrutvā jātāste vaiṣṇavāstataḥ || 36|| hiraṇyakeśaśiṣyāśca prāpitā vai tadāśramam | āśramaḥ sukhito jāto vaiṣṇavo bhagavanmayaḥ || 37||| atha rākṣasakanyāśca pañcasāhasrakanyakāḥ | bālakṛṣṇaṃ vilokya vavrire tadrapamohitāḥ ||38|| tanmātṛbhiḥ pradattā sañjagrāha bhagavām̐stu tāḥ | rakṣasāṃ bālakān dārān mantramaśrāvayanmuniḥ ||39|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | tataścāsuradārāṇāmājñāṃ cakre svayaṃ prabhuḥ ||2.76.40 || adyaprabhṛti kasyāpi hiṃsanaṃ kāryameva na | kṛṣiṃ kṛtvātra vai kṣetre jīvantu nivasantu ca ||41 || dātāhaṃ bhavatīnāṃ vai jalānnāmbarasampadām | ityuktvā cābhayaṃ datvā nītvā kanyāstadarpitāḥ |||42|| snātvā tatra tapatyāṃ ca kṛtvā tīrthaṃ taduttamam | yayau tīrthanimittena śrīharirdakṣiṇāṃ diśam ||43 || pūrṇāyāṃ tvakarot snānaṃ cāmbikāyāṃ tataḥ param | sahyādrau tu vimānena bhramitvā vai tataḥ param ||44|| mahābaleśvaraṃ gatvā bhīmāyāṃ snānamācarat | kṛṣṇāyāṃ tu tataḥ sasnau tuṃgabhadrājale tataḥ ||45|| paścimaghaṭṭake vārdhau snātvā śrīparvataṃ yayau | nīlagiriṃ vilokyātha elādriṃ vai tato yayau ||46|| akhāte’pi tataḥ snātvā siṃhalaṃ dvīpakaṃ yayau | tatra puṣpanadīṃ spṛṣṭvā kāveryāṃ snānamācarat ||47|| kaṭunadyāṃ tataḥ snātvā pannārīsnānamācarat | droṇācalaṃ tato gatvā kṛṣṇāyāṃ snānamācarat ||48|| kolārasarasi snātvā tato godāvarīṃ yayau | mañjirāyāṃ tataḥ snātvā tataścandrāvatīṃ yayau ||49|| indrāvatyāṃ tataḥ snātvā tataścilasaro yayau | mahānadyāṃ tataḥ snātvā huhūgalyāṃ tato yayau ||2.76.50|| gaṃgānadyāṃ tataḥ snātvā brahmaputrāṃ tato yayau | snātvā kaṃcanagaṃgāyāṃ kuśyāṃ snātvā tataḥ param ||51|| gṇḍakyāṃ vai tataḥ snātvā gogarāsnānamācarat | nandāyāṃ tu tataḥ snātvā yamunāyāṃ tataḥ param ||52|| cambalāyāṃ tataḥ snātvā snātvā sarasi śaṃbhare | śatalājājale snātvā rāvyāṃ snātvā tataḥ param ||53|| cīnāpāyāṃ tataḥ snātvā jhelamāsnānamācarat | kābilāyāṃ tataḥ snātvā sindhusnānaṃ samācarat ||54|| luṇīsnānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā gatvā nārāyaṇaṃ saraḥ | akhātaṃ samatīpyaiva gomatīsnānamācarat ||55|| bhadrāvatyāṃ tataḥ snātvā cāśvapaṭṭasaro yayau | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre lomaśasyāśrame hariḥ ||56|| vimānaṃ sthāpayāmāsa guruṃ natvā tataḥ param | gṛhaṃ gatvā svapitarau praṇamyābhāṣya yatkṛtam ||57|| nivedayāmāsa kanyāḥ pañcasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ | bhojayāmāsa tāścopakaraṇāni hyadāpayat ||58|| lomaśasyāśrame tāstu sthāpayāmāsa mādhavaḥ | śaṃkaraśca gaṇeśaśca vīrabhadro nijālaye ||59|| yayuḥ sudarśanaṃ cāpi vimānaṃ ca tiro’bhavat | lakṣmyādyāḥ śrīhareḥ kṣetre tīrthe naije ca mandire ||2.76.60 || yayuḥ prasādamābhuktvā bālakṛṣṇo nijālaye | viśaśrāma sukhaṃ rādhe sarvabhaktaiḥ prasevitaḥ ||61 || cāndre māghe kṛṣṇapakṣe caturthyāṃ parameśvaraḥ | rakṣayitvā jīvayitvā kṛtvā tīrthāni bhūtale ||62|| ājagāma nije kṣetre sarvaprāṇapradaḥ prabhuḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhaved dhruvam ||63|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne santāpanadaityamāritānāṃ hiraṇyakeśaśiṣyāṇāṃ sajīvīkaraṇaṃ, daityānāṃ nāśaḥ, dakṣiṇanadīnāṃ tīrthīkaraṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 76 ||
<2.77> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rādhe tathā cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ parātmanaḥ | bhaktānāṃ devasādhūnāṃ gavāṃ trātuśca sūtriṇām || 1 || purānaṅgapure rājā bṛhadvarcā babhūva ha | devasevāparo nityaṃ sādhusevāparāyaṇaḥ || 2 || dharmakāryaparo yajñasatrahomaparāyaṇaḥ | jñānavijñānasampannaḥ kathākīrtanatatparaḥ || 3 || anāthadīnakṛpaṇopakārī dānaśīlanaḥ | bhāryā pativratā sādhvī sādhusevāparāyaṇā || 4 || bhaktisevāparā nityaṃ sāṃkhyasatyabhidhānikā | putrāstasyāṃ nṛpasyāsan buddhimantaḥ śatatrayam || 5 || kanyāḥ śatadvayaṃ cāpi sarvāḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ | rājāsau tapatītīre gatvā parvaṇi parvaṇi || 6 || tīrthasnānavidhiṃ kṛtvā dānaṃ dadāti cottamam | suvarṇaṃ rūpyakaṃ tāmraṃ dhanaṃ dravyaṃ ca mudrikāḥ || 7 || ratnāni mauktikādīni hīrakān vidrumādikān | maṇīn māṇikyavarṇāṃśca gajānaśvān gavādikān || 8 || ajāvīn vāhanayānaśibikāśakaṭīstathā | vimānāni vicitrāṇi bāṣpayānāni vai tathā || 9 || dvicakrāṇi tricakrāṇi bahucakrāṇi yānyapi | vaihāyasāni yānāni śreṣṭhadānāni parvaṇi || 2.77.1 0|| dadātyapi yathāyogyaṃ viprebhyaḥ pūjanottaram | atha sūryagrahaṇe ca phālgune tapatītaṭe || 1 1|| yayau rājāplavanārthaṃ bahudravyasamanvitaḥ | tatrāyayustapatyāṃ saṃsnātuṃ vai lakṣaśo janāḥ || 1 2|| brāhmaṇā grāmavāsāśca pañcayojanabhūmigāḥ | yajñakarmakarāścāpi vedādhyāpanakāriṇaḥ || 13|| satpātrāṇi tapovidyāvratadharmaparāyaṇāḥ | sastrībālā hi te sarve tvāyayuḥ snānahetave || 14|| sūryoparāgasaṃsnātā japaṃ cakrurnadītaṭe | rājā dānaṃ pradātuṃ ca viprebhyaścopacakrame || 15|| gajān dadau ca saudhāni kṣetrāṇi vāṭikā maṇīn | mauktikān hīrakān gāśca dogdhrīśca mahiṣīstathā || 16|| aśvān yānāni cānnāni māṣān tāmrasya puttalīḥ | āyasaṃ puttalaṃ naijaṃ dadau carmāmbarāṇi ca || 17|| suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ mudrā yānāni vāhanānyapi | dāsīrdāsān dadau cājāvikān grāmān gṛhāṇyapi || 18|| kṛṣṇavastrāṇi ca kṛṣṇakaṇān kṛṣṇadravām̐stathā | kṛṣṇahārān maṇinaddhān kṛṣṇasūtraiḥ sughaṭṭitān || 1 9|| kṛṣṇapuruṣadānaṃ ca koṭimudrāsamanvitam | dadau pravāhamavadhiṃ kṛtvā hastacatuṣṭayam ||2.77.20|| lobhena vipravaryāste jagṛhurdānamuttamam | bhārayuktaṃ mahādānaṃ lakṣādhikadhanānvitam ||21 || pratyekaṃ jagṛhurviprāḥ sahasrasaṃkhyakāstadā | eko hastī tathaikāśvaścaikā gaurvṛṣabhadvayam ||22|| ekā ca mahiṣī dogdhrī gṛhaṃ caikaṃ nivāsadam | kṣetraṃ caikaṃ vāṭikaikā maṇiḥ kṛṣṇaśca mauktikam ||23 || hīrakaścaikayānaṃ ca māṣāstāmrasya puttalī | āyasaṃ puttalaṃ naijaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ carma tathāmbaram ||24|| kṛṣṇaṃ sūtraṃ kṛṣṇavarṇo dāso dāsyapi kṛṣṇikā | kṛṣṇājā kṛṣṇahāraśca kṛṣṇā madrā sakajjalā ||25|| kṛṣṇamāṣā lakṣamūlyaṃ svarṇaṃ raupyaṃ ca lakṣakam | pratyekāya tu viprāya tatsarvaṃ pradadau nṛpaḥ ||26|| sahasrabrāhmaṇā lubdhā gṛhītavanta eva tat | sūryaśuddhau punaḥ sasnustapatyāṃ te tu bhūsurāḥ ||27|| dānalabdheścātituṣṭāścātiprasannamānasāḥ | bahupremṇā jale sasnuryāvattu niryayurbahiḥ ||28|| tāvatte dānadoṣeṇa kṛṣṇāḥ kadrupiṇo’bhavan | kṛṣṇavarṇasya tu pratigrahe doṣo’bhipadyate ||29|| rādhike tacchṛṇu vacmi yena yaddoṣatā bhavet | hastidānena vai rājño yuddhe tvanyāyadūṣaṇam ||2.77.3 0|| pāpāpmakaṃ bhaved yadyat kāpaṭyaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ mahat | strībālānāṃ tvaparādhavarjitānāṃ vighātanam ||3 1|| sārathīnāṃ paśūnāṃ ca vāhānāṃ dūtakarmiṇām | hananaṃ yacca tatsarvaṃ hastidānena śuddhyati ||32|| etatpāpaṃ hastidānagrahiṇaḥ śirasi vrajet | aśvadānasya tu rājño’śvavāraistu kṛtaṃ mahat ||33|| saṃgrāme dūṣaṇaṃ cāśvamāraṇādinivartanam | phalaṃ rājño bhaved dānagrahītā doṣabhāg bhavet ||34|| godānāttu vṛṣādīnāṃ yuddhādau māraṇaṃ tu yat | rājye muṣkacchedanaṃ ca govṛṣādestu yadbhavet ||35|| tatpāpaṃ nṛpaternaśyed dānagrāhiṣu gacchati | vṛṣabhadvayadānena pretā yuddhe mṛtāstu ye ||36|| aśūrāḥ pṛṣṭhadhāvāśca prasahyāgatikā mṛtāḥ | teṣāṃ hatyodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ rājño naśyati tatpunaḥ ||37|| vṛṣadvayapratigrāhiṣveva gatvā sutiṣṭhati | mahiṣyāstu pradānena pāśaśūlāvaropaṇāt || 38|| yatpāpaṃ jāyate rājño’nyāyajanyaṃ hi daṇḍataḥ | kṛṣṇavastradharaiḥ pāśo dīyate pāśakārakaiḥ ||39|| taddhatyājaṃ nṛpatestu pāpaṃ naśyati tatpunaḥ | mahiṣīdānasaṃgrāhakartaryeva prapadyate ||2.77.40|| gṛhadānena ca rājño rājye pṛthvyāṃ prajājane | śilpinirmitasaudhādigrāmamārgādijaṃ ca yat ||41 || asaṃkhyajīvahatyāghaṃ pāpaṃ sarvaṃ nivartate | grahagrāhiṇi sarvaṃ tallagnaṃ bhavati tatkṣaṇāt ||42|| kṣetravāṭīpradānena kṛṣeḥ pāpamanantakam | prajānāṃ yad bhaved rājñastannivṛttiḥ prajāyate ||43|| kṣetravāṭyudyānagrāhiviprādau tatpravartate | kṛṣṇamaṇeḥ pradānena khanyādikhanane tu yat ||44|| rājyapāpaṃ bhaved rājñastatsarvaṃ vinivartate | maṇigrāhiṇi khātānāṃ pāpaṃ sarvaṃ pravartate ||45|| mauktikasya pradāne sāmudrajantuvināśane | mauktikotpādane yacca lavaṇotpādane ca yat ||46|| tathā matsyādijantūnāṃ māraṇe yantravāhane | sāmudrādisamutthaṃ ca pāpaṃ rājño nivartate ||47|| mauktikagrāhiṇi sarvaṃ pravartate’tiduḥsaham | hīrakasya pradānena viṣajanyamaghaṃ tu yat ||48|| viṣauṣadhādijanyaṃ ca grīṣmatāpaviṣodbhavam | viṣavāyūdbhavaṃ pāpaṃ prāṇināṃ nāśasaṃbhavam ||49|| rājño nivartate tacca tadgrāhiṇi pravartate | yānadānena yānasthacakrairyatprāṇighātajam ||2.77.50|| pāpaṃ rājño nāśameti yānagrāhiṇi gacchati | māṣadānena ca varṣe grahapīḍā nṛpasya yā ||5 1 || dīnānātha kṛpaṇānāmarakṣājaṃ tu pātakam | rājño nivartate tacca māṣagrāhiṇi gacchati ||52|| tāmraputtalikādānapradānena tu bhūpateḥ | gaṇikāsaṃgajaṃ pāpaṃ tādṛśaṃ ca nivartate ||53 || puttalīgrāhiṇi lagnaṃ jāyate ghoraduḥkhadam | āyasasya puttalasya dānena nṛpatestu yat ||54|| ṣaḍītijanyajaṃ rājye pāpaṃ prajājanotthitam | rājñastajjāyate naṣṭaṃ puttalagrāhake bhavet ||55|| ativṛṣṭiranāvṛṣṭiḥ śalabhā mūṣakāḥ śukāḥ | bhūkampaviplavaścaitāḥ ṣaḍītayaḥ samīritāḥ ||56|| kṛṣṇacarmapradānena mṛgayājamaghaṃ mahat | rājño nivartate carmagrāhake ca pravartate ||57|| kṛṣṇāmbarapradānena vastrayantrodbhavaṃ mahat | pāpaṃ tvasaṃkhyajantunāṃ nāśotthaṃ nṛpatestu yat ||58|| naśyatyevāmbaragrāhiṇyaghaṃ tacca pravartate | kṛṣṇasūtrapradānena rājye rajjūdbhavaṃ hyagham ||59|| ūrṇājanyaṃ tathorṇārthaṃ kauśeyārthaṃ ca yat kṛtam | pātakaṃ jīvaghātākhyaṃ rājye tannṛpaterbhavet ||2.77.60 || sūtradānena tad rādhe rājñaḥ sarvaṃ nivartate | sūtragrāhiṇi viprādau tatsarvaṃ sampravartate ||61|| kṛṣṇapūruṣadānena bālahatyodbhavaṃ tu yat | garbhahatyodbhavaṃ cāpi vṛthāhatyodbhavaṃ tathā |||62|| prajāpāpaṃ tu yad rājñastatsarvaṃ vinivartate | dāsadānagrāhake tu tatsarvaṃ sampravartate ||63|| kṛṣṇādāsīpradānena kanyāhatyodbhavaṃ tathā | strīhatyāvidhavāhatyāprabhṛtyutthaṃ hyaghaṃ tu yat ||64|| paradāraprasaṃgotthaṃ pāpaṃ rājño nivartate | dāsīgrāhiṇi viprādau tatsarvaṃ tu pravartate ||65|| ajādānena rājye yattvajāmāṃsādanodbhavam | pāpaṃ cāvikabhakṣotthaṃ sarvaṃ rājño nivartate ||66|| ajāgrāhiṇi cāyāti ghātakiśālikodbhavam | kṛṣṇamālāpradānena krūraṃ pracchannapātakam ||67|| nivartate ca tad rājño mālāgrāhiṇi gacchati | kṛṣṇamudrādidānena dhanajanyaṃ prajājane ||68|| kośajanyaṃ ca yatpāpaṃ karajanyaṃ ca yad bhavet | prasahyāharaṇairjanya hyaghaṃ daṇḍanimittajam ||69|| rājño nivartate tacca dravyagrāhiṇi gacchati | kṛṣṇamāṣapradānena rājñaḥ śanikṛtaṃ tu yat ||2.77.70|| pīḍanaṃ tanmāṣagrāhiṇye va saṃkramate’khilam | suvarṇadānataḥ pitṛprasannatvaṃ sureṣṭatā ||71 || rajatasya pradānena lakṣmīḥ sattvamayī bhavet | evaṃ dānaphalaṃ rājñaḥ pāpaṃ duḥkhaṃ tu pātrake ||72|| vastubhiḥ saha cābhyeti rājā doṣānnivartate | pratigrāhī pīḍyate tu tejohīnaḥ prajāyate ||73|| yadi cenna sa puṇyāḍhyaḥ samartho brahmabhāvanaḥ | puṇyabalavihīnastu tūrṇaṃ pāpaiḥ prapīḍyate ||74|| nyūnapuṇyāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇā jāyante grahamātrataḥ | kadrūpā jñānahīnā vā śāpadoṣād yathā janāḥ ||75|| vicittā vā dīrgharogā bhagnāṅgā bhagnabhūtayaḥ | bhagnavīryāḥ prajāyante bhagnakauṭumbikāstathā ||76|| sukhahīnā duḥkhapūrṇā jāyante dānasaṃgrahāt | tasmād ghorataraṃ dānaṃ na grāhyaṃ puṇyarakṣiṇā ||77|| dānasya grahaṇārthaṃ yo hasto dakṣa pralambate | puṇyaṃ dātuṃ lambate saḥ pāpamādātumityapi ||78|| tasmād dānaṃ tu gṛhṇīyād yo bhavet puṇyaśevadhiḥ | dānadoṣavināśārtha cared devārpaṇādikam ||79|| anyathā pāpabhug yāti duḥkhabhogasthalaṃ punaḥ | yāmyaṃ daihyaṃ ca gārbhaṃ ca yaduddhāro na vai drutam ||2.77.80|| ityevaṃ rādhike viprā dānaṃ jagṛhurutsukāḥ | kṛṣṇavarṇāśca kadrūpāścāntyajā iva vai kṣaṇāt ||81|| cāṇḍālā iva te jātā vivarṇāśca vitejasaḥ | yathā kajjaladehā vā vahnidagdhā yathā ca vā ||82|| tathā jātāḥ kṣaṇamātrāt tāpīsnānottaraṃ hyapi | ghoradānaphalaṃ tvetad durnivāryaṃ hyabhūttadā ||83|| grahaṇasnānapuṇyaṃ tu ghorapratigrahāntike | nābhūt trātuṃ samarthaṃ ca brāhmaṇān brahmavādinaḥ ||84|| athaivaṃ pāpasampannān dṛṣṭvā śrīsuratāyanaḥ | maharṣiścandanavṛkṣakṛtāvāso’titāpasaḥ |||85|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto’tivaiṣṇavaḥ | siddhaścaiśvaryapūrṇaśca jñānadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ||86|| pūrvaṃ varṣasahasraṃ yaḥ samādhau samatiṣṭhata | yasyoparyabhavan vṛkṣastambā valmīkamūlakāḥ ||87|| tapatyā jalavegena cātivṛṣṭikṛtena ca | mṛttikākṣālane jāte nigaracchanmahāmuniḥ ||88|| candanasya tarormūle grathito yasya vigrahaḥ | tasthau tatraiva mūle ca samādheḥ sa bahiryayau ||89|| cetanāṃ prāpya tadvṛkṣe nyavasanbhagavanmanāḥ | samādhinālokayacca bhagavān dhṛtavigrahaḥ ||2.77.90|| idānīṃ vartate pṛthvyāmaśvapaṭṭasaro’ntike | kṣetre kukumavāpyāṃ ca śrīmadgopālanandanaḥ ||91|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī pumuttamaḥ | śrīpatiḥ kamalākānto haṃsārādhāramāpatiḥ ||92|| māṇikīpārvatīmañjulāprabhāsaguṇāpatiḥ | anantamuktadevyaśca koṭyarbudasatīpriyaḥ ||93|| kambharāśrītanayo’sau bālakṛṣṇo virājate | nityaṃ jñātvā prayātyeva prātardarśanahetave ||94|| kṣaṇamātreṇa tu samādhinā cāyāti candanam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhajati nityaśaḥ ||95|| śrīharistaṃ nijaṃ mantraṃ śrāvayāmāsa sakṛpaḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||96|| sa ca mantraṃ japannāste candanādho nadītaṭe | tena dṛṣṭā brāhmaṇāste sahasrasaṃkhyakāstadā ||97|| gṛhītadānakṛṣṇā ye sañjātāḥ kalmaṣānvitāḥ | saśokā doṣanāśārthaṃ cintayānāḥ parasparam ||98|| te sarve taṃ mahāyogeśvaraṃ śrīsuratāyanam | yayuḥ śaraṇamāsādya sāśrunetrāstadābhavan ||99|| doṣaśāntyarthamevainaṃ prārthayāmāsurantike | niṣedurdaṇḍavat kṛtvā maharṣiḥ śrīhariṃ smaran || 2.77.10 0|| dadau jñānaṃ pāpaśāntipradaṃ copāsanāśrayam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptipradaṃ tadā || 101 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bṛhadvarcānṛpāt tāpītīre gṛhītaghorapratigraheṇa kṛṣṇakadrūpatā gatānāṃ sahasraviprāṇāṃ suratāyanarṣiyoga ityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 77 ||
<2.78> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca yajjñānaṃ pradadau śrīmatsuratāyanayogirāṭ | brāhmaṇebhyastu tajjñānaṃ rādhe te kathayāmi ca || 1 || rādhe pūrvaṃ mayā dattaṃ suratāyanayogine | tadeva te’tra saṃvacmi lokānāṃ hitakṛd yataḥ || 2 || suratāyanaviprarṣiḥ prāha śṛṇuta bhūsurāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmīśvareśvaraḥ || 3 || rājate kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre saurāṣṭramaṇḍale | yo vai sākṣātparabrahma paramātmā pareśvaraḥ || 4 || sarvaśaktisamāyuktaḥ pāpināṃ pāpanāśakaḥ | taṃ devaṃ parameśānaṃ yāta śaraṇamuttamam || 5 || bhaktyā tvananyayā taṃ śrīkṛṣṇamarcayata dhruvam | dhyānena karmayogena bhaktyā jñānena caiva saḥ || 6 || prāpyaḥ śrīparameśāno yāta taṃ śaraṇaṃ dvijāḥ | dānadharmātmakaṃ karma yadyadvarṇāśramātmakam || 7 || adhyātmajñānasahitaṃ muktaye bhavati dvijāḥ | mayā dharmaḥ purā prokto brahmavidyātmakaḥ paraḥ || 8 || sarvārpaṇe mayi kṣipte kartā kvacinna lipyate | dharmo jñānaṃ dāsyabhaktiḥ paraṃ brahma prakāśayet || 9 || sarvasaṃgān parityajya tameva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | upāsate sadā bhaktyā yogamaiśvaramāsthitāḥ || 2.78.1 0|| sarvasaṃgavinirmuktāḥ śāntā dāntā vimatsarāḥ | amānino harau sarvasamarpaṇāstadarthakāḥ || 1 1|| taccittāstadgataprāṇāstajjñānakathane ratāḥ | sarvanyāsā harau nāryo narā vā bālayauvanāḥ || 12|| teṣāṃ bandhanahartā vai parameśo hariḥ svayam | te sunirdhūtatamaso jñānenaikena tanmayāḥ || 13|| sadānandāstu saṃsāre na jāyante punarbhavāḥ | karmaṇā manasā vācā yāntu taṃ śaraṇaṃ dvijāḥ || 14|| bālyaṃ tu sarvadā rakṣyaṃ garbhāvasthā ca yoginā | yathā bālye ca vā garbhe vāsanā vāñcchanā tṛṣā || 15|| īhā tṛṣṇā rāgitā ca vartante naiva śākhivat | tathaiva yauvane cāpi vārdhakye stheyameva ca || 16|| yathā suṣupto vijño’pi jñapteḥ phalaṃ na caiti hi | tathā viprāḥ sadā stheyaṃ jñāne’pi munitā yathā || 17|| yathā tvanyamanaskasya nendriyagrāhyavedanam | tathā kṛṣṇamanaskasya vṛttirviprasya muktaye || 18|| yathā bālaḥ pṛthivyāstu mṛdamādāya limpati | na śokaṃ vāpi harṣaṃ ca bahu tatraiva manyate || 19|| tathā sarvāṇi vastūni kriyā vyāpāragocarāḥ | tasmin deve viniḥkṣipya mṛttikāpiṇḍavad budhaḥ ||2.78.20 || saṃgṛhyāpi na śokaṃ vā harṣaṃ nindeta tatrahi | tadā tatphalaveditvaṃ nāsyātīva pravartate ||2 1 || aveditve na bhoktṛtvaṃ kaśmalaṃ nopajāyate | nityaśuddhasya yā niṣkalmaṣatā muktireva sā ||22|| viṣayāśca śarīraṃ ca tathendriyāṇi mānasam | vijñātavyaṃ pṛthak cāpi tata ātmā nivartate ||23 || kartā vai bandhanaṃ yāti yadi teṣu prasajjate | asaṅgaḥ sajjate naiva bandhanaṃ naiva yāti ca ||24|| viṣayāstu yathā dūraṃ vartante vasturūpiṇaḥ | na te santi sahalagnā na cedātmātra sajjate ||25|| udyānasthāni puṣpāṇi madhuvantyapi ṣaṭpade | na bhavanti pralagnāni madhoḥ sthānaṃ na yānti te ||26|| tathā te viṣayāḥ sarve nāvṛṇvanti pravedinam | ātmānaṃ puruṣaṃ tasmād bandhayitavyameva na ||27|| śūlikāgṛhamābadhya kīṭī vasati tadgṛhe | gṛhaṃ cākṛṣya nityaṃ sā yatra tatra prayāti hi ||28|| ante gṛhaṃ śarīraṃ ca sarvaṃ nāśaṃ prayāti vai | ityeṣā jñānahīnā tadgṛhaṃ nītvā tu bhūtale ||29|| baddhā sarvatra aṭati tadvad dehasya bandhanam | ajñā baddhā cāpyaṭanti dehaṃ nītvā sthale sthale ||2.78.30|| tajjaṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ cāpi pratikṣaṇaṃ pravartate | yoginastu prabhāvajñāḥ saṃyamena śarīrakam ||3 1 || ekatrāpi vihāyaiva lokāntare’bhiyānti hi | na teṣāṃ bandhanaṃ kvāpi dṛḍhaṃ dehasya vartate ||32|| punarāgatya ca tatra vāsaṃ kurvanti cecchayā | pakṣiṇo vṛkṣaśākhāyāṃ vasanti vāsamātriṇaḥ ||33|| na śākhā bandhanaṃ teṣāṃ viyantyapi vihāya tām | tathā dehe nivāso’pi pakṣivanmuktavat kṛtaḥ || 34|| bandhanāya na jāyeta jīrṇacarmeva bhoginaḥ | indriyāṇi bhavantyeva dehāśrayāṇi sarvathā ||35|| samanaskāni bandhāya nirmanaskāni muktaye | mānasaṃ yojayitavyaṃ bhaved yāvatprayojanam ||36|| pratyāhartavyamevaitanniṣprayojanakaṃ yadā | tadendriyāṇi naiva syurbaddhāni bandhadāni ca ||37|| pratyāhṛtaṃ manaścāpi nirbaddhaṃ bandhakṛnna vai | buddhiryā sākṣiṇī sāpi patiṃ cātmānamāśrayet ||38|| na tu putraṃ manaścāpi putratulyendriyāṇyapi | navā dāsān viṣayām̐śca kadāpi sādhvikāśrayet ||39|| buddhernairmalyamevaitad yadatrāpratibimbanam | evaṃ pravāharodhe ca svayamātmā prakāśate ||2.78.40|| avraṇaścānaghaścāpyakalmaṣaḥ pāpavarjitaḥ | phalabhāvāpralubdhaścāsaṃgo mukto na duḥkhabhāk ||41 || nirdvandvaṃ mānasaṃ yatra buddhistatra hi nirmalā | gṛhiṇī nirmalā yatra gṛheśastatra modate ||42|| svasampatsu sadā tṛpto nānyasampadamicchati | kasmācchokaśca mohaśca tato’sya natu jāyate ||43 || ātmatṛptasya tu sadānandatṛptasya yoginaḥ | atyantatṛptasaṃyogaḥ svabhāvādvai pravartate ||44|| tenāyaṃ mokṣavannityaṃ yāti tiṣṭhati modate | ānandapūrṇatāṃ jñātvā pareśvarasya sarvathā ||45|| tatraiva sajjate samyaṅnānyasaktiṃ samicchati | vṛttayaḥ kuṇṭhitā yasya buddhistṛptyātmikābhavat ||46|| gṛhiṇī sukhadā yasya tasya mokṣo gṛhe sthitaḥ | gṛhiṇī duḥkhadā yasya tasya vai narakaṃ gṛhe ||47|| tasmāt sā gṛhiṇī buddhiḥ sarvanairmalyasādhanaiḥ | samprasannayitavyātra yayā rājā prasādavān ||48||| nityaprasādalābhārthaṃ yateta paramātmani | yatra karma na caivāsti na cāsti bhogyabhoktṛtā ||49|| tadyogena tathā syācca ghoratāvarjito bhavet | nityānandahrade magnaḥ kiṃ tasya kardamena vai ||2.78.50|| śvetāśvataranāmā vai āsīd brahmarṣisattamaḥ | tasya śiṣyaḥ pṛthoḥ pautraḥ putraḥ sa tu śikhaṇḍinaḥ ||51|| suśīlanāmā cābālyād vairāgyaṃ samupāśritaḥ | matiṃ cakre bhāgyayogāt sanyāsaṃ prati dharmavit ||52|| guroḥ sevāṃ karotyeva himavatpṛṣṭhasaṃsthitaḥ | dharmavane sthito yatra naranārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||53 || yatra mandākinī nāma supuṇyā vimalānadī | padmotpalavanopetā siddhasādhuniṣevitā ||54|| tasyāḥ sa salile snātvā tarpitvā pitṛdevatāḥ | arcayitvā narayuktaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ supuṣpakaiḥ ||55|| śvetāśvatarasaṃjñaṃ tu guruṃ natvaikadāha ca | aho me sumahadbhāgyaṃ tapāṃsi saphalāni me ||56|| yanme bhavādṛśaḥ sākṣāt sarvajña iva sadguruḥ | jñānaṃ bhaktiṃ ca naiṣkarmyaṃ sanyāsaṃ dehi me prabho ||57|| ityuktaḥ sa gururdevo dadau sanyāsamuttamam | samyaṅnyāsaḥ karmaṇāṃ yo’nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇe ||58|| sarvasamarpaṇaṃ prādāt prapattyātmakamityatha | ācacakṣe mahāmantraṃ kṛṣṇasya sarvasiddhaye ||59|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | sarvapāpopaśamanaṃ sarvasāraṃ pramuktidam ||2.78.60|| jñānaṃ sarvārpaṇaṃ cāpi dadau suśīlabhūbhṛte | mayi nārāyaṇaścāsti nārāyaṇe’pyahaṃ sthitaḥ ||6 1|| ahaṃ nārāyaṇaśceti nārāyaṇo’hameva ca | evaṃ brahmasthiterjñānaṃ dadau tu prathamaṃ guruḥ ||62|| tataḥ prāha na dehastvaṃ deho nendriyarūpavān | indriyāṇi mano naiva mānasaṃ na mahat tathā ||63|| mahattattvaṃ na cātmā vai nātmā māyātmakaḥ kvacit | māyā nātmasvarūpā ca tvadātmā pārameśvaraḥ ||64|| nārāyaṇastvadātmā ca tvaṃ vai nārāyaṇo mataḥ | nārāyaṇo hi nirlepaḥ karmabandhanavarjitaḥ ||65|| nityaṃ śuddhastathā buddho mukto māyāvivarjitaḥ | evaṃ matvā nijaṃ rūpaṃ bhaja śrīparameśvaram ||66 || prātaḥ snānaṃ nije dehe pareśānaṃ vidhāpaya | vastrādhānaṃ nije dehe pareśānaṃ vidhāpaya ||67|| bhūṣādhānaṃ candanādi pareśānaṃ vidhāpaya | ārārtrikādidānaṃ ca svadehe tasya vartaya ||68|| naivedyaṃ bhojanaṃ pānaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ sugandhi ca | svadehe taṃ pareśāna sampādaya śarīriṇam ||6 9 || upānatpādukāchatrapradānaṃ svasya varṣmaṇi | tasmai parātmane sarvayānādyarpaya bhāvataḥ ||2.78.70|| darśanaṃ śravaṇaṃ cāpi sparśanaṃ rasanādikam | kāmanaṃ snehanaṃ dehe prabhave pratipādaya ||71 || śayanaṃ gamanaṃ vārtā bodhanaṃ mananaṃ tathā | hasanaṃ rodanaṃ codvejanaṃ tasmai samarpaya ||72||| viśramaṇaṃ saṃskaraṇaṃ skhalanaṃ mādanaṃ tathā | ramaṇaṃ dhyānakaraṇaṃ dehe devāya cārpaya ||73 || jṛmbhaṇaṃ drāvaṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ kāryaṃ vicāraṇam | vivekaṃ śvasanaṃ bhaktiṃ dehe śrīpataye’rpaya ||74|| evaṃ kriyākalāpaṃ te bhautikaṃ sūkṣmamātrikam | karaṇotthaṃ bhāvanotthaṃ tasmin kṛṣṇe samarpaya ||75|| ātmodbhava kalāpaṃ ca parameśe samarpaya | so’yaṃ sannyāsa evāsti nirbandho muktiśabditaḥ ||76|| tatphalaṃ ca tvayā naiva bhoktavyaṃ haraye’rpitam | evaṃ vai vartamānasya karma divyaṃ samastakam ||77|| kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca tṛṣṇā prītiḥ ratiḥ kṣatiḥ | ghṛṇā krauryaṃ ca mālinyaṃ divyaṃ haryarpaṇaṃ yataḥ ||78|| ayaṃ sannyāsa evāsti vaiṣṇavaḥ pāramārthikaḥ | tatrasthaṃ kalmaṣaṃ puṇyaṃ nainaṃ vā paribādhate ||79|| evaṃ suśīlaḥ kṛtavān badaryāṃ tapa ācaran | bhajan devamanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||2.78.80|| āyuḥkṣaye paraṃdhāmāvāpa vigatakalmaṣaḥ | divyanārāyaṇarūpo babhūvāyaṃ caturbhujaḥ ||81|| tathaiva tu dvijā yūyaṃ bhajatainaṃ narāyaṇam | tāpītaṭe vaiṣṇavena yajñena vigatajvarāḥ ||82|| ityayaṃ bhagavāṃstuṣṭo haniṣyatyapi kalmaṣam | evamuktāstu te viprāścakruryajñaṃ suvaiṣṇavam ||83|| tapatyāḥ sattaṭe tatra candanadrumasaṃkule | saptame divase homāvasāne bālarūpakaḥ ||84|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt samāgataḥ | prasanno’smītyuvācaitān varaṃ vṛṇuta bhūsurāḥ ||85|| viprā vilokya mukteśaṃ koṭisūryaprabhāsvaram | nemustaṃ tuṣṭuvurvavrurdānaṃ kalmaṣanāśanam ||86|| ante dhāma paraṃ dehi darśanaṃ cāśvasārasam | dāsyaṃ dehi sadā cetyarthayitvā maunamādadhuḥ ||87|| tathāstviti prāha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hasan hariḥ | sasmāra cāśvinīputrau vaidyau rūpapradau prabhū ||88|| sūryaputrāvakasmācca tatrāgatau suvarculau | surūpau yauvanopetau bhūṣāmukuṭamaṇḍitau ||89|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇau kaustubhānvitau | śrīramāsevitau kṛṣṇaṃ nematustau narāyaṇam ||2.78.90|| vavandāte śrīhariṃ ca kiṃ kurvaḥ śādhi nāviha | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha kṛpābharaḥ ||9 1 || viprā ghorapratigrahādime kalmaṣatāṃ gatāḥ | yathā niṣkalmaṣā syuste kurutaṃ vai tathauṣadham ||92|| śrutvaiva cāśvinībālau praṇamya parameśvaram | āhaturbhagavan sarvaṃ kartuṃ cāsi svayaṃ prabhuḥ ||93|| avatāraiḥ prapūjyastvaṃ vartase parameśvaraḥ | saṃkalpe te mahāsṛṣṭisthitikṣaiṇyādyavasthitiḥ ||94|| tathāpi kṛpayā sevāṃ kārayituṃ smṛtau ca nau | nānyadatrauṣadhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tava pādāmṛtaṃ vinā ||95|| kādrūpyaṃ kalmaṣāṇyeṣāṃ layameṣyati pajjalāt | ityuktvā ca tato’śvinyā bālau naijaṃ kamaṇḍalum ||96|| tāpījalena saṃbhṛtvā śrīhareḥ pādapaṃkaje | prakṣālyānyakalaśe taddhṛtvā tatrauṣadheḥ rasam ||97|| cikṣipatuḥ svalpamātraṃ pāyayāmāsaturdvijān | prokṣayāmāsatuścāpi yāvattāvattu te dvijāḥ ||98|| pānāt pāpavihīnāśca sañjātā bhāsvarā drutam | kṛṣṇavarṇo gato nāśaṃ svarṇavarṇāstadābhavan ||99|| saṃprokṣaṇāttu kādrūpyaṃ naṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ kṣaṇāntare | pūrvavadrūpavantaste sañjātā brahmavarculāḥ || 2.78.1 00|| devavaddivyavadanāḥ pūrvato’bhyadhikāḥ śubhāḥ | ityevaṃ hariṇā teṣāṃ pāpaṃ prajvālitaṃ kṣaṇāt || 10 1|| tāpītaṭe kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā tīrthaṃ divyaṃ vyadhāddhariḥ | yatraite pāvitā viprāstattīrthaṃ paramaṃ śubham || 1 02|| babhūva khyātamaśvinīkumāratīrthamuttamam | śrīhariryatra vai tasthau sasnau tapatīvāriṣu || 1 03|| haritīrthaṃ ca tajjātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam | anye devā darśanārthaṃ tatrāyātāstathā jale || 1 04|| sasnustatra ca tīrthāni sañjātāni hyanekaśaḥ | tatra snātvā jalaṃ pītvā mṛtāsthikṣepaṇaṃ tathā || 1 05|| kṛtvā muktimavāpyeta mahāpāpo’pi mānavaḥ | atha viprā hareḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā pūjāṃ kumārayoḥ || 106 || vavanduśca kṣamāṃ tatra yayācire muhurmuhuḥ | niṣkalmaṣāḥ sthāpayitvā tvaśvinībālakau tadā || 1 07|| śrīhariṃ saṃpratiṣṭhāpya yayurgehān hi rādhike | ityevaṃ phālgune tatra viprarakṣāṃ cakāra saḥ || 1 08|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya pāpanāśo dhruvaṃ bhavet | tapatīsnānajaṃ puṇyaṃ labhecchrutvāpi mānavaḥ || 1 09|| aśvinībālakau devā adṛśyatāṃ tato gatāḥ | śrīhariḥ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ kṣaṇāt samāyayau || 2.78.11 0|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne suratāyanarṣikṛtopadeśaḥ, prabhoḥ prāvirbhāvo’śvinīkumārayorāgamanaṃ viprāṇāṃ niṣkalmaṣīkaraṇaṃ sannyāsaspaṣṭatā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 78 ||
<2.79> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike viprāḥ svasthālayaṃ gatā api | camatkāraṃ divārātrau cintayanti sma taṃ prabhum || 1 || darśanaṃ durlabhaṃ yacca tajjātaṃ sulabhaṃ yadā | suratāyanayogena tāvadārabhya caiva te || 2 || paśyanti paramātmānaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ dṛgantike | svapne paśyanti satataṃ suṣuptau na nivartate || 3 || ekavāraṃ hi dṛṣṭasya divyā mūrtiḥ ramāpateḥ | satataṃ hṛdaye’gādhe nihitā na nivartate || 4 || bahukālābhyāsalabdhā dṛḍhā yathā prakāśate | iyameva kṛpā tasya vinābhyāsaṃ pradarśanam || 5 || athāyāte puṇyakāle cāturmāsye tu bhūsurāḥ | tāpīnīre tu tattīrthe snātuṃ cāyayurutsukāḥ || 6 || te sarve militāḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | sasmaruḥ svarakṣakaṃ taṃ mahākalmaṣanāśanam || 7 || sammilitvā devaśayanyekādaśyāṃ ca bhūsurāḥ | pracakrurvai nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ nārāyaṇasya ha || 8 || śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa cāntarātman hare parabrahma śriyaḥ pate prabho | sarvāvatāreśvara bālakṛṣṇa gopālakṛṣṇātmaja kambharājane || 9 || rādheśa lakṣmīśa rameśa padmāpate prabhākānta ca tūlasīpate | vṛndāpate pāravatīpate śrīpate jagatkānta ca māṇikīpate || 2.79.1 0|| haṃsāpate mañjulikāpate śrīdayāpate śrīlalitāpate pate | ūrjāpate śrīsaguṇāpate kasturīpate śāntipate jayāpate || 1 1|| jaya cākṣarapara puruṣottama jaya mukteśvara sarvottama | jaya parameśvara ātmottama jaya sākṣinnavatārottama || 12|| jaya bhagavan jaya ātmārāma jaya nirguṇa jaya vai niṣkāma | pāhi sadā tava bhaktajanān kalmaṣanāśaka śrībhagavān || 13|| evaṃ te kīrtanaṃ cakrustapatyā dakṣiṇe taṭe | tallīnāḥ sambabhūvuśca tālavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ || 14|| tāvattatra prakāśo’bhūt madhye vimānamuttamam | tatra saṃrājate śrīmān bālakṛṣṇaḥ prasevitaḥ || 15|| ṣoḍaśapārṣadaiḥ sarve dadṛśustaṃ pareśvaram | sadratnanaddhahārālīrājadvakṣaḥsthalottamam || 16|| sauvarṇamaṇiratnādinaddhamukuṭamaṇḍitam | makarākārasauvarṇakuṇḍalābhyāṃ virājitam || 17|| prānte cañcatsūkṣmapiṅgakeśaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ suśobhitam | viśālabhāle vahnyābhakauṃkumatilakānvitam || 18|| koṭikāmakṛtāvāsabhrakuṭidvayarājitam | mīnacañcalaraktāntāyatanetravirājitam || 19|| mandahāsojjvalakāntiparidhyakṣaraśobhitam | praphullatilasumanonāsikābhyatiśobhitam ||2.79.20|| kṛṣṇabiddhīkṛtasthānadakṣagālātisundaram | tejaḥsaratprabhābhāsigolagaṇḍavirājitam ||21 || suvarṇasūkṣmasattantunibhaśmaśrusurekhakam | dhanuḥkammānikākārākṛtyūrdhvauṣṭhātikarṣakam ||22|| miṣṭāmṛtātisaṃbhṛtaraktādharamanoharam | susūkṣmakṛṣṇabindvyāḍhyacibukahanūsaubhagam || 23|| viśālabhālasaṃrājaddīrgharekhaikasaubhagam | śaṣkulīcakravadramyakarṇadvayātibhāsuram ||24|| sūryacandrātisaṃśobhipremaśevadhinetrakam | sarvasaundaryaśamaśrīsamāśritamukhottamam ||25|| koṭyaiśvaryakṛtasthānabhramaradvayarājitam | kundakalipayaḥphenanibhadantātimohakam ||26|| viśālaprāntahāsyāḍhyānanakoṇahṛdaṃgamam | sūkṣmagartikayā gaṇḍe mātṛvātsalyadarśakam ||27|| śvetacakṣurjanyatejo’bhibhūtānyāvalokanam | śaṃbhuryasya sthitaḥ kaṇṭhe śaṃkhaḥ kṛkāṭikāsthitaḥ ||28|| kaustubho hṛdaye yasya vanamālāsahāyakṛt | kṛṣṇabinduśca vai yasya kaṇṭhamadhye prabhāsate ||29|| kaṇṭhakūpe vāyucakraṃ samvatsarāśritaṃ sthitam | kaṇṭhasya valaye yasya tvakṣaraṃ brahma bhāsate ||2.79.3 0|| hṛdaye guṇaśūnyo vai hāraścarmaṇi cāmpakaḥ | bhramaraḥ śrīnivāsākhyo dakṣāvarto’sya rājate ||3 1|| śārdūlaskandhasadṛśadṛḍhaskandhau hareḥ śubhau | bhogibhogasamo pīnau mṛdulau subhujau hareḥ ||32|| kaumudīpaṭasaṃchannāvujjvalau netra hārakau | kukṣau kṛṣṇapiśaṃgābhau stabakau romasaṃkulau ||33|| dṛṣṭau darśakabhaktasya janyete snehabhāvanām | svarṇavarṇau bhujau ramyau campakābhe bhujāntare || 34|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmacihnāni bāhujāni ca | prakoṣṭhayostrirekhāśca kare dakṣe śubhāni ca ||35|| matsyatriśūlanārācaketusvastidhanūṃṣi ca | rekhācihnāni ramyāṇi aṣṭacakrāṇi santi tu ||36|| vajraṃ cāpi śatrunāśakaraṃ vidyata ityapi | paṃkajābhe karatale virājete samujjvale ||37|| nakhā bhānti yathā candrāḥ pūrṇimāyāṃ vyavasthitāḥ | udaraṃ trivaliśobhaṃ nābhirvijñānaśevadhiḥ ||38|| jaghanaṃ śrīpratimāḍhyaṃ liṃgaṃ kāmasamāśrayam | kaṭirnakṣatramāleva rājate paritaḥ śubhā ||39|| nitambau projjvalau ramyau sakhīmānasarañjanau | sakthimūle śubhravarṇe tejovyāpte’tisundare ||2.79.40|| raśanā kaṭibhāge ca vartate svarṇanirmitā | ūrmikā aṃgulisthānāḥ śṛṃkhalā bhujabandhane ||41|| kaṭake kānake cāpi prakoṣṭhe bāhubhāgayoḥ | sakthnormadhye’kṣarabrahmojjvalaṃ tejaḥ pravartate ||42|| vāme sakthini mūlācca hyadhaścihnaṃ tu kailakam | sakthnaścopari lakṣmyāśca cihnaṃ pāṇḍuravarṇakam ||43|| hastatalāyataṃ ramyaṃ yatra muhyanti yoginaḥ | jānū ramyau vartulau ca ramaṇīyau hareḥ śubhau ||44|| jaṅghe padmaprabhe ramye romāvalisamanvite | kadalīkandasaṃśobhe sakthinī śītale śubhe ||45|| pādau kammānikāsaṃsthau kamalodarasannibhau | ṣoḍaśādicihnayuktau tathordhvarekharājitau ||46 | | śikharaṃ kalpavallī ca cakraṃ ca yānamityapi | saudhaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ hastīśca turagaścandrakastathā ||47|| garuḍo haṃsaityādicihnitau pādapaṃkajau | svarṇaromāvalirājatpādordhvabhāgaśobhitau ||48|| ājānubāhuyugalaṃ pādāṅgulī pralambinī | saumyamūrtistathā tejovyāptā divyā hyabhūcchubhā ||49 || etādṛśo mandahāsyaṃ vimuñcan bhagavān hariḥ | avātatāra viprāṇāṃ madhye vimānato hariḥ ||2.79.50|| viprā nemuḥ pādayośca tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram | prasannamānasāḥ sarve babhūvurdarśanādati ||51|| suratāyanasaṃjño’pi maharṣiḥ śrīhariṃ tadā| āgatya candanavṛkṣāt pūjayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ||52|| aho bhāgyaṃ punarnastu yaddharerdarśanaṃ gṛhe | ityuktvāluṇṭhanaṃ cakre pādayoḥ śrīharestadā ||5 3 || pupūjurbhāvapūrṇāśca viprāḥ sarve’pi vai muhuḥ | te sarve kṛtakāryāśca tīrthavidhānavedinaḥ ||54|| prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ śrīhariṃ sannidhau sthitāḥ | darśanaṃ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetrasya kāraya prabho ||55 || iti stuto hariḥ prāhāśvinīkumāratīrthake | punaḥ snātvā mayā sākaṃ vimānamadhiruhya ca ||56 || samāgacchantu me kṣetraṃ bhavanto mama sevakāḥ | tataste hariṇā sārdhaṃ snātvāśvinīkumārake ||57|| suratāyanamukhyāśca niṣedustadvimānake | hariḥ sarvān saha nītvā pathā vaihāyasena tu ||58|| pañcasāhasraviprādyairāyayau dinamātrataḥ | akhātaṃ tu samullaṃghya śatruñjitānadīmukham ||5 9 || tatra tān snāpayitvā ca prayayau gopanāthakam | tattīrthe kārayitvā ca mūlasvarṇapurīṃ yayau ||2.79.6 0|| tattīrthaṃ tu vinirvartya somanāthaṃ yayau tataḥ | bhadrābdhisaṃgame snātvā camatkārapuraṃ yayuḥ ||6 1 || devikāyāṃ kṛtatīrthā vanasthalīnivāsinaḥ | prārthayāñcakruratyarthaṃ pāvayituṃ vanasthalīm ||6 2|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svīkṛtya cārthanām | cāndre tu śrāvaṇe kṛṣṇe pañcamyāṃ ravivāsare ||6 3 || vanasthalīṃ yayau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ svayam | bhaktān sarvān pāvayitvā bhojayitvā prasādakam ||64|| dadau tebhyaścopadeśaṃ bhavapārakaraṃ param | śṛṇvantu mama bhaktā ye sarvārpaṇaṃ vinā mayi ||65 || pāpapuṇyādibhogānāmanto nāyāti vai kvacit | ahaṃ nārāyaṇasteṣāṃ sarvārpaṇavidhāyinām ||66 || svayaṃ karomi nairmalyaṃ nayāmi mama dhāma tān | naro nārī bālakaśca bālā vā ṣaṇḍha ityapi ||67|| mamānugrahaleśena bhavanti mokṣiṇo drutam | tasmād bhajantu māṃ prītyā kurvantvatra sumandiram ||68|| matpratimāṃ sthāpayantu bhajantāṃ satataṃ ca mām | ahaṃ coddhārakṛccāsmi bhavatāṃ śaraṇārthinām ||6 9 || ityuktvādiśya bhūmiṃ ca pradatvā caraṇāmṛtam | nāśayitvā bhavarogān rogāṃśca rogiṇāṃ tathā ||2.79.70|| vanasthalīṃ pāvayitvā narān nārīḥ śubhāśiṣā | yojayitvā svabhaktau ca datvā caraṇavāri ca ||71|| darśanaṃ sparśanaṃ datvā pādasevāṃ pragṛhya ca | kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ parigṛhya samāruhya vimānake ||72|| kṣaṇamātreṇa ca yayau śubhaṃ saurāṣṭrapattanam | yatrāyaṃ vartate śrīmallakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||73|| svayaṃ svarāṭ mahāśobhe prāsāde suviśālake | rājate dugdhaśuklābho yuvā hāsyabharo hariḥ ||74|| saurāṣṭrīyaprajānāṃ ca pratimārūpavān prabhuḥ | bhajanīyaḥ pūjanīyo yogināṃ narayoṣitām ||75|| divyasuvarṇakalaśaiḥ śobhamāne mahālaye | vartamānāṃ nijāṃ mūrtiṃ saṃspṛśyābhāṣya ca priyām ||76|| lakṣmīṃ jagatāṃ jananīṃ dharmaṃ bhaktiṃ vilokya ca | sūryaṃ śeṣapraśāyaṃ ca dattātreyaṃ śivaṃ vidhim ||77|| hanudāsaṃ gaṇadāsaṃ samāśliṣya tato hariḥ | yayau vaihāyasā śubhravimānena kṣaṇottaram ||78|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram | udyāne cāndane tatra vimānaṃ sthāpya mādhavaḥ ||79|| lomaśasyāśramaṃ ramyaṃ vimānasthānadarśayat | aśvataṭākasalile snāpayitvā ca tairthikān ||2.79.80|| lomaśasya guroḥ ramyaṃ kārayitvā ca darśanam | koṭyarbudābjakanyānāṃ kārṣṇānāṃ cāpi darśanam ||81 || kārayitvā yayau kṛṣṇo naijaṃ prāsādamuttamam | darśayāmāsa jananīṃ kambharāśrīṃ mahāsatīm ||82|| tathā svapitaraṃ devaṃ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakam | sāptabhaume nijyaṃ hastyāsanaṃ prādarśayat prabhuḥ ||83 || ātithyaṃ kṛtavām̐steṣāṃ bhojanaṃ vāsanaṃ tathā | athātithyottaraṃ sarve viśaśramuśca te tadā ||84|| viśāle tadvimāne tu niśāṃ ninyuḥ samutsukāḥ | prātaḥ snānavidhiṃ kṛtvā vavanduḥ parameśvaram ||85|| kanyāśataṃ daduste tu śrīkṛṣṇaparamātmane | lomaśasyāśrame tāśca rakṣayāmāsa keśavaḥ ||86 || tato yātā mānitāśca tairthikāste nijaṃ gṛham | vimānena samaṃ śrīmannārāyaṇena vai saha ||87|| prāpayya tān harirdeśān ṣaṣṭhyāṃ punaḥ samāyayau | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ divyaṃ cākṣarabhūpadam ||88|| ityevaṃ darśanaṃ datvā kārayitvā ca tīrthakam | vimānena nijān deśān prāpayitvā kṛpāmayaḥ ||89|| bhagavānakarod rādhe bhaktamānasapūrṇatām | kṛpāsādhyaḥ svayaṃ tasmādanādipuruṣottamaḥ ||2.79.90 || na vratairna ca vā dānairna vā havanakarmabhiḥ | kintu sādhyapremabhaktyā nāmabhaktyā samarpaṇaiḥ ||91 || bhajatāṃ sevakānāṃ tu sevāyāṃ vartate svayam | rādhike ca yathā varte sevāyāṃ tava sarvadā ||92|| goloke sevikā nānyā tvādṛśī me’sti bhāminī | sevikāyāstu sevāyāṃ kānto bhavati dāsavat ||93 || tathā śrībhagavām̐ścāpi sevakānāṃ kṛte sadā | bhūtvākasmāt sevakaśca rakṣaparaḥ prajāyate ||94|| sarvapūjādhikā pūjā sevā tanvā vidhīyate | tataḥ sevā mānasī ca dravyajā tu tataḥ parā ||95|| sarvātmanārpaṇaṃ sevā hyatulyā rādhike yataḥ | prasannatākarī bodhyā cānukūlyena vartanam ||96|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastuṣyati dāsyataḥ | paraṃdhāma dadātyeva cānte śāśvatasaukhyadam ||97|| dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutaṃ kāntāṃ patiṃ kuṭumbavardhanam | ārogyaṃ sampado lakṣmīṃ sutāṃ gāṃ mahiṣīṃ gajān || 98|| aśvān dāsīḥ prajā dāsān pautrān svargān dadāti ca | ityetat kathito rādhe camatkāro harestava ||99|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya śrāvaṇātsmaraṇādapi | bhuktirmuktirbhavedante bhagavaccaraṇaṃ labhet || 2.79.1 00|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne suratāyanādipañcasāhasraviprāṇāṃ kuṃkumavāpītīrthāgamanaṃ śubhopadeśaścetinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 79 ||
<2.80> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā rādhe camatkāro hareḥ paraḥ | tāritā duḥkhato bhaktā bhīmāsarittaṭe purā || 1 || dakṣiṇe pauṃḍrakasaṃjñe pattane kṣatriyarṣabhaḥ | nāmnā baleśavarmābhūd rājā khaṇḍadharāpatiḥ || 2 || vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo bhakto yogakriyāviśāradaḥ | kapilasyābhavacchiṣyaḥ sāṃkhyajñānavivekavān || 3 || bhīmātaṭe nātidūre parvate kapilāśrame | sāṃkhyānāṃ yogināṃ yogaṃ samāgamaṃ karoti saḥ || 4 || yadāśrame purā devaḥ kapilastīrthayogakṛt | daśavarṣāṇi tatraiva tasthau ramye vane śubhe || 5 || adribhāge’tiśubhage śāntide nirjane’male | tadā baleśavarmāsau saṃsevya kapilaṃ munim || 6 || prāptavān sāṃkhyayogau ca paramaiśvaryasampadaḥ | siddhīścādṛśyabhāvaṃ ca bahurūpabhavādikam || 7 || kapilastu tathaiśvaryaṃ datvā yayau sthalāntaram | rājā nityaṃ samāyāti tadāśramaṃ vilokitum || 8 || kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā padaṃ tacca guruṃ saṃsmṛtya vai muhuḥ | prapūjya pīṭhametacca tato yogijanān parān || 9 || sādhūn vane sthitām̐ścāpi natvā yāti nijaṃ gṛham | evaṃ karoti nityaṃ sa sāṃkhyayogaparāyaṇaḥ || 1 0|| athaikadā vrataṃ kartuṃ rājā śrīkapilāśrame | samāyayau sapatnīkaḥ kārtike nyavasad bahiḥ || 1 1|| vṛkṣacchāyāṃ samāśritya bhūśayānaḥ phalāśanaḥ | brahmacaryaparaḥ kṛcchravratasthitā ca tatpriyā || 12|| ātithyadharmanirataścānnasatraprabandhanaḥ | nityaṃ homaparaścāpi sahasradīnabhojanaḥ || 13|| dānadharmaparaścāturmāsyāntavratatatparaḥ | bahavaḥ sādhavastatra siddhāḥ sādhyaśca yoginaḥ || 14|| yātriṇo vanavāsāśca samāyānti sadāvrate | annārthibhyo dadātyannaṃ vastrārthibhyastathāmbaram || 15|| pātrārthibhyaśca pātrāṇi dhanārthibhyo dhanāni ca | yadyadiṣṭaṃ bhaved yasyārthinastasmai tadiṣṭakam || 16|| dadātyeva baleśaḥ sa dakṣiṇāṃ pradadāti ca | kārtike dhṛtavān śreṣṭhaṃ vrataṃ yo yatprayācate || 17|| tattasmai sampradeyaṃ vai nakāro vācya eva na | rājñaḥ putro’bhavattatra dvādaśābdo’tikomalaḥ || 18|| rājñī śīlavatī nāmnā pātivratyaṃ prarakṣati | putraśca puṇḍrako nāmnā brahmabhaktiṃ karoti hi || 19|| trayaste lokasādhūnāṃ sevāparā bhavanti vai | tārakāyananāmā ca maharṣirvaiṣṇavo mahān ||20 || tatraiva vasati yogī yogadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ | vaihāyasagatirdivyaḥ kāmarūpadharo yatiḥ ||2 1|| aṣṭasiddhyāśrayaścāste sarvakāmānyavarjitaḥ | sa munirdhyānayogena jñātvā kuṃkumavāpikām || 22|| sākṣādanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasamāśritām | lomaśasyāśramaṃ gatvā kṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇadarśanam || 23 || gṛhītvā ca manuṃ mokṣapradaṃ śrīpatimādhavāt | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||24|| jajāpa nityadā naijāśrame sthitvāntare sthale | nityaṃ vyomnā prage yāti cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram || 25|| kṛtvā harerdarśanaṃ ca punaḥ prayāti cāśramam | tārakāyanasaṃjño’yaṃ maharṣirvyomato bhuvam ||26|| avātarat tadā rājā darśanārthaṃ yayau drutam | papraccha vinayī bhūtvā praṇatārtiharaṃ munim || 27|| gamyate kva ṛṣe nityaṃ prātaḥ kalyāṇakṛd yadi | jijñāsitaṃ tu me vācyaṃ yadi rodho na vidyate || 28|| sādhūnāṃ saṃgatiḥ svargapradā mokṣapradā tathā | duḥkhanāśakārī cāpadvināśinī matā sadā ||29|| yogināmīśvarāṇāṃ ca sādhūnāṃ ca satāmapi | vihāro yatra tatrāsti nārāyaṇo hi gocaraḥ ||2.80.3 0|| sādhūnāṃ caraṇaḥ pūjyo jalaṃ peyaṃ padāmṛtam | bhojyaṃ prāsādikaṃ teṣāṃ grāhyaṃ vaco mukhodbhavam ||3 1 || satāṃ sevā hareḥ sevā satāṃ saṃgo harerhi saḥ | satāṃ deho harerdehaḥ santo vai harimūrtayaḥ ||32|| santo dhyeyāḥ sadā dhyāne santo dhāryā sadā hṛdi | santaḥ sevyāḥ sarvadānaiḥ satsu harirvirājate ||33|| satāṃ dṛṣṭirharerdṛṣṭiḥ satāṃ sparśo harerhi saḥ | satāmāśleṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇāśleṣaṇaṃ pāpanāśakam ||34|| satāṃ pādarajo dhāryaṃ mastake hṛdi cānane | satāṃ pādajalaṃ dhāryaṃ mukhe śirasi vigrahe || 35| | satāṃ prasannatā prāpyā dehagehasutādibhiḥ | dhanasampatpradānaiśca svātmārpaṇena sarvathā ||36|| anityaḥ sarvathā deho rakṣito’pi vinaśyati | tena sevā sadā kāryā grāhyā prasannatā satām ||37|| yatrendriye ca viṣaye ruciḥ svasyātivegitā | tatrendriye hi kartavyā sevā tūbhayatuṣṭaye ||38|| sādhūnāṃ hṛdaye sākṣātparamātmā virājate | śubhāstasmāt kriyāḥ sarvāḥ satāmindriyadehajāḥ ||39|| santo divyāḥ kriyā divyā divyo dehaḥ satāṃ sadā | divyaścendriyavargaśca satāṃ divyā hi dhātavaḥ ||2.80.40|| satāṃ vicāro divyaśca buddhirdivyā satāṃ sadā | satāṃ svapnaṃ ca śayanaṃ ramaṇaṃ divyameva tat ||41 || satsu māyākṛtaṃ kāryaṃ vidyate naiva sarvathā | satsu puṇyaṃ tathā pāpaṃ parameśvaramāśritam ||42|| lepahīnaṃ sadā divyaṃ śāśvatānandadāyakam | puṇyānāṃ khanayaḥ santaḥ pāpaleśo na yatra vai ||43|| tādṛśastvaṃ mune divyo vartase tārakāyana | yathā viṣṇustathā tvaṃ vai tārako’si bhavārṇavāt ||44|| vada te saṃgamāptebhyo naśca bhāgyaṃ hi no mahat | ityuktvā nṛpatistasthau pratikṣam̐stadṛṣervacaḥ ||45|| taṃ tārakāyanaḥ prāha śṛṇu rājan baleśvara | yo loke prathitaścāsti bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ||46|| parabrahma ca vede’sti sarvāvatāradhṛk prabhuḥ | paradhāmasthito yaḥ saḥ saurāṣṭre kambharāgṛhe ||47|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre kuṃkumavāpikābhuvi | śrīmadgopālabālaḥ sa lomaśabhvāṃ virājate ||48|| yatra brahmapriyāḥ koṭyarbudābjapadmasaṃkhyakāḥ | sarvāśca śaktayastīrthakoṭayaḥ santi dehinaḥ ||49|| mānave pādape tārṇe tairyañce bhautike’pi ca | sarge brahmapriyā yatra tiṣṭhanti brahmalālasāḥ ||2.80.50|| muktā dhāmagatāścāpi bahudhāmanivāsinaḥ | pracchannā bhinnavarṣmāṇo yatra tiṣṭhanti yoginaḥ ||5 1|| taṃ prabhuṃ paramātmānaṃ draṣṭuṃ gacchāmi nityaśaḥ | prātaḥ sampūjya taṃ devaṃ pītvā taccaraṇāmbujam |||52|| tatastīrthāni kṛtvaiva samāgacchāmi cāsanam | ityukto nṛpatiḥ prāha kadā taddarśanaṃ mama ||53|| bhaviṣyatīti me brahman vada sādho kṛpāṃ kuru | muniḥ prāha gṛhāṇainaṃ mantraṃ japaparo bhava ||54|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | ityenaṃ rādhike mantraṃ datvā ca taulasīṃ srajam |||55|| mahāvaiṣṇavasevyaṃ ca datvā hareḥ padāmṛtam | ṛṣiryayau nijāvāsaṃ rājā rājñī sutastataḥ ||56|| jepustaṃ paramaṃ mantraṃ dhyāne babhūvurāsthitāḥ | sasmarustamanādiśrīkṛṣṇasvāminarāyaṇam ||57|| atha śrībālakṛṣṇastu parīkṣārthaṃ hi bhūbhṛtaḥ | ājagāmātithirūpo madhyāhne bhojanottaram ||58|| saptame’hni kṛṣṇavarṇo lohavalayadhārakaḥ | raktākṣaḥ kaupīnamātravasano jaṃgalī yathā ||59|| prāha rājā tu taṃ vīkṣya samāyāhi vanecara | gṛhāṇa bhojanaṃ vāri tato yāhi yathāsukham ||2.80.60|| jaṃgamī prāha nocchiṣṭaṃ mayā vai bhujyate kvacit | nānyapakvaṃ ca bhuṃje’haṃ kathaṃ dadāsi bhojanam ||6 1 || ahaṃ vai jaṃgalī cāsmi bhojanaṃ tāmasaṃ mama | anyaprāṇisamutthaṃ tu nāhaṃ bhuṃje kadācana ||62|| yadi satyapratijño’si nakāro nocyate tvayā | dehi me bhojanaṃ rājan priyaṃ yacchāntidaṃ bhavet ||63|| nṛpaḥ prāha yatheṣṭaṃ te dātuṃ śakto’smi bhojanam | vada svaiṣṭaṃ dadāmyatra nādeyaṃ me’tra vidyate ||64|| sāttvikaṃ rājasaṃ vāpi tāmasaṃ te’tra rocate | anyotthaṃ neṣyate cedve svotthaṃ vada dadāmi te ||65|| yacchaktaṃ tad dadāmyeva kārtikeyaṃ vrataṃ mama | dātavyameva labhyaṃ ced vada vanin dadāmi te ||66|| vanī prāha śṛṇu rājan māṃsādo’smi vane vasan | kārtike’pi mayā tvetadvrataṃ pālitameva ha ||67|| rājñaḥ putrasya māṃsaṃ vai mayā bhakṣyamayācitam | rājā yadi svayaṃ dadyāddhṛdayasyaiva netarat ||68|| ityevaṃ me vrataṃ tvāste raktaṃ peyaṃ ca hṛdgatam | naiva vāri prapeyaṃ ca vrataṃ me tāmasaṃ yataḥ ||69|| nāhaṃ yāce nṛpa tvatto vrataṃ mayā prakāśitam | yācanā naiva kartavyā vratabhaṃgakarī yataḥ ||2.80.70|| ityuktvā sa tataḥ sthānād vanaṃ prati vilokya ca | gantuṃ padakramān cakre yathā yāñcākaro na vai ||71 || rājñī prāha vilokyaiva vanin tiṣṭha sthiro bhava | pādaprakṣālanaṃ kurve cātitheḥ paramātmanaḥ ||72|| kṣaṇāntare dadātyeṣaḥ rājā tvadiṣṭabhojanam | āsanaṃ svīkuru tvetat kāmbalaṃ tiṣṭha śāntitaḥ ||73 || vanī prāha vrataṃ me’sti stheyaṃ vai kārtike sadā | kumārīkanyakāsakthi vivastraṃ cettu labhyate ||74|| tasyā ūrau mayā cāsītavyaṃ na tvanyathā kvacit | rājñī putrīṃ tadā prāha bhava putri śubhāsanam ||75|| kanyāḥ kṛṣṇā tathā bhīmā tuṃgabhadrā ca nāmataḥ | tisra āsam̐śca tadrājñastisrastatra hyupasthitāḥ ||76|| kṛṣṇā vastraṃ parityajya dadau sakthi yathāsukham | niṣasāda vanī tatra dhyānamagno babhūva ha ||77|| putraḥ prāha pitaraṃ tu rājan śīghraṃ hi hṛnmama | bhittvā dehi pareśāyātithaye muktaye bhavet ||78|| kṣaṇād rājā tu khaṅgena dvedhā skandhāt kaṭiṃ prati | vibhidya putrahṛdayaṃ dadau raktaṃ hi tatkṣaṇe ||79|| tāvat kanyā dvitīyāpi bhīmā vastraṃ vinā nijam | sakthi dadau vanine’tra vanī māṃsaṃ nidhāya ca ||2.80.80|| vubhuje ca papau raktaṃ tāvacca tuṅgabhadrikā | vivastrā vanino hastamūrau saṃskṛtya vai muhuḥ ||81 || mukhaṃ saṃskṛtya sakthnā ca pādasaṃvāhanaṃ muhuḥ | dehasammardanaṃ cāpi cakrustadvaninastadā ||82|| athotthāya pragantuṃ ca vanī yāvat samīhate | tāvadrājā dakṣiṇārthaṃ dadāti vacanaṃ śubham ||83|| vanī prāha vrataṃ me’sti yanmāṃsaṃ bhakṣitaṃ bhavet | tanmātā dakṣiṇāyāṃ vai grāhyā nānyat kadācana ||84|| vaninītyuktavatyeva rājñī śīghramupasthitā | eṣāhaṃ tava dāsyāsmi dakṣiṇāṃ svīkuru prabho ||85|| vanī tāṃ tvambaraśūnyāṃ kṛtvā vṛkṣatale’bhavat | ramaṇaṃ kṛtavān vyomni pṛthvīṃ caivāspṛśan kṣaṇam ||86 || ākāśe tāṃ dhṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā vyatarkayat tadā | aho me paramaṃ bhāgyaṃ putrasya yoṣitastathā ||87|| kanyakānāṃ mahābhāgyaṃ haryarthe yojitā vayam | vanī vā syād vānaprastho vanecaro’vanecaraḥ ||88|| antarātmā haristṛpto’nityadehādito mama | anityaṃ nāśamāyāti parārthaṃ saphalaṃ yadi ||89|| kimasmātparamaṃ bhāgyaṃ yairhi tṛpyati mādhavaḥ | dhanyo’haṃ kṛtakṛtyo’haṃ sarvaṃ me saphalaṃ kṛtam ||2.80.90|| āgatya vaninā cātra vratārthaṃ bhautikaṃ mama | nakārasyātra vai sthānaṃ na jātaṃ mama cānane ||91|| matpatnyā vā sutānāṃ vā putrasyeti jayo mama | dhanyāstāḥ putrikāścāpi dhanyaḥ putro’pi me priyaḥ ||92|| dhanyā rājñī ca me tvatra vrate naṃ nahi jagṛhuḥ | tārito’haṃ kuṭumbena satyaṃ kuṭumbakaṃ mama ||93|| atithyarthaṃ copayoge svīkāritaṃ svayaṃ śubham | dharmārthakāmamokṣā me vratenādya kare sthitāḥ ||94|| jitaṃ jaganmayā tvadya cātitheḥ kṛpayā khalu | evaṃ dhanyaṃ manyamānaḥ prasannamānaso’bhavat ||95|| tāvad rājñīṃ prabhuktvaiva vanī vṛkṣādayaḥ sthitaḥ | vanitvaṃ pravihāyaiva śrīlakṣmīrādhikāyutaḥ ||96|| dvibhujo’tha mahālakṣmyā yuto’dṛśyata vai tadā | mahāviṣṇudhṛtacchatro viṣṇudhṛtānnapātrakaḥ ||97|| bhojanaṃ saṃgrasan tatrādṛśyata pareśvaraḥ | koṭikandarpaśobhāḍhyaḥ koṭisūryasamojjvalaḥ ||98|| anantamuktasaṃstutyo devapitṛpravanditaḥ | īśvarairavatāraiśca pūjito bhūṣaṇairbhṛtaḥ || 99|| koṭibrahmapriyāsevyaḥ paramākṣaravanditaḥ | divyavyomapare dhāmni rājamāno vilokitaḥ || 2.80.100|| divyavimānamadhyasthagajāsanavirājitaḥ | divyaḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣāḍhyo hasan prema pradarśayan || 101 || vīkṣate parito bhaktān rājānaṃ tatpriyāṃ satīm | kanyāstisro’tibhāvena mohayan mānasaṃ muhuḥ || 1 02|| śrīhareḥ sannidhau tatra rājaputraḥ sthito’bhavat | divyo divyavibhūṣāḍhyo yathāpūrvākṛtiḥ śubhaḥ || 103 || puṇḍrakaḥ prahasan pārśvāddhareḥ svapitaraṃ prati | samājagāma sahasā suptotthita ivāmalaḥ || 1 04|| devā muktā īśvarāśca cakruḥ kusumavarṣaṇam | rājā tuṣṭāva bhaktyā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 1 05|| iti
