śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne baleśvararājñaḥ kapilabhagavadyogena paramabhāgavatatvaṃ, tārakāyanamaharṣiyogena kārtikavrate parīkṣārthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vanecararūpeṇāgamanaṃ, rājñaḥ putraputrīstrīkuṭumbārpaṇena prabhordarśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 80 ||
<2.81> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike rājā yathā tuṣṭāva mādhavam | baleśvaro’tibhāvena śrīpatiṃ parameśvaram || 1 || tvaṃ devadevo’si sadā parātmam̐ stvaṃ cākṣare dhāmni pare sthito’si | tvaṃ vai parabrahma pareśvaro’si muktaikavandyo’kṣaravandya eva || 2 || sarvāvatārai itipūjanīyaścārādhanīyo’si yato’vatārī | sarvairapīśairabhivandanīyo vyūhaiḥ samārādhanatatparaiśca || 3 || viṣṇusvarūpairapi pūjanīyo maheśavedhaḥprabhṛtiprathaiśca | suraistathā pitṛbhirarcanīyo diśāṃ prapālairmanujaiśca siddhaiḥ || 4 || daityaistathā dānavapuṃgavaiścāsuraiśca rakṣobhirabhiṣṭutaśca | nāgaiścaraiścācaraprāṇibhiśca dhyeyo’sigupto’sihṛdisthitaścā| 5 || tvaṃ vāmano’bhūrnarasiṃhako’bhūrnārāyaṇo’bhūrvṛṣaputrako’bhūḥ | tvaṃ viṣṇurūpo’pi ca haṃsarūpastvaṃ matsyarūpaḥ kamaṭhastathābhūḥ|| 6 || tvaṃ kroḍarūpaḥ kapilasvarūpastvaṃ dattarūpaḥ paraśudhrako’bhūḥ | tvaṃ yajñarūpo ramaṇasvarūpaḥ kumārarūpo’śvamukhasvarūpaḥ || 7 || devarṣirūpo’pinṛpasvarūpo vyāsasvarūpo’pi ca rādhikeśaḥ | jñānasvarūpaśca harisvarūpaḥ svāmisvarūpo’si patisvarūpaḥ || 8 || pracchannarūpo’si baṭusvarūpo gārhasthyarūpo’si vanastharūpaḥ | sādhusvarūpo’si satīsvarūpo viprasvarūpo’si ca bāhujo’si || 9 || tvaṃ vaiśyarūpo’sicasevako’si pativratādharmasurūpako’si | tvaṃ bhaktarakṣākaravatsalo’si tvaṃ mohinīrūpadharo’si nātha || 2.81.1 0|| tvaṃ koṭirūpo’si guṇāśrayo’si divyābhirāśīrbhirabhiprato’si | tvaṃ divyadeho’si parīkṣako’si hyuddhārakartāsi ca naḥ prapāhi || 1 1|| tvaṃ yācakastvaṃ sutabhakṣakaśca tvaṃ rakṣako jīvada īkṣyate’tra | tvaṃ bhogyabhoktā ca vihārakartā tva lepaśūnyo bhagavānihāsi || 1 2|| kathaṃkṛtaṃ kiṃkṛtamatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena dyumatā tvayā vai | mayārpitaṃ tatsaphalaṃ tvayīha mayi prasanno bhava viśvamūrte || 13|| dhanyā satī śīlavatī priyā te tisro’pi dhanyāśca kumārikāste | dhanyaḥ kumārastava pauṇḍrakaśca dhanyo baleśastava kiṃkaro’ham || 14|| dhanyaṃ svarūpaṃ vanavāsinaste dhanyā ratirvyomagatasya te ca | dhanyaṃ sutorau tava bhojanaṃ ca dhanyaḥ kumārastava bhojyarūpaḥ || 15|| dhanyo gurustārakayogivaryo dhanyā ca bhīmātaṭabhūmikeyam | dhanyā kriyā 3 divyatamā tvadīyā dhanyaṃ ca dhairye tava sevakānām || 16|| samarpaṇaṃ dhanyatamaṃ sutasya vrataṃ ca dhanyaṃ kumudasya māsaḥ | anādilakṣmīpatikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’si dhanyo’tra ca kambharājaḥ || 17|| gopālabālo’si ca bālakṛṣṇaḥ prabhāpatiḥ pāravatīpatiśca | rādhāpatirmāṇikikāpatiśca śriyaḥ patirbhūpatirīśvareśaḥ || 18|| haṃsāpatirmañjupatiḥ sureśo māyāpatirvai saguṇāpatiśca | rūpaṃ tavedaṃ bahukoṭisūryaiḥ samaṃ nirīkṣya sukhato na yadvai || 1 9|| koṭyarkabhāsvadbahumuktayuktaṃ tathāvatārairbahubhiḥ sametam | īśeśvaraiḥ pitṛsurādibhiśca daityaiśca nāgaiḥ parivāritaṃ ca ||2.81.20|| lakṣmyā śriyā rādhikayā yutaṃ ca yutaṃ tathā cakrapaviṣṇunā ca| tathā mahālakṣmikayā yutaṃ ca tathā mahāviṣṇusupūjitaṃ ca ||21 || netre na me vīkṣitumīśvare’tra tato’patejaḥ kuru darśanārham | prasīda jīveśa tava svarūpaṃ bālasvarūpaṃ subhagaṃ vidhehi || 22|| namo namaste bhavatāraṇāya namo’stu te brahmaparāyaṇāya | śrībālakṛṣṇāya narāyaṇāya bhūyo’pibhūyo’pi namo namaste ||23|| anantarūpāya visaṃkhyavaktre hyasaṃkhyanetrāya namo namaste | asaṃkhyanāmne parameśvarāya koṭyabjakanyāpataye namo’stu ||24|| sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ te’rpitameva kṛṣṇa yathāprasanno’si kuru tathā tvam | prāptaṃ mayāptavyamamutra cātra varārthakaṃ śiṣyata evanādya || 25|| ityevaṃ rādhike stutvā virarāma nṛpaḥ kṣaṇam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha bhuvaḥ patim ||26 || ayaṃ yo dṛśyate rājan mahāviṣṇuḥ svayaṃ bhavān | mahālakṣmīśca yā tvāste seyaṃ śīlavatī tava ||27|| śrīriyaṃ tava bhīmāsti lakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇāsti te sutā | rādhikā tuṃgabhadrā te putrītrayaṃ nibodha vai ||28|| ayaṃ viṣṇustava putraḥ pauṃḍrakaḥ svayameva ha | tārako’yaṃ guruste’smi rājan mokṣapradaḥ prabhuḥ ||29|| divyairnetraiḥ pradattaiśca yūyaṃ paśyata māmiha | sarvarūpaiḥ samāyuktaṃ naijarūpāṇi yānyapi ||2.81.3 0|| mamāvatārarūpāṇi prapaśyata tato hṛdi | putro’yaṃ tava rājendra na mṛto māyayā mama ||3 1 || darśitaṃ ca parīkṣārthaṃ sarvārpaṇavidhau tava | vrate’tra kārtike neti vaktavyaṃ nārthine kvacit ||32|| gṛhāṇa rājan putraṃ tvaṃ yathārūpaṃ yathāsukam | bhāryā bhuktā mayā naiva parīkṣārthaṃ pradarśitam ||33 || kanyā nagnāḥ kṛtā naiva parīkṣārthaṃ tu tatkṛtam | prasanno’smi ca sañjātaḥ prasannatama ityapi ||34|| yūyaṃ mamāvatārāḥ stha jñānaṃ tadvai bhaviṣyati | sarvadā cādyataḥ sarve bhavatātra sudevatāḥ ||35|| uddhārārthaṃ mayā loke kalāṃśāṃśādibhistviha | avatārāḥ saṃdhṛtā vaḥ kuṭumbarūpiṇo bhuvi ||36|| rūpadvayaṃ kurutātra matpratāpena ṣaṭ praṣaṭ | ṣaḍrūpāṇyatra tiṣṭhantu praṣaḍrūpāṇi matsamam ||37|| āyāntu kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre tiṣṭhantu tatra ca | aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthe tiṣṭhantu kanyakāḥ śubhāḥ ||38|| ityuktvā divyarūpaṃ svaṃ tiro’bhāvayadīśapaḥ | bālakṛṣṇasvarūpo’bhūd darśanīyo viśeṣataḥ || 39|| lāvaṇyaparipūrṇaśca sarvasaundaryabhājanaḥ | ākarṣakaśca netrāṇāṃ dṛṣṭeḥ sthairyasya bhūmikā ||2.81.40|| campakābhaḥ kānakābho vahniśuddhāṃśukānvitaḥ | sadratnāñcitabhūṣaśca koṭikandarpasundaraḥ ||41 || navīnabalapūrāḍhyo dhātupūrṇāṅgasudṛḍhaḥ | sarvāṃgaśobhanaścittākarṣakaśca manoharaḥ ||42|| saumyahāsyalasatkāntiḥ premadhārāpradāyakaḥ | snehaśevadhisamprāpyaḥ karuṇāvaruṇālayaḥ ||43 || evaṃ bālasvarūpo’bhūt padmakiñjalkakomalaḥ | puṇḍarīkāyatanetradvayenākarṣayan muhuḥ ||44|| jagāda varadānārthaṃ sarvaṃ kuṭumbameva tat | rājābhūt pūrṇakāmaśca kuṭumbaṃ tuṣṭameva ca ||45|| sākṣāt prāptiḥ prabhorjātā ko’nyo varo’tra śiṣyate | vicāryetthaṃ tu te prāhuryatheṣṭaṃ no niyojaya ||46|| harirhasam̐stadā prāha tisraḥ kanyā nijāśritāḥ | śrīśca kanyā tu yā bhīmānāmnī bhīmāpagāstu sā ||47|| mama tīrthasvarūpātra bhīmāyāṃ vāsametviha | lakṣmīryā kanyakā kṛṣṇānāmnī kṛṣṇāpagāstu sā ||48|| mama tīrthasvarūpātra kṛṣṇāyāṃ vāsametviha | rādhā tu kanyakā tuṃgabhadrākhyā saridastu sā ||49|| mama tīrthasvarūpātra tuṃgabhadrāsvarūpiṇī | evaṃ kanyātrayaṃ tatra nadīṣvevābhavat sthitam ||2.81.50|| lokoddhāravidhānārthaṃ kṛpayā vyadadhattathā | prabhuḥ svayaṃ tīrthakartā svayaṃ tābhiḥ sahāvasat ||51 || bhīmātaṭe haristatra bhīmākṛṣṇo virājate | kṛṣṇātaṭe hariḥ kṛṣṇā nivāsākhyo virājate ||52|| tuṃgabhadrātaṭe tuṃgabhadrānātho virājate | evaṃ tīrthatrayaṃ ramyaṃ kṛtavān bhagavān svayam ||53 || tataḥ prāha ca rājānaṃ tvaṃ tu mahābaleśvaraḥ | mahāviṣṇusvarūpo vai śaṃkareṇa samaṃ sadā ||54|| vasa rājan tīrtharūpo mama tīrthaphalapradaḥ | mahālakṣmyā sahitastvaṃ śīlavatyā tu yoṣitā ||55|| evaṃ tīrthaṃ mahālakṣmīyutaṃ mahābaleśvaram | kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇena vāsaṃ vai datvā tābhyāṃ tadā śubham ||56|| rājā rājñīṃ sthitavantau mahābaleśvare sadā | atha viṣṇuṃ puṇḍakaṃ tu sutaṃ prāha hariḥ svayam ||57|| tvaṃ sadā divyarūpeṇa puṇḍrake nagaraṃ kuru | viśvasthalasvarūpaśca sadā puṇḍrapure vasa ||58|| āśritānāṃ janānāṃ ca muktido bhava sarvadā | evaṃ viṣṇuṃ puṇḍrapure sthātumājñāpya tatparam |||59|| tattattīrthāni saṃsthāpya teṣu teṣu praviśya ca | viśeṣataḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’khileśvaraḥ ||2.81.60|| praṣaḍrūpāṇi divyāni yāni dhṛtāni cājñayā | nītvā divye vimāne sve tatastaṃ tārakaṃ gurum ||61 || āhūya tārakaṃ puṇyaṃ divyāśramaṃ samārpayat| | tvayā satārake puṇye sthātavyaṃ tīrtharūpiṇi ||62|| mama mantraḥ pradātavyaḥ śaraṇāgatadehine | ityuktvā sthāpayāmāsa tārake tārakāyanam ||63|| dvitīyaṃ cāpi tadrūpaṃ nītvā divye vimānake | datvāśiṣo’pi sarvebhyaḥ prasanno bhagavān hariḥ ||64|| kṛtvā tīrthāni saptaiva mūrdhanyāni bhuvastale | snātvā tīrtheṣu tatrāpi tattatsthaleṣu mādhavaḥ ||65|| tīrthottamottamānyeva vyadhāt trailokyanāyakaḥ | divyāni tāni rūpāṇi saptasaṃkhyāni vai yadā ||66|| vimāne śrīharirdivye dadhāra ca tadā surāḥ | brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitarastathā ||67|| sādhyāḥ siddhā vasavaśca īśvarā mānavottamāḥ | āyayustatra sahasā jayaśabdān vyadhurmuhuḥ ||68|| harṣanādān pracakruśca vardhayāmāsurakṣataiḥ | puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ pracakruśca siṣicuścāndanaṃ jalam ||69|| lājābhirvardhayāmāsurharṣayāmāsurīḍanaiḥ | praṇemurmānayāmāsuḥ satkāraṃ cakrurātmabhiḥ ||2.81.70 || arpitairvividhairdravyairdhanyavādān dadustathā | prāhuḥ śrīparamātmānaṃ nātha bhaktasya te kvacit ||71|| nādeyaṃ vidyate te’tra nidarśanaṃ baleśvaraḥ | naitādṛśī parīkṣā tu kartavyānyatra kutracit ||72|| apakvānāṃ vratahantrī bhavet kvaciddhi māyayā | amāyikasya te kṛṣṇa parīkṣaṇaṃ hyamāyikam ||73|| māyālubdhena durdharṣaṃ māyāhīnena pāryate | ityuktvā puṣpahārādyaiḥ pūjayitvā pareśvaram ||74|| sapta tām̐stu mahāmuktān samabhyarcya punastataḥ | adṛśyatāṃ yayurdevāḥ sarve’nye devasārthakāḥ ||75|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vimānamambare | prerayāmāsa tacchīghraṃ cāyayāvāśvasārasam ||76|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre lomaśāśramasannidhau | koṭisūryābhatejovat mūrtyaṣṭakasamujjvalam || 77|| avātatāra ca sāyaṃ bhramitvā daśayojanam | kadambānāṃ vanamadhye udyāne sumanohare ||78|| avateruśca te pṛthvyāṃ narā nāryastadābhitaḥ | darśanārthaṃ dudruvuśca dadṛśuḥ parameśvaram ||79|| saptadivyamahābhāgavatabhaktasamanvitam | vimānaṃ cādṛśyabhāvaṃ prāptaṃ kṣaṇājjanā api ||2.81.80|| jayaśabdām̐stadā cakruḥ praṇemuścāṣṭakaṃ śubham | harirnināya cāvāse mātaraṃ pitaraṃ prati ||8 1 || darśayitvā tataḥ śrīmallomaśaṃ praṇināya ca | aśvapaṭṭasaraḥ paścāttīrthāni praṇināya ca ||82|| kudambāya dadau saudhaṃ sadāvāsāya cottamam | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre tārakāyāśramaṃ dadau ||83 || satkāraṃ bhojanaṃ pānamupaskāraṃ ca vastu ca | apekṣitaṃ dadau sarvaṃ divyaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||84|| hariḥ prāha ca rājānaṃ vrataṃ te kārtikasya vai | sarvaṃ sampūrṇatāṃ prāptaṃ mama yogena sarvathā ||85|| yaśo dānaṃ cānnasatraṃ jalaṃ vastraṃ dhanādikam | japo homo’titheḥ sevā māsaṃ phalāśanādikam ||86|| sarvaṃ mama kṛpāleśāt tava sampūrṇatāṃ gatam | kartavyaṃ nāsti te rājannavaśiṣṭaṃ tathetarat ||87|| atra sevāparo bhūtvā mayyarpaṇaṃ samācara | kārtikānāṃ ca koṭīnāṃ vrataṃ te pūrṇatāṃ gatam ||88|| evamuktavate tasmai śrīkṛṣṇāya parātmane | rājñā kanyātrayaṃ tatrārpitaṃ kāntāya śārṅgiṇe ||89|| āśrame lomaśamuneḥ preṣayāmāsa kanyakāḥ | śrīharistārakaṃ baleśvaraṃ śīlavatīṃ satīm ||2.81.90 || puṇḍrakaṃ ca sutaṃ yatra kārayāmāsa cāplavam | aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva tāni tīrthāni cābhavan ||9 1 || tattannāmnā prasiddhāni divyāni tārakāṇi vai | tataḥ svayaṃ viśaśrāma nijālaye’tikomale ||92|| rātrau nidrāṃ cakārātha prātaścorjāṣṭamīprage | śrīharerjanmadivase pūjāṃ cakāra tārakaḥ ||93|| mahābaleśvaraścāpi kanyātrayaṃ ca kanyakāḥ | ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhā mānavā devatādayaḥ ||94|| īśvarā devikā sarvāḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram | daśame vatsarārambhadivase maṇḍape hariḥ ||95|| niṣasāda mahādivye gajāsane paraḥ pumān | īśapālā lokapālā rājyapālāḥ samāyayuḥ ||96|| pupūjuścātipremṇaiva lomaśo’rcanamācarat | ārārtrikaṃ cakārāthopadā daduḥ surādayaḥ ||97|| bhojayāmāsa ca pitā mātā satkāramācarat | devadevīkuṭumbānāṃ bahumānadhanādibhiḥ ||98|| tataścakre parihāraṃ sāyaṃ cakre mahotsavam | nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ vidyādharyo’nyāḥ kuśalastriyaḥ ||99|| tābhyo dadau pāritoṣikādikaṃ ca pitā svayam | haristvāśīrvādasaukhyaṃ dadau subhojanādikam || 2.81.100 || evamutsavamutkṛṣṭaṃ nirvartya daśavārṣikam | bhojayāmāsa viprādyān kuṃkumavāpikāsthitān || 101 || dadau dānāni ratnānāṃ gavāṃ cārthipratuṣṭaye | evaṃ mahotsavaṃ kṛtvā yayurdevādayo divam || 1 02|| anye lokānnijān sarve yayurgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ | viśaśrāma sukhaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’pi mandire || 1 03|| lomaśaḥ kanyakāyuktaḥ pūjāṃ prāpyāśramaṃ yayau | mahīmānā yayurnaijaṃ deśaṃ śaṃsanta utsavam || 1 04|| atha svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasevārthamutsuko | hemantabhagavantau dvau divyau śrīharipārṣadau || 1 05|| sevāyāṃ dāsavannityaṃ sthitau sarvātmanā prabhoḥ | rājopacārakaiḥ siṣevāte kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam || 1 06|| paṭhanācchravaṇād rādhe’nādikṛṣṇasya ceṣṭitam | bhuktirmuktirbhaved dhrovyā prabhākāntapratāpataḥ || 1 07|| iti śrīlasmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne baleśvararājñaḥ sakuṭumbasya śrīharistutiḥ, dvedhā divyadehādiprāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 81 ||
<2.82> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rādhe pravakṣyāmi pratyakṣapuruṣottamam | viśvāmitreṇa sandiṣṭaṃ jayadhvajāya vai kratau || 1 || candravaṃśo’bhavadrājā sahasrārjunasaṃjñakaḥ | sahasrabāhurdyutimān dhanurvedavidāṃ varaḥ || 2 || tasya sutāḥ pañcaśatānyāsan sarve mahārathāḥ | kṛtāstrā valinaḥ śūrā dharmātmānaḥ surārcakāḥ || 3 || kecid rudraṃ pūjayanti kecit sūryaṃ pare kratum | anye vahniṃ pūjayanti viṣṇumanye satīṃ pare || 4 || ajaṃ cānye gaṇeśaṃ ca pare’rcayanti candrakam | jayadhvajaḥ kaniṣṭhaśca sarvāvaraja eva yaḥ || 5 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmiparo’bhavat | nityaṃ sa matimān devaṃ nārāyaṇahariṃ prabhum || 6 || tiṣṭhate śaraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ daivataṃ brahmataḥ param | tamūcuritare putrāḥ śṛṇu cānuja dhārmikam || 7 || pitāsmākaṃ vahnideva śivaṃ dattamuniṃ tathā | abhajat tān bhajasvātra mā bhajasva narāyaṇam || 8 || jayadhvajo’bravīttām̐stu mama dharmaḥ paro mataḥ | viṣṇoraṃśena saṃbhūtā rājāno’tra mahītale || 9 || rājyapālayitā teṣāṃ bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ | pūjanīyo’jito viṣṇuḥ pālako jagatāṃ hariḥ || 2.82.1 0|| śrīharirhi bhavadbhistu pūjanīyo’pi sarvathā | sṛjed brahmā rajomūrtiḥ saṃharet tāmaso haraḥ || 1 1|| sattvātmā bhagavān viṣṇuḥ sampoṣayati sarvadā | tasmānmahīpatīnāntu rājyaṃ pālayatāmayam || 12|| ārādhyo bhagavān viṣṇurnārāyaṇapareśvaraḥ | sattvena mucyate jantuḥ sattvātmā bhagavān hariḥ || 13|| sattvadharmaḥ sadā śreṣṭho yogibhiśca viniścitaḥ | sarvaśuddhau sattvaśuddhirvaiśāradyaṃ viśadyate || 14|| viṣṇau sā sāttvikī śuddhirvaiśāradyaṃ hi śāśvatam | śaṃbhau vahnau tathā sūryaṃ tamomātrā viśeṣitā || 15|| kratau satyāṃ gaṇeśe’je rajo’dhikaṃ ca candrake | sattvaṃ deveśvare viṣṇau nārāyaṇe viśiṣyate || 16|| sa pūjyaḥ sarvadā yuṣmadbhiścāpi bhrātaraḥ sadā | viṣṇuḥ sampoṣakaḥ śāstā rājadharmo’pi tatra hi || 17|| svadharmo muktaye yukto nānyo rājñāṃ pramuktaye | nārāyaṇīṃ mahāśaktiṃ nṛpāṇāṃ dadhatāṃ sadā || 18|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārādhanamuttamam | śrutvaivaṃ tvagrajāḥ prāhuḥ piturdharmaḥ paro vṛṣaḥ || 19|| pitrā tvārādhito vahniḥ śaṃbhurdattaḥ prabhustathā | ta evārādhane grāhyāḥ pitṛdharmeṇa mokṣaṇam || 2.82.20|| jayadhvajaśca tān prāha yuktamuktaṃ mamāgrajaiḥ | pitṛdharmo rakṣaṇīyo yathāpekṣo ca cādhikaḥ ||21 || parantvatra kratau kārye sarvejyasamavāyake | kaḥ pūjyaśca samārādhya ityatrottaramacyutaḥ ||22|| pramāṇavṛṣayo hyatra yad brūyuste tathaiva tat | athāhūtā ṛṣayaśca vaśiṣṭhādyāḥ prajāvṛṣāḥ || 23|| pṛṣṭhā dharmavivāde tu devārādhanarūpiṇi | kratau vā cānyadā kaścārādhyo devo vadantu naḥ || 24|| tānabruvam̐ste ṛṣayo vaśiṣṭhādyā yathārthataḥ | yā yasyābhimatā puṃsaḥ sā hi tasyaiva devatā ||25|| kintu kāryaviśeṣeṇa pūjyate ceṣṭadāpi ca | devatā bahulāḥ santi brahmaṇaḥ pratimā hi tāḥ || 26|| bhinnārthinaśca vidyante yathārtho devatā tathā | kāryavaśāt kālavaśānniyogācchāsanāttathā || re7|| rājñā kāryavaśāt kvāpi kiṃkaraḥ samupāsyate | kiṃkaraḥ kiṃkaraṃ cāpyupāste kāryavaśādapi || 28|| śreṣṭhāḥ kāryavaśāccāpi kaniṣṭhān samupāsate | bhinnāstu jātayaḥ santi dehasaṃsthānayogataḥ || 29|| yatkāryaṃ jāyate yasmāt tattadarthamapāsyate | śreṣṭhamiṣṭaphalādyarthaṃ khādyaṃ sasyānyupāsate ||2.82.3 0 || rasaprāptyarthamevātha pṛthvīṃ jalaṃ hyupāsate | rasānāṃ pakvatārthaṃ ca sūryaṃ candraṃ hyupāsate || 31 || nṛpāṇāṃ daivataṃ viṣṇustathaiva ca purandaraḥ | viprāṇāmagnirādityo viṣṇubrahmaśivāḥ surāḥ || 32|| devānāṃ daivataṃ viṣṇurdānavānāṃ haraḥ sadā | gandharvāṇāṃ ca yakṣāṇāṃ daivataṃ soma ucyate ||3 2 || vidyādharāṇāṃ vāgdevī siddhānāṃ bhagavān hariḥ | rakṣasāṃ śaṃkaro devaḥ kinnarāṇāṃ tu pārvatī | |368|| ṛṣīṇāṃ daivataṃ brahmā śivaḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ surāḥ | raviragniśca viśve ca devāstathā janārdanaḥ | |35|| strīṇāṃ ca daivataṃ lakṣmīsamā ratiḥ pativratā | patiḥ pareśvaraḥ śaṃbhuḥ saubhāgyaśrīrapīti ca || 26 || gṛhasthānāṃ yathāpekṣaṃ devā devyaśca daivatam | parabrahma svayaṃ devo yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām || 37|| sādhūnāṃ tu kṣamā devī daivataṃ śīlamityapi | bālānāṃ janakau daivaṃ paśūnāṃ pālakaḥ suraḥ ||38|| gaṇānāṃ śaṃkaro daivaṃ bhaktānāṃ parameśvaraḥ | īśvarāṇāṃ vāsudevo vṛkṣāṇāṃ daivataṃ jalam || 39|| sarvoṣāṃ daivataṃ cāntaryāmī śrīparameśvaraḥ | rogiṇāmoṣadhaṃ daivaṃ caurāṇāṃ daṇḍa ityapi ||2.82.40|| evaṃ jaḍaṃ cetanaṃ vā daivaṃ sveṣṭaṃ bhavatyapi | sarvatra vartamānaḥ śrīhariḥ sarvasya daivatam ||41 || ato jayadhvajo nūnaṃ viṣṇavārādhanamarhati | harau rudrasya viṣṇośca tādātmyaṃ brahmaṇo’pi ca ||42|| budhvā hariḥ sadā pūjyaḥ sarveśvareśvareśvaraḥ | tatra sarve’vatārāśca vāsudevādayastathā ||43 || mahāviṣṇuprabhṛtayo vairājā aṃśarūpiṇaḥ | āveśā vā kalāścāpi vibhūtayaḥ surādayaḥ ||44|| samanvayaṃ pragacchanti śrīharau paramātmani | devā devyo guruḥ santo viprā gāvaḥ pativratāḥ ||45|| ityuktvā ṛṣayaḥ sarve kratuṃ tasya hi cakrire | vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo yajñaḥ saptāhakṛtasatkriyaḥ ||46|| yatreśvarāḥ samastāśca ṛṣayo devatāstathā | samastāḥ svarganilayā grahamānavabhūsurāḥ ||47|| bubhujurbahupakvānnapāyasānnāni sarvathā | tṛptiṃ prāpuḥ parāṃ somāmṛtabhojanapānakaiḥ ||48|| vahnayo marutaḥ sarve tatra yajñe’tibhāvataḥ | bubhujurdattahavyādi trailokyaṃ tṛptimāvahat ||49|| bubhuje divyamūrtiśca sākṣād vahnau samutthitaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||2.82.50 || evaṃ yajñe suniṣpanne dakṣiṇādānakarmaṇi | śeṣe ca havane cāpi sampanne’vabhṛthāplave ||21|| bhojanaṃ cakrire sarve paṃktiśo bhūsurādayaḥ | tāvattatra samāyāto videho nāma rākṣasaḥ ||52|| daṃṣṭrākarālo dīptākṣaḥ śūlabhṛnnādayan diśaḥ | taṃ dṛṣṭvā dudruvurmartyā bhayenāraṇyakaṃ prati ||53 || athārjunasya satputrāḥ sarve yattā mahābalāḥ | yuyudhurdānavaṃ śaktigirikūṭāsimudgaraiḥ ||54|| prājāpatyaṃ vāruṇaṃ ca raudraṃ vāyavyamastrakam | kauberamaindramāgneyaṃ cikṣipustatra bhūmipāḥ ||55|| dānavaḥ śūlamādāya sūryābhaṃ parito bhraman | bhrāmayan bhañjayāmāsa tānyastrāṇi samantataḥ ||56|| śūlasthavahninā tānyākarṣayāmāsa sarvathā | tato bhūpā gadābhistaṃ tāḍayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ ||57|| spṛṣṭamātrā gadāḥ sarvā bhagnā loṣṭādrivarṣmaṇi | na dānavaṃ cālayituṃ śekurgadābhirīśvarāḥ ||58||| tataste bhayamāpannā dudruvurvīkṣya pauruṣam | bhagnotsāhāḥ samabhavan dṛṣṭvā tasyātipauruṣam ||59|| atha pañcaśatānāṃ tu kumārāṇāṃ palāyanam | vīkṣya sasmāra ca jayadhvajo nārāyaṇaṃ harim ||2.82.60|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipumuttamam | dhyātvā kṣaṇaṃ jajāpainaṃ rakṣa rakṣa pumuttama ||61 || śaraṇāgatarakṣa tvaṃ samāyāhi pareśvara | evaṃ vai smaryamāṇaḥ sa bhagavān śrīhariḥ svayam ||62|| tūrṇaṃ tatrāyayau cakraśaṃkhapadmagadāyudhaḥ | viṣṇurjayiṣṇurlokādiścāprameyo nirāmayaḥ ||63|| bhaktatrātā śrīhariryaḥ pūrvapūruṣa uttamaḥ | dadau jayadhvajāyaiva cakraṃ svasya sudarśanam ||64|| jagrāha śrīhariṃ natvā rājā haste sudarśanam | prāhiṇottu videhāya rākṣase skandhayostadā ||65|| tūrṇaṃ tanmastakaṃ skandhāt pātayāmāsa bhūtale | rākṣaso vihatastatra śailatulyaśarīravān || 66|| iti jñātvā ṛṣirviśvāmitro draṣṭuṃ samāyayau | bhrātaraśca prasannāstaṃ praśaśaṃsurjayadhvajam ||67|| viśvāmitrāya munaye daduścottamamāsanam | niṣasāda munistatra kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭhavāṃstataḥ ||58|| jayadhvajo muniṃ prāha prasādād bhavato’suraḥ | nipātito’tra cakreṇa videho dānavo mahān ||69|| tvadvākyānnityadā cāhamabhajaṃ śrīnarāyaṇam | nyapataṃ śaraṇaṃ tasya prasādastena me kṛtaḥ ||2.82.70|| yakṣyāmi rākṣasahatyāpāpanāśārthamityataḥ | kathaṃ kena vidhānena sampūjyo harirīśvaraḥ ||71 || ko’yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ pūjyaḥ kimprabhāvaḥ kratāviha | sarvametat samācakṣva prasādayāmi taṃ prabhum ||72|| jayadhvajasya vacanaṃ śrutvā manirjagāda tam | parameśasya bhaktāgryaṃ prapannaṃ ca jayadhvajam ||73 || yataḥ pravṛttirbhūtānāṃ yasmin sarvaṃ yato jagat | tamanādiṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ yaja pareśvaram ||74|| yamakṣarātparatarātparaṃ prāhurguhāśrayam | ānandaṃ paramaṃ vyoma pare dhāmni sthitaṃ prabhum ||75|| parātparaḥ parabrahma paranārāyaṇātparaḥ || akṣarādhipatirmuktiprado muktapatirhi saḥ ||76|| avatārasahastrāṇāṃ heturyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | caturvyūhadharaścāpi cāvyūhaśca nirañjanaḥ ||77|| paramātmā paraṃdhāma paraṃvyoma paraṃpadam | tripādamakṣaraṃbrahma yasyāhurbrahmavādinaḥ ||78|| vāsudeveśvaro yogisiddhaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | yasyāṃśasaṃbhavā īśā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ||79|| vairājaśca mahāviṣṇurbhūmā kālo yadaṃśajāḥ | pradhānasya patirmāyāpatiryaḥ puruṣo’pi ca ||2.82.80 || mahāpūruṣa ityeṣo yasyāṃśo vidyate tathā | sarveṣāṃ ca bhagavatāṃ yaḥ paro bhagavān svayam ||8 1 || niṣkāminyā prapattyā sa cārādhyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | yajñaṃ taṃ tu punā rājan prasādaya pareśvaram ||82|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ | rājñā kratuḥ samārabdhastatra nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||83|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇadevaṃ viśvāmitraḥ sabhūsuraḥ | yājayāmāsa sarveśaṃ parameśaṃ parātparam ||84|| yajñe samāptimāpanne tatra sākṣāt svayaṃ hariḥ | āvirāsīt sa bhagavān punaḥ punarhavirgrasan ||85|| varaṃ vṛṇu kṣiternātha yatte manasi vartate | ityevaṃ ca hariḥ prāha rājovāca padaṃ tava ||86|| śāśvataṃ paramaṃ dhāmaṃ divyaṃ naya dayādhara | hariḥ prāha samīcīnaṃ cārthitaṃ te tathāstu vai ||87|| ityuktvādṛśyatāṃ yātastāvattatra catuṣṭayam | tāpasānāṃ samāyātaṃ bhikṣāṃ dehīti vādi ca ||88|| rājā bhikṣāṃ dadau tebhyo bhojanaṃ pāyasodbhavam | jagṛhuste ca bubhujuḥ rājā sa dakṣiṇāṃ dadau ||89|| kṛṣṇavarṇāstu te rūkṣā bhikṣavo romaśāstadā | kāmarūpadharāścāsan vanecarāḥ kurūpiṇaḥ ||2.82.90|| bhuktvā jalaṃ papuścātha niṣedurvṛkṣamāśritāḥ | yathā mūḍhā hi catvāraḥ śāntāḥ śāntaghanā iva ||91|| yajñakārye sunirvṛtte’vabhṛthasnānahetave | narmadāyāṃ yayuḥ sarve catvāro’pi yayuḥ saha ||92|| snātāḥ sarve’pi ṛṣayo devā bhaktāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ | mahīmānā mānavāśca viprāḥ satyaśca sādhavaḥ || 13|| nimnabhāge tu catvāraḥ snātāste kṛṣṇavarṇakāḥ | snānapuṇyapratāpena jātāste śvetavarṇakāḥ ||94|| sūryacandrasamābhāśca mahendrasamarūpiṇaḥ | viṣṇutulyasuvarṣmāṇo divyāḥ svargasurā iva ||95||| tān dṛṣṭvāvabhṛthasnātāḥ papracchustān kulaṃ prati | te prāhuḥ svasvanāmāni śrīśailaḥ prathamo hyayam || 96|| nīlagirirdvitīyo’yam elādriśca tṛtīyakaḥ | droṇācalaścaturtho’yaṃ vayaṃ merukulodbhavāḥ || 97|| kāmarūpadharāḥ śailāḥ smo’tra snātuṃ samicchavaḥ | pāpakṣālanakāmāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ smaḥ sthirādrayaḥ ||98|| asmāsu hiṃsakāḥ sarve’raṇyeṣu ca guhāsu ca | kurvanti yāni pāpāni tairthikā api vāsinaḥ || 99|| teṣāṃ pāpāni datvā naḥ śuddhāste vai prayānti hi | taiḥ pāpaiḥ kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ smo jātāḥ snānena cārjunāḥ || 2.82.100 || atrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam | āyayau yajñabhāgārthaṃ snānārthaṃ cāpi tena tu || 101 || vaiṣṇavānāṃ prasādena pāpaṃ naṣṭaṃ samastakam | atha śailā gamiṣyāmo nijāvāsān namo’stu vaḥ || 1 02|| yatra śrībhagavān sākṣāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | tasya bhaktā jale sasnustīrthaṃ caitaddhi nārmadam || 103 || jayadhvajaśca tān prāha kariṣye’tithisatkriyām | mama gṛhe’tra vāsaṃ vai prakurvantu nagottamāḥ || 1 04|| ityuktvā rādhike śailān svarṇavarṇasamān nṛpaḥ | avabhṛthānte nilayaṃ nināya bahubhāvataḥ || 1 05|| anye sarve mahīmānā bhuktvā samprāpya pūjanam | yayurnaijān gṛhān lokān viśaśrāma jayadhvajaḥ || 1 06|| prajā bhuktvānāthadīnāḥ kiṃkarā dāsadāsikāḥ | tutuṣuścātibhojyena kīṭāḥ pipīlikādayaḥ || 1 07|| enaṃ saśṛṇuyādbhaktyā pāṭhayecca paṭhecca vā | bhuktirmuktirbhavettasya nārāyaṇakṛpābalāt || 1 08|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne jayadhvajasya rājño viśvāmitropadiṣṭaparabrahmopāsanābalād yajñe śrīhariprāptiḥ, videharākṣasavināśaḥ, catuḥparvatānāmavabhṛthasnānādi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 82 ||
<2.83> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca evaṃ rādhe nṛpatiḥ sa jayadhvajaḥ suvaiṣṇavaḥ | droṇailānīlaśrīśailān caturo’pi nijālaye || 1 || susatkṛtyāsanādyaiḥ saṃcakāra svāgataṃ param | dadau bhojyāni ramyāṇi peyānyebhyo vidhānyapi || 2 || bhogyāni copakaraṇaprāsādikajalāni ca | śrīhareḥ pūjanavastūnyapi dadau jayadhvajaḥ || 3 || parvatāste kṛtakṛtyāḥ papracchustaṃ jayadhvajam | kathaṃ pāpāni naśyanti tīryate prakṛtiḥ katham || 4 || kathaṃ pāpyabhiyoge’pi nirlepatvaṃ bhavet sadā | keṣāṃ samāgamānmuktiḥ kasmācchāntiśca śāśvatī || 5 || kaḥ svārthaḥ kaḥ parārthaśca kā pravṛttiḥ śubhāvahā | jaḍatā divyatā vāpi prāpyate kena karmaṇā || 6 || bhavānāste mahārāja sarvajña iva bhaktarāṭ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇānugrahaleśataḥ || 7 || tasmānno vada paramaṃ śreyo yenāpi labhyate | śrutvā jayadhvajaḥ prāha mamāraṇye maharṣayaḥ || 8 || vasanti bahavo divyā ye vijñānasamṛddhayaḥ | teṣāṃ nityaṃ darśanārthaṃ prayāmi jñānalabdhaye || 9 || tebhyaḥ śrutaṃ mayā yadyat kathāprasaṃgalābhataḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāśrave’pi ca | | 10 || ātmanāpyanubhūtaṃ ca kathayāmi nibodhata | tīrthe pāpāni naśyanti tīrthaṃ sthiraṃ ca jaṅgamam || 11 || tārayitvā vāsanākhyasāgarāt śaraṇāgatam | prasthāpayati dhāmāpi paramaṃ pārameśvaram || 1 2 || tīrthaṃ tat sarvathā bodhyaṃ jaḍaṃ vā cetanātmakam | jaḍaṃ jalāni caityāni vastūni bhautikāni ca || 13 || nirguṇāni ca divyāni divyayogādbhavanti hi | pāpinastārayantyeva tīrthāni tāni sarvathā || 14|| ātmā tīrthaṃ mahat proktaṃ kṛṣṇastīrthottamottamam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastīrthaṃ parottamam || 15|| tasya tīrthasya yogena bhaktāstīrthasvarūpiṇaḥ | bhavanti tārakāḥ sarve santaḥ sādhvyaśca yoginaḥ || 1 6|| brahmaśīlā gṛhaśīlā vanaśīlā virāgiṇaḥ | nyāsaśīlā dhyānaśīlāḥ kṛṣṇatīrthā hi te matāḥ || 17 || kṛṣṇadāsyaḥ kṛṣṇabhaktāstathā kṛṣṇasya pārṣadāḥ | kṛṣṇasambandhamāptāśca tīrthā jaḍāśca cetanāḥ || 18 || kṛṣṇaguṇāḍhyapuruṣaḥ satī kṛṣṇakṛpāmayī | paśuḥ pakṣī vṛkṣalatāḥ kṛṣṇayogā hi tārakā || 1 9|| vāṭikā grāmaśālāśca dharmaśālāḥ sarittaṭāḥ | sarastaṭā vanasthalyaḥ śailāḥ araṇyabhūmayaḥ || 2.83.20 || sthāvarā jaṃgamāścāpi tīrthāste kṛṣṇayoginaḥ | grāmaḥ purī pattanaṃ ca nagaraṃ ghoṣa ityapi || 21 || pallyaścāvasathāścāpi yatra kṛṣṇo virājate | tat sarvaṃ tīrthameveti tārakaṃ divyatāṃ gatam || 22|| yatspṛṣṭaṃ hariṇā sākṣāt tat tīrthaṃ tārakaṃ bhavet | yathā haristathā tasya santastīrthāni santi hi || 23 || santārayanti satataṃ janān jñānapradānakaiḥ | ajñāna nāśayitvā ca samarpayanti divyatām || 24|| kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca madaṃ mānaṃ ca matsaram | tṛṣṇāṃ ca vāsanāṃ nāśayitvā kurvanti śodhanam | | 25 || tadyogāttīryate māyā satsu nauṣu sthitairjanaiḥ | santo bhavanti cakṣūṃṣi santo dīpā bhavanti ca || 26 || santo naukāścārṇavasthā dāvasthā amṛtasthalāḥ | viṣolbaṇeṣu vai santo viṣaghnāḥ kṣveḍahāriṇaḥ ||27|| hālāhalābdhisaṃsāre nīlakaṇṭhā hi sādhavaḥ | mahārogābdhisaṃsāre dhanvantarisvarūpiṇaḥ ||28|| viṣayānaladagdhānāṃ santo mānasavṛṣṭayaḥ | vāsanājālabaddhānāṃ kartanīrūpiṇo hi te || 29|| santastīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ paramātmavinirmitam | yatra nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣānmūrtimān vartate sadā || 2.83.30|| haryarthaṃ yaiśca gārhasthyaṃ tyaktaṃ tyaktaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ | bandhanaṃ śrīharau baddhāstīrtharūpā hi sādhavaḥ || 31 || haristīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrtha tīrthaṃ tatsādhavastataḥ | sādhvyastīrthaṃ sādhuvacca taranti pāpinaśca taiḥ ||32|| etattrayaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ caturthaṃ vipramaṇḍalam | gurustīrthaṃ sarvatīrthottamaṃ mokṣapradaṃ sadā || 33|| mātā tīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ pitā patistathā | satī tīrthaṃ dharmatīrthaṃ tīrthāstu dhārmikā janāḥ ||34|| putrastīrthaṃ dharmavacca kanyā tīrthaṃ vṛṣānvitā | svasā tīrthaṃ dharmayuktā patnī tīrthaṃ satī yadi ||35|| kuṭumbaṃ dhārmikaṃ tīrthaṃ tārayet tīrthamuttamam | devastīrthaṃ mandiraṃ ca tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ kathāmṛtam || 36|| vṛddhānāṃ vacanaṃ tīrthaṃ śāstraṃ tīrthaṃ ca śāśvatam | godānaṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ svarṇānnadānakam ||37|| satyaṃ tīrthaṃ kṣamā tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ rāgavihīnatā | dveṣarāhityamevāpi tīrthaṃ nairmalyakārakam ||38|| kṛṣṇasevā paraṃ tīrthaṃ bhaktistīrthaṃ tathottamam | kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ tu tīrthānāmuttamaṃ tīrthamucyate ||39|| dīkṣā bhikṣā samīkṣā ca tīrthatrayaṃ vivekataḥ | evaṃ śailāstu tīrthāni hareryogād bhavanti vai ||2.83.40|| kiṃ bahunātra vacasā santastīrthāni sarvathā | sarvapradāste jīvānāṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣiṇām ||41 || satāṃ śaraṇamāpannastaratyeva na saṃśayaḥ | kāṣṭhādhāraṃ samāpannastaratyeva jalārṇavam ||42|| kāṣṭhe laghutvamevāsti satsu harirvasatyapi | yatra haristatra sarvaṃ yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ bhavet ||43|| kalpavallī satāṃ haste cintāmaṇiḥ satāṃ mukhe | kalpavṛkṣaḥ saddhṛdaye kāmadhenuḥ satāṃ matau ||44|| aṇimādyāḥ siddhayastu luṭhanti pādayoḥ satām | aiśvaryāṇi satāmoṣṭhe vasanti sukhadāni vai ||45|| pāvitryaṃ tu satāṃ dṛṣṭau vākye dharmo vasatyapi | muktiṃ satāṃ tu sevāyāṃ vartate śaraṇaṃ gatā ||46|| prakṛtiḥ procyate māyābhyāso viṣayavastuṣu | saṃskāraḥ sthitisaṃstho’yaṃ kṛṣṇābhyāsena jīryati ||47|| kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti nārāyaṇeti sarvadā | raṭaṇena hi saṃskārā bhāvanākhyā bhavanti vai ||48 || kṛṣṇayogena divyāste nāśayanti tu māyikān | prākṛtān nāśayitvaiva śodhayanti hṛdantaram ||49|| sā māyā bhramarūpā vāvidyāhaṃmamatātmikā | rāgadveṣātmikā vāpi saṃśayo vā mṛṣātmikā ||2.83.50 || yāthārthyena vidhānena layaṃ yāti harerbalāt | āmṛtyukṣaṇamāsādya kṛṣṇe matirna ced bhavet ||51|| yatra nāryāṃ nare putre dravye’nyatra matirbhavet | sā māyā bandhakartryeva kṛṣṇasmṛtyā vinaśyati ||52|| evaṃ śailāḥ saṃśṛṇvantu kṛṣṇayogo hi tārakaḥ | satāṃ yogastārako’pi māyā tena nivartate ||53|| yathā lauhaṃ kāṣṭhayoge taratyeva jalopari | tathā pāpī satāṃ yoge taratyeva bhavopari ||54|| yathā padmaṃ svabhāvācca jale’pi nahi lipyate | tathā jñānī bhaktiyuktaḥ pāpe’pi nahi lipyate ||55|| yathā tailaṃ jalamadhye kṣiptaṃ tarati mūrdhani | tathā jñānī pāpimadhye sthitastarati pāpataḥ ||56|| jñānaṃ dahati karmāṇi bhaktiḥ karmaphalāni ca | dahatyevaṃ dvayaṃ cānyat kṛṣṇetarat kṛtaṃ tu yat ||57|| ātmā yena dhṛtaḥ kṛṣṇe nārāyaṇe parātmani | sa cātmā vartate cāntaḥkaraṇebhyo viyogavān ||58|| āntaraṃ karaṇaṃ tena bhinnaṃ prayatnamantarā | nendriyairśayate śaktiśūnyaṃ rūkṣaṃ patiṃ vinā ||59||| nendriyāṇi tato yānti viṣayān kṛṣṇavarjitān | viṣayeṣu gata pāpaṃ nopasaṃkrāmati hyataḥ ||2.83.60 || indriyāṇyaviṣayāṇi yadā bhavanti yoginaḥ | mānasaṃ cāviṣayaṃ ca jāyate sarvadāsya tu ||61 || ātmā viṣayaśūnyaśca kṛṣṇamātreṇa saṃmataḥ | bhavatyeva tadā pāpānnivṛtto mokṣago yathā ||62|| evaṃ bhūtvā śarīraṃ cendriyāṇyasya karoti cet | kriyāṃ yāṃ kāṃ, na caiṣā syād bandhanāya tu yoginaḥ ||63|| vidhikriyāthavā vidhivivarjitāpi kāpi vā | loke matāthavā naiva matā lokavivarjitā ||64|| vivekena kṛtā vā na kṛtā vivekavarjitā | pāpā vā pāpaśūnyā vā lokadṛṣṭyā tu yādṛśī ||65|| yādṛśī tādṛśī vāpi kriyā yā syāttu yoginaḥ | nisargajā na sā tasya bandhanāya prajāyate ||66|| yasya nāsti sukhe rāgo na dveṣo duḥkhavastuṣu | harṣāharṣarahitātmā na sa pāpena lipyate ||67|| yasya nāsti sukhaṃ me syād duḥkhaṃ mā syāditi pradhīḥ | īhāśūnyasya kartavyaṃ nirīhaṃ nahi lumpati ||68|| iṣṭaṃ tathāpyaniṣṭaṃ ca tyaktaṃ yenātmataḥ sadā | guṇatrayābhibhavanaṃ tasya naiva hi jāyate ||69|| sarvaṃ kṛṣṇātmakaṃ yasya bhogyaṃ bhogaśca bhoktṛtā | kriyākṛṣṇārpitā yena dehendriyatadīyajā ||2.83.70 || tatpāpaṃ tasya puṇyaṃ vā phalaṃ kṛṣṇārpitaṃ tathā | sa tu sarveṣu lipto’pi lipyate na manāgapi ||7 1 || evaṃ vai vartamānasya kṛṣṇārthakṛtakarmaṇaḥ | prasādhitaprasādhyasya sadā sādhusvabhāvinaḥ ||72||| nirlepasya prasaṃgena muktiḥ syād bandhanāśinī | bandho vai vāsanā proktā cāhaṃmamatvakāritā ||73 || mithyājñānajaniryā ca vāsanā jaḍatātmikā | sa saṃsāro bandhanaṃ vai kṛṣṇayogena naśyati ||74|| satāṃ kṛṣṇasvabhāvānāṃ samāgamena naśyati | tato muktirjīvato vai bhūtabandhanavarjitā ||75|| nirdvandvā ca nirīhā ca vitṛṣṇā rāgavarjitā | sthitirnityātmasaṃsthā ca nityānandapariplutā ||76 || sadā śāntasya kṛṣṇasya yogena śāntiracyute | ātmanā cātmani dhrauvyā yā śāśvatyanubhūyate ||77|| sā śāntiḥ śāśvatī kṛṣṇāt parameśāt prajāyate | iyaṃ muktiḥ parā muktiryataḥ śāntirna vai parā ||78|| asaṃkhyānandasandohe magnatā paramātmani | sa svārthasvātmano hyarthaḥ paraṃ prayojanaṃ hi tat ||79|| mokṣo’rtho jīvalokasya mumukṣoḥ svārtha eva ha | jñāto’rthaḥ svātmani precchet svārthaḥ sa cātra mokṣaṇam ||2.83.80 || kṣaṇikaḥ sukhadaḥ svārtho nāpekṣyo vai mumukṣubhiḥ | śāśvatānandabhṛtsvārthaḥ samapekṣyo mumukṣubhiḥ ||81 || evaṃ svārthaṃ pralakṣyaiva pravṛttiḥ śubhadāyinī | śubhaṃ puṇyaṃ svargalokaḥ satyamaiśvaradhiṣṇyakam ||82|| vināśayogi tat proktaṃ prakṛteḥ kṛtasarjane | avināśaṃ śubhaṃ mokṣaḥ kṛṣṇapādābhilaṃbhanam ||83|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptiḥ śubhaṃ sarvottamottamam | kṛṣṇo divyaḥ sadā cāste yādṛśastādṛśo’pi vā ||84|| tādātmyakarmabhirdivyabhāvaṃ vindati mānavaḥ | śarīrendriyakarmāṇi jaḍānyapi harergrahāt ||85|| bhavanti divyabhāvāni jaḍatā yāti divyatām | evaṃ śailā bhavanto’pi jaḍā bhaktiprayogataḥ ||86|| jāḍyaṃ bhāvaṃ parityajya bhavantu divyarūpiṇaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipatiprabhuḥ ||87|| vartate kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre cāśvasarontike | tadyogaṃ tadbhajanaṃ ca kurvantu tena divyatām ||88|| prayāsyathaiva śīghraṃ ca nārāyaṇakṛpāvaśāt | ityevaṃ procyamāneṣu jayadhvajena cādriṣu ||89|| catvāraḥ puruṣāścānye śāntāstatra samāyayuḥ | jayadhvajādikān natvā tasthuḥ pṛṣṭhāstato hi te ||2.83.90 || kuta āgamyate kutra gamyate kiṃ prayojanam | te procustaṃ vinatāśca vayaṃ śrutvā tava kratum ||91|| āgatā harṣataścātra gacchāmo’śvasarovaram | snātuṃ draṣṭuṃ pareśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||92|| yātrikaiḥ sampradattāni pāpānyasaṃkhyakāni tu | kṣālayituṃ pragacchāmaḥ kuṃkumavāpikāsthalīm ||93|| kolārasara evāyaṃ nāmnā khyāto’sti tīrtharāṭ | dvitīyo vartate nāmnā hyayaṃ cilasarovaraḥ ||94|| tṛtīyaḥ śaṃbhalasaro’bhidho’yaṃ tīrtharājakaḥ | caturtho’haṃ pumānasmi nārāyaṇasarovaraḥ ||95|| vayaṃ tvadya militvā tu yātā abhūma mānasam | saro divyaṃ haimaśaile darśanārthaṃ tataḥ punaḥ ||96|| śrutvā cātra samāyātā yajñaṃ te’tha tato vayam | gacchāmastatra yatraiva parameśo virājate ||97|| etacchrutvā ca te śailā jayadhvajo’pi bhūpatiḥ | vyomnā kuṭumbasahitaḥ sarve yayurhareḥ purīm ||98|| kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram | vyomnā te cāvateruśca sasnuścāśvasarovare ||99|| tato divyasvarūpāśca dṛṣṭvā śrīlomaśaṃ munim | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 2.83.100|| gṛhītvā paramaṃ mantraṃ bālakṛṣṇāntikaṃ yayuḥ | sampūjya vidhivat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ ca te tataḥ || 101 || pītvāmṛtaṃ caraṇayorniṣeduḥ satkṛtāḥ puraḥ | prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ dehi mokṣaṃ paraṃ padam || 1 02|| śrīhariḥ kṛpayā tām̐śca trirūpān saṃvyadhāpayat | tīrthabhaktamuktarūpān tīrthānyapreṣayattadā || 1 03|| naijaṃ naijaṃ nivāsaṃ ca pāvanārthaṃ hi dehinām | bhaktarūpām̐statra cāśvasarasyeva nyavāsayat || 1 04|| nijāśraye mahābhaktān saṃvidhāyaiva sevakān | tata ārabhya tattīrthe tīrthāṣṭakaṃ tato’vasat || 105|| kolāṭatīrthaṃ ca tathā cilatīrthaṃ tathottamam | tathā śaṃbhalatīrthaṃ ca nārāyaṇasarastathā || 1 06|| droṇatīrthaṃ nīlatīrthaṃ śrītīrthaṃ cailatīrthakam | divyarūpā virājante śrīkṛṣṇapādapaṃkaje || 1 07|| muktarūpān vimānenākṣaraṃ cāpreṣayat prabhuḥ | dhāma muktanivāsākhyaṃ rādhike karuṇānidhiḥ || 1 08|| ityevaṃ taccamatkāraṃ dṛṣṭvā jayadhvajo’pi ca | sthitvā māsaṃ mārgaśīrṣaṃ yayāce mokṣaṇaṃ hareḥ || 1 09|| cakre tasya harirmuktiṃ vimānena yayau sa tu | dhāmākṣaraṃ padaṃ divyaṃ śāśvatānandapūritam || 2.83.110 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne jayadhvajena pradattaṃ jñānaṃ, droṇailanīlaśrīparvatānāṃ kolāṭacilaśaṃbhalanārāyaṇasarasāṃ divyarūpatā mokṣaṇaṃ jayadhvajasya muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||83||
<2.84> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike camatkṛtiṃ nārāyaṇasya ca | brahmaputrapulastyasya bhāryāyā bhaktigocarām || 1 || pulastyasya priyā bhāryā tṛṇabindoḥ sutā śubhā | ailavilābhavannāmnā tasyāṃ vai viśravāḥ sutaḥ || 2 || abhavad bahuśāstrāṇāṃ jñātā dharmaparāyaṇaḥ | pulastyaṃ tvekadā cailavilāpṛcchad vṛṣān prati || 3 || yugadharmāḥ purā cāsan kīdṛśā vada me pate | pulastyastu tataḥ prāha sarvān saṃkṣepato vṛṣān || 4 || kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaśca kaliśceti caturyugam | dhyānaṃ tapaḥ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ jñānamadhvaraḥ || 5 || dvāpare yajña eveti dānamekaṃ kalau yuge | brahmā kṛtayuge devaḥ sarvatra gatimānabhūt || 6 || tretāyāṃ gatimān sūryaścābhavanmelanakṣamaḥ | dvāpare daivataṃ viṣṇuḥ sākṣācca gatimānabhūt || 7 || kalau kālasvarūpaśca devo rudraḥ pravartate | yatra tatra mahān kleśaḥ kalau vināśako yataḥ || 8 || kṛte tu samasaṃkhyākāḥ kanyāścātha kumārakāḥ | āsan samānayugalā vṛttisteṣāmalolupā || 9 ||| prajāstṛptāḥ sadā sarvāḥ sarvānandāḥ sukhāśrayāḥ | uttamādhamatā nāsti nirviśeṣāḥ purandhrikāḥ || 10 || tulyamāyuḥ sukhaṃ rūpaṃ balaṃ tuṣṭiḥ sthirā matiḥ | viśokā jñānabahulā ekāntabahulāstathā || 11 || dhyānaniṣṭhāstaponiṣṭhāḥ parabrahmaparāyaṇāḥ | sadā niṣkāmacāriṇyo nityaṃ muditamānasāḥ || 1 2|| parvatodadhivāsinyo hyaniketāḥ kṣitiśrayāḥ | saṃkalpajanyabhojyāśca saṃkalpotthajalādanāḥ || 1 3|| saṃkalpajanyasurasāḥ sadā śāntā yatheśvarāḥ | sarvamāsāmātmalabhyaṃ tadāsīd brahmasātkṛtam || 14|| rasollāsāḥ sadā hyāsan kṛtakṛtyāḥ kṛte yuge | catuḥsahasravarṣāṇāṃ vigame sandhirāgataḥ || 15|| aṣṭaśatābdastatraiva rasollāso na vegavān | rāgaścāpi vilāsaśca samudbhavati vai śanaiḥ || 16|| satyasiddhau prakṣīṇāyāmanyā siddhiḥ pravartate | apāṃ saukhye hirīsamāpte tadā meṣātmanāmbarāt || 17|| meghebhyaḥ stanayitnubhyaḥ pravṛttaṃ vṛṣṭisarjanam | sakṛdeva tayā vṛṣṭyā saṃpṛkto pṛthivītale || 18|| jalaṃ dvādaśamāsāṃśca vartate sma sthalabhṛtam | tatra vṛkṣā vallikāśca prādurāsan rasabhṛtāḥ || 19|| sarve pratyupabhogāśca tadā tebhyo bhavanti vai | vartayanti sma kalpākhyavṛkṣādibhyastadā prajāḥ ||2.84.20|| vṛkṣāstadā prajānāṃ ca nivāsāḥ ketanāni ca | āsan bhittivihīnāni sarvāṇyapi gṛhāṇyapi ||2 1 || vṛkṣāśritāḥ prajāḥ sarvā rāgalobhādidharṣitāḥ | svakīyatve ca pārakye vivādamāśrayan kvacit || 22|| rāgalobhodbhavaḥ kleśastadā sthānamavāptavān | tena daivāstu te kalpadrumā nāśamatho gatāḥ ||23 || tatasteṣu praṇaṣṭeṣu vibhrāntāḥ śokitāḥ prajāḥ | kalpadrumān balahīnān sevājanyaphalapradān ||24|| avāpuḥ pṛthivītastā bījādyudbhavagocarān | vastrāṇi valkalākhyāni phalāni bhojanāni ca ||25|| puṣpāṇi tvābharaṇāni prasūyante sma yatnataḥ | teṣveva jāyate tāsāṃ gṛdhno raso’tha bhojanam ||26|| amākṣikaṃ mahāvīryaṃ puṭake puṭake madhu | phalebhyaḥ prasravantyeva rasā miṣṭāśca dhārayā || 27|| taiḥ prajā vartayanti sma duṣṭāstuṣṭā gatajvarāḥ | atha tretottare kāle prajā lobhāvṛtāstadā || 28|| viśeṣataḥ samabhavan balāt kṛtvā nijān drumān | paryagṛhṇanta ca madhu mākṣikaṃ ca phalādikam || 29|| evaṃ kleśo nirbalānāṃ madhulābhe vinābhavat | vṛkṣā vilokya tu pakṣapātaṃ prajākṛtaṃ tadā || 2.84.30 || praṇaṣṭā madhunā sārdhaṃ bījodbhavā api drumāḥ | tadā śītātapavarṣābhiḥ pīḍā jāyate nṛṣu || 31 || dvandvaiḥ sampīḍyamānāstu cakrurāvaraṇāni hi | gṛhabhittīḥ parṇakuṭīrvārtopāyānacintayan || 32 || vṛṣṭijanyajalānyeva nimnagāni tu yatra ca | srotaḥsthāneṣu tiṣṭhanti garteṣu ca saraḥsu ca || 33 || tatra vāsān pracakruśca vṛkṣasasyādijīvikāḥ | apāṃ bhūmeśca saṃyogādoṣadhayastadābhavan || 34|| akṛṣṭapacyā api tāścānuptāśca kvacit kvacit | kvaciduptāśca sakaṇāḥ saphalāśca tadābhavan || 35|| ṛtupuṣpaphalāstatra vṛkṣagulmāśca jajñire | tretānte rāgalobhāḍhyāścāhaṃmamatvasaṃbhṛtāḥ || 36|| avaśyaṃbhāvitārthena prajāścāsan sakalmaṣāḥ | prasahya sattayā paryagṛhṇanta sasyavāṭikāḥ || 37 || vṛkṣagulmauṣadhīścāpi prasahya tu yathābalam | naijām̐ścakruḥ prajā rāgānnadīkṣetrāṇi parvatān || 38|| tatrāpi prabalā jātāḥ kṣatriyā rakṣakāḥ purā | brahmaṇā vai niyuktāste dīnarakṣākriyādiṣu || 39 || varṇāśramavyavasthāṃ ca tretāyāṃ kṛtavānajaḥ | maryādāyāḥ pratiṣṭhārthaṃ daṇḍaṃ tadā samasṛjat ||2.84.40 || yajñapravartanaṃ cāpi paśuhiṃsāvivarjanam | tretānte tāṃ vyavasthāṃ ca brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyānvitāḥ ||4 1 || samarakṣan yathāyogyāṃ materbhedastato’bhavat | rāgo lobhaḥ pakṣapāto yuddhaṃ sampadviluṇṭhanam |||42|| dvāpare tvāgate sarvaṃ prāvartata prajāsu vai | nagarāṇi ca rājyāni sīmakṣetrāṇi vāṭikāḥ ||43 || kṛṣṭapacyāḥ kaṇāścāpi prāvartanta tadā priye | avṛṣṭirmaraṇaṃ caiva tathaiva vyādhyupadravāḥ ||44|| vāṅmanaḥkāyajāḥ kleśā abhavam̐śca gṛhe gṛhe | prajāśca mithunotpādyāstretārdhottarakālataḥ ||45|| kvacit kvacittu saṃkalpaprajāścāsaṃstadā priye | dvāpare sarvathā kāmabījodbhavāḥ prajāḥ khalu ||46|| sāśrayāśca mṛṣāvīryā mṛṣāphalāstathābhavan | vāsanābalasaṃvyāptāścātmavīryavihīnakāḥ ||47|| siddhiśūnyāḥ prajāḥ sarvā vyavardhanta madārditāḥ | duḥkhānāṃ dvāpare cākasmikatā maraṇasya ca ||48|| tadbhayājjāyate tāsāṃ duḥkhamokṣavicāraṇā | vicārāccāpi vairāgyaṃ jñānaṃ bhaktiśca mokṣaṇam ||49|| evaṃ dvāparadharmāśca varṇānāmabhavam̐stadā | āśramāṇāṃ tathā dharmāḥ pṛthak pṛthak tato’bhavan ||2.84.50|| prāpte kalau kleśalābhe kleśavyākulitāḥ prajāḥ | tiṣye māyāmasūyāṃ ca vadhaṃ cāpi tapasvinām ||51 || sādhayanti janā nityaṃ tamasā madagarvitāḥ | kalau prabhārako rogaḥ satataṃ kṣudbhayaṃ tathā ||52|| anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ ghoraṃ deśānāṃ ca viparyayaḥ | adhārmikā anācārā mahākopālpatejasaḥ |||53|| anṛtaṃ bruvate lubdhāstiṣye janāḥ suduṣprajāḥ | duriṣṭairduradhītaiśca durācārairdurāgamaiḥ ||54|| viprāṇāṃ karmadoṣaiśca prajānāṃ jāyate bhayam | na dharmo vedadharmo hi kintu kalpita eva saḥ ||55|| śūdradharmāścaikavarṇāḥ śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ | bhavantyeva prajāḥ sarvā varṇāśramavivarjitāḥ ||56|| rājānaścaurakarmāṇo viprāḥ kāpaṭyabhoginaḥ | guravaḥ śiṣyahārāśca bhavantyeva kalipriyāḥ ||57|| bhrūṇahatyā vīrahatyā nārīhatyā nareśvare | sādhuhatyā satīhatyā dharmahatyā prajāsu ca ||58|| snānaṃ homo japo dānaṃ surārcanaṃ hareḥ smṛtiḥ | tyajyante mānavaistiṣye kāmalobhaparāyaṇaiḥ ||59|| devānsādhūn vṛṣān mokṣaṃ nindantyapi śriyaḥ patim | kurvantyanyāyakarmāṇi nikṛṣṭācārapanthinaḥ ||2.84.60|| kuśīlacaryāḥ pākhaṇḍairvṛthācāraiḥ samāvṛtāḥ | bahuyācanakāḥ sarve bhavantyeva kalau janāḥ ||61|| deśā rūkṣā aṭavīvat grāmā rūkṣāstu ghoṣavat | narā nāryastathā rūkṣāḥ premahīnāḥ parāśrayāḥ ||62|| sasyacaurāḥ kaṇacaurā vastracaurāḥ prahāriṇaḥ | caurāścaurasya hartāro harturhantā tathāparaḥ ||63|| duḥkhabahulā rugṇāścotsādāścālpāyuṣo janāḥ | adharmābhiniveśitvāt tamovyāptāḥ kalau prajāḥ ||64|| uccanīcāsanabhedo yogyatā pūjyatā nayaḥ | naranārīgauravādi naśyatyeva kalau yuge ||65||| rājā prajāḥ kapaṭasya nartakā iva tiṣyake | dvijāḥ śūdrā bhavantyeva śūdrāścāṇḍālakāstathā ||66|| sarvadharmastveka eva bhojyānnavāsalagnake | peyāpeyavibhāgo na bhogyābhogyavihīnatā ||67|| satyāsatyaviveko na grāhyāgrāhyātilaṃghitā | kalpanākuladharmāṃśca kāmānukūlayoṣitaḥ ||68|| mohānukūlakāntaśca yatayo dhūrtadharmiṇaḥ | lokagānairdevatānāṃ kīrtanaṃ dharmavarjitam ||69|| jñānaṃ karma vinaṣṭaṃ ca bhavatyeva kalau sadā | kīṭamūṣakasarpāṇāṃ daṃśā bhavanti tiṣyake || 2.84.70|| sarve duṣṭavratācārāḥ svārthamātrasuyoginaḥ | mohayanti janān sarvān darśayitvā phalāni hi ||71 || mantrakarmakarāścābhicārakā mārakāstathā | nirdayāśca śaṭhā dhūrtā ghātakā mānavāḥ kalau ||72|| māṃsādā madirāpāśca yonisambandhamātrakāḥ | liṃgasambandhamātrāśca dhanārthakṛtaghātakāḥ || 73 || veṣācārasamāścāpi netrasatkāravarjitāḥ | viśvāsaghnāśca mitradhnā āśritaghnāḥ kalau yuge ||74|| gṛhaghnāśca kuṭumbaghnāḥ svīyaghnāśca kalau yuge | dharmaghnāścāpi dharmighnā mātṛghnāḥ pitṛghātakāḥ ||75|| snuṣāghnāḥ kanyakāghnāśca svasṛghnā bhrātṛghātakāḥ | ṣoḍaśādikasaṃskārairhīnāḥ sūtakavarjitāḥ ||76|| śaucahīnāḥ snānahīnā vratahīnāḥ kalau yuge | sūtrahīnā vivāhādividhivarjyā narāḥ striyaḥ ||77|| agnihīnā maṇḍapādihīnā homavivarjitāḥ | sadācāravihīnāśca gṛhācāravihīnakāḥ ||78|| abhakṣyabhakṣaṇāḥ sarve sarvabhakṣāḥ kalau yuge | rākṣasā brāhmaṇā yakṣā gandharvāḥ kinnarāḥ surāḥ ||79|| śvapacāśca piśācāśca samā bhavanti vai kalau | anyonyabhayakartāro’nyonyanāśavidhāyakāḥ ||2.84.80|| alajjāścāpi nirlajjāḥ sarvagauravavarjitāḥ | yatheṣṭabhogavantaśca kumārāḥ kanyakāḥ striyaḥ ||8 1 || keśayonistanadarśakāmbarāḍhyāstu kanyakāḥ | kartryaścāpi ca kartāraḥ prakāśe guptakarmaṇām ||82|| hastamātraśarīrāśca romapaṭalavastrakāḥ | pañcahastadrumāścānte bhavantyeva kalau yuge ||83|| na rājā na prajābhāvo na śāsyaḥ śāsako na ca | na gṛhāṇi nivāsā na na śālāḥ pākasiddhaye ||84|| na gṛhe tvannacayitā na gṛhe vāripeyitā | na gṛhe śayanaṃ nāryā na patyurgṛhavāsitā ||85|| patipatnīkṛto yogo nahi tiṣṭhati vai kalau | aṣṭavarṣā madhyavegā dvādaśānte mṛtiḥ kalau ||86|| pañcottaraṃ sagarbhāśca vinā grāmaṃ nivāsitā | vānarīva tadā nārī sūtikā dūtikāṃ vinā ||87|| vinā khaṣṭvāṃ sūyate ca pṛthivyāṃ bālakaṃ tadā | varṣadvaye tadā gaurī dvivarṣānte tu rohiṇī ||88|| varṣatraye bhavet kanyā caturvarṣā rajasvalā || ata ūrdhvaṃ sagarbhā ca māsaṣaṭke prasūyate ||89|| varṣe dve vai prasūtī ca rajaḥ sakṛt kṣaṇasthiram | maraṇaṃ ghaṭikākāle prāṇo naiva cirāyate ||2.84.90|| apatyāni mṛgaśāvādivaccaranti bhūtale | sasyarasaiḥ prapuṣyante pakṣadugdhāstu mātaraḥ ||91||| pitṛnāma na caivāsti māturnāma kvacit kalau | dīkṣālopo gurorlopo mantralopo na cotsavāḥ ||92|| devānāṃ mānavānāṃ vā samājo na kalau yuge | idṃ kulamiti khyātiḥ kalau nāsti kuṭumbakam ||93|| pitṛśabdo guruśabdaḥ kalāvante na tiṣṭhati | na rājā rājyaniyamā daṇḍā vā śāsakastadā ||94|| na devo mandiraṃ sampradāyaḥ śāstraṃ purāvratam | brahmacaryaṃ na vai tatra yatitvaṃ gṛhasammatam ||95||| sanyāso vidyate naiva śīlaṃ dharmo na vai tadā | vaidhavyaṃ vā vidhuratvaṃ dharmo naiva kalau yuge || 96|| sādhvītvaṃ ca satītvaṃ ca dharmo naiva kalau tadā | kāmadharmaḥ paro dharmaḥ pākhaṇḍastatra saṃyamaḥ ||97|| narā nāryaḥ samarūpāḥ samaveṣāḥ samakriyāḥ | samapradhānabhāvāśca samadāyādabhāginaḥ ||98|| na tadā varṣagaṇanā na cāṃkagaṇanāpi ca | na vidyābhyāsa evāpi tamovṛttijanāḥ kalau ||99|| kalāvante hi bhagavān prādurbhavati svāmirāṭ | kalerbalaṃ vināśyaiva kṛtasthitiṃ karoti saḥ || 2.84.10 0|| evamuktā mayā patni dharmā yugacatuṣṭaye | yathā bhavanti te sarve kālayogena dehiṣu || 101 || divasānte vedhasastu dhṛṣyamāṇo hi golakaḥ | svalpatāṃ yāti vegācca bhramaṇena ca pārthivaḥ || 1 02|| divasā rātrya evāpi hrasvatāṃ yānti vai tadā | ghaṭikāśca kalāḥ kāṣṭhā māsāḥ kālā hrasanti ca || 103 || sarvaṃ hrasvagatikaṃ ca kṣīṇāyuḥ parivartate | tato hrāsaḥ pralayaśca sampadyate dinātyaye || 1 04|| ailavile vayaṃ yāmastadā satyaṃ tvajāśrayam | ityevaṃ rādhike prāha pulastyo nijabhāminīm || 1 05|| ailavilā tu tān dharmān śrutvā prāha patiṃ satī | yatra sarve yugadharmā vidyante pautramīdṛśam || 1 06|| draṣṭumicchāmi cātraiva caturyugāśrayam ṛṣe | pulastyaḥ prāha ca tathāstvityeva yoṣitaṃ nijām || 1 07|| pautrasyāpi prasaṃgena bhagavān sammiliṣyati | lābhamevaṃ viditvaiva sutaṃ viśravasaḥ satī || 1 08|| kṛṣṇayogapradaṃ vavre yaṃ so’bhūd rāvaṇastathā | ailavilā tapastepe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇopari || 1 09|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam | ailavilātapo draṣṭumāyayau sahyaparvate || 2.84.11 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pulastyoktacaturyugadharmāḥ, ailavilāyai varadānaṃ, tapaścaryā cetinirūpaṇanāmā caturaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 84 ||
<2.85> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ailavilā pulastyasya patnī tapaścacāra ha | dustaraṃ putraputrārthaṃ caturyugavṛṣānvitam || 1 || anādiśrīsvāminārāyaṇakṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | sahyādriśikhare tasyā āśrame viprarūpadhṛk || 2 || jaṭāvalkalabhasmāḍhyo mālājapaparāyaṇaḥ | tasthāvāgatya nikaṭe drumādhaśchāyite sthale || 3 || kandamūlaphalāhāro nityaṃ triṣavaṇastathā | bālarūpaḥ ṛṣiputro yathā kaścin manoharaḥ || 4 || āgatya tiṣṭhati tatra kvacit prayāti līnatām | kvacid vṛkṣe śuko bhūtvā bhūtvā kokilakastathā || 5 || mayūraścāpi haṃsaśca hariṇaḥ kvacideva vā | kvacidrūpamagastyasya dhṛtvā paśyati tattapaḥ || 6 || kvacid bhūtvā viśravāśca kvacit pulaspyayoṣitām | pulastyasya sutānāṃ ca dhṛtvā rūpāṇi vai kvacit || 7 || tapo nirīkṣate svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo muhuḥ | rādhikovāca he kṛṣṇa kiṃ puṇyaṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā || 8 || kathaṃ vai bhagavām̐stasyāḥ sannidhau vividhāni ca | rūpāṇi dhṛtavān svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 9 || śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prāha vai rādhe brahmā putraṃ pulastyakam | oṃ namaḥ śrīsvāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te svāhā || 2.85.1 0|| ityārpayanmahāmantraṃ tataḥ so’pi nijāṃ priyām | ailavilāṃ cārpayattaṃ mantraṃ jajāpa sāniśam || 1 1|| tajjāpākṛṣṭahṛdayaḥ svāmikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | bhaktivaśyaḥ samīpe’syāstathārūpo’bhavaddhariḥ || 12|| rādhike sa mayā dṛṣṭastadā kṛṣṇamṛgātmakaḥ | aṭamāno harikṛṣṇo vallabhaḥ śrīpatiḥ patiḥ || 1 3|| ailavilātapaḥ paśyan śṛṇvan jāpaṃ virājate | sāpi pulastyapatnī vai jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇī || 14|| parameśvaralabdhyarthaṃ yatate tāpasī satī | ākāśavāsinī pṛthvyāṃ kṛtvā tu vedikāṃ mṛdaḥ || 15|| vahniṃ tatra nidhāyaiva prātaḥ pūjāṃ karoti sā | tato rudraṃ satīṃ kṛṣṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ cājaṃ savitṛjām || 16|| sūryaṃ prabhāṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca sādhvīṃ sadvastubhiḥ surān | nityaṃ prapūjya ca mālājapaṃ karoti vai śatam || 17|| tataḥ phalādi cāhṛtya madhyāhne haraye svayam | naivedyaṃ sajalaṃ cārpya tapaḥ karoti tiṣṭhati || 18|| ekapādena vai sūryaṃ dṛṣṭvā sthirā pratiṣṭhati | āsāyaṃ ca tataścārārtrikaṃ snātvā karoti ca || 19|| rātrau karoti bhajanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca | ardharātrottaraṃ nidrāṃ ghaṭikāmātramṛcchati ||2.85.20|| samutthāya hariṃ dhyātvā brāhme snātvārcanaṃ hare | nityavat prakarotyeva kandamūlaphalāśanā ||21 || varṣamātraṃ tathā kṛtvā tato vāryaśanābhavat | sūryodayaṃ samārabhyāsāyaṃ tiṣṭhati nityadā ||22|| aṅguṣṭhaikasthirā caivaṃ varṣamātraṃ tapo’karot | tato divāniśaṃ sthairyaṃ samālambya sthitābhavat ||23|| vāyvāhārā hṛdayena pūjikā śrīharestadā | śarīraṃ varṣamātreṇa jaḍavat kāṣṭhatāṃ gatam || 24|| pakṣiṇo yatra tiṣṭhanti kīṭāḥ kurvanti mṛdgṛham | evaṃ valmīkachannā sā varṣe catuṣṭaye’bhavat ||25|| varṣe tu pañcame tasyā mastake stambarohaṇam | tṛṇodgamaśca sañjāto dṛśyate sā na mānavī ||26|| tato brahmā haro viṣṇuḥ sūryo gaṇapatiḥ striyaḥ | āyayurdevadevyādyāḥ satītapaḥprakarṣitāḥ ||27|| devyaḥ stambatṛṇādīni dūrīcakrurmṛdāṃ cayāt | gaṇeśaścāpi sūryaśca mṛdo dūrīpracakratuḥ ||28||| brahmā jalaṃ dadau tatrāñjalinā prokṣaṇaṃ śubham | rudraḥ prāṇapracāraṃ cākārayat prokṣaṇena tu ||29|| viṣṇustasyāścetanaṃ cāvāhyat sarvavarṣmaṇi | tataḥ sā tūtthitā bodhaṃ prāptānamat surān puraḥ ||2.85.3 0|| oṃ namaḥ śrīsvāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te svāhā | uvāca sādhvī cāvyagrā rakṣantaṃ svāṃ nijaṃ prabhum ||3 1 || sasmāra devadeveśaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | devā ūcurvada sādhvi kiṃ te manasi vartate ||32|| dadmaste’bhīṣṭamatraiva varaṃ vṛṇvadya mā ciram | ityuktā sā prajagāda varaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇāt ||33|| vṛṇomyeva na cānyasmād devāḥ svastyastu vaḥ sadā | bhavantaḥ pūjitā nityaṃ mayā dharmo yato hi saḥ ||34|| lokasaṃgraharakṣārthaṃ svati vo’stu yadāgatāḥ | devyaḥ svasti ca yuṣmākaṃ sadāstu kuśalaṃ tathā ||35|| ityuktvā svāgataṃ cakre hṛdayena sutuṣyatā | jajāpa śrīsvāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim ||36|| tāvacchrībhagavām̐statra ya āsīt stambasaṃsthitaḥ | vṛkṣarūpaḥ sa valmīke prāvirāsa hariḥ svayam ||37|| dvibhujaścampakavarṇaḥ svarṇabhūṣāvirājitaḥ | koṭikoṭyarkatejobhirvyāpto divyākṛtiḥ patiḥ ||38|| divyasauvarṇabhūṣāḍhyo divyāmbaravirājitaḥ | divyaratnālimālābhiḥ śobhamānaḥ śrīvallabhaḥ ||39|| divyakaṭakaśobhāḍhyo divyamukuṭakuṇḍalaḥ | divyakaustubharaśanormikāyaṣṭivirājitaḥ ||2.85.40|| rādhāramāprabhāpārvatīhaṃsāmañjulārcitaḥ | saguṇāmāṇikīśāntāvijayālalitārcitaḥ ||41 || hemantabhagavaddevaprakāśakeśavādibhiḥ | pārṣadaiḥ sahitastatra suyuvā saṃsthito’bhavat ||42|| rūpānurūpāvayavaḥ kare naktakamādadhan | tāmbūlacarvaṇaṃ kurvan hasan hariḥ sthito’bhavat ||43|| karābhyāṃ sa spṛśam̐stasyā mastake cāśiṣaṃ vadan | varārthaṃ ca prayuñjam̐stāṃ devān prati vyalokayat ||44|| devaiḥ sākṣāddharirdṛṣṭaḥ stutaḥ stotraistu sāmagaiḥ | pūjitaḥ parayā bhaktyā tatastasthuḥ sureśvarāḥ ||45|| pupūja sā svāmikṛṣṇaparabrahmapareśvaram | patraṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ bhāvaṃ dadau śrīpataye satī ||46 || varaṃ samārthayat tasmāccaturyugaguṇāśrayāḥ | pautrā me santu bhagavan yena yogo bhavettava ||47|| pautrāṇāṃ ca kuṭumbasya bhaktyā cānanyalabdhayā | yugadoṣeṇa doṣaiśca dveṣeṇāpi drutaṃ tava ||48|| bhaved bhaktiḥ smṛtirnityā snehādapyadhikā yataḥ | tava yogaṃ vinā mokṣo naiva bhavati dehinām ||49|| ānyopāyaiściraṃlabhyo dveṣairlabhyo drutaṃ bhavān | tava hastena maraṇaṃ mokṣadaṃ niścitaṃ bhavet ||2.85.50|| ityevaṃ matkuṭumbārthe samicchāmi varaṃ prabho | dehi me ceti śrutvaiva tathāstvityāha keśavaḥ ||5 1|| atha haryājñayā devāḥ satkṛtā prayayuśca te | ailavilā tapastyaktvā prasādaṃ bubhuje hareḥ ||52| jalaṃ phalaṃ rasaṃ madhu snātvā śuddhiṃ vidhāya ca | svāmikṛṣṇaṃ samapṛcchat pulastyasya priyā satī ||53|| ailavilovāca bhagavan saṃśayānme’tra chettumarhasi sarvavit | nāryāstu saṃśayān kaścidanyaśchettuṃ na cārhati |||54|| kecid dhyānaṃ vṛṣaṃ cānye vivekaṃ yogasādhanām | brahmacaryaṃ tapaḥ pātivratyaṃ patnīvrataṃ pare ||55|| satyaṃ tyāgamahiṃsāṃ satītvaṃ sanyāsamityapi | dānaṃ dayāṃ cādhyayanaṃ praśaṃsanti tathetare ||56|| tīrthayātrāṃ cendriyāṇāṃ nigrahaṃ satsamāgamam | sarvārpaṇaṃ prapattiṃ vā gurvarpaṇaṃ virāgitām ||57|| jñānaṃ brahmamayaṃ caiṣāṃ kiṃ śreyo brūhi me prabho | yadi vā vidyate cānyad guptaṃ tadvaktumarhasi ||58|| śrutvā cailavilāvākyaṃ svāmikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | prāha divyaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ śreyaḥpradaṃ parātparam ||59|| hitāya sarvajīvānāṃ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraiḥ sṛtam | avācyaṃ sarvagūḍhārthaṃ jñānamajñairbahiṣkṛtam || 2.85.6 0|| śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmyuvāca paraṃ guhyatamaṃ kṣetraṃ paradhāmapradaṃ param | mamākṣarāhvayaṃ kṣetraṃ yatra kuṃkumavāpikā ||6 1 || sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ vāsāt saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī | aśvapaṭṭasaroramyā lomaśāśramaśobhitā ||62|| tatra bhaktā ailavile madīyaṃ vratamāsthitaḥ | nivasanti mahātmānaḥ parāṃ bhaktiṃ mamāśritāḥ ||63|| uttamaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ kṣetrāṇāmuttamaṃ ca yat | sthānānāmuttamaṃ sthānaṃ kṣetraṃ me’kṣarasaṃjñitam ||64|| bhūtale naiva saṃlagnaṃ cidākāśasthitaṃ hi tat | adivyā nahi paśyanti muktāḥ paśyanti tad hṛdā ||65|| sthānaṃ priyatamaṃ me tad guptaṃ śīghraṃ pramuktidam | madbhaktā yatra vartante māmeva ca bhajanti vai ||66|| tatra yānti narā nāryaste’pi prayānti matpadam | anyadhāmāni dṛṣṭvaiva māmeva praviśanti te ||67|| dattaṃ japtaṃ kṛtaṃ ceṣṭaṃ taptaṃ dhyātaṃ hutaṃ śrutam | sevitaṃ bhojitaṃ jñātaṃ sarvaṃ tatrākṣayaṃ bhavet ||68|| janmāntarasahasreṣu kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tu sañcitam | kṣetre’kṣare praviṣṭasya sarvaṃ drāg yāti saṃkṣayam ||69|| mānavāstu narā nāryaḥ saṃkarāścātipāpinaḥ | pāpayonigatā duṣṭāḥ striyaḥ saṃkīrṇayogajāḥ ||2.85.70|| mlecchāścaṇḍālajāścāpi kīṭāḥ pipālikā mṛgāḥ | paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarīsṛpāstṛṇāni pādapāḥ ||7 1 || vallayo jaḍajātāśca yadi kṣetre’kṣare mṛtāḥ | te tu sacandratilakā mahāhastyādivāhanāḥ ||72|| ramye mamākṣare divyāste prayānti pramokṣaṇam | akṣare tu mṛtaḥ kaścinna yāti narakaṃ hyaghī || 73|| mamānugrahamāptāste sarve yāntyakṣaraṃ padam | kiṃ vaktavyaṃ bhavedatra cailavile mama sthale ||74|| mokṣaṃ sudurlabhaṃ jñātvā saṃsāraṃ cātibhīṣaṇam | gatiṃ jñānena hatvāpi vaset kṣetre’kṣare mama ||75|| yatra tatra vipannasya gatistvatra hi mokṣadā | prasādād dahyati pāpaṃ vāsāttu divyatā bhavet ||76|| darśanānmama muktiśca jāyate tvakṣare pade | mama yogānmahāmuktirjāyate me pare pade ||77|| apuṇyā nahi paśyanti māyāpaṭalacakṣuṣaḥ | tamovṛttā na paśyanti divyaṃ kṣetraṃ mamākṣaram ||78|| te tu viṇmūtraretobhṛddehe viśanti vai muhuḥ | hanyamāno’pi yo dehī viśed vighnaśatairapi ||79|| akṣaraṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro’bhitaḥ | sa yāti paramaṃ dhāma yatra gatvā na śocati ||2.85.80|| janmamṛtyujarāmuktaṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ mamāspadam | apunarmaraṇānāṃ tad gaditaṃ mokṣakāṃkṣiṇām ||8 1 || na dānairna tapobhiśca na yajñairnāpi vidyayā | prāpyate gatirutkṛṣṭā yākṣare labhyate parā ||82|| nānāvarṇā vivarṇāśca caṇḍālādyā jugupsitāḥ | kilbiṣaiḥ pūrṇadehāśca nikṛṣṭaiḥ pātakairyutāḥ ||83|| teṣāṃ tīkṣṇaṃ bheṣajaṃ cākṣaraṃ kṣetraṃ paraṃ padam | akṣaraṃ tatparaṃ jñānamakṣaraṃ tatparaṃ padam ||84|| akṣaraṃ tatparaṃ vattvamakṣaraṃ puruṣottamaḥ | dhṛtvā vai naiṣṭhikīṃ dīkṣāmakṣare ye vasanti te ||85|| matto labdhvā paraṃ jñānaṃ yānti me paramaṃ padam | prabhāsaṃ svarṇanagarī vastrāpathaṃ ca narmadā ||86|| nārāyaṇasaraccāpi puṣkaraṃ kauravaṃ sthalam | gaṃgā badarikā śālagrāmaṃ śrīśaila ityapi ||87|| himālayaśca kedāro gayā gokarṇamityapi | kṛṣṇā godāvarī sindhurgomatī brahmaputrikā ||88|| nārāyaṇīsariccāpi vijñaturīyakaṃ saraḥ | tūṃgānīkasaro nyāsasaraścaṇḍasarastathā ||89|| naṣṭajarānadī raktavārdhirnīlābdhirityapi | nīparā dīnayūpā ca senā mahābṛhatsaraḥ ||2.85.90|| antārkivartulaṃ cāpi sūparyuparikaṃsaraḥ | pannāmnī kālimā cāpi yāneśī śvetavāridhiḥ ||9 1 || uralādrirmānasaṃ ca saro brahmasarovaram | bālakṛṣṇasaraścāpi dvikalaṃ ca sarastathā ||92|| aṃgaśikṣāṃgikā cāpi murānadī turunadī | aitānadī mikāṃgā ca irāvatī nadī tathā || 93 || hutalīnā ca gaṃgāpi sābharākhyaṃ mahat saraḥ | etāni puṇyasthānāni pṛthivyāṃ viśrutāni tu ||94|| tāni tvāyānti satataṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram | tanmṛtāḥ paramaṃ mokṣaṃ na yānti te yathākṣare ||95|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre sākṣādahaṃ pareśvaraḥ | brahmahradaṃ samādāya vartāmyeva nirantaram ||96|| brahmahrado’nantajanmakṛtapāpāni nāśayet | anyatra sulabhā gaṃgā śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ japo vratam ||97|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre tatsarvaṃ tvatidurlabham | yadi pāpo yadi śaṭho yadi tvadhārmiko janaḥ || 98|| akṣaraṃ tatpadaṃ prāpya punāti kulasaptakam | yajeta juhuyānnityaṃ dadātyarcayate tathā ||99|| kṣetre’kṣare tu māṃ bhaktastasyānantaguṇaṃ phalam | tatra gatvā tu ye bhaktā arcayanti stuvanti mām || 2.85.10 0|| sarvapāpavinirmuktāste jñeyā mama pārṣadāḥ | anyatra yāgājjñānādvā sanyāsādatha yogataḥ || 10 1|| prāpyate tatparaṃ sthānaṃ sahasreṇa tu janmanām | akṣare ye vasantyete vindantyekena janmanā || 1 02|| tatra yogastapo jñānaṃ vrataṃ cāhaṃ nirantaram | māṃ samāsādya bhaktānāṃ gantavyaṃ nāsti cāparam || 103 || tadeva guhyaṃ guhyānāṃ paraṃ śreyaḥpradaṃ matam | jñānadhyānaniviṣṭānāṃ paramānandamicchatām || 104|| tatra dadāmyahaṃ mantraṃ tvakṣare kṣetrake mama | yattatparataraṃ tattvaṃ so’haṃ kṣetraṃ ca tanmama || 1 05|| bhrūmadhye nābhimadhye ca hṛdaye’pi ca mūrddhani | yasmāt kasmād yāti cāsustvakṣare’tra pramucyate || 1 06|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī vasāmyaham | māmāsādyātipāpāśca prayānti paramāṃ gatim || 1 07|| nārāyaṇānāṃ sarveṣāṃ śreṣṭho’haṃ parameśvaraḥ | nārāyaṇāstathā cānye śaṃbhvādyā vaiṣṇavā api || 1 08|| dhāmānyapi ca sarvāṇi dhāmasthā muktakoṭayaḥ | brahmāṇḍeśvaravaryāśca devādyāstīrthakoṭayaḥ || 1 09|| vasāmastatra me kṣetre’kṣare cāśvasaro’bhitaḥ | kuṃkumavāpikā brahmarūpiṇī muktasatpurī ||2.85.1 10 || pāpopahatamatayo naiva paśyanti divyatām | na teṣāṃ vīkṣituṃ śakyaṃ cākṣaraṃ mama bhūtalam || 11 1|| puṇyavāsāḥ smarantyenāṃ purīṃ divyena cakṣuṣā | paśyanti yogasiddhā ca lokāntare’pi vāsinaḥ || 11 2|| āgacchatāmidaṃ sthānaṃ sevituṃ mokṣakāṃkṣiṇām | mṛtānāṃ pathi cetteṣāṃ punarjanma na vidyate || 113 || yogī vāpyathavāyogī pāpī vā puṇyakṛttamaḥ | na lokavacanāt pitrorna cāpi guruvādataḥ | |1 14|| matiṃ cotkramayet sākṣādakṣarakṣetragāṃ śubhām | kuṃkumavāpikāvāsaṃ cāśvasarojalāplavam || 1 15|| rādhike bhagavānevaṃ cailavilāṃ prabodhya ca | virarāma kṣaṇaṃ sāpi śrutvāścaryamavāpa ha || 116 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne’nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāminā ailavilāyai kathitamakṣaramāhātmyamitināmā pañcāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 85 ||
<2.86> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścādailavilāvadaddharim | bhagavanme’sti jijñāsā tat kṣetrākṣaramīkṣitum || 1 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastāṃ sahyaparvatāt | āropya garuḍe caitre vyomnākṣaraṃ samāyayau || 2 || kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ divyamakṣarasaṃjñitam | saccidānandadhāmābhaṃ nityānanditamānavam || 3 || divyadehisamavyāptaṃ devapitrādisevitam | brahmahradodasanmiśrāśvapaṭṭakasaro’nvitam || 4 || sahasrarṣigaṇaiścāpi kṛtāvāsaṃ samujjvalam | pāvanaṃ pāvanānāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ tīrthamuttamam || 5 || mokṣadānāṃ paraṃ mokṣapradaṃ sarvāghanāśakam | śatasāhasraprāsādaiḥ śobhitaṃ vanavallibhiḥ || 6 || divyadrumaiḥ samudyānaiḥ sahasraiḥ parivāritam | jalāśayaiḥ śubhārāmaiḥ phalipuṣpisugandhitam || 7 || kalpadrumaiḥ samṛddhaṃ ca cintāmaṇiprabhāsitam | vardhitaṃ munibhirnityaṃ yajñādhyayanabhaktibhiḥ || 8 || āśritaṃ cātithibhiśca brahmadhāmagamaiḥ priyaiḥ | priyābhiḥ śrīhareryacca kṛtakautukamaṃgalam || 9 || amṛtānāṃ hradairyuktaṃ yāvatsṛṣṭiniṣevitam | gīrvāṇabhāṣākuśalairvaidikairdhārmikairyutam || 2.86.1 0|| sauvarṇadaṇḍasaṃrājaddīrghadhvajasahasrakam sāptabhaumāḍhyanilayaiḥ śṛṃgasaudhairvirājitam || 1 1|| vyomayānairyatra muktā uḍḍayanti narāḥ striyaḥ | svargagāḥ pakṣiṇo yatra saṃskṛtajñāḥ śukādayaḥ || 1 2|| vadanti vaidikīṃ bhāṣāṃ gohastyādyā api dvijaiḥ | agnayo yatra vartante pradīptā vedikāsthale || 13|| dānāni yatra dīyante sṛṣṭipālairdivāniśam | yātrikā yatra vartante lakṣaśo mokṣabhāginaḥ || 14|| śrotṛṇāṃ kathakānāṃ ca sabhāsthalasahasrakam | devapratimāprāsādāḥ śataśo’tha sahasraśaḥ || 15|| vidyante kānakaivyomni kalaśaiḥ śṛṃgaśobhanaiḥ | vanaspatayo dṛśyante nikuñjā gṛhamedhinām || 16|| āśramāḥ ṛṣivaryāṇāṃ śobhante svargiṇāmiva | tāpasā yatra vidyante koṭiśo’śvasaro’bhitaḥ || 17|| sādhavo yatra lokānāṃ kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ prakurvate | sādhvyo brahmapriyā yatra brahmavrataparāḥ sadā || 18|| vasanti kṛṣṇasevārthaṃ kṣetrākṣarakṛtāśrayāḥ | jñānayajñā brahmayajñā dānayajñā bhavanti ca || 19|| sevāyajñā mokṣayajñāstṛptiyajñā bhavanti ca | kathāyajñāḥ satataṃ ca viprarṣayo vasanti ca ||2.86.20|| vratayajñāḥ satrayajñā udyāpanavidhiprathāḥ | tīrthayajñā harernāmnāṃ kīrtanakratavaḥ sadā ||21|| vartante satataṃ yatra devārādhanarītayaḥ | divyapāvanahṛdayā vasanti yatra dehinaḥ |||22|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin parabrahmetivādinaḥ | kambharānandanakṛṣṇa gopālātmaja mādhava ||23|| śrīpate rādhikākānta sarvātman bhava me priya | ityevaṃ bhajamānāstaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ vasanti te ||24|| vairahīnāstiraścopi dadarśailavilāśrame | lomaśasya ramaṇīye brahmapriyādyadhiṣṭhite ||25||| mūrtayastannivāsinyastejaḥpracuraśobhanāḥ | tayā vyomnā vīkṣitā vai yānasthayailayā tadā ||26|| bhramaṇaṃ tadvimānena kṛtvā kṣetrapradakṣiṇam | avātatāra prāsāde kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sā ||27|| saha śrīsvāminā sārdhaṃ yayau śrīkambharāṃ prati | dadarśa pūjayāmāsa vavande ca nanāma ca ||28|| tato gopālakṛṣṇaṃ sā yayau nanāma pādayoḥ | tato gajāsanaṃ gatvā svāminaṃ sahayāyinam ||29|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kṛtapariśramam | bālarūpaṃ parabrahma siṣeve dehamardanaiḥ ||2.86.30|| pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre dāsīva śrīharestataḥ | tīrthānyaśvasaraḥsthāni yayau sasnau vidhānataḥ ||3 1|| jalaṃ kuṃkumavāpyāśca papau dadhāra mastake | tataḥ śrīlomaśaṃ natvā pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ||32|| brahmapriyāḥ sarvakanyā militvā mandiraṃ yayau | bālakṛṣṇastvailavilā bhojayāmāsa pāyasam ||33|| pāyayāmāsa madhuraṃ vāri svacaraṇāmṛtam | pāvayāmāsa bhaktāṃ svāṃ rañjayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ||34|| tataḥ sākṣarabhūmiṃ tāṃ vilokya sthātumānasā | prārthayatparamātmānaṃ sadā vāsaṃ satī yadā ||35|| caitre harirdadau tasyai rūpadvayaṃ samaṃ śubham | chāyāṃ saṃpreṣayāmāsa pulastyaṃ prati vai tadā ||36 || ailavilāṃ divyarūpāmarakṣat svāntike sadā | brahmavratadharāṃ sādhvīṃ sādhudharmānvitāṃ satīm ||37|| atha tasyā varadānaṃ saphalaṃ samajāyata | viśravaso’bhavanpatnyaścatasraḥ kulavardhikāḥ ||38|| puṣpotkaṭā ca vākā ca kaikasī devavarṇinī | jyeṣṭhaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ yakṣaṃ suṣuve devavarṇinī ||39|| kaikasyajanayat putraṃ rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhipam | kubhakarṇaṃ śūrpaṇakhāṃ tathaiva ca vibhīṣaṇam ||2.86.40|| puṣpotkaṭāpyajanayat putrān viśravasaḥ śubhān | mahodaraṃ prahastaṃ ca mahāpārśvaṃ kharaṃ tathā ||41 || kuṃbhīnasīṃ tathā śṛṃgīmanyāśca śatakanyakāḥ | vākājāstriśirāścaiva vidyujjihvaśca dūṣaṇaḥ ||42|| krūraṃ kanyāśataṃ cāpi paulastyavaṃśajā daśa | rakṣobhāvayutāḥ sarvayugadharmāśrayāstathā ||43||| tapoyuktā dānayuktā rāgayuktāḥ sakalmaṣāḥ | satyāsatyobhayayuktā baladarpasamanvitāḥ ||44|| kalidharmāśritāścāpi yannāśārthaṃ hariḥ svayam | rāmarūpaṃ vidhatte ca prahanti rākṣasām̐stataḥ ||45|| pāpāni kṣālayitvā te yānti vaikuṇṭhavāsitām | ailavilāvaradānapratāpena tu vaṃśajān ||46|| sabalān rākṣasān kṛṣṇacakraṃ hanti yuge yuge | rādhike mama cakraṃ vā jalaṃ vā tulasīdalam ||47|| padaṃ vā yena samprāptaṃ mukto bhavati ko’pi yaḥ | yakṣo vā rākṣaso vāpi dānavo daitya ityapi ||48||| viśravāḥ siṃhale dvīpe yayau vaṃśayutastataḥ | ailavilā tapaḥ sthāne cakre yatra hariḥ svayam ||49|| tadrakṣāṃ ca tapaso’pi parīkṣāṃ pracakāra ha | tattīrthaṃ cailavaileyaṃ śṛṃgaṃ sahyādribhūbhṛtaḥ ||2.86.50|| sajalaṃ jalakuṇḍena prasravaṇena rājitam | pāvanaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādarajonvitam ||51|| sañjātaṃ mokṣadaṃ yatra vṛkṣastambātmako hariḥ | samabhūd varṣamātraṃ vai varṣamātraṃ śukādayaḥ ||52|| hariṇā dhṛtarūpāśca tadvaṃśā vaiṣṇavāśca te | sahyādrau sahyapakṣistrījanyāste harivaṃśajāḥ ||53 || divyā divyasvarūpāśca vasanti susukhānvitāḥ | yatra vṛkṣāḥ pāvanāśca harivaṃśodbhavāstathā ||54|| yatrāvagrahaleśo’pi sahyādrau na kadācana | yatrānaladavo nāsti na hiṃsropadravastathā ||55|| śvetavarṇāśca kariṇaścaturdantā mahocchrayāḥ | harivaṃśodbhavā yatra vartante devavāhanāḥ ||56 || śarabhāścocchritā yatra harivaṃśodbhavāḥ śubhāḥ | śubhravarṇā vasantyeva dviśuṇḍāḥ siṃhajātayaḥ ||57|| śvetāḥ svastikayuktāśca bhujagāḥ pāvanāstathā | niḥkṣveḍā harivaṃśotthāḥ śvetā mayūrajātayaḥ ||58|| vartante divyarūpāste harervaṃśodbhavā hi te | sahyādriḥ sarvathā tīrthottamaṃ tasya vanāni ca ||59|| pañcavarṣāṇi vai hareryogāt pāvitryavanti ca | paṭhanācchravaṇād rādhe bhuktimuktipradāni ca ||2.86.60|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne ailavilāyāḥ kuṃkumavāpyāgamanaṃ rūpadvayaṃ, harivaṃśīyaprajāyāḥ sahyādrau vāsaścetinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 86 ||
<2.87> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike bhaktā harergṛhṇanti sadguṇān | duṣṭā guṇeṣu doṣām̐ścāropya gṛhṇanti durguṇān || 1 || viśravasastu putrasya kharasya rākṣasasya vai | khacaryāmabhavat putro hyadharmajīvasaṃjñakaḥ || 2 || kaṭyāṃ vakro bhagnapṛṣṭho gaṇḍe godhākhyadūṣaṇaḥ | kapardākṣaḥ sadā śvāse durgandhāḍhyaḥ śiśupriyaḥ || 3 || sakalmaṣo’tikāpaṭyācāro viśvāsaghātakaḥ | janmanā tāḍitā padbhyāṃ mātā mṛteti mātṛhā || 4 || ghūkasvaraḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ picchatulyaśiroruhaḥ | pṛṣṭhaliṅgī kuṇṭhakarṇo bahirdaṃṣṭro’timatsaraḥ || 5 || utpannamātraduḥkhakṛdbālānāṃ dharṣako’bhavat | ekadā sa yayau nadyāstaṭe rantuṃ sabālakaḥ || 6 || carmakārasya vāseṣu cāntyajānāṃ gṛheṣu ca | rikteṣu bālarakṣeṣu jyeṣṭhāstu karmaṇe gatāḥ || 7 || tatra bālāṃstāḍayitvā bhakṣayāmāsa tadgṛhe | śvamāṃsaṃ madyapānaṃ ca pracakāra papau jalam || 8 || tadā bālairmilitvā ca dhṛtvā baddhvāntyajairbalāt | kṣārakuṇḍe vinikṣipto durgandhe svalpakardame || 9 || śilayā chāditastatra kuṇḍyāṃ kṣārapaṭasya saḥ | divāniśaṃ sa vai kuṇḍyāṃ kuṇḍīgandhaṃ samagrahīt || 2.87.10 || māsārdhaṃ prāṇarakṣārthaṃ ubhukṣitastṛṣākulaḥ | carmakṣālanajaṃ vāri cārmakardamamityapi || 11 || sūkṣmakīṭodbhavaṃ kuṇḍyāṃ bhakṣayāmāsa pāpakṛt | rākṣaso jātijo yaśca cāṇḍālagṛhabhojanaḥ || 12|| carmakuṇḍakṛtāvāsaścarmakardamabhakṣakaḥ | mātṛhāḥ śiśumāraśca ko’smātpāpataro bhavet || 13 || rādhike tādṛśo’dharmajīvo nāmnā mahāsuraḥ | antyajaiścarmakāraiśca āvalīrañjanāmbaraḥ ||14|| niṣkāsya kuṇḍito duṣṭastāḍitaḥ ṣaṇḍhitastathā | siṃhale dvīpake tasthau raṇānte vanibhakṣakaḥ || 15|| paśūn pakṣigaṇām̐ścāpi kvacit kuṭumbajārbhakān | dhṛtvā karoti tadghātaṃ bhakṣayatyeva tānapi || 16 || ekadā bhaktarāṭ tatra vibhīṣaṇo hareḥ priyaḥ | gṛṇan rāmeti kṛṣṇeti nārāyaṇeti sañcaran || 17|| vihartuṃ tena mārgeṇa yayau vanāni vīkṣitum | tatrainaṃ vīkṣayāmāsādharmajīvaṃ mahāsuram || 18|| uvāca tvaṃ kathamatra vartase nirjane suta | ehi gṛhaṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaja nārāyaṇaṃ sukham || 1 9|| mā duḥkhaṃ vaha śuṣke’trāraṇye raṇe tu nirjane | śrutvā vibhīṣaṇaṃ prāha pitṛjyeṣṭhaṃ sagarvakaḥ ||2.87.20|| ko hariḥ kaśca kṛṣṇo’sti nārāyaṇo’pi ko’sti vai | nainaṃ jānāmi kaścāste kasmād bhaje’vicāritam || 21 || bhakto vibhīṣaṇaḥ prāha harirduḥkhaharo’sti saḥ | parabrahma svayaṃ divyo divyākṣaranivāsakṛt ||22|| rākṣaso’dharmajīvastu prāha dhanāpahārakaḥ | dravyāpahārako nāryādyapahāraka eva saḥ ||23|| hārakastvanyasamṛddheścauraḥ kaścid bhavet hariḥ | kṛṣṇaṃ pāpaṃ duṣṭakarma tatkṛt kṛṣṇo bhaveddhi saḥ || 24|| nārāsvapsvayanaḥ kaścit nadīstho dhīvaro bhavet | jalahārakabhṛtyo vā kiṃkaraḥ kasyacidbhavet ||25|| jale vāsakaro vāyaṃ sarpo matsyo’thavā bhavet | paraḥ śatrurbrahma mahān mahāśatrurbhaveddhi saḥ ||26|| divyo dhūrto dyūtavettā vyasanī kaścideva saḥ | akṣaiḥ pāśaiḥ ramate ca rāti gṛhṇāti nāṇakam ||27|| dyūtagṛhe nivāsī ca bhavet kaścidaghātmakaḥ | vibhīṣaṇastu taṃ prāha paramātmā pareśvaraḥ ||28|| puruṣottama evāyaṃ bhagavānīśvareśvaraḥ | muktādhipaḥ pare dhāmni rājamāno’sti putraka ||29|| rākṣaso’dharmajīvaśca prāha nāyaṃ tathā pitaḥ | paṃ pānaṃ madyajaṃ tatra ramate tvātmanā svayam ||2.87.3 0|| madyapānādilubdhaḥ sa madyapaḥ paramo bhavet | parasya dīnalokasya duḥkhakṛcceśvaro bhavet ||3 1|| puru sinoti pāpāni cādhikaṃ tamasāvṛtaḥ | tāmasaḥ pāpakṛccāyaṃ bhavet| sa puruṣottamaḥ ||32|| bhagaṃ guhyaṃ ca vā tasya nārīcihnaṃ bhavet khalu | bhagavān guptanārī sā bhavet puruṣaveṣiṇī ||33|| īśvarāṇāṃ mādṛśānāṃ yoddhṝṇāmiśubhirhataḥ | na rakṣituṃ svayaṃ śaktaḥ svaṃ bhavedīśvareśvaraḥ ||34|| muktā yāḥ patibhirnāryo gṛhānniṣkāsitāśca yāḥ | tāsāmadhipaḥ sa bhaved vyabhicāriśiromaṇiḥ ||35|| pare dhāmni gṛhe nityaṃ vasati parabhūsthitaḥ | gṛhadvāravihīnaḥ sa bhavedvā bhikṣukaḥ pitaḥ ||36|| vibhīṣaṇaśca taṃ prāha putra vyūhasvarūpadhṛk | sarvāvatārahetuḥ sa sarvaśaktidharaḥ prabhuḥ ||37|| golokeśaḥ sa vaikuṇṭhadhāmeśo vai paraḥ pumān | yogigamyo’ntarātmā ca mokṣadaśceti taṃ bhaja ||38|| adharmajīvarakṣo’pi prāha manye sa vañcakaḥ | vañcanārthaṃ tu lokānāṃ vyūhya vyūhya tu veṣadhṛk ||39|| kvacinnaṭaḥ kvacidgopaḥ kacidrājakumāravat | kvacidvipro bhavatyeva vañcako vyūhavān bhavet ||2.87.40|| sarveṣāmavatārāṇāṃ loke vai nimnakarmaṇām | hetuḥ kartā nimnavarṇo bhavet kaścid vivarṇajaḥ ||41 || sarveṣu prāṇiṣu śastraśaktyākhyasya prayojakaḥ | bhavet sa ghātakī kaściditi manye pitaḥ khalu |||42|| prasahya bhavati kaṣṭapradaḥ kaścid bhavedaghī | gavāṃ sa vṛṣabhāṇāṃ vai loke samūhake mahān ||43|| mahāvṛṣabho vā kaścid bhavedvā vṛṣavāhakaḥ | kuṇṭhitaṃ dhāmavāsādi gṛhakuṭyādivarjitaḥ ||44|| paraḥ śatrusvarūpo vā pumān bhaveddhi rakṣasām | samaśīlairyogavadbhirgamya sāptapadīnakam ||45|| tasmādasajjanaḥ kaściditi manye pitaḥ khalu | antaraṃ bhinnatā yasya kāme manasi cātmani ||46|| vāci vā bhinnatā tasmād viśvāsaghātako bhavet | mokṣaṃ sarvaṃ samācchidya durbalasya vināśanam ||47|| manye karoti kaścit sa hiṃsro durbalaghātakaḥ | kastaṃ bhajedasantaṃ vai guṇāgryaiśca vivarjitam ||48|| vibhīṣaṇastu taṃ prāha sa tu vidvān guṇāśrayaḥ | vedavid vedaśāstrādikartā śīlavratādimān ||49|| sarvadharmāśrayaḥ sādhukarmakaḥ śāntisaṃbhṛtaḥ | adharmajīvo rakṣo’tha prāha vidvānna cāsti saḥ ||2.87.50|| na raṃbhaṇaṃ vijānāti gītiṃ jānāti naiva ca | abhicārānna jānāti māyāṃ jānāti naiva ca ||51 || ato naiva bhavedvā sa vidvān pitaḥ kadācana | guṇo rajjurgavāṃ dohakāryārthaṃ yasya vidyate ||52|| skandhe tasmād bhaved gopo guṇāśrayaḥ pitaḥ khalu | vedaṃ vā vedikāṃ grāmacatuṣke nirmitāṃ janaiḥ ||53|| pāṣāṇānāṃ mṛdāṃ vā tāṃ kartuṃ jānāti kuṃbhakṛt | kubhakāro bhaved vāyaṃ vedikāśilpavit khalu ||54|| śaṃ śātanaṃ hi keśānāṃ karotyastreṇa mastake | nāpito’yaṃ bhavedvā ca romaśatrupraśastravān ||55|| śīlaṃ cāskhalanaṃ dharmo vrataṃ kṛcchrādi yattapaḥ | atti khādati cobhaṃ tat tādṛgdharmavighātakaḥ ||56|| śīlavratādanaścāyaṃ bhavet kaściddhi bhāṇḍakaḥ | sarve dharmāḥ paśudharmāstadvān vā sa paśurbhavet |||57|| sādhoḥ karma gṛhasthānāṃ viruddhaṃ gṛhabhañjanam | sanyāsādisvarūpaṃ tatkārako’yaṃ yatirbhavet ||58|| jaḍo vā syād vicitto vā śāntisaṃbhṛta ekalaḥ | vibhīṣaṇaśca taṃ prāha putra vipro’sti mādhavaḥ ||59|| yajñopavītasandhartā kleśatāpapraśāmakaḥ | mahāvidyāśrayaḥ śāstraracanākārakaḥ svayam ||2.87.60|| eka evādvitīyo’yaṃ tīrthayātrākaro’cyutaḥ | adharmajīvo rakṣastu prāha vipro bhavenna saḥ ||6 1|| viṃ pakṣiṇaṃ tu yaḥ prāti gṛhṇāti mṛgayūryathā | tasmād vyādho bhavet kaścit pakṣimāro’thavā paśuḥ ||62|| mādhavo mātṛgāmī vā bhavet kaścit paśuprajaḥ | yasya niyāmako nāsti yasya nāsti dhavastathā ||63|| mātṛhīnaḥ pitṛhīno bhavet kaścid vanecaraḥ | itaḥ prāptaśca viḥ pakṣī taṃ yajñasyaiva sannidhau ||64|| san dhārayati bhakṣyārthaṃ śakunādo bhaveddhi saḥ | kleśaistāpaiḥ prakarṣaiśca śāmako lokanāśakaḥ ||65|| tasmād viplavakartā sa bhavet kaścittu ghātakī | mahāvidyāḥ kāmavidyāścoccāṭanīṃ vināśinīm ||66|| māriṇīṃ mohinīṃ cedvā jānātyayaṃ tadā pitaḥ | śvapāko vātha cāṇḍālo malino vā bhaveddhi saḥ ||67|| śāstreṣu racanāṃ cāyaṃ pratāraṇasya kārakaḥ | pratārako bhavet kaścit nahi śāstrasya kārakaḥ ||68|| ekākī tu vane’raṇye bhraman kuṭumbahīnakaḥ | advitīyo vidhuro’yaṃ tīrthamuṇḍī ca vā bhavet ||69|| na cyavate dhanaṃ dāne daridraḥ sa bhavet pitaḥ | sādhudharmavihīnaśca kapaṭī nindakaḥ khalaḥ ||2.87.70|| pracchannacauro nārīṇāṃ cāñcalyasya pravardhakaḥ | asaṃkhyavāranārīṇāṃ bhrāmako veṣadhārakaḥ ||71|| gopīnāmadṛśyakartā siddhamantrakaro bhavet| | kāminīnāṃ kāmanāyāḥ pūrako’nyāyakārakaḥ ||72|| dharmaloptā kulaloptā hyāsakto grāmyadarśane | krodhalobhādidoṣāṇāmākaro’jñānaśevadhiḥ ||73 || vyavahāravidhuraśca buddhihīno’titāmasī | paśupāśo bhavet kaścit kanyāharaḥ śiśupriyaḥ ||74|| yādṛśastādṛśo vāpi bhavenme kiṃ prayojanam | tadguṇānna sahe divyānadivyān vā kathañcana ||75|| nāsti kaścit tato dhyeyo bhajanīyo’pi me pitaḥ | ahaṃ śreṣṭhastataścāsmi nāsti śreṣṭho’pi kaścana ||76|| vibhīṣaṇastataḥ prāha mā putra taṃ vimānaya | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkamalāpatiḥ ||77|| sarvapatiḥ parameśaścāntaryāmī niyāmakaḥ | kartumakartumanyathākartuṃ śaktaḥ sa vai hariḥ ||78|| vartate bālarūpastaṃ bhaja sarvātmanā suta | divyāḥ santi guṇāstasminnekaiko mokṣado hi yaḥ ||79|| satyaṃ śaucaṃ dayā kṣāntistyāgaḥ santoṣa ārjavam | śamo damastapaḥ sāmyaṃ titikṣoparatiḥ śrutam ||2.87.80 || jñānaṃ viraktiraiśvaryaṃ śauryaṃ tejo balaṃ smṛtiḥ | svātantryaṃ kauśalaṃ kāntidhairyaṃ ca mārdavaṃ tathā ||8 1|| prāgalbhyaṃ praśrayaḥ śīlaṃ saha ojo balaṃ bhagaḥ | gāṃbhīryaṃ sthairyamāstikyaṃ kīrtirmāno’nahaṃkṛtiḥ |||82|| kṛtopakāraścādroho’nīhākiñcanatā tathā | maitrī sārvajñyamevaite guṇāḥ santi parātmani ||83|| adharmajīvano rakṣaḥ prāha manye na tān guṇān | ahaṃ napuṃsakaṃ manye kāryotsāhavivarjitam ||84|| dhamārthakāmanāhīnaṃ niṣkriyaṃ nirbalaṃ ca tam | parabhāgyopajīvitvaṃ parasampadvikarṣaṇam ||85|| amārgavāhitā cāpi manye tatraiva santi hi | tasmāt pitarna me vaktuṃ guṇānarhasi tasya vai ||86|| rādhike evamevāyamadharmajīvano’suraḥ | śatādhikān harau doṣān jagāda pitaraṃ prati ||87|| vibhīṣaṇastu taṃ kruddho jaghāna gadayā tadā | amṛtaśca vidudrāva siṃhaladvīpatastataḥ ||88|| kapaṭī mānavo bhūtvā saurāṣṭre cājagāma saḥ | śatrujayānadītīre trivaṭākhye bhuvastale ||89|| uvāsa kṛtaketaśca dviṣan kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | yativeṣadharo bhūtvā satāṃ vidveṣakaḥ khalaḥ ||2.87.90|| duṣṭo dharmadhvajo bhūtvāpratārayan janān bahūn | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe śrīparameśvare ||91|| vairaṃ kurvan vacobhiśca loke nāstikyamādadhan | āyayau kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ naṣṭāyureva saḥ ||92||| lomaśasyāśrame gatvā nininda parameśvaram | tadā śrīśaṃkaraḥ śrutvā bhairavaṃ prāha sevakam ||93|| yāhi bhairava duṣṭaṃ tamadharmajīvanāsuram | ghātayainaṃ piśācaistvaṃ nārakiṇaṃ hi karmaṇā ||94|| ityukto bhairavaḥ śūlaṃ dhṛtvā gatvā piśācakaiḥ | jīvagrāhaṃ gṛhītvā taṃ baddhvā cārmaṇarajjubhiḥ ||95|| nicikṣepa malasthāne viṣṭāvyāptakṣitau tadā | tanmakhe mūtrayāmāsurviṣṭhāṃ cakruḥ piśācakāḥ ||96|| mūḍhamāraṃ dṛḍhaṃ sarve mārayāmāsurāsuram | aṅgāni chedayāmāsuścikṣipurlāvaṇaṃ jalam ||97|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadveṣiṇameva te | tato rajjuprabandhena gṛdhravāsadrumāntare ||98|| śākhāyāṃ bandhayāmāsurlambate so’pyadhomukhaḥ | gṛdhrakākādiviṣṭhā ca patatyeva tu tanmukhe ||99|| evaṃ māsadvayaṃ daṇḍaṃ cakre śrībhairavo’sure | tataḥ kṣudhātṛṣāvyāpto mamāra prāṇato hi saḥ || 2.87.100 || yayau yamālayaṃ so’yamasuro’dharmajīvanaḥ | kuṃbhīpāte’patattatra sahasravatsaraṃ hiṃ saḥ || 10 1|| athātra bhairavo devaḥ sasnau cāśvasarovare | tasya saṃsargadoṣotthapāpaprakṣālanāya vai || 1 02|| evaṃ vināśamāpanno’suro’dharmaprajīvanaḥ | śiśupriyaḥ svapāpena mṛto’sadgatimārgagaḥ || 1 03|| rādhike me’parādhasya kartṝṇāṃ nāsti sadgatiḥ | yadi syāccharaṇāpannastadā gatiṃ dadāmyaham || 1 04|| atha śaraṇaṃ nāyāto mṛto’pi parameśvaram | tataḥ koṭyarbudavarṣerapyasya sadratirna vai || 1 05|| āṣāḍhe sa mṛto daityasamo rakṣo’tinindakaḥ | atha vibhīṣaṇaḥ śrutvādharmajīvamṛtiṃ tataḥ || 1 06|| nītvā tanmātaraṃ tatra saurāṣṭre vyomamārgataḥ | āyayau cārthayāmāsa sadgatiṃ parameśvarāt || 1 07|| harirjanmāntare prāha tasya gatirbhaviṣyati | mama hastena mṛtyuṃ sa labdhvā yāsyati sadgatim || 1 08|| tasya mātre dadau mantraṃ lomaśarṣistataḥ param | vibhīṣaṇāya mantraṃ sa dadau śrīpārameśvaram || 1 09|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | māsaṃ sthitvā yayatustau rādhike vai nijālayam || 2.87.110 || bhejāte śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | vibhīṣaṇaśca khacarī tvante divyau babhūvatuḥ || 111 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kharaputrasyādharmajīvanasya nāstikyaṃ, harerguṇeṣvaguṇakalpanāḥ, harau dveṣo’sadgatistataḥ kālāntare sadgativaradānamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 87 ||
<2.88> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ rādhike divyaṃ camatkāraṃ punarhareḥ | prayāge kuṃbhayoge tu koṭiśo dehino yayuḥ || 1 || mānavā nāgadaityāśca surāḥ ṛṣigaṇāstathā | pitaro munayaḥ siddhāḥ śrāvaṇe tatra cāyayuḥ || 2 || daśakrośeṣu sarvatra nagaraṃ nūtanaṃ hyabhūt| | tadbahirdevavṛkṣāśca vallikā ūṣurutsukāḥ || 3 || divyānyapi ca tīrthāni divyānyapi sarāṃsi ca | saritaḥ sarvato divyāḥ kūpā vāpyaśca dīrghikāḥ || 4 || āyayustatra vai snātuṃ kuṃbhayoge tu saṅgame | gaṃgāyamunayoryoge sarasvatyāḥ samāgame || 5 || śrāvaṇe ca tathā bhādrapade sasnuśca tīrthake | tairthikairnijapāpāni triveṇyāṃ kṣālitāni vai || 6 || atha tatra mahātyāgī sādhuḥ sanatkumārakaḥ | brahmaputraḥ pañcavarṣabālarūpaḥ samāyayau || 7 || divyāṇuvyomayānastho’yutabhāskarasannibhaḥ | dyotayan bhūtalaṃ sarvaṃ diśo’mbaraṃ samantataḥ || 8 || āścaryaṃ dehinaḥ prāpurdevādyāstoṣamāyayuḥ | vimānaṃ sūkṣmarūpaṃ tadvikāsamagamat punaḥ || 9 || yatra divyasvarūpaḥ sa yogī bālo hyadṛśyata | śanairavātarad bhūmāvakṣayavaṭasannidhau || 2.88.1 0|| tatra tasthau mahāyogī śīghraṃ cādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ | prāvirāsa triveṇyāṃ saḥ sasnau śīghraṃ hariṃ smaran || 1 1|| tiro bhūtvā kṣaṇād yatra vimānaṃ tatra cāyayau | vaṭasparśaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā nanāma vaṭaśāyinam || 12|| pupūja divyakusumairvavande vedasaṃstavaiḥ | tāvattatrāyayurjñātvā devarṣipitṛmānavāḥ || 13|| darśanārthaṃ samāgatya puṣpādyaistamapūjayan | svāgataṃ kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭvā parasparaṃ ca te tataḥ || 14|| tasthuścāpi niṣeduśca viśāle bhūtale divi | tāvattatra tu tīrthāni nadā nadyaḥ samāyayuḥ || 15|| prayāgo mūrtimām̐ścāpi sarāṃsi kūpavāpikāḥ | pūṣā kaṭvī ca pannārī candrāvatī ca mañjirā || 16|| indrāvatī kuśī mahānadī huhūgalī tathā | gaṇḍakī kañcanagaṃgā śatalājā ca gogarā || 17|| cambalā cīnapā nandā jhelamā kābilā nadī | luṇī sindhustathā cānyā militvā brahmaṇaḥ sutam || 18|| sanatkumāraṃ papracchurnatvā pāpavināśakam | ṛṣie dvādaśavarṣeṣu yāni pāpāni dehinām || 19|| asmāsu tu samāgatya kṣālitāni bhavanti vai | tāni tiṣṭhanti sarvāṇi dvādaśavatsarāṇi ca ||2.88.20 || kuṃbhasnānaprasaṃgena tyaktānyatra prayāgake | tadā vayaṃ sukhaṃ śāntiṃ prāpnumaḥ pāpavarjitāḥ || 21|| kintu varṣe vatsare ca prativarṣaṃ kathamṛṣe | pāpanāśo bhavennastu yena śāntirbhavet sadā ||22|| māse māse tathā pakṣe ghorapāpadine tathā | yatra gatvā pāpaśāntiryathā bhavet pradarśaya |||23|| mahāpāpātipāpānāṃ jvalanaṃ yatra jāyate | tatsthalaṃ dāhakaṃ vipra pradarśaya ca naḥ prabho ||24|| prayāgaśca haridvāraḥ puṣkaro nāśikastathā | kuṃbhe pāpaharāḥ sarve pāpavanto bhavanti te ||25| | tataste pāpanāśārthaṃ yānti śrīkṛṣṇagomatīm | ityevaṃ nāradāt pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ godāvarītaṭe ||26|| tatra yāmo’thavā śreṣṭhaṃ tīrthottamaṃ bhaved bhuvi | kathayātra ṛṣe sarvaṃ viditaṃ te’sti mānase ||27 || iti pṛṣṭo brahmaputraḥ sanātanahariḥ svayam | sanatkumāranāmāsau prāha tirthāni tādṛśam ||28|| śreṣṭhācchreṣṭhatamaṃ sadyaḥ pratyahaṃ pāpadāhakam | mahāpāpātipāpānāṃ yāvadbrahmāṇḍavartinām ||29|| īśvarāṇāmīśvaro yaścāvatārādhipaḥ prabhuḥ | paramātmā mahākṛṣṇo’nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||2.88.3 0|| parabrahmākṣaramuktapatiḥ paratarātparaḥ | paradhāmanivāsaśca svāmī svāminikeśvaraḥ || 21 || bhagavatāṃ yāvatāṃ yo bhagavān yasya no samaḥ | adhikastu bhavennaiva yatra kāṣṭhā parā gatiḥ ||32|| so’yaṃ rājādhirājaśca svamūrteḥ kṣaṇamātrataḥ | rādhāpatiṃ śrīpatiṃ ca lakṣmīpatiṃ satīpatim ||3 3 || āviścakāra vasituṃ tebhyo dhāmāni saṃdadau | dadāvaiśvaryasiddhīśca dadau nijaguṇām̐stathā || 34|| so’yaṃ śrīkambharāputraḥ śrīmadgopālanandanaḥ | sṛṣṭyādau yatra prathamaṃ prāvirbabhūva bālavat || 35|| vartate kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre muktaprasevitaḥ | muktānībhiḥ sevitaśca brahmapriyāprasevitaḥ ||36|| munibhirlomaśādyaiśca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraiḥ | avatāraiḥ sevitaśca sahasrabhujaviṣṇubhiḥ || 37|| lakṣamastakavedhobhirvāsudevādibhistathā | sevito vandito yatra bhūmāvakṣarasaṃjñake ||38|| kṣetre’śvapaṭṭasaraso’bhitaḥ krīḍati mādhavaḥ | lomaśasyāśramasyāpyantike sarvatra vartate ||39|| yatra muktā vṛkṣarūpā surapatnyaśca vallayaḥ | muktāḥ stambasvarūpāśca vartante darśanecchayā ||2.88.40 || yatprasādecchukā devā bhūtvā pipīlikātmakāḥ | api haṃsacaṭakādyāścarantyaśvasaro’bhitaḥ ||41 || daśayojanakaṃ kṣetraṃ cākṣarabrahma tanmatam | yadrajasā parivyāptāḥ kīṭā yānti parāṃ gatim ||582|| pratyaṇubhūtalaṃ tattu divyaṃ mokṣapradaṃ śubham | parameśvarayogena pavano’pi pramokṣadaḥ ||43|| vallayaścāpi vṛkṣā vai lokān pavitrayanti hi | aśvapadrṛsarasyeva bhagavān nityameva tu ||44|| snāti khelati bhaktaiśca brahmahrado’tra vartate | gaṃgādyāni sutīrthāni vartante tajjalādiṣu ||45||| amṛtākhyo hradaścāpi virajā yamunādikāḥ | vartante tatra sarasi śrīhareryogalālasāḥ ||46 || tādṛśaṃ pāvanaṃ loke svarge satye rasātale | vaikuṇṭhādau ca vā nadyo vartante nādhikaṃ tataḥ ||47|| puruṣottamayogāt tat saro’kṣarasvarūpatām | prāptaṃ sarvokṛṣṭatāṃ ca pāpatāpanivārakam || 48|| nityaṃ gatvaiva tatraiva snātavyaṃ sāyamityapi | divājātāni pāpāni dahyanti tatprasaṃgataḥ ||49|| prātargatvāplavanaṃ ca kāryaṃ tena niśodbhavam | pāpaṃ sarvaṃ vilīyeta snātuścāśvasarovare ||2.88.5 0 || pratiparva pragantavyaṃ snātavyaṃ tatra dehibhiḥ | divyādivyairātmabhiśca vāsanākalmaṣāpahe ||51 || māse māse ca vā varṣe ṛtau vā cāyane’pi vā | snātavyaṃ tatra gatvaiva sarvapāpaṃ daheddhi tat ||52|| tatrāste kuṃkumavāpī yasyā jalaṃ hariḥ svayam | sadā pibati naivedyaiḥ saha vāpyā jale tathā ||53|| aśvapaṭṭasaraścedaṃ nityaṃ snāti prage hyage
