| seyaṃ kuṃkumavāpīti śrīharerhṛdayaṃ matam ||54|| tatparaṃ nāsti tīrthaṃ vai dhāmalokeṣu kutracit | devalokeṣu vā nāsti nāstīśvarādidhāmasu ||55|| kutaḥ pṛthvyāṃ tu labhyeta vinā kuṃkumavāpikām | kuṃkumavāpikātulyā kuṃkumavāpikā svayam ||56|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇatulyaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam | kaṃbharāśrīsatītulyā kaṃbharāśrīsatī svayam ||17|| gopālakṛṣṇatulyaśca gopālakṛṣṇa eva saḥ | akṣaraṃ cākṣaratulyaṃ paraṃ tulyaṃ na vidyate ||58|| etadbrahmāṇḍatulyaṃ ca etadbrahmāṇḍameva hi | yatrānādiḥ parabrahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’sti hi ||59|| tatra nadyo bhavatyastu gatvā kurvantu cāplavam | aśvapaṭṭasarodivyavāriṇi prātareva ca ||2.88.60|| pibantu kuṃkumavāpījalaṃ haripadāmṛtam | pratyakṣaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca prasevantāṃ divāniśam ||6 1|| vasantu devyastatraiva mūlarūpaiḥ sadā sukham | kāryarūpairviharantu deśeṣu jalarūpikāḥ ||62|| bālakṛṣṇasya yogena yūyaṃ prāpsyatha satsukham | lānirdeśyamavarṇyaṃ cāsīmātyānandalakṣaṇam ||63|| yanmūrtisthaḥ parānando’kṣare brahmaṇi nāsti ca | anyatra tu kutaḥ syādvai tat sukhaṃ lapsyatha dhruvam ||64|| sarvātmanārpaṇenaiva bālakṛṣṇasya sevane | sarvaṃ sukhaṃ haristuṣṭo dāsyatyeva nijapriyam ||65|| yatrāntaraṃ manāk cāste tatrānande’pi cāntaram | yatrāntaraṃ na tatrāsti tatrānande na cāntaram ||66 || dvayoraikye pravāhāśca sukhasyāvirbhavanti vai | sacchrīkṛṣṇo naraśreṣṭhaḥ, cit bhavatyastu sevikāḥ ||67|| tayorānanda evāyaṃ tatra duḥkhasya kā kathā | pāpāni kṛṣṇayogena vilīyante kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ||68|| puṇyānāṃ parvatāstatra prodbhavanti kṣaṇe kṣaṇe | ānandānāṃ pravāhāśca sāmudrā iva sarvaśaḥ ||69|| jāyante śrīhareryogāt sevantāṃ yāntu taṃ harim | ityevaṃ kathyamānānāṃ nadīnāṃ romamaṇḍalāt ||2.88.70|| niryayuḥ sūkṣmakīṭā vai kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ samantataḥ | tebhyaḥ pṛṣṭaṃ tadā tābhiḥ ke bhavanto’tra niryayuḥ ||71 || ūcuḥ kīṭā vayaṃ pāpānyaghināṃ pāparūpiṇaḥ| bhavatīṣu samutsṛjya pāpino yānti vai gṛham ||72|| vayaṃ tāni nirgatā vo dehebhyo’śvasaraḥsmṛteḥ | gamiṣyāmo vayaṃ nadyastvanyatra parvatādiṣu ||73|| anyathā vastatra gatvā snānamātreṇa naḥ kṣayaḥ | ityevaṃ bhayamāsādya nirgatānyatra jīvataḥ ||74|| ye smṛtvā kuṃkumavāpīṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ paraṃ prabhum | aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetramakṣaraṃ yānti tatprati ||75|| taiḥ kṛte saṃkrame śīghraṃ naśyantyaghāni sarvaśaḥ | tasmādvayaṃ jīvanecchāvanto yāmaḥ sthalāntaram ||76 || maraṇājjīvanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tapasā vā kṣudhāpi vā | kvacidavaśyaṃ jāyeta jīvata bhadradarśanam ||77|| puruṣārtho’pi jāyeta labhyeteṣṭaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | ityuktvā niryayuḥ sarvāghāni saridgaṇāttadā ||78|| tīrthāni cāpurāścaryaṃ yasya śravaṇataḥ khalu | pāpāni yānti vai dūraṃ tattīrthaṃ kīdṛśaṃ bhavet ||79|| tasmād gatvaiva sevyaṃ tat vastavyaṃ tatra caiva nu | iti niścitya ca muniṃ praśaśaṃsuḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||2.88.80|| pupūjuścātibhāvena samūcuśca muniṃ muhuḥ | sanatkumāra bhagavan prāpaya kṣetrameva naḥ ||8 1 || tvayā sahaikavāraṃ tvamupakāraṃ vidhehi naḥ | omityevaṃ jagādāsau munistīrthāni tatkṣaṇam |||82|| pṛthivyāṃ yāni kānyeva jahṛṣuścāti sarvaśaḥ | śīghraṃ vārtā prakāśaṃ sābhavat kuṃbhāgateṣu tu ||82 || sanatkumāro bhagavān sarvapāpaviśuddhaye | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prati prayāti vai ||84|| sarvatīrthāni cādāya saha kuṃkumavāpikām | yatra sākṣāddhariścāste bālakṛṣṇaḥ pareśvara ||85|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre yatrāste lomaśo muniḥ | kuṃbhaṃ kṛtvā tu gacchāmo divyatāprāptaye khalu ||86 || ityevaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā dhṛtvopakaraṇāni ca | tīrthayātrāvidhānārthaṃ tīrthāni niryayustadā ||87|| sarvakhaṇḍasthanadyastu sarvakhaṇḍasarāṃsi ca | sarvakhaṇḍagatāḥ kūpā vāpyo’khātāśca sāgarāḥ ||88|| nirjharaṇāni sarvāṇi taṭākā dīrghikāstathā | saṃgamāni nadīnāṃ ca samudrasaritāṃ tathā ||89|| jalatīrthāni cālokya pṛthvītīrthāni yānyapi | pārvatāni sthalāni gahvarāṇyucchrayāṇi ca || 2.88.90|| vanānyaraṇyavaryāṇi ghāṭāni saritastathā | dvīpānāṃ saritaścāpi tīrthayātrārthamāgatāḥ ||91|| mimiluḥ sahayoginyaḥ sahayogā yathāyatham | parvatāḥ śṛṃgaśailāśca taddevā devikāstathā ||12|| hradā hadinyaḥ sarvāstu padbhiryātrāṃ vyadhurhitām | lakṣasaṃkhyāni tīrthāni tathānye lakṣaśo’pi ca ||93|| vādyairvāditrakairvaṃśaistrāsakaiḥ karatālakaiḥ | mṛdaṃgairdvimṛdaṃgaiśca bherībhiḥ svaravādyakaiḥ ||94|| tāratantrībhirevāpi tumburādyaistathetaraiḥ | suvādyaiḥ saha gāyantaḥ kīrtanāni harestu vai ||95|| āśvīnamāsamāsādya prayāgānniryayuḥ sukham | mārge te puṣkaraṃ kṛtvā gatvā siddhāśramaṃ tathā ||96|| satīṃ bahucarāṃ natvā catuṣṭilakaparvatam | dṛṣṭvā tīrthāni devāśca siddhā maharṣayastathā ||97|| pitaraḥ parvatādyāśca divyarūpadharāḥ khalu | āyayuḥ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetrasīmāntikaṃ mudā ||98|| sanatkumārasahitāḥ ṛṣayaśca mahārṣayaḥ | tathānye divyadehāśca yogino’pi samāyayuḥ ||99|| viśaśramustu te kṣetrāduttarāt śāṃkarīṃ diśam | kramavyūhaṃ tataścakruḥ samājotsavabodhakam || 2.88.10 0|| rādhike svargavāsinyo devyo gāndharvya ityapi | satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ samājagmustīrthadarśanalālasāḥ || 10 1|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrīsanatkumārarṣipradarśitāśvapaṭṭasaromāhātmyena sarvatīrthānāṃ prayāgataḥ kuṃkumavāpīṃ prati yātrānirdeśanāmāṣṭāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 88 ||
<2.89> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca kṣetre kuṃkumavāpyākhye prāgbhāge rādhike śubham | amarāṇāṃ nivāsārhaṃ vanaṃ vai pārijātakam || 1 || viśālaṃ yojanāyāmaṃ tataśceśānadigbhavam | vanaṃ kādambamutkṛṣṭaṃ yojanatrayavistṛtam || 2 || tataścottarato bhadrānadī divyā virājate | yasyāṃ sthale sthale sasnau svāmikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 3 || tasyāstīre suviśramya snātvā saṃbhakṣya pāyasam | tato yātrāsamājo vai sasārāgre gṛṇan harim || 4 || bhūmāvarttagajaścāgre svarṇacitrādirañjitaḥ | gairikāśailatulyaḥ sa bherīṃ jīmūtasadṛśīm || 5 || udvahan yāti cāgre vai saśabdā garjanāvatīm | tatpaścāccharabho yāti vairājāvarttanāmakaḥ || 6 || paṭahadvayamucchabdaṃ pṛṣṭhe vahan samucchrayaḥ | tatpaścānmāṇikīpṛṣṭhe dhvajaṃ śatakarāyatam || 7 || kauśeyaṃ svarṇatārādipañcadevavirājitam | udvahan yāti vindhyādrirabbhrāṇi karṣayan dhvaje || 8 || tatpaścācchaṃkhanādaśca daśadikṣu ninādavān | maruddevakṛto bhāti bhūyate svargavāsibhiḥ || 9 || tatpaścād rodasī cāpi ninādayat sudhātujam | vigalaṃ bhagavān dhṛtvā vāmano yāti hāsayan || 2.89.10|| tatpaścācchrīnṛsiṃhaśca svayaṃ vai garjayan diśaḥ | divyasiṃhacchaṭāśobhaḥ prayāti piṃganetrakaḥ || 11 || tatpaścādaśvinīdevau sūryacandrasamāvubhau | surūpau turagārūḍhau kurvāte jayaghoṣaṇām || 1 2|| tatpaścācchvetavārāho dhunvan digantakān balī | garjayan yāti tīrthārthaṃ śvetavarṇo’tirūpavān || 13|| tato yānti ca gandharvā vādakā vādyavedinaḥ | vādayanti ca jhaṃkārān karatālān mṛdaṃgakān || 14|| vīṇāṃ mayūrakāṃścāpi tantrīṃ jalaninādakān | prāṇapāśān gālaśabdān tālikātālapaṭṭakān || 15|| vṛttabherīḥ paṭahām̐śca veṇunālān sṛjihvikāḥ | trāṭakān citraghoṣām̐śca śalākān rāgiṇīstathā || 16 || evaṃvidhāni vādyāni hyavādyanta tataḥ param | tato vai kīrtanakārāḥ puṃtīrthāḥ saṃprayānti hi || 17|| divyāḥ siddhāstato yānti satyaḥ sādhvyaśca sādhavaḥ | kīrtayanti harernāma savādyaṃ kṛṣṇamānasāḥ || 18|| tato yānti pitaraśca jayaśabdaiśca kīrtanaiḥ | tato vai devatā yānti surāḥ sarve dyuvāsinaḥ || 1 9|| tato yānti ca ṛṣayaḥ satyasthā bhūgatāstathā | kīrtayantaśca vedānāṃ mantrān sāmastavām̐stathā || 2.89.20|| tato’pi cāraṇā bhāṭā gandharvā gāyakāstathā | prayānti vādyaghoṣaiśca nāmakīrtanakāriṇaḥ || 21 || tatpaścācca surarājāḥ prayānti lokapālakāḥ | tatpaścāt saritaḥ sarvā nadyaḥ prasravaṇāni ca ||22|| sarāṃsi ca taḍāgāśca prayānti kīrtayanti ca | tato yānti ṛṣipatnyo devyastataḥ surastriyaḥ ||23|| kīrtayantyo bālakṛṣṇapadyāni premapūritāḥ | tato yānti vanāraṇyaśailabhūtīrthamaṇḍalam ||24|| tato dāsāstathā dāsyastato yānti ca mānavāḥ | evaṃ yātrāpravāhaśca samājo yojanāvadhim ||25||| dīrghāṃbhavattadā divyaḥ puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūttadā | mahīmānāni tīrthāni tvāgacchantīti vīkṣya ca || 26|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāgatavāñcchayā | agragobhūccātiharṣāt tathā gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||27|| kapilādyāḥ sādhavaśca lomaśādyā maharṣayaḥ | rādhāramādyāḥ satyaśca śaṃkarādyāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ ||28|| viprā vedavidaścāpi kanyāḥ koṭyarbudārbudam | brahmapriyāḥ kambharāśrīstathā sarvāśca vallikā || 25|| tīrthaṃ kuṃkumavāpī ca tathānyā dīrghikāḥ śubhāḥ | kṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarastathāśramasya pādapāḥ ||2.89.30|| kṣetrapālāśca tīrthāni sarvāṇyaśvasarastaṭe | yāni vasanti ye devā nadyo nadāśca parvatāḥ ||3 1|| sarve te dhṛtamālāśca madhuparkādisaṃyutāḥ | gītavāditrayuktāśca tairthikānabhisaṃyayuḥ ||32|| brahmahṛdo’śvataṭākastathā kuṃkumavāpikā | agre yayurhareḥ pārśve virajādyāstato yayuḥ ||33|| āgatāste mahīmānā vilokya harimandiram | prāsādaṃ sāptabhaumaṃ ca śātakauṃbhaṃ tathāparam ||34|| namaścakrurdaṇḍavacca dhūliṃ nyadhuśca mūrddhasu | jayaśabdān jagaduśca pūrṇotsāhapariplutāḥ ||35|| viviśuḥ kṣetrapīṭhaṃ te dūraṃ tu yojanaṃ yadā | mimiluścakrurālokaṃ jayadhvanīn punaḥ punaḥ ||36|| parasparaṃ sukhavādān papracchuḥ svāgataṃ tathā | cakrustīrthātmanāṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śrī bhagavān svayam ||37|| aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ tīrthānāmāgamo mama | ityuktvā śrīharistebhyo madhuparkādikaṃ dadau ||38|| puṣpahārān candanāni puṣpamālā daduḥ pare | militvā kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭvā samāśliṣya yathocitam ||39|| tairthikāstīrthakāmāśca kṛṣṇakīrtanatatparāḥ | āyayuḥ kuṃkumavāpīsannidhāvāśvasārasam ||2.89.40|| luluṭhuḥ kṣetramārgasya dhūlyāṃ tīrthāni vai muhuḥ | mahadbhāgyaṃ manyamānā devā devyastatharṣayaḥ ||41|| kecinnṛtyanti gāyanti vādayantyapare tadā | dhārayanti rajo mūrdhni dehe sammardayanti ca ||42|| namanti mastakaiḥ kecit kecidañjalinā harim | kecid vakṣaḥsu ca rajo yojayanti pare mukhe ||43|| svayaṃkumāro bhagavān luloṭha kṛṣṇapādayoḥ | kecid vijñāya māhātmyaṃ bhaktānāṃ padrajāṃsi ca ||44|| ṛṣīṇāṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ dhārayanti ca mūrdhasu | kecit patrāṇi puṣpāṇi śalākāśca tṛṇānyapi ||45|| gṛhṇanti tu mukhe dhṛtvā manvate kṛtakṛtyatām | jalaṃ prasravaṇotthaṃ ca matvā pāpapraṇāśakam ||46|| ghaṭukaṃ ghaṭukaṃ pītvā manvate kṛtakṛtyatām | kecit tvaśvasarovārispṛṣṭaṃ vāyuṃ samāgatam ||47|| mukhe pītvā muhuryānti nirvṛttiṃ paramāṃ tadā | kecit smaranti dhāmāni kecittadavatārakān ||48|| kecinmuktān tadaiśvaryasiddhīḥ smaranti taddhṛdaḥ | āyudhāścakraśaṃkhādyāḥ pārṣadāḥ sevikāstathā ||49|| mahīmānān yadiṣṭaṃ tad dāpayanti pathi drutam | evaṃ vādyaiḥ kīrtanaiśca vāhanaiḥ premapūrakaiḥ ||2.89.50 || jayanādaiḥ saha sarve prāpuḥ saro’śvasaṃjñakam | yeṣāṃ vajrasamānyāsan pāpāni dehināṃ tadā ||51 || tīrthe tyaktāni sarvāṇi tānyapyasaṃkhyakāni vai | aśvapaṭṭasarasastu darśanāt haridarśanāt ||52|| dagdhānyeva drutaṃ tatra śeṣamātraṃ na vidyate | anyatīrthe kṛte snāne yāni prayānti dūrataḥ ||53 || tāni dagdhāni sarvāṇi cāśvasaro vilokanāt | aho kṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate mahat ||54|| yadrajo yajjalaṃ yasya kṣetrasya patramityapi | dāhayanti ca pāpāni kiṃ vaktavyaṃ harau tadā ||55|| evaṃ praśaṃsamānāste mahīmānāḥ sarastaṭe | uttare’tiviśāle ca śāṃkare supradeśake ||56|| viśaśramustathā sasnuḥ papurjalaṃ vavandire | tīrthavidhiṃ pracakruścākṣālayan pāpamātrakam ||57|| athānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ saṃsnāpya tajjalaiḥ | cakruḥ snānāni tīrthādyāḥ papurvāri prasādajam ||58|| divyavārbhirdivyarūpā muktarūpāśca te’bhavan | evaṃ cāśvasarastīrthaṃṃ kṛtvā vidhānatastataḥ ||59|| yayuḥ śrīkuṃkumavāpīṃ viśālāṃ dhāmarūpiṇīm | tajjalaṃ vai papuḥ sarve sasnurjalairmuhurmuhuḥ ||2.89.60 || tadā sārṣṭi tu te prāptāstīrthādyā harivāñcchayā | tato brahmahradaṃ gatvā sasnuḥ papuśca tajjalam ||6 1|| tataḥ sārūpyabhāvaṃ ca prāptāste mahīmānakāḥ | vālakṛṣṇasamāḥ sarve guṇarūpasamṛddhibhiḥ ||62|| sañjātā muktiyogyāste punarjanmavivarjitāḥ | athottaraṃ yayuḥ sarve lomaśasyāśramaṃ śubham ||63|| lomaśaḥ svāgataṃ cakre miṣṭānnaphalavāribhiḥ | bhojayāmāsa tīrthādyān sarvān vai mahīmānakān ||64|| brahmadhāmānītadugdhasārairbhojyaiśca tarpaṇaiḥ | tṛptiṃ prakārayāmāsa mukhavāsān samārpayat ||65|| yayustīrthāni sarvāṇi devarṣipitṛmānavāḥ | nadā nadyaḥ parvatāśca vanāraṇyāni yānyapi ||66|| mahīmānāśca te sarve bālakṛṣṇālayaṃ śubham | divyaṃ divyavibhūtyāḍhyaṃ divyamuktaniṣevitam ||67|| apratarkyānantaśaktisevitaṃ ceśvarāśrayam | avatāraiḥ sadā juṣṭaṃ sāyujyamuktidaṃ śubham ||68|| tatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasnātajalahrade | divye brahmahradaśreṣṭhe prasasnurmahīmānakāḥ ||69|| divyadehā divyadṛṣṭiyuktā divye pare’kṣarāt | dhāmni sthitān nijān sarve hyapaśyanta hi śāśvatān ||2.89.70 || tadā pūrṇaṃ mahimānaṃ vividurmahīmānakāḥ | sālokyaṃ sārṣṭi sārūpyaṃ sāyujyaṃ cātra santi vai ||71|| pāpamuktiścānyatīrthe tvaśvasaro’ghadāhakam | sārṣṭidā kuṃkumavāpī brahmahradaḥ svarūpadaḥ ||72|| sālokyadaṃ lomaśasyāśramaṃ divyaṃ hi vartate | bālakṛṣṇālayaścāyaṃ sāyujyamuktido’sti hi ||73 || aho kṛṣṇapratāpena sarve tvekaikataḥ khalu | vardhante cātisāmarthye mokṣadāḥ sarvathāpyaho ||74|| atra vāsaḥ prakartavyo’thavā gantavyamakṣare | parabrahmaṇi samprāpte ko’nyatra saṃvasedaghī ||75|| evaṃ vai kathayantaste vyadhurmahotsavaṃ niśi | cāndre tu kumude māse saptamyāḥ kṛṣṇake dale ||76|| gāyanaiḥ kīrtanairnṛtyairbhajanaiḥ stavanaistathā | dhyānaiḥ kathāśravaiścāpi ninyurniśāṃ sukhaṃ tu te ||77|| prātaḥ snātvāśvasarasi kṛṣṇārcanārthamāyayuḥ | sarve tvekādaśe janmadine’ṣṭamyāṃ mahotsave ||78|| nirmite maṇḍape rātrau viśāle viśvakarmaṇā | madhye gajāsane tatra vyarājata hariḥ svayam ||79|| anyānyapyāsanānyatra siṃhāsanāni sarvaśaḥ | sthāpitāni ca teṣvatreśvareśvarāḥ pareśvarāḥ ||2.89.80 || avatārāstathā muktā muktānyaḥ sādhvya ityapi | sādhavo brahmaśīlāśca devā devyo maharṣayaḥ ||81|| brahmādyāḥ ṛṣayaścāpi pitaro devakoṭayaḥ | vyarājanta ca tīrthāni nadā nadyaḥ sarāṃsi ca ||82|| lokapālā rājyapālāḥ śailā vanāni bhūmayaḥ | araṇyāśca drumā vallyastṛṇāni dīrghikāstathā ||83|| jaḍacetanatattvāni vyarājantāsaneṣu ca | devavādyānyavādyanta māṃgalyānyabhavam̐stadā ||84|| vedaghoṣāhyajāyantābhavatkusumavarṣaṇam | lomaśo munirāṭ māyāvarjito’pūjayaddharim ||85|| tilakaṃ candrakaṃ bhāle’kārayatparamātmanaḥ | mukuṭaṃ nidadhe tasya mastake mālikāṃ śubhām ||86|| kānakīṃ taulasīṃ cāpi pauṣpīṃ rātnīṃ dadau gale | puṣpāṃjaliṃ dadau cāpi durvāṃkurāṇi karṇayoḥ ||87|| haste śrīphalamagryaṃ ca dadau phalāni cāgrataḥ | candanaṃ pādayoścāpyavardhayaccākṣataistataḥ ||88|| ārārtrikaṃ hareścakre āśīrvādān dadau śubhān | atha śrīkaṃbharādevī pupūja bālakṛṣṇakam ||89|| śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaśca hāraṃ kṛṣṇagale nyadhāt | bhagavān śukadevaśca vallabhādyā daduḥ srajaḥ ||2.89.90 || hemanto bhagavāścāpi haimyupadāḥ samuttamāḥ | santoṣā cāmṛtā dugdhā jīvantyādyā daduḥ srajaḥ | tilakaṃ kauṃkumaṃ cakrurbhāle binduṃ harestataḥ ||91 || atheśvarā avatārā muktā muktānya īśikāḥ | pūjayitvārārtrikaṃ ca pracakruḥ śrīharestadā ||92|| brahmavratāḥ ṛṣayaśca pitaraḥ suramānavāḥ | devā devyo nadā nadyaḥ sarāṃsyupajalānyapi ||93|| śailāśca bhūmayo’khātāstīrthāni ca vanāni ca | araṇyāni ca tattvāni pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ||94|| ārārtrikaṃ tathā puṣpāñjalīn tathopadā daduḥ | ābhūṣaṇāni vastrāṇi tathopakaraṇānyapi ||95|| ūrmikāḥ phalapuṣpāṇi ratnāni hīrakāṇi ca | yānāni kalpavṛkṣām̐śca dadurdivyāni pūjane ||96|| evaṃ pūjottaraṃ sabhāparihārottaraṃ hariḥ | bhojayāmāsa sarvān vai mahīmānān gṛhīyakān ||97|| āgantukānatithīṃśca sarvān dehina ityapi | dadau tu dakṣiṇāstebhyaḥ prāsādikāni bhāvataḥ ||98|| tadā tīrthaiḥ kṛtā tatrābhyarthanā śrīhareḥ puraḥ | labdhvā mokṣapradaṃ lābhaṃ cānyaṃ lābhaṃ ka icchati ||99|| tasmānmokṣaṃ kṛpāsindho dehi naḥ śāśvataṃ sukham | hariḥ kṛpayā teṣāṃ vai vyadhād rūpatrayaṃ tadā || 2.89.1 00|| mūlaṃ divyaṃ tathā chāyāṃ mūlarūpāṇi dhāmasu | vimānaiḥ so’preṣayacca pārṣadaiḥ saha keśavaḥ || 101 || divyānyatha svarūpāṇi svasannidhāvarakṣayat | aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre yatheṣṭaṃ nyavasam̐śca te || 1 02|| tīrthātmakāḥ samūrtāśca viśvakarmakṛteṣu ca | yogyālayeṣu santuṣṭā hareḥ sevābhilāṣukāḥ || 103 || chāyārūpāṇi tīrthānāṃ yāni tatrābhavam̐stadā | tebhyaḥ prāha prabhurlokapāvanārthaṃ śubhaṃ vacaḥ || 1 04|| madicchayaiva tīrtheśā yuṣmajjanmāsti bhūtale | lokānāṃ pāvanārthaṃ vai tasmādgantavyamīśvarāḥ || 1 05|| kāryarūpeṇa tatraiva sthātavyaṃ yatra saṃsthitiḥ | mayā kṛtāsti loke’tra nadīnadasarāṃsi ca || 106 || tattathaiva hi vastavyaṃ pāpipāpadahāya vai | āgantavyaṃ prativarṣaṃ janmāhe mama sarvaśaḥ || 1 07|| parvaṇyekādaśīkāle kuṃbhe māghe ca kārtike | saṃkrāntau śrāvaṇe cāpi vaiśākhe puruṣottame || 1 08|| ityuktāste samūrtāśca tīrtheśvarāḥ praṇamya ca | yayurnaijān pradeśāṃśca mahīmānā yayustathā || 1 09|| brahmapriyā hariṃ kāntaṃ prapūjya lomaśāśramam | yayuśca rādhike sarve svasvasthānāni mānavāḥ || 2.89.11 0|| rātrāvapyutsavaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kṛto nartanagāyanaiḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktimuktiprado bhavet || 11 1|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne sarvatīrthadevādīnāṃ kuṃkumavāpīyātrāgamanaṃ, śrīharerjanmadinotsavaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 89 ||
<2.90> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rādhe camatkāraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai | anyaṃ te saṃkathayāmi lokarakṣākaraṃ param || 1 || naranārāyaṇau devau dharmaputrau himālaye | badaryāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sasmaratuḥ purā || 2 || ūrjakṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ tau tāpasau svodbhavaṃ prabhum | gaṃgātīre dadhyatuśca svāśrame darśanotsukau || 3 || pṛthivyāṃ paścime prānte saurāṣṭre cājanābhaje | kṣetre kuṃkumavāpyākhye kambharāśrīgṛhe hariḥ || 4 || yastvāste bālarūpo’sau parabrahma paraḥ prabhuḥ | sarvāvatārahetuḥ saḥ kadā dāsyati darśanam || 5 || ityevaṃ smaratorbhrātrornaranārāyaṇātmanoḥ | saṃkalpaṃ sampūrayituṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 6 || aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetragatān bhaktān prabhāṣya ca | yayau yānena dityena haimādribadarīvanam || 7 || lomaśaṃ saha nītvaiva śeṣān saṃsthāpya tatra ca | rakṣaṇārthaṃ kathayitvā harāya kṣetrapāya ca || 8 || ekādaśyāṃ gataṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tu bāndhavau | pupūjaturjalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiḥ kārtikapakṣake || 9 || sevanaṃ tau cakratuśca dharmabhaktī tatharṣayaḥ | tāpasā api cakruśca sevanaṃ pratyahaṃ prabhoḥ || 2.90.1 0|| mārgaśīrṣaṃ śreṣṭhamāsaṃ yajñīyaṃ vīkṣya tāpasāḥ | pracakre vaiṣṇavaṃ yajñaṃ badaryāṃ te maharṣayaḥ || 1 1|| parṇaśālāṃ dadau nityaṃ nivāsārthaṃ yathocitām | lomaśāya tathā bālakṛṣṇāya śrīnarāyaṇaḥ || 1 2|| mārgaśīrṣe babhūvāyaṃ yajñotsavo mahān śubhaḥ | tatra devo hariḥ sākṣātparamātmā pareśvaraḥ || 13|| yajñeśvaro’nale sthitvā havyāni vubhuje tadā | sākṣād divyākṣaramuktāstathā golokavāsinaḥ || 14|| vaikuṇṭhavāsimuktāśca tathānyadhāmavāsinaḥ | samāyayuḥ kratau tatra prasādalālasā hareḥ || 15|| surā maharṣayo devyastīrthāni pitarastathā | siddhāścāraṇagandharvā bhūsurā vyomagāminaḥ || 16|| bhaktā daityā dānavāśca samāyayuḥ kratau tadā | evaṃ hi bhagavām̐statra rājate parameśvaraḥ || 17|| etasminneva samaye kārtike tu surāṣṭrake | śaṃbhordūtī mahāmārī śaṃbhornideśato niśi || 18|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetraṃ sīmni sthitā prarakṣati | tadā vai siṃhaladvīpāt smṛtvā vai bhrātṛputrakam || 19|| kubhīnasī tathā śṛṃgī rākṣasyo’nyāḥ śatadvayam | vyomagāḥ kāmarūpiṇyo māyājālaviśāradāḥ ||2.90.20 || jñātvā tvadharmajīvasya maraṇaṃ vai surāṣṭrake | vairaṃ niryāpayituṃ śastrāstrayuktāḥ samāyayuḥ || 21 || siṃhāraṇyāni collaṃghya vyomnā saurāṣṭramāyayuḥ | kṛṣṇāyāṃ tu caturdaśyāṃ kārtikasyāsite dale ||22|| dīpotsavāt pūrvarātryāṃ cāvaterustadāmbarāt | ulmukān darśayantyaśca vahnijvālāstathā mukhāt ||23|| mūrdhajebhyastriśūlām̐śca darśayantyo hi vahnimān | mārayaitāḥ khādayaitāḥ śatroḥ priyāḥ kumārikāḥ || 24|| bhedayaitāścarvayaitā nayaitā rākṣasārthakam | jvālayaitā dharṣayaitāḥ sarvāḥ kṛṣṇapriyā balāt ||25|| nāstyāsāṃ rakṣakaścātra samayo vijayasya naḥ | ityevaṃ bhāṣamāṇāstā lomaśasyāśrame drutam ||26|| nipeturdharṣaṇārthaṃ vai rākṣasyaḥ krūrayoṣitaḥ | sīmarakṣākarī dūtī mahāmārī hi bhairavī ||27|| jñātvākasmikasaṃgharṣa yuddhopadravamityapi | sahasrarūpiṇī bhūtvā saśastrā tvabhyadhāvata ||28|| kanyāvāseṣu sarvatra rātrāvākrośa ulbaṇaḥ | abhavat trāsakṛt tatra rākṣasīnāmupadravāt || 29|| bhairavī pāśamādāya sammantrya nāgabandhanaiḥ | mumoca rākṣasīsaṃghe rākṣasyo vandhanāntare ||2.90.30|| nāgairbaddhāścābhavam̐śca nigaḍaiścauravattadā | hasteṣvapi tathā kaṭyāmudare ca galeṣvapi ||3 1|| sarvā eva tu nāgānāṃ pāśairnaddhā viceṣṭitāḥ | abhavannyapatan bhūmau viṣadagdhāstathābhavan ||32|| atha sā bhairavī śaṃbhuṃ suptaṃ cāgatya saṃstavaiḥ | bodhayāmāsa śīghraṃ cāvedayāmāsa gharṣaṇam ||33|| śrutvopadravamīśāno lomaśāśramamāyayau | dṛṣṭvā nāgāstrasannaddhā rākṣasīstuṣṭamānasaḥ ||34|| prāhaināṃ bhairavīṃ dūtīṃ kurvetā gatabandhanāḥ | yuddhaṃ kṛtvā tu tāḥ sarvā vināśāya vilokaye ||35|| ityājñaptā bhairavī sā natvā śaṃkarapādayoḥ | rākṣasīstā bandhahīnāścakāra śaṃkarājñayā ||36|| uvācaitā raṇaṃ kartuṃ rākṣasyo balagarvitāḥ | yuddhaṃ cakruḥ śastradhartryo vividhairyuddhatarkaṭaiḥ ||37|| śaktibhirmudgaraiścāpi yaṣṭibhiḥ prastaraistathā | khaḍgairasibhiśchurikāmuṣṭyādyaiḥ pādatāḍanaiḥ ||38|| parvataprāyadehāśca vṛṣṭibhiścābhicārakaiḥ | yuyudhustā vyomagā hi bhairavībhirnirantaram ||39|| bhairavyo rudrabalato vajradehāstadābhavan | saṃkalpajā bahurūpā yuyudhustatra hetibhiḥ ||2.90.40|| kṛpāṇaiḥ paraśubhiśca kuṭhāraiśca triśūlakaiḥ | cakrairbhallaistathā stambhairvajrairdaṇḍaiśca jālakaiḥ |||41||| śalākābhiḥ kṣepaṇaiśca sphoṭagolaiśca śākhibhiḥ | nijaghnuścātiruṣṭāstā bhairavyo rākṣasīstvati ||42|| citkṛtyotplutya cākāśe nipetustāḥ parasparam | rākṣasyo māyayā naikarūpiṇyo jaghnurīśvarīḥ ||43|| īśānyo jaghnurīśasya mantrayukśūlaśaktibhiḥ | sītābhirbhallakairjaghnurbibhidurhṛdayāni hi ||44|| rākṣasīnāṃ mahāsainyaṃ kṛtrimaṃ samajāyata | kṛtrimā bhairavīyoṣā vidyatpāśaistu tāstadā ||45|| babandhurjvālayāmāsuravacitya ca mūlinīm | evaṃ yuddhe mahāghore jāyamāne sahasraśaḥ ||46|| nipetustatkabandhāśca śailaprāyā vihāyasaḥ | kuṃbhīnasī tathā śṛṃgī dudruvaturbhayād bahiḥ ||47|| tadanyāḥ śatasaṃkhyāśca bhairavībhistu bhakṣitāḥ | śatasaṃkhyāḥ parāstatra bhinnā mṛtāśca jīvataḥ ||48|| bhairavīnāṃ tadā jāto vijayaḥ śāṃkarād balāt| | śaṃbhustābhyaḥ prasanno’bhūt kṣetrarakṣā yataḥ kṛtā ||49|| lomaśasyāśramasyāpi kanyakānāṃ ca rakṣaṇam | kṛtaṃ rātrau mahāyuddhaṃ kṛtvā vacaḥprapālanam |||2.90.50|| prasannaḥ sannuvācaitā mahāmārīrvarapradaḥ | prasanno’smi varadānaṃ yācadhvaṃ pradadāmi vaḥ ||5 1 || mahāmāryastadā prāhurnatvā śrīśaṃkaraṃ tathā | mūlāṃ tāṃ bhairavīṃ pūjyāṃ mātaraṃ jananīṃ parām |||52|| yadi śaṃbho prasanno’si yadi deyo varo’sti naḥ | tadā kṣudhāsamavyāptā vayaṃ tṛṣākulāstathā ||53|| tannivṛttikaraṃ bhojyaṃ pariśramavināśakam | puṣṭidaṃ baladaṃ peyaṃ tāmasaṃ dehi naḥ prabho ||54|| tamojanyā vayaṃ sarvāstāmasyo yuddhadurmadāḥ | yuddhajaṃ māṃsaraktādi bhakṣayantyo’tipuṣṭidam ||55|| tadeva bhojanaṃ peyaṃ samicchāmo dadāsi cet | ityuktaḥ śaṃkaraḥ prāha dharmakṣetre surāṣṭrake ||56 || parabrahmanivāse’tra taddānaṃ cātiduṣkaram | kathaṃ kṛpālunāthasya deśe’tra taddhi saṃbhavet ||57|| tadā prāhustu tāḥ sarvā harerbhaktān vihāya vai | tāmasān pāpinaḥ krūrānnāstikān bhaktivarjitān ||58|| anācārān durācārān pūjāpāṭhavivarjitān | asnātān tīrthayātrādivarjitān dāṃbhikān śaṭhān ||59|| hareḥ prasādahīnām̐śca tulasīsragvivarjitān | aśāṃbhavan sattvahīnān avaiṣṇavān parārtidān ||2.90.60|| paradravyādyapahārakārakān puṇyavarjitān | yamayātrārthayogyām̐śca bhakṣayiṣyāma eva tān ||61|| tādṛśīśca malināśca nārīrdharmavivarjitāḥ | upāsanāvihīnāśca bhakṣayiṣyāma eva tāḥ ||62|| evaṃ kṛte bhagavām̐stu na roṣaṃ samupeṣyati | adhārmikāṇāṃ pāpānāṃ daṇḍārthaṃ yamapattanam ||63|| kṛtaṃ tenaiva sa kasmād duṣṭānāṃ bhakṣaṇe kṛte | santuṣṭo na bhavennātho vayaṃ taṃ prabhumīśvaram ||64|| pratoṣitaṃ vidhāsyāmaḥ sevayā kiṃkarīstriyaḥ | ityuktvā tā viremuśca śaṃbhuḥ kṛpāparastu tāḥ ||65|| prāha tathāsviti bhojyaṃ pānaṃ duṣṭaprajāsvadāt | mahāmāryastu taṃ natvā natvā cāpi haripriyāḥ ||66|| natvā ca kuṃkumavāpīṃ natvāśvapaṭṭasārasam | natvā śrīkambharālakṣmīṃ natvā gopālakṛṣṇakam ||67|| smṛtvā gopālatanayaṃ śrīpatiṃ svāminaṃ prabhum | daśayojanataḥ kṣetrād bahistāḥ prayayurmudā ||68|| mṛtānāṃ rākṣasīnāṃ tu dehān utthāpya paścime | mahāgarte viniḥkṣipya mānaveṣu drutaṃ ca tāḥ ||69|| viviśuścāvaiṣṇaveṣu śaivabhinneṣu vai drutam | abhakteṣu ca duṣṭeṣu daṃbhiṣu nāstikeṣu ca ||2.90.70|| śaṭheṣu dharmahīneṣu bāhyataścihnadhāriṣu | āntareṣu tu mālinyasaṃbhṛteṣu janeṣu ca ||71|| bhaktanibheṣu khyāteṣu bāhyato’ntaśca pāpiṣu | nareṣu tādṛśīṣu strīṣvapi praviviśuśca tāḥ ||72|| mahāmārīsahasraṃ tat sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrakam | saurāṣṭre gaurjare cāpi mahārāṣṭre ca dakṣiṇe ||73|| madhye pūrve cottare ca paścime sarvabhūmiṣu | mahāmāryo’bhavan vyāptā adṛśyā vāyuvigrahāḥ ||74|| tūrṇaṃ praviśya deheṣu tiṣṭhanti hṛdayeṣu ca | māṃsaṃ raktaṃ drutaṃ hyuṣṇaṃ khādanti ca pibanti ca ||75|| narā nāryo bhavantyeva kṣaṇānte prāṇavarjitāḥ | āsamudrāntamevaitā gatvā gatvā prajājanān ||76|| pāpiṣṭhānnaranāryādīn prabhakṣayanti lakṣaśaḥ | grāme grāme narā nāryā mriyante pratyakṣaṃ tadā ||77|| viṃśatyaṃśāḥ prajānāṃ vai pratisāhasrameva ha | mahāmāryastadā krūrā gaṇayanti na bālakān ||78|| kanyakā na vadhūṃścāpi yūno vṛddhānna garbhiṇīḥ | anāthānnāpyatithīm̐śca mahīmānānna deśikān ||79 || na rājño na tathā rājñīrna dhanāḍhyānna nirdhanān | na kaṣāyadhṛgaścāpi na vā sūtakasaṃsthitān ||2.90.80|| na yajñahomakarmāḍhyān na pūjāpāṭhakāriṇaḥ | pāpayuktān vilokyaiva bhakṣayanti narān striyaḥ ||81 || mriyante pratyahaṃ nāryo narāśca bhuvi lakṣaśaḥ | ekaṃ dhṛtvā bahiryānti mṛtastāvatparo bhavet |||82|| paraṃ mṛtaṃ viniṣkāsya yāvadāyānti vai gṛham | tāvadanye mṛtāḥ santi pañca sahaiva tatkṣaṇe |||83 || pañca niṣkāsya ca yāvadāyānti grāmagopuram | tāvadanye daśa santi mṛtā vā ca tato’dhikāḥ ||84|| keṣāñcid gṛhavartyeva kuṭumbaṃ nidhanaṃ gatam | keṣāñcittvardhabhāgena mānavā nidhanaṃ gatāḥ ||85|| kutracicchiṣyate bālaḥ kutracittu navā vadhūḥ | kutracid vṛddhajaraṭhaḥ kutracitpaśumātrakam ||86|| kutracinnagare lakṣe sahasraṃ tvavaśeṣitam | kutracid grāmabhāge tu grāmārdhaṃ sarvaśo mṛtam ||87|| kutracinmānavaiḥ śūnyā grāmā jātā bhayaṃkarāḥ | mriyamāṇaprajānāṃ ca jaladātā na vidyate ||88|| kuto’nnadātā labhyeta yatra nāstyeva darśakaḥ | evaṃ nāśo mahānāsīnmardanaṃ bahuśo’pyabhūt ||89|| māsamadhye tu lokānāmardhe pṛcchāṃ mṛtaṃ hyabhūt | koṭiśastu mahāmāryo’bhakṣayan pāpino janān ||2.90.90 || rākṣasā api daityāṃśca dānavānāsurām̐stathā | śaṭhānnaiṣkṛtikām̐ścāpi nāstikān dharmavarjitān ||9 1 || abhakṣayan hi māsānte hāhākāro digantare | abhavad vai tadā lokāstyaktvā grāmān gṛhāṇyapi ||92|| pattanāni nagarāṇi yayurbhayādaraṇyakam | vaneṣu vanivad vāsān cakruḥ kālabhayārditāḥ |||93|| araṇyāni nagarāṇi nagarāṇi vanāni tu | vaiparītyena jātāni mahāmārībhayāttadā ||94|| aśvapaṭṭākṣarakṣetre daśayojanavistṛte | mahāmārībhayaṃ nābhūd bhakteṣveva tadā priye ||95|| abhaktā ye’pi tatrasthāstattadbhāgyena deśitāḥ | yayurbahirhi ye kṣetraṃ tyaktvā te nidhanaṃ gatāḥ ||96|| trāhi trāhi prajāścocuḥ sasmaruḥ parameśvaram | rogasyāsya vināśārthaṃ prajāścakrurhi mānatām ||97|| naivedyāni vividhāni dāsyāmo devatāgṛhe | vastrabhūṣāmbarasvarṇaṃ dāsyāmo devasannidhau ||98|| kariṣyāmo’nnasatrāṇi pārāyaṇāni sanmakhān | dharmakāryāṇi dharmāśca kariṣyāmaḥ prasevanam || 99|| harestadīyasādhūnāṃ pūjanaṃ devasevanam | bhajanaṃ saṃkariṣyāmaḥ saṃtyakṣyāmo’ghapātakam || 2.90.1 00|| sūryaṃ śivaṃ satīṃ lakṣmīṃ pūjayiṣyāma īśinīm | gaṇeśaṃ ca mahākālaṃ mātṛkāḥ pitṛdevatāḥ || 101 || tīrthayātrāṃ kariṣyāmaścāśvapaṭṭasarovare | yatra nāsti mahāmārī bālakṛṣṇaprabhāvataḥ || 1 02|| prajāḥ sarvatra ca bhayānmaraṇasyātivihvalāḥ | pratijñāṃ saṃpracakruśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 1 03|| bhījaṣyāmo yadā jīvipprāṇāḥ sthāsyāma eva tu | bhairavi te mahāmāri kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya te || 1 04|| śapatho’sti yadi māṃ tvaṃ spṛśasi tatra mā spṛśa | āṇaṃ daduḥ prajāstvevaṃ hāhākāro’bhavad bhuvi || 1 05|| śaṃkarasya śapathaste pitroste śapathastathā | mā spṛśāsmān mahāmāri dadmaḥ saṃyāvamatra te || 1 06|| ityevaṃ rādhike lokā mānatāḥ saṃpracakrire | satyaḥ sādhvyo dvijāḥ santo vyomnā śrībadarīṃ yayuḥ || 1 07|| sadyojātamahādevāya te cāstu namo muhuḥ | mahākālāya ca kālabhairavāya ca te namaḥ || 1 08|| ajāpālāya ca vīrabhadrāya te namo muhuḥ | mṛtyuṃjayāya ca mahākālyai cāṇḍyai namo muhu || 1 09|| durgāyai nama ityeva dīnaprajāstadocire | śrīharirjñātavān sarvaṃ pūrvamenamupadravam || 2.90.110 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhorbadaryāṃ gamanaṃ, rākṣasīnāṃ kuṃkumavāpyāmāgamanam, mahāmāryā rākṣasīnāṃ nāśanam, tataḥ pāpiprajāsu bhakṣaṇārthaṃ vyāpakatā, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 90 ||
<2.91> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike saṃśṛṇu sādhvi gatvā śrībadarīṃ dvijāḥ | satyaḥ sādhvyastathā santo vyomnā sasnuḥ sarijjale || 1 || gaṃgāyāṃ ca kṛtasnānā nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ | cakruḥ saha militvaiva yayuryatra narāyaṇaḥ || 2 || naraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ natvā natvā maharṣimaṇḍalam | tatratyakṛtasatkārā labdhasvāgatapūjanāḥ || 3 || svīkṛtamadhuparkāśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya te | parṇakuṭīṃ yayuḥ pṛṣṭvā yatrāste lomaśo’pi ca || 4 || lomaśo vīkṣya bhaktām̐ścāgatān śokitamānasān| papraccha kuśalaṃ śīghraṃ cāgame’pi prayojanam || 5 || dattāsanāstu te sarve jagadurlomaśaṃ munim | darśanaṃ śrīhareḥ kṛtvā kṛtvā prapūjanaṃ tathā || 6 || tato vakṣyāma evāsmadgamane tvatra kāraṇam | ityuktvā śrīhariṃ parṇakuṭyāṃ sthitaṃ ca lomaśaḥ || 7 || drāgevāntargṛhaṃ gatvā cāvedya svajanāgamam | snehabhṛtaṃ hariṃ nītvā sahaiva sa bahiryayau || 8 || āgataṃ śrīhariṃ śālāṃgaṇe śrībadarītale | daṇḍavacca namaskārān cakruste yātrikāstadā || 9 || premṇā haristu papraccha kuśalaṃ svāgataṃ sukham | tadā cāśrūṇi muktvaiva jagaduḥ śrīhariṃ ca te || 2.91.1 0|| mahāmārī bhairavī yā sīmarakṣaṇakāriṇī | tayā siṃhaladvīpasya rākṣasyo’saṃkhyakā hatāḥ || 1 1|| yāśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre yuddhārthaṃ samupāgatāḥ | adharmajīvadaityasya vairaniryāpanakṛte || 12| kanyakā rakṣitāścāpi rakṣitaṃ cāśramaṃ tathā | mahāmāryā tathā rātrau tasyai śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃ tadā || 1 3|| prasanno varadānārthaṃ prāha sāpi tadārthayat | mahāmāryo madutpannā yuddhakartryaḥ kṣudhārditāḥ || 14|| tāmasyaśca samicchāmo naramāṃsāśanaṃ śiva | śaṃbhunoktaṃ na tad yogyaṃ tataḥ prāha tu bhairavī || 15|| bhaktānnaiva grahīṣyāmaḥ śrīhareḥ śaraṇāgatān | śivabhaktān harerbhaktān tyaktvā ye pāpinaśca tān || 16|| nāstikān dharmahīnām̐śca devadrohiṇa eva tān | śaṭhān vinindakān tīrthadrohiṇaḥ kapaṭānvitān || 17|| snānapūjājapabhaktihīnānnarām̐śca yoṣitaḥ | bhakṣayiṣyāma evātra bahirvai daśayojanāt || 18|| tathāstviti haraḥ prāha mahāmāryo’yutāyutāḥ | bhakṣayāmāsuratyarthaṃ bālān vṛddhān janān drutam || 1 9|| sagarbhā jaraṭhā nārīryuvatīryūna ityapi | evaṃ vai viplavo jāto grāmā mānavavarjitāḥ || 2.91.20|| vidyante kākavāsāśca janāḥ kuṭumbavarjitāḥ | ardhā vasatayo jātā nirvaṃśāścāpi kecana ||21 || ayaṃ tūpadravo nātha balamāsādya vartate | mahākālasya vegena mriyante mānavāḥ prabho ||22|| saṃkhyā nāsti mṛtānāṃ vai vāhakā na milantyapi | araṇyaṃ pattanaṃ jātaṃ jātā grāmā vanāni ca ||23|| śīghramāgatya rakṣāṃ naḥ kuru tatpralayātprabho| ityuktvā ruruduḥ sarve dayālustu dayāvaśaḥ || 24|| bhūtvotthāya tataḥ śīghraṃ susasmāra narāyaṇam | naranārāyaṇau parṇakuṭyāṃ tvāyayatustadā ||25|| agre niṣedaturnatvā parameśaṃ parātparam | papracchatustadājñāṃ ca kimevaṃ vyagratā prabho ||26|| hariḥ prāhājanābhe tu khaṇḍe pṛthvyāṃ vyajāyata | manuṣyāṇāṃ mahāmāryā vināśo pāpināṃ bahuḥ ||27|| mriyante tatra bhaktāśca svalpadoṣā api śritāḥ | saṃhāro’yaṃ samajani cādharmajīvarakṣasaḥ ||28|| vināśena pulastyasya vaṃśe kharasutasya vai | kharasya yā bhaginyastu rākṣasyastābhireva tu ||29|| upadravaḥ kṛto naśca kṣetre tatpratikārikā | bhairavī ca mahāmārī śaṃbhordūtī ca tāmasī ||2.91.30|| pāritoṣikarūpeṇa bhakṣayatyeva pāpinaḥ | pāpināṃ saṃgame svalpapāpāḥ supuṇyaśālinaḥ ||3 1|| bhaktāścāpi prabhakṣyante tadrakṣārthaṃ mayā drutam | gantavyaṃ tatra bhaktaiśca sākamebhiḥ surāṣṭrake || 32|| ityuktaḥ śrīnaranārāyaṇaḥ prāha kṛpānidhe | svatantrasya pareśasya yathecchā tadbhavet khalu || 33|| mayā nityaṃ pūjanārthaṃ kārtike bhagavān smṛtaḥ | pañcavāraṃ pratyahaṃ sampūjitaḥ kārtike mayā ||34|| vanditaḥ sevito nityaṃ pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ | phalaiḥ saṃbhojitaścāpi bhaktidharmādibhistathā ||35|| toṣitaścāpi ṛṣibhiḥ pāvitaṃ badarīvanam | pāvitāḥ ṛṣayaḥ sarve pāvitaśca himālayaḥ ||36|| pāvitā devagaṃgā ca pāvitā parṇaśālikā | sadā tīrthasvarūpeyaṃ sthāsyatyeveyamāśrame ||37|| saṃkalpāḥ pūritāḥ sarve darśitā tāpasī sthitiḥ | rītiśca saṃyamalabhyā tvatto nātha samarjitā || 38|| sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ mama jātaṃ sveṣṭo makho vyajāyata | kratuḥ sa vaiṣṇavaḥ pūrṇo vidhivat parivartate ||39|| parameśāstatheśāśca surā maharṣayastathā | pitarastoṣitā nātha tvayā yajñe pratiṣṭhatā ||2.91.40|| gṛhṇatā ca haviḥ sākṣād vahnimukhena bhāsvatā | kiṃnyūnaṃ me vartate’dya muktāḥ santoṣitāstathā ||41|| sarvaṃ prapūritaṃ nātha mānasaṃ bhavatā mama | sārdhamāsottaraṃ cātroṣitvā badarī pāvitā ||42|| ityuktvā śrīnaranārāyaṇau bhaktirmaharṣayaḥ | gharmastathānyadevāśca pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ||43|| ārārtrikaṃ pracakruśca pradakṣiṇaṃ sumāñjalim | kṣamāmapyarthayāmāsustataḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||44|| āśīrvādān dadau tebhyaścāha naraṃ narāyaṇam | bhaktiṃ dharmaṃ maharṣīṃśca samāgacchantu madgṛham ||45|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram | lomaśasya guroścāpyāśramaṃ paśyantu pāvanam ||46|| akṣaraṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ kurvantu pāvanaṃ mama | haimasthānāṃ bhavatāṃ tu darśanaṃ durlabhaṃ kṣitau ||47|| ityuktavān, naranārāyaṇādyā hṛṣṭamānasāḥ | mārgaśīrṣasya pūrṇāyāṃ snātvā yātrāṃ pracakrire ||48|| ṛṣayo vyomamārgasthāḥ kuṃbhakena yayustadā | naranārāyaṇau santo dharmo bhaktiśca lomaśaḥ ||49|| sādhvyo haristathā muktā vimānenāyayurgṛham | sāyaṃ prāpuśca saurāṣṭraṃ kālaśokitamānavam ||2.91.50 || naṣṭabhraṣṭagṛhācāraṃ naṣṭārdhamānavojjhitam | satejasko yathāpūrvaṃ cāsīnnāsīcca tādṛśaḥ ||5 1|| saurāṣṭraśca yathā tadvanmārge deśā vilokitāḥ | kuravaḥ śūrasenāśca maravo gaurjarāstathā ||52|| naṣṭaprajādhanāḥ śuṣkā nistejaskā gṛhā iva | mahāmārībhakṣitāśca kālavegena nāśitāḥ ||6 3 || mānavā vanavāsāśca gṛhavāsāḥ piśācakāḥ | śavā mṛtyunivāsāśca tiryagvāsaṃ ca jīvanam ||94|| āgārāṇi śmaśānāni mṛtyudūtāśca mūṣakāḥ | vilokyante nagareṣu hyatarkyaḥ pralayo yathā |||95|| etatsarvaṃ viditvaiva bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ | kṣaṇaṃ vicārya yānācca tadā sasmāra śaṃkaram ||96|| kṣetrapaḥ śaṃkarastatra cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe | upasthito’bhavattūrṇaṃ nanāma parameśvaram ||97|| śaṃkaraṃ śrīhariḥ prāha mahāmārībhireva yat | vināśyate jagatsarvaṃ mahāmārīṃ nivāraya ||98|| drāgeva śaṃkaro naijaṃ galanādaṃ cakāra ha | kampitaṃ sarvamaṇḍaṃ ca bhuvanāni caturdaśa ||59|| kampitānyabhavattūrṇaṃ mahāmārī samāhvayat | digbhyaḥ sarvābhya evaitāḥ koṭirūpadharāḥ striyaḥ ||2.91.60|| bhakṣikā madyamāṃsānāmāyayurharasannidhau | śaṃkarastāstataḥ prāha nārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||6 1 || dayālurbhagavānatra lokarakṣaṇakārakaḥ | niṣedhati svayaṃ śrīmān pāpipāpavināśakaḥ ||62||| mā bhakṣayantu pāpīśca bhakṣyante pāpisaṃgataḥ | bhaktāścāpi ca bhaktānāṃ kuṭumbānyapi sarvaśaḥ ||63|| teṣāṃ rakṣā mayā kāryā tyajantu tadvināśanam | ityuktāstā mahāmāryāṃ nivṛttā bhayato hareḥ ||64 || yayācire kṣamāṃ cāpi hareścaraṇasevanam | haristāḥ prāha vai sarvā yāntu sarvatra bhūtale ||65|| tilakaṃ candrako me syād bhāle kaṇṭhe ca mālikā | yeṣāṃ tān sampradāyaiva prāṇān śaktiṃ ca cetanām ||66|| jīvaya devajīvān bhaktimārgapravartakān | tatastāḥ prāha bhagavan na śaktā hi vayaṃ tathā ||67|| cetanaṃ jīvanaṃ dātuṃ kiṃ kurmo’tra tavājñayā | harirdadau tadā tābhyaḥ kalpalatā sujīvanīḥ ||68|| tā gṛhītvā yayuḥ sarvā jīvayāmāsurīṣṭakān | bhaktān sarvānardhapāpāna śrīharestu nideśataḥ ||69|| tadānandaḥ punarjātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ mānaveṣu vai | yeṣāṃ vai tilakaṃ kaṇṭhī te bhavanti sajīvanāḥ ||2.91.70|| ityudghoṣe pravṛtte ca mṛtānāmapi tajjanāḥ | kaṇṭhyā yuktaṃ śavaṃ kṛtvā vilokayanti jīvanam ||71 || kecit kurvanti tilakaṃ bhāle śavasya vai tadā | kaṇṭhe’rpayanti kaṇṭhīṃ ca taulasīṃ jīvanāya vai ||72|| evaṃ deśeṣu sarvatra śavāstilakasragdharāḥ | sajīvā utthitā bhūmau sāścaryaṃ cāvalokayan ||73|| vaiṣṇavāste tadā jātā mānavāścājanābhake | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmiviṣṇo mṛtyornivāraka ||74|| rakṣa rakṣa sadā caivaṃ tvārthayacchrīhariṃ prati | tadā śrīśaṃkaraḥ prāha sarvāstā bhairavī satīḥ ||75|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛpṇakarāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | mantramimaṃ bhavapyaśca gṛhṇantu matta eva ca ||76|| jīvitān mānavān karṇe śrāvayantvapi sarvaśaḥ | evamuktāḥ kṣaṇāt sarvā manovegāḥ sugṛhya tam ||77|| mantraṃ bhūtvā ca vaiṣṇasyo dadurmantrān tu sarvaśaḥ | kalpavallosamutthebhyaḥ kārayitvā tu vaiṣṇavān ||78|| jagadujjīvayāmāsurbhaktaśokān prajahrire | cakruścaitādṛśaṃ loke na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ||79|| parabrahma vinā tādṛk kartumarhasi ko’paraḥ | nāḍīprāṇā yasya haste tena kartuṃ hi śakyate ||2.91.80|| brahmāṇḍe cotsavā jātā grāme grāme gṛhe gṛhe | mṛtāścojjīvitāḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai ||8 1 || tīrthārthaṃ tvāyayuḥ sarve prāptanūtanajīvanāḥ | kṣetraṃ kuṃkumavāpīṃ tu tathā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||82|| mahāmārīsamūhām̐śca dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ prapedire | pauṣe māghe phālgune ca caitre’pi tvāyayurjanāḥ ||83|| bhūtvā sarve kṛtakṛtyā yānti sma nijamandiram | narā nāryaḥ koṭisaṃkhyā jīvitā hariṇā tadā ||84|| atha tā rādhike devyo mahāmāryo’pi mādhavāt | vavruḥ śrībālakṛṣṇādvai sevanaṃ nijapādayoḥ ||85|| haristābhyo dadau vāsaṃ tataḥ saurāṣṭrake vane | bhavatyo badarīvṛkṣā bhavantu divyarūpiṇaḥ ||86|| kṣetreṣu cāpyaraṇyeṣu svalpā vai cirajīvinaḥ | kaṇṭakadvayayuktāśca tāmasaiḥ kaṇṭakairyutāḥ ||87|| saurāṣṭre maccaraṇayoḥ rajobhiḥ saṃpariplutāḥ | pādasevātulyalābhā bhavantvākalpasaṃsthitāḥ ||88|| ahaṃ rāmasvarūpeṇa bhakṣayiṣye phalāni vaḥ | śabarījātikā me’tra dāsyantyapi phalāni vaḥ ||89|| ityevaṃ tāḥ kṛtā bhaktāḥ stambarūpā bhuvastale | kṣudrikāstā badaryaśca drāgjātāścirajīvanāḥ ||2.91.90|| naranārāyaṇādīnāmṛṣīṇāṃ bhaktidharmayoḥ | svāgataṃ śrīhariścakre mātā pitā ca lomaśaḥ ||91|| vāsaṃ naije cālaye’pi kānake pradadau hariḥ | bhojanaṃ tāpasebhyaśca havyādi pradadau prabhuḥ || 92|| viśaśramustataḥ sarve prātastvaśvasarovare | sasnustato yayuḥ sarve draṣṭuṃ śrīlomaśāśramam ||93|| vistīrṇaṃ divyarūpaṃ ca brahmapriyābhirujjvalam | yatra māyā na caivāsti divyākṣarasamaṃ śubham ||94|| tatastīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā gṛhītvā pūjanaṃ tataḥ | tīrthadevān militvā ca dhṛtvā rūpadvayaṃ ca te ||95|| tīrthe tīrthasvarūpeṇa sthitvāpareṇa te tataḥ | ājñāṃ labdhvā hareḥ sarve yayuḥ śrībadarīvanam ||96|| dharmatīrthaṃṃ bhaktitīrthaṃ naratīrthaṃ tathottamam | nārāyaṇasya tīrthaṃ ca ṛṣitīrthaṃ śubhaṃ tathā ||97|| badarītīrthamityetajjātaṃ cāśvasarovare | evaṃ vai rādhike tatra camatkāro mahānabhūt ||98|| bhuktimuktipradaścāpi smaraṇānmṛtyuhārakaḥ | kanyārakṣānimittena jagadvai vaiṣṇavaṃ kṛtam ||99|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mahāmārībhirbahumānavanāśe sādhvīsādhuviprarṣigaṇo badarīṃ gatvā prabhave nivedayitvā harimānayāmāsa, harimṛtān jagajjīvān jīvayāmāsetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 91 ||
<2.92> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike vāsudevaṃ saṃkarṣaṇādayaḥ | traya īśeśvarā jñānaṃ papracchurbrahmabodhakam || 1 || jñānaṃ jīveśvarāṇāṃ tu bhaktikṛd vada cāgraja | ko vā tvātmā ca kā muktiḥ saṃsāraḥ kinnimittakaḥ || 2 || kaḥ saṃsārastathā brahma kiṃ tat parataraṃ tataḥ | tvaṃ vetsi paramaṃ guhyaṃ sarvaṃ vai bhagavan prabho || 3 || nārāyaṇa svayaṃ sākṣātpurāṇācintyapūruṣa | na hyanyo vidyate vettā tvāmṛte puruṣottama || 4 || evamuktvāniruddhaśca pradyamnaḥ saṃprakarṣaṇaḥ | dadhyuḥ svasvahṛtsu taṃ kaṃcitparamaṃ puruṣaṃ prabhum || 5 || tāvad vilokayāmāsuḥ śrīhariṃ puruṣottamam | vihāya vāsudevākhyaṃ rūpaṃ tatkāraṇaṃ param || 6 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ brahmaparaṃ harim | vibhrājamānaṃ muktaiśca sevitaṃ divyamadbhutam || 7 || śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ kāntaṃ prabhāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam | sarvāyudhadharaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dhiyā yutam || 8 || nityānandaguṇaiśvaryabhūtiśaktisukhāśrayam | dvibhujaṃ koṭimuktābhirmuktaiḥ sevitapatkajam || 9 || hasantaṃ hāsayantaṃ ca koṭikandarpasundaram | kiśoraṃ divyaśobhāḍhyaṃ sarvasṛṣṭimanoharam || 2.92.1 0|| ujjvalaṃ saumyabhāvena saṃbhṛtaṃ cāyatekṣaṇam | pare dhāmni divyagajāsanasthaṃ parameśvaram || 11 || tato’kṣaraṃ brahmadhāma dadṛśuḥ sīmavarjitam | koṭimuktān dadṛśuścākṣarasaṃjñān manoharān || 12|| tataste dadṛśuḥ śīghraṃ golokaṃ gopasaṃśritam | gopīgaṇaiḥ śobhitaṃ śrīrādhākṛṣṇābhyadhiṣṭhitam || 13|| tataste dadṛśū ramyaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ brahmasadṛśam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇāvāsaṃ koṭipārṣadasaṃśritam || 14|| tato divyaṃ sukailāsaṃ sadāśivaśivāśritam | dadṛśuste ca bhūmno’thāmṛtākhyaṃ dhāma śobhitam || 15|| tataste dadṛśurviṣṇorvaikuṇṭhaṃ kṣīrasāgaram | śvetadvīpaṃ badarīṃ ca vāsudeve’graje tadā || 16|| tatra tatra harermūrtiṃ yādṛśīṃ tādṛśīṃ tu te | vāsudeve dadṛśurhi sarvāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ ca māyikīm || 17|| atha tiro’bhavat sṛṣṭiḥ kṣaṇānte tejasāṃ cayam | dadṛśustatra ca divyaṃ saurāṣṭraṃ vai yathāsthitam || 18|| tatra kṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro’bhidhaṃ subhāsvaram | tatra kuṃkumavāpīṃ ca tathā śrīlomaśāśramam || 1 9|| tatsarvaṃ paramaṃ dhāma divyamuktādirājitam | brahmapriyābhisaṃvyāptaṃ sāṃkhyayoginyadhiśritam ||2.92.20|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktādhivāsitam | divyaśrīkambharālakṣmīgopālakṛṣṇaśobhitam ||21 || prabhāpāravatīlakṣmīmāṇikīrādhikāśritam | mañjulāsaguṇāhaṃsāvijayālalitāśritam ||22|| śatena dvādaśabhiśca priyābhiradhivāsitam | anantakoṭayabjakānādhiṣṭhitaṃ divyabhūtikam ||23|| dadaśurdivyakalaśaiḥ prāsādānapi śobhitān | mahāprāsādametasyānādikṛṣṇasya dadṛśuḥ ||24|| svātmādhāraṃ paraṃ divyaṃ yatra śrībhagavān svayam | kiśorapratibhaścāste bālakṛṣṇo narāyaṇaḥ ||25|| nārāyaṇānāṃ paramaḥ pumān śrīparameśvaraḥ | īśvarāṇāṃ ca paramaḥ sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||26|| avatārasamūhānāṃ kāraṇaṃ cāvatārī yaḥ | kṛṣṇānāṃ cāpi yaḥ kṛṣṇo vyūhānāṃ vyūhakṛtprabhuḥ ||27|| taṃ hariṃ dadṛśū rādhe vāsudeve harau tu te | vibhrājamānaṃ vimale gajasvarṇāsane harim ||28|| yadantarā sarvametad yato’bhinnamidaṃ jagat | savāsudevaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahānandaṃ prapedire ||29|| tataḥ kṣaṇāntare sarvaṃ līnaṃ dadṛśire puraḥ | vāsudevaṃ dadṛśuste praśāntamanaso’bhavan | evaṃ pratyakṣavijñānaṃ kārayitvā tu tām̐stataḥ ||2.92.3 0|| vāsudevaḥ samuvāca guhyaṃ jñānaṃ sanātanam | yanna devā vijānanti yajamānā dvijātayaḥ ||3 1 || taṃ jñātvā parameśānaṃ brahmībhūtā maharṣayaḥ | saṃsāraṃ na prapadyante pūrve’pi brahmadhāminaḥ ||32|| ātmāyaṃ sukhavān svacchaḥ śuddhaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sanātanaḥ | tadantare tu yaścāste sarvāntaraḥ parātparaḥ ||33|| so’ntaryāmī sa puruṣaḥ sa prāṇaḥ svāmisaṃjñakaḥ | asmāt sañjāyate viśvaṃ tasya dhāmni pralīyate ||34|| sa māyāṃ chāyayā gṛhṇan karoti vividhāstanūḥ | nāsya bandho na tadbhāvo nāyaṃ māyāguṇāśrayaḥ ||35|| yathā prakāśatamasostādātmyaṃ nopapadyate | tadvadaikyaṃ na sambandhaḥ prapañcaparamātmanoḥ ||36|| chāyātapau yathā loke parasparavilakṣaṇau | tadvat prapañcapuruṣau vibhinnau paramārthataḥ ||37|| ātmā śuddho nityabuddho muktarūpaḥ svabhāvataḥ | paramātmātiśuddhaśca sarvajñaścātmasusthitaḥ ||38|| vikārahīnau nirdvandvau sadānandapariplutau | ātmatadantarātmānau sayujau divyasadguṇau ||39|| nityayuktau ca suhṛdau draṣṭārau ca niyāmakau | ātmā karma kṛtaṃ bhuṃkte’ntaryāmī bhogavarjitaḥ ||2.92.40|| diśatyeva yathākālaṃ niyāmya śreṣṭhine phalam | ahaṃ kartā sukhī duḥkhī kṛśaḥ sthūlaśca mānavān ||41 || ahaṃkāreṇa tadbhoktā bhavatyajñānavaibhavāt | ajñānādanyathājñānānmanasā saha yujyate ||42|| prākṛtaṃ guṇasaṃsargaṃ yojayitvā mano’sthiram | svadharmāḍhyaṃ tadātmānaṃ sampādayati vai muhuḥ ||43|| ahaṃkārāvivekena kartāhaṃ ceti mānayan | svātmānaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahma vismaratyeva kalmaṣī ||44|| anātmanyātmavijñānī sarvaduḥkhapraśevadhiḥ | rāgadveṣādayaścāpi bhrāntijāstatra yanti ca ||45|| tairdoṣaiḥ puṇyapāpe’yaṃ bhuṃkte svabhāvaje yathā | bhrāntināśe tu doṣāṇāṃ vigame niṣprapañcakaḥ ||46|| ekaḥ santiṣṭhate deve kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’rpitaḥ | saccidānandayogena saccidānandavān sadā ||47|| vartate parameśasya kṛpayā ceśvaro yathā | yathā vai dhūmasamparkānnākāśo malinaḥ kvacit ||48|| tathā mānasadoṣaiśca nirlepo’kṣarasaṃjñitaḥ | upādhivarjitaḥ śuddho vimalātmā prakāśate ||49|| jñeyaṃ tyaktvā tato jñaptiṃ jñaptisaṃskāramityapi | tyaktvā tvātmaprakāśaḥ syād yathā nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||2.92.50|| tasmādātmākṣaraḥ śuddho nityaḥ śrīharisaṃśritaḥ | upāsitavyo mantavyaḥ śrotavyaśca mumukṣubhiḥ ||5 1 || yadātmani parabrahma bhāti sarvatra sarvadā | śraddadhānasya bhaktasya tadā sampadyate svayam ||52|| yadā sarvaṃ kāryajātaṃ svasminnevābhipaśyati | kāryajāte nijātmānaṃ tadā sampadyate hariḥ |||53|| yadā sarvaṃ samādhistho nātiriktaṃ prapaśyati | ekībhūtaḥ pareṇātmā tadā muktaḥ prajāyate |||54|| yadāsya mānasā bhāvā vilīyante pare harau | tadāyamamṛtībhūto mokṣaṃ yāti hareḥ padam ||55|| yadā sarvaṃ pṛthagbhūtaṃ tasminneva vilokyate | tataścāpi ca vistāraṃ tadāsya brahmayogyatā ||56|| yadā paśyati cātmānaṃ tadātmānaṃ ca kevalam | tadāsya brahmasampattirnivṛttirmāyikī tadā ||57|| yadā janmajarāduḥkhavyādhīnāmekabheṣajam | ātmātmabrahmavijñānaṃ tadāyaṃ śāśvataḥ śivaḥ ||58|| yathā nadīnadā yānti sāgareṇaikatāṃ tathā | ātmākṣareṇa taccāpi pare brahmaṇi caikatām ||59|| vrajettadā bhavet sākṣādaparokṣānudarśanam | viśeṣādvaitādvaitaṃ tad śrutibhiḥ sannirūpitam ||2.92.60|| tadvijñānaṃ paraśreyaḥpradaṃ copāsanābhidham | yatra tajjāyate tatra na prapañco na vāsanā ||61 || ajñānaṃ vartate yatra tatra mohaśca vāsanā | tasmānmohaṃ parityajya dagdhvā sarvāstu vāsanāḥ ||62|| sarvaśrutisunistāraṃ brahma bhūtvā tared budhaḥ | vijñānaṃ bhagavadbhaktiṃ yogaṃ saṃsādhya vai dhruvam ||63|| brahmarūpaṃ vibhāvyaiva paraṃ harimavāpnuyāt | eṣa ātmāhamavyakto brahmedaṃ dhāma bhaktimat ||64|| brahmaṇyayaṃ paraḥ svāmī so’kṣare puruṣottamaḥ | viśeṣādvaitādvaitaṃ tad yo hariḥ parameśvaraḥ ||65|| sarvarasaḥ sarvarūpaḥ sarvagandho’jaro’maraḥ | sarvataḥ pāṇipādaśca sarvātmā sarvatomukhaḥ ||66|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’ntaryamano’pi saḥ | apāṇipādo javago grahītā sarvasaṃsthitaḥ ||67|| acakṣurapi caṣṭe’so karṇaśūnyaḥ śṛṇotyayam | vedāhamenaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ parameśvaram ||68|| pare dhāmni sthitaṃ cāpi kambharāśrīsutaṃ śubham | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīśaṃ naranārāyaṇaṃ ca tam ||69|| vāsudevaṃ haraṃ viṣṇuṃ hariṃ sarvāntarasthitam | paśyanti ṛṣayastaṃ tu tadanugrahaśālinaḥ ||2.92.70|| tāpasā naiva paśyanti paśyantyenaṃ hi sevakāḥ | nirguṇo’malarūpasya yadaiśvaryākṣarābhidham ||71 || upāsakāḥ prapaśyanti sūkṣmatattvādidarśinaḥ | yanna devā vijānanti mohitāstasya māyayā ||72|| kā kathā jīvalokasya śṛṇudhvaṃ bhrātaro mama | aniruddha tvayi tvāste sarjanaiśvaryamuttamam ||73 || akṣarasyaiva tadboddhaṃ brahmaṇaḥ koṭibhāgajam | pradyamna tvayi yaccāste poṣaṇaiśvaryamityapi ||74|| akṣarasyaiva tad bodhyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ koṭibhāgajam | saṃkarṣaṇa tvayi cāste saṃhāraiśvaryamityapi ||75|| akṣarasyaiva tadbodhyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ koṭibhāgajam | mayi cāste yadaiśvaryaṃ vasatirdīvyatistathā ||76|| akṣarasyaiva bodhyaṃ tad yatprāptaṃ tena vai hareḥ | ahaṃviśeṣaṇaṃ tatrākṣare’dvaitasvarūpiṇi ||77|| viśeṣādvaitametadvai cākṣaraṃ brahma vidyate | tadekaṃ tvakṣaraṃ nānyat samaṃ cākṣarasaṃjñitam ||78|| viśeṣyaṃ tvakṣaraṃ yatrādvaite śrīparamātmani | samanveti sa viśeṣādvaitādvaitaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||79|| māyātītaṃ cākṣaraṃ ca tadatītaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ | māyāṃ vihāya jīvāścākṣaraṃ yānti hi tatpadam ||2.92.80|| praviṣṭāstasya sāyujyaṃ labhante bhaktiyoginaḥ | ye hi māyāmatikrāntāḥ sarvā viśvasvarūpiṇīm ||81 || labhante te’kṣaradhāma tatra me paramaṃ padam | na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiraiśvarī cāpi māyikī ||82|| prasādāttasya kṛṣṇasyākṣareśasya hareḥprabhoḥ| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyetyanuśāsanam |||83|| tatputraśiṣyasādhubhyo dātavyaṃ brahmayoṣite | pradātavyaṃ na cānyebhyo’pātrebhyo’pathyameva yat ||84|| ityetad rādhike tubhyaṃ mayā jñānaṃ prakāśitam | vāsudevena yatpūrvaṃ cānujebhyaḥ prakīrtitam ||85||| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vāsudevaḥ gītāyāṃ parabrahmavijñānena viśeṣādvaitādvaitena tatpadaprāptyādi, nirūpaṇanāmā dvānavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 92 ||
<2.93> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike śrīvāsudevastvāha saṃkarṣaṇādikān | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ || 1 || sthitisthāpakaśaktyākhyaḥ kālaḥ putro layaṃkaraḥ | harate sarvamevaiṣo māyāvaiṣamyamityapi || 2 || kṣobhaṃ karoti caivaiṣastadā māyā pramāthinī | prasūte viṣamāvasthāṃ mahāpūruṣayogataḥ || 3 || māyā kālaḥ pūruṣaśca parameśvaraśaktayaḥ | tābhyaḥ sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ tasmāttā brahmarūpikāḥ || 4 || tajjātaṃ brahmarūpaṃ ca jagat sarvaṃ tu tattanu | tatra sarvatra evāsyākṣarasya brahmaṇaḥ khalu || 5 || pāṇipādākṣiśravaṇānanamastakanābhayaḥ | ataḥ sarvaṃ samāvṛtya tiṣṭhatyakṣarameva tat || 6 || sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ divyendriyasamanvitam | sarvādhāraṃ mahānandaṃ pramāṇātītagocaram || 7 || sarvopamānarahitaṃ sarvāvāsaṃ parāmṛtam | abhinnaṃ bhinnasaṃsthānaṃ śāśvataṃ dhruvamakṣaram || 8 || nirguṇaṃ paramaṃ jyotirnirvikalpamasīmakam | sa ātmā sarvabhūtānāṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ sthitaḥ || 9 || tatrāste sarvagaḥ śāntastadātmā parameśvaraḥ | tena vyāptamidaṃ viśvaṃ jīveśamuktavāsitam || 2.93.1 0|| tasyecchayāpyahaṃ jāto vāsudevaḥ pareśvara | matto yūyaṃ mūrtayaśca traya eva japoṣalāḥ || 11 || tato bhūmā mahāviṣṇustato virāṭ ca viśvasṛṭ | tato maharṣayo devā jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam || 12|| jaganmātā mahāmāyā tasyecchā mūlarūpiṇī | amṛtākhyā doṣakartrī pāragā pūrikā tathā || 13|| mahadādyaṃ viśeṣāntaṃ samprasūte’khilaṃ jagat | sā yā prakṛtiriṣṭaiva kāntāvanmohinī priyā || 14|| mohāpannastu puruṣaḥ sa ātmā jīva īśvaraḥ | ahaṃkārakṛtamaitryo mahattattvātibāndhavaḥ || 15|| mānase kṛtaviśvāso janmalābhāya kalpate | prakṛtau nāsti yasyeṣṭaṃ mohastasya na vidyate || 16|| ahaṃkāre na vai maitrī mahattatve na bandhutā | mānase na ca viśvāso mokṣalābhāya kalpate || 17|| tasyaite’nukūlabhāve vartante hyupakāriṇaḥ | māyā kālaśca puruṣasta ete’pyupakāriṇaḥ || 18|| prāpayantyakṣaraṃ divyaṃ yasyeṣṭaḥ parameśvaraḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ paramadhāmagaḥ || 19|| tadyogāttvasya jāyante bhaktasya divyavigrahāḥ | jñānecchākṛtayaścāpi sukhaduḥkhādibhāvanāḥ || 2.93.20|| dharmādharmādikośāśca mano’haṃbuddhivedanāḥ | jāyante divyarūpāśca sattvaṃ rajaśca kalmaṣam |||21||| tanmātrāṇīndriyavargaḥ ṣaṭkośā bhūtapañcakam | tadvikārāstathā sarve jāyante divyaghaṭṭanāḥ ||22|| tatkriyāstadvyavahāraśceṣṭā vartanamityapi | sarvaṃ divyaṃ mokṣadaṃ ca jāyate brahmanirguṇam ||23|| kālo nātra prabhuryo vai sṛjate harate prajāḥ | sarve kālasya vaśagāḥ kālo bhaktasya vai vaśe ||24|| bhakte’kṣaraṃ tvakṣare ca sarvajñaḥ svāmivallabhaḥ | sarvajñānna paraḥ kaścit taṃ bhajitvā pramucyate ||25||| nityaṃ nāstīti jagati kiñcit sthāvarajaṃgamam | ṛte śrīparamātmānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ||26|| nāyaṃ tapobhirvividhairna dānena na cejyayā | śakyo vai dehibhirjñātuṃ vinā bhaktiṃ parāśrayām ||27|| śrīhariṃ sarvabhūtānāmantastiṣṭhati sarvataḥ | taṃ sarvasākṣiṇaṃ lokā na jānanti pareśvarāḥ ||28|| yasminnantaḥ sarvamidaṃ yaśca sarvāntare sthitaḥ | so’yaṃ dhātā vidhātā ca kālo’gnirviśvatomukhaḥ ||29|| na taṃ paśyanti munayo rājasāḥ pitṛdevatāḥ | brahmā virāṭ tathā bhūmā ye cānye tatpare’pi ca ||2.93.30|| yathākathañcit tannāthaṃ jānāmyarthaṃ tato’varam | muktā nāntaṃ nākṣaraṃ ca tadānyeṣāṃ tu kā kathā ||31|| nityaṃ tadvigrahe vyāptā naiva jānāti māṇikī | tadānyāsāṃ tu śaktīnāṃ kā kathāsya vijānane ||32|| gṛṇanti satataṃ vedā tamekaṃ parameśvaram | yajanti vividhairyajñairbrāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ ||33|| dhyāyanti yoganiṣṭhāśca yatante pāramīkṣitum | vinānugrahamevāsya naiva paśyanti kāṣṭhayā ||34|| sa eva sarvahaviṣāṃ bhoktā cāpi phalapradaḥ | sarvadevatanuḥ so’yaṃ sarvātmā śreyasāṃ padam ||35|| taṃ tatkṛpayā paśyanti vidvāṃsaḥ santa eva tu | teṣāṃ sannihitaḥ so’yaṃ ye taṃ nityamupāsate ||36|| tebhyo dadāti tatsthānamānandaṃ paramaṃ padam | uttamā madhyamāścāpi nikṛṣṭāḥ pāpayonayaḥ ||37|| tasya bhaktyā pramucyante tenaiva saṃgatā yadā| tadbhaktā na vinaśyanti nimnaṃ yānti na vai padam ||38|| tanmārgasthāstasya yogaṃ kārayanti hi sādhavaḥ | yo vai nindati tān mūḍho bālakṛṣṇaṃ sa nindati || 39|| yastān pūjayate bhaktyā sa taṃ pūjayati prabhum | patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ bhojanaṃ cāmbaraṃ dravam ||2.93.40|| tasmai dadāti yo bhaktyā sa syāt tasya priyaḥ sadā | sa pūrvaṃ bhaktavargasya duḥkhanāśārthameva hi ||41|| śaktiṃ prakāśayāmāsa rādhikāṃ nijavāmataḥ | tayārthitaḥ sa vai kṛṣṇo babhūvākṣaradhāmani ||42|| goloke nyavasat tasyā bhaktigrahaṇahetave | sa pūrvaṃ bhaktavargasya sampaddānārthameva tu ||43|| śaktiṃ prakāśayāmāsa śrīlakṣmīṃ nijavakṣasaḥ | tathārthitaḥ sa vaikuṇṭhe nārāyaṇo babhūva ha ||44|| sa pūrvaracanārthaṃ vai sṛṣṭiṃ sasmāra pūrvavat| | śaktiṃ prakāśayāmāsa jaghanāt prakṛtiṃ parām ||45|| tayārthitaḥ sa bhagavānnavyākṛte’kṣarāśraye | vāsudevo’hamabhavaṃ prakṛteścetanāpradaḥ ||46 || tenārthitā mahāsṛṣṭirjanisthairyāntadharmiṇī | tanmūrtyātmakamaddehādbhavantastraya eva ca ||47|| aniruddhaśca pradyumnaḥ saṃkarṣaṇo’tivaibhavāḥ | prāvirbhūtā guṇakāryakarāḥ śrīparameśvarāḥ ||48|| tenārthitastato nyāyaḥ sa bhūmā taddhṛdudbhavaḥ | īśvarāṇāṃ nyāyakartāmṛte dhāmni virājate ||49 || tenārthitastato māyāvikāro’ṅkurakāraṇam | muktastasya bhrakuṭestu samutpannaḥ sa pūruṣaḥ ||2.93.5 0|| prakṛteḥ puruṣaḥ so’yaṃ ramate māyayā tadā | tasmājjātaṃ ca yugalaṃ buddhyā mahatsamākhyayā ||51 || sevitaśca pumān tasyāḥ kānto ramaṇarañjanaḥ | pradhānapuruṣau deho hareḥ khyātāvubhau sadā |||52|| tattvaṃ tābhyāmahaṅgarvābhidhānaṃ samajāyata | mahāviṣṇuḥ sa vai jātaḥ sṛṣṭyarthaṃ śrīniṣevitaḥ ||53 || tasmājjāto virāḍākhyastato devā harādayaḥ | tebhyaḥ pitṛpraṇālyā vai vedānaprāpayaddhariḥ ||54|| sa eva parame dhāmni rājamānaḥ pareśvaraḥ | tapo’rthaṃ kalpayāmāsa naranārāyaṇaṃ tanūm ||55 || jīvalokasya śāntyarthaṃ duḥkhanāśārthamityapi | āsurāṇāṃ praśāntyarthaṃ lakṣmīśaḥ kṣīrasāgare ||56|| śvedhāmni ramākānto virājateṃ’śamātrataḥ | yogināṃ ca satāṃ sādhvīyoṣitāṃ paramo guruḥ ||57|| dhārmikāṇāṃ sa goptā ca nihantā vedavidviṣām | māyikānāṃ ca māyāyā nihantā sa pareśvaraḥ ||58|| sā māyā ca parā śaktiryadā vidyeti gīyate | sā māyā cāparā śaktiryadāvidyā hi sā matā ||59|| nāśayet sa ca tāṃ māyāṃ mokṣaprado hi mādhavaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sarvaśaktīnāṃ pravartako nivartakaḥ ||2.93.60|| ādhārabhūtaḥ sarvāsāṃ nidhānamamṛtasya ca | ekā śaktiḥ keśavasyākṣaraṃ brahma ca dhāma yat ||61 || anyā śaktirvipulā yā saṃsthāpayati vai jagat | tatrāntaryāmitā tasya cāparā śaktireva sā ||62|| jñānabhaktiprapakṣābhyāṃ samārādhayati prabhum | sa yāti vai harerdhāma vyatikramya tu kilbiṣam ||63|| sarvāḥ śaktīrvyatikramya māṃ prayāti madiṣṭakṛt | mamopāsanayā kecid bhavantyapi narāyaṇāḥ ||64|| mama bhāvaiḥ saṃbhṛtāśca tārayanti ca dehinaḥ | kecid bhavanti lokeśā viṣṇavastatkṛpāvaśāt ||65|| kecit harādayaścāpi kecid brahmādikeśvarāḥ | teṣu sarveṣu bhagavān prerakaśca nivartakaḥ ||66|| so’yaṃ brahmavidāṃ brahmā svayaṃbhūrviśvatomukhaḥ | māyāvināmayaṃ devaḥ purāṇo hariravyayaḥ ||67|| yogināmastyayaṃ śaṃbhuḥ strīṇāṃ devī girīndrajā | ādityānāmayaṃ viṣṇurvasūnāmasti pāvakaḥ ||68|| rudrāṇāṃ śaṃkaraścāyaṃ garuḍaḥ patatāmayam | airāvato gajendrāṇāṃ rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāmayam ||69|| ṛṣīṇāṃ ca vaśiṣṭho’yaṃ devānāṃ ca śatakratuḥ | śilpināṃ viśvakarmāyaṃ prahlādaḥ suravidviṣām ||2.93.70|| munīnāmapyayaṃ vyāso gaṇānāṃ ca vināyakaḥ | vīrāṇāṃ vīrabhadro’yaṃ siddhānāṃ kapilo muniḥ ||71|| parvatānāmayaṃ merurnakṣatrāṇāṃ tu candramāḥ | vajraṃ praharaṇānāṃ ca vratānāṃ satyameva saḥ ||72|| ananto bhogināṃ so’yaṃ senānīnāṃ ca pāvakiḥ | āśramāṇāṃ gṛhasthaḥ sa yugānāṃ satyameva saḥ ||73|| kuberaḥ sarvayakṣāṇāṃ nirvṛtiḥ sarvarakṣasām | prajāpatīnāṃ dakṣaśca mṛgendrāṇāṃ mṛgādhipaḥ ||74|| vedānāṃ sāmavedaśca japyānāṃ praṇavastvayam | sūktānāṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ manurnītimatāṃ hi saḥ ||75|| vidyānāmātmavidyā saḥ tattvānāṃ cetano hi saḥ | gatīnāṃ muktirevāyaṃ bandhanānāṃ tu vāsanā ||76|| patnīvrato dvijānāṃ tu satīnāṃ kambharā satī | sampadāṃ ca mahālakṣmīrūpaḥ saḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||77|| evaṃ vai bhāvayettatra tatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | tena nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī tatra phalati sarvathā ||78|| sa ca mūrtisvarūpo’sti sarvalokeṣu cānujāḥ | tathaivācāryarūpo’sti guruḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ ||79|| sādhurūpaḥ sa evāsti divyadehaḥ sa pāvanaḥ | pitṛrūpaḥ sa evāsti mātṛrūpo’pi mādhavaḥ ||2.93.80|| satīrūpaḥ patirūpaḥ sa evāsti narottamaḥ | aṣṭāvete hi guravastārakā divyabhāvitāḥ ||81|| teṣāṃ pratyupakāro hi na kathaṃcana vidyate | teṣāṃ nityaṃ priyaṃ kuryāt karmaṇā manasā girā ||82|| ta evaite’nādiśrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakāḥ | matvaivaṃ ye bhajante tān yānti te paramāṃ gatim ||83|| so’yaṃ sākṣātparabrahānādiśrīpuruṣottamaḥ | sarvāvatāraśāstā ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||84|| bhagavām̐ścākṣarātītaścāntaryāmīśvareśvaraḥ | bālarūpaḥ kambharāśrīgṛhe cāste’vatīrya ca ||85|| śrīmadgopālabālaḥ saḥ lomaśāśramasannidhau | prāsāde kānake cāste’kṣarakṣetre’śvasārase ||86|| tīrthe kuṃkumavāpyākhye bhūtale divyavigrahe | vartate mānave rūpe brahmapriyābhisevitaḥ ||87|| kṛpayā jīvamokṣārthaṃ brahmāṇḍarakṣaṇāya ca | vartate mānave rūpe mānavarjyo’pi mādhavaḥ ||88|| brahmaviṣṇumaheśānām bhavatāmaṃśarūpiṇām | dṛndṛśyo vartate bhāgyād yo nāsmaddṛkpragocaraḥ ||89|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau vāsudevaḥ prabhuḥ kṣaṇam | dadhyuścitte trayaste’pi divyamānavamacyutam ||2.93.90|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vāsudevagītāyāṃ prabhoḥ prāptisādhanavibhūtīnāṃ nirūpaṇanāmā trinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 93 ||
<2.94> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike vāsudevavākyaiḥ prabodhitāḥ | māhātmyajñānavantaste trayo’ṇḍastadagrajam || 1 || pūrvotsaveṣu kṛṣṇasya darśanārthaṃ vayaṃ gatāḥ || idānīṃ taddarśanārthaṃ māhātmyajñānasaṃyutāḥ ||2 || jigamiṣāmo bhavatā sārdhaṃ bālasvarūpiṇaḥ | līlākaivalyavīkṣārthaṃ tadvijñānena rañjitāḥ || 3 || ityevaṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ prokto vāsudevo hariḥ prabhuḥ | bhrātṛbhiḥ saha tallokād brahmāṇḍodaramāyayau || 4 || vāsudevasya lokātte vairājasadṛśāṇavaḥ | bhūtvā vairājalokām̐ścāviviśuśca tato’pi ca || 5 || bhūtvā cāṇutarāḥ satye loke cāviviśustataḥ |. tato’pyaṇava evaite bhūtvā divaṃ samāyayuḥ || 6 || tato’pyaṇutamā bhūtvā mānavaṃ lokamāyayuḥ | yatpūrvaṃ śrīvāsudevamūrtirvai svasya dhāmani || 7 || tasyā romṇastu pārārdhyabhāgo’tra mānuṣe sthale | tasyāpi koṭibhāgena mānuṣaṃ dehamāsthitāḥ || 8 || tejasā bhāsurāste ca catvāro vyūhasaṃjñakāḥ | bālakāḥ sadṛśā bhutvā cāśvapaṭṭasaro’mbare || 9 || āyayurdivyahaṃsānāṃ vimāne cātibhāsurāḥ | vāsudevo’bhavattatra caturbhujo’tibhāsuraḥ || 2.94.1 0|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmahetimān mukuṭojjvalaḥ | anye trayo dvibhujāścābhavam̐ścakragadāyudhāḥ || 11 || kiśorā divyarūpāśca vāsudevasamāḥ śubhāḥ | anekasūryasaṃkāśāḥ svarṇakuṇḍalabhūṣaṇāḥ || 12|. vanamālākaustubhādidharā mukuṭaśobhanāḥ | divyadehā divyasiddhyaiśvaryasāmarthyarājitāḥ || 13 || sahasnakoṭidevānāṃ tejāṃsi bhāsurāṇi ca | yeṣāṃ romasu vidyante tādṛśāste vimānake || 14|| vyadṛśyantāmbarasthe te sāyaṃ madhyāhnavaddhyabhūt | saurāṣṭrasya prajāḥ sarvā vilokya divasādapi ||15|| cātipramāṇatejāṃsi vyatarkayan prabhuḥ svayam | vimānena vihārārthaṃ vyomnā yāti sthalāntaram || 16|| yadvā devāḥ samāyānti pūjanārthaṃ harermuhuḥ | tathaivete samāyātā bhaveyuścetyatarkayan || 17|| atha kuṃkumavāpyāśca prajā bhāgavatāstadā | niryayuḥ svagṛhebhyaśca tūrṇaṃ darśanahetave || 18|| tāvad vimānaṃ ruciraṃ hyavātatāra cāmbarāt | aśvapaṭṭasarastīre lomaśāśramasannidhau || 1 9|| catvāraste vyūhakṛṣṇā vimānādvahirāyayuḥ | koṭicandrojjvalakāntivyāptāmṛtābdhimūrtayaḥ ||2.94.20|| padbhyāṃ vihṛtya ca śanairaśvapaṭṭasarojale | sasnurmānuṣarūpāste prayayurlomaśāśramam || 21 || ṛṣiścakāra satkāraṃ svāgataṃ mānanādikam | madhuparkaṃ dadau pūjāṃ cakāra candanādibhiḥ ||22|| divyadṛṣṭyā vyūhatattvaṃ jñātvā cakāra daṇḍavat | ārārtrikaṃ tataścakre vyūhānāṃ lomaśo muniḥ ||23|| brahmapriyāḥ ṛṣayaśca cakrarnamaḥkriyāṃ tataḥ | utthāya te ṛṣīnnatvā bālakṛṣṇālayaṃ yayuḥ || 24|| bālakṛṣṇaḥ pitarau ca prāha vyūhāgamaṃ tadā | sotsāhau pitarau tūrṇaṃ mānārthaṃ cābhijagmatuḥ ||25|| śrutvā tvanye surāścāpi munayaśceśvarā api | tīrthāni tattvasaṃghātāḥ santaḥ sādhvyo maharṣayaḥ ||26|| sanmānārthaṃ cābhijagmuryatraite vyūhamūrtayaḥ | akṣataiścandanaiḥ puṣpairjayaśabdaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 27|| vardhitāḥ satkṛtāste ca bālakṛṣṇālayaṃ yayuḥ | bālakṛṣṇastadā naijaṃ rūpaṃ dadhāra dhāmagam ||28|| vāsudevasamūhāstu yanmūrtau yānti līnatām | koṭigolokavaikuṇṭhādhipāḥ prayānti līnatām ||29|| tādṛśaṃ paradhāmasthaṃ divyarūpaṃ dadhāra saḥ | divye gajāsane’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ || 2.94.3 0|| koṭimuktagaṇairjuṣṭaḥ tatsthamūrtirvyarājata | tadā vyūhān vihāyānyacakṣūṃṣi śrīharau kṣaṇāt || 31 || na prāvartanta vai parābhūtāni haritejasā | parābhūtākṣikamalāḥ surādyā niryayustataḥ || 32|| svasvasthānaṃ yayuḥ sarve tato vyūhān haristathā | pitarau svāgataṃ premṇā cakraturbhavanāṃgaṇe || 33 || bālakṛṣṇasya bhavane viviśuste sadīśvarāḥ | gajāsanasthitaṃ sveṣṭaṃ vavandire ca nemire || 34|| kṛtvā ca daṇḍavad bhūmau pūjanaṃ cakrire mudā | vāsudevo dadau divyaṃ mukuṭaṃ mastake hareḥ ||35|| lalāṭe candanaṃ tailasāraṃ saṃkarṣaṇo dadau | tilakaṃ candrakaṃ gandhasāraṃ pradyumna ārpayat || 36|| netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ ramyaṃ rañjanādi samārpayat | karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale gucchau karṇapūrāvataṃsakān ||37|| vāsudevo dadau kaṇṭhe sauvarṇamālikāḥ śubhāḥ | hārān hīrakamāṇikyamuktāñcitān sakaustubhān ||38|| dadau saṃkarṣaṇo ramyān kaṭakān śṛṃkhalāstathā | ūrmikāṅgūlīyakāni prakoṣṭhaśṛṃkhalāstathā ||39|| raśanāṃ ca sumañjīre dadau svarṇe’niruddhakaḥ | pāduke divyamṛdule cāmare cātapatrakam ||2.94.40|| yaṣṭiṃ ca kānakīṃ ratnanaddhāṃ kare tu naktakam | saugandhaṃ puṣpapatrādigranthiṃ saṃkarṣaṇo dadau ||41 || pradyumnaścārpayāmāsa sauvarṇasthālikāṃ śubhām | miṣṭānnāmṛtasampūrṇaphalabījādisaṃbhṛtām || 42|| aniruddho’mṛtapānaṃ dadau tāmbūlakaṃ tathā | ārārtrikaṃ cakārāsau vāsudevaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ||43|| pradakṣiṇaṃ namaskāraṃ daṇḍavat cakrurīśvarāḥ | puṣpāñjalīn daduḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvarāḥ ||44|| tvamanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | rājamānaḥ pare dhāmni dvibhujo’kṣarasevitaḥ ||45|| tanmuktaistava muktaiśca sevitaḥ parameśvaraḥ | parabrahma paramātmā parastvaṃ bhagavānprabhuḥ ||46|| tvatto muktāḥ prakāśante līyante vigrahe tava | tavāntike ca tiṣṭhanti tavānandātinanditāḥ ||47|| asaṃkhyā brahmabhāvāśca brahmapriyā bhavatsamāḥ | aiśvaryaśaktayaste ca tava vigrahajā hi tāḥ ||48 || tava sevāṃ prakurvanti muktānyo brahmavigrahāḥ | tvatto jātā vayaṃ vyūhā avatārāstatheśvarāḥ ||4 9|| īśvarāṇyastathā māyā pūruṣāḥ kālavatsarāḥ | vairājā vaiṣṇavāścāpi brāhmaṇāḥ śāṃbhavāstathā ||2.94.50 || vigrahāstava mūrtervai samutpannā maharṣayaḥ | pitaro munayaḥ siddhāḥ sādhavaḥ śīlayoginaḥ ||5 1 || satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ sāṃkhyayogavratinyaḥ kāntayoṣitaḥ | pativratā tathā patnīvrato lakṣmīrnarāyaṇaḥ ||52|| pitaro divyavāsāśca naro nārāyaṇastathā | pātālasthābhūgṛhāśca kṣīre śeṣo narāyaṇaḥ ||53|| śrīrlīlā bhūḥ satī padmā gaṃgā prabhā sarasvatī | māṇikyā saguṇā premā pāravatī ca mañjulā ||54|| vibhūtiḥ rādhikā sītāmṛtā santoṣikā ramā | haṃsā ca duḥkhahālakṣmīrdayā jayā ca tūlasī ||55||| haimī śāntā ca sāvitrī vṛndāstvetāstu śaktayaḥ | campā lalitā kastūrī ojasvatyādikāstathā ||56 || kapilo datta īśāno nṛsiṃho vāmano hariḥ | haṃso matsyastathā kūrmo varāho jiṣṇurityapi ||57|| hariḥ pṛthuśca gopālo haṃsaḥ ṛṣabha īśitā | rāmaḥ paraśurāmaśca balaśca bhagavān śukaḥ ||58|| vallabhaścāpi hemanto devaprakāśa ityamī | yajñaḥ kumārayogāśca tavaivāṃśavibhūtayaḥ ||59|| tattvāni tattvacaitanyaṃ guṇaśaktirasādayaḥ | tavāṃśā bhagavan sarve yeṣu tvamota eva ca ||2.94.60 || tvayi protaṃ tathā sarvaṃ tvameva patiruttamaḥ | tava darśanalābhārthaṃ bālaṃ vīkṣitumutsukāḥ ||61 || darśanaṃ prāptavantaśca kṛtakṛtyā vayaṃ prabho | ityuktvā praṇatāḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ datvā sukhasthitāḥ ||62|| bālakṛṣṇastu taṃ rādhe tadāhārthayituṃ varam | vāsudevastadā prāha vāsaṃ te caraṇe sadā ||63|| dehi nātha kṛpāsindho vyūhecchāṃ samprapūraya | tathāstviti prabhuḥ prāha cakāraiṣāṃ tanudvayam ||64|| kuṃkumavāpyāṃ vāsārhaṃ vyūhatīrthe’vasaddhi tat | dvitīyaṃ mūlarūpaṃ ca vyūhacatuṣṭayaṃ tu yat ||65|| śrīharerājñayā tattu yayau dvīpaṃ sitaṃ tataḥ | tasmād yayau satyalokaṃ tato’vyākṛtadhāma ca ||66|| evaṃ te vāsudevādyā vyūhasaṃjñā maheśvarāḥ | jīveśasṛṣṭiśāstāro rādhike śrīhareḥ puraḥ ||67|| sarvadā vāsamācakruścāśvapaṭṭasarovare | tīrthatoyataṭe teṣāṃ mandiraṃ paramaṃ śubham ||68|| vāsudevālayākhyaṃ ca nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā | śrīharerājñayā tatra rājante bhrātaraśca te ||69|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paṭṭaśiṣyake | svayaṃprakāśe līnāśca vartante vyūhasaṃjñakaḥ ||2.94.70|| bhagavantaśca catvāraścaitanyamūrtirūpiṇaḥ | vyūhasyaivāvatāraḥ sa svayaṃprakāśa īśapaḥ ||71 || vāsudevaḥ svayaṃ cāste caturguṇasamanvitaḥ | divyaṃ caturbhujaṃ cainaṃ svayaṃprakāśaṃ mānavāḥ ||72|| ye’rcayiṣyanti te puṇyaṃ lapsyante vyūhajaṃ phalam | śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike vāsudevaṃ svayaṃ prakāśakam ||73|| pūjanārthaṃ sadā prātaḥ prayāntyeva ca tatpriyāḥ | vāsudevasya vai patnī lakṣmīrmā hariṇī tu yā ||74|| saṃkarṣaṇasya yā patnī sunandā sā mahāsatī | pradyumnasya priyā dhīśca sarvapoṣaṇakāriṇī ||75|| aniruddhasya suśīlā catasrastāḥ striyaḥ khalu | catuḥśriyo vimānena nityaṃ yānti ca rādhike ||76 || paśyāyaṃ samayaścāste brāhmastāsāṃ pravāsayuk | tāvattāsāṃ vimānaṃ ca niryātaṃ rādhikāpuraḥ ||77|| rādhikā tāḥ pravīkṣyaiva vimānādavarohayan | rādhikā tu samutthāya natvā cāśliṣya bhāvataḥ ||78|| prasannā svāgataṃ cakre madhuparkaṃ tathāsanam | dadau pūjāṃ pracakārātithyaṃ pūrṇaṃ cakāra ca ||79|| kuśalaṃ paripapraccha tā api rādhikāṃ tathā | rādhāha kva prayāṇaṃ vaḥ prātaḥ sañjāyate priyāḥ ||2.94.80|| tāḥ prāhurnaḥ patiḥ śrīśaḥ svayaṃprakāśanāmataḥ | vyūhāvatāro bhagavān vartate’śvasarovare ||81|| anādiśrīkṛṣaganārāyaṇaśiṣyo mahāprabhuḥ | asmatpatīnāmaṃśāśca catvārastatra santi hi ||82|| vartate mānave bhāve bālabrahmavratānvitaḥ | kumārastasya pūjārthaṃ gacchāmo nityameva vai ||83|| tvayā smṛtāstato rādhe tvāgatāstvatra harṣitāḥ | ityuktvā rādhikāṃ tāstu pūjayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||84|| sarvaśṛṃgāradravyāṇi rādhikāyai dadurhi tāḥ | ājñāmādāya ca tūrṇaṃ yayuścāśvasarovaram ||85|| hariṇī ca sunandā ca dhīḥ suśīlā ca tā imāḥ | patyaṃśaṃ samprapūjyaiva kusumākṣatacandanaiḥ ||86|| patyaṃguṣṭhajalaṃ pītvā bhojayitvā ca taṃ tataḥ | ārārtrikādikaṃ kṛtvā prasādamāpya tasya ca ||87|| pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ śrīkaṃbharāśriyam | natvā sammilya ca pūjāṃ datvā prāpya śubhāṃ giram ||88|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prati yayustataḥ | pūjayitvā pareśeśaṃ natvā stutvā punaḥ punaḥ ||89|| ārārtrikaṃ hareḥ kṛtvā tasthurdadhyuḥ kṣaṇaṃ harim | prabhuḥ prāha prasanno’smi varaṃ vṛṇuta cepsitam ||2.94.90|| tadā tāḥ prāharasmākaṃ vāsastvatra yathā bhavet | pātivratyaṃ prarakṣyeta tathobhayatra sevane ||91|| vāñcchāpūrtiṃ sadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa vidhāpaya | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha rūpadvayaṃ vidhāya ca ||92|| tīrtharūpāṇi catvāri vyūhatīrthe nyavāsayat | mandire pratimāsvāsāṃ vāsaṃ cākārayat prabhuḥ ||93|| yathā divyasvarūpairhi svayaprakāśasevanam | bhavettathā kṛtaṃ tābhiḥ kṛte nārāyaṇena vai ||94|| anyāni mūlarūpāṇi cājñāmādāya vai tataḥ | yayustvavyākṛtaṃ dhāma vāsudevādisaṃśritam ||95|| ityevaṃ rādhike duṣṭaṃ bhavatyā cākṣigocaram | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyasyaiśvaryamadbhutam || 96|| kimahaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi pratāpaṃ parameśituḥ | yadguṇānāṃ kīrtanena bhuktirmuktirdhruvā sadā ||97|| yatraiśvaryāṇi satataṃ vartante divyavigrahaiḥ | yatreśvareśvarāścāpi vartante divyavigrahaiḥ ||98|| yatrāvatāraharayo vartante divyavigrahaiḥ | yatra sṛṣṭīśvarāḥ sarve surāśca divyavigrahaiḥ ||99|| yatra brahmapriyā muktā vartante divyavigrahaiḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprasannatāptaye || 2.94.10 0|| tasya kṣetrasya mahimā varṇayituṃ na śakyate | jyeṣṭhasya pūrṇimāyāṃ tad vyūhatīrthaṃ sarasyabhūt || 101 || āṣāḍhadvitīyāyāṃ ca śrīcatuṣṭayatīrthakam | svayaṃprakāśatīrthaṃ ca pāvanaṃ tadabhūt tadā || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vyūhacatuṣṭayaśrīcatuṣṭayayoḥ kuṃkumavāpītīrthāgamanaṃ svayaṃprakāśatīrthaṃ vyūhacatuṣṭayatīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturnavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 94 ||
<2.95> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ śrīhareḥ paramātmanaḥ | rādhe caikādaśabhaktayogād deśaḥ surakṣitaḥ || 1 || dakṣiṇe vartamāne vai khaṇḍe uṣṇālayābhidhe | astrālaye raṇe tatra sāmudraghoravāyubhiḥ || 2 || jāte tūpadrave deśo vālukābhistu madhyagaḥ | parito’bdhijalaiścāpi dharṣito viplavīkṛtaḥ || 3 || ācchādito’bhavad bhādrapade vṛṣṭyā vināśitaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena svāminā tataḥ || 4 || rakṣitaḥ svasya bhaktārthaṃ śṛṇu puṇyatamāṃ kathām | ūṣṇālaye mahākhaṇḍe pūrvegastyo mahāmuniḥ || 5 || ākāśena yayau pūrvaṃ pāvayituṃ tu tadbhuvam | agastyo bahudeśām̐śca samudraṃ pravihāya ca || 6 || yayau tasmin mahākhaṇḍe hemaśālākhyaparvate | tato bālācalaṃ rāvāsanādriṃ tvambarād yayau || 7 || dārāliṃgagiriṃ maṣīgrīvādriṃ bhekadānakam | adriṃ tathā śālavīnagiriṃ grāmācalaṃ tataḥ || 8 || ācālaparvataṃ cāpi divādikparvataṃ tathā | cāṭādriṃ ca tato gatvā tvāyayau hemaśālake || 9 || tasya droṇīṃ vṛkṣavallītṛṇaiḥ pallavitāṃ śubhām | suvṛṣṭyā phalapuṣpāḍhyāṃ vīkṣya vatsaramāvasat || 2.95.1 0|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyam̐ smaratyaharniśam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 1 1|| japatyeva sadā mantraṃ hemaśālācale vasan | lopāmudrāpi taṃ mantraṃ japatyeva pativratā || 1 2|| tayā saha munirnityaṃ tīrthīkartuṃ tadāpagāḥ | nityaṃ vihāyasā yāti snātuṃ bhinnasarittaṭam || 13|| murānadyāṃ turunadyāmaitanadyāṃ tathā muhuḥ | sasnau gośaṃkunadyāṃ ca bālānadyāmapi kvacit || 14|| sasnau marcāśanānadyāṃ mākamānasarasyapi | bālāsarovare māṅgisarasi śvānikājale || 15|| kuvane sarasi sasnau lābharucisarasyapi | jhinkunadyāṃ rinkunadyāṃ phinkunadyāṃ tathā punaḥ || 16|| sasnāvuttuṃgasarasi ārasarovare tathā | turūsarovare sasnau grāgirākhye sarasyapi || 17|| maurīnadyāṃ turānadyāṃ bhurānadyāṃ tathā muniḥ | sasnau kavindumānadyāṃ gaurānarasarovare || 18|| kāruliṅgyāṃ dāruliṅgyāṃ cāruliṃgīsarityapi | kvīlpīnadyāṃ laviṃgāyāṃ pāvanāyāṃ tathā tataḥ || 19|| mīcalāyāṃ philañcāyāṃ sasnāvagastyako muniḥ | ghelīnadyāṃ helīnadyāṃ vitūrīyāsarityapi || 2.95.20|| phījarāyāṃ cāpagāyāṃ sasno nirjharaṇeṣvapi | lopāmudrā satī pūjāṃ cakre taddevatārcanam ||21 || sarāṃsi saritaścāpi cakruragastyamānanam | athaiteṣu pradeśeṣu sarittaṭeṣu kutracit || 22|| kutracitpārvate deśe kutracit sarasastaṭe | viprāstu tāpasā raudrā vaiṣṇavāḥ sūryadevatāḥ || 23|| vasantaste vilokyainamagastyaṃ khyātapauruṣam | prasannahṛdayāḥ sarve svāgatādi vyadhurmudā ||24|| hemaśālāyano bālāyano rāvāsanāyanaḥ | dārāliṅgāyanaścāpi bhekadāneyatāpasaḥ ||25|| masigrīvamaharṣiśca tathā śālavanāyanaḥ | ācālarṣistathā grāmāyano vāṭāyanastathā ||26|| divādiṅgāyanādyāśca tāpasā brahmavedinaḥ | sahasraśo’nyaviprāśca brahmagṛhavanasthitāḥ || 27|| yatayaśca mahātyāgaparā vijñāśca yoṣitaḥ | satyaḥ sādhvyo nivasanti cātmadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ ||28|| agastyastu dadau tebhyo vijñānaṃ pārameśvaram | parabrahmākṣarātītaḥ paradhāmavirājitaḥ ||29|| anantamuktasevyaḥ śrīpuruṣottamasaṃjñakaḥ | paramātmāntarātmā ca kṛṣṇāt kṛṣṇataraśca yaḥ ||2.95.3 0 || vāsudevānmahāvāsudevaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ | divyaiśvaryavibhūtyādisaṃbhṛto bhagavān prabhuḥ || 31 || kālamāyāniyantā ca vyūhāvatāraśāsakaḥ | īśvarāṇāmīśvareśaḥ surāṇāṃ suraśaktidaḥ ||32|| ṛṣīṇāṃ cāpi pitṝṇāṃ rakṣakastaddhṛdi sthitaḥ | devamānuṣanāgānāmantaryāmī parātparaḥ |||33 || sarvabrahmapriyākāntaḥ sarvadhāmaprabhāpradaḥ | sarvāvatāradhartā ca sarvasākṣī nirañjanaḥ || 34|| svaprakāśo’sīmaśobhāsīmakandarpasundaraḥ | divyamūrtirvedavedyo yogivedyo’ntarātmani ||35|| hṛccakṣurbhistathā vedyaścāvedyo bāhyavṛttibhiḥ | agamyo māyayā channairgamyo bhaktisamanvitaiḥ || 36|| atidūro’pyatisāmīpyasthaḥ sakhā sukhapradaḥ | sarvapradaḥ sadānandaḥ sarvānandaprado hariḥ ||37|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo rādhāramāpatiḥ | prabhāpāravatīhaṃsāmaṃjulāsaguṇāpatiḥ || 38 || lakṣmīśrīmāṇikīnāthaḥ satpatirbhaktabhāvitaḥ | ṛṣīśaḥ karuṇāpūrṇo hyabālo bālarūpadhṛk ||3 9|| vartate yaścājanābhe khaṇḍe deśe surāṣṭrake | aśvapaṭṭasarastīre’kṣarakṣetre vimuktide ||2.95.40|| divye kuṃkumavāpyākhye nagare ca nijālaye | kambharāśrīnandanaḥ sa śrīmadgopālabālakaḥ ||41|| parabrahma svayaṃ yaḥ sa bālabrahmādya vartate | antarātmā ca yaḥ so’dya bālātmā bahirasti vai |||42|| yogināṃ yogaphalado jñānināṃ vittigocaraḥ | muktānāṃ mānase tiṣṭhan satīnāṃ satyadhārakaḥ ||43 || yajñānāṃ vahnirūpe ca bhojako havanāśanaḥ | tapasvināṃ tapovṛtteḥ śraddhārūpo’sti yaḥ prabhuḥ ||44|| sāttvikānāṃ dharmasattvaṃ nītīnāṃ nyāyavistaraḥ | satkriyāṇāṃ cātitheyo bhaktā rādhanagocaraḥ ||45|| nirākāro’saṃkhyamūrtiryaḥ sa bālo virājate | kṛpayā karuṇāsindhurmokṣadaḥ pāpināmapi ||46|| yatprasaṃgena tattvāni jaḍānyapi kṛtānyapi | akṛtāni cetanāni divyāni saṃbhavanti ca ||47|| amuktā muktimāyānti pāpā bhavanti pāvanāḥ | asiddhāḥ siddhimāsādya yaddhyānād yānti mokṣaṇam ||48|| aguṇā guṇavantaśca bhavantyasya pratāpataḥ | māyikā māyayā śūnyā jāyante’sya smṛterapi ||49|| kalmaṣā nāśamāyānti yanmūrterdarśanādapi | nāsya vai darśane prāpte kartavyaṃ cāvaśiṣyate ||2.95.50|| prāptavyaṃ śiṣyate nāpi sa vai bālo’dya vartate | viprā gṛhṇantu tanmantraṃ muktidaṃ sarvasiddhidam ||51 || ityuktā rādhike viprā jagṛhurmantramuttamam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||52|| prajepuḥ satataṃ taṃ ca dadhyurvai divyarūpiṇam | teṣāṃ vai hṛdaye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ samasphurat ||53|| kiśoro divyarūpaśca koṭimanmathasundaraḥ | bhejuste ca tato nityamagastyoditapūjanaiḥ ||54|| aṣṭadhā śrīharerbhaktiṃ cakrurmokṣābhivāñcchayā | evaṃ sahasralakṣāśca bhajante brāhmaṇā harim ||55|| agastyasya tu yogena astrālayakṣitau tadā | uṣṇālaye mahākhaṇḍe’bhavan bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ||56|| varṣānte’gastyamunirāṭ kṛtvā tīrthāni sarvaśaḥ | vaihāyasā yayau lopāmudrāyuto’śvasārasam ||57|| kṣetraṃ śrīkuṃkumavāpīsaṃjñaṃ tatra sthiro’bhavat | atha bhādrapade tatra vyomni rātrau graho mahān ||58|| sahasrayojanadīrghatejaḥkalgilasacchirāḥ | udayaṃ caiti nityaṃ vai deśopaplavasūcakaḥ ||19|| dhūmaketurmahātrāsaprado lokavināśakaḥ | yaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu prajāḥ sarvā nāśabhītisamākulāḥ ||2.95.60|| abhavam̐ścāpyabhajam̐śca bālakṛṣṇa pubhuttamam | akurvaṃstasya bhaktiṃ ca vividhārādhanātmikām ||61|| atha bhādrasya vigame pūrṇāyāṃ prātareva tu | samudrasya jalānāṃ vai viplavaḥ parito hyabhūt| ||62|| velā bhayapradā sarvadeśapralayakārikāḥ | cukṣubhuścāticaṇḍairvai vātaiḥ saha ca vṛṣṭibhiḥ ||63|| uṣṇālayasya khaṇḍasya parito’bdhijalairbhuvaḥ | yojanāyatabhāgā vai saṃplutā pralayo yathā ||64|| grāmāḥ kheṭāḥ kharvaṭāścāvasathā ghoṣavistarāḥ | samudramavadhiṃ kṛtvā yāvadyojanameva te ||65|| abdhivelaughavegaiśca naṣṭā jalalaye tadā | vṛkṣā latā vanoddeśā udyānāni ca vāṭikāḥ ||66|| naukāstheyāni bandhāni setavaḥ kṣetrabhūmikāḥ | vartmāni yānarakṣārthaṃ gṛhṇāṇi bhūśirāṃsi ca ||67|| velaughavegairnaṣṭāni vyāpārasya sthalāni ca | vimānāvasthalībandhā naṣṭāḥ sarve jalaughakaiḥ ||68|| nadīmukhāstathā sarve prajāvasatayo’pi ca | paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścānye khanayo’pi layaṃ gatāḥ ||69|| evaṃ jalalaye jāte hāhākāro mahānabhūt | atha nadyo’pi saṃkṣubdhāḥ kṣubdhāni ca sarāṃsyapi ||2.95.70|| nadīsarovarāpaśca yayuḥ kṣetreṣu cābhitaḥ | udvelābhiḥ pradeśāste saprajāḥ pralayaṃ gatāḥ ||71|| sthale jalaṃ jale sthalaṃ viparītamapadyata | ativarṣātivātaiśca dehino vilayaṃ gatāḥ ||72|| pārvatā vanavāsāśca dṛśyante naiva dehinaḥ | jalānāṃ tu pravāheṣu śavā mānavapakṣiṇām ||73|| paśūnāṃ ca sarīsṛpamṛgādīnāmanekaśaḥ | kallolairuhyamānāśca vilokyante sahasraśaḥ ||74|| vṛkṣāśca vṛkṣaśākhāśca dṛśyante pūravāriṣu | gṛhāṇi parṇaśālāśca taranti layavāriṣu ||75|| nadyaḥ sarovarāṇyanyā dīrghikāścāpi kūpakāḥ | sāmudrākhātasadṛśā dṛśyante jalapūritāḥ ||76 || evaṃ jāte vināśasya kāraṇe jalaviplave | jhaṃjhāvātairvālukāścāḍīyanta raṇagāstadā ||77|| yathā meghāstathā tāśca dṛśyante cāmbare tadā | vālukābhiḥ pūritāni netrāṇi cāndhatāṃ yayuḥ ||78|| vālukāhatanetrāste dehinastu parasparam | naiva paśyanti vai tatra rajo’ndhā vātatāḍitāḥ ||79|| ākāśe vāyuvegena kṣipyante śākhinastathā | gṛhāṇi vallayaścāpi maṇḍapācchādanānyapi ||2.95.80|| ullocāśca vitānāni vastrāṇi pakṣiṇastathā | kṣipyante bahuvegena vātena ca jale sthale ||81|| gṛhāṇi cātibhagnāni vṛkṣā bhagnāstathoṭajāḥ | āśrayā āśramāḥ saudhāḥ prāsādā neśurūṭajāḥ ||82|| vālukāvarṣaṇairgrāmāśchannā vai vālukātale | evaṃ raṇāt samuḍḍīya vālukāvarṣaṇaṃ hyabhūt ||83|| vṛkṣāśca vāṭikā udyānāni prajāśca pakṣiṇaḥ | paśavastāpasāścāpi vālukāchannavigrahāḥ ||84|| vālukāntargarbhagāste bhūgarbhe nihitāḥ kṣaṇāt | abhavam̐ste vinā śvāsairmṛtāḥ koṭisahasraśaḥ ||85|| ṛṣayo munayaścāpi parvatasthāḥ kṣitisthitāḥ | vīkṣyopacchavamatyugraṃ samādhau kṛtasaṃyamāḥ||86|| ākṛṣya nāḍikāprāṇān niṣeduḥ kuṃbhakādiṣu | sasmarurbhagavantaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hṛdi ||87|| abhaktā ruruduścāpi tresuścukruṣurudgalam | hāhācakrurbālakāśca hā mātastāta cukruśuḥ ||88|| vilapanto narāḥ patnīrāhvayāṃcakrurudgalam | patnyo’patyāni pitaraṃ cāhvayāṃcakruratyati ||89|| paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ cāpi uṣṭrāṇāṃ kariṇāṃ tathā | siṃhānāṃ cānalānāṃ cākrośāśca garjanānyapi ||2.95.90|| duḥkhabhṛtānyatyabhan jhaṃjhāvāte tadā muhuḥ | na śrūyante na rakṣyante svarakṣā yatra duṣkarā ||9 1|| tatrānyarakṣaṇaṃ kena kutra vā harimantarā | kālānane grāsabhāvaṃ gatānāṃ rakṣako’tra kaḥ ||92|| parvatā raṇadeśāśca nadyaścāpi sarāṃsi ca | vanāni coccabhāgāścāraṇyāni kṣetrabhūmayaḥ || 93 || sarve pṛthvītalaṃ jhaṃjhāvātaiścāpīḍitaṃ tadā | jātaṃ bhādrasya pūrṇāyāṃ rātrau tu pratipaddine ||94|| āsāyaṃ tanmahotpātairvinā mṛtiṃ mṛtāḥ prajāḥ | hemaśālāyanādyāstu tadā maharṣayo’malāḥ ||95|| vīkṣyāśāntaṃ vātavegaṃ jalānilakṛtaṃ layam | samādhāveva śāntyarthaṃ sasmarurbālakṛṣṇakam ||96|| karuṇāsāgaraṃ bhaktarakṣākaraṃ kṛpānidhim | avigaṇayya pāpāni śaraṇāgatarakṣakam ||97|| gajarakṣākaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ garbhe rakṣantamīśvaram | pralaye rakṣakaṃ nāthaṃ māyāto rakṣakaṃ prabhum ||98|| prāṇānāṃ rakṣakaṃ kāntaṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ harim | bālānāṃ rakṣakaṃ devaṃ sṛṣṭirakṣākaraṃ patim ||99|| yoge rakṣākaraṃ svāminārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dehiprajīvanam || 2.95.1 00|| sasmarurhṛdaye tvekādaśarṣayo laye sthite | tuṣṭavurmanasā sarve deśarakṣaṇahetave || 101 || jhaṃjhāvātasya śāntyarthaṃ vṛṣṭeḥ śāntyarthamityapi | vālukāvṛṣṭiśāntyarthaṃ bhūtānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || 102|| rādhike te tuṣṭuvurvai parameśaṃ parātparam | kṛpāluṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ samprāpte nāśe maharṣayaḥ || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāyantāne uṣṇālayakhaṇḍe’gastyapravāsastatratyarṣigaṇena jhaṃjhāvātābdhijalakṣobhe laye jāte śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ smṛta ityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 95 ||
<2.96> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike bālaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | yathā stutaḥ samāgatya rarakṣa jīvanaṃ dadau || 1 || deśe sarvatra ye jīvā agastyaṃ ca samāśritāḥ | guruṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ taṃ sasmarurmaraṇonmukhāḥ || 2 || nārāyaṇaṃ parameśaṃ parabrahma ca tuṣṭuvuḥ | bhagavan yadi nāśārthaṃ vayamatra kṛtāstvayā || 3 || sākṣāt svayaṃ samāgatya kathaṃ nāśaṃ karoṣi na | tava hastena nāśo no mokṣārthaṃ syācchubhārthakaḥ || 4 || yena tvayārpitaṃ janma tvayāgastyo’rpito guruḥ | tvaṃ kṛpānātha jihvāyāṃ mānase vartase tathā || 5 || evaṃ tava janā jīvā vayaṃ tvayā nijīkṛtāḥ | teṣāṃ no maraṇaṃ prāṇāstava haste bhavanti vai || 6 || jīvanaṃ prāṇanaṃ sañcālanaṃ sarvaṃ vaśe tava | tat kathaṃ vātavṛṣṭyātra vālukāvṛṣṭibhistathā || 7 || jalopaplavapralayairasadgatipradā mṛtiḥ | yatrānte darśanaṃ tena nāpyagastyasya yoginaḥ || 8 || ākasmike’tra maraṇe pretakhaṇḍo’yamulbaṇaḥ | bhaviṣyatyantakabhūmiḥ kimevaṃ tava rocate || 9 || śaraṇāgatapātā tvaṃ śaraṇyo duḥkhahārakaḥ | mṛtyorduḥkhavināśārthaṃ kathaṃ nāgacchasi prabho || 2.96.1 0|| ajātaprajñā bālāśca bālikā dauhṛdastriyaḥ | vṛddhāśrayasthitā garbhe mriyante vālukāhatāḥ || 11 || jaleṣu cāpi mriyante vinā te darśanaṃ prabho | harirnāma na te cāsti kiṃ vā nārāyaṇo bhavān || 19 || atra kiṃ vā tvayā kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇatvaṃ kalmaṣīkṛtam | aho prāṇanirodhena niruddhastvaṃ janārdana || 13 || janārdanaḥ kimatraiva khyāyase vātakarmabhiḥ | kṛpālustvaṃ kṛpāṃ kṛṣṇa kathaṃ lunāsi cāpadi || 14|| ahiṃsrastvaṃ kathaṃ hiṃsāṃ sahase nirguṇo’si kim | apatyānāṃ jāyamānaṃ duḥkhaṃ paśyati cet pitā || 15|| yatate duḥkhanāśārtha svayaṃ mṛtvāpi mānavaḥ | sa tvaṃ cāmānavastvāsse pitṛtvaṃ tvayi nāsti kim || 16|| kathaṃ noddharase kaṣṭāt kaṣṭahā nāsi kiṃ prabho | kathaṃ cākasmikaṃ tvaitad bhaktānāṃ maraṇaṃ hare || 17|| sahase kimabhaktāḥ smo’parāddhaṃ kiṃ tava prabho | kiṃ bhakteste phalaṃ caitad vinā mṛtyuṃ vināśanam || 18|| kathaṃ tvadbhaktika pāpametādṛśaṃ sthitam | ākasmikavināśo yatphalaṃ pretasthalī hi bhūḥ ||19|| udvelastvekatastvabdhiścaikato meghavarṣaṇam | ekato vālukāvṛṣṭirjhaṃjhaṃjhaivātastathaikataḥ ||2.96.20|| parito’bdhijalairnāśaścordhvato vṛṣṭibhirhatiḥ | pārśvato vālukābhiśca sarvato vātaghātanaiḥ ||21|| havanaṃ pīḍanaṃ prāṇarodhanaṃ mardanaṃ tathā | hīṃsanaṃ kaccarībhāvastāḍanaṃ rodhanādikam ||22|| sarvaṃ yadatra sampannaṃ yamaloko na cāparaḥ | evaṃ kathaṃ prabho te’tra bhaktānāṃ cāpado bhuvi ||23 || akāṇḍatāṇḍave prāṇān juhoṣi vada naḥ prabho | rakṣa rakṣa kṛpāsindho jalasindhuṃ nivāraya || 24|| trāhi trāhi raṇāpadbhyastrāhi vṛṣṭijalāditaḥ | rakṣāgastyaguro cāsmān rakṣa mṛtān tavāśritān ||25||| rakṣa rakṣa guro kṛṣṇa rakṣa nārāyaṇa prabho | ityevaṃ prārthayāmāsuḥ prajāstrāṇaṃ tathārthayan ||26|| tvayā rakṣā kṛtā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa purā hare | pṛthvyā vārāharūpeṇa pṛthurūpeṇa vai punaḥ ||27|| matsyarūpeṇa lokānāṃ jale naukā nidhāya ca | naraharisvarūpeṇa pralhādasyāvanaṃ kṛtam ||28|| pradyumnādisvarūpeṇa rakṣyante bhuvanāni vai | jiṣṇurūpeṇa devānāṃ rakṣāṃ karoṣi sarvadā ||29|| sādhurūpeṇa jīvebhyaścābhayaṃ pradadāsyapi | sarvarakṣākarastvaṃ vai sarve sṛṣṭaṃ tvayā hare ||2.96.30|| sarvaprāṇinivāsastvaṃ rakṣāṃ kuru, kṛpānidhe | bīje rakṣāṃ pṛthivyāṃ cāṃkure rakṣāṃ karoṣyapi ||3 1 || patre rakṣāṃ śalākāyāṃ granthau rakṣāṃ karoṣi ca | nāle rakṣāṃ tathā śimbyāṃ puṣpe kaṇe phale’pi ca ||32|| punabīje tathā rakṣāṃ karoṣi jagatāṃ prabho | jale sthale’mbare vāyau vahnau rakṣāprado bhavān ||33|| nārakāṇāṃ tathoddhārakaro virājate bhavān | śāvadīnāmahākālyā balibālāḥ prarakṣitāḥ ||34|| rākṣasīkaraṇaḥ śāpo nivāritastvayā purā | ṛṣīṇāṃ rakṣakaścāste bhavān śrībhagavān sadā ||35|| devāyano dvijastvayoddhṛtaścāṇḍālayonitaḥ | yamagṛhaṃ gato vipraputrastvayā samāhṛtaḥ ||36|| mojāmbikā tvayābdhau ca purā saṃrakṣitā prabho | brakadānarṣirakṣā ca tvayā kṛṣṇa kṛtārave ||37|| udayanṛpateḥ rakṣā jale magnasya vai kṛtā | vasumedho jale magnaḥ sakuṭumbastvayoddhṛtaḥ ||38|| sudhanākhyasya bhaktasya caurebhyo rakṣaṇaṃ kṛtam | hiraṇyakeśaśiṣyāṇāṃ rakṣonāśe’vanaṃ kṛtam ||39||
