nīpālayapradeśake ||96|| vihāre kosale cāpyavimuktakṣetrake tathā | iṣṭapitṛgṛhe sarve svaprākaṭyaṃ prapedire ||97|| jātismarā abhavam̐śca sarve bhāgavatottamāḥ | vaiṣṇavāḥ siddhimantaśca kāmarūpadharāstathā || 98|| divyā divyavihārāśca divyāmbaravihāriṇaḥ | sukhinaḥ sarvasampannā yathā vaikuṇṭhasaṃsthitāḥ ||99|| etāṃ sarvāṃ kathāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ | hemaśālāyanāyāha kanyā prāha tathorvaśīm || 2.103.10 0|| ityevaṃ rādhike sarvaṃ nārāyaṇecchayābhavat | na kālo na ca karmāpi prārabdhaṃ nātra kāraṇam || 10 1|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vaikuṇṭhāllakṣmyā dāsānāṃ dāsīnāṃ ca satyalokāgamastato’śvapaṭṭasarovarāgamastato nīpālayapradeśe śivarājagṛhe lakṣmyāḥ prākaṭyaṃ dāsadāsīnāṃ bhinnapradeśeṣu prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā tryadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 103 ||
<2.104> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike tatparaṃ hemaśālāyano narāyaṇam | papraccha tu tapaḥ kīdṛk kṛtaṃ śaṃkarakanyayā || 1 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagāda tūttaram | śivarājasutā cakravākīṃ śrīgaṇḍakītaṭe || 2 || uvāca parayā prītyā putri cāgaccha me gṛham | ityuktā prayayau putrī hyurvaśī jananīgṛham || 3 || rājyagṛhe’tiramye sā pāliteva sutiṣṭhati | janānāṃ sā tu sānnidhye naiva vadati kiñcana || 4 || nirjane bahudhālāpān mātrā saha karoti sā | nadyāmudyānake vāṭyāṃ kṣetre saudhe sabhāgṛhe || 5 || pākagṛhe ca śayane kaṇagṛhe mahānase | snānagṛhe samāje ca mandire svāminastathā || 6 || evamanyatra sarvatra sahagā corvaśī sadā | mātrā saha dinakṣepaṃ karoti śāpakāraṇāt || 7 || śivarājasya vai bhaktyā satyā bhaktyā jayasya ca | kṛṣṇāyāścāpi candrasya subhaktyā dhenupasya ca || 8 || nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ nityaṃ divyakiśorarūpavān | prasannastadgṛhe yāti viyāti prāpya pūjanam || 9 || bhuṃkte dattaṃ tu naivedyaṃ jalaṃ pibati miṣṭakam | tāmbūlaṃ cāpi gṛhṇāti vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇam || 2.104.1 0|| lakṣmyā ca kanyayā dattaṃ sarvamaśnāti bhāvataḥ | urvaśyāpi pradattaṃ ca pracchannaṃ janakāya yat || 1 1|| tat sarvaṃ cātibhaktyaiva gṛhṇāti bhagavān prabhuḥ | nityamevaṃ gṛhyamāṇe kānte kāntātibhāvukī || 1 2|| nimagnā premavaśagā tvekānte prārthanāṃ śubhām | cakāra svavivāhārthaṃ śāpanāśārthamityapi || 13|| kṛṣṇādīnāṃ pramuktyarthaṃ tadā prāha narāyaṇaḥ | mā śaighryaṃ vaha vāmoru nātidūraṃ kṣaṇaṃ tu tat || 14|| ityuktvādṛśyabhāvaṃ śrīnārāyaṇo’gamattataḥ | urvaśī prāha sā kanyā tapasā sādhyate hariḥ || 15|| ityevaṃ bhagavānāha pitā te māṃ narāyaṇaḥ | vad kīdṛk tapaḥ kāryaṃ kva gantavyaṃ himālaye || 16|| upadravā na yatra syustādṛśaṃ kiṃ sthalaṃ bhavet | tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ bhavet putri vada darśaya tatsthalam || 17|| daityāśca rākṣasāścāpi dānavā harivairiṇaḥ | śaṃbhośca vairiṇo’raṇye vicaranti divāniśam || 18|| abalānāṃ mahatkaṣṭaṃ nirjane tu tapo’rjane | tatra tvaṃ cakravākyāsse śyenebhyaste bhayaṃ sadā || 1 9|| ahaṃ kanyā vivāhārhā daityādibhyo bhayaṃ ca me | tapaḥsiddhiryathā syādvai nirvighnā harituṣṭaye ||2.104.20|| tādṛk sthalaṃ vada putri yadi jānāsi parvate | ityuktā tūrvaśī prāha mātaryāvān himālayaḥ ||21|| mayā dṛṣṭo’sti parito viharantyā suraiḥ saha| kāścit sthalyastatra santi yatra vasanti mānavāḥ ||22|| droṇyastāḥ pārśvabhāgasthā araṇyavanamiśritāḥ | bhūtāyanapradeśo’sti yatra vai śāṃkarīprajāḥ || 23|| nīpālayapradeśo’yaṃ yatra vai pārvatīprajāḥ | tathā badarīdeśaśca yatra nārāyaṇīprajāḥ || 24|| tathā trivartadeśo’pi yatra tridevajāḥ prajāḥ | tathā kāśmīradeśo’pi yatrāste kāśyapī prajā ||25|| tathā gāndharvadeśaśca cāraṇānāṃ pradeśakaḥ | kinnarāṇāṃ pradeśāśca kiṃpuruṣabhūmayaḥ ||26|| satīśivasya kailāsastathā devādibhūmikāḥ | vidyante’saṃkhyakā mātaḥ parvate tu himālaye ||27|| tatra vighnā bhaveyurvai devamānavadaityajāḥ | nirjanaṃ na sthalaṃ tatra kvāpi saṃbhāvyate’mba vai |||28|| mayā tvekaṃ sthalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ purā yannātidūragam | droṇyāṃ yat kṛṣṇaśailasya yatrāste pūrvasṛṣṭijaḥ |||29|| hanumān brahmacārī ca rāmabhakto’titāpasaḥ | yatra naivāsti vighnānāṃ saṃbhavastasya sannidhau || 2.104.30 || kadalīnāṃ vane so’yaṃ mahābhāgavataḥ prabhuḥ | nityaṃ sītādāsabhakto rājate nātigocaraḥ || 31 || kvacit śrībadarīṃ yāti kvacidgaurītapaḥsthalam | gaurīśikharamevāpi kvacit kailāsaparvatam ||3 2|| kvacidvai kāñcanīṃ gaṃgāṃ gahare śṛṃgavartini | yatra yatra hanumān sa prayāti ca vasatyapi ||33|| tatra naivāsti vighnānāṃ mātarvai saṃbhavaḥ khalu | gaṃgāmūle tu śikhare kalpalatā bhavanti ca || 34|| yad yadā ceṣyate tattat tadopasthitamāpyate | hanūmadāśramastatra vartate sarvarakṣakaḥ ||35|| gantavyaṃ tatra śikhare tapaḥ kāryaṃ hi nirjane | āvedayitvā kīnāśaṃ sthāsyāvastapase sadā ||36|| ityevaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā duḥkhinīkamalā sutā | mātre nivedayāmāsa jānakyai tapa īhitam || 37| mātarme vartate cecchā kartuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ patim | sa māṃ prāha madarthaṃ vai tapaḥ kuru sukanyake ||38|| tato’haṃ tapaso’rtha vai gamiṣye tu himālayam | gahanaṃ nirjanaṃ prāpya kariṣye tapa uttamam ||39|| tapaḥ siddhyuttaraṃ mātaścāgamiṣye tavāntikam | śrutvā mātā śuśocāti komalā bālikā mama ||2.104.40|| kathaṃ pāraṃ tapasaḥ sā gamiṣyati hareḥ kṛte | ityevaṃ cintayamānā sā jagād harāya tat ||41|| śivarājo vicāryaiva yogenāha tu jānakīm | yogyaṃ sā vakti kanyātra yataḥ sāsti ramā svayam ||42||| tvaṃ cāsi dakṣaputrī vai satī cāhaṃ haraḥ svayam | kṛṣṇādyā vaikuṇṭhavāsāḥ santi śāpavaśādiha ||43|| sarve’tra janimāpannā nārāyaṇaḥ sadā prage | bhaktasnehādatra nityaṃ samāyāti pareśvaraḥ ||44|| tadvākyena priye kanyā ramā tapaḥ kariṣyati | ramayā saha ca tato nārāyaṇasya śārṅgiṇaḥ ||45|| prāpte tu samaye patni vivāhaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati | tato vayaṃ ramāśāpād vimuktāḥ syāma bhāmini ||46|| tadyogyaṃ sarvathā cāstu tapo nirvighnameva ca | saphalaṃ tattapaścāstu hariścāstu sutāpatiḥ ||47|| eṣā yā cakravākyasti sā putrī corvaśī hareḥ | śāpamuktāpi tapasā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||48|| ityevaṃ śaṃbhvanumatā jānakī prāha putrikām | vatse tvayārthitaḥ kānto nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ||49|| tapasā tattapaste’stu saphalaṃ samanoratham | prāpayituṃ sthalīṃ yatra tapastvaṃ vai kariṣyasi ||2.104.50 || śivarājastathā cāhaṃ samāgacchāva īśvari | apekṣitaṃ gṛhāṇātra muhūrtaṃ ca śubhaṃ tathā ||51|| rakṣārthaṃ vada dāsyāmi bhrātaraṃ yadi rocate | tadā prāha ramā mātarmama kiṃcinna rocate |||52||| rakṣāṃ me tapasaḥ kṛṣṇo rakṣānāthaḥ kariṣyati | vastu kiñcinna cecchāmi vanyaṃ yaddehasādhanam ||53|| śubho me’stu haraḥ sākṣāt kailāsavāsakṛt prabhuḥ | rakṣā me’stu sadā mātā satī dakṣasutā mama ||54|| rakṣako me vaiṣṇavo’stu hanumān śaṃbhubālakaḥ | sāhacarye cakravākī yorvaśī mama bālikā ||55|| himālayaḥ svayaṃ rakṣāṃ kariṣyati mamāmbike | svayaṃ me rakṣakaścāste varado’pi narāyaṇaḥ ||56|| nārāyaṇaṃ variṣye’haṃ mariṣye vā himālaye | sādhayiṣye mano’bhīṣṭaṃ mokṣayiṣye tu śāpataḥ ||57|| ityevaṃ pūrvasaṃskārā jagāda mātaraṃ sutā | tataḥ sā balavaccandre pṛṣṭvā saṃpūjya mātaram ||58|| pitaraṃ bāndhavān bālā svasāraṃ ca suhṛjjanān | sakhījanān samāpṛcchya kṛtakautukamaṃgalā ||59|| jaṭāvalkalavastrāḍhyā śālagrāmaśilānvitā | aparigrahasarvasvā tyaktvā rājyasya vaibhavān ||2.104.60|| vighneśaṃ ca satīṃ sūryaṃ natvā śivaṃ narāyaṇam | kārtikasyaiva pūrṇāyāṃ yātrāṃ cakāra kanyakā ||61 || cakravākyā saha putrī yayau śīghraṃ vihāyasā | tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāstadābhavan ||62|| surāṇāṃ puṣpavṛṣṭiśca cāndanī vṛṣṭiruttamā | pārṣadānāmabhavacca sahāyā maruto’bhavan ||63|| śakunānyabhavam̐statra vyomni saubhāgyacihnitāḥ | suradevyaśca militā gacchantyo badarīvanam ||64|| śveto gajaścaturdanto milito’vataran divaḥ | hanūmān bālasūryābho mārge dṛṣṭipathaṃ gataḥ ||65||| yāsyan kāñcanagaṃgāṃ saḥ svāśramaṃ tu himālaye | apṛcchat kanyake kutra gamyete vada no’dhunā ||66|| mamāśrame hyabhaktānāṃ praveśo nāsti sarvathā | ramā prāha namaste’stu rāmanāmamahodadhe ||67|| mahābhāgavataśreṣṭha rāmapriya namo’stu te | tāpasīnāṃ taporakṣākara bhakta namo’stu te ||68|| abhaktā nāsmi sītāsmi nārāyaṇapriyā ramā | iyaṃ nārāyaṇaputrī cakravākyurvaśī sutā ||69|| sanatsujātaśāpena cakravākītanusthitā | śāpamokṣaṇakāmeyaṃ tapastaptuṃ samicchati ||2.104.70|| ahaṃ lakṣmīḥ svayaṃ cāsmi tatho’rthaṃ yāmi vānara | hanūmadāśramo yatra tvāste śṛṃge sugahvare ||71|| yatrāste kāṃcanagaṃgā kalpavallīsamāśrayā | tatra yāmi tapo’rthaṃ te sannidhau harilabdhaye ||72|| śrutvaivaṃ tu ramāvākyaṃ hanūmān mātaraṃ drutam | nanāma pādayoḥ śīghramahobhāgyamamanyata ||73|| śivarājasya jānakyā putrīṃ śrutvā tatastaram | ānandaṃ prāptavām̐ścāti sevāvān kiṃkaro’bhavat ||74|| śaṃkarasya sutaḥ sākṣāddhanūmān vānarottamaḥ | śaṃbhuputrīṃ svasāraṃ śrīṃ jñātvānandabharo’bhavat ||75|| svasṛputrīmurvaśīṃ ca jñātvā tāmabhyanandayat | sarvāśramaṃ nītavām̐statra kadalīvanaśobhitam ||76|| svalpaśṛṃgādhityakāyāṃ gahvare sarvadā sukhe | kalpavallīsamāyukte sarvasiddhisamanvite ||77|| narbhaye rājyasadṛśe vāsaṃ dadau plavaṃgamaḥ | dhūnī dadau tathā vahnikuṇḍaṃ dadau śubhāśrayam ||78|| kamaṇḍaluṃ valkalāni cāsanaṃ japamālikām | śītoṣṇajalakuṇḍāni phalamūlajalāni ca ||79|| tathā nārāyaṇamūrtiṃ caturbhujāṃ dadau tadā | tathopacārasarvasvaṃ dadau svasre hanūdharaḥ ||2.104.80 || evaṃ tadrakṣite deśe lakṣmīścakravatī tathā | mārgakṛṣṇadvitīyātastapa ādyaṃ japātmakam ||81|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | mālābhistanmantrajapaṃ cakratustu divāniśam ||82|| snānaṃ kāñcanagaṃgāyāṃ sadā triṣavaṇaṃ hi te | cakratuḥ prātarevaite natvā śrībhrātaraṃ kapim ||83|| pūjayitvā hariṃ nityavidhānatastataḥ punaḥ | havanaṃ tvanale kṛtvā tepāte sajapaṃ mudā ||84|| cakrāte māsamātraṃ te kandāhāraṃ sakṛd divā | rātrau bhūśayana kṛtvā cakrāte bhajanaṃ hareḥ ||85|| tato dvitīyamāse te phalāhāraṃ pracakratuḥ | tṛtīye māsi te patrāhāraṃ cakraturādarāt ||86|| caturthe māsi te puṣpāhāraṃ cakraturutsuke | pañcame māsi meghāmbupānaṃ cakraturambare ||87|| ṣaṣṭhe māsi tu bāṣpāṇāmaśanaṃ cakraturmudā | saptame cakratuḥ sādhvyau kṛṣṇārthaṃ pavanāśanam ||88|| aṣṭame śvāsamātreṇa tasthatuścetanānvite | navame māsi taruvat tvekapādena saṃsthite ||89|| daśame māsi ca tayordehayoḥ kāṣṭhatulyatā | ekādaśe tato māsi vahnistu tapasodbhavaḥ ||2.104.90|| samutthito mahājvālaścātmaśaktyā bhayaṃkaraḥ | vyānaśe sarvato dikṣu brahmāṇḍe nāśakārakaḥ ||9 1|| aṇurūpaiścātidāhairjāvāntaṃ prāṇanāśakaḥ | āścaryaṃ prāpa hanumān rāmakṛṣṇeti vai japan ||92|| rakṣāyāṃ vartate tatra sevako haribhaktakaḥ | vijñāya bhagavān lakṣmyāstapasaścātikāṣṭhatām ||93 || urvaśyāścāpi tapasaḥ parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ vilokya ca | nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ tatra drāgeva ca samāyayau ||94|| padbhyāṃ samāyayau premṇā patnyāstapo vilokitum | phalaṃ dātuṃ tapasaśca tapo’ntārthaṃ samāyayau ||95|| koṭisūryasamaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vilokya ca | hanumān daṇḍavaccakre tathā svāgatamuttamam ||96|| āsanaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca pūjanaṃ phalapuṣpakaiḥ | sunaivedyaṃ jalaṃ śītaṃ dadau nārāyaṇāya saḥ ||97|| naivedyaṃ ca jalaṃ naiva bubhuje śrīnarāyaṇaḥ | yāvallakṣmīścorvaśī ca na bhuñjāte phalaṃ jalam ||98|| atha gatvā sannidhau drāguvāca parameśvaraḥ | aho lakṣmyāstathorvaśyāḥ kīdṛśaṃ tapa uttamam ||99|| yadvarṣmaṇoranalā vai sūryasamāḥ kṣaranti hi | brahmāṇḍadāhaśaktā vai mahāpralayasadṛśāḥ || 2.104.10 0|| śāpasya pratikāro’dya pūrṇo jāto na śiṣyate | dadāmyābhyāṃ bodhayitvā yadiṣṭaṃ sukhadaṃ tayoḥ || 10 1|| iti vicintya bhagavān hanumantamuvāca ha | yāhyetayoścetanārthaṃ jalaṃ kāṃcanagāṃgakam || 102|| śīghramānaya pātre’smin mā ciraṃ kuru bhaktarāṭ | ityuktvā bhagavānāste kṣaṇaṃ maunaṃ samādhimān || 1 03|| ityevaṃ rādhike svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ | nārāyaṇasvarūpeṇa phalaṃ dātuṃ samāyayau || 1 04|| hemaśālāyanādyāstacchrutvāścaryaṃ paraṃ gatāḥ | acintayannaho lakṣmyāścorvaśyāstapa uttamam || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mātāpitrājñāṃ gṛhītvā lakṣmyurvaśyostapo’rthaṃ himālaye hanumadāśramagamanaṃ, tapaḥ, varṣānte tapaḥphalaṃ dātuṃ tatra nārāyaṇasya sākṣādgamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 104 ||
<2.105> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścād yajjātaṃ kathayāmi te | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha hemaśālāyanāya yat || 1 || kamaṇḍaluṃ gṛhītvā śrīhanumān vyomamārgagaḥ | jalaṃ kāñcanagaṃgāyā ānayatpāvanaṃ drutam || 2 || dadau nārāyaṇāya drāṅ nārāyaṇo’ñjaliṃ dadau | tāpasībhyāṃ tu śuṣkābhyāṃ yāvat tāvattu vai dvayoḥ || 3 || brahmarandhrāccetanasya sañcāro hṛdaye’bhavat | prāṇo’pyasañcarad dehe netre coddhāṭya te tadā || 4 || puro vyalokayatāṃ śrīnārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram | prāpatustu paraṃ harṣaṃ vilokya puruṣottamam || 5 || sauvarṇamukuṭaṃ ratnamaṇimauktikaśobhitam | dhārayantaṃ mastake sve vakrasnigdhajaṭāyute || 6 || karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale cāpi pārśvayoḥ śekharālikām | lalāṭe tilakaṃ candraṃ netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ śubham || 7 || paritaḥ paridhiṃ śuklataijasaṃ tvānanasya vai | hāsyayuktamukhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hārakaustubhaśobhitam || 8 || raśanāśṛṃkhalābhiśca kaṭakairurmikādibhiḥ | aṅgulīyakakaṭakairveṣakusumahārakaiḥ || 9 || śobhitaṃ parameśānaṃ parabrahma janārdanam | sarvaśobhāspadaṃ ramyaṃ kiśoraṃ svarṇarūpiṇam || 2.105.1 0|| campakābhaṃ vahnidhautadivyāmbaravirājitam | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmavanamālāvibhūṣitam || 1 1|| varadānaṃ pradātuṃ vai tvāgataṃ kamalāpatim | bhaktapatiṃ kṛpāpārāvāraṃ śāntamanoharam | 12|| punarjalena saṃprokṣya śāntayantaṃ tapo’nalam | āhvayantaṃ kamaleti urvaśīti punaḥ punaḥ || 13|| vadantaṃ yuvayoḥ siddhiṃ dātuṃ cāgatavāniti | varaṃ vṛṇuta kamale priye putri tathorvaśi || 14|| yuvābhyāṃ cātikaṣṭaṃ vai madarthaṃ prāptamityataḥ | prasanno’smi dadāmyadya varaṃ bhavatyapekṣitam || 15|| tapoyogānnivartethāṃ kamale cakravāki ca | śopasyānto bhavatvadya dadāmīṣṭatamaṃ ca vām || 16|| kamalā prāha bhagavan vivāhavidhinā tu mām | gṛhāṇa nijapatnīṃ vai cāparādhaṃ kṣamasva me || 17|| yadyapyahaṃ sadā patnī tavāsmīti na guptatā | tathāpi śivarājasya kanyāṃ māṃ vidhinā vaha || 18|| tathāstviti hariḥ prāha yāhi pitṛgṛhaṃ priye | pūrṇe dvādaśavarṣe te pitā mātā ca bāndhavau || 19|| svasā tvete prayāsyanti kāśīvāsārthameva tu | tatrāhaṃ prasamāgatya grahīṣye tvāmaninditām ||2.105.20|| tatra tvāmudvahiṣyāmi neṣyāmi mama mandiram | jalaṃ piba phalaṃ bhuṃkṣva meṃ’ke niṣīda vai rame ||21 || ityuktā sā tapastyaktvā nārāyaṇāntikaṃ yayau | aṃke niṣadya kāntaṃ taṃ samāśliṣat kṣaṇaṃ ramā ||22|| dattaṃ phalaṃ jalaṃ cāpi putrīṃ vihāya padmajā | nāgrahīdatha bhagavānurvaśīṃ prāha putrike ||23|| śīghramāyāhi bhuṃkṣvedaṃ phalaṃ piba jalaṃ tataḥ | putrī prāha pitanaivaṃ grahīṣye tu phalaṃ jalam ||24|| pitaryadi prasanno’si tapaḥ pūrṇaṃ ca me yadi | bhakteṣṭadātāsi nādeyaṃ vidyate yadi ||25|| apātrabhṛtavāryatra śikhare tapasaḥ sthale | prāpayānyat salilaṃ na pibāmi dehinārpitam || 26|| yadyevaṃ na dadāsyatra vāri tarhi pibāmi na | prāṇān jahyāṃ śikhare’tra tvadagre jalamantarā || 27|| viśvaṃbhareti ca pitastava nāma prasiddhyati | bhaktavatsalanāmā ca bhaktārthaṃ śrīviyogavān || 28 | mama mātā ramā lakṣmīṃ tyaktavān dhāmasaṃsthitām | tato’haṃ yadi bhaktāsmi putrī snehasya pātrikā || 29|| vātsalyena prayuktastvaṃ kiṃ karoṣi vilokaye | mayā vṛṣṭijalaṃ pātrābhṛtaṃ cātra samiṣyate || 2.105.30 || tat pibāmi tataḥ śāpānmokṣaṇaṃ cāstu me pitaḥ | ityuktvā nāgatā cāṅke jalārthaṃ tūrvaśī sutā ||3 1 | sarvaṃ tyajati bhaktārthaṃ madarthaṃ ki tyajatyayam | pito madbhaktivaśatāṃ prāptaśced bhagavān svayam || 35|| vicāryetthaṃ haṭhānnaivāgamat pituḥ samīpataḥ | pitā nārāyaṇaḥ prāha sute tatra jalāptaye || 33 || vṛṣṭyā droṇyāṃ saṃbhṛtāyāṃ jalaṃ śṛṃgagataṃ bhavet | ucchrite vṛṣṭisalile śikharānnimnabhūmikāḥ || 34|| sarvā magnā jaleṣu syuḥ prāṇināṃ pralayo bhavet | tatpāpaṃ te bhavet putri tato’trāgatya vai piba || 35 || urvaśī prāha bhagavan varadānavacastava | abhīṣṭadānavākyaṃ cet satyaṃ tvatra jalaṃ naya || 36|| yadi satyaṃ na te vākyaṃ yāhi kurve tapaḥ pitaḥ | atraiva tu mayā peyaṃ jalaṃ nānyatra kutracit || 37|| apātrasaṃsthitaṃ peyaṃ sthiraṃ peyaṃ na cañcalam | na vā divyaṃ bindurūpaṃ tbambarāt prapatat kila || 38 || ahaṃ cettava bhaktāsmi bhaktāvākyaṃ prapūraya | avākyapūraṇe te syātpāpaṃ tvasatyavāgbhavam || 39 || mṛṣābhīṣṭapradaṃ vākyaṃ noccāryaṃ vā kadācana | śaṃkarārthaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ madarthe na kathaṃ pitaḥ ||2.105.40 || kṛṣṇārthaṃ ca kṛtaṃ sarve madarthaṃ na kathaṃ pitaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin janārdana kṛpālaya ||41 || māṃ bhaktāṃ śikhare cātra pānīyaṃ na dadāsi cet| | saṃkariṣye tapaścograṃ sarvasaṃsārabhasmakṛt || 42|| bahūnāṃ dehināṃ nāśe tava pāpaṃ bhaviṣyati | jalamagne jagatyeva mama pāpaṃ yathoditam || 43 || kimatra cātivaktavyaṃ pāpanāśakaro bhavān | vartate’tra tathāpyatra pāpabhītiṃ dadāti cet ||44|| pitaḥ pāpavināśārthaṃ kastvāṃ vai saṃbhajiṣyati | puṣpodyānāni naivedyamiṣṭānnāni tvadarśakam ||45|| kaḥ kariṣyati te’rthaṃ vai yadi pāpaṃ na nāśyase | pāpahantā bhaved bhīruḥ pāpī kaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajet ||46|| ityukto bhagavānāha pibedaṃ pātumicchasi | tvayārthitaṃ jalaṃ tatra nāgamiṣyati putrike ||587|| lakṣmi tvaṃ ca jalaṃ tvetad piba cet pātumicchasi | eṣo’nyathā tu gacchāmi yatheṣṭaṃ cara bhāmini ||48|| ityuktvā bhagavām̐statra kṣaṇādantaradhīyata | lakṣmīḥ putrīṃ vinā naiva papau vāri manāgapi ||49|| putrī jalaṃ na jagrāha yatheṣṭaṃ nārpitaṃ yataḥ | ityevaṃ ca jalāpāne punastapaḥ pracakratuḥ ||2.105.50|| putrīṃ vihāya vai mātā gantuṃ gṛhaṃ śaśāka na | punarghoraṃ tapaścograṃ jalārthaṃ te pracakratuḥ ||51 || sarvaṃ dadāti bhaktārthaṃ jalaṃ dadāti nau na kim | ityevaṃ te viniścitya tṛṣite tapasi sthite ||52|| nārāyaṇena caikātmyaṃ kṛtvā saṃyamasādhanaiḥ | tapaste ceratuścograṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatāluke ||93 || cakratuste tapaścograṃ māsaṃ caikātmyayogataḥ | tadā putryāstathā patnyāstṛṣāyogāddharestṛṣā ||54|| vavṛdhe pratidivasaṃ kaṇṭhadāho’pyajāyata | bhaktairbhaktābhiratyarthaṃ pāyitaṃ jalamamṛtam ||55||| punaḥ punaḥ sa pibati nārāyaṇo jalāñjalīn | tathāpyasya tṛṣāyāstu nirodho naiva jāyate ||56|| śvetadvīpe kṣīravārdhau vaikuṇṭhe badarīvane | akṣare cāmṛte cāvyākṛte cānyatra yatra ca ||57|| nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ tvāste tatra tatra tu sarvathā | asaṃkhyabalapāne’pi tṛṣā nivartate na vai ||58|| jalaṃ pītvā svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śramamavāptavān | udaraṃ saṃbhṛtaṃ vārbhiḥ kaṇṭhaḥ śuṣkāyate muhuḥ ||59 || urvaśyāstṛṣitāyāstu tathā lakṣmyāstapo bahu | vegena vardhate nārāyaṇaḥ śāntiṃ na vindati | |2.105.60|| tṛṣādāhāgninā dagdho vicitta iva vartate | utthāyotthāya patati conmatta iva dhāvati ||6 1 || mūrchāṃ prāpnoti tṛṣito nidrāṃ sukhaṃ na vindati | kvacidutthāya salile vārdhau patati vai muhuḥ ||62|| bhaktābhiḥ sevakaiścāpi pavanaiḥ sevito jalaiḥ | siktaścāpi na śaityaṃ sa prāpnoti parameśvaraḥ ||63|| sarvāntarātmanaścaivaṃ jāte tṛṣātiśoṣaṇe | antaḥsthitasya dehā vai sarve sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ || 64|| avāpuḥ śoṣaṇaṃ cāti tṛṣājanyaṃ jagattraye | īśvarāḥ ṛṣayo devāḥ pitaro mānavāḥ khagāḥ ||65|| paśavo jalagāḥ sarve daityādyā api sarvaśaḥ | tṛṣādoṣairhatā bhrāntā dhāvanti ca patanti ca ||66 || trailokyaṃ tṛṣitaṃ sarvaṃ tadā nāśonmukhaṃ hyabhūt| | jalārtipānakartṛtve tundanāśe vināśanam |67| jalāpāne kaṇṭhaśoṣaḥ pāne’pi śoṣaṇaṃ tathā | ubhayathāpi nāśo’tra jagatāṃ samupasthitaḥ ||68|| tadā brahmā haro viṣṇuḥ kṛtvā samādhimeva te | jñātvā hetuṃ tṛṣāyāstu ramorvaśotṛṣātapaḥ ||69| śīghraṃ yayurbhūtale te saurāṣṭre’kṣarabhūtale | aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre yatrānādinarāyaṇaḥ ||2.105.70 || vartate kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre nijālaye prabhuḥ | sarvāvatāratṛṣayā mūrchitastṛṣito bhṛśam ||71|| brahmādyāstṛṣitāścāpi mṛtyusaṃyogino’pi te | yathākathaṃcidbhagavatpādayoḥ patitāstathā ||72|| śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālvādyā mṛtyukṣaṇagatā iva | trūṭitayā tadā vāṇyā jagaduḥ parameśvaram ||73 || śīghraṃ nātha ramāyāścorvaśyāḥ prāpaya vai jalam | avṛṣṭijaṃ cāpātrasthaṃ cānyāspṛṣṭamanāhutam ||74|| anyathā vai jagat sarvaṃ kṣaṇānte vā vinaśyati | sarvanāśe samutpanne svalpanāśo hitāvahaḥ ||75|| yadi dṛśyeta ca tadā svalpa tyaktvā parānavet | śīghraṃ vṛṣṭyā himaśaile śikhare vānarāśrame ||76|| ramorvaśītapobhūmau jalaṃ prāpaya ceṣṭakṛt | ityarthitaḥ suraiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||77|| drutaṃ meghān samāhūyājñāpayāmāsa vṛṣṭaye | meghā vṛṣṭiṃ pracakruśca sambhūya dvādaśaiva te ||78|| droṇīścopatyakāḥ kṣetraṃ śailaprākāramadhyagam | sarvaṃ tvāplāvayāmāsurāśṛṃgāntaṃ jalairlayaḥ ||79|| varyavarti mahān ghoro droṇyāṃ vai paśupakṣiṇām | araṇyāni nimagnāni magno hanumadāśramaḥ ||2.105.80|| daśayojanavistāraḥ sarvo magnaḥ pradeśakaḥ | jalaṃ śikharaparyentaṃ saṃmataṃ kṣitipātrake ||8 1 || nimnadeśā nimnabhāgā nimnāni śikharāṇi ca | droṇyaśca gahvarāṇyeva nimagnāni jalairlaye ||82|| lakṣmyurvaśyoḥ pādayośca jalaṃ sāmudrajaṃ yathā | tayoḥ prāptaṃ ca śikhare tapaḥsthalyāṃ puraḥ sthitam ||83|| tadā nārāyaṇo devā gatvā ca prārthayanmuhuḥ | jalapānārthametābhyāṃ te pānaṃ cakratustadā ||84|| tṛṣā nārāyaṇānāṃ ca drāgeva nivṛtābhavat | dehināṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ jaṅgamānāmapi sarvaśaḥ ||85|| tṛṣā śāntābhavattūrṇaṃ jalāni harivāñcchayā | pṛthvyāṃ samapasasnuśca divyā meghā yayurlayam ||86|| śrīśṛṃgaṃ corvaśīśṛṃgaṃ khyātaṃ tattapasaḥ sthalam | lakṣmīvanaṃ cakravākīvanaṃ khyātamabhūd vanam ||87|| lakṣmīgaṃgorvaśīgaṃgā khyātā gaṃgā tu kāṃcanī | hanumadgahvaraṃ cāpi nārāyaṇaguhābhidham ||88|| jalaṃ sarovaraṃ lakṣmīsarovaramabhūttataḥ | kāṃcanagaṃgātīrthaṃ ca brahmagaṃgādhikaṃ hyabhūt ||89|| kuśyāṃ kāṃcanagaṃgāyāṃ jalānyāsan gatāni vai | nimnadeśeṣu lokānāmadhairyaṃ jaladarśanāt ||2.105.90|| jātaṃ jalalayaḥ syādvai gantavyamitaratra tu | evaṃ kolāhalo jāto deśeṣu saritāṃ jalaiḥ ||9 1|| tanmiṣeṇa tato lokāḥ kāśīṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | kṣetraṃ ca kauravaṃ kṣetraṃ yayuryātrānimittataḥ ||92|| śivarājo jānakī ca kṛṣṇā jayaśca candrakaḥ | dhenupālaṃ pradāyaiva rājyaṃ kāśīṃ yayustadā ||93|| deśāntareṣu ye dāsā dāsyo vaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ | prākaṭyaṃ jagṛhuste’pi kāśyāmāgatya cottare || 94|| varaṇāyāstaṭe ramye nyūṣuścāmravaṇeṣu te | phalidrumasamākīrṇe puṣpavallyādigandhite ||95|| kāśīrājasya sainyaiścādhiśritodyānaśobhite | kāśīrājasya sauvarṇe prāsāde varaṇātaṭe ||96|| sarvopaskārasaṃyukte kāśīrājena mānitāḥ | satkṛtāḥ svāgataiścāti śatahastivimānakaiḥ ||97|| bahuvādyādibhiścāpi lakṣaśairmānavaiḥ suraiḥ | vidvadbhirbrāhmaṇairbrāhmairbṛhaspatipurogamaiḥ || 98|| devībhiḥ śaktibhiścāpi gaṇairvīrairasaṃkhyakaiḥ | sarvatīrthaiśca yatibhiḥ satībhiścāpsarogaṇaiḥ || 99|| pūjitaṃ śivarājasya kuṭumbaṃ guptamānavam | nityāvāsaṃ sāptabhaume saudhe suvarṇanirmite || 2.105.10 0|| kalpavallīsamāyukte cakāra śaṃbhumānitam | satīpatiḥ svayaṃ kāśīviśvanātho’nnapūrṇikā || 101 || śaṃbhordāsyastathā dāsāḥ śaṃbhurūpaṃ kuṭumbakam | śivarājaṃ śivaṃ caivāśliṣya svāgatamācarat || 1 02|| madhuparkaṃ cāmṛtādi dadau jaharṣa cāpyati | evaṃ vāsaṃ cakāraitat kuṭumbaṃ harivāñcchayā || 1 03|| sarvaṃ kālena bhavati yathā kṛṣṇaḥ samicchati | vaiṣṇavāḥ pārṣadāścānye pārṣadānyaśca yāḥ striyaḥ || 1 04|| mānavyaścābhavam̐stāśca kāśikānṛpamānitāḥ | śaṃbhunā mānitāścāpi nyūṣuḥ rājālayeṣvadhi || 1 05|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smaranta eva te | naranārāyaṇaṃ cāpi lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ tathā || 1 06|| lakṣmīṃ ca tāpasīṃ devyaḥ smarantyo nyūṣureva ca | rādhike corvaśīlakṣmyau sasmaratuḥ kuṭumbakam || 1 07|| cakravākyabhavacchāpānmuktā kanyā ramāsamā | urvaśītisvarūpāḍhyā neme svapitaraṃ harim || 1 08|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne nārāyaṇaprokṣitajalena tapasi lakṣmīcakravākyoḥ prāṇasaṃcāre sati cakravākī śikhare jalapānaṃ tato mokṣaṃ ca vavre, harirvṛṣṭibhirdeśaṃ nimajjayitvā śikhare jalaṃ dadau, pītvā śāpamuktiḥ, vṛṣṭibhayāt śivarājakuṭumbasya vaikuṇṭhīyapārṣadādīnāṃ mānavarūpāṇāṃ kāśyāmāgatya varaṇātaṭe kāśīrājasaudheṣu cāmravaṇe vāsādiḥ, śaṃbhukṛtasatkārādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā pañcādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 105 ||
<2.106> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ityevaṃ rādhike hemaśailāyanarṣaye hariḥ | kathayāmāsa cākhyānaṃ cakravākyā jalārthakam || 1 || urvaśī sā śāpamuktābhavadvai surasundarī | natvā svapitaraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ svāṃ mātaraṃ ramām || 2 || indralokaṃ yayau pūrvamindrāya cārpitā yataḥ | atha lakṣmīḥ svakāntāya kathayāmāsa vai tadā || 3 || hanūmān rakṣayāmāsa māṃ saputrīṃ tapaḥsthitām | tasmai hanumate deyaṃ varadānaṃ tvayā prabho || 4 || ityuktaḥ śrīharistvāha hanuman vṛṇu cepsitam | kapīśo varayāmāsa nāmārthaṃ sārthakaṃ sadā || 5 || kaṃ sukhaṃ śāśvataṃ nārāyaṇamūrternirantaram | pibāmītyarthakaṃ me’stu kapitvaṃ kṛpayā tava || 6 || tvayi nārāyaṇe bhaktirastu cāvyabhicāriṇī | yatra nārāyaṇakathā tatra me prāṇajīvanam || 7 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya te kathāmṛtam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāścāpi kathāmṛtam || 8 || yatra tatra bhavettatra mamopasthitirastu vai | yatra gāyanti te bhaktāstatra me sthānamastu ca || 9 || yatra yatrālayaste syāttatra taddvāri me sthitiḥ | sevārthaṃ śāśvatī cāstu bhaktarakṣaṇakāriṇī || 2.106.1 0|| ityevaṃ prārthanāṃ cakre hanūmān bhaktarāṭ tataḥ | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha dadau mauktikamālikām || 1 1|| pāduke ca dadau tasmai cāmlānāṃ puṣpamālikām | lakṣmīrdadau hanumate kuladevatvamityapi || 1 2|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha hanuman mama sannidhau | aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre vasa bhūmiṃ surakṣayan || 13|| hanumān kārayāmāsa lakṣmyāḥ śaile sumandiram | nārāyaṇena sākaṃ ca lakṣmyāḥ karoti pūjanam || 14|| atha lakṣmīṃ tato nītvā vimānena tu kāśikām | hariryayau śivarājādayo yatra vasanti hi || 15|| avatārya vimānācca vivāhārthaṃ varaṃ dadau | āyāsyāmi dvādaśābde te śāpānto bhaviṣyati || 16|| tāvanmāṃ tvaṃ pratīkṣasva śivarājāya cāha tat | udvāhayiṣye cāgatya sarvaṃ śubhaṃ bhaviṣyati || 17|| ityuktvograṃ tapaścāsyāḥ praśrāvya śrīnarāyaṇaḥ | yayāvadṛśyatāṃ tatra varaṇāyāstaṭe prabhuḥ || 18|| vimānena yayau cāśvapaṭṭasarovaraṃ hariḥ | hemaśālāyanaṃ prāhetyevaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 19|| lakṣmīṃ vivāhya śaṃbhvādīn śāpāt muktān vidhāsyati | ityevaṃ nijabhaktārthaṃ lakṣmīṃ jahau hariḥ purā ||2.106.20|| hemaśālāyanādyāstacchrutvā harṣaṃ paraṃ yayuḥ | atha sarvarṣayastatroṣṭrālayeṣu sthale sthale ||21|| anādiśrīhareryogaṃ pādayoḥ sparśanaṃ tathā | pāvitryaṃ cāpi tīrthatvaṃ kārayituṃ punaḥ punaḥ |22|| pūjayitvārthayāmāsustīrthīkartuṃ bhuvastalam | uṣṇālayapradeśaṃ taṃ prajāṃ pāvayituṃ tathā ||23|| bhagavan devadeveśa śailasarovarāpagāḥ | naijacaraṇanyāsaiśca snānāsanaprahīṇḍanaiḥ ||24|| tīrthīkurvantu tīrthāni gṛhāraṇyāni nastathā | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha divye vimānake tataḥ ||25|| āruruhuśca te sarve hemaśālākhyaparvatam | prathamaṃ parito vīkṣya hemaśālāyanagṛham ||26|| pāvayitvā caraṇotthaṃ sparśaṃ tatra vidhāya ca | pūjāṃ haimakṛtāṃ prāpya tato bālānadīṃ yayuḥ ||27|| tatra snātvā pāvayitvā vīkṣya bālādimityapi | gośaṃkusalile snātvā rāvāsanādrimāyayuḥ ||28|||| parvataṃ caraṇaiḥ sarvaṃ pāvayitvā tataśca te | marcāśanānadīṃ cāpi surānadīṃ turūnadīm ||29|| aitanadīṃ pāvayitvā tīrthīkṛtvāplavena ca | mākamānasaraḥsaṃjñe snātvā bālāsarasyapi ||2.106.30|| śvānanadyāṃ tataḥ snātvā dārāliṃgaṃ ca parvatam | kṛtvā supāvanaṃ padbhyāṃ snātvā kuvansarovare ||3 1 || lābharucisaraścāpi dṛṣṭvāraṇyaṃ ca dakṣiṇam | gaurānarasaromadhye snātvā turusarovare ||32|| snātvā grāgiri sarasi snātvā ārasarovare | pāvayitvā maṣīgrīvaṃ parvataṃ caraṇaistathā ||33|| uttuṃgasarasi snātvā raṇaṃ vilokya cāmbarāt | mekadāneyaśailaṃ ca kṛtvā padbhyāṃ tu pāvanam || 34|| uttare ca tato gatvā vitūrīyajalāplavam | kṛtvā delyāṃ ca ghelyāṃ ca snātvā nipīya tajjalam ||35|| gatvā śālavīnaśailaṃ pāvayitvā ca taṃ tataḥ | rinkunadyāṃ jhinkunadyāṃ phinkunandyāṃ ca te tataḥ || 36 || snātvā ca grāmaśailaṃ ca pāvayitvāvatīrya ca | kāruliṃgasarityeva dāruliṃgājale tataḥ ||37|| cāruliṃgājale snātvā snātvā murānadījale | turānadyāṃ murānadyāṃ snātvācālādrimāyayuḥ ||38|| padbhyāṃ taṃ pāvayitvaiva divādiṅparvataṃ yayuḥ | kiṇḍīcāyāṃ tataḥ snātvā kuvindūmānadījale ||39|| kvīlpīnadyāṃ laviṃgāyāṃ sasnuśca pāvanījale | micalāyāṃ tataḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā ca cāṭaparvatam ||2.106.40|| pāvayitvā cottaraṃ collaṃghya te paścimaṃ yayuḥ | phijarāyāṃ tataḥ snātvā pāvayitvā prajāśca tāḥ ||41|| prajābhiśca kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ jagṛhurharisevakāḥ | bhojitāḥ pūjitāścāpi vanditāśca muhurmuhuḥ ||42|| agastyaśca tathā śaṃbhurlopāmudrā ramā tathā | pārvatī cāśvinīputrastathā teṣāṃ ca sevakāḥ ||43|| uṣṇālayaprajānāṃ tu ye yāḥ rakṣākarāstadā | āśīrvādān dadustābhyaḥ prajābhyaścātinirbharān || 44|| dadustābhyo mahāmantraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mokṣadaṃ śubham | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||45|| tulasīkaṇṭhikāścāpi tathā ca japamālikāḥ | daduśca śaraṇaṃ paścājjayakāro’bhavat mahān ||46||| tato gatvā rājadhānyāṃ cakruste vaiṣṇavaṃ makham | tatratyāḥ ṛṣayastatra yājakāśca tadābhavan ||47|| agastyaścābhavadbrahmā rudro rudrasthale sthitaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’tiṣṭhanmukhyadevasthale prabhuḥ ||48|| hotā homāyanaścaiva tathodgātā balāyanaḥ | āhartā ca maṣīgrīvaḥ pratihartā ravāsanaḥ ||49|| anye hotāra evāsan yajamāno’bhavanmahān | rājoṣṇālayadeśasya samrāṭ dakṣajavaṃgaraḥ |||2.106.50|| dakṣasya mānasaḥ putro devadaityābhivanditaḥ | deśaviplavavighnaiśca yāni pāpāni kānyapi ||51 || nivṛttāni bhaveyuśca vighnā bhavantu no punaḥ | ityabhipretya te sarve rājājñayā tu bhūsurāḥ ||52|| cakuryajñaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca tuṣṭā devāśca dehinaḥ | brāhmaṇāstatra vai cakruḥ puraścaraṇamityapi |||53|| kecitpuruṣasūktasya viṣṇusūktasya cāpare | tathā nārāyaṇasūktasyānye śrīsūktakasya ca ||54|| pare lakṣmīprasūktasya devīsūktasya cetare | rudrādhyāyasya ca pare sāvitryāḥ savituḥ pare ||55||| gaṇeśādhyāyinaścānye sāmavedaprapāṭhakaḥ | evamanye ca vedānāṃ pāṭhāni cakrire tadā ||56|| dakṣajavaṃgaro rājā yajñārambhāt sadā prage | dadātyeva ca dānāni bhuṃjate ca prajāḥ sadā ||57|| miṣṭānnāni pratyahaṃ ca bālakā bālikādikāḥ | dīnānāthādhanāścāpi paṅgavndhakṛpaṇādayaḥ ||58|| pakṣāhaṃ yajñamevaite samāpyāvabhṛthaṃ tataḥ | dakṣajavaṃgararājño rājadhānyāḥ samīpage ||59|| uṣṇādattāṃgarākhyāyā nagaryā dakṣiṇe śubhe | ārasarovare cakruḥ phiṃkūnadīsamāgame ||2.106.60 || śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ parihāraṃ cakrurvimānakaistataḥ | yayurnaijān pradeśāṃśca tatratyā brāhmaṇādayaḥ ||6 1 || rājā tuṣṭo’bhavaccāpi nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ | prārthayacchrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kartuṃ sumandiram ||62|| tathāstviti hariḥ prāha rājākārayaduttamam | mandiraṃ tatra nṛpateḥ rājadhānyāṃ samucchrayam ||63|| iṣapūrṇātithau śrīyukkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim | sthāpitavān mahāvijño’gastyo vedavidhānataḥ ||64|| rājā bhaktiṃ cakārāsya kaṃbharānandanasya vai | atheyeṣa prajāyuktaḥ sakuṭumbaḥ sabhūsuraḥ ||65|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetraṃ draṣṭuṃ śrīharipattanam | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ vaiṣṇavo dhārmikaḥ śuciḥ ||66|| hariḥ prāha tathāstveva vimānaśatakena saḥ | daśasāhasrasaṃkhyākanaranārīprajājanān ||67|| gṛhītvā vyomamārgeṇa cāyayau lomaśāśramam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāpi sahāyayau ||68|| naijenaiva vimānena nijavaimānikaiḥ saha | uṣṭrālayīyabhaktānāṃ saṃghāścāpi samāyayuḥ ||69|| ūrjakṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ te’kṣarakṣetramāyayuḥ | svāgatādyairmānitāste nyūṣurvai dinapañcakam ||2.106.70|| sarvatīrthāni cakruśca śuśruvuśca kathāmṛtam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā nityaṃ pramuktidam ||71|| ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamībrāhme muhūrte’śvasarovare | snātvā cakruśca te’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇotsavam |||72||| dvādaśābdīyajanmāhanimittaṃ cārcanādikam | śrīkānto bhagavām̐statra nirmite svarṇamaṇḍape ||73|| devadevīsatīsādhvīmaharṣirājaśobhite | īśvarairīśvarāṇībhiradhiṣṭhite’tivistṛte ||74|| pitṛgāndharvavidyādhraiḥ śobhite cāpsarogaṇaiḥ | divye gajāsane’rājat pupūjustaṃ munīśvarāḥ ||76|| āśīrvādān daduścāpyārārtrikaṃ cakrurīśvarāḥ | sākṣatacandrakaṃ cakrurupadāḥ pradadurjanāḥ ||76|| saṅgītakaṃ tathā nṛtyaṃ savādyaṃ samajāyata | stutayo devabandībhirdivyalābhābhibodhikāḥ ||77|| kṛtāstatra ca kanyābhirbrahmapriyābhirarcitaḥ | bhagavān śuśubhe divyo vardhito vṛddhavāṅmayaiḥ ||78|||| dānāni pradadau tatra śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ | rātrāvuṣṭrālayabhaktā daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ ||79|| lomaśaṃ ca tathāgastyaṃ hemaśālāyanaṃ tathā | puraskṛtya prabhorjanmanimittamutsavaṃ vyadhuḥ ||2.106.80|| prabhuṃ gajāsane ramye niṣādya sarva eva te | mātaraṃ pitaraṃ natvā pūjayitvā yathākramam ||81 || pupūjurbālakṛṣṇaṃ te yāvadvidhopacārakaiḥ | nyadhuste mukuṭaṃ divyaṃ bālakṛṣṇasya mastake ||82|| sadratnasārasauvarṇamaṇirnaddhām̐śca śekharān | ālambayāmāsuriṣṭān mukuṭe karṇapārśvayoḥ ||83|| keśeṣu nyakṣipam̐stailaṃ sugandhaṃ cāttarādikam | lalāṭe puṇḍrakaṃ kṛtvā madhye kāśmīrabindukam ||84|| netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ datvā karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale daduḥ | karṇapūre ca sauvarṇe pauṣpe rañjanamoṣṭhayoḥ ||85|| skandhayoḥ rājakavacaṃ sauvarṇaṃ maṇibhiryutam | kañcukaṃ nāṭajātīyaṃ kauśeyaṃ svarṇatāritam ||86|| sauvarṇamaṇiratnāḍhyau paṭṭakau dīpacandrakau | sūryacandrojjvalau prabhāprasavau cāyatau śubhau ||87|| skandhayorlambamānau tau stanayorvakṣasi sthitau | kaṭisauvarṇaraśanāyojitau kiraṇānvitau ||88|| lakṣalakṣādhikamūlyau nyadhuḥ kṛṣṇasya vakṣasi | mukuṭordhve nyadhuḥ kalgiṃ mūle mauktikayojitām ||81|| madhye tejaḥparidhyuptasūkṣmahīrakaśobhitām | prānte sauvarṇatārālisravattejaḥsamanvitām ||2.106.90|| kaṇṭhe ca gaṇḍayorbhāle cibuke ca prakoṣṭhayoḥ | svarṇaśṛm̐khalikānaddhān maṇīn daduḥ sulagnitān || 91|| svarṇahārān puṣpahārān taulasīsraja uttamāḥ | gale nyadhustathā bāhvornyadhuḥ kaṭakaśṛṃkhalāḥ || 92|| ūrmikāḥ kaṭakām̐ścāpyaṅgulīyakāni vai daduḥ | svarṇayaṣṭi svarṇagacchān dhārayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ||93|| kaṭyadhaḥ svarṇavastrāṇāṃ sūravālaṃ dadhāra ca | svarṇabuṭṭāḍhyamurudhā maṇimauktikatārakam ||94|| saptapātālacitrāḍhyaṃ bahuraṃgavicitritam | pādaprakoṣṭhayoḥ svarṇamaṇinaddhe ca nūpure ||95|| daduste bhaktavaryā vai pādayoḥ svarṇapāduke| siṃhāgrāṅguṣṭhakīlāḍhye madhyahastivirājite ||96|| pārśvayorhaṃsaśobhe ca paścād garuḍarājite | agre śeṣasamākāre madhye kamaṭhaśobhite ||97|| parito maṇihārālirājite ca dadurhi te | nakheṣu rañjanaṃ dravyaṃ karapādataleṣvapi ||98|| tāmbūlakaṃ sugandhāḍhyaṃ daduste cūrṇamiśritam | uttarīyaṃ mahāvastraṃ saptasvargavirājitam ||99|| kānakaṃ divyadṛśyāḍhyaṃ daduste’kṣarasannibham | chatraṃ dvātriṃśacchalākaṃ sarvadhāmavirājitam || 2.106.10 0|| cāmare sūryacandrāgnividyuttejovirājate | ratnadaṇḍe dadustatra vitānaṃ satyasadṛśam || 101 || vimānaṃ sarvalokānāṃ pratimāḍhyaṃ śriyā yutam | kalpavallīyutaṃ divyaṃ daduścaikaṃ mahāyatam || 102|| rājā sauvarṇapātrāṇi ratnasthālān dadau tadā | sahasraikasuvarttyādyairyuktamārārtrikaṃ dadau || 1 03|| koṭikanyākṛte bhūṣā brahmapriyākṛte dadau | anantamaṇiratnādi tatho’pakaraṇāni ca || 1 04|| pūjottaraṃ dadau paścānnīrājanaṃ vyadhānmudā | tadā vādyānyavādyantājāyanta nartanāni ca || 1 05|| stutayaśca maharṣīṇāṃ gītikāḥ svargayoṣitām | susvarāḥ kanyakānāṃ ca śrūyante maṃgalapradāḥ || 1 06|| evaṃ dvādaśavarṣīyajanmāhotsavamadbhutam | cakraste’strālayabhaktāḥ sarājāḥ saprajā niśi || 1 07|| tataścakruḥ parihāraṃ suṣupuśca taduttaram | prātarnavamīdivase snātān kṛtasumaṃgalān || 1 08|| bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ dugdhasārānnasārakān | rasasārān peyasārān bhakṣyabhojyādisārakān || 1 09|| mukhaśuddhyabhisārām̐śca dadau gopālanandanaḥ | lomaśaṃ ca tathāgastyaṃ tathānyānṛṣipuṃgavān || 2.106.11 0|| śaṃbhuṃ cāśvinikāputrau tathā gaṇagaṇāyutān | pupūjuste’stradeśīyā dadustebhyo dhanāni vai || 111 || yatheṣṭadravyajātāni phalapuṣpāmbarāṇi ca | parihāraṃ tataścakrurājñāṃ jagṛhurādarāt || 112|| gamanārthaṃ nijaṃ deśaṃ mokṣaṃ tadārthayam̐śca te | hariḥ prāha kariṣyāmi mokṣaṃ vaḥ prāṇanirgame || 11 3|| hemaśālāyanādyāścaikādaśarṣaya eva te | aśvapaṭṭasarastīre nityaṃ vāsaṃ vyadhustataḥ || 114|| atha rājñaḥ śatakanyāḥ prajākanyāsahasrakam | vakrastaṃ paramātmānaṃ mugdhāstadā hi rādhike || 1 15|| rājā prajā dadustāśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya tāḥ | lomaśasyāśrame sarvā rakṣitāḥ paramātmanā || 1 16|| athājñāṃ śrīhareḥ prāpya yayuruṣṭrālayaṃ ca te | vimānaiḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhajanta eva ha || 1 17|| smarantaścākṣaraṃ kṣetraṃ praśaṃsanto’śvatīrthakam | pratāpaṃ saṃraṭantaśca prāpurdeśaṃ nijaṃ tu te || 1 18|| rādhike caitadākhyānaṃ mārjārībālarakṣaṇam | cakravākījalapānaṃ lakṣmītapo’tivāhanam || 1 19|| uṣṭrālayamahādeśaprajāpīḍānivārakam | śṛṇuyādvā paṭhedvā yaḥ śrāvayedvā smarecca vā || 2.106.1 20|| tasya bhuktistathā muktiryatheṣṭaṃ syāddhareḥ khalu | siddhyaiśvaryādisamprāptirdharādhānyasutādikam || 121 || sampadvaṃśapravistāraścārogyaṃ gṛhamedhitā | sarvaṃ bhavet kṛpayā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai || 122|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne hanumate varadānaṃ, uṣṭrālayakhaṇḍe prabhukutāni sarvatra tīrthāni, tatratyabhūpena dakṣajavaṃgareṇa kṛtaviṣṇuyāgaḥ, śatavimānaiḥ saprajanṛpasyāśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetrāgamanam, prabhordvādaśajanmadinotsave pūjopadādi, rājñaḥ śatakanyāḥ prajānāṃ sahasrakanyāśca bālakṛṣṇāyārpitāḥ nṛpādīnāṃ svadeśagamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 106 ||
<2.107> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ harestataḥ | bhaktasāhāyyakṛtkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’bhavad yathā || 1 || ekadā bhūtalaṃ draṣṭuṃ pitṝṇāṃ janavāsinām | mānasyaḥ kanyakā bahvyo vimānena samāgatāḥ || 2 || brahmaputrī lavahītā candrāvatī irāvatī | śālāvatī mīnakaṅgū lāṭiśā kāniśā tathā || 3 || māpīṃgā cāpi śīkyāṃgā aṃgasvāṃgā harāṃgahā | mauktikā tārimā cāpi pannāmā tvāṃgahā tathā || 4 || mīnāmī tānasarimā sīnā gāndharvavedikā | nṛtyagāyanakuśalārāgarāgiṇyabhijñikāḥ || 5 || surūpā yauvanabharāścandrāsyāḥ sūryabhāsurāḥ | vahniśuddhāṃśukavastrā divyabhūṣāḥ prabhānvitāḥ || 6 || viṃśatisaṃkhyakāḥ kanyāstāsāṃ dāsyaḥ sahasraśaḥ | kāmarūpadhārāḥ siddhaiśvaryasāmarthyarājitāḥ || 7 || astraśastradhārikāśca devyo’pradhṛṣyasadbalāḥ | nijalokāttu divyena vimānena śubhāṃganāḥ || 8 || yayuḥ satyaṃ namaskṛtya viṣṇuṃ śaṃbhumajaṃ tathā | brahmasabhāsthitān devān natvā kṛtasumaṃgalāḥ || 9 || meroḥ śikharāt prathamaṃ merudroṇīmupāyayuḥ | meruṃ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā dṛṣṭvā devālayān bahūn || 2.107.1 0|| brahmalokālayasamān saudhodyānamahālayān | svargātisvargaśobhāḍhyān dikpālānāṃ tathālayān || 1 1|| prāsādān grahanakṣatratārakāṇāṃ mahojjvalān | yogināṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca gāndharvāṇāṃ tathālayān || 1 2|| daityadānavasaudhāni kinnarāṇāṃ gṛhāṇi ca | sthānāni kiṃpuruṣāṇāṃ tāpasānāṃ tathāśramān || 13|| vilokyailāvṛtaṃ paścāt viyuktāṃ jāmbavīṃ bhuvam | pṛthvyāṃ samāyayurvyomnā tāḥ kiṃpuruṣakhaṇḍakam || 14|| āpatāyīparvataṃ ca gopīraṇaṃ tathākṣigam | parvataṃ kunalīnādriṃ kārukoraṃ triyānaśam || 15|| cipiṃgaṃ prācīnabhāga dṛṣṭvā pītasamudrakam | aṃgaśikṣāṃgasaritaṃ śikṣāṃgikāṃ nadīṃ tathā || 16|| jalapānapradeśām̐śca phullipānapradeśakān | vāraṇīyadvīpagaṇān dṛṣṭvā sumātṛkāṃ yayuḥ || 17|| tataḥ parāvṛttya yayurmīnakaṅgūnadīṃ prati | irāvatīṃ candravīnāṃ patatkāyādrimāyayuḥ || 18|| tāvat kanyāvimānaṃ ca vīkṣya sāmudrarākṣasāḥ | jalapānapradeśasthā vyomayānavihāriṇaḥ || 19|| piśaṃgavarṇā dīrghāśca parvataśṛṃgasadṛśāḥ | saśastrā stvāyayurhartuṃ kanyāratnāni cāmbare ||2.107.20|| evaṃ phullipānadeśaprajātā dānavā api | vyomamārgeṇa yānena kanyā hartuṃ samāyayuḥ ||2 1 || māyāvino vikarālā yatheṣṭarūpadhāriṇaḥ | astraśastradharā vyomni vihārāścābdhivartinaḥ ||22|| parvataprāyadehāśca vidyucchastrā bhayaṃkarāḥ | nirdayāḥ piṅgavarṇāśca rūkṣadehāḥ pradāhakāḥ ||23|| evamanye vāraṇīyadvīpadaityā bhayaṃkarāḥ | nirghṛṇā mānuṣādāśca vahnipāṣāṇaśastriṇaḥ ||24||| vrajakṣepaṇabāṇādyairyuktā vyomavihāriṇaḥ | kanyakānāṃ vimānaṃ tad ramyaṃ krośāyataṃ śubham ||25|| sūryaprabhaṃ vilokyaite hartuṃ kanyāḥ samāyayuḥ | ādamanadvīpataśca kṛṣṇānāgāśca kaṣmalāḥ ||26|| āyayustaṃ pravijñāya kanyāgaṇaṃ surūpiṇām | evaṃ te rākṣasāḥ pañcaśatāni ca sahasraśaḥ ||27|| daityāśca dānavāḥ kṛṣṇanāgāścāpi sahasraśaḥ | sarve te pañcasāhasrāḥ paritaścāyayustadā ||28|| patatkāye mahāśaile vimānaṃ rurudhuśca te | sarvāḥ śaraṇamāyāntvanyathā naṅkṣyatha vai drutam ||29|| ityuktvā cāsurāḥ sarve vimānaṃ pravivikṣavaḥ | praviṣṭuṃ tvaramāṇāśca dudruvuḥ parito yadā ||2.107.30|| vimāna puṇyatattvasya pāpināṃ sparśavarjitam | rakṣodānavadaityānāmapradhṛṣyaṃ tadāmbare || 31 || nirodhaṃ nāpa ca yadā tadā te cāsurāḥ punaḥ | māyāṃ vai nijapāpānāṃ kṛtvā dhṛtvā ca tatkṣaṇam || 32|| pāpatattvasya rūpāṇi pāpātattvāyudhāni ca | pāpāstrāṇi ca pāpānāṃ śastrāṇi pāpapāśakān ||33 || pāpamantritanārācān dhanuḥkhaḍgādikām̐stathā | vahnipāṣāṇabāṇām̐śca gadātomaramudgalān ||34|| golakān vahnicūrṇāḍhyān visphoṭakām̐stathāvidhān | vimānaṃ cāvarurudhustāsāṃ jivṛkṣavo hi te || 35|| pāpatattvena meghena gatiṃ rurudhureva te | dvārāṇyuparurudhuśca viviśuśca vimānakam ||36 || hāhākāro mahānāsīdvimāne kanyakāgaṇe | na kaścid vidyate trātā vimāne sannidhāvapi ||37|| bhūtale cāmbare vāpi parvate vāridhāvapi | kanyakā duḥkhamāpeduraryamāṇaṃ ca sasmaruḥ ||38|| pitaraṃ rakṣakaṃ naijaṃ janakaṃ duḥkhavārakam | tāvacchīghraṃ samāyātastvaryamā svagaṇaiḥ saha ||39|| smṛtamātro vimāne’sāvadṛśyata śataprabhaḥ | sahasraśaravarṣābhirvārayāmāsa rākṣasān ||2.107.40 || rākṣasā dānavā daityāḥ kṛṣṇanāgāśca vai tadā | parito bāṇavarṣābhirardayāmāsurāryakam ||41 || aryamā vahnimutpādya preṣayāmāsa sarvataḥ | rākṣasādīn pradagdhuṃ sa dadāha sarvato diśaḥ ||42|| jalapānīyarakṣāṃsi jalānyutpādya māyayā | śāntayāmāsuranalaṃ tato’yamaryamā pitā ||43 || aruṇānayutān sṛṣṭvā preṣayāmāsa sarvataḥ | tīkṣṇajvālāṇuśastrāste dāhayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ||44|| rākṣasān dānavān daityān kṛṣṇanāgām̐śca sarvaśaḥ | tadāsurā mṛṣārūpadharāḥ svamāyayābhavan ||45|| mūlarūpāṇi cācchādya yuyudhuścāruṇaiḥ samam | āruṇā aryamadūtāstīkṣṇoṣṇaraśmihetibhiḥ ||46|| anviṣyānviṣya daityādīn dāhayāmāsurāsurān | dagdhāstu bahavastatra navotpannāśca bhasmataḥ ||47|| ayutāyutalakṣāṇi rākṣasā abhavam̐stadā | yuddhaṃ taccāmbare sarvaṃ sarvasvadhvaṃsakārakam ||48|| āruṇānāṃ rakṣasāṃ cābhavattarkaparaṃ mahat | aryamṇā sūryamantraiścotpādyante’ruṇakoṭayaḥ |||45||| rakṣobhiḥ rākṣasairmantrairutpādyante ca rākṣasāḥ | nāntastvāyāti sainyānāṃ vardhante sainyakoṭayaḥ ||2.107.50 || āyudhānyapi vardhante vardhante śastrarāśayaḥ | vibhidyante vichidyante mriyante ca patanti ca ||51|| raktaṃ raktamayaṃ jātaṃ cāmbaraṃ bhūtalaṃ tathā | kāyavyūhāḥ patantyatra lakṣaśo vai samantataḥ |||52||| āruṇānāṃ rākṣasānāmadriśṛṃgasamā hatāḥ | dehāḥ kāyāḥ patantaśca sañcayā ucchrayāstathā ||53 || meghānullaṃghya gagane sañjātāḥ parvatā yathā | śatayojanavistāre bhūtale parvatocchrayāḥ ||54 || nagnānāṃ vai śavānāṃ te parvatā vai tadābhavan | patatkāyāḥ parvatāste nagnaśailā hi te’bhavan ||55|| piṃgoccayāḥ samabhavan ye naṣṭā yuddhakovidāḥ | āsaptāhaṃ mahāyuddhaṃ divāniśaṃ tvavartata | na virāmo’bhavattatra tadāryamā svayaṃ raviḥ ||56|| pitṛkakṣaḥ prasasmāra viṣṇuṃ śivamajaṃ trayam | rakṣārthaṃ devadeveśān pitṛrūpān pitāmahān ||57|| rakṣārthaṃ devadeveśāḥ samāyāntu drutaṃ kṣaṇāt | rakṣantu kanyakāḥ sarvā nāśayantvasurāniti ||58|| tāvattatra samāyātā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | vimānatrayamārūḍhā divyasainyasamanvitāḥ ||59|| etasminneva kāle tu daityadānavarākṣasāḥ | sasmaruśca mahādaityaṃ mahāmāyāviśāradam ||2.107.60|| kālaprāleyanāmānaṃ koṭisainyasamanvitam | mahākālasamaṃ mahāmāyotthaṃ merusadṛśam ||61 || sahasramastakaṃ pratyānane śatājacarvaṇam | drāgeva sa samāyātaḥ kampayan bhuvanāni vai ||62|| yasyāṭṭahāsyamātreṇa nipeturgrahasañcayāḥ | cukṣubhuḥ sāgarāḥ sarve medinī cāpyakampata ||63 || śikharāṇi nipetuśca bhūtāni tatyajurdhruvam | mahāvajranipātena samā jātāśca garjanāḥ ||64|| mandarasya śikharaṃ vai hastenaikena saṃdhṛtam | kālaprāleyakenānyakareṇa ketavo dhṛtāḥ ||65|| etādṛśo mahākāyo’suro yasyānanaṃ tadā | vyāttaṃ samabhavad vikāsitaṃ tu daśayojanam ||66|| evaṃ sahasravadano dṛṣṭvājaviṣṇuśaṃkarān | sakthisphoṭairājuhāvāmbare koṭisurānvitān ||67|| atha devāstu taṃ vīkṣya vairājapratirūpakam | saṃkarṣaṇaṃ mahākāyaṃ sasmaruḥ kālanāśakam ||68|| tūrṇaṃ saṃkarṣaṇo devastatrāmbare samāyayau | tuṣṭuvuste trayo devā rakṣārthaṃ sagadaṃ prabhum ||69|| saṃkarṣaṇo gadāṃ tasya mūrdhni balānnyapātayat | kālaprāleyakaḥ śīghraṃ vañcayitvā tu tāṃ gadām ||2.107.70|| saṃkarṣaṇaṃ sa gadayā tatāḍa mastakopari | saṃkarṣaṇaḥ svagadayā cūrṇayāmāsa tadgadām ||7 1 || kālaprāleyakaṃ mūrdhni tatāḍa vegatastataḥ | gadā bhagnābhavad daṇḍād daityamūrdhā babhaṃja na ||72|| daityastriśūlamādāya hantuṃ dudrāva tatkṣaṇam | saṃkarṣaṇaḥ svaśūlenābhinad vakṣasi kālakam |||73 || nipapāta tadā pūrvasamudre parvatocchrayaḥ | śaktyā hatastataḥ kaṇṭhe vajreṇa ca tathodare ||74|| marditaḥ parvataiścāpi kūrcitaḥ pattalaistathā | vyasuryathā tathā jātaḥ kṣaṇānmūrchāmavāpya saḥ ||78|| utthāya jīvarakṣārtha cakāra sa palāyanam | meruṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā dudrāva ca bahiryadā ||76|| saṃkarṣaṇastu taṃ lokālokācalāvadhiṃ yayau | pṛṣṭhadeśe yayau yenāsuraḥ sa kālakālayaḥ ||77|| lokālokaṃ vihāyaivālokaṃ vyoma yayau bahiḥ | sakarṣaṇabhayāt so’pyanantāsaṃkhyāmbare yayau ||78|| saṃkarṣaṇo’pi devastu śaṃbhvādīn sūkṣmarūpataḥ | nirbhayaṃ saṃpradatvaiva yayāvīśvaradhāma ca ||79|| atha daityairdānavaiśca yuyudhuḥ śaṃkarādayaḥ | nijaghnuḥ sarvato daityān kālaprāleyapakṣakān ||2.107.80|| triśūlaiścakrakairvidyutpāśaiḥ pāśaiśca tomaraiḥ | khaḍgaiḥ prakṣepaṇaiḥ śailairasibhiḥ śaktibhistathā ||8 1 || vāyvastraiḥ parvatāstraiśca meghāstrairanalāstrakaiḥ | nāgāstrairgaruḍāstraiśca siṃhāstraiḥ śarabhāstrakaiḥ ||82|| vārāhāstraiḥ kṛkalāstraiḥ karkastrairvṛścikāstrakaiḥ | yamāstrai rākṣasāstraiśca makarāstrairjalāstrakaiḥ ||83 || vyāghrāstraidīpakāstraiśconmādāstrairmūrcchanāstrakaiḥ | kṣudhāstraiśca tṛṣāstraiśconmattāstrairjaghnurāmithaḥ ||84|| brahmādīnāṃ ca sainyāni daityadānavarākṣasān | ardayāmāsuratyarthaṃ nāśayāmāsurantataḥ ||85|| koṭisaṃkhyā āsurāste hatā yuddhe samantataḥ | kṛtrimāścākṛtrimāśca māyikāścāpyamāyikāḥ ||86|| āruṇānāṃ ca sainyāni brāhmānāṃ pṛtanāstathā | śāṃkarāṇāṃ gaṇāścāpi vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca pārṣadāḥ ||87|| hatā yuddhe koṭiśaśca tān sarvāṃste’surāstrayaḥ | jīvayāmāsurāmnāyamantraiḥ saṃkalpasiddhibhiḥ ||88|| brahmādyāścāhuretebhyo varadānārthamiṣṭadāḥ | vavruste paramaṃ mokṣaṃ ye sarve jīvitāśca te ||89|| brahmādyāstu tadā prāhurvṛṇutānyaddhi mokṣaṇāt | jīvitāścāruṇādyāste mokṣānyaṃ naiva vavrire || 2.107.9 0|| viṣṇuḥ prāha tatastām̐śca mokṣāḥ santi hyanekaśaḥ | naranārāyaṇalokaṃ badrikāśramamityuta ||9 1 || payonidhiṃ vā yuṣmabhyaḥ śvetadvīpaṃ dadāmi vā | te prāhurnaiva taddhāma śāśvataṃ na tato vayam ||92 || samicchāmaḥ kintu cecchāmaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ śāśvataṃ param | viṣṇuḥ prāha tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ jalasyāvaraṇopari ||93 || vartate tad dadāmyeva vairājaṃ dhāma vottamam | te prāhurnahi vaikuṇṭhaṃ vairājaṃ vāpi śāśvatam ||94|| tasmādicchāma evānyaddhāma mokṣābhidhaṃ param | viṣṇuḥ prāhāmṛtaṃ dhāma bhūmno dadāmi caiva vaḥ || 95|| yadvāvyākṛtasaṃjñaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ vā dadāmi vaḥ | te prāhurnaiva cecchāmastaddhāma kintu tatparam ||96|| viṣṇuḥ prāha dadāmyeva golokaṃ parama padam | te prāhurnaiva vāñcchāmo vāñcchāmastu tataḥ param ||97|| śāśvataṃ cākṣarabrahmapadaṃ vedāntabodhitam | sarvadhāmnāṃ paraṃ dhāmopaniṣadvarṇitaṃ śubham ||98|| yatsamaṃ yatparaṃ nāsti taddhāma paramaṃ hareḥ | icchāmo dehi taddhāma parabrahmasamāśritam ||99|| viṣṇuḥ prāha na me śaktirvidyate’rpayituṃ tu tat | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 2.107.10 0|| paramātmā parabrahma sarvāvatāradhārakaḥ | dātuṃ śakto’sti taddhāma sa vai dāsyati tatpadam || 101|| ityuktāḥ sasmarustūrṇaṃ taṃ vai śrīpuruṣottamam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipumuttamam || 102 || dhyānamagnāśca sahasā hyabhavam̐statkṣaṇe tu te | ātmātmanyavagāhyaivāsmaran sarvāvatāriṇam || 103 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pitṛkanyakānāṃ kimpuruṣakhaṇḍe rākṣasādikṛtasya nirodhasya nivṛttayebrahmādidevakṛtayuddhaṃ mṛtānāṃ prāṇadānaṃ, jīvitairmokṣo yācitaḥ paramamokṣadastu anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa evetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 107 ||
<2.108> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike devairdhyāte smṛte narāyaṇe | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre bālakṛṣṇaḥ paraḥ pumān || 1 || prāha svānparamān bhaktānṛṣiṃ maṃkaṇakaṃ yatim | maṃkirayaṃ maharṣiṃ ca kūrmiṇam ṛṣipūjitam || 2 || prācīnabarhaṃ trītaṃ ca prabhūtānarṣimuttamam | ruśāyinaṃ ca khāsīnaṃ cāṃgaśyāmalakaṃ munim || 3 || ārakarṇaṃ brahmadāsyamanāmayarṣimityapi | śyāmalarṣiṃ malayarṣiṃ caturdaśarṣimaṇḍalam || 4 || samāhūya hariḥ prāha cāśvapaṭṭasaraḥsthitān | śṛṇvantu ṛṣayaḥ saumyā mahābhāgavatā yataḥ || 5 || tāpasā vaiṣṇavāgryāśca mama dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ | himālayāt pūrvadeśe dakṣiṇe ca pradeśake || 6 || patatkāye ca vartante vimāne pitṛkanyakāḥ | pradharṣitāstu tā daityaistataḥ pitā tadāryamā || 7 || brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca saṃkarṣaṇo mahān prabhuḥ | ete daityāśca yuyudhurjaghnurdaityāsurām̐stataḥ || 8 || mṛtānujjīvayāmāsurāruṇān sūryapārṣadān | vaiṣṇavān śāṃkarām̐ścāpi vaiśvasṛjām̐śca koṭiśaḥ || 9 || tebhyo varapradānārthaṃ devairvacanamarpitam | pārṣadairarthito mokṣaḥ paramo’kṣarataḥ paraḥ || 2.108.10 || surā dātumaśattarāstaṃ tataste cāruṇādayaḥ | bodhitā devavargaiśca tādṛṅmokṣapradaṃ ca mām || 11 || tataste dhyānamagnāśca māmidānīṃ smaranti vai | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ puruṣottamaḥ || 1 2|| bhavadbhyaśca maharṣibhyo gatebhyo mama dāsatām | mahābhāgavatebhyo vaścājñāpayāmi sarvathā || 1 3|| yūyaṃ yāta kṣaṇāttatra patatkāyādritaḥ param | varṣe kiṃpuruṣe gatvā prāgjyotiṣṣu tathādarāt || 14|| prācīnādripradeśeṣu vicaratāpi sarvataḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 15|| mantramimaṃ pradaddhvaṃ ca sarvebhyo vai surājñayā | kanyārakṣakaśaṃbhvādyāḥ pratīkṣante ca māmapi || 16|| bhavadbhiḥ saḥ pradeśaśca kāryo bhāgavatātmakaḥ | militvā cāruṇādyaiśca kāraṇīyā hyupāsanā || 17|| pravartanīyā me bhaktirdāsye teṣāmabhīṣṭakam | vimānairyāta vai sarve mā ciraṃ procya ceti vai || 18|| dadau divyaṃ vimānaṃ ca bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ | yayuste ṛṣayaścaturdaśa kṣaṇena cāmbarāt || 1 9|| patatkāye parvatordhve vimānaṃ tat sthiraṃ vyadhuḥ | apaśyan vyomasaṃsthaṃ ca pitṛkanyāvimānakam ||2.108.20 || bhāsvaraṃ koṭisūryābhaṃ vimānaṃ vīkṣya kanyakāḥ | brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāstathā cāruṇapārṣadāḥ ||2 1 || jayaśabdān harṣanādān cakrurutsāhasaṃbhatāḥ | ṛṣayo’pi tadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jayatviti ||22|| ityevaṃ jayaśabdām̐śca pracakrurvyomasaṃstare | jaya kṛṣṇa jaya nārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama |||2 3 || jayo’stvanādidevasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai | akṣarātītakṛṣṇasya parabrahmaṇa ā jayaḥ || 24|| evaṃ tu bhajanaṃ cakrustacchrutvā vyomamārgataḥ | ṛṣīṇāṃ vai vimāne te daśayojanavistare ||25|| yayuḥ sarve tu te nemuḥ paramarṣīn tato muhuḥ | kanyakābhiḥ pitṛjābhiḥ kumārikābhireva ca ||26 || prathamaṃ pādukāsammārjanaṃ tataśca pādayoḥ | ṛṣīṇāṃ sevanaṃ pādaprakṣālanaṃ phalārpaṇam ||27|| jalārpaṇaṃ svāgatādi candanādyarghyamityapi | svāsanādi pradattaṃ ca madhuparkādikaṃ kṛtam ||28|| tatasteṣu ca deśeṣu tatpaddhatyā nirantaram | prāghūṇikānāṃ sanmānaṃ kumārībhirvidhīyate ||29|| kiṃpuruṣapradeśānāṃ maṃgalaṃ kāryameva ca | kumārikābhiḥ sarvatra prathamaṃ sampravartyate ||2.108.30 || rādhike kanyakādyāste vidhāyarṣisamarcanam | ninyuratān svaṃ vimānaṃ ca tataste ṛṣayo’malāḥ ||31 || parabrahmapratāpena parabhāvamupāgataḥ | viṣṇoḥ śaṃbhorbrahmaṇaścāryamṇaḥ pūjāṃ pracakrire ||32|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśiṣaḥ samūcire | śrīmatāṃ smaraṇādatra preṣitāstena cocire ||33 || mantradānārthamevātra preṣitāśceti cocire | kiṃpuruṣaḥ samantācca kartavyo vaiṣṇavaḥ khalu ||34|| ityājñā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāstīti cocire | tato’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam ||35|| āgamiṣyati sarvātmetyevaṃ tebhyaḥ samūcire | śrutvā sarve jahṛṣuśca vimānadvayameva tu ||36|| candrāvatīnadītīre śobhane’raṇyasannidhau | ṛṣīṇāmājñayā cāvatārayāmāsurutsukāḥ || 37|| mīnasthānaṃ vanaṃ ramyaṃ vilokya tatra te janāḥ | havanaṃ cakrire daivam ṛṣayaste ca vaiṣṇavāḥ ||38|| tato’ryamṇaḥ sevakebhyaścāruṇebhyo maharṣayaḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 39|| itimantraṃ dadustatra srajaṃ ca taulasīṃ gale | pitṛputrā vaiṣṇavāste tato’bhavan sahasraśaḥ ||2.108.40 || ayutāyutasaṃkhyāste kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim | bhejire ca tatastatra ṛṣayaste tapodhanāḥ ||41 || viṣṇujebhyaḥ pārṣadebhyo dadurmantraṃ tameva ca | rudrasya ca gaṇebhyaśca brahmaśiṣyebhya ityapi ||42|| koṭikoṭisahasrebhyo dadurmantraṃ tameva ca | te sarve vaiṣṇavāstatra bhejire puruṣottamam ||43|| atharṣayastataḥ pitṛkanyābhyaścāpi taṃ manum | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||44|| pradaduśceti kanyāstā bhejire puruṣottamam | athaivaṃ dīkṣaṇāt paścāt kāmavallīdrumodbhavam ||45|| ṛṣīṇāṃ dānato miṣṭaṃ siddhānnaṃ bhojanādikam | dadurvai vaiṣṇavebhyaśca kanyābhyaścāpi te dvijāḥ ||46|| bhuktvā candrāvatīnadyāṃ sasnuste vaiṣṇavādayaḥ | athātra mantrayāmāsuḥ ṛṣayo vaiṣṇavāstathā ||47|| brahmaviṣṇumaheśāścāryamā ca kanyakāstathā | mīnakaṅgūnadītīre kartavyo vaiṣṇavo makhaḥ ||48|| tatra prāgjyotiṣāṃ sarvāḥ prajāḥ samantataḥ kila | āhūtā āgamiṣyanti āsamudrāddhi sarvataḥ ||49|| kiṃpuruṣasya khaṇḍasyāgamiṣyanti prajāstathā | yajñe tābhyaḥ pradeyo vai mantrastu vaiṣṇavo yataḥ ||2.108.50|| ityevaṃ śrīharerājñā pūrṇā cātra bhaviṣyati | brahmā prāha makhe tatra yuddhaṃ cāpi bhaviṣyati ||5 1 || tāmasyo vai prajāstvatra vartante pārvatā nṛpāḥ | jalapānaphilīpānavāraṇīyapradeśajāḥ ||52|| vartante tāmasāścāti mānavā rākṣasopamāḥ | eteṣvapi pradeśeṣu taistu yuddhaṃ bhaviṣyati ||53|| tataḥ syād vaiṣṇavī bhūmiḥ pāvanī tīrtharūpiṇī | astvevam ṛṣayaḥ prāhurviṣṇuḥ prāha tathāstviti ||54|| rudraḥ prāha tathāstvevaṃ cāryamā prāha omiti | mīnakaṅgūnadīmūle melakāṃgābhuvastale |||55|| makhaḥ prajāyatāṃ sarvadeśānāṃ madhyabhūtale | itiniścitya te sarve prayayurvai himālayāt ||56|| prāguttare pradeśe vai īśānadigbhave śubhe | piṃgadeśe kiṃpuruṣe yajñārthaṃ viṣṇusaṃhitāḥ ||57|| menakāṃgāvane tatra mīnakaṅgūnadītaṭe | piṃgāraṇye pracakruste yajñārthaṃ bhūmiśodhanam |||58|| aṃgasvāṃgāpaścime ca śālāvatyāstu pūrvataḥ | pañcāśadyojanamāne vartule’raṇyaśobhite |||59|| mīnakaṃgvāḥ paścime ca yajñamaṇḍapamācaran | mīnakaṃgvāḥ pūrvataścāvasathān cakruruttamān ||2.108.60 || mīnakaṃgūbhayatīre ṛṣyāśramān vyadhustadā | devāśramān pitṛvāsān siddhāśramān vyadhustathā ||61|| īśvarāṇāmāśramām̐śca śālāvatīnadītaṭe | cakrurbrahmamaheśādyāḥ pūrvabhāge’tiśobhane ||62||| muktānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ cāśramān ramyānmanoharān | śālāvatyāḥ paścime ca pracakrurvyomagāminām ||63|| ityevaṃ triṇadaṃ deśaṃ piṃgāraṇyaṃ mahāyatam | yajñārthaṃ kalpayitvaiva dūtaiḥ sarvān samāhvayan ||64 || muktām̐statheśvarān sarvānavatārām̐stitheśvarīḥ | brahmapriyāstathā pitṝnṛṣīndevān digīśvarān ||65|| mānavān devajātīśca pātālasthān satīḥ sataḥ | gāndharvān kiṃpuruṣām̐śca vidyādhrānapsarogaṇān ||66|| devīśca yoginīścāpi kailāsīyān samagrataḥ | vaikuṇṭhīyān samastām̐śca satyīyām̐śca samastataḥ ||67|| pitṛgaṇān samastām̐śca sureśvarān surām̐stathā | dikpālān pṛthivīpālān prajāpālān samagrataḥ ||68|| paśūn pakṣigaṇām̐ścāpi kāśyapīrbahulāḥ prajāḥ | vallīrvṛkṣān tṛṇastambān kandauṣadhikadambakān ||69|| nadān nadīstaṭākām̐śca sarāṃsi sāgarām̐stathā | parvatān khātabhāgām̐ścākhātānaraṇyabhūmikāḥ ||2.108.70|| vanānyupavanādīni vāpīśca dīrghikāḥ prahīn | tīrthāni sāgārām̐ścāpi narānnārīḥ samantataḥ ||71 || gaṇeśān kārtikeyām̐śca hanūmataśca pārṣadān | hetīn sarvān samūrtāṃśca sudarśanādikāyudhān ||72 || mantrān vedān sarvavidyāḥ kalāḥ sarvā rasām̐stathā | tattvāni cāpi sarvāṇi caityāni vividhānyapi ||73 || ṛtūn māsān vatsarādīn yugāndināni ca kṣaṇān | māyāṃ guṇān prakarmāṇi yāmyān pretāṃśca dānavān ||74|| daityānāsurabhāvām̐śca rākṣasān brahmavaṃśajān | sarvān makhe maheśādyā āhvayāñcakrire tadā ||75|| ājagmuste mahīmānāḥ sarvalokebhya utsukāḥ | devatrayānugāsteṣāmātithyaṃ cakrurutsave ||76 || brahmasthāne svayaṃ brahmā rudrasthāne haraḥ svayam | viṣṇusthāne svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ pitṛsthāne’ryamā svayam | |77|| mātṛkāścāsane tāsāṃ grahāṇāṃ cāsane grahāḥ | dikpālānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca sthāneṣu cetanāstu te ||78|| niṣeduścānyadevānāṃ sthāneṣu devayoṣitām | samūrtāste niṣeduśca devā devyo yathocitam ||79|| mukhyadevaḥ svayaṃ tatrānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | saṃsmṛtastaistadā sākṣānmātāpitṛsamanvitaḥ ||2.108.80|| lomaśādisametaśca brahmapriyāsamanvitaḥ | vimānenāyayau śīghraṃ bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ||81|| kalpavallīkalpavṛkṣakalpadhenvādisaṃyutaḥ | yājñikāḥ svāgataṃ cakrurbahumānapuraḥsaram ||82|| samājo harṣamāpannaḥ parameśvaradarśanāt | vāsaṃ kṛtvāplavanaṃ ca yajñabhuvaṃ hariryayau ||83|| kalpavallyādibhistatra ghṛtakulyāstadāyatāḥ | dadhikulyā madhukulyā dugdhakulyāstathāvidhāḥ ||84|| rasakulyā rasaśālābhṛtā miṣṭānnakāmṛtaiḥ | havyasāmagryasaṃkhyāśca bhakṣyasāmagryanantatā ||85|| vinirmitāstadā tatra parameśapratāpataḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||86|| pradhānadevasadane svarṇāsane vyarājata | yajamānaḥ svapatnīśrīkambharāsahitaḥ pitā ||87|| śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇo vai naijāsane vyarājata | pārṣado bhagavanhemantakau devaprakāśakaḥ ||88|| svayaṃprakāśo bhagavān vyarājanta sumaṇḍape | varaṇaṃ dehaśuddhiśca puṇyāhavācanādikam ||89|| aṃgadevasthāpanādi kṛtvā śrīlomaśo muniḥ | vahniṃ kuṇḍe samantraṃ ca prātiṣṭhipat tataḥ param ||2.108.90|| havanaṃ vedamantraiśca prāvartata sukhocitam | gaṇeśabhūtayakṣādyāḥ surādyāśca nijādanam ||91|| svasvabhāgān vahnimukhājjagṛhurhariṇārpitāḥ | pitṛdevā atṛpyanta ceśvarā muktakoṭayaḥ ||92|| āmantritāśca paritaḥ prāgjyotiṣāṃ ca mānavāḥ | jīvasumātṛkajanā malayasya janāstathā ||93|| irāvatītaṭasthāśca mīnakaṅgūtaṭasthitāḥ | śālāvatītaṭasthāśca śikṣāṃgātaṭasaṃsthitāḥ || 94|| aṃgaśikṣāṃgatīrasthā harāṃgātaṭavāsinaḥ | tārimātaṭavāsaśca mahatītaṭavāsinaḥ ||95|| āmūrataṭavāsāśca saritpradeśavāsinaḥ | tanmadhyadeśavāsāścāhūtā yajñe tu mānavāḥ ||96|| deśakalyāṇaheturvai mantro’yaṃ vaiṣṇavottamaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīpatidaivataḥ ||97|| sampadyate’tra gantavyaṃ sarvaiḥ kalyāṇahetave | ityāmantraṇamāśrutya sāttvikā mānavāstathā ||98|| rājasāścāpi viprādyāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyajīvinaḥ | vaiśyottamāstathā śūdrā nāryo narā yayurmakham || 99|| vimānairvyomayānaiśca garuḍaiśca jaṭāyukaiḥ | ātmānaṃ kṛtakṛtyaṃ te menire vīkṣya vai kratum || 2.108.10 0|| prāpya prāsādikaṃ cāpyavāpya kṛṣṇamanuṃ tathā | om anādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 101 || japaṃ mantraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamam | dṛṣṭvā bhuktvāmṛtaṃ pītvā divyabhāvaṃ yayuśca te || 1 02|| kaṇṭhīṃ ca taulasīṃ dhṛtvābhavan paramavaiṣṇavāḥ | koṭiśo mānavā bhaktā mumukṣavo haripriyāḥ || 1 03|| avabhṛthaṃ tataścakruḥ parihāraṃ makhasya ca | tāvattāmasabhāvā ye yajñadveṣiṇa eva ye || 1 04|| surārayo lakṣaśaste saśastrā yajñaghātinaḥ | satkāryanāśakāḥ krūrā jalapānīyajātayaḥ || 1 05|| philīpānīyavāsānāṃ sambandhino’tighātakāḥ | vāraṇīyaprajānāṃ ca jātīyā ādamāninaḥ || 106 || parasparaṃ tu militāḥ kālaprāleyajātikāḥ | anye tatsuhṛdaścāpi tatsahāyā guṇairapi || 1 07|| rājāno bodhapāṭhīyāścaityapāṭhakajātikāḥ | cāṃkaśekāḥ siṃgaliṅgā hāṃgacāudakāstathā || 1 08|| tūnakīnā hanoyāśca rāyagā baṃgakākinaḥ | lāśahā māṃgajātīyā mañcarāyāstathāpare || 1 09|| ete ca kṣatriyāḥ sarve tāmasā rākṣasā iva | lakṣāyutāni sainyāni gṛhītvā cāyayustadā || 2.108.11 0|| raṇatūryāṇyavādyanta prājāyanta ca garjanāḥ | śūrāṇāṃ raṇaśastrāṇi prāsphurannambare tadā || 11 1|| ityevaṃ rādhike tatra makhānte yuddhasaṃbhavaḥ | samabhavaddhi daityānāṃ brahmāṇḍasarjakaiḥ saha || 1 12|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kuṃkumavāpītaḥ ṛṣīṇāṃ preṣaṇāṃ tataḥ pitrādibhyāṃ ca saha hareḥ prāgjyotiṣādideśeṣu vimānena gamanaṃ, yajñānte yuddhasaṃbhavaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 108 ||
<2.109> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike teṣāmāsurāṇāṃ tu garjanaiḥ | vyanadam̐stu digantā cāmbaraṃ cukṣobha sagraham || 1 || jalapāneyadeśānāṃ rājā makaraketumān | philīpānāṃ nṛpaścāpi phalajaṃgamanāmakaḥ || 2 || vāraṇīyadvīparājo nāmnā vārdhūṣaketanaḥ | ārdramānadvīparājo nāmnā kalmāṣakesariḥ || 3 || kālaprāleyakānāṃ ca rājā raṇamadāṃkanaḥ | prācīnānāṃ ca deśānāṃ nṛpo bodhavihaṃgamaḥ || 4 || cipiṃgānāṃ ca deśānāṃ rājñā piṃgalakastathā | maṃgūjānāṃ mahārājo nāmnā samaramaṃgalaḥ || 5 || mañcūrāṇāṃ tathā rājā hārakiriṭanāmakaḥ | lāśahānāṃ mahārājaḥ kṣaṇātmavādanābhidhaḥ || 6 || karvarīprāntajo rājā kāruvarmābhidhastathā | ilādeśanṛpo nāmnā māṇḍalākṣirmahābalaḥ || 7 || pannāmadeśarājaśca nāmnā pādasahābhidhaḥ | prākcayanapradeśānāṃ rājā prācīnaśāyanaḥ || 8 || aṃgaśikṣāṃgadeśānāṃ śṛṃgaśekābhidho nṛpaḥ | etai cānye ca vai mukhyā rājānau yuddhadurmadāḥ || 9 | lakṣāyutairnijaiḥ sainyairvyomaprasāribhiḥ saha | vidyudgolairvahniyantraistūrṇasphoṭaiśca puttalaiḥ || 2.109.10 | śastrakṣepaiścāṇukṣveḍaiḥ suraṃgaśaktibhistathā | vyomajālaiḥ śataghnībhirmāyājālairviṣāśrubhiḥ || 11 | viṣānilaiḥ kṛtrimāryairyuyudhuḥ suramānavaiḥ | yuddhaṃ samabhavañcedaṃ śatayojanavartule || 12|| pitṛkanyāvimānaṃ ca brahmapriyāvimānakam | rarakṣaśaṃkaro devo bālakṛṣṇastathā svayam || 13 || anye ca śāṃkarā brāhmāḥ sauryāśca vaiṣṇavā gaṇāḥ | koṭiśo yuyudhustatrājñayāsuraiḥ samaṃ tadā ||14|| rādhike parvataprāyā yojanordhvembare tu te | utplutya grahavat sarve yuddhyanti sma tadāmbare || 15|| anye pañcayojanordhve pañcāśadyojanordhvagāḥ | sūryavat sahasā gatvā patanti sainyaśaktiṣu || 16|| nakṣatramaṇḍalānīva śobhante yodhino’mbare | makaraketumān rājā śatasāhasrasaṃkhyakaiḥ || 17||| yoddhṛbhiḥ sahito vyomni yuyudhe cāruṇaiḥ saha | aryamā taṃ tu rājānaṃ sasainyaṃ sāgaropari || 18|| viṣṇupradattacakreṇa tathā cakraiḥ svakairdrutam | ghātayitvāmbare tānapreṣayat sa yamālayam || 1 9|| sūryaketuśca tatputro hareḥ śaraṇamāgataḥ | rakṣito hariṇā tatra vaiṣṇavaḥ sa kṛtastataḥ ||2.109.20 || philīpānāṃ mahārājo yuyudhe śāṃkarairgaṇaiḥ | ayutayoddhṛsahito vahnigolaiśca hotibhiḥ ||21 || gaṇāstu śatasāhasrā nijaghnurvidyudastrakaiḥ | philīparājasahitān yoddhṝnayutasaṃkhyakān ||22|| tatsutaḥ śaraṇaṃ prāptaḥ śrīharerbījajaṃgamaḥ | anye’pi śataśaḥ putrāḥ śrīhareḥ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | |23|| te sarve bījajaṃgādyā vaiṣṇavā hariṇā kṛtāḥ | vāraṇīyabhuvo rājā dvaipo vārdhūṣaketanaḥ || 24|| pañcalakṣabhaṭopeto yuyudhe viṣṇupārṣadaiḥ | vahniyantraistūrṇaśastrairambare cakrakaistathā ||25|| pārṣadā nijacakraistān nijaghnuścābdhisaṃgame | caturlakṣabhaṭā naṣṭā rājā hataḥ sudarśanāt || 26|| tatputraḥ sāraketuśca lakṣayoddhṛsamanvitaḥ | śrīhareḥ śaraṇaṃ prāpto vaiṣṇavo hariṇā kṛtaḥ || 27|| tadbhaṭā vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve jātāḥ prāṇarirakṣavaḥ | ārdramānadvīparājo daitya kalmāṣakesarī || 28|| kṛṣṇakrūrāyutasaṃkhyabhaṭaiḥ saha vimānagaḥ | yuyudhe vyomajālādyairastraśastrairviṣāśrubhiḥ || 29|| kalpavallījanyabhaṭairlakṣasaṃkhyakavaiṣṇavaiḥ | vaiṣṇavā vyomajālāni cicchiduḥ kartarīgaṇaiḥ || 2.109.3 0|| kalpavallyutthitaistūrṇaṃ cāmbare bahuyatnataḥ | nijaghnuḥ prāṇataḥ sarvān sudarśanaiśca tadbhaṭān || 31 || kalmāṣakeśaraṃ mūrdhno dvedhā cakraṃ tadākarot | hate kalmāṣakeśe ca tatputrāḥ pañca kalmaṣāḥ | |3 2 || raktakeśaḥ kṛśākeśaścitrakeśo’gnikeśakaḥ | dhūmrakeśastathā cānye śrīhareḥ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ||33 || te’pi mantrapradānena vaiṣṇavā hariṇā kṛtāḥ| atha kālalayajanyā āsurā ye bhayaṃkarāḥ ||34|| triṃśallakṣāḥ saśastrāste naikarūpadharāḥ khagāḥ | yuyudhurvaiṣṇavaiḥ sārdhaṃ pārṣadairdaśalakṣakaiḥ ||35|| puttalaiḥ kṛtrimairvyomni tūrṇasphoṭaiśca golakaiḥ | śarāṇāṃ vṛṣṭibhirvidyutpāśaiḥ kāsāravṛṣṭibhiḥ || 36| | nāgapāśaiḥ śilābhiśca ghanairlohodbhavaistathā | nijaghnurvaipṇavān krūrā mṛṣāmāyāmadoddhatāḥ ||37| | pārṣadā bhagavadvarma dhārayitvā tu taiḥ saha | antarīkṣe vimānasthāstadā yuyudhire’strakaiḥ ||38| | kālakāleyajo jyeṣṭhaḥ putro raṇamadāṃkanaḥ | gadāṃ dhṛtvā mūḍhamāraṃ mamāra vaiṣṇavān bahūn ||39| | mūrchitāstvāpatannurvyāmanye bhagnāśca dudruvuḥ | kṛpṇanārāyaṇavarma rakṣārthaṃ jepurudvijaḥ ||2.109.40| | asya śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavarmaṇaḥ satī ramā | chando’nuṣṭup tathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastadiṣṭadaḥ ||41|| sarvajiṣṇuṃ parabrahma daityadānavanāśanam | namāmi śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ lakṣmīśaṃ vallabhaṃ prabhum | 42|| bījaṃ gopālabālaśca bhaktapālo mahāprabhuḥ | śaktiśca vaiṣṇavīdīkṣā mahābhāgavatī śubhā | |43 || kīlakaḥ śrīkambharāśrīnandano bhaktivardhanaḥ | viniyukto jape smṛtvā rādhāpāravatīpatiḥ ||44|| dhyānaṃ sarvāvatārāṇāṃ sāmarthyānāṃ prabhāvatām | prabhavasya saguṇasya mañjuhaṃsaharerhṛdi ||45|| nyāso me mastake cāstu mastakaṃ śrīhareriha | netrayorbhagavannetre hareḥ karṇau ca karṇayoḥ ||46|| nāsāyāṃ kṛṣṇanāsāstu mukhe nārāyaṇānanam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakaṇṭho me kaṇṭhe’stvasurakṣakaḥ ||47|| hṛdaye me cakradharturhṛdayaṃ cāstu śārṅgiṇaḥ | pṛṣṭhe kuṃkumavāpīsthahareḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ sadāstu me ||48|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥsthasyodaraṃ mamodare’stu ca | nābhyāṃ me bālakṛṣṇasya nābhirastu jagaddharā ||49|| jaghane me hareścāstu jaghanaṃ balasaṃbhṛtam | gupte kaṭyāṃ ca me stāṃ ca harerdhātuḥ kaṭīndriye ||2.109.50|| sakthnorme sakthinī ca stāṃ daityadānavanāśituḥ | jānvorme ca harerjānū stāṃ śaktisevituḥ prabhoḥ ||51|| jaṃghayoḥ stāṃ paranārāyaṇajaṃghe jagacchraye | pādayorme sarvadhātuḥ pādau stāṃ balirakṣakau |||52| mayyanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mūrtimāniha | brahmapriyāpatiścāstu maccharīrendriyādiṣu ||53|| ūrdhve māṃ rakṣatu svāmī paramākṣaradhāmagaḥ | puro māṃ rakṣatu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||54|| pārśvayoḥ rakṣatāṃ kṛṣṇo harirbhrātṛvarāvubhau | pṛṣṭhe’dhastād rakṣatāṃ me naro nārāyaṇastathā ||55|| pṛthvyāṃ māvatu lakṣmīśo jale rakṣatu satpatiḥ | tejasyavatu śrīkānto’ntarīkṣe tu prabhāpatiḥ ||56|| brahmapriyāpatirvyomni māṇikīśo’nile’vatu | rādhāpatiraraṇye me rakṣāṃ karotu cakradhṛk ||57|| gadādharo harirmāṃ saṃrakṣatvasurakoṭitaḥ | śaktidhṛg bālakṛṣṇo māṃ dikṣu vidikṣu rakṣatāt| ||58|| golokādhipatiḥ kṛṣṇo’vatu vahnigaṇācca mām | vaikuṇṭhādhipatirnārāyaṇo rakṣatu cāsurāt ||5 9|| astraśastravighātebhyo vīryavān māṃ prarakṣatāt | ākasmikabhayānmāṃ thīhṛdayasthaḥ prarakṣatāt ||2.109.60 || kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt | śūlamīnadhvajadhanuḥsvastikadhṛk prarakṣatāt ||61 || ityevaṃ kavacaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vaiṣṇavāḥ | dhṛtavanto’tha divyāste māyāpāraśarīriṇaḥ ||62 || sarvakṛṣṇabalā jātāḥ sarvaśaktisamanvitāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaiva hi mūrtayaḥ ||63 || sudarśanairmahācakraiḥ prayukteḥ sarvatodiśi | cicchiduḥ kālalayajān triṃśallakṣāsurān drutam ||64|| jīvataste mṛtāḥ sarvai raṇe peturmahājale | kālaprāleyaputro’pi mṛto raṇamadāṃkanaḥ ||65 || tatsutānāṃ śataṃ naṣṭaṃ viṣṇucakreṇa cāmbare | prācīnānāṃ nṛpo bodhavihaṃgamo’pi cāmbare ||66 || koṭipiśaṅgayoddhṛbhṛt pṛthvyāṃ yuddhaṃ cakāra ha | āruṇairvaiṣṇavaiḥ raudrairgaṇaiḥ kalpalatodbhavaiḥ ||67|| koṭisaṃkhyaiḥ raṇe deśe śastrāstrairavitarkitaiḥ | ambare salile pṛthvyāṃ parvate’raṇyabhūmiṣu ||68|| sarvato yuyudhustasya sainyānyanalaśastrakaiḥ | vidyudgolairvahniyantraistūrṇasphoṭaiśca puttalaiḥ ||69|| aṇukṣveḍaiḥ kṣepaṇaiśca śaraiḥ suraṃgaśaktibhiḥ | vidyuttārairvahnipāśairvyomajālairviṣānalaiḥ ||2.109.70|| śataghnībhiḥ sainyahābhiḥ śakaṭībhirvimānakaiḥ | jalaghātaiḥ kṣitighātairghātayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ ||71|| āruṇādyā gaṇā varma dhārayāmāsuraiśvaram | nijaghnurbodhasainyāni koṭiprasphoṭakāni vai ||72|| kalpavallyuttharamyā vai puttalā devasadṛśāḥ | vahniyantraprapūrāścāmbare jaghnurhi dānavān ||73|| ardhaṃ naṣṭaṃ mahāsainyaṃ puttalaiḥ puttalātmakam | sacetanaṃ tataḥ sainyamaśītilakṣasaṃkhyakam ||74|| āsurāṇāṃ hi tannaṣṭaṃ daśalakṣāṇi dudruvuḥ | daśalakṣāṇi śaraṇaṃ śrīharestatra cāyayuḥ |||75|| nāśaṃ prāptastathā rājā piṃgo bodhavihaṃgamaḥ | tatputrāḥ śatasaṃkhyāśca vijñavihaṃgamādayaḥ ||76 || śaraṇaṃ śrīhareḥ prāptā rakṣitā vaiṣṇavāḥ kṛtāḥ | daśalakṣabhaṭāścāpi vaiṣṇavā hariṇā kṛtāḥ ||77|| cipiṃgāstrilakṣasaṃkhyā yoddhāro vyomayānagāḥ | piṃgalakena cādiṣṭā yuyudhuste vināyakaiḥ ||78|| kalpavallījanaiḥ sarvaiḥ raudraistadā vane’mbare | katpalatodbhavairvināśakaiste lakṣaśo bhaṭāḥ ||79|| hatāḥ sarve paraśubhirgolakaiḥ kṣepaṇairnagaiḥ | sarpaiḥ pāśairvajradaṃśaistriśūlaiste jale’mbare ||2.109.80 || bhūmau caiva vimāneṣu yatra prāptā hatā hi te | piṃgalako hataścāpi tatputraḥ piṃgaśekakaḥ ||8 1 || śaraṇaṃ śrīhareḥ prāpto hariṇā vaiṣṇavaḥ kṛtaḥ | maṃgūjanapradeśānāṃ rājā samaramaṃgalaḥ |||82||| maṃcūraṇapradeśānāṃ hārakirīṭabhūpatiḥ | lāśahānā pradeśānāṃ kṣaṇātmavadano nṛpaḥ ||83|| kāruvarmā tathā rājā karvarīdeśajo’pi ca | ta ete nijasainyaiśca pañcāśallakṣasaṃkhyakaiḥ ||84|| sahitā yuyudhuḥ sarve brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā | brahmātvatharvamantraiśca janayāmāsa jāṭikān ||85|| devān daityapṛtanāsu prerayāmāsa satvaram | vidyutpāśaiḥ sametāste vyomamārgeṇa vai kṣaṇāt ||86|| uḍḍayāñcakrire tūrṇaṃ pañcāśallakṣajāṭikāḥ | vidyucchastraiśca tatpāśaistriṃśallakṣām̐stu dānavān ||87|| nāśayāñcakrire vidyudvajraiḥ śeṣāśca dudruvuḥ | ātharvaṇotthaśalabhairmeghavaccāmaradravaiḥ ||88|| viṣāktairdaṃśitā daityāḥ śeṣā ye daśalakṣakāḥ | mṛtāḥ sarve tataḥ śeṣā daśalakṣāṇi tadbhaṭāḥ ||89|| jīvanārthaṃ ca śaraṇaṃ śrīharestatra cāgatāḥ | te sarve vaiṣṇavāstatra bālakṛṣṇena vai kṛtā || 2.109.90|| mṛto hārakirīṭaśca tathā samaramaṃgalaḥ | hārakirīṭaputrāśca daśa sarve mahābalāḥ ||9 1 | | jīvanāśā yayuḥ sarve śaraṇaṃ śrīharestadā | prabhāsakirīṭaśreṣṭhā hariṇā vaiṣṇavāḥ kṛtāḥ ||92|| sahasraputrāḥ samaramaṃgalasyāpi vai hareḥ | śaraṇaṃ tvāgatāḥ sarve hariṇā vaiṣṇavāḥ kṛtāḥ ||93|| kṣaṇātmavadano rājā yuyudhe śaṃbhunā punaḥ | lakṣasainyasamāyukto nihataḥ śaṃkareṇa saḥ ||94|| kāruvarmā lakṣasainyayutaḥ punaśca śārṅgiṇā | yuyudhe hariṇā so’pi sudarśanena ghātitaḥ ||95||| tayoḥ putrāḥ prapautrāśca tatsahāyapradāstathā | samare nihatāḥ sarve sudarśanairhi viṣṇunā ||96|| ilādeśasya vai rājā maṇḍalākṣirmahābalaḥ | tathā pādasaho rājā pannāmadeśarakṣakaḥ || 97|| prākcayanabhūpālo nāmnā prācīnaśāyanaḥ | śatalakṣasainyayutā yuyudhuḥ śaṃbhunā saha || 98|| aṃgaśikṣāṃgadeśānāṃ śṛṃgaśekābhidho nṛpaḥ | śatalakṣabhaṭaiḥ sārdhaṃ yuyudhe śaṃbhunā saha || 99|| hatāste dviśatalakṣairyoddhṛbhiḥ sahitā raṇe | hareṇa svagaṇaiḥ sarve nāśitā māritā mṛdhe || 2.109.100 || eko’pi nāvaśiṣṭo’bhūddharasaṃgrāmayāyinām | evamete vinaṣṭāste catuṣkoṭiraṇaṃgamāḥ || 101 || śeṣā prajāstathā sainyabhaṭāstu vaiṣṇavāḥ kṛtāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena rādhike tadā || 102|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | mantraṃ dadau haristebhyaḥ ṛṣayaścājñayā hareḥ || 103 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne makaraketumadādipañcadaśabhūbhatāṃ sapādacatuṣkoṭisainyasahitānāṃ śaṃbhvādibhiḥ saha yuddhe maraṇācchiṣṭānāṃ pañcaviṃśatilakṣāṇāṃ śaraṇāgatirityādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||109||
<2.110> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ityevaṃ rādhike pūrvapṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntike | prāgjyotiṣādideśeṣu raṇo’bhūddānavāntakṛt || 1 || tatasteṣāṃ viśuddhyarthaṃ yajñaṃ punastu vaiṣṇavam | śālāvatīnadīmūle lāśahāsarasastaṭe || 2 || brahmaputrottare pārśve śatayojanavistare | sarovarābhitaścakre’nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 3 || samāhūtāḥ prajāḥ sarvā yuddhadeśīyamānavāḥ | vimānaiḥ sarvatobhadrairghaṭyā krośasahasragaiḥ || 4 || sarve surāḥ samāyātāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitarastathā | saptāhaścābhavad yajño’tyutkṛṣṭahavanādibhiḥ || 5 || havyānāṃ nahi saṃkhyāsti rasānāṃ gaṇanāpi na | bhojyānāmapi nānto’sti peyānāṃ tatra kā kathā || 6 || abjādhikā mahīmānāḥ saṃhatāstatra sāttvikāḥ | pārthivāśca narā nāryo yuddhaśuddhimabhīplavaḥ || 7 || devānāṃ ca maharṣīṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ gaṇanā tu na | āhūtāni ca tīrthāni nadā nadyaśca sāgarāḥ || 8 || lāśahāsarasaścāpsu brahmaputrājaleṣu ca | śālāvatyāstathā nadyā mūle tīrthāni cāyayuḥ || 9 || śatayojanavistāro bhūdeśo devatāśrayaḥ | goloka iva samabhūd vaikuṇṭha iva cābhavat || 2.110.1 0|| brahmaloka iva vāpi hyakṣaraṃ ceva vābhavat | yatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ || 11 || svayaṃ virājate yatra brahma brahmarṣayastathā | ṛṣayaśca surāścāpi jagatāṃ pitarastathā || 12|| tatra kiṃ nāma vai nyūnaṃ rādhike ṛddhivarjitam | yatra brahmapriyāḥ santi santi vai kalpavallayaḥ || 13|| svayaṃ brahmā haro viṣṇuścāryamā tatra kā kṣatiḥ | yatra vahniḥ saptajihvaścaturvedadharo hyajaḥ || 14|| pañcānanaḥ svayaṃ rudrastatra kā nyūnatā bhavet | lokakalyāṇadā devā īśvarā yatra sāttvikāḥ || 15|| yatra mokṣapradāḥ śuddhā maharṣayaśca vaiṣṇavāḥ | pāvanā lokaśuddhyarthaṃ militāstīrtharūpiṇaḥ || 16|| yatra pravartate yajño vaiṣṇavo vaiṣṇavaiḥ suraiḥ | tatra kā nāma kalyāṇe nyūnabhūmiḥ prajāyate || 17|| kalpavallyastathā muktā nadā nadyo drumāstathā | surāstattvāni cājahruryajñasāmagrikāḥ parāḥ || 18|| pañcagavyāni sarvān vai pāyayāmāsurīśvarāḥ | ṛṣayo ye vimānasthā nārāyaṇasahasthitāḥ || 19|| prajānāṃ yuddhagānāṃ ca dehaśuddhiṃ yathāvidhi | kārayāmāsurutsāhāt tato mantraṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ||2.110.20||| śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mama sarvathā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||21|| kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt | śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava ||22|| brahmāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto’smi śāśvataḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me ||23|| prathamaṃ śaraṇaṃ mantraṃ dvitīyaṃ tu samarpaṇam | ṣoḍaśākṣarayuktaṃ ca prathamaṃ ca dvitīyakam ||24|| tṛtīyaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ mantraṃ dvitriṃśadakṣaraṃ tathā | caturthaṃ brahmabhāvaṃ ca haryardhāṃgapradaṃ manum |||25|| dvātriṃśadakṣaraṃ daduḥ ṛṣayaste caturdaśa | maṃkaṇako maṃkirayaḥ kūrmo prācīnabarhaṇaḥ ||26|| trītaḥ prabhūtānakaśca ruśāyī khāsanastathā | aṃgaśyāmaḥ ārakarṇo brahmadāso hyanāmayaḥ || 27|| śyāmalarṣimalayarṣiścaite manūn dadustadā | havanottaramete vai prajābhyastaulasīḥ srajaḥ ||28||| daduścābjapramāṇābhyaḥ prajābhyaḥ śāsanāddhareḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī śrīhariṃ śaraṇaṃ mama ||29|| yajñe mantraṃ dadustābhyaḥ pāvanyaścākarotprajāḥ | lāśahāsalile sarvāḥ snāpayāmāsa keśavaḥ || 2.110.30 || śālāvatyāśca salile brahmaputrījale tathā | evaṃ sarvāḥ prajā nārīrnarān bālām̐śca bālikāḥ ||3 1|| pāvayāmāsa bhagavān sarvajñātīyamānavān | vahniṃ devān havyarasaiḥ santṛpya pitṛdevatāḥ || 32|| pārṣadān kanyakāścāpi santṛpya yuddharakṣitān | bhojayāmāsa bhagavān miṣṭānnairabjamānavān || 33|| yajñaprasādamāsādya kṛtakṛtyāśca te’bhavan | avabhṛthaṃ vidhāyaiva sabhāyāṃ bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||34|| ajamājñāpayāmāsa pāritoṣikahetave | brahmā natvā bālakṛṣṇaṃ prabhuṃ śrīkṛṣṇavallabham || 35|| prakāśaṃ prāha sarvābhyaḥ prajābhyo’bhayadānakam | parabrahmākṣarātītaḥ sarvāvatārakāraṇam ||36|| vāsudevādikavyūhā utpadyante yataḥ khalu | kālo mahāpūruṣaśca māyā yasya tu śaktayaḥ ||37|| avatārāśca dhāmāni jāyante yasya mūrtitaḥ | so’yaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇo’sti svāmiśrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ||38|| kaṃbharāśrīsutaḥ śrīmadgopālabālako hariḥ | aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre’kṣarakṣetre nivāsakṛt ||3 9|| kuṃkumavāpikāsaṃsthaḥ prabhāpāravatīpatiḥ | kṛṣṇābrahmapriyārādhāramālakṣmīpatiḥ prabhuḥ ||2.110.40|| māṇikīlalitāhaṃsāmañjulāsaguṇāpatiḥ | jayāśāntādayāmuktādevīhaimīkalāpatiḥ ||41 || satāṃ svāmī muktikāntaḥ sṛṣṭisvāmī pareśvaraḥ | sarvadhāmeśo’ntarātmā dehināṃ phaladaḥ svayam ||42|| yadāśrayeṇa jñātavyaṃ prāptavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate | yatparo na samo yena kaścidanyo na vidyate ||43 || āruṇaiḥ prārthanīyā yā muktiḥ śāśvatikā parā | tasyā dātā tvayaṃ svāmī patiḥ kāntaḥ paro hariḥ ||44|| parāmuktiḥ sameṣṭavyā hyetasmācchrīharerjanāḥ | asmākaṃ vijayastvasya pratāpena sadāsti vai ||45|| nārāyaṇādyāḥ satataṃ yaṃ bhajāmaḥ sa eva saḥ | asya mūrtiṃ pūjayadhvaṃ bhajadhvaṃ tvenameva ca ||46|| sevāmasya prakurudhvaṃ tiṣṭhadhvaṃ vacane’sya ca | asya vāṇī mahāvedā asya kriyā vṛṣo mahān ||47|| asya mūrtiḥ sadā sevyā hyayaṃ dhyeyaḥ sadā janaiḥ | asya sparśād pavitrā vai jāyante jaḍacetanāḥ ||48|| yuddhe hatāstu ye devā devapakṣāstathā ca ye | sajīvāḥ santu te sarve kṛpayāsya kṣaṇādiha ||49|| pṛthvyāṃ jale’mbare ye vā mṛtā devānusāriṇaḥ | śīghraṃ bhavantu divyāste samāyāntu hariṃ prati ||2.110.50|| ityuktvā jalamādāya kamaṇḍalau hareḥ padāt | cikṣepa cāmbare brahmā jalaṃ tanmeghasadṛśam ||5 1 || vardhamānaṃ drutaṃ ca prāsarad bhūvyomavāriṣu | amṛtaṃ tattadā bhūtvā jīvayāmāsa vai mṛtān ||52|| surapakṣān sarvajīvān kṛtrimānaparām̐stathā | tadeva jalamevābhūt spṛṣṭaṃ dānavasuptiṣu ||53|| tathāpi dānavā naiva sajīvā abhavam̐stadā | śrīśasvāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyecchā hi tādṛśī ||54|| spṛṣṭaṃ samaṃ surapakṣā jīvitā na tu dānavāḥ | atha brahma tadā tebhyo dadau mantracatuṣṭayam ||55|| jīvitebhyo haristatra pradadau pāritoṣikam | vijetṛbhyastathā tatra dadau supāritoṣikam ||56|| dehadvayaṃ muktiyogyaṃ caikaṃ paraṃ tu bhūsthitam | preṣayāmāsa tān sarvān muktiyogyān pade’kṣare ||57|| bhūyogyān bhagavānāha svayaṃ prasannamānasaḥ | yajñahavyaṃ prasādaṃ ca pānaṃ miṣṭaṃ subhojanam ||58|| gṛhṇantu ceti te sarve bhuktavantastadājñayā | atha rājakumārām̐śca ṛṣīn sainyāni cāpi ca ||59|| samāhūya hariḥ prāha prajāśca sakalāstathā | pāvitā vai mayā deśā bhavatāṃ tīrtharūpiṇaḥ ||2.110.6 0|| kṛtā mokṣapradā nadyo nadāḥ sarāṃsi parvatāḥ | daityadānavanāśo’ti kṛtaścātra bhuvastale ||61 || ete rājakumārāśca vaiṣṇavāste mamāśritāḥ | mayā nṛpāsaneṣveva sthāpyante mama bālakāḥ ||62|| prajāścāpi bhavatyo me bālikāḥ santi sarvathā | nṛpājñāyāṃ pravartantu mamājñaiṣā hi śāśvatī ||63|| mama bhaktiṃ prakurvantu mānyā me ṛṣayastathā | śṛṇvantvapi vibhāgena yathā rājyaṃ dadāmi tat ||64|| ayaṃ brahmā prajānāṃ ca pitāmahaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | yasya nāma vadāmyasmai kirīṭaṃ pradadātu saḥ ||65|| jalapānadvīpabhūmirdīyate sūryaketave | philīpadvīpasaṃghātā dīyante bījajaṃgine ||66|| vāraṇīyadvīpabhūmiḥ sāraketāya dīyate | ārdramānadvīpabhūmiḥ raktakeśāya dīyate ||67|| dīyate prācīnarājyaṃ vijñavihaṃgamāya ca | piṃgacipiṃgarājyaṃ tu piṃgakeśāya dīyate ||68|| maṃgūbhūmirdāyate ca āhavamaṃgalāya tu | mañcuraṇo’rpyate prabhākirīṭāya pradeśakaḥ ||69|| lāśahākhyapradeśaśca trītarṣaye pradīyate | trītavittetināmnā ca prasiddhaṃ rājyamastu tat ||2.110.70|| ṛṣirājyaṃ bhavatvetad vasantu tatra cāruṇāḥ | chāyāśarīrarūpāśca brahmātmajñānavedinaḥ ||7 1 || kārurājyaṃ dīyate ca kūrmiṇe tu maharṣaye | ṛṣirājyaṃ tadapyastu vaiṣṇavaṃ pāvanaṃ sadā ||72|| ilādeśasya vai rājya svayaṃ brahmā karotu ca | brahmadeśaḥ sadā cāstu tīrthaṃ cairāvatī nadī ||73|| pannāmanadikābhūmiṃ viṣṇuḥ praśāstu sarvadā | śyāmadeśo brahmapūrve pannāmnītīrthamastu ca ||74|| prākcayanākhyabhūmeśca rakṣako’stu śivaḥ sadā | vināyakāśca prācīnarakṣakāḥ santu tatparāḥ ||75|| aṃgaśikṣāṃgadeśānāṃ rājāpi śaṃkaraḥ svayam | svagaṇaiḥ saharājyaṃ tacchāstu prācīnadakṣiṇam ||76 || sumātṛke pradeśe ca tiṣṭhantu mātaraḥ sadā | śivasatyo rakṣaṇārthaṃ sāmudradaityanāśikāḥ ||77|| evametāni rājyāni bhavantu vaiṣṇavāni vai | iṭyevaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena bhāṣitam ||78|| brahmā ca pradadau tasmai tasmai rājyakirīṭakam | harirdadau svayaṃ cāpi viṣṇave’jāya śaṃbhave || 79|| tilakaṃ kaisaraṃ kṛtvā kaṇṭhīṃ mālāṃ ca taulasīm | nūtanebhyaśca pradadau bālakṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ tadā ||2.110.8 0 || athāha ca haristebhyo rājabhyo hitakṛdvacaḥ | guravo’pi mayā vo’tra dīyante bhaktihetave ||8 1 || karvarījalapānānāṃ guruḥ kūrmīti vai ṛṣiḥ | prācīnānāṃ philīpānānāṃ guruḥ śaṃbhurmaheśvaraḥ ||8 2 | | prācīnottarabhāgānāṃ guruḥ prācīnabarhaṇaḥ | śyāmalānāṃ cipiṃgānāṃ guruḥ śyāmalako muniḥ ||83 || malayānāṃ malayarṣirilāyā brahmadāsakaḥ | lāśahānāṃ gurustrīto lūśānāṃ lūśayastathā ||84|| vāraṇānāṃ mātaraśca gurvyo bodhyāḥ ṛṣipriyāḥ | ārdramānagururbrahmā brāhmāṇāmapi viśvasṛṭ ||85|| maṃgūjānāṃ maṃkaṇako gurustaddeśavāsinām | maṃcūrāṇāṃ prajādīnāṃ maṃkirayo gururmataḥ |||86 || bhūtānāṃ tu prabhūtānaḥ pannāmānāmanāmayaḥ | prākcayanapradeśānāṃ cayanarṣirgururmataḥ ||87 || aṃgaśikṣāṃgadeśānāmaṃgaśyāmalako guruḥ | ārākāṇāmārakarṇaḥ khasīnānāṃ tu khāsanaḥ || 88 || ete taddeśarājānāṃ prajānāṃ guravaḥ sadā | maharṣayo mayā dattā mahābhāgavatottamāḥ | |89 | | svīcakruste’pi rājāno vaiṣṇavā vaiṣṇavān gurūn | harṣaṃ prāpuśca te sarve ṛṣayo bhūbhṛtaḥ prajāḥ || 2.110.90 || atha śrībhagavān bhaktahṛdayajñaḥ prajārttihā | abjarūpadharo bhūtvā mimile sarvadehinaḥ || 91 || caraṇau pradadau sarvavakṣassu cihnaśobhitau | aṣṭakoṇaścordhvarekhā svastiko yavavajrakau || 92|| jāmbūphalaṃ dhvajoṃ’kuśaḥ padmaṃ dakṣapade’bhavan | trikoṇaḥ kalaśaścāpi goṣpadaṃ ca dhanuṣyakam || 93 || mīnārdhacandrakau vyoma vāme tu caraṇe’bhavan | kacchapaśca garuḍaśca śikharaṃ karihaṃsakau || 94|| vimānaṃ sūryamevaite pādagrantheradho’bhavan | dakṣe pade harestatra ghuṭikāḍguṣṭhadigbhavā || 95|| vāme tu ghuṭikānimne lakṣmīḥ saudhaṃ drumaśca gauḥ | siṃhāsanaṃ ca pañcaite pade samabhavan hareḥ | | 96|| atha mīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikaśūlinam | padmabāṇadaṇḍayutaṃ dakṣaṃ karaṃ tu siddhidam | | 97|| nirbhayacakrasahitaṃ śrīrekhaṃ samayūrakam | vaṃśīcihnaṃ kalpavallīyutaṃ cāśvavṛṣānvitam | | 98|| vāmaṃ karaṃ tu śubhadaṃ kṛtvā dvayostadāñjalim | prajānāṃ ca nṛpādīnāṃ pradadau mūrddhasu prabhuḥ | | 99|| mudrikāḥ kalpaphaladāḥ pradadau pratimānavam | kalpamūrtiṃ nijāṃ pūjākarmaṇe pradadau prabhuḥ | | 2.110.100 | | annavastrarddhibāhulyaṃ pradadāvāśiṣastathā | dadau divyaṃ darśanaṃ ca paradhāmavirājitam | | 101 | | rādhike kṛpayā yatra prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ | tatra triguṇajīvānāṃ samo lābho harerbhavet | | 102| | iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prāgjyotiṣādideśānāṃ vaiṣṇavanṛpavyavasthā, ṛṣivyavasthā, kṛpāvarṣaṇaṃ, divyadarśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā daśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ | | 110 | |
<2.111> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike divyakiśoraṃ darśanaṃ param | paradhāmagataṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa mādhavaḥ || 1 || rūpānurūpāvayavaṃ koṭikāmāśrayaṃ śubham | sarvatejomayaṃ sarvānandaśāntidayābhṛtam || 2|| apārakaruṇāyuktaṃ tathā vātsalyaśevadhim | anantānanta sauhārdasnehapremaprapūritam || 3 || sarvagandharasādyuktaṃ sarvapuṣṭibalānvitam | sarvābhṛtaprasavaṃ ca sarvasparśasukhapradam || 4 || mukuṭādivibhūṣābhiḥ śobhitaṃ ca manoharam | divyāmbarasuśobhaṃ ca sarvacihnavirājitam || 5 || rādhālakṣmīyutaṃ pārśve prabhāpāravatīyutam | māṇikīsahitaṃ divyaṃ brahmapriyābhivanditam || 6 || asaṃkhyamuktadhāmādiprastutaṃ cāvatārakaiḥ | pārṣadairīśvaraiḥ sarvairīśvarībhirnataṃ tathā || 7 || saguṇairnirguṇaistattvaiḥ sṛṣṭipālaiḥ pravanditam | ṛṣibhiḥ pitṛbhirdevairmānavairjaḍacetanaiḥ || 8 || pātālavāsibhiścāpi śaktibhiśca stutaṃ prabhum | sarvaṃ yatra mamau sūkṣmaṃ yasmācca niryayāvidam || 9 || sarvātmakaṃ tataḥ sūkṣmaṃ camatkāraprapūritam | sarvāścaryāśritaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ śrīkambharāsutam || 2.111.10 || kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram | divyākṣaraṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ darśayāmāsa vai prabhuḥ || 11 || pitṛkanyā viṃśatiśca daśasāhasrasevikāḥ | sarvāstāḥ pitṛputryo vai mumuhuḥ śrīharau tadā || 1 2|| vavrire kāntamātmānaṃ sarvātmavallabhaṃ prabhum | prajākanyāḥ koṭisaṃkhyā vavrire kāntameva tam || 1 3|| aryamṇā ca prajābhiśca bālakṛṣṇāya cārpitāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena svīkṛtāśca tāḥ || 14|| kṛtakṛtyā abhavam̐śca prāptavyaḥ prāpta eva yat | bhagavān svavimāneṣu tābhyo vāsaṃ tadā dadau || 15|| athāryamāṇa bhagavānāha kārukaparvate | sindhumūle sadā mūtyā stheyaṃ tvayātra bhūtaye || 16|| trītarājye cāruṇānāṃ rakṣārthaṃ paścime sthale | aryamam̐stava rājyaṃ tad bhaviṣyati sukhāvaham || 17|| ityevaṃ bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastu bhāsvate | aryamṇe pradadau kurukarādriṃ sindhupārśvagam || 18|| āruṇā divyavasanā divyarūpāśca tatstriyaḥ | prāpya tat sundaraṃ sthānaṃ mumudurdevatā iva || 19|| kaṃ sukhaṃ tatpradā yā aśmanām irā kṣitiḥ śubhā | kaśmerā parvatabhūmiḥ kāruparvataśobhanā ||2.111.20|| tatrāryamā svayaṃ vāsaṃ cakre śrīsahitaḥ sadā | śrībhūmiḥ pāvanī sā cābhavacchrīnagarī sadā ||21 || evaṃ
