sarvaṃ vyavasthāpya haristīrthavidhitsayā | vidhāpayituṃ tīrthāni nadīrnadān sarāṃsi ca ||22|| prajāḥ svasvapradeśām̐śca gantumājñāpya vai tataḥ | vimānairniryayau kṛṣṇo yātumādiśya vai nṛpān ||23|| brahmapriyākumārībhirdevapitrarṣibhiḥ saha | sasnau sa brahmaputryāṃ vai lāśahākhyasarojale ||24|| tataḥ sasnau sindhumūle tataśca terimājale | āmūrāyā jale sasnau homāṃgāyā jale tataḥ ||25|| mahatyāśca jale aṃgaśikṣāṃgāyā jale tataḥ | śikṣāṃgāyā jale sasnau manikaṅgvā jale tataḥ ||26|| pannāmnyāśca jale cāpi śālāvatyā jale’pi ca | irāvatyā jale snātvā sundarāraṇyamāyayau ||27||| pitṛkanyā hariḥ prāha bhavatyo’tra mama priyāḥ | dvirūpiṇyo bhavantveva mūlacchāyātmikāḥ śubhāḥ ||28|| mūlātmikā mama kṣetre vasantu tu mayā saha | chāyātmikā nadīrūpā vasantu tīrthabhūmigāḥ ||29|| brahmaputrī lavahītā candrāvatī irāvatī | śālāvatī mīnakaṅgū lāṭiśā kāniśā tathā ||2.111.3 0|| māpīṃgā cāpi sīkyāṃgā aṃgasvāṃgā harāṃgikā | mauktikā tārimā cāpi pannāmā tvāṃgahā tathā ||3 1 || mannāmnī maṇivarṇā ca raṃgavarṇā ca sundarī | etāḥ sarvāḥ svanāmnaiva khyātiṃ yāsyatha me priyāḥ || 32|| bhavatibhyo mayā dattaṃ sāmarthyaṃ pāpanāśakam | mokṣadaṃ puṇyadaṃ smṛddhipradaṃ putrādisampradam || 3 3|| bhavatīnāṃ mahimānaṃ kathayāmi mama priyāḥ | yāsāṃ sākṣāddhareryogo divyatāpādakaḥ śubhaḥ || 34|| muktatādāyako yogo yāsāṃ nārāyaṇena vai | tāsāṃ vai divyatā nityamuktatā kamalāsamā ||35|| rādhikayā samā lakṣmyā samāḥ śriyā samāstathā | yūyaṃ prabhāsamā divyā yūyaṃ pāravatīsamāḥ ||36|| yūyaṃ vai māṇikītulyā mama prāṇasamāḥ priyāḥ | yuṣmatsaṃsargamāptānāṃ mama dhāmni nivāsanam ||37|| bhavatīnāṃ jale snātā ye pakṣipaśavo janāḥ | kīṭāḥ pataṃgajantvādyāste yāsyanti paraṃ padam ||38|| yathā gaṃgā ca yamunā yathā sarasvatī satī | tathā yūyaṃ sarvamokṣapradā divyāḥ stha tārikāḥ ||39|| yathā ca gaṇḍakī śreṣṭhā gomatī svarṇalekhikā | tathā yūyaṃ sadā me vai nivāsārhāḥ stha yoṣitaḥ ||2.111.40|| mama mūrterjalaṃ yadvat tattathaiva ca vo jalam | brahmakamaṇḍaluvārisadṛśaṃ vo jalaṃ śubham ||41|| virājāyā yathā vāri brahmahradajalaṃ yathā | pāvanaṃ vo jalaṃ yadvadāmūla vārdhisaṃgamāt ||42|| mahāpāpātipāpānāṃ ghātahatyādibhāvinām | akṛtyajāyamānānāṃ kṣālanaṃ vo jale sadā ||43|| pītaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ tathā dṛṣṭaṃ ghrātaṃ cācamanīkṛtam | kaṇamātrajalaṃ vo’stu pāvakaṃ mama yogataḥ ||44|| āsurā rākṣasā daityā mlecchāḥ pāpāśca dānavāḥ | śuddhimeṣyanti salilādbhavatīnāṃ yuge yuge ||45|| pretā bhūtā rākṣasādyā asadgatigatāstathā | yadākadācit snānena muktimeṣyanti vai kṣaṇāt ||46|| śālāvatyā cāṃgaśikṣāyā madhye tu mayā kratuḥ | menakāṃgātaṭe yatra prathamastu kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ ||47|| tathātra lāśahānāmnastaḍāgasya samīpataḥ | dvitīyo’yaṃ mahāyajñaḥ kṛto vai vaiṣṇavaḥ śubhaḥ ||48|| ādyā vaikuṇṭhasadṛśī golokena samā parā | bhūmirdivyā bhavatīnāṃ yogācca mokṣasadṛśī ||49|| tatratyāśca prajāḥ sarvā mama pārṣadarūpiṇī | mama brahmapriyātulyāḥ satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ striyo’pi ca ||2.111.50|| bālā madbālatulyāśca vṛddhā me vṛddhasadṛśāḥ | samānā me samabhāvāḥ pāvanā mama yogataḥ ||5 1 || bhavatīnāṃ taṭe vāsaṃ kurvāṇā dehinaḥ khalu | jarāṇḍasvedabhedotthāścatvāro’pi prajīvinaḥ ||52|| pāvanā me bhaktiyuktā viṣṇutulyā matā mama | bhavatīnāṃ jale vāsaṃ kurvāṇā jantavastu ye ||53|| sadā vaikuṇṭhavāsāste bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ | bhavatīnāṃ kaṇavyāptāḥ pavanā yānti yaddiśam ||54|| te deśāḥ pāvanā viṣṇulokatulyā hi dehinām | bhavatīnāṃ jale yeṣāmasthikhaṇḍaḥ patedapi ||5 5 || yadvā bhasma śavasyāpi patetsvalpaṃ yadā tadā | te jīvāḥ pāvanā bhūtvā yāsyanti mama dhāma vai ||56|| bhavatīnāṃ smaraṇena prātarnāmnā tu yāḥ prajāḥ | yatra kvāpi kariṣyanti snānaṃ vāpījalādiṣu ||57|| gṛhe vā parvate’raṇye samudre yānavāhane | brahmaputryādināmneva te prāpsyanti kratoḥ phalam ||58|| atha gaṃgā cājanābhe abrikte ca narāyaṇī | irāvatī brahmadeśe trivitte brahmaputrikā ||59|| śyāmadeśe menakāṃgā prācīneṃ’gaśivāṃgikā | sarvāstā gomatītulyā golokāvāsadāyikāḥ ||2.111.6 0|| sarvatīrthaphalaṃ yāyāt snātvā smṛtvāpi mānavaḥ | bhavatīnāṃ taṭe kaścid dāsyatyapi ca ḍhabbukam ||6 1 || koṭimudrāpradānasya phalamāpsyati mānavaḥ | rūpyakaṃ vā svarṇamudrāṃ ratnaṃ ca hīrakaṃ ca vā ||62|| mauktikaṃ cāpi māṇikyaṃ maṇiṃ tāmraṃ varāṭikām | dāne dāsyanti ye tīre teṣāṃ koṭiguṇaṃ phalam ||63 || vastraṃ bhūṣāḥ kajjalādi śṛṃgāraṃ candanādikam | pāduke vāhanaṃ vāpi tathopakaraṇādikam ||64|| gṛhaṃ gṛhasya sāmagrīścānnaṃ rasaṃ ca bhojanam | yo vā dāsyati bhāvena tasya puṇyamanantakam ||65 || gajaṃ cāśvamajāṃ dhenuṃ dogdhrīṃ kanyāṃ ca vāṭikām | dāne dāsyati tīre vastasya puṇyamanantakam ||6 6 || vidyāṃ vidyārthināṃ cāpi sāhāyyaṃ pāṭhaśālikām | dāsyati vastaṭe teṣāṃ svargaṃ syāt samanantakam ||67|| ahaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī jalāddhastacatuṣṭaye | tīre dānapradātāro yāsyanti mama dhāma te ||68|| nārīṇāṃ cāpi bālānāmanāthānāṃ ca yoginām | sādhvīnāṃ ca satāṃ sevāṃ kartavyānantapuṇyadā ||69|| anaṃgānāmadhanānāmagṛhāṇāmanāyuṣām | sevanaṃ vastaṭe kāryaṃ tasya puṇyamanantakam ||2.111.70 || māghe pūrvadale yajñaḥ prathamaḥ pañcamītithau | samārabdho menakāṃgātaṭe tatra dine tu yaḥ ||71 || kariṣyati kratuṃ tatra vaiṣṇavaṃ raudrameva vā | svargarājyaṃ brahmarājyaṃ prāpsyanti mokṣaṇaṃ tathā ||72|| ekādaśyāṃ samāptiśca kṛtā tasyeti taddine | bhojanādīni dāsyanti prāpsyanti paramāṃ gatim ||73|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ pārāyaṇaṃ tataḥ | ārabhya kārayiṣyanti prāpsyanti mama dhāma te ||74|| mandire mama tatraivotsavaṃ ca mama sannidhau | kārayiṣyanti ye bhaktāsteṣāṃ mokṣastu śāśvataḥ ||75|| dṛḍhaṃ ca mandiraṃ nūnaṃ kārayitvā tu tattaṭe | lakṣmīrādhāprabhāpāravatīśrīmāṇikīyutam ||76 || saptamūrtisvarūpaṃ mā sthāpayiṣyanti ye janāḥ | tebhyo dhāma paraṃ sthānaṃ dāsyāmi mama śobhanam ||77|| pūjāpravāhaṃ vṛttiṃ ca jīvanaṃ dānabhojanam | dāsyanti ye bhavatīnāṃ taṭe manmandire janāḥ ||78|| tebhyaḥ svargāṇi ramyāṇi dhāmāni dyutimanti ca | dāsyāmyajasraṃ divyāni śāśvatāni na saṃśayaḥ ||79|| mandire dīpadānaṃ ca bhavatīnāṃ jale tathā | dīpadānaṃ kariṣyanti teṣāṃ cakṣurhi śāśvatam ||2.111.80|| sarvaṃ jñānamayaṃ divyaṃ vidhāsye muktidaṃ śubham | tulasīṃ campakaṃ padmaṃ tadudyānaṃ phalānvitam ||8 1 || kārayiṣyanti ye bhaktāstānnayiṣyekṣarālayam | mama vaiṣṇavabhaktānāṃ pūjāṃ bhojanadakṣiṇām ||82|| sevāṃ pādasya dāsyaṃ vā kariṣyanti tu ye janāḥ | sādhvīnāṃ vā pārṣadānāṃ kariṣyanti prasevanam ||83 || annadhanāmbareṣṭādyaistānnayiṣye’kṣaraṃ padam | bhavatīnāṃ taṭe ramye grāme cāvasathādiṣu ||84|| sādhurūpeṇa satataṃ vicariṣyāmi vallabhaḥ | sādhvīrūpeṇa me patnyo vicariṣyanti sarvadā ||85|| tāsāṃ pūjānnadānādyaiḥ kāryā svaśreyase janaiḥ | bhavatīnāṃ jale tāśca snāsyanti tīrthahetave ||86|| mama bhaktāvatārāśca me’vatārā yuge yuge | snāsyanti bhavatīnāṃ vai salileṣu punaḥ punaḥ ||87|| māghe saritsu caitāsu ye tu snāsyanti dehinaḥ | teṣāṃ pāpāni vilayaṃ yāsyanti koṭijanmanām || 88|| nadīnāṃ saṃgamādau ca kuṃbhalagne tu ye janāḥ | snāsyanti dūrato gatvā yāsyanti paramaṃ padam ||89|| mayā kṛpayā pitṛkanyāstīrthīkṛtāḥ sadā | matpriyā bhavathāto vai mattulyā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 2.111.90|| māghamāse bhavatīnāṃ jaleṣu svargavāsinaḥ | devāśca pitaraścāpi samāyāsyanti nityaśa ||9 1 || sarvatīrthāni lokebhyaścāgamiṣyanti sarvataḥ | koṭitīrthātmakaṃ vāri bhavatīnāṃ bhaviṣyati || 92|| satyaṃ svargādikaṃ sarvaṃ bhavatīnāṃ jale tadā | bhaviṣyati na sandeho yūyaṃ śreṣṭhatamāstataḥ ||93 || tattaddeśodbhavāḥ santo nivatsyanti hi vastaṭe | bhavatīnāṃ supāvitryaṃ vardhayiṣyanti sādhavaḥ ||94|| putrapautrakalatrādidhanadhānyāmbarādikam | bhūṣākṣetrodyānarājyasampatsmṛddhipradaṃ tathā ||95|| sarveṣṭasukhadaṃ svargamokṣadaṃ vaṃśadaṃ śubham | bhavatīnāṃ jale snānaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ vidhāsyati || 96 || bhavatīnāṃ taṭe vāsakṛtāṃ mokṣo bhaviṣyati | muṇḍanaṃ kārayiṣyanti ye tatpāpāni sarvathā ||97|| nāśameṣyanti ca śuddhiṃ yāsyanti cātmanāṃ tataḥ | bhavatīnāṃ taṭe dīkṣāṃ grahīṣyanti narāḥ striyaḥ || 98|| te muktā mama dhāmasthatulyā dehayutā api | snānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homaṃ svādhyāyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam || 99|| anāthapālanaṃ gopālanaṃ dīnasahāyanam | kariṣyanti janā ye’tra taṭe te mokṣabhāginaḥ || 2.111.1 00|| kumāradānakartāraḥ kanyādānavidhāyinaḥ | brahmadhāmagatiṃ cānte yāsyanti śāśvataṃ padam || 101 || bhavatīnāṃ jale tvekavāraṃ snāsyanti ye janāḥ | smṛtvā śatakulānyeva tāni yāsyanti mokṣaṇam || 1 02|| bhavatīnāṃ taṭe śrāddhaṃ mṛtānāṃ puṇyasatkriyāḥ | devānāṃ sthāpanaṃ vṛkṣe jalapānaṃ tathālayam || 103 || āśrayaṃ dharmaśālāṃ ca sāhāyyaṃ vipadātmanām | kariṣyanti janā ye’tra te prāpsyanti parāṃ gatim || 1 04|| bhavatīnāṃ mandirāṇi kāriṣyanti ye janāḥ | kuladevīṃ kūlavāsā mānayiṣyanti vaśca ye || 105 || pūjayiṣyanti vividhairnūtanairmiṣṭabhojanaiḥ | jalapuṣpaphalārghyaiśca teṣāṃ svargaṃ hi śāśvatam || 1 06|| avagrahātivṛṣṭyādipīḍā teṣāṃ na vai bhavet | ṛṣīṇāṃ mama śiṣyāṇāṃ mandire pratimārcanam || 1 07|| kariṣyanti janāsteṣāṃ dāridryaṃ naiva dṛśyate | ityevaṃ rādhike tābhyo dadāvāśīrvacāṃsi saḥ || 1 08| | itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne brahmaputryādibhyo hariṇā dattadivyadarśanam, daśasahasrāṇi viṃśatiśceti kanyakārpaṇam, aryamṇe kaśmerāpradeśarājyadānam, brahmaputryādīnāṃ nadīrūpeṇāpi bhavanam, tāsu harikṛtasnānam, varadānāni, tīrthaphalāni, dānaphalāni cetinirūpaṇanāmaikādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 111 ||
<2.112> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tābhirnadībhiryattadārthitam | tvayā kṛṣṇa vayaṃ sarvāstīrthīkṛtāḥ kṛpāvaśāt | | 1 || sarvadevanivāsām̐śca pradehyasmattaṭeṣviha | ityasmākaṃ susaṃkalpaṃ prapūraya prabhāpate || 2 || śrutvā prāha mahārājaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | brahmāṇaṃ śaṃkaraṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvadevāhvanāya vai || 3 || tridevāḥ sasmarurdevān trayastriṃśatprakoṭikān | sarve tūrṇaṃ samājagmuryatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 4 || vane vai sundarākhye te samāgatya narāyaṇam | namaścakruḥ samīhānā ājñāṃ nārāyaṇasya te || 5 || hariḥ prāha vasūnaṣṭau rudrānekādaśaiva ca | dvādaśādityavaryāścāśvinau dvau lokahetave || 6 || bhavanto bhinnarūpaiśca tiṣṭhantu tīrthakāmyayā | brahmaputryādisalile lokapāvanahetave || 7 || tata ārabhya tanmūle vasavo vāsamācaran | saṃgameṣvādityavaryā rudrāḥ samudrasaṃgame || 8 || aśvinau vakragatyādau vāsān samācaram̐stataḥ | indrādyāśca diśāṃ pālā aṣṭau teṣāṃ hradeṣu ca || 9 || saptarṣayastīravaneṣvavasan yatra parvatāḥ | navagrahā nivāsaṃ cākurvan nagarasannidhau || 2.112.1 0|| maruddevāśca tīreṣu svalpasaritsamāgame | catuḥṣaṣṭimahāyoginyaścāvasan samucchraye || 11 || avatāreṣu sarvatrāṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrthamaṇḍalam | vālakhilyāḥ pitaraścarṣayo viśvesurāstathā || 12|| siddhāścāsāṃ pramārgeṣu nyavasam̐stīrtharūpiṇaḥ | ityevaṃ śrīharistābhyastīrthāni pradadau svayam || 13|| eteṣāṃ tu nivāseṣu yajñadānatapaḥkriyāḥ | kriyamāṇā yajamāne śāśvatapuṇyakārikāḥ || 14|| māghakṛṣṇaikādaśikottaraṃ punarmṛdho’bhavat | saptāhastatra vai sarvān daityān vināśya mādhavaḥ || 15|| cakre dvitīyayajñaṃ sa māghe site tu pañcame | dine saptāhayajñaḥ sa pūrṇo’bhavad vrate dine || 16|| ekādaśyāṃ kṛtaṃ tasyāvabhṛthaṃ ca tataḥ param | caturdināni sarvāsāṃ jaleṣu snānamācarat || 17|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpūrṇimātithau | āyayau ca vimānena vanaṃ sundarasaṃjñakam || 18 || tasmāttīrthāni sarvāṇi lāśahākhye sarovare | śālāvatyā brahmaputryā jale saptāhake’tra vai || 1 9|| vasanti ca samāyānti māghaśukle viśeṣataḥ | saritsvanyāsu ca caturdineṣu saṃvasanti ca || 2.112.20|| tatra dānaṃ gavāṃ deyaṃ gajānāṃ vājināṃ tathā | ajānāṃ ca tathoṣṭrāṇāṃ vṛṣāṇāṃ deyamityapi ||21 || kambalānāṃ ca vastrāṇāṃ yānānāṃ dānamuttamam | vimānānāṃ gṛhāṇāṃ ca kṣetrāṇāṃ deyamityapi || 22 || annānāṃ vividhānāṃ ca dvidalānāṃ pradānakam | śākānāṃ cāpi pātrāṇāṃ kandānāṃ deyamityapi || 23|| kaṇānāṃ surasānāṃ ca śarkarāṇāṃ patattriṇām | patrāṇāmikṣudaṇḍānāṃ phalānāṃ deyamityapi ||24|| peṭikānāṃ mañjuṣāṇāṃ pātrāṇāṃ dānamuttamam | mañcopakaraṇānāṃ ca svarṇasya rajatasya ca ||25|| mudrādeśca dhanasyāpi kartavyaṃ dānamityapi | vidyādānaṃ pradātavyaṃ dāsadānaṃ tathottamam ||26|| dāsīdānaṃ pradātavyaṃ mokṣadānaṃ mahottamam | jñānadānaṃ kathādānaṃ putradānaṃ svadānakam ||27|| kanyādānaṃ pradātavyaṃ yogyāya tu varāya ca | saudhadānaṃ tathā śayyādānaṃ paryaṃkadānakam ||28|| kartavyaṃ daivapuruṣe daivīsatyāṃ phalapradam | devamūrtipradānaṃ ca svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā ||29|| dehadānaṃ prakartavyaṃ kaṭidānaṃ parātmane | sarvadānaṃ pradātavyaṃ śrīśāya paramātmane ||2.112.3 0 || ātmadānaṃ sadā deyaṃ gurave mokṣadāya vai | pustakānāṃ pāṭhadānaṃ kartavyaṃ pāṭhine sadā ||31 || māghe sarvāṇi dānāni sarvamāseṣvapi dhruvam | kartavyāni sakāmaistu labhyate phalamakṣaram ||32|| raktadānaṃ vāṣpadānaṃ garbhadānaṃ tathā striyāḥ | ratidānaṃ pradātavyaṃ auṣadhādipradānakam || 33|| nārāyaṇabaliḥ śrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ mṛtamuktidam | āśrayā ālayā dharmaśālā makhāśca tattaṭe ||34|| annasatrāṇi kāryāṇi vṛddhānāmāśrayāstathā | vidyānāmāśrayāḥ kāryāḥ kanyānāthāśrayāstathā ||35|| vidhavānāṃ vidhurāṇāmāśrayāḥ karmayojakāḥ | kartavyā dhanibhistāsāṃ nadīnāṃ tīrabhūmiṣu || 36 || lokasevāpravāhāśca kāraṇīyāḥ samantataḥ | paropakārāḥ kartavyā mānavairnarayoṣitām ||37|| tīrthekṛtāni tānyeva koṭiguṇaphalāni vai | kālamānapradānaṃ ca vidyunmānapradānakam ||38|| aṃgadānapradānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ tīrthabhūmiṣu | yantradānaṃ prakartavyaṃ pratibimbapradānakam || 39|| dūraśravaṇadṛṣṭyādiyantradānaṃ tathottamam | deyaṃ kṛṣihalādyaṃ ca sādhanaṃ mahaduttamam ||2.112.40 || atha deyaṃ sugandhyādi puṣpasāraṃ saduttaram | gandhasāraṃ rasasāraṃ sārasāraṃ parātparam ||41 || brahmaputrī sthāpanīyā caturhastātisundarī | lavahītā sthāpanīyā dvihastā ramaṇī satī ||42||| candrāvatī sthāpanīyā ṣoḍaśakaraśālinī | irāvatī sthāpanīyā aṣṭahastā sukanyakā ||43|| śālāvatī sthāpanīyā caturhastā manoharā | menakāṃgā manikaṅgū sthāpanīye caturbhuje ||44|| lāṭiśā kāniśā sthāpye dvibhuje kanyake śubhe | māpīṃgā cāpi sīkyāṃgā sthāpye’ṣṭakaraśālinī ||45|| aṣṭādaśabhuje sthāpye aṃgasvāṃgā harāṃgikā | mauktikā tārimā sthāpye dvibhuje cittakarṣike ||46 || pannāmnī tvaṃgahā sthāpye dvibhuje ca surūpiṇī | mannāmnī maṇivarṇā ca sthāpye daśabhuje śubhe ||47|| raṃgavarṇā tathā sthāpyā caturbhujā nadī satī | ityevaṃ kṛṣṇapatnīnāṃ rūpāṇi saritāṃ priye ||48|| kṛtvodbhinnayuvatītvabhāvāpannāni sarvathā | suhāsyasaumyavātsalyayuktānanāni rādhike ||49|| śvetacampakavarṇāni svarṇakāntiyutāni ca | kārayitvā pratimāśca mandirāṇi śubhāni ca ||2.112.50 || sthāpanīyānyanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai | sahitāni kiśoreṇa ramyāṇi mānavairbhuvi ||5 1 || tattannadīpradeśānāṃ prajānāṃ tā hi mātaraḥ | pūjitā vanditā nityaṃ kariṣyanti prajāvanam ||52|| tābhyo bhūṣāḥ pradātavyā nārībhiḥ patikāmyayā | saubhāgyadāśca tāḥ santi nārīṇāṃ pūjitāḥ sadā |||53 || avaidhavyapradāścāpi tathāyuṣyavivardhikāḥ | putrapautrapradāścāpyārogyadā dhanadhānyadāḥ ||54|| tābhyaḥ śāṭyaḥ pradātavyāḥ kaṃcukyaścolikāstathā | keśatailaṃ pradātavyaṃ keśaśṛṃgārakādikam ||55|| puṣpahārāḥ kajjalaṃ ca tailaṃ sugandhasārakam | ghargharyaḥ kavacaṃ vastraṃ tathā matsaravāriṇī ||56 || śayyā gendukamutkṛṣṭaṃ mṛdulaṃ guptadorakam | utarīyaṃ keśakāñcī pradeyā sarite janaiḥ ||57|| siṃhāsanaṃ kāraṇīyaṃ chatraṃ ca hāṭakādijam | mukuṭaṃ tantikā kāñcī raśanā kaṭakādikam ||58 || ūrmikāṅgulīyakāni śṛṃkhalāśca nupūrakam | hārāḥ suvarṇajanyāśca svastikaścandrakastathā || 59 || binduścandrakapaṭṭī ca nakharañjanakāni ca | bhojyapānāni deyāni mandire saritāṃ janaiḥ ||2.112.6 0 || kaṃkatirdorakaścāpi cipīṭakaśca rājataḥ | sukiṃkiṇījālayuktacaḍḍikā pādayostathā ||6 1 || dhūpo dīpaśca naivedyaṃ tathā nīrājanādikam | kalaśaścānyavastūni deyāni saritāṃ gṛhe ||62|| kanyakābhiḥ kuṃkumaṃ cākṣatā deyāśca śarkarāḥ | suvāsanībhiḥ śṛṃgārāmbarabhūṣādi saubhagam ||63 || dātavyaṃ vai nadībhyaśca haripriyābhya uttamam | preṅkhā deyā ghoṭakādi dolā pālanamityapi ||64|| vātayānaṃ vāṣpayānaṃ vahniyānaṃ tathā śubham | uṣṇayānaṃ prabhāyānaṃ cāṇuyānaṃ samuttamam ||65|| pradātavyaṃ vihārārthaṃ vyomni jale tathāmbare | jalayānaṃ cāśvayānaṃ dātavyaṃ bhūvihāri ca ||66 || jalarūpāṃ mūrtirūpāṃ pitṛkanyāṃ sutoṣayet | tāsu bhagavatpatnīṣu tuṣṭāsu tuṣyati prabhuḥ ||67|| tāsāṃ mahotsavāḥ kāryā māghe kṛṣṇe site tathā | tāsāmagre prakartavyaṃ nṛtyaṃ vāditravādanam ||68 || kīrtanaṃ bhagavadgānaṃ stavanaṃ sāmavaidikam | koṭihīrakaratnādyaiḥ śobhanīyāśca tāstadā ||69|| puṣpasugandhaśobhādyairarcanīyā haripriyāḥ | ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīprātaḥkāle brahmapriyāyutaḥ ||2.112.70|| pitṛkanyāyuto’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | pūjanīyo’tibhāvena śobhanīyo’tivastubhiḥ ||7 1|| śṛṃgāraṇīyo bhagavān tadā rājādhirājavat | svarṇahārādibhiḥ svarṇatantvambarādibhistathā ||72|| aṣṭottaraśataiścāpi bhakṣyabhojyādibhistathā | paricaryādibhiḥ kṛṣṇastoṣaṇīyo’tigītibhiḥ ||73|| rāśairmanoharaiścāpi naranārīsumiśritaiḥ | nagare nagare grāme vane cāvasatheṣvapi ||74|| ghoṣe ca pattane pūre rājadhānyāṃ viśeṣataḥ | tābhistābhiḥ supatnībhiḥ saha nārāyaṇo hariḥ ||75|| gajayānairaśvayānaiḥ svarṇaśakaṭībhistathā | rājatībhiḥ śakaṭībhiḥ kalaśadhvajāpārṣadaiḥ ||76|| sahitābhiḥ śubhābhiśca bhrāmayitavya eva saḥ | rathaśca sevakaiḥ sthirīkartavyaḥ praticatvaram ||77|| pratihaṭṭaṃ pratirathyaṃ pratyāpaṇaṃ ca gopure | pūjanīyaḥ śrīphalādyaiḥ pratirājagṛhaṃ tathā ||78|| puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ prakartavyākṣatalājādimiśritā | candanaṃ gandhasalilaṃ prokṣaṇe deyameva tu ||79|| miṣṭānnaṃ miṣṭapānīyaṃ pātavyaṃ cārthine rathāt | prasādaśca pradātavyo bhaktebhyaḥ pathi sarvathā ||2.112.80|| tūryāṇi rājatūryāṇi vādanīyāni cāgrataḥ | dhūpadīpasahito’yaṃ bhrāmaṇotsava uttamaḥ ||8 1|| kartavyaḥ kārtike kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇajanmamahotsavaḥ | evaṃ vai bhrāmayitvaiva bhagavantaṃ priyāyutam ||82|| viśāle maṇḍape rātrau sthāpanīyo gajāsane | nīrājanaṃ prakartavyaṃ śatāṣṭavarttibhistataḥ ||83|| rāsastatra prakartavyastālikādaṇḍikādibhiḥ | vāditrairvividhaiścāpi kathā kāryā tadā hareḥ ||84|| pūjanaṃ saṃvidhāyaiva parihāraṃ samācaret | rātrau tanmandire neyo bhagavān saha patnībhiḥ ||85|| tato bhaktaiḥ prakartavyaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ tathāthavā | suptavyaṃ svagṛhe gatvā brahmacaryaparāyaṇaiḥ ||86|| prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ natvā kṛtvā darśanapūjanam | tato dānādi kartavyaṃ navamyāṃ prātarityapi ||87|| tasya puṇyasya nānto’sti paramokṣapradaṃ hi tat | evaṃ mahotsave kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prasīdati ||88|| saritaśca prasīdanti dadatyatīva sampadaḥ | dhanadhānyādisamṛddhīrdadatyapi navā navāḥ ||89|| ārogyaṃ putrapautrādi gomahiṣī dhanānyapi | aśvahastyuṣṭrayānāni vimānaṃ rājasampadaḥ ||2.112.90 || kīrtiṃ svarṇaṃ pūjyatāṃ ca loke khyātiṃ parāṃ sthitim | dadatyeva saricchreṣṭhāstuṣṭāḥ śrīpatinā saha || 91 || ityevaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha svayaṃ prabhuḥ | gṛhe gṛhe prarakṣyā me pratimā saritā saha || 92|| pūjanīyā sadā prātarmadhyāhne sāyamityapi | kariṣye tanmana pūrṇaṃ sveṣṭaṃ dāsye punaḥ punaḥ || 92 || ityāha bhagavām̐stābhyaḥ satībhyastatra sundare | vane paścād brahmaputrīsāgare sasnureva ca || 94|| gaṃgāsāgarayoge ca sasnuḥ sarvavimānagāḥ | sākaṃ bhagavatā svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai || 95|| kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā pupūjuśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | dadhyurnārāyaṇamūrtiṃ hṛdayeṣu sthirīkṛtām ||96|| ityetad rādhike tubhyaṃ mayoktaṃ hariceṣṭitam | śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāpi bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham ||97|| svargamokṣapradaṃ cāpi pāpatāpapraṇāśanam | sarvadā kīrtanīyaṃ vai bhaktairapi mumukṣubhiḥ ||98|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne dvitīyayajñabhūmirūpalāśahāsarovarasaritāṃ mūrtyādipūjanapratiṣṭhāmāhātmyavarṇananāmā dvādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 11 2 ||
<2.113> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca atha śrīrādhike kṛṣṇapriyāstāḥ pitṛkanyakāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ papracchurādarāt || 1 || asmākaṃ mahimā kānta kṛpayā vardhitastvayā | śrīmataśca mahimānaṃ jñāsyāmaśca yathā vayam || 2 || tava no vada sarvātman mokṣo’nte no yathā bhavet | ityukto bhavanāśādivihīno bhagavān prabhuḥ || 3 || āha tābhyaḥ svarūpasya jñānaṃ bhaktisahāyakṛt | jīvalokātpare santi īśvarāṇāṃ hi bhūmayaḥ || 4 || vāsudevādayastatra vasanti vyūhakoṭayaḥ | goloke’haṃ rādhayā sevitaḥ kṛṣṇo vasāmi ca || 5 || vaikuṇṭhe’haṃ śriyā yukto nārāyaṇo vasāmi vai | tatpare cākṣare dhāmni vartāmi puruṣottamaḥ || 6 || akṣarātītasaṃjño’haṃ dvibhujaḥ parameśvaraḥ | parataścākṣarāccāpi paro’smi paradhāmani || 7 || asaṃkhyamuktasevyo’haṃ brahmapriyāprasevitaḥ | mama romaikāṇudeśādutpannaṃ teja aiśvaram || 8 || sarveśvareṣu tad vyāptaṃ pūrṇamiva prajāyate | madekaguṇaleśena bhavantīśā guṇocchrayāḥ || 9 || mama saṃkalpamātreṇa cāvatārā bhavanti hi | sṛṣṭayaścāpyasaṃkhyātā matpuruṣecchayā khalu || 2.113.10 || jāyante’nantasaṃkhyākāstatrāntaryāmyahaṃ sthitaḥ | antarbahiśca bhūtānāṃ yathāsthānaṃ vasāmyaham || 11 || yathākāryaṃ yathāpekṣaṃ yathābhaktānusevanam | tathā bhūtvā nivasāmi bhaktavṛndeṣu matpriyāḥ || 1 2|| kvacid bhavāmi ceśeṣu kvacid deveṣu vā divi | ṛṣivaryeṣu bhakteṣu kvacinmānavajātiṣu || 13|| kvacijjale sthale’raṇye śaile pṛthvyāṃ ca gahvare | paśau pakṣiṇi yādassu vṛkṣe vallyāṃ tṛṇādiṣu || 14|| yathākāryaṃ bhavāmyeva naro nārī ca vetaraḥ | rājā prajāthavā dīnaḥ sādhuḥ sādhvī ca kāminī || 15|| gopālo vāpi gobālo gojālo gopikāpatiḥ | kalpe yuge dine lagne’vatāro me dhruvaṃ priyāḥ || 16|| idānīṃ bālakṛṣṇo’smi śrīkaṃbharāsatīsutaḥ | koṭyabjakanyakākāntaḥ kanyecchāpūraṇārthakaḥ || 17|| śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasyānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | puruṣottamasaṃjño’haṃ paramātmā hi mānavaḥ || 18|| bhavatīnāṃ prāpyarūpaḥ karuṇākṛtakaitavaḥ | saurāṣṭre kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre’śvapaṭṭaśobhite || 19|| lomaśāśramasāmīpye’kṣarakṣetre vasāmyaham | naranāṭyaṃ prakurvāṇo’meyo’pi mānatāṃ gataḥ ||2.113.20|| pūrvakalpīyakanyānāṃ tapaḥphalapradehayā | koṭikandarpasaundaryānavadhivīryavānaham ||21|| ṣaḍbhagairaṣṭasāmarthyairaṣṭasiddhibhiranvitaḥ | koṭyabjarūpasāmarthyāsaṃkhyabalaguṇāśrayaḥ ||22|| kanyānāṃ bhāvapūrtyarthaṃ sākṣājjāto’smi kāntakaḥ | bhavatīnāṃ patiścāhaṃ varte’dya tapaso balāt || 23|| mama sevā prakartavyā bhavatībhiḥ sukhāptaye | snehena mama sevaiva bhaktireva matā mayā || 24|| tayā cāhaṃ prasannaḥ syāṃ nānyopāyena kenacit | satī pativratā yadvat sevate svapatiṃ sadā ||25|| tādṛgananyabhāvena mumukṣurmā sadā bhajet | parānurāgarūpā sā kartavyā mayi sarvathā ||26 || śravaṇaṃ ca kathāyā me kartavyaṃ janmakarmaṇām | mama bhaktasya bhaktāyā mukhādvā mokṣadaṃ hi tat | ||27|| me’vatāracaritrāṇāṃ śravaṇaṃ ca mumukṣuṇā | tathaiva mama bhaktānāṃ camatkāraśravaḥ śubhaḥ ||28|| śrotavyāni caritrāṇāmākhyānāni mumukṣubhiḥ | evaṃ priyā mama kāryaṃ kīrtanaṃ matsatāmapi || 29|| janmakarmacaritrāṇāṃ kathāvārtāḥ satāṃ mukhāt | kāraṇīyāstathā yogye samaye śraddhayā muhuḥ || 2.113.3 0|| madbhaktānāṃ mama cāpi granthānāṃ paṭhanaṃ tathā | pāṭhanaṃ mama patnīnāṃ caritrāṇāṃ hi mokṣadam || 31 || chandasāṃ baddhapadyānāṃ gadyānāṃ mama sarvadā | saṃskṛtānāṃ prākṛtānāṃ granthānāṃ gāyanaṃ mudā || 32|| vīṇādivādyasanmiśraṃ tālikāsahitaṃ ca vā | gāladhvānaiścipīṭābhiḥ kartavyaṃ kīrtanaṃ mama ||3 3|| pādayornupūranaddhakikiṇīdhvānamiśritam | kaṭyāṃ nibaddhapaṭṭatya ghurghurādininādanaiḥ ||34|| sahitaṃ vā prakartavyaṃ nṛtyayuktaṃ sukīrtanam | me stutiḥ samprārthanā ca nāmnāṃ me kīrtanaṃ tathā || 36|| kāryaṃ padyairmama prītyā tathā vākyairmanoramaiḥ | atha me smaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ cintanaṃ hṛdayāmbuje || 36|| sāṃgopāṃgā mama mūrtiścintyā svahṛdaye priyāḥ | ekaikamaṃgaṃ saṃcintya keśāt pādanakhāvadhim || 37|| mūrtidhyāne mama hāsyaṃ cintanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ | mama nāmāni karmāṇi smaraṇīyāni sarvadā || 38|| camatkārāḥ smaraṇīyā madbhaktānāṃ mamāpi ca | guṇānāṃ ramaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ japtavyo me manustathā ||3 9|| paradhāmākṣaradhāmnorgolokasyāmṛtasya ca | vaikuṇṭhasyāvyākṛtasya śvetadvīpasya vai tathā ||2.113.40 || viśālākhyasya me dhāmnaḥ sāketanāmakasya me | nityakailāsanāmnaśca kṣīrodasya ca me tathā ||41 || śrīpuraṃ ca śriyāṃ me pārṣadānāṃ brahmayoṣitām | aiśvaryāṇāṃ ca siddhīnāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ ca me priyāḥ ||42|| smaraṇaṃ mama divyānāṃ sādhūnāṃ kāryamutsavāt | mama devālayānāṃ ca mama pitroḥ kuṭumbinām ||43|| gavāṃ me vāhanādīnāṃ mama veṣasya vai tathā | mamāyudhānāṃ matsambaddhavastūnāṃ smṛtiḥ sadā ||44|| kartavyā vai tayā muktiḥ syād divyā muktidā hi me | atha kāryaṃ caraṇayoḥ saṃvāhanaṃ mama priyāḥ ||45|| pratyakṣasya harerme’trānādikṛṣṇasya satpateḥ | mama mūrteḥ pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kāryaṃ tathā muhuḥ ||46|| tatra sthito’haṃ gṛhṇāmi sevāṃ saṃvāhanādikām | mama mūrtiḥ kāraṇīyā sarvāṃgā cihnaśobhanā ||47|| dhātavī dāravī vāpi pārthivī ca kiśorikā | tasyāḥ sevā naraiścāpi nārībhiḥ sarvathā sadā || 88|| kāraṇīyā snehapūrṇā kartavyā manasepsitā | mānasīṃ vā mama mūrtiṃ prakalpya dhyānanirmitām ||49|| tasyāścaraṇayoḥ sparśastadaṃgānāṃ samantataḥ | sparśo bhāvena kartavyo rantavyaṃ ca tayā saha ||2.113.50 || mānasaṃ sarvathā kāryaṃ sevanaṃ mama bhāvitam | bhojanīyaḥ pūjanīyau rañjanīyo viśeṣataḥ || 51 || hṛdayastho’pyahaṃ kṛṣṇo grahīṣye sevanaṃ tu vaḥ | dhṛtvā māṃ śayane nitya suptavyaṃ hi mayā saha ||52 || vyavahāre’pi māṃ cāgre kṛtvā kartavya eva saḥ | bhoktavyaṃ māṃ pradhāryaiva nānyathā tu kadācana ||53|| śarīre’haṃ sadā cāsmi tathendriyeṣu sarvathā | bhoktaryevaṃ prabhogyeṣu māṃ nidhāyācaret kriyāḥ || 54 || tatsarvaṃ nirguṇaṃ mokṣapradaṃ puṇyapradaṃ bhavet | gantavyaṃ māṃ puraskṛtya sthātavyaṃ mayi sarvathā ||55|| evaṃ me sevanaṃ kāryaṃ dehasaṃvāhanaṃ mama | sevayā me vāsudevānujā vyūhasvarūpiṇaḥ ||56 || yāvatsṛṣṭyudbhūtipuṣṭisaṃhṛtiśaktimāpnuvan | mama pādāṃguṣṭhapūtā gaṃgā punāti golakam || 57|| kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatrukuhṛdbhayādikam | mama pādāśrayavatāṃ tūrṇaṃ naśyati sevayā || 58|| rādhāramāprabhāpāravatīśrīmāṇikīpriyāḥ | dvādaśādhikaśatasaṃkhyāścānyā brahmayoṣitaḥ ||59|| pādau paricarantyanyāḥ koṭyarbudastriyaśca me | muktakoṭyo’pi yau pādau sadā paricaranti hi ||2.113.60|| devapriyā hyasaṃkhyāśca mama pādaprasevayā | gopyaścāsaṃkhyakāścāpi kīrtiṃ prāpurmamādhikām ||6 1|| yau pādau me stuvantyeva vyāsāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ | tau pādau saṃvāhanīyau sevyau me muktikāmukaiḥ ||62|| caraṇau ca yayā sevyau sevyau bhujau tathā mama | mastakaṃ me sadā sevyaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ saṃvāhanena ca ||63||| sevyaṃ meṃ’gaṃ tathopāṃgaṃ pratyaṃgaṃ bhāvataḥ priyāḥ | yasya kasyāpi meṃ’gasya sevanaṃ mokṣadaṃ mama || 64|| athārcanaṃ mama kāryaṃ sātvatībhiśca sāttvataiḥ | bāhyārcanaṃ ṣoḍaśabhistathā cāṣṭaśatairapi || 65 || upacāraiḥ prakartavyaṃ hṛdyaiḥ śreṣṭhairmanoramaiḥ | calāyāṃ me pratimāyāṃ māmāvāhya prapūjayet || 66 || snāpayed ghṛtadugdhādyairabhiṣiñcejjalaistathā | kārayecca tataḥ śreṣṭhavāsāṃsi susamarpayet || 67 || alaṃkārān vividhām̐śca yathāsthānaṃ pradhārayet | kāśmīrakesaropetacandanādyaṃgalepanam || 68 || yathartuṃ kuryāt snehena tilakaṃ bindugarbhakam | hārān sugandhinaścāpi śekharānavataṃsakān || 69|| mama dadyātpradīpaṃ sudhūpaṃ naivedyamuttamam | mahānīrājanaṃ kuryādgītavāditravādanaiḥ | |2.113.7 0 || pradakṣiṇāṃ stavanaṃ ca prārthanāṃ namanādikam | puṣpāṃjaliṃ pradadyācca pañcakālaṃ tu pūjanam || 71 || trikālaṃ vā dvikālaṃ vā prātareva tu vācaret | mama janmadineṣvatra kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ mahat |||72 || vrateṣvekādaśīnāṃ ca gītavāditrapūrvakam | bhojanīyāḥ sādhavaśca satyaśca pāraṇādine ||73 || dhanavantaḥ kārayeyurmandirāṇi dṛḍhāni me | pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayettatra dhanī me sumahotsavaiḥ || 74|| grāmaṃ kṣetraṃ dhanaṃ dadyād gṛhaṃ pūjādhanārthikām | vṛttiṃ prabandhayed ramyāṃ pūjāpravāhasiddhaye | | 79 || kūpaṃ ca vāpikāṃ puṣpavāṭikāṃ susarāṃsyapi | kuṇḍān kūpān kārayecca madarthaṃ ca satāṃ kṛte || 76|| vaiṣṇavān kārayecchreṣṭhān makhān vai bhūridakṣiṇān | mantrajapān prakuryācca stotrāṇāṃ pāṭhanādikam ||77|| puraścaryāṃ tathā kuryānmama nāmnāṃ punaḥ punaḥ | mantrāṇāṃ ca puraścaryāṃ granthānāmapi bhāvataḥ || 78 || pitaro devatāḥ pūjyāḥ ṛṣayo vṛddhadehinaḥ | evaṃ bāhyārcanaṃ proktaṃ mānasaṃ cāntaraṃ tu tat || 79|| aṣṭādhikaśataśreṣṭhopacārairmānasairhṛdi | pūjanaṃ me prakartavyaṃ premasāgarasaṃbhṛtā | | 2.113.80 || atha me vandanaṃ kāryaṃ sāṣṭāṃgaṃ vāṃgaṣaṣṭakam | padbhyāṃ karābhyāṃ jānubhyāmurasā śirasā dṛśā || 81 || vacasā manasā ceti daṇḍavat puruṣaiḥ sadā | padbhyāṃ karābhyāṃ manasā vacasā śirasā dṛśāḥ || 8 2|| nārībhiḥ sanniṣadyaiva praṇāmaḥ kārya eva me | matpādaspṛṣṭasaddhūlyāṃ kartavyaṃ pariluṇṭhanam ||83|| rajāṃsi varṣmaṇi śīrṣe nidhatavyāni tāni vai | madgātraspṛṣṭavāryādi madgātraspṛṣṭacandanam ||84|| raṃgasalilasaugandhyacūrṇādi dhāryamityapi | aho bhāgyaṃ mama śreṣṭhaṃ prāptaṃ cūrṇaṃ rajo mayā ||85|| bhagavatpādapadmairyat spṛṣṭaṃ cāho subhāgyavān | ityevaṃ vai vadan nityānande bhagno bhavejjanaḥ ||86|| atha dāsyaṃ sadā kāryaṃ yathā me lomaśo muniḥ | dāsabhāve sadā lakṣmīriva saṃvartate tathā ||87|| na mānaṃ tatra vai kāryaṃ sevane kṣatidhāyakam | sarvakāle yathāpekṣasevāyāṃ dāsavad bhavet ||88|| paricaryā sarvavidhā yogyāyogyāpi sarvathā | kartavyā mama dāsyeva bhṛtyeva yoṣitāpi ca ||89|| nareṇa vā sadā bhaktyā sevyo’haṃ parameśvaraḥ | mama snānopayogārthaṃ jalaṃ svayaṃ samāharet || 2.113.90 || kusumānyāhareccāpi mālāṃ prāgumphayet svayam | tulasīṃ candanaṃ cāpi gharṣayed dravameva ca ||91|| pākaṃ kuryāt svayaṃ bhakto bhojayet kavalaiśca mām | jalapānādikaṃ dadyācculukaṃ kārayedapi || 92|| tāmbūlakaṃ mukhavāsaṃ dadyānme svayameva tu | tālavṛntādibhirbhakto vejayenmāṃ yathocitam ||93 || sammārjanaṃ mandirasya mama kuryād vilepanam | jīrṇoddhāraṃ prakurvīta nūtanaṃ mandirādikam ||94|| bhaktānāmannatoyādyaiḥ phalādyaiḥ sevanaṃ śubham | mānaṃ hitvā prakurvīta praṇamettān hi bhāvataḥ ||95|| dehastrīputravittāderdāsye’rpaṇaṃ vidhāpayet | ityevaṃ vartamānasya mama sāmyaṃ dadāmyaham ||96|| atha sakhyaṃ vidhātavyaṃ sarvaṃ prakāśavanmayi | ācaritavyemevātra paratra sa samo mama || 97|| dehastrīpatiputrādeḥ snehaḥ kāryo’dhiko mayi | mānuṣyanāṭyaṃ dadhato me kriyāsu na doṣadhīḥ ||98|| karturakarturanyathākarturme karmasu kvacit | saṃśayo nahi kartavyo bhaktādhīnasya me priyāḥ ||99|| kāmān krodhāttathā lobhānmohāt svārthāt sukhecchayā | ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃstathaiva bhajāmyaham || 2.113.10 0|| na tatra saṃśayaḥ kāryaḥ sakhyaṃ maitryamidaṃ mayi | yatkaromi tu bhaktārthaṃ bhaktakalyāṇahetave || 10 1|| lokā naitad vijānanti gahanāṃ tāṃ gatiṃ mama | tasmāt kāryo hi viśvāso mama kriyāsu sarvathā || 1 02|| atha kāryaṃ samastaṃ vai mayi tvātmanivedanam | nareṇa yoṣitā vāpi deho’rpyo mayi sarvathā || 10 3||| tathendriyāṇi cārpyāni tathāntaḥkaraṇānyapi | svabhāvāśca mayi cārpyāḥ kuṭumbaṃ cāpi vai mayi || 1 04|| samarpaṇīyaṃ bhaktena tadadhīno bhavenna vai | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī bhavāmyaham || 1 05|| mamādhīno bhavennityaṃ madarthaṃ sakalakriyaḥ | madarthasarvavyāpāro bhaved bhakto mama priyaḥ || 106 || evaṃ priyābhiryuṣmābhirvartitavyaṃ sadā mayi | kānto’haṃ bhavatīnāṃ ca dāsye vai śāśvataṃ sukham || 1 07|| evamāha svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ | rādhike bahudhā bhaktisvarūpāṇi viśeṣataḥ || 1 08|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhoḥ sarvathā prasannatāpādakavividhabhaktisvarūpavivecanāmā trayodaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 113 ||
<2.114> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca evaṃ viśeṣataḥ prāha śrīpatiḥ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ | adhikaṃ cāpi yatprāha śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike hi tat || 1 || mama bhaktau vighnakṛtān svajanānapi saṃtyajet | netrābhyāṃ darśanaṃ kuryānme’ṅgopāṅgātmavarṣmaṇaḥ || 2 || śrutibhyāṃ matkathāṃ nityaṃ śṛṇuyānmama karmaṇām | tvacā sparśaṃ mama kuryāt sarvāṃgānāṃ samastataḥ || 3 || me guṇoccāraṇaṃ kuryājjihvayā mantrajāpanam | mukhena me prasādasyāśanaṃ kuryājjalaṃ pibet || 4 || nāsayā me prasādaṃ ca patraṃ tulasīsaṃbhavam | puṣpaṃ gandhaṃ ca gṛhṇīyāccandanaṃ me samarpitam || 5 || karābhyāṃ mama dehasya kuryāt saṃvāhanaṃ śubham | śīrṣṇā kuryād vandanaṃ me padbhyāṃ pradakṣiṇāṃ tathā || 6 || manasā mama saṃkalpaṃ dhiyā me niścayaṃ param | cetasā cintanaṃ me ca kāntasyaiva vidhāpayet || 7 || mama dāsatvābhimānaṃ svasmin kuryātsadāhamā | madarthameva kuryādvai kṛṣivyāpārasatkriyāḥ || 8 || udyamaṃ ca madarthaṃ vai prakuryāt pitṛkanyakāḥ | yadyat sveṣṭaṃ bhaved vastu tattanme tvarpayet sadā || 9 || gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ cāmbaraṃ śrāṃgārikaṃ tathā | matprasādaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā dhārayettu tataḥ param | | 2.114.10 || patraṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ vāpi mahyaṃ yatsyānna cārpitam | tanna bhakṣyaṃ na vā peyaṃ na dhāryaṃ hīrakādyapi || 11 || tapaḥ kuryāt kratuṃ kuryād dānaṃ kuryājjapaṃ tathā | mama prasannatārthaṃ vai sarvaṃ kuryāt parārthakam || 1 2|| sāttvatāṃ sevanaṃ cāpi sādhvīnāṃ sevanaṃ tathā | kartavyaṃ mama bhaktairvai prasannatāyai me’naghāḥ || 13 || bhakte sādhau tathā sādhvyāṃ sthito vai sarvadāsmyaham | tadaṃgeṣu mamāṅgāni sarvendriyāṇi me sadā | | 14|| vasantyeva na sandehastasmāt sevyāstu te’nvaham | sakāmaiḥ sādhavaḥ sevyāḥ kalpavṛkṣā hi me matāḥ | | 15 || kāmanāpūrakāḥ santi sādhavaḥ svargamokṣadāḥ | sādhvyo me kalpavallyaśca sevyāḥ sakāmayā striyā || 16 || tābhyo manorathāḥ sarve siddhyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ | teṣāṃ tāsāṃ sadāśīrbhiḥ phalantyeva manorathāḥ | | 1 7 || dharmārthakāmamokṣākhyāḥ puruṣārthāḥ phalanti ca | teṣu tāsu vasāmyeva svayaṃ nārāyaṇottamaḥ | | 18 || yathāyathaṃ ca bhaktānāṃ pūrayāmi manorathān | dehānte śāśvataṃ sthānaṃ mahānandaṃ dadāmi ca | | 1 9|| labhante ceṣṭasaukhyāni tatra te cākṣayāṇi hi | sālokyaṃ sārṣṭi sāmīpyaṃ sārūpyaṃ ca tadātmatām | | 2.114.20 || dadāmyetebhya evāhaṃ yathā tuṣṭo hi sevanaiḥ | anye śreṣṭhā mahābhāgavatā bhaktāśca me parāḥ | | 21 || mama sevāṃ vinā nānyadicchanti siddhivaibhavān | na ca muktiṃ caturdhāṃ vā te samicchanti karhicit | | 22|| mayā dattaṃ dīyamānaṃ tvaiśvaryaṃ corjitaṃ param | naiva vāñchanti te bhaktā yathā lakṣmīrna te tathā | | 23 | | antarāyakaratvādvai santi vighnāni siddhayaḥ | aiśvaryāṇyapi vighnāni gṛhṇanti na hṛdāpi te | | 24|| mamānandenasampūrṇaṃ hṛd ātmakuṭikā śubhā | manmūrttyānandasaṃvyāptā bhavatyasya priyāḥ khalu | | 25|| evaṃ niṣkāmabhāvena māṃ bhajeram̐śca ye janāḥ | bhaktottamāste proktā me matpūrṇahṛdayā yataḥ || 26 || evaṃ māṃ bhajamānasya sevamānasya nityadā | sneho vivardhate bhūyān yatra vighno na jāyate || 27|| brahmaputryā yathā hyāpo bhittvā himagirīn bahūn | āyāntyāsāmadeśām̐śca viśanti sundarābdhikam || 28 || tathā premā hi bhaktānāṃ vighnān vibhidya deśajān | kālajān saṃgajām̐ścānyān viśatyanantake mayi ||29||| āntarāṇāṃ ca bāhyānāṃ tattvānāṃ vṛttayo’khilāḥ | svabhāvāścāpi saṃskārā mayyeṣāṃ viśramanti vai ||2.114.3 0|| pratyakṣe mayi samprāpte sannidhāvapyupasthite | svasamāne mānavākhye sajātīyādivartane || 31 || prāptasnehabharā bhaktā matsukhābdhau sukhaṃ gatāḥ | anyatra nānuraktāḥ syurmāṃ vihāya kvaciddhi te ||32|| vastudvayaṃ janaiḥ prāptaṃ viviktaṃ ca dvidhā hi tat | ramaṇīyaṃ svānukūlaṃ sukhadaṃ prathamaṃ matam || 33|| dvitīyaṃ nānukūlaṃ cāramaṇīyaṃ ca duḥkhadam | tattu tyājyaṃ svabhāvāddhi sarveṣāṃ tatra kā kathā ||34|| prathamaṃ tu sadā ceṣṭaṃ sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ khalu | tadāpyeṣā mahadduḥkhapradaṃ bhāti vivekinām || 35|| dehanirvāhamātraṃ vai grāhyaṃ prasahya yoginām | viśeṣaṃ tu tadapyeṣāṃ duḥkhadaṃ bhāti buddhitaḥ ||36|| ramyatvaṃ ramaṇīyeṣu naiṣā bhavati karhicit | ramyatvaṃ cāsti yatrāhaṃ tatraivaiṣāṃ mahātmanām ||37|| madvinā candanaṃ ramyaṃ śītalaṃ gandhasaṃbhṛtam | spṛṣṭaṃ viṣāyate śīghraṃ madyuktaṃ cāmṛtāyate ||38|| madvinā puṣpamālāśca svarṇahārādayastathā | pāśāyante gale kṣiptā madyuktāstu vadhūkarāḥ ||3 9|| bhūṣaṇaṃ madvihīnaṃ ca svarṇamauktikahīrakam | dhṛtaṃ godhāsamaṃ syādvai madyuktaṃ candravatsukham ||2.114.40|| sundarī puṣpaśayyā madvihīnā ramaṇīyutā | vahnidhautāmbaraklṛptā śreṣṭhāpi rauravāyate ||41 || cāndrakāntiḥ śāradī ca madvihīnā sudhāsravā | viṣātapāyate dugdhāyate sā tu mayā yutā ||42|| prāsādaścendravāsārho madvihīno guhāyate | janāvāso madvihīno bhūtāraṇyāyate tathā ||43 || sugandhiśītalo vāyurmadvihīno’nalāyate | śreṣṭhavastraṃ madvihīnaṃ śūlayukkharjanāyate ||44|| sambandhino madvihīnā vṛkāyante’sya sarvathā | rūpaṃ kuṣṭhāyate saumyaṃ madvihīnaṃ manoharam ||45|| svādu bhojyaṃ tu macchūnyaṃ bhaktasya tu viṣāyate | svādu pānaṃ mayā hīnaṃ vāntāyate’mṛtaṃ tvapi ||46 || gatirmādhuryapūrṇāpi mayā hīnā śarāyate | mayā hīnā satī nārī devyapi pradavāyate ||47|| sukhaṃ duḥkhāyate sarvaṃ śāntaṃ krūrāyate tathā | miṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ mayā hīnaṃ bhaktasya kaṭukāyate ||48|| utsavo madvihīnastu bhagnotsādvāyate sadā | ānando’pi mayā hīno tiktamarcāyate tathā ||49|| prasaṃgo’pi śubhaḥ sarvo māṃ vinā maraṇāyate | śubhaṃ sarvaṃ vinā māṃ tu bhaktasyaivāśubhāyate ||2.114.50|| evaṃ bhaktasya vijñeyaḥ sneho mayyatyasīmakaḥ | ahameva sphurāmyeko bhaktasyāntaśca vai bahiḥ ||51 || dṛṣṭo’hameva bhaktena sahasā tvāntare yadā | tadā vilokya māṃ bhaktaḥ premṇā vai hasati kvacit ||52|| kvacinmāṃ dūramālokya gacchantamiva roditi | kvaciccānandalābhena nṛtyaṃ karoti gāyati ||53|| kvacit saṃbhāṣate divyamūrtinā sa mayā saha | kvacit karoti sāṣṭāṃgaṃ kvacidāliṅgatīti mām ||54|| kvacit pracumbati māṃ ca kvacit svapiti cādarāt | kvacidutthāya sahasā jalaṃ dadāti me tadā ||55|| snānabhojanabhūṣādi kkacit kvacid dadāti me | kvaciddhyānaparo bhūtvā ramate cāntare mayi ||56|| kvacinmaunaṃ samālambya samāhvayati māṃ hṛdi | kvacit snehāt samākṛṣya māṃ nayatyeva nirjane ||57|| kvacid dāsī svayaṃ bhūtvā dāsyaṃ karoti me tadā | kvacit maitryaṃ kvacicchraiṣṭhyaṃ kvacit karoti sāmyakam ||58|| kvacinmatvāparādhaṃ svaṃ kṣamasveti vadatyapi | kvacit prārthayate vastu kvacit paravaśo bhavet ||59|| anargalaḥ kvacidbhūtvā nāmānyeva gṛṇāti ca | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipatiprabho ||2.114.6 0|| parabrahma parātmanme nātha kānta hare vibho | nārāyaṇa mahāviṣṇo kṛṣṇa śrīmannarāyaṇa ||6 1 || parameśa dayāsindho kvāsse vadātra māṃ prati | evamāhūya ca māṃ sa sevate’pi yatheṣṭakam ||62|| nātra loke bhavettasya trapā sevanavighnikā | tādṛśo mama bhakto yo bhaktā dāsī ca vā mama ||63 || punāti bhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ pāravāribhiḥ | tasya vai pādarajasā prajvalanti durītikāḥ ||64|| tasya sandarśanāllokāḥ pūtā bhavanti vai drutam | etādṛśasya bhaktasyāśrayeṇa muktiruttamā ||65|| sevanena bhavet sevā mamaivātra na saṃśayaḥ | tasya me nahi bhedo’sti tanuḥ so’sti mamaiva saḥ ||66|| tadindriyāṇi me santīndriyāṇi nātra saṃśayaḥ| paśyāmi tasya netrābhyāṃ spṛśāmi tasya vai tvacā ||67|| śṛṇomi tasya karṇābhyāṃ rasayāmi ca jihvayā | vadāmi tasya vai vācā jighrāmi ghrāṇayoginā ||68|| mama ghrāṇena tatraiva vividhān gandhagauravān | bhruvā ciceṣṭe tasyaiva gṛhṇāmi tatkareṇa ca ||6 9|| gacchāmi tatpadābhyāṃ ca devakṣetreṣu sarvadā | ānandayāmi tasyaivendriyeṇa kāmavṛttinā ||2.114.70|| kaccaraṃ cotsṛjāmyeva tadindriyeṇa pāyunā | cintayāmi tu tasyaiva cetasā mama cetasā ||7 1 || mananaṃ ca tayā kurve manasā tasya vai sadā | ahaṃbhāvaṃ ca sarvatra karomyahaṃ hi taddhṛdā ||72|| nirṇayaṃ tasya buddhyaiva karomyahaṃ sadā priyāḥ | śabdaṃ sparśaṃ rasaṃ rūpaṃ gandhaṃ cānandamityapi ||73 || gṛhṇāmyahaṃ sthitastasmin kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ | evaṃ tasya kriyāḥ sarvā divyā mama kriyārhi tāḥ ||74|| mokṣarūpā bhaktibhāvā māyikā nahi vai hitāḥ | tasya sevā prakartavyā tayā vindāmi tarpaṇam ||75|| tasyārpaṇena me syādvai sarvārpaṇaṃ hi dehinām | pratyakṣo’haṃ tathā cāsmi mama sādhusvarūpavān ||76|| parokṣo’haṃ tathā cāsmi mama sādhuviyogavān | pratyakṣāḥ sādhavo me vai santi divyāstu mūrtayaḥ ||77|| teṣāṃ bhagavatāṃ kāryā sevā sarvakriyādibhiḥ | na tatra saṃśayaḥ kāryo mama mūrtyātmakā hi te ||78|| na tathā brāhmaṇāḥ śreṣṭhā munayo na maharṣayaḥ | na cācāryā na guravo yathā me sādhavo varāḥ ||79|| varṇeṣu brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭho brāhmaṇeṣu ca sāttvatāḥ | sāttvateṣu mama bhaktāścātmanivedinaḥ parāḥ ||2.114.80|| ātmanivediṣu śreṣṭhā dīkṣāvanto hi sādhavaḥ | sādhubhyaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ evāhaṃ nānyo mattaḥ paraḥ samaḥ ||8 1 || sādhavo me samāḥ śreṣṭhā japāmyetān sadā hyaham | karomi darśanaṃ nityaṃ sādhūnāṃ mayi vāsinām ||82 || mayyarpitasamastānāṃ mokṣadānā madātmanām | karomi smaraṇaṃ teṣāṃ dāsyaṃ sakhyaṃ mahātmanām ||83 || kīrtanaṃ vandanaṃ teṣāṃ sādhūnāṃ ca karomyaham | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kurve sādhūnāmahamātmanām ||84|| arcane tvātmano me ca karomyapi nivedanam | sādhuto na priyaṃ me’sti mama tattvasya cintanāt ||85|| parameśvarasaṃjñāste mama nāmnā hi mokṣadāḥ | nārāyaṇāśca te proktāḥ sādhavo mama vai priyāḥ ||86|| tanmukhairbhojanaṃ kurve tṛpto bhavāmi teṣu ca | na devā na ca gandharvāścāraṇā guhyakādayaḥ ||87|| pitaro munayo viprā nādhikāḥ sādhuto hi me | īśvarā lokapālādyāḥ sādhuto nādhikā hi me ||88|| muktā muktiṃ gatāścāpi sādhuto nādhikā hi me | kā kathā vā svayaṃ lakṣmīḥ rādhikā kamalādikāḥ ||89|| śrīrlīlā bhūrvibhūtiśca pārvatī cāpi māṇikī | prabhādyā me sādhuto nādhikā anyasya kā kathā ||2.114.90|| evaṃvidhayā bhaktyā māṃ bhajadhvaṃ pitṛkanyakāḥ | uddhariṣyāmi sarvā vaḥ pāvayadhvaṃ ca dehinaḥ ||9 1 || ipyuktvā ca tatastābhyo rādhike śrīnarāyaṇaḥ | dadau tāsāṃ hṛdayeṣu caraṇau mūrtimityapi ||92|| snātvā bhuktvā bhojayitvā dadāvājñāṃ svayaṃ hariḥ | svasvasthāneṣu gantuṃ vai tīrtheṣu pāvaneṣu ca ||93 || mayoktayā sadā rītyā bhajadhvaṃ māṃ patiṃ prabhum | anāyāsena bhaktānāṃ bhaktiṃ kārayatāpi ca ||94|| ante vinā prayatnena nirodhaṃ prāpya vai mayi | yāsyanti tādṛśā bhaktā bhavatyaścāpi matpadam || 95|| divyā brahmatanuṃ prāpya madicchayā mamālaye | mayā saha prayāsyanti bhavatyo bhaktiyugjanāḥ ||96|| mayā dattāni sarvāṇi śāśvatāni parāṇi ca | anantānyakṣarāṇyeva divyasaukhyāni sarvadā ||97|| prāpsyanti mama sevāṃ ca bhavatyo bhaktisaṃbhṛtāḥ | ye janāśca tathā bhaktiṃ kariṣyanti striyo’pi yāḥ ||98|| te ca tāśca prayāsyanti mama muktipadaṃ param | yāntyevaṃ māṃ vidantvevaṃ sevantāṃ māṃ tathā priyam ||99|| mama mantraṃ pradāyaiva mokṣayantu hi dehinaḥ | gacchāmyahaṃ mama kṣetraṃ śāśvatīṃ kuṃkumasthalīm || 2.114.10 0|| ityuktvā pitṛtanayābhyaśca nadībhya ityapi | ṛṣīn devān brahmapriyāstato maunaṃ sthitaḥ kṣaṇam || 101 || ātmanyacintayat kiñcid vaktuṃ śrīśaṃkarāya saḥ | ājñāṃ pālayituṃ sajjā narā nāryo’vatasthire || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pitṛkanyātmakanadībhyo bhagavatā svātmātmakasādhujanādibhaktisvarūpapradarśanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturdaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 114 ||
<2.115> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike caivamājñāpya saritātmikāḥ | svasvapradeśān gantuṃ ca tataḥ śrīśaṃkaraṃ hariḥ || 1 || prāha yogin tava bhaktā ime yoddhāra eva ye | tebhyo rājyaṃ pradātavyaṃ tadyogyaṃ pārvataṃ śubham || 2 || kailāsasannidhau cātra parvate tu himālaye | bhūtānāṃ parvatāḥ santu tvāsāmasyordhvabhūmiṣu || 2 || pārvatīyaṃ mahārājyaṃ bhūtāsanaṃ tadastu vai | ityuktvā śaṃbhave kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo dadau śubham || 4 || mukuṭaṃ bhūtanātheti nāmnā rājyaṃ dadau tadā | bhūtanāthasvarūpega bhagavān bhairavātmakaḥ || 5 | | svasvarūpāya bhūtānāmadhipāya mahātmane | bhairavāya dadau tatra mukuṭaṃ śaṃkaro’pi ca || 6 || bhairavo rājyamāsādya natvā nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | haraṃ svapitaraṃ natvā gṛhītvā bhūtamaṇḍalam || 7 || ṣaṣṭilakṣādhikaṃ śailaṃ himālayaṃ yayau drutam | bhūtānāmālayāstena parvatā vai kṛtāstadā || 8 || evaṃ tasmai pradatvaiva rājyaṃ śrībhagavān prabhuḥ | brahmāṇaṃ prāha tatraiva bhavān cerāvatībhuvam || 9 || brahmadeśamitikhyātāṃ śāstu rakṣatu sarvadā | śaṃkaro yātu piṃgāyāṃ bhūmau prācīnarājyake || 2.115.10 || viṣṇuryātu śyāmarājyaṃ bhavannāmnā prasiddhimat | evamājñāpya tāndevān visarjayitvā cāpagāḥ || 11 || ṛṣīn tattatpradeśīyān ājñāpya gantumityatha | svasvasthānāni nityāni copadeṣṭuṃ prajā api || 12|| sarvavidhān devasaṃghān jātān yoddhṝn haristataḥ | prāha me sāmavedākhye deśe vasantu te’nugāḥ || 13 || ye’vaśiṣṭā bhavantyatra brahmaputryāstu pūrvagāḥ | kāmarūpapradeśeṣu patatkāyāvadhiṃ drutam || 14|| dakṣiṇe tu pradeśe’tra yāvadvai lukaśāyinam | nagnā ye parvatāścāpi lukahītānadīṃ prati || 11 || tanmadhye sāmadeśam ā abhivyāpya vasantviti | sarvayoddhṛgaṇānevaṃ vāsayitvā hariḥ svayam | | 16 || āsāmānāṃ nṛpaṃ tatra śivaliṃgaṃ cakāra ha | śivaliṃgākhyakagaṇo nītvā sarvān bhaṭām̐stataḥ | | 17| | āsāmīyapradeśe saṃvāsaṃ cakre samantataḥ | śivaliṃgodbhavāṃ devīṃ śivāṃ kāmasvarūpiṇīm || 18|| kāmarūpīyakāmākṣīṃ saha nītvā yayau gaṇaḥ | parvate tanmandiraṃ ca śubhamucchritamālayam || 19|| kṛtvā saṃsthāpayāmāsa kāmarūpāṃ satīṃ gaṇaḥ | mātaraṃ tāṃ sadā matvā pūjayāmāsa sādaram ||2.115.20|| svanāmnā nagaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sthāpayāmāsa cocchraye | evaṃ nārāyaṇo datvā śivaliṃgāya rājyakam || 21 || bhaṭān sarvān vyavasthāpya devān visṛjya vai munīn | tato vimāne saṃgṛhya koṭikanyāḥ prajārpitāḥ |||22 || daśasāhasrakanyāśca sevikā viṃśatiśritāḥ | viṃśatipitṛkanyāśca tathā brahmapriyāḥ parāḥ ||23 || saṃgṛhya śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī salomaśaḥ | mātāpitṛyuta āyād vyomnā kāśīṃ śriyāḥ sthalīm ||24|| śivarājagṛhe yatra nijalakṣmīrhi kanyakā | rājate sapratīkṣā vai prati śrīpuruṣottamam |||25|| tatrodyāne varaṇāyāstaṭe nijaṃ vimānakam | avatārya bhuvi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yayau gṛham ||26|| śivarājaṃ haraṃ natvā śvaśuraṃ pārvatīṃ tathā | bhaktaṃ jayaṃ ca candraṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ dhenupamityapi ||27|| ekānte svasatīṃ lakṣmīṃ militvā svapriyāṃ tataḥ | tāṃ vimāne sarvakanyāśleṣaṃ tāsāṃ ca darśanam |||28|| kārayitvā tathā pitrorlomaśasyāpi darśanam | āśvāsya ca punastasyāḥ pitṛgehe niveśyatām |||29|| āśīrdatvā vimānena bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ | āyayau kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ cākṣarasaṃjñakam ||2.115.30|| phālgunasyāsite pakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ hariḥ svayam | āyayau kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ sāyaṃ paraḥ prabhuḥ || 31 || māsānte tvāgataṃ vīkṣya bhrātṛsambandhisajjanāḥ | rudro devāśca tīrthāni aśvapaṭṭasaraḥ svayam ||32|| ṛṣaryo’śāvatārāśca tathā bhaktāśca koṭiśaḥ | āyayuḥ sannidhau dṛṣṭvā tejo vilakṣaṇaṃ tu khe ||33 || dṛṣṭvā divyaṃ vimānaṃ vai śrīnārāyaṇaśobhitam | koṭisūryaprabhaṃ ramyaṃ candrakāntisuśītalam ||34|| koṭikanyāyutakanyāviṃśatikanyakānvitam | jayaśabdān pracakruste’kṣarakṣetranivāsinaḥ ||35|| lājābhiścākṣataiścaiva kāśmīraiḥ kuṃkumaistathā | vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ vimānaṃ pārameśvaram ||36 || avātatāra ca tadā paścime’śvasarovarāt | udyāne’nādikṛṣṇasya prāsādasannidhau tataḥ ||37|| avaterurvimānācchrīsvāmī nārāyaṇo hariḥ | brahmapriyāḥ pitṛkanyāḥ prajākanyāśca sevikāḥ ||38|| lomaśaśca tathā cānye maharṣayastathā pitā | mātā ramādikāḥ satyo viviśuśca nijālayam ||39|| viśaśrāma harirmātā pitā kṣaṇaṃ ca lomaśaḥ | kanyakāstā hareḥ saudhaṃ parātparamalokayan ||2.115.40|| akṣarasthātisaundaryasampadvyāptaṃ mahālayam | divyasmṛddhiyutaṃ koṭisāmarthyaiśvaryarājitam ||41 || sāptabhaumaṃ puttalaiśceśvarāṇāṃ maṇḍitaṃ śubham | brahmahradena ca brahmasarasā cābhiśobhitam ||42|| divyaṃ divyaguṇopetaṃ divyayantrādirājitam | dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ paraṃ prāptāstāḥ sarvāḥ kanyakāstataḥ ||43|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāṃ bhaginīṃ tadā | santoṣāṃ prāha caitābhyo bhojanaṃ dīyatāṃ svasaḥ ||44|| bhrātṛjāyāṃ tathā devīṃ tvamṛtāṃ prāha mādhavaḥ | etābhyo dīyatāṃ peyaṃ mukhavāsādikaṃ śubham ||45|| ityukte sahasā te dve kalpacintāmaṇiprajam | bhojanaṃ śatarūpaṃ ca peyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tathā ||46|| dadaturbahusatkāraṃ cakratuḥ kṛṣṇayoṣitām | samāślikṣam̐śca tāḥ sarvāḥ svasāraṃ bhrātṛyoṣitam ||47|| tathānyāḥ kanyakāścāpi ṛṣipatnīśca yoṣitaḥ | atha kṛṣṇārpitayā sudivyayā dṛṣṭidhārayā |||48|| tāḥ sarvā lokayāmāsurdivyāstāḥ kanyakāstadā | vallyātmikāstathā pakṣimṛgyādirūpadhārikāḥ ||49|| kṛṣṇakāntā bahurūpā vilokyāścaryamāvahan | paścācchrīlomaśaṃ prāha bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ||2.115.50 || etā neyā bhavataiva guro śubhanijāśrame | brahmapriyādibhiḥ sārdhe rakṣaṇīyāḥ prayatnataḥ ||51|| lomaśaśca pūjito bhojito’bhivanditastathā | kanyā nītvājñayā naijāśramaṃ vai sa tadā yayau ||52|| bhagavām̐śca viśaśrāma pitarau yayatuḥ sukham | atha vai rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ||53|| phālgune pracakāraiva puṣpadolamahotsavam | kārayitvā divyaraṃgān vicitrān vārimiśritān ||54|| hemantabhagavadbhyāṃ pārṣadābhyāṃ cānyapārṣadaiḥ | sāmagrīḥ klṛptayitvātha samārabhata khelanam |||55|| kṣepakairyantravaryaiśca sauvarṇaiḥ śrīvasantakam | pūjayitvā nijamūrtiṃ tathā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam |||56|| akṣaraṃ ca tathā muktān tathā ca sāṃkhyayoginīḥ | svayaṃ dhṛtvā kare yantraṃ sauvarṇaṃ raṃgasaṃbhṛtam ||57|| cikṣepa raṃgaṃ maryādāsthitāsu janatāsu vai | nijāsaṃkhyāsu kāntāsu bhaktabhaktāsu vai muhuḥ ||58|| bhakteṣu sāttvateṣvevaṃ maharṣiṣu janeṣu ca | gopīṣu gopabhakteṣu cikṣepa raṃgamuttamam ||59|| pracikṣepa gulālaṃ ca raktavarṇānakārayat | sarvānnijāśritām̐ścāpi svayaṃ rakto’bhavattathā ||2.115.60|| raktaṃ vyomābhavaccāpi piśaṃgaṃ kaisaraṃ tathā | aśvapaṭṭasarasaśca jalaṃ raṃgavimiśritam ||61 || citrabhāvaṃ gataṃ yadvad vyomnīndradhanuṣā samam | bhūtalaṃ cākṣaraṃ kṣetraṃ citraraṃgamayaṃ hyabhūt ||62|| mṛttikā kuṃkumavāpīkṣetrīyā candanākṛtim | prāptā piśaṃgarūpaṃ sā raṃgavārisumiśritā ||63 || athaivaṃ puṣpadolasya khelanaṃ saṃvidhāya saḥ | sasnau haristu sarvābhiḥ prajābhiḥ saha cāśvake ||64|| tato vaneṣu vṛkṣeṣu nūtnāmbaradharā janāḥ | yayuḥ sugandhavāyvābhivyāptodyāneṣu cābhitaḥ ||65|| tatra puṣpamayī dolā preṃkhāṃ śākhāsu śākhinām | bhinnāṃ bhinnāṃ vicitrāṃ ca bandhayitvā samantataḥ ||66|| phalapuṣpādibhistatra kṛtvā śobhāmanuttamām | nūtnabeṣadharāḥ sarvāḥ kanyakā bhagavām̐stathā ||67|| prajājanāśca vai sarve puṣpadolamahotsave | āndolanaṃ śubhaṃ cakrurjahṛṣuścāpi nirbharam ||68|| sakhyaḥ parasparaṃ sarvāścāndolayanti kanyakāḥ | brahmapriyā nijaṃ kāntaṃ cāndolayanti bhāvataḥ ||69|| kīrtayanti vividhāni camatkārāṇi kīrtanaiḥ | nṛtyanti ca tadā kāściddharerāndolanāntike ||2.115.70|| vādayanti suvādyāni cāparāḥ kṛṣṇasannidhau | tathānyā hāsayantyeva kṛṣṇaṃ narmavacoyutāḥ ||71|| aparāśca dadustasmai kāntāya śītalaṃ jalam | itarāśca dadustasmai pakvaphalāni yoṣitaḥ ||72|| bahvyaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nijaṃ kāntaṃ kṛtvā svāndolane tataḥ | padbhyāṃ sahaiva dolāṃ svāmāndolayati vai muhuḥ ||73|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī patīśvaraḥ | jñātvā sarvamanāṃsyatrāsaṃkhyarūpo’bhavattadā ||74|| pratikanyaṃ pratināripratibhaktaṃ pratidrumam | kiśoraścābhavad ramyaḥ koṭikāmamadāpahaḥ ||75|| sarvāsāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ brahmayoṣitām | sevāṃ saṃgṛhya bhagavān punaścaikavidho’bhavat ||76|| evaṃ caitre kṛṣṇapakṣe dine tu prathame hariḥ | puṣpadolotsavaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ cakārākṣarakṣetrake ||77|| tato gehaṃ jagāmātha bhojayāmāsa vai punaḥ | sāyaṃ samutsavaṃ cakre gītanartanavādanaiḥ ||78|| tataḥ suptiṃ yayuḥ sarve viśrāntiṃ prāpurañjasā | athaivaṃ vartamānasya śrāvaṇastu samāgataḥ ||79|| bhaktaiḥ saṃklṛpya dolāśca vividhāḥ svarṇarājataiḥ | anekabhūṣāśobhāḍhyāḥ puṣpahārālirājitāḥ ||2.115.80|| divyahīrakamaṇyādyaiḥ khacitāśca sugandhitāḥ | divyakomalaśayyābhirvirājitāḥ śubhāsanaiḥ ||8 1 || tatra nārāyaṇasvāmikṛṣṇakāntaṃ niṣādya tu | brahmapriyāśca tā āndolayāmāsuḥ svamīśvaram ||82|| athāścaryamabhūttatra meghā vai mānuṣāstadā | bhūtvā vyomno hariṃ tvāndolanārthaṃ tatra cāyayuḥ ||83|| preṃkhāṃ ca nūtanāṃ vidyutprabhāṃ divyāṃ nirāśrayām | vyomāśrayāṃ dadustasmai śrīkṛṣṇāya parātmane ||84|| yatraikaikāṃgake tatra muktā gopyaśca pārṣadāḥ | avatārāśca dhāmāni dṛśyante īśvarāstathā ||85|| ṛṣayo munayo devāḥ pitaro mānuṣā api | samudrāḥ parvatāścāpi grahā nakṣatramaṇḍalam ||86|| dikpālā lokapālāśca tathā pātālavāsinaḥ | kṣīrodaḥ śvetadhāmāpi viśālākṣaravāsinaḥ ||87|| avyākṛtaṃ tathā tatrāmṛtaṃ dhāmāpi dṛśyate | golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ sāketaṃ ca kilāsakam ||88|| tathā caturmukho brahmā brahmā cāṣṭamukhastathā | tathājaḥ ṣoḍaśamukho dvātriṃśadānanastathā ||89|| pañcāśadānanaścāpi śatānano’pi dṛśyate | sahasrānana evāpi lakṣānano’pi dṛśyate ||2.115.90|| koṭyānanastathā brahmā dṛśyate maṇimaṇḍale | tādṛśī divyadolā vai meghairdattā tu śārṅgiṇe ||91|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagrāha tāṃ tadā | āruhyāndolanaṃ cakre meghān papraccha vai tadā ||92|| kasmādiyaṃ samānītā sarvabrahmāṇḍadarśikā | divyā preṃkhā śubhā yogyā mama sarveśituḥ kṛte ||93|| meghāḥ prāhurmahārāja vayaṃ kāśyāṃ samāgatāḥ | āṣāḍhe tīrthayātrārthaṃ varaṇāyāstaṭe tadā ||94|| dṛṣṭā mahālaye ramye śivarājasya kanyakā | vayaṃ tatra mitho vārtāmakaravāma śobhanām ||95|| snānaṃ ca darśanaṃ cātra kṛtvā gantavyameva tu | aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthaṃ lomaśasyāśramaṃ śubham ||96|| akṣarākhyaṃ śubhaṃ kṣetraṃ mokṣadaṃ śāśvataṃ param | yatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī paraḥ pumān ||97|| sarvāvatāradhartā yaḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam | virājate mahārājo’nādiśrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||98|| bālakṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ sākṣātparamātmā parātparaḥ | kambharāśrīsutaḥ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇabālakaḥ ||99|| tasyaiva darśanārthaṃ vai gacchāmaśceta eva nu | tacchrutvā kanyakā prāha dolā mama gṛhe’sti vai || 2.115.10 0|| tasyārthaṃ sā pradeyā vai yadi gantavyamasti hi | tayā vai duḥkhahālakṣmyā datteyaṃ cāhṛtā prabho || 101 || tad gṛhāṇa kṛpāsindho kanyābhāvabharaḥ prabhuḥ | ityukto bhagavām̐ścāti jaharṣa cādade tu tām || 1 02|| āśīrvādān dadau tasyai tebhyaścāpi punaḥ punaḥ | meghā natvā yayurvyoma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 1 03|| āndolanaṃ svayaṃ cakre dolāyāṃ śrāvaṇe smaran | lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇīṃ devīṃ manyate tu mahotsavam || 1 04|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya śobhanam | caritaṃ mokṣadaṃ rādhe sarvasampatpradaṃ śubham || 1 05|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi śrāvaṇātpāṭhanādapi | mananānmokṣadaṃ divyāṃ brāhmīṃ tanuṃ dadāti ca || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhurbhūtāsanarājyaṃ bhairavāya, nagnaparvatarājyaṃ sāmarājyaṃ ca viśiṣṭayoddhṛbhyaḥ pradattavān, sundaravane nadīḥ svasvapradeśān gantumājñāpya kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ pratyāgamane sati phulladolotsavaṃ śrāvaṇotsavaṃ ca kṛtavānityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 115 ||
<2.116> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai | janmamāsaḥ kārtiko vai kṛṣṇapakṣātmakaḥ śubhaḥ || 1 || aṣṭamīdivyadivasastrayodaśaḥ samāgataḥ | tadutsavaṃ vidhātuṃ prāgjyotiṣāṃ vaiṣṇavā janāḥ || 2 || prācīnadeśabhaktāśca śyāmabrahmapradeśajāḥ | trivittadeśajāścāpi kāśmerāsāmavāsinaḥ || 3 || tathānye himadeśasthāḥ śaṃbhudeśasamudbhavāḥ| narā nāryo bālakāśca bālikā vṛddhasevinaḥ || 4 || vimānairāyayustvaśvapaṭṭatīrthaṃ maharṣayaḥ | sādhavaśca tathā satyaḥ pragṛhya vividhopadāḥ || 5 || āyayurbālakṛṣṇasya pūjārthaṃ vai samutsukāḥ | uṣṭrālayapradeśācca tathābriktapradeśajāḥ || 6 || ārabījapradeśācca kumārīkṣetrajāstathā | anye vai cājanābhīyāḥ kacchadeśodbhavāstathā || 7 || āyayuḥ kṛṣṇapūjārthaṃ cotsukāḥ sopadādayaḥ | prātarvai maṇḍapaṃ ramyaṃ cakre gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 8 || gajāsane bālakṛṣṇaḥ snātvā dhṛtvāmbarāṇi ca | śṛṃgārābhūṣaṇādīni dhṛtvā sadasi cāyayau || 9 || tatra devāḥ pitaraśca munayo’kṣaramuktigāḥ | anyadhāmanivāsāśceśvarā devāśca mānavāḥ || 2.116.10|| āyayuḥ śrīharestasya pūjārthaṃ tasya saṃsadi | avādyanta suvādyāni jayaśabdāstathābhavan || 1 1|| vireje śrībālakṛṣṇo vardhitaśca nijāsane | samāje lomaśo vipraḥ pūjayāmāsa cācyutam || 12|| mukuṭaṃ dhārayāmāsa pradadau kuṇḍale tataḥ | tilakaṃ sākṣatacandraṃ cakre bhāle harestataḥ || 13 || ārārtrikaṃ cakārāsya puṣpahārān dadau gale | āśīrvādān dadau paścāt pūjayāmāsurīśvarāḥ || 14|| rādhike ca tato lakṣmyo brahmapriyāstato’pi ca | devyo gāndharvya āryāśca ṛṣipatnyastataḥ param || 15|| devā devyastathā vai prāgjyotiṣāṃ vaiṣṇavīprajā | deśāntarāgatāścāpi mahīmānāśca taṃ prabhum || 16|| pūjayāmāsuratyarthaṃ divyaiḥ sarvopacārakaiḥ | ārārtrikaṃ ca te cakrurdaduścāgre mahopadāḥ || 17|| vividhānyambarāṇyābhūṣaṇāni mauktikāni ca | hārān suvarṇarūpyotthān hīrakān raśanāyutān || 18|| yānāni vāraṇām̐ścāśvān alaṃkārām̐stathottamān | dadurbhojyāni pānāni phalāni cāmṛtāni ca || 19|| evaṃ sampūjya te sarve bālakṛṣṇaṃ sumaṇḍape | mātaraṃ śrīṃ ca gopālaṃ pitaraṃ śrīharistadā || 2.116.20|| natvā śrīlomaśaṃ carṣīn janarītyā gajāsanāt | utthāya ca sabhāsaṃsthān vṛddhān praṇamya vai tataḥ ||21|| yayau nijālayaṃ pitṛsammataḥ puruṣottamaḥ | mahīmānān bhojayitvā śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||22|| visarjayāmāsa lokān svasvān satīśca vai tataḥ | pūjayāmāsa lakṣmīśrīkambharā bhāvatastadā || 23 || bhojayitvā ca tā visarjayāmāsa nijālayān | evaṃ trayodaśasaṃkhyaḥ śrīharerjananotsavaḥ ||24|| susampanno mahīmānā yayurnaijān pradeśakān | dvitīye’hnyabhavattatrāścaryaṃ saṃśṛṇu rādhike| ||25|| dattātreyeṇa guruṇā bhagavatā parātmanā | preṣitaḥ śarabhaḥ kaścit kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāntikam || 26|| āyayau tatra mokṣārthaṃ tuṣṭāva śrīhariṃ tataḥ | divyadehaśca vai bhūtvā yayau dhāmākṣarābhidham ||27|| śrīrādhikovāca ka āsīccharabhaḥ kṛṣṇa dattātreyeṇa noditaḥ | vada me tatkathāṃ sarvāṃ śrotumicchāmi sarvaśaḥ ||28|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rādhe kathayāmi śarabhasya kathāṃ śubhām | samīraṇo’bhavad rājā sūryavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ || 29|| ājanābhasya khaṇḍasya paścimāyā bhuvaḥ śubhaḥ | gaurjarāṇāṃ ca kacchānāṃ saurāṣṭrāṇāṃ nṛpādhipaḥ || 2.116.30 || prajāpālanakaruṇo bhakto nārāyaṇasya ca | dharmakarmaparo nityaṃ dānahomaparāyaṇaḥ ||3 1 || akhaṇḍakīrtimānāsīd dīnarakṣāparastathā | gobhūbrāhmaṇasādhūnāṃ rakṣākaraḥ prarakṣakaḥ ||32|| yasya rājye kadācidvai durbhikṣaṃ nābhavatpurā | śaraṇāgatarakṣākṛt deśarakṣākarastathā ||33 || dhanurdharaḥ svayaṃ nityaṃ devasevāṃ karoti ca | rājadhānyabhavattasya śatruṃjītānadītaṭe || 34|| kuṇḍalākhyā mahādivyā nagarī vipraśobhitā | kṣatrīyavaiśyaśūdrādisaumyaprajānivāsitā ||35|| yajñayāgaparā yatra viprāśca vedaghoṣiṇaḥ | sādhavo yatayo yatra kṛṣṇadhyānaparāstathā ||36|| vanino’pi na yadrājye kaṣṭaṃ vindanti kutracit| | nāryo narāśca sukhino yadāśraye’bhavan sadā ||37|| samīraṇasya rājye vai viśeṣo’yamabhūt sadā | prātarninādyate nityaṃ paṭaho rājapūruṣaiḥ || 38|| dīno’ndhaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ kaścinnirādhāro nirāśrayaḥ | niranno’nāthabālo vā vṛddho vā bhikṣuko’pi vā ||39|| nārī nirāśrayā vṛddhā vidhavā cākuṭumbinī | sādhuḥ sādhvī yoginī vā tāpasī dhanavarjitā ||2.116.40|| daridro vādhano vā ca ṣaṇḍho vā ṣaṇḍhikā tathā | prātarāgatya maddvāre gṛhṇātu cānnabhojanam ||41 || mama grāme ca nagare pattane ca prajāsu ca | yatra yatra mamānnānāmāgārāṇi bhavanti vai ||42|| tatra tatra samāgatya gṛhṇātu cānnabhojanam | vastraṃ pātraṃ pragṛhṇātu bhajatāṃ puruṣottamam ||43|| ityevaṃ paṭahastasya prātarnadati bodhayan | mānavā nirdhanāstasya bhuñjate’nnaṃ sthale sthale ||44|| bhuktvā tṛpyanti satataṃ dadatyāśīrvacāṃsi ca | evaṃ puṇyayuto rājā tvekadā bhṛtyamaṇḍalam ||45|| gṛhītvā prayayau vyāghrāraṇyaṃ vihartumutsukaḥ | bhṛtyāśca gajaghoṭāśca dāsā api yayuḥ saha || 46|| madhyāraṇye dīrghikāyāstaṭe vṛkṣeṣu vai tadā | nivāsaṃ gajaghoṭādeḥ kārayitvā sa bhūpatiḥ || 47|| rājadharmeṇa mṛgayāṃ kartuṃ vanaṃ viveśa ha | bhṛtyā api yayuḥ kecit sārdhaṃ rājñā savāhanāḥ ||48|| gavayaṃ saṃvilokyaiva rājā pṛṣṭhamanuvrajan | araṇye gavayenāyaṃ viveśa gahane mudhā || 49|| dhanurdharo’śvamārūḍho vegād rājā paśupriyaḥ | nadīṃ ramyāṃ prāpa tatra jalapūravatīṃ śubhām ||2.116.50|| tasyāstīre’bhavat tatrāśramo ramyo’tisundaraḥ | phalapuṣpādiyuktānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ sughaṭāsu vai ||5 1 || munīnāṃ cātiviśvāsumṛgapakṣyādiśobhanaḥ | hiṃsrāṇāṃ hiṃsravṛttyādiśāntikṛccātinirmalaḥ |52|| muniśiṣyaiḥ praśiṣyaiśca sevito brahmadhāmavat | kāmakrodhātilobhānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ yatra nodbhavaḥ || 53|| māyānṛtādidoṣāśca paśuṣvapi na yatra vai | pakṣiṇo madhurān rāvān gāyanti sma drumādiṣu ||54|| vedavākyāni ca śukā mayūrā militāstadā | kokilā rājahaṃsāśca pragāyanti svabhāṣayā ||55|| devā devyo’pi nākācca yatrāgatya vasanti hi | ṛṣiṃ natvā prayāntyeva manvānāḥ kṛtakṛtyatām ||56|| etādṛśe cāśrame tu pārṣṇigṛho mahāmuniḥ | tapaḥ karoti vipulaṃ lokakalyāṇahetave ||57|| grīṣme pañcāgnimadhye ca niṣīdati nirantaram | varṣāyāṃ bhūtale varṣādhārāsveva niṣīdati ||58|| śaitye jale kṛtāvāso divā tiṣṭhati sarvathā | rātrau vṛkṣatale tatra vartate vai nirāvṛtau ||5 9 || kvacitphala kvacitpuṣpaṃ kvacinmunyannamityapi | kvacijjalaṃ kvacitpānīyakaṃ gṛhṇāti vārdalam || 2.116.60 || nirāhāraḥ kvattvāste bhajate śrīnarāyaṇam | susvāmiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa saṃbhajate hṛdi || 61 || tādṛśo’yaṃ muniryatra vṛkṣe’dho vartate tadā | tasya puraḥ sa gavayaḥ samāgatyātibhītitaḥ || 62 || abhavat susthirastatra ṛṣeḥ śaraṇamāśritaḥ | rājā dūrādanāvīkṣyāśramaṃ taṃ ca muniṃ tathā || 63 || mṛgayālagnacitto’sau jaghāna gavayaṃ balāt | śareṇa tīkṣṇadhāreṇa hyudarāntaḥpraveśinā || 64|| saśaro gavayastatrākrośaṃ kṛtvā ṛṣeḥ puraḥ | nipapāta yathā putrastathā rakṣārthameva tu || 65||| dīnavattaṃ muniṃ paśyan tadā dīnena cakṣuṣā | patitaṃ śarasahitaṃ vīkṣya pārṣṇigṛho muniḥ ||66 || dayāluḥ śīghramevainaṃ paśuṃ pasparśa pāṇinā | jalaṃ dadau mukhe tasyāpaśyallagnaṃ śaraṃ tadā | | 67|| tathā trāsena hariṇān palāyanaparān paśūn | parito dhāvamānām̐śca vilokya kaṣṭamāptavān ||68 || aho mamāśrame ko’yaṃ ghātakaścādya saṃgataḥ | paśūnāṃ trāsakṛd duṣṭo nirmaryādo’tidāruṇaḥ ||6 9 || nirdoṣaṃ gavayaṃ yo’tra jaghāna prāṇata śaraiḥ | evaṃ yāvanmuniśreṣṭho vicāraṃ prakaroti hi ||2.116.7 0 || tāvadrājā turaṃgasthastatra sṛtyā samāgataḥ | dadarśa brāhmaṇaṃ mālājaṭāśmaśrudharaṃ śubham ||7 1 || patitaṃ pādavikṣepān kurvantaṃ gavayaṃ tathā | manasā mṛdubhāvena tadāśramaprasaṃgataḥ || 72 || dūyamānaḥ sa vai rājā pārṣṇigṛhaṃ pravīkṣya ca | āyātaścāśvamābaddhya vṛkṣamūle padakramaiḥ ||73 | | bhītaḥ papāta sa ṛṣeḥ pādayoḥ śīghrameva tu | tāvad ṛṣistamuvāca kathaṃ duṣṭa hataḥ paśuḥ ||74|| tvayā vyādhena nirdoṣo mamāraṇyanivāsakṛt | duṣṭastvaṃ dṛśyase rājā kṛtyaṃ karoṣi hiṃsrakam ||75||| vyādhavat krūrakarmā tvaṃ munīnāmāśrameṣvapi | duṣṭakāryaṃ prakartuṃ kiṃ lajjase na narādhipa ||76 | | śareṇa bhagnā hariṇā mamāśramanivāsināḥ | gavayo’yaṃ mṛtaścātra bhavatyeva kṣaṇāntare ||77|| śare vikarṣaṇaṃ prāpte nāsya prāṇo’vatiṣṭhati| paśya pāpa nijaṃ putraṃ kathaṃ ghātayase na vai ||78|| mṛgayā te na vai yogyā ṛṣiviśvastajantuṣu | mṛgāḥ putrā mama tulyā mamāśramasamīpataḥ ||79|| tava bhītyā dudruvuvai prāṇarakṣaṇavāñcchayā | śareṇa bhagnā hariṇā mamāśramasamīpataḥ ||2.116.80|| śarabho bhava rājendra vanāvāso’tikaṣṭavān | punarnaivaṃ daṇḍaśikṣaḥ kariṣyasi vadhaṃ kvacit ||8 1 || ityuktaḥ ṛṣiṇā rājā tatraiva śarabho’bhavat | vihāya mānavaṃ rūpaṃ pāśavaṃ rūpamāptavān ||82|| ityevaṃ sa ṛṣiṇā vai śapto rājā samīraṇaḥ | śarabhaḥ sa paśurbhūtvā tadāśramād viniryayau ||83|| śāpamokṣaṇamatraiva prārthayituṃ na cāvadat | bhītaścātīva doṣeṇa kopenāpi ṛṣestadā ||84|| śīghraṃ tadāśramaṃ tyaktvā siṃhāraṇyaṃ viveśa ha | duḥkhātiduḥkhasaṃmagnaḥ sukhaṃ nāvāpa kutracit ||85|| jātismaraḥ sadā svasya duḥkhāntaṃ kartumeva tu | cintayatyeva satataṃ caran vane muhurmuhuḥ ||86|| rājabhṛtyāstu vai jñātvā vṛttāntaṃ taṃ tataḥ kila | bhītā nijaprāṇārakṣāṃ jñātvā gṛhān drutaṃ yayuḥ ||87|| gavaye ca ṛṣiṇaiva mantrapuṣpāñjalistadā | sandhinyā sahitaḥ kṣiptastenojjīvanamāhitam ||88|| rājā śāpanivṛttyarthaṃ bhramitvā tadvanaṃ tataḥ | pārṣṇigṛhaṃ samāgatya prārthayāmāsa mokṣaṇam ||89|| ṛṣiḥ prāha mahāraṇye pātālīye sarovare | raivatādriḥ samāgatya nijāvāsaṃ kariṣyati || 2.116.90|| tatra vai bhagavān sākṣād dattātreyo mahāprabhuḥ | śikhare tu janaihīne tvagamye vyomagāmini ||9 1 || svayaṃ tapo mahaccograṃ kariṣyati yadā tadā | śailadroṇyāṃ tvayā tatra sthitena bhagavān hi saḥ ||92|| dṛṣṭaścārādhitaścāpi kṛpayā tvāṃ suneṣyati | kṣetraṃ kuṃkumavāpyākhyaṃ tatra sthāsyati cātrijaḥ || 93 || aśvapaṭṭasarastīre paścime tapasā harim | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamārādhayam̐stadā ||94|| dattātreyasya kṛpayānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | vīkṣya tvaṃ tatpādayośca pītvā jalaṃ prasādajam ||95|| śīghraṃ śāpānmama mukto bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ | ityuktaḥ sa tu rājarṣiḥ śarabhasya tu dehavān ||96|| araṇyaṃ prayayau tasmānmahāsarovarāntike | tataḥ kālāntare tatra raivatādriḥ samāyayau ||97|| tatraiva bhagavānatriputrastapaścacāra ha | śikhare taṃ dadarśāsau śarabho japamācarat ||98|| dattātreyo dayāluḥ sa cainamādāya tadgṛham | samāyāto’sti bhagavānaśvapaṭṭasarovare ||99|| adṛśyastiṣṭhati cāsya śāpamokṣārthameva tu | dattātreyābhidhaṃ tīrthaṃ tadatrāśvasarovare || 2.116.100 || śāpapāpavināśārthaṃ vartate pāvanaṃ hi tat| | tatra vai śarabho gatvānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam || 101 || vīkṣya pādajalaṃ pītvā śāpānmokṣamavāptavān | rājarūpaṃ śubhaṃ prāptastato’pi tīrthavīryataḥ || 1 02||| divyarūpo’tra bhūtvaivākṣaraṃ lokaṃ yayau śubham | ityevaṃ rādhike cāśvasarovaraṃ varaṃ sadā || 1 03|| sāyaṃ sa śarabhaḥ pītvā jalaṃ pādajalaṃ hareḥ | muktiṃ jagāma paramāṃ brāhmīṃ divyāṃ tu śāśvatīm || 1 04|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi | sakāmānāṃ vaṃśavṛddhirduḥkhamuktirbhavedapi || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhostrayodaśajanmadinotsavaḥ, samīraṇarājño mṛgayārthaṃ gatasya vane pārṣṇigṛharṣiśāpena śarabhatvaṃ, tato raivatādrau dattātreyadvārā kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre mokṣaṇam, aśvapaṭṭasarasi dattātreyatīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍdaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 116 ||
<2.117> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānyad vārāhaṃ tīrthamityapi | kuṃkumāyā aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva purābhavat || 1 | | akṣarādhipatiḥ śrīmān sarveśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | parabrahma svayaṃ sṛṣṭiṃ yadārebhe svamūrtitaḥ || 2 || tattvāni cintayato’sya maravādagnirajāyata | divyo divyākṣaramukto divyamuktasvarūpadhṛk || 3 || dvibhujaḥ śvetavarṇaśca śītalasparśavām̐stadā | mūrtitejomayaḥ so’yamabhavad rūpavān śubhaḥ || 4 || bhagavānaikṣata vahniṃ kartuṃ tattvātmakaṃ tadā | vahniśceṅgitamājñāya tasthau puroharestadā || 5 || hariścājñāṃ cakārāsya yāhi tvaṃ ceśvarādiṣu | mayā vai sṛjyamāneṣu tejastattvaṃ sadā bhava || 6 || ityāśāṃ sa samādāya mahāmāyāṃ viveśa ha | garbharūpastadā māyā kṣobhaṃ tvavāpa vahnivat || 7 || yathā yathā tu sā māyā guṇatrayātmikā tadā | sūkṣmā sāmyasvarūpāpi kṣobhaṃ tvavāpa vai muhuḥ || 8 || tathā tathā ca māyāyā mauṣṇyaṃ kāryaṃ vyavartata | tāmaso vai sa bhāgastu vyavardhata harīcchayā || 9 || māyayā tattvasaṃghāto vairājaḥ samapadyata | tatroṣṇabhāvamāsādyoṣmātmako vai mahānalaḥ || 2.117.10 || mukhato bahirāyātaśceśvaro vahnināmakaḥ | vaṃ vairājaṃ samāśritya haṃ hanuṃ mukhamārgataḥ || 11 || abhito nirgato devo vahnirityeva so’bhavat | divyo’yaṃ śubhravadanaḥ śubhravarṇaḥ samujjvalaḥ || 12 || brahmabhāvaṃ tu visṛjyeśvarabhāvamupāgataḥ | vairājo nijaputraṃ taṃ vahniṃ puruṣarūpiṇam || 13 || prāha putrān sṛṣṭiyogyān sṛja putra samān tvayā | omityājñāṃ śirasyeva dhṛtvā vahnirvyatarkayat || 14|| putrā me sṛṣṭiyogyā vai bhavantu matsvarūpiṇaḥ | saṃkalpamātrajātā vai pāvanāḥ pavamānakaḥ || 15 || paviḥ trayaḥ samutpannā pavirvajraṃ tu vaidyutam | indrāya cārpitaḥ putro brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā || 16|| pāvakākhyastu lokebhyaścārpitaḥ pākakarmaṇe | pavamāno mahājvālāyutaścātīva cañcalaḥ || 17|| vegavān hānidaśceti dāhako’pi maholbaṇaḥ | iti jñātvā janāste tu nāgṛhṇanta yadā tadā || 18|| kruddho’raṇyaṃ jagāmāyaṃ bhojanārthaṃ mahāvane | babhrāma sa mahāraṇyaprabhṛtiṣu mahābalaḥ || 1 9|| evaṃ saurāṣṭraviṣaye pavamānaḥ svayaṃ bhraman | anveṣayan bhojanaṃ cālabhamāno’tiduḥkhitaḥ || 2.117.20 || vyāghrāraṇyaṃ dadāhāsau kṣudhayātīva bādhitaḥ | jvālāmālāsamāvyāptaṃ vanaṃ jātaṃ bhayaṃkaram || 21 || dahyamānaṃ duṣpraveśaṃ durnirgamyaṃ samantataḥ | hariṇā paśavaḥ pakṣyādayo mṛgāḥ sarīsṛpāḥ || 22|| dahyante vahninā tatra nibiḍe vṛkṣasaṃkule | tṛṇavallīghaṭāvyāpte’dṛśyabhūtalabhūmike |||23 || dhāvanti hariṇāḥ sarve dhūmāndhāḥ pakṣiṇastathā | aśaktāpatyabālādyā vanyānāṃ tiryagātmanām || 24|| sahasraśaḥ prāṇadhārā aśaktā vahnisaṃkulāḥ | dagdhāstatra vahniputrapavamānena vai mṛtāḥ ||25|| vṛkṣā dagdhāḥ sajīvāśca vallikā bhasmatāṃ gatāḥ | tṛṇānāṃ ca latānāṃ ca stambānāṃ gaṇanā tu kā || 26|| śikharāṇi vilokyante vṛkṣāṇāṃ vahniśailavat | ucchrayā bhūpradeśāśca vane vahnimayāstadā || 27|| alpaśṛṃgāstathā śailā vukṣāraṇyāmbarāstadā | dahyanti vahninā jvālāmukhāḥ śailā yathābhavan || 28|| evaṃ kraurye saṃpravṛtte vanavāsivināśane | vyāpake cānale jāte pavamāne’nilānvite || 2 9|| nadītīre’pi vṛkṣāṇāṃ dagdhabhāve hyupasthite | āśramaḥ picchalarṣeśca dāhavegena dharṣitaḥ || 2.117.3 0| | picchalarṣirbahuvarṣapurāṇastapasi sthitaḥ | dhyāyannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ śvetavārāharūpiṇam || 31 || tepe tapo mahāghoraṃ cāraṇye vanavāsiṣu | yatra kāmadughā gāvo pravasanti tadāśrame || 3 2|| gopālāstatra tiṣṭhanti pārśve vṛkṣāśraye’pi ca | te tā vahnipravegena dudruvuśca nadījale || 32 | | nipeturjīvarakṣārthe gopālāḥ peturapsu ca | athāyaṃ tu maharṣirvai picchalākhyo dvijeśvaraḥ || 34| | vilokya pavamānasya ceṣṭitaṃ krūratāmayam | dayāparaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā pavamānamuvāca ha ||3 5| | re re vahne mahākrūra mahāhiṃsakato’dhika | kṣudhayā pīḍitaścaitadvanaṃ mamāśramaṃ tathā || 36 | | gāḥ paśūn prāṇinaḥ pakṣigaṇān sarīsṛpām̐stathā | vināparādhaṃ dahasi dīnaṃ cāpi na muñcasi || 37|| bubhukṣitaḥ pāpabuddhirbhavatyeveti tattathā | kathaṃ vihāya maryādāṃ sarvaṃ nāśayase balāt || 38|| paśyāpatyāni pakṣyādijantūnāmapi niṣpadāḥ | apakṣāścāpi dahyanti paśyataste ghṛṇāpi na || 3 9|| kathaṃ tvaṃ krūratāṃ prāptaḥ śāntiṃ naivādhigacchasi | parvato bhūcchrayāścāpi dagdhāstava prabhāvataḥ ||2.117.40 || bhojyaṃ svaṃ vai labdhavatā dagdhaṃ sarvānyabhojanam | kṣayaṃ nītaṃ mamāraṇyaṃ kṣīṇāḥ sarve hi jīvinaḥ ||41 || tasmāttvāṃ kṣayakartāraṃ śapāmyatra na saṃśayaḥ | ityeva vahninā kliṣṭaḥ picchalarṣistu rādhike ||42 || śaśāpa pavamāna | tvaṃ kṣayamāpnuhi vai drutam | ityuktvā svakarasthaṃ ca jalaṃ mumoca bhūtale ||43||| yāvattāvaccānalasya jvālā māndyamupāgatāḥ | dāhaśaktirvinaṣṭā ca pākaśaktirlayaṃ gatā ||44|| rasādanasya sāmarthyaṃ līnaṃ kṣaṇāntare tathā | śvaityaṃ vahnervinaṣṭaṃ ca tathauṣṇyaṃ vilayaṃ gatam |||45|| naisargavardhanaṃ cāpi hrāsaṃ yātaṃ tadā svayam | dhūmrabhāvaḥ pravṛddhaścāṅgārā nistejasāsitāḥ ||46|| aprakāśāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ kāṣṭhakūrcāstadābhavan | vinā prayatnaṃ vahnirvai śamitaḥ śāpakāraṇāt ||47|| bhakṣitāstu rasāḥ sarve bījāni paśupakṣiṇaḥ | pavamānasya jaṭharādapakvā niryayurbahiḥ ||48|| mandodaro mandatejā mandaśvāso babhūva saḥ | maraṇonmukhatāṃ prāptaḥ pādaśaktivihīnakaḥ ||49|| jvālāśūnyaścendriyāṇāṃ vṛttiśūnyo babhūva ca | śuśoca bahudhā karmaphalaṃ prāpto ruroda ca ||2.117.50|| kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ kathaṃ śāpo maharṣikṛt | nivarteta kathaṃ so’pi prasannaḥ syād vyacintayat ||51 || athāyaṃ pavamānaśca nirmānastamṛṣiṃ prati | yayau hṛdā daṇḍavacca patitvā manasā girā ||92|| tuṣṭāva brahmarūpaṃ taṃ duḥkhamokṣasya kāṃkṣayā | he sādho tvaṃ dayālurvai nirdayo’haṃ tu hiṃsrakaḥ ||55 || satyavrato bhavān sādho na satyaṃ vidyate mayi | niṣpāpastvaṃ sadā tvāste pāpiṣṭho’haṃ tu duḥkhadaḥ ||54|| asantuṣṭo’smi vai lubdhastvaṃ santoṣī na lubdhakaḥ | parigrahaparaścāhaṃ tva virāgo’parigrahaḥ ||59|| tāpano’haṃ tu jīvānāṃ tvaṃ tapasvī na tāpanaḥ | brahmabhūtaḥ sadā tvaṃ tu bhramātmāhaṃ tu māyikaḥ ||56|| kṣamāśūnyo bhavāmyeva tvayi kṣamā sadāsti ca | siddhīnāṃ mayi leśo na siddhyāśrayo bhavāniha ||57|| pāpināṃ pāpanāśārthaṃ nāhaṃ śakto bhavāniva | tīrtharūpo bhavānāste nāhaṃ tīrthaṃ tarāmi na ||58|| ahamāvidyako jīvo bhavān vidyāśrayaḥ sadā | brahmatanurbhavānasti māyātanurbhavāmyaham ||59|| divyamokṣapradastvaṃ ca janmado’haṃ vināśakaḥ | śāntiprado bhavānāste’hamudvegaprado’smi tu ||2.117.60|| nityaṃ brahma paraṃ saumyaṃ cintayāno bhavāniha | kartumuddhāramevāste samartho dīnadehinām ||61|| ajñānāmaparādhānāṃ kṣamāṃ kuru mahāmate | mayā prajvālitaṃ yattajjīvayituṃ prabhurbhavān ||62|| tapasā dyotamānastvaṃ samujjīvaya jaṅgalam | paśūn prāṇigaṇām̐ścāpi pakṣiṇaśca vanaspatīn ||63|| jīvān sarīsṛpādīm̐śca māmuddhara tapodhana | śāpapātraṃ punaḥ syācca sādhūnāṃ toṣapātrakam ||64|| śikṣā prāptā mayā sādho maraṇaṃ mā vidhehi me | mṛtyoḥ sānnidhyamāpto’smi māmujjīvaya cārtihan ||65|| sādhūnāṃ kṛṣṇabhaktānāṃ sādhutvaṃ tvetadeva yat | kṣāntvāparādhān jīvasya tasmai guṇān dadāti ca ||66|| vṛścikaḥ kaṇṭakaṃ yuṃkte sādhustaṃ na vimuñcati | mūṣakaḥ kṛntati pakṣaṃ haṃsastaṃ na vimuñcati ||67|| rakṣakāḥ kurvanti rakṣāṃ duṣṭānāmapi dehinām | māmujjīvaya viprendra kṣamāsārā hi sādhavaḥ ||68|| naivaṃ punaḥ kariṣye’haṃ cāparāddhaṃ kadācana | satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ patitastava pādayoḥ ||69|| ityevaṃ sa hṛdā rādhe pavamāno muhurmuhuḥ | ṛṣiṃ taṃ picchalaṃ tatra tuṣṭāva patito vane ||2.117.70 || dhyānavṛttyā maharṣistajjñātvā tatstavanaṃ tataḥ | prasannaḥ karuṇāvārdhirdrāgevotthāya cāsanāt ||71 || pavamānaṃ stuvantaṃ svaṃ yayau śīghraṃ śubhāśrayaḥ | pavamāna śubhaṃ te’stu mā śokaṃ kuru vahnija ||71|| bhavān devo vahniputro yadi naivaṃ karoti cet | jīvayāmi bhavantaṃ vai mā pradahyatu dehinaḥ ||73 || ityuktvā jalamādāya kare sammantrya pātrataḥ | gṛhītvā pavamānasyopari cikṣepa yāvatā ||74|| pavamānaḥ saśakto’bhūduttasthau ca nanāma ca | tejoyukto daṇḍavacca cakāra tam ṛṣiṃ tadā ||75|| pavamānaśca taṃ prāha śāpamokṣaṃ kuru prabho | ṛṣiḥ prāha mayā śaktirdattā gantuṃ vihāyasā ||76|| yāhi śrīśailasaṃjñaṃ ca parvataṃ yatra sūkaraḥ | āste mokṣapradaḥ śrīmān dharaṇiprāṇarakṣakaḥ ||77|| sarvarakṣākaraḥ kroḍaḥ sa te rakṣāṃ kariṣyati | ityuktaḥ pavamānaḥ sa yayau śrīśailamādarāt ||78|| valmīkasannidhau tiṣṭhan smaratyeva ca taṃ tadā | rādhike bhagavām̐stasmād valmīkādutthito’bhavat |||79|| śvetavarṇaḥ sundaraśca pavamānastamānamat | sukhī bhaveti bhagavānāha vahnisutaṃ tadā ||2.117.80|| papraccha kāraṇaṃ tatrāgamanasya tato’nalaḥ | akhilaṃ kathayāmāsa kāraṇaṃ śāpamityapi ||81|| samuddhāraṃ mama viṣṇo kurvityāha vibhāvasuḥ | tejaḥ śaktiṃ balaṃ rūpaṃ divyatāṃ vyāpitāṃ tathā ||82|| guṇān purā bhavān me’tra dadātu parameśvara | ityuktaḥ śrīvarāhaśca prāha taṃ pavamānakam ||83 || āyāhi pavamāna tvaṃ mayā saha surāṣṭrakam | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ||84|| sarvāvatāradhartā yaḥ sākṣāt svāmī pumuttamaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |||85|| virājate’kṣarakṣetre sa te sarvaṃ pradāsyati | mokṣaṃ caiśvarabhāvaṃ ca sarvaṃ sa te pradāsyati ||86|| ityuktvā śrīvarāhastaṃ nināyākṣarabhūmikām | sahasā vyomamārgeṇa tathā cāśvasarovare ||87|| snapayāmāsa taṃ śīghraṃ darśanārthaṃ hareḥ puraḥ | taṃ nītvā prayayau śrīmān vārāho bhagavānprabhuḥ ||88|| cakāra daṇḍavat bhūmau pavamānastamādarāt | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścotthāpya vahnijam ||86|| niṣādya tvāsane kroḍaṃ samāślikṣattu vakṣasi | siṃhāsanaṃ dadāvasmai varāhāya nijātmane ||2.117.90 || tasmācca kāraṇaṃ jñātvā mānuṣyaṃ nāṭayan hariḥ | ṛṣeḥ śāpanivṛttyarthaṃ prasādaṃ pradadau prabhuḥ ||91 || pavamānaḥ prasādaṃ taṃ bubhuje cāmṛtaṃ phalam | jalaṃ papau ca yāvadvai tāvat sarvaguṇānvitaḥ ||92|| samapadyata viśvātmā yathāpūrvaguṇāśrayaḥ | sarvaśāpavinirmukto’bhavat sukhyatiharṣitaḥ ||93 || varāhaṃ pūjayāmāsa tathā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇām | pavamāno hareryogāttīrtharūpo’bhavattataḥ ||94|| tīrthe vāsaṃ cakārāsau varāho’pi sarovare | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaivājñayā prabhoḥ ||95|| evaṃ vārāhatīrthaṃ tat samabhūt tatra nityadā | varāho bhagavānāste pavamānayutaḥ prabhuḥ ||96|| tatra snānaṃ kariṣyanti ye janāste virogiṇaḥ | bhaviṣyanti hareryogāt secanāt tīrthavāriṇām ||97|| muktiṃ bhuktiṃ gamiṣyanti yāsyanti divyatāṃ tathā | paṭhanād vācanādasyārogyaṃ syātsarvadā priyam ||98|| rādhike bhagavānevaṃ tvāha vārāharūpiṇam | phālgune pūrṇimāyāṃ vai prātarvai pavamānakam ||99|| dadau vāsaṃ yajñabhūmau tathāraṇye mahājale | vṛṣṭyāścāpi jale vāsaṃ pavamānāya vai dadau || 2.117.1 00|| bhūgarbhe ca tathāvāsaṃ dadau kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | pradadau nirbhayatvaṃ vaiṣṇavatvaṃ dadau tathā || 10 1|| kaṇṭhīṃ ca taulasīṃ cāpi tilakaṃ candrakaṃ tathā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 102 || evaṃ mantraṃ dadau cātha praṇamya pavamānakaḥ | prapūjya ca hariṃ tīrthe vāsārthaṃ prayayau saraḥ || 103 || varāho’pi pradattaṃ satkāraṃ jagrāha sarvathā | vārāhe tanmahattīrthe vāsaṃ cakāra rādhike || 1 04|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne picchalarṣidttaśāpanivṛttaye varāhaṃ prabhuṃ gṛhītvāśvapaṭṭasarovaraṃ prati pavamānasya gamanaṃ, hareryogācchāpamuktiḥ, varāhatīrthaṃ pavamānatīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 117 ||
<2.118> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ hareḥ śubham | bhaktarakṣākaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pāpatāpapraṇāśanam || 1 || saurāṣṭre jayanagare’bhavat santāraṇo dvijaḥ | vedadharmarataḥ samyak pūjāvidhānatatparaḥ || 2 || ṣaṭkarmanirataḥ kathāvācane guṇakīrtane | kathāyāḥ śravaṇe viṣṇoḥ smaraṇe pādasevane || 3 || arcane vandane dāsye sakhye cātmanivedane | mahābhāgavataścāsīt kṛṣṇapūjāparāyaṇaḥ || 4 || svayaṃ dvijaḥ samutthāya prātarnityaṃ nadītaṭam | gatvā snātyeva bhadrāyāṃ kṛtvā sandhyāṃ ca vandanam || 5 || jalasya kalaśaṃ mūrghni svayaṃ nītvaiva bhāvataḥ | śālagrāmasya vai pūjāṃ svāhṛtakusumādibhiḥ || 6 || svaghṛṣṭacandanādyaiśca karotyeva sadā dvijaḥ | pūjāyāṃ jāyamānāyāṃ tasya patnī pativratā || 7 || taraṇyākhyā tu sāmagrīrdadātyeva hi bhāvataḥ | jalaṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ cāpi vastraṃ bhūṣāṃ ghṛtādikam || 8 || putrī tasya taralikā kanyā kumārikā satī | śīghraṃ pūjāsamayādvai pūrvamutthāya nityadā || 9 || snātvā natvā svapitarau devaṃ natvātibhāvataḥ | cullikāṃ vahniyuktāṃ ca vidhāya tvaritā satī || 2.118.10 || dugdhapākaṃ pūrikāśca paktvā naivedyamuttamam | samarpayati kṛṣṇāya viṣṇave cātibhaktitaḥ || 11 || dvitīyā kanyakā nāmnā kumudā sarvadā prage | gāṃ nijāṃ dohayitvaiva kṣīraṃ dadāti cārcane || 12|| dugdhasārādikaṃ kṛtvā nityaṃ dadāti cārcane| putrastasya vinodaśca devapuṣpadrumāśraye || 13 || jalasecanakāryādi karotyeva tu sevanam | pātrāṇāṃ mañjanaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ jalārpaṇādikam || 14|| karoti sarvadā pārśve pituḥ sthitvā yathāsthalam | dvitīyastasya putro’pi vasantarṣiśca vaiṣṇavaḥ || 1781|| vāyudānaṃ vyajanena karoti pūjanādiṣu | makṣikādrāvaṇaṃ cāpi śarkarātulasīdalam || 16|| phalānyapi dadātyeva yathāpekṣaṃ ca sevanam | atha pūjottaraṃ sarve kurvanti stavanaṃ prabhoḥ || 17|| pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavacca puṣpāñjaliṃ dadatyapi | kṣamāyāñcāṃ prakurvanti tato nṛtyanti vai mudā || 18|| vādayanti suvādyāni kīrtayanti pragītikāḥ | gāyanti tālamānādyairvividhairnartanaiḥ sadā || 19 || evaṃ saṃpūjayitvā ca ramākāntaṃ sadā patim | tataḥ prasādaṃ bhaktebhyaḥ saṃvibhajya pradāya ca ||2.118.2 0|| gṛhiṇaste samaśnanti śarkarānnajalādikam | madhyāhne ca tathā sāyaṃ pūjayanti vidhānataḥ || 21 || jīvikārthaṃ tu divase yatante’pekṣitaṃ manāk | evaṃ prayāte samaye bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ||22|| suprasanno’tibhaktyaiva sākṣād babhūva caikadā | āṣāḍhe kṛṣṇapakṣe vai rātrāvekādaśīvrate ||2 3 || mukuṭaṃ dhārayan ramyaṃ vakraṃ sauvarṇamuttamam | mayūravaryapicchāgraṃ maṇiratnādiśobhitam ||24|| kuṇḍale makarākāre dadhan ramye tu karṇayoḥ | tilakaṃ kauṃkuma madhye bhāle bibhrat sucandrakam ||25|| mandahāsyānano divyasmerākarṣitamānasaḥ | kaṇṭhe sukaustubhahārān tūlasīpatramālikāḥ ||26|| sauvarṇahāramālālīn dadhan kaṭyāṃ tu mekhalām | sauvarṇīṃ kaṭake cāpi bhujayośca prakoṣṭhayoḥ ||27|| śṛṃkhale svarṇaje ramye’ṅgulīyakormikāḥ kare | yaṣṭiṃ ca pauraṭīṃ muktāmāṇikyahīrakānvitām ||28|| pāduke ramyasauvarṇajanite dhārayan hariḥ | pītāmbaraśca ruciro vyadṛśyata yadṛcchayā || 29 || tejomaṇḍalamadhyastho dāsadāsīgaṇārcitaḥ | yuvā rājādhirājaśca rādhāramādisevitaḥ ||2.118.3 0|| tato bhaktān tirobhāvya kiśoro’bhūt svayaṃprabhuḥ | bālakṛṣṇasvarūpaḥ śrīmahārājādhirājakaḥ ||3 1|| kiśoro bhagavān kṛṣṇo dadau mantraṃ svayaṃ prabhuḥ| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya ravāmine svāhā ||32|| dadau ca mastake hastaṃ prabhustatra tiro’bhavat | evaṃ tato dinānnityaṃ prārabhyoṣaḥsamarcane ||33|| pūjāyāṃ śrīmahārājo nityamāyāti keśavaḥ | kiśoraḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhūprasevitaḥ ||34|| sarvopacārān gṛhṇāti pūjāyāmarpitāni vai | śrāvaṇe bhādrake māse tathāśvine’pi vai prabhuḥ ||35 || pūjāṃ teṣāmamāyāṃ vai gṛhītvā prāha tān hariḥ | ūrjakṛṣṇadalāṣṭamyāṃ mama janmamahotsavaḥ ||36| caturdaśo’śvasarasastaṭe’kṣarākhyabhūtale | bhaviṣyatīti yuṣmābhiścāgantavyaṃ mama gṛham ||37|| pitṛbhyāṃ cāpi kanyābhiḥ putraiḥ saha mamālaye | āgamiṣyanti trailokyeśvarā mamārcanāya yat ||38|| ityuktvā bhagavām̐stebhyo bhaktebhyo’tha tiro’bhavat | bhaktāste tīrthayātrārthaṃ samutsukāstato’bhavan |||39|| ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prasādhya pātheyaṃ gṛhaṃ pidhāya tālakaiḥ | upadāḥ subhagā gṛhya padbhyāṃ prasthānamācarat |||2.118.40 || saptamyāṃ sāyamevaite prāpustvaśvasarovaram | dṛṣṭvā kuṃkumavāpīṃ ca tathā śrīlomaśāśramam ||41 || ṛṣīn satīḥ sādhujanān devān devālayān bahūn | kṣetrapān kṣetrarakṣām̐śca nagaraṃ vāṭikādikāḥ ||42| udyānāni vicitrāṇi daivivṛkṣavanāni ca | yajñaśālāḥ kathāśālā dharmaśālā mahālayān ||43|| dṛṣṭvā śrīkambharālakṣmīṃ śrīgopālaṃ hariṃ tathā | daivīṃ bhūmiṃ vilokyaiva brahmapriyāśca kanyakāḥ ||44 vimānāni sudivyāni muktān saudhān samantataḥ | avāpuḥ paramāścaryaṃ parameśvaramadbhutam ||45|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvārcya vai tataḥ | satkṛtā bhojitāstena nārāyaṇena te janāḥ ||46|| nyūṣuḥ rātriṃ mahīmānagṛhe saudhe’tisundare | cakrurjāgaraṇaṃ rātrau saptamyāṃ premavihvalāḥ ||47|| dadṛśurvyomamārgeṇa vimānānyāgatāni te | yeṣu muktāstvakṣarasya tathā golokavāsinaḥ ||48|| vaikuṇṭhasya tathā muktā vairājāmṛtavāsinaḥ | brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyā īśvarāḥ pitarastathā | |49| ṛṣayaḥ svargiṇo devā mervāśrayāḥ surādayaḥ | dikpālā lokapālāśca mānavāḥ sādhavo’malāḥ ||2.118.50| siddhāḥ sādhvyaḥ satīnāryaḥ sāṃkhyayoginya ityapi | nadā nadyaśca tīrthāni samudrāḥ ṛtavastathā ||5 1 | māsā guṇā araṇyāni pātālavāsino’surāḥ | divyā bhaktāstathā daityā dānavāścāraṇādayaḥ ||52| rājāno divyabhaktāśca saṃsthitāḥ santi yeṣu vai | tādṛśāni vimānāni sūryacandranibhāni vai ||53| kumārīgaṇagītaiścodghoṣitāni śubhāni ca | vādyanādātiśabdāni vyomno’vaterurakṣare ||54| kṣetre kuṃkumavāpyāstu sannidho vai sahasraśaḥ | teṣāṃ prabhāḥ prakāśāśca koṭicandrasamāstadā ||55|| abhavan gagane bhūmau nagare sarvato diśi | rajomātraṃ nāndhakārastatrābhūddhāmasadṛśe ||56|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān prabhuḥ | tathā gopālakṛṣṇākhyaḥ pitā mātā tu kambharā ||57|| santoṣā ca svasā bhrātā bhagavām̐śca śukastathā | vallabhaścātha vai hemantako’pi bhagavām̐stathā ||58|| dāsau dvau mañjulā haṃsā saguṇā ca sakhīgaṇaḥ | svāgataṃ vāsamarghyaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ daduḥ sukham ||59|| atha vai brāhmasamaye vedānūcurmaharṣayaḥ | tadā maṃgalatūryāṇi tvavādyanta samantataḥ ||2.118.60|| munayo bhajanaṃ cakruḥ sādhavo dhyānamācaran | janāścāpi mahīmānā yayuḥ snātuṃ sarovaram ||61|| santāraṇo dvijaścāpi taraṇistasya bhāminī | taralā ca kumudā ca vinodaśca vasantakaḥ ||62|| sarve te vai kuṭumbaṃ ca smṛtvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | yayuḥ snātuṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovarajale tadā ||63|| naukāmādāya śabaraṃ tīrasthaṃ te vyalokayan | vihartumānasā vārdhau nāvamāruruhuśca te ||64|| śulkaṃ datvā niṣeduśca nāviko nāvamairayat | jalamadhye gatā naukā krośādapyadhikaṃ yadā ||65 || tadā naukā aparāśca mānavairadhirohitāḥ | śataśaścāpi saraso madhye taṭe samantataḥ ||66 || viharanti sma jaladhau sukhānnanu sarovare | yadṛcchayā mahatyā sā naukayā saha vai tadā ||67|| āghātaṃ sahasā prāpya vakrā cādhomukhī kṣaṇāt | abhavat tadbhayenaite naukāsthāḥ sahasā tadā ||68|| ekapārśve’pasasruśca patitāḥ salilāntare | naukāpi jalamadhye sā magnā jalaprapūritā ||69|| atropāyo na caivāsti samuddhartuṃ tadā hi tān | mahatyā naukayā cāpi tathā naukābhireva ca ||2.118.70|| sahasā tatra te sarve dhīvaraiḥ parimārgitāḥ | agādhe tu jale tatra magnāḥ ṣaḍeva tatkṣaṇāt ||71 || taraṇasya kalāṃ naite jānanti
