tena hetunā | sarasyeva tale magnā dhīvarāṇāṃ na hastagāḥ ||72|| abhavaiṃste tale magnāḥ papurjalaṃ viśeṣataḥ | sasmaruḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīparameśvaram || 73|| ārttihaṃ trāṇakartāraṃ nirādhārajalāntare | tuṣṭhuvurmanasā mṛtyupāśādhīnāśca vai harim ||74|| jalamagnāṃ mahīṃ yaśca samuddadhāra sūkaraḥ | jalasthāṃ ca mahānaukāṃ jagrāha makaraśca yaḥ || 75|| jalamagnaṃ mahāśailaṃ pṛṣṭhe kūrmo dadhāra yaḥ | jalamagnaṃ gajaṃ bhaktaṃ yo rarakṣa prabhurhariḥ ||76|| jalamagnaṃ ca vaṇijaṃ rarakṣa bhagavām̐stu yaḥ | jalamagnaṃ mahādeśaṃ coṣṭrālayaṃ rarakṣa yaḥ ||77|| jalamagnaṃ nṛpaṃ yaśca rarakṣodayanaṃ purā | māṃjhāṃbikāṃ jalamagnāṃ samudre saṃrarakṣa yaḥ ||78|| evaṃ cānyān jalamagnān rarakṣa vahudhā prabhuḥ | nijabhaktān yadi satyān manyase tvaṃ narāyaṇa ||79|| tadāsmān dayayā kṛṣṇa santāraya jalāntarāt | mṛtyuste sarvadādhīnaḥ kālaste kavalastathā ||2.118.80|| jalaṃ prāṇanirodhaśca tava śaktivaśau sadā | antarātmā bhavānāste tvakālamṛtyuhārakaḥ ||8 1|| hara duḥkhāni deveśa yadi trātuṃ hi manyase | tvaṃ naukāstvaṃ mahāprāṇastvaṃ jīvastvaṃ ca jīvanam ||82|| tvameva jalamadhye vai prahlādaṃ prāṇado’bhavaḥ | nāsti stutestu samayaḥ prāṇā jalanirodhitāḥ ||83|| sthairyaṃ yānti hṛdātmā ca mūrdhānaṃ pratigacchati | kṣaṇaṃ mṛtyormadhyavarti vidyate nādhikaṃ tataḥ ||84|| ityevaṃ te jalamadhye rādhike’tīva mūrchitāḥ | stutvārpaṇaṃ ca śaraṇaṃ jagmuḥ śrīkambharāsutam ||85|| sarvajño bhagavān śrīśo bālakṛṣṇastvarāyutaḥ | dhṛtvā vai kāmaṭhaṃ rūpaṃ mahākacchapamuttamam ||86|| ṣaḍbhaktān sahasā pṛṣṭhe dhṛtvā tāṃśca jalopari | ānayāmāsa bhagavān nirnaukājalamastake ||87|| mūrchāṃ jalaṃ ca sahasā bālarūpadharaḥ prabhuḥ | hastābhyāṃ ca muhuḥ spṛṣṭvā vārayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ||88|| pītaṃ jalaṃ vilīnaṃ ca karasparśanamātrataḥ | mūrchā dūra gatā cāpi bhānavanto’bhavam̐śca te ||89|| svastidā mahati kūrme sthitān dadṛśurantike | bālaṃ gopālakṛṣṇasya rakṣakaṃ dadṛśustathā ||2.118.90 || divarūpadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā śāntiṃ parāṃ yayuḥ | mārgayadbhirjanaiḥ ṣaṭ te dṛṣṭā vai kamaṭhopari ||9 1 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena rakṣitā iti | sahasā te tadā yātā naukāyāṃ kūrmapṛṣṭhataḥ ||92|| jagṛhustān nāvikā vai kūrmaścādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharo’bhūd bhagavān hi saḥ ||93|| sarvaireva kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ kūrmo jalāntare naraḥ | bālakṛṣṇe layaṃ yātaścaivaṃ dṛṣṭo janaistataḥ ||94|| naukayā tān samagṛhya tīramānīya tatyajuḥ | āścaryaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇacamatkārātmakaṃ prajāḥ ||95|| āvidan rakṣakaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhejurvai bhāvatastataḥ | atha janmotsavapūjāṃ kartuṃ tataśca maṇḍape || 96 || āyayurīśvarā muktā devā devyaśca dehinaḥ | pūjanaṃ sarvavastvādyairvyadhuścārārtrikaṃ vyadhuḥ || 97|| upadāścārpayāmāsustathā pradadurāśiṣaḥ | śrīgopālo mahīmānān bhojayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ || 98|| datvā dānāni bahūni matvopakṛtimuttamām | sarvān visarjayāmāsa mahīmānān yayuśca te ||99|| santāraṇo dvijastatra bālakṛṣṇāya vai tadā | kanyādvayamataṃ jñātvā kanyādvayaṃ dadau mudā || 2.118.10 0|| jagrāha bhagavān kanyāratnadvayaṃ śriyaḥ patiḥ | kanyake kṛtakṛtye ca sañjāte patilābhataḥ || 10 1|| lomaśasyāśrame cobhe lomaśāya harirdadau | rakṣituṃ kanyake brahmapriyābhiḥ saha mādhavaḥ || 1 02|| santāraṇaḥ sapatnīkaḥ saputraḥ śrīharestadā | pūjāṃ janmotsavaṃ kṛtvā dṛṣṭvā kṛteṣṭako’bhavat || 1 03|| ājñāmādāya sa vipro yayau jayantapattanam | rādhike tanmahātīrthaṃ śubhaṃ santāraṇābhidham || 1 04|| abhavad yatra vai kūrmo rājate bhagavān svayam | tīre mandiramadhye ca snānāt saṃsāratārakaḥ || 1 05|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi pāpatāpātsa tārayet| smaraṇādasya mokṣaḥ syāt kiṃ punaḥ sevanātprabhoḥ || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne’śvapaṭṭasarovare caturdaśavarṣīyabālakṛṣṇāṣṭamīprātaḥkāle jalamagnānāṃ santāraṇādiviprāṇāṃ kūrmarūpeṇoddharaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 118 ||
<2.119> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ rādhe bhaktasya vai hareḥ | nāmnā devāyatanasya saurāṣṭravāsinaḥ priye || 1 || grāme samādhiyānākhye bhakto’bhavacchubhāśrayaḥ | ābhīrajātimūrdhanyo devāyatanasaṃjñakaḥ || 2 || nityasnānaparo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritaḥ| hare kṛṣṇa hare svāmin hare nārāyaṇa prabho || 3 || śrīgopāla hare kṛṣṇa kambharāśri rame sati | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama || 4 || akṣareśa prabhārādhāmāṇikīpārvatīpate | satpate muktadhāmeśa bālakṛṣṇa hare hare || 5 || evaṃ nityaṃ kīrtanaṃ sa karoti saritastaṭe | vālukāsu jale cāpi vṛkṣāśraye ca bhūtale || 6 || gṛhe kṣetre vāṭikāsūdyāne’raṇye vane’pi ca | sarvakarmasu kṛṣṇaṃ taṃ parameśaṃ smaratyatha || 7 || bhojane śayane yāne gamane cāsane sadā | mroḍe kṣutau cāplavane śauce cālasyamandire || 8 || catvare ca sabhāyāṃ ca jātikuṭumbakotsave | sūtake śokaviṣaye harṣasthāne’pi sarvadā || 9 || hare kṛṣṇa hare svāmin tālīvādanapūrvakam | nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sarvadā || 2.119.1 0|| śraddhayā sa karotyeva snānottaraṃ ca pūjanam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrteḥ karoti ca || 1 1|| ārārtrikaṃ ca naivedyaṃ phalānnajalaśobhitam | dadātyeva bhagavate bhāvapremaprapūritaḥ || 12|| grāme deśe janāstaṃ tu devāyatarṣisaṃjñayā | prāhurdevāyatarṣiścaikadā vṛkṣatale sthitaḥ || 1 3|| ṭimburuphalamādāya pakvaṃ miṣṭaṃ sukhapradam | sasmāra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nivedanāya vai || 14|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhaktyā vaśaṃgataḥ | āyayau tumburuvṛkṣasthale yatra sa bhaktarāṭ || 15|| bālagopālaveṣo vai samāgatya hasam̐stadā | devāyatanahastābhyāṃ tumburudruphalāni tu || 16|| pakvamiṣṭāni saṃgṛhya bubhuje miṣṭatadrasam | bhakto devāyatanarṣiścāruphalāni saṃdadau || 17|| prasādaṃ kṛṣṇadattaṃ ca bhuṃkte nṛtyati śaṃsati | tallīno mūrtisaṃmagno divyadṛg divyadehavān || 18|| abhavad bandhanaśūnyo vyomākramaṇaśaktimān | bālakṛṣṇaḥ phalānyattvā nadīṃ yāto jalāya tu || 19|| devāyano’pi tatpṛṣṭhe nadīṃ yāto jalāya vai | kṛṣṇākṛṣṭendriyaprāṇavarṣmā vāṭaṃ yayāvanu ||2.119.20|| parvatān vanavṛkṣādīn samullaṃghya hariṃ tvanu | jagāma vyomamārgeṇa nirāvaraṇadehavān ||21 || āyayau kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ cāśvasarovaram | śrīhariṃ dhyānavṛttyā vai lakṣyīkṛtya sarovare ||22|| sasnau śrīkṛṣṇayogena sopānaiśca jalāntare | dehaṃ vismṛtya salile magno’bhūllīlayā kṣaṇāt ||23|| deho vai jalamadhye santiṣṭhanneva jalāvilaḥ | jalaṃ pītvātmanā divyo bhūtvā vai sa jalopari ||24|| hare kṛṣṇa hare ravāminnevaṃ raṭan bahistaṭe | nirgatya divyadehena kṣaṇaṃ tasthau ca yāvatā ||25|| tāvat tasya samāyāto vicāro jīvatārakaḥ | yadyahaṃ divyadehena kārayāmi prajāsu tu || 26|| bhajanaṃ kīrtanaṃ viṣṇorjīvā yāsyanti mokṣaṇam | ityevaṃ saṃvicāryaiva bhajanaṃ śrīhare hare ||27||| kurvan tvāraṇyakaṃ vyāghraṃ siṃhāraṇyaṃ tataḥ param | tataḥ saṃyamanīṃ yāmyāṃ purīṃ gatvāpyakīrtayat ||28|| hare kṛṣṇa hare svāmin hare nārāyaṇa prabho | śrīgopāla hare kṛṣṇa kaṃbharāśri hare vibho ||19|| bālakṛṣṇa ramārādhālakṣmīpāravatīpate | kamaleśa prabhāmāṇikīśa nārāyaṇa prabho ||2.119.3 0|| ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ cakre nāmakīrtanaghoṣaṇām | śrutvā yāmyanigaḍasthā vipāśā bandhanacyutāḥ ||3 1 || babhūvuḥ sahasā śuddhāḥ pāpatāpavivarjitāḥ | muktiyogyā divyadehā vaikuṇṭhayogyadehinaḥ ||3 2|| puṇyadehāśca te bhūtvā śrutvā nāma harermuhuḥ | dharmarājaṃ namaskṛtya yayurbrahma sanātanam ||33|| devāyano’pi yāmyānā bhramitvā sarvabhūmiṣu | bālakṛṣṇasya ca hareḥ śrāvayitvābhidhāṃ muhuḥ || 34|| prajvālya pāpipāpāni preṣayāmāsa dhāma ca | yamadūtā vilokyaitanmahāścaryaṃ yamaṃ prati || 35|| tvaritāḥ prayayurvijñāpayāmāsuraniṣṭakam | yamarāja mahābāho kārāgārāṇi pāpinām ||36|| kenacittu samāgatya saṃśrāvya nāma vai hareḥ | vidhāpyante tu riktāni prayānti brahma pāpinaḥ ||37|| puṇyadehāḥ puṇyarūpāḥ puṇyātmāno vihāyasā | divyayānena vai gantuṃ samarthāste prayānti hi ||38|| nāsmām̐ste gaṇayatyatra yojitān daṇḍadāyinaḥ | tiraskṛtya ca naḥ sarvān pradarśyāṅguṣṭhadantakān ||3 9|| vihasyāsmān prayāntyete paśya riktaṃ puraṃ tava | ityukto yamarājo’sau yāvat paśyati pattanam |||2.119.40|| yāmyaṃ sarvaṃ daṇḍalokaṃ riktaṃ saṃdṛṣṭavām̐stataḥ | taṃ dadarśa divyadehaṃ bhaktaṃ devāyanaṃ hareḥ ||41 | nāma gṛṇantaṃ tānena śrāvayantaṃ ca nārakān | prakṣālayantaṃ pāpāni kurvantaṃ divyamuktatām ||42|| preṣayantaṃ harerdhāma baliṣṭhaṃ sāttvataṃ sthitam | yamarājo vilokyainaṃ bhaktaṃ nanāma bhāvataḥ ||43 || prāha svāgatamarghyaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ dadau tathā | āsanaṃ pradadau tasmai upāviveśa bhaktarāṭ ||44|| papraccha kuśalaṃ sarvaṃ nirāmayaṃ ca nāma ca | āgamaṃ ceti bhaktasya bhakto jagāda vai śubham ||45|| yamaḥ prāha harernāma pāpināṃ pāpanāśakam | bhavān gṛhṇāti bhaktāgrya tadyogyaṃ vai vidhīyate ||46 || saṃsāro’yaṃ tu pāpiṣṭho duḥkhadaḥ karmabhirvṛtaḥ | karmaṇā jāyate jantuḥ karmaṇaiva vilīyate ||47|| karmaṇā bhujyate duḥkhaṃ karmaṇā sukhamāpyate | sādhukarmaprakartā vai svargaṃ prāpnoti caiśvaram ||48|| asādhukarmakartā vai nārakaṃ duḥkhamṛcchati | adharmakṛtakāryāṇāṃ pāpināṃ daṇḍahetave ||49|| viṣṇunā daṇḍaśālātra nirmitā vidyate sadā | tatrāhaṃ sūryaputro’smi niyukto dharmadehavān |||2.119.50|| dharmarūpasya me putro harirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam | kṛṣṇo naraśca te putrāścatvāro mama vai purā ||5 1 || viśālāyāṃ badaryāṃ vai mānasā hyabhavaiṃśca me | tannāmnā sarvadā pāpipāpāni prajvalanti hi ||52|| muktiṃ prayānti jīvāśca karmabhūmerbalāt khalu | yamasya nagaraṃ tvetad dṇḍaśālā hi kevalā ||53|| naiṣā karmakṣitiścāste nātra bhaktapraveśanam | antareṇa phalabhuktiṃ nāsmāt sthānānnivartanam ||54|| ityevaṃ śrīharerājñā manorājñā vidhestathā | tāmanusṛtya caivātra phalaṃ dadāmi dehine ||55|| tanmadhye na kṣatiḥ kāryā yena kenāpi vai kvacit | ityevaṃ niyamastvadya bhakta tvayā pradharṣitaḥ ||56|| avigaṇayya kṛṣṇasya niyamaṃ yad bhavāniha | samāgato’sti pāpānāṃ vināśako vimuktidaḥ ||57|| tad yogyaṃ na kṛtaṃ bhakta mā hareḥ kīrtanaṃ kuru | ityevaṃ cānunīto’pi na mene śrīharerbalāt ||58||| prāha bhakto yamaṃ tatra muñcedaṃ vyādhapattanam | harernāmnā tu te dharma muktiṃ karomi te’pi ca ||59|| hare kṛṣṇa hare svāmin vada nārāyaṇeti ca | bhajainaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ vācamanyāṃ vimuñca vai ||2.119.6 0|| taṃ viditvā cātimṛtyumupaiti netarā sṛtiḥ | mokṣārthaṃ khalu jīvānāṃ muktidānaṃ paraṃ matam ||6 1 || dīnānāthadaridrāṇāmaśaktānāṃ pramokṣaṇam | ajñānāṃ cāpyasurāṇāṃ rakṣasāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ sadā ||62 || kāryaṃ vijānatā nityaṃ saṃsāre pāpasaṃkule | mayā tvatra samāgatya pāpināṃ pāpavārdhayaḥ ||6 3 || pradahyante harernāmnā tad yogyaṃ kriyate yama | eko’pi mānavastvatra nāmnā ceduddhareditaḥ ||64|| tasya puṇyasya vai pāraṃ naiva paśyāmi sūryaja | yamadūtāḥ kathaṃ nvete rakṣitā rākṣasā iva ||65|| dīyatāṃ vai tvayā tebhyaścādyadinādabhṛtyatām || śravaṇādyāścitraguptāḥ pragacchantu ca mokṣaṇam ||66|| śrāvayāmi harernāma kurvantu nirjanāṃ purīm | vasantu bhagavadbhaktāḥ sarve duḥkhavivarjitāḥ || 67|| prakṣālayantu yantrāṇi pāpināṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kuru | vaiṣṇavāśca bhavantyeva sarve dayālusāttvatāḥ ||68|| harernāmabalāt sarvān mokṣayiṣye na saṃśayaḥ | yāmyāpurī bhavatveṣā svargapurī sukhānvitā ||6 9|| pāpiriktāṃ karomyeṣo bhajanena hareriha | yatheṣṭaṃ kuru yāmyeśa bhaja nārāyaṇaṃ harim ||2.119.70|| ityuktvā ca yamaṃ natvā bhajannārāyaṇaṃ harim | bālakṛṣṇaṃ hṛdi dhṛtvā yayau kuṇḍeṣu pāpinām ||7 1 || harekṛṣṇa haresvāmin harenārāyaṇa prabho | bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa śrīpate pārvatīpate ||72|| parabrahmākṣarātīta māṇikīśa ramāpate | rādhālakṣmīpate kṛṣṇa prabhāpate’va pāpinaḥ || 73|| ityevaṃ karatālābhyāṃ śabdayan kaṇṭhatastathā | purīṃ yāmyāṃ sukhayaṃśca pāpinaḥ parito yayau ||74|| asaṃkhyān pāpinastvevaṃ saṃśrāvya kīrtanaṃ manum | pāpāni saṃpradāhyaiva preṣayāmāsa cākṣaram || 75|| yamarājo vihvalaḥ san yayau kuṃkumavāpikām | akṣaraṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ divyaṃ cāśvasarovaram ||76|| akasmācchrīhareścāgre tvāgatya daṇḍavat bhuvi | patitaḥ sāśrunetraśca maunamāsthāya saṃsthitaḥ ||77|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | jānannapi nṛnāṭyena papracchainaṃ hi kāraṇam ||78|| jagāda yamarājo’pi bhaktaṃ yāmye samāgatam | arpayantaṃ pramuktiṃ ca pāpibhyo nāmakīrtanāt ||72|| hariḥ prāha tu tacchrutvā bhaktādhīno’smyahaṃ yama | bhaktecchāpūrakaścāsmi bhaktavaśyaḥ karomi kim ||2.119.80|| na niroddhumahaṃ śaktastvenaṃ brahmādayo’pi ca | tasmācchṛṇu mamājñāṃ tvaṃ mā śucaścātra saṃbhave ||8 1 || ekavāraṃ yāmyalokaṃ riktaṃ kārayituṃ hi te | madbhaktāya tu samayaṃ dehi paścāt gamiṣyati ||82||| riktāyāṃ yamapuryāṃ sa nāvalokya tu pāpinaḥ | kṛtakāryaṃ tu matvā svaṃ svayaṃ gato bhaviṣyati ||83|| adya me janidivasaścaturdaśasamākṛtaḥ | pāpināṃ nigaḍānāṃ vai mokṣaṇaṃ bhavatād yama || 84|| ityukto yamarājo’pi kṛṣṇājñāṃ prāpya pūjanam | hareścakāra vidhinā mumude sukhataḥ sthitaḥ ||85|| bhojayāmāsa bhagavān yamarājaṃ tataḥ param | dadau ca mukuṭaṃ tasmai sauvarṇaṃ mastake hariḥ ||86|| kaṇṭhe hāraṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ ratnahīrakaśobhitam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||87|| mantraṃ dadau ca tulasīmālāṃ yameśvarāya vai | pāritoṣyaṃ dadau mūrtiṃ pratimāṃ svāṃ suvarṇajām ||88|| tataśca bhagavān bālakṛṣṇo jagāda sūryajam | bhaktaṃ devāyanaṃ brūhi jaya kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa ||8 9|| vimānaṃ sarvagāmyetad dehi tasmai sukhāspadam | yātrārthaṃ sarvalokānāṃ kalpavallyādi saṃśritam || 2.119.90|| adhiruhya prayāhi tvaṃ yamarāja vimānakam | prasādaṃ tu mama nītvā dehi sarvebhya eva ca ||9 1|| tvatpuraṃ pāvanaṃ cāstu cādyāparādhivarjitam | devāyane prayāte tu punaḥ pūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati ||92|| ityukto yamarājaḥ sa rādhike śrīhariṃ tadā | natvā kṛtvā daṇḍavacca bhūtvā vai vaiṣṇavo mahān ||93 || yayau vimānavaryeṇa yāmyaṃ naijaṃ puraṃ punaḥ | śrāvayāmāsa sarvebhyo yadvṛttaṃ harisannidhau ||94|| devāyano’pi yacchrutvā mumude’ti nanarta ca | nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ cakre bhramitvā paritaḥ puram ||95|| riktaṃ yamapuraṃ cakre saṃśrāvya nāma vai hareḥ | yamarājo dadau tasmai prasādaṃ ca vimānakam ||96|| yamadūtāḥ pāpināṃ ca pīḍanaṃ prajahustataḥ | mocitā nigaḍebhyaśca bandhanebhyastathā tadā ||97|| gatāḥ sarve harernāmnā svargaṃ satyaṃ sukhāśrayam | vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāpi golokaṃ cāvyākṛtaṃ tathāmṛtam ||98|| akṣaraṃ dhāma paramaṃ nivartante na yadgatāḥ | ityevaṃ sucamatkāro dṛṣṭo jāto janaistadā ||99|| caturdaśasthalokairvai tathā dhāmanivāsibhiḥ | bhuktimuktipradaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samartho na karoti kim || 2.119.10 0|| yasya sarvaṃ yatra sarvaṃ yadvaśe sarvameva ca | yasmāt sarvaṃ sa vai śāstā kiṃ na karoti rādhike|| 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne devāyatanarṣibhakto yamapuryāṃ śrīharernāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ kṛtvā yāmyān sarvān mocayāmāsetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 119 ||
<2.120> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścād yāmyalokaiḥ prapūjitaḥ | devāyatanabhaktastu pūjāṃ prāpya yamārpitām || 1 || vimānena yayau tasmānnairṛtāṃ diśamekalaḥ | dadarśa nagarīṃ ramyāṃ svargatulyāṃ suvarṇajām || 2 || nirṛtānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ prāsādairabhiśobhitām | lakṣayojanavistīrṇaprākārapariveṣṭitām || 3 || mṛṣāmāyendrajālānāṃ śālābhiḥ ṛddhisaṃbhṛtām | arbudārbudapadmānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ kuṭumbakaiḥ || 4 || niṣevitāṃ mahāsvargopamāṃ cāmbarasaṃsthitām | sūryavad bhrājamānāṃ tāṃ vilokya bhaktarāṭ tadā || 5 || dīrghasvareṇa tālādyaiḥ sahitaṃ kīrtanaṃ hareḥ | harekṛṣṇa haresvāmin harenārāyaṇa prabho || 6 || bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa parabrahma ramāpate | lakṣmīpate māṇikīśa pāravatīprabhāpate || 7 || śrīgopāla satāṃpāla rādheśa kaṃbharātmaja | akṣareśa ca gopeśa mukteśa kuṃkumādhipa || 8 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo parameśa janārdana | muktinātha mahāviṣṇo śrīpate puruṣottama || 9 || evaṃ nairṛtapuryāṃ sa vicarannambare gṛṇan | nāmāni śrāvayāmāsa nairṛtebhyo manuṃ tathā || 2.120.1 0|| nairṛtāśca prajālokāḥ śrutvā śrutvā śubhāṃ giram | niṣpāpā abhavan rakṣogaṇāśca divyavigrahāḥ || 11 || rakṣobhāvavihīnāśca divyapārṣadadehinaḥ | sambhūya muktarūpāśca vihāya nagarīṃ nijām || 1 2|| yayurbhaktabalenaiva kalpalatotthavāhanaiḥ | gajayānairvimānaiśca devāyanārpitaistadā || 13|| akṣaraṃ brahmalokaṃ te tathā vaikuṇṭhamityapi | tathā golokamevānye’mṛtaṃ vāvyākṛtaṃ pare || 14|| yatheṣṭaṃ pārṣadā bhūtvā tattaddhāmasu te gatāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmaśraveṇa te || 15|| mahāpuṇyābdhayo bhūtvā yayurvai brahma śāśvatam | atha tasmātpradeśāt sa vyomnā vai vāruṇīṃ purīm || 16|| paścimāyāṃ yayau kurvan nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ | lakṣayojanavistīrṇaprākārāntaḥkṛtāśrayām || 17|| dadarśa tāṃ bhraman vyomnā vimānena samantataḥ | śrāvayāmāsa janatāḥ prācetasīrmuhurmuhuḥ || 18|| tāḥ sarvāśca prajā divyā bhūtvā śrutvābhidhāṃ manum | kalpavallīkṛtairyānairyayuste dhāma caiśvaram || 19|| narā nāryo divyadehāḥ sarvathā divyarūpiṇaḥ | bhinnadhāmāni ca yayurdevāyanasamāgamāt ||2.120.20|| atha tasmātpradeśācca vyomnā vai vāyavīṃ purīm | yayau devāyano bhakto gṛṇannāma harermuhuḥ ||21 || vāyūnāṃ devatāḥ sarvā marutāṃ sṛṣṭayastathā | vāyavīyaśarīrāste śrutvābhidhāṃ manuṃ hareḥ ||22|| lakṣayojanamadhyasthāstadā purīprajājanāḥ | divyadehadharā bhūtvā yayurdhāma hareḥ khalu ||23|| vimānaṃ tu bhramad vyomnā sarvāṃ prācetasīṃ purīm | prajāstatra sthitāḥ saṃśrāvayāmāsa hare hare ||24|| devāyano’pi tāḥ saṃpreṣayāmāsa harergṛham | tathānyānyapi dhāmāni kalpavallīvimānakaiḥ ||25|| athottarāṃ diśaṃ devāyanarṣiḥ prayayau tataḥ | kauberīṃ supurīṃ lakṣayojanāyatadurgikām || 26 || dadarśāmbaramārgeṇa gṛṇan nāma manuṃ hareḥ | tāṃ bhraman savimānena tadgatāṃ yakṣakaprajām || 27|| śrāvayāmāsa nāmāni kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho | harebrahma parabrahma yakṣān muktān cakāra saḥ ||28|| kṣayaṃ yātāni pāpāni yakṣāṇāṃ puṇyaśālinām | puṇyānyeṣāṃ vardhitāni nārāyaṇaśruterbalāt || 29|| divyadehāstato bhūtvā muktadehāḥ samantataḥ | kalpavallīsamutpannavimānairakṣarābhigaiḥ ||2.120.30 || yayuste tāṃ purīṃ tyaktvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca gavāṃ sthalīm | akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ prāpuste śrīharerbalāt || 31 || atha devāyano bhakto yayau ceśānapālitām | diśaṃ vilokayāmāsa purīṃ tatreśapālitām ||32|| lakṣayojanadurgāntarvartinīṃ rudraśobhitām | śatarudrāḥ koṭirudrāḥ śaṃkarā īśamūrtayaḥ ||33 || īśānyo rudrapatnyaśca yatrārbudābjakoṭayaḥ | bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca kūṣmāṇḍāśca vināyakāḥ ||34|| vetālāśca kumārāśca bhairavā gaṇakoṭayaḥ | vīrāśca bhadradevāśca ḍākinyaḥ śākinīgaṇāḥ ||35|| yoginyo yoginaścāpi yatayaśca virāgiṇaḥ | vetālanyaśca kūṣmāṇḍyaḥ kṛtyāśca pūtanāgaṇāḥ ||36|| durgāśca nandinaścāpi caṇḍāścaṇḍyaḥ satīgaṇāḥ | ete yatrāsaṃkhyadāsadāsīgaṇāvasanti hi || 37|| īśānasya harasyaiva dṛṣṭā devāyanena hi | tato vimānaṃ vyomni tad bhrāmayāmāsa bhaktarāṭ ||38|| jagādoccairharernāmānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇa | kambharānandana viṣṇo gopālabāla mādhava || 39|| bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa puruṣottama keśava | antarātman prabhākānta śrīkānta parameśvara ||2.120.40 || harekṛṣṇa haresvāmin harenārāyaṇa prabho | svāminnārāyaṇa nārāyaṇeśvara rameśvara ||41 || māṇikyeśvara māyeśa pārvatīśvara bhūpate | līlāpate vibhūtīśa rādhāpate satāṃpate ||42|| śrīvallabha śrīpadmeśa śrīkṛṣṇa śrīnarāyaṇa | śrīrāma śrīkamaleśa maṃgalāyatana prabho ||43|| ityevaṃ sa gṛṇan kṛṣṇanāmāni ca manuṃ hareḥ | śrāvayāmāsa sarvāṃśca mokṣayāmāsa karmataḥ ||44|| divyadehamayān kṛtvā dhāmayogyān gaṇān śubhān | viṣṇutulyān śaṃbhudāsān dāsīḥ ramāsamāstathā |||42|| preṣayāmāsa vaikuṇṭhaṃ golokaṃ cākṣaraṃ tathā | amṛtākhyaṃ divyadhāmāvyākṛtaṃ ca kilāsakam ||46| | sāketaṃ cāpi ye yasya yogyāstām̐statra cairayat | muktiṃ kṛtvā tu vai teṣāṃ nāmakīrtanato hareḥ ||47|| vimānaiḥ preṣayitvaiva tataḥ pūrvāṃ diśaṃ yayau | ujjvalāṃ koṭisūryābhāṃ dadarśendrapurīṃ śubhām ||48|| lakṣayojanaprākāravartinīṃ smṛddhisaṃbhṛtām | rājadhānīṃ divo ramyāṃ lokapālālayāṃ parām ||49|| sarvasuvarṇaprāsādāṃ dikpālādyadhivāsitām | grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ prāsādairabhiśobhitām ||2.120.50|| ketūnāṃ suravargāṇāmālayairabhitaḥ kṛtām | mandiraiḥ sarvasiddhīnāṃ vasūnāṃ ca sumandiraiḥ ||51 || nidhīnāṃ mandiraiścāpi saptarṣīṇāṃ nivāsanaiḥ | kṛttikānāṃ mahāsaudhairdiśāṃ prāsādakairyutām |52|| rudrāṇāṃ cāpi sūryāṇāṃ kāmānāṃ cālayairyutām | manūnāṃ ca kalānāṃ ca tithīnāṃ mandirairyutām ||53|| marutāṃ vālakhilyānāṃ cāruṇānāṃ nivāsanaiḥ | devīnāmapsarasāṃ brahmasarasāṃ tathālayaiḥ ||54|| tattvānāṃ susamudyānaiḥ kalpadrumaiḥ samantataḥ | amṛtānāṃ ca kulyābhirbrahmavāṭyabhiśobhitām |||55|| sūtairmāgadhalokaiśca bandījanaiḥ prasevitām | bhāṭacāraṇagandharvaiḥ kimpuruṣaiśca kinnaraiḥ ||56|| sādhyadevairviśvadevaiḥ siddhaiśca rājabhiryutām | sarvaśreṣṭhāṃ rājadhānīṃ vilokya cātisaṃbhṛtām ||57|| vividhairdehibhiḥ ramyāṃ bhinnajātīyavāsibhiḥ | harṣaṃ prāpyātivegena devāyanarṣirutsukaḥ ||58|| kīrtayāmāsa nāmāni bālakṛṣṇasya vai manum | harekṛṣṇa haresvāmin harenārāyaṇa prabho ||59|| bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa rāmakṛṣṇa janārdana | śrīgopāla satāṃpāla kaṃbharānandana prabho ||2.120.60|| brahmapriyāpate rādhāpate ramāpate vibho | ātmapate prāṇapate parabrahma pareśvara ||61 || sarvalokapate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabhāpate | māṇikyeśvara māyeśa sureśvareśvareśvara ||62|| śrībhūpāravatīkānta svāminnārāyaṇa prabho | akṣareśvara mukteśa mokṣaprada mahāprabho ||63|| bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa lakṣmīkānta divaspate | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama ||64|| nārāyaṇeśa kṛṣṇeśa kṛṣṇavallabhasatpate | vidyāvyāsāvatāreśa naranārāyaṇa prabho ||65|| evaṃ nāmāni bahudhā gṛṇan tālī pravādayan | bhrāmayan svaṃ vimānaṃ cābhitaścaindrīṃ purīṃ tadā ||66|| rādhike bhaktarāṭ devāyatanaḥ sāttvatāgraṇīḥ | mokṣayāmāsa devāṃśca mahendrapuravāsinaḥ ||67|| divyadehān muktadehān dhāmayogyān vidhāya saḥ | preṣayāmāsa kalpadrulatotthaiśca vimānakaiḥ ||68|| vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ cāvyākṛtaṃ golokamakṣaram | paramaṃ dhāma muktānāṃ vāsārhaṃ kārṣṇavāllabham ||69|| dharmabhaktiyutaṃ sarvasvāminā paramātmanā | adhiṣṭhitaṃ paraṃdhāma parameśaniṣevitam ||2.120.70|| devā naikavidhā devyo divyadehāścaturbhujāḥ | dvibhujāścāṣṭahastāśca tathā ṣoḍaśabāhavaḥ ||7 1 || bhūtvā bhūtvā ca nāmāni śrutvā dhāma yayurhareḥ | evaṃ svargasthitān kṛtvā muktān nāmnāṃ prakīrtanaiḥ ||72|| devāyatanabhaktaśca yayāvagnipurīṃ tataḥ | yatrāgnayo vibhinnāśca vasanti koṭyasaṃkhyakāḥ ||73 || garbhāgnayaśca pākānāmagnayo jāṭharāgnayaḥ | ūṣmāgnayastathā homāgnayaḥ kṣveḍāgnayastathā ||74|| cintāgnayastathā devāgnayaścitāgnayastathā | dāvāgnayaḥ śītavahnigaṇāścāmāgnayastathā ||75|| pretāgnayaśca devānāṃ mukharūpāgnayastathā | pāvakaḥ pavamānaśca paviḥ śmaśānajāstathā ||76|| ghaṭāgnayaḥ sarvabhakṣā havyabhakṣāgnayastathā | vaḍavānalarūpāśca tathā meghānalādayaḥ ||77|| ārtavā agnayaścāpi krūrāḥ saumyā gaṇāstathā | khanyagnayaśca bhūtānāmagnayo bhinnajātayaḥ ||78|| śvetā raktāstathā kṛṣṇā nīlā pītā haridguṇāḥ | kapīśāḥ saptajihvāśca bahujihvāḥ pradāhakāḥ ||79|| tān sarvān vīkṣya bhakteśo’mbare vimānasaṃsthitaḥ | kīrtayāmāsa bahudhoccakairnāmāni vai hareḥ ||2.120.80|| manuṃ saṃśrāvayāmāsa hare kṛṣṇa hare hare | bālakṛṣṇa parabrahma māṇikīrādhikāpate ||81 || yajñanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇavallabha śrīsatīpate | parameśvara deveśa muktadhāmapate hare ||82|| prabhākānta ramākānta kamalākānta mādhava | śrībhūlīlāpate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa satīpate |||83 || lakṣmīnātha ca dīnānāṃ pate brahmapriyāpate | pārvatīlalitāsvāmin vṛndāvibhūtipālaka ||84|| sarvavahnipate viṣṇo mahāviṣṇo narāyaṇa | sarvāvatāraheto śrīpate gopālanandana ||85|| ityevaṃ bhaktarāṭ devāyatano nāma vai hareḥ | gṛṇan saṃśrāvayāmāsa tālavādanakaiḥ saha ||86 || bhramitvā parito vahneḥ purīṃ lakṣāyatāṃ śubhām | vahnīn vahniprajāḥ sarvā divyā bhaktaścakāra ha ||87|| dvibhujān sucaturbāhūn bahubāhūn parān śubhān | nāmakīrtanasāmarthyāt kṛtvā datvā manuṃ hareḥ ||88|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mama sarvadā ||89 || kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt | śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava || 2.120.90|| brahmāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto’smi śāśvataḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me || 91 || kṛṣṇavallabhabhaktohaṃ śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama | ityevaṃ tu manūn tebhyo datvā muktān vidhāpya ca || 92||| vaiṣṇavān dhāmayogyām̐śca vimāneṣu niṣādya ca | preṣayāmāsa tān dhāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ tathā ||9 3 || avyākṛtaṃ ca golokaṃ paramākṣaradhāma ca | jayaśabdān prakurvanto yayuste dhāma vai hareḥ ||94|| ityevaṃ rādhike bhakto devāyatanasaṃjñakaḥ | śrīhareścātmavedī vai mokṣakartābhavatpurā ||95 || aṣṭānāṃ dikprapālānāṃ dhāmabhyastāḥ prajāḥ sa hi | mokṣayāmāsa sarvāśca preṣayāmāsa mokṣaṇam ||96 || nāmakīrtanabhaktyaiva balena śrīharestathā | manūn datvā sa sarvebhyo vidhāya vaiṣṇavān śubhān || 97|| riktān vai tatpradeśām̐śca kārayāmāsa nāmataḥ | na bhūto vā na ca bhāvī devāyanasamo muniḥ || 98|| ādyasṛṣṭau hi bhakto’yaṃ sañjātaḥ kṛṣṇavigrahaḥ | atha tasyā diśaścāyaṃ bhakto vimānamāsthitaḥ || 99|| āyayau kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre harṣasamanvitaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā puraḥ sthitaḥ || 2.120.10 0|| bālakṛṣṇaḥ samutthāya taṃ bhaktaṃ pariṣasvaje | dadau hṛdaye caraṇau hastau ca mastake tathā || 101 || prasādaṃ bhojayāmāsa gale hāraṃ dadau hariḥ | ūrje dhavalapratipaddine tasmai hariḥ prabhuḥ || 1 02|| dadau pāritoṣikaṃ ca tathāvāsaṃ nijālaye | sa viśrāntiṃ tataścakre kārtike pūrṇimāvadhim || 103 || rādhike paṭhanādasyā madbhaktasya camatkṛteḥ | pāṭhanācchrāvaṇādvāpi śravaṇānmuktibhāgbhavet || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne devāyatanarṣerbhaktyā prasanno bālakṛṣṇastadvaśībhūto jalāttaṃ rarakṣa, aṣṭadikpālaprajābhyaḥ śrīharernāma śrāvayitvā taddvārā tāsāṃ muktiṃ cakāretyādinirūpaṇanāmā viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 120 ||
<2.121> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rāseśvari mahādevi rādhe golokakaumudi | ākarṇaya kathāṃ devāyatanasya tataḥ parām || 1 || parabrahmabalenāsau muktatāṃ tu samarjayan | parabrahmasamaṃ kāryaṃ karotyeva nideśataḥ || 2 || mārgāsitasya pratipaddine kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | prāha bhaktaṃ pūjayantaṃ bahuvastubhirādarāt || 3 || bālakṛṣṇo’hamevāsmi parabrahmaparātparaḥ | parameśaḥ sarvanārāyaṇānāmīśitā prabhuḥ || 4 || sarve nārāyaṇā mattaḥ prāvirbhavanti sarvadā | sarvasṛṣṭiṣu bhaktendra me’vatārā asaṃkhyakāḥ || 5 || mama rūpāṇyasaṃkhyāni guṇaiśvaryamayānyapi | teṣāṃ yogena jīvānāṃ karomi śreya uttamam || 6 || mama bhaktāḥ pārṣadāśca satyo brāhmyo’pi me priyāḥ | āvirbhavanti lokeṣu tārayanti ca dehinaḥ || 7 || tvaṃ sadā mama mukto’si mamālayo’si vai hṛdi | mannivāso’si bhaktendra matkāryaṃ kriyate tvayā || 8 || jīvā yāmyā aiśvarāśca devā uddhāritāstvayā | athāpi kṣitiloke’tra yāhi kiṃpuruṣottarān || 9 || himālayāt pare pāre prajākalyāṇahetave | sindhumullaṃghya śailaṃ ca paramindukuśaṃ tataḥ || 2.121.10|| kaśyapāyanavārdhiṃ ca tathā ca urulāṃ nadīm | urulaṃ parvataṃ cāpi kārusamudramityapi || 1 1|| trimuraṃ dvīpakalpaṃ ca tandrāpradeśamityapi | śāntalāriṃ pradeśaṃ ca kāmacāṭakadeśakān || 12| stenāvāsaṃ parvataṃ ca tathā śailaṃ prabhānulam | dvikalaṃ ca saraścāpi samānaṃ parvataṃ tathā || 1 3|| kīragarjanabhūbhāgaṃ śibirājapradeśakān obīnadīpradeśam̐śca yāneśīsarito bhuvam || 14|| bīnāṃ nadīṃ piṃgadeśān yātu tvaṃ raśanābhuvam | uttarān raśanāsaṃjñān bhāgān kiṃpuruṣasya vai || 19|| tatratyamānavān sarvān vaiṣṇavān kuru bhaktarāṭ | bhajanaṃ ca manuṃ nāmnāṃ kīrtanaṃ śrāvayāniśam || 16|| vimānaṃ sacamatkāraṃ mahāścaryamayaṃ mahat | kalpavallīkalpavṛkṣacintāmaṇisamanvitam || 17|| gṛhīpvā ca prayāhyevaṃ jīvānuddhartumādarāt | pradyumnaṃ mama rūpaṃ ca sāhāyyaṃ te dadāmyapi || 18|| ityuktvā suvimānaṃ ca datvā pradyumnamityapi | preṣayāmāsa bhagavān mārgaśīrṣe’sita dale || 19|| yathoktena tu mārgeṇa devāyatanabhaktarāṭ | indukuśaṃ cābhivīkṣya mumude manasā muhuḥ || 2.121.20|| bhajanaṃ coccakaiścakre bālakṛṣṇa harehare | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin śrīmadgopālanandana ||21|| parabrahma harekṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śriyaḥpate | rādhākṛṣṇa prabhākṛṣṇa māṇikīkṛṣṇa mādhava ||22|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇa svāminnārāyaṇa narāyaṇa | jaya muktapate satāṃpata śrīpārvatīpata ||23|| sarvāvatāradhartastvaṃ jayaśrīkṛṣṇavallabha | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama ||24|| harekṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa hare hare | haresvāmin rāmakṛṣṇa sītāpate satīpate ||255||| rāmakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa kṛṣṇarāmajanārdana | kaṃbharānandana śrīmadgopālabāla keśava ||26|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥsūrya akṣarakṣetracandramaḥ | śrīmatkuṃkumavāpīstha jayakṛṣṇanarāyaṇa ||27|| harekṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa harehare | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīparameśvara ||28|| brahmapriyāpate kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa kṛṣṇaharehare | padmāpate ca kamalāpate śrītulasīpate ||29|| vṛndāpate tathā cātmapate kṛṣṇaharehare | bhārgavīkānta lalitākānta gopīpatehare ||2.121.30|| ityevaṃ kīrtanaṃ nāmnāṃ kurvan saṃgarjayan muhuḥ | ninādayan diśaḥ sarvāḥ prajābhyaḥ śrāvayan muhuḥ ||3 1 || vimānena yayau tvagre kaśyapāyanavārnidhim | tasya pūrvapradeśeṣu prajāḥ saṃśrāvayan tataḥ ||32|| ūrulāsaritaḥ pūrvapradeśeṣu punaḥ punaḥ | saṃśrāvayan harernāmakīrtanaṃ vyomamārgataḥ ||33|| urulāt parvatāt pūrvadeśān kārusamudrataḥ | pūrvadakṣiṇadeśām̐śca śrāvayannabhidhā hareḥ ||34|| trimuraṃ dvīpakalpaṃ ca yayau tandrāprajāsu ca | śrāvayāmāsa tannāma himaśaityasahāḥ prajāḥ ||35|| śāntalāripradeśām̐śca tato vai kāmacāṭakān | stenāvāsaṃ giriṃ cāpi dvikalaṃ ca sarovaram ||36|| prabhālunagiriṃ cāpi samānaṃ parvataṃ yayau | bālakṛṣṇasaraścāpi kīragarjanabhūtalam ||37|| śibirājapradeśām̐śca obīṃ yāneśakīṃ nadīm | bīnāṃ pigapradeśām̐śca sarvāṃ ca raśanābhuvam ||38|| rāśiyānapradeśām̐śca bhramitvā tu punaḥ punaḥ | śrāvayāmāsa vai sarvān janān nāmāni vai hareḥ || 39|| saptakṛtvo dadau cakraṃ rāśiyāneṣu rāśivat | uktasthalīyalokeṣu bhūśailaraṇavāriṣu ||2.121.40|| vanāraṇyahimadvīpopadvīpāntarabhūmiṣu | vimānena dadau cakraṃ śrāvayāmāsa kīrtanam ||41|| bālakṛṣṇaṃ harikṛṣṇaṃ parabrahma bhajantviha | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kurvantu vai hṛdi ||42||| karṇābhyāṃ tatkathāṃ ramyāṃ pāpatāpapraṇāśinīm | śṛṇvantu cakṣuṣā tvasya kurvantu darśanaṃ sadā ||42|| kaṇṭhe tasyaiva tulasīmālāṃ gṛhṇantu mānavāḥ | bhakṣayantu prasādaṃ ca pibantu tajjalaṃ śubham ||44|| kīrtayantu ca nāmāni bālakṛṣṇasya sarvadā | spṛśantu tasya caraṇau jighrantu gandhamasya ca ||45|| pūjayantu hariṃ nityaṃ śrīmadgopālabālakam | smarantu śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ kurvantu tasya vai stutim ||46|| śaraṇaṃ tasya kṛṣṇasya gṛhṇantu mokṣahetave | bhuktimuktipradaścāsya caraṇaḥ saṃ prasevyatām ||47|| dhāryatāṃ hṛdye mūrtiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai | parabrahmasvarūpaḥ sa vartate puruṣottamaḥ ||48|| saurāṣṭre kambharāgehe śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | aho lokā dehanāśe saha nāyānti kiñcana ||49|| sarvaṃ cātraiva tiṣṭhatyāvināśaṃ ca mṛṣā tataḥ | tadbandhanaṃ vihāyaiva bhajantu parameśvaram ||2.121.50 || ahaṃ tasyaiva bhakto’smi sākṣānnārāyaṇasya ha | tannāmāni raṭantvatra smarantvarthaṃ hariṃ prabhum ||5 1|| brahmadhāmeśvaraṃ sādhupatiṃ śrīmāṇikīpatim | muktanāthaṃ cātmanāthaṃ smarantu narayoṣitaḥ ||52||| mānuṣasya tu deho’yaṃ durlabho durlabhā gatiḥ | mokṣasyānena dehena prāpyate sādhanaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||53|| haresvāmin harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa janārdana | dharmaputra hare brahmapara śrīparameśvara ||54|| rādhāramāsatīsvāmin prabhāpāravatīpate | lakṣmīśrīmaṃgalākānta śrījayālalitāpate ||55|| bhagavan sarvalokeśa sarvanārāyaṇeśvara | avatāreśa dhāmeśa tattveśvara prabho hare ||56|| evaṃ saṃkīrtayantveva bhuktirmuktirbhaveddhi vaḥ | ityevaṃ saptavāraṃ sa bhaktarāḍ rādhike muhuḥ ||57|| rāśiyāneṣu deśeṣu śrāvayāmāsa kīrtanam | janāḥ śrutvā vimāna ca dṛṣṭvā divyaṃ sukhapradam |||58|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā ābālavṛddhamānavāḥ | draṣṭuṃ sambhūya ca bahiḥ samāyānti sma cāmbare ||59|| vilokayanti bahudhā kīrtayanti hariṃ tathā | bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇasvāmin kṛṣṇa hare hare ||2.121.60|| praśaṃsanti guruṃ bhaktaṃ devāyatanamīśavat | aho mātā pitā bandhurbhagavannāmadāyakaḥ ||61|| patiḥ patnī priyo mitraṃ harernāmnāṃ pradāyakaḥ | sutaḥ putrī sakhā saṃśrāvako nāmnāṃ harerhi saḥ ||62|| sutādayastu ye bhaktiṃ naivātra bodhayanti vai | te tu svārthaparā loke nāmamātrasya dhārakāḥ ||63|| durlabho mānuṣo deho dehināṃ kṣīṇadharmakaḥ | akṣīṇaṃ tvakṣaraṃ dhāma prāptavyaṃ tena dhīmatā ||64|| parameśvarabhaktau ye nirodhayanti mānavāḥ | na te sambandhino mānyāḥ sambandhino hi bhaktidāḥ ||65|| vimāne yaḥ sthito devaḥ kṛṣṇabhaktipradarśakaḥ | so’tra deśe gṛhe no’tra samāyātu pratāpavān ||56|| vayaṃ bhaktiṃ kariṣyāmo bālakṛṣṇasya devate | āruhyāsmadgṛhān deva pāvayāsmadgṛhāṇi ca ||67|| ityevaṃ te janāḥ sarve rāśiyānapradeśakāḥ | śrutvā śrutvā harernāma prārthayāmāsurādarāt ||68|| atha tatrābhavanmukhyāḥ ṛṣayo dvādaśottamāḥ | bhinnasthāneṣu tiṣṭhantastrikālajñā virāgiṇaḥ ||69|| rādhike te harerbhaktaṃ vimānaṃ bhaktiśobhitam | vijñāya vyomamārgeṇa vimānaṃ prati cāyayuḥ ||2.121.70|| meṣāyano maharṣiśca vṛṣabhāyana yogirāṭ | mithunāyananāmarṣiḥ karkāyanaśca tāpasaḥ ||7 1|| siṃhāyanastathā kanyāyanastulāyanastathā | vṛścikāyananāmarṣirdhanāyanaśca vai ṛṣiḥ ||72|| makarāyanasaṃjñarṣiḥ kuṃbhāyanastathāṛṣiḥ | mīnāyanaṛṣiścāpi sarve yogaparāyaṇāḥ ||73|| rāśiyānapradeśeṣu labdhasthānā maharṣayaḥ | brahmadhyānaparāścāsan sarve bhinnanivāsinaḥ ||74|| brahmajñānaparāścāpi samādhisthitivartinaḥ | jñātvā yogena ca devāyatanaṃ harideśitam ||75 || bodhayantaṃ janān loke kīrtanaṃ śrīhareḥ śubham | draṣṭuṃ vyomni vimāne te tvāyayurharṣavihvalāḥ ||76|| prathamaṃ te tu ṛṣayaḥ prajārūpeṇa bhaktakam | nemulauṃkikarītyaiva satkṛtā bhaktakena ca ||77|| vanditāḥ pūjitāḥ praśaṃsitā dhanyavacāyitāḥ | niṣāditāśca bhaktena jijñāsitāḥ pratīṣṭakam ||78|| pṛṣṭāḥ paricayārthaṃ ca jagaduste nijodbhavam | vayaṃ sarve bhrātaraḥ sma rudraputrā hi rudrajāḥ ||79|| brahmaṇā prathamaṃ sṛṣṭirlalāṭād yā kṛtā tadā | rudro jātaḥ krūraputro vṛddhaye viniyojitaḥ ||2.121.80|| tenāsaṃkhyāḥ samā svena rudrā vai prakaṭīkṛtāḥ | krūrāste brahmaṇā dṛṣṭāḥ saṃhāriṇo’vamāninaḥ ||8 1 || teṣāṃ saṃharaṇārthaṃ vai brahmā rudraṃ jagād ha | rudrasteṣāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ yadā saṃhāramācarat ||82|| tadā vayaṃ bhayaṃ prāptā dvādaśa rudraputrakāḥ | rudrā eva svakaṃ rūpaṃ pravivṛttya jalāntare ||83 || gahvare ca guhāyāṃ ca khanyāṃ droṇyāṃ yathāyatham | guptā jīvanavāñcchāḍhyā līnabhāvamupāgatāḥ ||84|| bahuvarṣasahasrānte brahmā tapastato’karot | rudrasṛṣṭervināśānte dundubhyādīn sasarja saḥ ||85 || mandirasthān pārṣadān vai tataśca sanakādikān | tato yogeśvarām̐ścāpi tato maharṣimaṇḍalam ||86 || rājarṣīṃśca tato brahmā sasarja pitṛdevatāḥ | kaśyapācca tataḥ sūryacandrādyā subhavestadā ||87|| asmābhiḥ svaprakāśatvaṃ kṛtaṃ devasabhāsu tu | brahmaṇā ca tathā devaiḥ sammāntitā maharṣayaḥ ||88|| yogino mānave loke sṛṣṭyarthamupakāriṇaḥ | niyuktā brahmaṇā devaiḥ saha kṛtvā vinirṇayam ||89|| rāṃ lakṣmīṃ sampadaṃ śobhām aśnumo vayamādarāt | dadmaścāpi prasannāśca rāśayastena vai vayam ||2.121.90|| niyuktāḥ phaladānārtha karmiṇāṃ kṛtakarmaṇām | tato vayaṃ sthitā yatra tatra te naḥ pradeśakāḥ || 91 || rāśiyānā ime santi vayaṃ vai rāśisaṃjñakāḥ | ājñāṃ saṃpālayantaśca brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ ||92|| dhruvadeśaṃ vicaranto vasāmastvatra sarvadā | sūryacandrādibhiḥ sarvairnavagrahaiḥ sahāyatām |||92|| asmākaṃ tu samagṛhya pacyate sṛṣṭimaṇḍalam | te vayam ṛṣayastvatra vasāmo rudraputrakāḥ ||94|| rudrasṛṣṭyavaśeṣā vai yathākarmaphalapradāḥ | tato brahmā dadau varṇān nastu sārasvatān pṛthaka ||95|| meṣāyanāya pradadau alaivarṇakān ajaḥ | vṛṣabhāya dadau brahmā vavauvarṇakān tadā ||96|| mithunāya dadau brahmā kachaghavarṇakām̐stadā | karkāyanāya pradadau ḍahākṣarau pitāmahaḥ ||97|| siṃhāyanāya pradadau maṭavarṇau pitāmahaḥ | kanyāyanāya pradadau paṭhaṇavarṇakān ajaḥ ||98|| tulāyanāya pradadau ratavarṇau pitāmahaḥ | vṛścikāya dadau brahmā nayavarṇau tadā tataḥ ||99|| dhanāyanāya bhamaphaḍhavarṇān pradadāvajaḥ | makarāya dadau brahmā khajavarṇau tadā tataḥ || 2.121.1 00|| kuṃbhāyanāya pradadau gaśavarṇau pitāmahaḥ | mīnāyanāya dacajhayavarṇān pradadāvajaḥ || 101 || tattadvarṇān jīvakarmabodhakān vidadhe hyajaḥ | asmadyoge tu candrādau yasya janma tu dehinaḥ || 1 02|| tattadvarṇakṛtanāmnā tatkarmāyurbhavediti | lokatantrapravāhārthaṃ brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā || 1 03|| niyuktāḥ smo vaya raudrāḥ sṛṣṭyupakṛtaye sadā | adya vai kṛtakṛtyāḥ smo nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ || 1 04|| bhavānatra samāyāto lokakalyāṇahetave | vayaṃ guptasvarūpeṇa meṣādinā purā tadā || 1 05|| jīvanārthaṃ tvabhavam̐śca tāni nāmāni santi naḥ | vastuto vai vayaṃ divyā raudrāḥ smo brahmapautrakāḥ || 106 | | āyāhyasmadgṛhān bhakta viśrāntiṃ labha sarvathā | kīrtanaṃ saṃkariṣyāmaḥ sūbhūya śrīharermuhuḥ || 107|| ityukto bhaktarāṭ devāyatanarṣirjaharṣa ha | omityāha tadā rādhe vimānaṃ cāvatārayat || 108|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kiṃpuruṣakhaṇḍe rāśiyānapradeśeṣu harināmakīrtanabodhārthaṃ preṣitena devāyatanarṣiṇā dvādaśameṣāyanādimaharṣisamāgamanāmaikaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 121 ||
<2.122> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike bhagavadbhakto devāyatanamuktarāṭ | meṣādīnāṃ maharṣīṇāmanumatyā vimānakam || 1 || dvikalākhyasarastīre dakṣabhāge’vatārayat | kṛkalāsasvarūpeṇa karkāyanarṣirapsu vai || 2 || vāsaṃ karoti sarasi tattaṭe cāvarohayat | jayaśabdāstadā lokaiḥ kṛtā jaya vimānakam || 3 || jaya devo vimānastho jaya pradyumna īśvaraḥ | ityevaṃ tu narā nāryo jayaśabdasamanvitāḥ || 4 || lājābhiḥ kusumairgandhairakṣataistamavardhayan | āśīrbhiḥ samayuñjam̐śca dadṛśurdevatāyanam || 5 || pradyumnaṃ ca tathā karkaṃ devāyatanamārcayan | pādayoḥ patitāḥ sarve pādavāri papustathā || 6 || menire dhanyabhāgyāni ghoṣayanto hare hare | harekṛṣṇa haresvāmin bālakṛṣṇa harehare || 7 || karkarṣistatra rājānaṃ tharkūṭasthābhidhaṃ prati | harernāmagrahaṇasyopadeśaṃ pracakāra ha || 8 || rājā jagrāha mantraṃ tanmālikāṃ taulasīṃ tathā | tharkūṭasthālaye saumye prāsāde tamavāsayat || 9 || devatāyatanarṣeśca mahāpūjanamācarat | devatāyatanastatra prāsāde rājakīyake || 2.122.10 || meṣādīn dvādaśarṣīṃśca rājasambandhinastathā | rājñīṃ cārumakāvāṃ ca tathā bākṛkalāsikām || 11 || trilūnāṃ maṃgalāṃ cāpi nāma mantraṃ tadārpayat | harekṛṣṇa haresvāmin harenārāyaṇa prabho || 1 2|| bālakṛṣṇa kambharāśrīyutra gopālanandana | śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mama sarvadā || 13 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | kālamāyāpāpakarmaśanuyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt | | 14|| śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava | brahmāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto’smi śāśvataḥ || 15|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me | kṛṣṇavallabhabhakto’haṃ śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama || 16|| ityevaṃ pradadau mantrān devatāyatanastadā | tataḥ prajābhyaḥ sarvābhyo dadau samantrakīrtanam || 17|| ityevaṃ vaiṣṇavān kṛtvā tatratyaiḥ pratipūjitaḥ | vimānaṃ ca samāruhyarṣibhiḥ rājakuṭumbibhiḥ || 18|| rājñā ca rājapatnibhiḥ samaṃ paścimabhūmikām | tānutuvāpradeśasthān śrāvayan nāmakīrtanam || 1 9|| avātārayad vāyānaṃ datvā mantrān prajātaye | tatkṛtāṃ prāpya saṃpūjām alpamātrāsarovaram | gatvāvatīrya yānācca irātrīśānadīmanu || 2.122.20 || makararṣinivāse ca sasnuḥ sarve’vatīrya ca | taṭāke ca tathā nadyāṃ snāpayitvā prajājanān || 21 || nāmamantraṃ dadau tebhyo devatāyatanaḥ ṛṣiḥ | tatkṛtāṃ paramāṃ pūjāṃ prāpya tato’pi paścime |||22|| bālakṛṣṇasaro gatvāvateruste sarastaṭe | dakṣiṇe bālikānadyāḥ saṃgame snānamācaran ||23||| mīnarṣiḥ svagṛhaṃ nītvā pupūja bhaktamaṇḍalam | vimānaṃ ca samāruhya pradyumnaṃ samapūjayat ||24|| śrāvayan kṛṣṇanāmāni prajābhyaḥ śrīharermanūn | dadau devāyatanakaścakāra vaiṣṇavīḥ prajāḥ ||25|| tatpradattāṃ prāpya pūjāṃ yayuḥ sarve tu paścime | kīragarjanadeśeṣu vimānātte hyavātaran || 26|| vṛścikarṣinivāseṣu gatvā datvā svadarśanam | taddeśīyajanebhyaśca manūn devāyano dadau || 27|| kīragarjanarājānaṃ sakuṭumbaṃ manuṃ śubham | śrāvayitvā vaiṣṇavaṃ ca kṛtvā nītvā vimānake || 28|| prajākṛtāṃ mahāpūjāṃ gṛhītvā devatāyanaḥ | sarṣirājakuṭumbādiḥ sīrānadīsamāgame ||19|| urule sarasi naijaṃ vimānaṃ svāmatārayat | nāma saṃśrāvayan sarvāḥ prajāstatra sarovare || 2.122.30 || asnāpayat tato mantrān dadau tebhyaḥ sakīrtanān | mithunāyanasaṃjñaśca ṛṣiryugalarūpadhṛk ||3 1 || svāvāse śrīvimānasthān pradyumnādīnupānayat | pupūja parayā bhaktyā vimānaṃ cāruroha ca || 32|| tataśca prayayuḥ sarve āmunadīsamāgame | tadūrdhvadeśavāsāśca prajāḥ saṃśrāvayan muniḥ ||33 || harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa mantrānaśrāvayacca tāḥ | vaiṣṇavīstāḥ prajāḥ kṛtvā vimānamadhiruhya ca || 34|| keśapāpayanavārdhiṃ ca gatvā pūrvataṭe śubhe | vimānādavatīryātha snātvā vārdhau ca te tataḥ ||35|| snapayitvā prajāstatra śrāvayannāmakīrtanam | mantrān dadau devatāyatanastābhyastataḥ khalu ||36 || vimānaṃ ca samāruhya urulāsaṃgamaṃ yayau | tatra kuṃbharṣiṇā sarve pūjitāḥ parameśvarāḥ ||37|| svāvāse bhrāmaṇaṃ teṣāṃ kāritaṃ cāpi pāvanam | devāyanaḥ śrāvayitvā nāmamantrān prajājanān ||38 || tebhyo datvā manūn paścād vimānenāpa parvatam | urulaṃ trivalāsaṃjñāṃ nadīṃ cāpi yayau muniḥ ||39|| irātrīśātribālāsaṃgame sasnuśca te tadā | tatpradeśīyalokām̐śca devatāyatano muniḥ ||2.122.40|| śrāvayāmāsa vai nāma hareścātha manūn dadau | siṃharṣiṇā samādiṣṭaprajābhyo munirāṭ khalu ||41 || taiḥ pradyumnaḥ pūjitaśca devāyano’pi pūjitaḥ | anye’pi pūjitāḥ sarve vimānena tadottare ||42|| śrāvayanto harernāma obītribalāsaṃgamam | avaterurvimānācca sasnustatra mahājale ||43|| dhanāyano maharṣiśca tathā prajājanā api | pupūjuḥ parayā bhaktyā vimānasthān janāṃstadā ||44|| devatāyatano nāma hareḥ saṃbhāvayan muhuḥ | prajābhyo nāma manrtrām̐śca datvā tatratyabhūpatim ||45|| vīrajāraṃ śrāvayitvā nāmamantraṃ manūm̐stathā | putrān putrīśca tatpatnīṃ śrāvayitvā ca tān manūn ||46|| vimāne saha nītvā ca yayau obyabdhisaṃgamam | avaterurvimānācca sasnurobyabdhisaṃgame ||47|| śrāvayanto harernāma āmadrākṣaprajājanān | tebhyo mantraṃ dadau devāyanarṣiśca tataḥ param || 48||| kanyāyanarṣistatraiva parvate corulābhidhe | nijāvāse vimānena nītvā sarvānapṛjayat ||49|| gṛhītvā tasya vai pūjāṃ pūrvāṃ diśaṃ yayau tataḥ | trāsasāgarasaṃyoge cāvaterurvimānataḥ |||2.122.50|| śrāvayāmāsuratyarthaṃ harekṛṣṇa prajājanān | snātvā ca snapayitvā ca manūn datvā ca vai tataḥ ||51 || yāneśīsāgarasaṃgaṃ yayuḥ sarve vimānagāḥ | sasnuśca snapayāmāsuḥ śrāvayitvā prajājanān ||52|| nāma mantraṃ dadau devāyatanarṣiśca bhaktarāṭ | aikāgārikadeśīyaprajābhyaśca manūn dadau ||53 || śibirājapradeśānāmuttareṣu stareṣu ca | tuṃgāsikānadīprānte prajābhyaḥ pradadau manūn ||54|| tandrādeśaṃ yayau devāyanarṣiḥ sarvasevitaḥ | himabhūmiprajāstatra śrāvayitvābhidhāṃ hareḥ ||55|| tābhyo manūn dadau devāyanarṣistrimuraprajāḥ | śrāvayitvā tatastābhyo nāma mantraṃ dadau tataḥ ||56 || renḍī meṣāyanarṣiśca pupūja tān vimānagān | svasthānaṃ pāvanaṃ cakre teṣāṃ pādarajo’nvitam ||57 || meṣāyanena ṛṣiṇā pradyumnādyāḥ prapūjitāḥ | gṛṇantaste harernāma anāvārānadīṃ yayuḥ || 58 || śrāvayitvā ca nāmāni snāpayitvā prajājanām | snātvā sarve saṃgame ca tatprajābhyo manūn daduḥ ||59 || vimānena yayuḥ pūrve ālanaukānadīṃ prati | tadabdhisaṃgame sasnuḥ sarve prajājanā api ||2.122.6 0 || śaktyakṣinṛpatiḥ sasnau sakudumbo’bdhisaṃgame | śrutvā nāma harekṛṣṇa vālakṛṣṇa narāyaṇa ||6 1 || jagṛhuste nāmamantrān devāyanamaharṣitaḥ | rājaprajārpitāṃ pūjāṃ prāpya pradyumnakādayaḥ ||62|| yayuḥ pūrvasthitān tandrādeśān bīnānadīmanu | līnāsāgarasaṃge ca sasnuḥ sarve vimāninaḥ ||6 3 || nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ cakruḥ prajāstatra samāyayuḥ | jagṛhurnāmamantrām̐śca devatāyatanāt tataḥ || 64|| tatratyo vṛṣabharṣiśca pūjayāmāsa tām̐stataḥ | pūjāṃ prāpya vimānena cāyayuḥ sarva eva te ||65|| uṣṭrīyāskānadīṃ tatra sasnuḥ prajājanaiḥ saha | prajābhyaḥ pradadau devāyatanaśca manūn tataḥ ||66 || nāma viṣṇoḥ śrāvayam̐śca yānāṃ nadīṃ yayustataḥ | yānābdhisaṃgame snātvā snapayitvā prajājanān ||67|| śrāvayitvā harernāma tebhyo manūn daduśca te | tato yayurvimānena kālimāṃ saritaṃ ca te ||68 || kālimābdhijale snātvā snapayitvā prajājanān | śrāvayitvā harernāma tebhyo manūn dadustadā ||69|| tulāyano maharṣiśca svasthānaṃ tān vimānagān | nināya pūjayāmāsa pradyumnadevatādikān ||2.122.7 0 || kālimāśaśca rājāpi suvaiṣṇavastadābhavat | pupūja parayā prītyā vimānasthān sureśvarān ||71 || vimāne sakuṭumbo vai samāruroha vaiṣṇavaḥ | tato yayuralāṃśukāpradeśān vai tataḥ param ||72|| dviraṃgākhyapradeśām̐śca anādīranadītaṭān | śrāvayitvā tadbhūmisthajanebhyo nāmakīrtanam ||73 || manūn tebhyo daduścātha yayurvai kāmacāṭakān | tatprajāḥ pāvayitvaiva harernāmnā tataḥ param ||74|| tābhyo mantrān pradāyaiva akṣauḍhābhuvamāgatāḥ | stenāvāsijanān sarvān śrāvayitvā harermanum ||75|| tebhyo mantrān pradāyaiva prabhālunādrimāyayuḥ | śrāvayitvā tadbhūmisthajanebhyo nāma vai hareḥ ||76|| tābhyo mantraṃ dadurdevāyatanādyāstataśca te | paścimaṃ prayayuḥ sarve vilīnāyupradeśakān ||77|| tatratyāśca prajāḥ sarvāḥ śrāvayāmāsurutsukāḥ | harekṛṣṇa haresvāmin bālakṛṣṇa harehare ||78|| mantrān tābhyo daduścāpi tābhiḥ kṛtāṃ tathopadām | saṃgṛhītvā yayuḥ sarve yoniṣoḍhāpradeśakān ||79|| tatratyāśca prajāḥ sarvāḥ śrāvayitvābhidhāṃ hareḥ | tābhyo mantrān pradaduśca tatkṛtaṃ pūjanaṃ tataḥ ||2.122.80|| samādāya yayuḥ sarve ompradeśān vimānagāḥ | avatīrya prajāḥ sarvāḥ śrāvayitvābhidhāṃ hareḥ ||81|| tābhyo dadurharermantrān cakrustān vaiṣṇavān śubhān | athaivaṃ rādhike sarvān deśān devāyano muniḥ ||82|| pradyumnena tathā śreṣṭhadvādaśarṣibhiranvitaḥ | rāśiyānapradeśānāṃ rājabhiḥ sahitastathā ||83|| bhramitvāṣṭabhramān daivān jīvān cakāra vaiṣṇavān | sthale sthale harernāma japapārāyaṇā janāḥ ||84|| abhavan vai narā nāryo bālā vṛddhāśca madhyamāḥ | snānaṃ ca pūjanaṃ nityaṃ bālakṛṣṇasya sarvadā ||85|| gṛhe gṛhe’bhavad vāso devadevasya vai tadā | atha devāyatanāya prārthayāmāsureva te ||86|| meṣāyanādyāḥ ṛṣayo tharkūṭasthanṛpādayaḥ | vayaṃ vai bhavato yogānnārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ ||87|| jātāḥ smo’dya prajāḥ sarvāḥ pāpamārgānnivāritāḥ | kṛṣṇabhaktiparā jātāścopakāro mahān kṛtaḥ ||88|| nṛdehasya tu sāphalyaṃ kāritaṃ bhavatādhunā | gurureva parabrahma tārako’sti bhavān hi naḥ ||89|| gurudvārā hariḥ sākṣāt milatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | yathā sākṣāddhareryogo bhavet tathā vidhehi naḥ ||2.122.90|| bālakṛṣṇasya kṛṣṇasya sveṣṭadevasya darśanam | pratyakṣaṃ no bhavettadvad bhavān karotu yojanām ||91 || yanmantro nāmamātraṃ ca pāpaprajvālanakṣamam | tasya sākṣāddarśanaṃ tu kiṃ na dhatte hiṃ dehinām || 92|| śravaṇaṃ maṃgalaṃ yasya smaraṇaṃ maṃgalaṃ muhuḥ | kīrtanaṃ maṃgalaṃ yasya kiṃ na dhatte tu darśanam ||93|| yathā kṛpātra cāgatya bhavatānuṣṭhitā tathā | iṣṭadevaḥ samāgacchet tathā kṛpāṃ vidhehi naḥ || 94|| bālānāṃ bālikānāṃ ca narāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā | aśaktānāṃ darśanaṃ śrīhareḥ syādāgamena vai ||95|| yadbhaktasya prasaṃgena daivā mumukṣutāṃ gatāḥ | vaiṣṇavāstaṃ bhajantyatra kṛtinastu tadāgame ||96|| deśo’pi divyatāṃ yāyānnadyo nadāḥ saro’bdhayaḥ | divyatāṃ tīrthatāṃ pṛthvyo yāsyanti cāgamāddhareḥ ||97|| vanāni parvatā grāmā nagarāṇi jalāni ca | khātāni cāpyakhātāni yāsyanti divyatāṃ tataḥ || 98|| raṇānāṃ bhūmayaścāpi dvīpānāṃ bhūmikāstathā | durgādurgapradeśāśca yāsyanti divyatāṃ tataḥ || 99|| mānavānāṃ hṛdayāni kāluṣyasaṃbhṛtāni vai | hareryogāddhavalāni bhaviṣyanti supuṇyataḥ || 2.122.10 0|| ityevaṃ prārthayāmo’tra pradyumnāya mahātmane | devatāyatanāyāpi dadmaścāśīrvacaḥ śubham || 10 1|| ityevaṃ cārthitau rādhe pradyumnadevatāyanau | āśvāsanaṃ dadatuśca tebhyo vai omiti dhruvam || 1 02|| tato vimānaṃ sarvaiśca bālakṛṣṇasarovare | uttare tattīrabhāge’vatāritaṃ nivṛttaye || 1 03|| viśaśramustu te sarve kṛtvā vai bhojanādikam | niśāyāṃ śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ bhejire sasmaruśca te || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne rāśiyānapradeśeṣu maharṣibhiḥ rājabhiśca saha vimānena bhramitvā prajāsu harernāmaśrāvaṇaṃ mantradānaṃ ca devāyatanarṣiścakāretyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 122 ||
<2.123> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca atha rāseśvari rādhe prātaḥ snātvā harerjanāḥ | pūjayitvā bālakṛṣṇamūrtiṃ pradyumnamityapi || 1 || devatāyatanaṃ cāpi hitāṃ cakrurvicāraṇām | meṣāyanādyāḥ ṛṣayaḥ tharkūṭasthanṛpādayaḥ || 2 | | rāśiyānapradeśānāṃ bhaktāgryāḥ sāttvatottamāḥ | śrutvā purā kratuṃ cakre bhagavān lāśahātaṭe || 3 | | śālāvatyāstaṭe cāpi piṃgadeśeṣu tatprajāḥ | kṛpayā pāvayāmāsa bālakṛṣṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ || 4 | | svayamāgatya devaiśca brahmapriyādibhiḥ saha | pitṛbhyāṃ sahitaścāpi tīrthīcakāra tadbhuvam || 5 || tathā cātra samāgacched bhaveyustīrthabhūmayaḥ | pavitrāḥ sukhadā sarvapāpapraṇāśaśaktayaḥ || 6 || sarvadevanivāsārhāḥ sarvapūjyāḥ pramokṣadāḥ | sarvanadyo bhaveyuśca bhagavatpādapāvitāḥ || 7 || tasmād yajñān kariṣyāmaḥ pañca śrīvaiṣṇavān śubhān | ādyaṃ makhaṃ śibirājye bālakṛṣṇasarastaṭe || 8 || tharkūṭasthabhūparājye dvitīyaṃ ca kratuṃ śubham | vīrajāramahārājarājye kratuṃ tṛtīyakam || 9 | | śaktyakṣinṛparājye ca makhaṃ caturthakaṃ śubham | kālimāśanṛparājye makhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ca pañcamam || 2.123.10 || kariṣyāmo dhanādyaiścārpaṇaiḥ sarvaprasādhanaiḥ | muktān tathātārām̐śca īśvarān pārṣadām̐stathā || 11 | | īśvarīrdevadevīśca pitṝn siddharṣipuṃgavān | mānavān jaḍacaitanyāśrayān sarvān hi dehinaḥ || 12 || tīrthāni lokapālādyānāhvayiṣyāma eva ca | kārayiṣyāma upkṛṣṭānmakhān kṛṣṇasya tuṣṭaye || 13 || tasmānnārāyaṇasvāmī bālakṛṣṇo janārdanaḥ | samāgacchecca no deśeṣvevaṃ bhaktavidhīyatām || 14|| ityukto devasadṛśo devatāyatano muniḥ | bāḍhaṃ bāḍhamuvācaitān mumukṣūn vaiṣṇavām̐stadā || 1 5|| kṣaṇaṃ viśramituṃ tvājñāṃ pracakāra ca bhaktarāṭ | gatvā śrībālakṛṣṇākhyasarastaṭe nṛpādikān || 16 || ṛṣayaśca nṛpādyāśca devāyatanako muniḥ | yayurvimānamārgeṇa bālakṛṣṇasarovaram || 1 7|| avateruśca te bhūmau vimānenottare taṭe | catvāro’pi ca rājāno dvādaśāpi maharṣayaḥ || 18 || tathā prajāgramānyāśca sahasraśo dhanānvitāḥ | vaiṣṇavāste’vateruśca yajñārthaṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ || 1 9|| pradyumnaśca ṛṣīn prāha kurvantu ghoṣaṇāṃ bhuvi | yajño vai vaiṣṇavaḥ kāryo bālakṛpṇasarastaṭe ||2.123.20|| uttare prathamaḥ paścād dvitīyastu kratūttamaḥ | dvikalākhyasarastīre tharkūṭabhūbhṛtā punaḥ |||2 1 || tṛtīyaśca kratuḥ kāryo vīrajāreṇa bhūbhṛtā | obīrātrīśanadyośca saṃgame kṣitivistare ||22|| caturthastu kratuḥ kāryaḥ śaktyakṣibhūbhṛtā śubhaḥ | ālanaukābdhisaṃyoge viśāle bhūtale tathā ||23 || pañcamastu kratuḥ kāryaḥ kālimāśena bhūbhṛtā | kālimāsāgarayoge teṣvāyāntu hi vaiṣṇavāḥ ||24|| tatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | akṣarādhipatiḥ śrīmān paramātmā pareśvaraḥ || 25|| bālakṛṣṇo hi bhagavānasmākamiṣṭadevatā | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrāt svayaṃ caivāgamiṣyati || 26 || darśanārthaṃ ca sevārthaṃ samāgantavyameva ha | pūrṇimāvadhiparyantaṃ dattā dīkṣā sthale sthale || 27|| athedānīṃ mārgaśīrṣe kṛṣṇaikādaśikādine | prathamasya makhasyaivārambhaḥ samyag bhaviṣyati ||28|| sāptadainasya yajñasya kāryaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kariṣyati | dvitīyasya tu yajñasya mārge vai pañcamīdine ||29|| samārambhaḥ samāptiśca hyekādaśyāṃ site dale | tṛtīyasya kratoścāpyāraṃbho va tṛtīyātithau ||2.123.3 0|| pauṣakṛṣṇe samāptiśca navamyāṃ saṃbhaviṣyati | caturthayajñārambhastu ekādaśyāṃ bhaviṣyati ||3 1 || śuklāyāṃ tu dvitīyāyāṃ samāptiśca bhaviṣyati | pañcamasya tu yajñasyārambho vai pañcamīdine ||3 2|| ekādaśyāṃ samāptiśca bhaviṣyatīti niścitam | ityevaṃ ghoṣayantveva rāśiyāneṣu sarvathā ||33 || ityuktā rājavargāśca tathā tattanmaharṣayaḥ | udghoṣaṇāṃ tathā cakruḥ svasvadeśeṣu satvaram ||34|| vaihāyasā tu yānena tato rājādayaśca te | śodhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ sāmagrīrvividhāḥ śubhāḥ ||35|| kārayāmāsurevātra sañcitāḥ sarvato diśaḥ | maṇḍapādīm̐stathā śālā nivāsān śibirāṇi ca ||36|| daśayojanabhūmau ca kārayāmāsurutsukāḥ | pradyumnaḥ kārayāmāsa yathāyogyaṃ nirīkṣakaḥ ||37|| devatāyatanaścāpi dvādaśarṣaya eva te | vimānena yayuḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prati ||38|| prārthayāmāsurīśeśeśvaraṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam| tathāstvevaṃ hariḥ prāha prasannaḥ pitṛdeśitaḥ || 39 || lomaśena tathājñapto devatāyatano muniḥ | ṛṣīn sahasraśo nītvā vimāne prayayau kratum ||2.123.40|| te sarve kārayāmāsurbālakṛṣṇasarastaṭe | kuṇḍān vividhān vedīśca sthāpanārthaṃ ca vedikāḥ ||41 || śālāḥ kratorvāsaśālā mahīmānāśrayām̐stathā | muktānāṃ cālayāna ramyānavatārālayām̐stathā ||42|| īśvarāṇāmālayām̐śceśvarīṇāmālayām̐stathā | pitṝṇāṃ ca tatharṣīṇāṃ brahmapriyālayām̐stathā ||43 || brahmasarasāmālayām̐ścāpsarasāmālayām̐stathā | devānāṃ bahujātīnāmālayān vividhām̐stathā ||44|| dāsānāmālayām̐ścāpi bhuvarlokanivāsinām | mānavānāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ tathālayān ||45||| atalādinivāsānāmālayān bahubhūmikān | viśāle bhūtale cāpi vyomni cāpi vyadhustadā ||49 || maṇḍapaṃ sāptabhaumaṃ ca viśālaṃ daśayojanam | vyadhustu viśvakarmāṇaḥ pradyumnasya nideśataḥ ||47|| pañcāśadyojane bhāge mahīmānāśrayān vyadhuḥ | pratyāśrayaṃ pradīpāśca maṇīnāṃ tu svabhāvajāḥ ||48|| śītoṣṇādijalānāṃ ca kulyāḥ svabhāvajāstathā | payodadhivṛtānāṃ ca kulyāścāpi svabhāvajāḥ ||49|| madhūnāṃ śarkarāṇāṃ ca rasakulyāḥ svabhāvajāḥ | peyānāṃ śītatoyānāṃ hradāścāmṛtasaṃjñakāḥ ||2.123.50|| brahmahradāstathā gopahṛdā nārāyaṇahradāḥ | satyahradāstathā devahradāśca nihitā dhruvāḥ ||51 || yathāpekṣamanalānāṃ kuṇṭhāśca kuṇḍikāḥ kṛtāḥ | naisargā dugdhapākāśca dugdhasārā nisargajāḥ ||52|| kāmadhenusamūhāśca rasavallīdrumālayāḥ | rasaśālāḥ sarvasṛṣṭibhojyapānapradāḥ śubhāḥ ||53 || vastrābhūṣaṇaśṛṃgārabhogyadravyādipeṭikāḥ | gandhasārapracūrṇādikajjalālaktavārpikāḥ ||54|| vādyagāyananṛtyādipradarśanapradarśikāḥ | manorañjanajālādyāḥ prasphoṭakānalānilāḥ ||55 || yānavāhanaśibikāgāruḍahaṃsagovṛṣāḥ | śayyāparyaṃkavitānollocapaṭādibhittikāḥ ||56|| udyānāni vicitrāṇi sarvauṣadhipravāṭikāḥ | bhojyapeyādivastūnāṃ parvatā iva sañcayāḥ ||57|| havyānāṃ ca kaṇānāṃ ca phalānāṃ sañcayāstathā | patrāṇāṃ ca rasānāṃ ca samidhāṃ saṃcayāstathā ||58 || vrīhīṇāṃ ca yavānāṃ ca munyannānāṃ viśeṣataḥ | tilānāṃ ghṛtabhāgānāṃ pakvānnānāṃ samucchrayāḥ | | 59 || dūraśravaṇayantrāṇāṃ dūradarśanakāriṇām | candrāṇāṃ dūravedhānāṃ sparśabodhanakāriṇām ||2.123.6 0 || ṛtubodhakarāṇāṃ ca golakāntarabodhinām | vārtātāragṛhāṇāṃ ca klṛptanaṃ vai sthale sthale || 61 | | dāsīnāṃ sevakānāṃ ca nisargalekhakāriṇām | klṛptanā kāritā tatra makhabhūmau sthale sthale | | 62 || rājamārgā devamārgā hastyaśvahaṃsagāruḍāḥ | yeṣu prayānti sukhatastathā vai nirmitāstadā || 63 || dakṣiṇārthaṃ dravyaśālā yajñārthaṃ pātramandiram | dānārthaṃ vastraśālāśca devapūjārhaśālikāḥ | |64|| sarvopacāraśālāśca nirmitā viśvakarmabhiḥ | sthāne sthāne kalpalatāḥ koṇe koṇe maṇiprabhāḥ | | 65 | | cintāmaṇipradhānāśca vāsāḥ sarvasukhapradāḥ | muktānāṃ dhavale vyomni cāntarīkṣe tu nākinām | | 66 || bhaumānāṃ bhūmibhāgeṣu bhūstare tvanyadehinām | nirmitāḥ sukhadā vāsā bālakṛṣṇamakhotsave | | 67 | | ityevaṃ sarvathā bhūmiḥ śṛṃgāritā mahālayaiḥ | maṇḍapasya śirobhāge dhvajo’ṣṭaśatahastakaḥ |||68 | | sahasraṃ kalaśānāṃ tu sauvarṇānāṃ ca ropitam | vedamantrā jhallarīṣu toraṇeṣu pralekhitāḥ || 69 || raṃgaraṃgolikāśobhāḥ svargodyānasamāḥ kṛtāḥ | evaṃ vai bhrājamāneṣu nivāseṣu makhābhitaḥ || 2.123.70 || āyayuśca mahīmānāḥ patraiścāmantritāstadā | yajño’yaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kārayati svayam ||7 1 || śibidevanṛpadvārā sarvairgantavyamādarāt | idānīṃ mārgaśīrṣe vai kṛṣṇaikādaśikādine || 72 || bālakṛṣṇasarastīre yajñāraṃbho vilokyatām | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paṭaho mahān ||73 || vyanadat sarvalokeṣu hariṇājñāpitaḥ śubhaḥ | daśamyāṃ sarvalokasthāḥ śrutvā kratuṃ samāyayuḥ |||74|| akṣarabrahmalokādvai muktāḥ sarve samāyayuḥ | dhāmāni cāpi sarvāṇi bhagavantastadāśritāḥ ||75 || bhagavatyaḥ samājagmurmuktānyaścāpyasaṃkhyikāḥ | īśvarā īśvarāṇyaśca pitaro munayastathā |||76 || siddhā brahmapraśīlāśca surāḥ surāṇya eva tu| brahmasaraso’psaraso devyo dikpālapuṃgavāḥ ||77|| sāṃkhyayoginya evāpi bhuvarlokasurāstathā | mānavāḥ ṛṣayo viprāḥ kuṃkumavāpikājanāḥ ||78|| abriktajāścājanābhā uraṣṭrālayādivāsinaḥ | āyayustalavāsāśca bhūvivaranivāsinaḥ ||79|| nadā nadyaḥ samudrāśca vṛkṣā vallaya ityapi | tīrthāni paśavaḥ pakṣavantastiryakprajātayaḥ ||2.123.80|| pārthivāśca jalīyāśca vāhneyā vāyavīyakāḥ | dehinaścāyayustatra yajñārthaṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ ||8 1|| devadānavadaityāśca rudrāśca vasavastathā | viśvedevāstathā sādhyā manavo brahmaputrakāḥ ||82|| sanakādyā sādhavaśca nāradādyā mahārṣayaḥ | brahmaputraprapautrādyāścāyayustvadhvare hareḥ ||83 || vineduśca diśaḥ sarvā vimānānāṃ samāgamaiḥ | rājāno rāśivargāśca dadurvāsāni cādarāt ||84|| tāvaddevāyanarṣiśca vimāne kāmage śubhe | sarvasmṛddhiprapūrṇe tu śātabhaume mahāyate ||85|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | brahmapriyāstathā sarvāḥ sarvaṃ kuṭumbamityapi ||86|| lomaśādīn saptarṣīṃśca viprān narām̐śca yoṣitaḥ | mātāpitarau devādīn tīrthāni śaṃkarādikān ||87|| kṣetrapān sevikā devīrdevatāśceśvarādikān | tatratyadivyadehām̐śca nītvā vyomnā samāyayau ||88|| avādyanta suvādyāni jayaśabdāstadābhavan | lājāpuṣpākṣataiḥ sarve vardhayāmāsureva tat ||89|| nemuśca paritaḥ sarve koṭisūryojjvalaṃ śubham | vimānaṃ parameśasyākṣaratulyaṃ mahojjvalam ||2.123.90|| divyahastisuśobhāḍhyaṃ divyahaṃsavirājitam | divyadhvajasukalaśaiḥ rājitaṃ kāmagaṃ sukham || 9 1|| yatpārśve suvimānāni suprayānti sahasraśaḥ | aśabdaṃ cāgataṃ meghādūrdhvaṃ dvipañcayojanam ||92|| ākāśe sthairyamāpannaṃ tasmādvai bhagavān svayam | avātatāra sahasā koṭyabjasārthaśobhitaḥ ||93 || vidyudyantrādinirghoṣā avādyanta ca sūcakāḥ | ākāśo mūrtimān bhūtvā kṛṣṇagītimagāyata ||94|| rāgāścāpi ca rāgiṇyaḥ sarasvatyaśca śāradāḥ | vidyāḥ sarvāstadā kṛṣṇakṛte’gāyanta catsukāḥ ||95|| lakṣmīgaṃgāvirajāsulalitāvijayājayāḥ ||96|| suśīlādyāśca vai gītiṃ tadā cakrurmanoharām | gandharvā gāyanaṃ cakrustadā kṛṣṇasya tuṣṭaye ||97|| ṛṣayo vedanirghoṣām̐ścakrurghanaravādibhiḥ | vahnyādyā devatāścāpi jayaśabdān pracakrire ||98|| śiṣyādyāśca ṛṣayaśca sanmānaṃ daṇḍavatpuraḥ | cakruḥ sarve jaya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti saṃjaguḥ ||99|| tāvaddhariḥ pṛthivyāṃ vai sabhāmaṇḍapamāgamat | puṣpahārān dadustasmai śekharān gucchakān daduḥ || 2.123.100 || puṣpāṇāṃ sañcayaiḥ sarve vardhayāmāsuracyutam | mātaraṃ pitaraṃ cāpi bhagavantaṃ śukaṃ tathā || 101 || santuṣṭāṃ cāmṛtāṃ cāpi devāyatanakaṃ munim | hemantaṃ ca bhagavantaṃ lomaśaṃ śaṃbhuviṣṇvajān || 1 02|| brahmapriyādikā rādhe kuṃkumavāpikāprajāḥ | vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ rāśiyānaprajā muhuḥ || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bālakṛṣṇasarovarataṭe yajñamaṇḍapādikaraṇaṃ mahīmānāgamo bālakṛṣṇādyāgamaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayoviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 123 ||
<2.124> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ityevaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇo mahāprabhuḥ || avatīrya vimānācca yajñamaṇḍapamāyayau || 1 || vilokya ca tataḥ śīghraṃ kṛtvā snānaṃ taḍāgake || yajamānaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā patnīvratadvijena ca || 2 || lomaśena tathā devāyatanena yutaḥ prabhuḥ || mātāpitrādisahito niṣasāda śubhāsane || 3 || viprāśca jagadustāvat svastivācanamutsukāḥ || ācamanaṃ grāhayitvā tato vai lomaśo muniḥ || 4 || śuddhimantrān samuccārya pañcagavyaṃ pradāya ca || jalena prokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā gṛhītvā sūtrakaṃ kare || 5 || bālakṛṣṇaṃ prakoṣṭhe cābandhayad yajamānakam || tathā bhūpaṃ yajamānaṃ gauṇaṃ sastrīkameva ca || 6 || śibidevābhidhānaṃ cābandhayan lomaśo muniḥ | bālakṛṣṇo’pi bhagavān lomaśaṃ yajñavedinam || 7 || mukhyaṃ cābandhayattatra gauṇaṃ patnīvrataṃ tathā || ācāryayugalaṃ kṛtvā tato dvādaśabhūsurān || 8 || raudrān rudrasvarūpām̐ścābandhayad rudrasannidhau | brahmaṇo nikaṭe cānyān daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakān || 9 || ṛṣīm̐ścābandhayat tatra japahomakarām̐stathā || brahmā svayaṃ brahmavedyāṃ sthitaḥ kṛṣṇājñayābhavat ||10|| vedāstathopavedāśca gātāraścābhavam̐stadā || udgātārastadā cāsan śākhāmūrtaya ityapi ||11|| hotāraścopahotārastadāsan sanakādikāḥ || yogeśvarāstathā siddhāḥ kapilādyā narāyaṇāḥ ||12|| āhartārastathā pratihartāraśceśvarāḥ śubhāḥ || bhūmādayo’pyabhavam̐śca vairājādiyutāstathā ||13|| ṛtvijaścābhavam̐statra vasiṣṭhādyā maharṣayaḥ | vālakhilyā abhavam̐śca vedapāṭhakarāstadā ||14|| vyāsādyā vedavettāro bṛhaspatyādayastathā | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ prapāṭhino’bhavan ||15|| nārāyaṇāstadā sarve havyavāhā hi vahniṣu || abhavan avatārāśca vahnyānanāstadā makhe ||16|| vahnayo divyarūpāśca rājante tatra saṃsadi | kalpavallīyutāḥ kalpadrumā havyapradāyinaḥ ||17|| samāharanti dravyāṇi saṃkalpitāni vai tadā | ityevaṃ yajñasāhāyyāḥ klṛptāstatra makhe tataḥ ||18|| pṛthvyāḥ sampūjanaṃ cāpi vārāhasya prapūjanam | kuṇḍasya pūjanaṃ cāpi vedikānāṃ prapūjanam ||19|| cakruḥ śrīlomaśādyāśca tato gaṇeśapūjanam || pratyakṣasya gaṇeśasyārcanaṃ cakrustadā dvijāḥ ||20|| śaṃkhasya pūjanaṃ cāpi tathā cakrasya pūjanam | kalaśasyārcanaṃ cāpi tathā lakṣmyāḥ supūjanam ||21|| rudrasya pūjanaṃ cāpi durgāyāḥ pūjanaṃ tathā | kalaśasthāpanaṃ cāpi mātṛkāpūjanaṃ tathā ||22|| dikpālānāṃ pūjanaṃ ca grahāṇāṃ cārcanaṃ tathā | īśvarāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ ca śaktīnāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ||23|| pārṣadānāṃ pūjanaṃ ca vasūnāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā || ādityānāṃ pūjanaṃ ca surāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ||24|| lokapālārcanaṃ cāpi satīnāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā | devānāṃ pūjanaṃ pitṛpūjanam ṛṣipūjanam ||25|| bhūtānāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi iṣṭāniṣṭapravedinām || diśāṃ prapūjanaṃ cāpi viśvedevaprapūjanam ||26|| aśvinīsutayoścāpi pūjanaṃ rakṣasāṃ tathā || kṣetrāṇāṃ kṣetrapālānāṃ pūjanaṃ yogināṃ tathā ||27|| yoginīnāṃ pūjanaṃ ca kalānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā || manūnāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi tattvānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ||28|| marutāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi tīrthānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā || rājasānāṃ tāmasānāṃ devānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ||29|| vighnānāṃ vighnarājānāṃ brāhmīnāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā | vidyānāṃ brahmapatnīnāṃ pūjanaṃ dhāmayoṣitām ||30|| mūrtimatāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ sarvāsāṃ tatra pūjanam | cakāra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasteṣāṃ pratuṣṭaye ||31|| tataḥ svayaṃ harikṛṣṇasvāmī śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mukhyadevasthale sthitaḥ ||32|| tasya pūjāṃ mahāpūjāṃ śibidevaścakāra ha| mukhyadeve pūjite cāvādyanta tūryakoṭayaḥ ||33|| tato vahniṃ mūrtimantaṃ prāha nārāyaṇaḥ svayam | tiṣṭha kuṇḍe mama mūrte devānāṃ tṛptaye makhe ||34|| ityuktvā pūjito vahniḥ prasannaḥ kuṇḍamāsthitaḥ | jvālārūpo’bhavattatra samitsu havyavāhanaḥ ||35|| yajñapātrādipūjāṃ ca kṛtvā vai ṛṣayastataḥ || kuṇḍadevān samiddevān sampūjya cānyadevatāḥ || 36|| tebhyo datvā yathāpūjāṃ homakāryaṃ vyavartata | svāhādyāstatra devyaśca sakhyo vai divyavigrahāḥ ||37|| kare kṛtvā ca havyāni dadurvahnimukhādiṣu || devatā īśvarāścāpi muktā nārāyaṇā api ||38|| brahmapriyāśca muktānya īśvarāṇyaśca devikāḥ || surāṇyaścāpi mānavyaḥ ṛṣayaḥ ṛṣisaṃpriyāḥ ||39|| sāttvikā rājasāścāpi tāmasāścāpi vai surāḥ || sāttvikyaścāpi rājasyatāmasyastanavo hareḥ ||40|| pratyakṣā mūrtimatyastā bhāgān jagṛhuradhvare | jīvasṛṣṭāvīśasṛṣṭau brahmasṛṣṭau tu ye ca ye ||41|| dehino vedaparṇasthāste sarve bhuñjate’nale || adhvare’rpitahavyāni jāyate tṛptimān hariḥ ||42|| evaṃ saptadinānyevābhavad yajño vidhānataḥ || vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo homaḥ sarvatṛptiprado makhaḥ ||43|| śrīrādhikovāca yān devān vai tadā smṛtvā yathā homaḥ prajāyate | tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi tasmin vai vaiṣṇave makhe ||44|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rādhe tatra homo yathā vai samprajāyate | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||45|| akṣarabrahmaṇe svāhā svāhā muktebhya ityapi || svāhā brahmapriyābhyaśca svāha muktābhya ityapi ||46|| svāhā kṛṣṇāya kāntāya svāhā gopīgaṇāya ca || rādhāyai kṛṣṇakāntāyai svāhā gopagaṇāya ca || 47|| svāhā golokadhāmne ca svāhā dhenubhya ityapi || svāhā nārāyaṇāyeti lakṣmyai svāhā śriyai tathā ||48|| śrīsakhībhyastathā svāhā svāhā vaikuṇṭhakāya ca | svāhā pārṣadavargāya svāhā dāsīgaṇāya ca ||49|| vāsudevāya vai svāhā svāhā saṃkarṣaṇāya ca | pradyumnāya tathā svāhā svāhāniruddhasaṃjñine ||50|| mahākālāya vai svāhā mahāpuruṣasaṃjñine || māyāyai ca tathā svāhā svāhā tatpuruṣāya ca ||51|| pradhānapuruṣāyeti svāhāvyākṛtadhāmine || amṛtavāsine svāhā bhūmne svāhā subuddhaye ||52|| ahaṃkārāya ca mahāviṣṇave manase tathā | svāhā vairājarūpāya viṣṇave śaṃbhave tathā ||53|| brahmaṇe ca tathā svāhā svāhā sadāśivāya ca | īśvarebhyastathā svāhā īśvarāṇībhya ityapi ||54 tanmātrābhyastathā svāhā svāhendriyebhya ityapi | prāṇebhyaśca tathā svāhā svāhā bhūtebhya ityapi ||55|| aṣṭāvaraṇavāsibhyaḥ svāhā īśeśvarāya ca | matsyāya kūrmarūpāya svāhā vārāharūpiṇe ||56|| kapilāya ca haraye svāhā śrīpṛthave tathā | dattātreyāya haṃsāya svāhā nṛsiṃharūpiṇe ||57|| ṛṣabhāya vāmanāya svāhā paraśudhāriṇe | yajñāya ca kumārāya svāhā rāmāya dhanvine ||58|| hayaśīrṣāya vai svāhā svāhā nāradanāmine | rājarājāya vai svāhā svāhā vyāsāya kalkine ||59|| svāhā mohinikāyai ca svāhāntaryāmiṇe tathā || svāhā satyanivāsibhyaḥ svāhā śrīparameṣṭhine ||60 || sarasvatyai ca gāyatryai sāvitryai brahmayoṣite | asiknyai ca paliknyai ca svadhā vīriṇiyoṣite 61|| sṛṣṭyai cāpyatha sandhyāyai mohinyai svāhiketi ca || dakṣādibhyo vaṣaṭ cāpi prajāpatibhya ityapi ||62|| manubhyo vālakhilyebhyo vaṣaṭ ṛṣibhya ityapi || pitṛbhyaśca svadhā cāpi svāhā meghebhya ityapi ||63|| svāhā dharmādharmavaṃśagaṇāya kāmamūrtaye || ṛtubhyo vatsarādibhyaḥ svadhā yugebhya ityapi ||64|| digbhyaḥ svāhā guṇebhyaśca svāhā dravyebhya ityapi | karmabhyaścāpi jātibhyaḥ svāhā yogebhya ityapi ||65|| indrādibhyo digīśebhyaḥ svāhā lokibhya ityapi | satyāya tapase svāhā janāya mahare’pi ca ||66|| svargāya svargavāsibhyaḥ svāhā devebhya ityapi | svāhāpsarogaṇebhyaśca svāhā devībhya ityapi ||67|| siddhibhyaśca vasubhyaśca svāhā nidhibhya ityapi | svāhā grahebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sūryebhyastithināmine ||68|| kalābhyaśca tathā svāhā nakṣatrebhyaśca ityapi | tārakābhyastathā svāhā svāhā marudbhya ityapi ||69|| rudrebhyo rudrapatnībhyaḥ svāhā śrīśaṃkarāya ca || kalābhyo yoginībhyaśca svāhā khanibhya ityapi ||70 naranārāyaṇāyeti svāhā vai śeṣaśāyine || avatārasvarūpāya svāhā mūrtyātmane tathā ||71|| gaṃgādyāyai tathā svāhā svāhā tīrthebhya ityapi | kailāsagaṇakeśāya gaṇeśāya śivāya ca ||72|| mātre yoginikācakrāya ca svāhā hanūmate | kārtikāya ca haṃsāya garuḍāyāruṇāya ca ||73|| svāhāgnimaṇḍalāyeti svadhā yāmyāya cetyapi | śrāvaṇebhyaḥ svadhā cāpi pretebhyaśca svadhā hyapi ||74|| bhūtapretapiśācebhyaḥ kūṣmāṇḍebhyaḥ svadhā tathā | vināyakebhyo vetālebhyaśca svāhā svadhā tathā ||75|| ḍākinīśākinībhyaśca svadhā vai pitṛyoṣite | sūtamāgadhabandībhyo vaṣaṭ tīrthebhya ityapi ||76|| mānavebhyastathā vaṣaḍ vṛkṣadrubhyo vaṣaṭ tathā || vallībhyaśca vaṣaṭ tṛṇalatābhyaśca vaṣaṭ tathā ||77|| tiryagbhyaśca paśubhyaśca pakṣibhyaśca vaṣaṭ tathā | sarīsṛpebhyaḥ kīṭebhyaḥ kṣudrebhyaśca vaṣaṭ tathā ||78|| gṛhagrāmakṣetradevatābhyaḥ svāhā ca bhūmaye || vanāraṇyanadebhyaśca vauṣaṭ cābdhibhya ityapi ||79|| āśramebhyaśca varṇebhyo vauṣaṭ śailebhya ityapi | svadhā pitre pitāmahāya prapitāmahāya ca ||80|| mātrādyāyai svadhā cāpi śrauṣaṭ viśvādhivāsine | gandharvebhyaḥ kinnarebhyaḥ śrauṣaṭ kiṃpuruṣāya ca ||81|| sādhyebhyaścāpi viśvebhyaḥ svāhā marudbhya ityapi | cāraṇebhyo vaṣaṭ vauṣaṭ nārībhyo gaṇikābhya ā 82|| sādhvībhyaśca tathā śrauṣaṭ tyāginībhyaśca sarvathā || yādobhyaśca vaṣaṭ nāgasarpebhyaśca vaṣaṭ tathā ||83|| daityebhyo dānavebhyaśca rākṣasebhyo vaṣaṭ tathā | yakṣebhyaśca vaṣaṭ cāpi kāśyapebhyo yathāyatham ||84|| sarvasṛṣṭipradevebhyaḥ svāhāntaryāmiṇe tathā | svāhā śrīharikṛṣṇāya ghanaśyāmāya vai tathā ||85|| bālakṛṣṇāya ca svāhā śrīkṛṣṇavallabhāya ca || gopālabālakāyeti kaṃbharāśrīsutāya ca ||86|| svāhā śrīharaye śrīmanmāṇikīpataye tathā || lakṣmīnārāyaṇāyeti svāhā prītimayāya ca ||87|| pārvatīpataye svāhā svāhā rāseśvarīśine | svāhā śrīduḥkhahālakṣmīsvāmine paramātmāne ||88|| svāhā jayālalitādhipataye haṃsayogine | antaryāmisvarūpāya svāhā sarveśvarāya ca ||89|| yajñanārāyaṇāyeti svāhā śrīvahnaye tathā | oṃ parabrahmaṇe svāhā homaṃ bhagavate daduḥ ||90|| sarve jīvāstadā tṛptā havyaiḥ kavyairmanoharaiḥ | ityevaṃ havanaṃ kṛtvā bhojayāmāsurādarāt ||11|| mahīmānān tathā deśanivāsān koṭikārbudān || mānavaॉśca cetanām̐śca jaḍām̐śca bhojyavastubhiḥ ||9|| āgatā vai tatra yajñe koṭiśo mānavāstadā || jagṛhuścāvaśiṣṭāśca mantrān śrīvaiṣṇavām̐stathā ||93|| ityevaṃ nityamevāpi jāyante havanādayaḥ || vaiṣṇavāścāpi jāyante mānavāḥ koṭiśo’pi ca ||94|| saptāhena susampādyo nyavartata kratuḥ śubhaḥ | avabhṛthaṃ tataścakrurbālakṛṣṇasarovare ||95 sarve vai dehino divyādivyā ye’tra samāgatāḥ | pāvanāste ca sañjātā bālakṛṣṇasya yogataḥ ||96|| dakṣiṇāḥ pradadau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’tibhūyasīḥ || śibidevo’pi sarvasvaṃ rājā yajñe dadau tadā ||7|| kanyakānāṃ śataṃ naijaṃ bālakṛṣṇāya vai dadau | hastyaśvarathasauvarṇayānavimānakāni ca ||98|| svarṇarūpyakahīrādigṛhavāṭīrdadau tathā | dāsīdāsānanekām̐śca dadau rājā kratau tadā ||99|| annavastragavāṃ dānaṃ koṭisaṃkhyaṃ dadau nṛpaḥ || sarvasvaṃ haraye naijaṃ dadau vai rādhike tadā ||100|| parihāraṃ tataścakre rātrau sarve viśaśramuḥ || śibistu kārayāmāsa mandiraṃ tatra śobhanam ||101|| bālakṛṣṇaśca ṣaṭpatnīsahito yatra rājate || rādhā lakṣmīrmāṇikī ca kamalā śrīḥ ramā tathā ||102|| sevayanti sadā kāntaṃ mandire vyomagāmini | paṭhanācchravaṇācāsya yajñasya phalabhāg bhavet ||103|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śibidevarājye bālakṛṣṇasarovarataṭe mahāyajñe yājñikavyavasthā, yajñakāryanivṛttiḥ, śrīharaye nṛpakṛtaśatakanyādānaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 124 ||
<2.125> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca evaṃ bālakṛṣṇasarastaṭe kṛtvā kratuṃ hariḥ | bālakṛṣṇaḥ svanāmnaiva vālakṛṣṇasaro’karot | | 1 | | asaṃkhyadehadhāribhyo datvā manuṃ ca darśanam | kṛtvā tānpāvanānpaścādbhojayitvā janānapi | | 2 | | tṛtīyāyāṃ janān sāyaṃ cājijñapatprabhuḥ svayam | śibidevo mahārājo muktavad vartate bhuvi | | 3 | | śibirājyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca matkṛpāvaśato’bhavat | śrīsampaddravyabhogyādisaṃbhṛtāśca śibeḥ prajāḥ | | 4 | | bhavantu sukhapātrāṇi mā tāsāṃ syāddhi nimnatā | mā syād duḥkhaṃ kvaciccāpi syāt sadābhyudayaḥ kila | | 5 | | bhavatīnāṃ prajānāṃ ca rājño’pi bhavatāt sadā | rājavaṃśe prajānāṃ ca mama bhaktiḥ sadāstu ca | | 6 | | atha kartuṃ dvitīyaṃ tu makhaṃ yāntu prajājanāḥ | sevakāḥ ṛṣayaścāpi tharkūṭasthanṛpādayaḥ | | 7 | | tharkūṭasthabhūparājye sāhāyyārthaṃ prayāntu ca | naijo dharmaḥ pālanīyo bhavadbhirbhaktisaṃyutaiḥ | | 8 || satāṃ guṇāścārjanīyāḥ sukhadā divyaśāntidāḥ | svasvarūpe brahmarūpe sthitiḥ kāryā hi sarvadā | | 9 | | satyaṃ yathārthavaktṛtvaṃ pālanīyaṃ hitapradam | śaucaṃ sadātmanaḥ śuddhiścāntarāṇāṃ praśuddhitaḥ | | 2.125.10 || pālanīyā sadā bhaktairakāluṣyaṃ tu pāpakaiḥ | dayā kāryā tu jīveṣu teṣāṃ duḥkhanivārikā | | 11 | | kṣāntiḥ rakṣyā sāparādhajaneṣvapi sahiṣṇutā | cittasaṃyamarūpā ca sadānudvegaśālinī || 12 | | tyāgo rakṣyaḥ sadā dānaṃ pūrṇakāmatvayogataḥ | māyikeṣu tu bhogyeṣu tvanādaraḥ praśāntidaḥ | | 13 || arthiṣu muktakaratā prāpteṣvapi na lubdhatā | santoṣaśca nijānandaparipūrṇatvamityapi | | 1 4| | yathālabdheṣvalaṃbhāvastṛṣṇārāhityamityapi | kleśarāhityamevāpi rakṣaṇīyaṃ sadā janaiḥ || 15|| ārjavaṃ cāpi sāralyaṃ trayāṇāmekarūpatā | manovāṇīśarīrāṇāṃ bhāvānāṃ caikarūpatā || 16|| rakṣaṇīyā prayatnena bhaktairbhāgavataiḥ sadā | śamaḥ śāśvatikī śāntirviṣayebhyo nivartanam || 17|| atiprākṛtasaṃjñebhyo duḥkhadebhyo nirantaram | damaścendriyaniyamaḥ kartavyaḥ śreyase sadā || 18|| tapo vijñānalabdhyarthaṃ yatnaḥ kāryaḥ sadā janaiḥ | vratopavāsarūpaṃ ca kartavyaṃ vṛddhasevanam || 1 9|| sāmyaṃ rakṣyaṃ śubhe duṣṭe’nādaro māyike sadā | titikṣā sahanaṃ rakṣyaṃ dvandvākhyairduḥkhasaṃsthitau ||2.125.20|| ātmarūpeṇa vai stheyaṃ cāpratikṣatibhāvataḥ | uparamaḥ sadā rakṣyo vyarthavyāpāravarjanam || 21 || śrutaṃ jñānaṃ prāpaṇīyaṃ śāstrasadgurudevataḥ | svayaṃ cāpi paraścāpi vedanīyo viśeṣataḥ ||22|| vairāgyaṃ sarvaviṣaye nispṛhatvaṃ tathā sadā | anākṛṣṭamanastvaṃ ca rakṣaṇīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||23|| aiśvaryaṃ bhagavadyogāt sārṣṭi prāpyaṃ hareḥ puraḥ | śauryaṃ svabhāvavijayaḥ kartavyaḥ sarvathā janaiḥ ||24|| tejo rakṣyaṃ bhaktajanairanyaiḥ pradhṛṣyaśūnyatā | balaṃ cātmabalaṃ sarvaniyantṛyogataḥ sadā ||25|| rakṣaṇīyaṃ hi sāmarthyaṃ bālakṛṣṇasya me kṛpā | smṛtiḥ kartavyaviṣaye’nusandhānaṃ śubhāśraye || 26 || rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnena parameśaprasaṃgataḥ | svātantryaṃ ca parānapekṣatā rakṣyā tu sātvataiḥ || 27|| kauśalaṃ sarvakāryeṣu naipuṇyaṃ rakṣyamuttamam | kāntiḥ rakṣyā brahmacaryabalajā śobhanātmikā ||28|| dhairyaṃ viṣamabhāve’pi vyākulatvavivarjanam | mārdavaṃ sarvadā rakṣyaṃ rokṣyakāṭhinyavarjanam ||29|| prāgalbhyaṃ pratibhā rakṣyā mokṣavicāradāyinī | praśrayo vinayo rakṣyaḥ sadvṛttiḥ śīlakāriṇī ||2.125.3 0 || sahanaṃ manasā kāryaṃ sarvaghāte’pyaghātitā | ojaḥ rakṣyaṃ cakṣurādau jñānendriyeṣu sarvathā || 31 || prabhāvaśca balaṃ rakṣyaṃ karmendriyeṣu vai tathā | bhago rakṣyo maddaiśvaryaṃ sarvotkarṣādisaṃsthitiḥ || 32|| gāmbhīryaṃ rakṣaṇīyaṃ ca durgāhyāntaramantraṇam | sthairyaṃ rakṣyaṃ sadā bhaktaiścāñcalyena vihīnatā ||33|| āstikyaṃ dharmamokṣādau harau mayi sthirā matiḥ | śāstrokte’rthe ca viśvāsaḥ śraddhā ca paramātmani ||34|| kīrtiḥ prāpyā śubhā bhaktiḥ khyātirdhāmapradā janaiḥ | maunaṃ rakṣyaṃ vṛthālāpavarjanaṃ sāttvataiḥ sadā ||39|| garvābhāvaḥ sadā rakṣyo guṇādyahantvahīnatā | mānābhāvastathā rakṣyo’vṛthāsvarūpahānitā || 36|| daṃbhābhāvastathā rakṣyo vañcakatvavihīnatā | yogyāhārastathā kāryo yo mokṣe phalado bhavet ||37|| dākṣyaṃ rakṣyaṃ hitavākyopadeṣṭṛtvaṃ na cetarat | maitrī rakṣyā ca viśvāsādhāratā sarvadehinām ||38|| upakāraśca sarveṣāṃ kartavyo’tivāñcchayā | akṣobhaśca sadā rakṣyo vegena tṛṣṇayāpi vā ||39|| kṣubdhavyaṃ naiva viṣaye sāttvikairbhaktiyogibhiḥ | pīḍanaṃ prāṇināṃ naiva kartavyaṃ vaiṣṇavaiḥ kvacit ||2.125.40 || sarvasatkārakāritvaṃ grahaṇīyaṃ samantataḥ | aniṣṭāptaparābhūtirāhityaṃ kāryameva ca ||41 || brahmajñānāṃ sahavāsaḥ kartavyaśca satāmapi | sādhutā rakṣaṇīyā ca śaraṇāgatapālitā ||42|| phalecchāśūnyatā rakṣyā parigrahavivarjitā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe mayi parātmani ||43 || sarvasvārpaṇabhaktiśca kartavyā mama sāttvatai | yathā bhaktirmama kāryā tathā kāryā satāṃ mama ||44|| nirdaṃbhapremabhāvena guroḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ tathā | guroḥ sevā mama sevā bhuktimuktipradā sadā ||45|| mama pūjā prakartavyā satāṃ mamārcanaṃ tathā | bhuktimuktipradaṃ caitat sarvapāpapraṇāśakam ||46 || patnī rakṣyā sadā saukhye pīḍanīyā na vai kvacit | patiḥ pūjyaḥ sadā patnyā pīḍanīyo na vai kvacit ||47|| vṛddhāḥ sevyāḥ sadā madhyāvasthaiḥ putrādibhiḥ khalu | gāvaḥ santaḥ sadā rakṣyā bhaktibodhakarā api ||48|| devā rakṣyā gṛhe mūrtisvarūpā dṛṣṭipāvanāḥ | guravaśca sadā rakṣyā gehe saṃsāratārakāḥ ||49|| bhajanaṃ ca sadā kāryaṃ mama nārāyaṇasya vai | śaraṇaṃ ca mama grāhyaṃ puruṣottamaśārṅgiṇaḥ ||2.125.50|| gurorājñā sadā pālyā śubhā vā mokṣadāyinī | sveṣāṃ śāntikarī mānyā vāco guroḥ sadānujaiḥ ||5 1|| pūjanaṃ sarvadā kāryaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya me | parabrahma evātra mūrtau me bhaktapuṃgavaiḥ ||52|| snānaṃ sarovare cātra kartavyaṃ bālakṛṣṇake | mārgaikādaśikāyāṃ cāmāyāṃ dvitīyake dine ||53|| saptāheṣu prakartavyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam | atra dānaṃ prakartavyaṃ gavāṃ mokṣapradāyakam ||54|| mama mūrteḥ pradānaṃ ca bhavet sarvārthasādhakam | istidānaṃ cāśvadānaṃ vṛṣabhasya pradānakam ||55|| mahiṣīdānamārpyaṃ ca reṇḍīvṛṣabhadānakam | śakaṭasya ca yānasya vimānasya pradānakam ||56|| śibikāyāḥ pradānaṃ ca vāhanānāṃ pradānakam | vastrāṇāṃ kambalānāṃ ca śāṭīnāṃ ca pradānakam |||57||| kartavyaṃ kañcukīnāṃ ca dāna koṭiguṇārthakam | svarṇadānaṃ rūpyadānaṃ tāmradānaṃ śriyaḥpradam |||58|| pātradānaṃ prakartavyaṃ cānnadānaṃ mahattamam | jaladānaṃ miṣṭadānaṃ ceṣṭadānaṃ śubhāvaham |||59|| śākadānaṃ prakartavyaṃ kanyādānaṃ divaspadam | jñānadānaṃ tathā yajñopavītasya pradānakam ||2.125.60|| gṛhadānaṃ tathā dānaṃ gṛhopakaraṇādijam | prakartavyaṃ vāṭikāyā dānaṃ kṣetrapradānakam ||61 || yadyat sveṣṭaṃ bhavettasya dānaṃ kartavyamatra vai | sādhubhyo bhojanaṃ deyaṃ maharṣibhyaśca pūjanam ||62|| bhojanaṃ valkalādyaṃ ca dātavyaṃ śreya icchatā | pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍadānādi kartavyaṃ pitṛtṛptaye ||62 || bālakṛṣṇasarasyeva śāśvatītṛptidaṃ bhavet | devānāṃ pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ bālakṛṣṇasarastaṭe ||64|| mandirāṇi surāṇāṃ ca kāraṇīyāni tattaṭe | muktānāmavatārāṇāmīśvarāṇāṃ tathālayāḥ ||65|| ṛṣīṇāṃ cāpi pitṝṇāṃ prāsādā mokṣadāḥ śubhāḥ | kāraṇīyā dharmaśālā bhaktiśālāḥ śubhāvahāḥ ||66|| udyānāni vāṭikādyāḥ kāraṇīyā hareḥ kṛte | mandiraṃ kārayitvātra mama mūrtyā samaṃ surān ||67|| sthāpayiṣyanti ye bhaktāstebhyo dhāma dadāmyaham | jīvikāṃ vṛttikāṃ cāpi pūjāyāśca pravāhikām ||68|| kārayiṣyanti ye bhaktāsteṣāṃ puṇyamanantakam | sarvaṃ dāsye’hamevāsmai dhāmni me puruṣottamaḥ ||69|| sarve devāstathā muktā īśvarāśca narāyaṇāḥ | avatārā īśvarāṇyo muktānyo devapuṃgavāḥ ||2.125.70|| devyo devāḥ ṛṣayaśca tīrthāni ca vasantviha | bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma svayaṃ vasāmi cātra hi ||71 || mārgaśīrṣakṛṣṇapakṣaikādaśikādine’niśam | pratisamvatsaraṃ sarvatīrthaiṃrdevaiśca sādhubhiḥ ||72|| muktaistatheśvaraiścātrāgantavyaṃ lokahetave | sarvapāvitryalābhārthaṃ saptāhaṃ tīrthabhāvataḥ ||73|| koṭiśaśca janāstvatra snāsyanti hi sarovare | teṣāṃ pāpavināśaśca puṇyaṃ syādapyanantakam ||74|| etattīrthavaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvatīrthottamottamam | mayā sampādyate cātra vāsaṃ kṛtvā tu śāśvatam ||75|| atra tīrthaprakartṝṇāṃ rogā yāsyanti vai kṣayam | dāridryaṃ nāśamāyācca durbhāgyaṃ nāśamāpnuyāt ||76|| lakṣmīsteṣāṃ gṛhe syācca saubhāgyaṃ vardhayettathā | putrapautrādivaṃśaśca tairthikānāṃ bhavediha ||77|| yatheṣṭaḥ syāttasya lābhaḥ puruṣārthacatuṣṭaye | mārgaśīrṣātirikte’pi māse tīrthavidhāyinām ||78|| praṇaśyanti ca pāpāni puṇyaṃ svargapradaṃ bhavet| | atra vārdhau mṛtānāṃ vai bhasmāsthikṣepaṇe’pi ca ||79|| sarvapāpavināśo’pi muktiśca śāśvatī bhavet | etatsarojalasyāpi kaṇaṃ pāsyati yo janaḥ ||2.125.80|| mṛtyavasthāgatasyāpi muktistasya tu śāśvatī | sarasaścāsya saṃbhūtaḥ svāmyahaṃ parameśvaraḥ ||8 1 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībālakṛṣṇakaḥ | sarojalasya yogena mama yogo dhruvo bhavet |||82|| snānāt pānād darśanāccācamanāt sparśanādapi | smaraṇādasya yajñasya sarasaśca pramokṣaṇam ||83|| bhavatyeva na sandeho dāsye’haṃ puruṣottamaḥ | tapastīrthaṃ vrataṃ homaḥ kāryāścātra mumukṣubhiḥ ||84|| samarpaṇaṃ kriyāṇāṃ ca kartavyaṃ mayi śārṅgiṇi | śāśvataṃ puṇyameva syādarpitasya mayi dhruvam ||85|| muktatīrthaṃ brahmatīrthaṃ brahmapriyāditīrthakam | avatārāditīrthāni bhūmatīrthaṃ tathātra ca ||86|| vāsudevābhidhaṃ tīrthaṃ prādyumnaṃ tīrthamityapi | devāyatanakaṃ tīrthaṃ vairājatīrthamityapi ||87|| kṛṣṇatīrthaṃ tathā rādhātīrthaṃ śrītīrthamityapi | nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ lakṣmītīrthaṃ śubhaṃ param ||88|| brahmatīrthaṃ viṣṇutīrthaṃ śivatīrthaṃ satīyutam | rudratīrthaṃ rāśitīrtham ṛṣitīrthaṃ tathottamam ||89|| pitṛtīrthaṃ devatīrthaṃ dikpālānāṃ ca tīrthakam | indratīrthaṃ vahnitīrthaṃ dharmatīrthaṃ śubhottamam ||2.125.90|| vāyutīrthaṃ yamatīrthaṃ kuberatīrthamuttamam | īśānatīrthamutkṛṣṭaṃ bṛhaspatipratīrthakam ||9 1|| lomaśākhyaṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ yajñatīrthaṃ śubhottamam | kambharātīrthamevāpi santoṣātīrthamityapi || 92|| śrīmadgopālatīrthaṃ ca māṇikītīrthamityapi | sabhātīrthaṃ tathā pāravaśaṃtīrthaṃ śubhaṃ priyam || 93|| vedatīrthaṃ ca gāyatrītīrthaṃ sāvitrikāhvayam | kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ bālakṛṣṇapratīrthakam ||94|| kalpavallīmahātīrthaṃ śubhaṃ sarveṣṭadāyakam | grahatīrthaṃ sūryatīrthaṃ devāyatanatīrthakam ||95|| vasutīrthaṃ sādhyatīrthaṃ viśvetīrthaṃ śubhāspadam | sāmudratīrthamevāpi kailāsatīrthamityapi ||96 || vaikuṇṭhatīrthamevāpi gaṇeśatīrthamityapi | gaṇatīrthaṃ satītīrthaṃ sādhvītīrthottamottamam ||97|| vratatīrthaṃ vimānākhyatīrthaṃ ca śibitīrthakam | avabhṛthaṃ mahattīrthaṃ sarvatīrthādhivāsitam ||98|| etānyanyāni sarvāṇi mūrtānyatra vasanti hi | mamājñayādyārabhyaiva pāvanāni tu dehinām ||99|| dharmakāryaṃ sadā cātra kartavyaṃ mānavaistataḥ | atha sarve prayāntyeva tharkūṭasthasya rājyake || 2.125.100 || yatra yaśaḥ prakartavyastatra kurvantu tatsthitim | ahaṃ tatrāgamiṣyāmi śvo vā paraśca eva tu || 101 | ityuktāstīrthadevāśca kṛtvā rūpaṃ dvitīyakam | tatra tīrthasvarūpeṇa sthitāḥ sadā hi rādhike || 102 || atha sarve yayustatra dvikalākhyasarovare | tharkūṭasthamahārājarājye yajñārthameva ha || 1 03|| vyomayānena vai sarve īśā devāśca mānavāḥ | koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyā hi satīsādhvīharipriyāḥ || 1 04|. bālakṛṣṇaḥ samuvāsa śibirājagṛhe dinam | viśrāntyarthaṃ tathā rājñaḥ sevāsvīkaraṇāya vai || 1 05| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bālakṛṣṇamūrtinā śrīhariṇā pradattopadeśāśiṣo, dvitīyayajñārthamājñā, bālakṛṣṇasarastīrthāni cetinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 125 ||
<2.126> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tatra camatkāro’bhavanmahān | sabhāyāḥ sannidhau tatra kṛśāṃgāśca sahasraśaḥ || 1 rukṣavarṇā narā nāryaḥ kṛṣṇāstejovihīnakāḥ | duḥkhinaścāśrayahīnā dīnā iva samāyayuḥ || 2 || prārthayantaḥ svamokṣaṃ vai duḥkhasāgarabandhanāt | dṛṣṭvā tām̐stu prajānāṃ ca tadāścaryamabhūnmahat || 3 | | ka ime kuta āyātā jijñāsāṃ cakrire prajāḥ | jñātvā ca hariṇā hārdaṃ pṛṣṭāste yūyamatra ke || 4 || te rudantastadā prāhuḥ śṛṇvatāṃ narayoṣitām | vayaṃ pretā mṛtāḥ pūrve pūrvajāḥ pretayonayaḥ || 5 || asadgatiṃ gatāḥ sarve sahasraśaḥ sarastaṭe | vasāmo’tra mahāraṇye kṣudhitā duḥkhitāstathā || 6 || prajānāṃ pitaraḥ smo’tra manyante na ime tu naḥ | uddhāraṃ tvaṃ bhagavannaḥ kurvatra jaladānataḥ || 7 || ītyuktavadbhyastebhyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jalam | prāsādikaṃ nijaṃ kṛtvā dadau pānārthameva ca || 8 || miṣṭaṃ prasāda datvā ca tṛptān kṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ | dadau muktiṃ brahmalokagāminīṃ paramottamām || 9 || sarve te divyadehā vai muktāstatrābhavan śubhāḥ | muktatulyā vimānaiśca yayuste brahma śāśvatam || 2.126.10 || ityevaṃ sarasastīre muktiṃ tebhyo dadau hariḥ | āścaryaṃ parama dṛṣṭvā prajāḥ śrāddhāni cācaran || 11 || pitṝṇāṃ tena muktiśca tṛptiścāpi vyajāyata | ityevaṃ rādhike pitṛtīrthaṃ tat samavartata || 12 || śibidevena codyāne bhūpaveṣe prapūjitaḥ | anādiśrībālakṛṣṇaḥ sainyādiparivāritaḥ || 13 || bhūpaveṣasuśobhāḍhyaścāmbālikāsamanvite | caturdantagaje śukle niṣāditaḥ pareśvaraḥ || 14|| svāmipālāśanāmnyāṃ vai gatvā vimānakena tu | rājadhānyāṃ nijāyāṃ ca caturdantagajopari || 15 || punaśca bhrāmitaḥ kṛṣṇo rājamārgādibhistataḥ | prajābhirvardhitaḥ puṣpākṣatalājābhiracyutaḥ || 16 || pūjito vanditaḥ kṛṣṇo bahubhāvena cārthitaḥ | rājñyā bhūprabhayā sākaṃ rājñā bhūpālaye ciram || 17 || tatastāmrakaśāyāṃ ca gatvā vimānamārgataḥ | datvā svadarśanaṃ rājñyāḥ pitṛbhyāṃ pūjitaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 8|| vimānena yayau rājñā śibinā saha mādhavaḥ | tharkūṭasthanṛparājye dvikalākhyasarastaṭe || 19 || paścime bhūtale bīnānadīparyantameva ha | kṛtām̐śca maṇḍapān dṛṣṭvā śibirāṇi navāni ca ||2.126.2 0 || sarovaraṃ bhrāmayitvāvātārayad vimānakam | paścime sarasastīre maṇḍapasya samīpataḥ || 2 1 || avādyanta suvādyāni tadā māṃgalikāni hi | jayaghoṣā hyabhavam̐śca sādhuvādāstathābhavan ||22|| puṣpacandanalājābhiścākṣataiḥ kuṃkumādibhiḥ | vardhayanti sma janatāḥ śrīkṛṣṇasvāminaṃ harim ||23|| koṭiśo mānavāstatra dvikalasya taṭe’bhavan | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśanotsukāḥ || 24|| pāvitryākāṃkṣayā yajñaṃ draṣṭuṃ cāpi samāgatāḥ | narā nāryaḥ koṭiśaste ābālavṛddhamānavāḥ ||25|| sūryavat kāśamānaṃ taṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ prabhuṃ tathā | mātaraṃ pitaraṃ cāpi bhrātarau bhaginīṃ snuṣām ||26 || śibidevaṃ ca bhaktāgryaṃ dṛṣṭvā jahṛṣurutsukāḥ | devatāyatanaścāpi lomaśaḥ patnikāvrataḥ ||27|| vaśiṣṭhādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca hārān śrīharaye daduḥ |
