tasmādvai dīkṣito bhavet || 61|| dīkṣitasya tu sevāyāḥ phalaṃ mokṣo bhavediti | dīkṣitasparśajaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāpāpādināśakam ||6 3 || dīkṣitasya prasādānnaṃ pāvanaṃ cāpi tajjalam | dīkṣitasya sahavāso mokṣado dhāmadāyakaḥ ||64|| dīkṣitasya tu satsaṃgo bhagavatsaṃgasadṛśaḥ | dīkṣitasya kriyāḥ sarvā divyā haryarpaṇātmikāḥ ||6 5 || dīkṣite sarvayajñānāṃ puṇyāni nivasanti vai | dīkṣitasya snānavāri pītvā tṛpyanti pūrvajāḥ ||66|| ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhā yogino yatayastathā | sādhavo brahmaśīlāśca dīkṣitaṃ praṇamanti vai ||67|| dīkṣito yadgṛhe yāti tadgṛhaṃ dhāmasadṛśam | sevate yā dīkṣitaṃ sā bodhyā vai puṇyaśālinī ||68|| sevate yo dīkṣitaṃ sa jāyate pārṣado hareḥ | pṛthvī nityaṃ hareragre prārthayati pradīkṣitam ||69|| sādhudīkṣāprapannānāṃ caraṇaiḥ pāvanī hyaham | dīkṣitasnānamātreṇa jalaṃ tīrthaṃ prajāyate ||2.133.70|| sādhulālāsanaścāhaṃ satyaṃ vadāmi vai muhuḥ | saccidānandasaṃjño’haṃ jāto vai dīkṣayā hareḥ ||71 || ābālyādapi saṃgrāhyaḥ śaraṇāgatamantrakaḥ | tasyāśrayapradātā śrīkṛṣṇo yatra bhayaṃ na vai ||72|| tato grāhyo rakṣaṇasya mantro’pyābālyato’pi vai | kālānmāyābandhanācca pāpācca karmabandhanāt ||73|| śatrubhyo yāmyaduḥkhācca kumitrād yadbhayādikam | tasmāt triśūlamatsyādicihno’vatyeva mādhavaḥ ||74|| yaddhaste triśūlacihnaṃ mīnacihnaṃ dhvajāṅkakam | dhanuraṃkaṃ cakracihnaṃ svastikāṅkaṃ ca vajrakam ||75|| tatra triśūlakaṃ divyaṃ kālabhītiṃ prahanti vai | dīvyamīnastathā hanti māyābhītiṃ ca bandhanam ||76|| dhvajacihnaṃ tathā divyaṃ hanti pāpabhayaṃ sadā | dhanuraṃkaṃ tathā divyaṃ karmabhītiṃ prahanti ca ||77|| cakracihnaṃ mahādivyaṃ śatrūn prahanti tadbhayam | svasticihnaṃ tathā divyaṃ yamabhītiṃ prahanti ca ||78|| kaṃ vajraṃ divyamevaitat kuhṛdbhayaṃ nihanti ca | saptacihnadharo hasto yasya dehaṃ spṛśatyapi ||79|| taddehe tūktabhītīnāṃ saṃbhavo’pi na jāyate | tataḥ samarpaṇo mantro grāhyo vai jñānapūrvakaḥ ||2.133.80|| oṃ nāmne haraye cāhaṃ namaskaromi sarvadā | svāmine śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyārpaṇatāṃ gataḥ ||81|| nānyasyāhaṃ bhavāmyadyadināt tasyaiva vai vaśe | dāso bhṛtyo dīnadāsī bhavāmyadyadināddhare ||82|| ityevaṃ tvātmadānākhyaṃ sarvasvaṃ tatra cārpyate | hutaṃ ghṛtaṃ yathā vahnau hutaścāhaṃ tathā harau ||83|| pṛthagbhāvo na me’styadyadinācchrīkṛṣṇaballabhāt | matvaivaṃ nijabhāve śrīharau dehe yathātmani ||84|| tathā śrībālakṛṣṇo’tra pare brahmaṇi sarvadā | patitvaṃ śāśvataṃ jñeyaṃ pitṛtvaṃ bandhutāpi ca ||85|| suhṛtā mitratā cāpi rakṣayitṛtvamityapi | pālakatvaṃ tathā kṛṣṇe śāśvataṃ jñeyameva ca ||86 || ityevaṃ cārpaṇe jñāne paripakve dṛḍhe sati | tato grāhyā sādhudīkṣā brahmabhāvapradā śubhā ||87|| brahmarūpo yataścāhaṃ dehendriyādyahaṃ na vai | premasevākaro bhaktaḥ śāśvato’smi hareryataḥ ||88|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvatvameva me | patiḥ pātā tathā bhoktā svāmī niyāmako mama ||89|| antarātmā parātmā ca bāhyātmāpi mamaiva saḥ | indriyātmā śarīrātmā daihikātmā mamaiva saḥ ||2.133.90|| ityevaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇād rikto’smi na kvacit | sadā tanmūrtimagno’smi tadguṇaśca tadaṃśakaḥ || 91 || evaṃ vai brahmabhāvaṃ svaṃ viditvā sādhutā phalet | parākṣare tu vindeta śrīhareḥ śāśvataṃ sukham ||92|| evaṃ dīkṣāgrahe śīghraṃ divyā bhavanti dehinaḥ | tasmād dīkṣā harergrāhyā jñānibhiḥ sādhavī parā ||93 || tadanyaiḥ rakṣiṇī dīkṣā śaraṇī vā samarpaṇī | grahītavyā vinā dīkṣāṃ na stheyaṃ mānavairiha ||94|| deśaḥ kālaḥ śubhaḥ saṃgo na hātavyaḥ kadācana | parameśe gṛhe prāpte prasanne mokṣadāyini ||95|| yo na māyāṃ tyajenmūḍhastasya hāniḥ pade pade | durlabhaṃ mānuṣaṃ varṣma mokṣasādhanamuttamam ||96 || prāpya tanna yatetāpi mokṣe’tra tvātmahā hi saḥ | tasmādātmā na hantavyo mokṣayogyo’pi mānavaiḥ ||97|| gṛhṇantu sādhavīṃ dīkṣāṃ tadanyāṃ pātratā yathā | ayaṃ śrībhagavān sākṣād dadātyeva yathā hi me ||98|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau saccidānandayogirāṭ | lakṣaśo mānavāḥ śrutvā dīkṣārthaṃ samupāgatāḥ ||99|| bālakṛṣṇo dadau tebhyaḥ śaraṇaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ tathā | samarpaṇaṃ manuṃ cāpi jñānibhyo brahmamantrakam || 2.133.1 00|| pañcasāhasrabhaktāste tadā vai sādhavo’bhavan | guravo lokajīvānāṃ mokṣakāriṇa eva ca || 101 || rāśiyānādideśeṣūpadeśārthaṃ nideśitāḥ | prayayurbhinnadeśeṣu haryājñayā hareḥ priyāḥ || 1 02|| rādhe harirviśaśrāma sabhāntaṃ pracakāra ha | nivāseṣu pragatvaiva viśaśramuśca dehinaḥ || 103 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrīhariḥ sādhulālāsanayogine sādhavīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ dīkṣāṃ datvā tataḥ pañcasahasrebhyaḥ sādhavīṃ dīkṣāṃ dadāvityādinirūpaṇanāmā trayastriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 133 ||
<2.134> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | trayodaśyāṃ prage snātvā samājuhāva bhūbhṛtam || 1 || kālimeśaṃ mahārājaṃ sa tu rājā drutaṃ yayau | hariṃ natvā supūjyaiva niṣasāda puro hareḥ || 2 || bhagavānāha sarvebhyo bhojanānte’dya dakṣiṇām | vidāyākhyāṃ dehi rājannutsavasya visarjane || 3 || ityuktaḥ sa mahārājo randhayāmāsa satvaram | bhojanāni vividhānyāhārayāmāsa saddhanam || 4 || hīrāmāṇikyaratnāni svarṇarūpyakamudrikāḥ | bhūṣālaṃkāravastrāṇi gā vimānāni vāhanam || 5 || madhyāhne śrīhariṃ sarvamahīmānebhya ityapi | dakṣiṇā dāpayāmāsa bhojayāmāsa tān mudā || 6 || bhojitā muktamuktānyo brahmākṣaravibhūtayaḥ | śaktayaḥ pārṣadā dāsā dāsyo bhṛtyāśca bhūbhṛtā || 7 || sevakāścāvatārāścāvatāriṇyaḥ subhojitāḥ | rādhālakṣmyādayaḥ sarvā vāsudevādayastathā || 8 || bhūmaviṣṇumahāviṣṇuvairājaśaṃbhutadgaṇāḥ | māyāstatpuruṣāścāpi dhāmāni tannivāsinaḥ || 9 || vairājāḥ satyalokīyāḥ ṛṣayo munayastathā | siddhāśca sādhavaścāpi pitaraḥ suradevatāḥ || 2.134.1 0|| dikpālā lokapālāśca meruparvatavāsinaḥ | bhuvarlokasthitāścāpi maruto viśvadevatāḥ || 11 || vasavaścāraṇāḥ sādhyā nidhayo mānavā gaṇāḥ | gaṇeśā gaṇikāścāpi bhūtāḥ pretāśca mātaraḥ || 1 2|| daityadānavarakṣāṃsi hyasurā bhaktasṛṣṭayaḥ | sūryā rudrā grahāstārā nakṣatrāṇi ca kāśyapāḥ || 1 3|| vṛkṣā vallyastṛṇastambā vaṃśāḥ kandāḥ phaladrumāḥ | nadā nadyaḥ samudrāśca sarāṃsi nirjharādayaḥ || 14|| vāpīkūpataṭākāni khātākhātāni cābdhayaḥ | tīrthāni parvatāścāpi vanānyupavanāni ca || 15|| kīṭāḥ pataṃgāśca sarīsṛpāḥ pātālavāsinaḥ | anye’pi deśadeśīyāstattvānyapi jaḍāni ca || 16|| yajñāśca vahnayaścāpi pātrāṇi havyasaddravāḥ | sarve mūrtā hareryogāt pūjitā bhūbhṛtā tadā || 17|| tathā sarvaiḥ rājabhiśca pūjitā bhojitāstathā | toṣitā dakṣiṇābhiśca kṣatyādau prakṣamāpitāḥ || 18|| dāsavargāḥ karmacārā ye’bhavan yajñakarmasu | bhāṭṭāśca bandinaḥ sūtā bhāṭāścāraṇaguhyakāḥ || 19|| gāndharvā nartakā nāṭyakalā naṭāśca gāyakāḥ | nartakyo gāyikāścāpi devyo’psarogaṇādayaḥ ||2.134.20|| pādasaṃvāhakāścāpi bhṛtyāḥ sevākarāstathā | sevakāḥ kṣālakāścāpi mārjakā hārakā api || 11 || kvaṇakā mālinaścāpi tvaṣṭārastantuvāyakāḥ | rajakā rājakāścāpi śilpinaḥ sukalāvidaḥ ||22|| evamanye dīpahārā vetrahārādayastathā | jayakārā vāharakṣāḥ saudhodyānādirakṣiṇaḥ || 23|| gopālā gṛhapālāśca vanāraṇyaprapālakāḥ | yānavāhanapālāśca koṭiśo’pi ca mānavāḥ || 24|| vārapriyāstathā vārā napuṃsakāni bhaṇḍakāḥ | bahurūpā raṅgagāmā hāsakāḥ kathakāstathā ||25||| sabhyāḥ sabhākalājñāśca śṛṃgārahāvabhāvinaḥ | pradarśanakarāścāpi vahnisphoṭakarāstathā || 26|| vidyudvijñā yantravāhā jalavāhādayastathā | dṛśyaśilpāstathā cānye ye ke karmacarādayaḥ ||27|| narā nāryaśca sarve te sarvā rājabhirarcitāḥ | toṣitā dakṣiṇābhiśca pāritoṣikavastubhiḥ ||28|| vastrāmbaradhanādyaiścālaṃkāropakarādibhiḥ | dravyaiḥ suvarṇakūpyaiśca ratnahārādibhistathā ||29|| bhojitāstoṣitāścāti prasāditāḥ punaḥ punaḥ | bhikṣukā dīnavargāścānāthā dāridryayoginaḥ ||2.134.3 0|| narā nāryaḥ satīsādhvyaḥ sādhavo rāgavarjitāḥ | aniketāstāpasāścātithayo vanavāsinaḥ ||3 1 || bahujātīyajīvāśca jātismarā viyonijāḥ | evamanye’pyalasāśca rājasāstāmasā api || 3 2|| sarve santoṣitāḥ sarvapradānairacyutājñayā | rājabhiḥ sarvadānaiste toṣitāstatra cotsave ||33 || atha rādhe hareḥ pūjāṃ cakruste’pyaparāhṇake | vidāyaṃ cārthayāmāsurharirvidāyakaṃ dadau || 34|| nīrājayitvā śrīpatiṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ pumuttamam | kṛtakṛtyān manyamānāḥ prāpyājñāṃ pārameśvarīm ||35|| prārthayate kṣamāṃ sevākṣatau rājñe pradāya ca | āśīrvādān vimānaiḥ svairyānaiḥ rathaiśca vāhanaiḥ ||36|| yathaiśvaryaṃ yathāsmṛddhiṃ yathāgati yayurgṛhān | svasvalokān kṣiterbhāgervāyumārgairvimānakaiḥ || 37|| garuḍaiśca gajairaśvairhaṃsaiḥ siṃhādibhistathā | analaiḥ kiraṇaiścāpi saṃkalpaiḥ siddhibhistathā ||38|| samādhinā yayuścāpyaiśvaryakaiḥ rūpalakṣakaiḥ | adṛśyabhāvanābhiśca līnaiśvaryādibhistathā || 39|| sṛjyaiśvaryaistathā cātmatattvabhāvairyayurgṛham | evaṃ tatra trayodaśyāṃ mahīmānāḥ samastataḥ ||2.134.40|| yayurlokānnijāndeśān saurāṣṭramaṇḍalaṃ vinā | koṭyarbudabrahmapriyākanyakāsahito hariḥ ||41 || lomaśādimunibhiśca tathāśvapaṭṭatīrthakaiḥ | kṣetrapairavatārādyaiḥ pitṛbhyāṃ sahitastathā ||42|| bhaktairdāsaiḥ kuṭumbena vaiṣṇavaiḥ ṛṣibhiḥ saha | sādhvībhiḥ sādhubhiḥ sākaṃ sarvakanyābhirityapi ||43|| akṣarakṣetravāsābhiḥ prajābhiḥ sāttvataiḥ saha | devāyanādibhiḥ sākaṃ śrīhariḥ pūrṇimāvadhim ||44|| kālimeśanṛpasaudhe samuvāsa kṛpākaraḥ | kālimeśakuṭumbasya śreyase toṣaṇāya ca ||45|| sarvarājakuṭumbāni nyūṣuścāpūrṇimāvadhim | ahaṃ kṛṣṇastathā nārāyaṇastasyecchayā prabhoḥ ||46|| tvayā lakṣmyā yutau cāvāṃ nyūṣima pūrṇimāvadhim | evaṃ vai rādhike kṛtvā prāghūrṇikavidāyakam ||47|| rātrau viśrāntimāpannaḥ sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamaḥ | caturdaśyāṃ prage snātvā samāhūya nṛpān hariḥ ||48|| upādideśa hārdaṃ svaṃ sabhyebhyo nṛpasaṃsadi | śṛṇvantu vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve rājānastatkuṭumbinaḥ ||49|| rājā dharmāśrayaścāsti rājanyahaṃ vasāmi ca | dikpālānāṃ śaktayaśca nihitā vai nṛpe mayā ||2.134.50|| rājādhīnaprajāḥ sarvāḥ pālayanti vṛṣān śubhān | acauryama cāpyahiṃsāṃ ca brahmacaryaṃ nayaṃ tathā ||5 1 || satyaṃ prapālanaṃ cāpi mātāpitṛprasevanam | patyadhīnā tathā patnī patnyadhīnaḥ patistathā ||52|| svāmyadhīnāstathā bhṛtyā bhṛtyādhīnaśca rakṣakaḥ | rājabhītyā yathācāre vartante daṇḍabhītitaḥ ||53 || tasmād rājā mama rūpo mama śāsanavartanaḥ | rājñā vai pālyate dharmastathārtho’pi prapālyate |||54|| rājā prajānāmarthaiśca karoti kratumutsavam | annasatrāṇi devānāṃ mandirāṇyartharāśibhiḥ ||55|| bhaktiṃ karoti rājā ca kārayatyapi rāṣṭrake | tārayati prajāścāpi yastu bhāgavato bhavet |||56|| tasmād bhavadbhiḥ kṣitipaiḥ pṛthvyāṃ dūtaistu sarvataḥ | kāraṇīyā harerbhakterghoṣaṇā paṭahairapi ||57|| prajā bhavantu ca harerbhaktimatyaḥ sudīkṣitāḥ | vaiṣṇavyaḥ sarvathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasamāśritāḥ ||58|| yajñopavītaṃ gṛhṇantu vaiṣṇavaṃ pāvanaṃ śubham | dīkṣāṃ mantraṃ harernāma gṛhṇantvapi pramokṣadam ||59|| vrataṃ kurvantu ca harerjanmāṣṭamyāṃ śubhorjake | kṛṣṇe dale’tibhāvena caikādaśyā vrataṃ tathā ||2.134.6 0|| atra yajñadinānāṃ ca kurvantu tīrthayātrikām | nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ cāpi prakurvantu divāniśam ||6 1 || utsavān vividhām̐ścapi vaiṣṇavairmilitaiḥ saha | kārayantu prajāścāpi kathāpārāyaṇādikam ||62|| cāturmāsye prapūjādi kurvantu śrīharestathā | ityevaṃ ghoṣaṇāṃ rājye kārayantu nije nije ||6 3 || ityādiṣṭāstu rājānaḥ pañcamukhyāstathāpare | śibidevanṛpaścāpi tharkūṭasthanṛpastathā ||64|| vīrajāramahārājaḥ śaktyakṣinṛpatistathā | kālimāśanṛpaścāpi tathānye khaṇḍabhūbhṛtaḥ ||65|| āśāṃ śirasi cādhāya nemuḥ śrīpuruṣottamam | kariṣyāmastathetyuktvoddhoṣaṇāṃ dūtasattamaiḥ ||66|| kārayāmāsuratyarthaṃ svasvarājye samantataḥ | bhojayāmāsa ca sarvān śrīharirnijamandire ||67|| kālimāśanṛpoktyā vai prāsādikaṃ tu naikadhā | sāyaṃ vimānamāruhya lālāyanamunergṛham ||68|| yayau śrībhagavān pūrvasamudre dvīpasaṃsthitam | prāsādikaṃ ca tat kṛtvā tvāyayau vyomamārgataḥ ||69|| kālimāśanṛpasaudhaṃ viśrāntiṃ prāpa vai niśi | lālāyanamṛṣiṃ sādhuṃ saccidānandasaṃjñitam ||2.134.70|| dīkṣitaṃ śrīharistvāha vraja tvaṃ cottarān kurūn | tava dvīpātpūrvadeśān kenāṭadvīpasaṃyutān ||71 || amarīṇāṃ pradeśām̐śca mama bhaktiṃ prakāraya | ityādato yatiḥ so’pi yayau kenāṭakān kurūn ||72|| vyomamārgeṇa yogena bahuśaktisamanvitaḥ | atha rātrau hariḥ prāpa viśrāntiṃ ca tataḥ punaḥ ||73|| pūrṇāyāṃ prātarutthāya snātvā dhyānaparo’bhavat | tāvat tatrābhavad rādhe mahāścaryaṃ hareḥ puraḥ ||74|| vimānaṃ tvakṣarāddhāmno muktayuktaṃ samujjvalam | āyātaṃ drāk sthiraṃ tasthau śrīhareḥ sannidhau tataḥ ||75|| pārṣadāstadvimānāccāvatīrya puruṣottamam | rādhike pūjayāmāsuḥ prāhurbhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ||76|| śūrajārasya muktyarthaṃ tathā tasya tu yoṣitaḥ | devavarūthinīnāmnyā mokṣārthaṃ bhavadājñayā ||77|| yathā pratiśrutaṃ tadvat smṛtvā samāgatā vayam | ājñāpaya yathā kṛṣṇa tathā smaḥ sevane ratāḥ ||78|| śrīhariṃ śrāvayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ bhūbhṛte tadā | saṃprayujyāśiṣo rājñe kālimeśāya śaktaye ||79|| vīrajāreṇa sahitaḥ śūrajārādisaṃyutaḥ | śrīharivīrajārasya rājyaṃ cobīnadītaṭe ||2.134.80|| āyayau suvimānena nijamaṇḍalasevitaḥ | śūrajāraṃ tathā devavarūthinīṃ tadā hariḥ ||8 1 || prāpayanmokṣakaṃ divyaṃ tvakṣaraṃ dhāma śāśvatam | atha śrībhagavām̐stūrṇa bālakṛṣṇasarovaram ||82|| āyayau tadvimānena śibirājālaye punaḥ | tharkūṭastho harerājñāṃ prāpya rājyaṃ nijaṃ yayau ||83|| athāścaryamabhūttatra kanyāḥ ṣoḍaśa cāyayuḥ | divyarūpadharāḥ sarvāstriśūlinyastrinetrikāḥ ||84|| tathā kumārāścatvāraste’pi triśūlanetrikāḥ | divyā yogakalāyuktā mahaiśvaryādiśālinaḥ ||85|| athānye puruṣā divyāḥ śvetāstriśūlanetrakāḥ | catvāraścaṃcalā dīrghāḥ sthūlāstatra samāyayuḥ ||86|| pañcāpare ca puruṣāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇāstriśūlinaḥ | trinetrā divyarūpāśca dīrghāḥ kṛśāḥ samāyayuḥ ||87|| ekaḥ kaścid durbalaśca niḥśastro’pi samāyayau | rūkṣavarṇo’pi sukhavān niścintaścañcalo’pi san ||88|| evamete samāgatya triṃśatte harisannidhau | nipeturdaṇḍavat kṛṣṇapādayorbhaktisaṃyutāḥ ||89|| dhanyā vayaṃ vayaṃ dhanyā uddhṛtāḥ paramātmanā | ityuktvā bahuratnādyaiḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ||2.134.90 || ārārtrikādikaṃ cakruḥ satkṛtāḥ śibinā tu te | niṣeduścātha saṃpṛṣṭāḥ ke yūyaṃ devarūpiṇaḥ ||9 1 || jagaduste vayaṃ rudrasṛṣṭāḥ purā tadātmajāḥ | rudrasṛṣṭervināśe’tra pracchannā vāsakāriṇaḥ ||92|| sadā vartāmahe tvadya pāvitāḥ paramātmanā | dehi mantrān vaiṣṇavām̐śca kuru śrīparameśvara || 93|| ityevaṃ tvarthitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo dadau manūn | tatra yāḥ kanyakāstvāsan rodryaḥ putryastu tā yathā ||94|| urulā bālikā irātriśā obī ca māniśī | bīnā tribalā trāsā ca tuṃgāsikā anāvarā ||95|| ālanaukā uṣṭrīyāskā yānā anādirā tathā | anāṃśukā kālimā ca vaiṣṇavyastāstadābhavan ||96|| kumārāścāpi catvāro nāmnā tān śṛṇu rādhike | bālakṛśo dvikalaśca alpamātro yurālakaḥ ||97|| te’pi mantrām̐stadā prāpya vaiṣṇavāścābhavan śubhāḥ | anye dīrghāśca puruṣā nāmnā tān śṛṇu rādhike ||98|| akṣoḍhā kārakaścāpi kaśyapāyo dviriṃgakaḥ | te’pi mantrān jagṛhuśca vaiṣṇavāścābhavam̐stadā ||99|| anye ca pañca puruṣā nāmnā tān śṛṇu rādhike | ūrulaśca samānaśca stenāvāsaḥ prabhālunaḥ || 2.134.10 0|| āpatāyī ta aivāpi jagṛhurvaiṣṇavān manūn | vaiṣṇavāścābhavam̐ścātha yaścaiko durbalo janaḥ || 101 || nāmnā śivaraṇaścāyaṃ jagrāha ca manūm̐stadā | vaiṣṇavāḥ samajāyanta sarve śrīharisevakāḥ || 1 02|| ājñāṃ gṛhītvā kanyāstā nadīrūpā yayuḥ sthalam | catvārastu kumārā vai sarorūpā yayuśca te || 1 03|| catvāraścāpi puruṣāścābdhirūpā yayuśca te | pañcāpi puruṣāścaite śailarūpā yayuśca te || 1 04|| eko rūkṣo durbalaśca raṇarūpo yayau tataḥ | tīrtharūpā nyavasam̐śca tārakā dehināṃ sadā || 1 05|| śibidevakuṭumbaṃ tad dṛṣṭvāścaryaparaṃ hyabhūt| | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya tattattīrthaphalaṃ bhavet || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīsaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne sarveṣāṃ mahīmānānāṃ vidāyasatkāraḥ, vaiṣṇavīghoṣaṇā, saccidānandalālāyanasyottarakurūn prati preṣaṇaṃ, śūrajāradampatīmokṣaḥ, triṃśadraudrīraudrātmajānāṃ vaiṣṇvībhavanam, tāni tīrthāni cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 134 ||
<2.135> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ | śibeḥ saudhe hyuṣitvā tatkṛtāṃ sevāṃ pragṛhya ca || 1 || vinirgamayya ca niśāṃ māghādyadivase prage | naityakaṃ daivikaṃ kṛtvādiśya dharmān susāttvatān || 2 || prāpya dattāṃ mahāpūjāṃ bhojanaṃ copadādikam | sarvān śubhāśīrvacanaiḥ saṃprayujya prasādya ca || 3 || devāyatanakaṃ bhaktaṃ tathā śrīlomaśādikān | brahmapriyāstathā sarvā akṣarakṣetravāsinaḥ || 4 || kṣetrapān devatīrthāni kuṭumbaṃ pārṣadādikān | mātaraṃ pitaraṃ cāpi bhrātṝn bhrātṛvadhūstathā || 5 || bhaginīṃ tatsakhīṃ cāpi rājārpitāśca kanyakāḥ | saurāṣṭrīyajanān naijān vimāneṣu naveṣu ca || 6 || niṣādya svavimānena vyomamārgeṇa sañcaran | indukuśaṃ samatītya sindhuvyoma vilaṃghya ca || 7 || badarikāśramaṃ gatvā dṛṣṭvā naraṃ narāyaṇam | ṛṣīn dṛṣṭvā tāpasām̐śca tataḥ śrīkāśikāṃ yayau || 8 || varaṇāyāstaṭe naijāṃ lakṣmīṃ śivasutāṃ satīm | śivarājaṃ tathā kṛṣṇāṃ candraṃ jayaṃ ca jānakīm || 9 || dṛṣṭvā sarvān sammilitvā snātvā gaṃgājale tataḥ | viśveśaṃ sarvadevāṃśca dṛṣṭvā sampūjya sarvathā || 2.135.1 0|| vimānaiḥ sahitaiḥ sarvaiḥ śrīhariḥ puruṣottamaḥ | rādhike cāyayāvaśvapaṭṭakṣetraṃ nijaṃ śubham || 11 || prajābhirjayakāraiśca vardhitāstīrthakāriṇaḥ | vimānāni tvakṣaraṃ tat kṣetraṃ tu vārasaptakam || 12|| bhramitvā kuṃkumavāpīṃ vilokyodyānavāṭikāḥ | sarvān vijñāpya ca nijāgamaṃ vai paścime tataḥ || 13 || avaterurmahodyāne sthairyamāptāni vai tataḥ | puṣpākṣataiśca lājābhiḥ satkṛtāni prajājanaiḥ || 14|| vimānebhyo bahiḥ sarve nirgatyāpṛcchya vai muhuḥ | kṣemaṃ ca kuśalaṃ cānāmayaṃ datvā sragādikam || 15|| satkṛtya ca samāśliṣya svasvasthānaṃ yayurjanāḥ | nivāsārheṣu saudheṣu nijān harirnyavāsayat || 16|| bhojayāmāsa śīghraṃ ca viśaśramuśca te tathā | prāhiṇot kanyakāḥ sarvāstadā brahmapriyāyutāḥ || 17|| lomaśasyāśrame ramye sadā māyāvivarjite | rarakṣa lomaśaḥ sarvā divyamuktottamo muniḥ || 18|| ṛṣayo devatādyāśca kṣetrapāstatravāsinaḥ | bhuktvā naijānnivāsām̐śca yayurviśrāntimāgaman || 19|| hariḥ kuṭumbasahito bhuktvā viśrāntimāpa ca | dvitīyāyā dine prātaḥ kṛtvā svaṃ naityakaṃ vidhim || 2.135.20|| mahīmānān surāṣṭrīyān bhojayāmāsa bhāvataḥ | kanthādharādyāśca tathā raṇaṃgamādayo’pi ca || 21 || viprāḥ śīlavratādyāśca maharṣayo’pi sādhavaḥ | ājñāṃ prāpya harernaijān grāmān yayuḥ samantataḥ ||22|| devāyatanakaṃ prāha hariḥ prasannamānasaḥ | tvayā bhakta kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ rāśirājyakam ||23|| naitādṛśaṃ mahat kāryaṃ vinā bhaktena jāyate | pāvitāḥ kiṃpuruṣā vai narā nāryo napuṃsakāḥ ||24|| prasanno’smi vadādeyaṃ tava me naiva vidyate | śṛṇu sarvaṃ dadāmyeva yatte manasi vartate ||25|| ityuktvā ca samākṛṣya mimile vakṣasā svayam | mastake śrīharistasya hastau tatra nyadhāt kṣaṇam ||26|| hṛdaye caraṇau divyau dadau śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | devāyano’pi bhakto’sau pūrṇakāmo’sti rādhike ||27|| tato vavre bhaktarāṭ sa gṛhaṃ te vai bhavāmyaham | yatra yatra bhavānāste pararūpaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ||28|| avatārasvarūpaścaiśvare daive ca mānuṣe | vibhavākhyo’thavā vyūhasvarūpo’pyathavāṃśakaḥ ||29|| arcārūpo’thavāveśakalāvibhūtirūpavān | śaktirūpo devarūpo yatrāste bhagavān bhavān ||2.135.3 0|| tatra tatra gṛhaṃ me’stu madgṛhe vasa sarvadā | hariḥ prāha ca dhanyo’si tvadātmakagṛhe’nvaham ||3 1|| yathā vasāmi saukhyena tathā tvaṃ bhava madgṛham | cetano muktarūpo’si saccidānandavigrahaḥ ||32|| tathā kāryasvarūpo’pi mama devālayo bhava | devālaye sadā cāhaṃ nivatsye sṛṣṭimaṇḍale||33|| prāsādo me bhavatveva gataḥ prāsādapātratām | yatrāhaṃ tatra sarvatra devāyatanako bhava ||34|| anekaśaktisampannaścānekarūpadhṛgbhava | jaḍavad dṛśyarūpastvaṃ tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ||35|| devālanāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhava tvaṣṭṛpravardhitaḥ | adhidevo’tirūpaśca darśanīyo hi dehinām ||36|| darśayiṣye ca rūpāṇi devālayātmakāni te | ityuktvā bhagavānasmai devāyatanakāya ca ||37|| darśayāmāsa śikharānvitaṃ devālayaṃ śubham | nijamūrtau tato mūrtidevālaye’pi tiṣṭhati || 38|| tādṛśaṃ darśayāmāsa sarvāṃge devatālayam | vedikāṃ jagatīṃ bhīṭaṃ pīṭhaṃ maṇḍovaraṃ tathā || 39|| śṛṃgaṃ padmaśilāṃ cāpi kalaśaṃ dhvajamityapi | agragaṃ maṇḍapaṃ cāpi gajāsanaṃ pradakṣiṇam ||2.135.40|| sarvaṃ mūrtau harirnaijasvarūpāyāṃ tadā muhuḥ | devatāyatanāyaiva devatāyatanātmakam ||41|| darśayāmāsa viśadaṃ jñānaṃ divyaṃ dadau tathā | devāyatanakaḥ prāpya jñānaṃ ca bhavanātmatām || 42|| kṛtakṛtyo’bhavannamro babhūva dvitvarūpavān | muktarūpastathā devālayarūpo’tiśobhanaḥ ||43|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre divyo devālayo’bhavat | sahasraḥ hastamānaḥ sa prāsādo’bhavadambare ||44|| yaddhaṭāścābbhrasalilaiḥ snānti nityaṃ dhvajānvitāḥ | tādṛśaṃ khalu bhagavān cakāra svaṃ śubhālayam ||45|| vijñāyaitadṛṣayaśca siddhāḥ devyaśca devatāḥ | jalajāḥ sthalajāścāpi catuḥkhanisusambhavāḥ ||46|| īśā īśvaramukhyāśca tattvāni cetanānyapi | vṛkṣā vallyaścākṛtayo garuḍā gajavājinaḥ ||47|| yoginyaḥ puṣpavallyaśca stambā mumukṣavastathā | araṇyasthā ambarasthā anye’pi saudhayoginaḥ ||48|| jñātvā devāyatanasya devālayasvarūpatām | tatra vāsaṃ cehamānāścāyayurharisannidhau ||49|| sadehāḥ śrīhareḥ sevāmicchanto bhaktibhāvukāḥ | prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ pūjayitvā hariṃ hi te ||2.135.50|| kṛpānātha dayāsindho sarvātman sarvarakṣaka | sarvāśrayapradātastvaṃ dehi vāsaṃ nijālaye ||51 || bhaktavatsalasaṃjño’si tava sarvaṃ śarīrakam | tvāṃ vinā naiva lokānāṃ vāsaḥ sukhāya kalpyate ||52|| devatāyatano bhakto bhaktyā tvadālayo’bhavat | vayaṃ te kṛpayā dāsāstvadālayanivāsinaḥ ||53|| bhavema iti viśvātman dhārayāmaḥ pradehi tat | tānāha bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ sarvaśreyaḥparāyaṇaḥ ||54|| durlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ matvā bhavadbhistvarthitaṃ nviha | mamālayo bhavatyeva tredhā yatra vasāmyaham ||55|| akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ muktisthānaṃ mamālayaḥ | yatrākṣaraṃ bhaved brahma tatrāhaṃ nivasāmi vai ||56|| yatra vāso hi muktānāṃ nānyeṣāṃ bhavati kvacit | māyāpāraṃ gatānāṃ ca brahmavidāṃ ca yoginām ||57|| yatra pūrve santi sādhyā devā nityanivāsinaḥ | jīvabhāvaṃ parityajya ceśabhāvaṃ vihāya ca ||58||| māyākarmāśayaṃ dagdhvā mamārādhanatatparāḥ | me dhyānaparamā bhūtvā kṣālitāśeṣakāraṇāḥ ||59|| śuddhāḥ sañcinmayānandā matprapannā madarthakāḥ | manmūrtau saṃyamaparāste yānti brahma cākṣaram ||2.135.60|| matkṛpāleśato divyā ye saṃbhūtā madātmakāḥ | madanyalayabhāvāste me yānti brahma cākṣaram ||61 || māyāvikṛtilubdhānāṃ māyāmiṣṭarasātmanām | māyāhaṃbhāvayuktānāṃ māyāsvabhāvaśālinām ||62||| svārthasādhanayatnānāṃ rāgārthaṃ yatatāṃ sadā | madbhāvanāvihīnānāṃ na sthānaṃ brahmaṇi kvacit ||63|| mama bhaktivihīnānāṃ mama mārgāvidāṃ tathā | mama mantrādiśūnyānāṃ na sthānaṃ brahmaṇi kvacit ||64|| ityevaṃ paramaṃ sthānaṃ mayoktaṃ tanmamākṣaram | tadanyad vai dvitīyaṃ tu sthānaṃ me hṛdayaṃ satām ||65|| yatrāhaṃ sarvadā vāsaṃ prakurve cetanālaye | mama muktā mahāmuktāścākṣaraṃ brahma cetyapi ||66|| muktānāṃ hṛdaye nityaṃ satāṃ vai jīvatāmiha | vasāmo militāḥ sarve hṛdayeṣu satāṃ vayam ||67|| tatra vai vāsanā nāsti nāsti māyāvikāritā | tatra matto’tiriktaṃ vai nāsti tato vasāmyaham ||68|| mama mūrtiḥ sadā divyākṣaradhāmanivāsinī | bhaktidharmayutā tatra rājate hṛdaye satām ||69|| dharmavaṃśo mama mūrto yo’sti divyaguṇātmakaḥ | te guṇāstatra rājante hṛdaye vai satāṃ sadā ||2.135.70|| śraddhā śāntirdayā medhā tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirgatistathā | lajjā maitrī titikṣā ca buddhirmūrtiḥ kriyonnatiḥ ||71 || dharmapriyā vasantyeva sādhūnāṃ hṛdaye sadā | jñānaṃ vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ cābhayaṃ tapa ārjavam ||72|| satyaṃ kṣemaḥ sukhaṃ śaucaṃ sthairyaṃ dhairyaṃ ca mārdavam | nigrahastyāga āstikyaṃ santoṣaśca kṣamā smṛtiḥ ||73|| damo yajñaḥ śamo yogaścoparatirupāsanā | prasādaśca śubhaṃ tejaḥ svādhyāyaḥ praśrayaśca mud ||74|| dhyānaṃ sāmyaṃ brahmavidyā lābhaḥ sāmārtha udyamaḥ | śravaṇādyā bhaktirūpā vasanti hṛdaye satām ||75|| tatrāhaṃ sarvadā śānto nivasāmi prasannahṛt | sadālayo mama yūyaṃ tatra vāso’nyadurlabhaḥ ||76 || amuktānāṃ mama mantravihīnānāṃ kadācana | mamābhaktimatāṃ vāso mama satsu na vidyate ||77|| yeṣāṃ vai tvakṣare vāso yeṣāṃ ca hṛdaye satām | teṣāṃ vāsaḥ sadā yogyo mama devālaye śubhaḥ ||78|| athāyaṃ bhaktavaryo’dya devāyatanako’bhavat | devālayasvarūpo’pi jaḍaprakhyo’pi cetanaḥ ||79|| tatra vāsaṃ jaḍacaitye prāsāde yadi cecchatha | mama mantrān pragṛhṇantu mama bhaktā bhavantu ca ||2.135.80|| vinā me sāttvatān bhaktān sthātumarhanti netare | lomaśo’yamṛṣiśreṣṭho mantrān vaḥ sampradāsyati ||8 1 || vaiṣṇavāḥ saṃbhavantvatra tato vasantu madgṛhe | ityuktā devatādyāśca dehinaḥ śrīhariṃ tadā ||82|| natvā samarcya sampūjyājñayā śrīlomaśaṃ yayuḥ | lomaśo’pi dadau tebhyo mantrān cakāra vaiṣṇavān ||83|| tataste devasadanaṃ devāyatanamāyayuḥ | nemurdevāyatanakaṃ nipeturharipādayoḥ ||84|| haryājñayā vaiṣṇavāste devālayanivāsinaḥ | bhavituṃ dīkṣitā jātāstadā devālayo’bravīt ||85|| bhagavan caṃcalā devāṃścañcalā dehinastathā | bhītiyuktāḥ sadā tvete hyāpatkāle samāgate ||86|| āsuropadravaṃ jñātvā vidraveyurna ced yadi | madhye madhye vihāyaiva gaccheyurna sthalāntaram ||87|| nityavāsapratijñāṃ cet kuryuste tava sannidhau | tadā vāsaḥ pradeyaḥ syādebhyaśceti vidhiṃ kuru ||88|| bālakṛṣṇastu tacchrutvā devālayavacaḥ śubham | hitaṃ pathyaṃ tathā satyaṃ prāha prārthayatastadā ||89|| yathā devālayo vakti tathā cenmanyate yadi | śapathān kurutātraiva tadā vāsaṃ dadāmyaham ||2.135.90|| yāvad devālayastiṣṭhejjīrṇo vā bhittimātrakaḥ | yāvaddevo’pi tiṣṭhecca tāvatstheyaṃ tadālaye ||91 || devatāyatano devo yadā sthānaṃ vihāya ca | sarvakālārthamudgacchet tadā gamyaṃ na cānyathā ||92|| ityevaṃ vai pratijñāṃ ca kurutātra tadāpyaham | vāsaṃ dadāmi devāyatane devālaye sadā ||93|| ityuktāste pratijñāṃ vai tathā cakrurnirantarām | yāvad devālayastiṣṭhed yāvattiṣṭhecca devatā ||94|| tāvadvastavyamevātra mahāpatkālake’pi ca | ityuktvā ca jalaṃ pītvā prāsādikaṃ kṣitāvapi ||95|| jalaṃ pramucya caraṇe hareḥ surādayo’spṛśan | ityevaṃ śapathaṃ prāptāḥ prāptā vāsaṃ mahālaye ||96|| devālaye harervāse vāsārhā vaiṣṇavā hi te | yāvaddevālayastasmāt taddevo’pi ca tiṣṭhati ||97|| tāvadvai rādhike devālayāṃgāni ca sarvadā | tiṣṭhantyeveti bhagnāśca khaṇḍitā api rādhike ||98|| jīrṇoddhārastato devālayasya hitado nṛṇām | prasannā devatāṃśāste sukhayanti sahāyinaḥ ||99|| evaṃ prasannatāṃ prāpya devāyatanako muniḥ | devālayātmatāṃ prāptastathā devā nivāsanam || 2.135.10 0|| kṛpayā śrīhareḥ prāptāstān named dūro’pi vai | śālagrāme khaṇḍite’pi yathā vasāmi sarvadā || 101 || devālaye prabhagne’pi jīrṇe’pi mūrtisaṃyute | vasāmyeva tvahaṃ yāvad devāyatanako’pi ca || 1 02|| vasatyeva tu tāvadvai mamājñāṃ mūrdhni dhārayan | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya devālayaphalaṃ bhavet || 103 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrīhareraśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetraṃ prapyāgamanaṃ, akṣaradhāmni satāṃ hṛtsu devālayamūrtau ceti harestredhā vāsaḥ, devāyatanarṣerdevālayasvarūpatā, devālayāṃgadevānāmapi sthairyādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 135 ||
<2.136> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike devāyatanako bhaktarāṭ punaḥ | papraccha śrīhariṃ jñātuṃ prāsādanirmitiṃ tadā || 1 || lokānāmupakārārthaṃ jñātumaṃgapramāṇakam | antarmānāni sarvāṇi vijñātuṃ mandirasya vai || 2 || bhagavan devadeveśa devālaye yathā yathā | aṃgāni mūlato yāni bhavanti cādhvajaṃ vada || 3 || yenāhaṃ ca mamāṃgāni jānīyāṃ yatra devatāḥ | ādhyātmikyaṃ imāścāpi nivatsyanti tanau mama || 4 || ityasya vai svarūpaṃ ca jñātvā prāsādakasya ca | anye prāsādavaryāśca bhaviṣyanti sajātayaḥ || 5 || śilpino viśvakarmāṇo yadādhārān svabuddhibhiḥ | prāsādān kalpayiṣyanti naikarūpām̐staduttaram || 6 || tasmād vada harekṛṣṇa prāsādāṃgavivecanām | hitakṛd devavāsānāṃ yanmūlaḥ śilpivistaraḥ || 7 || itipṛṣṭo harikṛṣṇastamuvāca samāsataḥ | rekhālakṣyātmarūpaṃ vai devāyatanakaṃ munim || 8 || saptayavodarairmītaścāṅgulo madhyamaḥ smṛtaḥ | caturviśatyaṃgulaiśca hasto vai parikīrtitaḥ || 9 || hasto’yaṃ gajasaṃjño’sti devaprāsādke tathā | pratimāyāṃ ca liṅge ca pīṭhe ca maṇḍape tathā || 2.136.1 0|| rājaprāsādike cāpi mahādīrghanivāsake | dīrghaharmye pṛthivyāṃ ca hastenānena māpayet || 1 1|| devaprāsādake cāpi maṇḍape bhittibāhyataḥ | mānaṃ grāhyaṃ ca śikhare mandire devatālaye || 1 2|| pṛthivyā dīrghatāyāṃ vai hastasaṃkhyā tu yāvatī | guṇitā sā prakartavyā vyāsatā hastasaṃkhyayā || 12 || utpannā yā hastasaṃkhyā bhañjanīyāṣṭasaṃkhyayā | śeṣasaṃkhyā bhavedaiva āyanāmnīti viśrutā || 14|| ekāṅkastu dhvajāyaḥ syāt pañcāṅkastu vṛṣāyakaḥ | saptasaṃkhyā gajāyaḥ syād devālaye ta uttamāḥ || 11|| dhvajāye tvarthalābhaḥ syād vṛṣāyo dhanadhānyadaḥ | kalyāṇado gajāyaśca mandirādau matā ime || 16 || prāsāde ca pratimāyāṃ liṅge pṛthvyāṃ ca maṇḍape | pīṭhe siṃhāsane vedyāṃ kuṇḍe dhvaje ca cāmare || 17|| chatre vāpyāṃ taṭāke ca kūpe devāsane’mbare | bhūṣāyāṃ pīṭhikāyāṃ ca hāre mukuṭake tathā || 18|| dhvajāyaḥ sarvathā śreṣṭho grāhyaḥ śilpikalāvidā | śeṣe tritve tu siṃhāyaḥ siṃhāsane śubho mataḥ || 1 9|| devālaye dhvajāyaḥ syācchreṣṭha eva na saṃśayaḥ | vṛṣāyo vā gajāyo vā na grāhyo devatālaye ||2.136.2 0|| dhvajāyo na bhaveccedvai gajāyastatra gṛhyate | pūrvāyāstu dhvajaḥ svāmī paścimāyā vṛṣāyakaḥ ||2 1 || uttarāyā gajāyo’sti siṃhāyo dakṣiṇādiśaḥ | kṣetrāyāmaṃ guṇayecca vistāreṇa tataśca tām || 22|| saṃkhyāṃ vibhañjyācca saptaviṃśatyā śeṣakaṃ ca yat | bhavettadaṃkasaṃkhyākaṃ nakṣatraṃ veśmano bhavet || 23|| nakṣatraṃ bhañjayitvā vai aṣṭākhyasaṃkhyayā tataḥ | śeṣasaṃkhyā vyayasaṃjñā nyūnā sā cāyato yadi || 24|| śreṣṭhā sā narasaṃjñāsti dhanadhānyādidāyinī | vyayo’dhiko rākṣasaḥ syāt samānastu piśācakaḥ ||25|| aśubhau tau sadā bodhyau naravyayo hi lābhadaḥ | aṣṭau vyayāśca te bodhyāḥ śeṣaike śāntanāmakaḥ ||26|| dhvajāyena samaṃ śānto vyayo deyaḥ phalapradaḥ | siṃhāyena samaṃ pauro vyayo deyo dvitīyakaḥ ||27|| vṛṣāyena samaṃ deyaḥ śriyānandastu pañcamaḥ | gajāyena samaṃ deyaḥ śrīvatso vyaya eva ca ||28|| kṣetrapāste prakīrtyante pūjitā vighnanāśakāḥ | maṇiratnasuvarṇādyaiḥ prāsādā devatāpriyāḥ ||29|| nadyāstaṭe pure tīrthe siddhāśrame ca gahvare | udyāne ca taṭāke ca kāryā devālayāḥ śubhāḥ || 2.136.30 || nagarābhimukhāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ prāsādāḥ sukhadāḥ sadā | teṣu madhye ca bāhye ca devatāḥ sukhadā sadā ||3 1 || śrīḥ kubero gaṇeśaśca gopure sukhadāḥ sadā | madhye vā svasya nilaye sukhadāḥ santi vaiṣṇavāḥ ||32|| rātrau pṛthvyāṃ pradīpaṃ ca saṃsthāpya dhruvatārake | avalambanasūtreṇa rekhaikyaṃ lekhayed budhaḥ || 33 || uttarā sā diśā śuddhā kīlakairniścitāṃ tu tām | kuryādāvāri niravanedāśilābhāgabhūtalam ||34|| pāṣāṇānte jalānte vā kūrmaśilāṃ niveśayet | yaddiśi syātsarpamukhaṃ tasyāṃ khātaṃ na cācaret ||35|| catuṣṣaṣṭicatuṣkīnāṃ kāryamekaṃ hi koṣṭhakam | samakoṇaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ kṛtvā cobhayatodiśi ||36|| ravyādivāsarām̐statra likhedaṣṭau kramādapi | catuṣkoṇe raviryathā patellikhettathāvidham || 37|| tatra koṣṭhe maṃgalasya paṃktau nāgamukhaṃ mahat | śaneḥ paṃktau maṃgalasya paṃktau deho mato’sya vai || 38|| śanaiḥ paṃktau tathā pucchaṃ bhavennāgāsyakoṣṭhake | dehasthale na vai khātaṃ kartavyaṃ kvacideva ca ||39|| kanyātulāvṛścike ca ravau pūrve mukhaṃ bhavet | bhādreṣorjeṣvapi nāgamukhaṃ pūrve bhavet sadā ||2.136.40 || tatastrike ca dakṣe syāt tatastrike tu paścime | tatastrike uttare syāt tatra khātaṃ na kārayet ||41 || kukṣidvayasya vai pārśve khātaṃ śastaṃ mataṃ yathā | yadi nāgamukhaṃ pūrve vāyavye khātamācaret ||42|| dakṣiṇe cet sarpamukhaṃ tvaiśānyāṃ khātamācaret | paścime cennāgamukhaṃ khātaṃ vahnau tadācaret ||43|| uttare cennāgamukhaṃ nairṛtye khātamācaret | devālayeṣu sarvatra nikhaned vāmakukṣike ||44|| gajaikamānaprāsāde caturaṃgulakūrmakaḥ | tato daśagajaṃ yāvad dvyaṃgulāṃ pratihastakam ||45|| kūrmaṃ saṃvardhayet kūrmaśilā yogyā tu sā matā | daśato viṃśatiṃ yāvadekāṃgulāṃ vivardhayet ||46|| viṃśatitaśca pañcāśadgajaṃ cārdhāṃgulaṃ dharet | iṣṭakānāṃ tu prāsāde iṣṭakākūrmakaḥ smṛtaḥ ||47|| pāṣāṇānāṃ mandirādau pāṣāṇasya hi kūrmakaḥ | kūrmaśilādhobhāge’ṣṭāṃśakaṃ padmaṃ samācaret ||48|| ekagajāyatā cāṣṭāṃgulordhvā caturasrikā | pāṣāṇasaudhe dātavyā svasthākhyā sā sahāyadā ||49|| iṣṭikānāṃ tu saudheṣu kūrmārdhāṃgulamānataḥ | kṛtvā kūrmaśilā deyā sthaulye sā syād dhruvapradā ||2.136.50|| kūrmaśilopari kāryā nava vai koṣṭhakāstataḥ | agnisthe koṣṭhake vāridṛśyaṃ matsyaṃ tu dakṣiṇe ||51 || nairṛte maṇḍukadṛśyaṃ paścime makaradṛśiḥ | vāyavye tu grāsamukhamuttare śaṃkhadarśanam ||52|| caiśāne sarpadṛśyaṃ ca pūrve kuṃbhasya darśanam | navame madhyabhāge vai kūrmaḥ kārya itisthitiḥ ||53|| nandā bhadrā jayā riktā tathājitāparājitā | śuklau saubhāginī cātha dharaṇī navamī matā ||54|| kūrmaḥ kāryaścaikahaste devālaye’ṅgulārdhakaḥ | suvarṇasyāthavā raupyakasya śreṣṭhaḥ sa sammataḥ ||55|| paścāt pratyekahastena āpaṃcadaśahastakam | ardhāṃgulena kūrmo’yaṃ vardhanīyo bhavediti ||56|| pañcadaśādekatriṃśadgajaparyantameva tu | caturthāṃśāṃgulavṛddhiḥ kūrmasyaiveṣyate sadā ||57|| ekatriṃśādāpañcāśadgajaparyantameva tu | ekaikadorakasyaiva vṛddhiḥ kūrme pradīyate ||58|| dugdhadadhighṛtamadhuśarkarābhiḥ sakūrmakaḥ | snapanīyastataḥ sthāpyo dharaṇīnāmako hi saḥ ||59|| patrāyo naiva kartavyaḥ kartavyaśchidravarjitaḥ | madhye ca vyomaśūnyaśca kartavyo bhāgavarjitaḥ ||2.136.6 0 || maṇibhiḥ pūjanīyaścācchādanīyaḥ pravālakaiḥ | yā nandādyāścāṣṭadikṣu śilāstāśca śubhā yathā ||6 1 || prāsāde tvekahaste tu matā saptāṃgulā śilā | tataḥ pañcagajaṃ yāvat dvyaṃgulāstāḥ śilāḥ matāḥ ||6 2|| tato vai daśahaste tu tryaṃgulāstāḥ śilā matāḥ | tato viṃśatihaste tu pādonacaturaṃgulā ||63|| pañcāśadgajaparyantaṃ sapādacaturaṃgulāḥ | samakoṇāścaturthāṃśasthūlāḥ kāryāḥ śilā nava ||64|| śilānāmupari cāgnikoṇe śaktiṃ pradāpayet | dakṣiṇāyāṃ ca daṇḍaṃ tu nairṛtyāyāṃ tu khaṅgakam ||65|| paścimāyāṃ tu pāśaṃ vai vāyavyāyāṃ tathāṃkuśam | uttarāyāṃ gadāṃ dadyād aiśānyāṃ tu triśūlakam ||66|| pūrvasyāṃ vajrakaṃ dadyānmakhaṃ tāsāṃ bahiryathā | raktaṃ śyāmaṃ cābhravarṇaṃ pāṇḍuraṃ śvetamambaram ||67|| haritaṃ śvetaṃ pītaṃ ca bastramācchādayet kramāt | khāte śilādhaḥ saṃpuṭāḥ sthāpanīyā nidhernava ||68|| śaṃkhaḥ padmo mahāpadmo makaraḥ kundanālakau | kacchapaśca mukundaśca kharvaśca nidhayo nava ||69|| īśānādagnikoṇādvā dakṣe śilāṣṭakārpaṇam | madhye kūrmaśilā paścād vedamāṃgalyagītikaiḥ ||2.136.70 || pūrve nandā sthāpanīyā tato’nyā dharaṇī tataḥ | śilāṣṭakodaraṃ sāvakāśaṃ rakṣyaṃ puṭādivat |||7 1|| abhitaḥ pālikāḥ kṛtvopari sthāpyāḥ puṭādivat | dharaṇīnābhinālaṃ tu sāvakāśaṃ tadūrdhvake |||72|| āsiṃhāsanaparyantaṃ cānayet sukhado hi saḥ | kūrmasya sthāpane śilāsthāpane ghṛtapakvakam ||73 || miṣṭānnaṃ devatābhyaśca dikpālebhyo’pi miṣṭakam | baliṃ dadyād divyavastraṃ śilpine śrīphalānvitam ||74|| brāhmaṇāyārpayed bhojyaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ vaidikāya ca | prāsādānāmadhiṣṭhānaṃ jagatī vedikā matā ||75|| yāvatkoṇo bhavet devaprāsādo jagatī tathā | caturasrā tathāṣṭāsrā vartulā cāyatāthavā ||76|| prāsādarūparūpā tu vedikā vai praśasyate | vedikā jagatī pradakṣiṇā ceti samarthakāḥ ||77|| prāsādājjagatī kāryā ṣaḍguṇā śobhanā matā | brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ saptaguṇā tu mandire ||78|| dviguṇā vā caturguṇā pañcaguṇā kvacinmatā | tribhramā jagatī śreṣṭhā dvibhramā tu ca madhyamā ||79|| ekabhramā kaniṣṭhā ca tribhramā viṣṇumandire | ucchrāyasya tribhāgena nyūnā dvitīyabhrāmiṇī ||2.136.80 || taducchrāyavibhāgena nyūnā tṛtīyabhrāmiṇī | evaṃ samucchrayaḥ kāryo bhramaṇīnāṃ tribhāgataḥ ||8 1 || catuṣkoṇā dvādaśakoṇā vā viṃśatikoṇakāḥ | aṣṭāviṃśatikoṇāḥ ṣaṭatriṃśatkoṇāstu cottamāḥ ||82|| prāsādaśced dvādaśahastāyato jagatī tadā | āyatārthapramāṇena samucchrayavatī matā ||83|| dvāviṃśatigajāyatye tattṛtīyāṃśakocchrayā | dvātriṃśadāyatabhāve caturthāṃśocchrayo mataḥ ||84|| pañcāśadāyatabhāve turye’pi caturaṃśikā | ucchraye samatā cāpi sadā nirvighnatākarī |||85||| jagatyucchrāyamānasya bhāgāḥ kāryāḥ samāḥ purā | aṣṭāviṃśatirevātha jāḍyakuṃbhastribhāgakaḥ ||86|| dvibhāgā karṇikā kāryā tribhāge sarapaṭṭikā | padmapatrayutā kāryā dvibhāgaḥ khurako mataḥ ||87|| saptabhāgo bhavet kuṃbhastribhāgaḥ kalaśo bhavet | ekabhāgāntarapatrī kapotālistribhāgajā ||88|| caturbhāgaḥ puṣpakaṇṭhaḥ kartavyaḥ sukhadā ime | nirgame puṣpakaṇṭho vai caturbhāgo hi gṛhyate ||89|| jāḍyakuṃbho’pi ca tathā caturbhāgo hi gṛhyate | karṇikāsu pūrvato vai samārabhya pradakṣiṇam ||2.136.90|| aṣṭānāṃ dikprapālānāṃ sthāpyāḥ supratimāḥ śubhāḥ | śilāḥ prāsādadhartryastu dīrghāḥ puṣṭā nīrandhrakāḥ || 91 || sthāpyā dṛḍhāḥ sucūrṇādyairavakāśavivarjitāḥ | jagatīdāśikāyāścopari bhīṭaṃ tato bhavet ||92|| gajaprāsādakabhīṭaṃ caturaṃgulamucchritam | kṛtvā tataśca pañcāśadgajaparyantameva tu ||93|| ardhāṃgulaṃ pratigajaṃ bhīṭamucchritameva ca | ekadvitrīṇi bhīṭāni coparyupari mānataḥ ||94|| caturthāṃśanyūnamānaiḥ kāraṇīyāni sarvathā | nikāso’pi caturthāṃśaḥ svasvocchrayapramāṇataḥ ||95|| bhīṭasyāṃśatrayaṃ kṛtvoparibhāge parārdhake | puṣpakacippikāḥ kāryāḥ pīṭhaṃ bhīṭopari nyaset || 96|| prāsāde tvekahaste tu pīṭhaṃ vai dvādaśāṃgulam | pañcahastāvadhiṃ pañcāṃgulaṃ pratigajaṃ tataḥ ||97|| daśāvadhiṃ tato vṛddhiścaturaṃgulamānataḥ | viṃśāvadhiṃ tato vṛddhistryaṃgulā vai matā śubhā ||98|| ṣaṭtriṃśadavadhiṃ vṛddhiḥ sārdhaikāṃgulamānataḥ | pañcāśadgajaparyantamūnapādaḥ samucchrayaḥ ||99|| pañcamāṃśādhikā śreṣṭhā pīṭhavṛddhiḥ śubhā matā | ekaviṃśatisaṃbhāgāḥ prāsādasyocchraye ca ye || 2.136.1 00|| pañcādinavabhāgāntaḥ pīṭhotsedho yatheṣṭakaḥ | śubhadaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ padmaṃ vasundharaṃ tathā || 10 1|| siṃhaṃ vyomaṃ garuḍaṃ ca haṃsaṃ vṛṣaṃ ca pīṭhakam | navadhā pīṭhameva syāt pīṭhaṃ prāsādadhārakam || 1 02|| pīṭhocchrāye tripaṃcāśad bhāgāḥ kāryāstataḥ param | dvāviṃśatibhāgāstu nirgame’rpyā vidhānataḥ || 103 || navabhāgā jāḍyakubhe saptabhāgāstu karṇake | andhārīsahite bodhyāścāthāpi saptabhāgakāḥ || 1 04|| chajjikāsahitagrāsapaṭṭikāyā matāstathā | hastistaro dvādaśāṃśe vājistaro daśāṃśake || 1 05|| aṣṭabhāge narastaraḥ kartavyaḥ śubhadarśanaḥ | aśvastare mukhyadevavāhanasya staro’pi vā || 1 06|| karṇakāgraprabhāvādvai pañcabhāgātmanirgamaḥ | jāḍyakuṃbho hi kartavyaḥ sārdhatribhāgakarṇakaḥ || 1 07|| āntarālaścārdhabhāgaścaturbhāgā tataḥ param | chajjikāyuggrāsapaṭṭī kartavyā śobhanā parā || 1 08|| hastistaraścaturbhāge nirgamo vājinirgamāt | prabhāgako hi kartavyonarastaro dvibhāgakaḥ || 109|| starāṇāmantarāle ca tathordhve karṇikā tathā | chajjikā ca prakartavyā śobhākarī tu rādhike || 2.136.110 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prāsādarūpe mandiranirmāṇe khātādyārabhya pīṭhakarṇīparyantaṃ mandirāṃgānāṃ nirdeśapramāpaṇādināmā ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 136 ||
<2.137> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca tato nārāyaṇaḥ prāha devāyatanakaṃ munim | śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike maṇḍovarādikaṃ yathāyatham || 1 || prāsādasya karṇarekhopari maṇḍovaraḥ smṛtaḥ | maṇḍovara udayinī ubhiṇīti samārthakāḥ || 2 || hastādipañcahastasya prāsādasyodayaḥ khalu | prāsādāyatatā sāmyā kartavyā śubhadā hi sā || 3 || daśahastapraparyantaṃ caturdaśāṃgulocchrayaḥ | pratihastaṃ prakartavyastatastriṃśadgajāvadhim || 4 || dvādaśāṃgulako maṇḍovaraḥ kāryastataḥ param | pañcāśadgajaparyantaṃ navāṃgulobhiṇīṃ matā || 5 || maṇḍovarasya bhāgāstu kartavyāḥ śilpinā yathā | catuścatvāriṃśadadhikaśataṃ maṇḍavārakaḥ || 6 || pīṭhasya mastakācchajjāmastakāntaṃ ca te matāḥ | khurakaḥ pañcabhāgeṣu viṃśatiḥ kuṃbhakastathā || 7 || aṣṭabhāgeṣu kalaśo’ntarālaṃ sārdhakadvayam| kapotikāṣṭabhāgeṣu mañcikā navabhāgikā || 8 || pañcatriṃśadbhāgajaṃghā pañcadaśasu tūdgamaḥ | aṣṭabhāgā ca bharaṇī śirāvaṭṭī daśāṃśikā || 9 || kapotāliścāṣṭabhāgā sārdhadvayāntarālakam | chādyaṃ trayodaśabhāgaṃ daśabhāgaśca nirgamaḥ || 2.137.10 || khurakaḥ pañcabhāgordhvo dvibhāgastasya nirgamaḥ | bhāgārdhaṃ cāntarapatraṃ karṇakastu dvibhāgakaḥ || 11 || vāpīskandhaḥ sārdhabhāgo bhāgaikaḥ kaṇakottamaḥ | kaṇakāgraṃ paṭṭikābhyāṃ śobhanīyaṃ sudarśanam || 1 2|| paṭṭike nirgame bhāgaike ca bodhye nacādhike | kaṇako nirgame sapādaikabhāgo bhavediti || 13 || kuṃbhakasya mahāpaṃktāvapaskandhasya nirgamaḥ | karṇakāvadhi kartavyastvatha vai kuṃbhakaṃ śṛṇu || 14|| viṃśatibhāgakotsedhaḥ kuṃbhakastatra khaṇḍaśaḥ | bhāgārdhaḥ skandhapaṭṭo vai cippikā tvekabhāgataḥ || 15|| skandhapaṭṭaḥ sulalito vartulaścitrapallavaḥ | kartavyaḥ śobhano yatra dṛśyaṃ vai sundaraṃ bhavet || 16|| cippikāṃ kamalaiḥ patraiḥ śobhanīyāṃ vidhāpayet | prācyamadhyāvasāneṣu kuṃbhe brahmā harirharaḥ || 17|| pratimāḥ rūpataḥ sthāpyā darśanārhāḥ sahetayaḥ | trisandhyābhadraśobhāṃ ca citrāṇi vividhāni ca || 18|| skandhapaṭṭe prakuryādvai yathādṛśyaṃ manoharam | nāsikāḥ karṇanāmnyastu pratirathikāyā dale || 1 9|| koṇeṣveva madhyagarbhe kāryāḥ sapratimāḥ śubhāḥ | staṃbhikāsu prakartavyaṃ toraṇaṃ padmapatravat ||2.137.20|| tathā kamaladaṇḍādyaiḥ śobhitaṃ susvarūpavat | vicitrākārarūpo’yaṃ kuṃbhakaḥ śreṣṭhako mataḥ ||2 1 || kuṃbhordhve kalaśaḥ kāryaścāṣṭabhāgaḥ suśobhanaḥ | ṣaḍbhāgo madhyabhāgo’sya kartavyo vai suśobhitaḥ || 22|| vṛttarūpaḥ prakartavyastasyordhve cippikā śubhā | ekabhāge prakartavyā paṭṭabandhāpi śobhanaḥ ||23 || ratnayuktaḥ prakartavyastathā sārdhadvayāṃśake | antarālaṃ prakartavyaṃ divyapuṣpādiśobhitam ||24|| athāṣṭabhāgikā kāryā kapotālī śubhāvahā | bhāgārdhā skandhapaṭṭī ca skandhaḥ sapādakadvayaḥ ||25 || mukhapaṭṭī pādabhāge dvibhāge karṇapaṭṭikā | skandhasyanirgamaḥ sārdhabhāgadvayātmakaḥ śubhaḥ ||26 || bhāgārdhaḥ skandhapaṭṭaśca kartavyo galatāyutaḥ | mukhapaṭṭī ca kartavyā tadadho’gre gagārakāḥ ||27|| sanmukhau caturaṃgulāḥ sadṛśāḥ śobhanā matāḥ | ūrdhvaskandhastu kartavyo dalagarbhanikāsavān || 28|| kapotālyaṃgagarbhordhve kartavyā tu ṭhagārikā | kapotālyupari kāryā mañcikā navabhāgikā ||29|| sapādabhāgaṃ cāntarapatrakaṃ ca tataḥ param | kāmarūpaṃ ca pādonaṃ paṭṭikā pādabhāgikā ||2.137.3 0|| skandho dvibhāgaḥ pāde ca mukhapaṭṭī tataḥ param | sapādāḥ karṇakastadvat skandho’pi ca sapādakaḥ ||3 1 || sapādāntarapatrī ca sārdhabhāgaḥ kaṇastathā | nirvāṇaṭṭikā pāde kartavyā śobhanā śubhā || 32|| kapotālyāḥ sūtradārai kartavyāśca gagārakāḥ | jaṃghāstaṃbhā nirgamāḍhyāstadadhovṛttalumbikāḥ ||33 || tadūrdhve jaṃghikāḥ kāryāḥ pañcatriṃśatsubhāgagāḥ | golastaṃbhīyutā nāsāphalanāsahitāḥ śubhāḥ ||34|| sarvāsu mūlanāsāsu kāryāḥ staṃbhīcatuṣkikāḥ | gajaiḥ siṃhairgaruḍaiśca makarairhesakairyutāḥ || 356|| karṇeṣu tvaṣṭadikpālāḥ pūrvākramāt pradakṣiṇe | nṛtyan rudraḥ paścabhāge’ndhakahantā sa dakṣiṇe ||36 || caṇḍanāśakarī daṃṣṭrānanā devī tathottare | pratirathe sūtradevāstathā diśādhipā api ||37|| munīndrā vārimārgeṣu kartavyāstapasi sthitāḥ | gavākṣakāśca bhadreṣu kartavyā nirgamānvitāḥ ||38|| pañcārabhaṇakaiḥ staṃbhaiśchādyaiśca tilakairyutāḥ | brahmaviṣṇumahādevaiḥ suśobhitāḥ sudarśanāḥ ||39|| gavākṣastambhikordhve’rdhagolatoraṇaśobhitāḥ | jaṃghāsu dampatī vāpi patrayūthāni vā tathā ||2.137.40|| mañjaryo vā tathā paryyaḥ kartavyāḥ śobhanā yathā | bharaṇī cāṣṭabhāgocchrādhaśchando golarūpavān ||41 || nirgamā grāsapaṭṭī ca bharaṇiskandhikāvaṭī | vartulā sā na kartavyā nirgame samasaddalā||42|| pādonaṃ kāmarūpaṃ ca pādā syāt skandhapaṭṭikā | cippikā cārdhabhāgā ca sapādaṃ kaṇakaṃ tathā ||43|| paṭṭikā cāntarālaṃ ca pādaṃ pādaṃ smṛtaṃ sadā | dvibhāgaḥ skandha ākāryo bhāgārdhaṃ karṇakotpalam ||44|| paṭṭikā cāntarālaṃ ca pādaṃ pādaṃ tathā matam | bhāgārdhaśca tathā skandho bartnaṃ pādonabhāgakam ||45|| antaḥpatraṃ cārdhabhāgaṃ kartavyaṃ kāmanāpradam | nāsopāṃgeṣu sarveṣu kartavyāḥ pallavāḥ śubhāḥ ||46|| aśokapallavāścāpi sarvakāmapradā hi te | kaṇakeṣu skandhabandhāstamālapatrarūpiṇaḥ ||47|| kartavyāśca bharaṇyūrdhve golabhāge pralīninaḥ | śirāvaṭṭirdaśabhāge kartavyā cocchrayā śubhā ||48|| tatra tribhāge kartavyā bhāraputtalikāḥ śubhāḥ | pādonastu bhavet skandhaḥ pādonaḥ karṇakastathā ||49|| antarā cārdhabhāgaṃ tadantare paṭṭakastathā | vṛttā śirāvaṭī pañcabhāge kāryā satantrakā |||2.137.50|| mauktikālaṃkṛtiyuktā kartavyā hīrakānvitā | tadūrdhve ca kapotālī pādabhāgasukalpitā |||5 1 || sārdhadvibhāgakaṃ cāntarālaṃ kartavyameva tu | chādyaṃ trayodaśabhāge kartavyaṃ tatra vai yathā ||52|| ardhabhāgā skandhapaṭṭī tribhāgaḥ skandha eva ca | ardhabhāgā mukhapaṭṭī caturbhāgaḥ chajodayaḥ |||53|| ekabhāgā daṇḍikā cāntarālaṃ caturaṃśakam | sapādabhāgaḥ kaṇako dvibhāgaḥ skandha ityapi ||54|| pādabhāgā skandhapaṭṭī sarvakāmaprapūrikā | kapotālpāśchādyanirgamastu daśāṃśako mataḥ ||55|| caturbhāgo hyadhaḥ skandhaḥ sārdhaiko maṇibandhakaḥ | agrecippī tvardhabhāgā sarvakāmapradā bhavet| |||56 || kāmarūpaṃ tvekabhāgaṃ pādaikāskandhapaṭṭikā | cippikā cāpi bhāgārdhā pādaikā mukhapaṭṭikā ||57|| dvibhāgaḥ kaṇakaścāpi bhāgārdho daṇḍakastathā | maṇibandhasya vai sthāne tribhāge sārilambanam ||58|| nikāro daśabhāgaśca praveśastu ṣaḍaṃśakaḥ | vārimārga3tu ṣaḍbhāgaḥ praveśo’pi ṣaḍaṃśakaḥ |||59|| bhāgasya ṣoḍaśoṃ’śastu pāṇitārāyatātmakaḥ | evaṃ sthite dṛḍhaḥ syādvai prāsādo dīrghajīvanaḥ ||2.137.6 0|| kuṃbhādayaḥ stharāḥ sarve nirgame samasūtriṇaḥ | pīṭhasya nirgamo bāhye tathaivācchādakasya ca || 61|| kumbhastarapramāṇaṃ ca prāsādāyatatā tathā | boddhavyā mūlanāsābhiryathāyogyā tu śilpinā ||62|| tripañcasaptanavaka upāṃgaphālanodgamaḥ | bahireva hi boddhavyaḥ śilpinā cārukarmaṇā ||63|| karṇaṃ pratirathaṃ caiva karṇikā caiva nandikā | uparathaṃ ca bhadraṃ ca subhadraṃ ceti nirgame ||64|| yathā bahirmūlasīmno bhavettathā bhavediti | saptanāsāḥ prakartavyā bhadrārdhe vai ṣaḍaṃśake ||65|| prathamā tvaṣṭabhāgaiśca dvitīyaikā daśāṃśikā | tṛtīyāpyaṣṭabhāgā ca prānte sārdhacatuṣṭayā ||66 || bhadrārdhaṃ syāddhi ṣaḍbhāgaṃ pūrṇaṃ tu dvādaśāṃśakam | vāstukṣetraṃ cāṣṭakoṇaṃ kartavyaṃ devatālaye ||67|| dṛṣṭikānāṃ stare bhittiḥ pādasthūlā matā sadā | pāṣāṇabhittikā bodhyā ṣaḍaṃśāvadhiketi ca ||68|| kāṣṭhaprāsādabhittiśca saptamāṃśātmikā matā | svarṇarūpyādibhittiśca māṇikyādyā daśāṃśikā ||69|| bhramaṇī cāpi kartavyā prāsādasya daśāṃśataḥ | bhramaṇīmadhyakoṇādyā neyāścopari tatkramāt ||2.137.70 || pañcāśadgajasaudhe ca bhadravad bhramaṇordhvanā | maṇḍapo’pi bhramayuktaḥ kartavyaḥ staṃbhasaṃdhṛtaḥ ||71 || dīpālayaṃ prakartavyaṃ prāsāde dakṣiṇeṃ’śake | prāsādavyāsabhāgārdhā kartavyā kolikā tathā ||72|| tadūrdhvaṃ śukanāsaśca kartavyo vai suśobhanaḥ | dvāraṃ pūrve paścime cottare kāryaṃ na dakṣiṇe ||73 || gajaprāsādake dvāraṃ ṣoḍaśāṃgulamucchritam | caturgajapraparyantaṃ pratihastaṃ tu ṣoḍaśam ||74|| aṃgulānāṃ vardhanīyaṃ tryaṃgulaṃ cāṣṭahastake | pañcāśadgajaparyante dvyaṃgulaṃ pratihastakam ||75|| dairghyārdhena pṛthutvaṃ ca dvārasya śobhanaṃ sadā | ūrdhvatāyāḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśo’dhiko’rdhe nihito yadi ||76 || śreṣṭhaṃ dvāraṃ bhavet taddhi sarvasampatsukhapradam | vimānapuṣpajātīnāṃ prāsāde nāgaraṃ śubham ||77|| navaśākhaṃ prakartavyaṃ dvāraṃ vai vaiṣṇavaṃ hi tat | dhvajāyastu pradātavyo dvāraṃ prāsādasūtrataḥ ||78|| talacchandānusāreṇa dvāraśākhā vibhājayet | navāṃge navaśākhā vai kartavyāstryaṃśake śubhāḥ ||79|| āyadoṣaviśuddhyarthaṃ hrasvavṛddhyāvapi mate | madhyapeṭe dvārapālāḥ kartavyāḥ sumanoharāḥ ||2.137.80|| pārśvaśākhāsvapi sūkṣmā vallayaḥ śobhitā matāḥ | śākhocchrayacaturthāṃśe dvārapālau matau śubhau ||81 || vāme ca yamunā dakṣe gaṃgā tathaiva cobhaye | gāndharvyaścātha gandharvāḥ kartavyā vādyasaṃyutāḥ ||82|| gajāśca garuḍāścāpi haṃsā aśvāśca pārṣadāḥ | devā vā yatra yogyāḥ syuḥ kartavyā navaśākhake ||83|| śākhāyāstatra kartavyā bhāgā ekādaśāyatāḥ | rūpastambhau ca dvau kāryau dvibhāgau koṇikāyutau ||84|| pādonadvayabhāgena nirgamastatra śobhanaḥ | prathamā patraśākhā ca gandharvā ca dvitīyakā |||85||| rūpastaṃbhā tṛtīyā ca khalvaśākhā caturthikā | gandharvā pañcamī cāpi rūpastaṃbhaśca ṣaṣṭhakaḥ ||86 || saptamī rūpaśākhā ca khalvaśākhā tathāṣṭamau | navamī siṃhaśākhā ca yatheṣṭaśobhanāthavā ||87|| śākhāpeṭakavistāraḥ praveśāyatapañcamaḥ | sthāpyadevasya mūrtiścottaraṃge śākhidevayuk ||88|| yadvā gaṇeśako devo devāḥ saparivārakāḥ | devyo brahmapriyāścāpi kartavyā uttaraṃgake ||89|| mūlakarṇasya sūtreṇa kuṃbhenodumbaraṃ samam | kartavyaṃ pañcaratnāni nihitavyānyadhasstare ||2.137.90|| dvārāyatyatṛtīyāṃśe madhye mandāriko mataḥ | ardhacandrasamākāro mṛṇālapatrasaṃyutaḥ ||91 || mṛṇālādho jāḍyakuṃbhaḥ kaṇālī kaṇapīṭhakaḥ | mṛṇālasya dvayapārśve koṇikā grāsayormukhe ||92|| udumbarasya pārśve ca śākhārūpatilāni ca | udumbarocchrayaḥ kāryaḥ kuṃbhāt pādonakaḥ śubhaḥ ||93|| khurakeṇa samo bodhyo’rdhacandrasyocchrayaḥ sadā | yathā dvārāyatalambo nirgame tu tadardhakaḥ ||94|| bhāgadvayārdhacandre cārdhārdhabhāge gagārakau | pārśvadvaye prakartavyau śobhanau ca surūpiṇau ||95|| candragagārayormadhye śaṃkhaḥ campakavalliyuk | candre’pi kamalaṃ kāryaṃ śobhitaṃ smṛddhidaṃ hi tat ||96|| ityevaṃ rādhike sarvamāntarāgaṃ tavoditam | devāyatanakaṃ prāha yacchrīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||97|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prāsādarūpe maṇḍovarakuṃbhīchajjunāsāmaṇḍapadvārodumbarādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 137 ||
<2.138> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike’nādiśrīhariḥ puruṣottamaḥ | devāyatanakaṃ bhaktaṃ tato yadāha vacmi te || 1 || prāsādasya pramāṇena kartavyo maṇḍapaḥ śubhaḥ | prāsādamūlakarṇāptasūtreṇa kolikī yathā || 2 || catuṣkī maṇḍapaścāpi kartavyāḥ śikharaṃ tathā | gūḍho vānāvṛttaścaikadvāro vātha tridvārakaḥ || 3 || prāsādāgre sukartavyo maṇḍapo devatāgṛhe | maṇḍapasyottare dakṣe pūrve rūpacatuṣkikāḥ || 4 || nṛtyamaṇḍapaḥ kartavyaḥ kartavyaśca balāṇakāḥ | sārdhaikāyatabhāgo vai prāsādācchobhano mataḥ || 5 || catuṣkikāyutaḥ kāryo dviguṇaḥ sumahāniti | maṇḍapopari ghūmmaṭaścāyatadīrghapramāṇavān || 6 || ucchrāyāḍhyaścārdhagolākāraḥ kartavya eva tu | aṣṭāṃśo maṇḍapaḥ śreṣṭho bhittibhiścāpi vartitaḥ || 7 || sopānatoraṇāḍhyaśca makarāsyajalasravāḥ | gavākṣā jālakayuktā yadvā nirjālakā matāḥ || 8 || mūlaprāsādake jaṃghāmekhalāpīṭhakādayaḥ | yathā syurvai tathā kāryā maṇḍape caikasūtragāḥ || 9 || dalenārdhena pādena dalānāṃ nirgamā matāḥ | maṇḍapaṃ navabhāgaṃ ca kṛtvā bhāgacatuṣṭayam || 2.138.1 0|| madhyaśālātmakaṃ grāhyaṃ padaṃ kartavyameva ca | raṃgabhūmirvicitrā ca saśobhā vai padātmikā || 11 || catuṣṣaṣṭistaṃbhayukto maṇḍapo me priyaḥ sadā | ekaviṃśatisopānāḥ kartavyā maṇḍapāgrataḥ || 12|| hastyaśvagāruḍarūpaiḥ śobhāḍhyā maṇibhistathā | pārśve catuṣkikāḥ kāryāḥ śobhanā yogyavistarāḥ || 13 || nava catuṣkikāḥ kāryāḥ śobhanā api sarvataḥ | bahuvitānaśobhāḍhyāścitraśobhānvitāḥ śubhāḥ || 14|| ākṣarabrahmanāmā vai maṇḍapo mama supriyaḥ | yugmastaṃbhaḥ prakartavyo na tvekīsaṃkhyayā kvacit || 15|| kādambaḥ kamalākāraḥ sūryamukhākṛto’pi ca | cāndro vā maṇḍapo bodhyaścendradhanuḥsamo’pi ca || 16|| jagatīmaṇḍapau bhadramānena nirgame matau | pratolyā jagatī cāpi bhadravannirgame matā || 17|| agre kāryāḥ pratihārā mukhyamūrtestu pārśvayoḥ | narapīṭhasya cordhvāttu yāvadbharaṇīmastakam || 18|| padāni daśasārdhāni kartavyāni tataḥ param | ekabhāgaṃ rājasenaṃ dvibhāgā vedikā matā || 1 9|| ardhabhāgāsannapaṭaḥ staṃbho bhāgacatuṣṭayaḥ | ardhabhāgaṃ bharaṇaṃ ca carustvekāṃśakastathā || 2.138.20|| sārdhaikabhāgaḥ pāṭaśca chādyakaṃ tu tataḥ param | kammānikāstathā kāryāstoraṇādisurūpikāḥ ||2 1 || raṃgamaṇḍapapūrve ca kāryā nṛtyasya maṇḍapāḥ | kathāyā maṇḍapāḥ kāryā homasya maṇḍapāstathā || 22|| udyāpanasya ca kāryā maṇḍapā rāsamaṇḍapāḥ | vāstuvedho na vai kāryaḥ staṃbhavedho’pi naiva ca || 23|| staṃbhasthaulyaṃ daśāṃśādvai caturdaśāṃśakāvadhim | prāsādasthaulyasāpekṣaṃ pāṣāṇadṛḍhatānugam || 24|| prāsāde tvekahaste tu stambhaḥ syāccaturaṃgulaḥ | dvihaste cāṃgulāḥ sapta trihaste nava cāṃgulāḥ ||25|| tato dvādaśahaste ca pratihastaṃ dvayāṅgulau | sapādāṅgulavṛddhiśca yāvatṣoḍaśahastake || 26|| aṃgulikābhivṛddhiśca catvāriṃśatkarāvadhim | pañcāśatkaraparyantaṃ pādonāṃgulikādhikā || 27|| svastikā mastake bhadrayutāṣṭāsrāśca stambhakāḥ | mūrtipatrasuvallyāḍhyā bhadrayukkaṃbhikāstathā ||28|| bharaṇe vallikāyuktāścaravaḥ kinnarānvitāḥ | mama vai mandiraṃ saptaśikharaṃ kāryamuttamam ||29|| tadagre kolikā bodhyā tadagre gūḍhamaṇḍapaḥ | tato nṛtyamaṇḍapaśca tataḥ sabhākhyamaṇḍapaḥ ||2.138.3 0|| tato vai rūpacokī ca tataḥ sopānakāni ca | ṣaṭpañcāśaddakṣabhāro ṣaṭpaṃcāśacca vāmake ||3 1|| mandirāṇi ca kāryāṇi patnīnāṃ mama sarvataḥ | madhyamandirake cāhaṃ pārśveṣu ṣaṭ prapatnikāḥ ||32|| maṇḍapeṣu ghūmmaṭeṣu bhūmikāḥ sapta sapta ca | rāsatoraṇavedyādiyutāḥ kāryāḥ suśobhanāḥ ||33|| paścime rathaśālā ca dakṣiṇe maṭhaśālikāḥ | uttare sūdaśālā ca pūrve cāyudhaśālikā ||34|| vāyau koṣṭhāgārakaṃ cāgnikoṇe tu mahānasaḥ | īśāne puṣpaśālā ca nairṛtye pātraśālikā ||35|| paścime jalaśālā ca hyupari vācanālayaḥ | kartavyā api sāpekṣā ālayā mandirābhitaḥ ||36|| dvārocchrāyasya tribhāge bhāgadvayaṃ tu jālakam | gavākṣāśca tathā kāryā hrasvā vā samastakāḥ ||37|| maṇḍapopari cāṣṭāsraṃ tadūrdhve ṣoḍaśāsrakam | tadūrdhve ghūmmaṭo golaścāyatārdhordhvamānataḥ ||38|| ucchraye ṣaṣṭhibhāgān vai kṛtvā tatrādimeṣu vai | karṇadardarikāḥ saptabhāge samocchranirgamāḥ ||39|| caturbhāge rūpakaṇṭho dvyaṃśe nirgamavānmataḥ | vidyādhrāḥ ṣoḍaśa kāryāścaturviṃśatihastinaḥ ||2.138.40|| vidyādharapṛthutvena saptāṃśe nirgamo mataḥ | tadūrdhve citrarūpāśca nartikā rāsanartanāḥ ||41 || ādyāste sārdhaṣaḍbhāgā dvitīyāḥ ṣaḍvibhāgikāḥ | pañcabhāgāstataḥ kolāḥ sārdhacaturgavālakam ||42||| madhyagolavitānaṃ tu kathācamatkṛtiprabhaiḥ | saṃgītagītanṛtyādiputtalaireva śobhitam ||43 || jīvalokeśvaralokabrahmalokādicitrakaiḥ | śobhitā ratnagarbhāśca sūryavarṇā vitānakāḥ ||44|| sābharaṇaṃ prakartavyaṃ prathamaṃ bhāgaṣaṭkake | dvitīyādyāni tānyeva caturbhāgavivṛddhitaḥ ||45|| kartavyāni pañcaviṃśatisābharaṇāni kramāt | prathame pañcaghaṇṭāśca kartavyāstvatiśobhanāḥ ||46 || dvitīyādau caturvṛddhyā kāraṇīyāstaduttare | vāme dakṣe tu bhadrārdhe rakṣārdhe navaghaṇṭakam ||47|| rathikāyatatārdhe ca bhāge tu rathikopari | ghaṇṭāḥ kūṭāḥ prakartavyāstato vai kalaśo bhavet ||48|| prathamā ghaṇṭikā kāryā pañcakalaśaśobhanā | evaṃ tvekīsaṃkhyayāpi cāgre kāryāḥ sughaṇṭikāḥ ||49|| ekadvitricatuḥpañcaṣaṭkasaptapadāntare | prāsādadevatāyāśca vāhanasya catuṣkikā ||2.138.50|| kartavyā vāhanasthānarūpā suśobhanā śubhā | devamūrternavabhāgā āpādaśikhameva tu ||51|| kartavyāḥ pañcaṣaṭsaptabhāgānto vāhanocchrayaḥ | yadvā vāhananetre ca guhyanābhistanocchraye ||52|| samarekhe bhavetāṃ ca tathocchrayaṃ tu vāhanam | yadvā pādakaṭijānusamarekhaṃ tu vāhanam ||53 || śivaliṃgasya vāhastu jalādhārīsamucchrayaḥ | sūryavāhaḥ skandharekhāsamau devasya vai mataḥ ||54|| mukhyaprāsādaparitaḥ prāsādā garbhasaṃkhyayā | garbhaṃ dhṛtvā tataḥ kāryā nābhivedhaṃ na kārayet ||55|| brahmaviṣṇuśivasaudhaḥ pūrvapaścimakānanaḥ | nagarābhimukhā devāḥ śubhāḥ kṣemakarāḥ sadā ||56|| parāṅmukhāḥ puraṃ ghnanti sarvāsyāstrisurāḥ śubhāḥ | gaṇeśo bhairavaścaṇḍī nakulīśo navagrahāḥ ||57|| mātaraśca kuberaśca dakṣiṇābhimukhāḥ śubhāḥ | nairṛtyadakṣiṇamukho hanumān nānyadevatā ||58|| prāsādagarbhatṛtīyabhāgena pratimottamā | daśabhāgena hīnā yā madhyamā sā prakīrtitā ||59|| pañcabhāgena hīnā yā kaniṣṭhā svastikāsanā | dvārocchrāyanavabhāge bhāgordhvaika vihāya ca ||2.138.60|| śiṣṭāṣṭabhāgake caturbhāgocchrāyā śubhā matā | caturbhāgāvaṣaṃ tu siṃhāsanaṃ mataṃ tathā ||6 1 || yadvā dvārocchrayasyaiva dvātriṃśadbhāgakeṣu tu | ūrdhvaṃ catuṣṭayaṃ tyaktvāṣṭāviṃśatiprabhāgake ||62|| siṃhāsanaṃ ca pratimā caturdaśe caturdaśe | siṃhāsanaṃ trayodaśe mūrtiḥ pañcadaśe smṛtā ||63 || siṃhāsanaṃ pañcadaśe mūrtistrayodaśe smṛtā | siṃhāsanaṃ dvādaśe cet pratimā ṣoḍaśāṃśake ||64|| prāsāde ekahaste tu mūrtirekādaśāṃgulā | daśāṃgulā vardhanīya yāvaddhastacatuṣṭayam ||65|| dvyaṃgulā vardhanīyā ca yāvadvai daśahastakam | ardhāṃgulaṃ vardhanīyā pañcāśadaṃgulāvadhim ||66|| madhyā daśāṃśahīnā syāt kaniṣṭhā taddaśāṃśahā | suptā mūrtirgarbhagehe saptabhāgeṣu pañcagā ||67|| dvau bhāgau varjanīyau ca śayanasthā sukhapradā | prāsādagarbhakhaṇḍau dvau dvārakhaṇḍaṃ vihāya ca ||68 || śeṣakhaṇḍe paccabhāgāḥ kartavyā āsanārdhakāḥ | bhittilagne prathame tu bhāge yakṣādikāsanam ||69|| dvitīye tu vibhāge syuḥ sarvadevāsanāni vai | tṛtīye tu vibhāge vai brahmaviṣṇuharāsanam ||2.138.70|| pañcamāṃśe yavamātramīśānyāṃ tu śivāsanam | prāsādānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ vibhāgo garbhato mataḥ ||7 1 || garbhasya madhyabhāgāddhi kramād devāsanāni vai | caturasrāṇyāyatānyāyatavṛttāni vai tathā ||72|| yathāyogyāni kuryācca vṛttānyaṣṭāsrakāṇyapi | bhittigāni maṇḍalāni tvaṣṭāviṃśatireva vā ||73 || madhye śivo dvitīye tu maṇḍale viśvasṛḍ bhavet | nakulīśastṛtīye sāvitrī caturthake matā ||74|| rudramūrtiḥ pañcame ca ṣaṣṭhe svāmī tu kārtikaḥ | brahmā tu saptame vāsudevo’ṣṭame tu maṇḍale ||75|| janārdanastu navame daśame viśvadevatāḥ | agnirekādaśe cāpi dvādaśe bhāskarastathā ||76 || durgā trayodaśe caturdaśe vighneśa ādṛtaḥ | navagrahāḥ pañcadaśe ṣoḍaśe mātṛdevatāḥ ||77|| saptadaśe gaṇāścāpi bhairavo’ṣṭādaśe mataḥ | kṣetrapālā navadaśe yakṣarājastu viṃśake ||78|| hanumānekaviṃśe ca bhago dvāviṃśake tathā| trayoviṃśe’paradevāścaturviṃśe tu daityakaḥ ||79|| pañcaviṃśe rākṣasaśca ṣaḍviṃśe tu piśācakaḥ | saptaviṃśe bhūtavargo’ṣṭāviṃśe riktameva ca ||2.138.80 || tattatpatnībhṛtyadāsīkuṭumbabhaktasevitāḥ | yathāyogyaṃ sthāpanīyā devā svasvālaye sadā ||81 || gajāsanaṃ ca vā siṃhāsanaṃ haṃsāsanaṃ tathā | vimānaṃ muktadhāryaṃ vā sachatraṃ cottamottamām ||82|| śaivaliṃgaṃ yādṛśaṃ tu tādṛśaṃ yonikāsanam | yonistvaṣṭādaśabhāgā kartavyocchrayamānataḥ ||83 || kaṇaḥ syāt sārdhabhāgena paṭṭikā cārdhabhāgikā | dvitīyā paṭṭikā tulyā skandhastribhāgakaḥ smṛtaḥ ||84|| ardhabhāgā paṭṭikānyā cāntarapatraṃ tu sārdhake | ardhabhāgā paṭṭikānyā dvibhāgaḥ karṇakastathā ||85|| ardhabhāgā paṭṭikānyā sārdhabhāgaṃ tu patrakam | ardhabhāgā paṭṭikānyā tribhāgaḥ skandha eva ca ||86|| paṭṭikādvayamevāpi tvardhadvayaprabhāgake | sārdhabhāgaḥ karṇakaśca tato liṃgasya darśanam ||87|| yaddravyaṃ tu bhavelliṃgaṃ taddravyā yonikā matā | caturasrā vartulā samekhalā bahukoṇikā ||88|| liṃgasthaulyaṃ māpanīyaṃ sūtreṇa paridhirhi saḥ | sūtrāyatāyataṃ kāryaṃ pīṭhaṃ vai vistṛtaṃ tu tat ||89|| sūtraṃ bhāgatrayaṃ kāryaṃ dvibhāge yonikā matā | bhāgaike śivaliṃgaṃ cocchraye bodhyaṃ sadā budhaiḥ ||2.138.90 || liṃgāt praṇālaṃ sūtreṇa pramītaṃ nirgame matam | sūtradīrghaṃ dvayameva yoniliṃgaṃ tu nādhikam ||91 || apūrṇaapūrṇaśirasordhvādvai liṃgapraveśa iṣyate | koṣṭhalādvā prapūrṇādvai liṃgapraveśa ūrdhvataḥ ||92|| praṇālaṃ cottare vāme guptaṃ caṇḍamukhe patet | bahudeveṣu praṇālaṃ jagatyāṃ vai caturdiśi ||93|| ṣaḍbhāgā dvāraśākhāyāḥ kāryā vai pañcame śubhe | lakṣmīnārāyaṇādīnāṃ dṛṣṭiḥ kāryā śubhā sadā ||94|| tṛtīyāṃśe śivamūrteḥ śrīśeṣaśāyino’pi ca | aṣṭabhāgāṃ dvāraśākhāṃ vibhajyaikaṃ tathāṣṭakaiḥ ||95|| catuḥṣaṣṭirbhavatyevaṃ bhāgānāṃ tatra sarvathā | ekībhāge devadṛṣṭirna tu yugme vinirṇayaḥ ||96|| ekī dvātriṃśadaṃśeṣu devadṛṣṭirvidhīyate | yugmāṃśā devadṛṣṭyarthaṃ niṣiddhā eva hānidāḥ ||97|| dṛṣṭidoṣavipākena sthānanāśo dhanakṣayaḥ | dṛṣṭidoṣahataṃ yadyanna punaśca prarohati ||98|| ūrdhvadṛṣṭyā dravyanāśo bhogahāniradhaḥsthayā | samadṛṣṭiḥ sukhadāsti sarvakāle yathāyatham || 99|| catuḥṣaṣṭiprabhāgeṣu prathame tvāditattvakam | sṛṣṭistṛtīye tattvaṃ ca pañcameṣṭistu saptame || 2.138.10 0|| āyustu navame caikādaśe lakṣaṃ mataṃ tathā | vijñaṃ trayodaśe pañcadaśe prājñaṃ mataṃ tathā || 101 || śāntitattvaṃ saptadaśe’vyaktaṃ navadaśe tathā | vyaktāvyaktaṃ tvekaviṃśe trayoviṃśe tu vyaktakam || 1 02|| pañcaviṃśe śeṣanāgaḥ saptaviṃśe śayī hariḥ | navaviṃśe tu garuḍastvekatriṃśe tu mātaraḥ || 1 03|| trayastriṃśe kuberaśca pañcatriṃśe varāhakaḥ | saptatriṃśe hyumārudrau navatriṃśe tu buddhakaḥ || 1 04|| ekacatvāriṃśake’jastricatvāriṃśake tataḥ | durvāsā nārado’gastyastrayaste’nye maharṣayaḥ || 1 05|| pañcacatvāriṃśake śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇādayaḥ | saptacatvāriṃśake ca dhātā tato’tha devatā || 106 || navacatvāriṃśake ca śāradā ca gaṇeśakaḥ | ekapañcāśadaṃke ca brahmā padmāsane sthitaḥ || 1 07|| tripaṃcāśattame siddhirharasiddhistathāparāḥ | pañcapañcāśattame’jo viṣṇuḥ sūryo virāgiṇaḥ || 1 08|| saptapañcāśattame tu śukrācāryaḥ pare yathā | navapañcāśattame caṇḍikā cānyāśca devikāḥ || 1 09|| ekaṣaṣṭitame devā bhairavādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | triṣaṣṭyāṃ vetālakādyāstatparaṃ śūnyameva tu || 2.138.11 0|| arcāyāḥ pādayoḥ kaṭyāṃ vā dṛṣṭirvāhanasya tu | evaṃ sthānapratiṣṭhānāt puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam || 111 || vaiparītye viparītaṃ phalaṃ vai rādhike bhavet | kṣayakṛt śrīhariṃ prāha devāyatanakaṃ munim || 11 2|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prāsādarūpemaṇḍapaghūmmaṭasiṃhāsanataddevāditattadaṃśapramāpaṇādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 138 ||
<2.139> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā rādhe hariṇā daivatāya tu | kathitaṃ śikharādyaṃ tat kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 1 || atha prāsādaśikharāṃ sabhedaṃ citrabandhanam | kathayāmi samāsena bahujātīyakaṃ śubham || 2 || bahuśṛṃgaṃ bahughūmmaṭakaṃ bahupraphālaṇam | bahubhadragavākṣaṃ ca bahurūpaṃ hi naiṣṭhikam || 3 || bahuvedībahupīṭhaṃ bahuvallīprapatrakam | bahurekhaṃ bahucitraṃ bahvagaṃ gṛhadharmi tat || 4 || sāptabhaumaṃ śatabhaumaṃ śikharaṃ bahuputralam | candraśālāntakaṃ bahukalaśaṃ vānaprasthakam || 5 || ekaśṛṃgaṃ tu sannyastamaśṛṃgaṃ sādhujātikam | lambagolaṃ tathā golaṃ aṃgaṃ yatheṣṭakaṃ bhavet || 6 || āyatatve caturbhāgaṃ dairghye tu pañcabhāgakam | ūrdhve trikalaśaṃ siṃhayuktaṃ tu lambagolakam || 7 || lambagole dakṣavāmabhāgau sārdhaikavistarau | phālanānirgamaścāṣṭabhadrakaṃ lambagolakam || 8 || ekāṇḍaṃ golaśikharaṃ karṇe śreṇyaṇḍakāni ca | caturbhāgaṃ samārabhya dvādaśottarakaṃ śatam || 9 || talānāṃ darśanaṃ kṛtvā bhavanti śikharāṇi vai | ekasyāpi talasyordhve bahūni śikharāṇi hi || 2.139.10 || chādyasyordhve prahāraḥ syācchṛṅge śṛṃgaṃ taduttaram | ekadvitriśikharāṇi rekhayaiva bhavanti vai || 11 || garbhāntare śṛṃgabhittirekhā naiva tu śasyate | vipulā vistṛtā bāhye sarvasaukhyapradā tu sā || 1 2|| śṛṃgarekhordhvatā rekhāyatatāpekṣayā kila | sapādā sārdhakā vā ca grāhyā na nyūnikā kvacit || 1 3|| śṛṃgaskandhordhvake ghaṇṭā kartavyā phaladā śubhā | pahārāṃśaṃ punardadyāt punaḥ śṛṃgāṇi tatra ca || 14|| śṛṃgādho vādyayuktā vai pratimāḥ śobhanā matāḥ | śṛṃgapārśve ca śṛṃgordhve śṛṃgikāḥ śobhanāstathā || 15|| uruśṛṃgāṇi kāryāṇi nava vā samarekhayā | ādyoruśṛṃgatalataḥ paroruskandhakāvadhim || 16 || bhāgāstrayodaśa kāryāḥ saptabhāgādyaśṛṃgakam | kṛtvā dvitīyakamuruśṛṃgaṃ pramardayet tataḥ || 17|| evaṃ vai nava kāryāṇi mṛdyamūlāni cordhvataḥ | rekhāmūle daśabhāgān kṛtvordhve tu ṣaḍaṃśakaḥ || 18|| skandho ramyaḥ prakartavyo nādhikāṃśaḥ sadoṣakaḥ | pañcabhāgānna vā nyūnaḥ sudṛśyo yo na jāyate || 1 9|| mūlaskandhe dhvajadaṇḍaścāviśet svāmināśakṛt | pratigajaṃ cāṃgulena dhvajadaṇḍāsanaṃ bahiḥ || 2.139.20|| ādyaśṛṃge gavākṣaṃ ca dvitīye māḍhameva ca| tṛtīyamastakaṃ yāvat siṃhasthānaṃ mataṃ śubham ||21 || caturthamastakaṃ yāvat śukasiṃhaḥ samucyate | yadvā vai navaparyantaṃ tathānyādivyamūrtayaḥ || 22|| gavākṣeṣu devatāśca hyagre śuko haristraye | bhadre sthāpyastena sarvaṃ saukhyaṃ syāt śikharodbhavam ||23|| chādyādvai skandhaparyantaṃ bhāgā vai caikaviṃśitaḥ | navatrayodaśamadhye siṃhā vai śukanāsakāḥ ||24|| pañcadhā tatra kartavyāḥ śukanāsā śubhā matāḥ | kolyāmekānnava yāvat siṃhā dairghyasya sūtrataḥ ||25|| maṇḍape stambhakān kuryānmadhyagarbhānusārataḥ | śukanāsasamā ghaṇṭā kartavyā nimnikāthavā || 26|| śṛṃgoruśṛṃgapratyaṃgairaṇḍān dadyāddhi tāvataḥ | karṇeṣu navakoṇeṣu tilakaṃ saudhabhūṣaṇam |||27|| aṃgānāṃ saṃkhyayā vāryantarāḥ kāryāḥ śubhāvahāḥ | yadvā mūlaśilārambhāt kalaśāntaṃ samucchraye |||28||| bhāgāstu viṃśatiḥ kāryā aṣṭabhāge hi cottamam | maṇḍovaraṃ dvisārdhāṣṭe madhyaṃ nave kaniṣṭhakam ||29|| maṇḍovarāduparyeva śikharodaya ucyate | prāsāde daśabhāgeṣu dvitracaturthake tathā ||2.139.30 || pāde cārdhe tribhāge vā śṛṃgodayo mataḥ sadā | daśāṃśān śikhare mūle kṛtvā daśāśakām̐stataḥ ||3 1 || dvau dvau bhāgau dvikarṇau ca sārdhau sārdhau paḍhārakau | tribhāgaṃ bhadrakaṃ kāryaṃ bandhanāmastake tvapi ||3 2|| navāṃśāśca prakartavyā dvau dvau bhāgau dvikarṇakau | sārdhau sārdhau tu paḍharau dvibhāgaṃ bhadrakaṃ tataḥ ||33|| karṇāt sapādaṃ śikharaṃ sārdhaikaṃ śikharaṃ ca vā | sapādakarṇayormadhye rekhāḥ syuḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ ||34|| udaye karṇayormadhye rekhāśca pañcaviṃśatiḥ | aṣṭādito’ṣṭaṣaṣṭyantaṃ rekhā bhavanti ṣoḍaśa ||35|| ūrdhve pañcāyatatve ca pañceti pañcaviṃśatiḥ | aṃśavṛddhiḥ kalā kāryā tena bhedāstathāvidhāḥ ||36|| aṣṭādito’ṣṭaṣaṣṭhyantaṃ caturvṛddhyā tu ṣoḍaśa | aṣṭadvādaśaṣoḍaśaviṃśā ūrdhve tathāyate || 37|| yadvāṣṭādaśa cordhve cāyate ṣoḍaśa eva ca | evaṃ rekhāḥ ṣaṭpañcāśad dve śate ca bhavanti vai ||38|| trikhaṇḍebhyaḥ khaṇḍavṛddhiryāvadaṣṭādaśaiva tu | ekaikasya kalā aṣṭau samārcāstena ṣoḍaśa ||39|| caturviṃśatiḥ prathamā dvitīyā saptaviṃśatiḥ | triṃśadbhāgā tṛtīyā ca tatra tatrāpi ṣoḍaśa ||2.139.40|| sūtraṃ caturguṇaṃ dhṛtvā rekhātaḥ padmakośavat | śikharāyatatā golā kāryocchrayaḥ sapādakaḥ ||41 || pañca bhāgāśca ṣaṭ saptāṣṭau dvādaśātha ṣoḍaśa | atha dhvajapuruṣaṃ vai kathayāmi tu rādhike ||42|| śṛṃgarekhā samārabhya yāvadbandhanikocchraye | ṣaḍbhāgān saṃvidhāyaiva ṣaṣṭhe bhāgacatuṣṭayam ||43|| ūrdhvabhāgaṃ vihāyaiva śeṣabhāgatrayāṃśakaḥ | dhvajādhāraḥ prakartavyaḥ pratirathe tu dakṣiṇe ||44|| yadvā rekhāṃ samārabhya śṛṃgaskandhāntakeṃ’śakau | dvau kṛtvordhveṃ’śake bhāgatrayaṃ kṛtvā tadardhakaḥ ||45|| vaṃśādhāraḥ prakartavyastadvāme tu kare dhvajaḥ | pradātavyo dhvajastaṃbhaḥ pradātavyastu dakṣiṇe ||46 || prāsādapṛṣṭhadeśe tu dakṣiṇe vai paḍhārake | dhvajādhāraḥ prakartavyaḥ pūrvānanasya nairṛte ||47|| īśānai paścimamukhaprāsādasya dhvajādharaḥ | prāsādasya skandhadeśe madhye paḍharayordvayoḥ ||48|| paḍharāvat prakāryo vartulaścāmalasārakaḥ | utsedho vistarārdhena kartavyastasya śobhanaḥ ||49|| taducchrayasya vai bhāgāścatvārastatra copari | grīvā pādonikā tasyāmalasāraḥ sapādakaḥ ||2.139.50|| ekabhāgā candrikā ca jhāṃjharī caikabhāgikā | kalaśasya tato mānaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ ||51 || padmakośe saptabhāgāḥ grīvāstasyaikabhāgikā | sārdhaikocchrāyavān āmalasāraḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ ||52|| pādonaṃ pañcapatraṃ ca pādonā jhāṃjharī tataḥ | tribhāgocchrayakalaśo dvibhāgāyatavān śubhaḥ ||53|| prāsādakarṇāyatyāyāḥ kalaśaścāṣṭamāṃśakaḥ | ṣoḍaśāṃśo vardhitaḥ sa śreṣṭho vyāse ghaṭo mataḥ ||54|| dvātriṃśadbhāgato vardhitaḥ sa vai madhyamo mataḥ | yadvā mūlasya rekhāyā vyāsasya pañcamāṃśikā ||55|| āyatatā kalaśasya kartavyā śobhanā matā | yadvā cāmalasārasyāyatatāyāścaturthake ||56 || aṃśe cāyatatā yā sā kalaśasya prakīrtitā | caturthāṃśo vardhanīyaḥ sārdhaścocchrayavām̐stataḥ ||57|| ucchrayo navabhāgaśca sthaulye ṣaḍaṃśakastathā | pramāṇasūtramānena kalaśaḥ sarvakāmadaḥ ||58|| grīvāpīṭhau tvekabhāge tribhāge tvaṇḍakaṃ tathā | karṇike caikaikabhāge ḍoḍalaśca tribhāgakaḥ ||59|| ḍoḍalāgraṃ caikabhāgaṃ mūlasthaulyaṃ dvibhāgakam | karṇikā ca tribhāgātha chajjī bhāgacatuṣṭayam ||2.139.6 0 || grīvā dvibhāgikārdhapīṭhakaṃ dvibhāgakaṃ tathā | pūrṇaṃ pīṭhaṃ caturbhāgaṃ cāṇḍaṃ ṣaḍbhāgakāyatam ||6 1 || śreṣṭhastu sarvaśreṣṭhānāṃ sauvarṇakalaśo dhvajaḥ | prāsādasyāmalasāro jīvasthānaṃ prakīrtitam ||62|| prāsādapuruṣastatra devāyatanako mataḥ | sthāpanīyaḥ sa puruṣaścādhyātmā cetanānvitaḥ ||63|| prāsāde caikahaste tu puruṣo’rdhāṃgulātmakaḥ | pañcāśadgajaparyante pratyekamardhaṃ vardhayet| ||64|| tasya vai śayanaṃ raupyaṃ kamalaṃ dakṣiṇe kare | vāme dhvajastripatāko vakṣasi dhārito yathā ||65|| dhvajāpatākābhāgastu yathā skandhopari sthitaḥ | āmalasārake tāmraṃ svarṇaṃ vā ghṛtapātrakam ||66|| sthāpanīyaṃ tathā svarṇaprāsādapuruṣo’pi ca | raupyaparyaṃkaśāyī ca sthāpanīyaḥ śubho mataḥ ||67|| paryaṃkasya catuṣpāde kuṃbhāścatvāra eva tu | sahemaratnasaṃyuktāstannidhicihnaśobhitāḥ ||68|| śaṃkhaḥ padmo mahāpadmo makaraśceti nāminaḥ | dhvajadaṇḍapramāṇaṃ ca kathayāmi niśāmaya ||6 9 || prāsādaḥ karṇake yāvadāyatastāvadeva saḥ | lamba eva dhvajādaṇḍaḥ kartavyo jyeṣṭhamānataḥ ||2.139.70|| madhyo daśāṃśahīnaśca pañcamāṃśaḥ kaniṣṭhakaḥ | yadvā jagatīśiraso ghaṭordhvaṃ yāvadeva ca ||71|| ucchrayasya trayo bhāgāstatraikadīrghadaṇḍakaḥ | jyeṣṭho bhavenmadhyamastu cāṣṭāṃśahīnako mataḥ ||72|| ṣaṣṭhāṃśahīnakaḥ proktaḥ kaniṣṭha eva sarvathā | yadvā rekhāpramāṇastu kaniṣṭhakaḥ sa ucyate ||73|| dvādaśabhāgavṛddhyā ca madhyamaḥ sa bhavedatha | ṣaṣṭhāṃśavṛddhitaḥ śreṣṭho bhavatyeva sa daṇḍakaḥ ||74|| prāsādakoṇamaryādā saptahastāntikā matā | garbhamānasya maryādā hastāḥ syuḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ ||75|| rekhāmānasya maryādā pañcāśaddhastikā matā | tattanmaryādayā dhvajādaṇḍasya dairghyamityapi ||76|| prāsāde caikahaste tu daṇḍaḥ pādokāṃgulaḥ | pṛthustataḥ pratigajaṃ cārdhāṃgulaṃ pṛthuṃ dharet ||77|| pañcāśadgajaparyantaṃ mānaṃ sthaulye mataṃ śubham | vaṃśamayaścāṃjano vā mādhukaḥ śaiṃśapeyakaḥ ||78|| khādiro vā prakartavyo vṛttaḥ sopānapaṃktiyuk | ekīparvayuto dvitvagranthisaṃkhyāsamanvitaḥ ||79|| daṇḍadairghyaṣaḍaṃśena lambā markaṭī pāṭalī | dairghyārdhāṃśaiścāyatā ca sthūlā cāyatyatryaṃśakaiḥ ||2.139.80 || kiṃkiṇīghaṇṭikāyuktā kāṃgarībhiḥ suśobhitā | markaṭyāyatatāyāśca pañcāṃśaiḥ kalaśocchrayaḥ ||8 1 || markaṭyadho’rdhacandrābhaḥ pakṣayoḥ sagagārakaḥ | daṇḍoparyeva kalaśaḥ sthāpanīyaḥ kuśāgrakaḥ ||82|| patākā daṇḍavallambā tadaṣṭāṃśaistathāyatā | tribhirvā pañcakaiḥ paṭṭairbhinnarūpaiḥ suśobhitā ||83|| dakṣaskandhe paṃḍharāyāṃ dhvajadaṇḍaḥ sthito bhavet | prāsādasya pṛṣṭhabhāge dakṣe tu paṃḍhare śubhaḥ ||84|| dhvajadaṇḍādhārarūpaḥ kalābaḥ śobhano mataḥ | kalābāyatatā kāryā mittiṣaṣṭhāṃśamānataḥ ||85|| ghaṇṭodayasamocchrāyaḥ kalābo manyate śubhaḥ | prāsādasya pṛthutve ca yāvaddhastā bhavanti ca ||86|| tāvadaṅgulamānena daṇḍagartaviśālatā | caturmukhe tu prāsāde īśānyāṃ daṇḍaropaṇam ||87|| īśānyāṃ tu manāk pāṭalikā daṇḍe parakṣayet | rājyavṛddhiḥ sthānavṛddhiḥ prajāsaukhyaṃ tato bhavet ||88|| dhvajahīne mahāsaudhe vāsamicchanti rākṣasāḥ | dhvajadānena tuṣyanti devatāḥ pitarastathā ||89|| daśāśvamedhikaṃ puṇyaṃ śataikaṃ tārayet kulam | jīrṇoddhāre pūrvasūtraṃ prāsāde na samutsṛjet ||2.139.90 || pūrvadravyāpekṣayā cottamadravyeṇa vāstukam | sumuhūrtādisadyoge śubhaṃ jīrṇaprapātanam ||9 1 || svarṇarūpyamayahastivṛṣadantaiḥ prapātanam | anyadevasya jīrṇādirnānyadevagṛhe’rpayet ||992|| pratiṣṭhitasya devasya cālanaṃ puṇyanāśakam | gṛhasthānāṃ na tu satāṃ yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām ||93|| pratimotthāpanaṃ lagne care lañcena vai matam | laṃcanaṃ ca gajāśvasya rūpyakaṃ vātha vajrakam ||94|| kapāṭāḥ samasūtre ca śreṇībhaṃgaṃ na kārayeta | pāṣāṇāditharāḥ sarve samasūtreṇa sammatāḥ ||95|| pratolikāḥ śubhāḥ kāryāḥ gopurāṇi mahānti ca | kīrtistaṃbhastathā kāryo vedhayantrādikaṃ tathā ||96|| ityevaṃ rādhike nārāyaṇaḥ prāha nijāśritam | devāyatanabhaktāyalakṣmyai prāha ca tat tathā ||97|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prāsādarūpe śikharapadmakośakalaśadhvajādiviśeṣanirūpaṇanāmā navatriṃśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 139 ||
<2.140> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike devāyatanāyāha yaddhariḥ | merujātīyasubhagaprāsādaṃ tadvibhāgakān || 1 || prāsādeṣu śataikāni cāṇḍāni kānakāni vai | sahasraikānyapi daive prāsāde saṃbhavanti hi || 2 || prāsādarājo merurvai sarvadevāśrayo mataḥ | prāsādastvakṣarākhyaśca golokākhyaśca kīrtitaḥ || 3 || vaikuṇṭhākhyo’vyākṛtākhyo’mṛtākhyaśca hiraṇmayaḥ | vāhneyaścāpi vairājo bhūmā ca vaiṣṇavo’pi ca || 4 || kailāsaścāpi vaiśālaḥ śvetadvīpo’pi mandaraḥ | sarvatobhadranāmā ca śrīvatsaḥ svastikastathā || 5 || haimo haṃso gāruḍaśca gajo vṛṣabha ityapi | mandiro brāhmasaṃjñaśca paṃcaviṃśatijātikāḥ || 6 || vartulo’nantaśikharo merurājaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | sahāsrāsraścākṣaraścānantabhavanasaṃkulaḥ || 7 || navaśatanavatistaṃbhāḍhyo goloka iṣyate | sarvathā śikharāḍhyaśca vaikuṇṭhākhyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 8 || sarvathā ghūmmaṭāḍhyaścāvyākṛtākhyaḥ prakīrtyate | sarvathā gṛhamātrāḍhyaścāmṛtaḥ parikīrtyate || 9 || sarvathā kammānikāḍhyo hiraṇmayaḥ prakīrtyate | sarvathā pāṭakādhāro vāhneyaḥ parikīrtyate || 2.140.10 || sarvathā gajaśobhāḍhyo vairājaḥ saṃprakīrtyate | sarvathāścādiśobhāḍhyo bhūmāsaudhaḥ prakīrtyate || 11 || dāsībhirvaiṣṇavadūtairvyāpto vaiṣṇava ucyate | sarvathā tu gaṇairvyāptaḥ kailāsaḥ sa prakīrtyate || 12|| sarvathā ṛṣibhirvyāpto vaiśālaḥ saprakīrtyate | tāpasaiḥ sarvathā vyāptaḥ śvetadvīpākhya ucyate || 13 || catuṣkoṇaḥ sarvabhadraḥ śrīyantravacchrīvatsakaḥ | svastikena samaḥ svastirbahukhaṇḍastu haimakaḥ || 14|| bahuhaṃso hāṃsakaśca gāruḍāḍhyaśca gāruḍaḥ | pañcapādo gajākhyaśca catuṣpādo vṛṣābhidhaḥ || 15|| śatapādo mandiraṃ ca daśapādastu brāhmakaḥ | iti mukhyā bhavantyeva tvaṃgabhedairvibhinnakāḥ || 16|| śilpabhedaiḥ rūpabhedairdṛśyabhedairvibhinnakāḥ | yathābuddhi yathāśakti yathālokaṃ yathāsukham || 17|| śilpabuddhisamutpannā mānavedhavivarjitāḥ | vaimānikāstu prāsādā bahudhā saṃbhavanti hi || 18|| yāvanto dehinaḥ santi tāvantastādṛśālayāḥ | bhaviṣyantyapare cāpi prāsādā bahurūpiṇaḥ || 1 9|| talabhāgāṣṭakaścāṇḍapaṃcakastu sa kesarī | navāṇḍaḥ sarvatobhadrastalatilāṣṭako hi saḥ ||2.140.20|| prāsādo nandanākhyastu trayodaśāṇḍasaṃyutaḥ | nandiśālikasaudhastu saptadaśāṇḍakaḥ smṛtaḥ |||21 || talabhāgā daśa tatra tilakānāṃ catuṣṭayam | talabhāgā daśa caikaviṃśatyaṇḍastu nandiśaḥ ||22|| dvādaśa talabhāgāśca pañcaviṃśatikāṇḍakaḥ | aṣṭatilakasaṃśobho mandirākhyaḥ sa ucyate ||23 || caturdaśatalabhāgo navaviṃśatikāṇḍakaḥ | caturviṃśatitilakaḥ śrīvatsākhyaḥ sa ucyate || 24|| caturdaśatalabhāgastrayastriṃśacchubhāṇḍakaḥ | ṣoḍaśottamatilakaścāmṛtodbhava ucyate |||25| caturdaśatalabhāgaḥ saptatriṃśacchubhāṇḍakaḥ | dvādaśatilakāḍhyaśca himavān sa tu kīrtitaḥ ||26|| caturdaśatalabhāgaścāṣṭatilakavām̐stathā | ekacatvāriṃśadaṇḍo hemakūṭaḥ sa ucyate ||27|| ṣoḍaśatalabhāgāśca tilakānāṃ catuṣṭayam | pañcacatvāriṃśadaṇḍaḥ kailāsaḥ sa tu kīrtitaḥ ||28|| navacatvāriṃśadaṇḍastalabhāgāśca ṣoḍaśa | pṛthvīvijayasaṃjñaḥ sa prāsādaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||29|| ṣoḍaśatalabhāgāśca tilakānāṃ tathāṣṭakam | tripaṃcāśadaṇḍakaśca prāsādaścendranīlakaḥ ||2.140.30|| ṣoḍaśatalabhāgāśca tilakānāṃ tathāṣṭakam | saptapaṃcaśadaṇḍaśca mahānīlaḥ sa ucyate ||3 1|| ṣoḍaśatalabhāgāścaikaṣaṣṭyaṇḍaḥ sa bhūdharaḥ | aṣṭādaśatalabhāgāḥ paṃcaṣaṣṭyaṇḍakastathā ||32|| catuścatvāriṃśattilaḥ ratnakūṭa sa ucyate | aṣṭādaśa talabhāgāścatvāriṃśattilastathā ||33 || navaṣaṣṭyaṇḍakaḥ prokto vaidūryākhyaḥ śubho mahān | aṣṭādaśatalabhāgāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśattilakānvitaḥ ||34|| trisaptatyaṇḍakaḥ proktaḥ padmarāgaḥ śubho mahān | aṣṭādaśa talabhāgā dvātriṃśattilakastathā ||35|| saptasaptatyaṇḍakaśca prāsādo vajrako hi saḥ | aṣṭādaśatalabhāgā aṣṭāviṃśatisattilaḥ || 36 || ekāśītyaṇḍakaśceti mukuṭojjvala ucyate | aṣṭādaśa tilabhāgāścaturviṃśatisattilaḥ || 37|| pañcāśītyaṇḍakaścāyamairāvatākhya ucyate | dvāviṃśatitalabhāgāścatvārastilakāstathā ||38|| navāśītyaṇḍakaḥ prokto rājahaṃsetināmavān | dvāviṃśatitalabhāgāstilakāṣṭakavām̐stathā ||39|| trinavatyaṇḍakaḥ prokto garuḍākhyaḥ śubho hi saḥ | dvāviṃśatitalabhāgāstilakānāṃ catuṣṭayam ||2.140.40|| saptanavatyaṇḍakaśca vṛṣabho’yaṃ samucyate | dvāviṃśatatilabhāgāḥ śataikāṇḍakavām̐stathā ||41|| meruprāsāda ukto’yaṃ sarvaśobhāspado hi saḥ | caturasratalaṃ caikāṇḍakastilakanāmakaḥ ||42|| gaurītilaka ekāṇḍāṣṭatilaścaturasrakaḥ | talabhāgāṣṭakastilacatuṣṭyāṇḍakaikavān ||43|| rudratilakaprāsādaḥ śreṣṭho bodhyaḥ sukhāvahaḥ | talabhāgāṣṭakaścatustilako’ṇḍakapañcakaḥ ||44|| śrītilakasaṃjñaḥ sa prāsādo’pi śubhāvahaḥ | talabhāgāṣṭakaṃ tilakānāṃ tathā catuṣṭayam ||45|| navāṇḍaṃ haritilakābhidhaṃ vai śikharaṃ matam | tadeva tu trayodaśāṇḍakaṃ lakṣmītilākhyakam ||46|| daśabhāgatalaṃ tathā dvādaśatilakāśritam | navaviṃśatyaṇḍakaṃ ca bhūtilakaṃ taducyate ||47|| tadeva ca trayastriṃśadaṇḍaṃ raṃbhātilākhyakam | caturviṃśatitilakaṃ talaṃ dvādaśabhāgakam ||48|| saptatriṃśadaṇḍakaṃ ca mandiratilakaṃ matam | dvādaśatalabhāgāśca viṃśatistilakāni ca ||49|| pañcacatvāriṃśadaṇḍaṃ hemavattilakaṃ matam | caturviṃśatitilakaṃ taladvādaśabhāgakam ||2.140.50|| navacatvāriṃśadaṇḍaṃ kailāsatilakaṃ matam | dvādaśa talabhāgāśca viṃśatitilakānvitam ||51|| saptapañcāśadaṇḍaṃ ca pṛthivītilakaṃ matam | ṣaṭtriṃśattilakaṃ cāṣṭāviṃśatitalabhāgakam ||52|| pañcaṣaṣṭyaṇḍakaṃ proktaṃ tribhuvanākhyameva tat | tadeva navaṣaṣṭyaṇḍaṃ cendranīlatilātmakam ||53|| aṣṭāviṃśatitilakaṃ dvātriṃśattalabhāgakam | trisaptatyaṇḍakaṃ proktaṃ sarvāṃgatilakaṃ matam ||54|| caturviṃśatitilakaṃ dvātriṃśattalabhāgakam | saptasaptatyaṇḍakaṃ ca suravallabhakābhidham |||55|| pañcaviṃśatyaṇḍamaṣṭabhāgatalaṃ catustilam | siṃhatilakamevaitat kalpitaṃ śilpibhiḥ śubham ||56|| dvādaśatilakaṃ saptasaptatyaṇḍaṃ talā daśa | makaradhvajasaṃjñaṃ tat tilakaṃ śobhanaṃ matam ||57|| pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatāṇḍasuśobhitam | daśabhāgatalaṃ cāṣṭatilaṃ maṃgalanāmakam |||58|| saptadaśādhikaśatāṇḍakaṃ catustilātmakam | talabhāgadaśakaṃ ca tilakākṣābhidhaṃ hi tat ||59|| tadevaikonapañcāśadaṇḍaṃ padmatilābhidham | pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatāṇḍakaṃ talāṃśadvādaśam ||2.140.60|| caturviṃśatitilakaṃ somatilakamucyate | navāśītyadhikaśatāṇḍakaṃ dvādaśa vai talam ||61 || viṃśatitilakaṃ nāma vijayākhyaṃ mataṃ śubham | pañcaviṃśatyadhikacatuḥśatāṇḍakaṃ śubham ||62|| tale dvādaśatilake caturviṃśe tralokanam | dvātriṃśattalabhāgāśca catustilaka eva ca ||63|| trayastriṃśatsaptaśatāṇḍakaḥ ṛṣabhasaṃjñakaḥ | dve śate navaṣaṣṭiścāṇḍakāni yasya santi ca ||64|| dvādaśatalabhāgāścājitaprāsāda ucyate | trayodaśādhikaśatāṇḍako’ṣṭādaśasattalaḥ ||65|| svayaṃbhūnāmakaḥ proktaḥ prāsādaḥ sukhadāyakaḥ | saptasaptatyadhikāḍhyaśatāṇḍakaḥ śubhākṛtiḥ ||66 || aṣṭādaśatalabhāgaścābhinandananāmakaḥ | caturdaśatalabhāgaḥ saptapañcāśadaṇḍakaḥ ||67|| sumatyākhyaḥ sa vai bodhyaḥ sarvaśāntipradāyakaḥ | viṃśatistalabhāgāśca aṇḍāni dve śate nava ||68|| padmavallabhasaṃjñaḥ sa prāsādo nāmato mataḥ | daśabhāgatalaścāpi saptapaṃcāśadaṇḍakaḥ ||69|| supārśvavallabhaḥ so’yaṃ prāsādaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | aṇḍakāni bhaveyuśca dve śate navaviṃśati ||2.140.70|| dvātriṃśattalabhāgaśca prāsādaḥ śītalābhidhaḥ | caturviṃśatitalabhāg dvādaśatilakānvitaḥ ||71 || navacatvāriṃśadaṇḍaḥ śriyoṃ’śakaḥ sa ucyate | caturviśatitilabhāka caturviṃśatisattilaḥ |||72|| trayastriṃśadaṇḍakaśca śītalākhyaḥ sa ucyate | aṣṭādaśatalabhāgo dvādaśatilakānvitaḥ ||73|| saptadaśāṇḍakaḥ so’yaṃ svakulābhidha ucyate | dvāviṃśatitalabhāgaḥ ṣoḍaśatilakānvitaḥ ||74|| dve śate saptapaṃcāśadaṇḍāni vasupūjyakaḥ | caturviṃśatitalabhāk saptasaptatikāṇḍakaḥ ||75|| vimalākhyo bhavet so’yaṃ prāsādaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ | viṃśatitalabhāgaśca tripaṃcāśaccatuḥśatam ||76|| aṇḍānāṃ yasya so’nantamāyā prāsāda ucyate | aṣṭāviṃśatitalabhāg dvādaśatilakānvitaḥ ||77|| pañcaviṃśatirdve śate’ṇḍānyayaṃ dharma ucyate | dvādaśatalabhāgaśca navāśītiḥ śataṃ tathā ||78|| aṇḍānyayaṃ śāntanāmā prāsādaḥ śobhano mataḥ | talabhāgāṣṭakaścāpi viṃśatitilakānvitaḥ ||79|| navaṣaṣṭyaṇḍakaḥ so’yaṃ kanthādharaḥ samucyate | aṣṭabhāgatalavām̐ścaikaviṃśatyaṇḍakaśca yaḥ ||2.140.80|| kamalakandanāmā sa prāsādaḥ śobhano bhavet | dvādaśatalabhāgaśca tathāṣṭatilakaśca yaḥ ||81|| ekāśītiḥ śataṃ cāṇḍānyayaṃ mahendrasaṃjñakaḥ | caturdaśatalabhāgāstilakānyaṣṭa yatra ca ||82|| pañcāśītyaṇḍakaścāyaṃ mānasatuṣṭināmakaḥ | paḍviṃśattalabhāgāśca ṣoḍaśatilakānvitaḥ ||83|| trisaptatiścatuḥśatānyaṇḍāni sumatirhi saḥ | dvāviṃśatistalabhāgāścatvāriṃśattilātmakaḥ ||84|| śataṃ trinavatiścāṇḍakānyayaṃ nemināmakaḥ | ṣaḍviṃśatistalabhāgāstathā ca tilakāṣṭakam ||85|| trayodaśādhikaśatāṇḍakaḥ pārśvābhidho hi saḥ | caturviṃśatitalabhāg dve śate caikaviṃśatiḥ ||86|| aṇḍāni yasya sa bodhyo vīranāmā śubhāvahaḥ | ekāṃgaścaikaprāsādaścaturasro’ṇḍakaikavān ||87|| trayāṃgāstriprāsādakāḥ paṃcāgāḥ pañca ityapi | saptāṃgāḥ saptaprasādā navāṃgā nava ityapi ||88|| vicitraśikharākārāḥ śilpibuddhyudayānvitāḥ | ekāṇḍakaścaturasro vairājākhyo hi kathyate ||89|| caturbhāgatalastrayodaśāṇḍo nandanābhidhaḥ | ekonatriṃśadaṇḍaśca śrīnandanaḥ sa ucyate ||2.140.90|| ṣaṭtalāṃśaḥ pañcaviṃśatyaṇḍo mandiranāmakaḥ | ekonatriṃśadaṇḍaśca malayākhyaḥ sa ucyate ||91|| trayastriṃśadaṇḍakaśca vimānākhyaḥ sa ucyate | saptatriṃśadaṇḍaścāṣṭatilakastu viśālakaḥ |||92|| ekacatvāriṃśadaṇḍastrailokyabhūṣaṇo mataḥ | talāṣṭāṃśaḥ pañcacatvāriṃśadaṇḍaka eva ca ||93|| catustilakasaṃyukto mahendranāmako mataḥ | aṇḍānāṃ vardhanāt saptabhedāścāsya bhavanti hi ||94|| talabhāgadaśakaścaikacatvāriṃśadaṇḍakaḥ | ṣoḍaśatilakairyukto mahīdharaḥ sa ucyate ||95|| tilakāṇḍaprabhedena bahudhāyaṃ bhavatyapi | ityevaṃ rādhike bhedān śikharāṇāṃ tadāha tam ||96 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prāsādarūpe mervādijātīyākṣarādijātīyatadanyajātīyaprāsādānāṃ svarūpanirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 140 ||
<2.141> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yathāha ca | bhaktaṃ devāyatanakaṃ te vadāmi yathāyatham || 1 || ekādhikasahasrāṇḍo dvāsaptatitalānvitaḥ | jyeṣṭhamervākhya evāsau mataḥ sarvottamottamaḥ || 2 || caturasrīkṛte kṣetre dvāsaptativibhājite | sārdhacaturbhāgabhittiḥ sārdhataryābhramantikā || 3 || atha kṣetraṃ caturasraṃ daśadhā bhājayettataḥ | bhāgaikā bhramaṇī kāryā bhittirbhāgaikasammatā || 4 || koṇo bhāgadvayātmā sārdhaikaṃ pratirathaṃ tathā | bhadraṃ bhāgatrayaṃ caitat sarvadikṣu samānakam || 5 || atha kṣetraṃ caturasraṃ tvaṣṭadhā bhājayetpunaḥ | dvibhāgastatra koṇaśca bhadraṃ bhāgadvayātmakam || 6 || evaṃ tridhā bhavantyeva meruprāsādakā bhuvi | dvāsaptatitalabhāgāḥ kaṇādibhadrakāntakāḥ || 7 || bodhyāstatra ṣaḍdvayaṃ ṣaḍdvayaṃ ṣaḍdvayam ṣaḍdvyam | ākarṇabhadramāvṛtya cāṃgabhāgādiyojanā || 8 || bhāgāṣṭakaṃ ca bhadrārdhaṃ nirgame bhāgaṣaṭkakam | bhadropari gavākṣāśca tavaṃgarathikāstathā || 9 || tathā paṃcoruśṛṃgāṇi ropaṇīyāni sarvathā | koṇe tu sarvatobhadro nandīśaḥ pṛthivījayaḥ || 2.141.10 || krameṇoparyuparyeva saṃsthāpyāste dṛḍhātmakāḥ | navāṇḍo bhadrako nandīśaścaikaviṃśatyaṇḍakaḥ || 11 || navacatvāriṃśadaṇḍaḥ pṛthivījaya ādṛtaḥ | karṇasamabhāgapaḍhare keśarībhadrakastathā || 12|| nandīśālaḥ pradātavyāstatra pañcāṇḍakeśarī | nandīśālaḥ saptadaśāṇḍako bhadro navāṇḍakaḥ || 13|| bhadrasya vāmadakṣasthanandikānāmuparyatha | keśarī keśarī śrīvatsaḥ śrīvatsāṇḍakāstathā || 14|| deyāstatraikāṇḍakastu śrīvatso’nye tu pūrvavat| | koṇasya vāmadakṣasthanandikānāmuparyatha || 15 || keśarī keśarī śrīvatsaśrīvatsāṇḍakāstathā | nandikāstatra ṣaḍbodhyāḥ svalpā mahatya eva vā || 16 || pratikarṇavāmadakṣasthanandikopari dhruvaḥ | keśarī eva dātavyo nānyathā tu kadācana || 17|| bhadre tu nāsikāṃ kṛtvā tatra śrīvatsakāṇḍakaḥ | karṇe ca pratikarṇe ca bhadrasya vāmadakṣiṇe || 18|| catuḥṣvevaṃ pradeyāni pratyaṃgānyaṣṭasaṃkhyayā | evaṃ caturṣu dikṣu dvātriṃśatpratyaṃgakāni vai || 19|| dvāsaptatipadasaudhe catuṣpaṃcāśadaṃśakaiḥ | śikharasya namaṇasya rekhāḥ kāryāstataḥ param || 2.141.20 || evaṃ bhavati caikāḍhyasahasrāṇḍasamanvitaḥ | jyeṣṭhamerusamākhyo vai parabrahmanivāsavān || 21 || madhyameruṃ kathayāmi kṣetraṃ tu caturasrakam | catuṣṣaṣṭivibhāgaṃ ca garbhādikoṇakāvadhim || 22|| saptadvayatricatuṣṣaṭactuṣṣaḍbhirvibhājayet | tribhāgo bhadranistāro bhadro’yaṃ bhāgasaptakaḥ || 23|| prathamā nandikā bhāgadvayā
