bhāgatrayāparā | pratikarṇacaturbhāgaḥ ṣaḍbhāgaḥ prātirāthakaḥ ||24|| pratikarṇaścaturbhāgaḥ koṇaḥ ṣaḍabhāgajastathā | evaṃ kāryaṃ caturdikṣu ṣaḍbhāgā bhramaṇī matā ||25|| ṣaṭṣaḍbhāgā bhittikāśca rekhā viṃśatibhāgikā | keśarī sarvatobhadro nandano nandaśālikaḥ ||26|| sthāpyāḥ krameṇa koṇeṣu trayodaśāṇḍanandanaḥ | śrīvatsau dvau keśarī syuḥ pratikarṇe sthitāḥ kramāt ||27|| śrīvatsaḥ keśarī caiva sarvatobhadrakastathā | paḍharopari dātavyaḥ prāsādatrayabhūṣaṇāḥ ||28|| śrīvatsaḥ keśarī caiva nandikāyāṃ niyojayet | dvitīyā nandikā kāryā śrīvatsadvayaśobhitā ||29|| paḍhare pratirathake karṇe ca nandike tathā | tadardhe vāmadakṣe tu deyaṃ pratyaṃgameva ca ||2.141.30|| aṇḍakāḥ pūrvavad bodhyāḥ śṛṃgamānaṃ ca pūrvavat | pañcādhikapañcaśatāṇḍako’yaṃ merumadhyamaḥ ||3 1 || munividyādharasiṃhagajaghaṇṭakakūṭakaiḥ | varālikāsaṃvaraṇairyuktaḥ śivādhivāsanaḥ ||32|| catuṣṣaṣṭitalaḥ pañcādhikapañcaśatāṇḍakaḥ | madhyameruḥ kīrtito’tha kaniṣṭhaṃ pravadāmi ca ||33|| caturasrīkṛte kṣetre pañcapañcāśadaṃśake | ṣaṭtritriṣaṭtriṣaḍbhiśca kartavyā yojanā kramāt ||34|| bhadramārabhya karṇāntā bhadrārdhaṃ cāṃśaṣaṭkakam | bhāgadvayaṃ nirgame ca tribhāṇā nandikā tathā ||35|| dvitīyāpi tribhāgā ca paḍharo bhāgaṣaṭkavān | tṛtīyā nandikā bhāgatrayāḍhyā koṇakāstu ṣaṭ ||36|| nirgame samabhāvāste tataḥ kāryāṃgayojanā | bhittiḥ sārdhacaturaṃśā bhramaṇyapi tathāyatā ||37|| namaṇasya tu rekhāśca madhyamerāviva dhruvāḥ | pratirathe ca koṇe ca śṛṃgāṇi trīṇi trīṇi ca ||38|| keśarīsaṃjñakānyeva deyānyuparitastataḥ | nandikāyāṃ pratikarṇe śrīvatsāśca trayastrayaḥ ||39|| bhadre tu nāsikāṃ kṛtvā dvau prakāryau śrīvatsakau | catvāri coruśṛṃgāṇi pratyaṃgaṃ vāmadakṣake ||2.141.40 || trinavatyāḍhyadviśatāṇḍako meruḥ kaniṣṭhakaḥ | gaṇavidyādhrādiśobho devānāṃ priya eva ca ||41 || atha mandiranāmāpi merumandiramucyate | caturastrīkṛte kṣetrehyaṣṭātriṃśadvibhājite ||42|| caturbhāgaṃ bhaved bhadraṃ dvibhāgaścāsya nirgamaḥ | nandikā caikabhāgā ca dvitīyā dvayaṃśikā tathā ||43|| pañcabhāgaḥ paḍharaśca tathā bhāgadvayāparā | nandikā cātha koṇastu pañcabhāgātmakastathā ||44|| samadalāḥ sarva ete bhittiḥ sārdhatrayā matā | bhramaṇyapi sārdhatrayā caturdikṣu samā matā ||45|| madhyaprāsādakatalaṃ mataṃ dvādaśabhāgakam | caturdikṣveva kartavyaṃ koṇe keśariṇastrayaḥ ||46 || ekaṃ śrīvatsakaṃ cāpi tato’tha paḍharopari | śrīvatsāśca trayaścaikaṃ tilakaṃ kāryameva ca ||47|| sarvanandikordhvake ca śrīvatsānāṃ tathāṇḍakāḥ | trayastrayaḥ karaṇīyāścatuḥśṛṃgāṇi bhadrake ||48|| pratyaṃgāni dakṣiṇe vāmake cāpi yathāyatham | rekhordhve dvādaśabhāgeṣvapi rūpāṇi sannyaset ||49|| aṣṭātriṃśattalabhāgastathā ca tilakāṣṭakaḥ | evaṃ pañcāśītyadhikāṇḍako merurayaṃ mataḥ ||2.141.50|| aṣṭātriṃśattalabhāgāścatuṣṣaṣṭitilāni ca | navacatvāriṃśadadhikaṃ śataṃ cāṇḍamaṇḍalam ||51 || lakṣmīkoṭarasaṃjño’yaṃ prāsādo merurucyate | caturviṃśatitilakaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśattalabhāgavān ||52|| navaviṃśatyekaśatāṇḍakaḥ kailāsamerukaḥ | dvāsaptatitilakāḍhyaścāṣṭādaśatalāṃśavān ||53|| ekaṣaṭyadhikaśatāṇḍaḥ sa paṃcānanābhidhaḥ | caturviṃśatitilakaḥ saptasaptatikāṇḍavān ||54|| ṣaḍeviṃśattalabhāgaḥ sa vimānamerurucyate | catuṣṣaṣṭyādhikaśatatilakaśca tale tu yaḥ |||55||| ṣaṭtriṃśadbhāgavān navādhikadviśatakāṇḍakaḥ | gandhamādananāmāsau meruḥ prāsādako mataḥ ||56|| ṣaḍviṃśatitalabhāgā viṃśatistilakāni ca | pañcaviṃśatyadhikaikaśatāṇḍo muktakoṇakaḥ ||57|| ṣaṭtriṃśaśca śataṃ cāpi tilakāni tathā tale | dvātriṃśadbhāgakā yasya tathā śataṃ ca paṃca ca ||58|| catvāriṃśaccāṇḍakāni giriprāsādakābhidhaḥ | caturaśītitilakaścāṣṭādaśatalāṃśavān ||59|| ekaviṃśatyaṇḍakaśca tilakābhidhamerukaḥ | dvānavatitilakaśca navādhikaśatāṇḍakaḥ ||2.141.6 0|| catustriṃśattalabhāgaścandraśekharamerukaḥ | ṣaṭpaṃcāśattilakaścaivatrisaptatikāṇḍakaḥ ||6 1 || aṣṭāviṃśatitalabhāṅmandiratilakābhidhaḥ | trayastriṃśadaṇḍakaśca ṣoḍaśatilakānvitaḥ ||62|| dvādaśatalabhāgaśca saubhāgyamerureva saḥ | aṇḍāni ca navādhikacattvāriṃśattu yatra vai ||63|| tilakāni cāṣṭayuktacatvāriṃśattu yatra ca | dvāviṃśatitalabhāgāḥ sundaro merureva saḥ ||64|| viṃśatistalabhāgāśca ṣaṭtriṃśattilakāni ca | aṇḍāni navacatvāriṃśadyuktaśatameva tu ||65|| śrītilakābhidhāno’sau prāsādaḥ sammataḥ śubhaḥ | saptapaṃcāśadāḍhyaikaśatāṇḍakastu yo bhavet ||66|| catvāriṃśattilakaścāṣṭāviṃśatisattalaḥ | viśālākhyaḥ sa vai bodhyaḥ prāsādaḥ śubhado mataḥ ||67|| ekāṇḍaśca catuścatvāriṃśattilakavām̐stathā | dvādaśatalabhāgaśca parvatakūṭako hi saḥ ||68|| catvāriṃśattilakaśca saptapaṃcāśadaṇḍakaḥ | dvāviṃśatitalabhāk sa nandivardhana ucyate ||6 9 || ityevaṃ kathitāḥ sarve prāsādāśca mamālayāḥ | pratimāścātha vakṣyāmi yathā yathā tu me matā ||2.141.70|| nibiḍā nirvaṇā mṛdvī sugandhā madhurā śilā | kāntiyuktā darśanīyā pratimārthā śilā bhavet ||71 || nirmalaṃ hemakāṃsyādi cihnaṃ lohamayaṃ ca yat | tathā vicitravikṛtiḥ pratimāyāṃ bhayāvaham ||72|| bhṛṃgakapotakumudamāṣamudgasitopamā | pāṇḍurā ghṛtapadmābhā sarvārcāsu śilā śubhā |||73|| dvādaśāṃgulato nyūnā pūjyā mūrtirgṛhe matā | dvādaśāṃgulato navagajāntārcyā surālaye ||74|| daśagajordhvā pratimā pūjyā prāsādakaṃ vinā | catuṣkyāmeva sā paṃcacatvāriṃśadgajāntikā ||75|| aṣṭalauhamayī śailī ratnajā śreṣṭhadārujā | pravālādimayī cāpi pratimā śubhadāyinī ||76 || śatavatsarapūrvā yā daivipuruṣaveśitā | khaṇḍitā sphuṭitāpyarcyā tadanyā doṣadāyinī ||77|| tīrthabhūmiṣvaraṇye ca devatāḥ khaṇḍitā api | pūjanīyā hi phaladā nānyatra tu kadācana ||78|| rātnī ca dhātavī lepaliptā ca durghaṭā tu yā | punaḥ saṃskārayogyā sā pūjanīyā tato bhavet ||79|| kāṣṭhapāṣāṇajā bhagnā saṃskārārhā na sā matā | nādhikāṃgā na hīnāṃgā kartavyā sā kadācana ||2.141.80|| kāṣṭhalepāśmadantotthā vitrāyasādijāpi ca | mānādhikā devaparivārā gṛhe na pūjyate ||8 1 || garjanāṃ rodanaṃ hāsyamunmīlananimīlane | krūratāṃ yatra kurvanti devāstatra mahadbhayam ||82|| pṛthvyāṃ śilā tu yā suptā nikhanyate bahistadā | dakṣiṇaṃ paścimaṃ pārśvaṃ smṛtvā śiro vidhāpayet ||83 || ekabhāgaṃ grāhamukhaṃ pakṣī dvibhāgavām̐stathā | tribhāgāḥ kuṃjarādyāśca caturbhāgāśca kinnarāḥ ||84|| vṛṣāḥ surāḥ pañcabhāgāḥ kartavyāḥ śilpinā śubhāḥ | gaṇeśo vāmanaḥ kroḍaścaite ṣaḍaṃśakā matāḥ ||85|| saptabhāgāstu kartavyā vṛṣabhakroḍamānavāḥ | aṣṭāṃśā pārvatī śaktistathānyā devikā api ||86|| navāṃśānyasurāḥ śivasaṃkarṣaṇā daśāṃśakāḥ | caṇḍībhūtahanumān kārtikāścaikādaśāṃśakāḥ ||87|| vaitālo dvādaśāṃśaśca trayodaśāṃśarākṣasāḥ | daityāścaturdaśāṃśāśca pañcadaśāṃśako bhṛguḥ | |88|| krūrā devā devikādyāḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśā matāḥ sadā | gaṇeśo mūṣakārūḍho dhatte dantaparaśvadhau ||89 | | paṃkajaṃ modakaṃ cāpi hastyāsyaḥ sarpabhūṣaṇaḥ | mukhaṃ bhāgadvayaṃ tasya bhāgadvayaṃ tathodaram || 2.141.90 || caturaṃgulaṃ jaghanam ājānvaṃgulasaptakam | jānū tryaṃgulamevāpi jaṃghā saptāṃgulā tathā || 91 || pādastryaṃgula evāpi mānaṃ ṣaḍbhāgamūrtikam | saptabhāge pramāṇaṃ tu kathayāmi nibodha me || 92 || keśāntāstu trayo bhāgā mukhamekāṃśakaṃ tathā | tryaṃgulaḥ kaṇṭha evāpi pakṣaḥ sārdhadaśāṃgulaḥ || 93 || navāṃgulodaraṃ proktaṃ sārdhaṃ saptāṃgulaṃ tu vai | nābhiliṃgāntarālaṃ ca sakthyaṣṭādaśakāṃgulam || 94|| jānustryaṃgulakaścāpi jaṃghāṣṭādaśakāṃgulā | pādastryaṃgulako bodhyaḥ saptavitastikāyakaḥ || 95|| aṣṭatāle mukhaṃ tālaṃ keśāntaṃ tryaṃgulaṃ tathā | grīvā ca tryaṃgulā bodhyā hṛdayaṃ ca navāṃgulam || 96 || dvādaśāṃgulamānābhim āmeḍhaṃ ca navāṃgulam | ekaviṃśatyaṃgulorurjānustryaṃgulako mataḥ || 97|| ekaviṃśatyaṃgulā jaṃghā pādastryaṃgulastathā | eṣā cāṣṭavitastyāḍhyā mūrtiḥ proktā suśilpake || 98|| navatālaṃ tathā vacmi keśāntaṃ tryaṃgulaṃ tathā | dvādaśāṃgulakaṃ bodhyaṃ mukhaṃ kaṇṭhoṃ’gulatrayaḥ || 99 || daśāṃgulaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ nābhirdvādaśakāṃgulā | caturaṃgulamudaraṃ guhyaṃ cāṣṭāṃgulāntaram || 2.141.100 || sakthi caturviṃśatikāṃgulaṃ jānuścaturmitaḥ | caturviṃśatyaṃgulā ca jaṃghā pādaścaturmitaḥ || 101 || vistāre stanagarbhe tu dvādaśāṃgulamīritam | stanāt kukṣiścaturaṃgulāyatā śobhanā tathā || 102|| kukṣibāhvoravakāśaścaikāṃgulo mataḥ śubhaḥ | hastaḥ saptāṃgulaḥ puṣṭaḥ skandhāt kaphoṇikāṃ prati || 103 || śoḍaśāṃguladairghyaṃ ca tataḥ prakoṣṭhakaṃ daśa | prakoṣṭhāyatatā tryaṃgulātha hastatalaṃ tu vai || 1 04|| dvādaśāṃgulalambaṃ ca paṃcāgulaṃ tathāyatam | madhyaṃ caturdaśāṃgulāyataṃ kaṭistu vai tathā || 105 || caturviṃśatyaṃgulā ca sakthimūlaṃ daśaikakam | jaṃghāprakoṣṭhaścaturaṃgulāyatastathā punaḥ || 1 06|| caturdaśāṃgulapādāyatatāṃgulikāntikā | bāhutaḥstanabhāgaśca caturaṃgulordhvagaḥ || 1 07|| kukṣeḥ skandhoparibhāgaścāṣṭāṃgulo matastathā | kaṇṭho’ṣṭāṃśaḥ pādaḥ ṣaṣṭhāṃśāyataśceti mānatā || 1 08|| ityevaṃ rādhike mānaṃ bahudhāpi bhavatyapi | yugānurūpamevāpi yathāha devataṃ hariḥ || 1 09|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pratiṣṭhotsave uttamamadhyamakaniṣṭhamerumandirāṇāṃ gaṇeśādimūrtīnāṃ ca mānānumāpādinirūpaṇanāmaikacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 141 ||
<2.142> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānyasuramūrtīrvadāmi te | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yadāha bhaktakam || 1 || aṃgapratyaṃgabhagnāṃ tu mūrtiṃ visarjayejjale | nakhābharaṇamālāstrabhagnāṃ tāṃ na visarjayet || 2 || ṛgvedādicaturbhedāt satyayugādibhedataḥ | brāhmādivarṇabhedācca caturmukho hi viśvasṛṭ || 3 || dakṣiṇārdhaḥ karādūrdhvaṃ japamālāṃ tathā srucam | granthaṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ dhatte saśmaśruḥ kamalāsanaḥ || 4 || akṣasūtraṃ pustakaṃ ca dhatte padmakamaṇḍalū | caturvaktrā hi sāvitrī śrotriyānandakāriṇī || 5 || ṛgvedaḥ śvetavarṇaśca dvibhujo rāsabhānanaḥ | akṣamālāmbupātraṃ ca bibhran svādhyayane rataḥ || 6 || ajāsyaḥ pītavarṇaśca yajurvedo’kṣasūtravān | vāme cāṃkuśapāṇistu bhūtido maṃgalāvahaḥ || 7 || nīlotpaladalābhāsaḥ sāmavedo hayānanaḥ | akṣamālādharaḥ savye vāme kambudharaḥ sa vai || 8 || atharvaṇābhidho vedo dhavalo markaṭānanaḥ | akṣasūtraṃ ca khaṣṭvāṃgaṃ bibhran vai vijayapradaḥ || 9 || viśvakarmā caturbāhurakṣamālāṃ ca sūtrakam | gajaṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ dhatte trinetro haṃsavāhanaḥ || 2.142.10 || sudarśanakarā savye padmahastā tu vāmataḥ | etad viṣṇunāmakasya rūpaṃ sūryasya kīrtitam || 1 1|| sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam | dvibhujaṃ caikavastraṃ ca śvetapaṃkajadhṛkkaram || 12|| vartulaṃ tejasāṃ bimbaṃ madhyasthaṃ raktavāsasam | saptānanahayairyuktaṃ rathe’ruṇena saṃyutam || 13 || viṣṇurgaṇeśaḥ sūryaśca śaktiḥ rudraśca devatāḥ | pañcāyatanarūpāśca bodhyāḥ sarvatra śobhanāḥ || 14|| navāṃśā tatra kartavyā mūrtirnārāyaṇasya vai | śaṃkhapadmagadācakradhāriṇī mukuṭānvitā || 15|| harirdhārayate kambuṃ cakraṃ padmaṃ gadāṃ tathā | kṛṣṇo dhatte pāñcajanyaṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ sudarśanam || 16|| garuḍo harito rūpe kauśikākāranāsikaḥ | caturbhujo vṛttanetramukhaḥ pakṣadvayānvitaḥ || 17|| gṛdhrorujānucaraṇaḥ svarṇavarṇaḥ kalāyutaḥ | chatraṃ kumbhaṃ dhārayeścāṃjaliṃ kurvan namoyutaḥ || 18|| vāmāgre kuñcitaḥ paścādanyapādastu jānunā | pṛthivīṃ saṃśritaḥ patro garuḍāsanasaṃsthitaḥ || 19|| umāmaheśvaro dakṣe kare triśūlakaṃ tathā | mātuliṃgaṃ samādhatte āliṃgitaṃ tu vāmake ||2.142.20 || aṃke sve pārvatīṃ devīṃ samāsīnāṃ śubhānanām | nāgendro’nyakare skandhe umāhasto’tiśobhanaḥ ||21 || karānye darpaṇaṃ cāpi vṛṣabho’dhaḥsthitastathā | kumāreṇa gaṇeśena bhṛṃgīraṭādibhiryutaḥ ||22|| umāṃ ca dvibhujāṃ kuryāllakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇāśritām | hariḥ śastraiḥ svakīyaiśca garuḍopari saṃsthitaḥ ||23|| dakṣiṇaḥ kaṇṭhalagnaḥ syād vāmahastaḥ sarojadhṛk | harervāmakaro lakṣmyāḥ kukṣibhāge sthitaḥ śubhaḥ ||24|| varaṃ triśūlarekhe ca pānapātraṃ subibhratī | mayūraṃ ca hastiṃ ca mahālakṣmīḥ prakīrtitā ||25|| aṣṭapatrāmbujasyordhve lakṣmīḥ siṃhāsanasthitā | vināyakavadāsīnā bhūṣitābharaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||26|| ūrdhvahastau prakartavyau devyāḥ paṃkajadhāriṇau | vāme’mṛtaghaṭaṃ dhatte dakṣiṇe mātuliṃgakam ||27||| ekavaktrā caturhastā mukuṭena virājitā | prabhāmaṇḍalasaṃyuktā kuṇḍalānvitaśekharā ||28|| akṣābjavīṇāgranthāḍhyā mahāvidyā prakīrtitā | varākṣābjagranthayuktā sarasvatīśubhāvahā ||29|| bhittisaṃlagnabimbaśca puruṣaḥ sarvathāśubhaḥ | na kadāpi dhvajādaṇḍaḥ sthāpyo vai gṛhamandire ||2.142.3 0|| ravāvuttarage śreṣṭhaṃ devānāṃ sthāpanādikam | abhiṣekaḥ pratiṣṭhā ca praveśaḥ pūjanādikam ||3 1 || prāsādāgre tathaiśāne cottare maṇḍapogajaiḥ | tripaṃcasaptanavaikādaśabhiścāntarālake || 3 2|| pṛthvīṃ pūrvaṃ śodhayitvā dāhakhātajalārpaṇaiḥ | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā ca pūjayitvā ca kūrmakam ||33|| śeṣanāgaṃ kṣitiṃ cāpi pūjayitvā tataḥ param | śuddhapūrvāṃ diśaṃ maṇḍapārthaṃ prasādhayed yathā ||34|| sūtreṇa vartulaṃ kṛtvā madhye śaṃkuṃ praropayet | udayāstasamayasya rekhābhyāṃ sādhayed diśam ||35|| aṣṭadaśadvādaśaṣoḍaśāṣṭādaśahastakaḥ | ṣoḍaśādistaṃbhayukto viṃśatihastako’pi vā || 36|| vitastyucchrāyatalavān gajocchrāyatalo’pi vā | dvitīye maṇḍape kārye cādyamaṇḍapamānataḥ ||37|| tāvaddhastapramāṇaṃ ca tyaktvā kāryo’nyamaṇḍapaḥ | maṇḍape navabhāge ca madhyabhāgā tu vedikā ||38|| maṇḍapasya tṛtīyāṃśā vedikā madhyagā matā | aṣṭāṃgulādhikadvihastapramāṇamitāni vai || 39|| caturdvārāṇi ramyāṇi toraṇādyairdyumanti ca | kartavyānyatha ca dhvajān kathayāmi nibodha me ||2.142.40|| aṣṭadhvajā ropaṇīyāḥ pūrvādikramato yathā | dvidvagajāyatāḥ paṃcapaṃcagajapralambanāḥ ||41 || pūrve pīto hasticitra indradhvajaḥ sa ucyate | agnau raktaścoraṇāsyacitravānagnidaivataḥ ||42|| dakṣe kṛṣṇo mahiṣāḍhyo yamadhvaja saḥ ucyate | nairṛtye nīlavarṇaśca sacitro rākṣaso dhvajaḥ ||43|| paścime śvetavarṇaśca makarāsyaśca vāruṇaḥ | vāyau harito mṛgavān vāyudhvajaḥ sa ucyate ||44|| uttare śvetavarṇaśca hasticihnaḥ kuberakaḥ | īśāne śvetavarṇaśca vṛṣacitrayuto dhvajaḥ ||45|| daśahastadīrghavaṃśaśīrṣe dhṛtvārpayeddhi tān | vaṃśā bhūmau ropaṇīyā dārḍhyasya hetave khalu ||46|| maṇḍapasya madhyabhāge saptahastasudīrghakaḥ | trihastāyata evāpi kiṃkiṇījālakāntakaḥ ||47|| miśraraṃgaścāmarāḍhyaḥ pradātavyaḥ śubho mataḥ | daśahastavaṃśaśīrṣe sudṛḍhaḥ śobhano bhavet ||48|| saptasaptahastadīrghā ekaikahastakāyatā | trikoṇākṛtikā tattadāyudhāḍhyā ca vaṃśagā ||49|| vajraśaktidaṇḍakhaṅgapāśāṃkuśagadāstathā | triśūlaṃ ceti kramaśo bodhyānyāyudhakāni ca ||2.142.50|| pūrvoktaraṃgayuktāśca patākāstu samantataḥ | patākā navamī śvetā madhye ceśānapūrvayoḥ ||51|| puṣpādyaiḥ pūjayitvā tāṃ ropayed daṇḍaśīrṣasu | api kuṇḍavidhiṃ vacmi maṇḍapāntarabhūmiṣu ||52|| daśahastebhya ārabhya ṣoḍaśagajasammite | vedīṃ maṇḍapamadhye ca kuṇḍaṃ kuṇḍām̐stathā śubhān ||53|| pañcāṣṭau nava vā kuryāt pūrvādikramaśaḥ khalu | pūrve catuṣkoṇakaṃ ca yonyākāraṃ tathāgnike ||54|| ardhacandraṃ dakṣiṇe tu nairṛtye tu trikoṇakam | paścime vartulaṃ kuryād vāyau ṣaṭkoṇameva ca ||55|| uttare’ṣṭadalapadmābhamaṣṭāsrakamīśini | vṛtto vā caturasro vā pūrveśānasumadhyake ||56|| ācārya kuṇḍanāmāsau sadikpālādikuṇḍavān | yadvā kuryāt pañcakuṇḍīḥ pūrve sā caturastikā ||57|| ardhacandrasamā dakṣe vṛttā tu paścime ca sā | uttare padmarūpā ca īśāne vartulāthavā ||58|| caturasrā ca kartavyā rūpāntaraprabhedataḥ | eka eva yadīṣṭaḥ saḥ caturasro mato hiḥ saḥ ||59|| paścime cottare vā caiśāne vā kārya eva saḥ | sapādagajadūre vai vedyāḥ sarve ca kuṇḍakāḥ ||2.142.6 0|| yadvā vedīcaturbhāgāntarālānte matā hi te | caturasro brahmaṇānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu vartulaḥ ||6 1|| ardhacandraḥ sa vaiśyānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ sa trikoṇakaḥ | yadvā catuṣkoṇa eva sarveṣāṃ vartulo’thavā ||6 2|| nārīṇāṃ yonikuṇḍo vai sammataḥ sarvathā śubhaḥ | mekhalāyoniyuktaśca hastamātro hi kuṇḍakaḥ ||63|| homāyutaṃ hastamātre lakṣārdhaṃ tu dvihastake | lakṣahomaṃ trihaste ca daśalakṣaṃ catuṣkike ||64|| triṃśallakṣaṃ pañcahaste koṭyardhaṃ tu ṣaḍasrake | saptake’śītilakṣaṃ ca koṭihomaṃ gajāṣṭake ||65|| pañcāśaddhavane kuryādekaviṃśatikāṃgulam | śatahome sārdhadvāviṃśatikāṃgulakaṃ tathā ||66|| sahastahavanārthaṃ tu hastaikamānavānmataḥ | homāyutāya dvigajo lakṣe caturgajātmakaḥ ||67|| ṣaḍhasto daśalakṣārthaṃ koṭihomārthameva tu | aṣṭahasto daśahasto’thavā ṣoḍaśahastakaḥ ||68|| sūkṣmaṃ havistilaghṛtaṃ madhyaṃ drākṣāyavādikam | sthūlaṃ bilvaṃ nārikelaṃ samidhādi prakīrtitam ||69|| yādṛśaṃ tu bhaved dravyaṃ tathā kuṇḍo’pyapekṣitaḥ | yadvā kuṇḍaṃ pratilakṣaṃ gajamānaṃ vivardhayet ||2.142.70|| daśalakṣapraparyantaṃ daśahastaṃ vidhāpayet | yadvā saptagajaḥ pañcāśallakṣahavanārthakaḥ ||71 || daśalakṣahavanāya pañcahastamito’pi vā | viṃśatilakṣahomārthaṃ ṣaṅgajaḥ kuṇḍako mataḥ ||72|| lakṣārdhahavanārthaṃ trihastakaḥ kuṇḍa ityapi | kuṇḍasya gādhatā kṣetrasamā samekhalā matā ||73|| vināpi mekhalāṃ samā gādhatāpi prakīrtitā | caturviṃśatyaṃśake dvādaśāṃśaḥ kuṇḍakaṇṭhakaḥ ||74|| ekā dve tisra etā vā dve tisraḥ pañca mekhalā | kṣetrabhāgāṣṭake pañcabhāgāṃ gādhāṃ khanet tataḥ ||75|| tribhāge mekhalāścordhve tisraḥ kāryā vidhānataḥ | ūrdhvā caturaṃgulā ca madhyā tryaṃgulakā matā ||76 || nimnā bhāgadvayāḍhyā ca mekhalā śubhadā matā | caturasraṃ gajamātraṃ caturaṃgulakocchrayam ||77|| ekāṃgulocchrayaṃ vāpi sthaṇḍilaṃ homavedikā | viśālāyāṃ vedikāyām ekadvitragajāyatam ||78|| sarvatobhadrakaṃ nāma maṇḍalaṃ kāryameva ca | aṣṭau dvātriṃśadevāpi catuṣṣaṣṭiśca vā dvijāḥ ||79|| ṛtvijo vaidikāścābhimantraṇīyāḥ kriyāvidaḥ | maṇḍapasya tribhāgena cottare snānamaṇḍapaḥ ||2.142.80|| tatra vai sthaṇḍile śaile vāluke chāyayānvite | pratimāḥ snapayitavyāḥ pañcagavyaiḥ kaṣāyakaiḥ ||8 1 || snāpayecchatakalaśavāribhirvalkalānvitāḥ | vedamantraiśca vāditrairgītimaṃgalakīrtanaiḥ ||82|| vedīpārśve maṇḍapādho vastreṇācchādayet surān | tulāmāropayed vedyāmuttarādau ca tāṃ nyaset ||83 || kalaśaṃ tu śirodeśe pādasthāne kamaṇḍalum | vyajanaṃ pṛṣṭhadeśe ca darpaṇaṃ vāmabhāgake ||84|| vajravaidūryamuktāśca tvindranīlaṃ sunīlakam | puṣparāgaṃ ca gomedaṃ pravālaṃ pūrvadikkramaiḥ ||85|| suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ kāṃsyaṃ rītiṃ ca sīsakam | vaṃgaṃ lohaṃ ca pūrvādau kramād dhātūnihārpayet ||86|| vajraṃ vahniśikhāṃ sahadevīṃ tulasīpatrakam | indravāruṇikāṃ śaṃkhāvalīmudyāvalīṃ tathā ||87|| tvaritāṃ pūrvakramataścauṣadhīḥ sthāpayettathā | yavaṃ vrīhiṃ ca kaṅgūṃ ca javarīṃ ca tilāni ca ||88 || akṣakān mudgakān godhūmakān pūrvāditaḥ kramāt | mahotsavaṃ nṛtyagītanaivedyārārtrikādibhiḥ ||89|| aṃganyāsādibhiścāpi pratiṣṭhāvidhimācaret | devārpitaṃ vastrabhūṣādikaṃ dadettu śilpine ||2.142.90|| yajñārpitaṃ samagraṃ tu dadyādācāryarūpiṇe | prāsāde devatānyāsān pratyekāṃgeṣu kārayet ||91 || vārāhaṃ kharaśilāyāṃ nāgaṃ tu vārimārgage | kuṃbhīṣu jaladevaṃ ca puṣpakaṇṭhe’surām̐stathā ||92|| jāḍyakuṃbhe nandinīṃ ca viṣṇuṃ karṇikayostathā | gajapīṭhe gaṇeśaṃ ca hyaśvapīṭhe tathāśvinau ||93|| narapīṭhe nagām̐ścaiva kṣurake medinīṃ tathā | sandhyātrayaṃ bhadrakuṃbhe kalaśe pārvatīṃ tathā ||94|| kapotālyāṃ ca gandharvān mañcikāyāṃ sarasvatīm | jaṃghāyāṃ tu diśāṃpālān udgame cendradevatām ||95|| sāvitrīṃ tu bharaṇyāṃ ca śirāvaṭyāṃ tu devikāḥ | vidyādharīṃ puṣpakaṇṭhe surām̐ścāyantarālake ||96|.| parjanyaṃ kūṭacchādye ca śākhayoḥ sūryacandrakau | uttaraṃge tridevām̐ścodumbare yakṣakaṃ tathā ||97|| śaṃkhāvaṭe’śvinīputro kolyāṃ śeṣaṃ kṣmāṃ paṭṭake | staṃbhe parvatadevām̐śca ghūmmaṭe vyomadevatāḥ ||98|| madhye mukhyaṃ ca devaṃ ca paranāle tu jāhnavīm | śikharasyoruśṛṃgeṣu brahmaviṣṇuhareśvarān ||99|| indraṃ ceti pañcadevān prāsāde trīn sureśvarān | śikhare caiśvaraṃ devaṃ kalaśe tvindrameva ca || 2.142.100 || grīvāyāmamaraṃ cāmalasāre tu niśācaram | padmapatre tu padmākṣaṃ kalaśo tu sadāśivam || 10 1|| chādyavāmevaghoradevaṃ dakṣe tatpuruṣaṃ tathā | bhairavaṃ sthāpayeccāpi prāsāde pañcabhāgake || 102|| devaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmakanyā vilokayet | tato’nye darśanaṃ kuryuḥ sādhusādhvyo virāgiṇaḥ || 103 || tato vai gṛhadharmāṇastena devapratoṣaṇam | prārthayed yajamānastu puṇyaṃ vai sūtradhārataḥ || 1 04|| sūtradhāro vadecchreṣṭhinnakṣayaṃ bhavatāttava | sūtradhārāya śilpibhyau dadyāt pūjopadādikam || 1 05|| mahotsavaṃ bhojanādyaiḥ kuryāt kathādibhistathā | ityevaṃ rādhike karma te mayoktaṃ harermatam || 106 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pratiṣṭhotsave brahmavedadevadevīprabhṛtimūrtimānopamaṇḍapa kuṇḍasaṃkṣiptapratiṣṭhādipradarśananāmā dvācatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 142 ||
<2.143> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ | devāyatanakāyāha vāstuṃ taṃ te vadāmi ca || 1 || kūrmaśilāsthāpanaṃ ca dvāraśākhādiropaṇam | padmaśilāsthāpanaṃ ca dhvajāpuruṣaveśanam || 2 || ghaṇṭāyāḥ sthāpanaṃ cāpi dhvajasya sthāpanaṃ tathā | devapratiṣṭhānamiti puṇyāhasaptakaṃ matam || 3 || vāstupūjā hi kartavyā tatra tatra punaḥ punaḥ | śāntikarmāṇi tānyeva caturdaśa vadāmi te || 4 || bhūmikhāte kūrmadāne śilādāne ca sūtrake | dvāradāne khuradāne kuṃbhīdāne ca pāṭake || 5 || pādmaśaile śukanāse dhvajapuṃsi ca ghaṇṭake | kalaśe dhvajadāne ca pratiṣṭhāyāṃ matāni vai || 6 || ekadā tu parabrahma svaṃ rūpaṃ dṛśyamācarat | tasmāttejo’nantakoṭisūryābhaṃ samajāyata || 7 || tatra yogīśvaro devaḥ saṃhāradharmavām̐stadā | samabhavat tallalāṭāt svedabindurabhūttadā || 8 || mūrtapūruṣarūpaṃ tad yadā cābhūd bhayaṃkaram | tadā devairbrahmabhāvairnyastaṃ bhūmāvadhomukham || 9 || tasya vāstoḥ pūruṣasya nairṛtāyāṃ tadābhavan | pādau jaṃghe ca jānū ca tatheśānyāṃ śiro’bhavat || 2.143.10 || dakṣakaphoṇikā cāgnau vāmā vāyau tadābhavat | asya dehe pañcacatvāriṃśaddevāstadābhavan || 11 || sarvadevayutaḥ pūjāṃ prāptaḥ sa sukhado bhavet | catuṣṣaṣṭivibhāgo’pi caturasro’pi pūjyate || 12|| ekāśītivibhāgo’pi caturasraḥ sa pūjyate | śatabhāgayutaścāpi caturasraḥ sa pūjyate || 13 || aṣṭāvaṣṭau surāścāsya pratikāṣṭhaṃ vasanti ca | gajādekāttu pañcāśadgajātmako vidhīyate || 14|| dvātriṃśanmaṇḍalānyeva kṛtvābhitaḥ prapūjayet | maṇibhiḥ svarṇarūpyābhyāṃ vidrumaiśca phalairapi || 15|| catuṣṣaṣṭipadaṃ śatapadaṃ vāstuṃ ca vā likhet | piṣṭena vākṣataiścāpi kṛtvā ca balimarpayet || 16 || catuṣṣaṣṭipadaṃ vāstuṃ darśayāmi nibodha me | caturastrīkṛte kṣetre hyaṣṭabhāgavibhājite || 17|| madhye brahmā caturbhāge tatpūrve cāryamā tathā | dakṣe vaivasvato maitragaṇaśca paścime tathā || 18|| pṛthvīdharaścottare ca tatheśānyāṃ dvidhākṛte | āpaśca āpavatsaśca tathāgnau ca dvidhā kṛte || 1 9|| sāvitraśca savitā ca tathā dvedhā tu nairṛte | indro jayaśca ca tathā vāyāvapi dvidhā kṛte ||2.143.20 || rudraśca rājayakṣmā ca sthāpanīyāstataḥ param | abhitaḥ sarvabhāgeṣu pradakṣiṇakramācchṛṇu ||21 || iśānyāmīśaditī dve parjanyo dakṣakarṇake | skandhe jayastathā cendraḥ sūryaḥ satyo bhṛśastataḥ ||22|| ākāśāgnī dvāvagnau ca pūṣā vitatha ityataḥ | gṛhakṣato yamaścāpi gandharvaśca bhṛṃgastataḥ || 23|| mṛgapitarāvaike ca nairṛte nandikastataḥ | sugrīvaḥ puṣpadanto’pi varuṇaścāsurastathā ||24|| śeṣaśceti tato vāyau pāparogau vyavasthitau | tato nāgaśca mukhyaśca bhallāṭaśca kuberakaḥ ||25|| śailaścāditirityevaṃ vāmaskandhe sthitāntimā | ta ete pūjanīyā vai catuṣṣaṣṭivibhāgake ||26|| ekāśītivibhāge tu koṇe dvau dvau surau tu na | ekaika eva devaḥ syāt tadyathā pravadāmi te ||27|| īśaḥ parjanyakaścāpi jayaścendraśca sūryakaḥ | satyo bhṛśastathākāśo’gniḥ pūṣā vitathastathā || 28|| gṛhakṣato yamaścāpi gandharvaśca bhaṃgo mṛgaḥ | pitṛ nandī sugrīvakaḥ pūṣyaśca varuṇo’suraḥ ||29|| śeṣaḥ pāpaśca rogaśca nāgo mukhyo bhallāṭakaḥ | kuberaśca tathā śailo’ditirditistatheti ca || 2.143.3 0|| carakī bahirīśāne’gnau vahistu vidārikā | pūtanā bahinairṛtye vāyau pāpā bahirmatā ||3 1|| caturasraukṛte kṣetre navabhāgavibhājite | madhye navapado brahmā ṣaṭpadāścāryamādayaḥ ||32|| koṇe tu padamadhyasthā dvipadāḥ parikīrtitāḥ | abhitaḥ padikā jñeyā ekāśītipade surāḥ || 33|| atha vāstuṃ śatapadaṃ vacmi nibodha rādhike | caturasrīkṛte kṣetre daśabhāgavibhājite ||34|| koṇāḥ sarve bahiṣṭhāstu riktā devāstu dakṣagāḥ | madhye brahmā ṣoḍaśāṃśaḥ ṣaḍaṃśāścaryamādayaḥ ||35|| āpādyāśca dvidvabhāgāḥ sthāpyāḥ pūjyāḥ sadā śubhāḥ | īśo mūrghni ca parjanyo dakṣakarṇe sthitaḥ sadā ||36 || jayaḥ skandhe indrasūryasatyabhṛśāmbarā bhuje | sāvitraḥ savitā haste’gnyādipitrantakāḥ pade ||37|| nandyādirogakāntāśca vāme pade bhavanti ca | vāme sakthini maitraśca vivasvān dakṣasakthini ||38|| guhye cendro gudābhāge jayantaśceti kīrtitau | rudraśca rājayakṣmā dvau vāmahaste matau tathā ||39|| nāgo mukhyaśca bhallāṭaḥ kuberaḥ śailako’ditiḥ | ta ete vāmabhujagā ditiḥ karṇe tu vāmake ||2.143.40 || āpaḥ kaṇṭhe āpavatso hṛdi pārśve’ryamā mataḥ | dakṣe’tha vāmake pārśve pṛthvīdharo matastathā ||41 || īśāne carakī bāhye cipicchā pūrvato matā | vidārikāgnikoṇe ca dikpālā dakṣiṇe tathā ||42|| nairṛtye pūtanā proktā paścime skandha eva ca | vāyau pāpā rākṣasī cottare tathā kuberakaḥ ||43 || evaṃ pūjyā vāstudehe devatāḥ śubhadā matāḥ | prāsādasyottare veśāne vā vedīṃ dvihastakām ||44|| kṛtvā tatra ca kauśeyaṃ śvetavastraṃ samāstaret | tatrākṣatasvastikaṃ ca kṛtvā pītāmbaraṃ tataḥ ||45|| āstīryāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tatraivākṣatajaṃ caret | pītopari tato raktaṃ vastramāstīrya tatra ca ||46|| vāsturekhāḥ svarṇaśalākayā vā yavapiṣṭajāḥ | kṛtvā brahmasthale madhye vārikalaśamānyaset ||47|| gaṃge yamune viraje godāvari sarasvati | narmade sindho kāveri jale’smin sannidhiṃ vaha ||48|| viṣṇuścāgre śivo madhye tale brahmā virājate | mātaraḥ paritaḥ kukṣau samudrāstīrthakoṭayaḥ ||49|| sarve vedāḥ patrarūpā ratnarūpā vasundharā | phalāni śrīphale sīdeta sthāpayāmi sthiro bhava ||2.143.50 || oṃ śrīsiddhyai namaḥ oṃ śrībrahmaṇe’pi namo namaḥ | oṃ śrībrahmāsane ramye tiṣṭha śrīgurave namaḥ ||5 1 || oṃ namaste vāsudeva viśvakarmannamo’stu te | śuddhānyarcanadravyāṇi jalena prokṣitāni vai ||52|| sarvaṃ śuddhaṃ jāyate śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasmṛteḥ | oṃ klīṃ siddhyai namaścātrāgaccha sthāne sthirā bhava ||5 3 || omaryamṇe namaścātrāgaccha sthāne sthiro bhava | vivasvate nama omāgaccha cātra sthiro bhava ||54|| oṃ mitrāya nama oṃ pṛthvīdharāya sthiro bhava | om ṛddhyai nama āgaccha sthāne’tra tvaṃ sthirā bhava ||55 || nama āpāpavatsāmyāmāgachataṃ sthirau tathā | sāvitrīsavitṛbhyāmoṃ nama āgacchataṃ sthirau ||56 || indrajayābhyāṃ nama omāgacchataṃ sthirau tathā | nama oṃ rudrayakṣmabhyāmāgacchataṃ sthirau tathā ||57|| oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ īśāya nama āgacchātra sthiro bhava | parjanyāya jayāyāpīndrāya sūryāya oṃ namaḥ ||58|| satyāya ca namo bhṛśāthākāśāya ca auṃ namaḥ | āgacchāsmin samāgaccha naije sthāne sthiro bhava ||59|| oṃ klīṃ agnaye nama āgaccha sthāne sthiro bhava | pūṣṇe virocanāya auṃ gṛhakṣatāya oṃ namaḥ ||2.143.6 0 || oṃ yamāya namo gandharvāya bhṛṃgāya oṃ namaḥ | oṃ mṛgāya nama āgacchāsmin sthāne sthiro bhava ||61|| oṃ klīṃ śrīṃ pitṛbhyo nama āgacchata sthirāstathā | dauvārikāya ca sugrīvāya namaḥ sthiro bhava ||62|| puṣpadantāya ca varuṇāya namaḥ sthiro bhava | om asurāya śeṣāya pāpāya ca sthiro bhava ||63 || oṃ klīṃ śrīṃ rogāya nama āgacchātra sthiro bhava | oṃ nāgāya ca mukhyāya bhallāṭāya sthiro bhava ||64|| namaḥ somāya śailāyādityai dityai namaḥ sthirā | oṃ cipicchāyai nama āgacchātra tvaṃ sthirā bhava ||655|| oṃ vidāryai ca jaṃbhāyai pūtanāyai ca oṃ namaḥ | skandāyai pāparākṣasyai yamāya oṃ namo’tra ca ||66|| oṃ carakyai nama āgacchātra sthāne sthirā bhava | oṃ śrīmanmahāgaṇādhipataye te namo namaḥ ||27||| iṣṭadevebhyaśca kuladevatābhyo namo namaḥ | sthānavāstudevatābhyaḥ sarvebhyaśca namo namaḥ ||68|| etatkarmapradhānāḍhyadevatābhyo namo namaḥ | kalpe’tra vatsare māse dine madiṣṭasiddhaye ||69|| devāḍhyavāstudevasya kariṣye pūjanaṃ namaḥ | paṃcāmṛtairjalairdevaṃ saṃsnāpya brahmasūtrakam ||2.143.70|| vastraṃ bhūṣā puṣpamālāṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ nivedanam | aṣṭabhyaśca baliṃ cācamanaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tathā ||71|| nīrājanaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavannamanādikam | tata oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kuru kuru svāheti japenmanum ||72|| nama oṃ vāstudevāya caikaviṃśatikaṃ japet | auṃ pūrve hetakabhairavāya namo’tha dakṣiṇe ||73 || ādivaitālabhairavāya namo’tha ca paścime | kālabhairavāya nama uttare’tha namo’stu ca ||74|| ekapādabhairavāya nama om ūrdhvake’tha ca | svacchandabhairavāyāstu nama āgneyako’tha ca ||75|| tripurāntakabhairavāya namo’tha nirṛtyake | agnijihvakabhairavāya namo’tha ca vāyuke ||76|| vāyudevāya namo’theśāne īśānakāya ca | namo’tha oṃ ca pātāle viṣṇave ca namo namaḥ ||77|| arghyaṃ datvā kṣamāṃ prārthayitvā vāstuṃ namet tataḥ | dikpālān kṣetrapālām̐śca gaṇeśaṃ caṇḍikāṃ tathā ||78|| samarcayet tataḥ pratiṣṭhādi sarvaṃ samācaret | oṃ āṃ īṃ klīṃ mahendrāya namaḥ sthāne sthiro bhava ||79|| kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇendrāya svāhā | oṃ hrīṃ hroṃ hrām̐ vahnaye ca namaḥ sthāne sthiro bhava ||2.143.80|| kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇāgnaye svāhā | oṃ krauṃ krauṃ krū kālamūrtaye namo’tra sthiro bhava ||8 1 || kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa namaḥ svāhā | oṃ aiṃ kṣoṃ kṣīṃ mṛtyave ca namaḥ sthāne sthiro bhava ||82|| kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa namaḥ svāhā | o śrāṃ śrīṃ śrūṃ vaṃ viṃ varuṇāya namaḥ sthiro bhava ||83|| kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa namaḥ svāhā | auṃ aiṃ viśvādhināthāya namaḥ sthāne sthiro bhava ||84|| kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa namaḥ svāhā | oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kuberāya ca namaḥ sthāne sthiro bhava ||85||| kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa namaḥ svāhā | oṃ klīṃ klīṃ klūṃ viśvaṃbharāya ca namaḥ sthiro bhava ||86|| kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa namaḥ svāhā | oṃ vrāṃ vrīṃ vrūṃ brahmaṇe ca namaḥ sthāne sthiro bhava ||87|| kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa namaḥ svāhā | oṃ śrāṃ śrīṃ śrīpataye namo’tra sthāne sthiro bhava ||88|| kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa namaḥ svāhā | evaṃ prapūjayet paścāt pratiṣṭhākāryamāvahet ||89|| māghe ca phālgune dhanāyuṣyārogyapradā hi sā | jyeṣṭhe vaiśākhake cāpi pratiṣṭhā dravyaputrahā ||2.143.90 || dakṣiṇāyanage sūrye vārāhaṃ mātṛkāstathā | bhairavaṃ vāmanaṃ devīṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ sthāpayettathā ||9 1 || śrāvaṇe śāṃkaraṃ liṃgamāśvine jagadambikām | mārgaśīrṣe hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pauṣe tu sarvakān ||92|| śanau ravau śaśāṃke ca budhe gurau ca śukrake | dvārocchrāyo’ṣṭadhā kāryaścāṣṭamaṃ parihāya ca || 93|| saptabhāgātmaśākhāyā bhāgatrayaṃ punaścaret | bhāgadvayaṃ pratimā syāt lambeti sarvanirṇayaḥ ||94|| dvāraṃ vibhajya navadhā bhāgaikaṃ ca parityajet| aṣṭabhāgaṃ tridhā kṛtvā dvibhāgā pratimā matā ||95|| gajāccaturgajāntaṃ tu ṣaḍaṃgulā gaje gaje | tato daśagajāntaṃ tu gaje tryaṃgulavardhanam ||96|| pañcāśadgajaparyantamekāṃgulapravardhanam | atra viṃśatyaṃśādhikyai śreṣṭhā prāsādamānataḥ || 97|| prāsādārthapramāṇena kolī jyeṣṭhāpi kathyate | ityevaṃ devatāyana bhavānāste tathāvidhaḥ ||98|| mandiraṃ mama rūpaṃ vai śṛṇu te rūpamarthavat | prāsādo devarūpo’sti pādau pādaśilāḥ smṛtāḥ || 99|| jaṃghā tu jagatī bodhyā staṃbhā vai jānavaḥ smṛtāḥ | sakthi kammānikā bodhyā meḍhraṃ kuṃbhādadhastalam || 2.143.10 0|| praṇālaṃ tu gudābhāgo ghūmmaṭaścodaraṃ matam | devasthānaṃ nābhitulyaṃ pīṭhikā hṛdayaṃ matam || 101 || pratimā jīva evāsau śikharaṃ vakṣa eva ca | amalasāraḥ kaṇṭhaśca śukanāsastu nāsikā || 10 2|| dīpaścakṣuḥ gavākṣaḥ karṇaḥ skandhaḥ kāyapālikā | kalaśo mastakaṃ dhvajā keśā bhūtāni dhātavaḥ || 103 || pralepo māṃsamevātra medaśca vasudhādravāḥ | asthīni ca śilāḥ sarvā vastraṃ cūrṇapaṭātmakam || 1 04|| evaṃ viddhi svakaṃ dehaṃ devāyatana bhaktarāṭa | ityevaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagāda tam || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pratiṣṭhotsave vāstupuruṣataddevādisthāpanāprabhṛtinirūpaṇanāmā tricatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 143 ||
<2.144> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cāgre pratiṣṭhādividhānakam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yadāha daivatam || 1 || yajamānaḥ prage snātvācāryahaste pradāya ca | pūjāsaṃbhārakān strībhiḥ suvāsinībhiranvitaḥ || 2 || prāsādo’gre maṇḍapasya bhūmimāgatya prāgdiśi | pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvāsane samupaviśya ca || 3 || ācamanaṃ tathā prāṇāyāmaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ param | baddhaśikhaḥ sapatnīko dhyāyan gaṇapatiṃ tataḥ || 4 || prāṅmukho vodaṅmukho vā saṃkīrtya deśakālakau | parameśvaraprītyarthaṃ pratiṣṭhākāryasiddhaye || 5 || gaṇeśapūjanaṃ kuryādācāryavaraṇādikam | pādaprakṣālanaṃ pādapūjanaṃ tasya cācaret || 6 || candrakākṣatapuṣpādyaiḥ samarcya praṇameddhi tam | asya devasya vai ramye prāsāde karmasiddhaye || 7 || pratiṣṭhāsiddhaye maṇḍapādikāryādisiddhaye | bhavantaṃ śrīharerbhaktamācāryatvena saṃvṛṇe || 8 || auṃ vṛto’smītyāvadeccācāryaḥ sarvārthapaṇḍitaḥ | yajamānaśca badhnīyādācāryakarakaṃkaṇam || 9 || ācāryapūjanaṃ kṛtvā bhūmimāvāhayettataḥ | āgaccha sarvakalyāṇi vasudhe’tra sthirā bhava || 2.144.1 0|| āyāhi varade dhātri yajñe’smin śubhadāyini | oṃ mahīrdyoḥ pṛthivī naḥ imaṃ yajñaṃ mimikṣatām || 11 || pipṛtānno bharimabhiḥ sarvarasānvitekṣite | evamāvāhya pṛthivīṃ smṛtvā ca sarvadevatāḥ || 1 2|| oṃ viśve devāsa iha mādayantām oṃ pratiṣṭha | iti kṣitiṃ pratiṣṭhāpya baddhvāñjaliṃ ca prārthayet || 1 3|| yajñabhāgaṃ pratīcchasva praṇamāmi kṣamāṃ kuru | tavopari maṇḍapādi bhaviṣyati makhe hitā || 14|| bhaveti tāṃ namaskṛtya prokṣayet pañcagavyakaiḥ | kuśaiśca haritaiḥ kṛtvā prokṣayecca vadettathā || 15|| omidaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame tredhā nidadhe padam | samūḍhamasya pāṃsure svāhā tvāṃ ca havāmahe || 16|| oṃ śanno mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ śanno bhavatvaryamā | śaṃ na indro bṛhaspatiḥ śanno viṣṇururukramaḥ || 17|| oṃ devasya tvāṃ savituḥ prasavena tathāśvinoḥ | bāhubhyāṃ ca karābhyāṃ ca pūṣṇo vācā sarojuṣaḥ || 18|| agneḥ sāmrājyakenābhiṣiñcāmi prokṣitāsi bhūḥ | ityuktvā ca gṛhītvā ca śvetasarṣapakān kare || 1 9|| īśānābhimukho vikiret tataḥ sarvatomukham | oṃ bhūtāni rākṣasā vā yatra tiṣṭhanti kecana ||2.144.20|| te sarve’pyapasarpantu viṣṇuyāgasya bhūmitaḥ | bhūtapretapiśācādyāścāpakrāmantu dūrataḥ ||21 || apasarpantu te bhūtā ye bhūtā bhūmisaṃsthitāḥ | ye bhūtā vighnakartāraste’payāntu harājñayā ||22|| ityabhidhāya sarvatra vikīrya śvetasarṣapān | saṃprokṣya pañcagavyena dadyādarghyaṃ bhuve yathā ||23|| gandhadūrvāphalapuṣpayavānvitaṃ jalaṃ śubham | tāmrapātre gṛhītvaiva dhṛtaśuklāmbaradvayaḥ || 24|| udaṅmukhaścārghyahasto’rghyaṃ dadyāt sukṛtāñjaliḥ | gṛhāṇārghyaṃ jaganmātaḥ prasannā bhava sarvadā ||25|| evaṃ sampūjya pṛthivīṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāya ca | bhadrapīṭhe cārcya vāstuṃ prācīṃ saṃsādhayed diśam ||26|| samānāyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ vai gaṇeśaṃ śrīguruṃ tathā | yajan mānasopacārairdhyāyecca kuladevatām ||27|| viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ datvā toṣayitvā tu śilpinam | kuryādvai maṇḍapaṃ ṣoḍaśahastaṃ dvādaśātmakam ||28|| daśahastaṃ cāṣṭahastaṃ yathāvakāśakaṃ ca vā | tatra kuṇḍaṃ pūrvavacca yathoktaṃ pravidhāya ca ||29|| tata uttaravedyāśca catuṣkoṇeṣu sarvathā | īśakoṇe grahapīṭhaṃ catustriṃśāṃgulātmakam ||2.144.3 0|| agno hastaṃ mātṛpīṭhaṃ dvādaśāṃgulakocchrayam | nairṛte vāstupīṭhaṃ ca hastaṃ dvādaśakocchrayam ||3 1|| vāyau ca yoginīkṣetrapālapīṭhaṃ tu hastakam | dvādaśāṃgulakordhvaṃ ca prakuryādvā yathocitam || 32|| aṣṭahastamitāyāstu dhārāyā vai ghṛtasya ca | kṛte pūrvasthale ramyaśilāropaṇamityapi ||3 3|| iṣṭikānāṃ ca vā bhittirvidheyā śobhanā tadā | toraṇaiśca patākābhiścaturasraṃ tu maṇḍapam ||34|| prāguktarūpaṃ kṛtvaiva taduttare’pi maṇḍapam | snapanārthaṃ ca kṛtvaiva kuryācca vedikātrayam ||35|| yathāyogyān maṇḍapām̐ścādyadine saṃvidhāya ca | haviṣyabhojanaḥ syādvai yajamānaḥ supuṇyavān || 36|| rātrau bhūśayano bhūtvā brahmacārī susāttvikaḥ | prātaścādhivāsane’hni snātvā tīrthodakaistataḥ ||37|| prāyaścittasya muktyarthaṃ pāpadhenuṃ samarpayet | adyāsmin divase devaprāsādakarmayogyatā ||38|| mayi syāditi lābhārthaṃ pāpānāṃ nuttaye tathā | pāpadhenuṃ brāhmaṇāya dadāmīti samarpayet ||39|| snātvā punastīrthajalaiḥ sarvauṣadhisamanvitaiḥ | pañcagavyayutaiścāpi vāruṇamantrayojitaiḥ ||2.144.40|| oṃ tvaṃ vāruṇī mūrtirvaruṇotthā hi devatā | vāruṇaṃ sadanaṃ cāsi vahāyurmama śobhanam ||41 || tava pāśāḥ prayāntyeva dūraṃ yajñe patantu na | apāśo’haṃ devatābhyo dāsye havyaṃ vidhehi tat ||42|| iti snātvā śuklapaṭe dhṛtvā gandhānulepanaḥ | śuklamālyāmbaradharaḥ patnīyuto’tisāttvikaḥ ||43|| yajamānaḥ sarvasaṃbhārān dhṛtvā śilpibhūmitaḥ | prādakṣiṇyena daivaṃ vai samānīya sugītibhiḥ ||44|| vāditraninadaiścāpi strīṇāṃ maṃgalagītibhiḥ | śāntipāṭhaiḥ saha caivāgatya maṇḍapasannidhau ||45|| praviśya paścimadvāreṇāsane sannidhāya ca | devaṃ tato yajamāno dakṣiṇadvārasannidhau ||46|| paścime bhadrapīṭhe prāgagradarbheṣu prāṅmukhaḥ | udaṅmukhaḥ sapatnīkaścopāviśet tataḥ param ||47|| saṃbhārān yajñīyakām̐śca dakṣapārśve nidhāpayet | kathayāmi samāsena saṃbhārān vividhān yathā ||48|| pratyekasamidhāmaṣṭottaraśataṃ samarjayet | arkamudumbaraṃ pippalakaṃ vaṭaṃ ca tūlasīm ||49|| apāmārgaṃ palāśaṃ cāmalakīṃ yajñabhūruhān | candanaṃ śiṃśapāṃ bilvaṃ pippalīṃ yajñabhūruhān ||2.144.50|| tilānevaṃvidhān yathāprāpyān samarjayed drumān | bhadrapīṭhatrayaṃ rakṣet puṣpamālāḥ phulāni ca ||51 || kuṃkumaṃ candanadravaṃ kastūrīṃ ghanasārakam | aguruṃ guggulaṃ dhūpaṃ dhūpapātraṃ ca darpaṇam ||52|| ghaṇṭāṃ ca pādukāmārārtrikaṃ balikaṇān balim | pāyasaṃ bhakṣyabhojye ca naivedyaṃ ca phalāni ca ||53|| pūgīphalāni tāmbūlaṃ cājyaṃ tilā yavākṣatāḥ | śarkarā ca phalaśreṣṭhānyapi śrīphalakāni ca ||54|| drākṣāśca kadalānyeva navaraṃgādikānyapi | catvāro viṣṭarāḥ pratikuṇḍaṃ sruksruvakau tathā ||55|| āsanāni kuṃkumāktatrisūtrī śobhanā tathā | śvetorṇāsūtrakaṃ cātha sarvatobhadralabdhaye ||56|| śvetaraktanīlapītakṛṣṇaraṃgāni yāni ca | tathā snapanakalaśāḥ pallavāḥ pañcajātikāḥ ||57|| kadalīstambhavaryāśca patākā daśasaṃkhyakāḥ | dhvajāsteṣāṃ veṇudaṇḍā eko madhyadhvajastathā ||58|| vajramauktikavaiḍūryaśaṃkhasphaṭikapuṣpakāḥ | indranīlamahānīlāścāṣṭaratnāni yāni ca ||59|| manaśśilāharitālābhrakakṛṣṇāṃjanāni ca | mākṣikakāsīsasvarṇamākṣikagairikāstathā ||2.144.6 0|| dhātvaṣṭakaṃ ca tat sarvaṃ rakṣayed yajñakarmaṇe | yavagodhūmanīvāramudgaśyāmākasarṣapāḥ ||61 || tilavrīhaya evaitatad bījāṣṭakaṃ ca sannyaset | suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ sīsakaṃ trapu cāyasam ||62|| raṃgaṃ rītirdhātvaṣṭakaṃ rakṣayed yajñakarmaṇe | madhuparkasya pātraṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ tāmrameva vā ||63|| arghapātraṃ suvarṇasya śalākāṃ rakṣayet tathā | kanakaṃ kuliśaṃ nīlaṃ padmarāgaṃ ca mauktikam ||64|| tāni kalaśaratnāni sthāpayennijapārśvake | ṣoḍaśadvārakalaśān aṣṭau tu lokapāghaṭān ||65|| caturo vedikalaśān vāstughaṭaṃ prarakṣayet | kuṇḍasaṃkhyakakalaśān nidrāyāḥ kalaśaṃ tathā ||66 || snapanaikāśītighaṭān śarāvām̐ścāpi tāvataḥ | dhārāsahasrakalaśau rājasthānasya mṛttikām ||67|| aśvasthānamṛdaṃ cāpi valmīkamṛttikāṃ tathā | saṃgamamṛttikāṃ kūladvayamṛdaṃ varāhajām ||68|| mṛdaṃ rājadvāramṛdaṃ rakṣayedaṣṭamṛttikāḥ | murāmāṃsīvacākuṣṭhaśaileyaharidrāstathā ||69|| dāruharidrāśuṇṭhīcampakamustāḥ sarvauṣadhīḥ | rakṣayeccāpi pañcagavyakaṃ pṛthak pṛthak tathā ||2.144.70|| vrīhiyavatilagodhūmaśyāmākanivārakān | mudgāniti ca saptāpi dhānyāni rakṣayettathā ||71 || śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ śvetacchatraṃ ca cāmaradvayam | vicitraṃ tu vitānaṃ ca trīn vai dukūlapaṭṭakān ||72|| ṛtvigvaraṇasāmagrīrudvartanārthadravyakam | goghṛtaṃ ca gośṛṃgodakaṃ tīrthodakaṃ ca kambukam ||73||| śilpideyāni vastrāṇi sugandhitailamityapi | netrāñjanārthakaṃ pātraṃ sindūraṃ rakṣayet tathā ||74|| āmrasatpatramālāśca devamūrtīśca kānakīḥ | nārikelaphalādīni rakṣayed yajñamaṇḍape ||75|| etān sarvān susaṃbhārān nije tu dakṣiṇe sthale | sthāpayitvācamanaṃ ca prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāya ca ||76 || gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe haste jalaṃ darbhādikaṃ tathā | om prapunātu padmākṣo nārāyaṇo hariḥ prabhuḥ ||77|| ityuktvā sarvasaṃbhārān prokṣya cātmānamityapi | gaṇeśādīn surān smṛtvā kuryāt saṃkalpamityamum ||78|| brahmāṇḍe’tra sthale viprasannidhau vatsare’muke | māsapakṣatithau vāre sarvapāpakṣayāya vai ||79|| uddhartuṃ pūrvajām̐ścāhaṃ sampadāyuṣyalabdhaye | bhuktimuktisulābhārthaṃ mūrtau devāgamāya ca ||2.144.80 || yathāśakti pratiṣṭhāṃ śrīharervānyasurasya ca | saṃkariṣye tadaṃgākhyaṃ śrīgaṇeśādipūjanam ||8 1 || svastipuṇyāhavācaśca mātṛkāpūjanaṃ tathā | nāndīśrāddhaṃ tathācāryavaraṇaṃ viprapūjanam ||82|| kariṣye iti saṃkalpya jalaṃ bhūmau samutsṛjet | sumukhaścaikadantaśca kapilo gajakarṇakaḥ ||83 || lambodaraśca vikaṭo vighnanāśo vināyakaḥ | dhūmraketurgaṇādhyakṣo bhālacandro gajānanaḥ ||84|| dvādaśaitāni nāmāni mama rūpasya vai paṭhet | saśuṇḍhaṃ ca triśūlāḍhyaṃ patnīputrayutaṃ gaṇam ||85|| prasannaṃ sāyudhaṃ dhyāyed vighnānāṃ vāraṇāya ca | evaṃ dhyātvā gaṇeśaṃ ca pūjayed bahuvastubhiḥ ||86|| he heramba tvamehyehi lakṣalābhayutastviha | siddhibuddhipate tvehi sarvāyudhasamanvitaḥ ||87|| āvāhayāmi pūjārthaṃ rakṣārthaṃ ca makhasya me | āgaccha ca bhava svārṇāsane sthiraḥ prarakṣa naḥ ||88|| gaṇānāṃ ca patiṃ priyapatiṃ nidhipatiṃ tathā | havāmahe vasātraiva śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śāṃkaro’si ca ||89|| āhamajāni garbhadhamātvamajāsigarbhadham | siddhibuddhiyutaṃ cāvāhayāmi gaṇanāyakam ||2.144.90|| sampratiṣṭhāpayāmyāsye sauvarṇe gṛhṇa cāsanam | pādyaṃ jalaṃ gṛhāṇāpi sugandhi nirmalaṃ śubham ||9 1 || tāmrapātragataṃ toyamarghyaṃ gṛhāṇa siddhikṛt | ācamanaṃ tīrthajalaṃ gṛhāṇa gaṇanāyaka || 92|| payaḥsnānaṃ gṛhāṇaitad dadhisnānaṃ gṛhāṇa ca | ghṛtasnānaṃ gṛhāṇāpi madhusnānaṃ gṛhāṇa ca ||93|| gṛhāṇa śarkarāsnānaṃ gṛhāṇodvartanaṃ tathā | tīrthajalaiḥ śuddhavārisnānaṃ kuru gaṇeśvara ||94|| vāsāṃsi dhāraya yajñopavītaṃ svīkuru prabho | candanaṃ cākṣatān ramyapuṣpāṇi pratigṛhyatām ||95|| durvāṃkurāṇi ramyāṇi dhūpaṃ ca pratigṛhyatām | dīpaṃ ghṛtāktamevāpi naivedyaṃ laḍḍukādikam ||96|| phalānyācamaṃ cāpi jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tathā | dakṣiṇā gṛhyatāṃ devārārtrikaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||97|| puṣpāṃjalirgṛhyatāṃ ca pradakṣiṇāṃ karomi te | viśeṣārghyaṃ phalayuktaṃ prāpyātra varado bhava ||98|| namaste gajaśuṇḍhāya kṛṣṇarūpāya te namaḥ | nirvighnaṃ kuru me deva sarvakāryaṃ makhādikam || 99|| anayā pūjayā sāṃgaḥ prīyatāṃ me gaṇādhipaḥ | iti sampūjya ca tataścaret puṇyāhavācanam || 2.144.100 || ityevaṃ rādhike’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | devāyatanakaṃ bhaktaṃ cāha te kathitaṃ tu tat || 101 || paṭhanācchravaṇādasya pūjanasya phalaṃ labhet | nirvighnaṃ jāyate śroturvaktuḥ kāryaṃ phalānvitam || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mūrtipratiṣṭhotsave ācāryavaraṇayajñasāmagrīsamarjanagaṇeśapūjanādinirūpaṇanāmā catuścatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 144 ||
<2.145> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca athāpi rādhike cāgre kalaśasthāpanādikam | kathayāmi yadāha śrīharirdevāyataṃ munim || 1 || kalaśaṃ jalasampannaṃ phalaratnādirājitam | nijayoḥ karayordhṛtvā śiraso’gre tato bhuvi || 2 || vakreṇa jānunā cārdhaṃ niṣadya dakṣiṇena tu | kareṇa dhārayitvā saṃsthāpayed vidhinā sthale || 3 || tato vipraiśca puṇyāhaṃ vācayed yajamānakaḥ | yajamānavacaḥprativaco dadhuśca bhūsurāḥ || 4 || me puṇyāhaṃ dīrghamāyurastu te brūma eva tat | śivā āpaḥ santu ceti saumanasyaṃ tathāstu ca || 5 || akṣatāriṣṭamastveva saumāṃgalyaṃ tathāstu ca | pāntu gandhāstathā pāntu cākṣatā āyurastu ca || 6 || pāntu puṣpāṇi cāstveva sauśriyaṃ siddhirastu ca | pāntu tāmbūlāni cāstvaiśvaryaṃ pāntu ca dakṣiṇāḥ || 7 || astu dhanaṃ bahuvidhaṃ śrīrastu cāstu sadyaśaḥ | vidyāvinayavittādi cāstu cāyuṣyamityapi || 8 || bahuputrādimattvaṃ ca dīrghamāyuḥ samastu te śāntiḥ puṣṭiścāstu tuṣṭiryajamānasya sarvadā || 9 || ityuccāryābhisiñceyuryajamānasya mūrdhani | bhadraṃ karṇe śṛṇuyāma bhadraṃ paśyema cakṣuṣā || 2.145.1 0|| stutiyogyaṃ tanu prāpnuyāma devahitaṃ sadā | devā bhadraṃ bhāvayantu cārātiśca nivartatām || 11 || devasakhyaṃ sadā cāstu tathāyuḥ kālavarjitam | draviṇaṃ puṣkalaṃ cāstu savitāvatu sarvataḥ || 12|| candraścāyuścāmṛtaṃ ca dadātvasmai sudaivatam | hiraṇyadā vasavo’sya yajamānasya santu vai || 13|| ityāśīrvādapātraṃ tvaṃ yajamāno vivardhatām | samāhitāntaḥ karaṇāḥ prasannāḥ smo’stu śāntikā || 14|| puṣṭistuṣṭirvṛddhirastu cāvighnāyuṣyamastu ca | ārogyaṃ śivakarmāstu samṛddhirastu karmaṇām || 15|| vedaśāstrasaṃhitānāṃ jñānasmṛddhiḥ sadāstu te | dhanadhānyaputrapautrasmṛddhirastviṣṭasampadām || 15|| ariṣṭanāśanaṃ cāstu dūre’stu rogapāpakam | akalyāṇaṃ hataṃ te’stu śreyo’stu sarvabhāvitam || 17|| uttare karmaṇi nirvighnatvaṃ cāstu sadā tava | śubhāśca saphalāḥ santu kriyāste cottarodbhavāḥ || 18|| tithyādayaḥ śubhāḥ santu jalasekena te sadā | tithyādyadhisurāḥ sarve prīyantāṃ jalasekataḥ || 1 9|| prīyetāṃ tithikaraṇe durgāpāñcālike tathā | prīyantāṃ viśvadevāśca prīyantāṃ ca marudgaṇāḥ ||2.145.20 || umāmātaraḥ prīyantāṃ prīyantāmekapatnikāḥ | prīyantāṃ sarvadevāśca prīyantāṃ vedamūrtayaḥ || 21 || prīyantāṃ brāhmaṇā brahma prīyetāṃ śāradāśriyau | śraddhāmedhe suprīyetāṃ kātyāyanī ca prīyatām ||22|| māheśvarī prīyatāṃ ca ṛddhikarī ca prīyatām | siddhikarī prīyatāṃ ca puṣṭikarī ca prīyatām ||23|| tuṣṭikarī prīyatāṃ ca prīyantāṃ kuladevatāḥ | prīyetāṃ bhagavantau ca tathā vighnavināyakau ||24|| prīyantāṃ grāmadevāśca hatāste paripanthinaḥ | brahmadviṣo hatāścāpi vighnadāśca hatāstathā || 25|| śatravaśca hatāḥ sarve śāmyantu ghoramūrtayaḥ | śāmyantu pāpapuñjāśca śāmyantu tava cetayaḥ ||26|| vardhantāṃ śubhakāryāṇi santu cāpaḥ śivāstu te | śivā āhutayaḥ santu syātāṃ śive niśādine ||27|| kāmaṃ varṣatu parjanyo hyoṣadhayaḥ phalānvitāḥ | yogakṣemau bhavetāṃ te prīyantāṃ gṛhadevatāḥ || 28|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśca prīyatāṃ tathā | parjanyaḥ prīyatāṃ svāmī prīyatāṃ kārtikastathā ||29|| brāhmaḥ kālaśca puṇyāhaḥ sadā te’stu śubhakriyaḥ | astu devapratiṣṭhākarmaṇaḥ puṇyāhameva te ||2.145.3 0|| punantu māṃ devadevāḥ punantu mānasaṃ dhiyam | punantu viśvābhūtāni jātavedaḥ punīhi mām ||3 1 || pṛthivyāmuddhṛtāyāṃ ca kalyāṇaṃ tu bruvantu me | oṃ kalyāṇaṃ maharddhiṃ ca bruvantu brāhmaṇā mama || 32|| satrarddhi mama ca jyotiramṛtaṃ svaḥ bruvantu me | svastiṃ vṛddhiṃ bruvantveva santu brūmaśca bhūsurāḥ ||33|| svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ | svasti nastārkṣyo’riṣṭanemiḥ svanti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu ||34|| haripriyā svastimatī svastiṃ karotu sarvadā | omastu śrīśca te lakṣmīḥ patnyau nārāyaṇasya vai ||35|| evaṃ puṇyāhavācaśca santu pūrṇā bhūsūriṇām | tataścābhiṣekakarma pātre tu kalaśodakam ||36|| dhṛtvā viprāśca catvāro dūrvāmrapallavādibhiḥ | yajamānamabhiṣiñceyuśca tvāṃ prapunantviti ||37|| punantu māṃ devajanāḥ punantu tīrthasāgarāḥ | pañcanadyo jātavedo punantyete yajisthitam ||38|| sāmrājyenābhiṣiñcāmi vācāṃ tvāṃ tu yajisthitam | bhaiṣajyenābhiṣiñcāmi tejasā brahmavarcasā ||39|| aindriyeṇābhiṣiñcāmīndrasya tvāṃ tu yajisthitam | viśvāni devasavitardurītāni parāsuva |||2.145.40|| makhasatre tu sarveṣāṃ yad bhadraṃ tanna āsuva | oṃ dyauḥ śāntirantarikṣaṃ śāntiścādhyātmikī tava ||41 || anena vācanenātra prīyatāṃ vai prajāpatiḥ | evaṃ vai rādhike puṇyāhavāguttarame ca ||42|| mātṛkāpūjanaṃ kuryāttvagnikoṇe supīṭhake | akṣatānāṃ prapuñjeṣu yadvā pūgīphaleṣu ca ||43|| gaurī padmā śacī medhā sāvitrī vijayā jayā | devasenā svadhā svāhā mātaro lokamātaraḥ ||44|| hṛṣṭiḥ puṣṭistathā tuṣṭirātmanaḥ kuladevatā | gaṇeśaśceti sampūjyā vṛddhāvetā hi ṣoḍaśa ||45|| rādhā lakṣmīrmāṇikī ca brahmavidyāramāratiḥ | suguṇā maṃjulā haṃsā lalitā kambharā satī ||46|| santoṣā kamalā durgā śāradārcyāśca ṣoḍaśa | gaṇeśāya nama omāvāhayāmi gaṇādhipam ||47|| oṃ gauryai ca namo gaurīmāvāhayāmi te namaḥ | oṃ padmāyai namaḥ padmāmāvāhayāmi te namaḥ ||48|| oṃ śacyai ca namaḥ śacīmāvāhayāmi te namaḥ | oṃ medhāyai namo medhāmāvāhayāmi te namaḥ ||49|| oṃ sāvitryai namaḥ sāvitrikāmāvāhayāmi ca | vijayāyai namaścāvāhayāmi vijayāṃ namaḥ ||2.145.50|| oṃ jayāyai namo jayāmāvāhayāmi te namaḥ | namaḥ śrīdevasenāyai senāmāvāhayāmi ca ||51 || oṃ svadhāyai namaḥ svadhāmāvāhayāmi te namaḥ | oṃ svāhāyai namaḥ svāhāmāvāhayāmi te namaḥ ||52|| oṃ mātṛbhyo namo mātṝrāvāhayāmi vai namaḥ | namo vai lokamātṛbhyo nama āvāhayāmi tāḥ ||53 || hṛṣṭyai namaścāvāhayāmyo puṣṭyai ca namastathā | āvāhayāmi tāṃ tuṣṭyai nama āvāhayāmi ca ||54|| namaḥ śrīkuladevyai cāvāhayāmi namo’stu te | oṃ rādhāyai namaścāvāhayāmi pratinaumi tām ||55|| oṃ śrīlakṣmyai nama āvāhayāmi praṇamāmi tām | oṃ māṇikyai nama āvāhayāmi praṇamāmi tām ||66|| oṃ brahmavidyāyai namaścāvāhayāmi praṇamāmi tām | ramāratyai namaścāvāhayāmyasyai namo namaḥ ||57|| oṃ śriyaṃ cāvāhayāmi śrīdevyai namo namaḥ | oṃ suguṇāṃ nama āvāhayāmyasyai namo namaḥ ||58|| mañjulāyai nama āvāhayāmyasyai namo namaḥ | haṃsāyai ca nama āvāhayāmyasyā namo’stu ca |||99|| lalitāyai nama āvāhayāmyasyai namo namaḥ | kaṃbharāyai nama āvāhayāmyasyā namo’stu ca ||2.145.60 || oṃ satyai nama āvāhayāmyasyai ca namo namaḥ | santoṣāyai nama āvāhayāmyasyai namo namaḥ ||6 1 || kamalāyai nama āvāhayāmyasyai namo namaḥ | oṃ durgāyai nama āvāhayāmyasyai namo namaḥ ||62|| śāradāyai namaścāvāhayāmyasyai namo’stu ca | ityāvāhya pratiṣṭhāpya pūjayedupacārakaiḥ ||63|| prīyantāṃ pūjayā devā devyastuṣyantu mātaraḥ | kuṇḍasthamātṛkāmūrdhni ghṛtadhārāṃ dadāmi ca ||64|| brāhmī māheśvarī cāpi kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā | vārāhī ca tathendrāṇī cāmuṇḍā ghṛtadhārayā ||65|| sahadhārayā tuṣṭā bhavantu varadāstathā | pādyādibhiḥ pūjayecca dhārā divyā balapradāḥ ||66 || tathānyāḥ ṣoḍaśadevīḥ pūjayed ghṛtadhārayā | nāndīśrāddhaṃ prakuryācca krameṇācamanādinā ||67|| prāṇānāyamya ca kālaṃ deśaṃ saṃkalpya vai tataḥ | asya devasya ca pratiṣṭhānakarmasu vastubhiḥ ||68 || nāndīśrāddhaṃ kariṣye’haṃ vighnādivinivṛttaye | nāndīmukhāḥ satyavasusaṃjñakā viśvadevatāḥ ||69|| oṃ bhūrmuvaḥ sva idaṃ vaḥ pādyaṃ pādāvanejanam | pādaprakṣālanaṃ vṛddhiścāstu mātā pitāmahī ||2.145.70|| prapitāmahikā caitā nāndīmukhyo bhavanti yāḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva idaṃ vaḥ pādyaṃ pādāvanejanam ||71 || pādaprakṣālanaṃ vṛddhiścāstu pitā pitāmahaḥ | prapitāmaha evaite nāndīmukhā bhavanti ye ||72|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva idaṃ vaḥ pādyaṃ pādāvanejanam | pādaprakṣālanaṃ vṛddhiścāstu sarvā tataḥ param ||73 || mātāmahaḥ pramātāmaho vṛddhapramātāmahaḥ | sapatnīkā nāndīmukhā ye ca ye ca bhavanti te ||74|| oṃ bhūrbhuva sva idaṃ vaḥ pādyaṃ pādāvanejanam | pādaprakṣālanaṃ vṛddhiścāstu dadāmi cāsanam ||75|| satyavasusaṃjñakebhyo viśvedevebhya ityapi | nāndīmukhebhya oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva idaṃ sukhāsanam ||76|| svadhā vo’stu nāndīśrāddhekṣaṇau kriyetāmoṃ tathā | svīkurutāṃ bhavantau ca prāpnuvaśca sukhānvitau ||77|| mātṛpitāmahīprapitāmahīnāṃ sukhāsanam | āsādayatāṃ vaḥ svāhāsādayāvaḥ sukhāvaham ||78|| pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahānāṃ sukhāsanam | āsādayatāṃ vaḥ svāhāsādayāmaḥ sukhāvaham ||79|| mātāmahapramātāmahavṛddhapramātāmahāḥ | va āsanaṃ svadhā vo bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sukhāvaham ||2.145.80|| gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dīyate ca satyavasubhya eva ca | viśvebhyo nāndīmukhyebhya idaṃ gandhādikārcanam ||81 || sampadyantāmiha vṛddhiḥ svadhā bhavanta eva ca | mātṛpitāmahīprapitāmahībhya eva ca ||82|| idaṃ gandhādyarcanaṃ ca svāhā vṛddhiḥ samastu ca | pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahebhya eva ca ||83|| idaṃ gandhādyarcanaṃ ca svadhā vṛddhiḥ samastu ca | mātāmahapramātāmahavṛddhapramātāmahāḥ ||84|| sastrībhyo va idaṃ gandhārcanaṃ svadhāstu vṛddhikā | ityevamarcanaṃ datvā bhojanasya tu niṣkrayaḥ ||85|| dravyaṃ dadyāt satyavasu viśvedevebhya eva ca | yugmabhojanaparyāptamannamamṛtamarpitam ||86|| svadhā sampadyatāṃ vṛddhirāyustejaḥpradā śubhā | mātṛpitāmahīprapitāmahībhya eva ca ||87|| yugmabhojanaparyāptamannamamṛtamarpitam | svadhā sampadyatāṃ vṛddhiḥ hiraṇyadakṣiṇāyutam ||88|| pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahebhyo’pi caiva ha | yugmabhojanaparyāptamannamamṛtamarpitam ||89|| svadhā sampadyatāṃ vṛddhirhiraṇyadakṣiṇāyutam | mātāmahapramātāmahavṛddhapramātāmahāḥ ||2.145.90|| sastrībhyo va idaṃ bhojyaṃ paryāptāmṛtamarpitam | svadhā sampadyatāṃ vṛddhirhiraṇyadakṣiṇāyutam ||91| dadāmi dakṣiṇāṃ drākṣāmalakayavaniṣkrayām | nāndīśrāddhaphalapūrvyai sasyavasubhya eva ca ||92||| mātṛpitāmahīprapitāmahībhyo’pi caiva ha | nāndīśrāddhaphalapūrttyai dadāmi dakṣiṇāṃ tathā ||93|| pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahebhyo’pi caiva ha | nāndīśrāddhaphalapūrttyai dadāmi dakṣiṇāṃ tathā ||94|| mātāmahapramātāmahavṛddhapramātāmahāḥ | sastrībhyo vo dadāmyatra dakṣiṇāṃ niṣkrayātmikām ||95|| nāndīśrāddhaphalapūrtyai drākṣāmalakamārdrakam | phalapratiṣṭhāsiddhyarthaṃ gṛhṇantu cotsṛjāmi ca ||96|| nāndīśrāddhaṃ susampannaṃ paṭhitvārpyaṃ ca dakṣiṇām | viśvedevāḥ prīyantāmomiti devavisarjanam || 97|| nāndīmukhā mātaraśca prīyantāṃ tadvisarjanam | nāndīmukhāḥ pitaraśca prīyantāṃ tadvisarjanam ||98|| nāndīmukhā mātāmahāḥ prīyantāṃ tadvisarjanam | anuvrajya ca viprāṇāṃ vacanāt paripūrṇakaḥ || 99|| śrāddhavidhirnāndīmukhaprāsādāt paripūrṇakaḥ | astu vai paripūrṇo’yaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ vaco’nugaḥ || 2.145.10 0|| ityevaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ | devāyatanakāyāha vidhiṃ mayoditastu te || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pratiṣṭhotsave kalaśasthāpanapuṇyāhavācanamātṛkādyāvāhananāndīśrāddhāsanapūjanabhojanadakṣiṇādānavisarjanādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 145||
<2.146> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike caivaṃ nāndīśrāddhottaraṃ tu yat | bhaktāya bhagavānāhācāryādivaraṇaṃ yathā || 1 || ometasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ kartavyāyāṃ tu karmasu | ācāryatvena vipraṃ tvā vṛṇe gandhākṣatādibhiḥ || 2 || puṣpatāmbūlamudrābhirvāsobhiścāsmi oṃ vṛtaḥ | taṃ prapūjya tato brahmavaraṇaṃ saṃvidhāpayet || 3 || ometasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ kartavyāyāṃ tu karmasu | kṛtākṛtekṣātmasu brahmasthāne tvāmahamāvṛṇe || 4 || gandhapuṣpākṣatatāmbūlakamudrāmbarādibhiḥ | brahmatvena vṛto’smīti brahmāsmi vai kratau tava || 5 || taṃ prapūjya ṛtvijo’ṣṭau caturo vṛṇuyācca vā | asya devasya ca pratiṣṭhāyāṃ vedavido’tra ca || 6 || amukān vo vṛṇe ṛtviktvena gandhādibhistviha | oṃ vṛttāḥ sma iti tān saṃpūjya gandhākṣatādibhiḥ || 7 || aṣṭau vā caturo dvārapālān saṃvṛṇuyānmakhī | ekaikavedinau dvau dvau jāpakau vṛṇuyānmakhī || 8 || bhavanti ṛtvijaścaivaṃ pañcaviśaṃtisaṃkhyakāḥ | yadvāśaktau vṛṇuyādvai tathā hotraṣṭakaṃ punaḥ || 9 || jāpakān caturo dvārapālacatuṣṭayaṃ gurum | evaṃ vai ṛtvijaḥ saptadaśāpyapi bhavanti hi || 2.146.1 0|| yadvā hotṝm̐śca caturo jāpakām̐ścaturastathā | caturo dvārapālām̐śca guruṃ ceti trayodaśa || 11 || yadvācāryaṃ tathā brahmāṇameva vṛṇuyānmakhī | dvābhyāṃ sarvaṃ yajñakarma nivartate na saṃśayaḥ || 12|| rājā tu śatasāhasrān vṛṇuyācca yathābalam | tato’rcayecca vidhinā gurvādīn varaṇakramāt || 13|| madhuparkeṇārcayedvai miṣṭena pāyasādinā | bhaghuparko bahuvidho miṣṭāmblapāyasādijaḥ || 14|| atha viprān prārthayecca makhī prāñjalirutthitaḥ | brāhmaṇāḥ santu me śāntāḥ sarvapāpanivārakāḥ || 15|| dānayajñajapahomairyājakāstṛptidāyakāḥ | pitṝṇāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca vedamūrtaya eva te || 16|| rakṣantu jāpakā māṃ ca ṛddhiṃ vṛddhiṃ dadatvapi | yāganiṣpattaye viprā vṛtāḥ kurvantu śāntikam || 17|| pauṣṭikaṃ ca prakurvantu niyame saṃsthitāḥ dvijāḥ | evaṃ viprān susamprārthyācāryaṃ saṃprārthayenmakhī || 18|| mantramūrtirbhavānāste kuru dharmonnatiṃ mama | tvatprasādena yajño’yaṃ nirvighno vai samāpyatām || 19|| evaṃ samprārthya ca tataḥ sasutthāya makhī svayam | gṛhītvā yogyasambhārān kṛtvāgrataḥ suvāsinīḥ ||2.146.20|| viprāṃstathāgrataḥ kṛtvā tūryaghoṣe pravartite | pūrṇakuṃbhasamāyukto yajamāno hi maṇḍapam ||2 1 || kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ prāpya paścimadvārameva tu | pāṇibhyāṃ cārghapātraṃ vai samādāya sthito bhavet ||22|| sārgho dvāre pṛthivīṃ ca dhyātvā kūrmoparisthitām | śuklāṃ padmaśaṃkhacakraśūlayuktacaturbhujām || 23|| savatsāṃ gorūpadharāṃ cāgaccha vasudhe tviha | gṛhāṇa phalapuṣpāṇi pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa matkṛtām ||24|| yajñārthaṃ bhagavatpatnīṃ tvāṃ vṛṇomīha vaiṣṇavīm | saubhāgyaṃ dehi putrām̐śca dhanaṃrūpaṃ pradehi ca ||25|| gṛhāṇārghyaṃ ca me devi susaubhāgyaṃ prayaccha me | ityaṣṭāṃgaṃ mahārghyaṃ ca datvā natvā tato makhī ||26|| paścimadvāramārgeṇa praviśed yajamānakaḥ | homadravyapraveśastu pūrvadvāreṇa vai mataḥ |||27|| dānadravyapraveśastu dakṣadvāreṇa vai mataḥ | dānārthān dakṣiṇārthāṃśca pratiṣṭhārthān supāvanān ||28|| saṃbhārānuttaradvāreṇaiva praveśayenmakhī | ācāryastu tato vāme haste vai gaurasarṣapān ||29|| lājāyuktān gṛhītvā ca kuryādvai dikprarakṣaṇam | oṃ rakṣohaṇaṃ valagaṃ cotkirāmi samantataḥ ||2.146.3 0|| aniṣṭānutkhana sarvān valaga tvāṃ kirāmi ca | rakṣohaṇo valagāḥ prokṣayāmi vaiṣṇavān balān ||3 1 || tṛṇāmyupadadhāmyatroparyūhāmi samantataḥ | rakṣobhāgo nirasto’sti rakṣobādho na vai bhavet ||32|| rakṣohā viśvacarṣaṇirabhiyonimayohate | droṇesadhaḥ sthalaṃ puṣṭaṃ samāsadat vinirbhayam ||33|| bhūmibhūtā vighnarūpā asarpantvitaḥ sthalāt | apakramantu bhūtāni piśācāḥ sarvato diśaḥ ||34|| yajñakarmavirodhyatra bhūtaṃ sthitaṃ sthale’tra vai | sthānaṃ vihāya cānyatra prayāntvastu ca śāntidam ||35|| pretādyāścāpagacchantu svīkaromi bhuvaṃ tvimām | karomi śāntikaṃ cātra kirāmīśānataḥ kramāt ||36|| āyāntvatra surā yātudhānādyā apayāntu ca | devayajanaṃ kṣetraṃ tvaṃ rakṣa viṣṇo’ntare sthita ||37|| iti rakṣāṃ vidhāyaiva pañcagavyena satkuśaiḥ | prokṣayenmaṇḍapabhūmiṃ yajñasaṃbhārakāṃstathā ||38|| hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvikā lokapāvikāḥ | agniṃ yā dadhire garbhe tā āpaḥ pāvayantu naḥ ||39|| vāruṇyo madhusrāviṇyaḥ śaṃsya apo bhavanti yāḥ | yatspṛṣṭaṃ bhakṣyameva syād devānāṃ tāḥ punantu naḥ ||2.146.40 || antarīkṣe pṛthivyāṃ ca śukraṃ yadudbhavaṃ rasam | puṣṭidaṃ sarvadevānāṃ tā āpo naḥ punantviha ||41 || śivena cakṣuṣā paśyatāpo māṃ spṛśatāpi ca | śivayā tanuvā māṃ ca balatejonvitaṃ tathā ||42|| punātu yajñasaṃbhārān pavamāno jalānvitaḥ | punantu manavo devāḥ punantu viśvaāyavaḥ ||43|| agne salila śaktyā te idaṃ brahma punīmahe | vaiścānaro raśmibhirmāṃ vātaḥ prāṇena varcasā ||44|| dyāvāpṛthivī payasā savitā kiraṇairihā | punantu māṃ ca saṃbhārānidaṃ brahma punīmahe ||45|| pāvamānyā pavitraṃ yat tadaśnantyeva devatāḥ | pāvamānyā tu saṃbhārāḥ saṃmatāḥ sadrasaiḥ sadā ||46|| tasmai rasavatī duhe sarvamaśnanti devatāḥ | ṛṣibhiḥ saṃbhṛtarasaṃ kṣīraṃ sarpirmadhūttamam ||47|| brāhmaṇeṣvamṛtaṃ hitaṃ nihitaṃ tacca vastuṣu | pavamānyā pavitreṇa devāścāśnanti bhāvataḥ ||48|| indraḥ somo varuṇaśca yamo rājā pūnantvidam | brahmajātaṃ vastujātaṃ pūtaṃ brahma punīmahe ||49|| ityevaṃ cābhiṣicyaiva āpohiṣṭhāmayo bhuvaḥ | tā na ūrje dadhātana maheraṇāya cakṣase ||2.146.50|| yo vaḥ śreṣṭhatamo miṣṭo rasastadbhājanaṃ vayam | āpastadbhājanaṃ sarvam āpo janayathā rasam ||51|| ityevaṃ sarvasaṃbhārān prokṣya kṛtāñjalirmakhī | tiṣṭhed vipro vadet svastimaśvinau kurutaṃ tava ||52|| aditiste svastimeva pūṣā svastiṃ dadhātu te | dyauḥ kṣitiste svastimeva cinutaḥ svastimaryamā ||53 || vāyuḥ svastiṃ guruḥ svastiṃ vahniḥ svastiṃ karotu te | devyaḥ svastiṃ tathā devāḥ svastiṃ kurvantu te sadā ||54|| svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ | svasti nastārkṣyo’riṣṭanemiḥ svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu ||55|| ityevaṃ svasmimādhatya maṇḍapasyārcanaṃ tathā | kuryādvai vāstupūjāṃ copaviśya vāstusannidhau ||56|| maṇḍapanairṛtyakoṇe prāṅmukho yajamānakaḥ | upaviśyācamya prāṇānāyamya ca samāhitaḥ ||57|| deśakālau prasaṃkīrtya vāstupūjāṃ carenmakhī | vāstoścaturṣu koṇeṣu catuḥśaṃkūn praropayet ||58|| oṃ viśantu bhūbhāge nāgāśca lokaprapālakāḥ | maṇḍape’trāvatiṣṭhantu balāyuṣyapradāḥ sadā ||59|| balidānaṃ māṣabhaktadadhyodanena cārpaye | śaṃkavaḥ pratigṛhṇantu bhavatpārśve samarpitam ||2.146.60|| rudrebhyaścāpi sarpebhyo baliṃ dadāmi śobhanam | gṛhṇantvīśānabhāgasthā ye cānye tatsamāśritāḥ ||61|| om agnibhyo’tha sarpebhyo ye cānye tatsamāśritāḥ | āgneyyāṃ vo baliṃ gṛhṇantvodanaṃ pradadāmi yat ||62|| nairṛtyādhipatiścaiva nairṛtyāṃ rākṣasāśca ye | baliṃ tebhyaḥ prayacchāmi gṛhṇantu mantritaṃ balim ||63|| vāyavyādhipatiścaiva vāyavyāṃ ye ca rākṣasāḥ | baliṃ dadāmi gṛhṇantvodanaṃ puṇyaṃ samarpitam ||64|| vāstupīṭhe kuṃkumādyaiḥ svarṇaśalākayā tathā | ratnena rajatenāpi phalena kusumena vā ||65|| navarekhāḥ prakartavyāstatra lakṣmyai namaśca om | yaśovatyai namaśceti oṃ kāntāyai namastathā ||66|| supriyāyai namaśceti vimalāyai namaśca om | oṃ śriyai nama oṃ subhagāyai namaśca omiti ||67|| oṃ sumatyai nama om iḍāyai namaśca omiti | evaṃ vai sthāpayitvaiva kṛtvā rekhāḥ punarnava ||68|| oṃ dhānyāyai namastatra oṃ prāṇāyai namastathā | viśālāyai namaścāpi oṃ sthirāyai namastathā ||69|| oṃ bhadrāyai namaśceti oṃ jayāyai namastathā | oṃ niśāyai namaśceti virajāyai namaśca om ||2.146.70 || vibhavāyai namaśceti sthāpayitvā prapūjayet | aiśāne ca pade devamīśānaṃ śikhinaṃ haram ||71 || dhyātvā cāvāhayāmyatra śaṃbhavāya namo namaḥ | bhavāya śaṃbhave śivatarāya ca namo namaḥ ||72|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ śikhinnihāgaccha tiṣṭha ca te namaḥ | taddakṣiṇe ca parjanyaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmyaham ||73 || abhivarṣatu parjanyaḥ parjanyāya namo namaḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ parjanya ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||74|| tato dakṣe jayantaṃ ca dhyātvā cāvāhayāmyaham | jayanta varmaṇā channa cāmṛtena samāplutā ||75|| urasā balamāpanna tvāṃ mṛndantu surā iha | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ jayanta ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||76 || jayantāya namaste’stu jayaṃ tanotu sarvathā | tato dakṣe mahendraṃ ca dhyātvā cāvāhayāmyaham ||77|| om āyātvindro vasatvatra stutaḥ śūraśca vardhanaḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ mahendra ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||78|| mahendrāya namo vajradharāya dyuprabhāviṇe | tato dakṣe sūryadevaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmyaham ||79|| savitre brahmarūpāya tejaḥkośāya te namaḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sūrya tvamihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||2.146.8 0|| tataśca dakṣiṇe satyaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmyaham | satyena dīkṣā phalati saśraddhā dakṣiṇātmikā ||81 || tatsarvaṃ satyakādhāraṃ satyāya te namo namaḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca satya ihāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ||82|| tato dakṣe bhṛśaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi bhāvataḥ | ātvā hārṣamantarabhrurdhruvastiṣṭhāvicācaliḥ ||83 || viśastvāṃ sarve vāñcchantu mā tvadrāṣṭradhidbhraśat | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ bhṛśa ihāgaccha tiṣṭha ca te namaḥ ||84|| tato dakṣe mahākāśaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca | svarā nādā dhvanayaśca sunṛtā mādhvya eva ca ||85 || tvayi santi mahākāśa tubhyaṃ divyāya vai namaḥ | au bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ ākāśa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||86 || tato dakṣe koṇabhāge’nalamāvāhayāmi ca | vāyusakhaṃ tathā vāyuṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca ||87|| agne saptasahasrātyajivha tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ | vāyo sahasrarathavan vahnimitra ca te namaḥ ||88|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca vahne vāyo cāgaccha tiṣṭha ca | tataḥ paśce pūṣaṇaṃ ca dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca ||89|| pūṣan tava vrate vayaṃ na riṣyema kadācana | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca pūṣannihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||2.146.9 0 || pūṣṇe namastava stotāro vayaṃ smaḥ sukhaṃ kuru | tataḥ paśce ta vitathaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca || 91 || vitatha tvaṃ sūryamahastubhyaṃ namaḥ punaḥ punaḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vitatha ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 92 || tataḥ paśce gṛhakṣataṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca | om akṣannamīmadaṃtahyavapriyā adhūṣata || 93 || oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ gṛhakṣata namaścāgaccha tiṣṭha ca | tataḥ paśce yamaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi te namaḥ ||9 4|| te yamāya pitṛmate svadhā dharmāya te namaḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ yamaścehāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 95|| tataḥ paścime gandharvaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca | gandharva tvāṃ viśvāvasuḥ paridadhātu bhūtaye || 96 || oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ gandharva namaścāgaccha tiṣṭha ca | tatpaśce bhṛṃgarājaṃ ca dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca || 97|| bhṛṃgarājāya ca namaḥ sūriṇe ca saromate | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ bhṛṃgarāja ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 98|| tataḥ paśce mṛgaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi te namaḥ | viśatruṃ kuru mṛgarāṭ durge’pi sahado bhava ||99|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ mṛgātra samāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | tatpaśce nairṛtakoṇe pitṝnāvāhayāmi ca || 2.146.10 0|| pitṛbhyaśca namaḥ sarvapitṝn samabhidhīmahi | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pitara ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata || 101 || taduttare dvārapaṃ nandinaṃ cāvāhayāmi ca | bahurakṣādhara nandin namaste’stu prarakṣaya || 1 02|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ nandim̐stvamihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | taduttare sugrīvakaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca || 1 03|| sugrīvāya namo rudropāśritāya gaṇāya te | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sugrīva ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 1 04|| taduttare puṣpadantaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca | śaṃbhusāmavidhātre te puṣpadantāya vai namaḥ || 105 || oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ puṣpadanta ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | taduttare ca varuṇaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca || 1 06|| raseśāya namo miṣṭahavyavāsāya dyumate | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 1 07|| taduttare’suraṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi te namaḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca asura ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 1 08|| taduttare śeṣamāvāhayāmi te namo namaḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ śeṣākhya ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 1 09|| taduttare ca vai pāpaṃ dhyāyāmyāvāhayāmi ca | o bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pāpa te namaścāgaccha tiṣṭha ca || 2.146.11 0|| taduttare vāyukoṇe rogamāvāhayāmi ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ roga te namaścāgaccha tiṣṭha ca || 11 1|| pāparogau prajānāṃ mā syātāṃ namāmyubhāvapi | tatpūrve nāganāmānaṃ cāhirbudhnyaṃ namāmi ca || 1 12|| āvāhayāmi cāgaccha tiṣṭhātra bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca | tatpūrve mukhyanāmānaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca || 11 3|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ mukhyātrāgaccha tiṣṭha ca te namaḥ | tatpūrve ca namo bhallāṭāya cāvāhayāmi tam || 1 14|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ bhallāṭa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | tatpūrve tu kuberāya nama āvāhayāmi tam || 1 15|| somāya oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva āgaccha tiṣṭha te namaḥ | tatpūrve tu ca śailāya nama āvāhayāmi tam || 1 16|| sarpāya oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva āgaccha tiṣṭha te namaḥ | tatpūrve’ditaye nama āgaccheha ca tiṣṭha ca || 1 17|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva adite mayi kalpapradā bhava | tatpūrve ca ditiṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi te namaḥ || 1 18|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ dite’tra samāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | vāstoḥ kaṇṭhe apo dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi vai namaḥ || 11 9|| āpo hiṣṭhāmayo bhuvastāna ūrjedadhātana | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ āpo vai ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata || 2.146.120|| skandhe dhyātvā cāpavatsaṃ cāvāhayāmi te namaḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ āpavatsa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 121 || dakṣe pārśve cāryamāṇaṃ namāmyāvāhayāmi ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ aryaman ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 122|| tato dakṣe kare sāvitrakamāvāhayāmi ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sāvitrāgaccha tiṣṭha ca te namaḥ || 123|| sāvitrapārśvake savitāramāvāhayāmi ca | kaphoṇikāyāḥ sānnidhye namāmi saṃsmarāmi ca || 124||| oṃ viśvāni devasavitarduritāni parāsuva | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ savitoścehāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 125|| tatpaśce dakṣasakthina vivasvantaṃ saṃsmarāmi ca | āvāhayāmi ca namaste vivasvan sudhāṃ kuru || 126|| dampatī cāśnutaścātrāgaccha tiṣṭha ca te namaḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vivasvantaṃ devaṃ saṃpradhīmahi || 127|| tatpaśce meḍhradeśe ca indramāvāhayāmi ca | vasudo bhava cāgaccha namaste tiṣṭha svaḥpate || 128|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva indrāya vibudheśāya te namaḥ | tadadho gudabhāge ca jayantaṃ prasmarāmi ca || 129|| āvāhayāmi auṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva ehi ca tiṣṭha ca | jayantāya nama aṣāḍhāya namo jayāya te || 2.146.130|| taduttare vāmasakthni mitramāvāhayāmi ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ mitra tvamāgaccha tiṣṭha te namaḥ || 13 1|| taduttare vāmakare rājayakṣmāṇameva ca | āvāhayāmi te namo yakṣmaṇā viprakarṣakṛt || 132|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ rājayakṣmannihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | kaphoṇīsannidhau haste vāme rudraṃ smarāmi ca || 133|| āvāhayāmi ca rudra namāmi śreyase bhava | auṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ rudrātra samāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 1 34|| tataḥ pūrve vāmapārśve pṛthvīdhara smarāmi ca | āvāhayāmi pṛthivīdhṛk śreyase namāmi ca || 135|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pṛthivīdharāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | vāstūdare ca brahmāṇaṃ smarāmyāvāhayāmi ca || 136|| brahmarūpa namaste’stu sato yoniṃ pradehi naḥ | auṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ brahmam̐stvamāgacchātra ca tiṣṭha ca || 137|| īśāne koṇake bāhye carakīṃ ca smarāmi ca | āvāhayāmi carakīṃ namāmi pāśanāśinīm || 1 38|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ caraki cehāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | agnau koṇe bahirvidārikāmāvāhayāmi ca || 139|| mṛtyunāśakari vidārike namāmi yogini | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vidārike cāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ||2.146.140|| rakṣaḥkoṇe pūtanāṃ cāvāhayāmi namāmi ca | bandhahantri pūtane tvaṃ nirṛtiduritāpahe || 141 || oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pūtane cāgaccha tiṣṭha cātra ca | vāyukoṇe pāpinīṃ cāvāhayāmi namāmi ca || 142|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pāpe tvaṃ cehāgacchātra tiṣṭha ca | pūrve skandaṃ namāmyāvāhayāmi saṃsmarāmi ca || 143 || bāṇebhyo rakṣa senāni śarma yacchatu duṣṭahan | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ skandātra samāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 144|| dakṣe’ryamāṇaṃ ca naumyāvāhayāmi smarāmi ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ aryaman samāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 145|| paścime jṛṃbhakaṃ naumyāvāhayāmi smarāmi ca | hiṃkṛte prothate śayānāya svāhā ca valgate || 146|| svapate jāgrate svāhā jṛṃbhamāṇāya kūjate | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ jṛmbhaka samāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 147|| uttare pilipicchaṃ naumyāvāhayāmi cintaye | pilippilākyai piśāṃginyai svāhā te namo’stviha || 148||| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pilipiccha samāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | pūrve cendraṃ smarāmyāvāhayāmi ca namāmi ca || 149|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ indra cāgaccha ceha ca tiṣṭha ca | agnāvagniṃ smarāmyāvāhayāmi ca namāmi ca || 2.146.150|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ agne cāgaccha ceha tiṣṭha ca | yāmye yamaṃ smarāmyāvāhayāmi ca namāmi ca || 151|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ yama cāgaccha ceha ca tiṣṭha ca | nairṛte nirṛtiṃ smarāmyāvāhayāmi naumi ca || 152|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ nirṛta cāgacchātra ca tiṣṭha ca | paścime varuṇaṃ smarāmyāvāhayāmi naumi ca || 153|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇa cāgacchātra ca tiṣṭha ca | smarāmi vāyuṃ vāyavye naumi cāvāhayāmi ca || 154|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vāyo cāgacchātra ca tiṣṭha ca | kuberamuttare smarāmyāvāhayāmi naumi ca || 155|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ kubera ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | īśānyāmīśānadevamāvāhayāmi naumi ca || 156| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ īśāna ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | īśānapūrvamadhye vai brahmāṇaṃ prasmarāmi ca || 157|| āvāhayāmi naumyenaṃ devā avantu sarvataḥ | o bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ brahmātra samāgacchātra tiṣṭha ca || 158|| varuṇanirṛtimadhye’nantaṃ smarāmi naumi ca | āvāhayāmyanantaṃ ca viṣarakṣākaraṃ harim || 159|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva ananta ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | ityāvāhya vāstupīṭhadevān praṇamya rādhike || 2.146.160|| kuryād devapratiṣṭhāṃ vai sāṃgopāṃgāṃ kratau tataḥ | buhaspatistanotvenaṃ viśvedevāḥ pratiṣṭhata || 161 || ityeva śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāha tu daivatam | tadeva tu mayā te’tra vāstudhyānaṃ prakīrtitam || 162|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pratiṣṭhotsave ācāryaṛtvigādivaraṇaṃ saṃbhāraprokṣaṇaṃ svastivāco maṇḍapapūjā vāstupīṭhadevāvāhananamanādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 146 ||
<2.147> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vibhuḥ | āha devāyatanakaṃ yattad vacmi ca te tataḥ || 1 || vāstudevārcanaṃ kāryaṃ pratiṣṭhānantaraṃ yataḥ | tadaṅgātmā sthāpanīyastāmrasya kalaśo navaḥ || 2 || om ājighra kalaśaṃ mahyā tvā viśantu cendavaḥ | sahasradhārāḥ payasvatvastvāṃ viśantu tiṣṭha ca || 3 || iti kalaśaṃ sthāpayitvā jalaṃ tatra prapūrayet | varuṇasya sukhaṃ sthānaṃ cottaṃbhanaṃ jalaṃ tvayi || 4 || ṛtaṃ ca sadanaṃ tvaṃ vai jalamādhatsva pāvanam | iti vāri pūrayitvā kaṇṭhe vastraṃ praveṣṭayet || 5 || vasoḥ pavitramasi śatadhāraṃ sahasradhāravat | itivastraṃ veṣṭayitvā pūgīphalaṃ ghaṭe’rpayet || 6 || oṃ phalinī puṣpiṃṇī syādaphalāpuṣpāpi te yujeḥ | pūgi tvaṃ ca ghaṭe tiṣṭha phaladā bhava dehinaḥ || 7 || iti pūgīphalaṃ datvā pañcaratnāni cārpayet | svarṇaṃ raupyaṃ hīrakaṃ ca māṇikyaṃ mauktikaṃ tathā || 8 || parivājapatiḥ kaviragnirhavyāni cākramīt | iti ratnāni datvaiva hiraṇyaṃ prakṣiped ghaṭe || 9 || agnerapatyaṃ devena vidhṛtaṃ śirasā purā | hiraṇyaṃ hariṇā nītaṃ kalaśe pradadāmi tat || 2.147.10 || iti hiraṇyaṃ dattvaiva gandhaṃ kalaśe prakṣipet | kauṃkumaṃ kaisaraṃ gandhaṃ cāndanaṃ pradadāmi te || 1 1|| itigandhaṃ pradāyaivārpayedoṣadhikāstataḥ | rasaplutā madhusrāvāḥ purā jātā harestanau || 12|| tāstvapi prakṣipāmyeva śataṃ sapta ca rughghanāḥ | iti sarvauṣadhīrdatvā saptamṛdaḥ samarpayet| || 13|| gajāśvagosthalījātāṃ valmīkacatvarodbhavām | rājacatvaralabdhāṃ cārpayet tulasīmūlajām || 14|| pṛthivī sarvarūpā tvaṃ śarmadā bhava vāsade | iti saptamṛdo datvā dūrvāṃ ghaṭe samarpayet || 15|| kāṇḍātkāṇḍātprarohantī paruṣaḥ paruṣaḥ pari | evaṃ no dūrve pratanoḥ sahasreṇa śatena ca || 16|| iti dūrvāṃ ghaṭe datyārpayedvai pañcapallavān | aśvatthevo niṣadanaṃ parṇe vo vasatiḥ kṛtā || 17|| gobhāja itkilātha yat sa navatha pūruṣam | oṃ namaḥ kalaśe mukhe’śvatthasya ca vaṭasya ca || 18|| cūtasyodumbarasyāpi plakṣasyāpi navāni vai | patrāṇi sthāpayāmyatra sasyavad rāṣṭrakaṃ tava || 19|| oṃ pavitraṃ pavitrākhyaṃ punātu sūryaraśmivat | pavitrapate kalaśe’rpayāmyatra pavitrakam ||2.147.20 || oṃ namaste pavitrāya kuśajanyāya vedhase | ghaṭe tvāṃ ca nikṣipāmi pavitraṃ kuru vāri tat ||21|| iti datvā pavitraṃ ca ghaṭoparyakṣatabhṛtām | sthālīṃ nyasennavāṃ śarkarādiyuktāṃ sukāṃcanīm ||22|| pūrṇā darvī parāpata supūrṇā punarāpata | vasneva vikrīṇāvahā iṣamūrjaḥ śatakrato || 23 || iti taṇḍulapātraṃ ca natvā śrīphalamarpayet | śrīśca lakṣmīḥ ramā rādhā brahmavidyāsatīratiḥ || 24|| suguṇā mañjulā haṃsā lalitā kambharā satī | santoṣā māṇikī durgāmṛtāmbā śāradā imāḥ ||25|| śrīphale saṃvasantvatra sampajjuṣyo bhavantu naḥ | iti śrīphalamāsthāpya śrīdaṃ taṃ praṇamenmakhī ||26 || oṃ manojutirjuṣatāmājyasya bṛhaspatiḥ kratum | imaṃ tanotvariṣṭaṃ yajñaṃ samimaṃ dadhātu ca | viśvedevā iha ghaṭe mādayantāmoṃ pratiṣṭha ||27|| iti ghaṭaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyāvāhayed varuṇaṃ tataḥ | jalaṃ sarvarasāḍhyaṃ vai pāvanaṃ ca kratorhitam ||28|| tattvāyāmi brahmaṇā vandamānastadāśāste yajamāno havirbhiḥ | aheḍamāno varuṇeha boddhyuruśaṃsamāna āyuḥ pramoṣī ||29|| oṃ bhurbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | ityāvāhya varuṇaṃ cārcayet ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ||2.147.30 || sarve samudrāḥ saritastīrthāni ca sarāṃsi ca | āyāntu ca makhīyānāṃ duritakṣayahetave || 3 1|| kalaśasya mukhaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ sadāśivaḥ smṛtaḥ | mūlaṃ brahmā svayaṃ bodhya udaraṃ mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ ||32|| kukṣayaḥ sāgarāḥ santi pṛthvī kalaśarūpiṇī | vedāḥ sāṃgāśca kalaśāvayavātmāna eva ca ||33|| āvāhayāmi tīrthāni cāgacchata ca tiṣṭhata | amṛtonmathane jātaḥ kalaśo viṣṇuhastagaḥ ||34|| tīrthaprāṇasurabhūtavāso’si phalado’si ca | ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevāḥ sapitṛkāḥ ||35|| aśvinau tvayi tiṣṭhantu yajñārthaṃ sannidhiṃ kuru | ityevaṃ kalaśaṃ prārthya tasyopari tu kānakīm ||36|| vāstumūrti kṛkalāsarūpāṃ tatra nidhāpayet | agnyuttāraṇakaṃ kuryād vastrairācchādayet paṭaiḥ ||37|| tata uttānakaṃ vāstumīśānaśirasaṃ naram | dhyāyedagnyuttāraṇe ca deśakālau prakīrtya ca ||38|| avaghātādidoṣāṇāṃ parihārārthameva ca | agnyuttāraṇakaṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ ca samācaret ||39|| mūrtiṃ pātre nidhāyaiva dugdhadhārā prapātayet | jaladhārāṃ tataḥ kuryāt sūktaṃ paṭhet punaḥ punaḥ ||2.147.40|| oṃ samudrasya tvāvakayāgne parivyayāmasi | sarvadevottāraṇaḥ pāvako’smabhyaḥ śivo bhava ||41 || oṃ himasya tvā jarāyuṇāgne parivyayāmasi | sarvadevottāraṇaḥ pāvako’smabhyaḥ śivo bhava ||42|| omapāmidaṃ nyayanaṃ samudrasya niveśanam | vighnarūpām̐stathānyām̐ste hyasmattapantu hetayaḥ ||43 || sarvadevottāraṇaḥ pāvako’smabhyaḥ śivo bhava | namaste harase śociṣe namaste astvarciṣe ||44|| vighnarūpām̐stathānyām̐ste hyasmattapantu hetayaḥ | sarvadevottāraṇaḥ pāvako’smabhyaḥ śivo bhava ||45|| prāṇadāpānadā vyānadā varcodā variṣṭhadāḥ | vidhnarūpām̐stathānyām̐ste hyasmattapantu hetayaḥ ||46 || sarvadevottāraṇaḥ pāvako’smabhyaḥ śivo bhava | evamagnyuttāraṇaṃ ca kṛtvā pañcabhiramṛtaiḥ ||47|| saṃsnāpya vāstupuruṣaṃ kalaśopari vinyaset | dhyāyed vāstusvarūpaṃ ca parabrahmodbhavaṃ purā ||48|| tataḥ śaṃbhoḥ śarīrāccābhavat putro balī mahān | yajñāpakārakaḥ so’yaṃ devaiḥ parājito mṛdhe ||49|| nipātyādhomukho baddhaḥ samantād devatāgaṇaiḥ | īśāne mastakaṃ nyastaṃ nairṛtye pādasaṃpuṭam ||2.147.50|| jānunī kūrparīkṛtya bāhuyugmaṃ tathāvidham | vāyavyāgnyostato jānuṃ hṛdaye cāṃjalistathā ||51 || padīkṛtya ca tasyordhvaṃ sarve surāśca rohitāḥ | taṃ sarvasukhāsaṃ cāvāhayāmi ca vāstukam ||52|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ saḥ vāstunaraṃ cāvāhayāmi naumi ca | sammānayāmi cāgaccha mahābalaparākrama ||53|| sarvadevāśritavapurbrahmaputra namo’stu te | sarvabrahmāṇḍadhṛgasi tvāgaccha bhagavanniha ||54|| āgaccha bhagavan vāsto sarvadevānvitastviha | tiṣṭhātra kuru kalyāṇaṃ yajñe’smin sannidho bhava ||55|| oṃ vāstoṣpate pratijānīhyasmān svāveśo anamīvo bhavā naḥ | yattvemahe prati tanno juṣasva śanno bhava dvipadeśaṃ catuṣpade ||56|| ityāvāhyākṣatapuṣpaiścandanāmbarabhūṣaṇaiḥ | sampūjya prārthayed rakṣāṃ rakṣa saṃkaṭaviplavāt ||57|| naivedyaṃ dhūpadīpau ca nīrājanādi cārpayet | svāhetyuccārya ca tato’gadavān vidhinārcayet ||58|| oṃ namaḥ śikhine ceśānāya pādyaṃ tathārdhakam | ācamanaṃ snapanaṃ cāmbaraṃ gandhaṃ tathākṣatān ||59|| puṣpāṇi dhūpadīpau ca naivedyaṃ ca jalaṃ phalam | tāmbūlaṃ śayanaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadāmi gṛhāṇa śam ||2.147.6 0 || parjanyāya namaḥ pādyādikaṃ gṛhāṇa śaṃ kuru | jayantāya namaḥ pādyādikaṃ gṛhāṇa śaṃ kuru ||6 1 || omindrāya namaḥ pādyādikaṃ gṛhāṇa śaṃ kuru | oṃ sūryāya namaḥ pādyādikaṃ gṛhāṇa śaṃ kuru ||62|| oṃ satyāya namaḥ pādyādikaṃ gṛhāṇa śaṃ kuru | oṃ bhṛśāya namaḥ pādyādikaṃ gṛhāṇa śaṃ kuru ||63|| oṃ ākāśāya namaśca oṃ vāyave ca namo namaḥ | oṃ pūṣṇe ca namaḥ oṃ vitathāyāpi namo namaḥ ||64|| gṛhakṣatāya nama oṃ oṃ yamāya namo namaḥ | oṃ gandharvāya ca namo bhṛṃgarājāya oṃ namaḥ ||65 || oṃ mṛgāya nama oṃ ca pitṛbhyo’pi namo namaḥ | pādyādīni ca gṛhṇantu kurvantu śaṃ namo namaḥ ||66 || oṃ nandine nama oṃ ca sugrīvāya namo namaḥ | oṃ puṣpadantāya namo varuṇāya ca oṃ namaḥ ||67|| omasurāya ca namaḥ śeṣāya ca namo namaḥ | namaḥ pāpāya rogāya oṃ nāmaścāhaye namaḥ ||68|| oṃ mukhyāya namo bhallāṭāya oṃ ca namo namaḥ | oṃ somāya ca nāgāyāditaye ditaye namaḥ ||69|| omadabhyaśca namaścāpavapsāya namo namaḥ | pādyādīni ca gṛhṇantu kurvantu śaṃ namo namaḥ ||2.147.70|| omaryamṇe nama oṃ sāvitrāya ca namaśca om | oṃ savitre namo vivasvate cendrāya oṃ namaḥ ||7 1|| oṃ jayantāya nama oṃ mitrāya nama oṃ namaḥ | rājayakṣmaṇe nama oṃ oṃ rudrāya namo namaḥ ||72|| oṃ pṛthivīdharāya ca nama oṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ | pādyādīni ca gṛhṇantu kurvantu śaṃ namo namaḥ ||73|| oṃ carakyai nama oṃ ca vidāryai ca namaśca om | pūtanāyai nama oṃ ca pāpāyai ca namaśca om ||74|| oṃ skandāya namaścāryamṇe namo jṛṃbhakāya om | nama oṃ pilipicchāya omindrāya namaśca om ||75|| agnaye oṃ namo yamāya oṃ nirṛtaye namaḥ | nama oṃ ca varuṇāya oṃ vāyave namo namaḥ ||76|| oṃ kuberāya nama omīśānāya oṃ namaḥ | oṃ brahmaṇe namaśca omanantāya namo namaḥ ||77|| pādyādīni ca gṛhṇantu kurvantu śaṃ namo namaḥ | bhavantaścāṃgadevādyā gṛhṇantu gandhamakṣatān ||78|| puṣpadhūpau dīpavastre pratipātrasthabhojanam | jalaṃ phalaṃ dalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ ca dakṣiṇādikam ||79|| ārārtrikaṃ cārpayāmi gṛhṇantu vitarantu śam | atha vāstupuruṣaṃ ca pūjayettu punastathā ||2.147.80|| kuryātprāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vai bījapraṇavabṛṃhitām | ekāgraṃ hṛdayaṃ kṛtvā dhyātvā devaṃ samuccaret ||8 1 || oṃ āṃ hrī krau yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ kṣaṃ haṃ saḥ so’ham | asya devasya vai prāṇā iha prāṇā vasantu ca ||82|| oṃ āṃ hrīṃ krauṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ kṣaṃ haṃ saḥ so’ham | asya devasya vai jīva iha jīvaḥ sthitaśca om ||83|| oṃ āṃ hrīṃ krauṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ kṣaṃ haṃ saḥ so’ham | asya devasya vāṅmanastvakcakṣuḥśrotramityapi ||84|| jihvā ghrāṇaṃ pāṇipādāḥ pāyūpasthāni cāntaram | asminnāgatya ca ciraṃ sukhaṃ tiṣṭhantu vai svāhā ||85|| oṃ manojūtirjuṣatāmājyasya bṛhaspatiryajñam | imaṃ tanotvariṣṭaṃ ca yajñaṃ samimaṃ dadhātu ||86|| viśvedevāsa iha mādayantāmoṃ pratiṣṭhata | evaṃ pratiṣṭhāyajñena yajante vai pratiṣṭhitān ||87|| tava vāsto mahāpūjāṃ karomyanugrahaṃ kuru | oṃ vāstupuruṣāya ca namo’rpayāmi pādyakam ||88|| arghyaṃ cācamanaṃ pañcāmṛtasnānaṃ dadāmi ca | śuddhodakaṃ yajñasūtraṃ cārpayāmi ca te namaḥ ||89|| vastraṃ gandhaṃ kusumaṃ ca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tathāttaram | naivedyaṃ phalatāmbūle cārpayāmi ca te namaḥ ||2.147.90|| dakṣiṇāṃ prāñjaliṃ cārghyaṃ samarpayāmi te namaḥ | oṃ pūjyo’si trilokeṣu yajñarakṣārthahetave ||9 1 || tvadarcanaṃ vinā naiva siddhyanti kratusatkriyāḥ | ayone bhagavan śaṃbhulalāṭasvedasaṃbhava || 92|| gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ vāsto svāminnamo’stu te | evamarthaṃ pradatvaiva balidānaṃ samarpayet ||93 || oṃ vahnaye nama eṣa pāyasabalirnamama | oṃ parjanyāya nama eṣa pāyasabalirnamama ||94|| oṃ jayantāya nama eṣa pāyasabalirnamama | omindrāya nama eṣa pāyasabalirnamama ||95|| oṃ sūryāya nama eṣa pāyasabalirnamama | oṃ satyāya nama eṣa pāyasabalirnamama || 96 || evaṃ vai vāstudevebhyaḥ pratyekāya punaḥ punaḥ | omamukāya nama eṣa pāyasabalirnamama ||97|| iti dadyād baliṃ tataścarakyādibhya ityapi | dikpālebhyo māṣabhaktabalīn dadyācca tadyathā || 98|| oṃ carakyai nama eṣa māṣabhaktabalirnamama | oṃ vidāryai nama eṣa māṣabhaktabalirnamama ||99|| pūtanāyai nama eṣa māṣabhaktabalirnamama | oṃ pāpāyai nama eṣa māṣabhaktabalirnamama || 2.147.1 00|| oṃ skandāya nama eṣa māṣabhaktabalirnamama | aryamṇe jṛmbhakāyāpi pilipicchāya cārpayet || 101 || indrāgniyamanirṛtavaruṇavāyave namaḥ | kubereśājānantebhyo māṣabhaktabalirnamama || 1 02|| tato vāstupuruṣāya baliṃ dadyāddhi mantrataḥ | nānāsugandhipakvānnaṃ pāyasādyaṃ vibhinnakam || 103 || baliṃ gṛhāṇa vāsto tvaṃ kṣudhādoṣaṃ praṇāśaya | oṃ nama eṣa vāstupuruṣāya balirnamama || 1 04|| ye devāḥ pāyasabhujo gṛhṇantu pāyasaṃ hi te | ye devāścānnabhoktāro gṛhṇantvannaṃ śubhaṃ madhu || 1 05|| ye devā rasabhoktāro gṛhṇantvete rasān bahūn | ye devāḥ kṛśarādāste gṛhṇantu kṛśarānnakam || 1 06|| ye devā māṣabhoktāro gṛhṇantu māṣajaṃ balim | ye devāścāmṛtabhujo gṛhṇantvamṛtameva te || 1 07|| ye devāḥ piṣṭacūrṇādā gṛhṇantu piṣṭacūrṇakam | ye devāḥ phalabhoktāro gṛhṇantvete phalāni ca || 1 08|| ye devāḥ kaṇabhoktāraḥ sarṣapādāśca ye surāḥ | śākādā havyabhoktāro yeṣāṃ yogyaṃ tu yadbhavet || 1 09|| tattanmayārpitaṃ devā gṛhṇantviṣṭabaliṃ namama | mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ bhaktiśraddhāvihīnakam || 2.147.11 0|| yadarpitaṃ mayā deva paripūrṇaṃ vidhīyatām | namaste vāstudeveśa sarvavighnaharo bhava || 11 1|| śāntiṃ kuru sukhaṃ dehi sarvān kāmān prayaccha me | oṃ śrīvāstupuruṣāyārpayāmi nārikelakam || 1 12|| suvarṇaṃ cārpayāmyatra praṇamāmi sukhaṃ kuru | śrīṃ lakṣmīṃ ca ramāṃ rādhāṃ brahmavidyāṃ ca padmajām || 113 || suguṇāṃ maṃjulāṃ padmāṃ lalitāṃ kaṃbharāṃ satīm | santoṣāṃ māṇikīṃ durgāmṛtāmbāḥ śāradāmimāḥ || 1 14|| arcayet sāttvikairdravyaiḥ pāyasādyaiśca toṣayet | tato vai maṇḍapaṃ veṣṭayet trisūtryā samantataḥ | sūktena pavamānena rakṣaghnena ninādayan || 1 15|| oṃ pavamānaḥ suvarjanaḥ pavitreṇa vicarṣaṇiḥ | yaḥ potā sa punātu māṃ punantu māṃ devajanāḥ || 116 || punantu manavo dhiyā punantu viśva āyavaḥ | jātavedaḥ pavitravat pavitreṇa punīhi mām || 1 17|| śukreṇa devadīdyat agne kratvā kratūranu | yatte pavitramarciṣi agne vitatamantarā || 1 18|| brahma tena punīmahe ubhābhyāṃ devasavitaḥ | pavitreṇa savena ca idaṃ brahma punīmahe || 119 || vaiśvadevī punatī devyāgād yasyaistanuvo vītapṛṣṭhāḥ | tayā madantaḥ sadhamādyeṣu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām || 2.147.120 || vaiśvānaro raśmibhiryā punāttu vātaḥ prāṇeneṣiro mayobhūḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī payasā payobhiḥ ṛtāvarī yajñiye mā punītām|| 121 || bṛhadbhiḥ savitastṛbhiḥ vaśiṣṭhairdevamanmabhiḥ agne dakṣai punīhi mā | yena devā apunata yenāpo divyaṃ kaśaḥ tena divyena
