brahmaṇā idaṃ brahma punīmahe || 122| oṃ rakṣohaṇaṃ valagahanaṃ vaiṣṇavīmidamahantaṃ valagamutkirāmi | yaṃ me’niṣṭyo yamamātyo nicakhānedamahantaṃ balagamutkirāmi || 123 || yaṃ me samāno yamasamāno nicakhānedamahantaṃ valagamutkirāmi | yaṃ me sabandhuryamasabandhurnicakhānedamahantaṃ valagamutkirāmi | | 124 | | yaṃ me sajāto yamasajāto nicakhānotkṛtyā kirāmi | oṃ kuṇuṣvapājaḥ prasitiṃ na pṛthivīṃ yāhi rājevāmavāṃ ibhena | | 125| | tṛṣvīmanuprasitiṃ druṇānostāsi viddhyarakṣasastapiṣṭhaiḥ | punantu māṃ devajanā manasā dhiyo viśvābhūtāni jātavedo’pi mām || 126 || ityevaṃ rādhike maṇḍapaṃ trisūtryā praveṣṭayet | maṇḍape ca tataścāgatyāsane tata āviśet || 127|| evaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo jagāda devatāyanam | tattathaiva mayoktaṃ te yadyapi nāti vistaram || 128 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pratiṣṭhotsave kalaśasthāpanaṃ vāstoḥ pratiṣṭhānaṃ pūjanaṃ vāstudevānāṃ pūjanaṃ naivedyaṃ balistrisūtryā maṇḍapaveṣṭanaṃ mantrāścetyādikathananāmā saptacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 147 ||
<2.148> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇastataḥ | devāyatanakāyāha pañca tatte vadāmi ca || 1 || tato vāyavīyapīṭhe yoginīkṣetrapālakān | pūjayed vidhinā samāvāhya śoḍaśavastubhiḥ || 2 | | oṃ divyayoginīmāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca | oṃ divyayoginīṃ naumi kṣetrarakṣaṇakāriṇīm | | 3 | | oṃ mahāyoginīmāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca | pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaistāṃ tasyai te namo namaḥ || 4 || oṃ siddhayoginīmāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca | pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaistāṃ tasyai te namo namaḥ || |1 || oṃ śrīgaṇeśvarīmāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca | pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaistāṃ tasyai te namo namaḥ || 6 || oṃ pretākṣīṃ ḍākinīṃ ca kālīṃ ca kālarātrikām | āvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ | | 7 | | niśācarīmo hūm̐kārī siddhivetālinīṃ tathā | āvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 8 || oṃ hrīṃkārīṃ bhūtaḍāmarīmūrdhvakeśīṃ ca oṃ tathā | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ | | 9 || virūpākṣīṃ ca śuṣkāṃgīṃ narabhojanāṃ ca oṃ tathā | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 2.148.10 | | oṃ kaṃkārīṃ vīrabhadrāṃ dhūmrākṣīṃ oṃ kalipriyām | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 11 | | rākṣasīṃ ghorarākṣasīṃ virūpākṣīṃ bhayaṃkarīm | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 12 || viśālākṣīṃ kāmarīṃ ca caṇḍīṃ vārāhinīṃ tathā | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ||1 3 || muṇḍadhartrīṃ bhairavīṃ cakriṇīṃ krodhāṃ ca durmukhīm | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 1 4|| pretavāhanāṃ kuraṃgīṃ pralambauṣṭhīṃ mālinīṃ tathā | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 15 || mantrayoginīṃ kālāgnīṃ mohinīṃ vakrikāṃ tathā | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 16 || kuṇḍalinīṃ bālakīṃ ca kaumārīṃ yamadūtikām | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 17| | auṃ karālīṃ kauśikīṃ ca yakṣiṇīṃ bhakṣiṇīṃ tathā | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 18 || kumārikāṃ yantravāhāṃ viśālākṣīṃ ca kāmukīm | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 19 || oṃ vādhrīṃ rākṣasīṃ pretabhakṣiṇīṃ dhūrjaṭīṃ tathā | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 2.148.20 || oṃ vikaṭāṃ ca ghorāṃ ca kapālīṃ vimalāṃ tathā | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 21 || oṃ mālāṃ sarvasiddhāṃ cāvāhayāmi ca vāṃ namaḥ | sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi sarvāḥ santu ca siddhidāḥ || 22|| anayā pūjayā ṣoḍaśopacārādibhiriha | prīyantāṃ pāyasabaliṃ dadāmi yoginīgaṇāḥ || 23 || atha kṣetrapālapīṭhadevatāḥ saṃprapūjayet | omajaramāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca te namaḥ || 24|| pūjayāmi baliṃ cārpayāmi namo’jarāya te | indracoram āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi ca te namaḥ || 25|| vyāpakaṃ cendramūrtiṃ cokṣṇaṃ kūṣmāṇḍaṃ varuṇakam | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 26 || vāmukaṃ ca vimuktaṃ ca līlālopaṃ ca śaptakam | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 27|| airāvataṃ caikadaṃṣṭram oṣadhighnaṃ ca bandhanam | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 28 || divyakaraṃ kambalaṃ ca gavayavaṃ ca kṣobhaṇam | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 29|| kālaṃ baladharaṃ cāṇḍaṃ candravāraṇakaṃ tathā | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 2.148.30 || phaṭāṭopaṃ ca jaṭilam ṛtuṃ ghaṇṭeśvaraṃ tathā | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 31 || vikaṭaṃ cāṇimaṃ guṇatrandhaṃ ca ḍāmaraṃ tathā | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 32|| ṭhaṃṭhaphaṇaṃ sthavilaṃ ca danturaṃ dhanadaṃ tathā | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 33 || nāgakarṇaṃ photkaraṃ ca mahādalaṃ ca cīrakam | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 34|| oṃ siṃhaṃ ca mṛgaṃ yakṣaṃ meghavāhanamityapi | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 35 | | oṃ tīkṣṇauṣṭhamanalaṃ sukratuṃ yudhāpaṃ vakrakam | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ || 36 | | oṃ vātaṃ yāpanaṃ cāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca | pūjayāmi baliṃ cārpayāmi vā praṇamāmi ca || 37|| pañcāśatkṣetrapālāścehāgacchatātra tiṣṭhata | āsanaṃ ca tathā pādyamarghyamācamanīyakam || 38 || pañcāmṛtāplavanaṃ cābhiṣekaṃ cāmbarāṇi ca | bhūṣāścandanagandhādi cākṣatān kuṃkumādikam || 39|| puṣpahārān kajjalaṃ ca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ nivedanam | bhojanaṃ jalapānaṃ ca phalaṃ tāmbūlakādikam || 2.148.40 || nīrājanādikaṃ samarpayāmi santu rakṣakāḥ | oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hruṃ svāhā baṭukāya prabhūtabalimarpayet || 41 || yoginyaḥ kṣetrapālāśca sarve yatra vasanti hi | tataścātra samāgatya baliṃ gṛhṇantu me’mṛtam || 42|| balidānena santuṣṭāḥ prayacchantu mamepsitam | yajñe kāryāṇi kurvantu doṣām̐śca ghnantu me makhe ||43 || iti datvārthayityā ca praṇamet sarvadevatāḥ | tataḥ śrīmaṇḍapapūjāṃ kuryāt ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ||44|| ṛtvibhirguruṇā cāpi snāpito yajamānakaḥ | sarvauṣadhisalilena śuklamālyāmbarastathā ||45|| śuklagandhānulepaśca sapatnīputrapautrakaḥ | sācāryartvik kare pūrṇakalaśastūryanādane || 46|| mukhyadevaṃ dhyāyamāno maṇḍapadhyānatatparaḥ | vedaghoṣān praśṛṇvāno maṇḍapaṃ pūjayet sudhīḥ || 47|| oṃ bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhiryajatrāḥ | sthirairaṃgaistuṣṭuvām̐sastanūbhirvyaśemahi devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ ||48 || ācamya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau prakīrtya ca | mukhyadevapratiṣṭhāne yajñāṃgaṃ pūjanaṃ śubham ||49|| gaṇeśasya devatānāṃ maṇḍapasya karomyaham | āvāhanaṃ sthāpanaṃ ca namanaṃ prakaromi ca ||2.148.50 || oṃ śrīgaṇeśvaramāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca | ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ sampūjayāmi praṇamāmi ca ||51 || evaṃ gaṇeśaṃ sampūjya datvā naivedyakaṃ tathā | stambhapūjāṃ tataḥ kuryādīśānādikramānmakhī ||52|| omīśānyāṃ brahmamūrtimāvāhayāmi vedhasam | sthāpayāmi pustakākṣasūtraśūlakamaṇḍalūn |||53 || dadhāna devatāyuktaṃ haṃsasthaṃ taṃ pitāmaham | āgaccha sṛṣṭikṛd brahman prathamastaṃbhavāsakṛt| ||54|| oṃ vrahma yajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastād visīmataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ | sabudhnyāḥ upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ sataśca yonimasataśca vivaḥ ||55|| oṃ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svarbrahmannihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | nama oṃ brahmaṇe ṣoḍaśopacārān dadāmi te ||56 || athāgneye śubhe staṃbhe viṣṇumāvāhayāmi ca | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmacaturbāhuṃ ramāpatim ||57|| garuḍasthaṃ kamalāśrīlakṣmīgaṇaprasevitam | āgaccha bhagavan viṣṇo dvitīyastaṃbhavāsakṛt ||58 || sthāpayāmi prabhuṃ tvāṃ ca pūjayāmi namāmi ca | oṃ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ viṣṇo ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||59 || nama oṃ viṣṇave ṣoḍaśopacārān dadāmi te | om idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame tredhā ca nidadhe padam ||2.148.6 0 || samūḍhamasya pāṃsure ā viṣṇave te namo namaḥ | atha nairṛtyakastaṃbhe śivamāvāhayāmi ca ||6 1 || vṛṣabhasthaṃ candrabhālaṃ śūlinaṃ muṇḍamālinam | umāgaṇasamājuṣṭaṃ nāgayajñopavītakam |||62|| āgaccha bhagavan śaṃbho tṛtīyastaṃbhavāsakṛt | sthāpayāmi haraṃ tvāṃ ca pūjayāmi namāmi ca ||6 3 || oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ śaṃbho ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | nama oṃ śaṃbhave ṣoḍaśopacārān dadāmi te ||64| | oṃ namaste rudramanyava utota iṣave namaḥ | bāhubhyāmuta te namaḥ oṃ śaṃbhave te namo namaḥ | |65|| atha vāyukoṇastaṃbhe indramāvāhayāmi ca | sahasrākṣaṃ gajārūḍhaṃ vajriṇaṃ ca śacīpatim |||66 || āgaccha bhagavannindra caturthastambhavāsakṛt | sthāpayāmi mahendraṃ tvāṃ pūjayāmi namāmi ca || 67|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ indra ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | nama indrāya oṃ ṣoḍaśopacārān dadāmi te ||68 || oṃ trātāramindramavitāramindraṃ have have suhavaṃ śūramindram | hvayāmi śakraṃ puruhūtamindraṃ svasti no maghavā dhātvindraḥ ||69 || oṃ indrāya namastato dvādaśastaṃbhapūjanam | bāhyabhāge maṇḍapasya karomīśānataḥ kramāt ||2.148.7 0 || atheśāne sūryamāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca | saptāśvarathasaṃrūḍhaṃ raktāṃgaṃ tigmatejasam ||7 1 || sapadmaṃ pūjayāmyatra pañcamastaṃbhasaṃsthitam | trailokyanetrarūpaṃ caṃ kuṇḍalādivirājitam ||72|| oṃ ākṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca | hiraṇmayena savitā rathenādevo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan |||73 || oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sūrya ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ ||74 || atheśānapūrvayostu madhye staṃbhe gaṇeśakam | āhayāmi sthāpayāmi vighnaharaṃ gajānanam ||75|| siddhibuddhipradātāraṃ praṇamāmi vināyakam | āgaccha gaṇanātha tvaṃ ṣaṣṭhastaṃbhe ca tiṣṭha ca ||76 || oṃ gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ havāmahe | oṃ priyāṇāṃ tvā priyapatiṃ havāmahe | oṃ nidhīnāṃ tvā nidhipatiṃ havāmahe | vaso mama āhamajānirgarbhadhamātvāmajāsigarbhadham ||77|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ gaṇapate ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhna ca te namaḥ ||78 || atha pūrvāgnyantarālastambhe yamaṃ yamādhipam | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi sarvajantubhayaṃkaram ||79 || raudramūrtiṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ praṇamāmi sadaṇḍakam | māhiṣavāhanaṃ karmasākṣiṇaṃ dharmamūrtikam |||2.148.8 0 || āgaccha dharmarāja tvaṃ saptamastaṃbhake viśa | oṃ yamāya tvā makhāya tvā sūryasya tvā tapase ||8 1 || devastvā savitāmaddhānaktupṛthivyāḥ saṃspṛśaspāhi | arcirasi śocirasi tapo’si brahmamūrtikaḥ || 8 2|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ yama ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtā pūjā gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ | |8 3 | | athāgnikoṇake staṃbhe śeṣaṃ pātālavāsinam | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi sahasraśirasaṃ śubham | |84|| svastikarekhayā yuktaphaṇāmaṇivibhūṣitam | nārāyaṇāsanaṃ devaṃ praṇamāmi viṣānvitam ||85|| āgaccha śeṣarāja tvaṃ cāṣṭamastaṃbhake viśa | o namo’stu sarpebhyo ye ke ca pṛthivīmanu ||86 || ye’ntarikṣe ye ca divi tatsarpebhyo namo namaḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ śeṣa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | |87|| ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ | athāgnidakṣamadhyasthe stambhe skandaṃ tu ṣaṇmukham ||88 || āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi kārtikeyaṃ hi śāṃkaram | sarvatattvabrahmavidaṃ mayūrasthaṃ namāmi ca ||8 9 || āgaccha śarajanma tvaṃ navame stambhake viśa | devasenāpate gāgeyaka vāhneyaka prabho || 2.148.90 || oṃ yadakrandaḥ prathamaṃ jāyamāna udyansamudrāduta vā purīṣāt | śyenasya pakṣā hariṇasya bāhu upastutyaṃ mahi jātaṃ te’rvan || 91 || oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ skanda ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ || 92|| dakṣanairṛtyāntarālastaṃbhe vāyuṃ prāṇaṃ dehinām | kṛṣṇamṛgasamārūḍhaṃ sarvādhāraṃ dhvajāyudham || 93 || āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi praṇamāmi sadāgatim | āgacchātra vāyudeva daśame staṃbhake viśa || 94|| oṃ vāyo ye te sahasriṇo rathāsastebhirāgahi | niyutvānsomapītaye prāṇītyadabhramātmasu || 95|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vāyo ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ || 96 || nairṛtyakoṇake staṃbhe somaṃ vai rātrināyakam | śaśinaṃ rudraśīrṣasthaṃ śvetaṃ kṣīrodaputrakam || 97|| āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi praṇamāmi suśītalam | āgacchātra somadevaikādaśastaṃbhake viśa ||98 || oṃ āpyāyasva sametu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam | bhavāvvājasya saṃgathe’mṛtavarṣī prapoṣitā | | 99 | | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ somadeva ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ | | 2.148.100 | | nirṛtipaścamadhyasthe staṃbhe tu varuṇaṃ suram | kuṃbhīrathasamārūḍhaṃ pāśahastaṃ samujjvalam | | 101 | | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi praṇamāmi jaleśvaram | āgacchātra varuṇeśa dvādaśastaṃbhake viśa | | 102 | | om imamme varuṇa śrudhī havamadyā ca mṛḍaya | tvāmavasyurācake tṛṭprabhāhan vipāśakṛt | | 103 || oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ | | 10 4| | paścavāyvorantarāle staṃbhe’ṣṭavasusattamān | aśvasthān puṣpamālādyairdhanasmṛddhyā samanvitān | | 105 | | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi praṇamāmi vasubhṛtān | atrāgacchata vasavo viśantu ca trayodaśe | | 106 | | oṃ vasoḥ pavitramasi śatadhāraṃ vasoḥ pavitramasi sahasradhāram | devastvā savitā punātu vasoḥ pavitreṇa śatadhāreṇa supvā kāmadhukṣaḥ | | 107 | | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vasavo ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata | ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇantu vo namaḥ | | 108 | | vāyustaṃbhe dhanadaṃ sayakṣaṃ narayānaṃ gadādharam | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi praṇamāmi kuberakam | | 109 | | atrāgaccha ca dhanada viśa staṃbhe caturdaśe | oṃ vayaṃ somavrate tava manastanūṣu bibhrataḥ | | 2.148.110 | | prajāvantaḥ sacemahi svarṇavantoḥ bhavemahi | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ dhanada ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | | 111 | | ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ | vāyūttarāntarālasthastaṃbhaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ gurum | | 112|| āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi praṇamāmi girāṃ nidhim | atrāgaccha bṛhaspate staṃbhe pañcadaśe viśa | | 11 3| | oṃ bṛhaspate atiyadaryo arhādyumadvibhāti kratumajjaneṣu | yaddīdayacchavasa ṛtapprajāta tadasmāsu draviṇaṃ dhehi citram | | 11 4| | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ bṛhaspate ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ | | 11 5|| uttareśānayormadhyestaṃbhe tu viśvakarmakam | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi praṇamāmi sutejasam || 116|| śvetaṃ śilpakalāḍhyaṃ ca sarvajñaṃ ca sanātanam | atrāgaccha viśvakarman staṃbhe ṣoḍaśake viśa | | 117 oṃ viśvakarman haviṣā vardhanena trātāramindramakṛṇoravarddhayam | tasmai viśaḥ samanamantapūrvīrayamugro vihavyo yathāsat | | 118 o bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ viśvakarmannihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ | | 119 ityevaṃ ṣoḍaśastaṃbhān pūjayed rādhike dharān | yadāha bhagavān kṛṣṇastatte proktaṃ mayātra ca | | 2.148.120 iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā dvitīye tretāsantāne devapratiṣṭhāne catuṣṣaṣṭiyoginīpañcāśatkṣetrapālamaṇḍapī ṣoḍaśastaṃbhadevāvāhanapūjanādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭacatvāriṃ śadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ | | 148 | |
<2.149> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścād bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ | devāyatanabhaktāya yajjagāda vadāmi te | 1 | oṃ nāgamātre nama iti balikāṣṭhāni pūjayet | candanaṃ kusumaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyamarpayet |2 | oṃ sarvebhyo nama iti śākhodbandhanamarcayet candanaṃ kusumaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyamarpayet | 3| nirgatya paścimadvārāt pūrvadvārasya toraṇam | pūjayenmaṇḍapātpūrve hastamātre bahiḥśubham |4 | aśvatthaṃ sudṛḍhākhyaṃ sindūravarṇaṃ hi toraṇam | mahendraparvatayutaṃ śaṃkhākitaṃ hi pūjayet |5 | oṃ aśvatthatoraṇaṃ cainaṃ yajñaṃ rakṣa prarakṣya ca | sarvān vighnān vārayātra sthitaṃ sthiraṃ namāmi te | 6| oṃ agnimīle purohitaṃ yajñasya devamṛtvijam | hotāraṃ ratnadhātamaṃ rakṣa maṇḍapasārthakam |7 | oṃ ṛgvedādhiṣṭhitāya sudṛḍhatorāṇāya ca | namaḥ sudṛḍhatoraṇa cāvāhayāmi te namaḥ |8 | gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam | tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gṛhṇa dṛṇatoraṇa te namaḥ |9| omatra tiṣṭhate kṛtayugāya ca namo namaḥ | kṛtaṃ yugaṃ toraṇe cāvāhayāmi ca te namaḥ |2.149.10 | gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam | tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gṛhṇa satyayuga ca te namaḥ | 11| tatraiva rāhave nama āvāhayāmi rāhukam | gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam |12| tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gṛhṇa rāho deva ca te namaḥ | bṛhaspataye nama āvāhayāmi bṛhaspatim || 1 3|| gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam | tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gṛhṇa bṛhaspate ca te namaḥ || 14|| tatraikaṃ kalaśaṃ dhṛtvā mahīṃ spṛṣṭvā manuṃ vadet| | oṃ mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca naḥ imaṃ yajñaṃ mimikṣatām || 15|| pipṛtānno bharīmabhiḥ samṛddhānno rasādibhiḥ | tatra cauṣadhayaḥ kṣepyā yavāḥ kṣepyā manuplutāḥ || 16 || oṃ oṣadhayaḥ samavadante somena saha rājñā | yasmai kṛṇoti brāhmaṇastaṃ rājan pārayāmasi || 17|| kalaśaṃ bhūtale cātha nidhāya ca manu vadet | oṃ ājighra kalaśaṃ mahyā tvā viśantvindavaḥ || 18 | | punarūrjā nivartasva śānaḥ sahasraṃ dhukṣva | urudhārā payasvatī punarmā viśatādrayiḥ || 19 || jalenāpūrya kalaśaṃ tīrthaṃ smṛtvā manu vadet | oṃ varuṇasyottambhanamasi varuṇasya skaṃbhasarjanīsthaḥ || 2.149.20 || varuṇasya ṛtasadanyasi varuṇasya ṛtasadanamasi | varuṇasya ṛtasadanamāsīda sarvatīrthamṛto bhava || 21 || atha gandhaṃ prakṣipecca kalaśe tīrthavāriṣu | oṃ gandhadvārāṃ durādharṣāṃ nityapuṣṭāṃ kariṣiṇīm || 22|| īśvarīṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tāmihopahvaye śriyam | sarvauṣadhīstatra tataḥ kṣipettāsāṃ manūn gṛṇan || 23 | | oṃ yā oṣadhīḥ pūrvā yātā devebhyastriyugaṃ purā | manainu babhrūṇāmahaḥ śataṃ dhāmāni sapta ca || 24|| atha dūrvāḥ kṣipet tatra dūrvāyāśca manuṃ gṛṇan | oṃ kāṇḍātkāṇḍātprarohantī paruṣaḥ paruṣaspari || 25 || evā no dūrve pratanu sahasreṇa śatena ca | atha tatra kṣipet pañcapallavān tanmanuṃ gṛṇan || 26 || oṃ aśvatthe vo niṣadanaṃ parṇe vo vasatiḥ kṛtā | gobhāja it kilāsatha yatsanavatha pūruṣam || 27||| atha saptamṛttikāścārpayet tāsāṃ manuṃ gṛṇan | oṃ syonā pṛthivī no bhavānṛkṣarā niveśinī || 28 || yacchā naḥ śarma saprathāḥ puṣṭidā bhavatheha ca | atha pūgīphalaṃ dadyāt tasyāpi ca manuṃ gṛṇan || 29 || oṃ yāḥ phalinīryā aphalā apuṣpā yāśca puṣpiṇīḥ | bṛhaspatiprasūtāstā no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ || 2.149.30 || atha pañcaiva ratnāni nyasetteṣāṃ manuṃ gṛṇan | oṃ pari vājapatiḥ kaviragnirhavyānyakramīt || 31 || dadhad ratnāni dāśuṣe sarvaratnāni cāvaha | atha kṣipeddhiraṇyaṃ ca hiraṇyagarbhakaṃ gṛṇan || 32|| oṃ hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt | sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema || 33 || atha vastraṃ veṣṭayecca yuvāsumantramuccaran | tejovāsāṃsi ramyāṇi datsva svarṇāni dhāraya || 34|| oṃ yuvā suvāsāḥ parivīta āgātsa u śreyān bhavati jāyamānaḥ | taṃ dhīrāsaḥ kavayaṃ unnayanti svādhyo manasā devayantaḥ || 3 5|| atha dhānyādinā pūrṇaṃ pātraṃ nidhāya tacchiraḥ | oṃ pūrṇā darvi parāpata supūrṇā punarāpata || 36 || vasneva vikrīṇāvahā iṣamūrjjaṃ śatakrato | itimantreṇa saṃskṛtya kalaśe dhruvamāhvayet || 37 || o dhruvaṃ cāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi namaśca te | gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ cārpayāmi te || 38 || pūjayāmi makhe cātra dhruvo dhruvataro bhava | tataśca dakṣiṇe gatvā audumbaraṃ ca toraṇam || 39 || vikaṭākhyaṃ cakracihnaṃ vindhyanāmādrisaṃyutam | dhūmravarṇaṃ toraṇaṃ cāvāhayāmyarcayāmi ca ||2.149.40 | | ehi vikaṭatoraṇa tvaṃ yajñaṃ rakṣa prarakṣa ca | vighnānnivārayetastāt rasān smṛddhiṃ pradāpaya ||4 1 || oṃ iṣe tvorje tvā vāyava sttha devo vaḥ | savitā prārpayatu śreṣṭhatamāya karmaṇaḥ | āpyāyaddhamaghnyā indrāya bhāgaṃ prajāvatīranamīvā ayakṣmā||42|| māvastena īśatamāghaśaṃso dhruvā asmin | gopatau syāta bahvīḥ yajamānasya paśūn pāhi | gomahiṣīḥ gajāśvān gavayān pāhi govṛṣāṃśca ||43 || oṃ yajurvedādhiṣṭhitāya vikaṭatoraṇāya te | namastvāmāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca te namaḥ ||44| | gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam | tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gṛhṇa vikaṭatoraṇa te namaḥ ||45 || omatra tiṣṭhate tretāyugāya ca namo namaḥ | tretāyugaṃ toraṇe cāvāhayāmi ca te namaḥ ||46 || gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpo naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam | tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gṛhṇa tretāyugaṃ ca te namaḥ ||47|| tatraiva sūryāya nama āvāhayāmi sūryakam | aṃgārakāya ca nama āhvayāmi cāṃgārakam ||48|| gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam | tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gṛhṇataṃ yuvābhyāṃ namo namaḥ | |49 || tatraikaḥ kalaśaḥ sthāpyaḥ pūrvoktavidhibhiśca saḥ | pūjanīyastatra dharāmāhvayāmi ca te namaḥ || 2.149.50 || gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca phala jalam | tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gṛhṇaṃ dhare sampaddharā bhava || 51 || tata ācamya ca paśce gatvā plākṣaṃ hi toraṇam | subhīmākhyaṃ svarṇarūpaṃ gandhamādanaśobhitam ||5 2 || gadāṃkitaṃ ca vinyasya pūjayettanmanuṃ gṛṇan | ehyehi subhīmatoraṇa yajñaṃ rakṣa prarakṣa ca | |5 3 | | sarvavighnānnivāraya rasān sarvān samāhvaya | oṃ agna āyāhi vītaye gṛṇāno havyadātaye ||54|| nihotā satsi barhiṣi sāmasaukhyaṃ vidhehi naḥ | oṃ sāmavedādhiṣṭhitāya subhīmatoraṇāya te ||55 || namaḥ āvāhayāmi tvāṃ tasmai te ca namo namaḥ | tadatra dvāparayugamāhvayāmi namo’stu ca ||56 || gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam | tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gṛhṇa dvāparāya ca te namaḥ ||57|| tatra śukrāya ca namaḥ śukramāvāhayāmi ca | tatra budhāya ca namo budhamāvāhayāmi ca ||58 | | gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam | tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gṛhṇa taṃ yuvābhyāṃ namo namaḥ | |59 || tatraikaḥ kalaśaḥ sthāpyaḥ pūrvoktavidhibhiśca saḥ | pūjyastatra vākpatiṃ cāvāhayāmi ca te namaḥ || 2.149.60 || gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam | tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gṛhṇa vākpate vākprado bhava || 61 || tata ācamyottare ca gatvā vaṭātmatoraṇam | suprabhākhyaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ himādriśobhitaṃ śubham || 62 || padmāṃkitaṃ ca vinyasya pūjayet tanmanuṃ gṛṇan | ehyehi suprabhatoraṇa yajñaṃ rakṣa prarakṣa ca || 63 || sarvavighnān nivāraya prabhāḥ sarvāḥ samānaya | oṃ śanno devīrabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu prītaye || 64|| śaṃyyorabhi sravantu naḥ tejāṃsi vardhayantu naḥ | o atharvavedādhiṣṭhitāya suprabhātoraṇāya te || 65|| nama āvāhayāmi tvāṃ tasmai te ca namo namaḥ | tadatra ca kaliyugamāhvayāmi namo’stu ca || 66 || gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam | tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gṛhṇan kaliyugāya te namaḥ ||67|| tatra somāya ca namaḥ somamāvāhayāmi ca ketave tatra ca namaḥ ketumāvāhayāmi ca||68 śanaiścarāya namaḥ śanimāvāhayāmi ca gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam||69 tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gṛhṇataitebhyaśca namo namaḥ tatraikaḥ kalaśaḥ sthāpyaḥ pūrvoktavidhibhiśca saḥ||2.149.70 pūjyastatra ca vighneśamāhvayāmi ca te namaḥ gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam ||71 tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gṛhna vighneśa siddhido bhava|| tataḥ pūrve ca gatvaiva mahīdyauriti saṃgṛṇan ||72 sthāpayecca pratidvāraśākhaṃ tu kalaśadvayam āvartanīyā mantrāste tattaddikkalaśaprathāḥ ||73 pūrvadvāre kalaśobhayake cairāvatābhidham | diggajaṃ cāvāhayāmi airāvatāya te namaḥ ||74 gandhādyaṃ tāmbūlakāntaṃ cārpayāmi ca pūjanam | kalaśopari sandeyo ghṛtadīpaḥ suśobhanaḥ ||75 tatra ṛgvidhinā prāthyo ṛtvijau brahmadaivatau | ṛgvedaḥ padmapatrākṣo gāyatraḥ somadaivataḥ ||76 atrigotrastu viprendra ṛtvik tvaṃ me bhava | oṃ agnimīle purohitaṃ yajñasya devamṛtvijam ||77 hotāraṃ ratnadhātamaṃ gandhādyaiḥ pūjayāmi ca | śrīsūktaṃ pāvamānaṃ ca somasūktaṃ sumaṃgalam ||78 pauruṣaṃ rudrasūktaṃ ca vāmadevyaṃ ca vai vadet | sahasrākṣaṃ gajasthaṃ sapītakirīṭakuṇḍalam ||79 dakṣavāmakaravajrotpalaṃ dhyāyenmahendrakam | āgacchāmarasaṃstutya rakṣa yajña ca te namaḥ ||2.149.80 o bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ indra ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | sāṃgaṃ saparivāraṃ sāyudhaṃ tathā saśaktikam ||81 indraṃ ca dvārakalaśe hvayāmi pūjayāmi ca | samucchreyetpītavarṇau patākāṃ dhvajakau tathā ||82 oṃ trātāramindramavitāramindraṃ have have suhavaṃ śūramindram | hvayāmi śakraṃ puruhūtamindraṃ svasti no maghavā dhātvindraḥ ||83 śākhāyāṃ dakṣiṇe dhātre vidhātre cottare namaḥ | dvāraśriyai namaścordhvaṃ gaṇādhipataye namaḥ ||2.149.84 tadūrdhve ca namo vāstupuruṣāya sutejase | namaścādho nu dehalyai kṣamāśaktyai namo namaḥ ||85 vāme staṃbhe gaṇeśāya dakṣe skandāya vai namaḥ | kalaśayośca gaṃgāyai yamunāyai namo namaḥ ||86 indrādibhyaḥ surabhyaśca gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ jala phalam | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ dakṣiṇāmarpayāmi ca || 87|| sāṃgāyendrāya saparivārāya sāyudhāya ca | saśaktikāya ca māṣabaliṃ dadāmi te namaḥ ||88 || iti datvā baliṃ cācāmeccāgneyīṃ diśaṃ tataḥ | gatvā ca pūrvavat nyasya kalaśaṃ sarva daivatam | |8 9 || tatra ca puṇḍarīkāya nama āvāhayāmi tam | amṛtāya nama amṛtaṃ cāhvayāmi vai tataḥ | | 2.149.90 | | gandhādyaiḥ parisampūjya pradātavyaśca dīpakaḥ | tataścāgniṃ chāgapṛṣṭhasthitaṃ raktaṃ tajihvakam | | 91 || dakṣe śaktiṃ kare vāme kamaṇḍaluṃ śiraḥśikhām | yajñasūtradadhānaṃ ca dhyāyedāvāhayenmakhī || 92 || oṃ ehyehi sarvāmarahavyavāha munipravaryairabhito’bhijuṣṭa | tejovatā lokagaṇena sārdhaṃ mamādhvaraṃ pāhi kave namaste | | 93 || oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ agne ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | kalaśe’tra samāgaccha tiṣṭha cāvāhayāmi vai | | 94|| oṃ tvanno agne tava devapāyubhirmaghono rakṣa tanvaśca vaṃdya | trātā tokasya tanaye gavāmasya nimeṣaṃ rakṣamāṇastava vrate | | 95 || evamabhyarcya ca gandhādibhirnaivedyakāntakaiḥ | oṃ agniṃ dūtaṃ purodadhe havyavāhamupabruve | | 96 || devān āsādayādihetyuktvā raktāṃ dhvajāṃ tathā | raktāṃ patākāṃ samucchrayet praśaṃprārthayet tataḥ | | 97|| āgneyaḥ puruṣo raktaḥ sarvadevamayo’vyayaḥ | dhūmraketurajo’dhyakṣastasmāt kṣamāṃ samarthaye || 98 || sāṃgāya agnaye parivārāyudhayutāya ca | māṣabhaktabaliṃ cārpayāmi saśaktikāya ca | | 99 || iti datvā baliṃ cācāmecca yāyācca dakṣiṇām | tatra pratidvāraśākhaṃ saṃsthāpya kalaśadvayam | | 2.149.100 || tatraiva vāmanākhyaṃ diggajaṃ cāvāhayettataḥ | pūjayet supradīpaṃ ca dadet saṃpraṇamettathā || 101 || yajurvedidvārapālau vṛṇuyād vai manuṃ gṛṇan | kātarākṣo yajurvedastraiṣṭubho viṣṇudaivataḥ || 102|| kāśyapeyastu viprendra ṛtvik tvaṃ me makhe bhava | iti vṛtvā tu pratyekaṃ gandhādibhiḥ prapūjayet || 103 || ā no bhadrānuvākaśca āśuḥ śiśānakastathā | yaddevā trīṇi ca paṭhet tato’ṣṭau ca punantu mām || 1 04|| mahiṣasthaṃ yamaṃ dakṣavāmayoḥ daṇḍapāśinam | kṛṣṇaṃ vahnisamanetraṃ dhyātvā namo manuṃ vadet || 1 05|| ehyehi vaivasvata dharmarāja sarvāmarairarcitadharmamūrte | śubhāśubhānandaśucāmadhīśa śivāya naḥ pāhi makhaṃ namaste| | 106 | | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ yama ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | yama sāṃgaṃ sakuṭumbaṃ cāvāhya kalaśe tataḥ | | 107 | | oṃ yamāya tvāṃ girasvate pitṛmate ca svāhā | svāhā gharmāya svāhā gharmaḥ pitre yamāya namaḥ | | 108 | | gandhādibhistaṃ saṃpūjyaśca kṛṣṇapatākikādhvajau | ucchrayecca makhī gṛṇan mantraṃ yamāya vai namaḥ | | 109 | | om āyaṅgauḥ praśnīrakramīdasadanmātarampuraḥ | pitaraṃ ca prayantsvaḥ tataḥ saṃprārthayenmakhī | | 2.149.110 | | vaivasvata mahādeva namaste dharmasākṣika | śivājñāpihito deva diśaṃ rakṣa bhavāniha | | 111 | | balāya sabalāya ca namo vai dvāraśākhayoḥ | śriyai cordhvaṃ namo gaṇapataye ca namo namaḥ | | 11 2| | namo’dhastāñca dehalyai vāstupuṃse namo namaḥ | staṃbhayoḥ puṣpadantāya kapardine namo namaḥ || 113 | | godāvaryai ca kṛṣṇāyaiḥ namo’stu kalaśadvaye | yamāya sakuṭumbāya māṣabhaktabaliṃ dade | 11 4| | ācamya ca tato gacchenairṛtyāṃ kalaśaṃ dadet | kumudaṃ durjayaṃ cāvāhayāmi vo namo namaḥ | | 115 | | dīpaṃ datvā narasthaṃ nairṛtiṃ nīlaṃ sakhaḍgakam | rakṣoyutaṃ pītabhūṣaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayecca tam || 116 | | rakṣaḥpiśācavetālairyutaścaihi kratuṃ hyava | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ nirṛte ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 117 | | oṃ asunvaṃtamayajamānamicchastenasyetyāmanvihistaskarasya | annyamasmmadicchasātaityānamo devinirṛte tubhyamastu | | 118 | | iti natvā ca saṃpūjya ghaṭe nairṛtameva ca | oṃ moṣuṇaḥ parāparānirṛtirdurhaṇāvadhīt | | 119 | | padīṣṭhatṛṣṇayā saha nīlapatākādhvajāvucchrayet | śavasthastvaṃ yajñarakṣāṃ kuru rakṣobhya eva ca | | 2.149.120 | | nirṛtaye sāṃgaparivārāya pradadāmi ca | māṣabhaktabaliṃ natvā gatvā ca paścime tataḥ | | 121 | | sthāpayecca pratiśākhaṃ pūrvavat kalaśadvayam | tatrāṃjanābhidhaṃ cāvāhayāmi diggajaṃ tataḥ || 122 | | pūjayāmi tataḥ sāmavedinau dvārapālakau | sāmavedastu piṃgākṣo jāgrataḥ śakradaivataḥ | | 123 || bhāradvājastu viprendra ṛtvik tvaṃ me makhe bhava | vṛtveti omagne āyāhi vītaye gṛṇāno havyadātaye || 1 24|| nihotā satsi barhiṣi iti gandhādibhistadā | sampūjyendrāya ca sāma gāyato dvau sugītikam || 1 25|| ahamasmi prathamajā setūṃ starā svadiṣṭyā | gāyanti tvā gāyatriṇaḥ dvārapālajapo bhavet || 1 26|| makarasthaṃ pāśahastaṃ dhyātvā ca varuṇaṃ sitam | ehi yādo’psaromeghavidyādhraiḥ pāhi te namaḥ || 1 27|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | kalaśayoḥ sāṃgamāvāhayāmi tvāṃ namāmi ca || 1 28|| tattvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānastadāśāste yajamāno havirbhiḥ| aheḍamāno varuṇeha boddhyuruśaṃsaḥ mā na āyuḥ pramoṣīḥ || 1 29|| varuṇāya namaḥ saṃpūjayāmi gandhavastubhiḥ | imamme varuṇa śrudhī havamadyā ca mṛḍaya || 2.149.130 || tvāmavasyurācake śvetapatākādhvajāvucchrayet | natvā ca varuṇaṃ jayaṃ vijayaṃ dvāraśākhayoḥ || 131 || ūrdhvaṃ śriyaṃ gaṇapatim adhaśca dehalīṃ tathā | vāstupuṃsaṃ staṃbhayornandinaṃ candraṃ namāmi ca || 1 32|| revāyai narmadāyai ca kalaśayornamāmi ca | pūjayāmi varuṇaṃ sakuṭumbaṃ māṣayugbalim || 133|| arpayāmi tato gatvā vāyavyāṃ kalaśaṃ dade | puṣpadantaṃ ca siddhārthaṃ cāhvayāmi namāmi ca || 1 34|| pūjayāmi pradīpaṃ ca dadāmi cintaye’nilam | mṛgasthaṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ ca citrāmbaraṃ ca cañcalam || 1 35|| varadhvajadharaṃ dakṣavāmayoḥ karayostataḥ | ehi yajñe rakṣaṇāya pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ || 1 36|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vāyo ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | praṇamāmi vahnisakhaṃ pūjayāmi manuṃ gṛṇan || 137|| oṃ āno niyudbhiḥ śatinībhiradhvaraṃ sahasriṇībhirupayāhi yajñam | vāyo asmin savane mādayasva yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ || 138|| oṃ vāyo ye te sahasriṇo rathāsastebhirāgahi | niyutvānsomapītaye dhūmrapatākādhvajāvucchrayet || 1 39|| vāyuṃ namāmi sāṃgāya dadāmi māṣayugbalim | gatvottare pratiśākhaṃ nidhāya kalaśadvayam || 2.149.140|| tatra sārvabhaumadiggajamāhvayāmi te namaḥ | dīpaṃ dadāmi cātharvavedinau dvārapālakau |||141||| bṛhannetro’tharvavedo hyanuṣṭup rudradaivataḥ | vaṃśapāyana viprendra ṛtvik tvaṃ me makhe bhava|| 142|| vṛtveti śanno devīrabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu prītaye | śaṃyyorabhisravantu naḥ gandhādyairarcayāmi ca || 143 | atharvāgirasaṃ caiva atharvaśirasaṃ tathā | śāntyādhyāyamityādidvārapālajayo bhavet| || 1 44|| narayānasthamābhūṣaṃ vastragadākaradvayam | haritābhaṃ kuberaṃ ca dhyāyāmi pūjayāmi ca || 145|| ehi vidhatsva rakṣāṃ no nakṣatrauṣadhipitṛbhiḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ kubera ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 1 46|| oṃ vayarṭha somavrate tava manastanūṣu bibhrataḥ | prajāvantaḥ sacemahi namāmi pūjayāmi ca || 147| oṃ āpyāyasva sametu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam | bhavā vājasya saṃgathe haritau patākādhvajāvucchrayet || 148| kuberāya tu somāya namāmi dvāraśākhayoḥ | pracaṇḍāya ca caṇḍāya namo dvāraśriyai namaḥ || 149| gaṇeśāya namaścādho dehalyai ca namo namaḥ | vāstupuṃse stambhayostu mahākālāya bhṛṃgiṇe || 2.149.150 | namaḥ kalaśayorvāruṇyai veṇyai ca namo namaḥ | namaḥ śrīkalaśāyāstu tatsthasurebhya oṃ namaḥ || 151| kuberasomarūpāya sāṃgāya māṣayugbalim | dadāmi yāmi caiśānyāṃ kalaśaṃ sthāpayāmi ca || 1 52| supratīkāya ca tatra maṃgalāya namo’rcaye | dadāmi dīpakaṃ vṛṣārūḍhaṃ vastriśūlakam || 153 | dakṣavāmakarayośca dadhataṃ tryakṣamujjvalam | dhyāyāmīśānadevaṃ cāvāhayāmi namāmi ca |||154 ehi yajñasya siddhyarthaṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa namo’stu te | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ īśāna ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca|||155 oṃ tamīśānaṃ jagatastasthuṣaspatiṃ dhiyaṃ jinvamavase hūmahe vayam | pūṣā no yathā vedasāmasadvṛddherakṣitā pāyuradabdhaḥ svastaye |156 iti saṃpūjya ca natvā śūlapāṇiṃ trinetrakam | | tamīśāneti mantreṇa pañcavarṇapatākādhvajāvucchrayet || 157 sāṃgāyeśānakāyemaṃ māṣayugbalimarpaye | īśānapūrvayormadhye ūrdhvamuddiśya vai ghaṭam || 158 nidhāya tatra brahmāṇaṃ pūjayed gandhavastubhiḥ | akṣasūtrakuśamuṣṭidharadakṣiṇahastakam ||| 159 sruvakamaṇḍaludharavāmakaraṃ caturmukham | śmaśrulaṃ jaṭilaṃ cājaṃ dhyāyāmi pūjayāmi ca || 2.149.160 ehi sarvapitaryajñe śivaṃ vidhehi no makhe | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ brahmannihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 161 || oṃ brahmayajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastād visīmataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ | savudhnyā upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ santaśca yonirasataśca vivaḥ || 162|| pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ raktapatākādhvajāvucchrayet | natvā taṃ brahmaṇe māṣabhaktabaliṃ dadāmi ca || 163 || tato nirṛtivaruṇāntarāle nyasya vai ghaṭam | tatrādho’nantaśayanāsīnaṃ phaṇābhimaṇḍitam || 164|| padmaśaṃkhadharordhvādhodakṣiṇahastakadvayam | nīlaṃ cānantakaṃ dhyātvā ehītyāvāhayet tataḥ || 165|| rakṣa nāgābhipūjyāṃghre’dhvaraṃ nastaladhṛk prabho | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ ananta ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 166|| āvāhayāmi sāṃgaṃ saparivāraṃ saśaktikam | oṃ āyaṃ gauḥ praśnirakramīdasadanmātaraṃ puraḥ || 167|| pitaraṃ ca priyaṃssvaḥ anantāya namo namaḥ | āyaṃgauriti dhūmrau patākādhvajau samucchrayet || 168|| anantāya ca sāṃgāya māṣayugbalimarpayet | tato maṇḍapamadhye cāmarakiṃkiṇikāyutaḥ || 169|| ṣoḍaśahastako daṇḍo daśahastamito’pi vā | trihastalambahastāyapañcavarṇadhvajānvitaḥ || 2.149.170|| omindrasya vṛṣṇo iti mantreṇordhvaṃ dhṛto bhavet | brahmayajñānamiti ca brahmāṇaṃ pūjayet tataḥ || 171 || namet ṣoḍaśastambhasthadevān dhyātvā punaḥ punaḥ | vaṃśeṣu kinnarebhyaḥ pannagebhyaḥ pṛṣṭhake namaḥ || 172|| pūjayitvā ca tān pūrvadiśi bhūmiṃ vilipya ca | maṇḍapād bahiretasyāmupaviśya vadenmakhī || 173 || caturdaśastaravāsā jāḍāścetanavargakāḥ | brahmaviṣṇuharavyāptā rakṣantu ca makhaṃ hi naḥ || 174|| siddhāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā āsurarākṣasāḥ | dānavā yakṣagandharvā bhūtāḥ piśācakādayaḥ || 175|| mānavāḥ paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaśca pādapajātayaḥ | sūkṣmadehāḥ sarpagaṇā makhaṃ rakṣantu nastathā || 176|| sarve devā īśvarāśca īśvarāṇyaśca bhūmipāḥ | kṣetrapā lokapāḥ sarve makhaṃ rakṣantu maṇḍapam || 177|| ghnantu vighnān duritām̐śca virodhinaśca vai makhe | sthāvarāṇi carāṇyāvāhayāmi pūjayāmi ca || 178|| namāmi saṃsmarāmyeva brahmaṇe viṣṇave namaḥ | devebhyo dānavebhyaśca gandharvebhyo namo namaḥ || 179|| siddharṣibhyaśca pitṛbhya āsurebhyo namo namaḥ | rākṣasebhyaśca yakṣebhyo bhūtebhyaśca namo namaḥ || 2.149.180|| piśācebhyo mānavebhyaḥ paśupakṣibhya ityapi | śākhibhyaḥ sūkṣmadehebhyaḥ sarpebhyaśca namo namaḥ || 181 || īśebhyaśceśvarāṇībhyo bhūmipebhyo namo namaḥ | kṣetrapebhyo lokapebhyo namaḥ sthiracarādaye || 182|| mātṛbhyo brahmasatībhyo namaścāvāhayāmi tān | pūjayāmi smarāmyetān dadāmi yogyabhājanam || 183 || māṣabaliṃ pāyasādīn phalāmṛtādikaṃ tathā | iti pūjāṃ vidhāyaiva sarvebhyo vai namo namaḥ || 184|| yajamānastathācāryaḥ ṛtvik dhautāṃghrihastakāḥ | ācāntāḥ pūrvadvāreṇa praviśeyurhi maṇḍapam || 185|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne toraṇakalaśadvāraśākhādehalītaddevādīnāṃ ṣoḍaśopacārapūjanādinirūpaṇanāmā navacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 149 ||
<2.150> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścād yat kartavyaṃ tadāha ca | anādiśrīharirbhaktāya tvā sarva vadāmi tat || 1 || śuddhimān yajamānaśca dakṣiṇadvārasannidhau | paścimāṃśe udaṅmukhaścopaviśya dvijostataḥ || 2 || kurudhvaṃ tu kratoḥ karma yathāvihitamādarāt | ityarthayet tataḥ pūrvakuṇḍe ṛgvedinau dvijau || 3 || hotārābupaviśetā brahmā tu paścimānanaḥ | homakartāparaścodaṅmukhastataśca dakṣiṇi || 4 || kuṇḍe yajurvedinau ca brahmā tatra hyudaṅamukhaḥ | pūrvamukho homakartā tataḥ paścimakuṇḍake || 5 || sāmavedidvijāvuttarakuṇḍe’tharvavedinau | tathāparau jāpaka1 dvau śāyapyadhikabhūsurau || 6 || tattadvedavidau copaviśetāṃ vai yathāsanam | tata ācārya indreśānayormadhye svakuṇḍake || 7 || upāviśet prāṅmukho’tha brahmā tūdaṅmukhastathā | guruḥ svakuṇḍe āgatya svagṛhyoktavidhānataḥ || 8 || agniṃ saṃsthāpayet pañcakuṇḍike’nye’pi tattathā | kuryuścāgnisthāpanaṃ caikakuṇḍe tu yathāyatham || 9 || ācāryaḥ prāṅmukho brahmodaṅmukhaḥ samupāviśet | prathamaṃ kuṇḍapūjāṃ ca kuryādvai yajamānakaḥ || 2.150.1 0|| svayamagneścāyatanādupaviśya ca dakṣiṇe | ācāryaścopaviśyaiva kuṇḍapaścimatastadā || 1 1|| ācamya ca tathā prāṇānāyamya ca tato vadet | apasarpantu ye bhūtā ye bhūtā bhūmisaṃsthitāḥ || 12|| ye bhūtā vighnakartāro dūraṃ yāntu makhakṣiteḥ | vikīrya sarṣapān pañcagavyena prokṣya maṇḍapam || 1 3|| kuṇḍaṃ ca yajñasaṃbhārān gurubhyo nama āvadet | gaṇeśaṃ sampraṇamyāpi kare dhṛtvākṣatādikam || 14|| gandhapuṣpajalādyaṃ ca deśakālau prakīrtya ca | tadetaddevaprāsādotsargakarmaṇi bhāvataḥ || 15||| kariṣye’gnipratiṣṭhāṃ ca tadaṃgamārjanādikam | mekhalāyonidevānāṃ sthāpanaṃ pūjanaṃ tathā || 16|| tataścāgnerāyatanaṃ saṃmṛjya kuśavāriṇā | kuṇḍaṃ prokṣyāñjalau puṣpāṇyādāya kuṇḍamāspṛśet || 17|| āvāhayāmi tatkuṇḍaṃ viśvakarmavinirmitam | śārīraṃ yacca te divyamagnyadhiṣṭhānamadbhutam || 18|| ye ca kuṇḍe sthitā devāḥ kuṇḍāgre yāśca devatāḥ | ṛddhiṃ yacchantu tāḥ sarvā yajñasiddhiṃ samāhitāḥ || 19|| he kuṇḍa vāñchitāṃ yajña siddhiṃ dadātu no hitām | iti prārthya kuṇḍamadhye viśvakarmāṇamarcayet ||2.150.20|| oṃ viśvakarman haviṣā vardhanena trātāramindramakṛṇoravaddhyam| tasmai viśaḥ samanamaṃta pūrvīrayamugro vihavyo yathā sat || 21 || upayāma gṛhīto’sīndrāya tvā viśvakarmaṇaḥ | eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā viśvakarmaṇe oṃ namaḥ ||22|| sampūjya candanādyaiśca prārthayet khātaśuddhaye | jñātājñātakhātadoṣān vināśaya namo’stu te ||23|| śvetāyāṃ mekhalāyāṃ śrīviṣṇumāvāhayettataḥ | oṃ viṣṇo yajñarakṣārthaṃ kuṇḍe sannihito bhava || 24|| auṃ idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame tredhā vai nidadhe padam | samūḍhamasya pāṇḍure svāhārcayāmi cakriṇam ||25|| sampūjya śrīhariṃ viṣṇumekhalāyai namo namaḥ | śvetādyamekhalāmārcya tato raktāṃ tu madhyamām ||26|| mekhalāṃ tatra brahmāṇaṃ cāvāhayet manuṃ gṛṇan | haṃsastho yajñarakṣārthaṃ kuṇḍe’smin sannidho bhava || 27|| oṃ brahmayajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastād visīmataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ | sabudhnyā upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ sataśca yonirasataśca vvivaḥ ||28|| brahmāṇamitisampūjya mekhalāyai namo namaḥ | raktāṃ brahmādhiṣṭhitāṃ ca mekhalāṃ pūjayenmakhī ||29|| tato’dho mekhalāyāṃ tu kṛṣṇāyāṃ rudrameva ca | āvāhayāmi vṛṣagaṃ gaṃgādharaṃ pinākinam ||2.150.3 0|| āgaccha bhagavan rudra kuṇḍe’smin sannidho bhava | oṃ namaste rudra mannyava uto’ta iṣave namaḥ ||3 1 || bāhubhyāmuta te namo mekhalāyai namo namaḥ | rudradevāṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāṃ mekhalāṃ pūjayenmakhī ||32|| kuṇḍe trikoṇe vṛtte ṣaṭkoṇe padme’ṣṭakoṇake | yoniryojyā paścime’gryaṃ bhavetpūrvamukhaṃ tathā ||33 || koṇe kuṇḍe yonikuṇḍe yoniḥ kāryā na sarvathā | kṣetrārdhamānalambā ca kṣetryaṃśāyatā tathā ||34|| caturviṃśatyaṃśordhvā ca samekhalāgranimnagā | praviṣṭā kuṇḍamagrerdhagoladvayayutā tathā || 35|| viśālamūlā samadhyanālāśvatthadalākṛtiḥ | brahmādhānasvarūpā sā pūjanīyā hi kuṇḍake ||36|| namo jagaddhetukāyai brahmadhātryai ca te namaḥ | oṃ sarvasya yonirasi sarvasya nābhirapyasi ||37|| gandhādibhiḥ pūjayāmi prārthayāmīṣṭasiddhaye | dehinastvāṃ prasevante puruṣārthān yunakti yā ||38|| yonirbrāhmī sukhadāyai brahmagarbhe ca te namaḥ | iti yoniṃ samarcyātha kaṇṭhapūjanamācaret ||3 9|| sragdharaṃ cottamāṃgasyādhāramāvāhayāmi ca | nīlagrīvāḥ śitikaṇṭhā divaṃ rudrā upaśritāḥ ||2.150.40 || teṣāṃ sahasrayojanevadhanvānitanmasi ca | iti sampūjya gandhādyaiḥ prārthayet kaṇṭhamujjvalam ||41 || kaṇṭha kuṇḍe sthito’bhito mekhalāste’si maṃgalaḥ | tata nābhiṃ pūjayecca kuṇḍābhāṃ padmabhāṃ ca vā ||42|| ādhārāṃ sarvakuṇḍānāṃ nābhimāvāhayāmi ca | nābhirme cittavijñānaṃ pāyurme’pacitirbhasat ||43|| ānandavandāvāṇḍau me bhagaḥ saubhāgyaṃpasaḥ | jaṃghābhyāṃ padbhyāṃ dharmo’si viśi rājā pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||44|| iti sampūjya nābhe tvaṃ sadevā kuṇḍake sthitā | bhava śubharddhidetyabhyarthya ca natvā punastataḥ ||45||| kuṇḍe nairṛtakoṇe vāstupuruṣaṃ prapūjayet | puṣpāṇyādāyāhvayāmi vāstuṃ prapūjayāmi ca ||46|| oṃ vāstoṣpate pratijānīhyasmān svāveśo anamīvo bhavā naḥ | yattvemahe pratitanno juṣasva śanno’bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||47|| gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ cārpayāmi ca | vāstupuruṣarūpāya baliṃ samarpayāmi ca ||48|| brahmaputraṃ rudraputraṃ sarvadevāśrayaṃ naram | vāstuṃ natvā tato’gniṃ sthāpayet kramānmakhī yathā ||49|| tuṣakeśakaṃkarādihīne kuṇḍe ca vā tathā | sthaṇḍile tu caturasrā bhūmiṃ samūhya satkuśaiḥ ||2.150.50|| īśānyāṃ ca kuśān tyaktvopalipyayā gomayodakeḥ | sphyena vā sruvamūlena prāgagradeśamātrakam ||51 || uttarottarakramatastrirullikhya tatastathā | ullekhanakrameṇaivānāmikāṃguṣṭhacipyayā ||52|| mṛdamuddhṛtya ca jalenābhyukṣya kāṃsyapātragam | vahniṃ kāṃsyānyapātreṇāpihitaṃ pratyaṅānanam ||53|| upasamādhāya gāyatrīmantreṇābhipūjya ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvassvastatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi ||54|| dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayād vahniṃ cāpūjayāmi ca | oṃ nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi ||55|| tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayād vahniṃ namāmi cintaye | tataśca yonimārgeṇa sthāpayet kuṇḍake’nalam ||56|| oṃ agnirmūrddhā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pṛthivyā ayam | apāṃ retāṃsi jinvati iti gṛṇan nidhāpayet ||57|| agneśca jīvanārthaṃ ca kiñcit samidh niyujya ca | vahnipātre jalādi kṣepayet tataśca vai śubham |||58||| ācāryakuṇḍakāyuddharaṇaṃ kuṇḍāntareṣu ca | agnisthāpanamādadhyāt tato navagrahārcanam ||59|| īśānyāṃ gṛhapīṭhe tu navagrahāhvanaṃ caret | raktapuṣpākṣatairmadhye vartulākārake ravim ||2.150.60|| prāṅmukhamāvāhayecca sthāpayecca manuṃ gṛṇan | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sūrya ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||61 || oṃ ākṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca | hiraṇmayena savitā rathenādevo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan ||62|| sūryāya ca namo gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ pūjayāmi ca | āgneyyāmardha candrābhe cakre śvetasumākṣataiḥ ||63|| candramāvāhayeddhyāyetpūjayeccandanādibhiḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ candra ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||64|| oṃ imaṃ devā asapatnaṃ suvadhvaṃ mahate kṣatrāya ca | mahate jyeṣṭhāya mahate jānarājyāyendriyasyendriyāya ||65 || imamamuṣya putramamuṣyai putramasyai viśa eṣa vaḥ | amī rājā somo’smākaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ rājā ca oṃ namaḥ ||66|| dakṣiṇasyāṃ trikoṇe tu raktapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ | dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ bhaumamāvāhayecca pūjayet ||67|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ bhauma ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | oṃ agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pṛthivyā ayam ||68|| apāṃ retāṃsi jinvati oṃ bhaumāya namo namaḥ | īśānyāṃ bāṇasadṛśe maṇḍale ca udaṅmukham || 69|| pītapuṣpākṣataiḥ ramyairbudhamāvāhya pūjayet| | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ budha ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||2.150.70|| oṃ udbudhya svāpneppratijāgṛhi tvamiṣṭvā pūrte sasṛje’thāmayaṃ ca | asmintsadhasthe addhyuttarasmin viśve devā yajamānaśca sīdata ||7 1|| uttare caturasre ca maṇḍale udaṅānanam | bṛhaspatiṃ pītapuṣpākṣatairāvāhayennameta ||72|| auṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ bṛhaspate ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | gandhapuṣpādibhirguruṃ pūjayāmi manuṃ gṛṇan ||73|| oṃ bṛhaspate atiyadaryo arhāddyumadvibhāti kratumajjaneṣu | yaddīdayacchavasaṛtaprajāta tadasmāsu draviṇaṃ dhehi citram ||74|| pūrve pañcakoṇake ca maṇḍale prāṅmukhaṃ kavim | śuklapuṣpākṣateḥ śukramāvāhayetprapūjayet ||75|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ śukra ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpādi saṃgṛhāṇa namāmi te ||76 || oṃ annāt parisruto rasaṃ brahmaṇā vyapibat kṣatraṃ payaḥ somaṃ prajāpatiḥ | ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipānaṃ śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payomṛtammadhu ||77|| paścime tu dhanustulye maṇḍale pratyaṅānanam | kṛṣṇapuṣpākṣataiḥ śanimāvāhayecca pūjayet ||78|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ śane cātra samāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | oṃ śanno devirabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye ||79|| śaṃyyorabhisravantu naḥ pūjayāmi namāmi ca | nairṛtye śūrpasadṛśe maṇḍale dakṣiṇānanam ||2.150.80|| kṛṣṇapūṣpākṣataiḥ rāhumāvāhayecca pūjayet | o bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ rāho cātrāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||8 1 || oṃ kayānaścitra ābhuvadūtīsadāvṛdhaḥ sakhā | kayā śaciṣṭhayāvṛtā pūjayāmi namāmi ca ||82|| vāyavyāṃ ca dhvajākāre maṇḍale dakṣiṇānanam | dhūmrapuṣpākṣataiḥ ketumāvāhayecca pūjayet ||83|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ keto ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | oṃ ketuṃ kṛṇvannaketave peśomaryā apeśase ||84|| samuṣadbhirajāyathāḥ pūjayāmi namāmi ca | athādhidevatā āvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca ||85|| ādityābhimukhāḥ sthāpyā devatā madhyake raviḥ | dakṣapārśve śvetapuṣpākṣataiḥ rudraṃ samāhvayet ||86|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ rudra samāgaccheha tiṣṭha ca | oṃ tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam ||87|| urvārukamiva bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt | āgneyyāṃ candradakṣe ca raktapuṣpākṣatairumām ||88|| āvāhayet sthāpayecca pūjayeccandanādibhiḥ | oṃ bhurbhuvaḥ svaḥ ume ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||89|| oṃ śrīśca te lakṣmīśca patnyāvahorātre pārśve nakṣatrāṇi rūpamaśvinau vyāttam | iṣṇanniṣāṇāmummaīṣāṇa sarvalokammaiṣāṇa umāyai namaḥ ||2.150.90|| yāmyāṃ bhaumasya dakṣe tu pītapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ | skandamāvāhayetsaṃpūjayennamecca saṃsmaret ||9 1|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ skanda ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyādi gṛhāṇa ca ||92|| oṃ yadakrandaḥ prathamaṃ jāyamānaḥ udyantsamudrāduta vā purīṣāt | śyenasya pakṣā hariṇasya bāhū upastutyaṃ mahijātante arvvan ||93 || īśānyāṃ budhadakṣe tu viṣṇuṃ pītasumākṣataiḥ | āvāhayed bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ viṣṇorāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ||94|| oṃ idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame tredhā vai nidadhe padam | samūḍhamasya pāṃsure svāhā ca viṣṇave namaḥ ||95|| uttare tu gurordakṣe śvetapuṣpākṣatairajam | āvāhayed bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ brahmannāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ||96|| oṃ brahmayajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastādvisīmataḥ suruco vvena āvaḥ| sabudhnyā upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ sataśca yonirasataśca vvivaḥ ||97|| pūrvasyāṃ śukradakṣe tu pītapuṣpākṣaterharim | āvāhayed bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ indra āgaccha tiṣṭha ca ||98|| oṃ trātāramindramavitāramindraṃ havehave suhavaṃ śūramindram | hvayāmi śakrampuruhūtamindraṃ svasti no maghavā dhātvindraḥ ||99|| paścime śanidakṣe ca kṛṣṇapuṣpākṣatairyamam | āvāhayed bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ yama āgaccha tiṣṭha ca || 2.150.1 00|| oṃ yamāya tvā makhāya tvā sūryyasya tvā tapase | devastvā savitāmaddhānaktupṛthivyāḥ saṃspṛśaspāhi || 101 || arccirasi śocirasi tapo’si yama te namaḥ | rāhordakṣe ca nairṛtyāṃ kālaṃ dhūmrasumākṣataiḥ || 1 02|| āvāhayed bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ kāla āgaccha tiṣṭha ca | oṃ kārṣirasi samudrasya tvā kṣityā unnayāmi || 1 03|| samāpo adbhiragmata samoṣadhībhiroṣadhīḥ kāla te namaḥ | vāyavyāṃ ketudakṣe tu raktapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || 1 04|| āvāhayeccitraguptamihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ citrāvaso svasti te pāramaśīya || 1 05|| pūjayāmīti vai rādhe’dhidevatāsamarcanam | śrīhariḥ prāha bhaktāya yattanmayā ta īritam || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne agnisthāpanakuṇḍadevamekhalādevayonivahnipūjanaṃ navagrahapūjanamadhidevatāpūjanaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 150 ||
<2.151> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike devāyatāya prāha yaddhariḥ | pratyadhidevatādyāvāhanādyaṃ kathayāmi te || 1 || madhye sūryasya vai vāme raktapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca agnimāvāhayāmyetiṣṭha ca || 2 || oṃ agniṃ dūtaṃ purodadhe havyavāhamupabruve | devānāsādayayādiha agne’rcayāmi te namaḥ || 3 || āgneyyāṃ candravāme ca śvetapuṣpākṣatairjalam | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca jalamāhvayāmyehi tiṣṭha ca || 4 || oṃ apsvagne’sadhiṣṭava sauṣadhīranuruddhyase | garbhe sañjāyase punaḥ jalārcayāmi te namaḥ || 5 || dakṣiṇe bhaumapārśve tu bhūmiṃ raktasumākṣataiḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ kṣite cāhvayāmyehi tiṣṭha ca || 6 || oṃ syonā pṛthivī no bhavānṛkṣarā niveśinī | yacchā naḥ śarma saprathāḥ bhūme’rcayāmi te namaḥ || 7 || īśānyāṃ budhavāme ca viṣṇuṃ pītasumākṣataiḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ viṣṇo āhvayāmyehi tiṣṭha ca || 8 || oṃ idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame tredhā vai nidadhe padam | samūḍhamasya pāṃsure viṣṇo’rcayāmi te namaḥ || 9 || uttare guruvāme ca indraṃ pītasumākṣataiḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ indra āhvayāmyehi tiṣṭha ca || 2.151.1 0|| oṃ sajoṣā indra sagaṇo marudbhiḥ somaṃ piba vṛtrahā śūra vidvān | jahi śatrūm̐rapa mṛdho nudasvāthābhayaṃ kṛṇuhi viśvato naḥ || 11 || pūrve śukrasya ca vāme pītasumākṣataiḥ śacīm | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ indrāṇyāhvayāmyehi pratiṣṭha ca || 12|| oṃ adityai rāsnāsīndrāṇyā uṣṇīṣaḥ | pūṣāsi gharmmāya dīṣvendrāṇyarcayāmi te namaḥ || 13||| paśce vāme śaneḥ śvetapuṣpākṣataiḥ prajāpatim | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ prajāpate hvayāmye hi tiṣṭha ca || 14|| oṃ prajāpate na ttvadetānnyanyo viśvā rūpāṇi paritā babhūva | yatkāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām || 15|| rāhorvāme ca nairṛtyāṃ nāgaṃ kṛṣṇasumākṣataiḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ nāgāvāhayāmyehi tiṣṭha ca || 16|| oṃ namo’stu sarpebhyo ye ke ca pṛthivīmanu | ye’ntarīkṣe ye divi tebhyo’rcayāmi vo namaḥ || 17|| ketorvāme ca vāyavyāmajaṃ śvetasumākṣataiḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ brahmannāhvayāmyehi tiṣṭha ca || 18|| oṃ vrahmayajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastād visīmataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ | sabudhnyā upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ sataśca yonimasataśca vvivaḥ || 1 9|| atha cāvāhayet pañcalokapālān surakṣakān | nairṛtyāmuttare rāhoḥ pītapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ||2.151.20|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ gaṇeśaṃ hvayāmyehi ca tiṣṭha ca | gandhapuṣpākṣatairnaivedyairabhyarcya namāmi te ||21 || oṃ gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ havāmahe priyāṇāṃ tvā priyapatiṃ havāmahe | nidhīnāṃ tvā nidhipatiṃ havāmahe vaso mama gaṇeśaṃ praṇamāmi ca ||22|| āhamajāni garbhadhamāttvamajāsi garbhadham | śanyuttare paścime ca durgāṃ raktasumākṣataiḥ ||23|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ durge hrayāmyehi ca tiṣṭha ca | pūjayāmi praṇamāmi sukhaṃ kuru jane namaḥ ||24|| oṃ jātavedase sunavāma somamarātīyato nijahāti vedaḥ | sa naḥ parṣadati durgāṇi viśvā nāveva sindhuṃ duritātyagniḥ ||25|| madhye sūryottare vāyuṃ pītapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vāyo ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||26|| oṃ ā no niyudbhiḥ śatinībhiruddharaṃ sahasriṇībhirupayāhi yajñam | vāyo asmin savane mādayasva yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||27|| pūrve śukrapūrvabhāge hyākāśaṃ nīmapuṣpakaiḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ ākāśa āgacchātra ca tiṣṭha ca ||28|| oṃ ghṛtaṃ ghṛtapāvānaḥ pibata vasāṃ vasa pāvānaḥ pibatāntarikṣasya havirasi svāhā | diśaḥ pradiśaḥ ādiśo vidiśa uddiśo digbhyaḥ svāhā pūjayāmi namāmi ca ||29|| rāhordakṣe ca nairṛtyāṃ śvetapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svo’śvināvihāgacchata tiṣṭhatam ||2.151.30|| oṃ yā vāṃ kaśā madhumatyaśvinā sūnṛtāvatī | tayā yajñaṃ mimikṣatāmaśvinau pūjayāmi ca ||31|| dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ devān prārpya namāmi ca | atha pūrvādikāṣṭhāsu cendrādīnāhvayenmakhī ||32|| pūrve oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaścendra ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ||33|| āgneyyāṃ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaragne āgaccha tiṣṭha ca | pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ||34|| dakṣiṇe oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ yama cāgaccha tiṣṭha ca | pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ||35|| nairṛtyāmoṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ nirṛte caihi tiṣṭhā ca | pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ||36|| paścime oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇāgaccha tiṣṭha ca | pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ||37|| vāyavyāmoṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vāyo āgaccha tiṣṭha ca | pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ||38|| uttare oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ kuberāgaccha tiṣṭha ca | pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ||39|| īśānyām oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ īśānāgaccha tiṣṭha ca | pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ||2.151.40 || īśānapūrvayormadhye brahmāṇamāhvayāmi ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ brahmannatrāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||41 || pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca | nirṛtivāruṇamadhye’nantaṃ hvayāmi naumi ca |||42|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaścānanta ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ||43|| atha maṇḍalamadhyasthapitāmahādi cāhvayet| | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ brahmannihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||44|| pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ śiva ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||45|| pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ viṣṇo ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||46|| pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ gaṇapate ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||47|| pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ lakṣmi ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||48|| pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca | oṃ pañcanadyaḥ sarasvatīmapiyanti sasrotasaḥ ||49|| sarasvatī tu pañcadhā sā vai deśe’bhavat sarit | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sarasvati ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||2.151.50|| pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca | oṃ ambe’mbike’mbālike na mā nayati kaścana ||51|| sasastyaśvakaḥ śubhadrikāṃ kāṃpīlavāsinīm | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ durge ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||52|| pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ kṣetrapāla ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||53|| pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ bhūtāni ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata ||54|| pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ viśvakarmannihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||55|| pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca | deśakālau prasaṃkīrtya yajñasiddhyarthamuttamam || 56|| karomi pūjanaṃ sarvadevānāṃ candanādibhiḥ | oṃ sūryādinavagrahebhyo namaḥ śāntidā hi naḥ ||57|| oṃ rudrādidevatābhyo namaḥ rakṣāpradā hi naḥ | omagnyādidevatābhyo namastejaḥpradā hi naḥ ||58|| oṃ gaṇeśādilokaprapālebhyo nama iṣṭadāḥ | omindrādidikprapālebhyo namaḥ puṣṭidā hi naḥ |||59|| brahmādiviśvakarmāntebhyo namaḥ sampadāṃpradāḥ | iti sampūjya ca makhī grahavedīsamīpataḥ ||2.151.60 || bhūmau tattannāmamantrairbaliṃ dadyācca tadyathā | guḍaudanaṃ tu sūryāya somāya ghṛtapāyasam ||6 1 || masūrānnaṃ maṃgalāya budhāya kṣīramodanam | dadhyodanaṃ tu gurave śukrāya ca ghṛtaudanam ||62|| śanaye tilapiṣṭaṃ ca pāyasaṃ rāhave tathā | citraudanaṃ ketave ca hyanyebhyaḥ pāyasaṃ balim ||63|| datvā tataścaiśakoṇe kalaśaṃ sthāpayenmakhī | oṃ bhūrasītimantreṇa bhūmisparśanamācaret ||64|| oṃ dhānyamasīti manunā bhūmau dhānyaṃ kṣinpemakhī | omājighretimantreṇa dhānyopari nyased ghaṭam ||65|| oṃ varuṇasyetyudakaṃ ca kalaśe paripūrayet | oṃ vasoḥ pavitreti manunā vastraṃ kaṇṭhe ca veṣṭayet ||66|| oṃ yāḥ phalinīti manunā pūgīphalaṃ samarpayet | oṃ parivājetimanunā pañcaratnāni nikṣipet ||67|| oṃ hiraṇyagarbheti manunā hiraṇyaṃ ca samarpayet | oṃ gandhadvāretimanunā gandhādikaṃ samarpayet ||68|| oṃ yā oṣadhīriti ca savauṣadhīḥ samakṣipet | aśvasthānād gajasthānād valmīkāt saṃgamād hṛdāt ||69|| rājadvārād gokulācca mṛdamānīya nikṣipet | oṃ kāṇḍātkāṇḍamiti durvāṃ kalaśe tu samakṣipet ||2.151.70|| omaśvatthetimantreṇa pañcapallavakān kṣipet | oṃ pavitreṇasthamantreṇa pavitrāṇi vinikṣipet ||71|| oṃ pūrṇā darvīti tandulapātraṃ ca kalaśe kṣipet | oṃ śrīśca ta itimantreṇa śrīphalaṃ kalaśe kṣipet ||72|| evaṃ ghaṭaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya varuṇaṃ salile hvayet | oṃ tattvāyāmīti mantreṇa varuṇaṃ prasamāhvayet ||73|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | pūjayāmi namaste ca ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ ||74|| sarve samudrāḥ saritastīrthānyapi sarāṃsi ca | jaladāśca samāyāntu sarvadurītanāśakāḥ ||75|| sarve devāḥ kalaśe tu pratitiṣṭhanti pāvakāḥ | kalaśasya mukhe ceti kalaśaṃ cābhimantrayet || 76|| devadānavamantreṇa kalaśaṃ prārthayet tataḥ | atha vai sarvatobhadramaṇḍalasya ca pūjanam || 77|| prāgudīcyāṃ gatā rekhāḥ kuryādekonaviṃśatim | khaṇḍendustripadaḥ koṇe, śṛṃkhalā pañcabhiḥ padaiḥ ||78|| ekādaśapadā vallī bhadraṃ tu navabhiḥ padaiḥ | caturviṃśatpadā vāpī viṃśatyā paridhiḥ padaiḥ ||79|| madhye ṣoḍaśabhiḥ koṣṭhaiḥ padmaṣṭadalaṃ smṛtam | śvetenduḥ śṛṃkhalā kṛṣṇā vallīrnīlena pūrayet ||2.151.80 || bhadrāruṇā sitā vāpī paridhiḥ pītavarṇakaḥ | bāhyāntaradalaśvetā karṇikā pītavarṇakā ||8 1 || paridhyāveṣṭitaṃ padmaṃ bāhye sattvaṃ rajastamaḥ | tanmadhye sthāpayeddevān brahmādyāṃśca sureśvarān ||82|| deśakālau ca saṃkīrtya devasthāpanakarmasu | sarvatobhadrake ṣaṭapañcāśaddevān samāhvayet |||83 || gṛhītvā cākṣatānmadhye brahmāṇaṃ tu samāhvayet | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ brahmannihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||84|| pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi gṛhṇa pūjanam | uttare oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ somamāvāhayāmi ca||85|| pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca | īśānyām oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ īśānamāhvayāmi ca ||86|| pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca | pūrvasyāṃ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ indramāvāhayāmi ca ||87|| pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca | āgneyyāṃ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ agnimāvāhayāmi ca ||88|| pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca | dakṣiṇe oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ yamamāvāhayāmi ca ||89|| pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca | nairṛtyām oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ nirṛtimāhvayāmi ca || 2.151.90|| pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca | paścime oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇamāhvayāmi ca ||9 1 || pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca | vāyavyām oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vāyumāvāhayāmi ca ||92|| pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca | uttare oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ kuberamāhvayāmi ca ||93|| pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca | īśāne oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ īśānamāhvayāmi ca || 94|| pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca | īśānapūrvayormadhye brahmāṇamāhvayāmi ca ||95|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ brahmannihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhado bhava ||96|| vāyusomāntarāle’ṣṭavasūnāvāhayāmi ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vasava ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata ||97|| pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ | someśānāntarāle ca rudrānāvāhayāmi ca ||98|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ rudrā ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata | pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ ||99|| īśānapūrvayormadhye ādityānāhvayāmi ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva ādityā ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata || 2.151.10 0|| indrāgnyāntarabhāge’śvikumārāvāhvayāmi ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ aśvināvihāgacchataṃ tiṣṭhatam || 10 1|| pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadau hi naḥ | omagniyamayormadhye viśvedevān sapitṛkān || 1 02|| āhvayāmi bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pitarastiṣṭhatātra ca | pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ || 1 03|| yamanairṛtayormadhye yakṣānāvāhayāmi ca | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ yakṣāḥ samāgacchata tiṣṭhata || 1 04|| pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ | nairṛtivaruṇāntarbhvāṃ bhūtanāgān hvayāmi ca || 1 05|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ bhūtā ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata | pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ || 106 || tatraiva bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sarpānāhvayāmi tiṣṭhata | pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ || 1 07|| varuṇavāyvantare ca gandharvāpsarasastathā | bhūrbhuvaḥ svaścārcayāmi smarāmi ca namāmi ca || 1 08|| tatraiva bhūrbhuvaḥ svaścāpsarasaścāpi tiṣṭhata | pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ || 1 09|| oṃ puñjikasthalī kratusthalī cāpsarasau daṃkṣṇavaḥ | paśavo hetiḥ pauruṣeyo vadhaḥ prahetistebhyo namo astu || 2.151.11 0|| brahmasomayormadhye skandaṃ śūlaṃ ca nandinam | bhūrbhuvaḥ sva āhvayāmi smarāmi ca namāmi ca || 111 || pūjayāmi iha sthāne samāgacchata tiṣṭhata | nandīśvarāya śkrāya mahākālāya vo namaḥ || 1 12|| brahmeśānāntarāle ca saptaprajāpatīn śubhān | bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ prajeśānā ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata || 11 3|| pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ | brahmendrayormadhyabhāge durge cāgaccha tiṣṭha ca || 1 14|| bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ durgāmāhvayāmi naumyarcayāmi ca | durgāpūrve bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ viṣṇumāvāhayāmi ca || 1 15|| pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi naumyāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | brahmāgnyormadhyake pitṝnāhvayāmi ca tiṣṭhata || 1 16|| bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pitaraścāgacchatārcayāmi ca | brahmayamayormadhye ca mṛtyurogān hvayāmi ca || 1 17|| oṃ paraṃ mṛtyo anupare hi panthā yaste anya itaro devayānāt | cakṣuṣmate śṛṇvate bravīmi mānaḥ prajāṃ rīriṣo mota vīrān|| 1 18|| pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi naumyāgacchata tiṣṭhata | brahmanirṛtyantarāle gaṇeśaṃ cāhvayāmi ca || 1 19|| bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ gaṇeśa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhado bhava || 2.151.120|| brahmavaruṇayormadhye apaścāhvayāmi ca | bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ āpa ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata || 121 || pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ | brahmavāyavyantarāle ca maruta āhvayāmi ca ||1 22|| brahmapāde pṛthivīmāvāhayāmi namāmi ca | bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pṛthivī ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 123|| pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā bhava | tatraiva saptanadyaśca ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata || 1 24|| bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca gaṃgādyāḥ pūjayāmi namāmi ca | gaṃge ca yamune sarasvati śatadrutāpike || 1 25| uṣṇāsiknī saptanadīḥ smarāmi ca namo namaḥ | tatraiva saptavārdhīṃśca āhvayāmi namāmi ca || 126|| bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sāgarāśca samāgacchata tiṣṭhata | pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi tṛptidāḥ sukhadā hi naḥ || 127|| tadūrdhve merumāhvayāmyāgaccha cātra tiṣṭha ca | bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca mero tvāṃ naumi me sukhado bhava || 128|| atha vai maṇḍalād bāhye somādisannidhau kramāt | uttare tu gadāmāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca || 129|| bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca gade ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | īśānyāṃ tu śūlamāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca || 2.151.13 0|| bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca śūlaka ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | pūrve vajramāhvayāmi sthāpayāmi namāmi ca || 131 || bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca vajra tvamihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | āgneyyāṃ śaktimāvāhayāmi saṃsthāpayāmi ca || 1 32|| bhūrbhuvaḥ svaścaihi cātrāgaccha tiṣṭha namāmi te | dakṣiṇasyāṃ daṇḍamāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca || 133|| nairṛtyāṃ khaṇḍahetiṃ cāvāhayāmi namāmi ca | paścime pāśamāvāhayāmi saṃsthāpayāmi ca || 134|| vāyavyāmaṃkuśamāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca | bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca daṇḍādyā ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata || 1 35|| pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ | tadbāhye cottare gautamamāhvayāmi naumi ca || 1 36|| īśānyāṃ bhāradvājaṃ cāhvayāmi praṇamāmi ca | viśvāmitraṃ ca pūrvasyāmāhvayāmi namāmi ca || 137|| āgneyyāṃ kaśyapamāvāhayāmi praṇamāmi ca | dakṣiṇe jamadagniṃ cāvāhayāmi namāmi ca || 138|| nairṛtyāṃ ca vaśiṣṭhaṃ cāvāhayāmi namāmi ca | paścime’trimāhvayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca || 139|| vāyavyāṃ cārundhatīmāhvayāmi praṇamāmi ca | pūrve caindryai namaścāgnau kumāryai tu namo namaḥ || 2.151.140|| dakṣe brāhmyai namo vārāhyai nairṛtyāṃ namo namaḥ | paścimāyāṃ cāmuṇḍāyai vaiṣṇavyai vāyuke namaḥ || 141|| māheśvaryai cottare ceśāne vaināyakīśriyai | namaḥ prapūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi sukhadā hi naḥ || 142|| ṣaḍpaṃcāśaddevagaṇānāvāhya paripūjayet | ityāha śrīharirbhaktadevāyatanakāya tat || 143|| mayā te’bhihitaṃ rādhe ūhyā mantrāstadarthagāḥ | dhūpadīpasunaivedyaistarpayed devatāgaṇān || 144|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pratyadhidevatāvāhanalokapālatridevadevīgrahāvāhanādighaṭasthāpanasarvatobhadrapūjanaṣaṭpañcāśaddevapūjanādipradarśananāmaika pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 151 ||
<2.152> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca tato yadāha bhagavān bhaktaṃ rādhe vadāmi te | vedimadhye tu kamale tāmraghaṭaṃ nidhāpayet || 1 || oṃ bhūrasīti vai bhūmiṃ spṛṣṭvā prakṣipya tandulān | yavān vā samiti tatra oṣadhīḥ sanniyujya ca || 2 || omājighreti kalaśaṃ sthāpayet tatra vai sthale | oṃ varuṇasyetyudakaṃ kṣiptvā vastreṇa veṣṭayet || 3 || oṃ yāḥ phalinīti pūgīphalaṃ ca pañcaratnakam | hiraṇyaṃ ca kṣipedgandhaṃ kṣipet sarvauṣadhīṃstathā || 4 || kṣipet saptamṛdaścāpi dūrvā ca pañcapallavān | pavitrāṇi kṣipettandulasthālīṃ ca nidhāpayet || 5 || śrīphalaṃ sannidhāyai va pratiṣṭhāpya ca devatām | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca || 6 || namāmi ṣoḍaśadravyaiḥ pūjayāmi ca te namaḥ | samprārthya tanmukhe svarṇamūrtiṃ nārāyaṇīṃ nyaset || 7 || agnyuttāraṇapūrvāṃ cācchādya paṭṭāmbarādibhiḥ | ehyehi bhagavan viṣṇo lokānugrahakāraka || 8 || yajñabhāgaṃ gṛhāṇemaṃ vāsudeva namo’stu te | oṃ viṣṇave namo madhusūdanāya namo namaḥ || 9 || oṃ namastrivikramāya vāmanāya ca oṃ namaḥ | śrīdharāya nama oṃ śrīhṛṣīkeśāya oṃ namaḥ || 2.152.10 || padmanābhāya ca namo dāmodarāya oṃ namaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya oṃ namo namaḥ || 11 || śrīkṛṣṇāya nama oṃ ca nārāyaṇāya oṃ namaḥ | naranārāyaṇāya oṃ namo vai haraye ca om || 12|| etaiśca nāmabhiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ sampūjya praṇametpunaḥ | gururācamya ca dvārapālān gandhaiḥ samarcayet || 13 || paṭhadhvaṃ ca yajadhvaṃ ca viprān vai prerayettathā | ācārya ṛtvijaḥ kuṇḍe’gniṃ smṛtvā kuryurāvidhim || 14|| pratikuṇḍaṃ kuṇḍadakṣe yajamāno niṣadya ca | dhṛtvā kuśayavajalānyadya kālādike śubhe || 15|| etaddevapratiṣṭhārthayajñakarmasvidaṃ haviḥ | dravyaṃ sarvagrahebhyo’dhidevatābhyaśca vai tathā || 16 || pratyadhidevatābhyaśca lokapālebhya ityapi | dikpālebhyastridevebhyo gaṇeśāya tathā hyapi || 17|| ambikābhūtayūthebhyastathā ca viśvakarmaṇe | varuṇāgnivāyusūryaprajāpatibhya ityapi || 18|| sviṣṭakṛdādidevebhyaḥ sarvebhyaśca namama om | ityuccārya pratikuṇḍaṃ dravyatyāgaṃ samācaret || 19|| jāpakānāṃ jape jāyamāne homaṃ samācaret | kraṇeṇa varaṇaṃ kuryād deśakālau prakīrtya vai ||2.152.20|| amukaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ brahmatvena tvāmahamāvṛṇe | vṛto’smīti prativākyaṃ vihitaṃ karma cācara ||2 1|| yathājñānaṃ karavāṇi vahnerdakṣiṇatastataḥ | tyaktvā paristaraṇārthabhuvaṃ datvā tu vedhase ||22|| vāraṇādidārurūpāsanaṃ prāgagragān kuśān | āsane tu samāstīrya vahnipradakṣiṇakramāt || 23 || brahmāṇaṃ tu samānīya pratiṣṭhākarmaṇi svayam | brahmā bhavetyabhidhāyāsane samupaveśayet ||24|| tadabhāve tu pañcāśatkuśātmakaṃ prakalpayet| | agneruttarataḥ prāgagrakuśairāsanadvayam || 25|| kalpayitvā vāraṇaṃ dvādaśāṃgulasudīrghakam | caturaṃgulavistāraṃ caturaṃgulakhātakam ||26|| camasaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā dakṣahastasthapātragam | jalaṃ prapūrya ca kuśairācchādya brahmaṇo mukham ||27|| vīkṣyāgneruttarataḥ paścimāsane kuśopari | nidadhyādvai tataḥ paristaraṇaṃ syād yathā tu tat ||28|| barhiṣo vai caturthāṃśaṃ dhṛtvā prāgagrakaiḥ kuśaiḥ | caturbhiśca caturbhiścāgneyādīśānakāvadhim ||29|| brahmataścāgniparyantaṃ nairṛtyād vāyakāvadhim | agnitaḥ praṇītakāntaṃ paristaraṇamiṣyate ||2.152.30|| kṛtvā tacca tato’gneruttarataḥ paścime khalu | pavitracchedanārthaṃ tu kuśatrayaṃ samādadet ||3 1|| pavitrakaraṇārthaṃ ca dvau kuśastabakau nayet | vāraṇaṃ prokṣaṇīpātra dvādaśāṃguladīrghakam ||32|| ājyasthālī taijasī dvādaśāṃgulaviśālikā | prādeśoccātha carusthālī sammārgatridarbhikāḥ || 33|| upayamakuśāstriprabhṛtayaśca samit trayam | pālāśyaḥ prādeśamātryaḥ sruvo hastaśca khādiraḥ || 34|| ājyaṃ gavyaṃ vrīhitandulakā dravyaṃ hiraṇyakam | ṣaṭapaṃcāśattathā śatadvayaṃ taṇḍulamuṣṭikāḥ ||35|| tandulapūrṇapātra ca rakṣaṇīyāni maṇḍape | āsādanaṃ pavitracchittidarbhānāṃ tu pūrvataḥ ||36|| tataḥ kuśaistribhiścāgre hitvā prādeśamātrakam | dve kuśataruṇe pracchidya pavitravidhāpanam || 37|| sapavitrakareṇaiva prokṣaṇīpātrake tadā | praṇītodakamākṣipyānāmikāṃguṣṭhacippyayā ||38|| uttarāgre pavitre gṛhītvā trirutyavaṃ tathā | prokṣaṇīpātrasya vāme haste vidhāpanaṃ tathā ||39|| anāmikāṃguṣṭhacippyā pavitre prāpya vai tataḥ | triruddiṃganamādheyaṃ tataḥ praṇītavāriṇā ||2.152.40 || prokṣaṇīprokṣaṇaṃ cātha prokṣaṇīvāriṇā tataḥ | ājyasthālyādīni pūrṇapātraparyantakāni vai ||41 || krameṇaikaikaśaḥ prokṣya prokṣaṇīpātrakaṃ tataḥ | asañcare praṇītāgnyorantarāle nidhāya ca ||42|| ājyamāsāditaṃ cājyasthālyāmagnestu paścake | nihitāyāṃ samākṣipya carusthālyāṃ tataḥ param ||43|| praṇītodakamāsicyāsāditān nyasya tandulān | brahmādhiśrayati cājyaṃ taduttarataśca svayam ||44|| carumevaṃ ca yugapadagnāvāropya vai tataḥ | īṣacchṛte carau jvaladulmukaṃ tu pradakṣiṇam ||45|| ājyacarvoḥ samantādvai bhrāmayecca tataḥ punaḥ | dakṣiṇapāṇinā sruvamādāya prāñcameva ca ||46|| adhomukhaṃ tathāgnau tāpayitvā savyahastake | kṛtvā ca dakṣiṇenaiva sammārgāgraiśca mūlataḥ ||47|| agraparyantakaṃ mūlairagramārabhya cāpyadhaḥ | saṃmṛjya mūlaparyantaṃ praṇītavāriṇā tataḥ ||48|| abhiṣicya punaḥ pūrvavatpratāpya ca dakṣataḥ | nidadhyādvai tata ājyamutthāpya pūrvataścaroḥ ||49|| nītvāgneruttarataśca sthāpayitvā caruṃ tataḥ | utthāpyājyasya paścādvai nītvājyasyottarāttataḥ ||2.152.50|| sthāpayitvā cājyamagneḥ paścādānīya vai carum | ānīyājyasyottarato nidhāya pūrvavat tataḥ ||51 || pavitrābhyāmājyamutpūyāvalokya ca vai tataḥ | apadravyanirāsaśca punaḥ prokṣiṇikotpavaḥ || 52|| tataścopayamakuśāt dakṣahastena vāmake | haste kṛtvā samuttiṣṭhan dhyātvā prajāpatiṃ hṛdi ||53 || tūṣṇīmagnau ghṛtāktāstrisamidhaḥ prakṣipenmakhī | upaviśya prokṣaṇīvāriṇā pavitrayojinā ||54|| dakṣiṇena culukena gṛhītenāgnimeva ca | īśānādyudagapavargaṃ pariṣicya vai tataḥ ||55|| dakṣiṇajānvavācyakuśāgreṇa brahmaṇāpi ca | anvārabdho yajamānenānvārabdhaśca vai tataḥ ||56|| samiddhe’gnau sruveṇājyāhutīśca juhuyānmakhī | ādhārāttu samārabhya dvādaśāhutikāsu ca ||57|| tattadāhutiśeṣasya sruvalagnaghṛtasya tu | prokṣaṇīpātrake kṣepaḥ kartavyo vidhirīdṛśaḥ ||58|| homastatra yathāyogyaḥ kartavyaḥ syād yadiṣṭakaḥ | oṃ prajāpataye svāhedaṃ prajāpataye namama ||59|| omindrāya svāhedamindrāyāghārakau namama | omagnaye svāhedamagnaye om oṃ namama ||2.152.6 0|| oṃ somāya svāhedaṃ somāyājyabhāgakau namama | oṃ bhūḥ svāhedaṃ bhūḥ namama bhuvaḥ svāhā idaṃ bhuvaḥ ||61|| oṃ svaḥ svāhā idaṃ svaśca mahāvyāhṛtayastvimāḥ | oṃ tvanno’gneityagnivaruṇābhyāṃ ca namama om ||62|| oṃ satvano’gna idamagnivaruṇābhyāṃ namaśca om | omayāścāgne iti ca idamagnaye namaśca om ||63|| oṃ ye te śatamiti svāhā savitre viṣṇave idam | idaṃ ca viśvadevebhyo marudbhyo’rkebhya omidam ||64|| oṃ uduttameti ca svāhedaṃ varuṇāya namama | varmavad devavighnānāṃ vāraṇaṃ śāntirucyate ||65|| oṃ āpaḥ śivāḥ śivatamāḥ śāntāḥ śāntatamāstāste kṛṇvantu bheṣajam | evaṃ kuryāt prokṣaṇaṃ sarvakuṇḍeṣvagniprokṣaṇāntakaṃ karma bhūsuraiḥ ||66|| athācāryo’gniṃ saṃpūjya grahahomaṃ samācaret | arkaḥ palāśaḥ khadiraścāpāmārgo’tha pippalaḥ ||67|| audumbaraḥ śamī dūrvā kuśāśca samidhaḥ kramāt | navagrahāṇāṃ boddhavyā dadhikṣīraghṛtāktakāḥ ||68|| samidhaḥ śākalyayutā juhuyādvai gṛṇan manūn | aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāṣṭāviṃśatirvāṣṭavārakam ||69|| oṃ ākṛṣṇeneti vai svāhā idaṃ sūryāya vai namama | o imaṃ deveti vai svāhā idaṃ candramase namama ||2.152.70|| oṃ agniritivai svāhā idaṃ bhaumāya vai namama | o udvuddhyasveti svāhā idaṃ budhāya vai namama ||7 1|| oṃ bṛhaspate iti svāhā idaṃ bṛhaspataye namama | oṃ annāditi vai svāhā idaṃ śukrāya vai namama ||72|| o śanna iti vai svāhā idaṃ śaniścarāya namama | oṃ kayāna iti vai svāhā idaṃ vai rāhave namama ||73|| oṃ ketumiti vai svāhā idaṃ vai ketave namama | atha haste jalaṃ dhṛtvā homena grahadevatāḥ ||74|| prīyantāṃ ca namameti jalaṃ bhūmāvavāsṛjet | tato navagrahādhidevānāṃ homaṃ samācaret ||75|| pālāśya īśvarādibhyaḥ prādeśamātrikāḥ śubhāḥ | sājyāḥ samidhaḥ pratyekaṃ cāṣṭau catasra eva vā ||76|| saghṛtāḥ sayavāstilā hotavyāśca vidhānataḥ | oṃ tryambakaṃ yajāmahe svāhedamīśvarāya namama ||77|| oṃ śrīśca te lakṣmīśca svāhedaṃ hmumāyaiḥ namama | oṃ yadakrandaḥ prathamaṃ svāhedaṃ skandāya namama ||78|| oṃ viṣṇorarāṭamasi svāhedaṃ viṣṇave namama | oṃ brahmayajñānaṃ prathamaṃ svāhedaṃ brahmaṇe namama ||79|| oṃ trātāramindraṃ svāhedaṃ cendrāya namama | oṃ yamāya tvā makhāya svāhedṃ yamāya namama ||2.152.80|| oṃ kārṣirasi svāhedaṃ kālāya oṃ namama | oṃ citrāvaso svāhedaṃ citraguptāya namama ||81|| anena dravyahomena prīyantāṃ cādhidevatāḥ | namameti samuccārya jalaṃ samutsṛjenmakhī ||82||| atha pratyadhidevānāṃ homaḥ kramāt tataḥ param | oṃ agniṃ dūtamiti svāhā idaṃ tu cāgnaye namama ||83|| auṃ apsvagne iti svāhā idamadbhyaśca oṃ namam | oṃ syonāpṛthivīti svāhedaṃ dharaṇyai oṃ namama ||84|| oṃ viṣṇorarāṭamiti svāhedaṃ viṣṇave oṃ namama | oṃ sajoṣā iti svāhedaṃ cendrāya oṃ namama ||85|| oṃ ādityaireti svāhedamindrāṇyai oṃ namama | oṃ brahmayajñānamiti svāhedaṃ brahmaṇe oṃ namama ||86|| oṃ namo’stu iti svāhedaṃ sarpebhya oṃ namama | oṃ prajāpate iti svāhedaṃ prajāpataye namama ||87|| anena dravyahomena prīyantāṃ pratyadhīśvarāḥ | namameti samuccārya jalaṃ samutsṛjen makhī ||88|| atha homaḥ pañcalokapālānāṃ vidhinā tataḥ | oṃ gaṇānāmitisvāhedaṃ gaṇeśāya oṃ namama ||89|| oṃ ambe’mbālike svāhedaṃ cāmbikāyai namama | oṃ vāto vāmana svāhedaṃ vāyave oṃ namama ||2.152.90|| oṃ ghṛtaṃghṛteti svāhedaṃ ākāśāya ca oṃ namama | oṃ yāvāṃkaśetisvāhedaṃ aśvibhyāṃ ca oṃ namama ||91|| anena dravyahomena prīyantāṃ lokapālakāḥ | namameti samuccārya jalaṃ samutsṛjenmakhī ||92|| atha homo daśadikprapālānāṃ vidhinā tataḥ | oṃ trātāramindraṃ svāhedaṃ cendrāya namama om ||93|| omagnidūtamiti svāhedaṃ cāgnaye namama om | oṃ yamāya tveti svāhā idaṃ yamāya vai namama ||94|| oṃ asunvanteti svāhā idaṃ nirṛtaye namama | oṃ varuṇasyeti svāhā idaṃ varuṇāya namama ||95|| oṃ vāyo ye te iti svāhā idaṃ ca vāyave namama | oṃ kuvidaṃ ceti svāhā idaṃ kuberāya namama ||96|| oṃ tamīśānamitisvāhā idamīśānāya namama | oṃ asmerudrā iti svāhā idaṃ vai brahmaṇe namama ||97|| oṃ syonā pṛthivīti svāhā idaṃ cānantāya namama | anena dravyahomena prīyantāṃ dikprapālakāḥ ||98|| namameti samuccārya jalaṃ samutsṛjenmakhī | gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ naivedyakaṃ dīpaṃ ca dhūpakam ||19|| arpayāmi ca tāmbūlaṃ prīyantāṃ parameśvarāḥ | ityevaṃ vidhinā kuryātpūjanaṃ rādhike tathā || 2.152.10 0|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha vidhānataḥ | devāyatanabhaktāya taduktaṃ ca mayāpi te || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kalaśataddevadvārapālapūjanaṃ, varaṇaṃ, prokṣaṇīpātrādi, caruḥ, ājyāhutiḥ, vāraṇaṃ, grahahomam, adhidevapratyadhidevānāṃ homaḥ, lokapāladikpālānāṃ homa, ityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 152||
<2.153> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhe vāstusthadevānāṃ homaṃ ca vidhinā tataḥ | harirbhaktāya yaṃ tvāha tathānyat karma vacmi te || 1 || śikhyādibhyaśca tatrādau svāhāntāḥ praṇavādikāḥ | nāmabhirvedamantraiśca pratyekaṃ śatamaṣṭavat || 2 || aṣṭāviṃśatirvāṣṭau vāhutistilājyapāyasaiḥ | samidbhiśca pradātavyā audumbarībhireva ca || 3 || tadabhāve’śvatthasamidanyā madhvājyadugdhayuk | hotavyā ca tilāḥ kṛṣṇā vidhinā mantrapūrvakam || 4 || oṃ śikhine ca vai svāhā idaṃ ca śikhine namama | oṃ parjanyāya ca svāhā idaṃ parjanyakāya ca || 5 || oṃ jayantāya ca svāhā idaṃ jayantakāya ca | omindrāya ca vai svāhā idamindrāya namama || 6 || oṃ sūryāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ sūryāya namama | oṃ satyāya ca vai svāhā iha satyāya namama || 7 || oṃ bhṛśāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ bhṛśāya namama | omākāśāya ca svāhā idamākāśakāya ca || 8 || oṃ vāyave ca vai svāhā idaṃ vāyave namama | oṃ pūṣṇe ca namaḥ svāhā idaṃ pūṣṇe ca namama || 9 || oṃ vitathāya ca svāhā idaṃ vitathāya namama | oṃ gṛhakṣatāya svāhā idaṃ gṛhakṣatāya ca || 2.153.10 || oṃ yamāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ yamāya namama | oṃ gandharvāya ca svāhā idaṃ gandharvāya namama || 1 1|| oṃ bhṛṃgarājāya svāhā idaṃ bhagāya namama | oṃ mṛgāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ mṛgāya namama || 12| oṃ pitṛbhyaśca vai svadhā idaṃ pitṛbhyo namama | oṃ dauvārikāya svāhā idaṃ dauvārikāya ca || 13|| oṃ sugrīvāya ca svāhā idaṃ sugrīvakāya ca | oṃ puṣpadantāya svāhā idaṃ puṣpāya namama || 14|| oṃ varuṇāya ca svāhā idaṃ varuṇāya namama | omasurāya ca svāhā idamasurāya namama || 15|| o śeṣāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ śeṣāya namama | oṃ pāpayakṣmaṇe svāhedaṃ pāpayakṣmaṇe namama || 16|| oṃ rogāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ rogāya namama | oṃ sarpāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ sarpāya namama || 17|| oṃ mukhyāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ mukhyāya namama | oṃ bhallāṭāya ca svāhā idaṃ bhallāṭakāya ca || 18|| oṃ somāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ somāya namama | oṃ sarpāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ sarpāya namama || 19|| omaditaye ca svāhā idamaditaye namama | o ditaye ca vai svāhā idaṃ ditaye namama ||2.153.20|| omadbhyaśca tathā svāhā ḍadamadbhyaśca namama | oṃ sāvitrāya ca svāhā idaṃ sāvitrāya namama ||2 1 || oṃ jayāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ jayāya namama | oṃ rudrāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ rudrāya namama ||22|| omaryamṇe ca vai svadhā idamaryamṇe namama | oṃ savitre ca vai svāhā idaṃ savitre namama ||23|| oṃ vivasvate ca svāhā idaṃ vivasvate namama | oṃ vibudheśāya svāhedaṃ vibudheśāya namama ||24|| oṃ mitrāya ca vai svāhedaṃ mitrāya ca namama | oṃ rājayakṣmaṇe svāhedaṃ rājayakṣmaṇe namama ||25|| oṃ pṛthvīdhṛge svāhā idaṃ pṛthvīdhṛge namama | omāpavatsāya svāhedamāpavatsāya namama ||26|| oṃ brahmaṇe ca vai svāhā idaṃ ca brahmaṇe namama | oṃ carakyai ca vai svāhā idaṃ carakyai namama ||27|| oṃ vidāryai ca vai svāhā idaṃ vidāryai namama | oṃ pūtanāyai ca svāhā idaṃ pūtanāyai namama || 28|| oṃ pāparākṣasyai svāhedaṃ pāparākṣasyai namama | oṃ skandāya ca svāhā idaṃ skandāya namama |||29|| omaryamṇe ca vai svadhā idamaryamṇe namama | oṃ jṛṃbhakāya ca svāhā idaṃ jṛṃbhāya namama ||2.153.3 0|| oṃ pilipicchāya svāhedaṃ pilipicchāya namama | omindrāya ca vai svāhā idamindrāya namama ||3 1 || omagnaye ca vai svāhā idamagnaye namama | o yamāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ yamāya namama ||32|| oṃ nirṛtaye ca svāhā idaṃ nirṛtaye namama | oṃ varuṇāya ca svāhā idaṃ varuṇāya namama ||33|| oṃ vāyave ca vai svāhā idaṃ vāyave namama | oṃ kuberāya ca svāhedaṃ kuberāya vai namama ||34|| omīśānāya ca svāhedamīśānāya vai namama | oṃ brahmaṇe ca vai svāhā idaṃ vai brahmaṇe namama ||35|| omanantāya ca svāhā idamanantāya namama | omugrasenāya svāhedamugrasenāya namama || 36|| oṃ ḍāmarāya ca svāhā idṃ ḍāmarāya namama | oṃ mahākālāya vaṣaṭ mahākālāyedaṃ namama ||37|| omaśvibhyāṃ ca vai svāhā idamaśvibhyāṃ namama | oṃ durgāyai ca vai svāhā idaṃ durgāyai namama ||38|| etaddhomena śikhyādyāḥ prīyantāṃ jalamutsṛjet | atha vāstoṣpataye ca śataṃ cāṣṭau tathāhutīḥ ||39|| samittilapāyasājyairjuhuyānmantrayojitāḥ | ekaikena tu mantreṇa saptaviṃśatikā hi tāḥ ||2.153.40 || oṃ vāstoṣpate prati jānīhmasmān svāveśo anamīvo bhavā naḥ | yatvemahepprati tanno juṣasva śanno bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade svāhā|||41|| idaṃ vāstoṣpataye svāhā vāstoṣpataye namama | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalaṃ samarpayāmi ca ||42|| oṃ vāstoṣpate prataraṇo na edhi gayasphāno gobhiraśvebhirindo | ajarāsaste sakhye syāma piteva putrānprati tanno juṣasva sanno bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade svāhā ||43 || idaṃ vāstoṣpataye svāhā vāstoṣpataye namama | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalaṃ samarpayāmi ca ||44|| oṃ vāstoṣpate śagmayāsaṃ sadā te sakṣīmahi hiraṇyayāgātumatyā | pāhi kṣema uta yoge varanno yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ svāhā ||45|| idaṃ vāstoṣpataye svāhā vāstoṣpataye namama | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalaṃ samarpayāmi ca ||46 || oṃ amīvahā vāstoṣpate viśvārūpāṇyāviśan | sakhā suśeva edhi naḥ svāhā vardhaya sampadā ||47|| idaṃ vāstoṣpataye svāhā vāstoṣpataye namama | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalaṃ samarpayāmi ca ||48|| tato vai sthālīpākenāhutayaḥ ṣaṭ ca tadyathā | omagnimindraṃ bṛhaspatiṃ viśvān devānupahvaye ||49|| sarasvatīṃ ca vājinaṃ ca vāstu me datta vājinaḥ svāhā | idamagnaye indrāya bṛhaspataye viśvadevebhyaḥ sarasvatyai vājine ||2.153.50 || oṃ sarpyadevajanānsarvān himavantaṃ sudarśanam | vasūm̐śca rudrānādityānīśānaṃ jagadaiḥ saha ||51 || etān sarvān prapadye’haṃ vāstu me datta vājinaḥ svāhā | idṃ sarpadevajanebhyo himavate sudarśanāya vasubhyo rudrebhya ādityebhya īśānāya jagadebhyaśca svāhā namama ||52|| oṃ pūrvāhṇamaparāhṇaṃ cobhau madhyandinā saha | pradoṣamardharātraṃ ca vyuṣṭāṃ devīṃ mahāpatham ||53|| etān sarvān prapadye’haṃ vāstu me datta vājinaḥ svāhā | idaṃ pūrvāhṇāyāparāhṇāya pradoṣāyārdharātrāvyuṣṭyaidevyai mahāpathāya namama ||54|| oṃ kartāraṃ ca vikartāraṃ viśvakarmāṇamoṣadhīśca vanaspatīn | etānsarvānprapadye’haṃ vāstu me datta vājinaḥ svāhā ||55|| idaṃ kartre vikartre viśvakarmaṇe oṣadhībhyo vanaspatibhyo namama | oṃ dhātāraṃ vidhātāraṃ nidhīnāṃ ca patiṃ saha ||56|| etānsarvān prapadye’haṃ vāstu me datta vājinaḥ svāhā | idaṃ dhātre vidhātre ca nidhīnāṃ pataye namama ||57|| oṃ śyonaḥ śivamidaṃ vāstudattabrahma prajāpatīna sarvāśca devatāḥ svāhā | idaṃ brahmaṇe prajāpataye sarvābhyo devatābhyo namama ||58|| punaḥ vāstoṣpate ceti mantrairekena vā saha | juhuyād vakṣyamāṇena bilvaṃ sājyaṃ sabījakam ||59|| pañcamaṃ cājyayuktaṃ ca bilvaṃ dhṛtvā manuṃ vadan | juhuyādvai śataṃ cāṣṭau pratyekaṃ ca vidhānataḥ ||2.153.6 0|| oṃ vāstoṣpate dhruvasthūṇāṃ satraṃ so abhyānādrapso bhettā purāṃ śaśvatīnām | indro munīnāṃ sakhā śanno bhavadvipadeśaṃ catuṣpade svāhā idṃ vāstoṣpataye ||6 1 || aghorebhyo’tha ghorebhyo ghoraghoratarebhyaśca | sarvebhyaḥ sarvaśarvebhyo namaste’stu rudrarūpebhyaḥ |||62|| vāstumarmasusandhānārthaṃ juhuyāt śatātparam | śikhyādibhyaḥ punarhutvāpūjya paṃcopacārakaiḥ ||63|| pīṭhasthāṃ pratimāṃ vāstordadhiddarvādibhistathā | śaivalasaptadhānyaiśca gandhākṣatasumādibhiḥ ||64|| yukte’pakvamṛdo bhāṇḍe saṃsthāpya ca pidhāya ca | prāsādāgneyakoṇe vā koṇapadāttathottare ||65|| ākāśapade jānugarte jalenāpūrya tatra ca | prakṣipya gandhapuṣpāṇi mṛdbhāṇḍaṃ ca nidhāpayet ||66|| gṛṇan namo varuṇāya mṛdā mṛdaṃ prapūrayet | hutvaivaṃ vāstudevebhyo yoginībhyo’rpayettataḥ ||67|| oṃ divyayoginyai svāhā idṃ divyayoginyai namama | yojanīyaṃ tathā sarvaṃ yoginyai namameti ca ||68|| oṃ mahāśabdāyai siddhyai gaṇeśvaryai svāhā namama | pretākṣyai ḍākinyai kāmyai kālarātryai svāhā namama ||69|| niśācaryyai ca hum̐kāryyai siddhivetālyai svāhā namama | hrīṃkāryyai bhūtaḍāmaryai ūrdhvakeśyai svāhā namama ||2.153.70|| virūpākṣyai ca śuṣkāṃgyai narabhojinyai svāhā namama | phutakāryai vīrabhadrāyai dhūmrākṣyai ca svāhā namama ||71|| kālapriyāyai rākṣasyai ghorarākṣasyai svāhā namama | virūpākṣyai bhayaṃkaryai viśālākṣyai svāhā namama ||72|| kaumāryyai caṇḍikāyai vārāhyai muṇḍamatyai svāhā namama | bhairavyai cakriṇyai krodhāyai durmukhyai svāhā namama ||73|| pretavāhāyai kuraṃgyai pralambauṣṭhyai svāhā namama | mālinyai mantrayoginyai kālaghnanyai svāhā namama ||74|| mohinyai vakrāyai kuṇḍalinyai bālakyai svāhā namama | kaumāryyai yamadūtyai karālyai kauśikyai svāhā namama ||75|| yakṣiṇyai bhakṣiṇyai kumārikāyai svāhā namama | yantravādinyai viśālākṣyai kāmukyai svāhā namama ||76|| vyāghryai rākṣasyai pretabhakṣiṇyai svāhā namama | dhūrjaṭyai vikaṭāyai ghorāyai kapālyai svāhā namama ||77|| vikalāyai ca mālāyai sarvasiddhyai svāhā namama | catuṣṣaṣṭiśca yoginyaḥ prīyantāṃ homataḥ khalu ||78|| kṣetrapālahavanaṃ ca kuryādvai vidhinā makhī | oṃ ajarāya ca svāhedam ajarāya vai namama ||79|| pāvakāya ca caurāya dakṣāya cendramūrtaye | kuṣmāṇḍāya varuṇāya bāhukāya svāhā namama ||2.153.80|| nimuktāya liptakāya tilalopāya svāhā namama | ekadaṃṣṭrāyairāvatāyauṣadhighnāya svāhā namama ||81 || bandhanāyādivyāptāya kambalāya svāhā namama | kṣobhaṇāya bhagavate dharāyālāya svāhā namama ||82|| aṇave candravāraṇāya karāṭopāya svāhā namama | uroṭopāya jaṭilāya ṛtave svāhā namama ||83 || maheśvarāya vikārāya maṇimāya svāhā namama | guṇabanghāya ḍāmarāya dṛḍhakiraṇāya svāhā namama ||84|| sthavilāya danturāya dhanadāya svāhā namama | nāgakaraṇāya ca phenakāriṇe svāhā namama ||85|| mahādalāya cirakāya siṃhāya svāhā namama | mṛgāya pakṣiṇe siṃhavāhanāya svāhā namama ||86|| tīkṣṇauṣṭhāya alābhāya sruktuṇḍāya svāhā namama | yudhāmanyave alīlāya vavrakāya svāhā namama ||87|| pāvanāya svāhā namama prīyantāṃ kṣetrapālakāḥ | tataśca mātṛkāhomaḥ gauryai svāhā ca oṃ namama ||88|| padmāyai śacyai medhāyai sāvitryai svāhā namama | vijayāyai jayāyai devasenāyai svāhā namama ||89|| svadhāyai svāhāyai mātṛbhyaḥ svāhā oṃ namama om | lokamātṛbhyo hṛṣṭyai puṣṭyai tuṣṭyai svāhā namama ||2.153.90|| kuladevyai namaḥ svāhā vasuhomastataḥ param | dhruvāya ca dharāya ca somāyādbhyo’nilāya ca ||91|| nalāya pratyūṣāya prabhāsāya svāhā namama | ādityahavanaṃ cātha dhātre’ryamṇe svāhā namama ||92|| mitrāya varuṇāyāpi cāśāya ca svāhā namama | gabhastimate indrāya vivasvate svāhā namama ||93|| pūṣṇe parjanyakāyāpi viṣṇave jaghanāya ca | svāhā namama ca tato rudrāṇāṃ havanaṃ yathā ||94|| oṃ vīrabhadrāya ca svāhā namama śaṃbhave tathā | girīśāyājaikapāde’hirbudhnyāya pinākine ||95|| aparājitāya bhuvanādhīśvarāya svāhā namama | kapāline sthāṇave bhagāya svāhā namama ||96|| saptamātṛhavanaṃ ca yathā brāhmyai svāhā namama | vaiṣṇavyai ca māheśvaryai kumāryai svāhā namama ||97|| kuberāyai ca vārāhyai indrāṇyai svāhā namama | ṣaḍvināyakahomo’tha modāya svāhā namama || 98||
