pramodāya sanmukhāya durmukhāya svāhā namama | avighnāya vighnahartre svāhā namama oṃ namaḥ ||99|| pitāmahādihomaśca brahmaṇe svāhedṃ namama | viṣṇave svāhedaṃ namama rudrāya svāhedaṃ namama || 2.153.10 0|| gaṇeśāya svāhedaṃ namama lakṣmyai svāhedaṃ namama | jātavedase viśvakarmaṇe svāhedaṃ namama || 10 1|| bhūtagrāmāya ca svāhedaṃ namama ca oṃ namaḥ | daśāṃśo’tha japānāṃ cāyuto gāyatrīhomakaḥ || 1 02|| samidājyacaruyavatilaiḥ sadugdhaśarkaraiḥ | śrīsūktādyairlakṣmīhomaḥ pradhānadevahomakaḥ || 1 03|| kartavyaśceti bhaktāya devāyatanakāya saḥ | hariḥ prāha mayā te’pi coktaṃ rādhe yathāyatham || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vāstudevahavanaṃ yoginīhavanaṃ kṣetrapālahavanaṃ mātṛkāhavanaṃ vasvādityarudramātṛgaṇapatipitāmahaviṣṇulakṣmīsūryādihavanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā tripaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 153 ||
<2.154> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca tataśca śrīhariḥ prāha devāyatanakāya yam | brahmapriyādihomaṃ ca rādhe taṃ te vadāmyapi || 1 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya brāhmarūpiṇīḥ | brahmapriyaścatvāriṃśat śataṃ cāvāhya pūjayet| || 2 || svarṇasihāsanaṃ dhyātvā viśālaṃ tāḥ samāhvayet | taṇḍuleṣvatha vā pūgīphaleṣu cārcayed dravaiḥ || 3 || oṃ śrīśca te lakṣmīśca patnyāvahorātre pārśvenakṣatrāṇi rūpamaśvinau vyātaṃn iṣṇaṃ | niṣāṇamummaīṣāṇa sarvalokammaiṣāṇaḥ || 4 || prathamaṃ ṣaṇmahābrāhmīpriyāścāvāhayenmakhī | oṃ śrīrādhikāyai svāhā idaṃ rādhikāyai namama || 5 || āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi tām | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanādi naivedyaṃ jalamityapi || 6 || tāmbūlakaṃ tathā nīrājanaṃ samarpayāmi ca | oṃ śrīlakṣmyai tathā svāhā idaṃ lakṣmyai namama om || 7 || āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanādi naivedyaṃ jalamityapi || 8 || tāmbūlakaṃ tathā nīrājanaṃ samarpayāmi ca | oṃ śrīmāṇikyāyai svāhedaṃ māṇikyāyai namama || 9 || oṃ śrībrahmavidyāyai svāhā idaṃ brahmavidyāyai namama | o śrīramāyai ca svāhā idaṃ ramāyai ca namama || 2.154.1 0|| oṃ śriyai ca tathā svāhā idaṃ śriyai ca vai namama | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca || 1 1|| dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanādi naivedyaṃ jalamityapi | tāmbūlakaṃ tathā nīrājanaṃ samarpayāmi ca || 12|| paravidyāṃ cāhvayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ sunaivedyaṃ samarpayāmi oṃ namama || 1 3|| brahmapriyāstathā gītā upaniṣada ityapi | jayantīścaikādaśīścārādhanāṃ cāhvayāmi ca || 14|| mahālakṣmīṃ tathā bhaktiṃ rādhāṃ ramāṃ pativratām | gaṃgāṃ ca rohiṇīṃ kāmadughāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ tathā || 15|| āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanādi naivedyaṃ jalamityapi || 16|| tāmbūlakaṃ tathā nīrājanaṃ samarpayāmi ca | saṃjñā vibhūtiṃ duḥkhahālakṣmīṃ ca kamalāṃ tathā || 17|| siddhiṃ mohinīmurvaśīṃ muktāṃ buddhiṃ ca pārvatīm | dīkṣāṃ līlāṃ virajāṃ ca vṛndāṃ nārāyaṇīṃ tathā || 18|| sarasvatīṃ svarṇarekhāṃ sitāṃ ca devikāṃ tathā | vibhāvarīṃ ca tulasīṃ mūrtiṃ jayāṃ ca gomatīm || 19|| āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanādi naivedyaṃ jalamityapi ||2.154.20|| tāmbūlakaṃ tathā nīrājanaṃ samarpayāmi ca | premasakhīṃ rukmiṇīṃ godāvarīṃ mañjulāṃ tathā ||2 1|| haṃsāṃ suguṇāṃ lalitāṃ dhātrīṃ raṃbhāṃ kumudvatīm | campāṃ ca śītalāṃ svarṇagaurīṃ nandāṃ dayāṃ kalām ||22|| durgāṃ ca nandinīṃ sādhyāṃ vijayāṃ vañjulīṃ tathā | dhanyā dolāṃ ca sāvitrīṃ puṇyāṃ ca kokilāṃ manum ||23 || āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ candanādi jalaṃ tathā ||24|| tāmbūlakaṃ tathā nīrājanaṃ samarpayāmi ca | citralekhāṃ pūrṇimāṃ śāradāṃ māṃ mañjarīṃ tathā ||25|| devikāṃ preyasīṃ śreyasīṃ vikuṇṭhāṃ tathāruṇām | jyoṣṭrīṃ śabarīṃ pampāṃ ca gālavīṃ sudughāṃ tathā ||26|| yājñasenīṃ vasumatīṃ padmāvatīṃ ca bhārgavīm | padminīṃ śrīmatīṃ jaratkārvīṃ līlāvatīṃ tathā ||27|| kalāvatīṃ ca kadalīṃ revāṃ kāntimatīṃ tathā | kālindīṃ vardhinīṃ puṇyanaidheyikāṃ sumitrikām ||28|| āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanādi naivedyaṃ ca jalaṃ tathā ||29|| tāmbūlakaṃ tathā nīrājanaṃ samarpayāmi ca | bandulāṃ ca suśīlāṃ ca mānasāṃ mādhavīṃ tathā ||2.154.3 0|| śarmavatīṃ dīrghikāṃ karṇotpalāmakṣamālikām | udumbarīṃ badarīṃ kubjikāṃ haimīmṛtambharām ||31 || maṃgalāṃ cāmṛtāṃ mahāvedīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ haripriyāḥ | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca ||32|| dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanādi naivedyaṃ ca jalaṃ tathā | tāmbūlakaṃ tathā nīrājanaṃ samarpayāmi ca ||33|| santoṣāṃ kaṃbharālakṣmīmāhvayāmi namāmi ca | sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi dhūpadīpajalādibhiḥ ||34|| naivedyaṃ candanaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ samarpayāmi ca | oṃ rādhāṣaṭkāya ca svāhedaṃ rādhāṣaṭkāya namama || 35|| pāyasaṃ polikā miṣṭānnādi sadvyaṃjanāni ca | bhakṣyabhojyāni lehyāni cośyāni cārpayāmi ca || 36|| oṃ parāvidyādikānāṃ catvāriṃśadyuje śatāya ca | svāhā idaṃ parāvidyādibhya oṃ tābhyo namama ||37|| pāyasaṃ polikā miṣṭānnādi sadvyaṃjanāni ca | bhakṣyabhojyāni lehyāni cośyāni cārpayāmi ca ||38|| oṃ santoṣāyaiḥ kaṃbharālakṣmyai svāhā tābhyāṃ namama | pāyasaṃ polikā miṣṭānnāni sadvyaṃjanāni ca ||3 9|| bhakṣyabhojyāni lehyāni cośyāni cārpayāmi ca | iti brāhmīḥ pūjayitvā hyavatārān prapūjayet ||2.154.40|| matsyaṃ kūrmaṃ ca vārāhaṃ kapilaṃ ca hariṃ tathā | vāsudevaṃ pṛthuṃ dattātreyaṃ haṃsaṃ nṛsiṃhakam ||41 || ṛṣabhaṃ vāmanaṃ parśurāmaṃ yajñaṃ kumārakān | rāmaṃ hayagrīvadevaṃ nāradaṃ rājarājakam ||42|| vyāsaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca gopālaṃ buddhaṃ kalikaṃ ca mohinīm | dhanvantariṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ tathā ||43 || sahasrahastaṃ vyūhaṃ ca sthāpayet svarṇamūrtiṣu | tanduleṣu pūgikāsu maṇiṣvapi nidhāpayet ||44|| āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanādi naivedyaṃ jalamityapi ||45|| tāmbūlakaṃ nīrājanaṃ samarpayāmi oṃ namaḥ | oṃ matsyādibhyaśca svāhā idaṃ matsyādibhyo namama ||46|| pāyasaṃ polikā miṣṭānnāni sadvyaṃjanāni ca | bhakṣyabhojyāni lehyāni cośyāni cārpayāmi ca ||47|| saśaktikāḥ sāyudhāśca sabhūṣāśca sasevakāḥ | pragṛhṇantvaṣṭyukchataṃ bhojyānāṃ tu makhe’rpitam ||48|| oṃ yajñena yajñamayajanta devāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan | te ha nākaṃ mahimānaḥ sacanta yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ ||49|| ityevaṃ tvavatārāṇāṃ homamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | yadvā pratyekamevāpi kuryānmakhī yathābalam ||2.154.50|| atha siṃhāsane svarṇe saguṇaṃ tu catuṣṭayam | vāsudevaṃ cāniruddhaṃ pradyumnaṃ ca saṃkarṣaṇam |||51 || āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca | aṣṭottaraśatadravyairarcayāmi saśaktikam ||52|| vāsudevādibhyaḥ svāhā idṃ catuṣṭyāya namama | pāyasaṃ polikāḥ śākānyapi rasām̐śca miṣṭakān ||53|| atha siṃhāsane svarṇe nirguṇaṃ tu catuṣṭayam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||54|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ naranārāyaṇaṃ samāhvayet | āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca ||55|| aṣṭottaraśatadravyairarcayāmi saśaktikam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇādibhyaśca vai svāhā ||56|| idaṃ tebhyaśca namama nīrājayāmi vai namaḥ | pāyasaṃ polikāḥ śākānyapi rasāṃśca miṣṭakān ||57|| iti sampūjya parameśvarān havanamācaret | tattannāmnāṣṭāhutīścārpayetpāyasājyakaiḥ ||58|| viṣṇormāsūramayaścaruḥ kṣīramayaścaruḥ śubhaḥ | idaṃ viṣṇuriti gṛṇān dvādaśākṣaravidyayā ||59|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | ṣoḍaśākṣaramanunā sahasraṃ sāṣṭakaṃ śatam ||2.154.60|| caruṃ juhuyāt oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya svāhā | samidbhiścājyayavatilaiḥ phalairjuhuyāttathā ||6 1 || oṃ idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame tredhā nidadhe padam | samūḍhamasya pāṃsure svāhā idaṃ tu viṣṇave ||62|| anena cāpi sahasraṃ sāṣṭakaṃ śatamarpayet | omagnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhedamagnaye namama ||6 3 || tata oṃ bhūḥ svāhedamagnaye namama śaṃ makhe kuru | oṃ bhuvaḥ svāhedaṃ vāyave namama śaṃ makhe kuru ||64|| oṃ svaḥ svāhedaṃ sūryāya namama śaṃ makhe kuru | itivyāhṛtihomaṃ ca kṛtvā tu maṇḍapasthitān ||65 || sampūjya ca baliṃ dadyāt sarvadevebhya eva ca | tataśca bahirāgatya lokapālebhya ārpayet ||66 || pūrve indra samāgaccha rakṣādhvaraṃ namo’stu te | diśaṃ rakṣa baliṃ bhakṣa yajamānodayaṃ kuru ||67|| indrasyānucarāḥ sarve bhakṣayantu baliṃ sukhāḥ | āgneyyāmagne āgaccha rakṣādhvaraṃ namo’stu te ||68|| diśaṃ rakṣa baliṃ bhakṣa yajamānodayaṃ kuru | agneścānusarāḥ sarve bhakṣayantu baliṃ sukhāḥ ||69|| dakṣiṇe yama āgaccha nairṛtyāmehi nairṛte | paścime varuṇāgaccha vāyavyāmehi vāyurāṭ ||2.154.70|| uttarasyāṃ kuberaihi aiśānyāmehi īśvara | diśaṃ rakṣa baliṃ bhakṣa yajamānodayaṃ kuru ||71|| tattadanucarāḥ sarve bhakṣayantu baliṃ sukhāḥ | īpūmadhye ehi brahman nipamadhye hyanantarāṭ ||72|| diśaṃ ca rakṣataṃ baliṃ bhakṣataṃ sānusevakau | kurutaṃ yajamānasyābhyudayaṃ ca makhodayam ||73|| atha kṣetrapāla baliṃ gṛhṇa rakṣa makhaṃ sadā | sānucaro yajamānodayaṃ kuru sukhaṃ kuru ||74|| dadhimāṣādikaṃ bhakṣetyuktvā tu taṇḍulān kṣipet | atha catuṣpathe bhūtā baliṃ gṛhṇantu śūrpagam ||75|| piṣṭaṃ māṣānnadadhyodanaharidrādikajjalam | sindūrakaṃ gandharaktapuṣpādi catvare makhī ||76 || gandhapuṣpārcitaṃ śūrpaṃ sthāpayedvai gṛṇan manūn | baliṃ gṛhṇantu te devā ādityā vasavastathā ||77|| marutaścāśvinau rudrāḥ suparṇāḥ pannagā grahāḥ | jṛmbhakāḥ siddhagandharvā mālā vidyādharā nagāḥ ||78|| asurā yātudhānāśca piśācā ḍākinīgaṇāḥ | śaktayo yakṣavetālā ye ca vighnavināyakāḥ ||79|| bhūtāḥ pretāśca kūṣmāṇḍāḥ śākinyo mātarastathā | tṛptā bhavantu balinā yajñaprasādarūpiṇā ||2.154.80|| mā vighnaṃ yajamānasya rogaṃ duḥkhamaniṣṭakam | kurvantu tatkuṭumbasya mā santu paripanthinaḥ ||81|| sarve bhavantu tṛptāśca rakṣāṃ kurvantu me’dhvare | devatābhyaśca pitṛbhyo bhūtebhyaḥ sahajantubhiḥ ||82|| etatsthānādhivāsibhyaḥ prayacchāmi baliṃ namama | trailokye yāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ||83 || devadānavagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ | kiṃpuruṣāḥ kinnarāśca sādhyā santaśca sādhvikāḥ ||84|| ṛṣayo munayo gāvo devamātara ityapi | kāśyapyastasya vaṃśīyā rājasāstāmasāḥ sitāḥ ||85|| ete mamādhvare rakṣāṃ kurvantu dehadhāriṇaḥ | mūrtāmūrtasvarūpāśca yamā yāmyāścarantu śam ||86|| etebhyaścāpi sarvebhyaḥ svāhā baliṃ ca oṃ namama| kṛtvāthācamanaṃ śuddhiṃ yāyānmaṇḍapasannidhau ||87|| viśramya yūpakāryaṃ ca tata ācārya ācaret | iti rādhe prabhūktaṃ te mayoktaṃ brāhmakarma tat ||88|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne rādhikādiṣaṭkaparāvidyācatvāriṃśaddhikaśatasantuṣṭākambharādvayaparameśāvatāraviṣṇulokapālabhūtādipūjābalisamarpaṇādināmā catuṣpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 154 ||
<2.155> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca atha śrībhagavānāha devāyatanakāyavat | yūpāropaṇakarmādi rādhike tadvadāmi te || 1 || ācāryaḥ pūrvakuṇḍādvai pūrvato maṇḍapācca vā | pādatrayamitāṃ bhūmiṃ vihāya ca tataḥ param || 2 || yūpasthānaṃ prakurvīta prāsāde śānake ca vā | ṣoḍaśa vā daśa hastān bhūbhāgān pravihāya vai || 3 || yūpasthānaṃ prakurvīta pūjanaṃ tasya vai tataḥ | kāṣṭhenāratnimātraṃ tu khātaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ param || 4 || yūpastutiṃ prakuryādvai yūpa tvaṃ nirmitaḥ purā | yajñabhāgātmako devaḥ prāsādarakṣakaḥ śubhaḥ || 5 || pūjāṃ puṣpabaliṃ dhṛtvā sthiro naścodayaṃ kuru | ityabhyarcya haridrātailāktaṃ yūpaṃ tataḥ param || 6 || śāntikuṃbhodakaiḥ snāpayitvābhbhujya ghṛtena ca | puṣpamālādinābhyarcya badhnīyāt poṭalīṃ tataḥ || 7 || dūrvāguggulasarṣapanimbapatragorocanaiḥ | sahitāṃ yūpamābadhnan mantraṃ vadenmakhī tadā || 8 || oṃ yadā badhnaṃ dākṣāyaṇā hiraṇyaṃ śatānīkāya sumanasyamānāḥ| tanma ābadhnāmi śataśāradāyuṣmām̐ jaradaṣṭiryathāsam || 9 || oṃ yuvā suvāsāḥ parivīta śreyān bhavati jāyamānaḥ | taṃ dhīrāsaḥ kavaya unnayanti svādhyāyo manasā devayantaḥ | iti vastreṇa cāveṣṭya tataścālambayenmakhī || 2.155.10 || oṃ yūpavraskā uta ye yūpavāhāścaṣālaṃ ye aśvayūpāya takṣati | ye cārvate pacanaṃ saṃbharantyutasteṣāmābhigūrtirna invatu || 11 || oṃ ucchrayasva vanaspata ityucchritya ca gartake | akṣatapuṣpadarbhāṃśca prakṣipya prokṣya vāriṇā || 12 || oṃ dhruvāsītimantreṇa ropayed yūpadaivatam | supratiṣṭhaściraṃ sthiraścāyudaḥ saukhyado bhava || 13 || oṃ dhruvāsi dhruvo’yaṃ yajamāno’sminnāyata prajayā paśubhirbhūyāt | ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī pūryyethāmindrasyacchadirasi viśvajanasyacchāyā || 14|| iti gartaṃ mṛdāpūrya dṛḍhīkurvanna vai calet | yajñāyajñāvo agnaye girāgirā ca dakṣase ||15|| prapravayamamṛtaṃ jātavedasaṃ priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣam | iti mūle jalaṃ datvā yūpaṃ kuṃkumarañjitam || 16|| kṛtvā dhūpadīpapuṣpagandhanaivedyasatphalaiḥ | dakṣiṇābhiśca saṃpūjya tadṛkṣe maṇḍalaṃ śubham || 17|| kuryād yūpadevatārthaṃ hastamātre hi sthaṇḍile | śubhravastraṃ samāstīrthaṃ pañcaviṃśatikoṣṭhavat || 18 || pūvottarābhiḥ rekhābhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ sukoṣṭhakam | kṛtvā ca vrīhibhiḥ ramyaṃ maṇḍapaṃ pūjayet surān || 19 || brahmāṇaṃ madhyakoṣṭhe tu saumaṃ tathottare’rcayet | aiśe śiva ca prāgindramāgneyyāmagnimarcayet| || 2.155.20 || dakṣe yamaṃ ca nairṛtyāṃ nairṛtiṃ ca samarcayet | paścime varuṇaṃ vāyau vāyuṃ tathā samarcayet || 21 || vāyusomāntarāle’ṣṭavasūn saṃpūjayenmakhī | someśānāntarāle caikādaśarudradevatāḥ | | 22 || īśānapūrvayormadhye dvādaśādityadevatāḥ | indrāgnayoścāntarāle’śvinau devau samarcayet |||3 || āgneyadakṣiṇamadhye saptamātṝḥ samarcayet | yāmyanairṛtyayormadhye gaṇeśaṃ ca samarcayet || 24|| varuṇanirṛtimadhye nāgān bhūtāni cārcayet | varuṇavāyvantarāle yakṣarakṣāṃsi cārcayet || 25|| brahmatastu udīcyāḥ prādakṣiṇyena madhyagān | vṛṣabhadhvajakaṃ sādhyānnārāyaṇaṃ ca pitṛkān || 26|| yamaṃ ca mṛtyurogāṃśca marutaścitraguptakam | aṣṭau saṃsthāpya ca devān pūjayettu tataḥ param || 27|| brahmaṇaḥ pādamūle tu pṛthivīṃ vai samarcayet | abhiṣekaṃ prakurvīta tattannāmāni vai gṛṇan || 28|| oṃ asaṃkhyātāḥ sahasrāṇi ye rudrā adhibhūmyāṃ vai | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane’vadhanvānitanmasīti || 29 || oṃ imaṃ me gaṃge yamune sarasvati śatadrustomaṃ sa ca tāparuṣṇyā | asiknyāmahadvidhevitattayārjīkīye śṛṇu hyāśiṣo mayā || 2.155.30 || oṃ imaṃ me brahmaputre irāvati sāle candre menakāṃgeṃ’gaśikṣāṃge corale | balo dīnāp kaṅgo nīpe nāyije narāyaṇi meke cārthe kaliṃgini ceme ||3 1 || oṃ ekā ca me, tisraśca me tisraśca me, pañca ca me pañca ca me, sapta ca me sapta ca me, nava ca me nava ca me, ekādaśa ca me ekādaśa ca me, trayodaśa ca me trayodaśa ca me, pañcadaśa ca me pañcadaśa ca me, saptadaśa ca me saptadaśa ca me, navadaśa ca me navadaśa ca me, ekaviṃśatiśca me ekaviṃśatiśca me, trayoviṃśatiśca me trayoviṃśatiśca me, pañcaviṃśatiśca me pañcaviṃśatiśca me, saptaviṃśatiśca me saptaviṃśatiśca me, navaviṃśatiśca me navaviṃśatiśca me, ekatriṃśaśca me ekatriṃśaśca me trayastriṃśacca me trayastriṃśacca me, yajñena kalpantām ||32 || catasraśca me’ṣṭau ca me’ṣṭau ca me, dvādaśa ca me dvādaśa ca me, ṣoḍaśa ca me ṣoḍaśa ca me, viṃśatiśca me viṃśatiśca me, caturviṃśatiśca me caturviṃśatiśca me, ‘ṣṭāviṃśatiśca me’ṣṭāviṃśatiśca me, dvātriṃśacca me dvātriṃśacca me, ṣaṭtriṃśacca me ṣaṭtriṃśacca me, catvāriṃśacca me catvāriṃśacca me, catuścatvāriṃśacca me catuścatvāriṃśacca me, ‘ṣṭācatvāriṃśacca me’ṣṭācatvāriṃśacca me yajñena kalpantām || 33 || oṃ ye tīrthāni pracaranti sṛkāhastā niṣaṅgiṇaḥ | teṣāṃ sahṛsrayojane’vadhannvāni tannmasi || 34|| iti yūpamabhiṣicya yūpanyāsān samācaret | yūpasya śirasi namo brahmaṇe cakṣuṣostvatha ||35|| sūryaśaśibhyāṃ ca namaḥ keśavāya namo hṛdi | namo nābhāvagnaye ca kaṭiguhyoruṣu nvimān ||36|| namāmyekādaśarudrān jaṃghayormerave namaḥ | pādayornāgadevām̐śca namāmi cātha vai punaḥ ||37|| oṃ athetasttha rāṣṭadā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhārthetasttha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta | ojasvatīsttha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhaujasvatīsttha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta | āpaḥ parivāhiṇīsttha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhāpaḥ parivāriṇīsttha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta | apāṃ patirāsi rāṣṭadārāṣṭramme dehi svāhāpāmpatirami rāṣṭadā rāṣṭramamuṣmai dehi | apāṃ garbho’si rāṣṭadā rāṣṭramme dehi svāhāpāṃgarbhosi rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai dehi | sūryatvacasasttha iti śikhāyām || 38 | | oṃ viśvataścakṣuruta viśvatomukho viśvatobāhuruta viśvataspāt | sambāhubhyāṃ dhamati patattrairdyāvābhūmī janayan deva eka iti cakṣuṣoḥ || 3 9|| oṃ vārāhāya nama iti nāsikābhyāṃ namo namaḥ | omagniṃ dūtaṃ purodadhe havyāvāhamupabruve | devānāsādayādiha ceti mukhe namo namaḥ |||2.155.4 0 || oṃ nīlagrīvāḥ śitikaṇṭhā divaṃ rudrā upaśritāḥ | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane vadhannvāni tanmasīti grīvāyām ||4 1 | | oṃ bāhvorme balamastu ceti bāhvoścāpi namo namaḥ | oṃ hṛde tvā manase tvā dive tvā sūryāya tvā | ūrdhvamimamadhvaraṃ divi deveṣu hotrā yaccheti hṛdaye ||82| | oṃ samudrādūrmirmadhumāṃ udāradupāṃśunā samamṛtatvamānaṭ | ghṛtasya nāma guhyaṃ yadasti jihvā devānāmamṛtasya nābhirityudare||43 || oṃ vāmadya savituriti kaṭidvayoḥ namo namaḥ | oṃ nābhirme cittaṃ vijñānaṃ pāyurme’pacitirbhasat || 44|| ānandanandāvām̐ṇḍau me bhagaḥ saubhāgyaṃ pasaḥ | jaṃghābhyāṃ padbhyāṃ dharmo’smi viśi rājā pratiṣṭhitaḥ iti jaṃghayoḥ|| 45 || oṃ āyaṃ gauḥ pṛragnirakramīdasadanmātarampuraḥ | pitaraṃ ca prayaṃtsvaḥ iti pādayoste namo namaḥ || 46 | | evaṃ yūpe nyāsamāptvāpūjya paṃcopacārakaiḥ | pūjāṃ baliṃ pradadyācca yūpāyaiṣa baliṃ namama ||47| | ehyehi dharmadhvaja yajñanātha trayīmayo vedaśarīrayūpa | dadhātu devādhvarayajñarakṣāṃ valiṃ gṛhāṇāpi namonamaste | |48|| oṃ somaparvateti kuṃkumāktasūtreṇa veṣṭayet | oṃ parvatasyeti parvatān varuṇaṃ dikprapālakān ||49|| yūpe gandhādyaiḥ sampūjya dhyātvā codaṅmukhaḥ paṭhet | mūlacchedena ca bhūmighātena pātakādikam ||2.155.5 0 || yūpa vyāpohya sarva yūpaspṛṣṭaḥ śuciḥ sadā | oṃ yā oṣadhīḥ pūrvā jātā devebhyastriyugaṃ purā ||51 || manai nu babhraṇāmahaṃ śataṃ dhāmāni sapta ca | badhvaivaṃ puṣpamālāṃ ca yūpaṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam || 52|| gāḍhamāliṅgya ca sarvaṃ namaskuryāt kuṭumbakam | pālāśo brāhmaṇasyokto naiyyagrodhastu bhūbhujaḥ || 53 | | bailvo vaiśyasya yūpaḥ syācchūdrasyaudumbaraḥ smṛtaḥ | śiraḥpramāṇo viprasya ākaṇṭhaṃ kṣatriyasya ca ||54|| uraḥpramāṇo vaiśyasya śūdrasya nābhimātrakaḥ | prācyāṃ tu padamātrānte iti nārāyaṇaṃ namet| ||55|| athādhivāsanaṃ kāryaṃ sāyaṃ mukhyasurasya vai | ācāryo yajamānaśca ṛtvik suvāsinī tathā || 56 || gaccheyuḥ śilpiśālāṃ ca devāgre sthāpayed ghaṭam | tīrthānyāvāhayet tatra gaṃgāṃ yamīṃ sarasvatīm || 57|| cerāvatīṃ brahmaputrāṃ nārāyaṇīṃ ca gaṇḍakīm | samudrān prataṭākām̐śca kṣetrāṇyaśvasarovaram || 58|| puṣkaraṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca mānasaṃ badarīvanam | āvāhayed ghaṭe tāni viśantu brahmaśāsanāt || 59|| kuṃbhasya tu caturdikṣu nama indrāya omiti | namo yamāya ca varuṇāya kuberakāya ca || 2.155.60 || pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaistathā homaṃ karomi ca | pratimāyāḥ śilāyāstu doṣavāraṇahetave || 61 || ghaṭanādau jantunāśotthādipāpanivṛttaye | sthaṇḍilaṃ pratimāyogyaṃ kṛtvā ca bhūtasaṃskṛtim || 62|| agniṃ nyasya prakuryācca homaṃ tilairvṛtādinā | hutvā cāghārājyabhāgau devamantreṇa vai tathā || 63 || ājyāhutīḥ śatadvayaṃ hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ tathā | prārthayenmūrtirūpastvaṃ smṛddhiyuktaḥ sadā bhava || 64|| kuśaiḥ sammṛjya madhvājyābhyaṃgena vraṇanāśanam | kartavyaṃ karaṇīyaṃ ca mṛdā snānaṃ viśuddhayā || 65|| gomayena gomūtreṇa bhasmanā payasā pṛthak | madhye madhye jalenāpi tato’bhiṣecanaṃ caret | |66 || gandhādyaiḥ sitapuṣpaiścāpūjya kuṃbhodakena ca | saṃsnāpya yajamānaḥ saḥ śilpine cāmbarādikam |||67|| dadyāccāpi tadācāryo mūrtiṃ vilokya sarvataḥ | devasya dakṣiṇe haste sitorṇādivinirmitam || 68|| sarvauṣadhimanaḥphalayutaṃ vitastimātrakam | dorakaṃ mūlamantreṇa badhnīyāt pratimāṃ tataḥ |||69||| rathe cāropayed gītavādyaiḥ śṛṃgāraśobhitām | āropayed rathe brahmā vedamantrān samuccaran || 2.155.70 || oṃ rathe tiṣṭhannayati vājinaḥ puro yatra yatra kāmayate sukhārathiḥ | abhīśūnāṃ mahimānaṃ panāyatamanaḥ paścādanuyacchanti raśmayaḥ ||7 1 || nadyāṃ vā sarasi kuṇḍe nītvā tāmadhivāsayet | puṇyāhavācanaṃ kuryāt svastivācastato’pi ca |||72|| oṃ ā no bhadrāḥ kratavo yantu viśvatodabdhāso aparītāsa udbhidaḥ | devā no yathā sadamidvṛdhe asannaprāyuvo rakṣitāro dive dive ||73|| ā devānāṃ bhadrā sumatirṛjūyatāṃ devānāṃ rātirabhino nivartatām | devānāṃ sakhyamupasedimā vayaṃ devā na āyuḥ pratirantu jīvase || 74|| oṃ tamīśānaṃ jagatastasthuṣaḥ patiṃ dhiyaṃ jinvamavase hūmahe vayam | pūṣā no yathā vedasāmasad vṛdhe rakṣitā pāyuradabdhaḥ svastaye || 75|| ityādi śāntipāṭhādi proccārya saritastaṭam | pañcagavyena samprokṣya nyasya pūjādravādikān ||76|| vastrācchāditamūrtiṃ ca manunāpsvadhivāsayet | udaṅamukho yajamāno deśakālau prakīrtya ca ||77|| varuṇasya gaṇeśasya mātṛkṣetrapaprabhṛteḥ | pūjanaṃ ca kariṣye’tra gaṇānāṃ tvā vadan tataḥ ||78|| bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ gaṇeśa tvamihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | siddhibuddhisahitaṃ tvāṃ pūjayāmi namāmi ca || 79|| idaṃ dīpamāṣabhaktabaliṃ samarpayāmi te | jalamātṝrjale tadvadarcayeccārpayedbalim ||2.155.80|| namo matsyai ca kacchapyai kūrmyaiṃ vārāhyai namama | daduryai śiśumāryai ceśvaryye namaḥ prapūjanam ||8 1|| akṣateṣu ca rekhāsu jīvamātṛḥ prapūjayet| | matsyai hṛdyai ca godhāyai makaryai ḍuṃḍubhyai namaḥ |||82||| daduryyai ca namo jalyai gandhādyaiḥ pūjanaṃ tathā | catuṣṣaṣṭiyoginīnāṃ kuṃkumādyairjale’rcanam ||83|| vāyavyāṃ kṣetrapālaṃ kuṃkumādyairarcayennaram| bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ kṣetrapāla ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ||84 | | kuṃkumaṃ dīpakaṃ māṣadadhibhaktabaliṃ gṛhṇa | atha kuryājjalapūjāṃ nama oṃ adbhya eva ca ||85 | | sāgarebhyaḥ sarobhyaśca tīrthebhyo nadībhyo namaḥ | gandhākṣatān jale kṣiptvā varuṇaṃ cāpi pūjayet ||86|| bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇa tvamihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca | māṣabhaktabaliṃ gṛhṇa varuṇāya namo namaḥ | |87| | pañcāmṛtaṃ kare dhṛtvā tanmantraiśca jale kṣipet | jaladevaṃ prārthayecca mūrtiṃ jale prarakṣayet ||88|| sapta pañca trirātraṃ caikarātraṃ yāmameva vā | ācāryāya hiraṇyaṃ cānyebhyaśca bhūridakṣiṇām | |8 9 || dadyānmūrtiṃ brāhmakāle ghaṭikādvayayāpite | jalānniṣkāsya tīre saṃsnāpya sampūjya saddravaiḥ || 2.155.90 || uttiṣṭha śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa rādhāramāpate | uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate devayantastvemahe | | 91 || upaprayantu marutaḥ sudānava indraprāśurbhavā sacā | iti mantraiḥ samutthāpya sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām || 92 || vādyagītaiḥ rathe nyasya mārge ca vasatau nayet | śilpiśālājale nītvā devamaṇḍapa dakṣiṇāt || 93 || bhrāmayitvānayet snānamaṇḍapaṃ ca tataḥ param | vedikāyāṃ bhadrake cāsane prāṅānanaṃ prabhum || 94|| sthāpayed bhadramantraiśca tataḥ snānaṃ prakārayet | rādhe tubhyaṃ mayoktaṃ tad daivatāyāha yaddhariḥ || 95|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne yūpāropaṇaṃ taddevādipūjanaṃ pratimāyā jalādhivāsanaṃ nagarabhrāmaṇaṃ maṇḍapānayanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcapañcāśadadhika śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 155 ||
<2.156> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca tataḥ śrībhagavānāha devāyatanakāya yat | snānavidhyādikaṃ sarvaṃ tad rādhe kathayāmi te || 1 || guruḥ snānasya śālāyāṃ kṛtvā tu vedikātrayam | kṛtvottarottaraṃ cātha snapanadravyasaṃbhṛtim || 2 || kṛtvā ca pañcagavyena bhūmiṃ saṃprokṣya vedikāḥ | vālukāyuktavedyāṃ vai dakṣiṇāyāṃ tadākṣataiḥ || 3 || svastikaṃ tu samullikhya bhadrapīṭhaṃ vidhāya ca | paścācca vedikāyāstu kalaśān ṣaḍ nidhāpayet || 4 || vāripūrṇān pallavāḍhyān tathā pañcāparānapi | mṛtpallavavṛkṣīyakaṣāyagomūtragomayaiḥ || 6 || bhasmagandhodakairbhṛtvā pañcadevaprasaṃjñakān | udaksaṃsthapaṃktirītyā ghaṭān nidhāpayet tataḥ || 6 || antyasthapatikalaśam vedyāḥ paśce hyekādaśa | sthāpyaitān bhadrapīṭhasyottaravedyāṃ ghaṭāṣṭake || 7 || paritaḥ pūrvakramaśaḥ kṣīraṃ dadhiṃ ghṛtaṃ surām | ikṣurasaṃ dūrvodakaṃ darbhodakaṃ nidhāya ca || 8 || hiraṇyagarbhādimantrairvinyasyet tadghaṭāṣṭakam | tato’nye paścime vedyā daśa mṛtikayā kramāt || 9 || gomūtreṇa gomayena bhasmanā pañcagavyakaiḥ | kṣīreṇa dadhnā ghṛtena madhunā khaṇḍayā yutāḥ || 2.156.1 0|| ghaṭāḥ sthāpyāstathā tatra caturdaśaghaṭāḥ punaḥ | śuddhajalairbhṛtāścānye’pyatha pañcatriṃśadghaṭāḥ || 11 || sthāpanīyāsteṣu madhye pañca pañcāmṛtairyutāḥ | pañcajalayutāścātha pañca patrakaṣāyiṇaḥ || 1 2|| punardaśa kramāt puṣpaiḥ phalai sauvarṇavāribhiḥ | gavāṃ śṛṃgodakaiścāpi dhānyaiḥ sahasrachidrakaiḥ || 1 3|| sarvauṣadhibhiśca pañcapallavaidūrvayā tathā | navaratnairyutā kāryā aviśiṣṭā daśātha tu || 14|| pūraṇīyā svacchavāribhiḥ kadambādipallavaiḥ | tatrāvāhya lokapālān ājighrakalaśaṃ dharet || 15|| kādambaṃ śālmalīpatraṃ jāmbavaṃ cāpyaśokajam | plakṣapatramudumbaradalaṃ vaṭadalaṃ tathā || 16|| bilvapatraṃ nāgavallīpatraṃ palāśapatrakam | tathānyānyapi vastūni sūkṣmavastraṃ sugandhi ca || 17|| sutailaṃ yavacūrṇaṃ codvartanārthaṃ tathāparam | sugandhāmalakīcūrṇaṃ jaṭāmāṃsyādikaṃ śubham || 18|| sarvamāsādayettatra vedīmadhye ghaṭeṣu ca | antyasthapatisaṃjñaṃ ca ghaṭaṃ tīrthodakānvitam || 19|| kṛtvā devasamīpe ca tīrthānyāvāhayejjale | gaṃge ca yamune sarasvati cerāvati tathā ||2.156.20 || menakāṃge brahmaputri nārāyaṇi tathorale | kaṃgo nāye ca vālge caime kāruliṃgike maki ||2 1 || dīnāp nīpe tathārthe ca narmade gaṇḍaki hare | svarṇarekhe puṣkaraṃ ca mānasaṃ cāśvapaṭṭakam || 22|| bālakṛṣṇaṃ tathā nārāyaṇaṃ cāpi sarovaram | sāgarāścāpi tīrthāni viśantvatra ghaṭe śubhāḥ |||23 || tato jalena devaṃ vai snāpayed vedamantrakaiḥ | yajamānaḥ pradadyācca śilpibhyaḥ pāritoṣikam ||24|| athācāryo baliṃ dadyāt siddhārthaghṛtapāyasaiḥ | dikpālebhyaḥ sarvadikṣu pūrvādikramato bahiḥ |||25|| ācamanaṃ prakuryācca pūrve indrāya vai balim | arpayāmi diśaṃ rakṣa yajamānodayaṃ kuru ||26|| āgneyyāmagnaye sāṃgāyārpayāmi baliṃ namaḥ | dakṣiṇe yamadevāya cārpayāmi baliṃ namaḥ ||27||| nairṛtye nirṛtaye cārpayāmi baliṃ namaḥ | paścime varuṇāyaivārpayāmi ca baliṃ namaḥ ||28|| vāyavyāṃ vāyave cārpayāmi baliṃ ca te namaḥ | uttare ca kuberāya arpayāmi baliṃ namaḥ |||29|| īśāne ceśadevāya cārpayāmi baliṃ namaḥ | baliṃ datvācamya devaṃ prasnāpayed vidhānataḥ || 2.156.30 || agnirmūrddheti ca mṛdā yajñāyeti kaṣāyakaiḥ | gomūtreṇa ca gāyatryā gandheti gomayena ca || 31 || bhasmanā mānastoketi gāyatryā gandhavāriṇā | pañcadaivatyakalaśaiḥ snāpayecca tataḥ param ||32|| namaḥśiveticādyena haṃsetidvitīyena ca | yāteti tṛtīyenāpi viṣṇoścaturthakena ca || 33 || brahmeti pañcamenāpi śuddhodakena vai tataḥ | puṣpākṣatādyaiḥ saṃpūjyācchādya pitāmbareṇa ca ||34|| dvitīyāyāṃ ca vai vedyāṃ bhadrāsanaṃ nidhāya ca | prāgagragān kuśānāstīrya ca devaṃ nidhāya ca || 35|| udaṅmukho mahācāryaḥ kuṃkumasūtrakeṇa ha | mūrtimāveṣṭya ca tato hiraṇyagarbhamantrataḥ || 36 || pātre madhughṛtaṃ miśriṃ madhuvātetimantrayet | tato madhughṛtāktāṃ ca śalākāṃ kānakīṃ dharet || 37|| oṃ citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasya agneḥ | oṃ agnirjyotirjyotiragniḥ svāhā sūryyo jyotirjyotiḥ sūryaḥ svāhā || 38|| oṃ agnirvarco jyotirvarcaḥ svāhā sūryo varcojyotirvarcaḥ svāhā | jyotiḥ sūryaḥ sūryo jyotiḥ svāheti kalpayet pratimāyāstu netrake ||39|| oṃ ākṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca | hiraṇmayena savitā rathenādevo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan ||2.156.40 || ityanena padmapuṭadvaye kuryāt kanīnikām | netronmīlanakāle na draṣṭavyaṃ devasanmukhe ||41 || ādarśasvarṇabhakṣyapāyasaphalāni darśayet | saumyā śubhā bhaved dṛṣṭirdevasya tu tathākṛte ||42|| śilpī śastreṇa ca rekhāmullekhayed vidhānataḥ | gururabhyujya madhunā ghṛtenābhyukṣya mantrataḥ ||43 || snāpayenmṛdgomayena śastradoṣanivṛttaye | svarṇapātraśalākādi vastrādi śilpine’rpayet ||44|| godānaṃ gurave cāpi datvā kuṇḍe havaṃ caret | dikpālebhyo baliṃ datvā brāhmaṇān caturaḥ śubhān ||45|| bhojayitvā dakṣiṇādi pradatvā tān visarjayet | iti netrāñjanaṃ kṛtvā saṃkīrtya deśakālakau ||46|| mahāsnānaṃ kārayecca devasya paramātmanaḥ | bhadrāsanāt pratimāmutthāpayenmantrakaṃ gṛṇan ||47|| oṃ uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate devayaṃtastvemahe | upaprayantu marutaḥ sudānava indra prāsūrbhavā sacā ||48|| ityutthāpya bhadraṃ karṇebhīti vedyām udaṅdiśi | bhadrāsane sthāpayitvā pādapīṭhaṃ prakalpayet ||49|| oṃ samudretimantraiśca snāpayeccaturbhirghaṭaiḥ | dadhidūrvākṣatādyaiḥ sampūjyārārtrikamācaret ||2.156.50 || namaste’rce sureśāni prakṛte viśvakarmaṇaḥ | prabhāvitāśeṣajagaddhātri tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ |||5 1 || tvayi sampūjayāmīśaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ parātparam | haritāśeṣadoṣe tvam ṛddhiyuktā sadā bhava ||52|| tato dakṣe kare caurṇasūtraṃ vitastimātrakam | yadā vaghnannitimantrairbadhnīyātpraṇamettathā ||53 || idamāpetimantraiśca prasnāpayeccaturghaṭaiḥ | agnirmūrddheti ca mṛdā tataḥ śuddhodakena ca ||54|| gomayena gomūtreṇa bhasmanā śuddhavāriṇā | pañcagavyena śuddhādbhiḥ kṣīreṇa śuddhavāriṇā ||55|| dadhnā śuddhajalenāpi madhunā ca jalena ca | śarkarayā jalenāpi snāpayenmārjayettataḥ |||56|| pañcāmṛtānāṃ mantrām̐ścoccārayet snānakārakaḥ | yajñāyeti sugandhena tailena cābhiyojayet ||57|| oṃ drupadādiva mumucānaḥ svinnaḥ snāto malādiva | pūtaṃ pavitreṇevājyamāpaḥ śundhantu mainasaḥ ||58|| yavaśāligodhūmādimasūrabilvacūrṇakaiḥ | udvartya oṃ yāteti ca limpayed yakṣakardamaiḥ ||59|| kastūryaṃśadvayaṃ kuṃkumāṃśatrayaṃ śaśyekakam | candanāṃśatrayaṃ yakṣakardamaḥ so’yamucyate ||2.156.6 0|| jaṭāmāṃsyānusaṃlipya ghaṭadvayena snāpayet | mānastokapratadviṣṇumantradvayaṃ samuccaret ||6 1 || pañcanadya itipañcāmṛtena ca pṛthakapṛthak | tattanmantreṇa saṃsnāpya śuddhodakena vai tataḥ ||62|| gandhodakena ca pañcapatrakaṣāyavāriṇā | oṣadhīkalaśenāpi sitapuṣpodakena ca ||63 || śāntighaṭodakenāpi phalaghaṭodakena ca | svarṇodakaghaṭenāpi hiraṇyetimanuṃ gṛṇan ||64|| tataḥ śṛṃgodakenāpi tato dhanyodakena ca | sahasradhārākalaśaiḥ sarvauṣadhījalena ca ||65||| patrodakena ca dūrvodakena ca ratnavāribhiḥ | tīrthodakena ca vārdhighaṭaiḥ saṃsnāpayettataḥ ||66 || kṣārodakena ca kṣīrakuṃbhodakena vai tataḥ | dadhikuṃbhena ca ghṛtenekṣurasena vai tataḥ ||67|| surodakena ca tataḥ svādūdakena vai tataḥ | nārikelajalenāpi lokapālaghaṭaistataḥ ||68|| kadambapatrakuṃbhena śālmalīkuṃbhakodakaiḥ | jambūpatraghaṭenāpi cāśokapatravāriṇā ||69|| plakṣapallavasalilaiścūtapatraghaṭena ca | vaṭapatrodakenāpi bilvapatrodakena ca ||2.156.70|| nāgavallīdalenāpi pālāśapallavena ca | rudrākṣavāriṇā cāpi saṃsnāpya cāvamārjayet ||7 1 || devamāvāhayenmantrairehi cātra sthiro bhava | yajñabhāgaṃ gṛhāṇemaṃ parameśa namostu te ||72|| hiraṇyapātrapādyaṃ ca dadyādarghyaṃ tathā śubham | ācamanaṃ candanādi dadyāttathopavītakam ||73 || vedāhametamiti sūtra yuvāsviti tathāmbaram | vedāhetyuttarīyaṃ ca idaṃ viṣṇuḥ supuṣpakam ||74|| dhūrasīti tato dhūpaṃ candramā iti dīpakam | annapate ca naivedyaṃ karodvartanamācamam ||75|| tāmbūlakaṃ phalaṃ yajñeneti puṣpāñjaliṃ tathā | datvā ca śilpine pātravastrādi sarvamarpayet ||76|| annādhivāsanaṃ kuryāt koṇe tu maṇḍapasya vai | saptasu dhānyaśṛṃgeṣu devānāmupaveśanam ||77|| kṛtvā deveśvaraṃ śayyāyāṃ tu samadhivāsayet | brāhmaṇādīn bhojayecca dvādaśa prīyatāmiti ||78|| godānaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā prāsādamukhadakṣagām | koṇagāṃ śayanīṃ kṛtvā stutvā devamutthāpayet ||79|| rathe tvāropayeccāpi prādakṣiṇyena mandirāt | ānīya yāgamaṇḍakṣmāṃ niveśya dvāri paścime ||2.156.80 || madhyavedyāḥ paścapīṭhe prāṅmukhaṃ taṃ nidhāya ca | dadyānmantrairmadhuparkaṃ puruṣa evedamitinā ||8 1 || pādyaṃ cārghyaṃ madhuparkaṃ mantrairdadyāttataḥ param | madhyavedyāṃ dhānyapuñje kāṣṭhaśayyāṃ tu prākśirām ||82|| āstīrya śuklavasane’kṣatasvastikamālikhet | prāgagragān kuśānāstīrya pūrvādiṣu pūjayet| ||83|| pūrve namo viṣṇave dakṣe madhusūdanāya ca | paścime trivikramāyottare vāmanakāya ca ||84|| āgneyyāṃ śrīdharāyeti ṛṣikeśāya nirṛtau | vāyavye padmanābhāyeśānyāṃ dāmodarāya ca ||85|| namaḥ sampūjayāmīti tatastān triḥparikramet | devaṃ ca śayane kṛtvā tribhiḥ paṭṭadukūlakaiḥ ||86|| ācchādya ca śirodeśe nidrākalaśamānyaset | sahiraṇyāmbaram āpodevīmantreṇa sannyaset ||87|| āpo asmānmātaraścetimantraiḥ pratiṣṭhāpayet | āpyāyasveti madhunā ghṛtenābhyaṃjayettataḥ ||88|| yā te rudretimanunopalipettailasarṣapaiḥ | gandhādyairabhyarcya sitaṃ paridhānaṃ samarpayet ||89|| bṛhaspateti manunā kare dadyāttu kaṃkaṇam | viśvateti pādanābhivakṣaḥśirassvālambhanam ||2.156.90|| purataḥ pāduke pārśvayoḥ śāntikuṃbhakau tathā | dakṣe chatraṃ vyajane ca purataścāsanaṃ tathā ||9 1 || ghaṇṭāṃ bhakṣyaṃ jalaṃ darpaṇādikaṃ sthāpayettataḥ | samantād bhasmanā darbhatilaiḥ prākārakatrayam ||92|| kṛtvā ca maṇḍapād bāhye lokapebhyo’rpayed balim | dikṣu datvā valiṃ kuṇḍamāgatya homamācaret| || 93|| oṃ parāya viṣṇavātmane namaḥ svāhedaṃ viṣṇave | aṣṭottaraśataṃhomaṃ kuryāt tilayavādibhiḥ ||94|| nyāsān kuryād yathā yaṃ pādayoḥ ūṃ hṛdaye tathā | maṃ lalāṭe iti rītyā mūrtau praṇavamarpayet ||95|| bhūḥ pādayorbhuvau hṛdi svarbhāle vyāhṛtīrnyaset | aṃ tālau āṃ mukhe iṃ dakṣe īṃ vāme ca netrake || 96|| uṃ dakṣe ūṃ vāmakarṇe kaṃ dakṣiṇagaṇḍake | ṛṃ vāmagaṇḍake laṃ dakṣiṇanāsāpuṭe tathā || 97|| lūṃ vāme nāsikāpatre eṃ ūrdhve oṣṭhake tathā | aiṃ adharoṣṭhe oṃ danteṣu auṃ danteṣu adhaḥsu ca ||98|| aṃ lalāṭe aḥ jihvāyāṃ yaṃ tvaci raṃ tu cakṣuṣoḥ | laṃ nāsāyāṃ vaṃ daśaneṣu śaṃ śrotrayoḥ ṣaṃ codare ||99|| saṃ karau haṃ hṛdi kṣaṃ nābhyāṃ laṃ liṃge nyasettathā | paphababhama dakṣiṇe bāhau taṃthaṃdaṃdhaṃnaṃ vāmake || 2.156.100 || ṭaṃṭhaṃḍaṃḍhaṃṇaṃ dakṣāyāṃ jaṃghāyāṃ caṃchaṃjaṃjhaṃñaṃ vāmāyām | kaṃkhaṃgaṃghaṃṅaṃ cāṃguliṣu mātṛkānyāsamācaret || 101 || oṃ ravicandrābhyāṃ netrayorbhaumāya hṛdaye tathā | skandhe budhāya jihvāyāṃ bṛhaspataye vai tathā || 10 2|| liṃge śukrāya ca śanaiścarāya tu lalāṭake | rāhave pādayoścāpi keśeṣu ketave tathā || 1 03|| rohiṇībhyo’pi hṛdaye mṛgaśirase mastake | ārdrāyai cāpi keśeṣu punarvasave bhālake || 1 04|| puṣyāya tu mukhe āśleṣābhyo nāsāpuṭe tathā | maghābhyo dantavargeṣu nyāsān samācarettathā || 1 05|| dakṣakarṇe tu pūrvāphālgunībhyo vāmakarṇake | uttarāphālgunībhyaśca hastāya hastayostathā || 1 06|| citrāyai dakṣiṇabhuje svātyai ca vāmabāhuke | viśākhānurādhābhyāṃ stanayo dakṣiṇe tvatha || 1 07|| kukṣau jyeṣṭhābhyo mūlāya vāmakukṣau tatastathā | kaṭyāṃ ca pārśvayoḥ pūrvāṣāḍhābhyo liṃgake tathā || 1 08|| uttarāṣāḍhābhya eva vṛṣaṇe śravaṇāya tu | dhaniṣṭhāyai tathā netre śatabhiṣābhya eva ca || 1 09|| ūrvoḥ pūrvābhādrapadottarābhādrapadābhyāṃ tathā | revatībhyo’śvinībhyaśca nābhyāṃ dhruvāya vai namaḥ | saptarṣibhyaḥ kaṇṭhadeśe mātṛkābhyaḥ kaṭyāṃ namaḥ || 2.156.11 0 || viṣṇupadebhyaḥ pādayostārābhyo romakūpiṣu | nāgavīthyai cāṃgavīthyai vanamālāyāṃ namaḥ || 111 || kaustubhe’gastimunaye namo grahebhya ityapi | hariḥ rādhe nyāsabhedānāha proktā mayāpi te || 11 2|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne snānakalaśasthāpanadikpālabalisvarṇaśalākānetrāṃjanabahughaṭasnānapatrasnāna pūjanābharaṇanaivedyahomapraṇavanyāsamātṛkānyāsanakṣatranyāsādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭpaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 156 ||
<2.157> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rādhe tathā nyāsān yānāha bhagavān svayam | devāyatāya mūrtau vai pravadāmi kriyā api || 1 || caitrāya ca namo mūrdhni vaiśākhāya mukhe tathā | hṛdi jyeṣṭhāyāṣāḍhāśrāvaṇābhyāṃ stanayornamaḥ || 2 || bhādrapadāya udare kaṭyāmāśvinakāya ca | ūrvoḥ kārtikamārgābhyāṃ pauṣamāghāya jaṃghayoḥ || 3 || phalgunāya pādayośca vatsarebhyo dakṣordhvake | saṃvatparīḍāvatsarebhyo namaścaturṣu bāhuṣu || 4 || sandhiṣu parvatebhyaśca liṅge ṛtubhya ityapi | asthiṣu cāhorātrebhyaḥ kṣaṇādibhyaśca romasu | | 5 || mukhe kṛtāya tretāyai hṛdi nitambayostu ca | dvāparāya kalaye pādayorbāhvormanubhya || 6 || parāya ca parārdhāya jaṃghayośca namo namaḥ | mahākalpāya dehe cāyanābhyāṃ pādayornamaḥ || 7 || viṣuvate’ṅgulīṣveva kālāyaiva namo namaḥ | mukhe viprāya bāhvoḥ kṣatrāyorvorvaiśyakāya ca || 8 || śūdrāya pādayoḥ saṃkarāya pādāgrayornamaḥ | sandhiṣu lomajebhyaśca gobhyo namo mukhe tathā || 9 || ajāvikābhyo hastayośca sarvatra paśubhyo namaḥ | namaḥ keśeṣu meghebhyo’bhrebhyo namo’sya romasu || 2.157.10 || namo nadībhyo gātreṣu namo’bdhibhyaśca kukṣike | ṛgvedāya namo mūrdhni yajuṣe dakṣiṇe bhuje || 11 || vāmabhuje tu sāmāyopaniṣadbhyo namo hṛdi | ākhyānebhyo jaṃghayośca nābhāvatharvaṇe namaḥ || 12|| pādayoḥ kalpasūtrebhyo vaktre vyākṛtaye namaḥ | ūhebhyaḥ kaṇṭhadeśe ca niruktāya namo hṛdi || 13 || netrayośchandase jyotiṣe bhautikāya karṇayoḥ | āyurvedāya ca dakṣe bhuje vāme dhanurvide || 14|| yogāya hṛdi nītyai pādayostantrāya cauṣṭhayoḥ | dive mūrdhni namaḥ sūryacandrābhyāṃ netrayornamaḥ || 15|| anilāya namo ghrāṇe vyomne nābhyāṃ namo namaḥ | samudrebhyo namo vastau pṛthpyai namaśca pādayo || 16 || hiraṇmayāya śirasi kṛṣṇāya keśamaṇḍale | bhāle rudrāya bhrūkuṭau yamāya ca namo namaḥ || 17|| aśvibhyāṃ karṇayorvaiśvānarasya ca namo mukhe | marudbhyaśca namo ghrāṇe vasubhyaḥ kaṇṭhake namaḥ || 18|| rudrebhyaśca namo dante sarasvatyai ca vāṅamaye | indrāya tu bhuje dakṣe vāme tu valaye namaḥ || 19|| prahlādāya dakṣastane vāme tu viśvakarmaṇe | nāradāya dakṣakukṣau vāme’nantādikāya ca || 2.157.20 || varuṇāya karayośca mitrāya pādayornamaḥ | ūrumadhye tu viśvebhyaḥ pitṛbhyo jānumadhyake |||21 || yajñebhyo jaṃghayoścāpi rākṣasebhyastu gulphayoḥ | piśācebhyo dakṣapāde’surebhyo vāmapādake ||22|| vidyādhrebhyaḥ pādayośca grahebhyaḥ pattale tathā | guhyakebhyo gude pūtanādibhyaśca nakheṣu ca ||23 || gandharvebhyaścauṣṭhayośca skandāya kaṭipārśvake | gaṇeśaṃ kaṭipārśve ca matsyāya mastake namaḥ || 24|| kūrmāya pādayornṛsiṃhāya namo lalāṭake | vārāhāya jaṃghayośca vāmanāya mukhe namaḥ || 25|| parśurāmāya tu hṛdi namo rāmāya bāhuṣu | nābhyāṃ kṛṣṇāya buddhāya buddhau jānvośca kalkine || 26 || keśavāya ca śirasi nārāyaṇāya vai mukhe | grīvāyāṃ mādhavāyāpi bāhvorgovindakāya ca || 27|| viṣṇave hṛdye madhusūdanāya tu pṛṣṭhake | trivikramāya ca kaṭyāṃ vāmanāyodare namaḥ ||28|| jaṃghayoḥ śrīdharahṛṣīkeśābhyāṃ tu namo namaḥ | gulphayoḥ padmanābhāya dāmodarāya pādayoḥ ||29 || mūrdhni namo’śvamedhāya naramedhāya bhālake | rājasūyāya ca mukhe gomedhāya tu kaṇṭhake ||2.157.3 0 || namo hṛdi dvādaśāyādhīnebhyo nābhimaṇḍale | sarvajite dakṣakaṭyāṃ vāmāyāṃ sarvamedhine ||3 1 || liṃge namo’gniṣṭomāyātirātrāya tu golayoḥ | āptoryāmāya corvośca jānvoḥ ṣoḍaśine namaḥ || 32 || utathyāya dakṣajaṃghāyāṃ vāmāyāṃ namo’pi tu | vājapeyāyātyagniṣṭomāya bāhau tu dakṣiṇe || 33 || cāturmāsyāya ca vāme sautrāmaṇaye hastayoḥ | paśviṣṭībhyo’ṅgulīṣveva darśapaurṇāya netrayoḥ || 34|| sarveṣṭibhyo romakūpe vaṣaṭ svāhāya ca stane | pādāṅgulīṣu ca pañcamahāyajñebhya eva ca || 35 || āhavanīyāya mukhe hṛdi dakṣiṇavahnaye | gārhapatyāya ca nābhau vedyai taduttare namaḥ ||3 6 || pravargyāya bhūṣaṇeṣu savanebhyaśca pādayoḥ | edhebhyo bāhuṣu darbhebhyaḥ keśeṣu namo hareḥ ||37|| mūrdhni dharmāya ca hṛdi jñānāya ca namo namaḥ | vairāgyāya ca guhye vai aiśvaryāya tu pādayoḥ || 38 || khaṅgāya namaḥ śirasi śārṅgāya mastake namaḥ | dakṣabhuje mūśalāya vāmabhuje halāya ca || 39 || nābhyāṃ ca jaṭhare pṛṣṭhe cakrāya ca namo namaḥ | śaṃkhāya liṃge vṛṣaṇe gadāyai jānujaṃghayoḥ ||2.157.40 || pādagulphayoḥ padmāya lakṣmyai namo lalāṭake | namo mukhe sarasvatyai ratyai guhye namo namaḥ || 41 || prītyai kaṇṭhe namaḥ kīrtyai dikṣu śāntyai namo hṛdi | tuṣṭyai namaśca jaṭhare puṣṭyai sarvatra vai namaḥ ||42|| dakṣavāmastanayoḥ śrīvatsāya ca namo namaḥ | kaustubhāyorasi vanamālāyai kaṇṭhake namaḥ ||43 || oṃ pādayornaṃ tu jānvomoṃ guhye bhaṃ nābhike | gaṃ hṛdi vaṃ kaṇṭhake teṃ mukhe vā netrayornamaḥ || 44|| suṃ bhāle deṃ mastake vāṃ dakṣapārśve yamuttare | aṃ randhre nāṃ śikhāyāṃ diṃ bhāle śrīṃ bhṛmadhyake ||45 || kaṃ mukhe ṣṇaṃ kaṇṭhamadhye nāṃ bāhvoḥ rāṃ hṛdantare | yaṃ stane ṇāṃ jaṭhare ca yaṃ nābhau jaghane tu pam || 46 || taṃ guhye yeṃ vṛṣaṇe naṃ sakthnormaṃ jānukadvaye | visargaḥ pādayośceti namaḥ śrīharaye muhuḥ ||47|| śrīṃ hṛdi rādhikāṃ vāme lakṣmīṃ bāhau tu vāmake | ramāṃ dakṣe brahmavidyāṃ bāhau hṛdi tu māṇikīm ||48|| parāvidyādikā mūrtau kṛṣṇāntā naumi vai hareḥ | santoṣāyaiḥ kaṃbharāyai namo harestu netrayoḥ ||49 || iti kṛtvā sarvanyāsān jīvanyāsaṃ tataścaret | mūrtau tejo bhāvayitvā buddhīndriyamanāṃsi ca ||2.157.5 0 || prāṇāhaṃkāratanmātrāḥ saṃyujya tanubhāvanām | puṃbhāvaṃ tatra vai kṛtvā bhāvayitvā tu sākṣiṇam ||5 1 || nyaset tattvatrayaṃ vā ca pañcatattvāni sanyaset | ātmatattvāya devāya brahmaṇe pādayornamaḥ ||5 2| | vidyātattvāya devāya viṣṇave hṛdaye namaḥ | śivatattvāya devāya śivāya mastake namaḥ |||5 3 || brahmatattvāya śirasi māyātattvāya kaṇṭhake | īśatattvāya hṛdaye jīvatattvāya pādayoḥ ||5 4|| antaryāmipratattvāya namaḥ sarvaśarīrake | tatpādāṃguṣṭhayoḥ saṃgulphayorvi jaṃghayostathā ||5 5 || tuṃ jānvorvaṃ tathorvoḥ reṃ gudeṃ ṇiṃ vṛṣaṇe tathā| yaṃ kaṭyāṃ bhaṃ nābhikāyāṃ gaṃ jaṭhare stane ca dem||56|| vaṃ hadi syaṃ kaṇṭhake ca dhīṃ vaktre tāluke ca mam | hiṃ nāsāyāṃ cakṣuṣodhiṃ yoṃ bhrvāṃ lalāṭake tu yom ||57|| pūrve naḥ ṣaṃ dakṣiṇe ca paśce coṃ uttare tu dam | yāṃ mūrdhni ca sarvatra tatsaviturhṛdi hareḥ |||18|| vareṇyaṃ mastake bhargo devasya dhīmahi kace | dhiyo yo naḥ netrayośca pracodayāt tadasrake ||899|| oṃ nāṃ pādāṃguṣṭhayośca rāṃ gulphayoryaṃ jaṃghayoḥ | ṇāṃ jānvoryaṃ tathorvo rviṃ gude vṛṣaṇe ghmakam ||2.157.60 || heṃ kaṭyāṃ vāṃ nābhikāyāṃ suṃ jaṭhare stane ca dem | vāṃ hṛdi yaṃ kaṇṭhake ca dhīṃ vaktre tāluke ca mam ||6 1 || hiṃ nāsāyāṃ cakṣuṣostat no bhrvāṃ viṃ tu lalāṭake | ṣṇuṃ randhre praṃ śikhāyāṃ coṃ mānase daṃ śarīrake || 6 2|| yāṃ cātmani sarvamūrtau cintayāmi hareriha | nārāyaṇāya hṛdaye vidmahe mastake tathā || 63 || vāsudevāya kavace dhīmahīti ca netrayoḥ | tanno viṣṇuścāntare na pracodayāta tadastrake ||68|| agnimīle pādayośca iṣe tvo gulkayornamaḥ | śanno devīti jānvoḥ suparṇosītyūrudvaye ca ||65|| svasti na iti jaṭhare dīrghāyu tveti vai hṛdi | śrīśca te iti kaṇṭhe ca trātāramiti vaktrake ||66|| tryambakamiti stanayornetrayośca namo namaḥ | mūrdhānamiti vai mūrdhni nārāyaṇāya te namaḥ ||67|| oṃ keśavāya namo mūrdhni mukhe nārāyaṇāya nam | grīvāyāṃ moṃ mādhavāya bhaṃ govindāya kaṇṭhake ||68|| pṛṣṭhe gaṃ viṣṇave vaṃ kukṣau madhusūdanāya ca | teṃ kaṭyāṃ trivikramāya jaṃghayorvāmanāya vām ||69|| suṃ guhye śrīdharāyeti deṃ gulphe hṛṣīkeśine | vāṃ pāde padmanābhāya dakṣe dāmodarāya yam || 2.157.70|| huṃ hṛdayāya namo hṛdi viṣṇave mastake namaḥ | śikhāyāṃ brahmaṇe cāpi dhruvāya kavace namaḥ ||7 1 || cakriṇe netrayornamo’strāya phaṭ cakriṇe namaḥ | sahasraśīrṣapādayoḥ pūruṣa eva jaṃghayoḥ ||72||| etāvāniti jānvośca ūrvostrapādūrdhvakam | tasmādirāṭ ca vṛṣaṇe tasmād yajñād kaṭisthale || 73 || tasmādyajñāt sarvanābhyāṃ tasmādaśvā hṛdisthale | taṃ yaśaṃ ca stanayośca bāhvoryatpurupaṃ tathā ||74|| brāhmaṇo’syeti ca mukhe candramā iti cakṣuṣoḥ | nābhyā āsītkarṇayośca bhuvoryatpuruṣeti ca ||75|| saptāsyetibhālake ca yajñeneti ca mastake | adbhyaśca hadaye vedāhamityetacca mastake ||76|| prajāpatiḥ śikhāyāṃ ca yodevakavace tathā | ṛcaṃ brāhmaṃ netrayośca śrīścāstraṃ nyāsamācaret | |77|| nidrāmāvāhayeccāpi mohinyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca | bhogiśayyāprasuptasya nārāyaṇasya śāsane ||78|| tvaṃ pratiṣṭhāsi vai devi gṛhāṇa pūjanaṃ balim | ehi sāvitrikāmūrte cakṣurbhyo sthānagocare | |79 || viśa nāsāpuṭe devi kaṇṭhe cotkaṇṭhitā viśa | idamarghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ pūjeyaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||2.157.8 0|| evaṃ nidrākalaśe ca nidrāṃ prapūjya vai tataḥ | baliṃ dattvā lokapālādibhyaḥ śayyāṃ prapūjayet ||8 1 || sarvatobhadrake viṣṇuṃ dvādaśāre sucakrake | padme’ṣṭadalake kṛṣṇaṃ mūlamantreṇa veśayet |||82|| karṇikāyāṃ hṛdayaṃ prapūjayecca hrade namaḥ | pūrvapatre śiraḥ pūjayecca vai viṣṇave namaḥ || 83 || dakṣapatre śikhāṃ pūjayecca vai brahmaṇe namaḥ | paścimaṃ kavacaṃ pūjayecca dhruvāya vai namaḥ ||858|| uttare’straṃphaṭapūjayecca vai cakriṇe namaḥ | āgneye śaṃbhave namo gāyatrīṃ pūjayettathā | |85|| vijayāmitisāvitrīmīśānadalake’rcayet | jyotirūpāya ca namo nairṛte vai namo namaḥ ||86| | cakrirūpāya ca namaḥ piṅgalāstraṃ tu vāyuke | iti garbhāvaraṇaṃ ca kṛtvārāsu purākramāt ||87|| keśavaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ mādhavaṃ govindamityapi | viṣṇuṃ ca madhusūdanaṃ trivikramaṃ vāmanaṃ tathā | |88|| śrīdharaṃ ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ padmanābhaṃ damodaram | pūjayed dvādaśamūrtīrdvitīyāvaraṇaṃ hi tat | | 8 9|| pūrvataśca punaḥ khaṅgaṃ cakraṃ suśaṃkhakam | padmaṃ halaṃ śārṅgamagnimūrtyadhipatikaṃ tathā || 2.157.90 || yajamānamūrtyadhipatikaṃ cograṃ tathārkakam | tṛtīyāvaraṇaṃ saṃpūjayet tadadhipām̐stataḥ || 91 || pṛthvyai tadadhipataye vāsudevāya vai namaḥ | dakṣe jalāya pataye saṃkarṣaṇāya vai namaḥ || 92 || paśce’gnaye’dhipataye pradyumnāya namo namaḥ | uttare vāyave cāniruddhāya vai namo namaḥ || 93 || svamūrtaye namo nārāyaṇāya ca namo namaḥ | indrādikān pūjayitvā vastrairdevamācchādayet | | 94|| stutvā puṣpāṃjaliṃ datvāvakīrya maṇḍapādikāna | puṣpādyairmaṇḍale svasti likhitvā devatātrayam ||95|| lokapālān vasūn rudrānādityān viśvadevatāḥ | sādhyān marudgaṇān gandharvāpsarasa ityamūn||96|| pitṛgaṇān sutīrthāni skandadurgādikām̐stathā | kṣetrapālān pārṣadāṃśca namaḥ kṛtvā prapūjayet ||97|| ācāryaḥ kuṇḍamāgatya palāśodumbarodbhavāḥ | aśvatthāpāmārgajāśca samidho’ṣṭaśatāni vai ||98|| trisahasrāṇi vā ṣaṭsahasrāṇyaṣṭasahasrakam | dvādaśāpi sahasrāṇi rakṣet kuṇḍasamīpataḥ ||99|| śāntikapauṣṭikairmantrairjuhuyācca yathāṃśakam | oṃ śanno vātaḥ pavatāṃ śaṃ nastapatu sūryaḥ ||2.157.10 0|| śannaḥ kaniṣkradaddevaḥ parjanyo hyabhivarṣatu | śanno devirabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye ||1 0 1|| oṃ puṣṭinaraṇvān kṣitirna pṛthivī girirna bhujmaḥ kṣodo na śambhuḥ | athonā majjan sargaḥ praṇaktaḥ sindhurna takṣodaḥ kadambarāto | jayasphāno amīvahā vasuvita puṣṭivardhanaḥ ||102|| atha pūrvakuṇḍake’gnimīlehi juhuyāt tilaiḥ | yavaiścāṣṭottaraśataṃ palāśasamidhāthavā ||103|| iṣe tveti manunā ca juhuyād dakṣakuṇḍake | omagneti juhuyācca paścime kuṇḍake tathā ||1 04|| śanno devītyuttare kuṇḍake ca juhuyāttathā | vauṣaṭiti ca manunā juhuyādagnidigbhave || 105|| gāyatryā ca juhuyācca nairṛte kuṇḍake tathā | jātavedasavāyavye namo brahmetīśānake || 1 06|| mūrdhānaṃ divamantreṇa pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ param | juhuyuścāhutipātā śāntighaṭe matāstadā || 1 07|| evaṃ rādhe hariḥ prāha devāyatanakāya yat | mayā te’bhihitaṃ sarva vidhānaṃ phaladaṃ śravāt || 108|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mūrtau māsartuyugavarṇavedavasudikpālalokapālakṣetrapālabhagavadavatāra yajñāgni heti bhūṣaṇa priyātattva mūlamantra gāyatrīdvayārpaṇamantra puruṣasūktanyāsa pūjābalipradāna havanādinirūpaṇanāmā saptapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’thyāyaḥ || 157 ||
<2.158> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tato rādhe pūrṇāhutiṃ mahāhutīn | yānāha śrīharistatra karma cātra vadāmi te || 1 || syonāpṛthvīti pṛthivyai aghorebhyaśca śaṃbhave | indrāyendro mahendrāyāgnaye’gniṃ dūtamityapi || 2 || paśūnāṃ paśupatayegnaye agna āyāhi ca | asihī yajamānāya tamindraṃ rudramūrtaye || 3 || yāmāyeti yamāyaiva udutyaṃ sūryamūrtaye | āvo rudrāya cāsunvantaṃ nirṛtaye’rpayet || 4 || āpohi jaladevāya vibhūṣaṃ tu bhavāya ca | imaṃ me varuṇāyeti vātaā vāyumūrtaye || 5 || īśānāya tamīśānaṃ ānonīti ca vāyave | vayaṃ somāya sūryāya indraṃ mahādevāya tu || 6 || ādipratneti haraye bhīmāya tu mṛgonabhī | īśānāya abhityaṃ tu juhuyānmantrasādhitam || 7 || ekakuṇḍe mahācāryo juhuyāt sarvanāmataḥ | aṣṭasāhasrakaṃ yadvā cāṣṭaśataṃ havān caret || 8 || pūrṇāhutiṃ tato hutvā devakarṇe tu dakṣake | nivedyayoḥ sparśaṃ ghṛtāhutyaṣṭakottaram || 9 || kuryācca mūlamantreṇa śatādisaṃkhyayā havam | yāmakuṇḍe dadhi hutvā devanābhiṃ spṛśettataḥ || 2.158.1 0|| vāruṇe kuṇḍake kṣīraṃ hutvā hṛdi hareḥ spṛśet | saumyakuṇḍe madhu hutvā mūrdhānaṃ tu spṛśeddhareḥ || 11 || vāruṇe kuṇḍake miśraṃ ghṛtādyeva catuṣṭayam | hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā sarvāṃgāni spṛśeddhareḥ || 1 2|| mūrtau kṛtvā nyāsavidhiṃ kūrmaśilāṃ prapūjya ca | brahmaśilāṃ piṇḍikāṃ ca vāhanāni ca pārṣadān || 13|| paricārakadevām̐śca parivārān prapūjayet | vāme’dhivāsayettām̐śca viṣṇorvai caṇḍaprabhatīn || 14|| madhughṛtaiḥ samabhyujya jalaiḥ prakṣālya pūjayet | vastreṇācchādya ca mūrtermantranyāsām̐stataścaret || 15|| viṣṇuḥ sthāpyo bhavedyatra pratimāpiṇḍikāvidhau | oṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ paṃ bhaṃ phaṃ lakṣmyai namo hṛdi ca mastake || 16|| śikhāyāṃ kavace netre huṃphaṭ svāheti vai namama | nyasyaivaṃ piṇḍikāyāṃ tu pañcāṃgāni ca tatra ca || 17|| vinyasenmūrtimān mantrairmūrtau vai mūrtimān yajet | oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hrāṃ kṣaḥ namaḥ śrīparabrahmaṇe’khiladhṛge || 18|| oṃ hrāṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ divyatejodhartryai subhagāyai namaḥ| ityadhivāsanaṃ kṛtvā prāsādasyādhivāsanam || 1 9 nūtanasya samīpe caikāśītipadamaṇḍalam | kṛtvākṣataiḥ padeṣveva saptadhānyajapuñjakān ||2.158.20|| kṛtvā jalāḍhyakalaśānekāśītiṃ śubhānnavān | āhṛtya tatra ca navanavakeṣu tu madhyamam ||21 || jñātvā koṣṭhaṃ teṣu kuṃbhān madhyapūrvakramādinā | nyasya madhye tu kalaśe dvādaśapallavāni vai || 22|| śamyudumbarakāśvatthapalāśāśokacampakāḥ | kadambaplakṣanyagrodhāmrakabilvārjunā drumāḥ ||23 || teṣāṃ patrāṇi grāhyāṇi namaḥ somāya nikṣipet | tataḥ pūrvaghaṭe padmakarocanādūrvāṃkurān || 24|| darbhapiñjūladhavalapītasarṣapakām̐stathā | raktacandanajātīpuṣpanandāvartamādaśa ||25|| tata āgneyakalaśe saptakaṃ nikṣiped yathā | yavavrīhitilasvarṇaraupyanadītaṭamṛdaḥ ||26|| bhūmyaspṛṣṭaṃ gomayaṃ ca nama uktvā vinikṣipet | tato yāmyaghaṭe’ṣṭau ca nikṣipet tad yathāyatham ||27|| sahadevīṃ viṣṇukrāntāṃ bhṛṃgarājaṃ mahauṣadhim | śamīṃ śatāvarīṃ guḍūcīṃ śyāmākaṃ vinikṣipet ||28|| tato nairrtyakalaśe kadalīṃ pūgikāphalam | nārikelaṃ ca bilvaṃ ca nārigaṃ mātuliṃgakam ||29|| badaraṃ cāmalakaṃ ca nama uktvā vinikṣipet | vāruṇe tu ghaṭe pañcagavyaṃ mantritamādadet || 2.158.3 0|| vāyavye kalaśe śamyudumbarāśvatthakodbhavam | nyagrodhakapalāśotthaṃ kaṣāyapañcakaṃ nyaset ||3 1 || saumye ghaṭe śaṃkhapuṣpīṃ sahadevīṃ balāṃ tathā | śatāvarīṃ kumārīṃ ca guḍūcīṃ ca vacāṃ tathā ||32|| vyāghrīṃ ca mūlarūpāstā aṣṭamūlāni saṃnyaset | īśakuṃbhe valmīkaprabhṛtisaptamṛdo nyaset ||33|| hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīṃ suvarṇarajatasrajām | candrāṃ hiraṇmayīṃ lakṣmīṃ jātavedo ma āvaha ||34|| iti mantreṇa ca madhyakuṃbhakānabhimantrayet | śeṣān gandhodakaiḥ pūrayitvābhimantrya vai tataḥ ||35|| mūlamantreṇa sūtraiścābhiveṣṭyāntarbahirhyadhaḥ | ūrdhvaṃ ca śikharaṃ prāsādaṃ prokṣya pañcagavyakaiḥ ||36|| mūrdhānaṃ divamantreṇa valmīkamṛtsnayā tataḥ | limpayedvai tataḥ samudrādūrmīti ca mantrataḥ ||37|| īśānamṛttikākuṃbhakena saṃsnapayettata | yajñāyajñetimantreṇa kaṣāyakuṃbhakena ca || 38,|| vāyavyena snapayecca payaḥpṛthivyetimantrataḥ | vāruṇena pañcagavyakuṃbhena snapayettataḥ ||39|| yāḥ phalinīti nairṛtaphalakuṃbhena vai tataḥ | haṃsaḥ śucīti saumyasthamūlāṣṭakuṃbhakena ca ||2.158.40 || viṣṇorarāṭamasīti pūrveṇa kuṃbhakena ca | somaḥ rājeti mantreṇāgneyasthakuṃbhakena ca ||41 || viśvataścetimantreṇa yāmyasthakuṃbhakena ca | namo’stu sarpamantreṇa madhyasthakuṃbhakena ca ||42||| aṣṭābhiḥ pūrvakramataḥ śikharaṃ snāpayettataḥ | oṃ idamāpaḥ pravahatāvadyañca malaṃ ca yat ||43 || yaccābhidudrohānnṛtaṃ yacca śepe abhīruṇam | āpo mā tasmādenasaḥ pavamānaśca muñcatu ||44|| oṃ daivyāya karmaṇe śundhadhvandevayajyāyai yaddravo śuddhāḥ parājagghnuridaṃ vastacchundhāmi | iti saṃprokṣya sūtreṇāveṣṭya snāpayitvā devarūpaṃ prāsādaṃ cintayitvādhivāsayet ||45|| oṃ hrīṃ sarvadevamayācintya sarvaratnojjvalākṛte | yāvaccandraśca sūryaśca tāvadatra sthiro bhava ||46 || atha śṛṃgakalaśaṃ ca patākāḥ sthāpayettathā | piṇḍikāvāhadevānāṃ homaṃ kṛtvā tilādibhiḥ ||47|| caturdhenūrdakṣadvāre sampūjyodaṅmukhīstataḥ | oṃ nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi ||48|| tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāditi dugdhvā ca pāyasam | śrapayitvā caruṃ nivedya ca nārāyaṇāya tu ||49 || daśaviprān bhojayitvā prīyatāṃ viṣṇuruccaret | dhenūrdadyānmahācāryāyartvigbhyaḥ svarṇajormikāḥ ||2.158.50|| datvā ca dakṣiṇā rātrau mahotsavaṃ prakārayet | saptapañcatryekarātraṃ balyantaṃ vādhivāsanam ||5 1|| tato gururbahirgatvā dhyāyet prāsādadevatām | pādau pādaśilā proktā jaṃghā pādordhvamucyate ||52||| garbhaścaivodaraṃ jñeyaṃ kaṭiśca kaṭimekhalā | staṃbhāśca bāhavo bodhyā ghaṇṭā jihvā prakīrtitā ||53|| dīpaḥ prāṇo’sya vijñeyo hyapāno jalanirgamaḥ | brahmasthānaṃ nābhirasya hṛtpadmaṃ piṇḍikā matā ||54|| pratimā puruṣaḥ so’yaṃ pādastvahaṃkarastathā | jyotiścakṣustadūrdhvaṃ ca prakṛtistasya kīrtitā ||55|| pratimātmā nalakuṃbhādadhodvāraṃ tu śiśnakam | śukanāsā nāsikāsya gavākṣaḥ karṇa ucyate ||56|| kapotapāliḥ skandho’sya grīvā cāmalasārakaḥ | kalaśastu śiro jñeyaṃ majjākṣiptarasaṃ hitam ||57|| medaṃ tu vasudhāṃ vidyāt pralepo māṃsam ucyate | asthīni ca śilāstasya snāyuḥ kīlādayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||818|| cakṣuṣī śikharāstasya dhvajāḥ keśāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | evaṃ narasvarūpaṃ saṃdhyāyetprāsādakaṃ makhī ||59|| pūjayed gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ sūtreṇa veṣṭayettathā | vastraṃ ca kalpayet sūtraṃ namaskāraṃ carettataḥ ||2.158.6 0|| ityadhivāsanaṃ kṛtvā prātaḥ snātvā ca maṇḍape | ācāryastu samāgatya mūrtipān dvārapān surān ||61 || vāstudevān samabhyarcya kuṇḍe hutvāṣṭakaṃ śatam | vāstoṣpatetimantreṇa pūrṇāhutiṃ tu mūlataḥ ||62|| dikpālebhyo baliṃ datvā devaṃ ca praṇamettataḥ | maṇḍapottarakalaśairyajamānaṃ tu secayet ||63|| guruṃ viprān sthapatyādīn toṣayed dakṣiṇādibhiḥ | prāsādotsargakaṃ kuryād deśakālau bhidhāya ca ||64|| imaṃ prāsādakaṃ devālayaṃ devasya prītaye | utsṛjāmīti saṃprocya kṣiptvā kuśābyavān tataḥ ||65|| natvā devaṃ brāhmaṇādīn sādhūn sādhvīḥ prabhojayet | acalāyāḥ pratimāyāḥ karmārthaṃ mūrtipaiḥ saha ||66|| samadhivāsitāṃ devādhārāṃ kūrmaśilā tathā | brahmaśilāṃ piṇḍikāṃ saṃgṛhyācāryaḥ pradakṣiṇam ||67|| prāsādaṃ tu samānīya trātāramindrakaṃ gṛṇan | astrāya phaṭ pramantreṇa vighnānāṃ nāśanāya vai ||68|| puṣpodakānāṃ dhārābhirabhyukṣya bhavanaṃ śubham | oṃ ca mahām̐ indreṇeti darbheṇollikhya vai tataḥ ||69|| prokṣyāstravāriṇā samyak prāsādadvāramadhyataḥ | yavārdhena ca vaiśānīmuttarāṃ cāpya vā diśam ||2.158.70 || snānādisaṃskṛtāṃ kūrmaśilāṃ tu pañcaratnake | praṇavena nidhāyaiva śubhre sauvarṇakacchapam ||71 || dvārābhimukhamānyasya nyasya ratnāni tatra ca | ṣaṭtriṃśatpañcacatvāriṃśadgarttasahitāṃ ca vā ||72|| brahmaśilāmadhivāsitāṃ nidadhyāt samarcayet | oṃ namo vyāpini sthire’cale dhruve ca śaṃ kuru ||73 || oṃ śrīṃ laṃ svāhetimantreṇābhyarcayed yatheṣṭakam | tvamevāsanaśaktiśca tiṣṭhātra sarvadā śile ||74|| varṇādhvane namaḥ padādhvane mantrādhvane namaḥ | bhuvanādhvane namastattvādhvane sakalādhvane ||75|| dhyātvārūḍhaṃ samadhvānaṃ puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tataḥ | aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā brahmaśilāpragartake ||76|| prādakṣiṇyena sahemnā hastena ratnanyāsakān | kuryāt śvabhrarahite tu śilābhāge saśvabhrikām ||77|| piṇḍikāṃ prākpaścamukhe saudhe saumyapraṇālikām | dakṣottare pūrvapraṇālīṃ gṛṇan dhruvasūktakam ||78|| devapatnīmantrakeṇa piṇḍikāmabhimantrayet | śrīśca te ca paṭhet sūktaṃ ramāṃ saṃsthāpayet tataḥ ||79|| tattvanyāsān prakuryācca ātmatattvāya vai namaḥ | ātmatattvakriyāśaktyai cādhipatyai namo namaḥ ||2.158.80|| vidyātattvāya ca namo jñānaśaktyai namo namaḥ | śivatattvāya ca nama icchāśaktyai namo namaḥ ||8 1 || pratitattve mūrtimūrtipalokapālakān nyaset | namaścādhāraśaktyai cānantāsanaṃ savahnikam ||82|| vidhāyābhyarcya oṃ namaḥ prārthayettāṃ suśaktikām | sarvalokādhikaraṇe tvāmatra sthāpayāmi ca ||83|| yāvadvasundharā tāvanmandire’tra sthirā bhava | itiprārthya ca tadbāhye praṇavaṣoḍaśasvarān ||84|| kṛtvābhito vyaṃjanāni nyasya śvabhrāntare tataḥ | ratnādīn sthāpayet bāhyaparidhau ca yavān vrīhīn ||85|| niṣpāvān tilāmāṣāṃśca priyaṅguṃ ca nīvārakān | śālisiddhārthakām̐ścāpi vajramauktikaśaṃkhakān ||86|| vaiḍūryasphaṭikapuṣparāgendranīlapadmakān | candrakāntaṃ manaḥśilāṃ haritālāṃ janaśyamām ||87|| janakāṃ sīsakāṃ saurāṣṭrīṃ rocanāṃ ca gairikām | pāradaṃ kanakaṃ rūpyaṃ tāmramāyasakaṃ trapum ||88|| sīsaṃ kāṃsyaṃ cārakūṭaṃ tīkṣṇalauhāni vāpyatha | śvetaṃ raktaṃ candanaṃ cāgurumarjunakaṃ tathā ||89|| uśīraṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ sahadevīṃ ca lakṣmaṇāṃ nyaset | bījābhāve yavān ratnābhāve vajraṃ samarpayet ||2.158.90|| dhātvabhāve haritālaṃ tāmrābhāve suvarṇakam | oṣadhyabhāve sahadevīṃ dadhāllaṃbhanaṃ tataḥ ||91|| pūrve trātāramindreti āgneyyāmagnimityapi | yamāya tvāmiti yāmyāṃ asunvanteti nirṛtau ||92|| vāruṇyāṃ pañcanadyeti vāyavyāṃ vāyo yetati | uttare oṃ vayaṃ ceti īśānyāṃ tamīśāneti ||93|| ratnanyāsān vidhāyaivaṃ pṛthvīsumerukacchapān | vāhanaṃ ceti sauvarṇān dvārābhimukhakān tathā ||94|| madhyaśvabhre pāradaṃ ca nidhāya guggulaiḥ rasaiḥ | ratnādikaṃ sthirīkṛtya śvabhraṃ pralipya pāyasaiḥ ||95|| madhunā copalipyāpi vastreṇācchādya hum̐ iti | kavacenāvaguṇṭhyaivāstrāyaphaṭsaṃvadettataḥ ||96|| manojūtirjuṣatāṃ ca prāsādamabhiṣicya ca | indrādibhyo baliṃ datvā prāsādāśca bahistataḥ ||97|| prādakṣiṇyena ca bhuvaṃ prokṣya vai pañcagavyakaiḥ | saṃmṛjya darbhapiñjūlyairaṣṭadikṣu tataścaret ||98|| vālukāsthaṇḍilānyaṣṭa caturasrāṇi vai tataḥ | trivitastipramāṇāni teṣāmīśānaprabhṛtau ||99|| kalaśān vāripūrṇān satpuṣpapallavasatphalān | sūtraveṣṭitakān nyasya sthaṇḍile bhūmisaṃskṛtim || 2.158.10 0|| sampādyāgniṃ praṇīyāpi palāśasamidhā tataḥ | aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā gāyatryājyena vai tataḥ || 10 1|| aṣṭakalaśatoyaiśca mūlamantrābhimantritaiḥ | devamūrdhnyabhisiñcecca hum̐phaṭ digbandhanaṃ caret || 102|| prārthayettaṃ prabudhyasva devadeva jagatpate | prabuddhasya dharānantavāsudeva namo’stu te || 103 || śaṃkhasthān taṇḍulatilakuśakṣīrajalādikān | rādhe datvārghyakaṃ devaṃ mantreṇotthāpayediti || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pūrṇāhutirnyāsā adhivāsanaṃ kuṃbhajalāni śikharasnānaṃ caruśrapaṇaṃ prāsādapuruṣākāratādhyānaṃ pūjanaṃ kūrmaśilā brahmaśilā piṇḍikā ratnāni devārghyaṃ cetyādinirūṇanāmāṣṭapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 158 ||
<2.159> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca tato rādhe harerutthāpanaṃ mantreṇa kīrtitam | tatsarvaṃ karmakāṇḍaṃ cāvicalāṃ pratimāṃ tathā || 1 || kathayāmi hariḥ prāha devāyatanakāya yat | oṃ uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate devayaṃtastvemahe || 2 || upapprayantu marutaḥ sudānava indra prāśurbhavā sacā | itimantreṇa cotthāpya rathe samupaveśayet || 3 || oṃ rathe tiṣṭhannayati vājinaḥ puro yatra yatra kāmayate suṣārathiḥ | abhīśūnāṃ mahimānaṃ panāyata manaḥpaścādanuyacchanti raśmayaḥ || 4 || iti rathe tu devasya purobhāge guruḥ svayam | pṛṣṭhabhāge yajamāno niṣīdet sakuṭumbakaḥ || 5 || pārśvapayomūrtipāḥ rakṣārthaṃ ca maṃgalaniḥsvanaiḥ | tūryaghoṣaiśca saudhasya grāmasya nagarasya ca || 6 || pradakṣiṇaṃ vidhāyaivānīya prāsādakaṃ rathāt | avatārya mandiradvārābhimukhaṃ vidhāya ca || 7 || ardhyaṃ datvā tataḥ prāsādake devaṃ niveśayet | yajamāno gururdevaṃ piṇḍikāyāṃ nidhāpayet || 8 || sumahurte sulagne ca śubhagrahaiḥ samīkṣite | īśvareśaṃ bhāvayam̐śca padmaṃ śvabhre nidhāya ca || 9 || yāvaddharaṇīvāsaśca tāvattvaṃ susthiro bhava | ityuktvā śaktisahite devaṃ dṛḍhaṃ sulagnayet || 2.159.1 0|| viṣṇorvāme mahālakṣmīṃ sthāpayenna caledyathā | viśvataścetimantreṇa hastaṃ devasya mūrdhani || 11 || kṛtvā dhyātvā tataḥ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ sucarenmakhī prāṇapratiṣṭhāmantrasya brahmaviṣṇuśivarṣayaḥ || 1 2|| ṛgyajuḥsāmachandāṃsi kriyāprāṇastu devatā | āṃ bījaṃ krauṃ tathā śaktiḥ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ niyojanam || 1 3|| brahmādibhyo namo mūrdhni ṛgādibhyo namo mukhe | prāṇāya ca namo hṛtsu āṃ bījāya gupte namaḥ || 14|| krauṃ śaktyai tu namaḥ pādayośca dehe namo namaḥ | tataḥ sabījān nyāsām̐śca prāṇāgamārthamācaret || 15 || oṃ kaṃkhaṃgaṃghaṃṅaṃ āṃ pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśātmane oṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ | oṃ caṃchaṃjaṃjhaṃñaṃ iṃ śabdasparśarūparasagandhātmane īṃ śirasi svāhā || 16 || oṃ ṭaṃṭhaṃḍaṃḍhaṃṇaṃ oṃ śrotratvakcakṣūrasanāghrāṇātmane aṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | auṃ taṃthaṃdaṃdhaṃnaṃ eṃ vākpāṇipādapāyūpasthātmane aiṃ kavacāya hum || 17|| oṃ paṃphaṃbaṃbhaṃmaṃ oṃ vacanādānaviharaṇotsargānandātmane oṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | oṃ yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃśaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃlaṃkṣaṃ aṃ manobuddhyahaṃkāracittātmane aḥ astrāya phaṭ || 18|| atha devaṃ spṛṣṭvā oṃ āṃhrīṃkrauṃyaṃraṃlaṃvaṃśaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃsaḥ devasya prāṇa iha prāṇāḥ | oṃ āṃhrīṃkrauṃyaṃraṃlavaṃśaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃsaḥ devasya jīva iha sthitaḥ || 19 || oṃ āṃhrīṃkrauṃyaṃraṃlaṃvaṃśaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃsaḥ devasya sarvendriyāṇīha | oṃ āṃhrīṃkrauṃyaṃraṃlaṃvaṃśaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃsaḥ devasya vāṅmanaścakṣuḥśrotraghrāṇaprāṇāḥ iha tiṣṭhantu svāhā ||2.159.20|| athārcāhṛdi aṃguṣṭhaṃ datvā japetasyai prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhantu asyai prāṇāścarantu ca | asyai devatvamarcāyai māmaheti ca kaścana ||21 || praṇavena sanniruddhya dhyātvā sajīvameva ca | dhruvā dyauśca gṛṇan karṇe japtvā gāyatrikāṃ manum || 22|| puruṣasūktenopasthāya ca natvā tataḥ param | pādau nābhiṃ śiraḥ spṛṣṭvā ihaivaidhīti trirjapet ||23 || svāgataṃ te harekṛṣṇa sthiro bhava śivāya naḥ | yāvadvai medinī cāste tāvatstheya kṛpālunā ||24|| sarvatejo’nvitaṃ śaṃkhacakragadāsamanvitam | cakriṇaṃ sthāpayāmyatra devo bhūtvā pareśvaram ||25|| pauruṣaṃ sūktakaṃ nāma mantrān japed yathāyatham | yena rūpeṇa bhagavan vyāptaṃ sarvaṃ carācaram ||26|| tena viśiṣṭarūpeṇa arcāyāṃ nihito bhava | ityuktvā tatparivāradevatāḥ sthāpayet tataḥ ||27|| pūrvakuṇḍe hṛnmantreṇa śiromantreṇa dakṣiṇe | śikhāmantreṇa paśce tu varmamantreṇa cottare ||28|| netramantrairguroḥ kuṇḍe juhuyādekaviṃśatim | pūrvakuṇḍe’stramantreṇa hutvā cāyudhamantrakaiḥ ||29|| hutvā ca prārthayellokarakṣārthaṃ sarvadā vasa | mābhūt prajāvirāmo’smin yajamānaḥ samṛdhyatu || 2.159.3 0|| rāṣṭraṃ satāṃ samṛddhaṃ stāt aśnātu sukhamakṣayyam | iti prārthyāṃgadevāśca sthāpayettattadālaye ||3 1 || arghyaṃ pādyaṃ cācamanaṃ dadyādāsanakaṃ namaḥ | svāhā sampūjya ca pañcāmṛtena vāriṇā tataḥ ||32|| saṃsnāpya prajapet sūktaṃ pauruṣaṃ prārthayet tathā | pādau nābhiṃ śiro vakṣaḥ spṛśecca mokṣado bhava ||33|| jñānato’jñānato nyūnavidhiḥ pūrṇo’stu te prabho | prasādena harekṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇa ||34|| dadyād devanāma nīrājayed vādyaiḥ stutiṃ caret | naimattikāghanāśārthaṃ prāyaścittahavaṃ caret ||35|| śamīpalāśatilādyairaṣṭottaraśatātmakam | ācāryāya dakṣiṇāṃ ca dhanagoratnabhūgṛhān ||36|| punarhomaṃ prakuryācca niṣiddhāgamaśāntaye | oṃ sthairyāya sthiro bhava svāhā klṛpto bhavātra ca || 37|| aprameyo vibodhaśca nityaḥ sarvagato bhava | sarvaśāntyarthamevātra homaṃ cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam ||38|| oṃ prajāpataye svāhā idaṃ prajāpataye namama | oṃ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhedamagnaye sviṣṭakṛte namama ||39|| hutvā saṃsravaprāśanamācāmaṃ pātradānakam | pūrṇaṃ prajāpatidaivaṃ viprāya te dadāmi vai ||2.159.40|| brahmagranthivimokaṃ ca kuryāt sumitrimantrataḥ | oṃ sumitriyāna āpa oṣadhayaḥ santviti ||41|| pavitrābhyāṃ praṇītena jalena yajamānakam | śiraḥ saṃmṛjya cāgnau prakṣipya pavitrake tataḥ ||42|| durmitrīti gṛṇan nyubjīkuryāt praṇītikāṃ khalu | īśānyām bahirutthāpyājyenāghārya ca vai tataḥ ||43|| hastenaiva ca juhuyānmantraṃ gṛṇan punaḥ punaḥ | oṃ devāgātu vido gātuṃ vitvāgātumita ||44|| manasaspata imaṃ devayakṣaṃ svāhā vātedhāḥ svāhā | tato deśaṃ samayaṃ coccārya ṛtvija eva ca ||45|| svasvakuṇḍe prakuryuśca homaṃ pūrṇāhutiprakham | yajamānaḥ sapatnīko dakṣaskandhaṃ spṛśan guroḥ ||46|| tāmbūlaphalapūgīphalākṣataghṛtakāni ca | śrīphalaṃ ca sruve kṛtvā juhuyānmantrakaiḥ saha ||47|| oṃ samudrādūrmirmadhumām̐2udāradupāṃśunā samamṛtatvamānaṭ | ghṛtasya nāma guhyaṃ yadasti jihvā devānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ ||48|| vayannāma prabravāmā ghṛtasyāsmin yajñe dhārayā mā namobhiḥ | upa brahmā śṛṇavacchasyamānaṃ catuḥśṛṃgo vamīd gaura etat ||49|| tridhā hitaṃ paṇibhirguhyamānaṃ gavi devāso ghṛtamanvaviṃdan| indraḥ ekaḥ sūrya ekaṃ jajāna venādekaṃ svadhayā niṣṭatakṣuḥ ||2.159.50|| etā arṣanti hṛdyāt samudrācchatavajrāripuṇā nāvacakṣe | ghṛtasya dhārā abhi cākaśīmi hiraṇyayo vetaso madhya āsām ||51|| samyak sravanti sarito na dhenā antarhṛdā manasā pūyamānāḥ | ete arṣantyūrmayo ghṛtasya mṛgā iva kṣipaṇo rīṣamāṇāḥ ||52|| sindhoriva prādhvane śūghanāso vātapramiyaḥ patayanti yahvāḥ | ghṛtasya dhārā aruṣo na vājī kāṣṭhā bhindannūrmibhiḥ pinvamānāḥ ||53|| abhipravaṃtasamanevayoṣāḥ kalyāṇyaḥ smayamānā so agnim | ghṛtasya dhārāḥ samidho na saṃtatā juṣāṇo haryyati jātavedāḥ ||54|| kanyā iva vahatu me tavā aṃjyaṃjānā abhicākaśīmi | yatra somaḥ sūyate yatra yajño ghṛtasya dhārā abhitatpavante ||55|| abhyarṣata suṣṭutiṃ gavyamājimasmāsu bhadrā draviṇāni dhatta | imaṃ yajñaṃ nayata devatā no ghṛtasya dhārā madhumatpavante ||56|| oṃ citiṃ juhomi manasā ghṛtena yathā devā ihāgamanvīnahotrā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ | patye viśvasya bhūmano juhomi viśvakarmaṇe viśvāhādābhyaḥ haviḥ ||57|| sapta te agne samidhaḥ saptajihvāḥ saptaṛṣayaḥ saptadhāmapriyāṇi | saptahotrāḥ saptadhātvā yajanti saptayonīrāpṛṇasvāghṛtena svāhā ||58|| punastvādityā rudrā vasavaḥ samindhatāṃ punarbrahmāṇo vasunītha yajñaiḥ | ghṛtena tvaṃ tanvanvardhayasva satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ ||59|| vasoḥ pavitramasi śatadhāraṃ vasoḥ pavitramasi sahasradhāram | devastvā savitā punātu vasoḥ pavitreṇa śatadhāreṇa supvā kāmadhukṣaḥ ||2.159.60|| pūrṇā darvvi parāpata supūrṇā punarāpata | vasneva vvikrīṇāvahā iṣamūrjjaṃ śatakrato svāhā ||61 || idamagnaye vaiśvānarāya vasurudrādityebhyaḥ śatakratave adbhyaśca namama | idaṃ tridevebhya īśebhyo’vatārebhyaḥ śaktibhyaḥ parabrahmaṇe svāhā namama ||62|| iti pūrṇāhutiṃ kuryāt sruvasthaṃ ca samarpayet | tatastryāyuṣakaraṇaṃ nyāsena vidadhīta ca ||63 || tryāyuṣaṃ jamadagnestu lalāṭe oṃ namo namaḥ | kaśyapasya tryāyuṣaṃ ca grīvāyāṃ oṃ namo namaḥ ||64|| yaddeveṣu tryāyuṣaṃ ca bāhumūle namo namaḥ | tanno’stu tryāyuṣamiti hṛdi kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||65|| evaṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ hutveśāne baliṃ samarpayet | śāntighaṭodakaṃ cābhisiñcettu yajamānake ||66|| sakuṭumbe vedamantraiḥ kuśadūrvāmrapallavaiḥ | oṃ āpo hiṣṭhā mayo bhuvastā na ūrje dadhātana ||67|| mahe raṇāya cakṣase yajamānasya śāntaye | yo vaḥ śivatamo rasaḥ tasya bhājayateha naḥ ||68|| uśatīriva mātaraḥ yajamānasya ṛddhaye | tasmā araṃgamāma vo yasya kṣayāya jinvatha ||69|| āpo janayathā ca naḥ yajamānasya tṛptaye | ārogyāya rasaghanāya mahāyuṣyāya santu naḥ ||2.159.70|| bhagapraṇetarbhaga satyarādho bhagemāndhiyamudavādadannaḥ | bhagaprano janaya gobhiraśvairbhagapranubhirnṛvantaḥ syāmaḥ ||71 || idamāpaḥ pravahatāvadyañcamalaṃ ca yat | yaccābhidruhohānṛtaṃ yacca śepe abhīruṇam ||72||| āpo mā tasmādenasaḥ pavamānaśca muñcatu | oṃ punantu māṃ devajanāḥ punantu manasā dhiyaḥ ||73 || punantu viśvā bhūtāni jātavedaḥ punīhi mām | āpyāyasva sametu me viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam ||74|| bhavā vājasya saṅgathe yajamānāya vai bhava | maharddhaye prapautrādivṛddhaye’nugrahaṃ vaha ||75|| oṃ payaḥ pṛthivyāṃ paya oṣadhīṣu payo divyantarīkṣe payodhāḥ | payasvatīḥ pradiśaḥ santu mahyam pāyasanno gṛheṣvastvaraṇyam ||76|| oṃ devasya tvā savituḥ prasave’śvino rbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām | sarasvatyai vāco yaṃ turyyaṃ triyedadhāmi bṛhaspateṣṭvā sāmrājyenābhiṣiṃcāmi ||77|| oṃ devasya tvā savituḥ prasave’śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām | sarasvatyai vāco yaṃ turyyaṃtreṇāgne sāmrājyenābhiñcāmi ||78|| oṃ devasya tvā savituḥ prasave’śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām| aśvinorbhaiṣajyena tejase brahmavarcasāyābhiṣiñcāmi ||79|| sarasvatyai bhaiṣajyena vīryāyānnādyāyābhiṣiñcāmi | indrasyendriyeṇa balāya śriyai yaśase’bhiṣiñcāmi ||2.159.80|| pālāśaṃ bhavati tena brahmaṇo’bhyabhiṣiñcati | brahma vai pālāśo brahmaṇaivenametadabhiṣiñcati ||8 1 || sarveṣāṃ vā eṣa venāṃ raso yatsāma sarveṣāmevainametadvedānāṃ rasenābhiṣiñcati | yaṃ devakalpāñjuhoti prāṇā vai kalpā amṛtamupavai prāṇā amṛtenaivainametadabhiṣiñcati ||82|| dīrghāyutvāya balāya varcase suprajāstvā sahasā atho jīva śaradaḥ śatam | dyauḥ śāntirantarīkṣaṃ śāntiḥ pṛthivī śāntirāpaḥ śāntiroṣadhayaḥ śāntiḥ ||83|| vanaspatayaḥ śāntirviśvedevāḥ śāntirbrahma śāntiḥ | sarvaṃ śāntiḥ śāntireva śāntiḥ sā mā śāntiredhi parabrahma śāntiḥ pratimāḥ śāntirbrahmapriyāḥ śāntireva śāntiḥ ||84|| parabrahmākṣaraṃbrahma golokaḥ kṛṣṇarādhike | lakṣmīrnārāyaṇaścaiṣaśasṛṣṭirdevādayastathā ||85|| jīvasṛṣṭiḥ śaktayaśca devyaḥ satyaśca sādhavaḥ | ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu svastiṃ śāntiṃ dadatvapi ||86 || yajamānastata ācāryāya dadyāddhi dakṣiṇām | grāmaṃ gomaṇḍalaṃ bhūmiṃ gajāśvādikavāhanam ||87|| dāsān dāsīrvitānādi yānāmbaravibhūṣaṇam | svarṇarūpyādikaṃ dadāmi te yajñāntadakṣiṇāḥ ||88|| gopucche yavatulasītilakuśayugjalena vai | prārthayecca krato vipra śāśvatasvargado bhavān ||89 || adya me saphalaṃ dravyaṃ janmādyaṃ sampadādikam | yathāśakti pradattaṃ ca prasanno bhava puṇyada ||2.159.9 0|| jñānato’jñānato vāpi yadyannyūnaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā | tatsarvaṃ pūrṇamevāstu tvatprasādāt kṣamasva me ||9 1 || ācāryaśca vadedbhaktaṃ puruṣottamavāñcchayā | nyūnaṃ sampūrṇatāṃ yātaṃ sarvaṃ pūrṇaphalapradam ||92|| dravyahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ vidhihīnaṃ pramādajam | tatsarvaṃ pūrṇamevāstu prasādācchrīharestu te || 9 3|| oṃ svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ | svasti nastārkṣyo’riṣṭanemiḥ svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu || 94|| oṃ śrīḥ varcasvamāyuṣyamārogyamāvidhāt śobhamānaṃ mahīyate | dhānyaṃ dhanaṃ paśuṃ bahuputralābhaṃ śatasamvatsaraṃ dīrghamāyuḥ || 95|| punastvādityā rudrā vasavaḥ samindhatāṃ punarbrahmāṇo vasunītha yajñaiḥ | ghṛtena tvaṃ tanvaṃ vardhayasva satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ || 96|| mantrārthāḥ saphalāḥ santu pūrṇāḥ santu manorathāḥ | śatrūṇāṃ buddhināśo’stu mitrāṇāmudayastava ||97|| devān kṣamāpayeccāpi prasannāḥ santu sarvadā | agniṃ sampūjya ca visarjayetkṣamāvaco’rpitam ||98|| gacchadhvaṃ bhagavannagre svasthāne kuṇḍamadhyataḥ | hutamādāya devebhyaḥ śīghraṃ dehi prasīda me || 99|| gaccha gaccha suraśreṣṭha svasthāne parameśvara | yatra brahmādayo devāstatra yāhi hutāśana || 2.159.100 || yāntu devagaṇāḥ sarve pūjāmādāya māmakīm | iṣṭakāmasamṛddhyarthaṃ punarāgamanāya ca || 101 || akṣatān prakṣipetsarvasthāpaneṣu sumāñjalim | pratiṣṭhotsava evāyaṃ śraddhādravyādyapūrṇakaḥ || 1 02|| vipraviṣṇuprasādācca vidhiḥ pūrṇatamo’stu me | brāhmaṇāste sarvayajño vidhipūrṇo’stu sarvathā || 103 || acchidraśca vadeyuśca gṛhṇīyurbhūyasīṃ tataḥ | bhojanaṃ cāpi gṛhṇīyurvadeyuśca punastataḥ || 104|| yasya smṛtvā ca nāmoktyā tapaḥpūjākriyādiṣu | nyūnaṃ sampūrṇatāṃ yāti sadyo vande hariṃ prabhum || 1 05|| pramādātkurvatāṃ karma pracyavetādhvareṣu yat | śrīhareḥ smaraṇāttadvai sampūrṇaṃ syāttathāstu ca || 1 06|| caturbhiśca caturbhiśca dvābhyāṃ pañcabhireva ca | hūyate ca punardvābhyāṃ tasmai yajñātmane namaḥ || 1 07|| mahābhojyaṃ kārayitvā mahādānāni cārpya ca | mahotsavaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā yajamānastu bhojanam || 1 08|| kuryāt sarvān bhojayitvā upadāścārpayet tataḥ | avabhṛthaṃ prakuryācca sarityabdhau sarovare || 1 09|| sarve devāḥ samāyānti tīrthānyavabhṛthe tadā | sarvadurītanāśārthaṃ kāryaṃ yathā cāvabhṛthaṃ tataḥ || 2.159.110 || ityevaṃ rādhike proktaḥ pratiṣṭhāvidhireṣa te | ukto yathā bhagavatā daivāyatanakāya yaḥ || 111 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne devasya piṇḍikāyāṃ siṃhāsane sthāpanaṃ, prāṇapratiṣṭhānyāsāḥ, jīvāvāhanam, ārārtrikam, homaḥ, pūrṇāhutihavanam āśīrvādaśāntisvastivācaḥ devānāṃ vidāyaḥ, pūrṇatāvāco’vabhṛthaṃcetinirūpanāmā navapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 159 ||
<2.160> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca atha vai rādhike vacmi yaduktaṃ paramātmanā | svarṇakalaśārohasya dhvajasya vidhānakam || 1 || ācāryo maṇḍapasyaivottarabhāge viracya ca | svastikamaṇḍalaṃ ṛtvigyajamānādibhiryutaḥ || 2 || yatra kuṭyāṃ kalaśānāṃ kṛtaṃ ghaṭanaṃ śilpibhiḥ | tatra gatvā pañcaghaṭaiḥ saṃsnāpya kalaśottamam || 3 || manojūtiritimantraiḥ pratiṣṭhāpya baliṃ tathā | datvā tu lokapālebhya ācamyābhyukṣya tailakaiḥ || 4 || candanādibhirabhyarcya trisūtryāveṣṭya vai rathe | āropya śāntipāṭhādyaiḥ snānamaṇḍapamānayet || 5 || svastike bhadrasaṃjñe cāsane saṃsthāpya tatpuraḥ | puṇyāhaṃ vācayet ghṛtaṃ ghṛtetyabhyujya vai ghṛtaiḥ || 6 || udvartya yavamasūraharidrāpiṣṭakena ca | uṣṇodakena prakṣālyopalipya vālmīkīmṛdā || 7 || gandhodakena saṃsnāpya caturbhiśca ghaṭaistathā | śuddhodakena saṃsnāpyārcayitvā gandhapuṣpakaiḥ || 8 || vastrairācchādya ca śāntipāṭhamantrān samuccaret | svastimantreṇa cotthāya prādakṣiṇyena maṇḍapam || 9 || ānīya paścimadvāre praviśya devasannidhau | bhadrāsane viniveśyābhyarcya gandhādibhistataḥ || 2.160.10 || bhakṣyabhojyādyairāpūrya paṭhitvā viśvataḥ śrutim | saṃkalīkṛtya cācāryaḥ svakuṇḍe tu pṛthak pṛthak || 1 1|| madhukṣīrājyadadhibhiraṣṭottaraśataṃ havam | kṛtvā ca śāntikalaśe nikṣipya saṃsravaṃ tataḥ ||12|| tenodakena kramaśaḥ pādanābhihṛdakṣikam | spṛśet puruṣasūktaṃ ca vinyasya kalaśe tataḥ || 1 3|| sampūjya kalaśaṃ datvā baliṃ prāsādameva ca | āruhya gandhasalilaiḥ prakṣālyāṃgeṣu vai tataḥ || 14|| kṛtvā nyāsān tūryaghoṣaiḥ prāsādamastake ca tam | kalaśaṃ tu samānīya kṣaṇaṃ viśramya vai tataḥ || 15|| dvādaśākṣaramantreṇa sumuhūrte sthale’rpayet | oṃ ājighrakalaśaṃ mahyā ddevā viśantvindavaḥ || 16|| oṃ punarūrjānivartasvaśānaḥ sahasraṃ dhukṣvoru dhārāpayasvatīnapunarmā viśatādrayiḥ | itimantreṇa pratiṣṭhāpya vastreṇāveṣṭyā streṇa huṃphaṭ svāheti samuccārya namettataḥ || 17|| cakraṃ hiraṇmayaṃ padmaṃ śūlaṃ śastraṃ ca vinyaset | susthirīkṛtya vai śilpo saṃsnāpya vāriṇā tathā || 18|| gandhapuṣpaiḥ pūjayitvāvatīryādhaḥ praṇamya ca | vastrālaṃkāraraupyādidānaṃ dadyād yathābalam || 19|| bhojanādi kārayecca dīnānāthasatāṃ tathā | viprācāryakuṭumbānāṃ sādhvīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām || 2.160.20|| atha kalaśasānnidhye mānastaṃbho’tidārḍhyavān | tatra ca dhvajastaṃbho’pi pratiṣṭheyo vidhānataḥ ||21|| vṛkṣasāramayaścāśmasārajo lohajo’pi vā | śīṃśapāstāmrapatrāḍhyo mānastaṃbho mataḥ khalu ||22||| vartulaḥ śṛṃgavaddīrgho’dhiko vā ca yathocitaḥ | śilpamānena vai kāryo daṇḍaśca kalaśo dhvajaḥ || 23|| navatriṃśacchatādhyāye mānameṣāṃ nirūpitam | atra tu pūjanamātraṃ phaloddeśaśca sammataḥ ||24|| maṇḍapasya dhvajamantrā boddhavyāścātra pūjane | pūjanaṃ havanaṃ cāpi tatratyavidhinā matam ||25|| dhvajo vai parameśasya cihnaṃ tu sārvadaivatam | yad dṛṣṭvā duṣṭasattvānāṃ bhavecchāsanavartitā ||26|| satāṃ bhaved bhaktivṛttirāsurāṇāṃ bhayantathā | dhvajahīnaṃ mandiraṃ na kartavyaṃ tu kvacid bhuvi ||27|| tantuvarṣasahasrāṇi svarge dātā mahīyate | dhvajadhūnanaśastreṇa dātuḥ pāpaṃ vinaśyati ||28|| yatra grāme nagare ca rāṣṭre rājye dhvajo’sti ca | nākālamṛtyustatrāsti nālakṣmīḥ pāpakṛtsvapi ||29||| nopasargabhayaṃ tatra na rogā na hyupadravāḥ | viparītāni no tatra subhikṣaṃ sasyasampadaḥ ||2.160.3 0|| svakālavarṣī parjanyaḥ payasvinyaḥ payobhṛtaḥ | dhvajavandanakartāraḥ puṇyavanto bhavanti ca ||3 1|| dhvajasya darśanaṃ sarvamaṃgalaṃ kalaśasya ca | śikharasyāpi ca tathā maṃgalaṃ puṇyadāyakam ||32|| pāpināṃ pāpaśāntiśca dhvajādidarśanād bhavet | prāsādapratimāvedīkuṇḍadhvajaghaṭeṣu vai ||33 || yāvantaḥ santi aṇavastāvadvarṣasahasrakam | svarge ca śāśvate svarge mokṣe modanta eva ca ||34|| yajamānādayaḥ sarve devasyānugrahāditi | calamūrteḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca vacmi saṃkṣepato yathā |||35|| śucau deśe maṇḍapaṃ ca kṛtvā kuṇḍaṃ ca vedikām | pratiṣṭhādivase mūrtiṃ cānīya maṇḍape tataḥ ||36|| nidhāya cāsane prāṇānāyamyollikhya vai dinam | saṃkalpya ca pratiṣṭhārthaṃ gaṇeśaṃ pūjayettataḥ ||37|| puṇyāhavācanaṃ mātṛkārcanaṃ kārayettathā | nāndīśrāddhaṃ vidhāyātha guruṃ vṛtvā ca ṛtvijaḥ ||38 caturo vā pūjayecca maṇḍapasthāpanaṃ guruḥ | agnisthāpanakaṃ vāstupūjanaṃ grahayajñakam ||3|| sarvatobhadrake brahmādikānāvāhayettataḥ | pūjayet sthāpayed daivatya naivāraṃ caruṃ tadā ||2.160.40|| śrapayitvājyabhāgānte grahahomaṃ vidhāya ca | pālāśādisamidbhiśca pratyekaṃ śatamaṣṭakam ||41|| pratidaivatamevāpi lokapālādimantrakaiḥ | vyāhṛtibhirjuhuyādvā cājyahomaṃ tathā caret ||42|| sthāpitānāṃ tu devānāṃ samittilājyakāhutīḥ | daśa daśa tathā sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutvāṣṭakaṃ śatam ||43|| pradhānadevatāmantrairjuhuyācca namet prabhum | svāgataṃ sarvadeveśa kurmaste’treti vai vadet ||44|| uttiṣṭhetisumantraiścotthāpya vedyāṃ nidhāya ca | pañcagavyaiścāmṛtaiḥ paṃcabhiḥ saṃsnāpya mantrakaiḥ ||45|| ghṛtābhyaṃgodvartanādi kalaśaiḥ snapanādi ca | kṛtvābhiṣicya taṃ pīṭhe hyupāveśya samantataḥ ||46|| jalakuṃbhānavasthāpya kṣiptvā gandhasumākṣatān | prathame kuṃbhake saptamṛdo’nye pallavān śubhān ||47|| tṛtīye saptadhānyāni kuśāṃścātha caturthake | śāntyudakaṃ pañcaratnaṃ pañcame tu phalāni ca ||48|| pravaṇodakaṃ puṣpāṇi kṣipet ṣaṣṭhe yavān tathā | saptame tu kṣipet sampātodakaṃ cāṣṭame tu vai ||49|| sarvauṣadhīḥ sunikṣipya āpohiṣṭhetimantrakaiḥ | hiraṇyavarṇāmantraiśca pavamānena cāpi ca ||2.160.50|| saṃsnāpya vāsasī copavītaṃ datvā prapūjayet| | gandhapuṣpairdhūpadīpairnīrājya piṣṭadīpakaiḥ ||51 || svarṇapātre tu madhvājyaṃ dhṛtvā svarṇaśalākayā | mantrānuccāryātha netre likhed dakṣiṇasavyake ||52|| oṃ citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ | oṃ tejo’si śukramasyamṛtamasi dhāmanāmāsi priyaṃ devānāmanādhṛṣṭaṃ devayajanamasi ||53|| añjanti tvāmadhvaramitimantroga mūrtimañjayet | punarmadhughṛtenāpi śarkarayāpi cāñjayet ||54|| devasya tvā savituścamantreṇāñjanamañjayet | bhakṣyabhojyādarśakāṃśca darśayet na vilokayet |||55|| dakṣiṇāṃ ca pradāyaiva dvijādibhyaḥ stuvīta ca | vaṃśapātre pañcavarṇānvitānnaṃ nyasya vahninā ||56|| devaṃ nīrājayedannaṃ rudrāya tu catuṣpathe | dadyād oṃ namo rudrāya svāhā karmāstu vai śivam ||57|| bhūtebhyaśca namo’śvatthaparṇe samarpya vai balim | ācamya maṇḍaladevān prapūjya madhyamaṇḍale ||58|| pratiṣṭhito bhavetyuktvā devaṃ niveśya pūjayet | devānāṃ nāmabhiḥ kuṇḍe tilājyairjuhuyād daśa ||59|| puṣpāñjaliṃ pradāyaiva natvā maṇḍalakottarāt | svastike mañcake śayyāṃ kṛtvottiṣṭhetimantrakaiḥ ||2.160.60 || upaviśya tu śayyāyāṃ sahasrasūktamāgṛṇan | nyāsān kuryāt namo brahmarandhre tu puruṣātmane ||6 1|| prāṇātmane namo mukhe kaṇṭhe prakṛtirūpiṇe | buddhitattvāya hṛdaye’haṃkārāyodare namaḥ ||62||| manastattvāya guptādau cittāya pādayornamaḥ | rasatattvāya bastau ca gandhatattvāya vai nasi ||63|| śabdatattvāya vai karṇe sparśatattvāya varṣmaṇi | rūpatattvāya netre ca rasatattvāya rāsane ||64|| vāktattvāya namo vāci pāṇitattvāya hastayoḥ | pādatattvāya caraṇe pāyutattvāya pāyuke ||65|| upasthāya namaścopasthake pṛthvyai tu pādayoḥ | aptattvāya namo bastau tejastattvāya vai hṛdi ||66|| vāyutattvāya vai ghrāṇe vyomatattvāya cāmbare | guṇatattvāya vai mūrtau karaṇebhyo namonamaḥ ||67|| pauruṣeṇa ca sūktena kṛtvā nyāsām̐stato vadet | sukhaśāyī bhavetyeva śayyāyāṃ svāpayet prabhum ||68|| saṃpūjyādhivāsayecca devopahāramarpayet | brahmaṇe tatra sarvānnaṃ ghṛtānnaṃ vajriṇe jalam ||69|| ājyānnamagnaye māṣānnaṃ ca yamāya cārpayet | nirṛtaye kṛṣṇavrīhyannaṃ saghṛtaṃ samarpayet ||2.160.70|| varuṇāya navanītaudanaṃ vāyave yavaudanam | praiyaṃgavaṃ kuberāya īśānāya tu pāyasam ||71 || sarvebhyaḥ pāyasaṃ dadyāt naivāraṃ carumityapi | sthāpayitvā maṇḍalasya devatābhyo’rpayed balim |||72|| rātriṃ nayettataḥ prātaścotthāya mūlamantrakaiḥ | śrapayitvā caruṃ ghṛtenābhighāryoṣṭayukśatam ||73|| mūlamantreṇa vai hutvā devanāmabhirityapi | svāhāgnaye ca somāya dhanvantarisvarūpiṇe ||74|| kuhvai svāhānumatyai ca prajānāṃ pataye svāhā | parameṣṭhisvarūpāya brahmaṇe svāhāgnaye ||7| somāya agnaye svāhā svāhā annāya agnaye | agnaye’nnapataye svāhā prajāpataye ca svāhā ||76|| viśvadevatābhyaḥ svāhā sarvabhūtebhyaśca svāhā | bhūrbhuvaḥ svaścāgnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā namama ||77|| sūryodaye gururvedyāṃ devaṃ cābhimukhaṃ tadā| vidhāya ratnapuṣpādimūlaphalauṣadhīstathā ||78|| darśayitvā tāmrapātre śāntijalaṃ pragṛhya ca | pradhānadevamantreṇa daśavāraṃ pramantrayet ||79|| abhiṣicya devamūrdhni oṃ uttiṣṭhetyutthāpayet | viśvataścakṣurityādi japennamet punaḥ punaḥ ||2.160.80 || brahmaviṣṇumaheśebhyo dikpālebhyo namonamaḥ | vasubhyaśca namo rudrādityebhyaśca namonamaḥ ||81 || aśvibhyāṃ ca marudbhyaśca kuberāya namonamaḥ | mahānadībhyo’gnīṣomābhyāṃ dyāvāpṛthvībhyāṃ namaḥ ||82|| indrāgnibhyāṃ dhanvantaraye sarveśāya ca namaḥ | brahmaṇe viśvadevebhyo namaśca parabrahmaṇe ||82 || japtvaivaṃ yajamānaṃ cābhiṣicya devatāṃ smaret | pratiṣṭhitāya devāya dattvā puṣpāñjaliṃ tataḥ ||84|| puruṣasūktagāyatryā vyāhṛtibhiśca mantrakaiḥ | devaṃ tu pratimāyāṃ vai pratiṣṭhāpya tataḥ param ||851|| prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kuryācca tadyathā rādhike śṛṇu | asya prāṇapratiṣṭhākhyamantrasya ṛṣayastrayaḥ ||86|| devā vedāstrayaśchandāṃsa kriyātmavapustathā | prāṇākhyā devatā āṃ bījaṃ krauṃ śaktiniyojanam ||87|| prāṇapratiṣṭhāyāṃ tathāhi ṛṣibhyo mastake namaḥ | chandobhyaścānane devatāyai tu hṛdaye namaḥ ||88|| āṃ bījāya namo guhye krauṃ śaktyai pādayornamaḥ | oṃ kaṃkhaṃgaṃghaṃṅaṃ āṃ pañcabhyo bhūtebhya āṃ hṛde namaḥ ||89|| oṃ caṃchaṃjaṃjhaṃñaṃ īṃ tanmātrebhyo namo īṃ ca ke svāhā | oṃ ṭaṃṭhaṃḍaṃḍhaṃṇaṃ oṃ jñānakṛdbhyo namo oṃ śikhāyai vauṣaṭ ||2.160.90|| o taṃthaṃdaṃdhaṃnaṃ eṃ karmakṛdbhyo namo eṃ kavacāya hum | oṃ paṃphaṃbaṃbhaṃmaṃ auṃ karmabhyo namo auṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ ||9 1 || oṃ yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃśaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃlaṃkṣaṃ oṃ āntarebhyo namo aḥ astrāya phaṭ | evamātmani deve ca nyāsān kṛtvā spṛṣṭvā devaṃ tato japet ||92|| oṃ āṃ hrīṃ krauṃ yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃśaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃsaḥ devasya prāṇā iha prāṇāḥ | oṃ āṃ hrīṃ krauṃ yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃśaṃṣaṃhaṃsaḥ devasya jīva iha sthitaḥ ||93|| oṃ āṃ hrīṃ krauṃ yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃśaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃsaḥ devasya sarvendriyāṇi | oṃ āṃ hrīṃ krauṃ yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃśaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃsaḥ devasyāntaḥkaraṇāni prāṇā iha sthitāḥ ||94|| ihāgatya svastaye ca ciraṃ tiṣṭhatu vai svāhā | hṛdyaṃguṣṭhena vai spṛṣṭvā pratimāyā japed yathā || 96|| asyai prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhantu asyai prāṇāścarantu ca | asyai devatvamarcāyai māmaheti ca kaścana ||96|| sanniruddhya praṇavena dhyātvā sajīvameva ca | oṃ dhruvā dyauḥ ṛcaṃ japtvā gāyatrīṃ karṇake manum ||97|| pādanābhiśirāṃsyeva spṛṣṭvā pauruṣasūktakaiḥ | svāgataṃ parameśātra kurmaściraṃ sthiro bhava ||98|| yāvaccandrāvanisūryāstiṣṭhantyapratighātinaḥ | tāvat tvayātra deveśa stheyaṃ bhaktānukampayā ||99|| pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ | ārcya kaṃkaṇaṃ visṛjya mūrtau bhūṣāyudhāni ca || 2.160.10 0|| vāhanaṃ parivāraṃ ca dhyātvā mudrāṃ pradarśya ca | saṃpūjya mūlamantreṇa japitvāṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 10 1|| stutvā natvācamya sviṣṭakṛtpūrṇāhutikāntakam | karmasamāpya godānaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ sampradāya ca || 1 02|| ārārtrikotsavaṃ kṛtvā naivedyānte ca bhojanam | kārayitvā janān kṛtvā svayaṃ pariharet kriyām || 1 03|| evaṃ calapratiṣṭhāṃ vai kārayed calamādhave | ityevaṃ bhagavānāha devāyatanakāya vai || 1 04|| jīrṇaraṃgādinoddhāre vidhiḥ saṃkṣepato mataḥ | dakṣiṇasyāṃ tu veśānyāṃ paścimadvārakaṃ śubham || 1 05|| ekatoraṇakaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍapaṃ madhyake tataḥ | vartulāṃ vā caturasrau vedīṃ kṛtvā tu paścime || 1 06|| vāstu pīṭhaṃ cottare tu vālukāsthaṇḍilaṃ tathā | deśakālau prasaṃkīrtya jīrṇadoṣaviśuddhaye || 1 07|| uddhāranimittakarma karomīti vicintayet | gaṇeśasyārcanaṃ svastivācanaṃ mātṛkārcanam|| 1 08|| nāndīśrāddhaṃ guruṃ vṛtvārcayitvā tām̐stataḥ param | maṇḍapasya pratiṣṭhāṃ ca vāstupūjāṃ tathā tataḥ || 1 09|| sarvatobhadrake devān nyasya pīṭhe tadāsanam | sampūjyaihi devadeva vyāpakeśvara te namaḥ || 2.160.11 0|| hṛdayāya namaḥ svāhā śirase śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | kavacāya hum̐ astrāya phaṭ vyāpakaśārṅgiṇe || 111 || mūlamantreṇārcayecca japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | agniṃ saṃsthāpyājyabhāgāntakaṃ hutvārpayed balim || 1 12|| jīrṇaṃ devaṃ praṇavena sampūjya prārthayettataḥ | jīrṇa bhagna devadeva jīrṇatvak jīrṇamūrtika || 1 13|| jīrṇāṃgaṃ proddharāmyatra kṣamāṃ kuru kṛpāṃ kuru | yāyāstvaṃ sammataṃ sthānaṃ pārśvemūrtau ca vākṣare || 1 14|| jīrṇoddhārottaraṃ punaścāgamāya prayāhi vai |
