ārārtrikaṃ bhojanaṃ ca pūjanaṃ jalapānakam || 1 15|| sarvaṃ nītvā pravāhyanyatra sthale cānukampayā | sveṣṭasthānaṃ yāhi viṣṇo sarvadevānvito’thavā | | 1 16|| ityuktvā cārpayet vidhāyāñjaliṃ kusumākṣataiḥ | punaḥ prāṇapratiṣṭhādi kṛtvā saṃpūjayettataḥ || 1 17|| bhojayed brāhmaṇādīṃśca jīrṇasaṃskārakarmasu | bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnoti devālayābhivṛddhikṛt || 1 18|| ityevaṃ rādhike’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | devāyatanakāyāha mayoditaṃ ca te tathā || 1 19|| etasya śravaṇātpāṭhātprāsādanirmiteḥ phalam | uddhārasya kratoścāpi pratiṣṭhāyāḥ phalaṃ labhet || 2.160.1 20|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kalaśārohaṇaṃ mānastaṃbhadhvajāropaṇaṃ calamūrtipratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ jīrṇoddhāraścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 2.160 ||
<2.161> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike divyabhaktaḥ sa devāyatanako muniḥ | śrutvāścaryabhṛtaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pupūja ha || 1 || ārārtrikaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā premamagno’tisiddhimān | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā tadā svayam || 2 || divyaprāsādarūpo’bhūt sahasrakalaśānvitaḥ | sarvalakṣaṇasampannaḥ sarvāṃgaparipūritaḥ || 3 || sarvopasthāpanayuktaḥ sevāyāṃ mūrtimānapi | vyatirikeṇāpi cāste muktarūpadharo’pi san || 4 || prāsādaḥ so’bhavat khyāto devādyaiśca prapūjitaḥ | indro vilokya tattulyaṃ kārayituṃ mano’karot || 5 || viśvakarmāṇamāhūya darśayāmāsa tatkṛtim | ājñāṃ dadau tato’marāvatyāṃ kartuṃ sumandiram || 6 || viśvakarmā samabhyasya kuṃkumākṣarabhūsthale | tataḥ svargaṃ yayau śṛṃgaṃ sahasrakalaśaṃ vyadhāt || 7 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | patnīṣaṭkasahitaṃ sthāpayāmāsa mahotsavaiḥ || 8 || atha pravṛttāḥ prāsādāḥ sarvalokeṣu vai tataḥ | sarvatrādhyātmiko devāyano devo’sti teṣu vai || 9 || evaṃ divyaṃ mandiraṃ tu draṣṭumāyānti mānavāḥ | surāḥ pātālasaṃsthāśca satyalokanivāsinaḥ || 2.161.1 0|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ dṛṣṭvā mandiraśobhitam | pramodante narā nāryo viśrāmyanti bṛhatsukhe ||1 1|| darśanīyaṃ mandiraṃ tu śrutvā kapardisaṃghataḥ | āsamudrāt samāyānti janā draṣṭuṃ samutsukāḥ || 12||| dhanamedo dhīvaro’pi pratīcivārdhitīragaḥ | śrutvā kuṭumbasahito draṣṭuṃ gṛhād viniryayau || 13|| vastrāpathaṃ śubhaṃ dṛṣṭvā turīdevīṃ yayau pathi | vṛkṣacchāyāghaṭāmadhye sthitāṃ mūrtimayīṃ śubhām || 14|| jīvantikānadītīre prāsāde saṃsthitāṃ satīm | āmrāṇāṃ vanamadhyasthāṃ kāṣṭhahārādisevitām || 15|| āśrayadāṃ vanināṃ tāṃ śāntidāṃ vanavāsinīm | vilokya gajapṛṣṭhasthāṃ caturbhujāṃ haripriyām ||16|| lakṣmyaṃśarūpāṃ sattvāḍhyāṃ phalapuṣpādipūjitām | neme gatvāntike tasthau dhanamedo’tibhāvataḥ || 17|| sasnau nadyā hrade cāmravṛkṣasyādho bhuvastale | sāmagrīryātrikīḥ sarvā nidhāya ca tataḥ param || 18|| samādāya jalaṃ śītaṃ puṣpāṇi cāmpakāni ca | amṛtasya phalānyuttamāni pakvāni taulasīm || 1 9|| yayau lakṣmīṃ turīnāmnīmarcayituṃ hi mandire | kuṭumbena tu taddevyāḥ sannidhau praṇanāma saḥ ||2.161.20|| stutiṃ cakāra vidhinā vanyarakṣaṇakāriṇīm | pupūja parayā prītyā phalapuṣpajalādibhiḥ ||21|| aho mātaśca he mātarmahālakṣmi mahāsati | vane dattaṃ mayā nītaṃ gṛhaṇādyaṃ namostu te || 22|| prasannā bhava yātrārthaṃ prajvālaya ca kalmaṣam | dhīvarāṇāṃ pāvanī tvaṃ samuddhara haripriye ||23|| na jānāmyarcanaṃ jātyā nikṛṣṭo’śuddha eva yat | hṛdayaṃ te’rpitaṃ śuddhaṃ matvā gṛhāṇa cāmṛtam ||24|| buddhiṃ dehi tathā bhaktiṃ muktiṃ dehi madarhikām | parivārasahitasya mahyaṃ śreyaḥ pradehi ca ||25|| ityuktvā ca muhurnatvā mārjayāmāsa mandiram | śuṣkapatrāṇi niṣkāsya dhūlyādi cāpahṛtya ca ||26 || jalena kṣālayāmāsa mandiraṃ turikāṃ tathā | snapayāmāsa salilaiḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ cakāra saḥ ||27|| patrapuṣpāṇi cādāya nūtanāni bahūnyapi | toraṇaṃ mālikāṃ cāpi klṛptvā dadau samarhaṇe ||28|| rātrimuvāsa tatraivāśrayaṃ pravīkṣya śāntidam | phalādivanyabhojyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvovāsa dināntare ||29|| tṛtīye’pi dine tasthau viśrāntimāpa bhūyasīm | nityaṃ svagṛhavat sarvaṃ devīkāryaṃ supūjanam || 2.161.3 0|| saṃśodhanaṃ sevanādi karoti bhāvato vane | rātrau kurvanti bhajanaṃ kuṭumbino hi kaṇṭhataḥ ||3 1|| vahniṃ prakāśayitvaiva tāpaṃ śaityanivṛttaye | gṛhṇantyapi ca taddevyā āgāre militāśca te ||32|| ityevaṃ rādhike rātriṃ viniryāpya dināntare | puṣpāṇi vividhānyeva samādāyāmbarāṇi ca ||33|| puṣpāṇāmeva saṃsādhya lakṣmyai samarpayanti te | mukuṭaṃ karṇaphullāni cāvataṃsān sukañcukīm ||34|| śāṭīṃ ca ghargharīṃ mālāṃ gucchaṃ ca raśanāṃ tathā | pāduke jhullarīṃ ceti kṛtvā samarpayanti te ||35|| sugandhi madhu miṣṭaṃ cānīya vṛkṣasusaṃsthitam | samarpayanti devyai ca bhojanaṃ surasān bahūn ||36 || candanasya śubhaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ samāhṛtya vanāntarāt | dhūpaṃ kurvanti gandhāḍhyaṃ sevante smeti bhāvataḥ ||37|| bhajanaṃ śrīhare kṛṣṇa lakṣmi mātarnamo’stu te | evaṃ kurvanti satataṃ vanamadhye turīgṛhe || 38|| turyāvasthātmikā lakṣmīradṛśyāpi tadarhaṇām | samagrahīt prasannābhūt svabhāvasevayā satī ||39|| mūrtau sthitāpi jagrāhāmṛtaṃ madhu phalāni ca | papau tu salilaṃ śītaṃ dadhāra mālikāśca tāḥ ||2.161.40|| pauṣpāmbarāṇi jagṛhe dhūpaṃ jagrāha bhāvataḥ | vane sevāṃ bhaktakṛtāṃ sarvāṃ jagrāha mūrtigā ||41|| evaṃ kuṭumbasahito dhanamedo’pi dhīvaraḥ | yogakṣemau vane lebhe tīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ ||42|| nirmalāntaḥkaraṇaḥ sa pañcadaśadināni vai | uvāsa mandire tatra vane turyāntike mudā ||43|| nityapūjādisampattyā puṇyaṃ cāvāpa bhūri ca | pāvitryaṃ prāpa bahudhā lakṣmīdevīprasādataḥ ||44|| pauṣaśuklasya pūrṇāyāṃ rātrau candre śirogate | kīrtanaṃ pracakārāsau mṛdaṃgena kuṭumbibhiḥ ||45|| śītakāntisudhāvalye vanavṛkṣādiśobhite | nirmale rajanībhāge śānte rājasabhāvane ||46 || gītiṃ cakāra patnyā ca putrībhiḥ putrakaiḥ saha | pratyakṣaṃ madhuraṃ śrutvā sākṣāt turī babhūva ha ||47|| rūparūpānuśobhāḍhyāvayavāṃgātisundarī | prasannavadanā haste kamalaṃ bibhratī satī ||48|| maṇisvarṇavibhūṣāḍhyā divyāmbarādidhāriṇī | koṭiśāradapūrṇendukāntyatikāntibhāsurā ||49|| śvetagajasya pṛṣṭhe sā niṣaṇṇā ca manoharā | varadānaṃ gṛhāṇātra prasannāsmītyuvāca tam ||2.161.50|| bhakta tvayā vane me’tra mandire vasatiḥ kṛtā | sevā bahuprakāreṇa kṛtā naijagṛhādivat ||51 || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yatheṣṭaṃ vada cārpaye | ekavāraṃ gṛhasyāpi mārjanena mamātra ca ||52|| dāridryaṃ nāśamāyāti svargaṃ divyamavāpnuyāt | ekavāraṃ pradīpena mamālaye tu vai ciram ||53|| phalaṃ sūryasya lokāptiḥ sahasrayugajā bhavet | ekavāraṃ tulasyāścārpaṇena mama mastake ||54|| cakravartitvamevāsmai dadāmi sampadaściram | puṣpahārādyarpaṇena dadāmi svarṇabhūṣaṇam ||55|| ekavāraṃ phalānāmarpaṇena pradadāmi vai | śāśvataṃ cāmṛtaṃ svargamaindraṃ padaṃ samujjvalam ||56|| ekavāraṃ jaladānād dadāmi vāruṇaṃ padam | ātmārpaṇena sarvasvaṃ dadāmi dhāma śāśvatam ||57|| patirme bhagavān sākṣādanādiḥ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ | tatsmṛddhiṃ pradadāmyasmai madbhaktāya mahātmane ||58|| mayyarpitaṃ pragṛhṇāmi samarpya pataye tataḥ | tatprasādaṃ sadā cādmi tasya sevāparāyaṇā ||59|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | smṛddhaḥ prasanno bhagavān jāyate mama sevayā ||2.161.6 0|| ahaṃ priyā yathā tasya yathā ca māṇikī priyā | tathā priyo’pi me bhaktastasmai dadātyalaṃ patiḥ ||61|| dhanameda pavitro’si prasannāhaṃ yatastvayi | vṛṇu yatte mānase’sti dadāmi pativāñcchayā ||62|| ityukto dhanamedaḥ sa rādhike kṣaṇamāntare | āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpya sukhaṃ prāpya mudaṃ parām ||63|| dāsyaṃ kuṭumbayuktasya varayāmāsa mātari | na sampadaṃ na ca rājyaṃ naiśvaryaṃ samiyeṣa saḥ ||64|| dhanyo’si dhanameda tvaṃ dāsye sarvaṃ pravartate | dāsyaṃ tu durlabhaṃ loke niśchadmaṃ svāminaḥ kṛte ||65|| abhilaṣanti dāsyaṃ vai bhṛtyāḥ saṃsārakoṭiṣu | svārthadāsā hyasaṃkhyātā vartante bhuvanatraye ||66|| hārdadāsā durlabhā vai hārdadāso’tra me bhava | hārdadāsye vasantyeva siddhyaiśvaryāṇi sarvadā ||67|| chadmadāsye kleśabhūtā vartante raktahāriṇaḥ | tasmāt kartavyamevātra dāsyaṃ hṛdayaraṃjitam ||68|| yathā dāsī bhavāmyatra nārāyaṇasya padmajā | yathā dāsī bhavatyatra śivasya pārvatī satī ||69|| sūryadāsī prabhā cāste dāsī padmāvatī hareḥ | yathā ca māṇikī dāsī rādhā dāsī harerjayā ||2.161.70 || yathā ca maṃjulā haṃsā dāsī ca suguṇā hareḥ | lalitā cākṣarabrahma garuḍo dāsa ityapi ||71 || tathā dāsyaṃ kuru deve yathā ca hanumān kapiḥ | yathā hemantako dāso vasanto dāsa ityapi ||72|| kalpe kalpe bhavantyeva dāsā hyete harestathā | labha dāsyaṃ mayi me ca patyau śrīpuruṣottame ||73|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkaṃbharāsutaḥ | mānavena tu rūpeṇa vartate yatra gacchasi ||74|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre lomaśāśramasannidhau | devāyatanasaudhe śrīkāntastatra virājate ||75|| mādṛśyaḥ kamalāstatra rājante koṭiśo’pi ca | sarvavīryadharasyāsya sevayānandasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||76|| yāhi bhakta śubhaṃ kṣetraṃ kuṃkumavāpikābhidham | kāntaṃ sevaya sarvaṃ te dāsyaṃ phalarddhimadbhavet ||77|| gṛhāṇa vanapuṣpāṇi phalāni vividhāni ca | arpaya pataye tatra namaskārām̐śca me vada ||78|| ahaṃ paścimabhāge’tra kṣetrasīmni tadājñayā | turīrūpeṇa tiṣṭhāmi kṣetrapā kamalā svayam ||79|| adṛśyena svarūpeṇa kṛṣṇaṃ seve hi nityadā | yāhi śīghraṃ mānaseṣṭaṃ tava tatra bhaviṣyati ||2.161.80|| ityuktvā sā turīlakṣmīrmūrtau vilīnatāṃ gatā | dhanamedo harṣamatto māghamāse tu kṛṣṇake ||81 || pakṣe kuṃkumavāpyāṃ sakuṭumbaśca mudā yayau | vīkṣya vīkṣya mudaṃ prāpa hyudyānāni vanāni ca |||82||| lomaśasyāśramaṃ vīkṣya vīkṣyākāśagatālayam | brahmapriyāḥ samālokya vilokyāśvasarovaram ||83 || saudhāni bahulakṣāni vilokya devatālayān | vīkṣya tīrthāni divyāni dhanamedo jaharṣa ha ||84|| sthale sthale cakārāsau daṇḍavat sakuṭumbakaḥ | lakṣmīdarśitakāntaṃ ca draṣṭuṃ mahālayaṃ yayau ||85|| yatrānādiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo virājate prabhuḥ | koṭisūryābhamukuṭābhūṣaṇādipratejitaḥ ||86|| rūpānurūpāvayavo bhagavān kamalādibhiḥ | sevitaḥ śrīhariḥ sākṣād devamuktādisevitaḥ ||87|| neme ca daṇḍavat kṛṣṇaṃ dadau turīpradopadāḥ | pupūja ca svayaṃ puṣpaiḥ phalairbhāvairhṛdaṃgamaiḥ ||88|| pādodakaṃ papau mūrti hṛdaye sa dadhāra ca | prāpya prāsādikaṃ cāpi satkāraṃ svāgatādikam ||89|| bhojanaṃ cāpi saṃprāpya viśrāntiṃ sa cakāra ha | sāyaṃ tīrthāni kartuṃ ca yayāvaśvasarastaṭe ||2.161.90|| niśāyāṃ ca taṭe nyagrodhasya tale hyuvāsa saḥ | jātisvabhāvabhāvena tīre vāsamarocayat || 91 || rātrau sa bhajanaṃ cakre nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ | prātarjātisvabhāvena vīkṣya matsyām̐stu rohitān ||92|| cakracihnasuśobhāḍhyān dhartuṃ mano’karottadā | tīraṃ gatvā sūtraraśmiṃ mumocāpsu sakaṇḍakām ||93|| matsyarūpadharaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ | bhūtvānane ca baḍiśaṃ gṛhītvā tadvaśaṃ yayau ||94|| dhanamedena samprāpto matsyo viśālatāṃ yayau | śaṃkhacakragadādhārī babhūva padmavān kṣaṇāt ||95|| mahadrūpaṃ vilokyāsau lajjāṃ bhakto yayau tadā | hariḥ prāha svabhāvaṃ tvaṃ tyaja māṃ bhaja dhīvara ||96|| lakṣmyāstvāśīrvacanaiśca prāpto’haṃ te kṛpālavāt | dāsyaṃ gṛhāṇa me yāhi lomaśaṃ manumāvaha || 97|| vaiṣṇavo bhava tiṣṭhātra kuru me sevanaṃ tathā | yathā tvaṃ dṛṣṭavānatra matsyarūpaṃ caturbhujam ||98|| matsyatīrthamidaṃ me’sti matsyāvatārarūpavān | tvadarthaṃ te dṛṣṭipathaṃ samāgato’smi taṃ bhaja ||99|| dhīvarā matsyadāyādā matsyasnehā bhavanti vai | tavāhaṃ matsyarūpeṇa dāsye mokṣaṃ bhajasva mām || 2.161.10 0|| matsyamūrtiṃ vidhāyātra vaṭādhastād bhajasva mām | tīrthaṃ matsyāvatārasya mamaitatpāpanāśanam || 10 1|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīre svargamokṣapradaṃ śubham | dhīvarāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇa bhaviṣyati prabhuktidam || 1 02|| ityuktvā rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastiro’bhavat | dhanamedo yayau śīghraṃ lomaśasyāśramaṃ tataḥ || 1 03|| prāpto mantraṃ taulasīṃ ca srajaṃ vaiṣṇavadāsatām | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyāṇāya pataye svāhā || 1 04|| itiprāpya sarastīre samāyayau kuṭumbayuk | vaṭādhastāt parṇakuṭīṃ kṛtvovāsa nirantaram || 1 05|| matsyamūrtiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā bheje kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | svalpakālena vai rādhe muktiṃ cāpa tu śāśvatīm || 1 06|| divyapārṣadavaryaiśca nīyamānaḥ kuṭumbayuk | yayāvakṣaralokaṃ sa tīrthe mātsye’śvasārase || 1 07|| evaṃ ye tatra vai gatvā kariṣyantyāplavādikam | dhīvarā api tattulyā mokṣaṃ yāsyanti rādhike || 1 08|| māghāmāyāṃ mayā tatra matsyarūpaṃ prakāśitam | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya matsyatīrthaphalaṃ bhavet || 1 09|| bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhenmartyaḥ svargaṃ putraṃ dhanādikam | yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ sarvaṃ labhet kṛṣṇakṛpālavāt || 2.161.11 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne turīdevyā āśīrvādena dhanamedadhīvarasya yātrāloḥ kuṃkumavāpyāṃ matsyāvatāradarśanottaraṃ muktirmatsyatīrthaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmaikaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 161 ||
<2.162> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca māghapūrṇāṃtithau rādhe camatkāro’paro’bhavat | kathayāmi samāsena śṛṇu taṃ jñānadāyakam || 1 || pāñcāle paścime deśe viṣṭijātisamagraṇīḥ | āsīdbhaktaḥ śatoḍhuśca nāmnā paramavaiṣṇavaḥ || 2 || dāsavargo’sya vaśagaḥ śibikāvāhako’bhavat | rājñāṃ ca śreṣṭhināṃ yānavāhakatvaṃ caranti te ||3 || viṣṭayo dūradeśaṃ ca yātrālubhiḥ sahaiva tu | gacchanti viṣṭikarmāṇaḥ somakṣetraṃ tathāparam || 4 || gopakṣetraṃ camatkārapuraṃ siddhapuraṃ tathā | māthuraṃ kṣetramevāpi kṣetraṃ ca puṣpakaraṃ tathā || 5 || vārāṇasīṃ narmadāṃ ca godāvarīṃ ca gomatīm | svarṇarekhāṃ tathā cāśvapaṭṭatīrthaṃ prayānti ca || 6 || ekadā sa śatoḍhuśca kathāṃ śuśrāva vaiṣṇavīm | saṃhitāṃ putrahīnasya gatirnāstīti sarvathā || 7 || aputrasya śatoḍhośca hṛdaye sā kathā sthitā | putrārthaṃ prairayat so’pi maunamādāya nityaśaḥ || 8 || mālāṃ japtvā nadītīre śamīsthāṃ bhuvaneśvarīm | pupūjārādhayāmāsa rātrau rātrau tadaikalaḥ || 9 || svagrāmanikaṭe nityaṃ śamīvṛkṣatale sthitaḥ | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ śamīpatraṃ naivedyaṃ caṇakādikam || 2.162.1 0|| samarpyaivaṃ baliṃ mālāvṛttiṃ karoti vai śatam | bhuvaneśi bhuvaneśi bhuvaneśīti saṃjapan || 1 1|| ante dehi ca putraṃ me prārthya gṛhaṃ prayāti saḥ | evaṃ vai varṣaparyantaṃ pracakāra tapaḥ śubham || 1 2|| varṣāyāṃ śiśire tāpe śaityādhikye’pi sarvathā | vratabhaṃgaṃ na cāvāpa śraddhayā tīvrayā tathā || 13 || titikṣayā guṇenāpi vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ cakāra saḥ | varṣānte bhuvaneśī sā navarātrāntime dine || 14|| sākṣādbabhūva bhaktasya prasannāsmītyuvāca tam | bhakto’pi vīkṣya tejo’ntamūrtiṃ divyāṃ surūpiṇīm || 15 || tryakṣāṃ śūladharāṃ śvetāṃ prasannavadanāṃ satīm | siṃhasthāṃ varadānārthaṃ kṛtordhvahastakāṃ śubhām || 16 || praṇanāma jayaśabdaṃ jagāda ca nanarta ca | mātarmanorathaścādya phalito me supuṣpitaḥ || 17|| yā sākṣājjagatāṃ dhātrī mama dṛṣṭimupāgatā | svalpenaiva hi tapasā phalaṃ labdhaṃ mayā bahu || 18|| kiṃ karomi ca pūjādi cātmanārpitavāhanam | pādayoste patito’smi mānasaṃ nihitaṃ tvayi || 19 || yāsāṃ prajānāṃ jananī rakṣayitrī ca poṣikā | vartate sarvathā tāsāṃ duḥkhaṃ sarvaṃ vinaśyati || 2.162.20|| mama duḥkhaṃ gataṃ sarvaṃ viṣṭijātīyakasya vai | ityuktvā pradadau śreṣṭhaṃ baliṃ pūjāṃ tathopadāḥ ||2 1 || prasannā bhuvaneśī sā jagāda praṇataṃ janam | varaṃ vṛṇu drutaṃ bhakta kiṃ te manasi vartate || 22|| śīghraṃ dadāmi varadā nādeyaṃ vidyate tava | ityuktaḥ saḥ śatoḍhuśca devīprabhāvadharṣitaḥ || 23 || maunaṃ dhṛtvā karābhyāṃ ca ceṣṭayā bālakaṃ śubham | vavre kukṣau karau kṛtvā maunicihnena putrakam || 24|| devī tathāstviti prāha mūkaḥ putro bhaviṣyati | ityuktvā tu tirobhāvaṃ prāptā śatoḍhurityapi || 25|| śamīṃ praṇamya devīṃ ca kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ muhuḥ | kṣamāṃ prārthyāntimāṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā gṛhaṃ yayau tataḥ ||26|| patnyai prāha kathāṃ sarvāṃ mūkaputrābhidāyinīm | sāpi śrutvā putramodaṃ mūkāmodaṃ jagāma ha ||27|| atha varṣāntare jāto bālo devīpratāpataḥ | vavṛdhe candrasadṛśo mūko vāṇīvivarjitaḥ ||28|| saṃskṛto bahudhā ceṣṭāvijñānaiḥ pratibodhitaḥ | janayāmāsa harṣaṃ sa pitrorvaṃśasutantukaḥ ||29|| vāṇīśūnyatvamevātra śokasthalaṃ hi vartate | pitā viṣṭisvarūpeṇaikadā śreṣṭhipravāhaṇaḥ ||2.162.3 0|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthayātrārthaṃ gatavām̐stadā | kathāṃ śuśrāva ca rātrau lomaśasyāśrame śubhām ||3 1|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ sarvārthasādhikām | cakṣurdadāti deveśaścāndhāya suprasāditaḥ ||32|| karṇau dadāti bhagavān badhirāya prarādhitaḥ | paṅguṃ pādau samarpyaiva dadhāti sukhinaṃ hariḥ ||33|| vṛkṇaṃ karau pradāyaiva karoti sukhinaṃ śritam | kuṣṭhinaṃ kuṣṭharahitaṃ karotyeva janārdanaḥ ||34|| daridraṃ sampadā yuktaṃ karotyeva śriyāḥ patiḥ | sarvakāmān hariḥ so’yaṃ svāmikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||35|| pūrayatyeva bhaktasya gopālakambharāsutaḥ | tīrthe vāsaḥ sadā kṛtvā yaścainaṃ pūjayeddharim ||36 || tasya sarvaṃ bhavet siddhaṃ prayatno niṣphalo nahi | ityevaṃ sa śatoḍhuśca śrutvā kathāṃ sarastaṭe ||37|| suṣvāpa ca tadā rātrau nidrāyāṃ bālakṛṣṇakaḥ | bhagavān divyarūpaḥ sa śatoḍhoḥ sannidhau tadā ||38|| āgatyāha ca te bhakta cintā dūre bhaviṣyati | voḍhurnāmnā tava putraścātrāgatya ca tapsyati ||39|| tasya vāṇī svayaṃ cātra sāṃkurā saṃbhaviṣyati | yāhi gṛhaṃ tataḥ putraṃ nītvā cāśvasarovaram ||2.162.40|| samāyāhi tataste’tra mānasaṃ phalavad yataḥ | ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastiro’bhavat ||41|| prabuddhaśca śatoḍhustanmahāścaryaṃ hyacintayat | satyaṃ kṣetraphalaṃ jātaṃ tīrthāgamanamātrataḥ ||42|| yathā dṛṣṭaṃ mayā svapne tathā karomi vai śubham | ityevaṃ ca vinirṇīya kṛtvā tīrthaṃ tu sārthakaiḥ ||43 || śreṣṭhinaḥ śibikāsthām̐śca prāpayya tadgṛhāṇi ca | gṛhaṃ gatvā nijāṃ bhāryāṃ prāha sarvaṃ yathāyatham ||44|| putrasya śāradāsiddhyai cāśvapaṭṭasarovare | vāso yogyo mato me śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāgrahāt ||45|| ityuktvā sammatiṃ prāpya patnyāḥ putraṃ nināya saḥ | śatoḍhuśca saha patnyā tvaśvapaṭṭasarovaram ||46|| voḍhustatra mahāmūko janmamūko niśāmukhe | suptaḥ svapnaṃ dadarśātha tapasā vākprakāśatām ||47|| ceṣṭayā pitarau prātarvijñāya svāpnavaibhavam | voḍhuḥ svayaṃ cakāraiva tapastāpasinaḥ kramāt ||48|| prathamaṃ sa yayau tatra lomaśasya mahāśramam | mantraṃ jagrāha vidhinā pañcagavyasya cādanam ||49|| cakāra dehaśuddhiṃ ca dadhāra taulasīṃ srajam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||2.162.50 || samprāptaṃ taṃ manuṃ śaśvajjapan śrīkṛṣṇavallabham | draṣṭuṃ devālayaṃ gatvā natvā śrīpuruṣottamam ||51 || pītvā pādodakaṃ tasya sarastaṭamupāyayau | praṇamya caraṇau pitroścāmalakīdrumāśraye ||52|| bhūtale sa niṣadyaiva kuśāsane tu mālayā | japaṃ kurvan hariṃ dhyāyan śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||53|| vṛttīḥ sarvāścāntare ca kṛtvā tapasi saṃsthitaḥ | vāgarthaṃ sa tapastepe cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ||54|| mūrtiṃ vidhāya vai svalpāṃ bālakṛṣṇasya saikatīm | sarvopacārakaistasyāḥ pūjāṃ cakre trikālikīm ||55|| mālājapaṃ cakārāpi vāṇīṃ dehīti mānasam | tulasīvanato nitya samāhṛtya dalāyutam ||56|| arpayati sma nityaṃ vai bālakṛṣṇāya pūjane | svayaṃ tulasīpatrāṇi bhuṃkte māsaṃ nināya saḥ ||57|| māse dvitīyake vanyaphalāhāro babhūva saḥ | tṛtīye māsi bhājānāṃ patrādaḥ sa babhūva ca ||58|| caturthe kandamūlānāmāhāreṇa sa vartate | pañcame jalamātreṇa ṣaṣṭhe vāyuprajīvanaḥ ||59|| saptame phenapaścāpi babhūva jalaśāyanaḥ | jale kṛtvā vicāraṃ sa naśyāmi vā vadāmi vā ||2.162.60|| arpayāmi haraye’tra cātmānaṃ mokṣaṇāya tu | ityevaṃ sa vinirdhārya jalavāso’bhavattataḥ ||61|| nāmaraṭaṇamātraṃ vai jānātyeva na cetarat | mānasaṃ raṭaṇaṃ sarvaṃ prāṇāntaṃ ca tapaḥ param ||62|| viditvā bālakṛṣṇo’yaṃ tutoṣa bālakāya saḥ | voḍhuścāyaṃ śāradārthaṃ tapastapati dāruṇam ||63 || madarthaṃ tyaktasarvasvo maraṇāya kṛtādaraḥ | toṣaṇīyo mayā bhakto vāṇīdānena vai bhuvi ||64|| śaraṇāgatarakṣo’haṃ bhaktatrātā bhavāmi ca | kṛpayā sādhya evāhaṃ kṛpayā toṣayāmi tam ||65|| iti vicārya bhagavān bhaktānugrahasaṃbhṛtaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kapilarūpadhṛk ||66|| sādhuveṣaḥ piṅgajaṭaḥ skandhe dhṛtopavītakaḥ | kare kamaṇḍaluṃ bibhran kukṣau cādhārapāvaṭīm ||67|| mṛgacarma dadhan mālāṃ sphāṭikīṃ jolikāṃ dadhan | yuvā tejaḥpravāhaiśca saṃśobhadvigrahaḥ śubhaḥ ||68|| bhasmacchannaśarīraśca kaupīnāmbarabhūṣitaḥ | surūpaḥ śāntamūrtiśca hṛdaye svarṇarekhakaḥ ||69|| matsyaśūladhanuḥsvastidhvajacihnitahastakaḥ | vāmasakthni śubhralakṣmīcandracihnavirājitaḥ ||2.162.70||| sādhuveṣo’pi bhagavān divyasiddhivirājitaḥ | akasmād vyomamārgeṇa tejomaṇḍalamadhyataḥ ||71|| avātatāra salile bhaktāgre susthiro’bhavat | anādhāro jalādhāro bhagavān voḍhumeva tam ||72|| dakṣahastena connītvā sarastaṭe nidhāya ca | netre pramṛjya coddhāṭya darśanaṃ pradadau nijam ||73|| prāha kasmājjale tvaṃ vai vartase’tra kimicchasi | vada dāsye samagraṃ te tapasāsmi pratoṣitaḥ ||74|| ananyasya bhavāmyeva cātmasamarpako’pyaham | ananyo me bhavāñjātastavānanyo bhavāmyaham ||75|| vada śīghraṃ varaṃ yācasvātra dadāmi cepsitam | ityuktvā virarāmāsau bhagavān karuṇānidhiḥ ||76 || voḍhuḥ svāsthyaṃ samāpanno bhānayuk śrīhariṃ tadā | sādhuveṣaṃ varadaṃ ca ramyarūpaṃ vilokya vai ||77|| atiharṣātimagnaścotthāya papāta pādayoḥ | hareścaraṇatalayoścāvalehaṃ cakāra saḥ ||78|| hṛdaye bhagavatpādau nyadhāt kṣaṇaṃ sukhaṃ yayau | mastake karakamale nyadhāt cakāra daṇḍavat ||79|| netrāśrūṇi mumocāpi snehodbharātivihvalaḥ | romāñcatāṃ tadā prāpto’ceṣṭayat parameśvaram ||2.162.80| | mānasenaiva bhāvena jihvāṃ pradarśya ceṣṭayā | nāsti vāṇī kṛpāsindho vāṇīṃ dehi kṛpāṃ kuru ||8 1 || iti sarvaṃ ceṣṭayaiva jñāpayāmāsa mādhavam | piṅgalaṃ kapilaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ darśayāmāsa jihvikām ||82|| bhagavānapi dīnasyoddhārakartā kareṇa tām | prahasan darśitāṃ jihvāṃ pasparśāṅgulibhirmudā ||83 || samākṛṣya manāk tatra kamaṇḍalorjalaṃ dadau | śvetavarṇaṃ sarvavidyāśritaṃ līnaṃ ca tatra tat ||84|| babhūva yatra salile sākṣāt sarasvatī hyabhūt | brahmajñānaṃ hyabhūdyatra sāṃkhyavijñānamityapi ||85|| vedānāṃ sarvavijñānaṃ tattvadṛṣṭirabhūttathā | evaṃ jalamiṣeṇaiva tattvapradarśitāṃ dadau ||86|| tāvadvāṇī devavāṇī gīrvāṇavāk susaṃskṛtā | prādurabhūt tadā voḍhujihvāyāṃ kṛpayā hareḥ ||87|| stutiṃ cakāra vividhāṃ voḍhurvedamayīṃ hareḥ | bṛhadbrahmaṇyayanavān divyaviprāsanaśca yaḥ ||88|| īśanībhirjuṣṭapadaḥ śrīśo’vatvakhilāspadaḥ | prāvirbhāvāṃśadivyātmāsaṃkhyadharmābhirarcitaḥ ||89|| īśakoṭiratho juṣṭo bhagī me bharaṇaṃ kuru | vedahṛd vāṅpravistāraḥ śāradādhipatiḥ pumān ||2.162.90|| sarasvatīpatiḥ pātāraṇaṃ me kuru piṃgalaḥ | indrendro’gocaro vācāṃ dehabhedātmadarśakaḥ ||91|| prākṛtāṃśapṛthagrūpaḥ kapilo māṃ sadāvatu | yaḥ kraturjātavedāśca siddharṣibrahmapādapaḥ ||92|| satīrthyaścātmanāṃ stambaḥ sāmbaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prarakṣatu | pṛthubhūtāni sūkṣmāṇi raśmayaśca pravāhaṇam ||93|| sphurtayaścāpūrakāṇi yacchrayāṇi sa māvatu | yajjīvaṃ cāṃkurāt sarvaṃ yadātmakaṃ viśiṣyate ||94|| yatpratnaṃ sakriyaṃ caitajjāyate budhnakaṃ punaḥ | tasmai devāya divyāya vidhema haviṣā hṛdā ||95|| rādhayeyaṃ ca taṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tu kaṃbhṛtam | kāmbhareyaṃ kāpilākhyaṃ guruṃ śamastu tatpade ||96|| iti stutvā rādhike sa papāta kṛṣṇapādayoḥ | kapilākhyaharistatra śīghramantaradhīyata ||97|| voḍhurvijñānamāpanno divyarṣiścābhavattataḥ | sāṃkhyayogāditattvānāṃ vyākhyātā paṇḍitaḥ śubhiḥ ||98|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kapilarūpiṇam | yatra tīrthe dadarśāsau kapilaṃ tīrthameva tat ||99|| aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva jātaṃ vidyāpradaṃ śubham | tatra voḍhurdadau lokebhyo vijñānaṃ tu tāttvikam || 2.162.10 0|| voḍhvāśrame harermūrti kāpilīṃ sundarāṃginīm | sarastīre pratiṣṭhāpya voḍhuḥ pupūja nityaśaḥ || 10 1|| mandiraṃ ramaṇīyaṃ vai kāpileyaṃ tato’bhavat | māghapūrṇādine voḍhurjñānaṃ vāṇīṃ ca darśanam || 1 02|| avāpa śrīharestatra ciraṃ vāsaṃ cakāra saḥ | tato mokṣaṃ gato voḍhuḥ rādhike yugaparyaye || 1 03|| tatra snātvā kathāṃ śrutvā brahmajñānamavāpnuyāt | aihikīṃ tu parāṃ siddhiṃ cāpnuyānnahi saṃśayaḥ || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śibikāvāhaśatoḍhutapasyayā labdhasya mūkaputrasya voḍhoścāśvapaṭṭasarasi tapasā kapilarūpeṇa śrīharerdarśanaṃ sāṃkhyajñānavāṇīsiddhiprāptiścetinirūpaṇanāmā dvāṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 162 ||
<2.163> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ hareḥ śubham | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya pravadāmi te || 1 || kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre pāvane kāmyake pure | karṣuko bhagavadbhakto dyuviśrāmābhidho’bhavat || 2 || dharmaṃ karma na jānāti naiva jānāti pūjanam | naiva jānāti śāstroktaṃ vidhānaṃ daivakarma ca || 3 || gavāṃ saṃrakṣaṇaṃ caiva govṛṣāṇāṃ prapālanam | jānātyeva paraṃ karma kṛṣiṃ jānāti cottamām || 4 || snānaṃ gopādarajasā sandhyā gokavalārpaṇam | gāyatrī gonāmajapaḥ pūjanaṃ goprarakṣaṇam || 5 || vaiśvadevo nijabhuktiḥ svādhyāyaḥ kṛṣireva tu | homo roṭakanirmāṇaṃ tarpaṇaṃ sasyapoṣaṇam || 6 || evaṃ tasya karmakāṇḍaḥ kṛṣikārye pravartate | nānyat kiñcit sa jānāti tathāpi śuddhamānasaḥ || 7 || na cauryaṃ nānṛtavṛttirna droho jantuhiṃsanam | na pratāraṇakāryaṃ ca vidyate’sya hṛdi kvacit || 8 || akalmaṣo vṛddhasevī gosevāpuṇyabhāg vratī | kṣetre vāṭyāṃ samāgacchedatithiścet sa pūjyate || 9 || dīyate’tithaye cekṣudaṇḍaḥ śākadalādikam | phalaṃ mūlaṃ dalaṃ kandaḥ vāso’pi pūlakagṛhe || 2.163.1 0|| sādhurvā bhagavadbhaktaḥ kaścidāyāttu vāṭikām | sastrīputraḥ sevate taṃ pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ || 11 || rātrau kṣetre drumādho bhūtale vahnikhale śubhe | vahniṃ prajvālya viśrāntiṃ tatprakāśe pravindati || 12|| mānasyai tu pratimāyai samarpayati bhojanam | jalaṃ phalaṃ mūlakandaṃ kaṇān dalādikaṃ ca yat || 1 3|| rātrau nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ smṛtvā nidrāṃ pragacchati | prātarutthāya śārīraṃ kṛtvā śuddhimayaṃ tataḥ || 14|| gṛhītvā bhojanaṃ kṣetre kṛṣikārye pravartate | evaṃ vai vartamānasya niṣpāpasya gṛhe kvacit| || 15|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthaṃ kartuṃ vai bhaktamaṇḍalam | samāyātaṃ niśāraṃbhe jñātvāśrayapadaṃ tu tam || 16|| so’pyāśrayaṃ dadau kāṇḍaśālāyāṃ bhāvabhaktimān | bhaktebhyaḥ sa dadau vāri dugdhaṃ ca roṭakādikam || 17|| tārṇāsanāni pradadau viśrāntiṃ cāpureva te | niśāyāṃ bhajanaṃ cakruḥ kīrtanaṃ cakrurutsukāḥ || 18|| kīrtane’nādikṛṣṇaśrīpatinārāyaṇo hariḥ | kīrtitaḥ kaṃbharāputraḥ prabhurgopālanandanaḥ || 19|| svarūpādvaitarūpaḥ sa yo’kṣare dhāmni vai pare | vartate divyarūpaḥ śrīpatiḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ||2.163.20|| sarvāvatāradhartā ca sarvāntaryāmī mādhavaḥ | jaḍacetanajātātmā bālakṛṣṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ ||21 || īśvarāṇāmīśvaro yo devānāmapi daivatam | prāṇināṃ prāṇarūpo yo bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||22|| indriyāṇāṃ tu yaścendro vastūnāṃ vāstavaṃ balam | karmaṇāṃ phalado yaśca bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||23|| viprāṇāṃ pāvano dharmaḥ kṣatriyāṇāmadhṛṣyatā | vaiśyānāṃ sasyasampattirbālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||24|| vṛkṣāṇāṃ rasasampattirvallīnāṃ phalapuṣpitā | dāsānāṃ sevikāvṛttirbālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||25|| varṇināṃ brahmacaryaṃ yad gṛhasthānāṃ saputratā | yatīnāṃ ca satāṃ brahma bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||26|| rājñāṃ nītiḥ prajānāṃ ca dāsyaṃ paropakāritā | anugrahaśca devānāṃ vālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||27||| grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ vahneśca vidyutāmapi | maṇīnāṃ cakṣuṣā tejo bālakṛṣṇa sa eva saḥ ||28|| yā tṛptirdehināṃ bhojye bhogye tṛptiśca yā matā | yā śāntiḥ prāpyalābhe’sti bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||29|| viśvāse phalavattā yā dāne śraddhā ca yā matā | kathāyāṃ cāntaro bodho bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||2.163.3 0|| yajñe yaddhavanaṃ proktaṃ vipreṣu sattvabhāvanā | yajamāne dadadvṛttirbālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||3 1|| garbhatanturyasya haste daurhṛdatvaṃ ca yatkṛtam | nālapuṣṭervidhātā ca bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ || 32|| cidākāśājaḍākāśaṃ kṛtavān yo nirañjanaḥ | racayāmāsa cāṇḍāni bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||33|| kulālān brahmasaṃjñām̐śca karṣukān viṣṇusaṃjñitān | lunakān rudrakām̐ścakre bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva yaḥ || 34|| dugdhayantrātmakapaśūn rasayantrātmapādapān | jñānayantranarām̐ścakre bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva yaḥ || 35|| ārtavaṃ ca jagaccakraṃ cālayanniyamena yaḥ | viśvakarmatvamāpanno bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||36|| ekasmād bhūstarāt khādyaṃ bhakṣayitvāpi pādapāḥ | bījabhedād bhinnabhāvāḥ bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa bījakaḥ || 37|| bhojyaṃ caikavidhaṃ nyastaṃ jaṭhare bhinnarūpi yat | bhinnaguṇaṃ yena dehe bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa jāṭharaḥ ||38|| adṛśyād dṛśyabhāvāstu sajātīyāt sajātikāḥ | bhavantyeva yadāveśād bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ || 39|| mantrādhīnāstathā devā vāgadhīnārthaśemuṣī | ātmādhīnaṃ jaḍaṃ yena bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||2.163.40 || iṣṭādhīnaścecchukaśca karmādhīnaṃ tathā jagat | yadadhīnā parāmuktirbālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||41|| atithīn sevate yaśca tasmai sevāphalapradaḥ | bījavacchatadhā dātā bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ |||42|| sarvasaukhyapradātā yaḥ sarvarakṣākaraśca yaḥ | sarvamānasapūraśca bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||43||| rātrirviśrāntidā yena dinaṃ pravṛttidaṃ kṛtam | nidrā śramaharā klṛptā bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||44|| sādhurūpaṃ dhṛtaṃ yena vairājaṃ ca tathā dhṛtam | paramāṇuḥ kṛto yena bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||45|| mārdavaṃ divyavastrādau kāṭhinyaṃ copalādiṣu | dehe dvayaṃ kṛtaṃ yena bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||46|| mahākālaḥ kṛto yena mahāmāyā yamāśritā | puruṣo yojito yena bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||47|| pralayaśca kṛto yena sargo yena kṛto muhuḥ | nirlepastatra yaścāste bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||48|| kāmaṃ krodhaṃ mahālobhaṃ mohaṃ madṃ ca matsaram | ākurvannapi cāsakto bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||49|| sadṛśeṣvapi bījeṣu vibhinnaśaktidhāyakaḥ | bhinnapākapradātā yo bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||2.163.50 || kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo viṣṇurvāsudevo’kṣarādhipaḥ | antarātmeśvaro yaśca bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ || 51|| bhagavān paramātmā ca hariḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | rādhālakṣmīpatiryaśca bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||52|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre sahasrakalaśālaye | brahmapriyāsaṃkhyasevyo bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||53|| bhajanīyaḥ pūjanīyaścintanīyaśca yo hṛdi | sevayā prāpaṇīyaśca bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ||54|| evaṃ vai kīrtanaṃ cakruḥ sarve bhaktā niśotsave | dyuviśrāmaḥ karṣukaśca śrutvānandaṃ lalābha ha ||55|| jijñāsāṃ kṛtavān mantragrahaṇe’tithimaṇḍalāt | atithistatra vipraśca ṣaḍguṇākhya uvāca tam ||56|| gṛhāṇa mantraṃ devasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mat | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||57|| itimantraṃ dadau tasmai karṣukāya tu ṣaḍguṇaḥ | sukaṇṭhīṃ taulasīṃ cāpi dadau nāma narāyaṇam ||58|| mālikāṃ pradadau tasmai japārthaṃ pratimāṃ tathā | dadau darśanakāryārthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ca ||59|| mālāyāṃ japanārthaṃ ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca | dadau nāma tadā sarve prātastasmātpratasthire ||2.163.60|| āyayuḥ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ śrīlomaśāśramam | aśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi sahasraghaṭamandiram ||61|| udyānaṃ sarvatīrthāni vyadhustato narāyaṇam | bālakṛṣṇaṃ yayuḥ sarve rājamānaṃ gṛhāntare ||62|| sampūjya vidhivattīrthaṃ kṛtvā deśaṃ nijaṃ yayuḥ | dyuviśrāmaḥ kṛṣīvalaḥ sakuṭumbo mudānvitaḥ ||63|| vicārya tīrthayātrārthaṃ niryayau kāmyakātpurāt | gobhirgovṛṣabhaiḥ sākaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ||64|| āyayau śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gṛṇan samutsukaḥ | cārayan vai vane gāśca vṛṣabhān sāyamāpa tat ||65|| sarastīre pūrvadakṣe viśrāntiṃ niśi cākarot | pāyayitvā jalaṃ gāśca vṛṣabhān pādapāśraye ||66 || vyasarjayanniṣeduste paśavaḥ sukhato’ntike | rātrau nidrāvaśaṃ yātāḥ paśavo mānavāśca te ||67|| pariśramaṃ cādhvajaṃ te vyapānudan sunidrayā | aviśaṃkāstīrthabhūmau svapanti sarasastaṭe || 68|| ardharātrau vyatītāyāṃ śānte mānavasañcare | grāmaśabde praśānte ca nidrāptapaśupakṣiṣu ||69 || siṃhānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ cāyāt saptānāṃ vyāghrajaṃgalāt | akasmād govṛṣān tadvai jagrāhātibhayaṃkaram ||2.163.70|| gāvaśca vṛṣabhāścāpyākrośām̐ścakruḥ praraṃbhaṇān | ākrandanāni viśrutya janā bubudhire drutam ||7 1 || bhagavantaṃ sasmaruśca rakṣārthaṃ parameśvaram | bhakto’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sasmāra vai hṛdā ||72|| āyāhi bhagavan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa parātpara | sarvajīvādhivāsa tvaṃ rakṣa trāhi ca pāhi ca ||73|| godhanaṃ me durbalasya balaṃ kṛṣīvalasya yat | siṃhairvināśyate cette dāso duḥkhī bhaviṣyati ||74|| śīghraṃ kuru mahārāja yāvannaivābhidharṣitam | dharṣaṇe naiva jīveyurgāvo vā vṛṣabhāstava ||75|| tvaccharaṇe’rpitāśceme paśavo me na santi vai | tvameva rakṣa bhagavan dugdhaṃ piba yathocitam ||76|| gā dāsye te mahārāja śīghraṃ pāhi ca rakṣaya | ityuccārya mahākāṣṭhaṃ vahnidagdhaṃ savahnikam ||77|| samuttolya sthito bhaktaḥ siṃhānāṃ sannidhau haṭhāt | siṃhāstu garjanāścakrurmuhurnādairbhayaṃkaraiḥ ||78|| saraḥkṣetraṃ samastaṃ tannāditaṃ garjanāmayam | tresuśca dehinaḥ sarve vinidrā garjanādibhiḥ ||79|| vidudruvuritastato bahiranto bhayārditāḥ | sāgnikaṃ tanmahākāṣṭhaṃ dṛṣṭvā siṃhā bhayānvitāḥ ||2.163.80 || nopājagmuḥ sannidhau vai kintu gāvo bhayānvitāḥ | saraḥsetuṃ parityajya dudruvurdūrameva yat ||81|| tatpṛṣṭhe dudruvuḥ siṃhā dadhrurdūraṃ gatāśca tāḥ | ruroda bhaktavaryaśca paśavo jñānavarjitāḥ ||82|| siṃhavajraparābhūtāḥ kiṃ karomyatra so’rudat | bhaktarakṣākarastāvad bālakṛṣṇaḥ kṛpānidhiḥ |||83 || gopālabālako devaścakradhāryabhavat kṣaṇāt| | harṣanādaṃ nadan kṛṣṇo mumoca cakramulbaṇam ||84|| vegādgataṃ bhramaccakraṃ jaghānasiṃhamaṇḍalam | yatra yatra paśūnāṃ tu nakhasparśo’bhavattadā ||85|| vidāraṇaṃ tvacāṃ cābhūt siṃhakṛtaṃ ca bhañjanam | tatra tatra paśudehe pasparśa svakareṇa saḥ ||86 || dayālurbhagavān śīghraṃ rujaṃ nyavārayat kṣaṇāt | sandhānaṃ ca tvacāṃ sparśamātreṇa pūrvavaddhariḥ ||87|| pracakāra yathā sparśo nakhānāṃ naiva vidyate | navā raktasya saṃsrāvastatra tatrābhavaddhyapi ||88|| śrīhareḥ karasaṃsparśād raktasrāvo’pi nābhavat | yathā devaśarīraṃ vai nīrujaṃ tādṛśāni vai ||89|| gavāṃ ca vṛṣabhāṇāṃ ca śarīrāṇi kṛtāni vai | godhanaṃ rakṣitaṃ caivaṃ tato vaṃśīṃ vyanādayat ||2.163.90|| bhaktasya sannidhau gatvā bhaktaṃ ca samabhāvayat | godhanaṃ sahasā śrutvā vaṃśīṃ bālaharestadā ||91 || tūrṇaṃ cāyāt sarastīre dyuviśrāmasya sannidhau | bhagavān cakradhāryeva niṣasādāsane’rpite ||92|| govṛṣāśca samāgatya lilihurharipatkajam | dugdhadhārāḥ pramuñcantyo gāvaścakrurhi raṃbhaṇam ||93 || bhakto dugdhāni tatkālaṃ dohayitvā hariṃ prabhum | pāyayāmāsa ruciraṃ miṣṭaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ payo muhuḥ ||94|| praśaṃsan bhagavān dugdhaṃ papau bhaktasamarpitam | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ hastacatuṣṭayam ||95|| darśayāmāsa rūpaṃ svaṃ haryavatārarūpiṇam | siṃhebhyaśca dadau muktiṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ prāhiṇoddhi tān ||96|| dyuviśrāmaṃ ca tatpatnīṃ putrān putrīḥ kuṭumbakam | divyaṃ rūpaṃ darśayitvā haristūrṇaṃ tiro’bhavat ||97|| phālgune kṛṣṇapakṣasyaikādaśyāṃ rātrimadhyake | siṃhebhyastu gavāṃ rakṣāṃ cakāra bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||98|| dvādaśyāṃ ca dadau bhakto dānāni vividhānyapi | pūjayāmāsa bhāvaiśca śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ||99|| dyuviśrāmo dadau bālakṛṣṇāya godhanaṃ tadā | hariḥ pratyarpayāmāsa bhakto’pi mumude hyati || 2.163.100|| haryājñayā ca gāḥ prāpya yayau svaṃ kāmyakaṃ puram | tattīrthaṃ haritīrthākhyaṃ gotīrthaṃ khyātamapyabhūt || 101 || evaṃ tatra kṛṣīvalaiḥ kāritaṃ harimandiram | hariṃ ca sthāpayāmāsuścaturbhujaṃ pareśvaram || 1 02|| bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca gāstatra sthāpayāmāsurutsukāḥ | śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya bhuktirmuktistathā bhavet || 1 03|| godānaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ koṇe’gnāvāśvasārase | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prasannatāṃ vrajet || 1 04|| rādhike yamadūtebhyo rakṣāṃ kuryāddhi tīrthinaḥ | godāturvṛṣadātuśca bālakṛṣṇo dayānidhiḥ || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne dyuviśrāmākhyakṛṣikārasya siṃhapradharṣitagodhanasyāvanaṃ harirūpeṇa bhagavatā kṛtaṃ haritīrthaṃ gotīrthaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā triṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 163 ||
<2.164> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ harestataḥ | bakasrāvākhyanagare vyāghrāraṇyābhisaṃsthite || 1 || bahuvṛkṣasamākīrṇe yatisādhunivāsite | cāturvarṇyajanavyāpte vṛkaśāvīnadītaṭe || 2 || nīlakarṇākhyacātvālo vasati sma kuṭumbayuk| jyeṣṭhe’raṇye cātivṛṣṭyā nadīpūre tu pattanam || 3 || magnaṃ samantato jātaṃ mānavāḥ paśavastathā | mṛtāścānnāni naṣṭāni bhakṣyaṃ kvāpi na labhyate ||4 || saptāhavṛṣṭyā bhūbhāgaḥ samudra iva dṛśyate | mārgā ruddhā gamanasya grāmāntaraṃ na gamyate || 5 || cātvālaḥ sakuṭumbo’sau druśākhāsvavalambate | baddhvā kāṣṭhāni vallyā ca śākhādolāsu jīvati || 6 || kuṭumbaṃ cāpi śākhāsu preṃkhāsu cābhijīvati | kṣudhitaṃ tadabhūccāpi mṛtinaikaṭyamāsa ca || 7 || vṛkāyano maharṣiśca samādhisthitimāsthitaḥ | uhyamānaśca kallolairāyād vṛkṣasya sannidhau || 8 || cātvālena tadā dīrgharajjvā cāvṛtya śākhayā | niruddhastatra vṛkṣādho vṛkṣastambanirodhitaḥ || 9 || cātvālena śanairvṛkṣādavatīrya vṛkāyanaḥ | jaṭayā saṃgṛhītaśca śākhāyāmadhiropitaḥ || 2.164.10 || atidurbaladeho’yaṃ samādhau magna eva tu | viveda naiva vṛṣṭyādi vahanaṃ drumarodhanam || 11 || cātvālena muhuḥ spṛṣṭaḥ kampito mastake ca saḥ | bahudhvānairbodhitaśca jāgratiṃ cāpa vai ṛṣiḥ || 12|| tadā sa jñātavān sarvaṃ cātivṛṣṭimayaṃ jalam | śīghraṃ sa bhajanaṃ cakre kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho || 13 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīkṛṣṇavallabha | gopālanandana lakṣmīpate śrīkaṃbharātmaja || 14|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrakṛtaprākaṭya keśava | brahmapriyāpate ramāmāṇikīpadmajāpate || 15|| satāṃ pate bibho dhāmākṣarādhipa pareśvara | rakṣa rakṣa janān kṛṣṇa cātivṛṣṭyātiduḥkhitān || 16|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ cakre prārthanāṃ ca vṛkāyanaḥ || 17|| tāvattasyātibhāvena bālakṛṣṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ | śvetagajasamārūḍho vyomamārgeṇa cāyayau || 18|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakaraḥ mukuṭamastakaḥ | vaijayantīkaṇṭhakaśca sudarśanāṅgulīyakaḥ || 19|| mandahāsānanaḥ premavarṣāmuñcatsunetrakaḥ | bhojyasaṃbhṛtapeṭāyuk aurṇavastrādimañjuṣaḥ ||2.164.20|| chatracāmarasaṃśobhatpārṣadadvayasevitaḥ | ākāśamārgataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samāgatya drumāntare ||2 1|| śākhāyāṃ ca svayaṃ bālo niṣadya peṭikādvayāt | bhakṣyaṃ pradattavān tasmai vṛkāyanāya tatkṣaṇam ||22|| nīlakarṇakuṭumbāya nīlakarṇāya vai dadau | bhakṣyaṃ pūrṇaṃ ca vastrāṇi dadau śrībhagavān svayam ||23|| nīlakarṇo hariṃ dṛṣṭvā tatkuṭumbaṃ nirāśrayam | dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ sākṣāt sādhuyogena vai tadā ||24|| babhūva kṛtakṛtyo vai bubhuje ca prasādajam | annaṃ dadhāra vastrāṇi śaityaṃ dūraṃ gataṃ tadā ||25|| praṇanāma muhuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram | vṛkāyano maharṣiśca stotraṃ cakāra vai hareḥ ||26|| pūjanaṃ pracakārāsau śālavṛkṣadalaistadā | vṛṣṭijalairmanobhāvaiḥ pupūja parameśvaram ||27|| yena rakṣā kṛtārambhe brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ | tena tvayātra me rakṣā kṛtā tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ ||28|| yena rakṣā kṛtā pūrvaṃ satyavratasya sāgare | tena tvayātra me rakṣā kṛtā tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ ||29|| yenābdhimanthane rakṣā bahūnāṃ vai kṛtā purā | yena devā rakṣitāśca daityāstu vinipātitāḥ ||2.164.30|| yena dugdhā medinī ca rakṣitāḥ prāṇinaḥ purā | yena sāgaratalagā rakṣitā vai kṣitiḥ purā ||3 1 || yenāṅguṣṭhajalenaitad brahmāṇḍaṃ pāvanaṃ kṛtam | tena tvayātra me rakṣā vihitā te namo’stu ca || 32|| yena dhruvaśca prahlādo rakṣitau bālakau purā | yena sāṇāsuraścātra ghātitaḥ paramātmanā ||33|| talājā rakṣitā yena mokṣitā śaraṇāgatā | daityo damanako yena mokṣitaḥ paramātmanā ||34|| kaṃkatālā mokṣitāśca nārakā mokṣitāstathā | sālamālo nāśitaśca yena tenāvito’smi ca ||35|| bālāḥ prabhokṣitā yena rājyamātā pramokṣitā | vallīdīno nāśitaśca varāṭako vināśitaḥ ||36|| vanaspatyādayo yena rakṣobhāvād vimocitāḥ | devāyanasamuddhāraścāṇḍālayonitaḥ kṛtaḥ ||37|| kaṃthādharaḥ kṛto yena ciraṃjīvo’pi vai tataḥ | raṇaṃgamena putreṇa tārito yena śārṅgiṇā || 38|| mām̐jāṃmbikā rakṣitā ca mlecchā vināśitāstathā | raktabījo nāśitaśca yena tenāvito’smyaham ||39|| jalamagno nṛpatiśca rakṣito hyudayābhidhaḥ | vasumedho rakṣitaśca jale yena namo’stu te ||2.164.40|| jyāmaghastārito yena caurebhyaḥ sudhano’vitaḥ | tryaṣṭakārurmokṣitaśca yena tubhyaṃ namo’stu me ||41 || hiraṇyakeśaśiṣyāśca sajīvā yena vai kṛtāḥ | vṛhadvarcāstāritaśca baleśvaro’pi mokṣitaḥ ||42|| jayadhvajo mokṣitaśca yena tubhyaṃ namo’stu me | ailavilā tāritā cādharmajīvo vināśitaḥ ||43|| mahāmārī nāśitā ca mṛtā yena tu jīvitāḥ | uṣṇālayaprajā vārimṛtā yena prajīvitāḥ ||44|| cakravākyai jalaṃ yena giriśṛṃge samarpitam | mārjārībālakā yena vahnibhrāṣṭryāṃ prarakṣitāḥ ||45|| kiṃpuruṣapradeśāśca prāgjyotirbhūpradeśakāḥ | yajñādyaiḥ pāvitā yena tasmai tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ ||46|| samīraṇo’vito yena pavamāno’pi rakṣitaḥ | santāraṇo’vito yena tasmai tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ ||47|| devāyatanako yena rakṣitaḥ paramātmanā | pretoddhāraḥ kṛto yena rāśiyāneṣu śārṅgiṇā ||48|| śūrajāro mokṣitaśca piśācyo mokṣitāstathā | dhanamedo mokṣitaśca yena tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ ||49|| voḍhurvijñānavān yena kṛto gā rakṣitāstathā | bālakṛṣṇāya te lakṣavāraṃ me’stu namonamaḥ ||2.164.50|| mama yogena bhagavan cātvālo’yaṃ samuddhṛtaḥ | tasmai dayāludevāya koṭivāraṃ namonamaḥ ||5 1 || nivārayātivṛṣṭiṃ ca meghān pravāraya prabho | samāveśaya pūrāpo rakṣa magnān hi dehinaḥ ||52|| ityuktvā sarjapatrāṇi nyakṣipanmastake hareḥ | hariṃ śaṃkhaṃ tadā dadhmau meghāḥ śīghraṃ tu ghoṣataḥ |||53|| vyadīryanta jalānāṃ ca varṣaṇaṃ vilayaṃ gatam | jalāni jalapūrāśca vyalīyanta ninādataḥ ||54|| prāṇinaḥ sukhino jātā vṛkāyanaprasaṃgataḥ | vṛkāyano maharṣiśca yayau kṛtasmaraṃ girim ||55|| bālakṛṣṇastirobhūya yayāvaśvasarovaram | nīlakarṇaḥ sacātvālastaddinātparameśvaram ||56|| ārādhayāmāsa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ ca taṃ harim | tasyaiva bhajanaṃ cakre pratyakṣasya hareḥ sadā ||57|| vṛkṣavāsī phalāhārī mālājāpī virāgavān | jñānī śrībālakṛṣṇe svahṛdayāpīṃ subhaktimān ||58|| bhajate sma hariṃ nityaṃ karatālādibhirgṛṇan | bālakṛṣṇaharekṛṣṇanārāyaṇāva māṃ vibho ||59|| bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa jayakṛṣṇa harehare | harekṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇavallabha śrīhare jaya ||2.164.60|| evaṃ sa bhajanaṃ cakre saha palyā sutādibhiḥ | yathālabdhānnasantoṣī svalpavastrāditṛptimān ||61 || bhajate śrībhagavantaṃ kāṃbhareyaṃ mahāprabhum | svajñātīnāṃ tu bhaktānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtavān hi saḥ ||62|| nityaṃ rātrau militvaiva maṇḍalasthā bhajanti ca | kīrtayanti harikṛṣṇaṃ stuvanti praṇamanti ca ||63|| pūjayanti tulasyādyairbhojayanti phalādikam | ārārtrikaṃ ca kurvanti prasādaṃ bhakṣayanti ca ||64|| tato yānti gṛhaṃ naijaṃ svapanti harimānasāḥ | utthāya ca hariṃ dhyātvā tato vyāpārayanti ca ||65|| evaṃ vai vartamānāste cātvālā bhaktivedinaḥ | nirṇayaṃ tvekadā cakruryātrārthaṃ kuṃkumasthalīm ||66|| lomaśasyāśramaṃ draṣṭuṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ vilokitum | aśvapaṭṭasaro draṣṭuṃ kartuṃ tīrthāni tatra ca ||67|| pātheyāni gṛhītvā te sakuṭumbāḥ śatādhikāḥ | mānavā vai narā nāryo bālavṛddhānvitā yayuḥ ||68|| mārge gāyanti vādyāḍhyāṃ gītiṃ nārāyaṇasya te | śanaiḥ śanaiḥ samāyānti kuṃkumavāpikāṃ tataḥ ||69|| kecinnamanti vṛkṣām̐śca keciddhūlīṃ vahanti ca | kecinnārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā viluṭhanti bhuvastale ||2.164.70|| keciccāpi prakurvanti sāṣṭāṃgaṃ daṇḍavat tadā | anye nṛtyanti bhāvena vādyamaṇḍalikāyutāḥ ||71|| pare gāyanti ca guṇān hareḥ kṛṣṇasya bhāvukāḥ | apare pratigāyanti guṇān punaśca tānapi ||72|| smṛtvā śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ te pibantyadanti vai pathi | satāṃ sevāṃ prakurvanti mārge pragacchatāṃ tadā ||73 || evaṃ sarve samāyātā bhaktāḥ śrīkṛṣṇamānasāḥ | lomaśasyāśramaṃ vādyakīrtanagarjanādibhiḥ ||74|| tān draṣṭumṛṣayaḥ sarve tathā brahmapriyādayaḥ | yayurbahirmārgatīre tadā bhaktā vilokya tān ||75|| cakruśca daṇḍavat sarve rajo nyadhuśca mastake | ṛṣīṇāṃ ca priyāṇāṃ ca prakṣālya caraṇān jalaiḥ ||76|| papuḥ prasādasalilaṃ nyadhurdehe ca mastake | lomaśaṃ vīkṣya vidhitaḥ pūjayitvā haripriyāḥ ||77|| prajvālya nijapāpāni gṛhītvā lomaśānmanum | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||78|| japantastaulasīrmālā dadhānā nijavakṣasi | raṭanto bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca parabrahma sanātanam ||79|| sahasrakalaśaṃ divyaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca harimandiram | nemustatkalaśān divyān dhvajaṃ cāmroparisthitam ||2.164.80 || aśvapaṭṭasarastīre yayuḥ snātuṃ drutaṃ purā | snātvā pītvā tīrthajalaṃ viśramya cāmradrutale ||81 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśanāya tu | yayuste sopadāḥ sarve pradivyamandirāntaram ||82 || bhagavān śrīhariḥ śīghraṃ nijaśiṣyaṃ suyoginam | svayaṃprakāśaṃ cāhūya dadau svacaraṇāmṛtam ||83 || tebhyo dadau ca te sarve pītavantaḥ kṣaṇāttataḥ | prasādaṃ pradadau kṛṣṇo bhuktavantaśca te tataḥ ||84|| dṛṣṭimātreṇa hariṇā vīkṣitāḥ sarva eva te | tāvaddivyasvarūpāste bhūtadehavivarjitāḥ ||85 || sūryadehasamā jātā devā vai divyavigrahāḥ | kuṇṭhabhāvavihīnāśca vyomamārgābhigāminaḥ ||86 || bhittyāvaraṇahīnāśca nirāvaraṇadṛṣṭayaḥ | divyajñānabhṛtāḥ sarve śvetavarṇāḥ sumūrtayaḥ ||87|| rūpānurūpāvayavā yathā muktā ihāgatāḥ | akṣarabrahmalokasya vaikuṇṭhasyāthavāgatāḥ ||88|| yadvā golokadhāmnaśca śvetadhāmnaśca vāgatāḥ | tādṛśāḥ śvetavarṇāśca candrabimbābhakāntayaḥ ||89 || hareḥ prasādamāpannā divyatāṃ bhaktito yayuḥ | cāṭvālatvaṃ vilīnaṃ ca jaḍatā vigatā tathā || 2.164.90 || apāvitryaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ ca mānuṣatvaṃ layaṃ gatam | devatvaṃ ca samudbhūtaṃ śāstrajñatvaṃ samarjitam || 91 || divyadṛṣṭijuṣo jātā nīlakarṇādayo’khilāḥ | atha śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ te pupūjuḥ paramādarāt |||92|| tāvattatra vimānaṃ vai divyaṃ vyomnaḥ samāgatam | muktyarthaṃ haribhaktānāṃ tadā te cakrurarthanām ||93 || tavājñāṃ ca vahāmo’tra saiva muktirhi vo matā | neṣyate’tra vimānaṃ vā neṣyate pāralaukikam || 94|| rakṣātraiva mahārāja kurmo dāsyaṃ tavātra ha | ityevaṃ yācamānebhyo hariścājñāṃ dadau tadā ||95|| yūyaṃ bhaktā divyayāne sthitvā yāntūttarāṃ diśam | ketumālaṃ mahādeśaṃ mālyavatastu paścimam ||96|| mālyo’yamuralākhyo’sti ketumālasya pūrvagaḥ | taddeśeṣu prajābhyo me mantradānaṃ dadatvapi ||97|| ityuktāḥ śrīhariṃ natvā vimānaṃ cādhyarohayan | tāvat kṛṣṇena tu smṛto vṛkāyanarṣisattamaḥ ||98|| vyomamārgeṇa cāyātastasmai śrīharireva saḥ | ājñāṃ dadau ketumālaṃ gantuṃ bhaktipravṛttaye ||99|| so’pi vimānamāruhya śatādhikairmaharṣibhiḥ | śrāvaṇe devarūpaiśca saha jagāma cāmbare || 2.164.10 0|| ketumālaṃ prati śīghraṃ vimānaṃ prairayaddhi saḥ | kacchaṃ sindhumindukuśaṃ kaśyapābdhiṃ vilokya tat || 101 || kukeśāsanamullaṃghya ketumālaṃ yayau drutam | yatra śaityena śubhrāṃgāḥ prajā vasanti kaśyapāḥ || 10 2|| kāśyapyaḥ sarvajanatā dharmakarmasu vai samāḥ | nīparāyāḥ saritaśca tīre vimānakaṃ nijam || 1 03|| nīlakarṇo bhaktarājo vṛkāyanājñayā tadā | kṣaṇaṃ viśrāntimāptuṃ vai cāmbarādavatārayat || 1 04|| rādhike nīlakarṇādyāścāśvapaṭṭasarovare | yatra snātāśca tat tīrthaṃ nīlakarṇābhidhaṃ hyabhūt || 1 05|| divyatāpādakaṃ taddhi snānamātreṇa dehinām | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi divyatā labhyate janaiḥ || 106 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne nīlakarṇacāṭvālakuṭumbasyātivṛṣṭau vṛkāyanarṣidvārā bhagavatā kṛtaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ, kuṃkumavāpīmāgatya nīlakarṇasya śataparijanasya divyatā, ketumālakhaṇḍaṃ prati tasya bhagavatā kṛtaṃ preṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuṣṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 164 ||
<2.165> śrīrādhikovāca priya prāṇapate kṛṣṇa kānta sarvamanohara | nīlakarṇo vṛkarṣiśca tathānye bhaktapuṃgavāḥ || 1 || kiṃ cakruḥ ketumālākhye nīparāyāstaṭe tataḥ | tadajñāte pradeśe tatsarvaṃ me vaktumarhasi || 2 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasambandhavatkathām | śrutvā tṛptiṃ na cāpnomi priyaprāṇamukhāt punaḥ || 3 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca nīparāyāstaṭe rādhe bahuvṛkṣasamākule | bahupakṣisamāvāse śītavāyumanohare || 4 || vimānātte kṣitau sarve cāvaterurjalāntikam | gatvā sasnustataḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvānādihareśca te || 5 || naivedyaṃ phalamūlādeḥ pakvānnasya tathārpya ca | pātheyādi prabhuktvaiva pītvā vāri prasādajam || 6 || ghaṭikāmātramāśramya cakruste nāmakīrtanam | harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa parabrahma harehare || 7|| maheśāna pareśāna sarveśāna harehare | evaṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ vādyaiḥ saha cakruḥ pramodinaḥ || 8 || tataḥ khaṇḍaṃ vīkṣituṃ te vimānamadhyarohayan | vyomamārgeṇa dakṣeṇa krameṇa gatimācaran || 9 || yavakrītapradeśām̐ste lokayāmāsurambarāt | nistārāṃ ca nadīṃ pṛthānadīṃ romāyanakṣitim || 2.165.1 0|| kṛpāsthalādriṃ dinapāṃ nadīṃ vīkṣya ca sevikām | yugaśāvapradeśām̐śca valgurāyapradeśakān || 11 || vīkṣya girīśadeśām̐śca iṣṭalavapradeśakān | āpyāyanādriṃ ca tathālpādriṃ vīkṣya tataḥ param || 1 2|| sveṣṭajarapradeśām̐śca pherunasapradeśakān | rāhūnāṃ ca nadīṃ dṛṣṭvā vīkṣya parījaparvatam || 1 3|| indirāṃ ca nadīṃ dṛṣṭvā gavādakavitāṃnadīm | nadīṃ gavādayānāṃ ca pūrtagaṇḍapradeśakān || 14|| trigrāsāṃ ca nadīṃ dūrāṃ nadīṃ mitrāṃ nadīṃ tathā | supānadeśān saṃvīkṣya gurūnāṃ saritaṃ tataḥ || 15 || phalāśanapradeśām̐śca lavavārāṃ nadīṃ tathā | senānadīṃ vilokyātha sthāyinīṃ vīkṣya cāpagām | | 16 || vallījīvanadeśām̐śca jarāmaunadradeśakān | ālpāpāṃ ca nadīṃ vīkṣya audarīṃ saritaṃ tathā || 17|| pālanādapradeśām̐śca nadīṃ viṣatulāṃ tathā | prapīṭhāṃ ca niyamānāṃ nadīṃ vīkṣya tataḥ param || 18|| lātavāyapradeśām̐śca vīkṣya dūnānadīṃ tataḥ | pāyupaśyasaro dṛṣṭvā leṇḍugaṃ vīkṣya vai saraḥ || 19 || yonigaṃ ca saro dṛṣṭvā phālanādapradeśakān | svādvadanapradeśām̐śca nāraravapradeśakān || 2.165.2 0|| trinayāṃ ca nadīṃ vīkṣya lepanādapradeśakān | koladvīpaṃ prasamīkṣya śvetavārdhiṃ vilokya ca || 21 || hīnāṃ nadīṃ vilokyātha pācaurāṃ saritaṃ tathā | kāmāyā vastunāyāśca saṃgamaṃ vīkṣya sundaram || 22|| donānadīṃ vilokyātha ājavābdhisamāgame | bhaktāste śanakainaiṃjaṃ vimānaṃ hyavatārayan ||23|| nyūṣuste tatra vṛkṣādyaiḥ ramaṇīye pradeśake | bhajanaṃ śrīhareścakrurvādyagāyananartanaiḥ ||24|| rātrau viśrāntimāsādya dvitīye divase punaḥ | ṣaṭkarmāṇi vinirvartya kīrtayantaḥ savādyakāḥ || 25|| tenaiva ca krameṇaite babhramurvai vimānagāḥ | śratvā prajāśca rājāno raṭaṇaṃ parameśituḥ ||26|| paramānandamāpannā jayavāco’bhisañjaguḥ | svāgataṃ svāgataṃ ceti satkāravācamairayan ||27|| puṣpādyairvardhayāmāsuḥ pratideśaṃ pratisthalam | evaṃ deśān bhramitvā ca donānadīṃ samāyayuḥ ||28|| viśaśramurbhojyapānaistṛptā niśāṃ tu kīrtanaiḥ | yāpayāmāsurevaite tṛtīye’pi dine tathā ||29|| prātaḥ kṛtyaṃ vidhāyaiva niṣadya ca vimānake | tenaiva ca krameṇaite babhramurvai vimānagāḥ ||2.165.3 0|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtergale ca yaḥ | cintāmaṇirdhṛto mālāmadhye spṛṣṭvā tu taṃ tadā ||3 1|| vṛkāyano maharṣiśca cintayitvā tu śarkarām | miṣṭāmamṛtakalpāṃ ca samutpādya navāṃ navām ||32|| yatra yatra janā deśe vilokyante ca tatra ca | varṣayāmāsa bahudhā hareḥ prasādalabdhaye ||33 || prajāstu harṣanādaiśca jagṛhuḥ śarkarāśca tāḥ | cakhaduścātimuditā jayanādān pracakrire ||34|| svāgataṃ svāgataṃ ceti prārthayāmāsurutsukāḥ | prasādaṃ ca samarpayya vimānaṃ sāyameva tat || 35|| donājavābdhisaṃgaṃ ca samāyātaṃ niśāmukhe | rātrau te bhajanaṃ cakruḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti vai || 36 || tāvattatra samāyātā aṣṭāviṃśatikanyakāḥ | divyarūpadharāḥ sarvāḥ kumāryaḥ śvetabhāsurāḥ ||37|| divyamālāmbarabhūṣādhāriṇyaścandrakāntayaḥ | ramaṇīyātisundaryo vaiṣṇavyastaulasīsrajaḥ ||38|| nārāyaṇaharekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇeti vai harim | raṭantyaḥ saumyabhāvena bhagavallagnamānasāḥ ||39|| puṣparatnākṣatahastāḥ kasturīcandanānvitāḥ | pūjāsāmagrikāyuktāḥ praṇemustā vimānakam ||2.165.40|| kumāryaḥ pañca divyāśca divyābharaṇaśobhitāḥ | divyavaiṣṇavaveṣāśca pūjopakaraṇānvitāḥ ||41 || ekaḥ śvetaścāparaśca kṛṣṇastṛtīyako javī | caturthastrinayanaśca pañcamo nīlavarṇakaḥ ||42|| te’pi natvā vimānaṃ ca tasthuḥ kṣaṇaṃ kumārakāḥ | tāvat trayaṃ samāyātaṃ nānyataraṃ suśobhitam ||43|| strīpuṃbhāvarahitaṃ ca śvetavarṇaṃ manoharam | natvā vimānaṃ tvaritaṃ tasthau trikaṃ kṣaṇaṃ tadā ||44|| tāvattatra samāyātaṃ viṃśatiyatimaṇḍalam | sajaṭaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ divyaṃ tāpasaṃ brahmabhāsuram ||45|| nārāyaṇaharekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa namo’stu te | ekasvareṇa pravadat neme vimānakaṃ tu tat ||46|| atha smṛddhapuruṣāśca catvārastatra cāyayuḥ | divyā divyābharaṇāśca divyarddhisaṃbhṛtāḥ śubhāḥ ||47|| tāpasāḥ siddhimantaśca yathā vai brahmacāriṇaḥ | natvā divyaṃ vimānaṃ te tasthuḥ kṣaṇaṃ viśaśramuḥ ||48|| atha ṣaṣṭirdivyarūpā militvā te narāḥ striyaḥ | vṛkāyanaṃ tathā cāṭvālarṣīn sarvān praṇamya ca ||49|| stutiṃ cakrurvimānābhimukha vilokya bhāvataḥ | ekasvareṇa muditā netre pramilya vai tadā ||2.165.50|| vyāpako yaḥ parabrahmānādiśrīpuruṣottamaḥ | muktamuktānikāsevyastasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||5 1 || akṣaraṃ brahma yatrāste dhāma divyaṃ parātparam | sevate yaṃ sadā tatra tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||52|| yanmūrtestu samutpannā rādhā śaktiḥ surūpiṇī | rādhārthaṃ kṛṣṇarūpo’bhūt tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||53|| yaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nityagoloke gāvo gopyaśca gopakāḥ | sevante sukhadaṃ rāse tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||54|| yanmūrtestu samutpannā lakṣmīrmūrtiḥ surūpiṇī | nārāyaṇo’bhūllakṣmyarthaṃ tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||55|| yaṃ vaikuṇṭhe pārṣadāḥ pārṣadānyaśca bhagāni ca | prasevante sakhīkoṭyastasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||56|| yo nātho’nādisṛṣṭeśca pravāhārthaṃ catuṣṭayam | vāsudevādikaṃ vyūhaṃ dhatte kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||57|| yo devo vai mahābhūmā vairājaśca purābhavat | tridevatāṃ samāpannastasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||58|| yaḥ svamūrtau māṇikīṃ ca ramāṃ padmāvatīṃ satīm | lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇīṃ dhatte tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||59|| yo haṃsāṃ suguṇāṃ mañjulikāṃ dhatte svavigrahe | dayāṃ jayāṃ ca lalitāṃ tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||2.165.60|| yo rādhāṃ yamunāṃ gaṃgāṃ virajāṃ ca sarasvatīm | śāradāṃ kamalāṃ dhatte tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||6 1 || yaḥ svamūrtervivareṣu dhatte brahmāṇḍakoṭikāḥ | brahmāṇḍeṣvanvitaścāste tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||62|| avyākṛte’mṛte dhāmni śvetadvīpe narāyaṇaḥ | yastvāste śrīramāsevyastasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||63|| ādityamaṇḍale hiraṇmayo yaśca virājate | agnau yajñasvarūpaśca tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||64|| brahmāṇḍe viṣṇurūpo yaḥ svarge vāmanarūpadhṛk | badaryāṃ ca hariścāste tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||65|| śeṣe nārāyaṇarūpaścātmasvantarniyāmakaḥ | sākṣī yaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||66|| yaścāste bālakṛṣṇo’yaṃ śrīmadgopālanandanaḥ | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||67|| yena gaṃgā kṛtā divyāsmanmātā ṣaṣṭibālakā | pādāṅguṣṭhena satye vai tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||68|| mūrtirūpo vimāne’tra yaścāste bhagavān hariḥ | gaṃgāpatyakṛpāvarṣī tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||69||| karmakāṇḍāya yogāya jñānāya ca viviktaye | nītaye ca vicārāya tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||2.165.70|| jīvāya jīvakāyāpi prāṇāya kośine ca te | khāya kāya ca satyāya tasmai kṛṣṇātmane namaḥ ||71 || tīrthāya sādhurūpāya sarvajñāya vihāriṇe | muktaye muktidātre ca tasmai kṛṣṇātmane namaḥ ||72||| cidacitsarvarūpāya vimānasthāya mūrtaye | bālāya bālakṛṣṇāya kāntakṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||73 || brahmapriyādhipataye koṭiśaktīśvarāya ca | śatacatvāriṃśadūrdhvakanyākāntāya te namonamaḥ ||74|| māyākālapuruṣāṇāṃ pataye dhāmadhāminām | īśajīvādhipataye tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||75|| gocarāyāgocarāya ṣaṣṭivandyāya mūrtaye | śaraṇaṃ smaḥ samāpannāḥ śaraṇyāya ca te namaḥ ||76|| evaṃ stutvā rādhike te vṛkāyanābhikāṃkṣayā | puṣpāñjalīnnibaddhyaiva vimānabhūmikāṃ yayuḥ ||77|| gāṃgeyāḥ ṣaṣṭibālāste viviśuśca vimānakam | yatrāste bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa mūrtirūpo hariḥ svayam ||78|| dṛṣṭvā puṣpāñjaliṃ cakrurdaṇḍavaccādarādati | tāvanmūrteḥ prāvirāsa bālakṛṣṇastu gocaraḥ ||79|| caturdaśasamāmūrtirdivyāvayavaśobhanaḥ | koṭikāmādhisaundaryo hāsyasaumyānanaḥ prabhuḥ ||2.165.80 || brahmapriyābhisahitaḥ ṣaṭpatnīsahitaḥ svayam | gaṃgāditīrthasahito vimāne gocaro’bhavat ||81|| gaṃgāṃ ca mātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā tathā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | ṣaṣṭibālā mumudire gaṃgāstanyaṃ tadāsravat ||82|| nipetuḥ śrīhareścāpi mātuśca pādayordrutam | pañjalāni papuḥ sarve prakṣālya magnamānasāḥ ||83|| pūjayāmāsuratyarthaṃ puṣpamauktikahīrakaiḥ | divyaratnaiḥ svarṇavastrābhūṣaṇaiśca phalādibhiḥ ||84|| divyaiśca madhubhiścāpi sugandhicandanādibhiḥ | gandhasāraiḥ sarvarasairbhāvanābhiśca vai hṛdā ||85|| nīrājanaṃ tadā cakrurhareśca māturityapi | pradakṣiṇaṃ pracakruśca prārthanāṃ cakrureva ca ||86|| koṭijanmāparādhānāṃ kṣantā nārāyaṇaprabho | asmaddeśeṣu cāgatya kuru deśān hi pāvanān ||87|| pratīkṣāmastvāgamaṃ te prajānāṃ pāvanāya vai | samāgatya harerasmān pāvayātra ciraṃsthitān ||88|| mātrā saha yadā satyāllokādāgamanaṃ tu naḥ | bhagīrathasya yatnena cābhūttadā hareṇa vai ||89|| grahītā svajaṭāyāṃ no jananī tu tadā vayam | viyuktā himavadvayomnastyaktvā kiṃpuruṣaṃ talam ||2.165.90 || ketumālaṃ nirjanaṃ ca dṛṣṭvātra nirupadravam | nārāyaṇecchayāgatya nivasāmo’tiśāntitaḥ ||91 || asmanmadhye bhavantīyā aṣṭāviṃśatikanyakāḥ | gaṃgāputryo vayaṃ sarvāḥ pañca putrā ime tathā |||92||| trīṇyapatyāni caitāni kumārā viṃśatistathā | catvāraścāpi bālāśca sarve gaṃgodbhavā vayam ||93 || kṛtvā yajñotsavānatra cāhūya daivamaṇḍalam | ketumālaṃ pāvanaṃ ca kuru kṛṣṇaṃ samantataḥ ||94|| śrutvānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | jahāse mumude cāpi svīcakāra tadarthitam ||95|| datvā tebhyaḥ prasādaṃ ca pratimāyāṃ tirobhavat | parivāro’pi sarvo hi kṣaṇādantaradhīyata ||96|| vṛkāyano maharṣiśca nīlakarṇādayastathā | śrutvā vṛttāntakaṃ dṛṣṭvā samāślikṣan hṛdā mudā ||97|| svāgataṃ te tataścakruḥ pūjābhojanavāribhiḥ | gāṃgeyānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ bālakṛṣṇakṛpājuṣām ||98|| militvā ca vimāne te cakruḥ śrīharikīrtanam | pradaduśca tato naijaṃ paricayaṃ parasparam ||99|| āmantraṇaṃ pracakruśca gāṃgeyāstu vimānagān | naijān deśān pāvayituṃ vihartuṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ || 2.165.10 0|| vṛkāyanādyāḥ svīcakrurāmantraṇaṃ punastataḥ | jagaduḥ svavimāne ca saha sthātuṃ tu ṣaṣṭikam || 10 1|| aṅgīcakruśca te ṣaṣṭirdivyabālā yathoditam | ityevaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇecchayā sammelanaṃ hyabhūt || 1 02|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vṛkāyananīlakarṇādimaharṣīṇāṃ ketumālaṃ prati vimānena gamanaṃ deśanirīkṣaṇaṃ gāṃgeyāpatyaṣaṣṭisammelanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 165 ||
<2.166> śrīrādhikovāca kathaṃ kadā samutpannā gaṃgāyāṃ bālabālikāḥ | tatsarvaṃ me vada kṛṣṇa śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || 1 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca vṛkāyanādibhiḥ pṛṣṭāste sarve’pi tathaiva tu | vṛttāntaṃ jagaduḥ sarve yathābhūtaṃ vadāmi te || 2 || ekadā khalu goloke rādhayā cārthitastvayā | śrīkṛṣṇo’hamapatyārthaṃ mayā saṃkalpitastadā || 3 || vikuṇṭhākhyā tadā putrī putrāśca saptasāgarāḥ | utpādyaiva pradattāste tvamabhūstuṣṭamānasā || 4 || tvāmapatyavatīṃ dṛṣṭvā gaṃgā tvapatyavarjitā | apatyecchāvatī jātāpatyāni cārthayacca mat || 5 || mayā putryaḥ śubhā dattā yāvatyastvabhivāñcchitāḥ | aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyākāstadā toṣamupāgatā || 6 || athaicchat sā kumārām̐śca mayā pañcārpitāstadā | tathāpi naiva santuṣṭā catvāraśca tato’rpitāḥ || 7 || athāpi toṣaṃ naivāptā punarviṃśatibālakāḥ | mayā dattā tadā toṣaṃ hyavāpaicchattathāpi sā || 8 || apatyāni tadā trīṇi mayārpitāni tatkṣaṇāt | evaṃ mayā tu gaṃgāyai goloke ṣaṣṭibālakāḥ || 9 || saṃkalpayogajā dattāstadā sā toṣamāpa ha | yadā sāvātaralloke tadāpatyayutā tu sā || 2.166.1 0|| samāgatā snehayuktāpatyānyādhāya vai saha | golokāt sā prathame tu vaikuṇṭhe samavātarat || 11 || tato jalasyāvaraṇe vaikuṇṭhe tu dvitīyake | tato viṣṇupādabhūtā satyaloke hyavātarat || 12|| brahmaṇā rakṣitā satye loke’bhiṣekavāñcchayā | kamaṇḍalau dhṛtā nityaṃ samūrtā svagṛhe’pi ca || 13|| kāryakāraṇarūpaiva brahmavāse virājate | bhagīrathaprayatnena kāryakāraṇarūpiṇī || 14|| arpitā sāgaramuktyai bhagīrathāya vedhasā | sampunānā maharṣīṃśca pitṝn devām̐śca vāyujān || 15|| merumārgeṇa sā devī nyapatad rudramastake | śaṃbhunā svajaṭāyāṃ sā dhṛtā tatra layaṃ gatā || 16|| tadā mātrā copadiṣṭā ṣaṣṭibālā himālayam | śaṃbhusthānaṃ parityajya dūraṃ bhayād yayurdrutam || 17|| indukuśaṃ kaśyapābdhiṃ tyaktvā kiṃpuruṣaṃ tathā | yayuḥ khaṇḍāntare yatra nirbhayāstasthureva te || 18|| ketumāle kṛtasthānā nyavasaṃste yathāmatam | gāṃgeyāste kumārāśca kumāryaḥ ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyakāḥ || 19|| pratīkṣante sma bhagavatpādapadmaṃ sukhasthitāḥ | ārādhayanti sma hariṃ smaranti mātaraṃ sadā ||2.166.20 || teṣāṃ mano’bhilaṣitaṃ pūrayituṃ pareśvaraḥ | preṣayāmāsa śatakaṃ bhaktānāṃ miṣamātrakam ||21 || tanmiṣeṇa svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ | rādhike mūrtirūpeṇa vimāne gocaro’bhavat ||22|| teṣāṃ saṃkalpasiddhyarthaṃ yajñaṃ kartumiyeṣa saḥ | ato datvā vacastatra punaścāntaradhīyata ||23|| śṛṇu kanyakānāmāni kumāranāmakāni ca | tiṣṭhanti mūrtimantaśca tiṣṭhanti kṛtakāni ca ||24|| jyeṣṭhā kanyā valgunāmnī niṣṭhāparā dvitīyakā | nistārā ca pṛthā cāpi dinapā sevikā tathā ||25|| saptamī cendirā gavādakavitāṣṭamī matā | rāhūnā navamī gavādayānā daśamī tathā ||26|| trigrāsā dūrikā mitrā gurūnā lavavārikā | senā sthāyinī cālpāpā hyaṣṭādaśī matā hi sā || 27|| audarī viṣatulyā ca prapīṭhā niyamānikā | dūnā trinayā ca hīnā pācaurā kāmikā tathā ||28|| donāṣṭāviṃśatitamā kanyāḥ proktāḥ kumārikāḥ | bālatrikastathā śvetaḥ kṛṣṇaśca kaśyapābhidhaḥ ||29|| ājavaḥ pañcamaśceti jyeṣṭhā vai bhrātarastvime | tataścatvāra evāsan bhrātarastān vadāmi te ||2.166.3 0|| parījo’lpaścāpyāyanaḥ kṛpāsthalaścaturthakaḥ | tato viṃśatiḥ sañjātāḥ śṛṇu nāmnā vadāmi te ||3 1|| yavakrītastathā romāyanaśca yugaśāvakaḥ | valgurāyo girīśaśca ṣaṣṭhaśceṣṭalavo mataḥ ||32|| sveṣṭajaraḥ pherunasaḥ pūrtagaṇḍaḥ supānakaḥ | phalāśano vallijīvo jarāmaunastrayodaśaḥ |||33 || pālanādo lātavāyaḥ phālanādastu ṣoḍaśaḥ | svādvadano nāraravo lepanādaśca kolakaḥ ||34|| ete viṃśatisaṃkhyā vai kṛṣṇatulyāḥ parākrame | tatastrīṇi ca jātāni hyapatyāni tu nāmataḥ ||35|| pāyupaśyaṃ leṇḍugaṃ ca yonigaṃ ceti ṣaṇḍhakam | evaṃ ṣaṣṭiḥ sahajānāṃ rādhike divyavaibhavā ||36|| vartate vaiṣṇavī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇārpaṇakriyā | yatra yatra tu yaścāste tattannāmnā sthalādikam ||37|| tattattataḥ prasiddhiṃ cāgamat tadadhidaivatam | ta ete ṣaṣṭibālā vai gāṃgeyāśca vṛkāyanam ||38|| prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ bhramituṃ nijadeśakān | punarvimānamāruhya sarve te śatameva tu ||39|| ṣaṣṭyā saha vimānena niryayurbhramituṃ tadā | prādakṣiṇyakrameṇaiva vyomnā pūrvakrameṇa ca ||2.166.40|| tattaddeśānavatīrya gāṃgeyānāṃ pravāñcchayā | pāvanān vai prakurvantaḥ kurvanto bhajanaṃ hareḥ ||41|| ṣaṣṭisthalāni saṃvīkṣya kṛtvotsavām̐śca tatra ca | śrāvayitvā harernāma nṛpān nṝm̐śca muhurmuhuḥ ||42|| punastatrāyayuḥ sarve donājavābdhisaṃgamam | nyūṣuḥ sukhena te sarve kīrtayanto hareḥ kathām ||43|| gāṃgeyāḥ prāhurevaitān vṛkāyanādikān punaḥ | kadānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāddhariḥ svayam ||44|| āgamiṣyati yajñārthaṃ kadā dṛṣṭyāmavāpsyate | deśeṣvatra prajāḥ sarvāḥ pratīkṣante samutsavam ||45|| vṛkāyana maharṣe tvaṃ prayāhi śrīhariṃ prati | śīghraṃ yathā bhavedyajñastathārthayitumarhasi ||46|| ityuktaḥ siddhimān divyo vṛkāyanaḥ samādhinā | drutaṃ prāṇān sanniruddhya brahmarandhramupāgataḥ ||47|| niryayau yogarītyaiva cāyayāvāśvasārasam | natvā devaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ cārthayāmāsa hṛdgatam ||48|| śrutvā śrībhagavānāha śrāvaṇe śuklapakṣake | pañcamyāṃ tu makhaḥ kāryaścaikādaśyāṃ samāptimān ||49|| tato deśeṣu sarvatra sthāne sthāne tu rājasu | gantavyaṃ bhādramāse vai āśvine kṛṣṇapakṣake ||2.166.50 || yāhi tvaṃ ca pradeśeṣu tathā prakāśanaṃ kuru | yathā yajñasya samayaṃ jānīyurjanatāḥ prajāḥ ||51 || sāmagrīścāpi gāṃgeyairmilitvā sañcitāḥ kuru | idaṃ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ saha nītvā prayāhi me ||52|| preṣaya vyomamārgeṇa taddeśeṣu samantataḥ | bhramitvā ca muhuryatra bhūmau viśrāntimācaret ||53|| tatra yajñaḥ prakartavyastatsthalaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ kuru | prakāśitaṃ sthalaṃ tacca vimānena punardinam ||54|| bhramitvāmbaramārgeṇa prasūcitaṃ vidhāpaya | ahaṃ vimānamārgeṇa śrāvaṇe’hni tṛtīyake ||55|| śukle devaiḥ kuṭumbādyairmaharṣibhiśca śaktibhiḥ | saha nītvā samāyāsye madhyāhnottarameva ha ||56|| ityājñapto maharṣiśca sudarśanena śobhitaḥ | yogaiśvaryeṇa sahasā donājavābdhisaṃgamam ||57|| yayau prātaśca vṛttāntaṃ sarvebhyo’kathayacchubham | ṣaṣṭibālāḥ prasannāste’bhavad śrutvācyutāgamam ||58|| prātaḥkṛtyāni nirvartya sarvavādyaiśca kīrtanaiḥ | sarve vimānamāruhya māṃgalyasūcanāya te ||59|| vyomnā prāguktakramaśaḥ sudarśanena saṃyutāḥ | yajñabhūmernirṇayārthaṃ kīrtayanto viniryayuḥ ||2.166.60|| ekavāraṃ mahaccakraṃ bhramitvālokya bhūmikāḥ | pradarśayat svakaṃ tejomaṇḍalaṃ sūryasadṛśam ||6 1 || sahasrāraṃ sudurlakṣyaṃ kiñcillakṣyaṃ prabhāvinām | hṛdayeṣu prajānāmāścaryaṃ cājanayanmahat ||62|| kautūhalaṃ vyadadhācca divyabhāvaṃ nyadhāpayat | evaṃ tu bhrāmaṇe jāte prajāścāsan suvihvalāḥ ||6 3|| draṣṭuṃ punaśca taccakraṃ vimānaṃ sūryavarcasam | atha cakraṃ punastena vimānena samaṃ bhuvam ||64|| nirṇetuṃ prāsarat śīghraṃ prasannaṃ janayat sukham | niṣṭhāparāprapīṭhāsaṃgame śāntamavātarat ||65|| uttarasyāṃ kṣitau rāsāyanāraṇyasuśobhite | paritaḥ sarvadeśānāṃ samamadhye subhūtale ||66 || vilokya śrīhareḥ sudarśanāvataraṇaṃ kṣitau | vimānaṃ saṃgame tatrāvātārayan maharṣayaḥ ||67|| vṛkāyano nīlakarṇo yavakrītastathāpare | viśramya bhūmikāṃ divyāṃ vīkṣya ramyāṃ makhārhikām ||68|| praśaśaṃsuḥ prasannāścābhavan gāṃgeyakādayaḥ | athodghoṣayituṃ sthānaṃ dinaṃ yajñaṃ ca te tataḥ ||69|| savādyakīrtanagītāḥ vimāne cāmbare’bhavan | prādakṣiṇyakrameṇaiva śaṃkhavādanapūrvakāḥ ||2.166.70|| paṭahān nādayantaśca gāyantaḥ kīrtanāni ca | harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa ramākṛṣṇa harehare ||7 1|| padmajāśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa lakṣmīpatehare | ityevaṃ saṃraṭantaste madhye madhye sthale sthale ||72|| udghoṣayanti yajñaṃ susthānaṃ ca dinamityapi | saptāho vaiṣṇavo yajño vaidikaḥ sārvadaivataḥ ||73|| niṣṭhāparāprapīṭhāsaṃgame viśālabhūtale | yatakrītarṣisaṃsthāne nadīdvayāntarālake ||74|| sampatsyate’tra bhagavān śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāyāsyati svayam ||75|| śrāvaṇasya tṛtīyāyāṃ śuklāyāṃ śrīhariṃ prabhuḥ | madhyāhnottaravelāyāmājanābhapradeśataḥ ||76|| kṣetrātkuṃkumavāpyākhyād vimānenāgamiṣyati | devarṣipitṛsahito brahmapriyāsamanvitaḥ ||77|| śrāvaṇasya tu śuklāyāṃ pañcamyāṃ prātareva saḥ | vidhāsyati makhārambhaṃ pāvanaṃ sarvadehinām ||78|| ekādaśyāṃ samāptiśca kratostatra bhaviṣyati | āmantryante prajāḥ sarvā rājāno’pi kuṭumbinaḥ ||79|| sarvavarṇā narā nāryo samāyāntu mahādhvare | paśyantu devadeveśaṃ kṛtārthayantu janma ca ||2.166.80|| gṛhṇantu cādhvaraprāsādikaṃ bhajantu ceśvaram | śṛṇvantu sukathā divyāḥ pāvayantu kulāni ca ||8 1 || bhajantu bhagavantaṃ taṃ pratyakṣaṃ kṛṣṇanāmakam | sarvaistu bhojanaṃ kāryaṃ saptāhe yājñaśālikam ||82|| prāptaṃ divyaṃ tu samayaṃ saphalayantu sarvathā | gṛhṇantu vaiṣṇavān mantrān nārāyaṇamukhānnanu ||83|| dhārayantu pāvanīśca srajastulasikodbhavāḥ | raṭantu śrīharernāma bhavantu divyavigrahāḥ ||84|| āgacchantu mahābhāgā yajñe nārāyaṇīyake | na bhūto na punarbhāvī kratuścaitādṛśaḥ khalu ||85|| adhvare cāgamiṣyanti dhāmadhāmanivāsinaḥ | muktakoṭyaśceśakoṭyo devakoṭyaśca mānavāḥ ||86|| ṛṣayaḥ pitaro yakṣā gāndharvā rākṣasāstathā | drumāstīrthāni tattvāni parvatā bhūmayastathā ||87|| mūrtāmūrtagaṇāḥ sarve samāyāsyanti cādhvare | kalpalatāḥ kāmagāvaḥ siddhayo yatayastathā ||88|| yoginaḥ siddhapuruṣāḥ śaktayo yoṣitastathā | sarve cātrāgamiṣyanti paśyantu tanmahādhvaram ||89|| harekṛṣṇa svāmikṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa harehare | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin harehare ||2.166.90|| rādhālakṣmīpate haṃsāramāpadmāvatīpate | māṇikīśrīmaṃjulāsadaguṇāpate śriyāḥpate ||91 || brahmapriyāpate kṛṣṇaparameśa harehare | harekṛṣṇa svāmikṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa harehare ||92|| vijayo’stu hareścātra prajānāṃ vijayo’stu ca | sukhābhivṛddhirevāstu smṛddhiścāstu sadāvyayā ||93 || ārogyaṃ cāstu deśānāṃ bhaktiścāstu pareśvare | parameśaṃ cintayantu prāpayantu parāṃ gatim ||94|| bhuktiṃ muktiṃ cārjayantu nārāyaṇaprasādataḥ | avaśyaṃ tu makhe samāgatya tṛptā bhavantu hi ||95|| bhavantu pāvanā bhaktā mokṣayogyāḥ śubhāśrayāḥ | dānahomaparāstatra bhavantu makhabhāginaḥ ||96|| rājāno rājavargāśca śreṣṭhivargāḥ prajājanāḥ | bālā bālyaḥ striyo vṛddhā gṛhṇantu lābhamādhvaram ||97|| ityevaṃ rādhike vyomni vimānaṃ ghoṣaṇāṃ muhuḥ | akarot saptavāraṃ vai bhramitvā ketumālake ||98|| uralāt paścime deśe samudratīrakāvadhim | sarvadeśeṣu kṛṣṇasya ghoṣaṇā vai pravartitā ||99|| tato vimānaṃ śāntaṃ ca yatakrītapradeśake | avātarat prapīṭhāyāḥ pūrve nīparapaścime || 2.166.1 00|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jayatu sarvadā | uccarantaścāvateruḥ sudarśanena saṃhitāḥ || 101 || viśaśramurmahāraṇye’mārātrau te maharṣayaḥ | gāṃgeyā bālabālādyaḥ śāntimāpuḥ parāṃ tadā || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne gāṃgeyānāmudbhavavṛttāntastannāmāni, vṛkāyanasya kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrāgamanaṃ, harerāmantraṇaṃ, sudarśanena saha ketumāle vṛkāyanāgamaḥ, sudarśanasthairyadarśitakratusthalīnirṇayaḥ, yajñodghoṣaṇā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 166 ||
<2.167> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścād yadajāyata vacmi te | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipatīśvaraḥ || 1 || praiṣayallomaśaṃ cānyān maharṣīn yajñakovidān | patnīvrataṃ maharṣiṃ ca śvetavyāsaṃ sanātanam || 2 || sanatkumāraṃ ca tathā gaṇeśaṃ jātavedasam | satrāyaṇaṃ gālavaṃ ca svīyaprakāśamityapi || 3 || śatānandaṃ nāradaṃ ca devaguruṃ bṛhaspatim | īśānaṃ ca mahādevaṃ kapilaṃ bhagavanmunim || 4 || śukaṃ ca vallabhamuniṃ vāmanaṃ suratāyanam | hemantaṃ devaprakāśaṃ yajñopakaraṇānyapi || 5 || samagrāṇi vimāne preṣayāmāsa sa tānmunīn | pratipaddivase sarve madhyāhnottarameva tu || 6 || prāptā niṣṭhāparātīre yatra vṛkāyanādayaḥ | svāgataṃ kṛtavantaste yavakrītādayastadā || 7 || āgatānāṃ lomaśādimaharṣīṇāṃ jayādibhiḥ | madhuparkādibhiścāpi pupūjurlomaśādikān || 8 || vimānaṃ tu vimānena saha bhūmāvarakṣayan | gāṃgeyāśca yavakrītādayaḥ pupūjurādarāt || 9 || viśvakarmā tathā devāyatano dvau samāgatau | haryājñayā śilpivaryau tatraiva pratipaddine || 2.167.1 0|| viśramya bhojanaṃ kṛtvā tato bhūmiviśodhanam | maṇḍapaṃ dharmaśālāśca pākaśālāḥ pracakratuḥ || 1 1|| yajñaśālā vāsaśālā homaśālāḥ pracakratuḥ | ghaṭaśālā vastuśālā mahīmānālayān śubhān || 12|| muktaśālā avatāranivāsān devatālayān | ṛṣiśālāḥ pitṛśālā yakṣarākṣasasadgṛhān || 1 3|| jaḍacetanavāsām̐śca cakratuste samantataḥ | śatakrośamite deśe nadīdvayāntarālake || 14|| cakraturmaṇḍapān ramyān yathāvāsisamarhaṇān | yavakrītādayaścāpi svasvadeśān yayurdrutam || 15|| tattaddeśīyanṛpatīnāninyuśca prajāstathā | śreṣṭhino bhaktavaryāṃśca narān nārīḥ kuṭumbinaḥ || 16|| vimānaistvaritaṃ sarve cāninyuścādhvarasthalīm | śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike mukhyābhidhānāni makhārthinām || 17|| samrāṭ pūrvapradeśānāmuralaketusaṃjñakaḥ | yavakrītarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ ṣaṣṭilakṣaprajāyutaḥ || 18|| kuṭumbasahitaścībjalakṣmīdravyādibhiḥ saha | yānavāhanasaṃsmṛddhyā yajñārthaṃ samupāyayau || 19|| romāyanarṣiṇā sākaṃ rumāṇāṃ krathako nṛpaḥ | lakṣaprajābhiḥ sahitaḥ sakuṭumbaḥ samāyayau ||2.167.20|| kṛpāsthalarṣiṇā sārdhama pṛthurājaḥ kuṭumbavān | daśasāhasramanujaiḥ saha yajñārthamāyayau | |21 || yugaśāvarṣiṇā sārdhamuṣṭrālanṛpatistathā | haṃkārākhyanṛpaścāpi jayakoṣṭhalabhūpatiḥ ||22|| trayaste bhrātaro bhūpāḥ kuṭumbasahitāstathā | lakṣaprajāyutāstatra makhārthaṃ samupāyayuḥ ||23|| valgurāyarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ tīrāṇabhūpatistadā | daśasāhasramanujaiḥ kuṭumbī kratumāyayau || 24|| girīśena samaṃ rājā alvīnaraḥ kuṭumbavān | daśasāhasramanujaiḥ sārdhaṃ yajñārthamāyayau ||25|| iṣṭalavarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ jinavarddhinṛpastadā | kuṭumbī pañcasāhasraprajābhiryajñamāyayau ||26|| āpyāyanarṣiṇā sārdhamalpaketurnṛpastadā | daśasāhasramanujaiḥ kuṭumbena sahāyayau ||27|| sveṣṭajararṣiṇā sārdhaṃ jayakṛṣṇavabhūpatiḥ | daśasāhasramanujaiḥ kuṭumbena sahāyayau ||28|| pherunararṣiṇā sārdhaṃ parīśānanṛpo makhe | daśalakṣaprajāyuktaḥ sakuṭumbaḥ samāyayau ||29|| parījamuninā sārdhamindurāyanṛpo makhe | trisāhasraprajāyuktaḥ sakuṭumbaḥ samāyayau ||2.167.3 0|| pūrtagaṇḍarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ gaṇḍako nṛpa āyayau | sakuṭumbaḥ pañcaśataprajābhiścādhvare tadā ||3 1|| supānamuninā sārdhaṃ nudrāṇḍanṛpatistadā | pañcalakṣaprajāyuktaḥ kuṭumbī samupāyayau ||32|| phalāśanarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ līnorṇanṛpatirmakhe | lakṣadvayaprajāyuktaḥ kuṭumbī samupāyayau ||33|| vallījīvanamuninā sākaṃ bṛhaccharo nṛpaḥ | sahasramanujairyuktaḥ kuṭumbī makhamāyayau ||34|| jarāmaunarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ balalīno nṛpo makhe | daśalakṣaprajāyuktaḥ kuṭumbavān samāyayau ||35|| pālanādarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ varasiṃho nṛpo’dhvare | lakṣaprajānvitaḥ kuṭumbena yutaḥ samāyayau ||36|| lātavāyarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ rāyagāmalabhūpatiḥ | sahasramanujaiḥ sārdhaṃ kuṭumbī yajñamāyayau ||37|| phālanādarṣiṇā sākaṃ phenatantunṛpo makhe | sahasramanujairyuktaḥ kuṭumbī samupāyayau ||38|| svādvadanarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ stokahomanṛpo makhe | sahasramanujairyuktaḥ kuṭumbī samupāyayau ||39|| nāraravarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ kāṣṭhayānanṛpo makhe | pañcaśataprajāyuktaḥ kuṭumbī samupāyayau ||2.167.40|| lepanādarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ kolako nṛpatiḥ kratau | śatamānavayuktaśca kuṭumbī samupāyayau ||41|| layadānapradeśebhyaścāṃgarājaḥ samāyayau | viṣaparṣiyuto lakṣaprajāyuktaḥ kuṭumbavān ||42|| śakuntadeśataścāpi śākuntako nṛpo’dhvare | lakṣaprajānvitaḥ kuṭumbavān tatra samāyayau ||43|| āyasāttu pradeśādvai prajā yajñe samāyayuḥ | uttaradvīpabhāgebhyastathā prajāḥ samāyayuḥ ||44|| vimānairhastibhiścāśvairanobhiḥ rāṇḍiyaistathā | uṣṭraiśca vṛṣabhaiścāpi svarṇaratnadhanānvitāḥ ||45|| bahubhojyapradeyaiśca vastubhiḥ saha cāyayuḥ | dāsadāsīsamāyuktāḥ putraputryādivalgitāḥ ||46|| dampatīsamudāyāśca save tatra samāyayuḥ | yajñārhābhiścopadābhiḥ sāmagrībhiḥ samāyayuḥ ||47|| ṣaḍviṃśatikṣitipāste’saṃkhyadravyasamanvitāḥ | yajñārthaṃ vastusāmagrīnītvotsāhabharā makhe ||48|| āgatya pradaduḥ sarvāḥ sāmagrīrvividhāstadā | gālavāyarṣaye sarvādhyakṣeśānāya vai tathā ||49|| īśānaḥ śrīmahādevo vaiṣṇavaḥ parameśvaraḥ | sarvayajñakriyādhyakṣo vastvadhyakṣo’bhavattadā ||2.167.50|| maṇḍapādivyavasthāyā niyāmako’pi so hyabhūt | rājabhistatra cāgatyeśānāya viniveditam ||51|| rājavargo hi pratyekaṃ yajñārthaṃ yajamānakaḥ | vyayaṃ dātuṃ prabhavati tasmānmakhā nṛpārthitāḥ ||52|| ṣaḍviṃśatisaṃkhyākāśca bhavantu kuṇḍaśobhitāḥ | śrutvaivaṃ rājavargasya vākyaṃ vṛkāyanastathā ||53|| lomaśaśca tatheśāno nīlākarṇādayastathā | svayaṃprakāśaḥ kapilo devaprakāśako’pare ||54|| agragā jagṛhurvāco viśvakarmātra daivataḥ | ājñāṃ prāpyarṣīṇāṃ tatra tathā kuṇḍāni cakratuḥ ||55|| saptaviṃśo mahān kuṇḍamūrdhanyo bhagavatkṛte | vihito homamūrdhanyaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇārthakaḥ ||56|| kuṇḍā navavidhāstatra kṛtā vai viśvakarmaṇā | vedarṣividhitaḥ sarve diśā niyamatastathā ||57|| sarvatobhadravedyākhyaḥ kamalākārakuṇḍakaḥ | sarvatobhadrikā vedī caturasrā tathā kṛtā ||58|| yonikuṇḍaḥ kṛtaścāpi kuṇḍo’rdhacandrakaḥ kṛtaḥ | kuṇḍastrikoṇakaścāpi kuṇḍo vartulakastathā ||59|| ṣaṭkoṇakuṇḍakaścāpi ṣaṭpatrakuṇḍakastathā | kuṇḍo’ṣṭakoṇakaścāpi kuṇḍo’ṣṭapatrakastathā ||2.167.60|| kṛtaścācāryakuṇḍaśca ṛgvedikuṇḍakaḥ kṛtaḥ | yajurvedikuṇḍakaścātharvavediprakuṇḍakaḥ ||6 1 || sāmavedikuṇḍakaśca vedikāścāparāḥ kṛtāḥ | madhyavedyaḥ pārśvavedyastathā ca vidhinā kṛtāḥ ||62|| evaṃ yathāyathaṃ pṛthvīṃ saṃskṛtya maṇḍapāntare | yathāyogyān śubhakuṇḍān vedikāścātiśobhitāḥ ||63 || devāyatanakaścāpi viśvakarmā pracakratuḥ | maṇḍapān rucirān ramyastaṃbhadhvajasuśobhitān ||64|| dikcihnādisamāḍhyasattoraṇādibhirañcitān | śatakrośe kārayāmāsatustau divyavaibhavān ||65|| naisargikāni tejāṃsi nisargasalilānyapi | śītasugandhivāyuśca nisargodyānabhūmayaḥ ||66|| svalpavimānavāhāśca vidyudvimānakoṭayaḥ | dolāśca vividhāstatra nisargagītayastathā ||67|| śītoṣṇahadakuṇḍāśca nisargagandhasārakāḥ | śayyāvāhanabhogyāni mālāpuṣpāṇi vai tathā ||68|| nisargatailasārāśca sarvaṃ naisargikaṃ kṛtam | svargaṃ vā satyaloko vā kiṃ vā vaikuṇṭhameva tat ||69|| sūryā nisargajā yatra candrā nisargabhāsurāḥ | sarāṃsi sarito yatra vahanti ca nisargajāḥ ||2.167.70|| evaṃ vai daihikaṃ sarvaṃ klṛptaṃ divyaṃ nisargajam | rājñāṃ cāpi prajānāṃ ca śreṣṭhināṃ ca tapasvinām ||71|| daridrāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca yoṣitāṃ ṣaṇḍhakasya ca | bhogā bhogyāstathā vāsā bhakṣyāḥ peyāstathālayāḥ ||72|| samānaṃ divyalokīyaṃ nityavibhūtijaṃ tadā | klṛptaṃ vai saccidānandaṃ hāsanāśavivarjitam ||73|| dugdhārthaṃ cāgatāstatra golokāt kāmadhenavaḥ | dugdhakulyā dadhikulyā ghṛtakulyāśca pāyasam ||74|| kṣīraṃ ca dugdhasārāṇi navanītāni vai tadā | akṣayyānyabhavan divyānyapi havyānyanantataḥ ||75|| vṛkṣāśca vallikā kalpalatā ninyurmadhūnyapi | ikṣusārān guḍān khaṇḍāḥ śarkarāścāpyasaṃkhyakāḥ ||76|| gundrām̐śca gundrapākāṃśca phalāni ca dalāni ca | araṇyāni vanānyudyānāni ninyuranantataḥ ||77|| oṣadhayastadā divyāḥ kaṇān vrīhīn rasām̐stathā | tilān yavān sudhānyāni samidho ninyurutsukāḥ ||78|| meghāśca vārdhayo miṣṭā nadā nadyaḥ sarāṃsi ca | naisargaśītamiṣṭāni ninyuḥ peyāni cāntataḥ ||79|| śrīlakṣmyau śrīhareḥ patnyau bhūlīlābjāvibhūtayaḥ | ramānnapūrṇā kamalā ninyurmiṣṭānnaparvatān ||2.167.80|| stambāḥ stabakāgucchāśca gulmā nālāśca kāṇḍikāḥ | vallayastṛṇapatrāśca ninyuḥ puṣpāṇi cāntataḥ ||8 1|| gahvarāṇi khanayaśca parvatā vivarāṇi ca | gairikāścitracūrṇāni ninyuḥ kuṃkumaraṃgakān ||82|| meruḥ pātrāṇi sarvāṇi cendraścāstaraṇāni ca | devatāśca vimānāni ninyuryajñamahotsave ||83|| vasavaśca kuberaśca dravyāṇi tu dadurmakhe | himālayoralādyāśca maṇiratnāni vai daduḥ ||84|| samudrā dvīpabhāgāśca mauktikāni dadurmakhe | ghanāścakrustadā chāyāmṛtavaścānukūlatām ||85|| gandharvā vādakāḥ sarve dadurvādyāni śāradāḥ | rājānaśca dadurdāsadāsīrbhṛtyān sukarmiṇaḥ ||86|| chatracāmarayānāni vāhanāni kratau tadā | gṛhe gṛhe ca nicitāścintāmaṇigaṇāstataḥ ||87|| cintayanti yadevārthyaṃ tat tat sarvaṃ dadatyapi | paṭahaḥ śrīharerdivyo nṛtyam̐śca ninadan muhuḥ ||88|| kalpapaṭaharūpo’yaṃ cākṣarabrahmarūpavān | sarvāpekṣyanidhiprakhyo dadātyapyabhivāñchitam ||89|| vastrābhūṣādravaddravyaśṛṃgāraṃ devaśilpinaḥ | yadapekṣyaṃ drutaṃ pratyupasthāpayanti vai makhe ||2.167.90|| evaṃ vai sarvavastūnāmānantyaṃ tatra vidyate | jaladevī svayaṃ yatra rasarūpā vyajāyata ||91|| bhūdevī bhojyarūpā ca kiṃ nyūnaṃ tatra rādhike | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vāñcchayā tvidam ||92|| saṃhitaṃ samabhūt tatrāntaḥsthitasyājñayā drutam | sūryaṃ candraṃ niśāṃ sandhyāṃ dinaṃ vāyuṃ tathāmbaram ||93|| analaṃ śravaṇān devān pṛthvīṃ jalaṃ ca parvatān | meghān kālaṃ vṛṣaṃ māyāmājñāṃ cakāra mādhavaḥ ||94|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | sarve drāgeva sarvatra caturdaśastareṣu vai ||95|| āvedayantu janatā adhvaro vai prajāyate | havyamādāya ca ketumāle yantu makhotsukāḥ ||96|| ityājñaptairveditāśca sthāninaḥ staravāsinaḥ | āninyustatra havyāni copadāḥ sīmavarjitāḥ ||97|| ityevaṃ rādhike yajñe’saṃkhyasāmagrikādrayaḥ | pūrvamevābhavan klṛptā acintyā vai maharṣibhiḥ ||98|| ṣaḍviṃśatikṣitipālā mahāścaryaṃ prapedire | aho devasya māhātmyaṃ cānumātuṃ na śakyate ||99|| abhavan garvahīnāśca sāmagryalpaṃ nijaṃ viduḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya rādhe yajñaphalaṃ labhet || 2.167.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśādīnāmṛṣīṇāṃ devāyatanaviśvakarmaṇoḥ ketumālīyabhūbhṛtāṃ prajānāṃ ca yajñabhūmāvāgamanam, maṇḍapakuṇḍahavyopakaraṇādisamupasthitiritinirūpaṇanāmā saptaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 167 ||
<2.168> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam | akṣarākhyaṃ pārṣadaṃ svaṃ sasmāra tūrṇameva ha || 1 || āgataścākṣarastatra kuṃkumavāpikāsthale | natvā tasthā haristasmai dadāvājñāṃ śubhaśrutim || 2 || ketumāle mahān yajño bhaviṣyatīti patrikām | kuṃkumāḍhyāṃ sarvasṛṣṭāśamantraṇārthamarthadām || 3 || śīghraṃ divyaiḥ pārṣadaistvaṃ sampreṣaya ca mā ciram | ityuktvā bhagavān tasmai dadau tāṃ patrikāṃ yathā || 4 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vijayatetamām | ketumāle sāprapauṭhāniṣṭhāparāsamāgame || 5 || śrāvaṇe śuklapañcamyāṃ sarveṣṭiṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ makham | kariṣyati trilokasthaistatrāgantavyamādarāt || 6 || gṛhṇīmaścātithilābhaṃ makhalābhaṃ vidantu ca | ekādaśyāṃ pūrṇahavo bhaviṣyati sukhotsavaiḥ || 7 || avatārā īśvarāśca pitaraḥ ṛṣidevatāḥ | mānavāḥ kāśyapāḥ sarve pātālādinivāsinaḥ || 8 || sthāvarā jaṃgamāścāpi samāyāntu makhe sukhāḥ | lomaśaśca yavakrītaḥ kapilaśca bṛhaspatiḥ | | 9 || sanatkumāro bhagavān uralaketubhūpatiḥ | īśānaśca vayamete nivedayāma ādarāt || 2.168.1 0|| jīvaloke īśaloke brahmaloke vasanti ye | āgantavyaṃ samastaistairnārāyaṇo’pi vacmyaham || 11 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastrivārakaṃ dale | pratijñāya punarvacmi sarve cāyāntu vai makhe || 12|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrāt tṛtīyāyāmahaṃ makhe | gamiṣyāmi bhavadbhiścopasthātavyaṃ tadā makhe || 13 || pārṣadāḥ sarvadhāmasthāḥ pārṣadānyaśca śaktayaḥ | samāyāntu mahīmānasevārthaṃ pūrvake dine || 14|| ityevaṃ patrikāḥ koṭirūpiṇīḥ samapraiṣayat | sarvalokeṣu bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 15|| cidākāśena ca bhūtākāśena māyayā tathā | mahākālena dharmeṇa dvārā vai sarvasṛṣṭiṣu || 16|| sṛṣṭyādau rādhike sarvatattvānāṃ lokalokinām | āsīt kuṭumbavad yogaḥ saṃsargo melanaṃ gatiḥ || 17|| tatra naivāsti cāścaryaṃ yatraite dvārarūpiṇaḥ | ahaṃ golokagaścāpi tvayā sākaṃ tadāgamam || 18|| sarve nārāyaṇāstatrāgacchan vilokya patrikāḥ | sarvasṛṣṭijanāstatra cāyayuḥ snehasaṃbhṛtāḥ || 19|| vārdhayastu janānāṃ vai vimānānāṃ tadāmbare | pradṛśyante sarvadikṣu tvāyānto makhabhūmikām ||2.168.20 || koṭyarbudābjapadmāni tvāyayuḥ pratidikstarāt | yāvanto muktakoṭyaśca tāvantaḥ pārṣadādayaḥ || 21|| tāvatyaḥ śaktayaścāpi muktānyaḥ siddhayastathā | tāvantaśceśvarāḥ sarve svasvaśaktyādiśobhitāḥ ||22|| tāvantaśca maheśādyāstāvantaścāṇḍavāsinaḥ | surāsurāścidacido dravyaguṇakriyādikāḥ ||23|| vedā vidyāśca tīrthāni tattvāni dharmavistarāḥ | tāvanta eva khanijāḥ sarvasvarganivāsijaḥ ||24|| vivarasthāśca miśrasthā vyatiriktāstathānvitāḥ | parabrahmamayāḥ sarve triguṇāstatra cāyayuḥ ||25|| sarvasṛṣṭinivāsānāṃ darśanaṃ durlabhaṃ tu yat | makhe’tra sulabhaṃ tadvai nārāyaṇakṛpāvaśāt ||26|| kiṃ vaktavyaṃ tadā rādhe’nyathākartā haristadā | kartākartāpi siddhaḥ sa nānyaśaktistu tādṛśī ||27|| cumbyante sarvasāmagryo yādṛśaṃ cumbakaṃ bhavet | cumbako’tra parabrahma sarvākṛṣṭiḥ kathaṃ na vai ||28|| varṇayituṃ na śaknomi yathākṛṣṭāḥ prajā makhe | ataḥ pūrvaṃ mayākṛṣṭā na dṛṣṭā vai makhāntare ||29|| utsavātte samāyānti kīrtanairvādyanartanaiḥ | vadantaśca parabrahmāmantrayatyeva no’pyaho ||2.168.3 0 || evaṃ vai gamyamāneṣu sarveṣu ca samantataḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prasthānamācarat ||3 1|| ṛṣibhirmunibhiḥ sākaṃ kṣetrapālādibhistathā | tīrthaiḥ saurāṣṭradeśīyaiḥ prajājanaiḥ kuṭumbibhiḥ ||32|| brahmapriyābhiḥ sarvābhiḥ koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyakaiḥ | bhaktaistathā kuṭumbena sahārohad vimānakam || 33 || vimāneṣu sahasreṣu tathānyā bhaktakoṭayaḥ | ārohan vyomamārgeṇa jayanādān pracakrire ||34|| sādhavaśca tathā siddhāḥ satyo’nvīyustadā harim | ākāśaṃ vyanadat sarvaṃ vimānavādyagarjanaiḥ ||35|| agre vedā mūrtimantaḥ prayānti mantrighoṣiṇaḥ | vetradharyaḥ śāradādyā gāyanti guṇakīrtanam || 36|| devavādyavimānāni kavayo yānti vai tataḥ | niśānadhvajaḍaṃkādyāstato yānti jayadhvanāḥ ||37|| tato muktāstataḥ patnyo brahmapriyā asaṃkhyakāḥ | tato vimānaṃ kṛṣṇasya tataśca rakṣiṇo janāḥ ||38|| pārṣadāśca tataḥ sarve prajāstataḥ surāṣṭrajāḥ | kṣetrapālāḥ sarvapaścāḥ samāyānti makhe tadā ||39|| himālayaḥ svayaṃ yadvad gagane kiṃ pragacchati | svargaṃ vā svayamāgatya kṣityuttare pragacchati ||2.168.40 || sāgarā ratnaśobhāḍhyā yānti vā nākameva kim | ityevaṃ darśanaṃ vyomni kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ||41 || prasthānasārthayānasyābhavattadā vilakṣaṇam | tṛtīyāyā dine madhyāhnottaraṃ bhagavān svayam ||42|| ghaṭikāsu daśasveva vyatītāsu makhāmbaram | prāpa tadā jayadhvānāntarīkṣe khe sthale’bhavan ||43|| arbudārbudakoṭyaśca darśakānāṃ viniryayuḥ | ākāśaṃ tejasā vyāptaṃ vilakṣaṇena cābhavat ||44|| sūryavahnayādayo yatra vilīnā naiva gocarāḥ | lokānāṃ darśanayogyānyāsan naitrāṇi vai tadā ||45|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya kṛpayaiva ha | śrīharestejasā sarve tejomayaṃ hyabhūttadā ||46|| api kṛṣṇāḥ śilāḥ sarvā bhāsante maṇayo yathā | api kṛṣṇaṃ bhūtalaṃ tu candrojjvalamabhūttadā ||47|| api romāṇi keśāśca svarṇavarṇāstadābhavan | api kākā bhramarāśca haṃsā iva ca kokilāḥ ||48|| api nīlaṃ tadā vyomābhavaccāndraṃ talaṃ yathā | apyāntarāṇi lokānāmabhavan brahmabhāni tu ||49|| bhautikaṃ tu tadā divyaṃ yāvattvakṣaravaddhyabhūt | svargabhūvyomatattvānāṃ bhedo’pi vilayaṃ gataḥ ||2.168.50 || saptarūpāṇi sarvāṇi śvetavarṇāni cābhavan | māyāyāstāmaso rakto bhāvo’pi sattvatāṃ yayau ||51|| api sarvāśca sāmagryo brahmamayyastadābhavan | brahmabhavanatulyāśca tadā grāmā gṛhāṇi ca ||52|| sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ cābhūd bālakṛṣṇasya tejasā | divyopahārapūjādyaiḥ prajā nṛpā maharṣayaḥ ||53 || rādhike
