svāgatārthaṃ copatasthire samutsukāḥ | jayanādān prakurvantaścitrayantaḥ pratikṛtīḥ ||54|| sāñjalayaḥ sārhaṇāśca sabhāvāḥ snehilānanāḥ | praphullanetrapadmāśca premabharāntarāstathā ||55|| nāryaḥ kukṣau dhṛtabālā narāścyutaśirodhṛtāḥ | ūrdhvalagnavṛttayaścottānānanāstadābhavan ||56|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān prabhuḥ | tirobhāvayadugraṃ tattejo’mbarādavātaran ||57|| sarvadṛśyo’bhavaccāpi sthūladṛśyo’bhavat prabhuḥ | ambarāt suramuktānāṃ puṣpavṛṣṭistadābhavat ||58|| candanānāṃ śubhā vṛṣṭiścākṣatānāṃ tathābhavat | svarṇarūpyakahīrāṇāṃ vṛṣṭistadāmbarādabhūt ||59|| klṛptagopurasopānaiḥ śanaiḥ kṛṣṇo hyavātarat | caturdantārjunahastiyāne kṛṣṇaṃ nyaṣādayat ||2.168.6 0|| nṛpāḥ sarve svarṇaratnahārān gucchān samārpayan | nemuśca daṇḍavat devyo rājñyaḥ kanyā vyavardhayan ||61 || bhagavantaṃ tvakṣatādyaiścāṃkuraiścandanaiḥ sumaiḥ | netrapuṭākhyakamalairduḥkhahāñjalibhirmuhuḥ ||62|| śāṭīprāntaistathā copasthānaiḥ svastikahastakaiḥ | hṛdayaiḥ premabhāvaiśca namanaistamavardhayan ||63|| jayaśabdaiśca lājābhiḥ kusumaistīrthavāribhiḥ || avardhayan hariṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prajāḥ ||64|| vyajanaiścāmaraiśchatraiḥ sugandhiśītalairjalaiḥ | gandhasārānvitaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ śreṣṭhino sukhayan mudā||65|| nārikelaiḥ śarkarābhiḥ kuṃkumābīralālakaiḥ | māṃgalikaphalādyaiśca bālakṛṣṇaṃ vyavardhayan ||66|| svarṇarathe śatacakre divyasiṃhāsane prabhuḥ | rājamānaśca gṛhṇāti janārpitopadāstadā ||67|| kāṃścid dṛṣṭyā netrakoṇaiḥ smitairhastaiśca kena ca | bhāvaistu vividhaiḥ kṛṣṇo mānayāmāsa vai prajāḥ ||68|| sarvebhyo hāsavadanairbahurūpaistadā hariḥ | samantato dadau naijaṃ darśanaṃ kṛpayā ciram ||69|| yathā cāgre tathā paśce yathā pārśve tathordhvake | tathaiva sarvanetreṣu hṛdayeṣvapyadṛśyata ||2.168.70|| kebhyaściddhārapuṣpāṇi dadātyeva prasādataḥ | kebhyaściddhīrakān mauktikādīn ratnāni gucchakān ||71 || dadātyeva mahārājaḥ prāsādikān pareśvaraḥ | phalāni tāmbūlakāni pūgyādīni dadāti ca ||72|| nārikelāni vastrāṇi pūjāyāmāgatāni ca | svāgatārthopadātmāni prāsādīni dadāti vai ||73 || śatakrośeṣu sarvatra datvā svadarśanaṃ hariḥ | gajayānena vai rātrau nivāsālayamāyayau ||74|| jalapānādikaṃ cakruḥ sarve sārthāśca bhojanam | dattālayeṣu yogyeṣu viśaśramuśca vai tataḥ ||75|| sakuṭumbo hariścāpi brahmapriyāsamanvitaḥ | ṣaḍyukcatvāriṃśadūrdhvaṃ śatayuk bubhuje svayam ||76 || papau śāntiṃ jagāmātha nidrāṃ yogamayīmapi | āprātaścāpi jagrāha dāsadāsīprasevitaḥ ||77|| rātrau sthale sthale tatra babhūvuḥ kīrtanāni tu | kathāḥ prāgvṛttamiśrāśca saṃpracakrurmaharṣayaḥ ||78|| cāraṇā vaṃśavistārān itivṛttajuṣastadā | itihāsān jagaduśca samāje bhūbhṛtāṃ tadā ||79 || sādhavo jñānavārtāśca cakrurmokṣavidhipradāḥ | nāryo gāyanti rāgādyairgītikāḥ kṛṣṇamānasāḥ ||2.168.80 || kanyakā rāsamābadhya bhramanti vartulāni ca | gāyanti tālikādhvānairnupūraghurghurīgataiḥ ||8 1|| nartakyo nartanaṃ raṃge kurvanti dhanisaṃkule | vādyakā vādyakuśalā vādayanti ramanti ca ||82|| naṭā nāṭyaṃ prakurvanti darśayanti ca pāṭavam | kavayo racanāvyāptā dṛśyante śaṃsinastadā ||83|| mallāḥ kurvanti yuddhāni lokarañjanakāni ca | pradarśanāni dṛśyante sṛṣṭisṛṣṭyantarāṇi ca ||84|| indrajālāni lokyante racitāni suvedibhiḥ | hāsyaśālāsu hāsyāni narmāṇi ca bhavantyapi ||85|| prakāśyante vahnicūrṇairvidyudagnisuśilpibhiḥ | vahnāvākārarūpāṇi cāmbare garjanāni ca ||86|| khelanāni vahniyogaiḥ kṣipyante tvambare’pi ca | bhavanti garjanā vyomni prasphoṭadravyacitratā ||87|| bahurūpadharāścāddi rūpyante kauśalairnijaiḥ | bhaṇḍakā veṣakāścāpi rañjayanti prajāstadā ||88|| vṛṣabhāṇāṃ mahiṣāṇāṃ rāṇḍiyānāṃ pragarviṇām | kariṇāṃ bhallukānāṃ vānarāṇāṃ yodhanāni ca ||89|| rātrāvutsavarūpeṇābhavam̐stadā tu rādhike | dvandvavādyānyavādyanta tūpaśabdāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||2.168.90|| ajāyanta murādīnāṃ vipañcīnāṃ svarāstadā | apsarasāṃ kanyakānāṃ gītayaḥ sarvato’bhavan ||91|| vaidikā dhvanayastatrārṣāṇāmapyabhavan kṣitau | napuṃsakānāṃ narmāṇi puttalīkhelanāni ca || 92|| gāruḍīnāṃ ca vidyānāṃ prayogāśca tadābhavan | kalpajālasya racanā vividhāśca kvacitsthale ||93|| rāse kṛṣṇakṛtā līlā gopījanavibhūṣitāḥ | kutraciccābhavam̐statra bhaktibhedairmanogamāḥ ||94|| rāmādityanarādityalīlāścāpi kvacitsthale | bālakṛṣṇacamatkārāḥ kvacitkurvanti tadvidaḥ ||95 || evaṃ rātrau tadā rādhe janānāṃ bhūmivāsinām | tathānyeṣāṃ yatheṣṭānyāsannānandotsavāni vai ||96|| śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasya tathā śrīkambharāśriyaḥ | yaśogānāni yoṣitsu sarvasthale tadābhavan ||97|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ surāṣṭaṃ cājanābhigam | tadā gītiṣu sarvāsāṃ dhanyavādena śasyate ||98|| gāṃgeyāstu tadā bālā bālikā bhūbhṛtastathā | ṛṣayo brahmabhaktāśca praśasyante ca gītiṣu ||99|| dvinadīsaṃgamaścāpi tīrthaṃ sudarśanaṃ tathā | yajñatīrthaṃ śatakrośaṃ śasyante rādhike’bhitaḥ || 2.168.10 0|| evaṃ tṛtīyarātriḥ sā vyatīyāya sukhocchrayā | prātarjātaṃ caturthyāstu kṛṣṇo nidrāṃ jahāti ca || 10 1|| maṃgalāni ca turyāṇi hyavādyanta samantataḥ | agāyanta yaśovārtāḥ sūtamāgadhabandayaḥ || 1 02|| rādhike śrīharirnidrāṃ tatyāja maṃgalaśravāḥ | unnidraṃ sarvataḥ kṣetraṃ cābhūt krośaśatāntaram || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne yajñamaṃgalapatrikāprakāśanaṃ sarvasṛṣṭivāsināmāgamanaṃ śrīhareḥ sakuṭumbasaurāṣṭrīyaprajāsahitasya vimānairyajñabhūmigamanaṃ svāgataṃ bhramaṇaṃ viśrāntirmanorañjanādīni cetinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 168 ||
<2.169> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike prātarutthāya bhagavān snānamācarat | dhyānaṃ japaṃ tathā homaṃ svādhyāyaṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā || 1 || pūjanaṃ nijarūpasya pitṛdarśanavandanam | sādhūnāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca darśanaṃ cākarottataḥ || 2 || dugdhāmṛtaṃ manāk pītvā yajñabhūmyavalokanam | kartuṃ kariṇamāruhya niryayau sa nijālayāt || 3 || sapakṣahastī vyomnaivāsañcarat sarvabhūmiṣu | vyalokayacchubhāṃ bhūmiṃ sudarśanaṃ pragṛhya ca || 4 || līnaṃ prakāśitaṃ jātaṃ yatra tatraiva vedikām | viśvakarmakṛtāṃ vīkṣya prasannaḥ sthānamāyayau || 5 || praśaśaṃsa hariśceśānaṃ devaṃ sarvadṛṣṭikam | bhaktaṃ devāyanaṃ viśvakarmāṇaṃ kapilādikān || 6 || devaguruṃ gaṇeśādīn praśaśaṃsa tadā hariḥ | sāmagrīdāyakān sarvān dāsān dāsīśca koṭiśaḥ || 7 || sarvabhūpālakām̐ścāpi praśaśaṃsa haristadā | sarvatattvāni bhagavān praśaśaṃsa muhurmuhuḥ| || 8 || rājānaḥ ṛṣayaḥ satyaḥ sādhavaḥ pārṣadādayaḥ | vrahmapriyādyāśca tataścakruḥ pūjāṃ harestadā || 9 || lomaśādīn harirnatvā viśrāntiṃ mandire’labhat | prātaḥ peyāni bhojyāni sarvebhyo’dāpayat prabhuḥ || 2.169.10|| rasaśālāḥ pravartante dīyante bhojanāni ca | yathāyogyāni ceṣṭāni sarvebhyaḥ pūrṇatṛptaye || 11 || prātarārabhya vai bhakṣyaṃ peyaṃ cānyadapekṣitam | sātatyena pravāheṇa dīyate cāniśāmukham || 1 2|| yathā yāni tu tattvāni varṣmāṇi yādṛśāni ca | yādṛśaṃ pathyameteṣāṃ tādṛg dadati vallikāḥ || 1 3|| maṇayo dhenavaścāpi vṛkṣāśca kalpacintanāḥ | muktā muktānya evāpi siddhayaḥ śrīramādayaḥ || 14|| brāhmyaḥ suśaktayo’nantā aiśvaryāṇi guṇāstathā | arpayanti samastebhyo’pekṣyabhojyāni vai tadā || 15|| pratimandirametebhyaḥ prāpayantīṣṭabhojyakam | yadyadapekṣitaṃ sarvaṃ tvadhikaṃ prāpayanti hi || 16|| tvaṃ rādhe’marṣamāpannā dṛṣṭvā gāṃgeyagauravam | kinna smarasi śāntā ca mayā tvaṃ sunayaiḥ kṛtā || 17|| bhojitā vanditā tvaṃ tu gaṃgayā pādavāhitā | śṛṃgāritā kavaryā ca prasannā tvaṃ tadā hyabhūḥ || 18|| caturthyāṃ rādhike tatra prāghūṇikā viśeṣataḥ | samāyayurvimānaiśca koṭiśo mānavā dine || 19 || rāśiyānapradeśebhyo ṣoḍaśalakṣamānavāḥ | prāgjyotirdeśato lakṣamānavāścāyayustadā ||2.169.20|| prācīnadeśataścāpi daśalakṣāṇi cāyayuḥ | brahmadeśāllakṣajanā uṣṭrālayācca lakṣakam || 21 || ājanābhāt koṭijanā abriktāt koṭiśo janāḥ | āraktāllakṣajanatāścottarādapi cāyayuḥ ||22|| mānavānāṃ koṭicatuṣṭayaṃ tatrābhavattadā | tadanyānāṃ tu lokānāṃ sṛṣṭitrayanivāsinām ||23|| āgatānāṃ dehināṃ tu saṃkhyāsaṃkhyā na vidyate | mahīmānālayā bhūmau jale’nile’ntarīkṣake ||24|| meghe girau ca vivare’mbare tattveṣu sarvaśaḥ | racitāścābhavan viśvakarmaṇā sūkṣmadarśinā ||25|| siddhimantastadā cāṇūbhūya miśrīprabhūya ca | līnībhūyāpi yajñe’tra tiṣṭhanti harimānasaḥ |||26|| pare brahmaṇi sarveṣāṃ tvakṣare cāpi dhāmani | āntarabhāvavāsena samāveśo’bhavattadā ||27|| mamuḥ sarve pare dhāmnyakṣare sākṣādvirājite | āścaryaṃ nāsti rādhe’tra sarvāśrayo yato hariḥ ||28|| aṇudeśe sarvasṛṣṭīḥ samāveśayituṃ kṣamaḥ | svalpe sthale viśālatvaṃ pradarśayitumarhati ||29|| tatkṛtyantaṃ na vinde’haṃ ko’nyo jñātuṃ tadārhati | aṇau sṛṣṭīḥ kṣaṇe kalpān darśayituṃ sa cārhati ||2.169.3 0|| jalagaṇḍūṣamātreṇa tarpayituṃ trilokajān | kaṇabhakṣaṇamātreṇa tṛptiṃ dātuṃ sa cārhati ||3 1|| asaṃbhāvyaṃ tathātarkyaṃ tathāśakyaṃ na mādhave | yanmūrteḥ sarvamevedaṃ samabhūt cekṣaṇātpurā ||32|| yatsaṃkalpātpunarhrāsaṃ cānte tatraiva yāsyati | ko’haṃ kā tvaṃ tathā cānye nārāyaṇāścaturbhujāḥ ||33|| tadagre śaktimanto vai yanmūrterabhavāma ha | alaṃ cātivacobhiśca sarvādhāro harirhi saḥ ||34|| sarvānakarot sukhino makhe saṃbhāvanādibhiḥ | atha śrībālakṛṣṇo’sau caturthyāṃ madhyage ravau ||35|| mantrān dadau nṛpebhyaśca janatābhyaśca maṇḍape | koṭirūpadharo bālakṛṣṇaḥ sarvatra so’bhavat || 36 || pratyāśrayaṃ tadā vṛṣyāṃ kuśajāyāṃ niṣadya ca | sajalaṃ bhaktakarṇeṣu mantrānaśrāvayat prabhuḥ ||37|| śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mama sarvadā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 38|| kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt | śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava || 3 9|| brahmāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto’smi śāśvataḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me ||2.169.40|| bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ | pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako’stu saḥ ||41 || śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svāmī me’yaṃ patirhi me | evaṃ śaraṇamantraṃ cārpaṇamantraṃ ca rakṣakam ||42|| manuṃ ca brahmabhāvaṃ ca mantraṃ svāmyanivedakam | sarvasvaṃ ca manuṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||43 || yathādhikāraṃ saṃvīkṣyābālavṛddhanarīnarān | kṛtārthān śrāvayāmāsa cakāra mānavān bahūn ||44|| tato vai bhojanaṃ cakrurdīkṣitāśca harirjanāḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākhyānaṃ sāyameva vai | lomaśaḥ pracakārātha cakre nīrājanaṃ hareḥ ||45 || jāyante cotsavāstatra rātrau tu bhojanottaram | sarveṣāṃ sukhadā rādhe’pararātre viśaśramuḥ ||46|| pañcamyāṃ ca prage brāhme muhūrte śrīhariḥ svayam | sasnau tu saṃgame nadyoḥ sarve sasnustataḥ param ||47|| nityavidhīn vidhāyātha kṛtvā devārhaṇādikam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yajñamaṇḍapaṃ śīghramāyayau ||48|| rājānaśca prajāḥ sarve ṛṣayo munayastathā | karmacārāḥ ṛtvijaśca jāpakādyāḥ samāyayuḥ ||49|| vāditrāṇāṃ ninādāśca tadābhavan susūcakāḥ | adhvarasya kriyākāṇḍaṃ kurvantu bhūsurā iti ||2.169.50 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścājijñapad dvijān | viprādyā maṃgalaṃ cakrarvedamantraiḥ prasusvaram ||51|| ācāryo lomaśastatra deśakālāvakīrtayat | gaṇeśasmaraṇaṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||52|| ācāryavaraṇaṃ cakre natvā śrīlomaśaṃ gurum | prakoṣṭhe bandhanaṃ cakre cakre cāvāhanaṃ kṣiteḥ ||53 || pañcagavyakuśairbhūmeḥ prokṣaṇaṃ pracakāra ha | bhūtādyapakramārthaṃ ca prākṣipat śvetasarṣapān ||54|| evaṃ bhūmiṃ pūjayitvā prāyaścittaṃ cakāra ha | ācamanaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ kṛtvā cakre prapūjanam ||55|| svātmakasya gaṇeśasya ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ | puṇyāhavācanaṃ cakre kalaśasthāpanaṃ tathā ||56|| āśīrvādān dadustatra brāhmaṇā vedavedinaḥ | śāntipāṭhāñjagurvārisekaṃ cakrustadā dvijāḥ ||57|| svastivāco jaguścāpi cakruḥ kṛṣṇābhisecanam | mātṛkāpūjanaṃ cakrurnāndīśrāddhaṃ pracakrire ||58|| tadaṃgadakṣiṇādānaṃ cakāra parameśvaraḥ | pratyekācāryavaraṇaṃ brahmavaraṇamityapi ||59||| ṛtvijāṃ varaṇaṃ dvārapālavaraṇamityapi | jāpakānāṃ varaṇaṃ ca cakre pupūja tām̐stataḥ ||2.169.60|| tataḥ pṛthivīṃ sampūjya cakre digrakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ | samprokṣya yajñasāmagrīḥ svastimantrān jagāda ha ||61 || maṇḍapapūjanaṃ vāstupūjanaṃ pracakāra ha | vāstudevārhaṇaṃ sarvaṃ vidhinā pracakāra ha ||62|| kalaśasthāpanaṃ cakre phalauṣadhimṛdārpaṇam | darbhapavitradānaṃ ca tīrthāvāhanamityapi ||63|| athāgnyuttāraṇa cakre sarvadevān pupūja ca | prāṇapratiṣṭhāmantrāṃśca jagāda parameśvaraḥ ||64|| yoginīkṣetrapālām̐śca pupūja vidhinā hariḥ | pīṭhadevārhaṇaṃ cakre baliṃ dadau nanāma ca ||65|| maṇḍapasyārhaṇaṃ cakre brahmapūjāṃ cakāra ha | tathā maṇḍapadevānāmarhaṇaṃ pracakāra ca ||66|| ṣoḍaśādistambhapūjāṃ bahirdevādipūjanam | śākhādevaprapūjāṃ ca dhvajānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ||67|| sarvakalaśapūjāṃ ca vedapūjāṃ cakāra ha | vedīkuṇḍeṣu sarveṣu kuṇḍapūjāṃ cakāra ca ||68|| kuṇḍamadhye viśvakarmapūjanaṃ pracakāra saḥ | mekhalāpūjanaṃ tatra devānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ||69|| yonipūjāṃ kaṇṭhapūjāṃ nābhipūjāṃ cakāra saḥ | vāstupūruṣapūjāṃ ca vahnisthāpanamācarat ||2.169.70|| navagrahārhaṇaṃ cādhidevatārhaṇamācarat | pratyadhidevatāpūjāṃ nāgapūjāṃ samācarat ||7 1 || lokapālārhaṇaṃ cakre gaṇeśabhūtapūjanam | dikpālapūjanaṃ cakre śrīdevīpūjanaṃ tathā ||72|| maṇḍalasthāpitadevārhaṇaṃ cakre haristathā | kalaśārhaṇamevāpi ṣaṭpañcāśatsurārhaṇam 73|| ṛṣīṇāṃ pūjanaṃ pitṛpūjanaṃ siddhapūjanam | mṛtyukālārhaṇaṃ cakre saritsāgarapūjanam ||74|| śailāyudhārhaṇaṃ cakre ārṣīdevīprapūjanam | kalaśasthāpanaṃ kṛtvā varuṇārhaṇamācarat ||75|| caturviṃśatyavatārān vāsudevādikānapi | īśvarān tatsatīḥ sādhvī sarvāśca harirārcayat ||76|| tridevapārṣadān sarvān sarvadhāmanivāsinaḥ | brahmasṛṣṭimayān sarvān īśasṛṣṭimayānapi ||77|| jīvasṛṣṭimayān sarvān śrīkṛṣṇaḥ samapūjayat| | caturdaśasu lokeṣu ye vasanti tu dehinaḥ ||78|| jaḍān divyān cetanām̐śca gurūn dāsīśca dāsakān | catuḥkhaniṣu cotpannān sarvān kṛṣṇo hyapūjayat ||79|| pratikuṇḍaṃ ca rājānastathā cakruḥ prapūjanam | tattanmaharṣiguruṇā yathoddiṣṭaṃ tathā vyadhuḥ ||2.169.80|| dravyatyāgaṃ kuṇḍavahnau cakāra parameśvaraḥ | prokṣaṇīprokṣaṇaṃ cakre tathājyahavanaṃ vyadhāt| ||8 1 || caruṃ tvagnau samāropya tathāvasthāpya tatsthale | samidho havanaṃ cakre sruveṇājyāhutīrdadau ||82|| svāhā devāyāmukāyetyevaṃ homaṃ cakāra saḥ | brahmasṛṣṭīśvarasṛṣṭijīvasṛṣṭibhya eva ca ||83|| yajñadevebhya evāpi bahvāhutīrdadau prabhuḥ | kuṇḍamaṇḍapavāstūnāṃ devatābhyo havaṃ dadau | satīsādhvīsevikāśaktibhyaḥ kṛṣṇo havaṃ dadau ||84|| yoginībhyaśca muktābhyo brahmapriyābhya ityapi | sarvāṃgavyāpinībhyaḥ siddhibhyaḥ kṛṣṇo havaṃ dadau ||85|| ādityavasurudrāśvikumārebhyo havaṃ dadau | avatārasahitāya nijāya cāhutīrdadau ||86|| carvāhutīrdadau cāmṛtātmikāstṛptaye hariḥ | yūpāropaṃ tataścakre yūpadevānapūjayat ||87|| yūpamasiñcayaccāpi baliṃ yūpāya vai dadau | nidrākalaśapūjāṃ ca prākārayaddharistataḥ ||88|| āmantritān jīvajātān yajñe bhāgaṃ harirdadau | pāyasānnaṃ ghṛtaṃ dugdhaṃ phalāni ca rasān dadau ||89|| yathā yathā makhe vahnau sahasrāyutadhārikāḥ | patantyāhutayo havyātmikāstathā tathābhitaḥ ||2.169.90|| sarve jīvāstṛptimanto jāyante haryanugrahāt | vrīhayaśca yavā nivārādyā munyannakāni ca ||9 1|| kharjurā rasavantaśca kaṇā miṣṭarasānvitāḥ | oṣadhayaśca samidhaḥ phalāni rasavanti ca ||92|| śarkarādyāstathā miṣṭānnāni cāhutayo’bhavan | vahnayaḥ sarvajātīyāścāgatya tṛptimāvahan ||93|| agnimukhā dehinaśca ye’nye brahmamukhāstathā | kṛṣṇamukhāstathā sarve sādhumukhāstathāpare || 94|| satīmukhyo devikāmukhyaśca yāḥ śaktayastathā | svāhāmukhyaśca yā lakṣmīśrīmukhyaśca tathāparāḥ ||95|| annapūrṇānanā yāśca sarvāstāstṛptimāvahan | jaḍacetanatattvāni tṛptāni vividhairhavaiḥ ||96|| pūrṇāhutiṃ dadau paścādārārtrikaṃ tato’karot | sarvadevādisattvānāṃ viśrāntiṃ pradadau tataḥ ||97|| evaṃ vai saptaviṃśatyātmakeṣu kuṇḍakeṣu ca | sarvatra ṛṣibhiḥ pūjābalidānahavāḥ kṛtāḥ ||98|| rājabhiryugalaiścāpi havanecchāyutaistathā | gṛhīto havalābhaśca bālakṛṣṇājñayā makhe ||99|| dakṣiṇāḥ pratipūjāyāṃ bhūyasyo’rpyanta eva ca | phalāhārā rasāhārā annāhārā hyatipriyāḥ || 2.169.100|| dīyante sarvajantubhyaḥ svasvāhārāstu śārṅgiṇā | kalpacintāmaṇijanyā dīyante bhakṣyasadrasāḥ || 101 || evaṃ nirvartitaṃ ramyaṃ pañcamīhavanaṃ śubham | tataḥ sarvānabjakoṭyarbudapadmādisaṃkhyakān || 1 02|| muktān dhāmāni muktānīścāvatārām̐śca tatpriyāḥ | pārṣadān pārṣadānīśca bhojayāmāsa cāmṛtān ||1 03 || miṣṭānnāni ca divyāni peyānyanantakāni ca | bhakṣyabhojyāni sarvāṇi lehyānyapi śubhāni ca || 1 04|| brahmapriyāstathā bhaktāḥ satīḥ sādhvīrharipriyāḥ | bhojayāmāsa bhagavān kanyakā bahusaṃkhyakāḥ || 1 05|| īśvarānīśvarāṇīśca māyāṃ māyākuṭumbakam | caturviṃśatitattvāni bhojayāmāsa mādhavaḥ || 1 06|| aṣṭāvaraṇalokasthān brahmeśaviṣṇusevakān | tridevadāsadāsīśca bhojayāmāsa mādhavaḥ || 1 07|| tridevadevikāḥ sarvā brahmacaryādhikanyakāḥ| devīḥ kumārikā yoginīḥ sāṃkhyayoginīḥ satīḥ || 1 08|| sarvāḥ saṃbhojayāmāsa vrataikādaśikādikāḥ | tithirūpān devikānāṃ gaṇānapsarasastathā || 1 09|| sarvāḥ saṃbhojayāmāsa bhagavān kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | merusthān satyalokasthān maharjanatapaḥsthitān || 2.169.11 0|| ṛṣīn pitṝn tathārṣīśca pitṛkā mātṛkāstathā | svaḥsthān devān devikāśca bhuvarlokasthitām̐stathā || 11 1|| bhūsthānnarān nārīvargān jarāyujāṇḍajām̐stathā | svedajānudbhitprajātān bhojayāmāsa mādhavaḥ || 11 2|| tīrthānyaraṇyasaritaḥ parvatān sāgarādikān | api kīṭapataṃgādyān bhojayāmāsa mādhavaḥ || 11 3|| brahmaputrān rājasāṃśca tāmasān sarvajātikān | dharmādharmaprajātām̐śca kāśyapān sūryacandrajān || 1 14|| pātālasthān rākṣasām̐śca yakṣān gandharvakinnarān | saptatalino bhūtām̐śca pretān yamālayasthitān || 11 5|| kiṃpuṃso māgadhān sūtān bandijanānabhojayat | cāraṇān śūdrajātīyān vidyādhrān vanavāsinaḥ || 1 16|| krūrān sattvān ḍākinīśca śākinīśca tathāparāḥ | cāṇḍālān śvapacān paśūn bhojayāmāsa mādhavaḥ || 1 17|| sarpānnāgān pakṣigaṇān kuṣmāṇḍān pravināyakān | daityān devānāsurām̐śca bhojayāmāsa mādhavaḥ || 1 18|| jaḍaṃ ca cetanaṃ sarvam ādhārādheyamiśritam | bubhuje yajñabhāgaṃ vai kratoḥ prāsādikaṃ śubham || 11 9|| sarvaṃ trisṛṣṭijaṃ nityamanityaṃ sthirajaṃgamam | bhuktvā yajñaprasādaṃ sutṛptimāpa hi śāśvatīm || 2.169.1 20|| rādhādyā me priyāḥ sarvāstṛptimāptā prasādajām | ityevaṃ rādhike yajñakāryaṃ cādyadine’bhavat || 121 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne yajñe bhūmipūjanaṃ vāstukuṇḍamaṇḍapādidevānāṃ pūjanaṃ brahmasṛṣṭīśvarasṛṣṭijīvasṛṣṭidehināṃ pūjanaṃ havanaṃ mahāpūrṇāhutidānaṃ bhojanadānaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 169||
<2.170> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike’tha tathā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ saptamyāmaṣṭamītithau | navamyāṃ ca daśamyāṃ ca tarpitā hariṇā makhe || 1 || ekādaśyāṃ tarpitāśca yāvadbhirvidhibhistathā | sarve vai dehino’dehāḥ sthūlasūkṣmā hi nāminaḥ || 2 || jaḍāścetanajātāśca dravyākhyāśca guṇābhidhāḥ | karmābhidhāśca taddevāstattattattveśvarādayaḥ || 3 || sarvalokanivāsāśca sarve kuṭumbinastathā | sthāvarā jaṃgamā nāryo narāḥ ṣaṇḍhāśca tarpitāḥ || 4 || abhidheyaṃ na vai kiñcid bhojane hyavaśiṣyate | evaṃ sarveṣṭiyajño’yaṃ vaiṣṇavo hariṇā kṛtaḥ || 5 || saptāhe nityamāyānti lokalokanivāsinaḥ | kṛtvā ca darśanaṃ yānti koṭyarbudā narāḥ striyaḥ || 6 || gagane tu vimānānāṃ sāṃkulyaṃ na nivartate | yāvanto gagane santi surāḥ svargādivāsinaḥ || 7 || tāvanto mānavā bhūmau tāvantaḥ parvatādiṣu | tāvanta eva vṛkṣeṣu tāvantaśca nadīṣu ca || 8 || naukāsu taṭabhūmyādau tāvantaḥ santi mānavāḥ | maṇḍapeṣu ca śālāsu saudheṣu gahvareṣvapi || 9 || kuṃjeṣu ca śakaṭyadau tāvanto vāhaneṣvapi | mānavā mānavā yatra tatra lokayanta eva tu || 2.170.1 0|| dhāmadhāmanivāsāśca lokyante tatra tatra ca | lokālokanivāsāśca dṛśyante tatra tatra ca || 11 || talastaranivāsāśca lokyante sarvatastadā | saptāhe cādhvare nityāgamavṛddhirvilokyate || 1 2|| svarṇarūpyakahīrāṇāṃ ratnānāṃ bhūṣaṇātmanām | maṇīnāṃ sarvakāntānāṃ kalpānāṃ śṛṃgiṇo’bhavan || 1 3|| upadāparvatā jātā yānavāhanakoṭayaḥ | vastravaibhavabhakṣyāṇāṃ bhogānāṃ śailapaṃktayaḥ || 14|| mauktikānāṃ śikharāṇi miṣṭānnānāṃ tu parvatāḥ | bhogyopakaraṇānāṃ tu śailagaṃjāstadābhavan || 15|| peyānāṃ saritaścāsan gavyānāṃ vārdhayo’bhavan | śevadhayaśca dravyāṇāṃ cāsan makhe samarpitāḥ || 1 6|| kubero vasavaścendro merurbṛhaspatistathā | viṣṇurvīkṣyādhvararddhīśca babhūvurlajjayā natāḥ || 17|| annapūrṇā mahimānaṃ vilokya pārameśvaram | lakṣmīḥ śrīścātra namrā babhūvaturlajjayādhvare || 18|| aprameyamatarkyaṃ cānupasthitamacintyakam | yadyadicchati tattvajñastattadaivopatiṣṭhati || 1 9|| pratāpo’yaṃ harestatra bālakṛṣṇasya rādhike | andhakuṣṭhidaridrāṇāṃ vyaṃgānāṃ duḥkhināmapi ||2.170.20|| āndhyaṃ kuṣṭhaśca dāridryaṃ vyaṃgatā vilayaṃ gatā | aniṣṭaṃ nāśamāpannaṃ tadeṣṭaṃ prāptameva tu || 21|| svargavat sarvamevābhūt makhe’tra pārameśvare | siddhayo’pi vilokyaitadāścaryaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ ||22|| aiśvaryāṇi samastāni lajjānamrāṇi cābhavan | māyāpi mohamāpannā camatkāre harestadā ||23|| bālakṛṣṇaṃ vīkṣituṃ vai koṭyarbudābjamānavāḥ | samāyānti cānuvelaṃ sammardo jāyate bahuḥ ||24|| nirāśatāṃ tadā yānti janā darśanalālasāḥ | teṣāṃ bhāvaṃ paraṃ jñātvā vijñāyāgamanaśramam ||25|| hatāśatāṃ parijñāya bhaktavātsalyavān prabhuḥ | antarātmā ca tatraiva bhaktāgre gocaro’bhitaḥ ||26 || netrāgre koṭirūpaiśca sthale sthale vilokyate | yādṛśo maṇḍape cāste homāsane ca yādṛśaḥ ||27|| tādṛśaścānyakuṇḍāgre havanāsanakeṣu ca | tādṛśo’saṃkhyasaudheṣu maṇḍapeṣu ca tādṛśaḥ || 28|| nadīkūleṣu naukāsu yāneṣvapi ca tādṛśaḥ | vimāneṣu ca vṛkṣeṣu vane’raṇyeṣu tādṛśaḥ || 29|| bhakteṣu bhaktavṛndeṣu mārgeṣu vīthikādiṣu | śālāsu candraśālāsu pākaśālāsu tādṛśaḥ ||2.170.3 0|| mahīmānanivāseṣu cātithisthānakeṣvapi | bhojyaśālāsu śaileṣu vāṭikāsvapi tādṛśaḥ ||3 1 || ratheṣu śakaṭībhāgeṣvapi cāśvagajādiṣu | dṛśyeṣu raṃganāṭyeṣu gahvareṣvapi tādṛśaḥ ||3 2|| jale sthale’mbare vārdhau sarassu ca nadīṣvapi | vigameṣu ca durgeṣu hariḥ sarvatra dṛśyate || 2 3|| mandahāsyānanaḥ śubhraḥ sarvabhūṣāvibhūṣitaḥ | pītavastradharaḥ saumyo bālakṛṣṇo vilokyate ||34|| divyacihnadharaḥ svāmī dhanurdhvajatriśūlavān | mīnasvastikacakrādyaiḥ śobhitaḥ sa vilokyate || 35|| nīlacañcadvakrakeśaḥ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇaḥ | kaustubhaśrīśobhitoraḥsthalo lakṣmīprasevitaḥ || 36 || koṭyarkabhādharaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vilokyate | evaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇasya darśanaṃ sarvatodiśam ||37|| bhāvukānāṃ purato’bhūt saptāhe cādhvare tadā | rādhike bālavṛddhādyaiḥ kṛtaṃ gṛhṇāti pūjanam || 38|| bhojanaṃ ca pramodaṃ ca gṛhṇāti pradadāti ca | ramate rāsabhāveṣu ramate ca satījane || 39|| ramate sarvalokeṣu sarvarūpadharo’bhavat | evaṃ dṛṣṭvā camatkāraṃ rādhe’haṃ vismayaṃ gataḥ ||2.170.40|| nārāyaṇo’pi vaikuṇṭheśvaraścāha tadā nu mām | paśya kṛṣṇa mahāścaryaṃ parākāṣṭhāgataṃ tvidam ||41 || rūpaṃ rūpaṃ pratirūpo bālakṛṣṇo hi rājate | nāsti vai tādṛśī bhūmirbālakṛṣṇo na yatra vai ||42|| ajñātamārgā lokā ye samāyānti makhaṃ prati | agre teṣāṃ jano bhūtvā jāyate mārgadarśakaḥ ||43|| asvasthamanasāṃ tvagre bhūtvā sa kathako dvijaḥ | kathāṃ purātanīṃ ramyāṃ kathayatyeva rañjanām ||44|| asvasthavarṣmaṇā pārśve gatvā vaidyasvarūpavān | svāsthyaprasañjakaṃ tebhyo dadāti cauṣadhaṃ śubham ||45|| camatkāro’dbhutastatra dṛṣṭo mayā tu rādhike | koṭyarbudābjalokeṣu dehatyāgo na kasyacit ||46|| nākasmāttu kṣayaḥ kvāpi kaścid duḥkhī na tatra ca | na kuṭumbī janaḥ kaścid viyuktaḥ svakuṭumbataḥ ||47|| sammarde na ca bhūṣādi vigataṃ kasyacittadā | nāṃgamardo’bhavattatra kasyacit pādakaccaraḥ ||48|| na yānaṃ cāpi bhagnaṃ vā na vastu vigamo’bhavat | adṛṣṭabālakṛṣṇaśca na ko’pi mānavo’bhavat ||49|| aprāptādhvaraśeṣaśca na kaścid dehavānabhūt | aprāptasvāgataḥ kaścinmahīmāno na vābhavat ||2.170.50 || ajātapūrṇakāmaśca tadā kopi na cābhavat | alabdhabrahmamantraśca tadā kopi na cābhavat ||51 || aho devasya aiśvaryam īśāno’pi mumoha tu | vāsudevādayo vyūhā dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ prapedire ||52|| lajjānamrā babhūvuste vimadāḥ svabale’bhavan | aho vibhavo devasya bālakṛṣṇasya cādhvare ||53 || mahāviṣṇustu bhūmānaṃ prāhaivaṃ dhūnayan śiraḥ | pārvatī māṇikīṃ prāha patyuste’ho camatkṛtiḥ ||54|| kaṃbharā kamalāṃ prāha paśya me putravaibhavam | kamalā patimodāḍhyā svātmānaṃ bahvamanyata ||55|| kṛṣṇasthāne tathā nārāyaṇasthāne sukarmaṇi | svayamāste hariḥ kartā mahāścaryaṃ tvidaṃ mama ||56|| aho vai rādhike kṛṣṇaprāptyā gāṃgeyakaistviha | putrāste sāgarā nimnīkṛtāstīrthavidhāviha ||57|| ketumālo nijārthe’dya sārthako harilabdhitaḥ | ketuvannanu sañjātaḥ sarvalokeṣu cādyataḥ | mālāsu ketuvaccāste brahmāṇḍānāṃ nvayaṃ sadā ||58|| bālakṛṣṇaprasaṃgena sadādhvareṇa pāvitaḥ | śvetadvīpasamo bhāvī tvaiśvarye’yaṃ mahattame | pāvano’yaṃ mahān deśo mokṣadātā bhaviṣyati ||59|| atra mṛtiṃ gatā jīvāḥ sūkṣmāḥ kīṭādayo hyapi | muktiṃ yāsyanti paramāṃ pāpino’pi ca dehinaḥ ||2.170.6 0|| yajñaṃ sarveṣṭirūpaṃ tu smariṣyantyapi ye janāḥ | teṣāṃ pāpapraṇāśaśca muktiḥ karagatā bhavet ||6 1 || namiṣyati bhuvaṃ smṛtvā dūradeśagatā api | teṣāṃ puṇyaṃ makhajanyaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||62|| api nāma raṭiṣyanti nīparāṃ ca prapīṭhikām | teṣāṃ pāpavināśaḥ syāt snānajaṃ ca phalaṃ bhavet ||63|| saptaviṃśatikuṇḍān yaḥ śaṃsiṣyati tu mānavaḥ | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ mahātṛptiṃ smṛddhyādibhiḥ prayāsyati ||64|| api dhūlīṃ saṃgamasya madhyabhūmergrahīṣyati | mastake vā śarīre vā śuddhātmā sa bhaviṣyati ||65|| api padbhyāṃ śraddhayā tāṃ bhūmiṃ tīrthavidhitsayā | gamiṣyati tu yaḥ kaścit pade’dhvaraphalaṃ labhet| ||66 || api sāptāhavāsaṃ vā dinavāsaṃ tu saṃgame | kariṣyati janaḥ kaścit svargaṃ tasya tu śāśvatam ||67|| api vrataṃ tu sāptāhaṃ dinamātraṃ phalādinā | vidhāsyati naro nārī sāmrājyaphalamāpnuyāt ||68|| api dīpaṃ patrapṛṣṭhe prajvālya salile tu yaḥ | dāsyati tīrthadevāya sa sūryasthānamāpnuyāt ||69|| api pāyasabhojyaṃ yo dīnānāthāya dāsyati | candralokaṃ sa vai prāpyāmṛtabhojī bhaviṣyati ||2.170.70|| api vastraṃ ca vā bhūṣāṃ pāduke kaṃkaṇau ca vā | chatraṃ vā cāmaraṃ vāpi vyajanaṃ naktakaṃ ca vā ||71 || pātraṃ jolīṃ koṣṭhalīṃ vā cāṃgarakṣakameva vā | kaupīnaṃ yataye yo’tra dadyāccaindrapadaṃ labhet ||72|| māṇikyāṃ pārvatīṃ lakṣmīṃ prabhāṃ śriyaṃ ca rādhikām | bālakṛṣṇena sahitāṃ pūjayedatra mokṣabhāk ||73 || gobhyo grāsānatra dadyāt pakṣibhyaśca kaṇān śubhān | janebhyo bhojanaṃ dadyādatra so’pi ca mokṣabhāg ||74|| jalaṃ dadyāt phalaṃ dadyāt patraṃ puṣpaṃ payo’rpayet | makhabhūmau saṃgame’tra svargabhāk sa tu mānavaḥ ||75|| śayyāṃ ca gendukaṃ khaṭvāṃ ye’tra dāsyanti bhāvataḥ | te yāsyanti mahat svargaṃ mahatpuṇyapratāpataḥ ||76|| āsanāni bṛsīścāpi dāsyantyatra catuṣkikāḥ | te brahmāsanayogyāśca bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||77|| makhabhūmau makhaṃ ye’tra kariṣyanti tu mānavāḥ | cidākāśaṃ paraṃ dhāma prayāsyanti tu te janāḥ ||78|| hastidānaṃ cāśvadānaṃ reṇḍiyādānamityapi | haṃsakokilamenānāṃ dānaṃ śukasya cāpi ye ||79|| vṛṣabhāṇāṃ vimānānāṃ yānānāmanasāṃ tathā | dānaṃ ye’tra kariṣyanti yāsyanti brahmadhāma te ||2.170.80|| kanyādānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ putradānaṃ mahattamam | gṛhadānaṃ kṣetradānaṃ vāṭikādānamityapi ||8 1 || vṛkṣavallīstambadānaṃ kariṣyantyatra ye janāḥ | prayāsyantyamṛtaṃ svargaṃ sarvarasāmṛtānvitam ||82|| kāṣṭhadānaṃ copalādipradānaṃ loṣṭhadānakam | dhātudānaṃ vidhāsyantyāpsyanti te vahnimaṇḍalam ||83|| dadhidugdhādidātāro yāsyanti candramaṇḍalam | gṛhopakaraṇānāṃ tu dātāro brahmaṇaḥ padam ||84|| rājyadātāra evātrāpsyanti vairājamaṇḍalam | svarṇarūpyakadātṝṇāṃ golokagamanaṃ bhavet ||85|| vidyādānapradātāro bhaviṣyanti surārhaṇāḥ | kṛṣeḥ sādhanadātāro bhaviṣyanti kuberakāḥ ||86|| kalākauśalyaśikṣādyā bhaviṣyanti tu viddharāḥ | etajjalaghaṭaṃ nītvā deśāntare’pi bindukam ||87|| anyasmai ye pradāsyanti cobhayormokṣadaṃ bhavet | atra jale paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ picchasthikaṃ patet ||88|| sarvapāpavinirmuktāste yāsyanti paraṃ padam | api mṛtyusamaye’pi mukhe yasya jalaṃ patet ||89|| śarīre mokṣaṇaṃ vāpi cāsthi yasya patejjale | te sarve muktimeṣyanti rādhike nātra saṃśayaḥ ||2.170.90|| etādṛśī sthalī tveṣā śatayojanavartulā | nadīdvayāntarālasthā pāvanī varṇanottarā ||91 || makhasthalyāṃ yadi kaścid dīkṣāṃ gṛhṇāti vaiṣṇavīm | caturbhujo bhaved divyaḥ pārṣadaḥ sa vikuṇṭhake ||92|| nārī dīkṣāvatī divyā caturbhujā haripriyā | jāyate nityamuktānī punarjanma na vidyate ||93|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ tu ye janāḥ | śrāvayanti ca śṛṇvanti te’tra mokṣagamā janāḥ ||94|| satībhyo bhojanaṃ dadyāt sādhvībhyaścātra sarvathā | sādhubhyo bhojanaṃ dadyād dātā mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||95|| atropavāsaniyamaiścariṣyanti tapastu ye | te śuddhā brahmagā bodhyā muktā divyākṣarārthinaḥ ||96 || kimu te rādhike vacmi yatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | nārāyaṇāstathā cānye’vatārā īśvarāḥ surāḥ ||97|| pitaraḥ ṛṣayaḥ siddhāḥ satyaḥ sādhvyo yatīśvarāḥ | yoginyo’rhaṇavargāśca tīrthāni tārakāṇi ca ||98|| āgatyoṣitavantaśca pītavantaḥ sarijjalam | bhuktavantaśca vanyāni spṛṣṭavantaḥ pratisthalam ||99|| tallīlāsmaraṇādeva bhavanti mokṣabhāginaḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhed dhruvām || 2.170.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne saptāhayajñe samarpitopadāḥ, bālakṛṣṇasya koṭyabjarūpadhāritvaṃ, yajñabhūmidānādimāhātmyaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā saptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 170 ||
<2.171> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike tatra nityaṃ vai rātrau janasamājake | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathā jāyate śubhā || 1 || sanatkumāro bhagavān svayaṃ vācayati prabhuḥ | śvetakṛṣṇāyanavyāsaḥ kathāṃ vivecayatyapi || 2 || śvetavyāsasya nāmnā ca śvetāsanaṃ taducyate | sthalaṃ tīrthasvarūpaṃ tajjñānavijñānadaṃ sadā || 3 || yavakrīto maharṣiśca gāṃgeyo yatra vai sthale | kṣārasya kavalaṃ bhuktvā tapastepe sudāruṇam || 4 || kṣārakavalasaṃjñaṃ tatpāvanaṃ tīrthamuttamam | tatra sthalyāṃ samabhavat prasiddhaṃ mokṣadaṃ sadā || 5 || tannāmnā sa pradeśo’pi śatayojanavistṛtaḥ | kṛṣṇavārdhipraparyantaṃ nistārāṃ yāvadeva ha || 6 || yavakrītaḥ prasiddho’bhūt niṣṭhāparātaṭāśrayaḥ | yavakrīto maharṣiḥ sa vedakarmaparāyaṇaḥ || 7 || ekādaśyāṃ tu madhyāhne bālakṛṣṇaṃ jagāda ha | hare’bhijinmuhūrte’tra pūrṇāhutīḥ pradehi vai || 8 || lomaśastattathā śrutvānumatyā śrīharestathā | dadau pūrṇāhutīstatra parabrahmātmavahnaye || 9 || tāmbūlaphalapūgīphalākṣataghṛtakāni ca | śrīphalaṃ ca sruve kṛtvā dadau pūrṇāhutīrhariḥ || 2.171.1 0|| oṃ samudrāditimantrān pūrṇādarvītibodhitān | ṛṣibhirvācyamānām̐śca śrutvā pūrṇāhutīrdadau || 11 || idamagnaye vaiśvānarāya vasurudrādityebhyaḥ śatakratave adbhyaśca namama | idaṃ tridivebhya īśebhyo’vatārebhyaḥ śaktibhyaḥ parabrahmaṇe svāhā namama || 12|| idaṃ saptatalasthebhyo bhūsthebhyaścaturbhyo jaḍacetanebhyaḥ svāhā namama | idaṃ saptasvarbhyaścāṣṭāvṛtisthebhya īśānāntebhyo dhāmibhyaḥ svāhā namama || 13|| idaṃ ca brahmaṇe svāhā svāhā ca parabrahmaṇe | ekasmai cādvitīyāya mahyaṃ svāhā ca oṃ namama || 14|| ityuktvā śrībālakṛṣṇo mahāpūrṇāhutīrdadau | śrīphalāni hyasaṃkhyāni sahasraghṛtadhārikāḥ || 15|| candanāni samidhaśca miṣṭamahāhutīrdadau | sākṣādanādibhagavān pratyakṣo vahnimaṇḍale || 16|| pratyahāt saviśeṣeṇa hasan jagrāha cāhutīḥ | sarvakuṇḍeṣu ca tadvajjagrāha yugalārpitāḥ || 17||| dakṣiṇāśca tadāsaṃkhyāḥ svarṇamayīrdadau prabhuḥ | maṇimauktikahīrādīn ratnāni vividhānyapi || 18|| evaṃ pūrṇāhutīrhutvā viprāstu vedapāragāḥ | āśīrvādān dadustatra yajamānāya mantrakaiḥ || 19|| śāntighaṭodakairviprāḥ kuśadūrvāmrapallavaiḥ | punantvityādibhiścābhiṣiñcāma iti vādinaḥ ||2.171.20|| tataḥ śāntipravācaścocire viprāḥ samantataḥ | dakṣiṇāśca punaḥ prāptāḥ svastivāco jagustadā ||2 1 || hutāśanādidevām̐śca nijasthānavidāyakam | dadurviprāḥ pūrṇatāyā vācastato’vadan sukhāḥ ||22|| yajñaprasādaṃ sarvebhyaścarujaṃ padmarekhayā | vṛddhiṃ yāntaṃ cāvyayaṃ ca dadau kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||23|| koṭyabjarūpadhārī ca dadau sarvatra mādhavaḥ | vinā caruprasādaṃ vai kaścittadā na śiṣyate ||24|| antarīkṣe’mbare vyomni jale sthale vane kṣitau | gahvare prāntake bhāge’raṇye vṛkṣe ca parvate ||25|| vimāne vāhane yāne naukāyāṃ śikhare’pi ca | asaṃkhyarūpadhṛkkṛṣṇo dadau caruprasādakam || 26|| tato vai bhojayāmāsa sarvān vai mahīmānakān | prāghūṇikān mahāmuktān muktān dhāmāni dhāminaḥ ||27|| brahmapriyāśca muktānī rādhāramādikāstathā | avatārān sarvanārāyaṇān śrīparameśvarān ||28|| vyūhān prakṛtipālām̐śca kālapuruṣakeśvarān | vairājān bhūmasaṃjñām̐śca mahāviṣṇugaṇām̐stathā ||29|| tridevānāvaraṇeśān tatpatnīdāsikāstathā | bhṛtyām̐śca pārṣadām̐ścāpi pārṣadānīḥ samantataḥ ||2.171.3 0|| bhojayāmāsa bhagavān brahmasṛṣṭīśasṛṣṭijān | tataḥ siddhānṛṣīn sādhūn pitṝn satīśca yoṣitaḥ ||3 1 || pañcasvargasthitān sarvān devān devīḥ kuṭumbinaḥ | brahmacārigaṇām̐ścāpi dikpālān lokapālakān ||32|| trayastriṃśaddevatāśca bhuvarlokanivāsinaḥ | bhūlokasthān catuḥkhanijīvān jaḍām̐śca cetanān |||33 || saptapātālasaṃsthām̐śca bhojayāmāsa mādhavaḥ | surāsuragaṇān sarvān kāśyapeyām̐śca mānavān ||34|| brahmasṛṣṭān sthiracarān guṇakarmatadāśritān | tadāśrayām̐śca bhagavān bhojayāmāsa vai kratau ||35|| adyāhaṃ bhagavānasmi bhojayāmi ca nirguṇam | ekādaśīdine cāpi phalavat sarvameva me ||36|| matspṛṣṭaṃ nirguṇaṃ sarvaṃ bhuñjantu bhāvato’khilāḥ | bhojanaṃ vai vrataṃ tvadya madicchayaiva jāyatām ||37|| ityevaṃ bhagavānāha bālakṛṣṇastu rādhike | sarvān saṃbhojya ca tataḥ svayaṃ pitrā yutastathā ||38|| bhrātṛbhiśca kuṭumbena saha bhojanamādade | mātā ca mātaraścānyā svasā santoṣiṇī tathā ||39|| brahmapriyāśca vai sarvāḥ kuṭumbaṃ bubhuje tadā | tāmbūlaṃ prāpya ca sarve viśrāmaṃ cakrurīśvarāḥ ||2.171.40|| tato vādyānyavādyanta hyagāyanta ca gītikāḥ | avabhṛthāplavanārthaṃ sarve vai yatnino’bhavan ||41|| niṣṭhāparāprapīṭhāyāḥ saṃgame’nantamānavāḥ | devā muktā īśvarāścāvatārāḥ śaktayo’khilāḥ ||42|| sṛṣṭitrayanivāsāścarṣayaḥ satyaśca sādhavaḥ | prayayurbhagavān sarveśvareśvareśvareśvaraḥ || 43|| padbhyāṃ jagāma sahito maharṣibhiśca kīrtitaḥ | vedamantraiḥ stūryamāno’vabhṛthārthaṃ nadītaṭam ||44|| tasthau ca saṃgame bālakṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | saṃkalpaṃ kārayāmāsa lomaśastu purātanaḥ ||45|| caturmukhājabrahmāṇḍe sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe kṛtāntage | prathame paryaye śrīmatkāṃbhareye narāyaṇe |||46|| vartamāne vatsare ca caturdaśe’tra bhūtale | sarvādyanararūpe’sminnavatāriṇi vartati ||47|| śrāvaṇe śuklapakṣīyaikādaśyāṃ sūryavāsare | niṣṭhāparāprapīṭhāsaṃgame yajñāntakaṃ tvidam ||48|| avabhṛthātmakaṃ snānaṃ sarvapāpaviśodhakam | adhvare nāntarīyakāghānāṃ kṣālanaśaktikam ||49|| sarvapuṇyapradaṃ sarvājñātakalmaṣavārakam | sūkṣmajantubījakāṣṭhakaṇapuṣpakalārpaṇe ||2.171.50 || vahnau samarpaṇe bhūmeḥ śodhane maṇḍapakṛtau | rasaśālāsthale cūllyāṃ kaṇḍanyāṃ jalakuṃbhake ||51|| peṣaṇyāṃ mārjane cāpi patradalāvabhedane | durītaṃ pratyavāyādi yatkiṃcijjātamityapi |||52|| tasya nāśakaraṃ snānaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | yajñakarmaprapūrtyarthaṃ suraprasannatārthakam ||53|| paramāpūrvapuṣṭyarthaṃ tvavabhṛthāplavātmakam | snānaṃ sṛṣṭitrayopetaḥ karomyadya ca oṃ namaḥ ||54|| iti kṛtvā susaṃkalpaṃ bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ | rādhike sa jale magno’bhavannirgavai punaḥ ||55|| snānāṃgaṃ tarpaṇaṃ cakre smṛtvā sṛṣṭitrayaṃ tadā | śarīre mardanaṃ cakre tilapiṣṭena vai tadā ||56|| āmalakīphalacūrṇaistīrthamṛdā ca bhasmanā | yajñakuṇḍīyakenaiva haridrācūrṇakena ca | candanena ca kastūryā yavapiṣṭādinā tathā ||57|| pañcaraṃgaistathā cūrṇaiḥ sarvauṣidhībhirityaṃpi | pañcagavyena ca tathā suvarṇatīrthavāriṇā ||58|| brahmakamaṇḍaludvārābhiṣedhavidhinā tadā | saṃmṛdya sarvacūrṇāni cakre snānamavabhṛtham ||59|| yadā snāto mahārājastadā tatra tu sāgarāḥ | brahmahradaḥ sudhāsindhurvirajā ca mahājalam ||2.171.60|| nārā āpastathā nadyo nadāḥ sarāṃsi dīrghikāḥ | vyomavāri tathā meghā jalaṃ divyaṃ ca pāṇḍuram ||61 || vāruṇaṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ mahābhūtajalaṃ tathā | sādhidaivāni sarvāṇi tīrthāni tatra cāyayuḥ ||62|| snapayāmāsuratyarthaṃ bhagavantaṃ hi dhārayā | muktā dhāmānyavatārā avatāriṇya ityapi || 63 || śaktaya īśvarā īśvarāṇyo brahmapriyāstathā | pitaro devadeveśāḥ ṛṣayaḥ siddhasādhavaḥ ||64|| āśramāḥ sarvavarṇāśca narā nāryo napuṃsakāḥ | jarāyūjāścāṇḍajāścodbhijjāḥ svedajajātayaḥ ||65|| daityāśca dānavā yakṣā rākṣasā vahnayastathā | pārthivāśca jalīyāśca taijasā vāyudehinaḥ ||66 || gaganīyāstalavāsāścetanāśca jaḍāstathā | sarve sasnustatra tīrthe’vabhṛthe puṇyavāridhau ||67|| divyayoge divyaguṇe nirguṇe divyakāriṇi | puṣpacandanavṛṣṭiśca tadā tatrābhavacchubhā ||68|| ākāśād devaguravaḥ pāvanānyavadam̐stadā | pāvayantu parabrahma brahmākṣaranivāsinaḥ ||69 || dhāmadhāmasthitā bhaktā bhakteśvarāvatāriṇaḥ | avatārāḥ pārṣadāśca pāvayantu tatheśvarāḥ ||2.171.70|| īśvarāṇyo mahāsatyaḥ pāvayantu sureśvarāḥ | yajamānaṃ yajamānān pāvayantu maharṣayaḥ ||71 || svabhāvapāvanaṃ devaṃ mahānārāyaṇaṃ surāḥ | pāvayantu ca tīrthāni cāvabhṛthāgatāni vai ||72|| gaṃgā cerāvatī menakāṃgī ca brahmaputrikā | aṃgaśikṣāṃgikā harāṃgahā āyūrikā tathā ||73|| bīnā yāneśvarī caubī sindhuścoralikā tathā | valgurniṣṭhāparā dīnā dinapādyāḥ saridvarāḥ ||74|| nārāyaṇī naṣṭajarā karmāṃgī jāmbujā nadī | murā ca kāruliṃgā ca parīnā āmajānikā ||75|| miśrasurī mahākāñjī yūkāsanā saridvarā | etāścānyā mahānadyaḥ pāvayantu makheṣṭinaḥ ||76 || aśvapaṭṭaṃ puṣkaraṃ mānasaṃ nārāyaṇaṃsaraḥ | pampāsaraścendradyumnasaro brahmasarovaram ||77|| śaṃbhulaṃ ca saraścilaṃsaraḥ kolārakaṃsaraḥ | mākamānasaro bālāsaraśca māṅgirāsaraḥ ||78|| lābharucisaraḥ saraḥ kuvanaṃ grāgiraṃ saraḥ | ārasarasturusaro gairānarasarastathā ||79|| suśīlaṃ ca saro mīnakaṅūsarastathā śubham | bālakṛṣṇasaraścāpi dvikalaṃ ca sarovaram ||2.171.80|| yugalaṃ ca sarastryaṃginarasarovaraṃ tathā | phulamaṇḍasaraścāpi lurāsaṃ ca sarastathā ||8 1 || maśakelasaraścāpi jayeśānasarastathā | udvaśaṃ ca saraścāpi yonigaṃ ca sarastathā ||82|| leṇḍugaṃ ca saraścāpi pāyūśaṃ ca sarovaram | tūnāyaṃ ca rukmavāsam āvālaṃ ca rudanphalam ||82||| viśturīyasaraścāpi ālavārtaṃ sarastathā | itivarttaṃ saraḥ kimvāsaraśca tuṃgayānikam ||84|| mādhuraṃ vāgviyālaṃ ca saro nyāsajayātmakam | śirovaṃ caṇḍasaṃjñaṃ ca grātavīraṃ sarastathā ||85|| grātaślavasaraścāpi arthavāsaṃ sarastathā | vinipāraṃ saraścāpi suparīyārakaṃ tathā ||86|| klinnavārisaraścāpi itīśaṃ sarovaram | śoṇabhadranadaścāpi ghargharānada ityapi ||87|| sāgarāścāpi sarve’tra pāvayantu ca dehinaḥ | punantu devasaritaḥ punantu tīrthakoṭayaḥ ||88|| merurmandaraśailaśca himādriryuralastathā | kārukarmā patatkāyo raivatādriḥ punantu vaḥ ||89|| ityevaṃ ca śatakrośe saritsāgaravāriṣu | sasnuḥ sarve ca rājāno makheṣu yajamānakāḥ ||2.171.90|| tatra tatraikapuruṣo divyastu sūryabhāsvaraḥ | nadyostu saṃgamāttatra samutpanno hariryathā || 91 || haste sauvarṇapātre ca dadhan candanakākṣatān | puṣpamālāṃ ca mukuṭaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ samāyayau |||92|| pūjayāmāsa vidhinā candrakaṃ pracakāra saḥ | harerbhāle’kṣatādraiḥ kuṃkumacandanakardamaiḥ ||93 || dadau tu mukuṭaṃ kṛṣṇamastake mālikāṃ gale | cakāra daṇḍavattatra bālakṛṣṇaṃ jagāda ha ||94|| sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ meghanādagambhīrayā girā | avabhṛtho’haṃ puruṣo yamaputro’smi śāśvataḥ ||95|| sarveṣṭivaiṣṇavo yajñaḥ pūrṇo’yaṃ pūrṇapuṇyadaḥ | ahaṃ puṣṭiṃ gato’smyadya sarvatīrthāgamādiha ||96 || atra snānaṃ prativarṣaṃ kurvāṇānāṃ tu śāśvatam | mokṣapadaṃ niścitaṃ syānnārāyaṇakṛpālavāt ||97|| sarve bhavantu sukhinaḥ śriyā dravyaiśca sampadā | ārogyeṇa kuṭumbādyai rasairbhogyaiḥ prapūritāḥ ||98|| yoginaḥ kṣemiṇaścāpi bhavantu siddhidhāriṇaḥ | narāḥ nāryaḥ samastāśca ye’tra makhe samāgatāḥ || 99|| bhuktimuktikṛtāhlādā bhavantu harisadṛśāḥ | ityuktvā ca jalaṃ tvavabhṛthau papau hi rādhike || 2.171.10 0|| tāvajjalātsamutpannā kumārī candrabhāsvarā | surūpā sarvaśobhāḍhyā puṣṭā campakaśobhanā || 101 || yogyā prasannā sumukhī lakṣmītulyā sabhūṣaṇā | haste pātraṃ pūjanārhadravyayuktaṃ ca bibhratī || 10 2|| akṣatādyaiḥ parameśaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ pupūja sā | tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mumuhuḥ sarve koṭiśo mānavā api || 103 | devā daityāḥ ṛṣayaśca pitaro dehadhāriṇaḥ | bālakṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ natvā pūjayitvā jagāda sā || 1 04| | ahaṃ tṛptiḥ śāśvatī ca havyaputrī bhavāmi ca | yajñe’tra sarvahavyebhyo mama janmāsti puṇyavat || 1 05|| kumāryahaṃ susantuṣṭā jātāsmi ca śubhāśiṣā | yunajmi vo bhavanto’tra bhavantu sukhinaḥ sadā || 106 || mama saubhāgyadātāro bhaviṣyanti subhāginaḥ | śrīharistāṃ tadā prāha varaṃ yācasva kanyake || 1 07| | kanyā prāha varaṃ dehi varaścāvabhṛtho hi me | śrīharirdrāk vicāryaiva dānakāle hyavabhṛtham || 1 08|| kumāraṃ taṃ samāhūya kare dhṛtvā kumārakam | kanyāyai cārthitavatyai cārthayantaṃ kumārikām || 1 09|| dadau kumāryai dānaṃ ca vidhinā dānavit prabhuḥ | kumāradānaṃ pradadau kumāryai bhagavān prabhuḥ || 2.171.110 || kumāro ratnahāraṃ ca kumāryai ca samārpayat | evaṃ vivāhavidhinā kumāradānamāpya sā || 111 || kumārī saubhāgyavatī kumāraḥ subhago’bhavat | ketumāle tadārabhya kumāradānamuttamam || 11 2|| nārī pradhānabhūtā ca kumāro nāryadhīnakaḥ | nārīvarcasvamevāpi narasya pāravaśyatā || 113 || avabhṛthakṛtaṃ jātaṃ nāryai samarpaṇaṃ sadā | nārīrājyaṃ hi tatsarvaṃ tanmāhātmyena vidyate || 1 14|| ityevaṃ naradānākhyaṃ saṃgame snānasaṃgame | utsave tatra kṛtvaiva niryayuśca jalād bahiḥ || 1 15|| sarve vai snānakartārastāvattu dampatīdvayam | nṛtyaṃ kurvat prasannaṃ ca jalāntare vyalīyata || 116 || ityevaṃ lokayāmāsurmahāścaryaṃ makhārthinaḥ | dadau dānāni ca tadā koṭiśo mānavādayaḥ || 1 17|| kanyābhyaḥ koṭisaṃkhyābhyaḥ kumārāṇāṃ yathākṛtam | kanyakāstu tadā prāpya kumārān vararūpiṇaḥ || 1 18|| koṭiśastatra sañjātāḥ saubhāgyabhāgyaśobhitāḥ | evaṃ kumāradānaṃ vai vivāhe tatra cādyajam || 11 9|| abhavat tat sadā tatra vidyate śāśvato vidhiḥ | kumāraiśca samaṃ pṛthvīgṛhagosvarṇadānakam || 2.171.1 20|| dadurvai pitarasteṣāṃ vadhūṭībhyo mudānvitāḥ | evaṃ cāvabhṛthaṃ kṛtvā datvā dānāni koṭiśaḥ || 121 || svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ yayuḥ sarve viśaśramuśca mandire | vāditrāṇāṃ ninādāśca tadā śāntimupāgaman || 122|| ityevaṃ rādhike mahāścaryaṃ yatte niveditam | śravaṇātpaṭhanādasya smaraṇācchrāvaṇādapi || 123 || avabhṛthaphalaṃ prāpya kumāradānajaṃ phalam | labhet bhuktiṃ tathā muktiṃ saubhāgyaṃ śāśvataṃ labhet || 124|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pratyakṣaharirmahāpūrṇāhutīrjagrāha, sarveṣāṃ bhojanāni, avabhṛthasnānaṃ, avabhṛthātmakakumāraprākaṭyam, tṛptirūpakumārī prākaṭyam, kumāryai varaṃ yācamānāyai avabhṛthākhyasya kumārasya dānam, vivāhavidhau kumāradānāni, mahādānāni, svasvasthāneṣu viśrāntiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 171 ||
<2.172> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike ketumālākhye kumārikābhya eva tu | kumārāṇāṃ pradāne vai phalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prajāyate || 1 || nārī tatra svatantrāsti kumāre svatvayāminī | patnīvaco mahattatra patnyājñā pārameśvarī || 2 || patnī varcasvadhartrī hi patirdāsasamastataḥ | patistu bījado mātraṃ kṣetraṃ pradhānamuttamam || 3 || kṣetraṃ vai rakṣakaṃ pātṛ janayitṛ niyāmakam | sthāyi sarvādhikārāptaṃ pārampararyasya sūcakam || 4 || avabhṛthapradānena dharmo kumāradānakam | pravṛttastatra tatkālād bālakṛṣṇecchayā paraḥ || 5 || gāṃgeyādīṃstadā śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaḥ pareśvara | aśikṣayat kumārāṇāṃ dānavidhiṃ svayaṃ prabhuḥ || 6 || makhabhūmau ca vā devamandire vā gurorgṛhe | śṛṃgārite ca vādyādyairdhvānite ca samājite || 7 || śubhe nirudyame vāre ārādhanādine prage | yāyāt kanyākuṭumbaṃ tu nītvā kanyāṃ suśobhitām || 8 || suveṣāṃ yogyaśṛṃgārabhāsitāṃ pūrṇayauvanām | sarvadṛśyānanāṃ citravastrāṃ chatrānvitāṃ tataḥ || 9 || mahāsiṃhāsane dharmaguruṃ natvā niṣāditām | mātrā dattapuṣpamālāṃ guruṇāśīḥprayojitām || 2.172.1 0|| anyaiścadarśakairmitraiḥ suhṛdādibhirarcitām | ācāryaḥ śrāvayeddharmān nītīśvarādimiśritān || 11 || tāvattatra samāgacchet kumāreṇānvitaṃ tadā | kuṭumbaṃ tu kumārasya mitrasuhṛtsamanvitam || 1 2|| suśobhitaṃ kumāraṃ ca kanyāpārśve niṣādya ca | puṣpahārādikaṃ dadyāccāśīrvādān gurustadā || 13 || parameśānamantrām̐stau śrāvayed dharmabhaktivit | tatastau dvau guruḥ puṣpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya mandire || 14|| puṣpahārau svahastena dadyāt tatkaṇṭhayoḥ pṛthak | gucchau dadyāt sugandhādi dadyānamālādvayaṃ kare || 15|| parasparaṃ nidadhyācca mālāṃ kaṇṭhe vadhūrvaraḥ | guruḥ kumārahastaṃ ca dadyātkumārikākare || 16|| kumārikā ca gṛhṇīyāt karaṃ patyustadā tataḥ | kumārasya kare dadyāt karaṃ naijaṃ kumārikā || 17|| kumārastaṃ ca gṛhṇīyāt premabhāvena lokayan | tataḥ parasparaṃ kuryāt mitho hastādicūmbanam || 18|| parasparaṃ parasparakarau dhṛtvā ca nartanam | tatastau praṇametāṃ ca pareśvaraṃ guruṃ tathā || 19|| atha dvayoḥ pakṣiṇaśca dadyurharidvayaṃ tadā | pratyekasya gale sarve sugandhādi śubhāspadam || 2.172.20 || sukhinau bhavatāṃ cāpi bhavatāṃ cirajīvinau | bhavatāṃ putraputryādiphalinau premakośinau || 21 || ityāśīrvādasamprāptau nametāṃ dharmapustakam | guruṃ tato bhavennṛtyaṃ paśyetāṃ dvandvayojitam || 22|| bhojanaṃ ca samājena gṛhṇīyātāṃ sahasthitau | tāmbūlakādikaṃ prāpya guruṇāśīḥprayojitau ||23||| gacchetāṃ ca samutthāya yatheṣṭaṃ kanyakāgṛham | kanyājñayā ca vā gacchetāṃ tadānīṃ varagṛham ||24|| svatantraṃ vā gṛhaṃ kīrtilabhyaṃ vāsāya yojitam | kumāraḥ kanyakājñāṃ ca lopayitvā na sañcaret ||25|| vadhūḥ sā svāminī nityaṃ svāmino vai niyāmikā | varteta sarvathādhīno varastasyā matau mate ||26||| evaṃ kumāradānaṃ vai kumāryai devamandire | utsavena ca bhojyena hāratorādibhirmatam ||27|| gāyanena ca nṛtyena vādyādibhiḥ suśobhitam | nātra yajñavidhirvahnau devasākṣye hyapekṣyate ||28|| abandhano vidhiścāyaṃ yatheṣṭagṛhayāpanaḥ | yadi premṇaḥ kṣatiścāste na cet svabhāvamelanam ||29|| puruṣo vai bhavatyeva tyaktavyo yoṣitā tadā | dvitīyaścāpi kartavyaḥ svatantrayā tu yoṣitā ||2.172.30 || ityevaṃ rādhike kanyāyai kumārapradānake | vidhiste’tra satīvaśyaḥ prokto vai ketumālake ||3 1 || tataḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo rātrau viśrāntimāpa ha | vivāhāḥ koṭiśastatra jātā vai dvādaśīdine ||32|| adhvare maṇḍape dānaṃ vivāhavidhinābhavat | madhyāhne bhojayitvā ca mahīmānān samastakān || 33 || vidāye bahudānāni tebhyo dadau hariḥ svayam | yāḥ sarvā upadāstatrāgatāstāstu prasādajāḥ ||34|| kṛtvā matvā dadau kṛṣṇo jagṛhuḥ sarvadehinaḥ | muktāstathāvatārāśca bhagavanto narāyaṇāḥ ||35|| īśvarā īśvarāṇyaśca muktānyaḥ śaktayastathā | tattvāni tattvavijñāśca satyaśca brahmacāriṇaḥ || 36|| sādhavaḥ pitaro devāḥ ṛṣayo devatopamāḥ | rājāno mānavā daivagandharvādyāḥ suraprajāḥ || 37|| lokapālā diśāṃpālā vanāni tīrthabhūmayaḥ | pātālasthā jalavāsā vyomavāsāśca bhūsthitāḥ ||38|| jaḍāśca cetanāścāpi mahīmānāstu ye tadā | yajñe samāgatāścāsan vidāyaṃ jagṛhuśca te ||39|| śrīharestvājñayā sarve pūjayitvā pareśvaram | yayurvimānayānaiśca vāhanaiḥ svālayām̐stataḥ ||2.172.40 || saurāṣṭrīyāḥ prajāścāpi yayurvimānamārgagāḥ | brahmapriyāḥ sarvakanyāḥ kuṭumbaṃ śrīharestadā ||41|| ṛṣayo lomaśādyāśca nīlakarṇavṛkādayaḥ | rājabhiścārthitāḥ sarve nyūṣustatra makhasthale ||42|| aśvapaṭṭasarodevāḥ kṣetrapā devatādikāḥ | īśāno rājaguravo makhācāryāśca tadbhavāḥ ||43 || gāṃgeyāścāmukaprajā nyūṣustatra tu saṃgame | harerdarśanalābhārthaṃ netuṃ hariṃ nijālayān ||44|| bhuktvā rātrau tadā cakrurviśrāntiṃ ca prage punaḥ | harirutthāya vidhivat snānapūjāṃ cakāra ha ||45||| trayodaśyāṃ tu madhyāhne bhojayāmāsa mānavān | rājā samrāṭ karau badhvā prārthayāmāsa mādhavam ||46 || me gṛhaṃ pāvanaṃ kṛṣṇa pādanyāsairvidhehi ca | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha tataścoralaketukaḥ ||47|| rājā tvājñāpayāmāsa pradhānān svāgatāya vai | vimānāni susajjāni tvānayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||48|| pradhānādyāstato yajñaparihāraṃ pracakrire | sāmagrīṇāṃ tu śiṣṭānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ dadhire tathā ||49|| yānābdherbhūpavargāstu prajāśca śreṣṭhinastathā | ninyuḥ svasvālayān staṃbhapaṭamaṇḍapapātrikāḥ ||2.172.50|| rājabhistvarthitastatra śreṣṭhibhiścārthitaḥ prabhuḥ | svasvadeśagṛhāṇyeva pavitrayitumādarāt ||51 || haristathāstviti prāha svasvarṣimatamāvahan | sarvālayānahaṃ samāgamiṣyāmi sukhāya vaḥ |||52|| rājānaḥ sarva evāto yāntu nijālayānitaḥ | guravastu mayā sākaṃ gāṃgeyāḥ santu saṃsthitāḥ ||53 || pratīkṣantu krameṇaiva mamāgamaṃ dinottare | prādakṣiṇyakrameṇaivāgamiṣyāmi ca vo gṛhān ||54|| ityuktāḥ prayayuḥ sarve rājāno nijarājyakam | vimāneṣu samāruhyoralabhūpena vanditāḥ ||55|| śrīharyādyā yayurvyomnā rājadhānīṃ tu mokṣadām | mokṣakapattanākhyāṃ ca bahuśobhārhaśobhitām ||56|| gopurāṇi svarṇarūpyamayāni toraṇānyapi | sūryacandraprabhātulyopajjvalāni śobhitānyapi ||57|| rājamārgāḥ śobhitāśca kṛtrimodyānapuṣpakaiḥ | raṃgavallyādibhiḥ staṃbhaiḥ kādalaiḥ padmapatrakaiḥ ||58|| jalakuṃbhaiḥ svāgatādyairdhvajaiścitrairmakhātmakaiḥ | yaśoślokānvitai ramyai raṃgapaṭādirājitaiḥ ||59|| patākābhiḥ śobhitāni phaṭākābhiśca śālikāḥ | gandhajalaiḥ prasaktāni vartmāni vīthayastathā ||2.172.60|| rājamārgāḥ sugandhādyaiḥ puṣpairaṃgaiḥ śubhāḥ kṛtāḥ | jayasvāgatamānādisūcikāmudrikānvitāḥ ||6 1 || sarvayantrānvitāṃ ramyāṃ viśālāṃ bahumānavām | daśayojanavṛttāṃ ca smṛddhyādibhiḥ prapūritām ||62|| śvetacampakatulyābhairmānavaiḥ pariśobhitām | vṛkṣavallīgṛhodyānai ramyāṃ manoharāṃ purīm ||63|| bahuvāditraninadaistūpasphoṭanagarjanaiḥ | rājasainyaiḥ kṛtamāno bālakṛṣṇo viveśa tām ||64|| vimānādavaruhyaiva caturdantakaristhitaḥ | śuśobha bhagavāṃstatra vardhito janakoṭibhiḥ ||65|| chatracāmaraśobhāḍhyo rājñā rājñyā gajāntare | jayakāreṇa mānena premṇā nibhālito muhuḥ ||66|| rājamārge pūjitaśca vandito namito muhuḥ | prasannatāṃ darśayan tān harirnṛpālayaṃ yayau ||67|| avātarat śanairdevo mātṛpitṛsamanvitaḥ | kuṭumbibhiryuto maharṣibhiryukto’ṅgaṇe śubhe ||68|| mahodyānamaye rājasaudhāgre bhūtale tadā | brahmapriyāstatheśānādayo hyavātaram̐stadā ||69|| vimānebhyo vyomamārgāt mahodyāne śubhāśraye | rājasaudhe mahādivye nināya puruṣottamam ||2.172.70 || ūrukīrtirnṛpaputraścoralaketubhūpatiḥ | pupūja bahudhā bhaktyā jalānnamadhuparkakaiḥ ||71|| candanākṣatagandhādyaiḥ kastūrīgandhasārakaiḥ | bahusvarṇamayaiḥ pātraṃ ratnāḍhyābharaṇādibhiḥ ||72|| divyavastūpasāmagrībāhulyairārcayaddharim | nīrājanaṃ tataścakre svarṇamudrāstu koṭiśaḥ ||73|| dadau dāne tu haryagre maṇihārān dadau gale | pādau prakṣālya ca tadā sakuṭumbo jalaṃ papau ||74|| śataṃ putrā daśa putryastathānyā bālabālikāḥ | dve patnyau dāsikāścāpi papurvāri prasādajam ||75 || kṛtakṛtyaṃ tadātmānaṃ menire rājayoginaḥ | sarve kuṭumbino rājñastriṃśatkanyā viśeṣataḥ ||76|| jahṛṣuḥ śrīhariṃ prāpya manasaicchan sadā prabhum | yavakrīto maharṣiśca pupūja parameśvaram ||77|| rājñārpitaṃ dhanaṃ cānyad dadau maharṣaye hariḥ | kanyābhiścārthitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kumāradānadharmataḥ ||78|| nṛpālaye’bhavat kṛṣṇecchayā kumāradānakam | kanyāstatra hariṃ prāpya jātāḥ pūrṇamanorathāḥ ||79|| pitṝn vṛddhān mātṛvargān praṇamyājñāṃ samarjya ca | sākaṃ śrīhariṇā sthātuṃ sarvadaiva mano vyadhuḥ ||2.172.80|| prāpya mantrān vaiṣṇavāṃśca pāvanyaḥ kanyakāstu tāḥ | pavitrahṛdayairbrahmapriyāmadhye sthitāḥ sadā ||8 1 || rājñā tatra kṛtā sevā rājñyādibhiśca sevakaiḥ | pradhānaiḥ śreṣṭhibhiścāpi dāsadāsībhirityapi ||82|| bhojanaiḥ pānadānaiśca mardanaiḥ raṃjanādibhiḥ | nagare’pi hariṃ nītvā śreṣṭhinaścārcayan prabhum ||83|| āprātaḥ śrīhariṃ ramyaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram | śreṣṭhinaḥ svālayānnītvā pupūjurbahubhāvanāḥ ||84|| bahvarpaṇāni pradaduścātmārpaṇaṃ vyadhurmudā | ekāntinaśca te bhaktā jātā narāḥ striyo’khilāḥ ||85|| paramā vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve bālakṛṣṇasya sevakāḥ | bālakṛṣṇāśrayaṃ muktyai cakrire tu samutsukāḥ ||86|| vidyutprakāśake tatra nagare bhrājite’bhitaḥ | paribabhrāma bhagavān kuṭumbena sahācyutaḥ ||87|| maharṣibhistatheśānamaṇḍalena purīṃ tataḥ | prātaḥ svasthānamāsādya viśrāntiṃ cāpa vai manāk ||88|| gṛhītvā yoganidrāṃ ca sūryodaye vihāya tām | samuttasthau nijaṃ dhyānaṃ kṛtvā cakāra cāplavam ||89|| uṣṇodakaiścandanādyairarcito marditastathā | rājñyādibhistathā bhaktābhiśca sasnau jagadvidhiḥ || 2.172.90|| pūjāṃ saṃdhyāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sadyojātaṃ ca bhojanam | pracakāra mahārājaḥ sabhāyāṃ tata āyayau ||9 1|| pūjitaḥ saprajābhiśca śobhate jayate hariḥ | rājate rājasanmānaiḥ śrīhariḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ || 92|| tāvat tatra sabhāyāṃ vai kṛṣṇadehāstu mānavāḥ | samāyayurvirūpāśca kṛśā duḥkhānvitāstadā ||93 || praṇipatya hariṃ prāhuḥ kuru no mokṣaṇaṃ prabho | vayaṃ tvatroraladeśe vasāmo’gatikā janāḥ ||94|| vāsanāyuktacittāśca pūrvajā rājamāninām | śrutvaivaṃ bhagavām̐stān jalapānamakārayat ||95|| rājñāṃ tu pūrvajāste saṃtyaktvā kāluṣyamulbaṇam | divyadehāḥ samabhavan caturbhujā vimānagāḥ ||96|| pārṣadairnīyamānāste viṣṇordhāma yayuḥ param | etad vilokya nṛpatistvāścaryaṃ paramaṃ mahat ||97|| natvātmānaṃ kṛtakṛtyaṃ mene mokṣaṃ svakaṃ hyapi | mokṣārthaṃ tvarthayāmāsa śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||98|| tathāstviti prabhuḥ prāha prāpte kāle bhaviṣyati | mokṣaṇaṃ sakuṭumbasyetyevaṃ varaṃ dadau tadā ||99|| athaivaṃ rādhike trayodaśyāṃ vidāyamāpya ca | rājñā sanmānitaścāpi prasthāpito haristataḥ || 2.172.10 0|| hārādibhiḥ śobhitaḥ śrībhagavān gantumutsukaḥ | prajābhiḥ pūjitaḥ sāyaṃ sarvānupādideśa ha || 10 1|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kumāradānavivāhavidhiḥ, mahīmānānāṃ vidāyaḥ, uralaketurājadhānyāṃ mokṣikāyāṃ prabhorgamanaṃ, nagare bhrāmaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ, rājapūrvajānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 172 ||
<2.173> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tatra yavakrītāya carṣaye | bhagavān pradadau jñānaṃ gāṃgeyāya mahātmane || 1 || rājñe rājakuṭumbāya prajābhyaścāpi śobhanam | pāramparyaprarakṣārthaṃ śiṣyatvāvedakaṃ nijam || 2 || yavakrītoralaketoḥ rājñyastathā prajāstvimāḥ | śṛṇvantu mama vākyāni kṛṣṇamūlaparāṇi vai || 3 || ahaṃ śrībhagavānasmi parabrahma parātparaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 4 || akṣarāttu pare dhāmni divye virājamānakaḥ | divyamūrtirnivasāmi divyamuktaprasevitaḥ || 5 || ahaṃ mama svarūpasya jñānaṃ dadāmi vai muhuḥ | bhaktebhyo muktasaṃjñebhyo muktānībhyastathā kvacit || 6 || kvacid brahmapriyābhyaśca rādhāyai ca śriyai kvacit | kvacillakṣmyai ramāyai ca māṇikyāyai kvacittathā || 7 || ramāyai ca jayāyai ca lalitāyai tathā kvacit | padmāvatyai mahālakṣmyai pārṣadebhyastathā kvacit || 8 || āyudhebhyo vibhūṣābhyo guṇebhyaśca tathā kvacit | aiśvaryebhyaśca śaktibhyaḥ kvacidbhaktebhya ityapi || 9 || jñānaṃ samyak svarūpasya pradadāmi tu sevine | sampradāyaḥ sa vai prokto jñānātmakaḥ pramuktidaḥ || 2.173.10 || jñānaṃ cāhaṃ parabrahmāsmīti jānantu sarvathā | dīyate’dya mayā tvatra bhavadbhyaḥ sarvathottamam || 11 || mayā sākṣāttu tad dattaṃ grāhyaṃ dhāryaṃ sadā hṛdi | matto’vatārā jāyante kṛṣṇādyāḥ koṭiśaḥ sadā || 12|| caturviśatyavatārāstathānye’pi sahasraśaḥ | mattaḥ sarve prajāyante madaiśvaryānvitāstu te || 13|| nārāyaṇāstathā sarve jāyante matsvarūpataḥ | vāsudevādayo vyūhā jāyante mama mūrtitaḥ || 14|| bhūmādayastvīśvarāśca mamāṃśāḥ sarva eva te | brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyā mamāṃśāśā bhavanti te || 15|| rādhāramādikāḥ sarvā mama santi praśaktayaḥ | golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ ca kilāsanam | mamākṣarapradeśāste prāntadhāmāni santi me || 16 || akṣaraṃ dhāma sarveśaṃ sarvebhyo mānavarjitam | anyadhāmāni sarvāṇi mānavanti bhavanti me || 17|| mahannagaramabhito yathā śākhāpurāṇi hi | bṛhaddhāmābhitastadvacchākhādhāmāni tāni vai || 18|| samrāḍasmyavatārāṇāṃ sarve mamāṃśayoginaḥ | evaṃ vai vartamānasya niyāmakasya me param || 1 9|| akṣarācca bṛhato’pi dhāmāsti paramottamam | manmūrterabhitaścaste mama dhāma parottamam ||2.173.20|| tasmācca paradhāmādvai tejo yannirgataṃ puraḥ | tadakṣaraṃ bṛhaddhāma bhaṇyate sarvabuddhiṣu || 2 1|| tasmād bodhyaṃ mama dhāma tvakṣarād paramaṃ bṛhat | akṣaraṃ tu brahatproktaṃ dhāmānyanyāni sīmni ca ||22|| akṣarasyaiva tiṣṭhanti tataśceśvarakoṭayaḥ | tato’ṣṭāvaraṇānyeva malināni bhavanti hi ||23|| tato brahmāṇḍalokāścoḍḍayanti tvaṇuvat sadā | sarveṣvahaṃ sadā cāntaryāmitayā vasāmi ca || 24|| atra yo’smi sa tatrāsmi bālakṛṣṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ | atra me yogamāpannāste sarve paradhāmagāḥ ||25|| ahaṃ sadaikarūpo’smi sarvaiśvaryādisaṃbhṛtaḥ | janāstu bhinnanetrā māṃ svīyadṛṣṭyā svavat sadā ||26|| paśyanti devavad devāḥ paśyanti martyavannarāḥ | paśyanti siddhavat siddhāḥ ṛṣayaḥ ṛṣivattathā ||27|| pitaraḥ pitṛvaccāpīśvarā īśvaravattathā | avatārāḥ svavaccāpi muktā muktasamaṃ tathā || 28|| brahmā tu brahmavaccāpi māyikā māyikaṃ yathā | mahāmuktāḥ svavaccāpi māṃ paśyanti sadā svavat ||29|| anantāpārarūpo’haṃ cāprameyo’smi sarvathā | svarūpeṇa svabhāvena guṇairbhāvaiśca sarvadā ||2.173.3 0|| nānto’sti mama divyānāṃ svarūpāṇāṃ kutastu me | vibhūtīnāṃ na me tvantaḥ kuto me mānatā tadā ||3 1 || ahamānandavānasmi tena jīvanti jīvinaḥ | yatrānandaśca tatrāhaṃ viditvaivaṃ ca māṃ bhajet ||32|| naro vā yadi vā nārī tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt | mokṣikeyaṃ hi nagarī mayā tvāgatya satkṛtā || 33 || mama jñānena lokānāṃ vasatāṃ mokṣadā nviyam | śarīreṇendriyairbhāvairantaḥkaraṇakaiśca mām || 34|| prabhajanti janā ye māmāntarasthaṃ taranti te | sarvadā karmakāṇḍe vai daihike mānase’thavā ||35|| aindriyake’pi madbhānaṃ tadeva mokṣadaṃ matam | nirguṇaṃ matkṛte sarvaṃ divyaṃ vaiṣayikaṃ ca vā || 36|| ityevaṃ ca jaḍaṃ cāpi cetanaṃ varṣma me matam | tatrāhaṃ sarvadā cāsmi viśiṣṭo’haṃ bhavāmi ca ||37|| cullikāyāṃ tathā kāṣṭhe vahnau bhrāṣṭre kapālake | piṣṭe ca roṭake cāhaṃ kartryā bhoktari cāpyaham ||38|| jāṭhare codare sarvavikṛtau ca bale’pi ca | dhātuṣvahaṃ ca garbhādau bāle’haṃ yauvane’pyaham ||39|| vārdhake ca śave bhūtībhāve cāhaṃ vasāmi hi | punaḥ khādye khādake ca bīje vṛkṣe kuṭhārake ||2.173.40|| chedane chettari dvaidhībhāve samitsu cāpyaham | evaṃ sarvatra nidhane puṣṭau ca janane’smyaham ||41 || madvinā nāpyaṇustvasti mayā sarvaṃ tvadhiṣṭhitam | evaṃ jñātvā sarvavidhāṃ mama mūrtiṃ bhajet sadā ||42|| tadā nairguṇyamāsādya mama bhāvāya kalpate | etajjñānaṃ mayā dhāmni pare purā tu sarjane ||43 || māṇikyāyai mama devyai vāhāyai cārpitaṃ dhruvam | tayā tu duḥkhahālakṣmyai dattaṃ tayā tu śaṃbhave ||44|| śivarājasvarūpāya śivena nijayoṣite | satyai dattaṃ tayā putragaṇeśāya purārpitam ||45|| tena buddhayai tathā siddhyai tābhyāṃ tajjñānamuttamam | padmāvatyai ramāyai ca tābhyāṃ hiraṇyagarbhiṇe ||46 || tena cānekaśiṣyebhyo bahuśākhāgataṃ tataḥ | bahudhā vardhitaṃ sampradāyaśākhāsu vartate ||47|| vighnā vai sampradāyasya nāśakāstu bhavantyapi | tairjñānaṃ na parābhāvyaṃ yadyahaṃ saṃsmṛto’ntare ||48|| sampradāyo rakṣaṇīyaḥ śiṣyaiḥ praśiṣyakaistataḥ | tanvā ca manasā buddhyā dhanairjñānaiḥ sumandiraiḥ ||49|| jñānāvanārthamevātra śāstraṃ tvapekṣyate sadā | vedāśca saṃhitā cāpi sarvavedārthabodhinī ||2.173.50 ||| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhiteyaṃ rakṣyā sadā hṛdi | tadvyākhyātā gururdhāryaḥ pūjārthaṃ mama rūpavān ||5 1 || gururvai dīkṣitaḥ saṃhitājño madātmako hi saḥ | saṃhitārthaṃ jñāpayet sa kathā dvārā sadā janān ||52|| mama pūjāprakārādi prakuryāt likhitaṃ yathā | pūjārthaṃ mama mūrtiśca sthirā sthāpyā sumandire ||53|| rādhayā ramayā lakṣmyā śriyā māṇikyayā saha | padmāvatyā ramayā gaṃgayā virajayā saha ||54|| sarasvatyā durgayā bhvā brahmapriyādibhiḥ saha | jayayā padmayā vṛndayā tulasyā ca haṃsayā ||55|| maṃjulayā sadguṇayā sthāpyā lalitayā saha | devyā ca muktayā haimyā śāntyā vā campayā saha ||56 || tatpūjāyāḥ pravāharthaṃ bhūgrāmādisamarpaṇam | kartavyaṃ vidhinā rājñā dhanāḍhyaistu dhanārpaṇam ||57|| vidyāyāstu parāyā me dānārthaṃ pāṭhaśālikāḥ | vidyālayā viśālāśca kāraṇīyā hi bodhadāḥ | śikṣakā yojanīyāśca pūjakā mandire’pi me ||58|| pustakānāṃ pracāraśca kartavyo mānaveṣvapi | deveṣu cānyalokeṣu pātāleṣvapi sarvathā ||59|| tatra tatratyasaṃhitābhāgaprasāramācaret | evaṃ ṣaḍaṃgarūpeṇa sampradāyaḥ pravartate ||2.173.6 0|| vidyā śāstraṃ gururmūrtirmandiraṃ śiṣyavargakaḥ | vidyā proktā parā mantro nāma cārādhanādikāḥ ||6 1 || aparā bahudhā jñānaṃ vyavahāreṇa miśritam | śāstraṃ vedāḥ saṃhitāśca gurorvāṇī harervacaḥ || 62|| gurustu vaiṣṇavo jñānamantraśāstrādiyojakaḥ | mūrtiścāhaṃ svayaṃ patnīsahitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||63|| muktairbhaktaiḥ priyābhiśca sahāryaḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | avatārāśca me sarve vyūhā me kāryakāriṇaḥ ||64|| aṃśāḥ kalāstathāveśā vibhūtayaḥ svarūpiṇaḥ | pūrṇāścopāsakā bhaktā nārāyaṇāstathāpare || 65|| mandiraṃ śatakalaśaṃ sahasrakalaśaṃ tathā | sauvarṇaṃ ca tathā divyaṃ maṇijaṃ kārayed dṛḍham ||66|| śiṣyavargā bhaveyurvai mantragrahaṇasevanaiḥ | sādhavo gṛhavargāśca narā nāryo hi sevakāḥ ||67|| bālā yuvāno vṛddhāśca sadhavā adhavā api | bālikāśca kumārāśca vijñā vijñānavarjitāḥ ||68| | rājā prajāḥ pradhānāśca brahmiṣṭhā vītarāgakāḥ | sanyāsāḥ sādhavo yogābhyāsāśca yatayastathā ||69|| mānavā api ṣaṇḍhā ye ye ke’pi sampradāyinaḥ | bhajeran māṃ sadā bhāvabharāḥ kapaṭavarjitāḥ ||2.173.70|| tṛṣṇārāgadveṣamanyudroherṣyāvarjitāstathā | bhajeyurmāṃ tadā sampradāyo śāśvato bhavet ||71 || nirdoṣaistvāśritaiḥ sampradāyaḥ prakāśatāṃ vrajet | sadoṣaistvāśritaiḥ sampradāyaścāndhyamupāvrajet ||72|| yatra nāsti gururboddhā nityatṛpto nirīhakaḥ | yamaiśca niyamairyuktaḥ sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||73 || yatra nāsti gurustyāgī vairāgyavān jitendriyaḥ | śāstrajño dharmaśīlaśca sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||74|| yatra nāsti gururjñātā jñānado’jñānanāśakaḥ | sarvaśāstravyāpakaśca sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati|| 75|| yatra gururdravyahartā vyasanī cānṛtī tathā | svārthamātraparastṛṣṇī sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||76 || yatra gururdayāhīnaḥ pārakyān manute śritān | duḥkhe prakṣipati śiṣyān sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||77|| yatra gururdharmahantā nāstikaḥ śaṭhadhūrtakaḥ | doṣālayaśca viṣayī sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||78|| yatra guruḥ sarvabhakṣī tṛṣṇālobhādiśevadhiḥ | pūryate nodaraṃ yasya sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||79|| rakṣakā bhakṣakā yatra trātāraśca viḍambakāḥ | viśvāsaghātinaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||2.173.8 0 || pāṣaṇḍicaurahārāṇāṃ luṇṭakānāṃ kriyāparāḥ | mūrdhanyā yatra vidyante sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||8 1 || sabhāsado vyavahāranirṇatāraśca yojakāḥ | luñcākhādakino yatra sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati |||82|| prasahyānyāyayuktāśca vigantāro virodhinaḥ | kleśino mānavā yatra sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||83|| gurudrohijanā yatra nimnadoṣāvalokinaḥ | bhāvahīnā nindakāśca sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||84|| avivekā adīrghadṛṣṭayaḥ premavihīnakāḥ | pūjyapūjollaṃghakāśca sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||85|| hatyākāṇḍābhirucayo devānnadravyabhojakāḥ | gurormānahano yatra sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||86|| kudṛṣṭayaḥ kusaṃkalpāḥ kusaṃgavyāptamānasāḥ | paragṛhaprabhaṃktāraḥ sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||87|| guṇeṣu doṣadraṣṭāraḥ parotkarṣāsahiṣṇavaḥ | mānavā yatra vai yāmyāḥ sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||88|| asatkāryamasadvāṇī anyāyaśca pade pade | mahatāmavamānaṃ ca sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||89|| yatra me pratimā nāsti nāsti me mandiraṃ ca vā | nāsti me saṃhitāśāstraṃ sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||2.173.90 || kathā me satataṃ nāsti santi hṛndyamalāni na | sevakā nirmalā naiva sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||9 1 || gṛhasthā guravo yatra tyāginaḥ śiṣyakoṭayaḥ | guravaḥ strījuṣo yatra sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||92|| sarvabhogavilāsāśca guruṣveva vasanti cet | tyāgāṃśo yatra nāstyeva sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||93 || guroḥ pṛṣṭhe mahacchidraṃ hṛdaye rākṣasī sthitiḥ | agre tu grahaṇāndhyaṃ ca sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||94|| narā nāryo niḥśvasanti yaṃ yān vai sāmpradāyikān | teṣāmādhārabhūtaścet sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati || 95|| vidyā vidyālayo nāsti camatkāro na yatra ca | siddhā yatra na santyeva sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||96|| udaraṃbhariṇo yatra śiṣyā dhārmyaśabhakṣakāḥ | devabhītivihīnāśca sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||97|| vākṣvanyad darśane cānyat hṛdaye’nyattu mānave | tādṛśo yatra kāryāgnyaḥ sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||98|| jñāne karmaṇi nāstikyaṃ cānṛtaiśvaryadarśanam | yatrādānaṃ vamayitvā sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ||99|| vidyā śāstraṃ gururdevā ālayā yatra santi na | sampradāyasya nāśastu druta tatra prajāpate || 2.173.10 0|| tasmāmantrā mayā dattā dīyantāṃ śiṣyavargiṇe | vidyāṃ śāstraṃ guruṃ devān sthāpayantvarcayantu ca || 101 || evamuktvāśiṣo datvā vimānaṃ tvadhyarohayat | jayanādairvādyanādairyantranādaiśca harṣaṇaiḥ || 10 2|| saha vyomnā sārthayukto yayau krathakarāṣṭrakam | romāyanenarṣiṇā prārthitaḥ krathakabhūbhṛtā || 10 3|| rādhike tu tadā vyomni yāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā hariṃ prajāḥ | āgantavyaṃ rakṣaṇīyā deyaṃ ca darśanaṃ jaguḥ || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne uralaketurājarṣiyavakrītamaharṣiprajābhyaśca hariṇā svasvarūpajñānaṃ sampradāyaśāśvatikajñānaṃ ca dattamiti nirūpaṇanāmā trisaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 173 ||
<2.174> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ | krathakasya rājadhānyām oṃkāreṣṭābhidhājuṣi || 1 || nagare śobhite kṛṣṇanāmadhunyaninādite | romāyanenarṣiṇā ca krathakena ca bhūbhṛtā || 2 || darśite bahuvidhibhiḥ śṛṃgāritaharitsthale | avātārayadudyāne vimānaṃ janasaṃkule || 3 || nṛpālaye vimānāccāvatīrya bhagavān yadā | praviveśa tadā puṣpākṣatavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha || 4 || tūryāṇi rājarītyaivāvādyanta miṣṭasusvaraiḥ | agīyanta sugītāni jayaśabdāstathābhavan || 6 || kuṭumbaṃ śrīhareḥ sarvaṃ brahmapriyā maharṣayaḥ | avaterurvimānāttu svarṇāḍhye bhūbhṛdālaye || 6 || vidyutprakāśakaiḥ samujjvale sugandhaśālini | sarvasāmagrikāramye dāsadāsīsabhājite || 7 || bhṛtyaiḥ pradhānakai rājakuṭumbakaiḥ prajājanaiḥ | saṃkulite’tisammarde kṛṣṇaḥ saudhe viveśa ha || 8 || praveśanasya samaye vardhitaḥ svāgatena tu | namanairvandanaiḥ premṇā darśanena sumākṣataiḥ || 9 || rājñā rājñyā kumāraiśca putrībhirbhrātṛbāndhavaiḥ | śrīhariḥ salilenāpi śītalairanilairapi || 2.174.10 || phalai rasaiḥ supeyaiśca satkṛtaḥ kṣaṇamātrataḥ | kuṭumbādisārthajanaḥ satkṛtāḥ sarva eva te || 11 || puṣpahāraistathā gucchaiḥ sugandhidravasecanaiḥ | rañjito bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ || 1 2|| evaṃ kṣaṇaṃ praviśramya romāyanena bodhitaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo rājasabhāṃ yayau || 13 || rātrāvapi tu dinavad bhrājamānāṃ pradīpakaiḥ | maṇīnāṃ kiraṇaiścāpi klṛptacandrakaraistathā || 14|| viśālāṃ parito bhittipaṭaleṣu suraiḥ sthitām | udyānadṛśyaśobhāḍhyāṃ svargavatsukalevarām || 15|| sabhāmāsādya tu harirniṣasāda gajāsane | svarṇahīrakaśobhāḍhye chatracāmarabhūṣite || 16|| anye pitrādayaścāpi niṣeduryogyakāsane | bhagavān sarvalokānāṃ kuśalaṃ sukhasampadam || 17|| samapṛcchattathārogyaṃ janāśca sukhino’bhavan | rājā rājakuṭumbaṃ ca pādau prakṣālya vai hareḥ || 18|| prāsādikaṃ payaḥ sarve papustataḥ sugandhibhiḥ | candanaiḥ puṣpahārādyaiḥ sauvarṇairhārakaistathā || 1 9|| hīrakairmauktikaiścāpi pupūjuḥ parameśvaram | prajājanāḥ pupūjuśca pradhānāḥ śreṣṭhinastathā ||2.174.20 || kṛtakṛtyāḥ kṛtā nātha vayamāgamadarśanaiḥ | bhagavatā śrīhariṇā pāvanī nagarī kṛtā ||21 || adya viśrāntimāsādya prātardehi svadarśanam | ityuktvā tvabhivandyaiva yayuḥ sarvaprajājanāḥ ||22|| mahimānāstataḥ sarve nivāsānāyayurdrutam | śrīhariḥ sakuṭumbaśca nṛpasaudhe suśobhane ||23 || viśrāntyarthaṃ yayau rājñā krathakena tatharṣiṇā | darśite śayane kṛṣṇaḥ suṣvāpa nidrito’bhavat || 24|| mahīmānā dugdhapānādikaṃ kṛtvā viśaśramuḥ | rājā yayau nijaṃ saudhaṃ viśrāntyarthaṃ tu rādhike || 25|| caturdaśyāṃ prage samutthāya śrībhagavān prabhuḥ | bodhito maṃgalaśabdaiḥ śuśrāva svayaśo’malam ||26|| dhyātvā svaṃ ca tato nityavidhiṃ cakāra sarvaśaḥ | darśanārthaṃ samājagmurlomaśādyāḥ prajāstathā ||27|| sa rājā krathako rājñī putryaḥ putrāḥ samāyayuḥ | pūjanārthaṃ hareḥ sarvasāmagrībhiḥ samutsukāḥ ||28|| pādaprakṣālanaṃ cakruḥ payasā tajjalaṃ papuḥ | vastrālaṃkārabhūṣādyairhīrakairmauktikaistathā || 29|| candanākṣatapuṣpādyairmaṇibhiścārcayan harim | mātaraṃ pitaraṃ cāpi santuṣṭāṃ śukavallabhau ||2.174.3 0|| brahmapriyāśca kanyāśca lomaśādīn samārcayan | tata ārārtrikaṃ cakrurdaṇḍavacca pradakṣiṇam || 3 1|| upadā sannyadhustvagre vividhā bhāvatastadā | rājā prāha harikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jagadgurum |||32|| pāvitaṃ mama rāṣṭraṃ saṃpāvitopi madālayaḥ | kuṭumbaṃ pāvitaṃ me’tra vasātra bhagavan sadā ||3 3 || bhavato’smi kuṭumbena sahito’haṃ kṛpānidhe | bhagavām̐śca nṛpaṃ prāha mūrtirūpeṇa sarvadā ||34|| rājaṃstava gṛhe nivatsyāmi pratyakṣavat sadā | kāraya tvaṃ mandiraṃ me sthāpayātra ca māṃ prabhum ||35|| nṛpaḥ papraccha ca hariṃ kadā kāryaṃ nu mandiram | kaḥ kālo hi muhūrtādiḥ dinanakṣatrarāśayaḥ ||36|| uttamā hi śubhe kārye mandirādau sukarmaṇi | bhavatsthāpanakālāśca tad vadātra tu me prabho ||37|| hariḥ prāha yadā rājan bhagavān bhuvi vartate | dhṛtamānuṣarūpo vai tadājñā tu yadā bhavet || 38|| rātrau vā divase vāpi sandhyāyāṃ sūtake’pi vā | akāle vā tathāniṣṭe śoke kleśamaye’pi vā ||39|| yādṛśastādṛśaḥ kālastanmataḥ śubha eva saḥ | haryadhīnāḥ sarvakālāstadicchayā śubhā hi te ||2.174.40|| deśaḥ sarvavidhaścāpi haryāśritaḥ śubho hiṃ saḥ | kṛṣṇatulyāḥ samarthā ye santasteṣāṃ vacāṃsi ca ||41|| yasmin kāle tu labdhāni kālaḥ sarvaḥ śubho hi saḥ | naisargeṇa tu te vacmi śṛṇu śraiṣṭhyaṃ tu kālikam ||42|| varṣaṃ māsāstathā pakṣāḥ saptāhāni dināni ca | nakṣatrāṇi grahā vārāścaturghaṭyo muhūrtakam |||43|| yogāśca tithayaḥ klṛptā vyavahārasya siddhaye | varjyān vacmyapi prathamaṃ śṛṇu rājan yathāyatham ||44|| tithinakṣatravāreścotpannān yogān hi dūṣitān | varjayecchubhakārye vai vyatīpātādikāṃstathā ||45| duryogānatha bhadrāṃ cāmāvāsyāṃ sūryasaṃkramam | janmarkṣaṃ janmatithikāṃ janmamāsaṃ vivarjayet ||46 || tithervṛddhiṃ kṣayaṃ cāpi vivarjayet sukarmaṇi | pāpagrahaiḥ prabhuktāni bhujyamānāni cāpi ca ||47|| bhogyānyapi ca ṛkṣāṇi varjayecchubhakarmasu | utpātarkṣaṃ pāpagrahaviddharkṣaṃ ca vivarjayet ||48|| ṛtaṃ ca bheditaṃ pāpagraheṇa tadvivarjayet | khagrāsagrahaṇarkṣaṃ tu ṣaṇmāsāvadhi varjayet ||49|| ardhagrāsasya nakṣatraṃ trimāsāvadhi varjayet | pādagrāsasya nakṣatraṃ māsāvadhi vivarjayet ||2.174.5 0|| grāsāt prāk tridinaṃ tyājyaṃ paścāt saptāhakaṃ tyajet | grastāste prāk tridinaṃ grastodaye tryahamuttaram ||61 || pūrṇagrāse prāk ca paścād dinatrikaṃ vivarjayet | māsāntaikadinaṃ cāpi nakṣatrāntaghaṭīdvayam ||62|| tithyantaghaṭikaikaṃ ca lagnāntārdhaghaṭīṃ tathā | nakṣatrāṇāṃ viṣāṃ nāḍīṃ varjayecchubhakarmasu ||53 || pātadoṣaṃ tathā caikārgalaṃ dagdhadinātmakam | saṃkrāntisamayaṃ cāpi varjayecchubhakarmasu ||54|| lagnasvāmī bhavet sthāne śatrormṛtyośca vā yadā | madhyāhnaṃ madhyarātriṃ ca sandhyāsandhiṃ vivarjayet ||55|| adhimāsaṃ ca śukrasya guroścāstaṃ vivarjayet | śukrasya ca gurorbālyaṃ vārdhakyaṃ ca vivarjayet ||56 || janmeśāstaṃ manobhaṃgaṃ sūtakaṃ māturārtavam | rogotpātādyariṣṭāni śubhakāryeṣu varjayet ||57|| siṃhasthe tu gurau tyājyā vivāho vapanaṃ vratam | yātrā dīkṣā pratiṣṭhā ca yatastatra savighnakāḥ ||58|| krūragraheṇa yadbhuktaṃ bhoktavyaṃ bhojyameva vā | nakṣatraṃ sarvakāryeṣu siddhikṛdgrāhyameva tat| ||59|| kintu rāhuyutamṛkṣaṃ tyājyaṃ vai śubhakarmasu | grahaduṣṭaṃ tu nakṣatraṃ sūryabhuktaṃ yadā bhavet ||2.174.60 || candrabhuktaṃ ca vā syācca tataḥ śubhapradaṃ bhavet | grahaṇena hatamṛkṣaṃ ṣaṇmāsānte śubhaṃ bhavet ||6 1 || ekamāse coparāgadvaye prāthamikaṃ tu bham | dvitīyagrāsapūrvaṃ syācchuddhaṃ ṣāṇmāsike’param || 62|| khātaṃ caitreśokada syād vaiśākhe dhanadaṃ smṛtam | jyeṣṭhe grahaprapīḍādam āṣāḍhe paśunāśanam ||63|| śrāvaṇe dhanavṛddhikṛt bhādrapade tu śūnyakṛt | āśvine kleśadaṃ syācca kārtike bhṛtyanāśakam ||64|| mārgaśīrṣe dhanadaṃ syāt pauṣe kāmarddhisampradam | māghe tvagnibhayadaṃ syāt phālgune śrīpradaṃ matam ||65|| gṛhāraṃbhastu meṣasthe sūrye sarvaśubhapradaḥ | vṛṣasthe dhanavṛddhikṛt mithunasthe mṛtipradaḥ ||66|| karkasthe śubhadaḥ syācca siṃhasthe bhayavardhakaḥ | kanyāsthe rogadaḥ syācca tulāsthe sukhado bhavet ||67|| vṛścikasthe dhanavṛddhirdhanuḥsthe mahatī kṣatiḥ | makarasthe dhanāyaḥ syāt kuṃbhasthe ratnado mataḥ ||68|| mīnasthe bhayadaḥ syācca vicāryāraṃbhamācaret | devapratiṣṭhā māghe ca phālgune dhanadā tathā ||69|| āyuṣyārogyadā bhartuḥ kīrtikarī bhaveddhi sā | caitre sā bhayadā rogapradā bodhyā tu sarvathā ||2.174.70|| vaiśākhe sā tathā jyeṣṭhe dhanaputrādidāyinī | dakṣiṇāyanage sūrye vārāhaṃ mātṛkāstathā ||71 || bhairavaṃ vāmanaṃ durgāṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ sthāpayet sukham | śrāvaṇe śivaliṃgaṃ cāśvine tu jagadambikām ||72|| mārgaśīrṣe hariṃ viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ ca māṃ prabhum | sthāpayet pauṣamāse tu sthāpayet sarvadevatāḥ ||73|| nītyaṃ gītaṃ kṛṣiṃ citramutsavaṃ ca gṛhādikam | vastrālaṃkārabhūṣādi śilpitā ca kalādikam ||74|| ekādaśyāṃ pratipadi ṣaṣṭhyāṃ nandākhyatattithau | vidhāpayet śikṣayet svo’dhīyīta śubhadaṃ bhavet ||75|| vivāhaścopanayanaṃ yātrā bhūṣādidhāraṇam | śilpakāryaṃ kalāśikṣā hastirathāśvacālanam ||76|| āvāhane samāroho siddhidāstu yathā śṛṇu | dvitīyāyāṃ ca saptamyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ bhadrikātithau ||77|| sainyasaṃgrāmaśastrādidhṛtyabhyāsaprayodhanam | yātrotsavagṛhāraṃbhauṣadhivyāpārakarma ca ||78|| jayākhyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāmaṣṭamyāṃ ca tathā śṛṇu | trayodaśyāṃ prakartavyaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam ||79|| śatrūṇāṃ māraṇaṃ bandhanaṃ tathā viṣayojanam | śastrāgniyojanaṃ kāryaṃ riktākhyāyāṃ tithau śṛṇu ||2.174.80|| caturthyāṃ ca navamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ ca siddhyati | riktāyāṃ maṃgalaṃ kāryaṃ na kartavyaṃ kadācana ||8 1|| rājyābhiṣeko yātrā ca vivāhaścopavītakam | śāntikarma puṣṭikarma pūrṇākhyāyāṃ tithau śṛṇu ||82|| pañcamyāṃ ca daśamyāṃ ca pūrṇimāyāṃ hi siddhidam | ityevaṃ karaṇe kāryasiddhirbhavati niścitā ||83|| dvitīyā paṃcamī cāpi tṛtīyā saptamī tathā | daśamyekādaśī kṛṣṇapratipacca trayodaśī ||84|| pūrṇimā tithayo hyetāḥ sarvakārye śubhāvahāḥ | anyāstu tithayo naiva śubhadā vai matāḥ kvacit ||85|| kṛṣṇā caturdaśī śuklā pratipat darśasaṃjñakā | varjanīyāḥ śubhe kārye tithayastā bhayāvahāḥ ||86|| ādityaścandramā bhaumo buddhaścāpi vṛhaspatiḥ | śukraḥ śanaiścaraśceti vāsarāḥ sapta yojitāḥ ||87|| guruścandro budhaḥ śukraḥ śubhāḥ śubhe tu karmaṇi | raviḥ śanirmaṃgalaśca krūrāḥ krūre tu karmaṇi ||88|| sthiraḥ sūryaścaraścandro bhaumaścogro budhaḥ samaḥ | laghurgururmṛduḥ śukraḥ śanistīkṣṇaḥ svabhāvataḥ ||89|| ravau devapratiṣṭhā tu tejaḥprabhāvadāyinī | candre kṣemakarī bhaume vahnidāhapradāyinī ||2.174.90|| budhe ceṣṭaphaladā syād gurau sthiratvadāyinī | śukre cānandadā syācca śanau kalpanivāsinī ||9 1 || rājyābhiṣeko māṃgalyaṃ yānavāhananirmitiḥ | sainyasvārī mantrasiddhirastraśastrāvamocanam ||92|| bheṣajasya prayogaśca yuddhaṃ cāpaṇapaṇyakam | agnidānaṃ sevanaṃ ca sauvarṇakāryamityapi ||93|| ābhūṣādhāraṇaṃ cāpi ravau vāre śubhāni hi | atha candre vāsare tu śaṃkhamauktikarūpyakaiḥ ||94|| ābhūṣaṇavidhānaṃ ca bhūṣādhāraṇamityapi | saṃgītavidyādhyayanaṃ yajñakāryaṃ kṛṣikriyā ||95|| bhojyaṃ strīsevanaṃ cekṣurasapākavidhāpanam | jalapravāhakūpādikoṣavahanamuttamam ||||6|| atha bhaume vāsare tu bhedabhāvastathānṛtam | caurye śāṭhyaṃ viṣaśastravahnighātanamityapi ||97 || karadaṇḍādānadānaṃ svarṇapravāladhāraṇam | evametāni kāryāṇi śubhānyuktāni maṃgale ||98|| atha vāre budhe śikṣyaṃ vāṇijyaṃ ca kalādikam | sambandhaśca bhṛtyatā ca vyāyāmo vedaghoṣaṇam ||99|| śāstrasya lekhanārambhaścaitāḥ kriyāḥ śubhā matāḥ | gurau vāre yajñakāryaṃ dharmaḥ satkāra ityapi || 2.174.100 || māṃgalyaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ vidyā yātrā gṛhavidhāpanam | bhaiṣajyaṃ cālaṃkaraṇaṃ kartavyāni śubhāni vai || 101 || śukre gītaṃ strīsaṃgaśca ratnadhāraṇamityapi | śayyāparyaṃkakaraṇaṃ vastrabhūṣādidhāraṇam || 1 02|| utsavo bhūkrayavikrayau kṛṣiścāpaṇakriyā | kośasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ ceti śubhāni tāni śukrake || 103 || śanau gṛhapraveśaśca mantradīkṣā tathottamā | hastiprabhṛtigṛhaṇaṃ bhṛtyatānirṇayastathā || 1 04|| śastropayogaścāsatyavadanaṃ cauryamityapi | kartavyāni sthirakarmāṇyapi śubhāni vai śanau || 1 05|| rohiṇyaśvimṛgāḥ puṣyo hastaścitrottarātrayam | revatī śravaṇaṃ caiva dhaniṣṭhā ca punarvasūḥ || 1 06|| anurādhā tathā svātī śubhānyetāni bhāni vai | śubhakāryāṇi sarvāṇi siddhyantyeteṣu bheṣu ca || 107|| pūrvātrayaṃ viśākhā ca jyeṣṭhārdrāmūlamityapi | śatatārābhameteṣu kṛtyaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ bhavet || 1 08|| bharaṇī kṛttikā cāpi maghāśleṣā tathaiva ca | atyugraṃ duṣṭakāryaṃ tat kartavyameṣu bheṣu tu || 1 09|| ityevaṃ rādhike’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | krathakāya tadā prāha romāyanarṣisannidhau || 2.174.110 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne krathakarājadhānyām oṃkāreṣṭāyāṃ gatvā pūjāṃ pragṛhya viśramya caturdaśyāṃ prage nṛpapṛṣṭo harirmandirādinirmāṇe śubhakālādīn prāhetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 174 ||
<2.175> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścād yadāha bhagavān svayam | nakṣatreṣu viśeṣeṇa śubhāśubhādi karma ca || 1 || rohiṇī cottarāstistro dhruvāsaṃjñā matā yataḥ | tāsu devālayaṃ grāmakhātaṃ nṛpābhiṣecanam || 2 || sthirakāryāṇi sarvāṇi kārayettu sthirāṇyataḥ | mṛgaścitrānurādhā ca revatī mṛdusaṃjñikāḥ || 3 || mitrabhāvāstatastāsu kuryād gītaṃ ratiṃ tathā | bhūṣāṃ māṃgalyakaṃ vastraṃ dhārayet sukhadaṃ sadā || 4 || puṣyāśvinyabhijiddhastaṃ laghu kṣipramudāhṛtam | tatra bhūṣauṣadhajñānaṃ gamanaṃ śilpitā ratiḥ || 5 || jyeṣṭhārdrā mūlamāśleṣā tīkṣṇaṃ dāruṇamucyate | tatra bhedo vadho bandho mantrabhūtādisādhanam || 6 || śravaṇāditribhaṃ svātiḥ punarvasucaraṃ calam | tatra vājigajāroho vāṭikāracanādikam || 7 || bharaṇī ca maghā pūrvā krūramugramudāhṛtam | viṣaśastrāgniśatādi tatrecchedavināśanam || 8 || viśākhā kṛttikā cāpi miśraṃ sādhāraṇaṃ matam | vṛṣotsargo’gnikāryaṃ ca miśrakāryaṃ ca siddhyati || 9 || gurau puṣyaṃ cottarāśca tisro vā rohiṇī mṛgaḥ | śravaṇaṃ cāśleṣikā vā pūrvāṣāḍhā bhaved yadi || 2.175.1 0|| gururvā tatparaḥ syācced gṛhāraṃbha sutapradaḥ | rājyapradaśca vā syācca sarvasaukhyapradastathā || 11 || aśvinī citrikā śatabhiṣārdrāḥ śukrake yadi | śukro vā tatparaḥ syācced gṛhārambhodhanānnadaḥ || 12|| revatīpuṣyahastāśca pūrvāṣāḍhā maghā tathā | mūlaṃ bhaume ca vā bhaumastatparaḥ syāttadā gṛham || 1 3|| ārabdhaṃ vahnidagdhaṃ syād yadvā putraprapīḍakam | rohiṇyaśvinyuttarāphālgunīcitrakahastikāḥ || 14|| budhe vā tatparaḥ sa syād gṛhāraṃbhaḥ sutapradaḥ | bhādradvayānurādhāsvātijyeṣṭhābharaṇībhidhāḥ || 15|| śanau vā tatparaḥ śanirgṛhārambho’tra ced yadi | bhūtarākṣasavāsaḥ syād gṛhe tatra na saṃśayaḥ || 16|| kṛttikopari sūryo vā candro vā ca bhavettadā | ārabdhaṃ tu gṛhaṃ sadyo vahnibhasma prajāyate || 17|| pāpagrahairyute yadvā viddhe candre ca tārake | candratārābale hīne’pi puṣye bhe kriyāḥ khalu || 18|| siddhayantyeva na sandeho samastamaṃgalāni vai | evaṃ vicārya khātādi kartavyaṃ krathaketi vai || 1 9|| yoganāmāni ca saptaviṃśatiṃ pravadāmi te | viṣkuṃbhaḥ prītirāyuṣmān saubhāgyaḥ śobhanastathā ||2.175.20|| atigaṇḍaḥ sukarmā ca dhṛtiḥ śūlaśca gaṇḍakaḥ | vṛddhirdhruvaśca vyāghāto harṣaṇo vajrakastathā ||21 || siddhiśca vyatīpātaśca varīyān parighaḥ śivaḥ | siddhiḥ sādhya śubhaḥ śuklo brahmā aindraśca vaidhṛtiḥ ||22|| yathā nāma tathā te vai phaladāḥ sārthakā matāḥ | vaidhṛtiṃ ca vyatīpātaṃ varjayet sarvathā śubhe ||23|| vajravikumbhayostyājyaṃ ghaṭikātrayamādimam | parighārdhaṃ parityājyaṃ ghaṭikāḥ pañca śūlake ||24|| gaṇḍātigaṇḍayoḥ ṣaṭ ca vyāghāte ghaṭikā nava | tyājyā vai śubhakārye ca viruddhayogapādakam ||25|| karaṇānyatha te vacmi kistughnaṃ bavamityapi | bālavaṃ kaulavaṃ cāpi taittilaṃ ca garaṃ tathā ||26|| vaṇijaṃ viṣṭiṃ śakuniṃ catuṣpādaṃ ca nāgakam | bave pauṣṭikakarmāṇi dvijakarmāṇi bālave || 27|| kaulave strīsuhṛtkarma taittile patnikāpriyam | gare bījapraropaśca vāṇijyaṃ vaṇije caret ||28|| dāhapātādikaṃ viṣṭyāṃ na śubhaṃ tatra sañcaret | śakunāvauṣadhaṃ mantrasādhanaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ caret || 29|| rājyaṃ goviprayoḥ kāryaṃ pitṛkāryaṃ catuṣpade | saubhāgyaṃ dāruṇaṃ nāge kistughne magalaṃ caret || 2.175.30 || ekādaśyāṃ caturthyāṃ ca śukle bhadrā parāhṇake | aṣṭamyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ ca bhadrā pūrvāhṇike matā ||3 1 || tṛtīyāyāṃ daśamyāṃ ca kṛṣṇe bhadrā parāhṇake | saptamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ bhadrā pūrvāhṇike tathā ||32|| mukhe pañcaghaṭikā sā kaṇṭhe caikaghaṭīrhi sā | hṛdi daśaghaṭīrbhadrā nābhau pañcaghaṭīrhi sā |||33 || kaṭyāṃ ṣaḍghaṭikā bhadrā pucche sā ghaṭikātrayam | evaṃ triṃśadvibhāgaiśca bhadrāṃgāni tu ṣaṭ tathā ||34|| kramāt phalāni cāṃgānāṃ kāryeṣvetāni tadyathā | kāryanāśo mṛtirlakṣmīnāśo buddhilayaḥ kaliḥ ||35|| tasmād viṣṭiḥ parityājyāvaśyake cānanaṃ tyajet | devarkṣayoge some ca budhe śukre gurau yadi ||36|| bhadrā bhavet sukalyāṇī sā sarvakāryasādhikā | titheḥ pūrvārdhajā rātrau dine bhadrā parārdhajā ||37|| na vai doṣapradā bodhyā kārye tvāvaśyake sadā | meṣe vṛṣe ca mithune vṛścike candrake sthite || 38|| bhadrā tiṣṭhati vai svarge śubhā sā sarvadā matā | dhane tulāyāṃ kanyāyāṃ makare candrike sati ||39|| bhadrā pātālavāsāsti sāpi śubhā sadā matā | kuṃbhamīnakarkasiṃheṣvavasthite tu candrake ||2.175.40|| bhadrāsti mānave loke sā tyājyā śubhakarmasu | vyatīpāto vaidhṛtiśca bhadrā bhaumaḥ parāhṇake ||41 || śubhāḥ sarve tathā duṣṭatārāścāpi śubhā matāḥ | janmarāśisthite candre puṣṭiḥ phalaṃ prajāyate ||42|| dvitīyasthānage naiva sukhaṃ syādvai kadācana | tṛtīye dhanalābhaśca caturthe rogasaṃbhavaḥ ||43 || pañcame kāryanāśaśca ṣaṣṭhe dravyāgamo mahān | saptame bhūpasanmānaṃ cāṣṭame maraṇaṃ dhruvam ||44| | navame tu bhayaṃ jñeyaṃ daśame kāryasampadaḥ | ekādaśe’rthalābhaśca dvādaśe vividhāpadaḥ ||45 || dvitīyaḥ pañcamaścandro navamo dhavale śubhaḥ | kṛṣṇe tārā valavatyo grāhyāḥ śubhapradāstu tāḥ ||46|| catuṣkoṇaṃ koṣṭakaṃ ca dīrghaṃ tu navakhaṇḍakam | viśālaṃ tu trikhaṇḍaṃ ca kṛtvā sapta ca viṃśatim ||47|| khaṇḍām̐steṣvādyanavake deyā aṃkāḥ kramānnava | dvitīye navake daśāṣṭādaśāṃkāḥ kramāttathā ||48|| tṛtīye navake caikonaviṃśasaptaviṃśatiḥ | evaṃ datvā navake ca janmasaṃpat vipattathā ||49|| kṣemaṃ carma sadhanaṃ ca nidhanaṃ maitrī mitratā | nāmnī tārā tu sā bodhyā janmatārā navātmikā ||2.175.50|| prathame navake sā ca dvitīye tu karmātmikā | tṛtīye navake sā ca ādhānā procyate sadā ||51 || triṣvapi navakeṣveva prathamā ca dvitīyakā | aṣṭamī tārakā madhyaphaladā samprakīrtitā ||52|| dvitīyā pañcamī saptamī tārā hyadhamā matā | caturthī ṣaṣṭhī navamī tārā śreṣṭhā phalapradā ||53|| aśubhaṃ candramaśubhāṃ tithiṃ bhaṃ cāśubhaṃ tathā | vimṛdya phaladā tārā ṣaṭacaturthanavasthitā ||54|| yātrāyuddhavivāheṣu janmatārā na śobhanā | anyeṣu śubhakāryeṣu śubhā praveśane’pi ca ||55|| meṣe siṃhe dhane candraḥ pūrve bhavati sarvathā | vṛṣe makare kanyāyāṃ dakṣiṇe candramā mataḥ ||56|| kuṃbhe tulāyāṃ mithune paścime candramā mataḥ | karke mīne vṛścike cottare vai vartate śaśī ||57|| sanmukhe cārthalābhaṃ tu dakṣiṇe sukhasampadaḥ | paścime kurute mṛtyuṃ vāme candro dhanakṣayam ||58|| karaṇarkṣavārasaṃkrāntikutithikulikakam | praharacatuṣghaṭīmaṃgalaśaniravigraham ||59|| rāhuṃ ketuṃ cānyadoṣān haratīndustu sanmukhaḥ | rāśyekastho’pi ca candro vartate sarvadikṣvapi ||2.175.60 || pūrve saptadaśaghaṭyaḥ pañcadaśa tu dakṣiṇe | ekaviṃśatiḥ paśce cottare ghaṭyastu ṣoḍaśa ||61 || punaḥ saptadaśa pūrve caturdaśa tu dakṣiṇe | viṃśatiḥ paścime pañcadaśaghaṭyastathottare |||62|| tattaddiśāphalaṃ dadātyekarāśisthito’pi saḥ | utsave ca vivāhe ca gururvai balavān mataḥ ||63|| rājasammīlane sūryabalaṃ sarvatra ceṣyate | bhaumabalaṃ tu saṃgrāme vidyābhyāse budho balī ||64|| śukrabalaṃ tu yātrāyāṃ dīkṣāyāṃ ca śanerbalam | sarvakāryeṣu candrasya balaṃ pūrṇaphalapradam ||65|| ekādaśyāṃ guruḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bhaumaḥ śukraḥ trayodaśe | navamyāmaṣṭamyāṃ pratipadi vāro ravirbhavet ||66|| dvitīyāyāṃ navamyāṃ ca daśamyāṃ somavārakaḥ | tatra bodhyaḥ siddhiyogaḥ sarvāraṃbhaprasiddhikṛt ||67|| nandā śukre budhe bhadrā śanau riktā kuje jayā | gurau pūrṇā bhavet
