siddhiryogakṛtkāryasiddhidā ||68| | ravau hasto mṛgaścandre gurau puṣyaṃ kuje’śvinau | anurādhā budhe śukre revatī rohiṇī śanau ||69|| amṛtasiddhiyogaḥ syāt sarvakāryārthasiddhikṛt | pañcamyāṃ ced bhaveddhasto raviyukto na śobhanaḥ ||2.175.70 || ṣaṣṭhyāṃ mṛgaśirā candrayukto’pi sa na śobhanaḥ | saptamyāmaśvinī bhaumayuktāpi na ca śobhanā ||7 1 || aṣṭamyāmanurādhā budhayuktāpi na śobhanā | navamyāṃ tu guruyuktaṃ puṣyaṃ naiva śubhāvaham || 72|| yadyapyamṛtasiddhiḥ sā tyaktavyā śubhakarmasu | anye’mṛtasiddhiyogāḥ sarvakāryaprasādhakāḥ ||73|| udvāhe gurupuṣyaṃ ca praveśe tu kujāśvinīm | tyajedetat prayatnena prayāṇe śanirohiṇīm ||74|| somabhīmabudhagurvanyatame vārake dine | ekapañcaṣaṭdaśaikādaśānyatamāyā tithau ||75|| anurādhārohiṇīpunarvasumaghānyatame | hastaviśākhamūlaśravaṇaprāgbhādrānyatame ||76 || nakṣatre syāt śreṣṭhaḥ kumārayogaḥ sarvasiddhikṛt | ravibhaumabudhaśukrānyatame vārake dine ||77|| dvātrasaptadvādaśapañcadaśānyatamātithau | bharaṇīmṛgapuṣyaprākphālgunīcitrānyatame ||78 || anurādhāprākṣāḍhādhaniṣṭhottarābhādrānyatame | rājayogo bhavatyeva śreṣṭhaḥ kāryārthasādhakaḥ ||79|| guruśanyanyantare caturaṣṭanavānyatame | trayodaśacaturdaśānyatare tithiviśeṣake ||2.175.80 || kārtikārdrāśravaṇottarāphālgunīsvātyanyatame | jyeṣṭhottarāṣāḍhāśatatārakārevatyanyatame ||8 1|| ṛkṣe sthavirayogaśca śreṣṭhaḥ kāryārthasādhakaḥ | bhaumaguruśanyanyatame dvāsaptadvādaśānyatame ||82|| mūlacitrādhaniṣṭhānyatame dvipuṣkarayogaḥ | śreṣṭhaḥ kāryārthadaḥ proktaḥ kāryārambhaḥ sukhapradaḥ ||83|| bhaumaguruśanyanyatame dvāsaptadvādaśānyatame | kṛttikāpunarvasūttarāphālgunikānyatame ||84|| viśākhāprāgbhādrapadottarāṣāḍhānyatamarkṣe | tripuṣkarayogaśca sarvakāryārthasādhakaḥ | |85|| ravau haste ca pañcamyāmaśubho mṛtyuyogakaḥ | some mṛge ṣaṣṭhikāyāmaśubho mṛtyuyogakaḥ ||86|| bhaume’śvinyāṃ ca saptamyāmaśubho mṛtyuyogakaḥ | budhe’nurādhāyāmaṣṭamyāmaśubho mṛtyuyogakaḥ ||87|| gurau puṣye navamyāṃ cāśubho vai mṛtyuyogakaḥ | ravāvārdrāyāṃ dvādaśyāmabalāyogako’śubhaḥ ||88|| ekādaśyāṃ mṛge sāme’balāyogo’pyaśuddhakaḥ | budhe dvaye ca rohiṇyāmabalāyogako’śubhaḥ ||89|| kṛttikāyāṃ śanau pañce’balāyogo’pyaśuddhakaḥ | kṛttikāyāṃ ravau dvādaśyāṃ bhaved viṣayogakaḥ ||2.175.90 || śatabhiṣāyāṃ saptamyāṃ bhaume viṣayogo’śubhaḥ | dvitīyāyāmāśleṣāyāṃ śanau viṣayogo’śubhaḥ ||9 1 | | bharaṇyāṃ ca ravau dagdhayogo’śubhaḥ sadā mataḥ | some citrāyāṃ ca dagdho yogo’śubhaḥ sadā mataḥ ||92|| maṃgale cottarāṣāḍhāyāṃ ca dagdho’śubhaḥ sadā | dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ budhe dagdho yogo’śubhaḥ sadā mataḥ ||93|| gurāvuttarāphālgunyāṃ dagdho yogo’śubhaḥ sadā | jyeṣṭhāyāṃ śukrake dagdho revatīyukśanāvapi ||94|| dagdho’śubhaḥ sadā bodhyaḥ kāryahānikaro hi saḥ | maghāyāṃ ca ravau yamaghaṇṭayogo’śubhastathā ||95|| viśākhāyāṃ candrake sa ārdrāyāṃ maṃgale’pi saḥ | mūle budhe yamaghaṇṭaḥ kṛttikāyāṃ gurau ca saḥ ||96|| rohiṇyāṃ śukrake so’pi haste śanau sa cāpi vai | yamaghaṇṭaḥ sadā varjyaḥ śubhaṃ naiva dadāti saḥ ||97|| sūryabhāt candranakṣatre turye ṣaṣṭhe trayodaśe | viṃśe ca navame raviyogaḥ sarvaśubhapradaḥ ||98|| anekadoṣasaṃghānāṃ dhvaṃsakaḥ śubhadaḥ sadā | ityevaṃ rādhike’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||99|| krathakaṃ prāha yat sarvaṃ mayoditaṃ tu te tathā | jñānadaṃ śubhakālānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ phalakṛttathā || 2.175.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne nakṣatreṣu śubhāśubhakāryatatphalayogakaraṇabhadrācakraśubhāśubhacandraphalatārābalacandrabalabhramaṇasiddhiyogacakraśubhāśubhayogaraviyogabalānītyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 175 ||
<2.176> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānandādyaṣṭāviṃśatiṃ tathā | yogān yānāha bhagavān krathakāya vadāmi te || 1 || ravāśvivanikāyukte some mṛgayute tathā | bhaume cāśleṣānvite ca budhe hastayute tathā || 2 || gurāvanurādhāsthite śukre cottaraṣāḍhige | śatatārānvayaśanāvānandayogaḥ siddhidaḥ || 3 || ravau bharaṇikāyukte ārdrānvite ca somake | maghāyukte maṃgale ca budhe citrāyute tathā || 4 || jyeṣṭhāyute gurau cāpi śukre’bhijitsamanvite | śanau prāgbhādrapadage yogaḥ sa kāladaṇḍakaḥ || 5 || phalaṃ mṛtyustatastyājyaḥ sarvathaiva tu karmasu | ravau tu kṛttikāyukte some punarvasusthite || 6 || maṃgale prākphālgunīsthe budhe svātiyute tathā | gurau mūlayute śukre śravaṇasthe śanau tvatha || 7 || uttarābhādrage dhūmrākṣayogaścāsukhaṃ phalam | ekaghaṭikā tyājyāsyārambhe tataḥ sukhapradaḥ || 8 || ravau tu rohiṇī some puṣyaṃ ca maṃgale tvatha | uttarāphālgunī cāpi budhe viśākhikā tathā || 9 || gurau pūrvāṣāḍhikā ca śukre dhaniṣṭhikā tathā | śanau ca revatī prajāpatiyogaḥ subhāgyadaḥ || 2.176.10 || ravau mṛgaśirā some cāśleṣā hastakaḥ kuje | budhe’nurādhā ca gurāvuttarāṣāḍhikā tathā || 11 || śukre śatatārakā cāśvinī śanau yadā bhavet | subhāgyadaḥ saumyayogaḥ tyājyaḥ pañcaghaṭīkikaḥ || 1 2|| ravāvārdrā maghā some citrā tu maṃgale tathā | jyeṣṭhā budhe’bhijid gurau pūrvābhādrapadā kavau || 1 3|| śanau tu bharaṇī dhvāṃkṣayogaḥ sa dhananāśakṛt | ravau punarvasuḥ pūrvāphālgunī somake tathā || 14|| svātiḥ kuje budhe mūlaṃ śravaṇaṃ tu gurau tathā | śukre cottarabhādrā ca kṛttikā ca śanau yadā || 15|| dhvajayogaḥ sukhado vai sarvakārye jayapradaḥ | ravau puṣyaṃ cottarāphālgunī some’tha maṃgale || 16 || viśākhā ca budhe pūrvāṣāḍhā gurau dhaniṣṭhikā | śukre revā śanau rohā sukhaḥ śrīvatsayogakaḥ || 17|| ravāvāśleṣikā some hasto’nurādhikā kuje | budhe cottaraṣāḍhā ca gurau tu śatatārakā || 18|| śukreśvinī śanau mṛgo vajrayogaḥ kṣayapradaḥ | tyājyaḥ sa pañcaghaṭikaḥ tato vai śubhadaḥ kvacit || 1 9|| ravau maghā somake tu citrā jyeṣṭhā tu maṃgale | budhe’bhijid gurau pūrvābhādrā bharaṇī śukrake || 2.176.20|| śanāvārdrā mudgarākhyayogo vai dhananāśakṛt | tyājyaḥ pañcaghaṭikaḥ sa tato vai śubhadaḥ kvacit || 21 || ravau pūrvāphākanī ca some svātiḥ kuje tvatha | mūlaṃ budhe śravaṇaṃ cottarābhādrā gurau yadā ||22|| śukre tu kṛttikāḥ śanau punarvasuryadā sa ca | chatrayogaḥ sa vai proktaḥ rājasanmānadaḥ sadā ||23 || uttarāphālgunī sūrye viśākhā somake yadā | pūrvāṣāḍhā maṃgale ca dhaniṣṭhā budhavāsare || 24|| revatī ca gurau śukre rohiṇī puṣyakaṃ śanau | mitrayogaḥ sa vai proktaḥ puṣṭidaḥ sarvakarmasu ||25||| ravau hasto’nurādhāḥ tu some ca maṃgale tvatha | uttarāṣāḍhikā cātha budhe tu śatatārakā || 26|| aśvinī ca gurau śukre mṛga āśleṣikā śanau | mānasākhyaḥ sa yogo vai sukhadaḥ sarvakarmasu ||27|| ravau citrenduke jyeṣṭhābhijid bhaume budhe tu ca | pūrvābhādrā bharaṇī syād gurāvārdrā tu śukrake ||28|| maghā śanau padmayogo dhanaprāptikaraḥ sa ca | caturghaṭiko varjyaśca tataḥ sukhaprado mataḥ ||29|| ravau svātirmūlamindro śravaṇaṃ maṃgale yadā | uttarābhadrikā budhe gurau ca kṛttikā tathā || 2.176.3 0|| śukre vasuḥ śanau prākphālgunī lambukayogakaḥ | dhanahānikaro varjyaścaturghaṭika eva saḥ || 31 || viśākhā ca ravau pūrvāṣāḍhā tu candrake yadā | dhaniṣṭhā maṃgale revā budhe gurau tu rohiṇī ||32|| puṣyaṃ śukre śanāvuttarāphālgunī yadā tadā | utpātayogo varjyaḥ sa prāṇanāśaphalo yataḥ ||33 || anurādhā ravāvuttarāṣāḍhā candraje tathā | śatatārā maṃgale cāśleṣā budhe gurau mṛgaḥ ||34|| āśleṣā śukrake hastaḥ śanau sa mṛtyuyogakaḥ | varjanīyaḥ sadā pūrṇo mṛtyuphalo yato hi saḥ ||35|| jyeṣṭhā ravāvabhijitsomake prāgbhadrikā kuje | budhe bharaṇī gurāvārdrā maghā śukre śanau tu vai ||36|| citrā sa kāṇayogaḥ kleśado varjyo ghaṭīdvayam | ravau mūlaṃ śravaḥ some uttarābhadrikā kuje ||37|| kṛttikā budhake vasurgurau śukre prākphālgunī | svātiḥ śanau siddhayogaḥ kāryasiddhiḥ phalaṃ bhavet ||38|| pūrvāṣāḍhā ravau some dhaniṣṭhā revatī kuje | budhe rohā gurau puṣyamuttarāphālgunī kavau ||39|| śanau viśākhā śubhayogaḥ sa kalyāṇakārakaḥ | ravau tu cottarāṣāḍhā śatatārā tu candrake ||2.176.40|| aśvinī maṃgale mṛgaśirā budhe gurau tu vai | āśleṣā śukrake hastaḥ śanau tathānurādhikā ||41|| amṛtasiddhiyogaḥ sa rājamānādisampadaḥ | ravāvabhijit pūrvābhādrapadā candrake tathā ||42|| bharaṇī maṃgale cārdrā budhe maghā gurau bhavet| | citrā śukre śanau jyeṣṭhā mūśalayoga ucyate ||43|| dhanakṣayakaraḥ catuṣghaṭiko varjya eva saḥ | ravau śravaścandrake cottarābhādrapadā tathā ||44|| kṛttikā maṃgale punarvasurbudhe gurau tu vai | pūrvāphālgunikā śukre svātiḥ mūlaṃ śanau tathā ||45|| gadayogaḥ kṣayadaḥ sa varjyaḥ saptaghaṭīkakaḥ | dhaniṣṭhā tu ravau some revatī rohiṇī kuje ||46|| puṣyaṃ budhe gurāvuttarāphālgunī kavau tu vai | viśākhā ca śanau pūrvāṣāḍhā mātaṃgayogakaḥ ||47|| kulavṛddhipradaḥ so’sti śubhakṛt sarvadā mataḥ | śatatārā ravau some’śvinī mṛgaśirā kuje ||48|| āśleṣā budhake hasto gurau śukre’nurādhikā | śanāvuttarāṣāḍhā ca rākṣasī yogakaḥ sa tu ||49|| mahākaṣṭaprado varjyaḥ sarvadā śubhakarmaṇi | pūrvābhādrapadā sūrye some ca bharaṇī tathā ||2.176.50 || ārdrā bhaume maghā budhe citrā gurau kavau tu ca | jyeṣṭhābhijicchanau carayogaḥ kāryasya hānikṛt ||51|| varjyaḥ sa vai trighaṭikaḥ, tato lābhakaraḥ kvacit | uttarābhadrikā sūrye candre tu kṛttikā tathā ||52|| punarvasurmaṃgale ca pūrvāphālgunikā budhe | svātirgurau kavau mūlaṃ śravaṇaṃ tu śanau tathā ||53|| sthirayogo mahāraṃbhakaraḥ sarvavivardhanaḥ | ravau tu revatī candre rohiṇī puṣyakaṃ kuje ||54|| uttarāphālgunī budhe viśākhā ca gurau tathā | śukre pūrvāṣāḍhikā ca dhaniṣṭhā tu śanau yadā ||55|| vardhamānākhyayogaḥ sa lagnakaraḥ śubhaḥ sadā | ravau śukre ca pratipat candre budhe dvitīyakā |||56 || maṃgale tṛtīyā śanau caturthī pañcamī gurau | maṃgale śukrake ṣaṣṭhī budhe ca saptamī tathā ||57|| ravau śanau maṃgale vāṣṭamī navamī maṃgale | ravau śanau cātha daśamī tu gurau ca candrake ||58|| ekādaśī gurau śukre dvādaśī budhavāsare | maṃgale śukrake trayodaśī śanau caturdaśī ||59|| gurau pañcadaśī cet syāt siddhiyogaḥ śubhāvahaḥ | athānyānaśubhān yogān dvādaśa pravadāmi te ||2.176.60|| hutāśanaśca dagdhaśca viṣaśca krakacastathā | saṃvartaścaturthīgṛhaṃ mṛtyuśca vajrapātakaḥ ||6 1|| kālamukhastathā jvālāmukho varjyo’śubhāstvime | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ candraśca saptamyāṃ maṃgalaśca budhe’ṣṭamī ||62|| navamyāṃ ca guruḥ śukre daśamyekādaśī śanau | dvādaśyāṃ tu ravirhutāśanayogo’śubhaḥ sadā ||63|| tṛtīyāyāṃ budhaḥ pañcamyāṃ bhaumaḥ ṣaṣṭhake guruḥ | śukro’ṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ ca śaniścandre hyekādaśī ||64|| ravau ca dvādaśī dagdhayogo’śubhaḥ sadā mataḥ | dvitīyāyāṃ budhaḥ sūryaścaturthyāṃ ṣaṣṭhake śaśī ||65|| śanirbhaumaśca saptamyāmaṣṭamyāṃ ca gurustathā | navamyāṃ śukrako yatra viṣayogo bhayāvahaḥ ||66|| ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śaniśca saptamyāṃ śukro’ṣṭamyāṃ gurustathā | navamyāṃ budha evāpi daśamyāṃ maṃgalastathā ||67|| ekādaśyāṃ candrakaśca dvādaśyāṃ ca ravistathā | krakacākhyaḥ sa yogo vai aśubhaḥ sarvathā mataḥ ||68|| ādye budhaḥ saptame’rkaḥ saṃvartayogako’śubhaḥ | ādye śanirdvitīye śukrastṛtīye gurustathā ||69|| caturthyāṃ budhakaḥ pañcamyāṃ bhaumaḥ ṣaṣṭhake śaśī | saptamyāṃ ca raviḥ caturthīgṛhayogako’śubhaḥ ||2.176.70|| ādye gururmaṃgalaśca dvitīye śukrako guruḥ | tṛtīye ca budhaḥ śukraścaturthe śukrako guruḥ ||71|| pañcamyāṃ śanirarke ca gurau ca ṣaṣṭhikā tathā | ravau candre gurau śukre saptamī budhake’ṣṭamī ||72|| navamī śukrake śanau daśamī ca tataḥ param | ekādaśyāṃ ravirbhaumo dvādaśyāṃ candrako guruḥ ||73|| trayodaśyāṃ budhacandrau pañcadaśyāṃ śanistathā | caturdaśyāṃ budhaśukraravayo mṛtyuyogakaḥ ||74|| aśubho mṛtyukaraṇaḥ tyājya eṣaḥ sadā tu saḥ | anurādhā dvitīyāyāṃ tṛtīye cottarātrayam ||75|| pañcamyāṃ tu maghā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ rohiṇī ca tataḥ param | hastaṃ mūlaṃ ca saptamyāṃ pūrvābhādrapadāṣṭame ||76|| navamyāṃ kṛttikā caikādaśyāṃ tu rohiṇī yadi | citrā svātistrayodaśyāṃ yogaḥ sa vajrapātakaḥ ||77|| vajrapātasamaṃ duḥkhaṃ karoti karmasu dhruvam | anurādhā tṛtīyāyāṃ caturthyāmuttarātrayam ||78|| pañcamyāṃ ca maghāṣṭamyāṃ rohā navame kṛttikā | kālamukhākhyayogaḥ sa sadā cāśubhapākadaḥ ||79|| mūlaṃ pratipadi cāpi bharaṇī pañcamīdine | aṣṭamyāṃ kṛttikā rohā navamyāṃ daśame’śliṣā ||2.176.80|| jvālāmukhaśca yogaḥ sa sadodvegakaro’śubhaḥ | saptamyāṃ bharaṇī puṣyaṃ navamyāṃ daśame’śliṣā ||8 1 || trayodaśyāṃ citrikā ca varjyayogo’śubho hi saḥ | ādye sūryo maṃgalaśca dvitīye śukrakaḥ śaśī |||82|| tṛtīyāyāṃ budho guruścaturthyāṃ paṃcame śaniḥ | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ sūryo maṃgalaśca saptamyāṃ śukrakaḥ śaśī ||83|| budho’ṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ ca gururdaśamake śaniḥ | ekādaśyāṃ ravirbhaumaścandraśukrau tu dvādaśe ||84|| budhastrayodaśe guruścaturdaśe pūrṇe śaniḥ | aśubhayogāḥ proktāste sarvakāryavighātakāḥ ||85|| jyeṣṭhāmūlarkṣayoḥ sandhau revatyaśvibhayostathā | āśleṣāmaghayorantarāle ghaṭīcatuṣṭayam ||86|| dve pūrvāyā dve paścāyā ghaṭyau gaṇḍāntayogakaḥ | tyājyaḥ so’pi śubhakārye phalāniṣṭo hi gaṇḍakaḥ ||87|| antare pañcamīṣaṣṭhyoḥ sandhau pṛrṇāpratipadoḥ | daśamyekādaśīsandhau gaṇḍānto ghaṭikādvayam ||88|| navamyante dve ghaṭike pañcamyante ghaṭī tathā | caturthyante’rdhaghaṭikā gaṇḍāntaṃ tyājyamityapi ||89|| karkasiṃhāntarālaṃ ca mīnameṣāntarālakam | vṛścikadhanuṣyamadhyaṃ ghaṭī gaṇḍāntakaṃ smṛtam ||2.176.90 || ravitaḥ śaniparyantaṃ muhūrtāḥ kramaśastvime | caturdaśadvādaśadaśāṣṭaṣaṭcaturdviprakhāḥ || 91 || kulikayogarūpāste tyājyāḥ śubhe tu karmaṇi | budhato bhaumaparyantaṃ muhūrtāṃkāsta eva tu || 92|| kramaśaḥ kaṇṭakayogarūpāstyājyāsta ityapi | guruto budhaparyantaṃ mūhūrtāṃkāsta eva tu || 93 || kramaśaḥ kālavelākhyayogastyājyaḥ sa eva ca | śukrato guruparyantaṃ muhūrtāṃkāsta eva tu || 94 yamaghaṇṭaḥ kramaśo vai tyājyaḥ sa śreṣṭhakarmasu | divase te kulikādyāścoktā rātrau tvatha śṛṇu ||95 || ravitaḥ śaniparyantaṃ muhūrtāḥ kramaśastvime | trayodaśaikādaśanavasaptapañcatryekakāḥ ||96|| kulikayogarūpāste tyājyāḥ śubhe tu karmaṇi | budhato bhaumaparyantaṃ ta evāṃkāstu kaṇṭakaḥ ||97|| guruto budhaparyantaṃ teṃ’kāśca kālavelikāḥ | śukrato guruparyantaṃ teṃ’kāstu yamaghaṃṭakāḥ ||98|| tyaktavyāste niśābhāge sarvathā śubhakarmasu | ravau caturdaśaṃ muhūrtakaṃ tyājyaṃ hi duṣṭakam ||99|| tathā candre navamaṃ dvādaśaṃ tyājyaṃ hi duṣṭakam | bhaume rātrau saptakaṃ ca dine tyājyaṃ caturthakam || 2.176.10 0|| budhe’ṣṭamaṃ gurau ṣaṣṭhaṃ dvādaśaṃ tyājyamityapi | śukre turyaṃ navamaṃ ca śanāvādyaṃ dvitīyakam || 10 1|| duṣṭakṣaṇāsta ete vai tyājyāḥ śubhe tu karmaṇi | candre śubhe tu te sarve nirbalāḥ śubhaśaṃsakāḥ || 1 02|| siddhiyoge kuyogāste nirbalāḥ siddhiśaṃsakāḥ | ravau gaganamadhyasthe muhūrte’bhijidāhvaye || 103 || ghaṭīdvayaṃ sarvadoṣān hanti jayamuhūrtakam | tatrārabdhaṃ sarvakāryaṃ jayadaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 04| | saptāṃgulā yaṣṭikā ca sthāpanīyā kṣitau tataḥ | chāyā tasyāḥ pradraṣṭavyā siddhacchāyābhidhā yathā || 1 05|| ravau caikādaśāṃgulā some sārdhāṣṭakāṃgulā | bhaume navāṃgulā dīrghā budhe’ṣṭāṃguladīrghikā || 1 06|| gurau saptāṃgulā śukre sārdhāṣṭāṃguladīrghikā | śanau sārdhāṣṭāṃgulā ca yadā sūryakṛtā bhavet ||107|| siddhicchāyāmuhūrtaṃ tat duṣṭān karoti śobhanān | ṛkṣaṃ tithiṃ dinaṃ tārāṃ candraṃ grahaṃ tadādikān || 1 08|| uktānetān vicāryaiva kāryaṃ khātādikaṃ śubham | ityāha śrīhariṃ rādhe krathakaṃ bhūpatiṃ tadā ||1 09|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne ānandādyaṣṭāviṃśatiyogatithivāranakṣatrotpannaduṣṭayogatrividhagaṇḍāntayogakulikādimuhūrtaduṣṭamuhūrtābhijicchāyāmuhūrtādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 176 ||
<2.177> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike coccagrahādikaṃ yathā hariḥ | krathakāyāha tadvacmi tathānyadaupayogikam || 1 || meṣasyārko vṛṣasyendurnakrasya maṃgalastathā | kanyāyāśca budhaḥ karkarāśergurustathā khalu || 2 || mīnasya śakrastulāyāḥ śaniścoccasthitā hi te | tulāyāśca ravirvṛścikasya candrastathā khalu || 3 || karkasya maṃgalo mīnasya ca budhastathā khalu | makarasya guruḥ kanyāyāḥ śukro meṣago śaniḥ || 4 || nīcasthānagatā ete bodhyā naiva sukhapradāḥ | rāhorgṛhaṃ tu kanyāsti mithunaṃ coccakālayam || 5 || dhanurnīcaṃ sthānameva bodhyaṃ tathā phalaṃ hyapi | dviḥ svabhāve sthire lagne tyaktvāṣṭamaṃ ca dvādaśam || 6 || sthānamanyeṣu sthāneṣu bhavanti cet| śubhagrahāḥ | ekādaśe ca ṣaṣṭhe tu pāpagrahā bhavanti cet || 7 || gṛhasaudhamandirāṇāmārambhastatra śobhanaḥ | lagne gurau ravau ṣaṣṭhe saptame ca budho yadi || 8 || caturthe śukrakaḥ śanistṛtīye cet tadā yadi | gṛhādyāraṃbhaṇaṃ kuryāt śatavarṣāyureva tat| || 9 || lagne śukre tṛtīye’rke ṣaṣṭhe bhaume gurustvapi | pañcame cet gṛhaṃ kuryāt śatadvayāyureva tat || 2.177.1 0|| sūrye caikādaśe lagne śukre daśamage budhe | tatra kuryād gṛhādyaṃ cet śatavarṣāyureva tat || 1 1|| gurau turye śanau bhaume caikādaśe’tha candrake | daśame ced gṛhaṃ kuryādaśītyāyurbhaveddhi tat || 12||| śukre ucce ca vā lagne gurau lagne vā turyake | ucce caikādaśe vā ca śanau sampatpradaṃ gṛham || 1 3||| lagne syāccet karkacandro guruḥ syāt kendrake yadi | anyagrahā uccarāśau mitrarāśau ca vā yadi || 14|| tadyoge mandiraṃ jātaṃ lakṣmīdaṃ śāśvataṃ bhavet | mīnarāśerlagnake ca śukraśca vartate yadi || 15|| karkaguruścaturthe ca bhavane vartate yadi | tulāśaniśca vaikādaśake bhavanake bhavet || 16|| prārabdhaṃ tu gṛhaṃ lakṣmīpradaṃ cirāyureva tat | sarve grahā dvādaśe cāṣṭame sthāne na śobhanāḥ || 17|| kendratrikoṇadhanurgāḥ pāpagrahā na śobhanāḥ | lagnacandro budhayuktaścāpi naiva sa śobhanaḥ || 18|| aṣṭamasthaḥ candramāḥ sa śobhano naiva naiva ca | sarve grahā bhaveyuśca nīcāṃśe tatra nirmitam ||1 9|| gṛhaṃ vai nirdhanaṃ syācca tatra kāryaṃ na sarvathā | ko’pyekaśca grahaḥ śatragrahasya navamāṃśake ||2.177.20|| sthito’pi daśame vā saptame syāccet tathā punaḥ | lagneśo yadi vai nirbalo bhavet tatra mandiram ||2 1 || kṛtaṃ varṣāntare syāt tatparahastagataṃ dhruvam | lagnasvāmī janmasvāmī rāśisvāmī ca yo grahaḥ ||22|| tathā candro guruḥ śukraścaite’nastagatā yadi | tathā svoccasthale svakṣetrake svāṃśe bhavanti cet| ||23|| tadārabdhaṃ gṛhaṃ saukhyaśrīpradaṃ jāyate sadā | atha pratiṣṭhāsamaye sūryaścellagnakuṇḍale |||24|| triṣaḍdaśaikādaśeṣūpacayasthānakeṣu cet| | bhavecchreṣṭhastathaiva syāccandro’pyuktasthaleṣu cet| ||25|| dhanurdharmasthānayukṣu bhavecchreṣṭhastathāvidhaḥ | bhaumaḥ śanistṛtīye caikādaśe ṣaṣṭhake śubhāḥ ||26|| budho gururdvādaśāṣṭabhinnasthāneṣu vai śubhau | ekadvātracatuḥpañcanavasthāneṣu cet kaviḥ ||27|| daśaikādaśayoścāpi vartate śreṣṭha eva saḥ | pāpagrahāḥ ravirbhaumaḥ śaniśca rāhuketukau ||28|| ādye’ṣṭame pañcame saptame cet syustadā ca te | tathā śubhagrahāḥ syuraṣṭame śaśī tathādyake ||29|| ṣaṣṭhe’ṣṭame bhavet kuṇḍalīgrahāstyājyakā ime | siṃhalagne sūryadevapratiṣṭhā tu śubhā matā ||2.177.3 0|| harasya mithune kanyālagne viṣṇormamāpi ca | kuṃbhe tu brahmaṇaścaralagne kṣudrasurasya ca || 3 1|| yoginīnāṃ tathā lagne care vai sthāpanaṃ matam | lagne tu dvisvabhāve devīnāṃ susthāpanaṃ varam ||32|| sthire lagne sarvadevapratiṣṭhā cottamā matā | pratiṣṭhākuṇḍale cādyabhavane mṛtyudaḥ śaśī ||33|| dvitīye tu dhanuḥsthāne dhānyavṛddhipradaḥ śaśī | parākrame tṛtīye tu kleśado vai bhavecchaśī ||34|| pañcamasthaḥ śaśī gotrasantānakṣayakārakaḥ | śatruto bhayadaḥ ṣaṣṭhe saptame duḥkhadaḥ śaśī ||35|| aṣṭame mṛtyudo vighnapradaśca navame śaśī | daśame baladaścaikādaśastho dhanadaḥ śaśī || 36 || dvādaśastho vyayakārī bodhyaścandro hi kuṇḍale | śubho’pi candramāḥ pāpagrahāt cet saptame sthale || 37|| aśubhaḥ syāttathā pāpagrahayukto’pyaśuddhakaḥ | tathā pāpagrahamadhye’śubhaḥ kṣīṇo’pyaśuddhakaḥ ||38|| nīcagaśca śanuvargagaścāpyaśobhano bhavet | yadi candro gurudṛṣṭyā yuktaścet śubhako bhavet ||39|| svakarkarāśigaḥ syādvā uccago vā śubho bhavet | śubhagrahanavāṃśasthaḥ svādhimitranavāṃśagaḥ ||2.177.40|| bhavedvāpi tadāśubhaḥ śaśī syācchubha eva saḥ | candrāccādye caturthe saptame ca daśame sthale ||41 || yadi krūro grahaḥ syāt tatkramāt yogāstvime’śubhāḥ | āpīḍā cāpi saṃpīḍā bhṛgvādyā vartitā tathā ||42|| tatra kārye kṛte svasya bandhornāryāśca karmaṇaḥ | caturṇṇāṃ vai vināśaḥ syāt tatra kāryaṃ na cārabhet ||43 || yatra rāśau bhaveccandrastatra krūragraho’pi cet | tadā yutirbhaveddoṣastyājyaḥ śubhe tu karmaṇi ||44|| budhena guruṇā yukte candre doṣo yutirna vai | abdāyanartumāsarkṣapakṣadagdhāhasaṃbhavāḥ ||45|| andhakāṇādilagnotthāḥ sapāpendunavāṃśajāḥ | doṣā naśyanti gurujñaśukraiḥ kendratrikoṇagaiḥ ||46 || kunavāṃśagrahodbhūtāḥ ṣaḍvargakṣaṇalagnajāḥ | śaśinyekādaśe doṣāḥ sarve naśyanti tadbalāt ||47|| lagne vargottame vendau ravau caikādaśe’thavā | kendre koṇe guruḥ syāccet doṣā naśyanti tadbalāt ||48|| tyaktvā vai saptamaṃ sthānaṃ kendre trikoṇake budhaḥ | śatadoṣānapi hanti teṣu śukraḥ śatadvayam ||49|| teṣu gururlakṣadoṣān hanti kāryaṃ śubhaṃ bhavet | lagneśo lagnake syādvā navāṃśe vā bhaved yadi ||2.177.50|| ekādaśe vā kendre vā sarvadoṣavināśakṛt | lagnabale cottame kuyogā na doṣadāḥ kvacit ||51 || śuklādyadivasād gaṇayitvā vai tithisaṃkhyakām | ravervārād vārasaṃkhyāmaśvinyā ṛkṣasaṃkhyakām ||52|| tadaṃkasaṃkhyāḥ sammiśrya bhaṃktavyāsturyasaṃkhyayā | ekaśeṣe sthitā pṛthvī gṛhāraṃbhe kalipradā ||53|| dviḥśeṣe kṣitirāsīnā śubhā triḥśeṣake’pi ca | śūnye śeṣe jāgratī sā gṛhārambhe tvaniṣṭadā ||54|| evaṃ vilokya sarvaṃ vai krathakātra sumandiram | prakāraya mamārthaṃ tvaṃ pūjāsevādilabdhaye ||55|| ityuktvā virarāmeśaḥ pareśaḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | krathakastad vaco dhṛtvā pupūja parameśvaram ||56|| romāyanastathā cānye pupūjuśca prajājanāḥ | hariṃ ca nagare tatra bhrāmayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||57|| yānavāhanavādyādyairmaṃgalaiḥ svāgatādibhiḥ | upadābhiranantābhirarcayāmāsuracyutam ||58|| hariḥ sarvaṃ dadau tatra romāyanamahātmane | prajābhyaśca dadau prāsādikaṃ rājñe kuṭumbine ||59|| nagarīṃ pāvanīṃ kṛtvā harmyāṇi śreṣṭhināṃ tathā | āgatya rājasaudhaṃ ca bhojanaṃ sa upādade ||2.177.6 0|| sarve te bhojanaṃ cakrustato nṛpasya kanyakāḥ | pañca divyātmavettryaśca harestu jagṛhuḥ karam ||6 1|| kumāradānaṃ madhyāhne hyabhūt tāśca tataḥ param | kumāreṇa samaṃ rājyānniryayurhariṇā saha ||62|| vimānenarṣayaḥ sarve lomaśādyā haripriyāḥ | brahmapriyāstathā sarve vidāyaṃ prāpya niryayuḥ ||6 3|| prasthāpitāśca rājñā te rājamānapuraḥsarāḥ | kṛpāsthalādrinṛpatipṛthunā prārthitāstataḥ ||64|| pṛthunā bhūbhṛtā sākaṃ kṛpāsthalarṣiṇā tathā | prajājanairyutaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vihāyasā ||65|| mārgeṇa divyayānena rājadhānīṃ jarasthalīm | vyomnā vilokayāmāsū rādhike’raṇyaśobhitām ||66|| kṛtasvāgataśobhāḍhyāṃ pṛthāpagātaṭasthitām | vīkṣya prajā vimānaṃ ca cakrurjayetighoṣaṇām ||67|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne uccanīcagrahaphalaṃ, pratiṣṭhāne lagnakuṇḍalīsthagrahāṇā phalaṃ, candraphalam, āpīḍādiyogāḥ, yutidoṣaḥ, lagnabalaṃ, pṛthivī suptetyādiparīkṣā, tato nagarībhrāmaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ vidāyaṃ, pṛthurājadhānīṃ jarasthalīmāgamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 177 ||
<2.178> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike devi prāṇapriye surūpiṇi | jarasthalīṃ yayau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vimānataḥ || 1 || pṛthurājakuṭumbaṃ ca sahābhūt hariṇā tadā | vimānasthaṃ svāgatārthaṃ cāvārohayadacyutam || 2 || vādyaghoṣairjayanādairyantrasphoṭanaghoṣaṇaiḥ | bherīḍaṃkakavigalaiḥ kṛtadhvānairninādayan || 3 || rājā gṛhṇan hārapūjāṃ samīpastho’bhavad bhuvi | pṛthātīre mahodyāne rājasaudhavirājite || 4 || viśāle bhūtale vyomno hyavārohayadīśvaraḥ | dadau hārān svayaṃ rājā śrīśāya paramātmane || 5 || rājño kṛpī dadau hārān kaṃbharāyai śriyai tadā | tasyāḥ kumārikā hārān dadrurbrahmapriyāgale || 6 || viṃśatisaṃkhyakāḥ sarvāḥ pupūjuścāparā api | kumārāḥ śatasaṃkhyāśca pupūjuśca ṛṣīṃstathā || 7 || svāgataṃ kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭvā rājā nyaṣādayaddharim | divye siṃhāsane rājasabhāsthe janatānvitaḥ || 8 || hariśca janatāḥ sarvāḥ papraccha kuśalaṃ śubham | caturdaśyāṃ tadā sāyaṃ nagare’bhrāmayaddharim || 9 || tato nadītaṭe gatvā sandhyāṃ rātrau samācarat| | śrīhariḥ ṛṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ tato bhojanamācarat || 2.178.10 || rātrau viśrāntimāsādya prātarbubodha satvaram | nityapūjādikaṃ kṛtvā sabhāyāṃ rājapūjitaḥ || 1 1|| upadeśaṃ dadau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | rājan varṣāsu cābhrāṇi jāyante yānti līnatām || 1 2|| tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni jāyante ca viśanti ca | adya vā śvaḥ paraśvo vā tato’gre vā viyojanam || 13|| saṃghātānāṃ militānāṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | garbhe dehā vipacyante bahiḥ puṣṭiṃ prayānti ca || 14|| jarāyāṃ khalu jātāyāṃ hasantyeva vichittaye | asthiraṃ mānasaṃ yadvaccañcalaṃ ca pratārakam || 15|| tathā varṣmāpi boddhavyaṃ viśeṣo nātra vidyate | kadā kvaitad viyuktaṃ ca bhaviṣyatīti mānavaḥ || 16|| nirṇetuṃ naiva śaknoti rakṣitaṃ cāpi yāsyati | rājyaṃ kulaṃ kuṭumbaṃ ca jñātiḥ prajāśca sevakāḥ || 17|| pūrvakarmānusāreṇa striyo’patyāni santi ca | bhagavatprāptireteṣāṃ bahupuṇyaiḥ prajāyate || 18|| tava puṇyasya nānto’sti kuṭumbasyāpi te nṛpa | yenādya tvadgṛhe vāso maharṣīṇāṃ mayā saha || 19|| prajānāṃ te mahadbhāgyaṃ yāsāṃ vai darśanaṃ mama | rāṣṭraṃ puṇyaṃ tava cādya jātaṃ tīrthasvarūpakam ||2.178.20 || ityevaṃ śrīhariṃ tatropadiśantaṃ nṛpaḥ svayam | papraccha śrīhariṃ natvā nijapūrvabhavādikam ||2 1 || ko’hamāsaṃ purā kṛṣṇa ka ime mama bāndhavāḥ | kuṭumbaṃ ca mama sarvaṃ prajā me vada mādhava ||22|| itipṛṣṭo hariḥ prāha śṛṇu rājan kathāṃ tava | purā kalpe bhavānāsīnmuniścāraṇyakābhidhaḥ ||23|| vanyaphalādano vṛkṣastambe vāsakaraḥ sadā | mahāmārgāṣṭakaṃ yatra yujyate svāśramāntike ||24|| mānavā mārgakairyānti cāyānti ca tavāśrame | viśramya ca kṣaṇaṃ bhuktvā tvaddattāni phalāni tu ||25|| pītvā jalaṃ ca natvā tvāṃ prayānti ca yatheṣṭakam | teṣāṃ sevā tvayā tatra phalairjalairvidhīyate ||26|| bṛsyādibhiścāśrayasya pradānena ciraṃ muhuḥ | nijasevāṃ bhavām̐staiścākārayannaiva sarvathā ||27|| yatastvaṃ jñānavānāsīḥ ṛṇaṃ kāryaṃ na sarvathā | dātavyameva sarvebhyo grāhyaṃ naiva rajo’pi tu ||28|| pratigrahe tathādāne teṣāmṛṇaṃ prajāyate | mānuṣyeṇa tu dehena ṛṇaṃ kāryaṃ na vai kvacit ||29|| ṛṇakartā punarjanma sameti nātra saṃśayaḥ | sevayā jāyate mokṣaḥ sevayā svargamāpyate ||2.178.3 0|| sevābhiścāśiṣaḥ prāpya bhavanti cirajīvinaḥ | dattaṃ sarvaṃ purā paścādāpyate niyamād dhruvam ||3 1 || tasmād deyaṃ yathāśakti dātavyaṃ śraddhayā muhuḥ | puṃse nāryai prāṇine vā yasmai kasmaicidātmane || 32|| evaṃ matvā tvayā dattaṃ bahvātmānaḥ prasāditāḥ | tavāśrame tadā pañcaviṃśatiḥ ṛṣayo’bhavan ||33 || tvayā tulyāḥ sevakāste sarvasevāparāyaṇāḥ | evaṃ bhavadbhiḥ sarvaiścānāthā nāryo narādayaḥ ||34|| sevitā āśrayaṃ datvā bālāśca vanavāsinaḥ | yuṣmākamāśrame saukhyaṃ dṛṣṭvā sevāṃ vilokya ca ||35|| daridrāśca tathānāthāstatra nyūṣurnirantaram | ṣaḍviṃśatibhūsurāṇāmājñāyāṃ tu sthitāḥ sadā ||36|| sevante’bhyāgatān sarvān puṇyaṃ cāpyarjayanti hi | sakāmāḥ sarva evai te sevakāḥ sevayanti vai || 37|| ṛṣīṇāmāśritāścāśramasthā jātāḥ kuṭumbavat | maṇḍalaṃ tanmanuṣyāṇāṃ sahasrottaratāṃ gatam ||38|| ṣaḍviṃśatyāśritaṃ tadvai vartate sevakādivat | taiśca vijñānavārtāyāṃ paralokagatau kila ||39|| prārthitāśca bhavanto’gresarā viprā dayālavaḥ | asmān vihāya gantavyaṃ naiva yuṣmābhiravyayam ||2.178.40|| svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca vā viprā nītvā gantavyameva naḥ | āśriteṣu tathāstviti dayayā cārpitaṃ vacaḥ ||41|| dayaiṣā bandhanarūpā varivarti bhavatkṛte | sādhubhistu dayā kāryā jīvaduḥkhaharā śubhā ||42|| na tu kāryā tathā yatra svasyāpi bandhanaṃ bhavet | bhavadbhistu kṛtā sveṣāṃ bandhadā yatra te khalu ||43|| tatra sthātavyarūpā vai puṇyaśevadhibhiḥ purā | paropakārapuṇyena bhavanto viṃśatiśca ṣaṭ ||44|| tathā pāre sahasraṃ cāśrite yanmaṇḍalaṃ ca tat | naityake tu laye cākasmike sāyaṃ samāgate ||45|| sarve dehān vihāyaiva svargalokamito gatāḥ | tato maharlokameva gatvā niśāṃ tu vaidhasīm ||46|| kṣapayitvā punaḥ sṛṣṭau svargamāśritya devatāḥ | caturdaśa tu manavastathā dvādaśa sūryakāḥ ||47|| jātāḥ kalpe gate tatra svargavāsāḥ sukhāśrayāḥ | āśritāḥ sarva evaite ye yasya sevakāḥ purā ||48|| abhavam̐ste tathā teṣāṃ kuṭumbaṃ samajāyata | gataḥ kalpaḥ susampūrṇaḥ sevāpuṇyaiḥ purārjitaiḥ ||49|| svarge bhukto devasṛṣṭau tadāhaṃ bhagavān svayam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ||2.178.50|| rājarājasvarūpeṇa bhavatāṃ sarvasandhiṣu | paṭṭābhiṣekadātāhaṃ cābhuvaṃ tatra tatra ca ||51|| sūryāṇāṃ ca manūnāṃ ca śāsako’haṃ tadā khalu | arthitaśca bhavadbhirvai mokṣārthaṃ sevayā tadā ||52|| mayā vicārya puṇyaṃ vai hyekajanmottaraṃ tataḥ | mokṣostu bhavatāṃ ceti tathāstviti vaco’rpitam ||53|| nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma koṭikalpe gate’pi tu | svargabhogāvaśiṣṭaṃ ca bhoktavyaṃ bhūtale bhavet ||54|| karmabhogātmabhūmau tad bhogārthaṃ cāgataṃ hi vaḥ | kalpe kṣīṇe punaḥ sṛṣṭau śubhabhogārthameva ha ||55|| bhavanto’tra kuṭumbairvai saha jātā bhavanti ca | bhavānāraṇyakaścāsīt tṛtīyaśca manustataḥ ||56|| ādyaścoralaketuśca dvitīyaḥ krathako manuḥ | uṣṭrālarājā caturtho’bhūnmanustatra kalpake ||57|| haṃkāro’yaṃ pañcamo’bhūt ṣaṣṭhastu jayakāṣṭhalaḥ | tīrāṇaḥ saptamaścāsīt alvīnarastathāṣṭamaḥ ||58|| jinavarddhirnavamo’bhūd daśamastvalpaketukaḥ | ekādaśo jayakṛṣṇo dvādaśo yajñaśānakaḥ ||59|| trayodaśaścendurāyo gaṇakastu caturdaśaḥ | ete vai manavaścāsan bhavanto’trakṣitīśvarāḥ ||2.178.6 0 || athāsan dvādaśa sūryā mudrāṇḍaḥ prathamo’bhavat | līnorṇo’rko dvitīyo’bhūd vṛhaccharastṛtīyakaḥ ||6 1 || balalīnaścaturthaśca pañcamo varasiṃhakaḥ | rāyagāmalakaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ saptamaḥ phenatantukaḥ ||62|| stokahomaścāṣṭamārko navamaḥ kāṣṭhayānakaḥ | daśamaḥ kolako rājā ekādaśoṃ’garājakaḥ ||63|| śākuntarājāpyabhavat dvādaśo’rkastadā purā | evaṃ sūryā rājarājeśvarasya mama mūrtayaḥ ||64|| mamāveśena cāsan vai bhavanto viṃśatiśca ṣaṭ | rājāno’tra samudbhūtā manavo’rkāḥ śubhāśrayāḥ ||65|| rājarājeśvarayogastadāsīd bhavatāṃ tataḥ | svarge vāmanayogaśca punarāsīt pare dine ||66|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyātra kṣitau mama | mahāpuṇyapratāpena yogo jāto’sti vaḥ punaḥ ||67|| anāthā ye tu te sarve nāryo narāśca bālakāḥ | bālikāḥ sevakāḥ svarge tadāsan vaḥ kuṭumbinaḥ || 68|| atra bhūmau tu te jātāḥ kuṭumbino’pi vaḥ punaḥ | yajñe mayā samastebhyo lābho datto hi gocaraḥ ||69|| pṛṣṭaṃ yad bhavatā tasmāt kathitaṃ prāgbhavaṃ hi vaḥ | jānāmyahaṃ ca tatsarva bhavadbhirvismṛtaṃ hi tat ||2.178.70 || bhavadbhistu vane vanyairyā sevā dehināṃ kṛtā | tatpuṇyairmanurājyāni bhuktvā rājyāni vai raveḥ ||71 || adyātra śeṣabhogārthaṃ jātā rājāna eva ha | mama yogena puṇyena purātanena cāpi vai ||72|| saṃskārāṇāṃ balaiścāpi gāṃgeyāśca maharṣayaḥ | kṛpāsthalādyā deśe’tra sthitā yuṣmābhirarjitāḥ ||73|| sevitāḥ sarvathā premṇāśīrvādāścārjitāstathā | tenāhaṃ punarevātra sarvaṃ smṛtvā purātanam ||74|| vṛkāyanaṃ nīlakarṇaṃ yajñārthaṃ samapreṣayam | prabodhārthaṃ ca mokṣārthaṃ lomaśādīnmunīṃstathā ||75|| ahaṃ svayaṃ cāgato’smi smṛtvā bhaktāṃśca vastathā | imāḥ prajāśca yāḥ sarvāḥ purāsan bhavatāṃ puraḥ ||76|| śamyajanā atithayo yairjagdhāni phalāni ca | tāḥ prajā vaḥ pradeśeṣu puṇyā bhaktā bhavanti hi ||77|| teṣāṃ bhāgyaṃ paraṃ manye bhagavadyojanaṃ yataḥ | nālpapuṇyena labhyeta bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ ||78|| nālpapuṇyena labhyante sādhavo brahmavedinaḥ | nālpapuṇyena labhyante bāndhavā bhaktitatparāḥ ||79|| nālpapuṇyena labhyeta kuṭumbaṃ sevaka hareḥ | satī nārī sevikā ca putrā bhaktā nideśagāḥ ||2.178.80 || putryo bhaktiyutāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaparātmani | mṛtyā dharmayutāḥ satyavratāḥ santoṣakāriṇaḥ ||8 1 || karmacārāḥ puṣṭidāśca dharmakārye sahāyadāḥ | duḥkhe bhāgagrahāścāpi na milantyalpapuṇyataḥ ||82|| sāṃsārikaṃ sukhaṃ puṇyairlabhyate’nantakālikam | parabrahmasukhaṃ sevādharmeṇa labhyate hareḥ ||83 || asaṃkhyaṃ cāpyanantaṃ ca na ca grastaṃ kadācana | na hrastaṃ na pariṇataṃ tatsukhaṃ duḥkhavarjitam ||84|| mānuṣasya tu sāphalyaṃ rājan brahmasamarpaṇam | yuṣmābhī rājabhistattu kṛtaṃ yajñamahotsave ||85|| kṛtakṛtyā bhavanto’tra jātā mamāśrayādiha | prasanno’smi pūjito’smi sarvabhāvairmahāmakhe ||86|| gṛhe niveśito’smyadya gṛhaṃ te pāvanaṃ sadā | bhaja māṃ premabhāvena prakāraya sumandiram ||87|| pratiṣṭhāpaya māṃ tatra dvibhujaṃ parameśvaram | yathādṛṣṭaṃ yathālabdhaṃ surūpaṃ māṇikīyutam ||88|| lakṣmīyutaṃ divyabhāvaṃ prasevaya ca sarvadā | sahārdhapañcaṣaṣṭhyaṃgulocchrayaṃ ca gajāsane ||89|| tathā śrīpadmābhyāṃyuktaṃ ramāyuktaṃ mahāsane | pratiṣṭhāpaya māṃ nityaṃ prapūjaya sukhaṃ labha ||2.178.90 || ityādiśyārhaṇāṃ prāpya bhojayitvā janānatha | svayaṃ bhuktvā bahūn kṛtvā nijamantrādhisaṃśritān ||91 || prāpya viśrāntimalpāṃ ca madhyāhne rājamaṇḍalaiḥ | pradhānādyaiḥ praharānte pūjitaḥ śrīharistataḥ |||92|| iyeṣa bahudhā rājñārthitaścoṣṭrālakena ha | yugaśāvena muninā cārthitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||93|| uṣṭrālaṃ tanmahadrājyaṃ gantuṃ madhyāhnakottaram | tāvadvai pṛthurājasya kanyakāḥ viṃśatistadā ||94|| mātṛbhiḥ saha saṃgatya pūjanārthamupāyayuḥ | varamālākṣatapuṣpasugandhipātrahastakāḥ ||95|| svayaṃvarasvarūpeṇa hareḥ kaṇṭhe tu rādhike | viṃśatyā cārpitā mālā vaivāhikā hi tatkṣaṇe ||96|| kumāradānavidhinā jagṛhuśca hareḥ karam | premṇā sarvā hariṃ nibhālayāmāsuḥ samutsukāḥ ||97|| pitaraṃ tāḥ praṇamyaiva mātṝśca vṛddhamaṇḍalam | āśiṣaḥ sarvathāsādya brahmapriyāstadābhavan ||98|| utsavaḥ satvaraṃ sarvaiḥ kṛto mālādikārpaṇaiḥ | vimānāni tadāsam̐śca prasthānasamparāṇi tu ||99|| kanyakāviṃśatiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai saha | gantukāmā vimāne śrīhareḥ priyāsu sarvathā || 2.178.100 || sammīlya prasthitāścānye sarve vimānamāsthitāḥ | kuṭumbaṃ ca hareḥ sarva maharṣayastathāpare || 101|| tadā vādyānyavādyanta maṃgalaśravaṇāni vai | gītikāścāpyagāyanta kīrtanaṃ ca vyajāyata || 1 02|| ārārtrikena vidhinā puṣpāñjalyādibhistathā | vardhitaḥ śrīharistūrṇaṃ tatsthalāccāmbare’bhavat || 1 03|| jayaśabdairyantraghoṣairharṣanādaiḥ saha prabhoḥ | vimānaṃ cānyayānāni vyomnyagre’saṃcaran sukhāt || 1 04|| prajāścāgamyamevātra punarvai kṛpayā prabho | ityāhurbahudhā vākyairatoṣayan pareśvaram || 1 05|| kṣaṇamātrād rādhike vai vimānānyambarāttadā | yugaśāvena nirdiṣṭamārgeṇoṣṭrālarāṣṭrakam || 1 06|| āyayurdinapānadyāstaṭe viyānikāṃ purīm | dadarśa rādhike vyomnā rāṣṭraṃ suśobhitaṃ hariḥ || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pṛthurājadhānīṃ jarasthalīṃ gatvā svāgatamāsādya harirūpādideśa, ṣaḍviṃśatinṛpāṇāṃ prākkalpe ṛṣitvaṃ manutvaṃ sūryatvaṃ cetyāha, tato viśramya pūrṇimāyām uṣṭrālarāṣṭramupāgamadityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 178 ||
<2.179> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike rājā viyānānagarīpatiḥ | uṣṭrālaśca tathā tasya bhrātānujo’pi bhaktarāṭ || 1 || nāmnā haṃkārakaḥ saumyo guḍākeśīpurīpatiḥ | tathā bhrātā tṛtīyaśca nāmnā tu jayakāṣṭhalaḥ || 2 || prayāganagarīrājo dhārmikaḥ śubhabhāvanaḥ | trayāṇāṃ bhūbhṛtāṃ kulaguruśca yugaśāvakaḥ || 3 || rājñāṃ sarvaṃ kuṭumbaṃ ca bandhavo’nye suhṛjjanāḥ | śreṣṭhinaśca prajāḥ sarvāḥ svāgatārthaṃ harestadā || 4 || dīnapāsaritastīre mahodyānasuśobhite | viyānākhyanagaryāstu nātidūre kṛtasthale || 5 || svāgatārthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ | dhvajapatākikāḍaṃkāniśānavādyakānvitāḥ || 6 || yānavāhanaśakaṭīvimānarathasaṃhitāḥ | puṣpamālākṣatadravyacandanagandhadhāriṇaḥ || 7 || rājasainyaiḥ prajāklṛptasvasevāmaṇḍalairyutāḥ | āsan vai tatparā vyomni pratīkṣantaḥ śubhāgamam || 8 || vimānaṃ ca vimānāni sūryatulyāni tāvatā | lulokire’titejobhiścakruste tu jayadhvanīn || 9|| svāgatadhvajadānāni darśayāmāsurambare | tadā vādyānyavādyantājāyanta yantragarjanāḥ || 2.179.1 0|| vimānāvataraṇārthaṃ sūcakāḥ sūcanāṃ daduḥ | prajāḥ sarvā jayakārān jaguḥ kīrtanamiśritān || 11 || harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho | parabrahma ramākānta rādhākānta harevibho || 12|| ityevaṃ kīrtanaṃ cābhūllakṣādhimānavaiḥ kṛtam | nadītīraśca gaganaṃ kīrtanoddhoṣitaṃ hyabhūt || 13|| prajā draṣṭuṃ tadāsam̐śca udvelā iva vārdhayaḥ | pūrṇimenduṃ pratīśeśeśvareśvaraṃ prati prabhum || 14|| mahodyāne viśāle tu hareryānamavātarat | tato yānāni sarvāṇi vyomnastatra hyavātaran || 15|| nṛpatrayaṃ tadamātyāḥ svāgataṃ cakrurādarāt | prajāḥ sarvāḥ svāgataṃ ca cakrustadā hareḥ śubham || 16|| agrajena hareḥ kaṇṭhe maṇihāraḥ samarpitaḥ | dvitīyena hīramālā harergale’rpitā tadā || 17|| tṛtīyena tu sāmudramauktikasrak samarpitā | rājñībhiśca tadā svarṇamālā haraye cārpitā || 18|| putraputryādibhiḥ puṣpamālāḥ kaṇṭhe samarpitāḥ | puṣpākṣataiścandanādyaiḥ satkṛtaḥ pūjito hariḥ || 19|| prajābhiśca dhanāḍhyaiścāmātyavargaiḥ prapūjitaḥ | śrīharistatpitarau ca bhrātṝn svasāramityapi ||2.179.20|| ṛṣīn maharṣīn bhaktāṃśca brahmapriyāśca sevikāḥ | sarvān sarvāstadā rājakuṭumbādyā hyapūjayan ||2 1 || gajāsane samāsīnaṃ natvā rājakuṭumbakam | kṛtvā ca daṇḍavat pādau prakṣālya caraṇāmṛtam ||22|| papau krameṇa rājādyāḥ pradhānāśca prajāstataḥ | evaṃ susvāgataṃ kṛtvā kārayitvā ca pāyasam ||23|| pānaṃ phalādanaṃ sarvān nagaryāṃ cāpyabhrāmayan | rājyaśobhitasainyaiśca vādyairvividhakaistathā ||24|| kīrtanairnāmagānaiśca bhrāmayāmāsurutsukāḥ | hastiyānaṃ suśobhaṃ ca viśālaṃ prāsarat puraḥ ||25|| gopure kanyakābhiśca vardhitaḥ kusumākṣataiḥ | lājābhirjalakalaśairduḥkhahāñjalibhistathā ||26|| ghaṇṭāpathe cāpaṇasthairdhanikaiḥ pūjito hariḥ | mauktikaiḥ prokṣitaścāgre catuṣke vanitāgaṇaiḥ ||27|| prajābhiḥ sarvathā sarvābhiśca candanavāribhiḥ | puṣpākṣatādibhirnārikelaiḥ phalaiśca kuṃkumaiḥ ||28|| śarkarābhiḥ puṣpahāraiḥ pūjito vardhito hariḥ | sarveṣu rājamārgeṣu paurastrībhiḥ prapūjitaḥ ||29|| nirīkṣitaśca bahudhāsvarūpastṛptidaḥ prabhuḥ | kumārīṇāṃ kamanīyaḥ kumāro viditastadā ||2.179.30|| yuvatīnāṃ mugdhamūrtiryuvā suviditaḥ prabhuḥ | vṛddhānāṃ bālarūpaḥ saḥ putravadviditastadā ||3 1|| vidhavānāṃ prabhuḥ sākṣāt prāpyaḥ sa viditastadā | satīnāṃ satsvarūpaścānāthānāṃ vidito’vitā ||32|| kumārāṇāṃ śikṣakaśca yūnāṃ praśāsakastathā | jaraṭhānāṃ prāpyarūpo viditaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||33|| bhaktānāṃ premapātrāṇāṃ svāmī sa vidito hariḥ | darśakānāṃ surūpaśca yogināṃ brahmamūrtimān ||34|| ṛṣīṇāṃ śaṃkhacakrādidhṛgacyutaḥ prabodhitaḥ | sādhūnāṃ ca tadānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||31|| jñāto’bhūt sarvalokānāṃ dvibhujaḥ parameśvaraḥ | ityevaṃ nagare datvā darśanaṃ bhrāmaṇena vai ||36|| ākṛṣya janatācittānyāyayau sve nṛpālaye | viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ tatropadeśaṃ lomaśo dadau || 37|| ayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣād rājan śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | prāgbhavīyamanūnāṃ ca ravīṇāṃ bhavatāṃ kṛte ||38|| bhaktavaśyaḥ prabhuḥ sākṣād bhaktān smṛtvātra cāgataḥ | yajño homo japo mālāvartanaṃ bhajanaṃ tapaḥ ||39|| jñānaṃ dānaṃ sevanaṃ ca sākṣāt kṛṣṇe virājate | sarvadharmāśrayaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvapuṇyanidhiḥ svayam ||2.179.40|| yeṣāṃ sa militaḥ sākṣānmānavarṣisvarūpavān | teṣāṃ tāsāṃ bhavet sevā kṛṣṇarañjanakāriṇī ||41 || yathā patyau yathā patnyāṃ yathā vṛddhe ca mātari | gurau jyeṣṭhe pūjyavarge yathā sevā tathā harau ||42|| sākṣātkṛtā divyarūpā puruṣārthacatuḥpradā | gṛhadharmo yatidharmo yatra bhaktiḥ suvidyate ||43 || nityaṃ tatraiva vasatastāvubhau parameśvare | sarvātmanārpaṇe kāryaṃ parameśe parātpare ||44|| satpātraṃ bhagavān sākṣātprāpyate puṇyakoṭibhiḥ | kṣaṇaṃ vittaṃ kṣaṇaṃ cittaṃ kṣaṇo deho dhanaṃ kṣaṇam ||45|| kṣaṇena sādhanīyaḥ sa bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ | kiṃ rājyena dhanenāpi kuṭumbena janena vā ||46 || kiṃ lakṣmyā cāpi sampattyā kiṃ mānena ca vidyayā | kiṃ kṣetreṇa striyā strībhiḥ putraiḥ putryādibhiśca kim ||47|| kiṃ yānena vimānaiśca kiṃ kīrtyā yaśasāpi kim | kiṃ puṣṭena surūpeṇa śarīreṇa balena kim ||48|| yadyanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhāvena sevayā | arpaṇena ca bhaktyāpi toṣito nahi janmani ||49|| ātmā deyastvātmano yat sarvaṃ tatrārpyameva ha | bhuktirmuktiścārjanīye sarvārpaṇena cācyutāt ||2.179.50|| bhavadbhiḥ rājabhiścātra kṛto yajñaḥ śubho mahān | ayaṃ śrīkambharābālo bālakṛṣṇaḥ pratoṣitaḥ ||51|| kṛtakṛtyā bhavanto vai sarvaṃ prāptaṃ śubhāspadam | kartavyaṃ śiṣyate naiva yato’yaṃ suprasāditaḥ ||52|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau lomaśaśca tataḥ param | śrīhareścaraṇau dhṛtvā rājā svamastake nyadhāt| ||53|| rājñī rājakumārāśca rājaputryo hṛdi nyadhuḥ | ājñāṃ prāpya yayuḥ sarve harirviśrāntimāpa ha ||54|| bhojanādi saṃvidhāya sarve nidrāṃ prajagṛhuḥ | prātarutthāya ca nityaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā haristataḥ ||55|| niṣasādāsane ramye maharṣikulapūjitaḥ | tāvad rājā tathā rājñī putryaḥ putrāḥ samāyayuḥ ||56|| uṣṭrālaścāpi haṃkāro jayakāṣṭhala ityapi | prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ ciravāsārthamīśvaram ||57|| hariḥ prāhādya bhavatāṃ janmasāphalyameva tu | darśanātpūjanājjātaṃ prasannatārjitā mama ||58|| yenāhaṃ samprasannaḥ syāṃ tadvidheyaṃ sadānaghāḥ | ciravāsāya samayo vidyate nahi sarvathā ||59|| haṃkārasyālaye rāṣṭre gantavyamapi vidyate | jayakāṣṭhalarājye ca gantavyamapi vidyate ||2.179.6 0|| atra lābho gṛhītaśca santuṣṭo’smyatra pūjayā | caraṇasparśanaṃ bhūmau rājyālaye bhavediti ||6 1|| bhavatāṃ kāmanāpūrtiṃ karomyadyaiva dhāryatām | adya prātardugdhapānaṃ kṛtvā vimānayānakaiḥ ||62|| sarvairgantavyamevādye haṃkārālayarāṣṭrake | madhyāhne bhojanaṃ tatra nagarabhramaṇaṃ tathā ||63|| pādanyāsādikaṃ kṛtvā madhyāhnottarameva tu | jayakāṣṭhalarājye vai gantavyaṃ tu tadālaye ||64|| tatra puryāṃ bhramitvā ca pāvayitvā tadālayam | rātrau ca bhojanaṃ kṛtvā viśramya ca niśāṃ tataḥ ||65|| aruṇodayavelāyām ālvīnarasya rāṣṭrakam | gantavyaṃ ceti tadrītyā kurvantu cānukūlatām ||66|| mamājñā sarvathā pālyā sukhaṃ tatraiva vidyate | svalpe’pi samaye dāsye saukhyaṃ saṃkhyāvivarjitam ||67|| ityāśrutya hareścājñāṃ bhrātarastraya eva te | prasannā bhagavadvākye tathaiva cakrurādarāt ||68|| uṣṭrālasyārhaṇāṃ prāpya prasthānāya samudyatam | bhagavantaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vai rādhike tadā ||69|| uṣṭrālasya sutāḥ pañca pūjanaṃ cakrurādarāt | putryo daśa hareḥ pāṇiṃ jagṛhuḥ patikāmyayā ||2.179.70|| pitṛbhyāṃ moditāstatra vivāhavidhinā harim | prāpurbrahmapriyāṇāṃ maṇḍale’milansamutsukāḥ ||7 1 || āśīrvādām̐stadā nītvā prasthānamāsthitāstadā | prasthitena ca hariṇā sārdhaṃ kanyāśca bhūbhṛtaḥ ||72|| vimānānyadhiruhyātha vyomnā śīghraṃ pratasthire | guḍākeśīṃ rājadhānīṃ haṃkārarājapālitām ||73|| kṣaṇamātreṇa saṃprāpuḥ śṛṇvanto jayaghoṣaṇām | tyaktaiḥ purogataiścāpi śrāvitāṃ maṃgalānvitām ||74|| dīnapāyāḥ saritaśca taṭe sthitāṃ suśobhitām | guḍākeśīṃ tu nagarīṃ mahodyānasamanvitām ||75|| śṛṃgāritāṃ gopurādyaistoraṇaiḥ kalaśādibhiḥ | raṃgavallīsvastikādyairdhvajacihnairalaṃkṛtām ||76|| sammārjitāṃ gandhajalaiḥ saṃsiktāṃ vādyanāditām | svāgatārthaṃ prajābhiśca pura āgatya garjitām ||77|| haṃkāraḥ sakuṭumbaścānujena saha pūrvagaḥ | svāgataṃ sainyasahitaścakre jayadhvajādibhiḥ ||78|| vimānaṃ tatsūcanānusāreṇa yugaśāvakaḥ | ṛṣiḥ saudhasya nikaṭe vyomno’vātārayattadā ||79|| vimānāni cāvaterustathānyāni tadāmbarāt | tūpaśabdāstadā jātā jayanādāḥ sakīrtanāḥ ||2.179.80|| harirvimānatastūrṇaṃ cāvatīrṇo mahītale | rājā haṃkārakeṇāpi kuṭumbena haristadā ||81 || vardhito vai jayadhvānaiḥ pūjitaścandanādibhiḥ | hareścaraṇau prakṣālya rājādyāśca papurjalam |||82|| tato’śvayāne śrīkṛṣṇaṃ samāropya purīṃ prati | utsavena saha ninye rājā tadrājamārgakam ||83|| sthale sthale hariṃ natvā prajāḥ pupūjurādarāt | upadāḥ pradaduścakrurdarśanaṃ vandanādikam ||84|| amātyāḥ svagṛhān nītvā cakruścārārtrikaṃ prabhoḥ | prajāḥ svasvagṛhān nītvā pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ||85|| evaṃ kṛtvā pāvanīṃ ca guḍākeśīṃ purīṃ tataḥ | rājālayaṃ yayuḥ sarve hariḥ svarṇarathāttadā ||86|| avatīrya drutaṃ snātvā madhyāhnavidhimācarat | devāya bhojanaṃ cārpya svayaṃ sarvān nijāśritān ||87|| bhojayitvā ca bubhuje viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ | rājānaṃ suprasannaṃ ca kṛtvā datvā śubhāśiṣaḥ ||88|| madhyāhnottaravelāyāṃ vimānena sasārthakaḥ | jigamiṣurhariḥ rājñyā prārthitaḥ kanyakādibhiḥ ||89|| pūjitaśca tataḥ pañca kanyakā nṛpatestadā | pāṇiṃ jagrāha kṛṣṇasya mātrā cājñāpitāstadā ||2.179.90|| kṛtakṛtyā abhavam̐śca kuṭumbaṃ harṣitaṃ tvabhūt| | brahmapriyāsu tāḥ pañca mimīlurdivyavigrahāḥ ||91|| atha rājānamāpṛṣṭvā rājñīṃ ca tatprajājanān | harirvimānamāruhya sasārthaścāmbaraṃ yayau ||92|| tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāstadābhavan | datvā sa darśanaṃ śīghraṃ yayau prayāgapattanam ||93|| jayakāṣṭhalanṛpateḥ rājadhānīṃ śubhāśrayām | mahodyānānvitāṃ ramyāṃ sāyaṃ prāpa prabhustataḥ || 94|| jayo rājā puro gatvā svāgataṃ prajayā saha | ācarad vādyaghoṣādyairdhvajaiḥ sainyaiḥ suśobhitaiḥ ||95|| sāyaṃ dṛṣṭvā purīṃ ramyāṃ prayāgākhyāṃ vimānakam | yugaśāvoktamārgeṇa vyomnastadā bhuvaṃ prati ||96|| avātārayadīśeśaḥ śrīhariḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | vimānāni cāvateruḥ saudhasya sannidhau tadā ||97|| jalena rājā caraṇau hareḥ prakṣālya vai papau | hāramālādibhiḥ kṛtvā svāgataṃ sujalaṃ dadau ||98|| sarvān jalāni miṣṭāni pāyayitvā sasainyakaḥ | rājā svanagarīṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhrāmayāmāsa sotsavaḥ ||9 9 || prajābhirmukhyavargaiśca pūjitaḥ parameśvaraḥ | caraṇairdarśanadānaiḥ pāvayitvā purībhuvam || 2.179.10 0|| rājasaudhaṃ samāyācca bhojanādi tato’karot | sarvān vai bhojayitvaiva viśaśrāma niśāmukhe || 10 1|| tadrājyagāyakairgānaistoṣitaḥ parameśvaraḥ | tebhyo dadau copahārān pāritoṣikahīrakān || 102|| rātrau suptvā prage tūryaiḥ prabubodha haristataḥ | nityaṃ vidhiṃ brāhmakāle śīghraṃ cakāra mādhavaḥ || 103 || rājā prajāḥ samāgatyopadā nyadhurhareḥ puraḥ | bhrātṛtrayasya tatsarvaṃ yugaśāvāya sandadau || 1 04|| atha rājñī vaiṣṇavī ca pañcaputrīsamāyutā | āyayau pūjanārthaṃ ca pañcakanyāḥ prapūjya tam || 1 05|| hariṃ jagṛhuḥ kāntaṃ svaṃ matvā mohavaśaṃgatāḥ | kumāradānavidhinā vivāhya parameśvaram || 106 || kṛtakṛtyāśca tā jātāstato dugdhāni vai papuḥ | pāyayāmāsuratyarthaṃ bhagavantaṃ kuṭumbinam || 1 07|| rājānaṃ ca prajāḥ sarvāḥ pāyayāmāsa mādhavaḥ | ṛṣīn devādikān sarvān brahmapriyādikāstathā || 1 08|| dugdhādi pāyayāmāsa paramātmā sanātanaḥ | atha gantumanāḥ kṛṣṇaścāśīrvādān dadau tadā || 1 09|| sajjo’bhūcchīghramevātha prasthāpitaḥ prajādibhiḥ | vimānaṃ śīghramevādau divyaṃ samāruroha saḥ || 2.179.11 0|| anye’pyāruruhurnaijavimānāni tadā drutam | jayamaṃgalaśabdaiśca prasthānaṃ cakrire tataḥ || 111 || valgurāyapradeśānāṃ rājā tīrāṇanāmakaḥ | sakuṭumbastathā ṛṣirvalgurāyaḥ kuṭumbavān || 1 12|| vimānena hariṃ śritvā saha pūrvaṃ yayau tadā | valgurāyapradeśām̐śca harirdadarśa cāmbarāt || 1 13|| ramaṇīyān sevikāyā nadyāstaṭe suśobhanām | tīrāṇāṃ rājadhānīṃ ca tato dadarśa cāmbarāt || 1 14|| rādhike ca vimānasthā aśṛṇvan maṃgalasvanān | jayadhvānān tūpaśabdān jayaśabdān prajoditān || 1 15|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne uṣṭrālayasya haṃkārasya jayakāṣṭhalasya ca nṛpasya rājadhānīṣu vimānairgamanaṃ nagareṣu bhrāmaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ pratipadi prātastīrāṇārājadhānīṃ prati gamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 179 ||
<2.180> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca tataḥ śrīmaddhariḥ svāmī rādhike svavimānakam | valgurāyarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ tīrāṇena ca bhūbhṛtā || 1 || pradarśitena mārgeṇa samavātārayat kṣitau | tataścānyavimānāni tvavaterustu pṛṣṭhataḥ || 2 || jayaśabdāstu tūryāṇāṃ ninādāśca tadābhavan | harṣaśabdāśca nārīṇāṃ bālānāṃ kalaghoṣaṇāḥ || 3 || prajānāṃ svāgataśabdāścābhavam paritastadā | puṣpavarṣākṣatavarṣā cāndanī vṛṣṭirityapi || 4 || abhūttadā vimānādvai yadā harirbarhiryayau | anye cāpi mahīmānāścāvaterurvimānataḥ || 5 || tīrāṇākhyanṛpastatra neme caraṇayorhareḥ| kuṭumbaṃ rājakīyaṃ ca neme caraṇayorhareḥ || 6 || prakṣālya caraṇau pānaṃ vyadhuḥ sarve kuṭumbinaḥ | hemahārān ratnahārān mauktikamaṇisañjitān || 7 || hareḥ kaṇṭhe nyadhuḥ sarve parabrahmaparātmanaḥ | svāgataṃ puṣpamālābhirjayaśabdaiḥ pracakrire || 8 || reṇḍiyārasaptavāhye rathe rājā hariṃ tadā | śvete niṣādayāmāsa tathānyān vājivāhane || 9 || rājasainyaiḥ kṛtamānaḥ pradhānaiharipūjitaḥ | chatracāmaraśobhāḍhyo reje śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ || 2.180.1 0|| tīrāṇākhyanagaryāṃ vai bahumānapuraḥsaram | śrīhariṃ sārthasahitaṃ bhrāmayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ || 11 || pūjayāmāsuratyarthaṃ prajāḥ sarvāḥ sthale sthale | āmadhyāhnaṃ pradāyaiva darśanaṃ ca nṛpālayam || 12|| devasabhāsamaṃ cendrasaudhāmaṃ prāpa vai prabhuḥ | viśrāntiṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā snānādikamathācarat || 13 || dugdhapānādikaṃ sarvānakārayadati nṛpaḥ | kṛtapūjo hariścāpi bhojayitvā kuṭumbinaḥ || 14|| mahīmānān ṛṣīn sarvān brahmapriyāśca sevakān | svayaṃ ca bubhuje svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 15|| rājādyāśca prasādaṃ śrīharerāpustadāśubham | ārāmaṃ kṛtavantaśca sarve madhyāhnakottaram || 16|| rājā kuṭumbasahitaḥ kṛṣṇapādāvamardayat | dehasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre sevālābhamavāpa ha || 17|| atha sāyaṃ sabhāsthāne viśālābhūt sabhā tadā | lakṣaśo mānavā yatra niṣeduḥ sannidhau hareḥ || 18|| nāryo narāśca parito niṣedustasthurityapi | atha rājā pupūjainaṃ copadābhiḥ pareśvaram || 19||| niṣasādāsane rājā papraccha vinayānvitaḥ | kathaṃ kṛṣṇa kṛte rājye bandhanaṃ nopasarpati ||2.180.20 || bhavatprāptyā bandhanāni chinnānīti ca vedmyaham | tathāpi baddhabhāvatvād yathā na bandhanaṃ bhavet ||21 || tathā śādhi mahārāja kuṭumbaṃ vada śāntidam | śrutvaivaṃ bhagavānāha sabhāyāṃ sarvaśṛṇvatām ||22|| bhavasāgaratīrasya prāpakaṃ pravadāmi te | yathā na bandhanaṃ madhye kutracit syāt kadācana ||23|| prāṇasyānnamidaṃ sarvaṃ nātmanastu kadācana | sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ sarvaṃ prāṇasyaivāsti bhojanam ||24|| sthite prāṇe tu tattvānāmapekṣā varṣmaṇi sthitā | prāṇo vai prakṛteḥ kāryaṃ gate prāṇe na tṛṣṇikā ||25|| matvaivaṃ tu budho bhakṣye bhogye varteta nispṛhaḥ | lubdhavannaiva varteta virāgasya na bandhanam ||26|| yathāruhya mahāvṛkṣamapahṛtya tato madhu | vṛkṣaṃ tyajati tatraiva bhuktvā madhu tataḥ param ||27||| malaṃ tyajati tatpaścād dehastyājyo bhaviṣyati | ityevaṃ cānusandhāya vartate na sa badhyate ||28||| yathā mārgaṃ mahāntaṃ vai janastvāśāśatākulaḥ | patan phalaṃ na vindeta nirāśaḥ samprajāyate ||29|| smṛtvā sarvaṃ tathā vijñaścalaṃ matvā na badhyate | āpatkāle yathā śaktajano’pi yāti mārdavam ||2.180.30 || tathā varteta māyāyāṃ mārdavena na badhyate | yathā ca jarayā vyāptaḥ śanuhastagato’pi vā ||3 1 || bhogyāśāṃ prajahātyeva tathāvṛttirna badhyate | parvatāśca drumāścāpi nityasaṃnyāsayoginaḥ ||32|| mamakāraṃ parityajya vartante niṣparigrahāḥ | tathāvṛttiḥ rājyakartā nirlepo nahi badhyate ||33|| audakāḥ sṛṣṭayaḥ sarvā ātmabharaṇatatparāḥ | parigrahaṃ na kurvanti tathāvṛttirna badhyate ||34|| śṛṇu cātretihāsaṃ tvaṃ tāpasānāṃ hitāvaham | purā gṛhān parityajya dvijāḥ kecana vaiṣṇavāḥ || 35|| vanamabhyāgaman dhīrā brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ | yatitulyā rūpavanto hyajātaśmaśravo’pi ha || 36|| indro dayāparo bhūtvābabhāṣe pakṣirūpadhṛk | aho bhavanto bālyādvai tyāgamārgamupāśritāḥ ||37|| kathaṃ gatā na gārhasthye ko hetustyajane’naghāḥ | śrutvā tadṛṣayaḥ prāhurnispṛhasya tṛṇaṃ jagat ||38|| gārhasthye vā vane vāpi tasya bandho na vidyate | vayaṃ vai nispṛhāstasmādvanamārgamupāśritāḥ ||39|| prakṣālanāddhi paṃkena paṃkāsparśo hi cottamaḥ | pakasparśo yasya jātastasyāpekṣā jalasya vai ||2.180.40|| jalātmakena jñānena prakṣālanaṃ varaṃ matam | yadvā cātapayogena śuṣkabhāvo varo mataḥ ||41 || kardamaḥ kṛkacībhūtvā svayaṃ viyogamāśrayet | ārādhanaṃ hareścāstyātaparūpaṃ viśodhakam |||42||| yadvā ca vāyunā śuṣkabhāvo’pi cottamo mataḥ | guruṃ vāyuṃ samāśrityāvidyākardamanāśanam ||43|| tasmād guruṃ mahāntaṃ vai santaṃ vā parameśvaram | tadvijñānaṃ samāśliṣya māyāṃ vināśayet sudhīḥ ||44|| karmāpi sarvamevaitallaukikaṃ vaidikaṃ ca vā | kurvannaiṣkarmyabhāvena siddhiṃ vindati mānavaḥ ||45|| siddhikṣetramidaṃ puṇyaṃ pakṣin karmaphalapradam | devavaṃśān pitṛvaṃśān brahmavaṃśān sato janān ||46|| anusṛtyaiva yatkarma tatkarma phaladaṃ nṛṇām | vayaṃ vartāmahe brahmavaṃśamāśritya vaidikam ||47|| gārhasthyaṃ cet tapoyuktaṃ yujyate mokṣadāyakam | kintu vighnagṛhaṃ tadvai vayaṃ śāntā yatastataḥ ||48|| nairbalye sati sāralyaṃ cātmamārgasya saṃśrayet | sabalānāṃ mahāmārgo gārhasthyaṃ bahutāpinām ||49|| na vayaṃ prabhavo voḍhuṃ gṛhadharmānato yamān | sādhudharmān saṃśritāḥ smo yatra śreyo dhruvaṃ bhavet ||2.180.50|| saṃśaye nirṇaye cādyaṃ tyaktvā nirṇayamāśrayet | śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ teṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ pakṣirāṭ svayam ||51|| jagāda tān gṛhadharmān kaṭhinān paramottamān | jale nimajjitaścāpi jalasparśātirekavān ||52|| vahnau tu patitaścāpi dāhabhāvātirekavān | kāmadharme sthitaścāpi kāmanāṃśavivarjitaḥ ||53|| kaścideva bhavelloke samarthaḥ puṇyāvānapi | tādṛśaḥ syād gṛhasthaścellabhate śreya uttamam ||54|| tyāgena tvātmamātrasya kalyāṇaṃ labhate janaḥ | gṛhadharmairasaṃkhyānāṃ kalyāṇakṛdbhavejjanaḥ ||55|| yathā sarvāstu sarito viśrāntiṃ yānti vāridhau | tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni viśramante gṛhigṛhe ||56|| tyāgavanto mahātmāno nispṛhā api yoginaḥ | gṛhadharmasthitān vṛkṣān saphalānāśrayanti vai ||57|| paropakaraṇaṃ tatra gṛhadharme prajāyate | atithīnāmāśrayo vai pakṣiṇāṃ gṛhadharmavān ||58|| arjitaṃ gṛhadharmaiśca nītyā satyena yuktayā | vibhajyaiva gṛhī bhuṃkte kuṭumbāśritabhikṣukān ||59|| nṛpaṃ cāgantukaṃ cāpyanāthaṃ pipīlikādikān | smṛtvā tebhyo yathāyogyaṃ datvā bhuṃkte gṛhī sadā ||2.180.60|| prātardevā hi tṛpyanti madhyāhne’tithibhikṣukāḥ | tataḥ paraṃ ca pitaraścānte vai kṣudrajantavaḥ ||61 || gṛhiṇā randhitaṃ cānnaṃ bhuñjate sarvadehinaḥ | vighasāśī gṛhī tasmād datvā gṛhṇāti nānyathā ||62|| ghasaṃ pāpaṃ svātmamātrodaraṃbharatvamucyate | vigataṃ tu ghasaṃ pāpaṃ yatrānye yānti tarpaṇam ||63|| yajño dānaṃ tapo homaḥ svādhyāyaśceśvarārpaṇam | ṣaḍetāni yatra santi vighasāśitvameva tat ||64|| śreṣṭhaṃ vai sarvadharmebhyo vighasāśitvamuttamam | pālayitvā ca taddharmaṃ śreyaḥ paramamarjayet ||65|| loko’yaṃ bhogadasteṣāṃ svargo’pi cātisaukhyakṛt | tato’pi ca phalādhikye paraṃ śreyo bhavedapi ||66|| sarvārpaṇavidhānena prāptavyaṃ paramaṃ padam | nedṛśaṃ karmabhūmau vai śreṣṭhaṃ tvanyad gṛhāśramāt ||67|| ahamindro’smi yatayaḥ karmaṇāptaḥ sureśatām | sūryacandrādayaḥ sarve’bhavan prāg vighasāśinaḥ ||68|| vartante tvadhunā svarge vighasāśina eva te | vaikuṇṭhastho hariḥ sākṣād vighasāśī virājate ||69|| goloke’pi tathā kṛṣṇo vighasāśī virājate | caturbhujo vāsudevo viṣṇuśca vighasāśanaḥ ||2.180.70|| haro brahmā vasiṣṭhādyā vighasāśina eva te | vartante bhogamārgasthā api dvandvavivarjitāḥ ||7 1 || īśvarārpaṇadharmāṇo gamiṣyanti paraṃ padam | evaṃ vai yatayo brahma gacchanti vighasāśinaḥ ||72|| sāyaṃ prātarvibhajyānnaṃ kuṭumbe’tithibhikṣuke | pareśe ca sure bhūte pitari svajane’pi ca ||73|| anāthe cāśrite bhṛtye śvādau cānāthake tathā | nāryāṃ gavi ca samprāpte yācake ca gurāvapi ||74|| dāse dāsyāṃ karmacāre prajāyāṃ bhautikātmasu | vibhajyānnādikaṃ sarvaṃ yathāyogyaṃ tu dharmataḥ ||75|| avaśiṣṭaṃ samaśnanti ye te syurvighasāśinaḥ | te lokaguravo bhūtvā jāyante śāśvatāśinaḥ ||76|| tridivaṃ ca mahadrājyaṃ prāpya śāśvatavārṣikam | īśvarārpaṇapuṇyena prayāntyapunarāgamam ||77|| tasmād vighasabhoktāro bhavanti bandhanojjhitāḥ | gṛhadharmān samāśritya bahavastatpadaṃ yayuḥ ||78|| tasmād bhavanto bālāśca bhavantu vighasāśinaḥ | etad vidustapo viprāḥ saptarṣayastathā pare ||79|| ityuktāste dharmayuktaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā yatīśvarāḥ | tyāgāśramaṃ vihāyaiva gārhasthyaṃ samupāśritāḥ ||2.180.80|| cakruḥ sarvārpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇe vighasāśā maharṣayaḥ | ātmanivedanadharmāśrayāḥ sarve tato’bhavan ||8 1|| sastrīputrakuṭumbāḍhyāścānte brahma yayuḥ purā | tasmād rājan gṛhadharmaḥ kaṭhino’pi sukhāvahaḥ ||82|| paropakārapuṇyāḍhyaḥ satsevāprāpakaḥ sadā | parameśvarasevāderlābhadaḥ śreṣṭhako yataḥ ||83|| vighasāśī bhavān nityaṃ vartayatu sahāśritaiḥ | sarvendriyakriyāsveva kṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyatu māṃ muhuḥ ||84|| bandhanaṃ te na vai bhāvi mama yogāt kadācana | mama yogāt sadā śāntistava rājan bhaviṣyati ||85|| rakṣātra pratimāṃ me ca kuru sarvārpaṇaṃ mayi | ananyabhaktaṃ tvāṃ bhūbhṛt nayiṣye brahmadhāma te ||86|| ye ye mamārpaṇadharmaparāyaṇā janā iha | teṣāmahaṃ samuddhartā karmabandhanasāgarāt ||87|| ityuktvā bhagavām̐statra virarāma prajāstu tāḥ | pupūjuḥ paramātmānaṃ mantrān jagṛhurādarāt ||88|| vighasāśivratavatyo jātāḥ sarvāśca taddināt | ityevaṃ rādhike sabhāṃ samāpya bhagavām̐stataḥ ||89|| snānasandhyādikaṃ cakre tataśca bhojanādikam | sarve te mahīmānāśca bhuktavanto viśaśramuḥ ||2.180.90 || rājā kuṭumbasahitaṃ siṣeve nidritaṃ harim | prātarbubodha ninadairvādyānāṃ śrīharistataḥ ||9 1 || kṛtvā nityavidhiṃ siṃhāsane cāgatya saṃsthitaḥ | tāvad rājādayaḥ sarve tvāyan pūjayituṃ harim ||92|| bahupadā arpitāśca rājñā tīrāṇakena vai | tasya rājñyastathā kanyāḥ samājagmuḥ kareṣu tu ||93 || dhṛtvā pūjanapātrāṇi pupūjuḥ parameśvaram | rādhike kanyakāḥ ṣaṭ ca jagṛhuḥ śrīhareḥ karam ||94|| kumāradānamāsādya kṛtakṛtyāstadābhavan | atha viśrāntimāsādya kṛtvā vai bhojanādikam ||95|| alvīnaranareśena prārthito gantumutsukaḥ | girīśarṣivanditaśca sajjo’bhavaddharistadā ||96|| tadā vādyānyavādyantāgāyanta gītikāstathā | jayaśabdān praśṛṇvānaḥ prāpya satkaraṇādikam ||97|| harirnaijaṃ vimānaṃ cādhyāruroha tathā pare | āruruhurvyomamārge vimānānyabhavam̐stadā ||98|| māṃgalikaninādaiśca yantraśabdādibhistathā | vardhitaścāśiṣā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastathā pare ||99|| pratasthire’tivegena vimānaiḥ kṣaṇamātrataḥ | girīśākhyāṃ bhuvaṃ prāpyābdhiyutaṃ rāṣṭramuttamam || 2.180.1 00|| prasanno’bhūddhariḥ śṛṇvan jayaśabdān vilokayan | alvīnaraḥ puro gatvā svāgatārthamupasthitaḥ || 101 || eti harirmahārāja iti prajāḥ samutsukāḥ | draṣṭuṃ svāgatamādhātuṃ sajjāścāsan bhuvastale || 1 02|| vilokayantyaścākāśaṃ kīrtanaṃ cakrurutsukāḥ | rādhike’kṣatapuṣpādidhṛtahastāḥ striyo narāḥ || 103|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne tīrāṇanṛparājyaṃ gatvā tīrāṇānagaryāṃ sasainyasvāgatarūpeṇa bhramitvā bhojanādi kṛtvā sāyaṃ sabhāyāṃ vighasāśitvadharmopadeśena nirbandhanatāmuktvā rātrau viśramya prātaḥ pūjāṃ pragṛhya bhuktvā sajjo bhūtvā harirdvitīyāyām alvīnararājyamājagāmetyādinirūpaṇanāmāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 180 ||
<2.181> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike gopi saśrīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | bhādrakṛṣṇadvitīyāyāmalvīnarabhuvaṃ prabhuḥ || 1 || girīśamuninādiṣṭasthale nijavimānakam | paśyan prajāḥ pratīkṣantīrvyomno’vātārayanmudā || 2 || vimānāni tadānyāni cāvaterustato’mbarāt | arthaśrīrājadhanyāḥ sannidhāvudyānabhūstare || 3 || girīśarṣistathā rājālvīnaraḥ sakuṭumbakaḥ | cakāra svāgataṃ vādyaiḥ pūjanairhāracandanaiḥ || 4 || vimānāt klṛptasopānaniḥśreṇyā bahiraṃgaṇe | niḥsarantaṃ hariṃ svarṇahārān kaṇṭhenyadhurjanāḥ || 5 || jayaśabdā vetradhārayaśaḥśabdāstadābhavan | sūtamāgadhabandīnāṃ cāraṇānāṃ yaśośritam || 6 || ślokaśravaṇamutkṛṣṭaṃ vāṇījanyaṃ tadābhavat | puṣpākṣataiśca lājābhiḥ svarṇamudrādibhistathā || 7 || godhūmaiḥ pūjanaṃ kṛṣṇasyākurvan janatāstadā | rājasaudhe hariṃ nītvā rājā sahakuṭumbakam || 8 || jalapānādi tāmbūlaṃ dadau neme ca pādayoḥ | pādaprakṣālanaṃ cakre rājā sutasutādiyuk || 9 || caraṇāmṛtapānaṃ ca pracakre sakuṭumbakaḥ | dugdhapānaṃ dadau tatra sarvebhyaśca tataḥ param || 2.181.1 0|| śīghraṃ sainyena sahito nagaryāṃ bhramaṇārthakam | yānaṃ sāśvaṃ suvarṇotthamānināya hareḥ kṛte || 11 || vyarājad bhagavām̐statra pitṛbhyāṃ sahito mudā | bhrātaraścānyamunayo brahmapriyādayastadā || 12|| yāneṣu śibikāyāṃ ca ratheṣu hastiyantrake | niṣeduśca tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaiḥ saha || 13 || vāhinī sarvaśobhāḍhyā prayayau nagaraṃ prati | arthaśryākhyanagaryāṃ sā rājamārgagatābhavat || 14|| amātyai rājapuruṣaiḥ śreṣṭhibhiḥ prajayā tathā | vardhitaḥ pūjitaḥ sākṣād dṛṣṭaḥ spṛṣṭaḥ prabhurmuhuḥ || 15|| vanditaścopadābhiśca suprasādita ityatha | sarvāṃ nagarīṃ parito bhramitvā bhagavān punaḥ || 16|| udyāne rājasaudhe ca samāgatya nijāsane | viśrāntimāpa ca sasnāvanye’pi śrāntimāgatāḥ || 17|| viśaśramuḥ svabhavane tataśca bubhujuḥ sukham | pakvānnāni hyanekāni bubhujuḥ paramādarāt || 18|| tadāścaryamabhūd rādhe śṛṇu tatkathayāmi te | krītadvipasya vāstavyo hyartheṣṭo rākṣaso mahān || 19|| āgato vai parīkṣārthaṃ laukituṃ tu harerbalam | prathamaṃ tena miṣṭānne miṣṭānnasadṛśīḥ śilāḥ ||2.181.20 || ghṛtāktā bhojane dattā pariveṣakarūpiṇā | jñātavām̐staddhariḥ śīghraṃ śilāḥ sarvā harīcchayā ||21 || miṣṭānnatāmavāpurvai hitvā tāḥ śailatāṃ tadā | sa tvāścaryaṃ gatastatra tataścakre parīkṣaṇam || 22|| aparaṃ tacchṛṇu rādhe śayyārūpo babhūva ha | upari mañcake ramyaṃ gendukaṃ sa pradarśya vai ||23 || guptaṃ cādhaḥ śūlaśayyāmakarot śrīhareḥ kṛte | haristāṃ śūlaśayyāṃ cādhyāruroha kṛtādaraḥ ||24|| śūlāḥ suvarṇapuṣpāṇi kaisarāṇyabhavam̐stadā | tatrāpyāścaryamāpyaiva nirgato rākṣasastataḥ ||25|| upānahau viṣeṇāpi yojite kṛtavām̐stadā | parīkṣaṇaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sa cakre’tha bhagavānapi ||26 || upānahau paridhāyāmṛtarūpe vidhāya vai | acalat sukhatastatra saudhe ca paritaḥ prabhuḥ || 27|| athāpi ca caturthī sa parīkṣāṃ rākṣaso’karot | sabhāyāmāsanaṃ divyaṃ sauvarṇaṃ cāgnimāvyadhāt ||28|| haristatra sabhāyāṃ ca gatvāsanaṃ tadāgnikam | spṛṣṭvā ca śītalaṃ cakre sauvarṇaṃ punareva tat ||29|| tadāścaryaṃ paraṃ prāpto rākṣaso mānavarjitaḥ | mokṣaṃ svasya nijaṃ gehamāyātuṃ kṛṣṇamārthayat ||2.181.3 0 || haristathāstvitiprāha rākṣasaṃ mūrdhni vai tadā | dadau svacaraṇau yāvat tāvad devo babhūva ha ||3 1 || tuṣito nāma divyaḥ saḥ svargavāsakaraḥ sadā | pṛṣṭo janaistadā so’pi vṛttāntamāha cātmanaḥ ||32|| tuṣito nāma devo’haṃ pṛthvyāmatra yadṛcchayā | bhramituṃ tvāgatastvatra mayā dṛṣṭātra sundarī ||33 || artheṣṭā nāmataścātra purā samudrasannidhau | pradharṣitā mayā sā cākasmācchāpaṃ dadau ca me || 34|| rākṣaso bhava duśceṣṭa kanyādharṣaṇatatpara | ahaṃ drāgeva tu jāto rākṣasaḥ krītabhūmigaḥ ||35|| tava sparśena bhagavannadyāhaṃ śāpavarjitaḥ | jāto devaḥ punaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jagatprabho ||36 || ājñā cedahametasyāt sthalād yāsye nijaṃ gṛham | hariḥ prāha prayāhi tvaṃ kurūnuttaradiksthitān ||37|| lālāyano mayā pūrvaṃ saccidānandabhāvanaḥ | preṣito’sti mārgayitvā sūcanāṃ me pradehi tam ||38|| gṛhāṇa mantrā deva tvaṃ mamājñayā prayāhi ca | ityuktvā sampradāyāsmai mantrān apreṣayat suram ||39|| vyomnā cottarakenāṭān deśān sūcayituṃ munim | hariḥ svayaṃ samāyātaḥ ketumāle tu paścime ||2.181.40|| māsānte’trāpi bhagavānāgamiṣyati niścayaḥ | uvāca taṃ muniṃ gatvā pālipārasarastaṭe ||41|| sthitaṃ pūrvataṭe śeṣakāṣṭhavanānadīyute | jaharṣātīva cākarṇya nijanāthāgamaṃ muniḥ ||42|| svāgataṃ sa muniścakre tuṣitasya tadā bahu | tuṣitena samaṃ deśeṣvevottare munirdrutam ||43|| janebhyaścāha kṛṣṇasyāgamanaṃ cotsukastadā | dvau tu babhramatuḥ kenāṭakeṣu sarvatodiśi ||44|| nāmamantrān dadaturvai prajābhyaścādarāt prabhū | atha śrībhagavān rādhe’lvīnarasyālaye tataḥ ||45|| rātrau sabhāṃ sumahatīṃ pracakre tatra mādhavaḥ | sammānitaḥ pūjitaścopādideśa prajājanān ||46|| prajā vā rājavargo vā yatayo vā gṛhasthitāḥ | kurvanto yogyakarmāṇi samarpayanti cenmayi ||47|| bandhanaṃ na bhavet teṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ ca phalasya ca | ahaṃ phalapradasteṣāṃ naiṣkarmyaṃ tatkaromi vai ||48|| vittāni dharmalabdhāni ye kratuṣūtsṛjanti ca | kṛtātmānaḥ karmiṇaste tyāgāśramiṇa eva te ||49|| na tyāgaṃ tyāgamityāhurabandhastyāga ucyate | audāsīnyaṃ parigṛhya vṛkṣavāsastu yo janaḥ ||2.181.50 || na karoti ca vā kiñcit tāmaso hi sa ucyate | yadīśvare bhavedvāsaḥ sa tu nairguṇyamāpnuyāt ||51 || kurvan karmāṇi sarvāṇi sukhecchayā muhurmuhuḥ | na devaṃ saṃsmaret tatra rājasāni tu tāni vai ||52|| sukhārthaṃ karmaṇāṃ tyāgo rājasaḥ sa mato bhavet | kurvan karmāṇi sarvāṇi mayi kṛṣṇe parātpare ||53|| yaścārpayati sarvasvaṃ sukhecchayā phalecchayā | sāttvikaṃ tad bhavet karma tyāgo’pi sāttvikaḥ sa tu ||54|| phalecchāvarjitaṃ kṛtvā mayi nyasyati yo janaḥ | tadbhavennirguṇaṃ sarvaṃ matsambaddhaṃ madarthakam ||55|| yathāguṇaṃ ca yatkarma tathā gṛhī nibadhyate | aguṇaṃ ced bhavet karma mucyate na tu badhyate ||56|| ekataścāśramāścānye gṛhasthāśrama ekataḥ | gṛhadharmī kṛṣṇadharmī bhavet sa nirguṇāśramī ||57|| mayi tyaktaṃ sarvakarma madātmakaphalaṃ dadet | śamo damastathā dhairyaṃ satya śaucaṃ tathārjavam ||58|| yajño dhṛtiśca dharmaśca nāsya pārthakyamāpnuyuḥ | abhimānakṛtaṃ karma mama smṛtivivarjitam ||59|| yamadvārā mṛtyupāśaṃ kaṇṭhe kārayati drutam | tasmānmānaṃ vihāyaiva kurvantu karma matparam ||2.181.60|| gārhasthye’pi tu mokṣārthaṃ kariṣyāmi mayi dhṛtam | asṛjaddhi prajāḥ sarvāḥ brahmā mamājñayā purā ||61 || karmapravāharakṣārthaṃ mama pūjārthamityapi | virudhaścāpi vṛkṣām̐śca yajñārthaṃ ca tathauṣadhīḥ ||62|| rasān phalāni patrāṇi yajñārthāni havīṃṣi ca | gārhasthyaṃ patnikāyuktaṃ yajñaṃ kartuṃ sadā matam ||63|| yugalaṃ devadevīnāṃ pūjārthaṃ vai praśasyate | tatsaṃprāpya gṛhasthā ye dhanadhānyarasānvitāḥ ||64|| na yajante yadi devān kilbiṣaṃ bhuñjate tu te | jñānayajñā viduṣāṃ ca satāmārādhanā makhāḥ ||65|| ṛṣīṇāṃ svādhyāyayajñā dravyayajñāstu bhūbhṛtām | annayajñāḥ kṛṣīśānāṃ dhyānayajñāstu yoginām ||66|| sevāyajñāḥ sevakānāṃ strīṇāṃ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ kratuḥ | putrāṇāṃ pitṛvākyāni brahma vai brahmacāriṇām ||67|| gṛhasthānāṃ dānayajñāstāpasānāṃ tapomayāḥ | evaṃ yajñāśca vividhā bhavanti yogyatāvaśāḥ ||68|| sarveṣāntu harerbhaktiyajñāḥ santi vibandhanāḥ | tasmāt kāryā yathāyogyaṃ yajñā māṃ vīkṣya tadgatam ||69|| dāsye muktiṃ na sandehastuṣṭo bhūtvā samarpaṇaiḥ | rājabhiḥ khalu dātavyā aśvā gajā gavādayaḥ ||2.181.70 || dāsā dāsyo’laṃkṛtāśca grāmā janapadāstathā | vāṭikāśca gṛhakṣetrodyānāni vividhāni ca ||71 || tatphalaṃ śāśvataṃ proktaṃ rājñāṃ tattu viśeṣataḥ | adātāro’śaraṇyāśca nṛpāḥ kilbiṣabhāginaḥ ||72|| doṣāṇāmeva bhoktāro na sukhānāṃ kadācana | aniṣṭvā tu mahāyajñairakṛtvā tarpaṇādikam ||73|| tīrtheṣvanabhisaṃplutyānārādhya parameśvaram | yadi prayāti panthānaṃ punarāvartate sa vai ||74|| chinnābhramiva vā gantā layaṃ yāti vinaśyati | dvyakṣaraṃ tu bhavenmṛtyustryakṣaraṃ brahma cāmṛtam ||75|| mameti mṛtyurevāsti namameti sadāmṛtam | taddvayaṃ sarvadā cāste nije mūrdhni ca vā hṛdi ||76|| tatra cāghaṃ parityajya paraṃ prāpyaṃ tu dehibhiḥ | mārgo’yaṃ sevitaḥ sadbhirbhavadbhiḥ sevyatāṃ sadā ||77|| labdhvā rājyaṃ sukuṭumbaṃ dhanāni sampadastathā | yajate na prabhuṃ yajñe niṣphalaṃ tasya tat khalu ||78|| anārādhitadevasya svārthamātraṃ prajīvataḥ | dravyādau mamabhāvasya mṛtyuḥ śikhāṃ na muñcati ||79|| bāhyābhyantaravartī yo bhūtānāṃ nityasākṣikaḥ | yairihārādhito dravyaistān mṛtyuḥ pravimuñcati ||2.181.80|| api smṛddhaṃ bhogapūrṇaṃ mānasaṃ tṛṣṇayā sthitam | klībaṃ tanmānasaṃ proktaṃ brahmarājyaṃ na vindati ||81 || na klībo brahmavasudhāṃ bhuṃkte bhaktidhanaṃ na ca | na tu klībālaye devārcanamāṃgalyamasti hi ||82|| tasmānna klībatā kāryā pareśārādhane kvacit | vṛddhaiḥ sadā hariḥ sevyastānanye’nusaranti hi ||83|| vṛddhonmādādāśritāśca syuḥ sadonmādino yataḥ | tasmādunmattatā tyājyā māyārāgādisaṃbhavā ||84|| bhajanīyaḥ sadā kṛṣṇo’nādinārāyaṇaprabhuḥ | yajñaḥ kṛto yathā tadvat kartavyaḥ sarvadā gṛhe ||85|| brahmayajñaḥ sadā kāryo mokṣaṃ dāsye na saṃśayaḥ | ityuktvā pradadau mantrān prajābhyaśca tadā prabhuḥ ||86|| rādhike’tha sabhāyāstu parihāro’bhavattataḥ | rātrau viśramya bhagavān prātaḥ kṛtavidhistataḥ ||87|| gantumiyeṣa vai śīghraṃ jinavarddhinṛpārthitaḥ | iṣṭalavarṣiṇā cāpyarthita iṣṭālirāṣṭrakam ||88|| rājā pūjāṃ bhojanādi cānayat sakuṭumbakaḥ | alvīnarastataḥ kṛṣṇo jagrāha tasya ceṣṭakṛt ||89|| anye’pi jagṛhuḥ sarve hareḥ sārthāstataḥ param | rājñī tasya pañcakanyāsahitāścārcayaddharim ||2.181.90|| pañcāpi kanyakāstatra jagṛhuḥ śrīhareḥ karam | vivāhavidhinā kṛṣṇo dadau tābhyaḥ karaṃ nijam ||9 1 || pūjāṃ cāśīrvacaḥ prāpya gantuṃ sajjo’bhavaddhariḥ | pañcakanyā brahmapriyādibhiḥ saha sutatparāḥ ||92|| yayuḥ śrīhariṇā sārdhaṃ vimāne samupāviśan | vidāyaṃ prāpya bhagavān yānamadhyāruroha ca ||93|| anye’pi ca tadā sarve’rohan vimānakāni vai | tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāstathābhavan ||94|| prajāḥ sarvā harekṛṣṇa harenārāyaṇaprabho | nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ cakrurvimānāni tadāmbare ||95|| iṣṭalavaproktadiśāṃ gatiṃ cakrurjalopari | vārdhikhāḍīṃ vyatyakrāman prāpuḥ rāmapurīṃ tataḥ ||96|| paścime khāḍikātīre jinavarddhinṛpaḥ purā | avātarad vimānād svāt svāgatārthaṃ kuṭumbavān ||97|| iṣṭalavo maharṣiśca prajāḥ sarvāstadā taṭe | udyānasannidhau cāsan svāgatārthaṃ prabhorhareḥ ||98|| aśrūyanta vilokyaiva vimānāni jayānvitāḥ | prajānādāstūpanādāḥ saṃkīrtanaravāstathā ||99|| ityevaṃ rādhike sarvaṃ rāṣṭraṃ svāgatatatparam | tatrābhūt saṃhitaṃ pṛthvī janavārdhisamābhavat || 2.181.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne harirbhādrapadakṛṣṇadvitīyāyām alvīnararājyaṃ gatvārthaśrīnagarīṃ bhramitvā bhuktvā rākṣasamuktiṃ kṛtvā taṃ tuṣitadevam uttarān kurūn sampreṣayitvā sabhāyāmupadiśya pūjāṃ saṃgṛhya viśramya prātarbhojanottaraṃ jinavarddhinṛparājadhānīṃ prati pratasthe cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 181 ||
<2.182> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | iṣṭalavarṣyupādiṣṭasthale nijavimānakam || 1 || avātārayadudyāne viśāle bhūtale śubhe | trivarāyāścāpagāyāstaṭasthe sudrumākule || 1 || rāmapuryā nagaryāstu nikaṭe vādyanādite | jinavarddhinṛpo’mātyaiḥ kumārairbāndhavaiḥ saha || 3 || prajābhiśca harestatra susvāgataṃ cakāra ha | puṣpahārān hīrakāḍhyasvarṇahārān gale dadau || 4 || bahiścāvatarantaṃ śrīhariṃ vimānakāt prajāḥ | sarvāścandanalājābhiścākṣataiḥ kusumādibhiḥ || 5 || jayaśabdairharṣanādairnamanairarhṛṇāṃ vyadhuḥ | pitarau bāndhavān sarvān bhaginīṃ ca gurūnṛṣīn || 6 || brahmapriyāśca sarve te pupūjurhāracandanaiḥ | atha sainyasahāye ca gajayāne suvarṇaje || 7 || harimārohayāmāsa rājā tu jinavardhakaḥ | mahīmānān samastām̐ścārohayāmāsa bhūriṣu || 8 || vāhaneṣu vimāneṣu gantrīṣu śakaṭīṣvapi | vādyakīrtanasaṃhrādotsavaiḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam || 9 || rāmapuryāṃ nagaryāṃ sambhrāmayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ | rājamārgeṣu sarvatra prajābhiḥ pūjito hariḥ || 2.182.1 0|| phalapuṣpākṣataraupyasvarṇamudrāmbarādibhiḥ | evaṃ vai darśanaṃ datvā rājasaudhaṃ samāyayau || 11 || vardhito janatābhiśca śuśubhe parameśvaraḥ | ānandapūrṇahṛdayaḥ sāyaṃ sabhāmakārayat || 12|| lakṣāvadhimanuṣyāṇāṃ priyakāryārthahetave | jalapānaṃ hariḥ kṛtvopādideśa prajāstadā || 13 || divye siṃhāsane tatrāsīnaḥ prasannabhāvanaḥ | bhagavatkāryakartāro bhagavaccaraṇāśrayāḥ || 14|| bhagavaddhyānasampannāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim | satāṃ sevāprakartāraḥ satāṃ vā caraṇāśrayāḥ || 15|| satāṃ mārge pragantāraḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim | smṛddhayo bhūmikājanyāścānte bhūmau viśanti hi || 16 || tā yadi syuḥ satāmarthe haryarthe mokṣadāśca tāḥ | pṛthvī dadāti cānnāni meghā apo dadatyapi || 17|| vahniḥ pākaṃ karotyeva vāyuḥ karoti rūkṣatām | saṃvidhāyaiva te sarve śayyābhogyadhanāni ca || 18|| mānavārthe dadatyeva mānavairarpyamīśvare | vinārpaṇaṃ pareśe tu sampado vipado nanu || 19|| nārakiṇyo bhavantyevānte’pi nirayasampradāḥ | tasmād bhūtaistu yā dattā vibhūtayo’tigauravāt ||2.182.20|| arpaṇīyā harau sarvāstāstadā mokṣadāḥ khalu | samudro’pi kṛtastena pṛthivī tena nirmitā ||21 || sasyāni tena devena kṛtāni kaṇadāni tu | dehastena kṛtaścāpi bījaṃ tena vinirmitam ||22|| sajātīyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena bhogyaṃ dattaṃ samānakam | yena dattamidaṃ sarvaṃ tasmai deyaṃ parātmane ||23|| sa eva bhagavānatra bhūtale lokahetave | dehināṃ śreyase cāste dṛggocaraḥ sukhapradaḥ ||24|| sevanīyastoṣaṇīyaḥ prayatnenāvagatya ca | evaṃ jñātvā mama sevāṃ kariṣyanti tu ye janāḥ ||25 || tānahaṃ tūddhariṣye vai janmasaṃsāravāridheḥ | ahaṃ daṇḍapradātāsmi daṇḍo mayā vinirmitaḥ ||26|| yadāśrayaṃ vinā daṇḍapātrāṇi dehinaḥ khalu | daṇḍadātāramevātra māmāśrayantu sarvathā ||27|| rājasu yo mayā kṣipto daṇḍo vaśyaḥ sa me sadā | yame cāpi mayā nyasto daṇḍo vikarmiśāsakaḥ ||28|| daṇḍaḥ śāsti prajāḥ sarvā dharmadaṇḍaḥ prarakṣati | daṇḍo jāgarti supteṣu dharmārthakāmamokṣakṛt ||29|| dhānyaṃ dhanaṃ striyaḥ putrā bhṛtyāḥ putryaśca vāṭikāḥ | dharmo nyāyaśca maryādā rakṣyante daṇḍabhītitaḥ ||2.182.3 0|| mātṛdaṇḍabhayādbālā kalahaṃ na prakurvate | rājadaṇḍabhayādeke pāpāḥ pāpaṃ na kurvate ||3 1 || devadaṇḍabhayād duṣṭā anyāyaṃ nāśrayanti hi | yamadaṇḍabhayāścāpi paralokabhayādapi ||32|| parasparabhayāścāpi niyamyante prajā iha | evaṃ sāṃsiddhiko loko bhayāddharme vyavasthitaḥ ||3 3|| daṇḍasyaiva bhayātsarve na khādanti parasparam | rājadaṇḍo dharmadaṇḍo yamadaṇḍastathāparaḥ ||34|| devadaṇḍaḥ pradhānāste rakṣanti vividhāḥ prajāḥ | adaṇḍikāḥ prajāścetsyurnimajjeyurmahāndhasi ||35|| adāntānapyaśiṣṭām̐śca damayatyeva daṇḍakaḥ | ājñādaṇḍo mamāstyeva mamājñā vaidikī hi sā ||36 || tāmanutsṛjya gantāro yānti daṇḍasya pāratām | netāhaṃ sarvasṛṣṭīnāṃ śāsako rakṣakastathā ||37|| rājasvāviśya tiṣṭhāmi vartayāmi ca śāsane | prajāḥ sarvāstathā sarvān nṛpān niyamarūpavān || 38|| yatra daṇḍo mama yāti carate sūdyataḥ sadā | prajāstatra na muhyanti neyuḥ sanmārgabhraṃśatām || 3 9|| manuṣyāḥ paśavaḥ pakṣavanto’pi kīṭamakṣikāḥ | daṇḍasyaiva bhayādete yathārthe vartmani sthitāḥ ||2.182.40|| nābhīto yajate kaścinnābhīto dātumicchati | nābhītaśca janaḥ kaścit samaye sthātumicchati ||41 || rudraḥ skando mahendraśca vahniśca varuṇo yamaḥ | kālo vāyuḥ kuberaśca ravirmṛtyuḥ śanistathā ||42|| vasavo marutaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāśca rākṣasāḥ | ete’pi bhayamāpannā daṇḍasya niyame sthitāḥ ||43 || etān prajāstathā bhītāḥ praṇamanti muhurmuhuḥ | bhayaṃ na ced bhavelloke vinaśyeyuḥ parasparam ||44|| daṇḍasyaiva bhayādbhīto dharme sarvaḥ pravartate | cāturvarṇyapramodāya sunītirakṣaṇāya ca ||45|| daṇḍabhītistu vihitā dharmārthau rakṣituṃ sadā | tābhyāṃ mokṣo bhavet paścād yo’sti manmūrtimāśritaḥ ||46|| yadi dharmānna bibhiyuḥ śvāpadādyā vijātayaḥ | adyurjñātiṃ nijāṃ siṃhādayaḥ krūrā vanaśritāḥ ||47|| manuṣyāścāpi saṃbhūya cādyuḥ prasahya vai mithaḥ | viśvak lopaḥ pravarteta bhidyerannītisetavaḥ ||48|| careyurnāśramaṃ karma kanyā nodvahanaṃ laṣet | yuvatī nāśrayet kāntaṃ preṣyā tvājñāṃ na codvahet ||49|| narastiṣṭhenna niyame śīle dharmabhayaṃ vinā | dharme svargo manuṣyāṇāṃ lokaścāyaṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||2.182.50|| dharmo bhaktyāśca sahito nirguṇatvāya kalpate | nātyantaṃ guṇavat kiñcinna cāpyatyantanirguṇam ||51 || ubhayaṃ sarvalokeṣu dṛśyate sādhvasādhu vā | sādhu vicārya kartavyaṃ tyaktavyaṃ yanna sādhu tat ||52|| satāṃ samāgamaḥ sādhuḥ śrīharerme sadāśrayaḥ | sarvārpaṇavidhānena kartavyo me samāgamaḥ ||53 || avadhye śāsake kṛṣṇe mayi nyastā hi ye janāḥ | na te vai kālamāyāderbhayena syuḥ prapīḍitāḥ ||54|| tasmād bhāgavataṃ dharmaṃ pālayantu prajājanāḥ | mamājñā daṇḍarūpāsti sukhadā bhayavarjitā ||55|| nirbhayāḥ santu sarve’tra mānavā iṣṭalīsthitāḥ | svasti vo’stu jinavarddhe iṣṭalavāśrayasthite ||56 || ityuktvā virarāmāsau bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ | tato nīrājanaṃ cakruḥ pūjanaṃ śrīharestadā ||57|| pitrośca bāndhavānāṃ ca rājādyāḥ susamutsukāḥ | rājñyādyāḥ pūjanaṃ cakrurbrahmapriyādiyoṣitām || 58|| upadāśca nyadhuḥ sarvāḥ svarṇarūpyakahīrakān | ābhūṣaṇāni vastrāṇi maṇīn pātrāṇi mauktikān ||59|| ratnāni copakaraṇānyadhurvividhakāni ca | mantrām̐śca jagṛhuḥ sarve narā nāryo’vaśeṣitāḥ ||2.182.60|| tataścakruḥ parihāraṃ sabhāyāḥ śrīharistataḥ | bubhuje dugdhapurikādikaṃ cānyepi sarvaśaḥ ||6 1|| mahīmānā bubhujuśca prasādaṃ jagṛhuḥ prajāḥ | rājādyāśca tato naijaṃ sthānaṃ yayustato hariḥ ||62|| nidrāṃ jagrāha rātrau ca prātarutthāya vai hṛdi | dhyātvā rūpaṃ paraṃ naijaṃ śuśrāva maṃgalasvanān ||63|| nityavidhiṃ vidhāyaiva yāvatsvastho’bhavattadā | rājā pakvānnapātrāṇi dugdhādīnyānināya ha ||64|| ārpayaddharaye praghūṇikebhyaste’danaṃ vyadhuḥ | atha madhyāhnakāle ca bhuktvā viśrāntimāyayuḥ ||65|| hariṃ tu bhuktavantaṃ vai rājñī kanyāśca sapta vai | sevituṃ tvāgatāḥ puṣpahārādyarpaṇamācaran ||66 || bhūṣaṇāni vicitrāṇi dhārayāmāsurīśvaram | ābhūṣayitvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ surūpiṇam ||67|| kare ca jagṛhuḥ kanyāḥ sapta vivāhakarmaṇā | kṛtakṛtyā babhūvuśca prāpya śrīkṛṣṇavallabham ||68||| brahmapriyāsu militā vaiṣṇavyaḥ sukhapūritāḥ | atha rādhe tadā sarve pupūjuryugalāni vai ||69|| tataścaikaṃ mahāścaryamabhūcchṛṇu vadāmi te | kaścid dīnajano’nātha ivāyāto hareḥ puraḥ ||2.182.70|| ākrośannāha bhagavan mama bālaṃ kumārakam | putrīṃ caikāṃ jahārātra rākṣasaḥ kaścideva ha ||7 1 || prajāputrān prajāputrīrharanti rākṣasāḥ pare | mārayanti janām̐ścāpi pṛṣṭhe gacchanti tānapi ||72|| dhṛtvā haranti cādrau tān vṛddhān yūno’pi rākṣasāḥ | tasmād rakṣa mahārāja nārāyaṇa pareśvara ||73 || parvatīyaprajāḥ sarvāḥ kṛpānātha kṛpāṃ kuru | ityuktaḥ śrīharistūrṇaṃ rādhe sajjo babhūva ha ||74|| dhṛtvā sudarśanaṃ sūkṣmaṃ cāṃgulyāṃ cormikāsamam | gūḍhatejo’nvita śīghraṃ gantuṃ ceyeṣa tatsthalam ||75|| tāvad rājā jinavarddhiścāpi śastrasamanvitaḥ | sajjo’bhavacca hariṇā sārdhaṃ dīnāvanodyataḥ ||76 || tāvattatra samāyāto rājā nāmnālpaketukaḥ | ālpaparvatarājyeśaḥ prāha natvā hariṃ tadā ||77|| mama rājyaṃ pāvanaṃ tvaṃ kuru śrīparameśvara | āpyāyano maharṣiśca tathaivārthayadīśvaram ||78||| tathāstviti hariḥ prāha jagādodantakaṃ tathā | rākṣasasya krūrakarmānāthasya parirakṣaṇam ||79|| alpaketuśca tacchrutvā śastrasajjo vimānake | niṣasāda vimāne’pi hantuṃ rākṣasapuṃgavam ||2.182.8 0|| vimānaiśca tadā sarvasainyānyapi ca satvaram | śastrāstrayantrayuktāni yuddhārthaṃ cāmbare’bhavan ||8 1 || rājñā rājñyādibhiścāpi prajābhiḥ pūjitaḥ prabhuḥ | alpaketorgṛhaṃ yāsyan haniṣyatīti rākṣasam ||82|| vijñāya ca śrīharaye dattānyupāyanānyapi | gṛhītvā suvidāyaṃ sarvebhyo datvā śubhāśiṣaḥ ||83|| vidāyatūryaninadān yuddhabherīpragarjanāḥ | śrutvā dhṛtvā puṣpahārān yānamadhyāruroha ca ||84|| anye prāghūṇikavargāḥ sārthāḥ sarve harestadā | vimānāni samāruhya jayaśabdān pracakrire ||85|| anātho’pi janaḥ kṛṣṇavimāne darśako’bhavat | tannidarśitamārgeṇa yānāni gatimācaran ||86|| kṣaṇamātreṇa śailaṃ tam apināyaṃ prapedire | pūrvavārdhikhāḍikāyāḥ paścime cāyatādrikam ||87|| durgamaṃ kaṇṭakāraṇyaiḥ pāṣāṇairgaṇḍaśailakaiḥ | hiṃsraprāṇinivāsaiśca rākṣasaiśca viśeṣataḥ ||88|| jvālamālāvṛtaśailarasavighnairviśeṣataḥ | ākāśātparvate’dhityakāyāṃ tu gahvaraṃ mahat ||89|| yanmukhe rākṣasā āsan vṛkṣo’dhaḥkṛtaketanāḥ | bhayaṃkarā vivastrāśca paśumāṃsāśanā api ||2.182.90|| naramāṃsādanāścāpi digambarā bhayaṃkarāḥ | asthiśastrānvitā mantrajālaśastravidastathā ||91 || vimānastho’nāthabhakto darśayāmāsa tāṃ diśām | harirvilokya bubudhe rākṣasānāṃ tadālayam ||92|| naranāṭyadharaḥ kṛṣṇo vetti sarvaṃ tathāpi vai | tadā prāha mahāyuddhaṃ dāruṇaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ||93 || ime tu rākṣasā ghorā vinā rudraṃ tu śaṃkaram | aśakyā hantumevātretyuktveśānamuvāca ha ||94|| rudra rudra mahābāho mama bāho sureśvara | yodhanārthaṃ prarakṣārthaṃ mayā tvamatra vai sadā ||95|| mama pārśve rakṣito’si kāryaṃ te samupasthitam | dhārayograṃ mahadrūpaṃ saṃharaitān mahāsurān ||96|| mārayaitānīśasaṃjñeśānadevo’rthavān bhava | ityevaṃ svavimānasthaṃ kṣetrapāleśvaraṃ haram ||97|| mahārudraṃ mahārājaḥ proktvā yuddhārthamairayat | tāvad rudro maheśānastyaktvā śāntaṃ tu bhāvanam ||98|| vikarālaṃ svarūpaṃ sandadhāra śailasadṛśam | ākāśe tu vimānāni hariṇā cakrasadṛśam ||99|| vyūhaṃ prakārayitvaiva sthirīkṛtāni sarvathā | jinavarddhimahārājastathālpaketubhūpatiḥ || 2.182.1 00|| ājñāṃ cakraturvādyānāṃ yuddhāvedananardane | yuddhavādyānyavādyanta śūrā raktadṛśo’bhavana || 101 || śaṃkhā bheryo bigulāni tadāvādyanta sarvaśaḥ | jayaśabdāśca vīrāṇāṃ yuddhārthamabhavam̐stadā || 1 02|| rākṣasā daśasāhasrā mārīśāyāṃ tadābhavan | te ca śarve viditvaivākasmād yuddhaninādakān || 103 || sajjā bhūtvā niryayuśca mārīśānagarīmukhāt | ākāśamārgagā sarve gahvaraṃ prāpya vismitāḥ || 1 04|| naṣṭabhānā iva cāsan mahāyuddhajayārthinaḥ | rādhike tu tadā rudragomukhaṃ vyanadad bahu || 105 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne jinavardhinṛparājye rāmapurīṃ pāvanīkṛtyopadiśya bhuktvā viśramya pūjāṃ prāpya janahārirākṣasavināśārthaṃ savidāyam apināyādriṃ harirjagāmetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 182 ||
<2.183> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike śrutvā raṇabherīstu rākṣasāḥ | kṛtvā kilakilāśabdān sakthisphoṭān bhayaṃkarān || 1 || kampayantaśca pṛthivīṃ nādayanto diśastathā | aṭṭahāsān prakurvanto yuddhārthaṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ || 2 || bhallān śūlānasīn khaḍgān mudgarān muśalāni ca | prastarān sarjavṛkṣām̐ścopalāḥ saṃgṛhya cāmbare || 3 || yodhanārthaṃ samutpeturdhṛtaparvatavigrahāḥ | astraśastrānvitāḥ sarve daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ || 4 || mārayantu khādayantu carvayantu vimānagān | bandhayantu mardayantu mocayantyasubhiśca tān || 5 || chindantu karapādādi śirāṃsi pātayantu ca | bhakṣayantu naradehān harantu kanyakāstvimāḥ || 6 || prajvālayantu yānāni yantrāṇi bhañjayantu ca | cūrṇayantu mastakāni vimānāni harantu ca || 7 || ityevaṃ bahujalpāste rākṣasāḥ sainyasadṛśāḥ | ākāśe parito bhūtvā gatvordhvaṃ kṣepaṇaistadā || 8 || pāṣāṇamāraṃ cakruśca bāṇavṛṣṭiṃ bhayaṃkarīm | nārācavṛṣṭiṃ golānāṃ vṛṣṭiṃ cakruḥ pradāhikām || 9 || tadā hariḥ samudraṃ ca tathā candramasaṃ drutam | sasmāra tāvubhau mūrtimantāvāgatya nematuḥ || 2.183.1 0|| hariḥ prāha jalaiścāpyamṛtaiḥ śamayataṃ tvimam | vahniṃ śīghraṃ golakānāṃ tau tathā cakraturmudā || 11 || samudro varṣaṇaṃ cakre bāṣpāṇāṃ jalasaṃbhṛtām | candro’mṛtaṃ drutaṃ tatra varṣayāmāsa vahnihṛt || 12|| atha rājā jinavarddhiścālpaketurmahābalau | nārācaiḥ śatasāhasrainijaghnuḥ rākṣasām̐stadā || 1 3|| ardhacandraistathā bhallaidvedhā chinnāḥ patanti tai | rākṣasā bhūtale pādakarān kṣiptvā jalaṃ jalam || 14|| pralapantastyajantyeva prāṇān pārvatadurgame | rājasainyāni bhūsthāni tūpagolaistadāmbare || 15|| rākṣasān mārayantyeva pātayanti ca jīvataḥ | dṛṣṭvaivaṃ ghorakadanaṃ mantramālinyakārikāḥ || 16|| rākṣasyo gahvarāttatra bahirāgatya satvaram | śatasāhasrasaṃkhyāstā utpetuścāmbare tadā || 17|| mantrakṛtairmṛṣodbhūtaiḥ rākṣasaiḥ khaṅgadhāribhiḥ | pātayāmāsurevaitau rājānau cāmbarād bhuvi || 18|| sainyāni mārayāmāsuḥ kṛtrimaiḥ rākṣasaistu tāḥ | mānavānāṃ tu sainyānāṃ mardanaṃ samajāyata || 1 9|| hāhākāro vimāneṣu tadābhavat samantataḥ | mriyamāṇau nṛpau dṛṣṭvā drutaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||2.183.20|| vimānādavatīryaiva vāyuvegena bhūbhṛtau | dhṛtvā bhujābhyāṃ ca punarvimānaṃ svaṃ samāyayau |||21|| karasparśena rājānau jīvayāmāsa mādhavaḥ | candramājñāpayāmāsārpayāmṛtaṃ samantataḥ ||22|| mānavānāṃ tu sainyeṣu mṛtān jīvaya satvaram | candraścakre tathā śīghraṃ sainyāni jīvanaṃ hyaguḥ ||23 || atha kṛtrimasainyānāṃ rakṣasāṃ nāśanāya vai | jaṭātaḥ susamutpādya māyāṃ mṛṣādinīṃ tadā ||24|| īśānadevo vyasṛjat mṛṣāsainyaṃ jagāma sā | pratirakṣo’bhavad rākṣasīsvarūpātyasaṃkhyakā ||25|| bhakṣayāmāsa sarvāṃśca rākṣasānatha śaṃkaraḥ | prerayāmāsa durgā svāṃ samutpādya tu vāmataḥ ||26|| rākṣasīnāṃ nāśanārthaṃ natvā durgā tu śaṃkaram | koṭirūpadharā bhūtvāṣṭādaśahastaśobhanā ||27|| siṃhārūḍhā bahuśastrā mahābalaparākramā | sarvarūpaiḥ sahakāle nipapātāmbare’bhitaḥ||28|| pratyekāṃ rākṣasīṃ dhṛtvā gale’nayad yamālayam | hāhākāro mahānāsīttadā rākṣasamaṇḍale ||29|| harṣanādā vimāneṣu sainyeṣu mānaveṣu ca | dṛṣṭvā durgākṛtaṃ kāryaṃ jaharṣa parameśvaraḥ ||2.183.3 0 || jahṛṣuḥ kanyakā brahmapriyādyā labdhalālasāḥ | tāvad dṛṣṭvā rākṣasāśca patnīnāṃ yamagāmitā ||3 1 || kruddhāścātīva vidhurā durgāsainyaṃ prati drutam | strīnāśārthaṃ cāmbarādvai durgāḥ prati pradudruvuḥ ||32 || śaṃkaraḥ svagaṇān kṣetrapālānāha dharantu vai | rākṣasān vyomamārgeṇa ekaikaśo gale drutam ||3 3 || kṣetrapālāstadā vyomnā dadhruḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ tu rakṣasām | prāpya prāpya gale dadhrurmārayāmāsureva tān ||34|| padbhyāṃ ca gadayā mudgareṇa bhallādibhistathā | muṣṭibhyāṃ jānumāreṇa
