kaphoṇikābhighātakaiḥ ||35|| asthibhagnaṃ mahābhāraṃ mārayāmāsurīśvarāḥ | kām̐ścicchastraistathā khaḍgaiḥ śūlaiḥ śaktyā ca bhallakaiḥ ||36|| prāṇairviyojayāmāsuḥ rakṣāṃsīśānapārṣadāḥ | mṛtāḥ pañcasahasrāṇi rākṣasā narayodhinaḥ ||37|| hṛtāśca śatasāhasryo rākṣasyo vyasavastadā | avaśiṣṭā vicāryaiva jīvane ko’rtha eva naḥ ||38|| hateṣu kulavargeṣu martavyaṃ sarvathā hyanu | ityevaṃ saṃvicāryaiva sannaddhāḥ sarvathāmbare ||39|| māyājālāni racayāmāsustā vividhāni vai | mohanānyapyasaṃkhyānyaracayan māyikāni ca ||2.183.40|| yathā vimānasainyāni vaimānikāni cāpyapi | vināśaṃ prāpurevātrāmbare tathā vyadhurmṛṣā ||41 || rākṣasānāṃ mahān rājā māyājālaparāyaṇaḥ | nāmnā mārīcaśārdūlo roṣatāmrekṣaṇo daśan ||42|| dantān jihvāmoṣṭhakau ca māyāmantrānavāsṛjat | avijñāya mahārudraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ satīṃ tadā ||43 || vijñāya mānavaṃ sainyaṃ balavad vā tathāvidham | rakṣasāṃ tvanyabhūjānāṃ māyāmantrānavāsṛjat ||44|| prathamaṃ pañcasāhasrān saṃrakṣya chāyayā svayā | tato mantrān mumocāyaṃ śālabheyān bhayaṃkarān ||45|| śalabhānāṃ samudro vai tadākāśe’bhavannavaḥ | yadbhāreṇa vimānāni nimnāni tu tadābhavan ||46|| yoddhāraścāvṛtāḥ sarve śalabhairvṛṣṭisadṛśaiḥ | abhraiḥ śālabharūpairna vyadṛśyanta tadā mithaḥ ||47|| tadvināśāya rudraśca kilahāstramavāsṛjat | asaṃkhyāḥ pakṣiṇo jātāḥ kilahākhyāstadāmbare ||48||| śalabhādrāḥ sarvatastān bhakṣayāmāsurambare | karbūrīṇāṃ samūhāśca vīkṣya rākṣasapuṃgavāḥ ||49|| tāsāṃ kalahajātīnāṃ vināśārthaṃ mano dadhe | māyayā śyenajālāni racayāmāsa mārgaṇaiḥ |||2.183.50|| śyenāścābjābjasaṃkhyāste bhakṣayāmāsurambare | kilahām̐śca tato bhūtvā yānatulyāḥ śarīrataḥ ||5 1|| vimānāni pakṣabalaistāḍayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ | kecidvimānatulyāśca kecitparvatadehinaḥ ||52|| anyānyasthaulyavantaste babhañjurvai samantataḥ | vimānāni tu bhinnāni kṣiptāni peturambarāt |||53||| evaṃ vicitre ghāte ca jāyamāne hariḥ svayam | vāyudevaṃ tadā cājñāpayāmāsa dhṛteḥ kṛte ||54|| bhagnānyapi vimānāni dhārayāmāsa vāyurāṭ | ambare eva tu viśvakarmā smṛto hyupāyayau ||55|| śilpena karmaṇā śīghraṃ bhagnabhāgānayojayat | yathāsaṃsthānayānāni vidhāya parameśvaram ||56|| cakāra suprasannaṃ ca tasthau tatraiva yodhane | atha rudro’nalamantraiḥ pakṣiṇo’nalasaṃjñitān ||57|| koṭyabjasaṃkhyakān śīghraṃ janayāmāsa mārgaṇaiḥ | analāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ śyenān bhakṣayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ ||58|| rākṣasānapi cāttuṃ te dudruvuḥ rudranoditāḥ | rākṣasā māyayā tatra tirodhānaṃ gatāḥ kṣaṇam ||59|| sarjayāmāsurugrām̐śca nāgān viṣolbaṇāṃstadā | sapakṣām̐ste vimānasthān gatvāviśya daśanti hi ||2.183.60|| rudro gāruḍamantreṇotpādayāmāsa bhakṣakān | garuḍān nāgasaṃhārakartṝn koṭisahasraśaḥ ||61 || garuḍāstānanudrutya bhakṣayāmāsureva ca | garuḍānāṃ vināśārthaṃ rākṣaso vahnimāsṛjat ||62|| agniragnirmahāgniścāmbare tvālāmayo’bhavat | rudro netraṃ tṛtīyaṃ coddhāṭayāmāsa tatkṣaṇe ||63|| tatrotpannaḥ pralayāgnirmṛṣāgniṃ rākṣasotthitam | ākṛṣya cājahāraiva naije rūpe’tidāruṇam ||64|| śaśāmāgnistadā śīghraṃ rākṣasā bhayamāvahan | gahvarasya drumādhastād guptā bāṇān śarām̐stathā ||65|| mumucurbhallakām̐ścāpi yoddhavyamiti niścitāḥ | rudragaṇā vyomamārgāt kṣetrapālāḥ samantataḥ ||66 || cakrustadā bāṇavṛṣṭiṃ hantuṃ rākṣasapuṃgavān | atha te rākṣasāḥ prāptāḥ prāṇasandehatāṃ yadā ||67|| tadā pāṣāṇamantraiste mumucurmārgaṇān bahūn | śilā vyomni samutpannā gaṇḍaśailasamāstadā ||68|| utpatyotpatyānarīkṣe jaghnurvimānakāni vai | jñātvā rudraśceṣṭitaṃ tad vajrāstraṃ pramumoca ha ||69|| śilāścūrṇībhūya sarvā vāyunoḍḍiḍyire diśaḥ | vyalīyanta tato daityā meghānugrānavāsṛjan ||2.183.70 || vāyvastreṇa tadā rudro meghān līnānakārayat | atha te rākṣasā bhītā mṛtaśeṣāstu vāridhim ||7 1|| praveṣṭuṃ dudruvustāvacchaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ | gaṇān vimocayāmāsa tatpṛṣṭhe dhartumeva tān ||72 || parāvṛtya tadā daityā gaṇairyuddhaṃ vyadhuḥ punaḥ | tadā rudro mumocātha śūlaṃ lokabhayaṃkaram ||73|| bhramad vegena vahnīṃśca muñcat samantataśca tat | mārayāmāsa daityāṃstān mārīśeśo tiro’bhavat ||74|| dhṛtvā tu māyikaṃ rūpaṃ vāhneyaṃ śūlameva tat | mukhe samāgrasattatra sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ tadā ||75|| vīkṣyāścaryaṃ paraṃ prāptāḥ śaṃkarādyā gaṇāstathā | tadvilokya paraṃ karma rākṣasasya narāyaṇaḥ ||76 || praśaśaṃsāsurasyaitatkarma lokabhayaṃkaram | śaṃbhuṃ vīkṣya haristūrṇaṃ cakraṃ karānmumoca ha ||77|| urmikāsadṛśaṃ cakraṃ nirgataṃ cāṃguleryadā | śīghraṃ vahniṃ vimuñcaccāvardhatātibhayaṃkaram ||78|| sahasrāraṃ sūryatulyaṃ raktavarṇaṃ ca vegavat | ninādayaddiśaḥ sarvāḥ prajvālayad vanāni ca ||79|| parvataṃ bhasmasāt kurvat cāgrasad rākṣasān drutam | pṛthivī kampitā tasya vegena vāyumaṇḍalam ||2.183.80|| kampitaṃ ca samudrā vai stabdhāścodvelatāṃ gatāḥ | vimānānyambare sthairyaṃ samatāṃ tatyajuḥ kṣaṇam ||8 1 || sarvadehihṛdayāni tresurdhairyaṃ pratatyajuḥ | hāhākārastadā jāto mumuhurnirbalāḥ kṣaṇam ||82|| satvāni mūrchitānyeva kṣaṇaṃ cakre’tivegite | rākṣasāḥ stabdhatāṃ yātā jñātavantaḥ sudarśanam |||83 || tāvaccakraṃ prāptameva vyadārayacchirāṃsi hi | hatāḥ śeṣā rākṣasā ye māriśeśo’pi nāśitaḥ ||84|| gaṇḍaśailā iva teṣāṃ dehāḥ petuḥ kṣitau tadā | atha cakraṃ gaṇarakṣākaraṃ śūlaṃ pragṛhya tu ||85|| nyavartata mahāghoraṃ vahnimaṇḍalasadṛśam | ativegaṃ samāpannaṃ śāntiṃ nāvāpa satvaram ||86|| parvatāraṇyabhogeṣu śanaiḥ śanairapāsarat | parvatasya bhūmikā yāḥ pradeśā bahavastadā ||87|| cakrāgnināṃ pradagdhāśca rasabhāvaṃ gatāstadā | śvetasphaṭikabhasmāḍhyāḥ kṛṣṇamaṇisamā api ||88|| pītāḥ svarṇasamāścāpi pradeśāstvabhavan priyāḥ | pāṣāṇaparvatarasā dagdhāścakrasya vahninā ||89|| punaḥ pāṣāṇatāṃ prāptā maṇayo vai yathā śubhāḥ | āsamantād rasotpannaḥ pāṣāṇā ārasāratmakāḥ ||2.183.90 || cakrasaṃgena saṃjātā marmarāḥ saṃgamarmarāḥ | śilpakāryārhadehāste pradeśā vikṛtiṃ gatāḥ ||9 1 || cakre śāntaṃ hyabhūccāpi mūrtiṃ dadhāra pārṣadīm | śūlaṃ tu gaṇamūrtiṃ ca dadhārāpi trilocanām ||92||| gaṇānāhūya ca senāṃ mānavānāṃ vanasthitām | dhairyaṃ ca dadatuścobhau vijayaṃ ca śaśaṃsatuḥ || 93|| tāvad vijayatūryāṇi tvavādyanta samantataḥ | puṣpavṛṣṭiścābhavattvambarād devādibhiḥ kṛtā ||94|| bheryo ninādān cakruśca śaṃkhāśca bigulāni ca | sainye tu mānave harṣo mūrtimān praviveśa ha ||95|| gaṇeṣvapi tu sarveṣu vaimānikeṣu vai tathā | ubhayornṛpayoścāpi hṛtsvānando na vai mamau ||96|| jayaśabdā vimāneṣu prābhavan bahuharṣataḥ | atha cakraṃ tathā śūlaṃ pārṣadau dvau ca parvate || 97|| yayaturgahvaradvāraṃ rakṣonivāsabhūmikām | vilokayāmāsatuścāntare gatvāndhakārite ||98|| prakāśaṃ svaṃ prasāryaiva tāvattatra ca gahvare | bhakṣitānāṃ narāṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ śeṣāsthisaṃcayān ||99|| vilokya duḥkhamāpannau dayāparau hi pārṣadau | agre gatvā punastatrālokayāmāsatustadā || 2.183.10 0|| kanyakāśca striyaścāpi rākṣasairyā apahṛtāḥ | śate dve ca sahasraṃ ca yuvatyo rurudustadā || 101 || tāvubhau vedayāmāsurvṛttāntāni hi rakṣasām | pārśve ca vidyate vṛkṣasamūhe nagarī vane || 1 02|| droṇyāmadṛśyarūpā tu yatra santi hyanekaśaḥ | apahṛtā narā nāryo bālā bālyaśca bandhane || 1 03|| tāḥ sarvāstau gahvarācca bahirniṣkāsya satvaram | yayaturnagarī rākṣasaiḥ prāk kṛtā yathā || 1 04|| tatra dṛṣṭā nigaḍasthā bahavo yuvamūrtayaḥ | anye vimuktabhāvāśca prākārāntarniveśitāḥ || 1 05|| narā nāryaśca bahavo bhakṣyāḥ kramāttu rakṣasām | pāresahasramāvīkṣya mocayāmāsatuśca tān || 106 || atha cakraṃ sthitaṃ tatra śūlaṃ yayau hariṃ haram | jagāda sarvaṃ vṛttāntaṃ tadā nārāyaṇo haraḥ || 1 07|| vimānaṃ satvaraṃ tyaktvā nagarīṃ yayaturdrutam | rudanto’pi gatā harṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā hariṃ haraṃ prabhum || 1 08|| prajāstāśca praṇemurbandhanamuktāḥ punaḥ punaḥ | hariḥ sarvāḥ prajāstatrāśvāsayāmāsa pitṛvat || 10 9|| anāthasya sutaścāpi sutāpi ca praṇematuḥ | parameśaṃ haraṃ cāpi rurudatuḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 2.183.11 0|| haristebhyo rādhike vai dhairyaṃ nirbhayatāṃ dadau | śaṃkarāya hariḥ prāha nistārārthaṃ sukhāvaham || 111 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne rākṣasānāṃ rājabhyāṃ tatsainyaiḥ saha yodhanaṃ rākṣasīnāṃ durgayā saha yodhanaṃ rudreṇa rākṣasānāṃ nāśanaṃ nigaḍasthaprajānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ parvatasya sudarśanatejasā rasaśilāmayatvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 183 ||
<2.184> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ | rudraṃ rākṣasahantāraṃ prāha coddharaṇakṣamam || 1 || śaṃbho’nāthasya bālāṃ ca bālaṃ pradehi mantrakam | anāthāya tato dehi vaiṣṇavau tasya bālakau || 2 || śaṃbhurmantraṃ dadau śīghraṃ bālāyai bālakāya ca | anātho’pi manuṃ śaṃbhorjagrāha vaiṣṇavo’bhavat || 3 || bālā sā rakṣakaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ matvā yogyaṃ varaṃ tadā | pitrājñāṃ prāpya tatraiva kṛṣṇahastamupādade || 4 || etadvilokya ca tadā śate dve ca sahasrakam | yā yuvatyo gahvarāttu mocitā rakṣitāśca tāḥ || 5 || sarvā vijñāya kāntaṃ svaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram | śuklavarṇā yathā devyastādṛśyo yogyamīśvaram || 6 || rakṣitāraṃ harerhastaṃ vivāhahṛdayaiḥ śubhaiḥ | jagṛhustatra ca vane svatantrāḥ puṇyanoditāḥ || 7 || śaṃbhuḥ sarvābhya evādau manuṃ dadau tu vaiṣṇavam | brahmapriyāsu tāḥ sarvāḥ sthāpayāmāsa cāmbare || 8 || kārāgāre sthitān sarvān narānnārīśca mādhavaḥ | dadau svacaraṇau mūrghni svatantrānapyacīkarat || 9 || duḥkhānyapāharat kṛṣṇo’dāpayacchaṃbhunā manum | vaiṣṇavāste tadā jātā bhejire śrīnarāyaṇam || 2.184.1 0|| mārīśānāmapuryāṃ ca ruddhā yā rākṣasaiḥ prajāḥ | tābhyo datvā mantrakām̐stu vaiṣṇavīstā haro’karot || 11 || tāṃ suśubhāṃ nagarīṃ ca paribhramya sthale sthale | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvāṃ devo’pavitrayattadā || 12|| taiḥ sarvairarthitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pūjito hṛdayaistathā | sthātuṃ niśāṃ tu tatraiva punaḥ punaḥ samarthitaḥ || 13|| dṛṣṭvā tadbhāvanāṃ vimānānyavātārayad drutam | viśāle’raṇyake mārīśāpuryāḥ sannidhau tadā || 14|| niśāmukhe nivāsām̐ścākārayad vṛkṣavadbhuvi | rātrau vai bhojanaṃ sarvān kārayitvā hariḥ svayam || 15|| vijayasyotsavaṃ tatra kārayāmāsa cottamam | gāyanairnartanairvādyaiḥ saṃkīrtanaiśca harṣaṇaiḥ || 16|| nāṭakaiśca kathākhyānairniśāmagamayattadā | yuddhe mṛtāstu ye sarve nijapakṣīyayodhinaḥ || 17|| tān sarvān śrīharistūrṇaṃ sasmāra yogavidyayā | sarve te jīvabhāvaṃ ca prāpya prāṇān śarīrakam || 18|| svasthā bhūtvā ca tadrātrau harervāse samāyayuḥ | gahvare’sthīni yeṣāṃ vai mṛtānāṃ ca vane’pi ca || 19|| nagaryāḥ sannidhau cāpi patitānyabhavam̐stadā | yogaiśvaryeṇa bhagavān sasmāra tatra dehinaḥ || 2.184.20|| mṛtāḥ sarve satyasaṃkalpasya kṛṣṇasya vāñcchayā | sajīvāścābhavan svasthā rātrau tatra samāyayuḥ ||21 || aneke vai narā nāryo bālā bālyaśca mānavāḥ | prātarnavīnarūpāḥ samadṛśyanta nivāsane ||22|| pārelakṣaṃ mānavān śrīhariścaivaṃ niśāntare | jīvayāmāsa kṛpayā tebhyaḥ śaṃbhurmanuṃ dadau ||23|| vaiṣṇavāste tadā jātā hareḥ pādajalaṃ papuḥ | bhinnadeśīyalokāste sasmarurnijabhūsthalīm ||24|| yayuḥ śaktā nijān deśānanye nyūṣuśca tatra vai | atha śrībhagavānāha lomaśāya mahātmane ||25||| jinavarddhinṛpāyedaṃ rājyaṃ samarpyameva tu | abhiṣekavidhinainaṃ pradehi mukuṭaṃ guro || 26 || vidhehi tilakaṃ tasya bhāle rājā bhavediha | jinavarddhistadā prāha vijetre deyameva tat ||27|| īśānāya pradeyaṃ tadrājyaṃ śrīparameśvara | alpaketustathā cānye maharṣayo’pi tattathā ||28|| ūcustato hariḥ śaṃbhuṃ prasahya kānakāsane | pratiṣṭhāpyākṣataiḥ kuṃkumaiśca candraṃ lalāṭake ||29|| svayaṃ dakṣakareṇaiva cakāra mukuṭaṃ dadau | īśānaḥ śrīmahādevo mārīśāyā nṛpo’bhavat || 2.184.3 0|| nagarīṃ pārvatībhūmerupatyakāsthale punaḥ | avāsayacchanaiḥ rādhe vāṭikodyānamaṇḍitām ||3 1 || īśānaḥ śaṃkaraḥ so’yaṃ dvitīyarūpadhṛk prabhuḥ | durgayā sahitaścāpi gaṇaiśca sahitastathā ||32|| haryājñayā nivāsaṃ svaṃ pracakāra prajārthitaḥ | iṣṭadevo’bhavat so’yamīśānaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||33 || śvetagauraprajānāṃ vai rakṣasāṃ nāśakārakaḥ | doṣāṇāṃ nāśako devo mokṣadaḥ sukhadaḥ sadā ||34|| āpyāyanaṃ ca gāṃgeyaṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha taddine | rājyasthitiṃ prasādhyaiva dāsye tubhyaṃ purīmimām ||35|| mālāṃ gṛhāṇa ca hareḥ sannidhau sajalāñjalim | ityevaṃ tatra saḥ prātaḥ prokto mālāmupādade ||36 || prātarharirgaṇān śaṃbhoḥ rakṣakān nyasya tatra ca | śaṃbhuṃ durgāṃ brahmasatīrmaharṣīn svakuṭumbakam ||37|| kārayitā dugdhapānaṃ pañcamyāṃ bhādrakṛṣṇake | upādideśa bhagavān sabhāṃ kṛtvā prajājanān ||38|| kālo vai rākṣasaścāsti yathātra rākṣaso hyabhūt | māritaḥ śaṃkareṇāsau mama bhaktena sānvayaḥ ||39|| tathā mamāśrayeṇaiva bhaktāḥ kālo’pi rākṣasaḥ | muktabhāvasamāpannairnāśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||2.184.40 || mama bhaktiṃ prakurvantu tatheśānaṃ bhajantvapi | iṣṭadevaṃ mahārakṣākaraṃ śaṃbhuṃ bhavantu vai ||41 || mahādevīṃ satīṃ durgāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ ca bhajantvapi | gataśvaḥ sūryavāro vai hyabhavat sūryadevatā ||42|| sarvadoṣavināśārthaṃ samārādhyā prakāśadā | sūryavāre mayā tvatra śaṃkarādisahāyinā |||43 || prahatā rākṣasā ghorā bhakṣakā duḥkhadāyinaḥ | bhavadbhiścāpi hantavyā doṣāḥ pāpapradā ravau ||44|| kāmakrodhādayaḥ sarve pālanīyo vṛṣo ravau | dvividho jāyate vyādhiḥ śārīro mānaso’thavā ||45|| śārīrānmānaso vyādhirmānasād dehajo’pi ca | parasparaṃ tayorjanma kāmakrodhādayo hi te ||46 || doṣā vai vyādhayaḥ proktāstyaktavyāste ravau dine | sattvaṃ rajastama iti mānasā vai trayo guṇāḥ ||47|| ravau vāre nātiyojyāstrayaste viśvarūpiṇaḥ | harṣeṇa bādhyate śoko harṣaḥ śokena bādhyate ||48|| tāmasena tu dharmeṇa harṣaśokau prabādhyataḥ | vijñāyaiva guṇacakraṃ bādhanīyaṃ ravau prabhau ||49|| asantoṣaḥ pramādaśca mado rāgo’tilālasā | lobho moho’bhimānaścodvegaścaite hi rākṣasāḥ ||2.184.50|| ebhiḥ pāpmabhirāviṣṭo bhavennaiva ravau kvacit | udarākhyāṃ khaniṃ nāhnā pūrayitumalaṃ janaiḥ ||51 || ravau tāṃ pūrayennaivāpūryā matvā vicakṣaṇaḥ | yatheddhaḥ prajvalatyagnirasamiddhaḥ praśāmyati ||52|| ravāvāhāraśūnyaḥ sa svayaṃ śāmyati vai prabhau | ātmodarakṛte lokaḥ karoti vighasaṃ bahu ||53|| ravāvudarajetā syād vijetā sarvapāpmanām | mānuṣāḥ kāmabhogāśca jetavyāḥ sūryavāsare ||54|| abhogino janāḥ sūrye yānti sthānamanuttamam | yogaḥ kṣemastathā tyāgaḥ sūrye kāryā harau sadā ||55|| ekodarakṛte vyāghraḥ karoti vighasaṃ bahu | tamanye’pyupajīvanti mandā lubdhā mṛgādayaḥ ||56 || vicāryaivaṃ ravau tyājyā vṛthā vighasarāśayaḥ | patrāhāraiḥ phalāhāraiścaikāhārairjanaiḥ ravau |||57|| yastvimāṃ vasudhāṃ kṛtsnāṃ praśiṣyādakhilāṃ nṛpaḥ | ravau tyāgaparo bhakto viśiṣyate na vai nṛpaḥ ||58|| saṃkalpāstu nirāraṃbhā ravau kāryā hare śubhāḥ | nirāmiṣā na śocanti tyājyaṃ vai cāmiṣaṃ ravau ||59|| pitṛyānaṃ devayānaṃ ravau labhyeta śaṃkarāt | tapasā brahmacaryeṇa bhajanena maharṣayaḥ ||2.184.6 0|| vimucya dehān yāntyante brahmalokamanāmayam | āmiṣaṃ bandhakṛtkarma tat tyaktavyaṃ ravau sadā ||6 1 || tasmānmukto hare lagnaḥ padamāpnoti tatparam | prajñāprasādamāruhya tyājyaṃ tyaktavyameva yat |||62||| grāhyaṃ ceśānabhajanaṃ cakṣuṣmatā subuddhinā | ṣāṭkauśike’tra dehe vai ravistu saptamaḥ pṛthak ||63|| taddevaṃ ca tadātmānaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati | tata eva tu śanakairbrahma sampadyate param ||64|| sūrye sūrigatiṃ yānti dāntāḥ śāntāstitikṣavaḥ | sūrye ceśānahavanaṃ durgāyāḥ pūjanaṃ tathā ||65|| guroḥ pūjā hareḥ pūjā kartavyā bhaktamānavaiḥ | asaktastaddine tiṣṭhenniḥsaṃgo muktabandhanaḥ ||66|| samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca sa vai mukto bhaved dhruvam | evaṃ dharmamanukrāntāḥ sadvā dānatapaḥparāḥ ||67|| ānṛśaṃsyaguṇopetāḥ kāmakrodhādivarjitāḥ | prajāpālanayuktāśca sūryeśānavratasthitāḥ ||68|| guruvṛddhārhaṇaparā iṣṭalokānavāpsyatha | svasti cāstu bhavatāṃ ca sadā sūryajuṣāṃ sukham ||69|| ityuktvā śrīharirmaunaṃ samāsthāya vicārya ca | alpaketuṃ prāha gantuṃ tadīyāṃ jīvanīpurīm ||2.184.70|| sajjā bhavantu cānye’pi bhokṣyāmastatra caiva ha | jinavarddhimahārājaḥ prāha natvā hariṃ tadā ||71 || īśānaśca tathā durgā āpyāyano munistathā | bhuktvātra bhagavan puryāṃ bhramitvā ca tataḥ param ||72|| pāvayitvā bhūtalaṃ ca gantavyaṃ tu tataḥ param | dayālurbhagavānāha rādhike vai tathāstviti ||73 || pakvānnāni kṛtānyeva śīghraṃ tatratyamānavaiḥ | madhyāhne bhojanaṃ cakruḥ sarve ceśānavāñcchayā ||74|| durgā satī brahmapatnīrbhojayāmāsa vai tadā | viśramya ca kṣaṇaṃ yānairvāhanaiśca vimānakaiḥ ||756|| sajjībhūyāmbare prāpya pūjāstanmānavaiḥ kṛtāḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇādyā vai vimāne viviśurdrutam ||76 || vidāyasya suvādyāni tadāvādyanta bhūriśaḥ | jayaśabdāstūryaśabdāścābhavan vai samantataḥ ||77|| rājasainyaṃ prarakṣyaiva tatra rājā jinarddhikaḥ | vidāyaṃ pradadau śaṃbhudurgānārāyaṇādaye ||78|| alpaketunṛpeṇaiva sākaṃ yānānyapāsaran | vimānāni cālpaketudarśitena pathāgaman ||79 || āpyāyano maharṣiśca vimāne saha cāgamat | apiyānaṃ parvataṃ cātikramya cottare girim ||2.184.80|| alpākhyaṃ samapaśyam̐śca vimānasthāḥ susundaram | alpaketurvimānena prathamaṃ cāgrago’bhavat ||8 1 || sāpyāyanaḥ svāgatārthaṃ nijāṃ vai jīvanīpurīm | savādyasainyayuktaśca śīghraṃ hārārhaṇādibhiḥ ||82|| rājñīputrasutādyaiśca sahitaḥ purato’bhavat | tadājñayā drutaṃ vādyaghoṣāḥ kṛtāśca vādakaiḥ ||83 || jayaśabdāḥ prajābhiśca vetrahārairyaśogiraḥ | yāntrikairyantraśabdāśca kṛtāḥ svāgatasūcakāḥ ||84|| narā nemuścāmbare ca dṛṣṭvā svarṇavimānakam | nāryaḥ parvatavāsinyastathā bhūbhavanā janāḥ ||85||| harervimānamālokya sadhvajaṃ tejasā jvalat | vilakṣaṇaṃ susampannaṃ divyatādhikyarājitam ||86|| bahumālātoraṇādyairmuktāhīrakajātikaiḥ | smṛddhaṃ mūrtisarattejaḥkiraṇaiḥ sūryasannibham ||87|| agre haṃsaiśca garuḍergajairmāṇikyavājibhiḥ | siṃhaiśca śarabhaiścāpi mūrtimadbhiḥ prayāpitam ||88|| bahubhiścānyayānaiśca vimānaiḥ pārśvamaṇḍitam | paścācca devadevībhiḥ parībhirjayaghoṣitam ||89|| puṣpākṣatādyairmālābhiḥ śṛṃgāritaṃ suvardhitam | adhastāccandrasadṛśairmaṇibhiḥ śītabhānvitam ||2.184.90 || kalpadrumālipuṣpādyaiḥ kṛtodyānasumadhyamam | cintāmaṇipraṇaddhāḍhyabhittipaṭṭavirājitam ||9 1 || svarṇakalaśaśobhāḍhyaśikharairatiśobhitam | kamalākārakalyāṇīkṛtasvastikacitrakam ||92|| divyavyajanacchatrādyaiścāmarairujjvalairyutam | vetrahārairjayaśabdairgajitaṃ pūrvakāṃganam ||93 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vijayatetamām | ityevaṃ svarṇavarṇaiśca sūcayanmādhavāśritam ||94|| evaṃbhūtaṃ śubhaṃ vīkṣya vimānaṃ nemurambare | rājñā darśitamārgeṇa bhūtale cāyate śubhe ||95 || harirnijaṃ vimānaṃ taccāvātārayadacyutaḥ | anyānyapi vimānāni cāvaterurbhuvastale ||9 6 || jayaśabdaiḥ svāgataṃ ca cakruḥ prajāḥ sudaṇḍavat | lājādi cikṣipustatra vimāne dūrataḥ sthitāḥ ||97|| puṣpāṇi cikṣipuścānye’kṣatāna kecicca cikṣipuḥ | gandhamālyādīni cānye cikṣipuśca vimānake ||98|| ityevaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇe bhādre tu pañcamīdine | jīvanīṃ nagarīṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prāpto vanānvitām ||99|| rājālpaketuko rājñī tathā putryaḥ sutādayaḥ | vimānāgre pratīkṣante bahiścāgamanaṃ hareḥ || 2.184.10 0|| sarve paśyanti tatraiva dvāre kadā hi mādhavaḥ | bahiśceyāt sthiranetrāścātiharṣābhisaṃbhṛtāḥ || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne anāthabāloddharaṇāya rākṣasānāṃ vināśottaraṃ dvyadhikaśatayuksahasrakanyābhiḥ harikaragrahaṇaṃ, rākṣasamāritāsthibhyo mṛtānāmujjīvanam, īśānarājyasthāpanaṃ,ravivāramāhātmyaṃ, pūjāśīrvādā niśāviśrāntiḥ, prātarbhojanottaram alpaketunṛpasya jīvanīṃ nagarīṃ prati bhādrakṛṣṇa pañcamyāṃ gamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 184 ||
<2.185> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca athāyaṃ bhagavān rādhe jīvanīnagarīṃ prati | dṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā vimānāt svād bahistūrṇaṃ samāyayau || 1 || tāvad rājālpaketuścāpyāyanarṣistathā pare | kumārā bālakṛṣṇasya kaṇṭhe hārān nyadhuḥ śubhān || 2 || sauvarṇān kausumām̐ścāpi hairakān rātnikānapi | kare gucchān sugandhām̐śca daduḥ puṣpāṇi mastake || 3 || akṣatairvardhayāmāsuḥ praṇemuḥ pādayorapi | anye’pi pūjitāḥ sarvairīśānādyāstatharṣayaḥ || 4 || pitaraḥ sakuṭumbāśca svāgataiścātimānitāḥ | pādau prakṣālya ca vāri papurbhaktā harestadā || 5 || hariṃ suvarṇaśobhāyāṃ gajagantryāṃ nyaṣādayan | anyān śubheṣu yāneṣu vāhaneṣu hyanassu ca | 6 || śibikāsu vimāneṣu niṣādya maṃgalasvanaiḥ | nagarīṃ bhrāmayāmāsuḥ rājādyāḥ premavihvalāḥ || 7 || pradhānaiśca nṛpādyaiśca śreṣṭhibhiścādhikāribhiḥ | prajābhiḥ sarvajātīyanārībhiśca naraistathā || 8 || vardhitaḥ pūjitaścāpi ghaṇṭāpathe ca catvare | aṃgane mārgikāyoge cāpaṇānāṃ ca vartule || 9 || svāgatena hariḥ sarvaiḥ prāsāditaḥ punaḥ punaḥ | upadābhiramūlyābhiḥ sarvopakaraṇādibhiḥ || 2.185.10 || phalapuṣpairmaṃgalaiśca samarcito narāyaṇaḥ | evaṃ tāṃ nagarīṃ vīkṣya datvā ca darśanaṃ tataḥ || 11 | nivāsālayamāgatya jalapānaṃ samācarat | haristūrṇaṃ sabhāyāṃ ca niṣasādādideśa ca || 1 2|| yatrāste bhagavān sākṣāt yatra santo hariṃ śritāḥ | yatra vasanti bhaktāśca deśaḥ sa divya ucyate || 13 | nirguṇaḥ sa pradeśo vai bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ | dhanyo’yaṃ ketumālaśca dhanyā nṛpā nadītaṭāḥ || 14|| dhanyānyeṣāṃ nagarāṇi yatra maccaraṇāgamaḥ | dhanyā yūyaṃ prajāścātra vaiṣṇavatvamupāgatāḥ || 15|| vaiṣṇavatvaṃ ca satsaṃgaḥ parameśaprasannatā | sadeṣṭadevabhaktiśca sevā satāṃ hi durlabhāḥ || 16|| te yeṣāṃ militāsteṣāṃ prāptavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate | sthānino divyalokasthā vāñcchantyetattu pañcakam || 17|| tapaḥsvādhyāyaśīlānāṃ santi lokāḥ sanātanaḥ | ajātaśatravo dhīrā bhaktyā mokṣaṃ paraṃ gatāḥ || 18|| viṣayebhyaḥ parāvṛttā yānti bhaktyā paraṃ padam | anirdeśyāṃ gatiṃ yānti mokṣiṇo bhaktisaṃyutāḥ || 19|| uktaṃ tu pañcakaṃ yeṣāṃ nāsti teṣāṃ tu laukikam | vipāṭya kadalīstambhaṃ sāralābho na vidyate || 2.185.20 || tasmāttatpañcakaṃ labdhvā śreyo lakṣyaṃ vidhāya ca | nigṛhya ca manastṛṣṇāmutsṛjya karmasantatim ||2 1|| pareśvare tu saṃlagnaḥ satāṃ mārgamanusmaran | dhyāyeddevaṃ cāntarasthaṃ sa vai śreyaḥ prayāsyati || 22|| kriyāratāḥ kratau magnā dāne sevāvidhāvapi | māṃ pralakṣyotsṛjanto ye te matā mama lokagāḥ || 23|| tyāgaḥ santoṣa iśejyābhilālasākṣayastathā | mānādivilayo yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ vai śāśvataṃ sukham || 24|| catuṣpado bhavedatra niḥśreṇī brahmalokadā | kathāyajñaḥ ṛṣiśreṇī jñānaṃ śreṇī tu tattvinām ||25||| karmaśreṇī gṛhasthānāṃ tapaḥśreṇī satāṃ matā | īhā ced viṣayāḍhyāsti tato’nīhā garīyasī || 26 || īhāyāṃ bahavo doṣāḥ saṃhārajananapradāḥ | īhayā dūṣyate cātmā śreyastena vilīyate || 27|| anarhaṃ yo’rjayatyatrārhaṃ ca tyajati sarvathā | sa cānte saṃparityakto bhaved dvābhyāṃ tato’ndhagaḥ ||28|| evaṃ vicārya manujairgṛhasthaistu viśeṣataḥ | karmayajño’pi vidhinā dhanayajño’pi saddhanaiḥ ||29|| kartavyaśca sameṣṭavyo nārāyaṇo’hameva ca | indro yajñaiśca vividhaiḥ surarājo’bhavat purā || 2.185.3 0|| mahādevo mahāyajñe hutvātmānaṃ babhūva saḥ | devadevo vyāpya viśvān viṣṭabhyeśānatāṃ gataḥ ||3 1|| āvikṣito marutaśca yajñe śrīṃ pariveṣiṇīm | prāpa sarvapradāṃ bhaktyā yayau dhāma mamāpi ca || 32|| evamanye pūrvakalpe kalpāntareṣu karmiṇaḥ | karmayajñeṣu saṃyujya dhanaṃ cāpi divaṃ gatāḥ ||33||| karmayajñe vaiṣṇavatvaṃ satsaṃgo haritoṣaṇam | satāṃ sevā bhavantyeva tādṛgyajñaṃ samācaret ||34|| anīhaścet susantoṣī vindate brahma śāśvatam | santoṣo vai paraṃ svargaṃ parānando hi toṣaṇam ||35|| tuṣṭeḥ paraṃ na vai kiñcit sukhaṃ kvāpi praśasyate | dehī kāmān samāhṛtya svātmanyeva prasīdati || 36|| bhayaṃ nāsya kutastādvai nāsmāttu kasyacid bhayam | svayaṃ hīnaḥ kāmaruḍbhyāṃ yadā tatrātmadṛg bhavet || 37|| adrohaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvākāṃkṣāvivarjitaḥ | sarvārpaṇaṃ harau prāpto brahma sampadyate sa ca ||38|| yathā pravṛttiryeṣāṃ tu bhūtānāṃ rāgavāhinī | tatra teṣāṃ gatiścāsti haryarpaṇe tu śāśvatī ||39|| kecit sāma praśaṃsanti prayatnaṃ cāpare janāḥ | anye dhyānaṃ praśaṃsanti cetare cāśrayaṃ śubham ||2.185.40|| ke’pi yajñaṃ praśaṃsanti sannyāsamapare’pi ca | dānaṃ caike praśaṃsanti pare lānti pratigraham ||41|| śāntāstūṣṇīṃ sthitiṃ prāpya parameśaṃ bhajanti ca | aśāntā rājyamicchanti yatrobhayatulā samā ||42|| etad vicārya vijñānaiḥ śrayaṇīyaṃ sukhapradam | naisargānugamaṃ śreyaḥpradaṃ vai sādhanaṃ śubham |||43 || adroheṇa tu bhūtānāṃ vartanaṃ sādhusādhanam | satāṃ mārgaḥ sa vai prokto yatrātmā naiva badhyate ||44|| rājā cet sa sadā rājye vartetādrohavartmanā | satyena saṃvibhāgena damena dayayā tathā ||45||| hriyā dānena deve’tibhaktyā prajāsu rakṣayā | vaśibhāvena ca priyāpriyatulyamanīṣayā ||46 || yajñaśiṣṭādanenāpi sādhvanugrahaṇena ca | tasyāyaṃ ca paro loko bhavecchreṣṭhaphalodayaḥ ||47|| evaṃ dharmaparāṇāṃ vai sādhusevājuṣāṃ sadā | prajārakṣārthamevātra yudhyatāṃ dharmahetave ||48|| bhavet svargātpare svarge sarvottamā gatiḥ śubhā | pūrve rudrāśca vasavaścādityā lokapālinaḥ ||49|| sādhyā maruto viśveśā devā dharmaṃ tathāvidham | kṛtvā puṇyaiḥ paraṃ svargaṃ prāptāstato’tra mānavāḥ ||2.185.50 || tadvidhaṃ dharmamāśritya yāntu vai paramāṃ gatim | gṛhasthaṃ hi sadā devāḥ pitaro’tithayastathā ||51|| bhṛtyāḥ santaśca satataṃ copajīvanti mānavāḥ | vayāṃsi paśavaścāpi bhūtānyupāśritāni ca |||52|| tapo yajñastathā vidyā bhaikṣyamindriyasaṃyamaḥ | dhyānamekāntaśīlatvaṃ tuṣṭirjñānaṃ ca sevanam ||53 || vipradharmā gṛhasthe ye te kṛṣṇe’rpyāḥ sadā mayi | yajño vidyā samutthānaṃ śryarjanaṃ daṇḍadhāraṇam ||54|| ugratvaṃ caritaṃ jñānaṃ prajāvanaṃ pradānakam | rājadharmā gṛhasthe ye te kṛṣṇe’rpyāḥ sadā mayi ||55|| dhanārjanaṃ vyavasāyo dānaṃ ca pālanādikam | sasyotpattyādikaṃ vaiśyadharmā arpyā mayi prabhau ||56 || sevanaṃ sahanaṃ cājñāvartanaṃ śeṣabhojanam | bhṛtyatvaṃ śūdradharmā yete’pyarpyā mayi mādhave ||57|| pātivratyaṃ guroḥ sevā gṛhasaṃskaraṇādikam | apatyarakṣaṇaṃ nārīdharmā arpyāḥ prabhau mayi ||58|| adhyayanaṃ khelana ca vikāsanaṃ ca rañjanam | narma sāhasakaṃ bāladharmā arpyāḥ prabhau mayi ||59|| kāmo balaṃ svārthadṛṣṭirvijayo’tivicāritā | arjanaṃ yojanaṃ yuvadharmā arpyāḥ prabhau mayi ||2.185.60|| jalpanaṃ kampanaṃ pāravaśyaṃ cāśaktirugratā | ālasyaṃ cāvamānādi mayyarpyā vṛddhadharmakāḥ ||6 1 || tāḍanaṃ sahanaṃ duḥkhaṃ dāridryaṃ paśutulyatā | daṇḍaḥ pāruṣyamarpyāśca dīnadharmāḥ prabhau mayi ||62|| hāsyaṃ ratirvilāsaśca prītirdāsītvamugratā | bandho nirāśritetyarpyā strīdharmā vai prabhau mayi ||63|| ityevaṃ vartamānānāṃ mayyevārpitacetasām | samuddhāraṃ karomyeva mṛtyuvārdhinimajjatām ||64|| purā śaṃkhaśca likhito bhūdevasaṃbhavau munī | abhūtāṃ bhrātarāvāvasathāvāstāṃ tayoḥ pṛthak ||65|| nityaṃ puṣpaphalairvṛkṣairupetau bāhudāmanu | kadācillikhitaścāyādāśrame śaṃkhapālite ||66|| śaṃkho nābhūdāśrame tu tadā vanāntaraṃ gataḥ | likhitaḥ pātayāmāsa pakvāni tu phalāni vai ||67|| bhakṣayāmāsa tatraiva tāvacchaṃkha upāgataḥ | bhrātaraṃ prāha cāpṛṣṭvā sasvāmikāni vai tvayā ||68|| pātitāni phalānyatra tava dharmo’tra dūṣyati | tvayā steyaṃ kṛtaṃ cedaṃ phalānyādadatā svayam ||69|| gaccha rājānamāsādya cauryaṃ karma nivedaya | so’pi tūrṇaṃ gato bhūpaṃ nyavedayacca karma tat ||2.185.70|| mayā cauryaṃ kṛtaṃ prāyaścittaṃ tasya pradehi me | sudyumno nāma rājāha yadi rājā matastava ||71 || tadānujñāṃ mama vipra gṛhṇānyad daṇḍato vṛṇu | evamukto’pi ṛṣirāṭ varayāmāsa netarat ||72|| tato rājā karau pracchedayāmāsa ṛṣestataḥ | dhṛtadaṇḍo yayau vipro bhrātaraṃ prajagāma ha ||73 || śaṃkhastaṃ prāha dharmiṣṭha bhrātaryāhi ca bāhudām | ṛṣīn pitṝn surām̐ścaiva tarpayasva yathāvidhi ||74|| tataḥ punaḥ kadācidvai naivādharme manaḥ kṛthāḥ | śaṃkhasyājñāṃ gṛhītvaiva likhito bāhudāṃ yayau ||75|| avagāhyāpagāṃ puṇyāṃ prāyaścittaphalaṃ mayi | samarpyodakadānārthaṃ yāvadvipraḥ pracakrame || 76|| prādurāstāṃ karau tāvattasya mayyarpaṇāttadā | tataḥ kṛtvodakadānaṃ sarvārpaṇaṃ sadā mayi || 77|| samācarat sa vipro’tra karmabhūmau nirantaram | vijñāyārpaṇamāhātmyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||78|| rājā yo dattavān daṇḍaḥ so’pi tenārpito mayi | udakādipradānaṃ ca likhitenārpitaṃ mayi ||79|| śaṃkhenājñāvacanaṃ ca tathaivābhyarpitaṃ mayi | evaṃ sarvārpaṇenaite pūtā mama prabhāvataḥ ||2.185.80|| na vāgdoṣo’sti śaṃkhasya daṇḍadoṣo na bhūbhṛtaḥ | hastadoṣo nāpi tathā likhitasya madarpaṇāt ||81 || ityevaṃ mānavā ye māṃ smṛtvā mayi samarpya ca | bhuñjate cāpi vartante nirbādhāste mamāśritāḥ ||82||| māmevānte prayāntyeva karmapāśavivarjitāḥ | tathā yūyaṃ rājavargāḥ prajāvargāśca sarvaśaḥ |||83||| mayi sarvārpaṇaṃ kṛtvā bhajitvā yāta dhāma me | ahamante’suvigame tūpasthāsyāmi gocaraḥ ||84|| nayiṣye’haṃ vimānena madbhaktān dhāma me param | bhajanaṃ me prakuruta prapūjayata māṃ sadā ||85||| dṛḍhāśrayaṃ me kuruta nayiṣye dhāma me param | ityuktvā bhagavānāha lomaśāya mahātmane ||86|| dehi mantrān prajābhyaśca gṛhṇantu bhojanaṃ janāḥ | ityuktaḥ sa dadau mantrān śaraṇāgatatārakān ||87|| atha sarvaprajāḥ svasvagṛhān yayustato hariḥ | bhojanaṃ rādhike cakre sarve’pi bhojanaṃ vyadhuḥ ||88|| rātrau viśrāntimāsādya prātarutthāya satvaram | kṛtanityavidhiḥ kṛṣṇo niṣasāda nijāsane ||89|| tāvad rājā dugdhapānādikaṃ kārayituṃ prabhum | prārthayāmāsa ca hariścakāra dugdhabhojanam ||2.185.90|| tāmbūlakaṃ cādade’pi prasthānārthamiyeṣa ca | anye’pi kṛtadugdhādibhojanāḥ prātareva ha ||9 1 || gantuṃ sajjā babhūvuśca tāvad rājñī sakanyakā | pūjanārthaṃ cāyayau ca pupūja parameśvaram ||92|| saptakanyāḥ kumāryaśca jagṛhuśca karaṃ hareḥ | karadānaṃ tathā kṛtvā prāpya kāntaṃ pareśvaram ||93 || varamālādikaṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyāstadābhavan | brahmapriyāsu tāḥ sapta militvā tadvimānakam || 94|| āruruhustadā rājā hariṃ pupūja cādarāt| | prajā vidāyadānaṃ ca daduḥ rājopadā dadau ||95|| tadā vādyānyavādyanta prasthānasūcakāni vai | mahīmānā vimānāni cāruruhustataḥ prabhuḥ ||96|| āruroha vimānaṃ svaṃ kuṭumbena ca śaṃbhunā | saha sveṣṭajareṇāpi muninā bhaktiśālinā || 17|| rājñā ca jayakṛṣṇavanāmnā tadārthito hariḥ | alpaketvādikān vardhayitvāśīrbhistadāmbare || 98|| vimānena gatiṃ cakre jayakṛṣṇavarāṣṭrakam | alpādriṃ ca vyatikramya sveṣṭajarāśrayāṃ bhuvam ||99|| prāpāmbare harikṛṣṇastathānye vyomavāhanāḥ | rāhūnāyā āpagāyā mūladeśeṣu cāyayuḥ || 2.185.10 0|| rājā ṛṣiryayatuśca pūrvaṃ svāgatasiddhaye | bhūtalaṃ cakratustatra vādyādyaiḥ svāgataṃ hareḥ || 101 || varaṇāṃ nagarīṃ dṛṣṭvā jaharṣa harirīśvaraḥ | viśālāṃ śobhitāṃ śṛṃgāritāṃ ca rādhike tadā || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne’lpaketorjīvanyāṃ nagaryāṃ śrīharerbhamaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ sabhāyāṃ śaṃkhalikhitadṛṣṭāntenopadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ prātarbhojanottaraṃ sveṣṭajararṣideśeṣu jayakṛṣṇavanṛpateḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ varaṇānagaryāmāgamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 185 ||
<2.186> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ākāśād bhagavān rādhe’paśyat prāvaraṇāṃ purīm | rājñādiṣṭena mārgeṇāvātārayad vimānakam || 1 || anyānyapi vimānāni cāvaterustaduttaram | bhūrivādyānyavādyantājāyanta jayaghoṣaṇāḥ || 2 || jayanādāścābhavam̐śca prajāharṣā mamurna ca | śrīhariṃ tu svayaṃ rājābhigatvā svarṇahārakaiḥ || 3 || puṣpahārairgucchapuṣpākṣatādyaiḥ samapūjayat | rājabhṛtyāḥ śreṣṭhinaśca prajāḥ svāgatamācaran || 4 || namaskārairjayadhvānaistathā saṃkīrtanaiḥ śubhaiḥ | utsāhaṃ darśayantyaśca prajāḥ mānamadarśayan || 5 || śrīhareśca caraṇau vārbhiḥ prakṣālyāmṛtamāpapau | rājā kuṭumbasahitaḥ prajāstadamṛtaṃ papuḥ || 6 || īśānasyārhaṇaṃ cakrustathānyeṣāṃ yathāyatham | rājñī brahmapriyādīnāmarhaṇāṃ saṃvyadhāttathā || 7 || śṛṃgāriteṣu sainyeṣu hastiyāneṣu sarvaśaḥ | ārohayitvā bhagavān gajayānaṃ samāruhat| || 8 || nagaryāṃ vādyagītaiśca rājā kṛṣṇaṃ mahāpathe | rathyāyogeṣu sarveṣu hariṃ tvabhrāmayanmudā | | 9 || rājasaudhe bhṛtyasaudhe pradhānasya gṛhe’pi ca | prajālayeṣu cānyeṣu prajāḥ nītvārhaṇāṃ vyadhuḥ || 2.186.10 || pāvanīṃ nagarīṃ kṛtvā madhyāhne bhagavān nijam | āvāsaṃ tvāyayau snānaṃ cakre viśrāntimāpa ca || 11 || sarve śrāntāstato rājā bhojanāni śubhāni vai | kārayāmāsa yuktāni pramiṣṭānnāni bhūriśaḥ || 12|| bhagavān bubhuje cānye pracakrurbhojana tataḥ | viśramya tu kṣaṇaṃ sāyaṃ sabhāṃ cakre prabhurhariḥ || 12 || tatropadeśaṃ pradadau bālakṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ yathā | puṇyapāpe tu panthānau yujyete dehinā sadā || 14|| kāle pāpaṃ ca vā puṇyaṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ dadātyapi | bhavatāṃ phalitaṃ puṇyaṃ yadatra tu mamāgamaḥ || 15|| mama yogo mama sevā bahupuṇyaphalaṃ tvidam | mantraḥ phalati kālena kāle phalati cauṣadham || 16|| kāle vṛṣṭiśca bhavati vṛkṣāḥ phalanti kālataḥ | candraḥ kāle pūryate ca pūryante sarito’pi ca || 17|| prāpte tu samaye smṛddhiḥ svayamevābhigacchati | bījamuptaṃ ca samaye kālāgame prarohati || 18|| kāle jarā tathā kāle rasahānirdrumeṣvapi | kālakṛto hi paryāyaḥ sarvān spṛśati dehinaḥ || 19|| vicāryaivaṃ svasthakāle parameśaṃ śrayet sudhīḥ | kālo’yaṃ maṃgalatamo bhavatāṃ vidyate’dhunā ||2.186.20||| yogo’tra bhavatāṃ jāto mama nārāyaṇasya vai | etādṛśaṃ tu sākṣānmāṃ labdhvā ye’nyatra saṃsthitāḥ ||21 || mugdhā vājñānasampannāsteṣāṃ hāniḥ pade pade | parameśaṃ vihāyaiva tṛṣṇālobhasamudbhavaiḥ ||22|| vegaiścānyatra viṣaye sthitāste duḥkhabhāginaḥ | tṛṣṇārtiprabhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ phalaṃ teṣāṃ na cetarat ||2 3 || yadvā labhyeta ced duḥkhottaraṃ sukhaṃ kṣaṇasthiram | sukhasyānantaraṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhasyānantaraṃ sukham ||24|| sukhameva hi duḥkhāntaṃ sukhāntaṃ duḥkhameva ca | tasmādetat dvayaṃ jahyād ya icchecchāśvataṃ sukham ||25|| yannimitto bhavecchokastāpo vā mūrchanādikam | tat yajed buddhimānatra śāśvataṃ sukhamarjayet ||26|| sarvaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhanāntarīyakaṃ māyikaṃ nviha | duḥkhānāṃ tu kṣayo nāsti jāyate hyuttarottaram ||27||| tasmāt paryāyabhāvena cāntarbhāvena sarvadā | sukhamiśraṃ samāyāti duḥkhaṃ saṃsāriṇaḥ khalu || 28|| vicāryaivaṃ kṣaṇaṃ naṣṭaṃ bahvāyāsaṃ ca tāpakṛt | sukhasaṃjñaṃ dhruvasaṃjñaṃ śāśvataṃ sukhamarjayet ||29|| sevayā tapasā bhaktyā dharmeṇaikāntikena ca | dānena nigraheṇāpi yānti sukhaṃ hi śāśvatam ||2.186.3 0 || santoṣo vai svargatamaḥ santoṣaḥ paramaṃ sukham | tuṣṭiḥ sudhāmṛtaṃ tuṣṭistuṣṭyā vai siddhiruttamā ||3 1 || nārāyaṇāśrito jīvo nārāyaṇabalāt sadā | bibheti na parāt kvāpi nāsmād bibhyati kecana ||3 2|| sarvatra matkṛtāhlādo brahma sampadyate tadā | yadā na bhāvaṃ kurute kasmiṃścidapi pāpakam ||3 3|| manasā karmaṇā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā | mānamohau hatau yena hatāḥ saṃgā mṛṣā tathā ||34|| mamāśrayamupetaśca nirvāṇamupayāti saḥ | matvā kṣayāntanicayān patanāntasamucchrayān ||3 5|| viyogāntakasaṃyogān maraṇāntakajīvanam | duḥkhāntakasukhaṃ cāpi vijño māṃ samupāśrayet ||36|| sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ krameṇaivopapadyate | taṭasya cetanāmāśu haratyeva ca dehinaḥ ||37|| satyevaṃ cābhijāto’smi siddho’smi cāsmi vai mahān | ityevaṃ sicyate cittaṃ naṣṭasmṛtirbhavatyapi ||38|| naṣṭasmṛtiḥ parasvānāmādānaṃ sādhu manyate | tamatikrāntamaryādaṃ rājā śāsti yamastataḥ ||3 9|| tasmād vicārya vīkṣyāpi vijño bhaiṣajyamācaret | sādhūnāṃ śaraṇaṃ yadvā śrīmannārāyaṇasya ca ||2.186.40|| anyathā duḥkhasampattirvibhramo’niṣṭavedanam| trikaṃ samupapadyeta caturthaṃ nāsya vidyate ||41 || jarāmṛtyū hi bhūtānāṃ khāditārau yathā vṛkau | na kaścittāvatikrāmedapi brahmāṇḍabhūpatiḥ |||42|| upasthitasya duḥkhasya parihāro na vidyate | sukhasyāpi tathā bodhyaṃ naikāntaṃ tacca vidyate ||43|| arthā nāyānti saṃsāre vāñcchitāḥ kintu cānyathā | upatiṣṭhanti vartante’varjanīyāḥ sadānyathā ||44|| apriyaiḥ saha saṃyogo viyogaḥ supriyaiḥ saha | arthānarthakarāvetau sukhaduḥkhapradau matau ||45|| utpattiḥ puṣṭirantaśca sarveṣvete pratiṣṭhitāḥ | gandharūparasasparśā kāle santi prayānti ca ||46 || āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ vimānaṃ pānamañjanam | bhojanaṃ ca samutthānaṃ jāyate ca vinaśyati || 87|| vaidyā api tu rugṇāste balinaḥ strīṣu nirbalāḥ | śrīmanto’pi tu ṣaṇḍhāste vicitraḥ karmaparyayaḥ ||48|| kule janma mahāvīryamārogyaṃ rūpamārjavam | saubhāgyamupabhogādyā labhyante bahupuṇyataḥ ||49|| teṣu satsvapi bhaktiścet kṛṣṇe nāstīti niṣphalāḥ | santi putrā daridrāṇāṃ bahavaścāpyanicchatām ||2.186.50|| nāsti putraḥ samṛddhānāṃ vicitraṃ karmaceṣṭitam | vyādhistāpaśca viduṣo bubhukṣā nirdhane tathā ||5 1 || āpadastu dhanāḍhyasya jvaraśca nṛpateḥ sadā | nirmāṇaṃ yasya yattasmād vicitraṃ karma ceṣṭitam ||52|| yuvā dhanī mṛto yāti nirdhanaḥ śatavarṣabhāk | akiñcanāściraṃjīvāḥ smṛddhāścālpāyuṣastathā ||53 || śrīmatsu bhogaśaktirna daridre jāṭharo’tigaḥ | sadhane kāryabuddhirna vicitraṃ karmaceṣṭitam ||54|| etadvicārya matimān svātmaśreyaḥ samācaret | nauṣadhāni na vai mantrā na homā na punarjapāḥ ||55|| mānatā mānavasmṛddhiḥ prāptamṛtyuṃ na rakṣati | yathā pūre taruḥ kāṣṭhaṃ sameyātāṃ yadṛcchayā |||56 || sametya ca vyapeyātāṃ tathā bhūtasamāgamaḥ | strīrājyasutavanto ye ye’nāthāśca parānninaḥ ||57|| īśvarā vā daridrā vā kālasteṣu samakriyaḥ | kṛtavidyāśca ye’ndhā vā yatnavanto na yatninaḥ ||58|| bhajamānāścābhajantaḥ kālasteṣu samakriyaḥ | abhuktaṃ vā prabhuktaṃ vā rakṣitaṃ nādṛtaṃ ca vā ||59 || viprakṛtaṃ svīkṛtaṃ vā kālasteṣu samakriyaḥ | mātāpitṛsahasrāṇi putradārāyutāni ca ||2.186.60|| asaṃkhyadhanarājyāni bhuktvā tyaktāni janmasu | punaḥ prāptāni saṃsāre kasya te kasya vā vayam ||6 1 || na cāsya kaścid bhavitā nāyaṃ bhavati kasyacit | mārge saṃgatameved dārabandhusuhṛnmayam ||62|| kvāse kva ca gamiṣyāmi ko’haṃ kimatra cāsthitaḥ | kiyān kālo dhruvo me’sti vicārayet punaḥ punaḥ ||63 || anitye duḥkhasaṃvāse bahiḥ sukhasame’śubhe | mārge saṃgatamevedaṃ mātā bhrātā sutaḥ priyā ||64|| jaganmajjati nityaṃ ca gaṃbhīre kālasāgare | jarāmṛpyumahāgrāhe na kaścidavabudhyate ||65|| āyurvedamadhīyānā api vyādhiparābhavāḥ | pibanto’pi kaṣāyām̐śca na mṛtyumatiyānti te ||66|| rasāyanapibāścāpi bhavanti jarayāplutāḥ | tapasvino’pi dātāro yajñino’pi ciraṃsthitāḥ ||67|| divyadehāścāmbarasthā api jīryanti kālataḥ | na hyahāni nivartante bhūtānāṃ yāni yānti vai ||68|| kālādhvānamanantaṃ vai sarvalokaniṣevitam | kṛtasthairyo’pi saṃyāti jano’vaśo’tilālasaḥ ||69|| deho jīvaṃ ca vā jīvo dehaṃ cābhyeti pānthavat | pānthena pānthā abhyetya viyanti bāndhavādayaḥ ||2.186.70 || nātrātyantaṃ susaṃvāso labhyate jātu kenacit | api svena śarīreṇa tadānyena tu kā kathā ||7 1|| ka gatāḥ karmiṇaḥ pūrve pitāmahādayastvataḥ | na paśyāmo vayaṃ tāṃstu te na paśyanti no’pi ca ||72|| māyayā tu piśācinyā bhakṣitāḥ pācanaṃ gatāḥ | agādhagarte saṃsuptā na nissaranti te punaḥ ||73|| tasmād vicārya kālaṃ ca karma māyāṃ viḍambinīm | dehaṃ viśvāsahaṃ cāpi saṃgatānāṃ viyojanam ||74|| svasyāsthairyaṃ kālabhakṣyaṃ cākasmikaṃ jagattathā | bhajantu bhagavantaṃ māṃ rakṣakaṃ kālapāśataḥ ||75|| madyoge na punarmṛtyurna grāsaḥ kālabhoginaḥ | na nāśaḥ sukhasampatterdhāmni me bhavatāṃ bhavet ||76|| macchrayāśca manmanaso madarpitendriyārthakāḥ | matsvarūpe sthitaprajñā yānti me śāśvataṃ sukham ||77|| jñānaṃ cāmṛtamevoktaṃ yadi bodhaphalaṃ bhavet | sevā me bhojanaṃ tasya yadi śraddhānvitā bhavet ||78|| prāptirme tṛptirevāsti yadi māhātmyasaṃyutā | sarvārpaṇaṃ mayi tasya śāśvatānandadāyakam ||79|| evaṃ vicintya vai bhaktā narā nāryo’pi sarvathā | karma sarvavidhaṃ kṛṣṇe mayyarpayantvaharniśam ||2.186.80|| ahaṃ nairguṇyametasmin prāpayya phalavarjanām | madātmakaphalāvāptiṃ dāsye coddhārasaṃjñitām ||8 1 || ityuktvā bhagavān rādhe virarāma tato janāḥ | pupūjuḥ parayā bhaktyā bālakṛṣṇaṃ krameṇa vai ||82|| candanena kusumaiścākṣatairhāraiḥ sugandhibhiḥ | puṣpasārai rasasārairambarairbahumūlyakaiḥ ||83|| vibhūṣābhiḥ phalairbījairmauktikai ratnahīrakaiḥ | upadābhirvividhābhirarcayitvā tato janāḥ ||84|| ārārtrikaṃ vyadadhuśca namaḥ stutiṃ vyadhustathā | atha rājā tathā rājñī tathā rājakuṭumbakam ||85|| sabhāyāstu samāptiṃ vai kṛtvā nijālaye harim | sanninyubhojayāmāsurhariṃ hareḥ kuṭumbinaḥ ||86|| maharṣīṃśca mahīmānān brahmapriyāstathāparān | bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ rājasevāparāyaṇāḥ ||87|| tato rājñī svayaṃ kanyāmāha naijāṃ suśobhanām | ekāmevādvitīyāṃ tāṃ kṛṣṇahastaṃ gṛhāṇa vai ||88|| sāpi cecchāvatī śīghraṃ kṛṣṇahastaṃ samagrahīt | mālāṃ sauvarṇajāṃ ratnakhacitāṃ śrīharergale ||89|| nyadhāt puṣpamayīṃ cāpi haristasyā gale hyapi | evaṃ vivāhavidhinā rājakanyāpa mādhavam ||2.186.90|| tadutsavaṃ tadā rājā cakre’tha ca tataḥ param | rātrau viśramya bhagavān prātaḥ prajājanān svayam ||9 1 || śrāvayāmāsa ca manuṃ naijaṃ vaiṣṇavatāpradam | kṛtāhnikastato gantuṃ mano dadhe’tha bhūpatiḥ ||92|| dugdhabhojyairhariṃ sarvān mahīmānān samantataḥ | bhojayāmāsa vidhinā vidāyaṃ ca dadau tataḥ ||93|| yānavāhanasainyaiśca vādyaghoṣairjayasvanaiḥ | puṣpākṣatairharṣaṇaiśca vidāyaṃ pradadau tadā ||94|| vimānānyabhavan vyomni niṣeduḥ sarvaśo janāḥ | harirvimānamāruhya gatyarthaṃ ca samairayat || 95|| rāhūnāṃ cāpagāṃ krāntvā vyomni vimānakāni vai | pherunasarṣivāsātmapradeśān prayayurdrutam ||96|| parīśāno nṛpaścātra pherunaso munistathā | vimānaṃ cāgrataḥ kṛtvāvateraturbhuvaṃ drutam || 97|| svāgatārthaṃ hareḥ rājā sainyaṃ samairayacchubham | vādyaghoṣān jayaśabdān yantrasphoṭānakārayat ||98|| prajā vyomni vimānāni pratīkṣante sma sādaram | lājākṣatakusumādyairyuktā harṣabharāstadā ||99|| atha śrībālakṛṣṇo vai dadarśa śobhanāḥ sthalīḥ | senānadītaṭe ramye parīśāṃ nagarīṃ śubhām || 2.186.10 0|| śobhayā nākamadharaṃ kurvāṇāṃ smṛddhiśālinīm | udyānairmiśritāṃ saudhaiḥ svarṇavaṇairvirājitām || 101 || viśālāṃ devatulyaiśca mānavairadhivāsitām | rādhike tvatsamābhiśca sundarībhirvirājitām || 1 02|| rājadarśitamārgeṇa mahodyāne nṛpālaye | vimānaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇaḥ samavātārayacchanaiḥ || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne jayakṛṣṇavarājarṣirājye vimānādavatīrya varaṇānagarīṃ paribhramya pūjāṃ pragṛhyopadeśaṃ datvā rātrau bhojanaṃ viśrāntiṃ labdhvā prātaścāhnikaṃ kṛtvā dugdhapānādyuttaram ṣaṣṭhyāṃ pherunasarṣideśān parīśānarājarājyaṃ harirjagāmetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 186 ||
<2.187> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca golokarāśeśvari bālakṛṣṇo vimānamadhyād bahirājagāma | dadarśa lakṣādhikamānuṣāṇāṃ sammardamāścaryakaraṃ tadānīm || 1 || cakorajātīyasamastakānāṃ yathendutejovalaye’kṣivṛttiḥ | tathākhilasvāgatakārakāṇāṃ pareśvare’bhūd varade’kṣivṛttiḥ|| 2 || yathā mayūrā ghanadarśanena bhavanti kekāninade’timagnāḥ | tathā prajāḥ śrīharidarśanena tadābhavan vai jayanādamagnāḥ || 3 || yathā ghane svātijale’tihṛṣṭā nandanti vai cātakapakṣisārthāḥ | tathā ghanaśyāmaphale’tihṛṣṭā ānanditāḥ svāgatapakṣisārthāḥ || 4 || yathā tu bālā madhurāṃ suśarkarāmāsādya modātibhṛtā bhavantyapi | tathā prajāḥ sveṣṭasudhānanaṃ prabhuṃ samprāpya modātibhṛtāstadābhavan || 5 || yathā satī kāntamatīva sundaraṃ ciraṃ viyuktaṃ hyadhigamya modate | tathā prajāstaṃ parakāntamacyutaṃ sadāviyuktaṃ pratilabhya harṣitāḥ || 6 || yathā pataṃgā hyatitejasānalaṃ vilokya kṛṣṭā abhiyanti mohitāḥ | tathā prajāṃgāni samujjvalaṃ prabhuṃ vilokya kṛṣṭāni patanti mohini || 7 || yathā niśeśaṃ prasamīkṣya pūrṇinaṃ jagatsu vārāṃnidhayo dravantyabhi | tathākṣareśaṃ prasamīkṣya pūrṇakaṃ prajābjakoṭyo’bhimukhaṃ dravantyapi || 8 || yathāpya lauhāni tu lauhakāntaṃ nisargatastatparito’bhiyanti | tathāpyalokā bahulokakāntaṃ nisargato bālahariṃ prayānti || 9 || yathā tu nadyo jaladhiṃ prayānti yatheṣṭalabhye hṛdayāni yānti | tathā prajānāṃ hṛdayāni kṛṣṇe samastadigbhyo hyabhavan gatāni || 2.187.10 || śrībālakṛṣṇo’mitatejasānvito babhūva madhyāhnagabhāskaropamaḥ | suśvetarūpātimanoharaprajā babhūvurunnidrasarojasannibhāḥ || 11 || tadā vimānaṃ hariṇā tvadhiṣṭhitaṃ puṣpābjalakṣaiḥ kusumāyanaṃ hyabhūt| | vicitrajātīyasumādhivāṭikābhramodvahaṃ mandaraśṛṃgamīkṣitam || 1 2|| haristadābhūt khalu puṣpavṛkṣaḥ sarvauṣadhimiśraṇagucchaśobhaḥ | nijākṣarasyānanagahvarādvā viniṣkramannakṣaramuktaśobhaḥ || 1 3|| dhṛto’cyutenācyutahīrakānvitaḥ suvarṇamāṇikyasuratnamuktavān | kirīṭavaryo nijamūrdhni kalgiyug yathāsthitaḥ saṃśuśubhe divaspatiḥ || 14|| nisargajāsaṃkhyakaraśmijālavān mukhābhitejaḥ paridhiḥ samantataḥ | sahasrabhāvṛttaniśāṃpatiḥ sthito hyabhinnatāyāḥ smṛtimātanotyapi || 15|| viśālabhālaṃ sitakaisaradvayordhvarekhayuksattilakena bhāyujā | janebhya āvedayati dvimārgakau sureśvarasyākṣaradhāmakasya ca || 16|| netre viśāle ca manohare priye sucañcale premabhare’timañjule | anantavātsalyavivarṣiṇī harestadā vibhinnāṅgitabodhinī mate || 17|| pravālaraktāyanakādharau hareḥ sānandamandasmitasaṃbhṛtau tadā | ākarṣaṇaṃ cādadhataśca yoṣitāṃ samastabhāvairmanasāṃ tathātmanām || 18|| suvartulau kuṃkumaraṃgasaṃspṛśau samunnatau kāntivilāsinau hareḥ | ānandapūrṇau maṇitulyabhāsvarau mṛdū samāstāṃ hṛdayaṃgamau śubhau || 19|| adakṣahasto dhṛtapuṣpagucchako varaprado’bhūcca tadā samunnataḥ | dhanurdhvajasvastikaśūlamatsyakābāṇāḍhyadakṣo’bhayadaḥ karo’bhavat ||2.187.20 || viśālavakṣaḥsthalaśobhicañcannavīnavaicitryasupuṣpamālāḥ | sammiśraṇaṃ prāpya ca kaustubhena śriyo mukhaṃ vakṣasi darśayanti ||2 1 || skandhau dṛḍhau puṣpasumālikābhirvyāptau tathā karṇasukuṇḍalāktau | ratnatviṣā pāravatīprabhe ca rādhārame’darśayatāṃ bhujasthale ||22|| tadodaraṃ divyasupuṣpahāraiśchannaṃ harervyaṃjayati prajābhyaḥ | hārātmaniḥśreṇikayā viśantu vakṣaḥsthale bhaktiyujo madūrdhvam ||23 || asaṃkhyadāsīparisevitāṃghridvayaṃ vyarājat sthalapadmakābham | janapravāhaiḥ satataṃ nataṃ cānanyapradaṃ svalpasamarpitasya || 24||| haristadā bhūpatibhistu samrāḍ rājā prajābhiśca guruḥ praśiṣyaiḥ | sadbhiśca sādhuḥ pramadābhiriṣṭo dīnaiśca dātā kavibhiḥ purāṇaḥ ||25|| prāpyaśca bhaktairaṇureva yogibhiḥ rūpapriyābhirnaṭavaryaveśakaḥ | kāntaḥ satībhiḥ ṛṣibhiśca vaidiko manoharaḥ sarvajanairapekṣitaḥ || 26|| sopānamārgeṇa harirhasan śanairavātatāreśvarapuṣpavārṣṭitaḥ | purāṃganādyakṣatavardhito janairjayadhvaniśrāvita āptakāmanaḥ || 27|| pradarśayan naijajanūm̐ṣi vai muhuḥ sopānakebhyaḥ samavātatāra ha | rājā sṛtau kauśikakomalāmbaraṃ samāstaratpādanidhānakakramāt ||28|| yatrābhavacchobhanakānako rathaḥ śataikasauvarṇaghaṭādhiśṛṃgavān | aṣṭaikacakrātisuvegavānapi catūradairvāraṇasaptakairyutaḥ ||29|| madhye parībhiḥ paritaḥ parībhiḥ surāṅganādyarpitamālikābhiḥ | bhrasanmukhābhiḥ priyasundarībhiḥ śṛṃgāritaḥ puṣpavimānatulyaḥ ||2.187.30 || rājā parīśānaka eva taṃ hariṃ nināya tūrṇaṃ sakuṭumbakaṃ prabhum | rathe samārohayadīśvareśvaraṃ nyaṣādayat kānakavāraṇāsane || 31 || pupūja hārairvividhairvicitraiḥ sugandhisāraiḥ sumacandanaiśca | lājākṣataiḥ śītasugandhivārbhiḥ sauvarṇabhūṣābhiramūlyavastraiḥ ||32|| dadau ca rājā suravālamuttamaṃ kauśeyamapyuttamarukmabuṭṭukam | tathā dadau kañcukamujjvalaṃ tathāvidhaṃ mahābhūpatidhāryamuttamam ||3 3|| dadau ca hīrāñcitaratnarājibhiḥ . samanvitaṃ sanmukuṭaṃ sakalgikam | dadau vibhūṣāśca suvarṇavaikṛtā dadhāra sarvān bhagavān pareśvaraḥ ||34|| papau jalaṃ śrīharipādadhautaṃ dadhāra mūrdhni svakuṭumbayuk ca | harirdadau kaṇṭhagatāṃ sumālāṃ gucchaṃ ca rājñe svakṛpābhiśaṃsam ||35 || janāstu lakṣādhikagauramūrtayaḥ surālayāt kiṃ sugatāstadābhavan | candrābhaśobhāḥ khalu śuklavarṇakāḥ supiṃganetrāstanudīrghayaṣṭayaḥ ||36|| gauryaśca kanyā pramadā yuvatyo vṛddhā api svalpanigūḍhadehya | samānaraṅgyo dhṛtacitrachatryo vivṛttakeśyaśca piśaṃganetryaḥ ||37|| saṃlagnaveṣā mṛduśoṇakāntikāḥ susūkṣmapārṣṇibhramipādarakṣikāḥ | sukuṇṭhitāntāmbaradṛśyavarṇikā gauryaḥ pragauryo’pyabhavan suharṣitāḥ ||3 8|| nedurmahādundubhayastadānīṃ vyaṃgūlavādyāni mayūrakāṇi | vipañcikā vaṃśaninādakāni vīṇāstathā bandikatūryakāṇi ||3 9 || jayapraṇādā hyabhavam̐stadābhito yaśoguṇānāṃ bahukīrtanānyapi | sahasrakaṇṭhasvaramiśritānyapi tadābhavan gītikakīrtanānyapi ||2.187.40|| sahasraśo yāntrikabandhukīkṛtāstūpīkṛtā golakabhedanaiḥ kṛtāḥ | śabdāḥ sukarṇyāśca tadābhavan śubhāḥ oṃ nādamāptāḥ parameśabodhakāḥ ||41 || mahāmahāsainyakṛtā ninādāḥ praharṣaśabdā vyagaman kakutsu | gajābhinādāsturagābhinādā vyāneśire brahmagamā vidikṣu ||42|| dantipragantrīmanu gantrya āśu vimānatulyāḥ śataśaḥ sahasram | śrībālakṛṣṇānugarohitāścāgacchan śanaistulyasuśobhitāśca ||43 || dhvajāpatākottamavāvaṭādyaiḥ sauvarṇaśṛṃgaiḥ kalaśairanekaiḥ | divyātidivyairabhitoraṇaiśca rathā aśobhanta maharṣiyuktāḥ ||44|| parīprabhābhāsasamūrdhvavarṇā brahmapriyāḥ kāñcanacārubhāsyaḥ | sauvarṇayāneṣu virājayantyo golokavaikuṇṭhamatiṃ nayanti ||45|| tadā janā darśanakāriṇaste narāśca nāryo mumuhurharau vai | rūpānurūpāvayavetiramye gopālabāle hyati kāmbhareye ||46|| tadāśvavārī khalu yojanāyatābhavajjanānāmatimardasaṃkulā | anekahastyaśvakareṇukarṣabhairhaṃsaiḥ prageṇḍairgaruḍairgaveyakaiḥ ||47|| yānairvimānairanasobhiruttamairvāṣpopayānaiścaraṇābhiyāyibhiḥ | sadbhirnṛpai rājakumārakaiḥ prajājanaiḥ samastairnagarīnivāsibhiḥ ||48|| ārṣairjanaiḥ sadgurusāṃkhyayogibhiḥ pativratābhiḥ paramāśramādibhiḥ | gāṃgeyakaiḥ raudragaṇādibhistathāśvavārikā sainyayutā hi śobhate || 49|| niśamya vijñāya purāntarasthā narā vilāsinya apīśvareśam | sasaṃbhramaṃ tyaktasamastakāryā draṣṭuṃ hariṃ yānti bahirgṛhebhyaḥ ||2.187.5 0 || taddarśanātyutsukamānasāste ghaṇṭāpathānte kṛtapaṃktidurgāḥ | anyonyasammarditadehabhāgā vilokayāmāsurudagranetrāḥ ||5 1 || sthitāstu mārge hyapi viprakaṣṭe niśamya vāditraninādamuccaiḥ | haryāgamāśaikanibaddhanetrāḥ samucchritāḥ prāñjalayaḥ praṇemuḥ ||52|| sauvarṇachatreṇa sucāmarādyaiḥ sāmrājyacihnaiḥ suvirājamānaḥ | purīṃ dadarśādbhutabhūriśobhāṃ susaṃskṛtāṃ sarvarasaiḥ prapūrṇām ||53 || sugandhivārbhiśca madairgajānāṃ saṃsiktaghaṇṭāpathacatvarāṃ ca | susvastikaiḥ svarṇaghaṭaiśca raṃbhāstambhai rasālādidalaiḥ suśobhām ||54|| puṣpākṣataiḥ kṛtrimagopuraiśca mahoccadurgāḍhyasugopuraiśca | tathoccasaudhairbahubhūmikaiśca sodyānabhāgairatiśobhamānām ||55|| gṛhe gṛhe puṣpitavallikābhiḥ sugandhitaiḥ pallavitairdrumaiśca | kuṇḍasthamūlaiḥ stabakaiḥ sumāḍhyairyutāṃ ca sasyāḍhyasuvāṭikābhiḥ ||56|| sarovarairmadhyasupaṭṭabhūmiścārāmabhūmiśca vihārabhūmiḥ | vyākhyānabhūmirnaṭikādibhūmiḥ pradarśanai raṃjanakairyutāṃ ca ||57|| kalāpraśālābhiranantikābhirbhiṣakpraśālābhirabhīṣṭikābhiḥ | rasapraśālābhiravantikābhiḥ saddharmaśālābhiratīva yuktām ||58|| vidyādhraśālābhiranugrikābhiḥ saṅgītaśālābhiramītaśobhām | satsaṃgaśālābhirabhīṣṭamodāṃ yantrādiśālābhirajasraghoṣām ||99|| nakṣatravedhairghanavedhakaiśca sāmudravedhairgrahavedhakaiśca | videśavedhaiḥ samayapravedhairvāyupravedhaiḥ samatattvavedhaiḥ ||2.187.60|| uṣṇapravedhaiḥ sahitāṃ praśītavedhairghaṭīvedhakayantrayuktām | vidyutpravedhai rasavedhakaiśca svarādivedhaiśca pradarśyavedhaiḥ ||61|| gantrīpravedhaiḥ śakaṭīpravedhai rdehapravedhaiḥ pṛthivīpravedhaiḥ | jalāntavedhaiḥ sahitāṃ suśobhāṃ vijñānadhāṃ tāṃ nagarīṃ dadarśa ||62|| vimānasaṃghaiḥ satataṃ ravāḍhyāṃ parīsamābhiḥ pramadābhirāptām | vyomāntacumbyūrdhvasubhaumaśālāṃ dyāṃ cāparāṃ tāṃ nagarīṃ dadarśa ||63|| śṛṃgāritāṃ cāgurudhūpadīpairdhvajaiḥ patākābhirabhīṣṭabhāvyām | jalasravābhirnalanālikābhistāraiḥ svanākarṣaṇakāribhiśca ||64|| dūraśravaistārakadīpakaiśca sthale sthale mānasasaṃharāṃ ca | parīśanāmnīṃ bhagavān dadarśa surāṃganāmaṃdiraśobhitāṃ ca ||65|| tāṃ sampraviṣṭaṃ sumanoharāṃgaṃ pūrṇendutulyaṃ navayauvanāḍhyam | svarṇātapatreṇa ca cāmarābhyāṃ sammānitaṃ taṃ dadṛśuḥ prajāśca ||66|| āruhya harmyāṇi parīstriyastadā sasaṃbhramāstyaktasamastavṛttikāḥ | vyatyastavastrābharaṇā gavākṣakaiḥ sthirekṣaṇāstaṃ dadṛśuḥ paraṃ priyam ||67|| sthale sthale saudhakavallabhīgatastrīmaṇḍalairakṣatapuṣpacandanaiḥ | saṃvardhitaḥ śrīpatirīśvareśvaro jagrāha tāsāṃ hṛdayārpitārpitam ||68|| tathaiva haṭṭāgrakṛtekṣaṇāstadā vaṇikjanā mānanamasya vai vyadhuḥ | nārīphalaiḥ śuṣkaphalaiśca bījakairmudrābhiriṣṭābhirathāmbarādibhiḥ ||69|| viprāstadā sākṣatacandanādyaiḥ puṣpīyahārairabhivādanādyaiḥ | vedasthamantraiḥ subhagāṃ pracakruruccaiśca sāmāni jaguḥ saharṣāḥ ||2.187.7 0|| dhanāḍhyavargā dhanadānakaiśca dīnā janā mānasadānakaiśca | bhaktā janā bhaktisamarpaṇaiśca harestadā svāgatakaṃ vyadhuśca ||71 || rājā nagaryāṃ paritaḥ sasainyakaḥ prabhuṃ samabhrāmayadantasīmnikām | purīṃ vilokyaiva hariḥ praśāsanaṃ vyadhāt parīśānapurīpraśaṃsanam ||72|| nṛpasya saudhe ca maharṣikuṭyāṃ śreṣṭhipradhānādikamandireṣu | vidhāya padbhyāṃ bahupāvanīṃ kṣmāṃ purīṃ sutīrthaṃ pracakāra kṛṣṇaḥ ||73 || evaṃ paribhramya nivartanaṃ vyadhād rājādhirājo nṛpamandiraṃ prati | āgatya yānād bahiretya mandiraṃ prati prapanno’bhavadiṣṭaśāntaye ||74|| jalaṃ papau śāntimavāpa vai kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ sabhāyāṃ samupājagāma ca | uccāsane rājakṛte vidhāpite virājamāno’bhavadacyutastadā ||75|| upādideśātha janān nṛpādikān parāvareśo jagaduddhṛtisthitiḥ | tūṣṇīṃ nyaṣīdan sakalāḥ prajājanā rādhe cakorā iva candramānasāḥ || 76|| dadhurmanāṃsīndriyavṛttikā harau samastakānte nijabhaktakāntide | sadā sudhāvarṣiṇi sādhuvṛttike nijātmakānte priyakṛṣṇavallabhe ||77|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prajānāṃ sammardo hareḥ śobhā gajayānārohaṇaṃ prajānāmākarṣaṇaṃ parīśānānagaryā bhramaṇaṃ rājasaudhāgamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 187 ||
<2.188> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike śrībālakṛṣṇa upādideśa saṃsadam | parīśānanagaryāṃ yat tatte saṃśrāvayāmyaham || 1 || hariḥ prāha hi saṃsāre maraṇaṃ dhruvameva hi | śarīraṃ gatvaraṃ prāṇā gatvarā gatvarāḥ śriyaḥ || 2 || saṃyogā gatvarāḥ sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ cāpi gatvaram | gatvarāṇi hi bhūtāni cātmānyatra gamiṣyati || 3 || punarnaitādṛśaṃ prāpyaṃ gatvaraṃ kṛtabuddhinā | ātmanā sthāsnunā labhyaḥ sthāsnurmokṣo hi śāśvataḥ || 4 || agrimāṇāṃ kṣitibhujāṃ mānyo devamaharṣibhiḥ | vardhitaḥ svastivacanairāśīrbhiryojito nṛpaḥ || 5 || āvikṣito maruttaśca mahābhāgavato hyabhūt | yasya sendrāḥ savaruṇā bṛhaspatipurogamāḥ || 6 || devā viśvasṛjo rājño yajñamīyurmahātmanaḥ | yasmin śāsati pṛthivī cākṛṣṭapākadābhavat || 7 || yasya yajñe tadāsam̐śca viśvedevāḥ sabhāsadaḥ | marutaḥ pariveṣṭāraḥ sādhyāśca sādhavastathā || 8 || ahamāsaṃ kratau bhoktā mūrtimānanale tadā | sa rājyaṃ matparaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā svaṃ matparāyaṇam || 9 || yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ me ca tathā kāryaṃ nṛpairiha | suhotro nāma nṛpatistathā bhāgavato’bhavat || 2.188.1 0|| yasmin hiraṇyaṃ vavṛṣe maghavā parivatsaram | satyanāmā vasumatī svarṇaṃ nadyo’vaham̐stadā || 11 || indro vavarṣa makarān kūrmān yādāṃsi yāni ca | hiraṇyamayāni samrāṭ sa brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samārpayat || 11|| ahaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇo’smi sarvapātreṣu māṃ sa tu | suyaṣṭvā so’tithirbhūtvā yayau me paramaṃ padam || 13|| aṃgo bṛhadratho rājā mahābhāgavato hyabhūt| | yaḥ sahasraṃ sahasrāṇāṃ śvetānaśvān pradattavān || 14|| sahasraṃ ca sahasrāṇāṃ kanyā hemapariṣkṛtāḥ | sahasraṃ ca sahasrāṇāṃ gajānāmatipadminām || 15|| śataṃ śatasahasrāṇi vṛṣāṇāṃ hemamālinām | sahasrāṇi suvarṇānāṃ niṣkāṇāṃ pratimānavam || 16|| ījāno vitate yajñe somasaṃsthāsu saptasu | bhikṣukebhyo’pi viprebhyo dakṣiṇā atyakālayat || 17|| kṛtvā māṃ suprasannaṃ ca bhajitvā māṃ kratau nṛpaḥ | mahābhāgavato bhūtvā yayāvante tu matpadam || 18|| śibiścauśīnaro rājā mahābhāgavato’bhavat | ya imāṃ pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ suvarṇairabhyaveṣṭayat || 1 9|| yāvadasyāṃ gavāśvaṃ ca hastigavayakaṃ tathā | abhūt sarvaṃ pradadau sa dāne’saṃkhyaguṇaṃ tataḥ ||2.188.20||| prāpya prasannatāṃ me’tra bhūtvā bhāgavato mahān | māṃ bhajitvā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ me śāśvataṃ śibiḥ ||21 || bhagīratho’nayad gaṃgāṃ pitruddhāraṇahetave | mahābhagavato bhūtvā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||22|| dilīpaḥ kṛtavān yajñaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mama tuṣṭaye | sahasraṃ vāraṇān haimān dakṣiṇāmatyakālayat |||23|| caṣāle yasya sauvarṇe tasmin yūpe hiraṇmaye | nanṛturdevagandharvāḥ ṣaṭsahasrāṇi saptadhā ||24|| sa prasādya paraṃbrahma māṃ bhaktyā sevayā satām | yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ me tu śāśvataṃ cāpunarbhavam || 25|| māndhātā yauvanāśvo’bhūd rājā bhāgavato mahān | indro poṣṭābhavad yasya sarvakṣmāśāsako’bhavat ||26|| aśvamedhaśataṃ cakre rājasūyaśataṃ tathā | hairaṇyān rohitān matsyān brāhmaṇebhyo’dadat sa ca || 27|| yajñeṣu māṃ pratarpyaiva kṛtvā bhaktiṃ mamādhikām | prāpa dhāmākṣaraṃ me sa kṛtakṛtyo’bhavat sadā ||28|| yayātiścābhavad rājā nāhuṣo bhaktimān mama | tīrakṣepeṇa kuṇḍaṃ sa kārayitvāyajaddhi mām ||29|| cakre yajñasahasraṃ sa vājapeyaśataṃ tathā | dadau dāne trīn suyogyān svarṇaśailān madarthakān ||2.188.3 0|| vane gatvā sa māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prasādyākṣaramāptavān | ambarīṣaśca nābhāgo mahābhāgavato’bhavat || 31 || yaḥ sahasraṃ sahasrāṇāṃ rājñāmayutayājinām | ījāno vitate yajñe mayi sarvārpaṇaṃ nyadhāt ||32|| sudarśanaṃ mayā cakraṃ tadrakṣārthaṃ samarpitam | so’nte dhāmākṣaraṃ prāpa prasādya māṃ pareśvaram || 33|| śaśabindurabhavacca bhūpo bhāgavato mahān | yajñe rājyaṃ ca sarvasvaṃ dattvā vanaṃ jagāma ha ||34|| māmārādhya yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ me śāśvataṃ sthiram | gayo rājābhavacchreṣṭho mahābhāgavataḥ śuciḥ || 35|| sa ca varṣaśataṃ rājā hutaśiṣṭāśano’bhavat | agnistuṣṭo varadānaṃ bhaktirūpaṃ dadau harau || 36|| ayajad vājimedhena sahasraṃ parivatsaram | sauvarṇāṃ pṛthivīṃ kṛtvā dadau dānaṃ dvijātaye || 37|| yāvatyo gāṃgasikatāstāvatīḥ pradadau sa gāḥ | mām ārādhya cāyuṣo’nte mamākṣarapadaṃ yayau ||38|| rantidevo’bhavad rājā mahābhāgavataśca saḥ | atithau māṃ vilokyaiva puṣkasāya jalaṃ dadau || 39|| śatakoṭisahasrāṇi bhuñjate tadgṛhe dvijāḥ | sa māṃ prasādya samprāpa dhāmākṣarapadaṃ mama ||2.188.40 || sagaro nāma rājā ca vājimedhasahasrakam | kṛtvā datvā ca sarvasvaṃ māmārādhya gato’kṣaram ||41 || pṛthuḥ sākṣādahamāsaṃ so’pi cārādhanāṃ mama | kṛtvā viveśa madrūpe tathā kurvantu bhūmipāḥ |||42|| rukmāṃgadaśca rājarṣirdharmāṃgadaśca tatsutaḥ | ārādhya māṃ yayatuśca mama dhāmākṣaraṃ param ||43 || rukmāṃgadagṛhe kanyā vedhaso mohinī priyā | patnīrūpābhavad yā tu vedhā tithiḥ samucyate ||44|| sudyumnaścābhavad rājā dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ tu mām | prāpad dhāmākṣaraṃ bhaktyā śāśvataṃ mama vai prajāḥ ||45|| indradyumno’bhavad rājā puruṣottamabhaktarāṭ | māmāradhya yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ vai śāśvataṃ mama ||46|| puṇḍarīko’bhavad rājā mahābhāgavato mama | bhaktyā dhāmākṣaraṃ prāpa śāśvataṃ paramaṃ padam ||47|| prahlādaśca balirbāṇo bhūpāḥ pātālavāsinaḥ | rājasthā api bhaktyā māṃ toṣayanti divāniśam ||48|| udayano mahārājastathā raṇaṃgamo’pi ca | citraketustathā nandastvete bhāgavatā mama ||49|| kanthādharaśca bhadrāśvo lakṣmaṇo mucukundakaḥ | viśālaśca prajāpālo durjayo’śvaśirāstathā ||2.188.50|| camatkāraḥ satyasandho’mitrajit kalaśo nṛpaḥ | puṇyanidhiḥ suyaśaśca paṃcālanṛpatistathā ||5 1 || alarkastoṇḍamām̐ścāpi nābhiḥ ṛtadhvajastathā | rantirvedaśravāścāpi nandasāvarṇirityapi ||52|| nimidhruvastathā dharmadhvajaḥ kuśadhvajastathā | dṛḍhadhanvā divodāsaścānartto raivatādayaḥ |||5 3 || ete tvanye ca bahavo rājāno vaiṣṇavā mama | matprāptiṃ durlabhāṃ prāpya saṃsiddhāścābhavan khalu ||54|| saprajā bahavastatra vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayuḥ param | prajānāṃ pālanaṃ dharmo rājñāṃ bhaktiyuto harau ||5 5 || rājājñāpālanaṃ dharmaḥ prajānāṃ bhaktiyuk harau | evaṃ parasparaṃ kṛtvā sāhāyyaṃ dharmakāṃkṣiṇaḥ ||56|| mama smṛtyānvayenaiva te bodhyā mokṣabhāginaḥ | mayā niyuktaḥ puruṣaḥ sādhvasādhu karoti hi ||57|| svayaṃ sādhupravāhaḥ syānna tvasādhupravāhaṇaḥ | jñānadṛṣṭyā vicāryaiva sādhu kuryānna cetarat ||58|| sarvakarmasu sādhutvaṃ mayyarpaṇaṃ mayā matam | mayyarpitaṃ bhavet sādhu tadbhinnaṃ naiva sādhu tat| ||59|| nānyadrohakaraṃ kuryānnodvejanaparaṃ kvacit | nātmahānikaraṃ kuryānna kuryāllokagarhitam ||2.188.60|| evaṃ varteta medhāvī sarvaṃ prakṣipya vai mayi | tadā śāntiṃ parāṃ labdhā tiṣṭhedante’kṣare pare ||6 1 || narā nāryaḥ karmanaddhā nākarmāṇo bhavanti vai | naisargikī kriyā yā ca sāpi kṣipenmayīśvare ||62|| vahnau kṣiptaṃ yathā kāṣṭhaṃ śuṣkamārdraṃ ca vetarat | drutaṃ cireṇa vā bhasmībhavennaivātra saṃśayaḥ ||63 || tathā karma śubhaṃ vānyat kṣipenmayi pareśvare | bhasmīkuryā samartho’smi mokṣayāmyapi karmadam ||64|| athavā tadupādānāt prāpnuyāt karmaṇaḥ phalam | prāpnuyāditi hetośca mayīśvare nivedayet ||61|| tathāpi puruṣaḥ kartā karmaṇoḥ śubhapāpayoḥ | sābhimāno’jñānavṛttyā bhoktā syāt tatphale’pi ca ||66|| karmasūtrātmakaṃ sarvaṃ sannaddhaṃ kramaśaḥ khalu | sukhaduḥkhaguṇodarkaṃ mayi nyastaṃ viśīryate ||67|| yo hi karmasamārambhe bhavet tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ | tadā tenābhibhūyeta mayīte nābhibhūyate ||68|| mayyeva kaluṣaṃ sarvaṃ samāptaṃ jāyate tataḥ | prāyaścittaṃ na tasyāsti bhogo vā vidyate’sya na ||69|| akurvan vihitaṃ karma pratiṣiddhaṃ tathācaran | prāyaścittīyate dehī mayyarpaṇavivarjitaḥ ||2.188.70 || akāryāṇi na manujo jātu kuryāt tathāhi vai | svadharmasya parityāgaṃ paradharmānuvartanam ||71 || śaraṇāgatasantyāgaṃ bhṛtyasyābharaṇādikam | parasvāpābhiharaṇaṃ pitrā vādaṃ na vai caret ||72|| strītyāgaṃ ca yuvā kānto na vai kuryāt kadācana | patnī ca yuvatī kāntaṃ na tyajedvai kadācana ||73|| āśritānāṃ subharaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ sarvadā matam | vṛddhānāṃ sevanaṃ kāryaṃ dīnānāṃ tu sahāyatā ||74|| asatyaṃ na vadet kvāpi pāruṣyaṃ chalasaṃbhṛtam | jīvānāṃ hiṃsanaṃ naiva kuryād dayāparo bhavet ||75|| āśritānāṃ paśūnāṃ ca kuryāt kṣuttṛṭnivāraṇam | paropakāraṃ kuryācca sataśca bhojayet sadā ||76|| satāṃ sevāṃ prakuryācca mama sevāṃ ca sarvadā | ātmānaṃ sukhinaṃ kuryānnodvege svaṃ nayet kvacit ||77|| nānyānudvejayet kvāpi vṛthāmṛṣānṛtādibhiḥ | hareḥ saṃkīrtanaṃ kuryāt satataṃ vacasā hṛdā ||78|| dhyānaṃ hareḥ sadā kuryānmuktidaṃ pāpanāśakam | kuryācchubhāni karmāṇi nivarteta śubhetarāt ||79|| dadyād vittādi nityaṃ ca tena mucyeta kilbiṣāt | śiṣṭācāraḥ paro dharmo deśakālādiyojitaḥ ||2.188.80 | sevitavyaḥ sa evātra pretyeha ca sukhepsunā | daivadeśe japaṃ kuryāt homaṃ copoṣaṇādikam ||8 1 || daivasandarśanaṃ jñānaṃ kuryādātmapraśodhanam | na garveṇa bhavet prājñaḥ kadācinmṛtyudharmavān ||82|| devānṛṣīnmanuṣyām̐śca pitṝn gṛhyāśca devatāḥ | pūjayitvā hariṃ cāpi gṛhastho bhoktumarhati |||83 || evaṃ kṛtvā na lipyeta rājā prajātha sādhavaḥ | striyo dīnā vṛndalāśca tathā kurvantu sarvathā ||84|| mama nāma gṛṇannityaṃ smaranmāṃ sarvataḥ kṣaṇam | kurvan sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi nyasya na lipyate ||85|| tathā kurvantu satataṃ māṃ smṛtvā mayi cārpaṇam | ahaṃ mokṣyāmi sarvān me vaiṣṇavān matparāyaṇān ||86|| astu svasti tu bhavatāṃ rājñāṃ rājakuṭumbinām | prajānāṃ ca prajeśānāṃ dīnānāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ||87|| astu svastyabalānāṃ ca madarthakṛtakarmaṇām | sarvadā svasti cāstveva hariḥ śaṃ vidadhātu vaḥ ||88|| ityuktvā rādhike bālakṛṣṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | parīśānasabhāyāṃ tu kṣaṇaṃ tūṣṇīmabhūttadā ||89|| rājā pūjāṃ ca vidadhe’saṃkhyamauktikahīrakaiḥ | hārādyairambarādyaiśca candanādyaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ || 2.188.90|| ārārtrikaṃ mahaccakre rājñī rājakumārikāḥ | kumārāśca pradhānāśca prajāścāpi pracakrire ||9 1 || vandanaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā cakhaduśca prasādakam | hariṇā karadattaṃ ca tataśca rājakanyakāḥ ||92|| ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyākā yuvatyo mugdhamānasāḥ | hareḥ karaṃ jagṛhuśca vivāhavidhinā tadā ||93 || karagṛhottaraṃ śīghraṃ rājā mahotsavaṃ niśi | bhojayitvā mahīmānān hariṃ prāghūṇikādikān ||94|| kārayāmāsa lalitaṃ nṛtyagītikalādibhiḥ | rātrau prāghūṇikāḥ sarve viśrāntiṃ cāpuruttamām ||95|| kanyakāstu navaṃ kāntaṃ siṣevire’tibhāvataḥ | prātarutthāya bhagavān naijaṃ dhyānaṃ cakāra ha ||96|| rājāpi tvāyayau kṛṣṇapūjārthaṃ ca pupūja tam | evaṃ mahotsavo rādhe vṛtto vai pārameśvaraḥ ||97|| parīśānānagaryāṃ copadāḥ prajāstato daduḥ | vidāyaṃ jagṛhe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastadā nṛpaḥ ||98|| dugdhapānādikaṃ sarvān kārayāmāsa bhāvataḥ | lomaśastu prajābhyo vai manuṃ dadau ca tārakam ||99|| hariḥ sajjo trabhūvātha gantu parījaparvatam | indurāyo nṛpastasyāgrahaṃ cāti cakāra ha || 2.188.10 0|| tadā vādyānyavādyanta harirvimānamāsthitaḥ | anye vimānagāstatrābhavam̐stato nṛpājñayā || 101 || vyomamārgeṇa ca yayuścendurāyasya rāṣṭrakam | harirvilokayāmāsa bhūtalaṃ parvatānvitam || 1 02|| svāgatārthaṃ cendurāyastvagre yayau kuṭumbavān | sanmānatūryaninadāstadābhavan samantataḥ || 10 3|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne parīśānāprajādibhya upadeśadānaṃ pūjanaṃ vimānaiḥ saptamyāṃ prātaḥ parījarāṣṭrāgamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 188 ||
<2.189> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike śrīhariḥ śobhāṃ parīnijādrisaṃbhavām | ambarādeva parito lokayāmāsa vṛkṣajām || 1 || tatpaścime tu nagarīṃ vāyūnākhyāṃ śubhāṃ sthitām | vilokya tatra janatā darśanārthamupasthitāḥ || 2 || svāgatārthaṃ tu rājānaṃ samupasthitamagrataḥ | bhūpadarśitamārgeṇāvātārayadvimānakam || 3 || udyāne rājasaudhāgre vanatulye’tisundare | avateruśca sarvāṇi vimānānyambarāttataḥ || 4 || bālakṛṣṇo vimānātsvādaṃganaṃ prati cāyayau | rājā hārān dadau kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe sumasuvarṇajān || 9 || anyeṣāṃ svāgataṃ cāpi yathārhaṃ tvakarottadā | ninādaśravaṇenātha hariḥ prasannatāṃ gataḥ || 6 || samuttīrya tadā rājasaudhe viśrāntimāpa ha | pādau prakṣālya rājādyāścaraṇāmṛtamāpapuḥ || 7 || miṣṭānnādyaiśca vividhairbhojayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ | mahārājaṃ kuṭumbādīn maharṣīn brahmayoṣitaḥ || 8 || sarvānanyān mahīmānān bhojayāmāsa bhāvataḥ | madhyāhne ca hariḥ prāpa viśrāntiṃ ca tataḥ param || 9 || rājā sainyaṃ mahat svasya suśṛṃgāryāvadaddharim | vāyūnāyāṃ nagaryāṃ me darśanadānahetave || 2.189.10 || sasainyo’haṃ samicchāmi bhramaṇaṃ bhavataḥ prabho | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha gajapīṭhe’tiśobhite || 11 || ambālikāyāṃ kānakyāṃ niṣasāda tadetare | yathāyogyeṣu vāheṣu niṣeduśca tataḥ param || 1 2|| prāvādyanta suvādyāni tūryāṇi vividhāni ca | yantrāṇāṃ sphoṭanaśabdā mānadāśca tadābhavan || 1 3|| prajāḥ paryo harikṛṣṇaṃ gauryo nijāṃgaṇādiṣu | vardhayāmāsurīśeśaṃ lājāpuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || 14|| phalādīnyarpayāmāsuḥ pupūjurdadṛśuściram | ātmānaṃ kṛtakṛtyaṃ ca menire tāḥ prajāstadā || 15|| evaṃ bhramitvā nagarīṃ rājasaudhaṃ yayau hariḥ | rājā rājñī mahāpūjāṃ cakraturbahuvastubhiḥ || 16|| svarṇapātrāṇi raupyāṇi mudrāśca hīrakādikān | dadau śrīharaye rājopadā ambarabhūṣaṇam || 17|| rājñyājñayā tadā kanyādvayaṃ kāntaṃ hariṃ tadā | pravīkṣya bālakṛṣṇasya karaṃ jagṛhaturmudā || 18|| vivāhavidhinā tatrotsavaḥ samyag vyajāyata | rājā dadarśa kṛpayā jāmātāraṃ caturbhujam || 1 9|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇaṃ karuṇāmukham | tuṣṭāva parayā prītyā parvatastho’pyaparvakam ||2.189.20 || avidyāparvaśūnyastvaṃ māyāguṇavivarjitaḥ | pāhi saṃghātadharmebhyo naya dhāmākṣaraṃ tava ||21 || anādyantaḥ parabrahma bālakṛṣṇo narāyaṇaḥ | harikṛṣṇo bhavānāste naro nārāyaṇo bhavān ||22|| ṛṣayaḥ pitaraḥ siddhā devā gandharvadānavāḥ | pannagā rākṣasā yakṣā yaṃ na jānanti tattvataḥ ||22 || yoginaḥ sādhavaḥ satyo jñāninastāpaseśvarāḥ | yaṃ na jānanti deveśaṃ kuto’yaṃ bhagavāniti ||14|| tasmai me nama ityastu pāhi saṃsārasāgarāt | yasmin janiḥ puṣā naṣṭirbhūtānāṃ te namonamaḥ ||25|| viśvātman viśvakarmātman viśvakarmekṣaṇādiman | karmaṇāmapi naiṣkarmyaṃ dadham̐stvaṃ pāhi sāgarāt ||26|| sahasrakiraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvataścakṣuṣaṃ prabhum | anantakarapādādyaṃ namāmi parameśvaram || 27|| aṇuṣvaṇuṃ mahāntaṃ ca mahatsvapi dhruvaṃ harim | gariṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhamatyūrdhvaṃ tvāṃ namāmi pareśvaram ||28 || atibhūtādikarmāṇaṃ buddhīndriyādyagocaram | purāṇapuruṣaṃ brahma tvāṃ namāmi pareśvaram ||29||| jagatkośaṃ cātmayoniṃ sanātanaṃ jagatpatim | sarvapatiṃ hiraṇvarṇaṃ tvāṃ namāmi pareśvaram ||2.189.3 0|| tapate śītalāyāpi prakāśāya ca te namaḥ | svarāya sārthatattvāya gītirūpāya te namaḥ ||3 1 || tvamoṃkāro’vatārastvaṃ vyūhastvaṃ tvaṃ caturbhujaḥ | bhūmā tvaṃ ca mahāviṣṇurvirāṭ tvaṃ kamalāśayaḥ ||32|| tvaṃ kriyā karaṇaṃ kartā karma tvaṃ kārakastathā | draṣṭā sākṣī mahākālaḥ kavalastvaṃ ca te namaḥ ||33|| sarvarūpāya śāntāya kāṃbhareyāya te namaḥ | bālakṛṣṇāya kṛṣṇāya gopālajāya te namaḥ ||34|| sarvapāpapraśāntāya sarvaduḥkhaharāya ca | ātmapātheyarūpāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ ||35|| gṛhaṃ me pāvanaṃ kṛṣṇavallabhasvāminā kṛtam | nimagnaṃ ca kuṭumbaṃ me tvayoddhṛtaṃ pragṛhya mām ||36|| namaste sarvalokeṣu sarvātmasu ca te namaḥ | bālakṛṣṇa mahākṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeśvara namo’stu te ||37|| ityuktvā rādhike rājā cendurāyo namo’karot | anādiśrībālakṛṣṇastu taṃ prāha śubhāṃ giram || 38|| rājan bhaktiṃ pravilokya parāṃ tava mayi dhruvām | manāg divyaṃ svarūpaṃ me darśitaṃ ca mayātra te || 3 9|| kanyādvayaṃ mamedaṃ yat hastagrahaṃ cakāra ha | tadā te mānase jātaṃ kathamevaṃ ca ko nvayam ||2.189.40 || saṃśayaṃ taṃ nirasituṃ kṛpayā darśitaṃ mama | caturbhujaṃ svarūpaṃ te dhyāyasvaitat sadā hṛdi ||41 || ityuktvāsaṃharad rūpaṃ mānavo’tha vyajāyata | papāta pādayoḥ rājā dadhāra caraṇau hṛdi ||42||| sāśrunetro’bhavaccāpi prayayāce kṣamāṃ kuru | sarvaṃ jagat tavaivāsti tatra kiṃ kanyakādvayam ||43 || ityuktvā vidhinā cakre mahotsavaṃ tadā nṛpaḥ | bhojayāmāsa sarvāṃśca pūjayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ||44|| hariścopādideśāpi yathā nirbandhanaṃ bhavet | rājan karmakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sampadyate vipadyate ||45|| madāśrayaṃ tu tatkarma vyatyeti sveṣṭakṛddhi tat | mamāśrayabalaṃ tādṛk karma syādanyathāphalam ||46|| devatānāṃ dvijānāṃ ca gurūṇāṃ pūjanaṃ satām | ānṛṇyaṃ tatkarotyeva pitrośca pūjanaṃ tathā ||47|| rājñāṃ dharmaḥ samutthānaṃ tena daivaṃ prajāyate | ubhayaṃ tat prasambhūya śrīpradaṃ muktidaṃ tathā ||48|| pauruṣaṃ prathamaṃ kāryaṃ tato daivaṃ samāśrayet | vinārambhaṃ prayatnaṃ vā phalabhāṅ na bhavet kvacit ||49|| pauruṣaṃ cāpi daivaṃ ca satyenāsāditaṃ yadi | dhruvasiddhipradaṃ syāttat pretya ceha sukhāvaham ||2.189.50 || śīladāntimārdavāḍhyo janaḥ śrīsevito bhavet | kāraṇaṃ svasya saukhyasya parabrahma vicintayet ||51 || kāraṇaṃ naiva hanyādvai tatkṛte svo vihanyate | jalādagnirbrāhmaṇātkṣatriyo’śmanaśca loṣṭhakam ||52|| utpannaṃ yadi hetuṃ svaṃ hantuṃ yāti vinaśyati | ātmā jñānaṃ kriyā karma samutpannā hareḥ puraḥ ||5 3 || hariṃ cenna bhajate’sāvātmahā harihā bhavet | kṛṣṇaghātaparasyāsya vināśo vahnivad bhavet ||54|| tasmādahaṃ sadā rakṣyo dhāryo mantavya ādarāt | smartavyaśca pūjanīyo dāsye muktiṃ hi bandhanāt| ||55|| vṛthā saṃpariheyāni vyasanāni mumukṣubhiḥ | vyasanaṃ bhojanaṃ pānaṃ śayanaṃ narmakāritā ||56|| rañjanaṃ nityasaṃlagnaṃ yathāpekṣātireki tat| | mayi cennyastamevaitad vyasanaṃ na nigadyate ||57|| nirvāhamātrāpekṣaṃ tad vyasanaṃ na nigadyate | ayogyanupayogī ca dyutādistu vipanmatā ||58|| vipadāṃ tu padaṃ nityaṃ duḥkhaśokānuyāyi vai | yatra tat syāt kathaṃ saukhyaṃ vindeta mānavo nijam ||99|| tasmād vicārya nairarthyaṃ tyajennisargadūṣakam | evaṃ vai vartamānā cet prajā syād varapaddhatiḥ ||2.189.60|| tadā dharmo bhavet tatra bhaktyā ca śraddhayā yutaḥ | yatra dharmaśca tatrāhaṃ nivasāmi nirantaram ||6 1 || pratyakṣo vā ca hṛdaye rakṣayāmi nijāśritam | bālān rakṣati māteva taṃ rakṣāmi vṛṣānvitam ||62|| tasmād dharmayutāḥ sarve māṃ bhajantu prajādayaḥ | uddhariṣyāmi kāmodāt sāgarānnātra saṃśayaḥ ||63|| mūrtiṃ me sthāpayantvatra nityadarśanahetave | gamiṣye tvadya saṃsnātumindirāyā jale śubhe ||64|| svasti vo’stu sukhaṃ cāstu sadārogyaṃ nirāmayam | ityuktvā cāsanāt kṛṣṇaḥ samuttasthau tataḥ param ||65|| nṛpo yānāni sarvāṇi vyomayānāni yāni ca | sajjayāmāsa śīghraṃ ca vidāyaṃ nṛpatirdadau ||66|| indirāyāṃ mahānadyāṃ snātvā supānarāṣṭrakam | gantavyameva sāyaṃ vai ceti niścayato hariḥ ||67|| sajjo bhūtvā samārohad vimānaṃ cāparepi ca | yānānyāruhya ca vimānānyāruhyāmbare’bhavan ||68|| rājā rājñī kuṭumbaṃ ca prajāḥ kṣamā yayācire | prasthānasya ca tūryāṇāṃ ninādā gītayastathā ||69|| jayaśabdā harṣanādā jīvaśabdāstadābhavan | supānamuninā sārdhaṃ mudrāṇḍena nṛpeṇa ca ||2.189.70|| sahasthenārthitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yayau puraḥ | vardhitaścāñjalivrātairindirātaṭamāyayau ||71 || avatīrya viśāle ca pradeśe yānatastadā | sasnau haristathā sarve sasnustīrthaṃ hyabhūddhi tat ||72||| dānaṃ śrībhagavām̐statra supānamunaye dadau | hareḥ snānāmṛtavāri papurbhaktajanāstadā |||73 || yatra snāto haristatra vetālā bahavo’bhavan | pūrvakarmakṛtāḥ sarve vigatiṃ tatra vai gatāḥ ||74|| te sarve tvāyayurgaurā api tejovihīnakāḥ | duḥkhino mānave rūpe nyavedayannasadgatim |||75|| prasahya luṇṭhakāḥ pūrve vayamārāvaṇāḥ khalāḥ | prajāpīḍākarāścaurā nijapāpairmṛtā iha ||76|| śītajhaṃjhāpravātena pīḍitāḥ kṣutpipāsitāḥ | jātā vetālakāścātra nivasāmo nadītaṭe ||77|| uddhāraṃ kuru deveśa vayaṃ te śaraṇāgatāḥ | ityukto bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’mṛtaṃ jalam ||78|| dadau tebhyo’bhipānārthaṃ papuste pāpavarjitāḥ | tatkṣaṇaṃ jātapuṇyāśca divyadehāḥ surā yathā ||79|| devā devyo’bhavam̐ste ca svargārhāḥ śubhagātriṇaḥ | kṛpālurbhagavānāha lomaśāya mahātmane ||2.189.80 || manumebhyaḥ prāpayātra vaiṣṇavāḥ syustaduttaram | lomaśastān harermantraṃ śrāvayāmāsa satvaram ||81 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | śrutvā mantraṃ vaiṣṇavāste divyarūpā vavandire ||82|| hariśceśānadevaṃ samprāha caitān nijāśritān | kailāse preṣaya śaṃbho gaṇāste santu tatra ca ||83 || ityuktaḥ śaṃkarastān saṃpreṣayāmāsa vai drutam | vyomnā kailāsalokaṃ ca hariḥ sarve janāstataḥ ||84|| vimānāni samāruhyāyayuḥ supānarāṣṭrakam | dūrākhyasaritastīre madriṭāpattane śubhe ||85|| viśāle lakṣaśāle ca bahūdyāne samantataḥ | svarganibhe susamṛddhe vyomnaḥ śobhāṃ vyalokayan ||86 || śṛṃgāritaṃ hi bahudhā saṃsiktaṃ gandhavāribhiḥ | toraṇairgopūravaryairnagaraṃ bahvaśobhata ||87|| sainyaṃ rājājñayā sāyaṃ nārāyaṇasya tuṣṭaye | svāgatārthaṃ nadītīre mahodyāne tadāramat ||88|| vimānaṃ nṛpatiḥ svasya samavātārayat tataḥ | ṛṣiḥ rājā prajāścāpi svāgatārthaṃ puro’bhavan ||89|| tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayanādāstato’bhavan | yantraśabdā janaghoṣāstūpaśabdāstato’bhavan || 2.189.90|| rājadarśitamārgeṇa vimānaṃ śrīharirnijam | mahodyāne’vātārayad rājasaudhasamīpataḥ ||9 1 || anyānyapi vimānāni cāvaterustadāmbarāt | rādhike harṣanādaiśca lājākṣatasumādibhiḥ ||92|| vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ prajā rājādayastadā | jayatvasaṃkhyatattvādhidevaścetiravān vyadhuḥ ||93 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne indurāyarāṣṭre tatsaudhe hareḥ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ vāyūnānagarībhramaṇam upadeśanaṃ vidāya saptamyāṃ sāyam indirānadīsnānaṃ vetāloddhāro mudrāṇḍarājarāṣṭrāgamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 189||
<2.190> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike rājā mudrāṇḍo mādhave tadā | puṣpahārān svarṇahārān ārpayat samapūjayat || 1 || rājaveṣaṃ bahuśobhamadhārayattadā harim | madriṭānagarīṃ sāyaṃ bhrāmayituṃ samārthayat || 2 || sarvāṃstatra mahīmānān pupūja rājakeśarī | supānarṣiśca tilakaṃ candrakaṃ haraye’karot || 3 || jalapānaṃ dadau paścād vāhaneṣu nṛpo’khilān | nyaṣādayad satūryāṇi vyanādayacchubhāni vai || 4 || harirnavaṃ rathaṃ śubhraṃ kambalājinasaṃvṛtam | yuktaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirgobhiḥ pāṇḍuhurairdevalakṣaṇaiḥ || 5 || tathāgryaikena mahatā pāṇḍureṇa vṛṣeṇa ca | bandibhiḥ stūyamānaścābhyarcyamāno maharṣibhiḥ || 6 || āruroha rathaṃ svarṇamaṇimauktikarājitam | jagrāha raśmīn maudrāṇḍaḥ kumārastrigrasāṇḍakaḥ || 7 || gavādakavitarṣiśca dhārayāmāsa chatrakam | dhriyamāṇaṃ mahacchatraṃ pāṇḍuraṃ rathamadhyagam || 8 || śuśubhe tārakāyuktacandramiva suhīrakaiḥ | cāmaravyajane tvasya munī jagṛhaturmudā || 9 || supānarṣistathā mitramaharṣiśca mahāvratau | candraraśmisamakāntiyute dīrghātimañjule || 2.190.10 || kṛṣṇasya pitarau rādhe bhrātaraśca svasā tathā | rathe sthitā adṛśyanta sarvedevasamāstadā || 11 || rathaṃ śubhraṃ samāsthāya yuktaṃ turagasatamaiḥ | anvayāt pṛṣṭhato rudraśceśāno gaṇasevitaḥ || 1 2|| rathaṃ hemamayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mahādīrghāśvayojitam | lomaśaśca samāsthāyānvayād rudraṃ guruḥ svayam || 1 3|| vṛkāyano nīlakarṇaścobhau pītarathena ca | yayatustu tato nīlavarṇāśvayojitena vai || 14|| brahmapriyāstataḥ sarvāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ sahasraśaḥ | narayānaistathā yānairuccāvacairyayustataḥ || 15|| gāṃgeyāḥ ṛṣayaḥ sarve kanyakāśca tathāpare | rājakanyāśca rājñyaścānvayurbhavyaiḥ rathādibhiḥ || 16|| tato rathāśca bahulā nāgāścoṣṭravṛṣānvitāḥ | padātayo hayarūḍhāḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ samanuvrajan || 17|| tato vaitālikāḥ sūtā māgadhāścāraṇāstathā | subhāṣitāni gāyanto yayuḥ prajājanānvitāḥ || 18|| tadā tu darśanaṃ viṣṇorbabhūvāpratimaṃ sukham | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyānupamaṃ bhuvi || 19|| madriṭāyāṃ hareḥ praveśane nagaravāsibhiḥ | nagarī rājamārgādyā bahudhā samalaṃkṛtāḥ || 2.190.20 || pāṇḍurairmālyavargaiśca patākābhiśca medinī | saṃskṛtā rājamārgābhūd dhūpanaiśca pradhūpitā ||2 1 || tathā cūrṇaiḥ sugandhānāṃ nānāpuṣpapriyaṃgubhiḥ | mālyadāmabhiḥ saṃsaktairnagarī śobhitā kṛtā ||22|| kuṃbhā dvāri kṛtāścāsan jalapūrṇā navāḥ śubhāḥ | sitāḥ sumanaso gaurā nikṣiptāstatra tatra ca ||23|| yathāsvalaṃkṛtānyeva dvārāṇi raṃgavallibhiḥ | evaṃ śṛṃgāritāyāṃ ca nagaryāṃ sa viveśa ha ||24|| praveśane harestatra janānāṃ puravāsinām | didṛkṣūṇāṃ sahasrāṇi samājagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ ||25|| rājamārgo’tiśuśubhe samalaṃkṛtacatvaraḥ | candrodaye’bdhivṛddhiśca pūrāgatāgatairyathā ||26|| prajānāṃ rājamārgeṣu vṛddhiścācintitābhavat | gṛhāṇi rājamārgeṣu ratnanaddhāni sarvathā ||27|| prākampantīva bhāreṇa gaurīṇāṃ pūrṇitāni vai | tāḥ striyaśca praśaśaṃsuḥ kāṃbhareyaṃ śriyaḥ patim ||28|| brahmapriyā imā dhanyā yāḥ prāptāḥ puruṣottamam | gaurīṇāṃ vratacaryāṇi praśaśaṃsustathā striyaḥ ||29|| praśaṃsāvacanaistāsāṃ prītiśabdaiśca rādhike | jayaśabdaiḥ kīrtanaiśca puramāsīnnināditam || 2.190.30 || pratirathyaṃ pratimārgasaṃgamaṃ praticatvaram | pratihaṭṭaṃ pratiharmyaṃ prajā ānarcurīśvaram ||3 1 || bhramitvā nagarīṃ rājamārgeṇa ca tato hariḥ | alaṃkṛtaṃ śobhamānamupāyād rājaveśma ha ||32|| tatra prakṛtayaḥ sarvāḥ paurā jānapadā api | ūcuḥ karṇasukhā vāco diṣṭyā prāpto’si mādhava || 33 || bhavatkṛpā bhavataśca darśane’tra matā śubhā | anyathā darśanaṃ kṛṣṇa kathaṃ te bhāgyamantarā ||34|| evaṃ rājakuladvāri maṃgalairabhitoṣitaḥ | praviveśa hariryānāduttīrya rājamandiram || 35|| rājā maharṣayaścāpi rājapatnī kumārikāḥ | gandhamālyai ratnahārairārcayan kṛṣṇavallabham || 36|| sumanomodakai ratnairhiraṇyena ca bhūriṇā | upadābhirvividhābhirvividhaiśca kimicchakaiḥ || 37|| tatraivāvasaraṃ jñātvā mohapāśavaśaṃgatāḥ | rājakanyā harerhastaṃ jagṛhurdaśa pañca ca || 38|| tataḥ puṇyāhaghoṣo’bhūnnāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ tathā | suhṛdāṃ prītijanakaṃ puṇyaṃ śrutisukhāvaham || 39|| tathā dundubhinirghoṣaḥ śaṃkhānāṃ ca manoramaḥ | jayaṃ pravadatāṃ cāpi prādurabhūtsvanaḥ śubhaḥ ||2.190.40|| śrutvā śrībālakṛṣṇaśca prasannahṛdayastadā | kāñcane rājasaudhasthe nyaṣīdat paramāsane ||41|| upādideśa bahudhā sabhāyāṃ bhūpatervṛṣān | vyasanī ced bhaved rājā lokaiḥ saparibhūyate ||42|| udvejayati lokaṃ yo dveṣṭi sukhaṃ na vindati | svapriyaṃ tu parityajya lokahitaṃ samācaret ||43 || dhīratāṃ na tyajet kvāpi rājā lokahitāvahaḥ | nātyarthaḥ parihāsaśca bhṛtyaiḥ kāryo nṛpeṇa vai ||44|| avamanyanti rājānaṃ saṃgharṣādupajīvinaḥ | sve sthāne na tu tiṣṭhanti laṃghayanti tu tadvacaḥ ||45|| preṣyamāṇā na gacchanti guhyaṃ prakāśayanti ca | ayācyamapi yācante bhojyāni bhakṣayanti ca ||46|| kruśyanti paridīpyanti kāryāṇi ghātayanti ca | vañcanāṃ cāpi kurvanti luñcāṃ gṛhṇanti vai kvacit ||47|| hastākṣaraiḥ kṛtrimaiśca sādhayanti nijāṃ kṛtim | strīrakṣibhiśca sajjante tulyaveṣā bhavanti ca ||48|| vāntaṃ niṣṭhīvanaṃ cāpi kurvate rājasannidhau | nirlajjā nṛpanikaṭe bhūtvā ghnanti yaśo’pyanu ||49|| rājavāhaṃ hayaṃ hastirathādyārohayanti ca | sabhāyāmapi rājānaṃ cājñāninaṃ vadanti ca ||2.190.50 || kruddhe nṛpe hasantyeva mantraṃ visraṃsayanti ca | guptaṃ prakāśaṃ kurvanti śāsanaṃ laṃghayanti ca ||5 1|| helanaṃ cāpi kurvanti nindanti sannidhāvapi | asmanmuṣṭyāṃ nṛpo’styeva lokām̐ścaivaṃ vadantyapi ||52|| tasmād bhṛtyādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ harṣulo na mṛdurbhavet | udyamaṃ saṃprakuryācca bhuktimuktipradaṃ sadā ||53|| lokānāṃ rañjanād rājā nṛpadharmo hi rañjanam | satyasya rakṣaṇaṃ cāpi vyavahārasya rakṣaṇam ||54|| kṣānteśca rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ rājamārgāccalenna ca | ātmavān puruṣārthaṣu jāgran rājatvamarhati ||55|| mānavāḥ sarvadharmāśca rakṣitavyā nṛpeṇa vai | vṛddhāḥ prasevanīyāśca sevanīyāśca sādhavaḥ ||56|| sadbhyo dadyādasadbhyastu samādadyānnṛpo vṛṣāt | śiṣṭān śiṣṭakriyāścāpi mānayet sarvathā nṛpaḥ ||57|| viduṣo rakṣayed rājā nītijñān śāstrakovidān | kathākārān dharmadhartṝn parameśopadeśakān ||58|| gurūm̐śca mānayed rājā pūjayed bahudānakaiḥ | sādhūn sampūjayennityaṃ bhojayed śṛṇuyāt kathāḥ ||59|| devālayān kārayecca pūjāprabandhamācaret | nityaṃ bhaktyā svayaṃ rājā yajeta devatāḥ priyān ||2.190.60|| daśāṃśaṃ vā ca viṃśāṃśaṃ śatāṃśaṃ pañcamāṃśakam | rājyarddhidravyadhānyebhyo’rpayeddharmārthameva saḥ ||6 1 || tīrthāni rakṣayed rājā kratūm̐śca kārayettathā | goviprastrīdīnabālān yatīn saṃrakṣayecchritān ||62|| nityaṃ dadyāttu dānāni pūjayitvā gurūn janān | vṛddhān vandeta satataṃ gṛhṇīyādāśiṣastataḥ ||63|| bhagavantaṃ smarennityaṃ prātaḥ sāyaṃ ca karmasu | na trāsaṃ janayet kiṃcidāyurnāśakaraṃ na ca ||64|| puṇyanāśakaraṃ cāpi naiva kuryāt kadācana | vighasāśī bhavennityaṃ brahmayajñaparo bhavet ||65|| prajāyāṃ saṃprapaśyettu putravātsalyamuttamam | māṃ hariṃ saṃsthitaṃ sarvāsvapi matvārcayed yathā ||66|| hiṃsanaṃ na vṛthā rājā kuryāt svārthārthamityapi | satkāryāṇi sadā loke samārabheta bhāvataḥ ||67|| puṇyakāryeṣu sāhāyyaṃ dadyāt kuryāt svayaṃ hyapi | sādhūn saṃvāsayed rājye seveta paramādarāt ||68|| bhagavantaṃ ca bhaktām̐śca bhrāmayennagarādiṣu | mālāvartanamādadhyād rājā nityāsanasthitaḥ ||69|| vartayet svakuṭumbādi dharme karmaṇi bhaktiṣu | snānaṃ dhyānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca nivedanam ||2.190.70|| dānaṃ dharmaṃ bhajanaṃ ca sevāṃ kurvannṛpaḥ svayam | evaṃ varteta ced rājā mucyate na tu badhyate ||71 || yasya kūṭaṃ na kapaṭaṃ na māyā satsu vai kvacit | yasya gehe kathā jñānaṃ bhajanaṃ devapūjanam ||72|| satāṃ vartmānugaścāpi tyāgīva vartate ca yaḥ | sa bhavedvai kvacinmokṣabhāgīśvareśasevayā ||73|| yathā rājā tathā dharmo yathā dharmastathā prajāḥ | kṛṣṇadharmo’tiyatnena rājñā rakṣyo mumukṣuṇā ||74|| svasmin bhāgavate dharme tiṣṭhatyeva kuṭumbakam | bāndhavāḥ suhṛdaścānye prajādyā api sarvathā ||75|| varteran sātvate dharme yathā rājā tathā prajāḥ | tasmād rājan prajāścāpi sarve kurvantu sāttvatīm ||76|| bhaktiṃ me mokṣadāṃ śreṣṭhāmuddhariṣye madāśritān | ityuktvā virarāmāsau bālakṛṣṇo hi rādhike ||77|| rājā prajādayaḥ sarve jagṛhustadvacāṃsi vai | mantraṃ mantravihīnā ye te sañjagṛhuraiśvaram ||78|| kaṇṭhīṃ ca bhajanaṃ nāmaraṭaṇaṃ jagṛhuśca te | tataḥ sabhāṃ visarjayāmāsa mudrāṇḍako nṛpaḥ ||79|| bhojanāni hariścāpi kuṭumbaṃ ca maharṣayaḥ | īśānādyā mahīmānāścakrurbrahmapriyādikāḥ ||2.190.80|| rātrau viśrāntimāsādya kṛtvotthāyāplavādikam | nityapūjāṃ vidhāyātha dugdhapānādikaṃ tathā ||81|| hariḥ sajjo’bhavad gantuṃ pūrtagaṇḍapradeśakān | tadā rājā prārthayacchrīhariṃ śaivālapattanam ||82|| gantuṃ gavādakavitānadītaṭasthamuttamam | haristathāstviti prāha jayaśabdaiśca kīrtanaiḥ ||83|| saha pūjāṃ samāgṛhya svaṃ vimānamarūruhat | anye niṣeduḥ śīghraṃ ca mudrāṇḍako’pi tatkṣaṇam ||84|| vimānamadhiruhyāgre yayau svāgatasiddhaye | vimānāni viceruśca śaivālapattanaṃ prati ||85|| kṣaṇāt prāpuśca taṃ deśaṃ gavādakavitāntikam | avaterurvimānāni gavādakavitātaṭe ||86|| rājā nijālaye kṛṣṇaṃ sarvānānarca bhāvataḥ | udyānaphalapuṣpādyairapūjayaddhariṃ nṛpaḥ ||87|| ārārtrikaṃ cakārātha nagare’bhrāmayatprabhum | kṛtvaivaṃ pāvanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hi pattanam ||88|| dugdha phalādikaṃ jagdhvā prāpya pūjāṃ nṛpādibhiḥ | prajābhiśca kṛtāṃ sarvāmāśiṣaḥ sampradāya ca ||89|| tanmānena samaṃ śīghramiyeṣa gantumacyutaḥ | gaṇḍo nāma nṛpastatra netuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ samāgataḥ ||2.190.90|| pūrtagaṇḍarṣiṇā sākaṃ hariḥ sajjo’bhavattataḥ | śīghraṃ vimānamāruhya datvāśīrvacanāni ca ||91 || yayau śṛṇvan jayanādān nadīṃ gavādayānikām | samullaṃghya nadīdeśānākāśe vyacaraddhariḥ ||92|| trigirāṃ ca nadīṃ prāpya rājā vai gaṇḍakaḥ puraḥ | pūrtagaṇḍarṣiṇā sākaṃ svāgatārthamavātarat ||93|| līśavanaṃ pattanaṃ ca śṛṃgāritaṃ hi rādhike | sainyayuktaṃ śubhaṃ gatvodyāne svāgatamācarat ||94||
