iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne madriṭānagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ rājaveśmāgamanaṃ pūjanam upadeśo bhojanaṃ niśottaram aṣṭamyāṃ prātaḥkṛtyottaraṃ prayāṇaṃ śaivālanagarīṃ bhramitvā pūrtagaṇḍarṣipradeśeṣu gaṇḍakanṛpasya līśavanapattanaṃ prati gamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 190 ||
<2.191> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike pūrtagaṇḍarṣirgaṇḍako nṛpaḥ | rājñī kumārikāścāpi kumārāśca tathāpare || 1 || bāndhavāścāmātyavargāḥ svāgatārthaṃ puro’bhavan | vimānamambarād rājodyāne hyavātaraddhareḥ || 2 || anyānyapi vimānāni cāvateruḥ samantataḥ | tadā vādyānyavādyanta tūryanādāstadābhavan || 3 || agāyanta ca gītāni jayaśabdā babhūvire | paṭahānāṃ vigulānāṃ dundubhīnāṃ ravottamāḥ || 4 || prajāharṣabharaiḥ śabdairdiśo hyanādayan daśa | harirvimānādutthāya śreṇyā bahiḥ samāgamat || 5 || rājā ṛṣiḥ kuṭumbādyāḥ puṣpādyaiḥ samavardhayan | hārairakṣatavaryaiśca lājābhiḥ svāgataṃ vyadhuḥ || 6 || gajayanvyā harikṛṣṇaṃ rājā nyaṣādayattathā | anyān yathocitavāheṣvapi sadvāhaneṣu ca || 7 || gantryādiṣu paṭolle ca śakaṭīṣu nyaṣādayat | vādyaśabdaiḥ saha deveśvaraṃ līśavanāṃ purīm || 8 || bhrāmayāmāsa sotsāhaḥ prajāścakruḥ samarhaṇam | darśanaṃ pādapūjāṃ ca bahūpadābhirādarāt || 9 || samudratīraśobhāṃ ca vilokya bhagavām̐stataḥ | rājaprāsādake śreṣṭhe samāyāt sakuṭumbakaḥ || 2.191.1 0|| rājā rājñyā ca kanyābhiḥ pūjitaḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | candanairgandhasāraiśca kusumairambaraiḥ śubhaiḥ || 11 || śītahāraiścaurṇaveṣai ratnairābhūṣaṇādibhiḥ | dravyaiḥ phalaiḥ prapūjāṃ śrīhareścakruḥ pradhānakāḥ || 12|| atha gaṇḍasya vai kanyā nava tatra kumārikā | karagrahaṃ hareścakrurvivāhavidhinā drutam || 13|| rājā babhūva ca bhāgyāt kṛtakṛtyo nṛpī hyapi | tadutsavaṃ mahāntaṃ ca cakre pūjanamānanaiḥ || 14|| bhojanaṃ kārayāmāsa rājā pakvānnapūritam | nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ tatra kārayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ || 15|| rājā kṛṣṇāya bahudhārpayāmāsa vibhūtikāḥ | bhagavān pūrṇagaṇḍāya ṛṣaye tā dadau tadā || 16|| bhuktvā viśrāntimāpuśca pānatāmbūlacarvaṇaiḥ | dugdhapānaiḥ svayaṃ rājā mahīmānānarañjayat || 17|| atha sāyaṃ sabhāsthāne bālakṛṣṇaḥ prajājanān | upādideśa bahudhā śāntivākyāni cāṃjasā || 18|| rājye vā vāṭikāyāṃ vā gṛhe vāpi vane’pi vā | antarvṛttiparo dehī vivekī śāntimṛcchati || 1 9|| tṛṣgātantuṃ suvicchidya bhogyavṛttiṃ vihāya ca | ātmasthityā sutiṣṭhed yaḥ sa śāntimadhigacchati || 2.191.20|| īhā coparatā yasya liṅgaṃ nirliṅgatāṃ gatam | rasanā nīrasā yasya sa śāntimadhigacchati ||21 || śabdāstvākāśabhāgāśca sparśā dāvānalopamāḥ | rūpāṇi kuṣṭhatulyāni yasya śāntiṃ sa ṛcchati ||22|| nāryaḥ prāṇaharā yasya yasyā naraśca rākṣasaḥ | dṛśyate manasā tyāgāt sa śāntiṃ sābhiyāti vai || 23|| dhātavo malarūpāśca kuṭumbaṃ vānarāyitam | bhṛtyāḥ kṣayasamā yasya sa śāntimabhiyāti vai || 24|| śiṣyāḥ śatrusamā yasya putrā bhakṣaṇatatparā | deho yasya sadā rugṇaḥ sa śāntimabhiyāti vai || 25|| vairāgyaṃ vartate yasya rāgasthalaṃ tu duḥkhadam | snehasthalaṃ nānukūlaṃ sa śāntimabhiyāti vai ||26|| bahubhoge bahuduḥkhe śāntiṃ yāti vivekavān | nāhaṃ deho na me bhogyaṃ nāhaṃ bhoktā hi dīnavat| || 27|| nāhaṃ jaḍādhīna evaṃ vivekī śāntimṛcchati | nadīnāṃ ramyabhāgeṣu vanodyāneṣu mandire || 28|| devālayeṣu tīrtheṣu nirjane śāntibhāg bhavet | yadā yatra na vai santi śatravo bahirāntarāḥ ||29|| āgantukāśca vā nityāstadā śāntiṃ pragacchati | kṣataduḥkho yathā nidrāvaśo duḥkhaṃ na vetti hi ||2.191.30| | jagaddhato’pi jīvātmā tūryāgato na khidyati | vāsanāprahataḥ prāṇī sādhusaṃgatimṛcchati ||3 1 || sādhusevārataḥ syāccet sādhvīṃ śāntiṃ sa gacchati | satāṃ guṇān pragṛhṇīyāt satāṃ śīlaṃ samācaret ||3 2|| agrāhyaṃ varjayennityaṃ grāhyaṃ śubhaṃ samārthayet | taraṃgān mānasān dehī śamayet śāntimān bhavet || 33 || vikalpān saṃśayān mohān tyajet guroranugrahāt | tarkān hetūn vivādām̐śca tyajennijamanīṣayā ||34|| udvegān dāvahetūm̐śca jñātvā dūrād vivarjayet | āyatiṃ suvicāryaiva vartayet nirabhiplavaḥ || 35|| hariṃ śaraṇamāsādya phalaṃ tatra samarpayet | ārabheta hariṃ dhyātvā māṃ kartāraṃ vibhāvya yaḥ || 36|| madanusyūtabhāvena kuryāddhitaṃ hitārthadam | svasya vānyasya sutarāṃ śreyaskṛtaṃ samācaret || 37|| jñānavijñānakośena dhanāḍhyatvaṃ vicārayet | aparigrahasampannastṛpto’tiśāntimāvahet ||38|| evaṃ vicārya satataṃ rājñā rājñyā prajādibhiḥ | anyonyahitamāśritya vartitavyaṃ suśāntaye ||39|| sevāṃ prajānāṃ rakṣāṃ ca rājarakṣāṃ parasparam | ātmabuddhyā sutabuddhyā samācaret suśāntidām ||2.191.40|| bṛhaspatirviśālākṣaḥ kāvyaḥ prācetasastathā | bharadvājo mahendraśca gauraśirā manustathā ||41 || brahmavādāsta evaite rakṣāṃ dharmaṃ parasparam | praśaṃsanti sadā kalpe kalpe rājapratāhitam ||42|| dānaṃ satāṃ sadā sevā satāṃ saṃgrahaṇaṃ tathā | dākṣyaṃ satyaṃ cārjavaṃ cāvekṣā samantatastathā ||43|| sīdatāṃ ca samuddhāraḥ kulīnānāṃ prasañjanam | sādhūnāmaparityāgaḥ sevā buddhimatāmapi ||44|| śatrumitraudāsyakānāṃ nirīkṣaṇaṃ pare svake | nītidharmānusaraṇaṃ cānāryavarjanaṃ sadā ||45|| utthānaṃ sarvathā yogyaṃ loke kārye harau matau | mokṣe tyāge ca vairāgye dharmā rakṣāparā nvime ||46 || rakṣaṇīyāḥ sadā rājñā prajayā cāmṛtehayā | utthānenāmṛtaṃ prāptāḥ surā mahendrasaṃhitāḥ ||47|| utthānena vihīnasya rakṣā dūraṃ prayāti hi | dharmotthānaṃ sadā kāryaṃ dharmiṣṭhāṃ cācaret kriyām ||48|| yadyapyasya vipattiḥ syād rakṣādharmasya dehinaḥ | so’pyasya vipulo dharmo yato rakṣāhameva vai ||49|| rakṣā ca rakṣakaścāhaṃ rakṣyaścāpyahameva ca | sadā rakṣākaraṃ cāhaṃ rakṣayāmi na saṃśayaḥ ||2.191.50 || arakṣakān krūrabhāvān na rakṣāmi kadācana | rakṣako rājavargaśca matsvarūpo’sti bhūtale ||51 || tasmād rakṣā mama dharmo matkṛtā pālyatāṃ janaiḥ | ityucyamāne śrīkṛṣṇe nārāyaṇe parātmani ||52|| rādhike gaṇḍako rājā papraccha śrīnarāyaṇam | rājaśabdaḥ kathaṃ kasmāt kadā vai bhavatā kṛtaḥ ||53 || tulyaśārīrabhāve’pi tulyendriyātmake’pi ca | tulyaduḥkhasukhe tulyavikāre tulyavigrahe ||54|| tulyaśukrāsthimajje ca tulyamāṃsādisaṃbhṛte | tulyaprāṇaśarīre ca tulyamṛtyubhavānvite ||55 || evaṃvidhe’pi caikasmin rājatā kathamūrdhvagā | kathameko viśiṣṭām̐śca śūrām̐śca paṇḍitānapi ||56 || adhitiṣṭhati sattāvān pṛthvīṃ rakṣati caikalaḥ | prasādena tathaikasya lokaḥ sarvaḥ prasīdati ||57 || ekasminneva rāṣṭraṃ ca devavad yāti sannatim | bhagavam̐statkathaṃ sāmye’pyeṣā vai rājatātigā ||58 || vartate sarvamūrdhanyā vadātra kāraṇaṃ tu kim | śrutvā prāha hariḥ rādhe rājaniyamajāṃ kathām ||59|| ādau kṛtayuge cātra nāsīd rājyaṃ na rājyapaḥ | na rājā na ca daṇḍo’bhūd daṇḍyo nāsīcca daṇḍakṛt ||2.191.60 || satyadharmaiḥ prajā brāhmyo rakṣanti sma parasparam | kalpavṛkṣāḥ kalpavallyaścintāmaṇiśca kāmagauḥ ||61 || āsaiṃstena prajāḥ sarvāḥ svātmādhīnāḥ sukhāstadā | atha kāle kṛtānte ca kalpanāyāṃ balāni tu ||62|| kṣīṇatāṃ saṃgatānyeva tadā svatvaṃ pravartitam | mamedaṃ kalpavṛkṣaṃ ca na tavedaṃ vivāditam ||63|| evaṃ mamatāmohau ca prajāsvāviśatāṃ tadā | cintāḥ saṃkalparūpāśca niṣphalāśca tadābhavan ||64|| tṛṣṇādoṣābhiveśena dharmaḥ satyo vyanīnaśat | lobhasya vaśamāpannā aprāptasyābhimarśinaḥ ||65|| kāmo’paro mahān doṣaḥ prajāsu pratyapadyata | kāmaparān janān rāgo’niṣṭakṛd vai samaspṛśat ||66|| tena kāryaṃ tathā kāryaṃ nābhyajānanta mohitāḥ | agamyāgamanaṃ cāpi vācyāvācyaṃ vyajāyata ||67|| bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ tathā dūṣyādūṣyaṃ ca pratyapadyata | viplute mānave loke brahmabhāvo nanāśa ha ||68|| brahmanāśe dharmanāśo devāstrāsaṃ tato’gaman | yayuśca pitaraṃ cājaṃ prasādyocuḥ suduḥkhinaḥ ||69|| brahman mānavaloke vai satyaṃ brahma layaṃ gatam | dharmo nāśaṃ gatastena vayaṃ svāhāvivarjitāḥ ||2.191.70 || kṣīṇatāṃ ca gatāḥ smo’dya mānavaiḥ samatāṃ gatāḥ | ato niḥśreyasaṃ yattad dhyāyasveha pitāmaha ||71 || brahmāha bhavatāṃ śreyaścintayāmi bhayāpaham | tatastretāmukhe brahmā dharmaṃ cārthaṃ ca kāmanām ||72|| mokṣaṃ ceti caturvargaṃ dharmaṃ cakre pṛthagguṇam | dharmarūpān niyamām̐śca daṇḍarakṣādikalpitān ||73|| cakre yajñādirūpām̐śca karmaphalādimiśritān | artharūpān padārthāṃśca kṣetravāṭīgṛhādikān ||74|| dhanasampatsvarūpām̐śca cakre svatvādibodhakān | kāmarūpān niyamām̐śca ṛtūn parasparānvitān ||75|| mohādiniyamām̐ścakre svasvabhogyavyavasthitān | mokṣadharmaṃ sāmarūpaṃ cārpaṇaṃ mayi mādhave ||76|| trivargārpaṇamevāpi mokṣadaṃ cetyanirṇayat | anyāni bahudhānyeva prakārāṇi hyanirṇayat ||77|| tāṃ nītiṃ śaṃkaraḥ pūrvaṃ jagrāheśānako hyayam | śaṃkaroktaṃ ca tacchāstraṃ vaiśālākṣaṃ tadābhavat ||78|| indrastasmātprajagrāha bāhudantakameva tat | bṛhaspatirlilekhedaṃ bārhaspatyaṃ tato’bhavat ||79|| auśanasaṃ tato jātaṃ tato nītiḥ pravartitā | devairviṣṇuścārthitaśca nītiśāstravidaṃ prati ||2.191.80|| tato nārāyaṇaścāhaṃ dadau vai mānasaṃ sutam | virajasaṃ tatputro’bhūt kīrtimān tasya putrakaḥ ||8 1 || kardamo’bhūt tasya putro’naṃganāmā subuddhimān | prajārakṣayitā sādhurdaṇḍanītiviśāradaḥ ||82|| tatsuto’bhūdaṃgarājo mṛtyuputrīṃ sunīthikām | vivāhya venaṃ krūraṃ vai putramekamajījanat ||83|| taṃ venaṃ dveṣiṇaṃ mantrakuśairjaghnurmaharṣayaḥ | mamanthurdakṣiṇaṃ corumṛṣayo venadehajam ||84|| niṣādaṃ janayāmāsurniṣādāśca tato’bhavan | bhūyo’sya dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ mamanthuste maharṣayaḥ ||85|| tato’haṃ pṛthurūpaścābhavaṃ śastrī ca varmavān | nītiśāstrajña evāhaṃ rājaśabdamavāptavān ||86|| mayā devaiḥ saha bhūmiḥ samapāṭā vidhāpitā | saṃkalpena mayā sarvā rājyasmṛddhirnavīkṛtā ||87|| ādye tu yugaparyāye rājyaṃ vai sthāpitaṃ mayā | pṛthvī dugdhā prajārthaṃ ca prajā daṇḍena rakṣitā ||88|| rañjanādvai prajāḥ prāhuḥ rājā pṛthuriti kṣitau | kṣatatrāṇāt kṣatriyo’haṃ tato’bhavaṃ dvijo’pi san ||89|| pṛthivīsthāpanaṃ rājyasthāpanaṃ cāhameva tu | viṣṇuḥ sanātanastatrākaravaṃ nītiyojim ||2.191.90 || mallalāṭāttadā jātaṃ kamalaṃ kānakaṃ śubham | śrīḥsaṃbhūtā tato devī kamalā dharmapatnikā ||9 1|| śrīrartharūpābhūd rājye kāmadā mokṣadā api | vaiṣṇavī śrīryadā rājye vartate mokṣadā tu sā ||92|| evaṃ tataḥ samārabhya devāśca naradevatāḥ | budhaistulyāḥ śabditāśca madaṃśā bhūbhṛto yataḥ ||93|| śraiṣṭhyamevaṃ mayā nyastaṃ rājñi rājatvasaṃjñakam | tena rājñā prajābhiśca draṣṭavyo’haṃ nijātmasu ||94|| pūjanīyo vandanīyaścārpaṇīyo’tibhāvataḥ | mayyarpitāstu māmeva prāpsyanti nātra saṃśayaḥ ||95|| māṃ vihāyābhimantāro naijaṃ padaṃ tu ye nṛpāḥ | kṣayaṃ yāsyanti te nyūnaṃ rājavaṃśā daridrakāḥ ||96|| ityevaṃ nirṇayaṃ jñātvā bhajantu māṃ janārdanam | rājarājeśvaraṃ nityaṃ caturvargaṃ nidhāya ca ||97|| mayyeveti hariḥ prāha rādhike ca sabhājanāḥ | jagṛhustadvacāṃsyeva nemuḥ sarve tato yayuḥ ||98|| hariḥ prāpa nijāvāsaṃ rājasaudhe ca bhojanam | cakārānye mahīmānāścakrurbhojanamādarāt ||99|| viśrāntiṃ ca tataḥ prāpuḥ rātrau sarve’pi nidritāḥ | rādhike rājakanyāstaṃ kṛṣṇakāntaṃ siṣevire || 2.191.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne gaṇḍakarājadhānīṃ prati gamanaṃ līśavanānagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanamupadeśanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 191 ||
<2.192> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike navamīprātarmaṃgalaistūryaniḥsvanaiḥ | bandimāgadhasūtānāṃ vāgbhirjāgaritaḥ prabhu || 1 || jajāgarustathā sarve nityavidhiṃ pracakrire | rājā dugdhādi bhojyādi tvānīya haraye dadau || 2 || sarve cakrurdugdhapānaṃ bhojanaṃ ca yathocitam | āśīrvādān dadau tatra bhūbhṛte śrīhariḥ prabhuḥ || 3 || janatābhyastathāśīrvāggauravādi dadau hariḥ | tato gantumabhavacca sajjo līnorṇarāṣṭrakam || 4 || līnorṇanṛpatistatrāgatya cārthayadacyutam | phalāśanena ṛṣiṇā sārdhaṃ prabhustadāvadat || 5 || gaṇḍako nṛpatistatra vidāyaṃ pradadau bahu | harirvimānavaryaṃ ca samāruroha pūjitaḥ || 6 || āruruhustathānye’pi prajājayadhvanīṃstadā | śṛṇvantaḥ sarva evaite prerayan vyomapattriṇaḥ || 7 || khāḍikāṃ ca samullaṃghya vāruṇīṃ nagarīṃ yayuḥ | līnorṇabhūpatiḥ pūrvamavatīrya puraṃ nijam || 8 || phalāśanarṣiṇā sākaṃ hareḥ svāgatamācarat | bhūpadarśitamārgeṇāvātārayad vimānakam || 9 || haristathānye yānānyavātārayattadāmbarāt | vādyānāṃ gītikānāṃ ca ninādo vyānaśe’bhitaḥ || 2.192.1 0|| hariryānāt samuttīrya narayāne suśobhite | rājñā pradarśite svarṇe vyarājata jayadhvanaiḥ || 1 1|| rājñā mālādibhiḥ samyak pūjitaḥ parameśvaraḥ | kuṭumbādyaiḥ saha sarvān vāruṇyāmavihārayat || 12|| rājasainyena sahito bhagavān nāgarairjanaiḥ | arcitaścāyayau saudhaṃ rājālayaṃ viśālakam || 1 3|| viśaśrāma tataḥ sasnau bhojanaṃ jagṛhe tadā | anye’pi bhojanaṃ cakrustato rājñī hareḥ puraḥ || 14|| pūjanārthaṃ samāyātā catuḥkanyāsamanvitā | kanyā hariṃ priyaṃ prāpya karagrahaṃ vyadhurmudā || 15|| rājñī pūjāṃ yautakaṃ ca pradadau vidhinā tataḥ | viśramya ca tataḥ sajjo babhūva bhagavān drutam || 16 || rājñaścābhiprāyamāpya sarvān sajjān vyadhāt prabhuḥ | bṛhaccharanṛpasyāgre rāṣṭraṃ vai khāḍigāntigam || 17|| vallījīvanamuninārthito harirjagāma ha | bṛhaccharo nṛpaścāgre hyavātarannijāṃ purīm || 18|| dhīvarākhyāṃ śobhitāṃ ca śrīhariṃ tu sahānayat | nagaryāṃ bhavane ramye pupūja parameśvaram || 19|| rājā rājñī kanyake ca prajāḥ svāgatamācaran | kanyādvayaṃ hareḥ pāṇiṃ jagṛhatuḥ subhāvataḥ ||2.192.20|| rājābhavat kṛtakṛtyo harirniśāṃ nināya ha | prātarnagaryāṃ parito vyabhramat sainyaśobhitaḥ || 21 || prajābhyo darśanaṃ datvā kṛtvā tāṃ pāvanīṃ purīm | dugdhapānādikaṃ kṛtvā gantuṃ sajjo’bhavatprabhuḥ | |22|| tāvatpaścimasāmudro rājā śrutvā prabhuṃ drutam | vimānaiḥ saha vai śīghraṃ netuṃ tatra samāyayau || 23|| aṃgarājo hariṃ natvāprārthayatparameśvaram | haristathāstviti prāha sajjastūrṇaṃ tadābhavat || 24|| anyānyapi vimānāni susajjāni tadābhavan | khāḍīmuttīrya bhagavān milindāṃ nagarīṃ yayau || 25|| rājñā sammānitaḥ śaktyā vādyaiḥ sainyena kīrtanaiḥ | pūjanairupadādānaistoṣito bhrāmitaḥ pure ||26|| bhojanaṃ kārayāmāsa madhyāhne sarvamānavān | sāyaṃ sarvān vimāneṣu kṛtvā dvīpānadarśayat || 27|| punaḥ sarvaṃ vilokyaiva milindāmāyayau hariḥ | dadau tatropadeśaṃ ca rājanītyupabṛṃhitam ||28|| dvilīnāyāḥ prajāścāpi sukautukīprajāstathā | śruśravustatra cāgatyopadeśaṃ saha cāṃgakaiḥ ||29|| daśamīrajanībhāge lakṣādhijanasaṃsadi | hitaṃ mokṣakaraṃ cāpyupādideśa ca rādhike ||2.192.3 0|| īśāno’yaṃ parabrahma mānanīyaḥ sadā janaiḥ | īśāne tu parābhaktiḥ kartavyā vai madātmake ||3 1 || anṛtaṃ na hi vaktavyaṃ śapathaṃ tatra nāpi vai | sūryavāraḥ pālanīyo harasyārādhanāya vai || 32|| pitarau sarvadā sevyau ghātaḥ kāryo na sarvadā | stainyaṃ varjyaṃ mṛṣā sākṣyaṃ varjyaṃ nyāyālaye’pi ca || 33|| pareṣāṃ dhanavastrādi kāmanīyāni naiva tu | parasattvaṃ na hantavyaṃ pārakyaṃ grāhyameva na || 34|| viśvāsaghātanaṃ naiva kartavyaṃ kasyacit kvacit | prajāyāṃ dharmaghātaśca kartavyo naiva sarvathā ||35|| evaṃ dharmān pālayitvā rājā nākaṃ samāpnuyāt | satyavākyaṃ krodhaśūnyaṃ kṣamāpanaṃ vibhājanam || 36|| svadāresveva ramaṇaṃ śaucaṃ drohavivarjanam | ārjavaṃ bhṛtyabharaṇaṃ kāryaṃ sarvajanaiḥ sadā ||37|| damaṃ purātanaṃ dharmaṃ jagṛhurviprajātayaḥ | svādhyāyaṃ yogakaraṇaṃ tapaḥ santānapālanam || 38|| maitryaṃ hitakaraṃ vākyaṃ dhartavyaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ sadā | evaṃ vai vartayan vipraḥ svargaṃ nityamavāpnuyāt || 39|| kṣatriyastu samadadyāt cādhīyīta yajeta ca | prajāḥ prapālayet parākramedanyāyavartini || 2.192.40|| kṣatrakṛtyaṃ dasyujātervāraṇaṃ mukhyamasti yat | dānaṃ cādhyayanaṃ yajñaśceti rājñāṃ sukhāvahāḥ ||41 || taiśca tiṣṭhannije dharme rājā sarvān hi vartayet | evaṃ dharme sthito rājā rājanyendraḥ samucyate ||42|| athetaraḥ kṛṣikarmā vyāpāravān ca vā janāḥ | dānamadhyayanaṃ yajñaṃ prakārayed dhanārjanam ||43|| paśūn vai pālayet sarvān putravātsalyabhāvataḥ | paśūnāṃ rakṣayā vaiśyaḥ paramaṃ sukhamāpnuyāt ||44|| prajāpatiḥ purā sṛṣṭvā paśūn vaiśyāya sandadau | rājñe dadau prajāḥ sarvā viprebhyaḥ śāradāṃ dadau ||45|| saptamaṃ bhāgamādāya jīvanaṃ sarvathā caret | kṣatriyaścettadā mahyaṃ samarpya mokṣamāpnuyāt ||46|| sevāṃ ca bhṛtyatāṃ dāsyaṃ paricaryā ca dūtatām | kurvāṇā dāsavargāstu mahatsukhamavāpnuyuḥ ||47|| śuśrūṣā kalpavallyasti śuśrūṣā kalpapādapaḥ | śuśrūṣā kāmadhenuśca cintāmaṇiśca sā matā ||48|| sevayā vaśamāyāti siṃho rājā gururgrahāḥ | dāsyena vaśatāṃ yānti svāmīpatiḥ satī prajāḥ ||49 || śuśrūṣayā vaśaṃ yānti śatrurdveṣṭā tamaḥ khalāḥ | paricaryāparo loko rañjayati niyāmakān ||2.192.50|| rañjanād rājarājyādi rañjakasya na vai pṛthak | tasmāt sarvaṃ prapadyeta sevayā ratnasaṃbhṛtam ||5 1|| chatraṃ veṣṭanamābhūṣā copānad vyajanādikam | ambarāṇi subhojyāni dīyante paricāriṇe ||52|| anapatyo hi bhartavyo bhartavyau vṛddhadurbalau | dāso dāsī bhatyavargo bhartavyā dharmatastu te ||53 || yajñaḥ pūjā brāhmaṇānāṃ yajño dhanena bhūbhṛtām | vaiśyānāṃ bharaṇaṃ yajñaḥ śraddhā yajñastu sevinām || 54|| agre sarveṣu yajñeṣu śraddhā yajño’tiduṣkaraḥ | daivataṃ paramaṃ śraddhā yayā tuṣyāmi mādhavaḥ ||55|| śraddhāmayāḥ karmakārāḥ sarvaphalaiḥ samṛddhinaḥ | tasmāt sarveṣu lokeṣu śraddhāyajño vidhīyate ||56|| daivataṃ paramaṃ yatra śraddhākhyaṃ tatra devatā | kāryasiddhiśceśasiddhirmayi nyasya samarthyate ||57|| steno vā yadi vā pāpo yadi vaḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ | yaṣṭumicchati yajñaṃ yaḥ sādhureva yato hi saḥ ||58|| yaṣṭavyaṃ sarvadā tasmād deve vā cetane’pi vā | daridre’nāthavarge vā pālye vā śraddhayoddhṛte ||59|| sarvathā sarvadā sarvairyaṣṭavyamiti niścayaḥ | nahi yajñasamaṃ kiñcit phaladaṃ sukhadaṃ param ||2.192.60|| brahmacaryaparo vā syād gṛhadharmamanācaran | brahmaṇyeva tu juhvānaḥ parabrahmādhigacchati ||6 1 || yadvā sadārakarmāpi matparāyaṇadharmavān | mamāśraye caran dharmaṃ bandhanānmucyate’pi saḥ ||62|| kṛtakṛtyo’thavā jñānadṛṣṭyā vane vasedapi | matparaḥ sa sadā karmī vrajatyakṣarasāmyatām ||63 || mama dharmān sādhubhāvānāśritya dvandvavarjitaḥ | yatiścet prāpnuyānmāṃ sa madbhāvāyopakalpyate ||64|| bhaikṣavṛttiśca yastiṣṭhenniṣparigraha ātmavān | karmī vā karmaśūnyo’pi madbhāvāyopakalpate ||65|| mitaśāyī mitāśī ca nirāśī cāpyaketanaḥ | yathopalabdhajīvī ca munirmāṃ samavāpnuyāt ||66 || nirāśī brahmavatproktastṛptaḥ pūrṇasukhāśrayaḥ | nirbhogo vṛttivarjyaśca vrajatyakṣarasāmyatām ||67|| gṛhāśramī tarenmāyāṃ māyāyāṃ māyayoṣitaḥ | api sarvāṃ mayi kṣiptvā tato bandhād vimucyate ||68|| svadāratuṣṭaḥ santoṣī śāṭhyajaihmyavivarjitaḥ | devapūjāparaḥ satyo dānto vibhāgakṛttathā ||69|| kṣamādayāparo dātā sarvebhyaśca yathocitam | ārjavaṃ cātithipūjāṃ bharaṇaṃ śritadehinām ||2.192.70|| yaḥ kuryād vartayeccāpi vartetāpi sa mokṣabhāk | svarge śuddhaṃ phalaṃ prāpya moditvā śāśvatīsamāḥ ||71 || dehānte cākṣayān kāmānanantān sarvataḥ sthitān | avāpnuyānna sandeho mayyarpaṇe tu madgatān ||72|| yo yathā kurute cātra tādṛśaṃ sa samāpnuyāt | pārakyaṃ prathamaṃ kṛtvopakārarūpamutsavāt || 73 || tato daihyaṃ cāntaraṃ ca tato naijaṃ samācaret | pārameśaṃ tataḥ kuryāt sarvadoṣanivārakam ||74|| ya evaṃ vartate rājā loke prajājano’pi vā | sarvatantuprotamaṇirmerukṛṣṇaṃ sa vindati ||75|| tasmāt prajābhiḥ satataṃ parameśe samarpya ca | nirdvandvābhirniṣkarmābhirbhāvyaṃ brāhmyadhilabdhaye ||76|| matkarmāṇaṃ madviśrāntaṃ maddhomaṃ matparāyaṇam | tārayāmi na sandeho mṛtyusāgarapūrataḥ || 77|| arcayitvā sarvapitṝn devānṛṣīn samāśritān | āntarasthaṃ hariṃ cāpi yāyādante hareḥ padam ||78|| akurvan vā vikurvan vā kurvan vā matkṛtāśrayaḥ | madyogātpāramāpnoti karmāsaṃkhyādhivāridheḥ ||79|| māṃ yajantu sadā prātarmāṃ smarantu kriyādiṣu | māmante hṛdaye kṛtvā prayāntu me’kṣaraṃ padam ||2.192.80 || ityuktvā virarāmaiva rādhike bhagavān svayam | milindārājadhānyāśca rājā prajāstathetare ||8 1|| dharmamāsādya vijñānairmiśritaṃ bandhanāśakam | prasannā jagṛhuḥ sarvān dharmāstadopadeśitān ||82|| lomaśaśca dadau tatra tābhyo mantraṃ harerapi | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||83|| tataḥ prajāśca rājā ca pūjayāmāsurīśvaram | svarṇarūpyakamudrābhiścopadābhistathāmbaraiḥ ||84|| vibhūṣābhiścandanādyairakṣataiḥ puṣpahārakaiḥ | vividhairdānayogyaiśca vastubhiḥ parameśvaram ||85|| haristābhyaḥ prajābhyaśca rājabhyaśca prasannahṛt | āśīrvādān dadau yūyaṃ bhavata śreṣṭhakīrtayaḥ ||86|| śreṣṭharājyāḥ śreṣṭhadharmāḥ śreṣṭhanyāyaparāyaṇāḥ | śreṣṭhasya me maheśānasyaiva bhaktau kṛtādarāḥ ||87|| evamuktvā viśaśrāma harirnijanivāsane | janā naijān nivāsām̐śca yayuḥ kṛtātmavedinaḥ ||88|| aṃgarājo bhojanāni dadau śrīparamātmane | sarvānabhojayaccāpi mahīmānān hareḥśritān ||89|| īśānaṃ pūjayāmāsa lomaśaṃ ca pupūja ha | hareḥ kuṭumbakaṃ prārcya rājā jagrāha bhojanam || 2.192.90 || rājñī raṃgarajānāmnī cāṃgarājasya patnikā | gaurī prasannahṛdayaikādaśaputrikāyutā || 91 || pauṣpakānakahārām̐śca candanākṣatagandhinaḥ | ādāyārcayituṃ cāyād bālakṛṣṇasya sannidhau || 92|| pupūja prītyā caraṇau payasākṣālayaddhareḥ | papau papuśca gauryastāḥ kanyāstvekādaśāpi vai ||93 || anādiśrībālakṛṣṇaṃ vilokya kāntamīśvaram | kare jagṛhuratyarthaṃ vivāhavidhinā tu tāḥ ||94|| kaṇṭhe hārān dadustāśca haristābhyo’pi sandadau | utsavaḥ sa mahān jātaḥ kṛtakṛtyo’bhavannṛpaḥ ||95|| atha nidrāṃ jagṛhuśca viśaśramuḥ sukhaṃ niśām | gatāṃ vilokya bhagavān śrutvā maṃgalaniḥsvanān || 96|| kṛtāhniko haristūrṇaṃ svastho’bhavad yadā drutam | tāvad rājā satī rājñīścājahratuḥ payaḥ śubham || 97|| phalātmabhojanādyaṃ ca jagrāha bhagavām̐śca tat | brahmapriyāḥ kuṭumbaṃ carṣayo jagṛhurutsukāḥ || 98|| phalāni jagṛhuścāpi tāmbūlāni tataḥ param | vidāyaṃ jagṛhuścāpi sanmānaṃ prāpya tatkṣaṇam ||99|| hariścānye nṛpaṃ pṛṣṭvāruruhuḥ sajjitā drutam | vimānāni tūryanādān śṛṇvanto vyomamārgataḥ || 2.192.10 0|| ākāraṇādivacaso viceruścāgratastadā | ityevaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yayau puraḥ || 101 || balalīnanṛparāṣṭraṃ jarāmaunarṣibhūtalam | ambarād bhūtalaṃ kṛṣṇo dadarśa bahuśobhanam || 1 02|| rājā puro yayau bhūmau balalīno maharṣiṇā | jarāmaunena sākaṃ vai svāgatārthaṃ harestadā || 103 || rādhike śrāvaṇe kṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ praharadvaye | tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayadhvānāstadābhavan || 1 04|| yantraśabdā nāmamālā bhajanānyabhavan bhuvi | rājadarśitamārgeṇa vimānāni kramāttadā || 105 || avaterurmahodyāne vālīnāyāstu sannidhau | viśālāyā rājadhānyā lakṣādhijanasaṃkule || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne harerlīnorṇarāṣṭrāgamanaṃ vāruṇyāṃ nagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ vidāyaṃ, tato bṛhaccharanṛparāṣṭrāgamanaṃ dhīvarāyāṃ nagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ, tato’ṅgarājasya milindānagarīṃ prati gamanaṃ bhrāmaṇamupadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśrāntirbhādrakṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ praharadvaye balalīnanṛparāṣṭragamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvānavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 192 ||
<2.193> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rādhe tato rājāvatarantaṃ vimānataḥ | bhagavantaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ puṣpahāraṃ gale dadau || 1 || ratnahāraṃ dadau kaṇṭhe kare gucchaṃ tu puṣpajam | rājñī sākṣatacandraṃ ca kauṃkumaṃ pracakāra ha || 2 || kumārikāḥ kṛṣṇapādau prakṣālyāmṛtamāpapuḥ | rājñaḥ kuṭumbaṃ cāmātyāḥ pradhānādyāḥ prajāstathā || 3 || śrīhareḥ svāgataṃ cakruḥ pūjābhistatra sādaram | jalapānaṃ ca haraye rājā dadau sugandhimat || 4 || anyānapi janān sarvān jalapānamakārayat | hariṃ rājā gajayāne sauvarṇe sannyaṣādayat || 5 || kuṭumbaṃ gajayāneṣu maharṣīn vṛṣavājibhiḥ | vāhiteṣu ramyapaṭṭīgantrīṣu sa nyaṣādayat || 6 || brahmapriyāstu divyāsu paṭṭagantrīṣu bhūpatiḥ | nyaṣādayattato rājā hastiyāne tvarūruhat || 7 || vālīnāyāṃ nagaryāṃ sasainyo rājā hariṃ prabhum | abhrāmayad rājamārgeṇānyarathyādicatvare || 8 || agre ḍaṃkakanādo vai yāti coṣṭrasya pṛṣṭhake | tato vājivaro yāti sadhvajo vāhakānvitaḥ || 9 || tato hastī mahān yāti dundubhidhvānabodhanaḥ | śṛṃgāritāstu te vāhāḥ śobhante devatā yathā || 2.193.1 0|| tato yāti ratho divyaḥ puttalīcakraśobhitaḥ | puṣpahārādidānārthaṃ prajāyai kṛṣṇapūjane || 11 || tataḥ svarṇamayī gantrī viśālā yantravāhitā | yatra jhāṃjhapakhājādimaṇḍalī kīrtanārthinī || 1 2|| yatra dhvānakarāścāśvavārāḥ sakuntasaddhvajāḥ | tato yāti mahān hastī yatra rājakumārakāḥ || 1 3|| tato yānti coṣṭragantryo yatra pradhānajāḥ prajāḥ | tato yānti siṃhaveṣā vāditranādino janāḥ || 14|| tato vyāghrapraveśāśca vigulādininādinaḥ | atha saptagajā yānti brahmarṣivāhanāstadā || 15|| tato’śvavārayugalāḥ svarṇaveṣāśca śastriṇaḥ | vādyayuktagaṇā yānti dundubhyānakadhāriṇaḥ || 16|| paṭahadhrāstato yānti paṭṭaghāśca tataḥ param | tato gaṇā yathā śaṃbhoḥ śataśo bhṛtyapārṣadāḥ || 17|| tato bhṛtyā rājagantrīvaryāsu vai sahasraśaḥ | tato vādyāni cānyāni miṣṭamadhurasadravaiḥ || 18|| bodhayanti janān paścād yānti brahmapriyā imāḥ | tato gantrīṣu sarvāsu gauryaḥ śṛṃgāritā yayuḥ || 1 9|| tataḥ kuṭumbaṃ kṛṣṇasya gajeṣu yāti śobhitam | tata īṣānadevaśca gajapṛṣṭhe virājate ||2.193.20 || tato rājñī rājamātā svarṇagantryāṃ virājate | tataḥ kumārakāḥ sarve kumārikāstataḥ param ||2 1 || gajayantrīṣu rājante tato rājā suśobhitaḥ | balalīno mahārājaḥ śrīkṛṣṇena tu satkṛtaḥ ||22|| hastiyāne bālakṛṣṇasannidhau rājate puraḥ | dhṛtachatraḥ pārśvabhāge cāmaradhrau pratiṣṭhataḥ || 23 || pṛṣṭhe mahāśvavārāśca gajavārāḥ prayānti ca | tato gauryaḥ svarṇaveṣāḥ prayānti maṃgalasvarāḥ ||24|| mastake kṛtakalaśāḥ phalapatrajalānvitāḥ | yānti gītiparāḥ sarvā rakṣakāśca tataḥ param || 25 || yantradhvānakarāścāpi cānte prayānti vai tadā | gauryaḥ prajāpriyāścāpi prayānti saṃghaśastadā ||26|| rājamārgāḥ saṃkulitāstadāsan mānavairati | catvarāścandraśālāścālayāḥ saudhāḥ pratardikāḥ || 27|| vitardyaḥ saṃgamā rathyāyogāḥ pārśvapadasṛtiḥ | vallabhyaścāṃgaṇānyagārāṇi gopurabhūmikāḥ ||28|| vṛkṣaśākhā durgabhāgā bhittikā gṛhaveṣakāḥ | koṇāḥ kaphoṇāścottānā madhyabhārā nalājalāḥ ||29||| ucchrayā jīrṇabhāgāśca gaṇḍordhvā gṛhabhūmayaḥ | udyānā mārgabhāgāśca pārśvaprākāravṛttikāḥ || 2.193.30 || sarvaṃ saṃkulitaṃ cāsīnmānavairdarśanārthibhiḥ | nagarī koṭimānuṣyairmarditā darśanārthakaiḥ || 31 || svargasyendrāvatīnāmnī yathāśobhata sā purī | catvarāḥ puṣpastabakaiḥ kṛtrimodyānakīkṛtāḥ || 3 2|| rathyādvārāṇi ca śṛṃgāritāni gopurādibhiḥ | haṭṭāṃgaṇāni sarvāṇi śobhitāni ca toraṇaiḥ ||3 3|| mārgapārśvaprabhāgāśca śobhitāḥ kadalīvanaiḥ | agārāṇi raṅgavallīsvastikādyaiḥ kṛtāni ca || 34|| mārgoparyantarīkṣaṃ śobhitaṃ patākikādhvajaiḥ | vāvaṭābhistoraṇaiśca saṃśobhitāḥ subhūmikāḥ || 39|| kalaśaiḥ śrīphalaiścāpi dvāraśākhāḥ suśobhitāḥ | kanyābhirgauravarṇābhiḥ śobhitā vallabhībhuvaḥ || 36|| śobhitāni gavākṣāṇi mṛgākṣīṇāṃ mukhābjakaiḥ | saudhā dhavalavarṇāśca vāvaṭābhiḥ suśobhitāḥ || 27|| śikharāṇi ghūmmaṭāni stūpāni vedhakāni ca | ghaṭīśṛṃgāṇi sarvāṇi śobhitāni śubhadhvajaiḥ ||38|| jayaśabdairvādyaśabdairyantrīdhvānaiḥ sugītibhiḥ | garjitā daśadikṣveṣā purī vālganikābhavat ||39|| gopure rakṣibhiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pūjitaśca pradhānakaiḥ | agre sainyaiḥ pūjitaśca rājakīyairjanaistataḥ ||2.193.40 || śreṣṭhibhiḥ satkulaiścāpyāpaṇibhiḥ sthānibhistathā | pūjitaḥ sarvavargaiśca yoṣidbhiśca naraistathā ||41|| upadābhiḥ phalādyaiśca kaṇādyairbhūṣaṇādibhiḥ | ambaraiḥ kambalādyaiśca hāraiḥ sragbhiḥ suvarṇajaiḥ ||42|| akṣataiḥ kuṃkumaiścāpi ratnahīrakahārakaiḥ | puṣpaiśca vardhitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’tibhāvataḥ ||43|| evaṃ bhramitvā nagarīṃ rājasaudhaṃ samāyayau | rājā saṃpūjayāmāsa koṭiratnārpaṇairharim ||44|| rātrau pūjāṃ vratasyaivaikādaśyāṃ pracakāra ha | jāgaraṇaṃ sabhāyāṃ ca dharmādeśayutaṃ hariḥ ||45|| pracakārotsavayuktaṃ kṛṣṇakīrtanasaṃyutam | rādhike ca mahīmānāścakrurviśrāntimādarāt ||46 || hariścopādideśaiva sarvān jāgaraṇasthitān | jāgratyeva nare vratasthite nidrotthadūṣaṇam ||47|| vrataghnaṃ nopasaṃyāti caitajjāgaraṇe phalam | vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ bhaveccāpi tamobhāvo niruddhyate ||48|| prasahyāpi bhaved bhaktirharau santoṣakāriṇī | śrīharau toṣite sarvaṃ saphalaṃ mānavaṃ janu ||49|| tadarthaṃ vai vrataṃ loke kartavyaṃ sāvadhāninā | udaye yā tithistvāste saikādaśī vratarthinī ||2.193.50||| sūryasyodayanaṃ matvā kāryā tvekādaśī sadā | mama janmāṣṭamī prātarjanmanyaṣṭamikodaye ||51 | ūrje kṛṣṇe sadā grāhyā śaratpūrṇottarāgatā | evaṃ cānyāśca tithayo grāhyā sūryodaye sthitāḥ ||52||| nakṣatraṃ vāsaraṃ vāpyālambya setsyanti mānavāḥ | tanna mukhyaṃ mataṃ me vai tithirme hyudaye matam ||53|| vrataṃ tatraiva kartavyaṃ yadvrate yatra yā tithiḥ | titheḥ kvāpi kṣayo nāsti kṣīṇā candrodaye matā |||54|| candrodaye ca vā sūryodaye’stitvaṃ titherdhruvam | rātrāvutsavakārye tu tithiścandrodayā matā ||55|| dine tūtsavakārye tu sūryodayā matā tithiḥ | evaṃ vratāni kāryāṇi madbalāttāni sarvathā ||56|| puṇyadāni pūrṇakāni bhavanti nātra saṃśayaḥ | mohinī brahmajā vedhā matsambandhe na hānidā ||57|| iti mamājñāṃ jñātvaiva vratāni cottamāni vai | kartavyāni sadā bhaktairmadājñā phaladāyinī ||58|| yatkāle yasya devāderutsavo janma vā layaḥ | tatkṣaṇe yā tithiścāste sā vrate śobhanā sadā ||59|| sūryodayastathā candrodayo vā tārakodayaḥ | gauṇastatraiva mantavyaḥ kṣaṇaṃ mukhyaṃ divāniśam ||2.193.60 || etad vihāya manujāḥ kariṣyanti vratāni cet | bhinnamatāni tatraiva bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||6 1 || vratacchedakarāṇyeva bhaviṣyanti tu tāni vai | tasmāt kṣaṇaḥ sadā grāhyo vrate sarvavidhotsave ||62|| tena dharmo vardhate vai nānyathā tu kadācana | śraddhayā vardhate puṇyaṃ kālayuktaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||63 || pātrayuktaṃ tato’pyati vardhate pātrasadbalāt | pātraṃ cāhaṃ parabrahma sevanīyo vrataṃ mahat ||64|| mātāpitrorguroścāpi śuśrūṣā vratamuttamam | ācāryasādhuśuśrūṣā vrataṃ puṇyapradaṃ mahat ||65|| janasevāḥ prapāḥ kūpāḥ śayanāni śubhāni ca | dānāni kārayed bhaktyā vrataṃ puṇyapradaṃ hi tat ||66|| ahiṃsā satyamakrodho vṛttidānaṃ prapālanam | vṛddhānāṃ sevanaṃ putradārāṇāṃ bharaṇaṃ vratam ||67|| dakṣiṇā yajñakāryeṣu dātavyā bhūtimicchatā | pākayajñāḥ prakartavyāḥ kaṇayajñāśca bhūtidāḥ ||68|| arhān pūjayato nityaṃ saṃvibhāgena sarvathā | vrataṃ tasya bhavettadvai svargadaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||69|| jñātisambandhimitrāṇāmāpaduddharturatra tu | puṇyaṃ svargapradṃ syādvai vratametatparaṃ sadā ||2.193.70|| sarvasatkārakartustu svargaṃ dhruvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | pitṛyajñaṃ bhūtayajñaṃ cātitheḥ pūjanādikam ||71 || devayajñaṃ kurvatastu svargaṃ dhruvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | dīkṣāyā grahaṇaṃ cāpi śiṣṭānāṃ pūjanaṃ sadā ||72|| devānāṃ smaraṇaṃ cāpi śaraṇāgatarakṣaṇam | akauṭilyena vṛttiśca vrataṃ brahma divaḥ pradam ||73|| sarvabhūteṣu dayayā pravṛttasya tu dehinaḥ | paritrāṇaparasyātra vrataṃ svargapradaṃ bhavet ||74|| āgatānāṃ svāgatādikarturyogyakriyāvatām | pūjayiturvinamrasya vrataṃ svargapradaṃ bhavet ||75|| kuṭumbasya vaśe sthātuḥ sādhūnāṃ vacane’pi ca | śāstrāṇāṃ vacane sthāturvrataṃ mokṣapradaṃ bhavet ||76|| āśrame yatra kutrāpi tadvṛṣe’vasthitasya tu | vrataṃ dharmamayaṃ svargyaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||77|| sthānamānaṃ kulamānaṃ vayomānaṃ guṇārhaṇam | kurvan varteta loke yastasya nākaṃ suniścitam ||78|| deśadharmān jñātidharmān prajādharmān vilokya ca | tattathā vartate yaśca vrataṃ tasyedamuttamam ||79|| gṛhastho’pi na vai lubdhaḥ smṛddhau ca viṣaye dhane | dehe vā daihike vāpi vrataṃ sādhusamaṃ bhavet ||2.193.80 || dharmārāmā dharmaparā dharmasāhāyyadā janāḥ | dharmāvāsā bhavantyeva gārhasthye’pi hi sādhavaḥ ||8 1 || ātmopamaśca yo loke bhūteṣu vartate sadā | paraduḥkhaharo dehī pratyeha labhate sukham ||82|| dharmodayā dharmavīryā dharmapālādhvarakṣakāḥ | tyāgadharmāśritāḥ śīghraṃ tarantyeva bhavāmbudhim ||83|| yadā dutstho’sya saṃkalpo nivṛtto mūlato bhavet | dehī sattvagatiṃ prāptastato brahma samaśnute ||84|| tasmāt sarve’pi saṃkalpā nyasanīyā mayi prabhau | ātmā nivedanīyaśca dāsye mokṣaṃ tu dhāma me ||85|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau bālakṛṣṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ | rājā pupūja devaṃ ca lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ tathā ||86|| satīśānaṃ maheśaṃ sapupūja paramādarāt| | prātaḥ snānādikaṃ kṛtvā pūjanādi vidhāya ca ||87|| rājā prakārayāmāsa miṣṭānnādyaiśca pāraṇām | śrīhariḥ pāraṇāṃ kṛtvā viśrāntiṃ cāpa yāvatā ||88|| tāvad rājñī śrīratīśā pūjopakaraṇānvitā | catvāriṃśatkanyakābhirgaurībhiḥ saha cāyayau ||89|| pupūja paramātmānaṃ pādāmṛtaṃ papau tataḥ | catvāriṃśatkanyakāśca hareḥ pāṇiṃ prajagṛhuḥ || 2.193.90|| tadā vādyānyavādyanta rājājñayā ca gītayaḥ | agāyanta ca gaurībhirutsavo nṛtyasaṃyutaḥ ||9 1 || ajāyata nṛpaśca svaṃ kṛtakṛtyamamanyata | upadā yautakaṃ cāpi rājā dadau tu śārṅgiṇe ||92|| ratnahārān svarṇabhūṣāḥ kambalāmbarabhūtikāḥ | hariḥ prāpya ca tatsarvaṃ nṛpājñayā drutaṃ tadā ||93 || gantuṃ sajjo’bhavacchīghraṃ rājābhojayadacyutam | mahīmānān samagrām̐ścābhojayatpāyasādikam ||94|| sainyaṃ tato’bhavatsajjaṃ prasthāne mānadaṃ tadā | avādayacca tūryāṇi cakre jayaninādanam ||95 || vimānāni tadā sarvāṇyevābhavan vihāyasi | āruroha mahārājaḥ pūjitaḥ prajayābhitaḥ ||96 || āruruhustathā sarve pālanādarṣibodhitāḥ | varasiṃhanṛpeṇāpi nimantritāśca te tadā ||97|| gatimanto’bhavan vyomni śṛṇvanto vai jayadhvanīn | harervimānamagamad varasiṃhasya rāṣṭrakam ||98|| rājā pūrvaṃ varasiṃho’vātatārarṣisaṃyutaḥ | svāgatārthaṃ hareḥ sainyaṃ sajjaṃ cāsthāpayatpuraḥ ||99|| viṣṇutulyānadītīre vāśīlānagarītaṭe | harervimānamālokya sainyaṃ svāgatamācarat || 2.193.100 || vicitravādyadhvanibhiryantragarjanayā tathā | gītikābhiśca gaurīṇāṃ vyoma nādamayaṃ hyabhūt || 101 || rājadarśitamārgeṇa vimānaṃ bhuvamāgatam | hareścānyāni ca vimānāni cāpyāgatāni vai || 102|| vimānopari puṣpāṇāṃ vṛṣṭiḥ prajākṛtābhavat | rādhike janatā cābhūd vihvalā darśanāya ca || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vālīnānagaryāṃ śrīharerdhamaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ vratopadeśanaṃ dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇaṃ tato vāśīlānagarīṃ pratigamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā trinavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 193 ||
<2.194> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike viṣṇutulyāyāstaṭe viśālavartule | udyāne śrībālakṛṣṇo vimānād bahirāyayau || 1 || rājā puṣpasrajaḥ kaṇṭhe dadau nārāyaṇasya ha | ṛṣirhārān dadau rājñī pradhānādyā daduḥ srajaḥ || 2 || supuṣpaiḥ prajayā kṛṣṇo vardhitastvakṣatādibhiḥ | gucche kare nyadhād rājā śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaprabhoḥ || 3 || gandhasārādikaṃ gandhijalaṃ veṣe’pyadāttadā | pādau prakṣālya rājādyā amṛtaṃ ca papustataḥ || 8 || varasiṃho nṛpaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ yantragantryāṃ nyaṣādayat | kuṭumbaṃ dīrghagantryāṃ ca maharṣīn vātagāsu ca || 5 || brahmapriyā gajayāneṣveva rājā nyaṣādayat | mahīmānayutaṃ śaṃbhuṃ śārabheyarathe śubhe || 6 || nyaṣādayattato vādyaiḥ sainyasatkārabodhanaiḥ | vāśīlāyāṃ nagaryāṃ vai hariṃ cābhrāmayannṛpaḥ || 7 || gopure’pūjayat kṛṣṇaṃ tato rājakuṭumbakam | pradhānāścatvare kṛṣṇaṃ pupūjuśca kuṭumbinaḥ || 8 || śreṣṭhinastvāpaṇāgreṣu sthānino mārgasaṃgame | prajāḥ sarvā mahāmārge pupūjuḥ kṛṣṇavallabham || 9 || tadānīṃ yoṣito gauryaḥ samārūkṣan nijālayān | hariṃ vilokayantyaścāvākiran puṣpakairharim || 2.194.1 0|| procuḥ parasparaṃ gauryo hṛṣṭāḥ śāntiṃ gatāstadā | netrāyataphalaṃ prāpya tadvīkṣākṛṣṭamānasāḥ || 11 || karuṇātinoditasudattadarśanaṃ lalanā śarīribhiragamyadarśanam | prasamīkṣyasundarataraṃ hariṃ nvamuṃ saphalaṃ svakaṃ kuruta janma mā ciram || 12|| viṣayātilubdhamavaśaṃ pravāsanaṃ nahi mānasaṃ samupagacchati sthitim | iti cāti lubdhamavaśaṃ pradarśanānnanu yoṣito bhavati mādhavaḥ svayam || 1 3|| praṇamatsurādhipatibhūpatīśadhṛkmukuṭāgrakalgikṛtayogitāsanam | caraṇāravindayugalaṃ satīnutaṃ kamalādhṛtaṃ kuruta mānase nvidam || 14|| paradhāmni yaśca śubhadivyavigrahaḥ parivarṇito’sti nigamairguṇāśrayaḥ | vibhavarddhirūpaguṇakaiḥ prapūritaḥ prabhayāvṛtaṃ kuruta mānase nvimam || 15|| bahukāntisaṃbhṛtamimaṃ hi sundaraṃ bahupuṣṭavigrahamimaṃ grahāśrayam | abalāḥ punarna tu gataṃ tvavāpsyatha tadayaṃ sadā svahṛdaye nigṛhyatām || 16|| vadanāmbujaṃ vividhatāpanāśanaṃ mitamandamiṣṭahasanātilobhanam | bhuvi muktidaṃ ca paralokamuktidaṃ nviṣapūrṇacandrasukhadaṃ nipīyatām || 17|| puruṣottamo’yamatikarṣati drutaṃ hṛdayaṃ tathendriyagaṇaṃ ca cetanam | tamavetya kāntamiha śāśvataṃ prabhuṃ hṛdaye milantu militaḥ prabhujyatām || 18|| hṛdayasthito bahirupāgato hyayaṃ kusumaiśca mānasabharaiḥ prapūjyatām | ratiratnahīrakasamarpaṇairayaṃ parirabdha āli militaḥ prasevyatām || 19|| itthaṃ gītayaśāḥ kṛṣṇo bhramitvā nagarīṃ tataḥ | rājaharmyaṃ samāyāto vandito nāgarairjanaiḥ ||2.194.20|| rājā tūrṇaṃ hareḥ pādau pūjayāmāsa candanaiḥ | akṣataiḥ kusumaiścāpi hariḥ siṃhāsane’bhavat ||21 || niṣīdantaṃ puṣpahāraiḥ kusumaistaṃ vavarṣa ha | lokaḥ premabharairhadbhiḥ sthiranetro dadarśa ca ||29|| sabhātimahatī tatra kṛtā śrīparamātmanā | upādideśa ca tadā janatāhitahetave ||23 || bhagavān parameśo yo rājate parame’kṣare | kṛpayā sa samāyāti nijaprajāvanāya vai ||24|| prajāḥ putryo bhagavataḥ pālanīyāśca mātṛvat | poṣaṇīyāḥ sukhanīyā netavyāścākṣaraṃ padam ||25|| sarvāvatāradhartāhaṃ śrīsvāmikṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | māyāṃ pramṛdya loke’tra varte bhavatpragocaraḥ ||26 || kāṃbhareyo rādhikeśo lakṣmīpadmāvatīpatiḥ | māṇikīśaḥ ramānāthaḥ svayaṃ gopālanandanaḥ ||27|| brahmapriyāṇāṃ kāntaśca sarvasṛṣṭipatiḥ prabhuḥ | sadguṇāmaṃjulāhaṃsālalitāvijayāpatiḥ ||28|| yatra vāso’tra loke’pi me tad dhāmamayaṃ bhavet | nārāyaṇanivāsena bhūmivaikuṇṭhasadṛśī ||29|| jāteyaṃ bhagavān heturdivyatve divyabhāvini | tathā bhakto’pi me hetuḥ saddeśādisamarjane ||2.194.3 0 || rājā bhakto bhaveccedvai tatra kṛtayugo bhavet| | nītidharmayuto rājā kṛtaṃ pravartayet khalu ||3 1 || tatra vai sarvavarṇānāṃ nādharme jāyate matiḥ | kṣemaṃ prajānāṃ subhagaṃ sarvadā hi pravartate ||32|| satkarmāṇi samastāni kriyante tu dvijātibhiḥ | susukhāḥ ṛtavaḥ sarve bhavantyapi nirāmayāḥ |||3 3|| prasīdanti mānavāśca hṛdā ca manasā girā | na jāyante vyādhayaśca nālpāyurjāyate janaḥ ||34|| kṛpaṇā na janāstatrāpatikā na ca yoṣitaḥ | pṛthvī cāpi vinā kṛṣṭiṃ janayatyeva sasyakam ||35|| oṣadhayaḥ phalantyeva kṣmārasena sukhapradāḥ | tvakpatraphalamūlāni vīryavanti bhavantyapi ||36|| dharma eva sukhaṃ caiva tṛptiścaiva gṛhe gṛhe | jane jane ca viśvāsaḥ sukhaṃ nodvejanaṃ kvacit ||37|| evaṃ rājā dharmayuktaḥ satyakālasya kāraṇam | yadāṃśaṃ tyajate rājā dharmasyaiva tadā bhavet ||38|| tretānāmayugaścātra mānaveṣu sthale sthale | aśubhāṃśaścaturthāṃśastāvanmānaṃ ca kaṣṭakṛt ||39|| kṛṣṭapacyā bhūrbhavecca tribhāgaphaladā tadā | sarvaṃ tribhāgaphaladaṃ phalgu bhāge caturthake ||2.194.40|| sukhe tatsādhane cāpi labdhavye viṣaye’pi ca | sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ na phalati tretāheturnṛpo yadā ||41 || ardhaṃ rājā yadā dharmaṃ nītiṃ tyajati vai tadā | dvāparaṃ nṛpatau prāptaṃ prajāsvevaṃ pravartate ||42|| meghe’raṇye ṛtau vṛkṣe rase goṣu pravartate | aśubhāṃśau bhavetāṃ dvau śubhāṃśau dvau matau tadā ||43 || sarvaṃ cārdhaṃ phalatyeva bāhyaṃ vāntaramityapi | svakīyaṃ vā ca pārakyaṃ daivaṃ vādaivamityapi ||44|| svārthaṃ vātha parārthaṃ vā cārdhaṃ phalati sarvathā | ardhā pṛthivī phalati sasyeṣvardhakaṇarddhitā ||45|| yadā rājā tyajatyeva tryaṃśaṃ dharmaṃ tadā bhuvi | ṛtau rase jane vṛkṣe kārye phale ca pādatā ||46 || tryaṃśe niṣphalatā bodhyā cāṃśe’pi niścayo nahi | evaṃ vai vartate rājā tadā tiṣyaḥ pravartate ||47|| prajā kliśnātyayogena tadādharmaparā janāḥ | sarveṣāṃ mānavānāṃ vai svadharmāccyavate manaḥ ||48|| kalāvadharmo balavān gṛhe gṛhe jane jane | bhikṣavo varṇasarvasvā bhṛtyāśca sārvavarṇikāḥ ||49|| varṇasāṃkaryabhūyiṣṭhaṃ yogakṣemau na vai kvacit | satkarmāṇi na vidyante kuto vaidikavārtikā ||2.194.50|| ṛtavaścāsukhāḥ sarve bhavantyāmayino janāḥ | asatye vijayaṃ manyamānāstiṣṭhanti sarvadā ||51 || hrasanti mānavānāṃ tu rūpasvaramanāṃsyapi | vyādhayo nūtanāstatra mriyante cālpakālinaḥ ||52|| vidhavā vidhurāḥ prāyo bhavanti bahavo janāḥ | nindyā eva prajāḥ prāyaḥ sukhaśāntivivarjitāḥ ||53|| pārśve varṣati parjanyaḥ pakṣe’vagrahakārakaḥ | kvacitsasyakaṇotthāṇaṃ kvaciccāṃkuradagdhatā ||54|| rasāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ syuśca yadā rājñi kalirbhavet | prajārakṣāhano bhūpāḥ kalikośā bhavanti vai ||15|| rājā kṛtasya sraṣṭā vai tretāyā dvāparasya ca | kaleśca sraṣṭā rājaiva kāraṇaṃ yugaparyaye ||56|| kṛtasya karaṇād rājā svargamuttamamaśnute | tretāyāḥ karaṇād rājā tryaṃśaṃ svargaṃ samaśnute ||57|| dvāparasyārjanād rājārdhaṃ sukhaṃ samavindati | kaleḥ pravartanāt kleśaṃ rājyanāśaṃ ca vindati ||58|| evaṃ kalau pāpameva bhuṃkte rājā hi rākṣasaḥ | tato yātyeva narake vasatyeva ciraṃ samāḥ ||59|| prajānāṃ kalmaṣaṃ bhuṃkte duḥkhaṃ bhuṃkte’pyasīmakam | pāpaṃ cāpyapakīrtica bhuṃkte duḥkhaparamparām ||2.194.60|| tasmānnītyā sadā rājñā vartitavyaṃ kṛtādivat | careddharmānasaṃmohān kuryāt snehaṃ vibandhanāt ||6 1 || labhedarthaṃ ca nirlobhāccaret kāmaṃ sadārtavāt | brūyāt priyaṃ na kārpaṇyāt parakramenna katthanāt ||62||| dadyāt kupātrado na syāt syād gaṃbhīro na nimnagaḥ | milet sarvairanāryaiśca gṛhṇīyānnāpyanītitaḥ ||63 || acāro na bhavet kvāpi kāryaṃ kuryānna pīḍayet | arthaṃ vadenna duṣṭeṣu guṇān vadenna cātmanaḥ ||64|| ādadyānna daridrebhyo nāśrayaṃ duḥsataścaret | avimṛśya daṇḍayenna rahasyaṃ na prakāśayet ||65|| visṛjenna tu duṣṭebhyo viśvasennāpakāriṣu | īrṣyāśūnyo bhaveccāpi dāreṣvapi prajāsvapi ||66|| strīḥ saṃseveta nātyarthaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ bhuñjīta nāhitam | mānayet pūjyavargāśca gurūn sevet bhāvataḥ ||67|| devān prapūjayed bhaktyā śriyaṃ cecchedaninditām | dākṣyaṃ kuryād yathāpekṣaṃ mārdavaṃ kālaviccaret ||68|| sāntvayet hārdalābhāyānugṛhṇīyāt samṛddhaye | praharet tattvamājñāya kṛtvā paścānna śocayet || 69|| krodhaṃ kuryānnānyathā vai mārdavaṃ gṛhṇīyānna ca | sataḥ seveta satataṃ śāntaye mokṣaṇāya ca ||2.194.70 || samādhyarthaṃ paṇḍitām̐śca seveta satataṃ nṛpaḥ | evaṃ buddhiṃ praseveta prātarutthāya nirjane ||71 || seveta cāntarātmānaṃ māṃ yathārthapradarśine | catvāriṃśadguṇaiḥ rājā devatvamiva rājatām |||72|| vikāsayitumarhaḥ syāt tasmānnītiyuto bhavet | māṃ sadā sarvathā sākṣye cāntare saṃsmarennṛpaḥ ||73|| tataḥ sarvaṃ prakurvīta satyayugaprado’smyaham | asanmārgapravṛttasyoddhārako’haṃ bhavāmi ca ||74|| saṃśayapaṃkamagnasyonnetāsmyahaṃ janārdanaḥ | akāryajālagrathanāgatasyāhaṃ vimocakaḥ ||75|| apāraṅgamagantuśca pāraṅgamaka ityaham | bhavāmyeva sadā tasmāt sevanīyo’hamāśrayaḥ ||76|| rājāthavā prajā putraḥ putrī vā kāryayoginaḥ | vistareṇa tu dharmāṇāṃ na jātvantamavāpnuyuḥ ||77|| taiḥ sadānuṣṭheyake’rthe sandigdhe nāntavartini | praṣṭavyā dharmaniṣṭhāśca śrutavantaḥ surottamāḥ ||78|| pratyutthāyopasaṃgṛhya caraṇāvabhivādya ca | nivedanīyāḥ kāryārthe nārāyaṇasmṛtestathā ||79|| gopāyitāraṃ dātāraṃ dharmanityamatandritam | akāmadveṣasaṃyuktamanurajyanti mānavāḥ ||2.194.80|| matparaṃ sādhusevaṃ ca madarthakṛtayatnakam | mayi nyastasamastaṃ ca bhūtānyanusaranti hi ||8 1|| tasmānniruktasṛtyā ca bhāvyaṃ rājñā prajājanaiḥ | tathā saukhyaṃ bhavedatra paratrāpi gatirbhavet ||82|| rājā prajā bhaved yo vā ko vāpyatra tu dehavān | dehadaṃ māṃ bhajennityaṃ sa syāt sukhī na cetaraḥ ||83|| dharmā arthāśca kāmāśca mokṣe yena niyojitāḥ | yojitaḥ sa bhavatyeva naisargānmayi mādhave ||84|| evaṃ sarve prakurvantu kāryāṇi manmayāni ha | bhuktirmuktirbhavatyeva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||85|| ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇo mantraṃ dadau tadā nijam | virarāma tataḥ svāmī sarvamānasatṛptidaḥ ||86|| rājñī ca rājakanyāśca pupūjuḥ parameśvaram | pañcakanyāstadaivāsya hastaṃ jagṛhurādarāt ||87|| kāntaṃ prāpya parānandaṃ lebhire pañcagaurikāḥ | rājā mumude’tyarthaṃ ca rājñī mene kṛtārthatām ||88|| hareḥ pūjā kṛtā lokaiḥ sabhāvisarjanaṃ hyabhūt | harirbhojanamāsādya viśrāntimāpa cālaye ||89|| mahīmānāḥ samastāśca viśrāntiṃ lebhire bhṛśam | rātriṃ nināya bhagavān pālanādāya carṣaye ||2.194.90|| datvopadādisāmagrīrgantuṃ sajjo’bhavattadā | rājā sainyena vādyādyairvidāyaṃ pradadau mahat || 91 || hariṃ rājā puṣpahāraiḥ prātaḥ kṛtāhnikaṃ tadā | dugdhapānādikaṃ vyadhāpayattato’tipūjanam || 92|| cakārārārtrikaṃ cāpi papau pādāmṛtaṃ tataḥ | hārālirājitavakṣā harirvimānago’bhavat ||93 || mahīmānāḥ samastāścāruruhurvyomagāmiṣu | vimāneṣu tato vādyānyavādyanta ca bhūriśaḥ ||94|| jayanādairyayustasmād rāyagāmalarāṣṭrakam | rāyagāmalarājā ca lātavāyamunistathā ||95|| kuṭumbaṃ rājakīyaṃ ca puro gatvātiśobhanam | svāgataṃ śrīhareścāpi sainyaśobhātikāritam ||96|| cakruḥ sarve ninādaiḥ kīrtanairvādyaiḥ sumādibhiḥ | ākāśe cāgataṃ kṛṣṇavimānaṃ vīkṣya te tadā ||97|| jayanādān pracakruśca yantrīdhvānānakārayan | goryaḥ sarvā gītinādān madhurānapyagāpayat ||98|| evaṃ sanmānasaubhāgye sthale hyudyānaśobhite | dvyūnāsarittaṭe puryā rigāyāḥ sannidhau hariḥ ||99|| rājadarśitamārgeṇāvātārayad vimānakam | anyānyapi vimānāni cāvaterustadāmbarāt || 2.194.10 0|| rādhike janatāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vyalokayan sthiradṛśaḥ | puṣpairavardhayan gītijayadhvānairavardhayan || 101 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne varasiṃhanṛpasya vāśīlānagaryāṃ harerbhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ yugopadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ viśramaṇaṃ nidrottaraṃ trayodaśyāṃ madhyāhnapūrvaṃ rāyagāmalarāṣṭragamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturnavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 194 ||
<2.195> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike śrībālakṛṣṇo vimānāt samavātarat | rāyagāmalanṛpatiḥ puṣpahārān dadau gale || 1 || rājñī prakṣālayāmāsa caraṇau paramātmanaḥ | kanyakāśca kuṭumbaṃ ca rājñaḥ pupūjuracyutam || 2 || gandhākṣataiḥ puṣpasragbhiścandanena sugandhinā | hārān gucchān dadau cāpi tato rājā hariṃ ca tam || 3 || nyaṣādayad ramyagaje’mbālikāvaraśobhite | śṛṃgārite’tisubhage caturdante’rjune vare || 4 || uccake saṃsthitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ janatā samalokayat | chatraṃ dadhuśca śirasi kumārāścāmare’pi ca || 5 || anyān sarvān mahīmānān śakaṭīṣu nyaṣādayat | rājābhrāmayadīśeśaṃ nagaryāṃ rājamārgake || 6 || rigāprajā hariṃ natvā pupūjuruttamottamaiḥ | phalai ratnairambarādyaiḥ svarṇarūpyakakambalaiḥ || 7 || puṣpahārairhīrakādyairamūlyavastubhistathā | gopure catvare saṃge haṭṭake mārgasannidhau || 8 || aṃgaṇe sarvathā lokā apūjayan suvastubhiḥ | avardhayan śubhā gauryo’kṣatalājābjakesaraiḥ || 9 || hārdikairbhāvanaiścāpi nirīkṣaṇaiḥ sumānasaiḥ | svāgataṃ sarvato buddhyā cakruḥ kīrtanagītibhiḥ || 2.195.10 || rājaprāsādavaryaṃ ca yayau kṛṣṇo’tibhāsvaraḥ | rājakanyāḥ pañca kṛṣṇahastaṃ jagṛhurādarāt || 11 || rājñī pupūja deveśaṃ jāmātāraṃ tadā mudā | dadau dānāni subhagā vividhāni pupūja ca || 1 2|| dadau kanyāḥ pañca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya tatra ha | utsavaṃ ca śubhaṃ cakre rājā kṛtārthatāṃ vahan || 13|| tataḥ pradhānasaudhāni prajāgṛhāṇi sarvaśaḥ | śreṣṭhināṃ mandirodyānagṛhādīni yayau hariḥ || 14|| bhagavān śrīharistatra sarvatra pūjitaḥ prabhuḥ | īśāno brahmapatnyaśca gauryo maharṣayastathā || 15|| sarve’pi pūjitāstasyāṃ nagaryāṃ nāgarairmudā | gaurībhiḥ pūjitaṃ kṛṣṇakuṭumbaṃ bhāvavastubhiḥ || 16 || tato harirnijāvāsaṃ cāyayau sainyaśobhitaḥ | jalapānaṃ cakārātha sabhāṃ cakāra tatra ca || 17|| upādideśa ca janān rādhike kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | dharmaḥ pālyaḥ sadā bhaktairarthastena prajāyate || 18|| kevalārthaparo janturacireṇa vinaśyati | vittaṃ dattaṃ ca vā nyastamasthāne ced vinaśyati || 19|| hiṃsārthaṃ yojitaṃ cāpi pāpāyaiva prakalpate | yadvātmano’pi hiṃsāṃ vā kurute hiṃsakaṃ bhavat ||2.195.20||| dharma ūdho bhavatyeva mā chindyāttaṃ kadācana | ūdhaśchede payolābho kṣīrārthino na jāyate || 21 || ūdhaso’rthamayaṃ dugdhaṃ pragṛhṇīyād vivekavān | dugdhaṃ dogdhryāḥ sevanena prāpyate nityamuttamam || 22|| evaṃ pṛthvīmupāyena bhuñjāno labhate phalam | satīṃ gāṃ ca tanuṃ dharmaṃ bhuñjāno labhate phalam || 23|| dogdhrīṃ dhānyaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca rakṣayet pṛthivīṃ ca tām | dharmaṃ nityaṃ rakṣayecca dogdhrīṃ matvā vivekavān ||24|| bhūtānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ dharmo dayā sā paramā matā | dayādharmeṇa kartā vai taratyasārasāgaram ||25|| bhītānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ rakṣāphalaṃ sulabhyate | daśavarṣasahasrāṇi svarge vāsātmakaṃ hi tat || 26|| sviṣṭiḥ svadhītiḥ sutapā yān lokān jayate tataḥ | tāneva dayayā prājño jayate dharmamācaran ||27|| devatāḥ pitaraḥ santo jīvanti dānadharmaṇā | anyabhūtāni jīvanti dayāgārhasthyadharmaṇā ||28|| chāyāyāmapsu vāyau ca sukhamuṣṇe pramelane | agnau vāsasi sūrye ca sukhaṃ śīte pramelane || 29|| śabde sparśe rase rūpe gandhe ca ramate manaḥ | uṣṇe śītaṃ sādhurūpaṃ prāptavyaṃ sukhadaṃ hṛdi ||2.195.3 0|| śīte coṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇarūpaṃ prāptavyaṃ sukhadaṃ sadā | teṣu bhogeṣu nāsakto labhate sukhamuttamam ||3 1|| anye dharmāḥ śītajānāmanye coṣṇanivāsinām | uṣṇasthānāṃ snānajaṃ ca phalaṃ yat syācchubhapradam ||32|| śītasthānāṃ yajñadānaistato’dhikaṃ phalaṃ bhavet | arthadānaṃ mataṃ puṣṭipradaṃ dehasya tuṣṭaye ||33 || artho dvedhā dhanarūpaḥ sukhado’tra bhavet khalu | parārtho mokṣarūpastu śāśvatikasukhapradaḥ ||34|| abhayasya pradātustu phalaṃ sarvottamottamam | nahi prāṇasamaṃ dānaṃ mokṣadānaṃ tato’dhikam ||35|| ahaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇo vai svāmiśrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | dadāmi mokṣadānaṃ ca prāṇadānaṃ dhanādi ca ||36|| śreṣṭhaṃ madhyaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ ca trayametadvibhajyate | mokṣadānaṃ paraṃ dānaṃ dātavyaṃ sarvathā bhuvi ||37|| grahītavyaṃ tu taddānaṃ nityānandapradaṃ tu yat | anyādāne bhaved vyādhirmokṣadāne vinaśyati || 38|| mokṣadāne brahmadānaṃ brahmabhūtaṃ karoti hi | brahmavṛkṣo rakṣyamāṇo madhuhema dadāti vai ||3 9|| brahmadānaparaṃ dānaṃ nādhikaṃ sṛṣṭimaṇḍale | mokṣadānaṃ brahmadānaṃ brahmāhaṃ māṃ dadāmi ca ||2.195.40 || dharmo’haṃ cārtharūpo’haṃ mokṣo’haṃ mokṣado’pyaham | mokṣātmānaṃ dadāmyeva mumukṣave prasāditaḥ ||41 || striyaṃ vā brahma vā hanyāt sādhuṃ hanyāttu yo ghṛṇī | tatpāpaiḥ kriyamāṇaiśca sṛjyate sa daridrakaḥ ||42|| īśāno rudradevaśca hinastyasādhupāpinaḥ | sādhūn rakṣati sarvātmā madrūpo rudra īśvaraḥ ||42|| ātmā rudro nijaḥ proktaḥ pāpaṃ hanyād yadā svataḥ | pāpaṃ dveṣo vañcanādi cātmaghātādi nāśayet ||44|| ātmaghāto mokṣaghātastaṃ na kuryāt kadācana | ātmā svārthī bhavennityaṃ mokṣārthī matsamāgamāt ||45|| dehabhāvaṃ na coheta miśrabhāvaṃ parityajet | śuṣkairārdraṃ dahyate’pi miśritaṃ ced bhaved yadi ||46 || ātmā duḥkhī jāyate’pi dehamiśro bhaved yadi | pāpakṛdbhiḥ kathaṃcicca na syānmiśro vivekavān ||47|| rāgadveṣau pāparūpau tyaktavyau muktimicchatā | pramādamohau pāpau ca tyaktavyau bhūtimicchatā ||48|| puṇyalokaḥ svayaṃ svargaḥ sukhī cātmā divaṃ matam | pāpaloko’tra nirayo duḥkhī cātmā hyadho mataḥ ||49|| pṛthvī sādhūm̐stathāsādhūn sandhārayati sadṛśī | sūryaḥ sādhūm̐stathāsādhūn karoti tāpanaṃ samaḥ ||2.195.50 || jalaṃ tṛptān karotyeva sādhūnasādhukānapi | vātaḥ prāṇaṃ sparśanaṃ ca samaṃ karoti dehiṣu |||51 || āpaḥ punanti sarvāṃśca sādhvasādhūn samānataḥ | atra loke tathā cāsti phalaloke tu bhinnatā ||52|| puṇyaśālikṛte vāri śītaṃ tatropasarpati | apuṇyasya kṛte vāri dṛṣṭimārgaṃ na gacchati ||53|| puṇyaśālikṛte pṛthvī komalāstaraṇānvitā | apuṇyasya kṛte pṛthvī kaṇṭakakarkarānvitā ||54|| puṇyaśālikṛte vāyuḥ śītalo gandhisaṃspṛśaḥ | apuṇyasya kṛte vāyurviṣolbaṇo’tidāruṇaḥ ||55|| puṇyaśālikṛte sūryo yathāpekṣoṣṇatāpradaḥ | apuṇyasya kṛte sūryo dāhako bhasmasātkaraḥ ||56|| ityevaṃ cāntaraṃ loke phalāḍhye vartate sadā | puṇyaloko madhumām̐śca ghṛtādaḥ svarṇabhūṣaṇaḥ ||57|| amṛtādo modayukto jarāmṛtyuvivarjitaḥ | pāpasya loko nirayastamoduḥkhasutāpanaḥ ||58|| kṣuttṛḍvyāptaḥ śokakośaḥ kṣaṇamṛtyuvaśaṃgataḥ | taṃ lokaṃ gantumicched yo vivekabhraṣṭa eva saḥ ||19|| puṇyalokaṃ prayātuṃ yo vāñcched vivekavān hi saḥ | śāśvataṃ ca paraṃ lokaṃ mama dhāmākṣarābhidham ||2.195.6 0|| gantumicchettu yaḥ prājño mumukṣūttama eva saḥ | nityapūjo brāhmaṇastallokaṃ samabhigacchati ||6 1|| nityaṃ dānī makhī rakṣī pūjī kṣatro’pi gacchati | udyamī copakārī ca dharmī vaiśyo’pi gacchati ||62|| hitī sevī ca santoṣī yāti śūdro’pi śeṣabhuk | tatra tatrānusandhānaṃ mama bhaktyātmakaṃ smṛtam ||63 || ājñāṃ vahate niyato guroryo’skhalito janaḥ | tasya siddhirbhavatyeva gurobarlānna saṃśayaḥ ||64|| alpaṃ ca sārabhūtaṃ ca karaṇīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ | yena siddhirdrutaṃ śreyaḥpradā bhavati dehinaḥ ||65|| yeṣāṃ śrībhagavān rakṣyo yeṣāṃ rakṣyaṃ ca kīrtanam | mama bhaktāstathā rakṣyāste rakṣyā mama sarvadā ||56|| yeṣāṃ purogamā bhaktāḥ santo brahmaparaṃ tvaham | yadgṛhe bhaktakanyāśca te rakṣyā mama sarvadā ||67|| na kālāt karmatasteṣāṃ māyāto yamato bhayam | yoṣāṃ cāsmi gṛhe cāhaṃ hṛdaye pūjitaḥ sadā ||68||| sādhūn rakṣet sadā rājā te hi rakṣanti rakṣitāḥ | āśīreṣāṃ bhaved dhāmapradātrī bandhanāśinī ||69|| dānena tapasā yajñairbhaktyā damena sevayā | sādhavo vā gṛhasthā vā kṣemamiccheyurātmanaḥ ||2.195.70|| apāre pārakartā yaścāplave plavado’pi yaḥ | yamāśrityātighore’tra saṃsāre sukhino janāḥ ||71 || tyāgī vāpi gṛhī vāpi naro nārī ca vā bhavet | tārakaṃ bāndhavaṃ matvā sādhuṃ taṃ paripūjayet ||72|| parameśaṃ tathā santaṃ jñānadaṃ ca guruṃ prabhum | satīṃ sādhvīṃ pūjayecca mokṣado hi yato guruḥ ||73|| kiṃ tairye vṛṣabhā nohyāḥ kiṃ dhenvā vāpyadugdhayā | kiṃ patnyā vandhyayā lābhaḥ ko’rthā rājñāpyarakṣatā ||74|| kiṃ taddhanena dehena sevā sādhorna me bhavet | kiṃ rājyena ca śuṣkeṇa kiṃ dasyugrastasampadā ||75|| kiṃ niḥsnehena bhogyena kiṃ janu yanna muktidam | yathā kāṣṭhakṛto hastī śārdūlaścarmakṛd yathā ||76|| yathā ṣaṇḍho yathā kṣāraṃ kṣetraṃ nirvidyako yathā | yathā meghāḍambaraśca kṣatraṃ balavivarjitam ||77|| yathā vrataṃ dānahīnaṃ bhaktaḥ snehavihīnakaḥ | gururjñānādiśūnyaśca sarvepyete nirarthakāḥ ||78|| saphalaṃ mokṣadaṃ sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ tadvivarjitam | ātmalābho na vai yatra sa lābho hānirucyate ||79|| ātmalābhaḥ paro lābhaḥ paramātmasamarpaṇam | mokṣalābho bhavettena satyalābho mato hi saḥ ||2.195.80 || sevayantu sato nityaṃ bhajantu māṃ sadā janāḥ | rakṣayantu svakaṃ dharma mama dhāma prayāntvapi ||8 1|| bhavatāmastu vai svasti loke cātra paratra ca | ityuktvā virarāmātha rājā pupūja taṃ prabhum |||82|| prajāścānarcayāmāsurbahuvastubhirādarāt | rājñī pūjāṃ cakārātha śrīhareḥ kanyakāyutā |||83||| tisraḥ kanyā harerhastaṃ jagṛhuḥ patibhāvitāḥ | sārthakaṃ ca januścakruḥ prāpya śrīpuruṣottamam ||84|| bhojanaṃ pradadau rājā haraye ca kuṭumbine | mahīmānebhya evāpi tataḥ svo bubhuje nṛpaḥ ||85|| cakāra sumahāntaṃ cotsavaṃ rātrau prajāyutaḥ | nṛtyāni kārayāmāsa vādyabhaktyādibhiḥ saha ||86|| rātrau subhojanaṃ labdhvā haryādyāste viśaśramuḥ | prātaḥ samutthitā vādyaravairmaṃgalaniḥsvanaiḥ ||87|| kṛtāhnikāstu haryādyā gantuṃ sajjāstadābhavan | mantraṃ harirdadau tatra prajābhyastūrṇamarthitam ||88|| rājā śrīharaye svarṇaṃ yautakaṃ bahudhā dadau | upadāḥ pradadau cāpi hariścāpi dhanaṃ tadā ||89|| lātavāyarṣiṇe prādād yathāyogyaṃ prapūjanam | rājā dadau vidāyaṃ ca dugdhapānottaraṃ tataḥ ||2.195.90|| harirvimānamāruhya tūrṇaṃ śṛṇvan jayadhvanim | ambare cābhavat sarvakuṭumbena samanvitaḥ ||9 1 || anyayānāni sarvāṇi cāmbare tvabhavam̐stadā | rājā sainyena sanmānaṃ kṛtavān samayocitam ||92|| phenatantunṛpaścāpi phālanādo munistadā | ājagmatuḥ samānetuṃ nijarājyaṃ satāṃ patim ||93 || haristenārthitastūrṇaṃ bahumānapuraḥsaraḥ | vyomnā sarvān prayujyaivāśīrvādaiḥ prayayau tadā ||94|| anyānyapi vimānāni yayustūrṇaṃ tadāmbare | phenatantumahārājarāṣṭramullaṃghya khāḍikām ||95|| tūrṇanayānadītīre saṃgamasthe manohare | nagare trinayākhye tatsamīpodyānamaṇḍale || 96|| rājā puraḥ pragatvaiva sainyasanmānamācarat | rājadarśitamārgeṇa harirnaijaṃ vimānakam ||97|| avātārayadudyāne rājasaudhasya sannidhau | vimānāni tathānyāni cāvaterustadāmbarāt ||98|| tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāstathābhavan | puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ prajānāṃ cābhavadvimānasannidhau ||99|| rādhike kīrtanānyeva gauryo jaguḥ prajājanāḥ | svāgataṃ paramaṃ rājā cakre yāntrikasadravaiḥ || 2.195.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne rāyagāmalarāṣṭre rigānagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanamupadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ viśramaṇaṃ rātriyāpanaṃ caturdaśīprātardugdhādipānottaraṃ phenatantunṛparāṣṭrābhigamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 95||
<2.196> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rādhe tataḥ śrīmān bālakṛṣṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ | vimānādavatīryādye ramye’śvavāhane śubhe || 1 || vyarājat svarṇaśobhāḍhye chatracāmarayojite | aurṇacitrādalikāstaraṇagaddisamanvite || 2 || phenatantunṛpaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ pupūja puṣpahārakaiḥ | svargahāraiścandanādyairamūlyavaravastubhiḥ || 3 || rājñī rājakuṭumbaṃ ca phālanādamunistathā | prajāścāpi tadānarcuḥ śrīpatiṃ gaurikāpatim || 4 || rājā sainyena sahitaḥ svāgatena vivardhayan | hariṃ vai bhrāmayāmāsa trinayāyāṃ samantataḥ || 5 || rājadhānyā gopure taṃ pradhānāḥ samapūjayan | rājamārge rājabhṛtyāḥ śreṣṭhinaścatvarādike || 6 || pratihaṭṭaṃ krayiṇaśca vikrayiṇaḥ prajājanāḥ | candanaiḥ kuṃkumaiḥ puṣpairdivyaiḥ śrīphalabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 7 || vardhayāmāsuratyarthe gauryaḥ sthale sthale tadā | nemuścākṣatalājābhirvardhayāmāsuracyutam || 8 || prajājanmaphalaṃ lebhurdarśanena harestadā | gauryo netrāyatalābhaṃ prāpuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vilokya ca || 9 || trinayānagarī sarvā janasaṃkulitā tadā | harerdarśanakāryārthaṃ tyaktānyakāryikābhavat || 2.196.10 || evaṃ sarvatra saṃsthāneṣvakhileṣvapi mādhavaḥ | datvā svadarśanaṃ rājasaudhaṃ sanmānito’gamat || 11 || 73 tatropadeśaṃ pradadau prajābhyo bhagavān svayam | virājamānaḥ sauvarṇe siṃhāsane’tibhāsvaraḥ || 1 2|| jetavyaṃ ca mano nityaṃ saṃsāravāsanāśritam | indriyāṇi tathārthebhyo jetavyāni viśeṣataḥ || 13 || nivartitavyaṃ satataṃ viṣayebhyaśca dehibhiḥ | vṛthā cintā na kartavyā vihāya parameśvaram || 14|| dinaṃ vyarthaṃ na netavyaṃ bhaktiṃ bhagavato vinā | āyurvyarthaṃ na netavyaṃ sādhūnāṃ sevayā vinā || 15|| āyāso na vṛthā kāryaḥ satsaṃgamantarā janaiḥ | vāṇī vyarthā na netavyā vinā me kīrtanaṃ kvacit || 1 6|| daihikaṃ na vṛthā kṣepyaṃ vinā samarpaṇaṃ mayi | rātrirvyarthā na vai kṣepyā vinā dhyānaṃ harermama || 17|| dhanaṃ vyarthaṃ na kartavyaṃ vinā manmandirādikam | ātmā vyartho na yoktavyo vinā māṃ parameśvaram || 18|| māyā vyarthā bhavet sarvā yadyahaṃ nāsmi tatra ca | tathā vyarthaṃ bhavet sarvaṃ yatrāhaṃ nāsmi pūjitaḥ || 1 9|| pūjite tu mayi kṛṣṇe sarve bhavati pūjitam | mayyarpite manāk cārthe sarvārtho nirguṇo yataḥ || 2.196.20|| nairguṇyena sadā bhāvyaṃ bhaktairmānuṣavigrahaiḥ | adroho’nabhimānaśca hrīstitikṣā damaḥ śamaḥ ||21 || satyaṃ dhṛtiḥ smṛtirdāntiścoparatirvilubdhatā | guṇā hyete’rpitāḥ kṛṣṇe mayi nairguṇyamāpnuyuḥ ||22|| tena muktirbhavedeva mokṣado’haṃ ca nirguṇaḥ | sarvaiśvaryacamatkāradivyaguṇādisaṃbhṛtaḥ || 23 || bhakte nairguṇyamāsañjya tārayāmi na saṃśayaḥ | ahiṃsā satyavacanamānṛśaṃsyaṃ damo ghṛṇā ||24|| etattapo mahatproktaṃ tena tuṣyāmyahaṃ sadā | dehasya śoṣaṇācchreṣṭaṃ manaḥśoṣaṇameva ha || 25|| manasaḥ śoṣaṇāt sevā dāsyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mataṃ mama | ājñānusārasaṃsthānaṃ sarvebhyo’pyadhikaṃ mama || 26|| ājñāṃkito jano nityaṃ dūro’pi nikaṭe’sti vai | anājñākṛnnikaṭe’pi vidūre’stīti me matam || 27|| tasmādāśā pālanīyāḥ guroḥ pitrorhareḥ striyāḥ | patyuśca pūjyavargasya viśeṣajñasya sarvadā ||28|| mayā vedā hi racitā ājñā vai vidhayaśca tāḥ | ṛṣibhistāḥ śreyase ca smaryante dehināṃ muhuḥ || 29|| prajābhyastūpadiśyante vartante tadanusṛtāḥ | ye te muktiṃ prayāntyeva bhuktvā svargāni bhūriśaḥ || 2.196.3 0|| sanmānayetpūjayecca ṛṣīn vācā ca karmaṇā | kuryācca priyametebhyo nāpriyaṃ kiñcidācaret ||3 1 || ṛṣayaḥ sādhavo divyā mama mūrtaya eva te | sarvathā guṇakośāste matsvarūpā vimuktidāḥ ||32|| nahi doṣo guṇo veti nirūpyasteṣu dṛśyate | ya evaṃ vartate nityaṃ sādhusatsaṃgamaṇḍale ||33|| yatra kvāpi sthitaḥ te’tra kalpyate yaśase ciram | pare svarge mama dhāmni gata eva sa kalpyate ||34|| loko’yaṃ tvāpadāṃ sthānaṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe vipatpradaḥ | satāṃ yogājñānalabdhyā vilīyante tadāpadaḥ ||35|| āpado dvividhāḥ santi bāhyāścābhyantarāstathā | svena vānyena vā sarvāḥ prāvirbhavanti nityaśaḥ ||36|| ābhyantarā bhavantyeva svena kṛtena karmaṇā | bāhyāstvanyasamutpannā vinā kṛtyaṃ bhavantyapi ||37|| ābhyantarāḥ sahanena jñānena nirvaheṇa ca | bāhyā anunayenānusṛtyā dānena yānti ca ||38 || śaktyānnadānaṃ satataṃ dravyadānaṃ hyapekṣitam | ārjavaṃ mārdavaṃ cāti titikṣā pūjanādikam ||39||| prasannīkaraṇaṃ cāpi bāhyāpadāṃ nivārakam | sarvāpadāṃ nāśakantu satāmāśīrvaco matam ||2.196.40|| śrīharerme śrayaṇe tu sarvasaukhyapradaṃ matam | sukhānāṃ śevadhiścāhaṃ yatra bhaktaiḥ supūjitaḥ ||41 | rakṣitaśca dhṛtaścāpi tatrānandasya vāridhiḥ | na tatrāpatpraleśo’pi yatrāhaṃ sukhasāgaraḥ ||42| yatra nāhaṃ tatra caurā duṣṭā ghnanti purīpatim | prajā ghnanti satprāmāṇyaṃ ghnanti vinā prarakṣakam ||43 | purā kākalato nāmnā munirāsīd drumāśrayaḥ | kākaṃ sa śikṣayāmāsa mānuṣaiḥ sahavāsanam ||44| kākāstu bahavastasya vṛkṣe tiṣṭhanti pañjare | kākavidyāṃ cireṇāsāvadhītavān samāgamāt ||45| vāṇīṃ sarvāṃ jñātavām̐śca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ prasaṃgataḥ | śakunāni vijānāti jānātyaśakunāni ca ||46 | kākān sa paṃjare kṛtvā paryacarati pattane | kosalāyāṃ nagaryāṃ sa yayau vasatisannidhau ||47| vadan janān bhāgyadarśī pravṛttyarthī punaḥ punaḥ | adhīdhvaṃ vāyasīṃ vidyāṃ śaṃsanti mama vāyasāḥ ||48| anāgatamatītaṃ ca vartamāne ca vedmyaham | evaṃ bhraman caturmāssu nagaryāṃ ca gṛhe gṛhe ||49|| sarveṣāṃ rājabhṛtyānāṃ duṣkarma paridṛṣṭavān | sarve’nyāyena gṛhṇanti dhanāni rājasevakāḥ ||2.196.50 || madyaṃ māṃsaṃ ca khādanti cauryaṃ kurvantyaśīlinaḥ | nirdayāśca prajāḥ sarvāḥ pīḍayantyaprakāśitam ||51 || rājānaṃ hantumicchanti rājyāptaye’pi te’nugāḥ | etatsarvaṃ kākavācā parijñāya yayau nṛpam |||52 || sarvajño’smīti nṛpatiṃ prāha bhṛtyādivartanam | amātyaṃ prāha nṛpatervacanādapi kākapaḥ ||53 || idaṃ dravyaṃ coritaṃ cāmutredaṃ ca tvayā kṛtam | asāvatra rājakośastvayā hṛto vināśitaḥ ||54|| anye kośaharāścāpi bhavantīme’nugāstava | evamākhyāti kāko’yaṃ satyametanmayoditam ||55||| rājā pragṛhya tān sarvān kośadravyamamārgayat | sarva satyaṃ prajātaṃ tat nānṛtaṃ kathitaṃ tu yat ||56|| tena rājñā daṇḍitāste pradhānādyāstataḥ param | anye bhṛtyā bhītimāptā daṇḍasya kākavācinaḥ |||57|| rātrau suptasya viprasya bāṇaiḥ kākamavedhayan | anye kākā bhinnajālātpañjarānniryayustataḥ ||58|| mṛtaṃ kākaṃ prasamīkṣya vipro gatvā nṛpaṃ prati | prāha rājam̐stava kṣemaṃ yāce tvāṃ nirbhayaṃ tathā ||59|| vacanātte mayā satyaṃ proktaṃ kākoditaṃ tu yat | daṇḍitāśca tvayā bhṛtyā anye bhītāstato nvimam ||2.196.60 || kākaṃ me hatavantaste duṣṭā bhṛtyāstavāhitāḥ | rājā yatra balī nāsti tatreyaṃ me daśāgatā ||6 1 || kākadravyaṃ hataṃ me’tra kākāścānye gatāstathā | tvattaḥ prāptaṃ na vai kiñcit prāṇabhītiṃ vināparam ||62|| bahumitrā hi rājāno bahvamitrāśca te tathā | rājasaṃgaprasaktasya nāśaḥ pūrvaṃ pravartate ||63 || naikāntenāpramādo hi kartavyaḥ syānmahīpatau | pramādite mahīpatau viśvasto yaḥ sa naśyati ||64|| pramādāddhi skhaled rājā skhalite nāsti jīvanam | rājānaṃ sevayet prājño mṛto’smītyabhimatya vai ||65|| durvyāhṛtādanādeśād duḥsthitād duradhiṣṭhitāt | durāsitād durvrajitād īṃgitādaṃgaceṣṭitāt ||6 6 || śaṃkamānaḥ pravarteta prājño nṛpasya sannidhau | vaiśvānara iva kruddhaśced yāvat pradahennṛpaḥ ||67|| tasmānnāhaṃ nivatsye’tra mama kṣemāya kevalam | paraṃ nibodha me rājan yatra rājā na vidyate ||68 || tatrāpadaḥ prajāsveva jāyante duṣṭanoditāḥ | yatra rājā nirbalaścādraṣṭājñātāvivekavān ||69|| tatrāpi cāpado gurvyo bhavantyeva prajāsvapi | bhavadrājye vasantyeva bhṛtyā ādānatatparāḥ ||2.196.70 || abhūtikāmā bhūtānāṃ vināśacauryahāriṇaḥ | ye vā bhavadvināśena rājyamicchantyanantakam ||7 1 || teṣāmahaṃ bhayād rājan gamiṣyāmyanyamāśrayam | yathā kāko mṛtastaiścābhisandhitaśareṇa me |||72 || tathāhaṃ vā tathā tvaṃ vā mā bāṇasya gatiṃ gataḥ | syāṃ syā veti viniścitya tīrṇo’smi kākadānataḥ ||73 || bahunakrajhaṣagrāhāṃ timiṃgilagaṇairyutām | tava rājyātmikāṃ duṣṭāṃ nadīṃ maraṇadāyinīm || 74|| gahanaṃ tava rājyaṃ vai hyandhakāramayaṃ nanu | neha viśvasituṃ śakyaṃ bhavatāpi kuto mayā ||71|| ato nātra śubho vāso vadho yatrāgrago’sti vai | sukṛtaṃ vadhyate yatra rakṣyante duṣprakarmiṇaḥ || 76 || neha yuktaṃ ciraṃ sthātuṃ cātmanaḥ kṣemamicchatā | madhuprapātaṃ rājyaṃ te bhojanaṃ viṣasaṃyutam ||77|| āśīviṣaiḥ parivṛtaṃ cāsadbhiḥ khāditaṃ pṛthak | śvagṛdhragomāyuyutaṃ rājam̐statpariśodhaya ||78|| tvayā puṣṭāstvayā rājye’dhikṛtāḥ paripālitāḥ | tvāmeva cābhisandhāya jighāṃsanti tavānugāḥ ||79|| bhavato’rthe mama kāko hatastairduṣṭamānasaiḥ | tasmād yāmi mahārāja kāraṇaṃ nānyadasti yat ||2.196.8 0 || arerhi durhṛdāt sarvairbhettavyaṃ kṣemayācibhiḥ | ityuktaśca nṛpaḥ prāha kākinaṃ satyavādinam ||8 1 || ahaṃ rakṣāṃ kariṣye te satkāreṇāpi bhūyasā | toṣayiṣye kākapālin bhūyo vasa gṛhe mama ||8 2|| evaṃ taṃ kathayantaṃ ca rājānaṃ prāha kākapaḥ | mā kuru tvaṃ sāhasaṃ vā vegaṃ rājan vidhāviha ||8 3|| kintvekaikaṃ pradaṇḍena pragṛhya durbalīkuru | tato doṣānusāreṇa pratyekaṃ puruṣaṃ jahi ||84|| evaṃ kṛte vijayaste nānyathā sahasā kṛte | kaṇṭakā bahavo yuktā hiṃsanti hastinaṃ dṛḍhāḥ ||85|| mṛdavo bahavo yuktā hiṃsanti balinaṃ nṛpam | adṛśyā bahavo doṣā nighnanti varṣmaṇaḥ patim ||86 || tasmādekaikaśo doṣā iva kṣayyā hi śatravaḥ | evamukte cakāraivaṃ rājā jaghāna vai kramāt ||87|| śatrūn niṣkaṣṭakaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtvā śrīkosalādhipaḥ | śaśāsa pṛthivīṃ paścāt kṛtvā satkarmaśobhanam ||88|| vrataṃ tapastīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā sevāṃ guroḥ satām | kṛtvā ca bhajanaṃ divyaṃ yayau dhāma sukhāspadam ||89|| tathā dehanagaryā vai rājā kauśalanāmakaḥ | ātmāyaṃ vartata dasyuvaryakrodhādipīḍitaḥ || 2.196.90|| guruḥ kākī śāstrakākān saha nītvā purīpatim | krodhādīnāṃ tu duṣṭatvaṃ vadatyeva punaḥ punaḥ || 91 || doṣāḥ śāstravihantāro’tidṛḍhā balinastathā | māyāyāṃ sthitamātmānaṃ jighāṃsanti ca saṃhatāḥ || 92|| tadvijñāya nṛpeṇaivātmānaṃ bhāvyaṃ sasattakam | doṣāḥ kramācchanaireva hantavyā nijasattayā ||93||| tato niṣkaṇṭake rājye kuryācchrīkṛṣṇasevanam | tenānando mahām̐ścāpi muktirājyaṃ bhavediha || 94|| ityevaṃ rādhike’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | upādiśya virarāma dadau mantraṃ ca vaiṣṇavam || 95 || tāvat kanyādvayaṃ rājño rājñā sākaṃ sabhāsthale | prapūjya paramaṃ kāntaṃ jagrāha śrīhareḥ karam || 96 || vivāhavidhinā prāpya prabhuṃ jāte kṛtārthike | hariṃ rājā prajāḥ sarve pūjayāmāsureva tu || 97|| bhūpatiḥ kārayāmāsa bhojanaṃ vividhaṃ tataḥ | sarve viśaśramuḥ sāyaṃ rātrau cakrurmahotsavam || 98|| prātarutthāya bhagavān phālanādāya sarvathā | upadāvastusarvasvaṃ pradadau parameśvaraḥ || 99|| kṛtāhniko dugdhapānaṃ kṛtvā gantuṃ mano’karot | tāvadrājā stokahomo netuṃ kṛṣṇamupāyayau || 2.196.100 || phenatantuṃ samāpṛcchya hariḥ sajjo’bhavad drutam | rājadattāṃ parigṛhya pūjāṃ vimānago’bhavat || 101 || anye sarve mahīmānā vimānagāstadābhavan | vidāyatūryaninadāstadā jayaravaiḥ saha || 1 02|| ambare dikṣu sarvatrāvyāpnuvan prajayā kṛtāḥ | harṣanādāḥ samabhavan śṛṇvan tān śrīhariryayau || 103 || stokahomanṛparājyaṃ svāduvadanarāṣṭrakam | samudrakhāḍikāṃ muktvā deśaṃ dadarśa saubhagam || 1 04|| rājā yayau purastatra svāgatārthaṃ hareḥ khalu | ṛṣiḥ svādananāmāpi yayau purastadāmbarāt || 105|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne phenatantunṛpasya trinayānagaryāṃ śrīhareravataraṇaṃ bhrāmaṇaṃ pūjanam upadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ viśramaṇaṃ ratryanantaraṃ bhādrakṛṣṇāmāyāṃ prātardugdhapānottaraṃ stokahomanṛparāṣṭrāgamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṇavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 196 ||
<2.197> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike svādanarṣiśca stokahomo nṛpo’pi ca | ambarādavatīryaiva mahodyāne viśālake || 1 || umāpuryāḥ sannidhau svāgatārthaṃ yayaturdrutam | sainyamādāya tūdyāne tiṣṭhataḥ saṃpratīkṣataḥ || 2 || rājadarśitamārgeṇāvātārayad vimānakam | hariścānye vimānāni tadudyāne’vatārayan || 3 || tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayanādāstathābhavan | prajānāṃ harṣanādāśca kīrtanāni tadābhavan | vimānaṃ phalapuṣpādyaiḥ prajābhiḥ saṃpravardhitam || 4 || harirlājākṣatādyaiśca vardhitaḥ svāgatīkṛtaḥ | śrīharirmadhyabhāgācca vimānād bahirāyayau || 5 || rājā pupūja vai bhaktyā svarṇakausumaśekharaiḥ | hārai ratnamayaiḥ pauṣpairgucchaiścandanavāribhiḥ || 6 || sugandhasārairvividhaiḥ pādaprakṣālanena ca | papau pādajalaṃ cāpi kuṭumbena samanvitaḥ || 7 || pradhānādyaiśca sahitaḥ prajābhiḥ sahitastathā | atha rājā tu pitarau hareḥ pupūja vai tataḥ || 8 || rājñī brahmapriyāḥ sarvāḥ pupūja parameśvarīḥ | rājānarceśānadevaṃ kanyā gaurīṃ pupūja ca || 9 || ṛṣirmaharṣīnānarca bhūbhṛttadā hariṃ prabhum | nyaṣādayannarayāne śeṣavatsvarṇamaṇḍite || 2.197.1 0|| phaṇāsahasraśobhāḍhye ṣaṣṭimānavavāhite | anyān nyaṣādayad rājā śakaṭīṣu navāsu ca || 11 || tatastūryaninādairhi yaśogānaiḥ sugītibhiḥ | nināditāsu tvāśāsu hariḥ svāgataśobhitaḥ || 1 2|| umāpuryāṃ vicacāra pāvayituṃ pratisthalam | gopure rājapuruṣairvardhito ratnamaṇḍanaiḥ || 13 || purīmadhye bhṛtyavaryaiḥ śreṣṭhibhiśca mahāpathe | gṛhibhiścāṃgaṇeṣveva sarvatra prajayā tadā || 14|| vardhitaḥ pūjitaḥ kṛṣṇo yayau dadan svadarśanam | pūjāṃ prāpya tataḥ sainyasahitaḥ svanivāsanam || 15|| āyayau jalapānādi cakāra nṛpanoditaḥ | kuṭumbaṃ jalapānādi cakre tathāpare’pi ca || 16|| jalapānādikaṃ cakruratha kṛṣṇaḥ sabhāsthale | rājasiṃhāsane sthitvā niṣadyopādideśa ha || 17|| prajābhiḥ sarvathā bhāvyaṃ parameśvarahetave | rājabhiḥ sarvathā bhāvyaṃ prajāntaryāmihetave || 18|| ubhābhyāṃ sarvathā bhāvyaṃ mitho’ntaryāmihetave | ubhayatra virāje’haṃ māṃ yajantu samāhitāḥ || 1 9|| tena yuṣmadvijayaśca bhuktau muktau bhaviṣyati | sādhūn saṃpūjayennityaṃ spardhāṃ tatra parityajet || 2.197.20|| na ca kāmād bhayāllobhākrodhādvā dharmamutsṛjet | amāninā satyavācā bhāvyaṃ jitātmanā tathā ||21|| tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya bhūtirbhavati śāśvatī | tejo dhairyaṃ kṣamā śaucamanurāgaḥ sthitirdhṛtiḥ ||22|| etān guṇān samāśritya vartitavyaṃ hi muktaye | kṛtaprajñaśca medhāvī budhaḥ sarvātmadarśakaḥ ||23|| sarvasatkarmaśuddhaśca vijñaścātmaparātmanoḥ | suhṛdātmā virāgaśca malloke gantumarhati ||24|| satyavāk śīlasampannaḥ satrapo brahmasaṃsmaraḥ | santuṣṭaḥ satyavratavān malloke gantumarhati ||25|| sāntvanaṃ vacanaṃ caikapadaṃ guṇairvibhūṣitam | ācaran puruṣaḥ saukhyaṃ labhet sarvatra sṛṣṭiṣu ||26|| sāma me stavanaṃ proktaṃ sāntvanaṃ ca tadeva tat | janānāṃ sāntvanaṃ cāpi hṛdisthasya mamaiva tat ||27|| tena tuṣyāmi satataṃ sāntvakīrtanasevanaiḥ | sāntvaṃ caikapadaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ sukhadaṃ sadā ||28|| sukṛtasya hi sāntvasya ślakṣṇasya madhurasya ca | samyagāsevyamānasya jihvāyāṃ saṃvasāmyaham ||29|| vyavahāreṇa śuddhena hṛdaye saṃvasāmyaham | ubhābhyāṃ sannidhau tasya cāgatya gocaro yathā || 2.197.3 0|| bhavāmyeva tathā nityaṃ karomyasya śubhaṃ nvaham | evaṃ tiṣṭhāmi satataṃ dhārmikeṣu janeṣvaham ||3 1 || dhārmikaiśca janairyatra svakīyā vasatiḥ kṛtā | tatra gūḍho vasāmyeva teṣāṃ rakṣaṇahetave || 32|| yaṣṭavyaṃ kratubhistaiśca dātavyaṃ dānayogine | anātharakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ na kāryaṃ dharmabādhakam || 33|| kṛpaṇānāthavṛddhānāṃ yoṣitāṃ sevināṃ tathā | yogaḥ kṣemastathā vṛttiḥ kalpanīyā hi dhārmikaiḥ || 34|| āśrameṣu yathākālaṃ cailabhājanabhojanam | dātavyaṃ taiḥ prajājanairnṛpeṇa śreṣṭhināpi ca ||35|| sarvārthatyāginaṃ santaṃ mokṣadaṃ śāstrasaṃvṛtam | pūjayecchreya icchan vai śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ ||36|| dasyavo’pi ghātakāśca viśvasanti tathāvidhe | pāpanāśakare śuddhe sādhau mokṣaprade gurau ||37|| sarvaśreyaskare sādhau viśvasanti vanasthitāḥ | āraṇyakāśca paśavaḥ siṃhāḥ krūrādayo’pi ca || 38|| śānti labhante tatraiva yatra sādhunivāsanam | ṛtavo’pi sattvavṛttā bhavanti sādhusaṃgame || 39|| bhūtāni sattvayuktāni jāyante sādhusannidhau | ahaṃ yasmād vasāmyeva sādhūnāṃ hṛdaye’nvaham ||2.197.40 || teṣāṃ sevanataḥ sevā mama saṃjāyate śubhā | phalaṃ yatsevanasyaiva jāyate sāghusevanāt ||41|| yathādeśaṃ yathākālaṃ yathābuddhiṃ yathābalam | sādhūn seveta satataṃ dharmārthī mokṣalālasaḥ ||42|| yathā śreyo bhavennaijaṃ tathā seveta kṣemavat | tathā karmāṇi kurvīta sādhustuṣṭo bhaved yathā ||43 || ye bhūtānyanugṛhṇanti śikṣayanti vṛṣādikam | te sādhavaḥ sadā rakṣyā rāṣṭre rājñā vipaścitā ||44|| dhanī saṃpūjayennityaṃ pānācchādanabhojanaiḥ | sādhuṃ prajāniyantāraṃ dharmasya śāsakaṃ śubham ||45|| prāyo dhanī dhārmikaśca tapoyuktān prapūjayet | buddhimān sādhupuruṣaṃ rakṣet svanagare sadā ||46|| satyamārjavamakrodhaṃ bhaktiṃ dharmaṃ virāgitām | pālayantaḥ sādhavaste rāṣṭrakṣemakarā matāḥ ||47|| kiṃ chidraṃ kasya saṃgo me kiṃ vā karomi sādhanam | kuto māṃ nāśrayed doṣaḥ iti vidvān vicintayet ||48|| rājā sādhūn rakṣayedvai sarvadoṣaharā hi te | dharmāya rājā bhavati lokarakṣaṇahetave ||49|| rājā carati ceddharmaṃ devatvāyaiva kalpate | rājā caratyadharmaṃ cennarakāyaiva kalpate ||2.197.50|| dharme tiṣṭhanti bhūtāni dharmau rājasu tiṣṭhati | taṃ rājā sādhu yaḥ śāsti sa rājā rakṣako mataḥ ||51|| rājā paramadharmātmā sādhurdharmaḥ sa ucyate | svadharme vartamānānāmarthasiddhiḥ pradṛśyate ||52|| tameva maṃgalaṃ dharmaṃ lokaḥ samanuvartate | mamedamiti naivāsti sādhūnāṃ dharmaśālinām ||53|| ṛṣayaḥ sādhavo vīkṣya lokakṣemaṃ samantataḥ | asṛjatsa mahadbhūtaṃ hyayaṃ dharmo bhaviṣyati ||54|| yasmin dharmo virājeta sa rājā rakṣako mataḥ | dharme vardhati vardhante sarvabhūtāni saukhyataḥ ||55|| tasmin hrasati hīyante tasmāddharmaṃ prarakṣayet | prabhavārthaṃ hi bhūtānāṃ dharmaḥ sṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃbhuvā ||56|| sādhau dharmaḥ prabhavati rakṣyāstasmāddhi sādhavaḥ | dharmasya sādhavo yonistasmāttān pūjayet sadā ||57|| mattātpramattāt paugaṇḍādunmattādvyasanāśrayāt | māyikācca śaṭhāddhūrtāllampaṭātkitavātmakāt ||58|| dūre bhavanti satataṃ sādhavo nirmalā yataḥ | tārayanti nimagnām̐śca prāpayanti ca māmapi ||59|| tasmād rakṣyāḥ pūjanīyāḥ sevanīyāḥ hi sādhavaḥ | atyāgaṃ cābhimānaṃ ca daṃbhaṃ krodhaṃ ca varjayet ||2.197.60 || kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśca yugaturyatā | rājādhināni sarvāṇi rājaiva yugamucyate ||6 1 || sudharmātmā nṛpaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kṛtaṃ yugaṃ sa tūcyate | adharmātmā bhaved rājā sādhavastvapayānti vai ||62|| vipado’pi bhaveyurvai rāṣṭre tatra samantataḥ | adharmabhūte nṛpatau sarve sīdanti jantavaḥ ||63|| yasya nāsti gururdharme na ca sādhūn supṛcchati | svayaṃ cāpāradarśī ca na ciraṃ sukhamaśnute ||64|| gurupradhāno dharmeṣu sādhudharme svayaṃ sthitaḥ | dharmapradhāno nṛpatiḥ sukhamakṣayamaśnute ||65|| tasmād prajābhiḥ satataṃ rājñā ca dharmavarmaṇi | vartitavyaṃ sādhusaṃge yena bhuktiśca mokṣaṇam ||66|| ityuktvā śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇo virarāmātha vai tataḥ | bhūpatiḥ pūjayāmāsa prajāḥ pupūjurādarāt ||67|| atha śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ taṃ stokahomasya kanyakā | mātṛvākyaṃ paripālya kṛṣṇahastamupādade ||68|| kṛtakṛpyābhavad gaurī rājotsavaṃ cakāra ha | hariṃ saṃbhojayāmāsa kuṭumbaṃ mahīmānakān ||69|| viśaśramustataḥ sarve prajāḥ svasvālayān yayuḥ | rātrau nṛtyādi ca rājākārayanmahadutsave ||2.197.70|| bhojanaṃ cātha viśrāntiṃ jagṛhuśca tataḥ param | prātarutthāya bhagavān kṛtāhnikaḥ supūjitaḥ ||7 1 || kṛtadugdhādipānaśca sajjo’bhūd gantumacyutaḥ| rājā dadāvupadāśca sainyena saha śobhanaḥ ||72|| vidāyaṃ pradadau cāpi tūryanādāstadābhavan | harirvimānamāruhya śṛṇvan jayadhvanīn śubhān ||73 || gaurīṇāṃ gītikāścāpi sarvairvimānavāsibhiḥ | prayayau cāmbarāttūrṇaṃ kāṣṭhayānanṛpasya vai ||74|| rāṣṭraṃ nāraravarṣidhraṃ sāgarāntaṃ mahāyatam | tunnayāmānagaryāḥ sannidhau vṛkṣādhivāsite ||75|| udyāne kāṣṭhayānaśca rājā puro yayau tathā | nāraravamuniścāpi svāgatārthaṃ hareryayau ||76|| ityevaṃ rādhike rājā sainyayukto’bhavatpuraḥ | sarvāḥ prajāstathā kṛṣṇasanmānārtha samāyayuḥ ||77|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne stokahomasya umāpuryāṃ hareravataraṇaṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanam upadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ bhādraśuklapratipadi prātastataḥ kāṣṭhayānanṛpatirāṣṭrāgamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 197 ||
<2.198> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca atha rādhe bālakṛṣṇaṃ kāṣṭhayāno nṛpastadā | ādideśāvatarituṃ vimānena yutaṃ harim || 1 || harirvimānamākāśādudyāne samatārayat | anyānyapi vimānāni cāvaterustadāmbarāt || 2 || sainyavādyānyavādyanta jayanādāstato’bhavan | prajābhirvardhitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jaharṣa ca || 3 || candanākṣatakusumairhārakādyaiśca pūjitaḥ | rājñā ca prajayā cāpi muninārcita īśvaraḥ || 4 || āyayau sa vimānādvai bahiḥ prasannatānvitaḥ | abhayaṃ pradadan premṇā kareṇa kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ || 5 || kāṣṭhayāno mahārājo harerhāraṃ gale dadau | koṭihīrakamūlyāḍhyaṃ pādau pupūja candanaiḥ || 6 || papau jalaṃ prasādotthaṃ kuṭumbaṃ cāpyapūjayat | śyāmāśvasyandane kṛṣṇaṃ nyaṣādayanmudānvitaḥ || 7 || rātrā chatraṃ dadhārātha kumārau cāmare śubhe | tadā jayasya ninadāḥ prabhābhirabhighoṣitāḥ || 8 || gaurībhiḥ puṣpamālābhiścākṣatairvardhitaḥ prabhuḥ | athānyān vai mahīmānān vāhaneṣu śubheṣu ca || 9 || rājā nyaṣādayat samyaguccāvaceṣu vai tadā | tunnavāyānagaryāṃ śrīhariṃ tvabhrāmayannṛpaḥ || 2.198.1 0|| rājñā gopuramadhye ca samarcitaḥ pareśvaraḥ | pradhānaiḥ pañcavartibhirnīrājitaśca pūjitaḥ || 1 1|| śreṣṭhibhiḥ pūjito madhye nagaryā hṛdayāṃgaṇe | āpaṇeṣu prajābhiśca pūjitaḥ phalanāṇakaiḥ || 12|| gṛhe gṛhe ca gaurībhirarcitaḥ prāṇadhārakaḥ | evaṃ vai nagarīṃ sarvāṃ bhramitvā bhagavān svayam || 13|| ājagāma nivāsaṃ svaṃ rājodyāne ca mandiram | tatrābhavatsabhā ramyā lokānāṃ bhagavān svayam || 14|| pūjāṃ prāpya prajābhyaścopādideśa hitāvaham | saṃsārasāgaraścāsti śītoṣṇādipradaḥ sadā || 15|| nimajjamānaṃ spṛśati doṣanakranakhādikam | tarituṃ nausvarūpā vai bhavanti khalu sādhavaḥ || 16|| tārayanti kare dhṛtvā bhavasāgaramajjitān | bhagavān hṛdaye yeṣāṃ nityaṃ vasāmi mokṣadaḥ || 17|| te pūjyāḥ sādhavo dhīrā hṛdayaṃ me yato matāḥ | sādhupakṣe vijayaḥ syādaihikaḥ pāramārthikaḥ || 18|| asādhuyukto vijayo hyadhruvo’svargya eva ca | sādayatyeva jayinaṃ saṃsāre ghorakardame || 19|| yastu dharmavilopena maryādālopanena ca | sādhuvākyopalaṃghanena kuryāttatra sukhāvaham ||2.198.20|| yasya lokāḥ prasannāścātithayaḥ pūjayārhitāḥ | santuṣṭaṃ ca kuṭumbaṃ ca nārāyaṇo gṛhe’sya vai ||21|| sādhavo guravaścācāryāścānye pūjyamānavāḥ | satyaśca pūjitā yasya tasya gṛhe vasāmyaham ||22|| nigraheṇa tu pāpānāṃ sādhūnāṃ saṃgraheṇa ca | bhaktyā yajñena dānena sevayāhaṃ vaśī sadā ||23 || sādhvarthe cāpi mokṣārthe haryarthe yaśca yudhyati | ātmānaṃ yūpamutsṛjya sa yaśo’nantadakṣiṇaḥ ||24|| madarthaṃ tyaktamānādirmadarthaṃ dīkṣitaśca yaḥ | so’śnute sarvakāmān vai sarvārthapraduho’kṣayān ||25|| duṣṭām̐styaktvā tataḥ sādhoḥ saṃgatiṃ sarvadācaret | duṣṭān bhāvairvijānīyālliṃgaiḥ parokṣagocaraiḥ || 26|| parokṣamaguṇānāha sadguṇānabhyasūyate | parairvā kīrtyamāneṣu tūṣṇīmāste parāṅmukhaḥ ||27|| niḥśvāsaṃ cauṣṭhasaṃdaṃśaṃ śirasaśca prakampanam | karotyabhīkṣṇaṃ vimanā bhāṣate viparītakam ||28|| parokṣe tu vikurute pratyakṣe nābhibhāṣate | pṛthaguktvā ca mṛdgāti nedṛgidaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||29|| āsane śayane yāne viruddhaṃ parivartate | yasmim̐statra pravijñeyaṃ duṣṭatvaṃ sahavāsataḥ ||2.198.3 0|| ārtirārte priye prītiretāvanmitralakṣaṇam | viparītaṃ tu boddhavyaṃ sadā duṣṭārilakṣaṇam ||3 1 || sādhavaḥ suhṛdo mitravaryā ātmahitaiṣiṇaḥ | pāpahā mokṣadāḥ santi sevanīyā viśeṣataḥ ||32|| svayaṃ cāpi vivekena vartitavyaṃ tadagrataḥ | hṛdaye’pi vivekaṃ vai kuryādanityavastunaḥ ||33 || anityaṃ sarvamevaitanmamāhaṃkārasaṃbhṛtam | nāmarūpaṃ yadastyeva sarvaṃ tannāsti cottare ||34|| evaṃ vivekavān naṣṭe vyathate na kadācana | prāpte na harṣavānāste gatvare kā nu devanā ||35|| āpadaṃ pragataścāpi vyathate na vivekavān | bhūtaṃ gataṃ bhaviṣyaṃ tu nāgataṃ vartate tu yat ||36|| hasamānaṃ prayātyeva sarvaṃ tanna bhaviṣyati | evaṃ viditavedyastu nahi śokāya kalpate ||37|| āgataṃ tadvinaśyeta jñātvaivaṃ ko nu saṃjvaret | śokamūlaṃ tataḥ sarvaṃ jñātvā śokaṃ parityajet ||38|| kva nu vṛddhā gatā ye tu pitā pitāmahādayaḥ | sarve dhruvā na vidyante jñātvaivaṃ ko nu saṃjvaret| ||39|| bālā madhyavayasaśca tato vṛddhāścirāyuṣaḥ | lakṣādhilakṣakoṭyabdā mariṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||2.198.40 || tathāpi mahatīṃ tṛṣṇāṃ vimuñcanti na dehinaḥ | vicāryaivaṃ ca tāṃ tyaktvā kurvīta priyamātmanaḥ ||41 || anāgataṃ na me cāsti krāntaṃ me nahi vartate | asti me na lalāṭe’sti tasmāt sādhurbhavet sadā ||42|| anāḍhyāścāpi jīvanti rājāno’pi tathaiva ca | rājasu vyādhibāhulyaṃ nānāḍhye’to’dhanaḥ sukhī ||43|| evaṃ matvā na śoceta kālaḥ sarvatra vai samaḥ | bhoktāro’nye’rjayitāro’pare cintāparāḥ pare ||44|| sarvabhogyeṣu loke’tra dṛṣṭvaivaṃ na śucaścaret | pūrvadattaṃ parasmim̐śca prāpyeteti sthitidhrurvā ||45|| adattaṃ cāpi vāñcchanti vinā yatnaṃ laṣanti ca | hīnabhogyo janaḥ so’jaṃ garhate na nijaṃ kvacit ||46||| īrṣyābhimānasampannastūdvegaṃ labhate tataḥ | etasmāt kāraṇād vyaktau duḥkhaṃ bhūyo’nuvartate ||47|| sahanīyā parā lakṣmīryā nāsti svalalāṭake | yatitavyaṃ tadarthaṃ vā yatnaphalā ramā yataḥ ||48|| anyatrāpi satīṃ lakṣmīṃ kuśalā bhuñjate sadā | abhinispandate śrīrhi yatnavantaṃ prabhāvinam ||49|| śriyaṃ ca putrapautrāṃśca kanyāṃ ca pṛthivīmapi | utpādya parabhogyāni svayameva tyajanti hi ||2.198.50|| akāmyān kāmayāno’rthān parādhīnānupadravān | tyaktvā bhavettu saṃkalpān sukhī sādhuryathāgrahī ||5 1|| anarthāstvartharūpā vai arthāścānartharūpiṇaḥ | bhavantyeva yathābhāgyaṃ tatra prājño na viśvaset |||52| arthāyaiva tu keṣāñcit sarvanāśo bhavatyapi | anarthāyaiva keṣāñcid bahulābho bhavatyapi ||53|| ajñaścānantalubdhaśca sukhaṃ matvā prasajjate | ramamāṇaḥ śriyā paścānnānyacchreyo’bhimanyate |||54|| akasmāttu śriyo nāśe samāraṃbho vinaśyati | tadā nirvidyate so’rthāt paribhagnamanorathaḥ ||55|| dharmameke carantyeva kalyāṇābhijanā bhuvi | paratra sukhamicchanto nirvidyante tu laukikāt ||56|| dhanameke’rjayantyeva mahālobhābhimarditāḥ | jīvitārthaṃ hi manyante puruṣārthaṃ dhanaṃ ca te ||57|| jñātvā teṣāṃ kṛpaṇatāṃ jñātvā teṣāmabuddhitām | adhruve jīvite mohādarthadṛṣṭimupāśritān ||58|| niṣphalān tapyamānām̐śca jñānavarjitamānavān | vilokyāndhatamaḥkṣiptān ko nu dadyānmṛṣā manaḥ ||59|| niyacchatendriyāṇyebhyo yacchatāpi mano nijam | saṃyacchata giro’pyebhyo viṣayebhyo vicārataḥ ||2.198.60|| bhavata pratiṣeddhārastadā jayo bhaviṣyati | bhāveṣu kṣaṇamātreṣu prajñātṛpto na śocati ||6 1|| alpe tṛpto mṛdurdānto brahmaśīlo na śocati | nṛśaṃsavṛttiṃ pāpiṣṭhāṃ prāptaḥ śokānna mucyate ||62|| api mūlaphalājīvo ramate nirjane vane | vāgyato matparo bhaktaḥ sarvārpaṇaḥ sukhī janaḥ ||63|| manīṣayā vinigṛhyeṣaṇāḥ sukhī gṛhī bhavet | yathaiko ramate’raṇyeṣvāraṇyenaiva tuṣyati ||64|| mahāpuruṣatṛptaśca svātmanaiva prasīdati | sādhuvadvartamānasya sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ parātmani ||65|| hitvā daṃbhaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca krodhaṃ harṣaṃ bhayaṃ tathā | sādhūn prasevya dehādyaiḥ śāśvataṃ sukhamarjayet ||66|| sādhusevā paraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapuṇyādhikaṃ matam | asaṃśayaṃ puṇyaśīlaḥ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim ||67|| mātāpitrorgurūṇāṃ ca pūjā bahumatā mama | iha yukto naro lokān yaśastu mahadaśnute ||68|| yacca te’bhyanujānīyuḥ kartavyaṃ pūjitāḥ khalu | dharmyaṃ dharmaviruddhaṃ vā tatkartavyaṃ sutādibhiḥ ||69|| na ca tairabhyanujñāto dharmamanyaṃ samācaret | yaṃ ca te’bhyanujānīyuḥ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ ||2.198.70 || ete eva trayo lokāstrayo’gnayaśca te matāḥ | trayo vedāstryāśramāśca tanmatasthā jayanti vai ||71 || pitā vai gārhapatyo’gnirmātā vai dakṣiṇo’nalaḥ | guruścāhavanīyāgniḥ sāgnitretā garīyasī ||72|| triṣvapramādyanneteṣu trīn lokān vijayeta vai | pitṛvṛttyā tvimaṃ lokaṃ mātṛvṛttyā divaṃ tathā ||73 || brahmalokaṃ guruvṛttyā jayeta nātra saṃśayaḥ | nityaṃ paricaretvetān tadvai sukṛtamuttamam ||74|| sarve tasyādṛtā lokā yasyaite traya ādṛtāḥ | anādṛtāstu yasyaite sarvāstasyāphalāḥ kriyāḥ ||75|| amānitā nityameva yasyaite guravastrayaḥ | na cāyaṃ na parolokastasya kṣemāya jāyate ||76|| na cātra vā pare loke yaśastasya pravartate | na cānyadapi kalyāṇaṃ cobhayatrāsya jāyate ||77|| daśaśrotriyataḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sadācāryo hi vidyate | daśācāryebhya evātropādhyāyaḥ śreṣṭha ucyate ||78|| daśopādhyāyataḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pitā sarvatra vartate | daśapitruttamā mātā sarvapṛthvīsamā hi sā ||79||
