gururmātā yathā proktā nāsti mātṛsamo guruḥ | gururgarīyān pitṛto mātṛtaścāpi sarvadā ||2.198.80|| ubhau hi mātāpitarau janmadau śarīrasṛjau | gururjñānaprado divyo divyajñātikarastathā ||8 1 || guruyuktā tu yā jātiḥ sā divyā sājarāmarā | avadhyā hi sadā mātā pitā guruḥ sutādibhiḥ ||82|| ṛṣayaścāpi devāśca prīyante pitṛbhiḥ saha | pūjyamāneṣu guruṣu tasmāt pūjyatamo guruḥ ||83 || kenacinna ca vṛttena hyavajñeyo gururbhavet | na te’vamānamarhanti mātā pitā gurustathā ||84|| na teṣāṃ dūṣayet kāryaṃ satkāraṃ tvācaret sadā | avamānaprakartuśca bhrūṇahatyāghamasti yat ||85|| mitradruhaḥ kṛtaghnasya strīghnasya gurughātinaḥ | caturṇāṃ niṣkṛtirnāsti mahāmahātipāpinām ||86 || sādhavaḥ śrīharerbhaktāstyāgino guravaḥ śubhāḥ | pūjanīyā vandanīyā bhojanīyāḥ samantataḥ ||87|| teṣu vai dharmasarvasvaṃ seviteṣu bhavediha | santuṣṭeṣu sarvayajñā bhavantīha na saṃśayaḥ ||88|| evaṃ gurūn pūjayitvārādhayitvā ca māṃ sadā | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhadhvaṃ vai matprasādājjanā iha ||89|| ityuktvā bhagavān rādhe virarāma tato nṛpaḥ | pupūja śrīhariṃ nīrājanādyaistu kṛtādaraḥ ||2.198.90|| pupūjuśca prajā sarvā bahubhirvastubhistadā | rājñī pūjāṃ cakārāpi rājakanyā kumudvatī ||9 1|| harerhastagrahaṃ cakre vivāhavidhinā tadā | mahotsavaṃ nṛpaścakre parihāraṃ cakāra ha ||92|| bhojayāmāsa nṛpatirhariṃ prāghūṇikām̐stataḥ | viśramya ca niśāṃ yāpayitvā prātaḥ kṛtāhnikaḥ ||93|| hariḥ sajjo’bhavad gantuṃ kolakakṣmeśarāṣṭrakam | kṛtadugdhādipānaśca kṛtārcano vimānakam ||94|| samāruroha sarve’pi cāruruhustato’mbare | jayanādaiḥ saha kṛṣṇo lepanādarṣisaṃyutaḥ || 95|| lepadeśān yayuḥ śīghraṃ mānito mānavaistadā | rājā svāgatasiddhyarthaṃ yayau purotibhāvatāḥ || 96|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kāṣṭhayānanṛpasya tunnavāyāpuryāṃ śrīharerbhramaṇaṃ pūjanamudeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ niśottaraṃ prātaḥ kolakanṛparāṣṭrābhigamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 198 ||
<2.199> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo hariḥ svayam | leparāṣṭranṛpaṃ sainyasahitaṃ bhuvyalokayat || 1 || svāgatārthaṃ sthitaṃ naije mahodyāne’tivistṛte | rājadarśitamārgeṇa bhagavān kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ || 2 || vimānamambarāt pṛthvyāṃ muramāṣāpurītaṭe | viśāle ramyabhāge cāvātārayat suśobhite || 3 || anyānyapi vimānāni cāvateruḥ samīpataḥ | tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayanādāstathābhavan || 4 || gaurīṇāṃ gītikāścāsan prajānāṃ harṣaghoṣaṇāḥ | vimānācca hariḥ śīghraṃ bahistatra samāyayau || 5 | rājñā ca prajayā rājñyā maharṣiṇārcitaḥ prabhuḥ | hāraiḥ suśekharaiḥ puṣpaiścandanairakṣatādibhiḥ || 6 anye’pi pūjitāstatra mahīmānāḥ prajājanaiḥ | narayāne hariṃ rājā niṣādyānyān gajādiṣu || 7 | muramāṣānagaryāṃ cābhrāmayad bahumānataḥ | rājavaṃśaḥ pradhānāśca śreṣṭhinaḥ paṇḍitā api || 8 | narā nāryo gopurādau rājamārge susaṃgame | catvarādau ca śālāsu pūjayāmāsurādarāt || 9 | bahvībhistūpadābhiśca svarṇaratnavibhūṣaṇaiḥ | anekadivyabhūṣābhiḥ kambalaiśca dhanaistathā || 2.199.10|| sthale sthale pracakruste nīrājanaṃ samarhaṇam | gauryaḥ puṣpādibhiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vardhayāmāsurīśvaram || 11 || evaṃ bhramitvā nagarīṃ rājasaudhaṃ sa āyayau | sabhāṃ kṛtvā janānāha bhagavān hitakārakaḥ || 12|| saccidānandarūpo vai parameśaḥ sanātanaḥ | pūjanīyo bhajanīyo mānavairmokṣakāṃkṣibhiḥ || 13 || satyaṃ vrataṃ paraṃ sādhu na satyād vidyate param | hānidaṃ satyamevāpi vaktavyaṃ na kadācana || 14|| ahiṃsārthāya bhūtānāṃ dharmapravacanaṃ kṛtam | dhāraṇād dharma ityāhurdharmeṇa vidhṛtāḥ prajāḥ || 15|| yaḥ syāddhāraṇasaṃyuktaḥ sa dharma itiniścayaḥ | yaḥ syādahiṃsāsaṃyuktaḥ sa dharma itiniścayaḥ || 16| hiṃsāyāṃ satyavacane’nṛtaṃ dharma itisthitiḥ | anṛte’pi ca hiṃsāyāṃ dharma itisthitiḥ || 17| satye’nṛte vā hiṃsāyāṃ maunaṃ dharma itisthitiḥ | jīvarakṣā satyaśiṣṭā satyaṃ brahma yato matam || 18| caurebhyo na dhanaṃ vācyaṃ satyaṃ tatra na bhūṣaṇam | tebhyaḥ satyaṃ na cākhyeyaṃ sa dharma itiniścayaḥ || 1 9| akūjanena cenmokṣo nāvakūjet kathaṃcana | avaśyaṃ kūjitavye vā svalpaṃ cānṛtamiśritam ||2.199.20|| dharma eva bhavettatra śreyaskaraṃ tadānṛtam | śapatho’pi pravaktavyo yadi cauraiḥ pramucyate ||21| prāṇātyaye vivāhe cānṛtaṃ satyaṃ taducyate | arthasya rakṣaṇārthāya parasya prāṇadhāraṇe || 22| anṛtaṃ satyamevāsti dharmatattvaṃ nigūḍhakam | sādhubhyo nānṛtaṃ vācyaṃ tārakāste hi dehinām || 23 || teṣvanṛtaṃ sadā pāpaṃ satyapūtaṃ tato vadet | satyaṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ vai vrataṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ matam || 24|| karmaṇā manasā vācā satyaṃ dharmaṃ samācaret | satyavratasya duḥkhāni nopayānti kadācana ||25|| saṃyatātmā vitṛṣṇaśca duḥkhadurgaṃ taratyapi | daṃbhācāravihīnaśca viṣayāṇāṃ vinigrahī ||26||| ahiṃsako nātivādī duḥkhadurge taratyapi | dātā yācakatāhīno’tithisaṃpūjakastathā ||27|| anasūyo’tisevākṛt mātāpitrorguroḥ satām | pāpahīno nyāyavṛttirduḥkhadurgaṃ taratyapi || 28|| satyavrato’nyakaṣṭasya nivārakaḥ śuciḥ sthiraḥ | kuhakena vihīnaśca duḥkhadurgaṃ taratyapi ||29|| tāpaso brahmavarcaskaḥ śāntaḥ sattvātivartanaḥ | trāsaśūnyo’bhayadaśca duḥkhadurgaṃ taratyapi || 2.199.30|| samadṛṣṭiśca sarvatra paraśrīvardhakastathā | grāmyārthavinivṛttaśca duḥkhadurgaṃ taratyapi || 31 || sarvadevanamoyuktaḥ sadā kṛṣṇakathāśravaḥ | śraddhadhānaḥ śāntacitto duḥkhadurgaṃ taratyapi ||32|| amānī mānado mānyo devarṣipitṛpūjakaḥ | akrodhaḥ krodhaśamano duḥkhadurgaṃ taratyapi || 33|| jitajihvo jitaśiśno jitanārāyaṇo’pi ca | jitatṛṣṇo jitavṛttirduḥkhadurgaṃ taratyapi ||34 || yatrāhaṃ padmaraktākṣaḥ pītavāsā janārdanaḥ | suhṛd bhrātā ca mitraṃ ca sambandhī ca sukhapradaḥ ||35|| kāmbhareyo bālakṛṣṇo gopālabālako’cyutaḥ | sthito’smi hitakṛd yatra bhaktasya hṛdi sannidhau ||36|| brahmapriyāpriyaḥ kāntaḥ śrīpatiryatra cāsmi tam | māṃ hariryaścāśrayati duḥkhadurgaṃ taratyasau || 37|| satyo’haṃ satyadharmo’haṃ duḥkhānāṃ nāśako’pyaham | māṃ viditvāśrayantaśca duḥkhadurgaṃ tarantyapi || 38|| tasmād bhajata māṃ nityaṃ māmevāpsyatha dhāmni me | ityuktvā pradadau mantraṃ bhagavān śaraṇārthine || 39|| rājñe cāpi prajābhyaśca tato rājārcayaddharim | rājñī kanyāyutā kṛṣṇaṃ rādhe prāpūjayattadā ||2.199.40 || kanyaikā kṛṣṇakāntaṃ taṃ kare jagrāha bhāvataḥ | vivāhavidhinā prāpya kṛtakṛtyā babhūva ha || 41 || sabhāṃ visarjayitvaiva sa rājā mahīmānakān | bhojayāmāsa vividhānnāni rasya phalāni ca || 42|| utsavaṃ subhagaṃ cakre rājā bhādrasya cārjune | tṛtīyāyā niśāyāṃ ca viśaśramustataḥ param ||41 || sarve prātaḥ kṛtasnānāścakruḥ pāyasabhojanam | tāvad gāṃgeyaputryaścāyayustvarthayituṃ hareḥ ||44|| nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya kanyāstā varadānakam | vavrire bālakṛṣṇādvai tīrthīkartuṃ saridvarāḥ ||45|| snāhi nārāyaṇa kṛṣṇavallabhaśrīpate jale | sarvā vayaṃ bhaviṣyāmastīrthātmikāstavāplavāt ||46|| haristathāstviti prāha dhṛtvā rūpāṇyanekaśaḥ | kṛpayā prayayau śīghraṃ snātuṃ nadīṣu vai tathā ||47|| sarassu ca samudreṣu yayāvanekarūpadhṛk | tathaikarūpataḥ kṛṣṇo rājate rājasannidhau ||48|| kolakākhyo mahārājo divyadṛṣṭyā pradattayā | sarvaṃ paśyati tatraiva muramāṣāsthito’pi san ||49|| hariḥ sasnau nīparāyāṃ nistārāyāṃ tathā tadā | pṛthāyāṃ dinapāyāṃ sevikāyāṃ snānamācarat ||2.199.50|| trivarāyāṃ rāhuṇāyāṃ senāyāṃ snānamācarat | indirāyāṃ gavādakavitāyāṃ snānamācarat ||51 || gavādayānānadyāṃ trigirāyāṃ snānamācarat | dūrānadyāṃ gurūṇāyāṃ mitrāyāṃ snānamācarat ||52|| senāyāṃ lavavārāyāṃ dvilīnāyāṃ tathāplavam | sukautukyāṃ sthāyinadyāṃ cālpāpāyāṃ tathākarot ||53|| audaryāṃ viṣṇutulyāyāṃ prapīṭhāyāṃ samāplavam | niyamānājale dūnānadyāṃ ca pāyupaśyake ||54|| sarasyapi leṇḍuge yonige snānaṃ samācarat | trinayāyāṃ ca hīnāyāṃ paṃcorāyāṃ samāplavam |||55||| kāmāyāṃ cāpi volgāyāṃ donāyāṃ snānamācarat | ājavābdhau śvetavārdhau kṛṣṇābdhau kāśyapeyake ||56||| bālatrike’bdhau bhagavān sasnau vai yugapattadā | catvāriṃśadrūpadhartā bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ ||57|| vidhāya tīrtharūpāstāḥ kanyakāśca sarāṃsi ca | upakanyāśca vai tatrādyātmikāḥ saṃvidhāya ca ||58|| śīghraṃ tiro’bhavat kṛṣṇaḥ kolakālayamāyayau | kolakastu tadā kṛṣṇamāhātmyaṃ saṃbubodha ha ||59|| avatārāvatāryeva paramātmā parātparaḥ | so’yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣājjāmātā me’bhavat prabhuḥ || 2.199.60|| kṛtakṛtyo’hamevāsmi vasātra bhagavan sadā | mamāvāse tava yogye kṛpāṃ kuru janārdana || 61|| ityevaṃ cārthayattāvanmadhyāhnaḥ samajāyata | yavakrītādayaḥ sarve gāṃgeyāśca maharṣayaḥ ||62|| āyayurdarśanārthaṃ vai hariṇā saṃsmṛtāstadā | niṣeduste praṇamyaiva bālakṛṣṇasya sannidhau ||63|| lomaśādyāstathā vṛkāyanāśca nīlakarṇakaḥ | īśāno’nye gaṇāścāpi pārṣadāḥ saṃsmṛtāstadā ||64|| āyayuḥ sannidhau sarve kolarājasya mandire | hariḥ prāha kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ ketumālasya sarvataḥ ||65|| deśāḥ sampāvitāḥ sarve rājāno bhaktimāśritāḥ | prajā bhaktāḥ prajātāśca tīrthānyapi kṛtāni ca ||66|| ṛṣayaścāpi santuṣṭā jātā dānādibhistathā | brahmapriyāstathā gauryaḥ sukhamayyo mayā kṛtāḥ ||67|| parvatāḥ pāvitāścātra sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ tato’bhavat | adhunā tatra gantavyaṃ yatrarṣimaṇḍalaṃ vadet ||68|| bhavanto me pramāṇaṃ vai sādhavaśca maharṣayaḥ | ityuktvā bālakṛṣṇaśca ṛṣivākyaṃ pratīkṣate ||69|| tāvad vyomnaḥ sakāśādvai puṣpavṛṣṭirvavarṣa vai | jayaśabdaiḥ saha sādhuḥ saccidānandasaṃjñakaḥ ||2.199.70 || lālāyano maharṣiryaḥ pūrvaṃ cottarato hyagāt | poṣapūrṇātithau paścāt tuṣito’pi suro hyagāt ||71 || tāvubhau suvimānasthau tvāgatau kolakālaye | bālakṛṣṇaṃ bhajamānau jayaśabdān pracakratuḥ ||72|| tīrthīkurvan ketumālaṃ jayatvakṣaradhāmapaḥ | harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇasvāmiśrīkṛṣṇavallabha ||73|| kāmbhareya brahmaśaktisvāmingopālanandana | vardhayātra ciraṃ tiṣṭha deśān saṃkuru pāvanān ||74|| ityevaṃ vyāharantau tau vimānaṃ bhāskaropamam | avatārayatāṃ rājālayodyāne śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||75|| nirgatau tau vimānācca munī sāttvatapuṃgavau | puṣpamālānvitau bhaktibharau kṛṣṇe’timānasau ||76|| nematuḥ śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ samāgatya samīpataḥ | daṇḍavat puṣpahārādyairānarcatuḥ pareśvaram ||77|| sāśrunetrau galatkarṇau jātapulakitāṅgakau | haryājñayāsanayośca niṣedatuḥ samīpataḥ ||78|| harirutthāya caraṇau dadau vakṣasi vai tayoḥ | nyadhāddhastau mastake ca bāhubhyāṃ pariṣasvaje ||79|| papraccha kuśalaṃ tābhyāṃ bhaktikāryaprasāraṇam | ūcatustau kṛpayā te yogakṣemau pravartataḥ ||2.199.80|| kenāṭāścāmarīdeśā bhavataḥ kṛpayā prabho | mumukṣuvāsitāḥ santi pratīkṣante tavāgamam ||8 1 | āgatya tatra kartavyo viṣṇukraturhi pāvanaḥ | tāḥ prajāḥ pāvayitavyā amarīkapradeśajāḥ |||82| rājānaśca prajāścāpi maharṣayaśca tadgatāḥ | āgamaṃ te pratīkṣante kṛtārthīkuru tatprajāḥ ||83| ityarthito hariḥ śrīmallomaśaṃ śaṃkaraṃ tathā | maharṣīn paripapraccha kiṃ kartavyaṃ vadantu mām ||84| sarve prāhuryathā lālāyanaḥ prārthayate prabho | tathā kartavyamevātra tārako hi bhavān yataḥ ||85|| yavakrīto nīlakarṇo vṛkāyanaśca lomaśaḥ | gāṃgeyāśca vayaṃ sarve śaṃkarādyā yathādiśaḥ ||86 || tathā kurmo na sandeho lokatāraṇahetave | evaṃ pratyuttare prāpte bhagavān naranāṭyadhṛk ||87|| tathāstviti prāha lālāyanaṃ tuṣitadaivatam | hāritarṣirnāmataśca prāha tatra tadā harim ||88|| gacchāmyahaṃ hare pūrvaṃ mama śiṣyapradeśakān | garimākhyān hāritām̐śca mādhyasthān kuru pāvanān ||89|| ityuktvājñāṃ śiro dhṛtvā yayau vimānataḥ puraḥ | garimākhyapradeśām̐śca svāgatārthamasañjayat ||2.199.90|| aparānāvikāpuryā dinamānārkabhūpatiḥ | hāritarṣipraśiṣyaśca svāgatārthaṃ hareḥ śubhaiḥ ||9 1 | maṃgalairvividhaiḥ kalpaiḥ śṛṃgāraṃ samasajjayat | athātra kolako rājā parameśaṃ munīn satīḥ ||92|| mahīmānān paramānnaistṛptayāmāsa bhojanaiḥ | pūjayāmāsa bahudhā samarpaṇaiśca sarvathā ||93|| arthayāmāsa rātryaikyaṃ sthātuṃ nijālaye prabhum | haristathāstviti prāha rājā rātrau mahotsavam ||94|| kārayāmāsa subhagaṃ nṛtyamallapradarśanaiḥ | niśānidrottaraṃ prātarhariḥ kṛtāhniko drutam ||95|| gantuṃ sajjo’bhavattūrṇaṃ rājā mānārhaṇāṃ vyadhāt | sainyena mānitaścāpi prajābhirmānitaśca saḥ ||96| vimānaṃ cārurohānye cāruruhurnijānyapi | yaśaḥkīrtyādi śṛṇvan śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||97| gāṃgaiyairnaijikaiścāpi vyomamārgeṇa sattvaram | samudraṃ tu samullaṃghya garimāpṛthivīṃ yayau ||98| hāritām̐stānpradeśām̐śca vyalokayattadāmbarāt | svāgatārthaṃ hāritarṣidinamānārkabhūpatī ||99| yatrāstāṃ tāvaparānāvikāpuryāṃ puraḥsthitau | tau vilokya dhvajacihnairambare sthairyamāptavān || 2.199.10 0|| sainyakṛtaṃ svāgataṃ saṃvilokya bhagavān hariḥ | rādhike bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa mumude tvantarīkṣagaḥ || 10 1|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kolakanṛpasya muramāṣānagaryāṃ śrīharestṛtīyāyāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanamupadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ gāṃgeyakanyādikṛtaprārthanayā tajjaleṣu bahurūpāṇi dhṛtvā yugapat snānena tīrthīkaraṇatā rātrau viśrāntirbhādraśuklacaturthyāṃ dinamānārkanṛpakhaṇḍaṃ prati gamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 199 ||
<2.200> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhe hāritadeśeṣu bahvaraṇyātiśītiṣu | svalpaprajāśriteṣveṣaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 || aparānāvikāpuryāṃ samudrasannidhau nijam | vimānamambarāttūrṇaṃ dinamānārkabhūbhṛtā || 2 || pradarśitena mārgeṇa garimāpṛthivītale | hāritarṣiṃ sthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā samavātārayacchanaiḥ || 3 || anyānyapi vimānāni cāvaterustadāmbarāt | rājā sainyena sahitaḥ svāgataṃ paramātmanaḥ || 4 || samācarattathā rājñī hāritaśca prajājanaḥ | rājā śrutaṃ hariṃ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaṃ vimānagam || 5 || antikaṃ cābhigatvaiva dadarśāścaryamāptavān | adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ śrīkāntaṃ ramaṇīyasuvigraham || 6 || prathamaṃ divyamālokya kṣaṇaṃ tu sthiratāṃ gataḥ | vimāne śrīharermūrtau līnaḥ samādhimāniva || 7 || jāta eva tathā rājñī kumārāśca kumārikāḥ | sarve dṛṣṭvā bālakṛṣṇaṃ samādhiṃ cābhipedire || 8 || koṭividyutsamaṃ tejo dadṛśuḥ sarvatomukham | tatreśvarān virāḍādyān dadṛśuśca tataḥ parān || 9 || bhūmādyānatha tatpaścād dhāma golokamuttamam | lokayāmāsurutkṛṣṭaṃ koṭigopagaṇāśritam || 2.200.1 0|| tatra kṛṣṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ vilokya punareva te | akṣarākhye pare dhāmni sthitaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam || 11 || vyalokayanmuktamadhye brahmapriyāsamanvitam | sarveśvareśvaraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ muktādisevitam || 1 2|| tataḥ samādhirnaṣṭaśca vyutthitāste vimānake | bālakṛṣṇaṃ nije rāṣṭre dadṛśuste’tibhāvukāḥ || 1 3|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā rājā rājakuṭumbinaḥ | hāracandanagandhādyairapūjayan vimānake | tāvaddharirbahiryāto vimānād bhāsvarāmbaraḥ || 14|| sarvalāvaṇyasaundaryaujjvalyahāsyamanoharaḥ | prajā gauryaśca hārityo vardhayāmāsuracyutam || 15|| lājākṣatādibhiḥ puṣpairgītaiśca namanādibhiḥ | prajājanāḥ praṇemuśca śrīpatiṃ kṛṣṇavallabham || 16|| rājā hariṃ kareṇaiva karamādāya kānake | yantrabāhye rathe nyaṣādayat sragādiśobhite || 17|| kuṭumbaṃ ca nṛpasyāpi rathe’tra niṣasāda ha | rājā chatraṃ dadhārāpi rājñī dadhre ca vāyudam || 18|| kumāryaścāmare dadhruḥ kumārā vetramāvahan | ratheṣvanyeṣu pitarau hareḥ kuṭumbameva ca || 19|| niṣādyānyarathe śaṃbhuṃ pareṣu munimaṇḍalam | guptigantrīṣu ca kṛṣṇakāntā nyaṣādayannṛpaḥ ||2.200.20|| mahatā svāgatenaivaṃ vādyadhvanipuraḥsaram | tūpaśabdairnāditā ca purīṃ prāveśayat prabhum ||21 || mahotsāhaḥ prajāyāṃ vai tadābhūnnūtanekṣaṇāt | hṛndi hariḥ prajānāṃ saṃpracakarṣa muhurmuhuḥ ||22|| yatrāṅge yasya cakṣurvai tadā lagnaṃ tvabhūddhareḥ | tatrāsaktaṃ dhruvaṃ cābhūnnirnimeṣaṃ sthiraṃ sukhāt ||23|| kecidasyamukhapaṃkajamīkṣyāpurhisādhanamapāsya samādhim | tatra cātihṛdayaṃgamamīśaṃ vīkṣya śāntimatigāṃ samavāpuḥ ||24|| kāścidasya madanāśritanetraṃ tvāyatāntamatikṛṣṭibharaṃ ca | vīkṣya mohitadhiyaḥ sthiratāṃ vai prāpya cakruramṛtottamapānam ||25|| yāstadoṣṭhamururaktakabimvābhaṃ vilokya samakarṣitacittāḥ | yoṣitaḥ samabhavansamalabdhau tāḥ satṛṣṇahṛdayā abhavam̐śca ||26|| kāścidasya purusundaragātrelubdhavṛttaya itīśvarabodhāḥ | arpaṇaṃ ca paricakruramuṣmai mānasaṃ tanugataṃ ca samastam || 27|| saṃvilokya purubhaktisevikāḥ kāścideṣa parameśvarottamaḥ | no nayatviti parākṣaraṃ nijaṃ hāritāḥ samavakalpayam̐stadā ||28|| rādhikākamalagāramāsatīmāṇikīprabhṛtayo divāniśam | yaṃ bhajanti bahudhā tu padmajābrāhmaśaktaya imā hi gaurikāḥ ||29||| taṃ bhajāma idamādhisaṃyutaṃ saṃvihāya tu calaṃ kalevaram | śāśvataṃ bhavati cātra vai sukhaṃ nvālayo’sya kuruta prapūjanam ||2.200.3 0 || atra śītabhavane samudrage’nugraheṇa bhagavān samāgataḥ | karmaṇā ca manasā ca kīrtanaiḥ sevayā kuruta naijamīśvaram ||3 1 || kīdṛśo nu paridhiḥ samantataścānanasya bhavatīha taijasaḥ | koṭicandraparikāntisaṃsravadvigraho’syahṛdayaṃgamo’sti yat||32|| naikamuktajanasevitapādaḥ koṭidāsaparimarditagātraḥ | prāpyate nu bahupuṇyadhanāḍhyairnāyamāpta iti vismaraṇīyaḥ ||33|| mānavāśca janatā ita ādye nedṛśaṃ hṛdi ca kāmitavantaḥ | tādṛśo’yamiha cāpta umeśastaṃ śrayanvatisukhaṃ parameśam ||34|| mā tyajantu militaṃ sulabhaṃ ca kāntakāntamurusadguṇabhājam | vardhayantu hadayaiḥ kusumaiśca pūjayantu nijasarvasudānaiḥ ||35|| ityevaṃ rādhike svāmibālakṛṣṇaṃ vilokya tāḥ | hāritāḥ pramadāḥ sarvā ūcuḥ papuḥ prabhuṃ sukhaiḥ ||36|| rājā gopurake ghaṇṭāpathe prādhānikāstathā | haṭṭeṣu haṭṭapāścāpi rathyāmukheṣu yoṣitaḥ ||37|| vallabhīṣu kanyakāśca janatāḥ pārśvabhūstaṭe | catvareṣu prajāḥ sarvāḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ||38|| lājābhiḥ satphalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kuṃkumairakṣatairapi | vastraiścandanapaṃkādyairgandhairānarcuracyutam ||39|| sāmudraratnahārām̐śca dadau te parameṣṭhine | aparānāvikāpuryāṃ bhrāmayitvā prajājanāḥ ||2.200.40|| pūjayitvā gṛhe nītvā sve sve kṛtārthatāmaguḥ | haristato nijāvāse dinamānārkamandire ||41|| āyayau hāritarṣiśca natvāha parameśvaram | bhojanāni sumṛṣṭāni vidyante bhuṃkṣva tāni vai ||42|| bhojayānyān harekṛṣṇa pāyasādīn pratarpaya | tato vimānamāruhya garimākṣmāṃ vilokitum ||43 || gantavyaṃ dṛṣṭimātreṇa pāvayituṃ samantataḥ | ityukto bhagavān śīghraṃ jagrāsa pāyasādikam ||44|| mahīmānān samastām̐śca bhojayāmāsa vai drutam | sarvān rājālaye tyaktvā śaṃkareṇa nṛpeṇa ca ||45|| ṛṣiṇā ca samaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ parimeyapuraḥsaraḥ | vimānaṃ svaṃ samāruhyāmbare jagāma cottare ||46|| vāśṛṃgatanubhūbhāgaṃ vilokyāpi parīsthalam | phudriktaṃ vilayaṃ deśaṃ kāñcanaṃ cārṣukaṃ sthalam ||47|| hāyanaṃ ca sthalaṃ vīkṣya hyaparānāvikāṃ yayau | evaṃ vilokya bhagavānavātatāra cāmbarāt ||48|| rājasaudhe viśaśrāma rājñī pūjārthamāyayau | pūjayitvā hariṃ tasyāḥ kanyādvayaṃ hariṃ tadā ||49|| apūjayat sukhāsakte kanyake sthiranetrike | hariṃ dṛṣṭvā cakamāte vavrāte’rpitamālayā ||2.200.50 || pāṇī jagrāha bhagavān pratyarpitasumālayā | tadutsavaṃ nṛpaścakre rātrau bhojanataḥ param ||51 || gaṇeśaṃ pūjayāmāsa dūrvālaḍḍūkakuṃkumaiḥ | nṛtyaṃ tvakārayad rājā vādyānyavādayattathā ||52|| sindūraiścārcayāmāsa gaṇeśavigrahe śubhe | agāpayacca padyāni kīrtanāni tadutsave ||53||| hārite kanyake kṛṣṇaṃ siṣevāte savottaram | niśā gatā prabhāte’tha kṛtasnānasupūjanaḥ ||54||| bālakṛṣṇo’bhavat sajjo dugdhapānottaraṃ tadā | gantuṃ kenāṭakadeśānamarīṇāṃ pradeśakān ||55|| pañcamyāṃ saṃgave kāle bhādre śukle’tiśobhane | rājā vidāyaṃ pradadau bahuratnādikaṃ tadā ||56|| harirhāritamunaye’rpayāmāsa dhanādi tat | rājā sainyena sahito mānaṃ tatra dadau bahu ||57|| jayaśabdā yaśaḥśabdā gītayaścābhavam̐stadā | gaurībhirhāritābhiśca kṛtā mādhuryasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||58|| harirhāraṃ dadau rājñe rājñyai putrebhya ityapi | prajānatiṃ samāgṛhya samāruroha śobhanam ||59|| āsanaṃ cānyavargāścāruruhuścāsanāni hi | upādideśa rājānaṃ prajājanāśca saddhitam ||2.200.60|| uṣṭraḥ purā tapaścakre prajāpatiḥ samāyayau | varadānaṃ tadā vavre grīvāstu yojanāyatā ||6 1 || brahmā tathāstvitiprāhāraṇye tūṣṭraḥ sadā sthitaḥ | mahālaso niṣadyaikasthale cakhāda pādapān ||62|| parito yojanāvarte rātrau svapiti saukhyabhāk | madhye śṛgālaḥ samprāpto vavalge tadgale dṛḍham ||63|| mamāroṣṭro madhyakaṇṭhe bhedanāllambakaṇṭhavān | tathā loke lambatṛṣṇo mriyeta māyayā hataḥ ||64|| tasmāt tṛṣṇāṃ na kurvīta kurvīta bhajanaṃ hareḥ | mamāśrayaṃ prakurvīta tāraye’haṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||65|| siṃhasyāsītpradhāno vai haṃsaḥ kaścid vanāntare | daridro brāhmaṇo nāmnā sattvavṛttiryayau vanam ||66|| haṃsastaṃ milito mārge papraccha kutra gamyate | sa prāha dhanalābhārthaṃ yāmi deśāntaraṃ nvitaḥ ||67|| haṃsaḥ prāha bhavān vipro mama pūjyo’sti cānagha | dāsye ratnāni te tvatra siṃhārjitāni hastitaḥ ||68|| mārayitvā gajān kuṃbhasthalamauktikajātikān | ityuktvā saha nītvainaṃ vipraṃ haṃso hyaraṇyake ||69|| yayau yatrāsti siṃhaḥ saḥ siṃhaṃ prāha sa haṃsakaḥ | atithirbrāhmaṇaścāyaṃ pūjanīyaḥ samāgataḥ ||2.200.70|| hiṃsājanyaṃ mahatpāpaṃ naśyedasmai pradānataḥ | ityuktaḥ śārdūlavaryaḥ prakṣālya caraṇau tataḥ ||71 || viprapādāmṛtaṃ pītvā pupūja ratnadānakaiḥ | vipro gṛhaṃ prayātyeva haṃsastadāha taṃ dvijam ||72|| āyāhi mā punastvatra mām ṛte duḥkhamudbhavet | ityuktvā prayayau haṃsastataḥ kālāntare dvijaḥ ||73|| punarlobhena saṃprāptastadvanaṃ saṃsmaran harim | haṃso mantrī tadā nābhūt kāko mantrī tadā hyabhūt ||74|| dvijaṃ pravīkṣya kākastu siṃhaṃ prāha prakhādaya | siṃhaḥ prāha na caivaṃ syād vipro’yaṃ pāvanaḥ sadā ||75|| pādavāri papau dhūlīṃ mastake sa nyadhāttadā | kākaḥ prāha pavitraṃ vai pādavāri tu yasya hi ||76|| sa tu pūrṇaḥ pavitro’sti bhakṣitavyaḥ sa sarvaśaḥ | tena pūtā vayaṃ syāmaḥ pāpaṃ naśyettathāntaram ||77|| ityuktaḥ siṃharājastu bhakṣayāmāsa taṃ dvijam | tasmāllobhaṃ na kurvīta mṛtyurlobhagṛhe sthitaḥ ||78|| lobhaṃ yaktvā hariṃ smṛtvā santoṣeṇa hi vartayet | sukhī sa syādatra loke dhāmni paratra me sukhī ||79|| santuṣṭasya paraṃ dhāma niścitaṃ bhaktisañjuṣaḥ | ekadā sāgaraḥ prāha saritaḥ kimu śākhinaḥ ||2.200.80|| āyāntyeva jalohyā vai nāyānti vaitasāni tu | nadyaḥ prāhurdrumāścaite kūlasthā api sarvadā ||81|| asmadabhyudaye cāpi na namanti kadācana | tān vayaṃ mūlato hṛtvā nayāmaḥ sāgarodare ||82|| vaitasīnālikāḥ pūre patitāstu namantyapi | vigate pūravege tu śanairyānti samutthitim ||83|| na tān vayaṃ nayāmo vai namato nālapatrakān | ye namanti janāḥ kāle mahāntaṃ veginaṃ tu te ||84|| nāpnuvanti mūlanāśaṃ sthitimanto bhavanti te | evaṃ kālaṃ tathā māyāṃ vegakāle namanti ye ||85|| śanairutthānamāsādya jīvanti dehinastviha | te na duḥkhaṃ prapaśyanti tadvad vṛtyaṃ janairiha ||86|| māmāśritya śanairmāyāṃ tyaktvā gantavyameva me | dhāma divyaṃ sukhāvāsaṃ susthirāśrayameva ha ||87|| deśakālau vicāryaiva vartitavyaṃ sukhārthinā | ahaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī bhajanīyaḥ sadā prabhuḥ ||88|| tārayāmi na sandeho bhajantaṃ māṃ padāgatam | mūrkhaḥ kroḍo’bhavatpṛṣṭhe śṛgālaṃ dhartumeva ha ||89|| adhāvad bahuvegena śṛgālo’vasare tadā | kūpamutplutya cākrāmat paratīraṃ gato’bhavat ||2.200.90|| kroḍaḥ sthūlavapurdhāvan vegataḥ kūpago’bhavat | apatajjalamadhye ca mamārājñānasaṃhataḥ ||9 1 || tasmānnaiva kvacidbhāvyaṃ vegena karmaṇā janaiḥ | śanaistareddhi saṃsāraṃ madāśrayeṇa mānavaḥ || 92|| śṛgālābhaṃ lobhavegaṃ nāśrayenmānavastviha | doṣātmakaṃ mahādhūrtaṃ pātayantaṃ tu gartake ||93|| kāmaṃ krodhaṃ madaṃ lobhaṃ mānaṃ tyaktvā sukhī bhavet | māmīśaṃ sādhupuruṣaṃ sādhvīṃ śritvā sukhī bhavet ||94|| evamuktvā dadau mantraṃ hariḥ rājñe kuṭumbine | prajābhyaśca dadau mantraṃ lomaśastu nideśitaḥ ||95|| hāritābhyaḥ prajābhyaśca mantraṃ dadau maheśvaraḥ | tato jalaṃ prapītvaiva bhagavān cāmbare’bhavat ||96|| gajādibhiḥ puṣpahāraiḥ pūjitaḥ parameśvaraḥ | āśīrvādān muhurdatvā nijaṃ vimānamāsthitaḥ ||97|| anye sarve’bhavan vyomni vimāneṣu sthitāstadā | vādyānyatīva vegenāvādyanta mānanāya vai ||98|| jayaśabdā yaśaḥśabdā yantrāṇāṃ dhvanayastathā | abhavam̐statra deśe vai hariḥ śīghraṃ vimānakam ||99|| prairayad vyomamārgeṇa kenāṭakabhuvaṃ prati | samullaṃghya samudraṃ vai kenāṭakapradeśakān || 2.200.10 0|| āyayuśca vimānāni madhyāhne vegavanti vai | deśān jale vikīrṇāṃśca dṛṣṭvāvicārayaddharim || 101 || yajñasthānaṃ prathamaṃ vai gantavyaṃ yatra vartate | lālāyano maharṣiśca tato’nyatkāryameva ha || 1 02|| atha lālāyanaścāpi smṛtvā vimānamaṇḍalam | tūrṇaṃ svāgatanādām̐śca rājasainyairakārayat || 103 || hariścāpi dviphenābdhiṃ dviphenadvīpameva ca | haḍḍikāsanamullaṃghya vinipārasaro yayau || 1 04|| yatra vādyāni vādyante svāgatārthaṃ harestadā | asaṃkhyamānavā yatra pratīkṣante pareśvaram || 1 05|| rādhike harṣanādāścābhavan digantagāminaḥ | dūradarśādibhirlokā vyapaśyannambare tadā || 106 || tūpaśabdāḥ karkaśāśca vāyukampanakāriṇaḥ | tūryasaṃgītaghoṣāścābhavan sammānane hareḥ || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne dinamānārkanṛpasya garimākhaṇḍe hareraparānāvikāpuryāmavataraṇaṃ bhrāmaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ viśramaṇaṃ samantato deśe vimānena gamanaṃ rātrau viśrāntyuttaraṃ prātarbhojanaṃ prasthānaṃ kenāṭakapradeśeṣu vinipārasarovaraṃ pratyāgamanaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā dviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 200 ||
<2.201> śrīrādhikovāca kānta kānta kṛpāsindho rādhāpate ramāpate | amarīṇāṃ pradeśeṣu kiṃ kiṃ cakāra mādhavaḥ || 1 || kva kva kutra yayau tasthau kaiḥ kaiḥ saṃsevito hareḥ | camatkārāśca ke tatra darśitāḥ paramātmanā || 2 || prajābhiḥ kiṃ kṛtaṃ tatra prāpte pareśvare prabhau | kām̐skān deśān jagāmāyaṃ bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ || 3 || vadāmarīpradeśānāṃ bhagavaccaritāni me | yāni yānyabhavam̐statra brahmapriyāniṣevituḥ || 4 || bahutṛptā bhavāmyasya bhūtvā nāthasya satkathāḥ | punastṛṣā bhavatyeva śrotuṃ taccaritāni me || 5 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike yāvaccaritrāṇi vadāmi te | yajñaḥ pūjā svāgatādi samarpaṇaṃ nideśanam || 6 || bhramaṇaṃ mantradānaṃ ca divyadarśanakāni ca | mokṣaṇaṃ dehināṃ tīrthīkaraṇaṃ saritāṃ tathā || 7 || sarasāṃ sāgarāṇāṃ ca pāvanīkaraṇaṃ śubham | kathayāmi samāsena camatkāramayāni te || 8 || yajñaṃ cakāra bhagavān vinipārasarastaṭe | śeṣakāṣṭhavanāsaṃge viśāle bhūtale śubhe || 9 || vaiṣṇavaṃ sarvadevānāṃ tṛptidaṃ prāṇināmiha | sṛṣṭitrayasthadehyādyā jaḍāśca cetanāstathā || 2.201.1 0|| bālakṛṣṇasya hastābhyāṃ tṛptiṃ te śāśvatīṃ yayuḥ | kenāṭakapradeśānāṃ khaṇḍānāṃ sārvabhaumakaḥ || 11 || rājā paṃcasarasāṃ vai rāyakinnaranāmakaḥ | divimānāyanarṣiśca sāhāyyaṃ cakratuḥ kratau || 1 2|| vaiṣṇavau paramau tau dvau lālāyanasya saṃgamāt | tuṣitasya pratāpena bhaktottamau babhūvatuḥ || 13 || lālāyanasya śiṣyo vai rājā ṛṣernideśataḥ | maṃgalapatrikāḥ sampreṣayāmāsa makhārthinīḥ || 14|| lālāyanasya yogena cāmarīṇāṃ pradeśakāḥ | vaiṣṇavībhiḥ prajābhiśca vāsitāḥ santi dharmiṇaḥ || 15|| khaṇḍe khaṇḍe ca rājāno bhavantaśca prajājanāḥ | vaiṣṇavatvaṃ copagatā ahobhāgyāni tāni naḥ || 16|| yo vai nārāyaṇānāṃ śrīnārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ | yadbhaktāśca vayaṃ smo’tra sa śrīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 17|| mama rājye samāgatya yajñaṃ vai vaiṣṇavaṃ śubham | kariṣyatīti sarvairāgantavyaṃ tanmakhotsave || 18|| bhādraśuklasya saptamyāṃ kratvāraṃbho bhaviṣyati | pañcamyāṃ paramātmā sa vimānādāgamiṣyati || 1 9|| khaṇḍagaiḥ rājabhiścātra saṃhitavyaṃ purā dine | svāgatārthaṃ hareḥ sarvaiḥ prajājanaiśca sāttvataiḥ || 2.201.20 || sainyaśobhāsusahitaiḥ kartavyaṃ harimānanam | ekādaśyāṃ samāptiśca kratorasya bhaviṣyati ||21 || lālāyanājñayā rāyakinnaro’haṃ likhāmi ca | uktairanuktaiḥ sarvairāgantavyaṃ strīnarairiha ||22|| ityevaṃ cāmarīṇāṃ vai pradeśeṣu supatrikāḥ | preṣayāmāsa dūtaiḥ sa rāyakinnarabhūpatiḥ ||23|| prāpyāmantraṇapatrāṇi tvāyayustvaritaṃ janāḥ | utsukā naranāryādyā darśanārthaṃ kuṭumbinaḥ || 24|| vimānairvāhanairyānairājagmuścopadāyutāḥ | svarṇarūpyakadhānyādyai ratnahīrakasadrasaiḥ ||25|| yajñīyavastubhiryogyairdeyaiḥ saha samāyayuḥ | koṭiśo mānavāḥ śeṣakāṣṭhāvanānadītaṭe ||26||| vinipārasaroyoge rājāno’pi tadābhavan | sainyāni bahuraṃgāni samāyātāni bhūbhṛtām || 27|| svāgatārthaṃ hareścāsannupasthitāḥ suveṣiṇaḥ | vādyayuktā dhvajāpatākikāvāvaṭaśobhitāḥ || 28|| hetihastā gajavāhā aśvavāhoṣṭravāhinaḥ | daśayojanavistāre klṛptanūtanapattane || 29|| sammardo’bhūttadā śeṣakāṣṭhavanānadītaṭe | sarastīre’nuśayināṃ koṭyabjanarayoṣitām ||2.201.3 0|| svargavadbhrājate yajñapattanaṃ nūtanaṃ tadā | pattanaṃ taddharikṛṣṇo’lokayattvambarānmuhuḥ ||3 1 || maṇḍapārthaṃ samālokya bhūmiṃ sarasorāntare | divimānāyanarṣyuktadiśāṃ vīkṣya samasthalīm ||32|| cakraṃ vidhāya sarvordhve’vātārayadvimānakam | vāditraninadāścāsannamarīṇāṃ ca gītikāḥ ||3 3| | jayadhvānāḥ prajānāṃ ca tadāsan vyomayoginaḥ | tūpaśabdā yantraravā mānane tvabhavan hareḥ |||34|| śreṣṭhā daśa nṛpastatra sārvabhaumā hyupasthitāḥ | gṛhītvā copadāḥ svarṇapātreṣu sapradhānakāḥ | |35|| rāyakinnaranṛpatiḥ rāyarokīśvaro nṛpaḥ | rāyaraṇajidbhūpaśca rāyavākakṣako nṛpaḥ ||36| | rāyamārīśabhūpaśca rāyabāleśvaro nṛpaḥ | rāyalambārabhūpaśca rāyanavārkabhūpatiḥ || 37|| rāyahaṇḍeśabhūpaśca rāyakūpeśabhūpatiḥ | ete sainyaiḥ suyuktāśca svāgatārthaṃ harestadā ||38|| vimānaistatra cāgatya prāgeva samupasthitāḥ | hastyaśvarathavāhādyaiḥ śṛṃgāritasuvigrahaiḥ | sainyaṃ svāgatakāryārthaṃ tadābhūttu vyavasthitam ||39|| vādakā nītikartāraścāgnirañjanaveṣiṇaḥ | jalavādyavidhartāro nṛtyavādyapraśabdinaḥ ||2.201.40 || galavādyaprabhāvajñā mayūravaṃśivādyakāḥ | tāravādyātikuśalāḥ paṭahadhvānakāriṇaḥ ||41 || sahaśārīraceṣṭākāḥ saśastrā namanārthinaḥ | vetradharā gaṇaveṣā vyāghraveṣāśca bhāllukāḥ ||42|| piṃgaveṣāḥ parīveṣā avadhūtasvarūpiṇaḥ | śūlacakradharāścāpi carmakhaḍgadharāstathā ||73 || tāṃsakaiḥ karatālaiśca vigulairlakṣitā api | śaṃkhino vajriṇaścāpi sukanyāveṣiṇastathā ||44|| jaṭāveṣadharāścāpi yoddhṛveṣātiśobhanāḥ | arjunāmbarayuktāśca raktāmbarāḥ pracitriṇaḥ ||45|| suchatrairvyajanaiścāpi cāmarairgucchakaistathā | vardhayitvā darpaṇaiśca svāgatārthaṃ hyupasthitāḥ ||46|| amaryo yoṣitastatra pāṇḍurābhāḥ suyauvanāḥ | kanyakā raktakādharāḥ pūravegātisaṃbhṛtāḥ ||47|| nīlapītaharidvarṇaveṣāḥ svarṇavibhūṣaṇāḥ | kiṃkiṇījālamālādyairambarairatiśobhitāḥ ||48|| dhṛtasthālā harerarcanārthaṃ lājākṣatānvitāḥ | kalhārapadmakumudaiḥ kādambapārijātakaiḥ ||49|| kundasāhasrapatraiśca sthalapadmaiḥ sukesaraiḥ | cāmpakaiḥ kāmalairhāraiḥ śekharaiḥ sragbhiranvitāḥ ||2.201.50|| kuṃkumavāṭikāyuktāḥ pūjārhacandanānvitāḥ | amaryastatra cāyātā lakṣaśo divyayoṣitaḥ ||51|| sahasraśo rājayoṣā asaṃkhyātāḥ prajāstriyaḥ | kenāṭakāḥ sarvadeśā maṃgalāmantraṇaistadā ||5 2 || samrājo mandire rāyakinnarasya makhottame | āyāsyato bālakṛṣṇaharerdarśanalabdhaye ||53 || ābālavṛddhā manujāḥ koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyakāḥ | āyayuste svāgatārtha hareḥ samupatasthire ||54|| śeṣakāṣṭhavanānadyā vinipārasarovare | saṃgamasyātidīrgha bhūtale samupatasthire ||55|| āgantukānāṃ vāsārhaṃ nagaraṃ bahuyojanam | makhasevābhidhaṃ vyadyotata svargamivāparam ||56|| maṇisevānagaryāḥ sannidhau pūrvaṃ sarovarāt | rājadarśitamārgeṇa bhagavān kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ||57|| vimānaṃ sūryasadṛśaṃ cāvātārayadambarāt | dyotayattu diśaḥ sarvāḥ svarṇavarṇamaśobhata |||58|| bhūmau sthairya samavāpya candratulyaṃ vyadṛśyata | anyānyapi vimānāni cāvaterustato’mbarāt ||59|| ākṛtigrāhakayantraiḥ kuśalā jagṛhuḥ kṛtim | rājānastaṃ tvekasūtre tiṣṭhantaścakrurānatim ||2.201.6 0|| sainyāni nemire dehairvādyairnṛtyakalādibhiḥ | samrājā sahitāḥ sarve nṛpāstannikaṭaṃ yayuḥ ||6 1 || īśāno lomaśaścobhau vimānāgraṃ prajagmatuḥ | vṛkāyano nīlakarṇaścobhau paścāt samāgatau ||62|| dvārapālāḥ pārṣadāścāṃgaṇe tasthuḥ savetrakāḥ | niḥśreṇī samadhiprāpya rājānastasthurīkṣakāḥ ||6 3 || tāvaddharirbālakṛṣṇaḥ pitṛbhyāṃ sahito bahiḥ | vimāne tvāyayau cāgre subhāsvare tu gopure ||64|| koṭikoṭyarkacandrāgnividyudbhāsvaravigrahaḥ | toraṇādhaḥsthitaṃ cañcadvidyudābhāṃ tu vallabhīm ||65 || kareṇa ca manāk spṛṣṭvā mandahāsyaṃ manoharam | śrīkṛṣṇaṃ taṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ rāyakinnarabhūpatiḥ ||6 6 || praṇamya gandhavipulāṃ mālatīpuṣpamālikām | citraraṃgāṃ dadau kaṇṭhe ratnahāraṃ dadau tataḥ ||67|| gucchaṃ pauṣpaṃ dadau haste candanārka tu bhālake | dadau sugandhasārāṇi pātreṇa sandhṛtāmbare ||68|| pādayoścākṣatān svarṇamayān mūrdhni sutandulān | puṣpāṇi vigrahe rājā cikṣepārhaṇakarmaṇā ||69|| jalaṃ dugdhaṃ dadau tāmbūlakaṃ phalaṃ ca sannidhau | kṛtāñjaliḥ prārthayacca makhārthakṣmāṃ vilokitum ||2.201.70|| hariḥ śanaiḥ svarṇasopānakairavātatāra ha | tato dattāsane saiṃhe kṣaṇaṃ vā niṣasāda ha ||71|| rāyarokīśvaraḥ puṣpahārai ratnairapūjayat | rāyaraṇajidbhūpaśca maṇyādyaistamapūjayat ||72|| rāyavākakṣako rājā svarṇādyaistamapūjayat | rāyamārīśabhūpo’pi ratnādyaistamapūjayat ||73 || rāyabāleśvaro rājā hīrakaistamapūjayat | rāyalambārabhūpaśca dhanādyaistamapūjayat ||74|| rāyanavārkabhūpaśca māṇikyaistamapūjayat | rāyahaṇḍeśabhūpaśca muktābhistamapūjayat ||75|| rāyakūpeśabhūpaśca rājataistamapūjayat | atha pradhānāḥ sarve’pi pupūjurbhūṣaṇādibhiḥ ||76 || śreṣṭhino’pi prabhumānarcuśca dhanānnasadrasaiḥ | havyakavyādibhiścāpi samidbhirbahuvastubhiḥ ||77|| pupūjuśca prajāvargāḥ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam | pūjāsvāgatamātaḥ śrīhariḥ papraccha tām̐stadā ||78|| anāmayaṃ sukuśalaṃ kṣemaṃ yogaṃ sukhādikam | rājādyāḥ sampraṇamyaiva prāhuste kṛpayā sukham ||79 || sarvavidhaṃ vidyate’tra dine’dya tu mahatsukham | svarṇasūryodayastvadya jāto naste kṛpā yataḥ ||2.201.80 || prāpto’dya śāśvato lābho yadbhavaddarśanaṃ tviha | siddhāścādya caturvagāścatvāraśca pumarthakāḥ ||8 1 || rājyabhāraphalaṃ tvadya labdhaṃ labdhavyalābhataḥ | śrīḥ sarvā cendrapadavīpradātrī no gṛhe’dya vai ||82|| puṇyaṃ tvakṣayamadyaivāsādita tava darśanāt | pāvanā no’dya deśā vai bhavadāgamanāt prabho ||83 || sampadaḥ sārthakāstvadya bhavatā viniyojitāḥ | satkārye saphalāḥ sarvā lakṣmambo’pi vividhā dhruvāḥ ||84|| mānavāḥ kṛtakṛtyāśca vaya mādhavadarśanāt | narā nāryo bālabālā vṛddhāḥ puṇyatamā nanu ||89 || paśavo vṛkṣavallyādyā bahupuṇyā dine’dya vai | pakṣiṇo jalagāścāpi bhūmigā vanino’pi ca ||86 || yadatra bhavatāṃ pādau spṛśato bhūtalādikam | bhūriyaṃ bahubhāgyā ca dhāmatulyā hi modate ||87|| jātādya pulakāḍhyā sā gandhadānairviśeṣataḥ | kṣā drrumāstṛgastambā dhanyabhāgyā dine’dya vai ||88 || yadatra bhavatāṃ pādarajaḥpūtā bhavanti te | dhanyāḥ pipīlikādyāśca bhavatprasādabhāginaḥ ||89|| dhanyā janapadāstvete yatra nārāyaṇāgamaḥ | prākaṭyaṃ mokṣadaṃ tvadya prāvartata harestava ||2.201.90 || dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ rājyamṛddhiḥ putrāḥ puro gajādayaḥ | yānavāhanasamṛddhiḥ sarvaṃ saphalameva yat ||9 1 || tavāgamena bhagavan kiṃ kiṃ nyūnaṃ bhavennanu | sarvaṃ naḥ pūrṇamevāsti harerlābho hi durlabhaḥ || 92|| yajñaṃ kṛtvā pāvayāsmān kalyāṇaṃ kuru śāśvatam | sadā deśe’tra vasatiṃ tavecchāmo’nugāstava ||93 || ityuktvā tu namaskāraṃ cakre rājā tu kinnaṭaḥ | anye nṛpāḥ praṇemuśca tato vai bhagavān svayam ||94|| samutthāya kṣitiṃ yogyāṃ draṣṭuṃ cacāra cābhitaḥ | śeṣakāṣṭhavanānadyāḥ saṃgamād dakṣiṇe sthale ||95|| bahuyojanavistāre maṇḍapārhāṃ kṣitiṃ śubhām | vīkṣya cājñāpayāmāsa rājānaṃ maṇḍapāya vai ||96|| rājadūtā viṣṇudūtāḥ śivadūtāstathāpare | smṛtāstatrāyayuḥ śīghraṃ viśvakarmā samāyayau ||97|| tānājñāpya navakuṇḍān kartuṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ca maṇḍapam | āprātaḥ sarvamevaitad yathā syāt samupasthitam ||98|| harirnivāsasaudhaṃ ca yayau madhyāhnake tataḥ | bhojanādi cakārātha viśaśrāma sasārthakaḥ ||99|| sarve te maṇḍapaṃ cakruḥ rātrāveva suśobhanam | kuṇḍavedīmahāvedīśobhitaṃ kalaśagṛhaiḥ || 2.201.100 || vastugṛhairvahniśālābhiśca yuktaṃ manoharam | maṇisevānagaryantaṃ maṇḍapaṃ saṃvidhāya ca || 10 1|| pārṣadā yajñasamidhaścāhartuṃ parito gatāḥ | ṛṣayaḥ sarvagāṃgeyāstathā lomaśaśiṣyakāḥ || 102|| yajñasaṃbhārakān cakrurdevā devyaśca tanmayāḥ | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛṣṇo mahīmānapurīṃ navām || 10 3|| vīkṣituṃ prayayau hastipṛṣṭhāsano nṛpairyutaḥ | pākaśālā rasaśālāḥ snānaśālā mahāyatāḥ || 1 04|| svāpaśālāḥ śāntiśālā havyaśālā vyalokayat | rājabhiḥ pūritāḥ pātraśālā mahānasāni ca 105|| vyalokayatsusāmagrīsaṃbhṛtāḥ sarvasaṃvidhāḥ | hariḥ sasmāra vai prātardevendraṃ cāmṛtānvitam || 1 06|| śīghraṃ samāyayau tatra mahendro’mṛtasaṃyutaḥ | amṛtasya hradastatra parito’kṣayatṛptikṛt || 1 07|| smṛtāḥ kalpalatāstatra tvāyayuḥ phalasaṃyutāḥ | phalānāṃ parvatāstābhiḥ kṛtā yajñārthameva ha || 1 08|| smṛtāḥ puṣpakaṇadāśca vṛkṣasasyadrumādayaḥ | kalpavṛkṣāḥ kaṇapuṣpādīnāṃ vai parvatān vyadhuḥ || 10 9|| āgatāḥ kāmadugdhadhrāḥ smṛtā vai nijadhāmataḥ | ghṛtakulyā dadhikulyāḥ payaḥkulyāśca dhenubhiḥ || 2.201.11 0|| saṃbhṛtā havyaśālāsu tvakṣayā dravyapūritāḥ | annapūrṇā satī devī śivā lakṣmīstadā smṛtā || 111 || āgatāstāḥ parvatām̐śca cakruḥ pakvānnakalpitān | pṛthvī mūrtā samāgatya miṣṭaṃ śarkaraparvatam || 11 2|| vyadhāddharervacanāt sā jaladevo rasān vyadhāt | oṣadhayaḥ samastāśca veṣavārādikān vyūdhuḥ || 11 3|| brahmā svayaṃ smṛtastatra samāyātaścaturmukhaḥ | nirmame yogyasaṃvāsām̐stathopakaraṇāni ca || 1 14|| kubero dakṣiṇārthaṃ ca svarṇarūpyādikaṃ nyadhāt | evamanye rāṣṭrapālā lokapālāḥ prajeśvarāḥ || 1 15|| saṃsmṛtāstvāyayuḥ śīghraṃ pūrtaye havyakavyayoḥ | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ madhyāhnake jāte sarvaṃ sampūrṇamūrjitam || 1 16|| susampannaṃ samabhūcca nyūnaṃ kiñcinna vidyate | koṭiśo mānavān rājā kinnaro miṣṭabhojanaiḥ || 1 17|| tarpayāmāsa bahudhā samastām̐stānprajājanān | hariḥ kuṭumbasahito maharṣimaṇḍalānvitaḥ || 1 18|| nijasārthayutastatra jagrāha bhojanāni vai | tato rājārthayat kṛṣṇaṃ rāyakinnarabhūpatiḥ || 1 19|| rādhike svālaye kṛṣṇaṃ tvāgantuṃ sainyasatkṛtam | nagare bhramituṃ cāpi kṛṣṇa omāha tatkṣaṇam || 2.201.120 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kenāṭakeṣu kratormaṃgalapatrikāpreṣaṇam | samāgataharerdaśabhūpādikṛtaṃ svāgatam, kuśalapraśnādikam, maṇḍapādinirmāṇājñā, bhojanādikaṃ kratupakaraṇasaṃcayādītyādinirūpaṇanāmaikādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 201 ||
<2.202> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike rāyakinnāraḥ śīghraṃ sainyamasajjayat | hastyaśvarathasaṃśobhadvādyamānavavāhanam || 1 || śvetahastī caturdantaḥ parvataśṛṃgakocchrayaḥ | sāmbāliko’ticitrāḍhyaḥ svarṇakūthasuśobhitaḥ || 2 || rājājñayā harerarthe hastipakena noditaḥ | āyayau śīghramevāgre cāruroha gajaṃ hariḥ || 3 || anye gajāstathordhvā vai ṣaṭ tatraivopatasthire | pitarau bhrātaraścāpi svasā bhrātṛpriyā hyapi || 4 || āruruhurgajān tām̐śca lomaśastuṣitastathā | lālāyanastathā ceśānaḥ svayaṃ gajamuttamam || 5 || āruruhurnarayāneṣvapi brahmapriyāḥ striyaḥ | sāvaraṇeṣu yāneṣu raṃginyo navayauvanāḥ || 6 || kanyakā gaurikāścāpi piśaṃgyo hāritāstathā | ratheṣvapi ca gāṃgeyā maharṣayastathāpare || 7 || niṣeduḥ sukhasampannā bhramituṃ maṇipattanam | mahīmāneṣu sarveṣu tūpaviṣṭeṣu tattathā || 8 || vāhṛneṣu tato lokajanānāṃ sainyakāni hi | agre vādyasuyuktāni dhvajāpatākikādibhiḥ || 9 || celurgāyanta evādyanārāyaṇamahadyaśaḥ | tato hastī mahān yātīśānadevasya śobhanaḥ || 2.202.10 || kuṭumbināṃ gajāḥ paścāttato maharṣivāraṇāḥ | brahmapriyādīnāṃ narayānāni yānti hi || 11 || rathāḥ prayānti śobhāḍhyāḥ sauvarṇakalaśānvitāḥ | citrapaṭṭāvṛtāścāpi śubhāḥ śvetāśvavāhitāḥ || 12|| tato hastī mahān yāti śrīpatikṛṣṇaśobhitaḥ | rājā kinnārako yatra chatraṃ dadhāra pṛṣṭhake || 13 || pārśve kumārakau dhṛtvā cāmarau samatiṣṭhataḥ | tato rājñāṃ vāhanāni niryayuḥ śobhanāni vai || 14|| amaryaḥ kanyakāḥ paścādgītanārāyaṇābhidhāḥ | kṛtakautukaveṣāśca śṛṃgārabhāvamaṃgalāḥ || 15 || mauktikāsanakalaśāḥ saphalāḥ śubhapallavāḥ | sarvaśobhāmbarabhūṣā yānti gāyantya aiśvaram || 16|| kīrtanaṃ kāṃbhareyasya śrīpateḥ kamalāpateḥ | narayāneṣu tanmadhye rādhā lakṣmīḥ prabhā satī || 17|| pārvatī māṇikī haṃsā maṃjulā saguṇāmbikā | santoṣā cāmṛtā muktirdevī ca lalitā jayā || 18|| etā anyāśca rājante bhūṣitāścāparāḥ striyaḥ | prayānti rājamārge’nyā aśvavārāśca rakṣakāḥ || 1 9|| rājājñākṛjjanādiṣṭamahāmārgeṇa saṃcaran | śrīhariḥ śobhate’rkadyutistadā janatārcitaḥ ||2.202.20 || evaṃ sainyaṃ cacālaitan maṇipuryāṃ harestadā | prathamaṃ rājaśobhāḍhyaṃ yayau tadrājamandiram || 21 || rājyāsane’tisauvarṇe maṇiratnasamujjvale | rājā vāhādavatīrya hariṃ nyaṣādayannaraḥ ||22|| jayaśabdāścābhavam̐śca puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūttathā | pradhānādyaiḥ kumārādyai rājñībhiśca kṛtottamā ||23|| rājñī mukhyā satī devī pupūja parameśvaram | tilakaṃ kukumenāpi candanenākṣataistathā ||24|| akarocchrīharerbhāle duḥkhahāñjalimācarat | puṣpairvikīrya kṛṣṇasya mastake namanaṃ vyadhāt ||25|| pādau prakṣālya dugdhena sthālyāṃ dugdhaṃ samānayat | papau prāsādikaṃ śīghraṃ rājakuṭumbameva tat ||26|| vāriṇā caraṇau paścātprakṣālya paramātmanaḥ | sannidhau hārabhūṣādirdravyaṃ koṭimitaṃ nyadhāt ||27|| yajñe’rpitaṃ mayā kṛṣṇa nṛpājñayā tavāsti tat| | ityuktvā pārśvamāgatya sthirekṣaṇā dadarśa tam ||28|| rādhike ca tadā rājā nanāma haripādayoḥ | kuṭumbaṃ maṇiratnādi pradadau pūjane tadā ||29|| bālakṛṣṇo dadau tebhyastadā netre sudivyake | pararūpagrāhiṇī ca tato naijaṃ tvalaukikam ||2.202.30 || darśanaṃ pradadau kṛṣṇaḥ sudivyaṃ sumanoharam | rūpānurūpāvayavaṃ koṭimanmathasundaram ||31|| koṭimuktaiḥ koṭiśaktibhiśca saṃsevitaṃ param | anantānantamuktaiśceśvarādyairjuṣṭamuttamam ||32|| brahmādyairvanditaṃ divyāmbarabhūṣāvirājitam | rādhāramādisaṃjuṣṭaṃ kāntakāntātikāntikam ||33 || avatāraistathā vyūhairdeveścaraiḥ prasevitam | vilokya rājakulino mumuhustatra mādhave ||34|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ vīkṣya kṣaṇaṃ stabdhā ivābhavan | tato rājā stutiṃ cakre divyabhāvena noditaḥ ||35|| mahātejaḥpuñjātmakaparamadhāmastharuciro mahāmuktaiḥ sevāparicaraṇatuṣṭo vijayate | anādiśrīkṛṣṇo’navadhiguṇadhārī parataro’kṣareśaḥ śaktyādyairadhigatapadaḥ saṃvijayate ||36|| tvamevāsse divye’kṣaraparamadhāmni svanilaye sa evāsse kṛśā dvibhujavararūpo’tisukhakṛt | gavāṃ loke gopīgaṇasuracitārghyaḥ svabhavane sa evāste lakṣmīparicaritavaikuṇṭhabhavane || 37|| tvamevāsse bhūmannamṛtaparipūrteśvarapade sa evāste vyūhātmakatanumayo’vyākṛtabhuvi | virāja tvaṃ cāsse bhavasi ca hiraṇyarbha puruṣastrideva tvaṃ viṣṇo bhavasi manujānāṃ hitakaraḥ ||38|| surā daityāścānye pitara iha viprāḥ ṛṣigaṇā nṛpāḥ pātālasthā jaḍacidabhidhaṃ sā tava tanūḥ | naro nārādyā ye munaya iha badrīśatanugaṃ bhajantyevātmajñā yugalatanugaṃ muktilaṣiṇaḥ ||39||| tathā śvete loke dhavalarucidehāstava janāḥ prasevante lakṣmīkṛtacaraṇasevaṃ phaṇiśayam | tvameva tvaṃ candre raviparidhiga tvaṃ hṛdayago’nale tvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo bhavasi tamasāṃ lopakṛtimān ||2.202.40|| idaṃ divyaṃ rūpaṃ tava jaḍacitisthaṃ nijadṛśā prapaśye’haṃ viṣṇo bhavadatikṛpāleśabalataḥ | tvamevādau cābhūḥ saparikaratattvādisṛjikṛt praviṣṭastvaṃ poṣṭā bhavasi parihāre’pi layakṛt ||41 || tvamevāsse’saṃkhyāvataraṇasumūrtidhragapi yaḥ paraṃśreyaḥkartā bhavajaladhimagnasya kṛpayā | sa evātra prāpto bhavasi bhagavan yajñatanumān prabhoktā tvaṃ yajñe kuru nijajanānāṃ sukhamayam ||42|| mayā dattaṃ dravyaṃ tava bhavati bhogyaṃ nanu purā samastaṃ rājyādyaṃ tava caraṇayorāhitamidam | ahaṃ varte rājye nanu satatamāgantuka iti mahārāja tvaṃ vai gṛhapatirasi svīyaviṣayaḥ ||42 || ityabhīṣṭūya rājā sa bālakṛṣṇaṃ tu rādhike | maunaṃ jagrāha ca tato bhagavān divyadarśanam ||44|| tirobhāvayadatha te dadṛśuḥ svarṇakāsane | nemuḥ praṇemuḥ sahasā sāśrunetrāḥ sahṛdgadāḥ ||45|| rājñyaḥ sarvāśca caraṇau dhṛtvā tadā tu śārṅgiṇaḥ | alihan dve tale premṇā jñātvā śrīparameśvaram ||46|| kanyakāstatra ca rājñastvekapañcāśaduttamāḥ | āsan darśanakartryastā mumuhuḥ puruṣottame ||47|| varamālāṃ karayośca dhṛtvā kaṇṭhe harerernyadhuḥ | bālakṛṣṇo nṛpādiṣṭaḥ karān jagrāha vai tadā ||48|| prāpya kṛṣṇaṃ kāntamīśaṃ tā āsan kṛtakāryikāḥ | rājānaṃ śrīharistatrāśīrvacāṃsi pradāya tu ||49|| yajñadravyaṃ dinamānarṣaye’dhīnaṃ vidhāya ha | uttasthau tvāsanād rājā kṛtakṛtyo babhūva ha |||2.202.50 || mandire tvālaye rājñaḥ sarvatra bhagavām̐stadā | vicacāra bahubhaume śatabhūmyādisaṃyute ||51 || rājodyānaṃ vicacāra pādapūtaṃ vidhāya ca | rājamandiramevādau tataḥ pradhānamandiram ||5 2|| śreṣṭhiṇāmālayām̐ścāpi tato nagaravāsinām | gṛheṣu caraṇau nyasyādāya pūjāṃ kratoḥ kṛte ||53|| rājamārge cāpaṇeṣu catvareṣu sthale sthale | pūjāṃ prāpya hariḥ sarvaṃ yajñārthaṃ tat samārpayat ||54|| evaṃ nagaryāmabhito bahumānapuraḥsaram | vicacāra janānāṃ tu manāṃsi sve jahāra ca ||55|| rājamārge bhramantaṃ taṃ mahāhastisthitaṃ prabhum | vilokya pramadāḥ sarvā amaryaḥ sañjaguryaśaḥ ||5 6 || dhanyāstā rājakanyā yā vavruḥ śrīpatimīśvaram | kṛtapūrvatapaḥpūjāphalamāpuḥ kuto’nyathā ||57|| nārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ kānto gṛhe milet striyastviha | yaṃ rādhā kamalā padmā lakṣmīḥ prabhā ca pārvatī ||58|| māṇikyādyāḥ prasevante taṃ prāptā bhāgyagauravāt | yaṃ sevante brahmapriyā yaṃ sevante’nyakanyakāḥ ||59|| yaṃ sevante gaurikāśca taṃ prāptā bhāgyagauravāt | yaṃ sevante hāritāśca devyo’saṃkhyaguṇāśrayam ||2.202.60|| prapaśyantu mukhaṃ tvasya candrabimbojjvalaṃ param | bhrūkuṭyāṃ vartate bāṇaḥ kāmadevasya saṃsthitaḥ ||6 1 || dhanurbhruvorvartate’sya dehe’sya rāmaṇīyakam | hāsye mahām̐ścamatkāraḥ samākarṣaṇamohanaḥ ||62|| netrakoṇe’sya rucirā camatkāntirvirājate | oṣṭhamadhye’tisaundaryaṃ samākarṣaṇakārakam |||63 || paśyantu cālayastvasya viśālaṃ samuraḥsthalam | kaustubhaśrīsamādhāraṃ sabalaṃ mohakaṃ vapuḥ ||64|| alaktātigaśobhāḍhye paśyantu karapattale | kadalīstaṃbhaśobhāḍhyau paśyantūrū hareḥ striyaḥ ||65|| pūrtistvasyātitejo’bhivyāptā pāradṛśiśrayā | mūrtistvasyātitejo’bhivyāptā pāradṛśiśrayā | nāyaṃ mānuṣadeho’sti divyo’sti parameśvaraḥ ||66|| nāsya mūrtāvavayavā dṛśyante sandhiyojitāḥ | sakhyaḥ paśyantu saundaryaṃ bahiścāntaḥ samantataḥ ||67|| amalaṃ cāsthināḍyādiklṛptighaṭanāvarjitam | ekatattvaṃ vibhātyeṣo’vaśyaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||68|| saccidānandarūpo’sti parātparaḥ pareśvara | śruto yaḥ śāstrakathane sa evāyaṃ vitarkyate ||69|| asya darśanamātrādvai sukhānantyaṃ samarjyate | ānandaghana evāyaṃ sarvagandharasāśrayaḥ ||2.202.70 || ātmajyotiḥpradaścāyaṃ haratyantarmano hi naḥ | prāptavyaḥ sarvathā cāyaṃ maraṇānte pare’kṣare ||7 1 || mantraṃ tasya grahīṣyāmo yajñe’vaśyaṃ hi yoṣitaḥ | prāpsyāmastaṃ paraṃ kāntaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ janārdanam ||72||| tejaḥpuñjo’sya tanuto niryāti kīdṛśo’tigaḥ | sukho nimeṣahṛtsaumyaḥ śīlaśāntiprado’vyayaḥ ||73 || evaṃ parasparaṃ rādhe maṇipuryāṃ tu yoṣitaḥ | amarījātīyanāryo vadanti smātimohitāḥ ||74|| mārge mārge gṛhāgre ca catvare saudhasannidhau | lājākṣataiḥ sumairvardhayanti sma parameśvaram ||75|| jayaśabdān samuccārya rañjayanti satāṃ patim | namanti tu gavākṣebhyaḥ paśyantyaḥ kāntamīśvaram ||76|| bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ deveśvareśvaraṃ guhāśrayam | evaṃ bhramitvā nagarīṃ maṇipūryabhidhāṃ hariḥ ||77|| yajñapattanamutkṛṣṭaṃ vīkṣituṃ saṃyayau tataḥ | mahīmānā narā nāryo dṛṣṭvā deveśvareśvaram ||78|| vardhayāmāsuriṣṭābhirdattābhiścopadādibhiḥ | pūjayāmāsuratyarthaṃ cakruḥ svāgatamuttamam ||79|| dhanairdravyai rasaiḥ kṣārairveṣavāraiḥ kaṇādibhiḥ | gavyairhavyaiḥ śālibhiścākṣatādyairārcayan prabhum ||2.202.80|| vastraiḥ śubhāsanaiḥ pātraiḥ kambalaiścolakañcukaiḥ | varmabhiśca vibhūṣābhirmukuṭādyaiśca kuṇḍalaiḥ ||8 1 || candanairatimiṣṭānnaiḥ phalaiḥ śuṣkaphalādibhiḥ | mukhasaugandhyavāsaiśca ratnahārālibhistathā ||82|| dakṣiṇābhirvividhābhiḥ suvarṇakūpyatāmrakaiḥ | bālakṛṣṇaṃ prajāḥ sarvāḥ pūjayāmāsureva ha ||83|| sainyenotsāhitaḥ kṛṣṇo datvaivaṃ darśanaṃ param | āśīrvādairyojayitvā janān prāpya tathopadāḥ ||84|| āyayau rājavargādyaiḥ sahitau nijasaṃśrayam | rājasaudhaṃ rumāvāsayogyaṃ svargasamaṃ hariḥ ||85|| dadau sarvaṃ cāgataṃ vai dhanaṃ dhānyādikaṃ makhe | sāyaṃ vinodakāyeva rājā prākārayan mudā | |869|| niśāyāṃ nartanotsāhaṃ mahotsavamakārayat | kanyārpaṇanimittaṃ ca dhanārpaṇamathākarot ||87|| harirbhuktvā bhojayitvā kuṭumbinaḥ samāśritān | mahīmānān munīn sarvān brahmapriyāśca yoṣitaḥ ||88|| prajājanān sukhaṃ paścāt suṣvāpāmarikāśaye | amaryastaṃ navaṃ kāntaṃ siṣevire’tisevayā ||89|| prātastūryāṇyavādyanta prabodhayitumīśvaram | maṃgalāni kīrtanāni gītikāśca striyo vyadhuḥ ||2.202.90|| vāditraninadā miṣṭāḥ śravaṇe’pyabhavam̐stadā | jajāgāra harikṛṣṇaḥ kṛtāhnikaḥ sabhāṃ yayau ||91|| dugdhapānādikaṃ kṛtvā vīkṣituṃ maṇḍapaṃ yayau | viśvakarmādibhiḥ rātrau racitaṃ śobhanaṃ param ||92|| viśālaṃ tu daśakrośaṃ cāyutāsanaśobhitam | koṭidevasamāveśaṃ citradhvajasamanvitam ||93|| kuṇḍāni nava tatraiva tathaikaṃ paramaṃ param | vīkṣya vedīśca pātrāṇi śālāśca havyaśālikāḥ ||94|| homasamidhaḥ saṃvīkṣya kavyāni vīkṣya cāpi vai | tutoṣa bhagavān cābhūtprasannaścātiharṣitaḥ ||95|| sudivyādivyasiddhīnāṃ yoginīnāṃ gaṇāstathā | devīnāṃ mātṛkānāṃ ca satīnāṃ maṇḍalāni ca ||96|| maṇḍalāni sāṃkhyayoginīnāmaiśvaryajūṃṣi ca | mahānasānāṃ rakṣārthaṃ vartante pākasiddhaye ||97|| tadvilokyātituṣṭo’bhūd bhagavān kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | devīṃ dharaṇiṃ cāhūyādhikāriṇīṃ tadākarot ||98|| annapūrṇāṃ tathā lakṣmīṃ dadau sahāyyadāṃ hariḥ | dharaṇyai sarvalokānāṃ bhojanādiprapūrtaye ||99|| varuṇāya jalārthaṃ dakṣiṇārthaṃ tu kuberakam | nyayojayaddharistatrārogyārthaṃ cāśvinau sutau || 2.202.10 0|| rakṣārthaṃ dharmarājaṃ ca vighneśaṃ vighnaśāntaye | akṣayārthaṃ sūryadevaṃ śāsanārthaṃ tu śūlinam || 101 || dānārthaṃ gocaraṃ viṣṇuṃ vyavasthārthaṃ tu vedhasam | sanmānārthaṃ tvāgatānāṃ mahendraṃ samayojayat || 1 02|| pācanārthaṃ vahnidevaṃ prakāśārthaṃ tu pārvaṇam | dhvanyādiparivṛddhyarthaṃ vidyutaḥ samayojayat || 1 03|| ityevaṃ rādhike śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaḥ prabhātake | nyayojayat karmacārān ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bhādre site dale || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne maṇisevāpuryāṃ yajñapattane ca harerviharaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ bhādraśuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ prātaḥ karmacārayojanetyādi nirūpaṇanāmā dvyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 202 ||
<2.203> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike vai tataḥ prātaḥ kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtādanaḥ | kṛtābhivṛddhasevaśca bālakṛṣṇaḥ sabhāṃ yayau || 1 || rājā tatrāyayau tūrṇaṃ pūjādarśanalālasaḥ | kṛtvā pūjāṃ candanādyairhariṃ tadāha sannatiḥ || 2 || adya kartavyaviṣayaṃ tvājñāpaya dayānidhe | sarva śaktyā sādhayiṣye kratvarthaṃ sevanaṃ prabho || 3 || haristamāha sauvarṇī pratimāṃ śobhanāṃ śubhām | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasyādya prakāraya saratnakām || 4 || navāṃgulāṃ caturbāhuṃ nārāyaṇasya mūrtikām | lakṣmyāścāṣṭāṃgulāṃ cāpi prakāraya nu kānakīm || 5 || mama pratimāṃ ramyāṃ ca prakāraya daśāṃgulām | māṇikīṃ svarṇamūrtiṃ ca matkarṇordhvāṃ prakāraya || 6 || lakṣmīṃ matskandhaparyantāṃ matkarṇordhvā ca padmajām | matskandhordhvāṃ ramāṃ cāpi rādhāṃ matkaṇṭhakocchrayām || 7 || amarīśāṃ tava kanyāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ manmukhakordhvakām | rājan kāraya sauvarṇīṃ yajñārthaṃ bahuśobhanām || 8 || mūrtyaṣṭakaṃ kārayitvā satīśivau prakāraya | sauvarṇau ca gaṇanāthaṃ sauvarṇaṃ samprakāraya || 9 || nandinaṃ kārtikeyaṃ ca tathā samyak prakāraya | pañcamūrtīstathā rājan kārayitvā ca bhāskaram || 2.203.1 0|| viṣṇuṃ ca kānakaṃ brahmāṇaṃ prakāraya kānakam | kaṃbharāṃ mātaraṃ cāpi gopālaṃ pitaraṃ mama || 11 || prakāraya ca sauvarṇaṃ pañcakaṃ śobhanaṃ tataḥ | vāstudevaṃ kānakaṃ ca prakāraya viśālakam || 12|| yūthaṃ ca kānakaṃ sarvadevāvāsaṃ prakāraya | ityājñāṃ pradadau kṛṣṇo devagṛhaṃ vidhāpaya || 13|| ājñāṃ labdhvā nṛpastūrṇaṃ kārayāmāsa mūrtikāḥ | bālakṛṣṇo’tha sasmāra nāradaṃ lokavedinam || 14|| sanatkumāraṃ sādhuṃ ca garuḍaṃ vāhanaṃ nijam | cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ cāpi saccidānandayoginam || 15|| pañcaite divyabodhāśca tūrṇaṃ tatrāyayuḥ puraḥ | kṛtvārhā daṇḍavaccakrurājñāṃ yogyāṃ samārthayan || 16|| bālakṛṣṇastadā tebhyo dadau prasādabhojanam | pānaṃ hārān karau mūrdhni tataḥ kāryaṃ samādiśat || 17|| āmantraṇadalaṃ tebhyo dadau yajñārthabodhakam | saptamyāṃ vaiṣṇavo yajñaḥ prārapsyate’tra bhūtale || 18|| amarīṇāṃ pradeśeṣu kenāṭakābhidhe sthale | maṇisevānagaryāḥ sannidhau viśālabhūtale || 1 9|| śeṣakāṣṭhāvanānadyāḥ saṃgame vinipārage | sarastīre’tra dhāmasthairmuktairmuktābhirutsave ||2.203.20 || avatāraiḥ samastaiśca tathā taddhāmapārṣadaiḥ | sarvāvatāriṇībhiśca pārṣadānībhirādarāt ||21 || vyūhairvyūhānikābhiśca nārāyaṇaiḥ samastakaiḥ | nārāyaṇībhiḥ sarvābhirāgantavyaṃ makhotsave ||22|| viṣṇubhirvaiṣṇavībhiśceśvarairīśvaraśaktibhiḥ | vairājena ca vairājñyā satyā gaṇaiḥ śivena ca ||23|| māyayā māyikaistatvaiḥ puruṣeṇāpi sarvathā | āgantavyaṃ mahotsāhairbrahmaṇā brahmaśaktibhiḥ ||24|| brahmacāriyatibhiśca ṛṣibhiḥ sādhavaistathā | pitṛbhirmātṛbhiścāpi devairdevībhirityapi ||25|| dikpālairlokapālaiścāgantavyaṃ svapriyāyutaiḥ | suraiḥ surābhiḥ svargasthairbhuvarlokanivāsibhiḥ ||26|| grahanakṣatratārābhirgrahaiḥ pretapiśācakaiḥ | bhūtakuṣmāṇḍakairvināyakairgaṇaiḥ samantataḥ ||27|| yakṣai rakṣobhiścaivāgantavyaṃ daityaiśca dānavaiḥ | kāśyapībhiḥ prajābhiśca vetālakaiśca śaktibhiḥ ||28|| rājasaistāmasaiścāpi mānavaiḥ sakuṭumbakaiḥ | yatibhiryogibhiścāpi vṛkṣaistṛṇaiśca vallibhiḥ |||29|| stambairghāsairjantubhiśca jarājairaṇḍajairapi | svedajaiḥ kaṇajaiścāpi kandajairjalajaistathā ||2.203.3 0|| āgantavyaṃ parvataiśca nadībhiśca sarovaraiḥ | tīrthairvanairaraṇyaiśca khātākhātaiḥ samudrakaiḥ ||3 1 || āgantavyaṃ kṣetrapālairgṛhadevaiḥ samantataḥ | kuladevairāyatanairgandharvaiścāraṇādibhiḥ || 3 2|| sūtairmāgadhakairbandījanairnartakanāṭyibhiḥ | bahurūpadharairmallairvidyādhraiḥ kinnarādibhiḥ ||33|| gaṇairgaṇikavargaiścānāthaiśca bhikṣukairapi | vanibhiścātalāvāsaiḥ pātālāntanivāsibhiḥ ||34|| phaṇibhirbalibhiścāpi samāgantavyamādarāt | śāstrairvedaiśca vidyābhirvyavahāraiḥ samantataḥ ||35|| jaḍaiśca cetanaiḥ sarvairāgantavyaṃ mahāmakhe | ahaṃ brahmapatirbrahmapriyāsvāmī pareśvaraḥ || 36|| avatārī bālakṛṣṇo nimantrayāmi cādhvare | devadaityagurubhiścācāryairaiśvaryaśālibhiḥ ||37|| viprairmunibhirbrāhmībhiścāgantavyaṃ makhe mama | saptamyāṃ prātarārabhyaikādaśyāṃ bhādraśuklake || 38|| makhakāryaṃ mataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ cāgantavyaṃ kuṭumbibhiḥ | anāgatānāṃ śapathaṃ dadāmyahaṃ narāyaṇaḥ ||39|| avaśyaṃ cāmarīdeśaṃ pavitrayantu pāvanāḥ | naranārāyaṇādyāśca śeṣanārāyaṇādayaḥ ||2.203.40 || svasvamuktādisahitāḥ samāyāntu sukhapradāḥ | śrīramārādhikāgaṃgāśāradātulasīprabhāḥ ||41 || tattaddhāmanivāsinyaḥ samāyāntu mahādhvare | yoginyo mātaraḥ sarvāḥ kuladevyaśca caṇḍikāḥ ||42|| sarvā vai brahmacāriṇyaḥ samāyāntu mamādhvare | sapatikāḥ saputrāśca savaṃśāḥ sānugāḥ samāḥ ||43||| āyāntu cādhvare’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇārthitāḥ | samājo’tra mahān bhāvī brahmāṇḍeśvaraśobhitaḥ ||44|| śatasahasravadanā brahmādyā viṣṇavo’pi ca | tathottamāḥ samāyāntu sarve śrīvaiṣṇave’dhvare ||45|| āhvayāmyāmantrayāmyākārayāmyahamacyutaḥ | parabrahmākṣarātītaḥ svāmiśrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ||46|| ityevaṃ rādhike yajñāmantraṇārthāṃ supatrikām | dadau śrībālakṛṣṇo vai nāradādibhya eva tu ||47|| dadāvanantarūpāṇāṃ dhartṛtvaṃ paramādbhutam | aiśvaryaṃ cāpi gatikāṃ sarvajñatvaṃ ca satvaram || 48|| sarve yayurharerājñāṃ pragṛhyāmantraṇārthikāḥ | madhyāhne yamarājaṃ ca sasmāra parameśvaraḥ ||49|| yamalokaṃ bandhaśūnyaṃ kārayāmāsa cājñayā | sarvān vimocayāmāsa jīvān yamavaśaṃgatān ||2.203.50|| yamadūtām̐stadā yajñe karmacārān cakāra ha | evaṃ nirvartya bhagavān madhyāhne bhojanādikam ||5 1 || kārayāmāsa sarvebhyo makhārthibhyastataḥ svayam | bubhuje’tha ca viśrāntiṃ lebhe kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ param ||52|| ādideśa haristatra brahmaṇe viṣṇave tathā | śaṃkarāya ca sarveṣāmāgamyamānadehinām ||53 || makhārthināṃ narāṇāṃ ca nārīṇāṃ svāgatāya vai | satyai lakṣmyai sarasvatyai cādideśa tathaiva ca ||54|| naranārāyaṇābhyāṃ cādideśa svāgatāya vai | dharmadevāya ca vāsudevāyāpyādideśa ca ||55|| svāgatārthaṃ hi sarveṣāmāgantukamakhārthinām | atha śrīlomaśaṃ prāha bhāradvājaṃ tathā munim ||56|| divimānāyanaṃ cāpi gāṃgeyān yavakrītinaḥ | bhavantaḥ svāgataṃ sarve kurvantu sarvadehinām ||57 | | āgatānāṃ jalaiścānnaiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaiśca mandiraiḥ | āvāsanapradānaiścāpekṣyavastubhirādarāt || 58 | | kalpavṛkṣān kalpalatāḥ kalpamaṇīṃśca kalpagāḥ | prāha sarvanivāseṣu yajñapattanake’bhitaḥ ||59 || upatiṣṭhantu sarvatra svāgatārthaṃ samanvitāḥ | yathāpekṣaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ ca vidhāyāpi navaṃ navam | | 2.203.60 || arpayantu mahīmānebhyastadā sārvavāñcchikam | brahmahradaṃ ca virajāṃ rasakūpaṃ tathāmṛtam | |6 1 | | brahmasaro hariḥ prāha tiṣṭhantu ca sthale sthale | sarvābhivāñcchitaṃ sarvaṃ peyaṃ samarpayantu vai | | 62 || pavanaṃ vahnidevaṃ ca prāha vyajanado bhava | uṣṇado bhava cāpyatra bahurūpadharo bhavān || 63 || vyoma prāha bhavānatra dūraśrutiṃ karotu vai | siddhīḥ prāha bhavatyo’tra kurvantu prāpaṇādikam | | 64|| evaṃ mantrām̐stadā prāha ghoṣayantu makhasthale | maṃgalāni vicitrāṇi cāgatānāṃ hi mānane || 65 || śāradāśca tadā prāha kurvantu gītikāḥ śubhāḥ | āgatānāṃ svāgatārthe vādyāni vādayantu vai || 66 | | rājabhyaśca hariḥ prāha sainyaiścarantu mānanam | svāgataṃ sarvalokānāmāgatānāṃ makhārthinām || 67 || vādyairyantradhvānakaiśca kurvantu bahumānanam | viśvakarmāṇamāhūya bālakṛṣṇo jagāda ha || 68 || muktānāṃ tu nivāsān vai vyomni kṣaṇātprakalpaya | avatāreśvarāṇāṃ ca tathā vyomni prakalpaya | | 69 | | devānāmṛṣivaryāṇāṃ vyomni pitṝṇāṃ kalpaya | brahmāṇḍāntaravāsānā bhūtale yajñapattane | |2.203.7 0 | | uttarottarabhūbhāgān prakalpaya kṣaṇānnanu | divyāṃ dadāmi śaktiṃ te saṃkalpotthaphalātmikām | |7 1 | | kalpaklṛptyabhidhāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ tayā sādhaya satvaram | ityuktvā virarāmāsau bhagavān svāsane’bhavat | |72 | | tāvad rājā rāyarokīśvaraḥ saṃprārthayaddharim | adya ced bhavato vāñchā mama rājyaṃ pavitraya | |7 3 | | sphūrtinārīvanāṃ divyāṃ mahākañjīnadītaṭe | nagarī me samāgatya dvimānāyanarāṣṭrakam | |74| | pavitraya harekṛṣṇa tavāgamyaṃ na kiñcana | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha pītvā jalaṃ suśītalam | | 75 | | vimānaṃ cārurohāpi mātrā pitrā samanvitaḥ | lālāyanena sahito māṇakyā sahitastathā ||76|| pārṣadairdivyadehaiśca bhṛtyairdāsīśatairapi | dvādaśabhiśca mukhyābhiḥ satībhiḥ sahito yayau ||77|| sphūrtinārīvanāpuryāmambarāt kṣaṇamātrataḥ | rājā ṛṣiścakratuśca sanmānaṃ sahagau tadā ||78|| udyāne tvavatīryaiva rājasaudhasamīpataḥ | sainyena svāgataṃ viṣṇoḥ kurutaḥ sma vidhānataḥ ||79|| pādau prakṣālya vidhinā papaturjalamamṛtam | candanaiḥ puṣpahāraiśca pupūjatustamādarāt ||2.203.80|| anyān sahagatām̐ścāpi pupūjaturnṛpo muniḥ | atha saudhe ninyatuśca śrīpatiṃ nṛpamandire ||8 1 || ārārtrikaṃ cakārāsya rājñīdaśakameva tu | kumārāśca kumāryaśca cakrurnirājanaṃ tataḥ ||82|| harirdivyaṃ darśanaṃ svaṃ caturbhujaṃ dadau ca tān | āścaryacakitāścāsan kumāryaścaikaviṃśatiḥ ||83|| rājakanyā mātṛvaśyā mātrājñayā ca mohitāḥ | varamālāṃ bālakṛṣṇakaṇṭhe samārpayam̐stadā ||84|| kṛtakṛtyāstā abhavan prāpya kāntaṃ janārdanam | rājā tadutsavaṃ cakre rājasaudhe hi śobhanam ||85|| hareśca pādayordravyaṃ koṭisaṃkhyaṃ nyadhānnṛpaḥ | yautakaṃ pradadau cāpi svarṇahārādikām̐stathā ||86 || bhūṣāmbarāṇi pradadau nīrājanamakārayat | natvā hariṃ tataḥ śīghraṃ kṣamāmayācata prabhoḥ ||87|| pāvito’haṃ dhṛto haste kanyā svīkṛtya me tvayā | naijīkṛto’smi bhagavan sadā rakṣaya māyikāt ||88|| rājñyastato hariṃ natvā candrakaṃ bhālake vyadhuḥ | kṣamāṃ harerayācanna samuddhareti cārthayan ||89|| hariḥ prāhoddhariṣye’haṃ nayiṣye’nte paraṃ padam | tato divyasvarūpaṃ svaṃ caturbhujaṃ vyalopayat ||2.203.90 || sarvato rājasaudheṣu vihṛtya ca tataḥ param | pradhānānāṃ gṛhāṇyeva gatvāpāvayadacyutaḥ ||9 1 || kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ parigṛhya sainyena śobhitaḥ prabhuḥ | sphūrtinārīvanāpuryāṃ rājamārge gato’bhavat ||92|| darśakaiḥ pūjakaiścāpi prajājanaiḥ supūjitaḥ | vandito’rcitapādaśca dravyādibhiḥ samarpitaḥ ||93 || amarībhiryaśogānaiḥ śrāvito rañjito’rcanaiḥ | vardhitaścāśiṣā puṣpairvikīrito’timānitaḥ ||94|| jayaśabdairvādyaśabdaiḥ kīrtitaḥ parameśvaraḥ | netrapadmaistathā pīto bhāvaiścākarṣito yayau ||95|| pradhānāḥ śreṣṭhinaḥ sarve prajājanāśca yoṣitaḥ | daduḥ pūjāṃ parigṛhya bhramitvā nagarīṃ tataḥ ||96|| rājasaudhaṃ samāgamya mahākāñcījalaṃ papau | mahākāṃcananāmānaṛṣiṃ sammānayan prabhuṃ ||97|| dravyaṃ tasmai dadau tatra rājā munirdhanaṃ tu tat | yajñārthaṃ tu vimāne vai kṛtvāprāpayadadhvaram ||98|| harirvimānamāruhya kuṭumbasahitastadā | rājñā rājñyā kanyakābhiḥ saha dvimānarāṣṭrakam ||99|| bhramitvā vyomamārgeṇa dṛṣṭvā deśapradeśakān | vinipārasarastīraṃ sāyaṃpūrvaṃ samāyayau || 2.203.10 0|| rājasaudhe tvavatīrya viśrāntiṃ prayayau hariḥ | kanyakāstā brahmasatyaḥ kāntāsu vāsamācaran || 10 1|| rāyarokīśvaro mahākāñcanarṣirdhanāni vai | dadaturyajñakāryārthaṃ kuberāya tadā hyubhau || 1 02|| athākāśe mahīmānavimānāni mahāmbarāt | akṣarāccāpi golokād vaikuṇṭhādamṛtādapi || 103 || avyākṛtādīśalokādvairājācca hiraṇmayāt | satyāt svargājjanādeśca merordigbhyaḥ samantataḥ || 1 04|| puryaṣṭakād bhuvanānāmantarālebhya āyayuḥ | pātālebhyastrisṛṣṭibhyo vimānāni samāyayuḥ || 105 || āmantritānāṃ yānāni koṭyarbudāni cāyayuḥ | ambaraṃ channabhāvaṃ vai prāptaṃ vimānakoṭibhiḥ || 106 || svargaṃ svargaṃ mahāsvargaṃ brahmasvargaṃ tadābhavat | sūryavatkāśamānaṃ vai divaṃ dvitīyakaṃ hyabhūt || 1 07|| rādhike jīvasṛṣṭiśceśvarasṛṣṭistathā parā | brahmasṛṣṭiḥ sarvavidhā tvāyayau vai nimantraṇāt || 10 8|| niśā layaṃ gatā tatra śrīhareścaikaromake | svāgataṃ sma prakurvanti brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | mahīmānāścāmbarāccāvatarantyucitasthalīḥ || 109 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne rāyakinnaranṛpāya sauvarṇamūrtividhāpanādeśaḥ, nāradādīnāṃ kuṃkumāmantraṇapatrikāyuktānāṃ sṛṣṭiṣu preṣaṇaṃ, hareḥ rāyarokīśvaranṛparāṣṭragamanaṃ pūjanaṃ sphūrtinārīnagaryāṃ deśe ca bhramaṇaṃ punaryajñasthalāgamanaṃ, mahīmānānāmāgamaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 203 ||
<2.204> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca āyayū rādhike muktāḥ paramākṣaradhāminaḥ | muktānyaścāyayustatra divyavimānasaṃsthitāḥ || 1 || kṛtaṃ śrīhariṇā teṣāṃ svāgataṃ bahuśobhanam | dhāmeśvarā avatārāścāyayuḥ śaktiśobhitāḥ || 2 || ahaṃ rādhe tvayā sākaṃ gopagopīgaṇānvitaḥ | agamaṃ divyapatnībhiḥ sākaṃ vimānamāśritaḥ || 3 || vaikuṇṭhācchrīpatirnārāyaṇo’pi tatra cāyayau | sarvapārṣadayuktaśca ramābhiḥ sahitastadā || 4 || vāsudevādayo vyūhāścāyayustatra cādhvare | avatārāstathā sarve’pyāyuḥ śaktisevitāḥ || 5 || sanmānaṃ svāgataṃ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ vyadhāt | mahāviṣṇustathā bhūmā virāḍapi hiraṇmayaḥ || 6 || aṣṭāvaraṇasaṃsthāśceśvarā māyāgatā api | śivalokagatāścāpi tatrāyayustadaṃśakāḥ || 7 || śrīhariḥ svayamevaiṣāṃ svāgataṃ mānamācarat | īśasṛṣṭisamastānāṃ brahmasṛṣṭinivāsinām || 8 || cidānandāmbare klṛpte nagare ca nivāsanam | pradadau śrībālakṛṣṇo’vatārī puruṣottamaḥ || 9 || brahmaṇaḥ satyalokasthāstathānyalokavāsinaḥ | ṛṣayaḥ pitaraḥ siddhāścāyayustatra vai makhe || 2.204.10 || devā deveśvarāścāśāpālā lokaprapālinaḥ | āyayuśca vimānairadhvare bhuvarnivāsinaḥ || 11 || meroḥ samāyayuścāpyantarīkṣād grahatārakāḥ | nakṣatrāṇi surādyāśca vasavo rudrakoṭayaḥ || 12|| ādityā aśvinau dharmarājastathāpare surāḥ | āyayuścādhvare naijakuṭumbapariśobhitaḥ || 13 || kailāsasya gaṇā gaṇyo yoginyaścaṇḍikāstathā | bhairavā bhūtadehāśca śāṃkarāste samāyayuḥ || 14|| etebhyo devakoṭibhyo yogyāvāsān dadau hariḥ | susvāgataṃ susammānaṃ cakrurbrahmājaviṣṇavaḥ || 15|| lomaśādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca cakruḥ sammānanaṃ bahu | vālakhilyamaharṣīṇāṃ munīnāṃ cordhvaretasām || 16|| sādhvīnāṃ ca satāṃ sāṃkhyayoginīnāṃ sumānanam | lakṣmyādyāścakruratyarthaṃ nivāsān pradaduḥ sukhān || 17|| sūtamāgadhabandyādyā vidyādhrāḥ kinnarādayaḥ | kimpuṃsaścāpi gandharvāścāraṇā bhāṭajātayaḥ || 18|| āyayuḥ kathakāścāpi rañjakā mallayodhinaḥ | rūpakāścāyayuścāpi narā nṛtyakarāstathā || 1 9|| sarvavarṇāḥ sarvadeśanivāsāstatra cāyayuḥ | saurāṣṭrīyā mānavāśca dakṣiṇāpathavartinaḥ ||2.204.2 0|| uṣṭrālayajanāścāpi brahmabhūmijanā api | śivarājyasthitāścāpi prācīnarājyavāsinaḥ ||21 || rāśiyānanivāsāśca ketumālanivāsinaḥ | abriktasthāstathā lokā āraktadeśavāsinaḥ ||22|| ārārtrikaguhāvāsāścāmarīdeśavāsinaḥ | hāritāśca tathāraṇyavāsāḥ parvatavāsinaḥ ||23|| jalasthāśca sthalasthāśca vyomasthāḥ prasamāyayuḥ | tebhyo dadurnivāsām̐ścākurvan mānaṃ harādayaḥ ||24|| vṛkṣā vallyastṛṇastambāḥ kandamūlādayastathā | āyayuḥ kaṇajātāścodbhijjā divyaśarīriṇaḥ || 25|| paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi haṃsagaruḍajātikāḥ | anye’pi jantavastatrāyayurdivyaśarīriṇaḥ ||26|| teṣāṃ nivāsān pradaduścakrurmānaṃ harādayaḥ | kāśyapyaśca prajāḥ sarvāḥ sarvātalādivāsinaḥ || 27|| sarpāśca nāgā nāgendrā vāhanāni samāyayuḥ | daityāśca dānavā raudrā rākṣasāśca samāyayuḥ ||28|| teṣāṃ dadunivāsām̐śca dakṣiṇe sarasastathā | sammānaṃ śaṃkaraścakre yathāyogyaṃ satī tathā |||29||| naranārāyaṇādyāśca śeṣanārāyaṇādayaḥ | avatārāstathā cānye tatrāyayurmahādhvare ||2.204.3 0|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasteṣāṃ samutsukaḥ | sammānaṃ svāgataṃ cakre nivāsān pradadau śubhān ||3 1|| nadyo nadāḥ samudrāśca tattvāni tvāyayustadā | tīrthāni vipravaryāśca divyadehāḥ maharṣayaḥ ||32|| meghā vidyudvilasitāścāyayustatra cādhvare | yathāyogyaṃ svāgataṃ ca teṣāṃ brahmā tadākarot ||33 || kālaḥ kṣaṇā muhūrtāni divasāḥ pakṣavatsarāḥ | yugā māsāścāyayuśca svāgataṃ śaṃkaro vyadhāt ||34|| śilpinaḥ koṭilokasthāścāyayustatra cādhvare | viśvakarmā susammānaṃ vyadhād vāsān dadau tadā ||35|| sarveṣāṃ bahudhāmānaṃ vāsudevo narāyaṇaḥ | yathāyogyaṃ pracakre vai sarvadānādibhistadā || 36|| rādhike tatra vāseṣu sarvaṃ sampūrṇamasti vai | pradīpāḥ pānapātrāṇi bhakṣyabhojyāni yāni ca ||37|| miṣṭānnāni ca peyāni lehyāni santi tatra ca | coṣyāṇi cāsanādīni śayyā yogyāḥ sukomalāḥ ||38|| dāsā dāsyo dugdhakuṇḍā amṛtānāṃ saridvarāḥ | udyānānāṃ sudṛśyāni bhṛtyā dāsyaśca sevakāḥ ||39|| karmacārā nideśasthāḥ sarvāvāseṣu nirmitāḥ | bālakṛṣṇena saṃkalpāt koṭiśo’nantasevakāḥ ||2.204.40|| dūraśravaṇayantrāṇi dūradarśanakāni ca | vaihāyasāni yānāni sarvasparśādisiddhikāḥ ||41 || ghṛtakulyāḥ payaḥkulyāḥ śarkarāparvatāstathā | tatrāsan sarvataḥ klṛtā mahīmānādituṣṭaye ||42|| rādhike kiṃ varṇaye’haṃ svarṇabhūṣādiparvatāḥ | ambarāṇāṃ tathā śailāḥ kṛtāḥ śrīparamātmanā || 42|| alaktānāṃ sugandhānāṃ droṇyastatra tadā kṛtāḥ | sarvaśṛṃgāravastūnāṃ tatrāsan parvatāḥ parāḥ ||44|| dīrghikāśca tathāsam̐śca rasānāṃ ca sarāṃsi vai | dravāṇāṃ tu nadāścāsan bhuktaye tu makhārthinām ||45|| yādṛśyaścākṣare santi goloke ca vikuṇṭhake | kailāsake śvetabhūmau tādṛśyaḥ smṛddhayo’bhavan ||46|| visasmarurmahīmānāḥ sarvasṛṣṭinivāsinaḥ | nijāṃ nijāṃ samṛddhiṃ cādhikāṃ prāpya harermakhe ||47|| āprātaścaivamevaivaṃ svāgataṃ samabhūt khalu | bhojanaṃ sevanaṃ pānaṃ śayyādānaṃ nivāsanam ||48|| dāsadāsīpradānaṃ ca sarvaṃ pūrṇamabhūt tadā | mahīmānāḥ prasannāśca jahuḥ pariśramaṃ tadā ||49|| sukhāvāsān parān prāpyādhikyena sukhino’bhavan | rātrau sthale sthale tatra manorañjanaśālikāḥ ||2.204.50|| abhavannartanādīnāṃ kathānāṃ yodhināṃ tathā | rūpapradarśanānāṃ ca hāsyānāṃ gītikāriṇām ||51|| ākhyānānāṃ ca nāṭyānāṃ rañjanānyabhavanniśi | prātarjātaṃ tvevameva saptamyāḥ śobhanaṃ priyam ||52|| rādhike śrībālakṛṣṇaḥ snānaṃ cakre prabodhitaḥ | kṛtapūjāvandanaścājuhāva lomaśaṃ munim ||53|| ṛṣiṃ cājñāpayāmāsa kṛtābhivandanaṃ gurum | yajñakārye samādhehi sarvadraṣṭāramuttamam ||54|| lomaśaścāha kṛṣṇaṃ taṃ tava śiṣyaṃ mahāmunim | vedaśāstranidhānaṃ ca karmakāṇḍātigocaram || 55|| trikālajñaṃ ca mantrajñaṃ samādhisiddhiśālinam | sarvaiśvaryayutaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ pareśvarayoginam || 56|| samarthaṃ naiṣṭhikavaryaṃ naikabhavanaśaktikam | svayaṃprakāśanāmānaṃ sarvadraṣṭāramuttamam ||57|| vidhehi tvadhvare cātra sarvatragatiśālinam | śāntaṃ guṇanidhiṃ yogyaṃ draṣṭāraṃ taṃ suyojaya ||58|| viṣṇurbrahmā haraścāpi bṛhaspatiḥ kumārakaḥ | gaṇeśaścāpi yogyaṃ taṃ cānvamodanta vaiṃ tadā ||59|| bhāradvājo vaśiṣṭhaśca bhṛgurvaiśvānarastathā | viśvedevā marutaścāpyanvamodanta taṃ tathā ||2.204.60|| svayaṃprakāśo bhagavān sārvajñyasya mahānidhiḥ | gurorvākyaṃ harervākyaṃ sarvadraṣṭṛtvadhāyakam ||6 1|| svīcakāra vinītaḥ saṃstataḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | kaṇṭhahāraṃ dadau tasmai śirastrāṇaṃ tadarthakam ||62||| kañcukaṃ svarṇatārāḍhyaṃ vastraṃ kauśeyakaṃ dadau | dhautraṃ tathāvidhaṃ cāpi sarvadraṣṭṛtvabodhakam ||63 || āsanaṃ cottamaṃ tatra maṇḍape tatkṛte mahat | nyadhāpayattatastaṃ cāpreṣayad yajñamaṇḍapam ||64|| gurvāsanaṃ lomaśāya dattavān bhagavān svayam | saccidānandarūpāya lālāyanāya mādhavaḥ ||65|| bālakṛṣṇo dadau pratinidhitvaṃ svasya vai tadā | yajamānastadā rājā rāyakinnarako mataḥ ||66|| satīdevīmahārājñīyuto maṇḍapamāyayau | avādyanta samastāni tūryāṇi maṃgalakṣaṇe ||67|| āyayuḥ sarvato yajñabhūmau tadadhikāriṇaḥ | bhūdevāḥ svargadevāśca satyadevāḥ samāyayuḥ ||68|| īśadevā devadevā devāḥ sarve samāyayuḥ | muktāstathāvatārāśceśvarāḥ patnīsamāyutāḥ ||69|| ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā mānavāḥ strīsamāyutāḥ | guravaḥ sarvalokānāṃ vyāsā vyāsatarāstathā ||2.204.70 || vedāḥ ṛcaśca sāmāni pūjyātmānaḥ samāyayuḥ | vayovṛddhā jñānavṛddhāḥ karmaṭhāśca samāyayuḥ ||71 || svaravṛddhā bhūtivṛddhā guṇavṛddhāḥ samāyayuḥ | dhanavṛddhā dharmavṛddhā lokavṛddhāḥ samāyayuḥ ||72|| yogavṛddhāstapovṛddhāḥ sthānavṛddhāḥ samāyayuḥ | gītivṛddhā vedavṛddhā vṛddhavṛddhāḥ samāyayuḥ ||73|| sattāvṛddhāścāyayuśca rājāno’pi samāyayuḥ | jāpakāḥ karmacārāśca homakā dānakāstathā ||74|| dvārapā maṇḍaparakṣā mukhyā gauṇāḥ samāyayuḥ | dravyahārā havyahārā samiddhārāḥ samāyayuḥ || 75|| niśānirmitakuṇḍāśca raṅgavallīprapūrakāḥ | dhvajāpatākādhartārastatra sarve samāyayuḥ ||76|| jalādānaprakartāraḥ pātrasaṃcayakāriṇaḥ | vastuhārāḥ phalapuṣpahārāstatra samāyayuḥ ||77|| rasahārā gavyahārā miṣṭahārāḥ samāyayuḥ | vāditreṣvatigarjatsu ninādite digambare ||78|| sarve maṇḍapabhūmiṃ vai draṣṭuṃ cāyayurutsukāḥ | vyomni vyomavihartāro’ntarīkṣe’ntarayoginaḥ ||79|| vāyustare bhuvarvāsaḥ samāgatya sthitāstadā | dyuvāsāśca prakāśeṣu vaimānikā vimānake ||2.204.80 || āgatya tu sthitāḥ sarve maṇḍapābhimukhāstadā | satyaḥ sādhvyaśca gauryaśca brahmapriyāśca hāritāḥ ||8 1 || amaryaḥ kanyakāścāpi devyaḥ sarvāḥ samāgatāḥ | devapatnyaḥ kṛtaveṣāścitraśṛṃgāraśobhitāḥ ||82|| pūrṇānandabharāḥ sarvā yajñamaṇḍapamāyayuḥ | īśvarāṇyaśca muktānyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginya ityapi ||83|| mānavyo mātaraścāpi yoginyaśca samāyayuḥ | yatinyaśca brahmapatnyo brāhmaṇyaśca samāyayuḥ ||84|| vāstudevāḥ kuṇḍadevāḥ śākhādevāḥ samāyayuḥ | dvāradevāstoraṇādisurā maṇḍapadevatāḥ ||85|| staṃbhadevā dhvajadevā yūpadevāḥ samāyayuḥ | trayastriṃśatpradevāśca pañcāyatanadevatāḥ ||86|| śrutvā vāditraninadān yajñamaṇḍapamāyayuḥ | nṛpā daśa sayoṣāśca bahuratnasamanvitāḥ ||87|| yajamānasvarūpāste yajñamaṇḍapamāyayuḥ | pṛthvyādibhūtatattvāni śabdādyā viṣayāstathā ||88|| vahnayo mūrtimantaśca yajñamaṇḍapamāyayuḥ | kuṇḍā bahuvidhāścāpi vedikā mukhyavedikāḥ ||89|| sthaṇḍilāḥ pālikāścāpi mūrtimantaḥ samāyayuḥ | sruksruvādyāni pātrāṇi patrāṇi kuśadevatāḥ ||2.204.9 0 || samidhaḥ kaṇajātāni havyānyapi samāyayuḥ | caravaśca pavitrāṇi mūrtāni tatra cāyayuḥ || 91 || śuddhayaścāpi gavyāni saptamṛdaḥ samāyayuḥ | āsanānyupakaraṇānyapi mūrtāni cāyayuḥ || 92|| atha jyotiḥpūruṣaśca mūrtimān divyarūpadhṛk | paṭahena diśaḥ sarvā nādayan samupāyayau ||93 || svarṇayūpapūruṣaśca mūrtimām̐statra cāyayau | tīrthāni sarvarūpāṇi mūrtimanti samāyayuḥ || 94|| svastayaḥ śrāddhapuruṣāstṛptayastatra cāyayuḥ | apūrvāṇi samastāni paramāpūrvalabdhaye ||95|| madhyāpūrvatrikāpūrvāyutāni tatra cāyayuḥ | kāṇḍikā vidhayaḥ sarve kramāstatra samāyayuḥ ||96|| hotavyāni samastāni mūrtimanti samāyayuḥ | prajāḥ prajeśvarāścāpyābālavṛddhayuvādikāḥ || 97|| narā nāryaścāyayurvai vādyaghoṣaiḥ kratusthalīm | saṃskṛtāṃ śobhayā yuktāṃ dyubhāsāṃ tvakṣarīkṛtām ||98|| yugalaiścāyugalaiśca saṃbhṛtāṃ navajīvanīm | maṇḍapai rājitāṃ yajñapattanairatigarvitām ||99|| sarvasṛṣṭyādhivāsaiścāśritāṃ śreṣṭatamāṃ mahīm | sārvabhaumīṃ dhāmatulyāṃ dhāminīṃ pārameśvarīm || 2.204.10 0|| rādhike karmaṇāṃ prāraṃbhasyottamaṃ muhūrtakam | upasthitaṃ tadā nādāḥ śaṃkhānāmabhavan śubhāḥ || 10 1|| tūpaśabdā abhavam̐śca vidyudvaṃśaninādakāḥ | sūcakāḥ karmakāṇḍasyārambhasyaiva tadābhavan || 1 02|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | āyayau maṇḍapaṃ śīghraṃ jayanādapravardhitaḥ || 103 || niṣasādāsane divye maṇḍape kuṇḍasannidhau | nṛpāścāgatya kuṇḍānāṃ nyaṣīdan sannidhau tadā || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne sarveṣāmāgantukānāṃ svāgatamāvāsanaṃ copakaraṇasaṃklṛptiḥ svayaṃprakāśasya haryavatārasya makhe sarvadraṣṭṛtvavidhānaṃ, maṃgalavādyaghoṣāḥ, sarveṣāṃ devīdevādīnāṃ yajñamaṇḍapāgamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 204 ||
<2.205> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike prātarmaṇḍape kuṇḍasannidhau | rāyakinnaranṛpatirditrimānāyanarṣiṇā || 1 || samaṃ samāyayau patnyā sahito yajamānakaḥ | rāyarokīśvaro rājā mahākāñcanakarṣiṇā || 2 || tathā svapatnyā sahitaḥ kuṇḍasannidhimāyayau | rāyaraṇajidbhūpaśca ālrāyasarṣiṇā samam || 3 || patnyā yutastathā kuṇḍasannidhau maṇḍape yayau | rāyavākakṣako rājā cārulāṣarṣiṇā samam || 4 || patnyā yutastathā kuṇḍasannidhau maṇḍape yayau | rāyamārīśabhūpaśca dānavarṣiyuto makhe || 5 || patnyā sākaṃ tathā kuṇḍasannidhau maṇḍape yayau | rāyabāleśvaro rājā mālāvanarṣisaṃyutaḥ || 6 || rājñyā sākaṃ yayau kuṇḍasannidhau maṇḍape tadā | rāyalambārabhūpaśca rūpartuṛṣiṇā saha || 7 || patnyā yuto yayau yajñe kuṇḍasya sannidhau tadā | rāyanavārkabhūpaśca vāśṛṃgatanukarṣiṇā || 8 || patnyā sākaṃ yayau yajñamaṇḍape kuṇḍasannidhau | rāyahuṇḍeśanṛpatirvīrākajanakarṣiṇā || 9 || samaṃ patnyā tvāyayau ca maṇḍape kuṇḍasannidhau | rāyakūpeśabhūpaśca heyatānarṣiṇā saha || 2.205.10 || patnyā sākaṃ yayau yajñamaṇḍape kuṇḍasannidhau | ityevaṃ daśa rājānau daśakuṇḍān nijīkṛtān || 11 || pratyekasyaiva kuṇḍasya niṣeduḥ sannidhau tadā | ācāryasya tadā kuṇḍe śrīharirbālanaiṣṭhikaḥ || 1 2|| lomaśena tu sahito rāyakinnarabhūbhṛtā | sapatnīkena sākaṃ vai nyaṣīdatparamāsane || 1 3|| anyakuṇḍarṣisahitā vedaprādhānikā nṛpāḥ | yathāyogyaṃ lomaśoktā niṣeduryugalātmakāḥ || 14|| rādhike devaviprāśca bhūviprāḥ satyabhūsurāḥ | prārabhanta tatastatra maṃgalāni śubhasvaraiḥ || 15|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śreṣṭhāsane sthitaḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ sarvatobhadramaṇḍale || 16|| asthāpayaddhariścaivaṃ sarvā mūrtīrnyadhāpayat | svarṇamayaṃ ca garuḍaṃ dvārapālām̐śca pārṣadān || 17|| asthāpayacchaktiyuktān harirviṣṇostu sannidhau | gaṇeśasthāpanaṃ caiśānyāṃ tu rudrasya pīṭhakam || 18|| pūrve kṣetrapīṭhaṃ cāgneyyāṃ śaktiprapīṭhakam | dakṣe gaṇeśapīṭhaṃ nairṛtyāṃ ca vāstupīṭhakam || 19|| vāyavyāṃ yoginīpīṭhaṃ snānapīṭhaṃ tathottare | grahapīṭhāni sarvāṇi koṇamadhyagagarbhake || 2.205.20 || nyasya tatra ca devām̐stānasthāpayat pareśvara | kuṇḍamaṇḍapavedīśca prokṣyadravyāṇi maṇḍape ||21 || asthāpayacca mukhyāni kaṇām̐śca samidhastathā | yavavrīhikuśān dūrvādadhicandanasarṣapān ||22|| siddhārtharocanāścāpi phalāni śarkarāstathā | gandhakusumapūgāni dhūpadīpādikām̐stathā ||23|| ācāryo lomaśastatra cakāra svastikaṃ śubham | vastrorṇāmudrikāpātramadhuparkādikām̐stathā || 24|| hiraṇyārārtrikāsnānapātraśaṃkhadharādikān | candanāgurukastūrīkarpūrakuṃkumāni ca ||25|| ājyasthālīṃ carusthālīṃ tandūlān bhājanāni ca | upavītaṃ cāsanāni mudrābhūṣāsumāni ca ||26|| tāmbūlakaṃ tathā tatrāpekṣitāni nyadhāddhariḥ | yajamānaḥ sapatnīkaḥ snānaśālāṃ yayau tataḥ ||27||| snānaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍape tvāyayau gaṇapatiṃ tataḥ | pupūja pracakārāpi mātṛśrāddhaṃ tato nṛpaḥ ||28|| mātṛpūjāṃ vidhāyātha dīkṣāṃ jagrāha vaiṣṇavīm | prāyaścittaṃ cakārātha vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ tato’karot ||29|| graharakṣāṃ dhvajāniveśanaṃ śibirabandhanam | pracakāra tataścācāryādīnāṃ varaṇaṃ nṛpaḥ ||2.205.3 0|| deśakālau samuccārya madhuparkaṃ tato’karot | ṛtvijāṃ varaṇaṃ cakre brahmaṇo varaṇaṃ tathā ||3 1 || ācāryavaraṇaṃ cāpi tathāsanāni sandado | saṃvaraṇopahārām̐śca niṣkrayaṃ dravyamityapi || 32|| varaṇaṃ jāpakānāṃ ca pāṭhakānāṃ tathāvidham | sahasrāyutakoṭīnāṃ viprāṇāṃ varaṇaṃ vyadhāt ||33|| cāturvedā brāhmaṇāśca mantrān jepurnijocitān | puṇyāhavācanaṃ cakrurviprāścāgamavedinaḥ || 34|| svastivāco’vadam̐ścāpyāśīrvādām̐śca dadustataḥ | saptarṣayastathā lakṣamitāḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ || 35|| vardhinīkalaśaṃ tīrthavāribhṛtaṃ nṛpo’mucat | svarṇa tatra pallavām̐śca ratnānyapi nyadhāttataḥ ||36|| atha śrīlomaśastatrānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | rādhālakṣmīprabhāśrīmāṇikībhūpārvatīyutam ||37|| sauvarṇa sthāpayāmāsāpūjayacca vidhānataḥ | svayaṃ śrīmadvālakṛṣṇaḥ sākṣāttatra vyarājata || 38|| śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rādhikāyuktaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ śriyāyutam | sauvarṇaṃ sthāpayāmāsa sākṣāt so’pi hyupasthitaḥ || 39|| avatārān śaktiyuktān sthāpayāmāsa vai tadā | sarve sākṣādatiṣṭhantādhvare tatra nijāsane ||2.205.40|| vāsudevādikavyūhān sthāpayāmāsa vai tadā | catvāraste gocarā vai hyupātiṣṭhanta cāpare ||41|| bhūmānaṃ ca hiraṇgarbhaṃ vairājaṃ cāvṛtīśvarān | sthāpayāmāsa te sarve sākṣāttatrāpyupasthitāḥ ||42|| svasvaśaktiyutāḥ svasvapārṣadādisamanvitāḥ | īśāno viśvasṛṭ viṣṇuḥ svasvaśaktisamanvitāḥ ||43 || āvāhitāḥ samāgatyārājanta gocarāśca te | mahāmāyā pūruṣaśca tattvānyapi ca tāttvikāḥ ||44|| śaktayaścāpi sākṣādāvāhitāścopatasthire | brahmapriyāḥ samastāścāvāhitā āyayurmakhe ||45|| sākṣātsarvā vyarājanta maṇḍape tu nijāsane | brahmā brahmapade’tiṣṭhat sākṣāllokapitāmahaḥ ||46|| rudro rudrapade’tiṣṭhaccaikādaśasvarūpavān | rudrāṇībhiryuto gaṇairgaṇeśakārtikādibhiḥ ||47|| sākṣānniṣeduḥ sauvarṇā api divyā nijāsane | āvāhitāśca pitarastathā maharṣayo’pi ca ||48|| sākṣādupasthitāstatra nijāsaneṣu cādhvare | maruto vasavaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāḥ sureśvarāḥ ||49|| digīśvarā lokapālā āvāhitāśca gocarāḥ | patnīyutāḥ samāgatya niṣeduścāsaneṣu te ||2.205.50 || siddhayo nidhayaścāpi grahāścopagrahādayaḥ | tārakāścāvāhitāśca sastriyo gocarāstadā ||5 1 || sākṣānniṣeduḥ sarve te svāsaneṣu samāhitāḥ | saptarṣayo vālakhilyāḥ kṛttikāśca diśastathā ||5 2|| ādityāḥ kāmadevaśca manavastithayastathā | āvāhitāstu sākṣātte hyupātiṣṭhanta cādhvare ||53 || nakṣatrāṇi kalāścāpi trayastriṃśatsurānugāḥ | guṇā yoginikācakraṃ tīrthāni saritastathā ||54|| sāgarā dīrghikāḥ kūpāḥ sarāṃsi parvatādayaḥ | āvāhitāścāyayuste sākṣātsarve sumūrtayaḥ ||55||| yakṣāśca rākṣasāścāpi bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācakāḥ | vināyakāśca kūṣmāṇḍā vetālādyā mahādhvare ||56 || svasvakuṭumbasahitāḥ sākṣāt tatrāyayurmakhe | āvāhitā niṣeduśca nirbhayā maṇḍape tadā ||57|| sūtamāgadhabandyādyā bhāṭacāraṇakinnarāḥ | vidyādharāḥ kiṃpuruṣā gandharvāḥ siddhakoṭayaḥ ||58|| sākṣātsamāvāhitāste cāgatā maṇḍape sthitāḥ | cāturvarṇā yatayaśca sādhavaḥ sanakādayaḥ ||59|| āvāhitā naiṣṭhikāśca sarve te maṇḍape sthitāḥ | garuḍaśca tathā haṃso hastī cāśvaśca kesarī ||2.205.60 || vṛṣabhaśconduruścaite āvāhitāḥ samāyayuḥ | dattāsaneṣu sākṣātte vyarājanta sumaṇḍape ||6 1 || hanumānādayaściraṃjīvāḥ sākṣāttu maṇḍape | āvāhitā āyayuśca sarve vai brahmavarcasaḥ ||62|| varṇāstathāśramā dharmā dharmarājo’nugānugaḥ | citraguptādisahitaḥ śrāvaṇādyaiḥ samāyutaḥ ||63|| kālaḥ samvatsarādyāśca yugā mūrtiyutāśca te | āvāhitā atiṣṭhanta maṇḍape sarvagocarāḥ ||64|| jalasthāśca sthalasthāśca jantavo’pi tṛṇādayaḥ | vallikāśca drumādyāśca kalpakandāśca mūlikā ||65|| stambādyāścāyayuścāvāhitāḥ sākṣāddhi maṇḍape | gṛhadevā grāmadevā vanadevāśca sīmagāḥ ||66|| āraṇyakāstathā devāḥ śākhātoraṇadevatāḥ | staṃbhadevā dvāradevāḥ kuṇḍadevāśca vai tadā ||67|| dehalīdevatāścāpi pālikādevatāstathā | prākāradevatāḥ sarve sarvā gopuradevatāḥ ||68|| prāṃgaṇadevatāḥ koṇadevatā bhāradevatāḥ | pāṭadevā dhvajadevā ghaṭadevāstadā makhe ||69|| daṇḍadevāḥ pīṭhadevāḥ svasvadevīsamanvitāḥ | āvāhitāstu te sākṣānmūrtimanto’bhavan sthitāḥ ||2.205.70 || dharmadevo’tha tatpatnyaḥ putrīputrasamanvitāḥ | mūrtimatyaḥ samāgatyāvāhitāstatra cāyayuḥ ||7 1|| dānavā daityavargāśca kaśyapajāḥ prajādayaḥ | pakṣiṇaḥ paśavaścāpi jantavaśca sarīsṛpāḥ ||72|| sarpā nāgādayaḥ sarve āvāhitāḥ samāyayuḥ | mūrtimanto maṇḍape te nyaṣīdan vihitāsane ||73|| sarvadhāmanivāsāśca sarvalokanivāsinaḥ | sarvasṛṣṭinivāsāścāvāhitāstatra maṇḍape ||74|| mūrtimanto hyatiṣṭhanta dattāsaneṣu cetanāḥ | jaḍāśca jaḍavargāśca dīnānāthāśca dehinaḥ ||75|| dattayogā maṇḍape te cāyayurdhanyavādinaḥ | kāśāśca kuśāśca patrāṇi śalākāḥ samidhastathā ||76|| havyānyapi ca kavyāni phalapuṣpakaṇādayaḥ | rasā dravyāṇi miṣṭāni miṣṭānnāni tvacastathā ||77|| gandhasārāṇi sarvāṇi samūrtāni tadādhvare | maṇḍape cāyayuścāvāhitāḥ sākṣāt sthitāśca te ||78|| kāmadhenugaṇāścāpi kalpavallyaśca mūrtayaḥ | kalpadrumāścāyayurvai cintāmaṇaya ityapi ||79|| mūrtimantaḥ kalpakośā akṣayapātrakoṭayaḥ | hetayaḥ śaṃkhacakrādyā makhānāṃ hetayastathā ||2.205.80 || sādhanāni samastāni pūjāṃgapātrakoṭayaḥ | āvāhitā mūrtimantaḥ sarve’tiṣṭhanta maṇḍape ||8 1 || mantrā vedāśca vidhayaḥ karmakāṇḍaprakārakāḥ | śuddhayo’pūrvadevāśca mūrtimantastu maṇḍape ||82|| āvāhitāścāyayuste’tiṣṭhanta vihitāsane | svarā vidyāḥ śāradādyā brahmavidyādikāstathā ||83 || gītayaḥ sāmasūktāni svāhāsvadhāvaṣaṭkulam | agnayaḥ sarvajātīyā ākāritāśca maṇḍape ||84|| mūrtimanto nyaṣīdan vai dattāsaneṣu te tadā | devadaityaguravaśca vyāsā vyākhyānamūrtayaḥ ||85|| tapāṃsi yogavidhayo jñānaṃ vairāgyamityapi | bhaktirvibhūtayaḥ sarvā ākāritāḥ samāyayuḥ ||86|| pratyakṣā yoṣitāṃ vargā atiṣṭhanta samūrtayaḥ | vighnā avighnarūpāste rogā arogarūpiṇaḥ ||87|| duḥkhānyadūḥkharūpāṇi ākāritāni cāyayuḥ | dharmavaṃśāstathādharmastatpatnyaścāpi vai tadā ||88|| tadvaṃśyāśca makhe te’pi saumyā bhūtvā samāyayuḥ | adharmo dharmarūpo’bhūttadā rūpaṃ vivartayan ||89|| ānandaśca sukhaṃ śāntistṛptiḥ santoṣakādayaḥ | āvāhitāścāyayuśca mūrtayo maṇḍape tadā || 2.205.90|| śabdādyā viṣayāścāpi ṣaṭkośādyāśca dehagāḥ | samūrtāścāyayuḥ sarve ākāritāstu maṇḍape ||91 || rādhike maṇḍapaścaivaṃ sarvasṛṣṭisamanvitaḥ | śobhane’nādikṛṣṇasyopasthitau divyadhāmavat ||92|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe śrīkṛṣṇavallabhe | sarvasvāmini yatrasthe tatra kiṃ pakṣapātanam ||93 || jaḍāśca cetanāścāpi jaḍacetanamiśrakāḥ | sarve vaṃśā hareḥ santi sarveṣu samavartinaḥ ||94|| rājasāstāmasāścāpi sāttvikā dehino’pi ca | santaścidaśca sarve vai ānandā mūrtiyoginaḥ ||95|| āvāhitāścāyayuste nyaṣīdan vai sumaṇḍape | dātā hotā svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ parameśaḥ sanātanaḥ ||96 || tatra nyūnaṃ na vai cāsti saṃkoco’pi vikāsitaḥ | dāridryaṃ prāptamevodāratāṃ vivartitaṃ tadā||97|| nakāro’pi gatastatra hākāratāṃ vivartitaḥ | saṃśayo’pi gatastatra niścayatāṃ vivartitaḥ ||98|| bhayaṃ vivṛttaṃ sahasāprāpannirbhayatāṃ tadā | nyūnatveṃ vivṛtaṃ cāpyadhikatāṃ tu samāsadat ||99|| ityevaṃ rādhike tatra maṇḍape devatādikāḥ | mūrtimantaḥ samāgatya niṣeduḥ sthāpane nije || 2.205.10 0|| ya evādṛśyarūpaiśca grahītārasta eva ha | sākṣādupasthitāstatra bālakṛṣṇecchayākhilāḥ || 10 1|| ityevaṃ sarvadevānāṃ daśakuṇḍeṣu maṇḍape | yathāpekṣamabhūd rādhe sthāpanā vedikādiṣu || 1 02|| sarve nṛpāstathākurvan karma yajñīyameva tat | tataḥ pūjā pravṛttā ca tattadṛṣipraṇoditā || 103|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne rājñāmṛṣīṇāṃ maṇḍape samāgamanaṃ devapīṭhānāṃ sthāpanā, ṛtvigācāryādivaraṇaṃ, pratyakṣadevānāṃ virājamānatā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 205 ||
<2.206> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike maṇḍape kṛṣṇaḥ sauvarṇau pitarau tathā | sūryaṃ candraṃ śaṃkaraṃ ca satīṃ gaṃgāṃ vyatiṣṭhipat || 1 || anādiśrībālakṛṣṇaṃ lomaśoktavidhānataḥ | rāyakinnararājaḥ saṃpūjayat parameśvaram || 2 || mātaraṃ pitaraṃ cāpi harestatrāpyapūjayat | āvāhanaṃ cāsanaṃ ca pādyamarghyaṃ dadau tadā || 3 || dadāvācamanaṃ vāri śaucārthaṃ vāri cetyapi | śuddhyarthaṃ ca tato dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ ca śarkarām || 4 || madhu dadau tataścābhiṣekārthaṃ tīrthavāri ca | vastrāmārjanamevāpi sugandhitailamardanam || 59 || vastrābhūṣāpradānaṃ candanākṣatagulālakam | puṣpahārān kajjalādi dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca kuṃkumam || 6 || tulasīṃ padmahārām̐śca naivedyaṃ copavītakam | chatraṃ cāmaravyajane naivedyaṃ phalamuttamam || 7 || jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ cārārtrikaṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadau | stutiṃ
