kṣamāṃ namaskāraṃ daṇḍavat kusumāñjalim || 8 || dadau pūjāprakāraiśca samarcya śrīnarāyaṇam | tato’vatārān muktām̐śceśvarān devān munīn surān || 9 || pitṝn devīrdevatāśca pūjayāmāsa pārthivaḥ | cakāra ca tataḥ prāyaścittāṃgaṃ vyāhṛterhavam || 1 0|| viṣṇuśrāddhaṃ cakārātha cakre mukhāvalokanam | ājyapātrasya dānaṃ cācāryāya pradadau nṛpaḥ || 11 || śuśrāva śāntipāṭhāṃśca viprakṛtān sukhāvahān | svastipāṭhān māṃgalikān śrutvā vavanda vai gurum || 12|| lomaśarṣistataścakre pradhānaṃ makhakarmaṇaḥ | saṃkalpaṃ cāṃgasaṃkalpaṃ kārayāmāsa taṃ nṛpam || 13 || bhūmikūrmānantapūjāṃ dīpasthānaṃ nṛpo vyadhāt | cakre digrakṣaṇaṃ vāme kare tvādāya sarṣapān || 14|| vikīrya sarvatobhāge’ghātayadvāmapāṇinā | bhūmiṃ cātha tataścakre kalaśārādhanaṃ nṛpaḥ || 15|| jale tīrthāni cāvāhya dehe sve prokṣaṇaṃ vyadhāt | pañcagavyena yajñasya saṃbhāraprokṣaṇaṃ vyadhāt || 16|| gaṇeśapūjanaṃ cakre sākṣād dūrvādibhistathā | ṣoḍaśabhistūpacārairathāvaraṇapūjanam || 17|| cakre tataśca gauryādimātṛkāpūjanaṃ vyadhāt | brāhmyādimātṛkāpūjā kṛtvā rājā tato’karot || 18|| nāndīśrāddhaṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikārakam | athārghavandanaṃ cakre kalaśe sūtraveṣṭanam || 1 9|| oṣadhipuṣpaniḥkṣepaṃ pañcapallavaratnakam | cikṣepa ca phalaṃ svarṇaṃ mṛttikāṃ dhānyadūrvikām || 20|| tataścācāryavaraṇaṃ brahmādivaraṇaṃ punaḥ | gaṇeśavaraṇaṃ dvārapālavaraṇamācarat ||2 1 || ṛtvijāṃ varaṇaṃ cakre madhuparkārhaṇaṃ vyadhāt | madhuparkaprāśanaṃ ca vyadhādācamanaṃ tataḥ |||22|| goniṣkrayaṃ dhanaṃ rājā dadau viprāya vai tadā | prārthayacca guruṃ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaṃ ca lomaśam ||23 || bhūbhṛtastilakaṃ cakre lomaśarṣistadā tataḥ rājñyā babandha ca vāme kare rakṣārthasūtrakam || 24|| kaṃkaṇaṃ vā tataścāpi puṇyāhavācanaṃ vyadhāt | sajalaṃ kalaśaṃ pūrṇapātrayuktaṃ tu dhānyake || 25 || nyadhāt| pupūja kalaśaṃ tajjalaistarpaṇaṃ vyadhāt | yajamānābhiṣekaṃ ca lomaśaḥ samavartayat || 26|| vardhanīkalaśasyāpi sthāpanaṃ pracakāra ha | rājā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya maṇḍape taṃ nyaveśayat || 27|| jalayātrāṃ lomaśaścākārayat kalaśānvitām | saubhāgyābhiśca nārībhirvādyayānasukīrtanaiḥ |||28|| tīrthe sampūjya varuṇaṃ gaṇeśaṃ jalamātaram | jalaṃ pupūja ca jīvamātaraṃ sthalamātaram || 29|| matsyī kūrmī ca vārāhī dardurī makarī tathā | jalūkī cāpi tantūkī tṛpyantāṃ jalamātaraḥ || 2.206.30 || kumārī dhanadā nandā vimalā maṃgalā calā | padmā ceti pratṛpyantāṃ saptaitā jīvamātṛkāḥ || 31 || urmīrlakṣmīrmahāmāyā pānadevī ca vāruṇī | nirmalā ca tathā godhā tṛpyantāṃ sthalamātaraḥ ||3 2|| tato’rcayaccatuḥṣaṣṭiyoginīcakramityapi | kṣetrapālaṃ tīrthagaṇaṃ varuṇaṃ samapūjayat ||3 3 || kalaśasthāpanaṃ cakre kṣetrapālaprapūjanam | tato maṇḍapamāgatya kalaśena samanvitaḥ ||34|| rājā ca dvāraśākhādhiṣṭhātṛdevānapūjayat | dehalīṃ māḍalaśobhāṃ kṛtvā vāstuṃ praṇamya ca ||35|| vāstusthāpanamevāpi lomaṣarṣistadākarot | vāstupīṭhaṃ vidhāyāpi gaṇeśaṃ samapūjayat ||36 || vāstudevān catuḥṣaṣṭisaṃkhyākān lomaśo muniḥ | āvāhya ca samabhyarcya kalaśaṃ samapūjayat || 37|| kalaśe vāstumūrtiṃ cāpūjayat ṣoḍaśādibhiḥ | bahirhomaṃ vidhāyātha baliṃ tasmai dadāvṛṣiḥ ||38|| maṇḍapasya tataḥ pūjāṃ stambhapūjāṃ samācarat | sarvakoṇastambhadevān madhyadevānapūjayat ||3 9|| dvāratoraṇadevām̐ścāpūjayannṛpatistataḥ | vedapūjāṃ cihnapūjāṃ śākhāpūjāmathākarot ||2.206.40|| kalaśe śākhino devānapūjayadvidhānataḥ | bhūtādibhyo māṣabalimārpayat sannyavartayat ||41 || sarvatobhadrakaṃ ramyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ devatāyutam | apūjayat trayastriṃśaddevatāstatra maṇḍale ||42|| madhye’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tamavatāriṇam | sarvapatnīyutaṃ rādhākṛṣṇaṃ śrīmannarāyaṇam ||43|| avatārān śaktiyuktānīśvarānapyapūjayat | īśvarāṇīstathā sarvā anyaśaktīrapūjayat ||44|| muktān muktānikāścāpi dhāmākṣaraṃ hyapūjayat | śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rādhikāyuktaṃ gopagopīgaṇānvitam ||45|| apūjayattadā dāsīpatnīpriyāsamanvitam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ pārṣadairgaruḍena ca ||46|| ramābhiśca pārṣadānībhiśca pupūja bhūpatiḥ | gaṇeśapūjanaṃ cakre vāstudevaprapūjanam ||47|| īśvarāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ ca cakāra bhūpatistataḥ | brahmāṇaṃ ca tathā somamīśānamindramityapi ||48|| agniṃ vaivasvataṃ rakṣo varuṇaṃ samapūjayat | vāyuṃ kuberaṃ ca vasūn rudrānekādaśāpi ca ||49|| ādityān dvādaśa caivāśvinau tatrāpyapūjayat | pitṝm̐śca viśvadevām̐śca saptayajñānapūjayat ||2.206.50 || sarpān gandharvakānapsarasaḥ skandamapūjayat | nandīśvaraṃ mahākālaṃ śūlaṃ dakṣādisaptakam ||51|| apūjayattathā durgāṃ viṣṇuṃ ca vaiṣṇavīṃ tathā | svadhāṃ svāhāṃ mṛtyurogau gaṇeśaṃ samapūjayat |||52|| varuṇaṃ ca makheśaṃ ca marutaḥ samapūjayat | pṛthivīṃ ca nadīṃ gaṃgāṃ saritaścāpyapūjayat ||53 || sāgarān sapta meruṃ ca pārthivaḥ samapūjayat| | āyudhāni samastāni tīrthāni samapūjayat ||54|| vibhūṣaṇāni divyāni mūrtimanti hyapūjayat | bhāradvājādikān maharṣivaryānapyapūjayat ||55|| arundhatīṃ tathā cānyā devīstatrāpyapūjayat | sarvadikpālapatnīśca rājā samyagapūjayat ||56|| īśvarān sarvapitṝm̐śca munīn devānṛṣīṃstathā | sādhūn sādhvīḥ sāṃkhyayoginīśca sarvā hyapūjayat ||57|| bhuvarlokanivāsām̐śca kuṣmāṇḍakān vināyakān | vetālān rākṣasām̐ścāpi pretān sarvānapūjayat ||58|| yamadūtān dharmavaṃśyān adharmavaṃśajānapi | nārīrnarān nṛpatiḥ saḥ sarvāṃstatra hyapūjayat ||59|| parvatān vanavṛkṣām̐śca vallīśca tṛṇajātikān | stabakān vaṃśajātīyān rasadānapyapūjayat ||2.206.60 || mūlakandān phalivṛkṣān jarāyūjāṃstathāṇḍajān | jantūn sūkṣmān viśālām̐śca yādovāsānapūjayat ||6 1 || svedajān kāśyapīḥ sarvāḥ prajāścāpyatyapūjayat | sthalajān vāyujām̐ścāpi vahnijān khātajānapi ||6 2|| pārthivān dehino vārijātān sarvānapūjayat | sāttvikān malinān rājasām̐śca tāmasadehinaḥ ||63 || apūjayattadā dīnānāthān bhikṣukānapi | anāśritān parādhīnān parabhāgyopajīvinaḥ ||64|| bhṛtyavargān dūravargān dāsavargānapūjayat | kalājñān śilpavetṝm̐śca nāṭyanartanakārakān ||65|| sūtamāgadhabandyādīn kathākārānapūjayat | jaḍān tattvaviśeṣāṃśca guṇān svarānapūrvakān ||66|| mantrān sarvān viṣayām̐śca bhūpatiḥ samapūjayat| | gītikā vedamūrtīśca yajñapātrāṇi satkaṇān ||67|| sasyāni samidhaḥ sarvān havyānyapi tvapūjayat | yāni yāni tadā yajñamaṇḍape hariṇā svayam ||68|| āmantritāni bhūtāni cāgatāni samutsave | api nikṛṣṭanāmāni nikṛṣṭadehavantyapi ||69|| pareśvaro nijāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ nijāpatyasvarūpiṇīm | sarvāṃ śrīvaiṣṇave naije yajñe hyapūjayattadā ||2.206.70|| pātālasthān daityagaṇān dānavān nāgavigrahān | dhāmalokanivāsām̐śca maṇḍape vai samāgatān ||71 || sarvānapūjayat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sukhapradaḥ | api kīṭapataṃgādyān pūjayitvā hariḥ svayam ||72|| sarvebhyo’rpya baliṃ cātarpayadvai nijake’dhvare | saṃkarṣaṇādikām̐ścāpi sanakādyām̐śca yoginaḥ ||73|| viśvaksenādikān sarvān pārṣadān yantradevatāḥ | śukādīn jñānayogām̐śca matsyādīn keśavānapi ||74|| praṇavādīn śāradām̐ścāvatārān ṛṣabhādikān | viśvāmitrādikān sarvānapūjayattadā nṛpaḥ ||75|| brāhmyādikāḥ śaktirūpā aṇimāsiddhikāstathā | dikpālān cāyudhānyeva vedān gaṃgādikāstathā ||76|| mantradevān kuṭumbāḍhyān pūjayattadā nṛpaḥ | tato’gnyuttāraṇa cakre mūrtānāṃ ghṛtalepanam ||77|| jaladhārābhiṣekaṃ ca kṛtvā prāṇān sa bījakān | iha prāṇāśca āṃ hrīṃ krauṃ yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃśaṃṣaṃsaṃham ||78|| saḥso’hamiti mantrādyairnyāsairbījairayojayat | evaṃ sauvarṇamūrtīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ tatra maṇḍape ||79|| sthāpitānāṃ hariścāpi pūjāṃ cakāra vai punaḥ | nijāṃ nijapituścāpi nijamātustathā svasuḥ ||2.206.80|| bhrātṝṇāṃ ca gaṇeśasya rādhākṛṣṇasya vai tathā | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasyāpi padmāyāśca tathā śubhām ||8 1|| ramāyāśca tathā māṇikyāyāstathā ca kānakīm | sūryasyāpi ca candrasyeśānasyāpi ca kānakīm |||82||| satyāśca kānakīṃ mūrtiṃ pratiṣṭhārthamapūjayat | ṣoḍaśaprāṇavāsārthaṃ mūrtīḥ sarvā apūjayat ||83|| brahmasṛṣṭimīśasṛṣṭiṃ jīvasṛṣṭimatho’smarat | tatrāvatāramūrtīnāṃ tadā kṛṣṇaḥ smṛtiṃ vyadhāt ||84|| sarvāvatārāścāgatya maṇḍape pratimādiṣu | atiṣṭhanta hi divyāste sarvatattvamayāḥ surāḥ ||85|| evaṃ vai vidhinā mūrtīḥ pratiṣṭhāpya sajīvikāḥ | cetanāstā vidhāyaiva prāviśad bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||86|| tataścakre pīṭhapūjāṃ rājā kṛṣṇānumoditaḥ | paradevatāpūjāṃ ca guroḥ pūjāṃ cakāra saḥ ||87|| vedavyāsaṃ ca garuḍaṃ durgāṃ sarasvatīṃ tathā | yamaṃ vāyuṃ śivaṃ cendraṃ nirṛtiṃ rudramārcayat ||88|| śaktiṃ kūrmamanantaṃ ca pṛthvīmadrimapūjayat | kṣīrābdhiṃ śvetadvīpaṃ ca maṇḍapaṃ padmamārcayat ||89|| sūryamaṇḍalamevāpi hiraṇmayaṃ narāyaṇam | somamaṇḍalamevāpi viṣṇuṃ divyaṃ narāyaṇam ||2.206.90 || hutāśane’gnidevaṃ ca nṛsiṃhaṃ ca narāyaṇam | sattvaśriyaṃ rajobhūmiṃ tamodurgāmapūjayat || 91 || ātmānaṃ cāntarātmānaṃ parātmānamapūjayat | jñānātmānaṃ vimalādyāḥ pīṭhaśaktīrapūjayat ||92|| pradhānapuruṣaṃ prakṛtipūruṣamapūjayat | kuṇḍasya pūjanaṃ cāpi viśvakarmaprapūjanam || 93|| mekhalādevatā viṣṇubrahmarudrānapūjayat | yonipūjāṃ kaṇṭhapūjāṃ nābhipūjāmathākarot ||94|| vāstudevām̐stathā brahmādīn vedān kacchapādikān | apūjayattadā rājā rāyakinnarasaṃjñakaḥ ||95|| dharmādikān pūjayitvā cakre’gnisthāpanaṃ tataḥ | sampuṭe’gniṃ samāhṛtya bhrāmayitvā trireva tam ||96 || agnimasthāpayat kuṇḍe dakṣe svāhāṃ svadhāṃ pare | samārcayacca vidhinā praṇītānayanaṃ tataḥ ||97|| paristaraṇamevāpi pātrāsādanamityapi | pavitrīkaraṇaṃ cāpi tathā vāryabhiṣecanam ||98|| uttānaṃ coddiganaṃ ca prokṣaṇaṃ kṣālanaṃ tathā | sekaścarvadhiśrayaṇaṃ paryagnikaraṇaṃ tathā ||99|| cakāra lomaśo devo grahasthāpanamācarat | navagrahānārcayaccādhidevānārcayattathā || 2.206.100 || pratyadhidevatārhāṃ ca lokapālārhaṇāṃ tataḥ | kṣetrapālasthāpanaṃ ca dikpālasthāpanaṃ tathā || 101 || mahārudrasthāpanaṃ ca teṣāṃ pūjanamācarat | catuḥṣaṣṭiyoginīnāṃ pūjanaṃ cākarottataḥ || 1 02|| pañcāśatkṣetrapālānāṃ pūjanaṃ ca tato’karot | parameśaṃ cāvatārānīśvarān devatāstathā || 103 || dadhyau rājā tu tilakaṃ hyakārayaddharestadā | tulasīmālikāṃ cāpi dadau mālāṃ dadau tataḥ || 1 04|| śaṃkhaṃ cakrādikaṃ datvāpūjayannṛpatiśca vai | matsyacihnaṃ triśūlaṃ ca dhanuṣaṃ bāṇamityapi || 1 05|| svastikaṃ ca dhvajaṃ cakraṃ vajraṃ cāpūjayattataḥ | ghaṇṭāpūjāmācaracca kalaśārhāṃ samācarat || 1 06|| bhūśuddhiṃ lomaśastaṃ cākārayad vai namastathā | āsanaṃ ca śikhāyā bandhanaṃ digbandhanaṃ tathā || 1 07|| tālatrayaṃ tathā bhūmitāḍanaṃ triḥ samācarat | bhūtaśuddhiṃ prācaracca kuṇḍalinīmapūjayat || 1 08|| ṣaṭcakrāṇi pūjayitvā jīvaṃ brahmāpyapūjayat | pāpapuruṣadāhaṃ ca dhyātvā rājākarottadā || 1 09|| śarīrāplavanaṃ cakre tathātmaśodhanaṃ nṛpaḥ | prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ sanyāsāṃ bījākṣarayutāṃ tathā || 2.206.110 || pāṭhaśaktisahitāṃ ca kṛtvā pūjanamācarat | pañcāvaraṇadevārhāṃ prāṇasthāpanamityapi || 111 || athāntarmātṛkānyāsān bahirmātṛkanyāsanam | ekādaśa tathā nyāsān śrīhareśca samācarat || 11 2|| pātrāsādanamevāpi dīpadānamathācarat | kalārhaṇāṃ tathārghaṃ ca kṛtvā datvā viśeṣataḥ || 113 || pādyārghyācamanaprokṣaṇīmadhuparkapātrakam | vidhināpūjayad rājā rādhike maṇḍape makhe || 1 14|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne sauvarṇīmūrtipūjā gaṇeśapūjā kalaśasthāpanaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vāstusthāpanaṃ sarveśvareśvaradevādipūjā kuṇḍamaṇḍapaśākhādidevadevīyoginīkṣetrapālātmādipūjā dehaśuddhyādibrahmapūjāgnisthāpanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 206 ||
<2.207> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śrīpatiṃ rādhike rājānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | apūjayanmahāmahopacāraiḥ sakuṭumbakam || 1 || dhyānamāvāhanaṃ samyagāsanaṃ pādyamarghyakam | ācamanaṃ madhuparkaṃ payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ madhu || 2 || śarkarāṃ pradadau tasmai cābhyaṃgaṃ nirmalodakam | abhiṣekaṃ sugandhāḍhyaṃ vastrāmārjanamādadau || 3 || vastraṃ yajñopavītaṃ cālaṃkārān mālikāṃ dadau | gandhasāraṃ kuṃkumaṃ ca kajjalaṃ cākṣatān dadau || 4 || puṣpamañjarikāścāpi tulasīpatramādadau | aṃgapūjāṃ kṛtavām̐ścāvaraṇānā prapūjanam || 5 || śrīharestatsevikānāṃ vyūhānāṃ ca prapūjanam | pārṣadānāmavatāramūrtīnāṃ ca prapūjanam || 6 || tathāvatāriṇīnāṃ pūjanaṃ pārṣadapūjanam | hetīnāṃ ca tadaiśvaryavibhūtīnāṃ prapūjanam || 7 || vāhanānāṃ tathā bhṛtyadāsānāṃ ca prapūjanam | dāsīnāṃ putrapautrāṇāṃ kuṭumbānāṃ prapūjanam || 8 || gṛhapālārhaṇaṃ dvārapālārhaṇaṃ cakāra ha | śvetacūrṇaṃ raktacūrṇaṃ sindūrakaṃ haridrikām || 9 || dhūpaṃ dīpamalaktaṃ ca naivedyaṃ ca jalaṃ phalam | apośanaṃ karodvarttaṃ tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadau || 2.207.1 0|| chatraṃ cāmarakaṃ cāpi vyajanaṃ darpaṇaṃ dadau | pāduke sarvaśṛṃgāraṃ dadau nīrājanaṃ tataḥ || 11 || vastranīrājanaṃ vārinīrājanaṃ namaḥkriyām | pradakṣiṇāṃ daṇḍavacca stutiṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ dadau || 12|| atha homaṃ tato vahnau cakāra nṛpatiḥ svayam | ādāvadhiśrite caroḥ sruvasya tapanaṃ vyadhāt || 13|| mārjanaṃ cābhyukṣaṇaṃ ca tapanaṃ ca nidhānakam | ājyodvāsanamevāpi carorudvāsanaṃ tathā || 14|| pavitrābhyāṃ tata ājyotpavanaṃ cāpyavekṣaṇam | apadravyanirāsaṃ ca prokṣiṇyutpavanaṃ tathā || 15|| paryukṣaṇaṃ nidhānaṃ ca kṛtvā homaṃ dadau nṛpaḥ | āghārāvājyabhāgau ca brahmā home dadau tadā || 16|| samiccarutilājyādihavirdravyāṇi sandadau | pareśāya maheśāya prajānāṃ pataye tathā || 17|| dikpālebhyastatheśebhyo lokapālebhya ityapi | navagrahebhyo devebhyaḥ pratyadhidevakoṭaye || 18|| adhidevebhya evāpi homaṃ dadau nṛpastadā | vāstumaṇḍaladevebhyo homaṃ dadau tataḥ param || 19|| samittilān pāyasādīnudumbarasamidvarāḥ | aśvatthādīn ghṛtamadhukṣīrāṇi pradadau tadā ||2.207.20|| tathāmaṇḍaladevānāṃ homaṃ dadau yathocitam | phalairbhinnairvibhinnaiśca dravyairhomaṃ dadau nṛpaḥ ||21 || brahmādidevatābhyaśca homaṃ dadau ghṛtādibhiḥ | pīṭhadevatābhyaścāpi homaṃ dadau ghṛtādibhiḥ ||22|| tataḥ samittilājyaiśca caruṇā pāyasena vai | homaṃ pradhānaṃ pradadau sahasrāyutameva ca || 23|| āvaraṇasurebhyaśca homaṃ dadau tato nṛpaḥ | drākṣekṣupūganāriṃgaistilājyairvyāhṛterhavam ||24|| dadau ca jambiraṃ bījapūrakaṃ khārikāṃ tathā | nārikelaṃ dāḍimaṃ ca guggulaṃ sarṣapādikān ||25|| lakṣmyai dadau tato dugdhaṃ śarkarākadalīghṛtam | phaladūrvākṣatām̐ścāpi homaṃ cakre nṛpaḥ svayam || 26|| gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca dadau tataḥ | brahmā dadau tataḥ sviṣṭakṛddhomaṃ ca navāhutīn || 27|| sarvebhyaśca surebhyaśca balidānaṃ yathocitam | dikpālebhyo dīpayuktaṃ pāyasānnaṃ baliṃ dadau ||28|| gaṇeśāya ca mātṛbhyo vāstudevebhya eva ca | vāstupuṃse tathādityādibhyo baliṃ dadau nṛpaḥ ||29|| yoginībhyaḥ kṣetrapālebhyaśca baliṃ dadau nṛpaḥ | maṇḍalasya pradhānasya devebhyo’pi baliṃ dadau ||2.207.30|| ṣaṭapaṃcāśaddevatābhyo baliṃ dadau sapūjanam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇarādhākṛṣṇābhyāṃ ca baliṃ dadau ||3 1 || naranārāyaṇavāsudevanārāyaṇāya ca | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svabaliṃ dadau ||32|| sarvābhyaśca hareḥ śaktibhyaśca baliṃ dadau nṛpaḥ | brahmapriyābhyaḥ sarvābhyo baliṃ rājā dadau tataḥ ||33|| dhāmapālabaliṃ cāpi dārapālabaliṃ tathā | sṛṣṭipālabaliṃ cāpi kṣetrapālabaliṃ dadau ||34|| nagaragrāmakṣetrādisthitebhyo’pi baliṃ dadau | gṛhāraṇyavanasthebhyo baliṃ rājā dadau tataḥ ||35|| pātālādisthitebhyaśca bhūmisvarvāsine tathā | bhuvarlokasthitebhya satyāntebhyo baliṃ dadau ||36|| āvaraṇasthitebhyaśca vairājalokavāsine | hiraṇmayāvyākṛtagolokavāsebhya ādadau ||37|| vaikuṇṭhākṣaradhāmasthamāyāsthebhyo baliṃ dadau | cetanebhyo jaḍebhyaśca dehyadehibhya ityapi ||38|| baliṃ dadau tadā rājā tattvebhyaśca yathocitam | śreṣṭhebhyaśca kaniṣṭhebhyo dadau baliṃ yathocitam ||39|| āmantritebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sthitebhyo maṇḍape tadā | naranārīsametebhyo baliṃ rājā dadau śubham ||2.207.40|| āmantritā ye cāgatā anāgatāstathādhvare | sakuṭumbāḥ sabhṛtyāśca sadāsāḥ sānugāstathā ||41 || sapatnīkāḥ savaṃśāśca sattvarajastamonvitāḥ | triguṇebhyaśca ye jātāḥ sādhyāḥ sādhanarūpiṇaḥ ||42|| yajñātmakā yajñadehā yajñāṃgāni makhāśritāḥ | sarvebhyastatra rājāsau baliṃ yathocitaṃ dadau ||43|| sarvakuṇḍeṣu rājānastattadgurvarṣinoditāḥ | dadurbaliṃ tathaivaite sarvaṃ karma vyadhustathā ||44|| grāhakā bhojakāścāpi ye cāhutyadanāḥ surāḥ | asurā vā mūrtimanto jagṛhuḥ svabaliṃ kare ||45|| pratyakṣaṃ te bhuktavantaḥ pratyakṣāḥ svakṣaṇe’nale | sarve vai dehinastatra bhuñjānāstṛptimāyayuḥ |||46|| yeṣāṃ yeṣāṃ yadannaṃ tat tatra tatra yathocitam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ saṃkalpya vai dadau ||47|| ākaṇṭhatṛptāḥ sarve te sṛṣṭitrayanivāsinaḥ | māyā tattvāni māyotthā māyikā dehinastathā ||48|| ātmā tattvāni cātmotthā ātmīyā dehinastathā | īśastattvāni ceśotthā īśīyā dehinastathā ||49|| muktāstattvāni muktotthā muktīyā dehinastathā | brahmatattvāni brahmotthā brahmīyā dehinastathā ||2.207.50 || śaktistattvāni śaktyutthāḥ śaktīyā dehinastathā | guṇauśvaryāyudhabhūṣādikā ye kecanāpi ca |||51|| sarvebhyaḥ śrīharistatra baliṃ datvā hyatarpayat | tṛptiṃ vai śāśvatīṃ naijāṃ dadau sarveśvaraḥ prabhuḥ ||52|| sarve codgāramāpannā ākaṇṭhabhakṣaṇāstathā | bahutṛptiṃ gatāstatra parameśamakhe janāḥ ||53|| jarāyūjāścāṇḍajāścodbhijjāḥ svedajanāstathā | bhautikāḥ kośajāścāpi kardamotthā rasotthitāḥ ||54|| sarve tṛptiṃ gatāstatra bālakṛṣṇamakhe’nale | athāntimāhutiṃ prādāllomaśastatra kuṇḍake ||55|| vasordhārāyutaṃ bahvāhutihomaṃ cakāra saḥ | parihāraṃ tataścakre devānāṃ śayanaṃ vyadhāt ||56 || evaṃ nityaṃ bhavatyeva rādhike’rhā havādikam | āmadhyāntaṃ tataḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇādayaśca te ||57|| cakrire bhojanānyeva mahīmānādayastathā | sarvaprajā bhojanāni cakrire nityameva ha ||5 8|| saptamyāṃ cāpi cāṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ daśamīdine | ekādaśyāṃ makhakāryaṃ nityaṃ pravartate tathā ||59|| bhojanāni vicitrāṇi nityaṃ bhavanti tatra ca | asaṃkhyadehinastatra bhuṃjate sma divāniśam ||2.207.6 0 || dīyatāṃ dīyatāmiti bhujyatāṃ bhujyatāmiti | ghoṣaṇā tvannadānasya satataṃ vai pravartate ||6 1 || annapūrṇā tathā lakṣmīstaddāsyo’nekaśaktayaḥ | sevante tvannadānādyairyathālokamapekṣitaiḥ ||62|| kalpalatāḥ kalpadrumāḥ kalpagāvo nirantaram | kalpakanyāstathā cintāmaṇayaḥ kalpacullikāḥ ||6 3 || kalpahradāḥ kalpapātrāṇyapi kalpanadādayaḥ | kalpapeṭāḥ pūrayanti ceṣṭabhojyāni cārthiṣu ||64|| bhojanānte janāḥ sarve viśrāmyanti viśeṣataḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastu bhūbhṛdarthitaḥ ||65 || āmantraṇānusāreṇa prayāti rājamandiram | punaḥ sāyaṃ maṇḍape’tra samāyāti vimānataḥ ||66|| evaṃ pañcadinaṃ rāṣṭre bhramaṇaṃ hariṇā kṛtam | pāvitāni samastāni rāṣṭrāṇi gamanakramāt ||67|| makhe dadāti bhagavān dakṣiṇāḥ koṭiśastathā | makhād bahiścārpayati yatheṣṭaṃ tvarthine’pi saḥ ||68|| deyaṃ deyaṃ ca dātavyaṃ śabdastvevaṃ hi sārthakaḥ | hareragre jāyate vai sarvayajñaphalapradaḥ ||69|| yatheṣṭaṃ dīyate nityaṃ rājāno’pi dadatyapi | prajāścāvasaraṃ prāpya dadatyapi dhanānyapi ||2.207.70|| gṛhadānāni ca kanyādānāni bahudhā vyadhuḥ | vidyābhūṣāmbaradānānyapi vyadhuḥ prajājanāḥ ||71 || yatra svāmī parabrahma śrīpatiḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | kartā dātā ca bhoktā ca tatrāśubhaṃ na vai kvacit ||72|| vighnaṃ nāsti niṣedhaśca nāsti yatra prabhāpatiḥ | kālo nāsti yamo nāsti bandho nāsti pareśvare ||73|| sūtakaṃ na ca śoko na na vāpaśakunānyapi | kumuhūrtaṃ ca naivāsti yatra śrīpārvatīśvaraḥ ||74|| sarvaṃ śubhaṃ bhavatyeva yatra lakṣmīpatiḥ prabhuḥ | sarvaṃ puṣṭaṃ bhavatyeva yatra śrīmāṇikīpatiḥ ||75|| sarvaṃ daivaṃ bhavatyevānukūlaṃ priyamityapi | sarvaṃ sampatpradaṃ cāste yatra devaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||76|| sarvaṃ tu maṃgalaṃ tatra jāyate yatra mādhavaḥ | viruddhā yadvaśe santi ko virodho’sya sannidhau ||77|| rādhike śrīhariścaivaṃ makhotsavaṃ vyadhācchubham | saptamyāmatha madhyāhnottaraṃ bhuktyuttaraṃ nṛpaḥ ||78|| rāyaraṇajidbhūpaśca prārthayatparameśvaram | nijaṃ rāṣṭraṃ pāvayituṃ samāyāhīti vai tataḥ ||79|| hariḥ prāha tathāstveva sajjastūrṇaṃ tadābhavat | ālāyasarṣimunirāṭ raṇajinnṛpatistathā ||2.207.80 || śīghramājñāṃ hareḥ prāpya vimānena nijālayam | ālākṣākapradeśasthaṃ mīnārkakṛṣṇapattanam ||8 1|| yūkāsanānadītīragataṃ gatvāgratastadā | śīghraṃ sainyādisahitaṃ vādyamaṇḍalatatparam |||82|| janatāpūrarājaccāśṛṃgārayad yathocitam | svāgatārthaṃ sopadāśca janatā rājasevikāḥ ||83|| śīghraṃ śīghraṃ copatasthurnṛpodyāne mahāyate | tadā vādyānyavādyanta dhvajā dhṛtāstathāmbare ||84|| tūpaśabdāḥ prābhavam̐śca śrīhareḥ svāgatāya vai | ghaṭikāyāṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ śṛṃgāritaṃ nṛpeṇa ha ||85|| tāvacchrīkāntabhagavān pitṛbhyāṃ śaṃkareṇa ca| lomaśena tatheśaiścāvatāraiśca sureśvaraiḥ ||86|| yathāpekṣaiḥ saha śīghraṃ rādhālakṣmyādibhistathā | naijaṃ vimānamāruhya prakāśayan diśo daśa ||87|| yayau yūkāsanātīre mīnārkakṛṣṇapattanam | dṛṣṭvā śrīmatsūryatulyaṃ vimānaṃ pārameśvaram ||88|| rāyaraṇajidbhūpaśca ālāyasarṣisattamaḥ | vimānāvataraṇārthaṃ dadatuḥ sthalasūcanām ||89|| bhramitvāmbaramevaitad vimānaṃ tadavātarat | tadā vādyāni tūryāṇi cāvādyanta muhurmuhuḥ || 2.207.90 || jayaśabdā harṣanādāḥ prajānāmabhavan śubhāḥ | dudruvuścātivegena darśanārthaṃ samīpagāḥ ||91|| prajājanā vardhayanti lājākṣatasugandhakaiḥ | kusumaiścāñjalibhiśca netravṛttyarpaṇaistathā ||92|| bhāvadānaiḥ svāgatādyairvardhayāmāsuracyutam | rādhike bhūbhṛtā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vimānataḥ ||93|| haste hastaṃ gṛhītvaivānīto’tibhāvato bahiḥ | rājā puṣpasrajaṃ kaṇṭhe bālakṛṣṇasya vai dadau ||94|| ṛṣiścandanadānenāpūjayat parameśvaram | rājaputrādayo’pyenaṃ samānarcuḥ sumādibhiḥ ||95|| vimānāgre kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā datvā naijaṃ ca darśanam | avatīrya hariḥ pūjāṃ jagrāha janatākṛtām ||96|| sarvāḥ prajāḥ sukhaṃ prāptāḥ pūjayā darśanena ca | tato nṛpālayāntarvai praviveśa śubhāsane ||97|| niṣasāda hariścānye niṣeduryogyakāsane | rājā rājñī rājaputryaḥ kumārāśca kuṭumbinaḥ ||98|| pupūjuḥ parayā prītyā śrīpatiṃ kṛṣṇavallabham | daśalakṣaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca dadau rājātibhāvataḥ ||99|| koṭimūlyān hīrakām̐śca dadau kṛṣṇāya bhūpatiḥ | kanyakā viṃśatiḥ kṛṣṇagale nyadhurhi mālikāḥ || 2.207.1 00|| rājñī dadau tadā śrīmadbālakṛṣṇāya tāḥ sutāḥ | viṃśatiḥ kanyakā prāpya bālakṛṣṇaṃ pati prabhum || 101 || kṛtakṛtyā abhavam̐śca harirdugdhaṃ papau tadā | tato mīnārkakṛṣṇākhye pattane śvetahastinā || 1 02|| vijahāra mahāsainyasammānito gṛhe gṛhe | pradhānāḥ śreṣṭhinaḥ sarve samānarcuḥ sthale sthale || 103 || bhramitvā nagarīṃ ramyāṃ nṛpasaudhaṃ samāyayau | rādhike śrīhariḥ śāntiṃ cālambyopādideśa ha || 104|| prajājanām̐stathā bhūpaṃ pāramārthikamuttamam| ubhayatra mahānandapradaṃ pumarthasādhakam || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyetretāsantāne śrīhareḥ ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ pūjanaṃ vahnāvāhutipradānaṃ sṛṣṭitrayadehibhya āhutipradānaṃ savebhya āhutipradānaṃ, parihāraḥ, bhojanaṃ, tato rāyaraṇajidrāṣṭraṃ pratigamanam, nagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ kanyakārpaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 207 ||
<2.208> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo’tihetubhiḥ | upadeśaṃ dadau tebhyaḥ kathayāmi nibodha me || 1 || mayā sṛṣṭaṃ hariḥ prāha jagat sarvaṃ hi gatvaram | na sthiraṃ jāyate tattvaṃ dīrghakāle’pi naśyati || 2 || avināśī mahānātmā saccidānandalakṣaṇaḥ | nijānandamayo dehe karmānugaphalādanaḥ || 3 || yāvatkarma sthirastāvat tato yānti gṛhāntaram | atra kṛtaṃ pare loke bhuṃkte phalātmakaṃ hi tat || 4 || vihāya sarvaṃ gantavyaṃ sarvairlokāntare dhruvam | yatra gatvā bhavet saukhyaṃ kartavyaṃ sādhanaṃ hi tat || 5 || lokāntarāṇi sarvāṇi svarādīni sukhāni vai | bahupuṇyena dānena paropakṛtikarmabhiḥ || 6 || labhyate sevayā cāpi vṛddhānāṃ ca satāṃ tathā | āśīrvādātmapuṇyena jāyate svargamuttamam || 7 || tato’pi cottamaṃ svargaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ vā tataḥ param | golokaṃ vākṣaraṃ dhāma paraṃdhāma mamāpi ca || 8 || vaikuṇṭhe me bhavantyeva kuṭumbāni śubhāni vai | pārṣadānāṃ tathā pārṣadānīnāṃ maṇḍalāni ca || 9 || yugalāni bhavantyeva divyāni yugalo’pyaham | lakṣmyādikoṭidāsībhiḥ sevyamāno’smi tatra ha || 2.208.1 0|| goloke’pi tathā cāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo rādhayā yutaḥ | koṭyabjagopagopībhiryugalaiḥ samprasevitaḥ || 11 || rājādhirājo varte’haṃ sadānandamahāmbudhiḥ | yugalānāṃ mahat saukhyaṃ śāśvataṃ tatra vartate || 1 2|| sarvaṃ divyaṃ mama yogānmokṣasthānamagatvaram | nityaṃ vivardhamānaṃ tat hrāsaśūnya paraṃ sukham || 13 || tadvat sukhaṃ sadā cāste kailāse nityayogibhiḥ | āśrite śāṃkare loke golokādadha eva ha || 14|| gaṇaiśca gaṇībhirdivyayoginībhiḥ prasevyate | śaṃkaro’haṃ vasāmyeva tatra kailāsake śubhe || 15|| mayā rūpaṃ dhṛtaṃ tadvai gārhasthyayogidarśakam | yogī tiṣṭhāmi gārhasthye satyapi śaṃkarātmakaḥ || 16|| tatsukhaṃ śāśvataṃ cāpi yugalānāṃ satāṃ dhruvam | satīsevāṃ ca gṛhṇāmi yoginīnāṃ patiḥ prabhuḥ || 17|| tataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ sukhaṃ cāste tribhyo lokebhya uttamam | akṣare me nityadhāmni yatheṣṭaṃ pārameśvaram || 18|| sarvaiśvaryamayaṃ sarvayogātmakaṃ sukhottamam | kāmarūpadharaṃ naikarūpabhogyaṃ sukhātsukham || 19|| sarvarūpadharatvaṃ vai vartate tatra cottamam | svātantryaṃ divyamuktānāṃ sarvaśaktijuṣāṃ sadā ||2.208.20 || sukhasyāntaḥ kvacinnāsti kadācit hrāsa eva na | vardhante sukhasandehāḥ sadā ānandavārdhayaḥ || 21 || anekendriyaviṣayā divyā akṣarasaṃjñitāḥ | śabdāḥ sparśā rasā gandhā dṛśyā divyā bhavanti vai ||22|| ānandākhyāḥ sukhaśailā ātmāno bhuñjate sadā | akṣare tatra koṭyabjagolokānāṃ sukhādhikam || 23|| tathā koṭyabjavaikuṇṭhakailāsānāṃ sukhādhikam | sukhaṃ sarvavidhaṃ cāste muktānāṃ mānasepsitam ||24|| tato’pyadhikaṃ caivāste paredhāmni sukhaṃ mama | mama yogena bhaktānāṃ sukhaṃ sarvottamottamam ||25|| anantaṃ manmūrtilabhyaṃ sarvendriyasugocaram | niravadhyadhikaṃ caiva niratiśāyi śāśvatam ||26|| yatheṣṭaṃ caikamūrtyā vā labhyaṃ ca yugalena vā | aikyabhāvena labhyaṃ vā sarvabhāvārjitaṃ ca vā ||27||| yatheṣṭeṣṭeṣṭeṣṭatamaṃ rādhe nirūpaṇātparam | evaṃ harirnijaṃ saukhyaṃ varṇayāmāsa mūrtijam |||28||| athāheha sukhārthaṃ ca rādhike vartanaṃ śubham | mārutodakavegena ye namantyunnamanti ca ||29|| oṣadhayo drumā gulmā na te yānti parābhavam | tathā sacetā bhūtvaiva prasahetā gataṃ parāt| || 2.208.3 0|| prātikūlyaṃ nigilatā prāpyate vijayaḥ sadā | sukṛtaṃ labhyate tena sahamānena sarvathā ||3 1|| duṣkṛtaṃ nāśyate tena namyamānena sarvadā | dehendriyādibhiḥ kvāpi dīyamāne nijātmane ||32|| kleśo vāturatā cāpi sahanīyā subuddhibhiḥ | lokairvā nijalokairvā bhūtairvā tattvasattamaiḥ ||3 3 || dīyamānaṃ mahākaṣṭaṃ sahate yaśca dehavān | sa eva vijayaṃ yāti pare svarge’pi modate ||34|| pratyakṣaṃ vā parokṣaṃ vā yo’parāniha nindati | nindāvṛttiḥ śvavalloke mṛtatulyaḥ śavādivat ||35|| nindakaṃ vai nartamānaṃ mayūraṃ nagnapucchakam | varjayenmṛtatulyaṃ vai tādṛśaṃ pāpacetasam ||36|| śālāvṛkaṃ ca mātaṃgaṃ cārivrataṃ vimārgiṇam | varjayet sarvathā kruddhaṃ sa syāt sukhī janeṣvapi ||37|| yasya bhṛtyajanaḥ sarvo jñānavijñānakovidaḥ | hitaiṣī vacane saktaḥ snigdhaḥ sa jāyate sukhī ||38|| mantriṇo yasya hitadā matidāśconnatipradāḥ | anāgatavivektāraḥ sa sadā jāyate sukhī ||39|| samaduḥkhasukhā yasya sahāyāḥ priyakāriṇaḥ | hitacintāparāḥ satyāḥ sa sadā jāyate sukhī ||2.208.40|| yasya nārtaḥ śritavargo bhāvato nikaṭāgamaḥ | sevādharmaparo dakṣaḥ sa sadā jāyate sukhī ||41 || bhāvyaṃ rājñā hitakartrā sevakenāpi sarvathā | aiśvaryabhāginā cāpi vindataḥ sukhameva tau ||42|| yasmātprāptaṃ mahaiśvaryaṃ prajayā cāśritena ca | tena vā ca tayā vā tad vismartavyaṃ na vai kvacid ||43|| kṛtaghnatve punarnāśo bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ | duḥkhamāsādyate tena viparītārthagāminā ||44|| āsīd vane mahāraṇye munirmokṣaparāyaṇaḥ | kṛpāyano dvijaśreṣṭho mahābhāgavataḥ śuciḥ ||45|| bhajamāno hariṃ nityaṃ niyato tapa āsthitaḥ | aiśvaryādhāra evāsau phalamūlādanaḥ sukhī ||46|| sattvabhāvena nivasan bahvāśrayaprado’bhavat | tamenaṃ sattvasampannaṃ cāhiṃsakaṃ samadṛśam ||47|| vijñāya vaninaḥ sattvāḥ samīpe nivasantyapi | mūṣakā nakulāścāpi mārjārāḥ sārameyakāḥ ||48|| dvīpino bhallukāścāpi vyāghrā gajā mahāgajāḥ | siṃhāścānye khaṅgamṛgā gaṇḍakā hariṇāstathā ||49|| vairaṃ tyaktvaiva tiṣṭhanti yānti cāraṇyake dine | rātrau vāhāralābhārthaṃ punaścāyānti tatra ca ||2.208.50|| mūṣakastvekadā yāto nijāhārārthamekalaḥ | dūraṃ tadāśramāttatra mārjāro militastadā ||51 || kṣudhayā ca patan dhartuṃ pṛṣṭhe’bhavadbalād yadā | mūṣakaḥ so’tivegena ṛṣyaṃke nyapatad bhayāt ||52|| prārthayanme bhayaṃ cāsmānmārjārājjāyate ṛṣe | nirbhayaṃ kuru viprendra yathā sukhaṃ vasāmyaham ||53|| ṛṣiḥ prāha bhavaivātra mārjārastvaṃ sukhī bhava | jātaḥ so’pi ca mārjārastaṃ dhartuṃ śvā samāgataḥ ||54|| punaścaivaṃ prārthayacca ṛṣiḥ prāha kṛpāyanaḥ | śvā bhaveti drutaṃ so’bhūt śvā tadā nirbhayo’niśam ||55|| athaikadā samāyāto vṛkastaṃ dhartumāpatat | śvā prāha ca ṛṣiṃ gatvā nirbhayaṃ māṃ vidhehi ca ||56|| ṛṣiḥ prāha vṛko’tra tvaṃ bhavaivaṃ nirbhayo bhava | vṛke jāte’tha ca tato vyāghraḥ kṣudhākulo vane ||57|| samāyāto vṛkaṃ hantuṃ vṛko bhayānvito munim | prārthayannirbhayaṃ bhāvaṃ munistaṃ vyāghratāṃ dadau |||58||| vyāghro bhūtvā nirbhayo’bhūt munyāśrame sukhasthitaḥ | kadācinmattabhāvena mahādantena hastinā ||59|| dṛṣṭaśca tāḍituṃ śīghraṃ samāyātena vegataḥ | uvācaivaṃ muniṃ gatvā dantyayaṃ māṃ haniṣyati ||2.208.60|| ṛṣiḥ prāha bhavātraiva dantī balī mahāvapuḥ | vyāghraḥ śīghraṃ hastibhāvaṃ gato’tibalapuṣṭimān ||6 1|| tāvat kaścit kadācidvai kesarī dṛṣṭavān gajam | dhartuṃ yāvat samāyāti gajastāvanmuniṃ prati ||62|| samāgatya bhayaṃ prāha nirbhayatvamayācata | ṛṣistasmai dadau śīghraṃ kesaritvaṃ kṛpāyanaḥ |||63|| athāyātaḥ kadācidvai śarabhastatra daivataḥ | dhartuṃ kesariṇaṃ tāvad bhayena kesarī munim ||64|| prārthayannirbhayaṃ bhāvaṃ muniḥ prāha kṛpāyanaḥ | bhava tvaṃ śarabhaḥ putra māstu bhayaṃ kadācana ||65|| śarabhaḥ sa tadā jātaḥ kesariprāṇanāśanaḥ | nirbhayo’sti vane tāvat kadācid dinasaptake ||66|| ativarṣā abhavam̐śca na prāpaccharabho’danam | tadā vyacintayaccainamṛṣiṃ saṃbhakṣayāmi vai ||67|| dhyānayogabalenāpi maharṣistaṃ tathāmatim | jñātvāha mūṣakaṃ tvāṃ tu madaiśvaryabalena ha ||68|| śarabhatvaṃ dattavām̐śca sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ ca nirbhayam | tathaiśvaryapradātāraṃ kṛpayā rakṣakaṃ prabhum ||69|| apāpaṃ prāṇadātāraṃ yato hiṃsitumicchasi | tasmātpunarmūṣakatvaṃ prayāhi pāpayonija ||2.208.70|| evaṃ śapto mūṣikatvaṃ prāptaḥ śarabhatā gatā | dīnatāṃ vai gataḥ paścādṛṣiṇā sa bahiṣkṛtaḥ ||7 1 || evaṃ vijñāya pātrādi sāttvikaṃ sattvavarjitam | vā tathā tatra vai deyaṃ caiśvaryaṃ nādhikaṃ kvacit ||72|| etādṛśānāṃ lokānāṃ viśvāso na hitāvahaḥ | svāminā śreṣṭhinā rājñā jñātavyaṃ vai sukhārthinā ||73|| nāparīkṣya kadācidvai deyaṃ sarva kupātrake | kupātrapāśamāpanno na kadācid sukhaṃ vrajet ||74|| kulīnaḥ prākṛto’pyatra duḥkhamāpto’pi vai kvacit | na pāpe kurute buddhiṃ bhidyamāno’pi sāttvikaḥ ||75|| kulīnabhinnapuruṣo buddhyā hīno’timūrkharāṭ | durlabhaiścaratāṃ cāpi prāpitaḥ śatrutāṃ vrajet ||76|| kulīnaṃ śikṣitaṃ prājñaṃ jñānavijñānapāragam | kṛtajñaṃ ca sahiṣṇuṃ ca santuṣṭaṃ ca jitendriyam ||77|| hitaiṣiṇaṃ satāṃ sevāṃ kurvantaṃ pitṛsevinam | brahmasevāparaṃ ceṣṭadevārpaṇavṛṣānvitam ||78|| yuktācāraṃ śubhacintāparaṃ vinayavedinam | iṃgitajñaṃ nītiyuktaṃ kuśalaṃ guṇasaṃbhṛtam ||79|| sevājñaṃ lābhahānyādivedinaṃ sattvamāśritam | durlabhaiśvaryavantaṃ yaḥ kurute jñānavān patiḥ ||2.208.80 || svāmī rājāthavānyaśca sa sukhī jāyate sadā | evaṃ śiṣyaṃ pravijñāya rājam̐ste’tra dadāmyaham ||8 1|| yogaiśvaryaṃ samādhisthaṃ bhāvaṃ mama svarūpake | paśya nityaṃ divyabhāvaṃ mama tvaṃ raṇajit sadā ||82|| yena te paramā siddhirmokṣadā hastagā bhavet | ityuktvā pradadau divyaṃ bhāvaṃ raṇajite hariḥ ||83 || viṃśatikanyakāpitre śvaśurāya mahātmane | sa cāpi bhāvamāpanno divyaṃ divyasunetrakaḥ ||84|| dṛṣṭavān kuṃkumavāpīṃ divyāṃ smṛddhāṃ mahāpurīm | dṛṣṭavān divyavaikuṇṭhaṃ golokaṃ cākṣaraṃ tathā ||85|| akṣareśaṃ kāṃbhareyaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ sutāpatim | tato hariḥ prajābhyaśca svaṃ divyaṃ darśanaṃ dadau ||86|| kṣaṇānte mānavaṃ bhāvaṃ prāpya mantraṃ nijaṃ dadau | vaiṣṇavāste tadā jātāḥ prajālokāḥ sahasraśaḥ ||87|| atha yukāsanānadyāṃ snātuṃ gopālanandanaḥ | yayau snātvā dhyānapūjāṃ kṛtvā śīghraṃ nṛpārpitām ||88|| pūjāṃ pragṛhya dugdhādipānaṃ kṛtvā vihāyasā | vimānena kṛtaṃ prāpya sammānaṃ prayayau tataḥ ||89|| ālāyasarṣisahito bhūbhṛtā sahitastathā | viṃśatikanyakāyukto hariḥ pitṛsamanvitaḥ ||2.208.90|| yajñabhūmiṃ cāyayau vai lakṣakoṭikamudrikāḥ | yajñe samarpayāmāsa dānārthaṃ kośarakṣiṇe || 91 || rātrau ca bhojanaṃ cakre mahotsavaṃ tathottamam | bhojayitvā janān sarvān suṣvāpa parameśvaraḥ ||92|| saptamyāṃ deśajāścānyadeśīyā mānavāstadā | ṛṣayo munayaścānye dharmākhyānaparā janāḥ ||9 3 || lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathānakāni vai | jagustatra mahotsāhayutā makhe’tiśobhane || 94|| kīrtanāni bhavantyeva līlāścaryamayāni ca | śeṣakāṣṭhavanānadyāstīre satāṃ nivāsane ||95|| rāsabhāvena sarvāścāmaryo ramanta ityapi | nāṭyabhāvena narakā nāṭyaṃ kurvanti vai niśi ||96 || atha rādhe prasevante viṃśatikanyakā harim | niśi śrīpatimīśeśaṃ kāntaṃ kāntimanoharam || 97|| śāśvataṃ sukhamāpustāḥ sevayitvā navaṃ prabhum | kṛtakṛtyā abhavam̐śca yogaiśvaryapratāpinam ||98|| prātarjātaṃ harirnidrāṃ tatyāja maṃgalaśravaiḥ | dhyānairmaṃgalatūryotthaiḥ sūtamāgadhajaiḥ ravaiḥ ||9 9 || gītikābhiśca vai brahmapriyāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ satām | kīrtanairbhajanaiścāpi prabubodha janārdanaḥ || 2.208.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mīnārkakṛṣṇapattane rāyaraṇajitprabhṛtijanān hariḥ samupādideśa, yajñabhūmimājagāma, rātrau suṣvāpa, prātaḥ prabubodhetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 208 ||
<2.209> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike prātaḥ kṛtasnānavidhiḥ prabhuḥ | pūjāṃ kartuṃ niṣasādāsane sauvarṇaśobhane || 1 || yajñanārāyaṇaṃ tatra pūjayāmāsa vastubhiḥ | ṣoḍaśādibhirutkṛṣṭaistāvattatra samāyayau || 1 || lomaśarṣiḥ pūjanārthaṃ pupūja parameśvaram | brahmapriyāśca rājānaḥ samāyayustathārcayan || 3 || tāvad vādyānyavādyanta yajñakāryamahotsave | gamanārthaṃ ca rājānaḥ prajā maharṣayastathā || 4 || brahmādyā īśvarāḥ sarve yajñabhūmiṃ drutaṃ yayuḥ | saṃbhārān bhūbhṛto’pīṣṭān cakrurekatritān makhe || 5 || dugdhaṃ samidhaḥ kāṣṭhādi kaṇāḥ phalāni śālayaḥ | sarvaṃ copasthitaṃ tatra kṛtaṃ devādibhiḥ kṣaṇāt || 6 || ācāryo devatāḥ sarve ṛtvijo jāpakāstathā | karmaṭhā yajamānāśca sahāyāścopatasthire || 7 || svastivāco’bhavam̐statra brāhmaṇānāṃ śubhapradāḥ | puṇyāhavācanaṃ cāpi vedaghoṣāstadābhavan || 8 || yathāsthānasthiteṣveva sarveṣu yājñikeṣu ca | dehaśuddhirdaśasnānaṃ gurupādābhivandanam || 9 || saṃkalpo digrakṣaṇaṃ ca kalaśārādhanaṃ tathā | gaṇeśapūjanaṃ cāpi mātṛkāpūjanaṃ tathā || 2.209.1 0|| nāndīśrāddhaṃ tathārghaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ tato’bhavat| | abhiṣeko vardhinīpūjanaṃ vāstuprapūjanam || 11 || maṇḍapārcanamevātha sarvatobhadrapūjanam | devatāpūjanaṃ yantradevānāmarhaṇaṃ tathā || 12|| agneruttāraṇaṃ pīṭhadevānāṃ pūjanaṃ tataḥ | kuṇḍapūjā devapūjā tato’gnipūjanaṃ śubham || 1 3|| grahāṇāṃ yoginīnāṃ ca pūjanaṃ kṣetrapārcanam | muktānāmavatārāṇāmīśvarāṇāṃ prapūjanam || 14|| īśvarīṇāṃ brahmayoṣitpūjanaṃ brahmacāriṇām | sāṃkhyayoginyarhaṇaṃ ca satīnāṃ pūjanaṃ satām || 15|| pitṝṇāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca dikpālānāṃ prapūjanam | lokapālārhaṇaṃ cāpi svargasthānāṃ prapūjanam || 16|| trayastriṃśatsurāṇāṃ ca pañcadevārhaṇaṃ tathā | bhuvarlokanivāsānāṃ pūjanaṃ rakṣasāṃ tathā || 17|| bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ mānavānāṃ samarhaṇam | catuḥkhanisthajīvānāṃ pūjanaṃ dāsavargiṇām || 18|| jaḍānāṃ cetanānāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ pūjanādikam | rasapradānāṃ sarveṣāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ prapūjanam || 19|| jantūnāṃ cāpi tattvānāmatalādinivāsinām | pūjanaṃ śrīmahāviṣṇorviṣṇośca pūjanaṃ tathā ||2.209.20 || śaṃkhaghaṇṭārhaṇaṃ prāṇapūjanaṃ ca nivedanam | havanaṃ bahumiṣṭānnairājyairghṛtādibhistathā || 21 || nīrājanaṃ ca vai balidānaṃ puṣpāñjalistathā | dakṣiṇā ca namaskāraḥ stutiścāśīḥpradānakam ||22|| parihāro bhojanāni kramāt sarvaṃ makhe hyabhūt | koṭiśo lakṣaśo devā tṛptiṃ prāptā mahāmakhe || 23|| aṣṭamyāmeva madhyāhne tathā sarvaṃ vidhānakam | kṛtvā śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo bubhuje sakuṭumbakaḥ ||24|| jagrāha tāmbūlakaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ viśrāntimāpa ha | tāvattatra nṛpaścāyāt prārthanārthaṃ samutsukaḥ ||25|| cārulāṣarṣisahito rāyavākakṣako nṛpaḥ | nijarāṣṭraṃ jalasthaṃ vai dvīpaṃ viṣaturīyakam ||26|| tūryapadāṃ purīṃ cāpi pāvayituṃ tadārthayat | hariḥ prāha tathāstvevaṃ śīghraṃ sajjobhavattadā ||27|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkambharāsutaḥ | pitarau bhrātaraścāpi santuṣṭā bhaginī tathā ||28|| amṛtā bhrātṛjāyā ca brahmapriyāśca vai satī | śaṃkaro lomaśaścāpi cārulāṣaṛṣistathā || 29|| rāyavākakṣako rājā vimānayostadā drutam | āruruhuryayuḥ sarve parimeyapadānugāḥ || 2.209.30 || samudrakhāḍikāṃ samullaṃghya dvīpamupāyayuḥ | viṣaturīyasaṃjñaṃ te rājā cāgre gato’bhavat ||3 1 || turyapadānagaryāṃ sa haryarthaṃ svāgataṃ vyadhāt | rājñyā sainyena sahito rājā sammānamācarat ||3 1 || vimānaṃ nikaṭe rājasaudhasyodyānamaṇḍale | uttārya śrīharistasmād vimānādbahirāyayau ||33 || rājā puṣpādibhiḥ pūjāṃ cakre śrīmādhavasya ha | kuṃkumādyaistathāmaryaḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ||34|| jayaśabdā vādyaśabdāstadābhavan samantataḥ | vardhayāmāsurīśeśaṃ puṣpalājākṣatādibhiḥ ||35|| prajāśca vardhayāmāsurharṣanādaiḥ pareśvaram | tato rājā hariṃ svalpe vimāne cādhyarohayat ||36|| kuṭumbaṃ ca vimāneṣu tathaiva cādhyarohayat | nagaryā pratibhavanaṃ vimānairabhigamya ca ||37|| pāvanāni janānāṃ vai gṛhāṇi pracakāra ha | pūjāṃ mahopacārām̐śca dhanaṃ dravyaṃ suratnakam ||38|| prāpya kṛtvā pāvanāni gṛhāṇi punareva ha | bhramitvā nagarīṃ divyāṃ datvā naijaṃ ca darśanam ||39|| ājagāma nṛpāvāsaṃ divyaṃ saudhaṃ haristataḥ | viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ dugdhaṃ papau sarve tataḥ papuḥ ||2.209.4 0 || rājā rājñī kumārāśca kanyakātrayamityapi | pupūjuḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkṛṣṇavallabham ||41|| upadābhirvividhābhiścandanākṣatakuṃkumaiḥ | anyahārairmahāratnaistato nīrājanaṃ vyadhuḥ ||42|| kanyātrayaṃ harau mugdhaṃ varamālā dadurgale | harirjagrāha hastām̐śca tāsāṃ rājñīmatena vai ||43 || kanyā jātāḥ kṛtakṛtyāḥ prāpya kāntaṃ surūpiṇam | rājā mumoda bahudhā rājñī cāti mumoda ha ||44|| haristebhyo dadau samyagupadeśaṃ sukhapradam | rājasaudhe mahāsiṃhāsane niṣadya cotsave ||45|| sadā bhaktirhareḥ kāryākṣareśasya mamāśritā | satāṃ sevā sadā kāryā puṇyadā mokṣadā śubhā ||46|| rakṣaṇaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ kartavyaṃ dayayānvaham | yasminnarthe hitaṃ yat syāttad grāhyaṃ netarat kvacit ||47|| ātmasaṃyamanaṃ buddhyā grāhyabuddhyā tu vartanam | parāmarśena mokṣaśca prāptavyo dehinā tviha ||48|| anuyuñjīta kṛtyāni dharmajñānamayāni ca | āgamairupadiṣṭāni gurūditāni yāni ca ||49|| dharmāṇāmavirodhena sarveṣāṃ priyamācaret | dharmamevābhirakṣedvai nijārthaṃ sādhayet kṛtī ||2.209.50 || śāstraṃ dharmo brāhmaṇasya daṇḍaḥ kṣatrasya vai vṛṣaḥ | kṛṣṭirvaiśyasya dharmo’sti sevakasya ca sevanam ||51 || satyaṃ dharmo hi sarvasya dharmāḍhyā devatāḥ smṛtāḥ | mānavā devatulyāste sarveṣāṃ prāṇarūpiṇaḥ ||52|| śāstraṃ śāsanakartṛ syād bhartṛpratyayalakṣaṇam | brahmaṇā lokarakṣārthaṃ mannideśāt purā kṛtam ||513|| vyavahārasukhārthaṃ ca bhartṛpratyayalakṣaṇaḥ | daṇḍo vinirmitaścāpi kṣātradharmātmakaḥ śubhaḥ ||54|| vyavahāro’paraścāpyudyamarūpo vinirmitaḥ | bibharti janatāḥ sarvā nītilabdhānnanāṇakaiḥ ||55|| āyotpādanarūpaḥ sa bhartṛpratyayalakṣaṇaḥ | tṛtīyaḥ puruṣaścāpi nirmitaḥ sukhasādhanaḥ ||56 || ājñādeśātmakaścānyaḥ puruṣo’pi vinirmitaḥ | sarveṣāṃ dīnavarṇānāṃ bhartṛpratyayalakṣaṇaḥ ||57|| ādeśe saṃsthitāścāpnuvanti bharaṇasādhanam | lokānāmeva sarveṣāṃ sasurāsurarakṣasām ||58|| samanuṣyoragavatāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca | caturdhāyaṃ vyavahāro bhartṛpratyayalakṣaṇaḥ ||59|| sukhasampatpravāhārthaṃ kṛto’sti pūrvato mayā | dharmayukto mama bhaktyā yuto yo matparāyaṇaḥ ||2.209.6 0|| bhūtvā varteta satataṃ tadbhartāhaṃ bhavāmi vai | karmaṇāṃ ca svabhāvānāṃ puṇyānāṃ vyavasāyinām ||6 1 || prayatnānāmahaṃ bhartā bhartṝṇāṃ cāpi bhartṛkaḥ | śāstā niyāmakaścāhaṃ lokayātrākaro’pyaham ||62|| evaṃ jñātvā ca māṃ lokā bhajeran vai taranti te | dharmamūlaḥ sadaivārthastathārthaphalanaṃ ratiḥ ||63 || dharmārthakāmanāḥ sarvā manomūlotthitāstviha | pravṛttirūpiṇaḥ sarve dharmādyā bhavayoginaḥ ||64|| samūlebhyaśca vai tebhyo nivṛttirmokṣa ucyate | dharmāccharīrayogaśca śārīro’rthaḥ sahāyakṛt ||65|| kāmaḥ phalaṃ mahābandhaḥ sarve tvete rajasvalāḥ | tān vihāya viśeṣāṃścārajasko bhaktimān mayi ||66|| vartate yogayuktātmā brahmabhūyāya kalpate | dharmo na cenmama prāptiprado’rtho’pi na cettathā ||67|| kāmo na cenmama prāptipradaste’narthakā matāḥ | arthānanartharūpām̐stān yuñjīta mayi vā tyajet ||68|| anyathā viṣaye buddhiryāsyatyeva vihāriṇaḥ | mokṣārthe saṃhṛtā buddhirvināśaṃ vai vrajettataḥ ||69|| buddhināśo mahānmohastāmaso’pi vivardhate | tasmānnāstikatā syācca durācārastato bhavet ||2.209.70|| durācārātprajā naṣṭā bhavatyeva hi sāṃkarī | sādhavo na gṛhaṃ yānti durācāragatasya vai ||71|| pāpānyasya tu vardhante duḥkhaṃ jīvitamṛcchati | jīvato’pi nirayo’yaṃ cāsukhaṃ jīvanaṃ yataḥ ||72|| tasmāttaddoṣanāśārthaṃ sukhārthaṃ sattvabhāvataḥ | brahmaniṣṭhān praseveta bhaktiyuktān harerjanān ||73|| japennāma sadā me’trārpayet sarvaṃ tathā mayi | dharmaṃ cārthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣāya kalpate hi saḥ ||74|| sādhūn prasādayennityaṃ karmaṇā manasā girā | tavāsmīti vadennityaṃ praṇamet sevanaṃ caret ||75|| satāmāśīrvacobhiśca prasādena ca sevayā | samāgamena yogena pāvano jāyate janaḥ ||76|| apāpo’yaṃ satāṃ saṃgaḥ sarvadoṣanikṛntanaḥ | pāpānyapi ca kṛcchrāṇi śamayennātra saṃśayaḥ ||77|| guravaḥ sādhavo loke śreṣṭhā mokṣapradā mama | suvarṇaṃ sarvathā śreṣṭhaṃ sarvāṃśe sādhavastathā ||78|| āpādakeśaparyantāḥ pāvanāḥ kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ | yathākathañcitprāptāste dāsyanti mama yojanam ||79|| kārayiṣyanti me bhaktiṃ yāpayiṣyanti dhāma me | tasmāt sevyā mama bhaktimantrayuktā hi sādhavaḥ ||2.209.80 || guravaste paraṃ dharmaṃ mahābhāgavataṃ mama | brūyustaṃ ye tvācarayeyuste yāsyanti parākṣaram ||8 1 || gurūṇāṃ tu prasādādvai paraṃ śreya avāpnuyuḥ | sarvadharmottamaṃ śīlaṃ śīladharmā hi sādhavaḥ ||82|| śīlena hi trayo lokāḥ śakyā jetuṃ na saṃśayaḥ | nahi kiñcidasādhyaṃ vai loke śīlavatāṃ bhavet ||83|| etatpṛthivyāmamṛtaṃ śīlaṃ sarvottamottamam | etāvacchreya evāsti śīlaṃ yatra pratiṣṭhitam ||84|| sādhūnāṃ cāvatārāṇāṃ satīnāṃ pariśīlanam | sevā śīlaṃ paraṃ proktaṃ brahmaśīlaṃ vrataṃ param ||85|| yathāvad guruvṛttyā vai samaṃ nānyaddhi vidyate | pūrvakalpe’bhavadrājā prahlādaḥ śīlavān sadā ||86|| sādhuśīlanamevāsya vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tadābhavat | tamenaṃ tu samāgatya vṛhaspatiḥ purā śubham ||87|| prahlādāya dadau jñānaṃ bhaktirūpaṃ sanātanam | prasthite tu gurau rājā dakṣiṇārthaṃ tadāvadat ||88|| bṛhaspatiryayāce vai dakṣiṇāṃ śīlarūpiṇīm | prahlādaśca dadau śīlaṃ yāvat tāvacca dehataḥ ||89|| śīlaṃ divyaṃ viniryātaṃ śrīścāpi niryayau saha | prahlādaścābhavattatra nistejo dharmavarjitaḥ ||2.209.90|| śīlahīnaḥ śriyāhīnaḥ papraccha puruṣaṃ ca tam | kastvaṃ kasmāt prayāsyevaṃ vada me tu yathāyatham ||9 1 || śīlaṃ prāha vrataṃ cāsmi dāne dattaḥ prayāmyaham | mayi yāte ca dharmo’yaṃ puruṣo’pi prayāti ca ||92|| dharmavaṃśyā ime cānye prayānti paśya pārthiva | mayi yāte dharmapatnī bhaktiryāti tathā ramā ||93|| lakṣmīḥ śrīrbhūḥ samagrāśca prayāntyeva haripriyāḥ | tacchrutvā bhayamāpannaḥ prahlādaḥ śīlavarjanāt ||94|| yatra nāsti satāṃ sevā śīlaṃ cendriyanigrahaḥ | adrohaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tatra nārāyaṇo na ca ||95|| yatra nārāyaṇo nāsmi yatra nāsti ramā mama | tatra mokṣo na vai cāste tasmād bhavantu śīlinaḥ ||96|| satāṃ me ca samarhāṃ vai sevāṃ kurvantu nityadā | sarvabhūtānugrahaṃ ca śīlaṃ samāsato hi tat ||97|| sampadaṃ bhuñjate śīlāḥ śāśvatīṃ madanugrahāt | aśīlāścedāpnuvanti bhuñjate na ciraṃ hi te ||98|| yajñadānādikāryārthaṃ dattā samattu nirguṇā | etaddeśīyalokā vai bhavantu yajñavṛttayaḥ ||99|| sukhino dānaśīlāśca tathā śīlavṛṣānvitāḥ | ityuktvā virarāmaiva bhagavān rādhike tataḥ || 2.209.100 || prajābhiḥ pūjitaḥ kṛṣṇo rājñā rājñyā samarhitaḥ | mantrān dadau prajābhyaśca dugdhapānaṃ cakāra ha || 101 || rājasaudhe caraṇau svau datvā kṛtvā ca pāvanam | sāyaṃ svāgatamānena vādyaghoṣādibhirhariḥ || 1 02|| vimānaṃ svaṃ samāruhya sarvasārthasamanvitaḥ | dvinaskaṃ pārśvarājyaṃ ca milvilaṃ dvīpamityapi || 1 03|| vilāsadvīpamevāpi bulandadvīpamityapi | vimānena tadā gatvā vihṛtya gagane tadā || 1 04|| vilokya śrīharistūrṇaṃ rātrau vaihāyasā drutam | aṣṭamyāmāyayau yajñabhūmiṃ nijālaye śubham || 1 05|| snānaṃ sandhyāṃ cakārāpi bhojanaṃ jagṛhe hariḥ | tathānye bhojanaṃ cakrurdravyaṃ yajñe harirdadau || 1 06|| viśaśrāma sukhaṃ rātrau kanyātrayeṇa sevitaḥ | yoganidrāvaśaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prātarbubodha maṃgalaiḥ || 1 07|| gītibhirvedaghoṣaiśca tūryasvanaiśca kīrtanaiḥ | sūtamāgadhabandyādyairbodhitaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 1 08|| rādhike svasvarūpaṃ sa dadhyau kṣaṇaṃ parātparam | akṣarātītarūpaṃ yat pūrṇabrahmaparātmakam || 1 09|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bhādraśuklāṣṭamyāṃ yajñe sarvakarmaṇāmantimāhutiparyantānāṃ karaṇaṃ bhojanaṃ tato rāyavākakṣakanṛpārthito haristadrājyaṃ viṣaturīyadvīpaṃ dvinaskaṃ milvilāṃ ca gatvā pāvayitvopadiśya rātrau punarmakhabhūmimājagāma viśaśrāmetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 209 ||
<2.210> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike prātaḥ snātvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | kṛtvā tu naityikī pūjāṃ yajñabhūmiṃ jagāma ha || 1 || lomaśādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca rājāno yajamānakāḥ | prajā devāḥ sureśāśca karmaṭhāścopatasthire || 2 || yajñahavyāni navyāni tatrāhṛtāni sarvataḥ | kāmadrumādibhistatra rasāḥ sampratipāditāḥ || 3 || svastivāco’bhavam̐ścāpi puṇyāhavacanānyapi | vādyaghoṣā abhavam̐śca vedadhvanaya ityapi || 4 || yajamānāśca rājāno navamyāṃ prātareva te | yathāsthānaṃ samāgatya karmakāṇḍe kṛtādarāḥ || 5 || sāvadhānā abhavam̐śca jāyante kramaśaḥ kriyāḥ | prokṣaṇāni pūjanāni naivedyabalayo’rpitāḥ || 6 || vahnau havyapradānāni jātānyāhutayo’bhavan | devatātarpaṇaṃ jātaṃ surādyāstṛptimāgatāḥ || 7 || brahmasṛṣṭīśvarasṛṣṭijīvasṛṣṭisthadehinaḥ | yajñāhutibhiḥ pratyakṣaṃ tṛptiṃ gatāstadādhvare || 8 || antyāhutiṃ tathā puṣpāñjaliṃ dadau harirmakhe | parihāraṃ cakārātha bhojanānyadadāt prabhuḥ || 9 || meśubhānnaṃ mohanasthālānnaṃ mudgajalaḍaḍukān | sukhadāṃ cūrṇalaḍaḍūm̐śca mauktikān śaṣkulīstathā || 2.210.10 || śāṭakān ghṛtapūrām̐ścāpūpām̐śca śatachidrakān | piṇḍakān barphikāṃ miṣṭapūrṇapolīśca pūrikāḥ || 1 1|| khājakān pāyasān kṣīraṃ saṃyāvaṃ ca birañjakam | kaṃsāraṃ bundikālaḍḍūn śarkarāghṛtalaḍḍukān || 12|| śrīkhaṇḍaṃ rājikārāddhaṃ kvathikāṃ sūpamityapi | odanaṃ bahuśākāni patrabhājāśca bhojanāḥ || 13|| caṇakā māṣakāścāpi śrapitā bharjitāstathā | vaṭikāḥ phullavaṭakā polikāścāmṛtāni ca || 14|| divyabhojyāni muktānāṃ sattvabhojyāni ceśinām | sudhābhojyāni devānāṃ cāmabhojyāni pitṝṇām || 15|| rasabhojyāni tattvānāṃ madabhojyāni rakṣasām | yathāyogyāni bhojyāni sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ tathā || 16 || yajñaprasādarūpāṇi tṛptidānyabhavam̐stadā | takraṃ bahuvidhaṃ śubhraṃ cāmblamiṣṭaṃ sugandhi ca || 1 7|| pācakaṃ śāntidaṃ tatrāmīkṣāghaṃ cābhavattathā | madhūni naikarūpāṇi madhuparkāṇi yānyapi | | 18|| tiktāmblakaṭucūrṇāni caṭanyaścābhavam̐stadā | āranālāni ramyāṇi phalāni vividhāni ca || 1 9|| tāmbūlakāni divyāni dehibhyo’dāpayaddhariḥ | evaṃ sarvān bhojayitvā tataḥ saṃbubhuje prabhuḥ || 2.210.20 || kuṭumbasahitaḥ śrīśo viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ tathā | madhyāhne rāyamārīśo nṛpaḥ prārthayadacyutam ||2 1 || nijadvīpaṃ samāgantuṃ hariḥ sajjo babhūva ha | anyān yathāpekṣitām̐śca nityayogasthitān prabhuḥ || 22|| pitrādīnīśvaraṃ śaṃbhuṃ satīṃ kuṭumbakaṃ nijam | ṛṣīn lomaśamukhyām̐śca nītvā vimānamāsthitaḥ || 23 || tadā rājā ca rājñī ca dānavarṣistathā puraḥ | vimānena yayuścāgre dvīpamālīsmarābhidham || 24|| ṛddhīśā nagarī saṃśobhābhiścalaṃkṛtā tadā | sainyena svāgatārthaṃ copasthitiḥ racitā drutam || 25|| tāvad vimānaṃ kṛṣṇasya vardhimullaṃghya khāḍikām | dvīpānuccāvacām̐ścāpyullaṃghya rāṣṭraṃ suśobhanam ||26|| ālīsmaraṃ hariḥ prāpa vimānaṃ bhūtale’nayan | ṛddhīśāyā mahodyāne nṛpālayasya sannidhau |||27|| tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayadhvānāstathābhavan | gītikāḥ smaranārīṇāṃ prajānāṃ jayagarjanāḥ |||28|| susvāgataiḥ patākādyairdhvajairlājākṣatādibhiḥ | toraṇaiḥ puṣpahārādyairañjalyādibhireva ca || 29|| namanaiḥ puṣpadānaiśca sammānaṃ śrīharerabhūt | vimānācchrīharistūrṇaṃ bahiryadāyayau tataḥ || 2.210.3 0|| rāyamārīśabhūpastrī rājñī kuśalakuṇḍalā | pādau tīrthajalaiḥ saṃprakṣālayāmāsa satvaram ||3 1 || harestaccaraṇotthaṃ ca jalaṃ papurnṛpādayaḥ | kuṃkumaiścaraṇau rañjayitvā mudrāśca jagṛhuḥ |||32|| puṣpahārān gandhavāri gandhasārān dadau tathā | duḥkhahāñjalibhirnāryaḥ smārikāḥ kṛṣṇameva tāḥ ||33|| pupūjurbahubhāvena kanyakā bhāvagarbhitāḥ | atha kṛṣṇaṃ mahāsaudhe rājā nyaṣādayat kṣaṇam ||34|| siṃhāsane svake nītvā dadau dhanaṃ tu koṭikam | sauvarṇaṃ cāmbarādyaṃ cīrṇaṃ sarvaṃ kūpyamityapi || 35|| ratnalakṣaṃ pradadau ca tadā kanyātrayaṃ śubham | mugdhaṃ kṛṣṇagale mālātrayaṃ samārpayat patim || 36|| matvā mātṛvaco’vāpya kṛṣṇavallabhamuttamam | patiṃ kanyātrayaṃ prāpa rājā santoṣito’bhavat || 37|| rājñī jātā kṛtakṛtyā tato dugdhaṃ papau prabhuḥ | anye dugdhaṃ papuścāpi drutaṃ kṛṣṇo vimānake || 38|| sthitvā svalpe ṛddhīśāyāṃ nagaryāṃ sainyavardhitaḥ | prajābhiścārthitaḥ saṃvihṛtya gṛhāṇi sarvataḥ | | 39|| pāvanāni tadā kṛtvā datvā svaṃ darśanaṃ śubham | prajābhiśca kṛtaṃ naikavidhopadābhirarcanam ||2.210.40 || gṛhītvā rājasaudhaṃ cāyayau svāmī hariḥ prabhuḥ | rājyasiṃhāsane sthitvopādideśa prajādikān ||41 || mama yogo mahatpuṇyairjāto’styatra mahārṇave | bhavatāṃ bhāvanākṛṣṭaḥ samāyāto’smi dūrataḥ ||42|| madarthe dīyate sarvaṃ śāśvataṃ jāyate hi tat | nirguṇaṃ mama yogena mokṣadaṃ jāyate hi tat || 43 || āśāṃ vihāya cānyasmin māyike’khilavastuni | ramate cātmayogeṣu mokṣamārgaṃ sa vindati || 44|| āśā duḥkhagṛhaṃ śaśvat himavatsamaniścalam | mahodadhisamaṃ cāpyagādhaṃ doṣasamanvitam ||45|| nabhaḥsamamapāraṃ ca rauravaṃ jīvataḥ sthitam | api rājyasthito rājā cāśayā mṛgayākṛte ||46|| vane duḥkhaṃ tathāpnoti yathā kṣudro hi lubdhakaḥ | api sarvendriyatṛptaḥ kāmanāśādhṛto bhavet ||47|| anyāyakāmabhogena mahadduḥkhamavāpnuyāt | antarīkṣaṃ tathā kāmo dvayorjyāyān nu ko bhavet ||48|| iti praśne’ntarīkṣaṃ vai jyāyaḥ kāmo na hi kvacit | antarīkṣasya pāraṃ vai yānti yogijanāḥ kvacit ||49|| āśāyā naiva pāraṃ saṃlabhante tadanusṛtāḥ | ṛṣabho nāma bhakto me purā śrībadarīvanam ||2.210.50 || upāyayau mama divyaṃ naranārāyaṇāśramam | yatra me badarī ramyā hrado vaihāyaso’malaḥ ||51 || aśvaśirā ṛṣiryatra yatra gaṃgātipāvanī | tatrāgatyāśrame ramye maṇḍape mama sannidhau ||52|| natvā vāsārthamevāsau dṛṣṭvāśramarṣisatkuṭīm | parṇakuṭīṃ yayau kartuṃ dīrghavāsecchayā punaḥ ||53 || tena mārge ṛṣirnānnā tanurdṛṣṭastapodhanaḥ | ūrdhve tvaṣṭaguṇo dehe kṛśatāyāṃ tṛṇeśavat ||54|| kaniṣṭhikāsamastvasya darśanaṃ cādbhutaṃ hyabhūt | taṃ natvā ṛṣabhastasthau dattāsane viveśa ha ||55|| pṛṣṭaḥ kuśalamevāpi kathayāmāsa sāntvanam | tathāha parṇaśālāṃ ca kartumicchāmi cātra vai ||56|| tapaḥ kartuṃ tathecchāmi śāntiṃ vindāmi yena ca | tatsarvaṃ kartumicchāmi śādhi me tvaṃ tano mune ||57|| tanuḥ prāha mayā naiva kṛtātra parṇasatkuṭī | yataḥ sarvaṃ naśvaraṃ vai kasyārthe parṇajā kuṭī ||58|| yāvadicchā ca te tvāste parṇaśālāvidhāpane | tāvacchāntirna te syādvai tṛṣṇāśālāvṛtasya vai ||59 || nistṛṣṇasya nirīhasya niricchasya mahatsukham | tapasāpi sukhaṃ naiva yadīcchā tatra jāgrati ||2.210.6 0|| parṇakuṭyāṃ niviṣṭasya na syād brahmapraveśanam | āśākuṭīvihīnasya bhaved brahmapraveśanam ||6 1 || brahmāveśitalokasya śāntiḥ śāśvatayoginī | tasmādāśāṃ parityajyāntarīkṣādapi dīrghikām ||62|| cidākāśe parṇakuṭyāṃ labha viśrāntimacyute | tanunaivaṃ samuktaḥ sa ṛṣabho jñānacakṣuṣā ||63|| parṇakuṭīṃ parityajyābhajanmāṃ parameśvaram| mamāṃśo matsvarūpaḥ so’bhavanmokṣagatistataḥ ||64|| tasmādāśāṃ parityajya mano mayi samarpayet | sarvaṃ mayi samarpyaiva śāśvataṃ sukhamāpnuyāt ||65|| āśā kṛtā kṛśā yena puṣṭātmā sa mato mama | āśā puṣṭā bhaved yasya kṛśaḥ syāt sa na saṃśayaḥ ||66|| yā saktā sarvabhūteṣu kṛtaghneṣvalaseṣu ca | nṛśaṃseṣu hiṃsakeṣu yāpakāriṣu vidyate ||67|| putrastrīdhanasaudheṣu dehendriyeṣu bhuktiṣu | vārdhakye putrahīnānāṃ putre rājñāṃ ca rāṣṭrake ||68|| pradānakāṃkṣiṇīnāṃ ca kanyānāṃ suvilāsane | lubdhānāṃ priyaviṣaye ḍimbhānāṃ mātari dhruvā ||69 || yāśā kṛtā kṛśā yena sa śāntimadhigacchati | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi gautamastapa ācarat ||2.210.70 || upāyāto dharmarājastamugratapasaṃ munim | gautamo dharmarājāya namaskutyāsanaṃ dadau ||7 1 || prapaccha kuśalaṃ cāpi svāgataṃ cākarottataḥ | dharmarājo gautamaṃ saṃpapraccha tapasā mune ||72|| kiṃ te prayojanaṃ cāste kathaṃ karoṣi dustapaḥ | gautamaḥ prāha śāntyarthaṃ tapaścarāmi duścaram || 73|| yena yāsye puṇyakṛtām̐llokān sukhādisaṃbhṛtān | yamaḥ prāha vicāraste vimārgaṃ pratigacchati ||74|| puṇyakṛtāṃ tathāpuṇyakṛtāṃ lokeṣu sadṛśam | tṛṣṇājanyaṃ mahāduḥkhaṃ bādhate puṇyaśālinaḥ ||75|| dhāmākṣaraṃ vinānyatra tārṣṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ pravidyate | tasmādāśāṃ vihāyaiva tiṣṭha brahmaṇi niścalaḥ ||76|| sarvāṃ śāntiṃ brahmayogādavināśāmavāpsyasi | āśāvataḥ sukhaṃ nāsti yayā te tapato’pi vai |||7|| yāvadāśā ca tṛṣṇā ca tathehā svārthagṛdhnikā | icchābhilāṣā kāmaśca tāvad vyakteḥ kathaṃ sukham |||77|| sarvaṃ ceṣṭaṃ nivṛttaṃ ca yasya bhavati sarvathā | tasyābdhiḥ śāśvataścopatiṣṭhedānandasaṃbhṛtaḥ ||79|| tasmānnārāyaṇaḥ sākṣād yeṣāmicchāsvavasthitaḥ | santo’pi brahmavettārasta eva śāntisaṃbhujaḥ ||2.210.80 || śrutvaivaṃ gautamastyaktvā tapo bhaktau vyavasthitaḥ | nirāśaḥ śāntahṛdayaḥ parāṃ śāntiṃ gatastadā ||8 1 || tasmānnṛpaiḥ prajābhiśca narairnārībhireva ca | yaṣṭavyo’haṃ mahāyajñaiḥ santoṣaṇīyaḥ sevayā ||82|| icchārpaṇena sākṣācca bhajanīyo’hameva ca| evaṃ māṃ prāpya sevābhirmokṣaṃ naijaṃ prasādhayet |||83 || bhavantaśca janāḥ sarve prajā rājādayo’pi ca | mayi nārāyaṇe kṛṣṇe karmaṇā manasā girā ||84|| sarvaṃ samarpya māṃ kṛṣṇe bhajantu gatalālasāḥ | mahāśāntiṃ paramāṃ me dāsye’kṣare pare sthitām ||883 || ityuktvā śrīhariḥ rādhe cāha mantraṃ prajādiṣu | bhaktiṃ dadau nijāṃ paścād virarāma mahāprabhuḥ ||86|| rājā rājñī prajāścāpi bhojayāmāsuracyutam | sārthān saṃbhojayāmāsuḥ rājādyāścakrurādanam || 87|| tataḥ pūjāṃ parigṛhya vimānamadhyarohayat | sarvān svayaṃ cāruroha gantuṃ ca makhabhūmikām ||88|| sammānaṃ bahudhā cakruḥ prajāḥ sainyāni yoṣitaḥ | sasāra ca tataḥ kṛṣṇo rājñā ca ṛṣiṇā saha ||89|| dvīpe dvīpāntare cāpi sāyaṃ vai kāśimaṃ yayau | dvivāmaṃ ca yayau paścānmīlavīlaṃ samāyayau || 2.210.90 || tato’dhvarapradeśaṃ sa āyayau ca niśāṃśake | snātvā sandhyā tatra cakre nijāvāse ca bhojanam ||91 || viśaśrāma ca nidrāyāṃ rāyamārīśakanyakāḥ | tisraḥ siṣevire kāntaṃ bhagavantaṃ navaṃ patim || 92|| prātaḥkāle vedaghoṣairmaṃgalāvahatūryakaiḥ | gītibhirvādyaghoṣaiśca jajāgāra hariḥ stavaiḥ || 93 || rājādhirājo bhagavān kṛtasnānavidhistataḥ | pitarau pūjayāmāsa bhaktebhyo darśanaṃ dadau || 94|| kṛtāhnikaḥ suveṣaśca makhabhūmiṃ samāgataḥ | dānavarṣiṃ tathā rāyamārīśabhūpatiṃ tadā || 95|| prāhedaṃ koṭidravyaṃ yat pūjāyāṃ mama cāgatam | bhavatośca prajānāṃ ca sarvaṃ makhe’stu cārpitam || 96 || ityuktvāhūya kośeśaṃ kuberaṃ pradadau ca tat | makhe vyayārthaṃ dhanarāḍayuṃkta sarvameva tat || 97|| ityevaṃ rādhike’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam | pāvayitvā janān deśān narām̐śca yoṣitastathā || 98|| saṃgṛhya śaraṇe muktiyogyān karotyanugrahāt | bālān vṛddhān madhyarūpān yūnaḥ sarvāśca dehinaḥ ||99|| pāvayitvā mokṣayogyān karoti parameśvaraḥ | api kanyā bhūbhṛtāṃ ca mugdhāḥ samarpitāḥ svayam || 2.210.10 0|| parigṛhyāpi vidhinā nijayogaṃ dadāti saḥ | kṛpāpārāvārarūpo divyo’pi janatāśrayaḥ || 101 || adivyān mānavān dehān svīkṛtyāpi pramokṣaṇam | dadātīti kṛpā tasyānandavārdherhareḥ priye || 102|| alepyasya na lepo’sti kālamāyeśituḥ kvacit | sarvaṃ cāsya śarīraṃ vai bhogyaṃ cādhīnakaṃ tathā || 103 || viśeṣeṇa parigṛhya pāvayatyeva bhaktigam | nityatṛptasya nāstyeva parādhīnā hi tṛptikā || 1 04|| sarvānandapradaḥ so’yaṃ sarvatra jayatetamām | rādhe bhaktyaiva bhagavān bhaktādhīno bhavatyapi || 1 05|| yo yathā taṃ prapadyeta taṃ tathā bhajate prabhuḥ | yā yathā sevata kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇastāṃ sevate tathā || 106 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne navamyāṃ yajñakāryottaraṃ rāyamārīśabhūparāṣṭre ālīsmaradvīpe ṛddhīśāpurīṃ pratigamanaṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanamupadeśanaṃ kāśimadvivāmamīlavīladvīpān pāvayitvā makhabhūmāvāgamanaṃ rātrau viśrāntiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā daśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 210 ||
<2.211> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike bālakṛṣṇo’yaṃ daśamyāmadhvaraṃ prage | yayau nijāsane svarṇe saṃsthitaśca tadābhavan || 1 || tūryāṇāṃ ninadāścāpi gītayo varayoṣitām | vedaghoṣā maharṣīṇāṃ gāndharvagāyanāni ca || 2 || dhvanayaścāpi mantrāṇāṃ haryāśca makhināṃ tathā | sajjāḥ kṛtāhnikā devāḥ karmaṭhā havyavāhakāḥ || 3 || havyapradā yajamānā maṇḍape copatasthire | svastivācaḥ prokṣaṇāni vastūnāṃ cāhṛtistathā || 4 || puṇyāhavāco viprāṇāṃ devānāṃ stavanāni ca | unnidratvaṃ tathā sākṣādupasthitiśca pūjanam || 5 || kramaśo’kṣaradhāmastheśvarasṛṣṭinivāsinām | jīvalokīyajīvānāṃ pūjanaṃ kramaśo’bhavat || 6 || ṣoḍaśopasuvastūnāmarpaṇairbhojanādibhiḥ | validānairhavyadānai rasadānaiḥ samarhaṇam || 7 || sudhāvṛtaphalānnādipāyasādipradānakaiḥ | carudānairyathāyogyayavamāṣādidānakaiḥ || 8 || bhakṣyabhojyapradānaiśca lehyacoṣyapradānakaiḥ | svādyapeyapradānaiśca tṛpyadṛśyapradānakaiḥ || 9 || bhāvyagamyapradānaiśca kalpyaklṛptyapradānakaiḥ | sthūlasūkṣmapradānaiśca sattvāsattvapradānakaiḥ || 2.211.1 0|| tṛptā bhavanti devādyāḥ sarvasṛṣṭinivāsinaḥ | vahnayo bhuñjate snigdhaṃ bahvannaṃ bahujātikam || 11 || havanāni ca havyānāmabhavam̐statra vahniṣu | asaṃkhyānyuttamānyeva bahuhastaiśca bhāvataḥ || 12|| antimaṃ havanaṃ kṛtvā datvā ca bhūyasīstathā | dakṣiṇāḥ svarṇamukhyāśca parihāraṃ vyadhāddhariḥ || 13|| rājāno yajamānāśca dadurdānāni koṭiśaḥ | evaṃ yajñe vartite’tha madhyāhne bhojanāni ha || 14|| cakrurmakhasya vai sarve prāsādikānnajāni vai | muktāstathāvatārāścāvatāriṇyo haripriyāḥ || 15|| pārṣadāḥ pārṣadānyaśca sāṃkhyayoginya ityapi | satyaḥ sādhvyaśceśvarāṇya īśvarā devatāstathā || 16|| ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā dikpālā lokapālakāḥ | mānavā daityayakṣāśca dānavāḥ paśupakṣiṇaḥ || 17|| api kīṭapataṃgādyā vṛkṣāḥ stambāśca vallayaḥ | tattvānyapi jaḍānyeva cetanāni ca sarvaśaḥ || 18|| nāmarūpamayaṃ sarvaṃ yatkiñciddharinirmitam | sarvaṃ prasādamāsādya tṛptiṃ jagāma cādhvare || 1 9|| hariḥ kuṭumbasahito’nugairyuktaśca sevibhiḥ | vrahmapriyābhiḥ sahito bubhuje carubhojanam ||2.211.20 || miṣṭānnāni ca śākāni rasasnigdhāni yāni ca | divyāni cāpi sarvāṇi bubhuje bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||2 1 || bhojanottaramevātra sannidhau śrīharestadā | rājā dvaipāyanadvīpapatiḥ rājñīsamanvitaḥ ||22|| rāyabāleśvaro nāmnā prārthayatparameśvaram | mālāvanarṣisahito vāyuphenāpurīṃ prati |||23|| netuṃ svarāṣṭre śrīkṛṣṇaṃ hāritāsmāritāpatim | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha tūrṇaṃ sajjo’bhavattadā ||24|| lomaśena kuṭumbena śaṃkareṇa saha prabhuḥ | vimānaṃ divyamāsthāyāmbare’bhavat kṣaṇāntare ||25|| ṛṣiḥ rājā vimāne sve kuṭumbasahito’bhavat | pūrvaṃ svāgatadānārthaṃ yayau tūrṇaṃ nijāṃ purīm ||26|| sainyaṃ sajjaṃ cakārāsau tūrṇaṃ sammānanāya vai | prajāḥ puṣpādisāmagrīrdhṛtvā sajjāstathābhavan ||27|| vāyuphenānagaryāḥ sannidhāvudyānasaṃsthite | rājasaudhe mahāviśālāṃgaṇe ca yayustadā ||28|| tāvaddharervimānaṃ cāmbare’tyantasubhāsuram | samadṛśyata suryābhaṃ vādyāni vividhāni vai ||29|| avādyanta tathā ghoṣā jayayuktāstadābhavan | prajāstvekāgradṛṣṭyaiva vīkṣituṃ tvaritāstadā ||2.211.3 0|| tāvacca sannidhau tūrṇaṃ vimānaṃ tvāgataṃ hi khe | rājñā darśitamārgeṇāvātarat saudhasannidhau ||3 1|| mālāvanarṣirmālābhirvimānaṃ prāgavardhayat | prajā lājākṣatādyaiścāvardhayat paritastataḥ ||32|| rājā mālāṃ svarṇahāraṃ hareḥ kaṇṭhe samārpayat | pādau prakṣālya ca papau harirbahiḥ samāyayau ||33|| prajāḥ sragādibhistūrṇaṃ pupūjuḥ svāgatādibhiḥ | rājā saudhe hariṃ nītvā pupūja bahubhirdhanaiḥ ||34|| tato yāne tu sauvarṇe copaveśya pareśvaram | kuṭumbaṃ lomaśaṃ śaṃbhuṃ nagaryāṃ nītavānnṛpaḥ ||35|| sasainyaḥ śrīharirmārge sammānitaḥ prajājanaiḥ | pūjito vanditaścāpi vīkṣito bhāvanetrakaiḥ ||36|| ārpito bahuratnādyairdhanaiḥ sauvarṇarūpyakaiḥ | pradhānaiḥ pūjitaścāpi bhramitvā nagarīṃ tataḥ ||37|| āyayau rājasaudhaṃ taṃ niṣasāda nṛpāsane | upādideśa ca tadā prajābhyo hitakṛdvacaḥ ||38|| īṣyate bahubhiḥ kṛṣṇo vinā puṇyaṃ na labhyate | labhyate bahubhiḥ puṇyairvinābhāvaṃ na sevyate ||39|| sevyate bahubhirbhāvairvinā śraddhāṃ na rajyate | rajyate cārpaṇaiḥ sarvaistatrānugrahakāraṇam ||2.211.40|| anugraheṇa vivaśo bhavāmyeva svayaṃ prabhuḥ | mayānugrahayuktena bhavaddeśo vilokitaḥ ||41|| sevā cāṃgīkṛtā premṇā nirguṇā muktidā hi sā | madyogo muktidaścāste sadā sarvasya dehinaḥ ||42|| yathājñānaṃ ca sevante prāpya māṃ dehinastviha | teṣāṃ tathaiva dātāhaṃ tathānugrahakārakaḥ ||43|| prasanno’haṃ dadāmyeva sukhaṃ rakṣāmi vighnataḥ | yogakṣemo karomyasya bhaktasya sevakasya me ||44|| sevābalāḍhyabhaktasya sarvaṃ sannihitaṃ śubham | sevābale bubhūṣedvai savaṃ balavato vaśe ||45|| sevābalaṃ sthitaṃ svasmim̐ttrāyate mahato bhayāt | sarvadharmādbalaṃ dharmaḥ sarvasaukhyapravartakaḥ ||46|| sevābale sthito dharmo dharme tiṣṭhāmyahaṃ sadā | mayi tiṣṭhati yāvacchrīḥ sarvasaukhyasya sādhanam ||47|| dhūmo vāyoriva vaśe sevāṃ dharmo’nuvartate | sevā balavatāṃ dharmaḥ sarvāpatyaḥ pravartate ||48|| nāstyasādhyaṃ sevakānāṃ prasannatvajuṣāmiha | madanugrahapātraṃ vai kṣipraṃ bahumataṃ bhavet ||49|| loke vai labhate pūjā paratreha mahatphalam | sukhaṃ sucitraṃ bhuñjīta śāśvataṃ ca tataḥ param ||2.211.50|| sevā satyena kartavyā devapitṛtapasvinām | atithīnāṃ satāṃ cāpyanāthānāṃ yoṣitaḥ tathā ||5 1 || asevā naiva kartavyā asevā droha eva tu | udvejanaṃ bhaved drohāt tena ruṣṭā bhavanti te ||52|| yeṣāṃ ruṣṭāśca gurvādyāsteṣāṃ bhāgyaṃ vilīyate | na teṣāṃ triṣu lokeṣu trātā bhavati kaścana ||53 || yastān parivadeccāpi tannāśaṃ cāpi rocayet | svayaṃ nāśe gataḥ syāt sa tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā ||54|| anāgatasya sandraṣṭā pratyutpannamatistathā | sevayā sukhamedhete tadvihīnau vinaśyataḥ ||55|| prāpte kāle bhavet sevā sā sevā mokṣadā matā | gate kāle gate deve gate śrīsaṃbhave tataḥ ||56|| sa lābho na bhavatyeva yo lābho’nugrahe’rthitaḥ | brahmavetṝn praseveta jñānavṛddhām̐stapasvinaḥ ||57|| śrutacāritryavṛttāḍhyān sataḥ seveta bhūtaye | prītyā yaśo bhaveddivyamaprītyā śreyasāṃ kṣayaḥ ||58|| prītiṃ sampādayet sevāṃ kṛtvā satāṃ sa buddhimān | prītāḥ santo harirvāpi śaraṇāyaṃ prarakṣati |||59|| kapotena śaraṇāyaḥ pūjito māṃsadānakaiḥ | lubdho’raṇye śabaro vai krūrakarmā ca niṣṭhuraḥ ||2.211.60|| janaḥ pāpasamācārastyaktaḥ svairbāndhavaiḥ purā | yayau vanaṃ tadā vṛṣṭirabhūt sarvātiśāyinī ||6 1|| jalaṃ jalaṃ hyabhūt sarvaṃ mahājalamayaṃ yathā | labhyante prāṇino naiva pakṣiṇaḥ paśavo’pi na ||62|| lubdhakaḥ sa tadā sāyaṃ tvekāṃ kapotikā vane | prāptavān pañjare tāṃ ca kṛtvā vṛkṣaṃ samāśritaḥ ||63|| lubdhakaḥ sa tadā rātrau vṛkṣaṃ matvā tu daivatam | sāñjaliḥ praṇatiṃ kṛtvā vākyamāha vanaspatim ||64|| śaraṇaṃ yāmi yānyasmin daivatāni vanaspatau | rakṣantu māṃ nirādhāraṃ śaraṇāgatamatra vaḥ ||65|| kṣudhitaḥ sa tu suṣvāpa mūle nidhāya mastakam | śākhāyāṃ vihagaścāste nāmnā citrakapotakaḥ ||66|| bhāryā tasya gatā bhakṣyaṃ carituṃ nāgatā tu sā | śuśoca bahudhā rātrau kapoto vṛṣṭipīḍitaḥ ||67|| manye bhāryā mṛtā me vai vātavṛṣṭibhiradya vai | api svasti bhavettasyāḥ priyāyā mama kānane ||68|| bhāryāhīnaṃ gṛhaṃ tvadya śūnyaṃ me dṛśyate kila | putrapautravadhūbhṛtyadāsādyaiḥ pūritaṃ hyapi ||69|| na gṛhaṃ gṛhamityāhurgṛhiṇī gṛhameva yat| | patnīṃ vinā gṛhaṃ cāste’raṇyaṃ śūnyamivāparam ||2.211.70 || tayā vinā jīvanaṃ me vyapārthakaṃ hi lokyate | na bhuṃkte mayyabhukte yā nāsnāte snāti suvratā ||7 1 || nātiṣṭhatyupatiṣṭhetsā śete tu śayite mayi | hṛṣṭe bhavati sā hṛṣṭā duḥkhite mayi duḥkhitā ||72|| proṣite dīnavadanā kruddhe tu priyavādinī | pativratā patigatiḥ patipriyahite ratā ||73 || yasya syāt tādṛśī bhāryā dhanyaḥ sa puruṣaḥ sadā | sā ca śānta kṣudhārtaṃ ca jānīte māṃ tapasvinī ||74|| anuraktā sthirā caiva bhaktā snigdhā yaśasvinī | vṛkṣo’pi sadgṛhaṃ bhāti tayā yuktaṃ sukhāvaham ||75|| tadvihīno mahāsaudhaḥ kāntāra iva bhāti vai | dharmārthakāmakāryeṣu bhāryā puṃsaḥ sahāyinī ||76|| videśagamane cāpi viśvāsapātrikā hi sā | bhāryā vai paramaścārthaḥ puruṣasya sadāsti hi ||77|| asahāyasya loke’tra bhāryā cāste sahāyinī | rogakṛcchrābhibhūtasya bheṣajaṃ paramaṃ hi sā ||78|| nāsti patnīsamo bandhuḥ sahāyo dharmasaṃgrahe | vinode paraloke ca gatau suhṛt tu sā saṭā ||79|| yasya sādhvī satī bhāryā ramyā ca priyavādinī | nāsti gṛhe ca tenātrāraṇye gantavyameva tu ||2.211.80 || martavyaṃ veti rātrau sa vilāpaṃ kṛtavān bahum | taṃ vilāpaṃ prasuptenāraṇye dhṛtā kapotikā ||8 1 || pañjarasthā praśuśrāva sasnehā vākyamabravīt | aho’tīva subhāgyāhaṃ yasyā me dayitaḥ patiḥ ||82||| anājñāpālikāyā me guṇānevaṃ prabhāṣate | na sā strī hyabhimantavyā yasyāṃ bhartā na tuṣyati ||83|| tuṣṭe bhartari nārīṇāṃ tuṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ | bhasmībhavati sā nārī yasyā bhartā na tuṣyati | iti sañcintya bhartāraṃ kapotī vākyamabravīt ||84|| nātha vakṣyāmi sukhakṛt tattayā kartumarhasi | śaraṇāgatasevāyāṃ tatparo bhava sarvathā ||85|| ayaṃ śākuniko lubdhastava vāsaṃ samāgataḥ| kṣudhārtasyānnadānena sevanaṃ puṇyadaṃ bhavet| ||86|| śaraṇāgatasevāyāḥ puṇyaṃ svargapradaṃ matam | sa tvaṃ sevaya kairātiṃ dehadānena vā priya ||87|| pūjāmasmai prayuṃkṣva tvaṃ śarīre mā spṛhāṃ vaha | iti śrutvā priyāvākyaṃ kapoto’dho jagāma ha ||88|| tamutthāpyāha bhadraṃ te svāgataṃ karavāṇi te | svagṛhe vartase cātra kimicchasi karomi te ||89|| tvamatra vanamadhye me śaraṇāgata āgataḥ | śatrāvapyucitaṃ kāryamātithyaṃ gṛhamāgate ||2.211.90 || yajñatulyaṃ phalaṃ tasyātithyakarturgṛhasthiteḥ | śrutvā kirātaścovāca śītaṃ kṣudhā ca me’dya vai ||9 1 || vādhete tannivṛttyarthaṃ yatnaḥ syācced vidhīyatām | kapotaḥ śīghramuḍḍīya karmāragṛhamāgataḥ ||92|| jvalatkāṇḍaṃ gṛhītvaiva cañcvā vṛkṣamupāyayau | śuṣkaparṇeṣu vahniṃ cādīpayallubdhako’tapat ||93|| śītaṃ gataṃ tataḥ prāha bhojanaṃ dehi me priya | kapotaḥ prāha me nāsti sañcayo vanavāsinaḥ ||94|| nityoñcchavṛttyā jīvāmi nāśayeyaṃ kathaṃ kṣudhām | kintu svātmapradānena tarpaye tvāṃ nu manyase || 95|| ṛṣīṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca mahātmanām | satīnāṃ ca satāṃ pūjāṃ kuryādātmārpaṇairapi ||96|| ityuktvā triḥparikramyāgniṃ viveśa vihaṃgamaḥ | bhakṣayeti gṛṇan vākyaṃ natvātithiṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 97|| lubdhako’pi kapotaṃ saṃvīkṣyāgnibharjitaṃ tadā | uppannakaruṇaḥ prāha pātakaṃ mitraghātajam ||98|| mamotpannaṃ nṛśaṃsasya prāyaścittaṃ nu kiṃ bhavet | aho dehapradānenātithyasevā pradarśitā ||99|| so’haṃ cāpi vane sthitvā cariṣye pāralaukikam | dharmaṃ karmaṃ cariṣyāmi dharmasevā parā gatiḥ || 2.211.10 0|| ityabhidhāya śīghraṃ tatpañjaraṃ ca kapotikām | pramucya kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti jajāpa bhaktimān yathā || 101 || sā kapotīṃ patiṃ vīkṣya vahnidagdhaṃ tato’pyanu | satīdharmaṃ tadālambya vahniṃ viveśa duḥkhitā || 1 02|| tataścitrāṃgadadharaṃ bhartāraṃ sānvapaśyata | vimānasthaṃ hi devībhiḥ pūjitaśca mahātmabhiḥ || 1 03|| prāpi divyā surāṇī ca bhūtvā vimānagābhavat | lubdhakastau vimānasthau devau khe sandadarśa ha || 1 04|| sevādharmaphalaṃ dṛṣṭvā kirāto’pi tapo’karot | atithīnāṃ sevanaṃ cākarod vananivāsinām || 1 05|| pālanaṃ paśupakṣyādeḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣaṇam | dāvāgninā vane dagdhe bhasmībhūto’bhavattataḥ || 106 || naṣṭakalmaṣa evāsau japan kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | divyāṃ gatiṃ jagāmaiva sevayā brahmasevinām || 1 07|| evaṃ sevāṃ prakurvantu yāntu mokṣapadaṃ param |7 ityuktvā rādhike kṛṣṇo virarāma kṣaṇaṃ tadā || 1 08|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne’dhvaradevatāpūjanahomādyuttaraṃ bhojanaṃ, tato rāyabāleśvararāṣṭraṃ dvaipāyanadvīpaṃ ca pratigamanam | vāyuphenāpuryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ copadeśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 211 ||
<2.212> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike’tha tataḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaḥ prabhuḥ svayam | dugdhaṃ papau bhojanaṃ ca cakāra sakuṭumbakaḥ || 1 || tāvat pūjāṃ mahārājñī kartuṃ kanyāyutāyayau | tisraḥ kanyā varamālāṃ daduḥ kaṇṭhe harestadā || 2 || kṛtakṛtyā abhavam̐stā rājñī mene subhāgyakam | rājā koṭisuvarṇāni pradadau haraye tadā || 3 || prajā mahotsavaṃ cakre pūjanaṃ ca harestataḥ | pūjāṃ labdhvā drutaṃ kṛṣṇo vimānaṃ cādhyarohayat || 4 || sarvān svayaṃ cāruroha rājā sainyena vai tadā | vidāyamānaṃ sammānaṃ vyākarod vādakaistathā || 5 || svayaṃ vimānamāruhya sarṣistadāmbare’bhavat | deśān rājye suyuktām̐śca vīkṣya harirnṛpānvitaḥ || 6 || sādhudvīpaṃ tato vīkṣya haṭṭāsanābdhimāpya ca | ullaṃghya śīghramevāpādhvarabhūmiṃ niśāmukhe || 7 || bhojanaṃ madhuraṃ cakre viśaśrāma sukhoṣitaḥ | tisraḥ kanyā hareḥ sevāṃ cakrire śayane tadā || 8 || prātastūryaninādaiśca māṃgalikastavaistathā | gītibhirbrahmapatnīnāṃ prabubodha mahāprabhuḥ || 9 || kṛtasnānādikastūrṇaṃ prapūjya pitarau gurūn | yajñabhūmau haristūrṇaṃ tatrājagāma sānvayaḥ || 2.212.1 0|| ekādaśyāṃ prage viprā munayo’pi maharṣayaḥ | sādhavaḥ karmaṭhāścānye yajñamaṇḍapamāyayuḥ || 11 || devādyāḥ sthānabhoktāraḥ sarve svasthānamāyayuḥ | niṣedurvahnayaḥ kuṇḍamadhye mūrtā yathocitam || 12|| svastivāco’bhavam̐statra puṇyāhavacanāni ca | prokṣaṇānyudbodhanāni pūjanānyabhavan kramāt || 13|| havanāni tarpaṇāni yathānityaṃ tathābhavan | antimaṃ homakāryaṃ ca parihāro’bhavattathā || 14|| havyānāṃ bhojanānyevābhavaim̐stadvratapuṣṭaye | anannāhāramāpuste śrīhareḥ karataḥ surāḥ || 15|| tṛptāstatra mahātṛptiṃ gatā hariprasādajām | atha tatra mahādravyadakṣiṇāḥ svarṇaratnajāḥ || 16|| koṭyabjārbudapadmānāṃ parārdhānāṃ parātparāḥ | viprebhyo’dāpayat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśca rājabhiḥ || 17|| tataḥ sarve’pi rājāno rājñīyuktā nije nije | kuṇḍe cakrurhavanāni pūrṇāhutyātmakāni vai || 18|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’pi mukhyakuṇḍake | pūrṇāhutīrdadau vahnau devatābhyo’mṛtātmikāḥ || 19|| tataścacāra bhagavān mahāpūrṇāhutiṃ parām | tadā muktā avatārā īśvarā munayastathā ||2.212.20|| ṛṣayo devatāḥ sarvā devyaśca mānavādayaḥ | kāśyapyaśca prajāḥ sarvā mūrtimanto narāḥ striyaḥ ||21|| caruprasādalābhārthaṃ mahāpūrṇahavāptaye | sthāvarā jaṃgamāḥ sarve copatasthurhi maṇḍape ||22|| ghṛtadhārāsahasrādyaistṛpyante devatādayaḥ | vasudhārāyutādyaiśca tṛpyante’nantasṛṣṭayaḥ ||23 || mahāpūrṇāhutihomasaṃkalpottarameva tu | mṛḍaṃ vahniṃ namaskṛtyājyaṃ cādhiśritya sruksruvau ||24|| pratāpya darbhaiḥ sammṛjyodvāsyājyamabhivīkṣya ca | saṃskṛtyājyaṃ gṛhītvā śrīphalaṃ sruci nidhāya ca || 25|| tāmbūlaṃ ca phalānyatra pūgākṣatādikāni ca | dhṛtvopari ca samidho’laṃkṛtya puṣpacandanaiḥ ||26|| pūrṇāhutyai nama iti saṃpūjya havyameva ca | dhṛtvā karābhyāṃ bhagavān rājādyā yajamānakāḥ ||27|| sthitāḥ praṇālikādvārā ghṛtadhārāḥ sahasraśaḥ | kuṇḍamadhye pravahantyavicchinnāśca tadā muhuḥ ||28|| vedamantrā abhavam̐ścoccaritā vahnidevatāḥ | vahnerdhyānaṃ tadā cakruḥ sākṣāt sthitasya hominaḥ ||29|| catuḥśṛṃgaṃ tridhā baddhaṃ dvimūrdhānaṃ samujjvalam | nāsādvayaṃ ca ṣaṇṇetraṃ catuḥśrotraṃ tripādakam ||2.212.3 0|| saptahastaṃ dakṣe catuḥkaraṃ vāme trihastakam | sruvaṃ srucaṃ tathā śaktimakṣamālāṃ ca dakṣiṇe ||3 1 || tomaraṃ vyajanaṃ caiva ghṛtapātraṃ tu vāmake | dadhānaṃ saptajihvaṃ ca trirjihvottarakānanam ||32|| caturjihvaṃ dakṣabhāge dvipañcāśatkalāyutam | koṭidvādaśamūrtyākhyaṃ raktapadmāsanasthitam ||33|| svāhāsvadhāvaṣaṭkārairaṃkitaṃ raktahāriṇam | piṃgākṣaṃ lohitagrīvaṃ kṛṣṇamārgaṃ hutāśanam ||34|| jvālāmayaṃ tathā saptārciṣaṃ taṃ havyavāhanam | agniṃ vaiśvānaraṃ tvāṃ vai namāmo gocaraṃ suram ||35|| iti dhyātvā tathā natvā vedamantrān jagurdvijāḥ | ghṛtadhārāḥ patantyeva tatra sahasraśo’nale ||36|| oṃ samudrādūrmirmadhumām̐ udāradupām̐śunā samamṛtatvamānaṭ | ghṛtasya nāma guhyaṃ yadasti jihvā devānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ ||37|| vayannāmapprabravāmāghṛtasyāsmin yajñe dhārayāmā namobhiḥ | upa brahmā śṛṇavacchasyamānaṃ catuḥśṛṃgovamīdgaura etat ||38|| catvāri śṛṃgāstrayo asya pādā dve śīrṣe saptahastāso asya | tridhā baddho vṛṣabho roravīti mahodevo martyānāviveśa ||3 9|| tridhā hitaṃ paṇibhirguhyamānaṃ gavi devāso ghṛtamanvaviṃdan | indra ekaṃ sūrya ekaṃ jajāna venādekaṃ svadhayā niṣṭatakṣuḥ ||2.212.40|| etā arṣanti hṛdyāt samudrācchatavrajāripuṇānāvacakṣe | ghṛtasya dhārā abhicākaśīmi hiraṇyayo vetaso madhya āsām ||41|| samyaka sravanti sarito’naghenāantarhṛdā manasā pūyamānāḥ | ete’arṣantyūrmayo ghṛtasya mṛgā iva kṣipaṇo rīṣamāṇāḥ ||42|| sindhoriva prādhvane śūghanāso vvātappramiyaḥ patayanti yahvāḥ | ghṛtasya dhārāaruṣona vvājī kāṣṭhā bhindannūrmibhiḥ pinvamānāḥ ||43|| abhipravaṃta samaneva yoṣāḥ kalyāṇyaḥ smayamānāso’agnim | ghṛtasya dhārāḥ samidho na santatā juṣāṇo haryyati jātavedāḥ ||44|| kanyā iva vvahatumetavāu aṃjyaṃjānāabhicākaśīmi | yatra somaḥ sūyate yatra yajño ghṛtasya dhārāati tatpavante ||45|| abhyarṣata suṣṭutiṃ gavyamājimasmāsu bhadrā draviṇāni dhatta | imaṃ yajñaṃ nayata devatā no ghṛtasya dhārā madhumatpavante ||46|| dhāmaṃ te viśvaṃ bhuvanamadhiśritamantaḥsamudre hṛdyantarāyuṣi | apāmanīke samitheya ābhṛtastamaśyāma madhumantaṃ ta ūrmim ||47|| oṃ mūrdhānaṃ divo aratiṃ pṛthivyā vaiśvānaramṛta ājātamagnim | kaviṃ samrājamatithiṃ janānāmāsannā pātraṃ janayanta devāḥ ||48|| oṃ citiṃ juhomi manasā ghṛtena yathā devā ihāgaman vītahotrā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ | patye viśvasya bhūmano juhomi viśvakarmaṇe viśvāhādābbhyaṃ haviḥ ||49|| sapta te agne samidhaḥ saptajihvāḥ sapta ṛṣayaḥ saptadhāma priyāṇi | saptahotrāḥ saptadhātvā yajanti saptayonīrāpṛṇasvā ghṛtena svāhā ||2.212.50|| śukraṃ jyotiśca citrajyotiśca satyajyotiśca | jyotiṣmām̐śca śukraśca ṛtapāścātyaṃhāḥ ||51 || īdṛṅtvānnyādṛṅca sadṛṅc pratisadṛṅca | mitaśca saṃmitaśca sabharāḥ ||52|| ṛtaśca satyaśca dhruvaśca dharuṇaśca dhartā ca vidhartā ca vidhādhayaḥ | ṛtajicca satyajicca senajicca suṣeṇaśca antimitraśca dūre’amitraśca guṇaḥ ||53|| īdṛkṣāsa etādṛkṣāsa ūṣuṇaḥ sadṛkṣāsaḥ pratisadṛkṣāsa etana | mitāsaśca sammitāso no’adya sabharaso maruto yajñe’smin ||54||| svatavām̐śca praghāsī ca sāntapanaśca gṛhamedhī ca krīḍī ca śākī cojjeṣi | ugraśca bhīmaśca dhvāntaśca dhuniśca sāsahvāṃścābhiyugvā ca vikṣipaḥ svāhā ||55|| punastvādityā rudrā vasavaḥ samindhatāṃ punarbrahmāṇovvasunītha yajñaiḥ | ghṛtena tvaṃ tannvanvardhayasva satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ ||56 || vasoḥ pavitramasi śatadhāraṃ vasoḥ pavitramasi sahasradhāram | devastvā savitā punātu vasoḥ pavitreṇa śatadhāreṇa suppvāvākāmadhukṣaḥ ||57|| pūrṇā darvvi parāpata supūrṇā punarāpata vasneva vvikrīṇāvahā iṣamūrjjaṃ śatakrato svāhā | idamagnaye vaiśvānarāya vasurudrādityebhyaḥ śatakratave adbhyaśca namama ||58|| idaṃ diviṣadbhyo bhuvaḥ sadbhyo mahaḥṣadbhyo janasadbhyastapaḥsadbhyaśca namama | idaṃ satyasadbhyaścāvṛtiṣadbhyaśceśvarebhyo virājāya mahāvirājāya namama ||59|| idaṃ viṣṇubhyo mahāviṣṇubhyo hiraṇyagarbhebhyo namama | idaṃ bhūmabhyo mahāpuruṣebhyo mahākālebhyaścaturvyūhebhyo namama ||2.212.6 0 || idaṃ cākṣarāya cākṣaraṣadbhyo’vatārebhyo’vatāriṇe namama | idaṃ brahmapriyābhya īśanībhyo dhāminībhyaḥ satībhyo namama ||6 1 || idaṃ pārṣadebhyaḥ pārṣadānībhyo gaṇebhyo gaṇanībhyo namama | idaṃ yogibhyo yoginībhyaḥ sarvapālebhyaḥ kṣetrapebhyo namama ||62|| idaṃ maharṣibhyaśca pitṛbhyo vāyavīyebhyo jalīyebhyo namama | idaṃ yamīyebhyaḥ kāśyapīyebhyo yakṣebhyo rākṣasebhyaśca namam ||63||| idaṃ mānavebhyo mānavībhyaḥ pāśavībhyaḥ paśubhyaśca namama | idṃ pākṣiṇībhyaśca pakṣibhyaḥ sṛpebhyaśca sṛpībhyaśca namama ||64|| idaṃ dāsebhyaśca dāsībhyaśca pādapebhyo vallībhyaśca namama | idaṃ tṛṇebhyaśca stambebhyaśca virudbhyaśca mūlebhyo namama ||65|| idaṃ tīrthebhyaśca nadībhyaścābdhibhyaśca taḍāgebhyo namama | idaṃ caityebhyaśca jaḍebhyaśca tattvebhyaśca cetanebhyo namama ||66|| idaṃ daityebhyaśca bhūtebhyaśca piśācebhyaśca bhūtinyādibhyaśca namama | idaṃ adhobhyaścoparibhyaścāntarebhyaśca pārśvagebhyo namama ||67|| idaṃ sādhyebhyaśca tāpasebhyaśca sāṃkhyayoginībhyaśca namama | idamaṃśebhyaśca kalābhyaścāveśebhyaśca vibhūtibhyo namama ||68|| idaṃ arcābhyaścāntaryāmiṇe ca svarūpebhyo rūpebhyo namama | idaṃ vibhavebhyaśca pratibimbebhyaścāvatīrṇebhyaśca namama ||69|| idaṃ tyāgibhyaśca yatibhyaśca śīlibhyaśca brahmiṣṭebhyo namama | idaṃ guṇebhyaśca kriyābhyaśca rasebhyaśca priyābhyaśca namama ||2.212.70 || idaṃ garbhebhyaśca bālebhyaśca yuvabhyaśca sthavīrebhyaśca namama | idaṃ pretebhyaśca vṛṣavandhebhyaśca kālebhyaśca namama ||71|| idaṃ kośebhyaścendriyebhyaśca śaktibhyaśca devatābhyo namama | idaṃ māyābhyaśceśānebhyaśceśānībhyaśca vaiṣṇīvībhyaśca namama ||72|| idaṃ brāhmībhyaśca brahmāṇībhyaśca vairājībhyaśca bhūmnībhyaśca namama | idaṃ dhāmabhyaśca vikuṇṭhābhyo hāritābhyaḥ śvetābhyaśca namama ||173|| idaṃ piśaṃgībhyaśca raktābhyaśca gaurībhyaḥ smāritābhyaśca namama | idaṃ lakṣmyai rādhikāyai sarasvatyai durgāyai gaṃgāyai namama ||74|| idaṃ virajāyai padmāvatyai ramāyai māṇikyai maṃjulāyai namama | idaṃ kamalāyai haṃsāyai camṛtāyai sadguṇāyai sudevyai ca namama ||75|| idaṃ duḥkhahālakṣmyai santuṣṭāyai cāmarībhyaḥ kambharāyai śriyai namama | idaṃ dharmāya ca vṛṣāya ca gopālāya ca bhagavate vallabhāya ca namama ||76|| idaṃ śukāya ca svataḥprakāśāya ca mahāvyāsāya ca daivādhikāśāya ca namama | idaṃ brahmasṛṣṭyai ceśasṛṣṭyai jīvasṛṣṭyai sarvasṛṣṭyai asṛṣṭyai ca namama ||77|| idaṃ viśiṣṭāya pareśāyānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namama | idaṃ yajñāya ca havyāya ca pātrebhyaścopakaraṇebhyaśca śrīkṛṣṇavallabhāya ca namama ||78|| idaṃ kuṇḍāya ca vedebhyaśca maṇḍapāya ca svarebhyaśca namama | idṃ mahīmānebhyaśca dīnebhyaścānāthebhyaśca kīṭebhyaśca namama ||79|| idaṃ bhikṣukebhyaśca nyāsibhyaśca bhṛtyebhyaśca sāśebhyaścāntevāsibhyaśca namama | idṃ pratīkṣadbhyaścāpratīkṣadbhyaśca mūrtebhyaścāmūrtebhyaśca tattvebhyaśca namama ||2.212.80|| idaṃ līnebhyaścālīnebhyaścāgatebhyaścānāgatebhyaśca namama | idaṃ lokibhyaścālokibhyaśca dehibhyaścādehibhyaśca paricchinnebhyaśca namama ||8 1 || idaṃ smṛtebhyaścāsmṛtebhyaścograkebhyaścānugrakebhyaścāparicchinnebhyaśca namama | idaṃ sāttvikebhyaśca rājasebhyaśca tāmasebhyaśca trikāspṛṣṭebhyaśca namama | |82 | idamindriyavadbhyaścānindriyebhyaśca kalalebhyaśca bījebhyaśca sūkṣmebhyo namama | idaṃ yāvadbhyaśca prayāvadbhyaśca parāṇubhyaścānaṇubhyaścāṃkurebhyaśca namama | |82 || idaṃ kāmebhyaśca ratibhyaścaiśvaryebhyaścāvṛṣebhyaśca yonibhyaśca namama | idaṃ bhaktibhyaścāparābhyaśca śāradābhyaśca bhūmyaśca liṃgebhyaśca namama | |84|| idṃ līlābhyaśca tulasībhyaśca daivasamidbhyaśca namama | idaṃ pūjābhyaścārhaṇābhyaśca svāgatābhyaśca namama ||85 || idaṃ rājabhyaśca prajābhyaśca śraddadhānebhyaśca namama | idaṃ vaṃśebhyaśca pravaṃśebhyaścānuvaṃśebhyaśca namama ||86|| idaṃ satībhyaśca garbhiṇībhyaśca prasūtābhyaśca namama | idaṃ viṣibhyaśca daṃṣṭribhyaśca śṛṃgibhyaśca namama ||87|| idaṃ mantribhyaśca malibhyaścāmalibhyaśca namama | idaṃ hetibhyaśra veṣebhyaśca yantrebhyaśca namama ||88|| idaṃ gantrībhyaśca vimānebhyaśca yānebhyaśca namama | idaṃ kalpebhyaśca kalpadrubhyaśca kalpavallībhyaśca namama ||89|| idaṃ dhenubhyaśca kāmadughābhyaśca cintāmaṇibhyaśca namama | idṃ brahmasarase brahmahradāyāmṛtadhārāyākṣayapātrāya namama || 2.212.90 || idaṃ caitasmai cetadvṛttaye mahākṛṣṇāya bālakṛṣṇāya namama | idaṃ brahmaṇe ca parabrahmaṇe ca nārāyaṇāya paramātmane namama || 9 1 || ityevaṃ rādhike havyāhutayo’nantanāmabhiḥ | dīyante kuṇḍake vahnau sākṣād devapradāya vai | | 92|| āgatyāgatya sarve te gṛhṇanti vahnikānanāt | tṛptāḥ prayānti sukhinaḥ sodgārāḥ sāśiṣastadā || 93 || evaṃ kṛtaṃ hi havanaṃ nārikelādibhistadā | mahāpūrṇāhutiprakhyaṃ bālakṛṣṇo’nale śubhe || 94|| divyarūpo’bhavad dṛśyaḥ sarveṣāmeva dehinām | viśvaṃbharaḥ svayaṃ bhuṃkte havyāni vividhāni vai || 9 5|| antarbhāvya tu tām̐stām̐śca tṛptastṛptiṃ dadāti vai | śarkarā madhuparkāśca caravaśca phalāni ca ||96|| ghṛtāni vrīhayo divyā rasā miṣṭānnakāni ca | amṛtāni sudhāścāpi peyāni vividhānyapi || 97|| kaṇabhūjāni sasyāni bījāni samidhastathā | dugdhasārāṇi cānyāni hūyante cānale harau ||98|| yadyalloke tu yānyeva yeṣāṃ khādyāni santi ca | sattvabhāvāni tānyeva hūyante cānale harau || 99|| yeṣāṃ yat tṛptikṛccāpi sarvajño bālakṛṣṇakaḥ | tatpradāyaiva taṃ tāṃ vā tarpayatyeva cānale || 2.212.1 00|| evaṃ pūrṇāhutirjātā mahāpūrṇāhutistathā | tṛptaṃ jātaṃ jagat sarvaṃ tṛptaṃ vai sṛṣṭimaṇḍalam || 101 || tṛptaṃ sṛṣṭeḥ paraṃ cāpi sarvaṃ vai brahmamaṇḍalam | tato devādayaḥ prāhuḥ pacyante nodare’dhunā || 1 02|| havyānīti parihāraṃ karotu parameśvaraḥ | ityevaṃ devakoṭīnāṃ ghoṣaṇāyāṃ hariḥ svayam ||1 03|| tṛptaḥ prasannaścodgāraṃ prāpya homāntakaṃ vyadhāt | mahāpūrṇāhutau home jāte nārāyaṇāstadā | amṛtākhyaphalānyagnau juhuvurdhāmajāni vai || 1 04|| muktāḥ kalpamayānyeva phalāni juhuvustadā | īśvarā aiśvarasudhāphalāni juhuvustadā || 1 05|| ṛṣayo devatāścāpi pīyūṣaphalakāni ca | juhuvurmānavā nārikelāni śarkarāstathā || 106 || parvatāścandanādīni dhenavaḥ pāyasānyapi | drumā rasān śreṣṭhagundrān juhuvuḥ sarvaśastadā || 1 07|| sasyāni juhuvustatra śālikaṇādikān śubhān | vallayo miṣṭapuṣpāṇi devyo miṣṭānnakāni ca || 1 08|| yathā yeṣāmabhūt smṛddhistathā phalādikāni vai | juhuvustatra kuṇḍāgnau parameśe parātpare || 1 09|| patravantastu patrāṇi gandhavantaḥ sugandhakān | tvagvantaśca tvacaḥ śreṣṭhā juhuvustatra cānale || 2.212.11 0|| trailokyāṃ vyānaśe dhūmraḥ sugandhimiṣṭatṛptidaḥ | sṛṣṭitrayaṃ tadā tṛptaṃ harau tṛpte hi rādhike || 11 1|| evaṃ yajño mahān jāto madhyāhne’bhūt samāptimān | devānāṃ dakṣiṇādānaṃ pūjanaṃ ca visarjanam || 1 12|| cakāra bhagavān sākṣād dakṣiṇādānamityapi | bhikṣukāṇāṃ hi sarveṣāṃ bhojanādīnyakārayat || 1 13|| ācāryādyā yathāyogyāḥ sāmagrīrjagṛhuśca tāḥ | yajñīyā dakṣiṇādyāśca parihārastato’bhavat || 1 14|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne caikādaśyāṃ mahāpūrṇāhutipradānaṃ sarveṣāṃ tṛptiryajñaparihāraścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 212 ||
<2.213> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike yajñabhūmau vai kuṇḍe tvagnirmahānalaḥ | acumbata vyoma hṛṣṭaścāśīrvādān dadau tadā || 1 || bhūmiśceyaṃ śāntivṛttiḥ śreṣṭhasmṛddhimayī sadā | nītisaukhyaprapūrāśca prajāḥ santu sadā tviha || 2 || amaryaḥ sukhabhāgyāśca smṛddhāḥ santu sadā tviha | rājāno nyāyamārgasthā mahāsmṛddhā bhavantu vai || 3 || kanyakāḥ sukhavatyaśca kumārāḥ smṛddhisaṃyutāḥ | prajā dīrghajīvavatyo bhavantu rogavarjitāḥ || 4 || sasyasmṛddhiḥ sadā cāstu svarṇarūpyādibhūrilā | buddhimanto janāḥ santu striyaḥ saubhāgyasaṃbhṛtāḥ || 5 || paśavo bahudugdhāśca pādapā rasasaṃbhṛtāḥ | rasālā pṛthivī cāstu devatulyāḥ kuṭumbinaḥ || 6 || sāmrājyaṃ śreṣṭhasattākaṃ cāstu smṛddhaṃ dhanādibhiḥ | divyo bhavatu deśo’yaṃ khaṇḍāḥ santu samṛddhayaḥ || 7 || pātrāṇi santu manujā devarṣigurupūjakāḥ | yajñā bhavantu loke’tra svarṇaṃ cāstu samunnatam || 8 || ityevaṃ vahninā dattā āśīrvādā hi cādhvare | aśrūyanta janaiḥ sarvaiḥ prasannahṛdayaistadā || 9 || evamāśīrvacanāni datvā vahnistiro’bhavat | yajñabhasmaprasādaṃ ca jagṛhurdehinastadā || 2.213.1 0|| yajñe parihṛte cājñā bhojanānāṃ tadābhavat | dīyante miṣṭabhojyāni tadā sarvavidhāni hi || 1 1|| bhuṃjate dehinaḥ paṃktibaddhā īśasurādikāḥ | mānavāścānyajātīyāstadā miṣṭānnamadhvare || 1 2|| dīyatāṃ dīyatāṃ ceti bhujyatāṃ bhujyatāmiti | gṛhyatāṃ gṛhyatāṃ ceti vadanti pariveṣakāḥ || 13|| asaṃkhyānnaṃ tathā
