dravyamasaṃkhyaṃ dīyate tadā | ambarāṇi hyasaṃkhyāni pātrāṇi vividhāni ca || 14|| annānyapi vividhāni dīyante tatra cādhvare | ekādaśyāṃ mahādānānyādīyante samantataḥ || 15|| rājabhiśca prajābhiśca svarṇapradhānakāni vai | rādhike ye mahīmānāste’pi dadati sarvaśaḥ || 16|| grāhakāśca gṛhītvaiva dadatyaparayācine | koṭiśo dehinastatra bhuñjate havyamuttamam || 17|| evaṃ samutsave jāte’vabhṛthārthaṃ prabhurjanān | munīn prajājanānāha nadīsaraḥsamāgame || 18|| snātuṃ gantavyamevādya sajjā bhavantu vai drutam | paṭaho vai mahām̐statra tāḍito ghoṣaṇākṛte || 19|| avabhṛthārthaṃ cāyāntu bhagavām̐statra yāti vai | yāni kāni ca pāpāni jantudrohodbhavāni ca ||2.213.20|| karmakāṇḍasya vaiguṇye samutthāni ca yānyapi | kaṇaśālisamiddhome yāni vā duritāni ca || 21 || teṣāṃ vināśanārthaṃ vāvabhathaṃ śasyate sadā | avabhṛthe’vatāraiśceśvarairdevaiśca mānavaiḥ ||22|| snātavyaṃ varuṇaṃ sampūjyaivāpūjya ca vāri ca | āmalakīphalaiścāpi bhasmanā ca ghṛtena ca ||23||| tīrthamṛdā tilaiścāpi snātavyaṃ vāribhistadā | ityevaṃ paṭahenāpi bodhitā mānavādayaḥ ||24|| īśvarā devatāścāpi nārāyaṇā nareśvarāḥ | devyaḥ satyo bhagavatyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginya ityapi ||25|| vādyaghoṣairgītibhiścāyayustvabhṛthāya vai | śeṣakāṣṭhavanānadyā vinipārasarovare ||26|| saṃgame pāvane sasnurvidhinā makhinastadā | yatra yatra taṭe ye ye tvabhavam̐statra tatra te ||27|| sasnuḥ sampūjya varuṇaṃ tīrthāni ca jalāni ca | bhagavān śrībālakṛṣṇo brahmapriyāśca yoṣitaḥ |||28|| sasnurdevāstathā devyastīrthottamaṃ hyabhūjjalam | nārāyaṇāvatārāśca tathā rādhāramādayaḥ || 29||| sasnustatra tu tīrthāni pāvanānyapi śuddhaye | evaṃ cāvabhṛthe jāte tvāyayurvai gṛhānnijān ||2.213.3 0|| tataḥ sabhā mahatyāsīt pāritoṣikalabdhaye | sarvebhyaḥ karmacāribhyastūpadāḥ svarṇanirmitāḥ ||3 1|| bhūṣā dravyāṇi ratnāni dīyante mādhavena vai | hārāḥ svarṇamayāścāpi śreṣṭhāmbarāṇi cāpi tu ||32|| suvarṇacandrakā ratnanaddhāḥ kāryaprasūcakāḥ | guṇāvedanarekhāśca makhacihnasamanvitaḥ ||33 || rūpyacandrāstathā caurṇakambalāmbaraśāṭikāḥ | tantikāḥ kuṇḍale cāpi raśanāṃgulimudrikāḥ || 34|| ūrmikāḥ kaṭakāścāpi mauktikānāṃ srajaḥ śubhāḥ | svarṇapātrāṇi ramyāṇi sthālikāḥ kalaśāstathā ||35||| chatrāṇi cāmare cāpi vyajanāni vimānakam | siṃhāsanāni ramyāṇi paṭṭikā ca catuṣpadī ||36|| svarṇamaṇimahāhārā mālāśca hīrakaiḥ kṛtāḥ | pāritoṣikarūpeṇa dadau śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ||37|| kṣatriyebhyaścāyudhāni viprebhyo yājanāni ca | anyebhyastu yathāpekṣaṃ dadau vai pāritoṣikam || 38|| mūrtayaḥ svarṇamayyo yāḥ prāṇaiḥ supratiyojitāḥ | pūjanārthaṃ dadau svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāryakaḥ || 39|| ācāryādeśamālambya bhūbhṛdbhyastatra cādhvare | evaṃ samāpya sarvaṃ vai kṣaṇaṃ viśrāntimāpa ha ||2.213.40|| tāvattatra samāgatya rāyalambārabhūpatiḥ | rūpartumaharṣiścāpi prārthayāmāsaturdrutam ||41 || kimuvakrān pradeśān nau kimuvakrāṃ purīṃ tathā | prapunīhi mahārājaikādaśyāmadya śobhanām ||42|| haristvathāsviti prāhāsahat sajjo vimānakam | kuṭumbena hareṇāpi lomaśena samanvitaḥ ||43|| rājā tūrṇaṃ yayau pūrvaṃ svāgatārthaṃ vimānagaḥ | hariḥ sāyaṃ yayau śīghraṃ kimuvakrāṃ purīṃ śubhām ||44|| rājadarśitamārgeṇāvātārayad vimānakam | udyāne nijasaudhasya svāgataṃ cācaran nṛpaḥ ||45|| vādyāni bahuramyāṇi tadāvādyanta sarvataḥ | prajā draṣṭuṃ samāyātā vardhayāmāsuracyutam ||46|| vimānācchrīharistatrodyāne bahirupāyayau | lājākṣatādibhiḥ puṣpaiścandanaiḥ parameśvaram ||47|| vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ prajādyā narayoṣitaḥ | rājā saudhe hariṃ natvā pupūja bahuratnakaiḥ ||48|| rājñī pūjāṃ cakārātha kanyakā bhūbhṛtastu ṣaṭ | vavrire bhagavantaṃ taṃ varamālāpradānakaiḥ ||49|| kṛtakṛtyāstu tā jātā rājā mumoda cāpyati | rājñī mumoda bahudhā dadāvupāyanāni ca ||2.213.50|| yautakaṃ pradadau rājñī nīrājanaṃ tato’karot | bhojayāmāsa dgdhādi pāyasaṃ śārṅgiṇe tadā ||5 1 || atha sainyena sahitaṃ tvācāryaṃ kṛṣṇavallabham | nagaryāṃ bhrāmayāmāsa rājamārgeṇa bhūpatiḥ ||52|| pradhānāḥ śreṣṭhinaścānye vardhayāmāsurīśvaram | pupūjuśca prajāḥ sarvā vakriṇyaḥ kanyakāstathā ||53|| hāraiḥ phalairdhanaiścāpi kambalairambarādibhiḥ | vibhūṣābhiḥ samānarcuḥ sarvaṃ dhanaṃ haristadā ||54|| rūpartuṛṣaye prādād yautakaṃ nītavān saha | rājasaudhaṃ samāgatya niśi viśrāntimāpa ca ||55|| kanyāṣaṭkprasevāṃ ca gṛhṇan bubodha vai prage | kṛtāhnikaḥ payaḥ pītvā gantuṃ sajjo’bhavaddhariḥ ||56|| sūryodaye samāyācca sainyasammānito drutam | prāpya pūjāṃ yajñapṛthvyāṃ naijālaye hyavātarat ||57|| evaṃ vai rādhike kṛtvā kimuvakrāṃ purīṃ śubhām | pāvanīṃ dvādaśīprātaryajñasthalīṃ vyalokayat ||58|| mahīmānānsārvabhaumānākārayat sabhāsthale | muktā dhāmānyavatārā nārāyaṇāstatheśvarāḥ ||59||. ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā daityāśca mānavāstathā | khagā jalagāḥ pātālāvāsāḥ sarve samāyayuḥ ||2.213.60|| sthāvarā jaṃgamāścāpi jaḍāśca cetanāstathā | dāsā bhṛtyāḥ svāminaśca svāminyaśca sabhāṃ yayuḥ ||61 || īśvarāṇyastathā nārāyaṇyaḥ satyaḥ surapriyāḥ | sarvapriyāścāyayuścāpsaraso mātṛkāstathā ||62|| yatinyo brahmasaraso brahmacāriṇya ityapi | sāṃkhyayoginya evāpi sṛṣṭayaścāgatāḥ sabhām ||63 || hariḥ prasanno bhagavān kalpadrudhenuvallikāḥ | kalpamaṇīn sevakām̐śca pārṣadān sevikāstathā ||64|| parṣadyākārayāmāsāyayuste tāḥ sabhāṃ tadā | siṃhāsaneṣu divyeṣu bhrājamāneṣu sūryavat ||65||| āsīneṣu samasteṣu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’bravīt | āgatebhyo’vatārebhyaḥ sarvebhyaścāha mādhavaḥ ||66|| sammānanaṃ dhanyabhāvaṃ kurve’haṃ bhavatāmiha | dhāmānyapi vihāyaiva yajñārthaṃ yadupāgatāḥ ||67|| īśvarāṇāmīśvarīṇāṃ sammānaṃ dhanyabhāvanām | kurve’haṃ dūrataścāpi yajñārthaṃ yadupāgatāḥ ||68||| ṛṣīṇāṃ ca munīnāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā | sammānaṃ dhanyavādaṃ ca kurve yanmakhamāgatāḥ ||69|| devānāṃ kāśyapīnāṃ ca prajānāṃ manujanmanām | sammānaṃ dhanyavādaṃ ca kurve yanmakhamāgatāḥ ||2.213.70| vṛkṣādīnāṃ tṛṇādīnāṃ vallīnāṃ virudhāṃ tathā | sanmānaṃ dhanyavādṃ ca kurve yanmakhamāgatāḥ ||7 1 | tīrthānāṃ daivatatvānāṃ jaḍānāṃ ca citāmapi | sammānaṃ dhanyavādaṃ ca kurve yanmakhamāgatāḥ ||72| pātālatalavāsānāṃ jalasthalanivāsinām | vahnivāyunivāsānāṃ tīrthānāṃ bhūbhṛtāṃ tathā ||73 || lokānāṃ ca diśāṃ pālakānāṃ ca karmacāriṇām | pārṣadānāṃ gaṇānāṃ ca gaṇeśānāṃ ca yoginām ||74|| sanmānaṃ dhanyavādaṃ ca kurve yanmakhamāgatāḥ | yajñārthaṃ kṛtayatnānāṃ sevakānāṃ samantataḥ ||75 || sevikānāṃ samastānāṃ kṣetrapānāṃ samantataḥ | dāsīnāṃ dāsavargāṇāṃ rakṣakāṇāṃ samantataḥ ||76 || sarvādhikāramāptānāṃ rasaśālākṛtāṃ tathā | dravyaśālārakṣakāṇāṃ saṃkalpavastusaṃjuṣām ||77 || dātṝṇāṃ ca nṛpāṇāṃ ca nṛpīṇāṃ brahmayoṣitām | viprāṇāṃ vedamantrāṇāṃ havyānāṃ makhapātriṇām ||78 || tattvānāṃ jaḍagranthīnāṃ caityānāṃ viśvakarmaṇām | sammānaṃ dhanyavādaṃ ca kurve yanmakhamāgatāḥ ||79 || vidāyaṃ prāñjaliṃ cātmaprasādatvaṃ śubhāśiṣaḥ | manmūrtiṃ svarṇarūpyādi sudhāmṛtāni sandade ||2.213.8 0 || mukuṭāni kaṭakāni sucandrakāṇi sandade | bhūṣāmbarāṇi pātrāṇi cāmbarāṇyapi sandade ||8 1 || chatrāṇi divyayānāni śāṭyādīni ca sandade | śirastrāṇāni ramyāṇi kauśeyāni ca sandade ||82 || hastyaśvaratharatnāni hīrakānapi sandade | śṛṃgārāṇi vicitrāṇi kañcukādīni sandade ||83 || akṣayānyapi pātrāṇi kalpavṛkṣādikān dade | kalpavallīḥ kalpadhenūḥ kalpamaṇīn dade ca vaḥ ||84 || divyajñānaṃ mahaiśvaryaṃ divyatejo dade ca vaḥ | divyarddhiṃ śāśvatīṃ śāntiṃ bhaktiṃ sevāṃ dade ca vaḥ ||85 || divyasiddhīrmahālābhaṃ mamāmṛtaṃ dade ca vaḥ | ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇavallabhācārya iṣṭakṛt || 86 || dadau divyākṣarasvarṇakṛtakirīṭakuṇḍale | avatārebhya evādye īśvarebhyastataḥ param ||87 || lokapālebhya evāpi rājabhyaśca tataḥ param | evaṃ sarvebhya evāpi yathāyogyaṃ tvapekṣitam ||88 || naranārīsametebhyo dadau vai pāritoṣikam | prātaścaivaṃ dānakarma samācaraddharistataḥ ||89 || dāsabhṛtyādidehibhyo dhanāni vyataratprabhuḥ | svarṇahārān ratnahārān dadau yogyān punaḥ punaḥ || 2.213.90 || nārībhyo nārikāyogyā dadau bhūṣāḥ suvarṇajāḥ | annapātrebhya evāpi dadāvannāni sarvaśaḥ || 91 || vastrapātrebhya evāpi dadau vastrāṇi sarvaśaḥ | bahubhyo gṛhadānāni dadau nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 12 || rājadvārādāpayacca bhavanāni dvijātaye | evaṃ sarvaṃ dānakarma tvapārayatprabhuḥ svayam || 93 || bhojanaṃ tu tataścaivākārayat sārvabhaumikam | pāraṇātma śubhaṃ miṣṭaṃ pāyasānnamabhojayat || 94|| rasānnaṃ madhuparkānnaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ cāpyabhojayat | sudhānnaṃ cāmṛtānnaṃ ca pīyūṣānnamabhojayat || 95 || puṇyānnaṃ bhāvanānnaṃ ca phalānnaṃ cāpyabhojayat | kaṇānnaṃ cāpi munyannaṃ patrānnaṃ cāpyabhojayat || 96 || bhājānnaṃ cāṃkurānnaṃ ca sasyānnaṃ cāpyabhojayat | jalīyānnaṃ pāvanānnaṃ cānalānnamabhojayat || 97|| taijasānnaṃ ca dhāmānnaṃ sāttvikānnamabhojayat | śuddhasattvānnakaṃ līlāvibhūtyannamabodhayat || 98 || ṛtvannaṃ cāpyaṛtvannaṃ dehajānnamabhojayat | kalpānnaṃ cāpi siddhayannaṃ siddhānnaṃ cāpyabhojayat || 99 || bhāvanānnaṃ ca tṛptyannaṃ santoṣānnamabhojayat | ānandānnaṃ mahāsaukhyānnakaṃ sarvānabhojayat | | 2.213.100 || takraṃ ca śarkarāṃ dugdhaṃ sūpaṃ tathaudanādikam | pūrikāṃ polikāṃ cāpi vyaṃjanānnānyabhojayat || 101 || miṣṭānnāni kvathikāśca caṭanīḥ parpaṭādikān | sevikāśca tathāpūpān saṃyāvaṃ cāpyabhojayat || 102|| caṇakām̐śca phullavaṭīrbharjitāścāpyabhojayat | meśubhām̐śca sukhadām̐śca mohasthālānabhojayat | | 103 || cakrapārān sthirakām̐śca granthakānapyabhojayat | rājikārāddhamevāpi tvāranālānyabhojayat || 1 04|| dadhighṛtaṃ navanītaṃ gūḍaṃ madhu hyabhojayat | amblavāna śaratpibaṃ cāmrarasānabhojayat || 105 | | phalāni tvārdraśuṣkāṇi bījānyapi hyabhojayat | mukhavāsān gandhikaṇān tāmbūlakānyabhojayat || 106 || brahmahṛdasya salilaṃ sarvebhyo’pāyayat prabhuḥ | evaṃ prabhojayitvaiva svayaṃ tu bubhuje hariḥ || 107 || kuṭumbena tu sahito brahmapriyāsamanvitaḥ | rādhāramāsatīlakṣmīprabhāpāravatīyutaḥ || 108 | | māṇikīduḥkhahālakṣmīmaṃjulāmṛtikāyutaḥ | saguṇāśāradāhaṃsādurgāsarasvatīyutaḥ || 109 || pitarau bubhujāte ca lomaśādyā gurūttamāḥ | bubhujire ca sarve vai dehino mahīmānakāḥ || 2.213.110 || gāṃgeyāścāmareyāśca maharṣayaśca kanyakāḥ | nadā nadyaśca tīrthāni bubhujire’tikaṇṭhataḥ || 111 || madhyāhne śrīharistatra rājabhyo’bhojayattvati | madhyāhnottaravelāyāṃ makhasya mahīmānakān || 11 re|| gantumājñāpayāmāsa svasvalokānnijālayān | ṛte brahmapriyāḥ sarvāḥ ṛte lomaśakādikān || 113 || ṛte naijaṃ kuṭumbaṃ ceśānaṃ satīṃ gaṇeśvaram | ṛte cāmarikarṣīṃśca ṛte ca tuṣitaṃ tathā || 1 14|| ṛte ca saccidānandaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ tvāṃ ca rādhikām | ṛte nārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmīm ṛte’śvasaraso janān || 1 15|| ityevaṃ sarvathā cājñāṃ labdhvā labdhvā ca rādhike | pratasthire vimānaiḥ svaiḥ sāyaṃ śūnyamivābhavat || 1 16|| racanānāṃ maṇḍapānāṃ saṃhāraṃ viśvakarmiṇaḥ | sadāsā vai niśāyāṃ te cakruḥ sthalī prage’bhavat || 1 17|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vahnerāśīrvādo bhojanāni, avabhṛthaṃ pāritoṣikāṇi, sāyaṃ hareḥ rāyalambāranṛparāṣṭragamanaṃ, kimuvakrāpuryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ prātaryajñabhūmimāgamanaṃ, mahīmānasabhākaraṇaṃ sammānadhanyavādopadāpāritoṣikādidānaṃ, bhojanāni vidāyaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayodaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 213 ||
<2.214> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike trayodaśyāṃ prātaḥ kṛtāhnikaḥ | haristvāsanamāsādya pūjāyāṃ saṃsthito’bhavat || 1 || tāvattatra samāyāto rāyanavārkabhūpatiḥ | nijarāṣṭraṃ samānetuṃ bhagavantaṃ samārthayat || 2 || haristathāstviti prāha sarvān sajjān samākarot | rāyakinnarasamrājaṃ tvāhūya prāha tadvidhim || 3 || rājā sampūjya kṛṣṇaṃ taṃ vidāyaṃ pradadau tataḥ | haristūrṇaṃ vimānaṃ svaṃ cāvaruhyāmbare’bhavat || 4 || tadā vādyānyavādyanta vidāye pārameśvare | rokīśvaro raṇajicca mārīśo vāyukakṣakaḥ || 5 || bāleśvaraśca lambārasta ete bhūbhatastadā | vidāyaṃ yautakaṃ cāpi sutābhyo haraye daduḥ || 6 || sainyaiḥ sammānito vādyairgītikābhiḥ sabhājitaḥ | vimānena yayau tūrṇaṃ sarvasārthasamanvitaḥ || 7 || rāyanavārkabhūpasya rāṣṭraṃ miśrasurābhidham | miśrasurāsaridyoge supārīyasaro’ntike || 8 || ciñcāgopurikāpuryā udyāne copakaṇṭhage | vāyuśṛṃgatanurnāmā ṛṣiḥ kṛṣṇena vai saha || 9 || vimāne cāgamat tatra rājā pūrvaṃ yayau tathā | svāgatārthaṃ hareḥ samyak sainyamasajjayad drutam || 2.214.1 0|| tadā vādyānyavādyanta prajānādāśca harṣajāḥ | vāditrāṇāṃ ninādāścābhavan digantacāriṇaḥ || 1 1 || kanyakāḥ pramadāścāpyagāyan sugītikāḥ śubhāḥ | māṃgalyadravayuktāścāyayuḥ kṛṣṇasamīpagāḥ || 12|| vimānaṃ nṛpabodhyena mārgeṇāvātarad bhuvi | tadākṣatānāṃ lājānāṃ puṣpāṇāṃ varṣaṇaṃ hyabhūt || 13 || jayaśabdā jīvaśabdāḥ sarvānanebhya ābhavan | sthirādvimānakāt kṛṣṇo bahiścāgre hyupasthitaḥ || 14|| tadā lokai rājabhiśca vardhitaḥ kanyakādibhiḥ | prakṣālya caraṇau rājā papau vāri ca ke nyadhāt || 15 || tato dugdhaṃ dadau pānārthaṃ ca sarvebhya eva ca | sainyena sahitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ puryāmabhrāmayanmudā || 16|| prajāḥ pupūjuḥ premṇaiva pradhānāḥ śreṣṭhinastathā | narā nāryo hyamaryaśca miśrasuryaśca yoṣitaḥ || 17|| dravyaiḥ puṣpairambaraiśca phalai ratnaiśca hīrakaiḥ | vividhairmukuṭaiścāpi bhūṣābhiḥ samapūjayan || 18|| avardhayannañjalibhirhṛdayārpaṇabhāvanaiḥ | namanaiśca yathāśaktidānaiścāpi samarhaṇaiḥ || 1 9|| bhramitvaivaṃ nagaryāṃ svaṃ datvā darśanamuttamam | āyayau rājasaudhaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇo’nugānvitaḥ ||2.214.20 || rājā pupūja ratnādyaiḥ sauvarṇairhārakaistathā | divyāmbarairdhanaiḥ śreṣṭhairdivyopadābhirādarāt ||21 || ārārtrikaṃ cakārāpi candanādyairapūjayat | papāta pādayoścāpi kṛtārtho’smīti saṃvadan ||22|| rājñyastasya catasraśca pupūjuḥ parameśvaram | kanyakāḥ sapta bhūpasya tadā candranibhānanāḥ || 23|| mumuhuḥ śrīpatau kānte jagṛhurmanasā patim | varamālā dadustāśca kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe suharṣitāḥ || 24|| kṛtakṛtyāśca tā jātā rājā rājñyo’pi vai tathā | kṛtakṛtyā abhavam̐śca bhāgyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ hi menire | rājotsavaṃ cakārāpi madhyāhne harṣasaṃbhṛtam || 25|| tataḥ sarvān sumiṣṭānnaṃ bhojayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ | tāmbūlakādikaṃ datvā yautakaṃ copadāṃ dadau ||26|| harirjagrāha sarvaṃ tat tanvartuṛṣaye dadau | yathāyogyaṃ nijayogyaṃ vimāne’sthāpayat tvapi || 27|| viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ paścād rājā svarlatikāpurīm | nijāṃ gantuṃ hariṃ prāha hariḥ sajjo’bhavat kṣaṇāt ||28|| rājā pūrvaṃ yayau tatra puryāṃ sammānamācarat | vādyaghoṣaiḥ prajāharṣanādaiḥ puṣpādipūjanaiḥ ||29|| mahodyāne cāvatīrya vimānād bhagavām̐stataḥ | rājoktarītyā nagare cābhramad darśanapradaḥ ||2.214.3 0|| pūjito vandito lokaiḥ vastubhiśca samārpitaḥ | dṛṣṭaścāvadhṛto naije hṛdaye parameśvaraḥ ||3 1 || vardhito bahudhā lokaiḥ prasanno’bhūtpareśvaraḥ | pūjāyāmāgataṃ vāyuśṛṃgatanvarṣaye dadau ||32|| viśaśrāma mahāsaudhe rājño divye suvarṇaje | tatrāyāto rāyahāṇḍeśvaro mākṣikarāṣṭrapaḥ ||33|| prārthayituṃ hariṃ naijaṃ rājyaṃ tathārthayattadā | hariḥ sajjo’bhavacchīghraṃ sāyaṃ sārthasamanvitaḥ || 34|| rāyanavārkabhūpaśca vidāyaṃ yautakaṃ dadau | vimānena haristūrṇaṃ vyomnā mākṣikarāṣṭrakam || 35|| niśāmukhe samāyācca mākṣikānagarīṃ prati | vidyutprakāśaiḥ paritaḥ śobhamānāṃ mahāpurīm || 36|| rāyahaṇḍeśabhūpaśca prāggatvā svāgataṃ vyadhāt | sainyena vādyaghoṣaiśca dhvajāpatākikādibhiḥ || 37|| puṣpahārairjayaśabdairgītikābhiśca maṃgalaiḥ | candanādyaiḥ svāgataṃ śrīhareḥ rājākarottadā || 38|| vimānaṃ cāgataṃ pṛthvyāṃ harirbahiḥ samāyayau | anantaśākhavidyudbhiḥ kāśite ca divānibhe ||39|| vimānāgre hi bhagavān śuśubhe divi candravat | taṃ vilokya paraṃbrahma yoṣitaśca prajājanāḥ ||2.214.40|| vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ hariṃ candanapuṣpakaiḥ | akṣataiścāpi lājābhirgandhasārairmanoharaiḥ ||41|| rātrau rājā nagaryāṃ vai bhrāmayāmāsa mādhavam | sainyena sahitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prajāḥ pupūjurutsukāḥ |||42|| gopure cāṃgaṇe madhye catvare rājamārgake | haṭṭāgreṣu ca saudheṣu vardhayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||43|| dravyaiḥ suvarṇamudrābhiḥ phalaiḥ kuṃkumacandanaiḥ | ambarairnārikelādyairgandhasāraiḥ sugandhibhiḥ ||44|| puṣpahārai ratnahārairamūlyopasuvastubhiḥ | evaṃ nagaryāṃ bhagavān paribhramya nṛpālayam ||45|| āyayau ca sabhāṃ cakre rātrāvupādideśa ha | sarveṣāṃ svavṛttitayeṣyamāṇaṃ vai prayojanam ||46|| sukhaṃ ca duḥkhābhāvaścetyubhayaṃ vai prayojanam | sukhārthaṃ ceṣyate dharmo dharmāt sukhaṃ hi jāyate ||47|| anāgatasya duḥkhasyānāgamāya yateta vai | adharmo duḥkhadaḥ prokto’dharmo hyapuṇyanāmadhṛk ||48|| hiṃsanaṃ parapīḍādi drohaḥ pāpaṃ hyadharmakaḥ | steyaṃ cānṛtakaraṇaṃ ca pratāraṇaṃ hi pāpakam ||49|| anyāyavartanaṃ cāpi paranāśakarī kriyā | paravṛttivināśaśca paravastuvināśanam ||2.214.50|| svasya mokṣasya hānyādirjñānena varjanaṃ tathā | maurkhyaṃ ca nijapitroścāsevanaṃ pātakāni vai ||51 || anyadravyādyāharaṇaṃ cāśritārakṣaṇaṃ tathā | vismṛtirdevadevasya pūjyānāṃ cāvamānanam ||52|| nārīṇāṃ pīḍanaṃ cāpi bālānāṃ pīḍanaṃ vṛthā | vṛkṣavallyādināśaśca vahnidānaṃ mahāvane ||53|| yatra jīvāḥ pradahyeyustatsarvaṃ pātakaṃ mahat | manuṣyeṇa na kartavyaṃ svātmanaḥ pīḍanaṃ tathā |||54|| sukhaṃ dehasamutthaṃ vendriyajaṃ cātmajaṃ ca vā | sarvaṃ prayojanaṃ svasya sādhayatyeva mānavaḥ ||55|| anityaṃ tu sukhaṃ nāśaṃ prāpsyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | vicāryetthaṃ ca tannārjyaṃ cārjyaṃ vai śāśvataṃ sukham | |56 || yajño dānaṃ dayā devāḥ satyaṃ ca sevanaṃ tapaḥ | sucāritryaṃ sukhadāni yogidharmā ime matāḥ ||57|| aṣṭaitāni pavitrāṇi śreyaḥ prasādadāni vai | puṇyatīrthābhigamanaṃ sukhadaṃ śāśvate hitam ||58|| puṇyadeśābhigamanaṃ pavitraṃ śreyasāṃpradam | martyo’nnadhanavastrādyaiścet samṛddhaśca jīvati ||5 9 || tadā yajñādikaṃ kṛtvā śāśvataṃ sukhamarjayet | puṇyatīrthāni santyeva sādhavo jagatāṃ hitāḥ ||2.214.6 0|| puṇyadeśāśca santyeva mandire pratimā hareḥ | tatra gatirmokṣagatistayā sukhaṃ hi śāśvatam ||6 1 || prāyaścittodvejanena jāyate pāpanāśanam | punarnaiva prakuryācced bhāvipāpāt pramucyate | |6 2|| satāṃ saṃgaṃ prakuryāccet kusaṃgāt parimucyate | sādhutīrthe parisnāto yamakleśātpramucyate ||63 || sādhutīrthī bhavet sādhurharitīrthī haro bhavat | sugandhasevī sugandhī syāt kṛṣṇagandhī bhavettataḥ ||64|| karmakṛtvābhimanyeta nāhamasmīti cetanaḥ | karmaṇā lipyate naiva padmapatramivāmbhasā ||61|| chidrāṇi vivṛtānyeva sādhūnāṃ cāvṛṇoti yaḥ | pāpātipāpakṛccāpi sa kalyāṇaṃ prapadyate ||66|| yathā sūryastamonāśī tathā kalyāṇakṛjjanaḥ | sarvapāpābhihartāpi sarvapāpavināśakaḥ ||67|| sevāparo jano nityamāśīrvādān pravindati | āyurannaṃ dhanaṃ saukhyaṃ vindati sevayā tataḥ ||68|| sādhūnāṃ sevayā saukhyaṃ śāśvataṃ kṛṣṇayogataḥ | sādhutīrthī bhavettasmānmānavo dīrghadṛṣṭiyuk ||69|| śāśvate sukhakośe te nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti keśave | tadāśrayiṇāṃ kośaḥ sa śāśvataḥ syādupasthitaḥ ||2.214.70|| ahaṃ kośaḥ śāśvato’smi mahānandapariplutaḥ | santo madānandayuktāḥ kurvantyāndino’parān ||71 || mukhyaṃ prayojanaṃ muktiḥ śāśvataṃ sukhameṣu vai | sādhuṣvevopalabhyeta sevyāḥ santastato’niśam ||72|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau bhagavān rādhike tataḥ | sabhānte nṛpatiḥ pūjāṃ cakāra dravyakoṭibhiḥ ||73|| suvarṇarūpyakapātrairambaraiśca vibhūṣaṇaiḥ | mukuṭaṃ dhārayāmāsa bālakṛṣṇasya mastake ||74|| kaṇṭhe hārān ratnayuktān sauvarṇān śrīharerdadau | aurṇān komalaveṣām̐ścārpayāmāsa suvarṇinaḥ ||75|| suchatraṃ cāmare śreṣṭhe svarṇadaṇḍaṃ ca vetrakam | hīrakaimauktikairyuktā mālā dadau ca śobhanāḥ ||76|| ūrmikāḥ karakānyācchādanāni vividhāni ca | dadau sugandhasāraiśca puṣpākṣatairapūjayat ||77|| rājñī hīravatī kṛṣṇapūjāmārārtrikaṃ vyadhāt | tilakaṃ kauṃkumaṃ bhāle sākṣataṃ candrakaṃ vyadhāt ||78|| mastake’kṣatapuṣpādyairarhaṇāṃ cottamāṃ vyadhāt | dadau miṣṭānnakavalaṃ mukhe kṛṣṇasya sā tataḥ ||79|| svasyāḥ pārśve sthitāḥ kanyā nava prāha janeśvarī | kanyākāḥ śrīpatiścāyaṃ rādhāsvāmī hi rājate ||2.214.80|| bahujanmakṛtaiḥ puṇyairlabhyate draṣṭumityapi | eṣa sākṣānmilito’sti kṛpayā svagṛhe’dhunā ||8 1|| hṛdaye taṃ vāsayantu mā tyajantu kadācana | pūjayantu hariṃ premṇā sevayantu janārdanam ||8 2|| sadā bhaktiṃ prakurvantu śrīramākamalā iva | śrutvaivaṃ kanyakāḥ kṛṣṇe bālakṛṣṇe’timohitāḥ ||83 || mātṛvākyena puṣṭiṃ ca prāptāstaṃ kāntamacyutam | vavrire phullavadanā hṛṣṭā mālāpradānakaiḥ ||84|| varamālāḥ kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe nyadhurnava tāḥ kanyakāḥ | tāsāṃ karagrahaṃ cakre bhagavān vidhinā tataḥ ||85|| utsavaṃ kṛtakṛtyaśca rājā cakāra vai niśi | bhojanāni tataḥ sarvasārthebhya pradadau nṛpaḥ ||86|| prajā api hareḥ pūjāṃ cakrustatrātibhāvataḥ | rādhādyā bhojanaṃ cakrūstataḥ kṛṣṇo niśāntare ||87|| kanyakāsevito nidrāṃ jagrāha kṣaṇameva tu | maṃgalairvādyaghoṣaiśca prabubodha prage drutam ||88|| trayodaśyāṃ kṛtasnānapūjanaśca payaḥ papau | papuścānye’pi dugdhādi huṇḍeśanṛpatergṛhe ||89|| prātaḥ ṛṣiśca vīrākajanarṣi śrīhariṃ prabhum | pūjayāmāsa vividhairvastubhirvedamantrakaiḥ ||2.214.90 || mahāpūjāṃ prakṛtvaiva mokṣaṃ vavre ca śāśvatam | hariḥ prāha samādhau tvaṃ tiṣṭharṣe mokṣamāvraja ||9 1 || ityuktaḥ sa ṛṣistūrṇaṃ dhyāne sthiro’bhavat kṣaṇāt | tāvanmūrti harerdivyāmapaśyat hṛdaye śubhām ||92|| divyatejomayīṃ divyamuktādyaiḥ sevitāṃ tataḥ | vimānaṃ tvakṣarasaṃjñamapaśyattejasāvṛtam ||93|| bhagavām̐staṃ rādhike vai haste dhṛtvā vimānake | nītvā dhāmākṣaraṃ naijaṃ prāpayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ||94|| rājādyāstu ṛṣerdehaṃ cikṣipurgartamadhyake | dehe jātaścamatkārastaṃ rādhe kathayāmi te ||95|| dehāt tatra samutpannā vīrā hetisamanvitāḥ | mahādehā baliṣṭhāśca hariṃ natvāgrataḥ sthitāḥ ||96 || vīrākajanaputrāste nivāsaṃ cārthayan prabhoḥ | haristebhyo dadau vāsaṃ śaṃbhorgaṇeṣu sarvadā ||97|| vīrāste ca janāste ca na tveśānaṃ satīṃ tataḥ | labdhājñāḥ prayayuḥ sarve kailāsaṃ śāśvataṃ sthalam ||98|| śaṃbhorlabdhamanavaste tāmasā vaiṣṇavāḥ sadā | vīrajanakhyātimanto’bhavan bhaktā harasya vai ||99|| atha śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaṃ kāmbhareyaṃ mahāprabhum | rājā cakre daṇḍavacca cakre vai pādavāhanam || 2.214.1 00|| sevāṃ kṛtvā tato nīrājanaṃ vyadhāt sa bhūpatiḥ | pādadhautajalaṃ divyaṃ papau tasthau samīpataḥ || 10 1|| tāvat tatra samāyāto rāyakūpeśabhūpatiḥ | hariṃ netuṃ svanagarīṃ havānākhyāṃ suśālinīm || 1 02|| hariḥ prāha tathāstvevaṃ śīghraṃ sajjo babhūva ca | huṇḍeśo yautakaṃ prādād yayāce ca kṣamāṃ hareḥ || 1 03|| hariścābhayadānaṃ ca datvā vimānamāruhat | sārthāścāpi vimānasthā abhavan keśavājñayā || 1 04|| rāyakūpeśabhūpaśca sammānārthaṃ jagāma ha | pūrvaṃ gatvā nijaṃ sainyaṃ nītvodyāne sthiro’bhavat || 1 05|| rāyahuṇḍeśabhūpaśca vidāyaṃ mānanaṃ tathā | jayaśabdairvādyaśabdairgītibhiśca dadau tadā || 106 || hareryānaṃ samāyācca havānāpurikāntikam | tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayanādāḥ prajākṛtāḥ || 1 07|| mantravādāstvabhavam̐śca mahodyāne tu rādhike | prajādyā harṣahṛdayā draṣṭuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tadābhavan || 1 08|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne trayodaśyāṃ prātaḥ rāyanavārkanṛparāṣṭragamanaṃ ciñcāgopurikāpuryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ tataḥ svarlatikāpurīṃ pratigamanaṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ tataḥ sāyaṃ rāyahaṇḍeśvaranṛparāṣdragamanaṃ mākṣikānagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ hyupadeśanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ bhādraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ vīrākajanarṣipramokṣaṇaṃ rāyakūpeśanṛparāṣṭragamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturdaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 214 ||
<2.215> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike’bdhisthe dvīpe kūpeśabhūpatiḥ | sammānaṃ śrīhareścakre kyūbākhye bahuśobhite || 1 || jalayantrairvāhanaiśca naukābhiśca prajāstadā | havānāyā nagaryāḥ sannidhau tūdyānake’gaman || 2 || vimānaṃ tvabdhitīrasya sannidhau bhūtale śubhe | avātarat tato rājā śrīkṛṣṇasannidhiṃ yayau || 3 || nanāma pādayoścāpi puṣpahārān dadau gale | rājñī pupūja deveśaṃ puṣpalājākṣatādibhiḥ || 4 || heyatāyanarājarṣiḥ pupūja parameśvaram | nagaryāṃ śrīhariṃ rājā bhrāmayāmāsa vāhanaiḥ || 5 || suvarṇaśakaṭīmadhye niṣādya chatracāmaraiḥ | śobhitaṃ śrīhariṃ lokāḥ pūjayāmāsurādarāt || 6 || dravyaiḥ phalaiścāmbarādyai ratnaiścandanakesaraiḥ | pūgīphalādibhirnārikelaiśca śarkarādibhiḥ || 7 || tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tu naukāyāṃ niṣādya bhūpatiḥ svayam | abdhau vihārayāmāsa dvīpasya sannidhau tadā || 8 || atha bhojanavelāyāṃ madhyāhne bhojanaṃ vyadhāt | bhagavān sārthayukto vai tadā rājñī samāgatā || 9 || pūjanārthaṃ hariṃ tatra tatputrīṃ haraye dadau | tāmbūlaṃ kāntamālāṃ ca kaṇṭhe nyadhāddharerhi sā || 2.215.10 || kanyā prāpya patiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛtakṛtyā babhūva sā | mātā cātiprasannābhūd rājotsavaṃ cakāra ha || 1 1|| tato viśrāntimāpāyaṃ bhagavān bhavanottame | athāyād darśanārthaṃ hi kanyāyā mātulo nṛpaḥ || 12|| kulambāyanarāṣṭreśo vigoṣṭhānagarīpatiḥ | nāmnā kālīmaṇḍalīnaḥ pupūjāpi sa mādhavam || 13 || śrīhariṃ cārthayāmāsa svarāṣṭragamanāya hi | haristathāstviti prāha tadā sajjo’bhavad drutam || 14|| kūpeśaśca vidāyaṃ śrīharaye yautakaṃ dadau | yayau kālīmaṇḍalīnaḥ pūrṇāsanarṣiyuk puraḥ || 15|| bhagavān svavimānastho vyomnā yayau vigoṣṭhikām | samudraṃ samatītyaiva sāyaṃ tvavāpa tāṃ purīm || 16|| rājā sainyena sahitaḥ sammānaṃ bahudhā vyadhāt | avātatāra bhagavān vigoṣṭhikāntikakṣitau || 17|| prajāstaṃ vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ cākṣatādibhiḥ | bhagavān svavimānāccāvatīryārpitakāñcane || 18|| niṣasādāsane divye rājā nanāma pādayoḥ | puṣpasrajo dadau kaṇṭhe gandhasāraṃ dadau tathā || 19|| tāmbūlakaṃ jalaṃ cāpi dadau sārthebhya ityapi | sainyena sahito rājā bhrāmayāmāsa vāhanaiḥ || 2.215.20 || gajāśvaśakaṭībhiśca tathā mānavavāhanaiḥ | vigoṣṭhākhyanagaryāṃ vai prajāḥ pupūjuracyutam || 21 || gajayāne sthitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pitarau ca kuṭumbakam | īśānaṃ lomaśaṃ cāpi satīṃ lakṣmyādikāstathā || 22|| aśvayānasthitām̐ścānyān sevakānṛṣisattamān | brahmapriyādikāḥ sarvāḥ śibikāsthāśca yoṣitaḥ ||23 || prajāḥ pradhānā viprādyāḥ śreṣṭhino dhaninastathā | dīnā narāḥ striyaḥ sarvāḥ pupūjuśca yathādhanam ||24|| namanaiḥ stavanaiścāpi hṛdayairnetrakaiḥ karaiḥ | bhāvanaiḥ puṣpahārādyaiḥ phalaiśca śarkarādibhiḥ || 25|| pupūjuḥ parameśānaṃ prāptaṃ divyaguṇodadhim | eva nagarīṃ sarvāṃ tāṃ bhramitvā bhagavān prabhuḥ ||26|| āyayau cārṣitāvāsaṃ sabhāṃ cakāra śobhanām | upadeśaṃ dadau tatra yogyaṃ yogyataraṃ hariḥ ||27|| yeṣāṃ deve’sti viśvāsasteṣāṃ phalati viśvasṛṭ | yeṣāṃ nāsti tu viśvāsasteṣāṃ phalaṃ na jāyate ||28|| bhavatāṃ cātiviśvāsāt prāptirme’tra sukhāvahā | jātā kālīmaṇḍalīnabhūbhṛtā dvārarūpiṇā ||29|| ahaṃ cāsmi pareśo vai sarvāvatāradhṛk prabhuḥ | parabrahma hṛdayasthaścāntaryāmī phalapradaḥ ||2.215.3 0|| pūjane sevane cāpi darśane vandane’rpaṇe | pādasaṃvāhane dāne phalado’smi na saṃśayaḥ ||3 1 || mama bhakto mahādevaḥ purā bālamajīvayat | viśvastānāṃ jambukasya vākyādapīti tattathā ||32|| devā viśvāsapūjyāśca nṛpā viśvāsavartinaḥ | śaraṇāgatimāptānāṃ viśvāsaḥ prathamā sthitiḥ ||33|| varaṇaṃ ca tataḥ proktaṃ cārpaṇaṃ ca tataḥ param | dīnavat sevanaṃ cāpi sthairyabhāvastataḥ param ||34|| yathā yathā haristuṣyettathā tathānuvartanam | na tuṣyettu yayā rītyā tasyā tasyā vivarjanam ||35|| evamādīni karmāṇi sādhanāni vimuktaye | santīha mānave bhāve sarvatrāpi tathā sthitiḥ ||36|| tasmāt sevyo’hamevātra muktaye smṛddhaye surāḥ | śāśvatānandalābhāya sevyo’haṃ parameśvaraḥ ||37|| śraddhayā sevitaścāhaṃ viśvāsena vinoditaḥ | dadāmi śreyaḥsarvasvaṃ svaṃ lakṣmīṃ pradadāmyaham ||38|| jīvanaṃ dhanasampattiṃ cārogyaṃ vaṃśavistaram | bhogān bhogyān bhogaśaktīrdadāmi nātra saṃśayaḥ || 39|| purā pāpakṛtaścāpi paścāt puṇyaniṣeviṇaḥ | mṛtā api purā te vai jīvitā iti niścayaḥ ||2.215.40|| purā puṇyakṛtaścāpi paścāt pāpaniṣeviṇaḥ | jīvitāste purā paścānmṛtā eva hi te matāḥ ||41 || tasmānmṛtānāṃ jīvāśā jīvanaṃ dīyate tu yaḥ | jīvanasya pradātā sa gururbodhyaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||42|| jīvannapi hariṃ naiva jānāti gocaraṃ prabhum | mṛta eva śvasan bhastrāsadṛśo mata eva ha ||43|| tādṛśo’pi satāṃ yogād bhagavantamupāgataḥ | bhajan sthitaścālaso’pi jīvatyevāmṛto hi saḥ ||44|| jīvanaṃ jīvanīyaṃ vai miṣṭaṃ śrīharisevanāt | rūkṣaṃ tu jīvanaṃ tyājyaṃ viṣayādiprasevitam ||45|| maraṇe’pi nikaṭe’pi smartā me yāti madgṛham | tathā buddhyā smarenmāṃ vai viśvāsena milāmyaham ||46|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthe’kṣarakṣetre purābhavat | viprasya vṛddhadevasya vārdhakye tvekaputrakaḥ ||47|| yayau jale sutaḥ snātuṃ jalamadhye papāta ha | mṛtaḥ so’yaṃ mṛtakalpo jalapānena so’bhavat ||48|| prāṇastasyābhavan mūrdhni na cāyāti ca netrayoḥ | nāḍyo naiva prasaranti coṣmā nāpi ca vidyate ||49|| mṛto vā mṛtakalpo vā dṛśyate sthāpito bhuvi | gomayena praliptāyāṃ janā jñātvā mṛtaṃ ca tam ||2.215.50|| pitrā sākaṃ khātabhāgaṃ ninyuryatra śmaśānakam | tatrāsīd vṛddhagṛdhro’pi dadarśa mṛtabālakam ||51 || dhṛtaṃ cāṃke janakena rudatātyajatā tadā | pitā bālaṃ parityajya gantuṃ śaknoti naiva tu ||52|| anye’pi bālakaṃ tyaktvā pratigantuṃ na śekire | tadā gṛdhraḥ samāgatyābravīd gacchata vai gṛham ||53|| iha nāryo narā nityaṃ sahasrādhikataḥ khalu | āyānti tu mṛtām̐styaktvā prayānti svagṛhaṃ sadā |||54|| nahi kaścit samāyāti mṛtaḥ punaḥ śarīrake | jagat sarvaṃ tathābhūtaṃ saṃklṛptaṃ vartate yataḥ ||55|| sukhaduḥkhādisaṃvyāptaṃ tatra kā paridevanā | mṛtā yātā mṛtavāhāḥ mariṣyanti kṣaṇāntare ||56|| iti jñātvā ye bhajeran hariṃ te cirajīvinaḥ | na punaḥ prāṇavān kaścinmahākālamukhaṃ gataḥ ||57|| priye’priye’pi samatā kālasya gatirīdṛśī | sarveṇa khalu gantavyaṃ janmavateha dehinā ||58|| karmāntajīvane yāte punarjīvo na labhyate | yāntu gṛhāṇi santyajya mṛtaṃ śavaṃ prayāntu śam ||59|| evaṃ jñānaṃ samāsādya samutsṛjya kṣitau narāḥ | prākrośanto yayuḥ snānahradaṃ jñātvā mṛtaṃ hi tam ||2.215.60|| tatrābhūjjambukavṛddhaścāgatyovāca tāñjanān | nirghṛṇā mānavāḥ sarve nirdayāḥ snehavarjitāḥ |||6 1 || kathaṃ tyaktvā gamane vai hṛdayaṃ vaḥ prajāyate | divaso’sti muhūrtaśca bahurūpo vivartate ||62|| kadācinmṛta evāpi jīvan yāti śmaśānataḥ | yūyaṃ vai nirvṛṇāstyaktvā kathaṃ yātha hi nirdayāḥ ||63|| tasya cakṣuḥ śrutirnāsā dehaḥ sarvo’pi vidyate | na vo’styasmin kimu snehaḥ paśupakṣisamo’pi na ||64|| asvārthavardhitānāṃ tu bālānāṃ sadṛśo’pi na | catuṣpātpakṣikīṭānāṃ poṣitānāmapi kvacit ||65|| phalāgamo na caivāsti na guṇo’pi kathaṃcana | tathāpi mṛtabālām̐ste yāvatpaśyanti bhūtale ||66|| tāvannaiva tyajantyete tāvān sneho’pi nāsti vaḥ | tato mā yāntu visṛjya kuladaṃ putramuttam ||67|| ciraṃ paśyata putraṃ taṃ yāvaddeho’sti cākṣataḥ | yatra nānye hi tiṣṭhanti tatra tiṣṭhanti bāndhavāḥ ||68|| jambukasya vacaḥ śrutvā snātā api narāśca te | putrasnehaparābhūtāḥ samāyātāḥ śmaśānakam || 69|| gṛdhrastāvad vilokyaivovāca janān śucānvitān | aho vai mānuṣā bhūtvā kimāyātā vimohitāḥ ||2.215.70|| prāṇendriyaiḥ parityaktaṃ bhūtātmakaṃ śavaṃ tvidam | śuṣkaṃ kāṣṭhatvamāpannaṃ kathaṃ śocatha vedinaḥ ||71 || kinna śocatha cātmānaṃ gatvaraṃ kinnu śocatha | tapasā nāśyate pāpaṃ bhaktyā bhavāntarādi ca ||72|| vilāpena bhavet kiṃ vai gatasya bālakasya nu | ṛṇaṃ datvā ca vā nītvā yānti dehadharā bhuvi |||73|| bālo’yaṃ gatavān tadvad datvā śokamanantakam | gṛhaṃ svarṇaṃ dhenavaścāpatyaṃ ratnāni bhūtayaḥ ||74|| sarvaṃ tapo’rjyamevāsti bhaktyā labhyaṃ tathā matam | puṇyalabhyaṃ ca vai sarvaṃ puṇyaṃ śocaya yaddhitam ||75|| svakṛtena tu dharmaṇa pāpena sukhiduḥkhitā | pitā putro’thavā bandhuḥ sukhī duḥkhī svakarmabhiḥ ||76|| tasmād yāta nijān gehān dharmaṃ kuruta sattamāḥ | vartadhvaṃ ca harerbhaktau satsu sureṣu pitṛṣu ||77|| śokaṃ tyajata mohaṃ ca nivartadhvaṃ vihāya tat | vidvān vā yadi vā cājño rājā dhanī ca nirdhanaḥ ||78|| sarvaḥ kālavaśaṃ prāptaḥ punarāyāti naiva ha | yūno bālān sthavīrām̐śca garbhān nārīrnarānapi ||79|| sarvānāviśate mṛtyurnayatyevāpunargamān | ityuktā mānavāste tu hitvā śavaṃ prayāntyatha ||2.215.80 || tāvadvai jambuka āha kena sneho hato hi vaḥ | snehahīnasya vākyena snehahīnāḥ kṛtāḥ katham ||8 1|| daivaṃ puruṣakāraśca śraddhā viśvāsa ityamī | kṛtāntaṃ cāpi dūraṃ vai drāvayanti kadācana ||82|| anirvedena bhāvyaṃ vai nirvede vai kutaḥ phalam | prayatnātprāpyate sarvaṃ mā yāntu nirdayāḥ katham ||83|| ātmamāṃsasamutthaṃ tu pitṛvaṃśasya sādhanam | śavaṃ tyaktvā sthite sūrye nirdayāḥ kva prayāsyatha ||84|| astaṃgate hi gantavyaṃ sthātavyaṃ cātra vā punaḥ | ārādhitāḥ surāścāpi dadatyasūn dayālavaḥ ||85|| ityuktāste ṛtaṃ matvā samāyātāḥ śavaṃ prati | atha gṛdhro jagādenān bāliśāḥ stheti bhāti me ||86|| atra bahūni varṣāṇi me jātasya gatāni hi | na dṛṣṭaṃ jīvitaṃ mṛtvā punaḥ strīpuṃnapuṃsakam ||87|| garbhā bālāḥ kiśorāśca yuvāno jaraṭhā api | mṛtāḥ punarna jīvanti sambandhisnehitā api ||88|| śokitāstu gṛhaṃ yānti sambandhibāndhavādayaḥ | tyajyatāmeṣa deho’pi śūnyaḥ kāṣṭhasamaḥ sutaḥ ||89|| anyatra vai gataṃ tyaktvā kathaṃ gṛhaṃ na yāsyatha | nātrendriyāṇi prāṇāśca tyaktvā kathaṃ na gacchatha || 2.215.90|| paraloke sukhārthaṃ vai yatnaṃ kuruta sattamāḥ | śrutvaivaṃ vinivṛttāste jambukastāvadāha tān ||9 1 || aho svarṇasamaṃ putraṃ tyaktvā yānti hi nirghṛṇāḥ | rākṣasā api putraṃ svaṃ tyaktvā naiva prayānti hi ||92|| yeṣāṃ nāsti svayaṃ prajñā teṣāṃ kimupadeśanaiḥ | śvetarājasya vai putro mṛtaḥ saṃjīvitaḥ punaḥ ||93|| satyavān jīvitaḥ patnyā sāvitryāpi patiḥ punaḥ | hariścandrasutaścāpi mṛtaḥ sañjīvitaḥ punaḥ ||94|| rukmāṃgadasya putro’pi mṛtaḥ sañjīvitaḥ punaḥ | naciketasya putro’pi mṛtaḥ sañjīvitaḥ punaḥ ||95|| maruto nāma devāśca garbhe hatāśca jīvitāḥ | tathā bhāgyāllabhet kaścinmṛtaṃ tu jīvitaṃ punaḥ ||96|| devaḥ kuryāt kṛpaṇānāmanukrośaṃ dadātyasūn | ityuktāste nyavartanta labdhāśāḥ snehilāḥ punaḥ ||97|| gṛdhraḥ punaḥ samāgatyovāca tānāśayā hatān | tapasāpi bhṛtāścaivaiśvaryavanto mahādhiyaḥ ||98|| mṛtyuṃ gatā na cāyānti pretapattanataḥ punaḥ | alamāśābandhanena mṛtasya jīvane tviha ||99|| naiva śṛgālaśatakaṃ jīvayiṣyati pretakam | atheśāno harirbrahmā yamarājo’thaveśvarāḥ || 2.215.1 00|| yadi tvenaṃ jīvayeyustadā jīvenna cānyathā | naiva vastvatra vāsena rodanenāpi jīvanam || 10 1|| bāṣpasrāveṇa vā śvāsaiḥ kuṭṭanairapi jīvanam | devasyārādhanaṃ kurmo militvā dharmasaṃyutāḥ || 1 02|| yadi syājjīvanaṃ yāvadāprātaḥ kurma eva tām | śrutvaivaṃ te nirāśāśca tyaktvā śavaṃ prayānti tu || 1 03|| jambukastāvadāgatyovāca śāntimayaṃ punaḥ | mā prayāntu nirāśā vai dhig gṛdhraṃ snehavarjitam || 1 04|| sukhasyānantaraṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhasyānantaraṃ sukham | avaśyaṃ jāyate tasmānmā visṛjya prayāntviha || 1 05|| jīvantameva paśyāmi kṣaṇāntare na saṃśayaḥ | ityāśāyojitāḥ sarve sthitāḥ pratīkṣayā punaḥ || 1 06|| gṛdhraḥ prāha śmaśānākhyaḥ pradeśo’yaṃ hi dāruṇaḥ | āśāṃ tyaktvā śavaṃ tyaktvā kurvantu pretakāryakam || 107|| sūrye tvastaṃ gate pretā yakṣā bhūtāśca rākṣasāḥ | yuṣmān pradharṣayiṣyanti raudrāḥ palalakhādakāḥ || 1 08|| jambukoktau śraddadhānā drutaṃ sarve vinaṃkṣyatha | ityuktāste prayāntyeva tāvacchṛgālako’vadat || 1 09|| mā bhayaṃ yāta mā yāta kravyādavākyamohitāḥ | vo vidrāvya svārthigṛdhraḥ śavaṃ vai bhakṣayiṣyati || 2.215.11 0|| gṛdhraḥ prāha na cāhaṃ vai svārthī svārthī tu jambukaḥ | andhakāre nijaṃ bhakṣyaṃ śavaṃ cecchati vañcanāt || 11 1|| ityuktā jñātavantaste tau svārthasādhakāviti | svārthārthabaddhakakṣau ca kṣudhānvitau ca jalpinau || 1 12|| vañcakābhyāṃ śavaṃ naiva dātavyaṃ ceti niścitāḥ | sāyaṃ śaṃbhuṃ sasmaruste putrasnehasamākulāḥ || 1 13|| tāvad devyā noditaḥ śrīśaṃbhustatra samāgataḥ | nemuḥ śaṃbhuṃ tu te duḥkhaṃ nyavedayam̐stato haraḥ || 1 14|| jīvitaṃ pradadau tasmai daśavarṣasahasrakam | svārthaparau vañcitau ca putro jīvanamāptavān || 1 15|| haramārādhya te putraṃ prāptāśca sukhino’bhavan | gṛhaṃ yātā hi viśvastāḥ phalamāptā hi jīvanam || 1 16|| prāptaṃ ca vañcakābhyāṃ tu karmaṇā pariyāpitam | tasmād viśvāsamāsādya māṃ hariṃ puruṣottamam || 1 17|| bhajantvananyabhāvena rakṣayiṣye na saṃśayaḥ | dāsye ca jīvanaṃ dhāmni śāśvatānandasaṃbhṛtam || 1 18|| ityuktvā pradadau mantrān prajābhyo bhagavānsvayam | vaiṣṇavān kṛtavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo nijāśritān || 119 || rādhike śrīharervāṇīṃ śrutvāśrayaṃ vyadhustataḥ | pūjayitvā hariṃ naijān gṛhān yayuḥ prajājanāḥ || 2.215.1 20|| rājñaḥ kanyāścatasraśca kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ mahāprabhum | varamālāṃ dadau kaṇṭhe vyadhurnaijaṃ patiṃ prabhum || 121|| rājotsavaṃ vyadhādrātrau bhojanādīnyakārayat | sevanaṃ kanyakāścakrurnidrāṃ kṛṣṇo hyavāpa ca || 122|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne hareḥ rāyakūpeśabhūparāṣṭragamanaṃ havānānagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ tataḥ kālīmaṇḍalīnabhūparāṣṭragamanaṃ vigoṣṭhikānagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ copadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 215 ||
<2.216> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike pañcadaśyāṃ vai prabhāte bālakṛṣṇakaḥ | maṃgalairgītikābhiśca vādyairbubodha saṃstavaiḥ || 1 || kṛtasnānaḥ kṛtapūjaḥ kṛtadugdhādipānakaḥ | siṃhāsane niṣasāda pitarāvabhivandya ca || 2 || tāvadrājā samāyātaḥ pūjanārthaṃ hareḥ puraḥ | dadau vai mukuṭaṃ mūrdhni kuṇḍale kaṭake tathā || 3 || suvarṇasyormikāścāpi śṛṃkhalāṃ mauktikasrajam | ratnahīrakahārām̐śca dravyaṃ lakṣādhikaṃ dadau || 4 || ātmārpaṇaṃ dadau cāpi puṣpahārān dadau tathā | pādau prakṣālya ca papau rājā sambandhisaṃyutaḥ || 5 || nīrājanaṃ cakārātha nanāma pāhi māṃ jagau | rājñī pūjāṃ yautakaṃ ca dadau vavre’vanaṃ sadā || 6 || evaṃsthite tu tadbhrātā kālīmaṇḍalināgrajaḥ | pūrvarājyapraśāstā vai vanajeleśabhūpatiḥ || 7 || vanajvālāpradeśeśaḥ sānujyoṣṭrīpurīpatiḥ | āyayau svavimānena samānetuṃ hariṃ tadā || 8 || āgatya daṇḍavaccakre puṣpamālāṃ gale nyadhāt | ārpayat svarṇapātre ca sauvarṇamudrikāśatam || 9 || prārthayacca pradeśān svān pāvayituṃ pareśvaram | haristathāstviti prāha sajjo’bhavat kṣaṇāntare || 2.216.1 0|| cakre kālīmaṇḍalīno nṛpo vidāyamānanam | arhaṇāṃ mahatīṃ cakre candanākṣatakuṃkumaiḥ || 1 1|| dravyairnānāvidhai ratnairhāraiḥ śekharakuṇḍalaiḥ | yautakaiścopadābhiśca nīrājanaṃ tato’karot || 12|| hareḥ sārthasya pūjāṃ ca kṛtvā sainyena tūryakaiḥ | jayanādaistathā mānaṃ vidāyaṃ śrīharervyadhāt || 1 3|| śrīhariḥ svavimānastho’bhavattatra tadāmbare | prajāstu darśanaṃ cakrurnemustuṣṭuvurutsukāḥ || 14|| āgantavyaṃ rakṣitavyā vayamāhuḥ punaḥ punaḥ | harirdarśitamārgeṇa vyomnā vimānamairayat || 15|| rākāsano maharṣiśca rājaguruvimānake | sārdhaṃ kṛṣṇena cāyāti rājā pūrvaṃ yayau purīm || 16|| sammānārthaṃ harestatra sainyaṃ sajjaṃ hyabhūt tathā | prajāḥ sarvāḥ sākṣatāśca puṣpamālāsamanvitāḥ || 17|| svāgatārthaṃ mahodyāne sānujyoṣṭrīsamīpataḥ | puraḥsthitā abhavam̐śca pratīkṣantyo harerdiśam || 18|| guruḥ kālīmaṇḍalīnasya pūrṇāsanako muniḥ | āyayau hariṇā sārdhaṃ tathā rākāsano muniḥ || 19|| vyomni prajā vimānaṃ vai samālokyātiharṣitāḥ | rājā sainyena sahitaḥ svāgataṃ vādyanādanaiḥ ||2.216.20|| cakāra jayaśabdaiśca dhvajaḥ patākikādibhiḥ | namanaiḥ puṣpadānaiśca gītikābhiśca maṃgalaiḥ ||21 || vimānaṃ bhūtale sthairyamāptaṃ harirbahiryayau | rājā dadau bālakṛṣṇakaṇṭhe pauṣpīḥ srajaḥ śubhāḥ ||22|| pādayośca jalaiścakre’bhiṣecanaṃ tadamṛtam | papau kuṭumbasahito daṇḍavat pracakāra ha ||23|| rājñī neme kaṃbharāyai mahālakṣmyai pupūja tām | gopālakṛṣṇaṃ pitaraṃ pupūja nṛpatistataḥ ||24|| kuṭumbaṃ brahmakāntāśca pupūjuśca kuṭumbinaḥ | hastiyāne hariṃ rājā nyaṣādayat suvarṇaje ||25|| tathānyānaśvagantryādau śibikādau nyaṣādayat | hāraśekharagucchādyaiḥ sampūjya sainyasaṃyutaḥ ||26|| vādyaghoṣaiḥ kīrtanaiśca ninye puryāṃ hariṃ nṛpaḥ | gopure pūjayāmāsuḥ rājakumārakāḥ pṛthak ||27|| catvare śreṣṭhinaścāpi pradhānā mahati sthale | prātirathyaṃ pūjanaṃ ca harestatra prajā vyadhuḥ ||28|| pramadā hārapuṣpādyaiścandanākṣatasatphalaiḥ | kuṃkumaiḥ pūjayāmāsurhṛdayairbhāvanādibhiḥ ||29|| ambaraiśca tathā bhūṣābhiśca dravyaiḥ suvarṇakaiḥ | pādasparśairmastake ca duḥkhahāvardhanairapi ||2.216.3 0|| añjalibhiścakṣuṣāṃ ca bhāvanābhirapūjayan| dṛṣṭvā kāntaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ rūparūpātiśobhitam ||3 1 || dadhyurvai hṛdaye kāntā avismaraṇaśāśvatam | aparā dūrataḥ sthitvā lokayāmāsuracyutam ||32|| divyatejomayaṃ śāntaṃ koṭikandarpasundaram | kṛṣṇaṃ rādhādisahitaṃ gopagopīgaṇārcitam ||33|| tathānyāstaṃ caturhastaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ ramārcitam | lokayāmāsureveśaṃ cetarā badarīpatim ||34|| tāpasaṃ śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ parāstu śeṣaśāyinam | kāścidanyāḥ sūryasaṃsthaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ prabhuṃ harim ||35|| tathānyā vahnimadhyasthaṃ divyaṃ satpuruṣaṃ prabhum | yuvatyo dadṛśuḥ kāntaṃ pūrṇakāmasukhapradam || 36|| bhaktā dadṛśustaṃ devaṃ mahākṣaranivāsinam | prajā narāstathā nāryo dadṛśurviṣṇurūpiṇam || 37|| rādhāramāsatīvṛndātulasīśrīprasevitam | ramāpadmāvatīhāsāmaṃjulāsadguṇārcitam ||38|| māṇikīduḥkhahālakṣmīdurgikākamalārcitam | dadṛśurbahudhā tatra hastiyānagataṃ harim ||3 9|| brahmapriyādibhiścāpi piśaṅginīprapūjitam | gaurībhiścāmarībhiśca kanyābhirarcitaṃ prabhum ||2.216.40|| dadṛśurvai yoṣitaśca divyaṃ śrīharimeva tāḥ | evaṃ harirdadau naijaṃ darśanaṃ bahudhā tadā ||41 || sānujyoṣṭrīnagaryāṃ vai prajābhyo viharan muhuḥ | evaṃ bhramitvā nagarīṃ rājasaudhaṃ samāyayau ||42|| siṃhāsane vyarājacca rājñī pūjāṃ cakāra ha | jalapānaṃ dadau cāpi tasyāstu pañcakanyakāḥ ||43|| pupūjuḥ śrīpatiṃ kāntaṃ sundaraṃ manasepsitam | varamālāṃ nyadhuḥ kaṇṭhe kṛṣṇasya pārijātikīm || 44|| vavrire tamalabhyaṃ vai sulabhaṃ svagṛhāgatam | kṛtakṛtyā abhavam̐śca prāpya kāntaṃ hariṃ ca tāḥ ||45|| nṛpo rājñī kumārāśca sadbhāgyaṃ menire nijam | rājotsavaṃ cakārāpi madhyāhne bhojanaṃ dadau ||46|| bhuktvā sārthāḥ suviśrāntimāpustrivādanottaram | yautakaṃ ca vidāyaṃ ca dadau rājā tu śārṅgiṇe ||47|| darśanārthaṃ narā nāryaścāyayuśca tadālayam | tebhyo harirdadau bodhaṃ mantraṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ śubham |48|| balaṃ sadā hareḥ rakṣyaṃ sarvasaukhyapradaṃ nṛṇām | āpatkāle mṛtyukāle yamakāle hyasadgatau ||49|| gatireva balaṃ me’sti cāpadādinivārakam | śālmalirbalahīno’pi purā brahmāśrayājjayī ||2.216.50 || abhavad vāyudevasya kṛtvā parābhavaṃ khalu | himācale mahānāsīd vṛkṣaḥ śālmalisaṃjñakaḥ ||51 || śākhī skandhī ca patrī ca paśupakṣyāśrayapradaḥ | puṣpaphalādibhiḥ kṣudvārakaścāśrayiṇāmapi ||52||| viśālāṃ prati gacchan vai nāradastaṃ viśālinam | papraccha tvaṃ kathaṃ vṛkṣa nirbhayo vartase sukhī ||53 || vāyunā tava śākhāṃ ca bhagnāṃ paśyāmi naiva yat | kinnu te pavanaścāste mitraṃ yastvāṃ prarakṣati ||54|| mahābalo hi pavanaḥ parvatānapi nāśayet | sa tvāṃ tyaktvā vartate’tra tato heturbhaviṣyati ||55|| hastino gavayāścānye mṛgāstiṣṭhanti te hyadhaḥ | śobhase tvaṃ parasevyaścopakārī hi sarvathā ||56|| tarkaye pavanaste’sti bandhuḥ sakhāthavā suhṛt| | yadvā tvaṃ pavanasya syāccharaṇāgata eva ha ||57|| śrutvā tu śālmaliḥ prāha na me vāyuḥ sakhā suhṛt | na bandhurna śaraṇyaśca yenāhaṃ rakṣito’bhavam ||58|| mama tejo balaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vāyoścāṣṭādaśādhikam | tena viṣṭambhito vāyurmayaivaṃ sa parākṛtaḥ ||59|| tasmād bibhemi vāyorna kuddhātvā vegavattamāt | nāradastu tadā prāha mahāścaryamidaṃ śrutam ||2.216.60 || varuṇo yamarājaśca kubero na marutsamāḥ | sarvaceṣṭākaro vāyustaṃ tvaṃ vai jītavān yataḥ ||6 1 || yadvā mithyā bhāṣase tvaṃ drupate buddhilāghavāt | kathayiṣye’nilaṃ gatvā tava durbhāṣitaṃ khalu || 62|| parvataiḥ sāgaraiścāpi grahairvā devapādapaiḥ | naiva kṣiptaḥ kadācidvai vāyuryathā tvayoditaḥ ||63|| te taṃ sarve namasyanti tvaṃ mohāt katthase’phalam | ityuktvā nāradaścāyād yatra vāyuḥ sthito’bhavat ||64|| śālmalivacanānyāha vyākṣepasaṃbhṛtāni tam | śrutvā tu pavanastatrāyayau yatra hi śālmaliḥ ||65|| kruddhaḥ prāha tvayā vṛkṣa nāradāya vigarhaṇam | mama proktaṃ yatastvāṃ darśaye balaṃ sthiro bhava ||66|| pitāmahaḥ prajāsarge tvayi viśrāntavān yataḥ | tvāṃ tyajāmi sadā vegena spṛśāmi harāmi ca ||67|| tadguṇaṃ tvaṃ parityajya balaṃ tvagre karoṣi me | samūlaṃ tvāṃ nayiṣye’dya vaṃśavistāravarjitam ||68|| evamuktaḥ śālmaliśca prāha me bhayameva na | yathābalaṃ samāyāhi tyajyatāṃ krodhanaṃ mayi ||69|| na me bhayaṃ tava vāyo balaṃ me’sti tvadūrjitam | ye tu buddhyā hi balinaste satyaṃ balinaḥ sadā || 2.216.70|| dehamātrabalā naiva balino vai yathārthataḥ | ityuktaḥ pavanaḥ kruddho jhaṃjhāvātamayo’bhavat ||7 1 || śālmalistaṃ vilokyaiva śātayāmāsa vai nijān | dalān śākhāḥ kusumāni phalāni svalpaśākhikāḥ ||72|| tasthau daṇḍasamo bhūtvā pavanaḥ kiṃkariṣyati | tāvadvāyuścātivegī dadarśa hīnaśākhakam ||73 || śīrṇaparṇadalādyaṃ provāca vanaspatiṃ hasan | paśya me balamaiśvaryaṃ yadbhayāt tvaṃ viśīrṇitaḥ ||74|| brahmāśrayāttathā me’tra kṛpāleśādabhūḥ sukhī | mahatāmāśrayaṃ tyaktvā mahāntamavamanyase ||75|| tatastvaṃ duḥkhito jāto vaṃśavistāravarjitaḥ | tvāṃ bhaktuṃ prasamartho’smi mā garvaṃ vaha vai kvacit ||76|| utkhātuṃ ca samartho’smi mā garvaṃ vaha niṣphalam | evamuktvātivegātmapravāheṇa vavau balāt ||77|| vakrībhūto’bhavat stambo bhaṃktuṃ ca tatparo’bhavat | utkhātuṃ ca bhuvaḥ kampo’bhavad vāyupravegataḥ ||78|| śālmalistu tadā namro brahmāṇaṃ smṛtavān hṛdi | nanāma vāyave cāpi brahmā śīghramupāyayau || 79|| abhayaṃ pradadau vāyurnirvego hyabhavattadā | pūjitau devavaryau tau yayatuśca nijasthalīm ||2.216.80|| ityevaṃ balahīno’pi dehī vṛkṣajaḍo’pi ca | yadi māṃ brahmadhāmānaṃ samāśrayati kānane ||8 1|| māyāmaye’pi tamahaṃ rakṣāmi māyikānilāt | kālācca karmaṇaścāpi yamadūtādavāmi ca ||82|| madbalaṃ mama sādhūnāṃ balaṃ tyajati cet pumān| vāyurūpāḥ kālakarmamāyāstaṃ nāśayanti vai ||83|| patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ śākhāḥ pautrān dhanaṃ sukhaṃ sutān | tyaktvāpi saṃśrayet sādhūn bhayaṃ tasya na vidyate ||84|| sarvatyāge’pi cennāsti mamāśrayastadā bhayam | kālānilād bhavatyeva tasmānmamāśrayaṃ labhet| ||85|| ityādiṣṭāśca rājādyāḥ prajājanā narāḥ striyaḥ | cakruḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇāśrayaṃ manuṃ ca jagṛhuḥ ||86|| jagṛhustaulasīṃ kaṇṭhīṃ mūrtiṃ hareśca jagṛhuḥ | pupūjuḥ śrīhariṃ premṇā tatheśānādikānapi ||87|| jalapānaṃ vyadhāccāpi viśrāntimāpa yāvatā | tāvad rājā vimānena pārāvārapibābhidhaḥ ||88|| ambikarṣiyutaścāyānnetuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ svarāṣṭrake | prārthayadbahudhā tvīśaṃ kṛṣṇastathetyamānayat ||89|| sajjo’bhavattadā śīghraṃ tato vidāyakaṃ nṛpaḥ | yautakaṃ ca dadau mānaṃ vanajvāleśabhūpatiḥ ||2.216.90|| prajābhirbhūbhṛtā sammānitaḥ śrībhagavām̐stataḥ | vimānago’bhavacchīghraṃ vyomamārge vimānakam ||9 1|| sammānena yayau rāṣṭraṃ gatainasaṃ pavitrakam | gatainārāṣṭrake rājā sammānārthaṃ yayau purā ||92|| kāyanyākhyanagaryāḥ sannidhau cābdhestaṭe tadā | mahāviśāle bhūdeśe mahodyāne mahālaye ||93|| sainyena sahito rājā sammānaṃ svāgataṃ vyadhāt | vimānaṃ cāgataṃ śīghraṃ cāvātarat subhūtale ||94|| prajā rājā tathā cānye jayaśabdān jagustathā | sainyāni nemire kṛṣṇaṃ prajāścakruśca vardhanam ||95|| māṃgalikasutūryāṇāṃ ninādāstvabhavan muhuḥ | kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ prajāḥ sarvā narā nāryaḥ samantataḥ ||96|| ājagmustatra sukhade mahodyāne mudānvitāḥ | puṣpahārādibhiryuktā lājākṣatādiśobhitāḥ || 97|| premṇā halahalāśabdairgogośabdātiharṣitāḥ | savegāḥ kakṣabālāśca nāryo’pi drutamāyayuḥ ||98|| medinī dyaurivāsīdvai tadojjvalaprajāyutā | harirvimānatastūrṇaṃ tvagre bahiḥ samāyayau ||99|| rājā nanāma caraṇe puṣpahāraṃ gale dadau | rājñī pupūja puṣpādyairjalaṃ cāmṛtavad dadau || 2.216.100 || pradhānā nemire cāpi puṣpahāraiḥ samārcayan | harirjagrāha sarveṣāṃ namaskārādimānanam || 101 || svāgataṃ svīcakārāpi madhuparkādikaṃ śubham | phalaṃ jalaṃ payaścāpi yadadādvai prajājanaḥ || 1 02|| rādhike vīkṣya kamalākāntaṃ manoharaṃ prabhum | vṛttayo niścalabhāvaṃ prāpustatra hi yoṣitām || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne hareḥ paṃcadaśyāṃ prabhāte prabodhanaṃ kṛtāhnikatvaṃ pūjanaṃ tato vanajvālārāṣṭragamanaṃ sānujyoṣṭrīnagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ divyadarśanamupadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ tato gatainasarāṣṭragamanaṃ svāgataṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣoḍaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 216 ||
<2.217> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike kāyanīpuryāṃ netuṃ ceyeṣa bhūpatiḥ| śrīhariṃ prārthayāmāsa tūpaviṣṭaṃ gajopari || 1 || harirgaje caturdante svarṇāmbālikayā yute | nyaṣīdacca tataścānyān nyaṣādayad gajādiṣu || 2 || śibikāsu haripriyā nyaṣādayattu rādhike | gaurīrbrahmapriyādyāśca hāritāścāmarīstathā || 3 || sainyavādyaiḥ saha śrīmatkṛṣṇo vai śuśubhe tadā | ambikarṣiścāmaraṃ ca dhṛtvā pṛṣṭhe hyupāviśat || 4 || evamabhrāmayat kṛṣṇaṃ kāyanyāṃ nṛpatiḥ svayam | nagaryāṃ catvarādau ca saudheṣvapi ca haṭṭake || 5 || sthale sthale prajāstaṃ sampupūjurbālakṛṣṇakam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ candanakāñcanaiḥ || 6 || phalaiśca mauktikairhārai ratnādyairakṣatādibhiḥ | vastrairbhūṣādibhiścāpi śarkarāmiṣṭavastubhiḥ || 7 || evaṃ śrībhagavān puryāṃ bhramitvāvāsamāyayau | jalaṃ papau rājasabhāgṛhe rātrau hyupādiśat || 8 || pūrṇārātrau deśajanānāha śrībhagavān prabhuḥ | upārjanīyaṃ puṇyaṃ vai yena kenāpi karmaṇā || 9 || pāpaṃ vai parihartavyaṃ yadvai śreyovighātakam | pāpasya vidyate sṛṣṭāvadhiṣṭhānaṃ pralobhanam || 2.217.1 0|| eko lobho mahāduṣṭo lobhātpāpaṃ pravartate | nāśamūlaṃ mahān lobho yena dhvaṃsagatā janāḥ || 11|| lobhāt saṃjāyate kvāpi krodhaḥ kāmaśca tṛṣṇikā | mānaṃ māyā ca mohaśca staṃbhaḥ parāsutāpi ca || 12|| akṣamā hrīvināśaśca sampacchrīdharmasaṃkṣayaḥ | akīrtirdīnatā vaśyabhāvo lobhāt pravartate || 13 || adānaṃ cātyajanaṃ ca tṛṣā vikarmavartanam | mado droho’vamānaṃ cāviśvāso’nārjavaṃ tathā || 14|| paradravyādiharaṇaṃ nindā vego vibhogakaḥ | īrṣyā kutsā vikatthā ca mātsaryaṃ duṣṭakāritā || 15|| sāhasaṃ vañcanaṃ cauryaṃ lobhāt sarvaṃ pravartate | yo na pūrayituṃ śakyo’yutajanmagatairapi || 16|| jīryato jīryati dhrauvyaṃ lobho dhrauvyaṃ na muñcati | nityaṃ gabhīratāṃ yāti prayukto’rtheṣu cākṣataḥ || 17|| rāgaṃ janayati dravye bhogye prayojitaḥ sadā | āsaktiṃ ca parāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ lobhāt prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 18|| sa lobhaḥ saha mohena jetavyaḥ śreya icchatā | lobhāśrayau dveṣaruṣau śiṣṭācāravighātakau || 1 9|| antaḥkrūrau channakūpau jagatāṃ nāśakārakau | lobhāśrayā janāścānyān vañcayantīha hetubhiḥ ||2.217.20|| satāṃ mārgān vilumpanti nāśayanti nijān vṛṣān | patanti dāruṇe kleśe pātayantyaparānapi ||21|| dharṣayantyuttamān svārthasiddhyarthaṃ pitṛbāndhavān | śiṣṭānaśiṣṭān kurvanti lubdhā lobhādayastathā ||22|| tena puṇyasya lopaḥ syāttathā bhūto vinaśyati | tasmācchucivratān sādhūn samāśrayed vitṛṣṇakān ||23 || lobhamoharahitān vai śreyaḥ syātparamaṃ tataḥ | satye sthitān dharmavṛṣān śiṣṭācārasamanvitān || 24|| kṛṣṇaprasaṃgasaṃprāptān sevetāpi dayāparān | pitṛdevātitheyāṃśca tathā sarvopakāriṇaḥ ||25|| sarvadharmāstikabhāvān sarvabhūtahite ratān | sarvadevān pūjayeccāśrayecchreyaḥ paraṃ bhavet ||26|| na yeṣāṃ bhidyate vṛttaṃ yatpurā sādhubhiḥ kṛtam | na trāsino na capalā na krūrāḥ satpathe sthitāḥ ||27|| tān sādhūn samprasevetāhiṃsakān matparāyaṇān | sarvadoṣavyapetām̐śca nirmamān nirahaṃkṛtān ||28|| suvratān sthiramaryādān samupāsīta bhūtaye | na dhanārthaṃ yaśo’rthaṃ vā dharmo yeṣāṃ vilupyate ||29|| avaśyaṃ kārya ityevaṃ śarīrasya kriyāparāḥ | na bhayaṃ ruṭ na cāpalyaṃ na śoko yeṣu laukikaḥ ||2.217.30|| satyārjavaparā ye ca mama mūrtiparāstathā | na bhraśyante ratiṃ prāpya na ca lābheṣu harṣitāḥ || 3 1|| na vyathanti vilābheṣu sattvamārgamupāśritāḥ | samabhāvā dayābhāvāḥ paropakārabhāvinaḥ || 32|| lābhālābhau sukhaduḥkhe priyāpriye janimṛtī | samāni yeṣāṃ cetāṃsi tānupāsīta bhaktimān ||3 3|| mahānubhāvān daivām̐śca guṇinaḥ samupāśrayet | ajñānahārakān divyān gurūn śrayecca bhūtaye ||34|| ajñānaṃ lobhamūlaṃ ca pāpotpādakamityapi | ajñānānna naro vetti tvātmanaḥ kṣayamityapi ||35|| ubhāvetau samaphalau samadoṣau mahattamau | ajñānaṃ cātilobhaśca sthitervināśakau matau ||36|| lobhaprabhavamajñānaṃ lobhavṛddhyā pravardhate | lobhe kṣīṇe kṣayaṃ yātyanyathā yātyabjadhāgatīḥ ||37|| indriyāṇāṃ damanena lobhaḥ kṣīṇo bhavennan | vāsanāyā vilopena lobhamūlaṃ vinaśyati ||38|| damaḥ kalyāṇado bodhyo damo dharmātiśobhanaḥ | damāt siddhirbhavatyeva damo dānād viśiṣyate ||39|| damāttejo vardhate ca tejasvī puruṣo bhavet | damī cātra paratrāpi paraṃ sukhaṃ pravindati ||2.217.40|| sukhaṃ dāntaḥ prasvapiti sukhaṃ ca pratibudhyate | sukhaṃ paryeti lokām̐śca manaścāsya prasīdati ||41 || adānto hi janaḥ kleśamabhīkṣṇaṃ pratipadyate | anarthośca bahūnanyān prasṛjatyadamo janaḥ |||42|| gurupūjāphalaṃ proktaṃ daminaḥ śīlinaḥ sataḥ | kāmaḥ krodho darpalobhau roṣa īrṣyāvamānane ||43 || asūyādyā durguṇāśca dānte tiṣṭhanti naiva ha | samudrakalpo dānto’sti yenendriyajhaṣā hatāḥ ||44|| yena grāmyāstathāraṇyāḥ pravṛttayo’pi vai hatāḥ | suvṛttaḥ śīlasampannaḥ prasannātmātmavid budhaḥ ||45|| dāntaṃ prāpyeha satkāraṃ sugatiṃ labhate pare | satāṃ samācaritaṃ yat karma dāntasya vartate |||46 || śubhaṃ kalyāṇadaṃ vartma satāṃ dāntasya vardhate | dānto dhūtvātmaniṣṭhaśca sādhusevāparāyaṇaḥ ||47|| maddhyānanirato bhakto brahmabhūyāya kalpate | yasmādabhayaṃ bhūtānāṃ bhūtebhyo yasya cābhayam ||48|| dehe vā ca videhe vā bhayaṃ tvasya kuto’pi na | ācinoti tu me sevāṃ sarveṣu mitratāṃ gataḥ ||49|| satāṃ mārgaṃ prapannasya gatirme sadṛśī sadā | lobhaṃ cājñānakaṃ tyaktvā dānto bhūtvā tu māṃ bhajet| ||2.217.50|| mokṣastejomayā yadvā lokāstasya tu śāśvatāḥ | samarpya mayi karmāṇi samarpya mayi vai tapaḥ ||5 1 || samarpya mayi vijñānaṃ prasannātmā madāśrayaḥ | prāpya bhogān divisthām̐śca matsvargaṃ vindati dhruvam ||52|| yadvā paitāmahaṃ sthānaṃ vairājaṃ vā tataḥ param | brahmarāśimayaṃ cāvyākṛtaṃ dhāmāmṛtaṃ ca vā ||53 || golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ bhaktyā damena vindati | jñānārāmasya bhaktasya sarvadehyavirodhinaḥ ||54|| nātra bhayaṃ punaścāsti paralokabhayaṃ na ca | damino yādṛśī śāntistādṛśī yatnino nahi ||55|| dame lokoktirekā syāt soḍhavyā sāhi sādhunā | yā cainaṃ kṣamayā yuktamaśaktaṃ manyate janaḥ ||56|| aśaktyā kṣamayā śreṣṭho guṇo’sya jāyate dhruvaḥ | kṣamayā vipulā lokāḥ sulabhā yenu durlabhāḥ ||57|| sahiṣṇutā sādhudharmo durlabho’nyadurātmanām | dāntasya kimaraṇyenāraṇyaṃ yatra saṃvaset| ||58|| dāntistapaḥ paraṃ proktaṃ yadicchāmāraṇaṃ mahat | vegavatāmindriyāṇāṃ nirodho yodhanaṃ mahat ||59|| tadvai tapaḥ sañcitaṃ ca sarvān kāmān dadāti hi | trīn lokām̐stapasā siddhāḥ prapaśyanti damānvitāḥ | | 2.217.60 | | yad durāpaṃ bhavet kiñcit tatsarvaṃ tapasā labhet | aiśvaryāṇi samastāni tapomūlāni tāni vai | | 61 || sarvapāpāni tapasā dahyante tāpitāni hi | nivṛttendriyavargasya tapo’naśananāmakam || 62| | sabalaṃ vardhate divyatejovardhanakaṃ param | na duṣkarataraṃ dānāt tapo nānaśanātparam | | 63 || na dākṣyaṃ cātmamuktyāpterna santoṣātparaṃ sukham | tapasā śakyate prāptuṃ deveśamuktatādikam || 64| | vāṅtapaḥ satyamevāsti satsu satyaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | satyaṃ dharmastapo yogo yajño brahma sanātanam || 65 | | tatsarvaṃ satyarūpaṃ vai tapaḥ kṛṣṇe samarpitam | hareryogād bhavet satyavrataṃ satāṃ tu sevanāt | | 66 | | sarvavastuṣu māṃ paśyet samatāvratamucyate | icchākṣayena ca damavrataṃ tṛṣṇākṣayena ca | | 67 || ātmaniṣṭhādṛḍhatvenābhayavrataṃ hyavāpyate | jñānena cāpyate sthairyaṃ gāṃbhīryaṃ dhairyamityapi || 68 || amātsaryaṃ labhyate ca nirmamatveva sarvathā | sādhutvaṃ kṣamayā śīlaṃ cāsaṃkalpena labhyate | | 69 || dhiyā śreyo labhyate ca kalyāṇaṃ puṇyakarmabhiḥ | hrīrdharmātprāpyate kṣāntirdhairyeṇa labhyate tathā | | 2.217.70 || tyāgaḥ snehasya yattyāgo viṣayāṇāṃ tathaiva ca | rāgadveṣaviyogena vairāgyeṇa ca labhyate | | 71 | | dhairyaṃ vikāraśūnyatvaṃ sukhaduḥkhaprade’pi ca | viṣaye cāpyadhṛṣyatvaṃ prāpyate cātmasattayā | | 72 || sarvathā kṣamiṇā bhāvyaṃ bhāvyaṃ satyapareṇa ca | vītaharṣabhayaruḍbhirbhāvyaṃ kalyāṇalabdhaye | |73 || adroheṇa sadā bhāvyaṃ sānugraheṇa vai tathā | satyadharmeṇa śīlena bhāvyaṃ kalyāṇamicchatā || 74| | satāṃ sevākṛtā bhāvyaṃ bhāvyaṃ madbhaktisaṃyujā | ātmārpaṇena vai bhāvyaṃ paraśreyo’bhikāṃkṣiṇā || 75 || mantro grāhyo vaiṣṇavaśca śaraṇaṃ me harestathā | tena śreyastathā preyaḥ paramaṃ vo bhaviṣyati || 76 | | ityuktvā virarāmāsau bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ | prajāḥ premṇā pupūjuśca mantraṃ hareśca jagṛhuḥ | | 77 || tato rājā ca rājñī ca kumārāścakrurarhaṇām | tisro rājñyastathā tisraḥ kanyakāścakrurarhaṇām || 78 || mahānīrājanaṃ cakruḥ karpūravartikāyutam | rājaveṣaṃ dhārayāmāsuśca gopālanandanam ||7 9 | | yogyāḥ kanyāśca vai tisro ramyā yuvatya eva tāḥ | mātrājñayā svahṛdayaiḥ suvarṇavaramālikāḥ | | 2.217.80 | | hareḥ kaṇṭhe nyadhuḥ sarvāścaraṇāmbu papustathā | madhuparkaṃ daduścāpyādaduḥ kānte samarpitāḥ || 81 | | kṛtakṛtyā abhavam̐stāḥ sthalapadmadalaprabhāḥ | pārāvārapibo rājā cakre vivāhakotsavam | |82 || parihārottaraṃ cakrarbhojanaṃ tatra saṃgatāḥ | asvapam̐śca tataḥ sarve kanyāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ siṣevire | |8 3 | | prātarvādyairgītibhiśca prabubodha mahāprabhuḥ | kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtapūjo’bhavat svastho yadā hariḥ || 84 | | rājā tvāyāt tatra kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayituṃ pupūja ca | tadā samāyānnṛpatiḥ śuciḥ koṭīśvarābhidhāḥ | | 85 | | ekadvārapradeśānāmadhiśāstā sudharmavān | tathā cāyānnṛpatiśca śrīsatīśābhidhaḥ śuciḥ | | 86 | | pārūparāṣṭranṛpatirdharmavānbhaktibhāvavān | mṛtyuharṣikoṣṭhakarṣibhyāṃ yutau tau nṛpau śubhau | | 87 | | prārthayāmāsatuḥ śrīśaṃ svarāṣṭragamanāya ha | haristathāstviti prāha satkāraṃ cākarot tayoḥ | |88 | | tāvadāyāt pradhāno vai hyamātyo yājaneśvaraḥ | īśānapānaśiṣṭākhyasamrājo brāhmileśituḥ | | 89 | | patreṇa sākaṃ natvaivāprārthayatparameśvaram | brāhmīlarājye cāgatya goyājanīpurīṃ ca naḥ | | 2.217.90 | | yajñairmahotsavaiḥ kṛṣṇa pāvayeti nṛpeṣaṇām | pūrṇāṃ karotu bhagavān prajāśreyo bhaviṣyati | | 91 || amarīṇāṃ ca bhāgyāni bhaviṣyanti śubhāni ca | bhavato darśanenāpi pūjanena ca sevayā | | 92 | | ityukto bhagavānāha svāgataṃ te nṛpasya ca | vacanaṃ mānaye’mātyavarya yogyaṃ samīhitam | | 93 || pañcamyāṃ tu prage tatra samāgatya kratūtsavam | kariṣye lomaśaṃ nītvā tathā maharṣisattamān | | 94| | īśānaṃ ca satīṃ nītvā yāhi rājñe nivedaya | sāmagrīsañcayaṃ cāpi prakāraya ca ghoṣaṇām | | 95 | | nadītīre śubhaṃ sthānaṃ yogyaṃ yajñārthamācara | pañcamyāṃ tu prage yajñāraṃbhaścaikādaśīdine | | 96 | | pūrṇāhutiḥ kratoḥ syācca praghoṣayeti sarvathā | amātyaḥ prayayau śīghraṃ tvājñāṃ prāpya nijālayam | | 97| | brāhmīleśaṃ tathoktaṃ cāvedayāmāsa sarvathā | lomaśeśānadevau ca lālāyano vṛkāyanaḥ ||98|| nīlakarṇo yavakrītastathānye ṛṣayo yayuḥ | svayaṃprakāśo bhagavān yayau yajñārthasiddhaye ||99|| āmrajanisarittīre śāntārāmarṣisevite | goyājanībhūmimadhye yajñasthalīṃ hyakalpayan || 2.217.100 || atha kṛṣṇo’bhavat sajjo dugdhaṃ pītvā kuṭumbayuk | gantumekadvārarāṣṭraṃ tathā pārūparāṣṭrakam || 101 || pārāvārapibo rājā vidāyaṃ yautakaṃ dadau | pūjālabdhaṃ dhanaṃ sarvaṃ dadau sa cāmbikarṣaye || 1 02|| svāgataṃ mānanaṃ prāpya harirvimānago’bhavat | koṭīśvaro yayau pūrvaṃ sammānārthaṃ harestadā || 103 || śrīsatīśo yayau cāpi nijarāṣṭraṃ haristataḥ | mṛtyuharṣisuyuktaśca koṣṭhakarṣiyutastathā || 1 04|| vyomnā śīghraṃ samāyācca peyisthānagarīṃ prati | rādhike ca tadā vādyānyavādyanta vilokya tam || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne hareḥ kāyanīnagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ rājālaye samupadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ svapanaṃ prātarvidāyaṃ āśvinakṛṣṇapratipadi koṭīśvaranṛpasya ekadvārarāṣṭragamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 217 ||
<2.218> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike pratipatprātaścāśvīnakṛṣṇapakṣake | peyisthāyāḥ sannidhau vai mahodyāne hi koṭiśaḥ || 1 || nṛpaḥ sainyena kṛṣṇasya svāgataṃ svaṃ vyadhārayat | vimānaṃ bālakṛṣṇasya divyasūryanibhaprabham || 2 || janā dṛṣṭvā jayaśabdān cakrurharṣasamanvitāḥ | rājadarśitamārgeṇāvātārayad vimānakam || 3 || peyisthāyā nagaryā udyāne dhvajādiśobhite | vimānaṃ cāvardhayam̐śca prajā akṣatacandanaiḥ || 4 || puṣpāñjalibhiścātyarthaṃ gītibhiḥ svāgataṃ vyadhuḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vimānato bahiḥ || 5 || āyayau ca tadā sūryānanaṃ vilokya mānavāḥ | kṣaṇaṃ tejodharṣitāścābhavaiṃstataḥ kṛpānidhiḥ || 6 || candrānano’bhavacchīghraṃ śāntasudhāpravarṣaṇaḥ | dadṛśuśca janāḥ sarve tadā śrīkṛṣṇavallabham || 7 || koṭīśvaro nṛpaḥ kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe hāraṃ dadau śubham | papau pādāmṛtaṃ cāpi tato’nye’pūjayan prabhum || 8 | | gaje niṣādya sarveśaṃ peyisthāyāṃ mahāpathe | mahāsainyena rājā so’bhrāmayanmānapūrvakam || 9 | | pradhānaiśca tathāmātyaiḥ śreṣṭhibhiśca prajājanaiḥ | dhanāmbarairhīrakaiśca mauktikai ratnahārakaiḥ || 2.218.10 || phalaiḥ puṣpairdalairmiṣṭaiḥ suvarṇādyaiśca pūjitaḥ | nīrājito vanditaśca yoṣidbhiḥ sannirīkṣitaḥ || 11 || manoharasvarūpaḥ śrīkāmbhareyo narāyaṇaḥ | datvaivaṃ darśanaṃ cāyānnṛpāvāsaṃ manoharam || 12 || rājā svamandire divye siṃhāsane janārdanam | niṣādya caraṇau natvā puraḥ svarṇāyutaṃ nyadhāt| || 13 || rājñī pupūja bhaktyāḍhyā candanākṣatapuṣpakaiḥ | kanye dve ca tadā kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe mātrājñayā śubhe || 1 4|| varamāle nyadhātāṃ te jāte pūrṇamanorathe | pareśvaraṃ patiṃ prāpyānandamagne babhūvatuḥ || 1 5|| rājā bhāgyaṃ nijaṃ mene sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ nṛpāṃganā | nīrājanaṃ cakārātha hariścopādideśa ha || 1 6|| krodho lobho rasāsvādo mānaḥ stainyaṃ ca paiśunam | ete pramattāḥ satataṃ tudanti puruṣaṃ striyam || 1 7|| ebhyaḥ pravartate duḥkhamebhyaḥ pāpaṃ pravartate | lobhāt krodhaḥ prabhavati mānācca jāyate bhṛśam || 18 || paradoṣaistathā krodho bhavedicchāvighātakaḥ | avamānād bhavet krodho vākkāṭhinyaśravāttathā || 1 9|| kṣamayā krodhanaṃ sādhau drāgeva vinivartate | krodhamūlaṃ kvacit kāmo bhavatyeva viyojitaḥ || 2.218.20 || kāmamūlaṃ tu saṃkalpo hetuvṛddhau vivardhate | sevyamānastu sutarāṃ tyajyamānastu naśyati || 21 || asūyā jāyate mānād yaśaḥkhaṇḍanatastathā | dāridryāt svāpakarṣāccāvanaternimnasaṃsthiteḥ || 22|| ajñānaprabhavo mohaḥ pāpābhyāsāt pravartate | jñānamārgeṇa vihato moho mūlānnivartate || 23 || vidhitsā karmaphalikā mayyarpaṇānna bandhadā | prītyā śokaḥ prabhavati ceṣṭāviyojanāttathā || 24|| yadā nairarthyamānaṃ syācchokaḥ sarvo nivartate | pāravaśyaṃ tṛṣṇayā vā lobhāt kāmāt sukhehayā || 25|| jāyate tattu vairāgyānnivartate samūlakam | asatyāśrayiṇo nityaṃ mātsaryaṃ pravivardhate || 26 || sādhūnāṃ sevanāt satyodbodhāttattu nivartate | avasthāguṇasampattikulakhyātikalādibhiḥ || 27|| aiśvaryād vidyayā cāpi jāyate tu madodbhavaḥ | teṣāmaṃśaṃ sukhadaṃ ca prāpyānyāṃśaṃ vivarjayet || 28|| evaṃ vai vartamānasya madaduḥkha na jāyate | īrṣyā paronnatiśraiṣṭhyāsahiṣṇunā vitanyate ||29|| upekṣayā nāśayed vai saṃharṣād vā vicārataḥ | kutsā sañjāyate śraiṣṭhyagarveṇānyatra vastuni ||2.218.3 0|| avasthābhedasāmyajñaḥ kutsāṃ jayati nānyathā | iti kartuṃ na śaktā ye balasthāya mahātmane ||3 1|| asūyā jāyate teṣāṃ bhāgyatuṣṭyā nivartate | kṛpā saṃjāyate loke hyupakāravivekataḥ ||32|| kṛpaṇeṣu tathānyeṣu daurguṇyena nivartate | ajñānaprabhavo lobho yatra yatra prajāyate || 33 || tatra tatra bhāvayeccāsthiratvaṃ duḥkhadāyitām | anapekṣasvabhāvena lobho’pyatra nivartate || 34 || nṛśaṃsaṃ varjayennityaṃ vijñāya ca yathātatham | saspṛho garvitaścāpyākroṣṭā ca vañcakastathā || 35|| śaṭhaḥ kṣudro naikṛtiko viṣamaśca vikatthanaḥ | saṃgī mānyasaṃvibhāgī sarvaśaṃkī ca nirdayaḥ || 36 || kṛpaṇo dveṣavān hiṃsāvihāro bahvalīkakaḥ | lubdhaḥ pāṣaṇḍavān nindākartā tvete nṛśaṃsakāḥ || 37|| dharmaśīlaṃ guṇopetaṃ pāpamityavagacchati | śreṣṭhān pūjyān sataḥ sādhvīḥ svārthārthamupahanti yaḥ ||38|| svapaiśunyapramāṇena na viśvasiti kasyacit | guṇināṃ svalpadoṣaṃ vā bahutvena ca vakti yaḥ || 39|| yaścopakāriṇaṃ mitraṃ manyate vañcakaṃ param | hitakṛte’pi ca muhustapatyeva nirarthakam ||2.218.40|| bhojanaṃ sādhu nītvaiva bhuṃkte prekṣakapaṃktiṣu | nārīṃ pratāpayed yaśca pitarau tāpayecca yaḥ || 41 || ete nṛśaṃsā jñātavyāsteṣāṃ saṃgaṃ na cācaret | sadbhyo datvā bhuṃjate ye suhṛdbhirbāndhavaiḥ saha || 42|| pretya labhante svargaṃ te svargāt svargaṃ tathottaram | nṛśaṃsān vardhayed jñātvāśrayet sādhūn hariṃ tathā ||43|| niḥsvebhyo deyameveti vidyānnāmbaramuttamam | yakṣyamāṇo dānapātraṃ sarvavidyādharastathā || 44|| ācāryapitṛkāryaśca dharmārthadattajīvanaḥ | ete vai sādhavaḥ proktāḥ parameśaparāyaṇāḥ ||45|| teṣāmāśrayaṇānmokṣo mahāsvargādikārjanam | sarvaiśvaryapralābhaśceśvarabhāvastadāśrayāt ||06|| madrūpaḥ sādhavaste vai yeṣu me sadguṇāḥ śubhāḥ | madguṇo vai madaṃśo’sti naro nārāyaṇāhvayaḥ ||47|| tyaktavyām̐śca janān vacmi yeṣāṃ saṃgo bhayāvahaḥ | lubdhaṃ krūraṃ dharmahīnaṃ mama bhaktivivarjitam ||48|| nikṛtiṃ ca śaṭhaṃ kṣudraṃ pāpācāraṃ vivarjayet| | alasaṃ sarvaśaṃkaṃ ca dīrghasūtraṃ vivarjayet ||49||| anṛjuṃ ca sadā kruṣṭaṃ gurudārapradharṣakam | vyasaneyaṃ durātmānaṃ pitṛhaṃ nirapatrapam ||2.218.50 || sarvataḥ pāpacakṣuṣkaṃ nāstikaṃ nindakaṃ khalam | asaṃyamendriyaṃ kāmāsaktaṃ pramattamutsṛjet| ||51 || asadvṛttaṃ ca vidviṣṭaṃ samaye cānavasthitam | piśunaṃ cākṛtaprajñaṃ matsariṇaṃ ca pāpinam ||52|| duḥśīlaṃ cākṛtātmānaṃ kitavaṃ ca nṛśaṃsakam | mitrāpakṛtikaṃ cānyadravyārthalālasānvitam ||53|| dānadveṣiṇamevāpi cāsantuṣṭaṃ parityajet | adhīraṃ balakhaṇḍaṃ cāsthānakrodhaparāyaṇam ||54|| ayuktaṃ cāvivekaṃ cākasmād virodhinaṃ tyajet | akalyāṇakaraṃ duṣṭaṃ vyasanāḍhyaṃ vivarjayet ||55|| apakāraparaṃ mūḍhaṃ puṇyapradhvaṃsakārakam | śatrurmitramukho yaśca mitradveṣī suhṛt tvapi ||56|| jihmaprekṣī svārthamātramelano yaśasāṃ kṣayī | pratyakṣe śaṃsako yaśca parokṣe nindako naraḥ ||57|| svārthe mṛduḥ kṛte svārthe stabdho yastān parityajet | pānapaṃ dveṣiṇaṃ ṛddhaṃ nirghṛṇaṃ paruṣaṃ tyajet | |58|| paratāpakaraṃ prāṇivadhe raktaṃ kṛtaghnakam | adhamaṃ chidrapaśyaṃ ca dūrato varjayet sudhīḥ | |59|| tena hānirna vai loke nātmavikṣepaṇaṃ kvacit | buddhināśo na caivāpi nābhyudaye’sya vighnatā |||2.218.60|| evaṃ parīkṣya matimān sādhūn hitān samāśrayet | kulīnān jñānasampannān kovidān subahuśrutān ||6 1 | | guṇopetānalubdhām̐ścājitān jitaśramām̐stathā | sanmitrāṇi kṛtajñām̐śca sarvajñān lobhavarjitān ||62|| mādhuryaguṇasampannān satyasandhān jitendriyān | vyāyāmaśīlānnirdoṣān sadācārān samāśrayet ||63|| nāsthāne krodhinaścāpyakasmānnaiva virāgiṇaḥ | viraktām̐ścārthavetṝm̐śca suhṛtkāryaparāyaṇān ||64|| viśvastān ghātahīnām̐śca rakṣakān dharmavatsalān | loṣṭakāñcanatulyārthān suhṛdo dṛḍhabuddhikān ||65|| svāmyarthaṃ kṛtasarvasvān śrayed vicārya sajjanān | īdṛśairbhagavadbhaktairyaḥ sandhiṃ kurute janaḥ ||66|| tasya nityaṃ bhavecchreyaḥ kalyāṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tathā | śāstranityā jitadoṣāḥ santoṣiṇo haristhitāḥ ||67|| śīlaśāntiguṇopetāḥ sandheyāḥ puruṣottamāḥ | nṛśaṃsāśca tathā duṣṭā ye coktāśca tato’dhamāḥ ||68|| kṛtaghnā mitraghātāśca tyaktavyā dharmavarjitāḥ | kutaḥ kṛtaghnasya yaśaḥ kutaḥ sthānaṃ kutaḥ sukham ||69|| aśraddheyaḥ kṛtaghno hi kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ | mitradroho na kartavyaḥ puruṣeṇa viśeṣataḥ ||2.218.70|| mitradhruṅ narakaṃ ghoraṃ duḥkhaṃ yāti vipattidam | kṛtajñena sadā bhāvyaṃ mitrakāmena caiva ha ||71 || mitrācca labhate sarvaṃ mitrāt pūjāṃ prapadyate | mitrādbhogānavāpnoti gitrādāpad vinaśyati ||72|| mitrāṇi sādhavo loke jīvānāṃ pāpanāśakāḥ | vāsanākṣālakāścāpi svargamokṣapradāstathā ||73 || bhavamṛtyuharāste ca śaraṇāgatarakṣakāḥ | sarvathā duḥkhahartāro dayālavo’tisāttvikāḥ ||74|| naraiścābālavṛddhaiśca nārībhiḥ śīlaśobhanāḥ | sevanīyāḥ sadā santaḥ sarvadoṣavivarjitāḥ ||75|| divyā divyaguṇopetā āśritadivyatāpradāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya me’nusevakāḥ ||76|| yatprasādo’pi divyo’sti darśanaṃ divyameva ca | sparśanaṃ divyamevāpi sevanaṃ divyamityapi ||77|| vandanaṃ vartanaṃ cājñāpālanaṃ caraṇāmṛtam | sarvaṃ divyaṃ dibyayogātte sevyāḥ satataṃ janaiḥ ||78|| naitādṛśaṃ paraṃ puṇyaṃ paro dharmo’pi nedṛśaḥ | parābhaktiśca me sādhau sādhavo bhavatārakāḥ ||79|| ityupādiśya bhagavān dadau mantrān suvaiṣṇavān | bhojanaṃ kārayāmāsa rājā koṭīśvaro harim ||2.218.80 || mahīmānām̐stathā sarvān tāmbūlāni tato dadau | dakṣiṇāḥ svarṇamudrādyā dadau caurṇāmbarāṇyapi ||8 1|| madhyāhnottaravelāyāṃ kuṣṭhakarṣistadā harim | ārthayannijarāṣṭraṃ tvāgantuṃ pārūpanāmakam ||82|| śrīsatīśo nṛpaḥ pūrvaṃ gato’bhūt svāgatāya ca | haristathāstviti prāha sajjo’bhavad drutaṃ tadā ||83|| koṭīśvaro nṛpaḥ prādād yautakaṃ ca dhanaṃ bahu | vidāyaṃ svarṇaratnanādi hariḥ prāpya nijānvitaḥ ||84|| āruroha vimānaṃ ca prasasāra purodiśam | tadā vidāyavādyāni hyavādyanta nṛpājñayā ||85|| jayaśabdāḥ prajābhiśca kṛtāḥ kṛṣṇo nato janaiḥ | vardhito bhāvanābhiśca yayāvambaramārgataḥ ||86|| pārūparāṣṭramāyācca sañcālānagarīṃ prati | mahodyāne rājasaudhe rājā sainyasamanvitaḥ ||87|| svastho’bhūt svāgatārthaṃ vai vimānaṃ tvāgataṃ drutam | sūryatulyaṃ vilokyaiva prajāḥ sainyāni cābhitaḥ ||88|| jayaśabdān pracakruśca darśayāmāsurānatim | dhvajān patākikām̐ścāpi darśayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||89|| candratulyā gṛhacitrā vāvaṭikāśca vāvaṭān | darśayāmāsurākāśe yaśoślokasamanvitān || 2.218.90 || rājadarśitamārgeṇa vimānaṃ śrīharistadā | udyāne mandirāgre’vātārayacchanakaiḥ sthale || 91 || prajābhistu vimānaṃ tat puṣpapatrādibhiḥ śubham | vardhitaṃ pūjitaṃ cāpi nataṃ prāñjalibhistadā ||92|| śrīharistvāyayau cāgre vimāne kṛpayā drutam | dātuṃ svadarśanaṃ sarvalokebhyaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||93 || sūryanibho’titejasvī candraśītalamānasaḥ | padmākṣaḥ premabhṛnnetro mandahāsyānano hariḥ |||94|| tejaḥparidhisaṃvyāptavigrahaḥ kānakīprabhaḥ | koṭikandarpasaundaryo vātsalyavāridhiḥ prabhuḥ || 15|| janebhyo darśanaṃ prādājjagrāha namanādikam | bhāvanāṃ hṛdayairdattāṃ svīcakāra hṛdā tadā ||96|| atha rājā puṣpahārān svarṇahārān gale dadau | śītasugandhasārām̐śca siṣeca mastakādiṣu || 97|| kare dadau puṣpagucchān tilakaṃ kaisaraṃ vyadhāt | pādaprakṣālanaṃ cakre prasādāmṛtamāpapau || 98|| rājñī tasyāpūjayacca śrīpatiṃ pārvatīpatim | ārārtrikaṃ vyadhāt tatra vimāne bahuvartikam || 99|| pūjāścakruḥ pūjanaṃ ca hārāvalyādibhistadā | atha kṛṣṇaḥ papau vāri śītalaṃ madhuraṃ tadā || 2.218.100 || rādhike’tha tadā sainyaṃ sañcālānagarīṃ prati | sajjaṃ hyabhūt hariṃ bhrāmayituṃ rājā samutsukaḥ || 10 1|| bhagavān śrībālakṛṣṇo vimānādavaruhya ca | śṛṃgārite gaje śvete svarṇāsane hyupāviśat || 102|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne peyisthānagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ copadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ vidāyaṃ tataḥ sāyaṃ pārūparāṣṭrāgamanaṃ pūjanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 218 ||
<2.219> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike’nādikṛṣṇasya gajapṛṣṭhe gajāntare | pitarau ca tato gajāntare svabhrātarastrayaḥ || 1 || tato brahmapriyādīnāṃ śibikādyāstathābhavan | amaryaścābhavan paścād gītikārasikāstathā || 2 || agre ḍaṃkāniśānādi paṭahādyāstathābhavan | sainyavādyānyavādyanta jayanādāstathābhavan || 3 || yantraśabdā vipraghoṣā jāyante smātigarjanāḥ | sañcālāyāṃ gopurādau candraśālāsu śākhiṣu || 4 || rathyāsu rājamārgeṣu gṛheṣu vallabhīṣvapi | haṣṭeṣu vedikāsveva caityeṣu durgamastake || 5 || saudheṣu madhyamārgeṣūdyāneṣu ca samantataḥ | prajānanā narā nāryo bālakṛṣṇaṃ vilokitum || 6 || upasthitāstadāsam̐śca dhṛtapūjāḥ karādiṣu | nagaryāṃ gopure kṛṣṇaṃ pupūjāmātyamaṇḍalam || 7 || catvareṣu dhanāḍhyāścodyānakeṣu pradhānakāḥ | rathyāsu cāpaṇeṣvete catvareṣu prajājanāḥ || 8 || apūjayan hariṃ puṣpāmbarabhūṣāphalādibhiḥ | hāraiḥ pauṣpairhīrakādyaiḥ ratnamālābhirityapi || 9 || amaryaḥ kanyakāścāpi pupūjurakṣatādibhiḥ | sthalapadmādihāraiścormikābhiḥ śarkarādibhiḥ || 2.219.10 || evaṃ bhramitvā bhagavān nagaryāmatha mandiram | rājñaḥ samāyayau tūrṇaṃ jalapānamathākarot || 11 || upādideśa bhagavān prajābhyaśca nṛpādaye | bhuktimuktipradān ramyān saddharmān vai niśīthake || 12|| deśe kāle tathā vyaktau kālaparyāya ulbaṇaḥ | aniṣṭo’pi samāyāti virāgajanakaḥ sadā || 13|| loko’yaṃ bahudoṣo’sti nirdoṣāḥ sādhavo’tra vai | bhagavadyogayuktāste kālapāśavivarjitāḥ || 14|| ātmamokṣakarāḥ santo mama yogād bhavanti vai | sarvaṃ vilokya niḥsāraṃ duḥkhabāhulyasaṃbhṛtam || 15|| ātmamokṣanimittaṃ vai yateta matimān janaḥ | naṣṭe dhane ca dāreṣu putre pitari svāmini || 16 || duḥkhaṃ yāti vimūḍho’yaṃ loko mamatvakarṣitaḥ | tacchokaṃ nāśayatyeva sādhureva na cetaraḥ | | 17 || yathā kāṣṭhaṃ ca kāṣṭhaṃ ca sameyātāṃ mahājale | sametya ca vyapeyātāṃ tadvad dehisamāgamaḥ || 18 || evaṃ pautrāstathā putrā dārāḥ putryaśca bāndhavāḥ | satyaśca patayaścāpi viyogottaranirṇayāḥ || 19 || tatra sneho na kartavyo viyogo tairhi vai dhruvaḥ | adṛṣṭaścāgataḥ pūrvaṃ gate punarna darśanam || 2.219.20 || evaṃ jñātvā jagat sarvaṃ mahīmānasvarūpavat | yathā śoko na jāyeta tatha vṛttyaṃ sudhājanaiḥ || 21 || tṛṣṇāsnehotthadukhaṃ vai duḥkhād duḥkhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | prāptau sukhaṃ gate duḥkhaṃ śoko dukhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 22 || sukhaduḥkhe janānāṃ vai jāyete cakrame muhuḥ | śarīraṃ vidyate tvāyatanaṃ dvayorvivartatoḥ || 23 || tad duḥkhaṃ na punaḥ syādvai vartitavyaṃ tathā pathi | anādiśrīhariḥ panthāḥ sarvaduḥkhavināśakṛt || 24|| āśrayaṇīyaḥ so’haṃ duḥkhāntauṣadhamasmi yat | anāśritāstu sādhūn ye māṃ tathā parameśvaram || 25|| vidanti duḥkhabhāgaṃ te sukhaśūnyā bhavanti hi | snehapāśairanekaiste nibaddhā viṣayehayā || 26|| akṛtārthā hi sīdanti mṛgatṛṣṇājalabhramāḥ | snehena tilavad yantre sarge sarvaṃ nipīḍyate || 27|| snehabaddhaḥ karotyasmai karma pāpabharaṃ tataḥ | tena kleśānavāpnoti paratreha punaḥ punaḥ || 28 || putradārakuṭumbeṣu prasaktāḥ sarvadehinaḥ | śokasāgaramagnāste sukhino na bhavanti vai | | 29 || iṣṭanāśe yathā prāpto dāvāgnistatsamo janaḥ | dahyate vai vṛthā bhasmībhavituṃ na phalaṃ śubham || 2.219.3 0 | | nālaṃ sukhaṃ pradātuṃ vai suhṛdo bāndhavā api | nālaṃ duḥkhaṃ pradātuṃ ca śatravo’nye pare’pi ca || 31 || nālaṃ cārthāḥ sukhaṃ dātuṃ nālaṃ tatsādhanānyapi | na dāridryaṃ duḥkhadātṛ prājño jānāti no’paraḥ || 3 2|| vivekī ca virāgī ca madbhakto vai bhavet sukhī | ahaṃ dhenusvarūpo’smi dogdhāraḥ sukhino mama || 33 || dhenurvatsasya gopasya svāminastaskarasya ca | payaḥpibasya sarvasya sukhadā vai tathānvaham || 34|| mama bhakteḥ pānakartā sukhī syānnātra saṃśayaḥ | buddhimāśritya jananīṃ vivekinīṃ ca poṣiṇīm || 35|| sukhaṃ samarjayet prājño nāntare kleśavān bhavet | vivekāllabhyate śāntiḥ sukhaṃ cānanda ityapi || 36|| ye vivekasukhaṃ prāptā dvandvātītā nirīhakā | tānnaivārthā na cānarthā vyathayanti kadācana || 37|| abuddhāścāvivekāśca mūḍhāḥ svabhāvakarṣitāḥ | prahṛṣyanti ca yāvantastapyante śatadhādhikam || 38|| vivekaprasavā śāntiḥ santoṣasahakāriṇī | bhūtiḥ smṛddhiḥ śriyā sārdhaṃ dakṣe vasati nālase || 3 9|| mūḍhaṃ smṛtihanaṃ tṛṣṇāyutaṃ ca sparddhinaṃ tathā | īrṣyāyuktaṃ janaṃ śokaścāviśati sahasradhā ||2.219.40|| mamāśritaṃ satāṃ bhaktaṃ vivekinaṃ subuddhikam | asūyerṣyāvarjitaṃ tu śoko na spṛśati kvacit || 41 || ātmasattāsamopetaṃ brahmaniṣṭhāniṣeviṇam | satsamāgamakartāraṃ na śokaḥ spraṣṭumarhati || 42|| yannimitto bhavecchokastāpo duḥkhaṃ ca vignatā | aśāntirvā yato mūlāt tat tyajet sa sukhī bhavet| ||43|| mamatvena nijasvārthe kalpitaṃ yatnitaṃ ca vā | sadyastatparitāpārthaṃ sampadyate nijātmani ||44|| kāmānāṃ tyāgakartātra sukhena pūryate sadā | kāmānupātī satṛṣṇaḥ kāmānanu vinaśyati ||45|| tṛṣṇākṣayo mahān prokto yogināṃ sukharūpakaḥ | tṛṣṇāyutasya lokasya dhāvataścehayābhitaḥ ||46|| atiśoko’bhipadyeta kila dehātmavādinaḥ | khaṅgadhāre’mṛtaṃ liptaṃ jihvayā leḍhumicchataḥ ||47|| aprāptirbhedanaṃ kaṣṭaṃ tredhā duḥkhaṃ prajāyate | tathā priyeṣu magnasya kāmaleḍhurjanasya vai ||48|| kṣaṇādduḥkhaṃ prajāyeta kāmaṃ tyaktvā sukhī bhavet | sarvān kāmān jugupsedvai kāmo mṛtyurmanobhavaḥ ||49|| saṃhṛtya kāmasaṃkalpān bhayaṃ tyaktvā bhavet sukhī | yadā necchā na ca dveṣastadā brahmagato bhavet |||2.219.50|| durmatibhiryā dustyājyā na yā jīrṇā tu jīryataḥ | prāṇagrāsakaro rogastāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tyajataḥ sukham ||5 1 || mṛtyunābhyāhato loko jarayā veṣṭitaḥ sadā | kālagrasto’pi na vetti tvātmaśreyaḥprasādhanam ||5 2|| divā rātrirvinā bhaktiṃ moghā yāto hi dehinaḥ | evaṃ jānan bhajet kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tu māṃ harim ||53|| yāte prayāte divase janāyuḥ śrīyate sadā | vinā bhaktiṃ divā vandhyo dehinā yāti sarvathā ||54 || atīva tṛṣṇayā yāti sukhārthī gahane tale | anavāpte tu kāme vai mṛtyurabhyeti bhakṣakaḥ ||55| | vicinvantaṃ sukhaṃ raktaṃ dūre cāsaktamānasam | sarpo bhekīmivāsādya mṛtyurgrastvā pragacchati || 56 || adyaiva śreyaḥ kartavyaṃ kālakṣepo na lābhakṛt | asaṃpūrṇeṣu kāryeṣu mṛtyurādāya yāsyati ||57 | | ātmakāryaṃ drutaṃ cādya kurvīta sāvadhānakaḥ | asyāpūrṇamidaṃ kāryaṃ ceti kālo na paśyati ||58 || kadā mṛtyurbhavet kasya naiva jānāti kaścana | tasmānmokṣārthakaṃ kāryaṃ prāk kartavyaṃ vijānatā ||59 || ābālyādvai bhajanīyaḥ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | tuṣṭe kṛṣṇe bhavet saukhyaṃ śāśvataṃ nirmalaṃ yaśaḥ || 2.219.60 | | mohāviṣṭaṃ dhanadāraputrakṣetrātimagnakam | kṣetrapaśvādisampannaṃ suptaṃ mṛtyurhariṣyati || 61 || avitṛptaṃ yatamānaṃ kāmārthaṃ bahuveginam | dhāvantaṃ cānudhāvan vai mṛtyurādāya gacchati || 62 || kariṣye śvaḥ paraṃ kāryaṃ tato’nyacca tataḥ param | evaṃ vai cintayānaṃ taṃ kṛtāntaḥ sannayiṣyati ||63 || ārabdhānāṃ phalaṃ nāptaṃ saṃsaktaṃ cānyakarmaṇi | kṛtānāṃ duḥkhabhoktāraṃ yamaścādāya gacchati ||64|| rājānaṃ ca daridraṃ ca vijñaṃ bhṛtyamanāthakam | sarvathā rakṣitaṃ cāpi mṛtyurādāya gacchati || 65 | | mṛtyuṃ jarāṃ ca śaithilyaṃ pāravaśyaṃ vimānanām | vyādhimaśaktiṃ dehe’tra vīkṣya vijño hariṃ bhajet | | 66 || jāto’nirdhārito bālo’nirdhāritā mṛtistathā | āgamiṣyatyakasmādvai tadvicārya hariṃ bhajet || 67|| mṛtyusthānaṃ viṣayeṣu ratireva hi dehinaḥ | viratirvai mahāraṇyaṃ yogināmiva śāntidā ||68 || pāśarajjurviṣayāḍhyā vṛttiryā dehināṃ sadā | chitvā tāṃ śrīhareḥ pādau samāśrayet sa buddhimān || 69 || na yoddhā jayati keścidāyāntīṃ mṛtyuvāhinīm | satyayoddhā jayapyenāṃ harau satye’mṛtaṃ sthitam ||2.219.70 || satyaṃ brahmeti vai proktaṃ parabrahmaparo bhavet | satyavrate sthitaścāpi satyayogaṃ samāśritaḥ ||7 1 | | satsamāgamanirataḥ sadyogenāntakaṃ jayet | mohamṛtyuṃ vijityaivāmṛtaṃ satsaṃgato labhet| ||72|| sādhvarthī parameśārthī sevārthī cātmaniṣṭhitaḥ | mṛtyuṃ tīrtvā mahānandāmṛtaṃ prāpnoti modate ||73|| sādhuyajñasthito dānto brahmayajñe ratiṃ gataḥ | parabrahmārpaṇamagno mahāmokṣaṃ prayāti hi ||74|| yasya kṛṣṇaḥ sadā tuṣṭaḥ sādhavo’nugrahānvitāḥ | kṛpāvarṣiṇaḥ pitaraḥ sa vai sarvamavāpnuyāt ||75|| vidyācakṣurdivyanetraṃ brahmavrataṃ paraṃ tapaḥ | sādhusevā paraṃ puṇyaṃ tyāgaḥ sukhaṃ tu śāśvatam ||76|| ātmanā vartamānasya parameśe sthitasya ca | vītarāgasya muktasya kiṃ punastārakāntaram ||77|| vittaṃ divyaṃ sādhavo vai ratnaṃ divyaṃ hariḥ svayam | pravṛttirbhajanaṃ yasya tasya kimanyasādhanaiḥ ||78|| akiñcanaḥ sukhaṃ śete sukhaṃ prabodhate’pi ca | sukhaṃ pathyaṃ śivaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prāpya pramodate sukhī |||79|| hariṃ vinā na yasyāsti dravyaṃ cākiṃcano hi saḥ | ākaiṃcanyaṃ paraṃ saukhyaṃ sṛṣṭitrayātireki tat ||2.219.80 || ākaiṃcanye tathā rājye viśeṣo vartate mahān | rājyavānnityamudvigno nirudvego hyakiñcanaḥ ||8 1 || nāgnermṛtyoścāsya bhītirna caurāriṣṭakādapi | na śatroḥ kālavegādvā bhayaṃ tasya prajāyate ||82|| tyāginaṃ bhagavadbhaktaṃ dehagṛhaṃ hariśrayam | sādhusevāparaṃ śāntaṃ praśaṃsanti harādayaḥ ||83 || nātyaktvā sukhamāpnoti nātyaktvā brahma vindati | nātyaktvā nirbhayaścāste tyāgaṃ labdhvā sukhī bhavet| ||84|| īhākṛṣṭasya dīnasya pramādamāviśed bhṛśam | pramattaṃ tyaktamaryādaṃ hyupayānti mahāpadaḥ ||82|| tāsāṃ vināśakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bheṣajaṃ sādhusevanam | yeṣāṃ saṃgājjñānalābhaścehānāṃ vilayo bhavet ||86|| snehadhārā bhavet kṛṣṇe mayi śrīśe pareśvare | śāśvatānandasampūrṇe madyogānmāmakaḥ sukhī ||87|| śāśvatānandapūrṇaḥ syāt tatkāryaṃ mānavairiha | ityuktvā rādhike’nādiśrīśanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||88|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | itimantraṃ dadau sarvebhyaśca sarvābhya ityapi ||89|| śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mama sarvadā | ityevaṃ śaraṇaṃ dadau sarvebhya eva saḥ ||2.219.90|| kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmya kuhṛdbhayāt | śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava ||9 1 || ityevaṃ rakṣaṇamantraṃ janebhyaḥ pradadau tadā | brahmāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto’smi śāśvataḥ ||92|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇānārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me | ityevaṃ vai brahmabhāvamanuṃ dadau ca vai hariḥ ||93 || bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ | pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako’stu saḥ ||94|| ātmanivedanamantraṃ dadāveva hariḥ svayam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ||95|| ityevaṃ śrāvayāmāsa namaskārārcanaṃ tataḥ | śrīśrīkṛṣṇasya bhaktohaṃ śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama ||96 || śrīkṛṣṇavallabheśo’yaṃ śrīsvāmī śaraṇaṃ mama | śrīkṛṣṇavallabhasvāmī śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama ||97|| ityevaṃ nijamantrām̐śca pradadau bhagavān svayam | atha prajā hariṃ natvā pūjayāmāsurādarāt ||98|| śrīsatīśanṛparājñī pupūja parameśvaram | śrīsatīśanṛpakanyāstisro yuvatya eva tam ||99|| hariṃ kāntaṃ manobhāvyaṃ prāpya kaṇṭhe tu mālikā | varamālātmikā datvārpaṇaṃ nyavedayan svakam || 2.219.100 || haristāsāṃ karān dhṛtvā tāsāṃ nātho babhūva ha | rājñī rājā mumudāte kṛtakṛtyāśca kanyakāḥ || 101 || tadutsavaṃ nṛpaścakre yautakaṃ bahudhā dadau | ārārtrikaṃ tataścakre rājā sa bhojanaṃ dadau || 1 02|| mahīmānān miṣṭavaryairbhojayāmāsa vai tataḥ | viśaśrāma harī rātrau trikanyāstaṃ siṣevire || 103 || prātarmāṃgalyavādyaiśca gītikābhiḥ stavādibhiḥ | prabubodha harikṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo narādhipaḥ || 1 04|| kṛtāhnikaṃ kṛtapūjaṃ hariṃ rājā hyupāyayau | dugdhaṃ vai pāyayāmāsa sarvān sukhena bhūpatiḥ || 105 || siṣeve ceṣṭadānādyairāśīrvādānavāpa ca | tāvattatra samāyāto netuṃ śrīharimacyutam || 106 || tretākarkaśarājarṣiḥ karṇaphālarṣisaṃyutaḥ | bālāvittakarāṣṭreśaḥ phānkalāśīpurīṃ prati || 1 07|| netuṃ samārthayat kṛṣṇaṃ daṇḍavat pracakāra ha | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha svāgataṃ bhūpaternṛpaḥ || 108 || vyadhāttato’bhavatsajjo rādhike parameśvaraḥ | rājā vidāyaṃ pradadau sainyena mānanaṃ dadau || 1 09|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne sañcālānagaryāṃ harerbhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ copadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ dvitīyāprātarvidāyaṃ sammānanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navadaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||219||
<2.220> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca tato vai rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mahāprabhuḥ | sajjo bhūtvārhaṇāṃ labdhāmbare vimānago’bhavat || 1 || kuṭumbaṃ ca vimāne cābhavanmaharṣisaṃyutam | brahmapriyādyāḥ sarvāśca niṣedustadvimānake || 2 || karṇaphālaṛṣiścāpi vimāne hariṇā saha | nyaṣīdacca nṛpastretākarkaśastu vimānake || 3 || nije cāruhya śīghraṃ vai prāg yayau svāgatārthakaḥ | harervidāye vādyāni tvavādyanta prajāravāḥ || 4 || jayakīrtanarāgāścābhavan digantaghoṣiṇaḥ | prasasāra vimānaṃ tu kṣaṇāntare hyavāpa ha || 5 || bālāvittakarāṣṭraṃ vai tvambare dyotate’rkavat | tretākarkaśanṛpatiḥ svāgataṃ tvācarattadā || 6 || vādyairninādairgītyādyaiḥ prajānāṃ harṣanādanaiḥ | jayaśabdaiḥ sainyavādyairnamanaiḥ puṣpakākṣataiḥ || 7 || ṛṣidarśitamārgeṇāvātārayad vimānakam | haristūrṇaṃ vimānādvai bahiścāgre samāyayau || 8 || svarṇabṛsyāṃ niṣasāda rājā taṃ samapūjayat | svarṇahārairambarādyaiścandanākṣatasatphalaiḥ || 9 || rājñī pādau jalaiścābhiṣiñcya papau jalāmṛtam | prajāḥ pupūjurīśeśaṃ harirdugdhaṃ papau tadā || 2.220.10 || mahīmānān samastāṃśca pāyayāmāsa satpayaḥ | bhūpatiśca tadā rājñī pāyayāmāsa yoṣitaḥ || 11 || atha sainyaṃ mahāśobhaṃ tadā śṛṃgāritaṃ hyabhūt| | nagaryāṃ brahmaṇārthaṃ vai rājodyānamukhātpuraḥ || 1 2|| mahāsvarṇarathe kṛṣṇaṃ śataikavṛṣayojite | nyaṣādayanmahārājastretākarkaśabhūpatiḥ || 13|| śataikasvarṇakalaśaiścaikaviṃśaticakrake | bahuvistārake rājapathamātrapravāhaṇe || 14|| hariṇā saha munayaḥ ṛṣayaḥ pārṣadāstathā | bhrātaraśca tathā rājā nṛpasyāpi kumārakāḥ || 1 5|| niṣedustvanyarathagā brahmapriyāstadābhavan | vādyaghoṣaiśca nagare vāhinī sā viveśa ha || 16|| jayaśabdāḥ prajānāṃ vai tadābhavan samantataḥ | puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ phalavṛṣṭiścandanānāṃ kaṇārpaṇam || 17|| svarṇamudrārpaṇaṃ hārārpaṇaṃ puṣpātisāraṇam | namanaṃ darśanaṃ dānaṃ
