pūjanaṃ ca vyadhuḥ prajāḥ || 18 || amarīṇāṃ gotayaścābhavan vyomābhibodhanāḥ | divyabhāvayutā nāryo vardhayāmāsuracyutam || 1 9|| pradhānāḥ śreṣṭhinaścāpi prajāśca parameśvaram | pupūjuḥ sarvaratnādyairbhāvanābhiḥ sthale sthale || 2.220.20 || phāṃkalāśīnagaryāṃ saṃbhramitvaivaṃ nṛpālayam | samāyayau nṛpastatra pupūja parameśvaram || 21 || svarṇasiṃhāsane ramye nyaṣādayat prabhuṃ mudā | karṇaphālaṛṣirnyarājayat kṛṣṇaṃ parātparam || 22|| rājñī kṛṣṇasya tilakaṃ kuṃkumenākṣataistathā | kesareṇa vyadhāt hāraṃ suvarṇasya dadau gale ||23 || yuvatyaḥ kanyakāḥ sapta rājñyā kṛṣṇaṃ manoharam | vīkṣya niścitya hṛdaye kāntaṃ vyadhuḥ patiṃ tadā || 24|| mātrājñayā varamālāḥ kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe nyadhurmudā | ārārtrikaṃ pracakruścārpitā iti jagurmuhuḥ || 25|| rājñī rājā prasannau ca kṛtakṛtyāśca kanyakāḥ | abhavan rādhike mokṣe prāpyaḥ prāpto’tra mādhavaḥ || 26|| utsavaṃ nṛtyagītādyairnṛpaścakre dine tathā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścopādideśa ha || 27|| mānavasya tu dehasya prāpteḥ phalaṃ sukhaṃ hareḥ | bhaktyuttaraṃ mahāmuktiḥ sevā satāṃ phalaṃ mahat || 28|| arāgadveṣabhāvaśca sadā kṛṣṇakathāruciḥ | titikṣā ca vivekaśca yasya saḥ syātsukhī janaḥ || 29|| arāgatā sukhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dveṣābhāvaḥ praśāntidaḥ | sukhaṃ svapiti nirviṇṇo nirdveṣaḥ kṣamayā yutaḥ || 2.220.30 || yaḥ kāmānāpnuyāt sarvān yaśca kāmān parityajet | tayostyāgī mahāsaukhyaṃ vindati na tu sarvavān || 31 || nāntaṃ gato’sti kāmānāṃ pūrvaḥ kaścinna cāparaḥ | gamiṣyatīti tṛṣṇāyāḥ kṣayāt prasādhayet sukham || 3 2|| bhuktamuktasya kāmasya nāntaṃ gacchati kaścana | sañcitasya dhanasyāpi nāntaṃ gacchati kaścana || 3 3|| tyaktvā sarvasamāraṃbhān sukhamāpnoti mānavaḥ | adhanasya bhaved rāgo labdhvā tu vardhate punaḥ ||34|| labdhanāśe tu mṛtyuḥ syād yadvā śocati nityaśaḥ | punarlabdhaṃ na bhavati tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||35|| na hi tuṣṭistu labdhena bhūya eva ca mṛgyati | anutarṣula evātra duḥkhī syādvai muhurmuhuḥ ||36|| dhananāśe’dhikaṃ duḥkhaṃ sarvebhyaścāvamānanam | dhane sukhakalā yā sā sahasraduḥkhamātṛkā ||37|| dhanavantaṃ vinighnanti dasyavo’nye haranti ca | tasmādāśāṃ parityajya mādhavaṃ samupāśrayet ||38|| nirvedaṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca tṛptiṃ śāntiṃ kṣamā damam | āśrayeccāpi santoṣaṃ sā syāt sukhī sadātra vai || 39|| kāmaṃ lobhaṃ ca tṛṣṇāṃ ca spṛhāṃ kārpaṇyamityapi | tyaktvā bhavejjano loke sukhī mukto jano yathā ||2.220.40|| svīyaprakāśaṃ papraccha bhagavān nāradaḥ purā | kathaṃ tvaṃ vartase brahman sukhe yatra na śocanam ||41 || yadā yadā tu paśyāmi tadā tadā sukhe’si vai | na śoke vai mayā dṛṣṭaḥ kimatra kāraṇaṃ vada ||42||| svīyaprakāśastaṃ prāha śṛṇu vidvan matiṃ mama | sadā paśyāmi sukhinaṃ kathaṃ kiṃ sukhamasya nu ||43|| sādhanaṃ cāsya vai kīdṛk kathaṃ cāste sukhī tathā | vṛṣabhaḥ śakaṭīṃ karṣan mayā pṛṣṭaḥ kathaṃ sukhī || 44|| sa cāha me na vai cintā bhojyavastragṛhādibhiḥ | karṣukeṇa dhṛtā sā tu madbalādhīnavartinā || 45||| tathāhaṃ trividhārthaṃ sañcintayāmi na sarvathā | tasmāt sukhī sadā cāsmi bhojyavastragṛhādibhiḥ ||46|| satrabhojī mayā pṛṣṭaḥ kathaṃ tvaṃ vartase sukhī | sa cāha me’nnapūrtyarthaṃ dhanaṃ cārjayate dhanī || 47|| aparo’yaṃ pācayitvā mahyaṃ dadāti nityaśaḥ | tato dhanānnapākānāṃ cintā me nāsti sarvathā || 48 || tadvicārya mayā sāpi kriyate na vṛthā yataḥ | śukaḥ pṛṣṭo mayāraṇye kiṃ tvaṃ pramodase vane || 49|| sa cāha me na bandho’sti yatra kvāpi carāmi vai | nīḍe vā gṛhanāle vā svapimyapi yathāmanaḥ ||2.220.50|| uḍḍīyāraṇyakaṃ gatvā bhakṣayāmi phalādikam | nāsti cintā sañcayasya nāsti me rakṣaṇasya ca ||51|| nāsti gṛhādicintā vā kuṭumbaṃ nāsti me yataḥ | tasmātsukhī pramode’haṃ sadā cintāvivarjitaḥ ||52|| tadvicārya mayā sāpi tyaktā nirbandhano’smi ca | atha pṛṣṭo mahā siṃhaḥ kathaṃ sukhī vibhāsase ||53 || sa cāha bhojanaṃ daivagatyā prāpya tryahāntare | na me hantā vane kaściditi matvā svapimyaham ||54|| tadvicārya mayā bhītiḥ kālādeḥ parivarjitā | tasmāt sukhī nirbhayaśca vicarāmi svapimyapi ||55|| sukhaṃ jīvanti munayaḥ parabrahmasamāśritāḥ | hrāsaṃ vṛddhiṃ vināśaṃ codbhavaṃ bhūtagatānimān |||56|| na māṃ lumpanti matvaivaṃ vicarāmi sadā sukhī | saṃyogān virahāntām̐śca saṃcayān śīrṇatānnakān ||57|| utpannān cāntayuktām̐śca jñātvā śocāmi naiva ca | śayanaṃ nidrayā vyāptaṃ rodanaṃ hānilepitam ||58|| harṣaṇaṃ prāptisañjanyaṃ trayaṃ tyaktvā sukhī sadā | satī śaṃbhoḥ mayā pṛṣṭā parādhīnā kathaṃ sukhā ||59|| sāha māṃ vai mayā dārḍhyaṃ kṛtaṃ svāminideśanam | mama dharmo na cānyo’sti mamānukūla eva saḥ ||2.220.6 0|| ato mayā mahatsaukhyaṃ svāminyevānubhūyate | tadvicāryaṃ mayā ceśe parameśe’nukūlatā ||61|| sarvavidhā kṛtā cāste pātivratyavidhottamā | ātmanivedyahaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe pareśvare ||62|| tasyecchā mama bhāgyaṃ vai bhāgyacintārpitā harau | viśeṣataśca tenāhaṃ sukhī sukhāśrayeṇa vai ||63 || śrutvaivaṃ nāradaścāpi jagrāha tādṛśīṃ sthitim | sukhyabhūcca sadā loke nirālambaścaran muniḥ ||64|| svīyaprakāśo bhagavān sanatkumārakastathā | lomaśarṣistathā śaṃbhuḥ sukhinaste hi śāśvatāḥ ||65|| indriyāṇi tadarthāśca vaśe yeṣāṃ bhavanti vai | aiśvaryāṇi ca bhūtāni vaśe yeṣāṃ bhavanti vai ||66|| camatkārāḥ siddhayaśca vaśe yeṣāṃ bhavanti vai | kālaḥ karma svabhāvaśca māyā yeṣāṃ vaśe sadā ||67|| ātmā vaśe ca yeṣāṃ vai ye vaśe paramātmanaḥ | te sadā sukhinaḥ santi sṛṣṭau vākṣaradhāmani ||68|| satī ramā brahmapriyāstathā muktāstathāvidhāḥ | sukhinaḥ śāśvatāścaite haryarthātmanivedinaḥ ||6 9 || tasmātsarvairharervaśyairbhāvyaṃ nānyavaśānugaiḥ | hariḥ śāśvatasukhavān sukhīkaroti sevakān ||2.220.70 || ityupādiśya bhagavān dadau mantrān tataḥ param | upārarāma nṛpatistvānarca rādhike hṛrim ||71 || tāvattatra vimānena prārthanārthaṃ samāyayau | adhaścilīrāṣṭraśāstā āṇḍajarākhyabhūpatiḥ ||72|| mantrāgnikarṣisahito namāma bahubhāvataḥ | labdhasvāgatasammāno’rthayāsa hariṃ nṛpaḥ ||73|| bhagavanme purīmantaḥprāgasthāṃ pāvaya prabho | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha sajjastūrṇo babhūva ha ||74|| tretākarkaśarājā ca vidāyaṃ yautakaṃ dadau | sainyena ca vyadhāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mānanam | |75|| hariḥ kuṭumbasahito vimāne cāmbare’bhavat | mantrāgnikarṣisahitastathā sārthasamanvitaḥ ||76|| rājā cāṇḍajarābhūpaḥ pūrvaṃ svāgatakārthakaḥ | yayau rāṣṭraṃ tadā tūrṇaṃ sainyaṃ prāk samasajjayat ||77|| tāvaddhariḥ samāyāto vimānavaravāhanaḥ | dṛṣṭvā prajājanāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jayatviti ||78 || harṣanādān jayanādān tūryanādān pracakrire | rājadarśitamārgeṇa ṛṣiṇā saha mādhavaḥ ||79|| udyāne’ntaḥprāgasthāyā nagaryāḥ sannidhau nijam | śṛṇvan svāgataghoṣām̐ścāvatārayad vimānakam ||2.220.80|| āyayau śrīharistūrṇaṃ vimānāgre bahistadā | cillyo nāryo harṣanādaiḥ śrīpatiṃ kṛṣṇavallabham ||8 1 || ciraṃjīveti vacanai rakṣarakṣetibhāvanaiḥ | sukhaṃ dehīti hṛdayairvardhayāmāsuracyutam ||82|| rājā pūjāṃ cakārādau candanākṣatapuṣpakaiḥ | rājñī pūjāṃ cakārāpi prajā nemuśca bhāvataḥ |||83|| tato rājā bālakṛṣṇaṃ nyaṣādayanmahāgaje | svarṇāmbālikayā yukte tathānyāśca rathādiṣu ||84|| hāragucchārcitān sarvān sasainyo bhūpatistadā | ninye svāṃ nagarīmantaḥprāgasthāṃ ca vibhūṣitām ||85|| bhrāmayituṃ rājamārge vādyakīrtanagītibhiḥ | gopure’pūjayat kṛṣṇaṃ pradhānāḥ śreṣṭhinastataḥ ||86|| catvarādau dhanāḍhyāścāpaṇeṣu paṇinastathā | rathyāmukheṣu cillyaśca nāryo bhāvabharāstadā ||87|| pupūjuḥ paramātmānaṃ hāracandanakuṃkumaiḥ | akṣatādyaiḥ phalairnārikelādyaiḥ śarkarādibhiḥ ||88|| kṛtakṛtyāścābhavam̐śca vīkṣya prapūjya mādhavam | tato rājānayat kṛṣṇaṃ nijaṃ viśālamandiram ||89|| ārārtrikaṃ cakārātha mukuṭaṃ mastake dadau | kaṇṭhe sauvarṇaratnānāṃ hārān dadau nṛpastadā || 2.220.90 || caraṇāmṛtapānaṃ ca pracakārābhipūjya ca | kṛtārtho’smītyuvācātha rājñī pūjāṃ vyadhāpayat || 91 || suvarṇamudrāsthālaṃ śrīhareścaraṇayornyadhāt | candanākṣatapuṣpādyairānarca parameśvaram || 92 || asyāstu kanyakāścillyo yuvatyo bhaktisaṃyutāḥ | catasro’pi hṛdi kṛtvā mātrājñayā tu mālikāḥ || 93 || hareḥ kaṇṭhe nyadhurhṛṣṭāścārpaṇavidhinā patim | prāpya kṛtārthakāryāstā babhūvurbhāgyanoditāḥ || 94|| rājā cātiprasanno’bhūnmahotsavamakārayat | hariścopādideśātha rādhe prajājanān niśi || 95 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āśvinakṛṣṇadvitīyāyāṃ prātaḥ phānkalāśīnagaryāṃ gamanaṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanamupadeśanaṃ vidāyaṃ madhyāhnottaram āṇḍajarānṛparaiṣṭragamanam āntaḥprāgasthānagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā viṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 220 ||
<2.221> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike śrīhariḥ svasthaḥ svarṇasiṃhāsanasthitaḥ | upādideśa cillyākhyaprajābhyaḥ suhitāvaham || 1 | | prajñā pratiṣṭhā jīvānāṃ prajñā mokṣakarī matā | mānavaṃ dehamāsādya prajñayā harimāpnuyāt || 2 || prajñā niḥśreyasī śuddhā prajñā svargasukhapradā | prajñayā prāpyate cārthaḥ prajñāvān vai sadā sukhī || 3 || pāṇipādayuto loke mānavaḥ puṇyavānmataḥ | pāṇibhyāṃ prajñayā budhvā praseveta prabhuṃ sataḥ || 4 || nānyasaktamanāḥ syādvai vihāya parameśvaram | bhavantyeke sukhitarāḥ santyanye bhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ || 5 || naikāntaṃ sukhameveha bhavate kasyacit kvacit | janā dhanāḍhyatāṃ prāpya rājyamicchanti cottamam || 6 || tato devatvamicchanti tataścendrādipūjyatām | brahmatāṃ ceśvarabhāvaṃ mokṣaṃ necchanti vai kacit || 7 || prajñā vivekasampannā mokṣadātrī bhavatyataḥ | prajñayā labhyate mokṣo brahmaloke dhruvā sthitiḥ || 8 || prajñānaṃ brahma cetyetat hṛdaye’pi vyavasthitam | upāsanīyaṃ satataṃ paraṃbrahma sanātanam || 9 || brahmarasaprasaktasya kāmo’nyo naiva jāyate | saṃsparśād darśanādvāpi śravaṇād brahmaṇastathā || 2.221.10 || sevanāddhyānakaraṇādbrahmarasaparo bhavet | taṃ vinā na bhavet tṛptiḥ priyalābhe’pare kvacit || 11 || tṛṣṇā śāmyati nādbhirvai bhūyo jvalati bhogakaiḥ | prajñayā sā samūlā vai naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 1 2|| kāmyakarmodbhavaṃ chitvendriyāṇi viniyamya ca | ātmabhāvena varteta tasya tṛṣṇā vinaśyati || 1 3|| aprāśanamasaṃsparśamasandarśanamityapi | arasanaṃ cāśravaṇaṃ cāghrāṇanaṃ ca nehanam || 14|| ityevaṃ niyamaṃ śreyaḥ paraṃ prajñākṛtaṃ bhavet | pāṇiyanto balavanto dhanavanto’pi dehinaḥ || 15|| tṛṣṇādāsyaparā bhūtvā kliśyante vadhabandhanaiḥ | rudantyapi ramante ca modante ca hasantyapi || 16|| evaṃ lokā bahubalā labdhavidyā manohṛtāḥ | jugupsitāṃ kṛpaṇāṃ ca hīnavṛttimupāsate || 17|| utsahante ca vardhante patantyapi rudanti ca | na bheko vā varāho vā śvātmānaṃ tyaktumicchati || 18|| puṣkaso vāpi cāṇḍālo baddhaḥ kīṭo’pi varṣmaṇi | svayā yonyā mahātuṣṭaḥ sthātumicchati māyayā || 19|| dṛṣṭvā vyaṃgān pakṣahatān kuṇīn kuṣṭhina ityapi | svastho’pi bhajate naiva hariṃ māṃ māyayā hataḥ ||2.221.20|| tasmād vicārya manasā vinirṇīya ca prajñayā | bhajenmāṃ paramātmānaṃ tyaktvāsaktiṃ ca mohanam ||21|| dhyānaṃ śuddhiṃ japaṃ pūjāṃ vṛddhapitrādisevanam | satāṃ sevāṃ mama bhaktiṃ kuryācchreyo vidhitsayā || 22|| sati rājye gṛhasmṛddhau satkāryāṇi samācaret | sunakṣatre puṇyakāle sutithau sumuhūrtajāḥ ||23 || yajñadānādibhiḥ puṇye yatante sādhuśīlinaḥ | teṣāṃ prajñā parabrahmayogācchīghraṃ prakāśata || 24|| prajñayā yāti paramaṃ dhāma me śāśvataṃ sukham | ye nakṣatreṣvāsureṣu duḥsthitau durmuhūrtajāḥ ||25|| te patantyāsurīṃ yoniṃ prajñāhīnāḥ kratudviṣaḥ | śṛgālaśvakhaniṃ yānti śreyasteṣāṃ na vidyate || 26|| santuṣṭaścāpramādaśca yajñadānatapaḥpriyaḥ | sādhusevāparaḥ prajñāśrayo yāti parāṃ gatim || 27|| priyadevātitheyāśca sevakāḥ priyasādhavaḥ | haryarthaṃ kṛtasarvasvāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim |||28||| utsavādutsavaṃ yānti haṣāddharṣaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | svargātsvargaṃ paraṃ yānti sādhorme ca prasevinaḥ ||29|| khalāḥ śaṭhāśca dhūrtāśca vañcakā ye tu pāpinaḥ | ātmanānarthayuktena niviśante’ghakarmasu ||2.221.3 0 || punaśca kaluṣaṃ kṛtvā kṛcchre loke bhavanti te | durbhikṣādeva durbhikṣaṃ kleśātkleś punaḥ punaḥ ||3 1 || bhayādbhayaṃ tathodvegādudvegaṃ samprayānti te | mṛtyormṛtyuṃ punaryānti daridrāḥ pāpakarmiṇaḥ ||32|| tuṣā yathā tu dhānyeṣu maśakā iva pakṣiṣu | tadvidhāste mānaveṣu dharmakarmavivajiṃtāḥ ||33|| pacyante kaṇavat garbhavahnau kālena bharjitāḥ | vinā prajñāṃ paraṃ śreyo nāpnuvanti kathaṃcana ||34|| udvignāste pradhāvanti saṃsārāraṇyamunmukhāḥ | kṛtaṃ karmānugaṃ bhūtvā dhartuṃ dhāvati tām̐stataḥ ||35|| suptau suṣuptau vijane jāgratyapi na muñcati | lagnaṃ chāyeva satataṃ taṃ vimucya na gacchati || 36|| karmākṛṣṭaṃ parādhīnaṃ vāsanāparisaṃvṛtam | vilokya ca mahākālo duḥkhābdhau parikarṣati ||37|| svakarmaphalaniḥkṣepaṃ kālo dadāti karmiṇe | yathāvṛkṣeṣu kālena puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca || 38|| jāyante nātivartante tathā karma purākṛtam | ātmanā kṛtaśeṣeṇa garbhaśayyāṃ prayāti ca ||39|| bālo yuvā ca vṛddhaśca tatphalaṃ pratipadyate | prajñāgninā viśuddhasya dīrghaṃ sukhamanantakam ||2.221.40|| prajñayā dhūtapāpānāṃ naṣṭarāgadviṣāṃ satām | parameśe prasaktānāṃ prapadyate’kṣayaṃ sukham ||41 || prajñāvān kurute yadyat tatsarvaṃ bandhanāya na | prajñayā mayi yukto yastasya karma na vidyate |||42||| jale jhaṣāṇāṃ gagane pakṣiṇāṃ na yathā padam | dṛśyate na tathā karma mayi bhaktasya vedinaḥ ||43 || jñānavidāṃ gatiścaiṣā brahmadhāmaparāyaṇā | sādhyā tu prajñayā sādhvyā mānavairvai mumukṣubhiḥ ||44|| sarvabhūteṣu gūḍho’haṃ cāntarātmā vasāmi vai | prajñayā tvagryayā tattvadarśinyā labhya eva ha ||45|| matprasādakṛtāhāro matsādhukṛtsamāgamaḥ | yuñjāno mayi cātmeśe brahmatulyaḥ prajāyate ||46|| cittasya ca prasādena samarpya mayi mānasam | nirmalātmā prasannātmā niveditātmā tiṣṭhati ||47|| mayi kṛṣṇe pare sthitvā sukhānantyaṃ samaśnute | anantāpāramānandaṃ samaśnute sthirāyatiḥ ||48|| sarvopāyairmahātṛṣṇāṃ lobhaṃ krodhaṃ jayet sadā | tadā prajñākṛtaṃ jñānaṃ pāvitryaṃ samupaiti ha ||49|| ātmasaṃyama evāsti mokṣātmā vṛṣasattamaḥ | tenātmanātmani tiṣṭhenmayi nārāyaṇe sadā ||2.221.50 || evaṃ vai vartamānasya mokṣaḥ karatale sthitaḥ | hṛdayastho’hamevāsya muktidogdhā bhavāmi vai ||51 || ityupādiśya bhagavān kāṃbhareyo mahāprabhuḥ | mantrān daduḥ prajābhyaśca cakruḥ pūjāṃ hareḥ prajāḥ ||52|| dravyāṇi cārpayāmāsurvastrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca | suvarṇāni ca rūpyāṇi daduḥ śrīharaye prajāḥ ||53 || tato rātrau nṛpatirvai bhojayāmāsa mādhavam | kuṭumbaṃ ca maharṣīṃśca bhojayāmāsa kanyakāḥ ||54|| tato viśrāntimāpātha nidrāṃ jagrāha keśavaḥ | kanyakāstā nijaṃ kāntaṃ pareśvaraṃ siṣevire ||55|| prātarvādyanighoṣaiśca gītibhirmaṃgalasvanaiḥ | vedaghoṣaiśca viprāṇāṃ prabubodha haristataḥ ||56 || kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtapūjaḥ kṛtadugdhaphalādanaḥ | rājñā rātryā pūjitaśca svarṇasiṃhāsane sthitaḥ ||57|| anyānnṛpaḥ payaḥpāna kārayāmāsa sārthakān | tāvatprajāḥ pūjanārthaṃ darśanārthaṃ samāyayuḥ ||58|| mantrāgnikarṣaye kṛṣṇo dhanādīni dadau tadā | samāgataścāṇḍajarānṛpabhrātā hariṃ naman ||59|| kurvaṃśca daṇḍavat prāha nijāṃ purīṃ suśobhanām | mantriṇāṃgāṃ pāvayituṃ nāmnā bālyarajo nṛpaḥ ||2.221.6 0|| haristathāstviti prāha cāṇḍajarāprapūjitaḥ | vidāyena yautakena saha samvanditaḥ prabhuḥ ||61 || mahīmānairyutaḥ śīghraṃ vimānamāruroha ca | rājānujo yayau sārdhaṃ vimānena tadāmbare ||6 2|| vidāyamānavādyāni cāvādyanta muhurmuhuḥ | prasasāra vimānaṃ ca hareragre’mbare tadā ||63|| rājño vimānaṃ purato yāti vai vegatastadā | mantriṇāṃgāṃ tu nagarīṃ prati cābdhyanumārgagam ||64|| sainyamāsīttatra yuktaṃ svāgatārthaṃ puraiva ha | tad dṛṣṭvā ca vimānaṃ vai sūryatulyaṃ mahojjvalam ||61|| svāgataṃ mānavāścakrurdhvajaiḥ patākikādibhiḥ | rājā hyavātarat pūrvaṃ tato harervimānakam ||66|| avātarat samudyāne mantriṇāṃgāsamīpataḥ | sammānaṃ tatra vai rājñī puraḥ sthitvā cakāra ha ||67|| vimānasthaṃ hariṃ natvā pupūja hārapuṣpakaiḥ | akṣataiścandanaiścāpi prakṣālya caraṇau papau || 68 | | rājasaudhe hariṃ nītvā vāsayāmāsa ceśvarī | ārārtrikaṃ cakārātha kanyaikā yuvatī satī | | 69 | | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya varamālikām | kaṇṭhe dadau tadā rājā mahotsavamakārayat | |2.221.7 0 | | bhojanaṃ pradadau bālakṛṣṇādibhyastataḥ param | āśvarathe niṣādyaiva bhrāmayāmāsa pattane | | 71 | | prajāḥ pupūjuḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhasvāminaṃ mudā | madhyāhne tu viśaśrāma haristāvannṛpaḥ svayam | | 72 | | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre bālakṛṣṇasya vai tadā | sāyaṃ vimānamāruhya babhrāma sāgarāmbare | | 73 | | tṛtīyāyāṃ tadā sāyaṃ netuṃ śrībālakṛṣṇakam | pātragonayarāṣṭreśo rāyasomanabhūpatiḥ | | 74| | nijaṃ deśaṃ pāvayituṃ netuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ samāyayau | harirvihṛtya cāvāsaṃ tvāyayau tatra bhūpatiḥ | | 75 | | neme rāyasomanaśca prārthayatparameśvaram | haristathāstviti prāha jalaṃ pītvā vimānakam | | 76 | | adhyāruroha śīghraṃ ca sarvasārthasamanvitaḥ | vāyumānanagarīṃ vai gantuṃ sajjo’bhavattadā | | 77 | | rājā vidāyaṃ pūjāṃ ca yautakaṃ pradadau mudā | vimānaṃ prairayat kṛṣṇo rāyasomanabodhitaḥ | | 78 | | śṛṇvan vidāyamānārthavādyāni bhagavān svayam | āyayau nagarīṃ divyāṃ vāyumānāṃ suśobhanām | | 79 | | nadītīrasthitāṃ ramyāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇo vimānakam | rājadarśitamārgeṇāvātārayannadītaṭe | | 2.221.80 | | tadā vādyānyavādyanta svāgataṃ bahudhābhavat | vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ puṣpākṣatādibhiḥ prajāḥ | | 81 | | harirvimānataścāyād bahiḥ svarṇāsane tadā | niṣasāda svayaṃ rājāpūjayat puṣpamālayā | |8 2 | | candanākṣatapuṣpādyaiḥ sugandhidravasecanaiḥ | rājñī pupūja ca prītyā nīrājanaṃ cakāra ha | | 83 | | rājā gaje niṣādyaiva bhrāmayāmāsa pattane | pradhānāḥ śrīhariṃ tatrānarcurgopuracatvare | | 84 | | mahāpathe samānarcuḥ śreṣṭhino dhaninastathā | rathyāmukheṣu nāryaśca sthānino gṛhasannidhau | | 85 | | pupūjuḥ śrīpatiṃ nāryo gītibhiḥ kīrtanaṃ jaguḥ | evaṃ hariṃ bhrāmayitvā nagaryāṃ ca nṛpo nije | | 86 | | mandire tvānayāmāsa rātrau kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | ārārtrikaṃ cakārāpi rājñī pupūja vastubhiḥ ||87|| tisraḥ kanyā hareḥ kaṇṭhe varamālāṃ nyadhustadā | patiṃ prāṇeśvaraṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyāśca tāḥ śubhāḥ ||88|| abhavan rādhike śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | bhojanāni tadā rātrau jagrāha sārthakānvitaḥ ||89|| āśvināsitatṛtīyarātrau viśrāntimāpa ca | siṣevire ca nāthaṃ svaṃ kanyāstisro’tibhāvataḥ ||2.221.90|| harirjagrāha vai nidrāṃ prātarbubodha maṃgalaiḥ | vādyaghoṣairgītibhiśca vedamantraiśca kīrtanaiḥ ||9 1 || sūtamāgadhabandīnāṃ praśaṃsāvākyakāvyakaiḥ | kṛtasnānāhnikaḥ kṛṣṇo vavande pitarau nijau ||92|| dugdhapānādikaṃ cakre caturthyāṃ prātareva saḥ | prajāstvāyayurīśeśapūjārthaṃ prātareva ha ||93 || rājā pupūja pūrvaṃ taṃ prajāścānarcuracyutam | tato dadau harirdravyaṃ bāladvijarṣaye dhanam ||94|| rāyasomananṛpatirbāladvijaṛṣistathā | santuṣṭau paramau jātau prajāstuṣṭāstathābhavan ||95|| hariścopādideśātha rādhike hitakṛttadā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’vatārakāraṇam ||96 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āntaḥprāgasthanagaryāmupadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇam āśvinakṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ prātarbālyarajonṛparāṣṭragamanaṃ mantriṇāṃgānagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ vidāyaṃ yautakaṃ sāyaṃ ca rāyasomananṛparāṣṭragamanaṃ vāyumānānagaryāṃ svāgataṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||22 1 ||
<2.222> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike śrībālakṛṣṇaścopādideśa tatprajāḥ | prātareva nṛpasaudhe viśāle hitakṛtprabhuḥ || 1 || rāyasomananṛpatiḥ śuśrāva sakuṭumbakaḥ | narā nāryaḥ pradhānādyāḥ sahasraśo’pi śuśruvuḥ || 2 || harau tyāgaḥ sadā kāryaḥ pravṛtteḥ karmaṇāṃ tathā | evaṃ tyāgī tu nairguṇyaṃ vindati mokṣasādhanam || 3 || tyāge yasya hutaṃ karma na tasya phaladaṃ bhavet | nirbandhān samparityajya rāgahīno bhavet sadā || 4 || aśokaṃ māṃ parabrahmātiṣṭhed yena mahatsukham | ajitaṃ tu jayet prājño manaḥ saṃgeṣvasaṃgataḥ || 5 || indriyairgṛhyate yat tat tyājyaṃ grāhyaṃ na bhāvataḥ | mano nigṛhya vai prāṇān dhārayet paramātmani || 6 || evaṃ dhāraṇayā syādvai nirvāṇaṃ śāśvataṃ sukham | sukhaṃ vai brahmaṇaḥ prāpyaṃ brahmārpaṇena sarvathā || 7 || satyaṃ brahma sadā grāhyaṃ cānṛtaṃ heyameva ca | anṛtaṃ tu tamaḥ proktamāndhyapradaṃ ca gartadam || 8 || vāsanārajjuyuktasya garte patanamāsthitam | avāsanasya tṛptasya prakāśo dhāmadaḥ smṛtaḥ || 9 || prakāśaṃ tu samālambya yateta duḥkhahānaye | tamonāśāya satataṃ satāṃ samāgamādibhiḥ || 2.222.1 0|| śārīrairmānasairvāpi duḥkhairnodvijate tu yaḥ | mama saṃgī sukhaṃ vetti sa eva mama mārgagaḥ || 11 || yatra duḥkhaṃ sa nirayaḥ sukhaṃ tu paramaṃ padam | tyaktaduḥkhasamārambhaḥ svargastasya na durlabhaḥ || 12|| brahmavratena doṣāṃśca dagdhvā jayetparaṃ padam | muktyāśramaṃ yaścarate muktabuddhirharipriyaḥ || 13 || sarvaṃ hutvā harau brahmalokaṃ janaḥ sa vindati | santaḥ sevyā brahmabhaktā brahmāptistena jāyate || 14|| ācāraniratāḥ santo mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ | pālyaḥ sadā śubhācāro gṛhasthairapi bhūtaye || 15 || śaucamāvaśyakaṃ kāryaṃ devānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā | pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ cāpi vṛddhānāṃ mānanaṃ tathā || 16 || sūryaṃ sadopatiṣṭheta sandhyākāle hariṃ smaret | śuciḥ kuryād bhojanaṃ ca na nindyānmānavādikān || 17|| devālayaṃ guruṃ sādhuṃ sādhvīṃ vṛṣaṃ catuṣpatham | dhārmikaṃ divyapuruṣaṃ nityaṃ kuryāt pradakṣiṇam || 18|| atithīnāṃ ca bhṛtyānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ bhojanādibhiḥ | anāthānāṃ copakāraṃ kuryācchakto bhavedyadi || 1 9|| dvivāraṃ caikavāraṃ vā bhojanaṃ nāntarā tu tat | evaṃ bhakṣayitā proktaścopavāsī sadā sukhī ||2.222.20 || yajñakārye pradātā ca ṛtau dānī na cānyathā | evaṃ dānto brahmacārī sadā bhavati śobhanaḥ || 21 || amṛtaṃ devabhuktaṃ vai pathyaṃ tathāmṛtaṃ matam | pāṃktaṃ grāhyaṃ yasya sosti devavanmānavaḥ sukhī || 22|| santastūpāsate devaprasādaṃ cāyuṣaḥ pradam | santaścopāsanīyā vai prasādakāmanāvatā || 23|| guroḥ sevā prakartavyā kartavyaṃ cābhivādanam | gurūnabhyarcya yujyante hyāyuṣā yaśasā śriyā || 24|| tīrthānāṃ guravastīrthaṃ śucīnāṃ guravaḥ śuciḥ | śiṣṭakṛtaṃ praśastaṃ tad gopucchaṃ pāvanaṃ sadā ||25|| darśane sparśane nityaṃ guruṃ sādhuṃ hi sevayet| | sādhorvai mastakaṃ keśāḥ romāṇi pāvanāni vai |||26 || satāṃ pādarajo mokṣapradaṃ pāpapraṇāśakam | sādhūnāṃ sparśanaṃ puṇyaṃ netre puṇye sadā mate ||27|| karṇau puṇyau hi sādhūnāṃ nāsā puṇyā sugandhinī | bhālaṃ vai tu satāṃ puṇyaṃ gaṇḍagālau hi puṇyakau ||28|| kapolau sarvathā puṇyau hāsyaṃ puṇyaṃ manoharam | dantā jihvā tathauṣṭhau ca puṇyadāḥ pāvanāḥ satām || 29|| kaṇṭhaḥ puṇyastathā śabdo vāṇī puṇyā sarasvatī | kathā puṇyā hi sādhūnāṃ puṇyadā saṃgatiḥ satām ||2.222.30|| skandhau puṇyau bāhuhastau puṇyau karāṃgulidhrajāḥ | nakhāḥ puṇyāśca rekhāśca prakoṣṭhaḥ puṇyadastathā ||3 1|| kaphoṇikā tathā cipīṭikā puṇyā satāṃ sadā | hastatale sadā puṇyaprade vakṣaśca puṇyakṛt ||32|| stanacihno sadā puṇyau nābhiḥ puṇyā ca pāvanī | udaraṃ puṇyakṛccāpi kaṭiḥ puṇyatamā satām || 33|| guptaṃ supāvanaṃ cāpi jaghanaṃ pāvanaṃ sadā | nitambau pāvanau cāpi sakthinī pāvane tathā ||34|| indriyāṇi pāvanāni jānū ca pāvanau sadā | jaṃghe pāvanakāriṇyau ghūṭike pāvane tathā || 35|| pattale caraṇau cāṃgulikā nakhāśca pāvanāḥ | tvaṅmāṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ divyaṃ divyaṃ tathāsthimaṇḍalam || 36 || majjā medo rasaścāpi pāvanā dhātavaḥ satām | śrīhareriva sādhūnāṃ sarve pāvanakārakam ||37|| trividhā bhagavatputrāḥ pāvanā bhagavāniva | santo vai bhagavatputrā dīkṣitāśca gṛhāśramāḥ || 38|| vaṃśodbhavāstathā putrāstrayaste pāvanottamāḥ | bhagavadbhaktisampannāsturyāste pāvanā api ||39|| dīkṣayā karmaṇā bhaktyā jñānena ca samanvitāḥ | santaḥ śrīharitulyāste pāvanā jagatāṃ matāḥ ||2.222.40|| tatprasādaḥ pāpahartā tajjalaṃ gāṃgato’dhikam | tatsevā pāpahā sarvā brahmārpaṇaṃ tadarpaṇam ||41|| sādhavo yaṃ tu vṛkṣādi spṛśanti taravo’pi te | divyā mokṣapradā loke jāyante pāpanāśakāḥ ||42|| yadvastraṃ dhāryate sadbhiḥ kārpāsaṃ vaurṇameva vā | kauśeyaṃ drutvaksvarūpaṃ divyaṃ tatpāvanaṃ sadā ||43|| paśuḥ pakṣī jano vānyaḥ sādhunā spṛṣṭa eva yaḥ | sa vai divyo bhavatyāśu bhūtapiṇḍo’pyalaukikaḥ ||44|| aśuddhaṃ jāyate śuddhaṃ sādhusparśena pāvanam | pāpaṃ pāpataraṃ vāpi sādhusparśād viśuddhyati ||45|| sādhunā yad dhṛtaṃ dehe tacchuddhaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || jalaṃ tīrthaṃ bhavatyāśu sādhunā sevituṃ tu yat| ||46|| pṛthvī satā sevitā ca tīrthībhūtā bhavatyati | patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ dhāryaṃ bhakṣyaṃ ca vāparam ||47|| yadyat sādhuprasaṃgaṃ vai prāptaṃ śuddhaṃ hi tanmatam | sādhusevī sadā śuddhaḥ sādhvī divyā harestanūḥ ||48|| vāhanaṃ cāsanaṃ vācyaṃ śuddhaṃ sādhuprasevitam | sāyaṃ prātaśca sādhūnāṃ pūjanaṃ svargamokṣadam |||49|| sādhusevā paro dharmaḥ sādhusevā dhanaṃ param | sādhusevā paraḥ kāmo mokṣo’pi sādhusevanāt ||2.222.50|| hṛdayaṃ sādhuvṛttānāṃ sādhutāṃ yāti sarvathā | sañcitaṃ sādhutādravyaṃ pade dhāmni sahāyadam ||51 || sādhutā sarvabhūtānāṃ śāntidā kṣemavāhinī | arjayet sādhutāṃ tasmād dhāmamārge sahāyinīm ||52|| devarṣipitṝṇāṃ yoniḥ sādhutā brahmasevinām | muktānāṃ sādhutā yonistāṃ seveta sadā budhaḥ ||53||| maraṇaṃ dhruvamevāsti kṛtaṃ bhuktaṃ gataṃ tu tat| | nūtanaṃ nārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati kimatsyasi ||54|| ityevaṃ samvicāryaiva puṇyapradā hi sādhavaḥ | sevanīyā hi satataṃ pitaro devatāstathā ||55|| sevāphalaṃ mahatsvargaṃ tvagre sthāsyati niścitam | prasannatāphalaṃ guroścāgre sthāsyati niścitam ||56|| iti nirṇīya satataṃ sevyantāṃ sādhavo’malāḥ | bhagavanmūrtayaḥ santi sādhavaḥ supratiṣṭhitāḥ ||57|| yasmāt sṛṣṭiriyaṃ jātā yato’vatārakoṭayaḥ | yasmādaiśvaryamāsādya jāyante ceśvarādayaḥ ||58|| ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā yamarcayanti nityaśaḥ | yataḥ sūryādayastejaḥpradhānāḥ saṃbhavantyapi ||59|| yato bhūtāni jāyante yasmāt hriyanta eva ca | indriyāṇi mano buddhiryasmājjātāni santi ca ||2.222.60 || tatra sākṣī sthito devaścetano’nukriyāparaḥ | taṃ niyamyāntare cāste yaḥ prabhuḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 61 || yena sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ vartate cāpiyāti ca | taṃ samāśritya deveśaṃ labhate śamamuttamam ||62|| tyaktvā vai prākṛtaṃ bhāvaṃ divyabhāvamupetya yaḥ | ātmaratirbhaved bhaktaḥ sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim ||63|| yathā vāricaraḥ pakṣī vāriṇā nahi lipyate | kṛtaprajñastathā loke sthitaścāpi na lipyate ||64|| iṣṭadevakṛpāprāptatuṣṭisantoṣavān naraḥ | aśocannaprahṛṣyeśca tiṣṭhate corṇanābhivat ||65|| vāsanākhyāṃ dṛḍhāṃ granthiṃ hṛdayasthāṃ nijātmanaḥ | vicchitvā sukhamāsīta paraṃdhāma sa cāpnuyāt ||66|| malino jalamādāya yathā śuddhati cāplutaḥ | tathā māyākaluṣo’pi śuddhiṃ yāti satāṃ grahāt ||67|| mahāraṇyasya pārajño na vai muhyati tatra vai | tathā māyāntavijñātā na vai tattveṣu muhyati ||68|| trivargo yasya viditaḥ prekṣya bhuktvā pramuñcati | abaddhasya nirīhasya brahmamārgaḥ prakāśate ||69|| viduṣāṃ na bhayaṃ cāsti tvajñānāṃ nirbhayaṃ na vai | ubhayeṣāṃ hareryoge cātyantikabhayaṃ na vai ||2.222.70|| yatkāryaṃ jāyate loke’nabhisandhiprapūrvakam | na tad bandhāya jāyeta priyaṃ vāpriyakaṃ samam ||71 || lokamāturamālokya sādhūṃścānāturām̐stathā | sādhuvṛttiṃ samāśritya māṃ bhajed yastareddhi saḥ ||72|| śocato naiva paśyedvai yena śoko na naśyati | aśocataḥ sadā paśyed yenāpyeta satāṃ sukham ||73 || satāṃ mārgānusāreṇa ye prayānti janāstviha | satāṃ gatiṃ labhante te prayānti paramaṃ padam ||74|| yatrāhaṃ satataṃ cāsmi virājito mahāhariḥ | anantakoṭimuktaiḥ saṃsevito dhyāta eva ca ||75 || ityuktvā rādhike’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | virarāma dadau mantrān vaiṣṇavān vai tadā svayam ||76|| rājā prajāḥ punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ pupūjurbahuvastubhiḥ | harirgantumiyeṣātha rājā dadau vidāyakam ||77|| yautakaṃ ca dadau śreṣṭhaṃ hariḥ sajjo babhūva ha | tāvattatra samāyāto rājārāyapatirnṛpaḥ ||78|| rājagirarṣisahitaḥ prārthayituṃ prabhuṃ harim | netuṃ svakīyabhavanam ārṣajatanurāṣṭrakam ||79|| vyenojarāśānagarīṃ parībhāsaritastaṭe | āvāsayituṃ satataṃ bhagavantaṃ tadārthayat ||2.222.80 || hariḥ kṛpāvaśastasmai tathāstviti nyavedayat | adya vai samayo nāsti gantavyaṃ tvadhare drutam ||8 1 || śvaḥ pañcamyāṃ bhaved yajñārambho brāhmīlarāṣṭrake | tasmād yajñaṃ samāpyaiva trayodaśyāṃ prage nṛpa ||||82|| bhavadrājye samāyāsye sāyaṃ naivātra saṃśayaḥ | bhavanmano’nusāreṇa sthāsye tavālaye’dhikam ||83|| bhavatā tu makhe tatrāgantavyaṃ pañcamīprage | ekādaśyāṃ tu madhyāhne samāptiḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ||84|| ityukto hariṇā bhūpaḥ svīcakāra harervacaḥ | pūjayitvā yayau naijaṃ rāṣṭraṃ tūrṇaṃ vimānagaḥ ||85|| atha rājā dvitīyo’pi samāyācchrīhariṃ prati | urugavākṣanṛpatiḥ rāyagrāmāpurīpatiḥ ||86|| urogamanarāṣṭreśaḥ prārthayatparameśvaram | mānatrivedaṛṣirāṭ prārthayaccāpi mādhavam ||87|| mama rāṣṭraṃ prajāścāpi pāvayāgatya keśava | haristathāstviti prāha sajjo vimānago’bhavat ||88|| sārthā vimānagāścāpyabhavam̐stadā prajājanāḥ | rājādyāśca vidāye vai janā nādān samūcire ||89 || bahuvādyānyavādyanta vimānaṃ cāmbare’bhavat | nataṃ prajājanaiḥ puṣpākṣatādyaiḥ pūjitaṃ tu khe ||2.222.90 || prasasāra tataścāgre urogamanarāṣṭrakam | āyayau śīghrameveti rājā hyavātarat puraḥ ||9 1 || sammānaṃ svāgataṃ cakre rāyagrāmāpurīpatiḥ | śṛṃgāritābhūnnagarī prāsādaḥ śobhito’bhavat ||92|| dhvajādyaiḥ patrakadalīstambhatoraṇasvastikaiḥ | kalaśai raṃgavallyādyairjalasecanakaistathā ||93 || evaṃvidhāyā puryāśca sannidhau sāgarāntike | vimānaṃ śrīharernaijaṃ saṃketenānayadbhuvam ||94|| tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāstathābhavan | bheryādyā nedire nārīgītayaścābhavan śubhāḥ ||95|| yantrīśabdā garjanāśca prajānāṃ harṣasadgiraḥ | abhavan svāgatārthaṃ vai vimānaṃ samavardhayan || 96|| prajāḥ puṣpākṣatādyaiśca haristvagre samāyayau | vanditaḥ pūjito rājñā rājñyā prajābhirityapi || 97|| niṣasāda śubhe svarṇāsane śrībhagavām̐stadā | rādhike stabakān hārān harergale dadau nṛpaḥ || 98|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pātragonayarāṣṭrīyaprajābhya upadeśanaṃ vidāyaṃ tato rājārāyapatirājyam ārṣajatanurāṣṭraṃ prati gamanaprārthanāṃ svīkṛtya tata urogamanarāṣṭraṃ prati gamanaṃ sammānanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ |||222||
<2.223> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike śrīhariṃ bhrāmayituṃ svapattane nṛpaḥ | rāyagrāmānagaryāṃ vai sainyaṃ sajjaṃ samānayat || 1 || hariṃ nyaṣādayattatra śvetāśvarathake śubhe | kuṭumbaṃ ca tathā kanyā brahmapriyā ratheṣu ca || 2 || vāditraninadairgītaiḥ saha kṛṣṇaṃ pure nṛpaḥ | abhrāmayat sukhaṃ tatra gopure tu pradhānakāḥ || 3 || pupūjuḥ paramātmānaṃ catvare śreṣṭhisattamāḥ | rathyāmukheṣu nāryaśca mārge haṭṭeṣu vai prajāḥ || 4 || suvarṇarūpyamudrābhiścandanākṣatakuṃkumaiḥ | ambaraiḥ puṣpahāraiśca nārikelaphalādibhiḥ || 5 || evaṃ bhramitvā nagarīṃ harī rājyālayaṃ yayau | urugavākṣanṛpatiḥ pupūja parameśvaram || 6 || cakre’bhiṣekaṃ payasā pādayoḥ paramātmanaḥ | tato miṣṭajalaiścāpi śuddhodakena vai tataḥ || 7 || papuḥ rājakuṭumbādyāḥ śrīhareścaraṇāmṛtam | rājñī pūjā cakārātha nīrājanaṃ vyadhādapi || 8 || kanyake dve tadā kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe mālāṃ tu kausumīm | varamālātmikāṃ dīrghāṃ dadatuḥ śobhanavrate || 9 || kṛtakṛtye tu te jāte prāpya kāntaṃ śriyāḥ patim | rājā rājñī ca menāte kṛtakṛtye tadā hṛdi || 2.223.1 0|| tadutsavaṃ tadā rājā kārayāmāsa śobhanam | bhojayāmāsa kṛṣṇaṃ ca mahīmānān samantataḥ || 11 || harirdravyaṃ dadau mānatrivedamunaye’khilam | tataścopādideśāpi prajābhyastatra mādhavaḥ || 12|| vṛttīnāṃ vilaye kṛṣṇo bhāsate hṛdaye sadā | dhyānagamyo bhavatyeva nārāyaṇapareśvaraḥ ||13|| dhyānayogena munayaḥ parāṃ siddhiṃ gatāḥ purā | gacchanti ca gamiṣyanti yoginaśca pare tathā || 14|| dhyānajñānamahātṛptā nirvāṇahṛdayā janāḥ | nāvartante hi saṃsāre muktāḥ saṃsārakardamāt ||15|| rāgadveṣaparityaktāścātmabhāve vyavasthitāḥ | nityasattvasthitā muktā nāvartante punaḥ kvacit || 16 || śāntipradāni karmāṇi saṃgahīnāni yāni ca | vādamāyārahitāni kurvanmāṃ yāti bhaktimān || 17|| prātarutthāya ca mano niyamya mama sannidhau | mama mūrtau dhārayedvai cintayet pratimāṃ mama || 18|| śabdaṃ sparśaṃ ca rūpaṃ vā rasaṃ gandhaṃ hyupasthitam | gṛhṇīyānnaiva maddhyātā cintayennānyavastukam || 1 9|| indriyāṇi manaḥ piṇḍīkṛtya mayi nirodhanam | kuryād yastasya manmūrtisphuraṇaṃ hṛdye bhavet ||2.223.20|| cañcale vai mano dhyāne mīnavad yadi jāyate | samādadhyātpunarmūrtau parāvṛttya prasahya tat ||2 1 || sabhūṣāmbaraveṣāḍhye mayi dhyānaṃ purā caret | tato veṣaṃ vilīyaiva mūrtimātraṃ vicintayet ||22|| tato divyaṃ hasantaṃ ca vadantaṃ māṃ vicintayet | tataścānandadātāraṃ tvekarūpaṃ vicintayet ||23|| evaṃ mūrtau cendriyāṇi mano’haṃkārabuddhayaḥ | vilīyante śanaiḥ premṇā tadā mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||24|| yogināṃ pragatiścaiṣā karmiṇāṃ nyāsalakṣaṇā | bahirvṛttānīndriyāṇi kṛṣṇārthāni samāni ca || 25|| arpitāni vidheyāni sarvārpaṇena karmibhiḥ | śuddhaḥ siddho mama bhaktaḥ sarvārpaṇena jāyate |||26 || śanairyatrendriyagrāmo vegalagno bhavatyapi | vijñāya viṣayaṃ taṃ ca mūrtau samparikalpayet ||27|| tatra tatra sthiraṃ cittaṃ kartavyaṃ tu śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | iṣṭaviṣayadānena tṛptaṃ sthairyaṃ vrajiṣyati || 28|| tatastaṃ viṣayaṃ mūrtau vilīya pratimāṃ mama | cintayettu śanairbhaktaścaivaṃ cireṇa śuddhyati || 29|| prasanne mama yogena citte sattvodbhavottamaḥ | tena sneho mama bhaktistena muktirbhavedanu ||2.223.3 0|| dhyānaṃ tapo damaṃ kṣāntiṃ vyāpāraṃ cintanādikam | vāṇīṃ ceṣṭāṃ gatiṃ sarvāṃ pravṛttiṃ mayi cārpayet || 31 || evaṃ pravartakaṃ yajñaṃ mayi tyaktvā sukhī bhavet | yadvā sarvavidheyāni pṛṣṭhe kṛtvā ca niṣkriyaḥ ||32|| bhūtvā pracintayenmāṃ vai manasā māṃ japet sadā | viṣayebhyo namaskuryād vyavahāraṃ na bhāvayet ||3 3 || hṛdyudbhāvya ca manmūrtiṃ tatra lagno bhavettataḥ | evaṃ madyogamāpannaścānte yāti paraṃ padam ||34|| sarvatyāgakṛtaścaivaṃ niricchasya tu yoginaḥ | brāhmyāstanvāḥ samavāptirmattulyo jāyate’kṣare ||35|| mama mūrtiṃ smarennityaṃ japennāma mamottamam | madarthaṃ tvācaret sarvaṃ mama lokamavāpnuyāt ||36 || brahmasthityā ca nirlipto bhūtvā māyāmayordhvagaḥ | amṛtaṃ cāmṛtapadaṃ parātmānaṃ prapadyate ||37|| prāptīnāmuttamaprāptiḥ pareśvararuciḥ sadā | satāṃ prāptirhareḥ prāptirdhāmaprāptirna cetarā || 38|| ahaṃkārakṛtā lokāḥ sarve nirayagāminaḥ | brahmakārakṛtā lokāḥ sarve tvakṣaragāminaḥ ||39|| ātmaghātī jano yāti nirayān yamarakṣitān | brahmasambandhamāpto vai nātmaghātī ca dhāmagaḥ ||2.223.40|| abhidhyānaṃ bhaved yatra pretabhāve ca tatra ca | jīvo yāti punarbhāvaṃ brahmābhidhyānamācaret || 41 || aiśvaryadhyānaparamo yāti māyāṃ tu sāttvikīm | punarbhāvapradāṃ tasmād brahmadhyānaparo bhavet ||42|| aiśvaryaiḥ samadhivyāpto madagarvādyadhiṣṭhitaḥ | vartate māyayā yaśca sa eva nirayo’sya vai ||43 || yasya tṛṣṇā yakṣiṇī ca rākṣasī ceṣaṇā sthitā | cintā piśācī yasyāsti tāstisro nirayātmikāḥ ||44|| rāgaśca rākṣaso yasya moho yakṣo’sti yasya ca | dveṣaḥ piśāco yasyāsti te trayo rauravātmakāḥ ||45|| trayo yatra bhavantyasya tatra tatropapadyate | durbuddhirjāyate taiśca tābhiśca mohavartanam ||46|| akṛtaprajñakastena mṛtyuṃ yāti hi rauravam | duṣprajñānena nirayā bahavo’tra bhavanti vai ||47|| yajjvālā dehinaścātra dāhayanti kṣaṇe kṣaṇe | nahyatṛptasya saukhyaṃ vai nirduḥkhaṃ samajāyate ||48|| duḥkhamiśraṃ sukhaṃ yattannirayākhyaṃ mataṃ tviha | māyā niraya evāsti nirduḥkhā na kadāpi sā ||49|| māyādehavataḥ saukhyaṃ naikāntātyantakaṃ na hi | tasmāt saukhyaṃ nirayātma vinākṣarapadaṃ dhruvam ||2.223.50||| varṇayāmi nirayān vai hyuccāvacān hi māyikān | prākṛtān layajuṣṭām̐śca brahmabhāve tu niṣphalān ||51|| mānavānāṃ tu saṃbhogā nirayā eva gocarāḥ | devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca saṃsthānāni gṛhāṇi ca ||52|| tādṛśā eva nirayā dehināṃ dehasaṃsthitāḥ | lokapānāṃ diśāpānāṃ grahāṇāṃ marutāṃ tathā ||53|| sādhyānāṃ viśvadevānāṃ gāndharvāṇāṃ gṛhāṇi ca | rudrādityavasūnāṃ ca siddhānāṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ ||54|| divyāni kāmacārāṇi vimānāni sabhālayāḥ | udyānāni ca padminyaḥ kāñcaneyagṛhāṇi ca ||55|| amṛtāni ca bhogāśca tejo’mbarāṇi yāni ca | samṛddhayaḥ surādīnāṃ dehāścāmṛtabhojinaḥ ||56|| divyāṃganā divyaśayyā divyagandharasādayaḥ | māyāpākā nirayāste brahmadhāmāgrato matāḥ ||57|| īśvarāṇāṃ virājānāṃ pradhānapuruṣasya ca | māyādhāmnāṃ ca ye bhogāḥ sattvamayāśca māyikāḥ ||58|| te sarve’pi mahattattvātmajā nirayasaṃjñakāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhāmāgrato matāḥ ||59|| golokasya tathā dhāmno vaikuṇṭhasya samīpataḥ | māyāmayāśca ye lokā bhogāste nirayā matāḥ ||2.223.60 || brahmalokasamaṃ nānyaddhāmāsti divyaśāśvatam | golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ brahmadhāmātmakaṃ hi tat ||6 1|| māyānirayaśūnyaṃ vai cāmāyikaṃ hi mokṣadam | ahaṃ śrīkṛṣṇarūpo’smi rādhādibhiḥ prasevitaḥ ||62|| goloke gopagopībhirmadrūpābhiḥ prasevitaḥ | divyaśāśvatarūpo’smi yatra māyā na vidyate ||63|| ahaṃ nārāyaṇarūpo vaikuṇṭhe parame sthitaḥ | lakṣmīramādibhirdivyābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ susevitaḥ ||64|| pārṣadairdivyarūpaiśca sevito divyaśāśvataḥ | divyaśāśvatarūpo’smi yatra māyā na vidyate ||65|| vāsudevasvarūpo’smi tvavyākṛte pare sthale | yatra māyā na cāstyeva so’haṃ divyasvarūpavān ||66|| evaṃ yatra mayā sthānaṃ kṛtaṃ divyaṃ hi tanmama | madyogād divyatāṃ prāptaṃ nirayastanna vidyate ||67|| madviyuktāni saudhāni sthānāni smṛddhayastathā | svāminaḥ sthāninaḥ sarve nirayā māyayā hatāḥ ||68|| ityevaṃ saṃvilokyaiva prajñayā matpradattayā | madyogaṃ sarvathā kuryānnirayatvaṃ vilīyate ||69|| divyatvaṃ prāpyate cāpi madarthayogatāṃ gatam | yatra me nāsti sambandhaścārpaṇātmaka ityapi ||2.223.70|| tatra sampadyate kālo matsambaddhe sa na prabhuḥ | ahaṃ kālasya śāstāsmi mayi pravartate na saḥ ||7 1 || yatrāhaṃ tatra bhakto me gatvā naiva hi śocati | īdṛśaṃ paramaṃ sthānaṃ brahmasambandhināṃ satām ||72|| tadbhinnāni tu nirayāḥ sarve eva yathāyatham | tadvicārya tu matimān matsambandhaṃ samācaret ||73|| jaḍaṃ vā cetanaṃ vāpi matsambaddhaṃ vidhāpayet | tadevānirayaṃ proktaṃ divyaṃ divyasuyogataḥ ||74|| evaṃ jñātvārpayitvaiva bhaktā me divyatāṃ gatāḥ | sṛṣṭau te naiva jāyante kālagrāse na yānti ca ||75|| aduḥkhaṃ sukhamāpyaiva vartante śāśvate sukhe | mamānande pare dhāmnyaśnuvate sarvakāmanāḥ ||76 || mama jāpaprakartāro mama mūrtiparāyaṇāḥ | amṛtāścāmṛtaṃ prāpya brahmabhūtā bhavanti te ||77|| brahmasthānamanāvarttamekamakṣarasaṃjñakam | aduḥkhamajaraṃ śāntaṃ prayānti mama yoginaḥ ||78|| sarāgaścekṣate lokān sarvānnirayasaṃjñikān | madyuktaḥ sarvato mukto’kṣare tu ramate sukham ||79|| naikadhā mama mūrtau sa ramate ca mayā sadā | mamānandabhṛto mukto matto nyūno na vartate ||2.223.80 || ityevaṃ copadiśyaiva tato mantrān dadau hariḥ | prajābhyaśca nṛpasyāpi kuṭumbāya nṛpāya ca ||8 1 || atha kṛṣṇo manaścakre gantuṃ rājā tadā punaḥ | dravyaṃ ca yautakaṃ cāpi vidāyaṃ bahudhā dadau ||82|| vādyaghoṣaiḥ prajādvārā sammānaṃ bahudhā vyadhāt | tāvat tatra samāyāto rājā parāṅvratābhidhaḥ ||83|| alaṃtrātarṣisahitaścāśanāpurīśvaraḥ | pārāvātarāṣṭrapatiḥ prārthayatparameśvaram ||84|| mama deśān samāgatya pāvayāsmān kṛpālaya | hariḥ śrutvā tathāstvāha sajjo’bhūt sakuṭumbakaḥ ||85|| śīghraṃ pūjāṃ parigṛhya tadā vimānago’bhavat | brahmapriyādyāḥ kanyāśca ṛṣayo’pyakhilāstadā ||86|| vimānasthā abhavam̐śca vimānaṃ prasasāra ha | vegena cāgataṃ pārāvātarāṣṭraṃ tadā nṛpaḥ ||87|| parāṅvrato hi sahasāmbarāt pūrvamavātarat | svāgataṃ nijasainyena śrīharestu samācarat ||88|| tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayanādāstathābhavan | prajāḥ svāñjalibhiḥ susthāḥ svāgataṃ vai samācaran ||89|| rājadarśitamārgeṇāvātarad vai vimānakam | udyāne subhage cāśāsanāpuryāḥ samīpage || 2.223.90|| hariṃ dṛṣṭvā prajā rājā rājñī prādhānikāstathā | anye’pi cāgatāḥ sarve svāgataṃ namanaṃ vyadhuḥ ||9 1 || rājā pupūja puṣpādyaiḥ svarṇahāraiḥ sumauktikaiḥ | rājñī nīrājanaṃ cakre hariṃ nyaṣādayattataḥ ||92|| gaje svarṇāmbālikayā yute cānyān rathādiṣu | āśāsanānagaryāṃ tu bhrāmayāmāsa mādhavam || 93|| pupūjurmānavāḥ sarve sāyaṃ ratnāmbarādibhiḥ | dravyasauvarṇamudrābhiḥ puṣpākṣatasragādibhiḥ ||94|| bhrāmayitvā rājasaudhaṃ tvānayāmāsa keśavam | pūjayāmāsa ca punarbhojayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ ||95|| tataḥ kanyādvayaṃ rājño mātrājñayā pareśvaram | pupūja ca hariṃ vavre patiṃ ca varamālayā | |96|| kaṇṭhe samarpya mālāṃ te kanyake tvarpite tadā | abhavatāṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇe sarveśe parameśvare ||97|| rājā mumoda hṛdaye rājñī prasannatāmagāt | kṛtakṛtye kanyake ca jāte nṛpo mahotsavam ||98|| kārayāmāsa vai rātrau hariścopādideśa ha | rādhike rājasaudhe vai sarveṣāṃ mokṣasādhanam ||99|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne hareḥ rāyagrāmānagaryāṃ bhramaṇam upadeśanaṃ pūjanaṃ vidāyaṃ tataḥ parāṅvratanṛpasya pārāvātarājye gamanam āśāsanāpuryāṃ svāgataṃ āśvinakṛṣṇacaturthyāṃ sāyaṃ bhramaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayoviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 223 ||
<2.224> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike bhagavānāha sarvāḥ prajā nṛpādikān | śvo’sti yajño mahān śreṣṭho brāhmīle rāṣṭrake śubhe || 1 || yajño yatra bhavatyeva deśaḥ sa puṇyado bhavet| | yajño nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt sa cāsmi puruṣottamaḥ || 2 || ahaṃ yajñena satataṃ prasannastṛptimemi hi | mayyarpitāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā yajña eva na saṃśayaḥ || 2 || nahi khalvanupāyena kaścidartho’pi siddhyati | yajñakāryeṇa yajño’yaṃ siddhyāmīha na saṃśayaḥ || 4 || mṛgairmṛgāṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ pakṣiṇāṃ pakṣibhiryathā | gajānāṃ ca gajairevaṃ yajño yajñena gṛhyate || 5 || yathā candro hyamāyāṃ vai hyaliṃgatvānna dṛśyate | tathāhaṃ hṛdi kaluṣe dṛśyo bhavāmi naiva ha || 6 || yathā pūrṇāṃ tithiṃ prāpya bhrājate candramāstathā | bhaktipūrṇāṃ matiṃ prāpya vibhrāje’haṃ pareśvaraḥ || 7 || rāhugrasto’pyapi candro jāyate viprakāśakaḥ | māyāgrasto’pi jīvātmā viprakāśaḥ prajāyate || 8 || abuddhiścākṛtaprajñastvākṛṣyate bahirmukhaḥ | viṣayeṣu kṛtāvāsaḥ kadāpi nahi tṛpyati || 9 || atṛptasya na vai śāntiraśāntasya na vai sukham | asukhasya na vai mokṣaḥ punarnirayagāmitā || 2.224.1 0|| viṣayāścaiko nirayaścendriyāṇi dvitīyakaḥ | manastṛtīyo nirayo vāsanā tu turīyakaḥ || 11 || karmāṇi pañcamaścāpi ṣaṣṭho nirayo durguṇāḥ | saptamastu gṛhe kleśaścāṣṭamaśca daridratā || 12| navamo nirayo rogo daśamaḥ paravaśyatā | ekādaśaścāpakīrtirdvādaśo buddhihīnatā || 1 3|| trayodaśaḥ kuṭumbādiścaturdaśastu bhṛtyatā | pañcadaśo vyaṃgatā ca śatravaḥ ṣoḍaśo’pi saḥ || 14|| saptadaśastu vai sākṣād deho nirayasaṃjñakaḥ | aṣṭādaśo vikārāśca dehajā nirayā ime || 15|| ityevaṃ nirayā loke saṃlagnā dehināmiha | yajñena yajñamāsādya nirnirayagato bhavet || 16|| yāvat kalmaṣamāste vai tṛṣāchedo na tāvatā | nivartate tadā tṛṣā kalmaṣānto bhaved yadā || 17|| viṣayeṣu tu saṃsargāt tarṣo vivardhate sadā | viṣayāṇāṃ virāgeṇātarṣo jñānena vardhate || 18|| jñānādarśe nijātmānaṃ śuddhaṃ paśyati paśyakaḥ | indriyāṇāṃ niyamena sukhī bhavati mānavaḥ || 1 9|| indriyebhyaśca rūpebhyo yacchedātmānamātmanā | vimuñcetprākṛtān grāmān matsthito’mṛtamaśnute ||2.224.20|| praṇītaṃ karmaṇā mārgaṃ bhuktvā tyaktvāthavā mayi | svargaṃ vā śāśvataṃ svargaṃ maddhāma paramaṃ labhet || 21 || ātmā tyājyaguṇairhīno yadā mayi pravartate | tadā sampadyate dhāma brahmalokaṃ mamāśrayam ||22|| ākṛtayo vilīnāḥ syuḥ samanobuddhivṛttayaḥ | yadātmani brahmarūpe parabrahma prakāśate || 23 || āgataṃ viṣayaṃ duḥkhaṃ cintayenna nivartate | bhaiṣajyametattyāgasya yadeteṣāṃ na cintanam ||24|| anityaṃ jīvanaṃ dravyaṃ priyayogo gṛhādikam | kālabhakṣaṃ vicāryaitanna gṛdhyettatra cātmavit || 25|| duḥkhaṃ tyaktaṃ bhavettatra sukhaṃ yadviṣayodbhavam | duḥkhamiśraṃ ca tadapi duḥkhabahulamityapi ||26||| vicāryobhayamevāpi tyajedabhyeti māṃ hi saḥ | yadātmanā bhaved bhaktirbrahmabhāve’timāyike ||27|| tadā prajñāyate brahma labhyate ca samādhinā | brahmabhāvaṃ ca nikaṣā gato dhyānamavāpnuyāt ||28|| dhyāto’haṃ cāsya vai dhyātrā cārohāmi tadantaram | sarvadvāraniruddhasya prakāśe’haṃ tadātmani ||29|| guṇānāṃ vilayastasyānāyāsena prajāyate | aguṇo divyaguṇavān madrūpaḥ sa prajāyate || 2.224.30 || saguṇāḥ prakṛtau sarve pravartante śarīriṇaḥ | svargayogyāśca te sarve nirguṇāstu madarhaṇāḥ || 31 || yāvadasya vartate’tra bhūtāveśo’tikaṣṭadaḥ | tāvadasya khaniścāste duḥkhasaṃsāravastujā ||32||| yāvadasya ca bhūtānāṃ viyogo jāyate bhṛśam | sūkṣmāṇāṃ cāpi hetūnāṃ brahma sampadyate tadā |||33|| dharmād bhaktervirāgāccotkṛṣyate śreya ātmanā | śreyasāḍhyo hariṃ caiti mā paraśreyasāṃ nidhim ||34|| yathā sāmyarasā bhūmirbhinnabījarasānugā | tathā sāmyarasaścātmā bhinnakarmajadehagaḥ || 35|| yathā svarṇaṃ lohamiśraṃ vahninā śodhitaṃ bhavet | tathā dehī mama bhaktyā prajñayā śodhito bhavet ||36|| prajñā purāṇī maddattā śodhitasya prakāśate | prajñāsṛtiṃ samālambya bhaktimān māṃ prapadyate ||37|| prajñānāṃ cāpi bhaktīnāṃ phalaṃ me divyadarśanam | aprajñāścāpyabhaktāśca taṃ māṃ paśyanti naiva ha ||38|| karmibhyaḥ sāttvikāḥ śreṣṭhāstato’pi śuddhasattvajāḥ | tebhyaḥ kālo mamaśaktirbalavān sarvabhakṣakaḥ ||39|| kālātparaṃ tu me dhāmākṣaraṃ divyaṃ nivāsanam | nādirnamadhyaṃ naivāntastasya dhāmnaḥ pravidyate ||2.224.40|| janmamṛtyujarājanyaṃ duḥkha yatra na vidyate | tad brahma paramaṃ sthānaṃ taddhāma paramaṃ padam ||41 || kālamūrdhni padaṃ dhṛtvā madbhaktā yānti tatpadam | nivṛttilakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ śubhaṃ madarpaṇātmakam ||42|| samāśritya prayāntyeva tato’nantaṃ parākṣaram | na yatnasādhyaṃ tadbrahma śabdabrahma samaṃ matam ||43|| kṛpāsādhyaṃ hi tadbrahma parabrahmaprasajjakam | pāpāt sādhanavirahādāsakteḥ karmabandhanāt ||44|| martyā naiva prapaśyanti svarūpaṃ nirmalaṃ nijam | viṣayeṣu tu viśrāntermamāhaṃkārabhāvanāt ||45|| balāttṛṣṇāpravāhasya brahma nātmā prapadyate | satāṃ prasevanād dhyānānmanmūrterbhaktibhāvanāt ||46|| brahmābhyāsāt pravairāgyāt snehād brahma prakāśate | guṇamiṣṭaṃ prapaśyanti miṣṭatṛṣṇāparāhatāḥ ||47|| paraṃ naivābhikāṃkṣanti cāmṛtottamamācyutam | avaraiśca guṇairyuktā naiva paśyanti pāragān ||48|| apāragā muhuścātra vicālyante’ṇḍarāśiṣu | satāṃ yogena bahavaḥ para pāraṃ gatāḥ purā ||49|| santaścaranti satataṃ śreyomārgajuṣāṃ puraḥ | yadi nāmāśrayante cet pārameṣyanti satvaram ||2.224.50|| āśīrvādātpuṇyabalāt sevāphalāt sukarmaṇaḥ | cedāśritāstadā yanti tūrṇaṃ brāhmīṃ tanuṃ śubhām ||5 1 || dhyātṝṇāṃ sevināṃ snigdhabhaktānāṃ brahmavartinām | sanātanī gatiryāsti tāmamṛtāṃ prayānti te ||52|| ityupādiśya ca kṛṣṇo virarāma pareśvaraḥ | jalapānādikaṃ kṛtvā suṣvāpa bhagavān prabhuḥ ||53|| kanyakāsevitaḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prage | prabubodha suvādyādyairmaṃgalairgītibhistataḥ ||54|| kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtapūjaḥ śīghraṃ gantumiyeṣa ha | rājā vidāyaṃ pradadau yautakaṃ pradadau tathā ||55|| svasārthasahitaḥ sajjo babhūva brāhmasaṃjñake | muhūrtaṃ śrīhariḥ samāruroha ca vimānakam ||56 || tadā tūryāṇyavādyanta prajāśca mānanaṃ vyadhuḥ | vardhitaḥ śrīharirdravyaṃ cālaṃtrātarṣaye dadau ||57|| śṛṇvan yaśo nijaṃ vyomni vimānaṃ cairayad drutam | āśvīnakṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ prātareva makhasthalīm |||58|| brāhmīlarāṣṭre goyājānagaryāḥ sannidhau śubhe | āmrajānikanadyāstu taṭe śīghraṃ samāgamat ||59|| vimānaṃ vai tadā jātaṃ sūryasahasrasatprabham | pratīkṣamāṇāḥ ṛṣayo rājādyāśca prajājanāḥ ||2.224.60|| vimānamāgataṃ vīkṣya dudruvuḥ svāgatasthalīm | viśāle bhūtale nadyāstīre’saṃkhyajanāśrite ||6 1 || sthirībhūtā janāḥ svasthāḥ, avātarad vimānakam | jayaśabdāḥ prajānāṃ vai gaganaprasarāstadā ||62|| abhavam̐stūpaśabdaśca yantrīśabdāḥ sumānadāḥ | pratidhvanayo dhvanijāḥ pratineduḥ samantataḥ ||63|| gītayo yoṣitāṃ cāpyaśrūyanta harṣasaṃbhṛtāḥ | vādyānāṃ ca vicitrā vai dhvanayo’pyabhavam̐stadā ||64|| śaṃkhanādāśca parito bigūlānāṃ ninādakāḥ | abhavanmaṃgalaghoṣā viprāṇāṃ tvāgate harau ||65|| vimānaṃ vardhitaṃ cāpi rājanyaiḥ samprapūjitam | surairdevagaṇaiścāpi kusumāñjalikārpitam ||66|| candanaiḥ prokṣitaṃ tilakitaṃ kuṃkumacandritam | namaskṛtaṃ vanditaṃ sammānitaṃ cāpi bhāvanaiḥ ||67|| śrīhariśca vimānādvai kṣaṇamātraṃ bahiryayau | tadā hārān hareḥ kaṇṭhe dadurmaharṣayastathā ||68|| lomaśastilakaṃ cakre śaṃbhuḥ puṣpasrajaṃ dadau | īśānapānaśiṣṭaśca rājā svarṇasrajaṃ dadau ||69|| śāntārāmaṛṣiḥ kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe vṛndāsrajaṃ dadau | atha pitrośca caraṇau pūjayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ ||2.224.70 || brahmapriyāṇāṃ pūjāṃ ca cakāra rājapatnikāḥ | rājakanyāstathā pūjāṃ cakrurvai sarvayoṣitām ||71|| lālāyano maharṣiśca tuṣito devasattamaḥ | svīyaprakāśo bhagavām̐ścaite prāhuḥ pareśvaram ||72|| maṇḍapaṃ ca kratoḥ kuṇḍaṃ samitkuśādihavyakam | janāvāsān bhakṣyabhojyān drutaṃ vilokaya prabho |||73 || bhavadājñānusāreṇa sarvaṃ samupatiṣṭhate | nyūnaṃ na vidyate kiñcid dṛṣṭyā pāvaya sarvataḥ ||74|| ityarthitaḥ śrībhagavān janāvāsān suvīkṣitum | viṃśatiyojanabhūsthān yayau vimānago drutam ||75|| āmantraṇena patreṇa yajñamaṃgalabodhinā | samāgatān mahāmuktānakṣaraṃ brahma dṛṣṭavān ||76|| muktānīśca brahmasatīrdṛṣṭavān makhamāgatāḥ | aiśvaryāṇi samastāni guṇān sarvān sumūrtikān ||77|| ābhūṣaṇāni sarvāṇi hetīn sarvān samūrtikān | dṛṣṭavān bhagavān naijāvatāraṃ kṛṣṇamityapi ||78|| rādhādibhiḥ sahāyātaṃ gopagopīgavānvitam | nārāyaṇaṃ ramayā śrīkamalābhyāṃ ca līlayā ||79|| bhūlakṣmītūlasīvṛndāpadmādibhiḥ samanvitam | pārṣadaiḥ pārṣadānībhiḥ sahitaṃ dṛṣṭavān prabhuḥ ||2.224.80|| vāsudevādikān vyūhān pradhānapuruṣādikān | mahākālādisamayān bhūmānaṃ dṛṣṭavām̐stathā ||8 1 || mahāviṣṇuṃ ca vairājaṃ brahmādidevatātrayam | saśaktikaṃ tathā māyāṃ tattvayuktāṃ ca dṛṣṭavān ||82|| siddhāṃśca yoginaḥ sarvān maharṣīn pitṛdevatāḥ | surān sureśvarān lokaprapālān dikprapālakān ||83|| sāttvikān rājasām̐ścāpi tāmasān dṛṣṭavān prabhuḥ | rudrān vasūn tathādityānaśvinau marutastathā ||84|| vidyādhrān devagandharvān diśo bhuvarnivāsinaḥ | sāgarān sarito vṛkṣān vallīstṛṇāni dṛṣṭavān ||85|| tīrthāni kāmadhenvādyāḥ svarān vedān guṇādikān | khanīn bhūdhrān mānavām̐śca nṛpān strīśca narān prajāḥ ||86 || grahān nakṣatratārāśca sthāvarān cāṇḍajām̐stathā | jarāyūjān svedajām̐ścodbhijjakān dṛṣṭavām̐stathā ||87|| yakṣarākṣasabhūtādīn gaṇān gaṇeśvarām̐stathā | yajñadevān samastām̐śca mātṛkā devikāstathā ||88|| yoginīrbrahmasarasaścāpsaraso’pi sarvaśaḥ | ārṣīrvidyādharīścāpi śaktīśca sāṃkhyayoginīḥ ||89|| vahnīn sarvavidhām̐ścāpi kāśyapīśca prajāstathā | talalokanivāsām̐śca yakṣarākṣasadānavān || 2.224.90 || daityān nirannamuktām̐śca tāpasān ṛtvijastathā | makhīyānmānavām̐ścāpi gāyakān yajamānakān ||9 1|| hotṝṃśca jāpakām̐ścāpi mahīmānān dadarśa saḥ | ghṛtakulyā dadhikulyāstakranirjharaṇām̐stathā ||92|| payohradānāmamṛtānāṃ sarito’pi dadarśa saḥ | kaṇamiṣṭānnaśālyādiparvatān phalasañcayān ||93|| nārikelādikān śuṣkasarasārdrān dadarśa saḥ | sādhanāni rasaśālāḥ patnīśālā dadarśa saḥ || 94|| yūpaśālā havyaśālā devaśālā dadarśa saḥ | sarvaṃ sampūrṇameveti copasthitaṃ vilokya ca ||95|| lomaśaṃ viśvakarmāṇaṃ lālāyanaṃ ca śaṃkaram | svīyaprakāśaṃ cānyāṃśca maharṣīn praśaśaṃsa saḥ ||96|| samāgatān bhūmipālān dṛṣṭavān makhakarmaṇe | amarībhūpradeśānāṃ rāśiyānabhuvāṃ tathā ||97|| ketumālapradeśānāṃ prācīnoṣṇabhuvāṃ tathā | prāgjyotiṣāṃ cājanābhapradeśānāṃ ca bhūpatīn ||98|| āntarabhūpradeśānāmabriktāraktasaṃbhuvām | dvīpātidvīpalokānāṃ bhūpatīn dṛṣṭavān prabhuḥ ||99|| alabdhamakhalābhām̐śca dṛṣṭavān sa viśeṣataḥ | dakṣāmarīpradeśānāṃ bhūpatīn yajñayoginaḥ || 2.224.10 0|| nṛpaṃ kālīmaṇḍalīnaṃ vanajeleśabhūpatim | pārāvārapibaṃ bhūpaṃ koṭīśvaraṃ nṛpaṃ tathā || 101 || śrīsatīśaṃ ca rājānaṃ tretākarkaśabhūpatim | parāṅvrataṃ nṛpaṃ rājārāyapatiṃ ca dṛṣṭavān || 1 02|| rāyasomanarājaṃ ca tathāṇḍajarabhūpatim | bālyarajonṛpaṃ corugavākṣaṃ bhūbhataṃ tathā || 103 || īśānapānaśiṣṭaṃ ca sapatnīkaṃ sa dṛṣṭavān | sarvān patnyādisahitān dakṣāmarīpradeśajān || 1 04|| nṛpānāha mahākṛṣṇo yajamānā bhavantviti | omityaṃgīkṛtaṃ taiśca parameśavacaḥ śubham || 105|| evaṃ saṃbhāvayitvaiva mahīmānān makhāgatān | nyūnaṃ pradāpayitvaiva drutaṃ naijālayaṃ yayau || 1 06|| tāvad vādyānyavādyanta kratormuhūrtavittaye | sajjā bhūtvā maṇḍape ca drutaṃ samāyayurjanāḥ || 1 07|| muktāstathāvatārādyā īśvarāḥ siddhasattamāḥ | ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā deveśā devavaśyagāḥ || 1 08|| devyo devīvaśinyaśca mānavā daityadānavāḥ | kāśyapyaśca prajāḥ sarvāḥ sthāvarā jaṃgamāstathā || 1 09|| makhārthā makhakartāraḥ karmaṭhāḥ sādhanāni ca | mantrāśca havyakavyāni sarvaṃ copasthitaṃ makhe || 2.224.11 0|| rādhike maṃgale śreṣṭhe kṣāme kāryamavartata | śrīharirmaṇḍapaṃ cāyāt sarvaprayojyapūjitaḥ || 111 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pārāvātarāṣṭraprajādibhya upadeśanaṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ vidāyam, āśvinakṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ brāhmīlarāṣṭre makhasthalīṃ prati cāgamanaṃ, mahīmānādīnāṃ saṃbhāvanā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 224 ||
<2.225> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca yajñasya ca śubhe śreṣṭhe muhūrte rādhike prage | ṛṣayo devatāścāpi yajñamaṇḍapamāyayuḥ || 1 || gṛṇantaḥ śrīharernāma vadanto vedakāṇḍikāḥ | japantaśca vedabhuvaṃ hṛṣṭā maṇḍapamāyayuḥ || 2 || devā deveśvaraḥ sākṣād brahmādyā īśvareśvarāḥ | īśāḥ pradhānāḥ patnyaśca devyaśca pārṣadādayaḥ || 3 || sākṣādvai maṇḍape tatrāyayurharṣabhṛto makhe | sāmagryaścāpi havyāni mūrtimanti śubhāni ca || 4 || āsanāni sādhanāni samidhaśca samāyayuḥ | dhvajaḥ sākṣād ghaṭaḥ sākṣāt sākṣāttathaiva maṇḍapaḥ || 5 || makhaḥ sākṣād vedikāśca sākṣāt sākṣācca yūparāṭ | kuṇḍaḥ sākṣād vāstupumān sākṣādvai samupāgataḥ || 6 || vedāḥ sākṣād vidhayaśca sākṣānmantrāḥ samāyayuḥ | sākṣāt suviniyogāśca kuśā darbhāḥ samāyayuḥ || 7 || sākṣāt pātrāṇi caravo vahnayaśca samāyayuḥ | samastopakaraṇāni tvāyayurmaṇḍape tadā || 8 || svastaścaya samayaśca deśaḥ puṇyāha āyayuḥ | evaṃ tīrthāni bhaumāni pañcāmṛtāni cāyayuḥ || 9 || upasthitāḥ samastāśca tanmakhe kāmadhenavaḥ | kalpalatāḥ kalpavṛkṣāścintāmaṇaya āyayuḥ || 2.225.1 0|| sarvāṇyakṣayapātrāṇi kalpāpūrakapeṭikāḥ | akṣayāḥ kośanidhayaścāmṛtāni samāyayuḥ || 11 || rasāśca phalajātāni patrapuṣpākṣatādayaḥ | mūrtimanto makhe tatra rādhike vai samāyayuḥ || 1 2|| viniyogānusāreṇa viniyujyanta eva te | lakṣmyaḥ sarvāśca vidyāśca satyaḥ sarvāśca siddhayaḥ || 1 3||| camatkārāstathā siddhāstatra yajñe samāyayuḥ | madhuparkāḥ sarvavidhāḥ sarve pakvānnaparvatāḥ || 14|| peyavastūni mūrtāni sākṣāt sarve sugandhakāḥ | svarṇarūpyakamudrāśca sākṣādgavyāni cāyayuḥ || 15|| evaṃ yāvatsu sākṣādvai hyupasthiteṣu maṇḍape | brāhmaṇānāṃ maṃgalāni yoṣitāṃ gītayo’bhavan || 16|| svastivāco’bhavam̐statra viprāṇāṃ sarvamaṃgalāḥ | deśakālādisaṃkalpo’kārayallomaśo muniḥ || 17|| maṇḍape yajamānaśca īśānapānaśiṣṭakaḥ | rājā ca dampatīrūpo mukhyastatra vidhiṃ śubham || 18|| ṛṣiṇā preritaścakre tathānyanṛpamaṇḍalam | maṇḍape kuṇḍasānnidhye’nukalpavidhimācarat || 1 9|| pradhānākhyaṃ ca saṃkalpaṃ lomaśaḥ samakārayat | digrakṣāṃ ca kalaśasyārādhanāṃ pracakāra ca ||2.225.20|| gaṇeśasya sthāpanaṃ ca pūjanaṃ cāpyakārayat | svastivācaśca puṇyāhavācanaṃ pracakāra ca ||21 || yajamānādyabhiṣekaṃ lomaśaḥ samakārayat | mātṛkāṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ ca pūjanaṃ samakārayat ||22|| nāndīśrāddhaṃ tathācāryādīnāṃ varaṇamityapi | arghavandanamevāpi madhuparkamakārayat ||23|| vardhanīkalaśasyāpi sthāpanaṃ cāpyakārayat | maṇḍape saṃpraveśaṃ ca maṇḍapaprokṣaṇādikam ||24|| vāstusthāpanamevāpi vāsudevaprapūjanam | maṇḍapasyārcanaṃ tatra sarvatobhadramaṇḍale ||25 || devānāṃ sthāpanaṃ pūjāmakārayaddhi lomaśaḥ | yantradevasthāpanaṃ ca devānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā || 26||| pīṭhasya pūjanaṃ vedīpūjanaṃ kuṇḍapūjanam | kuṇḍadevārhaṇaṃ cāpi kuṇḍe’gnisthāpanaṃ tathā ||27|| grahāṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ pūjāṃ yoginīsthāpanādikam | kṣetrapānāṃ sthāpanaṃ ca pūjanaṃ cāpyakārayat |||28|| kuṇḍe ca mekhalādīnāṃ pūjanaṃ devapūjanam | agneḥ pūjanamevāpi grahāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ||29|| anvādhānasya saṃkalpaṃ lomaśarṣirakārayat | āghārājyabhāgahomaṃ lomaśo’kārayattadā |||2.225.3 0 || vāstumaṇḍaladevārthaṃ yoginyarthaṃ havaṃ tathā | pradhānahomaṃ tatrāpi vyāhṛtihomamācarat ||3 1 || balidānaṃ sunaivedyaṃ dadau vai lomaśo muniḥ | yūpāropaṇamevāpi tato jalādhivāsanam ||32|| jalamātṛjalapūjāṃ śaṃkhaghaṇṭādipūjanam | bhūtaśuddhiṃ tathā prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ cāpyakārayat || 33 || sauvarṇapratimāpūjāṃ bālakṛṣṇasya cācarat | ṣoḍaśopacārapūjāṃ carunaivedyamārpayat ||34|| sahasrāhutikāścāpi sarvahomamakārayat | idaṃ muktebhyo namama samarpayāmi bhojanam ||35|| idaṃ brahmaṇe namama samarpayāmi bhojanam | muktānībhya idaṃ namama samarpayāmi bhojanam ||36|| avatārebhyo namama idaṃ dadāmi bhojanam | avatāriṇībhya idaṃ dade namama bhojanam || 37|| guṇaiśvaryavibhūtibhya idaṃ namama bhojanam | bhūṣāhetipraśaktibhya idaṃ namama bhojanam || 38|| īśvarebhyaśceśvarāṇībhyo namama bhojanam | vyūhebhyaḥ pārṣadādibhya idaṃ namama bhojanam || 39|| brāhmībhyaśca satībhyaśca idaṃ namama bhojanam | brahmapriyābhyaḥ sarvābhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ||2.225.40 || rādhālakṣmyādiśaktibhya idaṃ namama bhojanam | māṇikyādisatībhyaśca idaṃ namama bhojanam ||41 || gaṃgāsarasvatīśrībhya idaṃ namama bhojanam | dāsadāsīsametābhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ||42|| mahāviṣṇuhiraṇgarbhavirāḍbhyo bhojanaṃ namaḥ | brahmaviṣṇumaheśebhyo nama idaṃ ca bhojanam ||43 || sāvitrīkamalādurgādibhyo namama bhojanam | kaṃbharāyai mahālakṣmyai idaṃ namama bhojanam |||44|| santuṣṭāyai cāmṛtāyai idaṃ namama bhojanam | padmāvatyai ramāyai ca idaṃ namama bhojanam ||45|| maṃjulāsadguṇāhāsāmbābhyo namama bhojanam | bālakṛṣṇāṃganāduḥkhahālakṣmyādibhya ityapi ||46|| bhojanaṃ sarvapatnībhyaḥ siddharṣibhya idaṃ namama | idaṃ pitṛbhyo namama pitṛkābhyaśca bhojanam ||47|| ārṣībhyo bhojanaṃ cedaṃ surebhyo bhojanaṃ namama | surāṇībhyaśca devībhyo devatābhyaśca bhojanam ||48|| dikpālebhya idaṃ lokapālebhyo bhojanaṃ namaḥ | ādityebhyaśca rudrebhya idaṃ cedaṃ ca bhojanam ||49|| vasubhyaścāśvinībhyāṃ ca idam idaṃ ca bhojanam | digbhyaścāpi ca tattvebhya idam idaṃ ca bhojanam ||2.225.50|| nidhibhyaśca gṛhebhyaśca idam idaṃ ca bhojanam | siddhibhyaśca maharṣibhya idam idaṃ ca bhojanam ||5 1 || kṛttikābhyo manubhyaśca idam idaṃ ca bhojanam | marudbhyaśca kalābhyaśca idam idaṃ ca bhojanam ||52|| tīrthebhyaśca vālakhilyebhyaścedaṃ bhojanaṃ namama | yakṣarākṣasabhūtebhyaḥ pretebhyo bhojanaṃ tvidam ||53|| kūṣmāṇḍebhyaḥ piśācebhya id cedaṃ ca bhojanam | vināyakebhyo gaṇebhya idaṃ cedaṃ ca bhojanam ||54|| vetālebhyaścāraṇebhyaḥ sūtebhyo bhojanaṃ tvidam | māgadhebhyaśca bandībhyo bhṛtyebhyo bhojanaṃ tvidam |||55|| ḍākinībhyaḥ śākinībhyastāmasībhyaśca bhojanam | vidyādhrebhyo gandharvebhyaḥ kinnarebhyaśca bhojanam ||56|| kiṃpuṃbhyo viśvadevebhyo namama bhojanaṃ tvidam | daityebhyo dānavebhyaśca nāgebhyo bhojanaṃ tvidam ||57|| sarpebhyaśca phaṇibhyaśca sarīsṛpebhyo bhojanam | vṛkṣebhyaśca virudbhyaśca tṛṇādibhyaśca bhojanam ||58|| tīrthebhyaḥ parvatebhyaśca sāgarebhyaśca bhojanam | saridbhyaśca taḍāgebhyaścaityebhyo bhojanaṃ tvidam ||59|| kalpalatādrumebhyaśca kāmadhenubhya ityapi | cintāmaṇibhya idaṃ cākṣayapātrebhya ityapi ||2.225.6 0|| kuṇḍebhyaḥ kuṇḍadevebhya idaṃ namama bhojanam | maṇḍapebhyo maṇḍapasthadevebhyo bhojanaṃ tvidam ||6 1 || dvārebhyo dvāradevebhyaḥ śākhāsurebhya ityapi | dhvajadevebhya idaṃ ca yūpadevebhya ityapi ||62|| sruksruvādisādhanebhya idaṃ namama bhojanam | staṃbhebhyaḥ stambhadevebhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ||63|| mātṛkābhyaḥ satībhyaśca sādhvībhya idamityapi | idaṃ sāṃkhyayoginībhyo bhojanaṃ ca namonamaḥ ||64|| pativratābhyo devībhya idaṃ namama bhojanam | kāmadevāya ca saptarṣibhyo namama bhojanam ||65|| īśānāya varuṇāya mahendrāya ca bhojanam | agnaye ca kuverāya nairṛtāya ca bhojanam ||66|| vāyave ca yamāyedaṃ dūtebhyo bhojanaṃ tvidam | yādobhyo vāyuvāsebhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ||67|| bhūvāsebhyo himasthebhya idaṃ namama bhojanam | jarāyūjebhyo’ṇḍajebhyaśca idaṃ namama bhojanam ||68|| svedajebhya udbhijjebhyaścedṃ namama bhojanam | idaṃ kīṭapataṃgādisūkṣmebhyo bhojanaṃ namama ||6 9|| jaḍebhyaścetanebhyaśca makhibhyo bhojanaṃ namama | meghebhyaḥ stanayitnubhya idṃ namama bhojanam ||2.225.70|| surāsurādisarvebhya idṃ namama bhojanam | brahmasṛṣṭisthitebhyaśca idaṃ namama bhojanam ||71 || īśasṛṣṭisthitebhyaśca idṃ namama bhojanam | jīvasṛṣṭisthitebhyaśca idaṃ namama bhojanam ||72|| caturaśītikhanijebhyaścedaṃ bhojanaṃ namaḥ | smṛtebhyaścāsmṛtebhyaścedaṃ ca namama bhojanam ||73|| viśiṣṭaśiṣṭatattvebhya idaṃ namama bhojanam | samastebhyaśca vyastebhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ||74|| pratyekebhyaśca yāvadbhya idaṃ namama bhojanam | karmaṭhebhyo brāhmaṇebhya idaṃ namama bhojanam || 75|| idṃ namama sarvātmānanāya vahnaye svāhā | sahasradhārābhiścedaṃ havyaṃ ca vahnaye svāhā ||76|| evaṃ vai vahnaye havyaṃ ghṛtaṃ samit phalāni ca | miṣṭānnāni rasāścāpi dravāścāpi samarpitāḥ ||77|| tato bahvāhutiṃ homaṃ pracakre lomaśo muniḥ | mahāghṛtāhutihomaṃ tataścākārayanmuniḥ ||78|| tadā pratyakṣadevādyāstṛptā api punaḥ punaḥ | jagṛhurvahninā sārdhaṃ pradattaṃ havyamuttamam ||79|| nīrājanaṃ pracakāra tataḥ śrīlomaśo muniḥ | vāditrāṇāṃ ninadāścābhavam̐stadā samantataḥ ||2.225.80 || vedaghoṣā ajāyanta gītayo yoṣitāṃ tathā | puṣpāñjaliṃ tato rājā dadau devebhya eva ca ||8 1|| viprāścakruryajamānābhiṣecanaṃ tu pāvanam | śreyaḥpradānakaṃ cakruḥ rājā ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadau ||82|| viprā āśīrvacanāni jagurharṣabharāstataḥ | vahniṃ natvā ca devebhyo namaskṛtya kṣamārthanām ||83|| kṛtvā ca kārayāmāsa visarjanaṃ hi lomaśaḥ | ākāśaṃ tu tadā vyāptamabhūd vimānapadmakaiḥ ||84|| sṛṣṭitrayādhivāsānāṃ samāgamena sarvataḥ | pañcamyāṃ rādhike caivaṃ makhakāryottaraṃ hariḥ ||85|| bhojayitvā mahīmānān maharṣīṃśca dvijātikān | sarvān prāghūṇikām̐ścāpi dhāmadhāmādivāsinaḥ ||86 || bhojayitvā yathāyogyān tataścakāra bhojanam | yajamānairnṛpaiḥ sārdhaṃ bubhuje bhagavān svayam ||87|| evaṃ pravartito yajño rādhike saritastaṭe | pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍadānādyaistarpaṇaṃ samajāyata ||88|| sāyaṃ snānaṃ tataścakre bhagavān sarvamānavaiḥ | devaiśca dehibhiḥ sākaṃ varuṇaṃ samprapūjya ca ||89|| jalaṃ prapūjya bhagavān sasnau sarvaiḥ samanvitaḥ | athāyayau nijaṃ sthānaṃ dadau dānāni vai tadā || 2.225.90|| muktebhyaḥ pāduke sarvāvatārebhyaḥ kirīṭakān | muktānībhyo’vatāriṇībhyo dadau svarṇaśāṭikāḥ ||91 || mukuṭām̐śca dadau caiśebhyaśca hārān dadau prabhuḥ | īśānībhyaśca sa dadau śṛṃkhalā raśanāstathā ||92|| ṛṣibhyaḥ svarṇakalaśān ārṣībhyaḥ svarṇatantikāḥ | siddhebhya svarṇamālāśca siddhibhyaḥ svarṇakañcukīḥ || 93|| pitṛbhyaścāmṛtasthālīḥ pitrikābhyo’kṣayān ghaṭān | devebhyaḥ svarṇachatrāṇi devībhyaḥ kaṇṭhapatrikāḥ || 94|| kaṭakāni dadau cāpi deveśebhyaśca vetrakān | bhūtapretapiśācebhyaḥ kañcukān pradadau prabhuḥ || 95|| mānavebhyaḥ svarṇamudrā daityebhyaśca maṇīn dadau | sūtamāgadhabandībhyaḥ svarṇahārām̐stadā dadau ||96|| anāthabālavṛddhebhyo dravyāṇi cāmbarāṇi ca | dadau śrībhagavām̐statra yeṣāṃ yadyadapekṣitam || 97|| jaḍebhyaścetanebhyaśca yeṣāṃ yadyadapekṣitam | saṃkalpya sarvaṃ pradadau paramātmā dayānidhiḥ || 98|| mahādānāni sarvāṇi madhyadānāni yāni ca | kṣetrakanyādidānāni tadgurubhyo’pyadāpayat ||99|| rājānaśca daduḥ sarvaṃ dravyaṃ cānnaṃ gṛhāṇi ca | kanyādānāni bahūni gavāśvagajadānakam || 2.225.10 0|| evamārātriparyantaṃ dānāni pradadau prabhuḥ | tatastvārārtrikaṃ cābhūd bālakṛṣṇasya rādhike || 10 1|| rājabhiḥ saṃkṛtaṃ paścād bhojanānyabhavan punaḥ | athopadeśaṃ bhagavān rātrau prajāsu saṃvyadhāt || 10 2|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āśvinakṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ prātarhariṇā saha yajñabhūmiṃ prati mahīmānānāmāgamanam maṇḍape sarveṣāmupasthitiḥ svastivācanādi ghṛtabahvāhutihomaparyantakāryāṇāṃ vinivartanaṃ parihāraścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 225 ||
<2.226> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | yamupadeśaṃ pradadau svātmakalyāṇakārakam || 1 || tamahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi prajābhyaḥ pradadau prabhuḥ | parabrahmaprayuktena brahmaṇā cākṣareṇa vai || 2 || preryate puruṣo dhāmni sthitaḥ sṛṣṭividhāpane | yuyuje nijaśaktyā sa māyayā tena māyikāḥ || 3 || māyālīnānādino ye ātmānaste svakarmabhiḥ | preritā īśvarā yadvā jīvā bhavanti dehinaḥ || 4 || dehendriyāntaḥkaraṇatanmātrābhūtasaṃjñakam | saṃghātaṃ tu nijaṃ matvā badhyate tatra karmabhiḥ || 5 || saṃghātarūpān bhāvān vai gṛhṇanti prāṇino muhuḥ | punarviyogaṃ saṃyanti cakravatpariyanti ca || 6 || śāntaghoravimūḍhāṃśca bhāvān prayānti sarvataḥ | romalohitamāṃsāni bhāvā vai mātṛsaṃbhavāḥ || 7 || majjāsthisnāyavo bhāvā bhavanti pitṛsaṃbhavāḥ | sukhaduḥkhavimohāḍhyāḥ śītoṣṇadāhakāḥ sadā || 8 || tān bhāvān samavāpyāpi tairna yo bhāvito bhavet | so’haṃ so’haṃ vicintya syād bhāvabandhanavarjitaḥ || 9 || navadvāraṃ puraṃ ramyaṃ tattadbhāvaiḥ samanvitam | vyāpya śete cetanātmā puruṣaḥ so’yamucyate || 2.226.10 || tebhyaḥ puruṣasaṃjñebhyo’nantebhyaścottamo’smyaham | antarātmā virāje’haṃ brahmaloke yathāsmyaham || 11 || puruṣottama evāhaṃ bhavāmi sarvaśāsakaḥ | sarveṣu cetaneṣu yadvadahaṃ nivasāmi ha || 1 2|| tathā sarvajaḍe’pyasmi śarīrī tattvavadhārakaḥ | taṃ māṃ vijñāya bhakto me videho jāyate’cirāt || 13 || ajaraḥ so’maraścaiva sūkṣmo mama vṛṣānvitaḥ | mama mūrtau mama bhaktau sarvārpaṇo vimucyate || 1 4|| agniścāste sadā dārau dārunāśe viyujyate | pare tattve prayātyeva tathātmā dehanāśane || 15 || taṃ paraṃ paramātmānaṃ māmāśrityāpi pāpinaḥ | puṇyavanto bhavantyevāṅgārā ivāgniyogataḥ || 16|| mama satāṃ prasaṃgena mamaiśvaryātiyogataḥ | mamāṃśaguṇalābhācca bhakto matsamatāṃ vrajet || 17|| svapnadṛśyān padārthān vai tyaktvā cāyāti jāgrati | tathā māyādikāstyaktvā sarvadraṣṭari yāti vai || 18|| bhūmiṃ tyaktvā yathā vāri sariddvārā mahārṇavam | yāti tadvad vihāyedaṃ varṣmātmā māṃ pumuttamam || 1 9|| kṛtakāryā nivartante yathā vai karmacāriṇaḥ | bhuktabhogā nirvatante tathātmānaśca dehinaḥ || 2.226.2 0|| vegahīnaḥ śaro yadvanniṣkriyo yāti bhūtalam | vāsanāvegahīno’yaṃ jīvo yāti mamākṣaram || 21 || nirāśo jāyate yadvannivṛttaḥ karmaṇastathā | sarvāśāvarjito loke nivṛtto māṃ prayāti vai ||22|| sarvabhāvairvarjito yat tato yāti mamāspadam | madabhyāsānmayi sakto na yāti prakṛtiṃ punaḥ || 23|| bījānyagnyupadagdhāni na prarohanti sarvathā | tathāsya sarvabījāni na prarohanti vai punaḥ || 24|| amṛtāsvādasaṃsaktaḥ svādāntare na sajjate | mama svāde prasaktaḥ sa guṇasvāde na sajjate || 25|| durlabhā mama vettāro jagatyatra bhavanti vai | sulabhāḥ sarvato jīvā dehendriyārthapoṣakāḥ ||26 || nimnabhāve vegavanto yānti vāripravāhaṇāḥ | nimnagrāmye tathāvegā yānti vai prāyaśo janāḥ ||27|| vahnisvabhāvāḥ santastu yāntyūrdhvaṃ brahmavedinaḥ | satāṃ prasaṃgato bhaktāḥ prayāntūrdhvaṃ mamākṣaram || 28|| evaṃ vicārya satataṃ bhajanīyaḥ pareśvaraḥ | satāṃ saṃgena kartavyā bhaktirme dhāmadāyinī ||29|| sarvārpaṇaṃ mayi kṛṣṇe nārāyaṇe pareśvare | ye kurvanti na vai teṣāṃ māyā bādhakarī bhavet ||2.226.3 0 || yaḥ snehaḥ putravittādau yaḥ snehaḥ pramadādiṣu | yaḥ sneho nijadehādau taṃ snehaṃ tvarjayenmayi ||3 1 || yā tṛṣṇā viṣaye saukhye yā tṛṣṇā bhogasādhane | yā tṛṣṇā mānayaśasoḥ sā kāryā mayi mādhave ||3 2 || yo vegaḥ svārthasamprāptau yo vego’rijayādiṣu | yo vego’haṃkṛtau cāste sa kāryo mayi keśave || 33 || yā tṛptiśceṣṭalābhe’sti yā tṛptirbhoganirgame | yā tṛptirbahusantoṣe sā kāryā mayi sarvathā ||34|| yatsukhaṃ sāttvike bhāve nirdvandve cāpi yatsukham | yatsukhaṃ ca vivekena tat kāryaṃ mayi sarvathā ||35|| yā puṣṭiḥ sampadā syācca yā puṣṭirbalasaṃgrahaiḥ | yā puṣṭiḥ śāstraviṣayaiḥ sā kāryā mayi sarvadā ||36|| yatsthānaṃ cāśraye nityaṃ yatsthānaṃ ca sahāyade | yatsthānaṃ svasya hṛdaye tatkāryaṃ mayi sarvathā ||37|| yat tādātmyaṃ ca dehādau yattādātmyaṃ ca gaurave | yattādātmyaṃ nije saukhye tatkāryaṃ mayi satpatau ||38|| yā śubhāśā nije putre yā cāśā tvāyatau sukhe | yā cāśā lābhasam̐lagnā sā kāryā mayi sarvadā ||39|| upārjite yā mamatā tādātmye mamatā ca yā | yābhimate ca mamatā sā kāryā mayi muktaye ||2.226.40 || yaḥ prayatno viṣayārthaṃ dhanārthaṃ yaḥ prayatnakaḥ | prāṇārthaṃ yaḥ prayatnaśca kāryaḥ sa mayi mādhave ||41 || śarīravānupādatte mohāt sarvān parigrahān | tena vai bandhanaṃ syācca nirayaṃ tvabhiyāti saḥ ||42|| nāśuddhamācarettasmāt samicchan brahmasadgatim | karmaṇāṃ vighnarūpāṇāṃ phalaṃ necchet subuddhimān ||43 || yaśca karmācarellobhānmohānmadācca matsarāt | mokṣapanthānamutkramya sānubandhaḥ sa naśyati ||44|| tasmād rāgayujā naiva bhāvyaṃ kvacid vivekinā | bāliśena na vai bhāvyaṃ vā mugdhena jaḍātmanā ||451|| mṛnmayaṃ tu gṛhaṃ yadvanmṛdā samparilipyate | annamayaṃ tathā varṣma lepanīyaṃ tathānnakaiḥ ||46|| pārthivaṃ varṣma caivaitat pārthivaiḥ puṣṭimeti hi | naitāvatā mamatvena kāryāsaktirhi varṣmaṇi ||47|| miṣṭaṃ tiktaṃ ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ snigdhaṃ dhānyaphalādikam | mṛdvikārā mṛdo dehe’pekṣaṇīyā hi santi vai ||48|| tāvantaścopayoktavyā bandhanādivivarjitāḥ | evaṃ yātrāṃ vinirvāhya bhavapāraṃ prayāti vai ||49|| yathāraṇyaṃ gato yogī kvacidbhojyaṃ hi pattanāt | gṛhṇātyapi na tatrāpi badhyate rāgatastathā ||2.226.5 0 || saṃsārāraṇyamātiṣṭhan śramavān yātriko bhavan | yātrārthamadyādāhāraṃ yathā bandhāya no bhavet ||5 1 || indriyairmanasā buddhyā samīkṣya viṣayānapi | śāntimicchanna lubdhaḥ syāttadā nirbandhano bhavet ||5 2|| vāsanābhibhūtalokā mohitā māyayā mama | cakravat parivartante janmamṛtyubhavabhrame ||53|| tasmādajñānajān doṣān tyaktvā ca bandhanānyapi | mama mārgaṃ samāśritya mokṣabhāk syādvivekavān ||54|| akālapuruṣāt sarvaṃ cāhaṃkāre bhramatyapi | phalaṃ cāhaṃkṛtaṃ bhuṃkte punarmāyāṃ pragacchati ||55|| rajojanyaṃ svargarūpaṃ sthānaṃ vai bandhanaṃ param | tamojanyaṃ rākṣasādi sthānaṃ vai bandhanaṃ param ||56 || tasmādātmavatā varjyaṃ rajaśca tama ityapi | rajastamobhyāṃ śūnyaṃ ca sattvaṃ nirmalatāmiyāt ||57|| nairmalye cetanaḥ samyak prasādavān prajāyate | prasādarūpaḥ prāpnuyāt parameśaprasannatām ||58|| nityaprasannatāprāpto mokṣaṃ samadhigacchati | ātmā nara itiprokto nārī tu vāsanā matā ||59|| kṛtyā hyeṣā ghorabhāvā garte nayati kāminaḥ | rajastamomayīmūrtirindriyāṇāṃ balapradā ||2.226.6 0|| vāsanā ḍākinī duṣṭā naraṃ kṣipati sāgare | naradehe ca vā nārīdehe mohasya kāriṇī ||6 1 || pātayatyeva saṃghāte’śucau malinamandire | asaṃskṛtamahāmārge rūparāgapralepite ||62|| mohātpatitaḥ puruṣo bījaṃ vapati māyikam | jāyante jantavo bījāt putraputrītināmakāḥ ||63||| sādṛśye’tra viśeṣo’sti sāmye’pi svedajaiḥ sutaiḥ | svedajāḥ kramayaḥ proktā dhātujāḥ sutasaṃjñakāḥ ||64|| mokṣārthī tu kramīn putrān svajātān sāmyabhāvavān | virāgeṇa vivekena visṛjya māṃ samāśrayet ||65|| janau duḥkhe pāravaśye bālabhāve’pi duḥkhakam | yauvane viṣayecchābhiścendriyaparatantratā ||66|| vārdhakye pāravaśye ca punarduḥkhaṃ taduttaram | duḥkhādyantairduḥkhamadhyairnaraḥ śārīramānasaiḥ ||67|| vijñāyedaṃ duḥkhasaudhaṃ tadupekṣet māṃ śrayet | upādānānnimittācca sahakārita ityapi ||68|| āpūrakāttathā sarvaṃ duḥkhameva hi varṣmaṇi | tādṛśaṃ samanādṛtya tyāgānnirodhamāśrayet ||69|| mayi rodhaṃ prapannasyātarṣulasya vivekinaḥ | bhaktasya mama yogena muktireva na saṃśayaḥ ||2.226.70|| tattvajñānāmṛtabhujo bhaktirasapibasya vai | mama snehasudhāktasya mamākṣarapadaṃ matam ||7 1 || brahmacaryaṃ brahmarūpaṃ śīlaṃ cidambaraṃ matam| cidākāśaṃ samālambya mamākāśamupāvrajet ||72|| dehākāśaṃ tathendriyākāśaṃ cāntarvikāśakam | brahmākāśena saṃyujya haryākāśe’rpayet kṛtī ||73 || evaṃ mukto bhavatyeva mama yogamupāgataḥ | kṛtvaivaṃ nityamabhyāsaṃ kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||74|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau bhagavān kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | rādhike sa tato mantrān dadau bhaktebhya ārthitān ||75|| tato rātrau parāṃ śāntiṃ yoganidrātmikāṃ yayau | prātarvādyādimāṃgalyaiḥ kīrtanairyaśasāṃ śravaiḥ ||76 || jajāgāra svayaṃ nāthastrailokyāṃ maṃgalaṃ vyadhāt | kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtapūjaḥ kṛtasambhāvanaḥ prabhuḥ ||77|| sarvān bhaktān mahīmānān saṃbhāvya maṇḍapaṃ yayau | tadā vādyānyavādyanta makhotsāhapravṛttaye | |78|| maṃgalā gītayaścāsan nārīṇāṃ brahmayoṣitām | vedaghoṣā abhavam̐śca vaidikānāṃ samantataḥ ||79|| āyayuśca kratusthānaṃ makhīyāḥ karmaṭhā drutam | avatārāśca muktāśceśvarā devā maharṣayaḥ ||2.226.80|| pitaro mānavā daityā yakṣāḥ surāśca dānavāḥ | kāśyapyaśca prajāḥ sarvā devyaśca brahmayoṣitaḥ ||8 1 || nāgāḥ sarpāḥ khanijāścāyayurvai jaḍacetanāḥ | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prātaryajñakāryaṃ pūrvavanmunibhistadā ||82|| pravartitaṃ yathāyogyaṃ svastivācanapūrvakam | devānāṃ pūjanaṃ jātaṃ tathā balinivedanam |||83 || havyadānaṃ ca vahnau cāhutipradānakaṃ tathā | pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ cāpi puṣpāñjaliśca dakṣiṇāḥ ||84|| ārārtrikaṃ parihāraḥ sarvaṃ jātaṃ yathocitam | viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ cāpi mahīmānādibhojanam ||85|| yajamānādilokānāṃ bhojanāni śubhānyapi | jātānyatha suviśramya hariḥ sāyaṃ sabhāṃ śubhām ||86|| akārayat svayaṃ tatra svāmīśrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | ācāryavaryo bhagavān janebhyaḥ pradadau manūn ||87|| tataścopādideśāpi mokṣadaṃ hitakṛcca vai | rādhike’nādikṛṣṇaḥ śrīpatirgopālabālakaḥ ||88|| śrīkṛṣṇavallabhācāryaḥ koṭimuktābhivanditaḥ | dhāmadhāmeśvaranāthaḥ sarvāvatārakāraṇam ||89|| asaṃkhyabrāhmīsevābhiprasāditapareśvaraḥ | yajñe tṛptaḥ surādyaiśca pūjito mokṣadaḥ prabhuḥ ||2.226.90|| kāruṇikaḥ kāṃbhareyo’nantaśaktipatirhariḥ | upadeśakṣaṇe sarvaistvekavṛttyā vilokitaḥ ||91|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pañcamyāṃ rātrau prajābhya upadeśanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prātaścāhnikottaraṃ yajñasamastakāryanirvartanaṃ bhojanādi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 226 ||
<2.227> śrīkṛṣṇa uvācarādhike śrīharikṛṣṇo brahmavratamupādiśat | śṛṇu sarvavratebhyastacchreṣṭhaṃ brahmapadaṃ śubham || 1 || brahmacaryamiti khyātaṃ sarvamūrdhanyameva yat | bhaktaścāpyadhyavasyedvai brahmacaryamakalmaṣam || 2 || brahmavratirbrahmacārī brahmasevī ca śīlavān | kālaṃ māyāṃ ca karmāṇi jitvā maddhāma cāpnuyāt || 3 || sukaraṃ yoginā taddhi siddhānāṃ ca satāṃ tathā | satīnāṃ sukaraṃ cāpi duṣkaraṃ viṣayaiṣiṇām || 4 || sampradīptaṃ baliṣṭhaṃ cendriyagrāmaṃ viśeṣataḥ | nigṛhṇīyāt sāvadhānaḥ sa vai jayati mṛtyudam || 5 || kāmasya na svarūpaṃ vai cintayed viṣayānna ca | kāmacihnāni paśyenna rajobhāgān vivarjayet || 6 || rajaḥpuṣṭikarān bhāgān varjayed dehavāniha | dhātupuṣṭikarān bhogām̐stathaiva parivarjayet || 7 || jñānayuktena manasā virāgasahitena ca | rāgabhāvaṃ vināśyaiva vartayedātmabhāvavān || 8 || kuṇapāmedhyasaṃyuktaṃ śarīraṃ kāmanāśrayam | bhaviṣyannirayakṣepakārakaṃ viśvasenna vai || 9 || vātapittakaphāgāraṃ raktatvaṅmāṃsakuṇḍakam | majjāsnāyvasthināḍyāḍhyaṃ malamūtrādisaṃbhṛtam || 2.227.1 0|| kāmāśrayaṃ ca nikṛṣṭaṃ jñātvā rāgaṃ vivarjayet | dhamanyo malavāhinyaḥ pratāyante samantataḥ || 11 || āpagā iva cābdhiṃ vai dehaṃ puṣṇanti bāhyakaiḥ | tāsu caikā tu dhamanī manovāhābhidhā hṛdi || 12|| kāmadhātvāśrayā cāste śukraṃ muñcati kalpajam | śukraṃ bahuvidhaṃ proktaṃ taijasaṃ netrayorgatam || 1 3|| karṇayordravarūpaṃ ca śabdagrāhakameva tat| | evamanyendriyāṇāṃ mandire prāptaṃ praśaktidam || 14|| jale cāste tathā dugdhe sneho ghṛtaṃ ca varṣmaṇi | tadeva śukrarūpaṃ nirmathyate’ti tu manthanaiḥ || 15 || svapne’pyevaṃ manojanyaṃ saṃkalpajaṃ rajoṃ’śakam | śukraṃ tūtpadya vegena balahīnaṃ viśatyapi || 16 || trīṇi bījāni śukrasya hyannaṃ raso manovahā | etattrayaṃ viditvaiva śithīlayet trikaṃ muhuḥ || 1 7|| tataśca śukrānutpādād brahmavrataṃ prapuṣyati | mano bhakṣyasyāṇutamo bhāgaḥ puṣṭatamaṃ tataḥ || 18 || nirvāsanaṃ vidhāyaiva virāgeṇa jayeddhi tat | jyotiṣmadvirajaḥ svātmarūpatāmeti mānasam || 19 || rajomayaṃ parāvṛttya sattvamayaṃ prajāyate | sattvabhāvabhāvitaṃ ca saccidānandatāmiyāt || 2.227.20 || taruṇādhigataṃ tadvai rājasaṃ bhāti yāvatā | tāvatā tallayārthaṃ vai dhyānayogaṃ samācaret || 21 || ekāgrābhyasanaṃ kāryaṃ tāruṇyaṃ tena līyate | pakvabhāvaṃ gataṃ tacca balahīnaṃ prajāyate || 22|| tadātmānaṃ samāśritya jīvadātmabalānvitam | tataścātmānamutsṛjya na yāti viṣayaṃ kvacit | | 23 || na cendriyāṇyabhiyāti neśvarādicamatkṛtim | na siddhīrna ca vegādyaṃ na māyāṃ na ca tadguṇān || 24|| evaṃvidhaṃ vegahīnaṃ yadā syādvai svamānasam | tadā sudurgaṃ panthānaṃ guṇarājyānuyāyinam || 25 || atītya paramaṃ mārgaṃ cātmarāṣṭrīyamṛcchati | āsīmamārgaṃ collaṃdhyākṣare’mṛtaṃ samaśnute || 26 || ityevaṃ vartamānasya brahmalokaḥ karasthitaḥ | brahmacaryaratasyātra brahmaloko hi vartate || 27|| duranteṣvindriyārtheṣu saktāḥ sīdanti dehinaḥ | asaktā ye brahmaśīlāste yānti dhāma me param || 28 || dṛṣṭvā sṛṣṭiṃ santatāṃ ca janmamṛtyujarādibhiḥ | ādhivyādhikleśaduḥkhairvyāptā yateta muktaye || 29|| śarīrendriyasaṃghātānantaḥkaraṇakānyapi | saṃyujya śrīpatau bhakto nirapekṣaścaret sukham || 2.227.30 || manaḥsaṃgaṃ kṛpayāpi naiva kuryānmumukṣukaḥ | saṃge hyupekṣāṃ kurvīta jñātvā saṃgaphalaṃ jagat || 31 || saṃgaphalaṃ vihāyaiva vartayan karmaṭho’pi san | naiva badhnāti muktātmā padmapatramivāṃbhasā || 32 || kṣamārjavaṃ tathā droho yasya syāt sa sukhī bhavet | duḥkhānniḥsaraṇaṃ jñātvā niḥsaret sa sukhī bhavet || 33 || nāpadhyāyenna spṛhayennāyogyaṃ cintayedasat | cintayedvai paraṃbrahma śṛṇuyānme kathāmṛtam || 34|| kalkāpetāṃ vaded vācaṃ dharmaṃ kārṣṇamanuvrajet | vyāharecchrīharernāma cintayedarthamuttamam || 35|| anarthaṃ nirayāṇāṃ samprasañjakaṃ vivarjayet | pratilomāṃ diśaṃ budhvā sāṃsārikīṃ vivarjayet || 36 || anīhaśca tathā muktaḥ sarvaiḥ parigrahairmuhuḥ | viviktacārī niyamī jñānapradagdhakilbiṣaḥ || 37 || ātmāvān dhṛtimān bhūtvā hṛtprakāśaṃ pramārgayet | yatra devāḥ prakāśante tato brahma prakāśate || 38 || evaṃ sthitiṃ samāpanno brahmabhūyāya jāyate | yadvā yogamahāvṛttiṃ samācarecchanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||3 9 || āhāraniyamaṃ kṛtvā cintāniyamamityapi | dhyānavṛddhiṃ samāsādya svātmaprakāśamarjayet ||2.227.40 || jñānaprakāśasaṃyuktaścātmaprakāśa edhitaḥ | bhaktiprakāśasanmiśraḥ sūryavatsamprakāśate || 41 || devaprakāśavān pūrvaṃ paścādātmaprakāśakaḥ | tataḥ svayaṃprakāśaḥ syāt sa syādvai kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ||42 || evaṃ prakāśamārgeṇa parān svargān vikramya ca | citprakāśo bhavet śaśvad brahmaprakāśavān hi saḥ ||43 || saguṇo mañjulo haṃsaḥ pāravān svaprabho yadā | vītarāgo’pavargajño bhavenmāmeti vai prabhum || 44|| guṇātīto jarāmṛtyū jitvā māyāmayaṃ puram | akṣarāmṛtamāpnoti yattadbahma sanātanam || 45|| etatsarvaṃ brahmacaryalabhyaṃ bhavati śāśvatam | nidrā vratahā saṃtyājyā brahmacaryaṃ samicchatā || 46 || mano nidrāyutaṃ vyagraṃ rajasā tvabhibhūyate | rajobhāvasya nairbalye vyagratā kṣīṇatāṃ vrajet| ||47|| śāntirbhavet sattvavṛttiprādhānyaṃ gurutālayaḥ | tena nidrālayaḥ syācca jñānavṛttyā svapityapi ||48 || saṃsāravṛttivilaye svapnaṃ dūrataraṃ bhavet | tena brahmaparo bhūtvā brahmaśreṣṭhamavāpnuyāt ||49|| prasannamanasā yadyat saṃkalpayati mānasam | tattatsaṃskāramāpannaṃ smaryate ca muhurmuhuḥ ||2.227.50 || sāttvikeṣvapi deveśaṃ pareśaṃ māṃ vicintayet | sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthaṃ tena māṃ cottare labhet ||51|| lipsettu manasā bhakto mama yogaṃ sukhāvaham | ātmaprasādaṃ saumyaṃ ca devānāṃ darśanaṃ hṛdi ||52|| nityamevaṃ samabhyāsāt tatsaṃskāraḥ surāṃstataḥ | hṛdayaṃ saṃsthitān paśyettato brahma prakāśate ||53 || brahmacaryaṃ tadevāhuryattad brahmaṇi vartanam | brahmasaṃsṛṣṭadeveṣu satsu yadvartanaṃ ca tat ||54|| brahma tatparamaṃ jñānaṃ cāmṛtākṣaravedanam | evaṃ viditvā svātmānaṃ prayānti paramāṃ gatim ||55 || māyāṃ tyaktuṃ pravidyāccākṣaraṃ vidyādvimuktaye | pravṛttiṃ samparityajyākṣaro bhūtvākṣaraṃ vrajet ||56|| pravṛttiḥ punarāvṛttirnivṛttiḥ paramā gatiḥ | nivṛttilakṣaṇo dharmo brahmadaḥ śāśvatapramut ||57|| śriyaṃ divyāmabhiprepsuḥ śrīpatiṃ māṃ hṛdi smaret | sarvabhāvena matprāptyai kuryān madyogakṛttapaḥ ||58|| brahmacaryamahiṃsā ca śārīraṃ tapa tanmatam | matsmṛtirmanaso rodho mānasaṃ tapa eva tat ||59|| matprasādādanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tapo vai pāpanāśanam | vāsanāyā vimardo’pi buddhestapaḥ paraṃ matam ||2.227.6 0|| ātmaniṣṭhā cetanasya tapaḥ paramamucyate | madyogārthaṃ prayatnaśca satataṃ tapa uttamam ||61 || avyāhatā matiryasya madanyairjaḍacetanaiḥ | saṃsthitiṃ brahmasāmyāṃ vai gato yāsyati māmanu ||62|| māyāsarge yāyatiḥ sā parasarge na vidyate | ātmajñānaguṇādyaiśca divyabhāvaiḥ pramodate ||63 || āyuṣo’nte’tra manujāḥ sataḥ kecidupāsate | kecidakṣarabhāvaṃ cātmānaṃ kecidupāsate ||64|| pare devaṃ paraṃ māṃ vai prasthāne samupāsate | sarva ete parabhāvāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim ||65|| brāhmīṃ tanuṃ labhante te vimuktāmaparigrahām | mama vijñānasampannā madārādhanatatparāḥ ||66 || mamāśrayaṃ paraṃ labdhvā prayānti paramāṃ gatim | vidyāṃ labdhvā parāṃ brahmabhūtā yānti parāṃ gatim ||67|| yathābhāvamupāsantaḥ sarve yānti parāṃ gatim | kaṣāyavarjitāḥ śāntā madāśrayaparāyaṇāḥ ||68|| vimucyante guṇakleśaiḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim | bhagavantamajaṃ viṣṇuṃ divyaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||6 9|| jñātvātmasthaṃ hariṃ māṃ ca śuddhasnehasamanvitāḥ | bhāvatṛptā hi māṃ yānti nivartante na te’kṣarāḥ ||2.227.70|| māṃ vā me sādhupuruṣān madaṃśān saṃśrayanti ye | prāpya te paramaṃ dhāma modante’kṣaramavyayam ||7 1 || tṛṣṇābaddhaṃ jagat sarvaṃ cakravat parivartate | tṛṣṇātanturyena dagdhastasya maddhāmamārgaṇam ||72|| sūcyā sūtraṃ yathāvastre saṃsārayati vāyakaḥ | tadvat saṃsārasūtraṃ hi tṛṣṇāsūcyā prasāryate ||73|| tasmād vimuktaḥ puruṣo me bhaktyā yāti māmapi | taṃ snehena vimānena nayāmi dhāma māmakam ||74|| ityupādiśya bhagavān virarāma kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ | rādhike pradadau mantraṃ nūtnebhyaḥ śrīhariḥ svayam ||75|| sabhāsamāptimakarot sandhyāvandanamācarat | rātrau ca bhojanaṃ cakruḥ sarve’dhvare samāgatāḥ ||76|| mahīmāneṣu sarvatra rañjanānyabhavanniśi | śrīhariḥ śayanaṃ prāpa brahmapriyādisevitaḥ ||77|| makhārthimahīmānānāṃ śivireṣu naṭādayaḥ | cakrū rātrau nāṭyamagryaṃ pūrvāvatārabodhakam ||78|| mallāścakrurmallayuddhaṃ bahuyuktisamanvitam | gāyakānāṃ gāyanāni gāndharvamaṇḍape’bhavan ||79|| kutracittu viduṣāṃ vai kathākhyānāni cābhavan | sūtamāgadhabandīnāṃ cāraṇānāṃ ca śāstriṇām ||2.227.80|| kāvyāni caitihāsāni maṇḍape tvabhavanniśi | kutracid vāranārīṇāṃ nṛtyāni gītimanti ca ||8 1 || rājanyavargasaṃsatsu bhavanti sma tadā niśi | kutracid devatānāṃ ca devīnāṃ devayoṣitām ||82|| brahmasarasāmapsarasāṃ gītinṛtyāni cābhavan | kutracidīśasṛṣṭīnāṃ mahotsavā bhavanti hi ||83 || kvacid dānavadaityānāṃ manorañjanakāni ca | bhavanti vividhāstatra krīḍā utsavabodhikāḥ ||84|| pradarśanāni lokānāṃ paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ tathā | yoṣitāṃ ca narāṇāṃ ca dehināmabhavam̐stathā ||85|| kutracid vanavallīnāṃ drumāṇāṃ tṛṇapatriṇām | phalānāṃ śibikānāṃ ca pradarśanāni cābhavan ||86|| kutracicchilpakāryāṇāṃ kāṣṭhopalamṛdāṃ tathā | kārpāsahīrakauśeyatvagūrṇānāṃ tadābhavan ||87|| evaṃ gajānāmaśvānāṃ gavāṃ kesariṇāṃ tathā | śarabhāṇāṃ garuḍānāmuṣṭrāṇāṃ darśanāni ca ||88|| reṇḍīyānāṃ ca haṃsānāṃ śukānāṃ darśanāni ca | sainyānāṃ ca mahiṣīṇāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ darśanāni ca ||89|| evaṃvidhāni nūtnāni bahudeśodbhavāni ca | bahulokasamutthāni vastūni yāni yāni ca || 2.227.90|| kalātmakāni sarvāṇi hetumukhyāni yāni ca | yantrātmakāni cānyāni tatrābhavam̐stadā śubhe ||9 1 || goyājanabhūmau vai pradarśitāni pālakaiḥ | evaṃ ṣaṣṭhīniśā sarvā mahotsāhasamanvitā ||92|| vyatītārdhā tato lokā nidrāyāṃ saṃgatāḥ sukhāḥ | saptamyāṃ prātarevāthāvādyanta tūryajātayaḥ ||93|| maṃgalāni kīrtanāni gītayaścābhavam̐stathā | stāvakānāṃ stavanāni ninādā yantrasaṃbhavāḥ ||94|| vedaghoṣāśca viprāṇāṃ satāṃ sadbhajanāni ca | yoṣitāṃ śrībālakṛṣṇayaśoyuktāśca gītayaḥ ||95|| devīnāṃ devatādivyakathākhyānapragītayaḥ | īśvarīṇāṃ śeṣavārtāgītikāśca tadābhavan ||96|| nidrāśūnyā api rātrau bhūrītiṃ parigṛhya ca | maunaṃ śāntiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ prāptāścāsanniśāhvaye ||97|| prātaścaivaṃ tu vividhairmāṃgalikaśravādibhiḥ | svasthā bhūtvā kṛtasnānā kṛtāhnikāstadābhavan ||98|| rādhike śrīhariḥ snātaḥ kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtārcanaḥ | pitarau ca nijau kṛṣṇo vavande pādayoḥ patan || 99|| rājādyāśca kṛtakāryā hariṃ pūjayituṃ tadā | samāyayurmahāsaudhe
