śrīnivāsālaye śubhe || 2.227.10 0|| pupūjuḥ śrīhariṃ prītyā pādodakāni vai papuḥ | ārārtrikaṃ pracakruśca rājanyāḥ saṃgatā gṛhe || 10 1|| puṣpāṃjaliṃ pradatvaiva natvā cāśīrvaco’nvitāḥ | kṛtabhāgyāstathā rājñyaḥ pūjayitvā tathaiva tam || 10 2|| āyayurvai maṇḍapaṃ ca yajñasya bhagavānapi | ṛṣayaścāyayustatra karmaṭhā devatāstathā || 1 03|| rādhike sarvahavyāni samidhā mantradevatāḥ | vahnayaḥ sarva evāpi maṇḍape tatra cāyayuḥ || 104|| atha prāvartata kāryaṃ yajñīyaṃ cāditaḥ khalu | yathāpūrvaṃ kramalābhaṃ sāvadhānatayā makhe || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne yajñabhūmau ṣaṣṭhyāṃ sāyaṃ copadeśādi bhojanaṃ śayanaṃ saptamyāṃ prātaryajñamaṇḍapāgamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 227 ||
<2.228> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike saptamīprātarmuhūrte cottame punaḥ | makhakāryaṃ lomaśādyaiḥ kṛtaṃ pūrvadine yathā || 1 || prokṣaṇaṃ svastivāgādi puṇyāhavacanaṃ tathā | devānāṃ samprabodhaśca pūjanaṃ ca vidhānataḥ || 2 || ārārtrikaṃ balerdānaṃ mahānaivedyakāni ca | jalārpaṇaṃ tathā tāmbūlārpaṇaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam ||3 || agnāvāhutayaścāpi sarveṣāṃ havyalābhanam | ārārtrikaṃ ca devānāṃ viprāṇāṃ dakṣiṇādikam || 4 || puṣpāñjalistataḥ parihāraścetyabhavan kramāt | evaṃ nivartite kārye rājabhiryajamānakaiḥ || 5 || śrīharerājñayā sarve mahīmānottamādayaḥ | havyāni miṣṭabhojyāni bubhujuśca tataḥ param || 6 || lakṣāyutādyā manujā bubhujurdīnavargiṇaḥ | atha viśrāntimāsādya sāyaṃ tatrābhavatsabhā || 7 || anādiśrībālakṛṣṇasvāmī nārāyaṇādhipaḥ | prajābhyo hitakṛdvākyānyādideśa kṛpāparaḥ || 8 || yajñaścāhaṃ parabrahma vahnirmukhaṃ tu me matam | tanmukhena haviḥ sarvaṃ grasāmi bhakṣayāmi ca || 9 || manmūrtau brahmarandhre me’kṣaraṃdhāma virājate | keśeṣu sarvamuktā me muktānyo bhrakuṭau mama || 2.228.10 || mukhe netre gaṇḍayośca kapolayośca karṇayoḥ | śmaśruṣu cāpyavatārāḥ sarve vasanti mastake || 11 || cibuke nāsikādaṇḍe’vatāriṇyo vasanti me | kaṇṭhe vyūhā vāsudevādayo vasanti ceśvarāḥ || 12|| skandhe pṛṣṭhe mahāmāyā prakṛtiryā prakīrtyate | pradhānapuruṣaḥ kālo bhūmā puruṣa ityapi || 13|| mahāviṣṇustathā rudraḥ sadāśivo virāḍapi | sarve tvete pārśvayorme vartante kukṣisaṃśritāḥ || 14|| īśvarāṇyo mahādevyo mahālakṣmyaśca vai śriyaḥ | sarvāstāḥ śaktayo vakṣobhāge vasanti me striyaḥ || 15|| brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāḥ siddhāśceśvarakoṭayaḥ | vasanti nābhibhāge me sapatnīkā mamodare || 16|| ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā vasanti jaghane mama | yakṣā rakṣāṃsi daityāśca dānavā guptaromasu || 17|| gupte kāmādikā devā vasanti rājasā nṛpāḥ | nitambe bhūtakūṣmāṇḍāḥ pretapiśācakoṭayaḥ || 18|| sakthnorme mānavādyāśca jānvorme cāraṇādayaḥ | jaṃghayorme talavāsā daityādyāḥ saṃvasanti hi || 19|| patphaṇayoḥ sarpanāgā vasanti ca sarīsṛpāḥ | vṛkṣavallīprabhṛtayo vasanti romasu drumāḥ ||2.228.20|| kīṭapataṃgaśalabhāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ paśavastathā | śārīrakṣaraṇasthā me vasanti paritaḥ sadā ||21 || ityevaṃ mayi sarvā vai jaḍacetanasṛṣṭayaḥ | vasantīti mayi tṛpte tṛptāḥ sarve madātmakāḥ ||22|| viṣṇuyāge mahāyāge māṃ prapūjya pareśvaram | madbhaktān bhojayed yastu phalaṃ tasyāśvamedhajam ||23|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ māṃ yaḥ pūjayitvā makhe dvijān | bhojayet sa labhedatra vājapeyakratoḥ phalam ||24|| kāṃbhareyaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ makhe yaḥ pūjayecca mām | sādhūn saṃbhojayettasya rājasūyakratoḥ phalam ||25|| gopālabālaṃ govindaṃ makhe’tra pūjayettu mām | satīḥ sādhvīrbhojayecca phalaṃ tasyātirātrajam ||26|| puruṣottamasaṃjñaṃ māṃ makhe’tra pūjayettathā | bhojayedbālakān yaḥ sa pauṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet ||27|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ yaḥ pūjayedadhvare tathā | anāthān bhojayettasyāgniṣṭomādhvarajaṃ phalam ||28|| brahmapriyāpatiṃ māṃ yo’dhvare’tra pūjayettathā | kanyakā bhojayed yaḥ sa gavāyanaphalaṃ labhet ||29|| piśaṃgīkāntaṃ māṃ bhaktyādhvare’tra pūjayettu yaḥ | brahmayatīn bhojayecca labhet somakratoḥ phalam || 2.228.30 || śrīrādhāmāṇikīnāthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ māṃ prapūjayet| | gopagopīrbhojayitvā yāyādviśvajitaḥ phalam |||3 1 || prabhāpāravatīnāthaṃ pūjayenmāṃ makhe tathā | bhojayecca mahīmānān sautrāmaṇyāḥ phalaṃ labhet |||32|| gaurīnāthaṃ ca māṃ bhaktyā pūjayedadhvare’tra yaḥ | rudrayāgaphalaṃ yāyād bhojayitvā hi karmaṭhān ||33||| amarīsvāminaṃ māṃ yaḥ pūjayedatra vai makhe | amarīrbhojayitvā ca brahmayajñaphalaṃ labhet || 34|| brāhmīnāthaṃ ca māṃ bhaktyā makhe’tra pūjayettathā | brāhmīḥ sādhvīrbhojayitvā mahārudraphalaṃ labhet ||35|| lākṣmaṇīsvāmina māṃ ca makhe’tra pūjayettathā | labhennārāyaṇaphalaṃ prabhojya sāṃkhyayoginīḥ ||36|| ābriktisvāminaṃ māṃ ca makhe’tra pūjayettathā | jalahārīrbhojayitvā jalamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||37|| uṣṇālīsvāminaṃ māṃ ca makhe’tra pūjayettathā | pācinīrbhojayed yaḥ sa labhedannakratoḥ phalam || 38|| īśvarīsvāminaṃ māṃ ca makhe’tra pūjayettathā | makhabhṛtyān bhojayed yaḥ sa labhenmakhajaṃ phalam ||39|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sarvāvatāriṇam | muktapatiṃ ca duḥkhahālakṣmīkāntaṃ tu yo’dhvare ||2.228.40 || pūjayed bhojayet sarvān sarvamedhaphalaṃ labhet | mūrtimantaṃ gocaraṃ māṃ prīṇayitvātra cādhvare ||41|| yadyadicchenmama bhaktastattatsarvaṃ samāpnuyāt | dātāhaṃ sarvanātho’smi sarvaṃ dadāmi sevine ||42|| dānānyatra makhe śaktyā deyāni dharmakarmiṇe | dānairyat sukṛtaṃ cātra tadbhavedakṣayaṃ dhruvam ||43|| yajñavidho gṛhī divyaṃ kiṃkiṇījālamaṇḍitam | arkaprabhaṃ samāruhya vimānaṃ yāti matpadam ||44|| annānāṃ ca phalānāṃ ca dānaṃ vai samidhāṃ tathā | oṣadhānāmambarāṇāṃ patrāṇāṃ dānamityapi ||45|| bhaved dadāno dīrghāyuḥ svargabhāṅ mokṣabhāk tataḥ | saṃhitāpustakadānaṃ yaḥ karoti sa gacchati ||46 || svargaṃ satyaṃ ca vairāgyaṃ mokṣaṃ me cākṣaraṃ padam | yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke yaccāpi dayitaṃ gṛhe ||47|| tattat svārthaṃ pradeyaṃ vai tadevākṣayamicchatā | na dānaṃ yaśase dadyānna bhayena na lobhataḥ ||48|| paralokahitāyaiva deyaṃ pātrāya muktaye | vidyāvate hyanāthāya cārthine śīlayogine ||49|| sādhave dīyate syādakṣayaṃ tadvai mahāphalam | mama bhaktāḥ sarvasahā nispṛhā jitamānasāḥ ||2.228.50|| sarvabhūtahitāḥ santastebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam | santastuṣṭāstārayanti dātṝn sahasravaṃśajān ||51 || devālayaṃ dharmaśālāṃ sanmaṭhān kārayed dṛḍhān | yāvatya iṣṭikāstatra citā devālayādiṣu ||52|| tāvantyabdasahasrāṇi svargeṣu modate kṛtī | mama mandiranirmātā mama dhāmābhigacchati ||53|| pratiṣṭhayā pārameṣṭhyaṃ prāsādenaiśvaraṃ padam | pūjāvṛttyā brahmalokaṃ prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ ||54|| sudhādibhirlepayitvā jīrṇoddhāraṃ prakārayet | sammārjayellepayecca sevayet pratimāṃ mama ||55|| kūpavāpītaḍāgāni madarthaṃṃ kārayedapi | gāvaḥ pibanti salilaṃ sādhavo mānavāstathā ||56 || sarvāṇi cāpi sattvāni tṛṣārtāni pibanti ca | tīrthālaye ca tatpuṇyamaprameyaṃ hi jāyate ||57|| prāsādasyābhito ropaṇīyā vṛkṣā hi śākhinaḥ | ārāmāścāpi kartavyā viśrāntyarthaṃ tu dehinām ||58|| phalopayogino vṛkṣāstathā puṣpopayoginaḥ | samitpatropayogāśca pitṛdevopabhogadāḥ ||59|| etatatpuṇyamanantaṃ vai sarvasmṛddhipradaṃ bhavet | bhaktiyuktaṃ kṛtaṃ tattu mama dhāmapradaṃ bhavet ||2.228.6 0 || gṛhasthairvā dhanāḍhyaiśca rājabhistu viśeṣataḥ | tīrthabhūmiḥ sadā kāryā sajīvanā mahotsavaiḥ ||6 1 || yajñabhūmiḥ sadā puṇyā nadī puṇyā kratostaṭī | goyājanī medinī sā sadā mokṣakarī matā ||62|| atra vāse’pi lokānāṃ yāmyānāṃ darśanaṃ na vai | atra manurdhṛto yena vaiṣṇavastasya mokṣaṇam ||63 || mama pūjā kṛtā yena tasyāpi mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet | patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ cānnaṃ yena makhe’rpitam ||64|| tasya muktiṃ kariṣyāmi nayiṣye me’kṣaraṃ padam | aho yajña iti prājño guṇagrāhī bhavatyapi ||65|| tasya pāpābdhimevāhaṃ jvālayiṣyāmi keśavaḥ | yajñe dhṛtaṃ ca vastraṃ ca pātraṃ pāyasamityapi ||66|| yaḥ pradāsyati bhaktyā taṃ nayiṣye me’kṣaraṃ padam | godānaṃ pṛthivīdānaṃ gṛhadānaṃ vidhāsyati ||67|| kanyādānaṃ putradānaṃ kumāradānamityapi | svarṇadānaṃ rūpyadānaṃ yānavāhanadānakam ||68|| vāṭikodyānadānaṃ ca chatradānaṃ gajārpaṇam | yaḥ kariṣyati yajñe’tra taṃ nayiṣye’kṣaraṃ padam ||6 9|| ātmārpaṇaṃ tathā brahmārpaṇaṃ ca gurave’rpaṇam | sadbhyo’rpaṇaṃ ca yatkiñcid yathāśakti makhe’tra vai ||2.228.70|| yaḥ kariṣyati bhaktātmā dāsye’smai cākṣaraṃ padam | evamuktvā tato rādhe’nādiśrībālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||71 || mantrān dadau manuṣyebhyo makhibhyastatra vaiṣṇavān | tataḥ sandhyāṃ hariścakre devārārtrikamācarat ||72|| īśānapānaśiṣṭādyā rājādyāḥ śrīharerapi | ārārtrikaṃ pracakruśca pūjāṃ pūṣpāñjalīn dadau ||73|| prajāśca bhojayāmāsurmahīmānān samāgatān | yajñīyān karmaṭhān devān sarvāśca dehino’pi ca ||74|| āgantukān kautūhalānnirīkṣakān janānapi | āgatān vigatām̐ścāpi bhojanāni janādayaḥ ||75|| kārayāmāsuratyarthaṃ hareḥ kuṭumbakāni ca | miṣṭānnādyairvicitraiśca tattatsṛṣṭyucitairapi ||76 || sarvasṛṣṭinivāsām̐śca bhojayāmāsurīśvarāḥ | jalapānāni miṣṭāni tāmbūlāni dadustataḥ ||77|| rātrāvāsan kathāśrāvāḥ pradarśanāni vai tataḥ | nidrārāmāstataścāsan sarve vai dehino niśi ||78|| yathocitaṃ virāmasthāḥ prātarjajāgarurdrutam | maṃgalairvādyaghoṣaiśca gītibhirdevayoṣitām ||79|| sūtamāgadhabandīnāṃ yaśogānaiḥ samantataḥ | aṣṭamyāṃ rādhike prātarjajāgāra hariḥ svayam ||2.228.80|| kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtapūjaḥ pitarau svau pupūja ha | brahmapriyādyāḥ sarvāśca hariṃ pupūjurīśvaram ||8 1 || śrīharirlomaśaṃ natvā jagrāhāśīrvacastataḥ | rājāno rājabhṛtyāśca rājñyaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram ||82|| pupūjuścandanādyaiśca papuśca caraṇāmṛtam | tato muhūrtasadbhāve śrutvā vādyadhvaniṃ śubham ||83|| hariryajñasthale bhaktaiḥ sameto maṇḍape yayau | kṛtaśuddhirhariścāpi rājānaḥ karmaṭhāstathā | aparā devakoṭyaśceśvarāvatārakoṭayaḥ ||84|| mānavāḥ ṛṣayo devāḥ pitaraḥ sthāvarāstathā | jaṃgamā naranāryaśca maṇḍape tūrṇamāyayuḥ ||85|| sāmagryo havyarūpiṇyo havyavāhāśca vahnayaḥ | havyadā yajamānāśca yajñe tatra samāyayuḥ ||86 || viprāḥ karmaprayoktāro vedāḥ svarāśca gītayaḥ | kāśyapyaśca prajāḥ sarvā maṇḍape tatra cāyayuḥ ||87|| prokṣaṇaṃ svastivācaśca puṇyāhavacanānyapi | abhavan devatānāṃ prābodhanaṃ ca samantrakam ||88|| snānaṃ prapūjanaṃ patrapuṣpākṣatādivastubhiḥ | sarvopacāraiḥ subhagairdhūpadīpādibhistathā ||89|| ārārtrikaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalapānaṃ tathā tadā | tāmbūlādipradānaṃ ca mahāhutipradānakam ||2.228.90 || pūrvato’pyadhikaṃ jātaṃ havyadānaṃ tadānale | carordānaṃ pāyasādipradānaṃ ca phalārpaṇam || 91 || evaṃ yāvatpradehibhya āhutayaḥ samarpitāḥ | tṛpyuttaraṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ cābhavad bahu |||92||| devīnāṃ mātṛkāṇāṃ ceśvarīṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā | śaktināṃ vāminīnāṃ ca śrāddhaṃ ca tarpaṇaṃ hyabhūt ||93|| sṛṣṭitrayaṃ prataptaṃ ca parihāraṃ kratostataḥ | cakāra śrīhariḥ paścād bhojanānyabhavam̐stadā ||94|| madhyāhnottaravelāyāṃ sarve bubhujire janāḥ | miṣṭānnāni vicitrāṇi sudhāmṛtāni yāni ca || 95|| divyān rasām̐stathā divyapīyūṣāṇi śubhāni ca | brahmarasān dhāmarasān siddharasān parottamān ||96|| papurbubhujire devāḥ sṛṣṭitrayanivāsinaḥ | tṛptā bhojanamāsādya jalapānaṃ tataḥ param ||97|| takrapānaṃ pracakruśca phalādanaṃ ca tatparam | tāmbūlagrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā viśaśramurnivāsake ||98|| tataḥ sāyaṃ bālakṛṣṇaḥ sabhāyāṃ vai samāyayau | prajābhyo rādhike naijaṃ copadeśaṃ dadau hariḥ ||99|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne saptamyāṃ prātarmakhakāryāṇi nirvartya śrīhariṇā kṛtaṃ svasya sarvātmakatvādyupadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrāvutsavaḥ, tataḥ prātaraṣṭamyāṃ makhakāryavinirvartanaṃ bhojanama cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 228 ||
<2.229> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike lokānupādideśa mādhavaḥ | tyāga eva tu sarveṣāṃ mahāsukhaprade mataḥ || 1 || tyajanaṃ tyāga evāsti dūrīkaraṇamityapi | anāgrahaṇamevāpi tyāga eva hi so’rthataḥ || 2 || tṛṣṇātyāge mahāśāntiricchātyāge nivartanam | dravyatyāge karmaśāntirbhogatyāge vratodbhavaḥ || 3 || sukhatyāge tapaḥprāptiḥ sarvatyāge vimokṣaṇam | tyāgamārgo hi duḥkhānāṃ viprahāṇāya jāyate || 4 || yatra yena bhaved duḥkhaṃ tattat tyaktvā sukhī bhavet | māyāṃ tyaktvā guṇātīto brahmānandabharo bhavet || 5 || guṇayoge guṇabhāvāḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vimohanam | guṇatyāge guṇabhāvavidhvaṃsaścātmano bhavet || 6 || sattvaṃ rajastamaśceti śītoṣṇāṃgārasādhanāḥ | praharṣaḥ prītirānandaḥ sukhaṃ saṃśāntacittatā || 7 || sāttvikāḥ saṃbhavantyete vairāgyādveṣṭalābhataḥ | atuṣṭiḥ paritāpaśca śoko lobhastathākṣamā || 8 || rājasāḥ saṃbhavantyete rāgādvā dviṣṭalābhataḥ | avivekastathā mohaḥ pramādaḥ svapnatandrite || 9 || tāmasāḥ saṃbhavantyete jāḍyādvā buddhivibhramāt | iṣṭatāyāḥ parityāge sāttvikānāṃ layo bhavet || 2.229.1 0|| dviṣṭatāyāḥ parityāge rājasānāṃ layo bhavet | vibhraṃśasya parityāge tāmasānāṃ layo bhavet || 11 || evaṃ guṇatrayatyāge guṇātītasthitirbhavet | saccidānandarūpaṃ svaṃ vindati cetanaḥ svayam || 1 2|| evaṃ sati rūpanāmākṛtayo’sya na vai tadā | rūpanāmākṛtijanyāhantā na mamatāpi na || 13 || tayostyāge cetanasya mokṣabhāvo’bhijāyate | lipyate karmabhirnaiva na badhyate’pi mucyate || 1 4|| dṛḍhapāśā gatāścāsya śarīrendriyasaṃbhavāḥ | gatāścāntaḥkaraṇotthāstadā mukto’grago bhavet || 1 5|| aparokṣānubhavavān kālamṛtyubhayātigaḥ | puṇyāpuṇyātmapātheyaśūnyaḥ phalavivarjitaḥ || 16 || cidambarātmānamāpya cidākāśe pramodate | ūrṇanābhirhi nirbandhaḥ svajāle mukta eva saḥ || 1 7|| gireḥ patito grāvā vai bandhaśūnyo yathaiva saḥ | purāṇaṃ ruroḥ śṛṃgaṃ tyaktaṃ bandhāya naiva tat || 18 || tyaktā jīrṇā na bandhāya tvak sarpasya yathā tu vai | picchaṃ tyaktaṃ na bandhāya picchinastattathaiva ca | | 19 || nadyāṃ patan drumastyaktaḥ pakṣiṇo bandhanāya na | evaṃ dehālayaṃ tyaktvā vimukto vai mahāsukhī || 2.229.20 || dehe sthito’pi yaḥ prajñāmetāmāśritya vartate | muktavanmukta evāyaṃ guṇāsaṃgī mahāsukhī || 21 || atha loke sthitaścāpi guṇayogena vartate | tasyāpi sukhabāhulyasādhanaṃ dama eva ha || 22 || kriyāstapaḥ sukhaṃ satyaṃ dame sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | damastejo vardhayati bhayaṃ pāpaṃ nikṛntati || 23 || sukhaṃ dāntaḥ prasvapiti sukhaṃ ca pratibudhyate | sukhaṃ lokaiḥ samanveti sukhaṃ hṛdi prasīdati || 24|| damena vardhate cātmabalaṃ bhāgyamudeti ca | satkāryāṇāṃ phalaṃ sarvaṃ dame dānte pratiṣṭhati || 25 || bhavantyete guṇā nityā damayuktasya dehinaḥ | akārpaṇyamasaṃraṃbhaḥ santoṣaḥ śraddadhānatā || 26 || akrodha ārjavaṃ saumyaṃ nātivādo na paiśunam | nābhimānaṃ nāpyasūyā dayā ca gurupūjanam || 27|| janavādamṛṣāvādastutinindāvivarjanam | sādhukāmaḥ spṛhāśūnyaścāvairaḥ sūpacāravān || 28 || suvrataḥ śīlavān jalpavarjitaḥ suprasannahṛt | prasannātmātmavān doṣān jitvātmaniṣṭhasaṃsthitiḥ || 29 || sarvabhūtahite yukto na sma dviṣṭe’paraṃ tu yaḥ | mahāhradaṃ ivākṣobhyaḥ prajñātṛptaḥ prasādavān || 2.229.30 || kālākāṃkṣī carellokān nirapāya ivātmavān | svargavanmokṣavaccāpi dānto guṇairitīdṛśaiḥ ||3 1 || namasyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ brahmavanmodate sukhī | tyāgastapaḥ paraṃ proktaṃ dāntistapaḥ parottamam ||32|| ārjavaṃ tapasāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ maunaṃ śīlaṃ paraṃ tapaḥ | amṛtāśitvamaparaṃ tapaḥ sādhuprasevanam ||33|| kṛtaprajñasya dāntasya vitṛṣṇasya nirāśiṣaḥ | śrīharau dhyānaśīlasya sthairyaṃ tatparamaṃ tapaḥ ||34|| ārjavenāpramādena prasādena ca sevayā | vṛddhaśuśrūṣayā śāntyā tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ prajāyate ||35|| prajñālābhāttu puruṣaḥ sarvaṃ tudati kilbiṣam | vimāyiko labhate śaṃ śāntisthaḥ samprasīdati ||36|| labdhavyānyeva labhati gantavyānyeva gacchati | prāptavyānyeva prāpnoni duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca ||37|| etadviditvā kārtsyena yo na muhyati dehavān | kuśalī sa sadā cāste sa vai sarvadhano mataḥ ||38|| tasmād guṇānupārjyaiva sato seveta cānayān | satsaṃgena bhaved vṛddhirguṇānāṃ brahmagāminām ||39|| brahmaprāptirbhavettena sarvārpaṇena mādhave | ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prajājanān ||2.229.40|| manūnaśrāvayat samyag vaiṣṇavām̐stān vyadhāpayat | aṣṭamyāstu rajanyāṃ vai datvopadeśanaṃ tataḥ ||41 || bhagavān bhojayāmāsa sarvān vai mahīmānakān | prajāśca bhojayāmāsa tathā naijakuṭumbakam ||42|| svayaṃ bhuktvā ca viśrāntiṃ lebhe suyoganidrikām | navamyāṃ maṃgaladhvānaiḥ sūtamāgadhagītibhiḥ ||43|| bandīgītayaśovrātaiḥ prabubodha mahāprabhuḥ | kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtapūjaḥ kṛtavṛddhābhipūjanaḥ ||44|| māṃgalike muhūrte tvāyayau kratoḥ sumaṇḍapam | rājādayo yajamānāḥ samāyayustu maṇḍape ||45|| yathāpūrvamabhavacca yajñakāryaṃ samastakam | madhyāhne cāhutiṃ datvā bhagavān bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||46|| bhojayāmāsa sarvāṃśca svayaṃ ca bubhuje prabhuḥ | sāyaṃ vimānamāruhya samudropari cāmbare ||47|| rājabhiḥ saha bhagavān vihārārthaṃ yayau tataḥ | samāgatya nijaṃ sthānaṃ sandhyāṃ cakāra keśavaḥ ||48|| bhojayitvā janān bhuktvā rātrau viśrāntimāpa ca | daśamyāmapi prātaḥ sa kṛtāhnikaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||49|| yajñamaṇḍapamāgatya yajamānaiḥ sametakaḥ | maharṣibhiḥ kratoḥ kāryaṃ kārayitvā tathā havān |||2.229.50|| datvā madhyāhnavelāyāṃ bhojayāmāsa vāḍavān | mahīmānān samastāṃśca svayaṃ ca bubhuje tataḥ ||51|| sāyaṃ manūn dadau tatra bhaktebhyo bhagavān prabhuḥ | śrāddhāni kārayāmāsa vāḍavairbahutarpaṇam ||52|| rātrau bhojanamāsādya viśrāntiṃ cāpa mādhavaḥ | ekādaśyāṃ prage śīghraṃ samuttasthau sureśvaraḥ ||53|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān hariḥ | kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtapūjo maṇḍapaṃ drutamāyayau ||54|| vastūnāṃ prokṣaṇaṃ svastivācaḥ puṇyāhavācanam | kārayitvā surādīnāṃ prabodhanaṃ ca pūjanam ||55|| balidānaṃ mahānaivedyakaṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ tathā | homaṃ havyaviśeṣāṇāṃ pradadau bhagavām̐stataḥ ||56|| sahasraghṛtadhārābhistarpayāmāsa devatāḥ | tadā pratyakṣarūpāste bhuktavantaḥ surādayaḥ ||57|| sthāvarā jaṃgamā sarve tṛptiṃ prāptāḥ suhavyakaiḥ | iyaṃ cākṣaradhāmādhipataye cāhutirnamaḥ ||58|| imā muktebhya evāpi cāhutayaśca tānnumaḥ | imāḥ sarvāvatārebhyaścāhutayaśca tānnumaḥ ||59|| imā īśebhya āhutayaśca tebhyo namonamaḥ | imāḥ ṛṣibhyaḥ sarvebhya āhutayaśca tānnumaḥ ||2.229.60 || imāḥ pitṛbhyaāhutayastebhyaśca namonamaḥ | imā devebhya āhutayaśca tebhyo namonamaḥ ||61 || imā bhuvarnivāsibhya āhutayaśca tānnumaḥ | imā mānavajātibhya āhutayaśca tānnumaḥ ||62|| imāḥ saptatalavāsibhyaścāhutayastānnumaḥ | imā drumebhyaḥ sarvebhyo latātṛṇebhya ityapi ||63 || kandamūlādiyāvadbhyā āhutayaśca tānnumaḥ | imāḥ kīṭapataṃgādibhyaścāhutayastānnumaḥ ||64||| sarvayoṣidbhyaśca sṛṣṭitrayasthābhya imā numaḥ | jaḍebhyaścetanebhyaśca tattvebhyo’pi nama imāḥ ||65|| āhutayaḥ pradattāste tṛptiṃ yāntu hi dehinaḥ | ityevaṃ sruci śreṣṭhājyaṃ śrīphalaṃ samidhastathā ||66|| patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ miṣṭaṃ nidhāya sarvajātikam | mahāpūrṇāhutiṃ naumi namaskṛtya vicintanam ||67|| agnirnārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāttasmai dadāmi te namaḥ | idamagnaye ca vaiśvānarāya paramātmane ||68|| ityuktvā pradadau vahnau nārikelādikaṃ hariḥ | rājānaḥ pradaduścāpi śrīphalādyāni vai tadā ||69|| namaste gārhapatyāya namaste dakṣiṇāgnaye | namaścāhavanīyāya mahāvedisthitāya ca ||2.229.70|| brahmaṇe gārhapatyāya viṣṇave dakṣiṇāgnaye | śivāyāhavanīyāya śaktivedisthitāya ca ||71 || namaste sabhyarūpāya namo gṛhyāgnirūpiṇe | pañcāgnirūpiṇe tubhyaṃ namaste paramātmane ||72|| namo’gnihotrarūpāya namaḥ parveṣṭirūpiṇe | cāturmāsyasvarūpāya namaḥ paśviṣṭirūpiṇe ||73|| sautrāmaṇaye tubhyaṃ namo’gniṣṭomāya te namaḥ | atyagniṣṭomarūpāya namaste coktharūpiṇe ||74|| namaḥ ṣoḍaśarūpāya vājapeyāya te namaḥ | atirātrasvarūpāya sarvamedhātmane namaḥ ||75||| tvaṃ mukhaṃ sarvajīvānāṃ tvayāttaṃ tarpayet surān | jīvasṛṣṭirīśasṛṣṭirbrahmasṛṣṭiśca yā matā ||76|| tāsāṃ tṛptipradastvaṃ vai havyabhuk havyamāvaha | yāntu havyāni sarvebhyaḥ svadhāsvāhādyudīraṇāt ||77|| kālī karālī dhūmrā ca manobhavā sphulliṃginī | piṃgā raktā ca te jihvā tābhirgrasa havirmuhuḥ ||78|| pūgīphalāni ca vahnau phalānyanyāni yāni ca | praduduśca tadā vahnau tṛpyatāṃ parameśvaraḥ ||79|| ityuktvā śrīharikṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇo mahāprabhuḥ | mahāpūrṇāhutiṃ cāntāṃ dadau śrīpataye tadā ||2.229.80|| evaṃ homaṃ pradāyaiva brahmaṇe pātrakārpaṇam | kṛtavān śrīharirbrahmāyajamānābhiṣecanam ||81 || kṛtvāmṛtābhiṣekaṃ ca śreyodānaṃ tato’karot | dakṣiṇārpaṇamevāpi maṇḍape cākaroddhariḥ ||82|| svarṇagobhūtilādīnāṃ dānānyadāpayat prabhuḥ | rājāno rājyayogyāni dānāni pradadustadā ||83|| athābhiṣekam ṛṣayo lomaśādyā vyadhustadā | pavamānāni ṛṣayo hyāśīrvādām̐stadā jaguḥ ||84|| bhūyasīṃ sampradāyaivāśīrvādām̐śca dadustathā | smṛddhayaḥ santu divyā vo’kṣayāḥ śāśvatasaukhyadāḥ ||85|| kuṭumbavaṃśavistārāḥ prabhavantu nirogiṇaḥ | rājyavaibhavapaśavo dāsā dāsyo bhavantu vaḥ ||86|| āyurdīrghaṃ yaśo divyaṃ cānte svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam | bhavantu bhogyajātāni bhavatāṃ sarvadā tviha ||87|| sarve bhavantu sukhinaḥ sarve santu nirogiṇaḥ | svargaṃ dīrghaṃ paraṃ bhuktvā prayāntvante’kṣaraṃ padam ||88|| ityuktvā yajñadevānāṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ vidāyakam | pradadurlomaśādyāśca parihārastato’bhavat ||89|| yajñaprasādaṃ havyaṃ vai sarve bubhujire makhe | yeṣāṃ yeṣāṃ ca yānyeva havyāni tāni tāni vai ||2.229.90|| tebhyastebhyo harikṛṣṇo dattavān nijaśaktibhiḥ | sarvavidhāni bhojyāni havyānyamṛtakāni ca ||9 1|| sudhārasām̐śca vividhān pīyūṣapānakoṭikāḥ | yathāyogyebhyaḥ pradadau tṛptayāmāsa yāvataḥ || 92|| tato’dhikaṃ bhojanaṃ ca dadau bhikṣukayāyine | bhikṣukānāthanārībhyo pradadau bhojanānyapi ||93|| sarvebhyaḥ pradadāvekādaśyāṃ madhyāhnakottaram | bhojanāni samastāni pitṛśrāddhaṃ tato’karot ||94|| anekāni phalādīni jalādīnyapi sandadau | sāyaṃ sabhāyāṃ bhagavān niṣasāda śubhāsane ||95|| dadau mantrān janebhyaśca vyadhād vaiṣṇavasattamān | nijaṃ divyaṃ darśanaṃ ca dadau tvakṣaradhāmagam || 96|| brahmapriyābhirmuktaiśca sevitaṃ pārameśvaram | punastatra bālakṛṣṇasvarūpaḥ sambabhūva ha ||97|| yajñatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ janebhyaḥ prajagāda ca | rādhike tattadā sṛṣṭitrayaṃ śuśrāva vai mudā ||98|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āśvinakṛṣṇanavamīdaśamyekādaśīṣu yajñādikāryanirvartanaṃ mahāpūrṇāhutipradānaṃparihāro bhojanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 229 ||
<2.230> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike yajñabhūmau ca yāni tīrthāni cāvasan | tānyāha śrībālakṛṣṇaścāmrajānīsarittaṭe || 1 || yatra nārāyaṇaścāsmi yajñakartā pareśvaraḥ | sā bhūmistvakṣaratulyā divyā divyagatipradā || 2 || āmrajānīnadī divyā svargaṃgā badarīsutā | āmrajānyapsarā divyā nareṇa nijaśaktitaḥ || 3 || āmramañjarikābhiśca pramṛdyotpāditā purā | tapaścaryāpravighnārthaṃ purā mahendra āyayau || 4 || bahvapsarobhiḥ sahito badaryāṃ śrīhareḥ puraḥ | nārāyaṇena tāḥ sarvā nṛtyantyaścendradeśitāḥ || 5 || vilokitāstatastāsāṃ garvabhaṃgāya vai mayā | badaryāṃ ca naradvārā hyurvaśī prakaṭīkṛtā || 6 || tasyāstu sannidhau sarvāstadā śyāmā ivābhavan | rūpagarvaṃ vihāyaiva tatra kṣamāmayācire || 7 || tadā mayā tu tāḥ sarvā mantreṇa vaiṣṇavīkṛtāḥ | āmrajānīṃ yayāce vai mahendro rūpasundarīm || 8 || sā mayā tu mahendrāyārpitā tvekasvarūpiṇī | dvitīyā brahmacaryasthā matputrī mama sannidhau || 9 || badaryāṃ sā vasatyeva sātra jalasvarūpiṇī | pārākarṣitapaścaryāphaladānārthamāgatā || 2.230.10 || pārāko nāma rājarṣiḥ pitṝṇāṃ muktaye’tra vai | tapaścacāra paramaṃ varṣāṇāṃ tu sahasrakam || 11 || pūrvajānāṃ pratṛptyarthaṃ jalārthaṃ so’pyakalpayat | māṃ dhyāyan jalalābhārthaṃ tīrthaṃ śreṣṭhamayācata || 1 2|| mama mūrtiṃ pratuṣṭāva dhyānamagno’tibhāvataḥ | mayā hṛdā prasannena smṛtā putrī madāśrayā || 13 || seyaṃ jalasvarūpābhūt putrī mamājñayā tadā | saptadhārāsvarūpā sā bhūtvā brāhmīlabhūtale || 14|| pravāheṇa gatā yatra yatra pitara āsate | tatra tatra kṛtasteṣāṃ mokṣo yayuśca te’kṣaram || 15 || seyaṃ cāmrajanī divyā mokṣadā vartate nadī | tasyā rūpāṇi saptātra āmrajānī varīyasī || 16 || rākāntikāsanā cāpi dvitīyā sā prakīrtitā | gonikaṣā tṛtīyā ca goyājñī ca caturthikā || 17|| mādvārikā pañcamī ca ṣaṣṭhī sā puruṣā matā | mānāsanā saptamī ca sarvā mokṣapradā hi tāḥ || 18 || śāntārāmā purī ceyaṃ pāreśvaraṃ ca pattanam | āmrajānīsamudrasaṃgamaśca mokṣadaḥ sadā | | 1 9|| mahāpāpātipāpānāṃ kṣālakaḥ saṃgamo hyayam | atra bhūmau tu yajñānāṃ tīrthānāṃ bhūbhṛtāṃ tathā || 2.230.20 || mervādīnāṃ ca sarasāṃ nadīnāṃ vāsa eva ca | mayā saṃkalpitastasmāt tīrthānyatra vasantu vai || 21 || āmrajānyāṃ ṣaḍanyāsāṃ nadīnāṃ saṃgameṣviha | muktāstathāvatārāśceśvarā devā vasantvapi || 22|| devyaśca śaktayaścāpi sāgarāḥ saritastathā | sarvatīrthanivāso’tra bhavatviti nideśanam ||23 || bālakṛṣṇasthalī śāntārāmapāreśvarāntare| sarvatīrthanivāsā vai pāvanyakṣarasannibhā ||24|| goyājanyā gavākṣāyā madhye pṛthivī yāvatī | triśatakrośaparyantā sarvā mokṣapradā śubhā ||25|| atra snānena muktiḥ syād vāpyāṃ kūpe taḍāgake | nadīnāṃ jalapānena mama dhāma vrajejjanaḥ ||26|| svalpānnadānakaraṇād yajñajaṃ phalamāpnuyāt| | godānāt svarṇadānācca svargaṃ labhenna saṃśayaḥ ||27|| kanyādānaṃ bhuvo dānaṃ vastradānaṃ gavārpaṇam | bhūṣādānaṃ cānnadānaṃ pātradānaṃ kariṣyati ||28|| atra bhūmau tasya rājasūyaphalaṃ bhaviṣyati | oṣadhānāṃ pradānaṃ ca vidyādānaṃ jalārpaṇam ||29|| rasadānaṃ chatradānaṃ copakaraṇadānakam | gṛhadānaṃ vāhanānāṃ dānaṃ jñānapradānakam ||2.230.3 0|| yaḥ kariṣyati tasyātra sarvayajñaphalaṃ bhavet | vṛkṣāropaṃ phaladānaṃ dharmaśālāṃ ca vedikām || 31 || gṛhaṃ saudhaṃ nadīghaṭṭaṃ kārayiṣyati yo janaḥ | tasya svargaṃ bhaved dhrauvyaṃ tvante mokṣo bhavedapi ||32|| śubhe kāle śubhe pātre dattaṃ cātrākṣayaṃ bhavet | śayyādānaṃ bṛsīdānaṃ corṇāmbarapradānakam ||33|| dāsyatyatra bhavettasya svargaṃ ceha samṛddhayaḥ | vividhā rājabhogāśca vaṃśavistārasampadaḥ ||34|| atra tīrthaṃ tu ye lokāḥ saptasaritsu yatra vā | kariṣyanti jalapānaṃ snānaṃ caiṣyanti te divam ||35|| ityuktvā śrīharistatra rādhike virarāma ha | īśvarādyā nijāvāsaṃ cakrustīrthasvarūpiṇaḥ ||36|| saptanadyaḥ samāyātāḥ kanyakāstatra vai kṣaṇe | candanādyaiḥ svapitaraṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram ||37|| pupūjuḥ pādayornatvā prāhurvasātra sarvadā | haristathāstviti prāha mūrtirūpaḥ svayaṃprabhuḥ ||38|| tata ārabhya tatraiva mandireṣvavasat sadā | rājabhyaśca dadau svarṇamūrtīḥ śrīhariracyutaḥ ||39|| kanyakāstā yayustīrtharūpiṇyo vai nijālayān | rājāno’pi tataścakrurmandirāṇi sarittaṭe ||2.230.40 || suvarṇamūrtīsteṣu prātiṣṭhipan vidhinā nṛpāḥ | evaṃ vai rādhike śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||41 || upādiśyātha pradadau pāritoṣikarūpiṇaḥ | suvarṇasthālān mahataḥ suvarṇotthakamaṇḍalūn ||42|| suvarṇahārān vividhān mukuṭān kānakām̐stathā | svarṇasrajaḥ kuṇḍalāni śṛṃkhalāḥ kaṭakāni ca ||43 || hemaratnāni bhūṣāśca hemasūtrāmbarāṇyapi | svarṇahīrakasadratnapātrāṇi kalaśām̐stathā ||44|| veṣān śāṭīḥ kañcukīśca kauśeyīḥ svarṇabuṭṭikāḥ | yānavāhanadāsām̐śca dāsīśca mudrikāstathā ||45|| evaṃvidhāni pradadau sampāritoṣikāni vai | tato dadau dhanyavādān mahīmānebhya cādhvare ||46|| yajñasāhāyyakartṝṃścāśīrbhistatrāpyayūyujat | atra rātrau pāyasāni bhojanāni phalāni ca ||47|| akārayaddhi bhagavān sarvāṃstatra mahotsave | nṛtyagītotsavānte ca viśaśrāma pareśvaraḥ ||48|| nidrāṃ jagrāha bhagavān prātarbubodha maṃgalaiḥ | kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtapūjo mātāpitṛprasevakaḥ ||49|| āsane niṣasādāthāyayustatra nṛpādayaḥ | arcanaṃ śrīhareścakruḥ sannyadhuścopadāḥ puraḥ ||2.230.50|| dvādaśyāṃ ca tataḥ sarvānabhojayat prabhuḥ svayam | miṣṭānnāni vicitrāṇi rasān peyāni yānyapi ||5 1 || bhakṣyabhojyānyanekāni bhojayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ | svayaṃ sububhuje kṛṣṇastataḥ sabhāṃ cakāra ha ||52|| avabhṛthārthaṃ prayayuḥ sarve bhagavatā saha | āsam̐statra tu nārīṇāṃ devīnāṃ gītikā śubhāḥ |||53|| vādyānāṃ ninadāścāpi vedaghoṣāśca bhūsadām | āmrajānyāṃ gonikaṣāsaṃgame’vabhathaṃ tadā ||54|| cakrurmukhyaṃ mahāsnānaṃ varuṇādyarcanaṃ tathā | ye ye yatrābhavam̐ścāpi tatra sasnuśca tatra ca ||55|| tūpaśabdā yantraśabdāḥ śatadhnīdhvanayo’bhavan | saritsāgarasaṃyoge saritāṃ saṃgame tathā ||56 || vimānairdivyayānaiśca gatvā sasnuḥ prajājanāḥ | īśvarāścāpi devādyā dehinaḥ sasnurityapi ||57|| tataścāyayurāvāsān śrīharyādyā vimānakaiḥ | madhyāhnottaravelāyāṃ pitṛśrāddhāni cācaran ||58|| sarve’pi pitarastatra mūrtimantaḥ samāgatāḥ | tṛptiṃ prāpya vimānaiśca yayuḥ svargaṃ sahasraśaḥ ||59|| atha bhojanaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ bhojayāmāsa mādhavaḥ | sarve bubhujurmiṣṭānnaṃ punastatra sabhābhavat ||2.230.60 || vidāyaṃ śrīharistatra pradadau tu yathocitam | karmaṭhebhyaḥ karmakartṛbhyaśca sahāyivargiṇe ||6 1|| muktebhyaśceśvarebhyaścāvatārebhyaśca śobhanam | īśvarāṇībhya evāpi muktānībhyastathā dadau ||62|| devībhyo devatābhyaścārṣībhyo munibhya ityapi | mānavībhyo manuṣyebhyo maharṣibhyo’pi sandadau ||63|| jaḍebhyaścetanebhyaśca sarvebhyo’pi dadau hariḥ | yathocitaṃ vidāyaṃ vai kalpayoṣidbhya ityapi ||64|| karmakartrībhya evāpi dāsadāsībhya ityapi | pradadau svarṇahārām̐śca svarṇamudrāyathocitāḥ ||65|| āgantavyaṃ ceti punaryadā yajñe smarāmyaham | ityevaṃ śrīhariḥ prāha tato labdhvā vidāyakam ||66|| sabhāṃ vyasarjayat paścānmahīmānāḥ pratasthire | nijām̐llokānpradeśām̐śca grāmān sāyaṃ hi sarvaśaḥ ||67|| dvādaśyāmevamevāpi samājāḥ svagṛhān yayuḥ | rātrau śrībhagavānāste rājabhiḥ sevitaḥ sukham ||68|| brahmapriyādibhiścāpi kuṭumbena samanvitaḥ | nidrāṃ viśrāntirūpāṃ cāvāpa prātarbubodha ca ||69|| trayodaśyāṃ māṃgalikairvādyādyairgītibhirhariḥ | kṛtasnānāhnikaḥ kṛṣṇo niṣasāda varāsane ||2.230.70 || īśānapānaśiṣṭaśca rājā rājñī ca kanyakāḥ | hariṃ pūjayituṃ prātaścāyayuste tadā hareḥ ||71|| nīrājanāṃ pracakruśca pupūjuścandanādibhiḥ | brāhmīlyaḥ kanyakāścaikacatvāriṃśannṛpasya tu ||72|| varamālāṃ hareḥ kaṇṭhe daduḥ kāntaṃ hariṃ vyadhuḥ | rājā tvatiprasanno’bhūd yautakaṃ paramaṃ dadau ||73|| rājñī cāpi kṛtakṛtyā hyabhūt tatra mumoda ha | yautakaṃ haraye prādāt svarṇarūpyadhanādikam ||74|| vimānaṃ cāyataṃ cāpi dāsān dāsīḥ śatādhikāḥ | rājā mahotsavaṃ cakre kanyādānanimittataḥ ||75|| madhyāhne bhojanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dadau rājātibhāvataḥ | anyebhyaścāpi sarvebhyo rājabhyo bhojanaṃ dadau ||76|| vidāyaṃ pradadau paścād rājabhyo nṛpatirmahān | rājānaḥ prayayurnaijān deśān vimānasaṃsthitāḥ ||77|| tatra tāvat trayodaśyāṃ śrīmān rāyapatirnṛpaḥ | rāyagirarṣisahitaḥ prārthayāmāsa keśavam ||78|| nijadeśaṃ samāgantuṃ pāvayituṃ nijāṃ purīm | haristathāstviti prāha viśvakarmādikām̐stataḥ ||79|| sarvayajñīyavastūnāṃ parihārārthameva ha | maṇḍapādikadivyānāṃ samādideśa tūrṇakam ||2.230.80|| śīghraṃ sāyaṃ viśvakarmā tirobhāvayadeva tat | atha sajjo’bhavat kṛṣṇaḥ kuṭumbādyairyutastadā ||8 1|| śaṃkarādyaiḥ pārṣadaiśca tathā sarvamaharṣibhiḥ | tāvad rājā sainyayukto vidāye mānane hareḥ ||82|| avādayattadā ramyavāditrāṇi muhurmuhuḥ | hariḥ sammānamādāya puṣpahārān śubhān śubhān ||83|| brāhmīlībhiścākṣatādyairvardhitaḥ pūjito hariḥ | jayaśabdaiḥ śrāvitaścāruroha svavimānakam ||84|| kuṭumbena saha kṛṣṇo maharṣiśaṃkarādibhiḥ | vimānago’bhavaccātha prasasārāmbare’gragam ||85|| vidāyayantraśabdāścābhavam̐ścāti nṛpājñayā | rājārāyapatiścāgre vimānena yayau drutam ||86|| svāgatārthaṃ harestatra sainyaṃ prāsajjayad drutam | ārṣajatanurāṣṭre sve parīnāsaritastaṭe ||87|| vyenojarāśāpuryāṃ vai mahodyāne viśālake | sammānārthaṃ sainyayutastasthau rājā samālikaḥ ||88|| tāvadākāśamārgādvai vimānaṃ śobhanaṃ tadā | sūryavaccāgataṃ śīghraṃ dyotayan vidiśo diśaḥ ||89|| tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāstathābhavan | paryaḥ samantato vīkṣaṇārthaṃ dudruvurādarāt ||2.230.90|| rājadarśitamārgeṇa vimānaṃ śrīharirbhuvi | udyānamadhye bhūbhāge’vātārayacchannaiḥ śanaiḥ | harirvimānataḥ śīghraṃ tvagrabhāge bahiryayau ||9 1|| janānāṃ puṣpavṛṣṭirvai vimānopari cābhavat | akṣatādyairvardhitaśca prajābhiḥ parameśvaraḥ ||92|| rājā svarṇasrajaḥ kaṇṭhe kṛṣṇasyādhānnanāma ca | tadā rājñī puṣpamālāṃ kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe nyadhānmudā ||93|| kumārāśca kumāryaścandanādyairarhaṇāṃ vyadhuḥ | siṃhāsane niṣasāda haristatra kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ||94|| datvā svadarśanaṃ siṃhāsanāttūtthāya catvare | āyayau nṛpatistaṃ sugaje śṛṃgārite mudā ||95|| kuṭumbaṃ śrīhareścāpi nyaṣādayad gajādiṣu | śakaṭīṣu ca vāheṣu yathāyogyaṃ ca yoṣitaḥ ||96|| śibikāsu tathā divyagantrīṣu ca nyaṣādayat | atha vādyādininadairgītibhiśca suvardhitaḥ ||97|| harṣanādairjayaśabdaistathā gāyanakīrtanaiḥ | vyenojarāśāpuryāṃ śrīhariḥ saṃbhrāmito’bhitaḥ ||98|| gopurāgre ca rājanyairnagaryāṃ ca pradhānakaiḥ | catvareṣu prajābhiśca haṭṭāgre dhanikaiḥ prabhuḥ ||99|| pūjitaścāpi rathyāgre yoṣidbhiḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | svarṇamudrādidānaiśca nārikelaphalādibhiḥ || 2.230.100|| vastrapātravibhūṣābhiścandanākṣatavāribhiḥ | vardhitaścābhitaḥ puryāṃ bhramitvā sainyaśobhitaḥ || 10 1|| samāyayau śubhāvāsaṃ rājasaudhaṃ haristataḥ | jalapānaṃ vidhāyaiva viśrāntimāpa dharmapaḥ || 102|| gṛhītvā bhojanaṃ rātrau nidrāṃ jagrāha keśavaḥ | brahmapriyādibhiḥ saṃsevitaḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 103||| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āmrajānyādisaptasaritsu devatīrthānāṃ vāso māhātmyamavabhṛtham, pāritoṣikam, rātriyāpanaṃ, prātarvidāyaṃ mahīmānamaṇḍapādiparihārastato rājārāyapatirāṣṭragamanaṃ vyenojarāśāpuryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau śayanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 230 ||
<2.231> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca caturdaśyāḥ prage rādhe āśvinakṛṣṇapakṣake | māṃgalikaistūryanādairgītibhiḥ prabubodha saḥ || 1 || bālakṛṣṇaḥ kṛtasnānapūjaḥ svāsanamāviśat | rājārāyapatiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayitumupāyayau || 2 || nanāma pādayorbhaktyābhiṣekaṃ payasā tadā | pādayoḥ pracakārātha prasādāmṛtamāpapau || 3 || sakuṭumbaḥ śrīpatiṃ taṃ cāndanaṃ tilakaṃ vyadhāt | sacandrakaṃ tathā ramyanetrayoḥ kajjalaṃ dadau || 4 || mukuṭaṃ mastake cāpi kuṇḍale karṇayordadau | kaṇṭhe suvarṇaratnāḍhyahārān praśṛṃkhalāṃ dadau || 5 || bhujabandhau ca kaṭakāvaṅgulīyakamūrmikāḥ | raśanāṃ nūpūrakau ca kaṭyāṃ pādaprakoṣṭhayoḥ || 6 || nidhārayāmāsa rājā bhagavantaṃ ramāpatim | sugandhigandhasārādi vyalepayattadāṅgake || 7 || yathocitaṃ puṣpahārān pradadau ca sugandhinaḥ | rājaveṣaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ dhārayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ || 8 || harirdadhāra pramudā rājñaḥ snehābhivṛddhaye | tato nīrājanaṃ cakre rājā rājñīsamanvitaḥ || 9 || kanyāścāsya trayastriṃśan mahānīrājanaṃ vyadhuḥ | varamālā dadurmugdhā bālakṛṣṇasya vakṣasi || 2.231.10|| patiṃ prāpya prabheśaṃ tāḥ kṛtakṛtyāstadābhavan | rājā taṃ kānake siṃhāsane ramye nṛpārcite || 1 1|| niṣādya śrīhareḥ rājyamukuṭaṃ mastake dadau | rājyaṃ ca kanyakāḥ kṛṣṇa mokṣārthaṃ te pradīyate || 1 2|| ata ārabhya rājyaṃ te vayaṃ te dāsadāsikāḥ | atraiva bhagavam̐stiṣṭha kṛpāsindho parātpara || 1 3|| tvamātmā tvaṃ tvantarātmā paramātmā prabhurmataḥ | sarvaprāṇapate viṣṇo pāhi saṃsārasāgarāt || 14|| bhavaddattaṃ mayā rājyaṃ nirvāhitaṃ makhāvadhi | atha śrībhagavān svāmī samāyāto dhuraṃ vaha || 15|| tvannideśaṃ pālayiṣye bhṛtyavat tiṣṭha rājyapaḥ | anāyāsena bhagavān kṛpayāsmābhirarjitaḥ || 16|| yogino yasya labdhyarthaṃ tapaḥsu kṛcchrasādhiṣu | homaṃ nijāyuṣaḥ prakurvantyapi tvaṃ na cāpyase || 17|| siddhāḥ samādhibhājo’pi satataṃ tvāmupāsate | sākṣāttathāpi tvaṃ teṣāmakṣidṛśyo na jāyase || 18|| so’yaṃ vinā tapo me’tra gṛhe’nugrahataḥ prabho | samāgato mamoddhārakṛte kuṭumbinaśca me || 1 9|| sarvaṃ samarpya te haste kṛtakṛtyo bhavāmi tat | gṛhāṇa bhagavan dattaṃ rājyaṃ me mokṣamarpaya || 2.231.20|| mayā jñāto divyarūpastathā mānuṣavartanaḥ | avatārāvatārī tvaṃ śrutyuktaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 21 || brahmapriyāpate tvaṃ vai sāṃkhyayoginikāpate | lākṣmaṇīkānta kṛṣṇa tvaṃ cāraktānāṃ pate’va mām ||22|| uṣṇonāṃ kānta kṛṣṇa tvaṃ piśaṃgīnāṃ pate prabho | prācīnīnāṃ pate kṛṣṇa hāritīnāṃ pate’va mām ||23|| gaurīṇāṃ kānta bhagavannamarīṇāṃ pate vibho | brāhmīlīnāṃ parīṇāṃ ca pate rādhāpate’va mām ||24|| lakṣmīpate kṛpāsindho ramāsvāmin satāṃ pate | rājapate surādīnāṃ pate ceśapate’va mām ||25|| kamalā caraṇau te yā sevate lalitāpi yau | bahupuṇyena militau putrīṇāṃ mama keśava ||26|| sevate duḥkhahālakṣmīrjayā yau maṃjulā ca yau | nārāyaṇī sadguṇā yau tau divyau militau mama ||27|| māṇikyā sevate yau ca muktā yau sevate sakhī | padmāvatī satī hāsā sevate yau pramuktidau ||28|| catvāriṃśat śataṃ cāpi tathāparāstu koṭiśaḥ | sṛṣṭitrayanivāsinyastava dāsyo bhavanti hi || 29|| īśvarā avatārāśca muktā devā maharṣayaḥ | caraṇau yau prasevante te kṛpāplāvitā yadi ||2.231.3 0|| tau suprāptau mayā kṛṣṇa caraṇau pāvanau gṛhe | yatra sarvārpaṇaṃ pūrve rājānaścakrurātmanaḥ ||3 1 || āsāditau mayā tau vai tato’rpaye’va māṃ vibho | mahākālabhayaṃ māyābhayaṃ karmaprabandhanam ||32|| dūrayituṃ samarthaṃ netarat tato bhaje’va mām | śaraṇāgatarakṣa tvaṃ śaraṇyo’si janārdana |||33|| bhavapravāhapatitaṃ māmuddhara maheśvara | tava yogena divyaṃ me rājyaṃ gṛhaṃ dhanādikam ||34|| tīrtharūpaṃ mahajjātaṃ dhāmākṣarasamaṃ bhuvi | aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ rājārāyasya bhūtale ||35|| yadgṛhe kanyakākāntaḥ svayaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ parīnāsarito’pi ca ||36|| yatra tīrthāni sarvāṇi samāyānti te balāt | ārṣajatanturāṣṭrasya mahābhāgyaṃ pravartate ||37|| yatra nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādvartate parameśvaraḥ | vyenojarāśānagarī tavopasthititaḥ prabho ||38|| sārthakādya tu sañjātā sarvapāpavināśinī | mṛtyujarādirahitā tava vāsādajāyata ||39|| sadā tiṣṭha hare’cātra kariṣye tava sevanam | ityuktvā śrīhareścāgre daṇḍavat pracakāra ha ||2.231.40|| rādhike sā tato rājñī cakāra daṇḍavaddharim | mahotsavaṃ tataścakre caturdaśyāṃ mahattamam ||41|| prajāḥ pradhānā nāryaśca narāḥ samantatastadā | āyayurdarśanārtha vai dūrātidūradeśataḥ ||42|| tebhyo harirdadau mantrān sukhaṃ darśanajaṃ tathā | mānasānāṃ nijamūrtāvākarṣaṇena sarvathā ||43|| bhagavadbhāvanāṃ cāpi kārayāmāsa śāśvatīm | tatkṛtāṃ suprapūjāṃ ca jagrāha parameśvaraḥ ||44|| tebhyaḥ prāsādikaṃ datvā toṣayāmāsa keśavaḥ | divyaṃ svadarśanaṃ cāpi pradadau pārameśvaram ||45|| akṣarasya tathā golokasthaṃ vaikuṇṭhagaṃ tathā | avyākṛtasthaṃ rūpaṃ svaṃ cāmṛtasthaṃ tathā vibhuḥ ||46|| hiraṇmayaṃ tathā vahnimaṇḍalasthaṃ tathā punaḥ | viśālāsthaṃ śvetadhāmagataṃ kṣīrābdhivāsinam ||47|| tathā kuṃkumavāpīsthaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca gocaram | evaṃ tvanekarūpairvai pareśaṃ svamadarśayat ||48|| tena te kṛtakṛtyā vai narā nāryo’bhavam̐stadā | tebhyo mantrān dadau śrīmatsvāmiśrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ||49|| rājā prapūjya deveśaṃ bhojayāmāsa vai tataḥ | paryaḥ sarvāḥ kṛtakṛtyāḥ paryasevanta taṃ patim |||2.231.50 || hariḥ prāha ca rājānaṃ mama rājyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | tvayārpitaṃ mayā labdhaṃ punardadāmi te nṛpa |||51 || mamājñayā mahadrājyaṃ prapālaya yathocitam | dṛḍhaṃ ca mandiraṃ sāptaśikharaṃ saṃprakāraya |||52|| tatra māṃ śrīsametaṃ vai pratiṣṭhāpaya kānakam | svarṇamūrtau sadā sthāsye grahiṣye ca tvayā kṛtam ||53|| pūjanaṃ sarvadā rājan mamājñāṃ paripālaya | tathāstviti nṛpaḥ prāha rādhike drutameva ha ||54|| suvarṇamūrtiṃ tatraiva kārayāmāsa sannidhau | śrīsahitāṃ tatra kṛṣṇo viveśa gocaraḥ svayam ||55|| rājā gṛhe rarakṣaiva tataḥ kālena mandire | nyaveśayaddhariṃ caivaṃ siṣeve paramādarāt ||56|| caturdaśyāṃ ca madhyāhne bhojayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ | sāyakāle pitṛpūjāṃ parīnāsaritastaṭe ||57|| śrāddhāni vividhānyeva cakāra bhagavān svayam | pitṝṇāṃ jalapiṇḍādyaistṛptiṃ cakāra keśavaḥ ||58|| tataḥ sandhyāṃ pracakāra tataḥ saudhaṃ samāyayau | rātrau kanyāstu tāḥ sarvāḥ patiṃ naijaṃ siṣevire ||59|| prātarhariḥ prabubodha māṃgalikapragītibhiḥ | pravādyaiśca yaśobhiśca tataḥ sasnau nadījalaiḥ ||2.231.6 0|| amāvāsyādine pitṛjaladānaṃ cakāra ha | plakṣamūle dadau vāri sarvasṛṣṭibhya eva saḥ ||6 1 || āgatāḥ pitarastatra tṛptyarthaṃ harihastataḥ | muktā akṣarasaṃjñāśca golokāvāsagopakāḥ ||6 2|| pārṣadā vaikuṇṭhavāsā avyākṛtanivāsinaḥ | amṛtasthāstathā muktā anyavaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ ||63 || satyasthā brāhmasaṃjñāśca siddhā maharṣayastathā | brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyā munayo devatādayaḥ ||64|| aryamādyāśca pitaro mātṛkāḥ pitṛyoṣitaḥ | tathānye yāmyalokasthāstrilokisthāśca sarvataḥ ||65|| tṛptyarthaṃ tvāyayustatra nārāyaṇajalecchayā | śrīhariṃ svakarābhyāmañjalibhiḥ salilaṃ dadau ||66|| papuḥ sarve’pi pitaro muktiṃ gatāśca mokṣiṇaḥ | sthāninastṛptimāpuśca jagmurnijaṃ svarādikam ||67|| sarve tṛptiṃ gatā ye ye pitṛyonisthitāstadā | atha śrībhagavān svasyālayaṃ saudhaṃ samāyayau ||68|| pitṛśrāddhāni vividhaprakārāṇi tato’karot | piṇḍadānaiḥ pāyasādyaiḥ kṣīrānnabhojanādibhiḥ ||69|| phalapuṣpaudanādyaiḥ śarkarādyairmiṣṭasadrasaiḥ | sudhāmiṣṭānnakaiścāpi munyannaistānatarpayat ||2.231.70|| śrāddhāni vidhinā kṛtvā parihāraṃ tato’karot | prāsādikāni bhojyāni bhojayāmāsa vāḍavān ||7 1 || dīnānāthān kṛpaṇāṃśca satīḥ sādhvī sato yatīn | āśritān kanyakāścāpi kumārān karmacāriṇaḥ ||72|| bhaktān sarvāṃśca bhṛtyān saṃbhojayāmāsa vai prabhuḥ | rājñaśca rājavargāśca vaiśyān sevāparāyaṇān ||73|| bhojayāmāsa bhagavān sa rājāpyājñayā hareḥ | bubhuje tatprasādānnaṃ madhyāhnottarameva tu ||74|| hariḥ sabhāṃ sumahatīṃ cakre tūpādideśa vai | gṛhasthaiḥ sarvadā mātā sevanīyā pitā tathā ||75|| guruśca sevanīyo’tha tadājñāyāṃ yathocitam | sthātavyaṃ manasā vāṇyā dehena ca dhanena ca ||76 || daśaśrotrīyasadṛśaścaikopādhyāya ucyate | daśopādhyāyasadṛśaḥ pitā loke mahān mataḥ ||77|| mātā daśaguṇī śreṣṭhā pituḥ putraprapālinī | mātrā dhṛtaḥ sa garbhe vai bālye’pi sevitastathā ||78|| yauvane yojitaḥ patnyā tasmānmātā garīyasī | gururdaśaguṇo māturgarīyān jñānado mataḥ ||79|| janmamṛtyujarāho yo vāsanābandhanāśanaḥ | pāpanāśakaraḥ pūjyo gururjīvasya mokṣakṛt ||2.231.80|| mātā pitā gururmānyāḥ pūjanīyā hitaiṣubhiḥ | trayaste pūjitā yena tasya smṛddhirna riṣyati ||81 || trayaste devarūpā vai trayo’gnayaśca te matāḥ | teṣāṃ sevā kṛtā yena prāptaṃ janmaphalaṃ śubham ||82|| bhartsanīyā na te putraistāḍanīyā na vai kvacit | udvejanīyā nāpyatra poṣaṇīyāstrayo’pi te ||83 || mātaraṃ yaḥ prakuryādvai pradakṣiṇāṃ namastathā | tena pradakṣiṇā pṛthvyāḥ kṛtā syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ||84|| pitā saṃpūjito yena viṣṇustena prapūjitaḥ | guruśca pūjito yena tenārcitāḥ surādayaḥ ||85|| tebhyo deyaṃ yathāśakti dhanamannaṃ tathāmbaram | yadyadyogyaṃ tathāpekṣyaṃ tattaddeyaṃ hi sarvathā ||86|| vṛthā kliśyanti tīrtheṣu yeṣāṃ tīrthatrayaṃ gṛhe | trayāṇāṃ sevayā sarvādhvarapuṇyaṃ bhaved dhruvam ||87|| trayāśīrvādalābhena yāmyāḥ prayānti dūrataḥ | lakṣmyaḥ sarvavidhāstasya gṛhe tvāyānti cānyataḥ ||88|| trayaste pitaraḥ proktāḥ sajīvāḥ sevanāya vai | atraite sevitā yena paraloko’sya śobhanaḥ ||89|| ete duḥkhīkṛtā yena sa duḥkhī syātparatra ca | putrādibhiḥ sevitāśca tṛptā mṛtyuṃ prayānti ye ||2.231.90 || pitaraste bhaveyurvai muktāḥ svargādigāminaḥ | pretatvaṃ nahi teṣāṃ vai naiva kanīyasī gatiḥ ||9 1|| na janma duḥkhakṛt teṣāṃ prasannā ye mṛtiṃ gatāḥ | aprasannā duḥkhitāśca mṛtiṃ gatāśca ye janāḥ ||92|| krūrabhāvā hi te vaṃśyasthānāṃ raktaṃ pibanti vai | teṣāṃ sadgatilābhārthaṃ śrāddhaṃ dadyāt sutādibhiḥ ||93|| vaṃśe vighnāni naśyeyurvaṃśavṛddhirbhavet tathā | adya kṛtaṃ pradattaṃ ca śrāddhamannaṃ jalaṃ phalam || 94|| svargaṃ prayāti yatraiva santi pitara eva ha | tṛpyanti pitarastatra gṛhītvā sukhinaḥ sadā ||95|| tasmācchrāddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ mokṣasiddhaye | tannāmnānnaṃ jalaṃ vastraṃ phalaṃ pāyasamityapi || 96|| śayyā pātrāṇi dhānyāni rasā deyā viśeṣataḥ | bhojanāni pradeyāni pitṛtṛptyarthakāni hi ||97|| tīrtheṣu satsu pātreṣu deyaṃ śaktyā yathocitam | svarṇaṃ ca rajataṃ tāmraṃ dhanaṃ deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 98|| vāhanaṃ yānamevāpi yadāsīttasya vai priyam | tattaddeyaṃ hi pātrāya tatpuṇyaṃ syādanantakam ||99|| ityuktvā virarāmātha prajāḥ pūjāṃ pracakrire | dhanānnāmbarapātrādyaiścandanākṣatapuṣpakaiḥ || 2.231.100 || tato dhanaṃ viśeṣeṇāgataṃ pūjātmakaṃ tu yat | rājagirarṣaye kṛṣṇaḥ pradadau dānarūpakam || 10 1|| rātrau nidrāṃ ca viśrāntiṃ prāpa gopālanandanaḥ | rādhike sevitaḥ sarvapriyābhiḥ parameśvaraḥ || 1 02|| prātarmaṃgalavādyaiśca nārīṇāṃ gītibhistathā | prabubodha harikṛṣṇo dhyānaṃ svahṛdaye’karot || 103 || kṛtasnānādikaḥ kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtagurustavaḥ | niṣasādāsane divye tāvad rājā samāyayau || 1 04|| kṛtavān sa mahāpūjāṃ śrīhareścandanādibhiḥ | pāyasaṃ pāyayāmāsa mahīmānān samastakān || 1 05|| rājñī pūjāṃ cakārāpi pupūjuśca tataḥ prajāḥ | rājā ceyeṣa nagarāntarāṇi netumacyutam || 10 6|| haristathāstviti prāha sadyaḥ sajjo babhūva ha | rādhike svavimānastho’bhavat saha kuṭumbakaiḥ || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne hareḥ pūjanamupadeśanam pitṛśrāddhadānavāridānādikamamāvāsyāyāṃ kṛtvā rātrau viśramyāśvinaśuklapratipadi prātaḥ pūjanādikaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 231 ||
<2.232> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike cāśvinaśuklapratipadvāsare prage | rājārāyanṛpoktyā śrīhariḥ sajjo babhūva ha || 1 || khaṇḍarāṣṭrātmake rājye lāpalātrīpurīṃ yayau | samudrataṭavāsinyā nagaryāścopasāgare || 2 || mahodyāne dvīpakalpe mandire samavātarat | rājā pupūja kanakairyautakairvividhairapi || 3 || hīrakaiḥ ratnavaryaiśca mauktikairmaṇibhistathā | nagaryāṃ vādyaghoṣaiśca mahāsammānapūrvakam || 4 || rājārāyanṛpaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ bhrāmayāmāsa sarvataḥ | haristatra mahodyāne kṛtasevaḥ kṛtaśramaḥ || 5 || kṛtārāmaḥ samuvāca dinadvayaṃ praśāntaye | āśvinasya tṛtīyāyāṃ daityo vai navajīvanaḥ || 6 || māyāvī bahuvegaśca mahādritulyavigrahaḥ | samākarṣan bahūnmeghān keśairmastakasaṃbhavaiḥ || 7 || gadayā vidyuto vegān saṃnighnan bahusattvayā | ākāśaṃ garjayan hāsyaiḥ samudraṃ kṣobhayannakhaiḥ || 8 || gṛhāṇicchādayan dehasthaulyena niśi cāyayau | jñātvā divyaṃ vimānaṃ sa hastaikyenāpyatolayat || 9 || rudro vijñāya daityaṃ taṃ garjanāṃ pracakāra ha | ko’yaṃ vimānaṃ spṛśati gaccha dūraṃ mṛto’si vā || 2.232.10 || śrutvaitad vyanadacchīghraṃ prāṭṭahāsaṃ mumoca ha | gadayā sahito vyomni garjan jagāda bhītikṛt || 11 || kastvaṃ vimānabhūpo’si vimānaṃ kasya vā vada | ahaṃ neṣye vimānaṃ vā yuddhārthaṃ bhava cittavān || 12|| śaṃkaraḥ prāha mā yuddhaṃ samiccha yāhi dūrataḥ | yuddhe te nāsti vai śreyo vimānaṃ muñca satvaram || 13 || daityaḥ prāha vinā yuddhaṃ vijayo na bhavediha | neṣye vimānaṃ sarvāśca hariṣye yoṣitastvitaḥ || 14|| ityuktvā gadayā rudraṃ tatāḍa mūrdhni vegataḥ | śaṃkaro vegavān śīghraṃ śūlena tāṃ bibheda ha || 15|| gadā bhagnā hi daityasya samudre patitā yadā | tāvat samudravelāstu jalaplutāstadābhavan || 16 || atha vai gadayā śūnyo daityaḥ kṣobhamavāpa ha | kiṃ kṛtvā cāpi kiṃ hṛtvā vidravāmītyacintayat || 17|| rājasaudhe mahodyāne rājārāyanṛpasya vai | kaniṣṭhā bhaginī yāsīt suptā mātrā samaṃ tu tām || 18|| uttolya ca nidhāyaiva skandhe vyomagato’bhavat | vidyunmaṇiḥ rurodāti kumārī daityavāhitā || 1 9|| hāhākāro mahānāsīt trāhi trāhīti nādinām | mānavānāṃ ninādā vai sabhayāstvabhavam̐stadā || 2.232.2 0|| rājārāyapatiḥ śrutvā prabubodha kṣaṇāntare | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāpyutthito’bhavat ||2 1 || prajāḥ prabubudhuścāpi kolāhalasamanvitāḥ | mahīmānā yoṣitaśconnidrā jātāḥ samantataḥ || 22|| vṛttāntaṃ śaṃkareṇoktaṃ kanyāmādāya daityarāṭ | navajīvananāmā vai drutaṃ dhāvati cāmbare || 23|| eṣa nātidūrago’sti tvambare yāti paścime | māraṇīyo mayā kṛṣṇa tavājñāṃ prāpya sarvathā ||24|| tathāstviti hariḥ prāha rājārāyapatirnṛpaḥ | mātovāca tadāpyevaṃ tubhyaṃ dattā hi kanyakā ||25|| rakṣa rakṣa mahākṛṣṇa rakṣa śīghraṃ nivāraya | kṛṣṇaḥ prāha tu rājānaṃ vimānaṃ sajjamāviśan |||26| eṣa prayāmi rakṣārthaṃ tvaṃ vimāne’tra me śubhe | yadvā tava vimāne’tra mātrā sahānuyāhi mām || 27|| evamuktvā hariḥ śīghraṃ paścimāṃ kakubhaṃ prati | daityasyānujagāmaiva śīghraṃ kuṭumbasaṃyutaḥ ||28|| rājāpi svavimānaṃ vai tatpaścād bhṛtyasevitaḥ | vegenāvāhayad vyomni sūryatulyo’nugo’bhavat ||29|| harervimānaṃ vīkṣyaiva tathā rājavimānakam | daityo bhayena dudrāva vyomni kanyāyuto’pi san ||2.232.3 0|| vāyuvegena laghunā varṣmaṇā coḍḍito’bhavat | samudropari dudrāva rātrau sahasrayojanam ||3 1|| vimānaṃ śrīhareḥ paścād rājño vimānamityapi | anvadhāvaddhi vegena dhartuṃ taṃ daityapuṃgavam ||32|| daityo’pi bahuvegena dudrāvāprātareva ha | tāvad dvīpaḥ samāyātaḥ samudrāntargato mahān ||3 2|| navajīvanadaipyaścāpyavātatāra tāṃ bhuvam | śatayojanavistīrṇo dvedhā bhinnāṃ jalāntarām ||34|| prākāranagarīśobhāṃ daityalainyabhayaṃkarām | rājasaudhādiśobhāḍhyāṃ daityāvāsamayīṃ purīm ||35||| śīghraṃ praviśya daityo vai nanardānyān nyabodhayat | bherīṃ pratāḍayāmāsa yuddhāvedanakāriṇīm ||36|| śrutvā jarāmahānādaṃ daityā jagarjurutsukāḥ | yodhanārthe dhṛtaśastrā nirjagmuḥ parvatā iva ||37|| navajīvo’pie śīghraṃ tāṃ kanyāṃ nikṣipya gahvare | yodhanārtha tvājagāma daityasainyasamanvitaḥ ||38||| śrīhariryauvanaṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvā cakraṃ sudarśanam | yayau tadgahvaraṃ kanyāṃ nināya svavimānake ||39|| anyā māyāmayīṃ kanyāṃ kṛtvā mṛdā yathātatham | nikṣipya gahvare sarva daityamohakarīṃ prabhuḥ ||2.232.40 || yathārthā bhaginīṃ rājñe tvarpayāmāsa vai drutam | daityāstvetadajānanto yuddhāyābhyapatan balāt ||41 || kanyābhrātrā ca mātrā sā kṛṣgārpaṇaṃ niveditā | hareḥ kaṇṭhe karaṃ datvā patiṃ vavre vimānake ||41|| karamālāṃ varamālāṃ pragṛhya kṛṣṇakāminī | abhavat sā tataḥ śrīmān bālakṛṣṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||43|| īśānāya dadāvājñāṃ hantuṃ daityānmṛdhe tadā | śaṃkaro drāk jaṭāṃ krodhād vikīrya gaṇanāyakān ||44|| daśalakṣānasṛjattu rudrarūpān bhayaṃkarān | saṃkalpajanyahetīṃśca yoddhumājñāṃ dadau tadā ||45|| utplutyotplutya daityām̐ste nijaghnurvai triśūlakaiḥ | āmadhyāhnaṃ mahadyuddhaṃ daityanāśakaraṃ hyabhūt ||46|| sarve daityā vinaṣṭāśca viṃśatilakṣasaṃkhyakāḥ | hāhākāro mahānāsīt strīṇāṃ prarodanānyapi ||47|| dayāluḥ śrībālakṛṣṇastāsāṃ sukhāptaye gaṇān | ājñāṃ cakāra taddeśe nivāsārthaṃ gṛhāśrame ||48|| sarvāsāṃ daityapatnīnāṃ pāṇigrahān vyadhurgaṇāḥ | śāṃkarāste sutāḥ sarve vaiṣṇavāḥ kṛṣṇanoditāḥ ||49|| tāṃ tāṃ patnīṃ samagṛhya tattaddeśagṛhāṇi vai | yayuḥ sarve gaṇāstatra rājānaṃ kāmanāyakam ||2.232.50|| kāmanāyakanāmānaṃ gaṇaṃ cakāra mādhavaḥ | abhiṣicya mahadrājye gaṇakoṭiṃ tathā dadau ||5 1 || mahotsavaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā vallīliṅgapuraṃ prabhuḥ | bhramitvā śrīhariḥ sarvaṃ pāvanaṃ pracakāra ha ||52|| tato vimānamāruhya samullaṃghya ca khāḍikām | dinediṣṭhāṃ purīṃ gatvā bhramitvātha gaṇeśvarān ||53|| vāsayitvā tatkṛtāṃ supūjāṃ labdhvā pareśvaraḥ | rājānaṃ bhojanaṃ kartumājñāṃ pradāya māpatiḥ ||54|| militvā svavimāne vai bhojanāni harirdadau | vaimānikebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sāyaṃ datvābhayaṃ dhanam ||55|| dvinediṣṭhapure rājasaudhe niśāmuvāsa saḥ | āśvinaśuklapañcamyāṃ prage nidrāṃ vihāya ca ||56|| śrīhariḥ svavimānena vīkṣya dvīpaṃ samantataḥ | rājānaṃ tanmātaraṃ ca sasainyaṃ gantumeva tu ||57|| nijarājyaṃ samājñāpya tataḥ kuṭumbasaṃyutaḥ | harirvimānamāruhya mahīmānasamanvitaḥ ||58|| vyomamārgeṇa vai śīghraṃ samullaṃghya tu vāridhim | trāsamānadvīpamāyāt hambārtanagarīṃ prati ||59|| vaimānikā hi madhyāhne jagṛhurbhojanāni vai | tato maharṣayo bhaktā uṣṇālayapradeśajāḥ ||2.232.60|| pūrvaṃ prarakṣitāste tu darśanārthaṃ vimānakaiḥ | samāyayurharisteṣāṃ svāgatāni vyadhānmudā ||6 1 || pūjāṃ labdhvāśiṣo datvā vimānena harirdrutam | samudraṃ tu samullaṃghya allālīnagarīṃ yayau ||6 2|| uṣṇālaye bhūśiraso bhāge vandārukālaye | uṣitvā rajanīṃ tvekāṃ prātaḥ kṛtvā prabhojanam ||63 || vṛndārukarṣiṇā prātaḥ kṛtapūjo narāyaṇaḥ | samutthāya yayau vimānena kuṭumbaśobhitaḥ ||64|| uttarasyāṃ tu kāṣṭhāyāṃ pañcāśadyojanāntare | sthitaṃ siṃhalanāmānaṃ dvīpaṃ prāpābdhimadhyagam ||65|| madhyāhne bhojanaṃ kṛtvoḍḍīya vimānago hariḥ | sāyaṃ pampāsaraḥ prāpya rātriṃ tīre nināya ca ||66|| saptamyāṃ vai tataḥ prātarvimānamadhiruhya ca | gopanārthaṃ nijaṃ tīrthaṃ saurāṣṭre tvāyayau prabhuḥ ||67|| madhyāhne gopanāthe tu kṛtvā pūjanabhojane | āśvinaśuklasaptamyāṃ sāyaṃkāle śanaiḥ prabhuḥ ||68|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ tvāyayau vyomamārgagaḥ | kuṃkumavāpījanatāvirahārtāḥ pratīkṣaṇam ||69|| kurvantyaḥ kṛśatāṃ prāptā vinekṣāṃ śrīhareḥ sadā | tā narāḥ pramadā bālā bālikāḥ svāmisevakāḥ ||2.232.70|| vyomni tejaḥ samudāyaṃ vilokyāsupriyāgamam | pratarkyātimudā tvaśvapaṭṭasarovarāntike ||71|| mahodyāne dudruvuśca darśanārthaṃ samutsukāḥ | vimānaṃ tāvadevāpi sannidhau samupāgatam ||72|| jayaśabdāstūryanādāḥ śaṃkhānāṃ dhvanayastathā | gītikā yoṣitāṃ cāpi samantādabhavam̐stadā ||73|| kṣetrapālāśca tīrthāni devāstatra nivāsinaḥ | muktāstatheśvarāścāpyavatārāḥ pārṣadādayaḥ ||74|| maharṣayaśca rājanyā viprāḥ satyaśca sādhavaḥ | yoginaḥ siddhapuruṣāḥ santastathā vratasthitāḥ ||75|| akṣarabhūnivāsinyaḥ kanyakāśca kumārakāḥ | saubhāgyavatyo nāryaśca sarvamāṃgalikānvitāḥ ||76|| śīghraṃ prayayuḥ kṛṣṇasya svāgatārthaṃ sarontikam | lomaśāśramavāsāśca tathāmravaṇavāsinaḥ ||77|| tāpasāḥ prayayuḥ kṛṣṇa āyāta iti harṣitāḥ | candanaṃ puṣpamālādi gandhākṣataphalāni ca ||78|| gandhasārān gṛhītvāpi tyaktvā kāryāṇi vai gṛhe | sīmni visṛjya kāryāṇi karṣukādyāstathā vane ||79|| vanakāryāṇi visṛjya vyāpārādi vaṇigjanāḥ | sarve drutaṃ yayuścāśvapaṭṭasaro’bhi vai hareḥ ||2.232.80|| svāgatārthaṃ pūjanārthaṃ yayustyaktvā nijālayān | harervimānaṃ tvaritaṃ tatra bhūmau hyavātarat ||8 1 || vardhitaṃ candanādyaiśca puṣpairakṣatakuṃkumaiḥ | bhagavān śrīharistūrṇaṃ vimānāgre sthito’bhavat ||82|| darśanaṃ pradadau sarvajanebhyo vai samantataḥ | kuśalaṃ paripapraccha sarveṣāṃ snehapūritaḥ ||83 || sarve tvanāmayaṃ prāṇapateḥ papracchurutsukāḥ | tataḥ premāśrusahitā hariṃ cāśliṣya vai muhuḥ ||84|| puṣpahārān hareḥ kaṇṭhe nyadhuścandanakuṃkumaiḥ | akṣatādyairgandhasārairarhaṇaṃ vai tadā vyadhuḥ ||85|| puṃvargaḥ sampraṇanāma śrīmadgopālapādayoḥ | nārīvargaḥ praṇanāma kaṃbharāpādayormuhuḥ ||86|| gaṇavargaḥ praṇanāmeśānasya pādayostadā | yoginīmaṇḍalādyaṃ ca nanāma satīmīśvarīm ||87|| brahmapriyābhyaḥ sarvābhyo namaścakrurhi yoṣitaḥ | gaurīrhārītakīścāmarīśca vai brāhmilīstathā ||88|| nemire nūtanāḥ kṛṣṇavadhūrvai sarvayoṣitaḥ | atha vādyaiśca gītaiśca maṃgalairmandire hareḥ ||89|| prāveśayaddhariṃ tvārṣyaḥ kuṭumbasahitaṃ mudā | munayaḥ ṛṣayaḥ sarve pūjāṃ cakruśca daṇḍavat ||2.232.90 || prajāścāgatya kuśalaṃ papracchurvirahāturāḥ | hariḥ kuśalamāpṛcchya śubhāṃ saṃbhāvanāṃ vyadhāt ||9 1|| kṛtakāryāṇi bhaktebhyastvāvedayanniśāmukhe | tataścotthāya prayayau snānasandhyākṛte prabhuḥ ||92|| vinirvartyārhaṇaṃ paścād bhojanāni vyadhāpayat | lomaśaṃ samprapūjyaiva śaṃkaraṃ pitarau tathā ||93|| maharṣīn yavakrītādīn bhojayāmāsa mādhavaḥ | brahmapriyāstathā kṛṣṇo bhojayāmāsa kanyakāḥ ||94|| sarvāḥ kāntā bhojayitvā lomaśasyāśrame śubhe | sarvāstāḥ preṣayāmāsa brāhmīnāṃ maṇḍale tadā ||95|| bālakṛṣṇaśca divyāni sarvopakaraṇānyadāt | bahurūpadharaḥ kṛṣṇastābhyaḥ sukhaṃ dadau niśi ||96|| evaṃ vai rādhike pṛthvyāṃ sarvadeśeṣu sarvataḥ | sarvabhaktān pāvayitvā rājate’kṣarakṣetragaḥ ||97|| kuṃkumavāpikā dhanyā dhanyāstāḥ kanyakā api | dhanyā deśāśca te sākṣānnārāyaṇaprasaṃgagāḥ ||98|| imaṃ divyaṃ caritraṃ ye śroṣyanti bhuvi mānavāḥ | paṭhiṣyanti kīrtayiṣyantyapi bhāvabharā janāḥ ||99|| teṣāṃ pāpavināśaḥ syād bhuktiḥ śreṣṭhatamātra vai | muktiścānte’kṣaraloke syādevātra na saṃśayaḥ || 2.232.10 0|| yajñānāṃ ca kathāṃ divyāmṛṣīṇāṃ bhūbhṛtāṃ tathā | bhaktānāṃ ca kathāṃ ke’pi kīrtayiṣyanti mānavāḥ || 101 || teṣāṃ yajñaphalaṃ syācca smṛddhayaḥ syuśca tadgṛhe | brahmapriyāṇāṃ caritaṃ śrutvāpsyanti divaṃ param || 10 2|| japayajñaphalaṃ tīrthaphalaṃ vrataphalaṃ tathā | sarvapūjāphalaṃ syācca śravaṇādasya bhāmini || 103 || etaddivyaṃ caritraṃ vai prathamaṃ pārameśvaram | pṛthvyāmabhūt sārvabhaumaṃ bhaviṣyantyaparāṇyapi || 1 04|| saṃkṛtānyavatāraiśca madādyairbhagavatkulaiḥ | bhaktairbhāgavataiścāpi kalyāṇadāni rādhike || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āśvinaśuklapratipadi lāpalātrīpurīṃ hariryayau, tatra sāmudro daityaścāgatya nṛpasvasāraṃ vidyunmaṇināmnīṃ jahāra, rājā ca hariśca vimānābhyāṃ tamanu dudruvatuḥ, navajīvadvīpaṃ gatvā daityena yuddham, śaṃkarotthadaśalakṣagaṇairviṃśatilakṣadaityānāṃ nāśaḥ, kāmanāyakagaṇāya rājyaṃ dadau hariḥ, vidyunmaṇināmnī kanyā hariṃ vavre, dvinediṣṭhapuraṃ pāvayitvā pañcamyāṃ vimānena trāsamānadvīpamāgatya tato vṛndārukāmāgatya tataḥ siṃhaladvīpamāgatya pampāsaraścāgatyāśvinaśuklasaptamyāṃ sāyaṃpūrvaṃ kuṃkumavāpikāmavāpa, svāgataṃ kuśalaṃ bhojanaṃ śayanādikaṃ cedyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvātriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||232||
<2.233> śrīrādhikovāca gopīpate harekṛṣṇa śrāvitaṃ paramādbhutam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya caritaṃ śubham || 1 || pāvanaṃ divyamādyaṃ ca sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe navaṃ navam | śrutvā śrutvāti me śraddhā punaḥ śrotuṃ prajāyate || 2 || na hi tṛpyāmi kāntāsyodgatavāṇyā viśeṣataḥ | bhūyo me śrāvaya svāmin bālakṛṣṇo mahāprabhuḥ || 3 || kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre kiṃ tataḥ pracakāra ha | yatkiṃciccaritaṃ divyaṃ laukikaṃ vāpi muktidam || 4 || kauṭumbikaṃ tairthikaṃ vā camatkārayutaṃ ca vā | svalpaṃ vāpi mahadvāpi śrāvayālasyamantarā || 5 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu kānte priye rādhe puruṣottamasatkathāḥ | bhuktimuktipradā divyā bhaktānandapravarṣiṇīḥ || 6 || me’pi kathayamānasya tṛptirnaivopajāyate | puruṣottamasaṃjñasya mama mūlasya satkathāḥ || 7 || api tvaṃ rādhike cāsi mamārdhaṃ puruṣottamī | so’haṃ tvāṃ mat pṛthakkṛtvā goloke’smi pṛthak sthitaḥ || 8 || mūlarūpāt parabrahmasvarūpāt kṛṣṇarūpavān | tvadarthe cāsmi niṣpannastava kāmaprapūrtaye || 9 || tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca tathā lakṣmīrnārāyaṇaśca rādhike | pṛthagbhūtā dṛśyamānā api pṛthaṅn mūlataḥ || 2.233.10 || tvādṛśyo mādṛśā mūle pare brahmaṇi koṭiśaḥ | avatārā virājante mamaikasya tu kā kathā || 11 || tasya śrībālakṛṣṇasya kaṃbharāśrīsutasya vai | gopāṃlakṛṣṇanandasya brahmapriyāpaterhareḥ || 12|| sarvapateḥ pareśasyānandapradāni yāni tu | caritrāṇi paraṃ cetaḥ kathayāmi nibodha me || 1 3|| śrotṝṇāṃ cāpi vaktaṝṇāṃ mokṣadānīha sarvathā | smartṝṇāṃ vāsanānāśakārīṇi śobhanāni ca || 14|| sāttvikārthaṃ sāttvikāni rāgyarthaṃ rājasāni ca | tāmasārthaṃ tāmasāni muktārthaṃ nirguṇāni ca || 15|| nirguṇo’pi harirmāyāṃ yuktvā tadvānivāniśam | vartate guṇināṃ madhye teṣāṃ sukhābhisandhaye || 16|| stryapatyavanto lokāstu svatulyaṃ kalpayanti tam | strīputrābhijanabaddhaṃ na divyaṃ yad guṇadṛśaḥ || 17|| ahaṃ rādhe nirguṇo’smi kā kathā me parātmanaḥ | tvaṃ rādhe nirguṇā cāsse kā kathā brahmayoṣitām || 18|| gopā gopyo’pi divyā me golokasthāśca dhenavaḥ | vaikuṇṭhavāsino divyāḥ kā kathā paramātmanaḥ || 1 9|| camatkārāstasya divyāḥ kriyā divyā abandhanāḥ | yogo divyo harestasya ramaṇaṃ rāsanādikam ||2.233.20 || dāmpatyaṃ sarvathā divyaṃ divyaścābhijano’sya ca | divyāstasya guṇāḥ sarve māyā yatra ca tadvidhā ||21 || sarvaṃ divyaṃ mokṣadaṃ ca śāśvatānandadāyakam | laukikāśca kriyāḥ kṛṣṇe divyā muktisukhapradāḥ ||22|| mahīmānaṃ kathayato hṛdayaṃ me dravatyapi | madgaṇānāṃ varṇanaṃ na kartuṃ śakto bhavāmi vai ||23 || tarhyanantasya devasya prabhoḥ sarvāvatāriṇāḥ | varṇanaṃ kartumeveśaḥ ko bhaved rādhike priye ||24|| tvadarthaṃ na ca santoṣaṃ labhe guṇānuvarṇane | satpātraṃ yatra labhyeta tatra tṛptirna jāyate ||25|| atṛpto’haṃ kathayāmi miṣṭān miṣṭān harerguṇān | āśvine bhagavān pūrṇimāyāṃ candrodayottaram || 26|| niśīthe svapriyābhirvai rāsotsavaṃ cakāra ha | sarastaṭe’tidhavale cāmravaṇe’timañjule ||27|| vidyunmaṇipriyā prāha bālakṛṣṇaṃ susundaram | kṛṣṇa candrodayo jāto dhāvalyaṃ suvitanyate ||28|| dugdharātriḥ samutpannā mano me rantumicchati | anyāsāmapi sarvāsāṃ svasṝṇāṃ mānasānyapi ||29|| śārade śītale śānte rantuṃ tvarāṃ dadhatyapi | tannātha rāsaramaṇaṃ vidhehi śaṃ ca dehi naḥ | |2.233.3 0|| ityukto bhagavān śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo’tibhāvukaḥ | sarvāsāṃ svāṃganānāṃ sampūrayituṃ manorathān ||3 1|| divyarūpaṃ dadhārāsau yannijākṣaradhāmagam | muralīṃ cāpi jagrāha veṣaṃ rāsārhamādadhe ||32|| mastake ca mayūrāṇāṃ picchānāṃ mukuṭaṃ dadhe | kuṃkumasya ca tilakaṃ netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ dadhe ||33|| kuṇḍale karṇayoścāpi gaṇḍayoścandrakaṃ dadhe | kapolayo raṃgabindūn bhāle ca patrikāṃ dadhe ||34|| nārīkeśanibhān keśān skandhayorvistṛtān dadhe | kaṭake bhujabandhau ca maṇīn prakoṣṭhayordadhe ||35|| kaustubhaṃ mauktikīrmālāḥ puṣpahārān gale dadhe | kañcukaṃ hematārāḍhyaṃ raktavarṇaṃ śubhaṃ dadhe ||36|| sukhālaṃ śoṇavarṇaṃ kaṭibaddhaṃ dṛḍhaṃ dadhe | raśanāṃ svarṇasambhūtāṃ kiṃkiṇījālanāditām ||37|| nupūre sandadhe ramye kiṃkiṇīstabakānvite | ūrmikā hīrakāḍhyāśca gandhaṃ mumoca saurabham ||38|| snehavṛṣṭiṃ pupoṣāpi sasarjānaṅgabhāvanām | yuvabhāvaṃ prakāśayāmāsa yuvatībhāvanām ||39|| mugdhābhāvaṃ tathā madhyābhāvaṃ prauḍhādibhāvanām | samprāvirbhāvayāmāsa sarvāsu svapriyāsu saḥ ||2.233.40|| rādhike’tha tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ prerayituṃ svayaṃ priyāḥ | anyāḥ sarvāḥ samāklṛpya veṣaṃ śṛṃgāraśobhitam ||41|| kāntaṃ prati samāgatya prārthayāmāsureva tāḥ | kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa mahākṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa kṣapeśvara ||42|| kṣapāṃ sārthāṃ manaḥpūrtyā vidhehi ramaṇo’si naḥ | evaṃ śrutvātivegāḍhyāṃ vāṇīṃ kāntāgaṇasya saḥ ||43|| rādhike śrībālakṛṣṇaḥ śīghramutthāya cālayāt | bahiḥ saraḥ samāgatya dakṣiṇe vai taṭe śubhe ||44|| miṣṭāṃ ninādayāmāsa muralīṃ hṛdayaṃgamām | tanmiṣṭasvaramādhuryairhṛdayāni tu yoṣitām ||41|| śaityaṃ sukhaṃ ca kampaṃ ca prāpyāpi dravitāni vai | kamkamākhyāṃ ratiṃ prāpya kṛṣṇaṃ prati samāyayuḥ ||46|| sarvāstadā nijapatnyaḥ kumāryo lomaśāśramāt | ṛṣiṃ natvā samāpṛcchya nijaṃ kāntamupāyayuḥ ||47|| sarvānandabharāḥ kanyāḥ sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhitāḥ | kāntaṃ smṛtvāgrato yāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā śīghraṃ pradudruvuḥ ||48|| kṛṣṇo dṛṣṭvā nijāḥ koṭyarbudasaṃkhyākakāminīḥ | viśālaṃ rāsaramaṇaṃ talaṃ divyamakalpayat ||49|| na tatra dṛśyate divye tejomaye stare’kṣare | saraścāmravaṇaṃ cāpyāśramo vā nagarī ca bhūḥ ||2.233.50|| divyodyāno mahāñjātaḥ sarvākṣaradrumānvitaḥ | śatayojanavistīrṇaḥ śatastarocchrayastathā ||5 1 || pratistaraṃ pañcalakṣapramadānāṃ svayoṣitām | divyānāṃ kanyakānāṃ vai rāsāḥ klṛptāḥ kṛpālunāḥ ||52|| bhūtvā tāvatsvarūpaḥ sa yāvatpriyāḥ prasaṃkhyayā | divyodyānaḥ samasto vai divyayugalaśobhitaḥ ||53|| rāsabhrāmaṇaśobhāḍhyaḥ prājāyata navakriyaḥ | mukhyāstu māṇikī rādhā lakṣmīḥ padmāvatī ramā ||54|| sadguṇā mañjulā hāsā muktā ca lalitā jayā | hemnī dayā ca campāpi śāntirmanuśca maṃgalā ||55 || śrīścāyayustathā saurāṣṭryaśca catvāriṃśat śatam | meghanādyaścaturdaśasahasrāṇi tadāyayuḥ | ājanābhyastadā miśrāḥ devikāstāḥ samāyayuḥ ||56|| ṣaṣṭhyākhyā mānasā dīpāvalyaśca koṭirāyayuḥ | talājā kāmadhenavīyakanyāḥ koṭirāyayuḥ ||57|| ārjantyaśca śataṃ krodhanikaikā koṭigahvarāḥ | sūcī lakṣavanadevyo lakṣarākṣasya āyayuḥ ||58|| kaṃkatālyaḥ ṣaṭ tathā ca daśasāhasramāyayuḥ | pitṛkanyāścaikalakṣamāyayū rāsamutsukāḥ ||59|| rāsātalyaḥ pañcasahasraṃ vāsantyaśca ṣoḍaśa | sālamālyaḥ paṃcaśataṃ nāgakanyāśca viṃśatiḥ ||2.233.6 0|| nāginyo daśasāhasraṃ śāvadīnyaḥ sahasrakam | aindrajālyaḥ sahasraṃ ca vidyāśca pañcasaptatiḥ ||6 1 || lākṣmaṇyo dve sahasre ca rāsārthaṃ tatra cāyayuḥ | vaidhasyo dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi tvāyayustadā ||62|| vaiśvāvasvyastriśataṃ ca jummāsemlyaḥ sahasrakam | sāntapanyaḥ pañcaśataṃ sauratyaśca śataṃ tathā ||6 3|| bāleśvaryaśca tilaścailavīlā tvekalāyayau | dākṣajāvaṃgarīśataṃ prajākanyāsahasrakam || 64|| paitryaśca viṃśatirdaśasahasrasevikāstathā | prācīnyādyāḥ prajākanyāḥ koṭistatra samāyayuḥ ||65|| sāntāraṇyau ca dve kanye śaibyaḥ śataṃ samāyayuḥ | thārkūṭasthyaḥ paṃcāśacca vīrajāryaḥ śataṃ tathā ||66|| ṣaṣṭiḥ śāktyakṣikāḥ śataṃ picāśinyaḥ samāyayuḥ | śatadvayaṃ kāliyāśmastriṃśaduralaketujāḥ |||67|| krāthakyaḥ pañca ca pārtharājyo viṃśatirāyayuḥ | daśauṣṭrālyaḥ pañca hāṃkāryaśca kāṣṭhalīpañcakam ||68|| ṣaṭ tīrāṇyaścālvīnaryaḥ pañca sapta tu vardhikāḥ | anāthaikā dve sahasre prakīrṇikādikanyakāḥ ||69|| saptālpaketvyaścaikā ca jayakṛṣṇavakanyakā | pārīśānyaścaikaviṃśatirdve caindurāyosute ||2.233.70|| pañcadaśa tu maudrāṇḍyo nava gaṇḍanṛpātmajāḥ | catasraścaiva līnorṇyaścaikādaśabṛhaccharāḥ ||7 1 || catvāriṃśadvālalīnyaḥ pañcaiva vārasaiṃhikāḥ | rāyagāmalikāḥ pañca tisraścānyāḥ samāyayuḥ ||72 || ekalā stokahomī ca kāṣṭhayānī tathaikalā | ekalā kolakī dve ca dinamānyau samāyayuḥ ||73|| rāyakinnarikāścaikapañcāśattatra cāyayuḥ | rāyarokīśvarīkanyāścaikaviṃśatirāyayuḥ ||74|| rāṇajityo viṃśatiśca tisro vākakṣikāstathā | mārīśyaśca tathā tisro bāleśvaryaśca tisṛkāḥ ||75|| ṣaṭ lāmbāryaḥ sapta navārkyaśca nava tu huṇḍaśāḥ | ekā kūpeśikā catasraḥ kālīmaṇḍalīnikāḥ ||76 || jeleśyaḥ pañca tisrastu pārāvāryaḥ samāyayuḥ | koṭīśvaryau dve ca kanye tisraḥ sātīśikāstathā ||77|| sapta karkaśikāścāpi catasraścāṇḍajārikāḥ | bālyarājasī caikā ca tisraḥ saumanikāstathā ||78|| dve gavākṣyau pārāṅvṛttyau dve ca rāse samāyayuḥ | aiśānyaścaikacatvāriṃśacca rāse samāyayuḥ ||79|| rāyapātyaścatustriṃśaccatvāriṃśacca maṃgalāḥ | ājanābhyo viṃśatisāhasrakanyāḥ samāyayuḥ ||2.233.80 etāḥ sarvāścatuṣkoṭyaścaturlakṣaṃ hi kanyakāḥ | pañcapañcāśatsāhasrāstathā vai ṣaṭśatāni ca ||81 || viṃśatiḥ kanyakāstāśca kṛṣṇapatnyo’rpaṇāgatāḥ | tāsāṃ sakhyaśca kauberyo māhendryo yamakanyakāḥ |||82|| vāyavyo vaiśvakarmyaśca vārkṣyo raudraśca vahnijāḥ | śrāvaṇyaścāpi khānijyaḥ sāmvatsaryaśca gopikāḥ ||83|| prācīnyaśca piśaṃginyo rāśiyānyaḥ samāyayuḥ | raumāyaṇyaśca pāraśyo dhaivaryaḥ kinnarīgaṇāḥ ||84|| amaryaśca tathā gauryaḥ paryo hāritikāstathā | ābriktyo’pi ca pātālyaḥ svargyaścāpsarasastathā |||85|| brahmasaraso gāndharvyo yuvatyo’rbudamāgatāḥ | saśṛṃgārāḥ saccitsukhaprabhāmaṇḍaladyotitāḥ || 86 || remire bhinnacakreṣu muṣṭyuccapatinā hi tāḥ | śrīkṛṣṇavallabhāryeṇa svāmināsaṃkhyarūpiṇā ||87 || bhūtvā varṣadvayajyeṣṭho reme rāmo ramāvrajaiḥ | tālīvādanatālaiśca pādasthagitabhaṃgibhiḥ | | 88 | | pārśvadānapradānaiścāñjalidānaiśca gītibhiḥ | gaṇḍasparśaiḥ skandhahastairvakṣaḥśleṣairmuhurmuhuḥ ||8 9 || bhrāmaṇairvividhaiścādyaiḥ paścāpādaistathāgragaiḥ | kramaṇaiḥ kṣepaṇaiścāpi netrastanairmano’rpaṇaiḥ | | 2.233.90 | | hāvabhāvairgaṇḍadānai reme cāśleṣaṇaistathā | koṭiśo māṇḍalānyevaṃ tejaḥstareṣu sarvataḥ || 91 || vidyante rāsinīnāṃ vai rāse kāntaiḥ samantataḥ | sarvākarṣaṇakartāyaṃ nārāyaṇapareśvaraḥ | | 9 re || antarātmā nijaiśvaryānmahānandottamaṃ dadau | sarvendriyāṇāmānandaṃ divyaṃ savegiśāśvatam || 93 | | tathāpyaviplutānandaṃ dadau cāpātareva ha | darśane sparśane cāpi śravaṇe ghrāṇane’pi ca || 94|| rāsane grahaṇe cāpi pādanyāse ca kīrtane | āśleṣaṇe pṛṣṭhabhāve cāgre pārśve ca sannidhau | | 95 || yuvatīnāṃ svapatnīnāṃ sarvendriyeṣu sarvathā | sarvendriyāṇāmānandaṃ bahuvegaṃ nyadhātprabhuḥ || 96 | | yadānandena cākṛṣṭāḥ sarvāstallīnatāṃ gatāḥ | ratyānandaṃ pṛthaṅ naiva samaiccham̐stṛptimāgatāḥ | | 97 || kāntānandapravāhāśca hyātmānandapravāhakaiḥ | militāḥ kāmakārāśca pravāhā līnato yayuḥ | | 98 | | brahmānandapravāhe vai kāmānandaḥ kiṃmānakaḥ | koṭikoṭiprakoṭīnāṃ patīnāṃ sukhade’kṣaye | | 99 | | bālakṛṣṇāṃgayogotthe ko’yaṃ kāmo hi kaccaraḥ | kāme kāmatvanikṣeptā svayaṃ patirhi rāsane | | 2.233.100 | | ramate svapriyābhirhi sarvakāmasukhapradaḥ | tanmūrteḥ saṃgame rādhe mūrdhāṃ yayurhi yoṣitaḥ || 101 | | rāsabhramaṇamutsṛjya śayanaṃ tena cakrire | kṛtvā svoraḥsu kāntaṃ svaṃ mahānandaṃ prapedire || 10 2| | yugadīrghaṃ sukhaṃ prāpya vinirvṛttiṃ yayuḥ striyaḥ | vimūrchāśca nijaṃ kāntaṃ samutthāpya ca rāsane | | 103 || punarvai bhrāmaṇaṃ cakrustāvaccandro’bdhimāpa ha | bālakṛṣṇo muralīṃ svāṃ vyanādayanmuhurmuhuḥ || 10 4| | kṛkavākuprabodhāṃ tāṃ śrutvā prātaḥ prabodhinīm | sarvāḥ patnyaḥ samaṃ veṣaṃ śṛṃgāraṃ saṃvidhāya ca || 1 05|| śīghraṃ kāntaṃ samāśliṣya tathājñāṃ prāpya satvaram | prātaḥkṛtyavidhānārthaṃ prayayustāvadeva tāḥ || 106 || sarvaṃ tanmaṇḍalaṃ divyaṃ taijasaṃ saṃvyalīyata | aśvapaṭṭasarastatrādṛśyatāmravaṇaṃ punaḥ || 1 07|| ākṣarī pṛthivī bhūmiścāśramo lomaśasya saḥ | rāso’yaṃ rāsakhelānāṃ cihnāni ramaṇānyapi || 1 08|| vyalīyantecchayā tasya pareśasya hi rādhike | sarvāḥ snātvā sarasyeva kṛtvā nityavidhiṃ tataḥ || 1 09|| yayurnijān samāvāsān bālakṛṣṇo gṛhaṃ yayau | rādhike’haṃ tadā rādhāṃ draṣṭuṃ tatra hyupāgataḥ || 2.233.11 0|| kīdṛśī ramate rādhā cādṛśyaścābhavaṃ tadā | tvayā prasāditaḥ kānto bālakṛṣṇo manoharaḥ || 11 1|| paśyālasyaṃ kiyat prāptaṃ ramaṇena samutthitam | paśya svahṛdaye kāntaṃ ramantaṃ tadyathāsthitam || 11 2|| sphurantaṃ paśya gopi tvaṃ cāvismṛtaṃ pareśvaram | tasyānandottamalābhāt pūrṇakāmāsi rādhike || 113 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āśvinaśaratpūrṇimārātrau sarvanijapatnībhirbālakṛṣṇasya rāsānandaramaṇakrīḍāvarṇananāmā trayastriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 233 ||
<2.234> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike tata ārabhya śaradrātriprabhātataḥ | bālakṛṣṇaṃ vinā nāsāṃ kṣaṇo yāti sukhecchayā || 1 || śayane bhojane yāne vane snāne tathāsane | vārtane ramaṇe gāne sakhībhiḥ saha narmaṇi || 2 || bālakṛṣṇo hi netrāgre hṛdaye’pi sphuratyayam | smāraṃ smāraṃ mahānandaṃ bhramanti kṛṣṇavṛttikāḥ || 3 || kadāgacchet punaścaivaṃ śāradotsavamācaret | kāntānandapradaṃ kāntaścetyevaṃ saṃvyacintayan || 4 || brahmānandaṃ muhuḥ smṛtvā kanyā nidrāṃ na lebhire | kṛṣṇastāsāṃ divyarūpaiḥ pūrayatyeva kāmanā || 5 || sadā sahaiva tāḥ sarvāḥ prārthayāmāsuracyutam | rakṣituṃ mandire naije na tu vai lomaśāśrame || 6 || bālakṛṣṇastu tāḥ prāha mārgaśīrṣe vidhānataḥ | nayiṣye mandire naije śrutvā tā dhairyamāvahan || 7 || athorjakṛṣṇapakṣasyāṣṭamī janatithirhareḥ | āyātā cotsavaṃ tatra cakre gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 8 || caturdaśasamā jātā bālakṛṣṇasya bhūtale | pañcadaśī janmajayantyaṣṭamyatra pravartate || 9 || tatra śrībālakṛṣṇasya pitā kīrtyanusārataḥ | mahotsavaṃ paraṃ cakre pūrvapūrvātivartinam || 2.234.1 0|| sasmāra viśvakarmāṇaṃ nirmātuṃ maṇḍapaṃ śubham | śīghraṃ copāyayau viśvakarmā nanāma pādayoḥ || 11 || eṣa dāso hi kṛṣṇasyopasthito’smi nideśanām | dehi karomi śīghraṃ vai yatheṣṭaṃ śobhanaṃ yathā || 1 2|| śrutvā pitāha putrasya bālakṛṣṇasya śobhanā | janmajayantikā prāptā pañcadaśīti maṇḍapam || 12 || viśālaṃ nūtanaṃ divyaṃ divyasāmagrikodbhavam | prakāraya viśeṣeṇa deveśasaṃsaduttaram || 14|| tathāstviti praṇamyātha śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaṃ prabhum | pūjayituṃ yayau pārśve pūjayitvā prasannatām || 15|| ājñāṃ cāpya drutaṃ divyaṃ maṇḍapaṃ hṛdyacintayat | apūrvaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kartuṃ tvājñā jātāsti tattathā || 16|| karomi maṇḍapaṃ divyaṃ catuḥkammānikopari | aśvapaṭṭasaro yasyādho nihitaṃ yathā bhavet || 17|| ityevaṃ saṃprakalpyaiva pratimāṃ māṇḍapīṃ hṛdi | dhanuścatuṣṭayaṃ tatra sasmāra yojanāyatam || 18|| aindraṃ dhanuḥ śāṃkaraṃ ca dhanurdhanuśca vaiṣṇavam | dhanurmanobhavasyāpi dṛḍhaṃ bhārasahaṃ śubham || 1 9|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥpūrvadiśāyāṃ caindrameva saḥ | dakṣottaraṃ dīrghamasthāpayat kammānikātmakam | aiśaṃ dhanuścottarasyāmasthāpayattathaiva ca ||2.234.20|| paścimasyāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ cāsthāpayat tattathaiva ca | dakṣiṇasyāṃ ca kāmasyāsthāpayattattathaiva ca ||2 1 || yojanāyatabhūbhāge prāntāṣṭakaṃ nyadhāpayat | kṛtvaivaṃ caturasrāṃ vai catuṣkīṃ pādarūpiṇīm ||22|| tatra nyadhāpayat sūryaraśmīn tejonidhānakān | sūryakāntaiścandrakāntaiḥ sphāṭikairmaṇibhistathā ||23 || samasūtrāṃ catuṣkīṃ tāṃ kṛtvābhittisvarūpiṇīm | prākāraṃ gopurāḍhyaṃ sauvarṇaṃ kammānikāyutam ||24|| kārayāmāsa śīghraṃ saḥ madhye sabhāṃ śuśobhanām | cāndrakiraṇasampādyasudhādravyavitānikām ||25 || amṛtodbhavavallyāḍhyaśobhāstaṃbhasamanvitām | sauvarṇāsanasaṃrājatpārśvavartulamadhyamām ||26|| grahanakṣatratārādipradīpasthānarājitām | kaustubhavrātasaṃlagnavitānacchāyayānvitām || 27|| yāvallakṣmīsvarūpānurūpaśrīdhṛtamālikām | yāvadapsarasāṃ nṛtyārhaṇagītisvabhāvagām ||28||| sudharmābrāhmabhaumeśīsabhācatuṣṭayāṃkinīm | kāmadhenukalpalatācintāmaṇisamanvitām ||29|| kalpavallīkalpadrumākṣayapātrādimaṇḍitām | sarvagandharasāsvādasukhasparśānilānvitām ||2.234.3 0 || dūraśravaṇadṛśyādisarvaśaktyāśrayāṃ śubhām | yatra yāvatpadārtheṣu dṛśyate mūrtimān hariḥ ||3 1|| svayaṃprakāśo bhagavān bālakṛṣṇasya bhaktarāṭ | yathādideśa rūpāṇi tathā tvaṣṭā vyadhārayat || 32|| muktarūpāṇi sarvāṇi cākṣarasya svarūpakam | muktānīnāṃ svarūpāṇi tvaṣṭā vyakalpayattathā ||33|| teṣu śrībālakṛṣṇaścāntarātmā dṛśyate śubhaḥ | avatārān sarvavidhān tathāvatārayoṣitaḥ ||34|| vyūhām̐śca vyūhapatnīśceśvarānīśvariṇīstathā | teṣu śrībālakṛṣṇaścāntarātmā dṛśyate śubhaḥ ||35|| siddhāśca sāṃkhyayoginyaḥ satyaḥ sādhyaśca sādhavaḥ | ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā devyastāsāṃ prayoṣitaḥ ||36|| mānavā dikprapālādyā lokapālāḥ sayoṣitaḥ | kāśyapyaśca prajāḥ sarvā divyatattvāni sarvaśaḥ || 37|| ādityā vasavo rudrā gaṇeśā bhūbhṛto’pare | pārthivāścāpi vikhyātā nihitā viśvakarmaṇā || 38|| teṣu sarveṣu divyaḥ śrībālakṛṣṇo vilokyate | evaṃvidhāṃ sabhāṃ kṛtvā maṇḍapāḍhyāṃ sunūtanām ||3 9| | nyavedayaddhi saptamyāṃ pitre rātryardhake gate | prasanno’bhūt pitā dṛṣṭvā sopānāni samantataḥ ||2.234.40 || yānamārgān vimānānāmavakāśān tadantare | hastināṃ gatimārgāśca rathānāṃ pādacāriṇām ||41 || mārgān viśrāntiviśrāmān dṛṣṭvā mumoda vai pitā | klṛptodyānāni paritaḥ phalapuṣpayutānyapiṃ ||42|| bahuraṃgavicitrāṇi vīkṣya jaharṣa vai pitā | tatra sarvatra putraṃ svaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ vyalokayat ||43|| sarvaṃ tattvātmakaṃ cāste viśiṣṭaṃ tannidarśanam | racitaṃ cājñayā tvaṣṭrā hareḥ preraṇayā bhuvi ||44|| divyaṃ bhaumasaromūrdhni saraścādhaḥ pradṛśyate | koṭikamalaśobhāḍhyaṃ śeṣakamaṭhaśobhitam ||45|| pātāladṛśyaśobhāḍhyaṃ tejaḥpaṭaṃ tathā kṛtam | ityevaṃ maṇḍapaṃ divyaṃ vīkṣya sihāsanaṃ hareḥ ||46|| vyalokayanmahādivyaṃ paraṃ sarvāsanocchrayam | divyasattvotthasauvarṇaracitaṃ hastipīṭhagam ||47|| siṃhāsane’vayaveṣu sarvasiṃhāsanāni vai | antaḥklṛptāni divyāni sadevāni śubhāni vai ||48|| kārṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vāsudevīyaṃ bhaumamācyutam | sādāśaivaṃ ca hairaṇyagārbhaṃ vairājakaṃ tathā ||49|| brāhmaṃ caindraṃ vāruṇaṃ ca yāmyaṃ kauberakaṃ tathā | āgnikaṃ cānilīyaṃ caiśānaṃ nairṛtikaṃ tathā ||2.234.50|| śeṣīyaṃ sauramevāpi tathānyāni ca yānyapi | siṃhāsanāni sarvāṇi kṛṣṇāsanodare’bhavan ||51 || evaṃvidhaṃ divyagajāsanaṃ tvaṣṭā hyavānyasat | divyamuktānikāvṛndaiḥ karamālairgajāsane ||52|| sthitaiḥ puṣpāñjalibhiścākṣatacandanabhṛtkaraiḥ | suśobhite mahādivye maṇḍape ca sugandhini ||53 || ākṣaraistaijasairdravyairbhrājamāne samantataḥ | śuśubhe’ntargataḥ kṛṣṇo’saṃkhyarūpo mahāprabhuḥ ||54|| śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaḥ saṃvīkṣya putrāsanaṃ param | divyottamaṃ hi mumude mumude ca kuṭumbakam ||55|| brahmapriyādyāḥ patnyaśca mumudire’tikāṣṭhayā | nijakāntāsane vīkṣya gauravaṃ sārvabhaumikam ||56|| athaivaṃ saṃvidhāyaiva tvaṣṭā harṣānvito’bhavat | apūrvāṃ svakṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā mene kṛpāṃ harerhi saḥ ||57|| anarhaṃ yatsvabuddhestat samudbhūtaṃ mahāsanam | āntarasthaṃ prabhuṃ tasya vidhātāramamanyata ||58|| atha gopālakṛṣṇo’pi tejovyāpyaṃ hi maṇḍapam | vīkṣyākṣaraṃ ca tatkṣetraṃ maṇḍapasya hi tejasā ||59|| dinavadbhrājamānaṃ ca prātarbhrānto’bhavad drutam | prābodhayad gaṇeśaṃ ceśānaṃ satīṃ ca lomaśam ||2.234.6 0|| saccidānandamevāpi tuṣitaṃ ca sadāśivam | lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇīṃ cāpi sanatkumārakam ṛbhum ||6 1 || śīghraṃ tvājñāpayāmāsa kṣaṇād yāntu samantataḥ | kṛṣṇajanmajayantyāṃ vai hyāśīrvādaparāyaṇāḥ ||6 2|| brahmasṛṣṭīśvarasṛṣṭijīvasṛṣṭisthitā bhuvi | saurāṣṭre vai samāyāntu gopālakṛṣṇamandiram ||63 || aṣṭamyāmutsave sarve vardhayantu samāgatāḥ | ityāśāṃ saṃgṛhītvaiva drutaṃ lokāntaraṃ yayuḥ ||64|| muktā dhāma yayuścāpi gaṇeśaḥ śāṃkaraṃ padam | īśānaḥ satyalokaṃ ca satīsādhvyālayān yayau ||65|| lomaśastu maharṣīṃśca tuṣita pitṛmaṇḍalam | sadāśivaśceśvarāṇāṃ lokeṣu tūrṇamāyayau ||66|| saccidānandamuktaśca viṣṇudhāmāni vai yayau | lakṣmīḥ sarvapradevīnāṃ lokeṣu ca yayau tadā ||67|| nārāyaṇī badaryāṃ ca kṣīre śvete yayau tadā | sanatkumāro bhagavān sarvalokān yayau kṣaṇāt ||68|| naikarūpapradhartāraste yayuḥ sarvatodrutam | tattatsthānāni cāsādya sthānibhiśca kṛtārhaṇāḥ ||69|| nivedyāmantraṇavāco’kṣarakṣetramupāyayuḥ | āmantritāśca sarve te kuṭumbaparivāritāḥ ||2.234.70|| praphullahṛdayāstūrṇaṃ śṛṃgārādisamanvitāḥ | divyopadābhiḥ saṃyuktā vimānairvāhanādibhiḥ ||71 || āyayuḥ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ divyasumaṇḍapam | prātareva hariḥ snātaḥ kṛtapūjābhivandanaḥ ||72|| kṛtavṛddhopasevaśca śṛṃgārito’pi sarvathā | brahmapriyābhiḥ sarvābhirnataḥ praharṣitastathā ||73|| mātrāśīrbhiryojitaśca kṛtakautukamaṃgalaḥ | divyarūpadharo bhūtvā maharṣigaṇasevitaḥ ||74|| yayau tanmaṇḍape hastyāsane vādyasughoṣaṇaiḥ | gītibhiryoṣitāṃ cāpi vedamantraiḥ samanvitaḥ ||75|| gatvā kṛṣṇo niṣasāda jayaśabdāstadābhavan | lomaśastaṃ vedamantraiḥ pūjayāmāsa candanaiḥ ||76 || maharṣayo’pi sarve’pi pūjayāmāsuracyutam | āśīrbhirvardhayāmāsuścākṣataiścakrurarcanam ||77|| mātā cakre’sya tilakaṃ pitāsya mukuṭaṃ dadau | puṣpahārān brahmapatnyaścandrakaṃ śrīstadā vyadhāt ||78|| ārārtrikaṃ vyadhuḥ sarvāḥ sarve ca maṇḍapāgatāḥ | athaivaṃ divyarūpaṃ taṃ vīkṣya saurāṣṭravāsinaḥ ||79|| tallīnāścābhavam̐statra paraṃ samādhimāgatāḥ | viprāṇāṃ tatra jāyante vedaghoṣāḥ samantataḥ ||2.234.8 0|| bhrātā jyeṣṭho bhagavām̐śca śuko’pi vallabho’pyanu | mahādānāni dānāni dadustatra samastataḥ ||81 || athāyayustadā muktā muktānyo’kṣaralokataḥ | prapūjyārārtrikaṃ cakrurbālakṛṣṇasya te tataḥ ||82|| pārṣadairdarśitaramyāsaneṣu viviśustadā | athāyayuścāvatārāḥ sapatnikāḥ sapārṣadāḥ ||83|| rādhike ca tvayā sārdhamahaṃ tatrāgamaṃ tadā | nārāyaṇo’pi lakṣmyā yuk tatrāyayau mudānvitaḥ ||84|| anye nārāyaṇāḥ sarve svasvaśaktisamanvitāḥ | āyayuśca pupūjuśca viviśurdarśitāsane ||85|| vyūhāstatheśvarādyāśceśvaryastatra samāyayuḥ | pupūjuścopadābhiśca viviśurdarśitāsane ||86||| brahmādyāścāyayuścāpi trilokeśā hyasaṃkhyakāḥ | pupūjuścopadābhiśca viviśurdarśitāsane ||87|| munayo yoṣitāṃ teṣāmāyayuḥ pitarastathā | devā devyo lokapālā dikpālāḥ sakuṭumbakāḥ ||88|| ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ saśaktayaḥ samāyayuḥ | pupūjuścopadābhiśca viviśurdarśitāsane ||89|| mānavāḥ sādhavaścāpi satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ samāyayuḥ | pātālasthā vanasthāśca parvatasthāḥ samāyayuḥ ||2.234.90|| siddhacāraṇagandharvā vidyādhroragarākṣasāḥ | kinnarāḥ kiṃpuruṣāścāyayuḥ pupūjuracyutam || 91 || tīrthāni sāgarā nadyaḥ sarāṃsi caityajātayaḥ | drumā vallikā divyāśca gāvaḥ patatriṇastathā ||92|| vāhanāni sudivyāni dāsā dāsyastathāyayuḥ | pupūjuścopadābhiśca vardhayāmāsurāśiṣā ||93 || niṣeduścāsanādau ca maṇḍape divyatānvite | lokalokanivāsānāṃ devādīnāṃ hi mūrtayaḥ || 94|| maṇḍape sarvataścāpi hastyāsane pravīkṣya te | nijarūpāṇi saṃvīkṣyāścaryaṃ prapedire hyati ||95 || neyaṃ kṛtirhi devānāṃ devatvaṣṭurna vā yataḥ | akṣarādisvarūpāṇāṃ śilpane tasya no gatiḥ ||9 6 || tasmādasya vidhātā vai bhavettvaṣṭākṣarasthitaḥ | brahmadhāmanivāsena nirmito’yaṃ pratarkyate ||97|| ityāsan sandehabhājaḥ sarve maṇḍapamaṇḍitāḥ | lulokire hi tattveṣu bālakṛṣṇaṃ tadantare ||98|| mugdhāḥ sarve tathā jātā vīkṣya kṛṣṇaṃ hi garbhagam | āmadhyāhnaṃ pūjanaṃ cāśīrbhiḥ saṃvardhanaṃ tathā ||9 9 || vyavartata harestatra nṛtyaṃ cāpsarasāṃ tathā | gāyanaṃ tvabhavad divyaṃ saṃhitāvācanaṃ tathā || 2.234.10 0|| ākhyānānyabhavam̐ścāpi yaśogānaṃ harestathā | vetradhāreṇa ca hemantena vasantakena ca || 101 || ninādanaṃ mahākīrtirvijayāḍhyaṃ samīritam | satyāmbikayā ca tatra duḥkhahāñjalirāsthitaḥ || 102| mātrā sucandrako bhāle’kṣatayukte’sya vai kṛtaḥ | āśīrvādāstathā dattā tāmbūlakaṃ tathārpitam || 1 03|| sabhāyāṃ śarkarādyaṃ khārikādyaṃ ca vitāritam | pānatāmbūlakādyaṃ ca yogyaṃ sampāditaṃ tathā || 104|| athāgatānāṃ sarveṣāṃ svāgataṃ svastinā ca vai | nātheśena kṛtaṃ bhāvabharaṃ miṣṭavacoyutam || 1 05|| amṛtānāṃ sudhānāṃ ca miṣṭānnānāṃ prabhojanam | pānānāṃ miṣṭagandhānāṃ tāmbūlānāṃ pradānakam || 1 06|| mālānāṃ puṣpahārāṇāṃ gucchānāṃ ca pradānakam | maṇḍapārthāgatānāṃ sammānaṃ vai bahuśaḥ kṛtam || 1 07|| trailokyaṃ tatra samprāptaṃ tūtsave’bhūt samastataḥ | rādhike’tha parihāro’bhavat prātarvidhestataḥ || 1 08|| mahīmānā yayuryatrāvāsāsteṣāṃ samarpitāḥ | viśrāntiṃ lebhire divyasaudheṣu divasārdhajām || 109|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne hareḥ pañcadaśajanmajayantyaṣṭamyāṃ divyamaṇḍapaśobhā, āmantritānāmāgamaḥ, śrīkṛṣṇabālakṛṣṇasvāmi pūjanam, mahīmānasatkāraścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 234 ||
<2.235> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tatra samāyātā janādayaḥ | sarve hare prasādaṃ vai labdhavanto mudaṃ yayuḥ || 1 || madhyāhne vālakṛṣṇasya viprā āśīrvidhiṃ jaguḥ | nāryāṃ jaguśca gītani tato nīrājanaṃ hyabhūt || 2 || bālakṛṣṇo nijaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa vai tadā | akṣarātparadhāmasthaṃ divyaṃ divyottamottamam || 3 || maṇḍape svāsane cāpi ye ye’ntarnihitāḥ surāḥ | lokāśca lokapālāśceśvarāvatāraśaktayaḥ || 4 || te tāḥ sāmastyabhāvena bālakṛṣṇe samāsthite | adṛśyantākṣaramuktāḥ sarvasṛṣṭinivāsinaḥ || 5 || brahmāṇḍaṃ dṛśyate tatra caturdaśastarātmakam | bhūtalaṃ dṛśyate cāpi saurāṣṭraṃ dṛśyate tathā || 6 || dṛśyate kuṃkumavāpi sabhā ca dṛśyate tathā | dṛśyate maṇḍapaśceti dṛśyate kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ || 7 || ityevaṃ śrīharau sarvaṃ pāriṣadākṣigocaram | samabhūt te tato hṛtsu bālakṛṣṇaṃ vyalokayan || 8 || divyaṃ divyaguṇāgāraṃ kāmbhareyaṃ mahāprabhum | gopālabālakaṃ brahmapriyādīnāṃ patiṃ prabhum || 9 || atha divyaṃ darśayitvā nijaṃ rūpaṃ haristataḥ | bālarūpo babhūvāya sabhāvisarjanaṃ hyabhūt || 2.235.1 0|| sarvebhyo bhojanaṃ prādācchrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ | miṣṭānnāni vividhāni peyāni vividhāni ca || 11 || tato vidāyaṃ pradadau dānamānapuraḥsaram | yayurvai paralokasthā deśāntareṣu sarvathā || 12|| samājastatra saurāṣṭradeśīyānāṃ sthiro’bhavat | rātrau śrībālakṛṣṇāgre mallayuddhamabhūttathā || 13 || nāṭakāni vicitrāṇi śrīkṛṣṇāgrebhavam̐stadā | gāyanāni vicitrāṇi saṃgītakāni cābhavan || 14|| bhojanāni ca peyāni muhustatrābhavanniśi | evaṃ rātrau nartanāni hyabhavan vārayoṣitām || 15|| pāritoṣikadānāni hyabhavan karmacāriṇām | samāpya sarvaṃ rātryardhe nidrāṃ śrāntiṃ yayurjanāḥ || 16 || prātarutthāya vādyādyaiḥ kṛtakautukamaṃgalāḥ | hariṃ natvā vidāyaṃ ca gṛhītvā prayayurgṛham || 17|| viśvakarmā nideśaṃ ca prāpya maṇḍapamuttamam | tiro’bhāvayadevāpi prātareva kṣaṇāntare || 18|| tasmai śrībālakṛṣṇaśca pāritoṣikamuttamam | pradadau svarṇamukuṭaṃ kaṇṭhahāramanuttamam || 1 9|| buddhiṃ ca pradadau divyāṃ gatiṃ sarvatra sandadau | sṛṣṭitrayākṣimattvaṃ ca pradadau kṛpayā prabhuḥ || 2.235.20|| aśvapaṭṭasaro drāgadṛśyata maṇḍape hṛte | sasnuḥ prātarjanāḥ sarve sandhyāvandanadharmiṇaḥ || 21 || ityevaṃ rādhike janmajayantī pāñcadāśikī | vyatītā śrīharervarṣaṃ pañcadaśaṃ samāyujat || 22|| śrīharerdarśanārthaṃ vai prāyānti bahavo janāḥ | manuṣyāṇāṃ susammardo jāyate’harniśaṃ tataḥ || 23|| dīnāścāṇḍālaparyantāḥ samāyānti prayānti ca | rājādhirājakaruṇāṃ labdhvā prasādarūpiṇīm || 24|| prāpyānandaṃ bhojanādi bhavanti sukhinaśca te | rādhe tatra jayantyāṃ vai cāṇḍālaḥ kaścidāgataḥ || 25|| āsīnnāmnā tāmasākṣiḥ patnīputrasamanvitaḥ | harerbhakto yato naiva cauryaṃ karoti sarvathā || 26 || na vyāharatyasatyaṃ ca kapaṭaṃ na karoti ca | calālaye vasannityaṃ grāmamārjanakarmabhiḥ || 27|| labdhānnairdehamātrāṃ ca nirvartayati vai sadā | kintu cānnaṃ na vai pūrṇaṃ jāyate mārjanārjitam || 28|| grāme’styanyo na cāṇḍālaḥ kāryaṃ kartuṃ tu sammataḥ | nāyaṃ hiṃsāṃ karotyeva na tvanyāyaṃ karotyapi || 29|| bhikṣukavattathānnasyārjanārthaṃ na bhramatyapi | matvā lokāstu cāṇḍālaṃ kupātraṃ na dadatyapi || 2.235.3 0|| tataḥ kleśaṃ varaṃ prāpya kṣudhāpīḍātikarṣitaḥ | kuṭumbena sahito’yaṃ pañcaputrasamanvitaḥ ||3 1 || bālairapyanudyamaiśca dvikanyāsahitastathā | patnīyutaśca navamo jayantyāṃ svayamāgataḥ || 32|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīre vaṭacchāyāmupāśritaḥ | darśanaṃ bālakṛṣṇasya karoti sma navaṃ navam ||3 3 || mālāvartanamevāpi karoti sakuṭumbakaḥ | bhikṣānnaṃ tūtsave tena labdhaṃ pūrṇaṃ dine niśi || 34|| navamyāṃ tena sallabdhaṃ daśamyāṃ labdhameva ca | ekādaśyāṃ tadānnaṃ na labdhaṃ vai vratakāraṇāt ||
