35|| kṣudhitaḥ sakuṭumbo vai divāniśaṃ vrate’bhavat | rātrau tāmasabhāvena patnyapatyasamanvitaḥ ||36|| kṣudhādyairbhagnahṛdayo martukāmo’tivegavān | nipapāta sarasyeva patnī dhartuṃ papāta tam ||37|| putrīputrāśca patitā rudantaḥ pitarāviti | jalāgādhatvayogena talaṃ prāptāśca te tadā ||38|| madhyarātryuttare kāle naitat jānāti kaścana | jalaṃ te salilaṃ pītvā mṛtaprāyāstadābhavan || 3 9|| bālakṛṣṇaṃ hṛdye sve smarantyete mṛtā iva | bhagavān bālakṛṣṇo’pi prabubodha drutaṃ tadā || 2.235.40 || tyaktvā śayyāṃ rādhike svāṃ tamorātrau saro yayau | vāsudevasvarūpaḥ śrībālakṛṣṇo jalāntare || 41 || caturbhujo viveśātha dhṛtvā bhaktaṃ śvapākinam | tatpatnīṃ ca bahistīre tvānayāmāsa satprabhuḥ || 42|| punarjale harirgatvā putrīdvayaṃ sutaṃ tathā | jalānniṣkāsayāmāsa taṭe nyasya punarjale || 43|| sapraviśya haristūrṇaṃ putrām̐ścatura ityapi | ānayāmāsa ca bahistaṭe rarakṣa vai kṣaṇam || 44|| bālān sute ca patnīṃ ca patiṃ ca bhagavām̐stataḥ | vāsudevaścāniruddhaḥ pradyumnaḥ samakarṣaṇaḥ ||45|| catūrupadharo bhūtvā dhṛtvā tān pādayoḥ pṛthak | uttolyādhomukhān kṛtvā ghaṭikāmātrameva tān ||46|| tathaiva dhārayāmāsa pītajalasya nirgamam | mukhataḥ sarvathā kārayitvā tān labdhacetanān ||47|| varādhastāt saprasvāpya śaityanāśāya kāṇḍikāḥ | vaṭapatrādisahitāḥ śalākāśca samantataḥ ||48|| saṃpracitvā drutaṃ tatrānalaṃ prādīpayatprabhuḥ | tatra kāṣṭhāni vinyasya tapanaṃ pracakāra ha ||49|| tāpayāmāsa tān sarvān śanakaiḥ śrīhariḥ svayam | ānayāmāsa tatprāṇān mūrdhno hṛdayagahvaram ||2.235.50 || prāptajāgratprabhāvāste vīkṣya rūpacatuṣṭayam | vāsudevādikaṃ tūrṇaṃ nemire pādayoḥ prabhoḥ ||51 || tuṣṭuvuste hariṃ tatraikādaśīrātritūryake | dīnānāthadaridrāṇāṃ nātha dhāraka rakṣaka |||52|| natāḥ sma te pādayorvai cāṇḍālā vayamādarāt | tvaṃ dhātā tvaṃ cānnadātā tvaṃ bhartā tvaṃ hi poṣakaḥ ||5 3 || prāṇadātā tvamevāsi jīvayitā jalāddhi naḥ | sadānnaduḥkhaduḥkhino vayaṃ jīvanaduḥkhinaḥ |||54|| duḥkhairviraktabhāvena prāṇāntārthaṃ jale’rpaṇam | kṛtavanto hi dehānāṃ te smṛtiṃ prāpya vāriṣu ||55|| tatra tvaṃ prāṇanātho naḥ samāgatyoddhṛtiṃ vyadhāḥ | deharakṣā kṛtā yadvatprāṇarakṣā tathā kṛtā ||56|| jīvanasya pradānena rakṣāṃ vṛttyā kuru prabho | yadvā te brahmalokaṃ no naya bhaktānudāsanān ||57|| tvayā rakṣā kṛtā garbhe kṛmiyoge’pi janmani | janmamārge kṛtā rakṣā bālyabhāve’pi rakṣitāḥ ||58|| idānīṃ yāvadevāpi tvayānnādyairhi rakṣitāḥ | vṛkṣā vallyaḥ paśavaśca kīṭāḥ patatriṇastathā ||59|| rakṣyante’pi tvayā nātha rakṣa rakṣaya nastviha | adhamoddhārakartā tvaṃ duḥkhahartā ca duḥkhinām ||2.235.60 || anāśritānāṃ cāśrayapradātā tvaṃ pitā mataḥ | bālānāṃ cāvalambastvaṃ jīvanaṃ tvaṃ prajīvinām ||6 1 || śaraṇyaścāpadgatānāṃ tārakastvaṃ nimajjatām | āturāṇāṃ cārtihāstvaṃ mamārttiṃ hara māpate ||62|| annavastrairvihīnānāmannavastraprado bhava | durbhāgyānāṃ subhāgyasya vidhātā bhava māpate ||63|| annaduḥkhena bhagavannimagno’haṃ sarovare | kuṭumbasahito rātrau tvayā dayālunoddhṛtaḥ ||64|| tasmāt pūrṇāṃ dayāṃ kṛtvānnāmbarakaṣṭamacyuta | vināśaya te bhaktasya śaraṇe patitasya me ||65|| ityuktvā ca kṣitau nyasya mastakaṃ sāñjaliṃ mudā | praṇanāma muhuḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaṃ vilokayan ||66|| bhagavān vāsudevādisvarūpāṇi vyadarśayat | bālakṛṣṇasvarūpaśca bhūtvāha tāmasākṣikam ||67|| kuṭumbasahitaścātra nagaryāṃ me sadā vasa | mārjanādi vidhehyatra rathyāsu rājamārgake ||68|| vṛttiste tvannavastrādisvarūpā nirvahiṣyati | prātardāsye nivāsārthaṃ gṛhaṃ ramyaṃ tavocitam ||69|| mā khinno bhava bhakta tvaṃ maivaṃ punaḥ kṛthāḥ kvacit| | ātmaghātasamaṃ pāpaṃ mokṣahānikaraṃ mahat ||2.235.70 || netarad vidyate tasmānmā kṛthāścātmaghātanam | ātmajīvanadānena tulyaṃ puṇyaṃ mahattaram ||71 || mokṣasādhanadaṃ nānyattasmād rakṣeddhi jīvanam | gṛhāṇedaṃ bhojanaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ pūrtamityapi ||72|| ityuktvā vāsudevyā cāhṛtaṃ miṣṭānnakaṃ dadau | vastrāṇyapi dadau tasmai kuṭumbāya dayāparaḥ ||73 || prātaścāyāhi me gopurāgre dāsye gṛhaṃ tava | ahaṃ gacchāmi saudhaṃ me bhaja māṃ nidrito bhava ||74|| ityuktvāntardadhe śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo hi rādhike | cāṇḍālaśca prasanno’bhūt cakre tu bhajanaṃ hareḥ ||75|| tālikāvādanaiḥ sarve pracakruḥ kṛṣṇakīrtanam | prātaḥ snātvā harerdvāraṃ yayuḥ sarve’ti bhāvukāḥ ||76 || bālakṛṣṇo hi bhaktasya rakṣārthaṃ svayameva ha | gajāsanāt samutthāya gopuraṃ prayayau tataḥ ||77|| gṛhaṃ saṃkalpayāmāsa cāmravaṇe’tisundaram | sundaraṃ nūtanaṃ vṛkṣavallītṛṇavirājitam ||78|| viśālaṃ mārjanīcullīkaṇḍanyādisamanvitam | udakuṃbhīpeṣaṇībhyāṃ sahitaṃ śayanādiyuk ||79|| kusūladhānyapūrṇaṃ ca sarvānnasūpasaṃbhṛtam | śākapatrādivāṭyāḍhyaṃ kūpajalavirājitam ||2.235.80 || dogdhrīgosahitaṃ ramyaṃ catuḥkakṣādivartulam | evaṃ subhavanaṃ kṛṣṇo nijacitrasamanvitam ||81 || sarvaśobhāyutaṃ tasmai pradadau śvaprapākine | bhakto’yaṃ gṛhamāsādya prasanno’bhūnmumoda ca ||82|| mantraṃ śrībālakṛṣṇādvai jagrāha vaiṣṇavaṃ tadā | namaḥ śrībālakṛṣṇasya dāso’smyuddhara māṃ prabho ||83|| iti mantraṃ dadau tasmai bhagavān kaṃbharāsutaḥ | grāme kumakumavāpyāṃ ca pattane mārjanādikam ||84|| kartuṃ nyayojayattaṃ vai svabhaktaṃ tāmasākṣatam | so’pi labdhvā śubhaṃ lābhama bhaktiṃ cakre tvaharniśam ||85|| kuṭumbaṃ śrīhariṃ nityaṃ mūrtai prasevate’sya ca | kanyaikā dugdhikā devī tasthau sā brahmacāriṇī ||86|| kṛṣṇabhaktyā samādhisthā divyadehā babhūva ha | dugdhikā devatā cāṇḍālānāṃ sā kuladevikā ||87|| sarvadā tvabhavalloke bālakṛṣṇaniṣeviṇī | mantrikā cāparā kanyā bahumantravidhāyinī ||88|| harerbhajanayogena sātmabalavatī hyabhūt| | satyavaktrī manuṃ yaṃ sa klṛptvānyāṃ śikṣayatyapi ||89|| sa eva mantro balavān jāyate phalavaustathā | evaṃ sā mantrikā jātā mantrodbhāvanakāriṇī ||2.235.90 || cāṇḍālajātimantrāṇām ārṣī sā hyabhavattataḥ | putrāḥ pañcāpi sadbhaktāḥ sādhavo bhajanānvitāḥ || 91 || ajāyantāśrame naije maṇḍalīvāhino’bhavan | cāṇḍālānāṃ guravaste’bhavan santo hi bhaktitaḥ ||92|| bahukāle gate teṣāṃ pitarau bhaktibhāvinau | sevinau divyahṛdayau bhūtvā dehau vihāya ca ||93 || yayatuḥ śrīharerdhāmākṣaraṃ muktau babhūvatuḥ | rādhe kālāntare putrāḥ putryau sādhvyau ca bhaktitaḥ ||94|| tyaktvā dehān yayurdhāma bālakṛṣṇasya śāśvatam | evaṃ śrībhagavān rādhe bhaktarakṣāṃ cakāra ha ||95|| poṣaṇaṃ pracakārāpi jīvikāṃ pradadau tathā | mokṣaṃ tvante dadau cāpi śvapacebhyo mahāprabhuḥ || 96|| ye’nāthāśca daridrā vā dīnā bhāgyavihīnakāḥ | api gatvā harerbhūmau kuṃkumavāpikākṣare ||97|| bhajanaṃ ye kariṣyantyarpayiṣyanti nijaṃ nijam | dehaṃ prāṇān hṛdayāni dhanāni ca kuṭumbakam || 98|| teṣāṃ rakṣāṃ bālakṛṣṇaḥ kariṣyatyeva sarvathā | bhuktiṃ samarpya loke’tra muktiṃ dāsyati vai tataḥ ||99|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya kīrtanātpāṭhanādapi | bhuktirmuktirbhavedeva rādhike nātra saṃśayaḥ || 2.235.100 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne maṇḍapasya parihāro mahīmānavidāyaṃ tāmasākṣināmakacāṇḍālabhaktasya sakuṭumbasya jalamagnasya rakṣaṇaṃ poṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 235 ||
<2.236> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike bālakṛṣṇastu dhanatrayodaśīdine | dhanalakṣmyāḥ pūjanaṃ sampracakāra vidhānataḥ || 1 || lakṣmīṃ nijāṃ priyāṃ śrīṃ ca sauvarṇī pratimātmikām | kārayāmāsa dānārthaṃ tāṃ sumūrtiṃ vidhānataḥ || 2 || prāpūjayat ṣoḍaśādyopacāraiścandanādibhiḥ | bhojayāmāsa bahudhā pakvānnairnavadhānyajaiḥ || 3 || pratyakṣāṃ ca tato lakṣmīṃ patnīṃ nijāṃ śriyaṃ tathā | svarṇasihāsane niṣādyārcayaccandanādibhiḥ || 4 || keśaveṣādikaṃ cakre svayaṃ kṛṣṇo hi yoṣitoḥ | kabarīṃ kṛtvā dhammilaṃ granthayāmāsa vai svayam || 5 || puṣpahārān vibhūṣāśca granthayāmāsa tatra ca | śṛṃgāradravyasadratnairhīrakaiḥ kajjalādibhiḥ || 6 || kuṃkumairgandhasārādyaiḥ kesaraiḥ karakādibhiḥ | puṣpasragbhiśca bindvādyaistayoḥ śṛṃgāramācarat || 7 || tayoścārārtrikaṃ cakre pratyakṣayorhi kanyayoḥ | te hyubhe suprasanne ca tadāśīrvacanāni vai || 8 || prāhatuḥ śrīpate lakṣmīpate vivāhamāvaha | śrīpatiśca tathā lakṣmīpatirlagnena saṃbhava || 9 || rādhāpatiḥ ramāpatiḥ padmāvatīpatirbhava | māṇikīpatirevāpi brahmapriyāpatirbhava || 2.236.1 0|| duḥkhahālakṣmīpatistvaṃ vivāhavidhinā bhava | asaṃkhyānītapatnīnāṃ patirlagnena saṃbhava || 11 || samayo’yaṃ vivāhasya tava kṛṣṇa upāgataḥ | yogyo yuvā bhavasyadya yauvanāṃkuravān prabho || 12|| śubhe samaye śrīkṛṣṇo lakṣmīkṛṣṇo drutaṃ bhava | kanyakāśca vayaṃ sarvāḥ pratīkṣāmo bivāhanam || 13 || lakṣmīvān dhanavān śreṣṭhaḥ smṛddhimān vaṃśavān bhava | adyāpi brahmacārī tvaṃ mahāyogī praśasyase || 14|| yogaiśvaryeṇa cāsmākaṃ kāmapūro bhavasyapi | aviplutaḥ sadā cāste kimasādhyaṃ hi yoginaḥ || 15|| tathāpi vidhinā kṛṣṇotsavaṃ vaivāhikaṃ vaha | ityukto bhagavān kṛṣṇastathāstvevaṃ jagāda ha || 16 || mārgaśīrṣe kariṣyehaṃ lagnaṃ me sarvayoṣitām | tāvaddhairyaṃ bhavatyau cāvahatāṃ tvaparāstathā || 17|| ityuktvā dakṣiṇāṃ datvā vyasarjayat prapūjanam | dakṣiṇā vividhāścāpi dadau śrīlomaśarṣaye || 18|| svarṇamūrtidvayaṃ cāpi dadau śrīlomaśarṣaye | viprebhyo dakṣiṇāḥ svarṇapātrāṇyapi dhanaṃ dadau || 1 9|| evaṃ mahotsavaṃ kṛtvā sarovaramagāddhariḥ | vāsudevīyakaṃ tīrthaṃ yatra cāṇḍāla uddhṛtaḥ || 2.236.20 || tatra snātvā vyūhatīrthe vaṭavṛkṣaṃ yayau hariḥ | tatra brahmapriyāḥ sarvā vihartuṃ samupāgatāḥ || 21 | | tābhyo datvā dhanānyeva kuberopahṛtāni vai | prapūjya sarvapatnīḥ sa kanyakā dakṣiṇādibhiḥ || 22 || prasādya sarvasāmagrīśceṣṭā datvā taṭāntikam | vihartuṃ barburaṃ vṛkṣaṃ dantadhāvanakaitavāt || 23 || spraṣṭuṃ cāpi yayau bālakṛṣṇo hi rādhike tataḥ | brahmapriyādyāḥ sarvāstāḥ prapaśyanti tu mādhavam || 24|| yāntaṃ barburavṛkṣāgraṃ gatvā spṛśantameva tam | dantadhāvanayogyāṃ ca prāntapraśākhikāṃ tadā || 25|| gṛhītvākarṣayantaṃ ca prapaśyanti sma yoṣitaḥ | tāvad barburavṛkṣaḥ saḥ samūlaścotpapāta ha || 26 || nanāma bhūtale cāpi tasmād divyo mahānaraḥ | prāvirbabhūva sahasā māhendrasadṛśo’paraḥ | | 27|| dṛṣṭvā hariṃ namaścakre pṛthvyāṃ papāta pādayoḥ | cakāra daṇḍavattūrṇaṃ tuṣṭāva parameśvaram | | 28 || parameśa kṛpāsindhau smṛtvāhaṃ tāritastvayā | tvaṃ jīvānāṃ samuddhartā mokṣakartā pareśvaraḥ || 29 | | vartase’nugrahakartā samuddhartuṃ janāniha | carmacakṣurna jānāti bhavantaṃ puruṣottamam || 2.236.30 || mayā prāptaḥ pareśastvaṃ vṛkṣayonipramokṣakaḥ | adyāhaṃ vai pragacchāmi divyaṃ svargaṃ tavājñayā || 31 || ityuktvā praṇanāmāpi puṣpāṇi barburasya tu | arpayitvā mādhavasya pādayorgantumicchati || 3 2|| tāvattatra samāyātā āścaryaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ | brahmapriyāḥ samastāstāḥ papracchuḥ kāntameva tāḥ || 33 || ko’yaṃ vṛkṣāt samutpannaḥ kathaṃ vṛkṣo nipātitaḥ | kautūhalaṃ paraṃ no’tra vadaitatkāraṇaṃ prabho || 34|| śrutvaitad bālakṛṣṇo’pi varṇayituṃ tu taṃ naram | vṛttāntaṃ ca nijaṃ sarvamājñāpayaddhi tatpuraḥ || 3 5|| rājā praṇamya sarvāstā āha vṛttāntamadbhutam | purāhamāsaṃ samrāḍ vai gaurjare sābhrikātaṭe || 26, || barburo nāma rājā vai dharmakarmaparāyaṇaḥ | prajāpālanadakṣaśca devasādhuprapūjakaḥ || 37|| vratadānaparo nityaṃ nityavṛddhopasevanaḥ | kṛṣṇakathāparaścāpi vaiṣṇavo duṣṭaśāsakaḥ ||38|| ekadā tvagamaṃ dīrghe’raṇye sābhramatītaṭe | vanāni vīkṣituṃ parimeyabhṛtyo’tigo vane ||39|| dūrāraṇye prayātena padbhyāṃ cāśvo vilokitaḥ | saptarūpāśrayo divyaḥ kāntimadromavarmakaḥ ||2.236.40 || mukhe śuklaḥ śaphe cauṣṭhe raktaśca pucchapṛṣṭhayoḥ | bhramare’pyudare bhāge śyāmo nīlastu vai gale ||41 || pītaḥ karṇe pārśvabhāge jaṃghāyāṃ kapiśastathā | nāḍīmārgeṣu haritaścitraḥ sarvāṃgasandhiṣu ||42|| evaṃvidhaṃ vicitrāśca dṛḍhaṃ puṣṭaṃ balānvitam | śobhanaṃ saṃvilokyaiva dhartuṃ cākaravaṃ manaḥ ||43|| śanaiḥ pārśvaṃ tathā gatvā yathā viśvasito bhavet | dhṛtavām̐staṃ karṇadeśe raśminā ca gale tataḥ ||44|| gṛhītvaiva ca tatpṛṣṭhāsanaṃ ca kṛtavānaham | so’pi mayā yathā saṃpreritastathā jagāma ha ||45|| na jāne tvasya sāralyaṃ kutaścārjavamāgatam | yathā sañcālayāmyenaṃ tathāgre sa tu gacchati ||46|| evaṃ daivaturaṃgaṃ taṃ jñātvā ninye purīṃ mama | nijaṃ bhāgyaṃ manyamāno harṣitaścābhavaṃ muhuḥ ||47|| daivaṃ taṃ turagaṃ nāhaṃ kṣaṇaṃ dūraṃ karomi vai | tataḥ sa kopamāpanno māṃ śaśāpa ruṣā vadan ||48|| yasmānmāṃ muñcasi naiva naiva jānāsi māṃ tathā | naiva tṛptiṃ prayātyeva dṛṣṭvā māṃ bandhanānvitam ||49|| naiva vijñāya tattvaṃ me miṣṭaṃ dadāsi bhāvataḥ | paśuṃ jñātvā bandhane’tra nijaṃ kṛtvā ruṇatsi mām ||2.236.50|| tato rājan mama śāpād bhava barburapādapaḥ | kaṇṭakī suvane tatra duḥkhaṃ yāhi divāniśam ||5 1 || ityukto’haṃ tadā śīghraṃ jñātvā pūjyottamaṃ munim | patitaḥ pādayostasyāśvasya śīghraṃ vimuktaye ||52|| prārthitaḥ sa mayā devo munirvānyo’pi yo bhavān | ajñāto mama pūjyo’si kṣamāṃ kurvatra bāliśe ||53|| śāpaduḥkhaṃ yathā śīghraṃ nivarteta tathā kuru | nijarūpaṃ ca me deva pradarśaya namāmi te ||54|| aparāddhaṃ mayā cāvijānatā nānyathā prabho | tasmāt kṣamāṃ parāṃ kṛtvā nijarūpaṃ pradarśaya ||55|| ityarthito muhuḥ so’śvastiro bhūtvā mahānṛṣiḥ | āśvalāyananāmābhūd rājavaṃśaguruḥ svayam ||56|| ahaṃ ruroda bahudhā jñātvā kulaguruṃ tu tam | kṣamāṃ dinataro bhūtvāyācaṃ śāpanivṛttaye ||57 | | putro’parāddhān sandhatte pitā kṣamate’harniśam | śiṣyāddhi guravaścāpi samicchanti parābhavam ||58 || mayā hyajānatā cāśvalobhena nṛpabhāvataḥ | aparāddhaṃ tava pūjya kṣamāṃ kuru vidhehi śam | | 59 | | ityarthito hi bhagavānnāśvalāyanako muniḥ | kṣamāṃ kṛtvāha māṃ tatra kiṃ te vadāmi bhūpate ||2.236.6 0 || mahatāmavamānādvai mahadāsanalaṃghanāt | pūjyapūjāvilopācca puṇyaṃ naśyati sarvathā || 61 | | tava puṇyaṃ samagraṃ vai naṣṭaṃ matpṛṣṭharohaṇāt | rājabhāktvaṃ na cādyāsti śāpadagdho bhavasyapi ||6 2 || śāpabhogottaraṃ svargaṃ tava śīghraṃ bhaviṣyati | parastrīsaṃgamād rājan gurūṇāmavamānanāt || 65 | | parapīḍākaraṇāccāyuṣyanāśo hi jāyate | asatpakṣagrahāccāpi devasādhuvinindanāt | | 64 || satāṃ drohakaraṇāccāyuṣyanāśo hi jāyate | pitroḥ kaṣṭapradānācca patnīnāṃ pīḍanādapi ||65|| hiṃsāyāḥ karaṇāccāpyāyuṣyanāśo hi jāyate | madyamāṃsavyavāyādidoṣād dharmaprapīḍanāt ||66 || bhūtāveśādidoṣāccāpyāyurnāśaḥ prajāyate | tvayāparāddhaṃ cātyarthaṃ mayā noktaṃ tu lajjayā ||67|| yadahaṃ gururasyāsmi hyaśvarūpo vane’smi ca | rājāyaṃ dṛṣṭavān māṃ sa na jānīyād guruṃ yathā || 68 || tathā rūpaṃ mayā na vyāvartitaṃ tava sannidhau | dūraṃ kṣaṇāntare rājā gamiṣyati tataḥ param ||6 9 || mama rūpaṃ dhariṣye’haṃ vicāryetthaṃ turaṃgamaḥ | abhavaṃ cāvartayaṃ ca tāvatta bhavatāntikam ||2.236.7 0 || samāgatya dhṛtaścāsmi vāhitaśca gṛhaṃ prati | tathāpyacintayaṃ nāsmai darśayitavyamantataḥ ||7 1 || madrūpaṃ yanmandurāyāṃ gṛhe mokṣyati māṃ yadā | nirjane’trāndhakāre vā rūpaṃ dhṛtvā nijaṃ gṛhāt ||72 || prayāsye vai vanaṃ tena śoko nāsya bhaviṣyati | guroratyaparādhasyetyevamacintayaṃ nṛpa ||73 || tvayā tu lobhabhāvena nāhaṃ tyakto hi nirjane | cauravad bandhane kṣiptaḥ kārāgāre sthiro yathā ||74|| tato’haṃ krodhamāpannaḥ śāpaṃ vai sṛṣṭavām̐stvayi | puṇyaṃ tena vinaṣṭaṃ te kṛpā me kiyatī vad ||75 || tato rājatvamadyaiva dagdhaṃ te doṣakāraṇāt | varburasya drumasyaiva śarīraṃ te bhaviṣyati ||76 || karomyanugrahaṃ te’tra śīghraṃ śāpavināśane | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre’kṣarabhūmau saro’ntike ||77|| barburo bhava rājendra jalapānasukhādimān | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ ||78|| rājate bhagavām̐statra tadyogaṃ tvaṃ prayāsyasi | dantadhāvanalābhārthaṃ tava śākhāṃ grahīṣyati ||79|| svahastena yadā sākṣāt tasya sparśena vai bhavān | divyabhāvaṃ divyadehaṃ samāsādya hi daivatam ||2.236.80 || śīghraṃ yāsyasi nākaṃ tad yatrendro vartate sadā | tatra kalpaṃ svargasukhaṃ bhuktvākṣaraṃ prayāsyasi ||8 1 || tyaja cintāṃ vāsanāṃ ca rājye putre priyāsvapi | gatāḥ pūrve hi rājāno gamiṣyantyapare’pi ca ||82|| hareryogād gatā ye te gatā bhavanti netare | ityevaṃ māṃ jagādātha munirvanāntaraṃ yayau ||83 || svasti te’stviti māṃ coktvā yāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛto’pyaham | aśvapaṭṭasarastīre’bhavaṃ barvurapādapaḥ ||84|| daśavarṣāṇi jātāni me’tra barburavarṣmaṇi | tvayā samuddhṛtaḥ kṛṣṇa śāpapāpaṃ vināśitam ||85|| puṇyavānasmi sañjātastava sparśena muktida | kiṃkaro’smi śaraṇyastvaṃ dehi maṃtraṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ||86|| yena tvante bhavenmokṣo me tathā tvaṃ vidhatsva vai | rājāhaṃ rājarūpaṃ tvaṃ naijaṃ me tvaṃ pradarśaya ||87|| yatsvarūpaṃ sadā dhyātvā svargānmokṣamavāpnuyām | ityarthitastadā rādhe hariḥ rājasvarūpadhṛk ||88|| pṛthurājasvarūpo’bhūd bhaktecchāpūraṇāya vai | dadau maṃtraṃ ca tasmai sa vaiṣṇavaṃ ṣoḍaśārṇakam ||89|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | gṛhītvā tu manuṃ tvenaṃ vimānavaramāsthitaḥ ||2.236.9 0|| puṣpādyairvardhayitvaiva śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam | brahmapriyāstathā sarvā yayau svargaṃ surārcitaḥ || 91 || bālakṛṣṇaṃ tadā brahmapriyāḥ pṛthusvarūpiṇam | vyalokayan patiṃ naijaṃ trailokyanṛpatiṃ prabhum ||9 2|| dhanuścakradharaṃ viṣṇuṃ dṛḍhaṃ yuvānamacyutam | mohamāptāśca tāḥ patnyo remire pṛthunā tadā || 93 || āmravaṇe ciraṃ paścāt pūjayitvā kṛpānidhim | prayayuḥ sarasastīre sasnuśca patinā saha ||94|| tīrthaṃ tad varburākhyaṃ ca pṛthutīrthaṃ tato’bhavat | tatra vāsād bhavet svargaṃ śāpanāśaśca mokṣaṇam ||95|| anādiśrībālakṛṣṇaḥ snātvā dhṛtvāmbarāṇi ca | brahmapriyāḥ sukhayitvā preṣayitvāśramaṃ tataḥ || 96|| svagehaṃ cāyayau rātrau lakṣmīpūjāṃ punastataḥ | cakāra bhagavān rātrau ghṛtadīpān cakāra ha || 97|| ārārtrikaṃ ca naivedyaṃ prārthayadvai śriyai tadā | prasannā sābhavallakṣmīḥ smṛddhābhavad gṛhe gṛhe ||98|| ityevaṃ rādhike kṛtvotsavaṃ nidrāṃ jagāma saḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya lakṣmīvān mokṣago bhavet ||99|| śāpitānāṃ śāpamokṣaścāparādhavināśanam | apuṇyānāṃ puṇyalabdhirbhavennātrāsti saṃśayaḥ || 2.236.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne hariṇā dhanatrayodaśyāṃ dhanalakṣmīpūjā brahmapriyāpūjā barburanṛpasya āśvalāyanarṣiśaptasya barburavṛkṣībhūtasya mokṣaṇaṃ pṛthutīrthasthāpanaṃ barburasya svargaṃ prati preṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 236 ||
<2.237> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike’tha caturdaśyāṃ kālyāṃ śrīparameśvaraḥ | pūjāṃ cakāra vai śaṃbhornijakṣetraprarakṣituḥ || 1 || prātaḥ snātvā pitarau ca pūjayitvā tataḥ param | īśānadevaṃ cāhūya rudrānāhūya vai tathā || 2 || śaṃkaraṃ kṣetrapaṃ devaṃ samāhūya satīyutam | svarṇasihāsane śaṃbhuṃ samasthāpayadīśvaram || 3 || pupūja bālakṛṣṇastaṃ yoginaṃ padmajāpatim | pādyamarghyaṃ dadāvasmai candanaṃ bhasma cākṣatān || 4 || dhattūrapuṣpamālāṃ ca gale harasya sandadau | bhāle candratilakaṃ ca tripuṇḍraṃ cordhvapuṇḍrakam || 5 || vyadhācchrībhagavām̐stasya hāsayam̐staṃ maheśvaram | karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale cāpi karṇikākusumāni ca || 6 || rudrākṣamālikāṃ cāpi dadau tasmai harāya ca | vyāghracarma gajacarma dadau śrībhagavān svayam || 7 || bhaṃgāṃ dadau ca miṣṭānnaṃ miṣṭapānaṃ dadau hariḥ | puṣpahārān dadau cāpi śṛṃgāraṃ pradadau tathā || 8 || sugandhasāraṃ pradadau svarṇāmbarāṇi sandadau | svarṇahārān dadau cāpi satyai bhūṣāṃ dadau tathā || 9 || ambarāṇi navīnāni vibhūṣaṇāni sandadau | yatheṣṭāni samagrāṇi śrāṃgārikāṇi sandadau || 2.237.10 || ārārtrikaṃ cakārātha mauktikahīrakān dadau | evaṃ prapūjya bhagavān bhūtanāthaṃ satīyutam || 11 || utsavaṃ divase cakre rātrāvatha haristataḥ | bhojayitvā pūjayitvā śaṃbhuṃ satīṃ gaṇādhipam || 12|| kārtikeyaṃ nandinaṃ ca yoginīcakramityapi | navadurgāḥ prapūjyāpi gaṃgāṃ prapūjya śāṃkarīm || 13|| vīrabhadraṃ tathā jālandharaṃ ca tārakāsuram | tārakākṣaṃ gajaṃ mahiṣakaṃ caṇḍapracaṇḍakau || 14|| śṛṃgina bhṛṃginaṃ cāpi rīṭinaṃ ca kirīṭinam | agniṃ candramasaṃ cāpi maṃgalaṃ ca viṣaṃ tathā || 15|| kharparaṃ tasya devām̐śca tathā kharparamālikām | siṃhaṃ rudrākṣakām̐ścāpi vāsukīṃ śāṃkarīṃ prajām || 16|| hanumantaṃ tathā niṣādinaṃ gaṇānapūjayat | bhairavaṃ kālasaṃjñaṃ ca mahākālamapūjayat || 17|| bhūtapretapiśācām̐śca kūṣmāṇḍānapyapūjayat | vaināyakām̐śca vetālān gaṇān rogānapūjayat || 18|| mṛtyuṃ ca mṛtyupāśām̐śca caṇḍyādinīrapūjayat | mātṛkāśca grahām̐ścāpi tathā pretānapūjayat || 1 9|| rogikāśca mahāmārīprabhṛtikā apūjayat | kṛtyāśca kālikābrahmacāriṇīścāpyapūjayat ||2.237.20|| kailāsavāsinaḥ sarvān śītalādyā apūjayat | gaṇām̐śca gaṇapatnīśca rākṣasīḥ samapūjayat ||21 || māṣapiṣṭādipakvānnairatarpayattu tām̐stadā | yakṣāṃśca rākṣasān bhūtapatnīśca ḍākinīstathā ||22| śākinīyoginīścāpi vetālikā hyapūjayat | kālarātriṃ tathā rātriprajāḥ sarvā hyapūjayat || 23 || evaṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā baliṃ datvā tato hariḥ | homaṃ cakāra vidhinā ghṛtādyaistṛptaye prabhuḥ ||24|| sarṣapādyaiśca māṣādyaiḥ kṛṣṇatilaphalādibhiḥ | kṛṣṇapuṣpādibhiścāpi tarpayāmāsa devatāḥ ||25|| evaṃ kṛtvā pūjanaṃ ca balidānaṃ hava tathā | sarvatra dīpadānaṃ ca dadau śrībhagavān prabhuḥ ||26|| ityevaṃ kārtikaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ niśīthake | kālīcaturdaśī cāpi pūjayitvā hariḥ svayam |||27|| mahālakṣmīṃ pūjayitvā parihāraṃ cakāra saḥ | tataḥ rātrau susuṣvāpa prātardīpotsave dine || 28|| prabubodha suvādyānāṃ śabdaiśca kīrtanaistataḥ | kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtapūjaḥ pitṛpūjāṃ vyadhāt prabhuḥ ||29|| brahmapriyāśca lakṣmyādyāścāyayuḥ śrīhareḥ puraḥ | pūjanārthaṃ nijaṃ kāntaṃ kṛtakautukamaṃgalāḥ ||2.237.3 0|| rādhike pūjayāmāsuḥ sarvāḥ sarvopacārakaiḥ | āśīrvādān gṛhītvā ca bhojayitvā nijaṃ patim ||3 1 || tatpradattaṃ prasādaṃ ca gṛhītvā yayurāśramam | sāyaṃ dīpotsavaṃ cakre sarvābhiḥ saha keśavaḥ ||32|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥ sarvaṃ dīpaiḥ pūritamapsviti | svargavacchobhate cāpi nagarī hi tathāvidhā ||33|| rātrau śrībhagavām̐ścakre śāradāpūjanaṃ tathā | sākṣācchrīṃ śāradāṃ lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ satīṃ tathā ||34|| pañca kṛṣṇaḥ samāhūya pupūja parameśvarīḥ | nāgavallīdalaiḥ pūgīphalairmiṣṭānnabhojanaiḥ ||35|| sugandhasārairbhūṣābhiścāmbaraiḥ saddravādibhiḥ | toṣayāmāsa bhagavān yatheṣṭavastudānakaiḥ ||36|| ārārtrikaṃ cakārāpi rañjayāmāsa narmabhiḥ | svarṇādidakṣiṇā datvā bhojayāmāsa pāyasam ||37|| parihāraṃ tataścakre tataḥ suṣvāpa śāntimān | kanyakāścāśramaṃ gatvā nidrāṃ jagṛhurutsukāḥ ||38|| prātaḥkāle haristūrṇaṃ prabubodha saro yayau | sarojale kṛtasnānaḥ sasmāra svaṃ purātanam ||39|| sanātanaṃ svarūpaṃ cākhilarakṣākaraṃ taṭe | nijayogānmahātīrthaṃ yatrāste vai sarovare ||2.237.40 || rādhike śrīharistatra dadhyau cātmānamātmani | tāvattatra samāyātaṃ sainyaṃ samparkabhūpateḥ ||41|| mahāmārīduḥkhakhinnaṃ hāhākārakṛtaṃ taṭe | kṛśaṃ kṣudhātṛṣāvyāptaṃ śrāntaṃ maraṇasāyujam ||42|| śrīrādhikovāca saṃparko vai kathaṃ sainyasahitastatra cāyayau | kasya deśasya rājābhūt kathaṃ rogo’sya sainyake ||43 || bālakṛṣṇena kṛṣṇena kṛtaṃ kimasya vai tadā | brūhi kānta kathāṃ sarvāṃ saṃkṣepeṇa hareḥ śubhām || 44|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rādhe sa rājāsīt samparkaḥ kacchadeśajaḥ | tīrthayātrānimittaṃ saḥ somanāthaṃ gato hyabhūt ||49|| madaṃśaṃ pūrvakalpīyaṃ dattātreyaṃ guruṃ hi saḥ | bhajate sma sadā kacche kurvan rājyamakaṇṭakam ||46|| prātaḥ snānaparaścāyaṃ devapūjanatatparaḥ | dānadharmaparaścānnasatreṣvatithipūjakaḥ ||47|| nityaṃ dhyānaparaścāpi dīnānāthānnadāyakaḥ | sādhusevāparo vṛddhanideśādyanuvartataḥ ||48|| goviprabhaktasevī ca satīsādhvīprapūjakaḥ | ahiṃsakaḥ satyavṛttiścāsīt prajābhipūjitāḥ ||49|| sādhūn dṛṣṭvā ca vā śrutvotthāyābhiyāti dāsavat | sevate cāmbaradānairbhojyadānādibhistathā ||2.237.50 || yadrājye ca satāṃ santi maṇḍalāni samantataḥ | devabhaktiparāṇyeva kṛṣṇakathāparāṇi ca ||51|| yajño bhavati yadrājye nārāyaṇasarastaṭe | pratisaṃvatsaraṃ śreṣṭho vaiṣṇavaścātidakṣiṇaḥ ||52|| so’yaṃ rājā rādhike vai sainyasāmagrikānvitaḥ | hastyaśvoṣṭravṛṣabhainoyānavāhanaśobhanaḥ ||53|| yātrārthaṃ somanāthasya saurāṣṭre tvāśvine yayau | sahasrajanasaṃghāto viprasādhusamanvitaḥ ||54|| kṛtvā tīrthe hiraṇyāyāḥ saṃgame pitṛtarpaṇam | snānadānādikaṃ cāpi someśvaraṃ prapūjya ca ||55|| mūladvārikikātīrthaṃ kṛtvā prapūjya gopatim | prācīsarasvatīṃ gatvā nārāyaṇabaliṃ vyadhāt ||56|| tato vāmanabhūmiṃ ca svarṇarekhānadīṃ tataḥ | dṛṣṭvā kṛtvā cakratīrthamindreśvaraṃ jagāma saḥ ||57|| tataḥ sītāphalāraṇye kṛtvā tīrthaṃ ca tūrikām | yāyādāmravaṇaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro’vagāhitum ||58|| mārge śramaviśeṣeṇa bhojanāniyamena ca | tāpaprabhāvataścāpi sainyaṃ rugṇamabhūttadā ||59|| mahāmārīmahārogaprapīḍitaṃ saro’ntikam | āyayau tīrthalābhārthaṃ rogādhīnaṃ ca duḥkhitam ||2.237.60 || rājā vilokya bhṛtyādīn paśūn vai raktasāriṇaḥ | svaṃ ca rugṇaṃ vilokyāpi prasasmāra guruṃ nijam ||6 1 || dattātreyaṃ bhagavanta bālakṛṣṇakṣitau nṛpaḥ | pāhi tīrthapradeśe’tra pīḍitān mama mānavān ||62|| āgatya sadguro śīghraṃ jīvadānaṃ pradehi naḥ | rogo’yaṃ nāśakṛcchaktihārako bhṛtyavargiṇām ||63|| paśūnāṃ ghātakaścāpi raktasargo’tidāruṇaḥ | rakṣa rakṣa kṛpāsindho dattātreya jagadguro ||64|| bālakṛṣṇaḥ prabhuścāpi rakṣatāccharaṇāgatam | ityevaṃ tvarthayitvaiva sarasaḥ sannidhau nṛpaḥ ||65|| kadambānāṃ drumeṣvevāvāsaṃ cakāra sainyayuk | sarastīraṃ samāgatya pītvā jalaṃ taṭe prage ||66|| sasārtho nṛpatiścakre kīrtanaṃ bhajanaṃ hareḥ | tālītālasametaṃ vai nāmānuguṇavarṇanam ||67|| bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa nārāyaṇārtihan hare | dattātreya guro rakṣa parameśvara pāhi naḥ ||68|| ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ cakre rājā sahasramānavaiḥ | sahito garjanā ceyaṃ digantaṃ pragatābhavat ||69|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrutvā sthiro’bhavat | nagaraṃ tvabhiyāto’pi vīkṣituṃ bhajanādikam ||2.237.70 || sammardo’bhūt sarasyeva paritastīravāsinām | kuṃkumavāpīvāsānāṃ darśakānāṃ sarastaṭe ||7 1 || rādhike bhajane līnā pārśve paśyanti naiva te | na cāgre nāpi vai pṛṣṭhe netrāṇyunmīlayanti na ||72|| ekatānaṃ hi bhajanaṃ cakruḥ rogapraśāntaye | babandhuśca hariṃ vṛttyā rajjvā svahṛdayeṣu te ||73||| dṛṣṭvā śrutvā haristatra bālakṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | dattātreyasvarūpeṇa tūrṇaṃ copasthito’bhavat ||74|| kukṣau pāvaṭikāṃ haste kamaṇḍalu jaṭāṃ tathā | kaupīnaṃ japamālāṃ ca dadhānaḥ pāduke śubhe ||75|| kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa japan rājñaḥ sannidhau samupāgataḥ | rājā dṛṣṭvā ca taṃ tūrṇaṃ cakāra daṇḍavad bhūmau ||76|| sainyajanāścāpi cakrurdaṇḍavad vai samantataḥ | prasannavadano devo dattātreyo jagāda tān ||77|| kathaṃ smṛto bhavadbhiśca kāraṇaṃ brūta satvaram | rājā prāha mahāmārīkaṣṭaṃ tasmāt prarakṣaya ||78|| dattātreyo hi bhagavān kukṣikoṣṭhalikāṃ tadā | vyādāya tatra yadbhasma dadau tad bhūbhṛtelpakam ||79|| mukhe kṣipetyuvācaiṣaścikṣepa ca mukhe nṛpaḥ | mahāmārī bahiryātā samūrtā vikṛtānanā ||2.237.80|| bhītā praṇamya taṃ devaṃ dudrāva śaṃkaraṃ prati | sainyaṃ cāpi tadā jātaṃ nirug vai kṣaṇamātrataḥ ||81 || tāvattatra samāyāto dattātreyo’trinandanaḥ | kāmbhareyo drutaṃ jātastadā śrībālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||82|| rājā vīkṣya hariṃ tatra tathārūpaṃ rameśvaram | rakṣakaṃ mahadāścaryaṃ hyavāpa sainyayuk tataḥ ||82 || pupūja śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ dattātreyo mahāprabhum | prasannaḥ śrīharistasmai varadānārthamāha ca ||84|| dattātreyastataḥ prāha rakṣa māmatra sannidhau | tavāṃśo’haṃ tava kṣetre vastumicchāmi sarvadā ||85|| hariḥ prāha tathāstveva vasāśvasaraso jale | dattātreyamahātīrthaṃ tava nāmnā bhaviṣyati ||86 || tatastvaṃ revatagireḥ śikhare vāsamāpsyasi | raivatādrirmahendrākhyaḥ parvataścāgamiṣyati ||87|| saurāṣṭre ca kumudādiḥ parito’sya nivatsyati | tadā te śikhare vāso dattātreya bhaviṣyati ||88|| sadā tīrthaṃ mahat tatsyād dattātreyasya sānu tat | atra tīrthaṃ jalarūpaṃ sadā sthāsyati matsthale ||89|| tatra tīrthaṃ tu te vyomni sadā sthāsyati raivate | ityukto bhagavān dattātreyaścovāsa tajjale || 2.237.90|| dattātreyamahattīrthaṃ jātaṃ sarovare hi tat | samparkatīrthamevāpi jātaṃ rakṣākaraṃ hi tat| ||91 || sa rājā kārayāmāsa taḍāgasya taṭāntike | dakṣiṇe mandiraṃ ramyaṃ dattātreyavirājitam ||92|| nirug yayau nijaṃ deśaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ prapūjya vai | rādhike śrībālakṛṣṇaścaivaṃ rakṣati duḥkhinaḥ ||93| | avatārasya bhaktānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ tatsvarūpavān | bhūtvā karoti bhagavānavatārī parātparaḥ || 94|| sarve’vatārāstasyaiva sarvaṃ tasmāt pravartate | sarvanāthaḥ sarvarakṣāṃ karoti smṛta eva saḥ || 95|| araṇye parvate nadyāṃ samudre ca vane’pi ca | viṣame bhayade sthāne smṛto rakṣati māpatiḥ || 96 || śatrumadhye kālamukhe vahnau vāyuprakopane | bhūkampe ca mahāyuddhe smṛto rakṣati sarvagaḥ || 97|| tridoṣe mardane kūpe roge durbhikṣavatsare | nigaḍe parapāśe ca smṛto rakṣati sarvadṛk ||98|| viṣimukhe hiṃsramukhe śastrapāte ca vajrake | vyomapāte prapāte ca smṛto rakṣati cātmagaḥ ||99|| rājabhaye gṛhabhaye vidrāvaṇabhaye’pi ca | prāṇabhaye sarvabhaye smṛto rakṣati śaktimān ||2.237.1 00 || rādhike ye nijā jātāsteṣāṃ kṛṣṇo nijo bhavet | tadrakṣārthaṃ mahācintāṃ karotyeva divāniśam || 101 || paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya phalaṃ tīrthakṛtaṃ bhavet | rakṣaṇaṃ duḥkhanāśaśca bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ || 102|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kālīcaturdaśyāṃ śaṃkaratadgaṇabhṛtyadāsadāsīnāṃ pūjanottaraṃ śrīhariṇā dīpadānottaraṃ ca dīpāvalyāṃ śāradāmahotsavapūjā kṛtā, pratipadi mahāmārīrogapīḍitatīrthayātrikasaṃparkanṛpādīnāṃ dattātreyarūpeṇa darśanadānena roganāśanaṃ dattātreyatīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 237 ||
<2.238> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike nūtane varṣe prabhurbrahmapriyāpatiḥ | cakāra kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre’nnakūṭakotsavam || 1 || bhojayāmāsa sarvān sa kuṃkumavāpikājanān | narānnārīrbālavargān yūno vṛddhān samastataḥ || 2 || paśūn cāgantukām̐ścāpi pakṣiṇaśca jaleśayān | bhūśayān cetanān sarvān bhojayāmāsa vai hariḥ || 3 || pratipaddivase śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo nijālaye | lakṣmīṃ tathānnapūrṇāṃ ca prāha bhojanakāmyayā || 4 || adya me vartate vāñcchā sarveṣāṃ bhojanārthikīm | madhyāhnottaravelāyāṃ yadi syāt kurutaṃ tathā || 5 || ājñāṃ prāpyānnapūrṇā ca prāha śrīparameśvaram | bhagavan pakvabhāvārthaṃ ghaṭikāpañcakaṃ khalu || 6 || apekṣyate’dya samayo vartate ca tathāvidhaḥ | kariṣyāmo’nnasāmastyaṃ śṛtaṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ || 7 || ityuktvā sā cānnapūrṇā sasmāra svasakhīṃ bhuvam | śriyaṃ sasmāra tūrṇaṃ ca vārkṣī sasmāra tatra ca || 8 || sudhāṃ sasmāra dhānyānāṃ lakṣmīṃ sasmāra vai drutam | cullikāśca sakhīḥ sarvāḥ sasmāra samidhastathā || 9 || śākapatrāṇi sasmāra veśavārān samastakān | nadīḥ sasmāra gaṃgādyā dhenūḥ sasmāra kāmadāḥ || 2.238.1 0|| pākalakṣmīḥ prasasmāra vahnīn sasmāra tatra ca | pātrāṇyakṣayanāmāni tathā sasmāra sadrasān || 11 || brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca sasmāra cānnapūrṇikā | āndhasikīḥ prasasmāra sasmāra pariveṣikāḥ || 12|| āranālādikartrīśca takrapeyavidhāyinīḥ | prasasmāra tadā sarvā sakhīstāśca samāyayuḥ || 13|| bhuvaṃ cājñāpayāmāsa kuru śīghraṃ mahānasam | krośārdhaṃ vartulaṃ śīghraṃ kṣaṇāt sāpi tathākarot || 14|| nadīḥ prāha jalārthaṃ ca tā jalāni samānayan | cullikāḥ prāha yogye ca sthale sthātuṃ sthitāśca tāḥ || 15|| vahnīn prāha nivāsārthaṃ cullīṣu vahnayaḥ sthitāḥ || kaṭāhān prāha cullīnāṃ mastake sthātumāsthitāḥ || 16|| darvyādyāstūrṇamevāsan svasvakāryaniyojitāḥ | sasyāni cāpi dhānyāni rasādīnāha pātrake || 17|| cullīpātreṣu ca sthātuṃ ghṛtādyāśca tathābhavan | āsamantāttato lakṣmyaścāndhasikyaḥ sthitāḥ puraḥ || 18|| brahmapriyāḥ samastāścopakāriṇyastadābhavan | lakṣmīnāṃ vai samastānāmicchayā ca ghṛtādikam || 19|| kaṭāheṣu ca pātreṣu tvāyānti ca tapanti ca | yathāpekṣaṃ kaṇādyāśca piṣṭādikāni tatra ca ||2.238.20 || pakvatārthaṃ samāgatya praviśanti samantataḥ | śarkarādyāstathā pakvā veśavārādayo’pi ca ||2 1|| annapūrṇecchayā tūrṇaṃ samāgatya viśanti ca | aṣṭa vai siddhayastatra sevante sarvataḥ sthitāḥ ||22|| ghaṭīdvayānte siddhāni pakvānnāni bahūnyapi | āmantraṇāni śaṃbhośca pārṣadāḥ kṣetrapā daduḥ |||23||| ākṣarakṣetravāsebhyo bhojanārthaṃ samastataḥ | pakvānnānāmabhavaiṃśca parvatā vai mahānase |||24|| aśārkarādipākāśca tato’jāyanta bhūriśaḥ | bhakṣānyapi tato jātānyasaṃkhyarūpakāni ca ||25|| bhojyānyapi drutaṃ jātānyasaṃkhyarūpakāni ca | lehyānyapi kṛtānyeva bahusaṃkhyāni tatra ca || 26|| cośyānyapi samastāni kṛtāni subahūnyapi | peyānyapi samastāni racitāni tadā drutam ||27|| āranālādīni cāpi caṭanyo vividhāstathā | kṣāracaṇakamāṣādyāstatra śṛtāstathāvidhāḥ ||28|| śākānyapi vividhāni bhājā bhājyastathāvidhāḥ | murabbārasasārāśca rāyatāni bahūnyapi || 29|| dadhighṛtanavanītapāyasakṣīratakrakam | sarvaṃ yathāpekṣakaṃ tu pakvāpakvaṃ vidhāpitam || 2.238.30|| sarvābhirbrahmayoṣidbhirlakṣmībhiḥ kanyakādibhiḥ | satībhiḥ siddhibhiścāpi sarvaṃ kṛtvoparakṣitam ||3 1|| ghaṭikāpañcamadhye tu sarvaṃ sampāditaṃ hitam | prārthayāmāsurīśvaryaḥ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ||32|| vartate sarvamevātra siddhaṃ vibhinnajātikam | vaiśvadevaṃ vidhehi tvaṃ ghaṇṭānādaṃ prakāraya ||3 3|| bhojanārthaṃ janānāṃ vai paṃktayaḥ santu sarvataḥ | madhyāhne bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hi rādhike ||34|| snātvā kṛtvā vaiśvadevaṃ tarpitvāgniṃ ca pitṛkān | tarpitvā devatāḥ sarvā ghaṇṭānādamakārayat ||31|| āgacchantu mahābhāgā bhojanārthaṃ hi paṃktiṣu | yathājñaṃ sarvapātrāṇi tadābhavan hi paṃktiṣu || 36|| brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścānye’pi mānavāḥ | āyayustatra śīghraṃ vai bhojanārthaṃ samantataḥ || 37|| brāhmaṇebhyo brahmavargāḥ pariveṣaṇamācaran | bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ naranārīḥ samastataḥ || 38|| dakṣiṇāḥ pradadau tebhyo bālakṛṣṇo hi mudrikāḥ | laḍaḍukān śaṣkulīścāpi śatacchidrāṇi khājakān || 39|| meśubhān mohanasthālān parpikākhaṇḍakām̐stathā | piṇḍakān guḍakān śreṣṭhān granthikān modakām̐stathā ||2.238.40 || kalikālaḍaḍukām̐ścāpi mudgalaḍaḍūm̐śca maṇḍakān | sohilakām̐śca saṃyāvaṃ kaṃsāraṃ ghṛtapūrakān ||41|| sevikāḥ polikā miṣṭāḥ pūrikāḥ pāyasaṃ tathā | virañjaṃ sukhadāṃ pheṇīṃ gundrapākamapūpakān ||42||| pūpām̐śca ghurghurāṃścāpi vaṭakān tilapiṣṭakān | śāṭakān sthirakām̐ścāpi rambhācūtaphalāni ca ||43|| śākāni bhiṇḍakān svarṇadugdhāṃ kośātakīṃ tathā | rājakośātakīṃ gavāhārām̐śca mārgarīṃ tathā ||44|| karkoṭikāṃ śimbikāṃ ca karkaṭīṃ cirbhaṭaṃ tathā | raktāluṃ rājamāṣādīn śimbībimbīphalāni ca ||45|| śarkarākandamevāpi kharbūjaṃ kāravellakam | kūṣmāṇḍaṃ sūraṇaṃ cāpi muniśimbīḥ paṭolakam ||46|| karkaṭīrmethikāścāpi pāravallaṃ ca mūlakam | śatapuṣpāmamblaloṇīṃ jīvantīṃ syandikāṃ tathā ||47|| vṛntākaṃ bharjitaṃ cāpi rājikāktāni yāni ca | drākṣākhārikasammiśrān dadhimiśravaṭīvaṭān ||48|| puṣpavaṭīśca bhojyāni saurabhodanamityapi | sūpaḥ kvathikāstakrāṇi dadhimanthāni yāni ca ||49|| talitān harimanthām̐śca niṣpāvān parpaṭām̐stathā | navanītaṃ cāranālaṃ caṭanīṃ dhānyakādijām ||2.238.50|| dugdhaṃ ca kvathitaṃ miṣṭaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ sakesaram | marīcāni sutiktāni tathailākaṇakāni ca ||91|| bhūphalīśarkarābījānyapi vallān vaṭāṇakān | kalikā miṣṭapolīśca ghārikā miṣṭajambukān ||52|| roṭakān mūśalīpākān vāsudevīṃ ca mallikām | śrīkhaṇḍaṃ taralāṃ cāpi māṣalaḍaḍūn kalāvakam ||53|| ekottaraśataṃ tatra padārthān vāḍavādayaḥ | bhuktvā tṛptiṃ parāṃ prāpya yayurgṛhāṇi vai tataḥ ||54|| kṣatriyā vaiśyavargāśca śūdrā bubhujire mudā | dīnā anāthavargāśca bhikṣukāśca nirāśritāḥ ||55||| dāsavargā dāsikāśca sarvā bubhujire tadā | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrasthitā bubhujire’khilāḥ ||56|| tatra tatra padārtheṣu nyūnaṃ naiva prajāyate | vardhate tvakṣaye pātre vastuni pariveṣite ||57|| akṣayaṃ cāvyayaṃ sarvaṃ dīyamānaṃ prajāyate | maharṣayastathā santaḥ sādhvyo bubhujire tathā ||58|| ābālavṛddhagopālāḥ sarve bubhujire tadā | kṣetrapālā devatādyāḥ sarve bubhujire’pi ca ||59 || hareḥ sarvaṃ kuṭumbaṃ ca bubhuje śrīśavāñcchayā | brahmapriyādyāḥ sarvāśca bhojayituṃ priyaṃ patim ||2.238.60|| sotsāhāścāyayurbālakṛṣṇasvāmipurastadā | svarṇapaṭṭikasaṃsthāni pātrāṇi ca hareḥ kṛte ||61 || pakvānnapūrṇakānyeva nyadhurhareḥ puraśca tāḥ | svarṇāsane hariḥ samyaṅniṣadyorṇosane prabhuḥ ||62|| bhoktuṃ cācamya ca samārebhe vyāhṛtipūrvakam | ārcican śrīhariṃ tāścandanakuṃkumakesaraiḥ ||63 || bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ premālyaścātibhāvataḥ | lakṣmīrviśālaṃ sthālaṃ ca kānakaṃ nidadhau puraḥ ||64|| rādhe tvayā samantācca sthāpitā laghuvāṭikāḥ | māṇikyā kalaśaṃ pānapātraṃ jalayutaṃ nyadhāt ||65|| ramā ca vyajanaṃ dhṛtvā vāyudānaṃ karoti hi | padmāvatī naktakaṃ ca dhṛtvā pārśve sthitābhavat ||66|| brahmapriyāstathā sarvāḥ sarvadeśodbhavāstadā | vidadhurvai padārthānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pariveṣaṇam ||67|| annapūrṇādikā devyaḥ prāhuḥ śrīparameśvaram | bhuṃkṣva nātha kṛpākānta didṛkṣāmo’tra bhāvitāḥ ||68|| atha kṛṣṇaḥ kare kṛtvā kavalaṃ bubhuje mudā | aho miṣṭamaho bhojyaṃ kayedaṃ randhitaṃ śubham ||69|| pṛṣṭvā tatkartrīnāmāni praśaśaṃsa tu tā muhuḥ | atisvādu kṛtaṃ cedaṃ praśaṃsya bubhuje punaḥ ||2.238.70 || brahmapriyādyāḥ sarvāśca bhuñjānaṃ dadṛśurharim | vīkṣamāṇāḥ prāṇapatimāścaryaṃ lebhire striyaḥ ||71 || svalpaṃ bhuktvā samutthātuṃ samaihata yadā hariḥ | śāradā taṃ sthāpayantī jagau bhuṃkṣveti kīrtanam ||72|| sarasvatī savāditrā prītaye śrīhareḥ puraḥ | jagau bhojanapadyāni bhojayituṃ viśeṣataḥ ||73|| bhojanaṃ vidhehi nātha jīvana yogin prasādaṃ pradehi kānta hṛdayeśa yogin | kavalaṃ gṛhāṇa kṛṣṇa miṣṭamiṣṭamenam, prāsvādaya prakṛṣṭasaurabhānnakūṭam ||74|| pumarthadātṛ bhagavan prabhuṃkṣva kāmametat, samastapakvametat re jīvana yogin | bhojanaṃ vidhehi nātha jīvana yogin, prasādaṃ pradehi kānta hṛdayeśa yogin ||75|| meśubhamohanasthālaṃ rasālapāyasānnaṃ, suśaṣkulīṃ ca pheṇīṃ śrīkhaṇḍamiṣṭapolīm | bhojanaṃ vidhehi nātha jīvana yogin, prasādaṃ pradehi kāntajīvana yogin ||76|| suparpikāṃ rasāḍhyāṃ ca modakān virañjaṃ, sugundrapākamiṣṭaṃ suśāṭakāṃśca ghurghurān | bhojanaṃ vidhehi nātha jīvana yogin, prasādaṃ pradehi kānta jīvana yogin ||77|| svādumiṣṭacaṇakān surājamāṣavaṭakān, praśākabhājikādiprabhojyapuṣpavāṭīḥ | bhojanaṃ vidhehi nātha jīvana yogin, prasādaṃ pradehi kānta hṛdayeśa yogin ||78|| parparām̐śca caṭanīṃ śubhāranālakāni, sutakradugdhakāni samastabhojanāni | bhojanaṃ vidhehi nātha jīvana yogin, prasādaṃ pradehi kānta hṛdayeśa yogin ||79|| sugandhi vāri miṣṭaṃ sūpaudanaṃ yadiṣṭaṃ, praphullapūrikādiprapakvaghurghurādīn | bhojanaṃ vidhehi nātha jīvana yogin, prasādaṃ pradehi kānta hṛdayeśa yogin ||2.238.80|| elālavaṃgamiśraṃ tāmbūlakaṃ sudhāktaṃ, cākaṇṭhapūrtamadyaṃ prabhuṃkṣva dehi śiṣṭam | bhojanaṃ vidhehi nātha vallabha svāmin, prasādaṃ pradehi kānta kāmaneśa bhogin ||8 1|| ityevaṃ rādhike sarvā bhojayāmāsa satpatim | bhagavān vubhuje pūrṇaṃ tataḥ sarvā api striyaḥ ||82|| kavalāni kare kṛtvā bhojanāya nijaṃ patim | viśvaṃbharaṃ prasahyaiva yatnaṃ tatra pracakrire ||83|| yogeśvaro haristāsāṃ tādṛṅmānasasiddhaye | sarvapatnīsamasaṃkhyasvarūpo’bhūdasaṃkhyakaḥ ||84|| sarvāsāṃ brahmapatnīnāṃ karebhyaḥ kavalāni tu | bubhuje samakālena snehena tāḥ prarañjayan ||85|| jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ cāpi pratyekakarato hariḥ | papau prajagṛhe tatra pūrṇakāmāśca tāstataḥ ||86|| atha sarvasakhībhyaśca pakvānnāni muhurmuhuḥ | bhojayāmāsa bhagavān prasādāni kareṇa vai ||87|| bhojayitvā ca tāmbūlarasaṃ tāmbūlakāni ca | pāyayāmāsa tāḥ sarvāḥ koṭyarbudābjakanyakāḥ ||88|| kṛtakṛtyāśca tā jātā brahmapriyāstathāparāḥ | pariveṣaṇakartryaśca pākakartryastathā striyaḥ ||89|| pākasāhāyyakartryaśca vastuhāriṇya ityapi | vastūdbhāvanakartryaśca rasadā yoṣitastathā ||2.238.90|| annapūrṇādibhistatra yā yāścākāritāstu tāḥ | sarvāḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaprasādaṃ durlabhaṃ hyapi ||91 || sulabhaṃ prāpya ca bubhujire tṛptiṃ gatāśca tāḥ | evaṃ bhuktvā tvannakūṭaṃ pracakruḥ parihārakam ||92|| jalajantubhya evāpi dadau prasādamuttamam | pakṣibhyaśca paśubhyaśca kīṭādibhyaḥ samantataḥ ||93|| pradadau bhagavām̐statra prasādaṃ tvanivāritam | vṛkṣebhyo vanavallībhyaḥ stabakebhyaḥ samantataḥ ||94|| dravatprāsādikaṃ khādyaṃ dadau mūleṣu vai hariḥ | prasādagrahaṇārthaṃ vai devā maharṣayastathā ||95|| pitaraścāpi muktāśca divyadehāḥ samāyayuḥ | yatra yatra prasādaḥ sa dṛṣṭastatra tathāvidhāḥ ||96|| bhūtvā te jagṛhuḥ sarve prasādaṃ tvaprakāśitāḥ | evaṃ cānugrahaṃ prāpya svasvalokān yayurhi te ||97|| tāḥ sarvāḥ siddhayo bhuktvā labdhvājñāṃ pārameśvarīm | mahānasapradeśasya tirobhāvaṃ vyadhustadā ||98|| sarvaṃ vai līnatāṃ yātaṃ nagarī tṛptimāgatā | jayakāraṃ jagau kṛṣṇavallabhasya suharṣitā ||99|| tato nijālayaṃ gatvā viśrāntimāpureva tu | evaṃ mahotsavaṃ cakre rādhike kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ || 2.238.10 0|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya tvannakūṭaphalaṃ labhet | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheccāpi bālakṛṣṇasya tarpaṇāt || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrīhariṇānnakūṭotsavo vihitaḥ sarvaprajābhojanādi kāritaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭātriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 238 ||
<2.239> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike’tha śṛṇu cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ hareḥ prabhoḥ | kārtikaikādṛśīrātriprānte vyadhāttu yaṃ prabhuḥ || 1 || puṇḍarīko’bhavadrājā gaurjaro vaiṣṇavo mahān | sarvadharmānvito rājyamapālayanmahītaṭe || 2 || prātaḥ pūjāṃ karotyeva viṣṇorlakṣmyāḥ suvastubhiḥ | sādhūn vṛddhān pūjayitvā gṛhṇāti bhojanaṃ sadā || 3 || nityamatithayastasya gṛhe cāyānti yānti ca | harernāmnāṃ bhajanaṃ ca kṛtvā tvannāni bhuṃjate || 4 || harerjayantikāhānāṃ karotyapi vratāni ca | rājñā tena nije rājye śrāvitaḥ paṭahaḥ śubhaḥ || 5 || ekādaśyāstu yāvatyaḥ kāryā aśanavarjitāḥ | sarvābhirvai prajābhiśca vṛddhabālāturān vinā || 6 || prajāḥ sarvāstadājñāṃ ca pālayantyeva sadvratāḥ | vaiṣṇavyaśca prajāstasya bhajante ca vrate harim || 7 || sa rājā tīrthayātrārthaṃ tvaśvapaṭṭasaro yayau | kārtikaikādaśī tena kṛtā kṣetre’kṣarābhidhe || 8 || kuṃkumavāpikāyāṃ sa daśamyāmabhigamya ca | bhojayāmāsa sādhūm̐śca viprāṃśca bālakṛṣṇakam || 9 || pūjayāmāsa bhaktyaiva lomaśaṃ carṣimaṇḍalam | tīrthe’vagāhanaṃ cakre cakre devādidarśanam ||2.239.1 0|| vyalokayat sa nagarīṃ divyāṃ kuṃkumavāpikām | pradakṣiṇāṃ cakārāpi sarovarasya sarvataḥ || 11 || taṭasthadevatāḥ sarvāḥ pūjayāmāsa vastubhiḥ | rātrau tvārārtrikaṃ cakre sarovarasya bhūpatiḥ || 12|| viśrāntiṃ prāpa śālāyāṃ prātarutthāya satvaram | kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtasnānaḥ kṛtavipraprapūjanaḥ || 13 || kṛtatīrthavidhiḥ kṛṣṇadarśanārthaṃ yayau tadā | pūjayāmāsa bāleśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 14|| dadau dānānyanantāni svarṇarūpyāmbarāṇi ca | viprebhyaḥ pradadau tairthikebhyo rājā dhanāni ca || 16|| sādhubhyo’mbarapātrāṇi dīnebhyo’pekṣitāni vai | godānāni dadau cāpi hyannadānānyapi nṛpaḥ || 16|| udyāpanaṃ vratasyāpi kārayāmāsa satphalam | suvarṇaghaṭakādānādi svarṇamūrtipradānakam || 17|| dhanadhānyāmbarapātradānaṃ cakāra bhūpatiḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāśravaṇaṃ tathā || 18|| lomaśasyāśrame gatvā cakāra divase nṛpaḥ | ṛṣīṇāṃ sevanaṃ cakre sādhvīnāṃ sevanaṃ tathā || 1 9|| bhaktānāṃ vandanaṃ rājā cakre sāyaṃ prapūjanam | ārārtrikaṃ cakārāpi rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ vyadhāt ||2.239.20||| nirjalaśca nirāhāraḥ sarvasārthasamanvitaḥ | rātrau ca bhajanaṃ cakre tālīvādanapūrvakam || 21|| harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa parameśa pareśvara | kāṃbhareya paramātman śrīmadgopālanandana ||22||| brahmapriyāpate lakṣmīpate rādhāpate prabho | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa svāmipate vibho ||23|| evaṃ cakāra bhajanaṃ raṭaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ tadā | dadhyau svahṛdaye sākṣād dṛṣṭaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavallabham ||24|| āprātarbhajanaṃ kṛtvā dhyānamagno babhūva ha | anugāśca yayuḥ sarve snānārthaṃ ca sarovare || 25|| rājā brāhme muhūrte svahṛdaye śrīnarāyaṇam | dhyātvā so’haṃ ca so’haṃ ca so’haṃ so’haṃ jajāpa ha || 26| so’haṃ haṃsaśca haṃsaśca haṃsahaṃsaṃ jajāpa ca | bhagavān śrībālakṛṣṇaḥ śrutvā jāpaṃ hṛdi sthitaḥ || 27|| prasanno’bhūd drutaṃ smṛtvā haṃsarūpaṃ purātanam | babhūva śīghraṃ tatraiva haṃsarūpo hariḥ svayam || 28|| śuklavarṇaḥ śuklakāntiḥ śuklahaṃsasvarūpavān | divyamānuṣavaktraśca haṃsadehaḥ śriyā yutaḥ || 29|| rūpānurūpāvayavaḥ koṭikandarpasundaraḥ | sarvavidyāśevadhiśca tathā vedādiśevadhiḥ ||2.239.3 0|| śanaiḥ śanaiśca padbhyāṃ sa cāyayau nṛpasannidhau | rājā svahṛdaye deśaṃ dadarśa sarasastaṭam || 31 || haṃsamāyāntamevāpi lakṣmīṃ dadarśa pārśvagām | āścaryapūrṇahṛdayaḥ premapūritavigrahaḥ ||32|| utthāya bhagavantaṃ taṃ cābhiyātuṃ tvarānvitaḥ | abhavattāvadevāsau jāgradbhāvaṃ gato’bhavat |||33||| netre conmīlya yāvatsa rādhe paśyati sannidhau | paśyati sma mahātejaḥpuñjaṃ dikṣu samantataḥ || 34|| tejo yogye svake netre hyajāyetāṃ kṣaṇāntare | tatastejogarbhake sa dadarśa jagatāṃ patim || 35|| śvetavarṇaṃ haṃsarūpaṃ hasantaṃ śrīsamanvitam | utthāya sahasā rājā papāta daṇḍavat tadā ||36 || kṛtārtho’smītyabhidhāya mukhe pādarajo nyadhāt | luluṇṭha bhūtale’syāpi pādayoḥ sannidhau muhuḥ ||37|| netrāśrūṇi mumocāpi harṣeṇa mahatā nṛpaḥ | lakṣmīḥ kamaṇḍalorvāri nṛpamūrdhyanyabhisiṣeca ha ||38|| prasādaṃ prāpya rājā tajjalaṃ harṣānvitaḥ papau | kṛtakṛtyo’bhavatprāpya darśanaṃ prajagāda ha ||39|| ahobhāgyamahobhāgyaṃ rājadehasya me nvidam | yaddṛṣṭau paramānandaḥ pūrṇabrahma pareśvara ||2.239.40|| haṃsarūpaḥ śriyāyuktaḥ sākṣātkaruṇayāgataḥ | pāvito’haṃ mokṣito’haṃ samuddhṛto’smi sāgarāt ||41 || ityuktvā caraṇau dhṛtvā haṃsasya maunamāvahat | haṃsaḥ prāha varaṃ rājan vṛṇu yatte’bhivāñcchitam |42||| rājā prāha hare cātra mokṣaṃ dehi pade naya | name vāñcchāsti rājyasya lokaiṣaṇā na vidyate ||43 || anyaiṣaṇāstu sampūrṇā vartante mokṣamāvaha | yallābho yogināṃ nāsti yugakāle gate’pi ca ||44|| sa lābho’dya mayā prāptaścaikādaśīvratena ha | tasmād dehi kṛpāsindho mokṣaṇaṃ sarvathātra me ||46 || rādhike rājavākyāni svīkṛtya parameśvaraḥ | tathāstviti hasanprāha tāvadrājānugādayaḥ ||47|| āyuyurvīkṣya tejāṃsi taṃ hariṃ samalokayan | kṛtakṛtyā hi te jātā vīkṣya haṃsasvarūpiṇam ||47|| tāvat tatra samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ sūryavarculam | rājā dehaṃ vihāyaiva muktadehamavāpa ha ||48|| caturbhujo viṣṇutulyo vimānastho’bhavat kṣaṇāt | rājñī tasyāstadā śīghraṃ vimānaṃ svakareṇa vai ||49|| saha yātuṃ dadhāraiva sparśamāptāpi sā tadā | tyaktvā bhautikadehaṃ svaṃ divyadehā babhūva ha ||2.239.50|| vimānaṃ śīghramevāpi tatastatrāmbare’bhavat | haṃsaḥ śrībālakṛṣṇo’pi viṣṇuścaturbhujo’bhavat ||51 || tadvimānena rājānaṃ ninye vaikuṇṭhameva saḥ | bālakṛṣṇasvarūpeṇa sarastīre sthito’bhavat ||52|| tejo vilīnatāṃ yātaṃ sārtho’pyāścaryamāptavān | dehakriyāṃ pracakruśca sārthāḥ sarve nṛpānugāḥ ||53|| tato yayurnijaṃ deśaṃ putraṃ jagadurbhūbhṛtaḥ | vṛttāntaṃ sarvamevainaṃ punaḥ śrutvā mumoda ha ||54|| rādhike haṃsatīrthaṃ tattvaśvapaṭṭasarojale | abhavad dakṣiṇe pūrve koṇe muktipradaṃ śubham ||55|| snānāddānādavagāhājjalapānānniṣevaṇāt | bhuktiḥ svargaṃ ca muktiśca bhaveyurnātra saṃśayaḥ ||56|| ātmajñānaṃ bhavettatra snānātpānājjalasya ca | yajñapuṇyaṃ bhaveccāpi haṃsatīrthe’nnadānataḥ ||57|| dvādaśyāṃ tvekasādhorhi bhojanātpuṇyamuttamam| śatasādhubhojanasya puṇyaṃ bhavenna saṃśayaḥ ||58|| ekādaśyāṃ phaladānāt svarṇadānasamaṃ phalam | svarṇadānād rājasūyasamaṃ cātra bhavet phalam ||59|| śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tvanyaṃ camatkāraṃ mahāprabhoḥ | rolākhyaścotkalarājastīrthārthaṃ somanāthakam ||2.239.6 0 || samāyayau svasainyena bahumāsaiḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | somanāthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ kṛtvā prācīsarasvatīm ||61|| mūladvārikikātīrthaṃ kṛtvā ca vāmanasthalīm | bhadrāvatīmahātīrthaṃ kṛtvā kuṃkumavāpikām ||62|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīraṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ samāyayau | sāyamāgatya vidhinā kṛtvā tīrthaṃ jalaṃ pāpau ||63 || sainyaṃ tṛptaṃ jalapānād rātrau bhojanamāpa saḥ | devārārtrikanādām̐ścāśṛṇot sādhukṛtān stavān ||64|| rātrau viśrāntimāsādya tato nidrāvaśo’bhavat | suptaṃ sainyaṃ cotthitaṃ ca prātastaṭākaprāṅtaṭe ||65|| udyānaḥ phalapūṣpāṇāmāsīttatrāśvaśūṇḍhinaḥ | udyādyāḥ paśavo rājñastṛṇāni carituṃ yayuḥ ||66|| udyānavṛkṣaḥ paśubhirbhakṣitā nāśitā api | rājā sūryodaye bhūtvā vinidro’śvasaro yayau ||67|| snānaṃ dānaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā svaniveśamupāyayau | tāvannityaṃ prapūjāṃ sa yasyāḥ karoti bhūpatiḥ ||68|| śrīnṛsiṃhapratimāyāḥ sā tatra dṛśyatāṃ gatā | rājā śuśoca manasāparāddhaṃ tvatra vai mayā ||69|| nānyathā pratimālopo bhavedevaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | sa tu tuṣṭāva nṛhariṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā ||2.239.70|| kathaṃ nātha kṛpāpārāvāra ruṣṭo’dya vai mayi | na jāne tvaparāddhaṃ kiṃ mayātra yadgato bhavān ||71 || mariṣyāmyadanaṃ tyaktvā grahīṣye na jalaṃ phalam | aparāddhurbhavedeva prāyaścittamidaṃ mama ||72|| evaṃ pravadite tena vyomavāṇī hyajāyata | atra rājan phalapuṣpodyānaṃ pūrvadiśi dhruvam |73||| kṛṣṇavallabhakṛṣṇasya vidyate paramātmanaḥ | tannāśastvatpaśvādyairvai kriyate paśya mā ciram ||74|| nivāraya drutaṃ tām̐śca mahodyānaṃ prakāraya | aparāddhaṃ tvayā tvetacchṛṇu cānyattvayā kṛtam ||75|| atra pūjā tvayā śrīmadbālakṛṣṇasya no kṛtā | ahaṃ yasyāvatāro’smi sa me’vatārakāraṇam ||76|| tamapūjya mama pūjā yadi syāt te’parādhanam | tato’haṃ vilayaṃ prāptaḥ pūrvaṃ taṃ tvaṃ prapūjaya ||77|| tato māṃ sampūjayātra tena tuṣṭo bhavāmi te | mama mūrti sthāpayātra tvaśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ||78|| mandire śobhane tatra nivatsye kṛṣṇasannidhau | udyānasya prarakṣyārthaṃ vanyarakṣārthamityapi ||79|| tato’haṃ vai tvayā sārdhamāgamiṣyāmi nānyathā | ityukto rādhike rājā vyomavāṇīṃ prapūjya ca ||2.239.80|| tūrṇaṃ sainyāntikaṃ gatvā vārayāmāsa tān paśūn | vīkṣya bhagnaṃ samudyānaṃ paraṃ śokaṃ jagāma saḥ ||81 || vṛttāntaṃ sainyapālebhyo vinivedya tato drutam | ājñāpyodyānarakṣārthaṃ navodyānābhiklṛptaye ||82|| śīghraṃ prāsādanirmityai tathājñāṃ sampradāya ca | pūjāsāmagrikāyukto bālakṛṣṇālayaṃ yayau ||83|| rolamāyāntamāvīkṣya hasan jagāda satpatiḥ | rola rājan kadā tvasmin kṣetre prāpto bhavān vada ||84|| kaścinnirāmayaṃ te’sti tava sainyasya vai punaḥ | kaccit sukhinaḥ paśavo mānavā yātrikāstava ||85|| bhojanaṃ madgṛhe tvadya gṛhāṇa tvaṃ nareśvara | ityukto rolarājaḥ saḥ vimucyāśrūṇi cāha tam ||86|| nārāyaṇa kṛpāsindho’parāddhaṃ te mayātra vai | udyāno nāśitaḥ sainyapaśubhistatkṣamāṃ kuru ||87|| kārayiṣyāmi codyānaṃ kārayiṣyāmi mandiram | nṛsiṃhasya tava mūrteḥ sthāpanaṃ sarvadā tviha ||88|| kṣetrodyānasya rakṣārthaṃ yāsyāmi ca svarāṣṭrakam | tava pūjāṃ vinā kṛṣṇa nṛsiṃho me layaṃ gataḥ ||89|| tamimaṃ me’parāddhaṃ prakṣamasva puruṣottama | ityuktvā rādhike śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaṃ samārcayat ||2.239.90|| rājaveṣāmbarabhūṣāgandhamālākṣatādibhiḥ | daṇḍavat pracakārātha naivedyaṃ piṇḍakān dadau ||9 1 || tāmbūlakaṃ dadau cāpi prasādaṃ jagṛhe hareḥ | kṣamitaṃ ceti hariṇā prokto nijālayaṃ yayau ||92|| tāvannṛsiṃhabhagavān mūrtirūpo nijāsane | prakaṭībhūya nṛpateḥ pūjāṃ jagrāha bhāvataḥ ||93|| rājāpi kārayāmāsa mandiraṃ sudṛḍhaṃ navam | nṛsiṃhaṃ sthāpayāmāsa mandire vṛttikāṃ dadau ||94|| udyānaṃ ropayitvā ca niyujya rakṣakaṃ tataḥ | yayau cotkaladeśaṃ sa rādhike kṛṣṇabhaktimān ||95|| evaṃ nṛsiṃhatīrthaṃ tat sarovarajale’bhavat | rolatīrthaṃ suramyaṃ tanmandiraṃ nṛharestathā ||96|| sarvaṃ tīrthamayaṃ cābhūd bālakṛṣṇapratāpataḥ | tatra snānaprakartāro bhuktiṃ muktiṃ śubhāṃ gatim ||97|| yāsyantyeva hi dātāro phalānāṃ śākhiropiṇaḥ | puṣpastabakaropāśca mahodyānavidhāyinaḥ ||98|| prayāsyanti hi te sarve brahmadhāmākṣaraṃ ghruvam | vṛkṣamūle jalasekaprakartāro’pi mānavāḥ ||99|| svargaṃ prāpya ciraṃ bhuktvā yāsyanti tvakṣaraṃ mama | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsyodyānaropaphalaṃ bhavet || 2.239.10 0|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre yatra kvāpi kṣitau taṭe | vṛkṣavallīropiṇo ye te yāsyanti parāṃ gatim || 10 1|| avaṃśā vaṃśamāpsyanti nirdhanā dhaninastathā | arasā rasapūrṇāśca bhaviṣyanti drupālanāt || 1 02|| dhanadhānyasamṛddhāśca phalamiṣṭānnabhojinaḥ | bhaviṣyanti vṛkṣaropādaśvapaṭṭasarontike || 1 03|| rādhike vṛkṣapātāro bhavantyete mama priyāḥ | vaneṣu vallavīvrāte phale puṣpe vasāmyaham || 1 04|| vṛkṣarakṣakalokānāṃ gṛhe lakṣmīsamanvitaḥ | vasāmyahaṃ na sandehastannāśe’pasarāmi hi || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kārtikaikādaśīvratena puṇḍarīkanṛpaterhaṃsarūpahariṃ prāptasya mokṣaḥ, aśvapaṭṭasarasi haṃsatīrtham, colarājñāpi nṛsiṃhayogenāśvapaṭṭasarastīre nṛsiṃhasthāpanaṃ nṛsiṃhatīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||239||
<2.240> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ śriyaḥpateḥ | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre jātaṃ yogeśvaraṃ prati || 1 || vītihotro mahoyogī vane yogeśvaro’bhavat | himācale badaryāṃ sa tapastepe’tidāruṇam || 2 || sarvayogakalāḥ prāpa yathā śaṃbhustathābhavat | tena yogapratāpena dṛṣṭā vai divyacakṣuṣā || 3 || ketumāle kṛtā yajñāḥ kenāṭe’pi kṛtā makhāḥ | amarīṇāṃ pradeśeṣu kṛtaṃ yaddhariṇā tu tat || 4 || ūrjākṛṣṇāṣṭamījanmamahotsavaśca yaḥ kṛtaḥ | śāradāpūjanādyaṃ ca hyannakūṭamahotsavaḥ || 5 || etatsarvaṃ divyadṛṣṭyā vijñāya parameśvaram | kāṃbhareyaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ sākṣādupāyayau || 6 || āyayau kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre kṛṣṇanārāyaṇam | sahasrarūpadhartāsau vītihotraḥ samādhimān || 7 || mārgaśīrṣatṛtīyāyāmaśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe | setumāśritya ca nyagrodhasyādho’dhānnijāsanam || 8 || sahasrarūpadhartāsau saṃkalpya niṣasāda ha | mama mūlasvarūpaṃ cāgatyāśliṣyet ramāpatiḥ || 9 || tataḥ sahasrarūpaiścāśliṣyenmā sa prabhuḥ punaḥ | ṛṣabhasya kārayenye sadgurordarśane yadi || 2.240.10 || tadāhaṃ śrīhareragre nivatsye’tra sadānugaḥ | mokṣaṃ prasādhayiṣye’tra badaryā na prayojanam || 11 || na guroraparasyāpi mokṣado hi gururyataḥ | yatrātmano bhavetpuṣṭiryena tarati sāgaram || 13 2|| yasmāccātmamahāśāntistaṃ guruṃ tvāśrayejjanaḥ | yasmātpāpavināśaśca yasmādajñānanāśanam || 13 || yasmād vṛttinirodhaśca vāsanākṣapaṇaṃ yataḥ | yasmādātmaprakāśaśca taṃ guruṃ tvāśrayejjanaḥ || 14|| yasmācchikṣāmavāpyetaiśvaryaṃ camatkṛtiṃ tathā | divyayabhāvamadhitiṣṭhettaṃ guruṃ tvāśrayejjanaḥ || 15|| guravo bahavaḥ santi laukikāścāpyalaukikāḥ | laukikena hi lokasthāḥ kāryā vai guravo yathā || 15 || alaukikena śiṣyeṇālaukikā guravo dhṛtāḥ | mayāpyalaukikaḥ so’yaṃ kartavyo bhagavān guruḥ || 17|| yatra sarvaṃ hi kartavyaṃ harau parisamāpyate | mātā gururhi janudā pitā gururhi bījadaḥ || 18|| anye rakṣākarāḥ santi dehasya guravo hi te | bhāṣājñānakarāścānye bāndhavādyāśca yoṣitaḥ || 1 9|| tathā śikṣākarāścānye vidyādānakarā api | kalākauśalyaśikṣāyā dātāro guravo’pi ca || 2.240.20 || ta ete dehayātrāyāṃ bhavanti guravaḥ khalu | ātmajñānaprado yastu viṣṇumantrapradaśca yaḥ | | 21 || dharmavṛttiprado yaśca guruḥ śreṣṭho hi sammataḥ | brahmasthitiprado yaśca yogasiddhipradaśca yaḥ || 22|| vaiśāradyaprado buddhau guruḥ śreṣṭhataro hi saḥ | nirmalāṃ vāsanāṃ kṛtvā parameśapradarśakaḥ || 23 || ātmanā paramātmānaṃ prāpako divyamokṣadaḥ | brahmalokapreṣakaśca guruḥ śreṣṭhatamo hi saḥ || 24|| gakārastvandhamajñānaṃ rakāro jñānamujjvalam | ajñānahā jñānadaśca gururgauravavānmataḥ || 25| | gamayatyakṣaraṃ dhāma ramavatyapi dhāminā | guruḥ so’yaṃ mokṣadātā nānyaḥ śreṣṭhastato guruḥ || 26 || gururyogī brahmacārī dharmī jñānī virāgavān | sādhuśīlo guruścāpi nārāyaṇaḥ paro guruḥ || 27 || bhuktidātā mokṣadātā sarvasvado harirguruḥ | guroḥ sākṣātkārayitā gurorgururyato’tra saḥ | | 28|| sa eva śrīhariścāyaṃ muktānāṃ paramo guruḥ | guruḥ sarvāvatārāṇāṃ satīnāṃ ca satāṃ guruḥ || 29 || īśvarāṇāṃ tathā dhāmnāṃ yogināṃ sargasamvidām | pūrveṣāṃ sṛṣṭikartṝṇāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ dyuvāsinām || 2.240.30 || prajeśānāṃ karmaṭhānāṃ bhaktānāṃ ca paro guruḥ | gurūṇāṃ yāvatāmagryo nārāyaṇagurorguruḥ || 31 || anādi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ svāmī kāṃbhareyaḥ parātparaḥ | | 3 2|| śrīmadgopālabālo’yaṃ svāmī vai sarvadehinām | mayā labdhaḥ sa me pūrṇaṃ kariṣyatyeva mānasam || 33 || nivatsyāmi caraṇe’sya prāpsyāmi dhāma cākṣaram | sañcintyeti vītihotro dhyānamagnaḥ sahasradhā || 34|| sahasrarūpavān jāto dṛṣṭvā taṃ mānavāstaṭe | snātāro’guḥ parāścaryaṃ kasyemāni samāni vai ||35|| rūpāṇi ke cāgatā vai yogino’tra sahasraśaḥ | samaveṣāḥ samadehāḥ samāṃgāḥ santi sadṛśāḥ || 36 || samakeśāḥ samadhyānāḥ samānaparimāṇakāḥ | bhrātaro vā bhavantyete dhāmamuktā bhavanti vā || 37|| vadarīvāsino vāpi śvetamuktāḥ kimāgatāḥ| śaṃkarasya gaṇāḥ kiṃvā devāstāpasarūpiṇaḥ || 38|| sādhyā vā devatā yadvā meruvāsā hi tāpasāḥ | ka ete tu bhaveyurvai candrāsyā bhāskaraprabhāḥ || 39|| dhyānayogā yogino vā yogeśvarāḥ sahasraśaḥ | na vadanti na paśyanti na prāṇān cālayantyapi | |2.240.40 || sthiramaunāḥ sthiracittā īśvarāḥ syuśca kenvime | ityeva tarkayanto vai kuṃkumavāpikājanāḥ ||41 || saṃghaśo vai samāyānti draṣṭuṃ kutūhalānvitāḥ | kecinnamanti dṛṣṭvaiva praśaṃsanti vadanti ca ||42|| pratāpo’yaṃ bālakṛṣṇakṛpānāthasya vartate | asya darśanalābhārthaṃ nityamāyānti yoginaḥ ||43|| adṛśyā īdṛśāḥ sarve’dhunā te dṛśyatāṃ gatāḥ | rudrāḥ sahasraśaścāpi viṣṇavaśca sahasraśaḥ ||44|| sahasraśo’pi brahmāṇo draṣṭumāyānti sadvaram | tathā maharṣayo nityaṃ pitaro devatāstathā ||45|| sādhyā viśve ca maruto draṣṭumāyānti nityaśaḥ | tīrthānyapi samāyānti dikpālāḥ sṛṣṭipālakāḥ ||46|| athavā pārṣadā divyā golokādinivāsinaḥ | samāyānti ca vaikuṇṭhapārṣadā api nityaśaḥ ||47|| grahanakṣatratārāśca sūryāścandrāḥ sahasraśaḥ | vaimānikāḥ samāyānti lokāntarebhya ādṛtāḥ ||48 || vālakhilyāḥ samāyānti yadvā brahmasabhādvijāḥ | kiṃ vā bhaveyurgāndharvā yakṣā vā dhanadāśca vā |||49||| cāraṇāḥ parvatavāsā munayo vā vanasthitāḥ | paraṃ sādṛśyamevaiṣāmapūrvatvaṃ vigāhate |||2.240.50 || lalāṭe vaiṣṇavaṃ puṇḍraṃ mastake tāpasī jaṭā | netramudrā yogapuṣṭāḥ khyāpayantyaṃśamācyutam ||51 || ye vā ke vā bhaveyuste sākṣātkṛtā yadatra te | asmābhirdaivayogena puṇyavadbhiḥ subhāgyakaiḥ ||52||| avaśyameṣāṃ vijñānaṃ kṣaṇe’traiva bhaviṣyati | ityevaṃ te vadantaśca prajāḥ saṃghaśa eva ha | |53 || prapaśyanti sarastīre sahasrayoginastadā | atha śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo nārāyaṇagurorguruḥ || 54|| samāyayau sarastīre sannidhau yogināṃ tadā | hārdaṃ jānam̐stadā tūrṇaṃ pravīkṣya mūlarūpiṇam ||55|| samuttolya samāhūya nāmnā taṃ vītihotraka | uttiṣṭheti karo dhṛtvā kṛtvā vakṣasi yoginam ||56 || samāśliṣyaddhasam̐stūrṇaṃ svayaṃ sahasradhābhavat | samutthitaiḥ sahasrasvarūpairāśliṣyadacyutaḥ ||57|| tatastūrṇaṃ hariścaikasvarūpaḥ sambabhūva ha | vītihotro’pi sahasā tvekarūpo vyajāyata ||58|| āścaryacakitā lokā jayaśabdān pracakrire | tāvacchrībālakṛṣṇo’pi babhūva ṛṣabho guruḥ ||59 || vṛddhaḥ śvetajaṭāyukto vivastro dhūlidhūsaraḥ | vicitta iva conmatto jitasarvendriyo yatiḥ ||2.240.6 0 || svabhāvatejasā vyāpto brahmaniṣṭhāparaḥ pumān | aprākṛta iva tvāste vimanā iva dehiṣu ||6 1 || vītihotro’pi ca gurumṛṣabhaṃ vīkṣya daṇḍavat | cakāra bahudhā tatra tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ||69 || tvaṃ gurustvaṃ cāntarātmā ṛṣabhastvaṃ ca yogirāṭa | yogeśvaro bhavāneva tvaṃ ceśastvaṃ pareśvaraḥ ||63 || tvaṃ muktastvaṃ mahāmukto mukteśvaro bhavānapi | akṣaraṃ tvaṃ bhavān brahma parabrahma bhavānapi ||64 || bhagavān kṛṣṇa evāsi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’si ca | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastvaṃ parameśvaraḥ ||65 || avatārāḥ ṛṣabhādyāstavaiva śrīpate vibho | rādhāpatistvamevāsi lakṣmīpatistvameva ca ||66 || vāsudevīpatistvaṃ ca nārāyaṇīpatistathā | muktapatirbrahmapatirdhāmapatistvameva ca ||67|| mahākālasya hetustvaṃ mahāviṣṇośca kāraṇam | sadāśivasya hetustvaṃ vairājasya ca kāraṇam ||68 | | bhūmā tvaṃ pūruṣasaṃjñaḥ puruṣottama ityapi | brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ sarjako bhavān ||6 9 | | devānāṃ lokapālānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ sarjako bhavān | maharṣīṇāṃ yatīnāṃ ca sādhūnāṃ sarjakaḥ satām ||2.240.7 0 || satīnāṃ kamalādyānāṃ patiḥ pātā ca vai bhavān | surāṇāṃ mānavānāṃ ca paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ tathā ||7 1 || vallīnāṃ ca drumāṇāṃ ca sarjakastvaṃ rasapradaḥ | kāmadhenukāmavallīcintāmaṇyādisarjakaḥ ||72 || yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācānāṃ sarjakastvaṃ khacāriṇām | vārijānāṃ vanasthānāṃ bhūgarbhāṇāṃ prasarjakaḥ ||73 || daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca sarjakastvaṃ janārdanaḥ | dīnānāthadaridrānāṃ rakṣakaḥ poṣako bhavān ||74|| āśritānāmannadātā śaraṇyaścārtidehinām | kāmukānāṃ kāmadātā sakāmānāṃ prapūrakaḥ ||75|| tvaṃ nārī tvaṃ naraścāsse tvaṃ garbhastvaṃ kumārakaḥ| tvaṃ bījaṃ tvaṃ sasyarūpastvaṃ puṣpaṃ phalamityapi || 76 | | tvamindrastvamindriyastvaṃ nidrā tvaṃ jāgaro bhavān | tvaṃ suṣuptirmahānandastvaṃ prītistvaṃ ratistathā | | 77 || manmathastvaṃ manojanyo manaḥsaṃstho bhavānapi | jñānaṃ jñātā jñeyameva tvamevāsi pareśvara | |78 | | tvam ṛtustvaṃ dinaṃ rātristvamudyogo virāmakaḥ | tvaṃ viśvāsaścāśrayaśca tvaṃ mātā ca pitā guruḥ | | 79 | | dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tvamevāsi śaktirbalaṃ tvameva ca | nītirbhaktirvṛṣo rāgo vairāgyaṃ ca tvameva ha | |2.240.8 0 || tvaṃ prāṇastvaṃ jīvanaṃ ca naikadhā caikadhā bhavān | prakāśastvaṃ pravṛttistvaṃ nirodhastvaṃ guṇātmakaḥ ||8 1 || guṇātītastvamevāsi sarvasiddhiguṇāśrayaḥ | āścaryaṃ tvaṃ camatkārastvamaiśvaryaṃ prabhutvakam ||82 || tvaṃ bhūrjalaṃ bhavām̐stejo’nilastvaṃ tvaṃ tathānalaḥ | tvaṃ khaṃ tvaṃ mātrakaṃ tvaṃ ca buddhittvaṃ caiṣaṇātrayam ||8 3 || tvaṃ parīkṣā titikṣā tvaṃ tvaṃ bubhukṣā mumukṣatā | tvaṃ snehastvaṃ dhyānavṛttistvaṃ samādhiḥ parātparaḥ | |84 || upāstistvaṃ cittacaityaṃ tvaṃ jāḍyaṃ tvaṃ tathāṇutā | tvaṃ sāmyaṃ tvaṃ ca vaiṣamyaṃ tvameva sarvameva ha | | 85 || ahaṃ tvaṃ vītihotrastvaṃ tvaṃ guruḥ ṛṣabhastathā | tavaivāṃśakalāveśavibhūtisṛṣṭijaṃ tvidam | |86 | | yat kiṃcid dṛśyate cāpi bhujyate līyate’pi ca | yasmād yatra ca yenāpi yadarthaṃ ca tvameva saḥ || 87 || tasmai kṛṣṇāya nāthāya brahmaṇe parabrahmaṇe | samarpayāmi cātmānaṃ vītihotrābhidhaṃ sadā ||88 || dānameva na tu nyāsaṃ nāpi kusīdakaṃ tathā | yatheṣṭaviniyogārhaṃ samarpayāmi māṃ tvaham ||89 || iti stutvā rādhike sampapāta pādayorhareḥ | vītihotraścātha kṛṣṇastamutthāpayadūrdhvakam ||2.240.90 || samāśliṣya punarhastau datvā tasya ca mūrdhani | nyayuṃkta varalābhārthaṃ vītihotraṃ hariryadā || 91 || vītihotrastadā prāha sthāsye’tra tavapādayoḥ | ante mokṣaṃ gamiṣyasyakṣaraṃ dhāma tava prabho || 92|| dehi vāsaṃ sadā cātra tathāstūvāca vai hariḥ | rādhike tanmahattīrtham ṛṣabhākhyaṃ sarovare | | 93 | | vītihotrābhidhaṃ tīrthaṃ sahasrayogitīrthakam | evaṃ nāmnā tadevāsīt prasiddhaṃ mokṣadaṃ śubham || 94| | harirbabhūva sahasā bālakṛṣṇasvarūpadhṛk | prayayau ca nijāvāsaṃ vītihotrastaṭe sthitaḥ || 95 || vaṭavṛkṣaṃ samāśliṣya tāpaso janadarśanaḥ | tatra tīrthe kṛtasnānāḥ prāpsyanti paramāṃ gatim || 96 || yogasiddhimavāpsyanti yogābhyāsaṃ vināpi ca | rādhike tatra saṃsnānānnāśameṣyanti pātakam || 97|| ārdraṃ śuṣkaṃ mahatsvalpaṃ parapīḍākaraṃ ca yat | sarvaṃ naśyati pāpaṃ tajjalapānādapi drutam || 038 || tatrānnadānataḥ syāttu vājimedhasamaṃ phalam | ṛṣabhasyālayakarturmama dhāmākṣaraṃ bhavet || 99 || ityeva bhagavānāha rādhike tīrthavaibhavam | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhavettattīrthajaṃ phalam || 2.240.100 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vītihotrayogeśvarāya ṛṣabharūpeṇa sahasrarūpeṇa ca harerdarśanam, ṛṣabhatīrthīkaraṇam, stutiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 240 ||
<2.241> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ prabhostataḥ | mārgaśīrṣasya pañcamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe tu yo’bhavat || 1 || akṣarādhipatestasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya yaḥ | vāsudevābhidhaścāste’vatāro vyūhasaṃjñakaḥ || 2 || tasyāṃśaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhāraneyāpāraḥ samakarṣaṇaḥ | saṃkarṣaṇo yaḥ śāstreṣu varṇyate sa tu jāyate || 3 || rudrarūpo muhuścāpi śaṃbhurūpastathā muhuḥ | pralayātmā sa evāste sa cāste śeṣasaṃjñakaḥ || 4 || hariryatra praśete ca śeṣanārāyaṇaḥ sa hi | sa eva tu mahāyogī patañjaliḥ prajāyate || 5 || yogādeṣṭā hareraṃśaḥ patañjalimuniḥ sa vai | divyadeho’tra bhūmau sa kāśyāmāste sadā prabhuḥ || 6 || nityaṃ prātaryogadṛṣṭyā darśanārthaṃ hareḥ sa ca | pūjanārth samāyāti tvaśvapaṭṭasaraḥsthalīm || 7 || prapūjya paramātmānamanādiśrīnarāyaṇam | ārārtrikaṃ vidhāyaiva prasādaṃ prāpya vai tataḥ || 8 || prayātyeva nijāvāsaṃ kṣaṇāt kāśyāṃ samādhinā | evaṃ nityaṃ samāyāti mahāmunipatañjaliḥ || 9 || rādhike taṃ muniṃ tatra pūjayantaṃ hariṃ prabhum | dadarśa camaso nāmnā vyomnā caran hi yogirāṭ || 2.241.10 || avātarat sa vai puthvyāṃ papraccha taṃ patañjalim | bhagavan pūjyate tvatra tvayā śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 11 || sākṣātsarvāvatārāṇāmadhīśo bālakṛṣṇakaḥ | punaśca gamyate kāśyāṃ kathaṃ tyaktvā mahāprabhum || 12|| vada me kāraṇaṃ vidvan tīrthārthaṃ tvahamāgataḥ | kṛtvā tīrthaṃ tataścāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi revayā saha || 13 || pūjayāmi prabhuṃ cāhaṃ tato yāsyāmi vai tvayā | ityuktvā daṇḍavaccakre pupūja bālakṛṣṇakam || 14 || pūjayitvā hyubhau cājñāmāsādyāśvasarastaṭam | yayatuḥ pūrvasetau tau dhātrīvṛkṣamupāśritau || 1 5|| patañjalimuniḥ prāha kāraṇaṃ kāśikāsthiteḥ | camasaḥ tvaṃ śṛṇu hetuṃ yato yāmi varāṇasīm || 1 6|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ | mahaiśvaryasvarūpā yā tvardhasvarūpadhāriṇī || 17|| sarvaśaktyagragaṇyā yā sarvāsāṃ parameśvarī | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇī yānādinī tvardhāṃganā hareḥ || 18|| jagatāṃ brahmalokānāṃ mātāvatārayoginām | duḥkhahartrī sukhakartrī muktānāṃ śaktidāyinī || 19|| nārāyaṇānāṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvasāmarthyarūpiṇī | brahmapriyāṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ mūrdhanyā yā tu vakṣasi || 2.241.20 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaiva virājate | kṣaṇaṃ dūre na sā yāti vimuktā nahi jāyate || 21 || dṛśyādṛśyasvarūpā yāvinābhāvaniyojitā | rādhāramādidevīnāṃ sevanīyā pareśvarī || 22|| sā tvāste dhṛtadehādya kumārī śrīhareḥ priyā | śivasvāmigṛhe bālā satī putrī narāyaṇī || 23 || nāmnā tu sā dhanalakṣmīḥ sarvaduḥkhavināśinī | vartate sā mahīdevī samutthā divyamānavī || 24|| vijayasyāpi śaśinaḥ kṛṣṇāyā sānujā śubhā | pratīkṣantī harervāṭaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sā || 25|| tasyāḥ pūjāṃ tathā sevāṃ kartuṃ dāsyaṃ prayāmi hi | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇājñayā prayāmi vai || 26 || camasa tvaṃ vijānāsi yogāllabhyastu yo hariḥ | sa evāyaṃ paramātmā rājate kuṃkumakṣitau || 27|| asya vai darśanaṃ nityaṃ samādhirnirvikalpakaḥ | asya sākṣātprasevā ca samādheḥ phalamuttamam || 28 || yamāstvasyānuvṛttau vai vartanaṃ sammatā mama | ahiṃsā śrīharergrāhyā prasannatā tadātmikā ||29|| satyaṃ satyasvarūpasya hareḥ sadāvalambanam | asteyaṃ śrīhareragre dāsyabhāvena vartanam ||2.241.3 0|| brahmacaryaṃ harermūrtau premṇā tallagnatā matā | aparigraha evāpi taṃ vināptirna cetarā ||3 1 || niyamā api kṛṣṇasya paricaryātmakā mama | śaucaṃ tasya sparśanena hṛdaye dhāraṇena ca ||32|| santoṣaḥ śrīhareḥ prāptyā prasādena sadā hṛdi | tapastatraiva vṛttīnāṃ nirodhayatna eva ha ||33|| svādhyāyastasya vacanaṃ stavanaṃ bhajanādikam | praṇidhānaṃ ca tanmūrtau manaso nyāsa eva tu ||34|| ityevaṃ śrīharikṛṣṇe yamāśca niyamāḥ śubhāḥ | āsanaṃ vai tadājñāyāṃ saṃsthānaṃ sannidhau tathā ||35|| prāṇāyāmaḥ prāṇanāthe prāṇānāṃ prasamarpaṇam | pratyāhāraścendriyāṇāmāhāraḥ parameśvaraḥ ||36|| dhāraṇā dhāryate’nādikṛṣṇo nijātmani prabhuḥ | dhyānaṃ harau sadā me ca pratyayasyaikatānatā ||37|| rūpadhyānaṃ harermūrteḥ rasadhyānaṃ hareḥ rase | gandhadhyānaṃ harergandhe sparśadhyānaṃ hareḥ spṛśi ||38|| śabdadhyānaṃ harervākye hastadhyānaṃ hareḥ kṛtau | pādadhyānaṃ harerarthe vāco dhyānaṃ harerguṇe ||39|| ratidhyānaṃ hareryoge vighnanāśo visarjanam | cintanaṃ hṛdaye tasya mananaṃ mānase hareḥ ||2.241.40|| bodhanaṃ śrīharernityaṃ cāhaṃbhāvo harau sadā | vāsanābhāvanālagnavṛttiḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe ||41 || bhogastasmānmahānando nārāyaṇātpareśvarāt | guṇatyāgo guṇānāṃ divyatā tadyogataśca yā ||42|| nairguṇyaṃ śrīharerarthe yā sevā guṇato’pi vā | puruṣakhyātirevāpi yaddharernityadarśanam ||43|| guṇavaitṛṣṇyamevāpi harerguṇeṣu lobhanam | vaiśāradyaṃ ca vai buddherhareḥ smṛtistu yā dhruvā ||44|| vṛttirodhaḥ sa evāsti sarvatra haribhāsanam | samādhiśca savikalpaḥ svārthamiśraṃ hi sevanam ||45|| savitarkaḥ sthūlapūjā nirvitarko hi mānasī | savicāraḥ stotrabhaktirnirvicāro’ṅgabhāvanam ||46|| sānandaśca rasādānaṃ nirānando rasārpaṇam | sāsmitā svāmibhṛtyatve bhedena bhāsanaṃ harau ||47|| nāsmitā bhṛtyabhāvasya layaḥ kṛṣṇe sanātane | aikyaṃ kṛṣṇāveśitasya pārthakyaṃ na yadā mama ||48|| phalaṃ kṛṣṇasvarūpāptiḥ sālokyaṃ sārṣṭirityapi | sāmīpyaṃ cāvinābhāvaḥ sadā tatra vilīnatā ||49|| sarvaiśvaryacamatkārādyāptistasmānna bhinnatā | ityevaṃ camasaḥ prāpta sarvaṃ yogamayaṃ mayā ||2.241.50|| śrīharau na tato’nyadvai bhāsate ca mayi tvayi | bhaja tvaṃ tena bhāvena vasātrāśvasarovare ||51 || ityādiṣṭaścamasaratu patañjaliprayogiṇā | aśvapaṭṭasarastīre sadā vāsamavācarat ||52|| patañjaliryayau kāśīṃ camasaśca patañjaleḥ | pratyakṣaṃ viśramārthaṃ ca goṣṭhyarthaṃ sarasastaṭe |||53 || pātañjalīṃ kuṭīṃ śreṣṭhāṃ cakāra kāṣṭhaparṇajām | pātañjalaṃ tu tattīrthaṃ khyātaṃ loke’bhavattataḥ ||54|| yatra vai camaso nityaṃ karoti yogagoṣṭhikām | saha sthitvā śrīmatpatañjalinā yogavedinā ||55|| athāyāt tatra tīrthārthaṃ rājā vaivasvato manuḥ | dṛṣṭvā sthānaṃ camasasya patañjaleśca pāvanam ||56|| mandire kārayāmāsa dṛḍhaṃ pāṣāṇajaṃ tadā | viśālaṃ drusamūhe vai tatra śeṣaṃ patañjalim ||57|| pratiṣṭhāvidhinā rājā manurasthāpayanmunim | śeṣanārāyaṇaṃ phaṇāsahasravrātaśobhitam ||58|| phaṇāsu vidyate svastikasya cihnaṃ phaṇe phaṇe | sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ cāpi haridvarṇaṃ ca pāṇḍuram ||59||| raktāsyaṃ mauktikanetraṃ śeṣikābhiḥ prasevitam | śobhanaṃ mṛdulaṃ ramyaṃ kṛtakuṇḍalikāsanam ||2.241.6 0 || evaṃ śeṣaṃ tathā divyaṃ muniṃ patañjaliṃ gurum | maharṣiṃ mandire tatra yoginaṃ cāpyatiṣṭhipat ||61|| tatpārśve tatpriyāṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ siddhimatiṣṭhipat | tathā putraṃ ca yogākhyaṃ cātiṣṭhipanmanurhi saḥ ||62|| tathā saṃkarṣaṇaṃ devaṃ gadāpadmādirājitam | saṃkarṣaṇīpriyāyuktaṃ mandire samatiṣṭhipat ||63|| rudraṃ rudrāṇikāyuktaṃ trinetraṃ cāpyatiṣṭhipat | īśānaṃ ceśinīyuktaṃ mandire samatiṣṭhipat ||64|| jīvikārthaṃ mahākṣetravāṭikāḥ pradadāvapi | viprām̐steṣāṃ pūjanārthaṃṃ nyayuṅkta vetanādibhiḥ ||65|| pratiṣṭhāyāṃ manustatra mahārudraṃ makhaṃ śubham | kārayāmāsa vidhinā jāpayāmāsa rudrikāḥ ||66|| kārayāmāsa kuṇḍāni maṇḍapāni śubhānyapi | āhvayāmāsa yogīndrān munīn maharṣisattamān ||67|| viprān kṣatrapravarām̐śca surān devān prajāpatīn | gaṇām̐śca pārṣadām̐ścāpi rudraśiṣyān samastakān ||68|| kailāsasthān samastām̐śca kṣīrasthānapi sarvaśaḥ | śeṣajātīyanāgām̐śca śāṃbhavān yogisattamān ||69|| yoginīdevikāścāpi satīḥ sādhvīśca sarvaśaḥ | avadhūtānikāścāpi mātṛkāśca samastataḥ ||2.241.70|| vīrabhadrādikām̐ścāpi nandyādīṃśca samastataḥ | gaṇeśān kārtikeyām̐ścāhvayāmāsa makhe manuḥ ||71 || agragaśca mahācāryaḥ pulastyastatra cābhavat | mahārudrapradraṣṭā vai sarvavaidyaviśāradaḥ ||72|| karmaṭhāḥ ṛṣayastatra sāmagrīḥ susamarjya ca | svastivāco’vadan māṃgalikasvanāstathābhavan ||73 || dehaśuddhiśca saṃkalpaḥ kalaśārādhanaṃ tathā | gaṇeśapūjanaṃ mātṛkārcanaṃ ca tato’bhavan ||74|| nāndīśrāddhaṃ madhuparkastathā puṇyāhavācanam | vardhinīkalaśanyāso jalayātrā tato’bhavan ||75|| vāstunyāso maṇḍapārcā maṇḍaladevapūjanam | pīṭhapūjā kuṇḍapūjā vahninyāso’bhavam̐stataḥ ||76 || gṛhanyāso yoginīsthāpanaṃ kṣetrapasthāpanam | bhūtaśuddhistathā prāṇapratiṣṭhā mātṛkānyasiḥ ||77|| śatarudrīyapāṭhaśca rudranīrājanaṃ tathā | kramahomaḥ sarvadevahomaścordhvārhaṇābhavan ||78|| ajākṣīreṇa vā mṛgīkṣīreṇa ceṣṭikopari | vāyavye koṇabhāge’rkapatreṇa havanaṃ tathā ||79|| adhvaryuśca paṭhan śatarudrīyaṃ ghṛtadhārayā | arkakṣīradhārayā ca havanaṃ śaṃbhave dadau ||2.241.80 || rudrādibhyaḥ sametebhyo devebhyo havanaṃ dadau | puṣpāñjalirmahāpūrṇāhutirhomo’bhavattataḥ ||81 || mandire devatānāṃ ca darśanaṃ ca nivedanam | abhavacca tato mahādakṣiṇā sampradānakam ||82|| bhojanānyabhavam̐ścāpi sarveṣāṃ makhavartinām | mahīmānasvāgataṃ cāvabhṛthaṃ ca tato’bhavat ||83|| ityevaṃ rādhike vaivasvato manurhi śaṃkaram | śeṣaṃ patañjaliṃ saṃkarṣaṇamīśānamityapi||84|| mandire nūtane pratiṣṭhāpayāmāsa sotsavam | aśvapaṭṭasaraḥpūrvadiśāyāṃ pāvanī sthalī ||85|| arkāyanī mahādivyā śeṣasthalī tato’bhavat | aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva tīrthaṃ pātañjalaṃ param ||86 || cāmasaṃ tīrthamevāpi śeṣatīrthaṃ tathā mahat | sāṃkarṣaṇaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ śatarudrīyatīrthakam ||87|| avabhṛthaṃ mahattīrthaṃ śaṃbhutīrthaṃ sukhapradam | vaivasvataṃ tathā tīrthamityevamādikāni ca ||88|| tīrthāni cābhavan bhuktimuktipradāni sarvadā | suprakhyātāni jātāni tvaśvapaṭṭasarovare ||89|| gaṇāḥ snātā yatra yatra gaṇatīrthāni tāni tu | gaṇeśatīrthamevāpi skandatīrthaṃ tathābhavat ||2.241.90|| nāgatīrthaṃ tathā tatra pārṣadatīrthamityapi | satītīrthaṃ ca devikāsutīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ hyabhūt ||9 1 || ityevaṃ rādhike pūrvadigbhāge tīrthamaṇḍalam | samudbhūtaṃ śeṣayogāt sarvasiddhipradaṃ śubham ||92|| yatra snānājjalapānādācamanādapi spṛśeḥ | yogasya phaladaṃ tīrthaṃ cātmaprāptikaraṃ hyabhūt ||93|| tatra dānādbhavetprāptirnityakailāsakasya vai | tatra dīkṣāgrahaṇācca vaikuṇṭhavāsamṛcchati ||94|| tatra yajñāvidhānācca svargaṃ vai śāśvataṃ labhet | tatra mūrteḥ pratiṣṭhānāddhāma sāṃkarṣaṇaṃ labhet ||95|| tatra nityanivāsācca mahākālabhayaṃ na vai | tatra vratādikaraṇāt phalaṃ tvanantakaṃ bhavet ||96|| yatīnāṃ yoginīnāṃ ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ viśeṣataḥ | vṛttidānād bhavenmuktiḥ śāśvatī brahmayāyinī ||97|| rādhike rajasā tasya snānena pāpanāśanam | tatpradeśe mṛtānāṃ ca tiraścāṃ devajanurmatam || 98|| patañjale hara śaṃbho rudra saṃkarṣaṇa prabho | mano śeṣa camasa prakurvantu mama maṃgalam ||99|| ityuktvā prasvaped rātrau duṣṭasvapnaṃ na jāyate | tān smṛtvā vyavahared yastasya lābhaḥ pade pade || 2.241.100 || prātastān saṃvicintyaiva krayavikrayavastuṣu | hastaṃ datvācaret paṇyaṃ lābhastasya kṣaṇe kṣaṇe || 101 || annapūrṇā satī devī pārvatī śeṣiṇī śivā | sāṃkarṣaṇī yoginī ca kurvantu mama maṃgalam || 102 || ityuktvā vyavaharet strī kumārī yuvatī ca vā | suvāsinī vā vidhavā tasya lābhaḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe || 103 || duḥkhadāridryanāśaśca pūrṇakāmatvamityapi | sukhasampadvaṃśavṛddhirjāyate tatkṛpālavāt || 1 04|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya śrāvaṇānmananādapi | sarvapāpavināśaśca bhuktirmuktiśca rādhike || 1 05|| mānaseṣṭapralābhaśca māyānāśo’pi satvaram ātmasiddhiḥ prajāyeta saṃkarṣaṇakṛpāvaśāt || 106|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne patañjalicamasayoge’śvapaṭṭasarasaḥ pūrve taṭe vaivasvatakṛtaṃ saṃkarṣaṇapatañjaliśeṣādimandiraṃ jale ca saṃkarṣaṇaśeṣāditīrthajātamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 241 ||
<2.242> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rādhe kathāṃ tvanyāṃ pāvanīṃ paramādbhutām | ākṣare parame kṣetre jātāṃ cātipurātanīm || 1 || paṃkilo nāma brahmarṣiḥ pañcakalpāyurābhavat | tasya mātābhavat sādhvī dāsī maharṣisevikā || 2 || kumārī vyacaraccārṣe maṇḍale mṛtapitṛkā | ābālyādapyanāthā cābāndhavā mṛtamātṛkā || 3 || brāhmaṇī brahmavetrī ca maharṣilabdhabodhikā | ātmaniṣṭhāparā yogeśvarī samādhisaddhanā || 4 || sāṃkhyayogāśrayā cātmajaḍavivekaśevadhiḥ | samaduḥkhasukhā vṛddhasevādharmaparāyaṇā || 5 || manasā vacasā sādhvī kāyena ca guṇairapi | prayatnena ca dānena ṛṣisevāparāyaṇā || 6 || āsīdevamahājñānānaladagdhāśayā satī | dvandvābhinnā sadā dhyātrī śrīmannārāyaṇasya ca || 7 || evaṃvidhā sā pramadā yuvatī samajāyata | rajobhāvavihīnā ca kāmasaṃkalpavarjitā || 8 || brahmacaryaparā sādhvī ṛṣibhikṣādanā śubhā | yasyā vastraṃ tu pavane’mbare śuṣkāyate sadā || 9 || yasya bhikṣājolikā cāmbare vāyuṃ pralambate | etādṛśī camatkārasiddhirūpābhavaddhi sā || 2.242.10 || aśṛṇot sā kathāṃ divyāṃ maharṣijanasaṃsadi | satyāḥ kathā gaṇeśasya putrabodhāṃ samāśṛṇot || 11 || brahmaṇo mānasā jātāḥ sanakādyāśca tatkathām | aśṛṇodñjanīputrakathāṃ divyāṃ ca pāvanīm || 12|| tataḥ sāpi putravatīkathāḥ śrutvāvicārayat | mamāpi mānasaḥ putro bhavatveko guṇālayaḥ || 1 3|| putravatīsabhāmadhye mānapātraṃ bhavāmi yat | putraphalaṃ nijaṃ syādvai yoṣitāmavalambanam || 14|| mayā bhāgavataḥ putraḥ prāptavyaścetyacintayat | pūrvakalpe caturthe sā tretāyāṃ vāmadevataḥ || 15 || ṛṣeḥ saṃsparśamātreṇa mānasaṃ putramāpa ha | agarbho jātamātraḥ sa bālo yuvātirūpavān || 1 6|| jñānavijñānasampanno brahmacintāparāyaṇaḥ | vyomamārge carannitya caturvārdhyāplavakriyaḥ || 1 7|| caturdhāmamahātīrthavidhyuttarādanastathā | samartho mātṛvajjātaḥ pitṛvat siddhimām̐stathā || 18 || vāmadevīyasavanapraṇetā divyaśaktimān | dākṣīdevīṃ mātaraṃ ca pitaraṃ vāmadevakam || 19 || hṛdaye bāhyataścāpi nityaṃ prapūjya vai tataḥ | nityaṃ vanyaphalādyarthaṃ vane yāti samutsukaḥ || 2.242.20 || samitphalāni puṣpāṇi cāhṛtya gāṃgavāriṣu | paṃke nijāsanaṃ kṛtvā samādhau yāti vai niśi || 21 || paṃkilastena nāmnā sa dākṣīdevyā prakīrtyate | paṃkilo nāma viprarṣiḥ prasiddhaḥ samajāyata || 22|| ekadā paṃkamadhye sa divase’pi nijāsanam | kṛtvā samādhimāpannaḥ prāṇarodhena niścalaḥ || 23 || tatrāyātāḥ pañca satyo yadṛcchayā nadītaṭe | sādhvyo brahmaparāḥ śīlavratā nārāyaṇīsamāḥ || 24|| yogīndrāṇyo vāmadevaśiṣyāḥ siddhisamāśrayāḥ | āpastambī drumastambī marutstambī tṛtīyakā || 25 || phenastambī caturthī ca dhūmrastambī ca pañcamī | gaṃgājale tu tāḥ snātvā taṭe tasthuḥ kṣaṇaṃ hi tāḥ || 26 || madhyāhne paṃkilaṃ paṃke dṛṣṭavatyaḥ kumārakam | ujjvalaṃ brahmaniṣṭhaṃ ca sūryavarculameva tam || 27|| dhyānamagnaṃ divyarūpaṃ yoginaṃ vāmadevajam | bhaginyastā drutaṃ pārśve gatvā nemuśca taṃ munim || 28 || muniścāpi samādhau tā vīkṣya nijāsanāntike | bahiḥ śīghraṃ samāgatyāsanaṃ dadau nanāma ca || 29 || bhaginyo brahmavetryaḥ sthāgrajā vande muhurmuhuḥ | ityuktvā pādayostāsāṃ datvā cakṣuśca mastakam || 2.242.30 || pādadhūlīrbhaginīnāṃ mastake sa munirnyadhāt | svāgatārthaṃ drutaṃ saṃkalpayāmāsāsanāni ca || 31 || tāvattatra samāyātānyāsanānyajināni vai | pādyārthaṃ ca prasasmāra jalaṃ kamaṇḍalubhṛtam || 32 | | upasthitaṃ ca tattataḥ sasmāra madhuparkakam | miṣṭaṃ ceṣṭaṃ madhu miśphalāni śarkarādikam | | 33 || upasthito madhuparko dadau tābhyastu taṃ tadā | pūjādravyāṇi sarvāṇi cāgatāni smṛtestadā ||34|| paṃkilaḥ pūjayāmāsa bhaginīḥ sarvavastubhiḥ | bhojanaṃ pradadau ramyaṃ pakvamiṣṭakalātmakam ||35|| sudhāmiṣṭaṃ jalaṃ cāpi pānārthaṃ pradadau tadā | valkalāni suramyāṇi śāṭyarthaṃ kañcukīkṛte ||36|| tāpasīnāṃ suyogyāni kaṃkaṇāni dadau tathā | āśīrvādām̐stathā tāsāṃ yayāce’pi prasannatām ||37|| kṛtātithyāśca tāstuṣṭā bhrātre daduḥ śubhāśiṣaḥ | ekā prāha tadā bhrātaḥ kalpajīvī sukhī bhava || 38|| dvitīyāpi tathā prāha kalpajīvī sukhī bhava | tṛtīyāpi caturthī ca paccamyapi ca vai tathā || 39|| prāhuḥ prasannahṛdayāḥ kalpajīvī sukhī bhava | svasṝṇāṃ sa śubhāśīrbhiḥ pañcakalpaprajīvanaḥ ||2.242.40|| paṃkilarṣiḥ samabhavad rādhike svasṛpūjanāt | evaṃ sa pañcakalpāyurdharmajñānavirāgavān ||41 || brahmabhaktiparo loke yatheṣṭaṃ vartate ṛṣiḥ | kvacid yāti satyalokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ badarīṃ tathā ||42|| śvetadvīpaṃ tathā svargaṃ yāmyalokaṃ prayāti ca | aindraṃ lokaṃ sūryalokaṃ pitṛlokaṃ prayāti ca ||43|| kvacinmeruṃ kvacillokālokākhyabhūdharaṃ prati | kvacitsaptarṣilokaṃ ca dhruvalokaṃ kvacit kvacit ||44|| yāti cāndraṃ śītalokaṃ kvacitpātālamityapi | yatheṣṭaṃ paṃkilaḥ so’yaṃ viharatyeva yogirāṭ ||45 || kvacitsamādhāvevāyaṃ varṣāyutaṃ pratiṣṭhati | kvacidbhūmau kvacidvārdhau vajratulyaśarīrabhṛt ||46 || kvacid vahnau kvacid vāyau kvacittiṣṭhati cāmbare | brahmavad brahmagatikaḥ svasṛmātṛprasevanāt ||47|| pitṛbalād yogabalādavyāhatagatirhyabhūt | anekakāyarūpaśca līnakāyo bhavatyapi ||48|| sūryavattu kvacid bhāti cāmbare’pi bhuvi kvacit | kvacid devasvarūpaśca kvacinmānavarūpavān ||49|| kvacicchukasvarūpaśca kvacid vṛṣabharūpavān | kvacinmṛgasvarūpaśca kvaciddhaṃsasvarūpavān ||2.242.50|| kvacitparvatatulyaśca kvacitkaṇasvarūpavān | evaṃ svatantravidhivān brahmaniṣṭho hi paṃkilaḥ ||51 || vāmadevasamaścāste samastaiśvaryaśevadhiḥ | sa cāsmin tasya vai kalpe pañcame prātareva ha ||52|| vicaran vyomamārgeṇa dadarśāśvasarovaram | viśālaṃ nirmalajalaṃ śāntavāri mahojjvalam ||53 || candravadbhāsamānaṃ ca naikapadmasuśobhitam | rājahaṃsai rājaśukairmenābhirmiṣṭaśabditam ||54|| bhavyasetucatuḥśobhaṃ pātālāgādhavāribhat | kṣīrasarasvatītīrthaṃ brahmapādodakīmayam ||55 || phalapuṣpamahodyānaiḥ samantato virājitam | devadevaṃ kṛtāvāsaṃ maharṣigaṇasevitam || 56 || brahmapriyābhiḥ satataṃ snānāplavaiḥ supāvitam | divyasopānaghāṭeśca snānāvataraṇairyutam || 57|| tāpasānāṃ sanniveśairvaṭādyaiśchāyitaṃ taṭe | pānīyahārikābhiśca viśvag virājitaṃ mahat ||58 || kuṃkumavāpikāpuryā paścime’kṣarasannibham | dakṣiṇe tu maharṣīṇāmāśramairbahupāvanam ||59|| uttare śivatattvānāṃ kṣetrapāṇāṃ nivāsanaiḥ | divyasaudhaiḥ śobhitaṃ ca pūrve sādhusatīśritam 2.242.60 || yogibhiryatibhiścāpi virāgaistyāgibhistathā | nyāsibhiḥ satataṃ vyāptaṃ dadarśāśvasarovaram || 61 || dadarśa hemakalaśairmandirāṇi mahānti ca | samantataḥ suvarṇāḍhyān devālayān dadarśa ha ||62|| śuśrāva vādyanādām̐śca śaṃkhaśabdān stavām̐stathā | gītikā apsarasāṃ ca sādhūnāṃ stutivaibhavān || 63 || śrutvā vīkṣya samastaṃ ca vyastaṃ vyomnā yathābalam | avātarat tato vyomnaḥ paṃkilo’śvasarovare || 64|| jalaṃ pītvā tathā snātvā parāṃ śāntiṃ jagāma ha | smarannārāyaṇaṃ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram ||65|| rādhike paṃkilaḥ so’yaṃ jale vāsamarocayat | bahiḥ sarvatra lokānāṃ sammardaśaṃkayā khalu || 66 || divā jale tale cāste rātrau setuṃ śrayatyapi | tāpasānāṃ nivāseṣu yatheṣṭaṃ ca bhramatyapi ||67||||| maharṣyāśramabhāgeṣu sāyaṃ bhramati vā kvacit | prātarnityaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ gatvālaye’rcayatyapi || 68 || kvacit sa manasā yāti somanāthaṃ supāvanam | kvacit sa sahasā mūladvārikāṃ yāti varṣmaṇā ||69 || kvacit kanyā svayaṃ bhūtvā brahmapriyāsu tiṣṭhati | kvacit kumārako bhūtvā cāste gopālabālakaiḥ ||2.242.70 || evaṃ sa munirāḍ rādhe hyaśvapaṭṭasarovare | nityaṃ vāsaṃ prācarat bālakṛṣṇāśraye śubhe || 71 || athaikadā muniḥ śrīmān lomaśastaṃ vyalokayat | kanyārūpaṃ dhṛtavantaṃ nijāśrame samāgatam || 72 || prāha kā tvaṃ kutaścātrāyātāsi vada kanyake | sa cāha paṃkilā tvasmi dākṣīdevīsutāsmi hi ||73 || kanyakānāṃ darśanārthaṃ tvāgatāsmi tavāśrame | vāmadevī bhavāmyeva kāle’nyadā tu paṃkilaḥ || 74|| ityuktvā kanyakārūpaṃ vihāya paṃkilo’bhavat | lomaśo’pi viditvainaṃ prākparicitameva tu || 75|| mimīla hṛdaye kṛtvā susammānaṃ vyadhāttadā | prāpya mantraṃ hareḥ so’pi paṃkilo lomaśānmuneḥ || 76 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyeti jajāpa ha | natvā yayau jalagarbhe nivāsaṃ ca jale’karot ||77|| atha dvitīyadivase lomaśastaṃ samāgatam | prāha vai parṇakuṭyarthaṃ tatrāha paṃkilo muniḥ || 78 || āsāyaṃ me jīvanaṃ vai kalpo’yaṃ pañcamo mama | vyatyeti brahmaṇo’haśca tatra kā parṇaśālikā ||79 || tasmājjale nivatsye’haṃ paṃke niścintane gṛhe | idānīṃ yāvadevātra kvāpi loke’pi vai mayā ||2.242.8 0 || parṇaśālā kṛtā naiva cānte kāryāpi naiva tu | svalpakāle’vaśiṣṭe cet karomi parṇaśālikām || 81 | | haseyurmām ṛṣayaste cirakalpaprajīvinaḥ | ityuktvā nityamevāyaṃ jale vāsamarocayat || 82 | | mānasaṃ śrīharau dhṛtvā jale samādhimāptavān | samādhau vasatastasya yugakālo hyagād yadā || 83 || tadā rājā balirloke balavān vāmanena vai | prakaṭībhūya yajñe saurāṣṭre’rthito bhuvaṃ prati ||84|| baliḥ pradadau pṛthivīṃ vāmanāya tu chatriṇe | vāmanaḥ kapaṭī kṛṣṇo vardhayāmāsa varṣma ca ||85|| pādāṃguṣṭhāṃgulayaśca tasyāśvasārase jale | nyapatam̐statpratāpena sarobhūmirapūryata ||86 || jalānyapāsaran śīghraṃ pārśvapṛthvyāṃ tadābhitaḥ | varuṇastajjalānāṃ vai śamanaṃ pracakāra ha ||87|| paṃkilo nirgataḥ paṃkājjalarikte sarovare | vāmanāṃguṣṭhasaṃlagno babhūva likṣikā yathā || 88 || so’pi nirgatya sarasāṅguṣṭhaṃ tuṣṭāva vai kṣaṇam | tāvat trilokān jitvaiva vāmano bālarūpadhṛk ||8 9 || abhavat taṃ pravīkṣyaiva paṃkilaḥ premaharṣitaḥ | punarjalāḍhyasarasi yāvadicchati majjanam || 2.242.90 || tāvacchrīvāmanaḥ prāha kuru me mandiraṃ śubham | setau ca vāmanaṃ māṃ tvaṃ pratiṣṭhāpaya saṃvasa ||9 1 || mamājñayā sevako me bhūtvā me mandire vasa | ityājñāpya yayau vastrāpathaṃ śrīvāmanaḥ prabhuḥ || 92|| paṃkilo yogasāmarthyaiḥ rātrau cakāra mandiram | tatra śrīvāmanaṃ devaṃ sthāpayāmāsa śobhanam ||93|| paṃkilaṃ sthāpayāmāsa sevāyāṃ vāmanasya hi | sevārthaṃ paṃkilaḥ śiṣyaṃ prakalpya jālakīlakam ||94|| tatrādṛśyo’bhavannityaṃ vāmanasyālaye muniḥ | cirañjīvo jālakīlāyārpayat kālaparyaye ||95|| yogasiddhīrhi
