vividhā jālakīlo’pi yogirāṭ | abhavad brahmakalpāyurjāleśvaro dvijo hi saḥ ||96|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīre vāsaṃ so’pi sadā vyadhāt| | evaṃ tad rādhike tīrthaṃ jāleśvaraṃ ca pāṃkilam || 97|| vāmanaṃ tīrthamevāpi cāṃguṣṭhatīrthamityapi | kanyakātīrthamevāpi cāśvapaṭṭasarojale ||98|| abhavanmokṣadaṃ pāpapraṇāśakaṃ sukhapradam | yogasiddhipradaṃ smṛddhipradaṃ svargapradaṃ tathā ||99|| tatra snānāttathā dānād vāmanasyārcanāttathā | svargarājyaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ bhūrājyaṃ vā labhejjanaḥ || 2.242.100 || kāṃbhareyaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ smṛtvānādinarāyaṇam | yaḥ snāyād vāmane tīrthe brahmadhāmagatiṃ vrajet || 10 1|| vāmanaṃ paṃkilaṃ smṛtvā snānadānādikaṃ caret | dākṣīdevīṃ tathā smṛtvā kanyādānādikaṃ caret || 1 02|| kanyakābhyo bhojanaṃ ca dadyāt sadbhyo’pi bhojanam | sādhvībhyo bhojanaṃ dadyād rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne dākṣīdevīvāmadevayormānasaputrasya paṃkilasya jyeṣṭhapañcabhaginīsatkāralabhyāśīrvādaiḥ pañcakalpacirajīvitvaṃ yugaparyantamaśvapaṭṭasarovare samādhau sthityuttaraṃ vāmanapādāṃguṣṭhāṃgulisparśena jāgratā tena vāmanamandiramājñayā kāritaṃ vāmanāditīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvācatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 242 ||
<2.243> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā rādhe vāmadevasya kanyakāḥ | pañca vijñāya vai bhrāturvāsaṃ tvaśvapaṭṭasarovare || 1 || mātaraṃ divyamuktānīṃ satyaloke sthitāṃ sadā | pṛṣṭvā samāyayuḥ sarvāścāśvapaṭṭasarovaram || 2 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavallabham | draṣṭuṃ ca varituṃ cāpi labdhuṃ ca kṛtakṛtyatām || 3 || divyadehāḥ kaumudikā yathā cāndryastathāvidhāḥ | kṛtaśṛṃgārasarvasvā nārāyaṇasya tuṣṭaye || 4 || māyāṃśavarjitāścāpi parabrahmāṃśamohitāḥ | vyomamārgeṇa sahasā ciraṃjīvyaḥ samāyayuḥ || 5 || mārgaśīrṣasya vai ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kṛṣṇe dale’kṣarakṣitau | āgatya bhrātaraṃ naijaṃ nemuśca vāmanaṃ prabhum | pupūjuḥ parayā prītyā bhrātā svāgatamācarat || 6 || mātrājñāṃ cānujāyāpi kathayāmāsureva tāḥ | bhrātā prasannatāṃ prāpto bhaginyo yaddharipriyāḥ || 7 || yāsāṃ prasādato jātā pañcakalpāntajīvitā | tāsāṃ nārāyaṇītvaṃ vai śrutvā mumoda cāti hi || 8 || saptamyāṃ prātarevaitāḥ kṛtvā śṛṃgāraśobhanām | mātrā samaṃ yayuḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇālayaṃ prage || 9 || sapūjādravyahastāśca varamālānvitāstathā | sarvasvārpaṇabhāvāśca kṛṣṇavallabhasannidhau || 2.243.1 0|| tatra sthitāṃ mātaraṃ śrīkambharāṃ prathamaṃ tu tāḥ | pupūjuḥ parayā prītyā daduḥ paricayaṃ nijam || 11 || pitaraṃ cāpi natvaiva svasāraṃ cāgrajāvapi | amṛtāṃ bhrātṛpatnīṃ ca tato nārāyaṇaṃ muhuḥ || 1 2|| natvā natvā pūjanaṃ sapracakrurbahuvastubhiḥ | bhrātrā niveditāstāstu sarvasvārpaṇamāgatāḥ || 13 || harirbhāvaṃ vilokyaiva tathāstviti samagrahīt | bhrātrā paṃkilamuninā tāsāṃ karā hareḥ hare || 14|| arpitāḥ śrīhariṃ premṇā karān jagrāha vai tadā | āpastambī prathamā ca drumastambī dvitīyakā || 1 5|| marutstambī tṛtīyā ca phenastambī caturthikā | dhūmrastambī pañcamīti patnyo’bhavan hareḥ priyāḥ || 1 6|| pūjayitvā nijaṃ kāntaṃ varamālā dadurgale | hariḥ pārśve nije tāśca niṣādya varamālikāḥ || 17|| tāsāṃ kaṇṭheṣvadhāttatra prasādaṃ pradadau tataḥ | tāśca bhuktvā saha bhrātrā lomaśasyāśramaṃ yayuḥ || 18 || nideśato hareḥ rādhe brahmapriyāsu cāvasan | ityevaṃ prāpya rādheśaṃ rādhāvat tāḥ sadābhavan || 1 9|| athānyatpāvanaṃ ramyaṃ priye śṛṇu kathānakam | svarṇāṃgadasya rājño vai saurāṣṭrīyasya vaṃśajaḥ || 2.243.20 || haimakalgināmavām̐śca rājābhūd dharmavarmavān | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto hi sāttvataḥ ||21 || bhajate śrīpatiṃ nityaṃ kriyāsvapi divāniśam | mālāṃ na dūramādhatte smaraṇaṃ na tyajatyapi ||22|| bhojane śayane kṛṣṇaṃ hṛdaye saṃprarakṣati | bālakṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti harikṛṣṇeti vai muhuḥ || 23 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇetyāha divāniśam | vākyānte bālakṛṣṇeti kāṃbhareyeti sarvadā ||24|| pravaktyeveti raṭaṇaṃ karoti paramātmanaḥ | tasya pūjanavelāyāṃ yatra kvāpi gṛhe vane ||25|| sarastaṭe samudyāne maṇḍape mandire’thavā | nirjane sajane marde raho vā premabandhanaḥ ||26 || bālakṛṣṇo hi sākṣādvai gatvā tiṣṭhati cāgrataḥ | gṛhṇātyevārpitadravyāṇyakhilāni prapūjane ||27|| naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ khādyaṃ pāyasādyaṃ ca pūrikāḥ | sarvaṃ bhuktvā bālakṛṣṇaḥ śeṣaṃ dadāti bhūbhṛte ||28|| tatastirobhavatyeva rājā gṛhṇāti bhojanam | ityevaṃ hemakalgervā bhaktyā śrīpatirīśvaraḥ ||29|| vaśastasya vartate sma rādhike suprasāditaḥ | rājñī tasya kumudākṣīnāmnī tathaiva vartate ||2.243.3 0|| sāpi śīghraṃ samutthāya snātvānnaṃ miṣṭamuttamam | pācayatyeva bhaktyāḍhyā bālakṛṣṇasya tuṣṭaye ||3 1 || pāyasānnaṃ gavāṃ kṣīraṃ saśarkaraṃ sahaudanam | pūrikā ghṛtapakvāśca tathānyad ṛtusammatam ||3 2|| gundrapakvānnamevāpi laḍḍukān māṣapiṣṭajān | kṛtvā dadāti prātarvai rājñe pūjānivedane ||3 3 || tāmbūlakaṃ jalaṃ miṣṭaṃ madhuraṃ śītamuṣṇakam | yathākālaṃ dadātyevābhyaṃgadravyāṇi yāni ca ||34|| nityaṃ sā gāyati saudhe sakhīmadhye sukīrtanam | sakhyastāmanugāyanti tālīvādayutāḥ saha ||35 || śrībālakṛṣṇo janasaukhyakārīśrīkāṃbhareyo janapāpahārī | rājādhirājo mama bhāgyadhārī gopālabālo jayate murāriḥ ||36 || rādhāvihārī bhavabhītihārī gopīvicārī mama bhojyakārī | snehaprasārī nijabhaktatārī nārījanārtikṣapaṇaprakārī || 37|| cakṣuḥprakāśī hṛdayābhikāśī vijñānavāsī bahudhāmavāsī | māyāvipāśī nijabhaktadāśī sevābhilāṣiprasaratprakāśī ||38|| bhaktervikāsī nijarūpavāsī loke’syudāsī vadatīti dāsī | sā pālanīyā satatapravāsī gṛhābhivāsī bhava me’ntarāsī|| 39 || ityevaṃ rādhike nityaṃ rājñīṃ sakhīsamāyutā | gāyatyevārthayatyeva guṇān guṇinameva tam ||2.243.40 || bālakṛṣṇo’pi tacchrutvā jāyate tuṣṭamānasaḥ | evaṃ kāle gate kṛṣṇo dadau varmabhayacchidam ||41 || yad dhṛtvā nirbhayaścāste rājā rājñīyutaḥ sadā | mahākālo’pi tadvarma dṛṣṭvā prayāti dūrataḥ ||42|| yogasiddhiprabandhaṃ tanmadhyakaustubharājitam | paritaḥ prāntabhāgeṣu cāṣṭaiśvaryasamanvitam ||43 || mastake varmaṇo yasya rājate tu sudarśanam | skandhe gadā ca kukṣau tu pāśo yasya virājate ||44|| etādṛśaṃ suvarṇātisuvarṇaṃ taijasaṃ mṛdu | krūraṃ ca rakṣaṇe saumyaṃ darśane dhāraṇe laghu ||45|| varma vastrasvarūpaṃ vai bālakṛṣṇena cārpitam | rājā dadhāra tadvarma nairantaryeṇa kañcukam ||46|| yasmājjarā prayātyeva dūraṃ daṇḍo yamasya ca | saṃkarṣaṇasya saṃhāro dūraṃ yātyapi varmataḥ ||47|| pāśo varuṇadevasya bhayaṃ prāpnoti varmaṇaḥ | kavacācchaṃkaragaṇā vepante mārgagā api ||48|| mṛtyurmṛtyupadaṃ yāti yadi varmapathaṃ gataḥ | tādṛśaṃ bālasāmarthyayutaṃ tu kavacaṃ hi tat| ||49|| rādhike nṛpatirdhṛtvā muktavanmodate bhuvi | yasya kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ pārśve kā bhītirvada rādhike ||2.243.50|| yasya nārāyaṇaḥ pārśve kā bhītirvada bhāmini | rādhikeva ramevāyaṃ nirbhīko nṛpatirvane ||5 1 || araṇye viharatyeva bhajan kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | atha rājā yayau vyāghrāraṇye vihartukāmyayā ||52|| siṃhāraṇyaṃ tataścāpi yayau vyomnā vimānagaḥ | prayayau daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ dharmāraṇyaṃ tato yayau || 53 || naimiṣāraṇyakaṃ cāpi māhendrāraṇyamityapi | evaṃ vihṛtya vai rājñyā sākaṃ saurāṣṭrakaṃ yayau ||54|| tadvimānaṃ mahat kṣātratejobhṛtaṃ vilokya tu | parśurāmaḥ kṣatrahantā cakampe kālanoditaḥ ||55|| mahendraparvatācchrīghraṃ gṛhītvā paraśuṃ nijam | dhanurdhṛtvā śarām̐ścāpi khaḍgaṃ dhṛtvātiroṣavān ||56 || nipapāta vimānasya pṛṣṭhe vyomnā sa satvaram | mahātejaḥpragolo vai pṛṣṭhe tvāyāti śīghragaḥ ||57|| rājā naitatprajānāti nirbhayo hi vimānagaḥ | prajānāṃ hṛdayeṣvāsīt kṣobho’nile’ntarīkṣake ||58|| grahacakraṃ tadākṣubdhaṃ cāsīt bhāvibhayaṃkaram| cakampe pṛthivī cāpi tadā tejodvayāsahā ||59|| sampāte pralayo bhāvī tejasoravināśinoḥ | evaṃ tresustadā devā divyanetrāśca yoginaḥ ||2.243.60 || maharṣayo’tisaṃvignāstadāsan bhāvibhītitaḥ | dikpālāḥ kṣetrapālādyāḥ kṣayaṃ lokasya menire ||61 || pratuṣṭuvustadā siddhā viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | mā bhūdvai jagatāṃ nāśaḥ parśuvarmasamāgame ||62|| atha rājño vimānaṃ tu manovegaṃ kṣaṇād drutam | aśvapaṭṭasarastīraṃ samāyātamavātarat ||6 3 || rājā cakre jalapānaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ mudā smaran | rājñī pānaṃ pracakre’pi pāyayitvā nijaṃ prabhum ||64|| tāvadākāśamārgeṇa sūryavat krūragolakaḥ | tejomayo raktavarṇaḥ satvaraṃ samavātarat ||65 || pṛthivī cukṣubhe vāri sarasaścukṣubhe tadā | bhayaṃ tu menire tīrthavāsinaḥ kaṣṭamāgatam ||66|| tarkayanti vyomamārge dṛṣṭvā paraśugolakam | graho vā kṣubhitaścāyaṃ bhraṣṭo vā sthānato nijāt ||67|| sūryakhaṇḍo’thavāyāti vahnijvālāsamanvitaḥ | yadvā vahniḥ svayaṃ cāste kiṃ vā kopasamanvitaḥ ||68|| kiṃvā saṃkarṣaṇo devaḥ śeṣo vāyāti roṣavān | brahmaśastraṃ ca vā kṣiptaṃ kenacidapyavāritam ||6 9 || lokānāmapunarbhāvāyāyātyatra tu vā kimu | yadvā vai vāḍavaścāgniḥ samudrādutthitaḥ punaḥ ||2.243.70|| dagdhuṃ lokān samāyāti ko vāyaṃ krūradarśanaḥ | ityevaṃ cātarkayam̐śca mānasāni hi dehinām ||71 || tāvat sannidhimāpannaḥ sphuṭamūrtiradṛśyata | vikarālānano haste paraśudhragjaṭādharaḥ ||72|| sakacchaḥ sāyudhaścāpi brahmasūtrasamanvitaḥ | sphāracakṣuḥpradaṃṣṭrauṣṭhaprāntaścotphullavigrahaḥ ||73 || ko’yaṃ kṣātrakule cāste jīvati parśuyogini | vimānena vināśāya pracchanno’tra prakāśate ||74|| ityevaṃ vyāharam̐stūrṇaṃ sarastaṭamavātarat | tāvaktrokaiḥ sa vijñātaḥ parśurāmo’ntakṛd dvijaḥ ||75|| dudruvurmānavā bhītāḥ paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo’pi ca | haimakalgervimānāgre parśudhraḥ samupasthitaḥ ||76|| āśvapaṭṭataṭe ramye garvagaṃjanaśārṅgiṇaḥ | bālakṛṣṇasyākṣarākhye kṣetre kaupīnabhūsuraḥ ||77|| yāvad bhūmau padaṃ naijaṃ dhṛtavān parśudhārakaḥ | tāvadaṃguṣṭhasya nakhaḥ kaṃkareṇa vibheditaḥ ||78|| jātaṃ viprasya vai taccāmāṃgalyaṃ vijayārthinaḥ | tathāpi mānabhāvena hantuṃ haimaṃ samāyayau ||79|| kastvaṃ kṣatriyadāyāda matparśukṣut praśiṣyase | vada śīghraṃ prayuddhasva yamalokābhigo bhava ||2.243.80|| ityukto nṛpatirhaimaḥ śīghraṃ kṣātreṇa tejasā | viprasya tu yathā na syādaparādho jagāda tam ||8 1 || viprāḥ pūjyā jāmadagne mā kṣatreṇa parābhavaḥ | mā tvaṃ pūjyaśca prayuṅkṣvātrāsthāne parśuṃ balaṃ ca vā ||82|| sambhāvitasya cāsthāne parābhavo gururmṛtaḥ | kṣātro’haṃ brāhmaṇe vipra nāparāddhuṃ prakāṃkṣaye ||83|| mā roṣaṃ kuru viprendra mā puṇyaṃ kṣālaya dvija | pūjyo’syavadhya evāsi cātatāyyasi bhūsura ||84|| tasmātpūjāṃ pragṛhṇāsi kṣantumarhasi cānayam | ityuktvā haimarājo vai vipraṃ pūjayituṃ puraḥ ||85|| yāvadgacchati rādhe sa tāvatparśudharo dvijaḥ | hantuṃ pratatparo jāto roṣato yuddhamudrayā ||86 || haimakalgidrutaṃ smṛtvā śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | parśudhraṃ bandhayāmāsa sudarśanīyaraśmibhiḥ ||87|| cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ divyaṃ śrīhariṇārpitaṃ tu yat | tat svakiraṇairvāhneyairjālaṃ kṛtvā babandha tam ||88|| parśurāmaṃ saroṣaṃ vai sāyudhaṃ sabalaṃ kṣaṇāt| | parśudhrastejasā tatra cakrasyāvṛtaśaktikaḥ ||89|| jaḍa iva kṣaṇājjātaḥ patāta pṛthivītale | rājā prāha kṣamasvātra śrīmān māmaparādhinam ||2.243.90|| vipre’vamānakartāraṃ muñca krodhaṃ drutaṃ vraja | parśudhraḥ prāha muñcasva na me śaktiḥ pravartate ||91 || rājam̐stava prasanno’smi varadānaṃ dadāmi te | pāśān jālān cakradevaṃ pūjayāmi vrajāmi ca ||9 2|| drutaṃ muñcasva māṃ dahyamānaṃ cakrasya raśmibhiḥ | rājā prāha harerbhaktaṃ mā jighāṃsatu vai bhavān ||9 3 || kṣātraṃ viprāt samutpannaṃ bhaktaṃ vipro na hantu tat | varaṃ tvekaṃ pālayasvāparaṃ cātraiva saṃvasa ||94|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre tiṣṭha mūrtisvarūpadhṛk | ityuktaḥ parśurāmo vai varau dvau pradadau tadā ||95|| rājñā tu mandire parśurāmaḥ saṃsthāpitastataḥ | snāpito’śvajale cāpi pūjitaścopacārakaiḥ ||96|| rādhike tu tatastatra paraśurāmatīrthakam | pūrvadiśi samabhavat haimakalgipratīrthakam ||97|| parśurāmo hariṃ pūjayitvā yayau hi mandaram | mūrtirūpastatra nityaṃ tvāste’śvapaṭṭasāgare ||18|| rājā tato yayau śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | pūjayitvā hariṃ natvā kathayitvā hyudantakam ||99|| kṛtvā tīrthaṃ yayau naijāṃ rājadhānīṃ himāvatīm | atra tīrthe snānadānācamanairvijayo bhavet || 2.243.10 0|| paṭhanācchravaṇād vāsya doṣā naśyanti vai hṛdaḥ | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpyārogyaṃ dhanaṃ sutaṃ labhet || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vāmadevīyapañcakanyānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāntalabdhiḥ, haimakalginṛpasya bhaktyā harernityaṃ pratyakṣam, nṛpāt parśurāmaparābhavaḥ, aśvapaṭṭasarasi paraśurāmatīrthaṃ haimakalgitīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tricatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 243 ||
<2.244> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cāśvasarasyeva tataḥ param | mārgakṛṣṇasya cāṣṭamyāṃ yajñāraṃbho babhūva ha || 1 || nṛpo’śvapāṭalākhyo vai vaiṣṇavastvarbudācalāt | āyayau makhakāryārthe lomaśaṃ prati sānugaḥ || 2 || gajāḥ śataṃ gṛhe yasyāraṇyaṃ kṣetrāṇi bhūriśaḥ | rājyaṃ viśālaṃ yasyāste cārbudīyapradeśajam || 3 || sahasramānavairyuktaḥ sahasragovṛṣaistathā | bahusāmagrikābhiścāyayau saha makhārthakaḥ || 4 || aśvapaṭṭasarastīre tvaiśāne pāvane śubhe | bhāge sainyaśibirāṇi cakre pālāśake vane || 5 || āhūya lomaśaṃ cāpi kṛtvā ca darśanaṃ hareḥ | maharṣīṃśca samāhūya kratuṃ śreṣṭhaṃ cakāra saḥ || 6 || rādhike somayajñaṃ taṃ pañcāhaṃ pracakāra saḥ | somalatāḥ samāhṛtya sajīvāḥ kuṇḍikāsu tāḥ || 7 || vardhitāḥ pāyitāścāpi rājñā tvaśvasarastaṭe | ahīnākhyaḥ somayajñaḥ pañcāho’nuṣṭhitastaṭe || 8 || maṇḍape suviśāle saṃkāritaḥ kuṇḍasattamaḥ | rājā sapatnīka eva vṛttvā somapravākakam || 9 || somapravākaṃ vipraṃ sampreṣayāmāsa ṛtvijām | varaṇārthaṃ sa vipro’pi gatvānayattu bhūsurān || 2.244.1 0|| rājā datvā madhuparkaṃ varaṇaṃ pracakāra ha | adhvaryuṃ ca pratiprasthātāraṃ neṣṭāramityapi || 11 || unnetāraṃ tataścāpi brahmāṇaṃ ca samāvṛṇot | brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaṃ cāgnīdhraṃ potāraṃ samāvṛṇot || 1 2|| hotāraṃ ca tathā maitrāvaruṇaṃ ca samāvṛṇot | acchāvākaṃ grāvastutaṃ codgātāraṃ samāvṛṇot || 1 3|| prastotāraṃ pratihartāraṃ subrahmaṇyamāvṛṇot | sadasyānṛtvijaścāpi rājā tatra samāvṛṇot || 14|| devatāḥ samupasthāyāraṇyoścāropya cānalam | somakratusthalīṃ gatvā mathitvā cāraṇī tataḥ || 186|| samutpannaṃ gārhapatyāyatane’nalameva tam | prātiṣṭhipat tato’dhvaryuḥ praṇīyāhavanīyakam || 16|| caturviṃśatihomām̐śca hutvā visṛjya cānalam | praṇīya gārhapatyācca punarhomām̐śca sapta ca || 17|| kṛtvāgniṃ taṃ samutsṛjya dīkṣaṇīyeṣṭimācarat | ekādaśakapālaṃ ca puroḍāśaṃ vyadhāpayat || 18|| agnaye viṣṇave cāpi homaṃ dadau tataḥ param | prācīnavaṃśaśālāṃ ca nirmāya yajamānakaḥ || 19|| uttare ca bahirdeśe kārayitvā tu muṇḍanam | tīrthe snātvādhvaryuṇā ca datte dukūlake śubhe || 2.244.20 || paryadadhat tathā rājñī nakhanikṛntanādikam | snānaṃ kṛtvā paryadadhad vastre dukūlake śubhe || 21 || tato jāyāpatī cānnaṃ bubhujāte hi maṇḍape | navanītena vai tatra svāṅgāni cānulimpataḥ ||22|| añjāte cāñjanenāpyakṣiṇī naije tataḥ param | adhvaryuścānale tatra hutvā dīkṣāhutīśca ṣaṭ |||23|| pradadau yajamānāya tataḥ kṛṣṇājinadvayam | yajamānaḥ parigṛhyāhavanīyasamīpagaḥ ||24|| tadāstīryopaviśyāpi baddhvā kaṭyāṃ ca mekhalām | mṛgaśṛṃgaṃ tathodumbaradrudaṇḍaṃ dadhāra ca ||25|| patnī tatheṣikājālaṃ muñjayoktraṃ dadhāra ca | yajamāno muṣṭibandhaṃ cakārādhvaryurāha ca ||26|| dīkṣito yajamāno’yaṃ dīkṣitā brāhmaṇā ime | vāṅyato yajamānaścānakṣatrodayameva ha ||27|| avartatādhvaryuṇā cārpitaṃ payo’pibattataḥ | patnyapibad vāgvisargaṃ cakraturdampatī tataḥ || 28|| dadhi dhānānudumbaraphalasaktam̐śca vodanam | bhojanaṃ dampatī tatra yatheṣṭaṃ sampracakratuḥ || 29|| yācakā vipradevāśca yajñadravyopalabdhaye | yācanārthaṃ gatāścātha dampatī jāgṛto niśi || 2.244.30 || vrataṃ rarakṣatuścāpi nānṛtaṃ saṃvadediti | nāśnīyānmāṃsamadyādi nopeyācca striyaṃ tathā || 31 || na khaṭvādau śayītāpi kṛṣṇājinādi dhārayet | aṣṭamyāṃ somayāgasya kṛtyaṃ rājā tathā vyadhāt || 3 2|| tato rātrau sabhāyāṃ ca lomaśastūpadeśanām | dadau tvātmapralābhārthāṃ jñānavijñānasaṃbhṛtām ||3 3 || adhvarāḥ sarvadā kāryā dhanikaiḥ sukhahetave | ātmamokṣakarā yajñāḥ kartavyā dehibhiḥ sadā || 34|| mokṣayajñakarā lokāḥ puṇyahārā jitendriyāḥ | prāpnuvanti hareḥ sthānaṃ yatparaṃ prakṛterdhruvam || 35|| na prīyante vandyamānā na kupyantyapi ninditāḥ | etāṃ prajñāṃ tamāptāste prāpnuvanti hareḥ padam || 36 || pakvavidyā jitadoṣā nāparādhyanti ye janāḥ | anīrṣavo na hiṃsanti tapyante na pararddhibhiḥ || 37|| nindāśaṃse na kurvanti vikriyante na tatra ca | praśāntāḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ ratā bhavanti ye hite || 38|| na kruddhyanti na hṛṣyanti nāparān vañcayantyapi | vimucya hṛdayagranthiṃ te prayānti hareḥ padam || 3 9|| na yeṣāṃ bāndhavāḥ kecid ye cānyeṣāṃ na bāndhavāḥ | amitrāḥ santi yeṣāṃ na ye cāmitrā bhavanti na || 2.244.40|| ye dharmaṃ cānuruddhyanti sukha jīvantyaroṣiṇaḥ | amṛtasyeva tṛpyerannavamānasya yoginaḥ || 41 || viṣasyevodvijeyuśca sammānasya vicakṣaṇāḥ | avajñātāḥ sukhaṃ cāpi śerate tvakutobhayāḥ |||42|| viyuktāḥ sarvadoṣebhyo ye te yāntyakṣaraṃ padam | etadvratāni cāsādya praidhante sādhavaḥ sukham || 83 | | sarvān kratūn samāsādya kṛtvā mano’tinirmalam | prāpnuvanti harerdhāma yatparaṃ prakṛterdhruvam || 84|| naiṣāṃ devā na gandharvā narṣayaḥ pitaro’pi vā | padaṃ cānvavarohanti prāptānāṃ paramaṃ padam || 45 || yeṣāṃ naivāstyahaṃkāro guṇacāritrakṛt tathā | abhinnavāgdhṛdayāśca pūjyantatra paratra ca ||46 || adhyātmavidhitattvajñāḥ kṣāntāḥ śaktā jitendriyāḥ | ṛjavaḥ satyavācaśca pūjyante’tra paratra ca ||47 || tejasā yaśasā buddhyā jñānena vinayena ca | janmanā tapasā yuktāḥ pūjyante’tra paratra ca ||48|| suśīlāḥ sukhasaṃveśāḥ svādarāgatāḥ | suvākyāścāpyanīrṣyāśca pūjyante’tra paratra ca ||49|| kalyāṇaṃ kurvate’nyeṣāṃ pāpaṃ yatra na vidyate | na prīyante parakaṣṭaiḥ pūjyante’tra paratra ca ||2.244.50|| titikṣavaḥ samavṛttāḥ priyāpriyasahāstathā | hitārthavādinaḥ śāntāḥ pūjyante’tra paratra ca ||51 || adīnāḥ krodhahīnāścālubdhāḥ paropakāriṇaḥ | dhane kāme’pyakalahāḥ pūjyante’tra paratra ca ||52|| doṣā yeṣāṃ samucchinnā dṛḍhabhaktā harestu ye | vītasammohamānāśca pūjyante’tra paratra ca ||53|| asaktāḥ sarvasaṃgeṣu vinaṣṭasaṃśayāśca ye | nātmastutiparā lokāḥ pūjyante’tra paratra ca |||54|| nāsūyanti janaṃ kaṃcinnyāyamārge vahanti ca | avandhyakālā mṛdavaḥ pūjyante’tra paratra ca ||55|| kṛtaśramāḥ kṛtaprajñā na tṛptā harikīrtane | nityayuktāścāpramattāḥ pūjyante’tra paratra ca ||56|| nāpatrapāḥ paraśreyovidhātāraśca dāninaḥ | paraguhyāprabhettāraḥ pūjyante’tra paratra ca ||57|| evaṃ sarvaguṇopetān dakṣānātmahitārthinaḥ | kālajñām̐śca priyajñām̐śca pūjayanti surā api |||58|| anādyantamajaṃ divyaṃ parabrahma sanātanam | te janā āpnuvantyeva tadarthāstatsamarpaṇāḥ |||59|| tapo niḥśreyasaṃ tasya mūlaṃ śamo damastathā | tena sarvamavāpnoti yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ bhavet ||2.244.60|| tapasā jāyate dehī bhūtānāṃ dhāraṇe prabhuḥ | īśvarāstapasā jātā maharṣayo’pi tena ca ||6 1 || śabdabrahmaparāścāpi labhante brahma cordhvagam | rakṣādhvarāśca vai kṣattrā haviryajñā viśo matāḥ |||62|| paricaryāmakhāḥ śūdrāstapoyajñāśca bhūsurāḥ | tretāyāṃ saṃhatā yajñā brahmaprāptipradāḥ śubhāḥ ||63|| tapasā vidyayā cāpījyayā dānena vā janāḥ | yaśastvakhaṇḍitaṃ prāpya saṃsthāpya bhuvi tadyaśaḥ ||64|| ye prayānti paraṃ svargaṃ sukhānantyam̐ prabhuñjate | yajñe dātāra evātra sthāpayanti yaśobhuvam ||65|| yāvadyaśobhūrvidyeta tāvat svargamakhaṇḍitam | devarṣipitṛgurvarthe vṛddhāturātithikṛte ||66|| anāthadīnanāryarthe satīsādhvīsatāṃ kṛte | nādeyaṃ vidyate kiṃcidyeṣāṃ te divamāgatāḥ ||67|| gautamo’vagrahe viprān saṃsevyānnādibhiḥ sadā | prāpya divyaṃ divaṃ paścānnārāyaṇapadaṃ gataḥ ||68 || rantidevo vaśiṣṭhāya datvā vāri sukhapradam | āśīrvādena vai svargaṃ bhuktvā prāpa hareḥ padam ||69||| indradyumno makhe dravyamanantaṃ sampradāya ca | yayau divya divaṃ bhaktyā nārāyaṇapadaṃ gataḥ ||2.244.70 || śibiḥ putraṃ brāhmaṇārthe datvā svargaṃ paraṃ yayau | pratardanaḥ kāśikeśo datvā netre dvijātaye || 71 || bhaktyā svargaṃ prabhuktvaiva nārāyaṇapadaṃ yayau | dharmāṃgadaśiro datvā svarṇāṃgado’kṣaraṃ yayau ||72||| devāvṛdho nṛpaśchatraṃ sauvarṇaṃ bhūsurāya tu | datvā sarāṣṭraḥ prayayau pārameśaṃ paraṃ padam ||73 || sāṃkṛtikaśca śiṣyebhyaścopādiśyāntarasthitam | parabrahma yayau divyaṃ paraṃ padaṃ hareḥ kila ||74|| ambarīṣaśca viprebhyo datvā govrajamityapi | arbudārbudamevāpi svargaṃ bhuktvākṣaraṃ gataḥ ||75|| vṛṣādarbhiḥ sarvaratnaṃ viprāyārpyākṣaraṃ gataḥ | yuvanāśvaḥ priyānārīḥ ramyāṇyāvasathāni ca ||76|| viprebhyo dānamādattvā svargaṃ tato’kṣaraṃ gataḥ | nimiḥ rāṣṭraṃ pradatvaiva vaideho janako’bhavat ||77 || jāmadagnyo’pi pṛthivīṃ datvā nārāyaṇo’bhavat | gayo dvijātaye datvā svargaṃ ceśapadaṃ yayau ||78 || marutto nāma rājarṣiḥ samarpyāṅgirase sutām | divyaṃ jagāma divyaṃ sa tato’kṣarapadaṃ yayau ||701 || vrahmadatto’pi pāñcālyo nidhiṃ śaṃkhaṃ dvijātaye | datvā svargaṃ ciraṃ bhuktvā pārameśapadaṃ yayau ||2.244.8 0 || mitrasahaśca rājarṣirvasiṣṭhāya nijāṃ priyām | madayantīṃ pradatvaiva patnyā sahākṣaraṃ yayau ||8 1 || sahasrajit tathā rājā priyān prāṇān dadau śuciḥ | brāhmaṇārthe yayau svargaṃ bhuktvā mokṣapadaṃ yayau ||82|| śatadyumno nṛpo datvā sopaskarālayaṃ nijam | hiraṇmayaṃ mudgalāya svargaṃ bhuktvākṣaraṃ yayau ||83 || dyutimānnṛpatiḥ rājyamṛcīkāya pradāya ca | bhuktvā svargaṃ ciraṃ bhaktyākṣaraṃ dhāma yayau tataḥ ||84|| lomapāda sutāṃ śāntām ṛṣyaśṛṃgāya yogine | datvā divyaṃ divaṃ bhuktvākṣaraṃ dhāma tato yayau |||85|| madirāśvaśca rājarṣiḥ kanyāṃ datvā suśobhanām | hiraṇyakaraṛṣaye yayau svargaṃ tato’kṣaram ||86|| prasenajid gavāṃ lakṣaṃ datvā dānaṃ dvijātaye | svargaṃ bhuktvā tato yāto’kṣarākhyaṃ śrīhareḥ padam ||87|| caturdaśastarāvāsāḥ pitaraśca maharṣayaḥ | devā nṛpāḥ prajāḥ kanyā nijā datvā tu śārṅgiṇe ||88|| pūrvapūrvaṣu kalpeṣu golokaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ | gamiṣyanti paraṃ cāpi datvā haryarthameva ca ||89|| sarvasvaṃ vāpi kiñcicca bhaktyā yāsyanti tatpadam | dānaistapobhirbhaktyā ca bahavo vai divaṃ yayuḥ || 2.244.90 || yeṣāṃ pratiṣṭhitā kīrtirbrahmaloke sadāsti vai | pṛthvyāṃ kīrtistathā cāste yāvatsūryādayaḥ sthitā || 91 || sadbhya āgatavijñānāḥ śiṣṭā nārāyaṇārpitāḥ | haryarthakṛtasarvasvāstiṣṭhante śāśvatākṣare || 92 || dhṛtimanto’pramattāśca dāntā dharmavido janāḥ | vītaharṣamadakrodhā nāvasīdanti vai kacit || 92 || dānādhyayanayajñaiśca tapohrīdamanārjavaiḥ | vardhayate nijaṃ tejaḥ pāpmā sarvo vinaśyati || 94|| dhūtapāpā bhaktiyuktāḥ pratyāhārajitendriyāḥ | kāmakrodhānabhibhūtāḥ prayānti brahma śāśvatam || 95|| agniṃ vipraṃ satīṃ santaṃ devaṃ vṛddhaṃ namet sadā | vācaṃ krūrāṃ varjayecca brahma sampadyate tataḥ ||96| | prajñāniṣṭhaścātmaniṣṭhaḥ kurvannapi na lipyate | saṃsāravāsanādehāṃ nadīṃ tartuṃ yateta ca || 97|| sarvendriyajalāvāhāṃ lobhamohataṭāṃ tathā | krodhapaṃkāṃ kāladīrghāṃ kuṭumbasnehasajjhaṣām || 98|| sevāplavena bhaktyā vā nāvā satāṃ sahāyataḥ | taranti sāttvatāḥ śāntā dhīrāḥ pāragadṛṣṭayaḥ || 99|| abhaktāścāpyavijñāśca nottaranti nadīmimām | tasmādunmajjanārthaṃ vai yateta dānadharmavān || 2.244.100 || yajñena bhaktyā nyāsena nistarettāṃ sadāśrayaḥ | satāṃ dharmeṇa varteta kriyāṃ satāṃ samācaret || 101 || dharmabhaktiviśeṣajñā nadīṃ taranti dustarām | sādhavaḥ śrīharerbhaktyā tārayantyabudhān plavāḥ || 10 2 || ityevaṃ rādhike śrīmān lomaśo gurureva tu | upādiśya virarāma parihārastato’bhavat || 103 || bhojanānyabhavam̐ścāpi yatheṣṭatṛptidāni vai | tato’vāpuśca viśrāntiṃ rādhike sarvaśo janāḥ || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mārgaśīrṣakṛṣṇāṣṭamyām aśvapaṭṭasarovarataṭe’śvapāṭalanṛpatiḥ somayāgamārabdhavān, prathamadivasīyānuṣṭhānam, lomaśakṛtopadeśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuścatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 244 ||
<2.245> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike munirdvitīye’hni tu lomaśaḥ | somayāgīyakṛtyaṃ nirvartayāmāsa yacca tat || 11 || avaśyasaṃkalpādyaṃ ca kṛtvā satkarma vai tataḥ | prātareva prāyaṇīyeṣṭiṃ cakāra hi lomaśaḥ || 2 || pathyādipañcadevāṃścāsthāpayaccāpyapūjayat | pathyā svastiḥ prathamaiva dvitīyo’gniḥ surastathā || 3 || somastṛtīyaḥ savitā caturtho’ditiḥ pañcamī | aditerodano dravyaṃ caturṇṇāmājyameva ca || 4 || paktvaudanaṃ cāhavanīyāgnau cājuhavat tataḥ | somaṃ ca krītavām̐statra rājā daśabhirvastubhiḥ || 5 || aikahāyanyā gavā ca hiraṇyenājayā tathā | dhenvā savatsayā cāpi vṛṣabheṇa ca bhūpatiḥ || 6 || śakaṭavāhyanaḍuhā vatsatareṇa cāpi vai | vatsataryā vāsasā ca krītavān somameva saḥ || 7 || krītaṃ somaṃ yajamānaścorau dakṣe nigṛhya ca | havirdhānaśakaṭe taṃ nikṣipya cāyayau makham || 8 || prāgvaṃśasyāgrataḥ sthitvā cātithyeṣṭiṃ cakāra ha | viṣṇave ca puroḍāśaṃ dravyaṃ navakapālakam || 9 || dadau cātha ca somaṃ taṃ rājāsandyāṃ nyadhāpayat | ṛtvijo yajamānaścāvairāya śapathaṃ vyadhuḥ || 2.245.1 0|| pravargyaṃ karma ca tataḥ prāvartata sasādhanam | mahāvīrākhyapātrāṇi trīṇi, dve dohapātrake, || 1 1|| ājyasthālī, tathāśvau dvau, kapāle dve hi mārttikāḥ | vānaspatyā udumbarakāṣṭhajā api tadyathā || 1 2|| samrāḍāsandī, srucau dve, dve cāgarte srucāvapi | dvau śaphau, dvau cāpi dhṛṣṭī, methī, ca śaṃkavastrayaḥ || 13 || vyajanāni trīṇi, rukmau dvau, tathaikābhidhānikā, | nidāne, śākhadāmāni, tathā muñjatṛṇāni ca, || 14|| evaṃ pravargyasaṃbhārān adhvaryuścāharattataḥ | brahmaṇā cāpyanujñātaḥ pravṛñjanamathākarot || 15|| rauhiṇākhyaṃ puroḍāśaṃ vidhinā samapādayat | dvārāntike catuḥśaṃkūn kṛtvā sthaṇḍilamityapi || 16 || agniṃ prajvālya tatraiva mahāvīraṃ nidhāya ca | ājyenāpūrya tanmukhaṃ pidhāya kanakena ca || 17|| punaḥ punaḥ prakṛtvaivaṃ cādhvaryuśca tataḥ param | śaṃkuṣu gāṃ ca govatsamajāṃ badhvā dudoha ca || 18|| mahāvīre payastacca cikṣepoṣmā tato’bhavat | tṛpte ghṛte payaḥkṣepaḥ pravṛñjanaṃ samucyate || 1 9|| pravargyaṃ karma caivaitaccakārādhvaryureva ha | tataśca pratiprasthātā puroḍāśaṃ tu rauhiṇam || 2.245.20 || agartayā juhvayāhavanīye sma ca juhvati | adhvaryuścāśrāvaṇaṃ ca pratyāśrāvaṇamityapi || 21 || kṛtvā juhāva ca ghṛtaṃ payomiśraṃ ca vīragam | mahāvīrasthitaṃ dugdhaṃ hutaṃ gharma prakīrtyate || 22|| aśvinau ca mahendraśca devate’sya prakīrtite | avaśiṣṭena ca sviṣṭakṛtaṃ homaṃ cakāra ha || 23 || dadhnā prāpūrya ca mahāvīraṃ taddhomamācarat | vedyāṃ śeṣaṃ nidhāyāpi pratiprasthātā tataḥ || 24|| rauhiṇapuroḍāśasya homaṃ kiñciccakāra saḥ | adhvaryuśca ṣaṭśakalahomām̐ścakāra vai tataḥ ||25|| agnihotraṃ tathā homaṃ kṛtvā ca śeṣabhakṣaṇam | hotṛbrahmāgnīdhrayajamānaiḥ saha cakāra ha || 26|| evaṃ prātaḥ pravargyaṃ vai samapadyata vai tadā | sāyaṃ pravargyamevāpi tathaiva tu bhaviṣyati || 27|| chinnasya yajñaśirasaḥ sandhānārthaṃ pravargyakam | yajño viṣṇuḥ purā rādhe devaiḥ satramathācaran || 28|| yaśo viṣṇuravāpaiva na devāste tataḥ param | yuyudhurviṣṇunā sākaṃ viṣṇustu dhanuṣā surān ||29|| vijitya ca dhanuṣkoṭiṃ cibukādho vidhāya ca | tasthau tadā tu vamryaśca bhūtale jyāmavasthitām ||2.245.3 0 || bhūmikoṭeścicchiduśca dhanurvegāt samutpatat | viṣṇoḥ śiraḥ kaṣṭhadeśādutpāṭya gatamambare ||3 1 || tasya viṣṇoryajñamūrteśchinnamūrdhnaḥ prapūjane | niṣphalā abhavan devāḥ prārthayanta tadāśvinau ||32|| śirastatpratisandhātuṃ tau tadā prāhatuḥ surān | somayāge havirbhāgastvāvayorastu cādyataḥ ||33|| devairbhāgaḥ pradattaśca tāvayojayatāṃ śiraḥ | tadevaitat pravargyaṃ vai yajñaśiraso yojanam || 34|| mahāvīro yajñaśirorūpo bodhyaśca rādhike | tataśca prātarupasad iṣṭiścāpi hyajāyata || 35|| agniḥ somo viṣṇurete pradhānadevatāstrayaḥ | ājyaṃ dravyaṃ dadau home tebhyo devebhya eva tu || 36|| subrahmaṇyāhvānameva vidhāya viratistataḥ | sāyaṃkāle pravargyopasadau cakāra vai tathā || 37|| subrahmāyāhvānameva cakāra viratistataḥ | evaṃ karma navamyāṃ vai somasya samajāyata || 38|| tataḥ sarve bhojanāni cakrurmiṣṭānnakāni hi | rātrau śrīlomaśaścopādideśa mokṣasādhanam || 3 9|| upāsanāvihīnasya śiraśchedo bhavedataḥ | upāsanīyo bhagavān śrīpatiḥ parameśvaraḥ |||2.245.40|| anyebhyo vṛttimāhṛtya dhārayecchrīharau yadā | tadaikatānatāniṣṭhā jāyate parameśvare ||41 || indriyāhārasaṃhārairmanaāhāravarjanam | ahaṃlayena vai buddhyātmano jñānaṃ prajāyate |||42|| jñānena yacchedātmānaṃ tataḥ śāntimavāpnuyāt | idriyāṇāmanudraṣṭā hyāntarāṇāmapi sthiraḥ ||43 || ātmanaścātmanā draṣṭā durge tarati dustaram | svabhāvena yadi vyāghraḥ śvā vā sūkara eva vā ||44|| siṃho vā śarabho hastī mārjāro vānaro’pi vā | jambūkaḥ kāka evāpi nāgo vā vṛściko’pi vā ||45|| bako vā gardabho vāpi svabhāvairīdṛśo’pi yaḥ | pāpo vā puṇyakṛdvāpi kliṣṭo vā kleśamadhyamaḥ ||46 || akleśo vā vyāpṛto vā daridro vañcako’pi vā | pūrvāvasthānikṛṣṭo’pi sāṃkhyadharmamupāśritaḥ ||47|| yogavān sādhusaṃgī ca kṛṣṇadharmaparāyaṇaḥ | taratyevāśayadurgaṃ vāsanābdhiṃ mahārṇavam ||48|| yajñāsanaṃ hrīvarūthaṃ dharmavairāgyakūbaram | prāṇayugaṃ vicārākṣaṃ prajñāmārgaṃ kṛtodaram ||49 || ācāranemiṃ cendriyavāhanaṃ jñānanābhikam | śamapratodakaṃ puṇyasārathiṃ haryadhiṣṭhitam ||2.245.5 0 || jīvarathaṃ dīrghamārge pārayet sādhuvāhitam | sthāpayedakṣarodyāne rakṣayedālaye pare ||51 || brahmajñānapratiṣṭhe ca sarvayajñaparāyaṇam | anantaiśvaryasampannaṃ bhaktyā raṅgīkṛtāntaram |||52|| bhāsate hṛdye kṛṣṇaḥ prakāśate’ntare bahiḥ | etādṛśe pare bhakte sarvaṃ vai nihitaṃ jagat ||53 || evaṃ māhātmyabhāvasya sadṛśaṃ nāsti kiñcana | pṛthvīṃ jitvā jalaṃ tejo vāyuṃ jitvā tathāmbaram || 54|| tanmātrāṇi tato jitvāhaṃbuddhiṃ ca jayettu yaḥ | īśabhāvaṃ jayeccāpi parameśapadaṃ vrajet ||55|| pauruṣaṃ karma daivaṃ ca kālaṃ grahān vijitya ca | svabhāvaṃ vāsanāṃ māyāṃ jitvākṣarapadaṃ vrajet ||56|| tapodharmaparāḥ proktāḥ satyayugina eva ha | yajñadharmaparāḥ proktāstretāyugina eva ha |57|| dānadharmaparāḥ proktā janā dvāparayoginaḥ | dharmotsādaparāḥ proktāstiṣyayugina eva ca ||58|| brahmadharmaparāḥ proktā mokṣayogina eva te | parabrahmaparāścet syuste bhavantyakṣarasthitāḥ ||59|| nāntarā vidyātapasī nāntarendriyanigraham | nāntarā sarvasantyāgaṃ mokṣaṃ vindati mānavaḥ ||2.245.60 || sraṣṭvā sarvāṇi tattvāni sarjanasya kṣaṇe purā | jīvātmane pradattāni bhogasvargavimuktaye ||61 || bhūmirdehe jalaṃ kukṣau tejo manasi netrayoḥ | prāṇe vāyuścāvakāśaḥ koṣṭhalādau niveśitāḥ ||62|| tanmātrāṇi tu sarvāṇi golakeṣu dhṛtāni vai | viṣayā api sannyastāścendriyārthāśca vastuṣu ||63 || pāde viṣṇurbale śukro haste cendro nidhāpitāḥ | koṣṭhe tvagnirdiśaḥ karṇe jihvāyāṃ tu sarasvatī ||64|| candro manasi brahmā tu buddhau citte muktabhāvagataiḥ saṃrakṣitaṃ yanna viśīryate || 95|| tadakṣayaṃ cāmṛtaṃ śāśvatānandasaṃbhṛtam | naijaṃ nijātmasaukhyaṃ śrīharyāpūrakapūritam || 96|| ya etat kṛpayā prāptaḥ prāpto vā sādhanairapi | nāsya kośe sravaścāste prasādātparamātmanaḥ || 97|| yajñairdānaiśca havanaiḥ prāptavyaṃ tvetadeva ha | ātmanastu tato’nyadvai prāptavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate || 98 || ityevaṃ rādhike śrīmallomaśaḥ sadguruḥ svayam | upādiśya virarāma dugdhapānaṃ vyadhānniśi || 99|| sarvebhyo’pi payaḥpānaṃ kārayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ | atha rātrau praviśrāntiṃ jagṛhurmakhinaśca te || 2.246.100 || nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ smaranto hṛdye nije | suṣvupuśca mahīmānā maharṣayo’pare’pi ca || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne tṛtīyadivase daśamyāṃ somayāgasya kṛtyottaraṃ bhojanopadeśanādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 246 ||
<2.247> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike prātarutthāya yajamāno’śvapāṭalaḥ | rājā kṛtāhnikaścāpi lomaśo’nyamaharṣayaḥ || 1 || kṛtāhnikā yajñabhūmimāyayuśca samāhitāḥ | yāvatsāmagryādiyuktāsturye’hnyekādaśīdine || 2 || svastivācaḥ prokṣaṇādi svāṃgaśuddhiṃ tathāparam | sarvaṃ karma ca naityoktaṃ cakruryathoditaṃ tathā || 3 || viśeṣataḥ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu samāsatastvidam | prātaḥ pravargyopasadbhyāṃ pracarya ca tataḥ param || 4 || udvāsyāpi pravargyaṃ prakṣipya pātrāṇi cottare | agnīṣomaphalapaśostantramārabdhavān guruḥ || 5 || idhmakāṣṭhāni cādhāyāhavanīye’prakāśayat | ādāya jvalitaṃ vahniṃ sīmamādāya vai saha || 6 || mahāvedyantargatāyāṃ vedyāṃ vahniṃ nyadhāpayat | sa vahnirgārhapatyaśca prājahitākhya ityapi || 7 || somaṃ cāsthāpayaddhavirdhānaśakaṭe eva ca | dhṛtvā cātvālapāṃsūm̐śca taiśca dhiṣṇyānupāvapat || 8 || vapāyāgaṃ vidhāya subrahmaṇyāhvānamācarat | adhvaryurvai tataḥ somābhiṣavāya rasarddhaye || 9 || taḍāgād vasatīvarījalaṃ ghaṭe samāharat | śālāmukhīyakaṃ cāsthāpayan madhyandine tataḥ || 2.247.10 || paśupuroḍāśayāgaṃ prānivartayadeva ha | sāyāhne’pi hṛdayādiphalāṃgayajanaṃ vyadhāt || 11 || kṛtvāṃgāni ca patnīsaṃyājāntānyasamāpayat | bhojanāni vyadhuḥ sarve yathāyogyaṃ yathāvratam || 1 2|| rātrāvadhvaryurevāpi vasatīvarīdhraṃ ghaṭam | skandhenādāya vedyāśca parito viharan nyadhāt || 13 || tataśca pratiprasthātā vatsāpākaraṇādikam | śvo’pekṣitāmikṣārthakaṃ dadhnā saṃskāramācarat || 14|| dadhigrahārthaṃ ca dadhi picchalaṃ samapādayat | savanīyahaviṣyārthaṃ barhirāharaṇaṃ vyadhāt || 15|| virāmo yajñakāryasya tatastadā vyajāyata | sapatnīko yajamāno rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ vyadhāt || 16|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyotsavaprapūrvakam | ṣoḍaśādipadārthaiśca pūjanaṃ śrīharervyadhāt || 17|| vratasyodyāpanaṃ rātrau cakāra nṛpatistathā | ṛṣayo’pi janāścāpi cakruḥ saṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ || 18|| prātaḥ pūrvaṃ hariḥ sākṣānmuralīdhara eva saḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo rādhāramāyutaḥ || 1 9|| divyarūpadharo divyatejomaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ | sākṣādbabhūva sarveṣāṃ dhṛtābhūṣo hasan hariḥ || 2.247.20 || kaṃbharā dakṣiṇe yasya vāme gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ | māṇikyādyā brahmasatyaḥ parito yasya cābhavan || 21 || prasanno’smi vratenādya yajñenāpi viśeṣataḥ | phaladātāsmi mokṣātma svargātma yadabhīpsitam || 22|| tato rājādya kṛṣṇaṃ pupūjuḥ prāptavastubhiḥ | haristvadṛśyatāṃ prāptaḥ svīyasārthayutaḥ prabhuḥ || 23 || lomaśo’pi tataḥ sarvānupādideśa pāvanam | dharmo naikavidhastvasti lokeṣu ca janeṣu ca ||24|| yajñadharmaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇātmā brahmalokadaḥ | sevādharmo mahānāśīrvādadvārā divaḥpradaḥ || 25 || sarvabhūtādrohadharmaḥ parasaukhyaprado’sti vai | prasannatā pareṣāṃ vai mahānandarddhisampradā || 16 || devānāṃ tuṣṭirevāpi maharṣīṇāṃ tathāvidhā | āgantukānāṃ tuṣṭiśca paralokasahāyinī ||27|| purā maharṣijaṭilāyananāmā vane vasan | tapaścacāra bahudhā sthiradeho’calaḥ sadā || 28|| jaṭāyāmasya caṭakā nīḍaṃ cakāra garbhiṇī | tāṃ dayāvān maharṣiḥ sa tūpapraikṣata vai tataḥ ||29|| tṛṇatantvāḍhyanīḍe vai jaṭāyāṃ caṭakā tu sā | apātayattu svāṇḍāni tānyabudhyata vai ṛṣiḥ || 2.247.30 || budhvāpi na cacālaiṣo dharme kṛtamanāstathā | sarvabhūtāśrayadānaṃ dharmaḥ śaraṇyarakṣaṇam | aṇḍebhyastvatha puṣṭebhyaścājāyanta śakuntakāḥ ||31 || vyavardhanta ca tatraiva jātapakṣāstathābhavan | uḍḍīyoḍḍīya sāyaṃ te punarāyānti vai niśi | viśramya ca punaryānti prātaḥ kaṇābhivāñcchayā || 32||| atha kāle gate jātapravāsāḥ pakṣiṇastu te | nopāvartanta ca yadā prātiṣṭhata tadā ṛṣiḥ ||33 || sa cāmanyata dharmo’yaṃ siddho mama tapaḥparaḥ | sa cāśrayaṃ dadātyeva kṛtvāśramaṃ drumānvitam ||34|| atithīn sarvarūpām̐śca pūjayatyeva sādaram | nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ tatra samāyātaḥ parīkṣitum ||35|| vyādharūpo mṛtaṃ mṛgaṃ skandhe kṛtvā samāyayau | dehyāśrayaṃ tathā cullīṃ pātraṃ ca samidhastathā ||36|| cāṇḍālo’haṃ kukkurādo dehi te yadi rocate | jaṭāyano vicāryaiva dadau cullīṃ samit tathā ||37|| pātraṃ vahniṃ dadau cāpi parṇaśālāṃ dadau tathā | āśrayāgatalokasya sevane na kṣatirbhavet ||38|| itivratākhye dharme me cetikṛtvā dadau tadā | śvādaḥ sarvaṃ paripācya bubhuje tṛptipūrvakam || 3 9|| sarvaṃ tathāvaśiṣṭaṃ ca māṃsaṃ śālātale’kṣipat | sarvāmaśuddhāṃ kṛtvaiva niṣasāda bahiḥ sthale ||2.247.40 || pramārjayeti cājñāṃ sa kṛtavān tanmaharṣaye | maharṣiḥ suprasannastāṃ śālāṃ śuddhāṃ vyadhāpayat ||41 || śvādāya prāha cet kiṃcidapekṣitaṃ dadāmi te | śvādaḥ prāha caraṇau me mardanaṃ samapekṣataḥ ||42|| ṛṣistasya pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakāra bhāvataḥ | phalapatrajalapānaṃ dadau bhāvena vai punaḥ ||43 || prīyatāṃ bhagavānatra śaraṇāntarvasan prabhuḥ | ityuktvā pradadau vāri tāvadantarhito’bhavat ||44|| tejasā vyāptadehaśca divyarūpo babhūva ha | caturbhujaḥ prabhuḥ śrīmān lakṣmīśrīsevito hariḥ ||45|| jaṭilāyana evāsau nanāma pādayoḥ prabhoḥ | kṛpā kṛtā hare cātra kṛtakṛtyaḥ kṛtastvayā ||46 || dehi dhāmākṣaraṃ nātha darśanottarameva te | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha ṛṣirdehaṃ vihāya ca ||47|| yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ tatra sevādharmeṇa sarvathā | tasmād yajñaiśca dānaiśca gṛhaiśca vastubhistathā ||48|| sevanīyā atithayastatra nārāyaṇo milet | śaraṇāgatarakṣā vai nārāyaṇasya sevanam ||49|| tadantarātmā bhagavān prasanno jāyate dhruvam | taṃ pralakṣya samuddiśya dehinaṃ sevayejjanaḥ ||2.247.5 0 || sa ca yajño mahānāste yajñaprāptipradaḥ śubhaḥ | hariṃ vinā mahāyajñā ayajñāste bhavanti vai ||5 1 || athānye’pi ca manyante krayavikrayamokṣaṇam | lokānāmupakārārthaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ ca nirguṇam ||52|| sarvadehiṣu vai cāste parameśo’ntare sthitaḥ | krayī vā vikrayī nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ na cāparaḥ ||53 || lābhaṃ prāpyānandameti cāhartā parameśvaraḥ | dātā dhanaṃ tathā prāpyānandameti pareśvaraḥ ||54|| śākavikrayanāmā vai purā kaścid vaṇigjanaḥ | satyamārgaṃ samāśrityākarodvai krayavikrayau ||55|| pūrvaṃ prātaḥ svapitarau prapūjya sa vaṇigjanaḥ | bhojayitvā nideśaṃ saṃgṛhītvā yāti cāpaṇam ||56 || śākāni tulayā so’pi dadāti krayiṇe tadā | krayī bālo’thavā vṛddho yuvā vā cetaro’pi vā ||57|| strī vā kanyā ca vāpakvabuddhiryaḥ ko’pyupasthitaḥ | namaste viṣṇave coktvā dadātyeva tadarthitam ||58|| na nyūnaṃ vartate tatra tulāyāṃ vai manāgapi | dadāti ceśvarabhāvād bhikṣukāyāpi vai phalam ||59|| kramavāreṇa sarvebhyo dadātyeva na vikramāt | yathāyogyaṃ dadātyeva matvā tatra narāyaṇam ||2.247.6 0|| sa ca nityaṃ vikrayaṃ saṃkurvan jñānaṃ karoti vai | krayiṇaḥ sarvathā yūyaṃ bhajadhvaṃ parameśvaram ||6 1 || sarveṣāṃ yaḥ suhṛnnityaṃ sarveṣāṃ suhite rataḥ | karmaṇā manasā vācāntarātmānaṃ bhajadhvamut ||62|| dveṣaṃ kāmaṃ tyajataiva smarata śrīpareśvaram | kām̐ścinnaivānurum̐nddhavaṃ mā virodhayata kaiḥ saha || 63 || samaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tatra jñātvā bhajata taṃ harim | divyabhāvāśca bhavata samaloṣṭhāśmakāñcanāḥ ||64|| yathāndhā badhirā naiva paśyantyākarṇayantyapi | tathā bhāvyaṃ viṣayeṣu prāndhaiśca badhiraiḥ sadā || 65|| parameśe tvanandhatvaṃ cābādhiryaṃ kathāśrave | mūkatvaṃ tvanyaviṣaye parameśe tu vāgmitā || 66|| evaṃ sarvaṃ vidhātavyaṃ nārāyaṇe sacetanam | acetanaṃ viṣayeṣu prāptavyaṃ mānavairiha || 67|| yathā vṛddhāturakṛśā nispṛhā vai nisargataḥ | tayā bhāvyaṃ viṣayeṣu spṛhāhīnairjanairiha || 68|| yadā svasya bhayaṃ nāsti svasmād bhayaṃ na vidyate | rāgadveṣādiśūnyasya brahmaprāptiḥ suniścitā ||69|| pāpabhāvaviyuktasya brahmasampattiruttamā | yatrābhayaṃ mahān dharmaḥ sa prāpnotyabhayaṃ padam ||2.247.70|| yasmād bhayaṃ pareṣāṃ syāt tasya tvāyānmahadbhayam | ahiṃsāḥ sādhavo loke bhayadā na yathā kvacit ||7 1 || tathā vṛttiṃ cāśrayata prayāta brahmaśāśvatam | adrohavṛttiścācauryaṃ cāsthārthaścāpratāraṇam ||72|| yasya dharmā ime rūḍhāstasya brahma prakāśate | bhavantyubhayadānena samā nānye makhādayaḥ ||73 || loke yaḥ sarvadehibhyo dadātyabhayadakṣiṇāḥ | sa sarvayajñairījānaḥ prāpnotyabhayadakṣiṇām ||74|| sarvabhūtātmabhūto vai nārāyaṇo nirīkṣakaḥ | dadātyabhayadātre vai cākṣaraṃ nirbhayaṃ padam ||75|| kṛṣyācārā hiṃsrabhāvāstṛṇacchedādikāryakāḥ | vṛṣabhādivāhabhāvāḥ kleśadā hi bhayānvitāḥ || 76 || paśūn lokā vāhayanti badhnanti damayanti ca | mānuṣā mānuṣāneva dāsabhāvena bhuñjate ||77|| aśvādīn vāhanān kṛtvā nayanti bahukardamān | bhayadā hiṃsrakā lokāstatphalaṃ yānti vai bhayam ||78|| aghnyā iti gavāṃ nāma ka etā hantumarhati | agniṣome vatsanāma priyaṃ vṛkṣaphalaṃ tu yat ||79|| vatsāpākaraṇaṃ tadvai hṛdayaṃ rasapakvatā | aṃgānyapi phalasyaiva tena kṛṣṇaḥ pratuṣyati ||2.247.80 || nāhaṃ hanmi tṛṇaṃ vāpi phalaṃ vāpi kareṇa vai | na śastreṇa netareṇa cābhayaṃ pālayāmi yat ||8 1 || śākapatrādikaṃ yogyaṃ pakvaṃ vṛkṣād viyujyate | tasyaiva krayaṇaṃ kṛtvā vikrayaṃ prakaromi vai ||82|| sukhaḥdukhe same me sto na hi me staḥ priyāpriye | evaṃ dharmaṃ pālayadhvaṃ janāstvabhayadānakam ||8 3 || tena muktimavāpsyanti bhavanto’bhayavartanāḥ | nārāyaṇo hi bhagavāṃstena tuṣyati sarvadā ||84|| namo brāhmaṇayajñāya namaḥ prajādhvarāya ca | namaḥ sevāpravīṇebhyo janebhyaśca namonamaḥ ||85 || sukṛtena suhavyena devāstuṣyanti sarvadā | namaskāreṇa havyena stotreṇa hṛdayena ca ||86 || yajñāhutyā susantuṣṭā ādityā varṣayanti hi | tataḥ sasyarasānnāni tebhyaḥ prajāpravardhanam ||87|| prajāḥ kurvanti yajñām̐śca brahma tuṣyati tatra ca | brahmatoṣakarā bhaktāstoṣayantyaparānapi ||88 || tasmād bhaktiṃ prakurvantu sarvaṃ yad brahmadaivatam | brahmatṛptau jagatsarvaṃ tṛptameva na saṃśayaḥ ||89 || yajñe tṛptāḥ sarvadevāḥ syuryasya brahmatarpaṇam | tasya prajñānatṛptasya nityatṛptiḥ sukhodayā || 2.247.90 || dharmādhārā dharmodayā brahmadhyānaparāśca ye | bhaktivijñānasampannāḥ paraṃ pāraṃ titīrṣavaḥ ||9 1 | | sarvasthitaṃ parabrahma dṛṣṭvā labdhvā vicārya ca | puṇyātpuṇyatamaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnuvantyakṣaraṃ padam ||92|| yatra gatvā na śoko’sti na cyāvo na vyathā mṛtiḥ | naitādṛśānāṃ svargārthaṃ yajanaṃ vā yaśo’rthakam ||93 || satāmācararūpaṃ tad yajanaṃ drohavarjitam | brahmatṛptiparaṃ samidoṣadhiphalamūlakaiḥ || 94|| svargārthaṃ puṇyamevāsti nairguṇyaṃ muktaye bhavet | tadahaṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā nairguṇyaṃ tvācarāmi vai || 949 || anye yajanti yajñeṣu smṛddhyarthaṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ | tena te devayānena yathā yānti divaṃ punaḥ || 96 || āvṛtiṃ te’bhigacchanti nāvartante tu nirguṇāḥ | svayaṃ yūpānupādāya yajante svāptadakṣiṇaiḥ || 97|| punaḥ svargaṃ punarbhūmirbhramāvarto na līyate | tasmād bhavantu vai brahmayajanā nānyayājinaḥ || 98 || brahma vai daivataṃ kṛtvā yajñe mokṣaṃ prayāntu ca | ātmatīrthe makhaṃ śuklaṃ kurvantu divyabhāvanaiḥ || 99 || evaṃ kṛtopadeśaśca śākavikrayako vaṇik | sarvasevāparo nityaṃ cābhajat puruṣottamam || 2.247.100 || śrīharistvekadā cāyāt krayī bhūtvā tadantikam | dehi śākaṃ śāśvataṃ me pāravālikamāha tam || 101 || vaṇig budhvā pāravālaṃ śākaṃ dadau tu śārṅgiṇe | namaḥ pāravalāyaiva kṛṣṇāya kramiṇe’rthine || 101 || pāraṃ yo balayatyeva saṃsārābdheśca te namaḥ | ityuktvā daṇḍavaccakre cakriṇe divyadṛṣṭimān || 103 || tataścaturbhujo bhūtvā haristaṃ pāṇināspṛśat | mīnadhvajadhanuḥśūlāsvastikacakracihninā || 1 04|| ninye vimāne saṃsthāpya divyaṃ kṛtvākṣaraṃ padam | ityevaṃ makhamārgeṇa ye bhajante hariṃ sadā || 1 05|| te prayānti harerdhāma hariṇā saha naiṣṭhikāḥ | tasmād bhajantu satataṃ cāntarasthaṃ narāyaṇam || 1 06|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gopālanandanam | kambharābālakaṃ śrīśaṃ prabhuṃ śrīkṛṣṇavallabham || 1 07|| śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaṃ nāthaṃ bhagavantaṃ parātparam | ityuktvā lomaśo brāhme muhūrte prayayau saraḥ || 1 08|| rādhike ca tataḥ sarve snānārthaṃ prayayuḥ saraḥ | jāgaraṇaṃ prakṛtvaiva pūjāṃ kṛtvā ca naityikīm || 1 09|| maharṣayo yajamānastathānye makhino janāḥ | somakarmārthamāyātā maṇḍape pañcame dine || 2.247.11 0|| nityaprāptaṃ vidhāyaiva viśeṣaṃ ca samācaran | rādhike te pravakṣyāmi sarvapuṇyapradaṃ śubham || 111 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne caturthe divase somayāgasyaikādaśyāṃ kṛtyaṃ jāgaraṇamudyāpanamupadeśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 247 ||
<2.248> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca pañcame divase rādhe prātaḥ somasya cottaram | vidhiṃ sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi lomaśo yaṃ cakāra ha || 1 || dvādaśyāṃ brāhmakālasyāraṃbhe tu sarvaṛtvijaḥ | prabudhya snātvā somābhiṣavakarmāṇi cārabhan || 2 || adhvaryustāni pātrāṇyayojayat tatsthalīṣu vai | hotā śastraṃ cānuvākākhyamārabhata vai tataḥ || 3 || savanīyahaviṣāṃ nirvāpaṃ cakre ca pañcabhiḥ | dhānābhiśca karaṃbhena parivāpena vai tathā || 4 || puroḍāśena ca pratiprasthātāmikṣayā tathā | dhānā bhraṣṭayavā bodhyāḥ karaṃbho yavasaktavaḥ || |9 || parivāpaśca vai lājāḥ payasyāmikṣikā matā | teṣāṃ ca devatāḥ pañca haritvānindra ādimaḥ || 6 || pūṣaṇvānindro dvitīyaḥ sarasvatī tṛtīyakā | indrasturyo mitrāvaruṇau pañcamadevatā || 7 || tāḥ prapūjya tataścakre dadhigrahapracārakam | tadyathodumbarapātre gṛhītvā dadhiṃ hyuttamam || 8 || prajāpatidevatāyai juhāvaudumbareṇa vai | tato’dābhyagrahaṃ cakre somadevāya tadyathā || 9 || dadhnā vā payasāpūrya pātraṃ tathopanahya ca | somalatāvayavānāmaṃśutrayaṃ pragṛhya ca || 2.248.10 || grahapātre sthāpayitvā pañcakṛtvo grahaṃ hi tat | saptakṛtvo’thavādhūya tatpātraṃ sañjuhāva ha || 11 || tataścakreṃ’śugrahaṃ saṃgṛhyaikagrahasomakam | kṣiptvā pāṣāṇake siktvā vasatīvarīvāriṇā || 1 2|| abhiṣutya grāvabhiścādābhyapātre nidhāya ca | juhāva ca prajāpatidevatāyai tataḥ param || 1 3|| gṛhītvaiva ca tatpātraṃ praviśya ca sadastataḥ | bhakṣayitvā pātragataṃ somarasaṃ ca vai tataḥ || 14|| pātraṃ khare’sādayaścopāṃśugrahaṃ vyadhāttataḥ | tatra krītaṃ tathā vastre sthāpitaṃ copanahya ca || 15|| somaṃ samavamucyaiva gṛhītvā sarvameva ca | pravibhajya dvidhā prātassavanārtha viśeṣataḥ || 16 || svalpaṃ mādhyandinasavanārthaṃ kṛtvā ca vai tataḥ | prātaḥ stavanasomādvai caikagrahārthameva ha || 17|| somaṃ dhṛtvā hotṛcamase nidhāya ca vai tataḥ | vasatīvarībhiradbhiḥ siktvā piṣṭvā ca grāvabhiḥ || 18 || niṣpīḍya ca rasaṃ labdhvāñjalinādhvaryureva tam | upāṃśupātre trivāraṃ cānāyya ca juhāva ha || 1 9|| ādhārāgraha evāyaṃ devatāprāṇa eva ca | tasyai datvā tataścakurdhārāgrahān dhruvāntakān || 2.248.20 || somābhiṣavakaḥ so’yaṃ mahābhiṣavaḥ sammataḥ | upaviśyādhvaryavaśca hyabhiṣavasthale tataḥ || 21 || grāvṇaḥ prācyāmadhvaryuśca pratyaṅamukha upāviśat | dakṣiṇe pratiprasthātā codaṅamukha upāviśat || 22|| paścime prāṅmukho hotā cottare dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ | unnetā niṣasādāpi śilāyāṃ nyasya somakam || 23 || siktvā vasatīvaryadbhiḥ piṣṭvābhiṣuṇuyustathā | dakṣastenaivameva vāratrayaṃ vidhāya ca ||24|| piṣṭān somalatākhaṇḍān nikṣipyādhāvanīyake | mṛtpātre ca prapīḍyaiva rasaṃ niṣkāsya taṃ rasam ||25|| pātrāntare gṛhītvaiva tuṣān pārśve samakṣipan | athājalomajāṃ nābhiṃ prādeśamātranirmitām || 26 || pavitravastrakhaṇḍe tāmālambya droṇapātrake | vitatyādhārayam̐stāṃ codgātāraśca tataḥ param ||27|| unnetādhavanīyādudacanena ca somakam | rasaṃ dhṛtvāninayacca hotṛcamase eva tam ||28|| yathā pavitravastrāṃśe pated rasastathādharet | tataḥ sravantyā dhārāyā antaryāmyākhyapātrake || 29 || antaryāmagrahaṃ nyasyādhvaryurjuhāva śeṣakam | saśeṣamevāgrayaṇasthālyāṃ sampātamāpya ca || 2.248.30 || saśeṣaṃ ca grahaṃ khare’sādayacca tataḥ param | indrākhyadevatāyai taṃ homaṃ dadau guruḥ svayam || 31 || athaindravāyavādyām̐śca grahān cakrustataḥ param | aindravāyavaṃ saṃgṛhītvā dhārātaśca tato guruḥ || 32 || pavitradaśayā bahirmṛṣṭvā khare’pyasādayat | evaṃ maitrāvaruṇaṃ ca, śukraṃ ca, manthinaṃ rasam || 33 || āgrayaṇaṃ, tathāgneyam, aindraṃ sauryaṃ samukthyakam | dhruvaṃ ceti kramād gṛhye khare’sādayadeva saḥ ||34|| dhruvagrahagrahaṇordhva dhārāvirāmamācarat | havirdhānamaṇḍapācca pañcartvijo bahiryayuḥ ||35|| prāsarpan samanvārabdhā bahiṣpavamānakṛte | agre’dhvaryustataḥ kacchaṃ dhṛtvā prastotānvasarat ||36 || kacchaṃ dhṛtvā pratihartā tata udgātānvasarat | tato brahmā yajamānasataḥ kacchena cāsarat ||37|| cātvāladeśaṃ gatvopaviśya kacchamavāsṛjan | udgātā samprastotā ca pratihartā trayastvime ||38|| asruvam̐ste bahiṣpavamānastotreṇa vai tadā | tena sampāvitau cāśvinau grahau makhayogyakau ||3 9|| kṛtvāgnīdhreṇa dhiṣṇyeṣu prajvāliteṣu cāśvinam | adhvaryurgrahamāsādya droṇaghaṭāt khare’nyasan ||2.248.40 || tataḥ kṛtvā savanīyaphalopākaraṇādikam | vapāyāgāntakaṃ prātaḥsavanāya tataḥ param ||41 || adhvaryubrahmayajamānasadasyāḥ sadaḥsthalam | praviśya grahacamacādikapātrāṇi vai tathā ||42|| dhṛtvā dravyāṇi ca brahmā yajamānastataḥ param | taistairmantrairupasthāya sarvapātrāṇi vai tataḥ ||43 || uttareṇa havirdhānaṃ gatvā ca pūrvayā tathā | dvārā sadaḥ praviśyaiva svasvasthāne upāviśan ||44|| tataścakruḥ savanīyahaviṣāmanuṣṭhānakam | dhārāgrahapracāraṃ ca cakruryathocitaṃ tathā ||45 || sviṣṭakṛdantakarmānuṣṭhāyādhvaryuḥ samācarat| | aindravāyavamaitrāvaruṇāśvinān hi trigrāhān ||46 || adhvaryuṇaindravāyave gṛhīte ca tataḥ param | pratiprasthātā cādityapātre droṇaghaṭāt khalu ||47|| aindravāyavanigrāhyaṃ dhṛtvā sākaṃ juhāva ha | paraspararasasekottaramādityapātrake ||48|| samānayacca sampātaṃ hotre pātraṃ gururdadau | evamuttaragrahayoranuṣṭhānaṃ ca pātanam ||49 || unnetā ca tataścācchāvākacamasameva ca | varjayitvā tatra navacamasānapyapūrayat |||2.248.50 | | hotuśca brahmaṇaścāpyudrāturyajayitustathā | brāhmaṇyācchaṃsino maitrāvaruṇasya tathā ca vai ||51 || poturneṣṭustathā cāgnīdhrasya te camasā nava | pariplavayā kalaśādāsrāvya somakaṃ rasam ||52 || pūtabhṛtkalaśāt somamādāya camasām̐stataḥ | prapūrya droṇakalaśānnyasyātha camaseṣu ca |||813|| asrāvayat prathamaṃ srāvaṇaṃ copastarātmakam | dvitīyaṃ srāvaṇaṃ cābhidhāraṇasthānakaṃ matam ||24|| evaṃ sarvonnayanaṃ kartavyaṃ prapūraṇe khalu | tato’dhvaryuḥ śukrapātraṃ gṛhītvā somasaṃyutam ||55|| manthipātraṃ pratiprasthātā gṛhītvā sasomakam | havirdhānamaṇḍapasya pūrvadvāri susanmukhau |||56|| tiṣṭhantau svaṃ gṛhaṃ vāratniṃ sandhāya parasparam | mantrakṛtvaścāhavanīyasya puro’nugamya ca ||57|| paścamukhau grahahomārthaṃ sajjā sambabhūvatuḥ | tadā navacamasādhvaryavaḥ sacamasāḥ khalu ||58|| āvahanīyadeśaṃ ca gatvā pūrvānanāstadā | homārthamudyatāścāsan cakruścāśravaṇaṃ tathā ||59|| cakruḥ pratyāśravaṇādi dadau praiṣa tato guruḥ | hotrā kṛte vaṣaṭkāre’nuvaṣaṭkārake kṛte |||2.248.60 || dvirhutvā camasaścādhvaryuṇā ca preṣitā sadaḥ | pratibhakṣārthaṃ camasānāharat hotṛkādayaḥ ||61 || maitrāvaruṇādyādhvaryavaścamasān prapūrya ca | homārthamānayam̐ścāpyāhavanīyaṃ prati drutam ||62|| adhvaryupratiprasthātārau ca homaṃ pracakratuḥ | indradevatāyai svāhāgnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā ||63 || pratiprasthātā saṃsrāvahomamaṃgārake’karot | rudrāya svāheti tato’dhvaryuścamasamāpya ca ||64|| juhāva mitravaruṇābhyāṃ svāheti kramādapi | sarve’dhvaryavo juhuvuḥ svaṃ svaṃ camasameva ha ||65|| indrāya marute tvaṣṭre cāgnaye svāhā namama | tataścamasaprasādaṃ bhakṣayāmāsureva te ||66 || acchāvāko’pi camasaṃ bhakṣayāmāsa vai tataḥ | ṛtugrahapracāraṃ cākurutāṃ dvau tataḥ param ||67|| adhvaryupratiprasthātārau cakraturhavān śubhān | indrāya madhave svāhā maruta mādhavāya ca ||68 || tvaṣṭre śukrāya ca svāhāgnaye ca śucaye svāhā | indrāya nabhase svāhā mitrāvaruṇanabhasyebhyaḥ svāhā ||6 9|| draviṇodase iṣāya svāhā draviṇodase ūrjāya svāhā | draviṇodase sahāya svāhā draviṇodase sahasyāya svāhā ||2.248.7 0 || aśvinābhyāṃ tapase svāhā, gṛhapataye tapasyāya svāhā | tataścamasānāṃ vai bhakṣaṇaṃ vidhinābhavat ||7 1 || tataḥ śastraprapaṭhanaṃ pratigarasya pāṭhanam | adhvaryo śoṃ’sāvo im, śoṃ’sāmoda iva ||72|| oṃ mo3thāmoda iva, othāmoda iva | oṃ othāmoda ivetyādipāṭhaṃ samācaran ||73||| tato nārāśaṃsahomaṃ juhāvādhvaryureva ca | indrāgnibhyāmidaṃ svāhā pitṛbhyaḥ svāhā namaḥ ||74|| nārāśaṃsaṃ vidhāyaivaṃ praugaśastramuktavān | viśvedevatābhyaśca svāheti havanaṃ dadau ||75|| camasām̐śca tato’bhakṣayan vai niravaśeṣataḥ | ukthyagrahapracāraṃ ca homaṃ ca sarvabhakṣaṇam ||76|| prakṣālanaṃ khare sādanaṃ ceti sarvamācarat | mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ ca svāhendrāgnibhyāṃ tathā svāhā ||77|| ṛtvijaśca vidhāyaivaṃ sādanāntaṃ vidhiṃ tataḥ | prātaḥ savanaṃ nirvartya bahiryayuśca maṇḍapāt ||78 || madhyāhne ca pracakruśca mādhyandinaṃ savaṃ ca te | prātarvat sarvamākṛtvo dhārāsrāvaṃ vyadhuśca te ||79|| śukrāya manthine cāgrayaṇāya svāhā namama | pavamānaṃ jaguścāpi dadhiyāgaṃ vyadhustataḥ ||2.248.80 || bhakṣaṇaṃ sādane cakruruccāvacaṃ ca karma ca | dakṣiṇādānamevāpi yajamānaścakāra ha ||8 1 || gāvo’śvāścāśvatarāśca gardabhājāvayastathā | tilamāṣavrīhiyavā gajavāsohiraṇyakam ||8 2 || sarvasvameva rājyādi kanyāgṛhāṇi vāṭikāḥ | dakṣiṇāyāṃ pradattāni rājñā tadā makhotsave ||83 || marutvatīyagrahapracārastato’bhavat khalu | vaiśvadevapañcahomānadhvaryuḥ pracakāra ha ||84|| adhvaryuḥ pratiprasthātā hutvā cakraturbhakṣaṇam | homaṃ kampaṃ pracakruśca indrāya marutvate svāhā ||85|| ūrvobhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svāhā māhendrāya namaḥ svāhā | agnaye cendrāya svāhā raktāya ca svāhā namama ||86|| ukthyavigrahānuṣṭhānaṃ pañcastotraprapāṭhanam | savasamāptihomaṃ ca kṛtvā bahiryayustataḥ ||87|| tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ cāpi cakrurhomaṃ ca bhakṣaṇam | ādityebhyaḥ svāhā namaḥ payo dadhīdaṃ somakam ||88|| tataścārbhavapavamānāya prasarpaṇaṃ vyadhuḥ | dhiṣṇyān prajvālayāmāsuḥ kṛtveḍābhakṣaṇāntakam ||89|| savanīyahavīṃṣi sampracaryādhvaryureva tu | sakṛddhomaṃ pracakāra homaṃ cakre taduttaram ||2.248.90|| camasinaḥ svasvapitṝnuddiśya tānatiṣṭhipan | tato homaṃ savitre ca viśvadevebhya ādadau || 91 || makṣaṇaṃ ca tataḥ saumyacaruyāgo hyavartata | anavasrāvitastaṇḍulapakvaudanakaṃ carum || 9 2|| juhāva cāgnaye patnīvate svāheti vai guruḥ | ekaviṃśatikastomaṃ stotraṃ cāgāyata prakham | | 93 || camasān juhuvuścāpi vaiśvānarāgnaye svāhā | marudbhyaḥ svāheti namama bhakṣaṇaṃ ca tataḥ param || 94|| tato hāriyojanātmagrahapracārakaṃ vyadhuḥ | unnetā ca somarasaṃ yavadhānādimiśritam || 95 || juhāvānye’pajighram̐śca patnīsaṃjāyasaṃ tathā | yajuhomādikaṃ prāyaścittahomān cakāra ha || 96|| yajamānasya ca tato viṣṇukramaṇakādikam | evaṃ samāpya tṛtīyasavane bhojanāni ca | | 97|| vyadhuḥ sarve mahīmānā janāśca tīrthavāsinaḥ | sthāyinaśca tataścāvabhṛtheṣṭiḥ samajāyata ||98|| sapatnīko yajamānaḥ ṛtvijaścāpare janāḥ | rājāsandyāṃ somapātrāṇyādāyāgṛhya jīṣakam | | 99|| yayurjalasamīpaṃ ca gāyantaḥ sāmagītikāḥ | jale’gnīvaruṇābhyāṃ ca ājyabhāgau dadustadā || 2.248.100 || catuḥprayājām̐ścakruśca dvāvanūyājakau tathā | varuṇāya puroḍāśaṃ dadāmi vai jale namaḥ || 101 || ṛjīṣādīni ca jale kṣiptvā patnīnṛpastathā | sasnatuścāpare cāpi nemuścādityamityapi || 10 2|| śālāmukhe samāgatyodayanīyeṣṭimācaran | tata ānubandhyaphalayāgaścāmikṣikāyajiḥ || 103 || mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ svāhā datvā baliṃ tathocitam | yajamānaḥ keśaśmaśrunakhalomāni vai tataḥ || 1 04| | vāpayitvā ca snātvā ceṣṭikalpena ca pañca ca | dhātānumatirākāsinīvālīkuhūrityapi || 105 | | vyājyeneṣṭvā devatāstā udavasānīyeṣṭikām | aṣṭākapālapuroḍāśadravyāṃ tathākarot || 106 | | viṣṇave svāheti datvāgnihotraṃ niśi cācarat | tataścakruḥ parihāraṃ somayāgasya carṣayaḥ || 1 07|| somapānaṃ pracakāra rājā patnīyutastadā | bhojanāni pracakruśca sarve vai makhino’dhvare || 10 8| | evaṃ vai rādhike somayāgo dvādaśikādine | sampūrṇaścābhavad rātrau yajñanārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 109 || darśanaṃ pradadau rājñe varadānaṃ dadau tathā | svasti te’stu sadā rājan cānte mokṣapadaṃ vraja || 2.248.110 || sthāpayātra ca māṃ saudhe mūrtirūpaṃ narāyaṇam | sa rājā rādhike tūrṇa mandiraṃ samakārayat || 111 || yajñanārāyaṇastatra yājñīpatnīsamanvitaḥ | sthāpitastena vidhinā tīrthaṃ yajñākhyameva tat || 112 || somatīrthaṃ tathā cābhūt snānād yajñaphalapradam | aśvapaṭṭasarasyeveśānakoṇe hi pāvanam || 113 || nṛpo’śvapāṭalaḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇasya hastataḥ | kaṇṭhīṃ ca vaiṣṇavīṃ prāpa mantraṃ jagrāha lomaśāt || 1 14|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | tataḥ prapūjya deveśaṃ datvā dānāni sarvaśaḥ || 1 15|| yayau naijaṃ prarāṣṭraṃ ca rādhike sukhato nṛpaḥ | ṛṣayo’nye devatādyā yayurnaijān pradeśakān ||116|| tatra dānājjalapānādavagāhācca bhojanāt | pūjanādapi svargaṃ syādante’kṣarapadaṃ vrajet || 117 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne somayāge pañcamadine mārgakṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ prātaḥsavane mādhyandinasavane taduttarasavanaṃ pūrṇāhutiravabhṛtheṣṭiḥ parihāraścetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭācatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ | | 248 ||
<2.249> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike’tha tataḥ sarve nidrāṃ jagṛhureva ha | trayodaśyāṃ kṛtasnānārhaṇā vidāyamāpnuvan || 1 || lomaśarṣiḥ sabhāyāṃ vai hyupādideśa dehinaḥ | śraddhāyajñāḥ phalavantaścāśraddhāḥ phalavarjitāḥ || 2 || ājyena payasā dadhnā somena ca phalena ca | pūrṇāhutyā śraddhayā ca phalavanti kratavastviha || 3 || aśaktāśca makhe te tu pucchābhiṣecanena vai | abhiṣekeṇa vā pādarajasā santarantyapi || 4 || śraddhāṃ patnīṃ vidhāyaiva susatyena vratena tu | yajamāno yajeteśaṃ taratyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 5 || iṣṭaṃ tu daivataṃ kṛtvā yajeta śraddhayā muhuḥ | bhāvenārpaṇavidhinā taratyeva sa yāgakṛt || 6 || puroḍāśaḥ sadā medhyo devānāṃ tṛptikārakaḥ | sarvā nadyaḥ sarasvatyaḥ sarve puṇyāḥ śiloccayāḥ || 7 || sarvā pṛthvī harerdhāma brahmaniṣṭhasya dehinaḥ | śraddhā tu poṣitā yena sā tu puṣṇāti taṃ janam || 8 || śraddhāṃ nihanti yo dharme sā hatā hanti taṃ janam | sādhūnāṃ śraddhadhānānāṃ kurvatāṃ yajñavistaram || 9 || phalaṃ sampadyate sarvaṃ prasavitrī hi sā yataḥ | jñānavṛddhaṃ manovṛddhaṃ śraddhā deve hi rakṣati || 2.249.10 || śraddhāvṛddhaṃ harirnārāyaṇaḥ kvāpi na muñcati | aśraddadhāno devānāṃ nārhati havirarpaṇe | | 11 || ahavirannadātuśca bhoktavyaṃ naiva sarvathā | aśraddhā paramaṃ pāpa tanmayaṃ grāhyameva na || 1 2 || pāvayitrī jyāyasī ca nivṛttidā sukhapradā | śraddhā śāntipradā parabrahārūpā hi pāvanī || 13 || śraddhā brahmapradā tadvadahiṃsā vrahmadāyinī | ahiṃsā sarvadharmebhyo bhūtānāṃ jyāyasī matā || 14|| sarvayajñeṣu vai viṣṇurbhuṃkte havyaṃ hi pāyasam | pāyasaiḥ sumanobhiśca phalairgundrai rasairhavaḥ || 15 || pāvanastṛptido vipṇorjāyate śuddhabhāvanaḥ | auṣadhyādi pavitraṃ vai sarvaṃ devārhameva tat || 1 6|| yathā śarīraṃ na gleyāttathauṣadhaiḥ prajīvayet | kandamūlaphalādyaiśca yajñaṃ santoṣayet sadā || 1 7|| śraddhā vai jananī sarvaphalāvāptiprakāriṇī | ahiṃsā bhaginī tasyāste hyubhe devadarśike || 18 || jananī naiva hantavyā sadā bālopakāriṇī | ahiṃsā paramo dharmaḥ svadharmo mātṛrakṣaṇam || 1 9|| śraddhāṃ hatvā mātaraṃ ca ko hi jātu sukhī bhavet | mātā śarīrahetuḥ sā mātrā sanāthatā sadā || 2.249.2 0 || śriyā hrīno’pi sujanaścāmveti gehamṛcchati | putrapautrayutaścāpi jananīṃ prati bālakaḥ || 21 || asamaya vicittaṃ vā sutaṃ mātā prarakṣati | tadā vārdhakyamāyāti duḥkhadoṣasamanvitam || 2 2|| tadā śūnyaṃ jagattasya yadā mātrā viyujyate | nāsti mātṛsamaḥ kaścidādhāro bhūtale’pi ca || 23 || nāsti mātṛsamaṃ trāṇe priyaṃ prāṇasya bhājanam | kukṣisaṃdhāraṇād dhātrī jananājjananī hi sā || 24|| aṃgānāṃ vardhanādambā mātā mānakarī śiśoḥ | śraddhā dhātrī svargakukṣau jananī devayoniṣu |||5|| ambākṣarapradatvāśca mātā muktipradā yataḥ | svargakāmo yajeteti śraddhayā yajanaṃ matam ||26 || oṣadhyaḥ samidho vṛkṣā vīrudājyaṃ payo dadhi | havirbhūmirdiśaḥ śraddhā kālaḥ ṛco yajūṃṣi ca || 27| | sāmāni yajamānāgniḥ saptadaśāṃgakaḥ kratuḥ | ājyena payasā dadhnā śakṛtāmikṣayā phalaiḥ |||28|| rasaiśca śraddhayā viṣṇuḥ prasīdatyeva cādhvare | brāhmaṇaprabhavo yajño brahmārpaṇaparāyaṇaḥ || 29 || anuyajñaṃ jagat sarve yajñaścānu jagat saṭā | omiti brahmaṇo nāma namaḥ svāhā svadhā vaṣaṭ || 2.249.3 0 || yasyaitāni prayujyante tasya bhayaṃ na vidyate | tasyābhayapradaḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ 31 | | kāṃbhareyo hariḥ sākṣādakṣarātparataḥ paraḥ | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre bhavadbhirīkṣito makhe || 32 | | sa eva sarvayajñānāṃ phalaṃ jānāti vai prabhuḥ | dadātyeva phalaṃ samyag jananyā cānumoditaḥ || 33 || tasmād yajed yājayecca yaśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavallabham | vidhinā yajataḥ svarge śāśvataṃ cākṣarātparam || 34|| nāyaṃ loko’styayajñānāṃ nāpi paraśca niścitaḥ | nāpi dharmo’sti gatidaścāyajñānāmiha kṣitau || 35|| aśvapāṭala uvāca kathaṃ loko’yamutkṛṣṭaḥ paralokastathāpyate | kathaṃ dharmaśca gatidaḥ kṣitau syāttadvadātra me || 36 | | śrīlomaśa uvāca sādhvācārasya ca jitātmanaḥ samasya dehiṣu | sarvasatkārakāryasyotkṛṣṭo’yaṃ loka iṣyate || 37|| sarvatra brahmadṛṣṭeśca brahmapūjāratasya ca | brahmaniṣṭhasya bhaktasya paralokaḥ prakāśate || 38 | | sarvaprasannatārhasya sarvopakāraśālinaḥ | ahiṃsāsatyadharmasya dharmo vai gatido bhavet || 3 9|| māyābhāvavihīnasyākṣarabhāvagatasya ca | parabrahmāśritasyaiva trayaṃ karagataṃ hi tat ||2.249.40|| saiṣopaniṣadvidyā vai sannidhiyojikā hareḥ | yayāpyate parabrahma dhāmākṣaraṃ ca śāśvatam || 41 || jñānena cāpyate brahma jñānaṃ copaniṣanmatā | bhaktyā saṃprāpyate brahmā bhaktiścopaniṣanmatā ||42| | bhāgavatena dharmeṇāpyate kṛṣṇaḥ sa eva sā | vairāgyeṇa ca duḥkhena yadi gatvā hariṃ prati || 43 || vāsaḥ sañjāyate yena tattadupaniṣanmatā | devasya mandire vāso jāyate yena hetunā || 44|| śubhāśayaḥ sa vai heturbrahmāptyupaniṣanmatā | bālaḥ prasādalobhena yadi gacchati mandiram || 45|| harervai sannidhau tasyopaniṣat sa prasādakaḥ | karmaṇā śatruṇā vāpi vāñcchayā cehayāpi vā |||46|| hare sānnidhyamāpyeta yena sopaniṣanmatā | yajñena sevayā cāpi sārthena svārthakena vā ||47|| dānena tṛṣṇayā vāpi devasannidhirāpyate | yena kenāpi vai sātropaniṣat sammatā bhuvi || 48|| sādhusaṃgo’tivelaṃ yo brahmaprāptikaro’sti vai | sa copaniṣat saṃproktā satsaṃginā haripradā || 49|| kathāśravaṇamevātra nārīṇāṃ brahmayogadam | sā copaniṣad bodhyaiva yena nārāyaṇo milet ||2.249.50|| snehastānaṃ bhāvanā ca vṛttiḥ rāgo’pi ced yadi | brahmaprāptikaraste vai sarve copaniṣanmatā ||5 1 || gopīnāṃ kāmataḥ prāptirviprāṇāṃ yajñatastathā | gopānāṃ maitryataḥ prāptidaityānāṃ dveṣato’pi ca |||52||| sudāmno lobhataḥ prāptijīvanārth tu hastinaḥ | tapasā ca dhruvasyāpi prahlādasya tu niścayāt ||53|| pūtanāyā vairabhāvānnāradasya tu kīrtanāt | evaṃ yenaiva kenaiva hetunā cāpyate hariḥ ||54|| hetuḥ sa copaniṣat sā brahmaprāptikarī matā | jñānaṃ bhaktiśca vā karma bhāvanā vā samarpaṇam |||55||| sarvaṃ copaniṣat proktā yayā brahma hyavāpyate | aśvapaṭṭala yajñenānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |||56|| prāptastvayātra vai divyamūrtiḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | somayajñastavātraivopaniṣatsaṃmatā dhruvā ||57|| anugraheṇa jīvānāṃ kvacid yogaḥ prabhormataḥ | kvacid yatnena vā kvacijjātyā yogo bhavedapi ||58|| sā teṣāṃ yogināṃ hetuḥ śubhropaniṣat saṃmatā | yathā karmāṇi sarvāṇi phale parisamāpyate ||59|| phalaṃ śāntau sā ca bhoge brahmaṇyeva samāpyate | brahmabhāvaḥ pare deve parameśe samāpyate ||2.249.6 0 || yatayastaṃ vijānanti paśyanti yānti taṃ prati | nirdvandvā nirbandhanāśca vimuktāḥ śucayo’malāḥ ||6 1 || apavarge kṛtaniṣṭhā brahmiṣṭhā brahmavāsinaḥ | vimāyā brahmabhūtāśca gatisteṣāṃ sanātanī ||6 2|| anāraṃbhāḥ sudhṛtayaḥ śucayo brahmasaṃjñitāḥ | devaṃ pareśvaraṃ yajñaistarpayantyanṛtaiṣiṇaḥ ||63|| sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya paśyataḥ svetarāṇi ca | mārgaṃ yānti tatpradattanetravān tasya bhaktimān ||64|| navadvārapraguptiṃ ca kṛtvā hṛdayodghāṭanam | brahmamārgeṇa yātasya parabrahmagṛhe sthitiḥ || 65|| agnihotraṃ pūrṇamāso darśaḥ prayājakāstathā | sviṣṭakṛccānuyājāśca pitṛyajño’ṅgayāgakaḥ || 66||| cāturmāsyaṃ vaiśvadevaḥ sākamedhaśca vāruṇaḥ | somayāgaśca savanaṃ cāgrayaṇeṣṭirityapi ||67|| avabhṛtheṣṭiścokthaṃ ca ṣoḍaśī cātirātrakam | atyagniṣṭoma evāpi vājapeyaśca viṣṭutiḥ ||68|| vāyavyaḥ śatarudrīyo vāsavo rājasūyakaḥ | sautrāmaṇiścāśvamedhaḥ puṃmedhaḥ sarvamedhakaḥ || 69|| gomedho brahmamedhaśca yajñā ye’nye kriyāparāḥ | jñānaparāstapaḥparā dravyaparāśca ye makhāḥ ||2.249.70 || svāgatārthāścopakārāstathā ye dānadakṣiṇāḥ | sarve te kalpitā kṛṣṇe mokṣadā brahmamārgiṇaḥ ||7 1 || kṛtā vā na kṛtā vāpi nāsya kiñcit praśiṣyate | hariḥ santoṣitaḥ prāptastenāptaṃ sarvameva ha ||72|| kṛteṣvapi ca yajñeṣu toyiteṣu sureṣu ca | kṛṣṇabhānavihīnena kṛtaṃ cenmokṣadaṃ na tat ||73|| tasmāt teṣu cādhvareṣu kṛṣṇo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ | sādhavo brahmayatayo bāhyadvāranirodhinaḥ ||74|| sarvayajñeṣu taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tarpayantyamṛtaiṣiṇaḥ | anyadvāraṃ pidhāyaiva brahmadvāraṃ prasārayet ||75 || aśvapāṭala uvāca kathaṃ lomaśa dvārāṇi pidhātavyāni tadvada | pidhānottaramevāpi kṛtyaṃ syād vā phalaṃ vada ||76 || śrīlomaśa uvāca amṛtaṃ brahmakośe’sti cātmanā rakṣitaṃ param | apihitena dvāreṇa prayātyanyatra durlabham ||77|| devanaṃ yatkarābhyāṃ vai padbhyāmanyatra dhāvanam | kāmanā yā ca nikṛṣṭā cāsanaṃ tvanyacatvare ||78|| varṇanaṃ cānyaviṣayaṃ rūpaṇaṃ lokamiśritam | āsvādanaṃ prasādānye ghrāṇanaṃ klinnavarṣmaṇaḥ ||79|| sparśanaṃ mṛdumāyāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ calanāphalam | mananaṃ mamakārasya bodhanaṃ bahu me bhavet| ||2.249.80|| cintanaṃ cāmarau me sto’haṃpadaṃ nāsti mādṛśaḥ | ityevaṃ cāmṛtaṃ sarvaṃ jāgrati svapnake’pi ca ||81 || sarvaṃ sravatyajasraṃ vai pātraṃ riktaṃ bhaviṣyati | tasmāt pidhānaṃ kartavyaṃ vivekena vijānatā ||82|| nākṣatulyaivaiṃ dīvyecca na dhāvet kardamasthalīm | na kāmayennikṛṣṭāṃ kṣmāṃ nāsīta mohacatvare ||83|| na varṇayeduśatyānyad rūpayennahi rūpakam | nāsvādayeccārpaṇānyat jighrennaiva hi daihikam ||84|| na spṛśenmārdavīṃ śayyāṃ śṛṇuyānna kathetarat | mananaṃ māpateḥ kuryād bodhanaṃ brahma me bhavet ||85|| cintanaṃ cāmṛtaṃ me’stu cāhaṃ tasmin vasāmi ca | ityevaṃ dvāraguptiṃ vai kuryācchrīharirūpiṇīm ||86 || vṛṣṭerjalād yathā bhaumaṃ jalaṃ vṛddhiṃ sameti vai | tathā guptyāmṛtaṃ naijaṃ brahmaguptyā vivardhate ||87|| grīṣmatāpād yathā bhaumaṃ jalaṃ śuṣkaṃ vilīyate | tathā dvārāpidhāne tu svāmṛtaṃ layamīyate ||88|| vṛthā gacchenna vai loke vṛthādadīta naiva ha | vṛthā kāmaṃ na bhuñjīta vṛthā nopāviśet kvacit ||89|| vṛthā bhāṣāṃ satyahīnāṃ kṛṣṇahīnāṃ na vai vadet | vṛthā rūpaṃ kṛṣṇahīnaṃ na vai paśyennirarthakam || 2.249.90|| vṛthā svādṃ na gṛhṇīyād dehayātrātirekiṇam | vṛthā gandhaṃ nādadīta śvāsapūrtaṃ samācaret || 11 || vṛthā sparśaṃ na kurvīta hareḥ sparśaṃ vinā sadā | vṛthā dadīta karṇau na parameśaśravaṃ vinā || 12|| manane śrīhareḥ kuryācchrīpateḥ kamalāpateḥ | bodhanaṃ śrīpateḥ kuryāccintanaṃ śrīhareḥ sadā || 92|| ahantā tasya caivāsmi nānyasyāhaṃ kadācana | evaṃ lakṣmīpaterarthaṃ sarvaṃ cāhaṃ tadātmakaḥ || 94|| sarvendriyanivāso me parameśe narāyaṇe | bhavatveveti vai dvāraguptirbodhyāmṛtārthinī || 95|| yasya dvārāṇi sarvāṇi vihāravarjitāni vā | hareḥ prāptirbhavettasyāmṛtavārdhi pibatyayam || 96|| guptadvārasya bhaktasyāmṛtaṃ śāśvatato bhajet | sarve yajñāḥ samāpyante’mṛtaśāśvatatārthinaḥ || 97|| kiṃ tasya tapasā kṛcchrairyajñaiḥ kleśaistathetaraiḥ | arjanīyaṃ cārjitaṃ vai hṛdi nārāyaṇāmṛtam || 98|| aśvapāṭala saṃjñātvā kośasthaṃ tvamṛtaṃ nijam | na srāvayedamārgeṇa moghatāṃ na nayettathā || 99|| yathāpekṣaṃ tvambaraṃ ca yathāpekṣaṃ tṛṇāsanam | yathāpekṣopadhānaṃ ca yātrāmātrādanaṃ tathā || 2.249.1 00|| dvandvārāmān vihāyaivāntarārāmaṃ bhajet sadā | anyasārthaṃ vihāyaivāntarasārtha samāśrayet || 101 || tena dīrghasya mārgasya pāraṃ yāyāt sugatvaraḥ | ityeva rādhike rājñe lomaśaḥ prāha cāmṛtam || 10 2|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāmaśvapāṭalanṛpataye śraddhopaniṣadamṛtaguptyādirūpaṃ lomaśadattajñānamitinirūpaṇanāmā navacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 249 ||
<2.250> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike’śvapāṭalastu śrutvā śrīlomaśaṃ punaḥ | papraccha tyāgamārgaṃ ca pratyakṣaṃ phaladaṃ tathā || 1 || aśvapāṭala uvāca tyāgamārgeṇa pratyakṣaṃ yatphalaṃ samajāyate | tadvadātra maharṣe me kiṃ pratyakṣaṃ ca kiṃ phalam || 2 || kimatra pratyakṣatamaṃ yadupāste bhavāniha | pratyakṣe khalu sarveṣāṃ samānatāvalokyate || 3 || bhavānapīha śokaṃ ca yathā harṣaṃ ca vindati | indriyārthāśca bhavataḥ samānāḥ sarvadehinām || 4 || samānānāṃ hi sarveṣāṃ kiṃ pratyakṣaṃ nirāmayam | bhavato hi kimādhikyaṃ gṛhamedhita eva yat || 5 || śrīlomaśa uvāca harau tyāgastyāgamārgaḥ kimanyat tyajanena vai | sarvasvārpaṇarūpo’yaṃ tyāgaḥ sarvottamo harau || 6 | tenātmano hi sākṣāttvaṃ tatpradattadṛśā khalu | phalaṃ cātmasukhaṃ cāpi parameśaprasādataḥ || 7 || ahamupāsse pratyakṣaṃ bālakṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīkaṃbharāsutam || 8 || cakṣuṣormanasaścāpi yaḥ pratyakṣatamo’tra vai | ātmanyeva parabrahma sa evāste śriyāḥ patiḥ || 9 || lakṣmīpatiḥ satāṃ svāmīmuktapatiḥ pareśvaraḥ | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetralālaḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ || 2.250.10 || brahmapriyāpatiścātmapatirvidyāpatiḥ prabhuḥ | muktipatiścākṣareśo dhāmeśādhipatirhariḥ || 11 || sa pratyakṣatamo me’tra rājam̐staṃ tvaṃ vilokaya | harṣaṃ śokaṃ pravindāmi rājan nāṭyasya veṣavat || 1 2|| samānānīndriyāṇyeva dehe samānatāpi ca | grahaṇādivyavahāraḥ samāno’pi tathāpi tu || 1 3|| bhūtāveśitavannityaṃ carāmi paramātmanā | sa bhoktā sa niyantā ca sa evālocanādimān || 14|| sarvabhūtādhibhūtenāveśito’haṃ carāmi yat | harṣaṃ śokaṃ sa evātra dehe vetti na dehyayam || 15|| tathāpi nāṭyavatsarvaṃ darśayāmi yathā mayi | ahaṃ vedmi tathā vetti mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ || 16|| vetti sanatkumāraśca nārado vā narāyaṇaḥ | svayaṃprakāśaḥ śaṃbhurvā vetti nānyo bhuvaṃgataḥ || 17|| kapilādyāśca vartante jale kamalavaddhi te | nirlepāste vayaṃ kṛṣṇaliptā api vilepinaḥ || 18|| rājādyāḥ svārthaliptāśca pratyakṣaṃ sukhiduḥkhinaḥ | vayaṃ santaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇājasraparāyaṇāḥ || 1 9|| tadarthakṛtasarvasvāstanmayāstadviśeṣitāḥ | cintārogo na cāsmākaṃ sādhūnāṃ vidyate yataḥ || 2.250.20 || yo rogo jīvatāṃ dehendriyātmavādināṃ tviha | sa rogo vigato naśca tasmānnirāmayā vayam ||2 1 || vāsanā rogamūlaṃ ca sā ca nārāyaṇe’rpitā | dhanvantarimahāvaidye nāḍikā sarvato’rpitā || 22|| tasyānnirāmayāḥ smo’tra rājam̐stvaṃ tādṛśo bhava | haripradattajñānena viharāmo’tra varṣmasu ||23|| tatpreritaṃ prakurmaśca sarvamarthyaṃ nirāmayam | tatkṛtaṃ samanuṣṭhānaṃ sarvaṃ cāste nirāmayam ||24|| tatpradattaṃ ca vijñānaṃ śokaṃ jahāti mūlataḥ | taṃ vinā svārthavṛttyutthaṃ jñānaṃ nāśayati prajāḥ || 25| ato vayaṃ jñānavanto nirāmayā hi bhūpate | aikātmyaṃ brahmaṇā nārāyaṇenāptaṃ nirāmayam || 26|| tattvamabuddhvā bahavaścāhaṃkāravaśaṃgatāḥ | vādabalā na jānanti nirāmayatvamīdṛśam |||27|| tato bhavanti te brahmastenā mohavaśaṃgatāḥ | tamobhāvanimagnānāmeṣāṃ tamaḥ parāyaṇam || 28||| prakṛtiṃ svāṃ doṣarūpāṃ daṃbhānṛtamadātmikām | prākṛtāḥ samprayāntyeva brāhmāstadūrdhvavartanāḥ || 29|| evamāntarabodhāste santyajanti śubhāśubham | parāṃ gatiṃ prapaśyantaḥ santo nārāyaṇe ratāḥ || 2.250.3 0|| dānamadhyayanaṃ yajñaḥ prajā santānamārjavam | hariṃ vinā sāmayaṃ tanmokṣaḥ kṛtvāpi nāsti cet ||3 1 || dhikkārapadametad vai śramaḥ sarvo nirarthakaḥ | rājyeṣu strīṣu lokeṣu dehendriyārthabhuktiṣu || 32|| vartamāno’pi cet kṛṣṇārpaṇaḥ so’yaṃ nirāmayaḥ | nirvastro nirjanaścāpi niṣpātro niṣparigrahaḥ || 33|| sarvasaho’pi vai kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ vinā kṣayāmayaḥ | tasmād rājan bhava kāṇḍaistrībhiścāpi nirāmayaḥ ||34|| śuṣkajñaptyā karmaṇā vā kā nirāmayatā bhavet | kṛṣṇabhaktyārpaṇabhaktyā dhruvaṃ nirāmayo bhavet| || 35 || nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ śabdabrahma bodhyaṃ nirāmayam | tatra niṣṇātatāṃ prāpya parabrahmāgamaṃ vrajet| || 36 || evaṃ śuddhasamācāraścātmā bhavati brāhmaṇaḥ | kṛṣṇe tyāgakriyāvāṃśca parigrahavivarjitaḥ || 37|| manaḥsaṃkalpasaṃsiddho viśuddhabodhaniścayaḥ | janma karma ca vidyā ca śuklā yasya harau matāḥ || 38|| pratyakṣabrahmaparamaḥ śraddadhānaḥ parāvare | satsaṃgato bhāvitātmā śīlasantoṣasadvrataḥ ||39|| dharma bhāgavataṃ kṛcchre satyapyācaratīha yaḥ | tasya brahmasutasyaiva brahmāṃkaśayanasya vai ||2.250.40|| nirāmayatvaṃ cāstyeva śāśvataṃ nirupadravam | nāsya vai vartate kiṃcid vidhātavyaṃ divaṃ prati ||41 || prāyaścittaṃ na caivāsya karmaṇāṃ cārpaṇāddharau | evaṃ bahuvidhā viprā yajñakarmaparāyaṇāḥ ||42|| śucayo vratavantaśca tryavadānā haristhitāḥ | yajanto’haraharyajñairāśābandhanavarjitāḥ ||43|| ṛjavaḥ śamajityāśca brahmakarmaparāyaṇāḥ | brahma yeṣāṃ paro dharmaḥ parārtho brahma nityadā ||44|| kāmo’pi brahma caiteṣāṃ mokṣo brahma sanātanam | nyūnaṃ vādhikyamevāpi vartanaṃ brahma śāśvatam ||45|| vyutkramaśca kramaścāpi yeṣāṃ brahma parātparam | teṣāṃ kṛṣṇātmanāṃ brahmasattamānāṃ tu śāśvatam ||46 || svargaṃ svargottamaṃ nityaṃ nirāmayaṃ mahāsukham | śāśvatānandapūrṇaṃ te yanti tatparamaṃ padam ||47|| gṛhe yadvā vane yadvā nyāse vā brahmaṇi sthitāḥ | yanti te sātvatā rājan parabrahma pareśvaram ||48|| sakāmāste tu dṛśyante divi jyotirmayāḥ surāḥ | dhiṣṇyeṣu bahubhogāśca nakṣatratārakāgaṇāḥ ||49|| akāmā naiva dṛśyante dūraṃ pāraṃ paraṃ gatāḥ | sakāmāśca punaḥ santo bhūtvā yāsyanti tatpadam ||2.250.50 || brahmātmanāmatṛṣṇānāṃ teṣāmanāmayaṃ dhruvam | dhāmākṣaraṃ parabrahmasthānaṃ paraṃ nirāmayam ||51 || sāmayasya kṛte dharmaḥ paropakārasaṃjñakaḥ | puṇyadaḥ puṇyaśīlasya gṛhe janmapradastathā ||52|| puṇyajanmatayā cārthaḥ puṇyalābho’sya jāyate | kāmanā rāgahīnā ca kṛtātmanaḥ prajāyate ||53 || tyāgasantoṣasiddhiśca prajñā viśāradī bhavet | apavargamatiścāpi brahmadharmaparo bhavet ||54|| brahmaṇaḥ padamanvicchan brahmalokaṃ prayāti ca | gacchan kṣemaṃ samanvicchan durbalo’trāvasīdati ||55|| bhuṃkte datte ca yajate prāptābhirvastubhiryadi | parigrahaḥ śubho’pyasya na tyāgasukhasadṛśaḥ ||56|| karmapākaḥ śarīraṃ vai jñānapāko nirīhatā | bhaktipāko brahmatā ca brahmapākaḥ paraṃ padam ||57|| dayā kṣamā ca santoṣaḥ satyaṃ śāntirahiṃsanam | ārjavaṃ hrīstitikṣā ca mānagarvavivarjanam ||58|| satsaṃgo bhaktibhāvaśca sevā satāṃ surārcanam | panthāno brahmaṇastvete prāpnotyetaiḥ paraṃ padam ||59|| gatiṃ gacchanti santo yāṃ tāmāhuḥ paramāṃ gatim | saṃsāro vāsanāvargaḥ santoṣastvapavargakaḥ ||2.250.6 0 || sāmye’pīndriyavarge’pi sāmayāmayate nṛpa | ete nideśite te’tra nirāmayatvamāvaha ||6 1 || aśvapāṭala uvāca dharmārthakāmān satataṃ cāmanantīha dehinaḥ | mokṣaṃ kecit samicchanti tasmādvai balinastrayaḥ ||62|| tatra lābho viśiṣṭo vai kasyāśrayeṇa dehinaḥ | kiṃ phalaṃ kīdṛśaṃ ceti tanme lomaśa darśaya ||63 || lomaśa uvāca rājanpurā hyahaṃ kalpe gato’bhavaṃ vanāntare | puṣkarāraṇyasaṃjñe ca tatra vipro viśālikaḥ ||64|| āsīttena kṛtā me ca pūjā phalajalādibhiḥ | tapasvinā durbalena nirdhanena ca rāgiṇā ||65|| tato’haṃ pṛṣṭavām̐stasya kuśalaṃ sa jagāda mām | dāridryaṃ duḥkhadaṃ loke tannirākuru lomaśa ||66|| tatastaṃ ca samādāya gato’haṃ cottarāṃ diśam | kuberanagaraṃ divyaṃ vyomnā dravyapralipsayā ||67|| kuberaḥ svāgataṃ cakre dadau dhanaṃ yatheṣṭakam | viśālikaḥ prasanno’bhūd dravyaṃ jagrāha śevadhim ||68|| athāpi dhanarājena niśi nijapure śubhe | rakṣitau mandire ramye tvāvāmāsva ca nidritau ||69|| ahaṃ jānāmi tatsarvaṃ nidrāyāṃ brāhmaṇena yat | vilokitaṃ mahāścaryaṃ kalmaṣāḍhyaṃ hi tacchṛṇu ||2.250.70 || apaśyata janān kām̐ściddharmāḍhyān śuddhamānasān | kām̐ścitkāmābhibhūtāśca nṛtyagītaparāyaṇān ||71 || kām̐ścitsvarṇamaṇiratnadravyābhūṣaṇasaṃbhṛtān | kuberād dravyamādāya gacchataḥ svapurīṃ prati ||72|| tāvad bhūkampanaṃ jātaṃ bhūtanāśakaraṃ muhuḥ | pṛthvīgartagatāste vai mṛtā niṣpeṣitā mṛdā ||73 || tatrāyātā yamadūtā netuṃ mṛtānanekaśaḥ | kāmino nītavantaste dṛḍhabandhanabandhitān ||74|| dhanino’pi nītavanto vinā bandhanameva tān | tato dadarśa kāmaṃ ca krodhaṃ lobhaṃ bhayaṃ madam ||75|| nidrāṃ tandrāṃ mahālasyaṃ pāpaṃ cāvṛtya tāna sthitān | nirodhayitṝn svargāṇi bhayadān yāmyaduḥkhadān ||76|| vividhān nirayākhyām̐śca puruṣān paritaḥ sthitān | tāneva vipraḥ svadravye dadarśa līnatāṃ gatān ||77|| bhayaṃ cāvāpa vai svapne vipro doṣān vilokya ca | tāvad devāḥ samāyātā dhārmikān netumeva ha ||78|| vimānaiḥ śubhaśobhaiśca smṛddhaiḥ sammānitān mṛtān | dhārmikān devatulyām̐śca kṛtvā ninyurhi tāpasān ||79|| harṣitān dhārmikān prāptadivyalokān vilokya saḥ | vipro vicārayāmāsa tapodravyaṃ paraṃ sukham ||2.250.80|| dhanaṃ doṣabhṛta cāste kāmaḥ kalmaṣasaṃbhṛtaḥ | nirayāṇāṃ kāraṇe tau dhanakāmau na śāntidau ||8 1 || atho’narthasvarūpo’sti kāmo duḥkhasvarūpavān | tapodharmaḥ svarga eva dharmaṃ carāmi vai tataḥ ||82|| cariṣye’pi tato dharmaṃ lomaśasya kṛpāvaśāt | asyānugrahamāpyaiva sukhaṃ prāpsye vṛṣodbhavam ||83|| pṛthivīṃ ratnapūrṇāṃ vā mahāntaṃ ratnasaṃcayam | avāpya yāmyalokānāṃ dvāraṃ naiṣye kadācana ||84|| ityuktvā tu dhanaṃ prātastyaktvā tatraiva mandire | taṃ kuberaṃ namaskṛtya yayau vai tapase dvijaḥ ||85 || lomaśena samaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tapo divyaṃ cakāra ha | devārcanaparo nityaṃ nityaṃ cātithipūjanaḥ ||86 | | lomaśāśrayamāsādya parṇāhāro babhūva ha | jalāhārastataścāsīd vāyubhakṣo babhūva ca || 87|| divyadṛṣṭyā dvijaścāpi yamapuryāṃ nṛpān gatān | kuṇḍe rājasahasrāṇi magnāni niraye tadā ||88 || dadarśa tapasā cāpi nārakān kāmamohitān | tataḥ svapnaṃ kṣaṇāttasya tatraivāntaradhīyata || 89 || viśāliko drutaṃ śayyāṃ tyaktvā śrīlomaśaṃ munim | praṇanāma jagādāpi dṛṣṭaṃ sarvamaniṣṭakam || 2.250.90 || kāmo’rthaśca sadā yāmyalokadau duḥkhadau guro | mayā dṛṣṭau yamapuryāṃ dharmaḥ svargaprado mataḥ || 9 1 || dharmād dṛṣṭā gatiḥ śreṣṭhā tapasā svargasaṃbhṛtā | devatāḥ savimānāśca pūjayantīha dhārmikān || 92 || na dhanāḍhyānnāpi cātra kāminaḥ pūjayanti te | dharme sukhakalā cāste cariṣyāmi vṛṣaṃ hitam || 93 || nedaṃ dhanaṃ mayā grāhyaṃ duḥkhadoṣānusevitam | sarve doṣā nivasanti dhane dṛṣṭā mayā guro || 94|| adya svapne mayā dṛṣṭaṃ kampanaṃ vai bhuvaḥ khalu | dhanāraṃbhe mahadduḥkhabharaṃ yaddarśanaṃ tviha || 95|| tadevāmaṃgalaṃ me’dya taddhanaṃ na prarocaye | ityuktvā dhanadāyaiva dhanaṃ datvā tu bhūsuraḥ || 96 || lomaśena mayā sārdhaṃ cāyāt kuṃkumavāpikām | bheje kṛṣṇaṃ parabrahma tapasā dharmasaṃbhṛtā || 97|| bhaktiṃ jagāma paramāṃ bhaktyā nārāyaṇasya ca | vaiśālikaṃ hi tattīrthaṃ jātaṃ cātra purā nṛpa || 98 || tasmāddharmo mahāsvargamokṣadaḥ sukhaśāntidaḥ | nirdoṣaḥ śrīharo nyasto dharmo niṣkāmasāttvataḥ || 99 || sāttvatānāṃ samācārastapo dhyānaṃ kratukriyā | bhajanaṃ sevanaṃ devadevasyāśrayaṇaṃ sadā || 2.250.100 || tanmayatvaṃ tatparatvaṃ tadarthatvaṃ tadātmatā | tasya sambandhavat sarvaṃ divyācaraṇameva yat || 101 || snānasandhyādikaṃ daihyaṃ smṛtyārādhanamāntaram | pūjārcādyaṃ sāmayikaṃ satsaṃgādyaṃ tu sārthajam || 102 || sarvaṃ vai pāvanaṃ puṇyaṃ dharmākhyaṃ cātmano hitam | pāpanāśakaraṃ cāpi yāmyadūtanirodhakam || 103 || viṣṇudhāmapradaṃ svargyaṃ śāśvatānandadāyakam | ityuktvā rādhike śrīmān lomaśo virarāma ha || 1 04|| rājā dharme manaḥ kṛtvā punaḥ papraccha vai gurum | lomaśaṃ jñānadaṃ divyātmānaṃ brahmaparāyaṇam || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāmaśvapāṭalakṛtastyāgamārgapratyakṣaphalapraśraḥ, nirāmayapraśraḥ, trivargeṣu kiṃśreṣṭhapraśnaḥ, lomaśakṛtottaraṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 250 ||
<2.251> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike ca tato rājā cāśvapāṭalako gurum | papraccha lomaśaṃ dharmakratuṃ brūhīha kīdṛśam || 1 || lomaśaḥ prāha rājan yat prāṇināṃ drohakṛt bhavet| | tatsarvathā parityājyaṃ dharmakratuḥ sa eva saḥ || 2 || prāṇino duḥkhinaḥ kṛtvā devāstuṣyanti naiva ha | sarve bhavantu sukhino yathā devāstathāvidhāḥ || 3 || vartante’nugrahaparāstasmādadrohakaḥ kratuḥ | ahiṃsā vai dharmamakho hiṃsā yamagṛhaṃ matam || 4 || adrohaḥ sarvajantūnāṃ yajñaḥ satāṃ svabhāvajaḥ | snehavṛttyopakāro vai dharmayajño’sti bhūtale || 5 || aśvapāṭala uvāca ātmā śuddho’sti cet kena pāpātmā jāyate hi saḥ | kathaṃ dharmabhṛdātmā ca kathaṃ rāgaṃ pramuñcati || 6 || kathaṃ muktiṃ prayātyeva kutra vāsaṃ karoti ca | kīdṛśaṃ vartanaṃ tatra yasmānnāvartate punaḥ || 7 || śrīlomaśa uvāca saccidānandarūpo’yaṃ cātmā māyāvivarjitaḥ | ahaṃmamatvahīnaśca saṃgāt tadvān bhavatyapi || 8 || saṃgo māyāprasaṃgaśca sānnidhyaṃ cāntare sadā | tenākṛṣṭo bhavatyeva pāpātmā doṣasaṃbhṛtaḥ || 9 || jñānābhāve ca māyāyāḥ saṃgaṃ vai labhate yatiḥ | jñānena saṃgadoṣāśca naśyantyeva vivekinaḥ || 2.251.1 0|| jñātvā jñātvā viṣayām̐stu cecchā tatra pravartate | tadāptyarthaṃ pravṛttiśca nivṛttirvā prajāyate || 11 || rāgaḥ pravartakastatreṣṭatājñānena jāyate | dveṣo nivartakaścāpyaniṣṭatābodhanād bhavet| || 12|| yadarthaṃ yatate tatrārabhate karma dehajam | aindriyikaṃ ca vābhyāsaṃ tena karoti dehabhāk || 1 3|| rāgādyāḥ sudṛḍhāstena doṣā bhavanti duḥkhadāḥ | lobho mohaḥ prajāyete dharmasthitivināśakau || 14|| vyājena jāyate dharmo vyājataścarati vṛṣam | vṛṣavad rocate’rtha vyājenaiva dhanaistataḥ || 15|| kurute dehavānajñaḥ pāpaṃ parātmaduḥkhakṛt | vardhate’syādharmasargaścintanāt kāraṇāttataḥ || 16|| ekaśīlā militvaiva vardhayanti ca pāpakam | pāpavṛddhāvaśāntiścodvejanaṃ vighnadarśanam || 17|| kalaho rogayogaśca dhananāśo daridratā | jananāśo’vamānaṃ cāyaśaścāgaṇanā jane || 18|| cauryaṃ tenānṛtavādaḥ kāpaṭyaṃ chaladharmitā | pravartante’bhayāḥ sarve pāpātmasu prakarṣataḥ || 1 9|| na te sukhinaścātra kuta eva paratra tu | punaryāmyagatiścāpi tiryagyoniḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||2.251.20 || atha dharmabhṛtāṃ mārgaṃ śṛṇu rājan sukhapradam | pūrvapūrvānupuṇyena sārthasaṃgena vā janaḥ ||21 || satsaṃgena sadā dehī śubhaṃ sarvaṃ pravāñcchati | kuśalaṃ prakarotyeva satyaṃ vadati nānṛtam || 22|| satyaṃ vicintayatyeba satyaṃ karoti sādhanam | satyena vartate nityaṃ rāgaṃ dveṣaṃ na vindati ||23 || vijñavṛttyā hitaṃ svasya parasyāpi karoti ca | lobhaṃ mohaṃ vihāyaiva pravartate śubhāya vai || 24|| kuśalenaiva dharmeṇa dehayātrāṃ karoti ca | dānena sevayā saṃkīrtanena bhajanena ca || 25|| yajñena mālayā devapūjayā tapasā tathā | satsaṃgavṛddhyā nityaṃ ca vindati dharmamuttamam || 26|| vṛddhānāṃ sevayā lokasevayā vardhate vṛṣaḥ | doṣān vijñāya sarvān sa tyajatyeva ca dūrataḥ ||27|| guṇān vijñāya gṛhṇāti guṇeṣu ramate sadā | satsaṃgasārthamāsādya vardhayatyeva sadvṛṣam ||28|| sādhūn prasevate nityaṃ sādhudharmān prasevate | sādhvācārābhyāsavaśād vardhante’sya vṛṣāḥ sadā ||29|| prajñā vṛṣe sthirā cāsya nānyatra ramate kvacit | dharmapravṛttimān dehī dhanārthaṃ yatate’pi ca ||2.251.3 0|| dharmadhanaṃ samavāpya dharme vyayaṃ karoti ca | dharmamitrāṇi jāyante dharmiṇo vai svabhāvataḥ ||3 1 || dharmātmā dharmaśīlaśca dharmasatsaṃgaśobhitaḥ | dharmajanyaṃ sukhaṃ cātra labhate’pi paratra ca ||32|| svarge svargapare loke prabhutvaṃ labhate tathā | śabde sparśe rase rūpe gandhe bhoge prabhutvakam ||33|| evaṃ dharmaphalaṃ labdhvā modate nispṛho yathā | jñānadṛṣṭyā ca nirvedaṃ poṣayatyeva mānase || 34|| bhogeṣu satsvapi vidvān naiva badhnāti tatra hi | abhāvayatastasyaiva mano vairāgyavegavat || 35|| na kāmānanusañcāraṃ karotyasya kadācana | dharmaṃ naiva jahātyeva kaṣṭe cāpadi vaiśase || 36 || lokaṃ kṣayātmaka dṛṣṭvā dharme’pi rāgahīnatām | prāpyātmano muktimārgaṃ mārgayatyeva yatnavān ||37|| yatate cānvahaṃ mokṣābhyāse hyupāyamāśrayan | śanaiḥ śanaiśca sopānaṃ mokṣasya labhate tataḥ ||38|| pāpmānaṃ sarvamevāyaṃ karotyeva na vai kvacit| | jahātyeva samāyātaṃ pāpaṃ śuddhiṃ pravindati || 39|| vimalātmā ca santoṣī devāśrayaparāyaṇaḥ | vyarthavārtādirahito mokṣaṃ vai labhate param ||2.251.40 || vaikuṇṭhe cāpi goloke’kṣare dhāmni pare ca vā | yathopāstiṃ prayātyeva mokṣasthalaṃ parātparam ||41 || tatra brahmahade snātvā brahmatanuḥ hariryathā | sampadyate surūpeṇa divyarūpeṇa tādṛśaḥ ||42|| jakṣan krīḍan ramamāṇaścāste’śnute’khilepsitam | ekadhā vahudhā cāpi bhavatyeva yathepsitam |||43 || sarvarasaḥ sarvagandhaḥ sarvānandaḥ prajāyate | sarvasukhaḥ sarvarūpaḥ sarvasiddhiguṇāśrayaḥ ||44|| parabrahmasvarūpaśca tatsāmarthyasamanvitaḥ | tatsevātatparo muktaḥ prajāyate’timodanaḥ ||45|| brahmamūrtermahat saukhyaṃ pravāhaiḥ sa sametyapi | karāgre sarvasṛṣṭīśca prapaśyatyeva muktarāṭ |||46|| sārvajñyaṃ jāyate cāsyeśvaratvaṃ saṃprajāyate | nātra vānyatra loke’syāvartanaṃ jāyate kvacit ||47|| yatra yatra prayātyeva tatra dhāmākṣaraṃ puraḥ | prakāśate’sya nānyadvai divyanetrasya sarvathā ||48|| kriyā divyā bhavatyasya māyāsya saṃgato’pi ca | divyaiva jāyate tūrṇaṃ tattvādīnāṃ tu kā kathā ||49|| mānave suraloke vai paitṛke cārṣake’pi vā | aiśvare vāvatārabhyāṃ divyo mukto’yameva ha ||2.251.50|| yatra kvāpi vased vāpi yatra kvāpi caredapi | sarvaṃ divyaṃ karotyeva mokṣaṃ dadāti dehine || 51 || asyaiva darśanānmuktāḥ sparśanādapi mokṣiṇaḥ | saṃgāt prasevayā muktā jāyante
