strīnarādayaḥ ||52|| yathā dhāmni tathā sṛṣṭau dehe vā muktasaṃsthitau | sarvaṃ samaṃ bhavedasya bhinnatā nāsya vartane |||53|| evaṃ prāptāṃ gatiṃ nityāṃ sukhinīṃ modinīṃ satīm | ānandinīṃ priyāṃ mukto’nubhavatyeva sarvadā ||54|| rājam̐stvaṃ dharmamārgaṃ vai sādhūnāmavalambya ca | gatiṃ labhasva vai proktāṃ kimanyena vināśinā ||55|| vijñānaṃ sārathiṃ kṛtvā bhaktiṃ kṛtvā sahāyinīm | dharmaṃ cāgragatiṃ kṛtvā yāhi brahma sanātanam ||56|| aśvapāṭala uvāca kathaṃ doṣavināśaḥ syād yena dharmagatirbhavet | vijñāpaya maharṣe tvaṃ yena śreyo hi dehinaḥ ||57|| śrīlomaśa uvāca jayet krodhaṃ kṣamayaiva vicāreṇa punaḥ punaḥ | jayet kāmaṃ hyanābhogāt saṃkalpasaṃgavarjanāt || 58|| svapnaṃ jayecca tapasānāhāreṇa ca sattvataḥ | bhayaṃ jayettadutthānaparityāgād vivekataḥ ||5 9 || ātmaśīlābhyasanācca mṛtyubhītiṃ sadā tyajet| | dhairyeṇa kāmanāmicchāṃ dveṣaṃ jayet kaliṃ tathā ||2.251.6 0 || bhrāntiṃ mohaṃ mamakāra bhedajñānānnivartayet | yāthārthyajñānalābhena viparyadādikaṃ tyajet ||6 1 || upadravān jayet sarvān kauśalyena vidhānataḥ | rogān jayet hetujayāt pathyajīrṇamitāśanāt ||6 2|| lobhaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ vivekādvā santoṣāt prajayedapi | viṣayān viṣabodhādvā tattvadṛṣṭyā jayedapi ||6 3 || adharmaṃ cātmakṛpayā jayedanarthabhāvataḥ | dharmaṃ pālanabuddhyā ca jayenmokṣapradaṃ caret ||6 4|| āśāṃ jayennirutthānād bhāviphalguvidhānataḥ | arthaṃ cānarthabuddhyā ca jayet saṃgavivarjanāt ||65 || snehaṃ cānityadṛṣṭyā ca bandhanādivivekataḥ | kṣudhāṃ jayed yātrayā ca yogenāvaśyakena ca ||66|| mānaṃ jayedanāvṛttyā kāruṇyena vivekataḥ | santoṣācca jayed gṛdhnā vivekajñānatastathā ||67|| tandrāṃ jayet svasthabhāvādutthānācca balādapi | saṃśayaṃ śāstravacanācca nirṇayāt prajayet sadā ||68|| vāgdoṣān munibhāvena manodoṣām̐śca vidyayā | pāvitryeṇa jayeccāpi kalmaṣaṃ tāmasaṃ sadā ||69|| jñānadṛṣṭyā tamaścāpi jayedajñānasaṃjñitam | ātmabodhena ca jñānaṃ mānasaṃ prajayed yatiḥ ||2.251.70|| ātmānaṃ ca jayetparameśe samarpaṇena tu | tadarpaṇāt sarvadoṣā śiṣṭā naśyanti drāk khalu ||71 || tadā vivardhate tejo brahmalokaprakāśakam | siddhayaścodbhavantyasya vijñānaṃ sampravardhate ||72|| satāmācāramāptaḥ san vartamānaḥ satāśraye | svecchayaiva ninīṣet sa brahmākṣaraṃ paraṃ padam ||73|| eṣa mārgo vimuktervai rājan śubhāśrayaḥ sadā | yatra vighnā na jāyante nirvighnasya hareḥ śrayāt ||74|| divyendriyakriyāhāro divyasadguṇavartanaḥ | divyakṛṣṇe kṛtasthāno yāti brahma sanātanam ||75|| saṃghāte saṃsthiteścāpi mukto naiva hi tapyate | baddho hi tapyate tasya sambandhāstāpadāyinaḥ ||76 || nātmāsti kasyacit kaścinnāsya kaścana vidyate | kathaṃ gṛhṇātyayaṃ duḥkhaṃ parotpannaṃ nijātmani ||77|| naiva sañjāyate cātmā nāpi vipadyate kvacit | muktvā dehaṃ prāpya kṛṣṇaṃ prayāti paramāṃ gatim ||78|| puṇyapāpamayo dehaḥ karmakṣayena naśyati | tato dehī pramuktaḥ san brahmatvamupagacchati ||79|| puṇyapāpakṣayārthaṃ hi kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ vidhīyate | tathā nairguṇyamāsādya yāti brahmaparāṃ gatim ||2.251.80|| arthāḥ smṛddhibharāścāpi bāḍhaṃ duḥkhabharā yataḥ | svādalālāvagūḍhāste mohayantyavicakṣaṇam ||8 1 || sarvendriyasukhaṃ divyaṃ vitṛṣṇasya tu kalmaṣam | satṛṣṇena mamatvena kalpitaṃ svārthapūrtikam ||82|| tadeva paritāpāya nāśe sampadyate’dhikam | tasmāt tāpakaraṃ pūrvaṃ tāpaṃ matvā na cārjayet ||83|| kṛtakṛtyaḥ sadā matvā bhūtvāpyevaṃ na saṃjvaret | iṣṭāniṣṭāvubhau tyaktvā pareśe sarvamarpayet ||84|| prāṇāntikaṃ paraṃ rogaṃ tṛṣṇātmakaṃ parityajet | apūryamāṇaṃ pātālaṃ tṛṣṇātmakaṃ ca cāviśet ||85|| śīlaṃ santoṣamevāpi śāntiṃ bhaktiṃ kṣamāṃ matim | sevāṃ samarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā brahmadhāma samāviśet ||86 || paśyan mṛtyuṃ śikhāvāsaṃ kālaṃ ca prāṇavāsinam | karma cātmakṛtāvāsaṃ brahmavāsaṃ samarjayet ||87|| ahorātrāṇi yāntyeva yātrā bhavati khaṇḍitā | rātryāṃ rātryāṃ vyatītāyāmāyurvindati hasvatām ||88|| puṣpavad dehinaṃ mṛtyurnayatyapūrṇakāminam | ātmakāryaṃ tu prathamaṃ kurvīta daihikaṃ tataḥ ||89|| dehasambandhajaṃ paścād yena na syāt pratāritaḥ | akṛteṣvapi kāryeṣu mṛtyurādāya gacchati ||2.251.90 || nahi kaścid vijānāti kadā mṛtyurbhaviṣyati | suptaṃ vā jāgrataṃ svasthaṃ mṛtyurādāya gacchati ||9 1 || kurvantaṃ bahusaṃkalpān putrasmṛddhipaśusthitim | anyavyāsaktahṛdayaṃ mṛtyurādāya gacchati ||92|| na mṛtyupṛtanāṃ kaścinnivartayitumudbalaḥ | brahmabalo bhaktibalo mṛtyuṃ dūrayituṃ kṣamaḥ || 93|| brahmavidyāprakāśāḍhyaḥ satsaṃgayānavāhanaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇasārathiṃ prāpto mṛtyuṃ tīrtvākṣaraṃ vrajet ||94|| mā mohaṃ vraja rājendra kṛte puṇye kathaṃcana | svarge ca gatvarasaṃjñe sannaddho bhava keśave ||95|| keśavaḥ kālakālo’sti mṛtyormṛtyuḥ pareśvaraḥ | sarvakarmaphalajyoṣṭā tasmin kāryaṃ samarpaya || 96 || nirbhīko bhava rājendra bhayaṃ kośo hi karmaṇām | muñca nārāyaṇe deve vikośo bhava pārthiva ||97|| gṛhṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādaṃ hi nirbhayam | kāṃbhareyapade sthitvā śāśvatānandabhāg bhava ||98|| ityuktvā rādhike tatra lomaśo virarāma ha | rājāśvapāṭalaḥ śāntiṃ cāvāpa pārabheśvarīm ||99|| bahu matvāmṛtaṃ śrīmallomaśānanavāhitam | tṛpto’pi ca punastṛptiṃ nādhijagāma bhaktarāṭ || 2.251.100 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāmaśvapāṭalakṛtānām ātmanaḥ pāpātmakatve puṇyātmakatve muktibhāve doṣavināśabhāve ca praśnānāṃ śrīlomaśakṛtottaradānamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 251 ||
<2.252> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca athāpi rādhike devi rājāśvapāṭalastataḥ | punarbhāgavatān dharmān papracchātṛptamānasaḥ || 1 || aśvapāṭala uvāca kiṃ vrataḥ kīdṛśācāraḥ kiṃ bodhaḥ kiṃ samāśrayaḥ | akṣarākhyaṃ harerdhāma prayāti parataḥ param || || śrīlomaśa uvāca bhaktivrataḥ sadācāro brahmātmabodhavān śuciḥ | parabrahmāśrayo yāti dhāmākṣaraṃ parātparam || 3 || gṛhe gṛhe vasan śāntaḥ svārthānarthau vihāya ca | anutthitanavehaśca nirapekṣo’kṣaraṃ vrajet || 4 || na doṣaṃ vivṛṇuyācca sākṣātparokṣameva vā | kalpayennāntare cāpi nirdoṣako’kṣar vrajet| || 6 || adrohaḥ sarvabhūtānāmānandado bhavatyapi | jīvanaṃ cājātaśatru kurvaṃstadakṣaraṃ vrajet || 6 || vādatarkānna kuryācca nābhimānaṃ vivardhayet | priyaṃ ca kuśalaṃ kuryāt so’kṣaraṃ dhāma saṃvrajet || || prāṇayātrikamātraḥ san viśeṣaṃ cārjayenna ca | pūjito harṣayennaiva snigdhe snigdho na vai bhavet || 8 || nānnaṃ nindenna vānyaṃ ca naraṃ nārīṃ pranindayet | vṛkṣamūlamaraṇyaṃ vā guhāṃ vaset smaran harim || 9 || ajñātacaryo vicaret nānurundhyāttu dehinam | sadā tṛptaśca santoṣī prasannamānasānanaḥ || 2.252.1 0|| japan kṛṣṇaṃ rāgahīno nispṛhaḥ samadṛṣṭimān | parātmanātmānandaśca sarvavegapraśāntakaḥ || 11 || madhyastha iva tiṣṭham̐śca sarvodāsīnavartanaḥ | parabrahmakṛtamaitryaḥ prayātyakṣaradhāma saḥ || 12 || aśvapāṭala uvāca kadā sanyāsamāśritya gantavyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ padam kadā vā gṛhadharmāddhi yāyāt tadbrahmaṇaḥ padam || 13 || śrīlomaśa uvāca putrapautrādi saṃvīkṣya nivṛttiṃ cābhivīkṣya ca | abādhitasvabhāvaṃ cābhyasyāśritya ca sādhutām || 14|| bhaktiṃ kṛtvā vihāyātra varṣma gantavyamakṣaram | udyogino hi sānnidhye muktiścāyāti durlabhā || 15|. kārtike mārgaśīrṣe vā māghe caitre’pyāṣāḍhake | śrāvaṇe saṃpragṛhṇīyāt sanyāsaṃ sādhutānvitam || 16|| yadā nivarteta jagatastadā pravrajettatsthalāt | prajñayā ca tamaḥ sarvaṃ nirasya śrīharerbalāt || 17|| brahmaprakāśamāsādya yāyāt kṛṣṇākṣaragṛham | ayatnasādhyaṃ muktānāmanyeṣāṃ yatnagocaram || 18|| yatnena ceyate svargaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ padaṃ tathā | yatnena karmaṇā tacca mataṃ naṣṭaṃ bhavatyapi || 19|| tapasā labhyate bhūyastapasā bhujyate divam | tapasātmajuṣā dhāmākṣaraṃ cāpi pralabhyate ||2.252.2 0|| dharmeṇa sāttvatenaiva harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | prāpyate puruṣo’nanto’nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||21 || viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svarṇakeśaḥ hiraṇyaśmaśruracyutaḥ | vaikuṇṭhagolokavāso brahmapriyāpriyo vibhuḥ ||22|| tasmin sthitaṃ jagatsarvaṃ jaḍacaityaṃ carācaram | sūkṣmaṃ sarvaṃ brahmajuṣṭaṃ sthaulyaṃ prāpya prajāyate ||23 || puṣṭimeti tataścaiva tasminnapyeti sarvaśaḥ | sa eṣo bhagavān prāpyo bhaktyā ca saṃyamena ca ||24|| tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ prājño nirmalo brahmaniṣṭhakaḥ | brāhmīṃ sthitiṃ vaśīkṛtya sukhānantyaṃ samaśnute ||25|| svarṇaṃ vahnisahasrārciryojitaṃ dhmāyitaṃ muhuḥ | śuddhaṃ sampadyate cātmā jñānabhaktyādiyojitaḥ ||26 || janmāntaraśatenāpi vaikena janmanāpi vā | yatnena mahatā cātmā kalmaṣo’pi viśuddhyati || 27|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ śriyāḥ patiḥ | kṛpayā bhaktiyoge na sannidhiṃ bhajate’sya ca | |28|| akṣare vā kṣare loke yathā tadvad bhavadgṛhe | samāyāti ca ramate’nugrahapreritaḥ svayam ||29|| brahmaloko’sya mūrdhāstīśvaralokā hṛdādikam | jīvalokāścaraṇau ca tredhā sṛṣṭirvyavasthitā || 2.252.30 || karmaṇāṃ tapasāṃ vāpi jñānānāṃ vividhātmanām | sevānāṃ cākarmaṇāṃ ca phalaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 31 || aṇḍāni yasya romāṃśe pārameṣṭhyadhikānyapi | vedāḥ sarasvatī cāpi jihvā yasyāsti sṛṣṭiṣu || 3 2|| dharmo bhaktirbrahmaparau brahma yaddhṛdaye sthitam | tatra sthitaśca yo devo divyaḥ saḥ parameśvaraḥ ||3 3|| mantrāḥ pravartanā devāḥ pātrāṇi ca tadātmakāḥ | brahmā ca brāhmaṇācchaṃsī potāgnīdhro yadātmakāḥ ||34|| hotācchāvākako grāvaḥ stotā hyete yadātmakāḥ | adhvaryuḥ pratiprasthātā neṣṭonnetā madātmakāḥ ||35|| udgātā prastotā pratihartā subrahmaṇya ime | yadātmakāḥ kraturyadātmakaḥ sa parameśvaraḥ ||36|| muktā akṣaralokaśca golokaśca yadātmakāḥ | vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ cāvyākṛtaṃ ca badarīvanam ||37|| kṣīrālayaṃ śvetabhūmiryadātmakāḥ sa mādhavaḥ | rādhā kṛṣṇastathā lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ sitāramaḥ ||38|| ramākāntaḥ padmajeśa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sa hi | vāsudevādayo vyūhā avatāraprakoṭayaḥ ||39|| bhūmādyā īśvarāścāpi vairājādyāḥ pradhānajāḥ | brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca rudrā yadātmakā hi saḥ ||2.252.40|| ṛṣayaḥ pitaraścāpi vasavaḥ siddhasādhavaḥ | ādityāścāśvinau sūryādayo yadātmakā hi saḥ ||41 || dikpālā lokapālāśca surāśca mānavādayaḥ | sarvaṃ tadātmakaṃ rājan pṛthak cāpṛthageva tat ||42||| jñānena mahatā paśyan brahmaprakāśavān bhavet | brāhmaprakāśatejasvī paśyatyeva pareśvaram |||43|| sarvān svargān vijānāti sākṣāt karoti cāṃjasā | tattaddṛṣṭipratāpena pareśvarānubhāvitaḥ ||44|| aśvapāṭala uvāca tattatsṛṣṭau tu ke sargā anityā nityakāśca vā | yān sa paśyati muktātmā tānme vada guro nviha ||45|| śrīlomaśa uvāca brahmasṛṣṭau bhavantyeva pañcadhā brahmarūpaṇāḥ | parabrahma, brahmapriyāḥ, akṣarabrahma ityapi ||46|| muktā muktānya eveti pañcarūpaḥ sa eva saḥ | īśasṛṣṭau bhavantyeva sadvā daśavidhastathā ||47|| avatārā avatāriṇyaśca vyūhāḥ pradhānakam | bhūmānaśca mahāviṣṇavaśca vairājakoṭayaḥ ||48|| sādāśaivā gavādyāśca pārṣadāṇyaśca pārṣadāḥ | gopā gopyaśca rūpāṇi dvādaśaitāni cāpi saḥ ||49|| jīvasṛṣṭau daśadhā ca sargaścetanasaṃbhṛtaḥ | tridevāḥ siddhapuruṣāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitaraḥ surāḥ ||2.252.50|| āsurā mānavāścāpi tiryañcaḥ kīṭajātayaḥ | sthāvarāśceti mukhyāste tatrāvāntarajātayaḥ ||51 || asaṃkhyātāḥ prajāyante tridevecchānusārataḥ | saptaviṃśakalpa evāyaṃ mukhyo gauṇāstvanantakāḥ ||52|| sthāvarāṇāṃ ca kīṭānāṃ tiraścāṃ śubhayogataḥ | puṇyakṣetranivāsena tīrthayogena vā punaḥ ||53 || satāṃ deveśvarāṇāṃ vā yogena mānavī januḥ | āsurāṇāṃ kṛṣṇayogāt siddhayogācca mānavī ||54|| tatra dharmādilābhena daivī vai jāyate gatiḥ | ṣaṇṇāṃ bhaktyā ca vā puṇyaiḥ paitrī gatiḥ prajāyate ||55|| śrāddhadānamahāpuṇyairārṣīgatistataḥ parā | yogābhyāsavaśāsiddhagatistataḥ parā śubhā ||56|| teṣāṃ yogajalabhyopāsanotthā brāhmavaiṣṇavī | śāṃbhavī vā gatisteṣāṃ sattvaprakarṣalābhajā ||57|| gatirvairājikī teṣāmupāstisamviśeṣataḥ | jāyate ca gatirmahāvaiṣṇavī cāthavāparā ||58|| sādāśaivī gatiścāpi tataścaupāsanābalāt | bhūmnikā ca gatiścāpi prādhānapauruṣī tataḥ ||59|| vyūhātmikā tataścāpyadhikopāsanayā gatiḥ | gopagopīmayī cāpi pārṣadādimayī tathā ||2.252.6 0 || avatāriṇī ca gatistathā muktasvarūpiṇī | avatārasvarūpā ca muktānikāsvarūpiṇī ||6 1 || brāhmī brahmapriyārūpā gatiścāpi prajāyate | ākṣarī ca gatiścāpi hareścopāsanābalāt ||62|| jāyate brahmaparyantā paravrahma na jāyate | sa evaikaḥ paramātmā sarvāntaryāmimāpatiḥ ||6 3 || parabrahmāvatārī ca parameśvarasaṃjñakaḥ | nārāyaṇaprakoṭīnāṃ nārāyaṇottamottamaḥ ||64 || aśvapāla yadā dehī cādharmaṃ śrayati tviha | tadā tiryakkīṭayoniṃ yāti sthāvaratāmapi ||65|| āsurīṃ vā mānavīṃ vā nikṛṣṭāṃ janumeti ca | tato yāmyāṃ bhuvaṃ prāpya yathāvaśeṣameti hi ||66|| aśubhaṃ vā śubhaṃ janma dharmakṛccirakālikaḥ | mucyata na tu cādharmamārgī kvacid viyonitaḥ ||67|| śuddhena tu hṛdā kṛṣṇaṃ vicinvan brahmabhāvanaḥ | śuddhaṃ ca śāśvataṃ brahmākṣaraṃ copaiti yatparam ||68|| sarvā sṛṣṭirharerlokāt pravartate viśatyapi | tameva bhaja cāntaḥsthaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kṛṣṇavallabham ||69|| sṛjorṇanābhivat sūtraṃ granthasva yāvadarthakam | punarnigila kāryānte nirbandho bhava jālake ||2.252.7 0 || yadā tyaktvā mohajālaṃ punarnavaṃ prakāśaya | tyaktvā dharmyaṃ cānyadeva vikāśaya sukhapradam ||7 1 || jālaṃ jālanidhānaṃ vobhayaṃ tyaktvā sukhī bhava | śāśvate brahmaṇi kṣmeśa bhuñjānantapramodanam ||72||| granthayo hṛdayasyeha bhavanti vāsanāśritāḥ | pradhvastā brahmavijñaptyā punarnavā na santi ca ||7 3 || granthibandhanahīnaśca prayāti brahma śāśvatam | naiva tāmyanti santo vai vijñānino hariṃ śritāḥ ||74|| tāmyatyevormibhirlokā mohāśādisamanvitāḥ | ye jānanti ca bhūtaṃ ca bhaviṣyad bhavyamityapi ||75 || upakramaṃ ca saṃhāraṃ phalodayaṃ samāsamam | teṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ ca vodvego jāyate na vijānatam ||76 || karmaṇāṃ gatayo bhinnā dhanāḍhyā dhanavarjitāḥ | sudṛḍhadehāścāpathyarugṇā vā cānnavarjitāḥ ||77 || daridrā vā bahuputrāḥ satī ca duṣṭakāntakā | aputrā vāpi rājāno devā daityādipīḍitāḥ ||78 || vidvāṃso mānahīnā vā bhṛtyāścālasyasevakāḥ | surūpā api durhṛdaḥ khyātāśca stenakarmiṇaḥ ||79 || rājyabhogāśca satṛṣṇāḥ paśya saṃsāranimnatām | sahasriṇo’pi jīvanti jīvanti śatino’pi ca ||2.252.8 0 || daridrāḥ koṭipatayo jīvanti cānnabhojinaḥ | sarve prayānti nidhanaṃ sāyāsā niṣprayatnakāḥ ||8 1 || tadvicārya mahārāja bandhanaṃ māvamarśaya | na bāndhavāḥ suvarṇādi kaulyaṃ vīryaṃ manurbalam |||82 || duḥkhāt trātuṃ prabhavanti tasmānnārāyaṇaṃ śrayet | priyaṃ yaddharṣajananaṃ garvadaṃ tat tyajet sadā ||83 || brahmadaṃ mokṣadaṃ śāntipradaṃ priyaṃ bhajet sadā | arthakāmau mahābandhau dharmamokṣanivartakau ||84|| tāveva mādhave nyastau dharmamokṣakarau matau | evaṃ ca vartato naiva mṛtyuḥ kālo’pi bādhate ||85|| aśvapāṭala uvāca tattvajñānavihīnasya bahusaṃśayaśālinaḥ | aprāptanirṇayasyeha śreyo yena vadātra tat ||86 || śrīlomaśa uvācasādhūnāṃ ca gurūṇāṃ ca vṛddhānāṃ sevanaṃ sadā | devānāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi śāstrāṇāṃ śravaṇaṃ tathā ||87|| kartavyaṃ bhāvato nityaṃ mātāpitṛprasevanam | patisevā satīsevā pūjyāśīrvādasaṃgrahaḥ ||88|| harerbhajanamityeva śreyaḥpradāni santi vai | paraṃ naiḥśreyasaṃ bhaktyā pareśasya prajāyate ||89|| gauṇānyapi ca jāyante śreyāṃsi śubhasādhanaiḥ | satāṃ śubhāśiṣo nityaṃ dānapuṇyasvabhāvitā ||2.252.90 || devamandiravāsaśca śreyo naiḥśreyasapradam | sarvatra brahmabhāvaśca sarvasevāvidhānakam ||9 1 || devapitratithibhṛtyārhaṇā śreyastathāvidham | māyābhramavihīnatvaṃ santoṣaśceṣaṇālayaḥ ||92|| antarātmakṛtāvāsaḥ śreyo naiḥśreyasapradam | ātmadhyānaṃ tathā mokṣasādhanādivratārjanam ||93 || jñānadhanaṃ cātmaniṣṭhā śreyo naiḥśreyasapradam | sarveṣāṃ śubhamicchedvai sarvotkarṣaṃ samācaret ||94|| anyeṣāṃ śubhabhāvādīnatyutkarṣatayā vadet | anyebhyo mānamutsāhaṃ dadyāt pūjāṃ samācaret ||951|| asvapūjāparaścāpi parapūjyavicāravān | prajñālābhaparaścāpi śreyo vindati sarvadā || 96 || sādhuṣu vāsamicchecca vidvatsu mārjavaṃ bhajet| | puṇyaśīleṣu maitrīṃ ca kuryānniḥśreyasapradām || 97|| śreyohīnā janā yatra tatra vāsaṃ na rocayet | svāhāsvadhāvaṣaṭkārā vartante tatra vai vaset ||98|| yatra sukhaṃ mokṣasukhaṃ vasenmokṣāya tatra ha | muktā bandhanahīnāśca caranti sukhino janāḥ ||99|| saṃcaye dattayatnāśca kīṭādyā api bhūpate | asaktāḥ sukhinaścaite saktā duḥkhārṇavārditāḥ || 2.252.10 0|| svajaneṣu na vai cintā kartavyā madvinā katham | jīveyuriti viduṣā śreyo’rthinā vivekinā || 101 || sarve karmavaśaṃ tiṣṭhennidhanaṃ yāti karmataḥ | melanaṃ viprakarṣaśca yathākarma bhavatyapi || 10 2|| maraṇaṃ sarvathā satyaṃ śreyo’rthaṃ maraṇaṃ śubham | śreyāṃsi bahudhā kṛtvā maraṇaṃ maraṇāya tat || 1 03|| parārthe kṛtadurgaśca svārthe khātaṃ prasevate | na tasyeha bhavecchreyaḥ kathaṃ naiḥśreyasaṃ param || 1 04|| tasmād rājan pramādaṃ vai tyaktvā naiḥśreyasaṃ bhaja | divase divase kṛṣṇaṃ rātrau rātrau hariṃ bhaja || 1 05|| ātmabhāvaṃ brahmabhāvaṃ paśya mukto’tra saṃbhava | yasya loke na vai sthātuṃ samīhā vartate’gragā || 106 || prāṇayātrauṣadhāpekṣā vihārodāsatā tathā | vicittasyeva viṣayāḥ sa vai mukto’tra niścitaḥ || 1 07|| annavastrālayādyāśca yasya jīrṇatvaco yathā | janarddhisaṃgamo yasya marmabhedāyate’pi ca || 1 08|| indriyāṇāṃ sauṣṭhave’pi yasya nirindriyātmatā | bhojyabhogyādisampattau vipattivad vivekitā || 1 09|| so’yaṃ muktaḥ sadā cātra paratrāpi ca bhūpate | tadyogādanyalokānāṃ muktatāpi bhavet khalu || 2.252.110 || ṛṣīnnṛpān susamrājo bhuktvā bhuvaṃ gatā mṛtim | evaṃ paśyan bhavenmukto bandhanāśāvivarjitaḥ || 119 || duḥkhāni sulabhānyatra sukhāni durlabhāni ca | yatnalabdhāni naśyanti kathaṃ mokṣaṃ na pūjayet || 1 12|| sati dravye’bhitaḥ sarve śaṃsamānā aho iti | bhrātaḥ pitaḥ śubhāṃ vācaṃ vadanto’bhyarcayanti ca || 12 || svārthamātraparāste vai gate dravye virodhinaḥ | dāridrye vā na jānanti kva bhrātā kva pitā ca vā || 1 14|| kathaṃ buddhvā svārthaparān na virajyeta buddhimān | asāramiva mānuṣyaṃ niṣphalaṃ cāpi jīvanam || 1 15|| tasmād bhagavato dharmaḥ śreyānatra paratra ca | satāṃ dharmo’pi bhaktiśca naiḥśreyasapradāḥ sadā || 1 16|| ityevaṃ rādhike śrīmān lomaśaścāśvapāṭalam | upādideśa bahudhā rājā papraccha taṃ punaḥ || 1 17|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāmaśvapāṭalasyākṣaragatisādhanapraśnaḥ, sanyāsād gārhasthyādvā gatipraśnaḥ, sṛṣṭitrayasargapraśnaḥ, śreyaḥpraśnaḥ, lomaśakṛtottarāṇi cetinirūpaṇanāmā dvipañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 252 ||
<2.253> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike’śvapāṭalaśca śratvā naiḥśreyasaṃ param | lomaśaṃ paripapraccha punaścātmavimokṣaṇam || 1 || aśvapaṭṭala uvāca vada me’tra punaḥ śreya ihāmutra sukhāvaham | kartavyārthena nirvartyaṃ cābhyudayottarottaram || 2 || śrīlomaśa uvāca śakaṭaṃ rathino yāti bahubhāraṃ pravāsinaḥ | dehayātrāpare bhāre tṛptihīnasya bhūtale || 3 || kṣudhātṛṣe dve vṛṣabhau śokamohau ca cakrake | sukhaduḥkhe cāgrapṛṣṭhau vāsanā madhyasaṃsthikā || 4 || rathī svayaṃ ca śakaṭaṃ nītvā yātyadhikāya ha | yātrāmātrātirekeṣu lubdho’nuvindatīha ṣaṭ || 5 || ata eva sadā kliṣṭo nidrāṃ vetti na vāhakaḥ | śakaṭena vahan vastūnyasaṃkhyāni muhurmuhuḥ || 6 || araṇye cendriyacaure luṇṭhito jāyate’vaśaḥ | sukhaśāntyātmakaṃ dravyaṃ caurā haranti sarvaśaḥ || 7 || tasmānna vṛṣabhau rakṣyau rakṣyaṃ na śakaṭaṃ tathā | tattyāge dehayātrāyāṃ sukhaṃ śāntirhi yogivat || 8 || jāyate’sya rathino vai yātrāmātraprayogiṇaḥ | nādhikaṃ cābhivāñchecca vastrānnajalamandiram || 9 || puṇyakāryāṇi kurvīta devakāryāṇi yāni ca | paropakārakāryāṇi prakurvītātmasaṃdṛśā || 2.253.10 || durlabhaṃ mānavaṃ cāyurnaiva kṣipet pragartake | utkarṣābhyudayārthaṃ ca prayateta vimuktaye || 11 || puṇyena karmaṇāpyetotkarṣaścābhyudayastathā | vratayatnābhyāsabhāgyaiḥ satāmāśīrbhireva ca || 12|| akarmāṇi daivatānāṃ munīnāṃ ca satāṃ tathā | mahatāṃ na carettāni tejasvināṃ na dūṣaṇam || 13 || mahatāṃ cāghaṭitāni kutsayenna kadācana | śubhe vidadhyācchāntātmā bhadrāṇyeva sa paśyati || 14|| nṛśaṃsaṃ nārjayetkarma dhanaṃ mānaṃ praśāsanam | tatsarvaṃ yāmyalokasya duḥkhadaṃ bhāvi vai yataḥ || 15|| praśastaṃ cācaret sarvaṃ khyātaṃ dhanyaparāyaṇam | daivaṃ paitryaṃ cātitheyaṃ mānavaṃ pāśavaṃ ca yat || 16|| avyayakarmaṇā yānti siddhiṃ santo maharṣayaḥ | vyayena karmaṇā bhūpāścopāsanena yoginaḥ || 17|| sevayā yoṣitaḥ śūdrā dāsā dāsyena vai tathā | paṇḍitā jñānamārgeṇa kāravaḥ śilpavidyayā || 18|| gavādyā dugdhadānaiśca vṛkṣādyāḥ phaladānakaiḥ | stambāḥ patrapradānena vallikāḥ puṣpadānakaiḥ || 19|| mānavāścopakāreṇa parasparaṃ sahāyinaḥ | siddhiṃ vai yānti paramāṃ muktisiddhiṃ prayānti ca ||2.253.2 0 || hutvāpi havanaṃ vahnau munayo’pi yatavratāḥ | prayānti siddhiṃ paramāmuddiśya śrīnarāyaṇam || 2 1 || patnī cātmā ca mātā ca pitā janayitā sutaḥ | guruḥ putrī ca devāste sevyā yena phalaṃ sukham ||22|| te sarve vahnayaḥ proktāstaddhotraṃ hotrameva tat | teṣāṃ tṛptau haristṛpto bhavatyevāntare sthitaḥ || 23|| tasyāstṛpteḥ phalaṃ cātra sukhaṃ paratra śāśvatam | bhaktyā vā sevayā vāpi dānena ca makhena ca ||24|| tapasā kṛcchrasaṃjñena cānarhāścārhatāṃ gatāḥ | uśanā viśvāmitraśca vālmīkaḥ sadgatiṃ gatāḥ || 25|| uśanāstapasā śaṃbhoḥ śukratvaṃ prāpya vai tataḥ | śukrācāryo daityaguruḥ svarge sadā hyajāyata || 26 || kṣatriyo viśvāmitraśca brahmarṣitvamavāpa ha | vālmīkiḥ śabaraścāpi sadā mukto babhūva ha ||27|| śuśrūṣayā striyaḥ śūdrā gatiṃ yānti parāṃ śubhām | satāṃ saṃgaḥ sadā bhāgyodayapradaḥ supuṇyadaḥ |||28|| sannikarṣeṇa ca sataḥ sādhurvai jāyate janaḥ | satyaśramopārjitā ca kapardikāpi saukhyadā ||29|| anyāyopārjitaṃ svarṇaṃ duḥkhadaṃ nigaḍapradam | anyāyopārjitaṃ cānnaṃ rogāya vamanāya ca | |2.253.3 0|| anyāyopārjitaṃ kṣetraṃ vahnaye narakāya ca | anyāyopārjitā nārī mṛtyave cāpyakīrtaye ||3 1 || anyāyopārjitā sampanmūlanāśāya jāyate | brahmāsṛjat purā putraṃ dharma prajāsukhāya vai ||3 2|| sarve varṇāḥ svadharmasthāḥ svargasthāḥ sukhino hi te | teṣāṃ muktyarthamatha ca dharmo’sṛjannijāṃgataḥ ||3 3 || bhaktiṃ yathā janā yānti svargaṃ harerhi śāśvatam | tābhyāṃ svargaṃ ciraṃ cāpi śāśvataṃ ca tato milet ||34|| evaṃ prayatnaṃ kurvīta svargadvayajayo bhavet | yadā vyapetahṛllekhaṃ karmāsaṃgaṃ prajāyate ||35|| hṛtsthāntaryāmiṇaṃ śritvā kalyāṇamarjayecchuciḥ | prāyeṇa rājan sādhūnāṃ tyāgināṃ ca virāgiṇām ||36|| prajñābalena bhaktyā vā bandhanaṃ na dṛḍhaṃ bhavet | śaithilyaṃ cāpyate jñānād vivekācchāstraśīlanāt ||37|| gṛhasthānāṃ jaḍānāṃ vā bandhanaṃ dṛḍhatāṃ vrajet | gṛhāṇyāśritya gāścāpi kṣetrāṇyapi dhanāni ca ||38|| dārān putrām̐śca bhṛtyām̐śca bandhanaṃ dṛḍhatāṃ vrajet | rāgadveṣau vivardhete bhogamohādibhiḥ sadā ||39|| ratistaiścāpyudetyeva rato grāmyasukhādiṣu | nahi jānāti cātmārthe vivekaṃ mokṣamityapi ||2.253.40|| kintu yatate bhogī syāṃ tataḥ punarvinaśyati | tasmānniḥsaṃginā stheyaṃ gṛhadārādhanādiṣu ||41||| tapaḥphalaṃ sampadaśca bandhayanti janāniha | ādityā vasavo rudrā marutau manavastathā ||42|| viśvedevā aśvinau ca siddhāḥ sādhyā mahārṣayaḥ | kiṃpuruṣāśca gandharvā vahnīndrasūryacandrakāḥ ||43| | pitaro lokapālāśca rākṣasā yakṣakinnarāḥ | gaṇāśca pārṣadāścāpi grahā devāśca dānavāḥ ||44| | rājāno guruvargāścācāryāḥ siddhāḥ satīstriyaḥ | te sarve tapasā siddhā bhuñjate tapasāṃ phalam ||45|| mahākule prasūtā ye smṛddhā modanta īśvarāḥ | kauśikānyambarāṇyeva svarṇahīrakabhūṣaṇam ||86 || vāhanāsanabhojyāni pānastrīdāsadāsikāḥ | śayyottamāśca mṛdvayaśca vāsaḥ prāsādabhūmiṣu ||47|| abhipretāni sarvāṇi sarve tat tapasāṃ phalam | bhogārthe jāyate sarvaṃ karmaṇe narakāya ca ||48|| asantoṣaḥ praduḥkhāya prajñānāśakarastathā | bhrāmakaśca bhavatyeva vṛthādhāvanakarṣitaḥ ||49|| iṣuprapātamātraṃ hi sparśayogena kāmajam | auṣṇyasukhaṃ praduḥkhāya sarvathā nirayāya ca ||2.253.5 0 | | tasmād vijñāya kṣaṇikaṃ duḥkhabahulameva tat | medhāvī ca yatetāpi mokṣārthaṃ gṛhadharmyapi ||5 1 || mokṣaṃ cānabhisandhānāḥ kāmānandādisañjakāḥ | manuṣyā api puṇyāni dhvaṃsayantīva sūkarāḥ ||52|| yogyaṃ pātraṃ yuñjate na prāptaṃ kalpalatāsamam | mardayanti śuṣkayanti nāśayanti hi durbhagāḥ ||53|| prāptaṃ cintāmaṇiṃ dehaṃ mahiṣīmāyayāvṛtam | kṣapayanti narā nāryo mokṣaṃ kṛtvā tu niṣphalam ||54|| yadyapi nṛpateḥ lokaḥ svabhāvāt kāmanādimān | rudhyate nāvaśo nityaṃ pravartate hi karmasu ||55|| anekeṣu viṣayeṣu daihikāmodadāyiṣu | tathāpi guruvākyena teṣu karmasvathāparam || 56|| bhaktyākhyaṃ karma kartavyaṃ cādhikaṃ yena mucyate | satāṃ vṛttamadhiṣṭhāya magnā apyuddidhīrṣavaḥ || 57|| puṇyaṃ sukhaṃ śamaṃ prāpya svargaṃ paramavāpnuyuḥ | yadyapi viṣayāsaktā api drohavivarjitāḥ ||58|| haryarthaṃ karma kurvāṇā uddharantīva gopikāḥ | naiḥśreyasaṃ karmapathaṃ samāruhya hareḥ ratham ||59|| satāṃ sārthā bhaktiparāḥ samarpaṇavidhāyinaḥ | prayānti sthānamajaraṃ cākṣaraṃ svargamūrdhvagāḥ ||2.253.6 0 || bhaktā jayanti sarvatra saguṇāścāguṇā api | putrāḥ śiṣyā jayantyeva bhaktimantaḥ striyo’pi ca ||6 1 || pitā sakhā guruḥ patnī rājā mātā patiḥ suraḥ | abhaktānāṃ na tuṣyanti pitaraḥ sādhavo’pi ca | |62|| bhaktirhi sādhanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ toṣaṇe sevanaṃ śubham | śuśrūṣaṇaṃ tathā dāsyaṃ prāpaṇe śreṣṭhamatra ha ||6 3 || tasmād bhaktyādibhiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ | toṣaṇīyo hi sahasā dehenānena jānatā ||64|| rājān kaścit trāyate na mṛtyupāśamupāgatam | avaśiṣṭe puṇyapāpe nāpi kaścid vikarṣati |||55|| śatrurajñānatulyo’tra vartate nāparo nṛpa | tadvaśe manujo nityaṃ karoti ghoravaiśasam ||66 || tena duḥkhānyapiyanti navaṃ janma navāṃ mṛtim | tasya prabādhanāyeha vṛddhānupāsya vai sataḥ | |67|| prajñāmāsādya śatruṃ taṃ sasārthaṃ vipravāsayet | tataścintāmaṇiṃ gartaṃ kṣiptvā mokṣātpatenna vai | |6 8|| cāṇḍālatve’pi mānuṣyaṃ bhaktyarthaṃ śobhanaṃ yataḥ | manuṣyayoni śreṣṭhā vai cātmatrāṇatya sādhanam | |69|| upabhogairna deho’yaṃ kṣapaṇīyo hyanarthake | yāvanna vipraṇaśyetra tāvat kurmaḥ śubhaṃ param ||2.253.7 0 || etādṛśaṃ kalpabījaṃ prāpya mānuṣavigraham | dviṣate yo nijaṃ mokṣaṃ sa mato vañcitaḥ sadā | |7 1 || lokārthe vai prakurvītopakāraṃ dānakarmabhiḥ | kuṭumbārthe prakurvīta sāhāyyaṃ dhanavastubhiḥ | |72 || putrādyarthe prakurvīta vyavasāyaṃ yathocitam | ātmārthe tu prakurvīta mokṣadaṃ sādhanaṃ param ||73 || iṣṭiṃ dānaṃ ca yajanaṃ puṇyaṃ pitryaṃ ca daivikam | bhajanaṃ sevanaṃ cāpi śreyaso’rthe sadācaret | 174||| aśvapāṭala uvācakiṃ mūlaṃ śreyasāṃ yacca kṛtaṃ naiva vinaśyati | kva gato na nivarteta kvāpi brūhi ca me guro ||75 || śrīlomaśa uvāca sattvavṛttirasaṃgaśca satāṃ sevā samāgamaḥ | vṛddhāśīrvādalābhaśca śreyasāṃ mūlamakṣayam ||76 || tapo bhaktistathābhayadānaṃ nārāyaṇāśrayaḥ | ātmārpaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ caitat sarve naiva vinaśyati || 77|| kāyakleśebhya evātra tapobhyaścottamaṃ tapaḥ | harau vṛtternirodho vai cāparokṣadṛśipradaḥ ||78| sāparokṣānubhūtiśca labdhā naiva nivartate | abhayaṃ ca paraṃ dānaṃ sarvebhyaścātivartate || 7 9|| sarvābhayapradasyātra paratrābhayamakṣayam | vasan viṣayamadhye’pi vijño naiva vasatyapi ||2.253.8 0|| ajño’satsvapi viṣayeṣvatīva vasatīti vai | dharṣayanti na viṣayāḥ prājñaṃ tejasvinaṃ janam ||8 1|| aprājñaṃ cādhikaṃ svalpā api valganti vai dṛḍhāḥ | duṣkṛtaṃ tasya kartāraṃ naiva muñcati karhicit ||82| | kṛtātmāno na bhidyante viṣayaiḥ karmakoṭibhiḥ | akṛtātmānamevātra bhayaṃ kvacinna muñcati |||83|| vītarāgasya vai janmādarśanānmuktireva ha | kṛtena karmaṇā tasya lepo naivāsti jīvataḥ ||84|| mṛtasyāpi na vai bhogaḥ karmaṇāmasya vidyate | bhaktimārgaprayātasya paradhāmagatirmatā ||85|| vistarāḥ kleśasaṃyuktāḥ saṃkṣepāḥ sukhadāyinaḥ | parārthā vistarā duḥkhāstyāgaṃ cātmahitaṃ śrayet ||86|| ahorātrātmake loke dehī mṛtyumukhe sthitaḥ | grasyate nityamevāyaṃ chinnāyurjāyate’niśam ||87|| snehapāśaiśca bahubhiḥ prākṛtairmohavṛścikaiḥ | daṃṣṭo viṣamayodvigno na sukhaṃ labhate kvacit ||88|| pāśān chitvā gṛhaṃ hitvā parigrahān praṇamya ca | yaḥ prayāti harermārgaṃ sa vai pāragato bhavet ||89|| aśvapāṭala loko’yaṃ svasthe svāsthyavibhāgahṛt | asvāsthye dūragaścāste svārthamātraparāyaṇaḥ ||2.253.90 || svārthalokātparārtho yaḥ sa vai śreṣṭho mataḥ sadā| | parārthaparataścāpi titikṣurvai viśeṣitaḥ ||9 1 || titikṣorapi vijñaśca vijñājjyāyām̐śca bhaktimān | sa vai guptaṃ brahma bodhyaṃ bhaktyāḍhyaṃ mokṣakṛt sadā ||92|| amṛtasya paraḥ kośo mokṣasya dvāramuttamam | yānaṃ svargasya vai śreṣṭhaṃ dharmasya śevadhistathā ||93 || bhakto vai mānuṣe loke muktastiṣṭhati muktavat | bhaktasaṃgena bhaktā vai jāyante brahmagāminaḥ ||94|| yādṛśaṃ sevate jantustādṛśo jāyate’pi saḥ | yadi santaṃ sevate’tra sādhuḥ sañjāyate sa ca || 95 || devāstṛpyanti sadbhiśca pitaraḥ siddhakoṭayaḥ | muktāstṛpyanti sādhubhyastasmāt sādhutvamāvrajet || 96|| svārthamātraparān lokān devāstyajanti dūrataḥ | devā muktāḥ sādhavaśca vasanti sādhubhiḥ saha || 97|| ityevaṃ sādhuyogena brahmalokaṃ pragacchati | parabrahmasthito mukto’nantānandaṃ samaśnute || 98 || ityevaṃ rādhike śrīmallomaśaścāśvapāṭalam | upādiśya virarāma rājā papraccha vai punaḥ || 99 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāṃ nṛpakṛto’bhyudayapraśnaḥ, śreyomūlādipraśnaḥ, lomaśadattottarāṇi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tripañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 253 ||
<2.254> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike’śvapāṭalaśca papraccha devatoṣaṇam | ātmano ramaṇaṃ cāpi nirvighnaṃ yena jāyate || 1 || aśvapāṭala uvāca maharṣe suralokeṣu vāso vai surayājinām | brahmaloke nivāsaśca jāyate brahmayājinām || 2 || īśvarāṇāṃ tu loke’pi tattadīśvarayājinām | dhāmasu cāvatārāṇāṃ yajanādvasatirbhavet || 3 || devānāṃ toṣaṇaṃ yena yenopāyena jāyate | vadātra me kṛpāṃ kṛtvetareṣāmapi dhāminām || 4 || śrīlomaśa uvāca devāstuṣyanti yajñena pūjayopāstibhistathā | naivedyabalibhiścāpi mantrārādhanatadvrataiḥ || 5 || satyenāhiṃsayā śuddhyā śīlena ca vṛṣeṇa ca | ātmasamarpaṇenāpi mānatāśaraṇādibhiḥ || 6 || anuṣṭhānena kṛcchreṇa dānena smaraṇena ca | utsavena kīrtanādyairdevāstuṣyanti bhūpate || 7 || ātmaśuddhyā vivekena puṇyakarmabhirādarāt | tuṣṭā devā dadatyevaihikaṃ svargyaṃ sukhaṃ nijam || 8 || īśvarāḥ pitaraḥ śrāddhairmahodyāpanakarmabhiḥ | pārāyaṇairvedavidyādhyayanaiḥ pratimārhaṇaiḥ || 9 || mandire vidhitaḥ pratiṣṭhāpanaiḥ pūjanādibhiḥ | mahotsavairvedadharmaistuṣyantīśvarakoṭayaḥ || 2.254.1 0|| avatārā harerbhāvā bhaktyārādhanayā tathā | pūjayā mūrtisevādyaistīrthatadvratabhāvanaiḥ || 11 || ājñayārpaṇarītyā ca tatkathāśravaṇadibhiḥ | ananyaśaraṇāgatyā niṣṭhyaikaikatānayā || 12| satataṃ cānuvṛttyā ca smṛtyā dhyānena sevayā | pavitratayā vṛttyā ca nairmalyayutayāniśam || 13 || tacchaktitatpārṣadādisevayārpaṇatāśrayaiḥ | tattacchṛṃgāradānādyairmānasaiḥ pūjanādibhiḥ || 14|| tadbhaktānāṃ strīnarāṇāṃ sevanairbhojanārpaṇaiḥ | avatārāḥ pratuṣyanti tattadaiśvaryadāyinaḥ || 15|| tattaddhāmapradātāro bhavanti bhaktitoṣitāḥ | paramātmānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇastu bhūpate || 16 || sarvārpaṇātmabhaktyaiva tuṣyatyatra śriyaḥ patiḥ | viśvāsabhaktyā nyāsena dāsyena sthirasevayā || 17|| ānukūlyānuvṛttyā ca varaṇenārhaṇena ca | kaiṃkaryeṇāpyasaṃgena pūjanena vṛṣeṇa ca || 18 || dhyānena bhajanenāpi cātmārpaṇena tuṣyati | bhāvanā tu mahān hetuḥ snehastasya pratoṣaṇe || 1 9|| svalpaṃ vāpi mahadvāpi pūjanaṃ bhāvanānvitam | toṣayatyeva govindaṃ sarvavṛttyaikanirmitam ||2.254.20 || yena kenāpi bhāvena satatasmaraṇena ca | tanmayavitpravāheṇa premarajjumayena ca || 21 || sarvāntarātmadṛṣṭyā ca sarvatṛptikriyādibhiḥ | tadīyānāṃ svāgataiśca sādhūnāṃ sevanādibhiḥ ||22|| sāttvatānāṃ toṣaṇaiśca dīnānāmupakārataḥ | anāthānāṃ poṣaṇaiścādrohaiśca sarvadehinām ||23 || sarvairbhāgavatairdharmaistattvajñānaiḥ svavedanaiḥ | tatkathākaraṇaiścāpi tadguṇānāṃ ca varṇanaiḥ ||24|| tannāmaraṭaṇaiścāpi tadarthanyāsayojanaiḥ | tanmayākāravṛttyā ca tatsṛṣṭidharmarakṣaṇaiḥ || 25|| tatsnehārpaṇasarvasvaiḥ parabrahma pratuṣyati | jaḍacetanavargāṇāṃ yathāpekṣapradānakaiḥ || 26 || dānadharmaiḥ sattvavratairadrohāvañcanādibhiḥ | satāṃ dharmaiśca bhaktānāṃ bhaktānīnāṃ ca toṣaṇaiḥ || 27|| sarveṣu saṃsthitaścāste hariḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | sarvāstvasyaiva kṛṣṇasya pratimā jaḍacetanāḥ || 28|| narā nāryaścetaracca sarvasṛṣṭisthadehinaḥ | tatra sarvatra tadbuddhyā sattvarajastamassvapi ||29 || tanmūrtiṃ sevayāmyeva sa vai tuṣyatu matpatiḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkambharāsutaḥ || 2.254.3 0|| gopālanandanaḥ kṛṣṇasya vallabho preṣṭha īśitā | lakṣmīrādhāramāmāṇikyāramāpadmajāpatiḥ ||3 1 || brahmapriyāpatirmuktapatiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | satāṃ patiścātmapatiḥ sarvapatiḥ patirmama ||32|| itikṛtvā bhajettaṃ cāntaryāmiṇaṃ hi dehiṣu | taddṛṣṭyā tadbhāvanayā tadarpaṇakriyādibhiḥ ||33 || aphalākāṃkṣiṇā bhāvyaṃ tatra sarvatra pūjane | tuṣyatyeva tathā kṛṣṇaścādṛtaḥ sarvadehiṣu || 34 || tavāsmīha paritrāhi rakṣeti prārthayet sadā | harenātha harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa tavāsmyaham || 35|| yathā vartayase māṃ ca tathā varte tavājñayā | tavaiva sarvamevedaṃ nānyat tvāmantarā nviha ||36|| mama dṛṣṭipathe sarvaṃ tavaiva ca tvameva ca | ityevaṃ bhagavaddṛṣṭyā bhāvitasya tu dehinaḥ ||37|| kāmāt krodhācca mohācca svārthād bhaktyāśrayādapi | vartamānasya śaraṇe patitasya tadātmanaḥ ||38|| tūrṇaṃ tuṣyati bhagavān dayālurbhaktavatsalaḥ | nātrānyat sādhanaṃ vāpi dravyaṃ vā havanādikam ||39|| apekṣate toṣaṇārthaṃ yastasya tasya tuṣyati | ayaṃ me nāparasyeti hareḥ kṛpā hi tatprasūḥ ||2.254.40|| kṛpayā labhyate kṛṣṇaḥ kṛpayā nīyate’kṣaram | kṛpayā svapadaṃ cāpi samarpayati satpatiḥ ||41 || hīnabhāvanayā naiva bhavanti vai surādayaḥ | santuṣṭāḥ sarvadharmebhyo bahiṣkṛtena karmaṇā ||42|| bhaktaiḥ saha surādyā vai svāminaḥ sevakaistathā | dāsairniyāmakāścāpi tuṣṭā ramanta īśvarāḥ ||43 || ajñānāvṛtasattvānāṃ mātsaryādimaṣījuṣām | lobhādidoṣakṛṣṭānāṃ svargo mokṣo na toṣaṇam ||44|| prājño bhakto’kṣaraṃ yāti ramate sukhibhiḥ saha | balaṃ nijeṣṭadevasya prāpya śāntiṃ samaśnute ||45|| daivata dehināṃ karma kṛṣṇārthaṃ yat kṛtaṃ hi tat | devatvaṃ kṛṣṇabhajanaṃ śuddhiḥ svādhyāya ityapi ||46|| vrataṃ śīlaṃ jayaścāpīndriyāṇāṃ sādhunā matā | kalaho nindanaṃ cāpi kāpaṭyaṃ dhūrtatādikāḥ ||47|| asādhutvaṃ veditavyaṃ mṛtyustaiḥ saha vartate | parīkṣya mṛtyuryatrāste vihāya tāni buddhimān ||48|| mṛtyuṃ vivāsayed dūre harerāśrayaṇādiha | mṛtyubhītirahitaśca caredākṣarasādhanam ||49|| parabrahmālayalabdhiryathā syāttaccarennṛpa | ityevaṃ vartamānasya yasmānnaiva nivartate ||2.254.50|| tadakṣarasya lokasya prāptirbharveddhi śāśvatī | bhaktyā saṃprāpyate dhāma vāso niravadhiryataḥ ||51 || aśvapāṭala uvācaātmānātmavivekena muktirvai kīdṛśī bhavet | harerupāstyā muktiśca kīdṛśī saṃbhaved guro ||52|| yogābhyāsena vā muktiḥ kīdṛśī syād vadātra me | dharmamātrāśrayeṇāpi muktirvai kīdṛśī matā |||53 || gurorāśrayamātreṇa bhavedvā na bhavecca sā | niḥsaṃśayo mokṣalābhaḥ keneti vada me guro ||54|| śrīlomaśa uvāca deho vai pañcabhūtaiścendriyairāntarikairapi | karaṇaiḥ prāṇaistriguṇaistanmātraiḥ saṃhato mataḥ ||55|| ātmā tebhyaḥ pṛthaṅ nityaścetanaścāvibandhanaḥ | nityamukto nityaśuddho nityabuddho vasan sadā ||56|| jaḍacetanavijñānādṛjñānakṣayakāraṇāt | tattvābhyāsānnāsmi na me nāhaṃ ceti prakāśanāt ||57|| karmakṣayena dehādvai mukto mukto hi nirguṇaḥ | saccidānandarūpo vai janyaprakāśavarjitaḥ ||58|| svarūpakalpasthitiko muktyātmā cābhipadyate | na vai sukhī na cākāraḥ sadā jāḍyāśrayo bhavet| ||59|| jāḍyasya hāriṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ parameśaṃ bhajed yadi | brahmadhāmni parameśasvarūpo’bhiniṣpadyate ||2.254.6 0 || yathā haristathā bhaktaḥ sālokyaṃ sārṣṭimantikam | sārūpyaṃ samavāpnoti sarvāmodān samaśnute ||6 1 || brahmahrade kṛtasnāno brāhmīṃ tanuṃ hyavāpya ca | brāhmamukto divyaguṇaḥ sampadyate harīcchayā ||62|| na tatrāyaṃ hi saṃghāto dehaḥ prākṛtakāraṇaḥ | ātmaiva tattvamekaṃ ca samūrtaṃ svaprabhāvataḥ ||63|| upāsitahareryogāt samartho mūrtirūpakaḥ | mukto bhavati muktau vai māyā tatra na vartate ||64|| sarvakāmarasasvādaḥ sarvagandhasukhāśrayaḥ | sarvaiśvaryayuto nityānandāmodasya śevadhiḥ ||65|| avyayānandamagnaśca brahmaṇā saha modate | sarvān kāmānātmasaṃsthān bhuṃkte brahmasvarūpavān ||66|| parabrahmāptayogaśca sarvānandabhṛto bhavet | na nyūnaṃ śrīhareścāsti bhaktamuktasya tatra ha ||67|| evaṃ copāstiyogena muktiṃ śreṣṭhā bhavetparā | yogino yogayatnasthā yadi kṛṣṇamupāsate ||68||| tadā coktāṃ parāṃ muktiṃ vindati nātra saṃśayaḥ | yadi cānyānīśvarādīn vairājādīnupāsate ||69|| tadeśvarakṛtān lokānāpnuvantīśvarā yathā | prākṛtaiśvaryamuktiḥ sā mahālaye kṣayāvahā ||2.254.70|| siddhīḥ prāpya sthitiṃ labdhvā cānte nijāvaśeṣavat | layaṃ vānyeśvarabhāvaṃ devatvaṃ vābhiyanti ca || 71|| sahasradhābhavanādisamaiśvaryāṇi bhuṃjate | sā nikṛṣṭā pātadā ca muktirnimnasthalātparā || 72|| dhyānayogācca vā mūrtau harerlīnatvarūpiṇī | aikātmyamuktireteṣāmabhinnādisamādhibhiḥ ||73|| svāmisevakabhāvādivarjitā sā prajāyate | parameśe sadā tirobhāvarūpā na vai pṛthak ||74|| rājan dhyānavaśātte ca tallīnāstanmayāḥ khalu | parameśe parameśāḥ sampadyante’bhavāḥ punaḥ ||75|| eṣā śreṣṭhatarā muktiryā sthitiḥ pārameśvarī | dāsarūpeṇa sevātra śiṣyate na kathaṃcana ||76|| dharmamātreṇa yā muktiḥ sā tu bhogāviyoginī | svargasatyādilokeṣu sadeho vāsa eva ha ||77|| dharmaṃ bhuktvā punaḥ pṛthvyāṃ janmanā ca vṛṣārjanam | punaḥ svargaṃ punaḥ pṛthvī punareva pracakrakam ||78|| evaṃ jāte’pi dharmaḥ sa yadi bhāgavatātmakaḥ | brahmasambandharūpo vā nairguṇyanāmadheyakaḥ ||79|| sevātmako hareḥ syāccedadhvare dakṣiṇātmakaḥ | dānātmako harestuṣṭyai tadā muktirhi śāśvatī ||2.254.80 || dharmo vai svārthamātreṇa kṛto naiva hi muktaye | parārthabuddhyānuṣṭhitaḥ kalyāṇāya sa jāyate ||81|| parameśārpaṇabuddhyā kṛtaścenmokṣado’kṣare | evaṃ rājan kriyāḥ sarvāḥ śubhā vāpyaśubhāstathā ||82|| asaṃgabhāvajāḥ kṛṣṇārpaṇabhāvena nirvṛtāḥ | kṛṣṇasmaraṇasampādyāḥ sarvā mokṣapradā hi tāḥ ||83|| api kṣetrādhipaḥ kṣetraṃ saṃskṛtyotkhātya karṣati | vapate sasyakaṇiśān lunātyapi ca khādati ||84|| sarva brahmārpaṇaṃ kṛtvā karoti kururājavat | yadvā janakavaccāpi kūrmibrahmarṣivacca vā ||85|| tatsarvaṃ jāyate nirdoṣakaṃ kalmaṣavarjitam| svarṇakāraḥ satyavṛttyā sampādayati bhūṣaṇam ||86|| kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ cettat śailpyaṃ mokṣapradaṃ bhavet| | haryarthaṃ yatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirguṇaṃ mokṣadaṃ matam ||87|| hariṃ vinā kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ duḥkhadaṃ ca vā | abhyasyanti dvijā vedān haryanusmṛtivarjitān ||88|| cettadābhyasanaṃ śuno bhakṣaṇaṃ ceva jāyate | vinā maṇerhi māhātmyaṃ gopālo mahiṣīgale ||89 || badhnāti kaṃkaraṃ matvā mūlyaṃ tasya phalaṃ na ca | api śālagrāmaśilāṃ matvā viṣṇuṃ sanātanam ||2.254.9 0 || rakṣanti vaiṣṇavāḥ santaḥ sevayanti divāniśam | teṣāṃ viṣṇurhi tadrūpaḥ sevāṃ matvā vibhāvitām ||9 1 || caturbhujaḥ prāvirbhūy dṛśyate cākṣigocaraḥ | sa eva bhāvabhinnaścet tirobhavati drāk tataḥ ||92|| sa evārādhanāsnehapāśitaścet pareśvaraḥ | parabrahmāvatāryeva kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||93 || avatārāvatāryevānādyanantastathāntaraḥ | prakāśate hṛdi cāgre tato nayati cākṣaram ||9 4|| tasmād rājan kriyāyogāḥ kṛtā dehendriyādibhiḥ | svārthārthaṃ bandhakā hyete haryarthaṃ mokṣadā hi te ||95 || santaḥ kṛṣṇaprasaṃgena divyāḥ kṛṣṇahṛdātmakāḥ | kṛṣṇaiśvaryabhṛtā mokṣapradā bhavanti saukhyadāḥ ||9 6 || divyalokapradā divyānandadāścākṣarapradāḥ | bhagavatpratimāyogapradāśca jñānadāyinaḥ ||97|| vighnaghnāḥ prākṛtāvartanāśakā bhramavārakāḥ | duḥkhadoṣanivārāśca brahmalokasya dāyakāḥ || 98|| teṣāṃ sevā prakartavyāḥ sarvāḥ saṃśayavarjitāḥ | yathā te bhagavanmūrtiviśeṣā itimatya vai ||99|| yathā patnyāṃ ca putre ca pitrośca bāndhave nije | prītiścāste svārthaparāhamamatvaprayojitā || 2.254.100 || tathā prītiḥ sadā kāryā sadgurau mokṣadā hi sā | dharmo vā dharmayajño vā puṇyaṃ dānaṃ śubhā kriyā || 101 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe sarvaṃ samarpayet | tadā muktirmahāmuktirbrahmasāyujyarūpiṇī || 1 02|| brahmasārṣṭisvarūpā ca brahmalokapradāyinī | parabrahmasamamūrtikāriṇī cottamāttamā || 1 03|| prāpyate mānavenaiva dehena prabhaviṣṇunā | prabhuṇā saha saṃyogaḥ prāptavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate || 1 04|| gopyaḥ prāptāḥ paraṃ yogaṃ tathā brahmapriyāḥ khalu | muktāḥ prāptāḥ paraṃ yogaṃ nānyayogasya vāñchayā || 1 05|| ityevaṃ tvaṃ bhūpate’tra pratyakṣaṃ yogamāvaha | vapuḥ kṛtvā paraṃ divyaṃ śāśvataṃ yogamāvaha || 1 06|| rādhike lomaśastvevaṃ rājñe pradāya cāntaram | virarāmopadeśaṃ ca mumude nṛpatirbahu || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāṃ nṛpakṛto devādīnāṃ toṣaṇahetupraśnaḥ, vivekopāsanāyogadharmagurubhiḥ kīdṛśī muktiritipraśnaḥ, lomaśoktottarāṇi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥpañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 254 ||
<2.255> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike ca tataścāśvapaṭṭalo lomaśaṃ munim | yogasya ca balaṃ cāpyabalaṃ papraccha kīdṛśam || 1 || aśvapāṭala uvāca ṛṣe yogabalaṃ kīdṛg vettamicchāmi cābalam | yena mukto bhavedvāpi cāvaṣṭabhyeta nirbalaḥ || 2 || śrīlomaśa uvāca śaucaṃ tapo dayā satyamahiṃsā steyavarjanam | prāṇarodho vṛttirodho dhyānaṃ samā hi yoginām || 3 || abhyāso balavān yasya tasya yogaḥ prasiddhyati | nirbalasyābhyasanaṃ ca nirbalaṃ tena bandhanam || 4 || kāmaṃ lobhaṃ ca mohaṃ ca snehaṃ krodhaṃ ca rāgitām | yogācchitvāpyabalastu punasteṣvapi sajjate || 5 || yathā matsyāḥ sthūladehā chitvā jālaṃ punarjalam | viśanti nirbalāstadvat ṣaṭkaṃ viśanti vai punaḥ || 6 || yathā ca balavanto vai mṛgāḥ pāśān vibhidya ca | paraṃ vanāntaraṃ yānti tadvad yogivarāḥ param || 7 || māyāpāraṃ prayāntyeva baliṣṭhātmaparāyaṇāḥ | yathā ca balahīnā vai śaśādyā bandhanāni vai || 8 || āsādya nahi nirgantuṃ samarthā yoginastathā | nirbalā na samarthā vai nirgantuṃ jālato bahiḥ || 9 || jhaṣāśca nirbalā jālaṃ chitvā prayānti naiva ha | nirbalā yoginastadvanmāyāṃ chitvā prayānti na || 2.255.10 || śakunā balino jālaṃ chitvā yānti digantaram | yogino balino māyāṃ chitvāmbaraṃ prayānti hi || 1 1|| balavām̐śca yathā vahniḥ sarvaṃ dahati cāgatam | baliṣṭhā yogino māyāṃ dahantyeva svatejasā || 12|| nirbalastu yathā vahniḥ śāmyatyevāpi dārubhiḥ | yogyapi nirbalaḥ ṣaṭke parābhavaṃ prayāti vai || 13 || nadīsroto balahīnaṃ tvākṛṣya nayate jale | ṣaṭkaṃ tadvannirbalaṃ cākṛṣya nayati māyike || 14|| vāraṇaḥ sabalaḥ sroto viṣṭabhnāti ca gacchati | baliṣṭhaśca tathā yogī ṣaṭkaṃ nivārya gacchati || 15|| sabalāstu pramucyante nirbalā yānti bandhanam | pralayotthamahādityo yathā śoṣayate jagat || 16 || mokṣabalotthitayogī doṣān śoṣayate tathā | yogino yogabalato viśantīśvaramandiram || 17|| devānāmālayān prajāpatisthānāni vāpi ca | sarvadābhyāsaśīlasya balaṃ yogasya vardhate || 18|| tataḥ punarvibhidyaiva māyāṃ prayānti cākṣaram | kṛtābhyāso yathā dhanvī kuśalo lakṣyavedhakaḥ || 19|| vidhvā lakṣyaṃ jayaṃ yāti tathākṣaraṃ prayāti saḥ | mastake snehapātraṃ ca kṛtābhyāso nidhāya ca ||2.255.20|| yathā rajjvā naṭo yātyaskhalito jayameti ca | tathābhyāsabalarddhiścākṣaraṃ yogī prayāti hi ||2 1 || yathābhyāso karṇadhāro nāvā pāraṃ prayāti ca | tathā yukto balenāpi jagatpāraṃ pragacchati ||22|| sārathiśca balī cāśvānniyamya yāti niścitam | tathā yukto yogivaryo yātyakṣaraṃ dhruvaṃ padam ||23 || nijātmani pareśaṃ yaḥ paśyatyeva ca yogavit | māyājālaṃ sa vai chitvā prayātyeva paraṃ padam || 24|| cakreṣu dehasaṃstheṣu saṃvihṛtya malāni tu | dagdhvā dagdhvā brahmamārgaṃ yāti viyāti vai balāt ||25|| yatheṣṭaṃ ca yadā kalpayatyeva gantumakṣaram | tadā varṣma vihāyaiva svatantro yāti dhāma tat ||26|| baliṣṭhasyeṣṭadevasyopāstyā balamavāpnuyāt | abhyāsenātmayogena saṃyamena vṛṣeṇa ca ||27|| tapasā dhyānayogena samādhinā balaṃ vrajet | kintu rājan mahāraṇye pāraṃ kecitprayānti vai ||28|| baliṣṭhānāṃ vijetāro’raṇye vasanti vai yataḥ | nārāyaṇaṃ vinā pāraṃ gantuṃ sandehavatpadam ||29|| hriyante’pi baliṣṭhā vai prabaliṣṭhatamāribhiḥ | divyaiśvaryacamatkārasiddhidhāmanivāsibhiḥ ||2.255.3 0|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāgre yadā bhavet| | pragacchan sa nayatyeva jitvā baliṣṭhasattamān ||3 1 || nijaṃ paraṃ padaṃ divyaṃ śāśvataṃ mokṣamuttamam | rājan dehe guṇān matvā mā bhūrbaddhaḥ kadācana ||32|| vivekena pramātavyaṃ kalmāṣāṇāṃ gṛhaṃ vapuḥ | atra sattvaṃ daśabhāvaṃ me nibodha vadāmi tān ||33|| ānandaḥ prītiruddharṣaḥ prakāśaḥ puṇyakāritā | santoṣamārjavaṃ śraddhā tyāga aiśvaryamityapi ||34|| tathā rajo navabhāvaṃ me nibodha vadāmi tān | āstikatvamakārpaṇyaṃ dvandvopasevanaṃ tathā ||35|| kāmo dveṣo mado darpo vādaḥ paruṣatā tathā | tathā chāyā tamo’bhāvaṃ me nibodha vadāmi te || 36|| tāmasatvaṃ mohanaṃ ca dhūmrabhāvo matikṣayaḥ | nidrā pramāda ālasyaṃ nāśaśceti tathāvidhāḥ || 37|| buddhitattvaṃ saptabhāvaṃ me nibodha vadāmi te | ahantā mamatā mānaṃ dairghyaṃ cāśā svapūjyatā ||38|| īśateti manaścāpi ṣaḍbhāvaṃ tān vadāmi te | cāñcalyaṃ vegavattvaṃ ca saṃśayaśca svatantratā ||3 9|| snigdhatvaṃ cāpyaviśvāsyaṃ mānase te matāḥ sadā | indriyaṃ pañcabhāvaṃ ca me nibodha vadāmi te ||2.255.40|| atṛptiḥ raṃjanaṃ caudāsīnyaṃ cālocanaṃ gatiḥ | caturbhāvaṃ bhūtatattvaṃ me nibodha vadāmi tān ||41|| āśrayo bandhanaṃ nāśaḥ prasavaśceti sarvadā | tribhāvaṃ kośatattva ca ṣaṭkośāste tanusthitāḥ ||42|| romalohitamāṃsāni majjāsthisnāyavaśca te | bhāvāstu kledyatā mālinyaṃ tathā paribhogyatā ||43|| prāṇo vai dvisvabhāvaśca bhāvau dvau tau nibodha me | jīvanaṃ bhrāmaṇaṃ ceti tattvāni kathitāni te ||44|| rājan tattvavivekena bhāvāste doṣarūpiṇaḥ | ātmano mokṣamārge vai vighnāste yadi te tathā ||45|| tān vivicyaikabhāvaṃ vai sukhabhāvaṃ nijātmakam | parameśe’rpayed bhaktyā mokṣastasya sthito dhruvaḥ ||46 || yadvā bhāvān lokayitvā didṛkṣāntaṃ vidhāpayet | mānuṣān viṣayān sarvān paiśācān viṣayām̐stathā ||47|| yakṣāṇāṃ viṣayām̐ścāpyauragāṇāṃ viṣayām̐stathā | gāndharvaviṣayām̐ścāpi pitṝṇāṃ viṣayām̐stathā ||48|| tiraścāṃ viṣayām̐ścāpi marutāṃ viṣayām̐stathā | patatriviṣayām̐ścāpi rājarṣiviṣayām̐stathā ||49|| brahmarṣiviṣayām̐ścāpyāsurāṇāṃ viṣayām̐stathā | viṣayān viśvadevānāṃ yogināṃ viṣayām̐stathā ||2.255.50|| prājāpatyānaiśvarām̐śca brāhmānīśvarakoṭijān | viṣayān samparijñāya sukhaduḥkhe’nubhūya ca ||51 || guṇadoṣān vilokyaiva śāntiṃ prāpya tataḥ param | ātmanā ca vivekenātmānaṃ mokṣe niveśayet ||52|| jñānavijñānasampannaścopāyairbhāvitaḥ svayam | prāpnoti mokṣaṇaṃ divyaṃ nityānandākṣaraṃ padam ||53 || rājan saṃkocayet prāṇaṃ saṣaṭkośaṃ ca bhūtake | bhūtāni mātrayuktāni cendriyāṇi ca vai manaḥ ||54|| ahantādiyutaṃ buddhau vilopayed vivekavān | buddhiṃ samarpayennaije svarūpe tvātmasaṃjñake ||55|| ātmānaṃ brahmarūpaṃ ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe hṛdi | taṃ mokṣe yojayettena gacchedakṣaradhāma yat| ||56 || jñātvā kālasya kavalān devān prajāpatīn ṛṣīn | saptarṣīṃścāpi rājarṣīn surarṣīṃścyāvitān sadā ||57|| brahmarṣīṃśceśvararṣīṃśca jñātvā kālakṛtāntakān | na tatra vai cared dhyānaṃ mokṣamārgagatiṃ caran ||58|| pāpināṃ ca gatiṃ jñātvā yāmyaloke’bhisaṃvṛtām | vicitrayonijanmāni pretabhāvān vilokya ca ||59|| garbhaduḥkhāni vai jñātvā jantūnāṃ kutsitāni ca | upaplavān praghorām̐śca tārānakṣatrapātanam ||2.255.60 || yugalānāmakasmācca viyogaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ tathā | bhūtānāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ cāpyanyonyaṃ vilokya nirghṛṇam ||61 || viṣayāṇāṃ ca daurātmyaṃ gatāsūnāṃ na jīvanam | pāpināṃ duḥkhadāścāpi gatīrvijñāya dāruṇām ||62|| tiraścāṃ duḥkhamālakṣyāyuṣāṃ kṣayaṃ dine dine | dehināṃ saṃkṣayaṃ vīkṣya mṛtyuduḥkhaṃ vilokya ca ||63 || dehadoṣān pravijñāya narakāgāratāṃ tathā | nyasya dehaṃ brahmarandhrād gantavyaṃ paramaṃ padam ||64|| āśrayet prāṇadevaṃ ca vāyudevaṃ tataḥ param | vyomadevaṃ tataścāpi sūryaraśmiṃ tataḥ param ||65|| cāndraraśmiṃ tataścāpi puṇyaraśmiṃ tataḥ param | satyaraśmiṃ tataścāpi sattvaraśmiṃ tataḥ param ||66|| īśaraśmiṃ tataścāpi brahmaraśmiṃ tataḥ param | muktaraśmiṃ tataścāpi paraṃbrahma samarjayet ||67|| paramātmānamāsādya tadbhūtāyatanāmalaḥ | amṛtaṃ paramaṃ prāpto yatpunarna nivartate || 68|| paramā sā gatiḥ rājan satāṃ ca yogināmapi | sāttvatānāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ haryarthakṛtakarmaṇām ||69|| tatra jñānaṃ hi sārvajñyaṃ caiśvaryavrātasaṃbhṛtam | tṛptiḥ sarvātirekā cānandamātrāpi nirbharā ||2.255.70 || asaṃgasya hi sārvajñyaṃ nirdvandvāya sadā matam | ataḥ sārvajñyabhāvena yuktāste nityatoṣiṇaḥ ||7 1 || nityānandā nityaśāntā nityatṛptā nirāśayāḥ | sarvadarśina evāpi saṃsārādarśino hi te ||72||| saṃsāradarśinaścāpi tattadbhāvavivarjitāḥ | bhāvavikṛtiśūnyāśca pratyāhārādisiddhikāḥ ||73|| grāhyāgrāhyasamarthāste sṛṣṭidoṣavivarjitāḥ | nimnasṛṣṭikṛtān bhāvān jñāne sinvanti naiva te ||74|| aśvapāṭala uvāca kiṃ taddhāmākṣaraṃ vidvan yasmānnāvartate punaḥ | kiṃ ca kṣaraṃ tato bhinnaṃ yasmādāvartate punaḥ ||75|| śrīlomaśa uvāca akṣaraṃ dhāma subhagaṃ rājan pareśvarasya yat | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyātyavatāriṇaḥ ||76|| parabrahmaṇa evaitannārāyaṇeśvarasya tat | puruṣottamasaṃjñasyākṣarātītasya śāśvatam ||77|| śivaṃ kṣemaṃ cābhilāṣopanītaṃ sarvasiddhimat | sarveśvareśvarasthānaṃ muktāvāsaṃ parātparam ||78|| yanna kṣarati pūrveṇa yāvatkālena vai kvacit | āyatyā ca na vai grastaṃ cāvyayaṃ brahmadhāma tat ||79|| golokāccāpi vaikuṇṭhādūrdhvaṃ cānantamacyutam | yatra dhāmānyanantāni cāvatārakṛtāni vai ||2.255.80 || nārāyaṇānāṃ vidyante nārāyaṇīkṛtāni hi | avatārā nivasanti koṭiśo yatra dhāmasu ||8 1 || tāni yatra prabhāsante’kṣaraṃ taddhāma sarvagam | brahmalokaścidākāśo’khaṇḍatejobhuvāṃ nidhiḥ ||82|| yatrākṣaraṃ brahma cāpi mūrtimad rājate prabhu | akṣaraṃ tatparaṃ dhāma tasmātparaṃ hareḥ priyam ||83 || paraṃdhāmāsti vai yatra parabrahmāsanaṃ sadā | vartate sarvataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ gajāsanaśubhāsanam ||84|| brahmapriyāḥ samastā vai vartante tatra sevikāḥ| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya muktidāsikāḥ ||85|| muktānyo vai harermūrteḥ śaktayo’nantasiddhayaḥ | siddhāścānantasaṃkhyāśca sādhyā devā vasanti te ||86 || anādayaśca te muktā vasanti dhāmni tatpare | ādimuktāstvakṣare vai vasanti dhāmni sarvadā ||87|| etadakṣarasaṃjñaṃ taddhāma māyāparaṃ yataḥ | guṇātītaṃ mahānandaṃ nityānandādisaṃbhṛtam ||88|| yadromaleśasaukhyena dhāmānyanyāni yāni ca | ānandāmṛtasaukhyairvaiṃ saṃbhṛtāni bhavanti hi ||89|| anyāśceśvaralokākhyā bhuvastatsaukhyasaṃbhṛtāḥ | sṛṣṭayaḥ sarvavidhikāstadānandena nanditāḥ ||2.255.90 || māyātmikāḥ sṛṣṭayaśca kṣaraṃ kṣaranta eva vai | triguṇāśca tamo māyā cāvyaktaṃ puruṣāhitam || 91 || vyaktarūpaṃ bhavatyeva mahattattvamahaṃ tathā | vidyāvidye puṇyapāpe vidhyavidhī tathāparau ||92|| dharmo jñānaṃ virāgaṃ caiśvaryaṃ vyakte pratiṣṭhitam | tadviruddhaṃ tathā cāpi vyakte sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||93|| śabdaḥ sparśaḥ raso rūpaṃ gandho vai bhūtasūkṣmakam | manaścālocanārthaṃ ca śrotratvaṅnetrajihvikāḥ ||94|| ghrāṇaṃ ceti tato’nye ca vākpāṇipādapāyavaḥ | upasthaṃ ceti karmārthaṃ vyomānilānalāstathā ||95|| vārikṣye ca tataścānye ṣāṭkauśikatanubhṛtaḥ | etatsarvaṃ kṣarate’harniśaṃ tat kṣaramucyate ||96|| sarveṣāṃ dehabhāve vai caturviṃśatibhūmayaḥ | nyūnā vā santi kṣarikāḥ kṣaraṃ tasmādudīritam ||97|| yattu mūrtimayaṃ kiñcit sarvaṃ kṣaraṇadharmakam | jale bhuvi tathākāśe vāyau tejasi tatpare ||98|| puṇyastare siddhipare sattvapaṭalake’pi vā | kṣarādhāraṃ kṛtsnametat kṣarate vyaktasaṃjñitam ||99|| kṣare’kṣaraṃ sadā cāste hyātmā cākṣara ityapi | akṣare cātmani sthānaṃ yasya saḥ parameśvaraḥ || 2.255.100 || sa eva hṛdi sarvāsu mūrtiṣvātiṣṭhate hariḥ | bhaja taṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ rājan ramānvitam || 101 || śuklaraktakṛṣṇasṛṣṭisvāminaṃ padmajeśvaram | pāragaṃ cāntarasthaṃ ca kāṃbhareyaṃ priyaṃ prabhum || 1 02|| śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaṃ nāthaṃ kuṃkumavāpikeśvaram | gopālabālakaṃ rājan lomaśeṣṭaṃ patīśvaram || 1 03|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetrādityaṃ brahmapriyāpatim | bālakṛṣṇaṃ cākṣareśaṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ prabhum || 1 04|| sṛṣṭyādau tu bhuvaṃ cemāṃ bhajamānaṃ surāṣṭrikām | mahāviṣṇusutaṃ śrīmanmahālakṣmyekabālakam || 1 05|| tato’nekasvarūpaṃ ca bahvavatāradhāriṇam | tato dharmasutaṃ bhaktisutaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ ca tam || 1 06|| naraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ cāpi brahmaśīlaparāyaṇam | svāminaṃ tyāginaṃ cāpi sarvajñaṃ deśikaṃ tathā || 1 07|| ācāryaṃ sadguruṃ dhiṣṇyādhipaṃ sanmaṇḍaleśvaram | brahmavrataṃ sahājīvaṃ sarvālocakamacyutam || 1 08|| bhaja rājan parāṃ muktiṃ vraja tanmatkṛpākaṇāt | ityevaṃ rādhike cāśvapāṭalaṃ nṛpatimṛṣiḥ || 1 09|| upādiśya virarāma smaran śrīkṛṣṇavallabham | rājāpyānandasandohāt saṃbhṛtāntaraharṣitaḥ || 2.255.110 || adhikasvādamāsādya parabrahmakathāmṛte | satṛṣa iva pipāsuḥ punaḥ papraccha lomaśam || 111 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāṃ nṛpakṛto yogasya balābalapraśraḥ kṣarākṣaralokapraśnaḥ, lomaśakṛtottarāṇi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 255 ||
<2.256> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike ca tato rājā papraccha lomaśaṃ tu yat | kathayāmi samāsena hṛdayena nibodha me || 1 || aśvapāṭala uvāca kṣaraścāyaṃ hi saṃsārastatrākṣaro hi cetanaḥ | kathaṃ na muñcati tvetat kṣaraṃ yātyakṣaraṃ na saḥ || 2 || lomaśa uvāca garbhe karmavaśāt suptaḥ pacyate pakvamannavat | bhūtasaṃskāratādātmyam āpanna iva bharjitaḥ || 3 || kṣaradharmān samāsādyājñānadaśābhibhāvitaḥ | kṣarātmā sva iti bhrāntiṃ prāptaḥ prasūyate tataḥ || 4 || ahaṃ bālo naro nārī bāhyaśabdairvibṛṃhitaḥ | śuklalohitakṛṣṇārthabhānabhrāntipramīlitaḥ || 5 || saṃkīrṇakalpanāṃ prāptaḥ sārthasaṃgairjaḍīkṛtaḥ | kṛśaḥ sthūlo duḥkhī sukhī mamāhaṃtvaṃprabodhitaḥ || 6 || karmapāśāyuṣyarajjubandhitaścāvaśīkṛtaḥ | prāṇakoṣṭhalikāgranthigrathitaścāvināśitaḥ || 7 || māyātāpapariṣekaśokitaśca dṛḍhīkṛtaḥ | ṣāṭkauśikarasairliptastatraiva ca kṛtāsanaḥ || 8 || mahālepairlepitaśca neṣṭe nirgantumaprabhuḥ | tatraiva tāmasaṃ vāpi rājasaṃ sāttvikaṃ ca vā || 9 || pravāhaṃ ca rasaṃ pakvaṃ svādaṃ cābhyastametyayam | puṣṭimeti tatastaistairindriyāhṛtasadrasaiḥ || 2.256.10 || sukhānandaiśca puṣṇāti dhāvatyeva tadarthakaḥ | tadarthaṃ yatate cāpi jñātuṃ prāptuṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 11 || bhoktuṃ tyaktuṃ navīkartuṃ sañcayituṃ navaṃ punaḥ | tadvegavāsanākṣipto mūḍhaḥ kṣare kṣarātmakaḥ || 12|| abhinnaścāpṛthagbhūtvā vartate keśakarṣitaḥ | dehadharmaparo bhūtvā dehānandena nanditaḥ || 13|| punaḥ puṇyaṃ karotyeva divyadehādilabdhaye | evaṃ cakreṇa vai gacchan dehāt karma tato vapuḥ || 14|| punaḥ karma punardehaścetyevaṃ kṣaragartake | muhuḥ patati cājñātmā muhurmodaṃ ca vāñchati || 15|| nāsyaivaṃ vartamānasya kṣarānmuktiḥ kvacid bhavet | pratyuta vardhate moho bandhanaṃ saṃsṛtistathā || 16|| mohānmohaṃ cānuvrajya dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā navaṃ navam | prāptuṃ bhoktuṃ ca yatate karma badhnāti tanmayam || 17|| dehād dehasahasrāṇi karmabhiścābhipadyate | tiryakṣu devavargeṣu mānuṣeṣu ca pakṣiṣu || 18|| daityadānavarakṣassu jāyate ca punaḥ punaḥ | dvandvāneti ca nirdvandvastāsu tāsveva yoniṣu || 1 9|| devabhogān sādhyabhogān siddhabhogānanuttamān | īśvarāṇāṃ tathā bhogānāptuṃ mathnāti sarvaśaḥ || 2.256.20 || roge bhoge vihāre codvege kṣaye kṣatau kṣate | śarīrātmā bhramabhinno mameti cābhimanyate ||21 || bhinnadeheṣu kurvan vai rājyaṃ śete vibhinnake | śayane genduke kvāpi bile dvaidhe ca kardame ||22|| iṣṭikāyāṃ ca gagane garte ca gahvare kṣitau | kaṇṭake bhasmani kṣīṇe jale phale’nile nale ||23|| dadhan vastrāṇi ramyāṇi aurṇāni kambalāni ca | tārṇāni rājasānyeva kārdameyāni carma ca || 24|| yadyadyonau prajāyeta tattadvastraparigraham | bhojanāni vicitrāṇi gandhānyagandhakāni ca ||25|| kledaśaivālabhakṣyāṇi manyate svāni vaibhramāt | vividhāni ca kṛcchrāṇi bhuṃkte vratāni siddhaye ||26||| kurute cāpyabhīṣṭāni tānyanudravati pragaḥ | ātmarūpaguṇān lābhān vividhān hṛdayapriyān ||27|| dhāvate cānubhogārthaṃ bhoktavyāni mayeti ca | mamatvenāvṛto nityaṃ tatraiva parivartate ||28|| sargakoṭisahasreṣu triṣu lokeṣu tatphalam | yathākarma samaśnāti maraṇāntāsu mūrtiṣu ||29|| aśanārahitaścāpi sāśanaḥ samajāyate | nirindriyo’pi manute sendriyaṃ svaṃ vraṇānvitam ||2.256.3 0|| aliṃgo liṃgavantaṃ cāmṛtyurmṛtyubhayānvitam | aduḥkho duḥkhinaṃ cāpyakṣaro’pi manyate kṣaram ||31| evaṃ kṣarābhimānena kṣarānniryāti naiva saḥ | rājannajñānabhāvasya nāsyānte vidyate kvacit ||32|| ṛte gurūpaniṣadṃ śāstrāṇāṃ pariśīlanam | satsaṃgaṃ satkathālābhaṃ hareḥ satāṃ prasevanam ||33|| anugrahaṃ hṛtsthaharermuktānāmanuvartanam | ārādhanaṃ hareścāpi dhyānaṃ tasya parātmanaḥ ||34|| etāni sādhanānyeva divyāni divyadāni hi | ātmanā yujyate cātmā parātmā tatra yujyate ||35|| tadā pāraṃ paraṃ yātyakṣarātparasthitaṃ prabhum | yāvaddhariṃ śrayennaiva satsaṃgaṃ nācaredapi ||36|| bhaktiṃ vidhāpayennaivopāsanāṃ na samācaret | pratyakṣasya hareḥ sevāṃ guroḥ sevāṃ satāṃ tathā ||37|| yāvatkuryānna vai tāvatsaṃsāro’sya na līyate | sargakoṭisahasrāṇi patanāntāni gacchati ||38|| dhāmnā dhāmasahasrāṇi maraṇāntāni yāti ca | māyāmāyikasevābhimāyikastriguṇo bhavet| ||39|| māyāsambandhayogena māyāguṇamayo bhavet | ratyarthamabhisambandhādanyonyaguṇasaṃśrayāt ||2.256.40 || ṛtau garbhāśrayād rūpaṃ māyikaṃ labhate muhuḥ | evaṃ vai jāyamānasya mokṣadharmaḥ kuto bhavet ||41 || tasmād granthiṃ vāsanākhyāṃ chitvā bhitvā ca saṃvrajet | tṛṣṇākṣayaṃ tapasaiva kṛtvā jñānena vāpi ca ||42|| vivekena pṛthakkṛtvā matvātmānaṃ hyamāyikam | jñānaprakāśamārgeṇa gantavyaṃ satpathena ca ||43|| tadā guṇā viyujyante nirguṇādvai cidātmanaḥ | āgarbhādeva puṇyena guṇabhinnaṃ samīkṣate ||44|| prahlādavattathā madālasābālā ivāpi ca | śrīhareḥ kṛpayā yadvā divyacakṣuḥ prakāśate ||45|| ātmānātmavivekena guṇahānyā nijaṃ nijaḥ | paraṃ paśyati yuktātmā parātparaṃ hariṃ tathā ||46|| ekāgratā balaṃ tatra dhyānabalaṃ ca kāraṇam | vimuktaḥ sarvasaṃgebhyo brāhme muhūrtake sthiraḥ ||47|| dhārayettu manaḥ kṛṣṇe’pararātre hṛdantare | buddhyā vṛttiṃ sthirīkṛtyāpyakaṃpo niścalo bhavan ||48|| hariṃ paśyati cāntaḥsthaṃ tadā yukto bhavatyayam | yuktasya sarvadā bhānaṃ parameśaparāyaṇam ||49|| nānyacchṛṇoti cāghrāti na rasyati na paśyati | naiva spṛśati gṛhṇāti yāti vakti ca mehati ||2.256.50|| na manute na ca saṃkalpayate manyate na ca | na buddhyati tadā cātmā parātmani pramodate |||51 || prakāśate’mbare sūryo nirvāte dīpako yathā | taṃ prapaśyanti munayo brahmayonaya īśvarāḥ ||52|| taṃ paraṃ paramātmānaṃ dṛśyetātmadṛśā tadā | ātmadṛṣṭirmatā vidyā avidyā mānasī dṛśiḥ ||53 || avidyā sarganāśāḍhyā vidyā muktirhi śāśvatī | avyaktaṃ sṛjate’vidyāṃ vidyā cātmābhipadyate ||54|| avidyayā mṛtiṃ yāyād vidyayāmṛtamṛcchati | vidyālābhe tvātmano vai viveko bahuśākhavān ||55|| kṛtātmanaḥ prajāyeta śṛṇu rājan vadāmi te | kiṃ mayā kṛtametāvatkālena māyikena vai |||56|| ajñeneva jhaṣeṇātra jālaṃ samanuvartitam | jalādanyanna jānāti matsyo jalāptajīvanaḥ ||57|| tathā nāhaṃ paraṃ kaṃcijjñātavān bhramachāditaḥ | mamācāre bhrame dhigdhigastu mohānuvartane ||58|| mohānuvartanaṃ prāpya nāvediṣaṃ pareśvaram | māyayāhaṃ sthitaśchanno vañcitaḥ paramātmani ||59|| māyayāhaṃ vaśīkṛtaḥ kālametaṃ na buddhavān | vañcito’smyanayā yaddhi mokṣamārgaṃ na labdhavān ||2.256.60|| na cāyamaparādho’syā aparādho mamāpi ca | yo’hamatrāvasaṃ sakto lubdho viṣayavāsanaḥ ||6 1 || arūpaścāpyamūrtaśca rūpamūrto’bhavaṃ tayā | prākṛtena mamatvena dharṣito vañcitastataḥ ||62|| mamakāravihīnena mayā mamatvasañjuṣā | kiṃ kṛtaṃ prakṣipya mokṣaṃ nirayaṃ yat pralabdhavān ||63|| nānayā mama kāryaṃ vai śiṣyate vārayoṣitā | ātmānaṃ bahudhā kṛtvā yā māṃ yunakti vañcane ||64|| athedānīṃ prabuddho’smi kṛpayā sadgurorhareḥ | apetyemāṃ śrayāmyadya parameśaṃ guruṃ prabhum ||65|| sāmyaṃ yāsyāmi devena nānayā kūṭayoṣitā | kṣemaṃ kṛṣṇena yāsyāmi vrajiṣyāmi paraṃ padam ||66 || evaṃ kṛtvā vivekotthaṃ nirṇayaṃ cātmanā tataḥ | saṃgadharmā hareḥ saṃgāddharitulyo’bhipadyate || 67|| etaduktaṃ parabrahma yasmānnāvartate punaḥ | rājan yena paraṃ jñānaṃ prāptaṃ cedṃ pramokṣadam ||68 || yena kṣarākṣare jñāte bhayaṃ tasya na vidyate | śreyaḥ prakurvataścātra bhayaṃ cāpi na yasya ha || 69 || tasya bhayaṃ pare loke kadāpi naiva jāyate | dharmaṃ satāṃ hitaṃ puṃsāṃ cāśrayato bhayaṃ na vai ||2.256.70 || svādukāmukakāmānāṃ vaitṛṣṇyaṃ nirbhayaṃ sadā | jñāne dharme paricayaṃ kurvato na bhayaṃ kvacit ||7 1 || nityaṃ vai bahudātuśca sādhūnāṃ sevinaḥ sadā | satāṃ satkāraśīlasya bhayaṃ naiva bhavet kvacit || 72 || nyāyamarhāya dātuśca hṛdā śuddhasya vedinaḥ | viraktasya visaṃgasya bhayaṃ naiva bhavet kvacit ||7 3 || sarvanirhṛtadoṣasya sarvaprāṇiprasevinaḥ | paropakāraśīlasya bhayaṃ naiva bhavet kvacit || 74|| titikṣoḥ sahamānasya krodhahīnasya dehinaḥ | saralasya hitakarturbhayaṃ naiva prapadyate || 75 || śubhāśrayasya dātuśca saṃyamino dayājuṣaḥ | sarvatra mānabhāvasya bhayaṃ naiva bhavet kvacit ||76 || dhṛtātmanaḥ praśāntasya prājñasya bhakticāriṇaḥ | tapasvinaḥ sevakasya bhayaṃ naiva hi jāyate ||77|| dharmādharmavimuktasya sarvasaṃśayanāśinaḥ | janmamṛtyuvimuktasya paraṃ śreyo hi niścitam ||78 || puṇyapāpavimuktasya brahmānugrahayoginaḥ | dehatrayātiriktasya paraṃ śreyo hi niścitam ||79|| mūlaprakṛtitattve ca vikārāṇāṃ ca ṣoḍaśe | prakṛtivikṛtau cāpi yo baddhaḥ sa mucyate ||2.256.8 0 || anyaṃ dehaṃ nijaṃ cānyaṃ vidyād yaḥ sa na lipyate | anyacca maśakaṃ vidyādanyadudumbaraṃ tathā ||8 1 || navodumbarayogena maśakastatra lipyate | anya ca matsyakaṃ vidyādanyad vidyājjalaṃ tathā ||82|| na cāpāṃ saṃprasaṃgena matsyastatra pralipyate | anyaścāgniścullikānyā cullyāgnirnaiva lipyate | | 83 || jalaṃ cānyan padmamanyadadbhiḥ padmaṃ na lipyate | eteṣāṃ sahavāsaśca nivāso mitha eva ha || 84 | | tathāpyetatpṛthagbhāvaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati | evaṃ vai paśyatastatrāśrayanāśe na bandhanama | |85 | | tattajjīvanapūrāccedadhikaṃ jīvanaṃ milet | tato jīvanamāsādya sukhaṃ tatra pramodate || 86 || paramātmā jīvanaṃ vai sarvānandāmṛtapradam | tamāśrayaṃ samāsādya bhayaṃ mṛtyurna nāśanam | | 87 | | paraṃśreyaḥ paraṃbrahma parāmuktiḥ paraṃ padam | ajarāmaralokaścāvyayānandasukhābdhikam | | 88 yukto muktaḥ sadā cātra nijātmani samaśnute | nityaprasādastṛptātmā sukhasvapananirvṛtaḥ || 89 | | meghairyathā śilā naiva calatyayaṃ tathāvidhaḥ | na kampettu kṛtairghoṣagarjanāgītavādanaiḥ | | 2.256. 90 | | tailapātraṃ kare kṛtvā rajjvā naṭaḥ prayāti ca | sthālyāpi saṃyatātmā vai nirbhayaḥ kampavarjitaḥ | | 91 | | nāsya pātrāt sravate ca tailabindurmanāgapi | prayāti cottaraprāntaṃ tayā yukto jayaṃ labhet || 92 || etādṛśo brahmayuktaḥ paśyati brahma cātra ha | parabrahma samāsādya mukto mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 93 | | ityevaṃ rādhike bhūpaṃ copadiśya ca lomaśaḥ | śāntiṃ cāvāpa rājā ca punaḥ papraccha tatsṛtim | | 94| | yathā muktā mahātmāno muktā naiḥśreyasārthinaḥ | prayānti cotkramaṇādyaistāni papraccha lomine || 95 | | iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyām ātmanaḥ kṣaramocanaṃ cākṣaragamanaṃ ca kathaṃ neti praśraḥ, taduttaraṃ tanmocanaṃ tadgamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 256 | |
<2.257> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca yadā dehāt pṛthagbhūtaḥ śuddhaścātmā prayāti hi | rādhe kathaṃ prayātyevaṃ papraccha lomaśaṃ nṛpaḥ | | 1 | | aśvapāṭala uvāca ṛṣe cotkramaṇaṃ kīdṛk kathaṃ kasmān prayātyayam | ātmā dehādviniṣkramya tadvadasva mama prabho || 2 || śrīlomaśa uvāca yadyatsthānād viniryāti yathā yogatapobalāt | yathā bhaktibalāccāpi yathā puṇyabalādapi || 3 || yathā pāpabalāccāpi yathā karmabalādapi | yathā māyābalāccāpi vāsanābalato’pi ca || 4 || tattatsthānasthadevānāṃ lokān prayāti tadyathā | padbhyāṃ nirgatya cedyāti viṣṇusthānaṃ prayāti vai || 5 || jaṃghābhyāṃ cetprayātyeṣo vasūnāṃ yāti mandiram | ūrubhyāṃ cetprayātyeṣaḥ prajāpatiṃ prayāti saḥ | pāyunā cetprayātyeṣo maitraṃ sthānaṃ prapadyate || 6 || liṃgād yonyā prayāpyeṣaḥ satyalokaṃ prapadyate | jaghanena prayātyeṣo merusthānamavāpnuyāt || 7 || nābheścotkramate cedvai devānāṃ svargamāpnuyāt | pārśvābhyāṃ maruto lokān cetprayāti prapadyate || 8 || bāhubhyāṃ cotkramate cedindralokamavāpnuyāt | urasā cet prayātyeṣo rudralokamavāpnuyāt| || 9 || grīvayā yāti cedeṣo naralokamavāpnuyāt | mukhena cetprayātyeṣo viśvedevānavāpnuyāt || 2.257.10 || śrotreṇotkramaṇe cāsya dikpālatvaṃ bhavediti | ghrāṇena gamane vāyorlokāvāptirbhavediti || 11 || netrābhyāṃ gamane sūryalokaṃ candrālayaṃ ca vā | kapolābhyāṃ prayāṇe ca vahnilokaṃ prayāti saḥ || 1 2|| bhrūbhyāmasya prayāṇe cāśvinorlokamavāpnuyāt | lalāṭena prayāṇe tu pitṛlokagatirbhavet || 13 || mūrdhnā cotkramaṇe yāti brahmalokaṃ sanātanam | cakrebhyaścet prayātyeva suṣumṇāmārgamāśritaḥ || 14|| tadā tattadīśvarāṇāṃ lokāneṣa prayāti ha | sthānabalādidaṃ proktamutkramaṇaṃ narādhipa || 15|| upāsanābalāccāpyutkramaṇaṃ vai viśiṣyate | pāpapuṇyabalāccāpi gamanaṃ vai vibhidyate || 16 || śaṃbhorupāsanād yāti kailāsaṃ gaṇamaṇḍitam | viṣṇorupāsanād yāti śvetadvīpaṃ payodadhim || 17|| naranārāyaṇabhaktyā prayāti badarīpatim | sūryagāyatrikābhaktyā yāti sūryasya maṇḍalam || 18 || yajñādyupāstikriyayā svargaṃ yāti makhārthavān | pitrupāsanayā pitṛlokaṃ yāti hi mānavaḥ || 1 9|| brahmacaryāt siddhalokaṃ satyalokaṃ tapovidheḥ | pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena yāti vairājadhāma ca ||2.257.20|| mahāviṣṇorupāstyā ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti mānavaḥ | nārāyaṇopāsanayā mahāvaikuṇṭhamṛcchati ||2 1 || rādhākṛṣṇopāsanayā golokaṃ vindatīti vai | māyopāstyā māyikām̐śca lokānāvaraṇādikān ||22|| bhūmnaścopāsanayā cāvyākṛtaṃ yāti mānavaḥ | vāsudevopāsanayāmṛtaṃ dhāma prayāti ca ||23 || kapilādyāvatārāṇāmupāstyā tattadālayān | akṣaropāsanayā yātyakṣaraṃ dhāma śāśvatam ||24|| parabrahmopāsanayā paraṃdhāma prapadyate | anupāstyā karmabhiśca yāti yoniṣu janmavān ||25|| tāmasaiḥ karmabhirdaityo dānavo rākṣaso bhavet | tiryagyoniṃ prayātyeṣaḥ sthāvarādīn viśatyapi ||26|| rājasaiḥ karmabhiryāti rājyaṃ śreṣṭhinamityapi | vasūn gāndharvalokām̐śca lokapālān dyuvāsinaḥ ||27|| sāttvikairjāyate vipraḥ sādhurvā puṇyadevatā | pāpaiḥ prajāyate pakṣī paśuḥ kīṭo mṛgo’pi vā | |28| | puṇyaiḥ prajāyate rājā devo guruḥ satī vratī | ṛṇinastu prajāyante vāhā aśvavṛṣādayaḥ || 29|| dātāraśca prajāyante pūjyāsanavirājitāḥ | evaṃ vai bhinnaśakaṭaiḥ prayānti bhinnamandiram || 2.257.3 0|| gārhasthye vartamānāśca jñānānalasamanvitāḥ | pradahya sarvakarmāṇi prakāśyātmānamātmani ||3 1 || prayānti paramaṃ brahma yathā sanyāsino’malāḥ | asannyastā hi sannyastā jñānasanyāsamāśritāḥ ||3 2|| aśvapāṭala uvāca asannyastāḥ kathaṃ proktāḥ sannyastā iti vai guro | kathaṃ yānti ca gārhasthyasthitāstā paramāṃ gatim || 3 3|| śrīlomaśa uvāca ākarṇaya nṛpātrāpi kathāṃ tu paramādbhutām | ānartanṛpateḥ kuśalāyoginyā vai purābhavām ||34|| saurāṣṭre kṛṣṇabhakto vai rājā ānartako’bhavat | yenedaṃ vāsitaṃ surāṣṭrakaṃ cānāyya kṛṣṇataḥ ||35 || rājāsau vaiṣṇavo bhakto patnīvratadvijānugaḥ | jñānaṃ hyavāptavān patnīvratād viprāddhi tāttvikam || 36|| vartate sma ca sādhūnāṃ sabhāyāṃ jñānatatparaḥ | jñānaśāstreṇa saṃchidyāhaṃmametiprabandhanam ||37|| yoge santiṣṭhate nityaṃ samādhau parameśvare | sādhūnāṃ ca maharṣīṇāṃ bhavanti jñānavārtikāḥ || 38||| yatsabhāyāṃ sadā sāyaṃ camatkārapure nṛpa | tena kīrtirdiganteṣu vyāptā cānartayoginaḥ || 39 || tāṃ śrutvā kuśalā sādhvī yoginī siddhisaṃbhṛtā | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetravāsinī pārameśvarī || 2.257.40 || yāvadyogakalāpūrṇā parakāyapraveśinī | iṣṭarūpadharā vijñā tattvajñānārthaśevadhiḥ ||41 || vaiṣṇavī jaraṭhā dehadharmān vimatya tāpasī | ātmadharmamayī gurvī bhūtadharmāhatā satī ||42|| vartamānā brāhmabhāve’lakṣyaliṃgā narāyaṇī | parabhāvaṃ gatā kṛṣṇe sarvasannyāsavartinī || 43 || vaśe yasyā yathā lakṣmyā jagatsarvaṃ tathāvidhā | yathāvatāriṇī devī satī ca śivaśaktikā | | 44|| kuśalākhyā tu sā sādhvī camatkārapuraṃ yayo | kṛtvā rūpaṃ sundaraṃ codbhinnayauvanamuttamam || 45 | ānarttaṃ nṛpatiṃ prāptā vṛtaṃ sadasi sādhubhiḥ | yogibhirnyāsibhiścāpi maharṣibhiśca vedibhiḥ | |46|| sarve dṛṣṭvā saukumāryaṃ paraṃ tasyā navaṃ vayaḥ | keyaṃ kasya kutaścātretyāsan samprāptavismayāḥ | |47| | rājāpi svāgataṃ cakre dadau sadasi cāsanam | satkṛtā cāpi sammānairyoginī kuśalā satī ||48|| praṣṭuṃ cecchāvatī bhūpaṃ yogabandhairbabandha tam | maukṣadharme prasiddho’yaṃ rājā sarvatra gīyate ||49|| mukto rājā sāttvato’yaṃ kīdṛgāste vilokaye | ānartasya buddhisattve drāk svabuddhyā viveśa sā ||2.257.50|| netrābhyāṃ netrayorasya raśmīn saṃyamya raśmibhiḥ buddhivṛttīḥ praviveśa vijetuṃ jñānamārgaṇaiḥ ||5 1 || dvayoryogavidorbuddhau vivādo ghaṭate hṛdi | tayorekasya yogitve’parasya tu parājayaḥ |||52||| ayogī na jayaṃ yāti rājāyaṃ tādṛśo na vā | vicāryeti satī buddhau vaśīcakāra taṃ nṛpam ||53|| rājā vijñāya tadbhāvaṃ mūkāṃ kurve tu yoginīm | iti buddhyā satī buddhiṃ jagrāha yogasadbalaiḥ ||54|| nṛpadehe praviṣṭāṃ tāṃ satkṛtya buddhivigrahe | liṃgadehe hyavasthāpya rājā tasthau tayā saha ||55|| sthūladehāsaṃginau tau liṅgadehe sthitau tadā | yoginau svajayārthaṃ ca mitho vādaṃ pracakratuḥ ||56|| ānarta uvāca yogasatyāḥ kva caryeyaṃ kṛtā kva ca gamiṣyasi | kasya ca tvaṃ kuto veti kā ca kathaṃ hyupasthitā ||57|| ahaṃ rājāpi taccihnairmukto’smi yogamāsthitaḥ | sa tvāṃ jñātuṃ samicchāmi mānārhe yogini drutam ||58|| mayā patnīvratākhyād vai guroḥ prāptaṃ viśeṣataḥ | yogajñānaṃ viśālaṃ ca mokṣaśceti ca me śṛṇu ||59|| tattvajñāne ca yogarddhau rājyavidhau ca vai mayā | trividhe mokṣade prāptaṃ sthairyaṃ carāmyarāgakaḥ ||2.257.6 0 || mokṣasya kāraṇaṃ rāgābhāvo jñānena ceyate | jñānenārāgatādvārā mokṣasiddhirmayā kṛtā ||6 1 || advandvaścāpyasaṃgaśca tiṣṭhāmyacalabuddhitaḥ | śuṣkakṣetraṃ jalahīnaṃ sabījaṃ cāpi cāṃkure ||62 || kāraṇaṃ na bhavatyeva tathāhaṃ śuṣkatāṃ gataḥ | nābhirajyāmi miṣṭaiśca krūraiḥ khedaṃ karomi na ||63 | | candanenārcayed dakṣe vāme śastreṇa bhedayet | kaścinmāṃ tulyatā tatra sādhvi me vartate ṛtā ||64|| sukhyahaṃ kṛtasarvārthaḥ samakaṃkarakāñcanaḥ | asaṃgo rājyabhāve’pi varte sādhusamāgame | |65| | mokṣe hetu trikaṃ cāste jñānaṃ vivekajaṃ tathā | karmaṇāṃ cāpi sannyāso bhaktirvā paramātmanaḥ ||66 || mayā trikaṃ guroḥ prāptaṃ miśritaṃ yattu muktaye | karma bhaktyanvitaṃ sarvaṃ karomi ca vivekataḥ ||67|| yathā sannyāsinaḥ śreṣṭhā naiṣkarmyaṃ vai samāśritāḥ | tathā yame ca niyame kāme dveṣe parigrahe ||68|| māne daṃbhe ratau snehe naiṣkarmyaṃ prāptavānaham | yadi te mokṣagantāraḥ kathaṃ nāhaṃ tathāgatiḥ ||6 9|| parṇakuṭyāṃ vasatāṃ cenmokṣo jāyeta sarvathā | mahāsaudhe vasato me kathaṃ mokṣo na hastagaḥ ||2.257.70 || yasyārtho yena yenāsti tattadālambate janaḥ | kaścid daṇḍaṃ ca mālāṃ ca kaścicchatraṃ ca cāmare ||7 1 || gārhasthye doṣamāvīkṣya gatvā tyāgāśrame yatiḥ | utsṛjan prathamān dharmān gṛhṇan parān yathocitān ||72|| saṃgahāneḥ saṃgamāpya sa mucyeta na saṃgataḥ | ādhipatyaṃ mama rājye teṣāṃ vanye hi tulyakam ||73 || yadi mucyeta vai bhikṣurnāhaṃ mucye kathaṃ vada | bhojanaṃ cāmbaraṃ pānaṃ nidrāpekṣitasaṃgrahaḥ || 74|| ādhipatyaṃ kvāpi yatra tulyaṃ vai bhikṣuṇā mama | te yadi muktibhāgā vai mamāpi muktireva ha ||75|| yadi te bandhabhāgā vai tadā tulyāḥ kuṭumbibhiḥ | atha jñānena mokṣo’sti vṛthā kāṣāyadhāraṇam ||76|| vṛthā veṣṭanasantyāgo vṛthā jaṭāpradhāraṇam | vṛthā svarṇāmbaratyāgo vṛthāgnivastradhāraṇam ||77|| vṛthā pakvānnasadgrāsatyāgo bhikṣā vṛthā tataḥ | yadi jihveṣu satsveva jñānaṃ vai mokṣakāraṇam ||78|| āśramocitacihnāḍhyaṃ jñānaṃ me mokṣakāraṇam | yadvā duḥkhāni pāpāni vīkṣya tyāgāśrame matiḥ ||79|| tadā sukhāni puṇyāni vīkṣya gṛhāśrame samā | rāgadveṣaprayuktā vā pravṛttirbandhane samā ||2.257.80|| ākiñcanyaṃ vinā jñānaṃ kvāpyāśrame na vidyate | kaiṃcanyaṃ bandhanaṃ sarvāśrame tulyaṃ ca me’pi te ||81 || tasmāt kuśale dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu sarvathā | bandhanāyataneṣveva sthitaṃ māṃ viddhyasaṃginam ||82||| rājyaiśvaryaṃ dhruvaḥ pāśaḥ snehakarmādibandhanaḥ | mokṣadhārāvatā jñānāsinā chinno mayā sati ||83|| jñānāt tyāge vicarāmi saṃgaṃ prāpnomi naiva ha | nāhaṃ rājye’pi rājeva nipatāmi ca baddhavat ||84|| jñānāgninā mayā dagdhā vāsanāgranthayastataḥ | deharājye vicarāmīndriyādibhiḥ kuṭumbibhiḥ ||85|| nirbandho’haṃ vicarāmi satāṃ samāgame sthitaḥ | mokṣe sthito’smi no bandhe no rājye’pi tu vai vane ||86|| so’hamevaṃ sadā muktastvayi jātādaraḥ sati | pṛcchāmi tvāṃ kathaṃ muktā viruddharūpadhāriṇi ||87|| saundaryaṃ kāñcanābhāḍhyaṃ saukumāryaṃ navaṃ vapuḥ | vayo’gryaṃ rūpasampannaṃ sarvāḍhyā tvaṃ kathaṃ satī ||88|| sādhvī cenna bhaved raktā sarāgā sādhvikā na vai | tavobhayaṃ nānurūpaṃ vīkṣya yogarddhimityapi ||89|| mukteyaṃ vā navetyevaṃ saṃśayitaḥ sabhājanaḥ | bhogarājasabhāvāḍhyā śṛṃgāratānasaṃyutā ||2.257.90|| kathaṃ tvaṃ yogasampannā sādhvīti saṃprakāśase | mama yogaṃ gatā ca tvaṃ sparśadoṣābhisaṃvṛtā ||9 1 || me hṛdo nigrahakartrī kathaṃ śāstrī hi yoginī | yastvāṃ rāṣṭre sabhāyāṃ me sampraveśitavān janaḥ ||92|| tatparigrahamāpannā śīlād bhraṣṭā vibhāvyase | punarmāṃ kṣatriyaṃ prāpya mā kṛthā varṇasaṃkaram ||93|| sādhvī tvaṃ mokṣadharmāhaṃ rājadharmā gṛhāśramī | āvayośca hṛdaurekye dvitīyo dharmasaṃkaraḥ ||94|| tasmāt svātantryamādāya vartase cet prayogiṇī | yoginyāstava dharmādiśrutaṃ viplavate’dhunā ||95|| bhāvena jetumicchāsti jayāśā bandhanānvitā | baddhā tvaṃ matsamā nāsi na te hastaparigrahaḥ ||96|| yadvā matpakṣagān sarvān māṃ vijitya jitāniti | darśayituṃ bhavatyavaṣṭaṃbhaste tarhi mohinī ||97|| amarṣayuktā mohena mugdhā jetuṃ samicchasi | yogākhyaṃ ca viṣāktaṃ taccāmṛtaṃ tvayi saṃsthitam ||98|| icchatoryoga utkṛṣṭo’nicchatostu viṣopamaḥ | mā pradarśaya śraiṣṭhyaṃ svaṃ mukto vā na nṛpo hyayam ||99|| rājñāṃ balaṃ mahaiśvaryaṃ strīṇāṃ rūpāḍhyayauvanam | balaṃ brahma hi muktānāṃ mā balaṃ me pradarśaya || 2.257.10 0|| ārjavenābhigantavyā balinaḥ sukhadā hi te | anārjavena balino nāśayanti tathāgatam || 10 1|| sā tvaṃ dhārṣṭyaṃ vihāyaiva jātiṃ kulaṃ śrutaṃ tapaḥ | vṛttiṃ bhāvaṃ sthitiṃ cecchāṃ kāryaṃ me tattvato vada || 1 02|| lomaśa uvāca ityevaṃ bahubhirvākyairayuktairasamañjasaiḥ | ānartena nirādṛṣṭā kuśalā na bhayaṃ hyagāt || 103 || aśvapāṭalaḥ sā sādhvī tato’pi cārudarśanā | cāruprajñā pracakrāmottarayituṃ tato’dhikam || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāmātmano dehād viniṣkramaṇe hetupradarśanaṃ sanyastāsannyastavicāre ānartanṛpakuśalāyoginīsamvādaścetinirūpaṇanāmā saptapaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 257 ||
<2.258> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike lomaśaścāśvapāṭalaṃ ca tataḥ param | kuśalāyāḥ prativādaṃ prāha yathābhisaṃbhavam || 1 || śrīlomaśa uvācaaśvapāṭala kuśalā yogapāraṃ gatā satī | tattvajñānānaladagdhakaṣāyovāca tacchrṛṇu || 2 || kuśalovācaśṛṇvānarta bhavānāste tulādvayakṛtāspadaḥ | gārhasthyaṃ rakṣyase vākyairyogitvaṃ ca vitanyase || 3 || kuśalāyāścākauśalyaṃ bodhayase pradūṣaṇaiḥ | kalmaṣaṃ cedṛśaṃ rājan mukte cāste kathaṃ tvayi | | 4 || āptaṃ vākyaṃ pramāṇaṃ vai yogyatādisamanvitam | śaktyopabṛṃhitaṃ jātisārūpyādisabhājitam || 5 || jalpādidoṣaśūnyaṃ ca bhrāntikṣetrānna codgatam | lakṣaṇāśleṣabhāvādyaiḥ spaṣṭaṃ spaṣṭārthasaṃbhṛtam || 6 || vākyaṃ tādṛkpramāṇaṃ me cānartaikamanāḥ śṛṇu | yathā piṣṭaṃ ca pāṣāṇo meghaśca dhūmramaṇḍalam || 7 || saṃśliṣṭāni tathānarta saṃśliṣṭāḥ prāṇadhāriṇaḥ | śabdaḥ sparśo raso gandho rūpaṃ khavābbhūvahnayaḥ || 8 || saṃśliṣṭāḥ piṣṭavad rājan śilāvatte tathātmani | vilīyante meghavacca viśīryante ca dhūmravat || 9 || na svatvaṃ te vijānanti kathaṃ parapravedanam | manastaiḥ saha saṃyuktaṃ tadā bāhye’nuyanti ca || 2.258.10 | | codbhūtatvaṃ ca tatrāpi mahattvaṃ bāhyayogitā | ātmano yogitā cāpi grāhye bhavanti hetavaḥ || 11 || evaṃ sarvatra bāhyānāṃ grahaṇe hetavaḥ khalu | manaḥ saṃkalpya madbhāvaṃ tato buddhirviniścayam | | 1 2|| karotyevābhimānena mataṃ cātmani darpaṇe | nikṣipati tadātmāyaṃ mamedamiti manyate || 13 || vāsanā jāyate taiśca dṛṣṭamuktaiḥ smṛtipradā | avidyā ca tamo vāpi sauṣuptājñānamuttaram || 14|| bhramātmakaṃ ca vā tatra smaraṇaṃ jāyate muhuḥ | tataḥ sukhāsukhe lābhālābhau priyāpriye’pi ca || 15 || tatra kālo bhaveddhetuḥ prakṛtiśca prapūrikā | adṛṣṭaṃ yādṛśaṃ tādṛk phalaṃ sampadyate tataḥ || 16 || caturviṃśatisaṃghātaścaiva vedanakāraṇam | avyaktāṃ na vijānāti jānāti vyaktarūpiṇīm || 17|| sthūladarśī sa evokto mamāhaṃmiśritaḥ sa ca | avyaktāṃ yo vijānāti sa tvātmānaṃ prapaśyati || 18 || adhyātmacintakaḥ so’yaṃ paraṃ pāraṃ prayāsyati | vyaktāḥ kalāḥ prākṛtā yāḥ sarve vayaṃ narāḥ striyaḥ || 1 9|| bindugarbhāsanāḥ pūrve śukraśoṇitapiṇḍikāḥ | kalalāṃ daśarātreṇa budbudṃ peśikā tataḥ || 2.258.20 || tataścāṃgāni jāyante nakharomāntakāni ca | navame māsi bālaśca strī vā purmoṃśca vetarat| || 21 || liṃgādhīnāni nāmāni tataḥ kumāratādikam | sukumārāvayavānāṃ nāma kumārasaṃjñakam || 22|| abuddhasyeva tasyaiva bāliśasya tu bālatā | yuvabhāvena kāmena yunaktīti yuvā mataḥ || 23 || tiṣṭhaṃstiṣṭhan prayātyeva vīro bhūtvā sthavīrakaḥ | evaṃ kṣaṇekṣaṇe’nyeṣāṃ kalānāṃ ca vivartanāt | | 24|| nāmarūpādibhedaśca sūkṣmo’yaṃ na vibhāvyate | nātyayo na prabhavaścaiteṣāṃ saṃlakṣyate nṛpa || 25 || dīpārcivad dhāvato’sya sarvalokasya sarvadā | kaḥ ko’yaṃ vā kutaśceti kimarthaṃ kasya kena vā || 26 || kuto no vā kathaṃ kasya kena vā neti kaḥ kimu | ityete khalu sambandhā bhūtānāṃ svāṃgakairapi || 27|| naivaṃ parasparaṃ śaktyā jñātuṃ gatvaraśālinām | ādityāt kiraṇānyeva samidbhyo vahnayo yathā | | 28 || jāyante kṣaṇikā ye vai śakyante naiva niścitum | tathā sarve prākṛtā vai jantavaḥ saṃhatātmanaḥ || 29 || saṃghātarūpā jāyante mriyante ca kṣaṇe kṣaṇe | ātmā nityaḥ śāśvato’sti svastho’saṃghāta eva saḥ || 2.258.30 | | sa ced yogaṃ samāpanno vivekī muktavatsthitaḥ | paśyatyeva ca saṃghātaṃ gatvaraṃ śāśvataṃ nijam || 31 | | ātmanyevātmanātmānaṃ yadi tvaṃ svaṃ prapaśyasi | anātmānaṃ pṛthagbhāvaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ cet prapaśyasi || 3 2|| evamevātmanātmānaṃ parātmānaṃ samastagam | yuktayogābhilābhena śāśvataṃ cet prapaśyasi || 33 || tathaivātmani cānyasmin samatāṃ ced vyavasyasi | atha māṃ kāsi kasyeti kimarthamanupṛcchasi || 34||| idaṃ me syādidaṃ neti dvandvairmuktasya te nṛpa | kāsi kasmāt kimarthaṃ vā vacanaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam || 35|| tathāpyanabhisandhāya pṛthagbhāvaṃ ca gatvaram | aikyaṃ dehena sandhāya praśne kā tvayi muktatā || 36 || rājye śatrau ca mitre ca madhyasthe cājaye jaye | mamāhaṃvedini kṣatre tvayi kā nāma muktatā || 37 || dharmārthakāmanāsakte phalasaṃgānuyāyinī | rājabhāvena garviṣṭhe kā nāma tvayi muktatā || 38 || nare nāryāṃ surūpe ca kurūpe bhedalokini | dehabhāvena saṃvyāpte kā nāma tvayi muktatā || 39 || dehadharmān puraskṛtya saṃgadoṣābhidhāyinī | prākṛtaṃ bhāvamāpanne kā nāma tvayi muktatā ||2.258.40 || yogena vartamāne’pi cāyogena viḍambine | prākṛtaṃ sparśamāpanne kā nāma tvayi muktatā ||4 1 | | jñānasya śevadhistvaṃ vai bhāṣase māṃ striyaṃ kṛtim | matvā vīkṣya ca rājendra kā nāma tvayi muktatā || 42|| prākṛte prākṛto bhāvaścetane cetano hi saḥ | yasya nāsti samaṃ cakṣuḥ kā tasmin muktatā tvayi || 43 || kuśalo’yaṃ cetano’sti saṃghāte parivartite | rājan viddhi ca māṃ divyaṃ cetanaṃ saṃgavarjitam ||44|| kā kasya ca kutaḥ kena kimarthaṃ dehasaṃgatam | tadbhinno’haṃ bhavāmyeṣa paśyātmānaṃ narīsthitam || 45 || draṣṭuṃ cecchakyase naivaṃ saṃghātāvṛttimān bhavān | tadayuktasya te mokṣe’bhimatirniṣphalā nṛpa ||46 || sādhubhiḥ sannivāryā sā hyapathyabhojinastava | yajjñātvā vartane nāsti jñāne nāsti tatastaram || 47|| vyavahāre sutarāṃ nāstīti kiṃ yogajaṃ phalam | vṛthā śramo vṛthā mānaṃ vṛthā vāgdūṣaṇaṃ tathā ||48 || vṛthā satsaṃgayatnaśca yadi dehaṃ prapaśyasi | ātmā nārī naro nāpi napuṃsako na cāsti ca ||49|| tvaṃ tathāsse ca ced rājan cekṣase na kathaṃ pare | prākṛtāni prasaṃvīkṣya pṛthakkṛtvātmatattvataḥ || 2.258.50 || sarvatrātmānamāpaśyet kimanyanmuktalakṣaṇam | saṃgasthānāni sarvāṇi paśyet parātmani prabhau ||5 1 || ātmakrīḍa ātmaratirmuktasyaiva hi lakṣaṇam | mokṣe sthitasya saṃgāḍhyasthānānyapi ca me śṛṇu || 5 2 || rājyād rāṣṭrasya sāmānyād rājadhānī hi bandhanam | tato’pi rājasaudhaśca sāmānyaṃ bandhanaṃ hi tat| || 53 || tato’pi svagṛhaṃ tatra śayyā svīyā hi bandhanam | sāpi cārdhā strīsahitā vinā striyaṃ na bandhanam || 54|| tryapi kāmakriyāmātraṃ bandhanaṃ na tataḥ param | tatrāpi vāsanā cet syād bandhanaṃ saṃgamūlakam | |5 5 || dhātulābhe kāraṇaṃ ca bhojanaṃ cauṣadhādikam | bandhanaṃ vai tato rājñaḥ sevakādi ca bandhanam | | |56 || evaṃ stryādiprasaṃgena phalenāpīha yujyate | bhojanācchādanavastrābhūṣaṇeṣu ca bandhanam ||57|| nigrahānugrahau cāpi rājño bhavato bandhane | pāratantryaṃ sadā rājñaḥ svalpakārye’pi mānataḥ ||58|| bhṛtyavaśyatvamevāpi yuddhasandhiṣu sarvathā | strīṣu krīḍāvihāreṣu mantre cāmātyamaṇḍale ||59|| paroktādyanugāmitvaṃ kuto rājñaḥ svatantratā | mantrivaśe sthitaścāste neṣṭaṃ cāpyavaśaścaret || 2.258.60 || nidrāṃ kāle na labhate vyāpṛtaḥ svārthibhirjanaiḥ | śayane’pi kvacit suptaścotthāpyate’ridūtakaiḥ ||6 1 || dāsībhiśca kvacinnityaṃ cājñāyāṃ kriyate vaśaḥ | uttiṣṭha snāhi saṃgṛhṇa piba prāśa bravīhi ca ||6 2 || śṛṇu cāgaccha ca paśya viramasva ramasva ca | ityevaṃ paratantro’yaṃ rājā saṃgavaśaḥ sadā | |6 3 || yācakāśca samāyānti dātuṃ notsahate’pi ca | dāne koṣakṣaye cintā vairaṃ cādānake bhavet | |64|| rakṣaṇe satataṃ cintā cintāsaṃgī nṛpaḥ sadā | rājā sarvān śaṃkate vai mṛtyubhayena noditaḥ || 65 || parasparaṃ bhayavanto bhavanti nṛpatajjanāḥ | sarvaḥ sve sve gṛhe rājā sarvaḥ sve sve gṛhe gṛhī || 66 || nigrahānugrahavantaḥ sarve tulyā gṛhe gṛhe | putrā dārā gṛhaṃ cātmā kośo mitrāṇi saṃcayāḥ || 6 7|| sarveṣāṃ tulyabhāvāste saṃgadā bandhanāni vai | hato deśaśca grāmaśca dagdho vāho hato mama || 68 || dhanaṃ naṣṭaṃ ca sasyāni dagdhāni ca himāgninā | pakṣibhirbhakṣitaṃ kṣetraṃ caurairhṛtāśca dhenavaḥ ||69 || rogairhataṃ bhojanaṃ me svatantratā hatāribhiḥ | vāgbāṇādyairdharṣito’haṃ copthāpito nṛpāsanāt ||2.258.7 0 || ityevaṃ saṃgabhāvaiśca mithyājñānairhi tapyate | niyantṛjanyaduḥkhaiśca mānasai rāgaroṣajaiḥ ||7 1 || rogāvamānajanyaiśca duḥkhairvai paritapyate | amuktasaṃgaḥ satataṃ prasahya duḥkhabhogavān ||72 || tadalpasukhamatyarthaṃ bahuduḥkhamasāravat | taptāṃgārāsanaṃ rājyaṃ ko’bhipadyeta yogavit ||73 || mamedaṃ nagaraṃ rājyaṃ manyase dhanamuttamam | kastvaṃ kasya dhanaṃ rājyaṃ nagaraṃ vada cātmavit ||74|| pāñcabhautikadeho’yaṃ tava vahnau pravekṣyati | mamāpi ca tathā tatra tulyatā na viśeṣatā ||75 || dehasya saṃgadharmasyāsaṃgo nāsti kutaścana | ādhārādheyabhāvasya prākṛtasya kṣayārthinaḥ ||76 || cetanasya tvasaṃgasya nāsti saṃgaḥ kutaścana | ādhārādheyaśūnyasyāprākṛtasya sadā sataḥ ||77|| vada rājan samarthāhaṃ jñāne vaktuṃ sahasradhā | strīdehe nābhiṣaṃgo me kutastava parigrahe ||78|| na strīṃ matvā saṃgabhāvaṃ vyaktaṃ vaktuṃ tvamarhasi | nanu nāma tvayā mokṣaḥ kṛtsnaḥ patnīvratācchrataḥ ||79|| asaṃgaścāpyapāśastvaṃ kathaṃ sakto’si rājyake | śrutaṃ te niṣphalaṃ sarvaṃ dehabhāvena saṃjuṣaḥ ||2.258.8 0 || śrutaṃ vā nirgataṃ karṇāt śāṭhyamātreṇa vartase | yadvā naiva dhṛtaṃ vā pācitaṃ naiva tvayātmanā ||8 1 || yena tvaṃ tiṣṭhase saṃge laukike daihike’dhunā | baddhastvaṃ dṛśyase cātman prākṛto bhikṣuko yathā ||82|| mayātmanā praveśaśca kṛtastvayyātmani prabhau | kiṃ tavāpakṛtaṃ tatra nityamuktasya me vada ||8 3 || sādhūnāṃ śūnyavāsitvaṃ niyamo’sti sadā nṛpa | śūnye praveśamāsādya mayā kiṃ te’tra dūṣitam ||84|| na bāhubhyāṃ na corubhyāṃ nāṃgaiḥ spṛśāmi sarvathā | mā vaktatyaṃ sabhāyāṃ vai tvayā mayā śubhāśubham || 85|| strīpuṃsoḥ samavāyākhyaṃ sadasadvā kṛtaṃ mithaḥ | sādhavo guravaścaite tvaṃ ca rājā gurūttamaḥ ||86|| yogiṣu yogivādā vai na vaktavyāḥ kadācana | padmapatre jalaṃ tiṣṭhadasaṃgaṃ tiṣṭhate yathā ||87|| tathā tvayi nivatsyāmi niḥsaṃgena nijātmanā | yogivṛttyā nivatsyāmi cātmalābhādhisiddhaye ||88 || yatra vai sādhavo dhīrā yatayo yogapāragāḥ | parameśapadārūḍhāḥ samūrtā nivasanti vai | | 89 || tatra vāsaṃ yogavṛttyā ka ātmā nābhivāñcchati | yadi tvayi mama vāse
