sparśaṃ jānāsi cennṛpa | | 2.258.90 || jñānaṃ kṛtamabījaṃ te sarvaṃ vai vāgvibhūṣaṇam | sa gārhasthyāccyutastvaṃ vai muktisthitiṃ na vindasi || 91 || ubhayorantarālastho bhavasīha viḍambakaḥ | nahi muktasya muktena jñasya jñena samāgame || 9 2|| jāyate dharmasāṃkaryaṃ sadharmayorhi yojanam | sattvena sattvayogaścātmanā yogastathātmanaḥ || 93|| yoginā yogino yogastatra saṃkaratā na vai | brahmajñastvaṃ tathā rājan brahmajñāhaṃ savarṇikā || 94|| āvayormelane naiva varṇasaṃkaratā matā | brahmaputrīdehavām̐śca brahmā vai somanāthake || 95|| somanāthapratiṣṭhārthaṃ cāhūtaḥ śaśinā purā | tadā yajñe samutpannā mānasī kuśalā kriyā || 96|| satīrūpāhamevāsmi kriyākhyā kuśalābhidhā | kraturyajñastasya patnī dehabhāvena cedṛśī || 97|| ātmabhāvena sādhvī ca yogapāraṃgatāsmi ca | tasmād rājan bhavāmyatra cātmā nāsmi narī vidhā || 98 || nātrāsti saṃkaraḥ kaścit samabhāvāgame punaḥ | mokṣe te bhāvitāṃ buddhiṃ śrutvā ca kuśalaiṣiṇī || 99|| kuśalā tava mokṣasya jijñāsārthamihāgatā | saurāṣṭre’trākṣare kṣetre cāśvapaṭṭasarovare || 2.258.100 || kṛtasthānā kuṃkumākhyavāpyāstīre vasāmi ca | ekarātriṃ śarīre te sthitvā yāsyāmi matsthalīm || 101 || nāhaṃ lubdhe ciraṃ rājan tiṣṭhāmi brahmayoginī | ātithyenātmabhāvena mānitā jñānabhojanaiḥ || 102|| aprāpya tulyayogasthaṃ śvo gamiṣyāmi matsthalīm | yatra tulyagatiścāste lomaśo yogavittamaḥ || 103 || svīyaprakāśo bhagavānātmavittama ityapi | tatraikībhūya kuśalā brahmānandaṃ vahāmi vai || 1 04|| rājan dhṛtaṃ mayā rūpaṃ kiyadyogabalāṃ sabhām | vīkṣituṃ vīkṣitaṃ sarvaṃ yatrāgryo dehadarśanaḥ || 105 || ime stabdhā hi munayo dehadarśanayoginaḥ | kimahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi mā stabdho bhava bhūpate || 106 || naivaṃ cātmabalaṃ rājan vardhate dehadarśinām | nātmalābho bhaveccāpi sadṛśānāṃ vihāriṇām || 1 07|| na gārhasthyād bhavenmuktiścātmarūpo na yāvatā | vartate muktasaṃgo vai tāvatsaṃsāralagnatā || 108 || ānarta mā ruṣaṃ dhehi tathyaṃ bhakṣaya pācaya | yogeśvaratāsiddhyarthaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro vraja || 10 9|| svīyaprakāśaṃ yogīndraṃ lomaśaṃ yogisadgurum | santuṣṭāṃ yoginīṃ devīṃ saṃbhajasvācyuto bhava || 2.258.110 || śrīlomaśa uvāca ityevaṃ vadamānāṃ tāṃ tvānarto bhūpatistadā | neme vāsārhahṛdayaṃ dadau tatra samādhinā || 111 || saṃvādaṃ cātmanostatra cāprātaścakraturhyubhau | ṛṣayo jñātabhāvāśca svasvasthānaṃ yayustataḥ || 11 2|| aśvapāṭala cānarto jñātvā naijāṃ hi nimnatām | kuśalātaḥ parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ viveda sahayoginaḥ || 113 || tatastayā samaṃ prāyādaśvapaṭṭasarovaram | yatra pūrṇaṃ yogabalaṃ hyavāpya lomaśānmuneḥ || 11 4|| svasya prakāśādātmīyaṃ bodhaṃ prāpya mahottamam | santuṣṭāyoginītaśca brāhmīṃ sthitiṃ praśikṣya ca || 1 15|| ānartaḥ prayayau naijaṃ camatkārapuraṃ prati | tasmād rājan gṛhasthānāṃ tyāgitvaṃ samapekṣate || 1 16|| yadvā tyāgavatāṃ yogānmokṣo hastagato bhavet | sādhūnāṃ saṃgamāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo miled dhruvam || 1 17|| apūrṇasyāpi pūrṇatvaṃ sarvayatne samāpyate | asannyastā gṛhasthā vai sannyastā guruyogataḥ || 1 18|| prajāyanta kuśalāyā yogenānartako yathā | tādṛśānāṃ satāṃ yogād gṛhasthāḥ paramāṃ gatim || 11 9|| prayāntyeva na sandeho māyālubdhā api dhruvam | ityuktvā rādhike śrīmān lomaśo maunamāvahat || 2.258.120 || aśvapāṭalarājāpi śrutvā tṛptiṃ jagāma ha | tattīrthaṃ kuśalātīrthaṃ cānartatīrthamityapi || 121 || yogitīrthaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarojale pravidyate | yatsnānād yadvāripānādātmadarśanamṛcchati || 122|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyām ānartarājena saha brahmaputrīkuśalāsādhvyā vivādo gārhasthye’pi tyāgāt sādhusamāgamādvā muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 258 ||
<2.259> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca samākarṇaya rādhe tvaṃ tataścāśvanṛpaḥ punaḥ | papraccha lomaśaṃ yat tat pravadāmi satāṃ hitam || 1 || aśvapāṭala uvāca guro svīyaprakāśasya nirvedaḥ śāśvatāśrayaḥ | kathaṃ vyajāyata tattvaniścayaścākṛterhareḥ || 2 || śrīlomaśa uvāca brahmakallolasaṃjñasya pūrvakalpatapasvinaḥ | bhaktaviprasya putro’bhūnnāmnā trivikramaḥ prabhuḥ || 3 || śrīhareravatāraḥ sa punaḥ kalpāntare hariḥ | trivikramo babhūvāyaṃ prabaleḥ rājyahṛt tadā || 4 || so’yaṃ svarṇanadītīre dadarśāmānavaṃ naram | akasmād hṛdaye yoge nārāyaṇahradasthale || 5 || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhanuḥśūlaśarānvitam | dhvajasvastikavajrādicihnadakṣakarānvitam || 6 || hasantaṃ tejasā vyāptaṃ prasannaṃ dīrghanetrakam | ājānubhujamatyarthaṃ cojjvalaṃ śrīsamanvitam || 7|| svīyaprakāśo bhagavān svaṃ dadarśa tadantare | brahmarūpaṃ vāmanaṃ trivikramaṃ prabalergurum || 8 || nijāṃ mūrtiṃ vilokyaiva śrīmannārāyaṇe tadā | kṣaṇaṃ mumoha sahasā ko’yaṃ pṛthaṅ vyacintayam || 9 || tato divyadṛśā naijaṃ mūlaṃ rūpaṃ bubodha saḥ | tuṣṭāva śrīkṛṣṇadevaṃ svāminaṃ parameśvaram || 2.259.10 || antarātman parātmam̐stvaṃ sarvāvatāradhāraka | sarvāvirbhāvahetustvaṃ sarveṣāṃ hṛdaye sthitaḥ || 11 || sarvaṃ te hṛdaye cāste brahmābrahmamayaṃ vapuḥ | ahaṃ pṛthaṅnivāso’smi cāpṛthaṅavāsavām̐stvayi || 1 2|| tvameva paramaṃ tattvaṃ kṛpayā me’kṣi gocaraḥ | gocare mama rūpaṃ cāparokṣānubhavāñcitam || 13 || ātmadarśanamāsādya paramātmapradarśanam | ubhadarśanamāsādya kṛtakṛtyo’dya saṃvṛtaḥ || 14|| ājñāṃ dehi kṛpāsindho jagadbandho janārdana | prāpya tvāṃ paramātmānaṃ prāptavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate || 15|| kṛtvā tvadyogamudyānaṃ kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate | iti stutaḥ prabhuḥ śrīśo’nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 16 || svīyaprakāśamūrtau taṃ nijasthāyāṃ tato’dhikam | sarvaṃ saṃsāracakraṃ ca darśayāmāsa caikyataḥ || 17|| īśvarān brahmapuruṣān muktān dhāmānyanekaśaḥ | devānṛṣīn pitṛgaṇān deveśvarām̐śca mānavān || 18|| uragān rākṣasān daityān dānavānāsurānapi | paśūn pakṣiṇa evāpi sthāvarān jaḍacetanān || 1 9|| mahābhūtāni sarvāṇi tattvāni prakṛtiṃ sthirām | vikārān dehabhājaśca darśayāmāsa tallayān || 2.259.20 || evaṃ pradarśayitvaiva tirobhāvaṃ cakāra ha | tadidaṃ cāparokṣaṃ ca jñānaṃ śāśvatamātmagam || 21 || prakāśayitvā tasmai vai hṛdaye’sthāpayad dhruvam | varadānaṃ dadau tasmai nityaṃ te’stu prabhāmayam || 22|| jñānaṃ cedaṃ svataḥprakāśākhyaṃ māstu tirogatam | tataḥ ārabhya devo’yaṃ trivikramaḥ svataḥprabhaḥ ||23 || svataḥprakāśayogī ca khyāto babhūva yogiṣu | sa cārthayat vilokyaiva kṣetraṃ cākṣarasaṃjñakam ||24|| hṛdye harivāsāḍhyaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaronvitam | nijavāsārthamatyarthaṃ rūpaṃ divyaṃ tathāvidham || 25|| tathāstviti prāha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśca tatkṣaṇam | divyadeho’bhavattatra caturbhujo narāyaṇaḥ ||26||| mānasaḥ śrīhareḥ śiṣyo nityajñānāśrayaḥ sutaḥ | nārāyaṇahrade tatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai ||27||| sākaṃ snātvā tatastūrṇaṃ kuṃkumavāpikāsthalīm | prāpa yogena vegena balena kṛpayā hareḥ || 28|| evaṃ janmāntaraṃ dehāntaraṃ vṛttyantaraṃ tathā | kāyākalpaṃ hyavāpāsau putratvaṃ muktasaṃjñayā || 29|| avatārasvarūpeṇa viṣṇurūpeṇa sarvadā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamānasajākṛtim || 2.259.30 || divyāmavāpya satataṃ jātamātro narāyaṇaḥ | dharmavairāgyasampanno bhaktaḥ ṣoḍaśahāyanaḥ || 31 || babhūva kuṃkume kṣetre prabhuḥ kuṃkumavarṇakaḥ | naisargaśevadhiḥ sarvavidyānāṃ sa babhūva ha ||32|| sārvajñyāśraya evāpi sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ | sarvakalyāṇakartāsau yogidharmaparāyaṇaḥ ||33||| sarvātirekakāryaśca sarvātirekavarṇanaḥ | vicacārākṣare kṣetre tasmai kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||34|| anvaśāt sakalān dharmān gurupūrvīprasiddhaye | laukikān vaidikām̐ścāpi mānasām̐śca taduttarān ||35|| śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa uvāca putra tvaṃ sāttvatān dharmān niṣevasva hitāvahān | prāṇaṃ jaya sahasvāpi kṣutpipāse himātapau ||26|| jitvendriyāṇi tapasā satyaṃ damaṃ prapālaya | adrohamanasūyāṃ cārjavaṃ śīlaṃ prapālaya ||37|| devapitratithiprāptaśeṣānnayātrikāṃ hava | bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ pareśaṃ māṃ mā svapihi tamomaye ||38|| phenabudbudavatsthairye cetanāśritagatvare | ākasmike’jñavatputra mā viśvāsaṃ vidhehi vai || 39|| apramattā vinidrāśca nityayatnā hi śatravaḥ | chidraṃ paśyanti dehe’smin mā tvaṃ tairdharṣito bhava ||2.259.40 || divasāḥ kramaśo yānti kṛntanti vai janāyuṣam | jīvanaṃ kṣīyate nityaṃ guruṃ śaraṇamāvraja ||41|| ajñāścecchanti dehādyairmāṃsaśoṇitavardhanam | yadante gatvaraṃ sarvaṃ prasuptā mokṣasādhane |||42|| mā tanmātreṇa putra tvaṃ prayāhi prākṛto yathā | prāntaduḥkhaikamātreṇa yāmyabhavanavāhinā ||43 || yāhi satāṃ vṛṣasthānāṃ yogināṃ ca mahātmanām | dharmyaṃ panthānamevāptaṃ mokṣadaṃ cākṣarāntagam ||44|| upāsasva tataḥ samyak pṛccha dhāraya tadvacaḥ | manomanthaṃ sanniyaccha sthairyamāvaha satpatau ||45|| dharmaṃ niḥśreṇikāṃ dhṛtvā cāruhya bhaktibhūmikām | ātmaniṣṭhāpravegeṇa yāhi dhāma sanātanam || 46|| vāmataḥ kuru viprendra nāstikān bhaktivarjitān | āśāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ ruṣaṃ mohaṃ tyaja putra ca dūrataḥ ||47|| nāvaṃ yogaṃ samālambya tara saṃsāravāridhim | loko’yaṃ mṛtyunā nīto jarayā mardito’bhitaḥ ||48|| vahatyeva vaitaraṇyāṃ jñānapotena taṃ tara | tiṣṭhantaṃ vā vahantaṃ vā pibantaṃ śayane gatam ||49 || mṛtyuranvīkṣate martyaṃ mā tvaṃ tatkarago bhava | sañcinvānaṃ sukhārthāṃścātṛptaṃ lubdhaṃ ca māninam ||2.259.50 || anirvṛttaṃ vighnamardyaṃ garviṣṭhaṃ ca vimārgagam | ākasmikagatirmṛtyuḥ suptamādāya gacchati ||5 1 || andhakāramayaḥ koṣṭho brahmāṇḍodaranāmakaḥ | tadbahirgamanārthaṃ tvaṃ dīpaṃ jñānaṃ pradhāraya ||52 || anekadehacakreṣu gacchatsu niṣphaleṣu vai | divyapūṇyena brāhmaṇyaṃ prāptaṃ brahmamayaṃ vaha ||53 || brahmadeho mahān śreyān kṣudrakāmāya nocitaḥ | mokṣāya dharmalābhāya tapase śreyase mataḥ ||54|| amūlyastādṛśo maṇiścintitārthaphalapradaḥ | helanīyo na nirmūlyaḥ kṣudrā kapardikā yathā ||5 5 || gūhate mukhamupariṣṭādantare kāmasaṃbhṛtā | lajjāṃ pradarśayatyasmai bhoktre parajanāntike ||56 || antarviṣāmṛtavyāptā bandhayituṃ ca tatparā | yatate nijalābhārthaṃ bhuktvā duḥkhākaroti ca || 57|| tyajantaṃ na tyajatyeṣā yāti sthānāntaraṃ saha | tiraskṛtāpi saṃlagnā vāsanāmūlabandhanā ||58|| nirayākhyā svasaudheṣu vāsayatyatithiṃ ciram | pramattaṃ madapānena paśya māyāviceṣṭitam ||59 || ko nu tatra bhaved baddho rakto vā divyanetrakaḥ | supātratāṃ dehasaṃlagnāṃ mānuprasara karhicit ||2.259.6 0 || dehaḥ karmāvanaddhaśca punaḥ karmābhisarjakaḥ | kāmanāśevadhiḥ kopo mā taṃ naijaṃ niśāmaya ||2 1 || yatra rājabhayaṃ cāste yatra caurabhayaṃ tathā | tadvihāya dhanaṃ divyaṃ pātheyaṃ cārjayasva ha ||62|| paratra jīvyate yena na ca kāpi viyujyate | dhruvaṃ tadakṣaraṃ dravyaṃ samarjayasva putraka ||6 3 || mātā pitā suhṛd bandhuḥ saṃkare nānuyānti hi | karmaikaṃ kevalaṃ yāti naiṣkarmyaṃ tatsamācara ||64|| hiraṇyasañcayā rājyaṃ dāsā dāsyaḥ prajāḥ priyāḥ | dehakṣaye nivartante prabhuṃ sahacaraṃ bhaja ||65|| sākṣiṇaṃ cāntarasthaṃ vai brahmānandapradaṃ prabhum | uddhārakaṃ modanidhiṃ parameśaṃ sadā bhaja ||66|| gṛhasthadharmiṇo lokāḥ prajāpaterbṛhaspateḥ | śatakratośca lokān saṃvrajanti tvāntanāśinaḥ ||67|| mā tvaṃ vṛttiṃ samādhatsva gārhasthye brahmaputraka | nirbhayaṃ ca nirantaṃ ca nidhiṃ brahmavrataṃ vaha ||68|| asaṃgo divyadṛṣṭistvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sannidhiṃ kuru | samarpya parame kṛṣṇe mayi karma samastakam ||69|| nairguṇyaṃ paramaṃ bhuñjan bhava mukto’kṣare yathā | grāmavāso bandhanaṃ vai tacchittvā vanamāviśa ||2.259.70|| kiṃ te dhanena suhṛdā bandhunā ca sutena ca | svataḥprakāśo bhūtvaiva svīyaṃ prakāśaṃ saṃbhaja ||7 1 || mriyamāṇān samānām̐śca vilokya jagati sthitān | mariṣyataśca sañcintyānvicchātmānaṃ guhāgatam ||72|| śubhraṃ śīghraṃ prakurvīta śvaḥ kāryaṃ cādya vai drutam | kṣaṇāntare na jāne yanmṛtyurādāya yāsyati ||73 || mṛtyuśikhe hi saṃsāre mahākālasya bhakṣaṇe | gurvāśraye vivekī san mokṣaṃ sarvātmanā vraja ||74|| maraṇaṃ cātmano mokṣastameva sādhaya pradhe | vidvān mokṣārjanaparastaddhīno jaḍavargagaḥ ||75|| svargasopānakaṃ varṣma mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ tviha | tena sādhaya mokṣoyaṃ cānantaṃ śāśvataṃ sukham ||76|| yasya matirmokṣamārgādanyatra naiva dhāvati | sa eva puṇyakarmāsti cāśocyaḥ sarvamānavaiḥ ||77|| mokṣārthaṃ yanmatiḥ śuddhā dṛḍhā cārabdhatatkṛtiḥ | anyabhāvādiriktā ca na tasya kālato bhayam ||78|| hatasya puṇyapāpaiśca lubdhasya viṣayātmanaḥ | snehasambandhamagnasya vidyate kālato bhayam ||79|| mātāpitṛsahasrāṇi putradārāyutāni ca | atītāni gate kāle kasya te kasya cāpyayam ||2.259.80|| eko’haṃ tvātmasaṃjño’smi tvaṃ cātmā caikalaḥ svayam | anye’nyatra gatāḥ santi paśyantyete na vai mithaḥ ||8 1 || na teṣāṃ bhavatāṃ kāryaṃ na kāryaṃ tava tairiha | svakarmabhirgatānyeva tvaṃ svakṛtyairgamiṣyasi ||82|| loko’yaṃ svārthabahulaḥ svārthasnigdhaḥ svayogakṛt | svārthaṃ prasādhya sahasā tyajanti nirguṇaṃ janam ||83|| samṛddhānāṃ dhanināṃ hi vijanaḥ svajanāyate | daridrāṇāṃ nirdhanānāṃ svajano vijanāyate ||84|| kalatrayogamāsādya jano’śubhaṃ cinoti ca | tataḥ kleśabhṛtaṃ janma punarduḥkhaṃ punarjanim ||85|| evamāvartamagnasya vāsanāpreritasya ca | madhyasāgarabhāgādvai tīrayānaṃ na jāyate ||86|| tatputra dharmamāsādya vairāgyasahacāravān | jñānadīpātinetraśca bhaktyā yāhi paraṃ padam ||87|| kālaḥ pacati bhūtāni kaṭāhe mohasaṃjñite | sūryāgninā divākāṣṭhairmāsartudarvikādibhiḥ ||88|| nātra trātāramīkṣe’hamīkṣase tvaṃ na netaraḥ | na taṃ paśyāmi yasyāhaṃ na taṃ paśyāmi yo mama ||89|| tasmāt sadā pareśaṃ śrīpatiṃ śrīparameśvaram | karmabhūmau bhajasvātra yena dhāmākṣaraṃ vrajeḥ || 2.259.90|| kiṃ janmanā ca dehena jñānena ca vṛṣeṇa ca | tapasā vanavāsena yena mokṣo bhavenna cet ||9 1 || aśvapāṭala ityuktaḥ svataḥprakāśa eva ha | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇoktaṃ cāvadhārya ca ||92|| dadhau mokṣe mano nityaṃ brahmacarye vasan sadā | kvacid dṛśyaḥ kvaciccāpyadṛśyo’vartata vai kṣitau || 93|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre divyadeho’tibhāsuraḥ | cirañjīvo mahāmuktaścātimānavavartanaḥ ||94|| sarvasaṃgaviyuktaśca brahmasaṃgamupāgataḥ | dvedhā bhūtvaikadehena yayāvakṣaramuttamam || 95|| apareṇa sadā cāste kṣetre’trākṣarasaṃjñake | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe bhāvaparāyaṇaḥ || 96|| sarvavidyāśrayo bhaktyācāryo jñānanidhiḥ prabhuḥ | caturbhujo dvibhujo vā yatheṣṭānandaśevadhiḥ || 97|| rājaṃstattvaṃ mama yogājjñānamāsādya satvaram | bhajainaṃ paramātmānaṃ divyadeho bhavātra ca ||98|| tīrthaṃ svataḥprakāśākhyaṃ cāśvasarojale hi tat | vartate divyatādātṛ snānapānādibhirnṛpa ||99|| etajjñānaṃ samāsādya muktatā syānna saṃśayaḥ| sarvavidyāprakāśaśca bhavedātmaprakāśitā || 2.259.100 || devaprakāśitā syācca ciccaitanyaprakāśitā | putra jñānena yannaiva dharmeṇa tapasāpi ca || 101 || prāpyate tallabhyate vai guroḥ prasādaleśataḥ | ityuktvā rādhike śrīmān lomaśo virarāma ha || 102|| atha rājātisantṛpto hariṃ sve hṛdi saṃsmaran | kṛtānāṃ phalaviṣaye papraccha svādakarṣitaḥ || 10 3|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāṃ brahmakallolātmajasyānādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇopadeśajanyapāvanādhyayanaṃ mokṣasthitiśceti navapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 259 ||
<2.260> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike śrīmānaśvapāṭalabhūpatiḥ | lomaśaṃ yatpunaścāpi papraccha sukhasādhanam || 1 || aśvapāṭala uvāca dattamiṣṭaṃ tapaścāpi guroḥ śuśrūṣaṇādikam | yogināpi kṛtaṃ mokṣe niṣphalaṃ vā phalapradam || 2 || śrīlomaśa uvāca rājan kṛtaṃ kadācinna niṣphalaṃ ceha līyate | phalaṃ bhuktvaiva sahasā līyate yogināmapi || 3 || sarveṣāṃ phalabhogo’sti karmaṇāṃ sarvasṛṣṭiṣu | dāne kṛte na vai tatra bhogo dāturbhavediti || 4 || sarvakarmāṇi deyāni cārpaṇīyāni satpatau | puṇyaṃ vā yadi vā pāpaṃ cārpitaṃ naiva bhujyate || 1 || harāvarpitamevaitannairguṇyaṃ samapadyate | arpaṇasya phalaṃ tatra hareḥ prasannatā bhavet| || 6 || tayā bhaktasyārpayiturlabdhirhariśritātmatā | harerdhāmni nivāsaḥ syānmokṣānandaḥ phalaṃ matam || 7 || prākṛtaṃ karma kṛṣṇe ced datta phalamaprākṛtam | kṛṣṇānarpitametadvai bhujyate ceśvarādiṣu || 8 || deveṣu mānaveṣvanyayoniṣūccāvacādiṣu | kaluṣaṃ nīyate kleśe kartāraṃ prāptakālikam || 9 || dāridryāccāpi dāridryaṃ rogād rogaṃ bhayād bhayam | durbhikṣādeva durbhikṣaṃ yānti vai pāpino muhuḥ || 2.260.10 || smṛddheḥ smṛddhiṃ pramodācca pramodaṃ ca divo divam | sukhāt sukhaṃ prayāntyeva puṇyakṛto mahotsavān || 11 || adātāro hastahīnā vyālāḥ sarīsṛpādayaḥ | jāyante tāmasā naijanāstikyaphaladehinaḥ || 1 2|| dātāro devatā vā ca sādhyāḥ sthānina īśvarāḥ | priyadevātithiviprasādhavaḥ saṃbhavanti vai || 13|| adātāro janā loke dhānyeṣu pulakā iva | gajabhuktakapitthā vā pūtyaṇḍā iva pakṣiṣu || 14|| yeṣāṃ dharmo na cāstikyaṃ na dānaṃ nāpyupakṛtiḥ | udaraṃ bhariṇaste vai prāpsyanti nottaraṃ navam || 15|| bhuṃjate pāpamevātra svodaraṃbhariṇo janāḥ | adattebhyo na dāsyanti cānye cānyeṣu janmasu || 16|| śvetākhyo nṛpatiḥ svarge na lebhe’nnaṃ jalaṃ tathā | yadatra naiva dattaṃ vai dāne matvālpakaṃ hi tat || 17|| dattaṃ svarṇahīrakādi yānaṃ vāhanamityapi | tatsarvaṃ tena labdhaṃ vai svarge nānnaṃ na vā jalam || 18|| kṣudhitaśca tataḥ svargādāgatya svaśavodbhavam | bhasmalehaṃ vidhāyaiva tṛptyarthaṃ yatnamācarat || 1 9|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā nāradenāpi tadarthaṃ śrāddhamuttamam | tatputraiḥ kāritaṃ cānnajaladānādikaṃ bahu || 2.260.20 || tatastṛptimavāpāsau rājā śvetābhidhaḥ khalu | tasmād rājan karmabhūmau dattaṃ sarvamavāpyate || 21 || nādattaṃ prāpyate kvāpi tasmād deyaṃ vidhānataḥ | kṛtaṃ karma sitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dhāvantamanudhāvati || 22|| tattadevottaraṃ bhuktaṃ lagnaṃ chāyeva cātmanaḥ | karmāvṛtaṃ savikṣepaṃ samicchantaṃ sukhāyatim || 23|| vividhaṃ bhūtasaṃghātāvṛtaṃ kālo’pakarṣati | naisargikāni puṣpāṇi phalāni śākhinaṃ yathā || 24|| tathā kālena tiṣṭhanti kṛtakarmāṇi dehinaḥ | tatphalaṃ ca sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ lābhālābhau kṣayākṣayau ||25|| mānāvamāne dāridryasmṛddhī cotsavaśocane | āmṛtyanta pravartante nivartante na tāḍitāḥ ||26|| ātmanā cārjitaṃ kaṣṭaṃ garbhaśayyādikaṃ tataḥ | punaḥ kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvaṃ bhuṃkte kramāt kramāt ||27|| yathā vatsaḥ svakāṃ dhenusahasreṣvapi mātaram | mārgayatyeva karmo’pi svakartāraṃ prapadyate || 28|| kṣāreṇa vastramālinyaṃ savāriṇā viśīryate | tapasāntaramālinyaṃ sadharmeṇa vilīyate || 29|| jale matsyapadaṃ naiva dṛśyate ca tapasvini | tathā karmapadaṃ naiva bhāsate jñānaśevadhau || 2.260.30 || alamaprāptakaraṇairalaṃ kaṭhinasādhanaiḥ | guroḥ śuśrūṣaṇenaiva sarvā siddhiḥ kare sthitā || 31 | | tapasendriyarodhena siddhimāpnoti yādṛśīm | tataḥ sahasraguṇitāṃ yogenāpnoti mānavaḥ || 32|| tataścāyutaguṇitāṃ prāpnoti kṛpayā guroḥ | aśvamedhasahasrādiphalaṃ yogakalānibham || 33 || yogaṃ vinā vinā jñānaṃ vinā vijñānamityapi | guroḥ sevāṃ vinā cāpi rājan mokṣo hi durlabhaḥ || 34|| gurorjñānaṃ samāsādya saṃsevya gurumuttamam | bhaktiṃ kṛtvā harestūrṇaṃ mokṣaṃ paramamāpnuyāt || 35|| jñānavijñānaśuddhātmā gurvāśīrvādapeṭikā | bhūtvā brahmavatī cāpi mokṣaṃ śīghramavāpnuyāt || 36 | | prathame tvāśrame śīlī gurorvai kṛpayā drutam | mokṣamāsādayatyeva kimanyāśramayatnakaiḥ || 37 || rājasām̐stāmasān bhāvān hitvā brahmavratāśrame | sattvamārge samāsthāya paśyedātmānamātmanā || 38 || sarvātmabhūtamātmānaṃ pareśaṃ cātmani sthitam | vīkṣya sarvasthitaṃ taṃ ca karmabandhaṃ prahāpayet || 39 || abdhiṃ meghā vihāyaiva yathā yānti sthalīṃ prati | muktāstathā bhuvaṃ hitvā yānti brahmasthalīṃ prati ||2.260.40 || jyotirātmani saṃyuktaṃ sarvadeheṣu rājate | tapasā śakyate draṣṭuṃ bhaktyā ca kṛpayāpi ca ||4 1 || svasmād bhayaṃ pareṣāṃ na parebhyaḥ svasya no bhayam | dveṣarāgavihīnasya parabrahma prakāśate ||42 || pāpabhāvavihīnasya brahmabhāvayutasya ha | ātmaniṣṭhāsthitasyaiva parabrahma prakāśate ||43 || ātmānaṃ śrīharau yuktvā tyaktvā māyāṃ tu mohinīm | brahmahrade nimagnasya parabrahma prakāśate ||44|| bāhye tathāntare tvādye samavṛttimupāgataḥ | viṣame’pi samaścāste brahma sampadyate tadā ||45|| stutiṃ nindām ayaḥ svarṇaṃ sukhaduḥkhe priyāpriye | arthānarthau ca śītoṣṇe jīvanaṃ maraṇaṃ tathā ||46 || naijaṃ paraṃ jaḍaṃ caityaṃ bāhyamāntaramityapi | yadekṣeta samatvena brahma sampadyate tadā ||47 || tamovyāptaṃ gahvaraṃ ca yathā paśyet svatejasā | tathātmajñānadīpena brahma śakyaṃ nirīkṣitum ||48 || nāsti jñānasamaṃ cakṣurnāsti brahmasamaṃ gṛham | nāsti tṛṣṇāsamaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsti toṣasamaṃ sukham ||49 || vāsanāyā vinirvṛttiḥ satataṃ brahmaśīlatā | sādhuvṛttiḥ satāṃ sevā śreya etat pramokṣadam || 2.260.50 || saṃgī bhūtvā yadi kaścinmanyetāhaṃ sukhīti ca | nāyaṃ sukhīti mantavyaḥ saṃgo hi duḥkhasaṃbhṛtaḥ || 51 || saktasya buddhiścalati mohajālaṃ tanoti ca | jālabaddhasya parito duḥkhopadā milanti vai || 52 || śreyoghātakarau cobhau kāmakrodhau hi dehinaḥ | rāgadveṣātmakau tau ca doṣau nirayado matau ||53 || ātmānaṃ satataṃ rakṣet tābhyāṃ samāhitaḥ śubhaḥ | tābhyāṃ hīnaḥ sadā sādhustābhyāṃ hīnā satī tadā || 54|| yayostyāge mahām̐styāgaḥ sarvatyāgī sa jāyate | tābhyāmasajjamāno yaḥ sa cāpnotyakṣaraṃ padam |||55 || tābhyāṃ hīno bhūtahīnaḥ saṃghātakarṣaṇojjhitaḥ | sa vimuktaḥ paraṃśreyo na cireṇātitiṣṭhati ||56 || akaiṃcanyaṃ susantoṣo nirāśīstvamacāpalam | etatproktaṃ śreya eva tenāpnuyātparaṃ padam ||57|| parigrahe bhavecchokastacchūnye śocanaṃ katham | nirguṇaṃ nāśrayante’bhijanāḥ paurāśca rāṣṭrajāḥ || 58 || vijñāya nirguṇaṃ śāntaṃ kāntāpi vimanāyate | māyāpi nirguṇaṃ śāntaṃ tyaktvā saṃgaṃ vilīyate | |59 || nirāmiṣaṃ na valganti sāmiṣā rāgiṇo’mbare | udāsīnaṃ na bhāṣante bhāṣayantyapi naiva ca || 2.260.60 || prajñātṛptaṃ jñānatṛptaṃ brahmānandapariplutam | bhramamohasukhā lokāstyajanti ca vicittavat ||6 1 || anto nāsti pipāsāyāstuṣṭirvai paramaṃ sukham | prajñāsantoṣamāsādya brahmānandapluto bhavet || 62 || adhyātmakuśalairvāsaṃ vyavahāraṃ ca yogibhiḥ | maitrīṃ brahmavidāṃ śreṣṭhaiḥ kṛtvā brahmasukhaṃ labhet || 63 || sarvathā rājasā lokāstāmasāścārdhasāttvikāḥ | gurvāśīrvādarahitā dṛśyante nirayārhaṇāḥ ||64|| vañcanāyāṃ kṛtavāsā hiṃsāyāṃ kṛtamānasāḥ | anādṛtya guruṃ dharmaṃ jīyante nirayāya taiḥ || 65 || pūrṇasāttvikavargeṣu śrīḥ kaṃcidupatiṣṭhate | yatra nārāyaṇavāsastatra siddhiḥ pramokṣaṇam ||66 || uparyupari lokasya sarvo gantuṃ samīhate | yatate bhinnamārgeṇa na ca yāti yatheṣṭakam ||67|| tasmād rājan yogamārgaṃ harermārgaṃ parātparam | samālambya prayātavyaṃ kṛpāpātheyayoginā ||68|| na tu yogamṛte śakyaṃ prāptuṃ brahma sanātanam | vinā yogaṃ karmabandhaḥ kṣeptuṃ śakyo’pi naiva ca ||69 || rājan kṛṣṇe cittavāso yogaḥ paramamokṣadaḥ | rājan kṛṣṇe cātmavāso muktiḥ sā śāśvatī matā ||2.260.7 0 || naro nārāyaṇaścāpi hariḥ kṛṣṇaśca dharmajāḥ | bhrātaro’pi parabrahma dhyātvā tanmayatāṃ gataḥ ||7 1 || kapilaḥ ṛṣabho dattaḥ sanakādyāśca nāradaḥ | pṛthuśca vāmanaḥ parśurāmo rāmādayastathā ||72|| śvetavyāsādayaścānye brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | sādhayitvā parabrahmayogaṃ tanmayatāṃ gatāḥ ||73 || nirvāṇaṃ sarvadharmāṇāṃ nivṛttiḥ paramā matā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’rpitā kriyā hi sā ||74|| śrīrlakṣmīḥ kamalā rādhā bhūrlīlā pārvatī satī | ramā kṛṣṇā māṇikī ca gaṃgā durgā sarasvatī ||75|| ramā jayā ca virajā brahmapriyādikāśca yāḥ | sādhayitvā parabrahmayogaṃ tanmayatāṃ gatāḥ ||76 || yajñaḥ pravṛttirūpo’sti pare deve samarpitaḥ | nivṛttirūpa evāyaṃ tvayā rājan vinirmitaḥ ||77 || tena tvaṃ sarvayajñānāṃ phalaṃ vai labdhavān param | yadatrāgatya bhagavānanādiśrīnarāyaṇaḥ ||78|| prātareva dadau tubhyaṃ darśanaṃ parameśvaraḥ | devāḥ sarve harau tṛpte tṛptāstavādhvare nṛpa ||79 || kṛtakṛtyo bhavasyadya puruṣārthacatuṣṭaye | svasti te’stu ca lokānāṃ sevādharmajuṣāṃ sadā ||2.260.8 0 || aśvapāṭala uvāca kathaṃ yajñeṣvagraharo bhagavān samajāyata | kathaṃ yajñe ca bhāgārhā devatā hariṇā kṛtāḥ ||8 1 || śrīlomaśa upācayathāvṛttaṃ hi kalpādau sṛṣṭyārambhe ca tacchṛṇu | devatā brahmaṇā sārdhamṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ ||8 2 || tejovṛddhīcchayā jagmuḥ kṣīrodottaragaṃ taṭam | tapaścakruścordhvadṛṣṭibāhavaścaikapatsthitāḥ ||8 3 || sahasravatsarānte te śuśruvuścāmbarīṃ giram | bhobhoḥ sabrahmakā devāḥ ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ ||84|| pravṛttikāryaṃ kartavyaṃ yuṣmadbalābhivardhanam | mamārādhanatapasaḥ phalaṃ bhokṣyatha cottamam ||85|| yūyaṃ sarve yajadhvaṃ māṃ kalpayadhvaṃ mamāṃśakam | adhvare ca bhajadhvaṃ māṃ matsevā hi balapradā ||86|| rājam̐ste bhuvamāgatya kṛṣṇamaṇijanuṃ śubhām | surāṣṭrākhyāṃ makhaṃ cakruścātra yatra tvayā kṛtaḥ ||87|| ahamāsaṃ tadā tvatra maharṣimaṇḍale nṛpa | prathamo’tra kraturdivyo devādibhiḥ kṛtastadā ||88|| vedadṛṣṭena vidhinā vaiṣṇavaḥ sārvamedhikaḥ | tatra satre svayaṃ brahmā harerbhāgamakalpayat ||89|| devā devarṣayaścāpi harerbhāgānakalpayan | svasvabhāgerdadhuḥ sarve yajñāya paramātmane || 2.260.90 || te kārtayugadharmāṇo bhāgā divyāstadābhavan | arpitāḥ śrīharau sarve brahmarūpāstadābhavan || 91 || te bhāgā muktapuruṣā astuvan parameśvaram | ādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt puruṣottamam || 92|| varadānāya devebhyastataḥ sa varado hariḥ | aśarīro’mbare sthitvā babhāṣāśvasaro’ntikam || 93|| yena yaḥ kalpito bhāgaḥ sa sarvo māmupāgataḥ | prasanno’haṃ varaṃ vo’tra dadāmi baladāyakam || 94|| yūyaṃ sarve svayaṃ yajñairyajamānāḥ sudakṣiṇaiḥ | yuge yuge bhaviṣyadhvaṃ pravṛttiphalabhāginaḥ || 95|| bhavadyajñānusāreṇa ye yakṣyanti pare janāḥ | bhavadbhāgān kalpayitvā te yāsyanti phalaṃ param || 96|| dīyamānām̐śca vo bhāgān tān yūyaṃ samavāpsyatha | yuge yuge bhaviṣyadhvaṃ pravṛttiphalabhāginaḥ || 97|| pravṛttirnivṛttirūpā mayyarpitā bhaviṣyati | yathā bhavadbhirye bhāgāḥ kalpitāścātra te tathā || 98|| bhāgā bhāgapradāttṝṇāṃ kalpyante tvadhvare mayā | yūyaṃ lokān bhāvayadhvaṃ yajñabhāgaphalapradāḥ || 99|| mama bhāgaphalaṃ prāpya balaṃ yūyaṃ makhe surāḥ | muhuścāpyāyitabalā lokān vai dhārayiṣyatha || 2.260.100 || yūyaṃ vai bhāvitā yajñaiḥ sarvayajñeṣu mānavaiḥ | bhāvayiṣyatha māṃ caiṣā bhāvanā mama vo matā || 101 || sā vidhyarthasvarūpā vai vedavākye mayāhitā | yajñān kṛtvā makhe bhuktvā cintayadhvaṃ prajāhitam || 102 || vasiṣṭhādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca sanakādyā maharṣayaḥ | brahmādyā īśvarāścāpi ādityādyāśca devatāḥ || 103 || anye’pi mānavādyāśca yajñamārge’dhikāriṇaḥ | gacchadhvaṃ svānadhikārān vartayadhvaṃ mahāmakhān || 1 04|| pravartantāṃ kriyāyajñāḥ prādiśyata vidhīṃstathā | idaṃ kṛtayugaṃ nāma kālaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pravartate || 1 05|| catuṣpāt sakalo dharmaḥ pravartate’tra daivikaḥ | ityuktvā brahmaṇe kṛṣṇo naijaṃ rūpamadarśayat || 106 || hayagrīvasvarūpaṃ vai vedānāvartayat śubham | pariṣvajyāha ca brahman bhāraṃ tvayi kṣipāmyaham || 1 07|| asahye surakārye’haṃ jñānadaste muhurmuhuḥ | prāvirbhāvaṃ gamiṣyāmītyuktvā cāntaradhīyata || 1 08|| hayagrīvamahātīrthaṃ tat sarasi vyajāyata | tatra snānājjalapānād vedavijñānavān bhavet || 10 9|| brahmā jagāma svalokaṃ devā jagmurdivādikam | evaṃ rājan hariryajñe’graharaḥ samajāyata || 2.260.110 || devabhāgān dadau cāpi pravṛttiṃ ca nivartanam | naiṣkarmyaṃ baladaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ cakāra vai tadā || 111 || eṣa eva parabrahmānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | kathitaste jagatāṃ me mokṣadaḥ kambharāsutaḥ || 1 12|| kriyatāṃ madvaco rājan sevyatāṃ bālakṛṣṇakaḥ | gīyatāṃ satataṃ kṛṣṇaḥ pūjyatāṃ cāntare sthitaḥ || 113|| gamyatāṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāma bhujyatāṃ śāśvataṃ sukham | ityupādiśya ca rādhe lomaśo virarāma ha || 1 14|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāṃ yogino’pi datteṣṭaguruśuśrūṣādiphalāvāptiryajñe harerdevatānāṃ ca bhāgādyutpattirityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 260 ||
<2.261> śrīkṛṣṇa uvācaśṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścādāśvapaṭṭalabhūpatiḥ | pratyakṣaśrīharerbodhaṃ papraccha munaye tadā || 1 || aśvapāṭala uvāca mune yo’yamanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | pratyakṣo bhagavānāste tadbodhaṃ kāraya prabho || 2 || tannāmnā bhajanaṃ kurve sārthamāno yathānvaham | śādhi sarvārthasampannaṃ bodhaṃ māṃ pārameśvaram || 3 || śrīlomaśa uvāca rājannaikāntikā bhaktā vidvāṃso vedapāragāḥ | niruktāni harernāmnāṃ jānanti netare janāḥ || 4 || yato hyekāntinaḥ śreṣṭhā ye caivānanyadevatāḥ | tadātmānastatparāstacchīlāstatsahakriyāḥ || 5 || kadā kutra kathaṃ nāma kena jātaṃ vidanti te | pragṛṇanti tato bhaktāḥ pūrvaṃ prakāśitaṃ ca taiḥ || 6 || ādirjanmodbhavaścāpi dehendriyādiyojanam | prāgvisargaḥ paścasarge yanmūrtau naiva vidyate || 7 || kālo’kṣaraṃ yadādau na yasmin kvacid vilīyate | sarveṣāṃ svetareṣāṃ sa ādireva paraḥ prabhuḥ || 8 || nānyadādi hyabhūd yasya tasmādanādireva saḥ | nityaśrīḥ śrayati yaṃ ca divyaśobhottamottamā || 9 || divyaveṣaśca racanā vāṇī sampadvibhūtikā | aiśvaryāṇi guṇāḥ sarve śrīpadā yatra santi ha || 2.261.10 || tasmācchrīḥ sa śrītādātmyād ramālakṣmyādisaṃśrayaḥ | śrīmān sa eva bhagavān prokto vai parameśvaraḥ || 11 || narāṇāmātmanāṃ yo’yamayanaṃ vai cirantanam | nārāḥ sarvā divyarūpā śaktayastannivāsanam || 12|| arā māyā ca dāridryaṃ nāsti yatra hi muktigāḥ | muktā narāstannivāso nārāyaṇaḥ sa vai mataḥ || 13 || karṣatyeva jagatsarvaṃ sarvāḥ sṛṣṭistanau kvacit | nayatyeva layaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇastena prakīrtitaḥ || 14|| kṛṣiḥ kalmaṣanāśaśca naśca nirvṛttirucyate | tādṛśaḥ śrīkṛṣṇa evānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 15|| kaṃ sukhaṃ śāśvataṃ yacca kaṃ vā brahmaparaṃ prabhum | bibharti yā nije garbhe kaṃbharā hṛdaye ca vā || 16 || kaṃbharāyāḥ sutaścātra kāṃbhareyo harirhi saḥ | gāḥ kiraṇāni kṛṣṇasya pālayatyeva yaḥ svayam || 17|| gāśca dhenūḥ pṛthivīṃ gāṃ gatiṃ divyāṃ ca rakṣati | gopālaśca pitā tasya nando gopālanandanaḥ || 18|| purāṇi ca śarīrāṇi cetanāni jaḍāni ca | upatyeva ca teṣu śrīharirvai puruṣottamaḥ || 19 || bṛhatvādvyāpakatvācca paratvād brahma yaḥ paraḥ | parabrahma hariścaiva sa eva bhagavān svayam ||2.261.20 || paramāṇi samagrāṇyaiśvaryāṇi santi tatra ca | parameśvara evāsau pareśvara prasiddhyati || 21 || kṣaraṃ māyātmakaṃ sarvaṃ tatparaṃ dhāma cākṣaram | tadatīto hariḥ so’yamakṣarātīta ucyate ||22|| avatārā harerevāvirbhavanti samastataḥ | avatārī svayaṃ teṣāṃ mūlaṃ śrīharirucyate ||23|| hariścāyaṃ haratyeva bhaktānāṃ mānasāni vai | haratyeva ca duḥkhāni hariścāyaṃ prakīrtitaḥ || 24|| haraḥ saṃkarṣaṇaścāsājjāyate kāryakṛtprabhuḥ | harī tena tathoktaścaiśvaryavān bhagavānapi || 25|| vasatyayaṃ samasteṣu dīvyatyevāntarasthitaḥ | vāsudevaḥ sa vai proktaḥ parameśaḥ sanātanaḥ || 26|| prakṛtiryasya vāñcchāsti śaktiḥ śālo’pi vai tathā | māyā yā prakṛtistasya dhavo mādhava eva saḥ ||27|| kālātmāpi prabhuḥ proktaḥ sarvasarjanaśaktimān | viśanti sṛṣṭayo yatra yasmādvā viṣṇureva saḥ || 28|| veveṣṭi vyāpnoti caiṣo vyāpako viṣṇurucyate | damanena janā ūrdhvamṛcchanti dhāma me param ||29|| tena dāmodaraḥ kṛṣṇo dāne mode ramatyayam | keśāstadaṃśavaḥ proktāstadvān kṛṣṇo hi keśavaḥ ||2.261.3 0 || agniḥ somo mama rūpe mukhaṃ rasaśca tāvubhau | agniṣṭomastato nāma nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ kratuḥ ||3 1 || agniḥ kṣatraṃ dvijaḥ somastayoraikyaṃ haro hariḥ | agnirnārī naraḥ somaścāgniṣṭomo narāyaṇaḥ || 32|| naṣṭāṃ gāṃ pṛthivīṃ cāyamavindacca purā tataḥ | govinda iti vikhyāto gopālo goprapālanāt ||33 || hṛṣīkānīndriyāṇyeṣa īśate sa haristataḥ | hṛṣīkeśaḥ samabhavat hṛṣīkā tapasāṃ sthale ||34|| adhaḥ sarvaṃ paraṃ sarvaṃ paśyatyadhokṣajastataḥ | vṛṣodharmastannivāsaḥ kapirvārāharūpyayam ||35 || ramante yoginastatra rāmo ramaṇavān prabhuḥ | guṇakarmānuyogena nāmnāmasyāstyanantakam ||36|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ brahmaparaṃ bhaja | bālarūpaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kuṃkumavāpikākṣare ||37|| kṣetre virājate yastaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ sadā bhaja | bāmāyā layametyatra kṛṣṇe’to bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||38|| bālānajñānasaṃvyāptān janānādiśya satpatham | karṣatyakṣaradhāmakṣmāṃ paraṃ sukhaṃ dadāti ca ||3 9|| bālakṛṣṇo harikṛṣṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo brahmapriyāpatiḥ ||2.261.40|| satāṃ patirmuktapatiḥ sarvapatirjanārdanaḥ | bhaktapatirnijapatiḥ sevyatāṃ prāpyatāṃ nṛpa ||41 || aśvapāṭala uvāca aho jñānamaho bodhaścāho’mṛtaṃ rasāyanam | pāyitaṃ me muro’jasraṃ divyaṃ divyavimuktidam ||42|| taponidhe tvayoktaṃ me nārāyaṇakathāmṛtam | īdṛśo bhagavān mahyaṃ darśito bodhito’ntare ||43 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣānnibhālitaḥ | agniṣomātmakaḥ so’yaṃ bhagavām̐starpito mayā ||44|| prasāditastathā sākṣāt samāsādita eva saḥ | na tato’sti paraḥ kaścinna tatsamo’sti vetaraḥ ||45|| tatkathātulyamākhyānaṃ nānyat sṛṣṭitraye’pi vai | vidyate phaladaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ pāvanaṃ param ||46|| na cātrālpa mama puṇyaṃ vardhitaṃ bhavatā bahu | kuṃkumakṣmāṃ samāsādya yenāhaṃ dṛṣṭavān harim || 47|| ityevaṃ rādhike matvā kṛtakṛtyaṃ nija nṛpaḥ | papāta daṇḍavadbhūmau lomaśaṃ svaguruṃ prati ||48|| lomaśastaṃ tadā prāha harṣāśrupulakāṃcitam | dhanyo’styanugṛhīto’sti yadbhavān dṛṣṭavān harim ||49 || adṛśyadarśane tatra taddayaiva hi kāraṇam | avatārī hi bhagavān durdarśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||2.261.50|| nāsya bhaktāt priyataro lokaṃ kaścana vidyate | tataḥ svayaṃ darśitavān svamātmānaṃ nṛpottama ||5 1 || tasmāduttiṣṭhate rājan kṣamā yā vai kṣitau sthitā | tasmāduttiṣṭhate raso yenāpo rasasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||52|| tasmāduttiṣṭhate rūpaṃ yenārkādyāḥ surūpiṇaḥ | tasmāduttiṣṭhate sparśo yena prāṇāḥ suyoginaḥ |||53|| tasmāduttiṣṭhate śabdo yena lokā gṛṇanti ca | tasmāduttiṣṭhate manaḥ prakāśaguṇadhārakam |||54|| tasmāduttiṣṭhate buddhistattvanirṇayakāriṇī | buddhyā viditvā taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṣetrajñaṃ sāttvatāṃ nṛpa ||55|| viśanti paramātmānaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ samāhitāḥ | bhajainaṃ parameśaṃ taṃ rājan kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||56|| daivataṃ paramaṃ yajñaṃ parātmānaṃ sanātanam | īṣyate sarvayajñeṣu nityaṃ so’yaṃ jagatpatiḥ ||57|| ye yajanti surān pitṝn gurūn sādhūm̐stathātithīn | gāśca viprān dīnajanān kṣitiṃ satīṃ ca mātaram |||58|| ṛṣīn sevāparān bhṛtyān patnīṃ patiṃ ca bālakān | pūjyānanāthān raṃkām̐śca paśūn patatriṇastathā | | 59 | | stambān vṛkṣān pakṣiṇaśca viṣṇumeva yajanti te | antargataḥ sa bhagavān sarvapiṇḍe vyavasthitaḥ | | 2.261.60 | | gṛhṇāti śraddhayā dattaṃ jīvatṛptiṃ samāvahat | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so’yaṃ śrutau śrutaḥ | | 6.1 | | bhaja taṃ paramātmānaṃ rājan pratyakṣagocaram | ya eṣa gururasmākaṃ kaṃbharānandanastviha | | 62 | | ko yāyāt taṃ vinā cātra sarvatra kṣitimaṇḍale | prakuryācca mahāyajñān tārayenmocayejjanān | | 63 | | kathaṃ vinā taṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sarvajaganmanoharam | vṛṇuyuḥ kanyakā rājñāṃ sahasraśaśca koṭiśaḥ | | 64 | | kathaṃ devāśca ṛṣayaśceśvarāśceśvareśvarāḥ | āgatya pūjanaṃ kuryurmakheṣvasya hariṃ vinā | | 65 | | kathaṃ rādhāramālakṣmīkamalādyāśca koṭiśaḥ | kṛṣṇapatnyaścāsya sevāṃ kuryurnārāyaṇaṃ vinā | | 66 | | kathaṃ cihnāni sarvāṇi sṛṣṭitrayordhvagāni vai | nārāyaṇaṃ vināsyaiva mūrtau bhaveyurañjasā | | 67 | | sa vai vedanidhiḥ kṛṣṇastapasāṃ nidhireva ca | yogajñānanidhiścāyaṃ sarvodaraḥ sa eva ca | | 68 | | parabrahmaparā vedāḥ parabrahmaparā makhāḥ | parabrahmaparo mokṣaḥ parabrahmaparaṃ tapaḥ | | 69 | | parabrahmaparaṃ satyaṃ parabrahmaparamṛtam | parabrahmaparaṃ puṇyaṃ parabrahmaparā gatiḥ | | 2.261.7 0 | | pravṛttinivṛttidharmaḥ parabrahmaparāyaṇaḥ | parabrahmātmako gandhaḥ pṛthvyāṃ śreṣṭhatamo nṛpa | | 71 | | parabrahmaparā cāpāṃ guṇā rasātmakāḥ śubhāḥ | parabrahmaparaṃ rūpaṃ jyotiṣāṃ rūpiṇāṃ tathā | | 72 | | parabrahmātmakaḥ sparśaḥ sarvaspṛśyasthito’nugaḥ | parabrahmātmakaḥ śabdaḥ sarvaśabdyānupāvṛtaḥ | | 73 | | parabrahmaparaṃ cittaṃ mano’haṃ buddhirīśvarī | parabrahmātmikā mātrāḥ parabrahmātmakā guṇāḥ | | 74 | | parabrahmātmakaḥ kālaḥ parabrahmaparā kṛtiḥ | kīrtiḥ śrīrdevatā lakṣmīḥ parabrahmaparā ca bhūḥ | | 75 | | parabrahmaparā bhūtirlīlā sarasvatī satī | parabrahmaparāḥ sarvāḥ ṛco brahmapriyāstathā | | 76 | | parabrahmaparaṃ jñānaṃ yogastyāgaḥ śubhā kriyāḥ | kāraṇāni samastāni parabrahmaparāṇi ca | | 77 | | tattvaṃ jijñāsamānānāṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ pareśvaraḥ | sarveṣāṃ sa vijānāti manīṣitaṃ paraḥ prabhuḥ ||78|| daivaṃ paitryaṃ tapo dānaṃ sarvāśrayo hariḥ svayam | sarvabhūtakṛtāvāsaḥ kuṃkumavāpikālayaḥ ||79|| akṣarabrahmavāsaśca bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo nārāyaṇeśvaraḥ ||2.261.8 0|| sa vai hyekāntinaḥ sarvān prīṇāti bhagavān hariḥ | vidhikṛtāṃ supūjāṃ ca gṛhṇāti bhagavān svayam ||8 1 || ekāntino hi manujāḥ prayānti śrīhareḥ padam | ekāntadharmasarvasvaṃ parabrahmaparāyaṇam ||82|| sammitaṃ sāmavedena puraivādau kṛte yuge | dhāryate bālakṛṣṇena nārāyaṇeśvareṇa ha ||83 || nārāyaṇo yajñadharmaṃ svarṇarekhānadītaṭe | nārāyaṇahrade daivaṃ paitryaṃ nyavartayat purā ||84|| ṛṣayo devatādyāśca somo’pi mānavāstathā | makhadharmaṃ purākalpe nyavartayan hariśritāḥ ||85|| rudraḥ kṛte yuge nārāyaṇadharmaṃ hyapālayat | aśikṣayattathā viprān cādye kṛte yuge haraḥ ||86 || suparṇākhyamaharṣiśca prāpya śrīpuruṣottamāt | yajñadharmaṃ pṛthivyāṃ saḥ prāvartayata sadvidhim ||87|| samudro yajñadharmāṃśca tataḥ prāvartayannṛpa | athāraṇyakanāmāpi muniḥ prāvartayattataḥ ||88|| manustato yajñadharmān prāvartayata sāttvavān | sanatkumāro bhagavān prāvartayata tatparān ||89|| vīraṇaḥ suvrataścāpi barhiṣadaśca dakṣakaḥ | vivasvān sthāpitavanto dharmamenaṃ sanātanam ||2.261.90|| sarvārpaṇātmako dharmaḥ sāttvato duṣkaro janaiḥ | dhāryate’nādikṛṣṇena sthāpyate ca punaḥ kṣitau ||9 1|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena makharūpavān | sarvārpaṇātmako dharmo bhūgole sthāpite nṛpa ||92||| sa eva bhagavāṃlloke saṃsthāpya dharmamācyutam | yathecchati tathā paścāt krīḍati śāsti vai prajāḥ ||93|| evamekāntadharmaste kathito nṛpasattama | ekāntinaḥ kṣitau rājan bhavanti durlabhā janāḥ ||94|| yadyekāntibhirākīrṇaṃ jagat syād vaiṣṇavaṃ mithaḥ | bhaved brahmapuraṃ cātra kṛtaṃ yugaṃ vidoṣakam ||95|| yatra caikāntinaḥ santi parabrahmaparāyaṇāḥ | narā nāryaḥ paśavaśca pakṣiṇo devatādayaḥ ||96|| sarve varṇā vaiṣṇavāśca tatrākṣarapadaṃ matam | adharmastatra nāstyeva nādharmavaṃśajā api ||97|| naranārīvyavahārāḥ sarve syurmuktakoṭijāḥ | vaikuṣṭhaṃ vā ca goloko śveto vā badarīvanam ||98|| bhavettatra yadi kṣmāyāṃ sarve caikāntino janāḥ | sāttvatā bhaktimanto vai bhaveyurmuktaye dhruvam ||99|| manīṣitaṃ hyavāpyaiva bhajeyuḥ puruṣottamam | ekāntabhaktāḥ satataṃ parabrahmaparāyaṇāḥ || 2.261.10 0|| teṣāṃ haryaṃkaniṣṭhānāṃ yogakṣemavaho hariḥ | jāyamānaṃ janaṃ naijaṃ kṛtvā yaṃ vīkṣate hariḥ || 101 || sāttvataḥ sa bhavedatra dharmaikāntikavān sa ca | parabrahmātmake mokṣe tato yāti parāṃ gatim || 1 02|| nārāyaṇena dṛṣṭo yaḥ pratibuddho bhaveddhi saḥ | nātmecchayā tathā rājan pratibuddho bhavet kvacit || 103 || pravṛttilakṣaṇairyuktaṃ naivekṣati hariḥ svayam | paśyantyenaṃ mahāmāyā brahmā devāśca mānavāḥ || 1 04|| tataste vikṛtāḥ sarve māyābaddhā bhavanti vai | te yadi sāttvatānāṃ vai sevāṃ kurvanti bhāvataḥ || 1 05|| tadā kālāntare prāpya nairguṇyaṃ yānti cākṣaram | yadvā sāttvatasaṃghāte kṛpayā sāttvatekṣitāḥ || 1 06|| bhaveyuste yadā caikāntikasādhukṛpekṣitāḥ | tadā teṣāṃ hṛdayasya parivartanamāśu vai || 1 07|| bhaviṣyati na sandeho’thavā prasādabhojanaiḥ | harervā haribhaktānāṃ jalānnagrāsabhojanaiḥ || 1 08|| śuddhā buddhirnirguṇābhimukhī śanaiḥ prajāyate | niṣkalmaṣā prasannā ca tataḥ sāttvatamaṇḍale || 1 09|| nivāsena śanaiḥ sāttvatatvamāsādya mokṣaṇam | gamiṣyanti na sandehaḥ kṛpāsādhyā sthitirhi sā || 2.261.11 0|| ityuktvā virarāmaiva maharṣirlomaśastataḥ | rādhike’śvapaṭṭalaśca pupūja lomaśaṃ munim || 111 || bahusāmagrikābhiśca kṛtakṛtyo babhūva ha | aśvapaṭṭasarasaścottare tīrthābhivāñcachayā || 11 2|| lomaśaṃ prārthayattena lomaśena samaṃ tataḥ | sarastīrthāni ca yayau sarvasārthasamanvitaḥ || 113 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāṃ lomaśakṛtamaśvapāṭalāyānādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasākṣādbhagavattvabodhanaṃ parabrahmaparāyaṇadharmabodhanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikaṣaṣṭhyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 261 ||
<2.262> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike rājā tvaśvapāṭalasaṃjñakaḥ | lomaśena samaṃ somatīrthe vai prathamaṃ yayau || 1 || tatra snātvā ca vidhinā dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ | yūpasthalīṃ namaskṛtya rāmatīrthaṃ yayau tataḥ || 2 || aśvapāṭala uvāca kathaṃ tīrthamidaṃ jātaṃ maharṣe rāmanāmakam | samāsena kathāmetāṃ praśrāvaya purātanīm || 3 || śrīlomaśa uvāca bhāṇavīryo’bhavat siṃhajñātīyo nṛpatiḥ purā | gopanāthādikhaṇḍasya rājya karoti śobhanam || 4 || śatrujayapradeśām̐śca śāsti dharmadharo nṛpaḥ | rāmarāmetirāmetirāmādityeti sarvadā || 5 || kṛṣṇakṛṣṇetikṛṣṇetikṛṣṇādityeti vai tathā | japati svakuṭumbena sahito vaiṣṇavaḥ khalu || 6 || prajāstasya sukhasthānāḥ sukhālayāḥ sukhe sthitāḥ | bhajante ca sadā rāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ govindamacyutam || 7 || dharmaṃ karoti nityaṃ ca bhāṇavīryo’tithāvapi | sādhuṣu devakāryeṣu dānahomapradakṣiṇāḥ || 8 || evaṃ vai vartamānasyaikadā kaṣṭaṃ hi bhautikam | samutpannaṃ bhāladeśanṛpo nāmnā kṣamābhṛtaḥ || 9 || vijayārthaṃ svasainyena niryayau cānusāgaram | sābhramatīṃ samuttīrya dhavalākhyān pradeśakān || 2.262.1 0|| vijitya bhāṇavīryasya rāṣṭraṃ jetumupāyayau | sainyaṃ kṣamābhṛtasyāpyuddhataṃ grāmān purāṇi ca || 11 || aṭati sma nijān kṛtvā pradeśān siṃharāyikām | rājadhānīṃ vijetuṃ vai tūrṇamantikamāyayau || 12|| siṃharājyā nagaryā vai paritaḥ sainyacakrakam | kṛtvāvṛṇod rājadhānīṃ dūtaṃ cāpreṣayan nṛpam || 1 3|| rājavākyaṃ jagādāpi dūto gṛhāṇa vaśyatām | yadvā yuddhaṃ pradehyatra rājyaṃ vā sakalaṃ tataḥ || 14|| bhāṇavīryo jagādāpi dūtaṃ kṣamābhṛtasya ha | nānyāyo vidyate rājye nādharmo vidyate tathā || 15|| ījyate bhagavān rāmaḥ kṛṣṇaśca sarvadā mayā | rakṣyante sādhavaḥ sarve pūjyante’tithayaḥ sadā || 16|| rājyaṃ rāmasya śaraṇe mayārpitaṃ vibhāvyate | nātrāsti vaśyatānyasya yuddhaṃ naiva naraiḥ saha || 17|| rājyadānaṃ kṛtaṃ rāme kathamanyena bhujyate | ahaṃ tu tatpradhāno’smi yotsyate bhagavān svayam || 18|| vada dāsye na vai rājyaṃ kariṣye’pi na vaśyatām | yodhanaṃ bhagavāneva kariṣyati nijārthakam || 19|| sannaddho bhava rājendra garvaṃ mā vaha ceti vai | vada kṣamābhṛtaṃ yadvā yāhi svabhavanaṃ prati ||2.262.20|| yadvā mitrasvarūpeṇa svāgataṃ te karomi ca | yatheṣṭaṃ me punaścātrāvedayeti vilokaye |9| dūto gatvā jagādedaṃ yathoktaṃ ca tataḥ sa ca | kṣamābhṛto’preṣayacca dūtaṃ sajjo bhaveti ca ||22|| yuddhaṃ kṛtvā gṛhīṣye’haṃ rājyaṃ mā madamāvaha | nahi nārāyaṇo yuddhe rakṣiṣyati prabhaktakam || 23|| iti saṃpreṣayitvaiva dūtaṃ yuddhasya sūcakān | bherībyaṃgulaśaṃkhānāṃ ninādān samakārayat ||24|| yantraśabdān vividhām̐ścākārayat durgasannidhau | durgapālān gopurasthān dvārarakṣakarām̐stathā || 25|| bandhayitvā svavaśagān kṛtvā kṣamābhṛto nṛpaḥ | praviveśa nagaryāṃ vai siṃharājyāṃ sasainyakaḥ ||26 || prajāstresuḥ kampamānāḥ sasmaruḥ rāmamacyutam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ rakṣakaṃ parameśvaram ||27|| rājasaudhaṃ pragatvaiva kṣamābhṛto balānvitaḥ | bhāṇavīryād bāhuyuddhaṃ yayāce rāṣṭrakaṃ ca vā ||28|| bhāṇavīryo mahābhaktaḥ samadṛg vai kṣamābhṛtam | svāgatena samadṛṣṭyāmānayacca jagau tadā ||29|| rājan yuddhe manuṣyāṇāṃ nāśo hiṃsā bhavediti | jayo vāpajayo vāpi mayi tvayi bhaviṣyati || 2.262.3 0|| svasvarājye sthitau cāvāṃ vijayasthau na saṃśayaḥ | nahi tṛṣṇākhyatantūnāṃ vicchedo’nto bhaviṣyati ||3 1|| bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ rāmaṃ vṛthā kleśaṃ ca mā vaha | na me rājyaṃ na te rājyaṃ na kṣitiḥ saha yāsyati ||32|| na sainyaṃ bāndhavā bhṛtyā dhanāni rāṣṭrakaṃ prajāḥ | saha yāsyanti maraṇe mṛtau na kṣaṇanirṇayaḥ ||33|| mayā kṛṣṇārpitaṃ rājyaṃ na me rājyaṃ viśiṣyate | rāmarājye vṛthā gṛdhnāṃ mā samāvaha pārthiva ||34|| bāhuyuddhaṃ balaṃ pṛthvyā na te me’pi kathaṃcana | śastrayuddhaṃ hi sainyasya parasyaiva balaṃ hi tat ||35|| balaṃ rāmāt prasaṃpādyaṃ yadbalaṃ sahagaṃ bhavet | tadvinā cāphalaṃ sarvaṃ balaṃ nirbalameva tat || 36|| kṣamābhṛta uvāca rājā bhūtvā sādhuvādān vadasyeva hi nirbalaḥ | neyaṃ rājakule sādho rītiryaśaskarī kvacit| || 37|| nātra rāmo na vai kṛṣṇo na yuddhe rakṣako hariḥ | balajayyaṃ bhaved rāṣṭraṃ yuddhadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 38 || dehi yuddhena vā rājyaṃ śaraṇāgatimāvaha | anyathā tvāṃ nigaḍe vai kṛtvā neṣye tamogṛham || 3 9|| bhāṇavīrya uvācanigaḍā racitāḥ śrīmadrāmeṇa na tvayā nṛpa | duṣṭārthe nigaḍā yogyā yadyahaṃ tādṛśastathā ||2.262.40 || nigaḍe saṃbhaviṣyāmi mā cintāṃ tatra vai kuru | aduṣṭasya na nigaḍo yathā te rocate kuru || 41 || pareśvareṇa racitā bhūmirjalaṃ ca vahnayaḥ | vāyuḥ prāṇā gaganaṃ ca śabdādyāścendriyāṇi ca ||42|| śarīraṃ racitaṃ tena rājyaṃ tenaiva nirmitam | rājapadaṃ pradattaṃ ca tenaiva paramātmanā || 43 || yasya rājyaṃ jagat sarvaṃ yaddattaṃ prakaromyaham | rājyaṃ rājan karomyevaṃ taddattaṃ tvaṃ sukhī bhava ||44|| mā ca gṛdhaḥ parasyānnaṃ pareśasya kare sthitam | cātitṛṣṇo jano naśyet samūlaḥ saparigrahaḥ || 45|| rājñā kārye sadā ceśadattād deyaṃ parātmane | pūjane’rpaṇamevātra tvaṃ tathā bhaktimāvaha ||46|| anādadāno gṛhṇāno rājam̐stvaṃ doṣamugrakam | mā savahātra bhūmau vai mānave mokṣasādhane ||47|| paśya rājan rājyabhūmau karṣukā yadi vatsare | dvivatsarayośca vā trivatsareṣu karādikam ||48 || yadi naiva dadatyeva rājñe te doṣabhāginaḥ | rājadaṇḍyā bhaveyuste gṛhānniṣkāsitāstathā ||49|| kṣetravāṭīvihīnāśca bhaveyuḥ rājyadaṇḍitāḥ | karadānena nirdoṣāḥ karādānena doṣiṇaḥ ||2.262.5 0 || karṣukasya gṛhavāṭīkṣetrodyānādikaṃ ca yat | nṛpasyaiva bhavatyeva karādānanimittakam ||5 1 || karṣukastatra kṛṣyādyairjīvatyeva karapradaḥ | karṣukeṇa nṛpo naiva vismartavyaḥ kadācana || 52|| yadi rājā vismṛtaḥ syāt karṣuko daṇḍabhāg bhavet | karaṃ datvā nṛpaṃ smṛtvā jīvatyeva hyabādhitaḥ ||53 || evameva jagad rājan rājyaṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ | pṛthivī nirmitā tena jalaṃ tejo’nilo’nalaḥ ||54|| śarīraṃ nirmitaṃ tena dravyamannaṃ rasādayaḥ | narā nāryaḥ putrapaśuvṛkṣavallīgṛhādayaḥ ||55|| divā rātriḥ sūryacandrau sukhaṃ śamaḥ kuṭumbakam | sampadbhojyaṃ ca peyaṃ ca sarvaṃ tasyaiva rāṣṭrakam ||56|| tasmai rājñe samarpyo vai kasmai yajñātmako hi saḥ | anivedyāsamarpyāpi karaṃ nārāyaṇasya vai ||57|| karṣukāśca vayaṃ sarve bhuṃkṣvahe cedanarpitam | tarhi daṇḍasya pātrāṇi bhavema nātra saṃśayaḥ ||58|| tasmād rājan nahi pṛthvī te me vāpi kadācana | pṛthvyāṃ sthitaiśca vāsmābhiḥ karṣukatvena pālyate ||59|| sa eva samrāḍ rājāsti mā yuddhaṃ kuru pārthiva | mayā vā tena sākaṃ vā bhuñjīthāstena te’rpitam ||2.262.60|| tena vāsyamidaṃ sarvaṃ yat kiñcijjagatyāṃ hi tat| | tena dattaṃ prabhuñjīthā mā gṛdhoḥ yatparasya vai ||61|| naijaṃ muktvārpayitvaiva haraye mokṣamāvaha | mokṣarājyaṃ paraṃ rājyaṃ prāpnuhīti nibodha me ||62|| kṣamābhṛta uvāca bhūpapatho mokṣapatho jñānapathaḥ pṛthak trayaḥ | yuddhapatho nṛpāṇāṃ vai tatra jñānaṃ na yujyate ||63|| sarvaṃ nārāyaṇasyaiva balavān yaḥ sa vindate | bhuṃkte rājyaṃ samṛddhaṃ ced rājadharmo hi yodhanam || 64|| eṣa tvāṃ nigaḍe kṛtvā rājan harāmi rāṣṭrakam | ityuktvā sahasā kṣamābhṛto babandha bhāṇakam ||65|| sakuṭumbaṃ ca sāmātyaṃ kośaṃ ca rājamandiram | bhāṇavīryo hare rāma rāmakṛṣṇa harehare ||66|| bālakṛṣṇa kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa lakṣmīnātha harehare | evaṃ cakāra bhajanaṃ nigaḍastho’pi nirbhayaḥ || 67|| kuṭumbaṃ bhajanaṃ cakre nirbhayaṃ bhagavadbalam | kṣamābhṛtaśca mumude rājyaṃ prāptamakaṇṭakam ||68|| bhaktapriyo hi bhagavān bhaktasāhāyyadaḥ prabhuḥ | vaikuṇṭhasthaḥ prabhuḥ śrīmān sitāpatiḥ pareśvaraḥ ||6 9|| śuśrāva bhajanaṃ tasya bhāṇavīryasya cottamam | sitā prāha hariṃ tatra kimidaṃ kīrtanaṃ bahu ||2.262.70|| śrūyate tīvrasaṃvegaṃ kānta kena samīritam | rāmādityastadā prāha paśya lakṣmi svabhaktakam ||71 || nigaḍasthaṃ bhāṇavīryaṃ surāṣṭre siṃharājake | pattane ca nije kṣamābhṛtena nihitaḥ khalu ||72|| sitāpaśyannigaḍasthaṃ bhaktaṃ rājānameva sā | utthāya sahasā rāmaṃ samutthāya sapārṣadā ||73 || ājagāma kṣaṇāt pṛthvyāṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro’ntikam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ brahmapriyāstathā ||74|| saha nītvā sitā rāmaṃ sainyaṃ vyaracayattadā | caturaṃgaṃ ca yuddhārthaṃ vyomagaṃ śīghragāmi ca ||75|| bhaktasya rakṣaṇārthaṃ vai yuddhatūryāṇyavādayat | siṃharājīnagaryāstu prākārasya samantataḥ ||76 || cakravyūhaṃ pṛtanāyāḥ kṛtvā kṣamābhṛtaṃ nṛpam | cetayāmāsa yuddhārthaṃ so’pi sainyena saṃyutaḥ ||77|| yuddhārthaṃ tvāyayau śīghraṃ saṃgrāmo’bhūnmaholbaṇaḥ | daśasāhasrayoddhāraḥ kṣamābhṛtasya bheditāḥ ||78|| śarairbāṇaistomaraiśca vajraiścakraiḥ kṛpāṇakaiḥ | kṣamābhṛto dhṛto jīvasahaḥ pāśairmahābhaṭaiḥ ||79|| bhāṇavīryaṃ ca nirbandhaṃ cakāra hi sitā svayam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo rāmastasmai dadau svadarśanam ||2.262.80 || brahmapriyā daduścāpi darśanaṃ nṛpayoṣite | kuṭumbāya prajābhyaścāśīrvādān lomaśo dadau ||81 || ahaṃ rājan lomaśo vai mantraṃ dade’sya vaiṣṇavam | rājyaṃ bhaktāya dattvaiva kṣamābhṛtaṃ nibadhya ca ||82|| visṛjya tasya deśaṃ ca kuṃkumakṣetrakaṃ prati | bhāṇavīryaṃ savaṃśaṃ ca rāmādityaṃ sapārṣadam ||83 || ānāyyāśvasarovārau snāpayāmāsa śuddhaye | hatānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ prādād bhagavāna bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||84|| rāmādityaḥ samuvāsa sapārṣadagaṇastadā | ādṛtaḥ satkṛtaścāpi sarasyatrāplavaṃ vyadhāt ||85|| tattīrthaṃ rāmatīrthaṃ vai rājannetat tato’bhavat | sitātīrthaṃ muktitīrthaṃ sarasyetannigadyate ||86|| bhāṇavīryeṇa vai cātra mandiraṃ kāritaṃ śubham | rāmādityo hi sitayā sahitaścātra śobhate ||87|| pārṣadaiḥ sahitaścāpi dhṛtakārmukahetikaḥ | evaṃ bhaktasya rakṣā vai kṛtā śrīparamātmanā ||88|| bhāṇatīrthaṃ tathā khyātaṃ vaikuṇṭhatīrthamityapi | īśānataḥ paścime vai vartate somatīrthakāt ||89|| atra snāhi jalaṃ pītvā tarpitvā bhaktitaḥ pitṝn | dehi dānāni viprebhyaḥ sadbhyaḥ satībhya ityapi ||2.262.90 || sarvadānaphalaṃ cātra lapsyase tvalpadānataḥ | pṛthvīdānaphalaṃ cātra phalamātrapradānataḥ ||9 1|| svargadānaphalaṃ cātra dhenudānapradānataḥ | lakṣmīdānaphalaṃ cātra kanyādānapradānataḥ ||92||| mokṣadānaphalaṃ cātrābhayadānapradānataḥ | ityukto rādhike rājā bhāṇavīryo mahābalaḥ ||93 || bhaktarāḍ vidhinā snānadānārhaṇāni saṃvyadhāt | dhyānaṃ cakre kṣaṇaṃ rāmādityasya paramātmanaḥ ||94|| rāmasya darśanaṃ tasya tejomadhye hṛdantare | jātaṃ tutoṣa rājāpi lomaśo’pi samādhinā ||95| | dadarśa divyadṛṣṭyā vai smāritaḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | dṛṣṭaḥ sākṣāttato rāmo’ntardhānaṃ prajagāma ha ||96|| ityevaṃ cetanaṃ tīrthaṃ rāmādityābhidhaṃ param | rādhike smaraṇāccāpi rāmadarśanakārakam ||97|| pāpatāpaharaṃ śatrusaṃkaṭādivināśakam | vaikuṇṭhavāsadaṃ ramyaṃ viṣṇośca mandiraṃ śubham ||98|| yatra mṛtāḥ paśavo’pi yānti vaikuṇṭhamuttamam | yatra snātā narā nāryo yānti vaikuṇṭhamuttamam ||99|| yatra rāmahrade snātvā prayānti satyataḥ param | sakāmāḥ suralokaṃ vā niṣkāmāścākṣaraṃ padam || 2.262.1 00|| prayānti rādhike sampūjitāḥ pārṣadasattamaiḥ | śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya tatsarvaṃ phalamāpnuyāt || 10 1|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāmaśvapāṭalo rāmādityatīrthaṃ prāpya bhāṇavīryabhaktakathāṃ śrutvā vidhinā snānadānādikaṃ cakāra rājñoḥ mithaḥ saṃvādaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 262 ||
<2.263> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānyaṃ tīrthaṃ vai lomaśoditam | sūryanārāyaṇasyaiva sarvakuṣṭhavināśanam || 1 || rāmatīrthaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā yayau tvagre’śvapāṭalaḥ | tīrthaṃ sarastaṭe ramyaṃ sūryabhāsurasajjalam || 2 || sūryavad yatra dṛśyante śuktayo’pi subhāsurāḥ | kiraṇāni vimuñcanti jālāntarasthitā api || 3 || jalaṃ dedīpyamānaṃ tadvilokya tvaśvapāṭṭalaḥ | papraccha lomaśaṃ devaṃ mahāścaryabharastadā || 4 || aśvapāṭala uvāca guro tīrthamidaṃ sarvatīrthebhyo dyotanāśrayam | kathaṃ kasmāt kadā tvevaṃ jātaṃ vai sūryavarculam || 5 || jalānyapi prakāśante sūryagarbhāṇi vai yathā | kinnāma kiṃguṇaṃ kiṃsatphalaṃ tat kathaya prabho || 6 || śrīlomaśa uvāca śṛṇu rājan mahāścaryaṃ yadatra samabhūt purā | stambhapure purā tvāsīt kāyastho lekhakarmakṛt || 7 || bhajate sa prabhuṃ nityaṃ rājakarmacaro’bhavat | nyāyakārye sahāyo vai lekhako’bhūt subuddhimān || 8 || dāridryadoṣachannaśca lakṣmītṛṣṇāticañcalaḥ | yena kena prakāreṇa dravyaṃ sādhyaṃ dhanādikam || 9 || lekhane śabdamālānāṃ pūrvāparavichittayā | arthasyāpi bhaved yatrānartho’pi lābhahānidaḥ || 2.263.1 0|| tathā śabdān lekhaguptān kṛtvā tu lekhapatrake | yo dadāti dhanaṃ tasmai luñcārūpaṃ tadarthikām || 11 || lābhalipiṃ vilikhyaiva dadātyeva jayapradām | dvyartharūpāṃ saṃkarārthāṃ padacchede navārthikām || 1 2|| evaṃ lobhena bahūnāṃ nyāyānyāyavilekhanāt | pāpabhāreṇa jāto’yaṃ galatkuṣṭhī karadvaye ||1 3|| ūrjavrato hi nāmnā sa kāyastho hastarogavān | lekhakāryaṃ tatastyaktvā tīrthārthaṃ gopanāthakam || 14|| kṛṣṇalīlāmayaṃ tīrthaṃ tvāyayau snātavām̐stataḥ | guptaprayāgakaṃ kṣetraṃ dadau pāpanivārakam || 15|| snātastatra tato mūladvārikāṃ prayayau hi saḥ | tato yayau somanāthaṃ prācīplakṣaṃ tato yayau || 16|| sarasvatyāṃ kṛtasnānaḥ plakṣamūlasamāśritaḥ | jajāpa manasā jāpaṃ kṛṣṇakṛṣṇotimādhava || 17|| nārāyaṇaharerāma janārdana janāvana | kṛpālo karuṇāsindho rogād rakṣaya māṃ prabho || 18|| kṛtānāṃ karmaṇaṃ cātra phalaṃ tīvraprayogiṇām | jāyate mandavegānāṃ kālāntare prajāyate || 19|| janmāntare ca vā sarvaṃ bhoktavyaṃ vā yamagṛhe | yatra kvāpi gataṃ jantuṃ kṛtaṃ karma na muñcati ||2.263.20|| mayā lekhe bahūnāṃ vai satyādasatyamucchritam | asatyād satyarūpaṃ tu kṛtvā cākuśalaṃ kṛtam ||21|| tena pāpena bhagavan kuṣṭho’galan karadvaye | aṃguliṣu prajāto me tīrthaṃ pāpavināśanam ||22|| kṛtaṃ tathāpi bhagavan rogo’yaṃ na vilīyate | tasmāduddhara deveśa kṛpayā māṃ kṛpānidhe ||23 || naivaṃ punaḥ kariṣye’tra loke doṣaṃ kadācana | namaste pāpahartre’tra rogahartre namo namaḥ ||24|| bhaktānāṃ sukhakartre’tra tīrthe goptre namo’stu te | namaste sarvakarṇāya namaste sarvacakṣuṣe ||25|| namaste sarvavijñāya sarvahṛtsthāya te namaḥ | namaḥ kāyastharūpāya namo nikāyayojine ||26|| namaścādṛśyarūpāya śaraṇāgatarakṣiṇe | ityevaṃ prārthayāmāsa kāyastho vimanā iva ||27|| plakṣādho niṣasādāpi nirāśaścintayan mṛtim | tāvattatra samāyātaḥ kaścid vipro jaṭādharaḥ ||28|| ārādhayārkakṣetraṃ tvaṃ gatvāntikasthitaṃ tviha | arkavṛkṣāśrayo bhūtvā sūryamantrān sadā japa ||29|| sūryanārāyaṇo devaḥ kuṣṭhaṃ te nāśayiṣyati | sarasvatīṃ nadīṃ snātvā pītvā jalaṃ ca pāvanam || 2.263.30|| namo brahmasavitre te kuṣṭhahartre namo namaḥ | ityevaṃ japa gatvaiva sūryakṣetraṃ śubhapradam ||3 1|| ityuktaḥ sa tu kāyastho rājam̐stato’rkatīrthakam | viśvakarmakṛtaḥ sūryaḥ śāṇollīḍho yadā purā ||32|| yatra khaṇḍaśca patito yatrārkavṛkṣatāṃ raviḥ | gatastatra yayau pṛṣṭvā taṃ jaṭādhraṃ praṇamya ca ||33|| arkavṛkṣavanaṃ dṛṣṭvā tutoṣorjavrato hi saḥ | śvetārkān vyomaraṃgārkān sthūlapuṣpakān ||34|| bahudugdhān stambarūpān vallīrūpān bahūn drumān | phalapuṣpadalāḍhyāṃśca dṛṣṭvā tutoṣa vai hi saḥ ||35|| mārgayāmāsa bahudhā tīrthasthalaṃ kva vai bhavet | śreṣṭhārkasannidhau cāhaṃ niṣadya prajapāmi ha ||36|| tāvattenārkamūle’ vai bahuśākhadalāvṛte | bahupuṣpāśraye mūle śikhācakraṃ vilokitam ||37|| tatrāsya mānasaṃ lagnaṃ kuṭītulye’rkasadgṛhe | tacchāyāyāṃ cakārāyaṃ vāsaṃ mūle japan manum ||38|| namo brahmasavitre te kuṣṭhahartra namo namaḥ | ityevaṃ prajapam̐statra kṣutpipāsākulo’pi san ||39|| rātriṃ nirgamayāmāsa nidrāṃ lebhe na vai manāka | prātarutthāya puṣpāṇāṃ mālāṃ kṛtvā tṛṇe guṇe ||2.263.40|| śilācakrāya sūryāyārpayāmāsa sa bhaktitaḥ | jalaṃ dadau śilāyāṃ ca sītāphalaṃ phalaṃ dadau ||41 || tulasyāḥ patramevāpi dadau śilāsvarūpiṇe | stutiṃ namaskṛtiṃ cakre tataḥ sītāphalaṃ hi saḥ ||42|| prasādaṃ bubhuje paścājjajāpa satataṃ hi saḥ | evaṃ māse gate rājan phalāhāraparāyaṇe ||43|| cakrān samutthitaḥ kaścidajñānarūpasundaraḥ | puruṣaḥ śvetavarṇaśca bahuraśmisamanvitaḥ ||44|| suvarṇakuṇḍalakarṇaḥ samukuṭaḥ sacakrakaḥ | samaṇihāravakṣāśca hiraṇyavarṇa ujjvalaḥ ||45|| kaṭakāṃgadabāhuśca hasan snehasamākulaḥ | sauvarṇāmbarasaṃrājatkāntiparidhimastakaḥ ||46|| śanairāgatya cakrādvai dūramūrjavrataṃ sthitam | jagāda vada putra tvaṃ kimicchasi ca mā ciram ||47|| ūrjavratastadovāca devadeva jagadguro | kuṣṭharogapraśāntiṃ me samicchāmi dayāṃ kuru ||48|| ko bhavān bhagavānāste sarvatejo’nvitastviha | manye sūryaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇo me kṛpayādbhutaḥ ||49|| prakāśamāgatastvatra bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ | namaḥ sahasrarūpāya namaḥ sahasraraśmaye ||2.263.50|| namo bhaktakṛpākartre namaḥ sahasracakṣuṣe | namo jagatprakāśāya sarvabhūtapracakṣuṣe ||51 || parabrahmasvarūpāya mokṣadātre namo namaḥ | namastejo’bhihantre ca rogahantre namo namaḥ |||52|| ityuktvā nipapātāsāvūrjavrato’sya pādayoḥ | sūryastiro’bhavattūrṇaṃ divyavāṇyā jagāda ha ||53|| ūrjavrata svasti te’stu roganāśo bhaviṣyati | akṛtaniṣkṛtistvaṃ vai na māṃ spraṣṭumihārhasi ||54|| manmaṃtralakṣajāpena prāyaścittaṃ bhavet tava | tatkuru yāhi cetastu hyaśvapaṭṭasarovaram ||55|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrayākṣarābhidham | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ puruṣottamasaṃśritam ||56|| tasyaiva sarasastīre cottare śaṃkarāśraye | arkavṛkṣāśraye sthitvā japamantraṃ mamottamam ||57|| tava kuṣṭhasya vai nāśaḥ śīghraṃ tatra bhaviṣyati | śrutvaivaṃ śāradāṃ divyāṃ neme tāṃ diśameva saḥ ||58|| prasannaścorjavratako yayau śrībalikhātakam | tato yayau vāmanasya sthalīṃ vastrāpathaṃ tataḥ ||59|| suvarṇarakṣāsalile snātvā nārāyaṇe hrade| indreśvare mahālakṣmītīrthe cakrakatīrthake ||2.263.60|| śaṃkhalādevikāṃ natvā turādevīṃ praṇamya ca | vyāghrīṃ devīṃ tato natvā natvā śrīkharkharīṃ satīm ||61|| rāṇikāṃ ca tato natvā yayau kuṃkumavāpikām | mahālakṣmīṃ vāpikāyāstīre sthitāṃ praṇamya ca ||62|| praṇamya nagarīṃ svarṇavarṇāṃ nārāyaṇālayam | praṇamyāśvasaro dṛṣṭvā yayāvuttaragaṃ taṭam ||63|| śāṃkaraṃ kṣetrapeśaṃ ca natvā pītvā jalaṃ tataḥ | mārgayāmāsa vai cārkavṛkṣaṃ dadarśa sannidhau ||64|| bhikṣāṃ yācitvaiva bhuktvā phalamūladalātmikām | arkavṛkṣatale tasthau kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā raviṃ prabhum ||65|| arkamūle sa śuśrāva vāṇīṃ tvadṛśyarūpiṇīm | svasti te’stu hi kāyastha tiṣṭha japa raviṃ smara ||66|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nityaṃ prage bhaja | pūjayārkeśvaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ satāṃ patim ||67|| ahaṃ bhajāmi taṃ deveśvareśvareśvareśvaram | mayā labdhaṃ tataḥ sarvaṃ teja aiśvaryamityapi ||68|| sūryo’haṃ tava kalyāṇaṃ kariṣyāmi hariṃ bhaja | lakṣajapottaraṃ hastau snānamātreṇa sārase ||69|| jale pūrṇau rogahīnau bhaviṣyato’rkavaibhavāt | ityāśrutya giraṃ corjavrataścakre’rkapādape ||2.263.70 || mūladeśe nivāsaṃ ca valkalādyadhivāsanam | ayācitotkarṣavṛttyā jīvayātrāṃ karoti ca ||71 || phalamūladalāhāro jalāhāraḥ kvacittathā | namo brahmasavitre te kuṣṭhahartre namo namaḥ ||72|| jajāpainaṃ mahāmantraṃ satataṃ sūryamānasaḥ | nityaṃ pañcasahasrāṇi japān karoti bhaktarāṭ ||73 || ekaviṃśe dine lakṣajapeṣu nirvṛtteṣu ca | sotsāhaścorjavratakaḥ smaran sūryanarāyaṇam ||74|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīre prātaḥ snātuṃ yayau drutam | sasnau rājannatra tīre jale’vagāhya vai muhuḥ ||75|| nimajyonmajya ca punaḥ karau paśyati lekhakaḥ | naiva paśyati nīrogau tadā snāti punaḥ punaḥ ||76|| punaḥ paśyati hastau ca norogau naiva paśyati | evaṃ snātvā śramaṃ prāpya nīrāśo’yaṃ vyajāyata ||77|| jape vrate kṣatiṃ naijāṃ vyatarkayata lekhakaḥ | sasmāra śokamāsādya sūryanārāyaṇaṃ tadā ||78|| vyomavāṇī jagādainaṃ bhakta vrataṃ tavātra vai | sampannaṃ sarvathā tatra kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||79|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ madhyāhnake kṣaṇe | dhyātvā snāsyasi tūrṇaṃ te hastau rohiṣyatastadā ||2.263.80|| galatkuṣṭhena naṣṭā yā aṅgulyaśca karadvayam | hastatalaṃ samastaṃ tat sarvaṃ prarohayiṣyati ||81|| ityuktaścorjavratakaḥ kāyastho’rkasthalīṃ yayau | madhyāhne ca tathā sasnau yathoktasmṛtipūrvakam ||82|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sūryanarāyaṇaḥ | dvau samānavayasyau vai bhūtvā bālasvarūpiṇau ||83 || sundarau mandahāsyāsyau divyakuṇḍaladhāriṇau | rūpānurūpāvayavau devadevādipūjitau ||84|| āgatya jalamadhyasthaṃ snāntaṃ kāyasthabhaktakam | karābhyāṃ ca karau dhṛtvonmajjya niṣkāsya vai bahiḥ ||85|| asthāpayatāṃ sarasastīre pūrṇakarāgrajam | sūryeṇa tu dhṛto vāmakaraḥ pūrṇatamo’bhavat ||86|| hariṇā sandhṛto dakṣaḥ karaḥ pūrṇatamo’bhavat | kāyasthaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇo’pi tejasā tapasā tathā ||87|| puṇyairnārāyaṇasparśeḥ śvetarūpastadābhavat | yathā sūryo yathā kṛṣṇastattulyaḥ sa tadābhavat ||88|| tulyarūpām̐strīn puruṣān devavadbhāsamanvitān | janāstu dadṛśustatra mahāścaryaparāyaṇāḥ ||89|| ubhayoḥ śrīmatornārāyaṇayoḥ pādayostadā | pūrṇakāmaḥ sa bhakto vai nipapāta muhurmuhuḥ ||2.263.90|| tārito’haṃ kuṣṭharogād bhavarogācca tāritaḥ | hastalābhe harekṛṣṇa yadyahaṃ tuṣṭimāpnuyām ||9 1 || militayorbhavatorme punamelanamadhruvam | tasmāt tyakṣye na milito pāvitavantau māṃ prabhū ||92|| ūrjavrataḥ pradhṛtvaiva tayoścaraṇāveva ha | jagāda na mayā stheyaṃ bhūloke kleśasāgare || 93|| yuvāṃ nārāyaṇau kṛṣṇau hyuddhāraṃ kurutaṃ mama | sūryaḥ prāha ca kāyastha sthitvātra mama mandiram ||94|| prakāraya śubhaṃ svalpaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ mama kāraya | kuṣṭhināṃ snānataḥ paścānmama darśanamātrataḥ ||95|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya pūjanāttathā | roganāthastathā tīrthayātrā pūrṇā bhavediha ||96|| evaṃ kṛtvā tatastvaṃ vai saṃyātā ravimaṇḍalam | tataḥ satyapralokaṃ ca siddhānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ tataḥ ||97|| tato vaikuṇṭhamevāpi tato’kṣaraṃ gamiṣyasi | ityuktvāntarhitau devau sūryaḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||98|| kāyastho divyadehasthaḥ kārayāmāsa mandiram | sūryanārāyaṇaṃ cātra prātiṣṭhipat tathocitam ||99|| dvayornārāyaṇayośca tejāṃsyatra jalāntare | saṃvyāptānyabhavan rājan tadā kāle samantataḥ || 2.263.10 0|| matsyāśca śuktayaścāpi maṇayaśca jalāni ca | rajaḥkaṇāstadā tejovyāptāḥ sūryā ivābhavan || 10 1|| tādṛśyaḥ prakṛtayastāstato’dyāpi jalāntare | tābhyo vai jāyamānāśca tejomayyo hi śuktayaḥ || 1 02|| maṇayaḥ kaṃkarāścāpi rajāṃsi jalajāni ca | tadvaṃśāstatkiraṇaiḥ saṃvyāptā bhavanti sarvadā || 103 || sūryanārāyaṇaścātra jale śuktau maṇāvapi | mandire’dṛśyarūpo’pi vartate tejasānvitaḥ || 1 04|| tattejo’yaṃ sadā rājan prasaratyeva sarvataḥ | sūryatīrthaṃ tato jātaṃ pratyakṣaṃ sūryavarculam || 1 05|| ūrjavratastataḥ kālāntare sūryarathaṃ yayau | muktiṃ jagāma bhajanānnārāyaṇakṛpāvaśāt || 1 06|| kuṣṭhanāśakaraṃ tīrthaṃ sūryapratyakṣadarśanam | sūryatejobhisaṃvyāptajalaśuktyādiśobhanam || 1 07|| arkatīrthaṃ tathā corjavratatīrthamidaṃ śubham | kāyasthatīrthakaṃ cāpi sarvarogavināśakam || 1 08|| ityukto rādhike rājā cakre tīrthaṃ vidhānataḥ | dadau dānāni saṃsnātvā pupūjārkaṃ narāyaṇam || 109 || tataścāgre yayau tīrthāntaraṃ rājā salomaśaḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇādasyārogyaṃ muktiṃ vrajejjanaḥ || 2.263.11 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne galatkuṣṭhina ūrjavratakāyasthasya sūryopāsanayā nīrogitvaṃ muktiśca sūryatīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṣaṣṭhyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 263 ||
<2.264> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca tataśca rādhike cāśvapaṭṭalo lomaśānvitaḥ | yayāvagre ca śārṅgadhratīrthaṃ paramapāvanam || 1 || aśvapāṭala uvāca kavi tīrthamidaṃ saumyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ kimātmakam | yatra me sphurati vidyā vedavedāṅgabodhinī || 2 || śrīlomaśa uvāca rājam̐stīrthamidaṃ caivaṃ camatkārabharaṃ param | vidyate vai ṛṣeryogācchārṅgadharamahātmanaḥ || 3 || śārṅgadharomahātmābhūd vipro’pi buddhivarjitaḥ | dharmāraṇyakṛtāvāsaḥ śṛṃgadharasya vai sutaḥ || 4 || ābālyāttu jaḍavat sa vaktaṃu jānāti naiva ha | mūkavad vartate cāpi jihvāhrasvākhyadoṣataḥ || 5 || aśvapāṭala uvāca kathaṃ jihvābhavattasya hrasvā maurkhyaṃ ca me vada | mūkavadvā kathaṃ cāste bālye cāñcalyamandire || 6 || śrīlomaśa uvāca pūrvajanmani śūdro’bhūd daṇḍakāraṇyavāsakṛt | hiṃsāparastathā śāstradevanindāparo’pyabhūt || 7 || brāhmaṇān yajñakartṝn sa kleśayatyeva vāgruṣā | nārāyaṇāvatārām̐śca nāstiko manute na vai || 8 || kathā yatra ca bhavati tatrāsatyāṃ pravakti tām | sarvāmudarapoṣārthaṃ vakti svārthaparāyaṇām || 9 || evaṃ nindāparaścāyaṃ kadācid gautamītaṭe | mṛgayārthaṃ gatastatra śṛṃgamṛgaṃ vyalokayat || 1.264.1 0|| mṛgaṃ hantuṃ śaraṃ cānusandadhāti tu yāvatā | tāvanmṛgo bhayāt tūrṇaṃ dudrāva gautamīṃ prati || 11 || adṛśyatāṃ gato vṛkṣaghaṭāyāṃ ca tataḥ param | śūdrako’pi pradudrāva mārgayituṃ taṭaṃ prati || 12|| godāvaryā jalaprānte dadarśa taṃ mṛgaṃ punaḥ | śaro muktaśca śūdreṇa mṛgapṛṣṭhe praveśitaḥ || 12|| mṛgaścotplutya saritaḥ pravāhe nipapāta ha | abhāno mūrchito’gādhe jale vegapravāhaṇe || 14|| karṣitaḥ saśaro yāto jalayogena vai talam | mṛtaśca jalamadhye vai makareṇa sa bhakṣitaḥ || 15|| kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa nārāyaṇeti saṃsmaran | mṛgo’pi tīrthamāhātmyāt pareśasmaraṇāttataḥ || 16|| puṇyatīrthamṛterjāto dharmāraṇye sa bhūsuraḥ | śṛṃgacihnasametaśca bālaḥ parṇadharasya vai || 17|| viprasya mandire kṛṣṇabhaktimān viprasadgaṇaḥ | jātismaro’bhavaccāpi bhajatyeva hi mādhavam || 18|| gaṃge godāvari sindho yamune ca sarasvati | smṛtvā snāti harekṛṣṇa gṛṇātyeva divāniśam || 19|| vavṛdhe sa ca bālo’pi pitrā śṛṃgadharaḥ kṛtaḥ | upavītī ca śāstrāṇi samadhyaita pratāpavān ||1.264.20|| dharmakarmaparaścābhūdvivāhitaśca vai tataḥ | śūdro mamāra ca godāvarī taṭe vane tadā || 21|| godāvaryāṃ dehadāho niṣpāditaśca bāndhavaiḥ | tena puṇyapratāpena pāpāṇyasya prajajvaluḥ ||22|| mṛtyukāle’smarat so’pi mṛgaṃ taṃ śarasandhitam | tatpratāpena śūdraḥ sa śṛṃgadharasya putrakaḥ ||23 || dharmāraṇye’bhavad vipraḥ śūdrācārau jaḍo yathā | pitā jānāti vai sarvaṃ jātismarasvabhāvavān ||24| putro jānāti naivāyaṃ ko’hamāsaṃ purā tanau | bālaḥ sa śāradāhīno mūka iva vyajāyata ||25|| jihvā hrasvā yato vaktuṃ jānātyeva na bālyataḥ | truṭitānsphoṭitān varṇān mammā caccā vadatyapi ||26|| mūko vaktuṃ na jānāti nāmnā śārṅgadharaḥ kṛtaḥ | upavītī kṛtaḥ pitrā ṛṇānubandhano’pi saḥ || 27|| pūrvajanmakṛtanindāphalaṃ bhuṃkte hi mūkatām | nāstikyasya phalaṃ maurkhyaṃ bhuṃkte vicittavattathā || 28|| mṛgahatyāphalaṃ tasya putratābhavanaṃ hyapi | ṛṇadānāya janmāsyā bhavacchṛṃgadharālaye ||29|| tīrthamṛtyuphalaṃ cāsya vipragṛhe janirmatā | so’yaṃ maurkhyānmūkabhāvājjaḍatvānmānavarjitaḥ ||1.264.30|| jaḍavadvai tapastaptuṃ dharmāraṇye mano’karot | samārebhe sa vai sthitvā valmīkaśikhare sthitaḥ || 31 || tapaścograṃ cakārāsau phalamūladalāśanaḥ | nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnāyī mānasaṃ japamādadhe || 32|| lokā draṣṭuṃ samāyānti mūko vai tapasi sthitaḥ | nāyaṃ paśyati kām̐ścittu baddhanetro’bhavattadā ||33 || nāścaryaṃ manyate tatra mālayā japamādadhan | sasmāra bhagavantaṃ taṃ jihvāsarasvatīpradam ||34|| vedānāṃ śevadhiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram | sarvavidyāśrayaṃ sarvavijñaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavallabham ||35 || daśavarṣaṃ jajāpaivaṃ tapaścakāra sadṛśam | valmīkāvāsa evāsau varṣāsu plakṣamūlagaḥ ||36 || parṇakuṭīvihīnaśca vitānarahitastathā | āsanādivihīnaśca prāvaraṇavivarjitaḥ ||37|| jaṭādharo romadharo bhasmadharo’titāpasaḥ | valkalakaupīnamātraḥ karapātro’bhavat sadā ||38|| daśavarṣottaraṃ corje māse prabodhinītithau | rātrau tvākāśagīścāsmai śravasormadhyagā jagau ||39|| vipra tapasā siddho’si gataṃ te kalmaṣaṃ bahu | pūrvajanmāparādhānāmantastvayā vinirmitaḥ ||1.264.40|| tapasā cātha bhajanaistatastvaṃ sāvadhānataḥ | yāhi padbhyāṃ tīrthamagryamaśvapaṭṭasarovaram ||41 || paścimodadhisānnidhye dvīpe cānartasaṃjñake | saurāṣṭre deśake tatrākṣarakṣetraṃ pravidyate ||41|| nāmnā kuṃkumavāpīti nagarī cācyutāśrayā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāvāsā hi śāśvatī ||43 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | japa mantraṃ ca satataṃ yāhi taṃ deśamuttamam ||44|| sthānabalād deśabalādāśramasya balāttathā | devabalād yatnabalādasādhyamapi siddhyati ||45|| ityuktā virarāmaiṣā vāṇī tataḥ sa bhūsuraḥ | natvā pitre ca mātre ca tapaḥsthānaṃ praṇamya ca ||46|| valmīkaṃ plakṣamevāpi natvā prayayau tairthikaḥ | gayāṃ kāśīṃ prayāgaṃ ca indraprasthavanaṃ yamīm ||47|| puṣkaraṃ ca nadīṃ sarasvatīṃ siddhasamāśritām | bahucarāṃ satīṃ tīrthānyāvīkṣya pravidhāya ca ||48|| saurāṣṭraṃ cāviveśāsau mūkaścatuṣṭilācalam | gatvā kuṃkumavāpyākhyaṃ kṣetramāpākṣarābhidham ||49|| dṛṣṭvā sarovaraṃ ramyaṃ sāgarābhaṃ mahattamam | sarvatīrthāśrayaṃ devadevīsatīsadāśrayam ||1.264.50|| maharṣikṛtasandhyādidhyānakarmādiśobhitam | tīrthavāsiprajābhiśca snānadānādibṛṃhitam ||51|| haṃsagaruḍamenādyaiḥ pakṣivrātaiḥ samanvitam | āmrāmṛtaphalivṛkṣairudyānaiḥ parito’nvitam ||52|| īśānavaśyadevādyairgaṇaiḥ saṃrakṣitaṃ sadā | yajñabhūmaṇḍapādyaiśca vedaghoṣaiśca nāditam ||53||| kāmadhenukāmalatākalpamaṇivirājitam | saṃkīrtanaparairbhaktaiḥ kṛtavaiṣṇavasanmakham |||54|| devakanyārājakanyābrahmapriyābhiśobhitam | vaikuṇṭhātiprabhāśālikuṃkumānagarīyutam |||55|| tejaḥ paridhisaṃvyāpanmūrddhamuktaprajānvitam | rādhāramāsatīlakṣmīkamalāmandirānvitam ||56|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamandiramastake | sahasraikasvarṇaghaṭaiḥ prasāritaprabhānvitam ||57|| devālayaiḥ satāṃ sthānairvimānaiścātisampadam | vimānānāṃ vyomamārgairgatāgataiḥ sughoṣitam || |58|| ārtānāṃ duḥkhanāśena saṃstutaṃ ca nijārthibhiḥ | candraśītamadhumiṣṭakastūrīgandhasajjalam || 59|| pāvanaṃ pāpināṃ cāpi muktidaṃ brahmadaṃ saraḥ | vipro vilokya sahasā divyabhāvamupāgamat || 1.264.60 || vismṛtya sarvatīrthāni parāṃ śāntimupāgamat | uttare ca taṭe gatvā jalapānamupācarat || 61 || sasnau suvidhinā kandaṃ mūlaṃ prabhujya vai tataḥ | daivaṃ paitryaṃ cakārāpi pradakṣiṇāṃ tato’karot ||62 || uttare’tra sthale rājan sthitvā manuṃ jajāpa ca | nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnāyī nityamaharṣipūjakaḥ || 63 || nityaṃ devārhaṇastotrapūjāparo’bhavacchuciḥ | vaikuṇṭhaṃ vāpi golokaṃ prāpya yadvat pramodate ||64|| tathā mudā mūkavipraḥ kṛtakṛtyaṃ viveda ha | atha jñātvā lomaśasyāśramaṃ yayau mudānvitaḥ || 65|| natvā mumoda bahudhā papāta pādayoḥ ṛṣeḥ | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre ṛṣerbhāvasamanvitaḥ || 66 || jihvāgraṃ ca karāgraiśca dhṛtvāpyadarśayat tadā | ceṣṭayā tvārthayaccāpi vāṇī me bhavatu prabho ||67|| ṛṣistathāstviti prāha jihvātyajaddhi hrasvatām | varṇagrahaṇayogyā sā rājan mamāśrame’bhavat ||6 8 || tato jagrāha mantraṃ ca matto nārāyaṇasya saḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī mamāstu saḥ ||6 9|| iti mantraṃ gṛhītvā ca viprastvatra taṭe punaḥ | snātvā jajāpa vidhinā mantradvayaṃ niśāntare ||1.264.7 0 || tāvad brāhme muhūrte vai dvādaśyāṃ kārtike site | prāvirbabhūva bhagavān pratyakṣastasya gocaraḥ | |7 1 || aśvaśirā vedadhartā vedamūtirmahāprabhuḥ | aśvamukho naradehaḥ sarvavidyāvirājitaḥ ||72 || śāradāsahitaḥ kṛṣṇo jagāda kṣmāsuraṃ tataḥ | vada vipra prasanno’smi kiṃ te manasi vartate ||7 3 || vipro dṛṣṭvā tathā śrutvā bhagavantaṃ purātanam | sahasotthāya vidhinā cakāra daṇḍavannamaḥ ||74|| bhāvapuṣpaiḥ prapūjyaiva vavande śubhayā girā | dharmamūrte dharmaputra dharmāraṇye prabodhakṛt ||75 || dhārmikaṃ ca tapantaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā kṛpāparo bhavān | samuddadhāra māṃ magnaṃ saṃsārasāgare prabho | |76 || kṛpāṃ vinā na cānyadvai hetuścātra mayārjitaḥ | yadahaṃ pūrvapāpānāṃ kṣālanaṃ prāptavāniha ||77|| darśanaṃ prāptavānatra divyaṃ divyasthalasya te | divyamūrte kṛpāsindho vāṇī śrīlomaśasya vai ||78|| āśīrvādena me jātā darśanāttava cādhunā | jātismaro bhavāmyatra smarāmi nindanaṃ tava ||79|| prāgbhave śūdravarṇe yat kṛtaṃ daṇḍakasadvane | sarvaṃ pāpaṃ nāśamāptaṃ hato mṛgo mayā tu yaḥ ||1.264.8 0 || sa cāste mama janakaḥ śṛṃgadharaḥ saśṛṃgakaḥ | ṛṇaṃ tasya pradātuṃ tu tadgṛhe mūkaputrakaḥ ||8 1 || jāto’smi gomatītīrthayogād vipratvamāptavān | vipro vidyāvihīnaścet pāpaḥ sa nāmadhārakaḥ ||82 || tasmād vidyāṃ pradehyatra pitṛṛṇavimocinīm | ityuktvā praṇanāmāsau namo oṃ paramātmane | | 83 || atha śrībhagavānāha vipra tvaṃ mama vāñcchayā | kṛpāleśena sarasā śārṅgadhara pravaidikaḥ ||84|| sarvauṣadhīnāṃ vijñātā rasānāṃ tattvavedanaḥ | guṇajñaśca tathā daivabalo bhava hi sarvathā || 85 || ityuktvā bhagavānatra rājam̐stirodadhe drutam | vipre sā śāradā devī saṃhitā cauṣadhiprabhā || 86 || haridvarṇā praviveśa vipraścāyuṣyavedavān | abhavat tatkṣaṇādeva kare vidyāmavāptavān || 87 || vyaracayattataḥ śīghraṃ śārṅgadharākhyasaṃhitām | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāntike ||88 || gatvā nivedayāmāsa gṛhītvāśīrvacāṃsi saḥ | lomaśaṃ ca prapūjyādhyāpayāmāsa ca bhūsurān || 89 || evaṃ śārṅgadharaścātra rājannaśvaśirāhareḥ | darśanaṃ prāptavāṃstīrthaṃ śārṅgadharākhyameva tat || 1.264.90 || āśvaśirasamevāpi śāradātīrthamityapi | vartate cottamaṃ cedaṃ yatra vai tapaādibhiḥ || 91 || labhyate vedavijñānaṃ nindāpāpādināśanam | snāhi dehi ca viprebhyo’nāthebhyo dakṣiṇāḥ śubhāḥ || 92 || sa vipraśca tataḥ kālāntare dharmavanaṃ yayau | pitaraṃ prāpya mumude khyātiṃ cāvāpa śāśvatīm || 93 || yanna tapasā dravyeṇa yatnena nāpi sampadā | tadvai bhavati dhyānenāśīrvādairbhajanena ca || 9 4|| deśabalena cāśrayabalena mahimadṛśā | upāstyā jāyate cāpi durlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ nṛpa || 95 || ityukto nṛpatistatra śārṅgadharaṃ tathā dvijān | prapūjya cāplavanaṃ saṃpracakre saraso jale ||96|| dadau dānāni vidhinā bahuso’pyabhavattadā | tīrthasyaivaṃ pratāpaṃ sa jānan vai rādhike tataḥ ||97|| ratnadānaṃ ca godānaṃ vidyādānaṃ cakāra saḥ | chatradānaṃ vastradānaṃ bhūṣādānaṃ cakāra saḥ ||98|| annadānaṃ svarṇadānaṃ cakāra cāśvapāṭalaḥ | natvā tīrthaṃ surān natvā lomaśena samaṃ tataḥ || 99|| yayau cāgre śubhaṃ tīrthāntaraṃ māhātmyasaṃbhṛtaḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya vidyāvān vai prajāyate || 1.264.100 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne nindakaśūdrasya hariṇaghātino godāvaryāṃ maraṇāddharmāraṇye mūkaviprajanma, tapasā kṣīṇapāpasya kuṃkumavāpyāmoṣadhividyāvijñānaṃ, mūkatānāśaḥ śārṅgadharasaṃhitākartṛtvaṃ, śārṅgadharatīrthamāśvaśirasatīrthamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuṣṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 264 ||
<2.265> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike ca tataścāpi śṛṇu tīrthaṃ kṣayāpaham | aśvapāṭalarājāsau gatvā papraccha lomaśam || 1 || aśvapāṭala uvāca etattīrthasya māhātmyaṃ vada me nāmasaṃyutam | phalaṃ kīdṛk kadā jātaṃ kasyeti brūhi me guro || 2 || śrīlomaśa uvāca rājan purābhavacchūdraḥ pārṣṇiradābhidhaḥ śubhaḥ | ajāsaṃrakṣako bhadrānadītīranivāsakṛt || 3 || ājabālānnaravargānarbhakāneva vai vane | kṣudrabadarikājāle nikṣipatyeva nirdayaḥ || 4 || svārthaparo hi loko’yaṃ vinā svārthe na rakṣati | ajāputryo dvivarṣānte bhavantyeva payaḥpradāḥ || 5 || ajāputrāstu viphalā bahavo’sya nirarthakāḥ | rakṣaṇīyā vṛthā ceti matvā tyajati nirjane || 6 || ajāprasavakāle vai bālāṃ bālaṃ pravīkṣya saḥ | narām̐styajati jālādau kaṇṭakādau hi nirdayaḥ || 7 || bālikāstu sadā cājāpālā rakṣanti cāśayā | evaṃ vai jālake tyaktā arbhakā vanacāribhiḥ || 8 || śṛgālādibhiśca rātrau bhujyante krūraprāṇibhiḥ | arbhakā bahukaṣṭena nidhanaṃ yānti vai tadā || 9 || śapanti cārbhakāstatra kṣepakān duḥkhadām̐stathā | yathā vayaṃ vane kṣiptā vyāpāditāśca bhakṣitāḥ || 2.265.1 0|| vanibhiḥ prāṇibhistadvat tvadbālāḥ syuśca bhakṣitāḥ | evaṃ śapanti paśavaḥ putratulyā hi pālinaḥ || 11 || evaṃ duḥkhapradātṝṇāṃ bālā naśyanti vai muhuḥ | nirvaṃśāste tu jāyante yairhatāḥ putrarūpiṇaḥ || 12|| putrā vai bahudhā proktāḥ patnyāṃ caurasa eva saḥ | apatnyāṃ sa tu dāyādaḥ parasmādaṃkake kṛtaḥ || 13 || kuṭumbaputrakaścāpi tathā bhṛtyo’pi putrakaḥ | śiṣyaśca putra evāpi śaraṇāgataputrakaḥ || 14|| pālitaścāpi putraścādhyāpitaḥ putra ityapi | ta ete mānavāḥ putrāḥ putryaḥ proktāśca bhūmipa || 15|| tāteti ca vadan nityaṃ putro bhavati sadṛśaḥ | atha gopaśavaścoṣṭrā aśvā mṛgā ajāvayaḥ || 16|| mahiṣyo vṛṣabhāḥ śvāno gajā gardabhagovṛṣāḥ | pālitāḥ paśavaḥ sarve putrāḥ putryo bhavanti te || 17 || svāminā putravatpālyāḥ siṃhādyā vānarā api | śukā menāḥ śaśādyāśca kapotāścakrakādayaḥ || 18|| haṃsāśca garuḍāścāpi dāsā dāsyaśca putrakāḥ | rājñāṃ prajāḥ sadā putryo guroḥ śiṣyā hi putrakāḥ || 19|| vṛddhānāṃ bālavargāśca putratulyā hi putrakāḥ | phalivṛkṣāḥ puṣpadrumā vardhitā bījato hi ye ||2.265.20|| sarve putrāḥ putrasamā na ghātyāḥ svāminā hi te | hanane tu yathā hatyā tathaiva nirjane vane ||21 || prakṣipte maraṇārthaṃ vai kṣudhātṛṣāprapīḍite | dviguṇā bālahatyā sā jāyate kṣepiṇo hi sā ||22|| tatpāpaṃ raurave duḥkhaṃ nirvaṃśatvamihāpi ca | āpadyate hi tatkarturbālahatyāphalaṃ nṛpa ||23|| pārṣṇirado hyajāpālo bahuhatyābhidūṣitaḥ | mṛtaputro’bhavaccāpi mṛtabhāryastato’bhavat ||24||| mṛtavaṃśo’bhavaccāpi sarvanāśārditastviha | gṛhaṃ tasyābhavat sasyapulākaiḥ chāditaṃ tu yat| ||25||| sarvaṃ tad vahninā dagdhaṃ sopaskaraṃ hi bhasmasāt | nāvaśiṣyata evāsya vinā vai kambaladvayam |||26 || ajāśālā pradagdhā ca ajā dudruvurāturāḥ | rātrau caureṇa nītāstā ajāhīno babhūva ca ||27|| ityevaṃ sarvapāpānāṃ bālahatyā mahattamā | tatphalaṃ tvāptavān pārṣṇirado jīvanavarjitaḥ ||28|| samabhūd duṣṭabhāgyācca kṣayarogī praduḥkhitaḥ | tyaktvā bhadrānadīṃ tyaktvā vaṃśavaṭaṃ puraṃ nijam ||29|| śrutvā janebhyastīrthaṃ ca kuṃkumavāpikāsthitam | āśvapaṭṭasaraḥ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 2.265.3 0|| uttare’tra taṭe rājannāgatya vīkṣya nirmalam | jalaṃ papau tatastatra sasnau nārāyaṇaṃ smaran ||3 1 || kambaladvayayukto’sau taṭe’tra vāsamācarat | harekṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa japatyapi ||32||| bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa japatyapi | pradakṣiṇaṃ cakārāpi sarasaḥ paritastathā ||33|| lomaśasyāśrame divyāṃ kathāṃ śuśrāva mokṣadām | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā nārāyaṇāśrayām ||34|| mahāpāpātipāpāni naśyanti bhajanāddhareḥ | sādhūnāṃ sevayā sarvapāpāni prajvalanti hi ||35|| rogā naśyanti bhajanāt saubhāgyaṃ cābhivardhate | hareḥ saṃkīrtanāt kaṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ vilīyate drutam || 6|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇepyaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | kīrtitaṃ yena bhāvena kaṣṭaṃ tasya vilīyate ||37|| harervaśe bhavantyeva kālakarmasvabhāvakāḥ | mṛtyubhāgyādikaṃ cāpi līyante harikīrtanāt ||38|| harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa satataṃ yena kīrtitam | bhuktirmuktirbhavettasya svargaṃ vā kāmanānvitam ||39|| sādhūnāṃ sevayā cāpi bhāgyodayo bhavediha | satāmāśīrvacobhiśca dāridryaṃ pravilīyate ||2.265.40 || api janmasahasrasya pāpaṃ parvatasannibham | satsaṃgāllīyate tūrṇaṃ sevayā ca satāṃ tathā ||41 || ityevaṃ cāśṛṇod vārtā kathāṃ vai saṃhitāgatām | harṣaṃ cāvāpa bahudhā bhajanaṃ pracakāra ha ||42|| harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa harehare | vāsudeva parabrahma paramātman śriyaḥpate || 43 || evaṃ cakāra bhajanaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ sarvadehinām | lajjāṃ vihāya satataṃ tālīvādanapūrvakam || 44|| kvacittu nartanaṃ cāpi karotyeva sutānavān | kvacittiṣṭhan samāsīnaḥ suptaścākīrtayat prabhum ||45|| lokayanti janāstvenaṃ nāyaṃ paśyati kaṃcana | kīrtane dattacittaśca dattajihvaḥ sadābhavat ||46|| sādhūn sādhusamācārān vīkṣya yatīn sato janān | kāṣāyāmbaradhartṝṃśca natvā karoti daṇḍavat| | |47 | | mūrdhni dehe mukhe cāpi sādhupādarajaḥ śubham | nikṣipatyeva ca stauti dāsaṃ māṃ pāvanaṃ kuru | | 48 | | sādhūnāṃ parṇaśālāsu ṛṣīṇāmāśrameṣu ca | raṭannārāyaṇaṃ gatvā mārjanādi karoti ca | | 49 || pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cāpi karoti bhāvataḥ sadā | sādhūnāṃ bhakṣitaṃ cānnaṃ śiṣṭaṃ cādāya vai tataḥ | |2.265.5 0 | | matvā prasādamevānnaṃ sarojale’vadhūya ca | pāpahartṛ samaśnāti manyate kṛtakṛtyakam || 51 | | rājannevaṃ taṭe cātra pārṣṇirado’tibhaktimān | vyājāyata dine yāte bhaktirasya vyavardhata || 52 | | nārado brahmaṇaḥ putrastvekadā bhagavān svayam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadarśanahetave || 53 || samājagāma sajaṭaḥ sādhuvīṇāṃ ninādayan | harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa harehare || 54|| vāsudeva parabrahma paramātman śriyaḥpate | kīrtayan sa nijavīṇāsvarairmelaṃ vidhāpayan || 55 || vyomnaścāvātatāraitattaṭe taddaivanoditaḥ | pārṣṇirado drutaṃ dṛṣṭvā nāradāntikamāyayau | | 56 || matvā prabhuṃ vā devaṃ vā neme tūrṇaṃ hri daṇḍavat | dhūlīṃ tasya nije dehe dhṛtvā nikṣipya cānane | | 57 | | harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa harehare | vāsudeva parabrahma paramātman śriyaḥpate || 58 || ityevaṃ vyājahārāpi saṃnṛtyan tālikāyutaḥ | nāradastaṃ vilokyaiva prasanno’bhūt hṛdā tadā || 59 | | svasti te’stu tathārogyaṃ bhaktiste’stu pareśvare | bhaktaivaṃ bhaja govindaṃ sadā nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | | 2.265.60 | | ityevaṃ pradadau tatrāśīrvādān vai nisargajān | tāvattasya tu pāpāni nirgatāni śarīrataḥ | | 61 || yāni tīrthāvaśiṣṭāni jajvalurbhasmasāttadā | kākarūpāṇi sarvāṇi jajvalurbhasmasāttadā | | 62| | tato hatyā narīrūpā vikṛtāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇikāḥ | niryayuḥ śataśastasya śarīrānnagnikāḥ striyaḥ | | 63 || jajvalustāśca tūrṇa vai bhasmasāttatra cābhavat | tato’sya dehatastatra niryayuḥ kṣīṇadehinaḥ | | 64|| vṛddhāḥ sthūlaśirasaśca kṣīṇodarāḥ kṛśorasaḥ | makṣikāmaśakāvyāptāḥ puruṣāḥ pāparūpiṇaḥ | | 65 || kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ kṣudhitāśca nirdayāḥ pāpamūrtayaḥ | prajajvaluśca sahasā tadotthitena vahninā ||66|| bhasmasādabhavam̐ste’pi tataścāsya śarīrataḥ | kaphatantupravāhāśca raktajantumayāḥ khalu ||67|| viniryayurdrutaṃ tatra rogagṛhātmakā hi te | jajvaluste dhūmrabhūtāścāmbare vigatāstadā ||68|| pārṣṇirado’bhavacchuddho devatulyaśarīravān | nāradena kṛto divyo divyatīrthaprabhāvataḥ ||69|| sasnau śīghraṃ jale tatra papau vāri śubhaṃ tadā | nāradasya caraṇau vai prakṣālyācamanaṃ papau ||2.265.70 || svarṇāmbarayuto jātaḥ svarṇakuṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ | candrakāntyānanaḥ sūryaprabhaḥ surālayocitaḥ ||7 1 || nanarta divyadeho’pi dhūlīṃ kṛtvā ca varṣmaṇi | muhurnāradapādasthāṃ mahimānaṃ vibhāvya saḥ ||72|| harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa harehare | vāsudeva parabrahma paramātman śriyaḥpate ||73 || kīrtayatyeva satataṃ nānyad vadati vai tadā | devabhūto’bhavaccāpi visasmāra na kīrtanam || 74 || nārado’pi mahāścaryaṃ prāpto dṛṣṭvā tathāvidham | bhaktaṃ bhaktottamaṃ tatra kṣaṇaṃ tasthau hi sannidhau ||75|| aho bhakto’yamevāsti vaikuṇṭhayogya eva ha | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśanottaram ||76|| enaṃ neṣye hi vaikuṇṭhaṃ kīrtane sahayoginam | vicāryetthaṃ ca taṃ nītvā yayau kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||77|| pupūja parayā prītyā kusumādyaiḥ pareśvaram | ārārtrikaṃ tathā kṛtvā kṛtvā nṛtyaṃ ca gāyanam ||78 || nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ kṛtvā labdhvā svāgatamānanam | pārṣṇiradaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ netumājñāmavāpya ca || 79 | | nāradastena yuktaśca śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakam | pitaraṃ mātaraṃ devīṃ kaṃbharāṃ sampraṇamya ca ||2.265.8 0 || īśānaṃ lomaśaṃ cāpi natvā brahmapriyāstathā | smārayitvā vivāhasya kṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇasya mārgake ||8 1 || śukle caturthadivase vihasya ca prasādya ca | yayau pārṣṇiradasthānaṃ pārṣṇiradaṃ jagāda ha ||82|| atra tīrthaṃ tava nāmnā pārṣṇiradaṃ bhaviṣyati | nāradākhyaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ nṛtyatīrthaṃ bhaviṣyati ||8 3 | | bhakta māsaṃ vasātraiva kuru matparṇakālayam | mṛttikānāradaṃ sthāpya dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇavivāhanam ||84|| tato yāsyasi vaikuṇṭhaṃ divyadehaścaturbhujaḥ | ityuktvā taṃ taṭe tyaktvā tataḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||85|| punargatvā hariṃ prāha vaktukāmo’smi sevakaḥ | kāśyāṃ śrīduḥkhahālakṣmīḥ śivarājasya putrikā ||86|| samīkṣate vivāhaṃ ca tathā brahmapriyāḥ prabho | mārgaśīrṣasya dhavale caturthyāṃ śreyasāṃ nidhau ||87|| samaye bhagavām̐statra vivāhavidhimācara | smārayāmi bhagavantaṃ sarvajñamapi bhaktitaḥ ||88|| brahmapriyāṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ mānasairviniveditaḥ | ityuktvā prayayau cāpi nāradaśca yadā tadā ||89|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha hi nāradam | yāhi tvaṃ kāśikāṃ tatra śiveśvaragṛhaṃ prati ||2.265.90|| gatvā sarvaṃ yathāyogyaṃ jñātvā māṃ vinivedaya | tathāstvitinideśaṃ ca prāpya nāradako muniḥ ||9 1|| yayau tīrthanimittena jñātuṃ vṛttāntakaṃ nṛpa | tadidaṃ nāradaṃ tīrthaṃ pārṣṇiradaṃ ca tīrthakam ||92|| pāpahaṃ kṣayahaṃ tīrthaṃ devatīrthaṃ samucyate | atra snānāt samagrāṇi naśyanti pāpakāni hi ||93|| atra dānāśca jāyante smṛddhayaḥ svargasannibhāḥ | atra vai tapasā cāpi bhajanena ca kīrtanāt ||94|| nartanācca bhaved divyaṃ śarīraṃ devasannibham | āyuṣyaṃ vardhate cāpi bhāgyaṃ prakāśate tathā || 95|| satāṃ sevāsamo lābhaścātra vāsād bhavennṛpa | satāṃ prāptirbhaveccāpi śāntānāṃ mokṣadāyinām ||96|| akāmo labhate muktiṃ sakāmo labhate divam | viṣṇubhaktastu vaikuṇṭhaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||97|| rājannatra jalaṃ pītvā snātvā natvā ca nāradam | dehi dānāni dhenūnāṃ rājasūyaphalāni vai ||98|| ityuktau rādhike rājā dhenudānāni vai dadau | datvā tathānyadānāni snānādividhimācarat ||99|| tatastīrthaṃ paścimaṃ ca tato jagāma sānvayaḥ | lomaśena tu sahito rājāśvapāṭalaḥ śuciḥ || 2.265.10 0|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya pāpanāśo bhavettathā | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi yatheṣṭāṃ ca gatiṃ labhet || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne
