kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt || 6 || śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava | ityenaṃ rakṣaṇamantraṃ jagṛhuśca tataḥ param || 7 || brahmāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto’smi śāśvataḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me || 8 || brahmabhāvābhidhaṃ mantramenaṃ jagṛhurantataḥ | bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ || 9 || pitā bandhuḥ suhṛn mitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako’stu saḥ | ityenaṃ cātmanivedaṃ mantraṃ ca jagṛhustataḥ || 2.273.1 0|| atha te munayo rādhe natvā śrīlomaśaṃ munim | papracchuḥ pālyadharmāṃśca lomaśaḥ prāha vai tataḥ ||1 1 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | sarvān sādhusamarhāṃśca dharmān svayaṃ pravakṣyati || 12| atha rājñī rājapatnī sādhvīdīkṣāṃ tataḥ param | jagrāha tatra sarastaṭe vai rādhike śubhām || 12 || bahvayastataḥ prajagṛhuḥ sādhvīdīkṣāṃ hi yoṣitaḥ | dīkṣātīrthaṃ sādhutīrthaṃ sādhvītīrthaṃ hyabhūddhi tat || 14|| tataḥ sādhupañcaśataṃ sādhvīpañcaśataṃ tathā | lomaśena samaṃ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇālayaṃ śubham || 15 || gatvā sarve ca sarvāśca sādhudharmān harermukhāt | prapūjya ca niṣadyaiva śuśruvuḥ praśnitasya vai || 16 || sthūladehe sūkṣmadehaḥ sūkṣmadehe tu vāsanā | vāsanāyāṃ jīvanaṃ ca jīvane sākṣibhāvanā || 17|| sākṣibhāve ca nairguṇyaṃ nairguṇye lepavarjanam | alepe brahmaniṣṭhā ca brahmabhāve pramuktatā || 18|| pramuktau paramānandaḥ parabrahmakṛto bhavet | evaṃ daśavidhā vedīṃ cāruhyānandamaśnute || 1 9|| daśāṃgaṃ ca samādhānaṃ kartavyaṃ sādhubhiḥ sadā | dehasya vaśatā kāryā tapasā nigraheṇa ca || 2.273.20 || titikṣayā ca kṣamayā śīlena sevayāniśam | sūkṣmendriyāṇāṃ vaśatā kartavyā dhairyabhāvanaiḥ ||2 1 || apravṛttyā viṣayāṇāmadānena dhiyā tathā | vivekena vicāreṇa śāntavṛttyā nirantaram ||22|| vāsanāyāstato nāśaḥ kartavyo’nicchayā sadā | asmṛtyā caramasmṛtyā dairghyeṇa ca cireṇa ca ||23 || jīvanaṃ prāṇasañcāraḥ karmaphalāvinodbhavaḥ | phalārpaṇena vai kṛṣṇe prāṇasaṃyamanena ca || 24|| yātrāmātragrahaṇena kubhakādyaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ | prāṇasaṃyamanaṃ kuryāt prāṇadoṣān parityajet || 25 || sākṣibhāvaṃ sukhe duḥkhe svābhimānaṃ nijasya yat | tyajennirmamatāyukto nirahaṃkāra ityapi ||26 || svārthabhāve hi sākṣitvaṃ pārārthye sākṣitā kutaḥ | evaṃ jayet sākṣibhāvaṃ mamāhaṃtyajanād yatiḥ ||27|| tato’sya guṇasaṃsparśāḥ sukhaduḥkhavimohinaḥ | prakāśapravṛttiniyamāḥ śītoṣṇamadhyamāstathā ||28|| na jāyante yato’syaiva nairguṇyaṃ samapadyata | guṇānāmarpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇe nairguṇyaṃ cāntare’pi ca ||29|| manasā mananaṃ yattat kṛṣṇe’rpitaṃ na lepakṛt | cittena cintanaṃ kṛṣṇe’rpitaṃ naiva hi lepakṛt ||2.273.3 0|| buddhyā ca bodhanaṃ kṛṣṇe’rpitaṃ nāpi ca lepakṛt | ahantayābhimananaṃ kṛṣṇe’rpitaṃ na lepakṛt ||3 1 || tanmātrālocanaṃ tena sutarāṃ lepakṛnna vai | bhāvanā vāsanā vāpi saṃskāraśca harau dhṛtaḥ ||32|| sutarāṃ divyatāṃ prāpto lepakṛnnaiva nirguṇaḥ | evaṃ sarvārpaṇe sarvaṃ nirguṇaṃ hariyogataḥ ||3 3|| kartavyaṃ sādhubhiścāpi sādhvībhiḥ sarvathā tviha | māyāguṇairalope ca jāte phalādyayogini ||34|| brahmatā brahmaniṣṭhā vai brahmavad vartanaṃ sthitiḥ | jāyate sarvathā sādhoḥ sarvadākṣarasāmyatā ||35|| yathākṣare sṛṣṭayo vai jāyante’ntaḥprayanti ca | brahmaṇi sṛṣṭisparśo na māyāsparśo’pi naiva ca ||36|| tato’sya bandhanaṃ naiva māyāsparśo hi bandhanam | amāyikasya sādhośca dvandvābhāvo nirantaram ||37|| sākṣātkāro’parokṣaśca cidātmanyeva jāyate | aparokṣānubhūtyā ca mithyā sarvaṃ vilīyate ||38|| tena doṣavināśaśca pravṛtteśca vināśanam | phalasambandhanāśaśca sarvaduḥkhādināśanam ||39|| ātmamātraprasattākaḥ sādhuryadā bhavettviha | so’yaṃ tadā vimukto vai jīvannapi nirucyate ||2.273.40 || etādṛśaprayuktasya brahmānandaḥ prajāyate | nijātmānaṃ brahmarūpaṃ prāptasyeha sataḥ sadā ||41 || pare brahmaṇi cittervai tādātmyaṃ saṃprasajyate | tādātmyamiva tādātmyaṃ jāyate pārameśvaram ||42|| yathā jihvā madhorbhinnā madhoḥ rasaṃ pravindate | yathā cakṣurgolakasthaṃ vasturūpaṃ pravindate ||42|| yathā mano’ntarasthaṃ ca viprakṛṣṭaṃ pravindate | yathā buddhiścātmagatā parātmajñā prajāyate ||44|| svavettrī jāyate cāpi svātmādhikapragocarā | tathātmā svaprakāśo’sti svavettā svaṃ prakāśate ||45|| svaprakāśayuto’svaṃ svānvitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prakāśate | kṛṣṇaḥ prakāśayatyenaṃ parasparaṃ prakāśate ||46|| dvayoḥ prakāśayoraikye tādātmyamiva jāyate | guṇasājātmyatādātmyād guṇinostādṛśātmatā ||47|| evaṃ bhūtāveśanītyā parabrahmatadātmatā | jāyate vai tayā sādhvordvayoścātmaparātmanoḥ ||48|| parabrahmātmabhāvena brahmānandaṃ samaśnute | ayaṃ daśāṃgayogo vai sādhudharmaḥ sadottamaḥ ||49|| kathitaḥ susatāṃ sevyaḥ parabrahmanivāsinām | svabhānaṃ parabhānaṃ ca yadi syādaparā sthitiḥ ||2.273.50|| svabhāvarjyaṃ parabhānaṃ sā bodhyā paramā sthitiḥ | etādṛśo bhavet sādhustvasamprajñātanāmakaḥ ||51 || nārāyaṇasvarūpaḥ sa vedaśāstraiḥ pragīyate | sanatkumāraḥ śaṃbhuśca śeṣanārāyaṇastathā ||||52|| lomaśo’yaṃ maharṣiśca tvete nārāyaṇā matāḥ | brahmapriyāstathā sarvā rādhālakṣmīramādikāḥ ||53 || garuḍādyāśca me vāhāḥ sarve nārāyaṇā ime | kuṃkumavāpīnagarī sarvā nārāyaṇī mama ||54|| pramuktā vartate tvatra sādhavaḥ sādhvikāḥ samāḥ | parabrahmātmakā līlāvibhūtayo vasanti me ||55|| kecanātra bhavantyeva madguṇā vai sahasraśaḥ | kecanātra bhavantyevaiśvaryāṇi mama siddhayaḥ || 56|| kecanātra bhavantyeva divyāni bhūṣaṇāni me | kecanātra bhavantyeva śaktayo mama mūrtijāḥ ||57|| kecanātra bhavantyeva tejāṃsi mama bhāḥ prabhāḥ | kecanātra bhavantyeva bhogyajātāni yāni me ||58|| sarvā kuṃkumavāpīyaṃ mamopakaraṇātmikā | manmūrtirvidyate sarvā nirlepā nirguṇā parā ||59|| parabrahmasvarūpā vai brahmadhāmanivāsinī | bhūriyaṃ brahmadhāmāsti sādhavo māmakī tanuḥ ||2.273.60|| itītyevaṃ nijarūpaṃ parabrahmātmakaṃ sadā | cintayata dhyāyatāpi prāpnutānandamuttamam ||6 1 || evaṃ dharmā mayā vo’tra sādhūnāṃ gaditāstviha | divyāḥ sūkṣmā jñānagamyāḥ sādhavo hi tathā matāḥ ||62|| sādhava ūcuḥ bhagavan sūkṣmadharmā vai bhavattato’vagatāstviha | sthūladharmāḥ kīdṛśā vai kathaṃ rakṣyā vada prabho ||63|| parabrahmovāca deho naro ca vā nārī sādhubhāve yadā sthitaḥ | tadā dehasya doṣā vai tyājyā grāhyā guṇāstviha ||64|| ālasyaṃ ca pramādaṃ ca styānaṃ tyaktvā prage sadā | vinidrastvarito bhūtvā brāhme snānaṃ samācaret ||65|| jalena bhasmanā vā ca vāyunā mārjanena vā | dehaśuddhiṃ prakuryādvai tailādyabhyaṃjanena ca ||66 || āntare bhagavad dhyānaṃ śaucaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sadācaret | tato vai pūjanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai hareḥ ||67|| viṣṇoḥ śaṃbhorgaṇeśasya lakṣmyāḥ sūryasya vai tathā | sādhūnāṃ pūjanaṃ cārārtrikaṃ naivedyakārpaṇam ||68|| stavanaṃ nāmaraṭaṇaṃ mālāvartanamācaret | hareḥ kathaṃ prakuryācca bhikṣāṃ vai pākamācaret ||69|| bhūta yajñaṃ devayajñaṃ pitṛyajñaṃ samācaret | brahmayajñaṃ naijayajñaṃ kṛtvā bhojanamācaret ||2.273.70 || sāyaṃ cārādhanaṃ kuryānnavadhā śrīhareḥ śubham | yathocitaṃ śraddhayaiva sarvakalyāṇamācaret ||71 || santoṣeṇa ca saumyenāparigraheṇa nirvahet | nātyāhāraṃ nātitapaḥ prakuryāt sādhudharmavān ||72|| anācāraṃ nācareccākartavyaṃ nācarettathā | kleśaṃ hiṃsāṃ mṛṣā nindāṃ paravādaṃ vivarjayet |||73|| paropakāraṃ kuryācca dehena manasā girā | kriyayā parasaukhyārthaṃ hitaṃ saukhyaṃ samācaret ||74|| āpmamārgaṃ mokṣamārgaṃ viśeṣeṇa prasādhayet | pareṣāṃ pāpanāśārthaṃ śaraṇyaḥ saṃbhavet sadā ||75|| mama mantrān pradadyācca dīkṣāṃ dadyācca māmakīm | svādhyāyaṃ mokṣadaṃ jñānaṃ prakuryācchṛṇuyāttathā ||76|| tīrthāni vicareccāpi gṛhṇīyācchuddhabhojanam | śuddhaṃ jalaṃ prapeyācca gālitaṃ paya ādi ca ||77|| rāgaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ madaṃ lobhaṃ naiva kuryāt kadācana | tiraskāraṃ na kasyāpi kuryād vai brahmabhāvanaḥ ||78|| pratāraṇaṃ na vai kuryād dveṣaṃ kvacinna cācaret | dānaṃ dadyād yathāśakti mokṣasyāpyabhayasya ca ||79|| āśritasya snehabhaktiṃ svīkuryānmokṣayoginīm | sādhavaḥ pāvanāḥ santi satsaṃgaścāpi pāvanaḥ ||2.273.80 || sadā samāgame naije cānīya dehadhāriṇaḥ | pāvayet parayā prītyā preṣayenmama dhāma ca ||8 1 || indriyāṇyantaḥkaraṇādīni pratyāharet hṛdi | dhyānaṃ kuryānmama nityaṃ brahmānandaṃ samarjayet ||82|| mama mūrtau pralīnatvaṃ kuryāt kartavyamuttamam | upāsanāṃ prakuryācca nityaṃ me mananātmikām ||83||| evaṃ bhavadbhiḥ sthātavyaṃ kartavyaṃ sādhubhirmama | sādhvībhiśca tathaivātra kartavyaṃ sevanaṃ satām ||84|| nārīṇāṃ sarvadā mokṣadānaṃ jñānaṃ samarpaṇam | śikṣaṇaṃ ca sādhusādhvīdīkṣaṇaṃ muktaye bhavet ||85|| vyasanāni na kāryāṇi mokṣarodhīni yāni ca | patirnārāyaṇaścāhaṃ sādhvīnāṃ ca satāṃ sadā ||86|| pātivratyena dharmeṇa sevanīyo’hamiṣṭadaḥ | ātmanivedanaṃ mahyaṃ kartavyaṃ śāśvataṃ sukham ||87|| bhoktavyaṃ tu mayā sārdhaṃ mama divyasamāgamāt | ahaṃ kvacinna vai tyājyaḥ sarvakriyāsu sarvadā ||88|| ityeṣā jīvanī muktiḥ paramuktividhāyinī | divyadharmamayī proktā mayā santaḥ śubhāśrayā ||89|| dehadharmāḥ sādhubhirvai pālanīyā yathocitam | nādhikyenānuṣaktavyā me sevāvighnarūpiṇaḥ || 2.273.90|| svasti vo’stu sādhavo me sādhvyaśca svasti vo’stvapi | ityuktvā rādhike’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||9 1 || virarāma tataḥ santo’rhaṇāṃ nīrājanaṃ vyadhuḥ | rakṣaṇīyā mokṣaṇīyā bhavataḥ smeti sañjaguḥ |||92|| yayuścāśīrgṛhītvaiva sarastīre nijālayān | tāvat kāśīgato yaśca nārado harimāyayau |||93||| maṃgalapatrikāyuktaguruṇā saha cotsukaḥ | cakāra daṇḍavat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tataḥ param || 94|| pitaraṃ mātaraṃ natvā maṃgalaṃ prajagād saḥ | bṛhaspatirdevaguruḥ praṇamya prāpya mānanam || 95|| svāgataṃ madhuparkādi kuśalaṃ vinivedya ca | śiveśvarasya tatputryā lakṣmyāḥ saukhyaṃ namaskṛtim ||96 || patraṃ kuṃkumasūtreṇa veṣṭitaṃ ca saratnakam | patraṃ ca rādhike datvā vṛttaṃ nyavedayacchubham ||97|| kuśalaṃ sarvadā lakṣmyā yugalatvamuhūrtakam | mārgaśīrṣasya śuklāyāṃ caturthyāṃ ca nyavedayat ||98|| vardhayitvā ca tatpatraṃ prapūjya ca bṛhaspatim | gopālakṛṣṇakastatra nāradaṃ cāpyapūjayat ||99|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne’nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena sādhusādhvībhyo mantradīkṣājñānopadeśādi dattam, kāśītaḥ śiveśvarapreṣitamaṃgalapatrikāsahitasya bṛhaspaternāradena saha kuṃkumavāpyāmāgamanaṃ tatpatrapradānaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trisaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 273 ||
<2.274> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike śrībālakṛṣṇo mumude vīkṣya patrikām | bṛhaspatiṃ praṇeme ca ratnahāraṃ dadau gale || 1 || bṛhaspatirharestasya janmadinaṃ vyalokayat | cāndre māsi kārtike ca dale kṛṣṇe’ṣṭamīdine || 2 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇajanma satīśrīkambharodarāt | jātaṃ tasya caturdaśasamā māso dināni ṣaṭ || 3 || vyatītaḥ samayaścādya vartate tu caturdaśī | mārgaśīrṣasya kṛṣṇasyodvāhasvīkṛtiyugdinam || 4 || protsavo bhavitā kāśyāmitaśca pañcame dine | mārgaśuklacaturthyāṃ vai sarvaśreṣṭhamuhūrtake || 5 || yogapatrī tathā cāvedayatyeva sumaṃgalam | śiveśvareṇa devena preṣito’haṃ sapatrakaḥ || 6 || sarvaṃ śubhaṃ subhagaṃ syād gopālakṛṣṇa cottamam | gopālakṛṣṇo devarṣiṃ vilokya lomaśaṃ munim || 7 || āhvayāmāsa tūrṇaṃ sa munistatra samāyayau | kṛtādaraḥ kṛtadevagurupūjaḥ śubhāsane || 8 || niṣasāda kuśalaṃ ca pṛṣṭavān sa bṛhaspatim | gopālakṛṣṇadattāṃ ca patrikāṃ sa vyalokayat || 9 || kṛtanāradaśaṃsāṃ tāṃ vācayāmāsa lomaśaḥ | śrāvayāmāsa māṃgalyaṃ vardhayāmāsa so’pi ca || 2.274.10 || bālakṛṣṇastu mumude kaṃbharā mumude bhṛśam | kuṭumbino mumudire śrutvā tāṃ yogapatrikām || 11 || sarvā brahmapriyāścāpi śrutvā harṣaṃ paraṃ yayuḥ | parīgaurīhāritīśaktyamaryādyā mudaṃ yayuḥ || 12|| gopālakṛṣṇo vādyāni vādayāmāsa vai tadā | gurave pradadau pāritoṣikaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ śubhām || 1 3||| bhojayāmāsa vidhinā pāyasānnaṃ sumiṣṭakam | pūjayāmāsa śanakaiścandanādyaistataḥ param || 14|| gopālakṛṣṇo bhagavān papraccha nāradarṣaye | kanyāguṇān lakṣaṇāni kanyāyā nārado’vadat || 15|| brahmāṃśaḥ śaṃkaro devaḥ śiveśvaro virājate | mahābhāgavataścāpi mahālakṣmīrhi pārvatī || 16|| ubhau nārāyaṇāṃśau hi gariṣṭhau ca variṣṭhakau | pūjitau sarvalokaiśca garīyāṃsau pareśvarau || 17|| tayoḥ putrī svayaṃ lakṣmīrduḥkhadāridryanāśinī | kanyakānāṃ yoṣitāṃ ca varā cātīva sundarī || 18|| kāṃ praśaṃsāmahaṃ kurve śaṃbhuputryā viśeṣataḥ | ramaṇīyātiramyā sā ramā rāmāsu pūjitā || 19|| udbhinneṣadyauvanā ca nidhirvai sarvasampadām | lakṣmīcihnasahasraiśca śobhitā parameśvarī ||2.274.20 || pītacampakavarṇābhā ratnābharaṇabhūṣitā | vidyullateva cāñcalyahāsavilāsamaṇḍitā ||21 || taptakāñcanabhāyuktā tejasojjvalitā satī | divyāṃgā divyatattvā ca śuddhasattvānvitā sadā ||22|| satyadayākṛpāśīlā tāpasī ca harivratā | śāntā dāntā ca subhagānantaudāryanidhānikā ||23|| mastake svastikasvarṇagūḍhalekhāvirājitā | vakradīrghasvarṇavarṇaprāntakṛṣṇamanoharaiḥ ||24|| satejaskaiśca caṃcadbhiḥ śiraḥkeśairvirājitā | svarṇarekhasamaṃ ramyaṃ tilakaṃ tu viśālake ||25|| bhāle naisargacandraṃ ca dadhānā rājate hi sā | rādhā vā kamalā vā sā māṇikī vārkajā ca kim ||26|| pārvatī sāramā vāpi sarasvatī ca śāradā | vairājī vāsudevī vā nārāyaṇī sadāśivā ||27|| padmā vā virajā vāpi sāvitrī vā ca vaiṣṇavī | indrāṇī ca varuṇānī candrāṇī rohiṇī ca vā ||28|| kuberāṇī sūryapatnī svāhā vāhalyikā ca vā | dyauḥ svayaṃ kiṃ ca vā brāhmī śaktirvā śīlikā svayam |||29|| yadvānyāsu ramaṇīṣu śreṣṭhāḥ santi manoharāḥ | tāḥ sarvāḥ śivakanyāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||2.274.3 0|| śaratpūrṇenduśobhāḍhyā śaratkamalalocanā | tava putrasamā mūrtiḥ kimayaṃ tattanuṃ gataḥ ||3 1 || vivāhayogyā yuvatī vartate sātiśobhanā | divyadehā nārikāpi bhautikāṃśavivarjitā ||32|| bālakṛṣṇasvarūpā sā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇī hi sā | manye cāyaṃ parabrahma dvedhā bhūto virājate ||33 || kimatra varṇanīyaṃ vai yā hi sākṣāddharirhi sā | gopālakṛṣṇa putraste bhāgyavān bhagavān svayam ||34|| puruṣottamasaṃjñāya sarvasṛṣṭiṣu gīyate | seyaṃ tadaṃśā sarvāṃgī śrīlakṣmīḥ puruṣottamī ||35|| bālakṛṣṇakṛte jātā loke’tra muktidā nṛṇām | jaganmātā sarvamātā kimu tāṃ varṇaye nviha ||36|| śṛṇu cihnāni sarvāṇi yaiḥ sā jñāyeta cedṛśī | kīdṛśī vā svayaṃ kā vā nirṇetavyaṃ na yatparam ||37|| yāni lokāḥ samākarṇya muktimīyurna saṃśayaḥ | divyadṛṣṭyā gurubhāvānmayā dṛṣṭāni varṇaye ||38|| śivakanyāhṛdaye’sti bālakṛṣṇākṛtiḥ śubhā | pādayoḥ puṇḍrarekhordhvarekhe staḥ śobhane śubhe ||39|| jaghane bāṇarekhāsyā lalāṭe mukuṭākṛtiḥ | gaṇḍe tu dakṣiṇe bhāle śoṇabinduḥ praśobhate ||2.274.40 || urasi viṣṇurekhā ca vāmabāhau gadā śubhā | vāmasakthni pādukā ca vaijayantī hṛdi sthitā ||41 || kare’syāḥ kamalaṃ cāste gajacihnaṃ tathāparam | dakṣe pāde śaṃkhacihnaṃ naukācihnaṃ vimānakam | gadā matsyaḥ śikharaṃ ca jhaṣastāmbūlavallikā ||42|| vāme pāde yavarekhā prāsādaśchatramityapi | ūrdhvarekhā kamalaṃ ca dhvajoṃ’kuśo ghaṭo’pi ca | kumudaṃ śrīphalaṃ cāpi sthalapadmaṃ ca candramāḥ ||43|| daśacakrāṇi pūrṇāni svarṇarekhāṅgulīṣu ca | lalāṭe pauraṭo hāraḥ svarṇarekhāśca bindukaḥ ||44|| cibuke binduko hastarekhā dakṣastanopari | cakraṃ vāmastane kaṇṭhe hāro vakṣasi kānakaḥ ||45|| dhvajo matsyaśca vaṃśī ca svastiśca dakṣiṇe kare | dhanurmatsyaḥ kalaśaśca dakṣe kare ca santyapi ||46|| prākārastoraṇaṃ cāpi kamalaṃ santi dakṣake | pādaphaṇāyāmaśvaśca lāṃgalaṃ ca karī tathā ||47|| vṛkṣo yūpastathā bāṇastomaraṃ santi pādake | haste ca mālikārekhā dīparekhā ca cāmaram ||48|| śolaśca kuṇḍalaṃ vedī cakraṃ santi śubhāni vai | śobhanāni sucihnāni santyasyāścetarāṇyapi ||49|| nānyā tvetādṛśī dṛṣṭā trailokye kamalāṃ vinā | naitādṛśāni cihnāni sarvāṇi vai śriyaṃ vinā ||2.274.50 || gopālakṛṣṇa putro’yaṃ tava sākṣāt pareśvaraḥ | sarvaṃ jānāti tadvṛttaṃ nityaṃ gatvā ca pūjanam ||51|| tayā kṛtaṃ pragṛhṇāti tatpitṛbhyāṃ kṛtaṃ tathā | tathāpyajña ivāste’tra māyāṃ kurvan hariḥ svayam ||52|| hemaśālāyananāmā jānāti munirāḍidam | hanumām̐śca vijānāti lakṣyāstapo hareḥ kṛte ||53|| bālakṛṣṇo varadānaṃ svayogārthaṃ dadau tadā | sarvametacchubhaṃ cāste lakṣmyarpaṇaṃ narāyaṇe ||94|| gopālarāja paśyemaṃ devaguruṃ bṛhaspatim | māṃgalike mahākārye patraṃ nītvā tava gṛhe ||55|| āgataṃ yatpādapadme pūjayanti sureśvarāḥ | dhanyaṃ puṇyaṃ yaśasyaṃ te gṛhaṃ tenāpi pāvitam ||56|| aho bhāgyamahaṃ manye yo’haṃ godohanasthiraḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇayogotsavadarśanabhāgyavān ||57|| bhaviṣyāmi nivatsyāmi hyaśvapaṭṭataṭe sadā | praseviṣye’saṃkhyapatnīpatiṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||58|| subhaktyā bālakṛṣṇaṃ taṃ śrāvayiṣye ca gītikāḥ | utsaveṣu sadā sārdhaṃ vicariṣyāmi śārṅgiṇā ||59|| idaṃ vai janmasāphalyaṃ hareryogo bhavediha | yena kenāpi bhāvena bhajanīyaḥ pareśvara ||2.274.60 || gopālakṛṣṇa dhanyo’si dhanyo’sti śivaśaṃkaraḥ | dhanyāsti kambharālakṣmīrdhanyā devī ca pārvatī ||61|| dhanyā kuṃkumavāpī ca dhanyā vārāṇasī kṣitiḥ | dhanyo bṛhaspatiścāpi dhanyo devarṣināradaḥ ||62|| yeṣāṃ hṛdi cakṣuṣośca vasati śrīnarāyaṇaḥ | dhanyaścaturthīdivasaḥ sarvapūjyo bhaviṣyati | | 63 || bhaviṣyanto’vatārāśca vidhāsyantyatra cotsavam | tatra dine’rpitā kanyā lakṣmītulyā bhaviṣyati || 64|| ityuktvā nārado maunaṃ jagrāha ca bṛhaspatiḥ | viśrāntiṃ śāntibhavane jagṛhatuśca tau tataḥ || 65 || atha śrīnāradarṣiśca lakṣmyuktaṃ surahasyakam | nivedayituṃ kṛṣṇāya bālakṛṣṇālayaṃ yayau || 66 || bālakṛṣṇo’pi bhagavān lakṣmyuktaṃ vettumāturaḥ | pratīkṣate nārado me kadā hṛdyaṃ vadiṣyati | | 67|| tāvacchrīnāradastatra kṛṣṇasaudhe samāyayau | natvā śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ taṃ vihasya bhagavannamaḥ || 68|| samuccāryānanditaśca niṣasāda hi bhūtale | tāvacchrībālakṛṣṇo’sau samutthāpya ca satvaram || 69 || devarṣiṃ kānake naije paryaṅke taṃ nyaṣādayat | kṛtvā vakṣasi harṣeṇa samasaṅkta mahāmunim ||2.274.7 0 || prapraccha kuśalaṃ lakṣmyā vada nārada hṛdgatam | kiṃ svit sukhaṃ samāste sā kiyanmaddharṣasaṃbhṛtā ||7 1 || kiṃsvidvicāravatyāste madarthaṃ śivakanyakā | kimuktavatī vā kiñcid rahasyaṃ jñāpitaṃ tayā ||72|| vada me nārada śīghraṃ jijñāsitaṃ sukhāvaham | ityukto nārado rādhe vaktukāmaḥ praharṣavān ||73 || uvāca vidhivat sarvaṃ yathoktaṃ śivakanyayā | ākarṇaya harekṛṣṇa sukhamāste tvadarthinī ||74|| yadāhaṃ gatavān kāśyāṃ varaṇāyāstaṭe śubhe | udyānaramyabhūbhāge śiveśvaragṛhāntike ||75 || sauvarṇakalaśairvyāpte śobhane viṣṇumandire | tadā sā mātṛsahitā svasrā ca kṛṣṇayā yutā ||76 || darśanārthaṃ tvāgatā vābhavad viṣṇuṃ praṇamya ca | pradakṣiṇāyāṃ sahasā yāntīṃ cāñcalyaśobhanā ||77|| mayā dṛṣṭā dehacihnairlakṣmīste’rdhaśarīriṇī | ahaṃ vicitrarūpaśca bālako vai tadābhavam | |78 || tatsamo vayasā yena bālakhelanake sthitaḥ | pradakṣiṇapramiṣeṇa tayā saha ca mandiram ||79 || abhramaṃ vegataścāpi bālakṛṣṇo’vadaṃ muhuḥ | graśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi śiveśvarasuteti ca || 2.274.80 | | evaṃ śabdānaśṛṇot sā manmukhācca tadā hi sā | apṛcchanmāṃ namaste’stu kiśora tvamitaḥ kutaḥ ||8 1 || samāgato’si vada me jānāsi bālakṛṣṇakam | aśvapaṭṭasarovāsaṃ tathyamāvedaya drutam ||82|| tadāhaṃ dhṛtavām̐statra rūpaṃ nāradasammatam | sā tu vijñāya māṃ bhūtaṃ jahāsa praṇanāma mām ||83|| tato’haṃ bālarūpaśca punastatrābhavaṃ ca sā | prakāśe catvarabhāge kadambadrumaśobhite ||84|| khelanādipramiṣeṇāhūyākathayadāntaram | kathaṃ kasmād vada me’tra maharṣe yadi tadbhavam ||85|| mayā niveditā sādhvi bālakṛṣṇājñayāpyaham | āgato’smi vivāhasya jijñāsārthaṃ śivaṃ prati ||86|| vada śīghraṃ tava hṛdyaṃ jānīyānna yathā satī | pañcakaṃkarakhelādimiṣeṇa vada mā ciram ||87|| sā kṛṣṇa māṃ vilokyaiva modapramodasaṃbhṛtā | akathayanmama prāṇapatiḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||88|| kadā tvāyāsyati śīghraṃ kadā māṃ svīkariṣyati | ahaṃ kṣaṇaviyogaṃ vai soḍhuṃ śaknomi naiva ha ||89|| śīghraṃ ca satvaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vadāgaccheddhi satvaram | ayaṃ me samayaścāste pradānasya guro vada ||2.274.90 || tena me vacanaṃ dattaṃ caturdaśasamottaraḥ | svayamāgatya bhagavān grahīṣyati karaṃ mama ||9 1 || yadyadya vatsare kṛṣṇo na māṃ cet saṃgrahīṣyati | prāṇām̐styaktvā divyarūpā tatrāyāsyāmi niścitam |||92|| vada me janakāya tvaṃ mātre cāpi nivedaya | mā madvācaṃ tayoragre prakāśaṃ kuru buddhiman |||93 || śīghraṃ yathā sa vā me syāttathā klṛptiṃ vidhāpaya | ityuktvā pulakāṃgī sā premaplutā tadābhavat ||94|| snehāśrubhṛtanetrā ca samādhimiva saṃgatā | punaḥ svalpaṃ prākathayat nivedaya samarpitām ||95|| nādhikaṃ śrīhareragre vada nārada yāhi ca | madgṛhe tvāgatāṃ tatra mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vada ||96 || ityuktvā ca namaskṛtya matpādayorhi līlayā | utthāya khelānāsaktā śīghraṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ gatā ||97|| mandire tatra sā mātrā saha dṛṣṭvā hariṃ punaḥ | yātā nijaṃ gṛhaṃ kṛṣṇa nārado’haṃ tataḥ param ||98|| varaṇāyāṃ ca gaṃgāyāṃ snātvā tatra gato’bhavam | nāradena svarūpeṇa nārāyaṇeti saṃvadan ||99|| jaṭādharaṃ vilokyaiva satī me namanaṃ vyadhāt | mayā tvāśīḥ pradattā ca sā māṃ dṛṣṭvā mudaṃ hyagāt || 2.274.1 00|| apṛcchat kuśalaṃ sarvaṃ dattāsane sthitaṃ ca mām | gṛhṇantaṃ madhuparkādi tatrākasmāt samāgatam || 10 1|| ahaṃ nārāyaṇa viṣṇo bālakṛṣṇa hare prabho | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇetyāśrāvayaṃ tadā || 1 02|| tava nāmāni sarvāṇi pāvanāni śubhāni ca | smārakāṇi tava kṛṣṇa tato’pibaṃ jalaṃ manāk || 1 03|| atha śāntiṃ samāgṛhya vivakṣyāmi yadā tadā | sabhāyācca mamāgre sukhadālakṣmīḥ śravāturā || 1 04|| jyeṣṭhā kṛṣṇā tathā sakhyaścāparā divyadṛṣṭikāḥ | anamanmāṃ satīṃ cāpi nyaṣīdaṃstāḥ samantataḥ || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bṛhaspatipradattamaṃgalapatrikāyā lomaśakṛtasavidhipūjanavācanādikam, gopālakṛṣṇādyāḥ svāgatamadhuparkādyuttaraṃ bhojayāmāsuḥ, nārado gopālakṛṣṇāya kanyaiśvaryaguṇadivyalakṣaṇānyāha, bālakṛṣṇāya kanyoktarahasyārthaṃ cāhetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥsaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 274 ||
<2.275> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike nāradastābhyastato’kathayad yaddhi tat | kathayāmi samastaṃ te śṛṇu tvekāgramānasā || 1 || nārada uvāca āgato’haṃ satyalokādaśvapaṭṭasarovaram | pṛthvyāṃ paścimasaurāṣṭre yatrāste puruṣottamaḥ || 2 || tena sākaṃ pṛthivyāṃ ca vyacaraṃ yajñakarmaṇe | yatrāyātā dhāmamuktāstathānyadhāmapārṣadāḥ || 3 || pārṣadānyastathā satya īśvarāṇyaśca devatāḥ | mānavyo nāgakāntāśca sādhvyaḥ siddhivarāstathā || 4 || avatārāḥ samastāśceśvarāścāpi ca sādhavaḥ | siddhā brahmavratāścāpi pitaraśca tatharṣayaḥ || 5 || ārṣyaḥ sarvāstathā devā devānyaśca samāgatāḥ | mānavāśca divaḥpālā lokapālā maheśvarāḥ || 6 || ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau tatstriyastathā | vahnayaśca marutaśca nidhayaśca grahāstathā || 7 || diśaḥ kāmaśca menevastithayaśca kalāstathā | tattvāni sarvatīrthāni nadyaḥ sarāṃsi sāgarāḥ || 8 || parvatāśca vālakhilyā vāyudehāsurādayaḥ | daityā bhaktā dānavāśca pakṣāśca rākṣasāstathā || 9 || siddhacāraṇagandharvā vidyādhrāḥ kinnarāstathā | uragā kiṃpuruṣāśca vṛkṣāstṛṇāni vallayaḥ || 2.275.1 0|| dharmādyā yāmyabhaktādyāḥ śaivāḥ kailāsavāsinaḥ | vaikuṇṭhaśvetadugdhābdhivāsā badarīvāsinaḥ ||1 1|| meruvāsā āvaraṇavāsāḥ pātālavāsinaḥ | asaṃkhyadevakoṭyaśca prāyayurvai makhe makhe || 12|| sarve praśaṃsanti kṛṣṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram | vandante taṃ cārhayanti stuvanti kaṃbharāsutam || 13|| tatprasādaṃ taccaraṇāmṛtaṃ pibanti te tadā | lokapālā dhāmapālāḥ sṛṣṭipālā narāyaṇāḥ || 14|| nārāyaṇāśca ye te ca tadājñāmudvahanti ca | etat sarvaṃ mayā tatra pratyakṣaṃ tvavalokitam || 15|| śaṃkarastu svayaṃ yasyākṣarakṣetre nivāsakṛt | kṣetrapālatayā cāste hyaśvapaṭṭasaro’bhitaḥ || 16|| śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīrāmadevo naro nārāyaṇastathā | vāsudevādayo vyūhāḥ sanatkumārayogirāṭ || 17|| tathānye ceśvarāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ saṃkarṣaṇādayo’pi ca | mahāviṣṇustathā bhūmā vairājaśca sadāśivaḥ || 18|| yasyājñāṃ saṃvahante ca kālamāyāyameśvarāḥ | yasmād bhavanti bhūtāni puṣyante cābhiyanti ca || 1 9|| antarātmā tu yaḥ proktaḥ sākṣī ca bhagavān svayam | parabrahma ca yaḥ prokto yasmāt sarvamidaṃ tatam ||2.275.20|| vidyuto bhāni sūryaśca candro vahnistathā dhruvaḥ | yattejasā pravidyante tejasvinaḥ prabhākarāḥ ||21|| yatpraveśena bhūtāni bhavanti jñānavantyapi | yenāste jīvalokasya prakāśaṃ vai nijātmani ||22|| sarvaprakāśadātā saḥ kuṃkumavāpikāsthale | virājate hi bhagavānakṣarātīta eva yaḥ ||23|| mānavena svarūpeṇa gopālakṛṣṇabālakaḥ | ityevaṃ te praśaṃsanti vai mahīmānakā makhe || 24|| koṭirūpadharaḥ so’pi bālakṛṣṇo janārdanaḥ | koṭibhaktānekapade milatyeva ca vakṣasi ||25|| mayā dṛṣṭaṃ hi sākṣāttat śrutaṃ sarvaṃ praśaṃsitam | śrutā ca yoṣitāṃ vāṇī sthale sthalyāṃ mahotsave ||26|| dhanyā vayaṃ surūpasya sarveśvasya yoginaḥ | darśanaṃ tvadya kurmo yatpuṇyapāro na vidyate ||27|| aho’sya darśanācchāntiḥ śāśvatī samajāyate | asmākaṃ netrayordairghyaṃ sāphalyaṃ vindate’dya vai ||28|| dūrato’pi mahānando jāyate’sya vilokane | abhinnapūravegāḍhyaṃ yāvatsukhottaraṃ sukham ||29|| anubhūyate cāsmābhiḥ sarvendriyasukhaṃ mahat | yasya dūrāvalokena yadīdṛśaṃ paraṃ sukham ||2.275.30|| tadā sākṣāttasya patnyāḥ pārśvaśayanayoṣitaḥ | śiveśvarasutā lakṣmyā divyāyāḥ kīdṛśaṃ bhavet ||3 1 || ardhāṃgī ceśvarī yā vai nārāyaṇī pareśvarī | sūryacandranibhau yasyāḥ kapolau gaṇḍakau tathā ||32|| suvarṇasadṛśaṃ yasyā vapuścampakapuṣpavat | alaktakanibhe yasyāḥ karapādatale tathā ||33 || pakvabimbasamau yasyā oṣṭhau prītinivāsinau | kadalīstambhasadṛśe sakthinī cāpi śobhane ||34|| padmapatrāyatanetre yasyā rūpaṃ hyanuttamam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇavakṣovāsā yā parameśvarī ||35|| yā ca vāsayati kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ vai nijavakṣasi | sākṣāt sarvāṃgasaṃyuktā kīdṛśī sukhinī bhavet ||36|| aho dhanyā śivaputrī sukhaṃ kṛṣṇāt samaśnute | dhanyā sā pārvatī devī yatsukhāt sukhinī śivā ||37|| ramāyāḥ kamalāyā vā śriyā vā kṛṣṇayoṣitaḥ | vṛndāyā vā tulasyā vā bhārgavyā vā ca tatsukham ||38|| lalāṭe likhitaṃ kārṣṇaṃ yallakṣmyā likhitaṃ sadā | aho nedṛṅparaṃ bhāgyamasmākaṃ yanna ceyate ||39|| na cāsmākaṃ patiḥ so’yaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | vyarthaṃ janma striyā loke kṛṣṇayogasukhaṃ vinā ||2.275.40|| vyarthaṃ sarvaṃ pātivratyaṃ patiḥ kṛṣṇo na ced yadi | aho vai śivakanyāyāḥ sāphalyaṃ gaurave tathā ||41 || sarvarasān sarvagandhān sarvasparśān sukhairbhṛtān | sarvaśabdān sarvadṛśyān sarvānandān bhunakti yā ||42|| sarvānandāśrayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ labdhvā jitendriyam | akhaṇḍavīryaṃ sarveśaṃ bhuṃkte yā śivakanyakā ||43 || kāśīsthāpi sadā kṛṣṇe lagnā cāste’prakāśitā | paśyanti divyanetrāśca satyaḥ sādhvyo divāniśam ||44|| ityevaṃ vai mayā kīrtiḥ śrutā nārīgaṇānmuhuḥ | so’haṃ didṛkṣurevāsaṃ jijñāsuśca punaḥ punaḥ ||45 || pṛṣṭvā pṛṣṭvā śanaiścātra bhavatīgehamāgataḥ | saṃśrutaṃ duḥkhahālakṣmīritināmāpi vai muhuḥ ||46 || kīdṛśī sā kasya kanyā kīdṛgguṇā bhavediti | yadi syādatra sā devī draṣṭavyā sā mayā sati ||47 || kvāste kīdṛk svarūpā sā kimavasthā kimambarā | kiṃnisargā kiṃsupiṇḍā kiṃsaṃsthānā bhavatyapi ||48 || kimākṛtiḥ kiṃsuprabhā kiyadvarṣā hi bhāminī | kimānanā ca kiṃvegā kiṃbhāvā kiṃsulakṣaṇā ||49|| kiṃkalā kiṃsvarā kisaṃvarṇā kiṃpatkarojjvalā | kiṃbhālā kiṃsuṣṭhukeśī kimātmā kiṃsusiddhikā ||2.275.50 kiṃprabhāvā kiṃsukhāḍhyā kiṃbhānā kiṃsubodhinī | kiṃkāryā kibhaktimatī kiṃdivyā ca kimāntarā ||5 1 kiṃvidyā kiṃcihnaśobhā kimucchrayā ca kiṃgatiḥ | kiṃvāsā ca kiṃsakhī ca kiṃbhūṣā kiṃghaṭāchaṭā ||52 || kiṃbalā kiṃsusattvā ca kiṃbhojanā kiṃtāpasī | kiṃsantoṣā ca kiṃśaucā kiṃsvādhyāyā ca kiṃvṛṣā ||53 || kiṃhārdā kiṃpremapātrā kiṃkauśalyā ca kiṃmatiḥ | kimaṃgā kiṃdhanā kiṃcaṃcalā kiṃlekhanā hi sā ||54|| kiṃruciḥ kiṃpravādā ca kiṃvṛttiḥ kiṃpravartanā | kiṃtrikā kiṃsamāraṃbhamadhyaprāntaphalā tathā ||55|| kiṃkriyā kiṃviśeṣā ca kiṃsāmānyā kiṃmadhyamā | kiṃviśvāsā ca kiṃyogā kiṃbodhā kimupāsanā ||56 || kimārādhanikā kiṃśṛṃgārā kiṃsaṃvirāgiṇī | kiṃtuṣṭā kiṃgṛdhnikā ca kimāśā ca kimicchukī |||57|| kiṃtarkā kiṃniścayā ca kiṃvādā kiṃpramāṇikā | kiṃprameyā kiṃprayogā kiṃsiddhāntā kiṃnigrahā ||58 || kiṃvedā kiṃsādhanā ca kiṃpriyā kiṃvitarjinī | kiṃyamā kiṃniyamā ca kiṃdhyānā ca kimāsanā ||59 || kiṃprāṇā kiṃratiścāste kiṃkāmā śivakanyakā | evaṃdraṣṭuṃ ca jijñāsā me jātāti tato’pyaham ||2.275.6 0 || samāgato’yaṃ devarṣirnārado bhagavanmanaḥ | brahmaputraśca rudrasya bhrātā devarṣikīrtimān ||6 1 || viṣṇubhaktaḥ sthairyahīnaḥ sarvathā kalahapriyaḥ | yeṣāṃ gṛhaṃ pragacchāmi te yadi mānayanti me ||62|| vacāṃsi vai mayoktāni teṣāṃ sukhakaro’smyaham | nādriyante yadi lokā vacāṃsi toṣayanti na ||63 || tadā teṣāṃ gṛhe kṛtvā kalahaṃ cātiduḥsaham | pravrajāmi paraṃ gehaṃ yatra me mānanaṃ bhavet ||64|| kanyakā me darśayanti karau bhāgyaṃ vilokitum | ahaṃ dṛṣṭvā samastaṃ ca kathayāmi sukhapradam ||65|| asukhaṃ ca bhavet kiñcit tadahaṃ nāśayāmyapi | asatkāraṃ mama kṛtvā labhante na sukhaṃ janāḥ ||66|| susatkāraṃ labhante te mama vāco’nuvartinaḥ | mama godohamātraṃ vai vāsaścaikatra jāyate ||67|| tathāpi bhaktimāvīkṣya vasāmyapi divāniśam | tato viśeṣavāso me smṛddhisvargaprado bhavet ||68|| tato’pyadhikavāso me nārāyaṇāptidāyakaḥ | tato’pyadhikavāsaśca parabrahmapradāyakaḥ ||69|| muktiṃ dadāmi vacanānmuktiṃ dadāmi kīrtanāt | kleśaṃ dadāmi kalayā sukhaṃ dadāmi toṣaṇāt ||2.275.70 || viṣaṃ dadāmi vārtāyāṃ yatra nāhaṃ pratoṣitaḥ | pāyayāmyamṛtaṃ cāpi yatrāhaṃ sevito’bhavam ||71 || jijñāsā yatra pūrṇā me tatra svargottamaṃ sukham | datvā prayāmi cānyatra jānantviti vrataṃ mama ||72|| harekṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa harehare | śrīpate kaṃbharāputra lakṣmīpate harehare ||73 || śiveśvarasutākānta hare gopālanandana | brahmapriyāpate kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa harehare ||74|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa brahmapate hare | satpate sarvakāntānāṃ kānta kṛṣṇa harehare ||75|| śrīkṛṣṇavallabhasvāmin kuṃvarakṛṣṇarūpavān | deśika śrotriya svātman sarvātman śeṣaṇāśraya ||76|| ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ kṛtvā virarāma sa nāradaḥ | lakṣmīrvai manasā vācā karmaṇā nāradaṃ prati ||77|| dattendriyāntaravṛttistallīnā hi tadābhavat | satī śivāha devarṣi dhanyaṃ bhāgyamṛṣe mama ||78|| bhavān kṛṣṇasvarūpo yanmadgṛhaṃ samupāgataḥ | matputryāśca mahadbhāgyaṃ yat sataste’tra darśanam ||79|| nārado’haṃ vijānāmi śatajanmakṛtaṃ yadi | puṇyaṃ sammilitaṃ tena janma vai mānavaṃ labhet ||2.275.80|| punastatra kṛtā yajñāḥ syuḥ śataṃ tarhi vai divam | prāpyetendrasamakālaṃ tato’tra bhūtale sa tu ||8 1 || śeṣapuṇyaprabhāveṇa śreṣṭhamānavatāṃ labhet | tatra viprapratāpena satāmāśīrbhirityapi ||82|| rājyaṃ bhaktimayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prāpnuyāt sukhadaṃ śubham | tatra devakṛtā sevā sevātithijanasya ca ||83|| prāpayatyeva sadbuddhiṃ smṛddhiṃ vaṃśasya vallikām | pitṛtoṣeṇa tatrāpi putrāḥ putryo bhavanti ca ||84|| satāṃ sevāpratāpena jāyante sukhino janāḥ | satāṃ sevā dhanadātrī bhūmidātrī sukhapradā ||85|| sā ca dharmeṇa bhaktyā ca tapasā ca tathā vrataiḥ | milatyevānyathā naiva satāṃ sevā hi durlabhā ||86|| anugraheṇa dayayā satāṃ sevābhipadyate | pātivratyena dharmeṇa satāṃ sevābhipadyate ||87|| paropakāraśīlānāmannasatravidhāyinām | sadādānaparāṇāṃ vā satāṃ lābhaḥ prajāyate ||88|| bhaktānāṃ saumyabhāvānāṃ sarvārpaṇavidhāyinām | satāṃ satkārakartṝṇāṃ satāṃ lābhaḥ prajāyate ||89|| nityaṃ tīrthasvabhāvānāṃ nityaṃ kathāṃ suśṛṇvatām | nityaṃ vandanaśīlānāṃ satāṃ lābhaḥ prajāyate ||2.275.90|| nityaṃ devārhaṇasthānāṃ nityaṃ satkārakāriṇām | nityaṃ sādhusmṛtimatāṃ satāṃ lābhaḥ prajāyate ||91|| ātmaśreyo’bhilāṣāṇāṃ sevāvṛttijuṣāṃ tathā | jijñāsūnāṃ sevakānāṃ satāṃ lābhaḥ prajāyate ||92|| sato mārgayamāṇānāṃ satāṃ guṇānuśālinām | satāṃ gṛhe satāṃ yoge satāṃ lābhaḥ prajāyate ||93|| sadgurūṇāṃ nivāseṣu satāṃ mahotsavādiṣu | satāṃ prasaṃgāt satataṃ satāṃ lābhaḥ prajāyate ||94|| satyavratasthitānāṃ ca satparabrahmayājinām | hareḥ pārṣadayogānāṃ satāṃ lābhaḥ prajāyate ||95|| harerbhaktimatāṃ gehe bhaktānāṃ yoṣitāṃ gṛhe | viraktānāṃ samūheṣu satāṃ lābhaḥ prajāyate ||96|| sanmitrāṇāṃ prasaṃgena saddeśasya nivāsanāt | satkālasya ca yogena satāṃ sevā prajāyate ||97|| satāṃ dīkṣāprasaṃgena satāṃ mantragraheṇa ca | satāṃ snehavaśenāpi satāṃ sevā prajāyate ||98|| āstikyenāmantraṇena yaśasā satkulena ca | sambandhena ca mahatāṃ satāṃ sevā prajāyate ||99|| śrīhareḥ kṛpayā vāpi hareḥ patnyāḥ samāśrayāt | harervāsena vā nityaṃ satāṃ sevābhipadyate || 2.275.1 00|| adya nārada vāso me śmaśānaḥ śaṃkarālayaḥ | pāvito bhavatā sādho satā bhaktimatā hareḥ || 10 1|| tava pādaprasaṃgena pāvitaṃ sakalaṃ jagat | muktimārgaṃ prayātyeva madgṛhaṃ cāpi pāvitam || 1 02|| śrāvitaṃ śubhadaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇasambandhajaṃ sukham | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakīrtiḥ śrāvitā pāvanī tvayā || 1 03|| pāvitaṃ hṛdayaṃ me’tra matputryāścāpi te’ntike | sthitāyāḥ svarṇavarṇāyā lakṣmyā nārada jīva yat || 1 04|| aho bhāgyaṃ mama putryā yannāma jagatītraye | khyāyate sarvabhūteṣu dhanyāhaṃ mama putrikā || 1 05|| putri lakṣmi namaskāraṃ kuru śrīnāradāya vai | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cāpi tailāṃgamardanaṃ kuru || 1 06|| jalamannaṃ miṣṭamiṣṭaṃ gariṣṭaṃ dehi mā ciram | paryaṃkaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ dehi pānaṃ manastathā || 1 07|| yathecchati satāṃ varyo nārado’yaṃ hariḥ svayam | tathainaṃ ca parīkṣāṃ te kartuṃ dehi samastikām || 1 08|| brahmabhrātuśca vai śaṃbhoḥ kanyā tvaṃ duḥkhahe sute | ayaṃ putro brahmaṇaśca mama putro tavāgrajaḥ || 1 09|| sambandhato bhavatyeva guruścāpi mahānṛṣiḥ | nārado’yaṃ hareraṃśastava pūjyo’sti me’pi ca || 2.275.110 || putri yathā susantuṣṭo bhavettathā prasevaya | ityuktājākarīlakṣmīrnāradāya nanāma ha || 111 || jalapānaṃ tathā miṣṭamannaṃ dadau śubhāsanam | paryaṃkaṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ ca dadau puṣpasrajādikam || 11 2|| pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre lakṣmīḥ śrīnāradasya ca | rādhike śramanāśaṃ ca viśramya nārado vyadhāt || 113 || nārado’pi yathoktāni lakṣaṇāni nyabhālayat | sarvaśreṣṭhāni vai tatra pūrvadṛṣṭāni vai punaḥ || 1 14|| satī ca jānakī śīghraṃ śiveśvaraṃ patiṃ nijam | āhvayat sumahodyānagataṃ viśveśvaraṃ mudā || 1 15|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pārvatīsatyai nāradoktaśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamahimā, lakṣmīmahimā, satāṃ samāgamalābhakāraṇāni, nāradasammānanaṃ cetyādivṛttāntāvedananāmā pañcasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 275 ||
<2.276> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike nāradaścaivaṃ prāha śrīpataye tadā | bālakṛṣṇāya vai sarvaṃ vṛttaṃ śivagṛhe tu yat || 1 || nārada uvāca hare mayā viśramitaṃ tāvacchrīśivasarjakaḥ | viśvaśūro divyadehastryakṣo gṛhaṃ samāgataḥ || 2 || dhanyo’haṃ kṛtakṛtyo’haṃ vaiṣṇavo madgṛhe’dya vai | tatrāpi bhrātṛjo me’dya vatsalaḥ samupāgataḥ || 3 || aho nārada putra tvaṃ kutaḥ khalu samāgataḥ | śubhaṃ ca kuśalaṃ cāste tava bhrātuśca me tathā || 4 || viṣṇośca kuśalaṃ cāste kaccit kuṭumbinaḥ sukhāḥ | ityuktvā sahasā māṃ sa śivo vai vakṣasāmilat || 5 || mayā vai satyalokasya piturme brahmaṇastathā | mātuścāpi ca sāvitryāḥ kuśalaṃ parikīrtitam || 6 || tato vai sanakādīnāṃ rudrasyāpi prakīrtitam | dakṣādīnāṃ tataścāpi kuśalaṃ parikīrtitam || 7 | tato viṣṇormahālakṣmyā udantaṃ sarvameva tu | sukhaṃ ca kuśalaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhasthaṃ prakīrtitam | | 8 | tato traikuṇṭhake jātaṃ prāgvṛttaṃ smāritaṃ punaḥ | śivatāṇḍavakāle vai lakṣmyāḥ śāpādikaṃ tu yat || 9 || śivasya bhūtale janma śiveśvaro bhavāniti | lakṣmyāśca tyajanaṃ cāpi nārāyaṇena yat kṛtam || 2.276.10|| bhaktārthaṃ tvāyayau nārāyaṇo vai bhūtale hyanu | anādiśrībālakṛṣṇastanmiṣeṇa pareśvaraḥ ||1 1|| parabrahma samāyātaścāśvapaṭṭasarovare | śrāvitaṃ vai mayā tattu lakṣmīścāpi samāgatā |||12|| śivasvāmigṛhe putrī jāteyaṃ śrāvitāpi sā | śiveyaṃ pārvatī devī tatsarvaṃ śrāvitaṃ mayā || 13|| smāraṃ smāraṃ śiveśaścāśrūṇyapi hyavāsṛjat | pariṣvajya saḥ māṃ gāḍhaṃ putra putretyavāmilat || 14|| ahaṃ vai śaṃkaraṃ natvāśrāvayaṃ mama hṛdgatam | kanyāmetāṃ bhagavām̐śca smastyevāgadaṃ ca tam ||15|| pradānakālastvasyā vai samupasthita eva ha | yogyaṃ yathārthaṃ kartavyaṃ tena sampatsyate sukham || 16 || kṛṣṇasya tu bhavān śaṃbho pūjāṃ karoti nityadā | dṛṣṭa eva muhurdivyaḥ sa eva sundaro varaḥ |||17|| parabrahma svayaṃ te tu niścito’sti janārdanaḥ | mayā dṛṣṭo bhavatāpi dṛṣṭo mānavarūpavān || 18|| kṣetrapālasvarūpeṇa draṣṭavyo nāvaśiṣyate | tathāpi cet samāyāhi yadi vāñcchā pravidyate ||19|| ityuktaśca mayā śaṃbhuḥ sasmāraiva bṛhaspatim | sa ca tūrṇaṃ samāyāto madhuparkādikaṃ haraḥ ||2.276.20|| pradadau gurave sarvaṃ nyavedayanmayoditam | bṛhaspatiḥ śubhaṃ prāha sarvaṃ yathottamaṃ tathā ||21|| tato niścitya vai śaṃbhuḥ kanyādānaṃ tu maukhikam | mamāgre tvavadaccāpi guroragre punaḥ punaḥ || 22|| mayā śubhaṃ muhūrtaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā bhūṣāmbarāṇi ca | śrīphalaṃ tilakaṃ cāpi kanyāyai tvarpitāni vai ||23|| tvatto jātā prasannā sā paridhāyāmbarāṇi ca | sadbhūṣā vividhāścāpi tadā sāpi gurūditā ||24|| harṣaṃ gatā varārthāṃ svāṃ matvā sakhīṣu śobhanā | haro bṛhaspatiṃ prāha kadā mahotsavo bhavet ||25|| bṛhaspatiścaturthyāṃ vai mārge śukle’vadattu tam | śrutvā modaṃ gatāḥ sarve bṛhaspativacaḥsthitāḥ |||26|| nirṇīya ca mayā sākaṃ tato vācaspatirdrutam | yogapatraṃ samādāya kanyāmano vilokya ca ||27|| pārvatyāśca mano vīkṣya pūjayitvā gaṇādhipam | kuṃkumārdraṃ dravaṃ kṛtvā dṛṣṭvā muhūrtakaṃ śubham ||28|| alikhatpatramevāpi nāradasyaiva sākṣikam | vāditrāṇi janāstatrāvādayan vai harājñayā ||29|| maṃgalāni tathā nāryaścāgāyan devatāstriyaḥ | gūḍadhānādikaṃ śrīmān nāradaśca bṛhaspatiḥ || 2.276.3 0|| śaṃkarādyāstathā sarve samāśnan maṃgalāvaham | tato’yaṃ suragururāṭ śivena yogapatrayuk ||3 1 || saṃpreṣito mayā sārdhaṃ kuṃkumavāpikālayam | so’yaṃ suragururdevaḥ samāyāto’sti niścitaḥ || 32|| vāgdattāṃ tāṃ nijīkṛtvā kṛṣṇānaya priyāmiha | pratīkṣamāṇā te mārgaṃ vartate vihvaleva sā || 33 || kadā kṛṣṇaḥ samāgacchet kadā māṃ ca nijāṃ kriyāt | tyaktā pūrvaṃ kadā tvenaṃ prāpnuyāṃ prāṇajīvanam ||34|| kadā sā kambharālakṣmīḥ premṇā māṃ samalokayet | dvivāraṃ yā samāgatya māṃ vilokya gatā gatā ||35|| vimānenādhvarebhyaśca yadāyāto haristadā | punaḥ pūjyā na sāyāti kathaṃ māṃ na smaratyapi ||36 || pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭā tayā cāhaṃ bālikā tu tadābhavam | mama putrasya yogyeyaṃ kṛtvāṅke māṃ nyaṣādayat ||37|| manye sā vartate devī sadā niścitanirṇayā | tṛptā prasannā santuṣṭā yā māṃ naiva niṣedhati || 38|| nārada tvaṃ samāyātastadā sā kaṃbharā ramā | kiṃ māṃ manmātaraṃ vā cākathayad vada tattvataḥ |39|| ityevaṃ sā muhurmāṃ sampṛṣṭavatī rahasyakam | vaktavyaṃ tanmayā sarvaṃ kambharāyai samāhvaya ||2.276.40|| śīghraṃ kuru kṛpāsindho sarvaṃ hṛdyaṃ phaliṣyati | ityukto rādhike tatra bālakṛṣṇaḥ surarṣiṇā ||41 || samutthāya gataḥ śīghraṃ mātaraṃ kaṃbharāṃ prati | praṇamya mātaraṃ prāha nārado mama mandiram ||42|| jñāpayituṃ rahasyaṃ tu samāhvayati sotsukaḥ | santuṣṭāṃ matsvasāraṃ ca tathā bhrātṛvadhūṃ satīm ||43|| amṛtāṃ śrīṃ saha nītvā samāyāhi mamālayam | ityuktā bālakṛṣṇena mātā svasṛsamāyutā ||44|| bhrātṛpatnīsuyuktā ca bālakṛṣṇena saṃyutā | āyāt samutsukā rādhe bālakṛṣṇālayaṃ satī ||45|| nāradastāṃ vilokyaiva mandahāso’namat satīm | utthāya svāgataṃ cakre vāṇyā vai namrakaṃdharaḥ ||46|| kṛtahastāñjaliścāpi tadā sa protthito’bhavat | yāvanmātā svarṇasiṃhāsane tūpāviśat tataḥ ||47|| svasā bhrātṛgṛhiṇī ca yāvaccopāviśattataḥ | sammānitaḥ pūjitaśca vandito nārado muniḥ ||48|| namaskṛtya yathātathyamagadat kṛṣṇasannidhau | mātarnamāmi caraṇau rahasyaṃ pravadāmi ca | yanmāmuktavatī śaivī raho’rthaṃ vai punaḥ punaḥ ||49|| śrīkaṃbharālakṣmīruvāca kiṃ maharṣe bālikā sā nārāyaṇī pareśvarī | uktavatī madarthaṃ yat sarvaṃ tvatra nivedaya ||2.276.50|| kiṃ sā rūpavatī bālā hyavyaṃgā pūrṇalakṣaṇā | kiṃsvidārogyamasyā vai kiṃ svit tannirmalaṃ manaḥ ||51||| kiṃsvidicchati matputraṃ kiṃ svidāste’tra hṛnmayī | kaccit sā snehabhāvā māṃ kiṃsvinmatputramānasā ||52|| prasannahṛdayā kiṃsvidāste māṃ smṛtavatyapi | yadā yajño’bhavaccāpi piṃgāraṇye tadā satīm ||53|| samāgatāṃ tu tāṃ vīkṣya prasannā tvabhavaṃ hyati | snuṣābhāvaṃ pradarśyaiva svāṃke nītavatī ca mām ||54|| punaḥ sāhaṃ nijaṃ deśaṃ gatvā tato’dhvarāntare | rāśiyānapradeśeṣu gatvā punaśca tāṃ gatā ||55|| nijaputreṇa sākaṃ vai tāṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣitābhavam | tāṃ nijasya sutasyārthe vijñāpya rahasi sthitām |||56||| tanmātre’pi tadā sarvaṃ tatsambaddhaṃ prabhāṣya ca | nirṇītamiva niścityāgatā gatā na tāṃ punaḥ ||57|| sā kanyā matputrayogyā kiṃ niveditavatyapi | vada me sarvamevātra kiṃguṇā kiṃpraśikṣaṇā ||58|| kīdṛśī sā buddhiyuktā kalāyuktā tato’sti sā | vada me sarvamevātra yadbodhyaṃ vai snuṣākṛte ||59|| nārada uvāca mātaḥ sā kaṃbharālakṣmīrnāma śrutvātigauravāt | premabhāvāddharṣitā sābhavattathāśrusaṃyutā ||2.276.60|| kṣaṇaṃ bhūtvā dhairyayuktā māṃ vihasya samabravīt | kaccit sukhaṃ mamārhāyāḥ kaccinmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||6 1 || kiṃvṛttāntā mama pūjyā kiyadbhāvā ca māṃ prati | sā kiṃ mahyaṃ yatnavatī prasannā kiṃ ca māṃ prati ||62|| vada mahyaṃ maharṣe tvaṃ guṇasthānāṃ yathāsthitām | yadvā jñātavyamevānyat kathitaṃ māṃ nivedaya ||63|| tato’haṃ cāvad kanyāṃ śravaṇe dattamānasām | lakṣmi tvāṃ kaṃbharādevī na vai vismarati kvacit ||64|| bhojane tvāṃ sadā smṛtvā kṛṣṇaṃ tvāṃ smārayatyapi | kvacit kvacicca te vārtāmagnā tvadguṇavarṇanā ||65|| snehāśrubhṛtanetrā vai jāyate kiṃ vadāmi te | sukhaṃ śvaśrvāḥ sadā cāste sukhinīṃ tvāṃ pratīkṣate ||66|| sarvaśobhanavṛttāntā dehagehasutānvitā | sarvasampatsamṛddhā sā lakṣmi tvāṃ sampratīkṣate ||67|| yathā putrīṃ ca santuṣṭāṃ prati sā kambharā sadā | tathā tvāṃ prati cādhikyabhāvāste kambharā satī ||68|| tvadarthaṃ sā yatnavatī kadāyānme sutapriyā | sadā prasannā cāste tvāṃ pratīśvarī hi kaṃbharā ||6 9|| kvacid vadati kalyāṇī snuṣā me kiṃvratā bhavet | kṛṣṇo me tāṃ vinā naiva śobhate sadṛśīṃ priyām ||2.276.70|| ityevaṃ vai mayā mātaḥ sarvaṃ tasyai niveditam | āśīrvādāḥ pradattāśca tvaduktāśca tadāvadam ||71 || prasannā sā snehavatī cāste sadguṇaśālinī | ityevaṃ cāvadaṃ tasyai sā punaḥ prāha māṃ namaḥ ||72|| namaskārāśca me tasyāḥ pādayoḥ sannivedaya | prāṇāstvāste tava putre tathāryāyai nivedaya ||73|| ātmā tatrāgato’styeva pūjyāyai sannivedaya | kṣantavyā bālyabhāvā me’nāryāyāśceti vedaya ||74|| yādṛśī tādṛśī cāsmi parvatāraṇyavāsinoḥ | putrī jāḍyamayī cāhaṃ kṣantavyā ceti vedaya ||75|| nāhaṃ vidyāvatī cārye nāhaṃ kalānidhānikā | nāhaṃ vijñānasampannā nāhaṃ cāturyaśobhanā ||76|| nāhaṃ māyākarī cāpi nāhaṃ tīkṣṇaprayogiṇī| nāhaṃ kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇayogyā tathāpi māṃ na vismareḥ ||77|| pūjyāyāḥ putrikā cāhaṃ pūjyāputrasya patnikā | kanyakāsmi drutaṃ snuṣāṃ vidhehi cālamīdṛśam ||78|| vacanaṃ kanyakāproktaṃ dānakālo hi vidyate | ityuktvā pradadau mahyaṃ miṣṭāmṛtaphalāni hi ||79|| deyāni kambharālakṣmyai tatputrāya ca viṣṇave | ityuktvā prāṇaman mahyaṃ rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ tava ||2.276.80|| kṛṣṇaṃ vinā kṣaṇaṃ naiva yāpayatyeva sā satī | lakṣmītulyā tu sā lakṣmīrnānyatulyā kadācana ||81|| sarvatejāṃsi piṇḍāni tatsvarūpe vasanti hi | ujjvalā tādṛśī cāste yauvanodbhedanāṃkurā |||82|| sādhvyavasthā sadā cāste cidambarāmbarottamā | śāśvatikanisargā ca saccidānandapiṇḍikā ||83|| brahmasaṃsthānikā cāste muktākṛtirhariprabhā | dvādaśottamavarṣā ca puruṣottamamāninī ||84|| snehavegā harau pātivratyabhāvā virājate | hṛdo madhye hariścāste kṛṣṇalakṣaṇalakṣitā ||85 || sarvakalābhisampannā kimu mātaḥ pravarṇaye | jānāti pākaśāstraṃ sā jānāti grathanakriyāḥ ||86|| jānāti gṛhakāryāṇi gaṇakāryāṇi yāni ca | bālaśāstraṃ prajānāti kalāḥ śṛṃgārajā api ||87|| nepathyaracanāṃ sarvāṃ jānāti sundarīkriyāḥ | bhṛtyakāryāṇi sarvāṇi dāsyakāryāṇi yānyapi ||88|| sevākāryāṇi sarvāṇi manorañjanakāni ca | nāṭyakāryāṇi sarvāṇi nṛtyakāryāṇi yāni ca ||89|| vādyakāryāṇi sarvāṇi gītikāryāṇi sarvaśaḥ | utsavādīni yāvanti sabhākāryāṇi sarvathā ||2.276.90|| vyākhyānāni samastāni nyāyavākyāni vai tathā | ātmabodhān samagrām̐śca kalā yogodbhavāṃstathā || 91 || jānāti sarvasiddhīśca tattvajñānaṃ ca vaidyakam | āyurvedaṃ vijānāti yajñakarmāṇi sarvaśaḥ || 92|| sarvān vedān vijānāti sarvān vinimayām̐stathā | sarvān hetūnṛtūn sarvān vivṛttiṃ pariṇāmakān ||93 || sarvaṃ śailpyaṃ vijānāti vakti sarvāśca nītikāḥ | sarvacchandāṃsi jānāti vaṃśodbhavaṃ gṛhikriyāḥ ||94|| ātitheyaṃ vijānāti paitryaṃ daivaṃ samarhaṇam | satkāraṃ svāgataṃ cāpi vijānāti ca mānanām ||95|| paropakāraṃ dānaṃ ca vijānāti samudbhavam | snehaṃ prītiṃ svāmibhaktiṃ pātivratyaṃ vṛṣaṃ nijam ||96|| prajānāti rasān miśrān miṣṭānnāni samastataḥ | takrasaṃskārakaraṇaṃ payaḥpākādikaṃ tathā ||97|| vijānāti ca vayanaṃ śuddhiṃ vratāni cāṃjasā | paṇḍāvatī samāste sā dṛśyate ca bahuśrutā ||98|| śāradā vā kimāste sā kiṃ vā rādhā hi rañjanī | raṃgakalāṃ vijānāti dhenusevādi vetti ca ||99 || kṛṣikāryaṃ sasyapuṣṭiṃ jānātyapi vanāni ca | sarvauṣadhāni samidho jānātyārogyamityapi || 2.276.10 0|| jalakalāṃ vijānāti vahnikalāṃ pravetti ca | mantrakalāḥ samagrāśca pravāsān saṃpravetti ca || 101 || lābhālābhau sujānāti puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam | sāmadānādikaṃ cāpi vijānāti vivecanām || 1 02|| kathāḥ sarvā vijānāti mahodyānakalāstathā | miṣṭamādhuryakaṇṭhī sā miṣṭasvarātividyate || 103 || svarṇavarṇā brahmavarṇā raktapatkarapallavā | ujjvalā śāradī jyotsnā yaddehe vasati dhruvā || 1 04|| viśālonnatacandrābhabhālā candrādiśobhanā | kṛṣṇakeśī ca kṛṣṇātmā kṛṣṇaiśvaryādisiddhikā || 1 05|| sarvasampatprabhāvā ca brahmasaukhyasamanvitā | parabrahmaprabhānā ca parabrahmaprabodhinī || 106 || smṛddhikāryā harau bhaktimatī muktānikā sadā | bālakṛṣṇo’ntare tvasyā rājate mokṣakṛtprabhuḥ || 1 07|| sā cāste kaṃbhare caturdaśavidyāsamāśritā | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhanuḥśūlasamanvitā || 1 08|| pūrvoktacihnayuktā ca kamalācihnaśobhitā | lakṣmīcihnasahasraiḥ śobhitā varṣmaṇi sarvataḥ || 1 09|| dvāsaptatipramukhyāni mukhyāni santi tatra ha | bālakṛṣṇasya cākaṇṭhaṃ samucchrayā virājate || 2.276.11 0|| gajahaṃsagatiścāste parahaṃsagatiḥ sadā | svarṇavāsā sugandhā ca koṭyabjasakhikā tathā || 111 || rādhāramāsatīpadmāmāṇikīpadmajāśriyaḥ | śāradādyāśca sakhyo’syā vartante kṛṣṇapatnikāḥ || 1 12|| sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktā sarvasaṃghaṭanāśritā | camatkārachaṭāyuktā śīlakṛṣṇabalāsti ca || 113 || śuddhasattvamayī brāhmī brahmānandādanā sadā | pāyasādyadanā sādhvī satī kṛṣṇārthanigrahā || 1 14|| kṛṣṇadhyānatapoyuktā bālakṛṣṇārthatoṣiṇī | sarvatṛṣṇākṣayatoṣā amāyā śuddhiśobhanā || 115 || vedavidyāsamadhyāyā mahāsāttvatasadvṛṣā | mokṣahārḍhā cātmanivednahārdā samarpaṇe || 1 16|| nirvāṇapremapātrā śrīkṛṣṇapremaparāyaṇā | kṛṣāsādhanakuśalā cāgāmibodhasanmatiḥ || 1 17|| kṛṣṇāṃgā cācyutadhanā hyabhakte cañcalā sadā | kṛṣṇacāñcalyayuktā ca tathā kṛṣṇārthakhelanā || 1 18|| muktiruciḥ kṛṣṇakathāpravādā sthiravṛttikā | parabrahmapravṛttiśca puruṣārthatrayānvitā || 11 9|| sṛṣṭitrayavidhātrī ca yatnabhogaprahāphalā | yajñasvargamokṣaphalā cāpūrakakriyāvatī || 2.276.120 || brahmalābhaviśeṣā ca sṛṣṭisaukhyasamānikā | sūkṣmātmānandamadhyā ca mādhavaśvāsayoginī || 121 || kṛṣṇayogā sarvabodhā sarvajñopāsanāvatī | vṛddhārādhanikā nityaṃ kṛṣṇaśṛṃgāraśobhanā || 1 22|| kṛṣṇetare viraktā ca nārāyaṇe sutoṣiṇī | muktā satsaṃgagṛdhnā ca kṛṣṇāśā kambharecchukī || 123 || kadā vai kambharālakṣmyā gṛhaṃ paśyāmi cecchati | yadi nāhaṃ ca kṛṣṇārthāṃ tadā me jīvanaṃ kutaḥ || 1 24|| yato me jīvanaṃ cāste kṛṣṇārthāsmīti tarkagā | parabrahmoruyugalaṃ gṛhaṃ me cetiniścayā || 1 25|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavādā pade pade | pratyakṣaḥ śrībālakṛṣṇaḥ pramāṇaṃ divyaśāśvatam || 1 26|| tasyā vai vartate mātastanmūlānyaparāṇyapi | viśiṣṭaṃ sarvamevāste prameyaṃ tatkṛte sadā || 1 27|| parabrahma mahātattv yatsamaṃ nādhikaṃ param | tadyogaḥ suprayogo’syā kṛṣṇasiddhāntasiddhikā || 1 28|| kṛṣṇatantrasusiddhāntā sarvasvaprativarjitā | bālakṛṣṇagrahabandhā kṛṣayājñāvedasaṃbhṛtā || 1 29|| sādhyo nārāyaṇaścāsyāḥ sādhanaṃ na śamādikam | bālakṛṣṇapriyā kāntā kāntetaravitarjinī || 2.276.130 || mahābhāgavatadharmayamā kṛṣṇayamānvitā | kṛṣṇārthaṃ niyatā kṛṣṇaniyamā nāparāśritā || 131 || bālakṛṣṇānanadhyānā kuṃkumavāpikāsanā | tava putre prāṇavatī kṛṣṇe ratikriyāvatī || 132|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāmāvasāyinī | śrīkṛṣṇasyavallabhātipriyā sā kṛṣṇavatpriyā || 1 33||| vartate sā mahālakṣmi kambhare guṇasaṃbhṛtā | kṛṣṇaviyogo rogo’syā mānasaṃ tena kalmaṣam || 134|| tvatputrecchārbudayuktā hṛdayenātra rājate | sarvasnehā kaṃbharāyāṃ premasnehā sute tava | vivāhamānasā nityaṃ prasannahṛdayāpi ca || 1 35|| sadā smarati tvāṃ mātaḥ putraṃ nityaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | māṃ jagāda sā sadvegā śṛṇu tvaṃ kaṃbhare punaḥ || 136|| yadā yajño’bhavat piṃgāraṇye śvaśrūstadāgatā | snuṣābhāvaṃ pradarśyaiva svāṃke nītavatī ca mām || 1 37|| rāśiyānapradeśeṣu gatvā punaḥ samāgatā | māṃ nijasya sutasyārthe vijñāpya rahasi sthitām || 1 38|| sākṣataṃ candrakaṃ guptaṃ kṛtvā gatā gataiva sā | nādyāpi tvāgatā mātā pūjyāryā pārameśvarī || 139|| kadā cāyāsyati śrīśā vada me nārada drutam | kathanīyāḥ praṇāmā me cetyavadat punaḥ punaḥ || 2.276.140|| mātaḥ sarvaguṇopetā sarvakāryeṣu śikṣitā | gṛhakāryanipūṇā sā dānayogyā prakāśate || 141|| tasmācchīghraṃ pragatvaivotsavapatrānubodhitam | caturthīdivasaṃ matvā kuru tayorhi maṃgalam || 142||| ityuktvā rādhike vipro nāradastāṃ praṇamya ca | svāsane samprayātaśca viśrāntiṃ cāptavān punaḥ || 143|| kaṃbharā śāntimāpannā santuṣṭā mumude tadā | amṛtāpi pramodaṃ cānumodaṃ pradadau tadā || 144|| bālakṛṣṇaḥ prasannaścābhavat śrutvā hyudantakam | suṣvupuśca tataḥ sarve sukhaṃ caturdaśīniśi || 145|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne sarahasyalakṣmyuktodantaṃ nārado bālakṛṣṇāya prāha, tataḥ kaṃbharādevyai prāhetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 276 ||
<2.277> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike’māyāṃ prātargopālakanyakā | viprakanyā yuvatyaśca prajagurmaṃgalāni vai || 1 || suvāsinyastathā vṛddhā bālikā maṃgalātmakam | yogapatrāgamaṃ śrutvā prajagurmaṃgalāni vai || 2 || kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre bṛhaspateḥ śubhāgamāt || harermaṃgalamāśrutya jagurgītīrgṛhe gṛhe ||3 || brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca tathaiva sarvakanyakāḥ | kṛṣṇapriyā jagurgītīḥ kāntasya maṃgalāvahā || 4 || gopyaḥ sarvā militvā cāyayuḥ śrīkaṃbharāgṛham | sādhvyaśca brahmacāriṇyo gāyantyo maṃgalāni vai || 5 || kṣatrapatnyo vaiśyanāryaḥ pāṭalāścānyasevikāḥ | mahotsāhabharā gītīrgāyantyaścāyayurgṛham || 6 || devyo nityanivāsinyo’kṣarakṣetraṃ samutsukāḥ | śrutvā harerlagnavārtāṃ gāyantyaścāyayurgṛham || 7 || kāmarūpadharāḥ sakhyaścatuḥkhanisamudbhavāḥ | kāmavallyaśca gāyantyastvāyayuḥ kṛṣṇamandiram || 8 || aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthanivāsinyaśca mātṛkāḥ | surāṇyaśca guruṃ lagnaṃ śrutvā jñātvā sumaṃgalam || 9 || gāyantyo divyaveṣāṃśca kṛṣṇamandiramāyayuḥ | ārṣyaḥ sarvāḥ pūjanīyā rājapatnyaśca kanyakāḥ || 2.277.10|| kuṃkumavāpikānāryo gāyantyastatra cāyayuḥ | sarvavarṇayuvatyaśca sarvā nāryaḥ samāyayuḥ | satīṃ śrīṃ kaṃbharālakṣmīṃ kṛtasnānārhaṇāṃ ca tāḥ || 11 || praṇamya kānake saudhe niṣadya maṃgalāni vai | bālakṛṣṇasya kṛṣṇasya kīrtimayāni sañjaguḥ || 12|| kṛtasnānārhaṇaṃ mātrā kṛtamaṃgalacandrakam | kuṃkumākṣatayugbhālaṃ kṛtaśṛṃgāramacyutam || 13|| bhrātṛpatnyā kṛtaveṣaṃ parameśaṃ priyaṃ prabhum | gāyantyo yoṣitaḥ sarvā vardhayāmāsurutsukāḥ || 14|| cakrustāścandrakaṃ bhāle sākṣataṃ puṣpavardhanam | pragīya gītikāścāpi pradarśyānandamāntaram || 15|| āśīrdatvā guruṃ bṛhaspatiṃ natvā kṛtāhnikam | pītvā mātrārpitaṃ dugdhaṃ saśarkaraṃ sakesaram || 16|| gṛhītvā tāmbūlamiṣṭaṃ śubhamuktvā yayurgṛham | gṛhe gṛhe’tra saurāṣṭre kṛṣṇotsavasya vārtikā ||17|| vṛhaspaternāradasyāgamaścāprasarad drutam | sarvāḥ prajāstu tacchrutvā prāpurharṣaṃ mahotsavam || 18|| ānandamagnā abhavan darśanārthaṃ samāgaman | māṃgalikāni tūryāṇi tvavādyanta ca mandire ||19| suravādyāni sarvāṇi rājavādyāni yāni ca | gṛhavādyāni yāvanti deśavādyāni yāni ca ||2.277.20|| karavādyāni ca śvāsavādyāni pāvanāni ca | daṇḍavādyāni sarvāṇi vidyudvādyāni yāni ca ||21|| aṃgavādyāni ca saṃgapravādyāni ca yāni ca | prabhinnadeśavādyāni tvavādyanta samantataḥ |||22|| miṣṭā vai śaṃkhikānādā jalayantrasvanāstathā | tārasvanā ajāyanta vaṃśīsvanā gṛhe gṛhe || 23 || gāyakāścāpi gāyanti nṛtyanti cāpsaraḥsamāḥ | nāryastadā bālakṛṣṇotsavaṃ śrutvātiharṣitāḥ ||24|| saṃnṛtyanti mayūrāśca kūjanti kokilāstathā | śakunāni pragāyanti śukā menāśca sārasāḥ ||25|| padyotante grahāścāpi tejasvinaśca vahnayaḥ | sādhavaḥ snehatejobhirvyāptāstatkīrtanaṃ jaguḥ ||26|| bhaṭṭabhūsuravidyādhrā vidvāṃso vedavedinaḥ || sāmagītīstadāgāyan cāraṇāḥ kavitāṃ jaguḥ || 27|| anye jaya jaya tvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇetyūcuḥ prabhuṃ prati | evaṃ vai rādhike harṣavāco’bhavan jane jane || 28|| śrutvānye bālakṛṣṇasyotsavapatraṃ samāgatam | guruṃ ca nāradaṃ śrutvā darśanārthamupāyayuḥ ||29|| āśīrvādān vadantaśca cirajīvetivādinaḥ | api bhekā bhekasamā gālayantramanādayan ||2.277.3 0|| oṣṭhayantraṃ tammarikāsamāścāvādayam̐stadā | karatālaṃ vādayanto jayavādān vyadhuśca te ||3 1 || kiṃ bahunā rādhike’tra kathitena tavāgrataḥ | dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya gṛhadharmaṃ grahīṣyati || 32|| viśiṣṭaṃ yatparaṃ tattvaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ sarvadāsti tat | āvedayituṃ lokebhyo gṛhadharmaṃ cariṣyati ||3 3|| ityevaṃ saṃvicintyaiva lagnapatrakṛtotsavam | prakāśaṃ kartumicchanto mudā rāsotsavaṃ vyadhuḥ ||34|| naro nārī naro nārī naro nārī bhramātmakāḥ | bhramanto’pi ca gāyanto bālakṛṣṇaguṇān jaguḥ ||35 || dṛṣṭvā kuṃkumavāpyāṃ tad divyadṛṣṭyā purādiṣu | saurāṣṭre sārvabhaume ca gururvismayamāvahat ||36 || aho bhāgavatī bhaktirbhūrisnehamayī bhuvi | mahaḥpatraprasaṃgena mayā dṛṣṭā janeṣviha ||37|| īdṛśā bhaktimanto’tra loke muktā na saṃśayaḥ | yeṣāṃ hṛtsu harerbhāvo divyātidivyako’sti yat ||38|| aho nārāyaṇī dhanyā lakṣmīḥ sā śivakanyakā | yā vai prāpsyati dhāmeśaṃ khyātaṃ kāntaṃ hi śāśvatam ||39|| rādhāto’pi paraṃ cāsyāḥ sopānaṃ jñāyate mayā | yasyāḥ patiḥ paraścāste sordhvasopānagā yataḥ ||2.277.40|| kanyāpi kṛṣṇapatnī cej jaganmātā pragadyate| vṛddhāpi kubjikā loke kṛṣṇayogā praśasyate ||41 || vṛndā tulasī daityasya jalaṃdharasya vai tathā | śaṃkhacūḍasya patnyau te viṣṇuyoge ramānibhe ||02||| pūjanīye jagadvandye mokṣade’bhavatāṃ sadā | aho kṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ brahmapriyā asaṃkhyakāḥ ||43|| vartante’syāstu vai lakṣmyā gauravaṃ naiva yānti tāḥ | lakṣmyarthaṃ likhyate lagnapatraṃ yannānyasadṛśam ||44|| lakṣmyarthaṃ gamyate yena nānyasamo bṛhaspatiḥ | lakṣmyarthaṃ gīyate tvadya yaśo’pi nānyasadṛśam ||45|| lakṣmyarthaṃ harṣajananaṃ nānyatulyamidaṃ purā | lakṣmyarthaṃ bālakṛṣṇasya hṛdayaṃ nānyasadṛśam ||46|| lakṣmyarthaṃ laukikī vāṇī divyā cādya vibhāvyate | lakṣmyarthaṃ lokacāñcalyaṃ kalyāṇakṛd vilokyate ||47|| aho lokasya lokatvaṃ lakṣmīkṛṣṇāvalokanāt | yāthārthyaṃ bhajate tvadya divyālokātmakaṃ hi yat ||48|| aho me bhāgyamūrdhvaṃ vai tatsthānaṃ sārthakaṃ mama | guruścordhvaḥ sadā jāto lakṣmīpatraprapreṣaṇāt ||49|| ityāścaryamayo vipro devānāṃ sa bṛhaspatiḥ | rādhike vīkṣya sarvaṃ tad bālakṛṣṇāśrito’dhikaḥ ||2.277.50|| mahābhāgavato bhaktaścātmaniveditāṃ yayau | svarūpaṃ haraye samārpayat sarvasvadānataḥ ||51 || atha gantumanā bṛhaspatirgopālakṛṣṇakam | prāhādya kāśikāṃ yātuṃ samicchāmi nivedaya ||52|| amāyāṃ tatra śivarāṭ matpratīkṣāṃ karoti hi | tathāstviti ca gopālaḥ prāha cānyad bṛhaspatim || 53 || yāhi śīghraṃ guro kāśīṃ śiveśvaraṃ nivedaya | bhavadvāñcchā prapūrṇāstu pālayāmi vacastava ||54|| lagnapatraṃ prapūjya svīkṛtavānasmi bhāvataḥ | bhavadvidhānāṃ devānāṃ niścitaṃ tatsukhāvaham ||55|| viparītaṃ vaiparītye pariṇameta kaṣṭadam | kanyā yogyā kumāro’pi yogyo’stīti tathāstviti | maukhikīṃ svīkṛtiṃ proktvā pratipatraṃ dadau tadā ||56 || śrīrādhikovāca kīdṛśaṃ yogapatraṃ tat kīdṛśaṃ pratipatrakam | tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi cāvedanaṃ taduttaram ||57|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvācaśṛṇu rādhe kathayāmi tūbhaye patrike śubhe | yathārthe likhite gāṃbhīryādisadguṇamaṇḍite ||58|| svastiśrīśvarapūjanīyarajasi brahmākṣarakṣetrake| śrīmatkuṃkumavāpikābhidhavare yo rājate śrīpatiḥ | yadgehe parameśvaro vilasati śrībālakṛṣṇo hariḥ| koṭyabjeśvaravandito vijayate gopālakṛṣṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 59|| yo vairājapitā bhavannanu mahāviṣṇuḥ svayaṃ rājate| yaḥ sṛṣṭau pratham manuṣyacaritaścāste harerājñayā | sṛṣṭitryarthitayadyaśāḥ śubhaguṇāvāsastviha khyāyate| tasmai vai bhavate namāmi satataṃ śrīkaṃbharāsvāmine || 2.277.60 || yeṣāṃ puṇyasupuñjaśevadhiriha prākaṭyamāpadyate| yeṣāṃ sādhujanāśiṣo’tibahulāḥ kāle phalantyāyatau | yeṣāṃ yajñatapaḥphalaṃ hyudayate vṛddhopasevāphalaṃ, teṣāṃ tvādṛśaviṣṇunā saha bhavet| sambandhitā durlabhā ||6 1 || yatputrasya pade’rpayanti kṛtinaḥ puṇyāni śaṃdānyapi, dhāmeśāśca samarpayanti mukuṭān mūrdhasthitān pūjane | īśā divyasamṛddhimuttamamaṇīn ratnādikaṃ devatā, bhūpā rājyamanuttamaṃ kṣitidharāḥ svarṇādikaṃ śreṣṭhinaḥ ||6 2 || tasmai cākṣaravāsine bhagavate sarveśvareśāya vai, yogyāyātiguṇālayāya haraye śrībālakṛṣṇāya ha | kāśīsthastu śiveśvaro hi surarāṭ kailāsavāsīśvaraḥ, kanyāṃ me pradadāmi dānamanaghāṃ śrīpārvatīśo nvaham ||6 3 || yā lakṣmīrharidhāmatastviha purā nārāyaṇecchāvaśā, tadbhaktasya harasya me śubhagṛhe prākaṭyamāsāditā | seyaṃ sāmpratamasti yogyavaraṇā dānapradānocitā, tasyā dānavidhiścaturthadivase mārgasya śukle dale | | 6 4|| puṇyātpuṇyatame muhūrtakavare taddānakāryotsave, yāvacchraiṣṭhyaviśeṣita śubhatame cāsmābhirāniścite | satsambandhisuhṛtprasannahṛdayairāgatya manmandiraṃ śrīmadbhiḥ svasutena hastadharaṇādyātmā vinirvartyatām ||6 5 || bhakto’haṃ bhuvi sāttvato’tra ca haraḥ śrībālakṛṣṇasya vai, yāvacchakti susevanaṃ vidhiyutaṃ vaḥ saṃvidhāsye’nvaham | nirvighnaṃ gaṇanāyakasya kṛpayā sampāramāpta makhaṃ, dṛṣṭveṣyāmi sutoṣaṇaṃ tata imā gṛhṇantu matprārthanām || 65 || yā vai me matabodhikā hi likhitā patrī mayā śobhanā, śrīmatkuṃkumabindumaṃgalapadāsiktā pradānārthikā | dvyarṣeḥ sākṣiyutā bṛhaspatikare datvā mayā preṣitā, sā vo hastagatā karotu ca sute vo matsutā maṃgalam ||67|| śīghraṃ devaguruṃ kṛtādaramamuṃ sampreṣayitvā ca mām, āśvāse hi samarpya cordhvakaraṇe nibandhanaṃ sotsavam | kartuṃ yogyatamān hi no vidadhatu śrīkāśikāvāsino, bhaktānbrahmaparānhariśrutadharān naḥ sāttvatān sevakān ||48||| yadvānyat kuśalādiśobhi ca dinaṃ yacchrīmatāṃ śobhanaṃ, tadvā sadguruṇā samaṃ drutataraṃ dānārhamāvedyatām | anyaccāpi yathākula svasaraṇiprāptaṃ madarhaṃ ca yat, tatsarvaṃ vinivedyatāmiti vadan śaṃbhuḥ śamaṃ yāmi om ||69|| ityevaṃ rādhike dānapatrī śaṃkarapreṣitā | mayoktā te’nurodhādvai śṇūttaraprapatrikām ||2.277.70 || śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇo yāṃ lilekha prati śaṃkaram | sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyāṃ bahvarthasaṃbhṛtāṃ śṛṇu ||7 1 || oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanivāsabhūtasubhagāgolokabhūmau purā, śrīkṛṣṇāt prakaṭībhavan svavanitārdhāṃgaśca kailāsake | svīye dhāmni śivaḥ sadāśivabhidhaḥ saṃrājate vaiṣṇavo, vaikuṇṭhe harisannidhau savanito nṛtyaṃ cakārottamam ||72|| śrīlakṣmyā vidito hyakālagamano vighno vilāse hareḥ, śaptaścāpi manuṣyabhāvaniyataḥ patnyā yutaḥ saṃbhava | śrutvā śrīharireva bhaktamanugo’bhūcchrīṃ vihāyāpi vai, sā lakṣmīrharilabdhilobhamanugā cāste bhavatputrikā ||73 || evaṃ vai śivarūparūpiṇa iha śrīpārvatīsatpaterlakṣmyāścāpi karotu kṛṣṇabhagavān sanmagalaṃ sarvadā | tvatputraśca gaṇādhipaḥ savanito bhadraṃ kriyānmaṃgalaṃ, śrīmatkuṃkumavāpikānivasatirgopālakṛṣṇo’rthaye ||74|| madbhāgyaṃ bahulīkṛtaṃ hi bhavatā datvā sutāṃ śārṅgiṇe, matputrāya narāyaṇāya hariṇe śrībālakṛṣṇāya ha | sampṛktvāpi bṛhaspatiṃ suraguruṃ sampāvitaṃ madgṛhaṃ, tenāpyarpitadānapatramiha vai premṇā mayāṅgīkṛtam ||75 || tatrādiṣṭaśubhottamāvasarake samprāpya kāśīṃ purīṃ, śaṃbho darśanamuttamaṃ hi bhavataḥ prāptye’dya śaṃ śāntidam | evaṃ sarvavidhānavaidhamapi sannirvartya tīrthasthale | dampatyoḥ khalu śāśvataṃ vidhikṛtaṃ saṃlokayiṣye sukham ||76|| yattatrāhamumāpate’mbaravimānairāgamiṣye drutam, madhyāhnottarameva śuklagatṛtīyāyāṃ kuṭumbābjayuk | anye ye ca nṛpāḥ kṣitau kṛtamakhāḥ śrībālakṛṣṇe ratāstatsāhasramapīha vāhimanujaiḥ koṭyarbudaiḥ saṃgatam ||77|| muktā dhāmanivāsino’pyagaṇitā nārāyaṇā īśvarāḥ, siddhā ārṣagaṇāstathā ca pitaro devāstathā mānavāḥ | divyā dehayujo’pi cetanagaṇā bhūtāni tīrthāni vai, devyaḥ sṛṣṭiparasthitā api parārdhordhvāḥ prayāsyantyapi ||78|| kanyāḥ koṭya iha sthitā api tathā brahmapriyā yoṣitaścāyāsyanti bhavatsumandiramanādibrahmayogotsukāḥ | sarvajñe śivarūpiṇi tvayi mayā kiṃ cāntaraṃ gūḍhavad, vaktavyaṃ kuśale suyogini hare vaiśālabhūmisthite ||79|| ityevaṃ samabhipraṇamya ca tathā samprārthya kāśīpatim, patraṃ cedamathārpayāmi gurave satkṛtya ratnāyutaiḥ | nyūnādhikyamathottaraṃ hyaruciraṃ miṣṭaṃ gariṣṭaṃ kaṭu, kṣantavyaṃ mama sarvathā vilasitaṃ yuktātmanā śaṃbhunā ||2.277.80 || ityevaṃ rādhike patrottaraṃ dadau harāya ca | śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇo vai nāradenānumoditaḥ ||8 1 || brahaspatermahāpūjāṃ cakāra ratnakoṭibhiḥ | sadvastraiścandanaiścāpi mauktikairhāratarpaṇaiḥ ||82||| bhojanaiḥ pānasatkārai rañjayāmāsa sadgurum | vimānaṃ pradadau ramyaṃ saṃbhṛtaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||83|| kalpalatānvitaṃ ramyaṃ samāruroha sadguruḥ | pratipaddivase prātaryayau kāśīṃ vihāyasā ||84|| dadau patrottaraṃ patraṃ śaṃbhave mumude haraḥ | vācayāmāsa māṃgalyapatraṃ ca mumude punaḥ ||85 || namaskārādikaṃ cāpi vinayaṃ snehamātmani | śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasya bālakṛṣṇasya vai tathā ||86 || lomaśasya tathānyeṣāṃ kathayāmāsa sadguruḥ | āgamo’tra mahān bhāvī vāhinyāḥ sārvalaukikaḥ ||87|| ubhayoḥ khyātayoḥ satoḥ prādhānyena jagattrayam | āgamiṣyati vai dāne samaye gururabravīt| ||88|| śaṃbhuḥ prasannahṛdayaḥ prāhū guruṃ yathābalam | puṇyapātrasyāṃgaṇe vai bhavet trailokyamāgatam ||89|| yathāyogyaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ sevāṃ lokottarāṃ śubhām | koṭikoṭyarbudābjā me gaṇā loke vasanti ca ||2.277.90|| koṭikoṭyarbudā devyaḥ satīrūpā bhavanti me | saṃkarṣaṇo mahākālo mahārudro’pi rudrakaḥ ||9 1|| haro’haṃ mama rūpāṇi bhavanti koṭiśo’pi ca | mama sākṣāt pitā kṛṣṇo goloko mama sarvathā ||92|| mahāmāyā mama sṛṣṭirhanūmān mama vai sutaḥ | gaṇeśaśceti koṭyabjārbudābjāḥ pārṣadā mama ||93|| sarvaṃ me śubhakṛccāste bhavān devagurustathā | kiṃ nyūnaṃ me vartate’dya sarvaṃ sampannamasti me ||94|| ityuktvā tvāsanasthaṃ taṃ bṛhaspatiṃ prapūjya ca | śaṃkaro bhojayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṇḍapam || 95|| vāditrāṇāṃ ninādām̐śca kārayāmāsa diggatān | dūtān sampreṣayāmāsāmantraṇārthaṃ jagattraye || 96 || kuṃkumapatrikāyuktān śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ | rādhike tvabhavan sarvamaṃgalāni harālaye || 97 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne’māvāsyāyāṃ gopālakṛṣṇālaye trailokyayoṣitāṃ maṃgalagītayo gṛhe gṛhe mahotsavāḥ, bṛhaspateḥ sammānaṃ dānapatrikāvarṇanaṃ taduttaraṃ pragṛhya prapūjitabṛhaspateḥ kāśīṃ pratyāgamanaṃ, trailokye śaṃbhukṛtāmantraṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 277 ||
<2.278> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya maṃgalāni vai | pratipaddivase nāryo jaguḥ prātaḥ śubhāni hi || 1 || vāditrāṇi samastāni tvavādyanta samastataḥ | gṛhe gṛhāṃgaṇe raṃgavallyaḥ prapūritā janaiḥ || 2 || toraṇāni suramyāṇi navapallavabhāñji ca | gṛhadvārṣu pramadābhirnihitāni samastataḥ || 3 || ghṛtadīpāḥ kṛtāścāpi dhvajāḥ patākikā dhṛtāḥ | baddhā vyomapradeśeṣu bāvaṭā raṃgaśobhitāḥ || 4 || kuṃkumavāpikāśobhā samastā dhāmasadṛśī | prajābhiḥ saṃprahṛṣṭābhirvihitā citrayojanaiḥ || |1 || rathyāśca rājamārgāśca gauṇamārgāḥ pratolikāḥ | mārjitāśca jalaiḥ siktā raṃgacitraiśca citritāḥ || 6 || āpaṇāni kṛtānyeva toraṇaiḥ raṃgavallibhiḥ | dadhnāṃkurairnāgavallīpatrairmaṃgalabhāñji ca || 7 || ālayāśca mandirāṇi prāsādāḥ saudhapaktayaḥ | śālā viśālāścārāmāḥ śṛṃgāritā janaiḥ śubhāḥ || 8 || aśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi śṛṃgāritaṃ ca raṃgakaiḥ | tāraṇaiḥ śubhadīpaiśca catvarā vimalīkṛtāḥ || 9 || vitardikā vedikāśca dvāraśākhāḥ sudurgakāḥ | gopurāṇi ca ramyāṇi kalaśaiḥ saptasaṃkhyakaiḥ || 2.278.1 0|| sapatrapallavasūtraphalaiḥ śṛṃgāritāni vai | bālakṛṣṇālayastatra candrakāntādibhiḥ śubhaḥ || 11 || kalpalatāsamārāmaiḥ phalivṛkṣādibhistadā | sūryakāntādimaṇibhiḥ śṛṃgāritaḥ samantataḥ || 1 2|| sahasraikakalaśo yaḥ prāsādaḥ śrīharerhi saḥ | śṛṃgārito’bhito navyaiḥ śobhādravyādibhistadā || 13 || vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāparaṃ vā kiṃ golokaścāparo’pi kim | brahmadhāmāparaṃ vā kiṃ cāmṛtaṃ dhāma vetarat || 14|| svargaṃ vānyat samastaṃ kiṃ tarkitaḥ sa prajājanaiḥ | evaṃvidhāyāṃ puryāṃ vai nāryo narā navāmbarāḥ || 15|| navabhūṣā navaraṃgā navaśṛṃgāraśobhanāḥ | navotsāhā navabalā navarddhayo’bhavam̐stadā || 16|| navabhojanapānāśca navakīrtanagāyanāḥ | navasaṃkalpakodārā navasadguṇaśālinaḥ || 17|| abhavan paśavaścāpi navotsāhāśca pakṣiṇaḥ | dhenavo navadugdhāśca mahiṣyo navatejanāḥ || 18 || vṛṣabhā navavīryāśca gajādyā navakautukāḥ | aśvādyā navaharṣāścābhavan vai pratipaddine || 1 9|| vṛkṣā navaphalāścāpi vallikā navapuṣpikāḥ | śākhāḥ sarvanavarasāḥ sasyāni kaṇiśāni ca || 2.278.20 || madhūni navapuṣṭāni tadābhavan samantataḥ | viprāśca navaharṣā vai sādhavo navabhaktayaḥ || 21 || vidvāṃso navamatayastattvāni nūtanāni ca | taijasāni navatejomanti tadābhavan khalu |||22|| viśeṣatastu lokānāṃ nirmalānyāntarāṇi vai | bhāvodrekādabhavam̐śca śāśvatānandadāni hi || 13|| ityevaṃ rādhike kuṃkumavāpī nūtanā yathā | navayauvanasampannā sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhitā ||24|| lakṣmīrdivyā navā cāyāsyatīti nūtanābhavat | nūtanāyāḥ sapatnyā vai navaharṣopalabdhaye ||25|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya snehabhūtaye | maṇḍapaścākṣaradhāmno divyastatra samāyayau || 26|| neme śrībhagavantaṃ sa neme gopālakṛṣṇakam | natvā ca mātaraṃ muktasvarūpo maṇḍapaḥ sa ca ||27|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasaṃkalpamātrataḥ | divyaṃ muktasvarūpaṃ ca darśayitvā kṣaṇāntare || 28|| prārthayat paramātmānaṃ prasādayitumāgataḥ | yathājñaṃ maṇḍapaṃ ramyaṃ bhavāmyakṣaradhāmagam || 29|| hariḥ prāha tathāstvevaṃ tadarthaṃ vai smṛto bhavān | karotu maṇḍapaṃ ramyaṃ yathākṣare’sti rājate ||2.278.30 || omityājñāṃ samagṛhya rādhike maṇḍapaḥ svayam | mahāmukto maṇḍapātmā māṇḍapaṃ rūpamagrahīt || 31 || rūpadvayaṃ samagṛhya svalpaṃ ca mahadityapi | svalpaṃ rūpaṃ bālakṛṣṇaprāsādāgre sthiraṃ hyabhūt| ||32|| śataikakalaśāḍhyaṃ ca śatastaṃbhasuśobhitam | sāptabhaumaṃ ca parito madhye cāmbaramārgavat ||33| upari madhyakalaśenāmūlyena virājitam | yathā cāndrī kaumudī ca pṛthvyāṃ pūrṇātithau bhavet ||34| tathāsya dhavalā kāntiḥ payonibhā samantataḥ | ākṣare bhūtale tatra prāsaraccāndralokavat || 35|| madhye sūryamaṇiryatra naisargiko virājate | sahasrakiraṇaiḥ saumyairmṛdubhiḥ saṃprakāśate ||36|| vidyunnālāni pārśveṣu pradīpakāntibhāñji ca | dugdhadhāvalyabhāvanti vidyotante’bhitastadā ||37|| maṇayo naddhabhāvāśca śvetā raktāśca karburāḥ | nīlāḥ pītāśca haritāḥ kapīśāścitrabhānavaḥ ||38|| pratikoṇaṃ praṇaddhāste prakāśante hi tārakāḥ | yathā tathā vicitrāśca tatpārśve patravallikāḥ ||39|| oṣadhayaḥ patradīpāḥ prakāśante sthale sthale | stambāḥ kuṇḍasamādhārāḥ kuṇḍāḥ paṭṭīvirājitāḥ ||2.278.40 || paṭṭikā jalavāhinyo guptatejaḥpraṇālikāḥ | guptatejaḥpravāhāśca prakāśante yathāsthalam ||41 || vaṃśāḥ staṃbhāḥ puttalikāḥ kammānikāśca toraṇam | śākhāḥ praśākhā vaṃśādyāḥ prakāśante pravāhakaiḥ ||42|| tejasāṃ nyūnatā nāsti prakāśante’kṣare yathā | eka eva hi mukto’sau maṇḍapātmā yato’sti vai ||43 || tejāṃsi śītabhāvanti coṣṇabhāvanti vai tathā | śītoṣṇabhāprabhāvanti cānuṣṇaśītabhāni ca ||44|| miṣṭāmṛtasparśavanti brahmānandapradāni ca | sarvendriyāṇāmānandapradānyapi bhavanti ca ||45|| ityevaṃ dīpayukte’tra mahātejasvimaṇḍape | staṃbheṣu kadalīrūpeṣvakhaṇḍapatrayogiṣu ||46|| śateṣvapi sāptabhaumasthiteṣu pravibhāgiṣu | saptaraṃgāni divyāni veṣṭitānyambarāṇi vai ||47|| tanmadhye tejasāṃ vāse pravāhe sarvasṛṣṭayaḥ | vilokyante staṃbhamadhye merau yathā surāśrayāḥ ||48|| kvacit staṃbhe hi munayaḥ kvacit siddhā bhavanti ca | kvacittiṣṭhanti muktāśca haryākārā anantaśaḥ ||49|| kvacittiṣṭhantyavatārāḥ kvacittiṣṭhanti pārṣadāḥ | kvacinmuktānikāḥ sādhvyo brahmapriyāḥ kvacit khalu ||2.278.5 0|| kvacitkṛṣṇasya golokaḥ kvacidvaikuṇṭhamityapi | kvaciccāvyākṛtaṃ dhāma kvacitprakāśate’mṛtam ||51 || kvacaddhiraṇmayaṃ dhāma kvacidvairājakaṃ sthalam | kvacidbrāhmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca raudraṃ dhāma prakāśate ||52|| kvacitstaṃbhe satyalokaḥ kvacit pitṛnivāsanam | kvacid devāśca dikpālāḥ kvacidviśvādhināyakāḥ ||53 || kvacitstaṃbhe virājante sūryacandrādayo grahāḥ | kvacittiṣṭhanti vasavaścendrā maharṣayaḥ kvacit ||54|| kvacitstaṃbhe mānavāśca kvacid daityāśca dānavāḥ | kvacitsamudrā nadyaścāraṇyakāni vanāni ca |||55|| parvatāśca kvacitstaṃbhe kvacitpātālavāsinaḥ | jaleśayāḥ kvacitstaṃbhe kvacitsthaleśayā api ||56|| kvacidbileśayāstatra dṛśyante’pi gajādayaḥ | garuḍāḥ śukasārāśca menakāśca mayūrakāḥ ||57|| bhāsā haṃsāścātakāśca dṛśyante devayonayaḥ | apsaraso brahmasaraso’pi kvacicca nartakāḥ ||58|| dṛśyante staṃbhagarbheṣu citrāvaliyuteṣu ca | sṛṣṭitrayaṃ maṇḍape vai nihitaṃ cākṣarātmake ||59|| bhūtale svarṇabhūmau vai rājante divyabhūmikāḥ | kvacijjalaṃ kvacittejaḥ kvacidbhūmirvirājate ||2.278.6 0|| kvacidbhavanti sāmudrāḥ kvacidvanāni santi ca | kvacicca parvatāḥ santi sarāṃsi saritastathā ||6 1 || udyānāni suramyāṇi kvacicca nagarāṇyapi | bhūgarbhe paridṛśyante copari samasattale ||62|| evaṃ kṣīrasamudraśca nārāyaṇastathā prabhuḥ | madhye tu maṇḍape tatra bhūgarbhe dṛśyate hariḥ ||63|| staṃbhamūleṣu sarvatra dṛśyante vāstudevatāḥ | maṇḍape’pi yathāsthānā lokyante kṣitigarbhake ||64|| śākhādevā vilokyante dvāradevā bhavantyapi | toraṇasya tathā sakhyaḥ paryo devyaḥ sraganvitāḥ |||65|| vilokyante citrakammānikādhārāḥ suyauvanāḥ | suveṣāḥ sāmbarabhūṣā divyālokaprakāśitāḥ||66 || madhye dīpapradīpāśca lambante vartulāśritāḥ | pratolyāṃ samarājante devyo hāsyarasānvitāḥ ||67|| ratijātistriyaḥ sarvā vividhāścetanā iva | virājante vartulāgre darśanādhārasaṃsthitāḥ ||68|| gāyakāścāpi gāndharvā vidyante yugalātmakāḥ | dhvajābhiḥ samprakāśante maṇḍapāntarabhūmikāḥ ||69 || koṇe koṇe kalaśāśca sauvarṇāḥ sapta sapta ca | ekasūtre sthāpitāśca śobhante sūryabhāsvarāḥ ||2.278.70 || phalaśākhāśca lambante staṃbhastambāśrayāstathā | rajjvastatra praṇaddhāśca maṇimauktikmālikāḥ ||7 1 || vaicitryaṃ dṛśyate cātra maṇḍape darśane’bhitaḥ | ekataḥ koṭilakṣmyaścaikato vai koṭirādhikāḥ ||72|| ekataśca sarasvatyaścaikataḥ koṭidurgikāḥ | dṛśyante sāyudhāḥ sarvāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ||73 || toraṇoparibhūmīnāṃ sarvasṛṣṭimanoharāḥ | tadūrdhvaṃ pārṣadāścāpi gopāścāpi svarūpiṇaḥ ||74|| gāndharvāścāpi sakalā gaṇāśca śāṃkarāstathā | āyudhāni ca divyāni yāni sṛṣṭitraye’pi tu ||75|| vidyante tāni sarvāṇi tadūrdhve saṃsthitāni vai | tadūrdhve dhruvabhāgāśca sūryadvādaśakānvitāḥ ||76|| tejo’mbarasamṛddhāśca dyotante vṛttatānikāḥ | catuṣkikāstathā ramyā maṇḍovarāḥ samujjvalāḥ ||77|| sopānāni samastāni svarṇarūpyāstarāṇi ca | bhittikāḥ paṭavastrāṇāṃ ratnānāṃ svarṇapatriṇām ||78|| vitānāni samastāni dyotante kauśikāni ca | yathā yathordhvabhūmau ca divyaṃ vaikuṇṭhamanyakam ||79|| vikāsitaṃ mahodyāne rāsaramaṇaśobhitam | gajasiṃhagaruḍādivāhanāni dyuvāsinām ||2.278.80|| yāni śreṣṭhāni ramyāṇi śubhāni tatra santi ca | tāni sarvāṇyūrdhvabhūmau nihitāni kramādiva ||8 1 || kalpavallīkalpavṛkṣakalpadīpānvitaḥ śubhaḥ | kalpatejoviśiṣṭaśca kalpabhūphaladastathā ||82|| maṇḍapo hyabhavat so’yaṃ kalpamauktikamālyavān | kalpavāyusukhasparśaḥ kalpagandhavirājitaḥ ||83|| kalpāmbarapradaḥ kalpatāmbūlavallikānvitaḥ | kalpapānapradātā ca kalpasvalpavimānakaḥ ||84|| kalpaśayyāstaraṇaśca kalpaparyaṃkarājitaḥ | kalpagendukakaśipupradaḥ kalpopasādhanaḥ || 85 | | kalpabṛsīkalpamṛdvāsanasiṃhāsanānvitaḥ | kalpapīṭhasabhāśobhaḥ kalpapaṭṭikamaṇḍitaḥ | | 86 || kalpaśavaraṇairvakrairakhaṇḍāmbarakairyutaḥ | kācatoraṇayuktaśca maṇiratnāditoraṇaḥ | | 87 || maṇiratnānvitakapāṭāḍhyapeṭikabhittikaḥ | preṃkhādolādisaṃśobhatpārśvabhūmivirājitaḥ ||88 | | vidyuddarśanayantraiśca vidyudvāgyantrakairyutaḥ | vidyucchrāvaṇayantraiśca cāndrasparśasuyantravān | |89 || kalpavedhe kṛtakalpaṃ cānukalpavivartanaḥ | kālakalpanayantrāḍhyaḥ sarvajñatvapravartakaḥ || 2.278.90 | | piṇḍe brahmāṇḍake cakrottameṣu yogakalpavān | kalpayantrātmatūryādisvaragītiprakāśanaḥ || 91 || piṇḍabrahmāṇḍasarvasvadarśakayantraśobhitaḥ | kāmatṛptipradasparśottamacamatkṛtipradaḥ || 92 || smṛtamātrasya ceṣṭasya kṣaṇamātreṇa sampradaḥ | prācyasṛṣṭyāścaryayutaḥ saccidānandacetanaḥ || 9,3 || śāśvatānandadātā ca ghaṇṭaśaṃkhamṛdaṃgavān | bhogyajātahradayukto’mṛtavārdhisusaṃbhṛtaḥ || 94|| sarvasṛṣṭisthitā yā yā yādṛśyāḥ pramadottamāḥ | tāstāḥ sarvā bhinnarūpāśrayāstatra vidhāpitāḥ || 95 || koṇe māṇikyanāmā ca staṃbho yatra suvarṇajaḥ | raktaraṃgābhisaṃśobhaścatuḥkarṇasumastakaḥ || 96 || pūjitaḥ sindūrapuṣpairakṣataiḥ kamalādibhiḥ | tathā vai cāndanapaṭṭikāyāṃ cākṣatamaṇḍale || 97 || vārdhinīkalaśaḥ svarṇaḥ sajalaḥ pūjikāyutaḥ | kaṇṭhasūtrāmbaraśobho madhye jalena pūritaḥ || 98 || cūtāśokasucampakanāgavallīdalānvitaḥ | saśrīphalaḥ saratnaśca sadhātuḥ śobhanaḥ kṛtaḥ || 99 || gaṇeśena suvarṇena pūjitena surājitaḥ | siddhibuddhisahitena śubhalābhānvitena ca || 2.278.100 | | ityevaṃ maṇḍapastatra divyamukto babhūva ha | loke bhedena yāḥ śobhāstatra tena kṛtāḥ svayam || 101 || rādhike varṇanaṃ yasya kartuṃ naiva praśakyate | sarvamāṃgalikāṃkurākṣatakuṃkumapātravān || 102 || pūjāsatkāravastūpasampatsāmagrikābhṛtaḥ | dedīpyamāno hyabhavad bālakṛṣṇālayāgragaḥ || 103 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mārgaśuklapratipadi prātarmaṃgalāni, kuṃkumavāpīsarasoḥ śobhā, divyāṃgaṇamaṇḍapaśobhetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 278 ||
<2.279> śrīrādhikovāca māṇikyastaṃbha evātra maṇḍape sthāpyate katham | kalaśasthāpanaṃ tatra kimarthaṃ vai vidhīyate ||1 gaṇeśasthāpanaṃ cāpi mātṛkāsthāpanaṃ tathā | vāstusthāpanamevāpi viṣṇoḥ sthāpanamityapi ||2 kuladevasthāpanaṃ ca kathaṃ kṛṣṇa vidhīyate | kiṃ phalaṃ sthāpane proktamasthāpane kimapriyam || 3|| tatsarvaṃ vada me kṛṣṇa saṃsārisukhakāraṇam | yajjñātvā cottare lokāḥ kariṣyanti vidhānataḥ || 4 || sarṣayo bhagavadbhaktāḥ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam | sthāpayanti sadevaṃ ca kimatra kāraṇaṃ prabho || 5 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu rādhe pravakṣyāmi dampatīhitakṛtsukham | gṛhasthasya viśeṣeṇa patyustatra viśeṣataḥ | | 6 || maṇisvarṇādisampatkṛdgṛhasthasya gṛhe sadā | pūjitaścaindradaivatyaścāgnidaivatya ityapi | | 7 || dhenudaivatya evāpi māṇikyastaṃbha ucyate | maṇḍape sthāpitaḥ so’yamindrāgnidhenudaivataḥ || 8 || gṛhasthasya sadā cendrasamaṃ kuryāt samṛddhibhiḥ | agnitulyaṃ projjvalaṃ ca kuṭumbaṃ nityadā bhavet || 9 || dhenuḥ sadā rasān dadyād gṛhaṃ vai rasavad bhavet | indrasya smṛddhayaḥ santu gṛhasthasya gṛhe sadā || 2.279.10 || vahneḥ samṛddhayaḥ santu gṛhasthasya gṛhe sadā | dhenūnāṃ smṛddhayaḥ santu gṛhasthasya gṛhe sadā || 11 || ityevaṃ devatāstatra sthitā āśīrdadatyapi | anyathā trividhaṃ cāsya dāridryamupajāyate || 12 | | asmṛddhaṃ cāpacanaṃ cārasaṃ gṛhaṃ bhavet khalu | sarvaṃ duḥkhamayaṃ syādvai māṇikyāpūjanādiha || 13 || yatra māṇikyavāso vai tatra vāso hareḥ sadā | yatra harernivāsaśca tatra lakṣmīnivāsanam || 1 4|| yatra lakṣmyā nivāsaśca tatra smṛddhinivāsanam | tasmānmāṇikyayūpaṃ vai pūjayanti purāvidaḥ || 15|| pārthivā bahavo doṣā nidrālasyagurutvakam | jaḍatā śuṣkatā caite līyante tasya pūjanāt || 16 || vināśo vidhavātvaṃ ca vidhuratvaṃ ca rugṇatā | anapatyatvamevaite līyante tasya pūjanāt || 17|| pravāsitvamanāśrayatā cāpi gṛhaśūnyatā | phalivṛkṣādiśūnyatvaṃ līyante tasya pūjanāt || 18|| dampatyoḥ premaśūnyatvaṃ varālaye’manaskatā | vadhvāḥ saubhāgyaśūnyatvaṃ līyante tasya pūjanāt || 19 || bhūmāvabhāgitā vadhvā gṛhe cābhāgitā tathā | kule cābhāgitā vadhvā naśyatyevāsya pūjanāt || 2.279.20 || rākṣasānāmṛṇaṃ cāpi kumārīdevatāṛṇam | pitrādīnāmṛṇaṃ yāti māṇikyasya prapūjanāt || 21 || indrāgnidhenusākṣyaṃ vai paralokādisādhakam | gārhasthyaṃ sarvakarmāpi jāyate phaladaṃ tataḥ || 22|| ityevaṃ rādhike bodhyaṃ phalaṃ māṇikyapūjanāt | śṛṇu tvaṃ kalaśasyāpi pūjanasya phalaṃ śubham || 23 || kalaśe jalamadhye vai varuṇaḥ saṃvirājate | tīrthāni tatra cāyānti samudrasaritastathā || 24||| sarāṃsi devatāścāpi kalaśe’jaharīśvarāḥ | tatsādhyaṃ ca vivāhasya karma śāntisukhapradam ||25 || jalānnadāyakaṃ sarvarasānāṃ ca pradāyakam | śārīraṃ kāmakarmāpi pāvanaṃ tasya pūjanāt| ||26 || putrasampatpradaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhaṃ sadā ca pāvanam | naisargī yāpyaśuddhiśca nārīdehe nare’pi ca ||27|| varuṇasya jalaiḥ seke sā ca sarvā nivartata | tīrtharūpo bhavettena patistīrthaphalapradaḥ ||28|| tīrtharūpā bhavetpatnī sarvatīrthaphalapradā | yugala tīrthamevāstītyāha varuṇadevatā || 29 || yatra vai vāruṇaṃ sthānaṃ tatra ṛṇaṃ na jāyate | sarve rasāḥ sarvagandhāstatra bhavanti vāruṇāḥ ||2.279.3 0|| brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ nivāsastadgṛhe bhavet| | yadgṛhe kalaśasthānaṃ kalaśo’sya payobhṛtaḥ ||3 1 || payasā ca ghṛtenāpi navanītena sarvadā | daghnā takreṇa somenāmṛtena saṃbhṛto vaset| ||32|| evaṃ kalaśajātīyā dhātavo’sya vasanti ca | svarṇarūpyāṇi ratnāni saratnakalaśārhaṇāt ||3 3 || kanyāḥ kalaśamāṃgalyāścāsya snuṣāśritaṃ gṛham | bhaved vaṃśasmṛddhiyuktaṃ svarṇakalaśaśobhitam ||34|| evaṃ vai rādhike proktaṃ kalaśārhāphalaṃ mayā | asthāpane kalaśasya proktaṃ sarvaṃ na jāyate || 35 || viparītaṃ bhavet sarvaṃ duḥkhadāridryavardhanam | gaṇeśārhāphalaṃ vacmi kṛṣṇo’haṃ vai gaṇādhipaḥ || 36 || bhagavān sampadāṃ dātā sarvakāmaprapūrakaḥ | sarvasampatpradaścāpi siddhiṛddhipradastathā || 37|| śubhalābhapradaścāpi sarvavighnavināśakaḥ | sarvadā rakṣakaścāpi bhavāmi mama pūjanāt| || 38|| laḍaḍukādikamiṣṭānnaṃ mama pūjākṛto bhavet | svarṇarūpyagṛhāṇyasya jāyante pūjakasya me || 39 || hastyaśvarathabāhulyaṃ vāhanāḍhyaṃ gṛhaṃ bhavet | pītāmbarādisaṃśobho veṣo’sya sarvadā bhavet ||2.279.40 || gaṇeśasya mukhaṃ śuṇḍhānvitaṃ paśudhanapradam | udaraṃ strīsamaṃ bhojyapradaṃ putrādisampradam ||41 || kaṭyadhaḥ kāmanābhāgaḥ sarvakāmaprapūrakaḥ | duṣṭaprārabdhanāśaśca bhaved gaṇeśapūjanāt ||42|| upadravo bhavennāsya gaṇānāṃ duṣṭayoginām | ityevaṃ rādhike te’tra proktaṃ gaṇeśapūjanāt | |43 || phalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kṛṣṇarūpo gaṇeśo’haṃ gṛhe sthitaḥ | tatra sarvatra bhuktiṃ ca muktiṃ ca labhate gṛhī ||44|| mātṛkāsthāpanaṃ cāpi rādhike śṛṇu satphalam | śaṃkarasya tu yoginyaścatuṣṣaṣṭiprasaṃkhyakāḥ ||45 || mātṛkāśca tathānyāśca ṛṣipatnyaśca mātṛkāḥ | tathānyā jaladevyaśca caṇḍyādyāśca tathāparāḥ ||46 || bālagrahasvarūpiṇyaḥ koṭarādyāśca mātṛkāḥ | ṣaṣṭhīdevīprabhṛtikā rākṣasyo’pi ca mātṛkāḥ ||47|| ityevaṃ bahudhā santi pūjitāḥ sukhadāḥ sadā | apūjitā gṛhaṃ bālaṃ garbhaṃ cādanti kūpitāḥ ||48 || vadhūṃ varaṃ ca vā ruṣṭā bhakṣayanti kvacid gṛhe | tasmāt pūjyā bhavantyetāstuṣṭāḥ smṛddhiṃ dadatyapi ||49 || jalato vahnitaścāpi vārayantyāgataṃ bhayam | evaṃ sadā pūjanīyāḥ kuladevyo bhavanti ca ||2.279.50 || kulavṛddhyarthamevāpi sampadvṛddhyarthamityapi | vināśaparihārārthe pūjyante kuladevikāḥ ||5 1 || vāstuḥ puruṣaḥ sampūjya sadā pṛthvīpratuṣṭaye | gṛhakārye maṇḍape ca vedikāyāṃ ca kuṇḍake |||52 || jantunāśajapāpānāṃ nāśakaṃ vāstupūjanam | digdoṣāḥ pṛthivīdoṣā bhūtadoṣāḥ samantataḥ ||53 || nāśyante sarvathā rādhe pūjitena hi vāstunā | vāsaprado bhavatyeva dampatyościrameva saḥ || 54|| bhūmau bhāgyaṃ bhaved vadhvā varasyāpi dhruvābhidham | sarvakarmārpaṇaṃ deve vāstau kṛte bhavecchubham ||55|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ te’tra rogaghnaṃ vāstupūjanam | viṣṇoḥ sthāpanamevāpi lakṣmīdaṃ maṃgalapradam ||56|| yatra viṣṇustatra cāste smṛddhiḥ sarvasukhapradā | pūjito vandito viṣṇuḥ kuryād vaikuṇṭhavad gṛham ||57|| bhaktiṃ dadyāt kule tasya dampatyoḥ śreyasaṃ tathā | yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ sattvabhāvaṃ dadyād viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ ||58|| sudarśanena cakreṇa rakṣāṃ kuryāt prapūjitaḥ | dharmaṃ dadyāttathā ṭadyājjñānaṃ vivekasaṃbhṛtam ||59||| āntaraṃ divyamevāpi netraṃ dadyāt supūjitaḥ | ārādhitaśca nirvāṇaṃ dadyāt sarvasamarpaṇāt ||2.279.6 0|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ rādhe phalaṃ devādipūjane | maṇḍapasya phalaṃ cāpi śṛṇu rādhe śubhāspadam ||66 1 || maṇḍapaścāśrayaḥ prokto maṇḍapo devatālayaḥ | sarvasṛṣṭinivāsaśca maṇḍapaḥ parigīyate ||62|| paṭamaṇḍapa evāpi dhātumaṇḍapa ityapi | puṇyamaṇḍapa evāpi kāṣṭhamaṇḍapa ityapi ||6 3 || maṇimaṇḍapa evāpi gṛhamaṇḍapa ityapi | vṛkṣamaṇḍapa evāpi hyudyānamaṇḍapastathā ||64|| kāṇḍamaṇḍapa evāpi pārthivo maṇḍapastathā | kalpamaṇḍapa evāpi bhavanti maṇḍapā hi te ||6 5 || tatra sarvatra devādyā bhūtāni yāni yāni ca | guṇatrayasthitānyeva samāyānti samutsave ||66 || tasmānmaṇḍapapūjā vai sarvapūjāphalapradā | sarve tuṣṭā bhavantyeva devādyā maṇḍapārhaṇāt ||67|| mandiraṃ subhagaṃ syācca svargaṃ ca subhagaṃ milet | sarvasmṛddhirmileccāpi maṇḍapasya prapūjanāt ||68|| svāgate ca prasatkāre maṇḍapaścāgrato mataḥ | manaḥśāntikaraścāpi śāntiṃ cāsmai prayacchati ||69|| maṇḍ takrāmṛtaṃ cāpi dadāti sarvadā śubhaḥ | dadhimaṇḍaṃ dadātyeṣo havanaṃ kārayatyapi ||2.279.70|| tanmūlikāṃ parāṃ smṛddhiṃ karoti maṇḍapaḥ sadā | havan sarvadevānāṃ tṛptidaṃ sukhadaṃ matam ||71 || gṛhasthasya sadā rādhe havanaṃ pāpanāśanam | sarvabhogapradaṃ proktaṃ sarvāyuṣyavivardhanam ||72|| sarvārogyapradaṃ sarvaṛṇamocanakaṃ matam | sarvatobhadramevāpi sthāpyate maṇḍape śubham ||73 || tatphalaṃ grahakṛtpīḍānāśanaṃ pāpanāśanam | svarṇarūpyopakaraṇapradaṃ gṛhapradaṃ tathā ||74|| smṛddhipradaṃ paraṃ puṇyaṃ śayyopaskarasampradam | pātrabhūṣāpradaṃ cāpi chatracāmarasampradam ||75|| rājyarddhirājyasattādisampradaṃ bhadradaṃ tathā | śakunānāṃ mahaccaitacchakunaṃ bhadramaṇḍalam ||76|| puṇyadānāṃ paramaṃ ca puṇyakṛd bhadramaṇḍalam | svargāṇāṃ paramaṃ svargapradaṃ vai bhadramaṇḍalam ||77|| mokṣasyāpi ca bhakteśca dharmasyāpyadhvarasya ca | iṣṭāpūrtasya sarvasya vṛkṣāropasya vai tathā ||78|| kanyādānasya ca tathā kumāradānakasya ca | sarvadharmasya puṇyānāṃ pradaṃ vai bhadramaṇḍalam ||79|| yogānāṃ puṇyadaṃ cāpi sevānāṃ puṇyadaṃ tathā | paropakārakāryāṇāṃ puṇyadaṃ bhadramaṇḍalam ||2.279.80|| bhadraṃ paśyet sadā kanyā bhadraṃ paśyet sadā patiḥ | bhadraṃ paśyet kuṭumbaṃ ca bhadramaṇḍalapūjanāt ||81 || saubhāgyaṃ labhate kanyā gṛhitvaṃ labhate naraḥ | patiputravatī sādhvī bhaved bhadraprapūjanāt ||82|| viyogo na bhavet patnyāḥ patyuśca bhadrapūjanāt | vighnānāṃ vārakaṃ tvetat sampadāṃ ca prapūrakam ||83|| yatra vai pūjyate kṛṣṇaḥ pūjyante yatra devatāḥ | ṛṣayaḥ pārṣadāścāpyavatārāśca grahādayaḥ ||84|| dikpālā yatra pūjyante gṛhapālāstathāpare | īśvarā īśvarāṇyaśca pūjyante śāradādikāḥ ||85|| ekādaśyaḥ prapūjyante rādhādyāśca suśaktayaḥ | pūjyante devavaṃśāśca bhadradaṃ bhadramaṇḍalam ||86|| tasmādvai rādhike tatra maṇḍape bhadramaṇḍalam | pūjanīyaṃ vidhānena pūjanīyo haristathā ||87|| yatra kvāpi kriyāyoge mahotsave sukhotsave | vivāhe varayānādau kanyādāne satīsthale ||88|| brahmādāne mantradāne dīkṣādāne vratādiṣu | mahādāne janmadine pūjanīyo hariḥ sadā ||89|| parameśasya pūjā vai sarvapūjāphalapradā | sarvasaṃkalpasiddhīnāṃ pradā kāmaprapūrikā ||2.279.90|| sarvayajñaphaladā ca sarvakartavyapūrikā | sarvārambhaphalāḍhyā ca pūjādau śrīhareḥ sadā ||9 1|| lakṣmīpūjā tathā cādau kāryārambhe sukhapradā | sampatpradā bhavatyeṣā śāntisaubhāgyadā tathā ||92|| alakṣmīnāśinī cāpi duḥkhadāridryanāśinī | kṛpaṇatvasya vai nāśo bhavellakṣmīprapūjanāt ||93 || kanyāratnaṃ vararatnaṃ dhanaratnāni yāni ca | nirvighnāni bhaveyuśca lakṣmyāścādau prapūjanāt ||94|| ityevaṃ rādhike proktaṃ phalaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā yataḥ | sukhasampad bhavedeva yatra kvāpyapi pūjanāt ||95|| prāyo lokā bhavantyeva śārīrasukhavāsanāḥ | teṣāmuktaprapūjābhiḥ sukhasampad vivardhate ||96|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi phalādhyāyasya tatphalam | yatphalaṃ pūjanāccāpi jāyate dānatastathā ||97|| kanyādānasamaṃ dānaṃ trailokye naiva vidyate | yadādhāraḥ sarvadharmo vaṃśavistāra ityapi ||98|| yadādhāraṃ jagat sarvaṃ sṛṣṭiḥ sarvā yadāśritā | yadvinā pralayaḥ prokto yadvinā śūnyatā matā ||99|| indratvaṃ yadvinā nāsti cātmanāṃ yoṣitaṃ vinā |
