| koṭikanyāyutā cāpi saubhāgyapramadānvitā || 1 1|| gāyikābhiḥ samāyuktā vāditranādarañjitā | svarṇakalaśamūrdhābhirnārībhirveṣṭitā satī || 12|| pañcagavyādiyuktābhiḥ kanyābhirveṣṭitā hyapi | pūjāsāmagrikāsthālayuktābhiḥ saha śobhanā || 13|| vahnyujjvalāṃśukābhiśca saubhāgyābhiśca vardhitā | prathamaṃ sā yayau durgāṃ pupūja parameśvarīm || 14|| pañcāmṛtaiścandanādyaiḥ payobhistīrthavāribhiḥ | kuṃkumākṣatakastūrīkaisaradravadravyakaiḥ || 16|| sugandhipuṣpahārādyairnaivedyaiḥ pāyasādibhiḥ | miṣṭānnairjalapānādyaistāmbūlakaiḥ suvarṇakaiḥ || 16|| dakṣiṇābhiśca pātraiśca nīrājanaiḥ stavaistathā | pradakṣiṇairnamaskāraiḥ kṣamāparādhanārthanaiḥ || 17|| pupūja durgāṃ ca tataḥ śāṭīṃ ca kañcukīṃ tathā | ghargharīṃ naktakaṃ prārpya nupūre cormikāstathā || 18|| śṛṃkhale raśanāṃ cāpi svarṇahārān maṇīn śubhān | kaṭake valaye cāṅgulīyakāni ca padmakam || 19|| tantikāṃ natthikāṃ svarṇakuṇḍale patrikāṃ tathā | candrakaṃ ca prakoṣṭhayorvalaye bhūṣaṇānyapi ||2.287.20|| samastāni dadau durgādevyai provāca vai tataḥ | mātarme bhagavadyoge prodvāhe syādavighnatā || 21 || draṣṭavyāhaṃ tvayā durge sarvadā yāmi yatra vai | durgāpi rādhike tatra vihasyāha tathāstviti ||22|| evaṃ durgāṃ prapūjyaiva prāpya prāsādikaṃ phalam | yayau śrīhanumantaṃ sā tapo’rthaṃ tvāśrayapradam ||23|| gatvā natvā vāyuputraṃ śāṃkaraṃ bhrātaraṃ suram | pañcāmṛtaṃ jalaṃ datvā candanaṃ cārkamālikām || 24|| kuṃkumaṃ cākṣatān svarṇamālāṃ sindūrakaṃ tathā | tailaṃ kṣāndhisāraṃ ca bhūṣāmbarāṇi cāpi vai ||25|| śarkarāṃ vaṭakān datvā miṣṭānnāni śubhāni ca | jalapānaṃ mukhaśuddhiṃ phalaṃ datvā ca dakṣiṇām ||26||| nīrājanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā stavanaṃ ca pradakṣiṇam | kṣamāmayācata lakṣmīstapaḥsiddhisahāyaka || 27|| bhrātaḥ rakṣa sadā māṃ tvaṃ bhagavadyogakāraka | nirvighno me suyogaḥ syād bālakṛṣṇena śārṅgiṇā ||28|| jagannāthena nāthena sukhyahaṃ syāṃ tathā kuru | ityabhyarthita evāsau hanūmānāha vai svasaḥ ||29|| tathāstviti sadā saubhāgyavatī bhava duḥkhahe | atha natvā prasādaṃ ca gṛhītvā svasakhīyutā ||2.287.3 0 || samāyayau hi viśveśaṃ pitaraṃ mandirasthitam | viśveśvaraṃ subahudhā payasā madhunā tathā ||3 1|| dadhnā ghṛtena ca śarkarayā tīrthajalena ca | snāpayitvā gandhasāraḥ sampūjyārpya nivedanam |||32||| ārārtrikaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kṣamāṃ kṛpāmayācata | nirvighnatāṃ maṃgale cāyācatāpi tathāstviti ||3 3|| viśveśvaraḥ pitā prāha yayau tato’nnapūrṇikām | prapūjya mātaraṃ tathā prārpya śṛṃgārakaṃ tathā ||34|| nivedanaṃ dadau cāpi nīrājanaṃ vyadhāttataḥ | annapūrṇāṃ cakārāsyā bhāle sākṣatacandrakam ||35|| akhaṇḍasaubhāgyavatī śāśvatajīvanī bhava | āśīrvādaṃ dadau cātha kanyā natvā gaṇeśakam ||36|| dūrvāsindūralaḍḍūbhiḥ prapūjya tu sarasvatīm | gaṃgāṃ yayau paṃcagaṃgāṃ dharmaṃ devaṃ pupūja ca ||37|| natvā datvā ca dānāni svarṇarūpyamayāni hi | maṇimāṇikyahārām̐śca ratnāni mauktikāni ca || 38|| āśīrvādān samagṛhya prajānāṃ ca tato gṛham | nijālayaṃ prāyayau ca natvā śivapuraṃ satī || 39|| madhyāhne tvatha sarvābhyaḥ sakhībhyo bhojanaṃ dadau | lakṣmīścakre sakhībhyaśca pariveṣaṇamutsukā ||2.287.40|| himajānagarāvāsamahīmānastriyastadā | bubhujuḥ koṭiśaḥ paṃktau miṣṭānnāni samantataḥ ||41|| ābālavṛddhā nāryo vai tṛptā jātā hi bhojanaiḥ | nāryaśca śivapuragā mahīmānastriyastathā ||42|| bubhujurbhojanānyeva samastāḥ kanyakādikāḥ | tato narāśca bubhujuḥ pattanobhayavāsinaḥ ||43|| śivarājagṛhasthāśca kāśyāścāpi prajājanāḥ | bubhujuḥ koṭyarbudābjā īśā devāśca mānavāḥ ||44|| meśubhān mohanasthālān māṣalaḍḍūn sumauktikān | cūrṇalaḍḍūn dugdhapākān pāyasān kṣīrapolikāḥ ||45|| miṣṭapolīḥ pūrikāśca sūtrapheṇīṃ ca barphikām | dugdhasārāṃ biraṃjaṃ ca śaṣkulīṃ khājakān baṭīḥ ||46 || apūpān pūpasaṃyāvān bindulaḍaḍūn prabharjikān | śrīkhaṇḍān śatachidrām̐śca jāmbūkān ghevarām̐stathā ||47 || piṇḍakān granthakām̐ścāpi kalikā ghurghurām̐stathā | vaṭān phullavaṭīścāpi śarkarāktā badāmikāḥ || 48 || caṇakām̐staṇḍulām̐ścāpi bharjitān pācitānapi | sūpaudanaṃ ca kvathikāḥ śākāni vividhāni ca ||49 || bhājāśca vividhāścāpi sudhāścāmṛtakāni ca | takrāṇi peyadravyāṇi cośyāni satphalāni ca ||2.287.5 0 || rasān lehyān bhakṣyakaṇānāranālāni cāpi ha | parpaṭān caṭanīścāpi kṣārikāḥ saṃskṛtānapi ||5 1 || miṣṭaphalāni ca tathā cārdrabījāni yāni ca | śimbikāśca tathā vallān gundrapākādikām̐stathā || 52 || kandapākān vicitrām̐śca phalapākān gariṣṭakān | rājikārāddhamevāpi phalacūrṇāni yāni ca ||53 || vanyān kandān kṛṣikandān cākṛṣṭapacyakauṣadhīḥ | kalpapādapasañjātān bhakṣyabhojyān pramiṣṭakān ||54 || bubhujuśca papuścāpi pīyūṣāṇi viśeṣataḥ | tattallokīyabhojyāni tebhyo tebhyo dadau haraḥ || 55|| tattajjātīyapeyāni tebhyo tebhyo dadau haraḥ | tāmcūlakāni ramyāṇi svādvantyānanaśodhikāḥ ||56 || vāṭikāśca dadau śrīmān śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ | bubhujuśca mahīmānāstato’tithijanā api ||57|| bhikṣukāśca dīnajanā anāthā narayoṣitaḥ | karmacārāstathā bhṛtyā dāsā dāsyo’nugānugāḥ || 58|| pārṣadā dvārapālāśca tathaiva pariveṣakāḥ | rakṣakā darśakāścāpi bubhujurhṛṣṭamānasāḥ | |59 || jaḍāśca cetanāścāpi īśā devāśca mānavāḥ | sṛṣṭitrayanivāsāśca mahīmānāśca ye’tra ca ||2.287.6 0 || sarve te pūrṇatṛptā vai jātā bhojanasattamaiḥ | sarve viśrāntimāpuśca mahīmānāstataḥ kṣaṇam || 61 || atha śrībālakṛṣṇo’sau jñātuṃ dārḍhya śivasya tu | bhūtvā śrīkṛṣṇarūpo’sau śiveśvaraḥ yayau drutam ||6 2|| rahasye śivadevaṃ tu gatvā prāha śṛṇu priya | putraḥ yogyaṃ ca vāyogyaṃ kathayāmīha me śṛṇu || 63 || bhavān jānātu yaṃ kaṃ vā jānāmyenaṃ vadāmi ca | patnīvratasya putro’yaṃ vipro vai bhikṣuko’sti hi ||64|| bālakṛṣṇo’sti vai nāmnā bālaśo dīnajanmavān | bhikṣukāya sutā naiva deyā rājñā kathaṃcana ||65|| videśasthāya tatrāpi naiva deyā kathaṃcana | jātyā samena kanyāyā pradānaṃ śobhate sukhaḥ ||66|| vijātinā tu loke’tra duḥkhaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ | anyaccāpi śarīreṇa kṛṣṇo’yaṃ dṛśyate’balaḥ ||67|| dhavalāyāstava putrā yaugalye śobhate’pi na | tathānyatte kathayāmi purāṇo’yaṃ vilokyate ||68|| kanyeyaṃ komalā svalpavarṣīyā dīyate katham | tathānyaccāpi rājendra kumārāya kumārikā ||69|| deyā cet sukhamicchethāḥ kanyāyāḥ śāśvataṃ tadā | bālakṛṣṇo’tra vai koṭivadhūbhiḥ saha cāgataḥ || 2.287.70|| tatreyaṃ kiyatī bālā gaṇanāyāṃ bhaviṣyati | sapatnīnāṃ kalahastu viṣād vahnestu duḥsahaḥ ||71 || śṛṇu tvanyattathā cāsya sarvabhakṣitvamasti hi | bhuṃkte sarvapradattaṃ ca hyekadharmo’sya nāstyāpi ||72||| amāyī cāpi tu sadā nirguṇo’yaṃ pravidyate | kiṃ cāyaṃ vartate nityaṃ munivṛttiparāyaṇaḥ ||73||| rantuṃ naivāpi jānāti kāmanāvarjito’sti ca | māyāmāro vidyate’sau māyāṃ kartuṃ na vetyasau ||74|| paśya gopālakarmāsya pitā gopālasadṛśaḥ | gopālakṛpṇanāmāsti bhinnakarmasamāśritaḥ ||75|| kṣatriyeṇa na viprāya bhinnakarmakṛte sutā | deyeti sarvathā budhvā yatheṣṭaṃ te tathā kuru ||76|| hatyuktvā virarāmāsau śrīkṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇakaḥ | viśveśvastu pitaraṃ natvā prāha vicārya vai ||77|| pitaḥ putryā bhālarekhā sañcitaṃ ca tathā purā | vidyate viprarūpeṇa sākaṃ tatra pradānakam ||78|| patnīvrato mahāviṣṇuḥ svayaṃ pṛthvyāṃ hi vartate | jānāmi yogadṛṣṭyaiva tatputraṃ puruṣottamam ||79|| sadābhikṣākaraścāyaṃ bhaktānāṃ snehaśālinām | parabrahma svayaṃ cāste kathaṃ deyā na putrikā ||2.287.80|| dīnārthaṃ janmavānāste bālināṃ śaṃprado hariḥ | bālātmanāṃ nirmalānāṃ kṛṣiṃ mokṣaṃ karoti saḥ ||81 || bālakṛṣṇo hariścāste’kṣaradhāmādhipaḥ prabhuḥ | rājñā mayā mahārājñe bhikṣukāya tu śārṅgiṇe ||82|| pradātavyā sutā tatra yaśolābhodayo’sti hi | videśo’syākṣaraṃ brahma tasmai deyā kathaṃ na vai ||83|| jātyā samā mama putrī brahmaṇā brāhmaṇī tviyam | jātirna dehajā kvāpi guṇajā vidyate sadā ||84|| brāhmī lakṣmīrmama kanyā brahmaṇā saha yujyate | kṛṣṇo’yaṃ sārthakaścāste pāpasaṃkarṣaṇāt tathā ||85|| svadhāmanayanāccāpi kṛṣṇo’yaṃ ca yathā bhavān | purāṇo’yaṃ tu puruṣaḥ puruṣottamasaṃjñakaḥ ||86|| purāṇī me kanyakā nārāyaṇī puruṣottamī | puruṣottamasaṃjñasya tanvaḥ sarvāḥ prajā matāḥ ||87|| vadhvaḥ sarvā harestāśca samarthasya na dūṣaṇam | bāleyaṃ dṛśyate tvadya sugrāhyā tena śārṅgiṇā ||88|| sarvāsāmagragaṇyā ca gaṇanā sā mahottamā | sāpatnyaṃ nāsti kṛṣṇāgre rāgadveṣaharo hi saḥ ||89|| sarvabhakṣitvamevāsya parātmano hi yujyate | bhūṣaṇaṃ dharmadharturvai sarvadharmātmanaḥ prabhoḥ ||2.287.90|| māyā vai bandhadā yatra nāsti santi na tadguṇāḥ | sādhuvartana evāsau sarvakarmaphalapradaḥ ||9 1 || nyāyavartana evāsau vartate cāpyahiṃsakaḥ | munireva sadā cāste vedāḥ śvāsāstathāsya ha ||92|| gāyanti suguṇān śaśvat maunaṃ cāsyaiva bhūṣaṇam | apūrṇasya pitaḥ sañjāyate vai kāmanā muhuḥ ||93|| sarvasampatprapūrṇasya sarvānandabhṛtasya ca | sarvātmakasya kṛṣṇasyākāmatvaṃ tu guṇo mahān ||94|| ramaṇaṃ viṣayotthaṃ vai nāyaṃ jānāti yatparaḥ | putrī me’pi tathā cāste māyāparā ramātmikā ||95|| bandhadāyāśca prakṛternāśako’yaṃ pareśvaraḥ | kuhakaṃ na karotyeva māyāparo hi so’sti ca ||96 || gopālastvaṃ pitā cāste gopālaḥ so’pi tatpitā | vaiśyayoḥ sahamelastu bhāgyādevātra saṃgataḥ || 97|| viś praveśane’to veṣṭā cāntaryāmī prabhurhiṃ saḥ | lakṣmīḥ sṛṣṭitraye sarvapraviṣṭāntarniyāmikā ||98|| tayostu saṃgatiryogyā sarvadaiva praśasyate | kṣatriyaḥ sarvadā rakṣākaraḥ śaraṇavāsinām ||99|| bhagavān śrībālakṛṣṇaḥ kṣatriyo vai kathaṃ na hi | kṣatriyā mama putrī ca kṣatriyo bhagavānapi || 2.287.1 00|| dvayoryogo’sti vai bhāgyād prodvāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti | śubho me bhāti tasmātta pitaḥ śaṃkā na rocate || 101 || ityuktavantaṃ śrutvaiva hṛdaye hṛṣṭamānasaḥ | putraṃ tathāstvabhidhāya śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prayayau tataḥ || 1 02|| rādhike’tha tataścāpi bālakṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | śāṃbhavī cāpi vijñātuṃ strībhūtvā prayayau gṛham || 103 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne caturthyāṃ prage kṛtaṃ maṃgalaṃ, kanyākṛtaṃ kuladevatāpūjanam, mahīmānānāṃ bhojanādi, bālakṛṣṇasya śrīkṛṣṇarūpasya śiveśvareṇa saha kanyā na deyetisaṃvādaḥ, taduttarāṇi, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 287 ||
<2.288> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike ca tataḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇastataḥ param | rādhārūpaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā yayau śrīpārvatī gṛham || 1 || tvāṃ sā snuṣā pārvatī ca vīkṣyotthāyāsanaṃ dadau | rahasye’syai rādhikā provāca śṛṇu hitāvaham || 2 || mātā sā kathyate putryāḥ śreyaskarī sadā bhavet | dānamātraṃ na draṣṭavyaṃ draṣṭavyo’syāstathāyatiḥ || 3 || uttare syāt sutā nityasukhinīti matā matiḥ | nārīvargeṣu duḥkhaṃ cet sāpatnyaṃ sarvato’dhikam || 4 || mayā tvadya śrutaṃ tadvai yasmai pradīyate sutā | sa cāsti bālyato bhūmau patirvai koṭiyoṣitām || 5 || yāstāḥ sarvāścāgatā vai pitrādibhiḥ samaṃ tviha | pratyakṣaṃ vartate tvetat putrī syāt tatra duḥkhitā || 6 || mamāsti tatra vaimatyaṃ tasmād deyā na pārvati | bahustrīṇāṃ samavāye bhogā bhinno bhavanti hi || 7 || sampadā ca vibhāgāḥ syuḥ paryāptāḥ syurna te tataḥ | bahunārīmataḥ puṃso nāryastṛptiṃ na yanti hi || 8 || rājñāṃ saṃghaṭata sarvaṃ pṛthvīrājyavataḥ khalu | ayaṃ tu vidyate vipro jāmātā vaiśyakarmavān || 9 || nāsti grāmo’sya vāṭī vā kṣetraṃ vā cāpaṇādikam | bhikṣā tvasyāsti vṛttirvai kathaṃ syāt sukhinī sutā || 2.288.10 || gṛhe nāsyāsti vittaṃ vai darśayatyadhikaṃ bahiḥ | nāradoktyārpitā cāpi vāgdāne’pi viyujyate || 11 || tasmād deyā na vai lakṣmīḥ susukhā duḥkhinī bhavet | vada snuṣe mataṃ te’tra mayoktaṃ tapatā hṛdā || 12|| arogāya kumārāya suśīlāya suyogine | dhanavate’dvibhāryāya sutā deyā surūpiṇe || 13 || kuṭumbine samasthāya godhanāya mahīmate | svabāhūpārjitasampadyuktāya guṇaśāline || 14 || kīrtimate samarthāya kāmanāpūrakāya ca | patnīṃ tu devatāṃ matvā sukhadātre yaśasvine || 15|| rāmāya dharmayuktāya kanyā deyā suvedine | anye guṇāstato vīkṣyā asāpatnyottaraṃ tadā || 16|| sāpatnyaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ tvāgryaṃ narakaṃ sarvadā gṛhe | apatyānāṃ mānyatā ca dhruvavannaiva syācca vā || 17|| rohiṇyāṃ pakṣapātaśca candrasyeva bhavettathā | virajāyāśca rādhāyā me yathā tu kaliḥ purā || 18|| goloke’pyabhavattena duḥkhaṃ sāpatnyameva yat | mayoktaṃ me tu yadbhātaṃ snuṣe kuru yathocitam || 1 9|| ityevaṃ rādhike rādhāvākyaṃ śrutvā tu pārvatī | śiveśvarapriyā prāha pūjyā nirṇayamuttamam || 2.288.20 || puṇyo’yaṃ bālakṛṣṇo’sti parabrahma sanātanaḥ | patiḥ pūrṇānandaśca sāgaraḥ saritāṃ yathā ||2 1 || pūrṇasmṛddhaḥ pūrṇavīryaḥ pūrṇaguṇo virājate | asmādeva samutpannaṃ sarvaṃ vai sṛṣṭimaṇḍalam ||22|| rogaścintā ca sā nāsti pūrṇakāmasya vai prabhoḥ | kumāratvaṃ sadā cāste’viplutasyāsya yoginaḥ || 23 || śīlākhyaṃ ca vrataṃ tvasya gīyate śrutimūrdhasu | yogī cāyaṃ yogavettā nirodhavān sadāsti ca ||24|| sarvaṃ dhanaṃ kṛtaṃ yena so’yaṃ vai śreṣṭhisattamaḥ | medinī ca kṛtā tena vasavastena nirmitāḥ || 25|| kuberatvaṃ nirmitaṃ ca tenāto dhanavattamaḥ | yāvatyo’sya bhaveyuśca bhāryāstāvattanūdharaḥ ||26|| bhāryāṃ bhāryāṃ pṛthag bhuṃkte vartate’pi pṛthak sadā | advibhāryastataścāyaṃ candramovanna dūṣaṇam ||27|| rūpaṃ rūpaṃ pratirūpo babhūvāyaṃ surūpavān | kuṭumbaṃ cākṣare dhāmni cāsaṃkhyaṃ yasya vidyate ||28|| yasyaiva pratibimbāni santyavatārakoṭayaḥ | īśvarā manavo rudrā lokapālāśca viṣṇavaḥ ||29|| asyaiva santyavatārā ādityāḥ ṛṣayo’malāḥ | kuṭumbaṃ tvasya vidyate sārvabhaumaṃ mayā śrutam ||2.288.3 0|| sarvāsu samabhāvena tvāste’yaṃ puruṣottamaḥ | pratyutādhikabhāvena yāvat tṛptiḥ prajāyate || 3 1|| samastho viṣamastho vā patnyāḥ sukhaprado’sti saḥ | godhanaṃ cāpi goloke śreṣṭhaṃ mataṃ tvayā mayā ||32|| kāmadughāḥ sadā tvasya sevāyāṃ santi saṃśrutam | mahī cāsya samagrāsti rājānaḥ śvaśurā yataḥ ||33 || svabāhūpārjitā sampat sākṣādatra vilokyate | kāśīyātrāsya vai cāste koṭisṛṣṭisamanvitā ||34|| asya mātā svayaṃ mahālakṣmīreva virājate | pitā cāsya mahāviṣṇurgopālo’sti virājakṛt ||35|| aṣṭau mahāguṇāścātra vidyante śrutibodhitāḥ | nityā apahatapāpmatvādayaḥ parameśvare ||36|| satyaṃ śaucaṃ tathānye ca navatriṃśadguṇāstathā | asaṃkhyāśca guṇāstvatra vidyante nityayoginaḥ ||37|| kīrtirvedeṣu cāsyāsti dhāmasu ceśvareṣvapi | deveṣu mānave loke sarvapātālakeṣvapi ||38|| samartho’sti mokṣado’sti mokṣārthaṃ kanyakā mayā | dattāsti dīyate cāpi kā tatra parivedanā ||39|| kāmanāpūrakaścāyaṃ vidyate parameśvaraḥ | bhaktakāmaprapūro’sti sarvakāmaprapūrakaḥ ||2.288.40 || patnīṃ svāṃ devatātulyāṃ manyate’sau sadīśvaraḥ | sukhadoyaṃ yaśoyukto rāmo ramaṇako hi saḥ ||41 || sarvadharmabharo’styeva vidvānasti purātanaḥ | asāpatnyaṃ sadā cātra bahubhāryayute’styapi ||42|| nātra nyūnaguṇaiśvaryaṃ yena vai dhruvavad bhavet | candravad vā ca golokavadvā nātra tu saṃbhavet ||43|| haste’sya santi cihnāni matsyadhvajadhanūm̐ṣi ca | śaraśūlasvasticakradaṇḍādyāḥ pārameśvarāḥ ||44|| śarīre’sya bhavantyeva sāmudralakṣaṇānyapi | mayā śrutaṃ samastaṃ tannāradasya mukhāttataḥ ||45|| kanyā dattā sthale sthāne’rpaṇayogye pareśvare | tasmānmātaḥ suputrī me sukhinī bhāgyaśālinī ||46|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ labdhvā varottamam | tayā tapaḥ purā bālye ghoraṃ taptaṃ himālaye ||47|| hanūmadāśrame tatra so’yaṃ divyarūpadhṛk | varaṃ lakṣmyai patitvena datvā cādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ||48|| tataḥ putrī gṛhaṃ yātā māmāha tamudantakam | tata ārabhya sā pratīkṣate dvādaśavarṣakam | svasyāḥ kṛṣṇasya tu varṣaṃ pūrṇaṃ coktaṃ caturdaśam ||49|| so’yaṃ vai vidyate śreṣṭhaḥ samayaḥ samupāgataḥ | mama gṛhe samāyāto bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ||2.288.50 || kṛtakṛtyā bhavāmyadya pūjyo me puruṣottamaḥ | mahālakṣmīrvidhātryasyā vidyate bhāgyaśālinī ||51 || kṛtakṛtyā ca me putrī tava pautrī sadāryake | ityuktā rādhikā sā ca maunamāśritya cāśiṣā ||52|| samāyujya yayau naijālayaṃ sāpi tiro’bhavat | bālakṛṣṇo dṛḍhaṃ jñātvā bhāvaṃ tu vṛddhayornije ||53 || mumude cātihṛṣṭaśca lakṣmīṃ prati yayau rahaḥ | viprarūpo bālakṛṣṇaḥ provāca hradayāgamam ||54|| śṛṇu putri pradānaṃ te mayā śrutaṃ pravartate | rājaputrīṃ pariṇetumāgato’styapi bhūsuraḥ ||55|| bhikṣuko’sau rājyahīnaḥ śruto mayābdhitīragaḥ | dhīvaro hi yathā tadvad gopālo vartate’pyasau ||56|| nāsya gṛhe’sti vai sampannāyaṃ vadhūvrato’sti ca | paraṃ naiva kumāro’pi koṭinārīpatirhi saḥ ||57|| śruto mayaivaṃvidhiko nāryo’syāpyāgatāstviha | vidyante hi samānārthaṃ tvayā saha sthitāstviha ||58||| maṇḍape tvāgamiṣyanti bhramiṣyanti pradakṣiṇam | vahniṃ sākṣye’tra saṃsthāpya sapatnyaste hi kanyake ||59|| kimidaṃ rocate tubhyaṃ sapatnyastava maṇḍape | mā taṃ vṛṇu rājaputri bahunārīpatiṃ dvijam ||2.288.60|| rājānaṃ vṛṇu rājendri nārāyaṇāṃśameva ha | dharmiṣṭhaṃ ca garīyāṃsaṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām ||6 1 || tvaṃ cāste sundarī ramyā ramā rāmāsu pūjitā | navayauvanasaṃveśā tejasojjvalitā satī ||62|| taptakāñcanavarṇābhā śuddhasattvasvarūpiṇī | pativratā satyaśīlā śāntā śreṣṭhaguṇānvitā ||63 || indrāṇī varuṇānī ca rohiṇī ca kalāvatī | svāhā saṃjñā ca sāvitrī kuberāṇī ca vidyase ||64|| anyāsu śreṣṭhakāntāsu śreṣṭhatamā virājase | śaratpūrṇenduśobhāḍhyā śaratkamalalocanā ||65|| mā vipraṃ vṛṇu rājendri bhikṣukaṃ dūravāsinam | śrutvaivaṃ kanyakā prāha viprarūpaṃ nijaṃ patim ||66|| vipro’si mama pūjyo’si māvocastadvacaḥ punaḥ | anyathā daṇḍapātraṃ syāḥ, yāhi tatrāgato yataḥ ||67|| bhikṣuko yādṛśo vāpi tādṛśo vā bhavedapi | mayā parīkṣitaḥ pūrvaṃ paścādaṃgīkṛto mama || 68|| rājyaṃ yasyāsti vai sārvabhaumaṃ sṛṣṭitrayātmakam | kṣīrābdhitīragaḥ so’yaṃ sarvajño dhīvaro patiḥ ||69 || gavāṃ ca tejasāṃ cāpi pālako’sau virājate | sarvāśca sampadastvasya ceśāvāsyamidaṃ yataḥ || 2.288.70 || bhaktimatīvrato nityaṃ vartate hi priyāvrataḥ | koṭinārīpatiścāpi sadordhvasattvavānayam || 7 1 || sadā kumārakaścāste jānāmyenaṃ purābhave | tathā vidito’styevākhaṇḍordhvaretāḥ prayogavān ||72 || vipra nāryaḥ koṭisaṃkhyā yadi me maṇḍape tviha | mama pṛṣṭhe bhramiṣyanti tatra me gauravaṃ bhavet |||73 || sapatnīnāṃ hi sarvāsāmagrapūjyā bhavāmi yat| | agnisākṣye mama sāmye bhavantu koṭiyoṣitaḥ ||74|| asya tato’pyadhikāśca bhavantu me’tra gauravam | paripūrṇo milennāthastadāśaṃ vṛṇuyāddhi kā ||76|| yathā so’yaṃ dūravāsā tathāhaṃ dūravāsinī | dvayorvai melanaṃ yogyaṃ mā cintā vaha bhūsura | | 76|| indrādyā yadvaśe santi brahmādyāśca vaśe’sya tu | vairājādyā vaśe cāsya vyūhāścāsya vaśe’pi ca || 77 || avatārā vaśe cāsya kā kanyā vṛṇuyānna tam | pūrvākhyānaṃ ca vedoktaṃ jānāsyeva na tacchruṇu || 78|| kṛpayā bhagavān sākṣācchrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | uddhārārthaṃ hi lokānāṃ bhaktānāṃ cāpi sarvathā | |79|| bālakṛṣṇo’yamevāste paripūrṇatamaḥ prabhuḥ | kambharāśrīsakāśādvai gopālakṛṣṇasadgṛhe ||2.288.8 0 || jāto’sti parameśaḥ sa rādhāramāsatīpatiḥ | vidhātuśca vidhātā saḥ brahmeśaśeṣavanditaḥ ||8 1 | | jyotiḥsvarūpo bhagavān paramātmā parātparaḥ | nirliptaśca nirīhaśca sākṣī ca sarvakarmaṇām | |82 | | hṛdayasthaśca sarvasthastadarthaṃ cāhamāgatā | dhāmnaḥ pūrvaṃ tamevātra varayāmi na cetaram | |83 | | samarpitāhaṃ tatraiva svātmanā paramātmani | vidhātrā likhitā rekhā tasyārthaṃ mama bhūsura | |84| | paśya taṃ paramātmānaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham | dhyānānurodhahetuṃ ca nityadivyasurūpiṇam | |85| | darśanāt kuru viprendra svajanmakarmakhaṇḍanam | yaṃ na jānanti catvāro vedāḥ santaśca devatāḥ ||86|| saddhendrāśca munīndrāśca devā brahmādayo hyapi | dhyāyante dhyānamagnāśca yogino’pi na yanti yam ||87|| sarasvatī jaḍībhūtā varṇane yasya jāyate | sahasravaktraḥ śeṣo’pi pañcavaktraḥ sadāśivaḥ ||88 || caturmukho jagaddhātā kumāraḥ kārtikastathā | ṛṣayo munayaścāpi bhaktāḥ paramavaiṣṇavāḥ ||89|| akṣamāḥ stavane yasya dhyānāsādhyaśca yoginām | bālikāhaṃ vipravarya tadgaṇān kathayāmi kim ||2.288.90|| vṛtāsmi taṃ sadā vipra tadarthaṃ cāsmi bhāminī | kanyā cāpi tadarthāhaṃ viśveśvarasya putrikā ||91 || bhaktaputrīha sañjātā bhūmau bhagavadarthinī | pātivratyaṃ hi tannāma kanyātve yo hṛdi sthitaḥ ||92|| manasā ca dhṛto nāthaḥ sa eva jīvanaṃ sadā | hṛdayasya pradānaṃ vai hṛdayena prajāyate ||93 || sthūladehapradānaṃ tu paścātsthūlena jāyate | vyavahārapravāhārthaṃ loke’sti kalpitaḥ sthūlaḥ ||94|| so’yaṃ me’dya vijānīhi yāhi taddarśanaṃ kuru | yāvattvayā na dṛṣṭo’sti sarvakānto mahāprabhuḥ ||95|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīprāṇavallabhaḥ | tāvadvai bhāṣase me’trāśrāvyaṃ vipra kṣamāṃ vaha ||96|| ityukto bhagavānāha dārḍhyaṃ cedṛk tavāsti cet | kṣantavyaṃ yanmayoktaṃ tat prayāmi paśya māṃ punaḥ ||97|| ityuktvā nijanāmāḍhyaṃ dadau svarṇāṃgulīyakam | darśanaṃ divyarūpaṃ ca dadau svaparicāyakam ||98|| hārakeyūrakaṭakakuṇḍalādyairvirājitam | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmapītāmbarādiśobhitam ||99|| lakṣmīrnāthaṃ dvijātmānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ vīkṣya yathārthakam | pādayoḥ patitā śīghraṃ kṣaṇaṃ taṃ pariṣasvaje || 2.288.10 0|| priye sāyaṃ samāyāmītyuktvā miṣṭaṃ vacaḥ priyam | tūrṇaṃ tirobabhūvaiva sā tvānandapariplutā || 10 1|| viveda na kṣaṇaṃ tatrātmānaṃ tadgatamānasā | bhānamāsādya śanakaiḥ pramodānvitavigrahā || 1 02|| dhanyabhāgyaṃ nijaṃ mene rādhike ramaṇīvarā | gāmbhīryaṃ rakṣamāṇā sā novācedaṃ prakāśane || 1 03|| ityevaṃ bhagavān bhāvaṃ vividānyatsvarūpadhṛk | ātmanivedibhaktānāṃ bhaktivaśyo’bhavaddhi saḥ || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bālakṛṣṇasya rādhārūpasya pārvatyā saha kanyā na deyeti samvādaḥ, viprarūpasya mā vipraṃ bhikṣukaṃ vṛṇu iti lakṣmyā saha saṃvādaḥ, taduttarāṇi, dārḍhyaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 288 ||
<2.289> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca atha vai rādhike tatra prahare tu tṛtīyake | kṛtadugdhajalapānaḥ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 1 || mahīmānaistathā śreṣṭhajanaiśca devatādibhiḥ | rājabhiḥ saha saubhāgyavatībhiḥ saha vai tadā || 2 || sthāleṣu praviśāleṣu sauvarṇarājateṣvapi | sajjayāmāsa kanyārthaṃ divyaveṣāmbarāṇi ca || 3 || ābhūṣaṇāni sarvāṇi hārām̐śca vividhāṃstathā | sarvasaubhāgyaratnāni saubhāgyopakarāṇi ca || 4 || saubhāgyadravyagandhāni śatadhā vai navāni hi | miṣṭānnāni samastāni tāmbūlādīni yāni ca || 5 || camatkṛtiprakāṇḍāni vastūnyapi śubhāni ca | svarṇapātreṣu ca nidhāpayāmāsottamāni ca || 6 || suvarṇaghargharīḥ ramyāḥ śatadhā bhinnaraṃgikāḥ | vahniśuddhāḥ śāṭikāśca śatadhā svarṇabuṭṭikāḥ || 7 || bhinnaraṃgā bhinnacitrāḥ kauśeyikāstathāparāḥ | svarṇatārāvalīśobhāḥ svarṇaprāntāḥ sahīrakāḥ || 8 || svarṇavarṇā raktavarṇāḥ kaṃcukīḥ ratnasaṃhitāḥ | kauśeyikāstārahārigranthigrathanaśobhanāḥ || 9 || colikāśca tathā ramyāḥ śatadhā tārarājitāḥ | amūlyāśca keśalīnāḥ kucalīścāpyamūlyakāḥ || 2.289.1 0|| caṭṭikāścāpyamūlyāśca svarṇaprāvaraṇāni ca | svarṇajā nāḍikāścāpi sauvarṇīrdehabandhikāḥ || 1 1|| sagucchahīradorāṃśca keśabandhānamūlyakān | kucabandhān kaṭibandhām̐ścāntardhāryāṇi yāni ca || 12|| kauśeyāni suvastrāṇi śatadhā kalpitāni ca | svarṇasthāleṣu vai nidhāpayāmāsa tadā pitā || 1 3|| makhamallyau svarṇayujyau komale cāpyupānahau | rañjite sthalapadmābhe śatadhā ca nyadhāpayat || 14|| keśasādhanakānyeva sarvāṇi śobhanānyapi | viṣṇutailāni cānyāni gandhasārāṇi vai tathā || 15|| kastūrikādipaṃkāni cāndanādīni yāni ca | kajjalāni vividhāni raktadravyāṇi yāni ca || 16|| kuṃkumāni ca sindūrakardamāni śubhāni ca | cañcanmūdupracūrṇāni navanītadravāṇi ca || 17|| mārdanārhadravām̐ścāpi snānārhaguṭikāstathā | nakharañjanatattvāni talaraṃgadravām̐stathā || 18|| alaktādīni citrāṇi patrikārthadravāṇi ca | cañcaddhīrakacandrām̐śca cañcaccūrṇāni yāni ca || 19|| svarṇasthāleṣu sarvāṇi nyadhāpayattadā pitā | sthalapadmādipakvāni sugandhisalilāni ca ||2.289.20 || harikamaṇimāṇikyamauktikai ratnakaistathā | naddhāḥ suvarṇajā ramyā ūrmikāḥ śataśastathā |||21 || bhramikāḥ kaṭikāścāṅgulīyakāni śubhāni ca | prakoṣṭhakaṭakām̐ścāpi vyaṃgiḍīḥ kānakīstathā ||22|| naddhahīrakaramyām̐ścāṃgadān sukaṭakottamān | bhujabandhān prasauvarṇān śṛṃkhalā bahuśobhanāḥ ||23|| patrikāḥ śṛṃkhalāyuktā rañjitāḥ phullapatrikāḥ | siṃhānanān suvalayān kaṃkaṇāni bahūni ca || 24|| natthikāścibukīścāpi ṭibakīrbindukīstathā | satārāśca sucandro bahuragām̐śca śobhanān || 25|| kānakīḥ karṇamālāśca karṇikāḥ karṇaśṛṃkhalāḥ | sauvarṇān vardhakām̐ścāpi troṭikāḥ phullagranthikāḥ ||26|| sauvarṇastabakām̐ścāpi śiṃghoṭakān kadambakān | sauvarṇahīrakanaddhān ārāyakān subuṭṭikāḥ ||27|| vālikāstārikāścāpi kuṃcikā rūpyakānakīḥ | tantīṃ bhāgyamayīṃ cāndrīṃ candrapatrīṃ tathāyatām ||28|| sauvarṇaṃ kamalaṃ cāpi svarṇamālāṃ suśobhanām | sauvarṇasūryaṃ śobhāḍhyaṃ bhāloparinivāsinam ||29|| keśacippikasūcīśca sauvarṇīṃ rājatīstathā | dhammilabandhavālīśca sauvarṇīḥ śṛṃkhalātmikāḥ ||2.289.3 0|| kabarīpārśvacandrām̐śca vastrāvagūhavālikāḥ | oṣṭharañjanacūrṇaṃ ca kapolagaṇḍacūrṇakam ||3 1 || nyadhāpayaddhi pātreṣu kanyārthaṃ tatra cotsukaḥ | kaṇṭhahārān patrikāḍhyān phalagranthiprahārakān ||32|| śṛṃkhalāhārakām̐ścāpi plakṣapatraṃ suvarṇajam | maṃgalaṃ kānakaṃ cāpi mādalīṃ kānakīṃ tathā ||33|| svastikaṃ kānakaṃ cāpi cakraṃ vai kānakaṃ tathā | hastapadmaṃ kaṇṭhapadmaṃ kānakaṃ bhālapadmakam ||34|| galārthaṃ valayaṃ cāpi kānakaṃ siṃhikānanam | tilahārān mudgahārān māṣahārān sugaṭhṭhikān ||35|| sūkṣmapatrīprahārām̐śca tārahārām̐śca śobhanān | kucapuṭām̐śca sauvarṇān kuntalān kuntaśobhitān ||36|| sūryamukhīṃ ca sauvarṇīṃ sauvarṇakalaśīstathā | svarṇapaṭṭān svarṇamālā mauktikahārasattamān ||37|| kaṭipāśām̐śca sauvarṇān śṛṃkhalā raśanāstathā | kandūrikāśca sauvarṇīstrisarīḥ śobhanāstathā ||38|| nupūrān kiṃkiṇīyuktān jhaṃjharīḥ svarṇanirmitāḥ | kadalīḥ kambikāścāpi śṛṃgalā ghurghurām̐stathā ||39|| sarvavidhāni saubhāgyābhūṣaṇāni navāni ca | tāmbūlapānadānīśca śūṭikāḥ kaṃkatīstathā ||2.289.40|| ādarśānnaktakām̐ścāpi karapoṣām̐śca maujikān | ācchādakān śirastrāṇān harirajjūḥ suśobhitā ||41|| puṣpikāḥ kalikāścāpi sauvarṇīścaurṇapaṭṭikāḥ | pṛṣṭhapatrīṃ kaṭikatrīṃ dantapatrīṃ suśobhanām |||42|| muktāhārān padmarāgamaṇimālāḥ suśobhanāḥ | mārakatīḥ srajaścāpi vaidūryamaṇimālikāḥ ||43|| indranīlasrajaścāpi puṣparāgādipatrikāḥ | karketanakṛtamālāḥ pulakasphaṭikasrajaḥ ||44|| vidrumanaddhapattrāṇi sthāleṣvapi nyadhāpayat | gālīcakāni ramyāṇi hārītakāni yāni ca ||45|| aurṇāni ca tathā kauśeyāni cāstaraṇāni ca | gulālāni ca raktāni kuṃkumāni śubhāni ca ||46|| akṣatāni sutīkṣṇāni yavamālāḥ śubhāstathā | puṣpahārām̐śca pātrāṇi gandhadhānīśca kānakīḥ ||47|| ityevaṃ rādhike koṭikoṭyabjārbudamūlyakam | tato’bjamūlyakaṃ śṛṃgārakaṃ nyadhāpayat pitā ||48|| sthāleṣu sūryatulyeṣu nidhāpya kaṃbharāpatiḥ | vādyaghoṣairyutaḥ kanyāgītikābhiryutastathā ||49|| yayau kanyānivāsaṃ vai śivasvāmyālayaṃ tadā | kanyakāyāḥ kṛte sarvaṃ kṛṣṇāllabdhaṃ śivena ca ||2.289.50|| teṣāṃ tāsāṃ svāgataṃ ca sammānaṃ svīkṛtiṃ tathā | vidhāya bahubhāvena jalapānaṃ harastadā ||5 1 || akārayacca miṣṭānnabhojanaṃ svalpamaṃgalam | tāmbūlakaṃ dadau cāpi bahu bahvityabhāṣata ||52|| hṛṣṭo gopālakṛṣṇaśca dadau sarvaṃ śivāya ha | ājñāmavāpya tūrṇaṃ vai svāvāsaṃ cāyayau tataḥ || 53 caturthe prahare tatra kanyāśṛṃgāramācaran | sarvāḥ sakhyaḥ sumilitāḥ provāhocitamutsukāḥ ||54|| kṛṣṇasyāpi pitā sthāne śṛṃgāraṃ samakārayat | gajaṃ suvāhanaṃ caturdantaṃ sāmbālikaṃ śubham ||55|| pitā śṛṃgārayāmāsa dhavalaṃ sarvato’dhikam | sauvarṇacandrakūthena svarṇāmbālikayāyutam ||56|| śuṇḍāyāṃ citraśūlaṃ ca kapāle ca sudarśanam | karṇayorvyajane cāpi gaṇḍayoḥ sūryakau tathā ||57|| danteṣu svarṇavalayāḥ kaṇṭhe sauvarṇaghaṇṭikāḥ | pādeṣu pārṣadāścitrasvarūpāścodare gadā ||58|| pucche sauvarṇamālāśca niḥśreṇī pārśvake tathā | ityevaṃ ca gajaṃ śṛṃgārayāmāsa pitā tadā ||59|| bhūmisparśāni ca tadā mandavimānakāni ca | pitā śṛṃgārayāmāsa vāhinyarthaṃ tadā mudā ||2.289.6 0|| muktānāṃ sugajāścāpi garuḍāśca tadābhavan | smṛtamātrā āgatāśca śṛṃgāritāḥ suśobhitāḥ ||61 || aśvāścoṣṭrāstathā haṃsā menāśca cātakāstathā | vṛṣabhā gavayāścāpi mṛgāśca makarāstathā ||62|| geṇḍūkāśca tathā siṃhāḥ śārdūlāḥ śarabhāstathā | vāhanāni yathā yeṣāṃ smṛtāni kalpapādape ||63|| kāmadughānirmitāni tūrṇaṃ tatrāgatāni ca | vyomayānāni ramyāṇi svalpāni bhūmigāni ca ||64|| śṛṃgāritāni sarvāṇi rathāśca rathikāstathā | śibikāstāpadānāni naravāhāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ ||65|| dhvajaḍaṃkāniśānādivetrachatrāṇi yāni ca | śṛṃgāritāni sarvāṇi sajjīkṛtāni vai drutam ||66|| vāhinīsthā narā nāryaḥ śṛṃgāraśobhitāstadā | navacañcadvarṇaveṣā ābhūṣādivirājitāḥ ||67|| anyūnasarvaśṛṃgārā abhavan vai tadā mudā | vādyakārā nartakāśca naṭā dundubhinādakāḥ ||68|| sarvavāditravijñāśca veṣairbhinnairvibhūṣitāḥ | devā devyaḥ samastāśca sṛṣṭitrayanivāsinaḥ ||69|| śṛṃgāritā abhavam̐śca varayātrocitāstadā | lagnayātrocitāḥ kanyāścatuṣkoṭiprasaṃkhyikāḥ ||2.289.70|| tathānyāḥ koṭiśaścāpi koṭyavurdābjasaṃkhyikāḥ | pitrādibhiḥ sakhībhiśca śṛṃgāritāstadābhavan ||7 1 || kaṇṭhamālāyutāḥ sarvāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ | vahneḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ sarvāścehamānā harīcchayā ||72|| lomaśasya nideśena sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ | dānayogyā abhavam̐śca yathā lakṣmīstu kanyakā ||73 || caturthapraharasyānte kṛtvā śṛṃgāramadbhutam | suśubhe samaye śivapurād kṛṣṇo viniryayau || 74|| koṭikoṭayabjajanatāsahito vardhito janaiḥ | pūjito vanditaścāpi phalapuṣpadhanārpaṇaiḥ || 75|| vārāṇasyāṃ bhramitvaiva mahārājapathe tataḥ | devatādarśanaṃ kṛtvā viśveśvaraṃ praṇamya ca | gaṃgāvāri śubhaṃ pītvā sahasrāyutavāhanaḥ ||76 || lakṣavimānayuktaśca sarvastrīnaravardhitaḥ | yukto yāvanmahīmānaiścāyāti yogamaṇḍapam ||77|| varaṇāyāstaṭe ramye kāpiladhārikāsthale | viśāle sārarūpe vai kṣetre hyudyānaśobhite ||78 || śivasvāminaśca prāsādāgre kailāsarūpiṇam | śatayojanavistāraṃ kailāsātmakamaṇḍapam ||79 || yo vai kailāsarūpo’bhūt gagane svāgatārthakaḥ | sa eva nityakailāso maṇḍapo’tra virājate ||2.289.8 0 || tatra kā nyūnatā rādhe yatra vai maṇḍape’bhitaḥ | samastaṃ śivanagaraṃ pārvatīnagaraṃ tathā ||8 1 || kāśīnagaraṃ cāpyantarbhāvamīyuḥ praśobhayā | tādṛśīmaṇḍape śobhā śaṃbhunā tatra nirmitā ||8 2 || gaṃgāgogarābhūbhāge vistṛto’bhūddhi maṇḍapaḥ | śatayojanavistāraḥ kuṇḍavedīpraśobhitaḥ ||8 2 || ucchraye yojanaścāpi divyatejo’bhisaṃbhṛtaḥ | golokīyasamastābhiḥ sāmagrībhiśca pūritaḥ ||84|| siṃhāsanādibhiryukto maṇitejo’bhirājitaḥ | pārṣadaiḥ sarvataḥ sevāparāyaṇairgaṇairyutaḥ ||85 || kāmadhenusamastābhiḥ kalpalatābhivartitaḥ | rāsamaṇḍalaśobhāḍhyagopagopīvirājitaḥ ||86 || sarvalokanivāsānāṃ puttalairabhimaṇḍitaḥ | ghṛtakulyādadhikulyāmadhukulyābhirājitaḥ || 87 || sarvāsanaiśca mṛdubhirbṛsībhiḥ paṭṭikādibhiḥ | aurṇāstaraṇakauśeyāstaraṇaiśca talīkṛtaḥ ||88 || manohārisvarayuktagītibhiścābhikarṣitaḥ | nṛtyanāṭyakalājñābhirhāsyajñābhirvirājitaḥ ||8 9 || dūradṛśyadūraśrāvadūraspṛśaiśca nirmitaḥ | saṃkalpayānavāhādyaiḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe prasevitaḥ ||2.289.90|| śītairvidyutpravāhaiśca sarvathā tūjjvalīkṛtaḥ | sudhāmṛtapravarṣibhistāraiḥ samantato’nvitaḥ ||9 1 || staṃbheṣu toraṇeṣūrdhvabhāgeṣu tvāsanānvitaḥ | varakanyāvivāhasya pratibimbārthadarśanaḥ || 92|| svarge tārāśca yāvatyastāvanto maṇayastviha | kailāse maṇḍape tatra rājante yogamaṇḍape ||93 || sṛṣṭipānāṃ tu yāvanti sabhāsthānāni santi hi | tāvanti maṇḍape tatra kṛtāni viśvakarmaṇā ||94|| dānārhakanyakānāṃ cāsanāni madhyagolake | kṛtāni kaṇṭhamālārthaṃ sannidhau viśvakarmaṇā ||95|| kailāsaḥ puruṣastatra rājate mūrtimānapi | sarvārhavastudānārthaṃ provāhe tatra vai mahe ||96 || na bhūto na bhaviṣyam̐śca maṇḍapaścedṛśaḥ kvacit | ārapāradṛśā dṛśyo vidyate dhāmavat sthitaḥ ||97|| yūpakalaśadevādhivāsanaiḥ svastikādibhiḥ | adhiṣṭhito mahīmānaiḥ pārvatīnagarījanaiḥ || 98|| kāśīnagarīlokaiśca sṛṣṭitrayanivāsibhiḥ | saṃkulito vadadbhiśca prodvāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ||99|| maṇḍapasyottame śreṣṭhe gopure maṃgalātmake | vīrabhadro’mbare vakti maṃgalaṃ kṛṣṇayoriti || 2.289.1 00|| vadanti vyomayantrāṇi samāyāntu mahotsave | paśyantu paramātmānaṃ pradānaṃ kṛṣṇayoriti || 101 || sāmavedo mūrtimām̐ścāmbare sthitvābhivandate | āgacchan śrīśarājo’sau harirvijayatetamām || 1 02||| ṛgvedaśca gopurāgre sthitaḥ paśyati vāhinīm | samāyāntīṃ mahādīrghāmasūcayacchivādikān || 1 03|| satī śrīpārvatīdevī tūrdhvabhūmau gatā tadā | kiyatī kīdṛśī ceti vāhinīti pravikṣitum || 1 04|| śivapurāt kāśikāṃ saṃgṛhya maṇḍapasannidhau | ātāṃ cātidīrghāṃ saṃvīkṣya stabdhābhavat kṣaṇam || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kanyārthaṃ bhūṣāmbaropakaraṇādipreṣaṇam, vāhinījanamahīmānakṛṣṇaśṛṃgārādi, śrīkṛṣṇasya maṇḍapaṃ prati niryāṇaṃ, maṇḍapaśobhā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 289 ||
<2.290> śrīkṛṣṇa uvācapārvatīṃ cordhvagāṃ vīkṣya koṭiśo yoṣitastadā | kṛṣṇayānyā vilokārthaṃ cāruruhurnijālayān || 1 || maṇḍapasyordhvaśālāsu tvāsthitā vīkṣaṇotsukāḥ | ṛgvedaṃ girijā prāha bṛhaspateḥ samīpataḥ || 2 || dṛśyate tvagrataḥ kiṃ tat sāntaṃ me sannibodhaya | mama putryāḥ kṛte ke ke mahīmānā mamādya vai || 3 || ke santi kīdṛśāścāpi sutāsvāmyapi kīdṛśaḥ | mahattamo’sti sarvaṃ tajjijñāse vada me’khilam || 4 || sarvajñaḥ ṛgveda evaṃ pṛṣṭo harṣamavāpa ha | satīṃ śrīgirijāṃ vaktuṃ samārebhe kramātattaḥ || 5 || paśya mātaḥ prathamaṃ vai maṃgalākhyo hi pārṣadaḥ | caturbhujaḥ satilakaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 6 || maṃgalādevikāyuktaḥ sarvamāṃgalyakānvitaḥ | sāmamantrān pragāyan vai samāyāti śubhāvahaḥ || 7 || svalpahaṃsasamārūḍhaḥ sarvaśobhāsamanvitaḥ | tathāhaṃsasamārūḍhā maṃgalā ca sarasvatī || 8 || śāradā ca samāyānti sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ | etadvai darśanaṃ sarvamaṃgalānāṃ sumaṃgalam || 9 || tato vaikuṇṭhavādyāni vādakairvāditāni vai | samāyānti trilokyāṃ yanninādāśca dhvananti hi || 2.290.1 0|| paśya tataḥ samāyāti sadhvajaḥ śobhano gajaḥ | akṣarasyaiva mukto’sau mahādririva rājate || 1 1|| paśya tataḥ samāyānti jayaśabdapravartakāḥ | brahmacaryaparāḥ pāresahasraṃ snātakā ime || 12|| paśya tataḥ samāyāti ḍaṃkāniśānavān śubhaḥ | śyāmakarṇo dhavalāśvo’kṣaramukto hi vartate || 1 3||| paśya bherībhṛtaṃ paścād rathaṃ vṛṣabhavāhitam | sauvarṇaṃ svarṇakalaśadhvajāvarūthaśobhitam || 14|| paśya tato’śvavārām̐śca sahasraśaḥ sahetikān | paśya mātastataścoṣṭrasthitān nirṛtarākṣasān || 15|| sarve śṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyān vaiṣṇavān viṣṇusevakān | paśya mātastato yakṣān padātīn dānakāriṇaḥ || 16|| svarṇarūpyādivṛṣṭiṃ ca kurvato dhanasaṃbhṛtān | sahasraśo hi mukuṭairanvitān svarṇabhūṣaṇān || 17|| paśya mātastato rāsakṛtān vai vaiṣṇavān janān | sahasraśaḥ savādyām̐śca kīrtayaṃto harerguṇān|| 18|| paśya mātastato nārīvaiṣṇavīrgītikāparāḥ | kṛṣṇakīrtanakartrīśca sahasraśo vibhūṣitāḥ || 19|| paśya tataḥ śibikāsu narayāneṣu saṃsthitān | brahmadhyānaparān pūjyān maharṣīṃśca sahasraśaḥ || 2.290.20|| paśya mātaḥ pitṛdevān aryamṇā sahitām̐stataḥ | sauvarṇanarayāneṣu lakṣakanyāyutānapi || 21 || paśya tataḥ siddhajanān sādhūn rathādyadhiṣṭhitān | pāresahasraṃ divyām̐śca pāvanān lokapāvanān ||22|| paśya mātastato vaṃśīvādyayuktān hi komalān | pārṣadānnavayūnaśca divyaveṣavibhūṣitān ||23|| paśya mātaḥ śarabhasthān daityān pravaiṣṇavām̐stataḥ | śṛṃgāritān jayanādān prakurvataḥ sahasraśaḥ |24|| paśya mātastato raudrān gaṇān vṛṣabhavāhanān | vaiṣṇavān bahuveṣām̐śca rūpiṇaḥ śivasadṛśān ||25|| bhūtān pretān piśācām̐śca paśya vaiṣṇavasevakān | paśya mātastato divyān gāndharvān vādyagāyakān ||26|| svarṇacampakavarṇābhān tālamānasamanvitān | paśya mātastataḥ sarvatīrthāni mūrtimanti ca || 27|| pāvanāni samāyānti lakṣaśo divyabhāni ca | paśya mātastato devīḥ koṭiśo gītikāyutāḥ ||28|| vibhūṣitā divyaveṣā narayānasthitāḥ śubhāḥ | paśya mātastato vṛddhān saurāṣṭrīyān narān śubhān ||29|| paśya devān vāhanasthān chatracāmarabhūṣitān | lakṣaśo bhānuvarṇān vai dāsadāsīsamanvitān ||2.290.3 0|| svalpakalpavimānasthān sthalagān vyomagānapi | candravarṇān bhānuvarṇān vahnivarṇān surām̐stathā ||3 1|| paśya mātastato yātān pātālasthān phaṇādharān | bahurūpān kāmarūpān koṭiśo’tra samāgatān ||32||| paśya mātaḥ sūtalokān māgadhān kinnarām̐stataḥ | kiṃpuṃsaḥ paśya vidyādhrān devavādyaninādakān ||33|| paśya mātastato viprān vedaghoṣakarān dvijān | paśya tato gajasthām̐śca nṛpān bhūgolabhūpatīn ||34|| jummasemlanṛpaṃ hastisthitaṃ tathābhito’sya ca | sahasrakanyakā yānagatāḥ paśya hareḥ priyāḥ ||35|| paśya mātastato dakṣajavaṃgaraṃ nṛpaṃ gaje | śatādhikasahasrakanyakā yānagatāstathā ||36|| śibirājaṃ paśya mātargajasthaṃ śobhanaṃ nṛpam | narayānagatāḥ kanyāḥ śataṃ paśya vibhūṣitāḥ ||37|| tharkūṭasthaṃ mahārājaṃ pañcāśatkanyakāyutam | svarṇasiṃhāsanasthaṃ viṣṭiskandheṣu vilokaya ||38|| vīrajāramahārājaṃ śatakanyāyutaṃ tataḥ | narayānasthitaṃ paśya sarvābhūṣaṇaśobhitam ||39|| śaktyakṣinṛpatiṃ ṣaṣṭikanyakāsahitaṃ tathā | śatapiśācinīkanyāyutaṃ paśya suśobhitam ||2.290.40|| kālimāśaṃ nṛpaṃ paśya kanyāśatadvayānvitam | svarṇayānasthitaṃ sarvaśṛṃgārasaṃvibhūṣitam ||41|| ete nṛpā rāśiyānāḥ kiṃpuruṣaprajātikāḥ | devatulyāḥ pravidyante tava gṛhe samāgatāḥ |||42|| atha vāditraninadān śṛṇu paśya navottamān | ketumālīyajātīm̐śca suśobhān yantravāditān ||43|| uralaketukaṃ paśya rājānaṃ svalpayānagam | triṃśatkanyāsahitaṃ ca venumālaprakhaṇḍagam ||44|| krathakaṃ paśya rājānaṃ pañcakanyāyutaṃ śubham | svalpayānasthitaṃ pṛthuṃ viṃśatikanyakāyutam ||45|| uṣṭrālarājakaṃ daśakanyānvitaṃ vilokaya | haṃkāraṃ paṃcakanyāsaṃyutaṃ yāne vilokaya ||46 || jayakāṣṭhalabhūpaṃ ca pañcakanyāsamanvitam | tīrāṇarājakaṃ mātaḥ paśya ṣaṭkanyakāyutam ||47|| alvīnaraṃ nṛpaṃ paśya saptakanyāsamanvitam | jīnavarddhinṛpaṃ paśya yānasthamekakanyakam ||48|| tataḥ paśya mahādevi rājñāṃ pṛṣṭhe ca maṇḍalam | kanyakānāṃ dviśatasahasradvayasuśobhitam ||49|| mahāvimānagaṃ sarvaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam | vimānaṃ bhūtale yāti kalpalatāsuśobhitam ||2.290.50|| alpaketuṃ nṛpaṃ paśya saptakanyāsamanvitam | jayakṛṣṇavabhūpaṃ ca mātaḥ paśyaikakanyakam ||51 || parīśānaṃ nṛpaṃ paśya tvekaviṃśatikanyakam | svalpavimānagaṃ sarvaśobhābhūṣaṇabhūṣitam |||52||| tataḥ paśya dvikanyaṃ ca nṛpamindurayaṃ śubham | mudrāṇḍaṃ nṛpatiṃ pañcadaśakanyāyutaṃ tataḥ ||53 || svalpavimānagaṃ paśya sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam | gaṇḍanṛpaṃ navakanyāyutaṃ paśya vimānagam ||54|| līnorṇaṃ ca nṛpaṃ paśya catuḥkanyā vimānagam | bṛhaccharaṃ nṛpamekādaśakanyāsamanvitam ||55|| balalīnaṃ tataḥ paśya catvāriṃśatsukanyakam | svalpavimānagaṃ sarvasāmagrīśobhitaṃ śubham ||56|| varasiṃhākhyarājānaṃ paśya vai pañcakanyakam| rāyagāmalabhūpaṃ ca paśyāṣṭakanyakaṃ śubham ||57|| phenatantunṛpaṃ paśya kanyādvayasamanvitam | stokahomaṃ tathā paśya kanyaikaṃ yānagaṃ śubham ||58| | kāṣṭhayānanṛpaṃ paśya kanyaikaṃ kolakaṃ nṛpam | kanyaikaṃ ceti ketumālīyā nṛpā bhavanti te ||59|| ete sarve mahīmānāstava gṛhe nibodha me | atha vāditrakuśalān paśya garimadeśajān ||2.290.60|| hārītakān divyaveśān paśya mātaḥ kramācchubhān | paśya vimānagaṃ bhūpaṃ kanyādvayayutaṃ tataḥ ||6 1 || dinamānārkanṛpatiṃ svatantraṃ suvibhūṣitam | paśya mātastato yāntaṃ rāyakinnarabhūpatim ||62|| ekapañcāśatkanyakāyutaṃ svarṇavimānagam | kinnāṭakapradeśānāṃ nṛpaṃ cāmarikānvitam ||63||| amarīdeśajān paśyottarakurunṛpānatha | bhūtalasparśisaṃvegamahāvimānagān śubhān |||64|| rāyarokīśvaraṃ bhūpamekaviṃśatikanyakam | rāyaraṇajidbhūpaṃ ca viṃśatikanyakāyutam ||65|| rāyavākakṣakaṃ paśya trikanyaṃ suvimānagam | rāyamārīśabhūpaṃ ca trikanyaṃ ca vimānagam ||66|| rāyabāleśvaraṃ bhūpaṃ trikanyaṃ ca vimānagam | rāyalambārabhūpaṃ ca ṣaṭaknyaṃ vai vimānagam | |67 || rāyanavārkabhūpaṃ ca saptakanyaṃ vimānagam | rāyahūṇeśabhūpaṃ ca navakanyaṃ vimānagam ||68|| rāyakūpeśabhūpaṃ ca kanyaikaṃ svavimānagam | paśyaitān chatraśobhāḍhyān dāsadāsīsamanvitān ||69|| paśya mātastato vādyavādakān kṛṣṇaveṣakān | paśya mātastato bhūpān dakṣiṇakurudeśajān ||2.290.70 || kālamaṇḍalīnabhūpaṃ kanyācatuṣṭayānvitam | gajayānagataṃ paśya sarvaśobhāsamanvitam ||7 1 || vanajeleśabhūpaṃ ca pañcakanyāsamanvitam | gajayānagataṃ paśya mātaśchatrādiśobhitam |||72 || pārāvārapibaṃ bhūpaṃ kanyātrayasamanvitam | gajayānagataṃ paśya sarvabhṛtyādisaṃyutam ||73 || koṭīśvaraṃ nṛpaṃ paśya kanyādvayasamanvitam | gajayānagataṃ mātaḥ sarvabhṛtyasamanvitam ||74|| śrīsatīśanṛpatiṃ kanyātrayasamanvitam | tretākarkaśabhūpaṃ ca saptakanyāyutaṃ tathā ||75|| āṇḍajarānṛpaṃ paśya kanyācatuṣṭayānvitam| bālyarajonṛpaṃ paśya kanyaikaṃ gajayānagam ||76|| rāyasomananṛpatiṃ śubhaṃ kanyātrayānvitam | urugavākṣabhūpaṃ ca paśya kanyādvayānvitam ||77|| parāṅavrataṃ nṛpaṃ paśya kanyādvayayutaṃ tataḥ | īśānapānabhūpaṃ ca mahāgajacatuṣṭaye ||78|| yāne sthitaṃ tvekacatvāriṃśatkanyāsamanvitam | paśya cāmarachatrādidāsīdāsasusevitam ||79|| rājārāyapatiṃ paśya trayastriṃśatsukanyakam | caturgajamahāyānasthitaṃ chatrādiśobhitam ||2.290.80|| pūrvadeśaprajāścāpi paśya mātarvimānagāḥ | koṭikanyāyutāḥ sarvāḥ koṭikumāraśobhitāḥ ||8 1 || ābālavṛddhasarvasvā dṛṣṭiryāsu na gacchati | viśālāṃ vāhinīṃ paśya tavāṅgaṇe hyupāgatām ||8 2|| mahābāleśvarān paśya suratīyān prapaśya ca | sāntapanīḥ prajāḥ paśya pañcasāhasrakanyakāḥ ||83|| sarvā vimānagāḥ śṛṃgāritāścābharaṇānvitāḥ | bhūgarbhasya nṛpasyāpi lakṣmaṇasya vimānakam ||84|| paśya mātardvisahasrakanyānvitaṃ viśālakam | śāvadīnasya kanyānāṃ sahasraṃ ca vimānagam ||85|| nāgakanyāvimānāni nāgārūḍhāni paśya ca | sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi paśyāṃgaṇe tavātra vai ||86 || paśya mātastato devān chatracāmaraśobhitān | narayānagatān naijavādyavetradharānvitān ||87|| kubero’yaṃ samāyāti vaiṣṇavaḥ pūrvakalpagaḥ | nijakuṭumbasahitaḥ sarvaśobhāsamanvitaḥ ||88|| mahendro’yaṃ samāyāti paśya taṃ devatānvitam | mahāsiṃhāsanasthaṃ vai svargarājaṃ raviprabham ||89|| paśya mātastato vāyuṃ samāyāntaṃ surānvitam | rājādhirājaśobhaṃ ca paśya rudraṃ gaṇānvitam || 2.290.90 || vahniṃ paśya tato yāntaṃ paśya sūryaṃ vimānagam | paśya candraṃ budhaṃ śukraṃ koṭidevaprasevitam ||91 || mahāvimānasaṃsthaṃ ca paśya mātarmunīśvaram | ṛbhuṃ sanatkumāraṃ ca koṭisatpuruṣānvitam ||92|| vāditrāṇi satyalokasthāni śṛṇu tato’pi ca | paśya mātarjanavāsipitṝn vai koṭikanyakān || 93|| vimānasainyasaṃsthām̐śca paśya viśvāvasuṃ tataḥ | kanyāśatatrayayutaṃ gāndharvagaṇasevitam ||94|| rasātalīyadaityām̐śca paśya bhaktān samāgatān | prahlādādīnnṛpānatra pañcasāhasrakanyakān || 95|| saṃvaraṇaṃ ca dharaṇiṃ koṭikanyāsamanvitām | paśya mātarbhūṣitāṃ ca vimānottamasaṃsthitām || 96|| kāmadhenukuṭumbāni muktātmakāni paśya ca | koṭikulāni cāyānti tava gṛhaṃ sukhāśrayam || 97|| paśya mātastato viṣṇuṃ koṭipārṣadasaṃyutam | vaikuṇṭhavādyaśobhāḍhyairjanaiścāgre prayāyibhiḥ | | 98|| jayanādairvardhitaṃ ca koṭidīpāvalīyutam | ārjantīśatayuktaṃ ca ramākoṭisamanvitam || 99|| paśya mātastato yāntaṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam | diśāṃ pālairlokapālaiḥ koṭibhiścābhivardhitam || 2.290.100 || sarasvatyādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ brahmasarobhiranvitam | dvāsaptatisahasrakanyakāyuktaṃ vimānagam || 101 || aindrajālikakanyānāṃ sahasreṇāpi rājitam | paśya mātarlomaśaṃ ca maharṣikoṭisevitam || 102|| mahāvimānasaṃsthaṃ ca guruṃ lakṣmīpateḥ prabhoḥ | paśya mātastasya pṛṣṭhe kanyāgaṇān hi koṭiśaḥ | | 103 || vimānagān vanadevīkanyālakṣagaṇānapi | drumān stabakān kalpalatāḥ paśya sthāvaradehinaḥ || 1 04|| mahīmānān śobhanān vai devasadṛśavigrahān | paśya mātastato lakṣakanyānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ param || 1 05|| dāmanīnāṃ vimānasthaṃ saudāminīkulaṃ param | paśya mātastato’yutakaṃkatālīyakanyakāḥ || 106 || vimānasthā bhūṣitāśca gītikātatparāstathā | sālamālīyakanyāśca vāsantikāśca kanyakāḥ || 1 07|| paśya mātarvimānasthāḥ sahasrāṇi tathāparāḥ | paśya mātaryamajāśca vāyujāḥ kanyakāstataḥ || 108 || meghanādyaścaturdaśasahasrāṇi tathāparāḥ | vārkṣyo raudryaśca khānijyaḥ sāṃvatsaryaśca gopikāḥ || 10 9|| śrāvaṇyā vaiśvakarmyaśca prācīnyaśca piśaṃgikāḥ | rāśiyānyaśca romāṇyaḥ pāraśyaḥ kinnarīgaṇāḥ || 2.290.110 || dhaivaryaścāpi parthaścāmaryo gauryaśca bhūṣitāḥ | hārityaścāpi vai svargyāḥ pātālyaścābririktajāḥ || 111 || bhaumyaścāpi ca dānavyaḥ koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyakāḥ | paśya mātastava putryā mānārthaṃ santi tāstviha | | 11 2|| āyānti cotsukāḥ sarvā prodvāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti | paśya mātastato yāntaṃ sahasrakalaśānvite || 113 || mahāvimānake śrīmadvairājaṃ puruṣaṃ param| anekeśvarayuktaṃ ca sahasrabhujaśobhitam || 1 14|| paśya mātastato yāntaṃ sahasravadanaṃ hyajam | brahmaṇaśca tathā viṣṇūn sahasravadanān śubhān || 1 15 || paśya sarveśvarān mātarmahāviṣṇuṃ vilokaya | paśya mātarhi bhūmānaṃ pareśvaraṃ vimānagam || 116 || koṭīśvarayutaṃ paśya pradyumnaṃ cāniruddhakam | paśya mātastathā vāsudevaṃ kuṭumbakānvitam || 11 7|| prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ paśya sarvatattvānvitaṃ tataḥ | paśya mātaśceśvarāṇāṃ vāditravādakām̐stataḥ || 11 8|| paśya mātaśceśvarāṇīmaṇḍalāni tataḥ param | vimānasthāni garuḍasthāni hastigatāni ca || 11 9|| rathasthāni paśya mātaḥ pārṣadāṇīrvibhūṣitāḥ | aho mātastataḥ paśya bhagavantaṃ sanātanam || 2.290.120 || matsyarūpaṃ kūrmarūpaṃ tataḥ paśya nṛsiṃhakam | vārāhaṃ ca tataḥ paśya haṃsaṃ hariṃ vilokaya || 121 || kapilaṃ ca tataḥ paśya pṛthuṃ paśya tataḥ param | dattātreyaṃ tataḥ paśya ṛṣabhaṃ paśya vāmanam || 122 || parśurāmaṃ tataḥ paśya yajñaṃ paśya tataḥ param | rāmaṃ paśya tato mātarhayagrīvaṃ vilokaya || 123 || nāradaṃ paśya mātarvai rājarājaṃ vilokaya | vyāsaṃ śvetaṃ paśya mātarbuddhaṃ paśyāśvinīsutam || 1 24|| dhanvantariṃ tataḥ paśya paśya nārāyaṇān bahūn | koṭivimānagān paśya pārṣadām̐statpriyām̐stataḥ || 125 || paśya mātastato muktān dhāmadhāmanivāsinaḥ | paśya mātarhi muktānīḥ sāṃkhyayogavatīstathā || 126 || paśya mātarbrahmasakhīrbrahmapriyāstathāparāḥ | catvāriṃśadūrdhvaśataṃ ṣaṭkaṃ paśya ca yoṣitām || 127 || rādhāṃ lakṣmīṃ ramāṃ padmāvatīṃ śrīṃ māṇikīṃ tathā | kārṣṇīḥ paśyaitā mātaste gṛhaṃ sarvāḥ samāgatāḥ || 128 || mādhavī suguṇā hāsā dayā śāntā sumāmbikā | campā haimī muktikā devikā lalantikā jayā || 1 29||| anyāśca śataśo mātastvāgatāḥ paśya te gṛham | kṛṣṇākṛṣṭāḥ kṛṣṇajīvāstvatputrīsvasṛbhāvanāḥ || 2.290.130 || mātaḥ paśya mahāntaṃ vai vimānaṃ gajavāhanam | yatra pitā ca mātā ca bhrātaraśca kuṭumbakam || 131 || śrīharestu samāste vai koṭisūryasamaprabham | paśya mātastato divyaṃ sahasragajavāhitam || 13 2|| vimānaṃ kalaśāḍhyaṃ vai sahasraśikharānvitam | sahasrāyutayānaiśca samantāt parivāritam || 132 || koṭisaubhāgyavatībhirvardhitaṃ sevitaṃ tathā | vīkṣitaṃ divyaśobhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇakāntaṃ vilokaya || 134|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇakam | śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vallabhaṃ sarvaṃ svāmiśrīkṛṣṇarūpiṇam || 1 35|| bhrātṛjāyādibhiścāpi svasṛbhiścābhivardhitam | puruṣottamamevainaṃ sarvāvirbhāvakāraṇam || 1 36|| aho mātastava bhāgyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati | kṛṣṇāyatī cedṛśī vai na bhūtā na bhaviṣyati || 1 37|| paśyamātastataḥ kṛṣṇayātīsthamahīmānakān | sarvalokabhavān cāśvavārān paśya ca koṭiśaḥ || 1 38|| paśya mātastato gītikāriṇīrvarayoṣitaḥ | bhaumī sarvā bhūṣitāśca paśya tataśca darśakān || 139 || śrīgirijovāca aho me paramaṃ bhāgyaṃ cakṣurme bālakṛṣṇake | niruddhaṃ ṛk na paśyāmi cetaraṃ vada mā nviha || 2.290.140|| dhanyā putrī mama jātā yadarthaṃ tvīśvarā iha | yāmi śīghraṃ svāgatārthaṃ cāyāhi maṇḍapāntikam || 141 || ityuktvā rādhikeḥ sā tu himajā tūrṇameva ha | sammānārthaṃ svāgatārthaṃ tvadhaścāvātarad gṛhe || 142|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrīśāṃkarīdevyai ṛgvedena kṛṣṇayātīvarṇitamahīmānaparicayaḥ prakārita ityādinirūpaṇanāmā navatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 290 ||
<2.291> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike kṛṣṇavāhinyāṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā tu koṭiśaḥ | strīgaṇāḥ mumuhuścāti yuvānaṃ parameśvaram || 1 || koṭitejobhirāpūrṇaṃ koṭilāvaṇyaśobhanam | koṭyānandabharaṃ puṣṭaṃ koṭibhūṣaṇabhūṣitam || 2 || koṭisadguṇavāsaṃ ca koṭikāmabhṛtaṃ prabhum | vīkṣya vīkṣya navā nāryastallīnāḥ sthiradṛṣṭayaḥ || 3 || yāvatyaḥ kanyakāścāpi saṃbabhūvuḥ samādhigāḥ | api narāśca lokāśceśvarāśca līnatāṃ gatāḥ || 4 || devāḥ sarve’pi mumuhuryoṣitāṃ tatra kā kathā | sādhavo yoginaścāpi muktāśca pārṣadā api || 5 || mumuhuryatayaścāpi muktānīnāṃ tu kā kathā | mahāmāyā pradhānaṃ ca prakṛtirdhāmayoṣitaḥ || 6 || mohinyaścāpi mumuhurlaukikīnāṃ tu kā kathā | ājanābhyo yuvatyaśca kṛṭumbasahitā yayuḥ || 7 || darśanārthaṃ sotsukā vai provāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti | tā api mumuhustatra pareśe paramātmani || 8 || rājāno rājakanyāśca daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ | kṛṣṇayānyāgatāścāpi niścikyustaṃ nijeśvaram || 9 || prajākanyāstathā tatra daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ | niścikyuḥ śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ ceśaṃ naijaṃ vimohitāḥ || 2.291.10 || tatparāśca samāsan vai kaṇṭhamālāḥ pragṛhya ca | vahnisākṣye bhaviṣyāmo dāsyaḥ kṛṣṇasya cārpitāḥ || 11 ityevaṃ koṭyarbudā vai kanyakāstatparāstadā | sarvasajjīkṛtāveṣāḥ pratīkṣante tu maṃgalam || 12| vidyādharyaḥ koṭiśaśca mumuhurvīkṣya mādhavam | apsarasaḥ koṭiśaśca mumuhurvīkṣya keśavam | |13 || gāndharvyaśca koṭiśo’pi mumuhurvīkṣya cācyutam | kinnaryaśca koṭiśo’pi samuhurvīkṣya kāmadam || 14|| nartakyaḥ koṭiśaścāpi mumuhurvīkṣya māyinam | śilpinyo mumuhuścāpi vādinyo mumuhustathā || 1 5|| puṣpiṇyo mumuhuścāpi yatinyaḥ koṭiśastathā | sādhvyaśca mumuhuścāpi sanyāsinyaśca koṭiśaḥ || 16 || mumuhurbrahmacāriṇyo viprāṇyo mumuhustathā | bālakṛṣṇaṃ vīkṣya rādhe mumoha sakalaṃ jagat || 17 || kāściddhariṃ pravīkṣyaiva tvākṛṣṭāḥ keśavaṃ prati | kaścit tatkalagiṃ vīkṣya sauvarṇatāntavī sthirām || 18|| piśaṃgīṃ kiraṇairvyāptāṃ sthirāstatraiva cābhavan | lakṣmyāśrayaṃ ca mukuṭaṃ sauvarṇaṃ koṭihīrakam || 19 || naikaratnamaṇivyāptaṃ sūryavadbhāsvaraṃ śubham | vīkṣya kāścittatra lagnāḥ sthirā magnāstathābhavan || 2.291.20 || kaścinmukuṭasaṃsthām̐śca ratnahārān sumasrajaḥ | puṣpapaṃktīśca kalikāḥ śekharān puṣparājikāḥ || 21 || pradānasūcakān vīkṣya mumuhustatra ca sthirāḥ | kāścitkeśān mañjulām̐śca cākacikyaprabhānvitān || 22|| kṛṣṇān vakrān bhaṅgikāḍhyān sūkṣmān netraharānśubhān | sugandhitailapānām̐ścākarṇāgrakṛtatoraṇān || 23 || paścabhāge chādakām̐śca vīkṣya prakīrṇakasthitān | dantikābhiḥ saṃskṛtām̐śca samīkṛtān samāntakān |||24|| prāntapiśaṃgakān vīkṣya mumuhustatra susthirāḥ | kāścittejaḥparidhiṃ ca vīkṣya mahāntamujjvalam ||25|| antaḥparidhisāhasraṃ koṭikiraṇabhābhṛtam | bahuraṃgaṃ miṣṭakṛṣṭicamatkārabhṛtaṃ śubham ||26 || divyaṃ vīkṣya ca tatraiva mumuhuścābhavan sthirāḥ | kāścidbhālaṃ pravīkṣyaiva viśālaṃ tvardhacandravat |||27|| ujjvalaṃ tvekarekhāḍhyaṃ prāntayoścandrabhābhṛtam | madhye sūryasamaṃ bhāsvat projjvalaṃ connataṃ matam ||28|| puṣṭaṃ ramyaṃ manohāri vīkṣya mugdhāḥ sthirāstadā | kāściccandraṃ kauṃkumaṃ ca madhye sthitaṃ suśobhanam ||29|| vālasūryasamaṃ vīkṣya mugdhāḥ striyo’bhavan sthirāḥ | kāścid vīkṣya sutilakaṃ cordhvapuṇḍraṃ hi kānakam ||2.291.3 0|| svarṇavarṇaṃ cāndanaṃ ca kauṃkumaṃ miśritaṃ tanu | tatraiva mugdhā abhavan sthirānandabharāstadā |||3 1 || kāścittu prāntayorvīkṣya patrike cāndanīkṛte | madhye kuṃkumasūkṣmālpabindvībāhulyaśobhite ||32|| tāsveva mumuhurnāryaḥ patryāṃ bindvīṣu ca sthirāḥ | kāścid bhrūyugale ramye kāmakammānikātmake ||33|| sūkṣmanīlāticañcatsadromāvalivirājite | prāntatanusūkṣmakāgre mugdhāstatrābhavan sthirāḥ ||34|| kāścid bhruvormadhyayoge śvetatejovirājite | cāndrapiṇḍasamaśobhe mumuhustatra ca sthirāḥ ||35|| kāścid bhrūnimnabhāge ca nāsāmūle manohare | cakṣuṣormadhyake dyotamāne mumuhuḥ susthirā || 36|| kāścittilasumābhāṃ ca nāsikāṃ vīkṣya bhābhṛtām | namaṇīṃ ramaṇīṃ nimnāṃ tatra mugdhāstathā sthirāḥ ||37|| kāścid golakapolau ca raṃgaśobhau surañjitau | madhyonnatau sugolau ca cumbanārhau saratnakau || 38|| hāsyabhṛtau connatau ca sūryacandrābhakāntikau | prapuṣṭau madavāhau ca vīkṣya mugdhāstathā sthirāḥ || 39|| kāścinnetre cākarṇāntāyate madanavāsite | tīkṣṇakoṇe premavāhe ceṅgitasūcake bhare||2.291.40|| raktarekhe kajjalāḍhye śvetagole ca cañcale | kṛṣṇakanīnike ramye bhāvajñe bhāvabodhake ||41 || caikāntabodhake cāntaśceṣṭāpramāṇapūrite | ākarṣake mohabhṛte meṣonmeṣavirājite ||42|| sūkṣmaromāvalirājadrakṣikāchajjikāyute | jagatāṃ sarvasṛṣṭīnāṃ pratibimbāśraye śubhe ||43|| sāgarau premasaritāṃ nidhāne sarvatejasām | sarvapramāṇasaṃsthāne mumuhustatra ca sthirāḥ ||44|| kāścicca karṇayoḥ śaṣkulikāsaṃsthānayostadā | svarṇakuṇḍalasauvarṇaphullikāsvarṇacippibhiḥ ||45|| svarṇaśṛṃkhalikābhiśca ratnanaddhasthalaistathā | yuktayoścandrabhayośca mumuhustatra ca sthirāḥ ||46|| kāścittu buṭṭikāṃ vīkṣya svarṇasthalavirājitām | tatraiva mohamāpannāḥ sthirāstatrābhavan striyaḥ ||47|| kāścid vīkṣyordhvakauṣṭhasya pṛṣṭhaṃ sauvarṇakojjvalam | sūkṣmātisūkṣmaromāliṃ kāmasambodhakāriṇīm ||48|| śmaśrulekhāṃ piṃgavarṇāṃ mumuhustatra susthirāḥ | kāścidoṣṭhaṃ samasaṃsthānakaṃ dīrghaṃ yathocitam ||49||| raktabhṛtaṃ pakvabimbaphalābhaṃ rasasaṃbhṛtam | cumbanārhaṃ cośyarasaṃ madhye dhanuṣyamadhyavat ||2.291.50|| prāntayordhanuṣaḥ prāntau yathā tathā sughaṭṭitam | sarveṣāṃ dhanuṣāṃ rūpaṃ dadhatpremanidhānakam ||51 || īṣatkuñcatpremabhāvabodhakaṃ hāsyamandiram | prasannatāśrayaṃ ramyaṃ tāmbūlarasarājitam ||52|| kvacit kvacicca dantaiśca kvacicca jihvayā tathā | kvaciccādharakauṣṭhena vidhāpita sucumbanam ||53|| madhyabindau nimnabhāgaṃ nāsā daṇḍikayā kṛtam | ūrdhvauṣṭhaṃ vīkṣya vai kāntā mumuhustatra ca sthirāḥ ||54|| sugandhasambhṛtaṃ śvāsaṃ cehamānaṃ striyo’parāḥ | prasarantaṃ sarvadikṣu sugandhayantamīśvarān ||55|| mādayantaṃ śāntayantaṃ ghrātvā mugdhāstathā sthirāḥ | adharauṣṭhaṃ raktavarṇaṃ tāmbūlarasavedinam ||56 || adharauṣṭhasakhāyaṃ taṃ vīkṣya mugdhāḥ striyaḥ sthirāḥ | cibukaṃ svarṇacibukapiṃgabinduvirājitam ||57|| śobhanaṃ samasaṃsthānaṃ yogyanimnatvaśobhanam | samanikāsahanusaṃśobhāvardhitasundaram ||58|| divyaṃ navanītakābhaṃ sthalapadmākṛti prabham | vīkṣya nāryo mumuhuśca kṛtvā hṛdyabhavan sthirāḥ ||59||| kambukaṇṭhaṃ susvaraṃ ca hanvadhaḥ puṣṭapeśikāḥ | galaṃ puṣṭaṃ yathāghaṭṭaṃ mumuhurvīkṣya ca sthirāḥ |||2.291.60|| siṃhaskandhau harervīkṣya puṣṭau balabhṛtau tathā | vīkṣya kāścittu mumuhuḥ sthirāstatrābhavam̐stadā ||6 1 || kāścid vīkṣyonnataṃ puṣṭaṃ viśālaṃ vakṣa uttamam | dugdhacampakabhāvyāptaṃ sarvabalāśrayaṃ śubham ||62|| naratvāvedakaṃ śūramanaḥkṣobhakaraṃ kṣaṇam | nāryabhivāñchitaṃ rādhāramāśleṣavibhāvitam || 63 || svarṇarekhāyutaṃ romṇāṃ dakṣāvartasamanvitam | śrīvātsalyabhṛtaṃ sūryacandrābhastanarājitam ||64|| āyataṃ cāpi vai dīrghaṃ dṛḍhabandhavibhāsitam | kukṣikomalatāyuktaṃ pārśvamārdavasuspṛśam || 65|| pṛṣṭhavaṃśadṛḍhasthānaṃ bāhumūlātiśobhanam | evaṃvidhaṃ harervakṣaḥsthalaṃ sukhasthalaṃ param ||66 || sampatsaukhyasamīhāḍhyaṃ vīkṣya vai sundarīgaṇāḥ | mumuhuścāti tatraivābhavan magnāḥ sukhasthirāḥ ||67|| sauvarṇaṃ kaṇṭhalaṃ kaṇṭhe bhūṣaṇaṃ ratnaghaṭṭitam | tathā sauvarṇapatrīṃ ca śṛṃkhalāṃ kānakīṃ tathā ||68 || plakṣapatrīṃ ca sauvarṇīṃ pañcasarīṃ ca kānakīm | badarīmālikāṃ svarṇāṃ gokṣurāṇāṃ srajaṃ tathā ||69 || sauvarṇī sūkṣmapatrīṃ ca mālikāṃ mudgamālikām | yavamālāṃ kānakīṃ ca kānakīṃ rājamāṣikām ||2.291.7 0 || kānakaṃ pūrttalāyaṃ ca tvaṣṭakoṇamaṇisrajam | kaṇṭhikāṃ taulasīṃ svarṇasūkṣmamaṇiprakaṇṭhikām ||7 1 || mālikāṃ kānakīṃ cāpi pauṣpān hārān sugandhakān | sauvarṇabuṭṭakauśeyakañcukopari saṃsthitān ||72 || dhṛtān hārān maṇiratnahīrakādivirājitān | mauktikām̐śca dhṛtān hārān kaustubhān vīkṣya vai striyaḥ || 73 || candrakāntān sūryakāntān vahnikāntān maṇīn śubhān | vīkṣya kaṇṭhe dhṛrtauṃstatra mumuhurvai surastriyaḥ ||74|| anyāḥ sarvāśca mumuduḥ kṣaṇaṃstatrābhavan sthirāḥ | bhujau pṛṣṭhau ca kadalīgarbhābhau śobhanaujjvalau | |75 || pūrtadravyau kaṭakāḍhyau śṛṃkhalābhivirājitau | siṃhānanabhujabandhābhūṣāvirājitau śubhau ||76 || vīkṣya nāryo hi mumuhuḥ sthirāstatrābhavan kṣaṇam | prakoṣṭhau kāmaphalakau svarṇaśṛṃkhalikānvitau ||77 || maṇimauktikaratnāḍhyamāṃgalyabhūṣaṇānvitam | puṣpaśṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyaṃ vīkṣya mugdhāḥ striyaḥ sthirāḥ ||78|| hastatale yāvakābhe nakhān raktabharām̐stathā | hrasvacandranibhān vīkṣyāṅgulīścāṃgulikāsrajaḥ ||79 || yuktāstathā kānakāṅgulīyakairmaṇiratnajaiḥ | ūrmikābhiḥ śobhitāśca mṛduraktāgrikāḥ striyaḥ ||2.291.8 0 || suparvāḍhyāḥ sukhasparśā vīkṣya mugdhāstathā sthirāḥ | hastayoḥ pañcajau ramyau nīlabindvīsamanvitau ||81 || vīkṣya nāryo mumuhuśca sthirāstatra tadābhavan | dakṣe hastatale vīkṣya mīnaṃ dhvajaṃ triśūlakam ||82|| dhanurbāṇaṃ svastikaṃ ca vajraṃ daṇḍaṃ ca cakrakam | gadāṃ padmaṃ śaṃkhamasiṃ khaḍgaṃ sauvarṇaśobhitam ||83|| mumuhurvai striyaḥ sarvāḥ sthirāstatra tadābhavan | khaḍgādhānaṃ bhinnamaṇinaddhaṃ carma tathāvidham ||84|| vīkṣyāpi mumuhuḥ sarvāḥ kaṇṭhe maṃgalasūtrakam | bhuje maṃgalatantuṃ ca vīkṣya mugdhāḥ surastriyaḥ ||85||| jihvāṃ raktāṃ svādayogyāṃ sarvasvādabhṛtāṃ striyaḥ | viśālāṃ mohakāgrāṃ ca sthalapadmanibhābhikām ||86|| dantān hāsye kundadalīsamān dāḍimabījabhāna | śvetakāntiyutān cañcatprabhān vīkṣya ca mohitāḥ ||87|| spṛhāṃ cakrurhi labdhyarthaṃ sthirāstatrābhavam̐stathā | trivalyā sahitaṃ ramyamudaraṃ projjvalaṃ śubham ||88|| śītalaṃ nimnanābhyā ca madhyavallyāḍhyayā yutam | vīkṣya tatra ca mumuhuḥ sthirāstatrābhavaṃstadā ||89|| ārdhabhedena ca dhṛtaṃ sauvarṇapaṭakaṃ gale | skandhe lambatprāntabhāgaṃ vīkṣya mugdhāḥ sthirāstadā ||2.291.90 || kāścid dhyātvā tu jaghanaṃ guptaṃ cāpi kaṭidvayam | śyāmalaṃ mumuhustatra kaṭyāṃ baddhe tathāmbare ||9 1 || sauvarṇatārayukte ca bahumūlyakabuṭṭake | suravāle rājayogye kauśeyavaranirmite ||92|| koṭiratnāśrite svarṇabuṭṭimauktikayojite | phullaphummakikāyuktanāḍikābhipraveśite ||93|| dhṛte cāpādaramye ca mumuhuryuvatīstriyaḥ | sarvakāmāśraye kāmye tvantaraṃge’khilāḥ striyaḥ ||94|| sarvamohāśraye mugdhā vividurnetarat kṣaṇam | kammānikānibhe ramye pādaprakoṣṭhakāgrataḥ ||951|| pādayoḥ pañcajau bhāgau sūkṣmaromavirājitau | mṛdupānahsusaṃyuktau svarṇaśobhālisaṃvṛtau ||96 || rañjitau saṃpravīkṣyaiva mugdhāḥ striyaḥ sthirāstathā | sakthnoḥ sakthimūlamadhye’naṅge’timumuhuḥ striyaḥ ||97|| aṃgulikāḥ svarṇabhūṣormikā vīkṣya tathā striyaḥ | kiṃkiṇikāyutau vīkṣya sauvarṇau pādabhūṣaṇau | kaṭakau jhaṃjharīnālau troṭakau mumuhuḥ sthirāḥ ||98|| ājānulambahastau ca jaghane kariśuṇḍhavat | karabhau karagau karikaravad vīkṣya yoṣitaḥ || 99|| mumuhustatra ca sthirā abhavan vai samādhigāḥ | gajavimānage svarṇasihāsane mṛdusthale || 2.291.100 || āsīnaṃ rājarājeśarājarājaṃ varaṃ prabhum | vīkṣya mugdhāḥ striyaḥ sarvā āyāntaṃ gopuraṃ prati || 101 || kuṃkumākṣatabindvāḍhyaṃ vīkṣya śrīparameśvaram | cakrurvai darśanaṃ lokā jayaśabdān jagustathā || 102| evaṃ vai rādhike prāptā mahāntaṃ gopuraṃ prati | vādyanādeśca lokānāṃ manojñā yogayātrikā || 103 || bhāvajño bhagavām̐statra yātrāyāṃ svāsane sthitaḥ | darśanaṃ pradadau tatra vibhinnaṃ śṛṇu rādhike || 1 04|| puruṣottamarūpeṇa muktebhyo darśanaṃ dadau | gopebhyaḥ kṛṣṇarūpeṇa gopībhyo darśanaṃ dadau || 105 || pārṣadebhyo darśanaṃ nārāyaṇātmatayā dadau | īśvarebhyo vāsudevarūpeṇa darśanaṃ dadau || 1 06|| siddhasādhugaṇebhyaśca viṣṇurūpeṇa tad dadau | maharṣibhyastadā brahmātmanā svaṃ darśanaṃ dadau || 10 7|| pitṛbhyaścāryamarūpātmanā svaṃ darśanaṃ dadau | surebhyaḥ kṣīranāthātmanāpi svaṃ darśanaṃ dadau || 108 || mānavebhyo naranārāyaṇātmanā ca tad dadau | pātālavāsilokebhyaḥ śvetaprabhvātmanā dadau || 109 || nārībhyaḥ kāmadevātmarūpeṇa darśanaṃ dadau | kanyābhyaḥ svāmirūpeṇa mālādhraṃ darśanaṃ dadau || 2.291.110 || pūjyābhyo bālarūpeṇa kaumāraṃ darśanaṃ dadau | bhaktānāṃ bhagavadrūpaṃ mokṣadaṃ darśanaṃ dadau || 111 || sarvāyudhaṃ caturhastaṃ ramāvṛndaniṣevitam | narebhyo darśanaṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇātmanā dadau || 112|| antarātmasvarūpaṃ cāvedayaddhṛdi dehinām | ityevaṃ rādhike śrīmadbālakṛpṇo hariḥ prabhuḥ || 113 || vijñāto hyadhirājo’sau maṇḍapākhyapurasya ha | gopurāgre cāyayau saṃlebhe sthairyaṃ kṣaṇaṃ tadā || 1 14|| vāhinyapi samagrā ca kṣaṇaṃ tasthau prapūjitā | samīpe tvāgataiḥ śreṣṭhaiḥ kṛṣṇabṛhaspatidvijaiḥ || 115 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne suveṣite śrībālakṛṣṇe pratyekāṃge naranārīṇāṃ vṛttyākarṣaṇena mugdhatā, divyadarśanaṃ, gopuraṃ prati prāgamanaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmaikanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 291 ||
<2.292> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca koṭibhirmunibhiḥ sākaṃ rādhike śrībṛhaspatiḥ | saṃsthito’bhūdakṣatādipūjāpātrairhareḥ puraḥ || 1 || maṇḍapākhyaṃ puraṃ ramyaṃ pañcāśadyojanātmakam | abhivyāpyeśvararājadarśanārthaṃ sthitāḥ prajāḥ || 2 || śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīhariṃ tatra praṇanāma svayaṃ tvaham | brāhmaṇāḥ saṃpraṇemuśca vedamantrān jagustadā || 3 || yavāṃkurān daduścāpi bālakṛṣṇakare tadā | puṣpagucchaṃ dadau kṛṣṇaḥ kare gale ca mālikām || 4 || bṛhaspatiḥ puṣpahāraṃ kādambakaṃ dadau gale | sākṣatakuṃkumacandraṃ bhāle gurustathākarot || 5 || lājābhirvardhayāmāsurnāryaḥ kanyāprapakṣikāḥ | jalapānaṃ dadau tatreśvarāya ca bṛhaspatiḥ || 6 || puraṃ praveśayāmāsa bālakṛṣṇasya vāhinīm | sarvāṃ divyasvarūpāṃ ca dadṛśuḥ sarvathā prajāḥ || 7 || devakanyā nāgakanyā rājakanyāśca yoṣitaḥ | munikanyāśceśakanyāḥ prapaśyantīśvaraṃ harim || 8 || paśyanti yoṣitaḥ sarvā nimeṣarahitena vai | śivasvāmī prapūjārthaṃ gopurāgre samāyayau || 9 || prapūjya kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭvā prasannaṃ pracakāra ha | vasuṃ ca pitaraṃ cāpi tathānyānmahīmānakān || 2.292.10 || mahīmānastriyo nemuḥ prapaśya parameśvaram | prasannavadanaṃ kāntaṃ manoharaṃ surūpiṇam || 11 || sarvaśobhānvitaṃ pūjya sarveṣṭaṃ hṛdayaṃgamam | ratnendrasāraśobhāḍhyabhūvimānasthitaṃ prabhum || 12| sarveṣāṃ paramātmānaṃ bhaktānugrahagocaram | navīnacāndradhavalaṃ śobhitaṃ hārarājibhiḥ || 13 || candanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ bahumālāvibhūṣitam | ratnakeyūravalayaratnamālābhirujjvalam || 14|| ratnakuṇḍalabhūṣābhirgaṇḍasthalīvirājitam | ratnendrasāranirmāṇakvaṇanmaṃjirarañjitam || 15|| sasmitaṃ gucchahastaṃ ca paśyantaṃ ratnadarpaṇam | muktaiḥ saṃsevitaṃ śvetacāmaraiśchatrakena ca || 16 || pārśve svataḥprakāśena mukhyeśvareṇa rājitam | navayauvanasampannaṃ śaratkamalalocanam || 17|| śaratpūrṇendutulyāsyaṃ sarvānugrahakārakam | koṭikandarpasaundaryaṃ cākṣarātītamacyutam || 18|| tīrthapūtaṃ kīrtipūtaṃ sureśvarādivanditam | paramāhlādakaṃ deveśvaraṃ saundaryaśevadhim || 1 9|| dūrvayā paṭṭasūtraṃ ca kadalyāḥ sphuṭamañjarīm | dadhānaṃ ca pracūḍāyāṃ mālamālyābhimālikām ||2.292.20 || puṣpaṃ nārīpradattaṃ ca sugandhigucchamuttamam | etādṛśaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā mūrcchāmāpuḥ striyastadā || 2 1|| lakṣmyāstu jīvanaṃ dhanyaṃ ślāghyamityūcurīpsitam | himajā śrīḥ dadarśāpi tārakaṃ taṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 22|| śiveśvaraḥ viprayuktaḥ sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ | samāgatya nanāmāpi devadevaṃ hariṃ prabhum ||23|| vasvagre maṇḍape dīrghe kārayāmāsa nartanam | nartakānāṃ cātiramyaṃ gāndharvāṇāṃ ca gāyanam ||24|| gāyikānāṃ gītikāśca nartakīnāṃ ca nṛtyakam | vādyānāṃ śabdabhedām̐śca kārayāmāsa vai puraḥ || 25|| āsphoṭānāṃ sphoṭanāni vidyutkhelanakāni ca | yantrāṇāṃ sphoṭananādān dundubhīnāṃ sugarjanāḥ ||26|| kārayāmāsa vāhinyāścāgre tvagre śivastadā | vardhayāmāsurevāpi prajāḥ śrībālakṛṣṇakam || 27|| evaṃ tadā puṇyayātrā viśrāntigṛhamāyayau | kṛṣṇo vimānakāt samuttīrya gopuramāsthitaḥ || 28|| pārvatyā vardhito duḥkhahāñjalibhiḥ punaḥ punaḥ | tīrthajalena caraṇau prakṣālitau harestu vai ||29|| candanākṣatapuṣpādyaiḥ pūjito maṃgaladravaiḥ | yavāṃkuraiśca dūrvābhiḥ pūjitaśca sugandhikaiḥ ||2.292.3 0|| lājābhiśca tathā nīrājanaiḥ sampūjitastadā | vipraiśca guruṇā cāśīrvākyaiḥ saṃvardhitastadā ||3 1|| prokṣitaśca tataḥ pārśve viśrāntimandire kṣaṇam | svarṇasihāsane nītvā sarvaśāntiprade śubhe ||32|| hariṃ niṣādayāmāsa tathā sarvāgryapūjyakān | pitarau śivadeveśca pupūja svāgatena ha ||3 3 || bhojanaṃ madhuparkākhyaṃ jalapānena saṃyutam | dadau tadā śivasvāmī śāntyarthaṃ vyāvahārikam ||34|| tadā kanyāḥ koṭiśo’pi naijaṃ śṛṃgāramādadhuḥ | yogayogyāmbarabhūṣā dhārayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||35|| gandhasugandhadehāśca raṃgarāgayutāstathā | bindubindvīyutāścāpi sajjāstadābhavan sthitāḥ || 36 || pratīkṣante yadā lakṣmyāḥ dānaṃ harirgrahīṣyati | tadāsmākaṃ karān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo grahīṣyati ||37|| iti lakṣmyāśca śṛṃgāraṃ sakhyastadā vyadhuḥ śubham | nakhān vai rañjayāmāsuḥ sthalapadmanibhān śubhān || 38|| alaktakena karayoḥ pādayośca talānyapi | oṣṭhau raktena raṃgeṇa rañjayāmāsureva ca || 39 || kuṃkumakardamenāpi kapolau dvau ca karṇakau | locane kajjalenāpi tvañjayāmāsureva ha ||2.292.40 || lalāṭaṃ kaisareṇāpi candanena suśobhitam | dehaṃ ca candanenāpi cakruḥ sugandhisaṃbhṛtam ||4 1 || gandhasāraistathā dehaṃ sugandhāḍhyaṃ vyadhuśca tāḥ | keśān prasādhayāmāsustailasāreṇa gandhinā ||42|| kabarīṃ ca pracakrustāḥ śobhanāmujjvalāṃ śubhām | dhammilaṃ bandhayāmāsuḥ sthalapadmasraganvitam ||43|| sukundakalikāhārayuktaṃ ca paritastathā | mālatīpuṣpasaṃyuktaṃ gumphitaṃ citratantubhiḥ ||44|| prānte ramyāmbarakhaṇḍaṃ kauśeyaṃ citraśobhitam | pārijātaprasūnānāṃ śekhareṇa virājitam ||45 || sauvarṇamaṇimālābhirgolāyitaṃ śubhāspadam | candrakāntamaṇiṃ tatra nyadhuḥ prakāśahetave ||46 || sūryakāntaṃ brahmarandhrasthale nyadhuśca taijasam | strīyogyaṃ sumukuṭaṃ tā nyadhuśca mastakopari ||47|| maṇihārakaratnāḍhyaṃ sauvarṇaṃ raṃgaraṃgitam | śekharāstatra lambante maṇimauktikapuṣpajāḥ ||48 || tantikā svarṇapārāṇāṃ bahuratnādigumphitā | bhāle tā dhārayāmāsuḥ kārayāmāsureva ca ||49 || madhye sucandrikābindvīṃ kāśmīreṇa draveṇa ha | sākṣatāṃ ca tathā viśālake bhāle ca kaisarīḥ || 2.292.50 || rekhā vakrā vyadhuścordhvāḥ koṇavakrāḥ śubhāstadā | madhye madhye catuṣkyāṃ ca bindvīścakruśca kauṃkumīḥ || 51 || cākacakyakaraṃ cūrṇaṃ manāg vikīritaṃ vyadhuḥ | puṣpahārān nidadhuśca dānayogyān hi maṃgale || 52|| sauvarṇīṃ mauktikāḍhyāṃ ca natthikāṃ sumanoharām | dhārayāmāsurevāpi svalpāṃ ca śreṣṭhavālikām ||53 || cibukaṃ harikāḍhyaṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ pradadustathā | bindvīṃ gāle daduścāpi karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale daduḥ ||54|| īrike’pi ca sauvarṇe hīrakādisamanvite | daduśca karṇayoḥ pañcasarike karṇaśṛṃkhale || 55|| sūkṣmahīrakasannaddhe phullike patrike daduḥ | sauvarṇīṃ kaṇṭhahaṭhikāṃ maṇinaddhāṃ dadustadā ||56|| kauśeyīṃ kucabandhīṃ ca kauśeyakīṃ ca kaṃcukīm | svarṇabuṭṭāliśobhāḍhyāṃ svarṇatārālisaṃbhṛtām || 57 | | divyahīrakaratnādigumphitāṃ hīragranthitām | keśācalī nidadhuśca skandhayościpikānvitām | |558 | | sauvarṇarūpyakajanyāṃ śalākāṃ bandhikāṃ daduḥ | orṇīṃ sauvarṇatārāḍhyāṃ kārpaṭiko dadustathā | | 59 | | rañjitāṃ raktaśobhāḍhyāṃ kucayoḥ kuṃkumaṃ daduḥ | śāṭīṃ svarṇamayīṃ ramyāṃ sūkṣmahīrakasaṃbhṛtām | | 2.292.60 | | sūkṣmatāramayīṃ mṛdvīṃ dhārayāmāsurutsukāḥ | kaṃsadorakabandhādyairbandhayāmāsurambaram || 61 | | cippiṭaiḥ sūkṣmarūpābhiḥ śalākābhistathāntaram | bhujāntare tathā vakṣo’ntare kaṭyantare’mbaram || 62 | | bandhayāmāsurevāpi daduścāntaraghargharīm | mahatīṃ ghargharīṃ cāpi sauvarṇatāragumphitām || 63 | | harikaiḥ svalpakādarśairmaṇibhiḥ khacitāṃ śubhām | raktavarṇāṃ citrayuktāṃ prāntapiśaṃginīṃ tathā | | 6 4|| kaṭyāṃ kaisarapaṭṭyāḍhyāṃ saṃhitahīranāḍikām | pādayośca daduḥ pattrāṇike makhamalātmike | | 65 | | komale sthalapadmābhe sauvarṇaratnagumphite | aṃgulīyakamevāpi pratyaṃgulaṃ saśṛṃkhalam | | 66 | | paṃcāṃgulapraparyāptaṃ sauvarṇaṃ ca dadustadā | pañcajayoścordhvabhāge sauvarṇīṃ kacchapīṃ daduḥ || 67 | | ūrmikā api nidadhurhīrakādisamanvitāḥ | padmakaṃ hastake cāpi nupūre patprakoṣṭhayoḥ || 68 | | sauvarṇe siṃhaśobhāḍhye kiṃkiṇījālanādite | kāmbike ca tathā kaṭakike māṇikyasaṃyute | | 69 | | mañjīrake ca sauvarṇe daduḥ prakoṣṭhayoḥ śriyāḥ | raśanāṃ cāpi sauvarṇīṃ kaṭyāṃ daduḥ samauktikīm | | 2.292.70 | | kaṭake hīrakanaddhe vyaṃgiḍikāḥ suvarṇajāḥ | ratnahīrakasannaddhāḥ śṛṃgale tu prakoṣṭhayoḥ ||7 1 | | padmakāḍhye kaṃkaṇe ca valayāni dadustathā | bhujabandhau kānakau ca maṃgale dalake daduḥ ||72 || sauvarṇe śubhakaṭake daduśca śṛṃkhale’pi ca | svastikaṃ kānakaṃ cāpi candrakaṃ bhujayordaduḥ | | 73 || kaṇṭhe hemamayān hārān ratnahīrakaśobhitān | mudgamālāṃ yavamālāṃ jambūmālāṃ dadustathā | |74 || plakṣapatraṃ kānakaṃ ca kaṇṭhīṃ mauktikamālikām | saptaśṛṃkhalikāhāraṃ sūkṣmapatrīṃ śubhāṃ nyadhuḥ ||75 || catuṣkikādalīṃ mālāṃ badrīmālāṃ ca māṣikām | hīrakaiḥ saṃbhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ koṭimūlyāṃ ca taijasīm ||76 | | sarvaśobhākarīṃ netracaurīṃ paṭṭikakañcukīm | dhārayāmāsurevāpi naktakaṃ karayordaduḥ ||77 || iti śṛṃgāritā kanyā lakṣmīrlakṣmīsakhījanaiḥ | sarvāḥ kanyāḥ koṭiśo’pi śṛṃgāritāstadābhavan ||78|| udvahiṣyati naḥ kṛṣṇo suyoge kṛṣṇayoriti | atha vādyānyavādyanta sarvāṇi vasuyātriṇām ||79|| āpte śubhe kṣaṇe śreṣṭhe nakṣatre maṃgalāvahe | sarvasaubhāgyade yoge māhendre sampadāṃ prade ||2.292.80 || mahānandaprade śreṣṭhodaye siddhisamanvite | lagneśānvitasaṃllagne prodvāhocitaśobhane ||8 1 || sadgrahāṇāṃ dṛṣṭiśuddhe cāsatāṃ dṛṣṭivarjite | candratārāśuddhiyukte vedhadoṣādivarjite ||82|| śalākādikahīne ca sadā sukhaprade kṣaṇe | dampatyoḥ sukhayogye ca samaye bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||83 || āyayau śivadevasya kailāsamāḍapāṅgaṇam | bṛhaspatinā vipraiścarṣibhirniśyarthito hariḥ | |84 || lomaśādyaiśca sahito jñātibhirbāndhavaiḥ saha | pitrā mātrā nṛpaiḥ sārdhaṃ sambandhibhiḥ suhṛjjanaiḥ ||85 || suraiśca pitṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ sādhubhiryatibhiḥ saha | pārṣadaiśceśvarairmuktairbhaṭṭaiścāpi purohitaiḥ ||86 || sṛṣṭipālaiḥ samastaiśca vedīmaṇḍapamāyayau | raṃbhāstambhasahasraiśca svarṇapaṭṭavibhūṣitaiḥ ||87|| campakāśokacūtānāṃ candanānāṃ ca toraṇaiḥ | sarvarūpāḍhyapuṣpāṇāṃ mālābhiḥ supariṣkṛtam ||88 || maṃgalasvarṇakalaśaiḥ phalapallavaśobhitaiḥ | kastūrikākṣatairlājādūrvākuṃkumapūjitaiḥ ||89 | | puṣpaiḥ parṇaiścandanaiśca ratnairvastraiḥ samanvitaiḥ | parito bhrājamānaiśca maṇḍitaṃ sumanoharam || 2.292.90 || śaṃbhorvai pakṣagaiḥ sarvairmahīmānaiśca veṣṭitam | pārṣadaiścāvatāraiśca saṃkarṣaṇapurogamaiḥ || 91 || īśvarairdaivatābhiścarṣibhirnṛpairdigīśvaraiḥ | kailāsavāsibhiścāpi sṛṣṭitrayanivāsibhiḥ || 92|| purohitairbrāhmaṇaiśca yatibhiścāvadhūtakaiḥ | gaṇaiśca yoginībhiśca kanyāpitṛbhirityapi || 93 || ratnendrasāranirmāṇavedīyuktaṃ śubhāspadam | raṃgaiścāndanacūrṇaiśca kastūrīkuṃkumādibhiḥ || 94 || sugandhisārakaiścāpi sugandhitaṃ suraṃgitam | nānāmaṇiprabhāvyāptaṃ dhūpasugandhavāsitam ||95|| citraśobhānvitaṃ ramyaṃ gāndharvīgītikāyutam | saṃgītanāditaṃ vidyādharīnṛtyasuśobhitam ||96|| parito yuvatībhiśca vīkṣitaṃ maṃgalāyanam | māṃgalikaṃ ghaṭaṃ dhṛtvā guruṇā ca purodhasā ||97|| śobhitaṃ kalpavallyādirājitaṃ dānamaṇḍapam | kuśahastena bhūpena dānārthaṃ copatiṣṭhatā ||98|| dānavastusahitena śobhitaṃ yajñamaṇḍapam | samantādūrdhvabhāgeṣu koṭyabjakanyakādibhiḥ ||99|| prodvāhyābhirbhūṣitābhiḥ pitrādikayutādibhiḥ | kṛtādhivāsaṃ ramyaṃ taṃ maṇḍapaṃ bālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 2.292.10 0|| mukhyadvāraṃ tvājagāma pūjito vardhito dvijaiḥ | śiveśvarastatra cāgre pūjanārthaṃ samāyayau || 101 || bālakṛṣṇo hi bhagavān samayaṃ prāpya satvaram | sarvā ājñāpayāmāsa kāntā yāḥ svasya tāstadā || 1 02|| mayārpitāni vastrāṇi bhūṣāḥ śṛṃgārakāṇi ca | sarvāṇyudvāhayogyāni dhṛtvāyāntu sumaṇḍape || 103 || udvāho bhavatīnāṃ vai kāryo mayā śriyā saha | śrutvā sarvāḥ sajjībhūyāyayurvṛdhyāpi maṇḍape || 1 04|| svasvapitrādisahitā dānārthaṃ samupasthitāḥ | śivasvāmikṛte naijakanyārthaṃ tu vidhau tadā || 1 05|| sarvāsāṃ vidhirevāsmin vidhau tatrāpyavartata | śṛṇvāścaryaṃ rādhike koṭyarbudābjādhiyoṣitām || 1 06|| kṛte kṛṣṇo yaccamatkārādi tatra vyadarśayat | śiveśvaraḥ karmakāṇḍaṃ prāvartayaddhi sarvataḥ || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bālakṛṣṇasya gopure pūjanaṃ darśanaṃ, tadagre nartanaṃ cāsphoṭanaṃ, viśrāntimandire viśramaṇaṃ madhuparkadānaṃ, sarvakanyakānāṃ lakṣmyāśca śṛṃgāraḥ, devasya tudānamaṇḍapamukhyadvāraṃ pratyāgamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvānavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 292 ||
<2.293> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śiveśvaro mahān bhakto mahimānaṃ vidan hareḥ | rādhike dhanyabhāgyaṃ svaṃ mene gṛṇannidaṃ tadā || 1 || adya me saphalaṃ janma tvadya me saphalāḥ kriyāḥ | adya me saphalaṃ sarvaṃ yadgṛhe puruṣottamaḥ || 2 || adya me jīvanaṃ jātaṃ sarvaṃ suprajīvitam | yajjātaṃ janmakoṭīnāṃ karmamūlalayānvitam || 3 || yatpādapadmaṃ munayo dhyāyanti satataṃ hṛdi | sarvaphalapradātā śrīharirme prāṃgaṇe’dya vai || 4 || sṛṣṭitrayaṃ ca me tvadya prāṃgaṇe tīrthakṛttamam | aho kalpāntaparyantaṃ tīrthībhūtaṃ mamāṃgaṇam || 5 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ | adṛśyaścakṣuṣāmadya dṛśyo me prāṃgaṇe hariḥ || 6 || karmaṇāṃ phaladaṃ taṃ tvāṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam | antaḥsthitaṃ parātmānaṃ madātmānaṃ namāmyaham || 7 || evaṃ stutvā rādhike ca śivastutaṃ smaran harim pādyaṃ padmārcite pādapadme tatra mudā dadau || 8 || arghyaṃ ca pradadau tatra dūrvāpuṣpaphalānvitam | madhuparkaṃ manāk cāpi dadau bhāle sucandrakam || 9 || kuṃkumākṣatakastūrīkṛtaṃ tilakaṃ dadau | cāndanaṃ ca sugandhaṃ ca gandhasāraṃ dadau tanau || 2.293.1 0|| pārijātasya mālāṃ ca svapriyāṃ tad gale dadau | ratnahāraṃ gale cāpi prakoṣṭhe maṇibhūṣaṇam || 11 || vahniśuddhāṃśukedivye mukuṭaṃ bhāsvaraṃ dadau | kuṇḍale kaṭake cāpi śṛṃgalā cormikādikam || 1 2|| ratnacāmarayugalaṃ chatraṃ sauvarṇamityapi | svahīrakahārām̐śca kaustubhasragvibhūṣaṇam || 13 || koṭikoṭisuvarṇāni nyadhād kṛṣṇasya pādayoḥ | dhūpaṃ ratnapradīpaṃ ca tathā nīrājanaṃ dadau || 14|| svarṇasiṃhāsanaṃ ramyaṃ dadau dāne harestu vai | saptatīrthodakaṃ cāpi madhuparkaṃ punastathā || 15|| ācamanaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ jalapānaṃ sugandhi ca | śayyāṃ śreṣṭhatamāṃ cāpi bhūṣaṇāni dadau tadā || 16|| puṣpāṃjaliṃ dadau cāpi nanāma pādayostathā | girijā cāpi taṃ putryāḥ kāntaṃ pupūja cādarāt || 17|| pādaprakṣālanaṃ cakre lājābhiḥ samavardhayat | candanādyaiḥ pupūjāpi svarṇamudrādikaṃ dadau || 18|| gṛhopakaraṇānyevottārayāmāsa mastakāt | kośasya kuñcikāṃ cāpi lekhinīṃ taravārikām || 19|| mūśalaṃ tarkaṭīṃ cāpi mārjanīṃ vellaṇaṃ tathā | darvīṃ ca śṛṃkhalāṃ cāpi kīlakaṃ yaṣṭikāṃ tathā ||2.293.20|| triśūlaṃ cāpi śaṃkhaṃ ca cakraṃ gadāṃ ca carma ca | rajjūṃ kaṃgatikāṃ cāpi darpaṇaṃ kalaśaṃ tathā ||21|| sthālīṃ saubhāgyavaṭikāṃ dūrvāṃ kāṇḍaṃ ca vaṃśikām| phalaṃ cānnaṃ jalaṃ śākaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ samidhaṃ tathā |||22 || evamādīni sarvāṇyuttārayāmāsa mastakāt | kṛṣṇasyaiva tato nīrājanaṃ kṛtvā ca mastakāt ||23 || añjalinā duḥkhahāniṃ cintayāmāsa pañcaṣaḥ | tataḥ praveśayāmāsa dvāraṃ tatra ca bhūtale ||24|| brahmāṇḍasampūṭakaṃ ca kapāladvayanirmitam | māyātantuprabaddhaṃ ca sthāpitaṃ vīkṣya mādhavaḥ ||25|| nyasyopari svapādaṃ tad babhañja ca tato hariḥ | vidhnanāśaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā svarṇasiṃhāsanaṃ varam ||26 || kuṇḍasya sannidhau nyastaṃ jagṛhe tvāsanaṃ hi tat | upāviveśa tatraiva nanāma yūpamityapi ||27|| kalaśaṃ mātṛkāścāpi gaṇeśaṃ devatāstathā | maṇḍapaṃ ca tathā kuṇḍaṃ guruṃ nanāma sarvataḥ ||28|| śiveśvaro dvijāścainaṃ vardhayāmāsurakṣataiḥ | evaṃ vai varaṇaṃ prāptaḥ śuśubhe bhagavān hariḥ ||29|| etasminnantare lakṣmīsukhadā śivaputrikā | ājagāma sakhībhiśca maṇḍape vedikāntikam || 2.293.3 0|| avādyanta suvādyāni cāgīyanta ca gītikāḥ | vedamantradhvanayaścājāyanta vedavedinām ||3 1 || lakṣmīstatrāgatā ramyā mātrā sakhībhiranvitā | bhaktyā padbhyāṃ cāgatā sadratnālaṃkārabhūṣitā || 3 2|| vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā kabarībhārabhūṣitā | sandṛśya darpaṇaṃ sādhvī candanādisugandhitā || 33 || kastūrībindubhiryuktā bhāle sindūrabindunā | taptakāṃcanavarṇābhā tejaḥparidhiśobhanā ||34|| yāvadbhūṣādhāriṇī ca pūjāmālādikānvitā | bhrātrādibhiḥ samāyuktā tvāyayau varasannidhau ||31 || dadṛśustāṃ candratulyāṃ mahīmānāstu koṭiśaḥ | rādhā vai sarvasṛṣṭīnāṃ nārīṣu cojjvalottamā || 36 || tato’pi cojjvalāṃ vīkṣya praśaśaṃsuḥ punaḥ punaḥ | pativratā tu sā lakṣmīḥ praṇamya maṇḍapaṃ tathā ||37|| praṇamya svapatiṃ devān saptapradakṣiṇā vyadhāt | siṣeca śītatoyena snigdhacandanapallavaiḥ ||38|| siṣeca tāṃ bālakṛṣṇaḥ kāntāṃ lakṣmīṃ susasmitām | dadarśa kāntaḥ kāntāṃ tāṃ kāntā kāntaṃ ca satkṣaṇe || 3 9|| tadāścaryaṃ paraṃ jātaṃ rādhike śṛṇu sarvathā | lakṣmīṃ siṣeca bhagavān yadā tadābhiṣecanam ||2.293.40|| prodvāhyānāṃ kanyakānāṃ sarvāsāṃ mastakopari | sarvataścāpatat sarvā harṣitā vai tadābhavan ||41 || tato lakṣmīrniṣasādāsane kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca | vāme sthitvā devapūjāṃ cakāra svāminānvitā ||42|| bṛhaspatirlomaśaśca kārayāmāsatuśca tau | deśakālau prasaṃkīrtya kanyādānasya siddhaye ||43 || caturthyāṃ mārgaśīrṣasya śukle gaṇeśapūjanam | kārayāmāsatuścāpi śrīviṣṇoḥ pūjanaṃ tathā ||44|| rudrasya pūjanaṃ cāpi mātṛkāpūjanaṃ tathā | maṇḍapasya ca devānāṃ yoginīnāṃ ca pūjanam ||45|| grahāṇāṃ dikprapālānāṃ vasūnāṃ cāśvinostathā | ādityānāṃ pūjanaṃ carṣīṇāṃ pitṛdivaukasām ||46|| pūjanaṃ brahmaṇaścāpīśvarāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā | sarveśvarāṇāṃ pūjāṃ ca vighnānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ||47|| kanyārakṣākarāṇāṃ ca rakṣasāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā | vahnīnāṃ kuṇḍadevānāṃ śākhātoraṇavāsinām ||48|| dvāḥsthānāṃ maṇḍapasthānāṃ māṇikyastaṃbhavāsinām | kārayāmāsatuścāpi lakṣmyāśca pūjanaṃ tathā ||49|| pārvatyāḥ pūjanaṃ cāpi hanūmataśca pūjanam | durgāyāḥ pūjanaṃ śrāddhaṃ kārayāmāsatustathā ||2.293.50 || yathā yathā kṛtā pūjā tāṃ prapaśyanti kanyakā | tathā tathā prakurvanti sarvā vai kṛṣṇakanyakāḥ |||51 || ityevaṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā vahniṃ kuṇḍagataṃ tadā | āhavanīyaṃ sampūjya kanyā cotthāya puṣpajām ||52|| kaṇṭhamālāṃ svakāntasya gale nyadhāt suvistṛtām | pādayoḥ praṇanāmāpi lalāṭe kuṃkumākṣataiḥ ||53 || tilakaṃ candrakaṃ cāpi cakāra kusumāṃjalim | tavāsmīti samuvāca niṣasāda nijāsane ||54|| kṛṣṇaścāsyai gale mālāṃ dadau sākṣatakuṃkumam | ārdraṃ dhṛtvā ca bhāle’syāścandrakaṃ pracakāra ha ||55|| kabaryāṃ ca dadāvasyāḥ sindūrakaṃ ca maṃgalam | puṣpāṃjaliṃ dadau cāpi gulālamuṣṭikāṃ dadau ||56|| sāpi gulālaprasṛtiṃ dadau kṛṣṇāya maṃgalām | tataḥ purohitau dānamantrān jagadaturmudā ||57|| sarvā pradānakanyāśca tathaivānupracakrire | kāmaphale dvayorhastaprakoṣṭhayostadā gurū ||58|| babandhatustathā vastraprāntagranthiṃ babandhatuḥ | kaṇṭhamālāṃ dvayoḥ kaṇṭhe tvekāṃ dīrghāṃ pracakratuḥ ||59|| rādhike ca tadā sarvāḥ kanyāḥ koṭyarbudāni tu | vinā kāntaṃ nijāgre ca cintāmāpuḥ kṣaṇaṃ yadā ||2.293.60 || tadā śrībālakṛṣṇo’sau camatkāramadarśayat | koṭirūpadharo jātaḥ koṭikoṭyadhimālikaḥ ||6 1 || yāvatyaḥ kanyakāḥ pūrvamupārjitāśca tāḥ prati | pratikanyaṃ pratikānto babhūvabjasvarūpavān ||62|| yā yā yatra sthitāścāsan tatra tatra vidhānataḥ | yathā lakṣmyā dakṣapārśve sarvāsāṃ pārśvake’bhavat ||63 || kaṇṭhamālāṃ sa jagrāha dadau sindūrakādikam | prakoṣṭhe bandhanaṃ cāpi kāmaphalasya candrakam ||64|| sarvaṃ vai labdhavām̐statra paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām | āścaryaṃ cāparaṃ tatra jātaṃ śṛṇvatra rādhike ||65|| bṛhaspatirlomaśaśca tatrābjarūpiṇau tadā | abhavatāṃ bālakṛṣṇecchayā maṇḍapakuṇḍakāḥ ||66|| abjādirūpā abhavan devatāścakitāstadā | kanyānāṃ pitaraścāpi mahāścaryamagustathā ||67|| śiveśaḥ pārvatī vīkṣya śrīkṛṣṇasya pareśatām | mahīmānāstathā vīkṣyaiśvaryaṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ ||68|| tuṣṭāḥ prasannāḥ sañjātā vavandire muhurmuhuḥ | mugdhāśca dadṛśuḥ sarvaṃ kanyādānavidhiṃ tadā ||69|| kanyānāṃ pitarastatra tiṣṭhanti dānahetave | yāsāṃ tu pitaro naiva santi ye maraṇaṃ gatāḥ ||2.293.70|| bālakṛṣṇasmṛtāstatrāyātāstūrṇaṃ sumūrtikāḥ | adṛśyanta dānakāle sarve mudānvitāḥ śubhāḥ ||71 || lomaśo’pi mahāścaryaṃ prāptaḥ prāpto bṛhaspatiḥ | naitādṛśaścamatkāro bhūto vā ca bhaviṣyati |72|| prakāśaṃ paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāmidamāsa ha | athaivaṃ kanyakānāṃ vai kāntapārśvasamāgame ||73|| pitṛbhirdānavidhinā dīyante kanyakā nijāḥ | lajjayā namravadanā bhāsurāstejasā śubhāḥ ||74|| svasvakanyā daduḥ sarve paripūrṇatamāya ha | bālakṛṣṇasya vai haste dakṣe kanyākarāṃstadā ||75|| daduḥ sarve janakāśca śiveśaṃ pradadāvapi | pradaduḥ sampradānena vedamantreṇa rādhike ||76|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya paramātmane | bālakṛṣṇāya ṛṣaye dīyate kanyakā mayā ||77|| ityevaṃ te samuccārya dhṛtvā haste jalaṃ tadā | mumucuścāgnisākṣye vai bhūmau gaṇeśasannidhau ||78|| bālakṛṣṇastadā pitrājñayā svastītyuvāca ha | jagrāha lakṣmīṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hi kanyakāḥ ||79|| arbudābjāstadā tvekakṣaṇe tāvatsvarūpadhṛk | dṛṣṭvaivaṃ sumahaiśvaryaṃ tuṣṭāva śivasattamaḥ ||2.293.80|| śivabhāvaṃ samāsādya divyarūpaṃ vidhāya ca | dhṛtvā svaḍamarūṃ haste nināda ca nanarta ca ||8 1|| yo hi sarvajagatsākṣī sṛṣṭicakrapravartakaḥ | parameśo’kṣare dhāmni rājamānastvameva saḥ ||82|| mama gṛhe samāyātaḥ koṭikanyāsusiddhaye | dhanyaṃ cādya gṛhaṃ me’tra yajño me śāśvatastathā |||83|| yadgṛhe’rbudakoṭyaśca kanyakāḥ parameśine | arpyante divyagranthyā vai dhanyo’yaṃ śivasattamaḥ ||84|| tvāmekamīśeśvarapālapālaṃ pareśvarākhyaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam | namāmi kāntaṃ mama kanyakāyāḥ kāntaṃ tathā cārbudakanyakānām ||85 aṇoraṇīyānmahato mahīyān hiraṇyavarṇo jagadantarātmā | samastakāntāhṛdi sanniviṣṭaścānantarūpaṃ praṇamāmi taṃ tvām ||86|| oṃkāranāmākṣaramuktibījaṃ svayaṃprabhastvaṃ puruṣottamo’si | samastanātho’yutamastakastvaṃ sanātanastvaṃ puruṣottamo’si||87|| tvāmeva vedmyadya purātanaṃ tamādityavarṇa tamasaḥ parastāt | manmokṣaṇārthaṃ samupāgato’si tavaiva kāntā hi purātanīyam||88|| bhakto’hamevāsmi purātanastvaṃ saṃgṛhya sarve nanu tāritā vai | anantarūpaṃ vararūpajanmapradaṃ supūjyaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye ||89|| ityuktvā rādhike śrīmadbālakṛṣṇāya śaṃkaraḥ | yautakaṃ pradadau sarve rājānaḥ pradadustadā ||2.293.90 || suvarṇānāṃ koṭikaṃ ca vimānaṃ sūryabhāsvaram | kalpalatāṃ śiraśchatraṃ cāmare ratnadaṇḍake ||9 1 || tāmbūlārthaṃ svarṇapātraṃ tathā cākṣayapātrakam | kalpaghaṭaṃ tathā svarṇapāduke maṇiratnakam ||92|| kāmadughānāṃ dhenūnāṃ sahasrakaṃ savatsikam | vāraṇānāṃ sahasraṃ ca turagāṇāṃ ca lakṣakam ||93|| gṛhopakaraṇānāṃ ca śayyādīnāṃ samastakam | haraye pradadau śaṃbhurbālakṛṣṇāya hastagam ||94|| rājāno’pi dadustatra śayyā ratipradāḥ śubhāḥ | kośām̐śca vividhāṃścāpi svarṇahīrakamauktikam ||95|| hareḥpakṣāstadā cāpi daduḥ kṛṣṇāya sarvathā | hastagrahaṃ dhanaṃ svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ siṃhāsanādikam ||96|| vāsudevo dadau divyaṃ mukuṭaṃ ca gajāsanam | mahāviṣṇurdadau tatra vyomayānaṃ vimānakam ||97|| vairājaḥ pradadau svarṇakuṇḍale svarṇachatrakam | brahmā dadau kalpaghaṭaṃ viṣṇuścakraṃ dadau tadā ||98|| pitaraḥ pradadau svarṇapātrāṇi vividhāni ca | surā daduścāmṛtānāṃ kośān divyāmbarāṇi ca ||99|| dikpālā divyasauvarṇanāṇakāni dadustadā | muktāhārān sāgarāśca mauktikānāṃ srajastathā || 2.293.100 || vṛkṣā rasān dadustatra rājāno maṇiratnakam | govājigajavṛṣabhānantyaṃ dadustadā mudā || 101 || dāsīnāṃ cāpi dāsānāṃ koṭikaṃ ca tadā daduḥ | sṛṣṭitraye’pi yacchreṣṭhaṃ yasya yasyābhavattadā || 10 2|| dadurhastagrahaṃ sarve varadravyaṃ hi dānakam | kanyāpakṣagatāścāpi dadustadā ca yautakam || 1 03|| śrīkṛṣṇaḥ pradadau gopīsahasraṃ maṇiśobhitam | hīrahārān ratnamaṇisrajo bhūṣā dadau tathā || 1 04|| mukuṭaṃ ca satīyogyaṃ dadau saṃkarṣaṇastathā | ratnahārān dadau sadāśivaḥ kālo’mbaraṃ dadau || 1 05|| divyāṃ śāṭīṃ jarāhīnāṃ kaṃcukīṃ navayauvanām | śāśvatīṃ pradadau cāpi rudrā daduḥ srajastathā || 1 06|| kānakīrdivyamālāśca śṛṃgārābhūṣaṇāni ca | asaṃkhyāni dadū rudrāḥ śaṃkaraśchatrikāṃ dadau || 1 07|| siṃhāsanaṃ dadau devī kuberaḥ koṭikānakam | dravyaṃ dadau tadā lakṣmyai lokapālā dhanaṃ daduḥ || 1 08|| svargīyāśca talavāsāḥ śeṣādyāśca maṇīn daduḥ | bhūtapretagaṇāḥ sarve’mbarabhūṣāstadā daduḥ || 1 09|| narā nāryo lokarītyā devarītyā yathāyatham | kanyābhyaśca svāmine’pi dadurdānāni bhūriśaḥ || 2.293.110 || parabrahma svayaṃ yo’sti sarvaṃ yasyāsti rūpavat | tenādya svīkṛtaṃ dānaṃ maṇḍape na mamau hi tat || 111 || evaṃ dānottaraṃ kanyāpitaraśca tadā kare | jalamādāya vai procurgotranāmādi vai tadā || 1 12|| parabrahmapragotrāya bālakṛṣṇāya śārṅgiṇe | kṛṣṇākṣaranarāyaṇapravarāya mahātmane || 113 || sāmavedipraviprāya patnīvratīyaśākhine | śrīmadgopālabālāya vahneḥ sākṣye svayaṃ śivaḥ || 1 14|| śrīkṛṣṇagotrakaścāhaṃ sadāśivapraśākhakaḥ | rudrakālayamākhyatripravaraḥ ṛkpravedavān || 1 15||
