dattavān mama kanyāṃ śrīṃ lakṣmīṃ lakṣmīsvarūpiṇīm | tena dānena bhagavān prīyatāṃ puruṣottamaḥ || 1 16|| ityuktvā ca jalaṃ bhūmau mumoca punareva ca | gṛhītavānahaṃ cetyuvāca tatra hariḥ punaḥ || 1 17|| evaṃ sarve janakāśca tathocurmumucurjalam | tataḥ purohitau vastradivyagranthiṃ babandhatuḥ || 1 18|| vahneḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ caturvāraṃ vai prabhukanyayoḥ | kārayāmāsatustatra mālikāgalayorgurū || 11 9|| vahniṃ natvā yugalāni niṣeduḥ svāsaneṣu vai | vahnau tatra śubhe gārhapatye ca havanaṃ vyadhuḥ || 2.293.120|| ghṛtena ca tilaiścāpi śarkarayā ca satphalaiḥ | vrīhibhirhavyadravyaiśca vividhairhavanaṃ vyadhuḥ 121|| tataḥ prāsādikaṃ parasparaṃ ca madhuparkakam | kṛṣṇakānterjagṛhatuḥ kavalaṃ ca mukhārpitam || 122|| parasparaṃ tato hastāñjaliṃ spṛṣṭvā ca nematuḥ | prakoṣṭhasvedabhāvo’bhūd śriyāstatra tadā drutam || 123 || romṇāṃ pulakabhāvaśca kṛṣṇasyāpi tadābhavat | sarvāḥ kanyā kaṇṭhamālāyutāḥ vahnipradakṣiṇam || 1 24|| cakruśca jagṛhurmukhakavalaṃ harayo’pi ca | havanādi tathaiva tāḥ samakālaṃ vyadhuśca te || 1 25|| rādhike rādhikā lakṣmīḥ śrīḥ ramā māṇikī tathā | padmāvatīti ṣaṭsatyaḥ kanyakāśca pradakṣiṇam || 1 26|| sahaiva vahneścakrustā kṛṣṇena saha maṇḍape | hemantena pradatte’tra ramā padmāvatī hyubhe || 1 27|| nārāyaṇena saṃdattāścānyāśca haraye’pi tāḥ | sahaiva vahneścakrustāḥ svāmināgnipradakṣiṇām || 128|| anyāḥ samastāḥ kāntāśca cakrurvahnipradakṣiṇām | kāntena sākaṃ mumudurvidhiṃ vīkṣyātimodadam || 129|| catvāriṃśaccādhiśataṃ kanyakā dhāmavāsikāḥ | saha pradakṣiṇāścakruḥ kavalaṃ haraye daduḥ || 2.293.1 30|| tathā sarvā brahmakanyāśceśakanyāstathāparāḥ | rājakanyā lokakanyāḥ prakīrṇakāḥ pradakṣiṇāḥ || 131 || pracakrire ca kavalaṃ mitho dadurvaraṃ nijām | varasya ca vadhūṭīnāṃ kavalagrāsatastvanu || 1 32|| aṃgulīyakaramaṇaṃ raṃgapātrajale’bhavat| tatra rādhe kṛṣṇapatnīrlagnitāḥ śṛṇu mat tviha || 133|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śiveśvarakṛtaṃ kṛṣṇapūjanaṃ, pārvatīdevīkṛtaṃ gṛhopakaraṇottāraṇe, kṛṣṇasya maṇḍapāsane niṣīdanaṃ, kanyāyāḥ kanyakānāṃ cāgamaḥ kṛṣṇapūjā devapūjā, kāmaphalabandhanaṃ, kanyādānam, hastagrahe dānāni, koṭyarbudābjakanyākṛte kṛṣṇasya tāvadrūpadhāritvaṃ, sarvakanyākaragrahaḥ, sarvakaṇṭhamālādhṛtiḥ, sarvavahnipradakṣiṇam, gotrādividhinārpaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trinavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 293 ||
<2.294> śrīrādhikovācame sarvāḥ kathayātraiva kāḥ kāḥ pariṇatāḥ priyāḥ | yāsāṃ smaraṇamātreṇa māyāto mucyate janaḥ || 1 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike bālakṛṣṇena saha vai tadā | yathā lakṣmīryathā ṣaṭakṃ rādhā lakṣmīśca māṇikī || 2 || ramā padmāvatī śrīśca catvāriṃśadyutaṃ śatam | brahmapriyā mukhyakanyā aśanādyāḥ samarpitāḥ || 3 || vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ cakruḥ puṣpamālāsamanvitāḥ | meghanādyaścaturdaśasahasrāṇi samarpitāḥ || 4 || tathā ṣaṣṭhī manasā ca dīpāvalyaśca kanyakāḥ | koṭisaṃkhyā agniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā samarpitāḥ || 5 || talājā tvekalā kāmadhenvākhyāḥ koṭisaṃkhyikāḥ | ārjantyo vasumatyādyāḥ koṭisaṃkhyāḥ samarpitāḥ || 6 || śāṃbhavī krodhanā kanyā dharāputryaśca gahvarāḥ | koṭisaṃkhyā dharayā cārpitāstatra mudānvitāḥ || 7 || vedhaḥputrī sucī vanadevīkanyāśca lakṣakam | vanadevyārpitā varamālāyuktāḥ sukhānvitāḥ || 8 || dāmanyo rākṣasakanyā lakṣaṃ damanakārpitāḥ | vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sapuṣpasragtadāśritāḥ || 9 || ṣaṭkanyāḥ kaṃkatālyaścāyutaṃ ca kāṃkatālikāḥ | kaṃkatālārpitā vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ vidhāya ca || 2.294.10 || puṣpamālāyutā bālakṛṣṇena saṃnijīkṛtāḥ | pitṛkanyālakṣakaṃ cāryamṇā dattā nijīkṛtāḥ || 11 || janapitṛkanyakāśca viṃśatiśca nijīkṛtāḥ | pitṛdāsyo daśasāhasraṃ ca tatra nijīkṛtāḥ || 12|| rāsātalyaḥ pañcasāhasraṃ kanyā daityajāstathā | vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sapuṣpasragnijīkṛtāḥ || 13|| vasantakāntāḥ kanyā vai ṣoḍaśāpi nijīkṛtāḥ | vasantena tadā dattā vahniṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam || 14|| sālamālīyadaityasya pañcaśataṃ ca kanyakāḥ | śatamātṛyutā daityārpitāstatra nijīkṛtāḥ || 15|| svastikanāgakanyāśca viṃśatiścāyutaṃ parāḥ | vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sapuṣpasragnijīkṛtāḥ || 16|| śāvadīnanṛpakanyāḥ sahasraṃ sasumasrajaḥ | vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā nṛpārpitā nijīkṛtāḥ || 17|| aindrajālikakanyāśca śaṃbhujāḥ śaṃbhunārpitāḥ | sahasraṃ sapuṣpamālā vahnisākṣye nijīkṛtāḥ || 18|| sarasvatī, caturdaśavidyāśca ṣaṣṭikanyakāḥ | brahmaṇā cārpitā vahnisākṣye sragbhirnijīkṛtāḥ || 19|| bhūgarbhīyāśca lākṣmaṇyo dve sahasre hi kanyakāḥ | lakṣmaṇenārpitā vahnisākṣye tatra nijīkṛtāḥ ||2.294.20|| vedhaḥkanyā dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi tu nāḍikāḥ | vedhasā saṃpradattāśca vahnisākṣye nijīkṛtāḥ ||2 1 || gāndharvyastriśataṃ kanyā viśvāvasusamarpitāḥ | vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sapuṣpasragnijīkṛtāḥ ||22|| jummāsemalānṛpakanyāḥ sahasraṃ jummalārpitāḥ | vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sapuṣpasragnijīkṛtāḥ ||23 || sāntapanyaśca rākṣasyaḥ pañcasahasrakanyakāḥ | sāntapanārpitā vahnisākṣye sragbhirnijīkṛtāḥ ||24|| sauratyaḥ śatamevāgniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ vidhāya ca | suratarṣyarpitāḥ kanyāḥ sapuṣpasraṅnijīkṛtāḥ ||25|| mahābāleśvarya eva trikanyā vahnisākṣikāḥ | baleśvarārpitāḥ puṣpamālāyuktā nijīkṛtāḥ |||26 || ailavīlaikakanyā ca īlavilārpitā tadā | vahnisākṣye puṣpamālāyutā tatra nijīkṛtā ||27|| dakṣajavaṃgarabhūpakanyāḥ śataṃ sumasrajaḥ | prajākanyāsahasraṃ coṣṇālayasya nijīkṛtāḥ ||28|| agniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā puṣpamālāsamanvitāḥ | prācīnadeśakanyāśca nṛpajāśca prajodbhavāḥ ||29|| vahnisākṣye tajjanakairarpitāḥ koṭisaṃkhyakāḥ | piśaṃgarājadattāśca varasragbhirnijīkṛtāḥ ||2.294.3 0|| santāraṇadvijakanye dve puṣpamālikāyute | santāraṇārpite vahnisākṣye tatra nijīkṛte || 31 || śibidevanṛpakanyāḥ śataṃ śibyarpitāstadā | vahnisākṣye puṣpamālāyutāstadā nijīkṛtāḥ || 32|| tharkūṭasthanṛpakanyāḥ pañcāśadvahnisākṣikāḥ | tharkūṭasthārpitā puṣpasragyuktāḥ saṃnijīkṛtāḥ || 33 || vīrajāranṛpakanyāḥ śataṃ vai vahnisākṣikāḥ | vīrajārārpitāḥ puṣpamālāyuktā nijīkṛtāḥ ||34|| śaktyakṣinṛpakanyāśca ṣaṣṭiśca vahnisākṣikāḥ | piśācinyaḥ śataṃ kanyāḥ śaktyakṣiṇā samarpitāḥ ||35|| vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sapuṣpasraṅnijīkṛtāḥ | kālimāśanṛpakanyāḥ śatadvayaṃ nṛpārpitāḥ ||36|| vahnisākṣye yogamālāyutāstatra nijīkṛtāḥ | uralaketubhūpasya triṃśatkanyā nṛpārpitāḥ ||37|| vahnisākṣye yogamālāyutāstatra nijīkṛtāḥ | krathakakṣmāpateḥ kanyāḥ pañca vai vahnisākṣikāḥ || 38|| pitrārpitā yogamālāyuktāstatra nijīkṛtāḥ | pṛthurājena dattāḥ svakanyā viṃśatiragnikam || 39|| pradakṣiṇaṃ vidhāyaiva sayogasraṅnijīkṛtāḥ || uṣṭrālarājakanyāśca daśoṣṭrālena cārpitā ||2.294.40 || vahnisākṣye puṣpamālāyutāstatra nijīkṛtāḥ | haṃkāranṛpateḥ pañca jayakāṣṭhasya pañca ca ||41 || tīrāṇanṛpateḥ ṣaṭ ca alvīnarasya pañca ca | jīnavarddhinṛpasyāpi saptānāthā tathaikalā ||42|| tattadrājārpitā vahniṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ hi tāḥ | yogamālāyutā bālakṛṣṇena saṃnijīkṛtāḥ ||43 || prakīrṇikāḥ śate dve ca sahasraṃ kanyakāḥ śubhāḥ | rakṣoruddhā vahnisākṣye sasumasraṅnijīkṛtāḥ ||44|| alpaketo saptakanyā jayakṛṣṇavajaikalā | parīśānanṛpasyaikaviṃśatiḥ kanyakāstathā ||45|| indurāyanṛpasyāpi kanye dve śobhane tadā | mudrāṇḍanṛpateḥ kanyā pañcadaśa vibhūṣitāḥ ||46|| gaṇḍabhūpasya ca nava līnorṇajācatuṣṭayam | bṛhaccharanṛpasyāpi tathaikādaśakanyakāḥ ||47|| catvāriṃśatkanyakāśca balalīnasya bhūpateḥ | varasiṃhasya pañcaiva rāyagāmalajāṣṭakam ||48|| phenatantunṛpasya dve stokahomasya caikalā | kāṣṭhayānanṛpasyaikā kolakasyāpi caikalā ||49|| dinamānanṛpasya dve kanyāḥ sayogamālikāḥ | vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā svasvapitrā samarpitāḥ ||2.294.50|| rājabhirarpitā bālakṛṣṇena tā nijīkṛtāḥ | rāyakinnararājasyaikapañcāśatsuputrikāḥ ||5 1 || rāyakoṭīśvarasyaikaviṃśatiḥ kanyakāstathā | rāyaraṇajidbhyasya viṃśatiḥ kanyakāstathā |||52 rāyavākakṣabhūpasya tisraḥ kanyāstathā tadā | rāyamārīśabhūpasya tisraḥ kanyāśca śobhanāḥ ||53 || rāyabaleśvarasyāpi tisraḥ kanyāstathā parāḥ | rāyalambārabhūpasya ṣaṭ kanyā yauvanānvitāḥ ||54|| rāyanavārkabhūpasya sapta kanyāḥ sumañjulāḥ | rāyahūṇḍeśabhūpasya nava kanyāḥ sukomalāḥ ||55|| rāyakūpeśabhūpasyaikalā putrī satī śubhā | kālīmaṇḍabhūpateśca catasraḥ kanyakāstathā ||56|| vanajeleśanṛpateḥ pañca kanyāḥ supāṇḍurāḥ | pārāvārapibasyāpi tisraḥ kanyāḥ suraktikāḥ ||57|| koṭīśvaranṛpasya dve tisraḥ satīśabhūpateḥ | tretākarkaśanṛpateḥ sapta kanyāḥ sugorikāḥ ||58|| āṇḍajarānṛpasyāpi catasraḥ kanyakāḥ śubhāḥ | bālyarajonṛpasyāpi kanyaikā dharmaśālinī ||59|| rāyasomanabhūpasya tisraḥ kanyāḥ suśobhanāḥ | ūrugavākṣanṛpataḥ kanye dve śobhane tathā ||2.294.60 || parāṅvratanṛpasya dve rājārāyasvasaikalā | īśānapānabhūpaikacatvāriṃśatsukanyakāḥ ||6 1 || rājārāyapatikṣmeśatrayastriṃśatsukanyakāḥ | etāḥ sarvāṃstadā tatra yogamālāvibhūṣitāḥ ||62|| rājaśṛṃgāraśobhāśca svasvapitrā samarpitāḥ | vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā bālakṛṣṇanijīkṛtāḥ ||63|| triṃśatkanyā maṃgalādyā maharṣibhiḥ samarpitāḥ | ṛṣīṇāṃ tā vibhinnānāṃ bālakṛṣṇanijīkṛtāḥ ||64|| ājanābhapradeśānāṃ rājñāṃ kanyāḥ samujjvalāḥ | sahasrāṇi daśa tattatpitrādibhiḥ samarpitāḥ ||65 || prajākanyā daśasahasrāṇi prajābhirarpitāḥ | sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyā yogamālāvibhūṣitāḥ ||66|| vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā bālakṛṣṇanijīkṛtāḥ | pṛthak pṛthak prakuṇḍeṣu pṛthag vahneḥ prasākṣikam ||67|| karagrahaṇametāsāṃ sarvāsāmabhavattadā | rādhike ca tathānyāśca kauberyaśca sahasraśaḥ ||68|| sahasraśaśca māhendryo yamakanyāḥ sahasraśaḥ | vāyavyo vaiśvakarmyaśca vārkṣyo raudryaśca vahnijāḥ || 69 || śrāvaṇyaścāpi khānijyaḥ sāṃvatsaryaśca gopikāḥ | prācīnyaśca piśaṃginyo rāśiyānyaśca koṭiśaḥ ||2.294.7 0 | | raumāyanyaśca pāraśyo dhaivaryaśca sahasraśaḥ | kinnaryo’marya evāpi gauryaḥ paryaśca koṭiśaḥ || 71 || ābriktyaścāpi hārityaḥ pātālyaḥ svargya ityapi | apsaraso brahmasaraso gāndharvyaḥ koṭiśo’pi ca ||72 || vidyunmaṇiścaḥ kuśalā yoginī, dve tathāpare | bhaumyaścāpi ca dānavyaḥ koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyakāḥ || 73 || kaḥ kartuṃ tatra śakyet saṃkhyāṃ cārvāṃgadṛśirjanaḥ | tāḥ sarvāḥ smṛtapitrādyāḥ pitrupasthitisannidhau ||74|| vibhūṣitāḥ kṛtavastraprāntabandhāḥ suyauvanāḥ | yogamālāyutā vahniṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ tadā ||76 || tattatpitrādyarpitāśca karagrāheṇa vai tadā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇenāṅgīkṛtāḥ pṛthak ||76 || sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ bālakṛṣṇena paramātmanā | udvāhitā vahnisākṣye sarvasākṣye samarpitāḥ ||77|| rādhike te śrāvitāstāḥ sṛṣṭyādau paramātmanā | udvāhitā hi vidhinā sarvā brahmapriyā imāḥ ||78 || harermūrteḥ samutpannā hareḥ śaktaya eva tāḥ | haryarthaṃ cāgatāḥ pṛthvyāṃ sṛṣṭau sarvatra tatra ca ||79 || yatheṣṭaṃ saṃsthitāḥ kāle kṛṣṇakāntāśca sarvathā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kāśyāṃ samāśritāḥ ||2.294.8 0 || śiveśvarāṅgaṇe dattā kālo yāsu na jaṃbhate | śivaḥ kālasvarūpo vai tenārpitāstato’tigāḥ ||8 1 || kālātītāḥ kṛpṇamūrtimayyaḥ sarvā hi mokṣadāḥ | saurāṣṭraṃ manmaṇerjātaṃ bālakṛṣṇo’tra rājate |||82 || kāśyāṃ prodvāhamāpannaḥ sṛṣṭitraye prakāśate | pratīkṣamāṇāḥ sarvāstāḥ prodvāhaṃ prāpya cādya vai ||8 3 || kṛtakṛtyā babhūvuśca śāśvatānandasaṃbhṛtāḥ | lakṣmīḥ prāptā nijaṃ kāntaṃ śiveśvarasutā kṣitau ||84|| diśāṃ putrī padmavatī sūryaputrī subhāsvarā | kalpadrumasutā śrīśca lakṣmīḥ kṣīrodaputrikā || 81 || divyavibhūtiputrī ca māṇikyācākṣarīsatī | kamalādyāstathā cānyāḥ prāpya kāntaṃ hariṃ śubham ||86|| kṛtakṛtyo babhūvuśca sarvasaubhogyasaṃbhṛtāḥ | sarvā udvāhitāstatra suyoge kṛṣṇayoḥ śubhe || 87| | śṛṇu rādhe tadā kāśīrājaśca śivachatrakaḥ | dhenupālastathā śiveśvarasyāpi subhaktarāṭ || 88 || vīkṣyaiśvaryaṃ bālakṛṣṇe cānantaṃ pārameśvaram | tadaiva pradadau kāśīrājaḥ kanyā daśāpi ca ||8 9 | | dhenupālo dadau tisro vahnisākṣye tadantare | yogamālāyutāstāśca maṇḍape’tra najīkṛtāḥ || 2.294.90 | | yautakaṃ pradadau rājā tadā sauvarṇalakṣakam | narayānaṃ tathā dāsīśataṃ vibhūṣaṇāni ca | | 91 | | prajāścāpi dadustasmai bālakṛṣṇāya maṇḍape | dānaṃ bahuvidhaṃ paścāttatkuṇḍe havanaṃ tadā | | 92 || vahnau datvā gurūktām̐śca gārhasthyasadvṛṣān varaḥ | aṃganāsahitastatrāśṛṇot pālyān samantataḥ | | 93 | | saha dharmaṃ yugalasyābhinnaṃ pālaya mādhava | ardhāṃganāstava cemāstāḥ sarvāḥ paripālaya || 94|| sukhe sukhaṃ tathā duḥkhe duḥkhaṃ paśya pareśvara | kāntā kānto na vai bhinnau dehayoraikyamāvaha | | 95|| svātmavat sarvakāntāstvaṃ vibhāvaya pramodaya | kāntānāṃ cāntare dehe tava deho virājate || 96 || mastake mastakaṃ mukhe mukhaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ hṛdi | udare udaraṃ madhye madhyaṃ pādau ca pādayoḥ | | 97|| kāntādehaṃ svadehaṃ ca matvā tāḥ paripālaya | kuru dharmān sahaivātra vaṃśavardhanahetukān || 98 || kāntābhiścāpi kāntaḥ svo mantavyaḥ prāṇa eva ha | prāṇasevā prakartavyā sarvathā ceśavat sadā | | 99 || pātivratyaṃ sadā pālyaṃ kāntābhiḥ sukhahetave | ājñā prabhoḥ sadā pālyā prāṇairapi kriyādibhiḥ || 2.294.100 || aikyabhāvena mantavyo bhajanīyaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | ityevaṃ vīkṣya yugalairvartitavyaṃ nirantaram | | 101 || sāpatnyaṃ na samudbhāvyaṃ parasparaṃ kadācana | sapatnībhiḥ svasṛvacca vartitavyaṃ nirantaram || 102 | | santoṣṭavyaṃ parasyai vai sukhaṃ datvā sadā sutāḥ | prabhoraṃśāḥ svāṃśakā vai mantavyā nānyathā kvacit | | 103 || itimātre vṛṣe stheyaṃ svastyastu vaḥ sukhaṃ ca śam | ityuktvāṃkurasalilaiḥ prokṣaṇaṃ cakraturgurū | | 10 4|| dakṣiṇāṃ pradadau kṛṣṇo bhūyasīṃ kanyakāstathā | koṭiratnāni ca maṇīn koṭisaṃkhyaṃ suvarṇakam || 1 05|| parihāraṃ tato gurū cakrāte yajñakarmaṇaḥ | devavisarjanaṃ cāpi sarvavisarjanaṃ tataḥ || 1 06|| anekarūpavilayaṃ hariścakre’tha satvaram | etasminnantare devī girijā tūrṇamāgatā | patiputravatībhiśca sādhvībhiḥ sahitāgragā || 1 07|| sarvasṛṣṭinivāsinyo mātaro’pi tadāgatāḥ | sukṛtvā maṃgalaṃ sarvāstatra nirmañcchanādikam || 1 08|| dampatirveśayāmāsuḥ ratnanirmāṇamandiram | koṭyarbudābjakanyānāṃ vāsārhaṃ dīpitaṃ yathā || 1 09|| dvitīyamiva golokaṃ drāk kṛtaṃ viśvakarmaṇā | kailāsākhyasya muktasya sāhāyyena navīkṛtam || 2.294.11 0|| ratnasiṃhāsaneṣveva vāsayāmāsureva ca | bhojayāmāsurevāpi svāminā saha kanyakāḥ || 111 || sakarpūraṃ satāmbūlaṃ pradadurvāsitaṃ jalam | sarasvatī tadovāca sarvāḥ sṛṣṭeśca mātaraḥ || 1 12|| devyaḥ satyastathā sādhvyo nārāyaṇyaḥ pativratāḥ | kanyakāḥ saubhāgyavatyaḥ kurvantu maṃgalaṃ param || 1 13|| yathā svāmī tathā kanyā yojitāḥ paramātmanā | vidagdhānāṃ vidagdhena bhavantu saṃgamāḥ śubhāḥ || 1 14|| atha sarvān mahīmānān narānnārīḥ śivāpatiḥ | pūjayāmāsa vidhinā bhojayāmāsa sādaram || 1 15|| khādyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ sveṣṭaṃ cūṣyatāṃ lihyatāṃ muhuḥ | dīyatāṃ dīyatāṃ cāpi gṛhyatāṃ tṛpyatāmiti || 1 16|| pīyatāṃ svādyatāṃ ceti śabdo’navarato’bhavat | ghoṣo babhūva śālāsu vādyasaṃgītamaṃgalaiḥ || 1 17|| evaṃ rātrau bhojanānte tāmbūle’pi nivartite | mahīmānāḥ parāṃ śānti viśrāntiṃ nidrikāṃ śubhām || 1 18|| jagṛhuścobhayapakṣā viśāle klṛptapattane | dampatīmandire śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo’pyanantakaḥ || 11 9|| yāvatyaḥ santi kāntaśca tāvadrūpadharaḥ prabhuḥ | tābhirmṛdvīṣu śayyāsu sevitaḥ sukhado’bhavat || 2.294.120 || rādhike’nantasattvasyānantavīryasya yoginaḥ | koṭyarbudābjapatnyo’pi na vijetuṃ kṣamāḥ kvacit || 121 || niśāyāṃ nṛtyakhelādyā mallānāṃ yuddhasatkalāḥ | vādyānāṃ ca samāśrāvā nāṭakānāṃ kalādṛśaḥ || 1 22|| abhavannagare tatra prodvāhotsavalambitāḥ | rātryardhordhva tataḥ śāntaṃ sarvaṃ vai satyamaṇḍalam || 123 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vahnisākṣye prodvāhitānāṃ nirdeśaḥ, gṛhadharmopadeśaḥ, prodvāhakāryaparihāraḥ, dampatībhojanam, sarvabhojanam, koṭyarbudābjarūpaparihāraḥ, sarvābhiḥ saha sarvarūpeṇa kṛṣṇasya dampatīmandire vihāraḥ, sarvaśayanaṃ, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturnavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 294 ||
<2.295> śrorādhikovāca kati kanyāstadā kāntāḥ prasaṃkhyātā ratigṛhe | yā vai pūrvaṃ sulabdhāśca tato labdhāśca vai kati || 1 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvācarādhike nijapitrādyairarpitā yāstu kanyakāḥ | tāstu kāntāścatuṣkoṭyaścaturlakṣāṇi vai tathā || 2 || pañcapañcāśadapi ca sahasrāṇi tathādhikāḥ | ṣaṭ śatāni dvāviṃśatirnūtnakanyā nijīkṛtāḥ || 3 || athānyāḥ kanyakāḥ kauberyādyāḥ sṛṣṭitrayāgatāḥ | arbudaṃ tāḥ svāgatā vai tathābjaṃ sūkṣmavartikāḥ || 4 || rādhike sakhya evaitā bālakṛṣṇasya mandire | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya śayane’bhavan || 5 || koṭyarbudābjāstāḥ sarvāḥ kāntā vai ratimandire | koṭyarbudābjaśayyāsu cāsan tāvadvarānvitāḥ || 6 || atha prātastato jāte pañcamyāṃ śrīharistadā | maṃgalairgītikābhiśca suvādyānāṃ ninādanaiḥ || 7 || bhāṭacāraṇabandīnāṃ yaśogānairdvijeritaiḥ | vedastotrasvarādyaiśca vetradhārapraśaṃsanaiḥ || 8 || jajāgāra prabhuścāpi prabhvyaḥ sarvā jajāgaruḥ | kṛtasnānāhnikaḥ kṛtaśṛṃgāro bālakṛṣṇakāḥ || 9 || kṛtaśṛṃgāraśobhābhiḥ kāntābhiḥ sahitaḥ prage | vṛddhānpūjyāngurūnśreṣṭhānsatīḥ sādhvīḥ prapūjya ca || 2.295.10 || vṛddhāśīrvādamādāya koṭistrīnaraśobhitaḥ | sajjo’bhavannagaryāṃ hi bhramaṇārthaṃ sayātrikaḥ || 11 || yogayātrī tadā vṛddhanideśena yathāyatham | sajjā kṛtā saśobhā ca phullekārthā suśobhanā || 1 2|| gajaśobhaṃ vimānaṃ svaṃ cādhiruroha saddhavaḥ | viśālaṃ bahuśobhaṃ ca viśvakartrā tadā kṛtam || 13 || mārgayogyāyataṃ cāpi dairghye tu bahuyojanam | koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyasvanavoḍhābhiḥ susevitaḥ || 14|| vyarājata vimāne bhūsparśe tasmin pareśvaraḥ | kailāsākhyaśivamuktapreritaṃ navasaṃsthakam || 15|| raṃgagulālakāśmīrakastūrīgandhaśobhitam | puṣpāhārāvalirājatsarvavartulasundaram || 16|| svarṇasiṃhāsanāsaṃkhyayutaṃ dṛśyaṃ manoharam | puṣpaprakṣepaṇadroṇīklṛptaṃ gulālakośavat || 17|| mahīmānāgraṇībhiśca narairagre pravāsitam | mahīmānāgraṇīstrībhiḥ pṛṣṭhe gītyabhighoṣitam || 18|| tathā vai dampatīsambandhibhiḥ pitrādibhiryutam | sarvāgre sarvavādyaiśca nināditaṃ sumānitam || 19|| vimānaṃ śrīśaṃkarasya gṛhāṃgaṇe prapūjitam | phullagulālaprasṛtikṣepakṛddampatīśritam ||2.295.20 || śanaiścāgre’prasaradvai mahānandapradarśakam | vāhinī sā śivaprāsādakādagre sasāra ha ||2 1 || vardhayanti yugalāni prajājanāḥ phalādibhiḥ | dravyairhārairhastadānaiḥ puṣpaiḥ śubhāśiṣā tadā ||22|| girijānagaraṃ sarvaṃ bhramitvā phullayātrikā | sarvapūjāṃ samagṛhya vardhayinīṃ prajākṛtām ||23|| kāśīpattanamevāpi samastaṃ sāntamityatha | bhramitvā kuladevyāśca durgāyā darśanaṃ tathā ||24|| hanūmato darśanaṃ ca viśveśvarasya darśanam | annapūrṇādarśanaṃ ca gaṇeśasyāpi darśanam ||25|| pañcagaṃgātaṭe dharmadevasyāpi ca darśanam | pūjanaṃ ca dhanairdānaiḥ puṣpapatraphalādibhiḥ ||26 || kṛtvā sarvatra ca tato bindumādhavamāyayau | tatra śrīmādhavaṃ prārcya datvā dānāni dakṣiṇāḥ ||27|| vimānaṃ pāvanīgaṃgājalopari hyapāsarat | yogagranthiyatāḥ kāntāḥ kāntaścāpi nadījalam ||28|| ācamanaṃ pragṛhyaiva prapūjya tīrthamuttamam | kṣamāpya śrīmatīṃ gaṃgāṃ dīpadānaṃ pradāya ca ||29|| mukhe pradadurdānaṃ bahusvarṇaṃ samantrakam | sadgururlomaśastatra yogagranthīn vyamocayat || 2.295.30|| tato nagaramadhye ca vimānena punaḥ prabhuḥ | mahārājapathenāpi nirgato vādyanādakaiḥ ||3 1|| narā nāryaśca vai draṣṭuṃ satvarāḥ sarvataḥ sthitāḥ | dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā kāntakāntāḥ kāntaṃ yogyaṃ susundaram ||32|| praśaśaṃsurhi bahudhā dampatīsukhamuttamam | ūcuḥ parasparaṃ tatra mugdhāḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe ||33 || ayameva caiti bhagavān kṛpānidhiḥ, sakhi naḥ kadā sa ca miliṣyati prabhuḥ | bahukanyakābhiriha labdha īśvaraḥ, kṛpayaiva naiva nijapuṇyasaṃgrahāt ||34|| iha mānavaṃ hi vapurāpya durlabhaṃ, sakhi cenna kṛṣṇabhagavānniṣevyate | bhavabandhanāni ca tadā na yānti śaṃ, nijanetrakaiḥ prabhurayaṃ vilokyatām ||35|| paramākṣare’niśamanantapārṣadaiḥ, sukhadābhirīśvarasatībhirarcitaḥ | bhuvanāntareṣvapi ca kanyakārcitaḥ, sukhadaḥ samāgata iha prasecyatām ||36|| bahukoṭirūpadharaśaktiko hyayaṃ, nikhilābhikāmarasapūrako hyayam | hṛdaye sthito’pi nijanetragocaro, bhavatīha taṃ patitayā pragṛhyatām ||37|| śrutayaḥ purāsya yaśasāṃ pragāyanairatha kanyakātanudharā hyasevayan | surapatnikāśca nṛpakanyakādikāḥ saha, yānagā harivatīrvipaśyata ||38|| nanu puṇyanāṇakadhanaiḥ sugamyakaṃ, vayamatra tādṛśadhanena varjitāḥ | nahi labdhavatya iha yaḥ pare’kṣare, bhajanena cāpi ca laye’pi ceṣyate ||39|| sakhi kāntakoṭiriha bhujyate yathā, nijakarmaṇāpi ca harirna labhyate | yadi labhyate’pi nahi bhujyate tviha, svajanustadāpi viphalaṃ vilokyate ||2.295.40|| vijayantu tasya sumamālikāyutā, bahuvatsarāṇi ca sukhābdhimagnikāḥ | śatakoṭikāmavararūpaśobhanaṃ, sukhayantu cāpi labhantu satsukham ||41|| api naḥ spṛhāsya mukhapaṃkaje sakhi, hyatijāyate kimiha labdhisādhanam | iyamarthanāsti hṛdayasthito bhavān, pradadātu tatra navasaṃgamaṃ hi naḥ ||42|| ayi vadhva īśvarakṛtābhivandanāḥ, praṇibhālayantu nijadāsikā hi naḥ | samaye kvacinnijapatiṃ ratisthale, smaraṇaṃ dadhatviti hi no’rthanāsti vai ||43||| rādhike ceti tāḥ stutvā natvā dhṛtvā hariṃ hṛdi | puṣpādyairvardhayāmāsuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||44|| śṛṇu rādhe parabrahma vilokya vārayoṣitaḥ | sahasraśaḥ pupūjuśca vardhayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||45|| mumuhuścākṣatāḥ kanyāstisraḥ catuḥśataṃ tathā | mātrājñayā tadā tāśca mārge mārge varaṃ prabhum ||46|| prapūjya puṣpamālāśca kaṇṭhe prabhostu vai nyadhuḥ | arpitāstāśca mātṛbhirvimānamadhyarohayan ||47|| kṛṣṇapatnyaśca tā jātā gāndharvyaḥ sevikāḥ sadā | evaṃ rādhe’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya patnikāḥ ||48|| catuḥkoṭyaścaturlakṣāṇyapi cāpi tato’dhikāḥ | ṣaṭapañcāśatsahasrāṇyabhavam̐śca pūrvabṛṃhitāḥ ||49|| koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyāśca tadanyāśca nijīkṛtāḥ | tā etāḥ saha modante samarūpaiḥ samastakaiḥ ||2.295.50 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaiḥ śrībālakṛṣṇakaiḥ | tretāyāṃ phullayātrīyā vāhinī ca tataḥ param |||51|| śivasvāmipuraṃ yātā nijāvāsamanuttamam | phullayātrāparihārastato jātaḥ śubhāvahaḥ ||52|| śiveśvarādayo yātā nijāvāsaṃ samutsukāḥ | śrīkṛṣṇādyāstato yātāḥ pārvatīpattanaṃ śubham ||53|| bhojanāni tataḥ sarvān mahīmānān hi śaṃkaraḥ | kārayāmāsa vidhinā bahumiṣṭānnakāni vai ||54|| pāyasāni vividhāni odanānyuttamānyapi | śākāni dvidalāścāpi bhakṣyabhojyāni yāni ca ||55|| lehyacoṣyāṇi sarvāṇi miṣṭapānāni yāni ca | amṛtānyapi sarvāṇi bhojayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ ||56|| mahīmānān samastāṃśca dampatīpakṣakānatha | grāmaprajā dīnabhikṣūn bhojayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ ||57|| sarvasevakavargāśca tathā nāṭyādivargakān | sarvān stāvakavargāṃśca vādakān vai samastakān ||58|| vāhakām̐śca samastām̐śca rakṣakān gāyakām̐stathā | karmacārān yatīn sādhūm̐ścātithīn prasamāgatān ||59|| viprān sarvān gurūn sarvān brahmapriyāḥ prabhuṃ tathā | kṛṣṇasya pitaraṃ bhrātṝn kuṭumbaṃ ca samastakam ||2.295.60|| bhojayāmāsa śivarāḍa jalapānāni saṃdadau | pātālavāsinaḥ sarvān sarvān pṛthivīvāsinaḥ ||6 1|| svargādivāsinaḥ sarvān sarvānaiśvaravāsinaḥ | bhojayāmāsa bahudhā sarvānakṣaravāsinaḥ ||62|| munīn sādhūn satīḥ sādhvīrbrahmacaryadhṛtāstathā | tyāgivargān yogivargān bhojayāmāsa ceśvarān ||63| api kīṭapataṃgādīn paśūn pakṣigaṇām̐stathā | svedajān jalajām̐ścāpi bhūjān sthāvarajaṃgamān ||64||| tīrthāni parvatām̐ścāpi nadīnadām̐śca sāgarān | kalpalatādikān sarvān devān caityān samastakān ||65|| bhūtapretapiśācādīn gāndharvān kinnarām̐stathā | cāraṇān kāśikāvāsān bhojayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ ||66|| jalapānānyadāccāpi tāmbūlakāni sandadau | dakṣiṇā bhūyasīścāpi svarṇarūpyasumauktikīḥ ||67|| sauvarṇamudrikāścāpi bhūṣāmbarāṇi mālikāḥ | dadau tadā śivastatra koṭikoṭyarbudātmikāḥ ||68|| yautakaṃ pradadau paścāt koṭisauvarṇamudrikāḥ | kalpapeṭīṃ kalpapātraṃ cākṣayāṃ sthālikāṃ tathā ||69|| avyayaṃ kośamevāpi cāvighnaṃ chatrakaṃ tathā | sarvarasāṃ pātrikāṃ ca sarvagandhāṃ suvallikām ||2.295.70|| sarvarūpāṃ puttalīṃ ca sthirayauvanikāṃ guṭīm | cāmaraṃ vyomagatidaṃ kavacaṃ kālavārakam ||71 || śayyāṃ cānandanidhikāṃ pāraśaṃ ca maṇiṃ tathā | cintāmaṇiṃ dadau cāpi bālakṛṣṇāya vai tadā ||72|| kāśīrājo dadau cāpi vimānaṃ sūryavarculam | hastiśataṃ sahasrāśvān kāmadhenusahasrakam ||73 || lakṣakaṃ vṛṣabhāṇāṃ ca śyāmakarṇāśvalakṣakam | dāsīnāṃ ca sahasraṃ vai ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ tathā ||74|| mṛtyubhakṣāṃ mahāyaṣṭiṃ rogaghnīṃ vetrikāṃ tathā | ājanābhāśca rājāno pradaduryautakānyapi ||75|| ājanābhyaḥ prajāścāpi yautakāni tathā daduḥ | kanyānāṃ pitaraścāpi bhrātaraścāpi mātaraḥ ||76|| kanyādhanaṃ daduścāpi bhūṣāmbarādi śobhanam | ratnahīrakamālyāni hārān maṇikṛtām̐stathā ||77|| sauvarṇarājataratnapātrāṇi mauktikāni ca | vimānāni suyānāni śayyāḥ paryaṃkaśobhitāḥ ||78|| muktāstatheśvarāścāpyavatārā īśvarīgaṇāḥ | devāśca pitaraścāpi maharṣayaśca mānavāḥ ||79|| sarve daduryautakāni yathāyogyāni sarvathā | yautakasya parihāre kṛto tato hariḥ svayam ||2.295.80|| dadau yathārhapātrebhyaḥ sauvarṇaṃ pāritoṣikam | dāsebhyo bhṛtyavargebhyaḥ sevakebhyo’yutāyutam ||8 1 || sauvarṇānāṃ dadau cāpi karmacāribhya ityapi | gāyakebhyo nāpitebhyaḥ savāhakebhya ityapi ||82|| dehamardakalokebhyaḥ sevikābhyastathā hyapi | mārjikābhyaḥ kṣālikābhyo mañjikābhyo dadau dhanam ||83|| nartakībhyo vādinībhyo gāyikābhyo dadau dhanam | bhāṭacāraṇabandībhyo vidyādhrebhyo dadau dhanam ||84|| gāndharvebhyastathā śilpicitrakebhyo dadau dhanam | yānibhyo mārgadarśibhyo jayibhyaḥ pradadau dhanam ||85|| jalibhyaḥ pavanibhyaśca śamanibhyo dadau dhanam | śākaṭibhyo vimānibhyo rathibhyaḥ pradadau dhanam ||86|| patākibhyo vādakebhyo yantribhyaḥ pradadau dhanam | rakṣibhyaḥ sahayāyibhyo bhikṣukebhyo dadau dhanam ||87|| kanyakābhyaḥ kumārebhyaḥ satībhyaḥ pradadau dhanam | nālinībhyaḥ śodhinībhyastālinībhyo dadau dhanam ||88|| vaṃśinībhyo dvijebhyaśca tairthikebhyo dadau dhanam | darśakebhyo lambahastakebhyaścāpi dadau dhanam ||89|| manasā vāñcchakebhyo’pi dadau kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | rājānaśca daduḥ svarṇaṃ rūpyakaṃ mudrikāstathā ||2.295.90 || pātrāmbarāṇi ca tathā pāritoṣātmakaṃ dhanam | sīvakebhyaśca mālibhyaḥ kārdamibhyo dadurdhanam ||9 1|| gandhasāribhya evāpi patribhyaśca dadurdhanam | kailāsāya maṇḍapāya mūrtimate hariḥ svayam ||92|| koṭyarbudābjamūlyām̐śca sauvarṇamukuṭān dadau | gaṇebhyaścāpi sarvebhyaḥ sauvarṇaṃ pāritoṣikam ||93|| anādiśrībālakṛṣṇo dadau cānyebhya ityapi | bhaginīputrakebhyaśca putrībhyaḥ pāritoṣikam ||94|| bhūṣāmbarādikaṃ tatra dadau sauvarṇamuttamam | viśvakāryāya devāya dadau śrībālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||95| kaṇṭhahāraṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ koṭihīrakagumphitam | svarṇamaṇikṛtaṃ cāpi mukuṭaṃ śobhanaṃ tadā ||96| śiveśvarāya bhagavān parameśvarabhāvavān | dadau siṃhāsanaṃ divyaṃ cāvikuṇṭhaṃ jagattraye ||97| śiveśvaro’pi ca dadau sarvasvaṃ paramātmane| bṛhaspataye sarvasvaṃ haristadā tu sandadau ||98|| ityevaṃ pradadustatra pāritoṣaṃ yathārthakam | tataḥ svalpāṃ prāptavanto viśrāntiṃ madhyasūryake ||99|| atha tīrthe snānavāñcchā kṛtavān bhagavān punaḥ | sarvastrībhirmahīmānaiḥ saha gaṃgāṃ yayau punaḥ || 2.295.10 0|| tīrthavidhiṃ cakārātha dānāni vividhāni vai | prāyaścittāni kṛtvaiva dadau sasnau punaḥ punaḥ || 101 || sarvāḥ kāntā prasasnuśca dadurdānāni bhūriśaḥ | śaṃbhustatra vipraveṣaḥ samāyayau hi bhikṣukaḥ || 1 02|| bhikṣāṃ yayāce bhagavān pradadau svarṇalakṣakam | punaryayāce ca tato dadau tulasīmālikām || 1 03|| punaryayāce ca tato dadau mūrtiṃ nijāṃ hariḥ | kānakīṃ sarvarūpāḍhyāṃ svastītyuvāca śaṃkaraḥ || 1 04|| punaryayāce vacanaṃ hariḥ prāha vadātra me | śaṃbhuryayāce gaṃgāyāṃ vāsaṃ tīrthārthameva ha || 1 05|| varaṇāyāṃ tathāvāsaṃ yayāce paramātmanaḥ | haristathāstviti prāha pañcagaṃgājale taṭe || 1 06|| bālakṛṣṇaṃ mahātīrthaṃ kṛtvovāsa tato hariḥ | adṛśyadivyarūpeṇa sarvadānyena vartate || 1 07|| mārgaśīrṣe śuklapakṣe caturthyāṃ pañcamīdine | prativarṣaṃ samāyāti brahmapriyāsamanvitaḥ || 1 08|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇacandrakaḥ | tadā snānāttathā dānānmokṣātmakaṃ phalaṃ dhruvam || 109|| atha snātvā sakāntaḥ śrīhariḥ śivapuraṃ yayau | dugdhapānādikaṃ kṛtvā lebhe viśrāntimacyutaḥ || 2.295.11 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kāntānāṃ saṃkhyā, pañcamyāṃ prātaḥ phullakayātrābhramaṇa, gaṃgāyāṃ granthimocanam, madhyāhnabhojanam, śivapure cāgatya viśrāntiḥ, pāritoṣikādyarpaṇam, gaṃgāyāṃ punastīrthasnānaṃ, bālakṛṣṇatīrthaṃ, paṃcagaṃgāyāṃ granthitīrtham, śaṃkarāya bhikṣādānaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 295 ||
<2.296> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike yatra bhagavān samuvāha ca maṇḍape | kanyakāstatra vai tīrthamudvāhasaṃjñakaṃ sadā || 1 || varaṇāyāṃ tathā koṭitīrthaṃ mokṣapradaṃ śubham | koṭyarbudābjarūpeṇa bhagavāṃstā gṛhītavān || 2 || tadā śivapuraṃ tīrthaṃ pārvatīpattanaṃ tathā | maṇḍapākhyaṃ yajñatīrthaṃ sārabhūtalamucyate || 3 || paṃcamyāṃ tripraharānte vidāyaṃ śaṃkaro dadau | kṛṣṇapakṣasamastebhyo bahudravyāṇi sandadau || 4 || kṛṣṇasya pūjanaṃ cakre pituścāpi kṣamāpanam | mahīmānādivargāṇāṃ nyūnasevākṣamāpanam || 5 || arthayāmāsa sagalatkaṇṭho vai śivarāṭ svayam | śivachatro’pi rājāsau kṣamāṃ tadārthayanmuhuḥ || 6 || bhojyapānādikaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prapakvānnaṃ ghṛtāktakam | pātheyaṃ pradadau cāpi rakṣakaprāpakārthakam || 7 || yautakaṃ ca nyadhāt sarvaṃ śreṣṭhe vimānake haraḥ | vaimānikaṃ dadau cāpi gaṇaṃ vimānavāhakam || 8 || atha vādyānyavādyanta vidāyasūcakāni tu | yantraśabdā ajāyanta gītiśabdāḥ śubhāstadā || 9 || śiveśvaro mimelāpi gopālaṃ kṛṣṇakaṃ hṛdā | kṣamāpanīyaḥ sevāyāṃ nyūnatvehamuvāca ha || 2.296.1 0|| āgantavyaṃ nijaṃ matvā gṛhaṃ māṃ ca kuṭumbakam | putrī ca bhavadīyeti matvā rakṣyā hi mānada || 1 1|| kuśalaṃ lekhanīyaṃ ca prāpya kuṃkumavāpikām | tadbhātṛbhyo lakṣmiṇaśca kuṭumbijanatastathā || 12|| bhāvavadbhyastathā bhrātṛputrebhyaḥ sakalo hariḥ | devamayasamastebhyaḥ kṣamāmayācateśvaraḥ || 1 3|| akṣarānmuktavṛndāśca vāsudevāttathā kṣamām | pradyumnādaniruddhācca bhūnmaścāpi virājakāt ||14|| avatārasamastebhyo nārāyaṇānnarāttathā | viṣṇoścāpi mahāviṣṇorbrahmaṇaḥ śaṃkarāttathā || 15 || aryamṇaśca sanatkumārādibhyaśca satastathā | munisādhudevadevīrnārībhyo’yācata kṣamām || 16|| nṛpavipralokapāladikpāladevadhiṣṇyagāt | mānavebhyo bālakṛṣṇasambandhistrībhya ityapi || 17|| kṣamāmayācatāthāpi yogyaṃ vidāyakaṃ dadau | nāgalokagatebhyaśca bhūsaṃsthasarvadehinaḥ || 18|| saurāṣṭrīyanaranārībhyo’yācateśvaraḥ kṣamām | vidāyaṃ jalapānaṃ ca miṣṭamiṣṭaṃ sumasrajaḥ || 1 9|| dadāvebhyaḥ śivasvāmī mimela vakṣasā ca tān | pūjyāryābhyāḥ kṣamāmayācata hastāñjalirharaḥ ||2.296.20|| śivā ca pārvatī devī sarvā mātṝstadā drutam | kaṃbharāṃ śrīṃ namaskṛtya kṣamāṃ tābhyo’bhyayācata ||21 || anyā āryāḥ samarcyaiva natvā dīnasvabhāvinī | kṣamāmayācatābhyo vāgdoṣātmikāṃ ca sevane ||22|| vastudāne rakṣaṇe ca mānane svāgate tathā | bhojane svāpane pāne nyūne kṣamāmayācata ||23 || mama putrī tava putrī mātastāṃ tvaṃ prarakṣaya | vṛttāntaṃ ca kvacit hṛdyaṃ sampreṣaya suvatsale ||24|| vadhūṭībhyaḥ kṣamāmayācata rakṣata naijikīm | lakṣmīṃ ceti samuvāca vidāyaṃ tūcitaṃ dadau |||25|| puṣpahārān dadau cāpi jalapānādikaṃ dadau | śivachatro’pi ca tadā kṣamāṃ varamayācata ||26|| śiveśvaro’pi ca tadā kṣamāṃ varamayācata | śaivachatrī nṛpī kṣamāṃ kambharāyā ayācata ||27|| kāntāḥ sarvā mātāpitṝn nemire cāśrulekṣaṇāḥ | jayādyāścandrapālādyāste’pi kṣamāmayācire ||28||| | jyeṣṭhāśokā svasā lakṣmyāḥ nanāndṛtastadā drutam | santoṣāyā varasvasṛtaḥ kṣamāmapyayācata ||29||| bhātṛjāyāḥ kṣamāmayācire striyo’parāstadā | evaṃ parasparaṃ nāryaḥ kṣemaṃ ca kuśalaṃ narāḥ ||2.296.3 0|| pṛṣṭvā datvā vidāyaṃ ca puṣpahārān dadurmithaḥ | kanyāpakṣā mahīmānā śrīkṛṣṇādyāstataḥ param ||3 1|| saṃkarṣaṇastathā rudraḥ śaṃkaraḥ śeṣa ityapi | mahākālo yamaścāpi yakṣeśo bhūtabhairavāḥ ||32|| skando gaṇeśo nandī ca vīrabhadrādayastathā | koṭikoṭyadhikāḥ sarve tathā caṇḍyādiśaktayaḥ ||33 || bālakṛṣṇāt kāṃbhareyāttathā gopālakṛṣṇataḥ | vāsudevādvyāsadevāt kapilācca narāyaṇāt ||34|| viṣṇordharmād virājācca kṣamāṃ tadā yayācire | kuśalaṃ ca sukhaṃ kṣemaṃ snehabhāvaṃ yayācire ||35|| rādhā lakṣmīḥ satī durgā sarasvatī narāyaṇī | kamalā ṛṣipatnyaśca devyaśca gaṇikāstathā ||36|| gaṇāśca sevakāścāpi kaṃbharāmātaraṃ tadā | mahālakṣmīṃ tathā lakṣmīṃ sāvitrīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ tathā ||37|| sūryaṃ candraṃ vasūn sādhyān saṃjñāṃ ca rohiṇīṃ tathā | natvābhyo’yācan kṣamāṃ tu devīrdevyaḥ sukhaṃ ca śam ||38|| vidāyaṃ pradaduścāpi puṣpahārākṣatādikam | evaṃ sarve mahīmānāḥ sṛṣṭitrayanivāsinaḥ ||39|| narā nāryo militvaiva kṣamāṃ mitho yayācire | śrīharaye ca kāntābhyaścāśīrvādān dadustadā ||2.296.40|| sajjā babhūvuḥ sarve vai svasvapakṣā narāḥ striyaḥ | kṛṣṇaḥ kāntāścopaviṣṭuṃ yadā vimānamāyayuḥ ||41 || mātāpitṛpade nyasya mastakāni ca kanyakāḥ | kṣaṇaṃ tu rodanaṃ cakrustadā snehaviyogajam ||42|| jānakyādyā mātaraśca kanyāḥ kṛtvā svavakṣasi | mumucuścāśrūṇi caiva siṣicurnetrajairjalaiḥ ||43|| jīvāmaśca kathaṃ putryo vo vinā prāṇadurlabhāḥ | no gṛhācchrībālakṛṣṇagṛhaṃ yātha hi vatsikāḥ ||44|| ityuktvā putrikā naijā nyaṣādayan vimānake | pitaro’pi tadā dhairyaṃ dadurnyaṣādayan sutāḥ ||45|| mumocāpyaśrūṇi svāmī bālakṛṣṇo’pi māyayā | vimānaṃ cārohayāmāsa śrīgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||46|| putraṃ kāntāḥ kuṭumbaṃ ca tadā śivādayaḥ khalu | viśiṣṭaṃ yautakaṃ cāpyarpayāmāsuḥ samutsukāḥ ||47|| gajām̐śca turagān dāsīḥ kiṃkarām̐śca suvarṇakam | ratnānyamūlyabhūṣāśca pātrāṇi surabhīstathā ||48 || ambarāṇyāsanopakaraṇānyapi śubhāni ca | sajjāḥ sarve nijapakṣāḥ puṣpahārādipūjitāḥ ||49|| āruruhurvimānāni naiko’pyatrāvaśiṣyate | tatra bherīninādaśca gateraśrūyatottamaḥ ||2.296.50|| vāditrāṇāṃ ninādairmiśrito vyaṅgulanādanaiḥ | jayārāvairvardhitaścāvyāpnot samantatastadā ||5 1 || drutaṃ sarvāṇyapi vimānāni kāmagamāni vai | vyomnā yayuḥ sukhaṃ paścimāṃ diśaṃ vai sahasrakam ||52|| āgantavyaravāstatrājāyanta śivayoginām | śivasvāmī tadā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇāt pareśvarāt ||53 || aprārthayad drutaṃ naijāmantimāṃ janmamokṣikām | kadā nātha kṛpāsindho cāsmān sammokṣayiṣyase | jātismaro’smi deveśa lakṣmīrlabdhā tvayā tava ||54|| śrībālakṛṣṇa uvāca varṣottaraṃ mokṣayiṣye smara māṃ hṛdaye’nvaham | āmantrayāmi sarvāścāgantavyaṃ me janurdine ||55|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre corjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīdine | tato manorathaṃ śaṃbho pārayiṣye tavārthitam ||56|| ityuktvā bhagavānnaijaṃ vimānaṃ cairayattadā | śiveśvaraścāprayāgaṃ naijavimānakena vai ||57|| kāśīrājastathā kṛṣṇaḥ saṃkarṣaṇādayo’pi ca | prahituṃ prayayuścāpi pītvā triveṇikājalam ||58|| nyavartanta tataḥ sarve prāvartanta puro’mbare | indraprasthavanaṃ vyomno dṛṣṭvā vīkṣya sarasvatīm ||59|| ānarttaṃ cāyayuḥ kṣetraṃ kuṃkumavāpikākṣaram | sāyaṃ prāpuścāśvapaṭṭasarastīraṃ viśālakam ||2.296.60|| tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāśca khe’bhavan | bhūtale janatāśabdā jayabodhāstadābhavan ||61 || śāvadīnā mahākālī kṣetrapā mumude tathā | vārinaraḥ kṣetrapālo mumude ca jagarja ca |||62||| jayanādān pracakruśca devāstīrthāni pādapāḥ | maṇḍapākhyastathā mukto bhūmipāśca samāgatāḥ||63|| prajā jayaninādām̐śca pracakruścātiharṣitāḥ | yātrikā jayanādām̐śca cakrustadā pravīkṣya kham ||64|| darśanārthaṃ prajāḥ sarvā dudruvurambaradṛśaḥ | hariṃ prasasmaruścāpi hariṇīḥ sasmarustathā ||65|| avaterurvimānāni sahasraṃ vyomamārgataḥ | yathāvakāśaṃ bhūmau tu harervimānamityapi |||66|| paścime śobhane bhāge’vātatāra suśobhanam | śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaścāvatīrya sarvasaṃgataḥ ||67|| praviśya svapurīṃ ramyāṃ kārayāmāsa maṃgalam | vādyāni vādayāmāsa drutaṃ manoharāṇi vai ||68|| kambharā cāmarīdevyastathānyā yoṣitastadā | lakṣmīṃ tasyāḥ sakhīḥ sarvā vilokya satvaraṃ tadā ||69|| akṣarabrahmaṇā tatra svasmānnavaṃ vinirmitam | koṭyarbudābjakanyānāṃ kāntānāṃ bhinnaveśanam ||2.296.70|| brahmapriyāpattanaṃ ca prabhuṃ śrīkṛṣṇamīśvaram | catuḥkoṭicaturlakṣaṣaṭpañcāśatsahasrakāḥ ||71 || kāntāḥ praveśayāmāsurlakṣmīṃ cābhyudaye kṣaṇe | maṃgalaṃ kārayāmāsuḥ praveśavidhipūrvakam ||72|| gaṇeśādeḥ pūjanaṃ ca maṇḍapasya prapūjanam | gurośca pūjanaṃ yūpapūjanaṃ devatārcanam ||73|| viprādyaiḥ kārayāmāsurjalapānaṃ dadustataḥ | mahīmānā mahāmaṇḍapottame jagmureva ha ||74|| tato gopālakṛṣṇo vai bhojanāni niśāgame | kārayāmāsa sarvāṃśca mahīmānān prajā api ||75 || sarvān dāsān dāsikāśca kṣetrapān karmacāriṇaḥ | hariṇīrbālakṛṣṇaṃ ca bhojayāmāsa kaṃbharā ||76|| caturvidhaṃ bhojayitvā muktānīśān surādikān | mahīmānānnarānnārīrmunīnnṛpām̐śca bāndhavān ||77|| sṛṣṭitrayanivāsām̐śca viprān bhaṭṭān nijān parān | tāmbūlādi pradāyaiva parihāraṃ cakāra ha ||78|| dhanaṃ ca dāpayāmāsa viprebhyo dakṣiṇāstadā | suratnāni vicitrāṇi dhanānyapi bahūni ca ||79|| maṃgalaṃ kārayāmāsa gopālaḥ kṛṣṇaraṃjanam | bhuktvā viśrāntimāpuśca prasvāpaṃ lebhire tataḥ ||2.296.80 || yuvatyo bālakṛṣṇasya pratistrīrūpayoginaḥ | pratigṛhaṃ pracakruśca sevanaṃ navaharṣitāḥ ||8 1|| aviplutamahāsattvamahāvīryaḥ pareśvaraḥ | parabrahmanijānandaṃ dadau tābhyo hyasīmakam ||82|| mahānandasamādhau mūrchitāḥ kṣaṇena sadṛśīm | niśāṃ bubudhuḥ kāminyo kāntakṛtāṃ yugāyitām ||83|| rādhike rāsarātrirme tasyā agre lavāyate | pareśasya tu sāmarthyaṃ kenāpi naiva pāryate ||84|| atha śrīśivadevādyāḥ prayāgātprayayurgṛham | varṇayanto guṇān sveṣāṃ sambandhipārameśvarān ||85|| dhanyabhāgyānyamanyanta kṛṣṇādyā api mādhavāḥ | pārvatīpattanaṃ gatvā sarve’pi bubhujustataḥ ||86|| pānatāmbūlakaṃ labdhvā suṣvupuḥ sukhanidrayā | ṣaṣṭhyā prātarvinidrāścābhavan maṃgalavādyakaiḥ || 87|| kṛtasnānārhaṇāḥ sarve dugdhapānaṃ vyayadhustataḥ | bhojanāni pracakruśca miṣṭānnapāyasāni ca ||88|| jalapānāni jagṛhustāmbūlakāni vai tathā | madhyāhne ca pralebhuste viśrāntiṃ ca tataḥ param ||89|| sammilitvā narā nāryaḥ sambandhinaḥ suhṛjjanāḥ | gopya īśānyaśca satyaḥ sādhvyo devyastathārṣikāḥ ||2.296.90|| mānavyaśca surāṇyaśca gaṇyaśca phaṇikāstathā | bhūtyaścāpi tathānyāśca gaṇāśca pārṣadāstathā ||91 || gopāśca kuśalaṃ kṣemaṃ nyūnasevākṣamāpanam | parasparaṃ samabhyarthya śiveśvaraśca pārvatī ||92|| kṣamāṃ tu mahīmānānāṃ yācitvātha vidāyakam | dadatuśca yathāyogyaṃ tathocatustadā khalu || 93|| bhavatāṃ cāgamaiḥ sarvavidhiḥ suśobhano’bhavat | sarveṣāmupakāryo’smi kṣantavyo me’parādhakaḥ ||94|| girijāpi satībhyaśca kṣamāmayācatāpi vai | punaścāgantavyamatrāpi kṛpā kāryā sadā mayi || 95|| ityuvāca tato vidāyakaṃ dhanādikaṃ dadau | puruṣān vai śivasvāmī pūjayāmāsa hārakaiḥ ||96|| nārīvargān himaputrī tathāśokakumārikā | pūjayāmāsatuścāpi vidāyaṃ dadatustathā ||97|| bhūṣāmbarāṇi pātrāṇi sādhanānyuttamānyapi | tataścakre parihāraṃ mahīmānāśca vai tataḥ ||98|| sajjā bhūtvā vimānāni cāruruhuḥ samastakāḥ | śrutvā gamanavādyānāṃ ghoṣān vyomni drutaṃ tadā ||99|| gamayāmāsa sahasā vimānāni samantataḥ | yathāmārgaṃ yayuḥ sarve śivarājastataḥ khalu || 2.296.10 0|| ājñāpayāmāsa gaṇān cakruste parihārakam | śivapuraṃ maṇḍapaṃ ca pārvatyānagaraṃ tathā || 10 1|| kailāsaṃ sahasā tiro’bhāvayannativegataḥ | śiveśvaraḥ śivachatraḥ pāritoṣikamuttamam || 1 02|| karmacāribhya evāpi dadatuśca yathocitam | viśrāntiṃ cāvāyatuśca smarantau kṛṣṇamīśvaram || 1 03|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ ca bhejire sadā | rādhike lokarītyaiva lokeśāścācarantyapi || 1 04|| pātheyāni cottamāni prārpitāni dināntare | prāghūṇikebhya evaite praśaṃsanto yayurgṛhān || 1 05|| vidāyaṃ bahumānaṃ ca gṛhītvā yaśa uttamam | śivaśaktipreritāśca yayurnaijālayāniti || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prodvāhatīrthaṃ koṭitīrthaṃ yajñatīrthaṃ, mahīmānānāṃ vidāyaṃ, mithaḥ kṣamāyācanā, viyoge śokaḥ, vimānānāṃ pragamanaṃ, kuṃkumavāpikṣetrāgamo dānaṃ maṃgalaṃ gṛhapraveśo bhojanāni nāgarīṇāmānandavihārānidrādicetinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṇṇavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 296 ||
<2.297> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike ṣaṣṭikāprātarjajāgaruḥ sumaṃgalaiḥ | vāditraninadaiḥ sarvāḥ sakṛṣṇā mahīmānakāḥ || 1 || kṛṣṇagṛhe kṛtasnānasandhyāvandanapūjanāḥ | sopavītyaḥ sarvakāntāḥ svādhyāyaṃ cakrurutsukāḥ || 2 || pauruṣaṃ sūktakaṃ nārāyaṇasūktaṃ tathāparam | viṣṇusūktaṃ ca śrīsūktaṃ lakṣmīsūktaṃ tathā ca vai || 3 || devīsūktaṃ bṛhatsāma vācayāmāsureva ca | vahnau ca havanaṃ cakruḥ pañcayajñāṃśca saṃvyadhuḥ || 4 || vṛddhapūjāṃ tathā cakruḥ patipūjāṃ tathā vyadhuḥ | śatarudrīyakaṃ lakṣmīrnityavacca papāṭha ha || 5 || mālājapaṃ tathā cakruḥ oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇa | śrīkṛṣṇaśrīpatisvāmin svāmin gopālanandana || 6 || ityevaṃ rādhike nityaṃ kurvanti sma vidhānataḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmiprapūjanam || 7 || kurvantyamūlyopacārai patipādajalaṃ papuḥ | ātmanivedanamantraṃ dadau tābhyaḥ patiḥ svayam | oṃ śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mama sarvadā || 8 || ityevaṃ śaraṇaṃ mantraṃ dadau hariḥ pṛthak tataḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā || 9 || enaṃ samarpaṇamantraṃ dadau tābhyaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | kālamāyāpāpakarmaśanuyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt || 2.297.1 0|| śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava | enaṃ rakṣaṇamantraṃ ca dadau tābhyaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ || 11 || brāhmyahaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktāsmi śāśvatī | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me || 12|| enaṃ vai brāhmamantraṃ ca dadau tābhyaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ || 1 3|| pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako’stu saḥ | ātmanivedanamantramenaṃ dadau svayaṃ prabhuḥ || 14|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | kaṃbharāśrīnandanaḥ śrīgopālakṛṣṇabālakaḥ || 15|| parabrahmākṣarātīto’vatārāṇāṃ svarūpadhṛk | antaryāmī sadāsmāsu bhagavān sarvakāraṇam || 16|| sarvāntarātmā sarveśo nirlepo mokṣadaḥ sa hi | pāvanaḥ sevito bhuktimuktidaśca sadāvatu || 17|| ityenaṃ jñānamantraṃ ca svayaṃ tābhyo dadau prabhuḥ | kṛṣṇapriyāprabhaktāhaṃ śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama || 18|| śrīkṛṣṇaśrīhariḥ śrīsvāmī sākṣāt śaraṇaṃ mama | śrīkṛṣṇadevo me svāmī śrīhariṃ śaraṇa mama ||1 9|| etān śaraṇamantrāṃśca tādātmyabodhakān dadau | brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca rādhālakṣmyādiyoṣitaḥ ||2.297.20|| parabrahmasvarūpāśca parabrahmārdhamūrtayaḥ | parabrahmārthasarvasvā divyā bhuktipramuktidāḥ ||21 || tatsambandhikriyāścāpi nirguṇā mokṣadāḥ sadā | iti jñānamayaṃ mantraṃ tābhyaḥ svayaṃ dadau prabhuḥ ||22|| yo yo yā yā bālakṛṣṇaṃ tatpriyāśca bhajanti vai | sa sa sā sā tatsvarūpā divyā mokṣapradāḥ sadā ||23|| itijñānaṃ dadau cāpi nirguṇatvādidāyakam | ityevaṃ jñānamantrāḍhyāḥ sarvā vidyādharāḥ striyaḥ ||24|| siṣevire sadā rādhe svāmiśrīkṛṣṇamīśvaram | atha śrīkambharādevī prātaḥ kṛtāhnikā satī ||25|| sutā vilokayituṃ cāgatastrīṇāṃ sumānanam | vyadhād bhojanapānādyaistāmbūlādanasatkaraiḥ ||26|| praśaśaṃsustathā nāryo lakṣmīṃ sarvāstathāparāḥ | kāntā vīkṣya surūpāśca daduścāśiṣa tā muhuḥ ||27||| sukhinyaḥ śāśvatikāśca bhavantu kṛṣṇayoṣitaḥ | putraputryādimatyaśca sadā saubhāgyasaṃyutāḥ |||28|| datvaivamāśiṣo nāryo prāpya pūjāṃ yayurgṛhān | śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaśca mahīmānān samastakān ||29|| kṛtasnānaprapūjām̐śca bhojayāmāsa pāyasam | miṣṭānnāni vibhinnāni śākāni vividhānyapi ||2.297.3 0|| amṛtāsvādayuktāni pakvānnānyodanāni ca | sūpaḥ kvathikā ramyāśca dadhidugdhāni yāni ca ||3 1 || kesaraśarkarāyuktānyamblatiktā vaṭīstathā | jalapānāni miṣṭāni sugandhīni śubhāni ca ||32|| tāmbūlakāni divyāni dadau sarvebhya eva saḥ | kuṃkumavāpikāvāsiprajāḥ saurāṣṭravāsikāḥ ||33|| bhojayāmāsa ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vai kṛṣṇotsavanimittataḥ | koṭiśo mānavā bubhujire śrīkambharālaye ||34|| sarvāḥ putryastatra cakruḥ pariveṣaṇamutsukāḥ | āmadhyāhnaṃ protsavaḥ saḥ kṛto bhojanasaṃbhṛtaḥ ||35|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīre madhyāhnottaramuttamaḥ | nirjagmustāstato vanānyādraṣṭuṃ patisaṃyutāḥ ||36||| mahīmānāstadā sarve viśaśramuḥ sukhālaye | kāntānāṃ ca harervimānakaṃ cottaradigbhavam ||37|| pradeśaṃ cābhilakṣyaiva prasasāra vihāyasā | tāśca śālavanaṃ bilvavanaṃ vīkṣyottare tataḥ ||38|| pālāśāraṇyamāvīkṣya vīkṣyāpi cāndanaṃ vanam | devadāruvanaṃ vīkṣya tulasīvanamuttamam ||39|| campakānāṃ vanaṃ pūrvadiśi vṛndāvanaṃ tathā | candanānāṃ vanaṃ vīkṣya kaṇikānāṃ vanaṃ tathā ||2.297.40|| āmrāṇāṃ ca vanaṃ vīkṣya kundānāṃ sthalapadminām | aśokānāṃ vanaṃ vīkṣya ketakānāṃ vanaṃ tathā ||41|| kamalānāṃ pārijātādīnāṃ kadambaśākhinām | dakṣiṇe tvāśramān vīkṣya lomaśādiṛṣikṛtān ||42|| jambīranārikelādisamudyānaṃ vyalokayan | paścime cāmṛtānāṃ ca kadlīnāṃ vanāni ca ||43 || vīkṣya bhūmiṃ ramaṇīyāṃ badrīvanasuśobhitām | bakulānāṃ vanaṃ vīkṣya jambūvanaṃ pravīkṣya ca ||44|| gundravanaṃ tathā sītāphalavanaṃ vilokya ca | samāyayuścāśvapaṭṭasaro hṛṣṭā niśāmukhe ||45|| avatīrya vimānāttāḥ sandhyāvandanamācaran | tato yayurnijāvāsān bālakṛṣṇena saṃyutāḥ ||46|| bhojanaṃ cakrire sarvāstataḥ śṛṃgāramācaran | bālakṛṣṇo mahīmānānāṃ sevanārthaṃ yayau tadā ||47|| pitrā bhrātrādibhiḥ sākaṃ mahāmaṇḍapamandire | sarvān saṃbhojayāmāsa bahumānapuraḥsaram ||48|| tāmbūlakādi pradadau dadau tatrāpyapekṣitam | sarvaṃ cāste prapūrṇaṃ vai kiṃ nyūnaṃ mādhavīgṛhe ||49|| mahīmānāḥ prasannāścābhavan varavivekataḥ | viśrāntiṃ paramāṃ rātrau lebhire narayoṣitaḥ ||2.297.50 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mandiramāyayau | pratīkṣante navoḍhāstāḥ kāntaṃ sukhayituṃ tadā ||51 || sarvāsāṃ navapatnīnāṃ pūrayituṃ manorathān | koṭyarbudābjarūpāṇi dadhāra śrīpatiḥ prabhuḥ ||52|| pratyekasyāstu bhavane bhavane sa ratipradaḥ | pravartate niśāyāṃ sa mahāyogeśvareśvaraḥ ||53 || śṛṇu rādhe tadā tvekā kanyā divyā samāgatā | draṣṭuṃ praśaṃsitaṃ haṃsarūpadevairhi maṇḍapam ||54|| svalpaṃ cāpi mahāntaṃ ca vīkṣituṃ samupāgatā | sā tu pūrvaṃ mahāntaṃ vai maṇḍapaṃ koṭirūpiṇī ||55 || bhūtvā vyalokayat sarvaṃ mahāścaryaṃ gatā tadā | punaścālpaṃ maṇḍapaṃ ca vyalokayat sthiradṛśā ||56 || sṛṣṭitrayaṃ pravīkṣyaiva mahāścaryaṃ punargatā | maṇḍapāya nama uktvā kṣaṇaṃ maunaṃ sthitābhavat |||57|| śrīrādhikovāca kā sā kanyā kathaṃ tatrāgatya punargatā kva sā | vada me bhagavan sarvaṃ śrāvyaṃ ced vidyate param ||58|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike maṇḍapaṃ dṛṣṭvā haṃsarūpā hi devatāḥ | svargaṃ gatvā praśaśaṃsurmaṇḍapaṃ bahuśobhanam ||59|| tacchrutvā dyauḥ svayaṃ draṣṭuṃ tadā mano’karod drutam | dyauḥ svayaṃ kanyakā bhūtvāgatā kuṃkumavāpikām ||2.297.6 0|| sakuṇḍalā samukuṭā saśṛṃkhalā sabhūṣaṇā | sarvatejobhṛtā pūrṇāmṛtapīyūṣasaṃbhṛtā ||6 1 || rūpānurūpāvayavā mohinīvāparā yathā | rādhā vā kamalā vā cāpareva tatra cāgatā ||62|| adṛṣṭaṃ cāśrutaṃ vāpi tayā pūrve kvacittu yat | tatsarvaṃ maṇḍape vīkṣya mahāścaryaṃ gatā satī ||63|| svalpe tu maṇḍape devī yūpapārśve sthitābhavat | namaskārayutādevyā maṇḍapaḥ svāgataṃ vyadhāt ||64|| samāgaccha svargadevi svāgataṃ karavāṇi te | pādyamarghyaṃ madhuparkaṃ gṛhāṇa bhojanaṃ jalam ||65|| ityuktvā pradadau tasyai siṃhāsanaṃ jalādikam | madhuparkaṃ dadau cāpi bhojanaṃ pradadau śubham ||66|| labdhvā sā maṇḍapaṃ prāha muktarāṭ maṇḍapa śṛṇu | yasyāyaṃ maṇḍapaścedṛg bālakṛṣṇasya vidyate ||67|| tatprāsādaḥ kīdṛśaḥ syāt kīdṛśyaśca samṛddhayaḥ | tadbhoktryaścāpi tatkāntāḥ kīdṛśyaḥ syuḥ sudivyakāḥ ||68|| kīdṛśaḥ syācca vai tāsāṃ kāntaścāsyāpi vaibhavāḥ | kīdṛśāścāpi vai syuśca draṣṭumicchāmi dyauraham ||69|| koṭyarbudābjakāntānāmeka eva patiḥ sa tu | śruto mayādya devānāṃ bṛhaspatermukhāditaḥ ||2.297.70|| kathaṃ sa sarvāsevyaḥ syād draṣṭumicchāmi dyauraham | mayi devā nivasanti tebhyaścāyaṃ tu kiṃbalaḥ ||7 1 || kimaiśvaryaśca kiṃvīryaśca kiṃyogabalo’sti vā | kiṃrūpo vā vartate’dyaikalaḥ sarvapatirhi vai ||72|| indro’pi matpatirnedṛksamartho’stīti vai śrutam | sāhaṃ draṣṭuṃ samāyātorvaśyā sampreritā satī ||73|| uktā ca devaguruṇāsahamānā samāgatā | devaiścāhamadhikṣiptā na tvaṃ maṇḍapasadṛśī ||74|| na tvaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇasyaiśvaryakoṭyaṃśagāpi vā | tadahaṃ tvāgatā cādya saṃdṛṣṭvā maṇḍapaṃ tviha ||75|| adṛṣṭaṃ cāśrutaṃ vāpi maṇiṃ ca dehalīsthitam | vigarvāsmi hi sañjātā draṣṭumicchāmi tacchriyaḥ ||76|| tatsmṛddhīstaṃ divyakāntaṃ tāśca koṭyabjayoṣitaḥ | viśeṣato navāṃ lakṣmīṃ draṣṭumicchāmi dyauraham ||77|| ityukto maṇḍapastūrṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasyaiva mandiram | gatvā lakṣmīgṛhadvāri vetradhāramajijñapat ||78|| vetradharo ratnayukto gatvājñāṃ samavāpya ca | dyāṃ tāṃ praveśayāmāsa kanyāṃ lakṣmīsumandiram ||79|| koṭyarbudābjarūpā dyaurbhūtvā vai samakālinī | praviveśa tu sarvāsāṃ gṛhāṇi vīkṣituṃ tadā ||2.297.80|| sā dadarśa divyarūpaṃ pratyekayā saha sthitam | vibhinnaceṣṭakaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gṛhe gṛhe ||8 1 || lakṣmyā gṛhe tu dolāyāṃ dolāyamānamacyutam | lakṣmyā sākaṃ dadarśainaṃ pupūja dyaurnanāma ha ||82|| māṇikyāstu gṛhe kṛṣṇaṃ bhuñjānaṃ sā dadarśa ha | padmāvatyā gṛhe kāntaṃ paryaṃkasthaṃ dadarśa sā ||83| ramāyāstu gṛhe dugdhaṃ pibantaṃ sā dadarśa ha | rādhāyāstu gṛhe śayyāsthitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dadarśa sā ||84| śrīgṛhe tu śriyā sākaṃ ramantaṃ dyūtameva sā | dadarśa kuśalāsaudhe bhakṣayantaṃ hi tāmbulam ||85|| sarasvatīgṛhe taṃ ca gāyantaṃ vīṇayā sthitam | gaṃgāgṛhe gaṃgayā vai pādasaṃvāhitaṃ ca sā |||86|| dadarśa virajāgehe viharantamitastataḥ | durgāgṛhe hasantaṃ ca narmavākyairdadarśa sā ||89|. śāradāmandire mālā japantaṃ taṃ dadarśa ha | kāśīrājasya putrīṇāṃ geheṣu kṛṣṇarūpiṇam ||88|| śṛṃgārayantaṃ vanitāḥ dadarśānandakāriṇam | ājanābhīgṛheṣvenaṃ dadarśa dyauḥ pṛthagvidham ||89||| aitihāsikavārtāsthaṃ kalākauśalyavartinam | aśanāditriṃśadūrdhvaśatapatnīgṛhe tu tam ||2.297.90|| śayyāsuyogabhāvena ramantaṃ sā dadarśa ha | maṃgalādiyoṣitāṃ tu geheṣu keśasādhanam || 9 1| prakurvantaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ dadarśa dyaustadā prabhum | auṣṇālayīyanārīṇāṃ gehe tābhiḥ pramarditam ||92| snapitaṃ tailasārādyairbhūṣābhirbhūṣitaṃ prabhum | dadarśātha ca prācīnīyakāntānāṃ tu mandire ||93|| alaktakādibhistābhiḥ rajyamānaṃ ca citritam | ramantaṃ hāsayantaṃ ca dadarśa dyauḥ subhāgyagā ||94|| rāśiyānīyakāntānāṃ gṛheṣu svāminaṃ harim | tattaddeśīyavṛttānte magnaṃ dadarśa śobhanam ||95| kiṃpuruṣīyapatnīnāṃ gṛheṣu kambharātmajam | saṃgītamagnaṃ sarvābhiḥ saha dadarśa sā tadā ||96| ketumālīyakāntānāṃ mandireṣu śukānujam | rājabhūṣā dhārayantaṃ dadarśa rājarītigam ||97| amarīṇāṃ gṛheṣvenaṃ nṛtyantaṃ tābhiranvitam | lalanābhiḥ saha dyauśca dadarśānandasaṃbhṛtam ||98|| hārītīnāṃ nivāseṣu sambandhijanasevitam | āsīnaṃ cāsane strībhirveṣṭitaṃ taṃ dadarśa sā ||9 9 || brāhmīlīnāṃ nivāseṣu devapūjāparāyaṇam | rātrau dadarśa taṃ dyauśca divyarūpadharaṃ prabhum || 2.297.1 00|| ābriktīnāṃ mandireṣu gāyanaṃ vādyatālakaiḥ | rajobhāvabharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ svamagnaṃ sandadarśa sā || 101 || paitṛkīnāṃ gṛhe kṛṣṇaṃ śrāddhayuktaṃ dadarśa sā | devīnāṃ ratibhāvādyairyuktaṃ dadarśa mādhavam || 10 2|| kutracinnāṭyakhelaṃ ca lokayantaṃ striyā saha | kutracit premabhāvena spṛśantaṃ taṃ dadarśa sā || 103 || kutracidyogivaddhyāne magnaṃ dadarśa sā tadā | kutracit taṃ suptameva nidrāyāṃ sā dadarśa ha || 1 04|| kutracidvai śikṣayantaṃ yoṣito brahmavedanam | kutracitpūrayantaṃ ca manāṃsi yoṣitāṃ tadā || 1 05|| dadarśa kutracinmālāṃ grathnantaṃ puṣpajātibhiḥ | dyaurdadarśa taṃ gṛhāṅgaṇe sthitaṃ vai tadaikalam || 1 06|| kutracittu samāyāntaṃ pārśvagṛhād gṛhāntaram | kutracid gṛhamadhye tu tapantaṃ vahninā ca tam || 1 07|| dadarśa bahirevainaṃ dvāri vā kutracitprabhum | kutracid bhāryayā sākaṃ yāntaṃ dadarśa bhūṣitam || 1 08|| kutracid darpaṇe naijāṃ patnīṃ mukhaṃ sacandrakam | darśayantaṃ ca kurvantaṃ candrakaṃ sā dadarśa ha || 1 09|| kutracitpramadānetre’ñjayantaṃ kajjalaṃ ca tam | kutracit svapriyābhāle kurvantaṃ patrikāṃ tadā || 2.297.11 0|| kutracit pādayoścāpi lepayantamalaktakam | kutraciccātitādātmyāt samāśliṣyantamityapi || 11 1|| kutracittaṃ bhojayantaṃ kavalena nijāśritām | kutracittāmcūlarasa cārpayantaṃ mukhena ha || 11 2|| dadarśa śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dyaurvyajanānvitam | kvaciddadarśa taṃ rājādhirājaṃ tvāsanesthitam || 11 3|| kvacicca marditaṃ saṃvāhitaṃ bahvībhireva tam | kvacinnetramiṣeṇāpi tvāhvayantaṃ nijāṃ priyām || 1 14|| kvacillikhantaṃ patraṃ ca jñācinnigūḍhaceṣṭakam | evaṃ bhinnakriyaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vibhum || 115 dadarśa dyauḥ sarvamandireṣu sarvāyutaṃ prabhum | pupūja parayā prītyā dampatī sā gṛhe gṛhe || 116 lakṣmyādyāścāpi tāṃ jñātvā dyāṃ mahīmānikāṃ nijām | svāgataṃ paramaṃ cakrurbhojayāmāsurutsukāḥ || 1 17|| daduśca puṣpahārādīn pāritoṣikamuttamam | kāntalīlāsmaraṇaṃ ca mokṣadaṃ pradaduḥ striyaḥ || 1 18|| smṛddhiṃ vilokayāmāsa dyaustu sarvotamottamām | yā na svarge na vai satye neśvareṣvapi santi ca || 1 19|| tāstāḥ smṛddhīścāmbarāṇi vibhūṣāścāsanāni ca | paryaṃkān śayanārhāṃśca pātrāṇi maṇihīrakān || 2.297.1 20|| kośān catuṣkikān yantrottamāni svarṇapeṭikāḥ | vimānāni vilokyāpi mahāścaryaṃ gatābhavat || 121 || indragṛhe brahmasaudhe sūryagṛhe śaśigṛhe | dhruvālaye kuberasyālaye smṛddhirna yāsti tām || 122|| vilokyaikagṛhe dyauḥ svagarvahīnā babhūva ha | āśiṣaṃ ca kṣamāṃ prāpyāgatya vai maṇḍapaṃ tataḥ || 123|| yayau svargaṃ bhāsayantī diśo daśa vihāyasā | ityevaṃ rādhike śrīmad bālakṛṣṇasya ceṣṭitam || 124|| koṭyaiśvaryasamāyuktaṃ koṭyarbudābjapatnikam | tāvatībhiḥ sahaśaśvat śṛṃgārabhāvasaṃbhṛtam || 125|| divyameva hi mantavyaṃ nirguṇaṃ mokṣadaṃ śubham | nityamevaṃ sukhado vai bhagavān bhaktisevinām || 1 26|| navoḍhānāṃ rātrisakhaḥ prasuṣvāpa sukhottaram | sarvakāmaprapūraḥ sa bhagavān bhāgyagocaraḥ || 1 27|| atha dyauḥ rādhike svargagatāpi mohitā harau | patnīṃ bhavituṃ satataṃ ceyeṣāharniśaṃ tataḥ || 1 28|| kadācit kāmabhogecchāvatyāyāt śrīhariṃ rahaḥ | tṛptāṃ cakre harirbhukttvā sā yayau muditā divam || 129|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne ṣaṣṭhyāḥ prātaḥ kṛtāhnikāḥ kāntā mantrān jagṛhuḥ, mahīmānānāṃ bhojanam, yuvatīnāṃ vimānena vanāvalokanārthaṃ vyomaviharaṇam, rātribhojanam, līlāṃ draṣṭuḥ dyauḥ kanyā samāyātā, koṭyarbudābjayoṣitāṃ saudheṣu bhinnalīlaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vīkṣya mugdhā dyauḥ svargaṃ gatā, harernidrā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 297 ||
<2.298> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca rādhike yugapad rātrau svāṃganānāṃ sukhapradaḥ | jajāgāra harirvādyairmaṃgalaiḥ stavanaiḥ prage || 1 || jajāgarurvidheyārthā brāhme muhūrtake tadā | hariḥ prāha ca sarvābhyo dhyāne tiṣṭhata me kṣaṇam || 2 || mama yogena divyāḥ stho bhavatyaścādya yoṣitaḥ | muktā māyāvihīnāścāvaraṇādivivarjitāḥ || 3 || ityuktā rādhike sarvāḥ kṛṣṇamādhavayoṣitaḥ | pativratāḥ svakāntājñāṃ labdhvā dhyāne sthitāḥ kṣaṇam || 4 || tāvadbhagavati sarvā nāḍīprāṇavaśāstadā | saṃhṛtya nāḍikāprāṇān samādhau hṛdaye yayuḥ || 5 || vismṛtā dehabhānaṃ tā hṛdaye kāntasannidhau | dadṛśuḥ kāntamūrtisthaṃ brahmatejotibhāsuram || 6 || tejasāṃ rāśayastatra mahārṇavā ivābhavan | tatra vyalokayan svargaṃ sarvadevālayām̐stataḥ || 7 || tato’gre svavimānena svāminā saha tatparam | yayuḥ pitṛpradeśām̐ścālokayan puṇyabhāsurān || 8 || yayustato’pi cāgre vai kṛṣṇakāntena saṃyutāḥ | satyalokaṃ yayuḥ sarvāstannivāsaiśca satkṛtāḥ || 9 || divyabhāvaṃ samāpannāḥ pṛthivyāvaraṇaṃ dṛḍham | vibhidya prayayuḥ sarvāḥ salilāvaraṇaṃ tataḥ || 2.298.10 || agre tā dṛṣṭavatyaśca vaikuṇṭhaṃ tejaso’ntikam | āvaraṇasya sandhau vai tatra śrīrāmasevikāḥ || 11 || sītāramādyāstāsāṃ vai svāgataṃ saṃvyadhurmudā | rāmādityaścakārāpi svāgataṃ paramātmanaḥ || 12|| tataścāgre yayustatra marutpaṭaṃ vihāya ca | vyomapaṭaṃ tathāhaṃbhittikāṃ vihāya cordhvake || 13 || mahattattvātmakaṃ cāvaraṇaṃ vihāya copari | yayuḥ kāntena sahitāḥ śubhaṃ vairājamandiram || 14|| tatra tenārcitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ | pūjitāśca hareḥ sarvā vairājyā rājayoṣitā || 15|| tataścāgre yayuḥ sarvā hiraṇyagarbhamaṇḍalam | mahāviṣṇormahārājyaṃ yatra gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 1 6|| nijeśvaraḥ śrīdevyā ca mahālakṣmyākhyayoṣitā | tathā śrīkambharādevyā saha tatra virājate || 1 7|| tābhiśca pūjito devaḥ kāntapitā tataśca vai | kāntamātā pūjitā ca tābhyāṃ śriyaśca satkṛtāḥ || 18|| bhojitā āśliṣya cāśīrvādaiḥ samyak prayojitāḥ | patiśca pūjitaścājñāmādāya cordhvake stare || 1 9|| patiyuktā vimānasthā yayurbhūmno mahāsthalam | bhūmnyā devyā satkṛtāstā bhūmnā ca satkṛto hariḥ || 2.298.20|| tadvibhūtīrvilokyāgre vāsudevālayaṃ yayuḥ | vāsudevī cakārāsāṃ satkāraṃ bahubhāvitā ||21 || susatkāraṃ hareścakre vāsudevanarāyaṇaḥ | amṛtānāṃ prapānaṃ ca pīyūṣabhojanādikam ||22|| vāsudevyaḥ kārayāmāsuḥ prapūjāṃ vyadhustathā | athāvatāradhāmāni pradarśya bhagavām̐stataḥ || 23|| akṣaraṃ dhāma paramaṃ nijaṃ jagāma vai hariḥ | brahmahrade snapayitvā niṣkāsyākṣaratejasi ||24|| nijamūrtau tato līnīkṛtya sarvāśca vai tadā | muktā divyāśca sārūpyānvitā vidhāya vai tadā ||25|| svena rūpeṇa niṣpannāḥ sarvāvaraṇavarjitāḥ | puruṣottamabhāvāśca parabrahmātmikāśca tāḥ ||26|| rūpadharmasvabhāvaiśca guṇaiḥ sarvātmanā hariḥ | svavad vyadhāt tadā cātra rādhe kiṃ vai vadāmi te || 27|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre śarīrāṇi svayoṣitām | dhāmayogyāni jātāni māyikatvaṃ layaṃ gatam || 28|| caitanyaikarasānandātmakāni santi sarvadā | sārvajñyātmajñānapiṇḍavikāsāḍhyāni tāni hi ||29|| sampannānyabhiniṣpannānyeva dhāmagatāni vat | prajātāni tato brahmahrade snānāttato’pi ca ||2.298.3 0|| brāhmītanusvarūpāṇi muktātmakāni santi ca | akṣarabrahmarūpāṇi tejomayāni tāni vai ||3 1 || prajātānyatha mūrtisthitilābhato’dhikāni vai | bhagavadrūpaṃ prāptāni bhāgavatāni santi vai || 32|| prajātānīti caitanyabrāhmabhāgavatāni hi | jñānatejaḥsusārūpyābhidhānāni bhavanti hi ||33|| tatrāsaṃkhyābhiretābhirmuktānībhiḥ prasevitaḥ | muktaiśca sevitaḥ śrīmān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||34|| darśayāmāsa tābhyo vai sāmrājyaṃ tvakṣarātmakam | sārvabhaumaṃ mahārājyaṃ sṛṣṭitrayordhvasaṃsthitam ||35|| nijaiśvaryāṇi sarvāṇi vibhūtīḥ sakalā api | nityānandāni bhogyāni darśayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ||36|| smṛddhīdivyāṃ maṇḍalāni muktānīnāṃ samantataḥ | muktānāṃ maṇḍalakoṭīrdarśayāmāsa kāntakaḥ ||37|| udyānāni vicitrāṇi mandirāṇi śubhāni ca | sarvāsāṃ nijavāsām̐śca darśayāmāsa kṛṣṇakaḥ ||38|| sampadaḥ sarvadivyāśca sarvasaubhāgyakāni ca | sarveṣṭakalpamaṇikān darśayāmāsa kaustubhān ||39|| nijamūrteḥ kiraṇāni puṣṭidāni samantataḥ | tṛptidāni sukhāvāptipradānyānandadāni ca ||2.298.40|| ratiprītiharṣadāni kāmakalpapradāni ca | nityānandabhṛtānyeva darśayāmāsa vai patiḥ ||41|| sarvavidhāstathā śālāḥ sevāyogyā navā navāḥ | yatheṣṭāvyāhatāścāpi vihārāṇāṃ sthalīḥ śubhāḥ ||42|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavyāptā hyadarśayat | veṣabhūṣāmbaraśṛṃgārādīn divyānadarśayat ||43|| rahasyabhāvavāsām̐śca śayyā ramyā adarśayat | tatratyaṃ sarvamevābhyo darśayitvā tataḥparam ||44|| parabrahmānandamayaṃ bhojanaṃ pānamuttamam | tāmbūlakaṃ dadau tābhyo vihāraṃ pradadau sukham ||45|| aikāntikaṃ sukhaṃ cāpi rahasyajaṃ dadau prabhuḥ | tato dhāmno mahāmuktakṛtāṃ pūjāṃ śubhocitām ||46|| jagrāha bhagavām̐stāsāṃ sannidhau muktayoṣitām | muktānībhiśca muktaiśca kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ ca tā api ||47|| jagṛhurdivyarūpāśca svāgataṃ mānanaṃ bahu | evaṃ nijaṃ gṛhaṃ sarvaṃ pradarśya bhagavān hariḥ ||48|| akṣarāt prayayau śrīmadgolokaṃ dhāma vai tataḥ | śrīkṛṣṇena kṛtaṃ tatra svāgataṃ paramātmanaḥ ||49|| rādhādibhiḥ kṛtaṃ tatra sammānaṃ hariyoṣitām | kāmadhenupayaḥpānaṃ dadū rādhādayastadā ||2.298.50|| pāyasānnāni bhojyāni śṛṃgārāṇi dadustathā | tataḥ śīghraṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ yayau tābhiḥ saha prabhuḥ ||51 || tatra kṛtaṃ svāgataṃ ca lakṣmyā kamalayā tathā | bhārgavyā ca śriyā vikuṇṭhayā cānyābhirityapi ||52|| nārāyaṇena ca kṛtaṃ sanmānaṃ śrīharestadā | pūjanaṃ stavanaṃ cāpi prāpya pradarśya bhūtikāḥ ||53|| sādāśaivaṃ hri kailāsaṃ divyaṃ yayau svayaṃ prabhuḥ | tatratyāśca samagrāśca vibhūtīrbhagavān priyāḥ ||54|| darśayāmāsa śaivīśca durgādyāścāpyapūjayan | gaṇāḥ sarve’pi vai tatra cakrurhareḥ prapūjanam ||55|| tato yayau sa tābhirvai sahitaḥ śrīhariḥ khalu | kautukārthaṃ mahāmāyādhāma māyāmayaṃ śubham ||56|| vyalokayan hareḥ kāntātulyāḥ kāntāśca koṭiśaḥ | sarvā brahmapriyāstatra sammānaṃ bahu lebhire ||57|| māyābhiśca vicitrābhiḥ kanyābhiścābhipūjitāḥ | sevitā bahudhā tatra māyikairvastusattamaiḥ ||58|| bhojyapānasubhogaiścāmbarabhūṣāprasādhanaiḥ | sarvottejakacūrṇaiśca śṛṃgārarasavardhakaiḥ || 99 || sarvaveṣopakaraṇaiḥ sarvasaubhāgyavastubhiḥ | sarvānandapradairbhāvaiḥ sevitāḥ pūjitāḥ striyaḥ | | 2.298.60 || mahāmāyā svayaṃ tatra pādasaṃvāhanaṃ hareḥ | cakāreti mahāścaryaṃ prāpuḥ sarvā haristriyaḥ | | 61 || rājarājeśvarī sarveśvarī rājñīśvarī hi sā | svapatiṃ sevamānā vai sarvābhiravalokitā || 62 || pradarśya ca harirmāyādhāma paścād drutaṃ tataḥ | viṣṇordhāma yayau tatra vaiṣṇavyo mānanaṃ vyadhuḥ | | 63 | | sarvāsāṃ svāgataṃ nīrājanaṃ prapūjanaṃ tathā | bhojanaṃ pānamiṣṭaṃ ca dadurvastrāmbarāṇi ca | | 64| | tataḥ śrībālakṛṣṇo’sau yayau priyābhirañjanaḥ | śatamastakaviṣṇośca sahasrānanaśārṅgiṇaḥ | | 65 || lakṣānanasya viṣṇośca koṭyānanasya śārṅgiṇaḥ | abjanetrasya śaṃbhośca padmānanasya vedhasaḥ | | 66| | parārdhānanasaṃśobhadvedhaso’ṇḍāni vai hariḥ | darśayāmāsa sarvāṇi sṛṣṭyānantyamayāni hi || 67 | | taistaiḥ sampūjitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ priyonijaḥ | darśayāmāsa teṣāṃ ca vibhūtīḥ svasamarpitāḥ || 68 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārpitā vibhūtikāḥ | bhuñjate sarva evaite brahmapriyābhireva tat | | 69 | | vilokitaṃ hi sākṣādvai samādhau rādhike tadā | tatastā vai samādāya sūryacandrādikān grahān | |2.298.7 0 || darśayāmāsa lokasthān nirayātmakasaṃsthitān | tān vilokya tadā tāsāṃ mano lagnaṃ na tatra vai ||7 1 || śīghraṃ tā ānayāmāsa kṣetraṃ kuṃkumavāpikām | naije divyākṣarākhye vai maṇḍape bhavane śubhe || 7 2 || ākṣareṇa same tatra manaḥ sthairyamavāpa ha | samādhitaśca tāḥ sarvā jajāgarustadā nijān ||7 3 || dehān dhāmagatān divyān prāptānamānavān parān | dadṛśuścāvaraṇabhāvavarjitānapyabhautikān || 74| | amāyikān sadā tvekarūpān kṣuttṛḍvivarjitān | māyāguṇairvihīnām̐śca dhāmaiśvaryasamanvitān | |75|| sarvadhāmasvabhāvām̐ścākṣaratulyasukhātmakān | brahmānandabharām̐ścāpi divyaveṣābhiśobhitān || 76 || patyanyūnasamaiśvaryān divyatāśevadhisthitīn | mahānandabharā jātāḥ samarthā bālakṛṣṇavat || 77 || evamāsādya divyatvaṃ patiṃ prāpya ca tāstadā | sārvajñyaṃ lebhire patnyo vadhūṭayo’pyavadhūṭikāḥ ||78 || evaṃ dadau haristābhyo nijasāmyaṃ hi śāśvatam | rādhike tvaṃ mayā yadvat kṛtā svasāmyaśobhitā ||79|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇenaivaṃ kṛtā vai nijayoṣitaḥ | pṛthivyāvaraṇaṃ bhittyāvaraṇaṃ ca gṛhāvṛtim ||2.298.8 0 || yāsāṃ na vidyate vyāghātaśca dvārapidhānake | jalamadhye samudrādau nadīpravāhaṇe hime ||8 1 || vṛṣṭyādyābhiḥ parābhūtiryāsāṃ dehe na vidyate | vahnidāho na cāsāṃ vai dāhaḥ sūryātapairna ca ||82||| vāḍavānala evaitā vidyudvā na dahatyapi | sūrye candre grahānye ca svatantrā gantumeva tāḥ ||8 2 || śvāsādhīnā na caitāśca na vāyuḥ śoṣayatyapi | prāṇāyāmordhvabhāvāstā vidyante brahmayoṣitaḥ ||84|| tandrālasyagurutvāni vidyante naiva sarvathā | viṣeṇa vā naiva cāsāṃ parābhavo bhavatyapi |||85||| śastraghāto nāpi dehe bhedako jāyate kvacit | rogāḥ sthātuṃ na ca śaknuvanti tāsu ca māyikāḥ ||86 || dūraśravaṇasiddhiśca dūrapratyakṣasiddhikā | dūragrahaṇasiddhiśca dūrālāpādisiddhayaḥ || 87|| manojavitvamevāsāṃ sūkṣmabhāvitvamityapi | mahadbhāvitvamevāpi sarvakāmāvasāyitā || 88 || sarvasya vaśatā cāpi koṭirūpādidhāritā | brahmāṇḍāntaragamanaṃ śītoṣṇānabhibhūtatā ||8 9 || saṃkalpasṛṣṭikartṛtvaṃ siddhyaiśvaryāṇi yāni ca | tānyāsāṃ sampravartante bālakṛṣṇakṛpāvaśāt || 2.298.90 || kalpalatāḥ kalpagāvaḥ kalpapātrāṇi yāni ca | kalpamaṇayaścāpyāsāṃ vartante kalpanāvaśāḥ || 91 || ityevaṃvidhamaiśvaryaṃ cātulaṃ ca kṣaṇe kṣaṇe | tāsāmavartata rādhe dadṛśurvyutthitāstadā || 92|| śarīrāṇi dhāmamuktamayānītyavalokayan | prasannāścābhavan sarvā māyāgarvavivarjitāḥ || 93 || tataḥ sarvāḥ samutthāya bālakṛṣṇaṃ nijeśvaram | divyarītyāpyasevanta snānapūjanabhojanaiḥ || 94|| śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaśca bālakṛṣṇādayastathā | kṛtasnānāhnikebhyaśca mahīmānebhya ārpayan || 95 || pūjanāni bhojanāni satkārāṇi dhanāni ca | tṛptāstāmbūlakānyāpya sarve gantuṃ nijān nijān || 96 || deśān lokān mahīmānā arthayāmāsuracyutam | śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaṃ ca tathā śrīkambharāsatīm ||97|| hareḥ pitā kṣamāṃ tebhyo yayāce nyūnasevane | bhavatāmāgamenāyaṃ protsavaḥ śobhano’bhavat ||98|| punarbhagavatāṃ yogo darśanaṃ vā kadā bhavet | avaśyamatrāgantavyaṃ jñātvā naijaṃ vaśānugam || 99|| ityuktvā praṇanāmāpi vidāyaṃ pradadau bahu | pūjāṃ cakāra bahudhā dravyāṇi pradadau tathā || 2.298.10 0|| svarṇarūpyakahīrakān pūjāyāṃ pradadau pitā | karmacāribhya evāsau pāritoṣikakān dadau || 101 || dīnānāthātithivargebhyaśca dadau yatheṣṭakam | dāsabhṛtyakalāvidbhyaḥ pradadau tuṣṭikṛddhanam || 1 02|| rājabhyaścāpi sarvebhyo dadau sumukaṭāni vai | devebhyaśceśvarebhyaśca kirīṭān pradadau prabhuḥ || 103 || devībhyaścāpi nārībhyo veṣābhūṣādi sandadau | sarvebhyaḥ pradadau sveṣṭaṃ sarveṣṭaṃ pāritoṣikam || 1 04|| avatārāstathā vyūhā bhūmādyāśca virājakāḥ | viṣṇavo’jāḥ pitaraśca surāḥ siddhā maharṣayaḥ || 1 05|| mānavāstalavāsāśca tīrthādrisaritādikāḥ | sarve tuṣṭā avadam̐śca santuṣṭāḥ sma sadā tava || 1 06|| gopālakṛṣṇa yāsyāmaḥ svastyastu te sutasya vai | kanyakānāṃ tathā svasti kuśalaṃ vo’stu sarvadā || 1 07|| ityuktvā sajjabhāvāste sajjopakaraṇādikāḥ | vimānāni sajjayitvābhavan prasthānatatkṣaṇāḥ || 1 08|| parasparaṃ mahīmānāḥ sambandhinaḥ suhṛjjanāḥ | mimilurvakṣasā vakṣo datvā nāryo’pi tattathā || 1 09|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne saptamyāṃ prātaḥ sarvāsāṃ samādhau sṛṣṭitrayākṣaradhāmādipradarśanaṃ, tāsāṃ śāśvatadivyamuktasvabhāvīkaraṇam, mahīmānabhojanapūjanadānakṣamāvidāyādi, kṣetradevapāritoṣikādi cetinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 298 ||
<2.299> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike gantuṃ samaye sarvakanyakāḥ | mātṛbhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ parirabdhāḥ snehabhṛtāntarāḥ || 1 || viyogāśrūṇi saṃsrāvya maunaṃ vai jaḍavat sthitāḥ | divyāśca divyadehāśca pūrvato’bjaguṇoditāḥ || 2 || vīkṣya sambandhināṃ cāsu snehaṃ cābhyadhivardhitam | soḍhuṃ teṣāṃ viyogaṃ cāśaktā manāk tadābhavan || 3 || tadā tanmātaraḥ putrīrvīkṣya viyogaduḥkhitāḥ | mugdhāstā arthayāmāsurmātaro bālakṛṣṇakam || 4 || saha netuṃ nijāḥ putrīḥ svalpasamayameva ha | vilokayituṃ rāṣṭraṃ svaṃ kuṭumbinaḥ suhṛjjanān || 5 || vīkṣārthā svasṛsahajā udāraṃ śrīhariṃ muhuḥ | prabho preṣaya naḥ putrīrnaḥ sukhārthahetave || 6 || punaḥ śīghraṃ ca māsānte preṣayiṣyāma tāriha | sevāyāṃ tava bho kṛṣṇa kṛpālo’rthitamāvaha || 7 || hariḥ prāha tathāstveva tāsāṃ vāpsalyahetave | sarvā ājñāpayāmāsa gantuṃ mātrādibhiḥ saha || 8 || prasannāstāstadā sarvāḥ śrutvā prabhorudāratām | sahasā tāḥ hariṃ gatvā nemuḥ sasvajire prabhum || 9 || drutaṃ samāgamiṣyāmaścetyuktvāpyantasevanam | kṣaṇaṃ cakrustṛptidaṃ vai punarāgamanāya tāḥ || 2.299.10 || svakāntaṃ tā muhuḥ saṃsevya ca sajjā vibhūṣitāḥ | śṛṃgāritā hyabhavam̐śca pupūjuḥ parameśvaram || 11 || pitaraṃ mātaraṃ viṣṇoḥ svasāraṃ pūjyayoṣitaḥ | sarvā vṛddhān kuṭumbasthān natvābhāṣya sukhāgatam || 12 || sukhāyatiṃ prabhāṣyāpi yogyocitāmbarānvitāḥ | yogyabhūṣā vimānānyāruruhuḥ svāminirdeśitāḥ || 13 || āgantavyaṃ cetyuvāca sarvā vai bhagavām̐stadā | mumocāśrūṇi viśvātmā māyayā cāpyamāyikaḥ || 14|| tadā vādyānyavādyanta pūṣpākṣataiśca pūjanam | vimānānāmabhavacca kṛtaṃ saubhāgyikādibhiḥ || 15|| ṛtavo dharmadevaśca naro devī ca pīṭhikā | mahī ca maṇḍapo mukto māṇikyastaṃbha ityapi || 16 || sudarśanaṃ tathā cakraṃ haro gaṇādhināyakaḥ | nava te darśanārthaṃ vai mātṝṇāṃ samupāyayuḥ || 1 7|| kṛtavanto daṇḍavacca kṣantavyāḥ kṣetrapālakāḥ | ityuktvā sthitavantaśca tadā tebhyo haristathā || 18|| haripriyāḥ samastāśca vāsudevādayo’pi ca | āśīrvādān pradaduśca daduśca pāritoṣikam || 1 9|| ratnānyanekarūpāṇi hīrakādisrajastathā | mukuṭāni suramyāṇi pātrabhūṣāmbarāṇi ca || 2.299.20 || nāmapaṭṭāni sauvarṇākṣarayuktāni vai tathā | dhanāni copakaraṇānyuttamāni śubhāni ca || 21 || te saṃgṛhya sukhāpannāḥ sañjātāḥ kṣetradārakāḥ | vyaṃgulānāṃ tadā śabdā yantraśabdāstathābhavan ||22|| bherīśabdā jayaśabdāścābhavannambare’bhitaḥ | kanyakā harṣitāḥ pitṛvimāneṣu sthitāstadā || 23 || aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre kāntaṃ vilokayantyapi | lomaśaṃ puṣpavṛṣṭyā ca praṇāmaiścāpyapūjayan ||24|| athāmbare vimānāni gatimantyabhavam̐stataḥ | koṭyarbudābjakanyāstāḥ sarvāḥ pitrādibhiḥ saha || 25|| kāśīśvarīṃ vinā jagmunaiṃjān deśān samātṛkāḥ | ākṣarāṇyaśca muktānyo brāhmyastatra prabhuṃ vinā || 26|| na gantavyamiti kṛtvāvasan svakāntamandire | rādhike bālakṛṣṇo’pi cāntarātmā saha sthitaḥ ||27|| ātmanivedinīstrībhiḥ sahādṛśyo yayau sahaḥ | sṛṣṭitrayasya kāntāstāḥ svasvalokaṃ gatāstadā ||28|| kṣetre kuṃkumavāpyākhye śūnyamivābhavat kṣaṇāt | haryājñayā tato mukto maṇḍapo’pi tiro’bhavat ||29|| susvalpo maṇḍapaścāpi śīghraṃ tatra tiro’bhavat | evaṃ jātaḥ parihāro bālakṛṣṇecchayā drutam || 2.299.30 || yāratu sakhyo’vasan svāmisevāyāṃ kāśikāsutāḥ | tā asevanta śrīkṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ mudāniśam ||3 1 || divyā divyasvarūpā vai pātivratyaparāyaṇāḥ | karmaṇā manasā vācā dehena sevanaṃ vyadhuḥ ||32|| lakṣmīrviśeṣabhāvena sevate parameśvaram | satsu dāsīsahasrāsu samānāsu satīṣvapi || 33 || snapanaṃ vastradānaṃ cābhyaṃgaṃ prakeśasādhanam | veṣaṃ vastrakṣālanaṃ ca dantadhāvanamityapi ||34|| kajjalaṃ mastake tailaṃ cāṃgamardanamityapi | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ vāripānadānaṃ ca bhojanam ||35|| tāmbūlakaṃ vyajanena vāyudānaṃ ca naktakam | phaladānaṃ tathā śayyāstaraṇaṃ kalaśārpaṇam ||36 || yatkiṃcinnijatanvā syāt tatsarvaṃ svayamācarat | nijeśasya samastaṃ sevanaṃ pariparāyaṇā ||37|| lakṣmīrevāsti lakṣmīrvai netarā tatsamā kvacit | evaṃ vai vartamānāyāṃ lakṣmyāṃ kṛṣṇasya vai kvacit ||38|| kṣatirna dṛśyate sevākṛte tadvai viśiṣyate | tathāpi samadṛk kṛṣṇaḥ sarvāsu samatāyutaḥ ||39|| vartate sukhadaścātisnehavānnatu pakṣavān | audāryaṃ parame kānte tadeva vartate sadā ||2.299.40|| sarvāsāṃ kāmapūratvaṃ tṛptidatvaṃ yatheṣṭakam | padmāvatyā ramāyāśca lakṣmyadhikaṃ hi sevanam | ābhyāṃ vismāritā lakṣmīḥ svāmyarthābhyāṃ sadā tvanu ||41|| atha rādhe vasante cotsavaṃ kṛṣṇaścakāra ha | puṣpadolotsavaṃ cāpi pracakāra sukhāvaham | cāturmāsyotsavaṃ cāpi pracakāra vratātmakam ||42|| ūrjamāsaḥ samāyātaścāṣṭamī janmabodhikā | kārṣṇī samīpagā cāste ceti vicārya yoṣitaḥ ||43|| sarvāḥ pitṛgṛhāttūrṇamārūḍhāḥ suvimānakam | āyayuḥ śrībālakṛṣṇagṛhaṃ pitrādisaṃhitāḥ ||44|| svāmigṛhaṃ samāsādya sukhinyo vai tadābhavan | sarveṣāṃ vai mahīmānottamānāṃ sukhamānanam ||45|| śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇo vai yathārthamakarottadā | rājāno’pi tathā cakruḥ śrīkṛṣṇasya prabhostabhā ||46|| pañcadaśe pūrṇavarṣe ṣoḍaśe janmasūtsave | sutānāṃ pitaraḥ sarve sarvasṛṣṭinivāsinaḥ ||47|| samāyātāścākṣarākhye kṣetre vardhayituṃ harim | prātareva kṛtasnānaścāṣṭamyāṃ kṛtamaṃgalaḥ ||48|| kṛtaśṛṃgāraveṣaśca hariḥ saṃsadamāyayau | lomaśādyaiḥ pūjitaśca vardhito’pi śubhāśiṣā ||49 || pūjādānaiḥ pāvitaścānandito yaśasāṃ stavaiḥ | rājādhirājaśobhāḍhyaḥ śuśubhe parameśvaraḥ ||2.299.50 || prātaścaivaṃ vartamāne janmāhasumahotsave | dīyante tatra dānāni gajavājigavādayaḥ ||51|| gomahiṣīvṛṣabhoṣṭrayānavāhanakāni ca | gṛhakṣetrārāmavāṭīdhanasvarṇātmakāni ca ||52|| vādyante tatra vādyāni gīyante tadyaśāṃsi ca | parihāre tato jāte madhyāhne bhojanādikam ||53 || abhavat sarvalokānāṃ kāntānāṃ śreṣṭhameva ha | atithīnāṃ prasatkārā annavastrādibhiḥ kṛtāḥ ||54|| rātrau nāṭyaṃ cābhavattu tadā dṛśyaṃ manoharam | mallānāṃ khelanaṃ cāpi saṃgītānāṃ ravāstathā ||55|| kāvyāni kavivaryāṇāṃ nṛtyāni vārayoṣitām | upadeśāśca sādhūnāmabhavan janmasūtsave ||56|| etasminnutsave rādhe ramāpadmāvatīpitā | nārāyaṇaḥsutaścārkodevaścākṣarakṣetrake ||57|| svayaṃ divyāvatāro yaḥ sūryāṃśaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ | kāśītaścāgatastatra saṃsmṛtvā vacanaṃ hareḥ ||58|| mokṣaṇārthaṃ svayaṃ jātismaraḥ śivo yato hi saḥ | mānavaṃ bhāvamutsṛjya śivabhāvaṃ samīhate ||59|| dhenupālo’pi svarājyaṃ datvā putrāya yogine | dharmapālāya ca tatastena sahāgato’bhavat ||2.299.60|| sarve te kṛtasaṃkalpā muktyarthaṃ tvaritāstadā | abhavam̐ste tu vai kṛtvā śubhaṃ janmotsavaṃ tataḥ | prārthayan paramātmānaṃ dehamocanahetave ||6 1 || hariḥ prāhottarāyaṇasthitaṃ sūryaṃ vilokya vai | gantavyaṃ mama dhāmātra stheyaṃ tāvad gṛhe’tra ca | ityāśāṃ śirasi dhṛtvā sarvaṃ kuṭumbakaṃ śriyāḥ ||62|| tasthau lakṣmyā gṛhe nityaṃ viśāle mandirāntare | śivaḥ svayaṃ hariṃ putrīpatiṃ papraccha sādhanam ||6 3|| mokṣasyaiva tadā kṛṣṇaḥ svapriyaṃ prajagāda tam | śṛṇu śaṃbho kathayāmi mokṣasādhanamuttamam ||64|| ye vai mokṣe sthitāḥ santo māyābhāvavivarjitāḥ | teṣāṃ samāgamāt prasevanānmokṣo’bhilabhyate ||65|| yo’haṃ mokṣe nivasāmi nivasāmi sadātmasu | taṃ māmupāsya satataṃ mokṣaṃ vindati mānavaḥ ||66|| mayā kālaḥ karma dharmo jñānaṃ me śaktayastvimāḥ | matvaivaṃ śaktimantaṃ māṃ yastvāśrayati mucyate ||67|| dehena karmaṇā vācā manasā svīyavastubhiḥ | sarvātmanārpito yaḥ syānmayi drāk sa pramucyate ||68|| māṃ paśyenmāṃ rasayecca māṃ sadā saṃprakīrtayet | māṃ jighrenmāṃ spṛśenyāṃ saṃśṛṇuyāccintayecca mām ||69|| māṃ gṛhṇīyāt praseveta saṃvāhayecca māṃ sadā | māmabhigacched rahasi cānandayecca māṃ hṛdi ||2.299.70|| sthāpayenmāṃ pramanvīta nirṇayenmāṃ hṛdantare | ahamayecca māṃ nityaṃ madyoge sarvadā vaset ||71 || māṃ dhyāyenmāṃ snehapūrṇaḥ samāśliṣyenmilecca mām | māmekīkṛtya cādadyād bhogyajātaṃ mayi kṣipet ||72|| māṃ pratyakṣaṃ nijīkṛtya ceṣṭāṃ kuryānmadarthikām | śivarājaivamāsādya madyogaṃ mokṣamāvrajet ||73|| ramaṇaṃ bhramaṇaṃ viharaṇaṃ ca nartanaṃ raṇam | jāgaraṇaṃ svapanaṃ ca pravartanaṃ nivartanam ||74|| ācaraṇaṃ vicaraṇaṃ sadācaraṇamīraṇam | sarvaṃ kuryānmadarthaṃ vai dhruvamokṣamavāpnuyāt ||75|| ityuktaḥ śivarājo’yaṃ rādhike śītajā tathā | jayaścandro dhenupālo’śokā ca harau sthirāḥ ||76|| sthiradhyānā abhavam̐śca sthirasevāparāyaṇāḥ | divyabhāvaṃ samāpannāḥ sarvasvārpaṇasevinaḥ ||77|| uttarāyaṇage sūrye samutsukāśca te tataḥ | svaputrīṃ prasamāśliṣya lakṣmīṃ mokṣābhikāṃkṣiṇaḥ ||78|| aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva snātvā kṛtvārhaṇaṃ hareḥ | dhenupālo’pi ca sutātrayamābhāṣya vai tadā ||79|| vṛttī sarvāḥ parāhṛtya dhyānamagnāstadābhavan | jñānadaḥ śrīkṛṣṇadevaḥ sarvasvāmī hṛdisthitaḥ ||2.299.80|| tathā pratyakṣavartī tān jñātvā nirvāṇamānasān | svāsaktān prati tūrṇaṃ sa divyavimānamāsthitaḥ ||8 1 || nijadivyasvarūpeṇa muktiṃ dātuṃ samāyayau | lakṣmīpatiharistebhyastaireva varṣmabhistadā ||82|| ārohayāmāsa divye vimāne paśyatāṃ satām | tadā dundubhayo nedurdevānāṃ sarvatodiśi ||83|| sadāśivaḥ paraṃ mokṣaṃ yāti nityakilāsakam | devādyairvardhitāḥ sarve yayuḥ kailāsamuttamam ||84|| pārṣadāśca yayurnityaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ kṛṣṇikā tathā | lakṣmīstathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāryaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||85||| sarvaṃ kartuṃ samartho tau tenaiva varṣmaṇā hi tān | rādhe mokṣaṃ nītavantau mahāścaryamidaṃ hyabhūt| ||86 || taduttaravidhiṃ tatra sveśena saha putrikā | cakre laukikadānāni śrāddhotsavādikāni ca ||87|| atha śrībālakṛṣṇo’pi dhenūnāmuttarāyaṇe | prapūjanaṃ vyadhāttatra puṇyakāryapravṛttaye ||88|| dhenubhyaḥ pradadau tvārdraghāsān sasyāni vai tadā | gūḍaṃ ca dhānyakhādyāni dāpayāmāsa sarvataḥ ||89|| dhenavaśca tadā sarvalokebhyo divyavigrahāḥ | bhaumasthāścāyayustūrṇaṃ tadā prasādalālasāḥ || 2.299.90|| bhuktvā natvā hariṃ prāpya pūjāṃ svasvāśramān yayuḥ | atha dvijebhyo bhagavān dadau dānāni bhūriśaḥ ||9 1 || sadbhyo dadāvambarāṇi bhojanānyuttamāni ca | dīnānāthebhyaśca dadau bhikṣukebhyo’pi sarvathā ||92|| miṣṭānnāmbararūpyādi svarṇaṃ pātrāṇi vai tadā | evaṃ kṛtvā dānavidhiṃ saptadhānyānvitāṃ navām ||93|| taralāṃ randhitāṃ cāpi ghṛtānvitāṃ saparpaṭām | sudadhnā cāranālena samaṃ saṃbubhuje hariḥ ||94|| bhojayāmāsa sarvāśca kāntāḥ kṛśarasaṃjñitām | kvathikāsahitāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ svādavatīṃ sugandhinīm ||95|| ityevaṃ rādhike kaṣṇakāntāryo hi mahotsavam | uttarāyanayogasya cakre gopālakṛṣṇajaḥ || 96 || ṣoḍaśe vatsare tvevaṃ brahmapriyāsamanvitaḥ | bubhuje bahubhogām̐śca sarvakalyāṇakārakaḥ || 97|| rādhike taṃ smaret kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ narāyaṇīḥ | līlāḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣotthāḥ muktidāḥ śāntidā hareḥ || 98 || sarvamokṣaphalaṃ tvāsāṃ śravaṇe jāyate’kṣayam | brahmapūjāphalaṃ tvāsāṃ śravaṇe jāyate’kṣayam || 99 || puruṣottamayogo’yaṃ sarvayogottamottamaḥ | sarvāvatārayogo’yaṃ sarvajñānottamottamaḥ || 2.299.100 || sarvalakṣmīpradaścāyaṃ sarvamuktipradastathā | sarvasaubhāgyadaścāyaṃ tvevaṃ śrutvā ramāpitā || 101 || śāśvataṃ cāpi mokṣaṃ svaṃ samīpsat tamamokṣayat | yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ so’sya kriyāṃ śrībhagavām̐stathā || 102 || sambandhinastataścakrurharisaṃlagnamānasāḥ | rādhike śrīhareryogaḥ sarvamuktipradastvayam || 103 || sarvasaubhāgyadaścāpi tretāsantānanāmakaḥ | sarvavratānāṃ yajñānāṃ dānānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām || 1 04|| sarveṣāṃ tapasāṃ dīkṣāyogānāṃ tyāgadharmaṇām | sanyāsadharmaṇāṃ cāpi bhaktīnāṃ ca phalapradaḥ || 105 || sarvāśramāṇāṃ dharmāṇāṃ śravaṇātphalado mataḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā vai hṛdayaṃ hyayam || 106 || prāṇānāṃ jīvana cāyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakaḥ | sarvapratiṣṭhāphaladaḥ sarvatīrthaphalapradaḥ || 1 07|| sarvasevāphaladaśca sarvavidyāphalapradaḥ | satīdharmaphaladaśca pātivratyaphalapradaḥ || 108 || sarvabhogapradaḥ sarvasmṛddhidaḥ śravaṇād dhruvam | divyatāpādakaḥ sarvavāsanākṣayakārakaḥ || 10 9|| sarveṣāṃ cātra pāpānāṃ prajvālakaḥ supuṇyadaḥ | niṣkāmakarma caitadvai yadasya śravaṇaṃ sadā || 2.299.110 || pūjanaṃ cāsya vai tadvad dānaṃ cāsya mahatphalam | rakṣaṇaṃ gṛhamadhye’sya kālamāyādināśanam || 111 || asya khaṇḍasya bhāvena śravaṇācchrīhariḥ svayam | lakṣmyādibrahmaśaktyāḍhyo dadyāt divyaṃ svadarśanam || 112 || asya kathā kāraṇīyā puraścaraṇamityapi | agatīnāṃ bhavenmokṣo bhūtādīnāṃ pramokṣaṇam || 113 || duḥkhadāridryanāśaśca lakṣmīkulakuṭumbakam | yatrāyaṃ vartate tatra sarvadā vāsamāpnuyāt || 1 14|| vaṃśavṛddhirbhavet putradhanadārapatiśriyaḥ | bhavanti yatra khaṇḍo’yaṃ pūjyate paṭhyate’pi ca || 1 15|| rādhike’sya kathā yatra tatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca muktamaṇḍalamityapi || 1 16|| ahaṃ kṛṣṇastathā nārāyaṇaḥ sarvasvamaṇḍalaḥ | vasāvastāṃ kathāṃ śrotuṃ sarvadeveśvarānvitau || 1 17|| vācakasya prapūjā ca kāraṇīyā vidhānataḥ | naranārīvibhūṣāścāmbarāṇi dhanamityapi || 1 18|| gṛhakṣetragrāmavāṭīgajāśvahīrakādikam | yathāśakti pradātavyaṃ vācakāya śravārthibhiḥ || 1 19|| mokṣadāya hi sarvasvaṃ dātavyaṃ paramārthine | udyāpanaṃ kāraṇīyaṃ mahotsavaḥ śubhastathā || 2.299.120 || sakṛcchravaṇe māyā vai naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | kalpalatā kalpavṛkṣaḥ kalpadhenustvayaṃ mataḥ || 121 || kalpamaṇiḥ kalpapātraṃ tretākhaṇḍo hi rādhike | śrīkṛṣṇo’haṃ vadāmyatra tretāsantānasevanāt || 1 22|| nāryai rādhāpadaṃ dāsye viṣṇupadaṃ narāya vai | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya paramātmane || 123 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne cireṇa lomaśāśramasthitānāṃ kāntānāṃ pitrādibhiḥ saha svadeśagamanaṃ, maṇḍapādiparihāraḥ, lakṣmyādikāśikāṃganākṛtasevāprakāraḥ, ṣoḍaśajanmotsave ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ sarvajanānāmāgamanam, mahotsavaḥ, śiveśvarādīnāṃ mokṣopadeśānmokṣaḥ, ṣoḍaśe vatsare uttarāyaṇadānādi, saṃhitāyāstretāsantānasya māhātmyamiticetinirūpaṇanāmā navanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 299 ||
<2.300> śrīrādhikovāca kṛṣṇakānta kathāḥ sarvāḥ saṃkṣepāt kathayāsya me | tretākhaṇḍasya vai śāntiḥ śravaṇe me’tijāyate || 1 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvācarādhike bhagavān śrīmallakṣmīnārāyaṇo’bhavat | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo lakṣmyā yuto yadā || 2 || tamenaṃ paramātmānaṃ hṛdayekṣaṇavarjitāḥ | na jānanti yathārthaṃ vai parabrahma sanātanam || 3 || so’yaṃ samāgataḥ pṛthvyāṃ kṛpayoddhārahetave| bhaktānāṃ mānasapūrttyai narāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā || 4 || dhanyāstāstanavaścātra yābhiḥ prāpto hariḥ svayam | dhanyāni tānīndriyāṇi hareryogaṃ gatāni vai || 5 || dhanyāstāḥ ṛddhyaścāpi dhanyā deśāśca te tathā | dhanyāḥ kuṭumbinaścāpi puruṣottamayoginaḥ || 6 || yatra vai paṭhyate lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya saṃhitā | dhanyo deśaḥ sa evāpi yatrāste puruṣottamaḥ || 7 || lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ khaṇḍe dvitīyake | tretāsantānake nāmnā proktamādyaṃ sumaṃgalam || 8 || sārvabhaumaṃ ca māhātmyaṃ parabrahmaṇa īritam | tato hiraṇyamayāṇḍasya kośakūrcasamudbhavau || 9 || hiraṇyakūrcahiraṇyāṇḍābhidhāvasurāvubhau | yuyudhāte saha saṃkarṣaṇena gadayā tataḥ || 2.300.1 0|| merorbhāgā vyavacchinnā ye ye te tvabhavan grahāḥ | sarvadhāmyarthitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prakaṭībhūya dhāmataḥ || 11 || sevāṃ gṛhṇāti ca pṛthvyāṃ kambharāśrīgṛhe’pi ca | prādurbhāvajayantyāṃ cotsave dānastavādayaḥ || 1 2|| devadevījananānivṛkṣavallyādiṣu kṣitau | daśame divase daityaiḥ prabhorapakṛtiḥ kṛtā || 13 || ṣaṣṭhīsūtakaśeṣādyairbālakṛṣṇāvanaṃ kṛtam | sūtakasya samutpattiḥ sūtātmavaradānakam || 14|| nāmakāryotsave sāṇāsuro vyāghrāsuro hatau | ekādaśe’hani preṃkhāroho’nantasvarūpakaiḥ || 15|| talājārākṣasīnāryā moho harau subhaktatā | lājā sa maṃgalakāryakarī jātā kṛpāvaśā || 16 || dugdhapānadine naikarūpairdhenupayo’śanam | gorūparākṣasīnāṃ saprāṇastanyasya pānakam || 17|| harerbhūmyupaveśākhyasaṃskāre siṃhikādarī | anyāścāpi bālakṛṣṇaṃ siṣevire hariṃ prabhum || 18|| karṇavedhe’sya saṃskāre sūcyādyā devatā api | sevāṃ kṛtvābhajan kṛṣṇaṃ patiṃ bahusvarūpiṇam || 19 || annaprāśanasaṃskāre dadāvannāni bhūriśaḥ | oṣadhayo bhojayitvā kāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prapedire ||2.300.20 || vṛttijñānāya vai dvātriṃśadvastūni sahaiva saḥ | tāvaddhastaiḥ prajagrāha divyatāsya prakīrtitā ||2 1 || tato daityastriyo yuddhaṃ vidhavāḥ kartumāyayuḥ | rākṣasīnāṃ kanyakānāṃ tumulaṃ yuddhamābhavat ||22| kanyakānāṃ vijaye rākṣasīnāṃ śaraṇāgatiḥ | divyatā kanyakākārātmatā śrīhariṇā kṛtā || 23 || tābhyaḥ śrīlomaśaḥ prāha sevāmokṣavṛṣām̐stataḥ | āśramīyāḥ sarvakanyāḥ vrataṃ varṣāsu cakrire ||24|| śatrūñjayādrisaṃvāsāḥ kaṃkatālā hatā mṛdhe | kaṃkatālyaśca rākṣasyo yuddhe divyā haripriyāḥ ||25| abhavam̐śca nyuṣurlomaśāśrame cātmavedikāḥ | pitṛkanyā hareḥ pūjāṃ cakrire pretamokṣaṇam ||26 || rāśibhiḥ kṛtapūjā ca kṛṣṇaprāsādavarṇanam | mahāmaṇḍapaśobhā ca hareḥ śṛṃgāravarṇanam ||27|| prahlādasya mṛdhaṃ nārāyaṇena bhaktito jayaḥ | dānavānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ ca kanyānāṃ varaṇaṃ hareḥ ||28|| śrīhareścaulasaṃskāre romṇāṃ nārāyaṇātmatā | jīvānāṃ romarūpāṇi tvaghānīti prakīrtitam ||29|| sālamālāsuranāśastatstrīṇāṃ harisaṃgrahaḥ | yajñasūtrotsave daityā sālamālādijātayaḥ ||2.300.3 0 || vināśitāstathā mokṣadharmā lomaśavarṇitāḥ | sukeśinaḥ samākhyānam aśūnyaśayanavratam ||3 1 || devasvāpā bhinnabhinnatithiṣvapi ca pūjanam | pātāleśasya vai kāraṇḍavasya nāśanaṃ tataḥ ||32|| kanyakā rakṣitā lomaśālaye svastikasya vai | āraktadeśīyabhūpaśāvadīnasutārthakam ||33 || pūjanaṃ śāvadīnāyai devyai bālabalikṛtam | devyā rājādisaṃhāraḥ kṛto’tha badarīvanam ||34|| kuru kṣetraṃ hareḥ kuṃkumavāpī prati cāgamaḥ | bālārpaṇaṃ tatpitṛbhyo mātṝṇāṃ mokṣa īritaḥ ||35|| purādharme śvetaketormaryādā sampradarśitā | saudāsapatnyāṃ vāsiṣṭho’śmako jātastathā vṛṣaḥ ||36|| utathyabhāryābhogaṃ vai cakre bṛhaspatirbalāt | dīrghatamā baleḥ patnyāṃ putrānajanayad bahūn || 37|| sarve bālagrahāḥ proktā ye ye yā yāḥ svabhāvataḥ | atha vyāghrāsurāṇāṃ vai vināśo hariṇā kṛtaḥ || 38|| pañcamābdotsave gāndharvāṇāṃ pragāyanāni ca | siṃhavyāghrādicarmabhyaḥ siṃhāḥ sajīvanīkṛtāḥ ||39|| haro naṭanaṭīyukto nāṭyāni vidadhe tataḥ | prasannahariṇā tatra kṣetre saṃvāsitāḥ sadā ||2.300.40|| śrīhareḥ sarvavidyāptirvarāṭakatapohatiḥ | varāṭakānīkanāśo daṇḍādi ceritaṃ tathā ||41|| dikpharamlecchasaṃhāro hariṇā kṛta īritaḥ | śaṃkare vastrarahite ṛṣyāśramagate dvijāḥ ||42|| tāḍayāmāsurīśaṃ te satīśāpāddhi rākṣasāḥ | teṣāṃ vināśitaṃ rākṣasatvaṃ śrīhariṇā tataḥ ||43|| ṣaṣṭhavarṣārambhamahe kṛṣṇādyaiḥ pūjanaṃ kṛtam | devāyanadvijasya tatpatnyāḥ śvapacatā hatā ||44|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāyāṃ camatkṛtiḥ | stutistīrthaṃ corjavrataṛṣikṛtamudīritam ||45|| kanthādharasya caritaṃ camatkāro’timṛtyutā | hṛḍḍakāyanikāsvāmitvaṃ nāstikyaṃ kuruṃgataḥ ||46|| mṛtasya vipraputrasya vṛṣaparvetijīvanam | nāstikyena maraṇe’sya mlecchajanma, sutena tu ||47|| kṛtoddhāro dvayorbhūtvā vaiṣṇavo lomaśānmuneḥ | raṇaṃgamakṛte yajñe yakṣakanyādivāhanam ||48|| śrīhareśca kṛtaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ saptamo jananotsavaḥ | raṇaṃgame gate dakṣiṇadhruvekṣaṇavāñcchayā ||49||
