antārkideśabhūpena lakṣmaṇāryeṇa satkṛtiḥ | patnīmātṛdrohakartṛmātrāgaskararākṣasāt ||2.300.50 || patnīmātṛrakṣaṇaṃ ca śrīharikṛtamīritam | yuddhe raṇaṃgamasyaiva jayo’tha lakṣmaṇārpitāḥ ||51|| sahasradvayakanyā vai lomaśasyopadeśanam | putraputrīpatipatnīśiṣyaśiṣyādivarṇanam ||52|| vedhaḥputryaḥ suṣumṇeḍāpiṃgalāḥ svāmibhāvataḥ | hariṃ vīkṣya yayurdeśān lokayituṃ vimānagāḥ ||53 || satyalokaṃ yayustābhyaḥ śrutvā hariṃ suvīkṣitum | prasthitā dvāsaptatikanyakā yānena vedhasaḥ ||54|| abrikteśena svasainyaiḥ ruddhaṃ vimānamambare | dūtādyuktistatra śukrārajādaṇḍādivarṇanā ||55|| viśvakarmacitrāṃgadāsurathānāṃ ca varṇanā | tato yuddhe mlecchakoṭyo vinaṣṭā lakṣaśo’pi ca ||56|| sadvivekāvivekau varṇitau ca śaraṇāgamaḥ | punaḥ kāpaṭyayuddhe ca mṛtā mlecchāḥ sahasraśaḥ ||57|| mlecchastriyo lakṣaśo’pi yuyudhurmumuhurharau | kṛtyābhirnāśitāścātha rājñaḥ śrīharidarśanam ||58|| tasya prāgjanmapuṇyādi coktaṃ prasaṃgataḥ khalu | abriktadeśasāmrājyaṃ bhaktābhyāṃ pradadau hariḥ ||59|| ārabījapradeśānāṃ rājyaṃ yuddhe vijitya ca | dharmarāṭa pradadau devamarudbhyo daityayoniṣu ||2.300.60|| janmāntarakathā devamarutāṃ tatra kīrtitā | raktabījārabījādidhundhudaityakathoditā ||6 1 || nadīpūroḍhanaukāyā udayākhyanṛpasya ca | rakṣā kṛtā tu hariṇā prajānāṃ ceti varṇitam ||6 2|| krūrasiṃhasya vai rākṣasatvaṃ haripramocitam | aṣṭamābde rugṇavyaṃgyādīnāṃ nairogyamāhitam ||63|| jalamagnavasumedhaśreṣṭhirakṣoditā tataḥ | gopanāthamahātīrthaṃ saurāṣṭre varṇitaṃ tataḥ ||64|| bālakṛṣṇasyopavītamahotsavastu varṇitaḥ | nāradoktaparāvidyopadeśastatra varṇitaḥ ||65|| pāritoṣikadānāni tathopadārpaṇānyapi | prabhoḥ sevārcanapūjādiphalaṃ parivarṇitam ||66|| ṣaḍbhirjanmabhirvai jāḍyamaghadṛṣṭāntadānataḥ | pūrvasvabhāvavaicitryaṃ vistarāt sunirūpitam ||67|| naiṣkarmyayogaḥ samprokto jñānamādhyātmikaṃ tathā | ātmaniveditabhaktyā rājarājñyoḥ pramokṣaṇam ||68|| āmodanagarāvāsasudhanākhyasya rakṣaṇam | caurebhyo vai kṛtaṃ divyarūpeṇa hariṇeritam ||69|| tryaṣṭakārorantyajasya sastrīkasyāpi mokṣaṇam | kauśikāmbarṣiyogena kuṣṭhajalodarakṣayaḥ ||2.300.70|| viprabālaṣaṭśatānāṃ nāśakān rākṣasān hariḥ | nāśayāmāsa yuddhe jīvayāmāsārbhakān punaḥ ||71 || tithīkaraṇa saritāṃ, ghorapratigrahaiḥ phalam | viprāṇāṃ nāśitaṃ proktaṃ hariṇā kṛpayeritam ||72|| bāleśvaranṛpasyāpi parīkṣā putrarandhanāt | kanyāpatnīgrahaṇācca kṛtā śrīhariṇeritam ||73 || jayadhvajasya yajñe śrīharerdarśanamīritam | droṇādiparvatānāṃ cāvabhṛthe pāpanāśanam ||74|| kolāracilaśaṃbhalanārāyaṇasarāsyapi | divyatāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ prāpuḥ kathā ceyaṃ suvarṇitā ||75|| dharmāścaturyugāṇāṃ vai pulastyoktāḥ pradarśitāḥ | akṣarakṣetramāhātmyaṃ proktaṃ kauṃkumavāpikam ||76|| harivaṃśīyaprajānāṃ sahyādrau vāsa īritaḥ | kharaputrādharmajīvāsuranāstikatā harau ||77|| darśitāsadgatiḥ paścād gatyarthaṃ varadānakam | atha kuṃbhe prayāge cāgatatīrthādikoṭayaḥ ||78|| sanatkumāravacanāt kuṃkumavāpikāṃ yayuḥ | atha siṃhalavāsānāṃ rākṣasīnāmupadravaḥ ||79|| mahāmāryādibhirvināśitau badrīṃ gate harau | āgatya hariṇā prajīvitā mṛtāstu ye purā ||2.300.80 || atha jñānaṃ viśeṣādvaitādvaitaṃ mokṣadaṃ matam | harervibhūtayo mokṣapradāstato’bhivarṇitāḥ ||81 || vyūhacatuṣṭayasyāpi svataḥprakāśarūpatā | varṇitā kuṃkumavāpyāṃ tīrtharūpeṇa vāsitā ||82 || uṣṭrālaye mahākhaṇḍe jhaṃjhāvāte mahatyatha | kṛtā śrīhariṇā rakṣā jīvitā ye mṛtāstadā ||83|| urvaśyāścakravākītvaṃ mārjārītvaṃ tathā ṛṣeḥ | sanatsujātasaṃjñasya mithaḥ śāpānnivāritam ||84|| cakravākyai pāyitaṃ vai vāri śṛṃge girestathā | mārjārikābālakānāṃ bhrāṣṭre rakṣāgnitaḥ kṛtā ||85|| kṛtaṃ ca mokṣaṇaṃ śāpāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai | māturmāhātmyamapyuktaṃ tato vaikuṇṭhadhāmani ||86|| nārāyaṇasya vai lakṣmīśayane saṃratasya tu | darśanārthaṃ cāgateṣu dhenupālādikeṣu ca ||87|| nṛtyādāvadhike kāle yāte lakṣmīḥ ruṣāśapat | tataḥ śivādayaḥ pṛthvyāmavāpurmānavīṃ janum ||88|| lakṣmīṃ vihāya bhagavān yayau yatra śivādayaḥ | lakṣmīḥ sakhyaśca śokaṃ vai kṛtvā janmāni cādaduḥ ||89|| lakṣmyurvaśyau tapo’rthaṃ jagmatuḥ śrīhanumadvane | nārāyaṇaḥ prasannastatphalaṃ dātuṃ samāyayau ||2.300.90 || cakravākyai jalapānaṃ śikhare hariṇārpitam | śivavarmakuṭumbādeḥ kāśyāmāgamanaṃ tathā ||9 1|| rājamānaṃ nivāsādi labdhvā harirnijālayam | āyayau kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ ceti samīritam ||92|| uṣṭrālaye mahādeśe hemaśālāyanagṛhe | viṣṇuyajñaḥ kṛto rājñā dakṣajavaṃgareṇa vai ||93|| rājakanyāśataṃ prajākanyakānāṃ sahasrakam | prārpya kṛṣṇāya rājādyāḥ kuṃkumavāpikāṃ yayuḥ || 94|| tīrthaṃ kṛtvā punaruṣṭrālayaṃ yayurvimānakaiḥ | athāyayurdarśanārthaṃ pitṛkanyāśca tāstadā ||95|| tāsāṃ vimāne rurudhuḥ, rākṣasāḥ hariṇā hatāḥ | prāgjyotiṣapradeśeṣu vimānenāgamo hareḥ ||96|| yajñasyānte mahāyuddhaṃ tatrāsurāstu koṭiśaḥ | vināśitāstato rājye sthāpitā vaiṣṇavā nṛpāḥ ||97|| yajñaṃ kṛtvā hariḥ svīyaṃ nagaraṃ svatanau tadā | darśayitvā kanyakābhyaḥ svākṛṣṭāstāścakāra ha ||98| lāśahāsaritāṃ mūrtipratiṣṭhāmahimoditaḥ | navadhā bhaktirūpāṇi vighnanāśāḥ phalāni ca ||99|| sādhūnāṃ svātmarūpatvaṃ śraiṣṭhyaṃ sarvata īritam | bhūtālayāsāmakāmarūpaśyāmādirājyakam || 2.300.10 0|| nirṇītaṃ brahmarājyaṃ cākṣarakṣetrāgamastataḥ | puṣpadolotsavaṃ cakre, janmotsavaṃ cakāra ca || 101 || samīraṇanṛpasyāpi mṛgayārthaṃ gatasya vai | vane pārṣṇigṛharṣestu śāpena śarabhatvakam || 1 02|| raivatādrau haridattātreyadarśanato gatam | aśvapaṭṭasarasyetad dattātreyasutīrthakam || 103 || vārāhatīrthakaṃ cāpi sopākhyānaṃ samīritam | pavamānākhyatīrthaṃ ca jātamaśvasarovare || 1 04|| kacchaparūpiṇā santāraṇādyā brāhmaṇā jale | magnā uddhāritāḥ kacchapākhyatīrthaṃ tato’bhavat| || 1 05|| devāyatanabhaktena dikpālānāṃ prajāḥ kṛtāḥ | muktāḥ śrīharināmnāṃ vai śrāvaṇeneti ceritam || 106 || rāśiyānādideśeṣu rāśidvādaśakasya vai | katheritā, ca muktiśca, bālakṛṣṇasarovare || 1 07|| mahāyajñaśca kathito devāyanāṭanaṃ tathā | yajñānte śibinā kanyāśatadānaṃ hi śārṅgiṇe || 1 08|| kṛtaṃ cātha guṇārthāḥ samvarṇitāḥ sādhuyoginām | tīrthānyuktani sarasi pitruddhārastathā kṛtaḥ || 1 09|| dvikalākhyasarobhūmau yajñārthaṃ śrīhariryayau | tatra dharmopadeśaśca pretānāmuddhṛtistathā || 2.300.11 0|| rājñe nītyupadeśaśca tṛtīyādhvaramāgatiḥ | yajñe’rkalokavāsānāṃ vīrajārādidyusadām || 111 || muktiḥ proktā tathā dānaṃ kanyānāṃ copadeśanam | avabhṛthasya tattvārthaḥ kathitastatphalādikam || 11 2|| caturthe tu kratau paścāt svasya mūrtyādi deśitam | pañcame tu kratau sarvāḥ piśācinyo hi tāritāḥ || 113 || piśācitve kāraṇāni proktāni mantradīkṣaṇam | pūjāśca divyasadrūpaṃ svasya tatra pradarśitam || 1 14|| lālāsanākhyasādhurvai yajñānte samupāyayau | vaiṣṇavīṃ sādhavīṃ dīkṣāṃ sa jagrāha harestadā || 1 15|| anye pañcasahasrāṇi dīkṣāmāpuśca sādhavīm | lālāyano yayāvuttarān kurūn kṛṣṇavāñcchayā || 1 16|| śrīhariḥ svakuṭumbena vimānenākṣarasthalīm | āyayau tatra vai devāyanasya mandirātmatā || 1 17|| darśitā hariṇā sāṃgadevālayasvarūpitā | devālayasya khātādyārabhya dhvajāntamīritam || 1 18|| svarūpaṃ cāntarīyakā vibhāgāśca sphuṭīkṛtāḥ | siṃhāsanāni devādyāḥ prāsādābhinnanāminaḥ || 1 19|| merujātīyaprāsādāḥ kārtsnyenāpi pravarṇitāḥ | vedānāṃ devatānāṃ ca mūrtimānāni vai tathā || 2.300.120|| āyudhādīni vai cāpi varṇitāni tataḥ param | dhvajādayaśca kathitāḥ kuṇḍāśca homasaṃkhyayā || 121 || vāstupuruṣasaṃsthānaṃ devakarmāḍhyamīritam | ācāryavaraṇaṃ śrīmadgaṇeśādiprapūjanam || 122|| devānāṃ sthāpanaṃ nāndīśrāddhādyaṃ ca prapūjanam | vāstupīṭhasthadevānāṃ sthāpanaṃ svastivācanam || 1 23|| pūjanaṃ yoginīnāṃ ca kṣetrapālādipūjanam | staṃbhadevārcanaṃ śākhātattaddevādipūjanam || 124|| agnisthāpanakuṇḍāṅgayonigrahādipūjanam | ṣaṭpañcāśaddevapūjā pratyadhidevatārcanam || 1 25|| lokapālagrahāvāhanādipūjanamīritam | yoginīkṣetrapālādinaikadevāhutistathā || 1 26|| rādhādiṣaṭkaṃ parāvidyādicatvāriṃśadayukśatam | parameśāvatārādi balidānena cārcitam || 127|| netrāṃjanābharaṇādinaikanyāsādi varṇitam | pūrṇāhutiḥ śṛṃgasnānaṃ caruśrapaṇaprabhati || 1 28|| rathopaveśanaṃ grāme bhrāmaṇaṃ prāṇayojanam | ārārtrikaṃ pūrṇahomaścāśīrvādā avabhṛtham || 1 29|| kalaśārohaṇaṃ mānastaṃbhadhvajādhirohaṇam | calamūrtipratiṣṭhādi jorṇoddhāraśca kīrtitāḥ || 2.300.13 0|| dhanamedhadhīvarasya turīlakṣmīprasādataḥ | kuṃkumavāpikātīrthānmokṣaḥ śrīhariṇā kṛtaḥ || 131 || śibikāvāhavoḍhośca jñānāptistapasoditā | dyuviśrāmakṛṣikāragodhanaṃ siṃhato’vitam || 1 32|| hariṇā ceti kathitaṃ cātha vṛkāyanādayaḥ | ketumāle gatāstatra ṣaṣṭigāṃgeyamelanam || 13 3|| ketumāle mahāyajñaḥ kathito hariṇā kṛtaḥ | sarvabhūbhṛdupaprāptistaddeśeṣu harergatiḥ || 1 34|| sarvasṛṣṭijanāyaśca manorañjanakānyapi | rātrau, prātarbhoṃjanāni mantradānāni kārtsnyataḥ || 1 35|| vidhivat sarvadevādipūjanaṃ havanaṃ makhe | dhṛtāni hariṇā koṭyabjādirūpāṇi tatra ca || 1 36|| avabhṛthakumārotpattiśca tṛptikumārikā | utpannāsyai kumārasya dānaṃ vivāhataḥ kṛtam || 1 37|| athoralaketurājadhānyāṃ susvāgataṃ hareḥ | mokṣaṇaṃ bhūbhṛtpūrvajānāṃ śrīhariṇā kṛtam || 138|| nijasvarūpavijñānaṃ sampradāyasya saṃsthitiḥ | kathitātha krathakasya rājadhānyāṃ harergatiḥ || 139|| mandirādikakāryeṣu kālādyāḥ kīrtitāḥ śubhāḥ | nakṣatrayogakaraṇacakracandrabhatārakāḥ || 2.300.140|| śubhāśubhāḥ sukathitā muhūrtānīritāni ca | jarasthālyāṃ rājadhānyāṃ svāgataṃ pūjanaṃ hareḥ || 141 || ṣaḍviṃśatinṛpāṇāṃ prāgjanmavṛttānta īritaḥ | atha prabhuryayāvuṣṭrālarāṣṭraṃ sakuṭumbakaḥ || 142|| satkāraṃ prāpya tīrāṇārājadhānīṃ yayau tataḥ | yogibhyo gṛhadharmādyā indreṇoktāḥ pramokṣadāḥ || 143 || pūjāṃ prāpyāyayāvalvīnararājyaṃ haristataḥ | arthaśrīnagarīṃ gatvā muktiṃ tuṣitarākṣase || 144|| datvātha jinavarddhibhūbhṛdrājadhānikāṃ yayau | rāmapuryāṃ paribhramya janahāryākhyarakṣasaḥ || 145|| vināśārthaṃ yayau cāpināyādriṃ parameśvaraḥ | rākṣasān hatavān rudradvārādreścakravahninā || 146|| ārasamayitā, kanyādānagraho’tha rakṣaṇam | prajānāṃ nigaḍasthānāṃ tato’vanamudīritam || 147|| mṛtāsthibhyo jīvadānaṃ, jīvanīnagarīṃ gatiḥ | likhitasya śaṃkhavāṭyāṃ cauryaṃ hastasuchedanam || 148|| bāhudāyāṃ snānatastu hastayo rohaṇaṃ punaḥ | jayakṛṣṇavabhūpasya varaṇānagarīkṣaṇam || 149|| kṛtvā hariryayau parīśānarājyaṃ tato’bhramat | pāvayitvā yayau parījarāṣṭraṃ cāpapūjanam || 2.300.150|| vāyūnānagarīyānam indirāvāriṇā hareḥ | snānaṃ tatra ca vetālānāṃ tu pramokṣaṇaṃ kṛtam || 151 || rājñe caturbhujaṃ dattaṃ darśanaṃ ca tataḥ param | mudrāṇḍarāṣṭrāgamanaṃ madrirāpurikekṣaṇam || 152|| pūjāṃ prāpyopadiśyātha śaivālanagarīkṣaṇam | kṛtvā līśavanaṃ prāpa pattanaṃ gaṇḍakeśituḥ || 153 || pūjāṃ prāpyopadiśyātha yayau līnorṇarāṣṭrakam | bhramitvā vāruṇīpuryāṃ dhīvarāpurikāṃ yayau || 154|| milīndānagarīṃ cāpi bhramitvā vālinīpurīm | balalīnanṛparāṣṭre bahumānamavāpa ha || 155|| vratopadeśanaṃ vāśīlāpurīṃ gamanaṃ tataḥ | pūjopadeśo bhramaṇaṃ rāyagāmalarāṣṭrake || 1 56|| gamanaṃ tatra ca rimānagaryāṃ svāgataṃ mahat | phenatantunṛparāṣṭrāgamanaṃ pūjanādikam || 157|| bhrāmaṇaṃ trinayāpuryāṃ copadeśaḥ prapūjanam | dhvāṃkṣadṛṣṭāntamatroktaṃ stokahomabhuvaṃ gatiḥ || 158|| umāpuryāṃ vicaraṇaṃ kāṣṭhayānasya rāṣṭrakam | bhramitvā ca tunnavāyāṃ nagaryāṃ copadeśanam || 159|| tataḥ kolakabhūpasya rāṣṭrābhigamanaṃ hareḥ | muramāṣānagaryāṃ susvāgataṃ pūjanādikam || 2.300.160|| hareḥ snānaṃ bahurūpairgāṃgeyakanyakādiṣu | tato hāritadeśeṣu tvaparānāvikāpure || 161 || dinamānārkarājarṣergarimāpṛthivītale | vimānena yayau svāmī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 162|| aparānāvikāpuryāṃ svāgataṃ deśalokanam | kenāṭakapradeśeṣu vinipārasarogatiḥ || 163|| yajñārthapatrikāsampreṣaṇaṃ ca yajñapattane | yajñe kāryakarāḥ proktāḥ pratimāḥ kṛṣṇayoṣitām || 164|| sphūrtinārīnagaryāṃ tu rāyarokīśvarecchayā | bhrāmaṇaṃ cāpyadhvarasya sthalīṃ pratyāgamaḥ punaḥ || 165|| viprasvataḥprakāśasya sarvadraṣṭṛtvamadhvare | sākṣād devā vyarājanta devapūjāhavo’nale || 166|| pūrṇāhutistato rāyaraṇajidrāṣṭralokanam | viṃśatikanyakāpūjāpuṣpamālāgrahādikam || 167|| rāyavākakṣakabhūbhṛdrājye dvīpatraye gatiḥ | rāyamārīśabhūpabhvāṃ vyacarad dvīpaturyake || 168|| rāyabāleśvararāṣṭre vāyuphenākhyapattane | svāgataṃ ca tato yajñamahāpūrṇāhutiḥ kṛtā || 169|| āśīrvādā dakṣiṇādyā avabhṛthaṃ vidāyakam | rāyalambararājye’pi kimuvakrāpurīṃ gatiḥ || 2.300.170|| rāyanavārkanṛpateḥ svarlatikāpurīṃ gatiḥ | rāyahaṇḍeśvararāṣṭre makṣikānagarīṃ gatiḥ || 171 || rāyakūpeśvararāṣṭre havānāyāpurīṃ gatiḥ | kālīmaṇḍalīnarāṣṭre vigoṣṭhikāpurīṃ gatiḥ || 172|| vanajvālārāṣṭrake ca sānujyoṣṭrīpurīṃ gatiḥ | tato gatainasarāṣṭre kāyanīnagarīṃ gatiḥ || 173|| koṭīśvarakṣmeśarāṣṭre peyisthāyāṃ gatirhareḥ | pārūparāṣṭre sañjālānagaryāṃ svāgatādikam || 174|| bālāvittakarāṣṭre’gāt phānkalāśīpure hariḥ | āṇḍajarānṛparāṣṭre āntaḥprāgasthapattane || 175|| svāgataṃ ca tato bālyarajonṛpasya pattane | mantriṇāṃgānagaryākhye svāgatādi tataḥ punaḥ || 176|| rāyasomananṛpatervāyumānāpure’pi tat| | pātragonayarāṣṭrīyaprajābhya upadeśanam || 177|| rājārāyapatirājyam ārṣajatanurāṣṭrakam | urogamanarāṣṭraṃ ca yayau śrībhagavām̐stataḥ || 178|| rāyagrāmānagaryāṃ svāgataṃ cāśāsanāpure | parāṅvratanṛparājye svāgataṃ bhramaṇaṃ tathā || 179|| upadeśo’tha ca brāhmīlākhyarāṣṭre makhasthale | āgamanaṃ ca devānāṃ sthāpanaṃ pūjanādikam || 2.300.180|| āhutidānamaṃtrāthopadeśādi prakīrtitam | brahmacaryasya māhātmyaṃ tatra yajñe prakīrtitam || 181 || sarvātmakatvaṃ svasyāpi mahāpūrṇāhutistathā | parihāro’dhvarasyāpi saptasaritsu tīrthatā || 182|| lāpalātrīpurīyānaṃ sāmudradaityanāśanam | vidyunmaṇikaragrāho dvinediṣṭhapure gatiḥ || 183|| trāsamānadvīpe vṛndārukādvīpe ca siṃhale | pampāsarasi cāgatya kuṃkumavāpikāgamaḥ || 184|| śaratpūrṇārāsakhelaḥ svāṃganābhirharestataḥ | caturdaśajanmajayantyaṣṭamyāmutsavaḥ kṛtaḥ || 185|| divyasabhādbhutatāvarṇanaṃ mahaḥsamāpanam | tāmasākṣiśvapacasya sakuṭumbasya mokṣaṇam || 186|| aśvarūpadharasyāśvalāyanarṣeḥ praśāpataḥ | barburanṛpaterbarburadrutvānmokṣaṇaṃ kṛtam || 187|| kālīcaturdaśīrātrau śaṃkarādiprapūjanam | dīpāvalyāṃ śāradāyā utsavo hariṇā kṛtaḥ || 188|| samparkanṛparogasya nāśaḥ śrīhariṇā kṛtaḥ | dattātreyasvarūpeṇa tīrthaṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ śubham || 189|| annakūṭotsavaḥ proktastato haṃsasvarūpiṇā | puṇḍarīkanṛpamuktistato nṛharirūpiṇā || 2.300.190|| colarājño’pi muktiśceritā tīrthadvayaṃ tu tat| | vītihotrayoginā vai sahasrarūpadhāriṇā || 191|| sahasrarūpataścāpi ṛṣabhasyāpi rūpataḥ | darśanaṃ hariṇā dattaṃ stutiścāpi samīritā || 1 92|| sarastīre kṛte vaivasvatena śeṣamandire | śeṣasaṃkarṣaṇapatañjalyādisthāpanoditā || 1 93|| tattattīrthaṃ tathā proktaṃ vāmanāṃguṣṭhatīrthakam | paṃkilarṣiprasaṃgena jātaṃ samabhivyāhṛtam || 1 94|| haimakalginṛpāt proktaḥ parśurāmaparābhavaḥ | aśvapāratnanṛpakṛt somayāgo nirūpitaḥ || 1 95|| pravargyopasadau subrahmaṇyāhvānaṃ nirūpitam | savanāni mahāpūrṇāhutiścāvabhṛthādi ca || 1 96|| śraddhopaniṣadvijñānaṃ viśālikanidarśanam | lomaśarṣerāśvapāṭalayoḥ saṃvāda īritaḥ || 1 97|| seyaṃ lomaśagītoktā sarvamokṣanidarśinī | asyāmānartarājasya kuśalāyoginīstriyāḥ || 198|| saṃvādo’pi darśito’tha svataḥprakāśayoginaḥ | pūrvavṛttānta uditaścopadeśo gurorapi || 199|| bhāṇavīryabhaktakathā rāmādityanimittajā | ūrjavratasya kāyasthasya kuṣṭharoganāśanam ||2.300.20 0 || śūdrasya mūkaviprasya śārṅgadharākhyasaṃhitā | kṛtiruktākhyānayuktā tapasā bhāvitātmanaḥ ||20 1 || pārṣṇiradasya śūdrasya kṣayarogo nivāritaḥ | arkapurīśiturvipraśāpena sarpatā tataḥ || 202|| viprasya sarpadaṃśaśca mṛtiḥ kṛṣṇāttu jīvanam | rakṣāṃgārakanṛpateḥ rāṇikāyāḥ katheritā ||203|| amohākṣanṛpamokṣaḥ prabuddhaguruvākyataḥ | abhayākṣanṛpasyāpi tyāgidīkṣānirūpaṇam ||204|| sarovārimagnadevānīkarakṣoditā tataḥ | brahmastambākhyaviprasya puruṣottamadarśanam ||205|| amarīṃ kanyakāṃ tuṣṭo mahāviṣṇuḥ samudvahat| | gajato rakṣaṇaṃ kūpyavālakāṣṭhaharasya ca ||206|| kuṃkumasya satīśāyā dhanyeśvaryā udantakam | caityabrahmadvijasyāpi camatkārāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||207|| harikṛṣṇanaranārāyaṇatīrthaṃ tathoditam | māṇikītīrthamaya cāśvapaṭṭābhidhaniścayaḥ ||208|| aśvapāṭalasaṃjñasya sādhudīkṣoditā tataḥ | kāśītaḥ śivaśaṃbhupreṣitayogākhyapatrikām ||209|| nītvā bṛhaspatiścāpi nāradaḥ prāpaturharim | kanyaiśvaryaguṇadivyalakṣaṇānyāha nāradaḥ |||2.300.21 0 || yogapatrī pratipatrī darśite guṇagarbhite | maṇḍapo varṇito divyo māṇikyastaṃbhapūjanam || 211 || kalaśasya gaṇeśasya mātṛkāṇāṃ ca pūjanam | vāstorviṣṇoḥ kuladevasarvatobhadrapūjanam ||212|| phalādeśānvitaṃ proktaṃ mahāmaṇḍapavarṇanam | kuṃkumapatrikāsampreṣaṇaṃ tāmbūlakotsavaḥ ||213 || rātrau gītinṛtyavādyamallakāvyādanotsavāḥ | piṣṭikāmardanaṃ śṛṃgāro hareśca janāgamaḥ ||214|| kāśīyātrāsajjatā cāsaṃkhyakanyāsusajjatā | yogavāhinikā kāśīṃ prāptā śivapure sthitā ||2186|| pārvatīpuramapyatra varṇitaṃ śivapattanam | sammānaṃ kuśalapraśnāḥ kailāsasyāvatāraṇam ||21 6|| śivapuryāmatha pūjā kuladevyāstathā hariḥ | kṛṣṇarūpeṇa ca rādhārūpeṇa ca parīkṣaṇam || 2 17|| cakre kanyā na deyaiti bālakṛṣṇāya sarvathā | śivaśaṃbhupuro’thāpi girijāyāḥ puro’pi ca ||218|| lakṣmyāḥ puro’pi hariṇā proktvā dārḍhyaṃ parīkṣitam | kanyārthāmbarabhūṣādipreṣaṇaṃ samavarṇitam || 219|| varṇanaṃ yogavāhinyā pārvatyai darśitaṃ ṛcā | mumuhurdarśakanāryaḥ kṛṣṇāṃgeṣu pravīkṣya tam || 2.300.220|| viśrāntimandire kṛṣṇasyābhavanmadhuparkakaḥ | kanyakānāṃ suśṛṃgāro harermaṇḍapa āgamaḥ ||221 || koṭyarbudābjarūpaiśca hariḥ kanyāḥ samagrahīt | vidhiḥ sarvaḥ kṛtaścāpi kāntoddeśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||222|| sarvarūpādivilayo prodvāhavidhipūrṇatā | sarvābhiḥ saha śayane vihāre naikarūpataḥ || 223|| prātaḥ phullakayātrā ca yogagranthivimocanam | gaṃgāyāṃ sarvavargebhyaḥ pāritoṣādikārpaṇam ||224|| pañcagaṃgātaṭe bālakṛṣṇābhidhasutīrthakam | śaṃbhave bhikṣikādānaṃ śivapattanamāgamaḥ ||225|| satkārapūjanaṃ cāpi vidāyaḥ kṣāntiyācanā | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetramāgamo yogayātriṇām ||226|| gṛhapraveśaḥ kāntānāṃ vihāro’tha vinodanam | gurumantragrahaṇaṃ ca vanānāmavalokanam ||227|| dyauḥ kanyārūpiṇī līlāṃ koṭyarbudābjarūpiṇaḥ | kāntābhiḥ ramamāṇasya harerdṛṣṭvā mumoha sā || 228|| atha sarvakanyakānāṃ samādhiṃ harirairayat | sṛṣṭitrayākṣaradhāmādikaṃ tvadarśayaddhariḥ ||229|| mahīmānavidāyaṃ ca mithaḥ kṣamādiyācanam | mātṛbhirbhikṣitāḥ kanyāḥ sarvāḥ śrīhṛriṇārpitāḥ ||2.300.23 0|| maṇḍapādiparihāro lakṣmīsevā surītikā | janmotsave ṣoḍaśe svasatīnāṃ punarāgamaḥ ||23 1|| śivaśaṃbhvādimokṣastretāsantānaśruteḥ phalam | tretāsantānaviṣayoddeśaḥ khaṇḍasamāpanam ||232||| tretāmāhātmyamuktaṃ ca saṃkṣiptā viṣayāstvime | tretāsantānake rādhe varṇitā mokṣadāḥ khalu ||233 || nṛpāṇāṃ cāpi bhaktānāṃ yajñānāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā | tīrthānāṃ ca kathā divyāḥ santi cātra sahasraśaḥ ||234|| vai dvātriṃśatsahasrāṇi ślokāḥ santānake’tra ca | adhyāyāstriśatānyeva parabrahmaparāyaṇāḥ || 235|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇāt kīrtanādapi | rakṣaṇādvā gṛhe bhuktimuktiyuktā bhavanti hi || 236|| kṛtādhyāyāḥ pañcaśataṃ navatiśceti saṃhitāḥ | tretādhyāyaiste’ṣṭaśataṃ navatiśca bhavanti hi ||237|| saptāśītisahasrāṇi ślokā bhavanti saṃhitāḥ | athottaraṃ tṛtīyo dvāparasantānakābhidhaḥ ||238|| khaṇḍaḥ sampatsyate rādhe kṛṣṇanrāyaṇagocaraḥ | ṣoḍaśābdātmakāvasthakṛṣṇasvarūpavarṇanaḥ |||239|| kṛṣṇakāntā yoṣitaśca narāḥ kṛṣṇasya sevakāḥ | bhavantyetatkathāyogācchrīkṛṣṇo’haṃ bravīmi vai ||2.300.240||| svasti vo’stu parabrahma śrīkṛṣṇaḥ svasti vaḥ kriyāt | mātā pitā patiḥ patnī svasti vaṃśā bhavantu vaḥ ||241 || vācakāyāsya sarvasvaṃ deyaṃ vyāsāya muktaye | smṛddhaye śraddhayā divyabuddhyā śrotṛbhiro namaḥ || 242|| svarṇaṃ ratnāni śayyādi hīrakā mauktikāni ca | gajavājigavādīni vimānaṃ vāhanāni ca || 243 || yānaṃ saudhaṃ vāṭikādi deyaṃ vyāsāya śārṅgiṇe | śrīkṛṣṇovallabhaḥsvāmisvarūpo vyāsa eva yat ||244|| saubhāgyāni samastāni deyānyasmai praśṛṇvatā | dhanasampatputrapatnīrājyamānaṃ hi labhyate ||245||| brahmaprāptikaraṃ śāstraṃ sarvavidyāprasaṃbhṛtam | tretāsantānakaṃ kṛṣṇātmakaṃ vijayatetamām ||246||| sarvaduḥkhavināśo’sya śravaṇād dānatastathā | sarvaśāntisamāyogaḥ sarvasiddhiprasaṃjanam ||247|| vidyābhūkanyakāsvarṇadānānāṃ phaladā śrutiḥ | mokṣadānaphaladā ca kṛṣṇasvāmyapradāyinī ||248|| omāryaḥ kambharābālaḥ sarvasvāmī satīśvaraḥ | satāṃ rūpaḥ paramātmā jayatyaharniśaṃ prabhuḥ ||249|| tasminneva pare brahmaṇyarpito’yaṃ dvitīyakaḥ | santānaḥ santanotvatra śaśvattvaṃ subhagaṃ va om ||2.300.250|| vai dvātriṃśatsahasrāṇi dve śate ca śatārdhakam | catvāraśca bhavantyatra ślokāstretāsutānake ||251 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lakṣmīnārāyaṇamahimā, tretāsantānakhaṇḍasthaviṣayāṇāṃ saṃkṣiptanirdeśaḥ, dvāparasantānaprastāvaḥ, āśīrvādāśceti nirūpaṇanāmā triśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 300 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyastretāyugasantānakhaṇḍaḥ samāptaḥ oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmyarpaṇamastu
<3.1> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca oṃ namaḥ śrīparabrahmākṣarātītāya cakriṇe | pareśāya dhvajaśūladhanuścihnāya śārṅgiṇe || 1 || sarvakāntāya kāntāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ | muktabandhāya hṛdyāya namaḥ sarvāvatāriṇe || 2 || yasmāt sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ yena puṣṭiṃ prayāti ca | yatra sthitaṃ bhavedante tasmai kāntāya te namaḥ || 3 || yasmāt sarve hyavatārāḥ śrīkṛṣṇādyā bhavantyapi | kālo māyā yadaṃśāśca tasmai kāntāya te namaḥ || 4 || yāha vai sukhadālakṣmīḥ viśveśvarasutā tava | priyā bhūtvābhavaṃ nārāyaṇīśrīste namo namaḥ || 5 || anantāḥ kanyakā jātā nārāyaṇyo hareḥ priyāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te namo namaḥ || 6 || lakṣmīkāntāya kāntāya rādhākāntāya te namaḥ | māṇikyāvāhine ramāpataye te namo namaḥ || 7 || śrīśāyate padmāvatīpataye ca namo namaḥ | brahmapriyāśanādyānāṃ pataye te namo namaḥ || 8 || ṣaṣṭhī yā manasā devī taddhavāya ca te namaḥ | dīpāvalīnāṃ pataye talājāpataye namaḥ || 9 || kāmadhenupragopāyārjantīnāṃ pataye namaḥ | krodhaneśāya ca dharāputrīṇāṃ pataye namaḥ || 3.1.1 0|| sūcīkāntāya ca vanadevījeśāya te namaḥ | dāmanīpataye kaṃkatālikeśāya te namaḥ || 11 || pitṛkanyāprakāntāya janapitṛsuteśine | pitṛdāsīśvarāyāpi bālakṛṣṇāya te namaḥ || 12|| rāsātalīnāṃ kāntāya vāsantikeśa te namaḥ | sālamālīyanārīṇāmīśvarāya ca te namaḥ || 13|| svastikīnāgakanyānāṃ pataye te namo namaḥ | nāginīnāṃ ca pataye parameśāya te namaḥ || 14|| śāvadīnoprakāntāya pareśāya ca te namaḥ | aindrajālikakāntānāṃ pataye te namo namaḥ || 15|| vidyānāthāya ca sarasvatīśāya ca te namaḥ | lākṣmaṇīśāya devāya nāḍikeśāya te namaḥ || 16|| gāndharvīṇāṃ ca pataye jummasemlīśa te namaḥ | sāntapanīvarāyāpi sauratīpataye namaḥ || 17|| mahābāleśvarīśāya cailabīleśa te namaḥ | dākṣajāvaṃgarīśāya cauṣṇīśāya ca te namaḥ || 1 8|| prācīnīnāṃ pataye te piśaṃgīpataye namaḥ | sāntāṇarīśvara kṛṣṇa śaibīnāṃ pataye namaḥ || 19|| thārkūṭasthīpramadeśa vīrajārīśa te namaḥ | śāktyakṣīpramadānātha piśācīśvara te namaḥ ||3.1.20|| kālimāśīśvara kṛṣṇa dīnabandho ca te namaḥ | auralakaitavīśāya krāthakīpataye namaḥ ||21|| pṛthuputrīsvāmine te coṣṭrālīpataye namaḥ | hāṃkārīsvāmine jayakāṣṭhajeśāya te namaḥ ||22|| tīrāṇīpataye nātha cālvīnārīśa te namaḥ | jīnavarddhisuteśāyānāthānāthāya te namaḥ ||23|| prakīrṇapramadeśāya parameśāya te namaḥ | ālpakaitavīkāntāya pārīśānīśa te namaḥ ||24||| indurāyasuteśāya mudrāṇḍīpataye namaḥ | gaṇḍabhūpasuteśāya līnorṇāpataye namaḥ ||25|| bārhacchārīsvāmine te bālalīnīśa te namaḥ | vārasiṃhīsvāmine te rāyagāmīśa te namaḥ ||26|| phainatāntavīkāntāya stokahomīśa te namaḥ | kāṣṭhayānīsvāmine te kolakīpataye namaḥ || 27|| dainamānīsvāmine te mama kāntāya te namaḥ | pareśāya namo rāyakinnaṭīpataye namaḥ ||28|| rāyakoṭīsvarīśāya namaste paramātmane | rāyaraṇajitputrīśa namaste haraye namaḥ || 29|| rāyavākakṣikeśāya rāyamārīśakeśine | rāyabāleśvarīśāya rāyalambārikeśine ||3.1.3 0 || namaste rāyanavārikeśa śrīparamātmane | rāyahūṇḍeśikeśāya rāyakūpeśikeśine ||3 1 || kālīmaṇḍīsvāmine te vanajeleśikeśine | pārāvārapibīśāya koṭiśeśāya te namaḥ ||3 2|| satīśīśāya devāya tretākarkaśikeśine | āṇḍajarāsvāmine te bālyarājasīsvāmine ||33|| rāyasomanīsvāmine te sarveśāya namo namaḥ | urugavākṣikeśāya parāṅvratanikeśine ||34|| rāyasvastrīśa te kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho namaḥ | aiśānapānīśa kānta rājārāyīśa te namaḥ ||35|| maṃgalādiprakāntāya cājanābhīśvarāya ca | namaḥ kauberikeśāya māhendrīpataye namaḥ ||36 || yamīnāṃ svāmine kṛṣṇa vāyavīśāya te namaḥ | vaiśvakarmīsvāmine te vārkṣīṇāṃ pataye namaḥ || 37|| raudrīṇāṃ pataye vahniputrīṇāṃ pataye namaḥ | śrāvaṇīnāṃ ca pataye khānijīśāya te namaḥ ||38|| sāṃvatsarīsvāmine te gopīnāṃ pataye namaḥ | prācīnīnāṃ svāmine te piśaṃgīsvāmine namaḥ || 39|| rāśiyānīśvara romāyanīśvara ca te namaḥ | pāraśīpataye kṛṣṇa dhīvarīpataye namaḥ ||3.1.40|| kinnarīpataye kṛṣṇāmarīṇāṃ pataye namaḥ | gaurīṇāṃ pataye parīpataye te namo namaḥ ||41 || ābriktīsvāmine hāritīśāya te namo namaḥ | pātālīpataye svargīpataye te namo namaḥ ||42|| apsarasāṃ dineśāya brahmasaro’dhiśāsine | gāndharvīṇāṃ pataye te kuśaleśāya te namaḥ ||43 || vidyanmaṇisvāmine te bhaumīnāṃ pataye namaḥ | dānavīnāṃ pataye te śaktīnāṃ pataye namaḥ ||44|| kāśikākanyākānātha dhenupālīśa te namaḥ | kāntākānteśa sarveśa mama prāṇeśa te namaḥ ||45|| namaḥ śrīkaṃbharāputra santuṣṭānuja te namaḥ | tvayā vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ ||46|| śrīkṛṣṇāyaviṣṇavesvāmine matpataye namaḥ | lakṣmīśeśastvamevarṣisattamastvaṃ nṛpottamaḥ ||47|| tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ jāṭharaśca tṛptidastvaṃ pareśvara | prāpya tvāṃ tvarbudādyāśca nāryo muktiṃ gatāstviha ||48|| muktāśca muktimāpannā narā jātāḥ parārdhagāḥ | tvāṃ bhajitvā svaḥ prayānti janaṃ satyaṃ prayānti ca ||49|| tvāṃ bhajitvā ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ vairājakṣmāṃ prayānti ca | tvāṃ bhajitvāmṛtalokaṃ golokaṃ ca prayānti vai | akṣaraṃ paramaṃ dhāma tvāṃ bhajitvā prayānti hi ||3.1.50|| bhavatā bhagavan sarvaṃ samādhau darśitaṃ hi naḥ | me tadārabhya jijñāsā vartate kālagocarā ||51|| ātyantike laye muktamaṇḍaleṣu virājase | prākṛte punarārabdhe sarge kālena nodite ||52|| pradhānapuruṣe jāte mahāviṣṇau tathodgate | vairāje ca tato jāte tathā jāte ca vedhasi ||53 || idānīṃpariparyantaṃ kālaḥ kiyān gato vada | jñātavyaṃ cāpyadhikaṃ ced vidyeta vada me hare ||54|| yadyahaṃ jñānapātraṃ ced vada me prāṇarakṣaka | pṛthvyāmidānīṃ kālo’pi kiyānastīti me vada ||55|| puruṣottama evāsi sarvajñaḥ sākṣagocaraḥ | tvāṃ vinānyo na vai śakto vaktaṃ bhavennarāyaṇa ||56|| śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kālasaṃkhyānamādarāt | vaktumaśakyamanyena jñātuṃ cāśakyamityapi ||57|| yadā nāsīnmahāmāyā sṛṣṭirūpā guṇatrayā | līnā madicchārūpā sā yadāsīdakṣare pade ||58|| yadā nāsīnmahākālaḥ puruṣastatprayojanaḥ | līnaścāsīnmadaiśvaryarūpo muktaḥ sa cākṣare ||59|| tadākṣaraṃ paraṃ dhāma mamaivāsīnna cetarat | brahmasṛṣṭiḥ kevalā sā naiśvarī jīvanī kutaḥ ||3.1.60|| mahāpralaya evāsau bodhyastvayā narāyaṇi | mayā cekṣā kṛtā hyeko bahu syāṃ māyayānvitaḥ ||6 1 || tadā tvicchāsvarūpā sā māyā prakāśamāgatā | divyā muktānikā śaktirmama sā tu guṇātmikā ||62|| kālākhyaḥ puruṣaścāpi mayā prakāśitastataḥ | mamaiśvaryasvarūpaḥ sa mukto tayānvayaṃ gataḥ ||63|| yugalaṃ tattu prakṛtipuruṣau madapatyakau | jātau tābhyāṃ mayā tvājñā dattā sṛṣṭyarthameva ha ||64|| tābhyāṃ ca jātamātrābhyāṃ sṛṣṭyāraṃbhaḥ kṛtaḥ prage | ekaṃ suyugalaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ pradhānapuruṣātmakam ||65|| tena sṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā mahāviṣṇukoṭyarbudātmikā | pradhānapuruṣaḥ so’yaṃ sāyaṃ ca vyaśanattataḥ ||66|| rātryante ca prage kālaprakṛtibhyāṃ punarnavam | yugalaṃ sṛṣṭamevānyat pradhānapuruṣātmakam ||67|| sṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā ca sāyaṃ tadvinaṣṭaṃ punareva ha | divaso’yaṃ mahākālakalpaḥ saṃprocyate’kṣare ||68|| sahasraṃ tu mahākālakalpānāṃ varṣamekakam | prakṛteścāpi kālasya vidyate tatra sarvathā ||69|| etādṛśāni varṣāṇi pañcāśad vigatāni vai | prakṛtipuruṣasyaivaikapañcāśattu vatsaram ||3.1.70|| vartate’dyādyadivasaṃ tāvatyaḥ sṛṣṭayo gatāḥ | te pañcāśatsahasrāṇi pradhānapuruṣā mṛtāḥ ||71 || ekapañcāśatsahasrādyaḥ pradhānapuruṣo’sti vai | śṛṇu cāgre’pi kālaṃ vai nārāyaṇīśri sarjanam ||72|| ayaṃ pradhānapuruṣaḥ prātareva navaṃ navam | mahāviṣṇuṃ janayati vairājīsṛṣṭikārakam ||73|| mahāviṣṇuḥ sa vai sāyaṃ naśyatyeva dināntake | evaṃ sahasradivasātmakaṃ varṣaṃ pradhānakṛt| ||74|| pradhānapuruṣasyāsya vai pañcāśatsamā gatāḥ | tat pañcāśatsahasrāṇi te mahāviṣṇavo mṛtāḥ ||75|| ekapañcāśattame’bde cādyasya divasasya vai | ekapañcāśatsahasrādyo mahāviṣṇū rājate ||76|| śṛṇu cāgre’pi kālaṃ vai nārāyaṇīśri sarjanam | mahāviṣṇuścāyamatra prātareva navaṃ navam ||77|| vairājaṃ janayatyeva vaidhasīsṛṣṭikāraṇam | vairājaśca sa vai sāyaṃ naśyatyeva dināntake ||78|| evaṃ sahasradivasātmakaṃ varṣaṃ pravidyate | mahāviṣṇormama piturgopālakṛṣṇakasya vai ||79|| mahāviṣṇoścāsya tatra vai pañcāśatsamā gatāḥ | vai pañcāśatsahasrāṇi vairājāstatsutā mṛtāḥ ||3.1.80|| ekapañcāśattame’bde cādyasya divasasya vai | ekapañcāśatsahasrādyo vairājo virājate ||8 1|| śṛṇu cāgre’pi kālaṃ vai nārāyaṇīśri sarjanam | vairājaścāpyayamatra prātareva navaṃ navam ||82|| brahmāṇaṃ janayatyeva viṣṇurudrasamanvitam | sa brahmāpi sadā sāyaṃ naśyatyeva dināntake ||83|| evaṃ sahasradivasātmakaṃ varṣaṃ virāṭkṛtam | asya vairājapuṃsaśca paṃcāśadvai samā gatāḥ ||84|| te pañcāśatsahasrāṇi brahmāṇastatsutā mṛtāḥ | ekapañcāśattame’bde cādyasya divasasya vai ||85|| ekapaṃcāśatsahasrādyo vedhāśca virājate | śṛṇu cāgre’pi kālaṃ vai nārāyaṇīśri sarjanam ||86|| vedhāścāpyayamevātra prātareva navaṃ navam | āsvargāntaṃ sṛjatyeva surarṣimānavādikam ||87|| āsvargāntaṃ ca sāyaṃ vai nityaṃ naśyati tattathā | evaṃ sahasradivasātmakaṃ varṣaṃ hi vaidhasam ||88|| ekaṃ kalpasahasraṃ tad brahmaṇo’bdaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | vedhaso’sya gatāścāpi tatpañcāśatpravatsarāḥ ||89|| tatpañcāśatsahasrāṇi trailokyāni mṛtāni vai | ekapañcāśattame’bde tvādyasya divasasya vai ||3.1.90|| ekapañcāśatsahasrādyaḥ kalpo vārāhasaṃjñakaḥ | vartate divasaḥ so’yaṃ cādyaṃ yugacatuṣṭayam ||9 1 || ayaṃ caturmukhaścāste brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | brahmaṇo divasaḥ kalpa iti nāmnā kṛto mayā ||92|| vairājasya tu divaso mahākalpaḥ kṛto mayā | mahāviṣṇostu divaso mahāmahākhyakalpakaḥ ||93|| pradhānapuṃso divasaḥ kṛtaḥ prākṛtakalpakaḥ | māyākālasya divaso mahākālākhyakalpakaḥ ||94|| tannāśe ca mahān prokto mahāpralaya eva ha | brahmā varṣaśataṃ cāste virājo’pi tathā nijam ||95|| mahāviṣṇurnijaṃ varṣaśataṃ jīvati ceśvaraḥ | pradhānapuruṣaścāpi nijaṃ varṣaśataṃ tathā ||96 || prakṛtipuruṣaścāpi nijaṃ varṣaśataṃ tataḥ | tādṛgvarṣaśataṃ mahāpralayo vai niśātmakaḥ ||97|| punaḥ sṛṣṭiḥ punarmahāpralayaścaivameva ha | kṛtaṃ tantraṃ mayā śrīnārāyaṇīśri praśāśvatam || 98|| punarmahāsṛṣṭireva mahāpralayakaḥ punaḥ | brahmaṇo divase caike manavaśca caturdaśa ||99|| utpadyante vilīyante kā teṣāṃ gaṇanā priye | ekaṃ kalpasahasraṃ tu brahmaṇo’bdaśca yo mataḥ || 3.1.100 || tadabdāṣṭasahasraṃ tu brahmaṇastadyugaṃ smṛtam | ekaṃ yugasahasraṃ tu savanaṃ brahmaṇo matam || 101 || lakṣaikavāraṃ trailokyanāśe brahmā vinaśyati | lakṣaikavāraṃ cājasya nāśe virāḍ vinaśyati || 1 02|| lakṣavairājanāśe ca mahāviṣṇurvinaśyati | mahāviṣṇulakṣanāśe pradhānapuṃvināśanam || 1 03|| pradhānapuṃlakṣanāśe prakṛtipuṃvināśanam | ityevaṃ kālagaṇanā bodhyā tvayā narāyaṇi || 1 04|| tāsu tāsu ca sarvāsu sṛṣṭiṣvahaṃ tvayā saha | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 1 05|| prādurbhavāmyavatārī śrīpatiḥ parameśvaraḥ | avatārā hyasaṃkhyātā me tatra saṃbhavantyapi || 1 06|| ahaṃ vedmi na cānyastān sarvajño’haṃ na cetaraḥ | vidanti nāpyavatārāḥ pūrvasṛṣṭivido hi te || 1 07|| mā sandehaṃ vidhehyatra mama dairghyaṃ durantakam | adhikaṃ pṛccha jijñāsyaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 1 08|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne nārāyaṇīśrīkṛtā puruṣottamastutiḥ sṛṣṭikālagaṇanā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā prathamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||
<3.2> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca vedhaso’sya harekṛṣṇa puruṣottama matpate | dvāpañcāśadvatsarāṇāṃ nāmāni vettumeva me || 1 || icchā prajāyate tasmād vada śrīpuruṣottama | manūnāṃ cāpi ca caturdaśānāṃ nāmamātrakam || 2 || vettumicchāmi bhagavan kalpe vārāhake tvaham | ekapañcāśattame’bde ye kalpāścāntato gatāḥ || 3 || tānapi vettumicchāmi tava prākaṭyayoginaḥ | saṃkṣepād vada me kānta yadi bhāro na vidyate || 4 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca brahmaṇo’sya vatsarastu prathamaḥ padmavatsaraḥ | nālakramo dvitīyaśca nālordhvagastṛtīyakaḥ || 5 || turyaṃ stāvanavarṣaṃ ca vyomavāṇaṃ tu pañcamam | ṣaṣṭhaṃ tapovapsaraṃ ca saptamaṃ yamavatsaram || 6 || niyamaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ cāpi varṣaṃ navamamāsanam | daśamaṃ prāṇarodhākhyaṃ caikādaśaṃ pratihṛtiḥ || 7 || dvādaśaṃ dhāraṇaṃ varṣaṃ dhyānavarṣaṃ trayodaśam | caturdaśaṃ tu mananaṃ pañcadaśaṃ samādhikam || 8 || ṣoḍaśaṃ prajñātavarṣaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parikīrtitam | aprajñātaṃ saptadaśaṃ cāṣṭādaśaṃ tu līnatā || 9 || navadaśaṃ vatsaraṃ tu sākṣātkārābhidhaṃ tataḥ | viṃśatitamavarṣaṃ ca sṛṣṭibhānābhidhaṃ tataḥ || 3.2.10 || ekaviṃśatitamaṃ vai vedavatsarasaṃjñakam | rudravatsaranāmnā ca dvāviṃśo vatsarastataḥ || 11 || sanātanastrayoviṃśaścaturviṃśastathārṣakaḥ | dharmavarṣaṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ ṣaḍviṃśo’naṅgavatsaraḥ || 1 2|| saptaviṃśo’dharmasaṃjño’ṣṭāviṃśo’nalavatsaraḥ | navaviṃśaṃ pitṛvarṣaṃ triṃśastu devavatsaraḥ || 13 || ekatriṃśaṃ mānavākhyaṃ dvātriṃśaṃ kalpapādapam | trayastriṃśaṃ sasyasaṃjñaṃ catustriṃśaṃ tu pāśavam || 14|| pañcatriṃśaṃ yākṣavarṣaṃ ṣaḍviṃśaṃ rākṣasābhigham | saptatriṃśaṃ cāṇḍajākhyamaṣṭātriṃśaṃ tu gharmajam || 1 5|| navatriṃśaṃ nāgavarṣaṃ catvāriṃśaṃ tu yādasam | adhvarākhyaścaikacatvāriṃśo vai vatsarastataḥ || 16 || hiraṇyavatsaraṃ dvācatvāriśaṃ ca tataḥ param | rājataṃ tricatvāriṃśaṃ kāpālakaṃ tataḥ param || 1 7|| apsarovatsaraṃ pañcacatvāriṃśaṃ tato’bhavat | brahmasarovatsaraṃ ca svardhūnīvatsaraṃ tataḥ || 18 || arcimārgābhidhamaṣṭacatvāriṃśaṃ ca vatsaram | abdhimanthaṃ tato varṣaṃ nāradākhyaṃ ca vatsaram || 19 || ekapañcāśattama somanāthavatsaraṃ tataḥ | dvipañcāśattamaṃ varṣaṃ vaiṣṇavākhyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 3.2.20 || gāyatrīvatsaraṃ tripañcāśattamaṃ pravartsyate | ekapañcāśattame’yaṃ vārāho nāma kalpakaḥ || 21 || mayā vārāharūpeṇa kṣitirjalāt samuddhṛtā | atra vai manavo bhūpā bhaviṣyanti caturdaśa || 22|| svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ pūrvastataḥ svārociṣo manuḥ | uttamaśca tāmasaśca raivataścākṣuṣastataḥ ||23|| vaivasvataśca sāvarṇī cāṣṭamo manureva ha | navamo dakṣasāvarṇī brahmasāvarṇikastataḥ ||24|| tataśca dharmasāvarṇiḥ rudrasāvarṇikastataḥ | tataśca devasāvarṇiścendrasāvarṇikastataḥ ||25|| caturdaśaite manavaścendrāścāpi caturdaśa | divase samprajāyante rātrau tāvān layo mataḥ ||26|| kalpe kalpe bhavāmyeva pṛthivyāṃ puruṣottamaḥ | te pañcāśatsahasrāṇi kalpāstu brahmaṇo gatāḥ || 27|| nārāyaṇi hyavatārī tāvatsaṃkhyo’bhavaṃ kṣitau | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||28|| yuge yuge tvavatārā me bhavanti yathākriyam | teṣāṃ saṃkhyā na cāstyeva jānāmyahaṃ na cetare ||29|| tatra nāmānyanantāni bhavanti guṇakarmabhiḥ | kintu kalpe tvekavāraṃ bhavāmi puruṣottamaḥ || 3.2.3 0|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ bālakṛṣṇakaḥ | avatārī koṭibhaktabhaktānīpatirīśapaḥ ||3 1 || yatra kalpe samāraṃbhe yo’vatāro bhavenmama | tena nāmnāpi ca mayā sa vai kalpaḥ prakāśyate || 32||| tasmāt kalpābhidhānāni madvijñānakṛtāni vai | na śakyamānupūrvyeṇa teṣāṃ vaktuṃ pravistaram ||33||| anāditvāddhi kālasya hyasaṃkhyānācca vedhasām | ābhūtasamplavo hyetadahorātraṃ smṛtaṃ tataḥ ||34|| trailokye yāni sattvāni gatimanti dhruvāṇi ca | ābhūtebhyaḥ pralīyante tasmādābhūtasamplavaḥ ||35|| caturyugasahasrānte divase brahmaṇo gate | suṣupsurviśvasṛṭ naijāṃ rātriṃ vai kurute tataḥ || 36|| tataḥ sa vasati rātriṃ tamasyekārṇave jale | prātaḥ sisṛkṣayā yukto yathāpūrvaṃ karoti ca ||37|| vatsarāraṃbhadivase brahmā yadyat karoti hi | pradhānaṃ karma tannāmnā vatsaro vāpi jāyate ||38|| tatpañcāśattame varṣe vedhasaḥ kalpakeṣvaham | bahuvāraṃ samutpanno nārāyaṇyā tvayā samam ||3 9|| brāhmakalpe pādmakalpe vairājakalpake tathā | śvetakalpe lohite ca kṛṣṇakalpe’bhavaṃ tathā ||3.2.40|| sanatkalpe bhavakalpe bhuvaḥ kalpe’bhavaṃ tathā | tapaḥkalpe bhāvakalpe raṃbhakalpe ṛtau tathā ||41 || ṛtukalpe vahnikalpe havyavāhanake’pi ca | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ tadābhavam ||42|| sāvitrakalpe bhuvaḥkalpe cośikakalpake | kuśike cāpi gāndhāre ṛṣabhe ṣaṭjakalpake ||43|| mārjālīye madhyame ca vairāje kalpake’pi ca | niṣāde prāṇake cāpi meghavāhye’bhavaṃstathā ||44|| cintake cākūtike vijñātau mānase’pi ca | bhāve rathantare śvetalohite raktavāsasi ||45|| pīte ca sitakalpe ca viśvarūpe’bhavaṃstathā | tadanyeṣu ca kalpeṣu yathākāryaṃ narāyaṇi ||46|| abhavaṃścābhavaṃścāpi me’vatārā asaṃkhyakāḥ | kalpe kalpe’pi bahudhā śrīstvaṃ bahvī prajāyase ||47|| mama patnī yathā tvadya vivāhyā mama jāyase | tava nāmānyanantāni te’vatārā asaṃkhyakāḥ ||48|| jānāmyahaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ nārāyaṇīśri sarvathā | nārāyaṇi tvidaṃ sarvaṃ vyāptaṃ mamaiva tejasā ||49|| mama lakṣmyā mamaiśvayairmadguṇairmadvibhūtibhiḥ | madaṃśairmama sāmarthyairmama sampatsamṛddhibhiḥ ||3.2.50|| pataṃge cāpi mattejaḥ pradīpe’pi ca māmakam | vidyuti grahanakṣatratārāsu śaśisūryayoḥ ||51|| mama tejo hi sarvatra tejasvino mayā hi te | maṇyoṣadhiṣu dyumārge svarge jane tapasyapi ||52|| maharloke satyaloke merau tejo hi māmakam | lokāloke śaṃkare ca viṣṇau cāje virājake ||53 || mahāviṣṇau pradhāneśe prakṛtīśe’kṣare’pi ca | mukteṣu cāpi sarveṣu cāvatāreṣu sarvathā ||54|| aiśvaryaguṇatejāṃsi mamaiva santi tāni vai | mama mūrteḥ kiraṇaiste puṣṭiṃ tṛptiṃ vidanti ca ||55|| puruṣottamamūrteśca kiraṇānāṃ vicitratā | puṣṇāti muktajātāni vibhinnatṛptidānataḥ ||56|| sadā ṣoḍaśavarṣo’haṃ caikamāno’kṣare pare | poṣayāmi muktajanān mahānandādidānakaiḥ ||57|| mama tejāṃsi sarvāṇi mahānandamatāni vai | śāntiśītalatātṛptisudhābhṛtāni santi ca ||58|| tadbhoktāro muktajanā muktānyaśca tvayā saha | śāśvatānandapūrṇāste nityatṛptā bhavanti hi |||59|| romṇāṃ mūrteḥ kiraṇāni niryānti rasabhṛnti vai | sṛṣṭitrayasyauṣadhayaḥ puṣṇanti tadrasaiḥ sadā ||3.2.60|| muktāśca tadrasaiḥ puṣṭāḥ sarvadaikapramāṇinaḥ | eṣāṃ tejāṃsi netrābhyāṃ niryānti bhāskarāṇi vai ||61 || tatprabhābhiḥ prapaśyanti sṛṣṭitrayasya dehinaḥ | dakṣanetrakiraṇebhyaḥ sūryā bhavanti sarvaśaḥ ||62|| vāmanetrakiraṇebhyaścandrā bhavanti sarvaśaḥ | mastakasya ca paridherbhavanti stanayitnavaḥ ||63|| sṛṣṭitrayasya vai vidyutpravāhāśca bhavantyapi | mukhamādhuryatejāṃsi nissarantyabhito hareḥ ||64|| tanmādhuryamadhubhiśca tṛpyanti muktakoṭayaḥ | tṛptibhṛdbhirhi kiraṇaiḥ sṛṣṭitrayasya dehinaḥ ||65|| kapolābhyāṃ mama mūrterniryānti mohinīprabhāḥ | tābhirmuktāstatheśādyā mugdhā mūrtau bhavanti vai ||66|| oṣṭhābhyāṃ cāmṛtabhṛnti niryānti kiraṇāni vai | tadrasāmṛtapānena tṛpyanti trisṛjisthitāḥ ||67|| netraprāntāt prabhavanti tejāṃsi premabhṛnti ca | taiścākṛṣṭāḥ premabhāgā jāyante trisṛjisthitāḥ ||68|| sudhābhṛtāni dantebhyo jāyante kiraṇāni vai | sudhāpānaiḥ sṛṣṭayo vai sarvāstṛpyanti sarvadā ||69|| pīyūṣāṇāṃ kiraṇāni bhālamadhyād bhavanti vai | pīyūṣapānatṛptāśca jāyante trisṛjisthitāḥ ||3.2.70|| karṇābhyāṃ saṃprajāyante tāratejaḥsvarātmakāḥ | tejaḥpravāhāstaiḥ sarve śṛṇvanti divyakarṇakāḥ ||7 1 || mūrterabhito jāyante miṣṭasparśāḥ sukhāvahāḥ | spārśanaiḥ kiraṇaiḥ spṛṣṭā bhuñjate sukhamācyutam ||72|| jihvātaḥ kiraṇānīṣṭamiṣṭarasāni yānti hi | sarvasṛṣṭijanāstaistu rasyante’danti tadrasam| ||73|| nāsikātaḥ kiraṇāni gandhavanti prayānti ca | tadgandhaiḥ sarvasṛṣṭisthā jighranti vai sugandhikam ||74|| śrīharerme hṛdayāttu nissarantyabhitaḥ khalu | śāśvatānandapūrṇāni kiraṇāni sukhāni vai ||75|| tairmahānandamagnāśca vartante trisṛjisthitāḥ | mama mūrghnaścidākāśātmakabrahmākhyarandhrataḥ ||76|| prabhavanti mahānandā miṣṭā vāṇī parā tathā | tābhyaḥ sṛṣṭitrayasthāśca vyāharanti vacāṃsi hi ||77|| madvācā vāgminaḥ sarve matkṛtārthānuyoginaḥ | maddhastābhyāṃ kiraṇāni kriyāvanti prayānti ca ||78|| taiśca sṛṣṭitrayasthā vai bhavanti yatnaśīlinaḥ | mamodarāt kiraṇāni niryānti paritastathā ||79|| prāṇadāni ca taiḥ sarve jīvanti trisṛjisthitāḥ | mama prajananād yāntyānandāḍhyakiraṇāni vai ||3.2.80|| tanmātrayānandavantaḥ sṛṣṭitrayasthadehinaḥ | manmūrteḥ pādayoryānti vihārakiraṇāni vai ||8 1 || tairbhavanti sagatikāḥ sṛṣṭitrayasya dehinaḥ | manmūrteḥ kaṭibhāgācca prayānti kiraṇāni ha ||82|| sabalāni ca taiḥ sarve balavanto bhavanti hi | pṛṣṭhadaṇḍāt kiraṇānyādhāravanti prayānti ca ||83 || tena lokāṇḍakoṭyaścādhārastaṃbhāśritāḥ sadā | mama pāyūtsarjabhāso yānti vai sṛṣṭikoṭiṣu ||84|| tābhirbhābhiḥ samutsargo jananāni bhavanti ca | mama nitambabhāgābhyāṃ kiraṇāni prayānti ca ||85|| āsyaśaktyāsanabaddhāḥ sarve lokā bhavanti taiḥ | mamāntaragatā bhāsaḥ prayānti sarvasṛṣṭiṣu ||86|| tābhirbhābhirmananaṃ ca bodhanaṃ mānanaṃ tathā | cintanaṃ nirṇayaṃ sākṣādvijñānaṃ yānti dehinaḥ ||87|| mama kaustubhakiraṇaiḥ pradīpāḥ saṃbhavanti ca | mama saundaryakiraṇaiḥ sundaryaḥ sṛṣṭayastvimāḥ ||88|| mama lakṣmyāśca kiraṇairgṛhiṇyaḥ sarvasṛṣṭiṣu | gṛhalakṣmyo bhavantyeva sarvasaubhāgyaśobhitāḥ ||89|| mama vātsalyakiraṇaiḥ snehabaddhā hi sṛṣṭayaḥ | mamodāryaprabhābhiścaudāryayuktā hi sṛṣṭayaḥ ||3.2.90 || mamābhirūpakiraṇaiḥ sarvaṃ rūpānvitaṃ sadā | mama kalpākhyakiraṇaiḥ kāmāvasāyitādikāḥ ||9 1 || siddhayaḥ sampravartante kalpapādapavallayaḥ | mama dharmapradaraśmibhiśca tṛpyaṃ sṛjitrayam || 92|| pākaṃ ca pariṇāmaṃ ca prayānti taiśca sṛṣṭayaḥ | mama raudraiśca kiraṇaistirobhāvaṃ prayāntyapi ||93|| sthairyaśaktimayaiścāpi kiraṇaiḥ sarvamaṇḍalam | sṛṣṭitrayātmakaṃ svasvakramasthairye pravartate ||94|| mamāpūrakakiraṇairāpūryante hi sṛṣṭayaḥ | mama puṇyakakiraṇaiḥ pūyante ceśvarādayaḥ ||95|| mama vijñānakiraṇaiḥ sārvajñyaṃ yanti dehinaḥ | mama kṛpāprabhābhiśca samudyanti hi dehinaḥ ||96|| mama śobhāprabhābhiśca śobhante sṛṣṭināyakāḥ | mama guptapratejobhirnigūḍhaiśvaryayoginaḥ || 97|| mama mūrternididhyāsairmanmayāḥ sādhavaḥ sadā | saditi mama cākhyāsti tadvanto ye bhavanti vai || 98 || mamātyantasayujāste santo manmūrtayaḥ priyāḥ | bhavatyaḥ kāśikākṣetre vidhāyāgniṃ pradakṣiṇam ||99|| mama sāyujyamāpannāḥ satyo manmūrtayaḥ priyāḥ | māmārādhya mama yoga gatāste mūrtayo mama || 3.2.10 0|| muktāśceśāḥ surā viprāḥ santo gāvaśca kanyakāḥ | kumārā brahmaśīlāśca satyaśca mūrtayo mama || 10 1|| mama mūrteḥ kiraṇaiśca sattāvadbhiḥ sṛjitraye | prajāyante tu rājāno madyogānmūrtayo mama || 1 02|| indraḥ svāyaṃbhuvo brahmā vairājastatpitāpi ca | tatpituśca pitā cāpi sarvāstā mama mūrtayaḥ || 103 || śacī śatasvarūpā sāvitrī vairājikā tathā | mahālakṣmīḥ pradhānā ca prakṛtirmama mūrtayaḥ || 1 04|| vāsudevādayo vyūhāḥ śrīkṛṣṇādyāśca mūrtayaḥ | nārāyaṇāstathā santaḥ sādhvyaśca mama mūrtayaḥ || 1 05|| agnirviṣṇuḥ suvarṇaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ cetanaṃ guruḥ | yugalaṃ tulasī satyaṃ sarvadā mama mūrtayaḥ || 1 06|| vedaḥ sūryo vyavasāyo daṇḍaḥ sneho’tithiḥ sukham | arbhakaścāśrito’nātho vidyārthī mama mūrtayaḥ || 1 07|| rājācāryaḥ pradhānaścopadeṣṭā vyāsa ārtihāḥ | rakṣakaḥ pālakaḥ svāmī śaraṇyo mama mūrtayaḥ || 1 08|| yajñaḥ śrāddha pūjanaṃ ca svāgataṃ madhuparkakam | dakṣiṇā havyakavyādi manmayaṃ mama mūrtayaḥ || 1 09|| kaṇḍanī peṣaṇī cullī jalakumbhī ca mārjanī | madarthaṃ tūpayuktāstāḥ pāvanyo mama mūrtayaḥ || 3.2.11 0|| śayyā yānaṃ vāhanaṃ ca godhanādyaṃ gṛhādikam | madarthaṃ copayuktaṃ cet sarvaṃ manmūrtirūpi tat || 111 || sarvaṃ madanvitaṃ nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ yathā mama | madarthaṃ cet kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ mama sāyujyadaṃ bhavet || 1 12|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ te’tra bhojanaṃ mūrtirūpyaham | sarveṣāṃ pṛccha me cānyajjijñāsitaṃ tu te yadi || 113 || paṭhitvemaṃ tathā śrutvā madbhāvaṃ cāpnuyāt priye | muktiṃ muktiṃ labhet tīrthaphalaṃ yogaphalaṃ labhet || 1 14|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso dvāpañcāśadvatsaranāmāni, vartamānakalpīyacaturdaśamanunāmāni, pañcāśadvarṣīyāntimacatvāriṃśatkalpanāmāni, puruṣottamakiraṇapoṣyaṃ sṛṣṭitrayādītivibhūtivarṇanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvitīyo’dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||
<3.3> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca bhagavanme kṛpāsindho vada jijñāsitaṃ tvidam | dvāpañcāśadvatsareṣu brahmaṇo yatra vatsare || 1 || mukhyāvatārī tvaṃ jāto nāmakarmaguṇānvitaḥ | tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvallīlā muktidā yataḥ || 2 || nānto’sti te’vatārāṇāṃ tadbhāraṃ na dadāmi te | avatārisvarūpasya prākaṭyaṃ tatpurābhavam || 3 || śrotumicchāmi bhagavan yanme’pi smaraṇaṃ bhavet | puruṣottamaprākaṭyamātraṃ me vada vatsala || 4 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathayāmi nibodha me | bhuktimuktipradaṃ tattaccaritraṃ mama bhāmini || 5 || vedhaso vatsare pādme kalpāṣṭame’ṣṭame manau | vedhaso nālakhaṇḍādvai rohiṇāṇḍodaro’suraḥ || 6 || jajñe brahmāṇḍatulyo vai śarīreṇa balena ca | tejasā tāmasenāpi trilokibhakṣako’bhavat || 7 || rudreṇa gadayā cāpi triśūlena pratāḍitaḥ | dudrāva jalamadhye sa rudrastamanvagāttadā || 8 || pṛthivyāvaraṇaṃ bhittvā praviveśāṇḍamaṇḍalam | satyaṃ tapo janaṃ tyaktvā maharlokamupāyayau || 9 || meroḥ sa gahvare sūkṣmo bhūtvā gupto’vasattataḥ | rudraḥ svargaṃ vīkṣituṃ vai mahendrālayamāyayau || 3.3.1 0|| devāśca pitaraścāpi maharṣayaḥ samāyayuḥ | indrasabhā prapūrṇābhūt sūryacandrādibhistadā || 11 || rohiṇāṇḍodaro jñātvāvasaraṃ vavṛdhe tadā | merutulyodaro bhūtvā mukhyaṃ vyādāya tāṃ sabhām || 1 2|| sasvargāṃ sūryacandrendrarudranakṣatrasaṃyutām | nyagilat sahasā sarvaṃ svargaṃ tasyodare’bhavat || 13|| hāhākāro mahāñjātaścukṣubhurbhūtalāni ca | maharjanādilokāścākasmādvai pracakampire || 14|| satyaloke mahān kampastadā jāto’tidāruṇaḥ | lokālokācalaścāpi muhuḥ kampamagāttadā || 15|| akasmāt pralayaṃ jñātvā svargalokasya devatāḥ | sarudrendrārkaśaśino rohiṇāṇḍodare sthitāḥ || 16|| tuṣṭuvurbhayamāpannā māṃ tadā puruṣottamam | parabrahma kṛpāsindho sarvarakṣaka mādhava || 17|| namaste bhagavan sarvāntaryāmin parameśvara | tvāṃ vinā rakṣako nānyaścākasmikalayādiha || 18|| vidyate prāṇanātha tvaṃ rakṣa rakṣa mahālayāt | kevayaṃ svargavāsāśca kutrātra gahvare gatāḥ || 19|| na jānīmo vayaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa jagadguro | svargaṃ divyaṃ sarvatejomayaṃ mahati gahvare ||3.3.20|| patitaṃ kiṃ ca vā bhūt sattvaṃ vā nyagiladdhi naḥ | akāle pralayaḥ prāptastasmād rakṣaya rakṣaya ||2 1 || śaraṇaṃ tava yātāḥ smaḥ samarpitāḥ svayaṃ surāḥ | ātmanivedinaste’tra yatheṣṭaṃ kuru naḥ kṛte ||22|| ityevaṃ saṃstutaścāhaṃ brahmaṇāpi ca saṃstutaḥ | tvayā sākaṃ tadā nārāyaṇīśri rohitodare ||23 || indrasya mānasaḥ putraḥ sacakraścābhavaṃ drutam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||24|| tvaṃ tadā mānasī putrī rudrasyāpyabhavaḥ priye | devāḥ pratyakṣatāṃ prāptaṃ māṃ tadā puruṣottamam ||25|| vilokya magnahṛdayāḥ pupūjurhṛdayārpaṇaiḥ | mayā tūrṇaṃ tadā sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ mahat kṛtam ||26|| koṭyaraṃ kartanaṃ rohitāṇḍodarasya varṣmaṇaḥ | mayā muktaṃ karāttūrṇaṃ nyakartayat tadāsuram ||27|| parito bahudhā gatvā bhramitvā ca muhurmuhuḥ | cakrotpanno mahānagniścāsuravarṣmakhaṇḍakān ||28|| koṭidhā tatkartitām̐śca bhasmasāt pracakāra ha | tacca bhasma tadā svarṇaṃ rohitākhyaṃ hyabhūttdā ||29|| rohitāṇḍodaranāśe jāte svasthāḥ surādayaḥ | māṃ viditvākṣareśaṃ śrīmahendrabālakaṃ prabhum ||3.3.3 0|| rakṣakaṃ parameśānaṃ cendrālaye surālaye | mahotsavaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā rudro vai devasākṣike ||31 || maṇḍape tvāṃ nijāṃ putrīṃ mānasīṃ me dadau tadā | ramaṇīṃ daivavidhinā prāptavām̐stvāṃ tadāpyaham ||32|| mama saṃjñā tadā cāsīdanādidyunarāyaṇaḥ | tadā svarga tathā devā yathāvat sthāpitā mayā ||33|| mama yogabalenaiva vikṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ kṛtam | avatārī svayaṃ so’haṃ yo’haṃ cātrāsmi so’bhavam ||34|| smara raudri priye tatra līlā me tava yoginīḥ | me’vatārāstatra varṣe pratyahaṃ bahavo’bhavan ||35|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ cādyaṃ janma me mānasaṃ tadā | atha dvitīyaṃ janmāpi dvitīye vatsare śṛṇu || 36|| nālakramābhidhe varṣe brahmaṇaḥ prathame’hani | tṛtīyasya manorante merurnāmnā hi parvataḥ ||37|| caturdaśastarāṇāṃ vai bhāreṇa mahatā tadā | ākrānto’bhūttadā pātālādho viveśa vai manāk ||38|| caturdaśastarairyuktaḥ surāsurālayānvitaḥ | nimnabhāvaṃ gate merau bhuvanāni caturdaśa ||39|| bhagnāni meruṇā sākaṃ cādhobhāvaṃ gatāni vai | bhugnāni merupārśveṣu cākṛṣṭāni samantataḥ ||3.3.40 || prajātāni tadā satyaṃ svargaṃ bhūśca rasātalam | sarvaṃ vai budhnabhāvaṃ ca gataṃ cābhūt samantataḥ ||41 || lokālokācalaścāpi prākāro’ṇḍasya sarvataḥ | āntarābhimukhaṃ kṛṣṭo hrasvavalayatāṃ yayau ||42|| tathāpi tasya balato bhugnānyapi sthirāṇi vai | bhuvanānyabhavam̐statra kṣaṇaṃ saṃkucitānyapi |||43 || brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāḥ staṃbhanāśaṃ vilokya ca | brahmāṇḍanāśaṃ matvā tadrakṣārthaṃ parameśvaram ||44|| parabrahma hariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhuṃ tu mām | astuvan parayā bhītyā rakṣārthaṃ merubhūbhṛtaḥ ||45|| brahmāṇḍasyāsya rakṣārthaṃ lokānāmavanāya ca | tvamādhāro’si sarveṣāṃ brahmāṇḍānāṃ pareśvara ||46 || sarvasṛṣṭisthairyaśaktistvayyeva vartate prabho | tavāntarvartamānatvāt sthiraṃ sarvaṃ pravidyate ||47|| bhagavan bhavadutpannaṃ tvadādhāraṃ samastakam | tvayā hīnaṃ layaṃ ceyāt trāhi nāśābhisannidheḥ ||48|| vinā staṃbhaṃ gṛhaṃ naiva tiṣṭhedaṇḍaṃ tathā tvidam | meruṃ vinā bhuvanāni tiṣṭheyurnaiva cāmbare ||49|| merurmūle viśatyeva bhārākrāntaḥ starānvitaḥ | vayaṃ nāśagatāḥ syāma rakṣaṃ meruṃ tadāśrayam ||3.3.50 || itistutvā kṣaṇaṃ dhyānaṃ cakrurmama sureśvarāḥ | ahaṃ lakṣmi tvayā sākaṃ tūrṇaṃ cākṣaradhāmataḥ ||51|| samāyayau satyaloke vedhasaḥ sannidhau drutam | surāṇāṃ paśyatāṃ tatra vedhasoṃ’kerbhako’bhavam ||52|| ujjvalaḥ koṭisūryābhaḥ sajaṭaḥ sarvabhūṣaṇaḥ | hasannaṃke samuvāca vedhasaṃ pitarityaham ||53 || sa māṃ putreti sambodhya māyayā cāgrahīt sutam | devā natvā hariṃ matvā puṣpādyaiḥ parameśvaram ||54|| māmānarcuḥ stavaṃ cakruḥ rakṣetyūcuḥ punaḥ punaḥ | anādiśrīmerunārāyaṇanāmā suto’pyaham ||55|| tūrṇaṃ tvāṃ paramāṃ śaktiṃ kṛtvā meroḥ pradhāriṇīm | mama rūpe’tisampannāṃ līnāṃ kṛtvātisatvaram ||56|| devān brahmādikān nītvā saha pātālamāyayau | merumūlaṃ pṛthivyāṃ yannihitaṃ tadapūjayam ||57|| tvāṃ prapūjya mahānārāyaṇīśri cādideśa ha | atra śaktisvarūpā tvaṃ viśeti sahasā tadā ||58|| tvaṃ praviṣṭā mahāśaktirmayā sṛṣṭā mayānvitā | mayā merustadā devaiḥ sākaṃ mūle samuddhṛtaḥ ||59|| uttolito’tibalibhiḥ sākaṃ brahmādibhiḥ saha | yathāpekṣa tato meruśconnatiṃ pragato’bhavat ||3.3.60|| bhuvanāni samastāni samasūtratalāni ca | babhūvurvāsayogyāni devādyāḥ sukhino’bhavan ||61 || tvayā lakṣmi nijacchāyātmikayā dhṛtisaṃjñayā | tadārabhya dhṛtaścāyaṃ merurmūle ciraṃ sadā ||62|| ahaṃ viveśa ca tatra merau dhāraṇarūpavān | ambarākarṣaṇarūpo’ntarātmā merugarbhagaḥ ||63|| evaṃ merau paraṃ kṛtvā sthairyaṃ tataḥ surādibhiḥ | saha mūlāni lokānāṃ merulagnāni vīkṣya ca ||64|| sulagnāni tadā kṛtvā sthirāṇyāsthāya vai kramāt | rasātalāttathā mahātalāt talātalāttathā ||65|| sutalād vitalāccāpi tathātalād bhuvaṃ prati | ājagāma tvayā sākaṃ bhuvaḥ svaśca maharjanam ||66|| tapaḥ satyaṃ paraṃ gatvā cājaputraḥ sthiro’bhavam | anādiśrīmerunārāyaṇo’haṃ vedhasaḥ sutaḥ ||67|| meruputryā tvayā sākaṃ surādibhirvivāhitaḥ | ākalpāntaṃ tadā cāsaṃ sarvarakṣaṇahetave ||68|| avatārī svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ | avatārāstadā varṣe kalpe kalpe mamābhavan ||69|| aneke kāryavaśagā yatpāro naiva vidyate | mahānārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ smara svatsaṃbhava tadā ||3.3.70|| mamāpi saṃbhavaṃ merunārāyaṇātmakaṃ śubham | athānye vatsare lakṣmi tṛtīye vedhaso’pi ca ||71 || kathayāmi janurme’tra śṛṇu kṛṣṇanarāyaṇi | nālordhvavatsare cādye kalpe manau tṛtīyake ||72|| nārāyaṇi tadā svarge bhūtale sūryamaṇḍalam | aśātitaṃ tu lokānāṃ bhasmasāt kārakaṃ hyabhūt ||73|| lakṣaraśmiyutaṃ cāsīd dāhakaṃ sarvatomukham | diśāṃ vidiśāṃ lokānāṃ grahāṇāṃ sṛṣṭidehinām ||74|| bhūtalānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ samudrāṇāṃ ca dāhakam | bhuvaḥsthānāṃ vāyavīyasṛṣṭīnāṃ dāhakaṃ hyabhūt ||75|| lokālokasyāpi merordāhakaṃ vanavāsinām | nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca tārāṇāṃ dāhakaṃ janavāsinām ||76|| maharlokanivāsānāṃ tathordhvavāsināmapi | samantato’bhavaccāpi dāhakaṃ bhasmasātkaram ||77|| taddāhaduḥkhamāsādya manavo devatāstathā | sarvalokanivāsāśca tuṣṭuvurvedhasaṃ tadā ||78|| brahmā stutiṃ samākarṇya yayau sūryasya śāntaye | so’pi dagdhaḥ parāvṛtya satyalokaṃ yayau tadā ||79|| śaṃkaro vai mahāśāntiṃ kartuṃ yayau raviṃ prati | so’pi dagdho namaskṛtya parāvṛtyākriyo’bhavat ||3.3.80|| tato viṣṇustathā devā militvā parameśvaram | tuṣṭuvurmāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||81 || sūryatejaḥpraśāntyarthaṃ namaścakruḥ punaḥpunaḥ | koṭisūryapraṇetastvaṃ bhagavan parameśvara ||82|| jagaccakṣurjagatprabhāprada sūryāt prarakṣaya | vayaṃ trilokavāsāśca tathānye cordhvavāsinaḥ ||83|| dagdhā bhavāmaḥ sūryasyānalairlakṣaprasarpibhiḥ | tvayā kṛtaṃ jagat sarvaṃ saprakāśaṃ sukhārthakam ||84|| tadyadi syād dagdhabhasma kiṃ sūryasya prayojanam | tasmād rakṣaya deveśa taptān śāntān vidhehi naḥ ||85|| ityuktvā pradaduḥ pūjāṃ bahvīṃ me’rpaṇarūpiṇīm | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya paramātmane ||86|| tadāhaṃ kamale sākaṃ tvayā tūrṇaṃ narāyaṇaḥ | akṣarādāyayau satyaṃ brahmasthānaṃ tataḥ param ||87|| devaiḥ sampūjitaścāhaṃ viṣṇoraṃke’bhavaṃ sutaḥ | sahasrahastakaḥ saumyaḥ kirīṭakuṇḍalādimān ||88|| śāṇaśastrādiyuktaśca sudhāmṛtaghaṭādimān | sudarśanaṃ mayā tatra śāṇātmakaṃ kṣaṇāt kṛtam ||89|| sarvāgniśāmakaṃ sudhāmṛtaṃ śātanaśaktikam | mayā lakṣmi tadājñaptā tvaṃ devī śātanī bhava ||3.3.90|| sūrye praviśya ca tatrāmṛtaṃ dhāraya śātani | auṣṇyaṃ yadvad bhavennyūnaṃ tathā vidhehi satvaram ||9 1|| tvaṃ cājñāṃ me samādāya tūrṇaṃ vahnisvarūpiṇī | mahātejomayī bhūtvārbudatāpakarī satī ||92|| amṛtaṃ ca samādāya praviṣṭā sūryamaṇḍalam | śanaiḥ sudhāṃ ca tadgarbhe sannihitavatī tataḥ ||93|| śanaiḥ śanaiḥ kiraṇāni śāntimāptāni vai raveḥ | tvama ca śanaiḥ śanaistatra svaṃ tejaḥ samupāharaḥ ||94|| tataścāhaṃ tava rūpe śāṇe yantre raviṃ tadā | dhṛtvā tejo’titīkṣṇām̐śca pradeśānapyaśātayam ||95|| sarvān vibhidya taddeśān devādibhyastadādadam | te cakruścāyudhānyeva cāvyāhatāni vai tadā ||96|| sūryo mayā kṛtastatra sahasrāṃśuḥ sukhapradaḥ | anyeṃ’śavastvayā lakṣmi līnīkṛtāḥ svavarṣmaṇi ||97|| tata ārabhya sūryaḥ sa lokasampatkaro’bhavat | sā tvaṃ tataśca tatputrī saurī śātanikābhidhā ||98|| abhavaḥ sā mayā viṣṇuputreṇa sūryaśātinā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇenāpi vivāhitā ||99|| kalpāntaṃ cāvasastatra smara tvaṃ tanmayā saha | āsīnnārāyaṇīśri yat sūryakarmābhavaṃ prabhuḥ ||3.3.1 0 0|| parabrahma svayaṃ sūryakarmāhaṃ cābhavaṃ priye | evaṃ tatrāpi varṣe cāvatārā mama koṭiśaḥ || 101 || sañjātā dharmaguptyarthaṃ rakṣārthaṃ dehināṃ tathā | avatārī svayaṃ prokto’nādiviṣṇunarāyaṇaḥ || 1 02|| tṛtīyaṃ mama vai lakṣmi prākaṭyaṃ tatra vatsare | jānāmyahaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ hastāmalakavat priye || 10 3|| māṃ bhajitvā tadā muktiṃ gatā hyasaṃkhyadehinaḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktirmuktirbhavettathā || 1 04|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ prathame varṣe’nādiśrīdyunārāyaṇasya rohiṇāṇḍodarāsuranigalitasvargarakṣārtham, dvitīye varṣe svabhāreṇa nimajjato merordhāraṇārtham anādimerunārāyaṇasya, tṛtīye varṣe dāhayato raveḥ śātanārtham anādiviṣṇunārāyaṇasya, ca prākaṭyamitinirūpaṇanāmā tṛtīyo’dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||
<3.4> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ caturthaṃ mama vartanam | candrarakṣākaraṃ svarge gāyatāṃ mokṣadaṃ param || 1 || stāvane vatsare’jasya kalpe caturthake tadā | dvādaśe ca manau vartamāne’suro’tidāruṇaḥ || 2 || dhūmro nāmnābhavad raudraḥ śaṃbhormastakapṛṣṭhataḥ | samutpanno vyomadeho’ntarīkṣago bhayaṃkaraḥ || 3 || śaṃbhorlalāṭe bhāvantaṃ dṛṣṭvā kāntamayaṃ maṇim | spardhāṃ kṛtvā yayau vyomni cāvāptuṃ vai niśāmaṇim || 4 || candramasaṃ samāhartuṃ yatnaṃ tadākarod bahum | candreṇa vāryamāṇaḥ sa niśitaiḥ śastrahetibhiḥ || 5 || nipapātāmbarādadrau śvetaśṛṃgābhidhe tadā | śaṃbhumuddiśya ca tapaḥ śaṃbhuputro’karottataḥ || 6 || nirāhāro’bhavattvekayugaṃ tato hi śaṃkaraḥ | prasannaḥ prāha dhūmraṃ taṃ putraṃ mastakapṛṣṭhajam || 7 || vada kiṃ rocate te’dya kathaṃ tapasi vartase | vadeṣṭaṃ pradadāmyeva mā kṛthāstapa ugrakam || 8 || ityuktaścāsuraḥ prāha varaṃ dehi jayāvaham | candraṃ jeṣyāmyayatnena tathecchāmi na cetarat || 9 || tathāstviti haraḥ prāha dadau dhūmrāya śūlakam | apradhṛṣyamavināśyaṃ cakrāccāpi bale’dhikam || 3.4.1 0|| tadādāya tu dhūmraḥ sa mervadriṃ prathamaṃ yayau | sārvabhaumajayaṃ kartuṃ tṛṣṇātantuprapreritaḥ || 11 || meruvāsān surān jitvā pṛthvyāṃ jetuṃ nṛpān yayau | jitvā bhūmau bhūbhṛtaśca pātālān prayayau tataḥ || 12|| daityānnāgānkacchapām̐śca makarānmatsyakām̐stathā | nakrān jitvā phaṇadhrām̐śca jitvā yayāvaraṇyakam || 1 3|| vidyādharām̐śca gandharvān jitvā ca kinnarām̐stataḥ | guhyakān cāraṇān jitvā yayau saṃyamanīṃ purīm || 14|| yamadūtām̐stadā jitvā yuyudhe sa yamena vai | yamo daṇḍena kālenāsuraḥ śūlena vai mithaḥ || 15|| yuyudhāte tu naikasya parājayo’tra vidyate | yamena saṃsmṛto rudro’sureṇa saṃsmṛto haraḥ || 16|| hararudrau samāyātau madhyasthau sambabhūvatuḥ | vārayāmāsatustau ca yayatuḥ śaṃsitau gṛham || 17|| athāsuro garvayukto yayau cendraṃ divaspatim | indro jñātvā mahādevadattaṃ śūlamajayyakam || 18|| utthāya saumyabhāvena satkāraṃ kṛtavān śubham | asurāya dadau ramyaṃ hāraṃ maṇyabhinirmitam || 19|| pūjayāmāsa ca śaṃbhoḥ śūlaṃ bahuvidhānataḥ | asuro’pi vinā roṣaṃ mṛdurbhūtvā vilokya tat ||3.4.20|| yayau sūryaṃ vijetuṃ ca sūryaścāstaṃ drutaṃ yayau | yayau tadāsuro’jaṃ ca vijetuṃ parameṣṭhinam ||21 || brahmā jñātvā śāṃbhavaṃ tat triśūlaṃ sampupūja ha | madhuparkaṃ dadau cāpyasurāya mānanaṃ dadau ||22|| dhūmrastvāsanamāsādya sauvarṇaṃ bahuśobhanam | mumude ca mṛdurbhūtvā natvājaṃ prayayau divam ||23|| candraṃ dṛṣṭvā pūrṇabhāsaṃ yayau taṃ prati satvaram | sadā candrastatra cāsīnnīrogaḥ sakalaḥ sadā ||24|| ekarūpaḥ kṣayavṛddhivarjitaḥ śāśvataḥ sukhaḥ | grahagrāsādihīnaśca pūrṇakalaḥ samantataḥ || 25|| tādṛśaṃ pūrṇapīyūṣaṃ gatvā dhūmro bhayānakam | śatacandrāyataṃ rūpaṃ kṛtvā jagrāha pāṇinā ||26||| sparśaiḥ sudhāmṛtānāṃ tu kiraṇānāṃ mahāsuraḥ | sukhaṃ mahānandabhṛtaṃ hyavāpāpūrvamuttamam || 27|| ataścandre jātalobho jagrāsa śaśinaṃ mukhe | hāhākāro mahānāsīt svarge pṛthvyāṃ samantataḥ || 28|| amṛtasya nidhānaṃ vai śītatejobhṛtaṃ maṇim | tajjyotsnāmanavāpyaivauṣadhayo’tivijīvanāḥ || 29|| mṛtaprāyā abhavam̐śca devāścāmṛtavarjitāḥ | kiraṇādhārajīvāśca sarve maraṇaśālinaḥ || 3.4.3 0|| tadā jātāścātha devāḥ svaguroḥ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ | sadaspatirdevaguruścāstaut māṃ parameśvaram || 31 || candrasya rakṣaṇārthāya lokarakṣaṇahetave | namo devādhidevāya sūryacandrapracakṣuṣe || 32|| sarvāntaryāmiṇe rakṣākarāya paramātmane | puruṣottamasaṃjñāya sudhāpradāya śārṅgiṇe ||33|| grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ bhāskarāya mahātmane | namaścāntaravedyāya cābhaktakṣayakāriṇe ||34|| samāyāhi hare śīghraṃ rakṣāṃ tvaṃ śaśinaḥ kuru | mahādevo dhyānamagnaścirakārī virājate ||35|| śīghraṃ dhūmrād rakṣa muktapate śrīparameśvara | stutaścaivaṃ tadā cāhaṃ nārāyaṇīśri satvaram || 36|| tvayā sākaṃ tvājagāma devagurorgṛhaṃ divi | drāgevādṛśyarūpo’pi tadaṅge mānasaḥ sutaḥ || 37|| samabhavaṃ subālo’haṃ sarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmaśūlaśaktiśarāyudhaḥ || 38|| vajradhanurdaṇḍapāśakhaṅgacarmavirājitaḥ | tvaṃ tadā tu mayājñaptā praviṣṭā cāsurodare || 39|| candramasi sthirā jātā cāndrī kalāprarakṣiṇī | tvadbalādvai tadā lakṣmi candro mūrcchāṃ na cāptavān ||3.4.40|| nāpi tejovihīnaśca nāpi cāmṛtavarjitaḥ | nāpi saṃpācito garbhe dhūmrāsureṇa vahninā ||41 || evamevābhavadgarbhe yathāpūrvaṃ tathābhavat | athāha pūjito devairdevagurvaṃkaśobhitaḥ ||42|| prārthito’suranāśārthaṃ jagāmāhaṃ mahāsuram | devasainyena sahito yuyudhe candraghātinā || 43|| tadā lakṣmi mayājñaptā kanyārūpābhavaḥ kṣaṇam | asuro dhūmrasaṃjño’pi tvāṃ vilokya mumoha ca ||44|| śūlaṃ visṛjya ca kṣaṇaṃ tvāṃ dhartuṃ yatnamācarat | tvayā śūlaṃ tadā grastaṃ mamājñayā hi śāṃkaram ||45|| mayā cakreṇa vai śīghraṃ hato’suraḥ sahasradhā | dhūmro vināśamāpanno bhasmasādabhavattadā ||46|| candraḥ pūrṇakalastatra nirjagāmodarād bahiḥ | tvaṃ ca śūladharī cāndrī kanyā nāmnā tu kaumudī ||47|| vardhitā sarvadevādyaiḥ pūjitā parameśvarī | ahaṃ sarvaiḥ pūjitaśca vardhito vanditastathā ||48|| devaguroḥ sutaścāhaṃ bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ | candramasā harirjñātvā vanditaḥ pūjitastathā ||49|| kanyā tvaṃ kaumudīnāmnī dattā mahyaṃ tadā priye | mayā vivāhitā tvaṃ ca devagurorgṛhoṣiṇā ||3.4.50|| anādiśrīdevanārāyaṇanāmnā narāyaṇi | tataḥ sasmāra śaṃbhuṃ ca devagurorgṛhe’pyaham ||51 || śaṃbhustūrṇaṃ samāyāto jñātvā māṃ parameśvaram | dhūmrāsuraṃ vinaṣṭaṃ ca jñātvā mumoda vai haraḥ ||52|| triśūlaṃ pradadau śaṃbhuścandramase hi śāśvatam | pitā tubhyaṃ dadau śūlaṃ yautakaṃ śāśvataṃ śivam ||53|| tvayā mahyaṃ pradattaṃ ca mayā haste surekhakam | kṛtaṃ dhṛtaṃ sarvadaiva paśya dakṣe kare mama ||54|| triśūlaṃ rekhitaṃ cāste prākaṭyaṃ yāti cecchayā | smara lakṣmi tava prākaṭyaṃ ca me’pi tadābhavam ||55|| avatārī svayaṃ cāsaṃ tadā devanarāyaṇaḥ | avatārāstadā me’pyāsam̐śca koṭisahasraśaḥ |||56|| ākalpāntaṃ cābhavaṃ vai tvayā sākaṃ gurorgṛhe | athājasya pañcame vatsare yo’haṃ tadābhavam ||57|| ādye kalpe cādyamanau tvaṃ cābhavaḥ kathāṃ śṛṇu | vyomabāṇābhidhe varṣe prākkalpe prathame manau ||58|| vidyamāne brahmaputrā maharṣayo’jasaṃsadi | saṃhatāśca pracakrurvai vicāraṃ vedavādinaḥ |||59|| brahmāṇḍe bhūtalaṃ karmabhūmiḥ phalapradāsti yat | tatra kṛtaṃ dehibhirvai dattaṃ dānaṃ vṛṣādikam ||3.4.60|| anyalokagataiḥ sarvaiḥ prāpyate bhojanādikam | bhūtale yatpradattaṃ ca jalānnāmbarabhūṣaṇam ||61|| kṣetravāṭīrūpyakanyāsuvarṇagṛhasādhanam | havyaṃ kavyaṃ baliḥ puṇyaṃ vrataṃ śrāddhaṃ sahāyakam ||62|| sarvaṃ lokāntare dātrā kartrāpyate’yutottaram | yathā jīvanti sannyāsā vānaprasthāśca naiṣṭhikāḥ ||63|| gārhasthyamupasaṃlambya tathālambya kṣitau kṛtam | jīvanti svargadevāśca pitaraśca maharṣayaḥ ||64|| sukṛtaṃ tad yajñakāryaṃ jīvanaṃ sarvadehinām | viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ yatra devānāṃ havyamityapi ||65|| śrāddhaṃ ca pitṛdevānāmṛṣīṇāṃ puṇyamityapi | soma sudhāmṛtaṃ bhojyaṃ yajñe sarvaṃ hi labhyate ||66|| tasmād yajñaḥ prakartavyaḥ śikṣaṇīyaḥ kriyātmakaḥ | mānavebhyo bhūdevebhyaḥ kriyāsantānahetave ||67|| kratutantau samārabdhe sandhite yojite kṛte | yajñānāṃ sampracāreṇa jīvanaṃ syānnirāmayam ||68|| tasmād gacchāma evādya maharṣayo hi bhūtalam | devān pitṝn saha nītvācariṣyāmaḥ kratūttamam ||69|| itisammantrya munayaḥ pitaraśca sureśvarāḥ | āyayurbhūtalaṃ lakṣmi yajñārthaṃ merusannidhau ||3.4.70|| pālāśāraṇyake sarve svargaṃgāyāstaṭe sthitāḥ | prayatante sma yajñārthaṃ bhinnakarmaniyojitāḥ ||71 || prathamo’yaṃ yato yajñaḥ kramaṃ jānanti naiva te | na kaścit sarvayajñānāmabhyāsī karmagocaraḥ ||72|| yathākramaviniryoktā deve pitari bhūsure | maharṣau vā tadā tatrābhavat karmakramābhivit ||73|| tataste mohamāpannāḥ karmakāṇḍāpravedinaḥ | idaṃ pūrvamidaṃ pūrvamevamāgrahiṇo’bhavan ||74|| aniścitte kratukrame tadaṃgānāṃ krame’pi ca | vedhaḥputro brahmakumārākhyau naiṣṭhikaśīlavān ||75|| yajamānaṃ cāha tatra jyotiṣmannāmakaṃ manum | vayaṃ sarve karmakāṇḍe hyapūrvagocarāḥ khalu ||76|| viguṇe tu phalaṃ yajñe viparītaṃ bhavediti | yajñadraṣṭā yajñavaktā nānyo nārāyaṇaṃ vinā ||77|| parabrahmākṣarātītaṃ śrīhariṃ puruṣottamam | tamevārādhayāmo’tra saṃhatya kramahetave ||78|| sa cāgatya kratuṃ sarvaṃ śikṣayiṣyati yajñakṛt | yajñadevaḥ sa yajñātmā yajñajño yajñakārakaḥ ||79|| ityukto vai manuścānye svīcakrustadvacastataḥ | parameśaṃ militvaivārādhayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||3.4.80|| maharṣayaśca pitaro devatā bhūsurādayaḥ | oṃ namo yajñarūpāya parameśāya karmiṇe ||8 1|| yajñadevāya yajñāya yajñajñāya kratukṛte | yajñaśāstre’dhvarakāryakāriṇe paramātmane ||82|| namo’ntaryāmiṇe naśca sāhāyyadāya śārṅgiṇe | ityastuvan surādyā māṃ yajñārthaṃ puruṣottamam ||83|| tadāhaṃ tu tvayā sākaṃ śrutvākṣare’pi cārthanām | agacchaṃ gāṃgatīraṃ vai meroḥ pālāśakṛdvanam ||84|| brahmakumāranikaṭe bālo’hamṛṣiveṣadhṛk | sarvavidyāmayaḥ sarvamantradraṣṭā niyogavān ||85|| yāvadvidhipravīṇo’haṃ yāvatpātradharo dvijaḥ | sarvakramābhivettā ca sarvadravyādibodhavān ||86|| dvitīyo vai yathā brahmā tathā prakaṭito’bhavam | sarve dṛṣṭvā tu māṃ vipraṃ koṭibhāskarabhāsuram ||87|| sahasotthāya nemurmāṃ kastvaṃ papracchurutsukāḥ | adhvaro’haṃ hi bhagavān bhavadārādhanāphalam ||88|| ityuktvāhaṃ bālarūpo brahmakumārakāṅkagaḥ | abhavaṃ putrabhāvenābhāvayat so’pi māṃ tathā ||89|| tvaṃ tadā cāviśo jyotiṣmanmanau bhūyasī satī | athāhaṃ ca samāśvāsya sarvān yajñārthakarmasu ||3.4.90|| niyujya kramavāraṃ tān prāvartayaṃ kratuṃ tadā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ parameśvaraḥ ||91|| anādiśrīyajñanārāyaṇo bhūtvā vyadhāpayam | avabhṛthāntaṃ yajñaṃ taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ sārvabhaumikam ||92|| adhvaro’haṃ manostasmād yayāce dakṣiṇāṃ tadā | bhūyasīṃ yajñabhūmau vai maṇḍape vedikāntike ||93|| tadā tvaṃ kanyakā nāmnā bhūyasī dakṣiṇābhidhā | prādurabhavaḥ kalyāṇi kanyakā vai madarthinī ||94|| manorjyotiṣmataḥ putrī nārāyaṇī hi bhūyasī | adhvare’mbarabhūṣāḍhyā koṭisvarṇadhanānvitā ||95|| madyogyā yācamānāya mahyaṃ vai manunārpitā | tata ārabhya tadvarṣe sahasrakalpakātmake ||96|| mayādiṣṭaprakāreṇādhvarāḥ sarve pravartitāḥ | kalpāyuścābhavam̐statra tvayā sākaṃ mahādhvaraḥ ||97|| yajñanārāyaṇaḥ so’haṃ cānādiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | avatārī svayaṃ svāmī parabrahma pareśvaraḥ ||98|| bhūyasī dakṣiṇānāmnī tvaṃ me patnī tadābhavaḥ | smara nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ tatkalpaṃ taṃ ca vatsaram ||99|| tato’nye me’vatārāśca tatrābhavan hi koṭiśaḥ | vedmi sarvānahaṃ lakṣmi nānye smaranti tānapi || 3.4.1 00|| sarvayajñasvarūpo’smi sarve yajñā mayi sthitāḥ | sarvayajñā mūrtayo me sarvayajñapravartakaḥ || 101 || bhoktā sarveṣu yajñeṣu sarvādhvaraphalapradaḥ | sarvakriyākalāpajñaścāhaṃ bhavāmi cādhvare || 10 2|| tvāṃ vinā naiva tiṣṭhāmi daive paitrye tathārṣake | mānave vā vidhau lakṣmi dāne’rhaṇe ca pūjane || 10 3|| jape vrate krame jñāne sākaṃ tvayā vṛṣe’pi ca | upatiṣṭhāmi deveśi śiveśvari na cānyathā || 104|| ityevaṃ cādhvaraṃ janma kathitaṃ vai tvayā saha | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi mahādhvaraphalaṃ bhavet || 1 05|| tavāpi smaraṇāllakṣmi bhūyasīdakṣiṇāphalam | sampatsiddhirbhavedatra paratra mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 10 6|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaścaturthavatsare dhūmrāsuranāśārthaṃ candrarakṣārtham anādidevanārāyaṇasya, pañcamavatsare’dhvaratantusampādanārtham anādiyajñanārāyaṇasya ca prākaṭyamitinirūpaṇanāmā caturtho’dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
<3.5> puruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ ṣaṣṭhe tāpasavatsare | vedhaso’sya dvitīye kalpake ca prathame manau || 1 || prākaṭyaṃ tava rudrācca mamāpi brahmato’bhavat | pratikalpaṃ trilokīnāmutpattistatra jāyate || 2 || utpādako’tra vai brahmā sāyaṃ saṃhārako haraḥ | poṣaṇasya prakartā tu viṣṇustatra sadā mataḥ || 3 || kintu taṃ niyamaṃ tyaktvā rudro devo maheśvaraḥ | brahmāṇamāha mā sṛṣṭiṃ kuru tvaṃ yat karomyaham || 4 || sāyaṃkālasya kāryaṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇa lokasaṃhṛtim | na me tad rocate brahman saṃhārākhyaṃ hi karma yat || 5 || yogināṃ mādṛśānāṃ tanmahad duḥkhaṃ vivekinām | saṃhṛtirnahi yogyā me hiṃsātmikātinirghṛṇā || 6 || satāṃ dharmo na vai hiṃsā paraduḥkhapradātṛtā | paraduḥkhāsahiṣṇutve mama hiṃsā na rocate || 7 || api kāyena manasā necchāmi parahiṃsanam | kutaśca karmaṇā kurve pāpakṛt karma bhīṣaṇam || 8 || apadebhyaḥ sapadānāṃ hiṃsā pāpādhikānvitā | sapadeṣvapi likṣāṇāṃ makṣikāṇāṃ tato’dhikā || 9 || caṭakānāṃ ca gṛdhrāṇāṃ garuḍānāṃ tato’dhikā | śvādīnāṃ gomahiṣāṇāmuṣṭrāṇāṃ kariṇāṃ tataḥ || 3.5.1 0|| nāgānāṃ ca piśācānāṃ bhūtānāṃ ca tato’dhikā | daityānāṃ rakṣasāṃ hiṃsā dānavānāṃ tato’dhikā || 11 || sūtamāgadhabandīnāṃ bhṛtyānāṃ ca śvapākinām | mānavānāṃ ca viprāṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ ca tato’dhikā || 12|| kanyakānāṃ kumārāṇāṃ bālānāṃ ca satāṃ tathā | yogināṃ cāpi bhaktānāṃ sādhūnāṃ brahmacāriṇām || 13|| sagarbhāṇāṃ sūtikānāṃ satīnāṃ ca tato’dhikā | tīrthānāṃ cāpi caityānāṃ pratimānāṃ tato’dhikā || 14|| mandirāṇāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca devānāṃ ca tato’dhikā | mumukṣūṇāṃ tāpasānāṃ hiṃsā pāpādhikā tathā || 15|| yajñīyānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca gurūṇāṃ ca tato’dhikā | vedānāṃ cāpi śāstrāṇāṃ hiṃsanaṃ sarvato’dhikam || 16|| haryeśānāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ hiṃsanaṃ ca tato’dhikam | ityeṣāṃ pāpavistāro hiṃsātmā me na rocate || 17|| kariṣye’haṃ sarjanaṃ vai kuru tvaṃ vai visarjanam | ciraṃ mayā kṛtaṃ visarjanaṃ tvayā prasarjanam || 18|| āyatau tvaṃ vidhehyeva visarjanaṃ na sarjanam | ahaṃ sadā kariṣye sarjanaṃ na tu visarjanam || 19|| ityuktaśca tadā lakṣmi brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | śaṃkaraṃ prāha mā maivaṃ tvādṛśo hiṃsako’smi na ||3.5.20|| śreṣṭhaṃ kāryaṃ vihāyaiva kaḥ kaniṣṭhe viśejjanaḥ | brāhmaṇo’haṃ na tatkartuṃ śaknomyatra kadācana ||21 || rudrasya tava kāryaṃ tat krūrasya nirghṛṇasya ca | brāhmaṇā dayayā yuktā na niṣādāḥ kadāpi vai || 22|| mayā naiṣādikaṃ kāryaṃ manasāpi na manyate | jālaṃ pāśo ghātanaṃ ca kartanaṃ kūrcanaṃ tathā ||23|| vidalanaṃ rodhanaṃ ca naiṣādikaṃ hi tadbhavet | dāhanaṃ bhedanaṃ cāpi peṣaṇaṃ prāṇakarṣaṇam ||24|| māraṇaṃ pāpakarmaitanme na śaṃbho prarocate | nāhaṃ tatra kṛtaprajño bhavām̐stat kartumarhati ||25|| ityuktaḥ śaṃkaro lakṣmi raudrabhāvamupāgataḥ | asahamāno vākyāni jagrāha vedhasaṃ gale ||26 || nyapātayat kṣitau tatrottānaṃ vai vedhase haraḥ | pādaṃ datvā balād vakṣasyeva śūlaṃ gale nyadhāt ||27|| hāhākāro mahānāsīttadā trailokyavāsiṣu | brahmaṇo’dya vināśo vai bhaviṣyatīti menire ||28|| ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā jaḍāśca cetanā api | cakampire rudraroṣānmadhyasthaḥ ko’pi nāgamat ||29|| bhayaṃ gato’pi viṣṇuścānyasya tatra tu kā kathā | brahmā sasmāra māṃ tatra trātāraṃ parameśvaram ||3.5.30|| akṣarānmama vai sthānāttūrṇaṃ tatra samāyayau | tvayā sārdhaṃ tadā lakṣmi śūlaṃ jagrāha pāṇinā ||31|| tvamādiṣṭā praveṣṭuṃ ca hare śāntikarī satī | hararoṣo’bhavacchāntastavāveśāttadā priye || 32|| vivedākāryamevaitannamro māṃ vīkṣya lajjitaḥ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||33|| koṭisūryasamābhāsaṃ sarvābhūṣaṇabhūṣitam | sarveśvaraṃ dhṛtaśūlaṃ brahmarakṣākaraṃ prabhum ||34|| akasmādāgataṃ śāntaṃ sarvāntaranivāsinam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīparameśvaram ||35|| brahmaṇo vakṣasi nyastaḥ śaṃbhupādo mayā tadā | śūlaṃ ca mama hastābhyāmuddhṛtau līlayā priye ||36|| śaṃbhuḥ papāta vegenottāno mama balāttadā | pārśve patantaṃ śaṃbhuṃ taṃ devāścālambanaṃ daduḥ ||37|| rakṣa rakṣa harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa pareśvara | ajaṃ rakṣa haraṃ rakṣa rakṣa naḥ śaraṇāgatān ||38|| sarve vayaṃ tava bālāḥ poṣyā rakṣyāḥ sadā tvayā | ityuktvā te nipeturme pādayordaṇḍavat tadā ||39|| puṣpādyairmānasairbhāvaiḥ pupūjurmāṃ dayābhṛtam | parabrahmākṣarātītaṃ brahmavakṣogataṃ harim ||3.5.40|| śaṃkaro’pi ca me bhakto prayayāce kṣamāpanam | mayā śaṃbhubodhitaśca saṃhāre dūṣaṇaṃ na te ||41 || mama śaktisvarūpo’si kartāhaṃ tava rūpavān | mayā sṛṣṭamidaṃ sarvaṃ vijñavedhaḥsvarūpiṇā || 42|| mayā sampuṣyate sarvaṃ dātṛviṣṇusvarūpiṇā | mayā saṃhriyate sarvaṃ hartṛharasvarūpiṇā ||43|| yo’haṃ so’haṃ haro viṣṇurbrahmā bhinnābhidhānvitaḥ | pṛthagbhāvo na bhavatāṃ mama māyā durāsadā ||44|| tayā bhedaṃ gataścāhaṃ mamecchayaiva māyayā | karomi bhedavat sarvaṃ vibhinnaṃ cetaro yathā ||45|| ajñānivacceṣṭayāmi līlā me sārvakālikī |. tatra te dūṣaṇaṃ śaṃbho hiṃsādoṣātmakaṃ na vai ||46|| utpannaṃ syād vinaṣṭaṃ vai svabhāva eṣo vastunaḥ | tatra draṣṭā bhavān rudro vināśe nyāyato mama ||47|| nimittāni pralayādyāḥ kālo yugā niśāstathā | kālasīmā nimittaṃ vai mayā maryādayā kṛtā ||48|| tasmātte dūṣaṇaṃ śaṃbho saṃhāre nāsti sarvathā | ityuktaḥ śaṃkaro lakṣmi mayā svāsthyamupāgataḥ ||49|| kalahaṃ taṃ parityajya sadā saṃhāramānasaḥ | sevate manniyogaṃ vai harate’nte yathoditam ||3.5.50|| athāhaṃ saṃvinīyaiva śaṃbhuṃ brahmasuto’bhavam | anādiśrībrahmanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||51 || tvaṃ ca lakṣmi haradehānniṣkrāntā kanyakā tataḥ | vaiṣṇavī rudraputrī vai mahyaṃ hareṇa cārpitā ||52|| ityevaṃ mama vai tatra prākaṭyaṃ ca tavāpyabhūt | ākalpāntaṃ tataścāhaṃ brahmanārāyaṇo’vasam ||53|| tvayā sākaṃ hi vaiṣṇavyā nārāyaṇīśri tatsmara | evamanye’pyavatārāḥ koṭiśastatra me’bhavan ||54|| na tān śaktāḥ prasaṃkhyātuṃ cānye māmantarā priye | athānye vatsare cāpi prākaṭyaṃ mama saṃśṛṇu ||55|| yamākhye vatsare cādye kalpe cādye manau tathā | devatānāṃ vivādo’bhūd dhiṣṇyārthaṃ svargavāsinām ||56|| ekaḥ prāha mahendrasya padaṃ bhokṣye’hameva ha | cāparaśca tadā prāha sūryo’haṃ nāparo bhavet ||57|| tṛtīyaḥ prāha candro’haṃ turyaḥ prāha dhanī tvaham | kaścit prāha jaleśo’haṃ kaścitprāha maruttvaham ||58|| vasuścāhaṃ devaguruścāhaṃ ceśānadevatā | ahamagnirgaṇeśo’haṃ senānyahaṃ dhruvo’pyaham ||59|| merurmama divaṃ me’pi maruccāhaṃ bhavāmyapi | yamaścāhamahaṃ viṣṇurbhavāmi śaṃkaro’pyaham ||3.5.60|| dikpālo’haṃ lokapālaḥ sādhyo’haṃ saṃbhavāmi vai | viśvadevapadaṃ cāhaṃ bhokṣye pitṛpadaṃ tvaham ||61 || ityevaṃ vadamānānāṃ surāṇāṃ kalaho mithaḥ | varivarti mahānevāśāmyaḥ kenāpi śāsinā | |62|| parasparaṃ tadā lakṣmi balino devasattamāḥ | prasahyeṣṭapadānyeva svāyattokṛtya sarvathā ||63|| sthitavanto nirbalāśca nirādhārāstadābhavan | andharājyaṃ yathā svargaṃ tatrābhavad balārjitam ||64|| sāttvikā devatāścendravasucandrādayastadā | āndhyasya vāraṇārthaṃ vai mimilurvai gurorgṛhe ||65|| kathamāndhyaṃ nivartetetyevaṃ vicāraṇā vyadhuḥ | brahmaṇo vāpi śaṃbhorvā viṣṇorvā vacanāni vai ||66|| amaryādā na manyante devā garvapravegitāḥ | tasmādatra prakartavyaḥ sarveṣāṃ hitakṛd vidhiḥ ||67|| yathā suragururmārgaṃ darśayet kurma eva tam | śrutvaivaṃ tu tadā devānāha suraguruḥ svayam ||68|| dyauḥ sadā devamātā vai devān garbhe prarakṣati | seyaṃ mūrtimatī cāste kurmastat sā vadecca yat ||69|| viṣṇurnāma tathādityo rājate’tra sadasyapi | yathā vadet tathā sarve kurmastadvacanaṃ hitam ||3.5.70 || ityuktau tau namaskṛtya devān sarvānupasthitān | prāhaturnirṇaye cāndhye yogyau nāvāṃ tathāpi vaḥ ||71 || sūcayāvo hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paraṃ brahma sanātanam | ārādhayāmaścātraivādhikārapadada prabhum ||72|| sa eva nirṇayaṃ naśca dāsyatyevākṣarādhipaḥ | yena sampālitaṃ sarvaṃ yena sannoditaṃ tvidam ||73|| yena sañcālitaṃ yāti sa no dāsyati nirṇayam | yena ṛddhiḥ pradattā ca yathākarma yathāguṇam ||74|| yathāsthānaṃ yathaiśvaryaṃ yathādhiṣṇyaṃ padāni ca | ārādhitaḥ samāgatya sa no dāsyati nirṇayam ||75|| ityuktāḥ sarvadevāste prasahya balavādinām | śāsanārthaṃ sasmaruśca parabrahma sanātanam ||76|| akṣareśaṃ bhagavatāṃ bhagavantaṃ pareśvaram | tūrṇaṃ cākṣaradhāmno’haṃ samāyāto mahāprabhuḥ ||77|| tvayā sākaṃ tadā nārāyaṇīśri pareśvaraḥ | devaguroḥ sabhāyāṃ vai viṣṇvākhyādityasannidhau ||78|| divyo divyāmbarabhūṣo divyaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ | koṭicandrārkarūpaśca sabhāmadhye vyavasthitaḥ ||79|| tvamādiṣṭā tadā lakṣmi dyutanau samavasthitā | adṛśyā śāsayitrī tvaṃ sarveṣāṃ hitakāriṇī ||3.5.80|| surā dṛṣṭvā tu māṃ sarveśvareśvareśvareśvaram | praṇatāścāsanaṃ cāpi madhuparkaṃ dadustataḥ ||81|| kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭavām̐ścāhaṃ tebhyaste’pyanivedayan | āndhyaṃ svarge pradhiṣṇyārthaṃ tacchāntiṃ cārthayannapi ||82|| mayā nārāyaṇīśri vai tadā sudarśanāni me | samarthamuktarūpāṇi śāsakāni samantataḥ ||83|| krūrāṇi sāyudhānyeva prahitāni divi priye | yatra yatra surāḥ santi paradhiṣṇyasthitāstadā ||84|| tām̐stānāhūya sarvān vai mama yuktāḥ sudarśanāḥ | dhṛtvā dhṛtvā gurordvāraṃ samāninyurmadantike ||85|| mayā pṛṣṭāścāndhyapravartayitāraśca vai tadā | nocuste lajjitāḥ kiñcit kṣamāṃ matto yayācire ||86|| daṇḍitā vai mayā sarve yamitāśca nije pade | sthāpitāśca yathāyogye pade devā divi sthitāḥ ||87|| sarveṣāmadhikāre vai vyavasthā ca mayā kṛtā | tadā tvaṃ ca mayādiṣṭā sarvaniyāmikā satī ||88|| paradhiṣṇyāyogyapātranirodhinī tadābhavaḥ | aiśvaryaṃ ca mayā lakṣmi tadā tubhyaṃ samarpitam ||89|| dhiṣṇye dhiṣṇye tvayā tatra sthātavyaṃ sarvadā priye | ayogyaścet samāgacchet prasahya padamuttamam ||3.5.90|| anyasyānyastadā lakṣmi tvayā kṣepyo vidūrataḥ | tadārabhya hi deveṣu cānyapade’paraḥ kvacit ||9 1|| upaviṣṭaṃ samartho vai jāyate kṣipyate drutam | evaṃ sarvapadeṣveva tvaṃ tadā saṃsthitā priye ||92|| ahaṃ putro’bhavaṃ viṣṇorādityasya tadā priyaḥ | tvaṃ tataḥ kanyakā jātā dyugarbhā śrīrnarāyaṇī ||93|| dyāvā tadārpitā mahyaṃ tadā tvaṃ dyunarāyaṇī | ahamāsaṃ tadā kalpe’nādyādityanarāyaṇaḥ ||94|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpatiracyutaḥ | ākalpāntaṃ tadādityagṛhe’vasaṃ sutaḥ sadā ||95|| dyuputrī tvaṃ mama patnī devavīthī tadābhavaḥ | ahaṃ smarāmi tatsarvaṃ smara tvaṃ devavīthikām ||96|| parabrahma svayaṃ cāhamabhavaṃ tatra vai sadā | asaṃkhyā me’vatārāśca tatra varṣe’bhavannapi ||97|| evaṃ dhiṣṇyavivādaṃ vai tyaktvā devā yathoditam | svasvadhiṣṇyaṃ gatāḥ sarve vivādapadavarjitāḥ ||98|| tadārabhya punarnaiva padārthaṃ yodhanaṃ kvacit | babhūva tatra varṣe vai tathā kalpāntare’pi ca ||99|| mayā niyamitaṃ sarvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ sthāpitaṃ yathā | tathaiva yāti sukhato viparītaṃ na vai kvacit ||3.5.1 0 0|| ityevaṃ te śivaputri prākaṭyaṃ kīrtitaṃ mama | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 1 01|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ ṣaṣṭhavatsare rudraśāsanārtham anādibrahmanārāyaṇasya, saptamavatsare devānāṃ dhiṣṇyaniyamārtham anādyādityanārāyaṇasya, prākaṭyamiti nirūpaṇanāmā pañcamo’dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||
<3.6> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ tato’pi cāṣṭame punaḥ | ajasya niyamākhye vatsare kalpe tu pañcame || 1 || saptame tu manau vartamāne tatra tadāpyaham | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 2 || mānāvānāṃ sukhārthaṃ vai tadā prakaṭito’bhavam | pātāle tvekadā nāgāḥ kāmarūpadharāḥ priye || 3 || saṃkarṣaṇaṃ prīṇayituṃ mahārudraṃ pracakrire | yajñe tatra mahārudre phaṇādhrāṇā kulāni vai || 4 || dvāpañcāśatsahasrāṇi saṃhatāni tadābhavan | kṛṣṇā raktāstathā citrāḥ śvetāḥ śvitrāśca karburāḥ || 5 || nīlāḥ pītāśca haritāḥ svastikāścandrakāstathā | paṭṭiśā dviphaṇāścāpi triphaṇāśca catuḥphaṇāḥ || 6 || śatānanāstathā nāgāḥ sahasraphaṇino’pare | nāgarājāḥ karkaṭakāḥ śītalā ḍiṇḍimāstathā || 7 || bhūphiṇḍādyāḥ koḍiphāśca pāṇḍurāḥ paṇḍakāstathā | śūlakā daṇḍakāścāpi dvimukhā divyacākṣuṣāḥ || 8 || oṃkārāstilavarṇāśca pāraḍaṅkāḥ kaṇāśanāḥ | tiryagdhārāḥ sūtradhārā mudrapṛṣṭhā dvipṛṣṭhakāḥ || 9 || dvijihvā bahujihvāśca bahudaṃṣṭrā viṣālayāḥ | kālakūṭāḥ samaṇayaḥ kārdamikāśca vārśayāḥ || 3.6.1 0|| ānalikāścānilakā mārucchrayāḥ sapakṣakāḥ | ugrakāḥ śāntadāsāśca māhālasyā viḍambinaḥ || 11 || ityevaṃ bahujātīyāḥ kaṇādhrāḥ saṃhatāstadā | saṃkarṣaṇaṃ yajñadevaṃ nijeṣṭaṃ cānalānanam || 12|| ījire toṣayāmāsurmiṣṭāhutibhirutsukāḥ | sahasradivasaṃ naijaṃ yajñaṃ niyamato vyadhuḥ || 13 || gurusteṣāṃ svastiko’bhūt śeṣo’bhūnnṛpatistadā | agragaṇyo yajamānaścānye puṇyāśca ṛtvijaḥ || 14|| pātālīyāni miṣṭāni sāmudrāṇi rasāni ca | phalānyāraṇyajanmāni pārthivānyadanāni ca || 15|| kaṇām̐śca sasyajām̐ścāpi kandām̐ścauṣadhiśākhinaḥ | samidhaśca vividhā vai gundrāṇi vividhāni ca || 1 6|| bhūvikārāṇi sarvāṇi bhojyāni havyakāni ca | vratādanāni yogyāni juhuvustatra cādhvare || 17|| saṃkarṣaṇo mahādevo nijamaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ | pātālīyasurāḍhyaśca gāruḍaiḥ surakoṭibhiḥ || 18|| surāṇībhiśca sahitastṛptiṃ parāṃ makhe yayau | pratyakṣo’bhūd rudrarūpadharastatrāntime dine || 19|| pūrṇāhutau pāyasādyairvṛtaistilaiśca piṣṭakaiḥ | miṣṭarasaiḥ kriyamāṇāyāṃ kaṭvoṣadhibhistadā ||3.6.20|| prasanno’smītyāha sarpān tṛpto’smīti punaḥ punaḥ | varaṃ vṛṇudhvaṃ sukhino bhavantvityāha tānpunaḥ ||21 || tadā rājā prajādyāste sarpā yayācire tataḥ | vayaṃ vai mānave loke bhavāmo rājyabhāginaḥ ||22|| karma kṛtvā prayāsyāmo muktiṃ svargaṃ paraṃ layam | dehyevaṃ varadānaṃ cet prasanno’si sukarṣaṇaḥ ||23|| varayogyāḥ sma ca viṣṇo sakarṣaṇa nijeṣṭada | saṃkarṣaṇo vicāryaiva kṣaṇāntare jagāda tān ||24|| āraṇyavāsāḥ satataṃ mahāraṇyanivāsinaḥ | bhavantu rājyabhoktāraḥ pṛthvyāṃ surasabhoginaḥ |||25|| mā mānavān bhūnivāsānudvejayantu vai kvacit | ityevaṃ niyamaṃ kṛtvā varaṃ dadāmi vo dvijāḥ ||26|| evaṃ vai vartamāneṣu bhavatsu sukhamuttamam | bhaviṣyati sukhaṃ yāntvabhyudayaṃ satataṃ dvijāḥ ||27|| ityuktvā ca haviṣyānnaṃ pūrṇāhutisvarūpakam | labdhvā saṃkarṣaṇo devaḥ sasuro’dṛśyatāṃ yayau ||28|| atha nārāyaṇīśri vai tataste phaṇino’pi vai | balino varadāne na satṛṣṇā mānave guṇe ||29||| mānaveṣu ca bhogeṣu gṛdhgino mohamāritāḥ | āyayurvāyuvivarairbhūlokaṃ vai samantataḥ ||3.6.3 0|| kāmarūpadharāḥ sarve narā nāryo hi mānavāḥ | sarpākṛtayo naivaiṣāṃ santi yadāgatā bhuvi ||31|| pracchannāste mānaveṣu vartante ca vasanti ca | hartuṃ rājyāni bhogāṃśca kāpaṭyabhṛtyakarmiṇaḥ ||32|| sarvatra bhūtale te vai rūpasaundaryaśālinaḥ | nāgāścāpi ca nāginyo’bhavan bhṛtyakriyāparāḥ ||33|| rājasu śreṣṭhiṣu vipravargeṣvamātyaseviṣu | sattāvatsu pradhāneṣu gṛhiṣvapyavasam̐śca te ||34|| bhṛtyā dāsāstathā dāsyo bhūtvā varṇānukāriṇaḥ | vivāhitāśca kanyā vai mitho mānavayonibhiḥ ||35|| samūhurmānavakanyā nāgāśca nararūpiṇaḥ | evaṃ sambandhamāpannā labdhvāvasarameva te ||36|| daśanti sma narān rātrau nidrāvaśān kvacit kvacit | mriyante saṃdaṃśitāśca nṛpā rājñyaśca sarvathā ||37|| śreṣṭhinaśca dhanāḍhyāśca sarve varṇeṣu sattamāḥ | riktaṃ sthalaṃ ca sampattiṃ nijāṃ kṛtvā ca te tataḥ ||38|| bhuṃjate smoragāḥ kāmarūpadhrāḥ pṛthivīśvarāḥ | saṃkarṣaṇasya vacanaṃ nānuṣṭhitaṃ hi tāmasaiḥ ||39|| svārthaparaiśchadmadharaiḥ pracchannabhogatatparaiḥ | evaṃ tairmānavī sṛṣṭiḥ prāyaśo vai vināśitā ||3.6.40|| pracchannadaṃśadoṣaiśca nijasvārthaparāyaṇaiḥ | nāgajātīyugaptāpi nijasṛṣṭirvivardhitā ||41 || mānavānāṃ kriyāḥ sarvā devārādhanamityapi | luptaṃ luptaṃ yajñakāryaṃ sandhyā luptā tathāhutiḥ ||42|| śrāddhaṃ luptaṃ tathā dānaṃ damo luptaśca mānuṣaḥ | ṛṣīṇāṃ gotrasaṃkalpāstathā luptāḥ samantataḥ ||43 || saṃskārā mānavā luptā udbhūtāścoragakriyāḥ | vratāni cāpi luptāni luptamāvāhanādikam ||44|| arghaṃ luptaṃ raveścāpi vaiśvadevo layaṃ gataḥ | pretakāryaṃ tathā luptaṃ devālayā nirarhaṇāḥ ||45|| kathāṃśāśca layaṃ prāptā viprā nṛpā mṛtāḥ khalu | brahmacārinivāsāśca guruvāsā layaṃ gatāḥ ||46|| satyaḥ sādhvyo mṛtāścāpi māritā nāgakoṭibhiḥ | sādhavo’pi mṛtāścāpyāvāsā grāmāḥ purāṇi ca ||47|| amānavāstu te jātā nāgakopaiḥ samantataḥ | pravarāṇāṃ ca nāmāni layaṃ gatāni vāsiṣu ||48|| na jñāyante janaiścaitat kuta evaṃ vyajāyata | atha devā yajñahīnāḥ pitarastṛptivarjitāḥ ||49|| śatavarṣe gate kāle’vicāryan samāhitāḥ | kuta evaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ nāstikyaṃ bhūtale’śubham ||3.6.50|| mānavānāṃ śataṃ varṣāṇāṃ gataṃ bhūtale’pi naḥ | āmantraṇāvāhanādi naiva bhavati vai katham ||51 || dṛṣṭyā tu divyayā vīkṣya jñātavanto narā mṛtāḥ | sarpā rājyāni kurvanti prajāḥ sarpātmikā api ||52|| kāmarūpadharāḥ sarpā nāginyo yoṣitaistathā | iṣṭarūpapradhāriṇyo bhuñjate bhūmisampadaḥ ||53|| etajjātamaniṣṭaṃ vai dharmakarmavivarjitam | tiryañcastāmasāḥ sarpāḥ pracchannachadmakāriṇaḥ ||54|| bhuñjate mānavān bhogān devarṣyunnatighātinaḥ | mānavānāṃ bahudhā vai ghāto jātaḥ purādiṣu ||55|| vasatyādau na vidyante mānavāḥ phaṇino’ntarā | araṇyādau pravidyante mānavā viralāḥ kvacit ||56|| te tvasmābhiścetanīyā nāgebhyo maraṇaṃ prati | nāgānāṃ māraṇopāyān bodhanīyāśca pratyapi ||57|| ityabhimantrya kamale
