ca ye tatra samāyātāḥ kutūhalāt || 3.13.110 || sarve nāryaḥ samabhavan mahākhelo’bhavaddhi saḥ | parasparaṃ prapaśyanti spṛśanti strīsvabhāvavat || 111 || hasanti ca pramodante strīkṛtaṃ hi striyā jagat | nārāyaṇaṃ cakāraiṣā nārāyaṇīṃ sudarśanī || 1 12|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ ṣoḍaśe vatsare ārṣakumāraśiṣyayā brahmacāriṇyā sudarśanyā svapradharṣaṇakāriṇāṃ śukrādīnāṃ doṣeṇa tathābhūlokanarādīnāṃ śāpadvārā strīkaraṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā trayodaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 13 ||
<3.14> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca evaṃ nārāyaṇīśri svasadṛśaṃ ca pareśvaram | strībhūtaṃ samalokyaivāścarya nāryo gatāstadā || 1 || dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇīdvandvaṃ rādhādvandvaṃ samānakam | sevārhaṃ spṛśyamevāpi siṣevire satīstriyaḥ || 2 || sarvāstā brahmacāriṇyastatrotsave hariṃ striyam | sarvabhāvairyogyasevāprakārairvai siṣevire || 3 || samāyātāḥ striyaḥ sarvā narapūrvāḥ samantataḥ | samājaścābhavanmandākinyāstīre hyasaṃkhyakaḥ || 4 || strīsamāje strīsvarūpaścāhaṃ tatra virājitaḥ | nārībhiścārthitaścāhaṃ strībhāvamocanaṃ prati || 5 || vayaṃ nāryo narapūrvāḥ sudarśanyāḥ praśāpataḥ | jātāḥ smo’tra vinā doṣaṃ duṣṭadaityādidoṣataḥ || 6 || duṣṭarājanyadoṣaiśca satīdharṣaṇapāpakaiḥ | nirdoṣā api bhūvāsā narā nārītvamāgatāḥ || 7 || sudarśanyā bhaktyā te daṇḍo’tikramitaḥ kṛtaḥ | tasmāt kṛtvā kṛpāṃ kṛṣṇa patīnno dehi puṃtanum || 8 || nāryo’pi naisargasiddhā arthayāmāsurityapi | patīnno dehi bhagavan bālān bālātmakān kuru || 9 || pūrvanarān vidhehyatra narānnṛlokavāsinaḥ | hariścāhaṃ ca tatchrupvā jagād strīsamājake || 3.14.10 || bhaktāgre’haṃ parādhīno bhaktoktaṃ laṃghayāmi na | surdśanīṃ yācamāno militvā strījanā vayam || 11 || ityahaṃ samupādiśya samāje cotthito’bhavam | samāhūtāṃ samāje ca sudarśanīṃ tadāvadam || 12 || bhakte brahmapare sādhvi mahaiśvaryasamanvite | duṣṭānāṃ daṇḍanaṃ yuktaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ svavratasya ca || 13 || ayuktaṃ daṇḍanaṃ yadvai niraparādhadehinām | bālakānāṃ ca vṛddhānāṃ yūnāṃ dharmavatāmapi || 14|| tasmād yāce svayaṃ cāhamanādiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | nārīrūpastava vākyād vāritaṃ vacanaṃ kuru || 15|| śāpanivāraṇaṃ sarvalokānāṃ kuru bhāminī | nārīmayaṃ jagat sarvaṃ vinā naraṃ na yāsyati || 16 || vicārya śāpasaṃhāraṃ kuru bhakte madarthitam | śrutvā sudarśanī devī vicārya tūrṇamāha mām || 17|| śāpasya kāraṇaṃ kṛṣṇa devadaityanarādibhiḥ | pradharṣaṇaṃ satīnāṃ vai kriyate cāśrameṣvapi || 18|| tanmā bhūditi kṛtvaiva sadā nāryo mayā kṛtāḥ | yadi tvaṃ ced rakṣaṇasya kartā no duṣṭanāśakṛt || 19 || ākalpāntaṃ vasa bhūmau tadā śāpaṃ harāmyaham | ityuktvā sā satī sudarśanī me pādayostadā || 3.14.20|| patitā daṇḍavat pūjāṃ pracakāra sumādibhiḥ | mālikāṃ pradadau kaṇṭhe strīvraje strīsvarūpiṇaḥ || 21 || ahaṃ bhaktāprarakṣārthaṃ oṃ tathāstvityuvāca tām | satī sudarśanī paścājjalaṃ haste nidhāya ca || 22|| śāpanimittena prāpitaḥ parameśvaraḥ | bhūtale dhanyabhāgyo’yaṃ loko yatra pumuttamaḥ || 23 || hariścātra nijāvāsaṃ tvākalpāntaṃ kariṣyati | rakṣāṃ brahmavratinīnāṃ kariṣyati kusaṃgitaḥ ||24|| evaṃ vinimayenāhaṃ mama śāpaṃ maholbaṇam | saṃharāmi jagatsāmye śrīhareḥ sannidhāviha || 25|| ityuktvā karatoyaṃ sā mumoca kṛṣṇapādayoḥ | bhūmau tāvat samāje cānyatra loke sthalāntare || 26|| satye svarge mānave ca pātālādau ca ye’bhavan | narapūrvā nārikāstā drāṅnarā abhavam̐stadā || 27 | | trilokīyaṃ yathāpūrvā tadāsan yugalātmikā | kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇasvarūpo’bhūnnārāyaṇo nijātmakaḥ || 28 | | puruṣottama evāpi puruṣottamarūpadhṛk | tathaiva ca yathāpūrvaṃ sarvaṃ tatra vyajāyata | | 29 | | nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ prāha samāje’haṃ tadā punaḥ | satīdharṣaṇakṛnme’tra vadhyaḥ sudarśanena vai | | 3.14.30 || bhaviṣyati na sandeho dehānte strī bhaviṣyati | daityāśca dānavāścāpi nṛpāśca surakoṭayaḥ || 31 || satīdharṣaṇakartāro vīkṣya duṣṭāḥ sudarśanam | nikṛntanaṃ taijasaṃ ca duḥsahaṃ dāruṇaṃ tataḥ | | 32 || kṣamāmayācire tatra vivāsitāśca te tadā | dūraṃ te prayayuḥ sarve duḥkhitā vai vanāntare || 33 | | athāpi duṣṭabhāvā ye te cakreṇa nikṛntitāḥ | niṣūditāḥ pare loke duṣṭabhāvānvitāśca ye || 34| | sādhvyaḥ satyaśca vai sarvā brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ | api dharṣaṇamāpannā yā yāstā harisannidhau | | 35 || samāgatya harervāri pādayostāḥ papuḥ śubham | pāvanaṃ sarvapāpānāṃ tena vai śuddhatāṃ yayuḥ | | 36 || saṃsevyaṃ navadhā bhaktyā pratyakṣaṃ puruṣottamam | pāvanyastā hi saṃjātā muktānyastvaikṣarārthikāḥ || 37| | ahaṃ lakṣmi tvayā sākaṃ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | nyavasaṃ cāpyanādiśrīstrīpuṃnārāyaṇābhidhaḥ | | 38 | | ayonijaḥ svatantraśca prākaṭyaṃ samupāśritaḥ | bhaktānāmnā prasiddhiste lakṣmi sudarśanī yathā || 39 || tathā sudarśanīśrīstvaṃ prasiddhā parameśvarī | jātā sudarśanīyogāt śīlavratasya poṣiṇī | | 3.14.40 | | ityevaṃ śivasukteśri prākaṭyaṃ mama vai purā | kathitaṃ smara sarvaṃ tat strīmayaṃ jagadadbhutam | | 41 || athānye’pi me’vatārāstatrābhavan hi koṭiśaḥ | sarvān jānāmyahaṃ lakṣmi yathākāryaṃ mayā kṛtān | | 42|| śṛṇu tvanyanmama cāpi prākaṭyaṃ cānyavatsare | saptadaśe vatsare cāprajñātākhye tu vedhasaḥ | | 43 | | kalpe trayodaśe cāpi manau tu daśame tadā | āsījjaganmahādaityakulenātīva pīḍitam ||4 4|| timiṃgilo mahādaityo mākaro varuṇākare | abhūt purā tadā kāmarūpadhṛga jalasañcaraḥ || 45 || śrīśīlike jalavyāpte dvīpe yasyābhavad gṛham | tajjātikāstathā cānye kāmarūpadharā api ||46|| mākarāśca vasanti smāyutasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ | narā nāryo bhavanti sma viniryānti jalād bahiḥ ||47|| nivasanti mahādvīpe śrīśīlike gṛheṣu ca | bahiryāntyapi deśeṣu māṃsādāste narān paśūn ||48|| apahṛtya jalamadhye dvīpe vā bhakṣayanti tān | nararūpāśca te bhūmau prayānti nagarādiṣu ||49|| apaharanti nārīśca bālakān bālikāstathā | vyomnā yānti mahābhūbhṛtsānuṣvapi ca mākarāḥ ||3.14.50|| vanasthān parvatasthām̐śca gahvarasthān hi tāpasān | ṛṣīn dvijān paśūn pakṣigaṇān haranti vai balāt |||51 || dvīpe nītvā bhakṣayanti naramāṃsādamākarāḥ | samudre jalamadhye ca matsyān jalecarānapi ||52|| naukāgānmānavām̐ścāpi bhakṣayanti sma vai balāt | ityevaṃ śatavarṣāṇi bhakṣitā mānavādayaḥ ||53|| lokeṣu sarvakhaṇḍeṣūdghoṣo mahānajāyata | parvateṣu gahvareṣu tāpaseṣvapi sarvataḥ ||54|| mākarāṇāṃ bhayaṃ cāste trasanti sma ca dehinaḥ | balināṃ sannidhau ke’pi prayānti naiva rakṣaṇe ||55|| rājāno’pi bhayodvignāstadā jātāḥ samantataḥ | cakravartī mahārājastadāsīd dharmavāhanaḥ ||56|| yoddhuṃ yayau samudrānte vyomnā raṇe tu mākaraiḥ | bahurūpadharairvyomnā māyāvṛṣṭyā nipātitaḥ ||57|| samudre ca mṛtaḥ so’pi rājā vai dharmavāhanaḥ | tato loke bhayaṃ yānti cānye mākarayuddhataḥ ||58|| mākarāṇāṃ balaṃ puṣṭaṃ jāto rājño vināśataḥ | prasahyābdhitaṭasthānāmāharanti dhanastriyaḥ ||59|| bālāṃśca bālikā gāścābhūṣaṇāmbarasampadaḥ | bhuñjate nirbhayāścāpi caidhitāśca samantataḥ ||3.14.6 0|| atha ye khaṇḍarājānaste’pi taiśca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | pṛthak pṛthak hṛtāścāpi mākarairmāṃsabhojanaiḥ ||6 1 || dvīpāśca dvīpakalpāśca bhūbhāgā vaśagāḥ kṛtāḥ | bhuñjate sma yatheṣṭaṃ te māyārūpapradhāriṇaḥ ||62 || atyācāro mahān khaṇḍe khaṇḍe sma jāyate tadā | rudanti nirbalā lokā narā nāryaḥ pradharṣitāḥ ||63 || bhakṣitā bālakā yeṣāṃ patnyaśca patayastathā | nirvaṃśā bahavo jātā mākaropadravaistadā ||64|| evaṃ te śatavarṣānte vṛddhimāptā hi mākarāḥ | koṭisaṃkhyāḥ prajātā vai rākṣasā iva sarvataḥ ||65|| jalaprānte vasantyete sabalā api vai kvacit | nirbalatvakṣaṇe vārdhau praviśanti sma tatkṣaṇam ||66|| yuddheṣvebhirjayaṃ naiva labhante mānavā nṛpāḥ | māyāmantrakarā naikarūpadhṛgo’tidāruṇāḥ ||67|| nṛpān vijitya rājyāni cakrurvaśāni khaṇḍaśaḥ | atha prajāstadā cātyācāraṃ mākarakāsuraiḥ ||68|| kṛtaṃ naiva sahante smāsahma sarvavināśanam | yajñāḥ sarvatra nāśyante vyomamārgeṇa taistadā ||69|| utsavā devanilayā nāśyante’pi samantataḥ | udyānāni vināśyante phalapuṣpamayānyapi ||3.14.70 || sasyāni ca kaṇāḍhyāni nāśyante’pi samantataḥ | yadyad ratnamayaṃ loke hriyante sarvameva taiḥ ||71 || evaṃ tūpadrave jāte mānavāḥ parameśvaram | parabrahmākṣarātītaṃ tadā māṃ cārthayanmuhuḥ ||72|| samastairhṛjjanyabhāvaiḥ pūjayanti sma māṃ hṛdi | prārthayanti sma rakṣārthaṃ dīnānāthābalādikāḥ ||73 || tato mayā śrutaṃ teṣāmārādhanaṃ tadākṣare | mākarāṇāṃ vināśārthaṃ dharmarakṣaṇahetave ||74|| mānavānāṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ tvayā sākaṃ tadā drutam | ahaṃ sāyudha evāpi vimānena bhuvaṃ prati ||75|| ājagāmāmbarāt tūrṇaṃ dvāradvīpamupāśritaḥ | vimānaṃ vai mayā tatrādṛśyabhāvaṃ kṛtaṃ kṣaṇāt ||76|| āraṇyakaṃ mayā rūpaṃ tvayāpyāraṇyakaṃ kṛtam | tāpasaṃ cāpi tadrūpaṃ dhṛtvāhaṃ vyacaraṃ vane ||77|| atha te mākarā lokā dvīpādāgatya māṃ tvayā | sākaṃ jahrurnije dvīpe tapasvinaṃ tato mayā ||78|| dṛṣṭo dvīpaḥ sanniveśagrāmapattanaśobhitaḥ | māṃ khādituṃ mākarāste tvāyātāḥ sotsavāstataḥ ||79 || mayā sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ prahitaṃ tatkṣaṇānnanu tacca vyāpādayad vahnijvālayā cādahattathā ||3.14.80 || ghaṭikākālamātreṇa dvīpo nirmākaraḥ kṛtaḥ | dadruvurmākarā mākaryaśca sarīsṛpā jhaṣāḥ ||81 || yādāṃsi ca tathā bhūtvā viviśurmakarālayam | dvīpamadhye tāpaso’haṃ tvayā sākaṃ tadāvasam ||82|| pattanāni tu śūnyāni vartante sma tadā khalu | atha daityo mākareśo yuddhārthaṃ jalamadhyataḥ ||83 || sannaddhaśca paro bhūtvā sasainyaḥ samupāyayau | mayā sudarśanenaiva nikṛntitā hi mākarāḥ ||84|| daityaḥ parājayaṃ vīkṣya prāṇatrāṇaparāyaṇaḥ | dudrāva sahasā cābdhau viveśa gahanaṃ talam ||85|| sahasrahastavān daityaḥ sahasramastakastathā | sahasrapādasampannaḥ punaryuddhārthamāyayau ||86 || mayā punaḥ preritaṃ ca cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ mama | nikṛttā bāhavaścāsya bahavo vai tadā hi saḥ ||87|| punarviveśa jaladhimathāhamapi vai tadā | khaṇḍe khaṇḍe sthitān mārgayitvā tān mākarāsurān ||88|| sudarśanena cakreṇa vyāpādayaṃ samantataḥ | pṛthvyāṃ yatra ca yatraite hyāsan mākaradānavāḥ ||89|| tān sarvānahanaṃ cakradhāreṇāvasare tadā | atha vai mākaro daityo’yutahastasamanvitaḥ ||3.14.90 || ayutānana evāpyayutapāt samupāyayau | me bhātaṃ ca vināśo’sya kartavyo’vaśyameva ha ||91 || tataḥ śāntiṃ mākarāṇāmupadravaḥ prayāsyati | athāhaṃ saṅgaraṃ cakre mākareṇa durātmanā || 92|| hatā hastāḥ sahasrāṇi trīṇi trīṇyānanāni ca | yadā tadā mākareśo dudrāva jaladhiṃ yayau ||93 || ahaṃ sākaṃ tvayā lakṣmi cābhavaṃ jalamānavaḥ | lakṣahasto lakṣamukho lakṣapāllakṣahetikaḥ ||94|| lakṣajālasamāyuktaḥ prāviśaṃ mākarālayam | sa māṃ dṛṣṭvā mahadrūpaṃ cakre vārṣu palāyanam ||95|| abdhitaścānyamabdhiṃ ca tato’bdhyantaramityapi | pṛṣṭhe yāntaṃ tu māṃ vīkṣya prāṇatrāṇaparāyaṇaḥ ||96 || bhayodvigno babhūvāti kṣīrasāgaramāviśat | mayā sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ prahitaṃ tasya mṛtyave ||97|| pṛṣṭhalagnaṃ prajajvāla dadāha taṃ samantataḥ | cukṣobha sāgaraḥ sarvaścakampe pṛthivī muhuḥ ||98|| atha jñātvā nidhanaṃ svaṃ yuddhārthaṃ sammukho’bhavat | mayā yuddhaṃ nyāyasāraṃ dattaṃ tasmai mahātmane || 99|| yathā yathāhaṃ taṃ hanmi tathā sa nūtanaḥ | utpadyate mākaro’pi māyayā koṭirūpadhṛk || 3.14.100 || māsānte sa mayā vārdhau yuddhaṃ datvā hato’suraḥ | sudarśanena cakreṇa lakṣakaṇṭhā nikṛntitāḥ || 10 1|| tadā vyomni ninedurvai dundubhayo dyuvāsinām | puṣpāṇāṃ varṣaṇaṃ jātaṃ samudro māmapūjayat || 1 02|| pārṣadāḥ sarvadhāmnāṃ ca muktāśceśāḥ samāyayuḥ | surāśca mānavāścāpi pupūjurmāṃ pumuttamam || 103|| jalamānavarūpaṃ māṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam | lakṣānanaṃ lakṣahastaṃ lakṣahetisamanvitam || 1 04|| lakṣapādaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ komalaṃ candrabhāsanam | jalāvāsaṃ jaladevīdevaiḥ prapūjitaṃ hi mām || 1 05|| duḥkhamuktā dehinaścānarcurmāṃ parameśvaram | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam || 1 06|| jalamānavarūpaṃ māṃ svayaṃ śrīparameśvaram | anādiśrījalanārāyaṇāhvayaṃ tadā priye || 1 07|| tvāmanādijalanārāyaṇīṃ cānarcureva te | atha jalād vinirgatya śrīśīlike bhuvastale || 1 08|| dvīpe vāsaṃ cakārāhaṃ mākarāṇāṃ hi pattane | tato me pārṣadāstatra tvāyātā bahavastadā || 1 09|| śrīdvīpo me’bhavad dvīpaḥ samudrataṭavartanaḥ | tāpasānāṃ ca muktānāṃ tapo’rthaṃ tatra kalpake || 3.14.11 0|| brahmaṇo vatsare saptadaśe lakṣmi ca taṃ smara | śvetadvīpo yathā cādyastathā śrīdvīpanāmakaḥ || 11 1|| śrīśīladvīpa evābhūnmama te vāsakāraṇāt | jaladvīpastathā śvetanārāyaṇālayo’pi saḥ || 1 12|| tadā lokāśca śāstrāṇi kathayanti sma naikadhā | smara sarvaṃ hi tallakṣmi purātanātpurātanam || 1 13|| cakatkāramayaṃ sthānaṃ divyaṃ mayā purārjitam | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇānmokṣamāvrajet || 1 14|| anye tathāvatārā me jātāścāpi sahasraśaḥ | tānahaṃ vedmi sarvān vai pratyakṣajñānavānaham || 1 15|| tato bhaktā mayā pṛthvyāṃ pārṣadairmama yogibhiḥ | ṛṣibhirmunibhiścāpi sādhubhirvaiṣṇavāḥ kṛtāḥ || 1 16|| prajāḥ sarvāstato jātā vaiṣṇavyo mama cāśritāḥ | muktimārgaḥ pravṛttaśca yajñayāgādayo’bhavan || 1 17|| prajāśca sukhitā jātā mānavā nirbhayā api | dṛśyante vaiṣṇavā bhūmau mama pūjāparāyaṇāḥ || 1 18|| narā nāryo vyomagāścāyānti maddarśanāya ha | sarvābhyaḥ khalu digbhyaśca śrīdvīpo mokṣado’bhavat || 1 19|| ākalpāntaṃ tataścāhaṃ nyavasaṃ śrīsuśīlike | dvīpe tatra tataścāhaṃ svākṣaraṃ prayayau priye || 3.14.1 20|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne strībhūtānāṃ bhūtalavāsiprajānāṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ prārthanayānādistrīpuṃnārāyaṇasya, saptadaśe vedhaso vatsare ca mākarādidaityanāśārtham anādiśrījalanārāyaṇasya ca prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturdaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 14 ||
<3.15> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ śivajanye śri vedhaso vatsare tataḥ | aṣṭādaśe layabhāvābhidhe dvādaśakalpake || 1 || ekādaśe manau tatra yugahrāsabalāt khalu | vināśe sādhudharmāṇāṃ sādhudīkṣākṣaye tathā || 2 || mokṣamārgasya rodhe ca daivapaitryavidhau gate | punastatsthāpanārthaṃ ca revayā sākaṃ hariḥ svayam || 3 || prāvirāsaṃ cāgrajasya vaṣaḍviprasya sadgṛhe | vaṣaṭkāro’bhavannāmnā vipro vrataparāyaṇaḥ || 4 || tāpaso hṛtasarvasvo duṣṭanāstikamānavaiḥ | pīḍito mama bhakto’sau tyaktvā grāme vanaṃ yayau || 5 || bhajate sma sadā māṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim | phalairmūlairdalaiḥ puṣpairbhāvanairmānasaistathā || 6 || nityaṃ māṃ prātarevāsau pūjayatyeva vastubhiḥ | bhāryā tasya tathā sādhvī japasevāparāyaṇā || 7 || nityaṃ tvāṃ śrīsatīṃ lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇīṃ sanātanīm | pūjayatyeva vidhinā bhojayatyeva satphalam || 8 || jalaṃ puṣpaṃ dalaṃ cāpi samarpayati sādaram | kīrtanaṃ bhajanaṃ me ca te cobhau kurutaḥ sadā || 9 || madhyāhne ca tathā sāyaṃ mama dhyānaparāyaṇau | araṇyavāsau nityaṃ ca tāvāstāṃ vai videhinau || 3.15.10 || dehārthaṃ vaibhavā bhogā yasya naiva kvacit khalu | haryarthaṃ vaibhavā yasya videhaḥ sa bhavet priye || 11 || evaṃ vai vartamānau tāvanapatyau sukhāśrayau | vārdhakyaṃ kiñcidāpannau vane vṛkṣanivāsinau || 12|| tayorevaṃ hi vasatoḥ putraputryeṣaṇābhavat | vaṣaṭkārasya manasi putraiṣaṇā vyajāyata || 13 || svadhāvatyāśca manasi putryeṣaṇā vyajāyata | mātā tvicchati kanyāṃ vai sarvakārye sahāyinīm || 14|| pitā precchati putraṃ vai sarvakārye sahāyakam | putraputryeṣaṇāvantau gṛhadharmaparāyaṇau || 15|| ubhau tau māṃ prārthayataḥ pūjanānte manoratham | loke lakṣmi janānāṃ vai tryeṣaṇā jāyate muhuḥ || 16|| lokaiṣaṇā tathā vittaiṣaṇā putraiṣaṇā khalu | nārāyaṇasya bhaktānāṃ lokaiṣaṇā praśāmyati || 17|| yato bhaktyā paraṃ dhāma bhaktāḥ prāpsyanti vai dhruvam | sādhūnāṃ toṣiṇāṃ cāpi vittaiṣaṇā praśāmyati || 18|| jalānnāmbaralābhaśca yātrāmātraḥ satāṃ yataḥ | putraiṣaṇā saputrāṇāṃ jñānināṃ ca praśāmyati || 1 9|| uttamarṇā dhanāptyarthaṃ jāyante’patyarūpiṇaḥ | tādṛśānāmapatyānāmasattve sukhameva yat || 3.15.20 || apatyānāṃ garbhake’pi janane pālane tathā | poṣaṇe lagnakaraṇe vyaye roge hi duḥkhakam || 21 || tathāpi lokavākyānāṃ sparśo yeṣāṃ prajāyate | vidhuro’yaṃ hyaputro’yaṃ nirvaṃśo’yaṃ tathaikalaḥ || 22 || evaṃvidhānāṃ vākyānāṃ yeṣāṃ nāsti sahiṣṇutā | teṣāṃ māyābhibhūtānāmeṣaṇādruḥ prajāyate || 23 || jñānahīnasya bhaktasya mūlyaṃ bhavati laukike | jñānino mama bhaktasya dagdhaṃ māmantarākhilam ||24|| yasya dagdhaṃ hi sarvaṃ vai māyikaṃ tasya kiṃ nviha | putreṇa lokakāryeṇa rājyena vaibhavena vā ||25||| bhautikasya tu putrasyaiṣaṇā bandhāya kalpyate | vaṣaṭkārasya viprasya putraiṇaṣā hyabhūt kila || 26|| kintu sā madgocarābhūt harirme sutatāṃ vrajet | svadhāvatyāścaiṣaṇāpi lakṣmīrme bālikā bhavet || 27|| evaṃ madyogasaṃkalpau tayorāstāṃ śubhāśrayau | tau saṃkalpau sadā divyau māyābandhanavarjitau || 28 || āstāṃ tayoḥ śubhau tasmānmayā dhyānaṃ kṛtaṃ tayoḥ | pitarau tau vidhātavyo dharmasthāpanahetave || 29|| tayostu bhaktayoścāpi saṃkalpayoḥ prapūrtaye | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ ca tvayā saha ||3.15.3 0 || vimṛśya tadvanaṃ yāto gocarastāpaso’bhavam | atithībhūtaścāhaṃ tvaṃ mama sārthā ca bhikṣukī || 31 || gatavantau tayorvāsaṃ vane vai bhaktayoḥ puram | tāpasau sajaṭau cīravalkalau rūkṣaveṣiṇau ||32|| viprau nārāyaṇaṃ nāma raṭantau mālikānvitau | sādhudharmau bhikṣukau vai madhyāhne samupasthitau ||33|| tadā tau hṛṣṭamanasau cakratuḥ svāgataṃ śubham | pādyamarghyaṃ cāsanaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ phalādikam || 34|| salilaṃ śubhavacanaṃ dadatustau tadā hi nau | mayā bhikṣā svīkṛtā ca tvayāpi svīkṛtā tataḥ || 35|| pādasaṃvāhanaṃ tau cakrāte nau ca praṣevaṇam | dhanyau svo yat satoḥ sevā sādhvoścādya prapadyate || 36 || sādhusevāpāpahantrī dibyapuṇyapradāyinī | bhuktidātrī muktidātrī sarvasaṃkalpapūraṇī || 37|| kalpavallīsamā kalpadrumatulyā phalapradā | cintāmaṇisamā sevā kāmadhenusamā satām || 38|| sādhavo yasya vai gehe samāyānti haripriyāḥ | tadgṛhaṃ sarvadā tīrthaṃ vanaṃ vā pattanaṃ ca vā || 3 9|| anyatīrthāni kālena pāvayanti yathābalam | sādhutīrthaṃ tūrṇameva punanti sevino janān ||3.15.40|| yatra sādhvāgamastatrāgamo vai śrīharerdhruvaḥ | yatra haryāgamastatra muktānāmāgamo dhruvaḥ ||41 || yatra muktāgamastatra muktyāgamaśca vai tathā | mukteryatrāgamastatra bhaktyāgamo’pi vai dhruvaḥ ||42||| yatra bhaktyāgamastatra dharmāgamo’pi vai dhruvaḥ | jñānavairāgyayoścāpyāgamaśca sampadāṃ dhruvaḥ || 43 || yatra nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sadbhiḥ sahopapadyate | tatra lakṣmīśca kamalā śrīḥ siddhiḥ śāśvatī dhruvā ||44|| yatra nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇastatra yajñā vratāni ca | tapāṃsi cāpi sarvāṇi surāḥ sarve’pi tatra ca ||45 || yatra nārāyaṇaḥ sadbhirbhuṃkte phalajalādikam | tatra vai bhuṃjate devāḥ pitaraśca jagattrayam ||46 || adya vai vanavāso nau sādhvorāgamakāraṇāt | saphalaḥ khalu sañjāto rājyādhiko’pi modadaḥ ||47|| adya nau tvanapatyatvaṃ vilīnaṃ satprasevanāt | adya nau nirdhanatvaṃ ca mahatyarthe phalapradam ||48|| adya nau jīvanaṃ jātaṃ sārthakaṃ suprajīvanam | adya nau mānasau bhāvau pūritau niścitau tviha ||49 || manyāvahe’dya kālo’pi pavitratāṃ prayāsyati | śakunāni śubhānyeva jāyante bhavadāgamāt ||3.15.50 || sphuranti śubhabodhāni cāṅgāni nau tvadāgamāt | vasatāmatra pūjyau vai sevayiṣyāva ādarāt ||51 || satāṃ sevāprasaṃgena taranti dehino’bhavam | vane ca nirjane cātra bhavadvāsena śobhanaḥ ||52|| satsaṃgo modajanako naḥ pratyahaṃ bhaviṣyati | eṣā bakulavṛkṣādhobhāge vai parṇaśālikā ||53|| bhavadbhyāmarpitā ramyā śītātapanivāraṇī | āvāṃ tvanyāṃ kariṣyāvaḥ kuṭiṃ svāśrayadāyinīm ||54|| ityuktvā viprayugalaṃ patitaṃ pādayorhi nau | mayoktaṃ ca tadā tābhyāṃ kuśalaṃ bhavatoḥ sadā ||55|| nirāmayaṃ cābhyudayaḥ sukhamastu ca śāśvatam | āvāṃ vanecarau svo’tra naikasthānanivāsinau ||56|| nirbandhanau sarvavāsau guptakuṭinivāsinau | bhavadvidhānāṃ viprāṇāṃ bhaktānāṃ tu samāgame ||57|| daivecchayā jāyamāne tiṣṭhāvo gopradohanam | tathāpīśvarabhaktānāṃ nirmalānāṃ tapasvinām ||58|| gṛhe sañjāyate kvāpi pakṣapāto hi nau mudhā | premṇātithyaṃ gṛhītaṃ ca gṛhītaṃ svāgataṃ tathā |||5 9 || ājñāṃ prāpya gamiṣyāvo vanāntaraṃ ca vo’stu śam | tadā tau cāśrūṇi muktvā prāhaturnau mudānvitau ||3.15.60 || kuṭiryatra satāṃ saṃgaḥ sā kuṭirna tu pārṇikī | vāso yatra satāṃ yogaḥ sa vāso na tu bhūmigaḥ ||6 1 || jīvanaṃ ca saha sadbhirjīvanaṃ na tu bhojanam | sukhaṃ sevā satāṃ nityaṃ kartavyaṃ nāparaṃ śubham ||62|| āvāṃ sādhusvarūpau svo yāsyāvo’nubhavatpadam | yadvātra kurutāṃ vāsaṃ sevālābho hi nau bhavet ||63 || bhavadāgamane vṛkṣā modante vanapakṣibhiḥ | bhavadāgamane vallyo vikāsante supuṣpakaiḥ ||64|| bhavadāgamane’ṅgāni hṛdayāḍhyāni sarvathā | anubhavantyapūrvāṇi sukhānyānandakāni ca ||65|| tiṣṭhate ca tato’traiva dāsau svo bhavatoriha | mayoktau ca tadā tau vai kathamīdṛk parāgrahaḥ ||66 || kriyate’tra bhavadbhyāṃ vai vadataṃ hārdameva nau | tāvubhāvāhatustatra vane tvekākinau sadā ||67|| āvāṃ vāsaṃ prakurvaśca bhavatāṃ tu sthitāviha | sārthavāso bhavedeva satāṃ saṃgo hi durlabhaḥ ||68|| sapatnīkagṛhasthasya vāsastvekākino vane | bhayado vai tataḥ stheyaṃ gṛhasthena sahāyinā ||69|| dvayorgṛhasthayorvāsaḥ śobhano vai vanāntare | trayāṇāṃ cādhikānāṃ ca vāso vai cātiśobhanaḥ ||3.15.70 || nārīṇāṃ tu satīdharmānvitānāṃ dharmapālane | sāhāyyaṃ syāt pramadā hi sādhvyaḥ sādhvyaḥ sukhāśrayāḥ ||71 || tasmād vāṃ rocayāvo’tra vāsaṃ sādhupradharmiṇoḥ | vinā vai bhavatorvāsaṃ śāntinau na bhaviṣyati ||72|| tadā mayoktaṃ ca tathāstvityomityabhinoditau | sukhaṃ cāvāpatustūrṇaṃ harṣānvitau babhūvatuḥ ||73 || āvāṃ sukhasthitau tayoścāvāse kṛtapūjanau | mudā sāyaṃ gataṃ vārtālāpaiḥ saddharmabodhanaiḥ ||74|| sandhyāṃ kṛtvā niśāyāṃ ca harervārtā vidhāya ca | suṣvupuścāpi catvāro niśānte ca dvayorapi ||75|| brāhmamuhūrte pūrve vai samaye śobhane tadā | viprasya cāpi viprāṇyāḥ svapne cāvāmupāgatau ||76|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇau sākṣāttāpasau samupāgatau | putrarūpo’pyahaṃ jātastvaṃ svapne putrikābhavaḥ ||77||| yamalaṃ ca dvijābhyāṃ vai prāptaṃ bālasvarūpi tat | prāpya viprau sumuditau tataḥ svapnaṃ nyavartata ||78 || āvāmadṛśyatāṃ prāptau tau tu jāgaritau tadā | abhavatāṃ tato draṣṭuṃ tau svakuṭyāṃ tu nāvubhau ||79|| adṛṣṭvā sumahāścaryaṃ prāptau ca muditau tataḥ | āvāṃ tatra tadā lakṣmi vāyudevaṃ hi garbhagam ||3.15.8 0|| samāhūya dadatuśca garbhājñāṃ garbhadarśanam | prakārasya yathā garbhavatī vai pramadā bhavet ||8 1 || vāyuścaivaṃ cakārāpi garbhakukṣau vasan sadā | yathā garbhavatī nārī tathaudaramadarśayat ||82|| āvāmadṛśyarūpeṇa vartamānau tadāśraye | pratimāyāṃ samaye tvāgate yamalameva ha ||83|| prādurbhūtau yadā vāyurgarbhadvārād viniryayau | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇau yamalātmakau ||84|| kanyākumārakau cobhāvajāyevahi tatpuraḥ | ayonijāvapi yadvad yonijāviva vai tadā ||85|| ākāśātpuṣpavṛṣṭiśca devamuktakṛtābhavat | dundubhayo nineduśca vane jāto mahotsavaḥ ||86|| ṛṣayaśca samājagmustatra darśanahetave | maṃgalaṃ bahudhā tatra jātaṃ janestadāvayoḥ |||87|| kṛtasaṃskārakau sarvavidhau ca yamalātmakau | āvāṃ vṛddhiṃ gatau tatrāraṇye ca brahmacāriṇau ||88|| sādhudharmaparau sādhudīkṣāyuktau svayaṃkṛtau | ajāyevahi tatraiva brahmasūtrānvitāvapi ||89|| athāraṇyanivāsebhyo grāmavāsebhya ityapi | upādiśāvaḥ sādhūnāṃ dharmān tyāgāśramārthinām || 3.15.90 || kāmadevasya vai tyāgo jihvārāsanavarjanam | mohadarśanasantyāgaḥ snehaspārśanavarjanam ||9 1 || calaśabdādisantyāgo vikṛtigandhavarjanam | parigrahasyāsaṃgaśca rāgadveṣavivarjanam || 92|| yātrāmātrānnasalilagrahaṇaṃ cāniketanam | maunaṃ karmaparityāgo harau sarvārpaṇātmanā || 93 || tapodharmo nigrahaśca vāsanātyajanaṃ sadā | mamāhaṃtyājanaṃ cāpi daihyabhinnaprabodhanam || 94|| sarvadrohākaraṇaṃ ca kṣamā sahiṣṇutā dayā | adhyātmacintanaṃ nityaṃ parameśasya pūjanam || 95 || brahmasthityā vartanaṃ ca śokamohavivarjanam | ayācite ca samprāpte santoṣaścārjavaṃ tathā || 96 || kāṣāyāmbaradhāritvaṃ karapātrakatā tathā | yathāpekṣāmbaragrāho yathāsukhaṃ vane sthitiḥ || 9 7|| oṃ namaḥ śrīśīlanārāyaṇāya paramātmane | itimātrajapaścāpi bhaktiśca paramātmani || 98 || ityevaṃ vai narāṇāṃ ca nārīṇāṃ sādhuvṛttitā | śikṣitā vai tadāvābhyāṃ mānavebhyaḥ sukhāvahā || 99 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena paramātmanā | mayā tvayā tadānādisādhudharmāḥ pravartitāḥ || 3.15.100 || anādiśrīśīlanārāyaṇena paramātmanā | anādisvāminīnārāyaṇyā tvayānvitena ha | | 101 || sahodareṇa vai bhrātrā mayā sādhusvarūpiṇā | sahodaryā ca vai svasrā tvayā sādhvyā suyoṣitā || 102 || koṭiśo mānavā jātāḥ sādhavaḥ śīlavartanāḥ | sādhvyaśca koṭiśo jātāḥ śīlavrataparāyaṇāḥ || 103 || tato yajñāśca saṃjātā vratāni vividhāni ca | bhajanaṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi mandirāṇi mamāpi ca | | 1 04|| śīlasya niyamaścāpi daivapaitryakriyāstathā | tīrthasevā sādhusevā sarve dharmāḥ pravartitāḥ || 1 05|| anādiśrīśīlanārāyaṇena vai mayā tadā | sarvaṃ jānāmyahaṃ lakṣmi smara prākaṭyameva yat || 106 || anye’pi ca tadā tatrāvatārā mama naikaśaḥ | abhavan kāryavaśagā jānāmyahaṃ na cetaraḥ || 1 07|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ me te prākaṭyaṃ śīlahetave | smaraṇācchravaṇāccāpi pāṭhanānbhuktimuktidam || 1 08|| ākalpāntaṃ tvāvayośca tadābhavaṃ nivāsanam | dharmārthaṃ sādhurūpeṇa koṭibhiḥ sādhubhiḥ saha || 10 9|| śiṣyapraśiṣyaśākhāśca vyavardhanta tadā kṣitau | mātre pitre tato muktiṃ datvā gatau nijākṣaram || 3.15.110 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso’ṣṭādaśe vatsare sādhudharmasthāpanārtham anādiśrīśīlanārāyaṇasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 15 ||
<3.16> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ brahmaṇo vatsare tataḥ | sākṣātkṛnnāmake ṣaṣṭikalpe trayodaśe manau || 1 || kailāsavāso rudro vai tīrthārthamagamat kṣitau | paryaṭan cāṭulādrau sa viṣṇutīrthamupāyayau || 2 || tatra vai parvate ramyā śāradākhyā saridvarā | brahmaputryavahat tasyāstaṭe śrāntaḥ śubhaṃ jalam || 3 || pītvā prokṣya niṣasāda dhyānamagno’bhavat kṣaṇam | viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ sarveśvaraṃ dadhyau pareśvaram || 4 || tāvadvanāt samāyāto vārāho mattavegavān | mastakena haraṃ śaṃbhuṃ dhāvan vallmīkavaddhi saḥ || 5 || uccakhānāvilokyaivāspaṣṭaṃ bhasmāvṛtaṃ haram | dhyānāttūrṇaṃ samuttasthau vārāhaṃ vīkṣya śaṃkaraḥ || 6 || roṣaṃ cakāra sahasā bhrakuṭiḥ raktatāṃ gatā | tasyā vyāghrānalo vahnijvālāmālāsamākulaḥ || 7 || samutpannastāmaso vai mahāsuro’drisadṛśaḥ | vārāhaṃ kṣaṇamātreṇānāśayacchaṃbhunoditaḥ || 8 || vārāhacarma saṃgṛhya vyāghrānalo harājñayā | jāṭharānalaśāntyarthaṃ yayāce bhojanaṃ harāt || 9 || śaṃbhustvāha samudrāntarvartināṃ yādasāṃ kulam | bhojanaṃ vai mayā dattaṃ tava yāhi jalāntikam || 3.16.1 0|| vyāghrānalo’tibalavān kāmarūpadharo gaṇaḥ | nirbhayaḥ kṣutpraśāntyarthamabdhitīramupāyayau || 1 1|| bhakṣayāmāsa yādāṃsi makarān kacchapān timīn | yathāyathā bhojanaṃ sa cakre tathā tathāsya ha || 12|| jāṭharāgniḥ pradīptaśca pācakaḥ san vyavardhata | śarīraṃ ca tathā tasya vṛddhiṃ jagāma śailavat || 1 3|| daśayojanavistāro bhūtvābdhiṃ sa viveśa ha | bhakṣayāmāsa bahuśo yādāṃsi pratyahaṃ sa ca || 14|| māsānte ca babhūvāpi śatayojanavistṛtaḥ | varṣānte sa babhūvāpi sahasrayojanāyataḥ || 15|| mahāsamudramāviśya jalaṃ pibati śvāsataḥ | jhaṣādyāḥ koṭiśo yānti tasyodare pacanti ca || 16|| jalaṃ sarvaṃ cānalena dagdhaṃ prajāyate’pi ca | atha kāle vyatīte so’yutayojanavistṛtaḥ || 17|| vyāghrānalo’bhavad vārdhau pibatyapi divāniśam | sahasrayojanaṃ vārdhi śuṣkaṃ karoti nirjalam || 18|. evaṃ sarve samudrāśca pītāstena kramāt khalu | mahājalaṃ kramāt sarvaṃ pītaṃ bhūparito’bdhijam || 1 9|| vinā jalaṃ na vai meghā prajāyante’bdhimaṇḍalāt | abdhiṣvagnistasya vyāghrānalasya prasṛto’bhavat || 3.16.20|| samudravivarāścāgnimayāḥ pṛthvī tathābhavat | śuṣkā jalena hīnā ca garbhajalamadahyata || 21 || śuṣkaṃ ca bhūtalaṃ sarvaṃ vṛṣṭirodho vyajāyata | mamruśca dehinaḥ prāyo yoginastu trilokya tat || 22|| samādhau pravilīnā vai ṛṣayastu divaṃ yayuḥ | akālaḥ pralayo bhūmau jāto vyāghrānalena vai || 23|| jalālābhe kardamādīn vyāghrānalo’tti vai talāt | sarvato jalahānyā ca pṛthvī rūkṣagatiṃ gatā ||24|| vārdhayastu mṛtaprāyāḥ śrīhariṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ | rakṣa rakṣa kṛpānātha vyāghrānalānmaholbaṇāt ||25|| bhakṣayatyeva yādāṃsi kardamāni jalāni ca | akālapralayo jāto mṛtā iva vayaṃ tataḥ || 26|| raudro’yaṃ vartate cādyāyutayojanavistṛtaḥ | āyatau vardhamāno’yaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ nigaliṣyati || 27|| tadanto bhavatā kāryo bhavataḥ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | kṣāraḥ pīto hi sarvasvaścānye pītāśca khaṇḍaśaḥ || 28|| bhavantamantarā nāsyāsurasyāntakaro’paraḥ | bhavatā rakṣyate sarvaṃ cāpatyamiva sarvadā ||29|| vayaṃ samudrāḥ sarve vai rādhāputrā jalātmakāḥ | pitā naḥ śrīkṛṣṇa eva bhagavāna rādhikāpatiḥ ||3.16.3 0 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāvatāra eva yaḥ | golokādhipatirgopīpatiḥ śrīpatirīśvaraḥ || 3 1|| tataḥ putrā vayaṃ te smo rakṣa kaḥ puruṣottama | ityevamarthitaścāhaṃ samudraiḥ saptabhistadā || 32|| tvayā sākaṃ mahālakṣmi vārdhīnāṃ gocaro’bhavam | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmasvastikadhvajaśūlavān || 3 3|| pūjito vanditastaiśca miṣṭodenābhivanditaḥ | miṣṭodasyaiva patnyāṃ puṣkariṇyāṃ tu tadābhavam || 34|| bālo’haṃ jātamātro’pi yuvābdhiputra eva ha | tvaṃ tadā śivasatyeśri puṇḍarīkasya putrikā ||35|| bhūbhṛtaścābhavaḥ sarvaiśvaryasaundaryalakṣitā | nāmnā śrīpuṇḍarīkaśrīḥ sarvakalyāṇakāriṇī ||36|| athāhaṃ ca prasasmāra vāhanaṃ jalagāmyapi | tadā miṣṭodakātprāpto jalaturaṃgamo’dbhutaḥ ||37|| sapakṣaḥ śuṇḍhavām̐ścāpi sajālapādavānapi | kāmarūpadharaścāpi śvāsarodhasamādhimān ||38|| bale’bdhisadṛśaścāpi gatyā vidyutsamo’pi ca | adhṛṣyaḥ parvataprāyaḥ śvetavarṇasturaṃgamaḥ |||3 9|| bhūvāryambaragamanaḥ sthūlasūkṣmādisiddhimān | sarvabhāṣāpravaktā ca divyadeho’vibhedyakaḥ ||3.16.40|| svambālikāyutaścāpi yuddhakauśalyaśevadhiḥ | cintāmaṇyabhiyuktaśca maṇimauktikabhūṣaṇaḥ ||41 || jalāntardīpakāntiścāndhakāre suprakāśavān | naisargadṛḍhavarmāḍhyaḥ śastraprasavatūṇavān ||42|| sudhāsrāvikesarāḍhyo mṛtyuhṛtkalgiśobhitaḥ | puṣṭaḥ sarvāṃgatāmrāḍhyaścāgapya māṃ nanāma saḥ || 43|| patkhurairharṣaṇaśabdaiḥ stavanaiḥ pakṣavistaraiḥ | uccāgrairjavakampaiśca svāgataṃ sa mamācarat ||44|| mayā vāhanarūpo’sau nirvidhnāya prapūjitaḥ | vijayāya ca tatpṛṣṭhe datto dakṣaḥ karo mayā |||45||| amṛtaṃ pāyitaścāpi bhāle tilakitastathā | yātrārthaṃ bodhitaścāpi saṃgarārthaṃ prahreṣitaḥ ||46|| hreṣāśabdo’sya vai lakṣmi dikpālānāṃ gṛhān yayau | cakampe dyauḥ samastā vai pṛthivyāstatra kā daśā ||47|| parvatāśca samudrāśca jaladevāśca mātaraḥ | varuṇaśca nadā nadyo yuddhārthaṃ militā mayā ||48|| svasvavāhanasaṃyuktāścākāritā mayāyayuḥ | viṣṇuhastatalotpannaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ mahāgajam ||49|| cādhiruhya devarājastatra lakṣmi samāyayau | rudraujaḥsaṃbhavaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ ca pauṇḍrakābhidham ||3.16.50|| mahiṣaṃ dharmarājaśca samāruhyāyayau tadā | brahmakarṇamalodbhūtaṃ śyāmaṃ jaladhināmakam ||51|| śiśumāramadhiruhya varuṇastatra cāyayau | tathā śakaṭacakrākṣaṃ śelākāraṃ naraṃ śubham ||52|| sapakṣaṃ cāmbikāpajjamāruhya dhanadaḥ sthitaḥ | gandharvān bhujagendrām̐ścāruhya śvetavṛṣām̐stathā ||53|| rudrā raudrāsuranāśārthaṃ tatra samupāyayuḥ| ardhasahasrahaṃsāḍhyarathamāruhya candramāḥ ||54|| āyayau ca tathādityā hayoṣṭrarathavāhanāḥ | kuṃjarasthā vasavaśca yakṣāśca naravāhanāḥ ||55|| kinnarā bhujagārūḍhā hayārūḍhau tathāśvinau | sāraṃgādhiṣṭhitāścāpi marutaścāyayurbalāḥ ||56|| gandharvāśca svarārūḍhā agnirmeṣasya pṛṣṭhagaḥ | samudrā makarārūḍhā surā yānavimānagāḥ ||57|| brahmā haṃsasamārūḍho viṣṇurgaruḍavāhanaḥ | ṛṣayaścāsanasthāśca pitaraḥ puṇyavāhanāḥ ||58|| pṛthivī śeṣavāhā ca śeṣaḥ kacchapavāhanaḥ | kacchapā meghavāhāśca meghāśca vāyuvāhanāḥ ||59|| parvatāḥ pakṣavāhāśca vidyuto meghavāhitāḥ | nadā nadyastaraṃgasthāḥ saśastrāḥ samupāyayuḥ ||3.16.60 || tadā vādyānyavādyanta devānāṃ tānarohiṇaḥ | baladā ninadāścāpyaśrūyanta dyusadāṃ tadā ||6 1 || vyāghrānalaḥ praśuśrāva ninādān vai digantagān | ruṣṭaścāpyasahamānastūrṇamāsphoṭayan muhuḥ ||62| ūrūn karatalaiścāpyamocayaccāṭṭahāsakān | ūrdhve coḍḍīya saṃvīkṣya yuddhasannāhasaṃsthitān ||63|| surān śīghraṃ gadāṃ gurvīmudgṛhya garvamohitaḥ | ākāśaṃ pūrayan tanvā māṃ surān prati cāyayau ||64|| ucchraye gamanasparśī dīrghaścāyutayojanaḥ | viśālo vārdhivad vyāghrānalo yuddhārthamāyayau ||65|| indreṇa dharmarājena samaṃ yuddhaṃ cakāra saḥ | varuṇena dhanadena samaṃ yuddhaṃ cakāra saḥ ||66|| candramasā tathā rudrairādityairyuyudhe’pi saḥ | mūrchāṃ prāpya punaryuddhaṃ cakre balī punaḥ punaḥ ||67|| yakṣaiśca kinnaraiścāpi marudbhiryuyudhe balī | agninā brahmaṇā sākaṃ viṣṇunā yuyudhe muhuḥ ||68|| parvataiścāpi vidyudbhiryuyudhe cātidāruṇaḥ | sahasrarūpadhṛgbhūtvā yuyudhe ca suraiḥ saha ||69|| pradhāvan vyomamārgeṇākarṣayan grahamaṇḍalam | nakṣatrāṇi pātayaṃśca dudrāva yuyudhe’pi ca ||3.16.70|| sthiraṃ tadāmbaraṃ cāpi sakampaṃ vai vyalakṣyata | vāyustarā vyamuñcanta dhṛtiśaktīḥ prakampitāḥ ||71 || pṛthvī kampena ca tadā saṃsthānāni vyasarjayan | nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca gatayo’pi savyāhatayo’bhavan ||72|| vijayasyāpi viśvāsaścāgād dvayorhi saṃśayam | pralayo mumude cāti puṣṭiṃ vīkṣyāyatau nijām ||73|| āyudhāni samastāni praviśya varṣma cāsuram | viniryānti paraṃ pāraṃ mārgagānīva romataḥ ||74|| nāsya dehe garbhabhāge sparśo’pi śastrakṛttadā | jāyate tādṛśaścāste yuddhyatyatyantamojasā ||75|| prāṇān glahām̐stadā kṛtvā paṇaṃ kṛtvā vināśane | nāśe vā niścayaṃ kṛtvā vṛkānalaḥ prayuddhyati ||76 || gadayā tomareṇāpi śaktyā pāśena cāsinā | khaḍgena kṣepaṇaiścāpi parvataiścopalādibhiḥ ||77|| śūlena cāpi cakreṇa daṇḍena ca śaraistathā | vakṣasā bāhunā cāpi hastyādibhiśca tāḍanaiḥ ||78|| evaṃ yuddhaṃ cakārāsau vṛkānalo’surastadā | devāśca balavanto’pi prāpurmahāpariśramam ||79|| athāhaṃ ca tadā lakṣmi viniścitya durāsadam | cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ cāsmai mumoca lakṣadhāravat ||3.16.80|| pralayāgnisamaṃ ghoraṃ svargapātāladāhakam | vardhamānaṃ mahadrūpaṃ dadāhainaṃ samantataḥ ||8 1|| vyāghrānalaśarīrādvai khaṇḍāstadā tu koṭiśaḥ | pṛthagbhūtāḥ kartitā ye te’pi vyāghrānalāḥ punaḥ ||82|| bhavanti tvasurāstena tulyāstatra hi saṅgare | cakraṃ tūrṇaṃ mayājñaptaṃ dahyatyeva ca tānapi ||83 || antarīkṣaṃ samastaṃ ca tadā vahnyambaraṃ hyabhūt | pralayāgnisamāvyāptaṃ brahmāstramiva vā hyabhūt ||84|| tadā mayā tvamājñaptā mahāmāyāsvarūpiṇī | mohinīrūpamāsthāyāsurasya jaḍatāptaye ||85|| sannidhāvambare prāptāsuro mohamupāgataḥ | yuddhaṃ cāsaṃkhyarūpāṇi tyaktvā tvāṃ dhartumāgataḥ ||86|| samāślikṣacca yāvat tvāṃ tāvat tvayā svavahninā | vyāghrānalasya vahnirvai samasto’pi hṛto’ntarāt ||87|| vyāghrānalo vinā bhānaṃ vinānalaṃ ca taijasam | jaḍībhūto’bhavattāvat sudarśanena bheditaḥ ||88|| papāta śatadhā cāpi sahasradhā mahārṇave | khaṅkaśṛṃgāṇi jātāni vārdhau taddehakhaṇḍakāḥ ||89|| nirjīvāśca jalamadhye parvatā iva te’bhavan | evaṃ vyāghrānale lakṣmi nāśite meghagarjanāḥ ||3.16.90|| ākāśe cābhavam̐statra samudrāścārdratāṃ yayuḥ | mama dehāttadā dhārā jalānāṃ ca pariśramāt ||91 || abhavan vardhamānāstāḥ samudrānabhyapūrayan | ākāśādabhavad vṛṣṭirjayapuṣpākṣatātmikā ||92|| surā mudaṃ yayuścāpi pupūjurmāṃ śriyāḥ patim | mayāpi satkṛtā devāḥ kṛtakāryā nijālayam ||93||| yayurlakṣmi tadā tvaṃ cādṛśyabhāvamupāgatā | mamāpi vāhanaṃ cāśvastvayā sākaṃ pitustava ||94|| gṛhaṃ prāpayya ca tvāṃ tu miṣṭodaṃ samupāgataḥ | ahaṃ surānnamaskṛtya miṣṭodaṃ samupāgataḥ ||95|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | anādiśrīvārdhinārāyaṇanāmnā kṣitau tataḥ ||96|| prasiddhaścābhavaṃ mahyaṃ puṇḍarīkaḥ pitā tava | dadau putrīṃ tu vidhinā yogyāya me’ntarātmane ||97|| surādivanditāyeśeśvarāya paramātmane | tvāṃ samudvāhya vidhinā puṇḍarīkaśriyaṃ tataḥ ||98|| aśvaṃ ca vāhnaṃ labdhvāvicaraṃ bhuvanatraye | ākalpāntamatiṣṭham̐śca dharmarakṣaṇahetave ||99|| anādiśrīhariḥ so’haṃ parabrahma sanātanaḥ | vedmyahaṃ sarvamevaitat mama prākaṭyamuttamam || 3.16.10 0|| evaṃ jātā hyavatārā mama tatrāpyasaṃkhyakāḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇādvāpi kīrtanātsmaraṇādapi || 101 || bhuktimuktipradāḥ sarve camatkāraparāyaṇāḥ | smara nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śivaputri camatkṛtim || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ ekonaviṃśe vatsare raudrasya vyāghrānalāsurasya nāśanārtham anādiśrīvārdhinārāyaṇasya prākaṭyamiti nirūpaṇanāmā ṣoḍaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 16 ||
<3.17> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ ca tato mama | vedhasaḥ sṛṣṭimānākhye vatsare cādyakalpake || 1 || ādye manau saṃpravṛtte brahmā nidrāṃ vihāya ca | prabhāte devanadyāṃ vai snātuṃ yayau vicintayan || 2 || adya sṛṣṭiṃ kīdṛśīṃ ca kurve trilokiśobhanām | mādṛśīṃ sarvathā kurve bhedabhāvavivarjitām || 3 || iti saṃkalpya vai sasnau sandhyāṃ kṛtvā gṛhaṃ yayau | naityakaṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā sṛṣṭiśālāṃ samāviśat || 4 || sṛṣṭiyantraṃ sa pasparśa garbhayantraṃ vyalokayat | caturmukhā samastā ca sṛṣṭiradya prajāyatām || 5 || iti saṃkalpayāmāsa tāvanmaharṣayastataḥ | svatulyā abhavan sarve caturmukhā dvijātayaḥ || 6 || devāḥ sarve’pi ca tathābhavam̐ścaturmukhāḥ śubhāḥ | mānavāścāpi gandharvāḥ kinnarāḥ sādhyadevatāḥ || 7 || kiṃpumāṃsaḥ paśavaśca pakṣiṇaśca sarīsṛpāḥ | svedajā aṇḍajādyāśca jarāyūjāśca dehinaḥ || 8 || kalalotthāśca yādāṃsi mṛjjanyāḥ patrasaṃbhavāḥ | tṛṇotthā vivarotthāśca pātālādisamudbhavāḥ || 9 || sarve vedhaḥprasaṃkalpājjātāścaturmukhā nanu | daityāśca dānavāścāpi rākṣasā āsurāstathā || 3.17.1 0|| yakṣāḥ piśācakā bhūtāḥ sarvabhavam̐ścaturmukhāḥ | vedhasā pitṛbhirdevairmānavairbhaktapuṃgavaiḥ || 1 1|| kathāprasaṃge sarvatra varṇito’haṃ caturmukhaḥ | sarve caturmukhāḥ santītyevaṃ vedā vadantyapi || 1 2|| muktāścaturmukhāḥ sarve īśvarāśca caturmukhāḥ | ityevaṃ kalpanāṃ cakrurnijavat kathakā janāḥ || 13 || atha brahmarṣayaḥ sādhyāḥ sādhavo brahmacāriṇaḥ | yatra yatra kathāśālā vivadanti ca matkṛte || 14|| kecid vadanti bhagavānāste sahasramastakaḥ | anye vadanti bhagavānāste’pyasaṃkhyamastakaḥ || 15|| sarvatrānanavānāste pravadanti pare tadā | apare ca tadā śrīśo vartate hyekamastakaḥ || 16 || caturānana evaṃ cetare sma pravadanti ca | yathā vayaṃ tathā so’pi yathā haristathā hyajaḥ || 17|| yathā brahmā tathā sarve maharṣayastathā surāḥ | tathā ca mānavāḥ sarve vayaṃ yathā tathā hariḥ || 18|| evaṃ tatrāvadan kecidevamāsīd vivādanam | etannirṇayalābhārthaṃ vivādā bahavo’bhavan || 19|| atharṣibhirmānivaiśca devaiḥ saṃhatya bhūtale | taṭe suvarṇagaṃgāyāścottare pariṣat kṛtā ||3.17.20|| tatra dvijāgraṇīḥ śrautavṛṣarṣiḥ prāha kīdṛśaḥ | bhagavān vai parabrahma yaḥ samupāsyate prabhuḥ ||21 || vaidikāstu tadā prāhurvedaprāmāṇyagāmina | sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt ||22|| anye prāhuśca taṃ deveśvareśvaraṃ hariṃ tadā | sarvataḥ pāṇipādo’yaṃ sarvato’kṣiśiromukhaḥ ||23|| sarvataḥ śrutimān śrīśaḥ sarvātmā sa pratiṣṭhati | pare prāhurhariṃ tatra parameśaṃ sanātanam ||24|| nirguṇaṃ ca nirākāraṃ niṣkriyaṃ rūpavarjitam | anye tadā tu taṃ prāhuścaturmukhaṃ nijādṛśam ||25|| brahmā prāha hariścāste’kṣare dhāmnyekamastakaḥ | dvibhujaśca dvipāccāpi dvicakṣuśca dvikarṇakaḥ ||26|| athāpare tadā prāhurnaiva naivaṃ kadāpi vai | trinetraḥ sa hariścāste sarvadā parameśvaraḥ ||27|| evaṃ vicāre jāte ca nirṇayastatra nābhavat | atha brahmā tadā prāhārādhanaṃ prati śārṅgiṇaḥ ||28|| harirvai kīdṛśaścetyārādhanāgocaro bhavet | vayamārādhayāmastaṃ cirakālaṃ janārdanam ||29|| athāste bhagavān divyastathā dṛśyo bhaviṣyati | atha sarve militvaiva svarṇanadītaṭe ca te ||3.17.3 0|| japayajñātmikāṃ mukhyāṃ bahubhaktyupabṛṃhitām | ārebhire gocaro’stvityārādhanāṃ priye mama ||3 1 || sahasradivyamānāṃ te cakrurārādhanāṃ mama | tatastaṃ havanaṃ cakrurudyāpanātmakārhaṇam ||32|| utsavaṃ sumahāntaṃ sampracakruḥ kīrtanātmakam | dānabhojanarūpaṃ ca nṛtyagītapuraḥsaram ||33|| teṣāṃ tu bhāvanāpūrtyai madrūpanirṇayāya ca | bhakteḥ phalaṃ pradātuṃ ca gocaro’haṃ tadābhavam ||34|| cidākāśātmakaṃ tejastejorāśyātmakaṃ param | prathamaṃ sarvatastatra nibiḍaṃ samadṛśyata ||35|| apāraṃ cāpyadṛśyaṃ cāpraveśyaṃ caikarūpakam | anantasūryacandrāgnigrahatejo’bhibhāvakam ||36|| tatastatrāsaṃkhyatānā asaṃkhyabhinnabhāsvarāḥ | ekadeśād viniryāntaḥ parārdhakiraṇavrajāḥ || 37|| adṛśyantābhitaścādhaścordhvaṃ pārśveṣu sarvataḥ | tatsthale pāradṛśyaṃ ca nirmalaṃ śītalaṃ sukham || 38|| hṛdyaṃ tathānavadyaṃ ca sarvatejaḥpaṭātmakam | mūlaṃ paridhirūpaṃ vai paṭalaṃ samadṛśyata ||39|| yanmadhye mandahāsyāḍhyā snehapremakhanistathā | divyā hyasaṃkhyakāmānāṃ rūpagarvābhibhāvinī ||3.17.40|| mūrtistvekānanā netradvayakarṇadvayānvitā | ekamūrdhā dvihastā ca dvipādā cojjvalā hyati ||41 || samadṛśyata ramyā cānandapūrṇā manoharā | vakrasnigdhacākacakyojjvalatānvitamūrddhajā ||42|| svarṇacañcattārakalgisaṃśobhanmukuṭānvitā | ratnanaddhasusauvarṇamakarākārakuṇḍalā |||43 || koṭicandraprabhābhāsvanmandahāsyānanā śubhā | svarṇahārālisaṃrājatpuṣṭavakṣaḥsthalānvitā ||44|| bhujaṃgabhujaśobhāḍhyā kaustubhahārarājitā | śrīvatsacihnayuktā ca bhujabandhasuśobhitā ||45|| sauvarṇakaṭakāḍhyā ca śaṃkhacakrādiśobhitā | pītāmbarā pītaraktaprāvaraṇāḍhyakañcukā ||46|| sauvarṇaraśanāyuktā svarṇakaṭakaśobhanā | sauvarṇaśṛṃkhalāyuktā svarṇanupūrarājitā ||47|| svarṇormikānvitāṅgulīyakayuktakarāgrajā | mīnaśūladhvajadhanurbāṇasvastikarājitā ||48|| pakvabimbaphalatulyauṣṭhadvayarājitā śubhā | mīnacañcalanetrāḍhyā padmapatrāyatekṣaṇā ||49|| tilapuṣpopamanāsā dvicandrābhakapolikā | koṭikāmanivāsārhabhrūkuṭidvayakarṣikā ||3.17.50|| ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣīyā śmaśrurekhāvirājitā | puṣṭaskandhā sthalapadmamṛdusatkarapattalā ||51 || alaktaraṃgavadbhāḍhyā hastiśuṇḍhoruśobhanā | śirīṣapuṣpavanmṛdvī nakhacandrasamujjvalā ||52|| trivalyudaranābhyāḍhyā sarvānandapariplutā | rājīvalocanā śāntā padmaprakoṣṭhaśobhanā ||53|| suṣṭhuvartulajānvāḍhyā samavṛttordhvajaṃghikā | sarvakāmanivāsāḍhyajaghanātimanoharā ||54|| sarvasaugandhyasaundaryasarvamādhuryasaṃbhṛtā | sarvavātsalyasauśīlyaudāryasauhārdapūritā ||55|| sarvaiśvaryaguṇaśakticamatkāranidhānikā | sarvābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyalakṣmyā tvayā virājitā ||56|| anekapārṣadairyuktā sevitā muktamaṇḍalaiḥ | muktānībhirvanditā ca mūrtirme samadṛśyata ||57|| ekamastakayā lakṣmyā sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhayā | vyajanena sudivyena vījitā vāmasaṃsthayā ||58|| kamalānāṃ sumālābhiryuktayā ramyayā śriyā | ālokitā tu netrābhyāṃ netrayoścāntarajñayoḥ ||59|| vīkṣitā sarvadevādyaiḥ sāścaryaṃ sā hyapūrvikā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtiḥ sanātanī ||3.17.60|| pupūjuste tadā sarve natvā māṃ tādṛśaṃ prabhum | nirṇayaṃ te paraṃ jagmurdṛṣṭvā māmekamastakam ||6 1|| tuṣṭuvuśca surādyā vai nīrājanaṃ vyadhustataḥ | ahaṃ copādideśaitān sākṣād yathā bhavāmi ca ||62|| devādyā yad bhavanto’tra śṛṇvantu māṃ svarūpiṇam | dvibhujo’haṃ sadā cāsmyakṣare dhāmni parātpare ||63|| ekānano divyarūpaḥ svecchānaikavapurdharaḥ | caturbhujo’thavā śatabhujaḥ sahasrahastakaḥ ||64|| tathāvidhānanaścāpi bhavāmi kāryarodhagaḥ | vibhinnāni svarūpāṇi bhavanti tu madicchayā ||65|| kāryaṃ yogyaṃ vinirvartya tirodadhāmi tāṃ tanūm | ārādhito bhavadbhiśca nirṇayārthaṃ pareśvara ||66 || so’haṃ yathāsvarūpo’smi tathāsmi cātra gocaraḥ | etanmama svarūpaṃ copāsitavyaṃ nirantaram ||67|| anantasṛṣṭināśe’pi yanna layaṃ prayāti vai | nāpyadṛśyatvamāpnoti tadrūpaṃ mama caiva hi ||68 || dhārayantu hṛdayeṣu bhajantvetannirantaram | pūjayantu stuvantvetadrūpaṃ me śāśvataṃ śubham ||69|| athādṛśyo bhavāmyeva paśyatāṃ bhavatāmiha | vivādaṃ samparityajya bhajantu māṃ sadedṛśam ||3.17.70|| evamukteṣu deveṣu mānaveṣu maharṣiṣu | mānasānyabhavam̐steṣāṃ kṣitau matsthāpanāya ha ||71 || prāhuste parameśaṃ māṃ dehināṃ mokṣaṇāya vai | nivāsaṃ mānave loke vidhehi bhagavan sadā ||72|| dharmamārgastathā muktiḥ sevayā te hi dehinām | bhaviṣyati kṛpāmetāṃ kuru śrīpuruṣottama ||73 || athāhaṃ cintayāmāsa kṛpayā dehināṃ hitam | ātyantikaṃ ca kalyāṇaṃ matprasaṃgād bhavediti ||74|| mama yogena bhaktā me bhaviṣyanti yuge yuge | santaścāpi bhaviṣyanti dharmamokṣaprasādhakāḥ ||75|| teṣāṃ yogena jīvānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ ca bhaviṣyati | tasmānmayā kṣitau stheyaṃ mānavaiḥ saha pāvanaiḥ ||76 || kṛtvā mānavarūpaṃ ca caturmukhaṃ yathāprajam | lakṣmyā cāpi tathā caturmukhayā stheyameva ha ||77|| itiniścitya cāhaṃ vai tadā lakṣmi janān munīn | tathāstviti prāvadaṃ ca sarve duṣṭāstadābhavan ||78|| pupūjuḥ parayā prītyā puṣpākṣatasucandanaiḥ | athāhaṃ pitarau bhūmau vyacintayaṃ caturmukhau ||79|| tvayā sākaṃ tadā lakṣmi cādṛśyatāmupāyayau | devāśca mānavāḥ sarve svasvalokaṃ yayustadā ||3.17.80|| athāhaṃ kṛṣṇayaśasaṃ vipraṃ dharmayutaṃ śubham | pitaraṃ cākalpayaṃ ca tasyāhaṃ mānasaḥ sutaḥ ||8 1 || bhāryayā tu prabhāvatyādhyāsitaśca caturmukhaḥ | āvirabhavaṃ tatraiva prabhāvatyaṃkagaḥ sutaḥ ||82|| aṣṭabhujaḥ pitrākṛtiścaturmukho’tiśobhanaḥ | devadundubhayo nedustadā kusumavarṣaṇam ||83 || jayaśabdā abhavam̐ścarṣīṇāṃ tadāśiṣo’bhavan | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||84|| jātamantro yuvānādicaturmukhanarāyaṇaḥ | svayamevābhavaṃ sarveṣṭasya pūraṇahetave ||85|| tvaṃ tataśca mayādiṣṭā madhuvidyasya vai gṛhe | viprasya mākṣikīsatyā bhāryāyā mānasī sutā ||86|| caturmukhāṣṭahastā ca vyajāyathāḥ svayaṃ ramā | sarvalakṣaṇasampannā sarvasadguṇaśālinī ||87|| jātamātrā yuvatī tvaṃ mānasī yugadharmataḥ | tvatpitṛbhyāṃ madarthaṃ tvaṃ kalpitā parameśvarī ||88|| vivāhavidhinā ca tvāṃ pariṇeme’hamuttamām | kumārikāṃ pūrvasarvasmarāmaiśvaryaśālinīm ||89|| tadā sṛṣṭiścaturvaktravatī cāsādya māṃ harim | tvāṃ cāsādya samānāṃ cāsevayat samaśīlinī || 3.17.90|| ākalpāntaṃ tadā cāsaṃ sākaṃ tvayā śubhānane | caturānanasṛṣṭīnāṃ sevāgrahaṇahetave ||9 1 || asaṃkhyātāścāvatārā mama sākaṃ tvayā priye | teṣu teṣu ca varṣasya kalpeṣvāsan tathāvidhāḥ ||92|| sarvakalyāṇakartāraḥ sarvasaṃkalpapūrakāḥ | vedmyahaṃ sarvamevaitannānye jānanti sarvaśaḥ ||93 || smara naijaṃ śivadeviśrī janma svaṃ caturmukham | pramākṣikīramānāmnī tadā khyātimagāḥ khalu ||94|| tadā kalpe tava mūrtirmama mūrtiścaturmukhī | āsīd devālayeṣvatra svargādiṣvapi tādṛśī ||95|| pṛthvyāṃ gṛhe gṛhe cāsan tathāvidhā hi mūrtayaḥ | māṃ bhajitvā yayurdhāma janā ye te dvihastakāḥ ||96|| divyarūpāstadā bhūtvā tyaktvā śavaṃ caturmukham | aṣṭahastaṃ parityajya bhūtvā caikānanā drutam ||97|| prāpurmatpārṣadairnītā dhāmākṣaraṃ parātparam | mukhānāṃ cābhidhānāni diṅnāmabhistadābhavan ||98|| viprāṇāṃ tu vṛṣajñānavirāgabhaktibhāñji vai | mukhānyāsan prasiddhāni bhuktimuktipradāni vai ||99|| kṣatriyāṇāṃ sāntvadāmabhedadaṇḍābhibhāñji ca | vaiśyānāṃ tu ca dharmārthakāmamokṣābhibhāñji ca || 3.17.1 00|| sarveṣāṃ ca satyadayāyajñatapomayāni ca | sukhānyāsan prasiddhāni tattatphalapradāni ha || 10 1|| dāsānāṃ tu vyavasāyadāsyatuṣṭistavāñci ca | evamāsan mukhānyeva phaladāni tadā sṛjau || 1 02|| ityevaṃ śrīśivasvāmisute prākaṭyameva me | tvayā sākaṃ tadā jātamudīritaṃ sukhāspadam || 1 03|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇātpāpanāśanam | yatheṣṭarddhiprāpaṇaṃ ca mokṣalābhaḥ prajāyate || 1 04|| sarvatīrthaphalānyeva sarvayajñaphalānyapi | sarvavrataphalānyeva jāyante nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso viṃśatitame vatsare sṛṣṭisadṛśasyānādicaturmukhanārāyaṇasya pramākṣikīramāsahitasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||
<3.18> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ satkathāṃ paramāṃ mama | ekaviṃśe vedhaso vai vatsare vedavatsare || 1 || kalpe’śītitame cāpi manau dvādaśake purā | abhūd bhaktaḥ puṇyarāto dvijo bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 2 || patnī tasya rādhanikānāmnī cābhūt pativratā | dampatī cakraturnityaṃ snānaṃ dhyānaṃ mamārhaṇam || 3 || bhajanaṃ cakratuścāpi japayajñaṃ ca saṃghaśaḥ | akhaṇḍanāmadhunyaṃ ca pracakratuḥ kvacitkvacit || 4 || lakṣatulasikāpatraiḥ pūjanaṃ cakratuśca me | kārtike ca madarthaṃ vai vratānyudyāpanāni ca || 5 || navānnānāṃ sumiṣṭānāṃ naivedyāni pracakratuḥ | māghe vāsantikaṃ cāpyutsavaṃ pracakratustathā || 6 || puṣpadolotsavaṃ cāpi vaiśākhasya vratāni ca | cāturmāsye niyamām̐śca bhaktiyuktān pracakratuḥ || 7 || nityaṃ pracakratuḥ sādhusādhvīsevāṃ samutsukau | tābhyāṃ sādhumukhādākarṇitaṃ kathāprasaṃgataḥ || 8 || annadānātparaṃ dānaṃ vastradānaṃ prakīrtyate | vastradānāt paraṃ dānaṃ dhanadānaṃ prakīrtyate || 9 || dhanadānātparaṃ dānaṃ godānaṃ samprakīrtyate | godānācca paraṃ dānaṃ kanyādānaṃ prakīrtyate || 3.18.1 0|| kanyādānāt paraṃ dānaṃ putradānaṃ suvaṃśakṛt | putradānāt paraṃ dānaṃ kṣetradānaṃ prakīrtyate ||1 1|| kṣetradānātparaṃ dānamārogyasya pradānakam | ārogyadānataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ savṛttigṛhadānakam || 1 2|| savṛttigṛhadānācca puṇyadānaṃ paraṃ matam | puṇyadānāddharmakarmapradānaṃ paramaṃ matam || 13|| dharmakarmapradānācca jñānadānaṃ sadādhikam | jñānadānād bhaktidānaṃ sarvebhyaścātiricyate || 14|| bhaktidānāt svargadānaṃ śāśvatānandadāyakam | śreṣṭhaṃ bhaktiyutaṃ cettat tato’bhayapradānakam || 15|| sarvadānāni ramyāṇi paralokapradāni ca | brahmāṇḍadānatulyāni yāni yāni ca santi vai || 16|| jīvābhayapradānasya nārhanti ṣoḍaśīṃ kalām | abhayaṃ kālato māyātaścāpi karmatastathā || 17|| pāpato yamadūtāśca kuhṛdbhyaḥ śatrutastathā | vāsanātaśca bandhebhyo muktiścābhayadānakam || 18|| apunarāvṛttirūpā muktiryā sādhikā tataḥ | sālokyā tatra vai śreṣṭhā sārṣṭyākhyāto garīyasī || 1 9|| sārūpyākhyā tataḥ śreṣṭhatarā proktā sukhānvitā | sāmīpyākhyā sarvaśreṣṭhatamā tato’pi vai tadā ||3.18.20|| sāyujyākhyā cātiśreṣṭhatamā yatparamā na vai | vidyate’nyābhayadānātmikā mūrddhanyaśālinī ||2 1|| tasmāt sarvapradānebhyo’bhayadānaṃ viśiṣyate | anyairvai pūrvakāle yad yādṛśaṃ nārpitaṃ kṛtam || 22|| tādṛśaṃ dānamevātra dātavyaṃ cābhayātmakam | ityevaṃ ca satāṃ vaktrāchrutvā kathāmṛtaṃ tataḥ ||23|| puṇyarātastathā patnī vicāraṃ cakraturmuhuḥ | dānaṃ dadatyatra loke dhanāḍhyāśca dhanādikam ||24|| āvābhyāṃ tu pradātavyaṃ pūrvaṃ kaiścinna yat kṛtam | yādṛśaṃ na pradattaṃ ca tādṛśaṃ deyameva nau ||25|| athaivaṃ tau saṃvicārya kuruto bhaktidānakam | jñānaṃ bhaktiṃ dadataśca kurutaśca svayaṃ sadā ||26|| evaṃ yāteṣu māseṣu varṣeṣvapi ca vai tataḥ | prāṇāyāmaparau jātau yogakriyāparāyaṇau || 27|| prāṇarodhasamarthau ca samādhisthitivartinau | tāpasau brahmaparamau tyaktadehasukhau tataḥ ||28|| videhau jīvanamuktau māyāsaṃgavivarjitau | kṣapitabandhakarmāṇau dagdhaiṣaṇau ca yoginau ||29|| anyeṣāmabhayadānadharmamātraparāyaṇau | vicārayantau satataṃ kathaṃ mokṣāśca dehinām ||3.18.3 0|| ātyantiko bhaveccātra kartavyaṃ dānameva tat | abhīdānasamaṃ dānaṃ nānyad bhavati vai tataḥ ||3 1 dātavyaṃ cābhayadānaṃ sarvajīvebhya eva ha | ekaikasmai mokṣadānaṃ copadeśād bhavediha | mantradānaiḥ śatānāṃ ca sahasrāṇāṃ bhavediha || 32 yatnaśca bahulastatra sādhanasyāvalambinoḥ | āvayorvai bhavedeva tasmāt sādhye svayaṃ harau ||33| yatnaḥ samyaga vidhātavyaḥ prāpaṇīyaḥ pareśvaraḥ | bhūlokasthamanuṣyāṇāṃ tatsambandhavatāṃ tathā ||34| tiraścāmapi mokṣaḥ syādevamarthyaḥ pareśvaraḥ | yuge vā yugadaśake manau vānyamanau sthite ||35|| pratyakṣaḥ śrīhariścāyād dadyānmuktiṃ ca śāśvatīm | sarvebhyo mānavebhyaśca yathā yatnastathātra vai ||36|| dehenānena kartavyo mahān svalpastu naiva ha | ityāniścitya kamale tāvubhau bhaktisaṃyutau ||37|| mama mūrteḥ samīpasthau jagrahaturvrata dṛḍham | adyārabhya japayajñaḥ kartavyaḥ śrīhareḥ śubhaḥ ||38|| rātriṃdivaṃ vyomavāsaṃ kṛtvā bhuktvaikakālikam | phalaṃ caikavidhaṃ vāri pātavyaṃ caikavārakam ||39|| yāvaddharirmilennaiva kartavyaṃ tāvadeva hi | śīlaṃ vrataṃ sadā rakṣyaṃ vane vastavyameva ca ||3.18.40 || ityevaṃ vrataniyamaṃ gṛhītvā dampatī hi tau | yugādidinamārabhya cakratustapa uttamam ||41 || dehasya dhāraṇe śaktau yatheṣṭaṃ tyajane’pi ca | kālasya rodhane śaktau mṛtyuñjayau babhūvatuḥ ||42|| aniśaṃ māṃ bhajamānau nārāyaṇaparāyaṇau | babhūvatuḥ priyau me’pi mama bhaktiparāyaṇau ||43|| mayā tvadṛśyarūpaṃ ca tadrakṣārthaṃ sudarśanam | sthāpitaṃ tadvane pārśve kālādibhayanuttaye ||44|| dāvānalo’tivṛṣṭiśca jhaṃjhāvāto’tiśītatā | himavṛṣṭiśca vā krūraprāṇivighnādikaṃ sadā ||45|| nivāryate hi cakreṇa bhaktarakṣākareṇa me | adhairyasaṃbhṛtordvayoryugacatuṣṭayam ||46 || vyatītaṃ ca tataścāhaṃ viprarūpo yayau puraḥ | bhikṣāṃ dehīti madhyāhne’vocaṃ tayoḥ samīpataḥ ||47|| śīghramutthāya viprāya jalaṃ phalaṃ tathāsanam | pādyaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ ca namaskāraḥ kṣamāpanam ||48|| nārāyaṇaḥ prasanno’stu cetyuktvārpitameva me | labdhvā mayoktau tau bhaktau śreyo vāmastu sarvadā ||49|| omityuktvāhaturmāṃ tau hi sarveṣāṃ dehināmiha | śreyo yathā bhavet śreṣṭhamāśīrvādān pradehi nau ||3.18.50 || mayoktaṃ pāpino jīvā bhavanti vāsanāmayāḥ | teṣāṃ śreyo bhaveccāpi tapoyogasamādhibhiḥ ||51|| bahukālānuṣṭhitaiśca nālpakālena vai khalu | tāvāhaturhariścātra nau kadā vai miliṣyati ||52|| sarvamānavamokṣārthaṃ kadā sākṣānmiliṣyati | sarvadehipramokṣārthaṃ kadā kṛṣṇo miliṣyati ||53|| mayā śrutvā tadoktaṃ vai vāṃ harirmilito’sti vai | sarvamānavamokṣārthamardhamanvantare gate ||54|| miliṣyati hariḥ sākṣāttapobhaktivalādiha | pūrṇe manvantare yāte tiraścāmapi muktaye ||55|| miliṣyati prabhuścātra yathābuddhi vadāmyaham | ityāśrutya sīmavākyaṃ prahṛṣṭau tāvubhāvapi ||56|| pādayoḥ patitau me ca pupūjatuḥ punaḥ punaḥ | nematuśca muhuḥ pādarajaḥ sma lihatastadā ||57|| ayaṃ nārāyaṇaśceti vijñāya tau samutsuko | darśanaṃ nijarūpasya dehīti vadataḥ sma mām ||58|| ahaṃ tadā prasannaśca dadau divyaṃ svadarśanam | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ prasannatānvitam ||59|| anekakoṭicandrabhānanaṃ cābharaṇānvitam | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakratuśca vividhapūjanam ||3.18.60|| varārthaṃ kathitau tau ca prārthayāmāsatustadā | mānavānāṃ kṣitisthānāṃ tatsambandhavatāṃ tathā ||61 || prāṇināṃ paramāṃ muktimicchāvo yugapat prabho | varaṃ varāṇāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ taṃ sarvābhayapradānakam ||62|| dehi nātha kṛpāsindho prasanno bhava keśava | itinārāyaṇīśri prārthayatāṃ tau varaṃ param ||63|| mayoktau bhavatormokṣakaraṇārthamahaṃ tviha | samāyāto’smi tūrṇaṃ cāgacchatāṃ vai mayā saha ||64|| āvāhatuḥ prabho mokṣo nau te yogānna saṃśayaḥ | jñāta eva ca jīvānāṃ mānavānāṃ tu mokṣaṇam ||65|| vināvāṃ na prayāsyāvo yatheṣṭaṃ kuru vatsale | hariḥ prāha tathecchāpi pūrṇā kālena vai kvacit ||66|| bhaviṣyati tapobhaktyā yāmi vāṃ kuśalaṃ bhavet | ityuktvāhaṃ tirobhāvaṃ tūrṇaṃ jagāma padmaje || 67|| tau prasannau pūrṇakāmau vardhamānapraharṣaṇau | cakraturmama bhaktiṃ ca smarantau viprarūpiṇam ||68|| nityaṃ navotsāhavantau catvāriṃśadyugāvadhim | cakratuśca tapobhaktiṃ tadāhaṃ punarāyayau ||69|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ śrībhagavān svayam | tāpasau mama bhaktau tu śuṣkadehau jagāda ha ||3.18.70|| manuṣyān bhūsthitān sarvān nītvā yātaṃ mamākṣaram | evaṃ phalaṃ tapaso vāṃ pradātuṃ samupāgataḥ ||71 || svīkurutaṃ tapaḥsiddhiṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ pramuktidām | tatastau māṃ prapūjyaiva saṃsevya paramādarāt ||72|| āhaturbhagavannatra manuṣyāṇāṃ gṛhe gṛhe | gāvo’śvāḥkariṇaścoṣṭrā ajāścāśvatarā mṛgāḥ ||73 || ūraṇāḥ śvāpadāścāpi siṃhāśca gavayādikāḥ | ye ye vai paśavaḥ santi śukādyāḥ pakṣiṇaśca ye ||74|| sarīsṛpādyā ye cāpi ye manuṣyopayoginaḥ | sarve te mānavaiḥ sākaṃ muktimīyustathā kuru ||75|| tān vihāya manuṣyāṇāṃ muktiṃ necchāva eva ha | śrutvāhaṃ cāvadaṃ tābhyāṃ cireṇaiva bhaviṣyati ||76 || tatastau harṣasampannau jātau kālāvadhiṃ gatau | pūjāṃ prāpya tatastūrṇamahamadṛśyatāṃ yayau ||77|| atha bhaktau ca tau tadvat tapobhaktiparāyaṇau | ajāyatāṃ mayi snigdhau jalānnarahitau tataḥ ||78|| tapaḥ pūrṇaṃ tayorjātaṃ bhaktiḥ pūrṇābhavat tadā | tṛṇaśchannau mṛttikākhyau tapasā jātavigrahau ||79|| manvantare gate kāle madarthaṃ tau babhūvatuḥ | dehināmupakārārthaṃ muktyarthaṃ paśudehinām ||3.18.80|| abhīdānapradānārthaṃ tyaktasaukhyau babhūvatuḥ | mama yogapradānārthaṃ jīvānāṃ sarvathā hi tau ||8 1 || pāṣāṇamṛttikākalpau tapobhaktau babhūvatuḥ | tato’haṃ sahasā tatra lakṣmyā ca pārṣadaiḥ saha ||82|| sarvapūjādisāmagrīyukto vai samupāyayau | īśvarāścātha munayo devāśca ṛṣayo’pi ca ||83| | āyayuḥ sarvatīrthāni tatra sthale nu māṃ tadā | dundubhayaśca devānāmavādyanta tadāmbare ||84|| candanānāṃ suvṛṣṭiścāmṛtavṛṣṭistadābhavat | jayanādāśca bhūtānāmabhavanparito’bhitaḥ ||85|| vimānānyapyasaṃkhyānyāyātāni svargiṇāṃ tadā | madicchayā ca muktānāṃ koṭayaḥ samupāgatāḥ ||86|| koṭikoṭivimānāni koṭikoṭīśvarāstathā | koṭikoṭisurāścāpi koṭikoṭimaharṣayaḥ ||87|| ambaraṃ sarvathā vyāptamabhavan tadvimānakaiḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāṇo’haṃ puruṣottamaḥ ||88|| avatīrya vimānācca brahmahradajalaṃ sthale | tayostapaso bhūmau vai mṛttikāyāṃ nikuñjake ||89 || añjalinākṣipaṃ tatra tāvad bhūmermahānalaḥ | divyatejomayaḥ prāvirāsīt svargādhitaijasaḥ ||3.18.90 || tejomadhyaḥ tato jātā divyā tanurdvijasya ha | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharā mūrtiḥ suśobhanā ||91 || ākṣaramuktasadṛśī tatpatnī ca tathāvidhā | muktānikāsvarūpā cābhavat tatra ramādṛśī ||92|| ubhau mayābhāṣitau ca kṣemaṃ mokṣaṃ sukhaṃ prati | āhatustau kṛpayaiva pāraṃ yātau tavāśritau ||93|| muktiyogyau samanujaiḥ satatsambandhidehibhiḥ | paśupakṣyādibhiḥ sākaṃ jātau cedabhidhāritau ||94|| tadā nārāyaṇakṛṣṇa parameśa parātpara | muktiṃ dehi manuḥ kālo vyatīto vacanāttava | |95|| abhīpradānakaṃ dehi parameśvara mādhava | vimānāni hyasaṃkhyāni samāyātāni yāni ca ||96|| namastebhyo bhavatātra sahitebhyo’pi koṭidhā | namaḥ samastabhūtātman parameśa namo’stu te ||97|| akṣarādhipate cāntaryāmin bhaktārthapūraka | kuru muktiṃ dehināṃ vai madarthitāṃ tu satvaram ||98|| kṣamāparādhaṃ bhagavan manukālena vai mayā | tapobhaktyā niruddhastvaṃ sarveṣāṃ mokṣahetave ||99|| aparādhaparārdhāni mayā kṛtāni keśava | kṣāntvā dhāmāni sarvān vai dehino naya mādhava || 3.18.1 00|| yathāyogyāni dhāmāni naya svatantrako’si yat | nāgraho bhagavanme’tra svarge satye tathākṣare || 101 || ityarthitaṃ mama sarvaṃ vidhehi parameśvara | asaṃkhyābhayadānecchā pūritā svāminā tvayā || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaścaikaviṃśe varṣe sarvabhūmidehimokṣārthaṃ tapasyato rādhanikāpuṇyarātaviprayormanvantarakāle gate vāñcchāpūraṇārthaṃ śrīpuruṣottamanārāyaṇasya sarveśvaradevādisahitasyasamāgamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 18 ||
<3.19> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ tato’haṃ puruṣottamaḥ | puṇyaṃ bhaktiṃ tapo dṛṣṭvā bhaktayormanukālajam || 1 || yoginoḥ pātrayormamānugrahasya ca divyayoḥ | īśvarībhūtayorhārdaṃ pūrayituṃ purārthitam || 2 || bhūloke mānavā ye ye narā nāryo napuṃsakāḥ | bālā vṛddhā yuvānaśca vidhurā gṛhiṇastathā || 3 || tyāgino vanavāsāśca tān sarvān vai samantataḥ | yugapad divyadehāśca kṛtvā vimānasaṃsthitān || 4 || kām̐ścidapreṣayaṃ śvetadvīpaṃ kāṃścit kṣīrodaghim | kāṃścit svargaṃ ca vividhaṃ kām̐ścijjanaṃ mahastapaḥ || 5 || kām̐ścidvai satyalokaṃ ca kāṃścid vaikuṇṭhamāvṛtau | kām̐ścid vairājalokām̐śca kām̐ścid vaiṣṇavasatpadam || 6 || kām̐ścittu nityakailāsaṃ kāṃścidavyākṛtaṃ padam | amṛtaṃ dhāma kāṃścicca kām̐ścid vaikuṇṭhamuttamam || 7 || kām̐ścid golokamevāpi kām̐ścidakṣaramuttamam | kām̐ściddhāmānyanekāni yeṣāṃ yogyāni yāni ca || 8 || tāni tān prāpayāmāsa cāhaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | atha ye paśavaścāpi pakṣiṇaśca mṛgādayaḥ || 9 || sarīsṛpādayaścāpi mānavādhārajīvanāḥ | mānavāpekṣakāḥ sarve grāmāraṇyanivāsinaḥ || 3.19.10 || divyadehāḥ kṛtāstūrṇaṃ dvibhujā devakoṭayaḥ | tān sarvānapi divyeṣu vimāneṣu nidhāya ca || 1 1|| svargaṃ janaṃ mahaḥ satyaṃ sauryaṃ cāndraṃ ca vāruṇam | āgneyaṃ tāpasaṃ cārṣaṃ vairājaṃ dhāma ityapi || 12|| apreṣayaṃ yathāyogyān jīvān bhaktecchayā tvaham | dagdhvā janyāni karmāṇi bhūsthān jīvānamocayam || 1 3|| aprāpayaṃ divyalokān yathāpekṣamanugrahāt | lakṣmi kṛpā mayā ceyaṃ kṛtā bhaktānusāriṇī || 14|| bhūlokaḥ prāyaśaḥ śreyolokeṣu preṣito’bhavat | pṛthvī riktā ca sañjātā vinā mānavarūpakaiḥ || 15|| tathā tadyogayuktānāṃ paśvādīnāṃ ca rūpakaiḥ | riktā jātā mahī sarvā bhaktayostapaso balāt || 16|| puraiva mocitā jīvā abhīdānapradānakaiḥ | mama bhaktena vipreṇa puṇyarātena yoginā || 17|| madbhaktānyā tathā rādhanikayā dvijayoṣitā | sarvasṛṣṭau kṛpāluścāhaṃ tadā khyātimāpa ha || 18|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | bhaktādhīnaḥ prabhūtvaivākaravaṃ śreya uttamam || 19 || tato’bhavaṃ hyanādiśrīkṛpā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | śṛṇu lakṣmi tato bhaktaṃ puṇyarātaṃ tathā satīm || 3.19.20 || rādhanikāṃ divyadehau kṛtvā viṣṇusvarūpiṇau | vimāne sve sthāpayitvāpreṣayaṃ tau nijākṣaram || 21 || atha brahmādayo devā bhūtalaṃ vīkṣya nirjanam | prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ punarmānavasṛṣṭaye || 22|| paśvādīnāṃ ca sṛṣṭyarthaṃ sthātuṃ cākalpameva mām | tato’haṃ bhūtale loke nyavasaṃ divyarūpavān || 23 || tvayā divyasvarūpiṇyā lakṣmyā sākaṃ pumuttamaḥ | punaḥ sṛṣṭimakaravaṃ yathāpūrvāṃ tu mānasīm || 24|| mānavānāṃ paśūnāṃ ca pakṣiṇāṃ sarvadehinām | icchayā vedhasaścāpi nyavasaṃ kalpakāntakam || 25 || evaṃ muktiḥ kṛtā cāpi punaḥ sṛṣṭiḥ kṛtāpi ca | smara sarvaṃ śivarājñi pare jānanti naiva tat || 26|| avatārā hyasaṃkhyātā jātā me kāryato’pi ca | vatsare tatra kalpeṣu vedmi sarvānahaṃ priye || 27|| kṛpāvatīramā tvaṃ ca tadābhavo mayā saha | ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi prākaṭyaṃ mama vai tadā || 28 || athānyavatsare cāpi kathayāmi nibodha me | brahmaṇo vai rudravatsarākhye dviśatakalpake || 29 || babhūva cāraṇo bhakto rakṣālayābhidhānakaḥ | cāraṇī tasya bhāryā ca nāmnā tu santayoginī || 3.19.30 || yogabhraṣṭau pūrvabhaktau jātismarau babhūvatuḥ | bhajamānau ca māṃ bhaktyā nārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram || 31 || snānabhaktiparau sādhusādhvīsevāparāyaṇau | nivasataḥ sma mahiṣīgovraje drumasaṃkule || 3 2|| pallyāṃ kharvaṭanikaṭe tṛṇaghāsādiśobhane | antarīkṣaprakāśe vai kāmakalpānadītaṭe || 33 || cārayataḥ paśūnnityaṃ dadhighṛtādijīvanau | ūrṇavastrau hare kṛṣṇa nārāyaṇeti saṃsmarau || 34|| anivedya ca me sthālīṃ polikādadhipūritām | prātarnaiva na madhyāhne bhuñjāte na tathā niśi || 3 5|| jalaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ vanyadrumebhya eva ca | āhṛtya sundaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ hṛdyaṃ cārpayato mama || 36|| sādhavo’tithayaścāpyāyānti ye tu nijoṭajām | tebhyo’rpayato dugdhānnaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhi ca polikāḥ || 37|| santastṛptāḥ prakurvanti nāma saṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ | divāniśaṃ ca vā yānti yatheṣṭaṃ vā vasantyapi || 38|| sādhvyaścāpi samāyānti yoginyaḥ satyadevatāḥ | brahmacāriṇya evāpi prasiddhaṃ cāraṇālayam ||39|| devālayo yathā tadvad pallī sā govrajātmikā | satīsādhvīsatāṃ vāsād devālayasamābhavat ||3.19.40 || yatra madbhajanaṃ nityaṃ yatra matpūjanaṃ sadā | yatra matkīrtanaṃ nityaṃ tatra devālayo mama ||41 || ityahaṃ cāgocaro’pi nyavasaṃ tatra padmaje | bhaktānāṃ hṛdaye nityaṃ gṛhe cāpi ca maṇḍale || 42|| tīrthe cāpi vasāmyeva bhaktakalyāṇahetave | bhuñje svapimi nṛtyāmi pibāmi ca rame’nvaham ||43|| viharāmi vihasāmi sahayāmi viśāmi ca | yatte vadāmi gāyāmi prasīdāmi bhajāmi ca ||44|| snāmi śaucāmi saṃkurve cintayāmi ca raumyapi | bhaktaiḥ saha militvaivācarāmi vividhāṃ kriyām ||45|| līlāṃ mokṣakarīṃ sarvā divyāmānandayāmyapi | rāsabhāvena gopaiśca gopībhiśca bhrame’pi ca ||46|| madbhaktānāṃ nivāseṣu tathā vasāmi sarvadā | evaṃ cāraṇavāse’haṃ nyavasaṃ bhaktamaṇḍale ||47|| sarvathā sarvadādṛśyo na jānanti yathā hi te | tathāvasaṃ tayoḥ kuṭyāṃ govraje mūrtirūpavān ||48|| athaikadābhavat kāmakalpānadyāstaṭe śubhaḥ | sādhūnāṃ vai samājaśca mahotsavo’nnasatrakaḥ ||49|| tatra yātāścāraṇāśca sādhavo’pi samutsave | annasatramaye yajñe bhojayituṃ janānapi ||3.19.50 || annadānaṃ dugdhadānaṃ vastradānaṃ ghṛtārpaṇam | kriyate ca yathāśakti bhikṣukebhyo nadītaṭe ||51 || dānotsava itikhyātiḥ satrasyāsya tato’bhavam | tatra sarve cāraṇā vai gatāścātha tu cāraṇī ||52|| ekākinī gṛharakṣākṛte gehe sthitābhavat | vatsānāṃ pālanādyarthaṃ gṛhakāryārthamityapi ||53 || atha devāḥ samāyānti vyomamārgāt tadā bhuvi | dānasthale mahātīrthe mahāścaryaparāstadā ||54|| viprāśca bhikṣukā bhūtvā bhūtvā sādhusvarūpiṇaḥ | kiṃciddānaṃ svīkurvanti kāmakalpaphalapradam ||55|| dāturgrahitustulyaṃ vai jāyate tatra tatphalam | ataḥ puṇyapralobhena devā gṛhṇanti dānakam ||56|| vaicitryaṃ dānasatre’trobhayataḥ phaladaṃ yataḥ | athāmbarāttadā devo vaimāniko’lpapuṇyavān ||57||| niryayau vyomamārgeṇa pallīṃ paśyan nadīṃ prati | tena mohadṛśā dṛṣṭā surūpā cāraṇī satī ||58|| ujjvalā puṣṭadehā ca yuvatī svalpavastrikā | nirjane prabhayā vyāptā sughaṭṭāṃgasuśobhanā ||59|| miṣṭasvaraṃ samuddhāṭya kīrtane magnamānasā | snānārdrasarvadehā ca siñcamānā jalaṃ tanau ||3.19.6 0|| svarṇacampakavarṇābhā ratimūrtirivāparā | evaṃ vilokya mugdho’sau vaimāniko hi nirjane ||6 1 || cakame tāṃ satīṃ devīmavātarat tadantikam | bhūtvā devo’pi ca yuvā surūpaścāraṇottamaḥ ||62|| sarvābharaṇasaṃśobhaḥ puṣṭaśca navayauvanaḥ | kāmamūrtiriva tatra śobhate tejasā hyati || 63|| āyayau sannidhau tasyā hasan spraṣṭuṃ yatheṣṭakam | sāpi bhaktā navaṃ dṛṣṭvā janaṃ tūrṇaṃ sakāmukam ||6 4|| śīghramutthāya kuṭyāṃ sā yayau śīlāvanāya vai | māṃ deva mā prapaśya tvaṃ kudṛṣṭyā śīlaśālinīm ||65|| pūjayāmi namaskurve prayāhi yāhi śaktimān | pradharṣaṇamakāmāyā nikṛṣṭaphaladaṃ yataḥ ||66|| mānyāḥ pūjyāḥ sadā devāḥ svalpe tāḍyā na vai mayā | yāhi satraṃ sukhaṃ tyaktvāśāṃ durantāṃ vimānavan ||67|| eṣa dugdhāñjaliṃ tubhyamarpayāmyarhaṇārthakam | mama vākyaṃ susammānya prayāhi tvaṃ yathāgatam ||68|| sādho pativratāyāśca tapasvināṃ gavāṃ tathā | anivāryo bhaved daṇḍo yamasya brahmacāriṇām ||6 9|| devo vā sārvabhaumo vā vipro vā ceśvaro’pi vā | bhavet kupathago daṇḍyaḥ pathi tiṣṭhan prapūjyakaḥ ||3.19.70|| ityukto’pi satīṃ tāṃ cāraṇīṃ spraṣṭuṃ ca dharṣitum | upāyayau sa śālāyāṃ khinnā satī jagāda tam |||71||| devo bhūtvā divyabhogān bhuktvāpi mānave tanau | mohaṃ yāto bhavānatra bhasmasād bhava kāmuka ||72|| mā devāścādyataḥ pṛthvyāṃ samāyāntu vimānagāḥ | ye’bhiyāsyanti bhūbhāge bhaviṣyanti hi bhasmasāt ||73|| ityuktamātra evāsau bhasmasādabhavattadā | dānasatre ca ye devāḥ pṛthivīsthāstadābhavan ||74|| te’pi tūrṇaṃ śāpamātrādabhavan bhasmasāt priye | hāhākārastadā jātaścāraṇīśāpataḥ kṣitau ||75|| jñātvā devā divyabuddhyā kāraṇaṃ svavināśakam | drutaṃ ca dudruvurvyomnā dānaṃ tyaktvā nijālayān ||76|| devāgamo’bhavad ruddho brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | indracandrādayaścāpi bhuvaṃ nāyānti bhīvaśāḥ ||77|| devatā na samāyānti tīrthadevā yayurdivam | pativratāyāḥ śāpena bhayamāptā divaṃ gatāḥ ||78|| atha ye mānavā loke pāpāste tīrthagāminaḥ | pāpaṃ prakṣālayantyeva tīrtheṣu bhūmigeṣu vai ||79|| tāni pāpāni tīrthānāṃ dagdhuṃ nāyānti devatāḥ | kuṃbhe parvaṇi saṃkrāntau cāvabhṛthe’pi bhīvaśāḥ ||3.19.80|| atha tīrthāni sarvāṇi pāpākrāntāni pāpinām | duḥkhitānyabhavam̐ścāpyārādhayāmāsuracyutam ||8 1 || satīśāpāt surā naivāyānti bhūmaṇḍalaṃ bhayāt | asmannāśo bhavedevācireṇa pāpasaṃgrahāt ||82|| tasmādāgatya bhagavannuddhāraṃ kuru no bhuvi | parabrahma svayaṃ cāhaṃ devānāṃ stavanaistataḥ ||83 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ bhuvamāgataḥ | cāraṇīgṛhamāgatya tadaṅke putratāṃ gataḥ ||84|| tīrthairdevaiḥ pūjitaśca śaṃkhacakrādicihnavān | tvaṃ tadā cābhavo ratnadhanākhyacāraṇātmajā ||85|| tena vijñāya cihnaistvaṃ ramā ratnanarāyaṇī | ratnanārāyaṇīśrīstvamarpitā vidhinā ca me ||86|| anādiśrītīrthanārāyaṇo’haṃ parameśvaraḥ | sarvatīrthaiścāraṇaiśca prakhyāpitaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||87|| tataḥ sākaṃ tvayā cāhaṃ pitṛbhyāṃ sahitastathā | tīrthānyakaravaṃ sarvāṇyabhigatvā punaḥ punaḥ ||88|| aghānyadahaṃ teṣāṃ cākaravaṃ śāpamokṣaṇam | devānāmāgamārthaṃ vai pṛthvyāṃ mātṛnideśataḥ ||89|| tato devā āyayuśca śāpasaṃharaṇottaram | athāhaṃ kalpaparyantaṃ tīrthanārāyaṇo’bhavam ||3.19.90|| nyavasaṃ dharmamāsthāya nītvā ca pitarau saha | bhaktānnītvā nijaṃ dhāma tato yayau purātanam ||91 || ityetanmama bhūbhāge cāraṇīśāpanuttaye | prākaṭyaṃ yatpurā jātaṃ kathitaṃ kamale ca te ||92|| jānāmyahaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ nānye jānanti vismarāḥ | smara tvaṃ cāraṇīṃ jātāṃ ratnanārāyaṇīṃ priye ||93 || anye tadāvatārā me pṛthvyāṃ jātā anekaśaḥ | sākaṃ tvayā śivarājñi tān jānāmi samastakān ||94|| tato mayā kṛtā loka cāraṇā devajātayaḥ | yathā santastathā sarve yathā viprāśca bhūsurāḥ ||95|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya śrāvaṇāt smaraṇāttathā | mananānmama prākaṭyasyāpi syānmokṣabhāg janaḥ ||96|| dhanavān dharmavān syācca putravān sarvaśaktimān | nārī saubhāgyasaukhyādyaiśvaryavatī bhavedapi || 97|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso dvāviṃśe vatsare tīrthapāvanārthaṃ cāraṇyā aṃke’nāditīrthanārāyaṇasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikadaśamo’dhyāyaḥ || 19 ||
<3.20> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ me tataḥ param | sarveśvareśvareśānāṃ viniyantuḥ parātmanaḥ || 1 || trayoviṃśe vedhasaśca sanātanākhye vatsare | dvipañcāśattame kalpe prathame ca manau purā || 2 || pṛthivyāṃ suranadyāśca taṭe kālādane vane | madhumacchṛṃgavatpārśve kṣmāsurāḥ sma vasanti vai || 3 || tāpasā dhyānaparamā yajñayāgaparāyaṇāḥ | brahmakāryaparāścāpi paramārthaparāyaṇāḥ || 4 || gṛhadharme sthitāḥ karmajñānamukhyāḥ vibhaktikāḥ | manvate na bahubhaktiṃ sma te mokṣasya sādhanam || 5 || dharmayuktaṃ hi vijñānaṃ vivekaṃ bahu manvate | jaḍājaḍavivekā ye nijadharmaparāyaṇāḥ || 6 || taranti sarvabhogāḍhyā api jñānena bandhanam | akartātmā cāpyabhoktā nityaśuddho’sti varṣmasu || 7 || ahaṃmamatvarahito rāgadveṣavivarjitaḥ | sukhaduḥkhavimuktaśca mukta eva na saṃśayaḥ || 8 || vāsanāśayahīnaśca kriyāyatnavivarjitaḥ | bahirbuddhivihīnaśca mukta eva na saṃśayaḥ || 9 || rajobhāvavihīnaśca kāmakrodhādivarjitaḥ | vṛthāceṣṭāvihīnaśca mukta eva na saṃśayaḥ || 3.20.1 0|| strīputragṛhayukto’pi vanavāṭīsamanvitaḥ | mahiṣīgovṛṣayuk ca nirbandho mukta eva saḥ || 11 || lokācārayuto nityaṃ śāstrācāraparāyaṇaḥ | maryādāyāṃ vartamāno mukta eva na saṃśayaḥ || 1 2|| ityevaṃ vṛṣamukhyāste kṣmāsurā makhakarmiṇaḥ | sustrīputrīputrayuktā vartante sma sarittaṭe || 13 || phalamūladalāhārāḥ sūryapakvāśanāstathā | ṛtupakvāśanāścāpi vartante sma nirāśayāḥ || 14|| brahmaśīlaparāścāpi cīravalkaladhāriṇaḥ | jaṭābhasmādiyuktāśca parṇakuṭyādivāsinaḥ || 15|| brahmacaryaṃ yathāyogyaṃ pālayanti vratāni ca | yajñotsavān prakurvanti smotsavān jñānināmapi || 16|| evaṃ vai vartamānāste janeṣu bhūtalādiṣu | sthāpayanti sma vai jñānaṃ sakarma mokṣasādhanam || 17|| bhaktiṃ smaranti naivaite dharme samāśrayanti ca | tato vai caikadā bhaktyā patnyātikṛśayā patiḥ || 18|| dharmadevo’rthitaḥ puṣṭyai nijāyāḥ prāṇarakṣakaḥ | kānta rakṣaka lokānāṃ patnīvrato’sti vai bhavān || 1 9|| tava puṣṭiṃ prakurvanti kṣmāsurāḥ kalpake’tra ca | mama sthānaṃ na tatrāsti mṛtiṃ yāsyāmi vai tataḥ ||3.20.20 || māṃ vihāya tvayā nātha na gantavyaṃ kadācana | tava puṣṭirmama hānirnaitad yuktaṃ kadācana ||21 || yathā puṣṭirmama syācca tathā pālyā tava priyā | apriyā cet tavāhaṃ vāstrīti tyājyā sadā khalu ||22|| yena me maraṇaṃ śreyaḥkaraṃ syānna tu jīvanam | ityukto dharmadevo vai śuśoca kṣaṇamāntare ||23 || bhaktipuṣṭiṃ hṛdi kṛtvā nirṇayāmāsa tatkṛtim | yayau nārāyaṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ parabrahma sanātanam ||24|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ puruṣottamam | akṣarākhye pare dhāmni cāgatya ca pupūja mām ||25|| prārthayad bhaktidevyāstu sthāpanārthaṃ kṣitau vṛṣaḥ | parabrahma harekṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa pareśvara ||26|| adya kalpe kṣitau lokā dharmamātraparāyaṇāḥ | karmakāṇḍaparāścāpi bhaktihīnā vivekinaḥ ||27|| jaḍacetanabhedajñāḥ kaivalyārthā bhavanti vai | upāsanā na caivāsti nārāyaṇasya te prabho ||28|| arcāgandho’pi naivāsti kṣmāyāṃ kvāpi harestava | tataścārcāsvarūpasyārhaṇamupāsanādikam ||29|| pravartayituṃ bhagavan bhaktiṃ poṣayituṃ tathā | jīvayituṃ bhaktibhedān prayāsaṃ vaha mādhava ||3.20.3 0|| śrutvaivaṃ prārthanāṃ dharmadevasya bhaktipoṣiṇīm | drutaṃ lakṣmi sadāyuktayoginaṃ hi sadāśivam || 31 || prerayāmāsa pṛthvyāṃ vai gantuṃ khaṇḍayituṃ tathā | kevalaṃ karmavādaṃ ca jñānavādaṃ ca kevalam ||32|| bhaktiṃ vinā niṣphalaṃ vai karma jñānaṃ na mokṣadam | ityevamupadeśārthaṃ preṣayāmāsa śaṃkaram ||33|| sa ca bhūmau drutaṃ gatvā dṛṣṭvā lokāṃśca karmaṭhān | bhaktihīnān kṣmāsurādīn racayāmāsa kautukam ||34|| digambaro yuvā bhūtvojjvalo mohakavigrahaḥ | devyā yukto haraḥ puṣṭo yayau kṣmāsurakharvaṭam ||35|| yatra vasanti sarve te karmaṭhāḥ kṣmāsurādayaḥ | tatpatnyaścāpi tatkanyāḥ kumārāśca dvijodbhavāḥ ||36|| karmaṭhāḥ sarva evaite bhedajñānaparā api | bhaktihīnā divyadṛṣṭivihīnā dehamāninaḥ ||37|| kāmakrodhaparāścāpi devamāhātmyavarjitāḥ | yogisādhupratimādimāhātmyavarjitāstathā ||38|| ātitheyavihīnāśca brāhmadaśāvivarjitāḥ | saṃsāradṛṣṭiyuktāśca doṣabhaddhṛdayānvitāḥ ||39|| evaṃvidhāḥ kṣmāsurāste yatra vasanti saṃhatāḥ | narā nāryo grāmavāsāḥ parṇakuṭyādivāsinaḥ ||3.20.40|| tatrāyaṃ śaṃkaro nagno yayau ceṣṭāṃ tu kāminaḥ | kurvan gṛhaṃ gṛhaṃ yāti kanyāstathā kumārakāḥ ||41 || yuvatyaśca tathā nāryo mattaṃ vilokya dehinam | pramattaṃ sundaraṃ puṣṭaṃ mohakaṃ tamanudrutāḥ ||42|| narmavākyāni jagadurvīkṣayāmāsurīśvaram | kāmukaṃ hasamānāśca cikṣipurdhūlikādikam ||43 || kāścittu tāḍayāmāsurnitambe daṇḍayaṣṭibhiḥ | mohitāḥ śmāsurapatnyo’nujagmurbhānavarjitāḥ ||44|| pasparśuḥ sukhālobhena ninyurnirjanakuṃjake | viprā vīkṣya tathā śrutvā karmakāṇḍaparāyaṇāḥ ||45|| mṛṣāvivekadhvajino’nupeturhananāya tam | prāpya daṇḍairyaṣṭibhiśca tāḍayāmāsuratyati ||46|| śaṃkaro yuktayogyeva duḥkhaṃ jānāti naiva ha | tāḍanaṃ balavat prāpya mamāra patito bhuvi ||47|| śavībhūto’bhavat tatra śvāsaṃ gṛhṇāti naiva ha | samādhau vartate yadvanmṛto yathābhavattadā ||48|| te ca santyajya patitaṃ viprāḥ svasvālayān yayuḥ | satī devī tataḥ kruddhā śaśāpa tān pratāḍakān ||49|| yato mithyājñānakarā vivekadhvajino dvijāḥ | ātmasattāvihīnāśca nijākartṛtvamāninaḥ ||3.20.50|| akartṛtvamabhoktṛtvaṃ nityaśuddhatvamātmani | aṃśamātraṃ na manvānā vāgāḍambaravedinaḥ ||5 1 || karmaṭhā deharūpāśca kāmakrodhaparāyaṇāḥ | yogināṃ ca satāṃ divyamāhātmyasyāvidastathā || 52|| kāmakriyāparā yūyaṃ svavatpare’bhiśaṃkinaḥ | nirdayā brahmahatyākā mṛtiṃ yāntu yathā haraḥ |||53 || iti satyā cābhihite kheṭe kharvaṭake vane | kṣmāsurā naravargāste drutaṃ kramānmṛtiṃ yayuḥ ||54|| śavā gṛhe gṛhe jātā narāṇāṃ vasatiṣvapi | hāhākāro mahān jāto viprāvāseṣu cābhitaḥ ||55|| viprā mṛtiṃ prayāntyeva nagnanāryāḥ praśāpanāt | kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ rakṣaṇārthamihādya vai |||56|| nāryo rudanti parito bālāḥ kanyā rudantyapi | mānavāścāpi saṃśrutvā rudanti ca sthale sthale ||57|| ātmabhāvavihīnāśca vivekajñānavarjitāḥ | vāṅmātrajñānakartāro bhedajñānavivarjitāḥ ||58|| karmaṭhāḥ krodhakāmādidoṣayuktāḥ śucānvitāḥ | sarvatra mānave loke kṣitau deśeṣu vai tadā ||59|| kṣmāsurā gatabhānāśca gatāsavo’bhavam̐stadā | dinamadhye tu sarvasyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ kamale tadā || 3.20.60|| koṭyarbudaśavānāṃ vai śmaśānānyabhavam̐stadā | gṛhe gṛhe śavastatra kṣaṇe kṣaṇe prajāyate ||6 1 || kopo’yaṃ kaścidevāpi mahattama iti striyaḥ | anye janā aviprādyā menire sarvanāśakaḥ ||62|| yatra yatrābhavan viprāḥ karmaṭhā bhinnavādinaḥ | bhaktihīnāśca te sarve śavatāṃ bhejire tadā ||63|| hāhākāre tathā jāte narā nāryo’vaśeṣitāḥ | ārādhanāṃ pareśasya cakrurme paramātmanaḥ ||64|| tvaṃ prāṇastvaṃ jīvanaṃ ca tvaṃ rakṣākara mādhava | tvaṃ strīṇāṃ śaraṇaṃ nātha jīvayāsmatpatīn janān ||6 5 || ityevaṃ stavanaṃ śrutvā nimittaṃ cāgame mama | ahaṃ sākaṃ tvayā lakṣmi cāyayau puruṣottamaḥ ||66 || bhuvaṃ śīghraṃ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmādiśobhitaḥ | svarṇabhūṣāmbaraśālī divyatejo’bhirājitaḥ ||67|| yatra haraśavaścāste yatra dvijaśavāstathā | tatra pradarśya madrūpaṃ samāśvāsya ca yoṣitaḥ ||68|| tathā narān dvijabhinnānahaṃ dhairyaṃ paraṃ dadau | karmaṭhā jñānakartāro vivekācāravarjitāḥ ||69|| śuṣkajñānā bhaktihīnāḥ sādhvaparādhakāriṇaḥ | sadyaḥ phalamime prāptāścāviditvāparādhinaḥ ||3.20.70|| śuṣkajñāne mahatpāpaṃ jñātuścācāravarjinaḥ | jñāyate yat procyate’pi nācaryate na dhāryate ||71 || tatpāpasadṛśaṃ pāpaṃ nānyad bhavati dehinām | karmakāṇḍaratāśceme vivekadhvajinastathā ||72|| rāgadveṣavihīnatvaṃ pālayanti na sarvathā | māritastvavadhūto’yaṃ yogī vivekavām̐śca taiḥ ||73 || sādhorbhaktivihīnaiśca mṛtiścāmantritā nijā | atha lokā janā nāryaḥ papracchuḥ parameśvaram ||74|| kathameṣā mahāpattirvilīyeta praśādhi naḥ | ahaṃ tadāvadṃ tebhyo lakṣmi tatpūjanāya vai ||75|| śavaṃ taṃ māritaṃ gatvā pūjayantu pratiṣṭhitam | prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kurvantu tanmūrtiṃ pūjayantu ca ||76|| ṣoḍaśādyupacārairvai naivedyārpaṇasevanaiḥ | nīrājanādibhiścāpi stavanaiḥ pūjayantu tam ||77|| tadā prayāsyati dhvaṃsaṃ mṛtyorupadravastvayam | śrutvā nāryo narāścāpi mṛṣāvivekavarjitāḥ ||78|| sarve nītvā susāmagrīścandanākṣatamālikāḥ | dhūpadīpasunaivedyavastrālaṃkārapādukāḥ ||779 || āvāhanādikaṃ kṛtvā prapūjya sarvavastubhiḥ | prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ cakruste matpūrvāḥ strīnarādayaḥ ||3.20.80|| nīrājanaṃ pracakruśca tāvacchaṃbhuḥ sacetanaḥ | bhūtvā netre samunmilyotthito’bhavat kṣaṇāntare ||8 1 || naivedyaṃ ca dadustasmai jalapānaṃ dadustataḥ | harastadā prasannaścābhavad varārthamāha tān ||82|| sarve tadārthayāmāsurmṛtānāṃ jīvanaṃ punaḥ | haraḥ prāha prapūjyaināṃ devīṃ labdhvā śubhāśiṣaḥ ||83 || jīvitāste bhaviṣyanti nānyathā tu kadācana | atha devīṃ pupūjuste lakṣmi nāryo narāstathā ||84|| arthayāmāsurevāpi mṛtānāṃ jīvanaṃ punaḥ | śivā prāha yathā cātra pūjitā śaṃkarānvitā ||85|| tathā lakṣmīmimāṃ śrīmannārāyaṇasamanvitām | pūjayantu tataḥ sarve mṛtā yāsyanti jīvanam ||86|| ityuktāśca narā nāryaḥ pupūjurmāṃ tvayānvitam | tataḥ sarve cotthitāścāparādhamṛtivarjitāḥ ||87|| te jīvaṃ prāpya māṃ jīvannārāyaṇeti vai jaguḥ | khyātiṃ prāptastadānādijīvannārāyaṇo’pyaham ||88|| tvayā sākaṃ mama mūrti bhaktinārāyaṇātmikām | sarvadā tu tato bhaktyā matpradarśitayā janāḥ ||89|| sevayāmāsuratyarthaṃ tyaktvā śuṣkaṃ vivecanam | karmakāṇḍaṃ ca vai sarvasamarpaṇātmakaṃ vyadhuḥ ||3.20.9 0|| śaṃkarastān samastām̐ścopādideśa madarpaṇam | sarvavidhaṃ karmakāṇḍaṃ mama bhaktyātmakaṃ tataḥ ||9 1 || dharmayuktaṃ bhaktiyuktaṃ jñānaṃ tu vedanaṃ mama | tataḥ pravartitaṃ tatra kalpe mokṣapradaṃ śubham ||92|| bhakterujjīvanaṃ jātaṃ bhaktimārgaḥ pravartitaḥ | mūrtayo mama śaṃbhośca saśaktikāśca bhūtale ||93 || tatastairjīvamāpannaiḥ sthāpitā darśitā yathā | pūjitāścāpi sarvatra bhaktiḥ puṣṭiṃ jagāma ha ||94|| evaṃ śaṃbhuḥ satīyuktaḥ kṛtvā kautukamuttamam | sthāpayitvā kṣitau mūrtipūjāṃ bhaktiṃ tathottamām ||95|| yayāvadṛśyatāṃ cāhaṃ jīvanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | tvayā sākaṃ kṣitau kalpāntakaṃ kālamuvāsa ha ||96|| ityevaṃ śivarājñīśri prākaṭyaṃ kīrtitaṃ mama | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ ||97|| dharmasya bhaktiyuktasyopāsanāyāśca puṣṭaye | pūjāyā mama mūrteśca mūrteśca śaṃkarasya ca ||98|| nāsīlliṃgaṃ ca tatkalpe mūrtirāsīddharasya vai | mama mūrtistadaivāsīnnāsīdviṣṇuśilā tadā ||99|| evaṃ pūrvaṃ tu yajjātaṃ vedmyahaṃ sarvameva tat | smara tvaṃ mama pūjādi tadā prākaṭyamityapi || 3.20.10 0|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇāccintanādapi | mama pūjāphalaṃ lakṣmi bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ || 10 1|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasastrayoviṃśe vatsare bhakteḥ prārthanayānādiśrījīvanārāyaṇasya prākaṭyaṃ śaṃkaradvārā bhaktimārgapravartanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā viṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 20 ||
<3.21> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri prākaṭyaṃ cāparaṃ mama | caturviṃśe vatsare ca vedhasastvārṣasaṃjñake || 1 || kalpe śatatame ṣaṣṭhe manau yathābhavat purā | tadānīṃ vedavidvāṃso brāhmaṇā yatayastathā || 2 || devatāḥ ṛṣayaścāpi pitaraścājanirmite | sarvamedhātmake yajñe mimilurmokṣadātaṭe || 3 || vicārāstatra sarveṣāmabhavan matparāyaṇāḥ | kīdṛśo’yaṃ hariḥ sevyaścaikalo vāpi yugmakaḥ || 4 || nirguṇo vā saguṇo vā mūrto hyamūrtaṃ eva vā | agnirūpo’thavādityasvarūpo vāpyarūpakaḥ || 5 || atha tatra svayaṃ brahmā jagāda yugalātmakaḥ | anye maharṣayaḥ prāhuścaika eva parātparaḥ || 6 || devāḥ prāhuḥ saguṇo’yaṃ yatayo nirguṇaḥ svayam | sevanīyo yathāyogyo mūrtimānapare jaguḥ || 7 || karmaṭhāḥ prāhurevāyaṃ sevanīyo hyamūrtakaḥ | agnirūpo hariḥ sākṣāt pare prāhurhi bhāskaraḥ || 8 || sevanīyo brahmamūrtiścetyevaṃ vādamācaran | nirṇayo naikarūpo’bhūt tadā viṣṇurjagāda ha || 9 || śaṃbhuścāyaṃ yathā tvasmān vadennirṇaya eva saḥ | śaṃbhuḥ śrutvā harervākyaṃ prajagāda sabhājanān || 3.21.10 || dhyānaṃ kṣaṇaṃ prakurvantu svayaṃ dāsyati nirṇayam | ityuktaṃ śaṃkaravākyaṃ sarvamedhādhvare tadā || 11 || dhyānamagnā abhavam̐śca devarṣipitṛmānavāḥ | tāvad vyomno divyatejomayo’driḥ samupāyayau || 12|| avyāpnodambaraṃ sarvaṃ divaṃ bhuvaṃ digantaram | tanmadhye suvimānaṃ cākṣarābhidhaṃ mama priyam || 1 3|| adṛśyata tadā lakṣmi tatrāhaṃ ca tvayā saha | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’rdhakamalātanuḥ || 14|| pratyakṣaḥ puratasteṣāṃ dhyāne tataśca gocaraḥ | ardhe śikhā śirasyāste’rdhe śrīkeśātmadhammilaḥ || 15|| ardhabhāle sutilakaṃ cārdhabhāle sucandrakaḥ | dakṣe karṇe kuṇḍalaṃ ca vāme kuṇḍalikairiṇī || 16|| dakṣe tu nirmalaṃ cūrṇaṃ vāme netre tu kajjalam | dakṣe śmaśrustathā riktā nāsā vāme sanitthakā || 17|| dakṣaṃ vakṣaśconnataṃ ca vāmaṃ stanasamanvitam | dakṣahastau śaṃkhacakrayutau sukaṭakānvitau || 18|| vāmahastau padmamālāśṛṃkhalāvyajanānvitau | dakṣe śrīvatsacihnārdhaṃ vāme mūrtyardhakaṃ ca me || 19|| dakṣodare’rdhatrivalī vāme samodarātmatā | dakṣe’rdhaṃ naraliṃgaṃ ca vāme’rdhāyonirityapi ||3.21.20|| dakṣe tveko hi vṛṣaṇo vāme tu guptagranthikā | dakṣapādaḥ saromā cāromā vāmaḥ samujjvalaḥ | naravaddīrghaphaṇakaḥ nārīvaddhrasvasatphaṇaḥ ||21 || dakṣārdhaṃ śyāmasaundaryaṃ vāmārdhaṃ kanakojjvalam | dakṣārdhaṃ pītadhautrādisvarṇārdhamukuṭānvitam ||22|| vāmārdhaṃ kañcukīśāṭīsvarṇamukuṭikānvitam | dakṣārdhaṃ narabhūṣāḍhyaṃ vāmaṃ nārīvibhūṣaṇam ||23|| dakṣaṃ puṃbalasaṃyuktaṃ vāmaṃ nārīsumārdavam | evaṃ bhūtvā caika eva tathāpi dvisvarūpavān ||24|| pratyakṣaḥ puratasteṣāmardhaśrīśanarāyaṇaḥ | dadhyuste cāntare māṃ ca tādṛśaṃ dvyekarūpiṇam ||25|| pupūjurmānavā devāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitaro’pi mām | brahmādyāḥ prārthayāmāsuratra kṣitau sadā vasa ||26|| evamevasvarūpastvaṃ lokakalyāṇahetave | tato’haṃ mokṣadānadyāstaṭe merostu paścime ||27|| ādhvare bhūtale nityamavasaṃ sarvagocaraḥ | ākalpāntaṃ parameśaḥ śikṣayan pratimārhaṇam ||28|| anādiśrīmadardhaśrīśvaranārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | tathaiva mandirādau ca gṛhe gṛhe ca sarvathā || 29|| mūrtiścaikavidhā me’bhūdardhaśrīśanarāyaṇī | tathaivopāsanā dhyānaṃ pūjanaṃ veṣadhāraṇam ||3.21.3 0|| sarvaṃ me tādṛśaṃ hyāsīd bhaktaiḥ saṃsevitaṃ vapuḥ | madicchayā mayā lakṣmi tatra kalpe tathā kṛtam ||3 1|| dhṛtaṃ rūpaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vai yathākṣare viśiṣṭakam | atha devādayo māṃ ca tataḥ paraṃ tathāvidham ||32|| pūjayantyupāsayanti sma ca muktiṃ vrajanti ca | ityevaṃ me tatra kalpe prākaṭyamuditaṃ tava ||33|| ityevaṃ smara yugmaikyaṃ nijaprākaṭyamīśvari | sarvaṃ jānāmyahaṃ lakṣmi tathā naikāvatārakān ||34|| athāgre cetaranme ca prākaṭyaṃ pravadāmi te | pañcaviṃśe vedhasaśca dharmākhye vatsare tadā || 35|| kalpe pañcaśate cādye manau pitṛgaṇāḥ purā | pṛthvyāmāgatya vaṃśebhyo jagaduḥ śrāddhabhojanam ||36 || tattadvaṃśodbhavā lokā vidyāvanto vyadhuśca tat | śraddhayā pitṛsaṃghānuddiśya piṇḍādikaṃ daduḥ ||37|| te sarve pitaraścāpi vinirgatyārdhadehinaḥ | prasāritakarābhyāṃ vai piṇḍān prajagṛhurmudā || 38|| prasannavadanāścāpi samujjvalakarāstathā | nābhyūrdhvadṛśyadehāśca piṇḍān prāpyaiva tasthire ||39|| karasthabhojanāḥ sarve evameva sthirāstadā | abhuñjānā abhavam̐śca maunāḥ śāntā nirutsukāḥ ||3.21.40 || tadā vaṃśajaviprādyairabhuñjānā vilokitāḥ | pṛṣṭāśca pitaraḥ sarve kathaṃ bhuṅdhve na cārpitam ||41 || te prāhuśca hareḥ prāsādikaṃ nāstyetadeva yat | tadabhakṣyaṃ sadāsmākaṃ yataśca vaiṣṇavā vayam ||42|| atha vaṃśyāḥ pṛṣṭavantaḥ kathaṃ prāsādikaṃ bhavet | yadatra dṛśyate naiva na cāste ca narāyaṇaḥ ||43|| tadā te pitaraḥ prāhurharisūktaṃ japantviha | haristvāgatya piṇḍādi pāyasānnaṃ grahīṣyati ||44|| atha te
