harisūktenārādhayanmāṃ tadā kṣaṇe | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||45|| ahaṃ sākaṃ tvayā lakṣmi pitṝṇāṃ bhaktirodhataḥ | pratyakṣastatra vaṃśyānāmagre nābhyūrdhvadehakan ||46|| pitṛbhiḥ saha tatraiva niṣadya bhuktavān payaḥ | pāyasaṃ cāpi miṣṭānnaṃ phalaṃ dalaṃ ca mūlakam ||47|| tvaṃ ca nārāyaṇīśri svanābhyūrdhvadṛśyavigrahā | śṛṃgāritā mayā sākaṃ bhuktavatī ca pāyasam ||48|| atha te pitaraḥ sarve jalānnādikameva tu | prāsādikaṃ mayā dattaṃ bhuktavantaḥ sukhotsukāḥ ||49|| tṛptāḥ sarve yayurbhuktvā pitṛlokān nijālayān | ahaṃ sañjo’bhavaṃ yāvattāvad viprādibhiḥ kṣitau ||3.21.50|| prārthitau nityavāsārthaṃ nānyūrdhvadehadhāriṇau | ardhadṛśyau divyarūpau sundarau saumyavigrahau ||51|| tathāstvityucitaṃ matvā sthitavantau sadā kṣitau | ākalpāntaṃ ca nābhyūrdhvārdhamūrtidhāriṇau sadā ||52|| mūrtayaścāpi tādṛśyo gṛhe vane ca mandire | dhyāne’rhaṇe cotsave cābhavam̐stathārdhavigrahāḥ ||53|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | anādyardhapitṛnārāyaṇākhyaḥ prathito’bhavam ||54|| smara lakṣmi tvayā sākaṃ mama mūrtiṃ tadārdhinīm | athānye’pyavatārā me’bhavam̐stadāpi koṭiśaḥ ||55|| jānāmyahaṃ samastāṃstānnānye jānanti vai gatān | smaraṇādvandanāccāpi bhuktimuktipradān śubhān ||56|| nāmyadho māyiko bhāgo nārako janmasampradaḥ | nābhyūrdhvaṃ pāvano bhāgo mokṣado darśito mayā ||57|| ardhordhvamūrtirūpeṇa tadā jñānaṃ tathābhavat | evaṃ vijñāya sampūjya yātā dhāmākṣaraṃ janāḥ ||58|| atha vakṣye vedhasaśca ṣaḍviṃśe’naṅgavatsare | kalpe saptaśate manau saptame’haṃ pareśvaraḥ ||59|| prāvirāsaṃ plakṣamadhye’nādiplakṣanarāyaṇaḥ | tatra kalpe mahātmāno hyātmajñānaparāyaṇāḥ ||3.21.60 || āsan vai sādhavo dhīrā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ | jaṭāvalkalavastrāścāyācitānnādikāśanāḥ ||61 || yadṛcchālābhasantuṣṭā lokakalyāṇakāriṇaḥ | yajñopavītayuktāśca tilakānvitavigrahāḥ ||62|| kaṇṭhīmālādiśobhāśca dhyānabhajanakāriṇaḥ | ekadā militāḥ sarve viṣṇunadyāstaṭe śubhe ||63|| bhaktyaraṇye tapo’rthaṃ vai bhaktyarthaṃ paramātmanaḥ | saṃvādaṃ te pracakruśca parasparaṃ susaṃhatāḥ ||64||| tapaḥ śreyaḥpradaṃ kiṃ vā bhaktiḥ śreyaḥpradā dvijāḥ | yadvobhayaṃ mataṃ śreyaḥpradaṃ ceduttamaṃ nu kim ||65|| ityevaṃ praśnasāre ca jāte kalyāṇayogiṣu | eke prāhustapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ pare prāhurna tattathā ||66|| tapasā kṣīyate pāpaṃ puṇyaṃ prajāyate śubham | tena bhogopalabdhiśca svargaṃ ca maraṇaṃ kṣaye ||67|| tato vai laukikaṃ śreyastapaścānte na tattathā | tasmād bhaktiḥ parā śreṣṭhā śreyaḥpradā hi śāśvatī ||68|| anye prāhuḥ sakāmā sā nātyantaśreyasaḥ pradā | niṣkāmā śreyasī śreṣṭhā paraśreyaḥpradā hi sā ||69|| pare tvāhuryadi bhaktirniṣkāmā kāmanāṃ vinā | phalahīnā vṛthā sā hi prayāsamātrarūpiṇī ||3.21.70|| tasmāt sakāmā sā kāryā sveṣṭasatphaladāyinī | ityevaṃ vadamāneṣu maharṣiṣu tadā vṛṣaḥ ||71 || dharmadevo viprarūpaḥ samājastho’bravīdidam | sarveṣāmantarātmā yaḥ sarvasākṣī virājate ||72|| sa devo’tra drume plakṣamaye dharmye virājate | tasya pūjāṃ prakṛtvaiva praśnabhāro’tra pippale ||73|| nyasanīyaścottaraṃ ca tatsthaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pradāsyati | ityevaṃ tvekamatyaṃ vai kṛtvā maharṣayastadā ||74|| pippalaṃ tatra sampūjyāśrāvayan parameśvaram | kimatyantaṃ paraṃ śreyastapo bhaktiśca vā prabho ||75|| iti saṃśrāvya tasthuśca varṣaśataṃ tapo’nvitāḥ | tathāpi labdhavanto nottaraṃ plakṣāttapodhanāḥ ||76 || tāvad vyomagirā devaḥ pareśvaro jagāda tān | tapasā na bhavecchreya ātyantikaṃ tapodhanāḥ ||77|| ārādhayantu māṃ brahmaparamaṃ sarvasākṣiṇam | niṣkāmabhaktyā tuṣṭo’haṃ bhavāmi satataṃ dvijāḥ ||78|| bhaktyā cātyantikaṃ śreyaścātyantikamavāpsyatha | ityuktāste jagaduśca kathaṃ bhaktirvinā harim ||79|| sākṣāddhariṃ vinā bhaktiḥ premasevā kathaṃ bhavet | vayaṃ cet tapasā pūtāḥ pātrabhūtāḥ sma mādhava ||3.21.80|| asmanmadhye samāgatya śaśvattiṣṭha kṛpālaya | bhaktāḥ priyāśca te nityaṃ yadarthaṃ cāmbare sthitaḥ ||8 1 || adṛśyo’pi bhaktapakṣī vyomavāṇyāpi vatsalaḥ | karoṣi śāsanaṃ śreyaḥpradaṃ matvā nijāñjanān ||82|| yathā śabdena ca tathā svarūpeṇāpi śādhi naḥ | pratyakṣeṇa nijānasmān samānandaya mādhava ||83 || ityukto’hamavadam̐stān bhāvayantu samāhitāḥ | prāpte cārādhanāpāke bhaviṣyāmi hi gocaraḥ ||84|| atha nārāyaṇīśri svabhāgyāni cottamāni vai | manyamānā dvijāstatra śatavarṣāṇi saṃsthitāḥ ||85|| ārādhayanto deveśeśvareśvareśvareśvaram | sādhavaste nirāśāśca brahmāśāmātratatparāḥ ||86 || brahmarūpā brahmabhūtāḥ plakṣachāyāmupāśritāḥ | jepurnārāyaṇaṃ māṃ ca bhejurmāṃ nāmakīrtanaiḥ ||87|| ānarcurmāṃ tulasyādyairdadhyurmāṃ mānase gṛhe | gateṣu śatavarṣeṣu satāmabhyāsināṃ mama ||88|| sannidhāvabhavaṃ sākṣāt plakṣamūlasamāśritaḥ | tvayā lakṣmyā sahitaḥ śrīplakṣanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||89|| plakṣastambe garbhabhāge divye tejo’bhimiśrite | sāvakāśe cidākāśe plakṣabrahmaṇi saṃsthitaḥ ||3.21.9 0|| vāme sākaṃ tvayā padme caturbhujo narāyaṇaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ puruṣottamaḥ ||9 1 || svecchayaiva samudbhūtaḥ sādhuvāñcchāprapūrtaye | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmasvastikadhvajaśūlavān ||92|| sarvadivyābharaṇaśca svarṇamukuṭakuṇḍalaḥ | divyacampakavarṇābho divyāmbaradharastathā ||93|| divyatejobhisaṃvyāpto yugalātmā pareśvaraḥ | sādhvicchāpūrakastatra pratyakṣaḥ śreyasāṃ pradaḥ ||94|| atha divyanayanāste vyapaśyanmāṃ drumāntare | divyagṛhāmbare tatra drumābhinnaṃ pumuttamam || 95|| nemuścakrurdaṇḍavacca tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram | pupūjustatra militaiścopacārādibhistadā ||96|| snehabhaktyā sadā bhejurmāṃ prarakṣya ca maṇḍale | ityevaṃ sarvalokānāṃ śreyaḥprado’bhavaṃ priye ||97|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ sanātanaḥ | puruṣottama evāhaṃ svecchayā sādhumaṇḍale ||98|| anādiśrīplakṣanārāyaṇātmā cābhavaṃ sthitaḥ | vedmyahaṃ sarvameveti smara tvaṃ plakṣavāsinīm ||99 || tava mūrtiṃ śubhāṃ lakṣmīsvarūpiṇīṃ sanātanīm | anye’pi cāvatārā me’bhavan śatasahasraśaḥ || 3.21.1 00|| īśvarā nāpi jānanti kutaḥ surāśca mānavāḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya śrāvaṇātsmaraṇādapi || 101 || sevanātplakṣavāsinyāste ca me sevanādapi | bhuktiścāpi bhavenmuktirmuktiḥ śreṣṭhā ca vai bhavet || 1 02|| pippalaśrīṃ tvarcayed yaḥ pippale śrīnarāyaṇam | tasya lakṣmyā anapāyo mokṣāvāptirdhruvā bhavet || 10 3|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaścaturviṃśe vatsare’nādiśrīmadardhaśrīśanārāyaṇasya, pañcaviṃśe vatsare’nādiśrīmadardhapitṛnārāyaṇasya, ṣaḍviṃśe vatsare cānādiśrīplakṣanārāyaṇasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikaviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 21 ||
<3.22> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ mama cāparam | avṛṣākhye vedhasaśca saptaviṃśe tu vatsare || 1 || kalpe catuḥśate manau tṛtīye bhūtale’bhavan | bhūsurā yajñakartāraścakruste cādhvarān bahūn || 2 || agnihotraṃ darśahomaṃ pūrṇamāsaṃ prayājakam | sviṣṭakṛdyajanaṃ pitṛyajñaṃ ca vaiśvadaivatam || 3 || cāturmāsyaṃ sākamedhaṃ somaṃ cāgrāyaṇeṣṭikam | avabhṛtheṣṭiṃ tathā cātirātraṃ vājapeyakam || 4 || agniṣṭomaṃ tathā sautrāmaṇiṃ ca rājasūyakam | aśvamedhaṃ sarvamedhaṃ puṃmedhaṃ ca savān bahūn || 5 || bṛhaspatisavaṃ vaiśyasavaṃ somasavaṃ tathā | gosavaṃ brāhmaṇasavaṃ tathaudanasavaṃ śubham || 6 || pṛthisavaṃ marutstomaṃ putreṣṭiṃ ca tathāparān | yajñān vyadhuścaikadā te prārebhire nṛmedhakam || 7 || pañcāhaṃ tatra vai yajñe dvyūnadviśatapūruṣān | devatābhyo hi vidhinopākṛtya ca tataḥ param || 8 || puruṣāṇāṃ viśasanaṃ kartumārebhire dvijāḥ | vapārthaṃ havanārthaṃ ca bhrāntāstattvavido dvijāḥ || 9 || śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ ye nṛpaśavaścābhavan | nyūnadvādaśavarṣāste yajñopavītadhāriṇaḥ || 3.22.10|| bhaktā abhaktā viprādyā āsan yajñārthakalpitāḥ | tatraikastvabhavad yogī mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 11 || kālamāyādyasaṃgī ca dehādau nispṛho naraḥ | śubhravarṇaḥ sundarākhyaḥ komalo mudabhṛnmukhaḥ || 12||| pāvitaḥ prathamo viprairupākṛtaḥ samāhṛtaḥ | viśasanasya śālāyāṃ yathāvidhi samarcitaḥ || 1 3|| nārāyaṇahare kṛṣṇāntarātmannitimānasaḥ | ātmanivedano nityaṃ madarthasarvaceṣṭakaḥ || 14|| etādṛśaṃ mama bhaktaṃ jñātvā viśasanārthakam | tūrṇaṃ cāhaṃ samāyātaḥ padme viśasanagṛhe || 15|| adṛśyaḥ karmaṭhānāṃ vai dṛśyo bhaktasya me tadā | adṛśyīkṛtya madbhaktaṃ sthito’haṃ tatsthale sphuṭaḥ || 16|| tadākāraśca maunaśca bhaktarakṣārthamityapi | bhrāntināśārthamevāpi hiṃsāyāśca vichittaye || 17|| dharmarakṣārthamevāpi mṛṣākarmavichittaye | viprebhyo bodhadānārthaṃ yathārthatāpravṛttaye || 18|| tāmasānāṃ pāpakarmanāśārthaṃ śasanālaye | prāvirāsaṃ tadā lakṣmi pratyakṣaḥ svīyarakṣakaḥ || 19|| atha te yāgadīkṣāptā dvijā mantrān jagustadā | prokṣya sarvaṃ suvidhinā pūruṣaṃ māṃ prajagṛhuḥ ||3.22.20|| mukhabandhaṃ nirdayāśca pracakruryavapūraṇaiḥ | vṛṣaṇau mardayāmāsuśchedayāmāsurutsukāḥ || 21|| jīvato me bhramayuktā bhrāntyātmavidhinā khalāḥ | viśasanaṃ pracakruśca tadāhaṃ pāpināśakṛt ||22|| kartitābhyāṃ vṛṣaṇābhyāṃ vajrābhābhyāṃ tu satvaram | karmaṭhānāṃ kapālāni brahmarandhrāṇyatāḍayam ||23|| vajramaṇinibhābhyāṃ sāgnibhyāṃ pratāḍitā dvijāḥ | jajvaluścāpi mamruśca bhinnamūrdhakapālakāḥ ||24|| sahasraśaḥ samutpannā mahānto vartulāśca te | mahāśilāsvarūpāśca pralayānalasannibhāḥ || 25|| dāhayāmāsureveme pṛthvīṃ nabhaśca tārakān | bhedayāmāsureveme śailaprāyāstadākhilam ||26||| nāśayāmāsuḥ parito yajñaṃ yajñīyakānyapi | hāhākāro mahāñjātaḥ svargapralayavāhakaḥ ||27|| pṛthivyāṃ pattanānāṃ ca dahyanti bahularddhayaḥ | araṇyāni cārṣavāsā dahyanti vṛṣaṇānalāt ||28|| śālā grāmā āvasathā dagdhāstairvṛṣaṇānalaiḥ | atha viprā jīvavantaḥ prārthayāñcakrire surān || 29|| rakṣayantu surāścāsmān mṛtyumukhasamāvṛtān | prāyaścittaṃ kariṣyāmo vyutkramāderavantu naḥ ||3.22.30|| naivaṃ punaḥ kariṣyāmo bhrāntiṃ tyakṣyāma eva naḥ | rakṣa rakṣa kṛpāpārāvārapārīṇamādhava ||3 1 || ityevaṃ mriyamāṇāste nipetuḥ pādayorhareḥ | manniyuktāstadā yajñādhidevā jagadurdvijān ||32|| śālāyāṃ vṛṣaṇābhyāṃ vai tayorgrāmā hi nirgatāḥ | divyā divyacamatkārāḥ śālagrāmā hi te hareḥ ||33 || bhaktarakṣākṛte’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam | upasthitaḥ śāsituṃ vaḥ puṃpaśurūpavān hariḥ ||34|| tasya tvime vṛṣaṇā vai śālagrāmā bhavanti hi | agnirūpā vajrarūpāḥ śāstāro bhavatāṃ dvijāḥ || 35|| yūyamakāryakaraṇā hiṃsābhrāntā vimārgagāḥ | devānāṃ no havyamiṣṭaṃ na māṃsaṃ vai kadācana || 36 || pāyasānnaṃ ceṣṭatamaṃ tena kurvantu cādhvarān | phalāni śarkarāścāpi bījāni kamalāni ca || 37|| kaṇā vrīhiyavāścāpi śālayaśca dalāni ca | tilā miṣṭānnamapi ca madhu rasāśca śobhanāḥ ||38|| samidhaśca priyā nityaṃ devānāṃ na tu māṃsakam | dvijā bhrāntā bhavanto vai hiṃsāṃ kurvantu mā tviha || 39|| vayaṃ pavitrā devā mā hyaśuddhe yojayantu naḥ | pāpaphalaṃ tu vai duḥkhaṃ bhavatāṃ tad bhaviṣyati ||3.22.40|| puṃstvapraṇāśanaṃ caccādhvare’nuṣṭhīyate dvijāḥ | bhavadbhiḥ svasya puṃstvasya vināśaḥ kriyate divi ||41 || svargasyāpi vināśo vo hiṃsādoṣeṇa jāyate | vayaṃ śuddhivihīnāśca māṃsadoṣeṇa cādhvare ||42|| prāyaścittīyakarmāṇo bhaviṣyāmo dvijāstviha | svarge prāyaścittakarma tvakṛtvā svasvamandiram ||43 || saṃpraveṣṭamaśaktā hi hiṃsāṃ kurvantu no tataḥ | śālagrāmamahāgneśca śāntiryathā bhavediha ||44|| tathā viṣṇuṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram | ārādhayāmastvatraiva surarṣipitṛmānavāḥ ||45 || svayameva hariścāgneḥ śāntiṃ tatra kariṣyati | ayaṃ cāvṛṣaṇo devo nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ naraḥ ||46 || bhavadbhirhomakāryārthaṃ yojitaḥ saṃskṛtastviha | tamenaṃ paramātmānaṃ śaraṇaṃ sampatantu ca ||47|| sa hi rakṣāṃ rakṣako vai kṣamāṃ kṛtvā kariṣyati | ityuktāste surā lakṣmi tadā tuṣṭuvurīśvarāḥ ||48|| pitaro mānavā viprā māmevāvṛṣaṇaṃ harim | tvaṃ parabrahma bhagavān mūlaśrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||49|| ekamevādvitīyastvaṃ sarveśvarapareśvaraḥ | tvamevākṣaramuktānāmakṣarasyāpi kāraṇam ||3.22.50|| avatārāvatārāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ śaktisañjuṣām | śaktīnāṃ kāraṇaṃ sarveśvarāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavān ||51 || yajñānāṃ kāraṇaṃ tvaṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavān | vidhīnāṃ ca nidhīnāṃ ca dravyāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavān ||52|| sarveṣāṃ karmakāṇḍānāṃ devānāṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavān | kartā prerayitā tvaṃ ca vettā tṛptistvameva ca ||53|| dvijāśca karmaṭhāścāpi yajamānastvameva ca | dravyāṇi sarvahavyāni tvameva bhagavannasi ||54|| arthajñānaṃ vidherjñānaṃ mantrajñānaṃ ca vaidikam | tvāṃ vinā ca kriyājñānaṃ ko’nyo darśayituṃ kṣamaḥ ||55|| kṣamāṃ kṛtvā hare nātha dahyamānaṃ jagat tviha | rakṣa rakṣa kṛpāsindho’parādhām̐śca kṣamasva naḥ ||56|| ajñātamantratattvāśca vayaṃ viśasanaṃ tu yat| | kṛtavanto narasyaitat kṣamasva kṛpayā prabho ||57|| ajñānināmaparādhān kṣamante jñānino janāḥ | tvaṃ pitā jananī rakṣākaro vijño maheśvaraḥ ||58|| tvaṃ prabhuḥ sarvakartā ca sarvaśāstā sukhapradaḥ | yathārthabodhakaścāsi śādhi naḥ puruṣottama ||59|| ete tvaccharaṇaṃ prāptāstrāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān | ityevaṃ prārthitaścāhaṃ tadā lakṣmi pumuttamaḥ ||3.22.6 0|| upādideśa tān sarvān vedārthaṃ mama bhāṣitam | dvijatvaṃ dayayā śreyovidhānenāpyahiṃsayā ||6 1|| śuddhyā bhaktyā rāgadveṣarāhityena prajāyate | alobhenāpyakāmenātṛṣṇayā tapasā tathā ||62|| sadācāreṇa dharmeṇa santoṣeṇa prajāyate | satyena daivavṛttyā ceśvarārpaṇena vipratā ||63 || adroheṇābhayadānamokṣadānena jāyate | tad brāhmaṇyaṃ vidyayā ca vedenādhiprakāśate ||64|| prāpya tad drohakaraṇaṃ dvijānāṃ vṛṣa eva na | hiṃsā droho mahānatra svargamokṣanirodhakṛt ||65|| paraduḥkhakaraścātmā duḥkhaṃ bhuṃkte’pi tādṛśam | jīvataḥ śasane duḥkhamapāraṃ tatra jāyate ||66|| evaṃ duḥkhaṃ pradāyaiva dharmo’dharmatvamṛcchati | anyaccāpi ca viprendrāḥ śṛṇvantu suvivekavat ||67|| śuddhaṃ svādu sugandhaṃ ca paramānnaṃ mukhe gatam | ucchiṣṭaṃ jāyate tattūdare malatvamṛcchati ||68|| tadvikārāḥ peśikāmāṃsādyā malasvarūpiṇaḥ | devādibhiḥ kathaṃ sattvamayaiḥ śuddhaiḥ sudhādanaiḥ ||69|| bhujyante tādṛśaṃ viprā vicārayantu tāttvikam | tāmasyo makṣikā yatra vyākulitā bhavanti hi ||3.22.70|| aśuddhaṃ cāpi durgandhaṃ tāmasaṃ malinaṃ hi tat | kathaṃ devā dvijāstadvai samiccheyurhi bhojanam ||71 || dugdhaṃ sugandhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vai rasātmakaṃ ghṛtānvitam | sāttvikā yat samicchanti pavitraṃ bhojanaṃ payaḥ ||72|| makṣikā yat samicchanti sugandhaṃ miṣṭakaṃ madhu | rasām̐śca vividhān miṣṭām̐stān samicchanti devatāḥ ||73|| tasmāddhiṃsātmakaṃ yajñaṃ mā kurvantu dvijottamāḥ | paśūnāṃ bandhanaṃ saṃjñapanaṃ viśasanaṃ tathā ||74|| vapoddharaṇaṃ homādi sarvaṃ hiṃsātmakaṃ hi tat | hiṃsā kvāpi na vai kāryā cetyevaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ ||75|| sarvārpaṇaṃ harau kāryaṃ ceti me vaidikī śrutiḥ | patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ vastraṃ gṛhaṃ dhanaṃ sutaḥ ||76|| sutā patnī patirgauśca kṣetraṃ sampat svayaṃ tathā | nārāyaṇāya dātavyaṃ cetyevaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ ||77|| nārāyaṇātmanā dhyātvā kṛtvā nārāyaṇe’rpaṇam | yathārhamupayoktavyaṃ na tu ghāto vidhīyate ||78|| upākṛtyaiva tu tattaddevatābhyo yathārpitam | sarvaṃ prāsādikaṃ kṛtvā yoktavyaṃ vaiṣṇavo vṛṣaḥ ||79|| sarvaṃ nārāyaṇasyeti dhyātvaivaṃ ca tataḥ param | grahītavyaṃ nānyatheti sarvaṃ svaṃ prārpayeddharau ||3.22.80|| vaiśyasave caturvarṣastrīpaśuśca tathārpitaḥ | utsraṣṭavyo hareḥ sā ca bhoktavyā naiva sarvathā ||8 1 || pūjanīyā devikā sā ceti vai vaidikī śrutiḥ | gosave’pi tathā gāvo’rpaṇīyāḥ parameśvare ||82|| dakṣiṇāścāyutasaṃkhyāgāvo matāḥ prapūjitāḥ | utsraṣṭavyāḥ pūjanīyā dātavyā dugdhalabdhaye ||83|| marutstome’pi ca saptadaśāpi pañcavatsarāḥ | puṃpaśavastathāspṛṣṭagarbhā varṣatrayātmakāḥ ||84|| strīpaśavaścārpaṇīyāḥ parameśe parātmani | sādhavaste tathā sādhvyo bhaveyurbrahmabodhadāḥ ||85|| prathame ca dvitīye ca tṛtīye vatsare’pi ca | caturthe pañcame varṣe tathāsaṃkhyā narāḥ striyaḥ ||86|| tyāgāśrame pradātavyā acyutagotrakā iti | vaiṣṇavāste prakartavyā ityevaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ ||87|| aśvamedhe’pi daivaḥ sa nopayoktavya eva ha | aśvo yo’rpita evāpi devāya devatāyanaḥ ||88|| kuṣmāṇḍākhyaṃ phalaṃ deyaṃ vahnaye devatājuṣe | puroḍāśāḥ pradātavyāścaravo’pi yathocitam ||89|| evametanna sandeho vidheyo brāhmaṇairiha | vedavaktāpyahaṃ cāsmi yajñātmāpyahameva ca ||3.22.90|| mantre’hameva tiṣṭhāmi hārde vidantu me dvijāḥ | pratijñāṃ samprakurvantu hantavyo jantureva na || 91 || pūjanaṃ me vṛṣaṇayoḥ śālagrāmasvarūpayoḥ | kurvantu tena śāntirvai bhaviṣyatyanalasya ha ||92|| nānyathā syādagniśāntirjagad bhasmībhaviṣyati | śālāsu kartitau me vai vṛṣaṇau puṃstvasaṃbhṛtau ||93|| tābhyāṃ grāmāḥ samūhāścotpannāḥ koṭyarbudādhikāḥ | śālagrāmā hi te sarve matsvarūpā madātmakāḥ ||94|| jagadbhasmakarāḥ sarve tānarcayantu vai dvijāḥ | ityuktāḥ kṣmāsurāḥ sarve bahubhiścopacārakaiḥ ||95|| vaiṣṇavaiḥ sāmamantraiśca puṃsūktaiśca punaḥ punaḥ | pupūjuścāpi nāpyetāḥ śāntāḥ śālaśilāstadā ||96|| ahaṃ viprānakathayaṃ saṃśṛṇudhvaṃ vai samāhitāḥ | vinā yogyāsanaṃ naiva śāntiṃ yāsyanti tāḥ śilāḥ ||97|| prārthayantu śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ yogyaṃ sā saṃvidhāsyati | atha viprairarcitā tvaṃ lakṣmīsūktādibhistadā ||98|| pūjitā vanditā cāpi śāntyarthaṃ viniveditā | tatastvaṃ pippalapatrākārapīṭhātmikābhavaḥ ||99|| divyāsanātmikā jātā divyasauvarṇarūpiṇī | siṃhāsanābhidhānā vai dhṛtavatyapi tāḥ śilāḥ || 3.22.100 || atha śāntiṃ tathā sthairyaṃ śilāḥ prāptāśca niṣkriyāḥ | upadravavihīnāśca śānto’gniḥ sarvato diśi || 10 1|| suraiśca pitṛbhiḥ sarvairmānavairmunibhistadā | pūjitā bahubhāvādyaiḥ śālagrāmāśca candanaiḥ || 1 02|| sugandhibhiścopacārairdivyāste harayo’bhavan | haryātmakā hareraṃśā haryarcārūpiṇaḥ sadā || 103 || harerme’ṅgamayā madātmakā mokṣapradāyinaḥ | śrīyuktāste bhagavanto’bhavanpāṣāṇamūrtayaḥ || 1 04|| atha mūlau vṛṣaṇau me mayā dhṛtau yathāsthale | lagnitau ca yadā tau me tadāhaṃ puṃstvasaṃyutaḥ || 1 05|| pūrṇamūrtirabhavaṃ vai bhaktā mayā hi rakṣitāḥ | naramedhe purā yajñe bhūtvā pratyakṣarūpiṇā || 1 06|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | anādiśrīśālapuṃstvanārāyaṇo’bhavaṃ tadā || 1 07|| saumyaḥ śālagrāmamūrtiḥ pīṭhikāśrīśubhāsane | ākalpaṃ cābhavaṃ lakṣmi smara māṃ tvāṃ tathāvidhām || 1 08|| avasaṃśca tvayā sākaṃ mūrtimān śrīpatiḥ pumān | anye me te’vatārāśca tatra kalpe’bhavan priye || 1 09|| sarvān vedmi yathākāryamavatārān hi me priye | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktirmuktiḥ prajāyate || 3.22.11 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso’vṛṣākhye saptaviṃśe vatsare naramedhe bhaktarakṣārtham anādiśrīpuṃstvanārāyaṇasya prākaṭyaṃ naramedhādiyajñārthajñānādikaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 22 ||
<3.23> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ me cātipāvanīm | prākaṭyarūpāṃ divyāṃ ca vedhaso’nalavatsare || 1 || aṣṭāviṃśe tvaṣṭaśate kalpe ca prathame manau | rājāsīt sūryavarcākhyo brahmaṇā tvanubodhitaḥ || 2 || vedamārgarataḥ sarvastarāṇāṃ maṇḍaleśvaraḥ | vyomacārivimānena devānāṃ sadasi sthitaḥ || 3 || pātāleṣu tathā merau graheṣu gatimān vratī | mama pūjāparo nityaṃ siddhānāṃ sevako yuvā || 4 || prajānāṃ mama bhaktyarthaṃ yatnavān sādhusadguṇaḥ | sa tvekadācintayaddhi rājñyā samaṃ nijālaye || 5 || mānavo’yaṃ mama dehaḥ priye nṛpābhibodhitaḥ | nṝnpātītiyathārthaṃ vai kadā pravartate priye || 6 || rājñī prāha manuṣyāṇāṃ deho’yaṃ mokṣasiddhaye | nṝṇāṃ mokṣapradātṛtve nṛpaḥ svārthe pravartate || 7 || nṛpaśabdo’nyathā naiva sārthakaḥ śāsane mataḥ | bhūtvā bhūtvā vilīyante mānavāḥ karmasaṃhṛtāḥ || 8 || teṣāṃ pālanakārye ca kṛte’pi yānti saṃkṣayam | deharakṣā na vai rakṣā dehapatvaṃ na pālanam || 9 || annāni ca jalaṃ vahnirvāyuḥ pānti svabhāvataḥ | rājñāṃ tatrāvaśyakatā nāsti svabhāvapālite || 3.23.1 0|| śreṣṭhayuge na vai cauryaṃ na chadma nāpahartṛtā | tena yugaḥ prayātyeva rājñāṃ tatra na pālitā || 1 1|| kṛte yuge satyadharme rājā nirarthako yataḥ | sārthakatvaṃ nṛpatvaṃ tu mārgaṇīyaṃ bhaved yadi || 12|| mama buddhau mokṣadānapradānena nṛpālitā | sārthaketi prajānātha pratibhātyeva tatkuru || 1 3|| rājā bhaktyā svayaṃ mokṣaṃ prayātyeva yathā tathā | prajāścāpi parābhaktyā mokṣamāpnuyureva cet || 1 4|| nṛpatitvaṃ kṛtaṃ tena sārthakaṃ janmavedinā | etādṛśaṃ nṛpatvaṃ tvaṃ rājan kuru pramuktidam || 15|| śrutvaivaṃ mahiṣīvākyaṃ nṛpo mumoda cāntare | śrutitulyāṃ satīṃ matvā patnīṃ mokṣasahāyinīm || 16|| punaḥ papraccha tāṃ mudgāyanīnāmnīṃ nijāṃ priyām | kayā rītyā nṛṇāṃ mokṣakaraṇaṃ syāt praśādhi me || 17|| mudgāyanī tadā prāha ṛṣīn siddhān tapasvinaḥ | sādhūn sādhvīḥ samāhūya lokāntarebhya ityapi || 18|| mandiraṃ kārayitvā ca mokṣadāṃ pārameśvarīm | pratimāṃ sthāpayitvā tvaṃ sadā kuru mahotsavān || 19|| prajāḥ sevāṃ pūjanaṃ ca darśanaṃ smaraṇaṃ tathā | kīrtanaṃ śravaṇaṃ bhṛtyaṃ dāsyaṃ ca vandanaṃ stavam ||3.23.20|| kariṣyanti bhajanaṃ ca nartanaṃ bhāvanārpaṇam | annavastrārpaṇaṃ pātrārpaṇaṃ ca candanārpaṇam ||2 1|| śṛṃgārāṇāmarpaṇaṃ ca sugandhānāṃ tathārpaṇam | pañcāmṛtārpaṇaṃ cāpi gītārpaṇaṃ japārpaṇam ||22||| ātmārpaṇaṃ kariṣyanti gamiṣyanti paraṃ padam | mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ cāpi dīpārpaṇaṃ dhvajārpaṇam ||23|| vādyārpaṇaṃ vādanaṃ ca phalapuṣpārpaṇaṃ tathā | kuṃkumākṣatahārāṇāmarpaṇaṃ dhūpakārpaṇam ||24|| naivedyārpaṇamevāpi tathā nīrājanārpaṇam | pradakṣiṇaṃ stutiṃ namo daṇḍavacca tathāñjalim |||25||| hāvaṃ bhāvaṃ ca vai harerālocanaṃ ca cintanam | mananaṃ nirṇayaṃ cāpi kariṣyanti janāḥ kathām ||26|| dhanaṃ svarṇaṃ tathā raupyaṃ tāmraṃ vā yaṣṭikāṃ ca vā | ābharaṇāni divyāni maṇīn ratnāni hīrakān ||27|| mañjarīḥ puṣpamālāśca gucchān veṣān suśobhanān | mukuṭaṃ kaṭakaṃ mālāṃ śṛṃkhalāṃ mekhalāṃ tathā ||28|| ūrmikāṃ cāpi hetīṃśca śaṃkhacakrādikāni ca | naktakaṃ sukhaśayyāṃ ca pāduke yānamuttamam || 29|| vāhanaṃ ca vimānaṃ ca godhanaṃ ca rasādikam | sumiṣṭaṃ śarkarādyaṃ ca madhu ghṛtaṃ kaṇādikam ||3.23.3 0|| ghaṭaṃ sukalaśaṃ sthālīṃ pūjāpātrāṇi varttikāḥ | utsavopakaraṇāni dāsyanti mānavāḥ khalu ||3 1 || haraye tvarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā yāsyanti paramaṃ padam | karmaṭhā api satrāṇi kṛtvā vai mandire hareḥ |||32|| bhikṣukāśca prasādānnaṃ bhuktvā yāsyanti tatpadam | aparādhakṛtaḥ kṣamāṃ yācitvāpi hareḥ puraḥ ||33 || pāpāḥ pāpaṃ nivedyāpi yāsyanti paramāṃ gatim | vratī vratāni prārpyaiva gamiṣyati paraṃ padam |||24|| nāryo nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ bhajitvā parameśvaram | kāntaṃ sarveśvaraṃ taṃ ca yāsyanti paramaṃ padam ||25|| bālā vṛddhāḥ sadhanā vā nirdhanā api sarvathā | bhajitvā bhagavantaṃ taṃ yāsyanti paramaṃ padam ||365|| tasmād rājannṛṇāṃ mokṣamārgasyodghāṭanāya vai | nṛpatitvaṃ sārthakaṃ vai kartuṃ śrīharimandiram ||37|| prakāraya śubhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sahasraikaghaṭānvitam | sahasraśikharaṃ ramyaṃ sauvarṇakalaśānvitam ||38|| gaganasparśi śobhāḍhyaṃ tatraiva vidhinā harim | bhagavantaṃ prabhuṃ devaṃ pratiṣṭhāpaya kānakam ||3 9|| pratimārūpiṇaṃ devaṃ devarṣigaṇabodhitam | surūpaṃ sundaraṃ jagatkartāraṃ parameśvaram ||3.23.40 || nijaśaktiyutaṃ nijaiśvaryapārṣadasevitam | nijāyatanasaṃyuktaṃ pratiṣṭhāpaya tatra ca ||41 || sarvadṛśyaṃ sarvasevyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśakam | sarvaśāntipradaṃ devaṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ||42|| ityuktvā svāmine rājñī tūṣṇīmāsa kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ | rājā pathyaṃ ca tathyaṃ ca mene mokṣapradaṃ vacaḥ ||43 || japasatraṃ cakārāsau māsikaṃ kīrtanānvitam | āhvayāmāsa siddhām̐śca ṛṣīndevāṃśca mānavān ||44|| akhaṇḍanāmabhajanaṃ kārayāmāsa māsikam | hare kṛṣṇa hare kṛṣṇa śrīpate puruṣottama ||45 || antarātman prabho viṣṇo parameśa namo’stu te | ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ rājā kārayāmāsa cāniśam ||46|| bhojanāni vicitrāṇi sudhāsvādūni vai dadau | sevāṃ sarvavidhāṃ sarvasatriṇāṃ vidadhe mudā ||47|| nityamāyānti lokebhyaḥ prayānti ca surādayaḥ | bhajanaṃ satataṃ tatra jāyate’virataṃ priye ||48|| evaṃ māse śrāvaṇe vai vyatīte cāntime dine | pūrṇātithau sabhāmadhye praśnaṃ cakāra bhūpatiḥ ||49|| mānuṣāṇāṃ mokṣagatirakhaṇḍitā bhavediha | yathā tathā surādyā me darśayantu prathāṃ śubhām |||3.23.50|| atha siddhāstadā prāhurmandiraṃ tvatra kāraya | ṛṣayaśca surāścāpi mānavā jagadustathā ||51 || mandireṇa parā puṣṭirmokṣasyātra bhaviṣyati | tatprakāraya rājendra pratiṣṭhāpaya tatra ca ||52|| śrīpatiṃ paramātmānaṃ parabrahma pareśvaram | pratimārūpiṇaṃ devaṃ sarvamokṣapradaṃ prabhum ||53|| omityuktvā japayajñaṃ pūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tato nṛpaḥ | kārayāmāsa sauvarṇaṃ sahasraśikharānvitam ||54|| nakṣatrasparśi sudṛśyaṃ mandiraṃ prathamaṃ bhuvi | sāṃgopāṃgasamastaṃ vai jātaṃ pūrṇaṃ tataḥ param |||55||| cintayāmāsa mūrtyarthaṃ kutaḥ kasmād bhavediti | rātrau rājācintayacca nirviṇṇo mānase’bhavat ||56|| sasmāra māṃ parabrahma śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam | ahaṃ bhaktasmṛtiṃ jñātvā sākaṃ tvayā tu padmaje ||57|| gatavān yatra rājāsau pratyakṣatāṃ gato’bhavam | sūryavarcāstadā dṛṣṭvā natvā māṃ gocaraṃ puraḥ ||58|| praṇanāma madhuparkaṃ dadau cakāra daṇḍavat | āsanaṃ pradadau mahyaṃ sarvābharaṇaśāline ||59|| sarvatejo’bhidīptāya sarvaiśvaryānvitāya ca | sarvaprasannatāvṛṣṭikārakāyāntarātmane ||3.23.6 0|| pradadau bhojanaṃ pānaṃ pūjanaṃ ca nijārpaṇam | sarvasvārpaṇamevāpi cakre bhaktyānvito nṛpaḥ ||6 1 || prārthayāmāsa māṃ tatra nirmite mandire śubhe | nityavāsasya yogye vai mahodyānābhisaṃvṛte ||62|| pratyakṣaṃ bhagavannatra vasa sthiraḥ sadā bhava | salakṣmīkaḥ pārṣadādyaiścopakaraṇairanvitaḥ ||63 || mayā lokasya mokṣārthaṃ tathāstvevaṃ samīritam | athoktaṃ yāhi rājendra vanānte śiṃśapādrumam ||64|| ṛṣīṇāmāśramamadhye sthitaṃ mahāntamuttamam | tatpārśvasthaṃ vāmagaṃ ca vaṭavṛkṣaṃ śubhottamam ||65|| mandire’tra yathāvāso mama tatra tathaiva ca | tau vṛkṣau tava rājye’tra nau mūrtirūpiṇau nṛpa ||66 || svecchayaiva mayā lakṣmyā cobhābhyāṃ kalpitau kṛtau | nityau divyau mama rūpau prācīnau bahuvatsarau ||67|| nityapuṣṭau devapūjyau vartete śrīnarāyaṇau | tānibhau nṛpa cāvāṃ svo yāhi pūjaya mānaya ||68|| ṛṣibhiḥ pūjitau nityau vartāmahe drurūpiṇau | atha mūrtisvarūpau vai tābhyāṃ prakāśitāviha ||69|| sthāsyāvaścātra vidhinā pratiṣṭhitau svayaṃ nṛpa | ityuktaḥ sa yayau rājā mahodyāne vaṭāntikam ||3.23.70|| śiṃśapādrumasaṃyuktaṃ divy divyarasānvitam | vaṭaṃ śubhraṃ samālokya nṛpastvāścaryamāptavān ||71 || ṛṣīn praṇamya vidhivanmaharṣigaṇakāritām | pūjāṃ cakre drumayoḥ saṃyuktayośca nṛpaḥ svayam ||72|| dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ jaladānaṃ naivedyaṃ kusumāñcalim | datvā cārāretrikaṃ cakre tadāhaṃ śiṃśapādrume ||73 || stambe nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣātparamātmā sanātanaḥ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhārī śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||74|| śyāmalaḥ śyāmavarṇaśca divyarūpo’bhavaṃ puraḥ | śiṃśapāstamba evāhaṃ cāhaṃ stambo na vai pṛthaka ||75|| śākhā me pārṣadāḥ sarve pārṣadāṇyaśca vai tadā | maddehayogavantaste hyadṛśyanta madātmakāḥ ||76|| atha vṛkṣe vaṭe stambe bhavatīgocarā priye | stambābhinnā stambagarbhā vaṭakāraṇarūpiṇī ||77|| śākhāśca tava sakhyaśca muktānyaḥ śobhanāḥ priyāḥ | adṛśyanta tvadabhinnāstvadyoginyastvadātmikāḥ ||78|| evaṃ māṃ tvāṃ vīkṣya rājā sūryavarcā mudānvitaḥ | prakṛtvā daṇḍavattūrṇaṃ saṃprokṣya vedamantrakaiḥ ||79|| māṃ tvāṃ sammānapūrvaṃ cārohayāmāsa vai rathe | sauvarṇe śatakalaśe vimānavatsuśobhite ||3.23.80|| śataikahastivāhye ca mahotsavasamanvitaḥ | ānīya mandirabhūmau maṇḍape vidhivattadā ||8 1 || saṃsthāpya vidhinā kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāṃ sarvakarmabhiḥ | mandire māṃ tvāṃ tathā ca pārṣadān tvatsasvīstathā ||82|| saṃpratiṣṭhāpayāmāsa divyaṃ pratyakṣamāgatam | ākalpaṃ nyavasaṃ naije mandire vai tvayā saha ||83 || divyarūpo divyanetravatāṃ bhaktijuṣāṃ kṛte | mūrtirūpaścarmacakṣuṣmatāṃ māyājuṣāṃ kṛte ||84|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ puruṣottamaḥ | anādiśrīśiṃśapānārāyaṇaḥ śyāmalo’bhavam ||85|| anādiśrīśyāmanārāyaṇetikhyātimāptavān | tvaṃ vaṭaśrīkhyātimāptā mama pārśve’tisundarī ||86|| gauraśvetasuvarṇā vai divyadehā manoramā | mānavāstu tato nityaṃ surā maharṣayo’pi ca ||87|| pitaraścāsurāścāpi māṃ tvāṃ prasevya muktigāḥ | babhūvustatra kalpe vai lakṣmi nṛpatā sārthikā ||88|| rājñā tena kṛtā rājñyupadeśena pramokṣadā | sarvābhayapradānaṃ vai kṛtaṃ rājñā madarpaṇāt ||89|| etajjānāmyahaṃ lakṣmi śyāmalaṃ mama rūpakam | gauraṃ rūpaṃ tava lakṣmi smara tanmandiraṃ hyapi ||3.23.90|| smara taṃ pārṣadaṃ cāpi rājānaṃ ca sakhīṃ nṛpīm | smarāsaṃkhyām̐stadā jātānmuktān koṭyarbudābjakān ||9 1|| anye tadāpyavatārā mama jātā hyanekaśaḥ | yathākāryānurūpā vai jānāmyetānahaṃ priye ||92|| evaṃ śyāmalarūpeṇa bhaktānāṃ bhaktimuttamām | śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ pādasevanaṃ vandanaṃ tathā ||93|| arcanaṃ sakhyamevāpi tathā cātmanivedanam | lepanaṃ mārjanaṃ pādasaṃvāhanaṃ ca bhojanam ||94|| jalapānaṃ vastrabhūṣādānaṃ śṛṃgārakaṃ tathā | ārādhanaṃ namaskāraṃ sahayānaṃ ca nartanam ||95|| gāyanaṃ ramaṇaṃ vāṭyāṃ vihāraṃ hasanaṃ tathā | sarvaṃ tvaṃgīcakārāhaṃ bhūtvā prasanna eva tān ||96|| nināya mama dhāmāpi tvakṣarākhyaṃ paraṃ padam | vaiṣṇavī pṛthivī sarvā narā nāryaśca vaiṣṇavāḥ ||97|| paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi madyogānmuktimāyayuḥ | śyāmalaḥ śyāmalaśceti nārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||98|| gāyanto jīvavṛndā māmīyuḥ kalpe tadā priye | pāpino’pi hare śyāma vandato dharmiṇo’bhavan ||99|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇānmuktimāpnuyāt | ante rājā sadeśaśca sagotraḥ saprajājanaḥ || 3.23.10 0|| sāśritaḥ sabhṛtyakaśca sastrīko muktimāpa ha | api go’śvaprabhṛtayaścāpi muktiṃ yayuḥ parām || 10 1|| tasmānmandiranirmāṇaṃ pratimāsthāpanaṃ mama | śreṣṭhamabhayadānaṃ tajjīvānāṃ jāyate kṣitau || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso’ṣṭāviṃśe vatsare sūryavarcānṛpadvārā mandire’nādiśrīśiṃśapā(śyāma)nārāyaṇasya vaṭaśrīsahitasya prākaṭyamityādiniparūṇanāmā trayoviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 23 ||
<3.24> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri brahmaṇaḥ pitṛvatsare | navaviṃśe navatyātmakalpe ca saptame manau || 1 || āsīdvai mama loke’tra prākaṭyaṃ śṛṇu padmaje | brahmaṇo guptaromabhyaścāsuraścitrarūpavān || 2 || mayūranāmako jajñe sapakṣapicchacañcukaḥ | pādayuktaḥ kāmarūpadharaḥ parvatasannibhaḥ || 3 || ḍayamāno’mbare tvākarṣayati grahamaṇḍalam | pṛthvyāṃ gacchan grāmakūṭān parvatān samakarṣati || 4 || jale’ntaḥ sampraviṣṭaḥ san saṃkṣobhayati vāridhīn | kampayatyeva pṛthivīṃ devām̐strastān karoti ca || 5 || mānuṣānnāgasarpāṃśca sahasraśo haratyapi | kvacid bhavati devaḥ sa mahendrābhaḥ svarūpavān || 6 || kvacicca mānavaṃ rūpaṃ samrāṇṇibhaṃ bibhartti ca | kvacinmaharṣitulyaśca tejaḥparidhiśobhanaḥ || 7 || jāyate kāmarūpo vai mohako balavānapi | tapaścacāra rājasya lobhād varṣasahasrakam || 8 || brahmā tuṣṭo varaṃ prādānmṛtyurhariṃ vinā na te | sa tvevaṃ prāpya vacanaṃ tuṣṭo niḥśaṃka eva ha || 05 || satye loke jane svarge mānave cātalādiṣu | tattadrūpadharo bhūtvā yāti bhuṃkte prahṛṣyati || 3.24.1 0|| kvacid devagṛhān gatvāmṛtaṃ bhuktvā prayāti ca | devīṃ vā mānavīṃ nārīṃ hṛtvā yāti sthalāntaram || 11 || yakṣiṇīṃ rākṣasīṃ nītvā smṛddhiṃ nītvā prayāti vā | dānavīṃ vā satīṃ nāgīṃ nītvā yāti vanāntaram || 12 || gā vatsatarīraśvān gajānnītvā prayāti ca | merordroṇyāṃ vanāḍhyāyāṃ śatayojanavistare || 13 || araṇye svālayaṃ cakre smṛddhaṃ subhogaśobhanam | hṛtvā hṛtvā narānnārīrdevīrvā rākṣasīśca vā || 14|| sarvaṃ naijaṃ sa kṛtvaiva bhuṃkte bhogamayaṃ ca tat | yuddhe na maraṇaṃ yāti brahmaṇo varadānataḥ || 15|| sarvatra gatimatvācca vijayaṃ labhate sadā | evaṃ samrāṭsamo jātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ svabalāddhi saḥ || 16|| nṛpānanyān śanairjitvā nṛpeśvaro’bhavattataḥ | sāmrājyaṃ mama sarvatra pārthivaṃ ceti vakti ca || 17|| uddhoṣaṇāṃ kṛtavām̐śca cakravartyahameva yat | balī sarvatra gatvaiva jayatyākṣitimaṇḍalam || 18|| nṛpān rājye’surān pratiṣṭhāpya rājyaṃ karoti ca | evaṃ śanaiḥ samabhavaccakravartī mayūrakaḥ || 19|| pradharṣitumathendrāṇīṃ svargalokaṃ jagāma saḥ | uddhṛtya tāṃ cāmbareṇoḍḍīya yāvad bhuvaṃ prati ||3.24.20|| prayāti tāvadevendro vajreṇainaṃ jaghāna ha | vajraṃ cānalaprakhyaṃ tajjagrāsa cañcusaṃdhṛtam ||21|| atha trāsaṃ jagāmendraḥ vīkṣya māyūrakaṃ balam | nivavṛte nijaṃ sthānaṃ dikpālebhyo nyavedayat ||22|| sajjāḥ sarve’pi dikpālā yuddhārthaṃ samupāyayuḥ | yamaḥ kuberaśceśāno varuṇo nirṛto’nilaḥ ||23|| analo’rkaśca rudraśca pṛthvyāṃ sarve samāyayuḥ | sabalāḥ sajjaśastrāśca vineduścāmbare ca te ||24|| bhutvā nādān samarārthān garjanā dyusadāṃ tathā | mayūro niryayau śīghraṃ yuddhārthaṃ balasaṃyutaḥ ||25|| daśasāhasrasenānīsahito’bjabhaṭānvitaḥ | yuyudhe ghorasaṃgrāmaṃ samvatsaraṃ hi mānavam ||26|| hataṃ sainyaṃ hi bahudhā svasya tadapyajīvayat | āsuryā vidyayā mitho yuyudhe dyusadīśvaraiḥ ||27|| māyūrakā mahākrūrā āsurā vai samantataḥ | sākaṃ devagaṇaiḥ sarve yuyudhire’tinirbhayāḥ ||28|| nānto yuddhasya bhavati māyūro nāpi naśyati | virāmo na surāṇāṃ ca manuṣyā duḥkhino’bhavan ||29|| mānavyaśca surāṇyaśca satyo nāginya ityapi | daityānyaścāpi vai trastā niryānti sma na vai bahiḥ ||3.24.30 || trailokyāṃ sarvalokeṣu prajāsu cāpi rājasu | udvejanaṃ ca duḥkhaṃ ca vartate’sya sadā tadā ||3 1|| nirviṇṇāścātha vai devāḥ pariśramaṃ gatā bahum | nistejasko ravirjāto mahendro bhagnamānasaḥ ||32|| varuṇaḥ kṣīṇaśaktiśca yamo vibhramatāṃ gataḥ | nirṛto’pi kṣīṇasainyo’bhavattatra raṇe tathā ||33|| īśāno’pi hatotsāhaḥ kuberaḥ kṣīṇasattvakaḥ | agnistaikṣṇyavihīnaśca marudrodanamācaram ||34|| anye devā gatāśāścābhavannṛpāstu tadvaśāḥ | evaṃ kāle samāpanne duḥkhe ca sarvato’dhike ||35|| devā raṇaṃ vihāyaiva yayuste brahmaṇo gṛham | prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ jagaduḥ svāpakṛṣṭatām ||36|| āsurasya balaṃ cāpi rakṣārthaṃ cānvarodhayan | brahmā śrutvā tu tānāha yatiṣye bhavatāṃ kṛte ||37|| sarve caivātra tiṣṭhantvārādhayantu hariṃ param | hariṃ vinā na vai tasya nāśako’nyo’sti madvarāt ||38|| ityuktā devatādyāścārādhayāmāsurutsukāḥ | māmanādiśrīśanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||39|| ahaṃ sākaṃ tvayā lakṣmi gajārūḍho’kṣarād drutam | upāyayau satyalokaṃ tadā brahmasabhāsthalam ||3.24.40|| brahmādyāḥ svāgataṃ pūjāṃ mama cakrustataḥ param | jagadurnijaduḥkhaṃ cāsuranāśaṃ pravavrire ||41 || tadāhaṃ cāsuranāśaṃ padmaje samacintayam | yāntu naijān pradeśānityavadaṃ ca surānaham ||42|| śīghraṃ surā yayurnaijān deśānahaṃ ca mānavam | rūpaṃ dhṛtvājagāma kṣmāṃ yatrālayo’surasya vai ||43|| kṣātraṃ rūpamahaṃ dhṛtvā saśaraṃ dhanuṣā yutam | gatvā ca gopure tasya bhikṣāyātrāṃ vyadhāpayam ||44|| mayūraśca tadā dūtairvijñaptaḥ svayameva tu | ātithyārthaṃ gopuraṃ svaṃ cājagāma samutsukaḥ ||45|| natvā māṃ kinnu bhikṣāyāṃ yācase tviti cāha saḥ | yuddhabhikṣāṃ dehi me’tra yāce’haṃ nāparāmiti ||46|| yācitaḥ sa dadau bhikṣāṃ jalaṃ dhṛtvā kare tadā | śastreṇa śastraṃ saṃyujya dhanuṣāptā mayāpi sā ||47|| tatraiva yuddhaṃ hyabhavad gopurāgre vanottame | ghoraṃ tenaiva sākaṃ vai māsāntaṃ subhayaṃkaram ||48|| surāṇāṃ mānavānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ śīlasañjuṣām | rājñāṃ cāpi pravīrāṇāṃ romaharṣaṇakārakam ||49|| devā ākāśamārgeṇa jñātvā yuddhapravartanam | paśyantyāgatya tatraiva jayaṃ vadanti me tadā ||3.24.50|| eko’haṃ vai mayūreṇa yuddhaṃ karomi nāparaḥ | māsānte mama bāṇaiśca śastrairastrairgadādibhiḥ ||5 1 || bhinnapiccho’bhavattūrṇaṃ nirāśo’pyabhavattadā | māyūrakānnijayoddhṛn yojayāmāsa saṃyuge ||52|| te sāhāyyakarāstasya māmāvṛttya samantataḥ | yuyudhire’tivegena cārbudāste mayūrakāḥ ||53|| māyārūpadharāścāpi māyāśastradharāstathā | māyāveṣadharāścāpi māyāyuddhakarāstathā ||54|| mṛṣādehadharāścāpi mṛṣāsainyanirūpiṇaḥ | sarve mayā hatāstatra sudarśanena vai kramāt ||55|| dagdhā mṛtā mayūrāste sudarśanasya tejasā | māyūrakī purī dagdhā bhaktā mayā surakṣitāḥ ||56|| śacyādikāḥ priyā yāśca mānavyaścāpi mānavāḥ | narā nāryo devatāśca mayā tatraiva rakṣitāḥ ||57|| āsurāste hatāḥ sarve māyūravaṃśayoginaḥ | sarve niravaśeṣāste kṛtāḥ sudarśanena vai |||58|| māyūrakastathā dṛṣṭvā vināśaṃ svasya sarvathā | andho bhūtvā mahākhaḍgaṃ dhṛtvā kare vihāyasā ||59|| adriprāyaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā papāta mama mastake | hantuṃ māṃ khaḍgadhāreṇa tāvanmayā sudarśanam ||3.24.60|| adhastātpreritaṃ tasmai dadāha taṃ tadāmbare | bhasmībhūtaḥ samasto vai vyomnyeva samapadyata ||61 || devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭirmamopari | candanākṣatavṛṣṭiśca jayaghoṣāstathābhavan ||62|| māyūravaṃśajā nāryo rurudurvai tadā mudhā | devānāhūya ca tadāvātaraṃ tatra pattane ||63 || māyūrake mahāraṇye sarvasmṛddhisuśobhane | kārāgāraṃ vilokyāpi tatsthānamocayaṃ janāna ||64|| devānamocayaṃ tūrṇaṃ tathā devīramocayam | śacīmukhyādevatāścāmocayaṃ mānavīstathā ||65|| tadrājye devatāḥ sarvā devāśca mānavā api | māṃ kṣatraṃ paramātmānaṃ śrīhariṃ puruṣottamam ||66|| tīrthajalairabhiṣicya pupūjurhi vidhānataḥ | pratiṣṭhāpayāmāsuśca śriyā sākaṃ samutsukāḥ ||67|| anekāḥ kanyakā nāryo mayūravaṃśajāstadā | anāthā māṃ paraṃ nāthaṃ prāpya tā vavrire mudā ||68|| mayā yajñe pāvitāśca gṛhītā vidhinā kare | brahmādyairarpitāḥ sarvā mama patnyastadābhavan ||69|| evaṃ mayā mayūrākhyo mahāsuro hataḥ purā | māṃ vinā tasya vai nāśo nānyena nirmito yataḥ ||3.24.70|| tasya tejo nirgataṃ tu mayyeva śāntimāpa ha | muktiṃgato’suraḥ so’pi tathānye’pi ca ye hatāḥ ||71|| sarve mokṣaṃ gatā me yat sudarśanena vai hatāḥ | mocitāścāpi rājāno māṃ prapūjya pareśvaram || 72|| yayuste vai nijadeśān surāśca tridivaṃ gatāḥ | nāgapatnyaśca mānavyastathā devyo’pyanāthikāḥ ||73|| māṃ vivāhya sthitā sarvā mama patnyastadā priye | tvaṃ sarvāsāṃ rājarājñīnāmnī śrīrabhavastadā ||74|| ayonijā kṣātrarūpadhartrī matpārśvaśālinī | atha picchānmayūrasya saṃgṛhya mārjanī tvayā ||75|| kṛtā bhūmārjanārthaṃ vai tathā matpārṣadairapi | mārjanikāḥ kṛtāḥ sarvāḥ surūpāḥ śobhanā api ||76|| athāhaṃ svavimānena bhūtale sarvato diśi | yatra yatrāsurāścāsan mayūreṇa nṛpīkṛtāḥ | tatra tatraiva gatvā ca hatvā tān mūlataḥ priye || 77|| dadau rājyāni sarvāṇi kṣatriyebhyo yathāyatham | evaṃ mayā mama sarvaṃ sāmrājyaṃ bhūtale’bhitaḥ ||78|| sthāpitaṃ ca tadā śreṣṭhaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ paramātmanā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena cakradhāriṇā ||79|| anādiśrīkṣatranārāyaṇarūpeṇa rakṣatā | anādiśrīrājarājñīsahitena smara priye ||3.24.80|| mayā kṣātravṛṣāḥ sarve pālitāḥ kṣitimaṇḍale | sarve yajñāḥ kṛtāścāpi rakṣitāśca prajā api ||8 1|| devatā rakṣitāścāpi dharmamārgāḥ pravartitāḥ | satraprathāḥ kṛtāścāpi vedamārgāḥ prapoṣitāḥ ||82|| nītayaḥ sthāpitāścāpi sādhavo rakṣitāstadā | sanmaṭhāḥ kāritāḥ śreṣṭhā devādayāśca kāritāḥ ||83||| tīrthāni rakṣitānyeva bhikṣukāścāpi rakṣitāḥ | kathā nārāyaṇasyāpi sarvā nityaṃ pravācitāḥ ||84|| satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ pālitāśca dharme sadā prarakṣitāḥ | bhaktiśca mama te cāpi sarvakṣmāyāṃ pravartitā ||85|| vaidikaścāpyātmabodhaḥ kalpe tadā mayoditaḥ | sabhāyāṃ me tadā lakṣmi daśasāhasrasādhavaḥ ||86|| daśasāhasraviprāśca daśasāhasrasādhvikāḥ | daśasāhasrabaṭavo daśasāhasravaidikāḥ ||87|| daśasāhasrātithayo daśasāhasrabhikṣukāḥ | daśasāhasrānāthāśca daśasāhasrajāpakāḥ ||88|| daśasāhasramakhino daśasāhasrasatriṇaḥ | daśasāhasrayamino daśasāhasratāpasāḥ ||89|| vratino daśasāhasrā daśasāhasrapaṇḍitāḥ | daśasāhasradāsāśca daśasāhasradāsikāḥ ||3.24.90|| daśasāhasrayogajñā daśasāhasracāraṇāḥ | nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti sattvasthā jñānayogaparāyaṇāḥ ||91 || mama bhaktiyutāḥ sarve mama satre prabhojinaḥ | mama mūrteśca dhartāro dhyānamārge kṛtādarāḥ ||92|| babhūvuḥ kṛtavāsāśca sadā svātmanivedinaḥ | mayā pṛthvyāḥ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sāptasāmudrasaṃvṛtam ||93|| mānavānāṃ hi mokṣārthaṃ devānāṃ sukhalabdhaye | pātālādinivāsāśca svargādikanivāsinaḥ ||94|| anvasaram̐śca māṃ sarve bhejurmāṃ sakaleśvaram | ākalpaṃ tu tadā cāhaṃ nyavasaṃ bhūtale’niśam ||95|| vaikuṇṭhatulyā pṛthivī nirātaṃkā tadā hyabhūt | kalpadrumāstathā kāmadhenavaḥ kāmavallikāḥ ||96|| cintāmaṇayaḥ sarvatra tadāsan mama yogataḥ | sadā kṛtayugaścāpi kālaścaikavidho’bhavat ||97|| mānasyaścāpi ca spārśanyaśca dārśanikāstathā | tathā ca sahavāsinyaścāsan vai sṛṣṭayastadā ||98|| smara sarvaṃ rājarājñīśri tvaṃ rājādhirājatām | jānāmyahaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ nānye jānantyabuddhayaḥ ||99|| avatārāḥ pare cāpi tadāsanme yathocitāḥ | devamānavarūpāśca tattatkāryanivartakāḥ || 3.24.10 0|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ te’tra prākaṭyaṃ mama padmaje | paṭhanācchravaṇādvāpi bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 101 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso navaviṃśe vatsare māyūrakāsuranāśārtham anādiśrīrājanārāyaṇasya rājarājñīśrīsahitasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 24 ||
<3.25> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ mama vai tataḥ | triṃśattame vedhasastu devavatsarasaṃjñake || 1 || varṣe kalpe daśaśate manau caturdaśe purā | camatkāraṃ tava lakṣmi vadāmi hi mayā saha || 2 || prākaṭyaṃ vai tadā loke yadāsīd bhūtale śṛṇu | prānte kṛte’bhavan bhaktāḥ surāṣṭre pañca cāvayoḥ || 3 | | devasakhaśca kīrtiśca ciklīta kardamastathā | jātavedaśca te viprāḥ sahodarāśca sāttvikāḥ || 4 | | tāpasā dharmaniyatāḥ santuṣṭā brahmavādinaḥ | śauce tapasi santoṣe svādhyāye bhajane ratāḥ || 5 || adrohe satyabhāve cāsteye śīle’parigrahe | kṛtābhyāsāḥ śame cāpīndriyāṇāṃ nigrahe ratāḥ || 6 || titikṣāyāṃ kṣamāyāṃ ca mārdave śreyasi sthitāḥ | yoge vivekaje jñāne satvotkarṣe sadā sthitāḥ || 7 || dhyāne home jape pūjāyāṃ ca satkārasevane | ātmabrahmātmavijñāne cātmanivedane sthitāḥ || 8 || siddhyaṣṭakaṃ tathā tveṣāṃ nidhīnāṃ navakaṃ sadā | kalpavāṇī ca sevāyāṃ vartante kāmadhenavaḥ || 9 || ākāśaśāyinaścaite digvastrāḥ phalabhojanāḥ | jalāmṛtādipānāśca prabhādīpāḥ samādhigāḥ || 3.25.10 || ātmānalā brahmagṛhāścāntarātmasahāyinaḥ | bhaktiyuktāḥ sādhusaṃgāḥ satīsatkāratatparāḥ || 11 || atithipūjakāḥ sarve nirīhāśca videhinaḥ | anāvaraṇabhāvāśca tathāvyāhatasañcarāḥ || 12|| bhūtasparśādihīnāśca dehadoṣādivarjitāḥ | vajratulyā divyadehā divyānandaparāyaṇāḥ || 13 || saṃkalpaprāptasarvasvabhogayogādiyātrikāḥ | vāksiddhā duḥkhahantāraḥ śaraṇāgatavatsalāḥ || 14|| brahmā vipṇurmaheśo’rkaścandra ivāparāḥ surāḥ | khyātāḥ kṣitau bhuvaḥsvargamaharjanatapassu ca || 15|| satye loke tathā merau pātāleṣvapi sarvathā | aiśvaryaśālinaḥ sarve īśvarā aparā iva || 16|| devavad duḥkhahartāro yogivadātmadarśakāḥ | śreṣṭhivaddhanadātāraḥ pativatputradāyinaḥ || 17|| rakṣakāḥ svāmivaccāpi dātāro viṣṇuvattathā | jñāne brahmasabhāḥ sarve pūraṇe kalpapādapāḥ || 18|| brahmacaryojjvalā deheṣvapi kṣmābhā dhṛtau tathā | sahasre sādhavaśceme pūrṇakāmāśca muktavat || 1 9|| etādṛśān prasiddhān vai jñātvā lokāstu duḥkhinaḥ | samāyānti nijārtīnāṃ vināśārthaṃ divāniśam || 3.25.20 || rogiṇo bhoginaścāpi dīnā dāridryabhāginaḥ | kadaryāḥ śatruduḥkhāśca vidhurāśca viputriṇaḥ || 21 || anannāmbarasaudhāśceṣaṇāvanto bubhukṣavaḥ | mumukṣavo mumūrṣavaścāyānti śaraṇaṃ sadā ||22|| teṣāṃ kleśānnāśayanti hyāśīrvādaparāyaṇāḥ | dātāraḥ sarvavastūnāṃ sukhānāṃ dhanasampadām || 23|| mānavāśca narā nāryo yānti pūrṇamanorathāḥ | ānanditāḥ pūrṇakāmāḥ pūrṇāśāḥ pūrṇamānasāḥ |||24|| dhanārthibhyo dadatyete dhanāni siddhijāni vai | putrārthibhyo dadatyete’patyānyabhīṣṭakāni ca |||25|| patiṃ patnīṃ gṛhaṃ rājyaṃ kṣetraṃ gajaṃ ca gāstathā | ārogyaṃ vaṃśavistāraṃ sampadaśca dadatyapi |||26|| tāpatrayādirāhityaṃ kurvanti śaraṇārthinaḥ | evaṃ sarve camatkārabhṛtā īśvarasadṛśāḥ || 27|| bhavanti sma kṣitau lakṣmi bhaktāste me’pi sarvathā | athaikadālaye teṣāṃ lakṣmīvāñcchāparāyaṇaḥ || 28|| asurastvāyayau nāmnā prasaviṣṇurmahābalaḥ | viprarūpadharaḥ so’yaṃ tāpasaḥ kāmavāsanaḥ || 29|| nārāyaṇasya yā patnī sā me patnī bhavediti | lakṣmyāste kāmanāyukto bhaktānāṃ pura āyayau ||3.25.3 0 || yayāce svepsitāṃ bhikṣāṃ pañcabhyo’pi tadāsuraḥ | lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇapatnīṃ mahyaṃ dadatu dāninaḥ || 31 || bhaktāstvayogyabhikṣāṃ tāṃ śrutvaiva menire tadā | kintvadātṛtvagaṇanāsparśārthaṃ prāhuromiti || 3 2|| harirvai balavānenaṃ lakṣmīrvā saṃhariṣyati | iti vicārya dānendrāḥ sasmaruḥ śrīṃ mama priyām || 33 || bhaktecchānusāriṇā ca mayājñaptā ca vai drutam | ākṣarāttvaṃ hi pañcānāṃ purataḥ samupasthitā || 34|| kumārikā surūpā ca dvādaśādhikavatsarā | sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyā svarṇacampakavigrahā ||35 || śobhanāṃ mohinīrūpāṃ tvāṃ vilokya tadāsuraḥ | mene svārthasya vai siddhiṃ mumude hṛdi tāsamaḥ ||36 || atha devasakhādyāste dṛṣṭvā pupūjurīśvarīm | nārāyaṇīṃ samarthāṃ ca vijñapyāpi kṣamārthanam ||37|| āsure dānarūpārthaṃ kāryaṃ nivedya vai jalam | kareṣvādāya ca dadruścāsurāya priye tadā ||38 || tvāmāsādya prasaviṣṇuścāsuro viprarūpadhṛk | yayau gṛhaṃ nijaṃ tatra tvayā vrataṃ dhṛtaṃ param ||3 9|| brahmacaryābhidhānaṃ vai naiṣṭhikaṃ pālyameva tat | aviplutaṃ tāpasaṃ ca spraṣṭavyo nāsuraḥ kvacit ||3.25.40 || atha tvaṃ tadgrahaṃ prāptā tvāṃ sa spraṣṭaṃ samīcchati | kintu pralayānalabhāṃ jvālāmālāsamāvṛtām ||41 || tvāṃ vilokya trastamanā yathāgato nivartate | atha vicārya bahubhirdivasaiḥ kāraṇāntaram ||42|| tava sparśasya siddhyarthaṃ punarbhaktān hi pañca tān | pratyāyayau subhikṣārthaṃ ratiṃ mūrtimatīṃ tathā ||43|| kāmaṃ sumūrtaṃ bāṇām̐śca vasantaṃ me dadatviti | pañca bhaktāstu te tatra sasmarustān tathākṛte ||44|| kāmādyā āyayustūrṇaṃ saṃkalpitāstadā puraḥ | atha daduste dāne’pi mahāsurāya tām̐stadā ||45|| asurastānupādāya yayau naijālayaṃ prati | tān kāmādīnādideśa praveṣṭuṃ kamalātanau ||46 || yaiḥ sā sampīḍitā lakṣmīrmāṃ svayaṃ samupeṣyati | ityevaṃ so’suraścāpi pratīkṣāṃ prākarodapi ||47|| atha kāmo nicikṣepa bāṇānunmādakādikān | vasantaḥ sumanobhirvai paritaḥ sumanoharaḥ ||48 || praphullitaḥ śriyāstatra praphullatāṃ nayatyapi | ratistataḥ svayaṃ mūrtimatī lakṣmyā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||49 || praveśaṃ cehamānā tu sahāsyā samupāyayau | lakṣmīrvijñāya tāṃ duṣṭāṃ kāmapatnīṃ durāśayām ||3.25.50 || sadyo roṣaṃ samāpannā tvaṃ tadā parameśvarī | netrābhyāṃ pralayāgniṃ vai cotpāditavatī svayam |||5 1 || dṛṣṭavatī ratiṃ kāmaṃ vasantaṃ ca śarānapi | asuraṃ ceti tān sarvān kṣaṇamātreṇa bhasmasāt| |||52||| kṛtavatyeva deveśi naiṣṭhikavrataśālinī | hāhākārastadā jāto deveṣu mānaveṣvapi ||53 || raternāśāt kāmanāśād vasantādervināśanāt | ṛtvabhāve vanāraṇyodyānādyāḥ puṣpavarjitāḥ ||54|| navāṃkuravihīnāśca lakṣmīśūnyāstadābhavan | satyāmapi tu lakṣmyāṃ vai nirlakṣmīkaṃ jagaddhyabhūt ||55|| nārīṇāṃ ca narāṇāṃ ca pramodā vilayaṃ gatāḥ | ānandā nāśamāpannāḥ prasaviṣṇuvināśanāt ||56|| evaṃ lakṣmi tvayā dagdhā ratyādyā netravahninā | jagat sarvaṃ naiṣṭhikaṃ ca sañjātaṃ tvadvratena vai ||57|| devāśca mānavāścāpi maharṣayaśca dehinaḥ | sarve vicārya kimidaṃ kathaṃ ceti samanvitāḥ |||58|| yayuḥ satye vedhase ca prāhuḥ kaṣṭaṃ tu ṣāṇḍhikam | ratirnāsti na kāmo’sti vasanto nāsti vai kvacit ||59|| kimidaṃ ca kathaṃ jātaṃ nivārayārttimulbaṇam | ityuktastu tadā brahmovāca kṣaṇaṃ vicārya vai ||3.25.6 0 || pūrve ye pañcadevāśca pañcendrāste tataḥ param | pañca bhaktā hi kalpe’smin bhajante parameśvaram ||6 1 || devasakhādayaḥ sarve dātāraścārthisampadaḥ | īśvarāḥ pañca te dātuṃ samarthāḥ sarvasampadaḥ ||6 2|| tebhyaścārpitavān lakṣmīṃ prasaviṣṇurmahāsuraḥ | mama liṃgamalotpanno balī khalo’tidoṣabhṛt ||63|| te viprā vai samāhūya lakṣmīṃ tasmai dadustataḥ | asurastāṃ samādāya yayau naijaṃ gṛhaṃ prati ||64|| lakṣmīrvrataṃ dadhārāpi naiṣṭhikīṃ brahmacāritām | asuraḥ kāmavegena spraṣṭuṃ lakṣmīmupāgataḥ ||65|| vīkṣya tāṃ pralayotpannāgnibhā trasto mahāsuraḥ | punargatvā ca viprebhyo yayāce tu ratiṃ tathā ||66 || kāmaṃ vasantaṃ bāṇāṃśca mūrtimataśca te dvijāḥ | dadustasmai sarvamūrtān nītvāsuro yayau gṛham ||67|| prerayāmāsa tān sarvān lakṣmīṃ kartuṃ hi cañcalām | lakṣmīḥ kruddhā svacakṣubhyāmutpādya pralayānalam ||68|| bhasmīcakāra tān sarvān jagat tena tathaiva ca | kāmabāṇavasantaiśca ratyā hīnaṃ nirarthakam ||6 9|| nirānandaṃ prasaṃjātaṃ kāraṇaṃ tvetadeva yat| | kathitaṃ tatra vai nānyastūpāyo’styatra vārakaḥ ||3.25.70 || lakṣmīkrodhena kāmo’pi ratiścāsurako’pi ca | prasavaste tathā bāṇā vasantaśca mṛtāḥ sadā ||7 1 || lakṣmīścet tān punaḥ sarvānutpādayet prasāditā | naiṣṭhikaṃ vratamevāpi prasamāpya hareḥ puraḥ ||72 || parameśasyājñayā ca sarvānujīvayed yadi | tadā ṣaṇḍhatvadoṣo’yaṃ trailokyād vigamiṣyati ||73 || nānyatheti tadarthaṃ śrīhariṃ prati yatāmahe | ārādhanāṃ prakurmo’tra hariḥ svayaṃ sutoṣitaḥ ||74|| samāyāsyatyatra śīghraṃ duḥkhaṃ nivārayiṣyati | ityuktāste satyaloke cakruḥ prārādhanāṃ mama ||75|| lakṣmyā tvayā viyogena duḥkhitayā smṛto’pi ca | samāyātaḥ satyalokaṃ brahmādīnāṃ puraḥ sthitaḥ ||76|| dṛṣṭavantaśca te māṃ vai divyarūpaṃ sanātanam | śaṃkhacakradharaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram |||77|| sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇam | ānarcuste pracakruśca svāgataṃ tuṣṭavustataḥ ||78|| sarvaduḥkhapraśāntyarthaṃ māṃ hariṃ puruṣottamam | śrutvā teṣāṃ prārthanāṃ cāvocaṃ tebhyastadā priye ||79|| lakṣmyā kṛtaṃ na cāhaṃ tad vikartuṃ prabhuratra ha | tasmād yāmo yatra devī lakṣmīrvane virājate ||3.25.80 || sthitā sā brahmacarye vai prasaviṣṇuvane satī | tāpasī naiṣṭhikadharme vartate sā maheśvarī ||81 || atha sarve vayaṃ tatrāyātā yatra tava sthalī | vilokya māṃ prasannā tvaṃ papāta mama pādayoḥ | |8 2|| svāgataṃ devatānāṃ ca kṛtavatyatibhāvataḥ | ratyādinārājanyaṃ ca duḥkhaṃ prati niveditā ||8 3 || stutā sarvaiśca devādyaiḥ prasāditā punaḥ punaḥ | tvamāttha sarvadevādīn dinānto’yaṃ pravidyate | |8 4|| śvaḥ prātaste tu kāmādyā brahmaṇo dehajāḥ sutāḥ | bhaviṣyanti hi ratyādyāḥ samarthā dehadhāriṇaḥ ||85|| prasravākhyo’suraścāpi srāvātmā saṃbhaviṣyati | adya sandhyāsamaye vai teṣāṃ nāsti prayojanam ||86 || naiṣṭhikaṃ vratamāsthāya bhajantāṃ parameśvaram | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||87|| ahaṃ bhajāmi cātraivāmanvantaṃ svāminā saha | bhagavān mama kāntaśca naiṣṭhiko’pyatra tiṣṭhatu ||88 || mayā vrataṃ dhṛtaṃ tvetannaiṣṭhikaṃ pralayāntikam | sarve’pi vai vrate tatra tiṣṭhantu śreyasāṃ prade ||89|| tvayoktāste tadā devā mānavāḥ ṛṣayastathā | sarve sthitā vrate tatra naiṣṭhike’nyadināvadhim || 3.25.90 || ahaṃ tavecchayāraṇye bhūmau lakṣmi tadāvasam | anādiśrībrahmacārinārāyaṇābhidhastvayā || 91 || saha tvaṃ vratamāpannā sadaiva tapasi sthitā | sādhvī dharmavatī lakṣmi naiṣṭhikīśrīriti priye ||92 || atha sṛṣṭistadā cānte manau ruddhā samantataḥ | mṛtā vṛddhāśca saṃbhūya prajāḥ śanaiḥ śanaistadā || 93 || tāvatpralayakālaścāyayau sarvaṃ niśāmukhe | yathākramaṃ nityavacca saṃhṛtaṃ parameṣṭhinā || 94|| tvaṃ vrataṃ svaṃ samāpyaiva devasakhāśramaṃ prati | mayā sākaṃ gatā lakṣmi tānādāya tato divam || 95|| prāpayya tān pañcabhaktān bhāvimahendravigrahān | maharlokaṃ janalokaṃ satyalokaṃ tataḥ param || 96 || prāpayya brahmaṇe’rpayya vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca mayā saha | gatvā tataḥ paraṃ me’pi dhāmākṣaraṃ gatābhavat | | 97| | ityevaṃ mama te cāpi prākaṭyaṃ kathitaṃ priye | smara tattāpasaṃ rūpaṃ naiṣṭhikaṃ cākṣareśvari ||98 || anye’vatārāstadvarṣe mama te cāpyasaṃkhyakāḥ | jātāstān vai samastāṃśca vedmyahaṃ netare surāḥ || 99|| atha kalpāntare ratyādayo jātā ajātmajāḥ | sadehā ajasāhāyyapradāste vacanāt khalu || 3.25.100 || paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya naiṣṭhikasya phalaṃ bhavet | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi yatheṣṭamāpnuyāttathā || 101 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīya saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasastriṃśe vatsare devasakhādibhaktyā prāptalakṣmyā kṛtaprasravaṇāsuraratikāmavasantabāṇādibhasmībhāvottaraṃ naiṣṭhikatāpālanārtham anādiśrībrahmacārinārāyaṇasya naiṣṭhikīśriyā saha prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 25 ||
<3.26> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ me tataḥ param | vedhaso mānavākhye vai caikatriṃśe tu vatsare || 1 || kalpe tu ṣaṭśate trayodaśe manau tadā purā | brahmaṇaḥ pṛṣṭhanimnādhobhāgānmalimaso’suraḥ || 2 || hallakākhyo babhūvāpi śavabhakṣo bhayaṃkaraḥ | tapastepe mahāghoraṃ cārdhakalpaṃ hi dāruṇam || 3 || brahmā tutoṣa ca tato gocaro’syābhavad bhuvi | asuro mṛttikābhūto vallīvṛkṣādhirohitaḥ || 4 || asthimṛdastitāmātro yatrāsīt tatra viśvasṛṭ | gatvā jalenābhiṣicya drumānutsārya pārśvataḥ || 5 || mṛttikādrumūlabhāgāt hallakaṃ cābhyajīvayat | vallīpādaśarīraśca haridvarṇo’tidurbalaḥ || 6 || śmaśrulo vedhasaḥ putrastūttasthau mūlajālakāt | vedhasaṃ jīvayantaṃ svaṃ vīkṣya neme’tibhāvataḥ || 7 || yayāce’pi varaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kālasaṃhārakārakam | kālaṃ vā kālarūpaṃ vā saṃhārakaṃ hi dehinām || 8 || saṃhārayāmyahaṃ caivaṃ varaṃ dehi pitāmaha | brahmā prāha varaścāyaṃ me balādatiricyate || 9 || nāhaṃ dātuṃ samartho’smi kālādhīno’smyahaṃ yataḥ | hallakastu tadā prāha dehi cet taṃ na cāparam || 3.26.1 0|| tapaḥ kariṣye satataṃ tadarthaṃ vai pitāmaha | kālaṃ hantuṃ samartho vai kaścideva hariṃ vinā || 1 1|| naivāsti sṛṣṭijo vyaktiviśeṣo’pi kathaṃcana | ato hallaka yadvacmi śṛṇu te yadi rocate || 1 2|| kālasya khalu rūpāṇi bahūni santi sṛṣṭiṣu | teṣvekasyaiva rūpasya sakṛt hantā bhaviṣyasi || 1 3|| yadi te rocate tvetattadā gṛhāṇa me varam | ityukto mohavaśago hallako vai tadā varam ||14|| jagrāha tattapastyaktvā yayau meruguhāṃ prati | brahmaṇo varadānena garviṣṭho vartate sadā || 15|| surān daityān rākṣasāṃśca dānavān kinnarādikān | tāmasān rājasān devān yakṣān kiṃpuruṣādikān || 1 6|| gandharvāṃścāraṇām̐ścāpi gaṇayatyeva naiva saḥ | avamānaṃ karotyeva yuddhyatyeva sthale sthale || 1 7|| brahmaṇo varadānasyānarthaṃ prakāśayatyapi | kālanāśaka eveti nijaṃ prakhyāpayatyapi || 18|| svarge jayaṃ samāsādya pātāleṣu yayau tataḥ | tatrāpi vijayaṃ prāpya lokālokaṃ yayau hi saḥ ||19|| sarvatra vijayaṃ prāpya yamalokaṃ tato yayau | yamastaṃ pūjayāmāsa jñātvā kālavināśakam || 3.26.20|| hallako’yaṃ tato jñātvā nijaṃ vijayinaṃ param | yayau kailāsalokaṃ sa jetuṃ rudraṃ śivaṃ haram ||2 1 || gaṇāḥ kailāsavāsā vai jaṅgabhadrādayastu tam | nyavārayan gopurād vai tato’sau hallako ruṣā ||22|| yuyudhe dvārapālaiśca vijitya tān gaṇān parān | gaṇeśān bhūtamūrdhanyān bhairavādīṃstataḥ param ||23|| śaṃbhugṛhaṃ yayau krūro duṣṭo malinavāsanaḥ | kailāsaṃ vai nijaṃ kartuṃ vaśe kartuṃ satīṃ tathā || 24|| gaṇān bhṛtyāṃstathā kartumiyeṣa vīkṣya sampadaḥ | prāha śaṃbhuṃ bhava bhṛtyo mama śaṃbho’nyathā tava ||25|| vidhāsye’haṃ vināśaṃ vai dehi satīṃ tu me tava | kailāsarājyaṃ me datvā yāhi tvaṃ meruparvatam ||26|| punaḥ kālāntare dāsye tṛpto’haṃ te yathāyatham | śaṃbhurvicārayāmāsa balaṃ tvasya bhavet kiyat ||27|| yotsye’nena tu balinā brahmaṇo varayoginā | nāśayiṣye kṣaṇādenaṃ varadānayutāsuram ||28|| vicāryaivaṃ kālarūpaṃ raudraṃ dadhāra śaṃkaraḥ | triśūlaṃ tvantimalayakartṛ dadhāra taijasam ||29|| sāṃkarṣaṇaṃ bhīmarūpaṃ kṛtvā śīghraṃ samāyayau | yuddhārthaṃ tasya sānnidhyaṃ tāvat hallaka ityapi ||3.26.3 0 || jagrāha pārvataṃ rūpaṃ bhayakṛcca vināśakṛt | saśūlacandrakaśastraṃ kare dadhāra cāyasam ||3 1 || kālakālo yathā bhāti tathā bhātyatra hallakaḥ | yuddhadundubhayo neduḥ kailāse gaṇatāḍitāḥ ||32|| devā deveśvarāstatrāyayuḥ kautukakarṣitāḥ | śaṃbhoḥ sāhāyyakāḥ sarve dikpālāśca samāyayuḥ ||33|| yuddhaṃ hallakaharayorjātaṃ pralayakārakam | meghā naṣṭāḥ phaṭākaiścādrayo naṣṭāśca hetibhiḥ ||34|| kṣitiḥ śīrṇā patpraghātaiḥ kampaiścukṣubhire’bdhayaḥ | vegairnipetustārāśca jagarjurnādanairdiśaḥ ||35|| gaṇā gaṇeśvarāstatra trāsamāpurmṛtiṃ prati | bhagnāḥ kecit kaṭibhāgāt kecit skandhapradeśataḥ ||36|| anye galātpare jānvorbhāgād bhagnā mṛtiṃ yayuḥ | bhūtapretapiśācādīn kālabhairavabhairavān ||37|| hastenaikena saṃgṛhya mukhe nyasyātti hallakaḥ | śūrabhadraṃ vīrabhadraṃ jaṅgabhadraṃ subhadrakam ||38|| vāmahastena yugapanmukhe nyasya cakhāda tān | etādṛśo mahānāste kālakālo mahāsuraḥ ||39|| śaṃkaraḥ saṃśayamāpto jaye triśūlasaṃsravāt | śaṃbhorhastagataṃ śūlaṃ sraṃsate sma punaḥ punaḥ ||3.26.40|| vṛṣabhaśca tathā siṃho dvāvetāvapi vai tadā | hallakasya pracakreṇa nikṛtau mṛtyumāpatuḥ ||41 || satī saṃśayamāpannā jīvane śaṃkarasya tu | śīghraṃ śaṃbhoḥ śarīre sā tirobhāvamupāgatā ||42|| śaṃbhurvijñāya kailāsaṃ chinnaṃ bhinnaṃ mṛtānugam | tyaktvā ca jīvanāśāṃ sa dudrāva hallakāntikam ||43|| puraścāgatya śīghraṃ svaṃ triśūlaṃ pralayānalam | mārayāmāsa mūrdhnyasya hallakasya galopari ||44|| hastād viyujya vegena hallakasya gale gatam | praviṣṭaṃ cānalaprakhyaṃ triśūlaṃ taddharasya yat| ||45|| nigalitaṃ gataṃ tatra rasabhāvamupāgatam | pathyaṃ jātaṃ hallakasyodare’mṛtamivābhavat ||46|| atyadbhutamidaṃ jātaṃ kālaśūlaṃ hi jīrṇitam | evamanyāni śūlāni triśūlāni ca hetayaḥ ||47|| sarve hallakavarṣmāpya rasabhāvamupāgatāḥ | ahetiḥ śaṃkaro jātastadā viṣṇuṃ tathā hyajam ||48|| prasasmāra śivastūrṇaṃ viṣṇustatra hyupāyayau | cakraṃ dadau nijaṃ tasmai harāya ca haro’pi tat ||49|| cakraṃ mumoca kaṇṭhe’sya hallakasya rasaṃ hyabhūt | athānyaccakramādhattaṃ muktaṃ tad rasatā gatam ||3.26.50|| evaṃ cakrāṇi sarvāṇi gatāni rasato tadā | brahmā tvāgatya ca tatra yāvatpaśyati śaṃkaram ||51 || tāvat saśūlacandreṇa muktena vegagāminā | śaṃkarasya śiraḥ kaṇṭhānnikṛtaṃ hallakena vai ||52|| hāhākāro mahān jāto raudro rudro’pi vai hataḥ | śokamāpuḥ sarvadevā mānavāśca maharṣayaḥ ||53 || athāpi sarvabhūtāni babhūvuḥ śokabhāñji ca | hallakasyāpi sāmarthyaṃ śūlacandrāyudhena vai ||54|| sahaiva tu gataṃ sarvaṃ brahmaṇo varadānataḥ | asāmarthyo babhūvāpi vijñātaḥ sarvayoddhṛbhiḥ ||55 || brahmaṇoditamevātha vijñāya tu surāstataḥ | gaṇāścābhipradudruvurmāraṇāyāsurasya vai ||56|| tāvattriśūlacakrāṇi sarvāṇyapi ca yāni vai | galitānyabhavam̐stāni nirgatya cāyayurdrutam ||57|| viṣṇuṃ prati samastāni śaṃkarasya śavaṃ prati | viṣṇuścakraṃ mumocāsmai yāvat tāvatsa hallakaḥ ||58|| hare viṣṇo hare kṛṣṇa trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam | uktvā papāta sahasā pādayoḥ śārṅgiṇo’suraḥ ||59|| na hantavyo vrataṃ viṣṇoḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣaṇam | ataścakraṃ nāhanattaṃ viṣṇo viṣṇo pravādinam ||3.26.60|| brahmaṇo varadānācca tathānimittaśālinam | brahmaṇaḥ pṛṣṭhaputraṃ ca bhaktaṃ tāpasayoginam ||61 || babandha taṃ hariḥ pāśaiḥ śaṃkarasyāparādhinam | vadantaṃ ca hare viṣṇo nārāyaṇa prapāhi mām ||62|| raṭantaṃ manasā māṃ ca smarantaṃ ca hṛdā hi mām | etādṛśaṃ haraghnaṃ taṃ devahatyā surāsadā ||63 || vavalge krūrarūpā sā śatacakrakarā harā | prāṇānāṃ grāsasāmarthyā vikṛtā vikṛtānanā ||64|| ghorāṃ ca valgitāṃ tvenāṃ hallako vīkṣya duḥkhadām | cukrośa bahudhā tatra raṇāṃgaṇe surāntike ||65|| hatyayā tāḍito devaistāḍito gaṇakoṭibhiḥ | mṛtaprāyo maran vavre hareḥ śaraṇarakṣiṇaḥ ||66|| dehi me bhaktarūpāya śaraṇasthāya mādhava | agryaṃ padaṃ mahaiśvaryaṃ dveṣiṇe śaṃkarasya vai ||67|| brahmaṇo varadānācca mahākālasya caikakam | rūpaṃ mayā hataṃ lābhaṃ vinā vai śāṃkaraṃ tvidam ||68|| hatvā hato’smi sañjāto māyayā garvanoditaḥ | tapaḥ sarvaṃ kṣiptarvośca tāmase karmaṇi prabho ||69|| ataḥ kṛpayā viṣṇo tvaṃ sukhaṃ dehi kṛpāṃ kuru | devahatyā dahatyeṣā tāṃ nivāraya keśava ||3.26.70 || ityuktvātirurodāpi maraṇāntikatāṃ yayau | viṣṇuḥ prāha manoḥ kālaṃ tathā rātriḥ prapūrṇikā ||71 || devahatyākṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bhuṃkṣva hallaka raurave | pañcadaśamanūnāṃ vai kālānte divasāntare ||72|| yāvad duḥkhāni saṃbhuktvā malino mlecchakarmavān | mleccheśvaro bhavān bhakto brahmaṇo me bhaviṣyati ||73|| anekasaṃkhyalokānāmāsurāṇāṃ gururmahān | ityuktvā bhagavān viṣṇuryamadūtaiśca hallakam ||74|| preṣayāmāsa pāpaṃ taṃ sahatyākaṃ yamālayam | atha devāḥ ṛṣayaśca pitaro mānavā dvijāḥ ||75|| pārṣadāśca gaṇāścāpi bhaktā devyaḥ satīstriyaḥ | yoginyo mātaraścāpi grahādyā dyusado’pi ca ||76 || bhaktāḥ sarve ca kailāse saṃgatā hariṇā smṛtāḥ | viṣṇustebhyastathā tābhyaḥ śaṃbhorujīvanāya vai ||77|| provācārādhanāṃ kartuṃ mama sarvāvatāriṇaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya svāminaḥ sataḥ ||78|| sarvāntaryāmiṇaste’thārādhayāmāsurutsukāḥ | māṃ sadākṣaradhāmasthaṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ||79|| drāgevāhaṃ tvayā sākaṃ śrutvārādhanamāgataḥ | kailāse gocaraścakṣuṣmatāṃ divyasumūrtimān ||3.26.80|| vīkṣya māmabhavan sarve viśokāścārthayam̐stataḥ | śaṃbhujīvanadānārtha tato’haṃ prāviśaṃ tanau ||81 || śaṃkarasya kabandhe’pi mastake’pi ca yogataḥ | prāṇaśaktiṃ pradāyaivājīvayaṃ cāpyasandhayam ||82|| kabandhe mastakaṃ śaṃbhoścārcayaṃ devakoṭibhiḥ | pitṛbhirmānavaiścāpi maharṣibhistataḥ param ||83 || śūrabhadrādayo ye ca carvitāśca mṛtāstadā | ye ca lakṣmi mṛtāḥ sarve hatā ye ca gaṇāśca te ||84|| mayā smṛtā manojanyā abhavan jīvanānvitāḥ | āgatya purataḥ śaṃbhostasthuste navasṛṣṭayaḥ ||81|| vṛṣabhādyā mṛtāścāpyujīvitāstatra vai mayā | gaṇānāṃ koṭayaḥ sarvā devānāṃ koṭayastathā ||86 || sarvā mayā prasaṃkalpya svasthāścojjīvitāstadā | śaṃkarasya punarjīvotsavaḥ kailāsake kṛtaḥ ||87|| satī śaṃbhoḥ svarūpācca tadojjagāma gocarā | pratyakṣā vai mahādevī prasannā cābhavattataḥ ||88|| ārthayanmāṃ nityameva kailāse bhūtalopari | sthātuṃ sākaṃ tvayā lakṣmyā śaṃbhuścārthayadeva tu ||89|| devāśca mānavāścāpyārthayanmāṃ puruṣottamam | sthātuṃ kailāsake kṣetre dehināṃ śreyase’pi ca ||3.26.90|| tato’haṃ śivarājīśri tvayā sākaṃ sadāvasam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||91 || anādiśrīśivanārāyaṇanāmnā śiveśvaraḥ | tvaṃ tadā cābhavastatra śivanārāyaṇī priye ||92|| atha devā yayuḥ sarve mānavāḥ pitarastathā | svasvalokān munayaśca kailāse’haṃ tato’vasam ||93|| ākalpāntaṃ śivarājñi jānāmyahaṃ na cetare | smara te me’pi divyaṃ tatprākaṭyaṃ kamale priye ||94|| bhadrādrau śītale ramye viśāle’yutayojane | tatra sthite tu kailāse bhūbhāge tvavasaṃ sadā ||95|| vaiṣṇavī pṛthivī sarvā tadā prābhūnmayā kṛtā | devāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve tvāsan bhaktiparā mama ||96|| mama bhakte phalaṃ lakṣmi rājase tāmase’pi ca | asure vā sure vāpi prāpte kāle’ṅkurāyate ||97|| tasmād bhaktiḥ sarvaśreṣṭhā bhuktimuktiphalapradā | sthāpyate vai mayā dharmayutā kāle yuge dine ||98|| kalpānte vā samārambhe sthāpayāmi sadā hitām | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi ||99|| smṛddhisampatputravām̐śca bhavedānandaśevadhiḥ | mahaiśvaryayutaścāpi parameśasarūpavān ||3.26.1 0 0|| sarvavighnavināśaśca sarvāmṛtaniṣevaṇaḥ | bhavecchāśvatavāsaśca brahmasāyujyavān bhavet || 10 1|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasa ekatriṃśe vatsare hallakāsurasya brahmaṇo varadānād vijayayātrāyāṃ śaṃbhośśiracchede samujjīvanārtham anādiśrīśivanārāyaṇasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 26 ||
<3.27> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇāśri tvaṃ paraṃ tasmāt kathāmṛtam | prākaṭyaṃ me yathā te ca dvātriṃśe parameṣṭhinaḥ || 1 || kalpadruvatsare ṣaṭpaṃcāśatkalpe’ṣṭame manau | ekadā vai kuberasya yakṣaḥ suvarṇamālikaḥ || 2 || yayau svarge vihartuṃ ca tato viṣṇupuraṃ yayau | satyalokaṃ tato vīkṣya dikpālānāṃ tathālayān || 3 || vīkṣya yamālayaṃ draṣṭuṃ yayau saṃyamanīṃ purīm | tāvattasyāyuṣaścānto jāto mṛtyuṃ gato hi saḥ || 4 || yakṣasya yamarājaḥ prākārayaccāntimāṃ kriyām | jñātvā kubero yakṣasya maraṇaṃ vai yamālaye || 5 || yamadūtairmāritaścetyamanyata tato ruṣā | jvalan sainyena sahito yamasthalyāṃ svayaṃ yayau || 6 || yodhayāmāsa bahudhā yamena saha vai tadā | yamaṃ jitvā svarṇamālaṃ nināya svagṛhaṃ prati || 7 || atha rājā yamastūrṇamāhvayāmāsa nirṛtim | rākṣasaṃ sainyasahitaṃ nirṛto’pi talasthitān || 8 || pātālādinivāsām̐śca rākṣasān yuddhaśālinaḥ | koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyānāhvayāmāsa svapakṣagān || 9 || kuberaṃ tasya rājyaṃ ca jetuṃ yayuśca te tataḥ | yuddhavādyānyavādyantālakāyāḥ sannidhau hi khe || 3.27.1 0|| jñātvā kuberakastvetanniryayau yakṣakoṭibhiḥ | yuddhaṃ tvākasmikaṃ tatrābhavat sarvavināśakam || 1 1|| yāmyadūtairhatā yakṣāḥ koṭiśo rākṣasaistathā | kubero’pi hataḥ kaṇṭhād dvedhā yamena vai tadā ||12|| kuberarājyaṃ sarvaṃ svāyattīkṛtaṃ yamena tu | nirṛtena tathā rājye rākṣasā niyatīkṛtāḥ || 13|| atha yakṣāḥ pare kecit trastāḥ śrīśānadikpatim | indraṃ varuṇaṃ vāyuṃ ca gatvā nyavedayaddhi tat || 14|| te sarve tvāyayustūrṇaṃ kuberanagarīṃ prati | dṛṣṭvā te dharmarājaṃ vai tathā nirṛtamityapi || 15|| īśāno nijaśiṣyasya kuberasya ca pakṣagaḥ | vairaniryātanārthaṃ vai yuddhaṃ cakre hi dāruṇam || 16|| mahendro’pi tathā vahnirvāyurvaruṇa ityapi | kuberapakṣamādāya yuddhaṃ cakruryamena te || 17|| atha sūryaḥ svaputrasya yamasya pakṣamāvahan | svarbhānuśca tathā śaniścaraścānye’pi rākṣasāḥ || 18|| yamapakṣaṃ parigṛhya yuddhaṃ dadurmaholbaṇam | koṭiśaśca gaṇāstatra surā yakṣā hatāḥ punaḥ ||19|| abhyastayuddhakarmāṇo yāmyā jayaṃ gatāḥ punaḥ | rākṣasā lebhire yuddhe vijayaṃ yāmyapakṣagāḥ ||3.27.20|| krūrāśca krūrakarmāṇo lohaghṛṣṭakarādayaḥ | loṣṭhāgniśastrayantrāstrakovidā nirghṛṇā yamāḥ ||21|| mārayāmāsuratyarthaṃ vāyuṃ cendraṃ jalādhipam | īśānaṃ cānalaṃ cāpi bhagnāste naṣṭasainyakāḥ ||22|| hāhākāro mahānāsījjagatyāṃ sarvaśastadā | devāstrastā yayuḥ satyaṃ gahvarāṇyapare tathā ||23|| pṛthvyāṃ svarge ca sarvatra balaṃ pātālavāsinām | dikpālānāṃ pradeśeṣu tvabhavad vardhitaṃ tadā ||24|| lakṣmi tadāntarīkṣaṃ vai cakampe sarvato diśaḥ | dikpālānāṃ vivādeṣu bhṛtyakoṭyo hatā mṛtāḥ ||25|| yamarājo’bhavad rājā cālakāyāḥ samantataḥ | astitvaṃ vai kuberasya niṣkāsitaṃ samantataḥ ||26|| nirṛtāḥ rākṣasāḥ sarve yamāścārkaḥ śanistathā | rāhuścānye pare cāpi babhūvuḥ svabalaidhitāḥ ||27||| svatantrā iva trailokyāṃ ghnanti virodhaśālinaḥ | niṣkāsayanti cānamrān devādīn nijavāsataḥ ||28|| evaṃ jātaṃ svargaloke cāvyavasthaṃ mitho’pi ca | dikpālānāṃ balaṃ naṣṭaṃ yamadaṇḍasya sannidhau || 29|| indrājñāyāṃ na vartante sūryacandrādayo’pare | surāstadāśritāścāpi svargaṃ vai paragaṃ hyabhūt ||3.27.3 0 || athaivaṃ vīkṣya kamale īśānendrānalānilāḥ | varuṇaśca pare devā mahendragṛhamāyayuḥ ||3 1|| cakruśca mantraṇāṃ tatra kiṃkartavyavihīnakāḥ | brahmāṇaṃ sasmaruścāpi viṣṇuṃ sasmarurīśvarāḥ ||32|| śeṣaṃ prasasmaruścāpyāyayuste parameśvarāḥ | śuśruvuste kuberasya nāśaṃ cānyaparājayam ||33|| vijayaṃ dharmarājasya śokaṃ cakruḥ kṣaṇaṃ tadā | dharmarājagṛhe tatrānyāyo naiva bhavediti ||34|| kāraṇaṃ sarvamevāpi jñātvā yakṣasya vai mṛtim | nyāyyāmanyāyamālambya kuberasya tu yodhanam || 35|| kampayitvā śirāṃsyete menire na jayaṃ punaḥ | yatrānyāyo na vijayastatra saṃbhavati kvacit ||36|| kuberasyānyāyabhāktve mṛtyuścāyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | caturdaśānāṃ lokānāṃ dehināṃ nāyako yamaḥ ||37|| āyuṣyānte nayatyeva tatra kā paridevanā | indraṃ vāyuṃ jaleśaṃ ceśānaṃ vahniṃ tayeśvarān ||38|| nayatyeva yameśo vai kā kathānyasya vai mṛteḥ | tasmād yamāya devāya devo vai vijayo’tra ha ||39|| asmābhistu pramantavyaḥ parājayo’tra karmaṇi | kubero dikpatirbhūtvā tvanyāyaṃ kurute yadi ||3.27.40|| tatpakṣāṇāṃ hi sarveṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ syād vardhitaṃ punaḥ | tasmādatra na viṣṇośca śeṣasya vedhaso’pi ca ||41|| anyeṣāmapi cāturyaṃ jayameṣyati vai surāḥ | atastatra na gantavyaṃ yatrāste yamarāṭ svayam ||42|| alakāyāṃ viśeṣeṇa sarvanāśāya bho surāḥ | kintu devādhidevānāmīśvarāṇāṃ maheśvaraḥ ||43|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | akṣarādhipatiḥ śrīśaḥ śrīhariḥ parameśvaraḥ ||44|| smartavyastvatra vāde vai nirṇayaṃ sa vidhāsyati | indragṛhe mahāsatraṃ kurvantu prajayātmakam ||45|| parameśasya bho devāḥ svayamāyāsyati prabhuḥ | ityuktāste harādyāśca devā indrālaye tadā ||46|| japasatraṃ pracakruśca deveśvarāśca sarvaśaḥ | hare kṛṣṇa hareviṣṇo parameśa parātpara ||47|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa rakṣa pareśvara | satataṃ kīrtanaṃ cakrurdevānāṃ pūrṇavatsaram ||48|| indrasya vatsarānte śrīhariścāhaṃ samāyayau | gocaraḥ sarvadevānāṃ śaṃkhacakrādimān prabhuḥ ||49|| tvayā sākaṃ tadā lakṣmyā sarvabhūṣāḍhyayā priye | devā māmanusaṃvīkṣyāścarthaparāḥ susatvaram ||3.27.50|| utthāya nemurbahudhā cakruśca pūjanaṃ mama | madhuparkaṃ daduścāpi satkāraṃ ca dadhustataḥ ||51|| mahāsanaṃ dadustatropāviśaṃ ca tvayā saha | nyavedayam̐śca te sarvamudantaṃ dhanarakṣiṇaḥ ||52|| yakṣāṇāṃ nāśanaṃ cāpi nijānāṃ ca parājayam | yamasya vijayaṃ cāpi svarge svatantratāṃ tathā ||53|| avyavasthā ca deveṣu śuśrāvāhaṃ ca padmaje | kṣaṇaṃ dhyānaṃ tadā kṛtvāvocaṃ dikpālakānidam ||54|| bhavadbhirvai mayā sākaṃ gantavyaṃ yatra vai yamaḥ | kuberasya nagaryāṃ hi sarvaṃ saukhyaṃ bhaviṣyati ||55|| sāmnā vādasya sarvasya neṣye’ntaṃ prasukhāvaham | ityuktvāhaṃ tvayā sākaṃ sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ saha |||56|| agacchaṃ tvalakābhūmau yamanaiṛtasannidhau | śrutvā māṃ sa tu tūrṇaṃ vai trastamanā upāyayau ||57|| padbhyāṃ matsannidhau lakṣmi bhayaṃ prāpāpyacintayam | pādaprakṣālanaṃ cakre papau vāryamṛtaṃ mama ||58|| svāgataṃ pradadau cāpyāsanaṃ vādyānyavādayat | dāsavat sarvadevānāṃ paśyatāṃ prajagāda mām ||59|| aparāddhaṃ mayā kṛṣṇa kubero mārito mayā | nagarīyaṃ kṛtā vaśyā kṣamasva puruṣottama ||3.27.60|| anyāyamārgiṇāṃ daṇḍo’vaśyaṃ bhavati keśava | yadyahaṃ syāṃ tathā tarhi daṇḍo mayyapi dhīyatām ||61|| ityuktvā śaraṇaṃ prāpya papāta pādayormama | anyāyena vihīnasya daṇḍo naiva hi yujyate ||62|| kubero’yaṃ mārito yat tanna yogyaṃ bhavediha | yakṣeśvaro jīvanīyo jīvanīyā gaṇā api ||63|| surādyā jīvayitavyā ye hatā āhave yama | kuberasya purī tasmai dātavyā punareva ha ||64|| tvayā dharma pragantavyaṃ yamarājapurīṃ prati | saṃyamanīṃ sadā rakṣa mānyagṛdhnāṃ samācara ||65|| ityuktaśca mayā dharmarājo’yācata vai kṣamām | padaṃ kauberakaṃ tyaktvā prasthānamakarot tataḥ ||66|| mayā lakṣmi kuberasyāvāhanaṃ tatra vai punaḥ | kṛtaṃ mānasaputro me jajñe dhanādhipastataḥ || 67|| vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo bhakto yakṣāśca jajñire punaḥ | anye mṛtāḥ surāḥ sarve jajñire mānasā mama ||68|| sutā devādayaste vai māmānarcurmudānvitāḥ | mayārpitaṃ kuberāya mānasāya padaṃ punaḥ ||69|| tenārthitastadā cāhaṃ nityavāsārthameva ha | svarṇavatyāṃ nagaryāṃ vai nyavasaṃ svarṇavarṇavān ||3.27.70 || śaṃkarādyāḥ pūjayitvā yayuste svapadāni hi | yamo yayau yāmyapadaṃ cānye yayurnijālayān ||71 || kuberasya navīne tūdbhave tasya mahotsavaḥ | mayā kṛtaḥ svarṇapuryāṃ pūjito vardhitastathā ||72|| tvaṃ sadā kānakīlakṣmīrmayā sākaṃ virājitā | anādiśrīsvarṇanārāyaṇena sārdhamīśvarī ||73 || ākalpāntaṃ nyavasaṃ vai svarṇavatyāṃ pareśvaraḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||74|| sarveṣāṃ lokapālānāṃ dikpālānāṃ niyāmakaḥ | sarvarakṣākaraḥ sākṣācchrīpatiḥ parameśvaraḥ ||75|| smara lakṣmi suvarṇe tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ me ca te tadā | rājarājeśvarīrūpaṃ sarvānandapariplutam ||76|| atha sūryādayaścānye devā yamānugā api | kṣamāpya māṃ bhajante sma svarṇanārāyaṇaṃ tataḥ ||77|| hiraṇyavarṇaṃ puruṣaṃ svarṇaśmaśruṃ yamārdanam | dikpālānāṃ niyantāraṃ vinetāraṃ virodhinām ||78|| kleśānāṃ śāntikartāraṃ dātāraṃ sampadāṃ tathā | dagdhāraṃ pāpapuñjānāṃ hartāraṃ vipadāṃ ca mām ||79|| pūjayanti hi devādyāḥ parameśaṃ sanātanam | paravrahmākṣarātītaṃ satpatiṃ muktasevitam ||3.27.80 || paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇādapi muktibhāg| bhuktibhāgapi jāyeta svarṇaśri nātra saṃśayaḥ ||8 1 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso dvātriṃśe vatsare yamena māritasya kuberasyojjīvanārtham anādiśrīsvarṇanārāyaṇasya kānakīśrīsahitasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 27 ||
<3.28> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīlakṣmi prākaṭyaṃ me tataḥ param | vedhaso vatsare trayastriṃśe sasyābhidhe purā || 1 || kalpe triṃśattame tvekādaśe manvantare tathā | meroḥ pūrve śvetakhaṇḍe’ruṇācalo’bhavadgiriḥ || 2 || yojanotsedha evāyaṃ daśayojanavistṛtaḥ | jvālāgarbhaḥ sadā cāste vahnirasāḍhyakandaraḥ || 3 || na pārśve mānavāḥ santi nāraṇyāni vanānyapi || nadyastūṣṇapravāhā vai bhūmistvaṃgārasannibhā || 4 || varṣe varṣadvaye varṣāṣṭakottare śatābdake | jvālāruṇācalo jvālāmayo bhavati sarvataḥ || 5 || vahnirasāḥ pravartante deśeṣu ca saritsvapi | tatpratāpātpradahyanti dūradeśā api priye || 6 || mānavāḥ paśavaścāpi pakṣiṇo vyomacāriṇaḥ | tāpoṣmaṇā pramūrchāptā vyasavaḥ saṃbhavanti vai || 7 || sasyānāṃ ca vanānāṃ ca vahnisekena bharjanam | dūrasthānāṃ bhavatyeva phalapuṣpādināśakam || 8 || yāṃ diśāṃ prati vāyūnāṃ pravāhā yānti sānalāḥ | śatayojanaparyantā deśā bhavanti bharjitāḥ || 9 || vahnisekamṛtā jīvāḥ pralayasthā bhavanti vai | ekadā tu mahājhaṃjhāvāto babhūva cāmbare || 3.28.10 || jvālāruṇācalaścāpi vahnirūpo babhūva ha | vahnijvāloṣmapūrāṇyāvahan pravāyuṇoditāḥ || 11 || ativegena pūrvasyāṃ śatayojanaveginaḥ | meroḥ pārśve vasatayo lakṣaśo dehino’bhavan || 1 2|| uṣmaṇā dagdhadehāste mṛtāścirapravāhiṇā | koṭiśo gajago’śvādyā nagarāṇi sahasraśaḥ || 13|| tatrāsīnnagaraṃ svāminagaraṃ yojanāyatam | prāyaśo mama bhaktaiścādhiṣṭhitaṃ pāvanairjanaiḥ || 14|| maṭhāśca sādhusādhvīnāṃ yatīnāmabhavan śubhāḥ | brahmacaryavratānāṃ ca satīnāṃ dharmayoṣitām || 15|| āśramā bahavaścāsan japayajñakṛtāṃ tathā | vaiṣṇavānāṃ yogināṃ ca karmaṭhānāṃ mahālayāḥ || 16|| babhūvuryatra devārthā devālayāḥ prasevinām | madarthaṃ tapasā bhaktā yatrāsan vai videhinaḥ || 17|| mama lakṣyaparāstyaktamadarthasarvabhogakāḥ | madālambanamātrāśca madārādhanatatparāḥ ||18|| madbhaktānāṃ maṇḍalānāṃ sevādharmaparāyaṇāḥ | ātmasarvasvasampatsannivedino madātmakāḥ || 1 9|| sādhyabhaktiparāḥ sarve sādhanasthāstu cālpakāḥ | evaṃvidhe’tra nagare jvālānaloṣmaṇā drutam ||3.28.20|| yogābhyāsavihīnāstu bhaktāḥ samantato mṛtāḥ | yogajñāḥ sādhavaḥ satyo brahmabhāvavibhāvitāḥ ||21|| sasmarurmāṃ yatra tatrānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | parabrahmākṣarātītaṃ śrīkāntaṃ puruṣottamam |||22|| tuṣṭuvuḥ ruddhamarutaścaikatānena yojitāḥ | rakṣa rakṣa parabrahmāntarātman puruṣottama ||23|| sarvasvāmin samāgaccha rakṣa jvālānalādasūn | ityevaṃ tvekatānaiścābhyarthitastīvrabhaktibhiḥ ||24|| tūrṇaṃ sākaṃ tvayā lakṣmyā jīvoddhāraṇahetave | gocaro’hamabhavaṃ vai gṛhe gṛhe jane jane ||25|| mama brahmahradasyaivāmṛtabinduṃ samakṣipam | ahaṃ jvālānalādrau ca vyomamārgeṇa vai drutam || 26 || vahnirlayaṃ gataścāpi jvālā śaityaṃ samāvahan | auṣṇyaṃ pariṇataṃ śaitye dāhaśāntikaraṃ tadā ||27|| śaityāmṛtaṃ tu vātena yān yān mṛtānhi dehinaḥ | sthāvarān jaṃgamām̐ścāpi samaspṛśattadā ca te ||28|| navajīvanamāsādyānanditā jīvino’bhavan | cvālāruṇācalaḥ so’pi brahmahradāmṛtānvayāt ||29|| śītāmṛtācalo jātaḥ kṣaṇātpariṇato’bhavat | ākalpāntaṃ tathaivāsīt parvato’mṛtaśītalaḥ ||3.28.3 0|| bhaktaiśca yogibhiḥ sarvairyatibhirbrahmaśīlibhiḥ | sādhubhiśca satībhiśca sādhvībhistyāgibhistathā ||3 1|| vaiṣṇavairmānavaiścāpi dṛgagre’haṃ nibhālitaḥ | prārthitastatra vai nityaṃ sthātuṃ bhakteṣu rakṣakaḥ ||32|| pūjito vanditaścāpi nyavasaṃ vai tvayā saha | tasmin vai svāminagare’nādisvāminarāyaṇaḥ ||33|| svāminyā ca tvayā lakṣmyā sahitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | ityevaṃ svāminīśriṃ svaṃ prākaṭyaṃ kathitaṃ tava ||34|| smara tvaṃ svāminī lakṣmi svāmipattanarakṣakam | anādiśrīsvāminārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||35|| sārdhaṃ tvayā rakṣayitryā hyanādisvāminīśriyā | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi hyāpadbhyo rakṣaṇaṃ bhavet ||36|| athānyasmin pāśavākhye catustriṃśe tu vatsare | vedhasaḥ saptaṣaṣṭyūrdhvatriśate kalpake purā ||37|| dvādaśe ca manau bhūmau yugalaṃ dvijajātikam | pāvanaṃ bhaktimallakṣmyā āsīt kauśeyake pure ||38|| anapatyā dvijapatnī nāmnā nirvāṇikā satī | dvijaṃ kṣmācolakākhyaṃ svaṃ patiṃ prāha sukhārthinī || 39|| dāridryaṃ vartate nityaṃ cullī cāndrāyaṇe sthitā | dantā vrataṃ niraśanaṃ prakurvanti nirāmayāḥ ||3.28.40 || gṛhe dhūmro na cāyāti yātrāyāṃ pragato yathā | vahnirlajjānvito bhūtvā darśanaṃ na dadātyapi ||41 || gatā tīrthe jantavaśca gṛhāt pipīlikādayaḥ | kapāṭasya pidhāne’pi prayojanaṃ na vidyate ||42|| dvāraṃ coddhāṭitaṃ nityaṃ svargadvāraṃ yathā śubham | śālāste mālikāyuktā kevalā rāgavarjitā ||43|| apādo’pi samāyāto mokṣo vipra gṛhe tava | ahaṃ māyāsvarūpāpīdānīṃ jaṃjālavarjitā ||44|| nirguṇe tvadgṛhe cāsmi nairguṇyaṃ samupāśritā | jīvato’pi nirālambā sthitiste vartate dvija ||45|| sālambāhaṃ nirālambā jātāsmi niṣparigrahā | aho bhāgyasya māhātmyaṃ saguṇo nirguṇāyate ||46 || bhūtvā bhūtvā vilīyante cāśā nirvāṇadarśanāḥ | kākāḥ kapotāścaṭakāḥ śvāno mṛgāśca mūṣikāḥ ||47|| biḍālādyā na cāyānti gṛhaṃ nau vai kvacit pate | nirastasarvasaubhāgye ko nivaset savāsanaḥ ||48|| kaṇḍanī peṣaṇī nāsti mārjanī nāsti khaṭvikā | sūryabhāsā divā dīptaṃ niśi candragrahādibhiḥ ||49|| brahmadhāmasamaṃ vipra gṛhaṃ svargaṃ prabhāsate | jaṭā naisargikī nau ca dyotate yoginījaṭā ||3.28.50|| aho daivasya daurātmyaṃ saṃsāre cāpyasāratā | satyāmapi gṛhalakṣmyāṃ bhāgyalakṣmīrna vidyate ||51|| alakṣmīkagṛhaṃ satyaṃ brahmadhāmāyate sadā | etādṛśaṃ gṛhaṃ vipra cāvayorvidyate’calam ||52|| bhālaṃ bhāgyaṃ bhogajātaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhāsā na santi vai | tato’vaśyaṃ yogisevyaṃ gṛhaṃ te rājate dvija ||53|| gṛhisevyaṃ na caivāste lakṣmyā hīnaṃ ca nirguṇam | tanmayā cintyate nityaṃ lakṣmīryathā gṛhe mama ||54|| samāgacchettathā lakṣmyā ārādhanā pate mayā | kartavyā vratayoginyā sampadvanme gṛhaṃ bhavet ||55|| ityarthito nijasvāmī tathāstvevaṃ jagāda tam | sāpi lakṣmīvrataṃ cakre vārṣikaṃ dugdhabhojanā ||56|| śete pṛthvyāṃ brahmacaryaparāyaṇā nirāsanā | karoti jāgaraṃ cārdharātriṃ yāvat tataḥ sukham ||57|| nidrāti bhajate lakṣmi lakṣmi lakṣmīti vai hṛdā | prātarnadyāṃ sadā snāti sārdravastrā gṛhaṃ prati ||58|| samāgatyārcanaṃ lakṣmyāḥ karoti padmapuṣpakaiḥ | aṣṭottaraśatairnityaṃ dhūpadīpādibhistathā ||59|| nīrājanaṃ karotyeva sugandhaṃ cārpayatyapi | naivedyaṃ dugdhapākādi samarpayati polikāḥ ||3.28.60|| aṣṭottaraśatapradakṣiṇāni bhramati śriyam | mṛnmūrtiṃ śrīṃ namaskṛtyāvartayatyeva mālikāḥ ||6 1|| lakṣmi śri kamale padme rame nārāyaṇīndire | hiraṇmayi mahālakṣmi īśvari parameśvari ||62|| kṛṣṇe hariṇi dravyākhye vaiṣṇavi puruṣottami | sampadrūpe bhagavati haridāsi haripriye ||63|| brāhmi vaikuṇṭhike smṛddhe śālagrāmi trayodaśi | cakriṇi padmini bindvi cābdhije svarṇarūpiṇi ||64|| gośakṛdvāsini brahmahṛdayasthe dhaneśvari | ṛtambhare plakṣavāse māye me māta īśvari ||65|| amāye meruputri tvaṃ dhṛte raudri praśātani | kaumudi bhūyasi devavīthi cānantike kale ||66|| ārṣi jyotsne śive śārdūlike saraḥprabhadrike | sarvabhadre svatantre ca jaye sudarśani mate ||67|| jalanārāyaṇi svadhātmaje ca mākṣiki sati | puṇḍarīki ratnike ca kṛpāvati ca bhaktije ||68|| ardhaśri pippale cārdhordhve vaṭi pīṭhike’cyute | rājarājñi naiṣṭhikīśri śaivi svāmini kānaki ||69|| nirvāṇike brahmaśakti cātmātmike’ntarātmike | cañcadrūpe cañcale ca sattvaprakarṣiṇi prabhe ||3.28.70|| śrīvatse yantrike caindri jayanti maṇḍalātmike | sarvatobhadrike padmaśile prajñe tathākṣari ||71|| śrāṃgārike bhāgyarūpe siddhe śānte’vatāriṇi | aṃśe pare ca vibhavi kale’rce bhūmni dhāmini ||72|| janani kāriṇi ramye devīśvarīśvarīśvari | muktānike parabrahmapatni prapoṣike kriye |||73||| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatni hyanādini | evaṃ tvaṣṭādaśayuktaśatābhidhānike mayi ||74|| kṛpāṃ kṛtvā samāyāhi madgṛhe vaibhaveśvari | sarvagandhe sarvarase sarvarūpe surūpiṇi ||75|| sarvasparśe sarvaśabde samāgaccha gṛhe mama | sarvānande sarvasaukhye sarvade smṛddhivardhini |||76||| anantoddhārasaṃśakte samāyāhi gṛhe mama | dāridryaduḥkhasaṃhantri hyalakṣmīdūrakāriṇi ||77|| kīrtitejovardhayitri sukhayitri svasatrjuṣām | bhaktāyā me gṛhe lakṣmi śri samāyāhi śobhane ||78|| ityevaṃ sā prārthayattvāṃ nirvāṇikā dvijapriyā | śrutvā tvaṃ vīkṣya bhaktiṃ ca prasannācintayaḥ priye ||79|| tadgṛhe gantumevāpi dātuṃ ca darśanaṃ hyapi | madājñāṃ tvaṃ samādāya yātā nirvāṇikālayam ||3.28.80|| gocarā purataḥ sthitvābhavastatra tato’vadaḥ | nārāyaṇaṃ vinā naiva sthāsyāmyatra gṛhe tava ||81|| tamārādhaya mātarvai mādhavaścāgamiṣyati | ityuktvā tvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ gatā tasyāstu varṣmaṇi |||82|| putrīrūpā surūpā tvamajāyathāḥ sukanyakā | tayā cārādhitaścāhaṃ savanākhyadrumāttataḥ ||83|| prāvirāsaṃ yuvā divyasvarūpaḥ parameśvaraḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||84|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaścojjvalakāntimān | anādiśrīsāvanadrunarāyaṇābhidhānakaḥ ||||85||| bhikṣāṃ yayāce tasyāśca mātā te me dadau tadā | vivāhavidhinā tvāṃ vai sarvasaubhāgyasundarīm ||86|| tato nirvāṇikā māṃ ca tvāṃ ca rarakṣa sarvadā | nije gṛhe sevamānā kṣmācolasyājñayā priye ||87|| ahaṃ pṛthvyāṃ tato vāsaṃ cākalpaṃ pracakāra ha | nairvāṇikīśrīsameto dharmamasthāpayan kṣitau ||88|| nirvāṇikāgṛhaṃ samyagbhṛtaṃ tato hyajāyata | vivāhe devadeveśairarpitāni bahūnyapi ||89|| ratnāni kalpapātrāṇi dhenavaḥ kalpavallikāḥ | vimānāni mandirāṇi vibhūṣaṇāni vai tadā ||3.28.90|| ambarāṇi vicitrāṇi śayyāḥ sāstaraṇāstathā | sauvarṇāsanaparyaṃkapreṃkhādolādikāstathā ||9 1 || dhanāni maṇimāṇikyamauktikāni śubhāni ca | hārān kṣetrāṇi vāṭīśca mahodyānāni vai tathā ||92|| hastyaśvavṛṣabhām̐ścāpi dāsadāsīśatāni ca | evaṃ smṛddhaṃ gṛhaṃ te cāgamenābhūnmahodayam ||93|| sauvarṇakalaśaiḥ rājacchṛṃgaṃ yathendramandiram | evaṃ tava nimittena prākaṭyaṃ mama vai tadā ||94|| abhūllakṣmi smara sarvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ sukhasampadaḥ | anye’pyaṃśāvatārādyā mamābhavannasaṃkhyakāḥ ||95|| sarvān jānāmyahaṃ nārāyaṇīśri nāpare janāḥ | yadgṛhe’haṃ nivasāmi tadgṛhaṃ dhāmasadṛśam ||96|| mukteśvarādigamyaṃ ca tīrthāvāsaṃ bhavatyapi | supāvanaṃ satāṃ kṣetraṃ tadbhavatyeva sarvadā ||97|| yajñānāmavatārāṇāṃ vāsarūpaṃ bhavatyapi | dhāmānyapi ca sarvāṇi mannivāse vasantyapi ||98|| ityevaṃ mama vāsena bhuktirmuktiḥ kare sthitā | vartate tatra lokānāṃ paṭhanācchravaṇādapi ||99|| smaraṇāt sarvasiddhiśca jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | vratānāṃ puṇyamutkṛṣṭaṃ yāvatāmapi jāyate ||3.28.1 00 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasastrayastriṃśadvatsare jvālāruṇācalavahnirasairdahyamānānāṃ svāminagarasthānāṃ prajānāṃ rakṣārtham anādiśrīsvāminārāyaṇasya svāminīśrīsahitasya prākaṭyaṃ, catustriṃśadvatsare nirvāṇikāviprāṇyā lakṣmyā aṣṭādaśottaraśatanāmabhirārādhitayā lakṣmyā sākam anādiśrīsāvananārāyaṇasya prākaṭyamiti cetinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 28 ||
<3.29> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ vedhaso yākṣanāmake | pañcatriṃśe vatsare ca kalpe’ṣṭāśītiyucchate || 1 || tṛtīye ca manau jātaṃ prākaṭyaṃ me śṛṇu priye | aṃśukramatho rājarṣistadāsīd dakṣiṇe vratī || 2 || meroḥ sannihite deśe nālaveyaprajādhipaḥ | samastasya nalavasya bhūkhaṇḍasya niyāmakaḥ || 3 || anye sahasrabhūpāśca karadāstasya cābhavan | dānī dhyānī vratī bhaktaḥ sādhusevī śravī makhī || 4 || harinyāsī nivedī ca viśvāsī pūjako mama | nṛpoṃ’śukramatho lakṣmi mahāvaiṣṇavasatkriyaḥ || 5 || yathābhavattathā tasya patnyo’pi haridīkṣitāḥ | vaiṣṇavyaḥ śatasaṃkhyāścābhavan hariparāyaṇāḥ || 6 || dātryo dhyātryo vratinyaśca bhaktāḥ sādhuprasevikāḥ | śraviṇyaśca makhinyaśca harinyāsinya ityapi || 7 || ātmanivedikāḥ sarvā viśvāsinyaśca pūjikāḥ | pātivratyaparāścāpi mayi sarvakṛtādarāḥ || 8 || madarcāyāṃ lagnacittā matsādhudivyadṛṣṭikāḥ | patyau harau satsu nityaṃ samasevāsamādarāḥ || 9 || rājñaḥ putrāstriśatāni putryaḥ śatadvayaṃ tathā | pitṛvat mātṛvat satsu harau sevāparāyaṇāḥ || 3.29.1 0|| manasā vastubhirdehaiḥ sevante bhagavatkulam | sarve cāsan divyabhāvā videhāḥ siddhapuṃgavāḥ || 1 1|| naiṣāṃ rājye kadāpyāsan nītayo duḥkhaviplavāḥ | nāvagraho nātivṛṣṭirna yuddhaṃ bhūmikampanam || 12|| na śaityābhibhavaścauṣṇyopadravo’pi na vai kvacit | na rogāścābhavan rāṣṭre nākālamṛtyavo janāḥ ||13|| annavastrādimodinyaḥ prajā bhūṣāmahotsavāḥ | parasparaprasannānurāgiṇyaśca sadābhavan || 14|| parasparasahāyāśca nityamatpūjanānvitāḥ | mahyamarpayya khādinyo bhoginyo’rpayya me’khilam || 15|| hṛṣṭapuṣṭā narā nāryo dveṣahiṃsādivarjitāḥ | na stenā na kadaryāśca rājye teṣāṃ tadābhavan || 16|| sarvarasapradā pṛthvī ṛtavaḥ phalapuṣpadāḥ | vṛthā vallīvirudhaścāstambāt phalasumapradāḥ || 17|| asatyaṃ mānave nāsīt kāpaṭyaṃ na prajāsvapi | tṛṣṇā nāsīd bhogavṛttiḥ santoṣaḥ saṃvyavartata || 18|| devā maharṣayaḥ santaḥ siddhāḥ sādhvyo’pyaharniśam | yatayo brahmaśīlāśca bhuṃjate’sya sahasraśaḥ || 19|| annasatrāṇi rājyeṣu kṛtāni tena bhūbhṛtā | bhuṃjate lakṣaśo vidyārthino vidyārthakanyakāḥ ||3.29.20|| pratikheṭaṃ pratigrāmaṃ pratigrāmaṃ pratipattanamasya vai | annasatre’tithayaśca gṛhṇanti bhojanaṃ varam |||21 || prātarnityaṃ pratigrāmaṃ devānāṃ sarvasampadām | pūjanaṃ nṛpatereva dhanādibhiḥ prajāyate ||22|| ghaṭikākālaparyantaṃ kṛtvā saṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ | bhuṃjate’tithivargāścānāthādyā asya satrake || 23||
