sāyaṃ bhajante māṃ lokā rātrau saṃkīrtayantyapi | divā matkāryaparamāstataḥ svārthaparā janāḥ ||24|| evaṃvidhāḥ prajāstvasya dehānādaratatparāḥ | tapasyo bhaktimatyaśca sādhusevāparāyaṇāḥ ||25|| sādhurūpo hi bhagavān cetano’tra kṣitau sadā | koṭirūpo rājate vai prajānāṃ śreyasāṃ karaḥ ||26|| sādhureva hi bhagavān sādhureva hi tārakaḥ | sādhuḥ sadgatidātā ca sādhumūrtiḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ||27|| sādhuryanmānavaṃ rūpaṃ dṛśyate’smatsamaṃ hyapi | divyaṃ tat tatkriyā divyā mokṣado bhagavān svayam ||28|| darśanaṃ sparśanaṃ pādasaṃvāhanaṃ prasevanam | bhojanaṃ bahudhā sevā sarvaṃ sādhoḥ pramuktim || 29||| sādhūnāṃ paricaryā yā sakṛdvā bahudhāpi vā | pāpanāśakarī sarvā brahmamuktipradāyinī ||3.29.30 || ye putrā dīkṣitā divyā harereva hi vaṃśina | bhavanti janmabhūtyāgāsta eva harirūpiṇaḥ ||31|| tatkriyāyāṃ brahmacaryaṃ vrataṃ dānaṃ ca dakṣiṇā | tapo dharmo vivekaśca bhaktiḥ sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 32|| sādhorhastau harerhastau satpādau caraṇau hareḥ | satāṃ mukhaṃ kṛṣṇamukhaṃ tvak śrīhareḥ satāṃ tvacam ||33|| netre dve śrīharernetre sajihvā jihvikā hareḥ | sanmastakaṃ harermūrdhā sannāsā nāsikā hareḥ ||34|| satkarṇau śrīhareḥ karṇau saddantā daśanā hareḥ | satāṃ kaṇṭho hareḥ kaṇṭho harervakṣaḥ satāmuraḥ || 35|| satāṃ tundaṃ harestundaṃ satkaṭiḥ śrīhareḥ kaṭiḥ | satāṃ dṛṣṭirharerdṛṣṭiḥ satāṃ sparśo harerhi saḥ ||36|| satāṃ prasannatā yā sā harereva prasannatā | sukhaṃ satāṃ tu sevotthaṃ harereva sukhaṃ mama || 37|| modaḥ pramodaścānandaścotsavā ye satāṃ matāḥ | te sarve śrīharereva mamānandāḥ pṛthaṅ na vai || 38|| satāṃ santoṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ mama santoṣaṇaṃ hi tat | satāmindriyavargo yo mamendriyāṇi tāni vai ||39|| satāṃ buddhirmama buddhiḥ santo’haṃ sarvadā bhuvi | ahaṃ santaḥ sadā loke bhavāmi bahurūpavān ||3.29.40|| aparigrahadharmāṇaḥ santo me brahmamūrtayaḥ | satāṃ dharmārthakāmā ye te me sarve matāḥ sadā ||41|| ityevaṃ kamale rājā rājñyaśca nirmalāntarāḥ | kumārāśca kumāryaśca prajā bhṛtyāstathetarāḥ ||41|| sarve satāṃ prasaṃgaiste hyāsan mama parāyaṇāḥ | siddhayaḥ kalpalatikāḥ kalpapātrāṇi tadgṛhe | cintāmaṇaya evāpi kāmagāvaḥ sadāvasan ||43|| lakṣaśaḥ sādhavaścāpi sādhvyaśca kṛtabhaktayaḥ | bhajante māmāśramasthā niṣkāmā matparāyaṇāḥ ||44|| atha teṣāṃ bhaktiṃ vilokyātmaniveditām | kṛpayāhaṃ tadeyeṣoṣitaṃ sādhvīsatāṃ gaṇe ||45|| mādhavākhye mama māse rājā cakāra kīrtanam | māsikaṃ cākhaṇḍitaṃ ca triṃśaddinaṃ makhātmakam ||46|| hare nārāyaṇa viṣṇo kṛṣṇa keśava mādhava | parabrahma prabho śrīśa puruṣottama satpate ||47|| namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya paramātmane | namo’ntarātmane sādhusvarūpāyākhilātmane ||48|| namaḥ sādhvīsvarūpāya śrīkāntāya sadātmane | namo bhaktipralabhyāya sevāsādhyāya cakriṇe ||49|| svatantrastvaṃ cākṣareśo vartase muktakoṭiṣu | tathātrāyāhi sākṣādvai divyamūrtiryathāsi naḥ ||3.29.50|| ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ cakruḥ rājā prajāśca sādhavaḥ | taiḥ sahāyaṃ kīrtayāmi nṛtyāmi ca hasāmi ca ||51|| bhuñje tiṣṭhāmi saṃyāmi niṣīdāmi vadāmi ca | pibāmi cāpi jighrāmi rasayāmi svapimyapi ||52|| pramode cānandayāmi viharāmi namāmi ca | praseve sādhuveṣo’haṃ sādhuṣu tanmakhotsave ||93|| gūḍharūpaṃ ca māṃ te tu naiva jānanti mādhavam | sādhuṃ kaṃcit prajānanti kecanaiva samājake ||14|| tva tadābhūḥ satī sādhvī bālā śīlaparāyaṇā | kāṣāyāmbaraveṣā ca pratyakṣā gūḍhasadguṇā ||55|| gūḍharūpā gūḍhacihnā sādhvīsevāparāyaṇā | sādhvīnāṃ maṇḍale tatra vyacaraḥ samavartanā ||56|| na tāḥ sādhvyaḥ prajānanti lakṣmīṃ tvāṃ gocarāmapi | mama māyā tathā cāste svatantrāvaraṇātmikā ||57|| annasatraṃ makhasatraṃ tathā kīrtanasatrakam | mādhavānte prapūrṇaṃ ca jātaṃ vai pūrṇacandrake ||28|| dine sāyaṃ kathāṃ cakrurmama māhātmyabodhinīm | sādhavaścāpi satyaśca rājā prajā mahotsave ||59|| mama pūjāṃ tataścakrurniśi mūrtau suvastubhiḥ | nīrājanaṃ tataścakruḥ puṣpāñjalīrdadustataḥ ||3.29.60|| bhojanāni pradaduśca tataḥ savādyanartanam | kīrtanaṃ tālamānādyaiḥ susvaraistālikādibhiḥ ||61 || kiṃkiṇīghurghuraśabdaiścakrurjāgaraṇānvitāḥ | tadāhaṃ kīrtanākṛṣṭaḥ prāvirāsaṃ hi nartakaḥ ||62|| nartakī tvaṃ bālikā vai bālo’haṃ ṣoḍaśābdikaḥ | caturdaśābdikī tvaṃ ca suveśābhūṣaṇānvitā ||63|| māyūrapicchamukuṭā divyakuṇḍalaśobhanā | nṛtyārhasarvaveṣāḍhyā prasannā nāṭyakovidā ||64|| ahaṃ cāpi tathārūpaḥ sarvayogyaparigrahaḥ | sabhāyāṃ raṅgamadhye cāgato’lakṣyapradeśataḥ ||65|| na vai kaiścidahaṃ jñāto jñātā vā ca kuto nvimau | cakitā nau vilokyāsan rājādyāste sabhājanāḥ ||66 || āvayorvai mahattejaḥ sabhāyāṃ prāsarattadā | ānandamodasaukhyāni prāsaran vai samājake ||67|| miṣṭaṃ sveṣṭaṃ kāmitaṃ ca mahāsaukhyaṃ tadābhavat | janānāṃ tvāvayoryogānnṛtyagītipratālanaiḥ ||68|| asmallīnāstadā sarve pratyayaikapratānitāḥ | cākṣuṣamātravegāśca śravaṇākṛṣṭamānasāḥ ||69|| vyapaśyan nirnimeṣā māṃ tvāṃ divyāṃ śrīṃ śriyaḥpatim | anantakoṭisūryābhamasaṃkhyacandraśobhanām ||3.29.70|| māṃ tvāṃ vyalokayan lokāḥ kṛpāluṃ ca kṛpānvitām | kīrtanaṃ snehabhajanaṃ kāraṇaṃ satprasevanam ||71 || divyabhāvaḥ sadā satsu hetavo darśane hi nau | athānṛtyanta bhaktānyo bhaktāścākṛṣṇamānasāḥ ||72|| paramānandamagnāśca dehātibhānavarjitāḥ | sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ tatra darśanaṃ cāvayoḥ śubham ||73|| divyaṃ yathākṣare dhāmni tathābhavat kṣaṇaṃ tadā | athānantaramevāhaṃ tejastiro vyadhāpayam ||74|| ākṛṣṭā vṛttayasteṣāṃ svāsthyamāptā yathendriyam | tato nau nijatulyau te vyalokayantupasthitau ||75|| vinivṛttā drutaṃ nṛtyād gāyanāt kīrtanādapi | mahāścaryabharā nemurdaṇḍavattvāṃ ca māṃ janāḥ ||76|| dadurmukhyāsanaṃ svarṇasiṃhāsanaṃ nṛpādayaḥ | āvāṃ siṃhāsanasthau ca pupūjuste kṛtādarāḥ ||77|| candanairakṣataiścāpi puṣpairhāraiḥ sugandhibhiḥ | rājādyā ratnahāraiśca sauvarṇaraśanādibhiḥ ||78|| mukuṭādyaiśca bhūṣābhirdhūpainaiṃvedyābhojanaiḥ | miṣṭapānaiśca tāmbūlairnīrājanena saṃstavaiḥ ||79|| namaskāraiśca te sarve daṇḍavadbhiḥ punaḥ punaḥ | jayaśabdairharṣanādairvetradhṛgghoṣaṇaistathā ||3.29.80|| sarve prasādayāmāsuratyarthaṃ tvāṃ ca māṃ tadā | tuṣṭuvuḥ parayā prītyā jñātvā vai parameśvaram ||8 1 || sādhava ūcuḥ yatra kvāpi bhavejjanma paścātpuṇyapratāpataḥ | bhavaccharaṇamāpannāḥ putrāḥ smo bhagavam̐stava ||82|| acyuto vai pitā yasya te tvacyutā bhavanti vai | vayaṃ cācyutatāṃ prāptāḥ kṛpaiṣā śrīhare tava ||83|| suputreṣu ca divyeṣu kṛpayā tvaṃ samāgataḥ | snehapātrāṇi saṃvīkṣya pratyakṣaḥ sā kṛpāparā |||84||| athāto’pi sadā satsu vāso yathā tanau tathā | satāṃ madhye vasa kṛṣṇa kṛpeyaṃ pāramārthikī ||85|| yathā dhāmni tathā satsu maṇḍaleṣu nivāsanam | sadā sādhusvarūpeṇa karotu paramāṃ kṛpām ||86|| sādhvya ūcuḥ mātarlakṣmi mahāmātastvā vayaṃ śaraṇāgatāḥ | mokṣārthinyo brahmasādhvyo bhavatyāḥ putrikā vayam ||87|| mātṛvātsalyamatyantaṃ sutāsu tu nisargajam | tatpuraskṛtya janani dadāsi darśanaṃ hi naḥ ||88|| abalānāṃ balopetaṃ bhāgyamadya pravartate | divyatāṃ prāpya te yogānmuktatāṃ yāma eva ha ||89|| karuṇā te’pyatulyāsti yatsādhvīṣu vibhāvanam | tatrāpi cātikāruṇyaṃ yadi vāsaṃ prarocayeḥ ||3.29.90|| prārthanāmurarīkṛtya yatheṣṭaṃ prakarotviha | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇājñayākṣareśvari || 91 || rājñī provāca dhanyāhaṃ mama putryaśca putrā rājyaṃ nṛpastathā | prajā dhanyā mama lakṣmi yadatra darśanaṃ tava ||92|| kuru vāsaṃ sadā cātra tava sarva bhavatyapi | dāsyahaṃ sarvadā te’smi vasa lakṣmi kṛpāṃ kuru ||93|| saṃsāre lābha evātra prāptaḥ sādhvīsamāgamaḥ | bhavatyā darśanaṃ sākṣāt sa evānanyalābhakaḥ ||94|| rājovāca kulaṃ rājyaṃ dhanaṃ vaṃśaḥ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇa bhavatkṛte | mayārpitaṃ kṛtaṃ kṛtsnaṃ tvadātmakaṃ tvadarthakam ||95|| kṛpeyaṃ darśanaṃ sākṣāttavātra satsamāgamāt | prāptavyaṃ sarvamevādya prāptaṃ cātyantikaṃ phalam ||96|| sarvadā vasa me gehe kṛpāṃ kṛtvā pareśvara | ityuktvā praṇanāmaiva pavāta pādayornṛpaḥ ||97|| tathāstvomiti taṃ coktvā nyavasaṃ sādhumaṇḍale | anādiśrīsādhunārāyaṇaḥ sākaṃ tvayā priye ||98|| ākalpāntaṃ tataḥ sādhvīnārāyaṇyāvasaṃ kṣitau | smara tvāṃ māṃ tathā sarvaṃ cāvatārān parānapi ||99|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇānmuktimāvrajet| | prākaṭyaṃ me tavoktaṃ vai mokṣadaṃ kṛpayānvitam || 3.29.1 00|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ pañcatriṃśadvatsareṃ’śukramathanṛpaterbhaktyānādiśrīsādhunārāyaṇasya sādhvīnārāyaṇyā lakṣmyā saha prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navaviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 29 ||
<3.30> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tato rājñā sevito’haṃ sadā hariḥ | sādhusevāphalaṃ śvetadvīpaṃ dadau nṛpāya vai || 1 || kuṭumbasahitaḥ saukhyaṃ bhuktvā svargaṃ yayau tataḥ | tatra saukhyāni bhuktvaiva vairājadevatātmakaḥ || 2 || bhūtvā sukhāni bhuktvaiva satyalokaṃ yayau punaḥ | tato vaikuṇṭhamāsādya sukhaṃ bhuktvā divaṃ punaḥ || 3 || madicchayaiva samprāpto bhakteḥ pravartanāya ha | tataḥ koṭyadhilokānāmīśvaraḥ sa bhaviṣyati || 4 || nārāyaṇasvarūpaḥ so’saṃkhyalokān svakāśritān | nītvā bhaktiyutān dhāmākṣaraṃ me samprayāsyati || 5 || aṃśukramatha evāyaṃ bhakto me yādṛśo’bhavat | tādṛśā nāpare loke bhaviṣyanti nivedinaḥ || 6 || putrāḥ putryaśca rājñyaśca rājā prajāstathānugāḥ | sarve sarvāṇi rāṣṭrāṇi madarthasarvasampadām || 7 || kṛtopayogā āsam̐ste vaiṣṇavāḥ sarvatomukhāḥ | athānyatte kathayāmi prākaṭyaṃ śṛṇu mādhavi || 8 || vedhaso rākṣasākhye ṣaṭtriṃśe varṣe tataḥ punaḥ | kalpe ṣaṇṇavatisaṃkhye saptame ca manau priye || 9 || prākaṭyaṃ me yathā jātaṃ pravadāmi nibodha me | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaivāvatāriṇaḥ ||3.30.1 0|| kṛte yuge pañcadaśe yogī nāmnā hariprathaḥ | kuṃbhakāro’bhavat pṛthvyāṃ viṣṇupadyāstaṭe śubhe || 11 || ābālyātsādhuyogena babhūva bhaktarāṭ mama | mātā śreṇīmatī tasmai dadātyapi suśikṣaṇam || 12|| aṃke stanyaprapāne ca preṃkhāyāṃ kaṭivāsane | khaṣṭvikāyāṃ tathā yoge bālānāṃ khalane’pi ca ||13|| vada putra harernāma kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa narāyaṇa | vada putra śriyā nāma lakṣmi lakṣmi narāyaṇi || 14|| evaṃ mātā nijaṃ putraṃ śikṣayatyeva muktaye | śreyase pāpanāśāya janmasārthakyahetave || 15|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama | parabrahmākṣarātīta śrīpate parameśvara || 16|| evaṃ svayaṃ ca tanmātā karoti kīrtanaṃ mama | sadaiva sarvakāryeṣu bhaktimatī hi sadguṇā ||17|| kuṃbhakāro’pi viraṇo nāmnā me bhaktimān sadā | sarvakārye smaratyeva māṃ satāṃ sevako’pi san ||18 || bhajatyeva hariṃ nityaṃ smaratyeva janārdanam | karotyevārpaṇaṃ mahyaṃ tato bhuṃkte yathocitam || 19|| sāyaṃ nityaṃ mama mālāmāvartayati manmanāḥ | karotyapi sadā sevāṃ satāṃ bhaktimatāṃ śubhām ||3.30.20|| gṛhakāryaṃ pātrakāryaṃ grāmasevādikaṃ tathā | yadā karoti tatrāpi gṛṇāti śrīnarāyaṇa ||21|| kare mālāṃ gale mālāṃ sadā rakṣati kuṃbhakṛt | harernāma japan kālaṃ sārthakayati sarvadā ||22|| śṛṇu lakṣmi prabhaktasya bhaktirnāstyeva durlabhā | sarvadā sarvakāryeṣu sulabhātmanivedinaḥ ||23|| viraṇaḥ prātarutthāya nārāyaṇeti saṃvadan | ghaṭaṃ nītvā nadīṃ yāti snāti raṭati māṃ harim ||24|| jalaṃ bhṛtvā gṛhaṃ yāti pippalasya tu mūlake | smṛtvā māṃ salilaṃ tatra siñcatyapi tataḥ sa ca ||25|| sūryaṃ natvā mṛttikāyāḥ kṛtaṃ māṃ ca praṇamya ca | raṭan khādati mahyaṃ cārpitaṃ prātarhi roṭakam ||26|| tathaiva kuṃbhikṛt patnī bhuṃkte bhuṃkte suto’pi ca | athādātuṃ mṛdo yānti kīrtayanto hariṃ trayaḥ ||27|| kharapṛṣṭhe mṛdo yogyā āharanti yadā tadā | hareḥ kītanakartārastrayo yānti gṛhaṃ prati ||28|| gardhapyai gardhapāyāpi tṛṇādi ca jalādi ca | hariprasādasalilaiḥ saṃprokṣya tad dadatyapi ||29|| jalairmṛdaścārdrayanti kīrtayanti hariṃ tadā | mardayanti mṛdaścāpi kīrtayanti tadāpi mām ||3.30.30 || cakraṃ ca kīlake dhṛtvā bhrāmayanti smaranti mām | piṃḍaṃ cakre sthāpayanti māṃ smaranti janārdanam ||3 1 || ghaṭaśarāvapātrāṇi racayanti smaranti mām | tantunā ca pṛthak kṛtvāvatārayanti cāpyadhaḥ ||32|| smaranto māṃ ṭīppayanti pātrāṇi ṭīppasādhanaiḥ | vahnibhrāṣṭryāṃ klṛptayanti pakvayanti smaranti mām ||33|| vikrīṇanti ca pātrāṇi pakvāni ca smaranti mām | labdhadravyairannaśākādikaṃ krīṇanti cāpaṇāt ||34|| randhayanti bhojanāni smaranti ca raṭanti mām | sthālyāṃ bhṛtvārpayitvā me bhuñjate manniveditam ||35|| evaṃ yātrāṃ kuṭumbasya nirvartayanti matparāḥ | sāyaṃ kathāṃ praśṛṇvanti satāṃ mukhānmamālaye ||36|| rātrau śrutaṃ smarantyeva vicārayanti muktaye | na vinā bhojanaṃ mokṣo bhaktirna puṇyamantarā || 37|| puṇyaṃ sevāṃ vinā naiva sevā kṛpāṃ vinā ca na | kṛpā dāsyaṃ vinā naiva dāsyaṃ śraddhāṃ vinā na vai ||38|| śraddhā jñānaṃ vinā nāpi jñānaṃ na śravaṇaṃ vinā | śrutirvinā na satsaṃgaṃ satsaṃgo na sato vinā ||39|| santo bhāvaṃ vinā naiva bhāvo vinā na bhāvanām | bhāvanākhyastu saṃskāro na vinā prāgupārjitam ||3.30.40|| prāgupārjitamatraiva bhujyate phalarūpi tat | adyopārjitamanyatra bhokṣyate śreyasāṃ pade ||41 || śreyaḥ sarvavidhaṃ sādhyaṃ śreyaḥ paraṃ narāyaṇaḥ | tasya caraṇe mokṣo’sti prāptavyaḥ prematantunā ||42|| premapātraṃ harermūrtiścetanā sādhusaṃjñikā | santaḥ prasādayitavyāḥ sevābhiḥ śreyaicchubhiḥ ||43|| annaṃ jalaṃ ca vastraṃ ca tredhā nirvāhasādhanam | gṛhaṃ kāntā ca dhenuśca tredhā tvālambanaṃ matam ||44|| udyamaḥ putra ārogyaṃ tretā dhairyasya sādhanam | āyaḥ kośo bāndhavāśca tredhā balasya sādhanam ||45|| maitryaṃ mānaṃ yaśaśceti tredhā sthiterhi sādhanam | vidyā vṛttirvaśitvaṃ ca tredhā vaitṛṣṇyasādhanam ||46|| tṛptirvirāga aiśvaryaṃ tredhā śānteḥ prasādhanam | dharmaḥ kṣamā titikṣā ca tredhā sukhasya sādhanam ||47|| santo hariśca śīlaṃ ca tredhā mukteḥ prasādhanam | duḥkhaṃ viveko’vamānaṃ tredhā vairāgyasādhanam ||48|| karma tṛṣṇā vāsanā ca tredhā saṃsārakāraṇam | droho nindā ca nāstikyaṃ tredhā nirayasādhanam ||49|| pramādo moha īhā ca tredhā mṛtyunimantraṇam | naiṣkarmyamarpaṇaṃ bhaktistredhā mokṣasya sādhanam ||3.30.50|| tasmānmokṣārthameveha yatitavyaṃ nirantaram | anyāni samparityajya nirvāṇakāraṇeṣviha ||51|| ghaṭā yathā vibhinnā vai prajāyante tathātviha | prajā lokāśca karmāṇi sukhāni pratyahaṃ hatāḥ ||52|| kālavegena naśyanti dehadaihikasampadaḥ | kā nārī ko naraḥ putraḥ putrī vā kṛtrimaṃ tviha ||53|| sambandhā nāmasaṃjñāśca yathā mṛdā bhavantyapi | tathā ṣāṭkauśikādīnāṃ nāmasaṃjñāśca kṛtrimāḥ ||54|| kṛtrimaṃ dehamāsādya jñātvā mokṣasya sādhanam | yadi sādhyet mokṣo na vṛthā janma hi mānavam ||55|| sarvatra viṣayāḥ santi kṣudhā tṛṣā pramodanam | aihikaṃ sarvameveti kṣaṇikaṃ jīvabandham ||56|| navaṃ navaṃ bandhanaṃ ca nityaṃ nityaṃ prajāyate | na cānto’sti bandhanānāṃ nave varṣe navā ghaṭāḥ ||57|| ghaṭakartā mṛtiṃ yānti cānyastatra pravartate | ghaṭānāṃ ghaṭakartṝṇāṃ pravāho na nivartate ||58|| pravāhapatitā jīvā mamāhaṃpāśapāśitāḥ | ghaṭe naṣṭe’pi khaṇḍeṣu badhyante mohapāśitāḥ ||59|| kālena nāśaḥ sarveṣāmavaśyaṃ jāyate tviha | paśyantaśceti mokṣārthaṃ yatante na mṛtā hi te ||3.30.60|| punaḥ punarmariṣyanti vinā śāśvatasevanam | tasmānnārāyaṇo viṣṇuḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||6 1 || parabrahmāntarātmā śrīhariḥ sevyaḥ sadā bhuvi | bhajantu paramātmānaṃ raṭantu harināma ca ||62|| dhyāyantu ca harikṛṣṇaṃ prāpnuvantu pareśvaram | evaṃ nityaṃ niśāyāṃ vai viraṇādyā nijaṃ hitam ||63|| vicārayanti satyārthaṃ bhajante sma ca māṃ sadā | evaṃ yāte svalpakāle trayaste kuṃbhakarmiṇaḥ ||64|| sādhusevāparāḥ sādhvāśrayāśca sarvathābhavan | tadgṛhaṃ mandiraṃ jātaṃ mama sādhuniṣevaṇāt || 65 || sādhavo nityamevātra kurvanti matkathādikam | viraṇasya kuṃbhakṛtaḥ putro hariprathaḥ svayam ||66|| ānandabrahmaguruto dīkṣāṃ jagrāha sādhavīm | sādhurbhūtvā prabhuṃ nityaṃ bhajate māṃ divāniśam ||67|| vāksiddhistasya sampannā yathā vakti prajāyate | athaikadā satāṃ tatra sabhāyāṃ bhajane mama ||68|| jāyamāne tānamiśre’mbarāttatra manuḥ svayam | saptamo varṇiśālākhyo vimānena hi niryayau ||69|| sādhavaḥ kuṃbhakārādyāḥ sādhvyaśca bhajanottaram | viṣṇupadyāstaṭe snānādyarthaṃ yayuḥ sakīrtanāḥ ||3.30.70|| snānti kecittathānye ca kīrtayanti pareśvaram | yāvad ghaṭṭe’mbaraṃ dūraṃ bhramitvā manureva saḥ ||71 || yadṛcchayā viṣṇupadyāstaṭaṃ cāvātaraddhi saḥ | rājarūpo bhṛtyayukto jalāvatāramāyayau ||72|| yatra te bhajane magnāḥ sādhvādyāḥ snānahetave | tiṣṭhanti māṃ bhajantaśca raṭanto harikīrtanam ||73|| varṇiśālo manustatra bhṛtyānāha sagarvakaḥ | imān vai mānavānatra sarvānnārīnarādikān ||74|| niṣkāsayantu rundhantu dūrameva nadītaṭāt | yāvadahaṃ jale nadyāḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā na yāmi ca ||75|| tāvad bhṛtyāḥ karairdhṛtvā niṣkāsayantu dūrataḥ | ityuktvā bhṛtyavargāste pratyudgamya samantataḥ ||76|| dūrayāmāsurevaitān vārayāmāsureva ca | sādhavo’pi vinivṛttā ānandabrahmanoditāḥ ||77|| hariprathaḥ sādhubhaktaḥ prāha dūtān kathaṃ tvidam | rodhanaṃ vāraṇaṃ snāne bhavadbhiḥ saṃvidhīyate ||78|| dūtāḥ prāhuśca te kiṃ vā prayojanaṃ vibhāvane | gaccha dūraṃ yāntu sarve nātrāveśo bhaviṣyati ||79|| evaṃ vadanto dūtāśca jagṛhurbhujameva ca | dūraṃ niṣkāsayāmāsurhariprathaṃ tathāparān ||3.30.80 || hariprathastadovāca mṛtiṃ yātu nṛpo hi vaḥ | evamukte manustatra kṣaṇe mamāra jīvataḥ ||81|| vyasuḥ śavo’bhavacchīghraṃ papāta bhuvi padmaje | prasāritakarapādaḥ prākrośan cogravegataḥ |||82|| hāhākārastadā jātaścākṛtyaṃ samajāyata | dūtāstūrṇaṃ gatāḥ pārśve’sevayan pavanārpaṇaiḥ ||83|| pādasaṃvāhanairvāripānadānaistathāpi saḥ | manuryayau vihāyaiva prāṇān dharmālayaṃ tadā ||84|| hāhākāro’bhavat sarvaprajāpāleṣu vai tadā | dikpāleṣu samasteṣu deveṣu satyavāsiṣu ||85|| maharṣiṣu mahendrādau manurmṛto’bhavaddhi śuk | atha sarve’jaśaṃbhvādyāścāyayuryatra sa mṛtaḥ ||86|| jīvanārthaṃ tadā sarve cakruścārādhanaṃ hareḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mama padmaje ||87|| ahaṃ tatra samāyātastvayā sākaṃ narāyaṇi | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||88|| prārthitastairjīvanārthaṃ mayā te bodhitāstadā | madbhaktasya kṛtaṃ nāhaṃ parāvartayituṃ kṣamaḥ ||89|| prasādanīyo bhakto me sa vai śreyo vidhāsyati | tato bhaktaṃ surā nemuścārthayāmāsureva ca ||3.30.90|| jīvanaṃ ca kṣamāṃ cāpyarthayāmāsuḥ punaḥ punaḥ | pūjayāmāsurevāpi sādhūn hariprathastadā ||91 || jñātvā māṃ paramātmānaṃ natvābhyarcya śavopari | jalaṃ cikṣepa tāvadvai manuḥ prāṇayuto’bhavat ||92|| uttasthau ca hariṃ māṃ sa tuṣṭāva sampupūja ca | sādhūnnatvā kṣamāṃ labdhvā yayau naijaṃ padaṃ punaḥ ||93|| sādhubhiścārthitaścāhaṃ hariprathasya mandire | nyavasaṃ sarvadā lakṣmi sākaṃ tvayā satāṃ gṛhe ||94|| anādiśrībhaktanārāyaṇanāmnā svayaṃ prabhuḥ | tvaṃ tadā śrīkuṃbhikāśrīritikhyātiṃ gatābhavaḥ ||95|| vedmyahaṃ sarvamevaitanmanonāśaṃ ca jīvanam | smara sarvaṃ viṣṇupadītaṭādikaṃ satījanān ||96|| caturyugaṃ pūrṇameva nyavasaṃ sādhubhiḥ saha | anye’pi ca tato jātāḥ sampradāyāstadā mama ||97|| anye’vatārāḥ saṃbhūtā lokarakṣaṇahetave | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi ||98|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadvatsare hariprathabhaktasya śāpena mṛtasya varṇiśālamanorujjīvanārtham anādiśrībhaktanārāyaṇasya kuṃbhikāśrīsahitasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā triṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 30 ||
<3.31> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu cānyāṃ kathāṃ lakṣmi mama prākaṭyaśobhanām | saptatriṃśe’ṇḍajākhye vatsare vai vedhasaḥ purā || 1 || ekonanavatikalpe ṣaṣṭhe manau samudbhavām | ṛṣirnāmnājahārito babhūva tāpaso mahān || 2 || vedavijñaḥ sādhudharmaścaikalo’pi vane vasan | adhyāpayati viprādīn satkaroti samāgatān || 3 || atithīnarcayatyanyān dadātyebhyaḥ samāśrayam | āśrame parṇaśālāyāṃ vasati vṛkṣamaṇḍale || 4 || phalakandadalapatramūlāḍhyān pādapān sa ca | vṛttyarthaṃ jalamādattvā poṣayatyapi sarvadā || 5 || devānāṃ ca satāṃ cābhyāgatānāṃ svāgatādikam | karoti phalamūlādyaiḥ pakvairmiṣṭairniveditaiḥ || 6 || atha rājā sainyayukto vidravādhipatistadā | yātrārthamabhigacchan vai mārgeṇāśramamāyayau || 7 || viśrāntiṃ prāpa madhyāhne na ca jānāti tamṛṣim | samarthaṃ cāśramavāsaṃ matvā kiṃcid vanecaram || 8 || rājā neme na vipraṃ taṃ sādhuṃ sādhusvabhāvakam | pratyutāsya drumastambādiṣūṣṭrān kariṇo vṛṣān || 9 || turaṃgamān mumocaite bhakṣayāmāsureva ca | bhañjayāmāsurāmūlānnāśayāmāsurityapi || 3.31.10 || puṣpitān phalitān vṛkṣān ṛṣirdṛṣṭvāvadan nṛpam | mā rājan mama vṛkṣāṇāṃ nāśaṃ vidhehi mūlataḥ || 1 1|| niṣkāsaya paśūn dūre pārśve’raṇye drumānvite | rājovāca vanaṃ me’sti sarvaṃ rājño bhavatyapi || 12|| paśavo me kṣudhāvyāptā bhakṣayiṣyanti vai drumān | yāhi tvaṃ dūrataścāsmāt sthānādvanecaro’si yat || 13|| ṛṣirgarviṣṭhanṛpaterdaṇḍaṃ vyacintayad drutam | jalamādāya haste ca śaśāpa bhava ghoṭakaḥ || 14|| tūrṇaṃ rājābhavattatra turaṃgamo’tiśobhanaḥ | sainyaṃ duḥkhaṃ prāpa sarvaṃ prārthayāmāsa tamṛṣim || 15|| tasya rājño vimokṣārthaṃ rājñī cāpyārthayanmuhuḥ | ṛṣistasyai tadā prāha patiste’śvo’yamuttare || 16|| kāle’śvamedhayajñe tvatputraniṣpādite punaḥ | snātvā nārāyaṇayogādavabhṛthe nṛpo naraḥ || 17|| bhaviṣyati na sandehaścedānīṃ yātu vai gṛham | ityuktā svapatiṃ cāśvaṃ nītvā sā svagṛhaṃ yayau || 18|| sasainyā sā gṛhaṃ gatvārādhayatparameśvaram | rājñyā yaśovarākhyāyāḥ putro dharmadharābhidhaḥ || 39|| piturvarmadharākhyasya mokṣārthaṃ yajñamārabhat | dīkṣitaḥ sañcayāmāsa yajñīyaṃ vastujātakam ||3.31.20|| śuddhapṛthvyāṃ catuṣprānte vājimedhīyamaṇḍape| yajñakārye vartamāne guruṇā devasatriṇā ||21|| sarvasyāptyai sarvajityai sarvaśāpavichittaye | sarvapāpopaśāntyai ca hūyamāne’nale ghṛte ||22|| devāḥ sākṣāt samāyam̐śca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | anye devāścāyayurvai bhāgadheyādhikāriṇaḥ ||23|| devasatrī gururvipro’pūjayattaṃ turaṃgamam | pūrvabhāge kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ paścārdhe śvetarūpiṇam ||24|| lalāṭe śakaṭākārapuṇḍrayutaṃ śubhākṛtim | prāgasakṛtprapāyitasomarasāśvayugmajam ||25|| jātamātraṃ prapāyitasomarasaṃ ca vardhitam | caitryāṃ sāṃgrahaṇīṣṭikṛd vaiśākhyāṃ ca nṛpastataḥ ||26|| prajāpatidevatākayāgakṛcca tataḥ param | amāvasyeṣṭikṛccāpi kāritavapanastathā ||27|| dhṛtanūtnāmbaro maunī kṛtāgnihotrasatkriyaḥ | pare’hni maṇḍape gatvā kṛtaikādaśakāhutiḥ ||28|| brahmaudanaṃ ca ṛtvigbhyaścāśayitvā sukalpya tān | yajñīyāśvaṃ yajamānaḥ śvānaṃ ca caturakṣakam ||29|| taḍāgādijale nītvā sartvik tau samaprokṣayat | adhvaryuścāprokṣayacca śvānamutsṛjya vai tataḥ ||3.31.30 || aśvaṃ cāvāsṛjat pṛthvyāṃ bhramaṇārtha nṛpaḥ svayam | rakṣakairdhanvibhiḥ śūraiścatuḥśatairyutaṃ tataḥ || 3 1|| nṛpaḥ pratyahamevāpi viṣṇukramaṇasaṃjñakān | homān sāyaṃ ca prātaśca kurvan vīṇāpragāthinau ||32|| brahmakṣatrau samāhūya gāyayatyeva vai yaśaḥ | pāriplavaṃ śṛṇotyeva pratīkṣate’śvakāgamam ||33|| āśvapadikamārgeṣu yogyahomānakārayat | mukhyaṃ dantān hanūṃ coru pādau liṃgaṃ ca vājinaḥ ||34|| saṃsmṛtya havanaṃ cāpyakārayan nṛpatiḥ svayam | gamanaṃ dhāvanaṃ cākrandanaṃ heṣaṇamityapi ||35|| śayanaṃ cāpyavaghrāṇaṃ luṇṭhanaṃ vājino guṇān | saṃsmṛtya devatīkṛtya tebhyo homān dadau nṛpaḥ ||36|| atha kṛtvā vijayaṃ cāgatamaśvaṃ tu pāvanam | prapūjyāsthāpayat sthāne sutyākamakārayannṛpaḥ ||37|| sutyātraye dvitīye’hni codgātuḥ sthānake’śvakam | udgātāraṃ vyadhād rājā vaḍavābhiḥ samanvitam ||38|| hreṣāṃ cakāra turagaścodgīthaḥ sa vyajāyata | akhātayattato yūpānekaviṃśatisaṃkhyakām ||39|| madhye cottaradakṣiṇakoṇayoḥ suvyavasthitān | pūrve’gniṣṭhe turagaṃ taṃ babandha rājjudālaje ||3.31.40|| yūpe’sya pārśvayordevadārujau dvau ca yūpakau | tatpārśvayostrayastrayo bilvavṛkṣavinirmitāḥ ||4 1 || tatpārśvayostrayastrayaḥ khādirāstatprapārśvayoḥ | pālāśāśca trayastrayo yūpāstān samapūjayat ||42|| aśvaṃ raśanayāveṣṭya trayodaśa paśūn parān | raśanāyāṃ rajjubandhairabandhayacca pārthivaḥ || 43 || aśvalalāṭe cāgneyaṃ paścabhāge tu pauṣṇakam | uparyaindrāpauṣṇapaśumabandhayacca pārthivaḥ ||44|| bāhvorājñeyakau kṛṣṇagrīvau cābandhayannṛpaḥ | tvāṣṭrau sakthnoḥ śvetapṛṣṭhau bārhaspatyau tu pārśvayoḥ || 45|| śvetavarṇodaraṃ dhātṛdaivaṃ cādho hyabandhayat | pucche śvetamajaṃ cāpyabandhayat pārthivastataḥ ||46 || kṛṣṇavarṇamajaṃ sauryaṃ dakṣapārśve’pyabandhayat | yāmyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vāmapārśve’bandhayaccaivameva saḥ ||47|| grāmyān śatatrayaṃ navacatvāriṃśad babandha saḥ | āraṇyakān śatatrayaṃ ṣaṣṭiṃ cāpi babandha saḥ ||48 || ajādayo grāmyavācyā āraṇyāḥ śvāpadādayaḥ | tadupākaraṇaṃ cakre paryagnikaraṇaṃ tathā ||49|| namaskṛtya paśūn sarvān saṃkalpya devatārthakān | divyānpūjyānapasāryāvāsṛjattānpaśūnnṛpaḥ | |3.31.5 0 || aśvanāmnā sukuṣmāṇḍaṃ dhṛtvā ghṛtāktakambale | kṛtvā prākśirasaṃ codakpādaṃ saṃjñapanaṃ vyadhāt ||5 1 || rājñyaḥ patnyo grāmyaśabdairgarhāṃ vyadhustataḥ param | phalagarbhavapāhomān ṣaṭ prajāpataye dadau ||52|| viṣṇukramānakrāmacca kuṣmāṇḍānyaparāṇi ca | paśusthānāni saṃjñapya homān sarvānakārayat ||53 || ājyādinā tisra āhutīśca hutvā tataḥ param | patnīsaṃyājāntakarmānuṣṭhāya vyaramannṛpaḥ || 54|| sutyādine tṛtīye ca kṛtvā saumikakarma ca | prājāpatyān paśūnekādaśa kuṣmāṇḍarūpiṇaḥ ||55|| hutvā karmāṇyanuṣṭhāyāvabhṛthaṃ pracakāra ha | piṃgākṣaśvetakuṣṭhasya puruṣasya tu mūrdhani ||56 || homatrayaṃ pradatvā cādadat śatasuvarṇakam | kṛtvā traidhātavīyeṣṭim āsamvatsarameva ha ||57|| tattadṛtuphalaiḥ rājāyajaccāśvaṃ prapūjayan | daivāśvaṃ devavanmene rājā paramadhārmikaḥ ||58 || vatsarānte lakṣayatīn sādhūn sanyāsinastathā | satīḥ sādhvīstathā viprān bālān vidyārthinastathā ||59 || vidyārthinīrbhikṣukīśca bhojayāmāsa vai nṛpaḥ | āvarṣaṃ nityahomānte dadau dānāni bhāvataḥ ||3.31.60|| pratīkṣate kadā cāśvarūpaḥ pitā manuṣyatām | gacchediti vicārastho nidrāṃ yayau nṛpo niśi ||61|| vatsarānte yajñaparihāre rātrau narāyaṇam | dadarśa divyarūpaṃ cācyutaṃ mukuṭamaṇḍitam ||62|| sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvaśobhāsamanvitam | sarvaiśvaryādisampūrṇaṃ nyūnaṣoḍaśavatsaram ||63|| ācaturdaśahāyanyā tvayā lakṣmyā virājitam | prasannānanayā satyā tadā saubhāgyaśobhayā ||64|| nidrāyāmeva tuṣṭāva śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam | tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ cāśvarūpaścāśvamedhastvameva ca ||65|| tvaṃ rājā tvaṃ rājyapālastvaṃ rājeśvara eva ca | tvaṃ lokastvaṃ lokanāthastvaṃ devastvaṃ sureśvaraḥ ||66|| tvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ svayaṃ brahmā tvaṃ vairājo maheśvaraḥ | tvaṃ bhūmā tvaṃ pradhāneśo vāsudevo janārdanaḥ ||67|| tvaṃ dhāmeśo mahākālo māyeśastvaṃ pareśvaraḥ | tvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaprabhuḥ śrīmatpuruṣottama sarvarāṭ ||68|| kartā dhartā niyantā ca pātā hartāntarasthitaḥ | tvameva sarvaṃ bhagavam̐stvayi sarvaṃ samarpitam ||69|| tvaṃ vai śaraṇya evāsi piturme’śvabhavaṃ prabho | śāpajanyaṃ drutaṃ nārāyaṇa nāśaya keśava ||3.31.70|| evaṃ tuṣṭāva māṃ rājā tadā so’bhihito mayā | aśvamedhe mahāyajñe māṃ vihāya tvayā nṛpa ||71|| pūjitā devatāścānye vinā matsmaraṇaṃ kila | anarpito’śvamedhaśca mayi cārpaṇavarjitaḥ ||72||| tvadicchāpūrako naiva vartate’dya narādhipa | tasmātpunastvaśvayajñaṃ kuru pūjaya māṃ punaḥ ||73|| sarvatra sarvakāryeṣu tataste janako naraḥ | mānuṣatāṃ punaścāpi sameṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||74|| darśanaṃ me punarbhāvi sarvaṃ yogyaṃ bhaviṣyati | ityuktvādṛśyatāṃ prāptastvayāhaṃ śrīnarāyaṇi ||75|| dharmadharo nṛpa nidrāṃ vihāya tūrṇameva ha | utthitaśca yathārthaṃ vai svapnaṃ mene tataḥ punaḥ ||76|| kṛtvā me kānakīṃ mūrtiṃ yathādṛṣṭāṃ tvayā saha | punaścakre’śvamedhaṃ sa vidhinā māṃ prapūjayan ||77|| avabhṛthe punaścāhaṃ prāpto divyasvarūpavān | tvayā sākaṃ tadā lakṣmi snātvā vāri ca pāvanam ||78|| aśve pitari cikṣepa svayaṃ nārāyaṇo hyaham | sa tu rājā varmadharābhidho vidhūya pāpakam ||79|| pūrvarūpaṃ rājarūpaṃ prāptavān drutameva ha | sāśrurjātismaro māṃ sa tuṣṭāva bahugadgadaḥ ||3.31.80|| yaśovarābhidhā rājñī śri te satkāramācarat | devasatrī gurustasyāḥ pupūja māṃ pareśvaram |8 1|| ṣoḍaśopasuvastvādyaiḥ prārthayāmāsa vai punaḥ | ajahāritavacanādbhagavan samupāgataḥ ||82|| śāpamuktyai nṛpasyāsya vasātra bhagavan sadā | tathāstvevaṃ mayoktaśca devasatrī tapodhanaḥ ||83 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | anādiśrīmedhanārāyaṇanāmnā sthiro’bhavam ||84|| tvayā medhāvatīlakṣmyā sākaṃ vidravakhaṇḍake | tataḥ pṛthvyāṃ cāśvamedhā yajñā vai bahavo’bhavan ||85|| uccāvacā makhā yathāśaktyākurvan narādhipāḥ | vinā yuddhaṃ divyamaśvaṃ prapūjya ca punaḥ punaḥ ||86|| vartamānasya me bhūmau pūjitasyāśvamedhake | utsṛṣṭaṃ turagaṃ kecinnābadhnan mama bhītitaḥ ||87|| sarve nṛpā jñātavanto nārāyaṇo’śvamedhinaḥ | pakṣe gṛhe makhe cāste pratyakṣaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||88|| tasya yajñe yuddhavighnaṃ kartavyaṃ nahi sarvathā | yuddhena vijayaṃ kaścinnaiva yāsyati nirṇayaḥ ||89|| ityevaṃ tatra kalpe vai yajñā hiṃsāvivarjitāḥ | daivapāśavabhoktāro’bhavan mattoṣakāriṇaḥ || 3.31.90|| ajahāritavipraśca sādhudharmaparāyaṇaḥ | śrutvā māṃ tvāyayau śīghraṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ||9 1 || rājagṛhaṃ ca rājānaṃ militvā māṃ tataḥ param | sādhurūpo mama bhakto matsevāyāṃ vyarājata ||92|| pradadau sa mayājñapto vaiṣṇavān śreyase manūn | prajābhyo bodhayāmāsa kārayāmāsa macchritān || 93 || varmadharo’pi vairāgyāt prāpya dīkṣāṃ tu sādhavīm | upādideśa lokebhyaḥ pratyakṣopāsanāṃ hi me ||94|| bheje māṃ satataṃ sādhuḥ sādhudharmaparāyaṇaḥ | rājñī yaśovarā cāpi sādhvīdīkṣāmavāpya mām ||95|| bheje śriyā yutaṃ nityaṃ sādhvīdharmaparāyaṇā | nārībhyaḥ pradadau sā tu dīkṣāṃ me vaiṣṇavīṃ satīm ||96|| bhajanaṃ kārayāmāsa kārayāmāsa vaiṣṇavīḥ | sādhvīrbrahmasvarūpasthā brahmaśīlaprapālikāḥ || 97|| ākalpāntaṃ sthitaścāhaṃ tvayā sākaṃ narāyaṇi | smara nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sarvaṃ medhāvatīṃ nijām ||98|| evamanye’vatārā me jātāstato’pyanekaśaḥ | jānāmyahaṃ tu tānsarvān dharmakāryaparāyaṇān || 99|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāddhāraṇādapi | aśvamedhaphalaṃ prāpyāghāni nirdhūya sarvathā || 3.31.10 0|| sakāmaśced bahūn svargān bhuktvā ciraṃ tataḥ param | yāyād brahmaparaṃ dhāma bhaktyā me satataṃ priyam || 10 1|| niṣkāmasya tu bhaktasya bhaktirme jāyate drutam | sarvasaukhyaiḥ susantuṣṭo yāti matparamaṃ padam || 1 02|| sarvatīrthaphalaṃ sarvavratotthaṃ ca phalaṃ tathā | sarvasevāphalaṃ cāpi prāpnuyāt śravaṇājjanum || 103 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ saptatriṃśe vatsare’jahāritaśāpenāśvībhūtasya varmadharanṛpasya mokṣārthaṃ tatputrakṛtāśvamedhe’nādiśrīmedhanārāyaṇasya medhāvatīśriyā sahitasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 31 ||
<3.32> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ me tataḥ param | vedhaso’ṣṭātriṃśavarṣe kalpe ṣaṣṭe’ṣṭame manau || 1 || brahmadharmasamutpanno’suro’riṣṭo’nalādanaḥ | vavṛdhe jātamātraḥ sa bubhukṣito’titaijasaḥ || 2 || anyatejāṃsi yaddehe layaṃ yānti samantataḥ | agnīn sarvān bhakṣayati nānyaṃ bhuṃkte hi janmataḥ || 3 || jalaṃ pṛthvīṃ na grasate grasate’nalamātrakam | yatra yatrānalāḥ santi vahnayastatra tatra saḥ || 4 || gatvā gatvā prasahyāgniṃ dhṛtvā dhṛtvātti sarvaśaḥ | brahmaṇo mānasaṃ putraṃ mahāgniṃ sa tvabhakṣayat || 5 || tattrisutān pāvakaṃ ca pavamānaṃ śuciṃ tathā | abhakṣayattathā pāvakātmajaṃ saharakṣakam || 6 || pavamānātmajaṃ kavyavāhanaṃ cāpyabhakṣayat | śucyātmajaṃ havyavāhaṃ dhṛtvāsuro’pyabhakṣayat || 7 || agneścaturthaṃ putraṃ brahmaudanāgnimabhakṣayat | brahmaudanāgniputraṃ ca bharataṃ cāpyabhakṣayat || 8 || tathā bharataputraṃ ca vaiśvānaramabhakṣayat | athāgneḥ pañcamaṃ putramatharvāṇamabhakṣayat || 9 || atharvaputrānamṛtaṃ dadhyaṅgamaṅgiraṃ tathā | nirmathya ceti caturo’pyabhakṣayat mahāsuraḥ | | 3.32.10 || nirmathyasya sutaṃ gārhapatyaṃ tathā hyabhakṣayat | gārhapatyasutau śaṃsyaṃ śukaṃ tathā hyabhakṣayat | | 11 | | śaṃsyasutānāvasathyaṃ sabhyaṃ cāhavanīyakam | abhakṣayanmahāriṣṭānalādo nāma cāsuraḥ || 12 || tathā śaṃsyasutānanyān nadīṣu jātasaṃbhavān | dhiṣṇisaṃjñānapi putrānabhakṣayanmahāsuraḥ || 13 || ṛtuṃ pravāhaṇaṃ cāgnīdhraṃ samrājaṃ kṛśānukam | pāriṣadaṃ pratalkaṃ ca nabhasaṃ ca vasuṃ tathā || 1 4|| ajaikapādṃ cāhirbudhnaṃ ca gṛhapatiṃ tathā | abhakṣayacca hotrīyaṃ śāntapracetasaṃ tathā || 15|| viśvadevaṃ tathāvakṣumacchāvākamabhakṣayat | uśīraṃ ca kaviṃ potamāvārimapyabhakṣayat || 1 6|| bhāriṃ naiṣṭhīyasaṃ cāpi vyaratnimapyabhakṣayat | mārjālīyamavatphūrjamabjaṃ ca jāṭharaṃ tathā || 17 || jaṭharasya sutaṃ manyumantaṃ tathā hyabhakṣayat | savarttakaṃ manyumajjaṃ vāḍavaṃ cāpyabhakṣayat || 18 || vāḍavotthaṃ saharakṣaṃ kṣāmaṃ ca saharakṣajam | kṣāmātmajaṃ ca kravyādaṃ hyabhakṣayanmahāsuraḥ || 1 9|| śuceḥ putramāraṇeyaṃ cāparaṃ cāpyabhakṣayat | āraṇeyasutaṃ cāyuṃ cāyujaṃ mahimānakam || 3.32.20 || mahimānasutaṃ cāpi savanaṃ cāpyabhakṣayat | savanotthaṃ cādbhutaṃ ca vividhiṃ cādbhutātmajam || 21 || vividhijaṃ tathārkaṃ cāpyabhakṣayanmahāsuraḥ | arkasutān vājasṛgamanīkavantamityapi || 22 || yaṣṭikṛtaṃ rakṣohaṃ ca surabhiṃ ca vasuṃ tathā | annādaṃ rukmarājaṃ cāpyabhakṣayanmahāsuraḥ || 23 || evamanyān śmaśānasthān mahāsuro’pyabhakṣayat | evaṃ nārāyaṇīśri vai jagaccāgnivivarjitam || 54|| dāhaśūnyaṃ pākaśūnyaṃ himavat saṃvyajāyata | mṛtyūnmukhaṃ samastaṃ vai vīkṣya pṛthvī śucānvitā || 25|| yayau satyālayaṃ tatra brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā | tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyānalarakṣārthameva sā || 26 || analādavināśārthaṃ cakre vai prārthanāṃ muhuḥ | brahmā sasmāra manasā māṃ tadā puruṣottamam || 27 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | parabrahmākṣarātītaṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ harim || 28|| śrupvāhaṃ prārthanāṃ lakṣmi pratyakṣo brahmaṇo’bhavam | tvayā sākaṃ tadā padme brahmā pupūja māṃ tathā ||29|| tvāṃ pupūja pṛthivī sārthayad rakṣārthamityatha | asurasya vināśārthaṃ tadā tvaṃ tu madājñayā ||3.32.30|| pṛthvīputrī cābhavaśca pārthivīśrīḥ sukanyakā | tvāṃ nītvā sā yayau tūrṇaṃ bhūlokaṃ vimalāśayā ||3 1|| ahaṃ vahneḥ svarūpaṃ ca dhṛtvā jvālātmako’bhavam | analādo’suro māṃ saṃvīkṣya merau samādravat ||32|| bhakṣaṇārthaṃ cāyayau prādravaṃ cāhaṃ bhuvaṃ prati | yatra tvaṃ bhūsahitā ca pratīkṣase mamāgamam ||33|| bhānumatparvatasyaiva gahvare tatra cāgamam | paśyantyāśca tava cāpi pṛthvyāstatra mahāsuraḥ ||34|| agilanmāṃ mahājvālāmayāgniṃ parameśvaram | ahamantargato bhūtvādahaṃ taṃ vai mahāsuram ||35|| bhasmībhūtaṃ ca taṃ kṛtvā vahnīnajīvayaṃ punaḥ | sarve’gnayastadā jīvasahitāścetanāḥ śubhāḥ ||36|| yathāpūrvamabhavam̐ste’stuvanmāṃ cāpyapūjayan | anādiśrīvahninārāyaṇaṃ māṃ puruṣottamam ||37|| mayājñaptā vahnayaste svasvasthāneṣu vai drutam | pravṛttāḥ svasvakāryeṣu saśaktāśca samanvitāḥ ||38|| atha jaganti vai lokāḥ prajāśca sāgnayo’bhavan | himabhāvo gatasteṣāṃ sajīvā hyabhavan punaḥ || 39|| sarve jñātvā mama tatra prākaṭyaṃ tu surādayaḥ | āyayuḥ pūjanārthaṃ te vyomavṛṣṭistato’bhavat ||3.32.40|| candanānāṃ kusumānāṃ jayaśabdastathābhavan | mahotsavaḥ kṛtastatra sarvadevādibhirmama ||41 || pṛthvyā tvaṃ cārpitā mahyaṃ pārthivīśrīrvivāhitā | ākalpāntaṃ sthitaścāhaṃ tvayā sākaṃ narāyaṇi ||42|| prākaṭyaṃ me kathitaṃ te lakṣmi smara sukhapradam | anye’vatārā bahavastadā varṣe’bhavanmama ||43|| jānāmyetān samastān vai nānyo jānāti kaścana | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktirmuktiḥ prajāyate ||44|| vahnerupadravo na syād rogāḥ syurna kadācana | ānandaṃ brahmaṇo nityaṃ labhedevātra pāṭhakaḥ ||45|| athānyaccāpi me lakṣmi prākaṭyaṃ ca tataḥ param | kathayāmi samāsena mahāpuṇyapradaṃ śubham ||46|| navatriṃśe vedhasaśca nāgavarṣe purābhavat | ṣaṣṭhakalpe ṣaṣṭhamanau ilodaro mahāsuraḥ ||47|| rasādaḥ sarvatattvānāṃ rasabhakṣaka ulbaṇaḥ | rāhoḥ putro’surakarmā svargabhūrasabhakṣakaḥ ||48|| sa hi pṛthvyāṃ samāgatya tapastepe’tidāruṇam | sahasravatsarān mero tutoṣa śaṃkaraḥ svayam ||49|| āyayau sannidhau tasyovāca vṛṇu varaṃ tataḥ | asuraḥ saṃyayāce’pi sarvarasaprabhakṣitām ||3.32.50 || tathāstviti haraḥ proktvā tirobabhūva satvaram | asuraḥ sa sadā pārthivān rasān salilasthitān ||51 || bhuṃkte yatheṣṭaṃ satataṃ puṣṭimeti samantataḥ | tatastṛptaḥ punarvarṣasahasrordhvaṃ tapaḥ param ||52|| cakre brahmāṇamuddiśyāvadhyabhāvārthameva saḥ | vāyvāhāraṃ śuṣkagātraṃ vīkṣya brahmā hyupāyayau ||53|| uvāca prokṣya salilaiḥ sajīvīkṛtya taṃ tadā | varaṃ vṛṇu yatheṣṭaṃ me prasanno’smi mahāsura ||54|| so’pi netre samunmilyovācājeyatvamuttamam | caturdaśabhuvāṃ vāsairnāhaṃ jayyo bhavāmi ha ||55|| tathāstviti brahmavākyaṃ prāptavān sa mahāsuraḥ | brahmāpyadṛśyatāṃ prāpya yayau tato mahāsuraḥ ||56|| bubhuje bahuśo bhogānnirbhayo daivamānuṣān | athāpi cintayāmāsa maraṇaṃ me tu no bhavet ||57|| tatastapaḥ punaḥ kāryaṃ merau varṣasahasrakam | vicāryetthaṃ cakārāpi viṣṇumuddiśya vai tapaḥ ||58|| viṣṇurvarṣasahasrānte tvāyayau devanoditaḥ | prāha taṃ te kimiṣṭaṃ vai vṛṇu viṣṇurahaṃ tviha ||59|| varapradānakāryāya samāyāto’smi mā ciram | asuraḥ prāha yadyevaṃ maraṇaṃ me na vai bhavet ||3.32.60 || tathā vṛṇomi viṣṇoste varadānaṃ mayepsitam | viṣṇuḥ prāha janiryasya mṛtistasya dhruvāsura ||6 1 || pituste rāhusaṃjñasya maraṇaṃ dhruvameva ha | tatpituḥ kaśyapasyāpi tatpituścāpi vai dhruvam ||62|| amṛtyuḥ kasyacinnāsti vinā śrīpuruṣottamam | ātmā nityaḥ karmabhoktā vasati dehapañjare ||63|| sa ca dehādviniryāto mṛta ityupacaryate | dehaḥ ṣāṭkauśikaścāsti kośā bhūtādisaṃbhavāḥ ||64|| bhūtānāṃ pariṇāmāśca jāyante nityameva ha | pariṇāmā sadānityāstato’nityaṃ hi varṣma ca ||65|| anityasya na nityatvaṃ varamanyaṃ vṛṇu dhruvam | rājyaṃ svargaṃ ca pātālaṃ ciraṃjīvitvamityapi ||66|| dadāmi te’sura dravyaṃ svarṇarūpyādi bhūtalam | sauryaṃ cāndraṃ ca māhendraṃ padaṃ kauberamityapi ||67|| vṛṇu cānyatpadaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mā ciraṃ pradadāmi yat | śrutvaivamāha sarvādo mā mṛtyurme bhavediha ||68|| tridevatatsṛṣṭijebhyaśceti vṛṇomi dehi me | tathāstviti hariḥ prāhādṛśyatāṃ sa drutaṃ yayau ||69|| athāsurastapastyaktvā mṛtyubhīvarjitastathā | devadaityamanuṣyāṇāṃ bhogān bhuṃkte prasahya saḥ ||3.32.70|| brahmaṇaścāpi viṣṇoḥ saḥ śivasyāpi vibhūtikāḥ | sarvā āhṛtya ca balād bhuṃkte varabalaidhitaḥ ||71 || hyekadā sa yayau jitvā devān kailāsamityapi | śaṃkaraṃ prāha yuddhaṃ me kailāsaṃ vā pradehi me ||72|| śaṃbhuḥ prāhārdhamevaitat kailāsaṃ tava sarvathā | gṛhāṇeti tadā so’pi cārdhaṃ prāpya mumoda ha ||73|| athāyayau satyalokaṃ brahmāṇaṃ prāha me tava | padaṃ brahman hi sarvasvaṃ dehi vā yuddhameva vā ||74|| brahmā prāha gṛhāṇedaṃ pārameṣṭhyapadārdhakam | labdhvā so’pi prasanno’bhūd yayau viṣṇuṃ payodadhim ||75|| prāha me śvetabhūdvīpaṃ dehi viṣṇo saroṣakam | yadvā yuddhaṃ ca me dehi kuru yatte hi rocate ||76|| viṣṇuḥ prāha tu te dattaṃ kṣīrābdhyardhapadaṃ sadā | labdhvāsuraḥ prasannaśca yayau meruṃ nijālayam ||77|| atheyeṣa śivāṃ śrīṃ ca brāhmīṃ devīrmahāsuraḥ | arthayāmāsa tā yāvat tāvaddevā vināśane ||78|| matiṃ cakruścāsurasya kautukaṃ ca vyadhurdrutam | piśācinītrayaṃ tattadrūpadharaṃ haraḥ svayam ||79|| prāhiṇot taṃ tata ilodaro jaharṣa mūḍhadhīḥ | piśācinyo vrataṃ cakruḥ sarvarasaprabhakṣaṇam ||3.32.80|| māsamātraṃ vrataṃ sarvarasabhakṣaṇanāmakam | kṛtvā tato vrate pūrṇe bhaviṣyāmaḥ prasevane ||81 || upasthitā iti śrutvā jñātvā ca mumude’suraḥ | samartho’yaṃ sarvarasasañcaye vartate yataḥ ||82|| pārthivān vai sarvarasān jalīyānapi sarvaśaḥ | pākāpākakṛtān sarvānānayāmāsa satvaram ||83|| dadau tābhyastrivargābhyaḥ piśācinībhya eva ca | bhojayāmāsa bahudhā pāyayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ ||84|| pṛthvī rasavihīnā vai jalaṃ rasavihīnakam | tattvāni yāni rasyāni tānyarasāni cābhavan ||85|| rasaśūnyaṃ bhojanaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ cāmṛtamityapi | havyaṃ kavyaṃ cāmiṣādi sarvaṃ rasavihīnakam ||86|| jātaṃ tena samastaṃ cābhojyaṃ cāpeyamityapi | kleśamāptāḥ prajāḥ sarvā devāsurarṣimānavāḥ ||87|| parameśārpaṇe cāpi naivedye rasavarjitā | sarvā jātā tataśceśā nādanti bhojanaṃ kharam ||88|| te’tha sarve militvā māmārādhayan suduḥkhitāḥ | ilodarasya nāśārthaṃ tuṣṭuvurbahudhā tathā ||89|| śrutvāhaṃ ca parabrahma śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ ||3.32.90 || tvayā sākaṃ tvakṣarādvai dhāmno lakṣmi svayaṃ hariḥ | āyayau devakoṭīnāmagre sākṣād babhūva ha ||9 1 || pūjitaścārthitaścāpi nivedito’surārdane | gato’haṃ merubhūbhāge yatrāsuraḥ pramodate ||92|| rasarūpo’bhavaṃ tatra hrado bhūtvā vyavasthitaḥ | miṣṭaḥ śītaḥ sugandhaścānandadaḥ sukhadaḥ śubhaḥ ||93|| ujjvalaḥ śvetapīyūṣarūpaśca mādako mṛduḥ | pravāharūpaścāpūrṇo hrado’bhavaṃ tadantike ||94|| piśācinyastisra eva vīkṣya rasottamaṃ hradam | kathayāmāsurevainaṃ so’pi tūrṇaṃ samāyayau ||95|| papau rasaṃ tathā tāśca pāyayāmāsa sotsavaḥ | pāne tṛptirna codgāro jāyate pāti vai muhuḥ ||96|| bhānaṃ tyaktvā papau cāti papāvākaṇṭhameva tu | raso’haṃ na bhamau tvasyodare so’pi vyavardhata ||97|| pītvā pītvākṣayaṃ sarvaṃ rasaṃ so’bhūnmahodaraḥ | yāvatī mahimāsiddhistatastāvadabhūnmahān ||98|| mānottaraṃ gataścāpi papau rasaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | udaraṃ tasya vai tyaktvā śaktiṃ vai dhāraṇātmikām ||99|| madhyanābhipradeśācca pāṭitaṃ hṛdayāvadhim | jaghanaṃ pāṭitaṃ cāpi nirgato’haṃ rasātmakaḥ ||3.32.1 00 || bahirevodarāttasya papāta sa mamāra ca | anādiśrīrasanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ tvayā saha || 101 || anādiśrīrasalakṣmyā sākaṃ tatrābhavaṃ sthitaḥ | piśācinyaḥ prasannāśca pūjayitvā hariṃ tu mām || 10 2|| yayuḥ kailāsamevaitāḥ devādyāstatra cāyayuḥ | puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ pracakruśca tuṣṭuvurmāṃ rasātmakam || 1 03|| anādiśrīrasanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | sarvadā ca nivāsārthamarthayāmāsurīśvarāḥ || 1 04|| ahaṃ sadāvasaṃ pṛthvyāṃ rasapuṣṭipravṛddhaye | manvantaraikamātraṃ mūrtimānabhavaṃ tadā || 1 05|| tato rasātmako bhūtvākalpaṃ sthito’bhavaṃ priye | smara lakṣmi mama tadvai prākaṭyaṃ tadrasātmakam || 1 06|| atha devā yayuḥ sarve naijān vāsān divādiṣu | anye tadāvatārā me’bhavam̐ścāpi sahasraśaḥ || 1 07|| avatārī parabrahma rasanārāyaṇo’bhavam | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi || 1 08|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso’ṣṭātriṃśe varṣe analādamahāsuravināśārtham anādiśrīvahninārāyaṇasya pārthivīśriyāsahitasya, tathā navatriṃśe vatsare ilodarasya rasādasya mahāsurasya vināśārtham anādiśrīrasanārāyaṇasya śrīrasalakṣmyā sahitasya ca prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvātriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 32 ||
<3.33> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tataścāpi prākaṭyaṃ mama vacmi te | vedhaso vatsare catvāriṃśe kalpe’ṣṭame tathā || 1 || manau ca daśame prāntadvāpare bhūtale’bhitaḥ | kālabalena dharmasya nairbalye pāpidehiṣu || 2 || adharmasya bale vyāpte’surāṇāṃ balavardhane | prajāstvāsan pīḍitā vai makhā ruddhāḥ samantataḥ || 3 || dānaṃ dayā damādyāśca sarvathā vilayaṃ gatāḥ | ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ dṛśyante naiva bhūtale || 58 || śaucaṃ tapo vrataṃ ceti naṣṭānyati prajāsu vai | dṛśyate nopakāritvaṃ śīlaṃ naiva ca naiva ca || 5 || bādhante durbalān sarve baliścopabhuṃjate | tatsmṛddhīste prasahyaivāpyapaharanti sarvaśaḥ || 6 || daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ cāsurāṇāṃ koṭayo bhuvi | sarvatraivāvalokyante tīrthayātrā layaṃ gatā || 7 || maryādā naranārīṇāṃ rākṣasairhi vināśitā | sarvavarṇāḥ svatantrāśca dharmanyāyavivarjitāḥ || 8 || devānāmarhaṇaṃ sarvaṃ sarvathaiva layaṃ gatam | bālānāthātithīnāṃ ca pālanaṃ vilayaṃ gatam || 9 || nāstikyaṃ sarvakāryeṣu sarvadharmeṣu cābhavat | vṛddhānāṃ cāvamānādi dhārmikāṇāṃ prapīḍanam || 3.33.1 0|| āsuraiḥ sarvathā loke kṛtaṃ tvabhakṣyabhakṣakaiḥ | apeyapānakaiścāpyakāryairjugupsitairapi || 11 || nṛpāḥ sarve daityavaṃśā ācāryā daityavaṃśinaḥ | guravo’pi daityavaṃśā sambabhūvuryadā kṣitau || 12|| daivaṃ paitryaṃ tathā svargyaṃ sarvaṃ layaṃ gataṃ drutam | tadā devaiśca ṛṣibhirmānavairdharmamānasaiḥ || 13|| ārādhitaḥ svayaṃ śrīmatparameśvara eva ha | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 14|| jñānaviṣṇugṛhe putrasvarūpo’haṃ tadābhavam | sudarśanena sahitaścakranārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | | 15|| mātā me vedinī cāsīt tatkukṣeḥ prakaṭo’bhavam | tadā tvaṃ mannideśena rājakanyābhavaḥ śubhā || 16|| sārvabhaumasya nṛpaterbrahmacitradharasya vai | rājñyāḥ śobhālikānāmnyāḥ kukṣau sudhākṣiṇī tadā || 17|| sudhākṣyāste pitā cakre samrāṭ svayaṃvaraṃ tava | mahotsavaṃ tatastatra rājāno’surapuṅgavāḥ || 18|| tvadāśayāyayuḥ sarve samrājaḥ khaṇḍagāstathā | parakhaṇḍagatāścāpi vaimānikā balotkaṭāḥ || 1 9|| ahaṃ vaiśyo jñānaviṣṇoḥ sutaścakrasamanvitaḥ | yayau svayaṃvare tatra rūpaiśvaryaguṇānvitaḥ || 3.33.20|| tvaṃ māṃ vilokya sarvāstān vihāya parameśvarī | sabhāmadhye dadau mālāṃ mama kaṇṭhe’tiśobhanām || 21 || atha rājanyavargāste kruddhā yuddhārthamutthitāḥ | mayā sudarśanenaivāyutabhūpā nipātitāḥ || 22|| sādhāraṇānāṃ saṃkhyā na daityāḥ sarve hatā mayā | dānavā nihatāścāpyasurāḥ sarve nipānitāḥ || 23 || pitā te rakṣitastveko bhakto me so’bhavattataḥ | rājyaṃ nijaṃ sudhākṣiṇyai dattavān putravarjitaḥ || 24|| mayā sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sahasravatsaraṃ tataḥ | dharmāḥ saṃsthāpitā loke prajāsu devapitṛjāḥ ||25|| maryādā dānayajñānāṃ sthāpitā ca punarmayā | anādiśrīcakranārāyaṇena sarvajiṣṇunā || 26|| smara nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sāmrājyaṃ tava vai tadā | jānāmyahaṃ hi tat sarvaṃ nānye jānanti kecana |||27||| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktirmuktirbhaved dhruvam | anye’vatārāḥ śataśo dharmarakṣākarā mama ||28|| jātāstadānīṃ bahudhā devamānavasiddhajāḥ | dharmarakṣākarā muktipradāstān padmaje smara ||29|| athāpi vedhasastvekacatvāriṃśe tu vatsare | adhvarākhye tripañcāśatkalpe manau tu saptame || 3.33.30 || saptaṣaṣṭhitame cāpi kalau prākaṭyameva me | abhavattacchṛṇu śri tvaṃ parabrahmaṇa eva ha | | 31 | | kalerbale’tisaṃvyāpte jane mlecchamaye tathā | ekākāre sarvaloke varṇāśramavivarjite | | 32 | | vitastimātradehe ca pṛthvīvivaramandire | tṛṇamūlādane loke daivapaitryavivarjite | | 33 | | kuṭumbalope sarvatra svārthasambandhamātrake | yatheṣṭayugale loke mama bhānavivarjite | | 34 | | upadravādhike cālpasukhe cāśrayavarjite | jāte ca satyadharmāṇāṃ sthāpanārthaṃ svayaṃ hariḥ | | 35 | | prādurabhavaṃ bhūmau vai bhaktasya putratāṃ gataḥ | nāmnā drāvaṇaviprasya caturbhujaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | | 36 || tvaṃ tadā brahmavarcasthā mama dehe sthitā sadā | abhavo’dṛśyarūpā śrīrvijayākhyā mayā saha | | 37 | | āsurāṇāṃ vināśārthaṃ garuḍaḥ saṃsmṛto mayā | ratho divyo gajāścāpi caturdantāḥ sitaprabhāḥ | | 38 | | āyudhāni samastāni gadākhaṅgaśarāsayaḥ | dhanuśśaktivajracakraprāśatomarakuntalāḥ | | 39 | | astraśastradharaścāhaṃ tvayā vijayayā saha | jaitraṃ rathaṃ samāsthāya gāruḍadhvajamūrdhvagam ||3.33.40 | | hastivāhyaṃ vyomagaṃ ca yuyudhe’surakoṭibhiḥ | nāśitāśca nṛpāḥ pūrvaṃ mlecchā daityeśvarā balāḥ | | 41 || dānaveśāścāsureśāstato mlecchaprajādikāḥ | mayā ca rakṣitāstatra saṃgrāme śaraṇāgatāḥ | |42 | | kṛtāste pāyayitvāmbho pādayorbrāhmaṇāḥ punaḥ | niṣkāsitāśca te sarve matprākaṭyānalāntarāt | | 43 | | pāvitāśca kṛtāḥ kāyākalpitā dvijakoṭayaḥ | sthāpitāsteṣu sarveṣu dharmā me satyasaṃbhavāḥ | | 44 | | mamāstitvabalenāpi bhūtāni sāttvikāni vai | saṃbhūtāni samastāni narā nāryo’tisāttvikāḥ | | 45 | | satyadharmaparāḥ sarve saṃbhūtā matprabhāvataḥ | pavanānalavārbhūmivyomādyāḥ sattvatāṃ gatāḥ | |46 || vṛkṣavallītṛṇādyāśca rasapūrṇāstadābhavan | viprāḥ kṛtā hi rājāno yaśāścāpi pravartitāḥ | | 47 || āstikyaṃ dānadharmāśca vivāhāśca pravartitāḥ | sādhusādhvījanāścāpi santaḥ siddhāḥ śubhāḥ kṛtāḥ | |48 || tiṣyo vināśitaścāpi satyaḥ saṃsthāpito mayā | devāśca rakṣitā sarve ṛṣayaḥ sthāpitāḥ punaḥ | | 49 || mandirāṇi kāritāni homaśālā vidhāpitāḥ | satyatretāyugakālamavasaṃ bhūtale tadā ||3.33.50|| smara lakṣmi tadā camatkāraṃ mama purātanam | anādiśrīsatyanārāyaṇaṃ śrīvijayānvitam ||51|| parabrahma svayaṃ satyasthāpakaṃ cāvatāriṇam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam |||22|| evamanye’pyavatārāstatra tatra sahasraśaḥ | mama jātāstu tān sarvān jānāmyahaṃ na cetaraḥ ||53|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya satyadharmāśrito bhavet | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi yatheṣṭaphalavān bhavet ||54|| athānyanmama divyaṃ ca prākaṭyaṃ kathayāmi te | brahmaṇo dvācatvāriṃśābde hiraṇyābhidhānake ||55|| kalpe navatisaṃkhye cārambhe cādyamanostathā | pṛthvyāṃ dvādaśakhaṇḍānāṃ vibhājakāstu parvatāḥ ||56|| sapakṣāśca svatantrāśca tathānye dvīpaparvatāḥ | cetanāḥ sabalā mūrtāḥ sthānārthaṃ vādamādadhan ||57|| ahaṃ meroḥ sannidhāne nivatsyāmi na dūrataḥ | ahaṃ cāha tathetyevamanyonyeṣāṃ vivādanam ||58|| abhavad balinastatra ye cāseste tu vai balāt | iṣṭasthaleṣvavasam̐śca pare yātā manuṃ prati ||59|| svasvakaṣṭanivedārthaṃ manunāhūya bodhitāḥ | tathāpi menire naiva baliṣṭhāste manorvacaḥ ||3.33.60|| athendrāya dadāvājñāṃ vajradharāya śikṣaṇam | parvatevyaḥ pradātuṃ cānyathā daṇḍayituṃ nagān ||61|| indrastvāgatya bhūbhāge merau meroḥ samīpataḥ | parvatān mūrtarūpām̐ścāhūya jagāda taddhitam | |62|| brahmaṇā nirmitā yūyaṃ pṛthvīsthairyasya hetave | khaṇḍavibhāgakāryāya ratnanidhānahetave ||63|| prajārakṣaṇakāryāya khaṇḍaprākārahetave | ye ye yatra niyuktāste tatra tatraiva sarvathā ||64|| nivasantu nānyathā vai hitaṃ me vacanaṃ yataḥ | anyathā bhavatāṃ pakṣān śātayitvā balādaham | vajreṇa sarvathā yuṣmān pātayiṣye yathāsthalam ||65|| ityevaṃ garvayuktaṃ vai śrutvendravākyamulbaṇāḥ | parvatāstūrṇamevaite samutpeturvihāyasā | sarve balino garviṣṭhāḥ svecchārūpadharāstadā ||66|| grahatulyā mahendrasyopari nipetureva ha | indrastu marditastatra mṛtaprāyo babhūva ha ||67|| vajraṃ vajradharasyāpi naṣṭaṃ cūrṇaṃ babhūva ca | indrabalaṃ hataṃ dīrghabhūbhṛdbhiścūrṇitaṃ tadā ||68|| kaccaritāḥ surādyāśca palāyanaṃ pracakrire | bhūbhṛto vyomagāścāpi yuddhaṃ cakruḥ suraiḥ saha ||69|| pṛthvī bhāreṇa hīnā ca samataulyaṃ vihāya sā | mahājalatalaṃ gantuṃ pārśvanimnā babhūva ha ||3.33.70 || athotpātā babhūvuśca grahāṇāmapi sarvataḥ | vāyūnāmapi cāsthairyaṃ parvataiśca kṛtaṃ hyabhūt ||7 1 || gaganaṃ kampate sarvaṃ samaṇḍalaṃ laye yathā | pṛthivyāḥ rakṣaṇaṃ sthairyaṃ parvatasthairyalambitam ||72|| pṛthvīsthairye tato meroḥ sthairyaṃ dhruvasya cāpi vai | satyevaṃ svargalokānāṃ sthairyaṃ sukhaṃ bhavediti ||73 || vicārya sahasā brahmā rudro viṣṇuśca devatāḥ | mahānto namrabhāvāśca sāntvanāyuktabodhinaḥ ||74|| bodhayāmāsurevaitān parvatān bahudhā tadā | niyuktasthānavāsārthaṃ tathāpyete na menire ||75|| hiraṇyakaḥ kānakaśca rājato rātnakastathā | māṇeyaśca vaiṣṇavaśca haimeyaśca digīśakaḥ ||76 || bhairavaśca mahendraśca tathodayanaparvataḥ | āruṇaśca mahābhaśca lokālokaśca merukaḥ ||77|| evamanye mahāraudrā menire na tadā surāḥ | parvatānāṃ mahākleśapraśamāya narāyaṇam ||78 || parameśaṃ hyanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim | sasmarustūrṇamevāhaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ ||79 || parabrahma svayaṃ tatrājagāma tūrṇameva ha | sudarśanaṃ dhṛtaṃ cakraṃ gadā pṛthvyāṃ dhṛtā mayā ||3.33.80 || yatra cordhvābhavat pṛthvī tatrāpekṣitavattataḥ | samatolābhavat sā ca rakṣitāyudhabhārataḥ ||81 || parvatāṃśca samāhūya varadānena te tataḥ | yojitāśca mayā lakṣmi mama vāsakṛtā hi te ||82|| ye mayokteṣu deśeṣu sthāsyanti parvatāḥ kṣitau | tatra tatrāhamevāpi sthāsye śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||83 || tataste parvatāstūrṇaṃ mama vākyaṃ samāśritāḥ | merumadhye ca parito lokāloko vidhāpitaḥ ||84|| catuṣkoṇeṣu catvāro lambā samudragāḥ kṛtāḥ| hiraṇyako’gnikoṇe ca kānako nirṛte’kvake ||85|| rājataśca marutkoṇe ratnakaśceśakoṇake | pūrve cottaradakṣāvāyatau māṇeyavaiṣṇavau ||86 || dakṣiṇe prākpaścalambau haimeyaśca digīśakaḥ | paścime cottaradakṣau mairavaśca mahendrakaḥ ||87|| uttare cāruṇo mahābhaścāyatau niveśitau | pūrvābdhau nihitaścāpyudayanaḥ sarvabhānvitaḥ ||88|| evamanye parvatāśca madhye madhye niveśitāḥ | atha te prārthanāṃ cakruḥ pakṣanāśo hi no na vai ||89|| bhavediti mayoktaṃ ca sapakṣāḥ santu vai sthirāḥ | yadyākāśe gatimanto bhaviṣyatha tadā hyayam || 3.33.9 0|| mahendro vajradhāreṇa śātayiṣyati pakṣakān | tataste sthairyamāpuśca svasvasthāne yathāsukham ||9 1 || atha devādayaḥ sarve pūjayitvā ca māṃ yayuḥ | nijalokān parvateṣu nivāsaṃ ca tvayā saha ||92|| vyadhāpayaṃ bahurūpadharo rakṣākaraḥ prabhuḥ | ākalpāntaṃ nyavasaṃ vai tvayā hiraṇyayā saha || 93 || anādiśrīhiraṇyaśrīnārāyaṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ | vāgbaddho’haṃ parvateṣu nyavasaṃ bodhayan surān ||94|| mānavānapi pitṝm̐śca maharṣīn vyomacāriṇaḥ | atha sthirābhavat pṛthvī parvatāḥ sukhino’bhavat ||95|| nirbhayā mama vāsena prajāśca sukhitāstathā | anādiśrīhiraṇmayanārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ prabhum ||96|| smara nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ tvāṃ hiraṇyāṃ tathā smara | evamanye’pyavatārā devamānavajantuṣu ||97|| kāryāpekṣā abhavam̐śca tān jānāmi samastakān | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktirmuktirbhavecchubhā ||98|| mama smarturgṛhe vāso nityadā mama jāyate | yatra me bhāvayuktāśca bhaktā vasanti tatra ca ||99|| vasāmyeva na sandeho parvate ca vane’pi ca | gṛhe prāsādake cāpi mahālaye jale’pi ca || 3.33.100 || mama bhaktasya rakṣārthe puṣṭyā rakṣārthamityapi | devānāṃ cāpi lokānāṃ sṛṣṭeḥ rakṣārthamityapi || 101 || nivasāmi sthalaṃ kṛtvā tadrūpo’mānavo’pi san | yatra vasāmi tatraiva dhāmākṣaraṃ mamāsti ca || 1 02|| muktāścāyānti tatraiva sarve tatra prapadyate | māyikā naiva paśyanti paśyanti divyacakṣuṣaḥ || 103|| siddhā muktāḥ sādhavaśca santaḥ sanyāsino’malāḥ | sādhvyaḥ satyaśca bhaktāṃśca paśyanti majjaniṃ priye || 1 04|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaścatvāriṃśe vatsare daityānāṃ nāśārtham anādiśrīcakranārāyaṇasya sudhākṣiṇīśrīsahitasya, ekacatvāriṃśe vatsare ca satyayugadharmasthāpanārtham anādiśrīsatyanārāyaṇasya vijayāśrīsahitasya, dvācatvāriṃśe vatsare ca parvatānāṃ sthityartham anādiśrīhiraṇyanārāyaṇasya hiraṇyāśrīsahitasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā trayastriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 33 ||
<3.34> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ mama cetarat | brahmaṇo rājate varṣe tricatvāriṃśake purā || 1 || kalpe dvāṣaṣṭiyuksaptaśate manau trayodaśe | bhakto viṣṇornaiṣṭhikaścābhavannāmnā nirañjanaḥ || 2 || vipro drumanivāsaśca mūlapatraphalāśanaḥ | satyadharmaparo nityaṃ harerme japatatparaḥ || 3 || prāṇāyāmaparaścāpi siddhāsanaparāyaṇaḥ | pratyāhāraparaścāpi dhāraṇādhyānatatparaḥ || 4 || kāyena manasā vācātmanā viṣṇuparāyaṇaḥ | saṃyamī brahmavidvām̐śca rāgadveṣādivarjitaḥ || 5 || śuddhasphāṭikavadbhāsvān vyomavannirmalāntaraḥ | satsaṃgasnehapūrṇaśca satāṃ sevāparāyaṇaḥ || 6 || brahmadṛṣṭirbrahmayatno brahmavat siddhiśevadhiḥ | yathā brahmā yathā viṣṇuryathā śaṃbhustathā hyaham || 7 || upāsanābalāt sarvaiśvaryābdhiḥ samajāyata | naikarūpadharaścāpi parakāyapraveśavān || 8 || deveśvarādilokeṣu cāvyāhatagatistathā | samādhisiddhimān bhakto mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 9 || sa tvekadā sthito vṛkṣamūle’vicārayad yathā | viṣṇuṃ caturbhujaṃ tvadya pṛcchāmi hṛdayasthitam || 3.34.10 || nārāyaṇasya vai divyaṃ darśanaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tviti | vicāryetthaṃ prage snātvā pūjāyāṃ niṣasāda saḥ || 11 || viṣṇuṃ caturbhujaṃ nyasyārcayat sarvopacārakaiḥ | tataḥ samādhimāsādyāhvayad viṣṇuṃ puraḥsthitam || 1 2|| divyarūpaṃ ca viṣṇuṃ sa papraccha vinayānvitaḥ | nārāyaṇasya vai divyaṃ darśanaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tviti || 13 || viṣṇuḥ prāhāhamasmyeva nārāyaṇaḥ prapaśya mām | caturbhujaḥ śrīnivāsaḥ śaṃkhacakragadābjavān || 14|| nirañjanaśca taṃ prāha bhavānnārāyaṇo’paraḥ | paranārāyaṇo nāsti paraṃ darśaya me tviha || 1 5|| viṣṇuḥ śrutvābhavattatra sahasrabhujavām̐stadā | sahasraviṣṇusadṛśastejasā vayasā guṇaiḥ || 16 || prāha nirañjanaṃ paśya nārāyaṇaṃ hi matparam | mādṛśā viṣṇavaścāsmādutpadyante dine dine || 17|| varṣe varṣe sahasrāṇi vilīyante punaḥ punaḥ | śrutvā dṛṣṭvā ca sampūjya natvā prāha nirañjanaḥ || 18|| yadyapyayaṃ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrabhujavān prabhuḥ | paranārāyaṇaścāsti tathāpyasmātparo’paraḥ || 1 9|| nārāyaṇo bhavatyeva yasya me darśanaṃ priyam | bhaktābhilāṣāṃ saṃvīkṣya jñātvā viṣṇustataḥ param ||3.34.20|| rūpaṃ vivartayāmāsa mahāviṣṇavātmakaṃ drutam | mahālakṣmīsevitaṃ ca koṭivairājasadṛśam || 21|| tejasā vayasaiśvaryairguṇairvibhūtivaibhavaiḥ | darśayāmāsa tadrūpaṃ cāha bhaktaṃ prapaśya mām ||22|| ayutāyutabāhuṃ cāyutākṣipatkajam | idaṃ me paramaṃ rūpaṃ koṭivairājakāraṇam || 23 || śrutvā jñātvā vīkṣya natvā prapūjya ca nirañjanaḥ | prāha viṣṇuṃ na cāpyetatparamaṃ rūpamaiśvaram ||24|| ito’pyanyad vartate tad rūpasyāsyāpi kāraṇam | me tad darśaya rūpaṃ vai paramordhvamito’pi yat || 25|| śrutvā bhaktasya bhāvaṃ ca jñātvā viṣṇustataḥ param | vivartayāmāsa rūpaṃ tat tato’pi mahattaram || 26|| mahāviṣṇukoṭitulyaṃ koṭyaiśvaryādhikaṃ param | rūpalāvaṇyamādhuryatejaādibhirudgatam ||27||| koṭyayutākṣibāhuṃ koṭyayutapadāmbujam | koṭikoṭiguṇordhvaṃ ca prāha paśya tato’dhikam ||28|| nirañjanastu taṃ vīkṣya natvā prapūjya bhāvavān | kṛtvā ca daṇḍavat puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā jagāda ha ||29|| etadrūpaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ kṛpayā tava sadguro | sarvaiśvaryabhṛtaṃ sarveśvarāṇāṃ ca niyāmakam ||3.34.30|| īśvarāṇāṃ ca yā sṛṣṭistasyāsteṣāṃ ca śāsakam | tṛpto’smi vīkṣya paramaṃ rūpaṃ te paramaprabho ||3 1 || kintu nātyantatṛpto’smi cāgre dhāvati me manaḥ | draṣṭaṃ te paramaṃ rūpaṃ tato’pi pārameśvaram ||32|| śrutvā dṛṣṭvā bhaktabhāvaṃ viṣṇurbhūmasvarūpakam | drutaṃ vivartayāmāsa tato’bjārbudanetrakam ||33|| abjārbudādicaraṇaṃ tato koṭyabjasadguṇam | koṭibhūmotpādakaṃ ca koṭisaṃkarṣaṇādikṛt || 34|| vāsudevātmakaṃ divyaṃ koṭipradyumnasevitam | koṭitejomahaiśvaryāniruddhādisamanvitam ||35|| vāsudevaṃ prabhuṃ vīkṣya saṃhṛṣṭamānaso hyati | babhūva bhaktarāṭ tūrṇaṃ neme taṃ daṇḍavanmudā ||36|| tuṣṭāva ca hṛdā paścād viṣṇuṃ prāha punaḥ sa ca | nātra tṛptiṃ manaśceti pradarśaya tato’dhikam ||37|| yāvat catuṣṭayaṃ tāvatparaṃ rūpaṃ na tad bhavet | eka evādvitīyaḥ saḥ parameśaḥ parātparaḥ ||38|| śrutvā jñātvā bhaktabhāvaṃ viṣṇustataḥ punarnijam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa śobhanam ||39|| bhaktastaṃ cāpi natvaiva prapūjya daṇḍavad vyadhāt | naitadrūpaṃ ca tatprāha tato viṣṇuḥ punaśca tam ||3.34.40 || rādhākṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ svaṃ darśayāmāsa vai tadā | natvābhyarcya stutiṃ kṛtvā bhaktaḥ prāha punastathā ||41|| ito’pyūrdhvaṃ parabrahma nārāyaṇeśvareśvaraḥ | sarvāntaryāmikaḥ śrīmān pareśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||42|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ | akṣarādhipatirnātho muktakoṭyādisevitaḥ ||43|| yastaṃ nirañjanaṃ yāvadavatārāvatāriṇam | draṣṭumicchāmi vai viṣṇo kṛpā cenmayi darśaya ||44|| viṣṇurnirañjanaṃ prāha me’dhikāro na tatra vai | tadrūpaṃ ke’pi śaktā no dhartuṃ tasyāvatāriṇaḥ |||45||| avatārā īśvarā vā saguṇā nirguṇā api | aṃśā vibhūtayaścāpi kalāveśā maheśvarāḥ ||46 || vibhavāścāpi vā vyūhā dhartuṃ śaktāḥ kadāpi na | avatārī svayaṃ dhartuṃ śakto rūpāṇi tāni vai ||47|| tasmānnāhaṃ samartho’smi pradarśayitumeva tam | yadi tvaṃ vīkṣituṃ taṃ ced samicchasi nirañjana ||48|| madantaryāmiṇaṃ taṃ tvaṃ pūjayasva pareśvaram | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||49|| yastvadātmā sa evāpi mamātmā hṛdaye sthitaḥ | akṣare parame dhāmni sa evātmā sadā sthitaḥ ||3.34.50|| parabrahma svayaṃ tuṣṭastava dhyānena sevayā | tīvrayopāsanayāpi snehabhaktyātimātrayā ||5 1 || svayaṃ dṛṣṭipathaṃ cātrāgamiṣyati kṛpāvaśaḥ | bhaja taṃ śrīpatiṃ sarvapatiṃ hyekaṃ pareśvaram |||5 2|| sarvamuktapatiṃ sarvaśaktipatiṃ ramāpatim | māṇikīvāhinaṃ taṃ saṃ bhaja drakṣyasi keśavam ||53 || dvibhujaṃ sarvaśobhāḍhyaṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ ca tam | ityuktvā sahasā viṣṇustiro’bhavat tataḥ param ||54|| nirañjano vyadhād dhyānaṃ mama sarvāvatāriṇaḥ | dhāraṇāṃ ca vyadhāccāpi dhyānaṃ punarvyadhāttathā ||55|| samādhiṃ ca tato lebhe mayi śrīpuruṣottame | akṣare parame dhāmni samāyayau samādhinā ||56|| dadarśa mama rūpaṃ ca tvayā sākaṃ parātparam | divyaṃ muktajuṣaṃ sarvāvatārādivilakṣaṇam ||57|| ekamevādvitīyaṃ tat sarvodagraṃ parātmakam | yatra sarvāvatārāśca sarvadhāmāni yāni ca ||58|| sarveśvarāśca tallokāḥ sṛṣṭayaśca samastikāḥ | nirañjano dadarśaiva mūlaṃ rūpaṃ dadarśa ca ||59|| prārthayāmāsa bhakto māṃ gantuṃ loke nije saha | ātyantikavimuktyarthaṃ jīvānāṃ gocaro bhava ||3.34.6 0|| bhaktavaśyo’pyahaṃ tasmai tathāstvevaṃ tadāvadam | tvayā sākaṃ śriyā cāhaṃ bhaktena saha bhūtale ||6 1|| samāyayau tadā lakṣmi sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamaḥ | bhaktecchāpūrakaścāhaṃ bhūloke mānavo’bhavam ||62|| nirañjanasya vai gehe prākaṭyaṃ me hyajāyata | tvaṃ tadā pārśvavāsasya tāpasasya dvijasya ca ||63|| nāmnā niṣkiñcanasyāpi putrī vyajāyathāḥ priye | sa ca kālenārpayanme jñātvā māmavatāriṇam ||64|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | parabrahmākṣarātītaṃ parameśaṃ sanātanam ||65|| tataścāhamanādiśrīnairañjaninarāyaṇaḥ | khyātimāptastvayā sākaṃ naiṣkiñcanīśriyā priye ||66|| manvantaraṃ nyavasaṃ ca mocayan mānavān śritān | smara lakṣmi tadā māṃ tvāṃ prākaṭyaṃ smara śobhanam ||67|| anye’vatārāstatrāpi kalpe’bhavan mama priye | sarvān jānāmyahaṃ nānye jānanti tānnarāyaṇi ||68|| asaṃkhyajīvā mokṣe vai tadā sampreṣitā mayā | tvayā cāsaṃkhyajīvāśca sādhvyaścāpi vimocitāḥ ||69|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇāddhāraṇādapi | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi yatheṣṭānandavān bhavet ||3.34.70|| agrahā nāma te mātā mama mātāśutoṣiṇī | prāpya putrīṃ śriyaṃ putraṃ parameśaṃ hariṃ prabhum ||71|| menāte janmasāphalyaṃ muktānyau te hyubhe sadā | ācāryāṇyau tu te jāte lokānāṃ mātarāvubhe ||72|| yaśasvinyau mokṣadātryau sarvapūjye parāspade | vaṃśau tau sarvadā pūjyau babhūvatustadā priye ||73|| athetaracca lakṣmi tvaṃ śṛṇu prākaṭyameva me | vedhaso vatsare catuścatvāriṃśe kapālake ||74|| navanavatyūrdhvanavaśate kalpe’dvaye manau | pativratā mama bhaktā nāmnā puṇyavatī satī ||75|| viprāṇī devapuṣpasya viprasyābhūd vivāhitā | śīlaparā dharmaparā devapūjāparāyaṇā ||76|| patisevāparā cāpi satyadharmaparāyaṇā | tīrthakartrī vratakartrī dhyānayogaparāyaṇā ||77|| vipro’pi dhārmikaścāsīt sādhusevāparāyaṇaḥ | yugalaṃ nirapatyaṃ vai vārdhakyābhibhavānvitam ||78|| ajāyata suto naiva sutā nāpi vyajāyata | satī putreṣaṇākhinnā bhāgyaṃ śuśoca vai muhuḥ ||79|| ekadā bhāgyakartāraṃ vedhasaṃ sā śaśāpa ha | jaḍo bhava prajāhīno yathā cāvāṃ tathā bhava ||3.34.80|| drutaṃ tadā satyaloke vedhaso hastatastadā | nirmāṇadaṇḍo’pyapatat kulālasya karād yathā ||8 1 || saṃsāracakraṃ nyapatat kīlakāt pārśvabhūtale | brahmāṇḍaghaṭapiṇḍaśca viśīrṇo vegaśātitaḥ ||82||| tanturdūraṃ tathākṣiptaṃ kṣiptānyupakarāṇyapi | brahmā tu jaḍatāṃ prāptaḥ śavavanmūrchito’bhavat ||83|| ghaṭaśālā sakampā ca vyajāyata vimardanāt | kṛtānyanyāni cāṇḍāni bhagnāni cakrato’bhavan ||84|| hāhākāro mahān jāto ghaṭaśālābhitastadā | brahmā sraṣṭā mṛtaśceti mṛtaprāyo hi mūrchitaḥ ||85|| kāraṇaṃ kiṃ na vai vidmo jaguḥ kāryakarāstathā | sāvitryādyāścāyayurvai rurudurvīkṣya mūrchitam ||86|| siddhā maharṣayaścāpyāyayustatra prajeśvarāḥ | brahmaputrāḥ kāryakarāḥ śālāyāṃ samupāyayuḥ ||87|| dikpālāścāyayuḥ sarve brahmāṇaścāpare’pi ca | śāpajaḍaṃ tathā vīkṣya vīkṣya sṛṣṭivihīnakam ||88|| vilāpaṃ bahudhā cakruste sarve tatra saṃhatāḥ | atha ye ye brahmaputro brahmaputryastathā ca yāḥ ||89|| brahmaṇaścānapatyatvaśāpenāpi samāvṛtāḥ | mṛtyave samajāyanta rugṇāśca mūrchitā drutam || 3.34.90 || yathā dvau putrahīnau tau putrīhīnau tathā yathā | tathā brahmāpi putryādihīno sāvitrikā tathā ||9 1 || putraputryādihīnā ca bhavituṃ daivayojitā | nijaputrānnijaputrīrdadarśa jaḍarogiṇaḥ ||92|| mumūrṣūn sahasā tatra yataḥ śāpo bhayaṃkaraḥ | dvayorevāvaśeṣārthaṃ śāpaḥ satyāḥ pravartitaḥ ||93|| tadā sarvaiḥ smṛto viṣṇuḥ śaṃbhurvirāṭ narāyaṇaḥ | sarve kṣaṇādāyayuśca śāparodhanahetave ||94|| militvā kāraṇaṃ mārgayitvā yayurdrutaṃ satīm | puṇyavatīṃ prati kṣmāyāṃ sāntvayāmāsureva tām ||95|| sā prapūjya bhagavataḥ sarvān prāha hṛdi sthitam | bhāgyaṃ mama kathaṃ putraputrīhīnaṃ kṛtaṃ yataḥ ||96|| nāhaṃ śāpaṃ pradattaṃ nivartayiṣye sureśvarāḥ | yathāgatā gṛhaṃ yāntvanyathā śaptā bhaviṣyatha ||97|| jñātvā śrutvā ca bhaktāyā vacanaṃ balavattadā | bhītāḥ sarve sasmaruśca śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ||98|| taiḥ smṛto’haṃ bhagavānāgatastatra tu padmaje | tvayā sākaṃ hyanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||99|| puṇyavatī prabhuṃ vīkṣya lajjānamrā babhūva ha | iṣṭadevaṃ parameśaṃ vīkṣya maccharaṇaṃ gatā || 3.34.10 0|| papāta pādayostūrṇaṃ patyā saha ca me ca te | mayoktā sāntvitā sā tu yayāce yugalaṃ tadā || 101 || putraṃ māṃ ca tathā putravadhūṃ tvāṃ ca tataḥ param | vedhasaśca bhavecchāpanivṛttirbhāgyarohaṇāt || 102|| tathāstviti mayā proktā sā jagāda ca vedhasaḥ | jaḍatvaṃ yātu cāvābhyāṃ tulyatā cāpi māstu ca || 103 || saprajatvaṃ bahuputraputrīmatvaṃ bhavatvapi | ityuktamātre tūrṇaṃ sā ghaṭaśālā sucetanā || 1 04|| brahmā ca brahmaṇaścāpyapatyāni cetanāni vai | jijīviṣavo’jāyanta satīvākyapraṇoditāḥ || 1 05|| ahaṃ tasyāḥ suto jātastatraiva parameśvaraḥ | anādiśrīpuṇyanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 1 06|| tvaṃ ca kalyāṇikānāmnyā bhaktāyā mama putrikā | abhavaścāgnihotrasya dvijasyāpatyarūpiṇī || 1 07|| tena mahyaṃ pradattā tvaṃ vidhinā madvivāhitā | abhavastvaṃ tadā lakṣmi kalyāṇīśrīritiśrutā || 1 08|| smara sarvaṃ januste me sarvasaubhāgyakārakam | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇād bhuktimuktidam || 1 09|| anye tathāvatārā me tadābhavan sahasraśaḥ | bhuktimuktipradāścāpi lokarakṣākarāḥ priye || 3.34.11 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasastricatvāriṃśe vatsare bhaktārtham anādiśrīnairañjanīnārāyaṇasya naiṣkiñcanīśrīsahitasya, catuścatvāriṃśe vatsare ca brahmaṇaḥ puṇyavatīśāpanivṛttyartham anādiśrīpuṇyanārāyaṇasya kalyāṇikāśrīsahitasya ca prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 34 ||
<3.35> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tataścordhvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ me’psaro’bdake | vedhasaḥ pañcacatvāriṃśābde kalpe sahasrake || 1 || dvitīye ca manau sarvāpsarasāṃ bhaktibhāvanaiḥ | ākṛṣṭo’haṃ mokṣadātānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 2 || āvirāsaṃ pṛthivyāṃ vai śṛṇu tatpadmaje yathā | svarge satye mahendrasya sabhāyāṃ devakoṭiṣu || 3 || tathānyatra praśaṃsā vai sarvatra mama jāyate | rūpe guṇe svabhāve caiśvarye sukhe vilāsane || 4 || sparśe śabde vihāre ca śīle tṛptau rase bale | ānande sahavāse ca yoge hāsye ca narmaṇi || 5 || śayane sevane mohe hāve bhāve vikarṣaṇe | mode pramode ramaṇe utsave bhojane sthitau || 6 || āsane vāhane yāne gṛhe pāne ca nartane | śṛṃgāre ca sugandhe ca vīrye parākrame kṛtau || 7 || rañjane ca kriyāyāṃ ca prasannatve prabhogane | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇatulyo na cāparaḥ || 8 || evaṃ praśaṃsāṃ śrutvaivāpsarasaḥ koṭiśo divi | spṛhāṃ cakrurmama yoge bhāge vilāsane ratau || 9 || tāstu bhogān vihāyaiva mama prāptyarthamutsukāḥ | vratāni cakrurbahūni mānava iva yoṣitaḥ || 3.35.10 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | asmatpatirbhavedyena tṛptāḥ syāma hi sarvathā || 1 1|| iti saṃkalpya sarvāstāḥ pūjanaṃ mama savyadhuḥ | mayāpyākāśavāṇyā vai tābhyastato niveditam || 1 2|| sarvā bhavantu mānuṣyo nijāṃśaiḥ kanyakāḥ śubhāḥ | rājaputryo vipraputryo bhaktaputryaśca sarvathā || 13 || adyārabhya yatheṣṭaṃ vai gṛhṇantu janma bhūtale | meroḥ paścimato bhāge khaṇḍe hemarathāhvaye || 14|| tatrāhaṃ mānavo miliṣyāmi vai kṣatrapuṃgavaḥ | varciṣṇuvaṃśamūrdhanyaḥ parabrahma svayaṃ hariḥ || 1 5|| ityuktāstā apsaraso dadhrurjanmāni sarvaśaḥ | ahaṃ sākaṃ tvayā lakṣmi khaṇḍe hemarathābhidhe || 1 6|| varciṣṇukṣatriyavaṃśe bṛhadindranṛpālaye | prabhāsvatīmahiṣyāṃ vai prādurāsaṃ drutaṃ tadā || 1 7|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakaustubhādivirājitaḥ | bhaktau me pitarau dhanyaṃ bhāgyaṃ menāta eva ca || 1 8|| devadundubhayo nedurmaharṣayo’pi maṃgalam | smaraṇaṃ pūjanaṃ cakrurvardhayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ||1 9|| puṣpavṛṣṭirvyomamārgādabhavacchubhaśaṃsikā | utsavaṃ cakrire rājā prajāḥ surā maharṣayaḥ |||3.35.20 || atha tvaṃ rukmacampāyā rājñyā gavendrabhūpateḥ | kukṣau tadābhavaḥ prāduḥ sarvasaubhāgyasundarī ||21 || śātakuṃbhābhadehā ca sarvalakṣmasamanvitā | prāpte vivāhayogye ca kāle mahyaṃ samarpitā ||22|| tava pitrā tathā mātrā pradattā mama bhāminī | mayā ca vidhinā tatra vivāhitātisundarī ||23|| samrājastasya rājñaścotsave vaivāhike mama | ādeśānnṛpavaṃśāśca śreṣṭhivaṃśāstathā pare ||24|| dvijavaṃśāḥ kṣatravaṃśā vaiśyavaṃśāḥ samāyayuḥ | apsarasaśca yāḥ kanyā māṃ svapne dadṛśurniśi ||25|| vivāho jāyate naśca hariṇā paramātmanā | tava vivāharātrau tā dadṛśurmāṃ patiṃ prabhum ||26|| atha tā nirṇayaṃ cakrurmadarthaṃ vai svayaṃvare | patiṃ svayaṃ grahīṣyāmo varamālāpradānataḥ || 27|| athāha paramātmā ca mahaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ | tāsāṃ madarthakanyānāṃ pitṛbhyāṃ darśanaṃ dadau ||28|| svapne tābhyāṃ nijā putrī mahyaṃ datteti cotsave | tata utthāya pitarau sarvāsāṃ vai svabhāvataḥ ||29|| tāṃ tāṃ sutāṃ dattavantau mahyaṃ śrīparamātmane | koṭiśo’psaraso māṃ vai prāpya kāntaṃ yathepsitam || 3.35.30 || ānandaṃ paramaṃ prāpuḥ sukhaṃ prāpuranuttamam| ekamanvantaraṃ rājā cakravartī tadābhavam || 31 || nāmnā samrāḍbṛhadbrahmanārāyaṇanṛpeśvaraḥ | mama putrāstadā koṭyarbudābjāḥ putrikāstathā || 32 || tathāsaṃkhyā abhavam̐śca rājavaṃśeṣu cārpitāḥ | mama pautrāśca dauhitrā brahmakṣatraviśātmakāḥ || 33|| prajātmakāstathā jātā rājāno’pi ca bhūtale | manvantarānte patnīstā mokṣayitvā tataḥ param ||34|| ahaṃ vanaṃ jagāmāpi sākaṃ tvayā narāyaṇi | araṇye cādṛśyabhāvaṃ tvayā sākaṃ gato’bhavam ||35|| evaṃ mamāpi lokeṣu pūjā tataḥ pravartitā | anādiśrībṛhadbrahmanārāyaṇasya sarvadā ||36 || rukmavatyā tvayā sārdhaṃ cākalpāntaṃ hi padmaje | smara sarvaṃ śivarājñi prākaṭyaṃ te ca me’pi ca ||37|| evamanye’pyavatārāstatkalpe bahavo’bhavan | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktirmuktiḥ parā bhavet ||38|| sarvatīrthaphalaṃ syācca yāvadvrataphalaṃ tathā | yāvaddānaphalaṃ cāpi yāvacchrautaphalaṃ bhavet ||39|| sarvapāpavināśaḥ syāt sarvānandāptirityapi | sarvapramodabhāk syācca mama prāptistathā bhavet ||3.35.40 || athāparaṃ pravakṣyāmi prākaṭyaṃ mama tacchṛṇu | vedhaso vatsare ṣaṭacatvāriṃśe brahmasārase ||41 || kalpe navaśate ṣaṣṭhe manau cādye kṛte purā | brahmaṇā nirmitā viprā medhāvanto maharṣayaḥ ||42|| ūṣuste bhūtale karmabhūmau tvaravyavāsinaḥ | pratyakṣadarśinaḥ sarve sarvadharmaparāyaṇāḥ ||43|| brahmavidyābhavat teṣāṃ svābhāvikī pravartikā | atha tretāyuge prāpte sāṃśe hrāsaṃ gatā tadā ||44|| tarkavādā abhavam̐śca maharṣayaḥ parasparam | vismṛtayo’bhavam̐ścāpi kālenāvidyayā hatāḥ ||45|| tataścārādhayāmāsurmāṃ śrīśaṃ puruṣottamam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīparameśvaram | ahamāvirbhavaṃ teṣāṃ madhye jñānapradāpakaḥ ||46|| vidyāmadhyāpayāmāsa brāhmīṃ parāṃ tathāparām | vedavidyā tathā cātmavidyāṃ dharmakriyātmikāḥ ||47|| vidyāścānyā maharṣibhyo’dhyāpayāmāsa trai tadā | kutarkanāśinīṃ pūjābhaktibodhabhṛtāṃ śubhām ||48|| mokṣadāṃ svargadāṃ vidyāmadhyāpayaṃ hitapradām | maharṣīṇāṃ guruścāhaṃ vedavidyāprado’bhavam ||49|| brahmasvararṣiputraḥ san gaurave ca pade sthitaḥ | vipro bhūtvāvartayaṃ vai maharṣigaṇasevataḥ ||3.35.50|| ādvāparāntāyuṣko’haṃ tvayā sākaṃ suvidyayā | hṛdantararṣisutayā nāmnā suvidyayā śriyā ||51 || anādiśrīgurunārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | smara tvaṃ tvāṃ sarvavidyādhiṣṭhātrīṃ tu tadā priye ||52|| evamanye’pyavatārā bahavo’pi tadābhavan | jānāmyetānahaṃ sarvān smara tān parameśvari ||53 || paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya tamo līyeta mūlataḥ | brahmaprakāśo jāyeta tathātmadarśitāṃ vrajet ||54|| ityevaṃ mama kamale prākaṭyaṃ kathitaṃ tava | athānyadapi kathaye parabrahmaṇa eva me ||55 || svardhūnīvatsare saptacatvāriṃśe tu vedhasaḥ | kalpe’ṣṭādaśake triṃśacchatottare’ṣṭame manau ||56|| rājābhavanmama bhakto bṛhaddharmā janeśvaraḥ | sa tu yajñaṃ rājasūyaṃ samārabhata śobhanam ||57|| rājadhānyāṃ prasiddhāyām ojasvatyāṃ nṛpaḥ svayam | iṣṭīṃśca paśuyāgau ca somayāgān vyadhāpayat ||58|| navatriṃśadviśiṣṭaikaśatamiṣṭīnakārayat | ṣaṭsomayajñakān sapta darvīhomānakārayat ||59|| phālgune śuklapakṣasya prathame pratipaddine | samārabhaddhi tajyajñaṃ varṣamekaṃ tu tatra ca ||3.35.60 || cāturmāsyānuṣṭhānaṃ tvakārayadvidhinā nṛpaḥ | vaiśvānarasya ca parjanyasyeṣṭiṃ cāpyakārayat ||6 1 || āgneyaṃ saumyaṃ sāvitraṃ sārasvataṃ tataḥ param | pauṣṇaṃ ca mārutaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ dyāvāpṛthivyakam ||62|| yāgānetānaṣṭasaṃkhyān vaiśvadevākhyaparvaṇi | akārayat svayaṃ rājā tatra kramācca devatāḥ ||63 || agnaye’ṣṭākapālaṃ ca puroḍāśaṃ samārpayat | somāya ca caruṃ savitre dvādaśakapālakam ||64|| caruṃ samārpayat sarasvatyai caruṃ dadau tathā | pūṣṇe piṣṭacaruṃ marute tu saptakapālakam ||65|| puroḍāśaṃ dadau viśvedevebhya āmikṣakāṃ dadau | dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ dadāvekakapālakaṃ śubham ||66|| puroḍāśaṃ tatastatra madhuṃ ca mādhavaṃ tathā | śukraṃ śuciṃ ghṛtahomairatarpayannṛpaḥ svayam ||67|| evaṃ kṛtvā vaiśvadevaparva tato dvitīyakam | varuṇapraghāsaparva cakre tu vidhinā nṛpaḥ ||68|| āgneyaṃ saumyaṃ sāvitraṃ sārasvataṃ ca pauṣṇakam | aindrāgnaṃ mārutaṃ cāpi vāruṇaṃ kāyameva ca ||69 || akārayannavayāgān tatrāgniṃ stomamityapi | savitāraṃ tathā sarasvatīṃ pūṣāṇamityapi ||3.35.70 || indrāgnī marutaścāpi varuṇaṃ kaṃ krameṇa vai | tattaddravyairnṛpaḥ samyagavartayat havādibhiḥ ||71 || nabhaṃ nabhasyam iṣaṃ corjaṃ ceti hutvāpyatarpayat | avabhṛthaṃ cakārāpi niyamān jagṛhe’pi ca ||72|| tataśca tṛtīyaṃ sākamedhaparvāpyakārayat | anīkavatyādīṣṭīśca mahāhavīṃṣi cetyapi ||73|| pitṛyajñaṃ tryambakahavīṃṣi cāpi vyadhāpayat | ṛṣabhaṃ cāhvayaccāpi krīḍaneṣṭiṃ hyakārayat ||7|| sahaṃ sahasyaṃ tapasaṃ tapasyaṃ cetyatarpayat | tataśca vidhinā mahāpitṛyajñe hyakārayat ||75|| pitṛmantaṃ barhiṣado’gniṣvāttānapyatarpayat | piṇḍān dadau ca vidhinā tryambakahavīṃṣi dadau ||76|| rudrāya homaṃ pradadau cakārāditidaivatam | yāgaṃ ca caruṇā paścāt śunāsīrīyaparvakam ||77|| kārayāmāsa nṛpatirāgneyādīn yathāyatham | kārayāmāsa ca tathā aindrāgnaṃ vaiśvadaivakam ||78|| śunāsīrīyakaṃ vāyavyaṃ sauryaṃ yāgamityapi | akārayattathā tattaddevatāścāpyatarpayat ||79|| adhikamāsanāmnā caikakapālaṃ dadau tathā | aiṣṭikāni samastāni samvatsareṇa cākarot ||3.35.8 0|| tato rājā pavitrādīn ṣaṭ somayāgakānapi | krameṇākārayaccāpi sahasradhenudakṣiṇāḥ ||8 1|| dadau cāpyanumatyādīnaṣṭau yāgān vyadhāpayat | anumatyai puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālakaṃ dadau ||8 1|| ādityaṃ ca caruṃ cāpi pradadau nṛpatistathā | āgnāvaiṣṇavakaṃ caikādaśakapālakaṃ dadau ||83|| agnīṣomīyakaṃ caikādaśakapālakaṃ dadau | aindraṃ caikādaśakapālakaṃ cāgneyakaṃ tataḥ ||84|| aṣṭākapālakaṃ caindraṃ dadhi nṛpo dadau tayā | aindrāgnaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ caruṃ vaiśvadaivatam ||85|| saumyaṃ śyāmākaṃ ca caruṃ sārasvataṃ caruṃ dadau | aṣṭākapālamāgneyaṃ raudraṃ gāvīdhukaṃ carum ||86|| aindraṃ dadhi yavamayaṃ vāruṇaṃ ca caruṃ dadau | apāmārgakṛtān homān nṛpaścākārayattataḥ ||87|| dhātre dadau puroḍāśaṃ tad dvādaśakapālakam | anumatyai caruṃ rākāyai caruṃ ca dadau nṛpaḥ ||88|| sinīvālyai caruṃ kuhvai caruṃ dadau ca dakṣiṇāḥ | govṛṣabhau dadau cātha tato’nyahavanānyapi ||89|| āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ dadau nṛpaḥ | puroḍāśaṃ tathendrāvaiṣṇavaṃ ca tādṛśaṃ dadau ||3.35.90 || vaiṣṇavaṃ trikapālaṃ ca pradadau nṛpatistathā | agnīṣomīyakaṃ caikādaśakapālakaṃ tadā ||9 1 || puroḍāśaṃ dadāvindrāsomīyakaṃ ca tādṛśam | saumyaṃ caruṃ dadau cāpi saumapauṣṇaṃ caruṃ dadau ||92|| aindrāpauṣṇaṃ caruṃ pauṣṇaṃ ca dadau nṛpastathā | tato vaiśvānarīyāṃ dvādaśakapālikāṃ śubhām |||93 || iṣṭiṃ cakāra ca vāruṇaṃ caruṃ pradadau tataḥ | bārhaspatyaṃ carumaindramaikādaśakapālakam ||94|| puroḍāśaṃ dadau cāthādityaṃ caru dadau tataḥ | nairṛtaṃ ca carumaṣṭākapālamagnidaivatam || 95|| puroḍāśaṃ dadau daśakapālaṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā | puroḍāśaṃ dadau saptakapālaṃ mārutaṃ tathā ||96|| sāvitraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ puroḍāśakaṃ dadau | āśvinaṃ dvikapālaṃ ca puroḍāśaṃ dadau tathā ||97|| pauṣṇaṃ caruṃ raudramapi caruṃ dadau nṛpastataḥ | dvādaśeṣṭīstato rājā kārayāmāsa bhūsuraiḥ ||98|| cakāra dīkṣaṇīyeṣṭiṃ mitraṃ bṛhaspatiṃ tathā | ayajacca tataścāgnīṣomīye’ṣṭau havīṃṣi ca ||99|| dadau yathāgnaye puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālakam | somāya śyāmākacaruṃ dadau svayaṃ nṛpastataḥ || 3.35.100 || savitre dvādaśakapālaṃ puroḍāśakaṃ dadau | gāvīdhukaṃ ca rudrāya caruṃ dadau nṛpastataḥ || 10 1|| caruṃ naivārakaṃ bṛhaspataye ca dadāvapi | indrāyaikādaśakapālaṃ puroḍāśakaṃ dadau || 10 2|| mitrāya ca caruṃ varuṇāya yavamayaṃ carum | evaṃ datvā sarvayāgān kṛtvā rājā sthito’bhavat || 1 03|| brahmā rājñaḥ karaṃ spṛṣṭvā prajābhyaḥ sannyavedayat | ayaṃ rājā bhavatīnām aṅgīcakruḥ prajāḥ nṛpe || 1 07|| abhiṣekaṃ jalaiścakruḥ rājāṣaṭhomamācarat | sarvadravyādisampannaṃ devatāhlādakārakam || 1 05|| pārthahomottaraṃ bhūpau rathaṃ samāruroha ca | rathamocanahomām̐śca kṛtvāsanasthito nṛpaḥ || 1 06|| kathāṃ śṛṇvan bhūsurebhyo datvā svarṇaṃ tataḥ param | vaiśvadevaṃ tathā māhendrayāgaṃ ca vyadhāttataḥ || 1 07|| avabhṛtheṣṭiṃ kṛtvā ca havīṃṣi daśa cātanot | aṣṭākapālamāgneyaṃ puroḍāśaṃ dadau tataḥ || 1 08|| sārasvataṃ caruṃ cāpi dadau rājā tataḥ param | sāvitraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ puroḍāśakaṃ dadau || 1 09|| pauṣṇaṃ caruṃ tathā bārhaspatyaṃ caruṃ dadāvapi | aindramekādaśakapālaṃ dadau ca nṛpastataḥ || 3.35.11 0|| vāruṇaṃ ca daśakapālaṃ saumyaṃ ca caruṃ dadau | tvāṣṭramaṣṭākapālaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ trikapālakam || 111 || puroḍāśaṃ dadau caivaṃ saṃsṛpāmapyavartayat | dakṣiṇāḥ pradadau śreṣṭhāṃ rājā svayaṃ ca maṇḍape || 1 12|| adhvaryave svarṇamayau darpaṇau ratnaśobhitau| udgātre mālikāṃ hiraṇmayīṃ hotre tu vartulām || 1 13|| prastotre pratihartre ca dadāvaśvaṃ sabhūṣaṇam | brahmaṇe bālagarbhiṇīrdaśa gāḥ sandadau nṛpaḥ || 1 14|| maitrāvaruṇāya ca vandhyāṃ gāṃ dadau nṛpatistadā | brāhmaṇācchaṃsine balīvardaṃ dadau nṛpastadā || 11 5|| neṣṭe potre pradadau ca dhautāmbare śubhe tadā | acchāvākāya śakaṭaṃ yavapūrṇaṃ dadau tadā || 1 16|| agnīdhe ṛṣabhaṃ cāpi dadau nṛpastathāvidhim | daśapeyaṃ kratuṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ jagrāha vai tataḥ || 1 17||| keśānāmavapanākhyaṃ samvatsarāvadhi nṛpaḥ | tataścātirātrasaṃsthātmakaṃ somakratuṃ vyadhāt || 1 18|| vyuṣṭidvirātramevāpi kṣatradhṛtiṃ vyadhāpayat | sautrāmaṇiṃ cakārāpi vidhinā nṛpatistataḥ || 1 19|| aindraṃ tathāśvinaṃ sārasvataṃ caindravāyodhasam | payograhātmakaṃ homaṃ dadau rājā hyavabhṛtham || 3.35.1 20|| cakāraivaṃ ca dānāni dadau rājā bahūnyapi | iyeṣa rājyaṃ datvaiva dīkṣāṃ ca sādhavīṃ śubhām || 121 || grahītuṃ sveṣṭadevādvai viprebhyaḥ sa nyavedayat | sarvāṃ pṛthivīṃ viprebhyo dadau dāne hi dakṣiṇām || 1 22|| vrataṃ tvanaśanaṃ cakre sapatnīko madarthakaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 1 23|| svayamāgatya māṃ dīkṣayitvā sādhuṃ vyadhāpayet | rājasūyādiyajñānāṃ phalaṃ harau tadārpayat ||1 24||| ahaṃ tanniścaya jñācvā viprāṇāṃ prārthanāmapi| bhaktecchāpūraṇārthaṃ vai tvayā sākaṃ hi padmaje || 1 25|| āvirbabhūva sahasā koṭibhāskarasannibhaḥ | svāgataṃ me ca te cakruḥ pūjanaṃ ca tato’pyaham || 126 || dadau rājñe mahādīkṣāṃ sādhavīṃ mokṣadāṃ śubhām | rājñyai dīkṣāṃ dadau cāpi vīkṣya viprā maharṣayaḥ || 127|| lakṣamitā mahādīkṣāṃ jagṛhurmatta eva te | ahamācāryarūpaśca sādhudharmānabodhayam || 1 28|| vaiṣṇavyastāḥ prajā jātāḥ samastā mokṣagāḥ priye | tvaṃ satīnāṃ mahācāryāṇī tadā saṃvyajāyathāḥ || 129|| anādiśrīmahācāryanārāyaṇo’bhavaṃ tataḥ | anādiśrīmahācāryāṇīśrīyuto hariḥ svayam || 3.35.13 0|| sadbhiḥ samprārthitaścāhaṃ manvantaraṃ bhuvastale | vyacaraṃ divyarūpo vai mokṣadharmaparāyaṇaḥ || 131 || smara tvaṃ tvāṃ ca māṃ lakṣmi mahācāryasvarūpiṇau | evamanye’pyavatārā mamābhavan sahasraśaḥ || 132|| rājā nāmnābhavat rājasūyāyano hi dīkṣitaḥ | rājñī ca rājasūyaśrīrabhavat sādhvikā tadā || 133 || paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavet priye | svargo mokṣo bhaveccāpi rāgo virāgatāṃ vrajet || 134|| avidyā vilayaṃ gacchedīyurbandhā vilopatām | divyarūpo bhavet puṇyaśālisevyo bhavediha || 135|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ pañcacatvāriṃśe vatsare’psarasāṃ mānuṣībhūtānāṃ manorathapūraṇārtham anādiśrībṛhadbrahmanārāyaṇasya rukmavatīśrīsahitasya, ṣaṭcatvāriṃśe vatsare ca maharṣibhyo brahmavidyādidānārtham anādiśrīgurunārāyaṇasya suvidyāśrīsahitasya, saptacatvāriṃśe vatsare ca haribhaktasya bṛhaddharmanṛpateḥ rājasūyayajñe sarvasvadānottaraṃ sādhvīmahādīkṣārthaṃ prārthitasyānādiśrīmahācāryanārāyaṇasya ācāryāṇīśrīyutasya ca prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 35 ||
<3.36> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ me tataḥ param | vedhaso’rcimārganāmni vatsare cātha kalpake || 1 || saptaṣaṣṭyadhike cāṣṭaśate’tha pañcame manau | rudrakukṣeḥ samudbhūto vidyutsrāvo hi rākṣasaḥ || 2 || saḥ pracakre tapaścograṃ śaṃbhutoṣaṇahetave | sūryacandrāgnitejobhyaścātitejo’bhilabdhaye || 3 || pañcaśateṣu varṣeṣu gateṣu śaṃkaraḥ svayam | tutoṣa parayā prītyā varārthaṃ cānvarodhayat || 4 || so’pi vavre varaṃ sūryacandrāgnitejasāṃ param | tejo me syād yatheṣṭaṃ vai devādyanāśyameva ca || 5 || tathāstviti haraḥ prāha varaṃ labdhvātimodavān | tapastyaktvojjvalo bhūtvā svargaṃ cāyāti yāti ca || 6 || apsaraso mumuhuśca devyo’pi mohamāgatāḥ | cañcalāstaṃ vīkṣya cānududruvurvāritāḥ suraiḥ || 7 || devānāṃ svargaloke vai kleśo’yaṃ nūtano’bhavat | daityo’pi rākṣasarūpaṃ pragṛhya devatojjvalaḥ || 8 || devābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyaḥ svargāt svargaṃ prayāti ca | mohayatyeva devīśca kalahaṃ janayatyapi || 9 || sūryādhikaḥ surūpaśca sutejāḥ suprabhādharaḥ | bhūtvā sūryaṃ samabhyeti tiraskaroti bhāskaram || 3.36.10 || candraṃ vahniṃ samabhyeti tiraskaroti tejasā | vaḍavāgniṃ samabhyeti grahānabhyeti vai tathā || 11 || pātālādau maṇidhrām̐ścābhyeti tiraskaroti ca | mahājale tale cāpi sāmudre maṇiyādasām || 1 2|| prakāśān vai tiraskṛtya garvaṃ svīyaṃ karoti saḥ | sarvarūpadharo daityo jñātvā balaṃ nijaṃ mahat || 13 || iyeṣa rājā bhavituṃ yayau kuberapattanam | yuyudhe’ti kubereṇa cātmasāt kṛtavān purīm || 14|| tato vahniṃ yayau yuddhe jigāya svavaśaṃ nyadhāt | candraṃ jetuṃ yayau cāpi so’pi tadvaśago’bhavat || 15|| sūryaṃ jetumiyeṣāpi yuddhārthaṃ prayayau ravim | yuyudhe caturo māsān vidyutsrāvo mahāsuraḥ || 16|| parājayaṃ na cāpnoti śramaṃ yāti na vai manāka | vidyutaḥ prakaṭīkṛtya lokān dagdhān karoti ca || 17|| sūryādadhikatejobhirdahatyetajjagattrayam | hāhākārastadā jātaḥ sūryaḥ khinnaḥ śuśoca ha || 18|| sasmāra paramaṃ brahma parameśaṃ sanātanam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ puruṣottamam || 1 9|| saśrīko’haṃ samāyātaḥ sūryarakṣākaraḥ prabhuḥ | hiraṇmayaḥ pareśo vai sarvatejo’straśastravān ||3.36.20|| īśanīsaṃjñayā sarvaśaktimatyā tvayā saha | lakṣmi | sūryakṛtasvārhapūjāgatādisatkriyaḥ ||21 || sudarśanena cakreṇāśātayaṃ cāsuraṃ hi tam | vidyutsrāvo vināśaṃ ca prāpaccābdhau papāta saḥ || 22|| jagatsu tasya visṛṣṭān vahnīnaśāmayaṃ tvaham | tadā devarṣigandharvagrahamānavakoṭibhiḥ ||23|| saṃstuto’haṃ sarvabhūṣu paryaṭanaṃ cakāra vai | sūrye hiraṇmayaścāhaṃ hiraṇyakeśavān hariḥ ||24|| candre rājatadeho’haṃ kūpyakeśaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ | vahnau prabhojjvaladehaḥ prabhāśmaśrurbhavāmyaham ||25|| bhūtale tu tvayā sākaṃ mānavairabhiyācitaḥ | anādiśrīmahāvidyunnārāyaṇo’bhavaṃ tadā ||26|| vaidyutīśrīyutaścāhaṃ loke’tra mānave’vasam | manvantaraṃ tu kālaṃ vai mānavānāṃ hi muktaye ||27|| smara lakṣmi ca me te ca prākaṭyaṃ vai tathoditam | anyāstathāvatārā me jātā vai bahavo bhuvi ||28|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya duḥkhahānirbhavediha | bhuktiścātra bhavettvante muktirme śāśvate pade ||29|| atha te’nyacca me vacmi prākaṭyaṃ śṛṇu sundari | vedhaso’bdhimathanākhye vatsare ca navādhike ||3.36.3 0|| catvāriṃśe’tha dvipañcāśadūrdhve kalpake śate | tṛtīye ca manau lakṣmi loke’bhavaṃ tvayā saha ||3 1 || rasātalasya daityasya rasabhakṣasya vai sutaḥ | madhubhakṣo’bhavad daityo balavān tapasā purā ||32|| sa tu tepe tapastīvraṃ sundarākhye girau tadā | śaṃkaraṃ tapasārādhya varaṃ vavre hi śaṃkarāt ||33|| rasān bhoktuṃ madhūn bhoktuṃ śaktirme vipulā bhavet | yathā yathā bhakṣayāmi tathā tathā ca pācanam ||34|| bhavedeva na cājīrṇaṃ bhavenme vai kadācana | aruciścāpi me na syātpuṣṭirbalaṃ mahad bhavet ||35|| śrutvaivaṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha cāhatvauṣadhipādapān | rasān madhūn bhuṃkṣva kā cānyathā maraṇaṃ tava ||36 || ityevaṃ varadānaṃ vai datvādṛśyo haro’bhavat | madhubhakṣo’suraścāpi sundarādrau drumādiṣu ||37|| praviśya māyayā sarvān madhūn cūṣati cāntarān | patrapuṣpādikasthān sa madhūn cūṣati sarvaśaḥ ||38|| phalāni naiva jāyante śuṣyanti ca dalānyapi |
