navāṃkurāṇi sarvāṇi nārohanti tataḥ param ||39|| mūlarasaṃ stambarasaṃ sthāṇurasaṃ tataḥ param | skandharasaṃ ca śākhānāṃ rasān bhuṃkte samastakān ||3.36.40 || upaśākhārasām̐ścāpi patrarasān sa cūṣati | puṣparasān phalarasān cūṣatyeva samastakān ||41|| vṛkṣebhyaścāpi valībhyaḥ stambebhyastṛṇamūlataḥ | kandebhyaśca śalākābhyo rasān bhuṃkte samastakān ||42|| māyayā śatarūpaśca sahasrāyutarūpavān | koṭyarbudābjarūpaśca bhūtvā bhūtvātikhādati ||43|| yathā yathā rasān bhuṃkte pacanti sarvaśaśca te | puṣṭo bhavati balavām̐śca samartho bhojane’dhikaḥ ||44|| māyayā cāyatavapuḥ parvateṣu vaneṣu ca | araṇyeṣu mahodyāneṣvapi saudhadrumeṣu ca ||45|| vāṭikāsu kṛṣisasyeṣvapi sarveṣu śākhiṣu | aṃkureṣu tathāmeṣu pakvāpakveṣu sarvathā ||46|| madhūn rasān sadā bhuṃkte karoti śuṣkaśākhinaḥ | śuṣkāyante hyaraṇyāni kṣetrāṇi ca vanāni ca ||47|| prajābhiśca paśubhiśca pakṣibhirjantubhistathā | prāṇibhirnaiva cāpyante rasāśca madhavo’pi ca ||48|| kṣudhābhiḥ pīḍitā sarve mriyante’kālamṛtyavaḥ | avagrāhaṃ vinā jātaṃ durbhikṣaṃ prāṇanāśakam ||49|| mānavānāṃ ca lokeṣu pātālebhyaḥ samāyayau | mahāsuraḥ pṛthivīsthānacūṣad drulatātarūn ||3.36.50|| pārthivān sārvabhaumām̐śca vallītṛṇādipādapān | cakre sarvāṃśca sahasā nīrasān śuṣkavigrahān ||51|| mānavānāṃ bhojanāni devānāṃ bhojanāni ca | praṇaṣṭāni samastāni rasamūlāni sarvathā ||52|| madhūni sarvajātīni pītāni tena rakṣasā | vardhitaḥ sa tu balavān vāyuvad vyāpako’bhavat ||53|| udbhijjeṣu mahāśaktyā vyāpakaḥ so’bhavad varāt | māyayā cāpi daityaḥ saḥ sarvānnakhādako’bhavat ||54|| nirarthakā yato meghā kṛṣirnirarthikā tathā | pṛthvyāḥ rasapradānatvaṃ nirarthakaṃ kṛtaṃ tadā ||55|| bījānāṃ rasaśaktiśca sarvā nirarthikā kṛtā | prajārthaṃ cāsureṇaiva jagat kṣudhāprapīḍitam ||56|| kṛtaṃ tena tato lokāścārādhayan hariṃ ca mām | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||57|| śrutvā tu prārthanāṃ teṣāṃ jñātvāsuropapīḍanam | virasatvaṃ cauṣadhīnāmājagāma bhuvaṃ prati ||58|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmaśārṅgādihetimān svayam | divyarūpo hariḥ so’haṃ yuyudhe tena vai tadā ||59|| sudarśanena cakreṇa madhubhakṣo hato mayā | tvaṃ mayā mādhavī lakṣmīḥ kṛtvā drumeṣu veśitā ||3.36.60|| sarvapādapajātīnāṃ madhurūpā rasātmikā | tvamabhavastadā lakṣmi mādhavīśrīḥ samūrjitā ||6 1 || anādiśrīmadhunārāyaṇaścāhaṃ prajāsvapi | gocaro nyavasaṃ manvantarakālaṃ tvayā saha ||62|| praveśāttavavṛkṣāśca rasānvitāstadābhavan | sarvalokeṣu sarvatra madhuvāhā hi pādapāḥ ||63|| abhavan sindhavaścāpi madhukṣarāśca dhenavaḥ | oṣadhayo madhugarbhā mādhavīvāsitāstadā ||64|| babhūvuḥ pallavitāśca phalitāśca madhupradāḥ | mādhavo’haṃ tadā lakṣmi rasātmakastvayā saha ||65|| avasaṃ cāpi vṛkṣādau mādhavyā parameśvaraḥ | lokā apūjayam̐statra mādhavīmādhavau ca nau ||66|| smara tvaṃ mādhavīrūpaṃ māṃ ca madhurasātmakam | anye’pi ca tadā devā maharṣayaśca māṃ priye ||67|| pupūjuḥ parayā prītyā prāṇadaṃ parameśvaram | etatte kathitaṃ nārāyaṇi prākaṭyameva me ||68|| te’pi rakṣākaraṃ lokaprajānāṃ sarvadehinām | athāpyanyat pravakṣyāmi prākaṭyaṃ te ca me’pi ca ||69|| vedhaso vatsare pañcāśattame nāradābhidhe | aṣṭāśītyūrdhvake catuśśate kalpe’ṣṭame manau ||3.36.70|| tiṣye ca saptatau bhūmau daityāśca dānavāstathā | asurā nāstikā dharmahaṇo’bhavan samastataḥ ||71 || dharmāśca mānavā naṣṭāḥ krauryaṃ pravartitaṃ bahu | māṃsādāścābhavan sarve mlecchavarṇā narāḥ striyaḥ ||72|| pāpātmānaḥ pāpakarāḥ pāpamātraparāyaṇāḥ | sarvādāḥ sarvabhakṣāśca sarvabhoktāra utpathāḥ ||73 || paśūn pakṣigaṇān jantūn bhakṣayanti hi mānavāḥ | mānavān mānavāścāpi bhakṣayantīti kā kathā ||74|| anyeṣāṃ prāṇināṃ lakṣmi hāhākāro’bhavad bhuvi | āraṇyakā hi paśavo bhakṣitā mānavaiḥ khalu ||75|| pakṣiṇo bhakṣitāścāpi milanti na yathā tathā | vanāraṇyānyabhavam̐śca paśupakṣikṣayāṇi vai ||76|| paśupakṣivihīnāni tataste mānavāḥ khalu | grāmyān paśūn pakṣiṇaśca bhakṣayituṃ samārabhan ||77|| mahiṣyaścāvikā ūraṇyaśca sarvāḥ prabhakṣitāḥ | aśvā uṣṭrā gardabhāśca vṛṣabhāścāpi bhakṣitāḥ ||78|| hastinaścāpi gavayā hariṇā vānarā api | ṛkṣāḥ siṃhāḥ śvāpadāśca śvānaśca śūkarādayaḥ ||79|| sarve’pi bhakṣitāḥ krūraiḥ rākṣasairdaityadānavaiḥ | mānavaistādṛśaiḥ sarvairgāvo vatsāśca bhakṣitāḥ ||3.36.80|| dhenavaśca prabhakṣyante māṃsādaiśca yadā kṣitau | tadā rakṣārthamevāhaṃ cāyāmyaprerito’pi san ||8 1 || devā goṣu sthitāḥ sarve tāsāmārādhanāvaśaḥ | devānāṃ duḥkhahantāhaṃ gavāṃ rakṣākaraḥ prabhuḥ ||82|| dharmarakṣākaraścāpi pṛthvyāṃ sākaṃ tvayā priye | tūrṇaṃ cāgatavān sākṣāt sarvaśastradharo hariḥ ||83|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | dhenurakṣānimittaṃ vai samālambya pareśvaraḥ ||84|| sarvarakṣākaro dharmarakṣakaḥ śrīpatiḥ prabhuḥ | kalerdoṣavihantāhaṃ śīghraṃ vai gocaro’bhavam ||85|| ākṣarākhye rathe sthitvā hanyate yatra gauḥ kṣitau | tatsthale vyomamārgeṇa tūrṇaṃ gatvāhanaṃ hi tam ||86|| gohantāraṃ ghātakaṃ ca ghātakānaparānapi | ahanaṃ tatra tatraiva tena ruṣṭāstadagragāḥ ||87|| saṃbhūya māṃ prahantuṃ te cāyayurvai sthale sthale | mlecchaprāyā dānavāśca daityāścāsurakoṭayaḥ ||88|| ahanaṃ tān saṃgare’haṃ bhramitvā sakalāṃ kṣitim | koṭyarbudā hatā hiṃsrāḥ sāttvikyo mocitāḥ prajāḥ ||89|| mama vāyuprasaṃgena śiṣṭāśca sattvino’bhavan | gavāṃ rakṣā kṛtā viprarakṣā rakṣā satāṃ tathā ||3.36.90|| dharmarakṣā kṛtā cāpi devāḥ santoṣitā mayā | satyadharmāḥ sthāpitāśca mlecchā nṛpā vihiṃsitāḥ ||91 || ahiṃsā sthāpitā cāpyupāsanā mama cāhitā | devānāṃ pūjanārthaṃ ca sarvaṃ saṃsthāpitaṃ punaḥ ||92|| sevādharmo dayādharmaḥ sthāpitaśca mayā punaḥ | anādiśrīnāthanārāyaṇaḥ pṛthvyāṃ sthiro’bhavam ||93|| anāthānāṃ tu dhenūnāṃ rakṣako nāthanāmadhṛk | tvaṃ ca lakṣmi ghenumatīśrīrnāmnā cābhavastadā ||94|| yugārdhaṃ ca pṛthivyāṃ vai sthitvāhaṃ puruṣottamaḥ | tvayā sākaṃ yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ smara tadā janum||95|| mamaivaṃ tiṣyalokānāṃ śikṣārthaṃ vai punaḥ punaḥ | aṃśāveśakalābhūtyādyavatārā bhavantyapi ||96|| teṣāṃ vai gaṇanā nāsti kāryavaśād bhavanti yat | kāryaṃ niṣpādya līyante mayyeva śivaśaṃbhuje ||97|| kalpe kalpe svayaṃ svecchāvaśo bhaktavaśo’thavā | samāgacchāmi bhūmau vai kṛpayā hitakṛt prabhuḥ ||98|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ puruṣottamaḥ | avatārī parabrahma svayaṃ śrīparameśvaraḥ ||99|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi | yatheṣṭaphalasatprāptirbhavedapīha sarvathā || 3.36.1 00|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso’ṣṭacatvāriṃśe vatsare vidyutsrāvarākṣasasya sūryacandrādivijeturvināśārtham anādiśrīmahāvidyunnārāyaṇasya īśanīśrīsahitasya, navacatvāriṃśe vatsare ca madhubhakṣādidaityanāśārtham anādiśrīmadhunārāyaṇasya mādhavīśrīsahitasya, pañcāśattame vatsare ca gohantṝṇāṃ dharmahantṝṇāṃ tiṣye daityānāṃ nāśārtham anādiśrīnāthanārāyaṇasya dhenumatīśrīsahitasya ca, prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭtriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 36 ||
<3.37> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ me’vatāriṇaḥ | vedhaso vaiṣṇave caikapañcāśattamavatsare || 1 || ādye kalpe cādyamanau kṛte yuge hi vedhasaḥ | āyuṣyārdhotsavaṃ svarṇotsavaṃ devādayo’rjayan || 2 || satyaloke’bhavattatra samājo dyunivāsinām | talavāsāḥ svargavāsā janataponivāsinaḥ || 3 || meruvāsā mānasasthā lokālokanivāsinaḥ | vairājavāsāścaivānye satyalokaṃ samāyayuḥ || 4 || siddhāḥ sādhyā brahmaśīlā brahmacāriṇa āyayuḥ | maharṣayaśca ṛṣayaḥ pitaraśca samāyayuḥ || 5 || lokapālā devapālā lokeśvarāḥ samāyayuḥ | ādityā vasavo rudrā manavo’śvinīputrakau || 6 || indrā grahāśca tārāśca nakṣatrāṇi samāyayuḥ | yakṣāśca cāraṇā yāmyā gandharvāśca samāyayuḥ || 7 || kiṃpuṃsaḥ kinnarāḥ sarpā nāgā rakṣāṃsi cāyayuḥ | kailāsasthāḥ kṣīravāridhisthāścāpi samāyayuḥ || 8 || mānavāśca nadā nadyo vṛkṣā vallyaḥ samāyayuḥ | tīrthāni ṛtavaḥ kālāḥ pakṣādyāśca samāyayuḥ || 9 || yugāśca vatsarāścāpi bhūtatattvāni cāyayuḥ | dharmavaṃśāḥ satīsādhvyo yoginyaśca tathāyayuḥ || 10|| aṇḍajāḥ paśavaścāpi jātismarāḥ samāyayuḥ| sutāśca māgadhāścāpi bandinaḥ paṇḍitā yayuḥ || 11 || vedā rudrāśca rājāno yādāṃsi ca samāyayuḥ | khātākhātasamudrāśca parvatādyāḥ samāyayuḥ || 12 brahmasaraso’psaraso dāsā dāsyaḥ samāyayuḥ | vāhanāni vicitrāṇi śastrāstrāṇi samāyayuḥ || 13|| svarāḥ śāstrāṇi vidyāśca vidyāputryaśca samāyayuḥ | deśāḥ khaṇḍā mūrtimantaḥ svedajāścāpi cāyayuḥ || 14|| manojā dehajā sparśajanyāśca dṛṣṭijā yayuḥ | jaḍāśca cetanāścāpi kāmarūpāḥ samāyayuḥ || 15|| kāmādyāśca vasantādyā gaṇāśca pārṣadā yayuḥ | bhaktā muktā īśvarāśceśānyaścāpi samāyayuḥ || 16|| sarveṣāṃ vai samājo’bhūdasaṃkhyānandasaṃplutaḥ | prātarvai brahmaṇastatrābhiṣekaṃ te pracakrire || 17|| tataḥ śṛṃgāritaṃ cājaṃ pupūjuste vidhānataḥ | bhūdevāḥ svargadevāḥ satyadevā vanadevatāḥ || 18|| sarvajñātipradevāśca pupūjuḥ parameṣṭhinam | āśīrvādān daduścāpi daduścāpyupadāḥ śubhāḥ || 19|| bṛhaspatyādidevānāṃ vācakānāṃ śubhānyapi | brahmaśaṃsīnyabhavam̐śca vyākhyānāni sabhāsthale ||20|| nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ cāpi bahudhā ca tato’bhavat | saṃgītāni vicitrāṇi bhojanāni tathābhavan ||21 || pāritoṣikadānāni śreṣṭhānyapi tadābhavan | atha tatra sudhāpānaṃ cāmṛtānnādibhojanam ||22|| kṛtvā sarve pracakruśca mama bhaktimahotsavam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya bhajanaṃ mama ||23|| parabrahmākṣarātīta pareśa puruṣottama | jaya brahmeśa sarveśa śrīhare parameśvara || 24|| jayāvatāradhartastvaṃ jaya vyūhavibhāvana | jayeśvareśa deveśa jayāntaryāminīśvara |||25|| ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ cakruḥ savādyāḥ sarvadehinaḥ | tato vai tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve brahmādyā māṃ samāhitāḥ || 26|| āgaccha bhagavan bhartaḥ sarvasṛṣṭivibhāvana | parameśa kṛpāṃ kṛtvā no gṛhāṇyadya pāvaya || 27|| avatāreśa dhāmeśa mukteśa yāvadīśvara | nirguṇeśa saguṇeśa no gṛhāṇyadya pāvaya ||28|| tvamāyustvaṃ parā sattā tvaṃ dhiṣṇyaṃ tvaṃ prarājatā | tva prakāśaśca vijñānaṃ tvamicchā tvaṃ prayatnakaḥ || 29|| tvaṃ kriyā tvaṃ viniyogastvaṃ phalaṃ tvaṃ phalapradaḥ | tvaṃ bhoktā tvaṃ bhogyavāsastvaṃ bhogādhisthadevatā ||3.37.30 || tvaṃ cātmā tvaṃ parātmā ca tvaṃ sarvaṃ tvayi sarvakam | sarveṣu tvaṃ mahārāja no gṛhāṇyadya pāvaya ||3 1 || ityarthitastadā lakṣmi tvayā sākaṃ hariḥ svayam | ahaṃ vicārya sahasā satyaloke samāgamam ||32|| gocaro vai sabhāmadhye bhaktānāṃ bhajanakṣaṇe | sarvatejo’bhisampanno divyarūpo mahāprabhuḥ ||33|| vyarājaṃ sarvadevādyarpitasvarṇaśubhāsane | brahmā nanāma ca viṣṇuḥ śaṃbhurnanāma māṃ tataḥ ||34|| surādyāśca samānarcurmāṃ pracakruśca daṇḍavat | tvāṃ tathā mānayāmāsuḥ sāvitryādyāḥ satīstriyaḥ ||35|| āvābhyāṃ cāśiṣā brahmā vardhito’dbhiḥ praṣecitaḥ | brahmādyāśca tato nau vai naivedyaṃ bhojanaṃ śubham ||36|| ārpayan tāmbūlakādi jalaṃ cāmṛtamityapi | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakruḥ prārthayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||37|| kṛpayā pāvitāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa pareśvara | diṣṭā te darśanaṃ labdhaṃ sarveśvarasya vai prabho ||38|| anugraheṇa te caitad brahmāṇḍaṃ puṇyatāṃ gatam | ,pāvano’dya samājaśca divasaśca vayaṃ hyapi ||39|| yathā kṛtvā kṛpāṃ dattaṃ darśanaṃ satyalokake | tathā kṛtvā kṛpāṃ dehi darśanaṃ sarvalokake ||3.37.40|| vasa satye tapasyapi jane mahari bhūtale | atatvādau vasa śīśa parabrahma kṛpāṃ kuru ||41 || ityevamarthitaścāhaṃ tvayā sākaṃ hi padmaje | sarvaistadā tathāstvevaṃ mayā tatra pratiśrutam ||42|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ | puruṣottamaḥ | parabrahma svayaṃ satye jane tapasi bhūtale ||43|| maharloke tathā svarge gamanāya mano dadhe | brahmaṇaścotsavānte vai vidāyaṃ prāpya mānavāḥ ||44|| surā deveśvarāścāpi pitaraśca maharṣayaḥ | ninyurmāṃ svasvalokeṣu nānārūpadharaṃ vibhum ||45|| anādiśrīvibhunārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | vibhvīśrīsahitaṃ cāhaṃ bhūtalādau tadāvasam ||46|| ekamanvantaraṃ tatra kṛpayā tatra tatra ca | smara lakṣmi tava me’pi prākaṭyaṃ pārameśvaram ||47|| viṣṇoścāpi ca pañcāśadvarṣānte svarṇakotsave | śvetadvīpe yayau cāpi tvayā sākaṃ tataḥ param ||48|| śaṃbhoścāpi ca pañcāśadvarṣānte svarṇakotsave | kailāse ca yayau cāpi tvayā sākaṃ pareśvari ||49|| brahmā jyeṣṭho madhyamaśca viṣṇuḥ śaṃbhuḥ kaniṣṭhakaḥ | bhrātaraste trayo vairājād dinaikye prajajñire ||3.37.5 0|| ekapañcāśattamasya varṣasyādyadine tataḥ | mahotsaveṣu teṣāṃ vai tatropasthitavānaham ||51|| caturdaśasu lokeṣu madyogānmānasīprajāḥ | pārśanī dārśanī cāpi saṃginī ca prajā tathā ||52|| sarvāstā abhavam̐llakṣmi nārāyaṇyo mamāśritāḥ | vaiṣṇavyaḥ sarvathā jātā manvantareṣu tāstathā ||53 || bhaktānyaḥ satprajāḥ sarvā mama yogena vai tadā | ākalpāntaṃ ca tāḥ sarvā nārāyaṇyo’bhavan prajāḥ ||54|| asaṃkhyā me’vatārāśca te’vatārā hyasaṃkhyakāḥ | smara tān śri tvayā sākaṃ jānāmyahaṃ yathāyatham ||55|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ te ye prākaṭyaṃ paramottamam | athānyatte kathayāmi vedhasaḥ somavatsare ||56|| dvāpañcāśattame ṣaṣṭikalpe caturthake manau | brahmaikadā sabhāyāṃ svaputrānṛṣīṃśca devatāḥ ||57|| pitṝnupādideśāpi karmakāṇḍān sukhapradān | dhyānaṃ kuruta prātarvai snānaṃ kuruta vai tataḥ | pūjāṃ kuruta devānāṃ brahmāṃśānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||58|| vaiśvadevaṃ ca kuruta naivedyaṃ kurutāpi ca | atitheyādiyajñām̐śca kuruta vyāvahārikam ||59|| sandhyāṃ ca vandanaṃ bhaktiṃ śravaṇaṃ kīrtanādikam | kurutāpi ca viśrāntiṃ nidrāṃ śuddhiṃ ca bhojanam ||3.37.6 0 || daivaṃ paitryaṃ puṇyakāryaṃ dānaṃ kuruta sevanam | satāṃ sevāṃ ca satsaṃgaṃ dharmaṃ kuruta satkriyām ||6 1|| dārān putrān duhitṝśca patiṃ sambandhibāndhavān | poṣayata paśūn gāśca pakṣiṇo jantudehinaḥ ||62|| paropakāraṃ kuruta gṛhāṇi vāṭikāstathā | kṣetrāṇi sasyajātāni poṣayata samāśritān ||63|| dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ copārjayata yathocitān | sukhaṃ svargaṃ labhadhvaṃ ca punaḥ punardine dine ||64|| sṛṣṭipravāhaṃ kuruta cākhaṇḍitaṃ hi putrakāḥ | kalpānte satyalokaṃ vai samāyāta tataḥ punaḥ ||65|| kalpāraṃbhe saṃbhavata mahārṣayaḥ surāḥ punaḥ | pitaraśca lokapālāḥ sṛṣṭisañcālanārthakāḥ ||66|| śrutvaiva brahmaṇaḥ putrā ye cāsan siddhayoginaḥ | brahmaśīlā brahmavratāste papracchuḥ pitāmaham ||67|| ruciryeṣāṃ na vai tatra teṣāṃ karma pitāmaha | yadyuktaṃ vāparaṃ cāste pṛthak kṛtvā prabodhaya ||68|| śrutvaivamāha vedhāstān karma dvedhā bhavediha | pravṛttaṃ ca nivṛttaṃ ca phalaṃ dvedhāpi vai tayoḥ ||69|| uktaṃ sarvaṃ pravṛttaṃ tad dāraputradhanādijam | rāgadveṣādiyuktaṃ ca kāmakrodhādisaṃbhṛtam ||3.37.70 || vāsanāmohayuktaṃ ca sambandhaṃ gṛhalobhajam | atyāgo yatra dārāṇāṃ tayā lokaiṣaṇākṛtām ||71 || dvandvānāṃ sukhaduḥkhānāṃ janmamaraṇayostathā | āvarttānāṃ na vai tyāgo saṃsārānto na yatra ca ||72|| punarāvartanaṃ yatra jarāmṛtyusamanvitam | viṣayecchāsamāvāptirbhogatṛṣṇāmayaṃ tathā ||73|| śītoṣṇādisusaṃyuktaṃ śokodvegādiyojitam | utsavānutsavākrāntaṃ vaṃśavistāralambitam ||74|| pravṛttaṃ sarvamevaitanmayoktaṃ sṛṣṭihetukam | pūrve saptarṣayaścāpi tathā daśa maharṣayaḥ ||75|| prajāpatayo manavaḥ kṛtvā pravṛttikarma tat | punarāvṛttirūpāṇi śmaśānāni hi bhejire ||76|| rāgadveṣayutaṃ śokodvegaduḥkhādisaṃbhṛtam | aśuddhikarmamithunaṃ yadgṛhe tacchmaśānakam ||77|| tāpatrayodbhavo yatra puṇyāpuṇyodayastathā | iṣaṇātrayasambandhastadgṛhaṃ vai śmaśānakam ||78|| mriyante cāpi ca pretā jāyante yatra duḥkhinaḥ | garbhavāsāśca sūyante tadgṛhaṃ vai śmaśānakam ||79|| aśuddhadehayoryogo yatra vai kāmito’sti tat | mṛtānāṃ maraṇāyaiva janmagṛhaṃ śmaśānakam ||3.37.80|| saṃsāraḥ sarva evāsti śmaśānaṃ vai pravartakam | tato bhinnaṃ tu yatkarma nivṛttiḥ sā tu mokṣadā ||81|| yatra dāragraho nāsti nāsti kāmasya vāsanā | rāgadveṣau kāmaroṣau gṛhalobho na yatra ca ||82|| moho nāsti neṣaṇā ca dvandvāni santi yatra na | sā sthitiḥ brahmaśālāsti brahmavidyāpradāyinī |||83|| brahmacaryaṃ yatra cāsti brahmārpaṇaṃ ca yatra vai | viṣayecchālayaścāpi bhogatṛṣṇālayastathā ||84|| ātmatṛptiścātmaratiḥ parabrahmaprasaṃgitā | śokodvegoṣṇaśītādisparśāpi yatra nāsti vai ||85|| brahmotsavaḥ sadā yatrācyutagotratvamityapi | satāṃ satsaṃga evāpi brahmārpaṇaparasthitiḥ ||86|| nivṛttaṃ taddharau premabhaktyātmakaṃ hi karma yat | sarvaṃ mokṣapradaṃ tadvai samanuṣṭhāya sādhavaḥ ||87|| sannyāsinastathā siddhā yatayaścordhvaretasaḥ | brahmaśīlā brahmaparā satyaḥ sādhvyastathāvidhāḥ ||88|| tyāgamārgāśritāḥ pūrve dhruvasvargāṇi bhejire | yanna duḥkhādisaṃbhinnaṃ na ca grastaṃ tathottare ||89|| apunarāvṛtti sukhaṃ cāhataṃ svargamuttamam | tatsvargaṃ śrībhāgavatāḥ pūrve vai pratipedire || 3.37.90|| bhagavantaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | parabrahmākṣarātītaṃ bhajitvā puruṣottamam ||91 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sarvāvatāriṇam | bhajitvā śrīpatiṃ muktapatiṃ dhāma prapedire ||92|| tatsevāṃ tadbhajanaṃ ca taddarśanaṃ taddāsyakam | tadarcanaṃ ca tatsakhyaṃ tasmai cātmanivedanam ||93|| tadyogaṃ tatra sarvasvaṃ samarpya dhāma pedire | akṣaraṃ paramaṃ dhāma parāmuktisthalaṃ dhruvam ||94|| śāśvatānandasandohaṃ nivṛttāstat prapedire | puruṣottamayogena dhāmottamaṃ prapedire ||95|| bhavantaḥ sādhavaḥ siddhā brahmadharmaparāyaṇāḥ | nivṛttikarma sampādya prayāntu paramākṣaram ||96|| ityuktāste yatayo vai santuṣṭāścanivartanam | sarvārpaṇaṃ ca bhajanaṃ kṛtvāptāḥ kṛtakṛtyatām ||97|| brahmā cātha tato’pyāhobhayān ṛṣīn yatīn punaḥ | pravṛttaṃ vā nivṛttaṃ vā brahmārpaṇaṃ nivartanam ||98|| daihyaṃ vā daihikotthaṃ vā karmobhayaṃ kṛtaṃ hyapi | parameśe ca sarveśe pratyakṣe’rpitameva cet ||99|| nivṛttaṃ tat prajāyeta mokṣadaṃ hariyogataḥ | analasyātivegena sarvaṃ bhasmībhaved yathā || 3.37.100 || hareḥ sākṣāt suyogena sarvaṃ bhasmībhavettathā | śrutvaivaṃ harṣitāścāpi karmaṭhāḥ ṛṣayo hyati || 10 1|| nivṛttā harṣitāścāpi sarve papracchureva tam | pitāmahaṃ praṇamyaiva smṛtvā śrīpuruṣottam || 1 02|| hareḥ sākṣādatra loke yogo bhavet kathaṃ hi naḥ | yenārpaṇātmikāṃ sevāṃ kurmo darśaya tadvidhim || 1 03|| kṛtvāpi pravṛttikarma cārpaṇena ca gocare | harau prāpsyāma ūrdhvordhvaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ yataḥ || 1 04|| brahmovāca tadā lakṣmi tān sarvān tvarita vacaḥ | satraṃ kurvantu cātraivārādhanātmakameva ha || 105|| tenākṛṣṭo haristūrṇaṃ bhaktyadhīno bhaviṣyati | āgamiṣyati pratyakṣaḥ sevāṃ vaśca grahīṣyati || 1 06|| śrutvaivaṃ sarvadevādyāścobhaye ca pracakrire | nāmasaṃkīrtanasatraṃ satyaloke samāhitāḥ || 1 07|| śrutvāhaṃ tāpasānāṃ vai teṣāṃ bhaktisukīrtanam | āyayau ca tvayā sākaṃ lakṣmi cākṣaradeśataḥ || 1 08|| gocarastatsabhāmadhye nemuste māṃ pareśvaram | pupūjuścārthanāṃ cakrurnityavāsārthameva tu || 109|| ṛṣimadhye satyaloke siddhamadhye tathā punaḥ | pitṛmadhye janaloke mānaveṣu kṣitau tathā || 3.37.11 0|| tathāstvevamahaṃ prāha tvayā sākaṃ sadā sthitaḥ | anādiśrīmokṣanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 11 1|| muktiśrīritināmnā tvaṃ śrīmatī puruṣottamī | avasataṃ sarvalokeṣvanekarūpadhāriṇau || 11 2|| tataste satramāpūrṇaṃ kṛtvā yayurnijān gṛhān | pravṛttāḥ pravṛttimāptā nivṛttiṃ nivṛttā api || 1 13|| madarpaṇena nairguṇyaṃ cāptā dhāma prapedire | anye maharṣayo jātāḥ puṇyātmānaśca tatsthale || 1 14|| evaṃ mayā tvayā sākaṃ prākaṭyaṃ mokṣadaṃ kṛtam | smara manvantarakālaṃ pṛthvyāmāsamahaṃ svayam || 1 15|| evamanye’pyavatārā mama jātāḥ sahasraśaḥ | lakśo’pi ca tān sarvān jānāmyahaṃ na cetare || 1 16|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhed dhruvām | divyāṃ ca sukhasampattimaihikīṃ pāralaukikīm || 1 17|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ ekapañcāśattame vatsare svarṇotsave’nādiśrīviṣṇunārāyaṇasya vibhvīśrīsahitasya, dvāpañcāśattame ca vatsare’nādiśrīmokṣanārāyaṇasya muktiśrīsahitasya, prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 37 ||
<3.38> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tato’jasya gāyatrīvatsare punaḥ | ādye vārāhakalpe ca manau ca prathame mama || 1 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ | idānīṃ vartamānasya śivarājñīśriyā tvayā || 2 || saha me’trāsti vai prākaṭyaṃ kṣetre’kṣarasaṃjñake | aśvapaṭṭasarastīre kuṃkumavāpikāntike || 3 || mahālakṣmīkambharāśrīgṛhe sarvārthapūrite | śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇākhyajanakād vai surāṣṭrake || 4 || koṭyarbudābjakanyānāṃ manaḥpūraṇahetave | dharmasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya kṛpayā tvāgatasya me || 5 || pitrostapobhirugraiścākṛṣṭasyākṣaravāsinaḥ | prākaṭyaṃ me’tra saṃjātaṃ tvaṃ mayātra nijīkṛtā || 6 || koṭyarbudābjakanyābhiḥ sākaṃ nārāyaṇi priye | athāpi saṃbhaviṣyāmi kalpe kalpe punaḥ punaḥ || 7 || tvayaiva sākaṃ kamale kṣetre lomaśavāsite | mamāvatārā bahavo matsyavārāhakacchapāḥ || 8 || kapilasiṃhaturagā haṃsavāmananāradāḥ | vāsudevaharidattātreyaparśudhararṣabhāḥ || 9 || pṛthuyajñakumārādyā vyāsarāmādhirājakāḥ | dhanvantaribuddhakṛṣṇakalkimohanikāstathā || 3.38.1 0|| harikṛṣṇanaranārāyaṇakṛṣṇanarāyaṇāḥ | sahasraśo bhaviṣyanti kāryavaśāt kṣitau divi || 1 1|| yuge yuge’vatārā me vyāsāścāpi yuge yuge | bhaviṣyanti yathādharmasthāpakā dharmabodhakāḥ || 12|| bhaviṣyati śikhāyuktaḥ śvetakṛṣṇāyano muniḥ | śvetavyāsaḥ kathāvaktā saṃhitāyā bhaviṣyati || 13|| avatāro’dya me sādhyo viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | brahmalokanamaskāryo dharmavaktā bhaviṣyati || 14|| evamanye’pi vai vyāsā mamāṃśā dharmabodhakāḥ | satyabhārgavasavitṛvasiṣṭhāruṇisṛṃjayāḥ || 15|| ṛtaṃjayabharadvājatṛṇabindudvipāyanāḥ | prabhurvallabhasaureyadevānīkaṛtaṃbharāḥ || 16|| vāreyakamahāvidyavibhāvasusamāśravāḥ | dhārīṇakasukaukṣeyavārṣadhāravanavratāḥ || 17|| bhaviṣyanti mamāṃśāste vidyāprākaṭyakāriṇaḥ | kāladairghyeṇa saṃkhyātuṃ cānyena naiva śakyate ||18|| koṭiḥ koṭisahasrāṇāmatītā vai svaṃbhuvām | koṭyaḥ koṭisahasrāṇāṃ bhaviṣyanti punaḥ punaḥ ||19|| arthādasaṃkhyāste sarve sṛṣṭipāḥ kālabhakṣaṇāḥ | akālabhakṣaṇā nārāyaṇāḥ śriyo madātmakāḥ ||3.38.20|| nityamuktāstathā yāśca mucyante muktakoṭayaḥ | akālabhakṣāḥ sarve te dhāmadhāmanivāsinaḥ ||21|| ityetat kathitaṃ lakṣmi sarvaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ yathāyatham | avatārī svayaṃ prakāśito’haṃ kathito mayā ||22|| sukhaṃ labha nijaṃ lakṣmi mamāvatāriṇaḥ sadā | athānyaccāpīṣṭatamaṃ paripṛccha narāyaṇi ||23|| śrīśivarājñīśrīruvāca tṛptāhaṃ pūrvarūpāṇi jñātvā kāntamukhānmama | prāṇeśāya namaste’stu pururūpāya śārṅgiṇe ||24|| raudrīramaṇīnāthaśrīdyunārāyaṇa te namaḥ | mairavīdhṛtiyuṅamerunārāyaṇāya te namaḥ ||25|| saurīśātanīyaviṣṇunārāyaṇāya te namaḥ | cāndrīkaumudīśadevanārāyaṇāya te namaḥ ||26|| bhūyasīdakṣiṇāśrīśayañtrayaṇa te namaḥ | vaiṣṇavīśrīśa te brahmanārāyaṇa namo’stu ca ||27|| devavīthīśrīśa ādityanarāyaṇa te namaḥ | ānantīśrīśa te garutmannārāyaṇa te namaḥ ||28|| ārṣīpadmeśa te ārṣanārāyaṇāya te namaḥ | jyotsnāśrīśvara te prājñanārāyaṇa namo’stu te ||29|| śārdūlikāśrīśa vīranārāyaṇāya te namaḥ | sarobhadrāśrīśa bhadranārāyaṇāya te namaḥ ||3.38.30 || sarbhadrāśrīśa harinārāyaṇa namo’stu te | svatantrāśrīpate bījanārāyaṇa namo’stu te ||3 1|| jayālakṣmīpate varanārāyaṇa namo’stu te | sudarśanīśrīśa strīpuṃnārāyaṇa namo’stu te ||32||| jalanārāyaṇīśrīśa jalanrayaṇa te namaḥ | svadhājaśrīśa te śīlanārāyaṇa namo namaḥ ||33|| puṇḍarīkaśrīśa vārdhinārāyaṇa namo’stu te | mākṣikīśrīśa te caturmukhanārāyaṇa namaḥ ||34|| kṛpāvatīśrīśa kṛpanārāyaṇa namo’stu te | ratnanārāyaṇīśrīśa tīrthanrayaṇa te namaḥ ||35|| bhaktiśrīkānta te jīvanārāyaṇa namo namaḥ | ardhaśrīśvara te’rdhaśrīpatinārāyaṇa namaḥ ||36|| ardhordhvaśrīśvara te’rdhapitṛnārāyaṇa namaḥ | pippalaśrīpate plakṣanārāyaṇa ca te namaḥ ||37|| pīṭhikāśrīśa te śālapuṃstvanārāyaṇa namaḥ | vaṭaśrīkānta te śyāmanārāyaṇa namo namaḥ ||38|| rājarājñīśrīśa rājanārāyaṇa ca te namaḥ | naiṣṭhikīśrīśa te brahmacārinrayaṇa te namaḥ ||39|| śivanārāyaṇīśrīśa śivanrayaṇa te namaḥ | stanakīśrīpate svarṇanārāyaṇa ca te namaḥ ||3.38.40|| svāminīśrīpate svāminārāyaṇa ca te namaḥ | nirvāṇīśrīśa sāvananārāyaṇa ca te namaḥ ||41|| sādhvīnārāyaṇīśa te sādhunārāyaṇa namaḥ | kuṃbhikāśrīśa te bhaktanārāyaṇa namo namaḥ ||42|| medhāvatīśrīśa te ca medhanārāyaṇa namaḥ | pārthivīśrīśa te vahninārāyaṇa namo namaḥ ||43|| rasanārāyaṇīśrīśa rasanrayaṇa te namaḥ | sudhākṣiṇīśrīśa cakranārāyaṇa namo’stu te ||44|| vijayāśrīpate satyanārāyaṇa ca te namaḥ | hiraṇyāśrīpate hiraṇyanārāyaṇa te namaḥ ||45|| naiṣkiñcanīśrīśa nairaṃjaninrayaṇa te namaḥ | kalyāṇīśrīpate puṇyanārāyaṇa ca te namaḥ ||46|| rūkmavatīśrīśa bṛhadbrahmanārāyaṇa namaḥ | suvidyāśrīpate gurunārāyaṇa ca te namaḥ ||47|| ācāryāṇīśrīśa ācāryanārāyaṇa te namaḥ | vaidyutīśrīśa te vidyunnārāyaṇa namo namaḥ ||48|| mādhavīśrīpate madhunārāyaṇa ca te namaḥ | dhenumatīśrīśa nāthanārāyaṇa namo’stu te ||49|| viśvīśrīśa vibhunārāyaṇa te ca namo namaḥ | muktiśrīśa te mokṣanārāyaṇa namo namaḥ ||3.38.50|| śivarājñīśrīśa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te namaḥ | lakṣmīnāthaśrīpate te kamalākānta te namaḥ ||51|| padmāpate ramākānta nārāyaṇīśa te namaḥ | indirākānta ca hiraṇmayīprāṇapate nama ||52|| mahālakṣmīpate kṛṣṇāpate īśvarīśa namaḥ | hariṇīkānta parameśvarīpate ca te namaḥ ||53|| dravyāpate ca puruṣottamīpate ca te namaḥ | vaiṣṇavīśa ca sampadrūpādhīśa ca te namaḥ ||54|| bhagavatīśa ca haridāsīśvara ca te namaḥ | haripriyeśa vaikuṇṭhikeśa brāhmīśa te namaḥ ||55|| samṛddhīśvara śālagrāmīkānta ca te namaḥ | dhanatrayodaśīkānta cakriṇīnātha te namaḥ ||56|| padminīsvāmine bindvīpataye te namo namaḥ | abdhijeśāya ca svarṇarūpiṇīkānta te namaḥ ||57|| gośakṛdvāsinīsvāmin brahmahṛtstheśa te namaḥ | dhaneśvarīśvara ṛtaṃbharāya te namo namaḥ ||58|| plakṣavāseśvarīśāya māyeśāya ca te namaḥ | mātṛkeśvara cāmāyeśvara satīśa te namaḥ ||59|| svāminīnātha te brahmaśaktikānta ca te namaḥ | ātmātmikeśāntarātmikeśa rameśa te namaḥ ||3.38.60 || sattvaprakarṣiṇīkānta pañcaleśa ca te namaḥ | cañcadrūpeśvaraśrīvatseśa aindrīśa te namaḥ ||6 1 || jayantīśa ca te maṇḍalātmikeśvara te namaḥ | sarvatobhadrikāsvāmin padmaśileśa te namaḥ ||62|| ākṣarīśa ca prajñeśa śrāṃgārikeśa te namaḥ | bhāgyarūpeśa siddhīśāvatāriṇīpate namaḥ ||63|| śāntānātha pareśāṃśeśvara kaleśa te namaḥ | vibhavīśvara bhūmnīśa dhāminīkānta te namaḥ ||64|| arcāsvāmin jananīśa kāriṇīvara te namaḥ | devīśvarīśvarīśvara muktānikāpate namaḥ ||65|| prapoṣikeśa ca parabrahmapatnīpate namaḥ | anādinīpate mama pate vṛndāpate namaḥ ||66|| tulasīkānta te cāpi bhārgavīpataye namaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnīśa te namaḥ ||67|| annādinīpate vaibhaveśvarīśāya te namaḥ | sampattīśa ca vāsudevīśvara ca te namaḥ ||68|| kārṣṇīsvāmin haṃsikeśa māṇikīkānta te namaḥ | padmāvatīpate rādhāpate gopīpate namaḥ ||69|| pārṣadānīpate padmālayāpate ca te namaḥ | ājānubāhavīśāya yāntrikīśāya te namaḥ ||3.38.70|| saurāṣṭrīśāya te cājanābhīśvarāya te namaḥ | devikāpataye ṣaṣṭhīmanasāpataye namaḥ ||7 1 || dīpāvalīsvāmine te talājāpataye namaḥ | kāmadhenavīkāntāya ārjantīsvāmine namaḥ ||72|| krodhanāsvāmine te ca gahvarāsvāmine namaḥ | sūcīkāntāya ca vanadevīśvarāya te namaḥ ||73|| dāmanīsvāmine kaṃkātālīnāthāya te namaḥ | pitṛkanyāsvāmine te dāsīśvarāya te namaḥ ||74|| rāsātalīsvāmine te vāsantīpataye namaḥ | sālamālīśvara mātṛkeśvarāya ca te namaḥ ||75|| svāstikīnātha nāgeśīśvarāya te namo namaḥ | śāvadīnīsvāmine te aindrajālīśa te namaḥ ||76|| sarasvatīsvāmine te vidyākāntāya te namaḥ | lakṣmaṇīpataye bhūgarbhīyānāthāya te namaḥ ||77|| nāḍikāpataye haimīśvarāya ca mahāvedīśvarāya te namaḥ | khanīśvarāya ca sanātanīśvarāya te namaḥ ||226|| śyāmānāthāya ca sarveśanīśāya ca te namaḥ | tapasvinīsvāmine te gāyikāsvāmine namaḥ |||227||| kalpaputtalikeśāya īśikāsvāmine namaḥ | lājādhipataye preṃkhānāthāya te namo namaḥ |||228||| namaḥ śrīmaṃgalāgaurīsvāmine te namo namaḥ | krodhanāpataye te ca śrīvallīsvāmine namaḥ ||229|| vīrakanyādhipataye raṇacaṇḍīśvarāya ca | garutmatīsvāmine te bhīrulakṣmīśa te namaḥ ||3.38.23 0|| bālāhakīsvāmine te susahāsvāmine namaḥ | kiraṇāsvāmine dyutisvāmine te namo namaḥ ||23 1|| nūtnakumārikāsvāmināthāya te namo namaḥ | śatruñjayīsvāmine te kālalakṣmīśvarāya ca ||232|| śrāvaṇīpataye sāṃvatsarīkāntāya te namaḥ | kālakanyādhipataye vahnijāsvāmine namaḥ ||233|| praitīnāthāya pitrīsvāmine te ca namo namaḥ | darvyādisvāmine rāśikanyākāntāya te namaḥ ||234|| ānandinīsvāmine te mahābrāhmīśa te namaḥ | śāntināthāya ca paradhāmnīśāya ca te namaḥ ||235|| pradhānāpataye cāpi prāhlādīpataye namaḥ | vibhūṣāpataye kalikādyādhipataye namaḥ || 236||| daityānikādhināthāya sunandinībhṛte namaḥ | bhoginīsvāmine mahākālīnāthāya te namaḥ ||237|| kesaripṛṣṭhagābhṛte tapatīsvāmine namaḥ | saudāmnīpataye harijihvādhipataye namaḥ || 238|| dṛṣadvatīprakāntāya kṛttikāsvāmine namaḥ | karañjanilayānāthātmane te ca namo namaḥ ||239|| lohitāyanikānāthātmane te ca namo namaḥ | nāṭyanaṭīsvāmine te nārīśvarāya te namaḥ ||3.38.240|| kathānāthāya ca sañjīvanīnāthāya te namaḥ | rāṇikāpataye’maraputrikāpataye namaḥ ||241||| dhanyeśvarīsvāmine te satīśāsvāmine namaḥ | devānikīsvāmine te kṛṣṇikāsvāmine namaḥ ||242|| kuśānāthāya te’naraṇyasuteśāya te namaḥ | parānāthāya ca hṛcchāyinīnāthāya te namaḥ ||243 || paṭṭakanyāsvāmine te kṛtamālābhṛte namaḥ | mājāmbikādhināthāya jalanārībhṛte namaḥ ||244|| vidyāsnātāsvāmine te suṣumṇāsvāmine namaḥ | iḍānāthāya ca namaḥ piṃgalāpataye namaḥ |||245|| yaśasvinīsvāmine te viśvodarābhṛte namaḥ | payasvinīsvāmine te tejasvinībhṛte namaḥ || 246|| namaḥ purītatpataye gāndhārīpataye namaḥ | arajāsvāmine citrāṃgadānāthāya te namaḥ ||247|| daityanārīpraṇāthāya śvetānāthāya te namaḥ | raktānāthāya ca pītānāthāya te namo namaḥ ||248|| nīlānāthāya ca namo jayaśrīpataye namaḥ | sevādevīśvarāyordhvaretasīpataye namaḥ ||249|| āravīsvāmine’nāthāsvāmine te namo namaḥ | gopadevīsvāmine te merukoṭīśvarāya ca ||3.38.250 || kalpapāvaṭikeśāya kulapūjyābhṛte namaḥ | namaḥ kiśorīsvāmine sukṛtisvāmine namaḥ ||25 1 || rāthītarīsvāmine ca dhāmakanyābhṛte namaḥ | ṛṣipatnīsvāmine te tyāginīsvāmine namaḥ ||252|| manukanyādhipataye bhaktakanyābhṛte namaḥ | surāṇīpataye te cāsurāṇīpataye namaḥ ||253||| dhanālasādhipataye tryaṣṭakārvībhṛte namaḥ | dyumatīpataye te ca sāṃkhyasatīśa te namaḥ ||254|| śīlavatīsvāmine te bhīmāśrīpataye namaḥ | kṛṣṇānāthāya ca tuṃgabhadrānāthāya te namaḥ ||255|| ailavilādhināthāya sahyadvijībhṛte namaḥ | dugdhānāthāya jīvantīsvāmine te namo namaḥ ||256||| mahāmārīsvāmine hrasvabadrīśa te namaḥ | brahmayoṣitpataye te dhīnāthāya te namaḥ ||257|| sunandāpataye namo laviṃgāsvāmine namaḥ | cakravākīsvāmine te mārjārīśāya te namaḥ ||258|| jānakīpataye kāñcanīgaṃgāpataye namaḥ | candrāvatīsvāmine cerāvatīsvāmine namaḥ ||259|| śālāvatīsvāmine te harāṃgikābhṛte namaḥ | mīnakaṃgvadhināthāya brahmaputrībhṛte namaḥ ||3.38.260||| śikṣāṃgāpataye namo mauktikāpataye namaḥ | pannāmīpataye maṇivarṇānāthāya te namaḥ ||261 || nārāyaṇīsvāmine te menakāṃgābhṛte namaḥ | aṃgaśivāṃgikābhṛte lavahitābhṛte namaḥ ||262|| lāṭiśāpataye namaḥ kāniśāpataye namaḥ | māpīṃgāpataye namaḥ sīkyāṃgāpataye namaḥ ||263|| aṃgasvāṃgādhināthāya tārimāpataye namaḥ | aṃgahāsvāmine parṇavarṇānāthāya te namaḥ ||264|| mannāmnisvāmine devavarṇānāthāya te namaḥ | raṃgavarṇāsvāmine te śarabhīpataye namaḥ ||2646|| taralikādhināthāya kumudāsvāmine namaḥ | devavarūthinīśāya śūradevīśvarāya ca ||266|| piśācīśatanāthāya dīkṣitāsvāmine namaḥ | trinetrikādhikāntāya corulāsvāmine namaḥ ||267|| jagatīsvāmine pāṭalikānāthāya te namaḥ | dhvajānāthāya ca yonibhūte tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ ||268|| śilānāthāya ca yaśovatyādisvāmine namaḥ | mekhalāsvāmine cādhidevatāsvāmine namaḥ ||26 9|| prokṣaṇīsvāmine turīdevīnāthāya te namaḥ | bhuvaneśīsvāmine te gaṃgāputrīśa te namaḥ ||3.38.270|| valguprabhṛtināthāya cendirāsvāmine namaḥ | āmrajānyādināthāya vāmadevīsutābhṛte ||271|| amarīsvāmine māsvāmine tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ | nirguṇāpataye sarvāpataye te namo namaḥ ||272|| kāśyapīpataye kuṇḍalinīnāthāya te namaḥ | āpastambādipataye nijākāntāya te namaḥ ||273|| matkuṃjeśāya ca āmajanāyāḥ pataye namaḥ | akāntakāntākāntāya mama kāntāya te namaḥ ||274|| śrīraṃgāyāśokasundarīśrīkāntāya te namaḥ | dvādaśottarasāhasrayugalātmābhidhāya te ||275|| viśiṣṭasvāmine svīyāsvāmine te namo namaḥ | śivarājñīlakṣmīśāya nārāyaṇīśāya namaḥ ||276|| dayājayāramāhaimīmanūrjālāḍakībhṛte | mālatīsuguṇāhaṃsīkastūrīpataye namaḥ ||277|| muktābhuktādhināthāya raktāriktābhṛte namaḥ | smṛtvā sarvāṇi rūpāṇi madyuktāni prabhostava | bhavāmyatīva muditā yugalāni sukhāni ca ||278|| anyānyapi tvasaṃkhyāni smaryante kṛpayā tava | anyānandaṃ samāptāsmi bhūyaḥ kāntāya te namaḥ ||279|| athānyāni caritrāṇi bhaktānāṃ tvadgatātmanām | mokṣārthāni vṛṣārthāni śrotumicchāmi tadrasā ||3.38.280|| etad yugalaśrīkāntastotraṃ nāmasahasrakam | dvādaśottaranāmāḍhyaṃ catuḥpumarthadaṃ param ||28 1|| saubhāgyadaṃ vaṃśadaṃ ca lakṣmīdaṃ sampadāṃ pradam | rājyadaṃ svargadaṃ sarvabhogyadaṃ sveṣṭadaṃ param ||282|| siddhidaṃ puṇyadaṃ mūrtau samādhidaṃ ca pāvanam | pāpahaṃ mṛtyuhaṃ vighnanāśakaṃ duḥkhanāśakam ||283|| divyabhāvapradaṃ parāmuktibhūprāpakaṃ śubham | alabhyadaṃ tathārogyapradaṃ smṛddhipradaṃ sadā ||284|| paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ sarvanāmārthasmaratāṃ tathā | naranārīsamastānāṃ sarvavāñcchāprapūrakam ||285|| sākṣānmanmukhato jātaṃ lakṣmījaṃ śrīpradaṃ hare | lakṣmīrahaṃ stavarūpā stavapātraṃ bhavān patiḥ ||286|| āvayoḥ stāvakānāṃ cāvayostulyatvamastviti | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa namo’ntarātmane ||287|| sarvābhyastava yoṣābhyo namo bhūyo namo namaḥ | vada me’nyacaritrāṇi tvayi snehakarāṇi vai || 288||| puruṣottamabhāvasyodbhāvakāni śubhāni ca | naranārāyaṇādyāste’vatārāḥ santi ye bhuvi ||289|| tava bodhaṃ prakurvanti kayā rītyāvatāriṇaḥ | vada me tat kṛpāsindho yadi lokopakārakam ||3.38.290|| vināvatārivijñānaṃ nopāsanottamā bhavet | tasmāt kathaya me kānta kāntāyai kṛpayā prabho ||29 1 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ tripañcāśattame vatsare’nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya śrīśivarājñīśrīsahitasya prākaṭyaṃ, yugalasya dvādaśottaraśatādhikasāhasranāmastotramityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭātriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 38 ||
<3.39> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi naranārāyaṇīkathām | puruṣottamabodhāḍhyāṃ mamāpārokṣyabodhinīm || 1 || ekadā tu viśālāyāṃ darśanārthaṃ maharṣayaḥ | yayurmama svarūpasya naranārāyaṇasya te || 2 || tatra śrīśaṃkaraścāpi samāyātaḥ satīyutaḥ | sanatkumāraḥ sanakaḥ sanandanaḥ samāyayau || 3 || aṃgirādyā maharṣisattamāḥ svataḥprakāśakāḥ | patnīvrato dvijaścānye lomaśādyāḥ purātanāḥ || 4 || tapaḥsatraṃ cikīrṣanto’paśyan dharmasutaṃ śucim | nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ cāpi mattanuṃ tāpasīṃ śubhām || 5 || prapūjya vidhivat sarve stotraiḥ saṃstūya vaidikaiḥ | praṇemurdaṇḍavat bhaktisaṃyutā yogavittamāḥ || 6 || jagaduste hṛṣṭahṛdo nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ gurum | bhavantamekaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannāḥ puruṣottamam || 7 || nārāyaṇaṃ svayaṃ sākṣāt purāṇaṃ parameśvaram | śreṣṭhaṃ tapo bhavadyogo bhavajjñānaṃ tapaḥ param || 8 || muktidaṃ tat tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ yatra cārādhyate bhavān | tanno brūhi hare kasmādidaṃ pravartate jagat || 9 || ka ātmā kā ca muktirvai saṃsāraḥ ko’sti vai kṛtaḥ | kiṃ tatparataraṃ brahma sarvaṃ no vaktumarhasi || 3.39.10 || iti pṛcchanto munayaḥ prāpaśyan taṃ narāyaṇam | vihāya tāpasaṃ veṣaṃ parabrahma sanātanam || 1 1|| bhrājamānaṃ ca tejobhirmuktamaṇḍalasevitam | akṣarabrahmadhāmasthaṃ saśrīvatsaṃ śriyā vṛtam || 12|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ puruṣottamam | tvayā sākaṃ hasantaṃ svasarvāyudhasamanvitam || 1 3|| dṛṣṭvā śaṃbhvādayaḥ sarve lakṣmi kṣaṇaṃ pramugdhatām | atyānandena magnāste prāpuḥ śrīparameśvare || 14|| atha kṛtvā tirobhāvaṃ divyabhāvasya me tadā | nārāyaṇastāpaso’bhūd yathā badrītale’bhavat || 15|| tataḥ svasthān munīn sarvānāha tatra narāyaṇaḥ | adṛśyaṃ mama rūpaṃ tat parameśvarasaṃjñakam || 16|| yasmānmayi rājate’tra prakāśito narāyaṇaḥ | yaṃ na devā vijānanti yatanto’pi vinā kṛpām || 17|| kṛpayā darśanaṃ prāpya brāhmībhūtā mahattamāḥ | na saṃsāraṃ prapadyante brahmagā brahmavādinaḥ || 18|| vakṣye bhaktimatāmadya tajjñānaṃ brahmavādinām | ātmāyaṃ dehināṃ svacchaḥ śuddhaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 19|| tatra sarvāntaraḥ śrīmadbrahmanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | vartate sa prāṇarūpaḥ so’ntaryāmī pumuttamaḥ ||3.39.20|| asmādakṣaravāsādvai viśvāni ca bhavanti hi | sa māyayā naijatanūḥ karoti vividhāḥ sṛjau ||21 || karmabaddhā hi jīvādyāḥ saṃsaranti punaḥ punaḥ | akarmabaddhamuktāśca prayānti tatparaṃ padam ||22|| yathā prakāśatamasoḥ sambandho nopapadyate | tathā saṃsāraharyośca sambandho nopapadyate ||23|| chāyātapau yathā bhinnau tathā saṃsāraśārṅgiṇau | evamātmā dehināṃ ca bhinnaḥ saṃsārarūpataḥ ||24|| ahaṃ kartā sukhī duḥkhī kṛśaḥ sthūlastu yā matiḥ | sā cāhaṃkārakartṛtvādātmanyāropitā janaiḥ ||25|| tasmādajñānamūlo hi saṃsāraḥ karmabandhanaḥ | ahaṃkārāvivekena karmabandhaṃ karotyayam ||26|| paśyanti ṛṣayo bhaktāḥ paramopāsakā janāḥ | śuddhātmani nije devaṃ śrīpatiṃ parameśvaram ||27|| prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ kālaṃ buddhvātmānaṃ nijaṃ tathā | hariṇā saṃgato yaśca śāśvatānandabhāg hi saḥ ||28|| svātmānamakṣaraṃ brahma nāvabuddhyati ced yadi | anātmanyātmavijñānaṃ duḥkhasaṃsāradāyakam ||29|| rāgadveṣādayo doṣāḥ sarve tvajñānamāśritāḥ | kārayanti hi karmāṇi puṇyāpuṇyāni dehinām ||3.39.30|| tadvaśādeva sarveṣāṃ sarvadehasamudbhavaḥ | tasmād bhāvyaṃ brahmaṇā vai svenātmanā tu sādhubhiḥ ||3 1|| pareśena samaṃ naijaṃ tvaikyaṃ vyāpyaṃ subuddhibhiḥ | yathā tu bhūmasamparkānnākāśo malino bhavet| ||3 2|| tathā tvantaḥkaraṇotthairbhāvairātmā na lipyate | yathā svaprabhayā sūryaḥ prakāśate samantataḥ ||33|| tathā jñānamayaścātmā tadyuktaḥ samprakāśate | jñānarūpastataścāyaṃ cidrūpo bhavavarjitaḥ ||34|| yathā rañjanasānnidhye sphaṭiko rañjano janaiḥ | lakṣyate ca tathā cāyaṃ bhāvasannidhisadguṇaḥ ||35|| so’hamātmākṣaraḥ śuddho nityo bhakto mayāniśam | upāsitavyo mantavyaḥ śrotavyaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||36|| evaṃ jñāne tu sarvatra yadā bhātyasya mādhavaḥ | bhaktasya śraddadhānasya hariḥ sampadyate tadā ||37|| svasmin sarvātmakaṃ brahmaparaṃ bhātyasya vai yadā | tadā pratyakṣarūpaṃ taṃ svātmanyevābhipaśyati ||38|| yadā sarveṣu bhūteṣu pareśaṃ taṃ prapaśyati | tadā sarvatra bhaktasya parabrahma vikāsate ||39|| yadātmastho netaradvai svayaṃ kimapi paśyati | tadā pareṇa sambaddhaḥ parameśaṃ prapaśyati ||3.39.40|| yadā hṛdayakāmā vai vilīyante na santi tu | tadāsāvamṛtībhūtaḥ parameśaṃ prapaśyati ||41 || yadā sarvasthitaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prapaśyati | tadā tadyogamāpannastatsvarūpāya kalpate ||42|| yadā paśyati deveśaṃ paramaṃ puruṣaṃ prabhum | māyāmātraṃ gataṃ tasya nāsya brahmātirekitā ||43|| yadā janmajarāduḥkhavyādhīnāmekabheṣajam | svajñānaṃ brahmavijñānaṃ vartate’sau tadā śivaḥ ||44|| yathā nadīnadāḥ sarve samudre yānti vistṛte | tathā bhaktā akṣare brahmaṇi yānti hyupāstibhiḥ ||45|| ajñānamugdhā vijñānaṃ nārjayanti tu yāvatā | ajñānatimirākṛṣṭā na yānti paramaṃ padam ||46|| ātmajñānaṃ vidhātavyaṃ yogo nārāyaṇasya ca | ubhābhyāṃ śrīhariścāsya paramātmā prakāśate ||47|| hareryogātsamagrāṇyaiśvaryāṇyasya bhavanti ca | dehe’traivāthavā dehānte’pi hareḥ svanugrahāt ||48|| yattat sarvamataṃ divyamaiśvaryaṃ tadavāpnuyāt | tadaiśvaryapradātā saḥ sarveṣāṃ parameśvaraḥ ||49|| sarvabhūteṣu sarvātmā sarvasthaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ | sarvarūpaḥ sarvarasaḥ sarvagandho’jaro’maraḥ ||3.39.50 || sarvataḥ pāṇipādaḥ so’ntaryāmī śrīsanātanaḥ | apāṇipādo javano grahītā hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ ||51|| acakṣurapi draṣṭā saḥ cākarṇaśca śṛṇotyapi | vettyayaṃ sarvamevedaṃ na taṃ jānāti kaścana ||52|| parameśaṃ mahānāthaṃ vadanti vimalāśayāḥ | paśyanti ṛṣayo hetuṃ yadaiśvaryamanuttamam ||53|| viditvā tasya sāyujyaṃ labhante tatra veśitāḥ | ye tanmāyāmatikrāntā yā cāste bandharūpiṇī ||54|| te labhante paraṃdhāma nirvāṇaṃ hariṇā saha | prasādāttasya te yānti punarāvṛttimeva na ||55|| etajjñānaṃ putraśiṣyayogibhyo deyameva ha | mokṣadaṃ paramaṃ śāntipradaṃ vai brahmavittamāḥ ||56|| anyaccāpi praśṛṇuta parameśāttato’bhavat | kālākhyaḥ puruṣaścāpi pauruṣī prakṛtistathā ||57|| tābhyāṃ pradhānā puruṣastābhyāṃ hiraṇmayo’pyajā | hiraṇmayī ca tābhyāṃ tu virāḍ vairājiketi ca ||58|| tābhyāṃ tridevatāścāto naranārīmayaṃ jagat | evaṃ hareḥ sarvamidaṃ tasmād brahmamayaṃ jagat ||59|| haristvātmāsti bhūtānāṃ jñātātmā parameśvaraḥ | dvijāḥ śṛṇuta cāthāpi harericchā hyabhūtpurā ||3.39.60|| māyā sā divyarūpāpi jīvakarmānvitā satī | sattvakarmātmikā sattvā rajaḥkarmā tu rājasī ||61|| tamaḥkarmayutā sā ca tāmasī karmarūpiṇī | jīvānāṃ karmaṇāṃ yādṛg rūpaṃ sā tādṛśī janaiḥ ||62|| gīyate raktakācāḍhya tejo raktaṃ yathetivat | vastutaḥ śuddharūpā sā kintu jīvānuveśitā ||63|| karmānusāraphaladā sā māyā triprakāriṇī | mūlā śuddhātha viṣamā karmānusārayāyinī ||64|| mahattattvaṃ ca buddhyākhyaṃ prakāśayati vai tataḥ | mahattattvādahaṃ buddhiścābhimānātmikā tataḥ ||65|| tataḥ ṣoḍaśako gaṇastanmātrendriyamānasaḥ | tanmātrebhyaśca bhūtāni sthūlāni guṇavanti ca ||66|| sthūlebhyastu jāyante tajjagat khalu | jaḍātmakaṃ hyapi vyāptaṃ cetanaiḥ kurute kriyāḥ ||67|| karmānuguṇaṃ saraṇaṃ saṃsāro vāsanāmayaḥ | sāpi kālasya vaśagā hyavivekasamudbhavā ||68|| manaḥsāhāyyamāsādya pravartayati dehinaḥ | tasmānmano niyamyaiva vāsanāṃ kṣapayed budhaḥ ||69|| kālamāyātītarūpo bhūtvā bhajeta mādhavam | nāsti tasmātparaṃ kiṃcit taṃ bhajitvā vimucyate ||3.39.70|| nāyaṃ tapobhirvividhairna dānena na cejyayā | śakyo hi mānavairjñātumṛte bhaktimanuttamām ||7 1 || sa vai samagrabhūtānāmantastiṣṭhati sarvataḥ | taṃ sarvasākṣiṇaṃ jñātvā mucyate sarvabandhanāt ||72|| tasyāntare sarvamidaṃ sa tu sarvāntakaḥ paraḥ | tameva gṛṇanti śāstrāṇi satyekaṃ parameśvaram ||73 || yajanti vividhairyajñairbrāhmaṇāḥ satrakoṭibhiḥ | dhyāyanti taṃ yogijanā bhajante sādhavo’malāḥ ||74|| sarvadevatanuḥ so’yaṃ dhārmikāstamupāsate | tebhyo dadāti tatsthānamānandaṃ paramaṃ padam ||75|| narā nāryo’pi karmasthā bhaktimanto hyakalmaṣāḥ | pūjayanti ca taṃ bhaktyā te prayānti parāṃ gatim ||76|| ityevamṛṣayo buddhvā taṃ pareśaṃ prabhuṃ harim | sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ dhyātvā prayāntu paramaṃ padam ||77|| ityuktvā badarīnāthaḥ śivarāji ṛṣīśvarān | punaśca darśayāmāsa tāpase varṣmaṇi prabhum ||78|| koṭikandarpaśobhāḍhyaṃ śrīsametaṃ parātparam | anekaiśvaryasañjuṣṭaṃ rājādhirājaśobhinam ||79|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakaṃ susundaram | sarvakāntaṃ sarvadivyalāvaṇyamadhutānvitam ||3.39.8 0|| anantamuktamuktānīsevitaṃ pārameśvaram | avatārādibhiścāpi vyūhairnutaṃ stutaṃ tathā ||81 || parabrahmātmakaṃ divyaṃ sarveśvarādisevitam | sarvaśrīsaṃbhṛtaṃ dhāmeśvaraṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||82|| ṛṣayaste hareḥ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā tṛptāḥ sukhānvitāḥ | yāvattapaḥphalaṃ prāptā muditāstuṣṭuvuḥ punaḥ ||83|| tvaṃ prabhustvaṃ parabrahma tvaṃ kṛṣṇastvaṃ narāyaṇaḥ | nārāyaṇaḥ parajyotirbhavānakṣaradhāmavān ||84|| tvaṃ hiraṇmayarūpaśca viṣṇustvaṃ vyāpako bhavān | sarvadevamayastvaṃ ca tāpasastvaṃ pareśvara ||85|| tvā dṛṣṭvā kṛtakṛtyāḥ smastvāṃ prāpya puruṣottamam | māyāpāraṃ gatāḥ smo’dya kṛpā te’sīmamuktidā ||86|| yadicchayā samāyātāścātra pūrṇo manorathaḥ | netaracchiṣyate kāryaṃ kartavyaṃ darśanātparam ||87|| alaukikaṃ paraṃ rūpaṃ sadaivaṃ bhātu naḥ prati | ityevameva vāñcchāmo varaṃ dehi varaṃ hi naḥ ||88|| ityevaṃ śivarājñīśri stutvā maunaṃ ca tasthire | tato divyaṃ parabrahmarūpaṃ tatra tiro’bhavat ||89|| ahaṃ vai tāpaso jātaḥ sadyo nārāyaṇātmakaḥ | badaryadhaḥsthitaste ca pupūjurmāṃ tathāvidham ||3.39.90 || ājñāmādāya ca yayurbhajanto māṃ nijālayān | tvaṃ vijānāhi tadrūpaṃ mama nārāyaṇātmakam ||91 || tāpasaṃ lokarakṣārthaṃ dharmarakṣākaraṃ sadā | naranārāyaṇātmānaṃ cāntaryāmiṇameva mām ||92|| puruṣottamasaṃjñaṃ ca vijānāhi patiṃ tava | etajjñānaṃ samagṛhya śaṃkarādyāstato bhuvi ||93 || upādidiśuḥ ṛṣayo muktiṃ daduśca sarvataḥ | dehibhyo brahmadhānyeva mamopāsanakāriṇaḥ ||94|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccaitatsmaraṇādapi muktidam | sarvānandapradaṃ lakṣmi jñātavyaṃ na yataḥ param ||95|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne badaryāṃ tapo’rthaṃ prāptānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ naranārāyaṇe parabrahmarūpadarśanāt tṛptānāṃ mānavebhyaścopadeśanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 39 ||
<3.40> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca puruṣottamakāntānāṃ dharmakarmāṇi no vada | yena gārhasthyadoṣāṇāṃ saṃbhavo na bhavediha || 1 || bhavānāste parabrahma vayaṃ brāhmyaḥ striyastava | divyatā sarvathā yatra doṣaleśo na vidyate || 2 || tathāpi gṛhadharmāṇāṃ dehināṃ narayoṣitām | dharmalābho bhavet tasmād gṛhadharmān hi no vada || 3 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śṛṇvantu sarvamatpriyāḥ | gṛhadharmān doṣaharān vadāmi śreyasāṃ pradān || 4 || gṛhaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ jñeyaṃ patiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | putrā bodhyāḥ pañcadevāḥ kriyāśca pūjanaṃ mama || 5 || evaṃ yā saṃpravartante nāryo gārhasthyasaṃsthitāḥ | mayi sarvārpaṇabhāvāstāsāṃ dharmaḥ savaiṣṇavaḥ || 6 || dhyāyet patyau hariṃ nityaṃ māṃ patiṃ puruṣottamam | nāryāṃ dhyāyet sadā lakṣmīṃ śrīṃ satīṃ puruṣottamīm || 7 || putreṣu pārṣadān dhyāyet putrīṣu śrīramādikāḥ | vāhaneṣu garuḍādyān muktān vai bāndhavādiṣu || 8 || dhyāyedevaṃ nije dehe śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam | tasmai samarpayet sarvaṃ nijāntaranivāsine || 9 || evaṃ vai karmayogo’yaṃ bhavatīnāmudāhṛtaḥ | naiṣkarmyabhāvanāyukto mokṣado mama bhaktiyuk || 3.40.1 0|| karmayogeṣu sarveṣu tvayaṃ yogo viśiṣyate | hareḥ sevātmako yogaḥ karmaṇā manasā girā || 11 || harireva sadārādhyo nāmajapādibhistathā | pradakṣiṇāṃ prakuryācca pratimāṃ mama pūjayet || 12|| mama prāsādikaṃ bhuñjyānmatpādayormano nyaset | hareragre svanairuccairnṛtyettathā samālapet || 13 || karatālādisandhānaiḥ susvarairgāyanaṃ caret | kathāṃ śṛṇuyāt satataṃ nirmālyaṃ mastake dharet || 14|| arcanīyo namaskāryaḥ sadāhaṃ mokṣadaḥ prabhuḥ | tato’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīkāntamacyutam || 15|| śrīhariṃ māṃ pūjayadhvaṃ prapaśyadhvaṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe | bhaktimatyo harau patyau sarvadā bhavata priyāḥ || 16|| karmayogena satataṃ samārcayata māṃ harim | yajadhvaṃ māṃ hariṃ lakṣmyaḥ snānabhojanasevanaiḥ || 17|| prātarmatpūrvamutthāya suptasya me’ṅgamardanam | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ brahmapriyāḥ kuruta nityaśaḥ || 1 8|| yatheṣṭaṃ māṃ patiṃ devaṃ cānandayata sevayā | āśayā nijadehādiśuddhyarthaṃ yāta vai tataḥ || 19|| māṃ smarantyo hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ snāta matpādavāribhiḥ | mannāmakīrtanaṃ cāpi kurvantyastarpaṇaṃ jalaiḥ ||3.40.20|| añjalibhiḥ prakuruta surān saṃsmṛtya vai pitṝn | namaskuruta vṛddhāṃśca viprān sādhūn satīśca gāḥ ||2 1 || daivavṛkṣām̐śca tīrthāni devān namata sarvadā | snātvā dānāni yogyāni yogyapātrebhya eva tu ||22|| arpayata dhanānnādi vastrabhūṣādyapekṣitam | darśanāni ca devānāṃ vidhāya ca tato gṛham ||23|| samāyāta ca me sevāṃ snānādyaṃgamayīṃ śubhām | prakuruta yathāvadvai snāpayatoṣṇavāribhiḥ ||24|| tailasugandhalepādyairmardayitvā yathocitam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ puruṣottamam ||25|| veṣayata svarṇaraupyatārāmbarādibhistathā | ābhūṣayata bhūṣābhiḥ śṛṃgārayata saddravaiḥ ||26|| sugandhipuṣpahārādyairgandhasārādibhistathā | dhūpadīpādibhirmāṃ ca keśaprasādhanādibhiḥ ||27|| pūjayastvaṃ bhojayadhvaṃ dugdhapāyasabhojanaiḥ | jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ cārpayadhvaṃ premṇā tu me sadā ||28|| mārjayadhvaṃ gṛhasthalīḥ śayyāḥ saṃharatāpi ca | vāryāharata ca tathā caratādohanaṃ gavām ||29|| tarkadadhyādi kuruta vṛddhānarcayatāpi ca | pākādikaṃ prakurudhvaṃ bhojayadhvaṃ ca devatāḥ ||3.40.30|| ṛṣīnatithīn viprāṃśca sādhūn bhojayatāpi ca | gobhyo’rpayata grāsādīn agnibhyo havanādikam ||3 1|| anāthadīnabālādīn bhojayadhvaṃ subhojanam | paropakāraṃ kuruta sūryaṃ namata sarvadā || 32|| abhyāgatān bhojayadhvaṃ kuruta svāgatādikam | śṛṃgārayata dehām̐śca nijān bhūṣādibhiḥ sadā ||33|| bhavatyo matpriyāḥ sarvā madātmikā madarthikāḥ | matprasādamanuprāptā bhavantu bhāvanābharāḥ ||34|| bhuñjantu miṣṭamiṣṭānnaṃ prasannāḥ saṃbhavantu ca | vṛddhājñāṃ sammānayantu jyeṣṭhājñāṃ ca subhāṣitam ||35|| kuladharmāṃśca rakṣantu jñātidharmāṃstathāparān | deśadharmāṃśca gṛhṇantu maddharmān mukhyato’dhikān ||36|| vastrādīnāṃ sadāśuddhiṃ kṣālanādyairmṛdādibhiḥ | prakurvantu sadā lakṣmyo’nusarantu varīyasīḥ | kathāṃ jñānaṃ kalāṃ cāpi kauśalyaṃ vividhaṃ sadā ||37|| adhiyantu sadā lakṣmyaḥ pākādikakalāstathā | mātṛsevāḥ svasṛsevā śvaśrūsevāścarantviti | sapatnīsnehabāhulyaṃ vardhayantu dine dine ||38|| mahīmānān pālayantu satkārayantu bhojanaiḥ | sarvapradānakaiścāpi bhikṣūn sammānayantvapi ||3 9|| sādhūn sādhvīḥ pūjayantu vaiṣṇavāṃśca viśeṣataḥ | ānukūlyena bhogāṃśca bhuñjantu mapi cārpitān ||3.40.40|| sandhyāṃ devīṃ ca gāyatrīṃ japantu mayi yojitām | japaṃ kurvantu mannāmnā smṛtvā māṃ parameśvaram ||41|| gṛhakāryāṇi kurvantu vaiśadyāni śubhāni ca | rakṣantu gṛhavastūni sarvavidhāni cāṃjasā ||42|| nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ suveṣādi vidhāpayantu matkṛte | sevayantu gavādīni govatsādīni bhāvanaiḥ ||43 || śukamenāhaṃsacitragaruḍādīn prapāntu ca | gajavājivṛṣabhādīn prapāntu mahiṣīstathā ||44|| annādiśuddhiṃ kurvantu veṣavārādiśodhanam | pālayantu sūtakādi saṃskurvantu ca vikṛtīḥ ||45|| gṛhaśuddhiṃ prakurvantu poṣayantu kuṭumbinaḥ | yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ vardhayantu bhavantu sahanānvitāḥ ||46 || dayākṣamākṛpāsevāguṇavatyo bhavantu ca | paropakāraśālinyo bhavantu sarvadā priyāḥ ||47|| vibhajya svārthayāyinyo bhavantu nispṛhāstathā | parārthavṛttayaścāpi paramārthaparāyaṇāḥ ||48|| daivapaivyakriyāśraddhāvatyo bhavantu sarvadā | lokasevāparāścāpi śiṣyāsevāparāyaṇāḥ ||49|| prajāsevāparāścāpyāśīrvādādiparāyaṇāḥ | śubhāśayāḥ sadā santu parotkarṣapradāyikāḥ ||3.40.50|| parasmṛddhipramuditāḥ svasmṛddhyarpaṇabhāvanāḥ | aparigrahaśīlāśca bhavantu mayi cārpitāḥ ||5 1 || anyāyavarjitā nyāyamagnāḥ śīlavratānvitāḥ | tṛṣṇāgṛdhnāvihīnāśca rāgadveṣavivarjitāḥ ||52|| dharmavaṃśasamāyuktā adharmānvayavarjitāḥ | nārāyaṇīsvabhāvāśca bhavantu brahmayoṣitaḥ ||53|| māyāvatyo bhavantu svasambandhibāndhavādiṣu | snehilyaśca sadā santu naijakauṭumbikeṣu ca ||54|| aspṛśyadharmacāriṇyo vadhūrītimupāśritāḥ | spṛśyadharmābhicāriṇyo mātṛdharmamupāśritāḥ ||65|| bhavantu ca sadā devyo vṛddhāgre nimnatānvitāḥ | anuccāsanasaṃsthāśca karāñjalisamanvitāḥ ||56|| bhavantu madhurālāpā namrakaṃdharamānasāḥ | dṛṣṭvā svagṛhakāryaṃ cākṛtaṃ tvagre hyupasthitam ||57|| prakurvantu vinā mānaṃ stabdhatāmantarāḥ priyāḥ | parasparaṃ janayantu harṣaṃ sahāyyatāpradam ||58|| sahāyyaṃ cāpi kurvantu sapatnīkāḥ parasparam | parasparaṃ sevayantu keśaprasādhanādibhiḥ ||59|| asvāsthye’nyonyasevādi carantu bhāvabhāvitāḥ | pātrādiśodhanārthaṃ ca dāsīḥ rakṣantu sarvadā ||3.40.60|| dāsīnāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ bhojyāmbaravetanadānakaiḥ | yathāyogyaṃ prakurvantu mānadānādibhāvanaiḥ ||6 1 || rājasvalyaṃ pālayantu śuddhiṃ rakṣantu daihikīm | krodhādidoṣajātām̐śca varjayantu hi duḥkhadān ||62|| sukhanāśakarān lobhādikām̐styajantu sarvathā | mā mārayantu likṣādyāḥ svedajāścāṇḍajā api ||63 || mā hi ghnantu jīvajātān jantun sūkṣmānapi kvacit| | gālayitvā jalaṃ dugdhaṃ rasān pibantu śodhitān ||64|| rogadān mā bhakṣayantu jāḍyālasyakarānapi | cittabhrāmaṇakām̐ścāpi duṣṭagandhādisaṃbhṛtān ||61|| madyaṃ māṃsaṃ vyavāyaṃ ca stainyaṃ kurvantu mā kvacit | asatyaṃ cānṛtaṃ cāpi kāpaṭyaṃ mā carantu vai ||66|| nindanaṃ tvanyahānyarthaṃ mā vadantu kvacit priyāḥ | apriyaṃ kleśadaṃ cāpi krūraṃ vadantu mā kvacit || 67|| saroṣaṃ tu mukhaṃ naijaṃ mā kurvantu kadāpi vai | sahasā mā kvacit kāryaṃ kurvantu tvavicāritam ||68|| ayogyaṃ cāpi mā yāntu pradeśaṃ paramandiram | tyajantu saṃśayāpannaṃ kurvantu niścayorjitam ||69|| aphalaṃ mānutiṣṭhantu vṛthāvādaṃ vṛthākriyām | vṛthānidrāṃ ca mā prakurvantu vṛthāṭanaṃ tathā ||3.40.70 || vṛthāvighnāni keṣāñcinmā kurvantu kadācana | paśucaryāṃ mā carantu maurkhyaṃ tyajantu dūrataḥ ||7 1 || vicāraṃ ca vivekaṃ ca gṛhṇantu śikṣaṇaṃ sukham | ānukūlyena tiṣṭhantu śreṣṭhe pūjye ca sādhuṣu ||72|| abhyāsena mano nityaṃ niyamayantu sarvathā | iṣaṇā duḥkhadā yāśca tāstyajantu samantataḥ ||73 || sukhadā caiṣaṇāḥ nāryaḥ saphalayantu dhārmikīḥ | aviśvāsasthalānāṃ mā viśvāsaṃ prācarantu vai ||74|| anāvaraṇadehāśca mā bhavantu nirambarāḥ | saubhāgyābhūṣaṇahīnā mā bhavantu kadācana ||75|| nātibhogān prakurvantu rogaduḥkhakarān priyān | vratahāniṃ nācarantu lābhaṃ tyajantu naiva ca ||76|| akarmaṇyatāṃ pramādaṃ ca tyajantu dūrataḥ striyaḥ | mārdavaṃ cāpi naipuṇyaṃ samutsāhaṃ carantu ca ||77|| prītiṃ mitho bhāvayantu tyajantu ca durāgraham | haṭhaṃ tyajantu viphalaṃ hānidaṃ duḥkhadaṃ tathā ||78|| tavedaṃ na mamedaṃ vai mamedaṃ na taveti ca | matvā hānikaraṃ naiva kurvantu sve pare’pi ca ||79|| paśyantu nijavat sarvā nārāyaṇasya sevikāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mama yad bhavet ||3.40.80|| tatsarvaṃ cāpi paśyantu naijaṃ naijaṃ svakaṃ yathā | svakameva na pārakyaṃ bhavatyaśca yathā hi tat ||8 1 || pakṣapātaṃ na kurvantu sarvabhogyeṣu vai kvacit | sampatsmṛddhiṃ surakṣantu divyāṃ kṛtvā navāṃ navām ||82|| vyayaṃ kurvantu yogyaṃ ca yatheṣṭaṃ sukhadaṃ tathā | nijajanmadinādau ca dānaṃ kurvantu bhūriśaḥ ||83|| pātivratyaṃ pālayantu patnīvrataidhitaṃ sadā | devārpaṇaṃ prakurvantu vaiśvadevādikārpaṇam ||84|| nagnānnarān kvacinnaivāvalokayantu satstriyaḥ | vivādaṃ ca kaliṃ cāpi śāmayantu parotthitam ||86|| jalavahnyoghaviśvāsaṃ mā kurvantu kadācana | paśūnāṃ tatsamānāṃ ca mā viśvāsaṃ carantu vai ||86|| vañcikānāṃ sahavāsaṃ dhūrtānāṃ cāpi yoṣitām | mā kurvantu nāstikīnāṃ prasaṃgaṃ dviṣṭayoṣitām ||87|| nītikṣatau na kurvantu cātmaghātaṃ vibhedanam | tāḍanaṃ chedanaṃ vāpi cāṃgānāṃ tu vināśanam ||88|| śreyaḥ kurvantu sarveṣāṃ vadhūṭyo jananīdṛśaḥ | ātmahitaṃ prakurvantu patyurhitaṃ sadā tathā ||89|| mālinyaṃ mā prarakṣantu pātre vastre ca varṣmaṇi | oṣadhāni prasevantāṃ pathyāni hitadāni ca ||3.40.90|| samājeṣu yathāyogyaṃ prayāntu maṇḍalānvitāḥ | strīsamāje tvagragaṇyapadārthaṃ prayatantvapi ||91 || agragaṇyaguṇāḍhyāśca bhavantu strījanādiṣu | bālyabhāvān mācarantu vikhelanāni yāni ca ||92|| sukhelanāni gṛhṇantu dyūtaṃ mā svīcarantvapi | atinidrāṃ cātyaśanaṃ varjayantu ca rogakṛt ||93|| sarvavidhāni bhogyāni bhuñjantāṃ tṛptihetave | nyāyopetāni sarvāṇi pañcaviṣayakāṇi ca ||94|| yānavāhanaśibikāvimānāni śubhāni ca | adhiruhya vanoddeśān paśyantu vyomadṛṣṭayaḥ ||95|| jaihvyān rasān samastān vai bhuñjantāṃ ca madarpitān | spārśanāni sakāmāni cānubhavantu vai mayi ||96|| arpayantu samastāni karmāṇi mayi mādhave | nyūnaṃ mattaḥ pragṛhṇantu cāpekṣyaṃ sarvameva tu ||97|| madadhīnā api sarvāḥ svatantrāḥ santu nityaśaḥ | yathāyogyaṃ bahirdṛśo mā bhavantu kadācana ||98|| paragandhasahāścāpi mā bhavantu priyā mama | lajjānvitāḥ sukhinyaśca bhavantu satataṃ śubhā ||99|| brahmadṛśyo divyadṛśyo bhavantu muktakoṭikāḥ | bhūvārivahnivāyvādau śuddhiṃ paśyantu cārtavīm || 3.40.1 00|| evaṃvidhān vṛṣān patnyaḥ priyāścarantu śobhanān | śrāddhadānādisahitān bhaktiyuktān gatipradān || 10 1|| dhanadhānyapradān putraputrīvaṃśapradānapi | āyuḥkīrtipradām̐ścāpi saubhāgyavardhakānapi || 1 02|| tejaḥpradān saumanasyapradānānandadānapi | prasannatāpādakānme bhavantu modavārdhayaḥ || 1 03|| sarvasaukhyānvitāścāpi sarvecchātoṣasaṃgatāḥ | vijayantu sadā sādhvyo mama prāṇapriyāḥ striyaḥ || 1 04|| anyā yā jagati nāryo vartiṣyante yathoditam | ramaṇyaste puṇyabhūmikhanayo devikā matāḥ || 1 05|| svargaṃ tāsāṃ gṛheṣveva mokṣastāsāṃ kareṣvapi | saubhāgyaṃ śāśvataṃ tāsāṃ bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāmanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇopadiṣṭagṛhastrīkartavyatānirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 40 ||
<3.41> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca upavītaṃ rakṣayecca naro nārī samāhitaḥ | sandhyāṃ kurvīta ca named guruvargaṃ sadā vadhūḥ || 1 || upādhyāyaṃ ca pitaraṃ jyeṣṭhabhrātaramityapi | nṛpaṃ mātulaṃ śvaśuraṃ mātāmahapitāmahau || 2 || varṇaśreṣṭhaṃ ca pitṛvyaṃ mātāmahīṃ ca mātaram | pitṛsahodarīṃ gurvīṃ śvaśrūṃ pitāmahīṃ tathā || 3 || dhātrīṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ sapatnīṃ ca bhaginīṃ praṇamed vadhūḥ | anuvartanametāsāṃ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || 4 || prapālayecca tā dṛṣṭvottiṣṭhet samabhivādayet | naitairupaviśet sārdhaṃ vivadennātmakāraṇāt || 5 || jīvitārthamapi dveṣād gurūn naivāpamānayet | udriktāpi gurudveṣakarī vadhūḥ patatyadhaḥ || 6 || bhartā bhrātā tathā vidyāpradātā jananī pitā | pūjanīyā viśeṣeṇa pañca te guravo’gragāḥ || 7 || ātmanaḥ sarvayatnena prāṇatyāgena cāpi vai | teṣāṃ hitaṃ sadā kāryaṃ śvaśrvāśca śvaśurasya ca || 8 || mūtraṃ kṛtvā trirācāmet tathaiva bhojanottaram | malaṃ tyaktvā snānameva samācaret sukhārthakam || 9 || keśānāṃ guptadehasya sparśe prakṣālanaṃ nasaḥ | kartavyaṃ karṇanābhyādeḥ sparśe’pi caraṇaspṛśau || 3.41.1 0|| agnau śmaśāne kāṣṭhe vā śādvale gomaye na ca | jale jīrṇe devagṛhe valmīke jantugartake || 11 || malamūtrādi kuryānna rājamārge tuṣādiṣu | na kṣetre na bile tīrthe nodyāne nagarāśaye || 12|| nityamudyamamagnā syāt sādhvyācāraratā satī | gurvyagre prauḍhapādā na bhaved vadhūḥ kadācana || 1 3|| gurornindā tathā gurvyāḥ parivādo’pi yatra vā | pravartate tatra karṇau pidhātavyau yathānyataḥ || 14|| gantavyaṃ ca tathā sevā kartavyā bhāvanānvitā | prayuñjīta sadā vācaṃ madhurāṃ hitakāriṇīm || 15|| laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ vāpi tathādhyātmikamityapi | ādadīta yato jñānaṃ taṃ na druhyed vadhūjanaḥ || 16 || gurvīvatpratipūjyāśca savarṇā guruyoṣitaḥ | abhyañjanasnāpanādyairgātrasammārdanādibhiḥ ||17|| keśaprasādhanādyaiśca gurvyaḥ sevyā vadhūjanaiḥ | abhivādyā gurupatnī prādhīyīta śrutīstataḥ || 18|| sāvitrīṃ śrīhariṃ nāma vedāntām̐ścātmaśoṣitān | adhīyītābhyasennityaṃ brahmaniṣṭhā samāhitā || 19|| oṃkāramāditaḥ kṛtvā vyāhṛtīśca tataḥ param | tato’dhīyīta mannāma śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||3.41.20|| na jīrṇamalavadvastrā bhaved vadhūṭikā kvacit | sakhyaṃ sakhībhiḥ kuryācca kuryādātmahitaṃ vadhūḥ ||2 1 || vayasaḥ karmaṇo’rthasya śrutasyābhijanasya ca | deśavāgbuddhisārūpyamācarantī gṛhe vaset ||22|| vṛddhairvṛddhābhirutkṛṣṭaṃ sevitaṃ vṛṣameva sā | niṣeveta na teneyaṃ yāntī duṣyati karhicit ||23 || trivargasevikā syācca syācca vibhāgaśālinī | sā gṛhiṇī sadā proktā svargādisatyadhāriṇī ||24|| dharmasyāyatanaṃ yatnāccharīraṃ paripālayet | nahi dehaṃ vinā nārāyaṇo’haṃ prāptigocaraḥ |||25|| na hiṃsyāt sarvabhūtāni nānyāhitaṃ caret kvacit | na devadravyahartrī syād viṣaṃ devasya vai dhanam ||26|| devadrohaṃ na kurvīta gurudrohaṃ tathaiva ca | svāmidrohaṃ na kurvīta śvaśrūdrohaṃ na cācaret ||27|| anṛtād bahubhogācca parapīḍāvidhāpanāt | śāpād rogācca vai dīrghādāyuṣyaṃ nāśameti hi ||28|| na saṃvaset sumūrkhābhiḥ pāpābhiśca kvacid vadhūḥ | sahavāsāt saṃgamādyaiḥ pāpaṃ saṃkramate yataḥ ||29|| na kuryācchuṣkavairāṇi marmabhīndi na coccaret | bahvībhiśca samaṃ kuryānna virodhaṃ vadhūḥ kvacit ||3.41.30|| na devaguruviprāṇāṃ dīyamānaṃ nivārayet | na cātmānaṃ praśaṃsecca nindāṃ cāpi vivarjayet |||3 1 || na pāpaṃ pāpināṃ brūyānmithyādoṣaṃ na cārpayet | nāśnīyāt svāminā sārdhaṃ tvekasthālyāṃ kadācana ||32|| na kuryāt kasyacit pīḍāṃ sutāṃ śiṣyāṃ tu śikṣayet | nātmānaṃ cāvamanyeta dainyaṃ ca varjayet sadā ||33|| na saṃhatābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ kaṇḍūyedātmanaḥ śiraḥ | na gālīḥ saṃvadet kvāpi nāślīlāni vadettathā ||34|| naiva svapyācchūnyagehe nirjane vā parāsane | caityavṛkṣaṃ na vai chindyād gurūnna vañcayet kvacit ||35|| na devāyatane gacched vāmaṃ kṛtvā tu mandiram | na vyādhidūṣitābhiśca saṃsargaṃ racayed vadhūḥ ||36|| na ninded yoginaḥ siddhān vratino vā yatīṃstathā | devān devanivāsām̐śca sādhvīḥ satīśca gurvikāḥ ||37|| rātrau tilasamāyuktaṃ dadhi tyajenna bhakṣayet | nāśnīyāt payasā takraṃ kṛmiduṣṭaṃ vivarjayet ||38|| arthānāmucite pātre dānaṃ dadyāddhi bhūtaye | nityaṃ dadyājjalānnādi kvacid dadyād vratādiṣu ||39|| dadyādapatyavijayaiśvaryārthaṃ cāpi śobhanam | harerme cātiprītyarthaṃ dadyādvai brahmavādiṣu ||3.41.40|| dānenopāsitaṃ pātraṃ tārayatyeva sarvathā | bhaktipūrvaṃ pradātavyaṃ deyapātrapramodakṛt ||41|| bhūmiṃ dadyādikṣuyuktāṃ yavagodhūmaśālinīm | vidyāṃ dadyāttathā dadyāt suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ maṇīn ||42|| hīrakaṃ ratnabhūṣādi dadyād vastrāṇi kambalān | annaṃ śākaṃ ca pātrāṇi pradadyānmadhusarpiṣī ||43|| tilān dadyāt prīyatāṃ me hṛṣīkeśaḥ prabhuḥ patiḥ | evamuktvā yatīn sādhūn sādhvīḥ prapūjya cārpayet ||44|| phalamūlāni pānāni śākāni cauṣadhaṃ tathā | dadyācchatraṃ tathopānad yadiṣṭaṃ syāt samarpayet ||45|| kanyādānaṃ caret sādhvī rūpāḍhyaguṇaśālini | kuline yuni samṛddhe vittapūrṇe nare dṛḍhe ||46|| sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktā dātavyā kanyakā nijā | vikrayo naiva kanyāyāḥ kartavyaḥ śreyasāṃ prahan ||47|| bhūmiṃ gāṃ ca hiraṇyaṃ ca dhanaṃ vastraṃ ca dhānyakam | jāmāturyautakaṃ dattvā sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam ||48|| yautakena vinā dattā dāsītvamupagacchati | atyaśane vidūrasthe vyasanāḍhye’tidurjane ||49|| kulahīne ca mūrkhe ca na dātavyā kadācana | ativṛddhe cātidīne rogiṇi sarvanāśake ||3.41.50|| atikruddhe’pyasantuṣṭe dātavyā na hi kanyakā | kanyādātrī labhet svargaṃ patiṃ ca parameśvaram ||5 1|| kanyādātā labhet patnīṃ paratra varavarṇinīm | kaṇḍanī peṣaṇī cūllī jalakuṃbhī pramārjanī ||52|| pañcasūnā gṛhasthānāṃ naśyanti pañcasanmakhaiḥ | jantubhyaḥ saṃpradadyācca dadyāt pitṛbhya ityapi ||53|| yādobhyaśca tathā dadyād dadyād govṛkṣapatriṣu | devatābhyaḥ pradadyāccātithibhyo’pi yathādhanam |||54|| evaṃ dānena vai doṣā naśyeyurnātra saṃśayaḥ | dānaṃ śuddhiṃ tathā pātraṃ śuddhaṃ tārayati dhruvam ||55|| pāvakaḥ sarvathā medhyo medhyāśca yoṣitaḥ sadā | sādhavaścātimedhyāśca devatāste trayo matāḥ ||56|| surāpī vyādhitā dveṣṭrī na kartavyā vadhūḥ kvacit | virodhena na vai bhāvyaṃ patnyā patyādibhiḥ kvacit ||57|| yatrāvirodho dampatyostrivargastatra varddhate | mṛte jīvati vā patyau yā nānyamupagacchati ||58|| seha kīrtimavāpnoti modate svagṛhe satī | strībhirbhartṛvacaḥ kāryameṣa doṣo na vidyate ||59|| ājñāpitaṃ śubhaṃ cāpyaśubhaṃ kuryādasaṃśayā | bhartṛbhrātṛpitṛjñātiśvaśrūśvaśuradevaraiḥ ||3.41.60|| bandhubhiśca striyaḥ pūjyā bhūṣaṇācchādanāśanaiḥ | saṃyatopaskarā dakṣā hṛṣṭā vyayaparāṅmukhī ||6 1|| śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ kuryāt pādayorvandanaṃ sadā | hitā bharturdivaṃ gacchediha kīrtiravāpya sā ||62|| krīḍāśarīrasaṃskārasamājotsavadarśanam | hāsyaṃ paragṛhe yānaṃ tyajet proṣitabhartṛkā ||63|| patiṃ vinā na tiṣṭheta divā sandhau ca vā niśi | pūjayed vidhinā kāntaṃ ramayed rāmayettathā ||64|| parapākarucirna syādanindyāmantraṇādṛte | vākpāṇipādacāpalyaṃ varjayedvai vadhūjanaḥ ||65|| ācaret sadṛśīṃ vṛttimajihmāmaśaṭhāṃ tathā | daṃbhahetukapāṣaṇḍibakavṛttīśca varjayet ||66|| pādau pratāpayennāgnau na cainamabhilaṃghayet | viruddhaṃ varjayetkarma pretadhūmaṃ vivarjayet ||67|| guruṃ śāstraṃ tathācāryaṃ rājānaṃ strīṃ patiṃ tathā | nākrāmejjananīṃ śvaśrūṃ tacchāyāṃ ca vivarjayet ||68|| varjayetparaśayyādi paradravyāṇi varjayet | rasāsvādavatī bhūtvā nānyaṃ naraṃ samāśrayet ||69|| asnehā na bhavet kvāpi guptacārā ca no bhavet | sauvarṇarājatābjānāṃ śaṃkharajjvādicarmaṇām ||3.41.70|| pātrāṇāmāsanānāṃ ca kāryā śuddhirhi vāriṇā | uṣṇena sruksruvayośca dhānyānāṃ prokṣaṇena ca ||71|| takṣaṇād dāruśṛṃgāderyajñapātrasya mārjanāt | trapusīsakatāmrāṇāṃ kṣārāmlodakavāribhiḥ ||72|| bhasmādbhirlohakāṃsyānāṃ bhūśuddhirmārjanādinā | amedhyāktasya mṛttoyairgandhalepāpakarṣaṇāt ||73|| notsaṃge bhakṣayet bhakṣyān na nagnā ca svapet kvacit | na dantairnakharomāṇi chindyāt suptaṃ na bodhayet ||74|| kudvāreṇa praviśenna bāhubhyāṃ na nadīṃ taret | nāṅgārabhasmakeśādiṣvadhitiṣṭhet kadācana ||75|| yantracūllīpradīpādidīpane kuśalā bhavet | sāvadhānā bhaved vāryāharaṇe’dhvani sarvadā ||76|| kūpasarittaṭākāditīre dhyānavatī bhavet | pādanyāse’pi kṛṣyādau tṛṇādau kuśalā bhavet ||77|| karīṣakāṣṭhaprabhṛtyādāne’pi kuśalā bhavet | koṇe jīrṇe jantumaye sthale’pi kuśalā bhavet ||78|| mārge yāne’pi ca vadhūrnijaṃ kāntaṃ hyanuvrajet | sāvadhānā bhavet pṛṣṭhe yathā nānyabhramā bhavet ||79|| putrāpatyādibālānāṃ rakṣaṇe kuśalā bhavet | pathyāpathyādisaṃjñānā grāhyādau kuśalā bhavet ||3.41.80|| putrān saṃśodhayet sādhvī saṃskārayecchubhairvṛṣaiḥ | upādiśet sukhān dharmāncāstikyaṃ pālayet sadā ||8 1|| snāyājjalena ca vadhūrvarjayitvā śiraḥ sadā | tailasnānaṃ tu śiraso vidadhyānnityameva ha ||82|| udvartanaṃ śubhaṃ snānaṃ jñānasnānaṃ carettathā | brahmacintanakaṃ snānaṃ śodhanaṃ cācaret sadā ||83|| sahasraparamāṃ nityaṃ śatamadhyāṃ daśāvarām | mālikāṃ śruharernāmno japecchāntisthitā vadhūḥ ||84|| pitṝn prapūjayennityaṃ tredhā te pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ | pratyakṣā mānavāścātra devāḥ svargagatāttathā ||85|| anye pretā janmalābhāstrayaste pitaro matāḥ | mātā pitā guruḥ śvaśrūḥ patiḥ pratyakṣagocarāḥ ||86|| candramārko’gnirityete divi sthitā hi devatāḥ | pretabhāvaṃ gatāścānyajanmāno mṛtapūrvajāḥ ||87|| tṛtīyāste praboddhavyāstānnamed gṛhadhāriṇī | candraḥ pitā raviḥ pitāmaho’gniḥ prapitāmahaḥ ||88|| somapaśca barhiṣacca agniṣvāttaśca te kramāt | yajñīyā ājyapā viprāḥ sādhavastān prabhojayet ||89|| cāndrā mātāpitrādyāśca sauryā dvijādayaḥ śubhāḥ | āgnayo’tithayaḥ santaḥ pitaraste’kṣigocarāḥ ||3.41.90|| tān vadhūrbhojayennityaṃ yathāśakti yathādhanam | gavādīn sevayellakṣmīsampatsaubhāgyavāñcchayā ||91 || devatābhyo namaḥ kuryād vṛddhānnityaṃ namettathā | guruṃ namejjapenmālāṃ mama nāmayutāṃ vadhūḥ || 5 2|| japakāle na bhāṣeta smarecchrīpatimacyutam | harerārādhanaṃ puṇyaṃ nityamārādhayeddharim ||93|| nivedayennijātmānaṃ vadhūḥ śrīparamātmani | sandhyāyācchrīhariṃ nityaṃ sarvaśāntipradaṃ patim || 94|| devāyānnaṃ pradadyācca devayajñaḥ sa vai bhavet | mūrtaye vā jale bhūmyāṃ vaiśvadeve’pi cārpayet ||95|| śeṣaṃ gobhyaḥ śvapacebhyaḥ śvabhyo bhūtebhya ārpayet | dīnapatitapakṣibhyo bhūtayajñaḥ sa ucyate ||96|| sādhuṃ vipraṃ satīṃ bālān bhojayet pitṛyajñakaḥ | atithiṃ bhojayet tṛptiṃ kārayet pitṛvat sadā ||97|| abhyāgatān yathāśakti pūjayedatithīn satīḥ | bhikṣāṃ ca bhikṣave dadyāt sādhave brahmacāriṇe ||98|| arthibhyo’pi pradadyācca vadhūrvai lobhavarjitā | mānuṣo’yaṃ yajña ukto mahāśīrvādasādhanam ||99|| mahyaṃ dadyāt sadānnaṃ ca śrīmate paramātmane | brahmavettre pradadyācca brahmayajñaḥ sa vai mataḥ || 3.41.10 0|| sarvathā bhojanakārye karau prakṣālayet satī | śuddhipūrvaṃ pradadyādvai tena tṛpyanti devatāḥ || 101 || bhojanārthaṃ copaviśet pādau prakṣālya vai karau | āpośānakriyāṃ kṛtvā prāṇebhyaḥ prārpya vai tataḥ || 1 02|| praśaṃsāpūrvakaṃ cānnaṃ bhuñjyājjuhuyādātmani | nādyātsūryagrahātpūrvaṃ pratisāyaṃ śaśigrahāt || 1 03|| grahakāle na cāśnīyāt snātvāśnīyāt samarpayet | svārthārthaṃ bhojanaṃ yasyā bhogārthaṃ kāmamaithunam || 1 04|| vṛttyarthaṃ ca kalā yasyāstasyāḥ śūnyāntajīvanam | na dakṣābhimukhī svapyāt paścimābhimukhī na ca || 1 05|| na cākāśe na nagnā vā nānyāsane vadhūḥ satī | saṃsmarecchrīhariṃ māṃ vai sarvakāryeṣu cānvaham || 1 06|| divāniśaṃ smarenmāṃ vai mokṣadaṃ puruṣottamam | yatheṣṭaṃ māṃ praseveta vadhūḥ saṃkocamantarā || 1 07|| etān dharmān sadācārān pālayantī sukhasthitā | pramodate gṛhe nityaṃ sukhādhikyavatī bhavet || 1 08|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya dharmācāraphalaṃ labhet | pālanātpāpanāśaḥ syānmokṣamārgagatirbhavet || 1 09|| tīrthadānavratabhaktiphalaṃ labhet satī vadhūḥ | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca putraputrīrlabhettathā || 3.41.110 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ vadhūṭīdharmasadācārādivarṇananāmaikacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 41 ||
<3.42> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śivarājñīśriyaṃ hariḥ | tato’pi vividhānāhācārān vadāmi te śubhāt || 1 || navānnāni rasavanti dātavyāni sadārthine | navasasyeṣṭirevātra dīrghāyuḥsampradā yataḥ || 2 || sarve’pi mānavā nāryo narāścāpi nave’nnake | sati cāgniṃ viśuddhānnairyajeta parameśvaram || 3 || daghnā miṣṭāmblamadhurāsvādena payasā tathā | miṣṭasārānvitenāpi yajeta parameśvaram || 4 || pāyasānnaiḥ payaḥpākaiḥ kṣīrairyajeta mādhavam | ghṛtena ghṛtapakvena ghṛtāktaiśca śubhānnakaiḥ || 5 || navanītaiḥ śubhaiḥ sadyojātaiḥ śarkarayānvitaiḥ | yajeta paramātmānaṃ dugdhapuṭīprapūritaiḥ || 6 || pūrikāpolikāyuktairguptapuṭakabhojanaiḥ | yajeta māṃ hariṃ lakṣmi yena tṛpto bhavāmi ca || 7 || śarkarābhiśca khaṇḍādyairmadhubhirguḍakaisaraiḥ | sadrasaiścāpi māṃ śītapeyairyajeta sarvathā || 8 || āmraphalairmiṣṭaphalairyajeta drākṣikāphalaiḥ | kadalaiścāmṛtaiścāpi nārīkelādipācanaiḥ || 9 || śītaphalaiḥ rāyaṇaiśca jambūbhiḥ panasaistathā | navacirbhaṭakarkaṭībhiryajeta vadhūrhi mām || 3.42.1 0|| mānāvamānau dvāvetau sadā bodhyo viṣāmṛte | tatsparśābhibhavaṃ prāpya vadhūvargo’vasīdati || 1 1|| tasmād dāsyena bhāvena vartitavyaṃ vadhūjanaiḥ | cakṣuḥpūtaṃ carenmārgaṃ manaḥpūtāṃ caret kriyām || 12|| svāmipūtāṃ caret sevāṃ dharmapūte vadhūrvaset | svāmyājñāṃ pālayennityaṃ cājñābhaṃgaṃ na cācaret || 13|| ājñādharmo hi patnīnāṃ tenecchet siddhimuttamām | kaitavaṃ chadma śāṭhyaṃ ca paiśunyaṃ varjayed vadhūḥ || 14|| atihāsyamavaṣṭaṃbhaṃ līlāṃ svecchāpravartanam | varjayet sarvayatnena gurvīṇāṃ sannidhau vadhūḥ || 15|| tadvākyapratikūlaṃ ca tathāyuktaṃ gurau vacaḥ | na vaded gṛhiṇīvargo hyaniṣṭaṃ na smaret kvacit || 16|| rajasvalāṃ sūtikāṃ ca na spṛśenmalavāhinīm | caturthyāṃ suvadhūrnaiva ratikāryakarī bhavet || 17|| alpāyurvratavidyāḍhyatvādihīnaprasūstadā | yato jāyeta tasmādvai balavadgrahagā bhavet || 18|| saṅgaṃ satībhiḥ kurvīta bhavet sarvārthasādhikā | asatīsaṃgamujjahyāt paratrātra hitaṃ na yat || 19|| varjayet kṣudrasaṃgaṃ ca virodhaṃ svajaneṣu ca | śatrusevāparāsaṃgaṃ duṣṭāyogaṃ ca varjayet ||3.42.20|| uttamābhirhi sāṃgatyaṃ paṇḍitābhiśca satkathām | alubdhābhiśca mitratvaṃ kurvāṇā nāvasīdati ||21 || parasaṃgaṃ parihāsyaṃ cāsthāne narayoṣitoḥ | paraveśmani vāsaṃ ca na kurvīta kadācana || 22|| parāpi hitakartrī ced bāndhavī sā na cetarā | ahito dehajo vyādhirhitamāraṇyakauṣadham || 23|| bāndhavī yā hitā saiva sa pitā yastu poṣakaḥ | tanmitraṃ yatra viśvāsaḥ sa deśo yatra jīvyate ||24|| sa bhṛtyo yo vidhibhṛtyastadbījaṃ yatprarohati | sā bhāryā yā patiniṣṭhā sa putro yaḥ sukhāptaye ||25||| sā jīvati guṇā yasyā dharmo yasyāḥ sā jīvati | guṇadharmavihīnāyā niṣphalaṃ jīvanaṃ yataḥ ||26|| sā bhāryā yā gṛhe dakṣā pratiprāṇā priyaṃvadā | hitā bhaktānukūlā ca sarvasaubhāgyavardhinī || 27|| yasya bhāryā niḥsnehākṣī kapaṭā kalahapriyā | vādapriyānyasaṃsaktā tyaktalajjā vimāninī ||28|| kaśmalā sevayā hīnā sā jarā na jarā jarā | yasya bhāryā samavṛttirguṇajñā cānugāminī ||29|| patibhāgyālpasantuṣṭā priyabhāvā priyaṃkarī | patidharmā patyabhinnā sā priyā na priyā priyā ||3.42.30 || duṣṭā bhāryā śaṭhaṃ mitraṃ bhṛtyaḥ svārthaparāyaṇaḥ | sarpo yatra ca tatra syādvāso mṛtyupradaḥ khalu ||3 1 || aguṇajñaḥ patiḥ kruddhā sapatnī doṣadāyinī | sarvasaṃśayinī vāso yatra tatra na śaṃ bhavet ||32|| tyajantu durjanasaṃgaṃ bhajantu sādhusaṃgatim | kurvantu puṇyamaniśaṃ smarantu māṃ hariṃ patim ||33|| āpadarthe dhanaṃ rakṣed dārān rakṣeddhanādibhiḥ | patiṃ putraṃ satīṃ bhāryāṃ rakṣed dhanādibhiḥ sadā ||34|| tyajedekaṃ kulasyārthe dharmārthaṃ tu kulaṃ tyajet | dharmaṃ tyajecca haryarthe mokṣārthaṃ sarvamutsṛjet ||35|| varaṃ vāso’raṇyadeśe na tu duṣṭe gṛhe kvacit | duścaritaṃ gṛhaṃ kleśaḥ pratyakṣanarakāvubhau || 36|| calatyekena pādena tiṣṭhatyekena dhīmatī | na parīkṣya paraṃ sthānaṃ pūrvamāyatanaṃ tyajet ||37|| tyajeddaśamasadvṛttaṃ vāsaṃ sopadravaṃ tyajet | kṛpaṇaṃ svāminaṃ māyāmayaṃ duṣṭaṃ naraṃ tyajet ||38|| padasthasyaiva mitrāṇi yāni tāni na cāṃjasā | arthapadavihīnasya mitrāṇi sārthakāni vai ||39|| āpadrakṣākaraṃ mitraṃ kṣīṇasampatsu kāminī | durbhikṣādau sahayānā sā bhāryā bhāgyaśālinaḥ ||3.42.40|| drumaṃ kṣīṇaphalaṃ śuṣkaṃ saraḥ patiṃ ca nirdhanam | chāyā matsyā dharmapatnī na tyajanti kadācana ||41 || vihagāḥ sārasāścāpi gaṇikāstān tyajanti vai | svārthavaśāstathā bodhyā viśvasenna tathāvidhān ||42|| lubdhāṃ dravyapradānena śreṣṭhāmañjalinā tathā | mūrkhāṃ chandānuvṛttyā ca yāthātathyena paṇḍitām ||43|| sādhvīṃ prasevayā bālāṃ miṣṭavāṇyā jayed vadhūḥ | sādhvyaśca devatāścāpi tuṣyanti śuddhabhāvanaiḥ ||44|| asatī khādyapānādyaiḥ śaṭhā śāṭhyena tuṣyati | yasyā yādṛksvabhāvaḥ syāt tasyāṃ tathāviśed vadhūḥ ||45|| nadyaśca nakhinaścāpi śṛṃgiṇaḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ | rājakulaṃ ca luñcādo viśvāsārhā na sarvathā ||46|| dravyahāniṃ samudvegaṃ gṛhe duścaritaṃ tathā | avamānaṃ vañcanaṃ ca prakāśayenna vai vadhūḥ ||47|| svāmityāgo hīnasaṃgo vadhūśīlavināśakau | garvī doṣī vyasanī ca lābhanāśakarāstrayaḥ ||48|| yatra mānaṃ na prītirna vidyā śāntirna sauhṛdam | patisneho na vai patnyāṃ tad gṛhaṃ tvanalālayam ||49|| bhayahīnaṃ dhanaṃ tvarjyaṃ bhayahīnaṃ ca sauhṛdam | bhayahīnā tathā prītirnirbhayaḥ svarga eva saḥ ||3.42.50|| dātryā bhāvya na tvadātryā kṣantryā bhāvyaṃ striyā sadā | śīlinyā ca tathā bhāvyaṃ puṇyārjinyā sukhāya ca ||51|| nagnā rūkṣā bhikṣukī ca kṛpaṇā yācanāparā | avastheyamadānasya tasmād dātrī bhaved vadhūḥ ||52|| sañcitaṃ yācitaṃ prāptaṃ satkārye yujyate na cet | caurapārthivapṛthivīhāryaṃ tadvai bhaviṣyati ||53|| kadaryāyā dhanaṃ yāti bhūmitaskararājasu | nāryā daṇḍaḥ pṛthak śayyā patyurdaṇḍo hyasevanam ||54|| durjanā dāsavargāśca paṭahāḥ paśavastathā | tāḍitā mārdavaṃ yānti duṣṭā strī vyasanī naraḥ ||55|| nadyo nāryaḥ samabhāvā vegavatyo’tinimnagāḥ | kūlaṃ kulaṃ pātayanti svacchandagatikā yadi ||56|| na tṛptirasti kāmasya putrasya ca dhanasya ca | sukhasya jīvitasyāpi tāni jitvā bhajeddharim ||57|| śāśvataṃ sādhayed bhāvi devapūjādisādhanaiḥ | aśāśvataṃ viditvaiva tyaktavyaṃ daihikaṃ tu yat ||58|| dhruvamokṣaṃ parityajya cādhruvaṃ yā hi sevate | adhruvaṃ nātmanā sārdhaṃ gamiṣyati cared dhruvam ||59|| havirduṣṭakulād grāhyaṃ bālādapi subhāṣitam | amedhyāt kāñcanaṃ grāhyaṃ mokṣaḥ satpuruṣāttathā ||3.42.60|| sthāneṣveva prayoktavyā bhṛtyā bhūṣāḥ striyo’pi ca | satī nārī sadaśvaśca vīraḥ satyaparo janaḥ ||61|| anapekṣo na sahate kaṣāghātaṃ tathānṛtam | vaibhavena vihīnāpi satī nīcaṃ na sevate ||62|| sakṛdduṣṭaṃ punarmitraṃ na sandhīta kadācana | sandhānāyā bhavenmṛtyurvadhvāstatra viśeṣataḥ ||63|| śatrvapatyaṃ viṣapātraṃ viśvāsapātrameva na | vipatpradaṃ bhavet kāle viparīte samāgate ||64|| sānukūlaṃ yadā daivaṃ sarvamanyannirarthakam | sānukūle na daivaṃ cet kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||65|| dhanārjane vyaye vidyārjane prabhojane ratau | svakāryasādhane tyaktalajjā nārī sukhaṃ labhet ||66|| lajjā rakṣā jalaṃ rājā gururdevālayo nijāḥ | janā yatra na vartante sthitistatra hi duḥkhadā ||67|| sādhujyotirvido jñānī vṛddhaśca melanaṃ mithaḥ | snehaścānnaṃ ca vaidyaśca yatra no tatra no vaset ||68|| svajanān pālayet sādhvī vadhūrannāmbarādibhiḥ | viṣṇuṃ prapūjayennityamāyuḥkīrtibalapradam ||69|| kṣaṇena vibhavo naśyennātmāyattaṃ dhanādikam | kṣaṇaṃ matvā sādhayedvai mokṣaṃ prasevya māṃ satī ||3.42.70|| vyāghrī jarā ca rogo’riḥ prasahyāgacchato hi tau | āyurbhinnaghaṭābhaṃ ca jñātvā mokṣaṃ prasādhayet ||71 || pitṛvatparapuruṣe paradravyeṣu ghāsavat | nijavat sarvabhūteṣu yā paśyati satī hi sā |||72||| dravyavatyāstu mitrāṇi dravyavatyāstu bāndhavāḥ | dravyavatī supūjyā syād dravyavatī hi paṇḍitā ||73|| śāstrahīnā sadāndhā syāt tasmācchāstravatī bhavet | śāstracakṣuṣmatī nārī svārājyasukhamedhate ||74|| yayā santoṣito devaḥ patirdāsyaḥ pratipriyāḥ | kuṭumbanārīvargādyā jitā tena vasundharā ||75|| manastāpaṃ na kurvīta kvāpi vadhūrmahāpadi | samaprajñā vivekāḍhyā sukhaduḥkhasamā bhavet ||76|| paragṛhaṃ na mantavyaṃ patyurgṛhaṃ nijaṃ gṛham | yatpatyustannijaṃ sarvaṃ moditavyaṃ vivekataḥ ||77|| cāpalyād vārayed dṛṣṭiṃ mithyāvākyaṃ ca vārayet | mano nivārayecchāṭhyāt saṃsārāt svāṃ nivārayet ||78|| huṃkāraṃ bhrukuṭīṃ naiva tejayet svajanān prati | sahastrīvargamālokya rañjayet praṇamed vadhūḥ ||79|| udyogaśca vivekaśca dhairyaṃ śaktiḥ suśīlatā | utsāhaśceti ṣaṭ nāryāḥ siddhidāḥ sukhadāḥ sadā ||3.42.80|| mārdavaṃ dāsyabhāvaśca namratā kṣamatā dayā | prasannatā snigdhatā ca sapta vadhvāḥ sukhapradāḥ ||81 || kulaśīlaguṇopetā satyadharmaparāyaṇā | rūpavatī prasannā ca nāryadhyakṣā bhaveddhi sā ||82|| balābalamatijñātrī sainyādhyakṣā bhaveddhi sā | iṅgitākārabhāvajñā pratīhārī bhaved ramā ||83|| medhāvinī ca vācālā satyavratā jitendriyā | bahuśāstrādikuśalā copadeṣṭrī bhaveddhi sā ||84|| buddhimatī paracittalakṣakī tathyavādinī | kulīnā prabhuśaktyāḍhyā nārī dūtī tu sā matā ||85|| samastaniyamajñā yā tarkaśaktisamucchrayā | deśakālādivijñā ca dharmādhyakṣā bhaveddhi sā ||86|| mātṛmātāmahīdakṣā kṛtapākapariśramā | śuddhā śuddhipravijñā ca rasajñā pācikā bhavet ||87|| āyurvedakṛtābhyāsā sarveṣāṃ hitakāriṇī | nidānapaddhatiprajñā bhiṣagvaryā bhaveddhi sā ||88|| vedavedāṅgatattvajñā dhyānahomajapānvitā | hitāśīrvādavaktrī syād gurvī tathā ca śikṣikā ||89|| ācārajñā niyamajñā deśakālādibodhinī | kuśalā caturā syādvai lekhikā pāṭhikā guruḥ ||3.42.90|| dvijihvā kleśadā nārī tathodvegakarī śaṭhā | krūrā ca dāruṇā yā syāt sāpakārakarī matā ||91 || duṣṭā strī parihartavyā vidyayālaṃkṛtāpi tu | durjanī ca vadhūstadvat tyaktavyā vyavahārake ||92|| tulyārthāṃ tulyasāmarthyāṃ marmajñāṃ vyavasāyinīm | śūrāṃ prabhāvayuktāṃ ca yojayed rājyakarmasu ||93|| nirālasyā ca santuṣṭā sukhadā pratibodhikā | sukhaduḥkhasamā dhīrā bhṛtyā sarvatra durlabhā ||94|| kṣāntisatyavihinā ca krūrā śaṭhā ca nindikā | dāṃbhikī gṛdhnabhāvā ca tyaktavyā bhakṣyaluñcikā ||95|| guṇayuktā niyuñjīta gṛhe rājye śubhe sthale | aguṇāṃ mokṣamārge ca dāsye yuñjīta vā priyām ||96|| satībhiḥ satataṃ rāmā hyāsīta saṅgatau tathā | asatībhirna cāsīta maitrīṃ no vidadhīta ca ||97|| paṇḍitābhirvanitābhiḥ satyavratābhirityapi | bandhanasthāpi tiṣṭheta na khalābhiḥ kadācana ||98|| sāvaśeṣāṇi kāryāṇi kartavyāni vadhūjanaiḥ | apūrṇe tu parityakte hāniḥ svasyā prajāyate ||99|| makṣikāvanmadhu grāhyaṃ patyurvadhvā suyoṣitā | avandhyaṃ divasaṃ kuryād bhaktisevādibhiḥ sadā || 3.42.100 || rāgaṃ tyajennītivarjyaṃ snehaṃ kuryād vṛṣānvitam | jñānaṃ kuryādanālasyaṃ yā sā jayejjagattrayam || 10 1|| patyā na vai gṛhaṃ proktaṃ gṛhiṇyā gṛhameva yat | tasmād gṛhaṃ sadā rakṣyaṃ svāminyā pratimā yathā ||1 02|| kartavyametannāriṇāṃ vadhūnāṃ sujñayoṣitām | sarvaṃ matvā nijaṃ sevyaṃ vardhanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ sadācārapradarśanādinirūpaṇanāmā dvācatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 42 ||
<3.43> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ yadāha parameśvaraḥ | śivarājñīśriyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sadācāraṃ punastataḥ || 1 || sādhvīnāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ śīlaṃ patnīnāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ patiḥ | sarvāsāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ lajjā harirbhūṣaṇabhūṣaṇam || 2 || yā na sākṣād bhavellakṣmīrlakṣmītulyāpi naiva yā | yasyā bhāgyaṃ harau lagnaṃ sā vai nārāyaṇī smṛtā || 3 || mātā sākṣād bhavellakṣmīḥ pitā yasyā janārdanaḥ | bhāgyaṃ yasyā harau nāsti sā śocyā harivarjitā || 4 || pūrvakṛtaṃ samagraṃ vai kramād bhuṃkte hi dehavān | garbhaśayyā hi pākārthaṃ karmaṇāṃ brahmaṇā kṛtā || 5 || yasmin vayasi yatkāle yathā yasmād vinirmitam | tat tathāyāti vidhinā noditaṃ nānyathā kvacit || 6 || dattaṃ dānaṃ kṛtā vidyā purā kṛtaṃ hi kāmitam | sarvaṃ tvāyāti kāle vai bhogārthaṃ dehināṃ tviha || 7 || karmalabhyaśarīre’tra santi rogā hyanekaśaḥ | garbhakoṣṭhalikārogaḥ sadā cāste tu yoṣitām || 8 || ato vai śāstragarbhiṇyā buddhyā vicārya bhāminī | sarogāt svaṃ rogaśūnyamātmānaṃ samapādayet || 9 || ātmā yasyāḥ sadā satyaśaucena viśadīkṛtaḥ | sā śuddhā labhate svargaṃ parameśapadaṃ tataḥ || 3.43.10|| bhāvopahṛtahṛdayā tṛṣṇāśvapacīsaṃyutā | na punāti sahasraiśca snānānāṃ tīrthakarmaṇām || 11 || sammāne harṣaṇaṃ nāstyudvego nāsti vimānane | kṣamā śīlaṃ sadā yatra sā sādhvī sadvadhūrmatā || 12|| vālukākoṭisaṃghāto nadyā bhavati nimnagaḥ | karmakoṭisusaṃghāto nāryā bhavati nimnagaḥ || 13|| jalacetanasaṃghāto nadyā bhavati tīragaḥ | śīlacetanasaṃghāto nāryā bhavati pārakṛt || 14|| dūradeśaprasaktānāṃ bhinnakuṭumbayoṣitām | bhaktyātmakaṃ paraṃ karma kṛṣṇe mayi niyojakam || 15|| sakṛduccaritaṃ nāma yayā harīti bhāvataḥ | sādhitaṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāma tayā śāśvatamodanam || 16|| yadīcchecchāśvatīṃ prītiṃ śrīpatau mayi mādhave | anuvṛttiṃ pālayenme sādhanaṃ matparaṃ matam ||17|| sarvabhūteṣu viśvāsaḥ sattvabhāvaḥ svabhāvajaḥ | harau guptā sadā sevā sādhvyā vṛṣo hi sammataḥ || 18|| malināṃ maladantāṃ ca bahvāśinīṃ ca niṣṭhurām | sandhyāyāṃ śāyinīṃ nārīṃ śrīmapi tyajati prabhuḥ || 1 9|| bhūlekhinīṃ tṛṇacchetrīṃ dantāśuddhāṃ malāmbarām | rūkṣakeśīṃ nagnanidrāṃ śrīmapi tyajati prabhuḥ ||3.43.20 || dampatyośca striyoḥ paśvoryantrayorveginostathā | madhyato naiva gantavyaṃ kruddhayoryuddhyatostathā || 21 || ṣaṭkarṇā bhidyate gāthā catuḥkarṇā tu dhāryate | dvikarṇā tu kvacinnaiva prakāśameti vārtikā ||22|| kṣamāyukte jane lokāḥ kalpayanti hi dūṣaṇam | aśaktiṃ balahīnatvaṃ nirmālyamiva phalgutām || 23|| akṛtajñā hyanāryā ca dīrgharoṣā hyanārjavā | caturvidhā hi cāṇḍālī jātyā tato’pi pañcamī ||24|| nave vayasi yā śāntā sā śāntā sarvadā vadhūḥ | dhātukṣaye tu yāvatyaḥ śāntā bhavanti yoṣitaḥ ||25|| dharmo yatra hi sanyāsī tapastīrthārthamudgatam | satyaṃ yātrākaraṃ cāste kāpaṭyaṃ ca gṛhe sthitam ||26|| dāridryaṃ kalahaścāpi bāndhavā iva yadgṛhe | hiṃsā patnīsvarūpā ca tadgṛhaṃ yāmyakoṭarā || 27|| kupatau nirvṛttirnāsti kubhāryāyāṃ na nirvṛttiḥ | kumitre nirbhayatvaṃ na vicāryeti pravartayet ||28|| parānnaṃ ca parasvaṃ ca paraśayyāḥ parastriyaḥ | parapumān parasaudhaḥ śrīvināśakarā hi te ||29|| adhamāḥ kleśarāgā vai sandhirāgāstu madhyamāḥ | uttamā mānarāgāśca vadhyo bhavanti bhinnabhāḥ ||3.43.3 0|| adhamā dhanarāgāśca madhyā mānadhanānugāḥ | uttamā mānamātrasthā vadhvo bhavanti dehinām ||3 1 || virahaścāpamānaṃ ca ṛṇaṃ ca duṣṭasevanam | dāridryaṃ kalahaśceti vināgniṃ dāhakāni ṣaṭ ||32|| asthiraṃ jīvanaṃ dravyaṃ yauvanaṃ ca manastathā | putradārapatayo’pi hariṃ tataḥ sthiraṃ bhajet| || 33|| ahorātramayaḥ kālo harate dehimaṇḍalam | kālakālaṃ hariṃ jñātvāśrayenmāṃ puruṣottamam || 34|| yā nije na gurau bhṛtye patyau dīne dayāvatī | kiṃ tasyā jīvanaṃ loke kākīvad bhogayoṣitaḥ ||35|| yadgṛhe dharmabhaktyādiśūnyaṃ yāpayati kṣaṇam | bhasrāgṛhaṃ hi tadbodhyaṃ śvāsimāsanivāsadam ||36|| svādapramādaviśvāsaiḥ svārthadāridryamānanaiḥ | striyo bhraśyanti tasmāt tāstān kuryurdūrataḥ sadā ||37|| tāvadbhayasya bhetavyaṃ yāvadbhayaṃ hyanāgatam| upasthite bhaye tīvre sthātavyaṃ vai hyabhītavat ||38|| yā dayāṃ na kurute dīne bhṛtye gurau striyām | mitre patyāvanāthe jīvanaṃ tasyāstu kākavat ||3 9|| parādhīnā mṛtā eva svādhīnā jīvanārthikāḥ | paropakārakāriṇyo mṛtā api sajīvanāḥ ||3.43.40|| yathā yathā hi nāryo’tra śāstraśīlā bhavanti ca | tathā tathā sumedhāḥ syurbrahmavādinya ityapi ||41 || yathā yathā ca kalyāṇe kurvanti svamatiṃ tathā | tathā striyo bhavantyeva pūjāpātrāṇi supriyāḥ |||42|| parokṣe kāryahantrī yā pratyakṣe priyavādinī | varjanīyā prayatnena vallīva cendravāruṇī ||43|| durjanāyāḥ prasaṃgena sunāryapi vinaśyati | tasmād vadhvā durjanāyāḥ saṃgastyājyaḥ prayatnataḥ ||44|| manaḥprasannatā yatra maṃgalāni hi tatra vai | nārīprasannatā yatra tatra vāso hi sampadām ||45|| sā strī yā na madaṃ kuryāt sā patnī yā patipriyā | sukhinī sā hyatṛṣṇā yā vadhūḥ sā vaṃśavardhinī ||46 || sādhūnāṃ ca nadīnāṃ ca satīnāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā | mūlānveṣo nātikāryo vadhūnāṃ cauṣadhasya tu ||47|| rājyaśrīḥ kṛtapuṇyāntā śīlaṃ strīsaṃgamāntakam | kulakīrtiḥ strīśīlāntā kulasyāntaḥ striyo’pi ca ||48|| anāyake na varo vāso na vāpi bahunāyake | strīnāyake’pi na varo vāso’pi bālanāyake ||49|| pitradhīnā kumāratve patyadhīnā tu yauvane | putrādhīnā ca vārdhakye satyādhīnā tathāśrame ||3.43.50 || lajjādhīnā vyasane ca daivādhīnā tu sampadi | dānādhīnā tu patnītve yā vadhūḥ sā sukhapradā
