||51|| vandhyāṃ mṛtaprajāṃ strīmātaraṃ cāpriyavādinīm | aputradāṃ prarakṣyaiva putrārthaṃ tvaparāṃ vahet ||52|| arthahīnā bhiyā yuktā kāntādhīnā hi vartate | arthapūrṇā nirbhayāpi kāntādhīnā hi śasyate ||53|| arthāturāyā dharmo na kāmukāyā bhayaṃ na ca | cintāturāyāḥ saukhyaṃ na vadhūstāni vivarjayet ||54|| preṣyāyāśca daridrāyāḥ puṃścalyāśca sukhaṃ kutaḥ | ṛṇavatyā vyādhitāyā vandhyāyāśca sukhaṃ kutaḥ ||55||| sthānasthitāyāḥ padmāyā mitre varuṇabhāskarau | sthānacyutāyāstasyāstau kleśaśoṣaṇakārakau ||56|| sthāne sthitāḥ supūjyante nāryo’pi bālakā api | sthānabhraṣṭā na pūjyante keśā dantā nakhā nṛpāḥ ||57|| anṛṇāyāḥ sukhā nidrā nirbhayāyāḥ sukhā tathā | avyādhyāśca sukhā nidrā sannayāsinyāḥ sukhā tathā ||58|| asaṃgatāyāḥ puṃsā ca saṃgatāyāśca śārṅgiṇā | vitṛṣṇāyāḥ sukhā nidrā vadhvā vāpyanyayoṣitām ||59|| jalayogena kamalaṃ samucchrāyaṃ labhed yathā | balavatsvāminā bhāryā mahatpadaṃ labhettathā ||3.43.6 0|| ācāreṇa kulasyātra deśasya bhāṣaṇena tu | snehasya cakṣuṣā mūlyaṃ vapuṣā bhojanasya ca ||61 || abdhau vṛṣṭerna vai mūlyaṃ tṛpte ca bhojanasya na | samṛddhe naiva dānasya nīce puṇyasya naiva ca ||62|| dūragatasya hṛdaye snehena vāsa ucyate | samīpasthasya vaireṇa dūravāsaḥ samucyate ||63 || kadaryatvaṃ svaro dīno gātradāridryamūrjitam | kṛpaṇatvaṃ bhayaṃ ceti cihnāni yācanārthinām ||64|| mahān viṣṇurhi bhagavān yācamāno hi vāmanaḥ | jāyate tarhi kā cānyārthinī yāti na lāghavam ||65|| vidyādhanaṃ sadā prārjyaṃ sādhutādāyinī satī | priyākarī gauravasya pradā duḥkhavināśinī ||66|| paramā devatā vidyā divyajñānasya śevadhiḥ | vadhūrvidyā samā bodhyā gṛhasampatprasādhinī ||67|| sarvadravyāṇi bāhyāni nāśabhītimayāni vai | ātmadravyaṃ hi vidyāste nāśabhītivivarjitam ||68|| ātmavidyāvatī bhāryā tīrtharūpā na saṃśayaḥ | tīrthabhuvaḥ sutāḥ putryaḥ pāvanā mokṣabhāginaḥ ||69|| tīrthayogavataḥ puṃsaḥ patyurmokṣo bhavedapi | tīrthapāvanavastūnāṃ bhoktāraśca kuṭumbinaḥ ||3.43.70|| yānti mokṣapadaṃ bhāryātīrthapuṇyena pāvitāḥ | yasya bhāryā mahāsādhvī sādhuvrataparāyaṇā ||7 1|| dharmācāraparā nityaṃ vadhūḥ patiparāyaṇā | supuṇyāṅgī suputrā ca maṃgalārhā ṛtaṃvadā ||72|| śuddhā priyakarī priyavratā patiniṣeviṇī | jñātrī guṇavatī kathāśrāviṇī bahutāpasī ||73 || nityaṃ vai dharmataḥ patnī sahapuṇyakarā śubhā | patimārgaṃ prayātā ca patidevamakhānvitā ||74|| sadbhāvācca patiṃ naiva dūrayatyeva yā priyā | yathā chāyā tathābhinnavratadharmaparāyaṇā ||75|| nārīṇāṃ mokṣade pātivratye vrate sthitā sadā | puṇyā strī yasya bhavati sa vai brahmamayaḥ patiḥ ||76|| savyaṃ pādaṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāma svapatyurhi yā satī | manute dakṣapādaṃ ca parabrahmātmakaṃ sadā ||77|| tatpādodakasaṃsnātā brāhmī bhavati bhāminī | sarvatīrthasamā sarvatīrthavāsā hi sā matā ||78|| makhānāṃ yajanāt puṇyaṃ yādṛśaṃ samprajāyate | tato’dhikaṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ pātivratyena jāyate ||79|| nāsti nāryāḥ pṛthag dharmaḥ patyuḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ vinā | tasmāt kāntasahāyā sā sarvadā sukhadāyinī ||3.43.80 || puṇyā puṇyatamā sādhvī viśiṣyate jagattraye | sā na tyājyā bhavet kvāpi loke’trāpi paratra ca ||81|| yena bhāryā parityaktā sunītā dharmacāriṇī | daśāṃgadharmastenāpi parityakto bhavediha ||82|| bhartā yāti yadā grāmāntaraṃ tadā tu vai satī | bhūmau śayanakartrī syācchṛṃgāraṃ na karotyapi ||83|| ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ payaḥ pānaṃ dadhi miṣṭaṃ na khādati | tāmbūlaṃ madhu miṣṭānnaṃ naiva khādati vai satī ||84|| ekaveṇīdharā caikakañcukīvastradhāriṇī | viyoge cāsamarthā saṃpratīkṣate tadāgamam ||85|| sambandhaḥ puṇyayogena jāyate patinā saha | nārīṇāṃ hi sadā tīrthaṃ bhartā so’pi striyāstathā ||86|| mithaścāvāhayennityaṃ vācā kāyena karmabhiḥ | manasā pūjayennityaṃ satyabhāvena vai mithaḥ ||87|| dakṣāṃgaṃ cāpi vāmāṃgaṃ sadā tīrthadvayaṃ hyubhe | tārayatyeva satataṃ kuṭumbaṃ śatamekakam ||88|| susukhaṃ putrasaubhāgyaṃ sampatsaubhāgyamityapi | rūpaṃ tejo yaśaḥ kīrtiḥ bhartuḥ striyāḥ prasādataḥ ||89|| nārīṇāṃ yauvanaṃ rūpaṃ bhartuḥ sampat tu sā matā | tuṣṭe bhartari saṃsāre lokāḥ sarve striyāḥ śubhāḥ ||3.43.90|| patihīnā surūpāpi sampadbhiḥ saṃbhṛtā api | kutastasyāḥ sukhaṃ rūpaṃ yaśaḥ kīrtiḥ sutādayaḥ ||91|| durbhāgyaṃ ca mahāduḥkhaṃ pāpā bhuṃkte patiṃ vinā | tuṣṭe bhartari devādyā ṛṣayo mānavāḥ surāḥ ||92|| pitaraścāpi tuṣṭāḥ syurubhalokasukhapradāḥ | bhartā nātho gururbhartā devatā daivataiḥ saha || 93|| bhartā tīrthaṃ cā puṇyaṃ ca vadhūnāṃ bhāgyagauravam | śṛṃgāro bhūṣaṇaṃ rūpaṃ varṇasaugandhyamityapi ||94|| patiḥ svargaṃ patirdharmaḥ patiḥ saubhāgyameva ca | patirvaṃśaḥ patiḥ śobhā vadhūstathā patiṃ prati |||95||| vinā dharmaṃ vinā bhāryāṃ vinā ca svāminaṃ śubham | gṛhaṃ vanāyate cāpi śmaśānāyata eva ca ||96 || vadhūḥ pativratā yatra patnīvrataḥ patistathā | sampat snehaśca yatrāsti brahmabhaktiśca yatra vai ||97|| yatra devārhaṇaṃ nityaṃ strīsammānaṃ ca yatra ca | yatra kanyārakṣaṇaṃ ca yatra mātṛprasevanam ||98|| yatra bālā modate ca yatra nārī pramodate | yatra vai hṛdayaṃ nāryāḥ phullitaṃ sampramodate ||99|| tatra svargaṃ ceśvarāṇāṃ sampado brahmalokatā | tasmāllakṣmi brahmapriyā bhavantu śīlatatparāḥ || 3.43.10 0|| matparāḥ sarvadā satyaḥ sadācāraparāyaṇāḥ | saddharmaparamā nityaṃ devārhaṇaparāyaṇāḥ || 101 || pātivratyaparā hārivratyaparāśca sarvathā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ sadā || 1 02|| vadhvo mama priyāḥ sarvā gṛhṇantvānandaśevadhim | bhavatīnāṃ sukhaiḥ sarvaṃ sukhaṃ me śāśvataṃ yataḥ || 103 || vadhūdharmāḥ khaḍgadhārasamāḥ santi priyāsthitāḥ | tān prarakṣya sthitā yūyaṃ madātmikā bhaviṣyatha || 104|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ vadhūpālyācārādinirūpaṇanāmā tricatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 43 ||
<3.44> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ pūrvabhavāṃ śubhām | vedāyano maharṣiḥ svāṃ bhāryāmakathayat purā || 1 || śreṣṭhatamaṃ pravakṣyāmi pātivratyamanuttamam | vācā sumanasā caiva karmaṇā śṛṇu bhāmini || 2 || āgrāyaṇe śṛṇu dharmān vadhvāḥ śreyaskarān mudā | śuśrūṣāṃ kurute bhartuḥ pratyahaṃ svīyabhāvanaiḥ || 3 || kruddhaṃ ca nirdhanaṃ vāpi na tyajet taṃ pativratā | tasya doṣaṃ na gṛhṇāti tāḍitāpi pratuṣyati || 4 || bhartuḥ karmasu sarveṣu puratastiṣṭhate sadā | kuṣṭhinaṃ vṛndalaṃ vāpi kāntaṃ yā sevate satī || 5 || patyulaukaṃ prayātyeva prasādāt svāminaḥ śubham | patitaṃ vyādhitaṃ kubjaṃ vikalaṃ rogiṇaṃ ca vā || 6 || ṣaṇḍhaṃ dharmavihīnaṃ pātakinaṃ vyasanānvitam | api nāthaṃ tyajennaiva vadhūḥ śreyo yadīcchati || 7 || kāntaṃ tyaktvā vrajedanyatkāryārthaṃ snehavarjitā | sā patyuḥ śāpamāsādya puṃścalītvamavāpnuyāt || 8 || gate bhartari śṛṃgāraṃ laulyaṃ ca sevate yadi | sā tu kāmasya vegena bhraṣṭā bhavejjanāntarāt || 9 || yā patiṃ svaṃ parityajya piturgehe vaset sadā | vidhihīnā dharmahīnā sā nārī śāsanārhaṇā || 3.44.1 0|| gārhasthyaṃ hi parityajya yāṭate’nyatra veśmani | sā na bhavati sampūrṇā patidevā hyabhāginī || 11 || bhartāraṃ ca parityajya mahodyānādivartinī | śṛṃgārabhūṣāveṣāḍhyā nirghṛṇā sā tu pāpinī || 12|| bhavati puṃścalī nāma yayā tyaktaḥ svakaḥ patiḥ | pṛthakśayyā vadhūḥ proktā puṃścalī dharmavarjitā || 13|| cakṣurhīnā dharmanetravihīnā pativarjitā | sarvasthāne patirhyeko bhāryāyā dharmadhṛṅnaraḥ || 14|| piturgehe sthitā kanyā ciraṃ nāśaṃ prayāti sā | patyurgehe sthitā kāntā ciramāyuṣyamṛcchati || 15|| pativratā mahābhāgā sarvatīrthamayī satī | devī sarvamayī nityā sarvadharmamayo hi sā || 16|| asadgatiṃ gatāyai ca yasyai kasyaicidapyatha | dadātyekadinasyāpi puṇyaṃ pativratodbhavam || 17|| piśācinyā bhavenmokṣaḥ pāpaśāntirbhavettathā | śarīraṃ śīryate’vaśyaṃ pātivratyamupārjayet || 18|| piṃgalā śṛṃgalī nāma dvau kṛmīkarṇamūlayoḥ | capalaḥ pippalaścaiva dvāvetau nāsikāgrayoḥ || 1 9|| bhṛṃgalī jaṃgalī caito netrayorāntarasthitau | kṛmayo vai tathā santi sarvāṃgeṣu navā navāḥ ||3.44.20|| taiśca saṃbhakṣyate dehaḥ patidharmaparāyaṇaḥ | vadhvā vicārya sādhyo’to dharmaḥ pativratātmakaḥ ||21|| tejaḥprabhāvo hyatulaḥ satīnāṃ patidaivataḥ | dhātā soḍhuṃ samartho na na sūryo na ca pāvakaḥ ||22|| satkārayogyāḥ satyaśca satītvaṃ pūjyate sadā | kṣamā śāntirbrahmacaryaṃ dayā damaśca sauhṛdam ||23|| prajñā santoṣa aiśvaryamārjavaṃ śuddhatā tathā | siddhayaḥ kalpalatikāḥ satyā dehe vasanti hi ||24|| guravaḥ pitaraścāpi viṣṇurlakṣmyā samanvitaḥ | haraśca satyā sahitaḥ sāvitryā saha viśvasṛṭ ||25|| satīgehaṃ samāyānti devāścāgnipurogamāḥ | mokṣamārgasthitāyāṃ vai yoṣiti gṛhayoṣiti || 26 || jñānaudāryasthitāyāṃ ca satīṣu dharmavatsvapi | sādhuṣvapi gṛhastheṣu nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti devatāḥ || 27|| bhaktasyāpi kuṭumbasya gṛhe vasāmi mādhavaḥ | samarthāḥ sādhavaḥ sādhvyo yatra tatra vasāmi ca || 28 || satīgṛhaṃ gṛhaṃ me vai brahmapriyāyutasya ha | sañcarāmi sadā gehe pātivratyādiśobhite || 29|| īśvarāḥ svāminaḥ sarve darśanārthaṃ prayāntyapi | pativratāgṛhaṃ yatra nivasāmi narāyaṇi || 3.44.30 || rūpasaubhāgyaśṛṅgārasukhaṃ sampattirityapi | nārīṇāṃ sarvathā kānte sarvasvaṃ śobhate’niśam || 31 || kāntā kāntena riktā na tyaktavyā vai kadācana | tyāgakartā doṣabhāk syāt satīdharmasya lopakṛt || 32|| vinītāṃ vimalāṃ puṇyāṃ vadhūṃ tyaktvā prayāti yaḥ | tasya puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ vṛthā vadhūvilāpanāt || 33 || dharmācāraparāṃ puṇyāṃ bhāryāṃ tyaktvā prayāti yaḥ | sādhvīṃ suguṇāṃ vatsāṃ sa dharmaphalaṃ na vindati || 34|| sarvācāraparā sādhvī puṇyapuñjārjane ratā | satīvrataratā sevāratā vijñā vinodinī || 35|| jñānaguṇā bhavedbhāryā yasya bhaktimatī śubhā | mahāsatī ca tadgehe devāstiṣṭhanti sarvadā || 36 || pitarastādṛśaṃ putraṃ vadhūṃ cecchanti sarvathā | puṇyā satī vadhūrgehe vartate satyaśālinī || 37 || tatra yajñāśca devāśca tīrthāni puṇyadāni ca | kāmadughāḥ kalpalatāstatra vasanti sarvadā || 38 || tatra sarvāṇi puṇyāni tīrthāni sarito nadāḥ | tatra lakṣmyo nivasanti sampadaśca vasantyapi || 39 || bhāryātīrthe sarvapuṇyaśīlāstiṣṭhanti yoginaḥ | bhāryāyogena patyuśca pādau tīrthasvarūpiṇau ||3.44.40 || satībhāryānivāsena sugārhasthyaṃ sudaivatam | sarvayajñamayaṃ syādvai sarvavratārthasampradam ||4 1 || gṛhasthasya gṛhaṃ puṇyaṃ bhāryā puṇyā pativratā | yatra tatra pravartante sarve dharmā sanātanāḥ ||42|| dānācārāḥ pravartante utsavāśca mahāsukhāḥ | bhāryāhīnaṃ vanaṃ vyāghrākulitaṃ duḥkhasaṃbhṛtam ||43 || nāsti bhāryāsamaṃ tīrthaṃ dharmasādhanamuttamam | vane grāme’pyaraṇye vā satītīrthaṃ hi mokṣadam ||44|| nāsti bhāryāsamaṃ puṇyaṃ nāsti bhāryāsamaṃ sukham| nāsti bhāryāsamaṃ jñānaṃ tāraṇāya hitāya ca ||41|| dharmabhāryāṃ satīṃ tyaktvā yo’nyatra kurute matim | gṛhadharmaṃ parityajya phalaṃ kvāsya bhavennanu ||46|| patnīṃ vinā yadā tīrthe śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ kṛtaṃ śubham | sarvaṃ prayāti viphalaṃ tasmād vadhūṃ na saṃtyajet ||47|| yathāmṛtapradānena pitṛtṛptiḥ prajāyate | bhāryādattena piṇḍena tathā tṛptiḥ prajāyate ||48|| gārhasthyasya tu dharmasya bhāryā bhavati svāminī | tayā vinārpitaṃ śrāddhaṃ kavoṣṇaṃ jāyate hi tat ||49|| bhāryā pacati caivānnaṃ svahastenāmṛtopamam | tadannameva bhuñjanti pitaro hṛṣṭamānasā ||3.44.50 || tenaiva tṛptimāyānti santuṣṭāśca bhavanti te | tasmād bhāryā vinā dharmaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ na siddhyati ||5 1 || bhāryā satī vadhūrnityaṃ dharmaṃ sādhayati dhruvam | yajñāḥ siddhiṃ na cāyānti gṛhiṇīrahite gṛhe ||52|| satyadharmamukhāḥ puṇyā jñānādyāḥ prabalāḥ sutā | dharmasya te sahāyā vai satīṃ rakṣanti sarvathā ||13|| satī rakṣāparā cāste damaśāntiparāyaṇā | na tāṃ jetuṃ samartho vai kālo vā yama eva vā ||54|| bhartrā vinā satīṃ kaścinnirīkṣeta yadā janaḥ | satīnetrāgninā so’pi bhasmībhūto bhavet khalu ||55|| yatra satī mahābhāgā vadhūrvai sarvamaṃgalā | tasyāḥ satyena santuṣṭā devā varaṃ dadatyapi ||56|| satīṃ yāntīṃ cābhiyanti vahnayo devatā api | gṛhadevā abhiyanti vanadevyo’bhiyanti ca ||57|| satīṃ yāntīṃ jale snātuṃ jaladevyo’bhiyanti ca | satīṃ yāntīṃ tīrthayātrāṃ tīrthāni cābhiyantyapi ||58|| satīṃ yāntīṃ devagṛhaṃ devāttāmabhiyanti ca | satīṃ yāntīṃ vāṭikāyāṃ kṣetradevyo’bhiyanti tām ||59|| satīṃ yāntī yajñabhūmiṃ makhadevyo’bhiyanti tām | satīṃ yāntīṃ pravāsaṃ ca pṛthvī yāti satīmanu ||3.44.6 0|| satīṃ snāntīṃ prasevante pitryo devyo jalārthikāḥ | satītanvā jalaṃ tāśca pibanti vastrapīḍitam ||6 1 || vadhūryā modate pātivratyena svagṛhe sadā | svarge’pi tatsukhaṃ nāsti siddhilabhyaṃ satīsukham ||62|| siddhayaścāṇimādyāśca sevante vai pativratām | satīcchāḥ pūrṇatāṃ yānti yathātathāpi kalpitāḥ ||63 || viṣṇurbrahmā haraścendraḥ sūryaścandro yamo guruḥ | satīṃ namanti sādhvīṃ ca pūjayanti satīṃ ca te ||64|| nijapatnīṃ satīṃ sarve devā icchanti sarvathā | rājāno’pi diśāṃ pālā bibhyati strīsatībalāt ||65|| satyaṃ vrataṃ bhaved yatra satī sā sarvathā matā | patyurvrataṃ bhaved yatra satī sā tu pativratā ||66|| brahmavratavatī yā sā satī brāhmī pativratā | mama caikāntikā yā sā satī śrīpuruṣottamī ||67|| bahupuṇyena labhyo’haṃ patiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | śatajanmaśīlakośānmama prāptirbhavediha ||68||| satīsaṃkalpamātreṇa rogā dūraṃ prayānti ca | vighnā dūraṃ prayāntyeva gaṇeśo’pi bibheti vai ||69|| yamarājo bhayaṃ caiti kālo gacchati dūrataḥ | mātaraśca prasannāḥ syuryatra gehe pativratā ||3.44.70|| caṇḍyādyāḥ śāntimāsādya rakṣanti tāḥ satīgṛham | bālagrahā na cāyānti sīmni satīgṛhasya vai ||71 || mārīrogāśca mantrāśca mohabhrāntikarā api | uccāṭanādyā bhīṃ prāpya varjayanti satīgṛham ||72|| hanumān brahmaśīlo’pi senānīḥ śīlavānapi | brahmacaryākhyapuruṣaḥ satīṃ namanti dūrataḥ ||73|| vidyudvṛṣṭisamudrāṇāmutpātā bhīṃ prayānti ca | satīvākyena santo’pi svānurodhaṃ jahatyapi ||74|| pativratāyā vadhvāśca sannidhau ceśvarā api | parājayaṃ kvacit prāpya satyājñāṃ mānayanti ca ||75|| satīkopena sarpādyāḥ saviṣā yānti bhasmatām | parvatādyā vilīyante śuṣkāyante’bdhayo’pi ca ||76|| grahā gatiṃ vihāyaiva stabdhā bhavanti daṇḍitāḥ | kāmādyā mānasā devā layaṃ yānti satībalāt ||77|| vāsanā bhavadā satyāśīrvādena pradahyati | mahāmāyāvilayaśca jāyate tu satīcchayā ||78|| avagrahaḥ satīkopād vṛṣṭiḥ satīprarañjanāt | vaṃśarekhā satīśāpānnaśyatyapi jagatsu ca ||79|| satīcchayā navaṃ sarvaṃ jagatpunaḥ prajāyate | yatra satī vadhūścāste tatrāhaṃ bhagavān svayam ||3.44.80|| virāje dhāmasahito muktādisahitastathā | virāje pārṣadairyukto virāje dharmasaṃyutaḥ ||81|| virāje bhaktiyuktaśca śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | virāje sampadā yuktaḥ pratyakṣo’haṃ satīgṛhe ||82|| satī sādhvī brahmaparā bhaktā nārāyaṇī hi sā | pativratā sāttvatī sā mahābhāgavatī matā ||8 3 || saccidānandasaṃjño’haṃ nivasāmi satīgṛhe | tadvaṃśe prakaṭīsaṃbhavāmi cāpi satīcchayā ||84|| prasanno’haṃ sadā bhaktavatsalaḥ śrīsatīgṛhe | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ bhagavān svayam ||85|| paripūrṇatamaścāsmi tatra kṣatirna vidyate | nyūnatā naiva bhavati saṃśayo na bhavatyapi || 86 || tasya vai saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ gṛhamityapi | saphalo vaṃśavistāro yasya gehe hariḥ satī || 87|| dharmastasyāpi saphalo kriyāśca saphalāḥ sadā | prayāsāḥ saphalāḥ sarve yasya gehe hariḥ satī ||88 || sadānandāśca kuśalaṃ svāsthyaṃ sarvavidhaṃ tathā | yatra sādhvyo harirdharmo yatayaḥ sādhavaḥ surāḥ ||89 || tatra yato bhavet siddhiḥ laukikī pāralaukikī | yatra kṣaṇaṃ sthitā sādhvī santastatra hariḥ svayam || 3.44.90 || kṛtaṃ tena paraṃ puṇyaṃ pūrvajanmani cātulam | yena prāptā satī bhāryā hariḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 91 || satīṃ draṣṭuṃ mukhyadevāḥ santaścāyānti nityaśaḥ | aśvapaṭṭasaraścedaṃ gṛhaṃ me śivasaṃjñike || 92 || tasmāt paraṃ hi sukṛtaṃ deśasyāsya pravartate | yatra satyo mama patnyo bhavanti koṭiśo’rbudāḥ | | 93 || tvayā nibhālitā lakṣmi svatulyāśca madātmikāḥ | paripūrṇatamaścāhaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ || 94|| vadhūbhiḥ saha saṃrāje divye surāṣṭrake sthale | ākṣare mama satkṣetre divye kuṃkumanāmake || 95|| sṛṣṭidhāmādhipaścāhaṃ tava bhaktyā vaśīkṛtaḥ | lakṣmi vasāmi te’gre ca svavaśastava mandire || 96 || aho brahmapriyāḥ sarvā rasaṃ gṛhṇanti me hareḥ | kṛpayānandasandohaṃ pibanti mama cāmṛtam || 97|| yūyaṃ brahmapriyāḥ parabrahmarūpā madātmikāḥ | mama dharmaparāḥ santu kalyāṇadā hi yoṣitām || 98 || dhanyā kuṃkumavāpīyaṃ dhanyaṃ vyāghravanaṃ tvidam | dhanyaṃ cāśvasaraścāpi dhanyā bhūśca surāṣṭrikā || 99 || dhanyo deśaḥ prajāścāpi vṛkṣāśca vallikāstathā | dhanyāstṛṇastambavṛkṣāḥ paśavo narayoṣitaḥ | | 3.44.100 || dhanyaścāpi samayo’yaṃ dhanyāśca jantavo’pi ca | yeṣāṃ me śrīhareryogaḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe’tra jāyate || 101 || yatra dharmaḥ kuṭumbāḍhyo vartate śāśvataḥ sukhaḥ | yatra muktistathā bhaktiḥ prītiśca santi vai dhruvāḥ || 1 02|| evaṃ matvā narā nāryo dhanyamātmānameva ye | smariṣyanti satīdharmāste’pi yāsyanti dhāma me || 1 03|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya satīdharmasya vācanāt | pālanādapi muktiśca siddhiścāpi bhaved dhruvā || 1 04|| vaṃśaḥ sampad yaśo mānaṃ cārogyaṃ ca prabhāvitā | prabhūtā ceśvarabhāvo bhavantyasya vicāraṇāt || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ satīsatyasāmarthyanirūpaṇanāmā catuścatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 44 ||
<3.45> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca devadeva kṛpāsindho puruṣottama mādhava | nirguṇo bhaktiyogaste satyā kāryaḥ kathaṃ tvayi || 1 || śrotumicchāmi lokānāṃ hitārthaṃ sarvayoṣitām | brahmapriyābhiḥ sarvābhirasmābhiḥ kārya eva yaḥ || 2 || tathānyābhiśca yoṣidbhirnaraiścāpi kṛto bhavet | yathā tathākarṇayituṃ samyagicchāmi tadvada || 3 || etāḥ sarvāḥ svasāro me koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyakāḥ | śrotumicchanti kāntāstāḥ preritāstābhiratra ha | pṛcchāmi nirguṇaṃ bhaktiyogaṃ tava vadātra naḥ || 4 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca guṇavanti hi karmāṇi saphalāni bhavanti vai | tānyeva mayi saṃtyaktaphalāni nirguṇāni vai || 5 || phalākāṃkṣāyutaṃ karma bandhakṛjjāyate priye | aphalecchāyutaṃ karma mokṣadaṃ samprajāyate || 6 || sāttvikāḥ sattvakarmāṇi kṛtvā yānti divaṃ janāḥ | rājasā naraloke ca kṛtvā rājasasatkriyāḥ || 7 || tāmasāḥ kalmaṣalokān yānti tamolayā janāḥ | nirguṇaṃ māṃ tu samprāpya mamākṣaraṃ prayānti vai || 8 || pañcāgnayo vanevāsā niṣkalmaṣā janāḥ priye | lokaṃ saptaṛṣīṇāṃ te prayānti phalabhāginaḥ || 9 || sanyāsāśramavāsāśca daṇḍādidhāriṇastathā | jitendriyamanodharmāḥ satyalokaṃ prayānti te || 3.45.10|| aṣṭāṃgayogasampannāḥ svavaśā ūrdhvaretasaḥ | maharlokaṃ janalokaṃ prayānti gatakalmaṣāḥ ||1 1|| yājñikā yajamānāśca prayāntīndrapadaṃ ciram | dātāro yānti somasya lokaṃ cāmṛtavarṣiṇam || 12|| vratinastu prayāntyeva sūryalokaṃ sutejasaḥ | tairthikā vahnilokaṃ cojjvalaṃ prayānti puṇyataḥ || 13|| satyavratāstathā yānti vāruṇaṃ lokamuttamam | viṣṇubhaktiyutā yānti vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāpunarbhavam || 14|| śaṃbhubhaktiyutā yānti nityakailāsamūrdhvagam | pitṝṇāṃ yājinaḥ putrasukhaiśvaryādivāñcchayā || 15|| dakṣiṇena pathāryamṇā pitṛlokaṃ prayānti te | smṛtidharmaparāḥ svargaṃ prayānti puṇyakāriṇaḥ || 16|| pañcadevaprapūjāḍhyā divaṃ prayānti daivikam | prajāpatiyajo yānti dakṣādīṃśca prajāpatīn || 17|| bhūtayajñakarā yānti bhūtāni vividhāni ca | bhvāditattvopāsakāścāvaraṇeṣu vrajanti vai || 18|| yakṣalokām̐stathā yānti kauberayakṣayājinaḥ | īśvarāṇāṃ ca yajvāno yāntīśvarapadāni te || 19|| tāpasā badarīṃ yānti śvetadvīpaṃ tu sādhavaḥ | brahmavratāstu vairājān lokān yānti praśīlinām ||3.45.20|| sādhvyaḥ satīnāṃ lokāṃśca prayānti sūryavarcasaḥ | lakṣmīlokām̐stathā yānti śrīlokān dharmayoṣitaḥ ||21|| pativratā harerlokān patilokān prayānti ca | brahmacāriṇya evāpi lokām̐stu brahmacāriṇām ||22|| gaṇikā gaṇalokām̐śca prayānti karmavedinām | īśabhaktā īśalokān prāṇabhaktā marutsthalīm ||23|| āsurā nirṛtalokān yamalokām̐stu pāpinaḥ | ārṣāṃllokān saṃyamino yanti tapojanādikān ||24|| vedavidyāratā yānti satyalokaṃ virāgiṇaḥ | tyāgino yānti vaikuṇṭhaṃ jalāvṛttyūrdhvasaṃsthitam ||25|| aiśvaryayājakā yānti siddhilokān suyoṣitām | dravyadā vasulokām̐śca bhasmino rudramandiram ||26|| pañcāgnitāpasā yānti cādityamaṇḍalaṃ janāḥ | kāminaścāndralokaṃ ca śītadānaparāyaṇāḥ ||27|| krūkarmakarā yānti rākṣasānāṃ gṛhāṇi tu | vāsanāvanta evāpi yānti piśācayoniṣu ||28|| dīpadānādikartāraḥ prayānti vahnimaṇḍalam | smṛddhidā yānti vai svargaṃ nākṣatraṃ suvilāsavat ||29|| vāṭikākṣetradātāro yānti samrāṭpadaṃ kṣitau | vidyāvantastathā sārasvataṃ padaṃ prayānti ca ||3.45.30|| dharmasya nāśakā yānti dāruṇaṃ dānavaṃ padam | adharmiṇo bhavantyeva daityā udvegaśālinaḥ ||3 1|| kruddhāśca krūrakarmāṇo nāgāḥ sarpā bhavanti ca | jalahānikarā yānti yādasāṃ yonisaṃbhavān ||32|| punarāvartinaḥ sarve lokāḥ satyāntino matāḥ | karmaṇāṃ sanimittānāṃ mārgo gatāgatātmakaḥ ||33|| tāvanmodaḥ pramodaśca yāvatpuṇyaṃ pravidyate | kṣīṇe puṇye samāyāti nimnalokaṃ hi kālataḥ ||34|| tasmāllakṣmi kṛtaṃ karmārpaṇīya parameśvare | karmaphalasya saṃtyāgānnirguṇaṃ jāyate mayi ||35|| bhaktā niṣkāraṇā bhūtvā jñānavairāgyasaṃyutā | premabhaktyā yutā kṛṣṇaharibhaktajanapriyā ||36|| bhaja me caraṇau haṃsasevitaṃ nirbhayaṃ priye | mṛtyuryatra na sabalastaṃ māṃ bhaja priye sadā ||37|| bhaktiyogo dvidhā lakṣmi saguṇaścāpi nirguṇaḥ | saguṇo’sti bahudhā vai nirguṇastvekadhā mataḥ ||38|| bhāvo vibhidyate strīṇāṃ guṇayukto hi sarvadā | guṇatrikād bhavantyeva bhaktāstribhedaśobhanāḥ ||39|| hiṃsāṃ dambhaṃ ca mātsaryaṃ kapaṭaṃ svārthaśālitām | ālambya kurute bhāvaṃ kruddhā sā tāmasī matā ||3.45.40|| yaśa aiśvaryaviṣayānabhisandhāya yatnataḥ | arcayenmāṃ śivarājñi rājasī sā prakīrtitā ||41|| kartavyamiti matvā yā karoti rāgavarjitā | mokṣārthaṃ bhajate māṃ sā sāttvikī sevikā smṛtā ||42|| duḥkhī svārthī vivekī ca maniṣī bhajate tu mām | puṇyapātrāṇi vai nāryo nimittena bhajanti mām ||43|| snehena mama bhaktāśca māṃ bhajanti sadā sukhāḥ | guṇairdoṣaiścāpare’pi māṃ bhajanti smaranti ca ||44|| nirguṇaṃ bhaktiyogaṃ tu kurvanti mayi sādhavaḥ | sādhvyaśca rāgaśūnyā yāstā bhajanti hariṃ varam ||45|| paripūrṇatame sarvakāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇe | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe śrīkāntavallabhe ||46|| premagatiravicchinnākhaṇḍitāhetukī śubhā | sā bhaktirnirguṇā divyā mayi prasannatāphalā || 47|| yaḥ sneho duḥkhanāśārtho na svārtho na nirarthakaḥ | hareḥ prasannatālabhyastadvatī nirguṇā matā ||48|| bhaktiryathā nirguṇāsti dāsī tathā ca nirguṇā | nisargapremadhārā yaṃ prati śrīpuruṣottamam ||49|| vahati premarūpā sā nirguṇā mayi yojitā | ānandātma phalaṃ tṛptiḥ śāśvatī phalamityapi ||3.45.50|| praphullatā phalaṃ samutsāhaḥ phalaṃ pramodanam | aho aho sthitiryā ca sudhāmiṣṭā viśāradī ||51 || pīyūṣarasadātrī ca nirguṇāyāḥ phalaṃ matam | navavadhvā yuvatyāśca vivāhottarameva yat ||52|| svakāntasaṃgamecchāyā yathā dhārā pravartate | navānandaḥ pramodaśca praphullatā prasannatā ||53 || snehabharaḥ sutṛptiśca santoṣo nirvṛttistathā | miṣṭaṃ suṣṭhu samastaṃ vai yathā vadhvāḥ prabhāsate ||54|| tathā bhaktimatīnāryā mayi sarvaṃ prabhāsate | saiṣā vedaprasūrvidyā nirguṇā matsvarūpiṇī ||55|| naiṣā madvyatirekeṇa kvacit kutrāpi jāyate | saiṣā bhāgavatī vidyā śāśvatī puruṣottamī ||56|| saiṣā prasannatālabhyā mamāntare nivāsataḥ | nānyasādhanalabhyā vai nirguṇā nirguṇaṃ vinā ||57|| nṛpasneho nṛpakṛpāṃ vinā bhṛtyasya nāsti vai | tathā mama kṛpāṃ hitvā yogo’yaṃ naiva jāyate ||58|| lakṣaṇaṃ nirguṇānāṃ me bhaktānāṃ śṛṇu padmaje | ākṣaraṃ cāpi golokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ śvetabhūtalam ||59|| kṣīrasthānaṃ badrikāṃ vā pārameṣṭhyapadaṃ ca vā | avyākṛtaṃ cāmṛtaṃ ca lakṣmīlokaṃ prakuṇṭhakam | vairājaṃ veśvarāṇāṃ ca sthānāni vividhānyapi ||3.45.60|| śakradhiṣṇyaṃ sārvabhaumaṃ rasādhipatyamityapi | dikpālatvaṃ yāmyabhāvaṃ yogarddhiṃ vaiśvarottamam ||6 1 || camatkārām̐stathā siddhīraiśvaryāṇi mahāntyapi | nābhilaṣanti ye bhaktā mama pādaprasevakāḥ ||62|| dīyamānaṃ mayā lakṣmi sālokyaṃ cāpi vottamam | na gṛhṇanti kadācitte matsevānandasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||63|| sāmīpyaṃ cāpi necchanti premṇa aunyāt kṣateḥ khalu | viraho’pi saṃgavighnaḥ sparśavighno mahān hi saḥ ||64|| sannikṛṣṭe tu yatprema dūratvaṃ labhate kvacit | tasmānmatsaṃgataulye na sānnidhyaṃ vartate kvacit ||65|| athāpi dīyamānaṃ ca sārūpyaṃ mānasaṃbhṛtam | gṛhṇanti naiva bhaktā me samānatvābhimānataḥ ||66|| dāsye samānatā vighno nairapekṣyaṃ ca vighnatā | mama sevotsukāstasmānna gṛhṇanti sarūpatām ||67|| athaikatvaṃ dīyamānaṃ naiva vāñcchanti māmakāḥ | dravībhāve vilīnībhāve caikatvaṃ bhavet khalu ||68|| tathāsati kathaṃ saukhyaṃ svāmisevakasaṃbhavam | dāsīlabhyaṃ sukhaṃ naiva kāntāddharerbhavennanu ||69|| amūrtabhāve tvekatvaṃ bhaktasya saṃbhavennanu | satyevaṃ yogajaṃ saukhyaṃ mūrtermūrtau kathaṃ bhavet ||3.45.70 || sevāsukhaṃ na labhyeta necchatyekatvamityataḥ | nirapekṣāśca śāntāśca samadarśanasaṃgatāḥ ||7 1 || kāntasukhānusukhinyo bhavanti nirguṇāḥ striyaḥ | nairapekṣyaṃ mahāsaukhyaṃ nairapekṣā hariśritāḥ ||72|| sakāmāstu mahāsaukhyaṃ niṣkāmāyā vidanti na | niṣkāmo bhaktiyogo vai bhavedātyantikaṃ padam ||73 || nirapekṣāḥ priyā nityaṃ māṃ bhajanti prakārakaiḥ | smṛtyā saṃkīrtanenāpi śravaṇena ca sevayā ||74|| pūjayā vandanenāpi dāsyena sakhyakena ca | ātmanivedanenāpi premṇā bhaktiṃ caranti ha ||75|| durlabhā bhaktimatyo me madbhāvabhāvanānvitāḥ | mahatīnāṃ mānabhāvaṃ kurvantyaśca dayāṃ tathā ||76 || dīnāsvatha samānāsu maitrīṃ carantya eva yāḥ | mama pādābjamadhupā mama saṃyogalālasāḥ ||77|| māṃ prasmaranti prāṇeśaṃ yathā proṣitabhartṛkāḥ | mama smṛteḥ romaharṣo yāsāṃ svedaḥ prajāyate ||78|| ānandāśrukalāścāpi vaivarṇyaṃ premasaṃbhṛtam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gṛṇantya eva ca || 79|| divāniśaṃ mayi saktāstā vai bhāgavatītamāḥ | manmānasyo maddhṛdayā mayyevāṅgasamarpaṇāḥ ||3.45.80|| mayyevānandabhoktryaśca mahābhāgavatītamāḥ | bhuvi jale’nale vāyau gagane tārakāsu ca ||81 || vane’raṇye jaṃgameṣu paśyantyaḥ parameśvaram | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ ca praharṣitāḥ ||82|| vilokayantyaḥ kāminyo rudanti ca vadanti ca | kvacinnandanti dhāvanti hasanti mārgayanti ca ||83|| gāyanti cāhvayantyugraṃ nṛtyanti ramayanti ca | viharanti ca jalpanti paśyanti māṃ drumāntare ||84|| kvacittūṣṇīṃ bhavantyetā matsvarūpā madātmikāḥ | kṛtakṛtyāḥ kṛtārthāśca sarvānandapariplutāḥ ||85|| yāsāṃ darśanamātreṇa cānyā yānti kṛtārthatām | divyā divyakriyā vadhvo divyarūpā hi tā yataḥ ||86|| śāśvatīnāṃ ca tāsāṃ vai na kālo na yamastathā | na bhūmā na mahārudro daṇḍaṃ dātuṃ kṣamaḥ kvacit ||87|| yāsāṃ vāme gadā kaumudakī dakṣe sudarśanam | agre śārṅgaṃ dhanuḥ paśce pāñcajanyastu kambukaḥ ||88|| nandakaśca mahākhaḍgaḥ śatacandraḥ purastathā | iṣavaḥ paritaścāpi chatraṃ cordhve vyavasthitam ||89|| yaṣṭiśca pādayoścāpi pārśve tvaiśvaryakoṭayaḥ | mūrtau ca siddhayaḥ sarvā mama rakṣanti tāḥ priyāḥ ||3.45.90|| ūrdhvaṃ chatraṃ mahāpadmaṃ chāyāṃ karoti śobhanām | garuḍaḥ pakṣavātaiśca śramahartā bhavatyapi ||9 1|| yatra yatra gatāḥ satyastatra tatra hariḥ prabhuḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ vicarāmi ca ||92|| tīrthīkaromi bhūbhāgān śrīmatpādābjareṇubhiḥ | kṣaṇaṃ yatra sthitāḥ satyastatra tīrthāni santi hi ||93|| pāpā mṛtā bhavettatra sāpi yāti parāṃ gatim | kṛṣṇapriyā vīkṣya dūrānnādhayo vyādhayo’pi ca ||94|| bhūtapretapiśācādyā grahā vighnāśca rākṣasāḥ | āsurā doṣabhāgāśca palāyante bhayānmama ||95|| nadyo nadāḥ parvatāśca prākārāḥ khātabhūmayaḥ | gartāśca gahvarāścāpi samudrā vahnayastathā ||96|| mārgaṃ dadati sādhvībhyo nirapekṣābhya eva me | sādhvīnāṃ jñānaniṣṭhānāṃ viraktānāṃ hi yoṣitām ||97|| madātmikānāṃ tāsāṃ vai pratibandho na kutracit | śatajanmatapaḥpūtā puṇyapuñjasamanvitā ||98|| saṃgamāsāṃ sā labhate durlabhaṃ puṇyahānibhiḥ | yatkule mama bhaktā vai jāyate brahmalakṣaṇā ||99|| tatkulaṃ vimalaṃ bodhyaṃ nikṛṣṭamapi cordhvagam | lakṣmi me bhaktiyuktā tu sarvaiśvaryasamanvitā || 3.45.10 0|| pitṝn daśakulodbhūtānnijām̐śca patipakṣagān | mātṛpakṣagatām̐ścāpi tāvataścoddharatyapi || 101 || api brahmāṇḍamakhilaṃ samuddhartuṃ balānvitā | nirayān pāpabandhām̐śca kṣeptuṃ śaktā tu sā matā || 1 02|| ye yāśca dehavatyo vai sambandhinaśca ye ca yāḥ | bhṛtyādyāḥ suhṛdaścāpi karmacārāśca ye ca yāḥ || 1 03|| pakṣiṇaḥ paśavaścāpi jantavo maśakādayaḥ | pipīlikāḥ pataṃgāśca kīṭāśca makṣikādikāḥ || 1 04|| mama bhaktā gṛhe ye yāsteṣāṃ tāsāṃ pramokṣaṇam | bhavatyeva na sandeho makhatīrthavṛṣairvinā || 1 05|| sādhvīsaṃsargataste’pi tā yānti harimandiram | maline’pi pradeśe vai bhaktā lokān punāti me || 1 06|| mayi kenāpi bhāvena mano lagnaṃ karoti yā | yāti madrūpatāṃ sāpi mamābhyāsād yathā tathā ||1 07|| snehakāmabhayakrodhairaikyasauhārdamohanaiḥ | bhūtvā manmayabhāvā tu yāti madbhavanaṃ satī ||1 08|| snehāt pitarau grāmyāśca kāmād brahmapriyāstathā | bhayād daityā dānavāśca krodhād raṇāṃgaṇe bhaṭāḥ || 109|| aikyāt kuṭumbino’saṃkhyāḥ sauhārdād ṛṣayo’malāḥ | mohānnāryaḥ koṭiśaśca bhūtvā manmayabhāvanāḥ || 3.45.11 0|| madrūpaguṇasāmarthyabhāvasaṃlagnamānasāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāptā hi māṃ prabhum || 111 || tasmāt kenāpi bhāvena mano mayi niveśayet | satataṃ smaraṇaṃ me syāt tena madbhāvamṛcchati || 11 2|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ nirguṇabhaktiyoganirūpaṇanāmā pañcacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 45 ||
<3.46> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ viśeṣaṃ bhaktiyojanam | na māṃ rodhayati khyātirmakho dharmastapo na ca || 1 || na yogo na viveko’pi na vratāni yamāstathā | na tīrthāni ca chandāṃsi pūrtāni niyamā na ca || 2 || na dānaṃ dakṣiṇā neṣṭaṃ vinā bhaktiṃ kadācana | khyātyādibhiḥ prāpyate yat prāpyate sarvameva tat || 3 || bhaktyā tu svalpayā lakṣmi bhakteḥ padaṃ tataḥ param | naibhirbhaktipadaṃ labhyaṃ cāsamarthaiḥ pradhiṣṇyadaiḥ || 4 || uddhāriṇī mama bhaktirviśvapāpāddhi pāvanī | uttāriṇī bhavābdheśca saṃhāriṇī ca karmaṇām || 5 || satkāriṇī śreyasāṃ ca dātrī hareḥ padasya ca | vasantapañcamī bhaktajanānāṃ raṃgadāyinī || 6 || kalpalatā snehilānāṃ cintāmaṇistu kāminām | vidyullatāndhabhaktānāṃ dīpikā śāstragāminām || 7 || dīpāvaliḥ sukṛtīnāmutsavī varaśālinām | vijayā daśamī ceyaṃ jayināṃ damināṃ śubhā || 8 || naukā pāragatīcchūnāṃ vimānikāmbarārthinām | tāpinī śītamagnānāṃ prāṇadājārditārthinām || 9 || jīvanī viṣadagdhānāṃ prāpikā śreyaicchatām| niḥśreṇī cākṣaradhāmno mātā dīkṣāṃ pragṛhṇatām || 3.46.1 0|| bhaktirme nirguṇā vetradharā me yogadā sadā | brahmadhāmapradā brahmānandadā cānivartinī || 11 || śrīḥ pārvatī kamalajā tulasī ca padmā padmāvatī bhṛgusutāpi ca padminī ca | rādhā ramā ca virajā ca sarasvatī ca durgā ramā badarī padmaratī ca lakṣmīḥ || 12|| revā ratiśca lalitā ca jayā ca haṃsī bhaktiśca mādhavasutā hyatha māṇikī ca | nārāyaṇī ca suguṇeti ca mañjuleti jāpāttaranti bhavasāgaramatra nāryaḥ ||13|| nārāyaṇo’kṣarapatiḥ puruṣottamaśca kṛṣṇo hariśca parameśvara īśvareśaḥ | svāmī prabhuḥ paramadhāmapatiḥ pareśaḥ sarvāntarastha iha mānavarūpakṛṣṇaḥ || 14|| śyāmaḥ sitaḥ sakalabhaktapatirhṛdistho brahmātigo’pi nijabhaktasamūhasaṃsthaḥ | brahmapriyeśa iti me śubhanāmajāpā tpāraṃ prayānti tu narā mama bhaktibhājaḥ || 15|| satsaṃgena bhavedeva bhaktyaṃkuraḥ supallavaḥ | vardhate cātivegena satīsaṃgena siñcitaḥ || 16|| tasmāt satīprasaṃgaṃ vai dehena manasā girā | kriyayā sevayā sarvārpaṇenāpi kriyāt sadā || 17|| sevāvidhiṃ pravakṣyāmi lakṣmi gṛhī tarettathā | sevayā māṃ parabrahma prāpnuyācchrīpatiṃ harim || 18|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhyānaparāyaṇam | guruṃ santaṃ samāśritya siddhā bhavati mānuṣī || 1 9|| gurvī satīṃ samāśritya sādhvī bhavati mānuṣī | mānavā vai guruṃ prāpya taranti tu bhavāmbudhim ||3.46.20|| mama dīkṣānvitaḥ syādvai guruścācāryasattamaḥ | mama sevādhikārī ca sevādhikāriṇī ca vā ||21 || sevāvidhiṃ śikṣayedvai śrīkṛṣṇasya mama prabhoḥ | uttarābhimukhaṃ ramyaṃ kārayenmama mandiram ||22|| sahasrakalaśāḍhyaṃ ca kalaśaikyena cādhikam | tatra gajāsanaṃ proccaṃ sapīṭhaṃ kumbhamaṇḍitam ||23|| akṣarākhyaṃ saccidānandātmakaṃ svarṇanirmitam | bahusopānaśobhaṃ ca maṇiratnādibhūṣitam ||24|| mahārharatnairācchannaṃ pṛṣṭhāmbaravirājitam | āvaraṇāmbarāgraṃ ca tūlyāsanādiśobhitam ||25|| mṛdu pārśvakaśipvādisahitaṃ hemaśobhitam | upabarhaṇasaṃyuktaṃ samullocādichāyitam ||26|| sacitrakuṇḍaśobhāḍhyaṃ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam | toraṇaiḥ rājitaṃ ramyairgavākṣavāriyantrakaiḥ ||27| catuḥśālaviśālāgrajālaiḥ prakāśabhāsitam | prāṃgaṇe ca sabhāśreṣṭhamaṇḍapena suśobhitam ||28|| tulasyā śobhitaṃ ramyaṃ dvipidvayavirājitam | siṃhavyāghragaruḍādyaiḥ śobhitaṃ purataḥ śubhaiḥ ||29|| cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ śṛṃgopari dvāre’bhidhāyutam | mama nāmāni lekhyāni toraṇeṣu samantataḥ ||3.46.30|| śaṃkhaṃ padmaṃ gadāṃ śārṅgamālekhyāni ca bhittiṣu | bāṇā bāṇadharāḥ kośāḥ pārśvayoḥ sarvathā matāḥ ||3 1|| mandirasya pṛṣṭhabhāge śatacandraṃ ca nandakam | halaṃ ca muśalaṃ cāpi citritavyaṃ śubhātmakam ||32|| gajāsanasya vai pṛṣṭhe pārśve me paṭṭayoṣitaḥ | tato brahmapriyāścāpi gopyo gāvaśca dāsikāḥ ||3 3|| muktāḥ santastathā sādhvyaḥ satyaśca sādhavo’malāḥ | avatārāśca gopālāḥ sopāneṣu kapāṭake ||34|| dehalyāṃ kalpavṛkṣāśca stambheṣu ca latāstathā | kuḍyeṣu gomatī gaṃgā svarṇarekhāśvapaṭṭakam ||35|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ bhadrā yamī sarasvatī | ālekhyaṃ rāsaramaṇaṃ janmotsavo makhādayaḥ ||36|| daśāvatāracitrāṇi naranārāyaṇāśramaḥ | puṇyatīrthāni kāryāṇi raṃgairmandiramadhyataḥ ||37|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakaraṃ kiśoramūrtikam | sapādapañcaṣaṣṭyaṃgulapramāṇaṃ ca māṃ nijam ||38|| śvetacampakavarṇābhaṃ kārayitvābhipūjayet | pratiṣṭhāvidhināsthāpya guruhastena mandire ||39|| bhaktaḥ paramayā bhaktyā pūjayetparameśvaram | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ brahmapriyāpatim ||3.46.40|| bhaktā bhakto’pi ca sadāharniśaṃ matparo bhavet | matprasāde svarasanāṃ ghrāṇaṃ mattalasīdale ||41 || tvacaṃ matsparśane kuryāt karṇau macchravaṇe tathā | netre maddarśane dadyāt karapādādikaṃ tathā ||42|| dadyāt sevāvidhau me ca hyevaṃ sevāparā bhavet | bhaktāṃ premabharāṃ tāṃ vai prāhurbhāgavatottamām ||43|| aśvamedhāyutayajñā rājasūyāyutānyapi| mama sevākalāṃśasya tulyatāṃ yānti naiva ha ||44|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārcāpradarśanam | sevanaṃ tasya caivāste phaladaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||45|| koṭipāpāni naśyanti gurvācāryasya sevanāt | dehānte divyamuktā me śvetacampakakāntayaḥ ||46|| gajaṃ nītvā samāyānti netuṃ dhāma mamākṣaram | vimāne garuḍe cāpi gaje kṛtvā nayanti tām ||47|| brāhme muhūrte cotthāya mama nāma smaret satī | guruṃ māṃ ca tato natvā mukhakṣālanamācaret ||48|| upaviśyāsane śīghraṃ śvāsaṃ vijitya vai tataḥ | hastāvutsaṃga ādhāya dhyāyenmāṃ bhaktavallabham ||49|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ cāśīḥparāyaṇam | svastikāsanamāsīnaṃ dhyāyet suśāntamacyutam ||3.46.50|| brahmapriyābhisahitaṃ paṭṭāṃganābhisevitam | sarvāṃgasundaraṃ ramyaṃ sarvabhūṣāvibhūṣitam ||51|| kiśoraṃ śvetarūpaṃ ca tejaḥparidhibhāṣitam | dhyātvaivaṃ māṃ tato yāyād dehaśuddhyarthamanyataḥ ||52|| aśaucāyāstu viphalāḥ kriyā bhavantyataḥ sadā | dehaśuddhiṃ jalādyaiśca snānādyairācaret priye ||53|| sattvaśuddhivihīnāyā bhaktirme naiva puṣyati | mukhaśuddhivihīnāyā japamantrā nirarthakāḥ ||54|| āyurbalaṃ yaśo varcaḥ prajāḥ paśūn vasūni ca | brahma prajñāṃ ca medhāṃ ca dadāti śuddhiruttamā ||55|| sūryaṃ namennamed vṛddhān vṛddhāḥ satīrnamettathā | sādhvīrnamet praseveta sādhvīḥ sādhujanānapi ||56|| praṇayeddharibhaktām̐śca devāyatanaprabhṛtīn | nāmāni cāpi gṛhṇīyāt pāvanāni smarettathā ||57|| sāketā madhunagarī māyā kāśī hyavantinī | kāñcī suvarṇanagarī purī ca puruṣottamī ||58|| kuṃkumavāpikā caitā mokṣadāḥ praṇamettathā | śālagrāmo gaṇḍakīgaḥ śaṃbhalo harimandire ||59|| nandigrāmaḥ kosalastho’kṣaragrāmān smarettathā | daṇḍakaṃ saindhavāraṇyaṃ jambūbhāgaṃ ca puṣkaram ||3.46.60|| utpalāvarttamāraṇyaṃ naimiṣaṃ kurujāṃgalam | arbudaṃ hemavantaṃ ca vyāghrāraṇyaṃ smarettathā ||61|| tilakaṃ bhālake kuryād raktakuṃkumarājitam | candrakaṃ kauṃkumaṃ kuryānmadhye bhāle satī tathā ||62|| mandiraṃ prati gatvā ca ghaṇṭānādaṃ samācaret | kīrtanaṃ bhajanaṃ kuryāt smarantī parameśvaram ||63|| jayārāvaṃ tālikāṃ ca vādayantī nametprabhum | pradīpaṃ ghṛtasaugandhyavāsitaṃ ca pradīpayet ||64|| uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhagavan yoganidrāṃ tyaja prabho | sevāyāmāgatā cāsmītyevamutthāpayeddharim ||65|| pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kuryādaṃgasevāṃ samācaret | dantadhāvanamarpayya snāpayed gandhavāribhiḥ ||66|| gandhasārādyarpayenme tato vastrāṇi cārpayet | candanādyairarcayenmāṃ maṃgalārtikyamācaret ||67|| bhrāmayennavavāraṃ me mukhopari pradīpitam | pañcavarttyaṃ jalaṃ vastraṃ bhrāmayitvā jayaṃ vadet ||68|| nivedya bahupakvānnaṃ dugdhaṃ ca śarkarānvitam | śṛṃgāraṃ bhāvataḥ kṛtvā vastrabhūṣaṇamaṃgalaiḥ ||69|| ārtikyaṃ hāratorādyaiḥ śṛṃgāryaiva samācaret | purīlaḍḍunavanītadadhidugdhāni cārpayet ||3.46.70|| pañcabhogān, tato natvā tāmbūlaṃ jalamarpayet | atha naijaṃ caret kāryaṃ vyāvahārikamutsukā ||71 || madhyāhne ca mahābhogān nānārasān samarpayet | rājabhogārtikaṃ kṛtvā kārayecchayanaṃ mama ||72|| prasādaṃ tulasīyuktaṃ bhuñjīta satataṃ satī | caturghaṭyavaśeṣe tu dine utthāpayettu mām ||73|| vādyanādena bhāvena phalabhogaṃ samarpayet | tataḥ sevāṃ mama kuryāt kuryonnaijaṃ kriyādikam ||74|| tataḥ sandhārtikaṃ kuryād dugdhādīni nivedayet | pradoṣe punarārtikyaṃ bhogaṃ dattveṣṭameva me ||75|| śayanaṃ kārayed ramye rājasevāṃ samācaret | sarvārpaṇaṃ vidhāyaiva mahānandaṃ labhet satī ||76|| evaṃ kṛṣṇaparā sādhvī sevāsaṃlagnamānasā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadāsyaparāyaṇā ||77|| tārayitvā kulaśataṃ yāti dhāmākṣaraṃ mama | mama janmāṣṭamī kāryā rādhāṣṭamī śubhā tathā ||78|| lakṣmīnavamī kāryā ca vratotsavaprapūjanaiḥ | rāmādityanavamī ca vāmanadvādaśī tathā ||79|| annakūṭotsavaścāpi tathānantacaturdaśī | caturdaśī nṛsiṃhasya tathā janmadināni me ||3.46.80 || śuklā ramāsaptamī ca kārtike vratarūpiṇī | kartavyā puṇyavatīpūrṇimā caitrasya sotsavā ||81 || pañcavarṇasamāyukte sthaṇḍile kārayecchubham | saptadhānyaiḥ sarvatobhadrākhyaṃ śobhanamaṇḍalam | dvātriṃśaddalasaṃyuktaṃ karṇikākaisarojjvalam ||82|| karṇikāyāṃ nyasenmāṃ ca svarṇasiṃhāsane satī | ramāṃ rādhā śriyaṃ bhūṃ ca virajāṃ māṇikīṃ ratim ||83|| padmāvatīṃ ca lakṣmīṃ cāmṛtāṃ ca maṃgalāṃ tathā | durgāṃ sarasvatīṃ haṃsīṃ maṃjulāṃ sadguṇāṃ jayām | campāṃ kastūrikāṃ haimīṃ śāntāṃ muktāṃ ca devikām ||84|| sthāpayet tatsatīmadhye māṃ svayaṃ bhaktavallabham | rādhāramāsakhīścānyāḥ pārṣadān sthāpayecca me ||85|| śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ śārṅgaṃ bāṇāṃśca nandakam | musalaṃ ca halaṃ daṇḍaṃ kaustubhaṃ svastikaṃ tathā ||86|| vanamālāṃ śrīvatsaṃ ca pītāmbaraṃ ca vetrikām | sthāpayed garuḍaṃ cāpi tālaṃ ca rathaśobhitam ||87|| sumatiṃ dārukaṃ cāpi kumudaṃ kumudākṣakam | nandaṃ sunandaṃ caṇḍaṃ ca pracaṇḍaṃ ca balaṃ tathā ||88|| prabalaṃ vallabhaṃ cāpi śukaṃ bhāgavataṃ tathā | svaprakāśaṃ ca hemantaṃ bhagavantaṃ diśāṃpatīn ||89|| viśvaksenaṃ cākṣaraṃ ca śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ vināyakam | grahān devān mātṛkāśca brahmapriyādimaṇḍalam ||3.46.90 || vītihotraṃ tathā sarvānavatārān samanyaset | tataḥ sampūjayed bhaktyā satī tvāvāhanādibhiḥ ||91 || āvāhanaṃ cāsanaṃ ca pādyamarghyaṃ sugandhi ca | pañcāmṛtaṃ jalasnānaṃ bhūṣāmbaraṃ ca candanam ||92|| madhuparkaṃ dhūpadīpau gandhaṃ yajñopavītakam | puṣpākṣatān dravān ramyān kuṃkumaṃ jalamuttamam ||93 || ācamanaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tathā | pradakṣiṇaṃ prārthanāṃ ca daṇḍavacca kṣamāpanam ||94|| nīrājanaṃ namaskāraṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ tato’rpayet | tataḥ sarvādhidevān vai devīśca pārṣadādikān ||95|| pūjayet parayā bhaktyā bhaktā nārī satīvratā | ghaṇṭāvādyaraṇadghaṃṭākāṃsyavīṇādikīcakaiḥ ||96|| karatālamṛdaṃgādyaiḥ kīrtanaṃ nartanaṃ kriyāt | nṛtyeyuḥ śrīhareragre ye bhaktāḥ premavihvalāḥ ||97|| jayaśabdayutāścāpi satkathākhyānatatparāḥ | sarvā nṛtyaṃ prakuryuśca parīhāraṃ tataśca tāḥ || 98|| śayanaṃ kārayeyuśca māṃ satyo bhaktitatparāḥ | evaṃ sevāpradhānāyā vadhvā nāryāśca yoṣitaḥ ||99|| sadāṃke’haṃ nivasāmi vasāmi hṛdaye tathā | sāpi nāke padaṃ dhṛtvā mama dhāma prayāti vai || 3.46.100 || yā kāpi ko’pi me pūjāṃ kariṣyati jagattraye | tāste yāsyanti me dhāmākṣaraṃ catuḥpadārthadam || 101 || api māṃ pūjayed bhaktyā saṃsmaret sevayecca vā | bhojayed rāmayeccāpi śṛṃgārayet praraṃjayet || 1 02|| sahavāsakarī bhūtvā śayane svāpayecca mām | mardayed vāhayenmāṃ ca hāstayed rāsayedapi || 1 03|| sarvāṃ premamayīṃ bhaktiṃ kuryācca kārayedapi | sā vai priyā me sahagā brahmapriyā bhaviṣyati || 1 04|| naro vā brahmamuktaḥ syāttathātmavedano hi yaḥ | divyo vai pārṣadaḥ śaśvatmatsamo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ śrīpuruṣottamayoganirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 46 ||
<3.47> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ mama yogaṃ parātparam | nārāyaṇe jagannāthe sarvakāmaphalaprade || 1 || mayi kṛṣṇe ratiṃ kuryād yā sā labhet paraṃ padam | mayi dhyānaparā lakṣmi cāṇḍālyapi hi devatā || 2 || gaṇikā mama yogasthā nirguṇā divyavartanā | adhyātmajñānasampannā haripūjāparāyaṇā || 3 || labhate cākṣaraṃ dhāma punarāvṛttivarjitam | yato jātamidaṃ viśvaṃ yataścaitanyamaśnute || 4 || yasmiṃśca vilayaṃ yāti yenāviṣṭaṃ ca jīvati | nirguṇo’pi paro’nanto guṇavāniva bhāti yaḥ || 5 || sadāntarastho yo’haṃ saḥ saṃsārabhayanāśakaḥ | taṃ māmabhyarcya kānteśaṃ saṃsārāt parimucyate || 6 || karmaṇā dehamāpnoti dehī kāmena badhyate | sa kāmaṃ mayi saṃyujya prāpnuyānmatparaṃ padam || 7 || māṃ vinā kāmanāyuktā krodhena cābhibhūyate | lobhastāṃ praviśatyeva dharmanāśaṃ karotyapi || 8 || matibhrāntiṃ janayati pāpaṃ nayati mānavam | evaṃ pāpasya mūlaṃ syāccharīraṃ māṃ vinā priye || 9 || tasmānmadyogamāsādya doṣānnirguṇakān vrajet | sarvāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca saṃgṛhya śete yo’kṣaradhāmani || 3.47.1 0|| taṃ mā vai mokṣadaṃ jñātvā seveta satyadharmiṇī | vedārthavidbhiḥ karmajñairijyate vividhairmakhaiḥ || 1 1|| vratibhistāpasairyogasādhakairjñānayajñakaiḥ | sa eva karmaphalado mokṣado’kāmakarmaṇām || 1 2|| havyakavyādidāneṣu devatāpitṛrūpadhṛk | bhuṃkte yo bhagavān māṃ taṃ mokṣadam ṛṣayo viduḥ || 1 3|| dhyātaḥ praṇamito vāpi pūjito vāpi bhaktitaḥ | dadāmi śāśvataṃ dhāma taṃ māṃ hariṃ samarcayet || 14|| ādhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāmeko’haṃ parameśvaraḥ | jarāmṛtyuvinirmukto mokṣado’smyavyayo hariḥ || 15|| sampūjya mama pādābjaṃ dehino’pi narāyaṇi | amṛtatvaṃ bhajantyāśu māṃ viddhi puruṣottamam || 16|| ānandamajaraṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sanātanam | parātparataraṃ so’haṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 17|| advayaṃ nirguṇaṃ nityamadvitīyamanaupamam | paripūrṇatamaṃ jñānamayaṃ mokṣasya sādhanam || 18|| evaṃvidhaṃ tu māṃ lakṣmi sevayā sarvabhāvayā | yā tūpāste yoginī sā yāti matparamaṃ padam || 1 9|| nirguṇā saṃgarahitā śamādiguṇaśobhanā | vāsanāvarjitā brāhmī priyā yātyakṣaraṃ padam ||3.47.20 || mamāvatārarūpāṇi bhavanti yugalāni vai | samarthayanti māṃ sarve śāśvatasthānadaṃ harim ||2 1 || yasyābhinnamidaṃ sarvaṃ yacceṃgad yacca neṃgati | tamūrdhvamajaraṃ dhyātvā saṃsārānmucyate satī || 22|| jitaprāṇā jitāhārā mama sevāparāyaṇā | hṛdi paśyati māṃ kāntaṃ sarvānandasukhapradam ||23 || nirguṇo’pi guṇādhāro bhūtvā sevāṃ satīkṛtām | aṅgīkaromi sarvasvāṃ lokānugraharūpadhṛk || 24|| adhyakṣaḥ sarvakāryāṇāṃ dehināṃ hṛdaye sthitaḥ | anupamo’khilādhārastaṃ māṃ vai śaraṇaṃ vrajet ||25|| mahadādyā viśeṣāntā jātā yasyecchayā kṛteḥ | taṃ vidyānmāṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamanāmayam ||26|| yasyājñayā jagaccāniruddhaḥ sṛjati rūpavat | pradyumnaḥ pālakaścāste saṃkarṣaṇo vikarṣati ||27|| brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca tadaṃśāstatkriyāparāḥ | taṃ māṃ sarvāṃśadhartāraṃ vidyānmuktiṃ vrajet tataḥ ||28|| yajjñānaṃ bhaktimūlaṃ syānmokṣadaṃ jñānamityapi | bhaktiḥ karmātmikā snehasevātmikā śubhottamā ||29|| dānāni yajñā vividhā vratatīrthārhaṇādikāḥ | yayā pūrve kṛtāstasyā bhaktirbhaveddharau mayi ||3.47.30|| śāśvataḥ paramo dharmo bhaktileśena śobhate | śraddhayā parayā yukto mayi bhāgavato bhavet ||3 1 || doṣāṇāṃ vilaye buddhiḥ prasannā jāyate sadā | doṣā rāgādayaste ca mayi kṣiptā viśāradāḥ ||32|| guṇā eva prajāyante vivartante yato mayi | tairyuktā ca matiḥ śreṣṭhā prasannā ca viśāradī ||3 3|| sā jñānātmakadhārā ca tadā prāpyo bhavāmyaham | sā matirjñānarūpā vai mokṣadā mama dhāmadā ||34|| kriyāyogaṃ mayi kṛtvā matinairmalyamarjayet | sevāyogena māṃ nityaṃ tato dāsī prasevayet ||35|| sādhubhūrvārvahnisūryaviprahṛccitradhātujāḥ | sādhvīgoyogibuddhyādyāḥ pratimā mama mūrtayaḥ ||36|| devatācaityatīrthādyāḥ pratimāśca vibhūtayaḥ | etāsu pūjya evāhaṃ patyāviva janārdanaḥ ||37|| karmaṇā manasā vācā bhaktyā sarvagataṃ ca mām | pūjayed bhaktisaṃyuktā yā sā brāhmī bhaviṣyati ||38|| vadhvā patyau narabhāvo neśabhāvo bhavatyapi | kāmakrodhādidoṣāṇāṃ darśanād divyatā na vai ||39|| kintu patyau kṛtā syācced divyatā manasā sadā | vadhvā nārāyaṇadṛṣṭyā sevā sā muktidā bhavet |||3.47.40|| nāryā mūrtau pratimāyāṃ divyadṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā yadi | sā syāttasyā mokṣadā vai śivaliṃge yathā matiḥ ||41 || sādhavaśca tathā sādhvyo mūrtayaḥ pratimā mama | tāsu dṛṣṭiṃ śubhāṃ divyāṃ kṛtvā sevāṃ samācaret ||42|| pāñcabhautikapratimāścetanāstā mamaiva ha | tāsāṃ saṃprīṇanāccāhaṃ prasannaḥ saṃbhavāmi hi ||43|| kriyārpaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tatra gṛhṇāmi sevanātmakam | dadāmi sevikāyai tu dhāmākṣaraṃ padaṃ param ||44|| ahiṃsāsatyamakrodho brahmacaryāparigrahau | anīrṣyā ca dayā śāntiḥ sevā ca sadguṇā ime ||45|| sarvān vinyasya ca mayi mama yogaṃ samācaret | carācarātmako nāthaḥ śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ ||46|| matvaiva śrīhariṃ naijaṃ patiṃ kṛtvā bhajet priyā | yogo’yaṃ sādhyarūpo vai śreṣṭhaḥ sākṣānmadātmakaḥ ||47|| mama prāptisvarūpaḥ sa jānantyenaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ | doṣān vihāya kṛtvaiva guṇarūpān harau mayi ||48|| ānukūlyena sarveśaṃ kāntaṃ māṃ prabhajet satī | muktyarthamarcayennityaṃ kriyāyogaparā priyā ||49|| ratā lokahite cāpi svahite ca ratā tathā | samarcayati māṃ sādhvī divyakriyāvatī hi sā ||3.47.50|| nārāyaṇaṃ jagadyoniṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ harim | stotrādyaiḥ stauti māṃ prātaḥ kīrtanairgāyati prabhum ||51 || upavāsādibhiścāpi kathāśravaṇacintanaiḥ | puṣpādyaiścārcanaṃ cāpi kriyā divyā hi sā matā ||52|| bhaktikriyāvatāmevaṃ doṣā naśyanti mūlataḥ | divyabhāvaṃ prayāntyeva kāmakrodhādayo’pi ca ||53|| matirdivyā bhaveccāpi mokṣadā jñānasaṃbhṛtā | ekaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ māṃ ca ṛte sarvamanityakam ||54|| anityāstu padārthā vai nityastveko hariḥ prabhuḥ | anityaiḥ sādhanairvai ca nityamekaṃ samāśrayet ||55|| ihāmutra ca bhogeṣu viraktā tu sadā bhavet | aviraktā hi saṃsārānnivartate na vai kvacit ||56|| śamādiguṇasampannābhyasyenmokṣavibodhanam | haridhyānaparā syācca viśuddhamatikā bhavet ||57|| sarvatra bhāvayenmāṃ ca śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam | kṣarākṣarātmakaṃ viśvaṃ vyāpya kṛṣṇo’hamāsthitaḥ ||58|| iti jñātvā bhajenmāṃ ca sarvatra bhaktimāśritā | ātmā dvedhā paraścāpyaparaśceti svabhāvataḥ ||59|| paramātmā paraścāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ | mamāvatārā bahavo rādhākṛṣṇādayo matāḥ ||3.47.60|| mama mūrteḥ śubhaṃ tejaścātmākṣaro nigadyate | muktāśca bahavaḥ santi sarve’parā bhavanti te ||6 1|| īśvarāḥ śaktayo devā devyaśca mānavādayaḥ | sarve cāparajīvāste bhavanti bhavadehinaḥ ||62|| evaṃ cetanavijñānaṃ jīvātmaparamātmanoḥ | kṛtvā bhajetparaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sadā satī ||63|| ekaḥ śuddho’kṣaraparaḥ paramātmātmanāṃ patiḥ | māyākālākṣarapatiścāvatārapatiḥ prabhuḥ ||64|| satāṃ patirmuktapatirbrahmapriyāpatirhariḥ | satīpatirbhaktapatirbhaktāpatiḥ priyāpatiḥ ||65|| brāhmīpatiḥ sarvapatiḥ svapatiḥ parameśvaraḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśceti vibhāvayet ||66|| ekamevādvitīyaṃ yatparaṃ brahma sanātanam | vedāntavedyaṃ tadvai māṃ viditvākṣaramāvrajet ||67|| eka eva parānando nirguṇaḥ parataḥ paraḥ | divyaguṇairbhṛto nārāyaṇo’haṃ parameśvaraḥ ||68 || jñānināṃ paramātmāhaṃ hṛdi bhāmi nirantaram | aṣṭasopānasaṃsiddhā yāti matparamaṃ padam ||6 9|| āhāraśuddhiḥ prathamā dehaśuddhirdvitīyakā | tṛtīyendriyaśuddhiśca caturthyāntaraśuddhikā ||3.47.7 0 | | pañcamī tvātmaśuddhirvai ṣaṣṭhī parātmadhāraṇā | saptamī dhyānavṛttiścāṣṭamī tatraiva lagnatā | |7 1 || iti kṛtvāṣṭakaṃ sādhvī māṃ samāsena saṃśrayet | matprasādāśanā syāddhi cāhāraśuddhireva sā ||72 || mama dīkṣāyutā syācca dehaśuddhirmatā hi sā | indriyāṇi madarthaṃ vai tṛtīyā śuddhireva sā ||73 || karaṇāni madarthaṃ cāntarā śuddhirhi sā matā | ātmārpaṇaṃ mayi kṛṣṇe divyasadguṇaśālitā || 74|| sattvaprakarṣa evātra tvātmaśuddhirmatā hi sā | nijātmānaṃ brahmarūpaṃ vibhāvayet sadā satī ||75 || muktāṃ nityāṃ mahāmuktāṃ lakṣmīrūpāṃ sanātanīm | ātmaśuddhirhi sā proktā māyāmāyikavarjitā ||76 || nijaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ kṛtvā pareśaṃ māṃ ca vāhayet | dhārayet sthāpayeccāpi mama yogaṃ samācaret || 77 || mama dhāraṇayogyāyā rūpe vasāmi cetane | mama vāsaḥ sa evāsyāḥ parātmadhāraṇā matā || 78 || mayi pratyayabhāvasya tvekatānatvameva yat | sarvānandapravāhasya tvekatānatvameva yat || 79 || sarvaprakāśapūrasya caikatānatvameva yat | sarvacaitanyapūrasya caikatānatvameva yat ||3.47.80 || yāvatprajñāpravāhasya caikatānatvameva yat | avicchinnapravāhasya mayi lagnatvameva yat | |8 1 || saptamīdhyānavṛttiḥ sā proktā sopānikā varā | vṛttīnāṃ śrīharau jāte valayātmalaye’dhike ||8 2|| ākṛṣṭasya cetanasyārpaṇaṃ cābhinnayogitā | samādhiḥ paramaḥ so’tra śāśvatānandadohanaḥ ||8 3 || parameśasvarūpasya nirbhāso yatra vidyate | svanirbhāso na vai cāste’ṣṭamī sā paramā sthitiḥ ||84 || brahmānandamayī mūrtirnijā pareśarūpiṇī | yadā vibhāsate’śnute sarvān kāmān mayā saha ||85 || sukhaṃ tṛptiśca santoṣastuṣṭiścānanda utsavaḥ | ratiḥ prasannatā modaḥ pramodo rañjanaṃ ca cit ||86 || laharī tānatā bhogaḥ sattvaṃ caiśvaryamuttamam | praphullatā ca pulakaḥ snehaḥ prītirvirāmitā ||87|| ākarṣaṇaṃ ca viśrāntirmahāsuṣuptirityapi | turyāvasthā nijānandaścetyevaṃ bahunāmabhiḥ ||88|| phalaṃ pravarṇyate tajjñaistadvattā cāṣṭamī sthitiḥ | tāṃ prāpya punarāvṛttirvidyate naiva naiva na ||89|| evamaṣṭāṃgayogena mayoktena narāyaṇi | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ vai vivāhayet ||3.47.90|| haribhaktirdṛḍhā yasyā haripūjā tathottamā |, tasyā viśuddhiyoginyā mokṣo hastagato’sti vai ||91 || harau mayi sthirā syācca samāsīta mayi prabhau | śreṣṭhāsanaṃ hi tadbodhyaṃ prāṇaṃ māṃ ca samāśrayet ||92|| pratyāharaṇamevāpi mayyeva ca samācaret | prayātā syātparabrahma punarāvṛttivarjitam ||93|| nijātmani praveśayet parameśaṃ śriyaḥpatim | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ sthāpayet satī ||94|| sarvātmānaṃ nijātmānaṃ sarvalokaikakāraṇam | surūpaṃ kāntikāntaṃ ca tejaḥparidhirājitam ||95|| manogamyaṃ yuvānaṃ ca sarvakāmaprapūrakam | vikasatpadmapatrākṣaṃ cārukuṇḍalabhūṣitam ||96|| dīrghabāhumudārāṃgaṃ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitam | pītāmbaradharaṃ kāntaṃ patiṃ yogyaṃ susaṃginam ||97|| hemayajñopavītaṃ ca bibhratsattulasīsrajam | śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ hāramaṇikaustubhaśobhitam ||98|| dhyāyenmāṃ paramātmānaṃ paraṃ mokṣaṃ labhettataḥ | dhyānātpāpāni naśyanti dhyānānmokṣo bhavedapi ||99|| hariḥ prasīdati dhyānād dhyāne’haṃ samavasthitaḥ | dhyānaṃ dhyeyaṃ dhyātṛbhāvaṃ trayamekībhaved yadā || 3.47.100 || tadāmṛtatvaṃ bhavati jñānāmṛtaṃ niṣevate | mahānandaṃ prabhuṃkte ca bhuṃkte brahmāmṛtaṃ sadā || 10 1|| śabdabrahmākṣarabrahmakaraṇabrahma cetyapi | ātmabrahma parabrahma caikībhavanti tāni vai || 1 02|| mahānandasamudre vai muktiḥ samādhijā hi sā | ānando vai parabrahma parabrahma hariḥ prabhuḥ || 103|| omityeva parabrahma saccidānanda eva saḥ | etadabhyāsasaṃyuktā paraṃ mokṣaṃ vrajatyapi || 1 04|| yā tvetacchṛṇuyāccāpi paṭhedvāpi samāhitā | sā madaikyaṃ samāpannā haripriyā bhaved dhruvam || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ sākṣātparabrahmayoganirūpaṇanāmā saptacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 47 ||
<3.48> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca yathā tuṣyati bhagavān parameśaḥ parātparaḥ | tanmamākhyāhi sarvajña kānta kāruṇyavāridhe || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ kāntaṃ saccidānandavigraham | bhaja sarvātmanā kānte māṃ yadyānandamicchasi || 2 || ripavastāṃ na hiṃsanti na bādhante grahādayaḥ | rākṣasāścāpi nekṣante nārīṃ viṣṇuparāyaṇām || 3 || bhaktirdṛḍhā bhaved yasyāḥ pareśe paramātmani | tasyāḥ śreyāṃsi siddhyanti bhaktiyuktādhikā tataḥ || 4 || pādau tau saphalau tasyā yau viṣṇugṛhagāminau | tau karau saphalau tasyā mama pūjāparau tu yau || 5 || te netre saphale tasyāḥ paśyato ye śriyaḥ patim | sā jihvā maṃgalā tasyā harernāmaparā tu yā || 6 || te śrautre saphale tasyāḥ śrīkathāsāragrāhake | sā tvag vai pāvanī tasyā yā harisparśavedinī || 7 || rasanā sā rasavatī yayā prāpto hareḥ rasaḥ | ghrāṇaṃ puṇyaṃ hi tasyāstad yacchrīmadgandhavedi vai || 8 || sā kaṭiryā tu haryarthaṃ guptaṃ haryarthameva ca | vakṣaścāpyapi haryarthaṃ gaṇḍau haryarthameva yau || 9 || kapolaṃ cāpi haryarthaṃ haryarthaṃ jaghanaṃ tathā | sakthinī cāpi haryarthaṃ jaṅghe haryarthameva ca || 3.48.10 || auṣṭhau cāpi tu haryarthaṃ keśā haryarthameva ca | śayanaṃ cāpi haryarthaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ kṛte || 1 1|| yasyā ramaṇaṃ haryarthaṃ vilāso’pi hareḥ kṛte | hāvā bhāvāśca haryarthaṃ nṛtyaṃ haryarthamityapi || 1 2|| gāyanaṃ hasanaṃ cāpi dṛṣṭirharyarthameva yā | mānasaṃ cintanaṃ cāpi buddhirharyarthameva yā || 1 3|| ahaṃbhāvo’pi haryarthaṃ kriyā haryarthameva ca | śṛṃgāro’syāśca haryarthaṃ rūpaṃ haryarthameva ca || 14|| alaṃkārāśca haryarthaṃ bhūṣā haryarthameva ca | kajjalaṃ candanaṃ tailaṃ haryarthaṃ kabarī tathā || 15|| dhammilāścāpi haryarthaṃ puṣṭirharyarthameva ca | vrataṃ śīlaṃ tathā śuddhiḥ snānaṃ haryarthameva ca || 16|| saṃskārāścāpi haryarthaṃ tānaṃ haryarthameva ca | bhānaṃ lajjā pramodaśca prītirharyarthameva ca || 17|| saukumāryaṃ ca mādhuryaṃ dīptirharyarthameva yā | prasādhanaṃ ca haryarthaṃ protsāho’pi hareḥ kṛte || 18|| utsavāścāpi haryarthaṃ śobhā haryarthameva ca | upārjanaṃ vyayaścāpi yatno haryarthameva ca || 19|| sukhaṃ ratirmahānandaḥ sarvaṃ haryarthameva ca | gṛhaṃ kṣetraṃ sampadaśca sarvaṃ haryarthameva ca ||3.48.20 || sutāḥ putryaśca gāvaśca haryarthaṃ vājinastathā | gajā yānavimānāni yasyā haryarthameva ca ||21 || vāṭikā sasyasampaccopaskarāśca hareḥ kṛte | nimeṣaṃ śvāsarakṣā ca cetano’pi hareḥ kṛte || 22|| guṇabhāvāśca haryarthaṃ bhāvanāpi hareḥ kṛte | utthānamudayaścāpi virāmo’pi hareḥ kṛte || 23|| anāvaraṇabhāvaśca hṛdayaṃ ca hareḥ kṛte | gopyaṃ mantro rahasyaṃ ca sarvaṃ yasyā hareḥ kṛte ||24|| kalāḥ śikṣābhyasanaṃ ca rāgaḥ śāntirhareḥ kṛte | ārambhāśca prapūrtiśca pācanaṃ ca hareḥ kṛte ||25|| bhramaṇaṃ vyavahāraśca sphurtiścāsyā hareḥ kṛte | lobhaḥ kāmaśca saṃkalpaścotsavaśca hareḥ kṛte ||26|| yajñā dānaṃ bhajanaṃ ca dharmaścāsyā hareḥ kṛte | puṣpaśayyā uraḥśayyā cordhvaśayyā hareḥ kṛte ||27|| maṇḍapo maṇḍapī rāso līlā laulyaṃ hareḥ kṛte | bhramaṇaṃ haraṇaṃ cāpi vartanaṃ ca hareḥ kṛte ||28|| lekhanaṃ khelanaṃ cāpi kauśalyaṃ ca hareḥ kṛte | cāturyaṃ cāpi cāpalyaṃ divyatāpi hareḥ kṛte ||29|| apyaṃgānāṃ moḍanaṃ ca svedaścottejanaṃ tathā | rājaso vega evāpi sarvaṃ haryarthameva ca ||3.48.30|| bhojanaṃ pānamudgāro dhātulābho hareḥ kṛte | samayaścāpi saṃketo vāṭaścāpi hareḥ kṛte || 31 || mārgaṇaṃ cānveṣaṇaṃ ca pratīkṣaṇaṃ hareḥ kṛte | ānandecchā harereva haryarthaṃ cāntaraṃ sthalam ||32|| antarbahirhariryasyāḥ snehamūrtirharerhi sā | satyasāramidaṃ sarvaṃ na kāntaḥ keśavātparaḥ ||33|| asāre khalu saṃsāre sāraḥ kānto harirmahān | saṃsārapāśāḥ sudṛḍhā abhaktāyā bhavanti te ||34|| bhaktāyāste guṇadā vai vipāśāśca bhavanti vai | ānandamatulaṃ me ca vaśīkṛtvā samarjayet ||35|| sthānaṃ rūpaṃ tathānandaḥ sukhaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate | nirdeṣṭuṃ cāpi ca draṣṭuṃ śakyate nākṛtātmabhiḥ ||36|| sarvopādhivinirmuktaścānando’tiśayo hareḥ | parabrahmamayaṃ bhuktvānandaṃ brāhmī bhavet satī || 37|| tatkathāyāṃ ca ramate satkathāṃ ca karoti yā | satsaṃgo nityamevāsyāḥ prīto bhavāmi padmaje ||38|| nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ me ca kṣuttṛṭpraskhalanādiṣu | karoti satataṃ yā tu tasyāḥ prīto bhavāmi vai ||39|| yā tu vadhūḥ patiprāṇā patipūjāparāyaṇā | tasyāstuṣṭaḥ sadā cāsmi dadāmi svapadaṃ priyam ||3.48.40|| asūyārahitā yā tu tathāhaṃkāravarjitā | dāsībhāvaparā sādhvī tasyāstuṣyāmi sarvathā ||41|| tasmād brahmapriyāḥ sarvā haripriyā madātmikāḥ | bhajatātra hariṃ kāntaṃ māṃ priyaṃ kṛṣṇavallabham |||42||| śarīraṃ mṛtyuvāsaṃ vai hāsavāsaṃ hi karmiṇām | jīvitaṃ cañcalaṃ vidyullolāśca sampadastathā ||43|| rājādibhirdhanaṃ bādhyaṃ smṛddhayaḥ kṣaṇabhaṃgurāḥ | nidrāḍhyaṃ cāyuṣārdhaṃ copārjanārthaṃ tathārdhakam ||44|| bhogārthaṃ ca tadardhaṃ tu bālyaṃ sauṣuptamityapi | vicāryeti satī kuryād vayasyeva mamārcanam ||45|| vapurvināśanilayaṃ cāpadāṃ paramaṃ padam | akasmād bhinnamārgaṃ ca tena bhaktiṃ prasādhayet ||46|| asārabhūte saṃsāre sāre mayi samarpaṇam | sarvātmanā prakuryādvai jñātvā nārī pramokṣaṇam ||47|| dehayoganivṛttyarthaṃ sadya eva narāyaṇam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhajeta māṃ satī ||48|| koṭijanmasahasreṣu sthāvarādiṣu yoṣitaḥ | saṃbhrāntāyāḥ kathaṃcidvai mānuṣyaṃ samupasthitam ||49|| tatra dānaṃ cārcanaṃ ca janmāntaratapaḥphalam | bhaktiścāśīrvādaphalaṃ sevā saubhāgyamityapi ||3.48.50|| mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya yā hariṃ nārcayet satī | mūrkhī saiva jaḍabuddhirnārī punarbhaviṣyati ||5 1 || tasyāścātīva mūrkhāyā vivekaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati| ārādhito hariḥ kṛṣṇo dadātyabhimataṃ phalam ||52|| caṇḍālo vā nikṛṣṭo vā malinaḥ pāpavānapi | gaṇikā vā śīlahīnā vyavāyādiparāyaṇā ||53|| aśuddhā vā sūtikā vā viṣṇubhaktā dvijādhikā | viṣṇubhaktivihīnā tu dvijāpi śvapacī ca vā ||54|| tasmāddhariṃ prasevyaiva toṣayetparameśvaram | mayi tuṣṭe’khilaṃ tuṣṭaṃ sarvātmāhaṃ yato’smi ca ||55|| hastipade sarvapadaṃ gagane sārvabhautikam | anādiśrīharau tadvanmayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||56|| janmamṛtyū prāntabhāgau tannāśo mama sevayā | dhyātaḥ smṛtaḥ pūjito vā praṇato voddharāmyaham ||57|| saṃsārapāśavicchedaṃ karomi kṛpayā sadā | mannāmoccāraṇādeva mahāpātakanāśanam ||58|| manmūrteḥ smaraṇādeva brahmabhāvo bhavedapi | matsatīsevayā mokṣagāmitvaṃ syād drutaṃ priye ||59|| nīyamānā yamabhaṭairaśaktā svavimocane | apuṇyāpi smarenmāṃ ca tāmuddharāmi kaṣṭataḥ ||3.48.60|| vidrāvya yāmyadūtām̐śca nayāmi matpadaṃ priyām | smarantī māṃ śaraṇāptāmabalāṃ dīnamānasām ||61 || anāthāṃ paravaśagāṃ puṇyapuñjavivarjitām | ālambavarjitāṃ nirādhārāmuddhārayāmyaham ||62|| yāvannendriyavaikalyaṃ yāvadvyādhirna bādhate | tāvat prasevya māṃ sādhvī muktimārgaṃ hi klṛptayet ||63|| kṛṣṇaḥ sarvātmanā pūjyo dhyeyaśca mādhavaḥ sadā | hariḥ sevyaḥ sadā sādhvyā prasādanīyaḥ keśavaḥ ||64|| anārādhya jagannāthaṃ brahmapriyāntarasthitam | paramānandalābho na saṃsevya taṃ sukhaṃ vrajet ||65|| acyutānantagovindakṛṣṇamādhavakeśava | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa dāmodara prabho ||66|| hare kṛṣṇa vibho rāma nārāyaṇa narāyaṇa | ṛṣīkeśākṣarātīta parabrahma pareśvara ||67|| puruṣottama mukteśa brahmeśa ca janārdana | bhagavan vyāpaka svāminnuccārayet satī sadā ||68|| evaṃ māṃ bhajamānāyā dūre nāhaṃ vasāmi vai | sā mayyahaṃ ca tasyāṃ ca vartāmi sarvadā priye ||69|| nārāyaṇa jagannātha kambharātmaja kāmada | gopālakṛṣṇatanaya vāsudeva janārdana ||3.48.70|| kānta dānta mahānandaprada śrīparameśvara | satīnātha satāṃnāthetīrayanti muhurhi yāḥ ||71 || tāsāṃ pūjāṃ prakurvanti brahmādyā api devatāḥ | vanditāstā bhavantyeva sarvatra kamalā yathā ||72|| yatprabhāvaṃ na jānanti yā māyāvṛtamānasāḥ | hṛtpadmasthaṃ naṃ jānanti tāsāṃ hānirmahattamā ||73|| hariḥ śraddhāvatāṃ tuṣyenna dhanairna ca bāndhavaiḥ | nātmaguṇairna tapasā bhaktyā tuṣyejjanārdanaḥ ||74|| sevayā cātituṣyecca pūjayā smaraṇena ca | ātmārpaṇena tuṣyecca toṣayantu tataḥ priyāḥ ||75|| putramitrasmṛddhayaśca bahvyo bhavanti sampadaḥ | haripūjāratānāṃ vai durlabhāḥ santi tā nahi ||76|| ihāmutra sukhavāñcchāvatī sampūjayeddharim | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ puruṣottamam ||77|| na namedviṣṇave yasyā mastakaṃ, mokṣadāyine | karmaṇāṃ bhedine tasyā deho bodhyo’ghaśevadhiḥ ||78|| haribhaktiyuto deho divyo bodhyaḥ striyā api | śreṣṭhā bhaktyā bhavantyeva bhaktihīnā kaniṣṭhikāḥ ||79|| pūjanīyāstato lakṣmi yoṣito bhaktisaṃbhṛtāḥ | sammārjanādibhiryāstu mama śuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ ||3.48.8 0|| satāṃ samāgamakartryastā yānti paramaṃ padam | haridharmaratāḥ śāntā haripādābjasevikāḥ ||8 1 || harikāryaparāḥ kṛṣṇakṛṣṇaraṭanatatparāḥ | romaromasu kṛṣṇasya premanisyandarājitāḥ ||82|| ahaṃ kṛṣṇāpyahaṃ kṛṣṇā ceṣṭā evaṃ samāśritāḥ | gṛhāṇa vaṃśīṃ kuñje ca samāyāhīti śabditāḥ ||83 || ekāntaṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇātra rahasyaṃ me pradehi ca | premarasaṃ mahānandaṃ māṃ prapāyaya kuñjagām ||84|| antarbhāvarasaṃ kṛṣṇa saṃgamotthaṃ prapāyaya | tādātmyasnehamāpannāṃ kuru spaṣṭāṃ ca kiṃkarīm ||85|| aṃkadāsīṃ rāyanasya sakhīṃ vidhehi mādhava | nirjanasya sarasaśca vidhehi padminīṃ prabho ||86|| payaḥphenanibharātrervidhehi śāradīṃ vibho | vasantasya ca vallīṣu vidhehi kokilāṃ hare ||87|| śaityartormāṃ kṛpāṃ kṛtvā kambalinīṃ vidhehi ca | sarvayajñasya kāryasya vedīṃ vidhehi māṃ tviha ||88|| viśrāntyarthaṃ kṛpāsindho tūlikāṃ māṃ vidhatsva nu | agnitaptasya kāntasya śītāṃ kāntāṃ vibhāvaya ||89|| nirālambasamādheśca brahmānandīṃ priyāṃ kuru | māyāyuktasya kṛṣṇasya muktānikāṃ pujasva mām ||3.48.90|| sarvākṛṣṭasya cittasya magnasthalīṃ vidhāpaya | premapravāhasaritāṃ sāmudrikīṃ nibhālaya ||91 || amānodgatamodasya bhinnamūrtiṃ svakāṃ kuru | samarasmarayuktasya vāhinīṃ tava māṃ kuru ||92|| kaustubhasya viyuktasyāsanībhūtaṃ ca hṛt kuru | premabimbādharasyātrādhāralatāṃ suyojaya ||93|| padmapatrāyatanetre netrayorbimbake kuru | pūrṇāmāvārdhitulyāyāḥ kaumudīśo bhavātra me ||94|| sādhvyā svāmī cakorāyāścandraḥ kṛṣṇo bhavātra me | śalabhāyāścānalaśca timyāḥ kaṇṭaraso bhava ||95|| cātakyāstu svātivarṣā mayūryā jalado bhava | navavadhvā varaśreṣṭha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhava ||96 || virahāgnipradāvāyā yogivāriprado bhava | bhavābdhigartamagnāyāḥ karagrāho harirbhava ||97|| netre hṛdi ca manasi cetane nihito bhava | sarvendriyeṣu sukhadaścāntareṣu sthiro bhava ||98|| ānakhaśikhamāsādya yāvān yāvatsu me vasa | ityevaṃ śivarājñīśri mayi tādātmyayojanam ||99|| yāyād yā sā brahmapriyā haripriyā bhavediha | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya rādhālakṣmīsamā bhavet || 3.48.10 0|| mama tādātmyayogo’yaṃ kalpabhaktyā bhavennanu | naro nārī ca sampādya madātmakatvamāvrajet || 101 || apātraṃ bhaktihīnaṃ vai nāyaṃ pacati tasya vai | vadhūgītāṃ purā śrutvā sadācāraparā bhavet || 1 02|| satī bhūtvā nirguṇaṃ ca bhaktiyogaṃ tataścaret | puruṣottamayogaṃ ca prapātya tanmayī bhavet || 10 3|| tataḥ sākṣāt parabrahmayogayuktā bhaved dhruvā | tayā tādātmyayogo’yaṃ prāpyate matkṛpāvaśāt || 1 04|| sarvā vadhvo bhavantyevaṃ paripūrṇatame mayi | lokanāryastathā bhūtvā bhaviṣyanti madātmikāḥ || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne akṣarātītatādātmyayoganirūpaṇanāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 48 ||
<3.49> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca kṛpānātha ramānātha sarvānātha satāṃ pate | yā puṇyapuñjarahitā bubhukṣukoṭikā bhavet || 1 || tasyā bījabalārthaṃ vai kiṃ vidheyaṃ bhavediha | ādyārambhe mumukṣutābhāvasya vada me hare || 2 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ pāpāyā api śuddhaye | kramabhāvaṃ kathayāmi yena cāntapadaṃ labhet || 3 || ārtikāle vipatkāle tasyai vācyaṃ balaṃ mama | smṛto’pi manasā kṛṣṇo vipannāśaṃ karoti vai || 4 || sā smarenmāṃ tataścāsyai sakāmāyai vrataṃ śubham | lakṣmīnārāyaṇākhyaṃ vai vācyaṃ kuryāt tato hi sā || 5 || dehaśuddhiṃ pañcagavyairvidadhyācca tataḥ param | mama prāsādikaṃ vāri pibedācamanīyakam || 6 || upavāsaṃ prakuryācca mama pūjanamācaret | śṛṇuyādvai vadhūgītāṃ mantrān me śṛṇuyāttataḥ || 7 || śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mama sarvadā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā || 8 || kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt | śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava || 9 || brāhamyahaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktāsmi śāśvatī | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me ||1 0|| bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ | pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ poṣako’stu saḥ || 11 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhaktavallabhaḥ | parabrahmākṣarātīto’vatārāṇāṃ svarūpadhṛk || 12|| antaryāmī sadāsmatsu bhagavān sarvakāraṇam | sarvāntarātmā sarveśo nirlepo mokṣadaḥ sa hi || 13 || pāvanaḥ sevito bhuktimuktidaśca sadāvatu | brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca rādhālakṣmyādiyoṣitaḥ || 14|| parabrahmasvarūpiṇyaḥ parabrahmārdhamūrtayaḥ | parabrahmārthasarvasvā divyā bhuktipramuktidā || 15|| tatsambandhikriyāścāpi nirguṇā mokṣadāḥ sadā | yo yo yā yā bālakṛṣṇaṃ tatpriyāśca bhajatyapi || 16|| sa sa sā sā tatsvarūpā divyā mokṣapradā sadā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||17|| śrīkṛṣṇasvāmibhaktāhaṃ śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama | śrīkṛṣṇaḥśrīvallabhaśca śrīsvāmī śaraṇaṃ mama || 18|| śrīkṛṣṇovallabhaḥsvāmīśrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama | ityetān sarvamantrāṃśca sārthān saṃśrāvayet guruḥ | pūjanaṃ sarvatobhadramaṇḍale kārayenmama || 1 9|| pūjāvidhiṃ pravakṣyāmi vratāṃgaṃ śṛṇu sarvathā | upavāsadinaṃ grāhyaṃ mārgaśīrṣasya pūrṇimā | prātaḥsnānaṃ vidhāyāpi tīrthādau jalamarpayet ||20 || pitṛbhyaśca gṛhaṃ gatvā nārī nārāyaṇaṃ smaret | prakṣālya pādāvācamya śuddhāmbaradharā satī | nityaṃ devārcanaṃ kṛtvā paścāt saṃkalpapūrvakam ||21 || lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ devamarcayed bhaktibhāvataḥ | jalasya kalaśaṃ dhṛtvā sugandhajalasaṃbhṛtam ||22|| pañcāmṛtāni cādāya sauvarṇaṃ śrīnarāyaṇam | śuddhapātre nidhāyaiva pañcāmṛtādibhirjalaiḥ ||23|| snāpayeddhārayeccāpi vastrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca | arcayed gandhapuṣpādyaiścandanaistailakuṃkumaiḥ ||24|| dhūpadīpasunaivedyamūlaphalajalādibhiḥ | tāmbūlārārtrikastotravandanābhyarthanādibhiḥ ||25|| gītairvādyaiśca nṛtyaiśca saṃhitāpāṭhanādibhiḥ | saṃkīrtanaṃ prakuryādvai vratakartrī samāhitā ||26|| devasya purataḥ kṛtvā sthaṇḍilaṃ caturasrakam | aratnimātraṃ tatrāgniṃ sthāpayitvā ghṛtādibhiḥ ||27|| caruṇā ca tilādyaiśca juhuyād bhāvataḥ svayam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇābhyāṃ svāheti sā juhuyāttadā ||28|| aṣṭottaraśatahomān sarvapāpanivṛttaye | prāyaścittādikaṃ gurvī kārayet tāṃ tataḥ param ||29|| punaḥ pūjāṃ vidhāyaiva parīhāraṃ vidhāpayet | upacārādi devāya hyarpayed bhaktisaṃyutā ||30|| paurṇamāsyāṃ kṛtaṃ vrataṃ samarpayāmi te prabho | arghyaṃ dadyādindave’pi namaskuryāt supuṣpakaiḥ ||3 1 || akṣatādyaistataḥ kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ niśāntakam | saṃhitāśravaṇaṃ kuryānnṛtyaṃ ca kīrtanādikam ||32|| prātaḥ snātvā satīḥ sādhūn bhojayecca tataḥ svayam | pūjayitvā patiṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ ca bhojanam ||33|| pāraṇāṃ ca prakurvīta viprām̐śca bhojayedapi | evaṃ pauṣādimāseṣu saṃvatsaraṃ vrataṃ caret ||34|| kārtikyāṃ ca prakurvītodyāpanaṃ pūrṇimātithau | maṇḍapaṃ kārayed ramyaṃ caturasraṃ sumaṃgalam ||35|| kadalīstambhaśobhāḍhyaṃ navapallavatoraṇam | kalaśādyaiḥ śobhitaṃ ca dīpāvalivirājitam ||36|| puṣpamālādisaṃyuktaṃ vitānadhvajamaṇḍitam | tanmadhye sarvatobhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ pañcavarṇakam ||37|| tanmadhye ratnavāryāḍhyaṃ nūtnaṃ kumbhaṃ nyaset satī | pañcapallavavastrādyaiḥ śobhitaṃ ca tadūrdhvake ||38|| tilasthālyāṃ sthāpayenmāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ harim | pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpyābhyarcya gandhādibhiḥ kramāt ||39|| vastrabhūṣādibhiścāpi bhakṣyabhojyādibhistathā | siṃhāsane sthāpayenmāmārārtrikottaraṃ tataḥ ||40|| kathākīrtanabhajanairdivasaṃ ca prayāpayet | madhyāhne niśi pūjāṃ ca kārayejjāgaraṃ kriyāt ||41 || pare’hni prātareveyaṃ śrīpatiṃ māṃ samarcayet | sādhvībhyo bhojayeccāpi tato bhojanamācaret ||42|| gurvībhyaḥ sampradadyācca mūrtiṃ tilān tathetarat | tilahomaṃ prakuryāccārthayellakṣmīnarāyaṇam ||43|| kṛpayā tava deveśa kṛtaṃ sāmvatsaraṃ vratam | lakṣmīḥ prasannā bhavatu nārāyaṇaḥ prasādavān ||44|| bhaktāṃ māṃ sarvathā naijīṃ kṛtvā gṛhāṇa mādhava | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ dehi me tvaṃ kānta śrīpuruṣottama ||45|| phalaṃ samastamevāhaṃ cārpayāmi tvayi prabho | iti vyāhṛtya dadyācca puṣpāñjaliṃ namettataḥ ||46|| evaṃ kṛtvā parīhāraṃ visarjanaṃ samācaret | nityaṃ kathāṃ śṛṇuyācca satsaṃgaṃ ca samācaret ||47|| puṇyapuñjāśrayā bhūtvā sā yāyānme’kṣaraṃ padam | iha bhuktvā mahābhogān putrapautrasamanvitā ||48|| sarvapāpavinirmuktā kulāyutasamanvitā | prayāti mama bhavanaṃ yogināmapi durlabham ||49 || muktā divyā bhavedatra mama yogena bhāminī | brāhmī bhavettato brahmapriyā haripriyā tataḥ ||50|| sarvasiddhisamāyuktā sarvaiśvaryādiśālinī | yathā lakṣmīryathā rādhā tathā syānme priyā tataḥ ||51 || śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca vrataṃ kartumaśaktāyāḥ pāpāyāḥ pāpanāśakam| vinā prathatnaṃ saralaṃ sulabha sādhanaṃ vad ||52|| śrīpuruṣottama uvāca abalāyāstu pāpāyā vratāsamarthayoṣitaḥ | gurvarpaṇaṃ guruṃ nāvaṃ samāśrityāghanāśanam || 53|| gurutīrthe tu yā snātā śuddhyet sā drutameva ha | svargiṇī jāyate sadyo mokṣaṃ sveṣṭaṃ ca vindati ||54|| gurutīrthe parā siddhistīrthānāṃ paramaṃ hi tat | dhyānaṃ tīrthaṃ haristīrthaṃ brahmatīrthaṃ sanātanam ||55|| indriyāṇāṃ vṛttayo vai nivartante tu yatsthale | manobuddhyośca nirvṛttiryatra saṃjāyate parā ||56|| ātmaśāntirbhaveccāpi sadgurostu pratāpataḥ | evaṃvidhe gurau tīrthe snāyāt sarvārpaṇena vai ||57|| gakārastvandhakāraḥ syād rakārastannirodhakaḥ | gurvī sāsti samarthā vai cāndhakāranirodhikā ||58|| jñānaṃ dadyādātmanastu dhyānaṃ dadyāddharestathā | vivekaṃ pāpapuṇyānāṃ dadyājjaḍacidorapi ||59|| śubhāśubhānāṃ bhānaṃ ca dadyād doṣanivāraṇam | mumukṣutāṃ bhāvayecca yā sā gurvī hi tāriṇī ||3.49.60|| śāntiṃ dadyād vicāreṇa prasādena pavitratām | āśīrvādaṃ susnehena bhāgyaṃ dadyād balena ca ||6 1 || smṛddhiṃ dadyāttapobhiśca bhaktyā dadyāddhariṃ tu yā | mokṣaṃ dadyāt sahagatyā gurvī sā saṃśrayāt sadā ||62|| mantraṃ dadyāddhareryā ca kaṇṭhīṃ dadyācca taulasīm | nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ dadyāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca ||63|| snehaṃ dadyāddharau tasya māhātmyajñānamuttamam | divyatābhānamādadyāt tāṃ gurvīṃ saṃśrayet satī ||64|| yasyāḥ pādajalaṃ pāpaprakṣālakaṃ bhaved dhruvam || yasyāḥ prasādajaṃ cānnaṃ vāsanākṣālakaṃ bhavet ||65|| yasyāḥ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ vastraṃ dehayogagataṃ jaḍam | divyaṃ pavitraṃ puṇyaṃ ca mokṣadaṃ vartate śubham ||66|| yasyā deho’sti bhagavaddeha eva na saṃśayaḥ | yāsti vai nirguṇā nityaṃ nirguṇasya hareḥ priyā ||67|| mahābhāgavatī divyā sarvadātmanivedinī | tasyāḥ pādarajaścāpi pāpinīnāṃ tu pāvanam ||68|| kṣālakaṃ mūlataścāste mokṣadaṃ jāyate tathā | rādhālakṣmīsamā gurvī ramāpadmāsamā hi sā ||69|| preṣṭhāpadmāvatītulyā padminīmāṇikīsamā | kamalāśrīsamā pārśvavartinārāyaṇīsamā||3.49.70|| tasyāḥ keśeṣu bhagavatkeśāḥ santi nivāsitāḥ brahmarandhre hareḥ randhraṃ mastake mastakaṃ hareḥ ||7 1 || bhāle bhālaṃ hareścāsti bhrukuṭau bhrūkuṭirhareḥ | netrayorharinetre ca karṇau hareśca karṇayoḥ ||72|| medhāyāṃ śrīharermedhā harergaṇḍau ca gaṇḍayoḥ | kapolayoḥ kapolau ca harernāsā nasi prabhoḥ ||73|| tasyā mukhe ca jihvāyāṃ danteṣu coṣṭhayorhareḥ | mukhaṃ jihvā ca dantāśca hyoṣṭhau hanau hanūrhareḥ ||74|| tasyāḥ kaṇṭhe hareḥ kaṇṭho harervakṣastu vakṣasi | bhujayorhastayorbāhvoścāṃguliṣu nakheṣu ca ||75|| harerbhujau karau bāhū cāṃgulyaśca nakhāstathā | kukṣau kukṣirharestasyā udare hyudaraṃ hareḥ ||76 || nābhau nābhirharestasyā jaghane jaghanaṃ hareḥ | kaṭyāṃ kaṭirharestasyāḥ pṛṣṭhe pṛṣṭhaṃ harestathā ||77|| gupte guptaṃ hareścāpi sakthnorharestu sakthinī | jānvostasyā harerjānū jaṃghe ca jaṃghayorhareḥ ||78|| pādayoḥ phaṇayoścāpi hareḥ pādau phaṇāvapi | asthiṣu śrīhareḥ santi cāsthīni tvak tvacītyapi ||79|| romasu śrīhareḥ santi romāṇi mānase manaḥ | indriyāṇīndriyeṣvasyā guṇeṣu ca harerguṇāḥ ||3.49.80|| bhūteṣvasyā harestattvaṃ cāntare cāntaraṃ tathā | jñānecchāyatnadharmeṣu harerjñānādayastathā ||81|| kriyāyāṃ śrīhareścāsyāḥ kriyāśceṣṭā harestathā | hasanaṃ gamanaṃ yānaṃ kīrtanaṃ svapanaṃ tathā ||82|| gurvyāḥ sarvaṃ hareścāste tasmād gurvī hi tāriṇī | mokṣadā bhavapārasthā divyā divyagatipradā ||83|| gurvyā padośca tīrthāni pṛthivī vartate sadā | jaṃghayorvaruṇo devo jānvoḥ kuberako’sti ca ||84|| sakthnorindraśca śeṣaśca kaṭyāṃ dharmo virājate | hiraṇyagarbhaṃ udare jaghane vahnidevatā ||85|| nitambayostu nāsatyau vakṣasi śrīhariḥ svayam | stanayoḥ parvatāścaiva kukṣiṣu sāgarāstathā ||86|| romasvoṣadhayaḥ sarvāḥ pārśvayordevatāgaṇāḥ | kaṇṭhe sarasvatī cāste mukhe lakṣmīrvirājate ||87|| netrayoḥ sūryacandrau ca mastake brahma rājate | hastayoścāpyannapūrṇā durgā cāpi virājate ||88|| hṛdaye dharmavaṃśaśca mānase’syā haripriyāḥ | puṇyaṃ sādhvyā vacaneṣu śṛṃgāre smṛddhayastathā ||89|| gurvyā prasannatāyāṃ vai bhuktimuktirvirājate | āśīrvāde ceṣṭasukhaṃ bhāgyamāste ca darśane ||3.49.90|| bhojane yajñabhuk cāste pāne’mṛtaṃ virājate | rūpe ca śāradā devī lāvaṇye ca sudhāsti vai ||91 || pitaro’syāḥ samaudārye maharṣayo vrate tathā | sādhavo’syā bhāvanāyāṃ bhaktiścātmani rājate || 92|| gāvo’syā hastatalayorvasavo’syāḥ praharṣaṇe | rudrāścāsyā bhrukuṭau ca bhāskarā gaṇḍayostathā ||93|| oṣṭhayorbhagavanmāyā gurvyā divyā virājate | gurvyāsane’kṣaraṃ brahma gaṃgā pādukayostathā || 14|| gurvyāḥ śāṭyāṃ mahālakṣmīḥ kañcukyāṃ rādhikāsti ca | kaṭyambare surāṇyaśca bhūṣāsu śrīramādayaḥ ||95|| yajñopavīte trailokyaṃ yogapaṭṭe’ṣṭasiddhayaḥ | saubhāgyadravyapuñjeṣu sampado’syā vasanti ca ||96|| gurvyāstvaci ca sarvatra santi sthāvarajaṃgamāḥ | śarīramadhye sarvatra santi brahmavibhūtayaḥ ||97|| aiśvarye ceśvarāścāsyāścamatkāreṣu mātaraḥ | brahmavrataṃ ca śīle’syāstādātmye’haṃ pareśvara ||98|| gupte’syāḥ saguṇaṃ brahma sakthnormūle susṛṣṭayaḥ | rāje’haṃ gururūpāyāṃ gurvī cāhamahaṃ ca sā ||99|| asyā vai sevayoddhāraḥ pāpāyā api jāyate | api yā gaṇikā vāpi puṃścalī madyapāyinī || 3.49.10 0|| māṃsādā sarvabhakṣyā vā hatyāḍhyā śvapacī ca vā | gurvyāḥ satsaṃgaśaraṇāśrayasevādibhirhi sā | pūyate niṣkalmaṣā syād dīvyati prottaratyapi || 10 1|| māyākālakriyāpāśānmuktā muktiṃ prayāti me | paṭhanācchavaṇāccāsya mama muktiṃ prayāti vai || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ pāpoddhārakalakṣmīnārāyaṇavrataśrīharigurugurvītīrthamahimavarṇananāmā navacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 49 ||
<3.50> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca gurutīrthasya māhātmyaṃ bhūyo’pi vada me pate | jijñāsā vardhate śrotuṃ sulabhaṃ gurutīrthakam || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca dhanyāsi kṛtakṛtyāsi gurutīrthāvagāhinī | yoṣitāṃ dayayā lakṣmi śreyaḥkarī yato hyasi || 2 || kathayāmi tathā bhūyo gurutīrthaṃ niśāmaya | sarvapāpaharaṃ cāpi śiṣyāṇāṃ mokṣadāyakam || 3 || divyatāpādakaṃ puṇyaṃ dharmātmakaṃ sanātanam | sarvaiśvaryānvitaṃ śīghraṃ pratyakṣaphaladāyakam || 4 || guroḥ prasādāt kamale ihaiva phalabhāg bhavet | paralokasukhaṃ bhuṃkte mahānandamavānuyāt || 5 || guroḥ prasādāt kamale trailokyaṃ sacarācaram | pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate śiṣyairīśalokagatiṃ prati || 6 || avyāhatagatimān syād vijñānaṃ vindate tathā | yaśaḥ kīrti vyavahāraṃ prādhānyaṃ kṛpayā labhet || 7 || sūryavat sarvathā guruḥ prakāśako’ndhacakṣuṣām | somavacchāntidaścāpi prakāśado niśātmake || 8 || dīpavad gṛhahṛdaye prabhādo vai guruḥ sadā | divā sūryaḥ śaśī rātrau dīpo gṛhe guruḥ sadā || 9 || prakāśate śiṣyahṛdi gururbrahmaprakāśakṛt | ato guruḥ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tārakaṃ jñānadānakaiḥ || 3.50.10 || vijñāyaivaṃ guruṃ gurvī sarvabhāvaiḥ prasādayet | karmabhirmanasā dehairvāṇyā ca sevayā tathā || 11 || atrārthe te kathayāmi kathāṃ divyāṃ manoharām | brahmaputro bhṛgustasya vaṃśe’bhūccyavano muniḥ || 1 2|| kadāhaṃ jñānasampannaḥ syāmityacintayan muhuḥ | tadarthaṃ tīrthayātrāyāmagamajjñānalabdhaye || 13|| gaṃgāyātrāṃ badarītaścākapilāśramaṃ vyadhāt | godāvaryāḥ sarasvatyā narmadāyāstathā vyadhāt || 14|| kāyaśca nirmalo jātaḥ sūryatejaḥsamaprabhaḥ | oṃkāreśvaramāsādya vaṭacchāyāsthito’bhavat || 15|| narmadāyā jalaṃ pītvā kṣaṇaṃ dhyānaparo’bhavat | tatra śuśrāva pakṣiṇāṃ bhāṣāṃ vijñānasaṃbhṛtām || 16|| śukaputrā hi catvāraścāsaṃste pitṛnandanāḥ | ujjvalaśca samujjvalo vijvalaśca kapiñjalaḥ || 17|| ete kuṃjalaśukajāḥ pitṛmātṛparāyaṇāḥ | phalānyāhṛtya pitṛbhyāṃ dadatyapi ca bhuñjate || 18|| krīḍanti pitṛnikaṭe mātṛsannidhimutsukāḥ | svapanti ca cyavanasya paśyato nityameva te || 19|| sāyamāgatya te sarve nityaṃ sevāṃ caranti ca | āgatāste caritvaiva piturnīḍaṃ sukhāvaham ||3.50.20|| pitaraṃ mātaraṃ cobhau praṇemuśca phalāni ca | daduścāpi ca pitṛbhyāṃ mānitāḥ śrāntimāsthitāḥ ||21 || sambhāṣitāḥ sevitāśca pakṣavātādibhiśca te | sevante sma pitarau ca pitarau dadatustadā ||22|| śubhāśīrvacanānyeva tataḥ papraccha tān pitā | ujjvala tvaṃ cādya kasyāṃ diśāyāṃ vai gato’bhavaḥ ||23|| tatra dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ cāpyapūrvaṃ cenme nivedaya | śrutvojjvalaḥ praṇamyaiva pitaraṃ prāha tatkathām ||24|| gaṃgādvīpaṃ jagāmādya rājā yatra hi dhārmikaḥ | divodāso vartate vai satyadharmaparāyaṇaḥ |||25|| brāhmīdevī tasya patnī pātivratyaparāyaṇā | suṣuve guṇarūpāḍhyāṃ suśīlāṃ cārumaṃgalām ||26|| divyādevītivikhyātāṃ kanyāṃ lāvaṇyaśevadhim | prathame vayasi divyāṃ varayogyāṃ vilokya ca ||27|| pitā kāmarūpadeśarājaṃ citraprasenakam | āhūya kanyāṃ pradadau citrasenāya dhīmate ||28|| vivāhayajñe rājā sa citraseno mamāra ha | akṛtāgnipradakṣiṇā kanyā saubhāgyavarjitā ||29|| abhavad vai tadā rājā viprān papraccha kāraṇam | asyā vivāhasamaye citraseno divaṃ gataḥ ||3.50.30|| asyā vai kīdṛśaṃ karma bhavatyeva bruvantu me | śrutvā viprāḥ samāhurvai lagnakālastathāvidhaḥ ||21 || patimṛtyuśca vā patyuḥ pravrajitā ca rugṇatā | atha rājā ca kālena tvindraprasthapuraṃ yayau ||32|| indraprasthanṛparūpasenāyemāṃ samārpayat | rūpaseno’pi vai mṛtyuṃ gato vivāhanakṣaṇe ||33 || evaṃ yadā yadā yasmai rājā dadāti kanyakām | tadbhartā vahnisākṣye vai mṛtyuṃ gacchati satvaram ||34|| ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyākā varā mṛtyuṃgatāstathā | kanyā tvāste cākṣatā vai divodāsaḥ śuśoca ha ||35|| tato mantrivaco matvā svayaṃvaraṃ vyadhāpayat | rājāno bahavastatra samāhūtāḥ samantataḥ ||36|| svayaṃvarasabhāmadhye yadā prāptā kumārikā | rādhāsamāṃ candramukhīṃ vyalokayan nṛpāstadā ||37|| adattavaramālāyā rūpaṃ vīkṣya tu tāmasāḥ | rājāno mohamāpannā haraṇārthaṃ samudyatāḥ ||38|| anye tasyāstu rakṣārthaṃ tadaivaṃ samaro’bhavat | tatra mahān kṣayo jātaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ svayaṃvare ||39|| divyādevī suduḥkhārtā vairāgyaṃ samupāgatā | yayau vindhyācale taptuṃ tapastatra ruroda sā ||3.50.40|| mayā tasyā rodanaṃ vai śrutaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tadantike | pitastasyāḥ kathaṃ tādṛgbhāgyaṃ rājanyanāśakam ||41 || kumāratvaṃ vane vāsaścārdhaṃ vivāhanaṃ tathā | iti me saṃśayaścāsyāṃ vartate tanniṣūdaya ||42|| śrutvā putravacastatra śukaḥ kuṃjalako jagau | pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ śṛṇu putra hi kānyakam ||43|| sā kanyā pūrvamāsīdvai suvīravaiśyabhāminī | vārāṇasyāṃ ca nāmnā vai citrā svatantragāminī ||44|| anācāraparā pāpā svairiṇī vyabhicāriṇī | bhartāraṃ manyate naiva puṇyahīnā tu pāpinī ||45|| kutsayate patiṃ kleśakarī saddharmavarjitā | paragṛhe vasati bhramatyapi sā gṛhe gṛhe ||46|| paracchidraṃ paśyati drāk sādhunindāparā tathā | parahāsyakarī duṣṭā sadācāravivarjitā ||47|| suvīreṇa tu vaiśyena gṛhānniṣkāsitā hi sā | duṣṭānāṃ saṃgatiṃ prāptā dūtīkarma cakāra sā ||48|| kulaṭā ca vyabhicārakarma kārayati parāḥ | gṛhabhaṃgaṃ kārayati sādhūnāṃ dharmavartmanām ||49|| sādhvīṃ nārīṃ samāhūya dravyadānaiḥ pralobhayet | manobhaṃgaṃ kārayati vyavāye yojayatyapi ||3.50.50|| sādhūnāṃ sā striyaṃ bhaṅtvāpyanyasmai pradadātyapi | evaṃ gṛhaśataṃ bhagnaṃ citrayā duṣṭayā purā ||51|| saṃgrāmaṃ sā mahāduṣṭākārayat patiputrakaiḥ | evaṃ pāpaparā sā tu mṛtā yamapuraṃ gatā ||52|| bhuktvā ca yātanāḥ paścāt karmavipākamāgatā | sā tvidānīṃ kṛtaṃ karma bhuṃkte roditi bhāminī ||53 || yasmād gṛhaśataṃ tasmādasyāḥ śataṃ varāḥ | ekaviṃśatisahitā vivāhe ca svayaṃvare ||54|| pāpāyāḥ śubhasamaye tatsaṃkhyākā mṛtā varāḥ | gṛhabhaṃgo na kartavyo yasya kasyāpi dehinaḥ ||55|| parabhaṃge nijabhaṃgo jāyate naiva saṃśayaḥ | śrutvaivamujjvalaḥ prāha pitaścāsyā mahatkule ||56|| janma kathaṃ ca vai jātaṃ pāpāyā vada me’pi tat | śrutvā putravacaścāpi kuñjalaḥ prāha putrakam ||57|| dūtī yatrābhavat sā vai tatraikadā tu bhūsuraḥ | sādhudharmā siddhagatiḥ kucelo daṇḍavān yatiḥ ||58|| kaupīnamātravastraśca citrādvāramupasthitaḥ | maunī jitendriyo jñānī vrahmabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ||59|| tattvadarśī kṣudhātṛṣāvyāptaśca śramitaḥ sukhī | dūrādhvānapariśrāntaścitrayā sa vilokitaḥ ||3.50.60|| nāmnā kṛṣṇāyanaṃ citrā dṛṣṭvājuhāva taṃ gṛhe | āsanaṃ ca dadau vāri bhojanaṃ madhuparkakam ||61|| dehasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre sādhuṃ matvā susevanam | akarot sā prasannaḥ sā āśīrvādaṃ dadau śubham ||62|| rājaputrī bhavatvevaṃ kathayitvā yayau hi saḥ | atha kālāntare citrā mṛtyuṃgatā tatastviha ||63|| sādhoḥ sevāphalenāpi tadāśīrvādatastathā | divodāsagṛhe putrī divyādevī vyajāyata ||64|| sā hi dattavattī cānnaṃ jalaṃ sevāṃ tathāsanam | tasmāt puṇyasya māhātmyād rājaputrī hi vartate ||65|| gṛhabhaṃgādipāpaiśca hyadhavātvaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | sahate vai tataḥ sevā kartavyā satataṃ satām ||66|| guroḥ sevā prakartavyā sādhordharmavratasya ca | sādhvyāḥ sevā prakartavyā sarvasampatkarī hi sā ||67|| rājaputrā mṛtā ye ye te purā bhāṇḍajātayaḥ | nārīṇāṃ hārakāścāsan tena pāpena te mṛtāḥ ||68|| govipragurusādhūnāṃ sevāparāyaṇāḥ purā | āsam̐ścāpi ca vai tena rājaputratvamāgatāḥ |||69|| ataḥ sevyāḥ sādhavaśca guravaśca sadā hi tāḥ | parabhaṃgo gṛhabhaṃgo na kartavyaḥ kadācana ||3.50.70|| śrutvojjvalaḥ punastatra papraccha pitaraṃ prati | kathaṃ sā mucyate śokānmahāduḥkhād vadasva me ||71|| kathaṃ sā labhate mokṣaṃ taṃ copāyaṃ vadasva me | pitā ca kuñjalaḥ prāha śrutvā putraṃ tamujjvalam ||72|| śṛṇu putra pravakṣyāmi tasyā duḥkhavināśakam | sādhanaṃ mokṣaṇasyāpi yena śuddhā bhaviṣyati ||73|| harerdhyānājjapāccāpi vratācca gurusevanāt | pāpanāśo mokṣaṇaṃ ca bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ||74|| divyo nārāyaṇaścāste’kṣare dhāmni parātparaḥ | sarvajñaḥ sarvaśaktiśca sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ ||75|| kiśoraḥ sarvaśobhāḍhyaḥ śrīkāntaḥ parameśvaraḥ | māyikākāravarjyaḥ sa divyākārasamanvitaḥ ||76|| divyamukuṭamūrddhā ca divyacakrādiśobhanaḥ | koṭicandrābhavadanaḥ padmapatranibhekṣaṇaḥ ||77|| sarvabhūṣaṇaśobhāḍhyaḥ kaustubhena virājitaḥ | kamalākṛtasevaśca śrīvatsāṃkena rājitaḥ ||78||| manohārisvarūpaśca kāntaḥ kāntārhayauvanaḥ | evaṃ dhyāyet satī nityaṃ sarvapāpaviśodhakam ||79|| hare nārāyaṇa kṛṣṇa śrīpate kamalāpate | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīkṛṣṇamokṣakṛt ||3.50.80|| evaṃ kuryād bhajanaṃ vai japaṃ kuryāddhare iti | vrataṃ kuryāt pūrṇimāyā lakṣmīnārāyaṇavratam ||81|| udyāpanena sahitaṃ kṛṣṇapūjānvitaṃ śubham | gurostatra cyavanasya prakuryāt sevanaṃ hi sā ||82|| karmaṇā manasā vācā tadā duḥkhaṃ prahāsyati | ityuktaṃ sarvamevaitat pakṣyapatyaṃ praṇamya ca ||83|| piturājñāṃ samādāya yatra sā tatra vai yayau | pakṣibhāṣāṃ parityajya strīvāṇyā tāṃ jagāda ha ||84|| ujjvalaḥ sannidhau gatvā tāpasīṃ cedamabravīt | kā tvaṃ bhavasi kasyāsi kasmādatra samāgatā ||85|| samācakṣva tvamanaghe tapasaścāpi kāraṇam | divyādevī samuvāca pakṣyapatyaṃ vilokya sā ||86|| āścaryaṃ mahadāpannā pakṣin śṛṇu yathātatham | ko bhavān me vadatvatra viśvāso yena jāyate ||87|| pakṣī prāha mahābhāge pakṣyahaṃ tava duḥkhahāḥ | rudamānāṃ vilokyaitat pṛṣṭaṃ me vada kāraṇam ||88|| yathābalaṃ yatiṣye’haṃ tava duḥkhavināśane | śrutvā divyādevikā sā jagāda pakṣiṇaṃ prati ||89|| karmaṇāṃ me phalaṃ bhuṃje divodāsasutāsmi ca | śatādhikā hi patayo mṛtā udvāhanotsave ||3.50.90|| adhavāhaṃ hi tiṣṭhāmi tapo’rthamatra cāgatā | pāpanāśo bhaved yena tamupāyaṃ karomi ca ||9 1 || ujjvalaśca samākarṇya pitroktaṃ prāha yoṣite | sāpi tathyaṃ hi tanmene prāyaścittamiyeṣa sā ||92|| papraccha pakṣiṇaṃ pūrvakṛtapāpasya niṣkṛtim | ujjvalaḥ prāha viṣṇorvai dhyānaṃ kuru yathoditam ||93|| japaṃ kuru hare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa pareśvara | vrataṃ kuru śubhaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇavrataṃ param ||94|| pūrṇimāyāṃ nirāhāraṃ jāgaraṇasamanvitam | udyāpanasametaṃ ca guroḥ
