saṃsevanaṃ kuru ||95|| guruścātra cyavano’sti narmadāyāḥ śubhe taṭe | bhajasva taṃ mahātmānaṃ puṇyapuñjā bhaviṣyasi ||96|| ityuktā jagṛhe sarvaṃ pakṣitaḥ sā śubhodayā | vrataṃ cakre japaṃ cakre dhyānaṃ cakre harestathā ||97|| cyavanasya vaṭe sevāṃ cakre gatvā gurorhi sā | dehena manasā vācā sarvārpaṇena kanyakā ||98|| gurostu kṛpayā sādhvī varṣamadhye dadarśa ha | divyaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram ||99|| ghanaśyāmaṃ sundaraṃ ca śaṃkhacakragadādharam | sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ dṛṣṭvā nanāma pādayoḥ || 3.50.1 00|| daṇḍavad dharaṇiṃ prāpya cakāra gadgadābhavat | uvāca ca hariścāhaṃ kṛpayā tava cāgataḥ || 10 1|| guroḥ prasādalābhena jātaṃ me darśanaṃ tava | varaṃ vṛṇu mahābhāge dadāmi tava vāñchitam || 1 02|| śrutvā sā kanyakā vavre māmuddhara bhavārṇavāt | tava pādau bhajiṣyāmi kāntabhaktiṃ pradehi me || 1 03|| mokṣe dāsīpadaṃ dehi yadi tuṣṭo’si nātha me | hariḥ prāhāstvevameva cāyāhi mama dhāma vai || 1 04|| tāvat sāpyabhavad divyādevī lakṣmīsvarūpiṇī | vimānavaramāsādya yayau vaikuṇṭhameva sā || 1 05|| ujjvalaḥ pitaraṃ prāha vṛttāntaṃ sarvameva ha | pitā viveda sarvaṃ ca mahimānaṃ gurostadā || 1 06|| cyavanaḥ sarvakāmānāṃ pūrako vaiṣṇavo guruḥ | sevitaḥ kanyayā tena yātā sā brahmadarśanam || 1 07|| tenaiva divyadehena yātā mokṣapadaṃ satī | lakṣmīrjātāparā dhāmni dhyānajapavratādibhiḥ || 1 08|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya pāpāpi pāpaśodhitā | bhūtvā yāyāddharerdhāma lakṣmi kāntā bhavenmama || 1 09|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ gurutīrthe divyādevīmokṣaṇaṃ nāma pañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 50 ||
<3.51> śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kuñjalastu tataḥ param | dvitīyaṃ svasutaṃ cāpi papraccha vinayānvitam || 1 || samujjvala kimapūrvaṃ dṛṣṭavān śrutavān vada | śrutvā samujjvalaḥ prāha himavantaṃ giriṃ pitaḥ || 2 || āhārārthaṃ pragacchāmi paśyāmi kautukaṃ navam | mānasaṃ yatsaraścāste tatra dṛṣṭaṃ vadāmi tat || 3 || bahuhaṃsasamākīrṇo haṃsa ekaḥ samāgataḥ | sa ca kṛṣṇo mahātejāḥ kṛṣṇahaṃsānvitaḥ śubhaḥ || 4 || trayaścānye’pi śuklāśca cañcupādaistu kṛṣṇakāḥ | āyayuste caturṇṇāṃ vai patnyo haṃsyaḥ samāyayuḥ || 5 || bhayaṃkaryaścordhvakeśyaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇā vibhīṣaṇāḥ | kṛṣṇā haṃsā jale sasnurna sasnuśca trayo’pare || 6 || catasro haṃsikāścāpi naiva sasnuḥ sarovare | kṛṣṇā haṃsā jalāttasmādvinirgatyāyayurdrutam || 7 || trayo’nye haṃsakāścāpyāyayuruḍḍīya vindhyakam | śiṣṭāścatasro haṃsyo’pi vindhyācalamupāyayuḥ || 8 || haṃsā haṃsyo mahābhītā babhramuḥ paritastataḥ | niṣaṇṇā duḥkhadagdhāśca vṛkṣaśākhāsu saṃhitāḥ || 9 || tatra kaścit samāyāto lubdhakastu dhanurdharaḥ | śilāpṛṣṭhe niṣasāda bhillī tataḥ samāgatā || 3.51.1 0|| dvāvetau cyavanau dṛṣṭvā maharṣiṃ taṃ praṇematuḥ | cyavanasya pādajalaṃ pītvā divyau babhūvatuḥ || 11 || vimānavaramāruhya yayatuḥ svargameva tau | devau divyatamau bhūtvā hṛṣṭau sākṣānmayi hi tau || 12|| atha haṃsāstadoḍḍīya cyavanasyaiva pādayoḥ | rajassu te samaluṭhan tathā pādajalaṃ papuḥ || 1 3|| cyavanenābhiṣiktāste śvetā babhūvureva ca | kṛṣṇatvaṃ līnatāṃ prāptaṃ yayuścādṛśyatāṃ tataḥ || 14|| ke tvāsan vai pitarhaṃsāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇā hi te purā | paścāt śvetāḥ kathaṃ jātāḥ kva gatāste tataḥ param || 15|| kuñjalastat samākarṇya prāha putraṃ samujjvalam | śṛṇu putra kathayāmi divyaṃ kathānakaṃ tu tat || 16|| tānyāsan sarvatīrthāni cāṣṭaṣaṣṭimatāni vai | eteṣu mānavāḥ snātvā pāpāni kṣālayanti ca || 17|| govadhākhyaṃ mahāpāpaṃ strīvadhākhyaṃ tathāvidham | svāmidrohātmakaṃ pāpaṃ surāpānātmakaṃ tathā || 18|| hemasteyodgataṃ pāpaṃ gurunindātmakaṃ tathā | bhrūṇahatyā mahāghorā rājadrohastathāvidhaḥ ||19|| mitradrohaśca viśvāsaghātaśca devabhedanam | vṛtticchedo gocarasya nāśanaṃ vahnidāhanam || 3.51.20|| sādhusādhvīvināśaśca garadānaṃ bhayaṃkaram | mātāpitṛvadhaścāpi bālikābhoga ityapi ||21 || paśuhatyā mātṛsaṃgo viṃśatipātakāni vai | tathānyāni pātakāni mānavāḥ kṣālayanti hi ||22|| taiḥ pāpaiḥ kṛṣṇatāṃ yānti prāptāni tīrthakāni vai | tāni pāpāni sarvāṇi kṣālayituṃ nijāni hi || 23|| bhūtvā haṃsasvarūpāṇi gatāni mānasaṃ saraḥ | snātvā naiva vinaṣṭāni pāpāni tena vai punaḥ ||24|| narmadāyāstīramāptā haṃsāścāsan suduḥkhitāḥ | pāpaprakṣālanaṃ tīrthaṃ cintayanto drume sthitāḥ ||25|| tairdṛṣṭau divyarūpau ca vyādhīvyādhau divaṃgatau | parasparaṃ vadamānau cyavanasya gurorbalam ||26|| brahmahatyā gurughātaścāgamyāgamanādikam | gohatyā ca surāpānaṃ naṣṭaṃ gurorbalāddhi nau ||27|| divyau jātau svargayānau dhanyaṃ pādaṃ gurorbhuvi | itiśrutvā ca te haṃsāścyavanasyāntikaṃ yayuḥ ||28|| luluṭhuḥ pādarajasi pādavāri papuśca te | cyavano’pi tadā revatoyaiścāprokṣayaddhi tān ||29|| sarve haṃsāḥ śvetavarṇā bhūtvā natvā muniṃ muhuḥ | yayuścādṛśyatāṃ tatra haṃsā haṃsyo’pi sarvaśaḥ || 3.51.30|| gurutīrthaṃ pātakānāṃ śāmakaṃ paramottamam | sarvatīrthāni mānāni gurutīrthe bhavanti vai ||3 1 | kṛṣṇahaṃsānvitaścaiko yaścāsīt kṛṣṇahaṃsakaḥ | sarvatīrthasametaḥ sahyabhūt prayāgarājakaḥ ||32|| trayaścānye tu haṃsāste revā godā ca puṣkaram | haṃsyaścāpi catasrastā gaṃgā ca brahmaputrikā ||33|| sarasvatī ca kāverī hyāsaṃstatra hi haṃsikāḥ | ityetat kathitaṃ sarvaṃ gurutīrthaniṣevaṇam ||34|| sarvapāpaharaṃ mokṣapradaṃ vai gurutīrthakam | atha vai kuñjalaḥ putraṃ papraccha ca tṛtīyakam ||35|| kiṃ vijvala tvayā dṛṣṭamāścaryaṃ kathayātra me | vijvalaḥ pitaraṃ prāha nūtnaṃ vilokitaṃ tu yat ||36|| pitaścāhaṃ navalakṣābhidhaṃ vai parvataṃ yayau | devavṛndaiścāpsarobhiḥ ṛṣibhiḥ sevitaṃ śubham || 37|| divyavṛkṣaiḥ samākīrṇaṃ phalapuṣpanataiḥ sadā | yogino navalakṣāṇi vartante yatra parvate ||38|| ānandakānanaṃ nāma vanaṃ tatra prabhāsate | vimalaṃ ca sarastatra viśālaṃ cāvalokitam ||39|| yādobhirvividhairyuktaṃ haṃsakāraṇḍavādibhiḥ | kinnaroragagandharvaiścāraṇādyaiḥ suśobhitam ||3.51.40|| vimānaṃ tatra vārīṇāmupari cāmbare śubham | suvarṇakalaśairyuktaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ sahasā kānakam ||41|| chatradaṇḍapatākābhī rājamānaḥ pumān śubhaḥ | kinnarairapsarobhiśca gandharvādyairmaharṣibhiḥ ||42|| stūyamāno mahāsiddhairdṛṣṭaḥ surūpa uttamaḥ | sarvābharaṇaśobhāṃgo ratnahārādirājitaḥ ||43|| tatpārśve tvekakāntā ca varānanā suśobhitā | muktāhārayutā cāpi valayaiḥ kaṃkaṇairyutā ||44|| divyāmbarā suśṛṃgārā yuvatī cārcitā sthitā | tau dvau hṛṣṭau vimānāccāvarohayatāṃ bhūtale ||45|| snātavantau ca yāvattau mṛtau tāvaddhi tau taṭe | śavo divyau taṭe staśca tau dvau pṛthak taṭe sthitau ||46|| nāryau dve ca narau dvau ca tāveva vīkṣitau mayā | tatra vaimānikau dvau yau tau śastreṇa nijau śavau ||47|| bhakṣayāmāsatustatra nārī nārīṃ naro naram | kṣudhayā pīḍyamānau bhakṣayataḥ piśitaṃ nijam ||48|| anye dve ca striyau tāta cāyāte tvambarāt pṛthak | hasataḥ khādamānau tāvasmadyoge’pi nārpitam ||49|| annaṃ svalpaṃ jalaṃ svalpaṃ kasmaicittvapinārpitam | evaṃ tau bhakṣayitvaiva pītvā jalaṃ divaṃ prati ||3.51.50|| gatau vimānamāruhya dṛṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ mayā navam | kimetad vada me tāta svamāṃsabhakṣaṇaṃ kutaḥ ||51|| śrutvā putrasya tadvākyaṃ kuñjalaḥ prāha putrakam | śṛṇu vijvala loko’yaṃ karmabhūmirhi vartate ||52|| puṇyakarmā modate’tra paratra bhojanādibhiḥ | dattaṃ dānaṃ samāyāti purato yatra yāti saḥ ||53||| adattaṃ naiva cāyāti svarge’nyatra ca vā gataḥ | yādṛśaṃ vapate bījaṃ kṣetre tu kṛṣikārakaḥ ||54|| labhate tādṛśaṃ tatra phalaṃ bījasajātikam | yādṛśaṃ kriyate karma tādṛśaṃ labhyate phalam ||55|| karmadāyādako lokaḥ pūrvakarmavaśānugaḥ | pūrvaṃ dattaṃ kṛtaṃ caitat phalarūpaṃ niṣevyate ||96 || pañca sṛṣṭāni garbhe’sya dehinaḥ karmajāni vai | yaśovittaṃ jīvikā ca vidyā ca maraṇaṃ tathā ||57|| devatvaṃ vā mānuṣatvaṃ paśutvaṃ pakṣitāthavā | tiryaktvaṃ sthāvaratvaṃ ca smṛddhayo bhojanādikam ||58| ātmanā vihitaṃ yādṛk tādṛk samupatiṣṭhati | pūrvadehakṛtaṃ kaścit kartumalaṃ hi nānyathā ||59| śubhāśubhaṃ kṛtaṃ karma kartāramanugacchati | upabhogādṛte tasya nāśa eva na vidyate ||3.51.60 | suśīghramapi dhāvantaṃ svakarma cānudhāvati | upatiṣṭhati tiṣṭhantaṃ gacchantamanugacchati ||6 1 | chāyāvad vartate lagnaṃ bhogaṃ phalaṃ dadāti tat | yena yatropabhoktavyaṃ daivena tatra nīyate ||62| karmabhūmiriyaṃ tāta cānyā bhogāya dhūmayaḥ | colarājaḥ subāhvākhyo dadau dānāni bhūriśaḥ ||63|| ratnāni ca suvarṇāni rājatādīni koṭiśaḥ | annaṃ jalaṃ ca sulabhaṃ matvā dadau na tattadā ||64|| purodhāścolarājasya jaiministamupādiśat | śraddhayā vidhivat pātre dehi cānnaṃ dhanādikam ||65|| annadānāt paraṃ nāsti prāṇināṃ tṛptidaṃ drutam | tasmādannaṃ payoyuktaṃ pradehi kṣatriyarṣabha ||66|| tāraṇāya hitāyaiva sukhasampattihetave | grāsāgramapi dātavya muṣṭiprasthaṃ ca vā nṛpa ||67|| śraddhayā vā parvadine vipraṃ santaṃ prabhojaya | ekabhojanalabhyaṃ vai phalaṃ nityaṃ bhunakti hi ||68|| pūrvajanmani dattānnaṃ janmāntare sadā labhet | nityaṃ prabhujyate dattaṃ dehyannaṃ cāvicārayan ||69|| prāṇarūpaṃ yato’nnaṃ tat pradehi tvaṃ prayatnataḥ | svarge loke sadā cānnaṃ dattamamṛtamīyate ||3.51.70|| śrutvā nṛpatiḥ papraccha svargaguṇān vadātra me | jaiminiḥ svargalābhām̐ścākathayad vai subāhave ||71 || sarvakāmapradānyudyānāni svarge bhavanti vai | sarvartuphalapuṣpāṇi vimānāni ca santi vai ||72|| apsarasaśca divyāśca hemaśayyāsanāni ca | sarvakāmasamṛddhyo vidyante kalpavallijāḥ ||73 || na rogā na jarā mṛtyurna śoko na himātapau | na tatra kṣutpipāsā ca na glāniścāpi vidyate ||74|| evaṃvidhaguṇaṃ svargaṃ doṣām̐statrāpi tān śṛṇu | atra dattaṃ hi labhyeta nādattaṃ tatra labhyate ||75|| doṣo mahānayaṃ svarge’tiśayo doṣa ityapi | adattasyātra bhogyasyāsantoṣastatra vai sadā ||76|| anyaśriyaṃ parāṃ dṛṣṭvā samudvegaḥ sadāsti ca | akasmāt patanaṃ cāpi vāsanāvaśavartitā ||77|| phalabhūmirmatā dyauśca karmabhūmiriyaṃ matā | tasmādannaṃ pradattaṃ yat tatsvarge bhujyate suraiḥ ||78|| śrutvā nṛpaḥ ṛṣiṃ prāha nirdoṣaṃ vada me padam | jaiminiścāha bhagavatpadaṃ nirdoṣameva ha ||79|| ābrahmabhavanā lokāḥ sadoṣāḥ karmaṇārjitāḥ | māyālokāḥ samastā vai doṣavanto guṇātmakāḥ ||3.51.80|| aguṇaṃ tu padaṃ viṣṇornārāyaṇasya śārṅgiṇaḥ | bhaktiyogagatāstatra sādhvyo gacchanti sādhavaḥ ||81|| rājā prāha na me svargaṃ gantumicchā pravartate | yasmādvai patanaṃ tatra gantavyaṃ naiva sarvathā ||82|| dānaphalaṃ ca bhogo vai bhogānte patanaṃ yadi | dānameva na kartavyaṃ pātaphalaṃ mayā kvacit ||83|| kariṣye dhyānabhaktyādi yajiṣye kamalāpatim | dāhapralayavarjyaṃ ca gamiṣye paramaṃ padam ||84|| śrutvā taṃ jaiminiścāha rājan dharmo nṛpasya yaḥ | anicchatāpi kartavyo dānaṃ yajñaḥ pradānakam ||85|| ādāvannaṃ suyajñeṣu jalaṃ tāmbūlamambaram | kāñcanaṃ bhūmidānaṃ ca godānaṃ cetaracca yat ||86|| vaikuṇṭhe’pi phalaṃ bhuṃkte dānadharmasya śāśvatam | sādhubhyastu vibhāgaikaṃ gogrāsaṃ ca tataḥ param ||87|| bhṛtyādibhyaścaikabhāgaṃ prayacchanti tapodhanāḥ | evamannasya dānena divyalokagatā api ||88|| kṣudhātṛṣāvihīnāśca nityatṛptā hareḥ sthale | tiṣṭhanti nānyathā rājan dehyannaṃ dhanamityapi ||89|| dānājjñānaṃ tataḥ siddhistatastṛptiṃ gamiṣyasi | adāne tvaṃ gataścāpi vaikuṇṭhe kṣudhamāpyasi ||3.51.90|| śrutvā rājā tadā prāha dānaṃ cet tṛptikāraṇam | yogināṃ ca satāṃ tyāgavatāṃ mokṣe hi kā gatiḥ || 91 || adattadānāḥ ṛṣayaḥ karapātrā hi sādhavaḥ | aparigrahasarvasvā mokṣe tṛptāḥ kathaṃ vada ||92||| śrutvā prāha ṛṣistaṃ vai jñānabhaktiparāyaṇāḥ | mūrtyānandena tṛptāste sadā kṣuttṛḍvivarjitāḥ ||93|| rājā prāha tathaivāhaṃ yatiṣye jñānabhaktimān | dānaṃ bandhapradaṃ naiva kartavyaṃ niścikāya saḥ ||94|| jñānaṃ kṛtvā tathā svalpāṃ bhaktiṃ kṛtvā mamāra saḥ | subāhuḥ pramadāyukto vimānodagramāśritaḥ ||95|| yayau svargaṃ pūrvakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ bhoktaṃ vidhānataḥ | nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ svarṇādidānajam ||96|| kṣudhā jātā mahātīvrā tṛṣāpi ca tathāvidhā | rājā vai priyayā sārdhaṃ kṣudhātṛṣāprapīḍitaḥ ||97|| svarge ruddhaḥ karmaṇā vai vaikuṇṭhaṃ naiva gacchati | hṛṣīkeśo dṛśyate na vimānaṃ nordhvamṛcchati || 98|| svarge rājā vyākulo vai jātaḥ kṣudhādipīḍitaḥ | itaścetaśca vegaiśca dhāvati kṣmādhipastadā ||99|| sarvābharaṇaśobhāṃgaścandanādivibhūṣitaḥ | apsarobhiḥ sevyamāno devaiśca satkṛto’pi ca ||3.51.1 00|| adattaṃ nāptavān rājāmṛtaṃ cānnaṃ prabhojanam | jalaṃ ca nāptavān svarge babhrāma pīḍito muhuḥ || 10 1|| bhāryāṃ saṃprāha rājānaṃ satyaṃ dānaphalaṃ surāḥ | bhuñjate’mṛtamevātra dattamannaṃ purā tu yat || 10 2|| annavāripradānaṃ tu na kṛtaṃ bhūtale nṛpa | kṣudhā māṃ tvāṃ bādhate’tastṛṣā cogrā pravartate || 1 03|| bhojanaṃ salilaṃ cātra labhyate na vimānake | amṛtaṃ bhojanaṃ nāsti cānyadevagṛhe iva || 1 04|| yāmaḥ pṛthvyāṃ bhojanārthaṃ jalārthaṃ nanu pārthiva | ityukto bhūpatiḥ rājñyā vimānena drutaṃ kṣitim || 105|| ājagāma vane ramye nandane tatra vai ṛṣim | dadarśa vāmadevaṃ sa sabhāryo nṛpatistataḥ || 106|| avatīrya namaścakre dattāsane hyupāviśat | ṛṣikṛtaṃ svāgatādi jagrāhātha nirāmayam || 1 07|| pṛṣṭo rājā jagādarṣiṃ nirāmayo bhavāmi na | kṣudhā me bādhate cāpi tṛṣā cātīva dāruṇā || 1 08|| tābhyāṃ śāntiṃ na gacchāmi sukhaṃ vindāmi naiva ca | śrutvaiva vāmadevastaṃ prāha rājan hitaṃ śṛṇu || 1 09|| annadānaṃ jaladānaṃ tvayā dattaṃ na bhūtale | hariścārādhito naiva naivedyaphalavāribhiḥ || 3.51.11 0|| tena doṣeṇa svarge na vaikuṇṭhe’pi na te kṛte | bhojanaṃ vidyate rājan sarvamanyat pravidyate || 111 || ārādhitastvayā viṣṇurjñānabhaktyā tu śuṣkayā | tena prāptaṃ tvayā svargaṃ śuṣkaṃ bhojanamantarā || 11 2|| annaṃ tvamṛtarūpeṇa svarge cāvāpyate nṛpa | vaikuṇṭhe brahmatṛptyātma pīyūṣaṃ prāpyate sadā || 11 3|| kaṭutiktakaṣāyāśca kṣārāmblamadhurāstathā | snigdhāścopaskarāḥ sarve nānārūpāśca bhūgatāḥ || 114|| dattāḥ sarvā hyavāpyante oṣadhyaḥ puṣṭihetavaḥ | sādhavaḥ pitaro devā bhojitā yena bhūpate || 1 15|| sa eva bhuṃkte svarge’pi bhojanasya phalāmṛtam | miṣṭānnapānamevātra dāne dattaṃ na vai tvayā || 1 16|| svaśarīraṃ tvayā puṣṭamannairamṛtasadṛśaiḥ | adattaṃ ca yatastasmād bhuṃkṣva kṣudhātṛṣāphalam || 1 17|| yadi te kṣutpratīkāro hyabhīṣṭo vartate tadā | yāhi nandanasarasi snātvā bhuṃkṣva śavaṃ nijam || 1 18|| evamuktaḥ subāhuśca vāmadevaṃ praṇamya tu | nandanākhyavane gatvā sasnau taṭākavāriṇi ||1 19|| tāvacchavau samutpannau rājño rājñyā hi tau śavau | nijau tau bhakṣitavantau tṛptau jātau tadā hi tau || 3.51.120|| hasataśca striyau dve ye prajñā śraddhā hi te mate | dānamārgaṃ parityajya jñānamārge gataṃ nṛpam ||1 21 || lobhamārge sthitaṃ bhūpaṃ hasataste hyubhe striyau | asmadyoge’pi dattaṃ na bhuṃkṣva rājan phalaṃ ciram || 1 22|| atha rājā vāmadevaṃ yayau bhuktvā punarvane | uddhāro me yathā syādvai tathā vidhehi cārthayat || 123 || vāmadevaḥ kare datvā jalaṃ rājñyā nṛpasya ca | śamyāḥ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ puṇyamakārayad divaḥpradam || 1 24|| rājā kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ cakre puṇyaṃ gurostu pādayoḥ | puṇyahīno’bhavacchīghraṃ pāpahīno babhūva ca || 125|| phalamūlānnasalilairviṣṇumapūjayattadā | tṛpto viṣṇurgurorvākyāt pratyakṣaḥ samajāyata ||1 26|| pārṣadaiḥ sahito divye vimāne ca nṛpīṃ nṛpam | nītvā pīyūṣasaṃvārdhau vaikuṇṭhamanayat prabhuḥ || 127|| nityatṛptistadā jātā naivedyasalilārpaṇaiḥ | evaṃ śrutvā vijvalo’bhūt saṃhṛṣṭaḥ sadgurorbalam || 128|| gururmokṣapradātā ca viṣṇutulyo bhavatyapi | pāpatāpaśamayitā nityatṛptiprado guruḥ || 1 29|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam | sādhanaṃ cāpi kṛtvaiva brahmalokaṃ vrajejjanaḥ || 3.51.13 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ gurutīrthe tīrthānāṃ pāpanāśakaṃ gurupadam, adattānnajaladānakasya subāhunṛpateḥ svaśavabhakṣakasya vāmadevākhyaguroryogānnityatṛptirmokṣāvāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 51 ||
<3.52> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kuñjalasturyaputrakam | kapiñjalaṃ ca papraccha nūtanaṃ kiṃ vilokitam || 1 | | śrutvā kapiñjalaḥ prāha kailāse dhavale girau | śivasyāste divyamarthyaṃ mandiraṃ svargasannibham || 2 || sevitaṃ puṇyalokaiśca gaṇairgaṇībhiruttamam | tatrāhaṃ gatavānadya gaṃgāpravāhasannidhau || 3 || gaṃgāhrado mahānasti tatra haṃsā vasantyapi | vāritīre śilāyāṃ hiṃ kanyaikā saṃvilokitā ||4|| āsīnā muktakeśā ca rūpalāvaṇyaśobhitā | divyālaṃkāraśṛṃgārāmbaraśobhānvitā śubhā || 5 || duḥkhākulā roditi sāśrūṇi muñcati dhārayā | muktāmauktikatulyāni patitāni hradodake || 6 || tebhyo bhavanti padmāni hṛdyāni surabhīṇi ca | netrāśrujāni padmāni tarantyasaṃkhyakāni vai || 7 || tāni padmāni cādāya kaścitpuṇyamayo muniḥ | digvāsā jaṭilo daṇḍī tāpaso bhasmavān kṛśaḥ || 8 || pūjayati haraṃ ratneśvaraṃ nṛtyati gāyati | hasati susvaraṃ cāpi dṛṣṭametanmayādbhutam || 9 || pitaḥ kaḥ sa bhavettatra kā sā nārī ca vā bhavet | nārī praroditi kasmād vada me sarvameva tat || 3.52.1 0|| śrutvā sa kuñjalaḥ putraṃ kapiñjalamuvāca ha | putra śṛṇu mahādevī tvekadā prāha śaṃkaram || 11 || darśayasva mamaivādya kānanaṃ kānanottamam | mahādevastathāstvāha tataḥ sajjo babhūva ha || 12|| vṛṣabhaṃ cārurohāpi gaṇairdevyā yuto haraḥ | nandanākhyaṃ praviveśa vanaṃ divyaṃ manoharam || 1 3|| darśayāmāsa devyai tadvanaṃ smṛddhaṃ samantataḥ | kalpavṛkṣān kalpavallīrdarśayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ || 14|| pārvatī cākarottatra saṃkalpaṃ kanyakākṛte | kalpavṛkṣāt tatastūrṇaṃ kanyaikā samajāyata || 15|| svasvarūpā svasamānā yuvatī kamalekṣaṇā | padmānanā svarṇadehā saprabhā lambamūrdhajā || 16|| sugandhadehā divyā ca bhūṣāmbaravibhūṣitā | divyaśṛṅgāraśobhāḍhyā vanadevī yathā śubhā || 17|| kanyā nanāma bhaktyā ca pādayoḥ śivayostadā | pārvatī tāṃ tu putrīṃ svāṃ svīcakāra hi mānasīm || 18|| aśokasundarīnāmnīṃ prāha tāṃ pārvatī tataḥ | somavaṃśe nahuṣākhyo nṛpaste vai patiḥ sute || 19|| bhaviṣyatīti tasyai sā varaṃ dattvā hi pārvatī | vane visṛjya kailāsaṃ śaṃbhunā saha cāyayau ||3.52.20|| aśokasundarī reme nandane vanadevatā | tāmekadā vipracitidaityātmajastu huṇḍakaḥ ||21 || dṛṣṭvā kāmena cāviṣṭaḥ patnīṃ kartuṃ samādiśat | aśokasundarī prāha śivayorasmi kanyakā ||22|| nahuṣo me patirbhāvī pārvatī māṃ jagāda ha | mā vṛthā tvaṃ prayatasva viparītaṃ bhaviṣyati ||23|| mahāśāpena yokṣyāmi gacchānyatra mahāsura | śrutvā huṇḍastirobhūtvā cintayāmāsa vai punaḥ ||24|| kathaṃ bhāryā bhavet sā me kapaṭaṃ racayāmi tat | vicāryetthaṃ devakanyārūpaṃ dadhāra huṇḍakaḥ || 25|| vane tatra tayā sārdhaṃ mitratāṃ kṛtavām̐stataḥ | āśramaṃ me’tra gaṃgāyāstīre’stīti jagāda tām ||26|| aśokasundarī huṇḍāśramaṃ yayau sukhānvitā | huṇḍikākanyayā sārdhaṃ nyavasattatra tāpasī ||27|| bhojane śayane cāpi vihāre sahage hi te | vartete te sakhīrūpe snāne nidrāsthalādiṣu ||28|| rātrau te tvekaśayyāyāṃ supte tatra tu huṇḍikā | huṇḍakaṃ nararūpaṃ ca vidhāyāśokasundarīm ||29|| kāmabhāvena pasparśa tadā tvaśokasundarī | aprāptanidrā taṃ jñātvāsuraṃ kapaṭakanyakām || 3.52.30|| uvāca mā spṛśātra tvaṃ bhasma tūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyasi | trasto huṇḍastadā tūrṇaṃ papāta pādayoḥ punaḥ ||3 1 || aśokasundarī prāha mama bhartā nṛpo hi saḥ | āgatyātra vane duṣṭa tava nāśaṃ vidhāsyati ||32|| ityuktvā prayayau tūrṇaṃ gaṃgātīre vanāntare | tāpasī vartate tatrāśokasundarī bhāminī ||33|| atha rājā ailaputra āyuḥ putrārthameva ha | dattātreyāt prārthayacca suputraṃ sadgurorhareḥ ||34|| dattātreyo varadānaṃ dadau hi putravān bhava | sarvaguṇaiḥ samupeto vaiṣṇavāṃśena saṃyutaḥ ||35|| putraste sārvabhaumaśca mahendrābho bhaviṣyati | ityāśiṣaṃ samāsādya tvāyuḥ svarājyamāyayau ||36|| nāgābhidhe pure rājā cendumatyā striyā samam | reme lebhe ca nahuṣaṃ putraṃ yathoktalakṣaṇam ||37|| huṇḍaśchidraṃ samāsādya putraṃ jahāra cāmbare | nināya svagṛhe rātrau rākṣasyai cārpayat sutam ||38|| mārayitvā pācayitvā bhojanārthaṃ niveditam | rākṣasī vikalānāmnī dayāvatī tu bālakam ||39|| rātrau viśiṣṭakuṭyāṃ sā nikṣipya cāgatā drutam | hariṇaṃ pācayitvā ca bhojayāmāsa huṇḍakam ||3.52.40|| huṇḍastu nirbhayo jāto bālo mayā hi khāditaḥ | atha vaśiṣṭhaḥ prātaśca dadarśa bālakaṃ śubham ||41 || vardhayāmāsa divyaṃ taṃ viṣṇulakṣaṇalakṣitam | jñānaṃ śastrāṇi śāstrāṇi nītiṃ kalā vṛṣaṃ tathā ||42|| adhyāpayāmāsa bālaṃ rājyayogyaṃ cakāra ha | indumatyai prātareva nāradaḥ prāha taddine ||43 || mā śokaṃ kuru putraste vaśiṣṭhasyāśrame’sti vai | huṇḍaṃ daityaṃ nāśayitvā vivāhyāśokasundarīm ||44|| śivaputrīpatirbhūtvā gṛhaṃ te cāgamiṣyati | indropendrasamaḥ putro bhaviṣyati svatejasā ||45|| ityuktvā pūjanaṃ prāpya nārado’ntardadhe tadā | atha putraṃ ca nahuṣaṃ vaśiṣṭhaḥ prāha putraka ||46|| phalānyānaya vanyāni dhanurdhārī prayāhi vai | rājā tvājñāṃ samādāya yayau vanyārthameva ha ||47|| huṇḍastatrāyayau dṛṣṭvā kumāraṃ devatopamam | apahartuṃ nāśayituṃ manaścakre hi daityarāṭ ||48|| yuyudhe ca samāgatya nahuṣeṇa samaṃ balī | nahuṣāya sahasrākṣo dadau śastrāṇi vai tadā ||49|| devā divyāni cāstrāṇi dadustadā hi vai kṣaṇāt | indro rathaṃ dadau cāpi mātalisaṃyutaṃ śubham ||3.52.50|| viṣṇuścakrāt samutpādya cakraṃ dīptaṃ dadau tadā | śaṃbhuḥ śūlaṃ dadau cāpi brahmāstraṃ pradadāvajaḥ ||51 || yuyudhe nahuṣaḥ so’yaṃ huṇḍena māyinā tadā | devā devyaśca gandharvā jagurjayaṃ tu nāhuṣam ||52|| huṇḍo jñātvā nijaṃ śatruṃ yuyudhe cātivegataḥ | tatra sarve dānavāśca yuyudhire cakampire ||53|| sehire dānavā naiva bāṇavarṣaṃ hi nāhuṣam | mṛtāḥ kecid drutā kecinnaṣṭāḥ kecinmahāhave ||54|| rathasthena tu huṇḍena tāḍito nahuṣastadā | tribhirdhvajaṃ praciccheda huṇḍasya sāyakairbalī ||55|| caturbhisturagām̐ścāpi chatraṃ tvekena vai tathā | daśabhiḥ sārathiṃ paścādekena ca bhujaṃ punaḥ ||56|| ciccheda nahuṣastatra śaktiṃ mumoca taddhṛdi | huṇḍastu patito bhūmau mamāra prāṇatastadā ||57|| devāḥ praharṣaṃ jagmuśca puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ jayaṃ vyadhuḥ | aśokasundarī śrutvā daityavadhaṃ praharṣitā ||58|| nahuṣaṃ prāpya covāca dharmapatnī bhavāmi te | samudvahasva māṃ vīra devairhi nirmitā tava ||59|| nahuṣaḥ prāha bhadraṃ te gurorvākyottaraṃ priye | bhadre tvāmudvahiṣyāmi rathe tiṣṭha mayā saha ||3.52.60|| iti tāṃ rathamārūḍhāṃ nītvā gurvāśramaṃ yayau | nivedayāmāsa sarvaṃ gurave nṛpabālakaḥ ||6 1| vaśiṣṭho harṣamāpannastithau lagne śubhe tayoḥ | vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa vahnibhūsurasannidhau ||62|| āśīrbhirabhinandyainaṃ preṣayāmāsa tatpuram | nāgāhvayaṃ puraṃ gururnahuṣo’pi yayau tataḥ ||63|| pitaraṃ mātaraṃ natvā jagāda sarvaceṣṭitam | āyuścendumatī labdhvā sabhāryaputramuttamam ||64|| mahotsavaṃ pracakrāte putrasyāgamanaṃ prati | nahuṣo’pi dhanurdhṛtvā mahendrasya rathena vai ||65|| jigāya pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ saptadvipāṃ sapattanām | pitaraṃ yājayāmāsa rājasūyādibhistataḥ ||66|| atha devāḥ samāgatya nāgāhvayaṃ purottamam | abhyaṣiñcanmahātmānaṃ nahuṣaṃ vai narādhipam ||67|| ardhendrapadabhāg jāto nahuṣo vaiṣṇavāṃśavān | śivaputrīpatiḥ śrīmān gurorbalāt pratāpavān ||68|| vaśiṣṭhasya pratāpena mahendro mānavo’bhavat | śivāgurvīpratāpena kanyā cāśokasundarī ||69|| ardhendrāṇyabhavat tatra devī yā vanadevatā | indumatīṃ nijaśvaśrūṃ siṣeve kiṃkarī yathā ||3.52.70 || atha gaṃgātaṭe yā tu roditi tāṃ śṛṇu striyam | huṇḍe mṛte tu tatputro vihuṇḍastapa ācarat ||71 || devān hantuṃ kṛtamatistrailokyaṃ hantumudyataḥ | piturvairaṃ hariṣyāmi haniṣyāmi narān surān ||72|| iti niścitya gaṃgāyāstaṭe sa nandane vane | yayau yadā tadā viṣṇurnārīrūpo babhūva ha ||73|| mohayituṃ vihuṇḍaṃ taṃ nāśayituṃ tu yuktitaḥ | tāṃ māyāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ dṛṣṭvā mumoha tu vihuṇḍakaḥ ||74|| uvāca tāṃ varārohe saṃgamaṃ dehi me’naghe | māyovāca yadi māṃ tvaṃ bhoktumicchasi cettadā ||75|| saptakoṭimitaiḥ puṣpaiḥ prasaṃpūjaya śaṃkaram | kāmodāsaṃbhavairdivyaiḥ sugandhairdevadurlabhaiḥ ||76|| tatpuṣpāṇāṃ kṛtāṃ mālāṃ mama kaṇṭhe samarpaya | tadāhaṃ supriyā bhāryā bhaviṣyāmi tavānagha ||77|| ityuktaścāsuraścāpi mārgayāmāsa taddrumam | aprāpya tāṃ yayau nārīṃ papraccha taddrumaṃ punaḥ ||78|| nārī prāha drumo vai na tādṛśo vidyate kvacit | kāmodā vidyate kanyā gaṃgāhrade pratiṣṭhati ||79|| kāmodākhyā tu sā sādhvī yadā hasati vai tadā | utpadyante hi puṣpāṇi tasyā hāsācchubhāni vai ||3.52.80|| kāmodāni sugandhāni pītāni śobhanāni vai | tenāpyekena puṣpeṇa yaḥ pūjayati śaṃkaram ||81|| tasyepsitaṃ mahākāmaṃ sampūrayati śaṃkaraḥ | tasyāstu rodanāccāpi lohitāni sumāni vai ||82|| prabhavanti na vai teṣāṃ sparśaṃ kuryāt kadācana | rodanotthakusumānāṃ sparśe’niṣṭaṃ yato bhavet ||83|| gaṃgāhrade gaccha tatra prahāsaya ca tāṃ striyam | yadvā taddhāsyajātāni puṣpāṇi tu bahūnyapi ||84|| gaṃgāpravāhe cāyānti patitāni gṛhāṇa ca | ityukto dānavo gaṃgāpravāhe samalokayat ||85|| pravāhitāni kāmodārodanotthasumāni vai | jagrāha tāni sāralyādapūjayacca śaṃkaram ||86|| aniṣṭaṃ tatprajātaṃ vai tena kruddho hi śaṃkaraḥ | huṃkāramakarot tena dānavo vai mṛto’bhavat ||87|| devakāryaṃ kṛtaṃ tvevaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā | viṣṇurnārīsvarūpaḥ sa tirobhāvaṃ yayau tadā ||88|| devatāḥ suprasannāśca jātā huṇḍasya nāśanāt | athābdhimathane jātā catasraḥ kanyakāḥ purā ||89|| alakṣmīrvāruṇī kāmodā ca lakṣmīścaturthikā | uddālakāya cālakṣmīrdattā tadābdhinā tataḥ ||3.52.90|| varuṇāya ca vai devī vāruṇī tvabdhinārpitā | kāmodā viṣṇave dattā tūlasī yā bhaviṣyati ||9 1|| lakṣmīśca viṣṇave dattā vaikuṇṭhasahavāsinī | kāmodā sā tvabdhiputrī sudhotthā nāradāt khalu ||92|| śuśrāva viṣṇormānuṣye janma bhāvi punaḥ punaḥ | kāmodā cāsahamānā viṣṇorviyogameva sā ||93|| ruroda vai muhurgaṃgāmūle gatvā tadaikalā | rodanāt khalu jātāni raktapuṣpāṇi tāni vai ||94|| tatpūjotthaphalaṃ daityamaraṇaṃ samajāyata | kāmodāyā hāsyahetuṃ śṛṇu tatkathayāmi vai ||95||| yadā sā tulasīrūpā tadā viṣṇoḥ prapūjane | nijapatrāṇi dattvaiva copayuktā bhaviṣyati || 96 || tayā saha jagannātho ramiṣyati sadaiva hi | smṛtvaivaṃ hasati kanyā kāmodā vai kvacit kvacit ||97|| mañjarī hāsyajanyā ca boddhavyā tulasībhave | tulasyāḥ patramekaṃ vā mañjarīṃ viṣṇave’rpayet ||98|| brahmaṇe śaṃkarāyāpi tadeṣṭaphalabhāg bhavet | itītthaṃ puṣpapūjotthaphalaṃ bodhyaṃ śubhāvaham ||99|| kapiñjala tathā nārī kāmodā rodanānvitā | hāsyānvitā ca puṣpāṇāmutpādikā pradarśitā || 3.52.10 0|| vihuṇḍaḥ puṇyahartāpi tubhyaṃ mayā pradarśitaḥ | evaṃ viṣṇurūpagurostīrthayogena tūlasī || 101 || sadā pūjyā ca kāmodā tatpuṇyaṃ pūjyate’pi ca | puṣpaiśca pūjyate devamaṇḍalaṃ sarvadā suta || 1 02|| gurutīrthaṃ mahatproktaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ sadā | vihuṇḍo nāśamāpanno yayau kailāsameva saḥ || 1 03|| śaṃbhutīrthasya yogena huṇḍopi nṛpayogataḥ | svargaṃ gato hi tasmādvai gurutīrthaṃ viśiṣyate || 1 04|| kuñjalaḥ kathayitvaivaṃ virarāma nijān sutān | cyavanastu tadā lakṣmi śrutvā papraccha pakṣiṇam || 1 05|| ko bhavān vartate cātra divyajñānī vihaṃgama | pakṣī prāha purā cāhaṃ kaśyapasya kulasya vai || 106|| vidyādharasya vai putro dharmaśarmā hi nāmataḥ | mūrkho’hamabhavaṃ pūrṇaḥ kadācinmadgṛhaṃ prati || 1 07|| siddhāyano maharṣiśca sādhustatra samāgataḥ | mayā prasevitaḥ so’pi jñānaṃ mahyaṃ dadau śubham || 1 08|| āśīrvādaṃ pradadau me siddhāyanaḥ sa vai ṛṣiḥ | niḥsaṃgo niḥspṛho bhūtvā caikāntasthānasaṃśrayaḥ ||109|| sarvaprakāśako jñānī sarvadarśī bhaviṣyasi | ekasthānasthitaścāpi vetsyasi tvaṃ trilokajam || 3.52.11 0|| evaṃ guroḥ prasādena vedmi sarvaṃ trilokajam | bhavantaṃ cyavanaṃ vedmi sadguruṃ mokṣadaṃ param || 11 1|| kīrabhāve kāraṇaṃ ca mama vacmi niśāmaya | saṃsargājjāyate pāpaṃ saṃsargāt puṇyamityapi || 1 12|| mayā krītaḥ śukaśiśustasya mugdho’bhavaṃ sadā | māmevaṃ vadati so’pi tāta māmehi cāsyatām || 113 || snānaṃ gaccha mahābhāga devānarcaya cetyapi | tasya vākyavinodena vismṛtaṃ dharmakarma me || 1 14|| atha vāṭīṃ gataścāhaṃ śākādyarthaṃ tadā gṛhe | biḍālena hataḥ pakṣī mayāgatya vilokitaḥ || 1 15|| atiduḥkhena tatpaścānmṛto’haṃ śukabhāvanaḥ | maraṇe śukabhāvo’haṃ śukajanmagato’bhavam || 1 16|| jātismaro bhavāmyatra siddhāyanapratāpataḥ | nāsti tīrthaṃ gurusamaṃ jñāne mokṣe hi sarvathā || 1 17|| sthalajādudakād bāhyaṃ malaṃ naśyati nāntaram | gurutīrthāt pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ malaṃ vinaśyati || 1 18|| saṃsāre tāraṇāyaiva jaṃgamaṃ tīrthamuttamamam | athāhaṃ tartumicchāmi guro cyavana tāraya || 11 9|| ityuktvā pakṣirāṭ putrasahito bhāryayā yutaḥ | pādayorāgataścāpi cyavanasya mahātmanaḥ || 3.52.1 20|| cyavano bhagavannāmamantraṃ dadau śukāya vai | jalaṃ ca pāyayāmāsa kṛṣṇanāmnābhimantritam || 1 21|| pakṣiṇaste guruṃ natvā smṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ ca mām | dehām̐styaktvā pārṣadā me bhūtvā vaikuṇṭhamāyayuḥ || 1 22|| divyaṃ taṃ sadguruṃ tīrthaṃ labdhvā mokṣaṃ yayuryataḥ | sarvatīrthottamaṃ tīrthaṃ gurutīrthaṃ bhavatyapi || 123 || naro nārī mokṣadātrī gurvī tīrthasvarūpiṇī | vadhūrvā cādhavā cāpi bhaktā vai mokṣadāyinī || 124|| tāṃ samāśritya muktiṃ vai prāpaṇīyā hi śāśvatī | sādhvī devī sevanīyā vadhūbhiḥ pāpanāśinī || 125|| brāhmī brahmapriyā cāpi haripriyā pativratā | sādhuḥ satpuruṣaścāpi sadguruśca haripriyaḥ || 1 26|| bhuktimuktipradaścāpi sevanīyaḥ sadā janaiḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāllakṣmi cāsya mokṣo bhaved dhruvaḥ || 1 27|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ gurutīrthe nahuṣakathānakaṃ kuñjalaśukakathānakaṃ kāmodākathānakaṃ cyavanakathānakaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 52 ||
<3.53> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri yatkṛtvātmā viśuddhyati | vadhūṭyaḥ sarvathā śuddhiṃ prāpya preyuḥ paraṃ padam || 1 || guruṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ vai vidyācchrīparameśvaram | gurvī lakṣmīsvarūpāṃ ca vidyāt seveta tāṃ vadhūḥ || 2 || mānāvamānau dvāvetau tau bodhyau vai viṣāmṛte | avamāno’mṛtaṃ tatra sammāno viṣameva yat || 3 || gurormānaṃ vidhātavyaṃ svasyā amānameva tu | yā vadhūrvartate nityaṃ nirmānā mānadā tadā || 4 || sā labheta sadā mānaṃ mānyā bhavati yoṣitām | sevayā vaśamāyāti siṃho’pi ca graho’pi ca || 5 || sevāvṛttirgurūṇāṃ hi vaśakartrī vadhūkṛte | putryā vadhvā ca kiṃkaryā dāsyā ca bhṛtyayāpi ca || 6 || samāśritayāgantukayā sevayā sādhyate’khilam | rājñī gurvī śikṣikā vā devī gauḥ rākṣasī ca vā || 7 || sevayā svādhīnabhāvā jāyate śrīḥ satī ramā | gurusevā mahacchastraṃ vaśakārye sahāyadam || 8 || tasmādācāravadhvā vai śvaśrūḥ sevā hyamānayā | patyuḥ sevā devasevā śvaśrvāścājñāprapālanam || 9 || gṛhasevāpatyasevā vadhvāḥ pañcavratāni vai | akrodho guruśuśrūṣā śaucaṃ vṛddhābhisevanam || 3.53.10|| patyarthaṃ cāpi sarvasvaṃ vadhvāste niyamā matāḥ | vadhvā gṛhakriyā yajñaścātithyarhā surārcanam || 11 || kāntaprasannatābhaktiḥ sandhyā śvaśrūprasannatā | snānaṃ tu patisevātma yamāḥ dharmārthasādhakāḥ || 1 2|| sadācāraratā śāntā svadharmaparipālikā | sarvān lokān vinirjitya brahmalokaṃ prayāti sā || 13|| gurūpadeśayuktānāṃ vṛddhānāṃ kramavartinām | abhyutthānādikaṃ sarvaṃ praṇāmaṃ vandanaṃ caret || 14|| aṣṭāṃgairvā ca pañcāgaiḥ praṇipātena pādayoḥ | triḥpradakṣiṇayogena vandyā gurvī satīvratā || 15|| jyeṣṭhā sarvā vandanīyā vṛddhā vandyā punaḥ punaḥ | ājñābhaṃgaṃ na kurvīta yadīcchet siddhimātmanaḥ || 16|| duṣṭāyogaguhāraṇyaṃ kṣudramantropasevanam | viṣagrahaviḍambādīn varjayet sarvayatnataḥ || 17|| kaitavaṃ vittaśāṭhyaṃ ca paiśunyaṃ varjayet satī | atihāsyamatimānaṃ līlāṃ lajjāvivarjitām || 18|| svecchāvihārametān vai varjayed gurusannidhau | tadvākyapratikūlaṃ cāpyayuktaṃ cāpi no vadet || 1 9|| aniṣṭaṃ na smaret kvāpi kalahaṃ na smaret kvacit | ākrośaṃ na prakurvīta vaimanasyaṃ na cācaret ||3.53.20 || rasapātrāṇi sarvāṇi pākapātrāṇi vai padā | bhojyapātrāṇi vastrāṇi na spṛśennāpasārayet ||21 || yajñapātrāṇi pūjāyā dravyapātrāṇi vai tathā | pavitrayogyapātrāṇi gṛhavastūni yāni ca ||22|| mārjanīṃ cullikāṃ vahniṃ phalaśākāni yāni ca | peyapātrāṇi sarvāṇi śṛṃgārasya dravāṇi ca ||23|| pustakādīni darbhāṃśca puṣpapātrāṇi kajjalam | hetīn bhūṣāścāmbarāṇi prasādhanāni yāni ca ||24|| bhakṣyabhojyāni lehyāni cāranālāni yāni ca | veśavārādipātrāṇi kāṣṭhādyāsanakāni ca ||25|| vadhūḥ padā spṛśennaiva padā naivāpasārayet | devadrohaṃ gurudrohaṃ śvaśrvādidrohamityapi ||26|| grāmadrohaṃ satāṃ drohaṃ naiva kuryāt kadācana | uddhṛtānuṣṇaphenābhiḥ pūtābhirvastracakṣuṣā || 27|| adbhiḥ samācaret sarvaṃ varjayet kaluṣodakam | gandhavarṇarasairduṣṭamaśucisthānasaṃsthitam || 28 || paṅkāśmadūṣitaṃ caiva sāmudraṃ palvalodakam | saśaivālaṃ tathānyairvā doṣairduṣṭaṃ vivarjayet || 29 || jalāharaṇapātre vā haṇḍe gargarikāmukhe | kṣiptvāñjaliṃ mukhaṃ pādau kṣālayenna kadācana | | 3.53.30 || uddhṛtyādhikavāryūrdhvaṃ cocchiṣṭaṃ na kriyāttathā | mukhe spṛṣṭaṃ pānapātraṃ jalapātre na majjayet || 31 || aprakṣālya karau bhojyavastvādīni spṛśenna vai | pariveṣaṇakāryādi kuryānnākṣālitaiḥ karaiḥ || 3 2|| pākakāryaṃṃ naiva kuryādaśuddhivastradhāriṇī | agninā ca rasānāṃ ca śuddhiṃ kuryāt sadā vadhūḥ || 33 || tṛṇakāṣṭhādivastūnāṃ dṛṣṭyā ca kṣaraṇena ca | jalasyābhyukṣaṇenāpi śuddhiṃ kuryāt vadhūḥ sadā || 34|| muśalolūkhalasyāpi śuddhiṃ kuryāddhi vāriṇā | vastrādinā mārjanena śṛṃgāsthidāruśodhanam || 35|| dravyāṇāṃ saṃhatānāṃ tu śodhanaṃ prokṣaṇena vai | abhuktarāśidhānyānāṃ tvekadeśādidūṣaṇe || 36 || tāvanmātraṃ samuddhṛtya prokṣayedvai kuśāṃbhasā | śākamūlaphalādīnāṃ kṣālanena hi śodhanam || 37|| snigdhānāṃ mārjanenaiva rūkṣāṇāṃ tu jalādinā | mārjanena gṛhaśuddhimullekhanena vā tathā || 38 || lepanena kvacid vāriprokṣaṇena ca vāyunā | gonivāsena śuddhiṃ ca dharāyāḥ saṃvidhācaret || 39 || bhūmisthamudakaṃ śuddhaṃ nirmalaṃ medhyagandhitam | vatsaḥ śuciḥ prasravaṇe dohane prasave’pi ca ||3.53.40 || phalapāte tu śakuniḥ ratau bhāryāmukhaṃ śuci | paṇyaṃ prasāritaṃ śuddhaṃ vāyunā kiraṇena ca ||4 1 || śucirākarajaṃ sarvaṃ śvamukhaṃ ca mṛgagṛhe | chāyā ca vipruṣo viprāḥ santaḥ sādhvyaśca makṣikāḥ ||42|| rajo bhūrvāyuragniśca bālaṃ medhyāni sparśane | maithune ca malatyāge hyamedhyasparśane tathā ||43 || rajasvalādisparśe ca snānācchuddhirudāhṛtā | vaidyo viśasitā śuddho bhṛtyaḥ śuddhaḥ sadā mataḥ ||44|| gṛhasya paśavo bālāḥ pakṣiṇaśca gṛhāṃgaṇam | catvaro vedikā vṛkṣāḥ kapāṭaṃ chatramityapi ||45 || dolā khaṣṭvā gendukādi śakaṭaṃ mārjanī tathā | peṣaṇī paṭṭikā sopānāni kīlakamityapi ||46|| śṛṃkhalā paśurajjvaśca jalarajjuśca nāḍikāḥ | haṇḍādhānī yaṣṭikā matsaradānī ca puttalī ||47|| lekhinī pustikā dīpaḥ pratimā vyajanastathā | bhūṣāpātraṃ vastrapeṭī ghṛtatailādipātrakam ||48|| gavākṣaṃ candraśālā ca dhanadhānī nṛpastathā | sādhuryatirbrahmacārī guruḥ śuddhāśca gauḥ sadā ||49||| vāyunā cātapenāpi svabhāvena hi pāvanāḥ | dīkṣitāḥ kathakāścāpi karmaṭhāḥ pāvanāḥ sadā ||3.53.50|| khale dhānyaṃ sadā śuddhaṃ samāje mānavāstathā | utsave ca striyaḥ śuddhāḥ kanyāḥ śuddhāḥ sadā matā ||51 || naiṣṭhikānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca rājñīnāṃ guruyoṣitām | maṇḍalīnāṃ nṛtyagītakartrīṇāṃ dāsayoṣitām ||52|| bālarakṣāprakartrīṇāṃ sairandhrīvārayoṣitām | śuddhirvai sarvadā bodhyā nāṭyavādyajñayoṣitām ||53|| satye yuge sadā nāryaḥ śuddhāścārtavavarjitāḥ | yugāntareṣu māsānte rājasvalyena pāvitāḥ ||24|| śuddhyanti sarvadā nāryaḥ snānena ca vratena ca | rajasvalā spṛśennaiva rajasvalāṃ hi yatnataḥ ||55|| dine caturthake snātvā patiṃ devaṃ hi sevayet | caturthyāṃ sevane rātrau tvalpāyuḥ samprasūyate ||56|| vidyāhīnaṃ daridraṃ ca pitrasantoṣakārakam | pañcamyāṃ sevane kanyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ putraṃ prasūyate ||57|| saptamyāṃ sevane kanyāmaṣṭamyāṃ sūyate sutam | navamyāṃ sevane kanyāṃ daśamyāṃ paṇḍitaṃ sutam ||58|| ekādaśyāṃ sutāṃ dvādaśyāṃ dharmavatsutaṃ śubham | trayodaśyāṃ jaḍāṃ kanyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ sutaṃ varam ||59|| pañcadaśyāṃ dharmikanyāṃ ṣoḍaśyāṃ jñānapāragam | prasūyate tataḥ śuddhāḥ bhūtvā seveta vai patim ||3.53.60|| rājasvalye tu cāṇḍālaṃ malinaṃ sūyate sadā | patitīrthapratāpena prajā śuddhā bhavet striyāḥ ||61 || yādṛśaṃ patitīrthaṃ syāt prajā bhavati tādṛśī | kṣetraṃ cāpi bhaved duṣṭaṃ duṣṭā prajā prajāyate ||62|| manaḥśuddhiryādṛśī syātprajā bhavati tādṛśī | tattvaśuddhiryādṛśī vai tāttvikī śuddhireva sā ||63|| śuddhiḥ svayaṃ śuddhirūpā vartate śuddhapātrake | aśuddhe pātrake śuddhiḥ śuddhitvaṃ prajahāti vai ||64|| apātre khalu saṃskārāḥ saṃskāratvaṃ jahatyapi | pārthive varṣmaṇi devā devatvaṃ ca jahatyapi ||65|| nikṛṣṭasya gṛhe satyāḥ satītvaṃ vai vilīyate | āsurāṇāṃ gṛhe devyā devītvaṃ naśyati dhruvam ||66|| kaulikasya gṛhe rājñyā rājñītvaṃ naiva tiṣṭhati | vadhvā paragṛhe naiva pātivratyaṃ prarakṣyate ||67|| gaṇikāyā gṛhe naije satītvaṃ naiva tiṣṭhati | nāstikyā bhaktimattvaṃ ca bhaktāyā nāstikatvakam ||68|| naiva tiṣṭhati vai kvāpi tasmāt patipriyā bhavet | pativratā bhaved brahmapriyā bhaveddharipriyā ||69|| nārāyaṇapriyā nārī satsaṃginī bhavet sadā | sādhupriyā bhavenmokṣe na tvasādhupriyā kvacit ||3.53.70|| dharmapriyā bhavennityaṃ nādharmādipriyā bhavet | vratapriyā bhavet sādhvī nānācārapriyā bhavet ||71|| devapriyā bhaved devī nāsurāṇāṃ priyā bhavet | śīlapriyā bhavecchaśvanna tvaśīlapriyā bhavet ||72|| śaucapriyā bhavennityaṃ na tvaśaucaratirbhavet | tapaḥpriyā bhaveddāntā na tvatapaḥpriyā bhavet ||73|| haripriyā bhavennityaṃ na tu hāripriyā bhavet | brahmapriyā bhavennityaṃ bhramapriyā na vai bhavet ||74|| kṛṣṇapriyā bhavennityaṃ cātmapriyā tathā bhavet | muktipriyā bhavennityaṃ bhuktipriyā na vai bhavet ||75|| vibhupriyā bhavennityaṃ cālpapriyā na vai bhavet | dehipriyā bhavennityaṃ dehapriyā na vai bhavet ||76|| parapriyā bhavennityaṃ nāparasya priyā bhavet | parapuṃsaḥ priyā syācca nāparasya priyā kvacit ||77|| paraḥ pumān hariḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastasya priyā bhavet ||78|| patirnārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt tasya priyā sadā bhavet | ātmanaiva priyā syādvai naiva dehādibhiḥ kvacit ||79|| saiṣā brāhmī sthitirlakṣmi brahmapriyāvibhāvinī | brāhmī śuddhiśceyameva tāṃ prāpya mayi modate ||3.53.80|| vadhvā vadhūdaśāyāṃ sā prāpaṇīyā vivardhinī | hareryogasya sevāyāḥ pradāyinī pramokṣiṇī ||81 || aśuddho deha evāsāvindriyāṇi tathā ca vai | indriyārthā aśuddhāśca māyikā mohamātrakāḥ ||82|| vṛttayo’pi tathā bodhyā aśuddhā vai tadutthitāḥ | bhogāścāpi tathā bodhyā phalaṃ cāśuddhameva ca ||83| vāsanāpi hyaśuddhā ca tṛṣṇehāśca tathāvidhāḥ | pravṛttayaśca kāryāṇi hyaśuddhāni bhavanti vai ||84|| guṇāścāpi tathā nityamaśuddhā nirayapradāḥ | aśuddhaṃ sarvamevaitat kā śuddhistatra labhyate ||85|| śuddhaścaikaḥ svayamātmā paramātmasamanvitaḥ | paramātmagatāṃ divyāṃ śuddhimicchet samarpaṇaiḥ ||86|| yathā svarṇasya yogena pittalaṃ svarṇasadṛśam | svarṇamūlyena rājeta pittadeho’pi vai tathā ||87|| hareryogena sauvarṇo hiraṇmayaḥ pumān bhavet | indriyāṇi samastāni cendravāruṇikārasaiḥ ||88|| miśritāni harau tāni tvarpitāni madhūni vai | prajāyante hi divyāni śāśvatikāni padmaje ||89|| śāśvataṃ svarūpaṃ naijaṃ kṛṣṇayogena buddhyate | śāśvatānandamagnatvaṃ kṛṣṇakāntena labhyate ||3.53.90|| māyāputrāḥ purā lakṣmi vedhasā vai trayodaśa | ākūtayaḥ pañca pañca citayo mana ityapi ||91|| ahaṃkārastathā buddhiḥ preritā vai prajepsayā | sarve cādṛśyadehāste hyuktāḥ sṛjata vai prajāḥ ||92|| tataste nābhyanandanta tadvākyaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ | tyaktvā cājñāṃ nijaṃ karma doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā hi karmasu ||93|| jugupsantaśca karmāṇi vyaramanta hi sṛṣṭitaḥ | arthaṃ dharmaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca hitvā te niṣkriyāḥ khalu ||94|| ajanma kāṃkṣamāṇāste cāpravṛttāḥ vyavasthitāḥ | teṣāṃ tu tamabhiprāyaṃ jñātvā brahmā tu kopitaḥ ||95|| prāha tān vai mayā yūyaṃ prajāsarge niyojitāḥ | prasūyadhvaṃ yajadhvaṃ cetyuktā mayā purā tataḥ ||96|| mama vākyamanādṛtya santatiṃ nābhyanandatha | tasmād yūyaṃ karmaśīlā bhavatheti sadā śape ||97|| iti śaptā brahmaṇā te karmaśīlāstato’bhavan | trayodaśaiva te naije vyāpāre vipule sadā ||98|| pravartante divārātrau nivartante na vai kvacit | jayā nāma surāste vai sarve bhinnapravṛttayaḥ ||99|| ta eva tuṣitā bodhyāḥ satyāsta eva santi ca | harayaścāpi vaikuṇṭhāḥ sādhyā ādityakā api || 3.53.10 0|| tān sadā cārpayellakṣmi nārāyaṇe pareśvare | mayi tena hi cādityā mokṣadāḥ saṃbhavanti te || 101 || gurvarpaṇaṃ hi devānāṃ kriyāṇāṃ kārayet satī | vṛttīnāṃ cāpi teṣāṃ ca vyāpārāṇāṃ samarpaṇam || 1 02|| gurau mayi prakartavyaṃ tena divyā bhavanti te | brahmadhāmapradāḥ sarve rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ tava || 103 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ vadhūgītāyāṃ gururahasyasadācārakathananāmā tripañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 53 ||
<3.54> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇunārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ gurorbalaṃ mahattamam | mahāpāpātipāpānāṃ nāśakaṃ paramojjvalam || 1 || jālandhare mahāpīṭhe deśe dāsakriyāparam | khaśajātikuṭumbaṃ vai nyavasanmāmake pure || 2 || viṣṇudāso hi nāmnābhūt khaśo dharmaparāyaṇaḥ | anivedya viṣṇave ca gurave’pyanivedya saḥ || 3 || naiva bhuṃkte’nnavastrādi phalaṃ jalādyapi kvacit | viṣṇudāsasya vai tatra gururmokṣaparāyaṇaḥ || 4 || sādhurnāmnā ṛṣidharmo mokṣado bhaktikārakaḥ | nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnāyī trikāladevatārhaṇaḥ || 5 || vyavasthāparavṛttiśca triguṇakleśavarjitaḥ | ayācitānnapatrādivṛttirdigambaraḥ sadā || 6 || nadītīre kṛtāvāso vṛkṣādho nirjane sthitaḥ | nityaṃ vai bhajate nārāyaṇaṃ māṃ puruṣottamam || 7 || dvandvasahiṣṇurevāyaṃ rāgadveṣavivarjitaḥ | nirīho’pyatiniṣkāmo vṛddho doṣavivarjitaḥ || 8 || vāksiddhaścāpi maunī ca jayatyeva ca māṃ sadā | ārtāścāyānti cārtīnāṃ nāśārthaṃ śaraṇaṃ yadā || 9 || āśīrvādairjaladānaiḥ rajodānairvyapohati | duḥkhāni śaraṇārthināṃ paropakārabhūṣaṇaḥ || 3.54.10 || lokāḥ phalāni vastrāṇi miṣṭānnāni dhanāni ca | agre samarpya tiṣṭhanti prayānti taṃ prapūjya ca || 11 || sādhurvastūni naivāyaṃ spṛśati nāpi paśyati | anye tu bhikṣukā yadvā paśavo vā haranti ca || 1 2|| nirmoho nirmamaścāyaṃ vartate cāpyamāyayā | evaṃvidhaṃ gurum ṛṣidharmaṃ khaśo niṣevate || 13 || khaśapatnī rāmaṇī ca sevate mārjanādibhiḥ | patrapuṣpādyarpaṇaiśca pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ || 14|| khaśasyāsīt kanyakā ca nāmnā līlāvatī śubhā | dvādaśābdā hi sādhoḥ sā sevāyāṃ vartate sadā || 15|| devārthaṃ puṣpavallīnāṃ jalasekādikarmaṇi | śraddhāvatī bhaktimatī bhaktānāṃ svāgatādiṣu || 16|| sā cājñānavaśā kanyā vṛkṣeṣu jalasecane | bilavāsāṃ mūṣikāṃ sāpatyāṃ dadarśa nirgatām || 17|| bālabhāvena kanyā sā dhṛtvāpatyāni tāni ca | dūraṃ gatvā nicikṣepa bālān mātṛviyojitān || 18|| mūṣikā bhayamāpannā tṛṇapuṃjāntare sthitā | svalpān bālānādadānā kanyāṃ śaśāpa vai tadā || 1 9|| madviyuktāśca me bālā yathā duḥkhagatāstathā | bhavatī pitṛmātrādiviyuktā duḥkhinī bhava ||3.54.20|| mūṣikāyāstu śāpo’yaṃ dāruṇo vai vyajāyata | dināntare ca tatpākaphalaṃ prāptaṃ hi kanyayā ||21 || kanyā sāyaṃ guruṃ saṃsevya gṛhaṃ yāti yāvatā | mārge mleccho yuvā kaścitprāpto jagrāha kanyakām || 22|| rorūyamāṇāṃ śīghraṃ tāṃ nināya balavān vanam | vanād vanāntaraṃ rātrau dūradeśaṃ gato’bhavat ||23 || mlecchena svagṛhe dāsī kṛtā sā kanyakā khaśī | madyaṃ vai pāyitaṃ cāpi māṃsaṃ ca bhojitaṃ tathā || 24|| vyavāyitaṃ tathā pāpaṃ hiṃsādi kāritaṃ muhuḥ | mlecchakarma samastaṃ vai kāritaṃ tena kanyayā ||25|| mlecchī sā hyabalā cāpyajñātāraṇyasya mārgakam | naiva jānāti vai nityaṃ śocatyeva gṛhāgamam ||26|| athaikadā pure mlecchotsavo’bhavad vivāhajaḥ | tatrāyayurgāyikāśca gaṇikāścotsave tadā ||27|| saiṣā khaśī surūpā ca gaṇikāḥ samalokayat | dāsībhāvena tāmbūlaṃ dadāti nartanādiṣu ||28|| niyojitā hi mlecchena gaṇikāsevanaṃ vyadhāt | gaṇikā tāṃ samapṛcchat kva te mātā pitā sute ||29|| khaśī śrutvā jagādaiva sarvaṃ vṛttāntakaṃ nijam | bhāvaṃ jñātvā gamanasya haraṇārthaṃ mano vyadhāt ||3.54.3 0 || viśvāsaṃ sampradāyaiva saṃketaṃ cākarot tataḥ | atha kālāntare saṃketānusāreṇa kanyakām ||3 1 || mlecchagṛhāddhi niṣkāsyāprāpayad gaṇikā gṛham | gaṇikāyāḥ śubhā dāsī tato’bhavaddhi kanyakā ||32|| vyavāyādau pravṛttā cābhavaddharmavivarjitā | mahāpāpātipāpāni karoti gaṇikāvaśā || 33|| atha kālāntare rugṇābhavadvai gaṇikā hyati | udarendriyarogārtābhakṣayaccauṣadhānyapi ||34|| naivārogyaṃ labhate vai gaṇikā sā śuśoca ha | kathaṃ rogo bhaved dūraṃ bhagandarātmako mama ||35|| dāsī khaśī tadovāca gururme’sti mahān prabhuḥ | samartho roganāśāya vāksiddhistatra yāhi vai ||36|| śrutvaivaṃ gaṇikā jñātvā vṛttāntaṃ tu guroḥ śubham | sajjā babhūva sahasā dravyakhaśīsamanvitā ||37|| anyā dāsīśca gaṇikā bhāṇḍām̐śca puruṣānapi | ādāya gaṇikāraṇyamullaṃghya yatra rājate || 38|| sādhustatra nadītīre samāyātātibhāvataḥ | khaśī līlāvatī cātiprasannābhūddhṛdantare ||39|| sādhuṃ nanāma bhāvena prāptā svaṃ pitaraṃ yathā | guruṃ devaṃ praṇamyaiva vṛttāntaṃ svaṃ nyavedayat ||3.54.40 || gaṇikāyāśca vṛttāntaṃ roganāśārthakaṃ hyapi | nyavedayattataḥ sādhuḥ prāha karmaphalaṃ tadā ||41 || yayā yādṛk kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ tayā tādṛk prabhujyate | līlāvati tvayā bālā mūṣikāyā viyojitāḥ ||42||| vṛkṣāṇāṃ vāridānārthakāle mūṣikayā tadā | śaptā tvaṃ ca viyogena pitrorduḥkhaṃ gatā tataḥ ||43|| gaṇikeyaṃ vyavāyena rogaṃ bhuṃkte nikṛṣṭakam | kintu tvayā mama sevā kṛtā pūrvaṃ phalaṃ hi tat ||44|| kārayāmāsa me prāptiṃ punaścāsyā miṣeṇa vai | gaṇikeyaṃ cātithīnāṃ sevāparāyaṇābhavat ||45|| bhaktāyāstava yogena madyogaṃ samupāgatā | sādhuṃ nayati satsaṃgaḥ kusaṃgastu hyasādhukam ||46|| duṣṭaṃ karma duḥkhayati satī sukhayati kriyā | sādhusaṃgastu puṇyena jāyate nānyathā sute ||47|| tava pāpāni sarvāṇi mārjaye mlecchajāni vai | gaṇikāyāśca pāpāni mārjaye cāpi putrike ||48|| mamātra sannidhau vāsaṃ parṇaśālāṃ vidhāya vai | kurvantyatraiva ca vrataṃ kāyaśodhārthamityapi ||49|| ityuktāstāḥ samastāśca vṛkṣādhobhūtale śubhām | parṇakuṭīṃ vidhāyaiva vāsaṃ cakrurhi sannidhau ||3.54.50|| ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ tābhyo dadau ca ṛṣidharmakaḥ | pañcagavyaṃ vrate cāpyaprāśayad vai dinatrayam ||51|| tato mantrān dadau lakṣmi tābhyaḥ ṛṣivaraḥ śubhān | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||52|| kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt | śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava ||53|| śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mama sarvadā | brāhmyahaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktāsmi śāśvatī ||54|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me | itimantrān dadau karṇe haste jalaṃ dadau tathā ||55|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | ityuktvā ṛṣidharmaḥ sa jalaṃ vyāmocayad bhuvi ||56|| tāvattatrābhavallakṣmi mahāścaryaṃ ca tacchṛṇu | līlāvatyāstathā tāsāṃ gaṇikānāṃ śarīrataḥ ||57|| samantato nīlavarṇā niryayuḥ kākapakṣiṇaḥ | niryayuśca tato ghūkāstataśca maśakā api ||58|| piśācāśca tataścāpi kadrūpāḥ krūravigrahāḥ | vṛkṇāḥ kṛśāḥ kṣudhitāśca durbalāḥ kāṇakhañjakāḥ ||59|| kuṣṭhinaśca jaḍāścāndhā durgandhā malasaṃbhṛtāḥ | niryayuśca rudhirāḍhyāḥ sarvāṃgaviṣamāstadā ||3.54.60|| ruruduste ṛṣiṃ vīkṣya nagnāḥ sarve nirāśrayāḥ | līlāvatī gaṇikādyā āpuścāścaryameva ca ||61 || tāstu ṛṣiṃ guruṃ natvā papracchuḥ ke ime guro | guruḥ prāha sute sarvapāpāni santi vaḥ khalu ||62|| mayā mantrapradānena niṣkāsitāni dehataḥ | kākā ime śvapacānāṃ saṃgajāni hyaghāni vai ||63|| ghūkāśceme gaṇikātve kṛtānyaghāni santi vai | maśakā madyapānasya pāpāni santi tāni vai ||64|| piśācāśca bhavatīnāṃ māṃsāśanānyaghāni vai | tāni sarvāṇi dehebhyo yuṣmākaṃ nirgatāni vai ||65|| rudanti tāni sarvāṇi paśyantvimāni yoṣitaḥ | pāpānyapi tadā lakṣmi cakrurvai prārthanāṃ mune ||66 || nirādhārāṇi sarvāṇi vayaṃ suduḥkhitāni ha | ṛṣe mokṣaṃ vidhehyatra jaladānena sarvathā ||67|| śrutvā ṛṣirnijaṃ pādaṃ dakṣaṃ prakṣālya teṣu vai | añjalinā nicikṣepa gṛhītā bindavaśca taiḥ ||68|| pītāḥ sarve bindavaśca tṛptānyaghāni vai tadā | evamṛṣiḥ punaścāpi cikṣepāpi jalāñjalim ||69|| atha divyasvarūpāste yathā devāstathābhavan | athāñjaliṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca cikṣepa devatopari ||3.54.70 || tūrṇaṃ tryakṣā gaṇāḥ sarve babhūvuḥ śūladhāriṇaḥ | pāpānyapi puṇyajanā abhavam̐ste sahasraśaḥ ||71 || sarve narākṛtayaśca divyarūpadharāḥ śubhāḥ | ṛṣerājñāṃ samādāya natvā himālayaṃ yayuḥ ||72|| tato meruṃ yayuḥ sarve puṇyajanā hi te’bhavan | khyātā devagaṇāḥ sarve sādhoreva pratāpataḥ ||73|| atha pāpādiśūnyāśca gaṇikā devatā yathā | abhavan divyarūpāśca tābhyaḥ pādajalaṃ dadau ||74|| ṛṣeḥ pādajalaṃ pītvā nīrugṇā gaṇikābhavat | anyāścāpi jalaṃ pītvā naṣṭasaṃsāravāsanāḥ ||75|| yoginyaśca yathā sādhvyastathā sarvāstadābhavan | rogā nirgatya tūrṇaṃ vai natvā kailāsakaṃ yayuḥ ||76|| sarvā dīkṣāṃ jagṛhuśca sādhvīnāṃ gaṇikā hi tāḥ | | bhāṇḍāśca jagṛhurdīkṣāṃ sādhūnāṃ tatra vai tadā |||77|| hare kṛṣṇa hare viṣṇo hare nārāyaṇa prabho | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇākṣarapate vibho ||78|| ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ cakrustatrāśrame ca saṃhitāḥ | līlāvatyāḥ pitarau ca prāpya putrīṃ sukhānvitau ||79|| babhūvaturhi kamale bhaktau gurupratāpataḥ | sādhudīkṣāṃ jagṛhatuḥ khaśau tau tatra sa sadguroḥ ||3.54.80|| pāpanāśātmikī vārtā prāsarat sarvatodiśi | mānavāḥ pāpanāśārthaṃ cāyayuścakitāstadā ||8 1 || narānāryo jagṛhuśca dīkṣāṃ śrīvaiṣṇavīm ṛṣeḥ | tāḥ saṃvidhāya muktām̐śca preṣayāmāsa cākṣaram ||82|| śiṣyāścāpi ca śiṣyāṃśca preṣayāmāsa cākṣaram | ṛṣeḥ saṃkalpamātreṇa vimānāni cidambarāt ||83|| pārṣadaiḥ sahitānyeva viṣṇumūrtiyutāni vai | āgatāni ca tānyāruhyaiva yayuḥ paraṃ padam||84|| vaikuṇṭhavāsā abhavan gaṇikādyā gurorbalāt | līlāvatī tathā tasyāḥ sakhyaḥ pañca tathāparāḥ ||85|| sahasraśo’bhavan dhāmni vaikuṇṭhe śrīharermama | seyaṃ līlāvatī te’sti kāśīrājasutādhunā ||86|| bhaginī tava cātrāste brahmapriyā vivāhitā | gaṇikā sā suśīlāste sakhī te’tra samudraje ||87|| ityevaṃ śivarājñīśri mama yogena nirguṇaḥ | ṛṣidharmo nirguṇaśca tadyogena narāḥ striyaḥ ||88|| nirguṇā eva jāyante muktā eva na saṃśayaḥ | kāmāt krodhād bhayāllobhānmā ye yāḥ paryupāsate ||89|| madbhaktām̐ścāpi sādhūm̐śca gurūn tānuddharāmyaham | api pāpā durācārā guroryogena pāvanāḥ ||3.54.90 || jāyante dhāmavāsāśca kimuta vratināṃ tu me | gurau vai kṛtasarvasvā gurutīrśenaṣeviṇaḥ ||9 1|| gurau viśvāsamāpannāḥ prayānti paramaṃ padam | gururdevo guruḥ kṛṣṇo gururdīkṣā hi pāvanī ||92|| gururvrataṃ gururdānaṃ gururyasyā mato hariḥ | gurutīrthapratāpena bhavābdhiṃ sā taratyapi ||93|| prayāti paramānandaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ hi śāśvatam | mama vāsamayaṃ divyaṃ sarvadhāmaparaṃ priyam || 94|| sarvatṛptipradaṃ sarvakāmanāpūrakaṃ padam | na nyūnaṃ vartate tatrāśnute bhogān mayā saha ||95|| vadhvo vāpi vidhavā vā hyadhavā vā nirāśritāḥ | gurutīrthaṃ paraṃ prāpya mucyante bhavasāgarāt ||96|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇāt kathanādapi | bhuktirmuktirdivyagatirdhāmaprāptiḥ prajāyate ||97|| sakāmānāṃ svargalabdhirniṣkāmānāṃ pramokṣaṇam | matkāmānāṃ mama prāptiḥ puruṣottamaśārṅgiṇaḥ ||98 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ gurutīrthe ṛṣidharmamaharṣeryogena līlāvatyāḥ suśīlādīnāṃ ca pāpānāṃ vigame brahmapriyātvaprāptyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuṣpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 54 ||
<3.55> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ cānyāṃ supāvanīm | gurutīrthamayīṃ sarvoddhāriṇīṃ pāpahāriṇīm || 1 || saurāṣṭre copaleṣṭāyāṃ nagaryāṃ śvapacī satī | rakṣānāmnī haribhaktā sumarasya hi bhāminī || 2 || avasat sakuṭumbā vai puryā malāpahāriṇī | malānāṃ hāriṇītvāt sā hyaśuddhā vartate dine || 3 || madhyāhne tu tataḥ snātvā śuddhiṃ kṛtvā svahastayoḥ | tato yāti gṛhaṃ naijaṃ vṛkṣamadhye vidhāpitam || 4 || kṛtvā sā roṭakaṃ naijaṃ bhojayitvā patiṃ harim | śune datvā tato bhuṃkte rakṣā santoṣasadguṇā || 5 || vicārayati nityaṃ sā gṛhe sthitā daśāṃ nijām | kathaṃ vai mānave’pyatra śvapacī hyabhavaṃ nvaham || 6 || dāridryaṃ sarvadā cāste kaiṃkaryaṃ sarvadā tathā | malaniṣkāsanaṃ nityaṃ hyaśuddhirnityameva ca ||7|| tiraskāraḥ pratikṣetraṃ cāspṛśyatvaṃ ca sarvadā | satyapi mānave bhāve pāśavaṃ jīvanaṃ mama || 8 || bhojanaṃ dṛśyate naiva labhyate na rasānvitam | ambarāṇi nikṛṣṭāni śṛṃgāro labhyate na ca || 9 || gṛhaṃ tu śobhanaṃ naiva bhogyajātaṃ na vidyate | mānaṃ yaśo na caivāste dhik janma pāpasaṃbhṛtam|| 3.55.10 || yānaṃ ca vāhanaṃ nāsti dhātupātrāṇi santi na | vibhūṣāḥ santi naivāpi miṣṭānnaṃ vidyate’pi na || 11 || dravyaṃ ca nāṇakaṃ nāsti paryaṃko nāsti śobhanaḥ | suvarṇasya tu vai svapne cāśā nāsti kadācana || 12|| evaṃ me vidyate sarvaṃ vairupyaṃ kalmaṣaṃ tathā | eko guṇo me śvapacījñātau vai vidyate śubhaḥ || 13 || aspṛśyatvāt parapuṃsaḥ sparśo nāsti kadāpi me | pātivratyaṃ sarvadāsti sahajaṃ sarvato guru || 14|| svajātayo’pi vidyante dūre dūre purāntare | teṣāṃ nāraṇāṃ yogo’pi naivāsti sparśanaṃ mama || 15|| evaṃ me’sti vrataṃ śīlaṃ puṇyaṃ svargapradaṃ sadā | nirmānatā virāgaśca nirbādhatāpi vidyate || 16|| nadī tvāste pārśvato me snānaṃ nityaṃ bhavatyapi | gṛhaṃ vane sadā caste nirbandhaṃ vānaprasthavat || 17|| caurāṇāṃ tu bhayaṃ nāsti rājñāṃ bhayaṃ na vidyate | sukhaṃ svapimi patyā me sākaṃ sevāparāyaṇā || 18|| sādhūnāṃ pārśvamārgeṇa yātānāṃ darśanaṃ kvacit | jāyate me bhāgyavaśāt sūryasya darśanaṃ sadā || 1 9|| āmadhyāhnaṃ malahārātmakaṃ kāryaṃ na vai tataḥ | divasārdhaṃ niśāyāṃ ca nivṛttirmama vidyate || 3.55.20 || parameśasya nāmnāṃ vai bhajanārthaṃ viśeṣataḥ | vidyate me samayaśca lābhāḥ santi tathāvidhāḥ ||21 || grāme mahotsave daive mānuṣe vā pravartite | prasādaḥ prāpyate cāpi pāvano daivamānuṣaḥ ||22|| tatrāpi mama sāphalyaṃ manuṣyasya tu janmanaḥ | śvapacyā api me śīlaṃ pātivratyaṃ paraṃ khalu ||23|| anyāsāṃ janamadhye ca grāme vā narayoṣitām | prajāstrīṇāṃ sahavāso dṛśyate śīlanāśakaḥ ||24|| yatra narāstathā nāryo nivasanti mitho’bhitaḥ | tatra dharmo hanyate vai deśakālabalena ha ||25|| vivāhitānāṃ nārīṇāṃ parapuṃsparśanaṃ tathā | ekāntasevanaṃ cāpi dharmahaṃ nirayapradam ||26|| yāsāṃ tathāvidhānāṃ vai saṃkarīṇāṃ tu yoṣitām | adya vai narakaṃ nāsti tāsāṃ vai narakaṃ tataḥ ||27|| janmāntare bhavedeva ihādharmaprayojitam | mama śvapacīrūpāyāḥ pratyakṣaṃ narakaṃ tviha || 28|| kintu dharmabalenaiva mṛtyūrdhve narakaṃ na vai | tasmācchreṣṭhā gatiścāste prajānārībhya uttamā ||29|| asmṛddhayo virāgāya samṛddhayo bandhanāya vai | nairjanyaṃ paralokāya saujanyaṃ bandhanāya vai ||3.55.3 0|| śvapacyahaṃ bandhaśūnyā vicarāmi satī yathā | rathyāṃ rathyāṃ vicarāmi sādhvī pativratā yathā ||3 1|| nirbhayā me sthitiścāste sukhāḍhyā vyādhivarjitā | mārjayāmi malagartān vairāgyaṃ ca labhāmyapi ||32|| svamalaṃ sarvalokā vai mārjayanti dine dine | prātarutthāya sarve’pi kṣālayanti nijaṃ malam ||33|| nāryaścāpatyavatyaśca kṣālayanti hi bālakān | gṛhamadhye vastramadhye śayyāmadhye kṛtānyapi || 34|| bālamalāni vai sarvā niṣkāsayanti madvidhāḥ | viśeṣo me tathā tāsāṃ malaśuddhau na vidyate ||35|| sarve vai śvapacā naijadehamalāpasāraṇe | tasmācchraiṣṭhyaṃ mamaivāste śvapacyāṃ nirupadravam ||36|| rājā syād duḥkhabhāṅnityaṃ rājñī tato’pi duḥkhinī | kārāgāranibhe saudhe ruddhyamānā bhaṭaiḥ sadā ||37|| śreṣṭhināryo vastravaruthakaiśchannāḥ prayānti ca | śreṣṭhino’pi sabhayā no bahiryānti vinā bhaṭaiḥ ||38|| evaṃ duḥkhanimagnāste sākṣānnarakaṃ bhuñjate | ko viśeṣo’sti vai teṣāṃ śvapacyāḥ sannidhāviha ||39|| api tṛṣṇā piśācyeṣāṃ hṛdayāni nikṛntati | rogāḥ sākṣād yamadūtāḥ śoṣayanti dhanaṃ vapuḥ ||3.55.40|| bhṛtyādhīnā bhṛtyabhṛtyā jāyante dhanino janāḥ | pāratantryaṃ parāśā ca narakau dvau gṛhasthitau ||41|| svātantryaṃ ca nirāśā ca svargau dvau svakarasthitau | dhanyāhaṃ śvapacī śuddhā tādṛgdoṣavivarjitā |||42|| ājīvanaṃ svargayuktā cānte’pi svargagāminī | hariṇī labhate bhojyaṃ vane’pi phalapatravat ||43|| siṃhikā labhate bhojyaṃ mahāraṇye’pi māṃsajam | śreṣṭhinī labhate bhojyaṃ svādvapi rogasaṃbhṛtam ||44|| śvapacī labhate bhojyaṃ śuṣkaṃ cāpi balapradam | dhanyāhaṃ śvapacī cāsmi mahāsaukhyasamanvitā ||45|| rājā rājñī tathā cānye hyāyuṣo’ntimabhāgake || sannyāsino vānaprasthā jāyante mokṣasiddhaye ||46|| vane paśyāmi tān sarvān bhogarāgavivarjitān | mādṛśām̐stāpasān sarvān dhanyāhaṃ janmatastathā ||47|| sanyāsinī sadaivāsmi sadaiva patidevatā | sadaiva śīlayuktā ca bhavāmi śvapacī śubhā ||48|| aho me bandhanaṃ nāsti nāsti me dharmavarjanam | grāmasevā karomyatra jātiyogyāṃ hitāvahām ||49|| sādhavo brahmavijñānāḥ pāpināṃ pāpakalmaṣān | upadeśapradānena hṛdo niṣkāsayanti te ||3.55.50|| śvapacī karmavijñānā malināṃ malakalmaṣān | dehasevāpradānena niṣkāsayāmi garttataḥ ||51|| malaniṣkāsanaṃ kāryaṃ cobhayorvai samaṃ yataḥ | sanyāsinī bhavāmyeva karmasanyāsinī yathā ||52|| guravaḥ santi loke’tra malanāśakarāḥ śubhāḥ | ajñānamalanāśena prajñānaṃ dīpayanti te ||53|| ahaṃ bhūtvā nijā gurvī śokamalaṃ jahāmyapi | svasyā gurvī svayaṃ bhūtvā nirmalā vicarāmi ca ||54|| aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ śvapacyā mama mānave | sukhinyasmi sadā cānyāpekṣayā kṛpayā hareḥ ||55|| nāsti me phalahaḥ kaścid bahūnāṃ saṃgame hi yaḥ | nāsti me dharmabhaṃgaśca bahūnāṃ saṃgajastu yaḥ ||56|| vinā vanaṃ vane vāso vidyate me sukhāvahaḥ | ātmaśāntiḥ sadā cāste pravrajyāmantarāpi me ||57|| dhanyāhaṃ dhanyapātraṃ ca sukhapātraṃ yaduttamam | svapatyā dīyamānaṃ ca sukhaṃ bhuñjāmi sarvakam ||58|| yasyā gṛhe bhavet kleśo vaimanasyaṃ narastriyoḥ | nityaṃ śaṃkāspadatvaṃ ca rauravaṃ narakaṃ tu tat ||59|| yasya gṛhe bhavet prema saumanasyaṃ narastriyoḥ | tathā cānabhiśaṃkitvamaindraṃ svargaṃ padaṃ hi tat ||3.55.60|| tādṛśaṃ svargamevātra vidyate śvapacīgṛhe | drumāśceme mamodyāno vartate ca nadī mama ||61|| sādhvītvaṃ sarvamūrdhanyaṃ vartate mama mokṣadam | dhanyāhaṃ śvapacī tasmāt sarvasaubhāgyaśālinī ||62|| evaṃ vai vartamānāyāḥ pārśvamārgeṇa gacchataḥ | jātaṃ vai darśanaṃ sādhorbrahmamagnasya yoginaḥ ||63|| nāmnā caitanyaśīlasya mahāsiddhasya vai prabhoḥ | rakṣā tūṇaṃ yayau santaṃ prati mārge sthitābhavat ||64|| anamad dūrataḥ sādhuṃ kṛtāñjalirnatānanā | sādhuḥ prāha sadā śāntimatī mokṣavatī bhava ||65|| divyā devī tathā bhūtvā brahmapriyā sadā bhava | haribhaktā bhava sādhvī sādhusevākarī bhava ||66|| ityuktvā caitanyaśīlo bhadrāvatīnadītaṭe | vṛkṣatale’tidūre ca gatvā hyupāviśat kṣaṇam ||67|| nadījale tato gatvā snātvā kṛtvārhaṇaṃ hareḥ | haraye ca phalaṃ vāri śarkarāṃ ca nivedya saḥ ||68|| śvapacyai tatra yātāyai prasādaṃ dattavān muniḥ | sāpi prasādamāsādya pataye vinivedya ca ||69|| tataścakhāda śeṣaṃ ca matvā bhāgyaṃ nijaṃ param | atha sādhuḥ pādapādho rātrivāsaṃ vyadhādapi ||3.55.70|| śaityaṃ ca bādhate tasya vīkṣya sā śvapacī dadau | kāṣṭhāni cāgnidīptyarthaṃ sādhurvahnimadīpayat ||71 || mālāṃ cāvartayaccāpi bhajanaṃ pracakāra ha | hare kṛṣṇa hare viṣṇo hare nārāyaṇa prabho ||72|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama | tālikāvādanaiḥ sādhuścakre śrīnāmakīrtanam ||73|| śvapacī svāminā sākaṃ tvāgatya vṛkṣasannidhau | dūraṃ niṣadya bhajanaṃ tadvidhaṃ pracakāra sā ||74|| bhajanānte ca sādhuṃ taṃ papraccha vinayānvitā | kuta āgamyate sādho kva nivāso’pi nityadā ||75|| kutra saṃgamyate cāpi kuśalaṃ nvasti sarvathā | sādhuḥ prāha harergehādāgamyate’tidūrataḥ ||76|| nivāsaḥ śrīharau me’sti gamyate śrīhariṃ prati | kuśalaṃ sarvathā cāste gurutīrthaprasādataḥ ||77|| rakṣā prāha śubhaṃ sādho gurutīrthaṃ hi kīdṛśam | yena syāt kuśalaṃ sarvaṃ vada me kṛpayā mune ||78|| sādhuḥ prāha gururviṣṇurgururbrahmā gururharaḥ | guruḥ svāmī hariḥ sādhurgururmātā patiḥ pitā ||79|| gururjñānapradātā ca pāpahartā gururmahān | gururmokṣapradātā ca nijātmā paramo guruḥ ||3.55.80|| gurorguruścāntarātmā śrīhariḥ parameśvaraḥ | tadāśrayena pāpānāṃ dhvaṃso mokṣo’pi śāśvataḥ ||81 || api pāpasamācāraḥ śvapākaḥ śvapaco’pi vā | madyamāṃsāśanaścāpi vyavāyamadirāśanaḥ ||82|| mahāpāpātipāpo’pi praśuddhyati guruśrayāt | na vrataṃ naiva tīrthaṃ ca prāyaścittaṃ na tatparam ||83|| āptā guroḥ kṛpā yena sadyo mucyeta bandhanāt | gurormantraṃ harernāmno gṛhṇīyātpāvanaṃ param ||84|| pītvā guroḥ padāmbhojaṃ dhyātvā mūrtiṃ gurorguroḥ | sevayitvā guruṃ devaṃ prasādayitvā tatkṣaṇam ||85|| sarvasvaṃ prasamarpyaiva sadyo mokṣamavāpnuyāt | sādhurnaukā gururnaukā harirnaukā satīpatiḥ ||86|| jñānaṃ naukā parānaukā bhaktiśca śaraṇāgatiḥ | rakṣā papraccha sādhuṃ taṃ dehi me śaraṇāgatim ||87|| dehi mantraṃ śvapacyai me svāmine śvapacāya me | caitanyaśīlaḥ pūrvaṃ tāṃ pāyayāmāsa vai śubham ||88|| nijaṃ pādajalaṃ tatra nikṣipya śrīharerjalam | pavitrāṃ pāvanīṃ kṛtvā dadau mantraṃ tataḥ param ||89|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me ||3.55.90|| hare kṛṣṇa hare viṣṇo hare nārāyaṇa prabho | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama ||91|| iti mantrān dadau sādhuḥ śvapacyai śvapacāya ca | bhajanaṃ kārayāmāsa rātryardhaṃ ca tataḥ param ||92|| pādasaṃvāhanaṃ sādhoścakrāte dampatī hyubhau | cāṇḍālatvaṃ vilīnaṃ ca sādhoḥ saṃsevayā tadā ||93|| prātaḥparyantamevābhyāṃ pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kṛtam | prātarhariḥ samāyāto divyavimānarājitaḥ ||94|| pārṣadaiḥ pravarairyukto rādhālakṣmyādirājitaḥ | sādhuṃ rakṣāṃ sumaraṃ ca hariḥ prāha mamānugāḥ ||95|| trayo’pi mama bhaktāḥ stho divyabhāvamupāgatāḥ | gurutīrthaprapūtā me cārohata vimānakam ||96|| ityuktāste trayo natvā tyaktvā dehān bhuvastale | divyau ca pārṣadau bhūtvā pārṣadānī tathāvidhā ||97|| divyā caturbhujā bhūtvā sthitvā vimānakaṃ tadā | hariṇā saha vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayurmokṣamuttamam ||98|| evaṃ lakṣmi gurutīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ sadya eva ha | vadhūnāṃ cāpyaśuddhānāṃ śvapākītulyayoṣitām ||99|| mokṣadaṃ cottamaṃ cāste tasmād guruṃ niṣevayet | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavediha || 3.55.1 00|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ gurutīrthe caitanyaśīlaguroḥ pratāpāt sumarapatnyāḥ rakṣāśvapacyāḥ patinā saha guruṇā saha ca mokṣaprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 55 ||
<3.56> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca bhagavan devadeveśa gurutīrthaṃ parātparam | kathaṃ vai śreṣṭhatamatāṃ prāptaṃ me vada kāraṇām || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca bhūmiśuddhirvāyunaiva dehaśuddhistu vāriṇā | manaḥśuddhirvirāgeṇa cātmaśuddhirvivekataḥ || 2 || vivekastattvavijñānaṃ tacca gurorvinā na vai | tūrṇaṃ prakāśadātṛtvād gurustvaṃ paramo mataḥ || 3 || andhakāre manuṣyāṇāṃ lakṣeṣvapi pradīpakaḥ | prakāśakṛd bhavatyeva tathā guruḥ pradīpakaḥ || 4 || bahūnāṃ yādasāṃ cābdhau sattve’pi naurhi tārikā | jagadabdhau dehināṃ sattve’pi gururhi tārakaḥ || 5 || tārāṇāṃ gagane nāntaḥ prakāśakastu candramāḥ | mānavānāṃ tathā nāntaḥ prakāśadastu sadguruḥ || 6 || anyairgrahairna vai nāśo niśāyā vigamaḥ kvacit | anyairjanairna cājñānavigamaḥ sadguruṃ vinā || 7 || jalaṃ tīrthaṃ bhūmirijyā yajño vrataṃ ca caityakam | sadguruṇaiva tīrthāni sañjātāni purā kila || 8 || mūrtitīrthaṃ pratimākhyaṃ jñānatīrthaṃ tu pustikā | tu hyubhe sadguroreva samudbhūte na cānyathā || 9 || devā gurubalāḥ sarve mantrā gurubalāstathā | yogo gurubalaścāpi gurutīrthaṃ tato’dhikam || 3.56.1 0|| gurutvaṃ mama yogena vardhate ca prakāśate | camatkāramayaṃ cāpi jāyate mama saṃgataḥ || 11 || mama saṃgo mama sneho mama bhaktiḥ prasevanam | mamaiva ca kṛtaṃ yena gurutā tasya śāśvatī || 12|| śāśvato’haṃ gururyasmādanādijñānavān prabhuḥ | mama yogena bhaktasya śāśvatī gurutā tataḥ || 13|| mūlyavadvastuyogena nirmūlyaṃ mūlyavadbhavet | dugdhavatsāyutā gauśca bahumūlyā sadā bhavet || 14|| vidyākhanirmānavaśca bahumūlyaḥ prajāyate | nairmalyabhāhīrako’pi bahumūlyaḥ pragaṇyate || 15|| pittalaṃ svarṇasaṃgena bahumūlyaṃ hi jāyate | kanyā varayutā loke bahumūlyā supūjyate || 16|| bhṛtyā rājayutāḥ sarve rājamūlyā bhavanti vai | pātraṃ vastubhṛtaṃ cāpi mūlyavajjāyate priye || 17|| evaṃ bhakto bhaktiyukto mayā yukto viśeṣataḥ | nairmalyabhāvayuktaśca bahumūlyaḥ prajāyate || 18|| bhṛtyaḥ prasannaḥ sahasā prajākāryaṃ karoti vai | kārayatyeva sahasā nṛpadvārā tvarāyutaḥ || 19|| na tu rājñaḥ puttalikā prajākāryaṃ karoti hi | na ca puttalikā kāryaṃ tvaritaṃ kārayatyapi ||3.56.20|| tathā bhṛtyā mama bhaktāḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣakāḥ | śaraṇāgatakāryāṇāṃ kartāraḥ sahasā hyapi ||21|| caitanyamūrtayo me vai sādhavo guravo bhuvi | rājño vai kāryakartāro bhṛtyāścaitanyamūrtayaḥ ||22| abhidhāya hasitvā ca gṛhitvā sevanādikam | datvā dānaṃ manuṃ bhānaṃ kurvantīṣṭaṃ hi dehinām ||23||| śaraṇāgatajīvānāmādhārā guravo yataḥ | mayā dattaṃ gurubhyo vai padaṃ me’dhikṛtistathrā ||24|| madvad bhavanti pūjyāste loke nārāyaṇā hi te | yathāhaṃ ca tathā te’pi mama bhaktipravartakāḥ ||25|| tasmātte guravaḥ śreṣṭhāstīrthaṃ gurvātmakaṃ param | pāpānāṃ kṣālanaṃ śīghraṃ kurvanti vāridānataḥ ||26|| ajñānanāśanaṃ śīghraṃ kurvanti mantradānataḥ | svargādikāṃ mahāsmṛddhimāśīrvādairdahatyapi ||27|| prasādena drutaṃ mokṣapadaṃ sampreṣayantyapi | līlayā me kvacittūrṇaṃ kārayantīha darśanam |||28|| mama divyasvarūpasya kṛpayā darśanaṃ hṛdi | tasmānme sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā guravo lakṣmi sarvadā ||29|| bhaktyā me te bhavantyeva śreṣṭhatamāḥ pareśvarāḥ | bhaktiṃ te kathayāmyatra yayā śreṣṭhatamā hi te ||3.56.30|| gurudevarṣisiddharṣisevanaṃ sādhusaṃgamaḥ | satkriyāvyasanaṃ cātrāparā bhaktirmatā mama ||31|| mamāṃśānāṃ guruṇāṃ yā sevā sā cāparā mama | bhaktireva mayā nityaṃ manyate mokṣadāyinī ||32|| prāpya brahmarasaṃ divyaṃ pītvā cānandasaṃbhṛtam | bhaktā brahmaparābhogāstṛptā bhavanti śāśvatāḥ ||33 || brahmarasābhiplutāśca bhavantyakṣararūpiṇaḥ | yathāgniragnau samprāptastathātmā paramātmani ||34|| brahmarūpakaraṃ nāma hare hare sadā japet | ahaṃ brahmaparaṃjyotirmāyātattvavivarjitaḥ ||35|| ahaṃ brahma paraṃjyotirjñānavānasmi muktaye | bhaktyā jñānāḍhyayā labhyo bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ||36|| dhyānena pūjayā japyaiḥ samyak stotrairyatavrataiḥ | sevayā premabhaktyā vai prāpyo’haṃ parameśvaraḥ ||37|| mahataḥ śreyaso mūlaṃ prasavaḥ puṇyasantateḥ | jīvitasya phalaṃ svādu niyatismaraṇaṃ hareḥ ||38|| sevā snehayutā bodhyā bhaktiḥ sādhanabhūyasī | bhaktāste mama sevāyāṃ lagnā cābhinnabhāvanaiḥ ||39|| muñcantyaśrūṇi saṃharṣāt saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhāḥ | kṛṣṇakriyāparā nityaṃ snigdhā me vaiṣṇavāḥ sadā ||3.56.40 || brahmākṣaraṃ parabrahma śṛṇvan bhāgavatān gṛṇan | praṇāmapūrvakaṃ bhaktyā kīrtayed vaiṣṇavottamaḥ ||41 || me bhaktajanavātsalyaṃ bhaktapūjānumodanam | bhaktagāthāśrave prītaḥ sa vai bhaktottamo mataḥ ||42|| yena sarvātmanā kṛṣṇe bhaktyā bhāvaḥ samarpitaḥ | sadguroḥ śaraṇaṃ prāpya mahābhāgavato hi saḥ ||43|| svayaṃ tvabhyarcayenmāṃ vai viṣṇuṃ tathopajīvati | bahudhā bhaktisampanno mleccho’pi vaiṣṇavo hi saḥ ||44|| sa vai śreṣṭho munirbhaktaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim | tasmai deyaṃ tato grāhyaṃ sa ca pūjyo yathā hariḥ ||45|| punāti bhagavadbhaktaścāṇḍālo’pi yadṛcchayā | mama bhakto na cāṇḍālo divyo me pārṣado’sti saḥ ||46|| dayāṃ kuru prapannāya tavāsmīti ca yācate | abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo dadyādetadvrataṃ hareḥ ||47|| mantrayājisahasrebhyo vedavedāntavit paraḥ | sarvavedāntavijñebhyo viṣṇubhakto viśiṣyate ||48|| ekāntino divyadehairgacchanti paramaṃ padam | ekāntena samo viṣṇurviṣṇurbhaktaparāyaṇaḥ ||49|| bhaktā ekāntinaḥ santo viprakoṭyuttamā matāḥ | priyāṇāmapi sarveṣāṃ mama cātipriyā hi te ||3.56.50|| mahābhāgavatāḥ santaḥ sādhavo viprakoṭitaḥ | brāhmaṇānāmarbudebhyaḥ sadā śreṣṭhatamā matāḥ ||5 1 || lokānāṃ guravo viprā viprāṇāṃ vedayājinām | brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sādhavo guravo matāḥ ||52|| viprā gṛhanimagnāste śmaśānāni ha bhejire | sādhavo brahmamagnāste paraṃdhāma prapedire ||53 || āpatsvapi sadā yeṣāṃ bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī | yā prītiradhikā kṛṣṇe viṣṇau sadānapāyinī ||54|| viṣṇuṃ smaran mama bhakto hṛdo na dūrameti saḥ | dṛḍhabhakto rajjupāśairbaddho baghnāti māṃ mithaḥ ||55|| yo bhaktiṃ vahate viṣṇau tena sarvaṃ prasādhitam | sa eva sādhurevāsti yenāhaṃ sādhitaḥ priyaḥ |||56|| yajvānaḥ kratumukhyānāṃ vedānāṃ pāragā api | na tāṃ yānti gatiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ yāṃ yānti munisattamāḥ |||57|| yaḥ kaścid vaiṣṇavo loke mithyācāro’pyanāśramī | punāti sakalān lokān yathāhaṃ bhagavān svayam ||58|| ye nṛśaṃsā durātmānaḥ pāpācāraratāstathā | yānti sthānaṃ paraṃ me te nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ ||59|| dṛḍhā nārāyaṇe bhaktiḥ sadā yāvyabhicāriṇī | saiva śāśvatsukhadāsti kiyat svargaṃ tadantike ||3.56.6 0|| bhramitvāpi mahābdhau vai saṃsārākhye’bhito muhuḥ | pralambya svakaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dharantu yadi cāpyate ||6 1|| na śṛṇoti guṇān divyān śrīhareḥ paramātmanaḥ | sa loke badhiro bodhyaḥ sadā pāpaśravo’thavā ||62|| nāmni saṃkīrtite viṣṇoryasya no pulakodgamaḥ | sa rājāpi surūpo’pi bodhyo vai kuṇapaḥ śavaḥ ||63|| bhaktimatāṃ narāṇāṃ ca nārīṇāṃ ṣaṇḍhadehinām | mayi niviṣṭamanasāṃ muktirniścayabhāvinī ||64|| pāśahastān yamānāha yamarājo hyahaṃ prabhuḥ | avaiṣṇavānāṃ pāpānāṃ vaiṣṇavān mā nayantviha ||65|| api yāvaddurācāro bhajate māṃ mayi sthitaḥ | sādhureva sa vai muktaḥ koṭiviprādhiko guruḥ ||66|| mahābhāgavatā dharmāstasmin sarve vasanti ha | sarvavidhā tathā śāntistatra vasati padmaje ||67|| dharmārthakāmāścaitasya kiyatīṃ gaṇanāṃ gatāḥ | muktiścāsya sadā dāsī muktiścāsya kare sthitā ||68|| māyā vā māyikā lokāścaiśvaryāṇi ca siddhayaḥ | bhujyamānā api naiva bādhante mama yoginaḥ ||69|| kiṃ yajñaiḥ kiṃ vratairdānaiḥ kimanyaiḥ puṇyasādhanaiḥ | yasya prītirharau jātā tayā cārādhyate prabhuḥ ||3.56.70|| anyairlepaiḥ pradīpādyaiścandanairgandhabhūṣaṇaiḥ | nāhaṃ tuṣyāmi kamale yathā premṇārpaṇena vai ||71|| saṃsāraviṣavṛkṣasya dve phale hyamṛtopame | mayi kṛṣṇe parā bhaktirmadbhaktaiśca samāgamaḥ ||72|| patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiścādbhirdhanairbhojyairvibhūṣaṇaiḥ | bhaktyā labhye mayi nāthe vartayenmuktidāyinī ||73|| āsphoṭayanti pitaraḥ pranṛtyanti pitāmahāḥ | pretāścāsmatkule bhaktaḥ kaścinnastārayiṣyati ||74|| śaraṇaṃ māṃ prapannā ye dhyānajñānavivarjitāḥ | te’pi mṛtyumatikramya yānti matparamaṃ padam ||75|| muktihetumanādyantaṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam | yo namet sarvalokasya namasyo jāyate janaḥ |||76|| viṣṇumānandakośaṃ taṃ cāntarasthaṃ prabhuṃ harim| praṇamet sarvadā bhaktyā cetasā dehayoginā ||77|| yo’ntastiṣṭhan samagrāṇāṃ paśyatīśaḥ śubhāśubham | taṃ sarvasākṣiṇaṃ kāntaṃ praṇamet parameśvaram ||78|| helayāpi namaskāraḥ prayuktaścakrapāṇaye | saṃsārapāśarajjūnāṃ nāśakaḥ samajāyate ||79|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe śrīkṛṣṇarūpiṇi | bhāvakṛtaḥ praṇāmo’pi śvapākaṃ ca punātyapi ||3.56.80 || praṇamya daṇḍavad bhūmau namaskāraṃ carenmudā | ekapraṇāmamātreṇa yāti matparamaṃ padam ||81|| namaskāreṇa me lakṣmi śāśvatī muktireva ha | ahaṃ kṛṣṇo namantaṃ vaiṃ tārayāmi bhavārṇavāt ||82||| āsīno vā śayāno vā tiṣṭhan vā yatra tatra vā | namo nārāyaṇāyeti mantraṃ japet sadā sudhīḥ ||83|| nārāyaṇeti me nāma jihvāyogyaṃ pravidyate | tathāpi yāmyaṃ paśyanti gṛhaṃ vaitaṇḍikā janāḥ ||84|| vyāsādayaḥ śaṃkarādyāḥ stuvantaḥ parameśvaram | matiśramānnivartante madguṇānto na vidyate ||85|| avaśo’pi raṭennāma nārāyaṇeti cāsakṛt | baddhaḥ parikarastena mokṣāya gamanaṃ prati ||86|| svapne’pi śrīharernāma raṭitaṃ ca śrutaṃ ca vā | mokṣārthaṃ jāyate tadvai kiṃ punarjāgratastviha ||87|| namaḥ kāntāya kṛṣṇāya namaḥ śrīharaye namaḥ | svāmine ca namaśceti vadan mokṣagatiṃ labhet ||88|| kalmāṣāṇāṃ kṣayaḥ syādvai nāmasaṃkīrtanāddhareḥ | gacchatāṃ dūramadhvānaṃ śrīharerdhāmayojitam ||89|| pātheyaṃ śrīharernāmakīrtanaṃ lakṣmi sarvathā | vadhvaḥ striyo’tilajjāśca gṛhamadhye sthitā api ||3.56.90 || kṛṣṇakānta hare japtvā muktā bhavanti dhāmagāḥ | jihvāgre vartate yasyā harirityakṣaradvayam ||91|| saṃsārasāgaraṃ tīrtvā sā prayāsyati matpadam | sahasraduṣkṛtivyāptā dharmakarmavivarjitā ||92|| śuddhimabhīpsamānā ca muktiṃ ca matpadāśrayām | guptāpi mannāmaparā bhūtvā māṃ sā samarjayet ||93|| aśeṣalokakāntasyārādhanaṃ śrīharermama | sāraścāsārasaṃsāre yoṣitāṃ sarvathā priye ||94|| dadyād hṛdayabhāvena puṣpāṇyāpastathā phalam | mahyaṃ tenārcitā devāścārcitaṃ muktamaṇḍalam ||95|| na tatkaroti mātāpi na pitā nāpi bāndhavaḥ | yat karomi prabhuścāhaṃ santuṣṭaḥ sevayārcitaḥ ||96|| varṇāśramācāravatyā yoṣitā paramaḥ pumān | ahamārādhye vai lakṣmi sa panthāstoṣako mama ||97|| sampadaiśvaryamāhātmyaiḥ santatyā śraddhayāpi ca | premabhaktyānvitaiḥ sarvairārādhyo’haṃ bhavāmi vai ||98|| bhaktiṃ vinā vinā snehaṃ vinā prema ca bhāvanām | nāhaṃ prasannatāṃ yāmi bhāvakṣudhāyuto’smyaham ||99|| pūrve pūrvatarāścāpi gatā me’kṣaramuttamam | pūrvatamā gatā bhaktyā tathā yāntu striyo’pi ca || 3.56.1 00|| evaṃ māṃ sarvadā kṛṣṇarūpiṇaṃ śrīpatiṃ prabhum | svāminaṃ cāntarātmānaṃ rakṣanti hṛdi sādhavaḥ || 1 01|| ta eva mama yogena santaḥ satyaśca sādhavaḥ | sādhvyaśca guruvargīyāḥ sarvaśreṣṭhatamā matāḥ || 1 02|| madātmakā matsvarūpā madanyūnā narāyaṇāḥ | avatārā hi me sarve sādhavaḥ satyayoṣitaḥ || 1 03|| sādhvyaḥ sarvā avatāriṇyaśca me tā bhavanti vai | tasmād gurvyo mama yogānmantradā mokṣadā api || 1 04|| evaṃ nārāyaṇāśri vai guroḥ śraiṣṭhyaṃ sadāsti hi | ahaṃ gururguruścāhaṃ nātra bhedo manāgapi || 105|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ guroḥ śreṣṭhatamatve śrīharisvarūpatāhetunirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 56 ||
<3.57> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sarvavaidikasārakam | sarvasādhanasādhyo vai bhajanīyaḥ pareśvara || 1 || dānaistīrthaistapobhiścādhvaraiḥ paropakāryakaiḥ | rañjanīyaḥ paramātmā sādhanīyo narāyaṇaḥ || 2 || ṣaṣṭistīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭistīrthaśatāni ca | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktacaraṇe saṃvasanti hi || 3 || prāyaścittānyaśeṣāṇi tapāṃsi ca vratāni ca | yāni teṣāṃ samastānāṃ kṛṣṇānusmaraṇaṃ param || 4 || pāpadahanavāñcchānāṃ janānāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā | prāyaścittaṃ tu paramaṃ śrīhareḥ smaraṇaṃ mama || 5|| muhūrtamapi yaddhyānaṃ śrīhareḥ paramātmānaḥ | svargadaṃ tad bhavatyeva nityadhyānaṃ tu mokṣadam || 6 || jāgratsvapnasuṣupteṣu nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ | yeṣāṃ yāsāṃ vṛttayaśca tāste muktā na saṃśayaḥ || 7 || uttiṣṭhan nipatan gacchan pralapan viviśaṃstathā | bhuñjan pibam̐śca māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yaḥ smarenmukta eva saḥ || 8 || sve sve karmaṇi sarvatra vṛttiḥ kāryācyutāśrayā | tena karma hi tatsarvaṃ nirguṇaṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet || 9 || dhyānaṃ dharmaḥ paraḥ proktastapaḥ paraṃ vrataṃ param | śaucaṃ paraṃ harerdhyānaṃ dhyānamagnastato bhavet || 3.57.10 || nāsti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ dhyeyaṃ geyaṃ prāpyaṃ paraṃ tataḥ | tasmād viṣṇorhareḥ kāryaṃ dhyānaṃ pracintanaṃ hṛdi || 11 || yad durlabhaṃ paraṃ cāste manaso nāpi gocaram | tadapyatra harirdhyātaḥ prasannaḥ san dadāti vai || 12|| pramādādapi kṛṣṇasya dhyānaṃ smṛtirnamaskṛtiḥ | kṛtā satī parabrahmapadaṃ dadāti śāśvatam || 13|| dhyānena sadṛśaṃ cānyannāsti vai pāpaśodhakam | āgāmidehabījasya dāhakaṃ smaraṇaṃ hareḥ || 14|| viniṣpannā dhyānasiddhiḥ samādhiṃ cādadhāti vai || harau samādhimāpanno mokṣamatra samaśnute || 15|| nijacitte sthite viṣṇau bhaktānāṃ kilbiṣāṇi vai | dahyanti mūlataścātmā muktabrahma prajāyate || 16|| agniyogāt kanakaṃ vai nirmalaṃ samprajāyate | hareryogāddhi bhaktātmā brahmadhāmā prajāyate || 17|| gaṃgāsnānasahasreṣu puṣkarasnānakoṭiṣu | yatpāpaṃ līnatāṃ yāti smṛte naśyati taddharau || 18|| prāṇāyāmasahasraistu yatpāpaṃ līyate hi tat | dhyānena kṣaṇamātreṇa harerdhyāturvinaśyati || 19|| pāpaṃ kālastathā māyā cāntako yamasevakāḥ | mṛtyuścāpi na tasyāsti yasyāsti puruṣottamaḥ || 3.57.20|| sā tithistadahorātraṃ sa yogaḥ sa ca candramāḥ | śakunaṃ lagnametadvai śubhaṃ yatra smṛto hariḥ ||2 1 || sā hāniḥ sa ca rogo’sti saiva kṣatirdaridratā | yatra kṣaṇe gṛhe kṛṣṇo hariḥ smṛto na keśavaḥ ||22|| yasya gehe hariścāste tasya satyayugaḥ sadā | yasya nāsti harirgehe tasya cānye yugā gṛhe ||23|| hṛdaye yasya no kṛṣṇaścintane no haristathā | pratimā na gṛhe yasya śmaśānaṃ mānasaṃ gṛham ||24|| yasyāgratastathā pṛṣṭhe cāntare karaṇeṣu ca | govindaḥ samprabhātyevākṣaraṃ dhāmābhito’sya vai |||25||| vāsudeve mano yasya pānabhojanakarmasu | akṣaraṃ dhāma tasyāsti dṛḍhaṃ gamyaṃ hi śāśvatam ||26|| gārhasthyakarmakartāpi vyavahārāvṛto’pi ca | chinatti pauruṣīṃ māyāṃ keśavārpitatatkriyaḥ ||27|| vighnā dūraṃ prayāntyeva kālaḥ śikhāṃ tyajatyapi | mṛtyurdṛṣṭiṃ na cāyāti śrīharau hṛdayasthite || 28|| dhyāyennārāyaṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ taṃ sarvakarmasu | lābhastasya jayastasya yaddhṛdistho janārdanaḥ || 29|| kīṭapakṣigaṇānāṃ śrīhareḥ prasannatāyujām | brahmalokagatiścāsti kiṃ punaḥ sevināṃ hareḥ ||3.57.30|| nārāyaṇatarucchāyā nātiśītā na tāpadā | yāmyadvārapraśamanī sevanīyā sukhārthibhiḥ ||3 1|| vadatastiṣṭhato’nyadvā svecchayā karma kurvataḥ | na vismareddhariṃ yo vai siddhayogī mato hi saḥ ||32|| dhyeyaḥ sadā gurau mūrtau sādhvyā kānte ravau hariḥ | yuvā bhūṣāmbaradhārī koṭikāmātisundaraḥ ||33|| nahi dhyānena sadṛśaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśakam | śvapaco’pi bhavecchuddhaḥ śvapacānnāda ityapi ||34|| viṣṇubhaktiryasya jīve viṣṇuryadātmani sthitaḥ | sa tārayati saṃsārāccharaṇāgatakoṭikān ||35|| tajjñānaṃ yatra lakṣmīśaḥ sā kathā yatra mādhavaḥ | tatkarma yatkeśavārthe sā sevā yā śriyaḥ pateḥ ||36|| sā jihvā yā hariṃ stauti taccittaṃ cintayetprabhum | tau karau yau hareḥ sevāparāyaṇau satāṃ tathā ||37|| mastakasya phalaṃ kṛṣṇapraṇāmo dhīphalaṃ smṛtiḥ | hareḥ pūjā pāṇiphalaṃ manaḥphalaṃ matirharau ||18|| vacaḥphalaṃ hare stotraṃ cakṣuḥphalaṃ dṛśirhareḥ | tvakphalaṃ sparśanaṃ viṣṇordehaphalaṃ prasevanam ||39|| sarvārpaṇaṃ phalaṃ smṛddhermokṣaḥ phalaṃ tu jīvinaḥ | lokālokasamo rāśiḥ pāpasyāpi vinaśyati ||3.57.40|| śrīhareḥ smaraṇādeva puṇyātmā jāyate janaḥ | yatkiñcitkurute karma sādhvasādhu śubhāśubham ||41|| kāmikaṃ cākāmikaṃ vā svārthaṃ parārthamityapi | sarvaṃ nārāyaṇe nyasya kartā tasya na lipyate ||42|| rāṣṭrasya śaraṇaṃ rājā pitaro bālakasya ca | dharmastu sarvamartyānāṃ sarveṣāṃ śaraṇaṃ hariḥ ||43|| ye namanti smarantīśaṃ pūjayanti ca māṃ sadā | ta eva tīrtharūpā me’bhinnā mokṣapradāyakāḥ ||44|| śūdraṃ vā bhagavadbhaktaṃ niṣādaṃ śvapacaṃ ca vā | gaṇikāṃ ghātakaṃ vāpi śreṣṭhaṃ manye hi padmaje ||45|| ādīptaṃ parvataṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyante mṛgādayaḥ | mayā dīptaṃ janaṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyante’gharāśayaḥ ||46|| yasya yāvām̐stu viśvāsastasya siddhirhi tāvatī | anugraho viśeṣo’trāsīmaphalaprado bhavet ||47|| prasannatāyā nānto’sti phalānto’pi na vidyate | tatra yāvacca yāvām̐śca niyamo nāsti vai harau ||48|| prasanno bhagavān samrāṭ jalamātreṇa tuṣyati | dadātyamṛtasāmudraṃ svāmī kaḥ svāmino’sti vai ||49|| rājñe tu cūmbanaṃ datvā labhate’rdhāsanaṃ sakhī | haraye vai tathā datvā labhate me’kṣaraṃ padam ||3.57.50 || evaṃ nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sarvavadhūbhirīśvarī | samarpitāsi sahitā so’haṃ sā tvaṃ hariḥ svayam ||51|| harikṛṣṇaprasādena yadi kaścid bhajatyapi | na nistarati saṃsāraṃ devānāmapi dustaram |||52|| dhyāyedārādhayed viṣṇuṃ sadā nijātmasaṃsthitam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇaprabhuṃ tena mucyeta bandhanāt ||53|| sarvadehividhātāraṃ sarvajñānamanoratim | sarvagaṃ sadguruṃ viṣṇuṃ sadā dhyāyan pramucyate ||54|| dhāmātītaṃ dhāmasaṃsthaṃ sarvāvatārakāraṇam | avatārisvarūpaṃ māṃ dhyāyan śīghraṃ pramucyate ||55|| kṛṣṇamanādikṛṣṇaṃ ca nārāyaṇaṃ narāyaṇam | vāsudevādyātmakaṃ māṃ dhyāyan śīghraṃ pramucyate ||56|| bhūmānaṃ prakṛteḥ pāraṃ pūruṣaṃ puruṣottamam | sarveśvareśvaraṃ kāntaṃ māṃ dhyāyan saṃpramucyate ||57|| hiraṇmayaṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ vairājaṃ viṣṇumityapi | antarātmasvarūpaṃ māṃ dhyāyan sadyaḥ pramucyate ||58||| muktairmuktānikābhiśceśvarairīśvarikādibhiḥ | avatāraiḥ suraiścāpi dhyātaṃ dhyātvā pramucyate ||59|| saṃsārabandhanānmuktimicchan yaḥ ko’pi dehavān | stutvā dhyātvā pūjayitvā māṃ hariṃ sampramucyate ||3.57.6 0|| lakṣmi nityaṃ balaṃ prāpyaṃ mama sarvāvatāriṇaḥ | akṣareśaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||6 1 || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇaṃ parameśvaram | antaḥsthitaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyu kariṣyati ||62|| mīnaśūladhvajadhanuḥsvasticakraśarānvitam | śrīvatsāṃkaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||63|| kambharāśrīsutaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ priyaṃ patim | gopālajaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||64|| brahmapriyāpatiṃ haripriyāpatiṃ satīpatim | śrīpatiṃ saṃprapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||65|| rādhāramāpatiṃ lakṣmīramāpadmāvatīpatim | māṇikīśaṃ praprannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||66|| kamalāduḥkhahālakṣmīpatiṃ nārāyaṇīpatim | śivajeśaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||67|| divyādevīpatiṃ kīrāpatiṃ kāmodakāpatim | suśīleśaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||68|| līlāvatīkhaśīnāthaṃ huṇḍikāgaṇikāpatim | haṃsikeśaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||69|| aśokasundarīnāthaṃ vikalendumatīpatim | bhillīśaṃ saṃprapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||3.57.70|| rakṣāprajñāśamīśraddhānāthaṃ muktapatiṃ harim | mama kāntaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||71|| kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ rāmakṛṣṇaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ janārdanam | rājarājaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||72|| vārāhaṃ vāmanaṃ viṣṇuṃ mādhavaṃ keśavaṃ patim | kāntakāntaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||73|| kapilaṃ ca hariṃ vāsudevaṃ janārdanaṃ śivam | akṣareśaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||74|| anantaśirasaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sanātanaṃ paraṃ patim | brahmayoniṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ me mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||75|| premarasaṃ harernityaṃ pibāmi pārśvavartinī | hareḥ pādaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||76|| harestāmbūlajaṃ miṣṭaṃ rasaṃ sugandhasaṃbhṛtam | pibāmi taṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||77|| amṛtākhyaṃ prasādaṃ ca nityamāsvādayāmi ca | oṣṭharasaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||78|| śrīhareḥ śayanaṃ prāptā mahānandaṃ vahāmi ca | āntarasthaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||79|| ākṣaraṃ balamāptāsmi nityaṃ sukhaṃ gatāsmi ca | ekātmānaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||3.57.8 0|| tādātmyasukhamāpannā rahasyānandabhoginī | tadbhāvaṃ ca prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||81|| mṛtyoḥ pitā mahākālo yena sṛṣṭo’smi yadvaśaḥ | taṃ prabhuṃ samprapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||82|| ityevaṃ śrīharerme vai madamāptā priyā mama | nirbhayā sevate māṃ cāśnute sarvaṃ sukhaṃ mama ||83|| sā dhanyā sā saphalārthā sā ca sarvasukhasthitā | saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ tasyāḥ stauti yā puruṣottamam ||84|| oṃ namo’kṣaravāsāya muktasevyāya te namaḥ | oṃ namaśceśvareśāyāvatāreśāya te namaḥ ||85|| oṃ namo muktapataye satāṃ ca pataye namaḥ | oṃ namo’kṣarapataye muktānīpataye namaḥ ||86|| namaste paramānanda namaste paramākṣara | namaste nityasarvajña namaste jñānamuktida ||87|| namaste cātmavāsāya namaste puruṣottama | sarvāntarātmarūpāya nārāyaṇāya te namaḥ ||88|| namaste kambharāputra gopālajāya te namaḥ | namaste śrīpate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ca te namaḥ ||89|| namaste kuṃkumavāpīnivāsāyābdhiśāyine | brahmapriyādhipataye haripriyāpriyāya ca ||3.57.90|| jaya satyajagatsākṣin jaya sarvapumarthad | jaya vedāntavedyastvaṃ jaya kānta manohara ||9 1 || jaya sūkṣmacidānanda jaya cittanirañjana | jaya nātha jaya sarva jaya śāntasanātana ||92|| tvaṃ gurustvaṃ hare kāntatvaṃ svāmī tvaṃ mamādhipaḥ | dharmajñānādayastvaṃ me tvaṃ me viṣṇuḥ pramokṣadaḥ ||93|| tvaṃ prabhustvaṃ samuddhartā tvaṃ pātā tvaṃ pralumpakaḥ | tvaṃ śrīḥ puṣṭistvaṃ ca lakṣmīstvaṃ prabhā tvaṃ ca māṇikī ||94|| tvaṃ kṣetrajñaḥ pareśaśca tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ hutāśanaḥ | tava rūpamidaṃ sarvaṃ parabrahma tvamīśvaraḥ ||95|| avatārātmakamūrtiṃ te bhajanti divaukasaḥ | bhajane pūjane pāne bhojane puruṣottama ||96|| kṣantumarhasi deveśa yatkṛtaṃ na kṛtaṃ mayā | na śaknomi sadā kartuṃ pūjāṃ samyak kṣamasva mām ||97|| yat kṛtaṃ japahomādi hyasādhyaṃ puruṣottama | nyūnaṃ pūrṇaṃ mama matvā nijāṃ māṃ svīkuru prabho ||98|| divārātrau ca sandhyāyāṃ sarvāvasthāsu me prabho | acalā vai tvayi bhaktistavāṃghriyugale sthitiḥ ||99|| iti stotreṇa māṃ nāthaṃ bhaktyeḍiṣva narāyaṇi | yadicchasi mamānandaṃ bhaja bhaktyā jagadgurum || 3.57.10 0|| prātarjapedidaṃ stotraṃ smarantaṃ puruṣottamam | svargaṃ mokṣaṃ sampadaṃ ca sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt || 101 || putrārthī labhate putrān baddho mucyeta bandhanāt | kanyārthinī labhet kanyāṃ kanyā śubhaṃ patiṃ labhet || 1 02|| rogād vimucyate rogī nirdhano labhate dhanam | jātismaratvaṃ medhāvī vidyārthī jñānamarjayet || 1 03|| jaghanyaścāpi mūrdhanyastvasādhuḥ sādhusattamaḥ | śaṭho’pi satyavāk syācca yaḥ stauti puruṣottamam || 1 04||
