sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtā api te sādhavo matāḥ | yeṣāṃ pravartanaṃ sarvaṃ harimuddiśya jāyate || 1 05|| nāśaucaṃ vidyate tasyā yasyā bhaktiḥ pareśvare | mano vāg varṣma sarvasvaṃ mayā kṣiptau harau tviha || 1 06|| ārādhya sarvadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sukhapradam | naro nārī ca vā ṣaṇḍhaḥ prāpnotīha suvāñchitam || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ dhyeyasya śrīhareḥ sarvārpaṇastotrādipradarśananāmā saptapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 57 ||
<3.58> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirviṣṇureveti cintayan | nārāyaṇi bhavedatra jīvanmukto hi mānavaḥ || 1 || ārādhanā balaṃ jīve sañcitaṃ vai pramodadam | ārādhanāyutaścāyaṃ yāti muktiṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 2 || viṣṇau saktaṃ mano yasya viṣṇumevānupaśyati | viṣṇuṃ dhyāyestyajet prāṇān yāti tatparamaṃ padam || 3 || ārādhanena nāryaśca kṛtvā pāpāni bhasmasāt | harau magnā brahmakāntā labhante paramāṃ gatim || 4 || manthanād dṛśyate hyagnistadvad vai mananāddhariḥ | dṛśyate gocarasyāgre muktiścātraiva sā matā || 5 || vedātra taṃ puruṣaṃ yaṃ cidrūpaṃ tamasaḥ param | asyāhamitimokṣāya nānyaḥ panthā vimuktaye || 6 || yadā sarve nijā bhāvāścārpyante parameśvare | tadāmṛtatvamāpnoti jīvannevākṣarasthitaḥ || 7 || ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirmāyāpāre’smi sarvathā | matvaivaṃ paramātmānaṃ tvāśrayenmuktibhāg bhavet || 8 || smaraṇaṃ pūjanaṃ caiva praṇāmo bhaktipūrvakam | pratyekamaśvamedhasya phalādhikaphalapradam || 9 || purā vipraḥ kauśiko vai mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ | sāmagānarato nityaṃ karatālasamanvitaḥ || 3.58.1 0|| bhojanāsanaśayyāsu vyavahāre vinodane | mamaiva caritaṃ śaśvadgāyamāno’bhavanmuhuḥ || 1 1|| devālayaṃ samāsādya parameśvarasannidhau | agāyata hariṃ tatra tālavarṇalayānvitam || 12|| mūrchanāsvarayogena śrutibhedena bheditam | tatrainaṃ gāyamānaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā padmākhyabhūsuraḥ || 1 3|| dadāvannaṃ hi bhikṣārthaṃ gāyannāste ca kauśikaḥ | śṛṇvannāste sa padmākhyo nityaṃ bhikṣāṃ dadāti ca || 14|| kauśikasya tataḥ śiṣyā abhavan bahavaḥ khalu | sarve gāyanti vai viṣṇoścālaye kauśikānvitāḥ || 15|| mandire mālavo nāma vaiśyastatraiva bhaktimān | dīpamālāṃ harernityaṃ karoti bhāryayā yutaḥ || 16|| gomayena samālipya hareḥ kṣetraṃ samantataḥ | bhartrā sahāste suprītā śṛṇvatī gānamuttamam || 17|| evaṃ pativratā pūjākarī bhajati mādhavam | anye gāyanakuśalā brāhmaṇāśca kuśasthalāt || 18|| pañcāśadvai samāpannā gānārthaṃ harimandiram | kauśikasyeva gānasya puṣṭiṃ kurvanti te’pi ca || 19|| gānavidyārthatattvajñāḥ śṛṇvanto hyavasam̐stu te | evaṃ gāyanatattvajñāḥ samavetā hi mandire ||3.58.20|| khyātamāsīt tatra tasya gānaṃ vai kauśikasya tat | śrutvā rājā kaliṃgo’pi kīrtiṃ gītividāṃ tadā ||21 || samāyayau namaskāraṃ cakre prāha tataḥ param | mama saudhe samāyāntu sarve vai gītikovidāḥ ||22|| kauśiko’pi samāyātu mamaiva mahadālayai | mama gītiṃ prakurvantu kauśikādyā mamālaye ||23 || śṛṇvantu kā prajāścāpi mama sarvāḥ sugītikāḥ | pāritoṣikavaryāṇi dāsyāmi vetanānyapi ||24|| svarṇahīrakaraupyāṇi pañcaguṇāni vo’dhikam | tacchrutvā kauśikaḥ prāha kaliṅgaṃ bhūbhṛtaṃ śanaiḥ ||25|| na jihvā me mahārāja vāṇī me’pi na me manaḥ | hareranyadapīndraṃ vā stauti naiva ca vakṣyati ||26|| anye ca kauśikasyāpi śiṣyāḥ sarve tathāvadan | vaśiṣṭho gautamaścāpi hariḥ sārasvatastathā ||27|| citraśca citramālyaśca śiśuścocustathaiva te | na vayaṃ bhagavadbhinnaṃ naraṃ vā devatādikam ||28|| gāyāmo nāpi gāsyāmo vayamekāntino hareḥ | atha ye śrāvakāścāsan vaiṣṇavāste’pi vai tathā ||29|| pārthivaṃ jagadustatra rājan vayaṃ hi vaiṣṇavāḥ | dehendriyamanobuddhyahaṃkārātmaguṇā hi naḥ ||3.58.30|| viṣṇuparā nānyaparā vaiṣṇavasyāpi sevinaḥ | avaiṣṇavasya saṃgaṃ na kurvanti vibhramādapi ||3 1|| viṣṇorvaiṣṇavabhaktasya śṛṇvanti caritāni vai | śrotrāṇīmāni rājendra tadanyasya na karhicit ||32|| gānakīrtiṃ vayaṃ hareḥ śṛṇumo’nyāṃ na ca stutim | anyaiḥ saha vyavahāramātraṃ vacma iva tvayā ||33|| na spṛśāmo vaiṣṇavānyaṃ jalaṃ sthalaṃ jaḍaṃ citam | na vadāmo vaiṣṇavānyaṃ paśyāmo nāpyavaiṣṇavam || 34|| jalānnādi na gṛhṇīmo vaiṣṇavānyasya vai kvacit | yadi prāptaṃ bhavet syāttad bhuñjāmo vaiṣṇavārpitam ||35|| tacchrutvā pārthivo ruṣṭastvete mamāvamānakāḥ | prasahya gāpanīyā vai gāyantāmiti cābravīt ||36|| mama bhṛtyān mama kīrti śrāvayantu hi kovidāḥ | ityājñāṃ vai samākarṇya vaiṣṇavāste dṛḍhavratāḥ ||37|| naiva jagustadā rājā bhṛtyānājñāpayannijān | gātuṃ nijayaśo bhṛtyā ārebhire nṛpājñayā ||38|| nṛpaścaiva yaśo gātuṃ tadā te vaiṣṇavādayaḥ | aṅgulyādibhireva drāk śrotrāṇi pidadhustadā ||39|| tato rājā susaṃkruddhaḥ svadeśāt tān vivāsayat | gāyakāstaṃ parityajya yayurvai diśamuttarām ||3.58.40|| gāyantaḥ śrīharernāma śṛṇvantaḥ parameśvaram | śrāvayantaśca te nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hi mānuṣān ||41|| himālayaṃ yayuḥ śaitye kāladharmaṃ tato gatāḥ | viṣṇuḥ prāha samāgatya samāgacchantu māmanu ||42|| bhavanto mama bhaktā hi madarthaṃ tyaktajīvanāḥ | ityuktvā bhagavān viṣṇuranayattān divaṃ param ||43|| devādyaiḥ pūjitāste ca pitṛbhiścābhivanditāḥ | brahmalokaṃ gatāḥ śīghraṃ muhūrtenaiva te dvijāḥ ||44|| kauśikādīṃstato dṛṣṭvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | pratyudgamya yathāyogyaṃ svāgatenābhyapūjayat ||45|| tato viṣṇurhi bhagavān samādāya nijāśritān | viṣṇulokaṃ yayau śīghraṃ vāsudevaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ ||46|| vaikuṇṭhe tatra vai viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ | muktaiḥ siddhairviṣṇubhaktaiḥ pārṣadaiḥ parisevitaḥ ||47|| nārāyaṇasamairdivyaiścaturbāhudharaiḥ śubhaiḥ | viṣṇucihnasamāpannairdīpyamānairakalmaṣaiḥ ||48|| sanakādyairnāradādyairdivyastrībhiḥ samantataḥ | virājate sevyamānaḥ sahasradvārasaṃvṛte ||49|| sahasrayojanāyāme divye maṇimaye śubhe | vimāne vimale citre gajapīṭhāsane hariḥ ||3.58.50 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | kauśikādīn vilokyātha harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||51 || ekarūpo hyabhavacca divyagajāsanasthitaḥ | kauśiketyāha samprītyā svāgataṃ kṛtavām̐stathā ||52||| jayaghoṣo hi bhaktānāṃ tadāsīd dhāmagarjanaḥ | bhagavānāha bhaktā me vaikuṇṭhe saṃvasantviti ||53|| matkīrtiśravaṇe yuktā gītitattvārthakovidāḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitārthakīrtanagāyinaḥ ||54|| ananyadevatā bhaktā matsamīpe vasantviti | mama dhāmni bhavantvatra pārṣadā mama śāśvatāḥ ||55|| kauśiko mālavaścāpi mālavī padmanetrakaḥ | tathānye gāyakāḥ sarve mama gāyanasevinaḥ ||56|| mayaiva saha nityaṃ vai gāyantu ca vasantu ca | kauśiko gāyanaṃ me vai karotu vādyasaṃyutam ||57|| mālavo’yaṃ dīpamālāṃ karotu saha bhāryayā | padmākṣo’yaṃ dhaneśo me bhavatvevānnasampradaḥ ||58|| mama sānnidhyamāptā vai sarve vai lokapūjitāḥ | athaivaṃ vadati viṣṇau kṣaṇe tatra samāgatāḥ ||59|| vipañcīguṇatattvajñā vādyavidyāviśāradā | mandaṃ mandasmitā devī madhurākṣarapeśalā ||3.58.60|| śṛṃgāritā gāyamānā lakṣmīrviṣṇuparigrahā | vṛtā sahasrakoṭisvāṃganābhirvai samantataḥ ||61 || tatra smṛtā mahāsādhvī sarasvatī tu śārṅgiṇā | samāyātā savādyā ca sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhanā ||62||| rādhā ramā ca kamalā māṇikī śrīḥ satī tathā | padmāvatī ca haṃsī ca maṃjulī sadguṇā tathā ||63|| āyayustatra vai devyo gaṃgā durgā savādyakāḥ | sāvitrī virajā cāpsaraso nārāyaṇasmṛtāḥ ||64|| urvaśyādyāstadā gītinṛtyalīlāviśāradāḥ | menakā sahajanyā ca parṇinī puñjikasthalī ||65|| kṛtasthalī ghṛtācī ca viśvācī pūrvacittikā | anumlocā ca pramlocā manuvaṃtī sukeśikā ||66|| arūpā subhagā bhāsī haṃsā sūtā sarovatī | kāmalī hyabhayā haṃsapādī ca sumukhī dayā ||67|| anapāyāruṇā varāṃbarā ca vimanuṣyikā | asiparṇā miśrakeśī śucikālambuṣā ramā || 68|| mārīciścādrikā vidyutparṇā tilottamā jayā | kṣemā raṃbhā lakṣmaṇā cāsitā manobhavāmbikā ||69|| subāhvī supriyā puṇḍarīkā ca surasā prabhā | ajagandhā sudatī ca subhujā śāntikā himā ||3.58.70|| muktā devī ca haimī ca puṣpā campā savitrikā | āyayuścāpi gandharvāḥ smṛtā nārāyaṇena vai | nāradaḥ parvataścāpi viśvāvasurvareṇyakaḥ ||71|| vasuruciḥ suruciśca varuthaścāpi dāruṇaḥ | haṃso jyotiṣṭamo madhya ācārastumburustathā ||72|| subāhuśca hahā hūhūḥ parjanyaśca kalistathā | śāliśirāścitraratho bhīmaśca prayutastathā ||73|| arkaparṇaḥ parṇavān sūryavarcā dhṛtarāṣṭrakaḥ | gomān suparṇo varuṇaścograsenaśca bhīmakaḥ ||74|| ete cānye’pi vādyādyairanvitāstatra cāyayuḥ | tumburustatra gandharvaścājñapto mama sannidhau ||75|| lakṣmi tvāṃ gāyikāṃ paśyan neme tvāṃ māṃ tataḥ param | tatrāsīno yathāyogaṃ nānāmūrchāsamanvitam ||76|| jagau kalapadaṃ hṛṣṭo vipañcīṃ cābhyavādayat | śreṣṭhaṃ gānaṃ pragāyaiva prasāditaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||77|| dadau ratnāni divyānyābharaṇānyambarāṇi ca | tumburave hyamūlyāni hṛṣṭaśca tumburustataḥ ||78|||| praśaṃsitaḥ sa hariṇā tumburustatra cāgragaḥ | anye jaguśca gandharvā bahavastadyathābalam ||79|| yathājñānaṃ yathābhyāsaṃ jagurvādyasvarādibhiḥ | lebhire te’pi vai tatra pāritoṣikamuttamam ||3.58.80|| tathāpi tumburutulyaṃ na tadvai pāritoṣikam | apsarasastataḥ sarvāḥ prajagurvādyasādhanāḥ ||8 1|| lakṣmīrjagau tathādevī sarasvatī jagau tataḥ | uttamaṃ te labdhavatyau pāritoṣikamityapi ||82|| urvaśī prajagau ramyaṃ sarvarañjanakārakam | anyāścāpi yathāśakti jagurnṛtyasamanvitāḥ ||83|| bhagavān śrīhariścāhaṃ prasannaścābhavaṃ tadā | dattavān hīrakaratnāmbarabhūṣāsumālikāḥ ||84|| sarve sarvāśca santuṣṭāstato vai nārado jagau | dattavām̐ścottamaṃ tasmai pāritoṣikamityapi || 85|| manāṅnyūnaṃ tumburostu tena tuṣṭo na nāradaḥ | gāyane’pi na sampūrṇo yatastāpamavāptavān || 86 | | cintāmāpedivām̐statra śokākulāntaro’bhavat | kadāhaṃ gāyanaṃ kṛtvā sarvottamottamottamam | |87 | | lapsye hareḥ sakāśādvai pāritoṣikamuttamam | śreṣṭhaṃ tumburuṇā prāptaṃ dhiṅmāṃ mūḍhaṃ vicetasam || 88 || iti sañcintayan viprastapa āsthitavān muniḥ | divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu nāradaḥ śrīhariṃ smaran | |8 9 || tato gītiṃ kalāṃ sarvāṃ tumburorapyavāgamat | jñātvā sarvaṃ tumburośca jagau nārāyaṇaṃ prati || 3.58.90 || bahumanvantare kāle prasannaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | harirnārāyaṇo devastasmai sarvaṃ dadau śubham || 91 | | pāritoṣikamutkṛṣṭaṃ samaṃ cakre ca tumburoḥ | evaṃ śrībhagavaddāsī vadhūrnārāyaṇasya vai || 92|| lakṣmīryathā harerarthe sarvārpaṇaṃ cakāra ha | yathā ca tumburuścāpi nāradaśca yathāpi ca || 93 | | yathā ca kauśiko vipro yathā padmākṣako dvijaḥ | yathā ca mālavī patnī mālavaśca patistathā || 94|| yathānye gāyakā viprāḥ kṛtavanto’rpaṇaṃ harau | tathā sarvārpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ parameśe janārdane || 95 || iṃdriyāṇāṃ vṛttayaśca vyāpārāśca kriyāstathā | madarthameva kartavyāstena tuṣyāmi sarvadā || 96 || darśanaṃ śravaṇaṃ cāpi sparśanaṃ gāyanādikam | nṛtyaṃ hāsyaṃ madarthaṃ vai bhaktyā kartavyameva ha || 97 || madbhaktebhyaḥ pradātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ vāri cāmbaram | gṛhaṃ śayyāsanaṃ yānaṃ vāhanaṃ vāṭikā sthalam || 98 || yathāśakti pradātavyaṃ jāyate toṣaṇāya me | bhuktimuktiphalaṃ tacca bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 99 || lakṣmi saṃśravaṇāccāpi mananācchrāvaṇādapi | phalaṃ nāradatulyaṃ vai prāpyeta nātra saṃśayaḥ || 3.58.100 || lakṣmītulyaṃ phalaṃ nārī vadhūḥ sarasvatīsamam | janā gāyakatulyaṃ ca vindeyurnātra saṃśayaḥ || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ kauśikādigāyakadṛṣṭāntena vaiṣṇavottamatvanirūpaṇanāmāṣṭapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 58 ||
<3.59> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca nārāyaṇa hare kānta śrīpate parameśvara | nāradaḥ kena yogena gānavidyāṃ hi labdhavān || 1 || tumburośca samānatvaṃ kadā kāle upeyivān | pūrvakalpakathāṃ caitāṃ vada me śrīnarāyaṇa || 2 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri vistarāttāṃ kathāṃ śubhām | nāradastata ārabhya vaikuṇṭhācca viniryayau || 3 || nirucchrāsena vimanāstumburorgauravaṃ smaran | tatāpa varṣasāhasraṃ taporāśistato’bhavat || 4 || tadāntarīkṣe śuśrāva bhāratīmaśarīriṇīm | kimarthaṃ nārada caitattapastapasi duścaram || 5 || ulūkaṃ paśya gatvā tvaṃ yadi gāne ratā matiḥ | mānasottaraśaile vai gānabandhuritiśrutam || 6 || gaccha śīghraṃ prapaśyainaṃ gānavit tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi | ityukto nāradaḥ śīghraṃ gānabandhuṃ jagāma ha || 7 || kāmarūpadharaḥ pakṣī kāmasvaro’tidaivataḥ | śikṣayati sma gānaṃ ca pakṣiṇo dehino’pi ca || 8 || gandharvāḥ kinnarā yakṣāstathā cāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ | samāsīnāstu parito gānabandhuṃ tadābhavan || 9 || gānavidyāṃ samāpannāḥ śikṣitāstena pakṣiṇā | snigdhakaṇṭhasvarāstatra gāyanti sma kramāttadā || 3.59.1 0|| muniṃ nāradamālokya gānabandhuruvāca ha | namaste muniśārdūla svāgataṃ te’bhivandanam || 11 || kimartha bhagavām̐ścātra kṛpayā vā yadṛcchayā | dātuṃ vā darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ vada kiṃ karavāṇi te || 12|| nāradastaṃ tadā prāha śṛṇūlūka yathātatham | mahādbhutaṃ mama vṛttaṃ purā jātaṃ vadāmi te || 13|| atīte kalpake tatrātīte yuge tvahaṃ hareḥ | sannidhāvagamam̐statra gānaṃ kartuṃ samutsukaḥ || 14|| lakṣmīsamanvito viṣṇuḥ samāhūya ca tumburum | māṃ vinirdhūya saṃhṛṣṭo hyaśṛṇod gānamuttamam || 15|| tenāhamatiduḥkhārtastapastaptuṃ gato’bhavam | viṣṇormāhātmyayuktasya gānayogasya vaibhavam || 16|| sañcintyāhaṃ tapo ghoraṃ taptavān vai tataḥ param | divyavarṣasahasrānte tvāmuddiśyāmbarīṃ giram || 17|| aśṛṇavaṃ gānabandhvabhidhaṃ yāhi matiryadi | gāne ced vartate tarhi hyulūkaṃ paśya mā ciram || 1 8|| ityahaṃ preritaścātra tvatsamīpamupāgataḥ | śiṣyaṃ māṃ tvaṃ tato matvā praśikṣaya prapālaya || 19 || śrutvaivaṃ gānabandhuśca nāradaṃ prāha kovidaḥ | atyāścaryamayīṃ gāthāṃ viṣṇubhaktyāśrayāṃ śubhām || 3.59.20 || bhuvaneśaitikhyāto rājābhūt pūrvakalpake | aśvamedhasahasraiśca vājapeyāyutena ca || 21 || gavāṃ koṭyarbudenaiva suvarṇapadmakoṭibhiḥ | vāsasāṃ rathahastīnāṃ kanyāśvānāṃ parārdhakaiḥ || 22|| dānaṃ datvā hi viprebhyaḥ sādhubhyo’pālayaddharām | agāpayannijāṃ kīrtiṃ gāyakebhyo’pyaharniśam || 23 || ye na gāyanti tān kārāgāre dhṛtvāvarudhyati | mama gānamakurvāṇo vadhyo me itiśāsanam || 24|| mama gānaṃ prakurvantu striyo narāśca nityaśaḥ | sūtamāgadhasaṃghāśca gītaṃ kurvantu me muhuḥ || 25|| ityājñapya sa rājā vai rājyaṃ svaṃ paryyapālayat | tasya nṛpasya sāmrājye harimiśraitiśrutaḥ || 26|| brāhmaṇo viṣṇubhakto’bhūd gītiṃ karoti vai hareḥ | nadīpulīnamāsādya pratimāṃ śrīhareḥ śubhām ||27|| abhyarcyāpi ca naivedyaṃ jalaṃ datvā hyagāyata | atīva snehasaṃyuktastālavarṇalayānvitam || 28 || atha rājñaḥ samādeśakartā cāraḥ samāgataḥ | ājñāpayāmāsa taṃ ca gātuṃ rājño yaśastadā || 29 || vipraśca vaiṣṇavaḥ so’pi nāṅgīcakāra tadvacaḥ | tataścāro brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ gṛhītvā rājasannidhau || 3.59.30 || nītvā nyavedayad rājā bhartsayāmāsa taṃ dvijam | rājyānniryātayāmāsa hṛtvā sarvaṃ dhanādikam || 31 || vipro vanāntare gatvābhajacchrīparameśvaram | rājā cāyuḥkṣayenaiva kāladharmamupeyivān || 3 2|| yatraloke gatastatra kuṃbhīpāke papāta ha | kṣudhayā ca tṛṣā vyāptastiraskāraiḥ pratoditaḥ || 33 || bhuktvā duḥkhāni bahudhā tataḥ svargamupāgataḥ | kintu tatra vimāne yatprāptaṃ bhojyaṃ jalāmṛtam || 34|| dṛśyamātraṃ jāyate tallīyate grahaṇakṣaṇe | naiva peyaṃ tathā bhojyaṃ nṛpadevasya jāyate || 35 || tena khinnaḥ śuśocāpi svargatasyāpi me tviha | kṣuttṛṭpravartate bhojyaṃ peyaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ vilīyate || 36 || mayā pāpaṃ kṛta kiṃ yatphalaṃ tvetatprabhujyate | ityevaṃ cintayānasya vyomavāṇī hyajāyata ||37|| tvayā rājanmahatpātaṃ kṛtamajñānamohataḥ | harimiśraṃ dvijaṃ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaṃ hi gāyakam || 38|| tava gānamakurvantaṃ dattavān daṇḍamulbaṇam | tvayā hṛtaṃ dhanaṃ tasya vivāsitaśca rājyataḥ || 39 || sakṣudhātṛṭsamaveto vaṇe tapaḥ karoti vai | bhakto’yaṃ vai hareḥ rājam̐stvayā praduḥkhitaḥ kṛtaḥ ||3.59.40 || tena pāpena te rājan bhojyaṃ peyaṃ vilīyate | dānayajñādikaṃ sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ te prajāyate ||41 || gītavādyasamopetaṃ gāyamānaṃ hariśritam | harimitraṃ subhaktaṃ tvaṃ duḥkhitaṃ cākaroryataḥ |||42||| naṣṭaste svargaloko’pi gaccha parvatakoṭaram | dhūlīṃ khādan vasa tatra yāvanmanvantaraṃ bhavet ||43 || kardamī nāma kīṭastvaṃ tataḥ kālāntare punaḥ | pāpabhogaṃ prabhuktvaiva mānuṣyaṃ tvaṃ gamiṣyasi ||44|| ityevaṃ sa ca rājā vai bhraṣṭaḥ svargācca koṭaram | āyayau kardame jātaḥ kardamī jalabhūsthale ||45|| ulūko’haṃ tatra cāpi jijñāsārthaṃ gato’bhavam | mayā pṛṣṭaḥ sa vṛttāntaṃ jagāda pūrvapāditam ||46|| bhagavadbhaktadrohasya phalaṃ kardamabhakṣitām | jagādāpi tataścāhaṃ niryayau tasya gahvarāt || 47|| vyomamārge dṛṣṭvavośca vimānaṃ pārṣadānvitam | gītiyuktaṃ yatra cāste brāhmaṇo harimitrakaḥ ||48 || devaiśca pārṣadaiścāpi stūyamāno vimānake | viṣṇulokaṃ yayau śrīmān mayā so’pi vilokitaḥ ||49|| harergānasya puṇyaṃ tad vaikuṇṭhaṃ prati sadgatiḥ | tadaiśvaryaprabhāveṇa mano me samupāgatam || 3.59.50 || gānavidyāṃ prati tataḥ kinnaraiḥ samupāviśam | ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ gānayogena me tataḥ ||5 1 || jihvā vaiśadyamāpannā tato gānamaśikṣayam | tato’pi bahukālena gānaṃ cāśikṣayaṃ muhuḥ | |52|| gānayogasamāyuktā gatā manvantarā daśa | gānācāryo’bhavaṃ pūrve gandharvāṇāṃ ca yoṣitām ||53 || kinnarāṇāṃ gāyakānāṃ sarveṣāṃ narayoṣitām | apsarasāṃ tathācāryaścābhavaṃ pūrvakalpake ||54|| gāyakānāṃ tadā saṃghā māmācāryamupāgatāḥ | ye tvidānīṃ nāradātra vartante samupasthitāḥ ||55|| te tu śiṣyapraśiṣyāṇāṃ śākhāsahasrayoginaḥ | vaṃśavaṃśānuvaṃśyāśca vartante mama śiṣyakāḥ ||56 || tapasā naiva śakyā vai gānavidyā hi nārada | tasmācchrutena sampanno mattastvaṃ gānamāpnuhi ||57|| ityukto nārado lakṣmi praṇipatya namasya mām | śikṣākrameṇa colūkāt tatra gānamaśikṣata ||58|| kathāyāṃ strīsahasaṃge gīte dyūte ca bhojane | vyavahāre dravyalābhe cāye vyaye nijārthake ||59|| tyaktalajjo jano yāti jayaṃ lajjāyuto na vai | na kuṃcitena gūḍhena vastraprāvaraṇādibhiḥ ||3.59.6 0|| hastavikṣepabhāvena vyāditāsyena caiva ha | niryātajihvāyogena na geyaṃ hi kathaṃcana ||61|| na gāyedūrdhvabāhutve nordhvadṛṣṭiḥ kathaṃcana | svāṃgaṃ nirīkṣamāṇena paraṃ samprekṣatā tathā ||62|| saṃghaṭṭe ca tathotthāne kaṭisthāne na śasyate | hrāso roṣastathā kampastathānyatra smṛtiḥ punaḥ ||63|| naitāni śastarūpāṇi gānayoge mahāmate | naikahastena śakyaṃ syāt tālasaṃghaṭanaṃ mune ||64|| kṣudhārtena bhayārtena tṛṣārtena tathaiva ca | gānayogo na kartavyo nāndhakāre kathañcana ||65|| evamādīni cānyāni pramādālasyakāni ca | na kartavyāni vai raṃge gāyatā ca vijānatā ||66|| evaṃ śikṣāṃ samagṛhya vidhinā nārado muniḥ | aśikṣata tathā gītaṃ divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam |67|| tataḥ samastasampanno gītaprastarakādiṣu | vipañcyādiṣu sampannaḥ sarvasvaravibhāgavit ||68|| ayutāni ca ṣaṭtriṃśat sahasrāṇi śatāni ca | svarāṇāṃ bhedayogena jñātavān munisattamaḥ ||69|| tato gandharvasaṃghāśca kinnarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca | munināṃ saha saṃyuktāḥ prītiyuktāstato’bhavan ||3.59.70|| gānabandhuṃ muniḥ prāha prāpya gānamanuttamam | tvāṃ samāsādya sampannastvaṃ hi gītiviśāradaḥ ||71 || guro tava prapūjāyāṃ kimācārya karomi te | gānabandhustataḥ prāha brahmaṇo divase khalu ||72|| naśyanti manavastatra caturdaśa tathā tvaham | jīvāmīti varaṃ dehi dakṣiṇāṃ hi mamepsitām ||73|| tāvanme tvāyuṣo bhāvastāvanme paramaṃ śubham | manasā vāñchitaṃ me syād dakṣiṇā nāradātra vai ||74|| nāradastaṃ tadā prāha bhavatvevaṃ tato’pi ca | kalpāntare bhavāneva garuḍaśca bhaviṣyati ||75|| svasti te’stu mahāprājña bhagavadvāhanaḥ śubhaḥ | gamiṣyāmi namaste’stvityuktvā śrīnārado yayau ||76|| nārāyaṇasya vaikuṇṭhaṃ lakṣmi yatra vasāmyaham | mamāgre gāyanaṃ cakre bahudhaiva sugītikam ||77|| tacchrutvāhamavocaṃ taṃ gānāsampannameva ha | tumburorna viśiṣṭo’si gītairadyāpi nārada ||78|| gānabandhuṃ samāsādya gānārthajño bhavān nanu | yadā viśiṣṭo bhavitā tadā tuṣṭo’pi mādhavaḥ ||79|| bhaviṣyāmi kṣitau bhāvye mānave cāvatāriṇi | tadānīṃ māṃ samāsādya kārayethā yathātatham ||3.59.80|| tadā tvāṃ gītasampannaṃ kariṣyāmi mahāvratam | tumburośca samaṃ cāpi tathātiśayasaṃyutam ||81 || tāvatkālaṃ yathāyogaṃ devagandharvayoniṣu | śikṣasva tvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ svasti te’stu surāṣṭrake ||82|| śrutvā nārāyaṇavākyaṃ praṇamya nārado harim | skandhe vipañcīmāsādya sarvalokān cacāra ha ||83|| vāruṇaṃ yāmyamāgneyamaindraṃ kauberamityapi | vāyavyaṃ ca tathaiśānaṃ sadaḥ saṃprāpya nāradaḥ ||84|| gāyamāno hariṃ samyag vīṇāvādanadakṣakaḥ | gandharvāpsarasāṃ saṃghaiḥ pūjyamānastatastataḥ ||85|| brahmalokaṃ samāsādya rātriṃ nināya kālpikīm | prātaḥ punaścātra kalpe brahmaloke’jamandire ||86|| hāhāhūhūśca gandharvau gītavādyaviśāradau | brahmaṇo gāyakau divyau nityagāyanatatparau ||87|| tatra tābhyāṃ samāsādya gāyamāno hariṃ prabhum | gṛhītapāritoṣaśca praṇamya ca pitāmaham ||88|| cacāra sa yathākāmaṃ prayayau tumburorgṛham | vīṇāmādāya tatrastho hyagāyatāpyaśikṣata ||89|| svarakalpāstu tatrasthāḥ ṣaḍjādyāḥ sapta ye matāḥ | tānsamagrām̐stumburorvai nāradaḥ samaśikṣata ||3.59.90|| saptasvarāṃganāścāpi nāradaḥ samaśikṣata | kintu gāyanakāle vai vīṇāyoge hi cāṃganāḥ ||91|| tantryaḥ prapedire naiva yathāyogyodbhavāni vai | tato’śvapaṭṭasarasi lomaśasyāśrame punaḥ ||92|| gānaṃ cakārāniṣpannaṃ tadāhaṃ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ | avadaṃ tvāṃ priyāṃ nityadivyarūpāṃ hi padmaje ||93|| sarasvatīṃ cāvadaṃ ca śikṣayasva hi nāradam | viṇāgānasamāyoge tathetyuktvā tataḥ param ||94|| samprahāsā śikṣayāmāsitha lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī | tato brahmapriyāṇāṃ vai sannidhau gānamācarat ||95|| ukto’sau gāyamāno’pi na svaraṃ vetsi vai mune | tataḥ svarāṃganāḥ prāpya tantrīyogaṃ ca nāradam ||96|| āhūyāhaṃ gānayogamaśikṣayaṃ tvanuttamam | tato’tiśayamāpannastumburormunisattamaḥ ||97|| tato nanarta gātvaiva praṇipatya ca māṃ muhuḥ | mayokto nāradastatra sarvajño’si mamāntikaṃ ||98|| gāyasva jñānayogena jagau cāpi sa nāradaḥ | tuṣṭo’haṃ nityasānnidhyaṃ dattavānatra cākṣare ||99|| kṣetre kuṃkumavāpyāṃ sa vartate nārado muniḥ | prāpyottamaṃ pāritoṣikaṃ prasannena cārpitam || 3.59.10 0|| mayaiva tumburoścāpi śreṣṭhatvaṃ cāpi cārpitam | atha kālāntare kṛṣṇagṛhe gāsyati nāradaḥ || 101 || eṣa vo brahmapatnyo’tra prokto gītikramo muneḥ | gātā krameṇa cānena mama sālokyamāpnuyāt || 1 02|| karmaṇā manasā vācā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ | gāyan śṛṇvan māmupaiti tadvai geyaṃ paraṃ matam || 1 03|| ulūko’pi garuḍo’yaṃ vartate’śvasarovare | gānabandhurmahābhāgaḥ pārṣado gānakṛnmama || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne śreṣṭhabhaktadṛṣṭānte vadhūgītāyāṃ nāradasya gānaśikṣārjanagaruḍākhyānanirūpaṇanāmā navapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 59 ||
<3.60> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca vaiṣṇavā iti ye proktā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ | bhāgavatāḥ sāttvatā ye sarvasvātmanivedinaḥ || 1 || kāni cihnāni teṣāṃ vai tāsāṃ ca brūhi me prabho | teṣāṃ tāsāṃ ca bhagavān kiṃ karoṣi hare vibho || 2 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ mama bhaktasvarūpiṇīm | premakathāṃ pāvanīṃ me tādātmyabhāvadhāriṇīm || 3 || yatrāste prama bhaktastu tatrāha sarvadā sthitaḥ | ahameva sadā teṣāṃ tāsāṃ paramadevatā || 4 || kīrtyamāne harau nityaṃ romāñco jāyate muhuḥ | kampaḥ svedastathākṣeṣu dṛśyante jalabindavaḥ || 5 || mama bhaktiparānpuṃso nārīrvā vīkṣya vai drutam | prītirbhavati cāntargā yeṣāṃ yāsāṃ sa vaiṣṇavaḥ || 6 || nānyadācchādayed vastraṃ nānyādhīnā bhavet satī | vaiṣṇavaṃ sāttvataṃ dṛṣṭvā premṇā sammukhasaṃsthitā || 7 || praṇāmādi karotyeva śrīkṛṣṇe ve yathā mayi | bhaktaṃ bhaktāṃ ca vā vīkṣya bhakto bhaktā named drutam || 8 || madātmā mama bhaktaḥ sa bhaktā ca bhāminī mama | jayaṃ labhate trailokye sarvadhāmasu sṛṣṭiṣu || 9 || vinā lajjāṃ bhajate māṃ nirākṛtya durītakān | datte sarvaṃ madarthaṃ vai vaiṣṇavaḥ saḥ sā vaiṣṇavī || 3.60.1 0|| rūkṣākṣarāṇi vai śṛṇvan bhakteritāni vai kvacit | pramodaṃ labhate tatra na roṣaṃ prakaroti hi ||1 1 || praṇāmapūrvakaṃ kṣāntyā gṛhṇīyād guṇameva tu | vaiṣṇavo vaiṣṇavī saiva divyadṛṣṭiyutā satī || 1 2|| gandhapuṣpādikaṃ sarvaṃ śirasā yā hi dhārayet | hareḥ sarvamitītyevaṃ matveyaṃ vaiṣṇavī hi sā || 13|| mama kṣetre śubhāneva karoti tu divāniśam | māṃ sato mama bhaktām̐śca sevate snehasaṃyutaḥ || 14|| pratimāṃ pūjayennityaṃ mama sarvopacārakaiḥ | karmaṇā manasā vācā sa sā bhaktottamā matā || 15|| roge kaṣṭe’thavāpattau vighne codvejane tathā | mānatāṃ mama sevāyāḥ satsaṃgasya tathā satām || 16 || mandirasya ca sādhūnāṃ bhaktānāṃ bhaktayoṣitām | gurūṇāṃ cāpi sevāyāḥ kuryāt daharniśaṃ ca yaḥ || 17|| brahmapriyāṇāṃ sevāyāstathā kṣetrasya vai śubhām | annavastrajalādānavastrakṣālanakātmikām || 18|| lepanakṣālanasaṃskāraṇamārjanakātmikām | pātramajjanarūpāṃ ca gomahiṣīprasevanām || 1 9|| āgantvatithisevāṃ ca sevāṃ bhojanapānadām | pādasaṃvāhanasevāṃ cāṃgamardanarūpiṇīm ||3.60.20 || oṣadhādipradānāṃ ca kāṣṭhāharaṇarūpiṇīm | yathāśakti yathāyogyāṃ jātyavasthānurūpiṇīm ||21 || sevāṃ bhṛtyakriyāṃ dāsīdāsakriyāṃ suśobhanām | mānatāṃ yaśca yā kuryāt kuryāttathaiva bhṛtyatām ||22|| nārāyaṇaparaṃ yasya yasyāḥ sarvasvameva tu | satāṃ parāyaṇaṃ yasya yasyāḥ sarvasvameva ca ||23|| dharmārthaṃ cāpi mokṣārthaṃ yayoḥ sarvasvameva ca | nārāyaṇaparāvetau mahābhāgavatau hi tau ||24|| bhojanārādhanaṃ sarvaṃ yathāśakti karoti yaḥ | viṣṇubhaktasya vai nityaṃ sa vai bhāgavatottamaḥ ||25|| nārāyaṇaparo bhakto’śnāti yadannameva tat | harerāsyaṃ samaśnāti tṛpyatyeva hariḥ svayam || 26|| viṣṇubhaktān pūjayed yo bhaktyā vai viṣṇuvannaraḥ | nārī vā viṣṇusāmīpyaṃ yāti muktiṃ hi śāśvatīm ||27|| anyabhaktasahasrebhyo viṣṇubhakto viśiṣyate | viṣṇubhaktasahasrebhyo harerbhakto viśiṣyate || 28|| harerbhakto brahmarūpaḥ pareśadhāmago bhavet | avatārisvarūpasya mamaiva bhaktarāṭ hi saḥ ||29|| atraiva jīvamānāyā muktāyāḥ khalu rakṣaṇam | karomyahaṃ sadā lakṣmi śṛṇu bhaktākathāṃ parām || 3.60.30|| cidambarābhavad rājñī samrājñī jiṣṇubhūbhṛtaḥ | saurāṣṭre godale deśe mama bhaktiparāyaṇā ||3 1|| jiṣṇuśaktirhi nidhanaṃ prāpto bhaktyā mamālayam | yayāvakṣarasaṃjñaṃ ca rājñī rājyamakārayat ||32|| bhaktā brahmaparā devītulyā śaucasamanvitā | prātarutthāya māṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam || 33 || parameśaṃ cākṣareśaṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam | arcayāmāsa satataṃ vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ ||34|| bhojanaṃ pūjanaṃ vāridānaṃ puṣpasrajarpaṇam | gandhādipeṣaṇaṃ cāpi dhūpadravyaprasādhanam ||35|| bhūmerālepanaṃ cāpi haviṣāṃ pācanaṃ tathā | bhaktikautukasarvasvā svayameva cakāra sā ||36|| śubhā cidambarā nityaṃ vācā nārāyaṇeti ca | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti bhāṣate muhuḥ || 37|| daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tatparā cāntarātmanā | arcayāmāsa māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ sadā ||38|| viṣṇubhaktānaparām̐śca mahābhāgavatān śubhān | dānamānārcanairnityaṃ dhanaiḥ ratnairatoṣayat || 39 || tataḥ kadācit sā rājñī suṣvāpa pūjanottaram | dvādaśyāṃ ca niśānte tāṃ pratyakṣaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||3.60.40|| ahameva svayaṃ lakṣmi sarvaśobhānvito’bhavam | tayā svapnakṛtāṃ pūjāmaṅgīcakāra sarvaśaḥ ||41 || mayā dattāni cihnāni mālāṃ kaṇṭhe hi taulasīm | bhāle satilakaścandraḥ kauṃkumaḥ śobhanastathā ||42|| netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ cāpi karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale tathā | kaṇṭhe kamalamālāṃ ca bāhvorāyudhalekhikāḥ ||43 || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmarekhāḥ satilakāstathā | ahaṃ tato’bhavaṃ lakṣmi cādṛśyastatkṣaṇāddhi sā ||44|| unnidrā hyabhavattūrṇa dadarśāṅkitavigrahām | āścaryaṃ mahadāpannābhavat pramodasaṃbhṛtā | |45 || mahābhāgavatī jātā mahāsāttvatikā tathā | madarthakṛtasarvasvā madartharājyavaibhavā ||46 || madarthārpaṇasarvasvā bheje tato hi māṃ satī | mahāvairāgyamūrtiḥ sā parameśaparāyaṇā || 47|| brahmacaryaparā nityaṃ satsaṃgatiparāyaṇā | tyaktaviṣayarāgā ca sādhvīvad vartate sadā ||48 || ātmanivedinī dāsī kiṃkarīva hi vartate | atha kālāntare cāhaṃ parīkṣitumupāyayau | |49 || airāvatamivācintyaṃ kṛtvā vai garuḍaṃ nijam | svayaṃ śakro’bhavaṃ cāpi rājñīsaudhamupāgataḥ || 3.60.50 || indro’hamasmi bhadraṃ te kiṃ dadāmi varaṃ ca te | sarvasvargeśvaraścāhaṃ dātuṃ tvāṃ svargamāgataḥ | |5 1 || gṛhāṇa nākaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vā māhendraṃ padamuttamam | te dāsī bhavatu dyauśca bhūśca dāsī sadā tava ||52 || gṛhāṇa rājyaṃ subhage vaidhavyaṃ vipravāsaya | gṛhāṇa śreṣṭhaṃ saubhāgyaṃ manvantarasamaṃ śubham ||53 || mā dehaṃ kṣapayerdivyaṃ bhogayogyaṃ sukomalam | yadṛcchayāgataṃ prāpya sukhinī bhava bhāminī ||54|| vinā kāntaṃ sadā rūkṣaṃ jagad dagdhaṃ hi yoṣitām | tasmāt kāntaṃ sukāntaṃ māṃ gṛhāṇa puṇyaśālinī ||55 || śrutvā cidambarovāca namasyāmīndrayogine | devatāyai namo me’stu mā doṣaṃ paśya devate ||56 || deho’yaṃ mānavaścāste devatā taijasī sadā | aindrapadasya hantrī ca mānavīyonirulbaṇā ||57 | | mā manuṣye puṇyahāre manaḥ kṛthāḥ surottama | mā tathā macchāpadagdho bhava kṣamāṃ vidhehi mām |||58 || pūjāṃ prāpya namo labdhvā prayāhi tvaṃ sureśvara | rājasyo devatā pūyaṃ strīvanto vai svabhāvajāḥ ||59 | | strīkāmāstatra nāścaryaṃ kintu me tanna rocate | nāhaṃ tvāmabhisandhāya rājyaṃ karomi bhūtale || 3.60.6 0|| tvayā dattaṃ ca neṣyami yāhi cendra nijālayam | mama nārāyaṇo nāthastaṃ kāntaṃ prabhajāmi hi || 61 || gacchendra mā kṛthāstvatra mama buddhivilopanam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadāsī bhavāmyaham ||62| śrutvaivaṃ bhagavānindro vivṛtya cendrarūpatām | śārṅgacakragadāpadmapāṇirūpo’bhavat svayam ||63 || garuḍopari lakṣmīśrīsahito’haṃ hariḥ prabhuḥ | pratyakṣatāṃ gatastasyāḥ sā tuṣṭāva nanāma mām ||64|| prasīda devadeveśeśvareśvareśvareśvara | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama ||65|| tvamanādiḥ patirnāthaḥ svāmī kāntaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ | aprameyo vibhurviṣṇurgovindaḥ kamalekṣaṇaḥ ||66 || brahmapriyāpatirharipriyāpatiḥ parameśvaraḥ | tvāṃ prapannāsmi govinda godaleśa priya prabho ||67|| tvāṃ vinā kāṃkṣaye naiva rājyaṃ svargaṃ sukhaṃ param | nānyā gatistvadanyā me tvameva śaraṇaṃ mama ||68|| satyendrastvaṃ mahendratvaṃ cātmendrastvaṃ pareśvara | mama sarvendriyāṇāṃ tvāṃ yayārthendraṃ bhajāmi hi ||69|| namāmi prāṇanāthaṃ tvāṃ namāmi cāntarasthitam | namāmi sukhaśayyāsthaṃ turyapadasuyoginam ||3.60.70|| śrutvā stutimavocaṃ tāṃ kiṃ te hṛdi cikīrṣitam | tatsarvaṃ te pradāsyāmi vada bhaktāsi me parā ||71 || bhaktipriyo’haṃ satataṃ yadicchasi dadāmi tat | śrutvā cidambarā prāha nityaṃ me mānasaṃ ca hṛt ||72||| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāntaparāyaṇam | vartatāṃ mayi nāthastvaṃ kāntākānto hṛdi sthitaḥ ||73|| yathā hare bhavānāste sarvāntarātmavit prabhuḥ | tathā bhavāmyahaṃ kṛṣṇa tvadāntarātmabhūyasī ||74|| kṛpayā te yāvadasti pālayiṣyāmi medinīm | vaiṣṇavaṃ ca kratuṃ kṛtvā tarpayiṣyāmi devatāḥ ||75|| vaiṣṇavān pālayiṣyāmi bhavān vasatu me gṛhe | mama kānto bhavānāste sadā rakṣākaro bhava ||76|| yadvā dhāma nijaṃ nītvā māṃ lakṣmīmaparāṃ kuru | yatheṣṭaṃ cara gopāla ramāpāla cidaṃ prati ||77|| cidambaroktaṃ śrutvaiva mayā lakṣmi gadā mama | sarvasaṃhāratejobhiryuktā tasyai samarpitā ||78|| rājyarakṣākarī śatrunāśinī pārśvayāyinī | sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi gadānāṃ yatsvarūpataḥ ||79|| jāyante raṇakāle vai śāparogārināśikāḥ | tāṃ datvāhaṃ mama sthānaṃ samāyayau kṛpāmayaḥ ||3.60.80| sāpi pramuditā rāṣṭraṃ godalaṃ pālayatyapi | sarvavarṇān dharmamārge svasvakarmasvayojayat ||8 1|| gṛhe gṛhe’kārayacca bhaktiṃ śrīpauruṣottamīm | gṛhe gṛhe haristasthau vedaghoṣo gṛhe gṛhe ||82|| nāmaghoṣo hareścaiva yajñaghoṣaḥ pure pure | kārayāmāsa yajñām̐śca vaiṣṇavān nṛpanandinī ||83|| cidambarāyāṃ śāstryāṃ ca bhūmirāsīd rasapradā | satṛṇā rogahīnāśca prajāśca nirupadravāḥ ||84|| durbhikṣādirahitāśca mahotsavotsavāḥ śubhāḥ | akālamṛtyurnāstyeva vyādhirādhirna vidyate ||886|| evaṃ lakṣmi tayā rājñyā kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ hi vaiṣṇavam | sādhavo rakṣitāścāpi mandireṣu sthale sthale ||86|| santaḥ sampūjitāścāpi vāryambarānnabhojanaiḥ | satyaḥ sādhvyo rakṣitāśca sevitāḥ satataṃ tayā ||87|| gāvaśca rakṣitāḥ sādhvyāḥ anāthāḥ pālitāstathā | nityaṃ prātastathā sāyaṃ kāritaṃ bhajanaṃ mama ||88|| maṇḍalyaḥ sthāpitāścāpi bhaktanārījanānvitāḥ | hare kṛṣṇa hare nārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama ||89|| hare lakṣmīpate rādhāpate brahmapriyāpate | evaṃ tayā kāritaṃ ca kīrtanaṃ mama sarvataḥ ||3.60.90|| annasatrāṇi ramyāṇi kāritāni tayā tathā | jalaprapāḥ kāritāśca vṛkṣacchāyāḥ prakāritāḥ ||9 1 || dharmaśālāḥ kāritāśca gośālā kāritāstathā | vidyālayāḥ kāritāśca brahmavidyālayāstathā ||92|| kṛṣikāryodayāścāpi nadāśca kāritāstayā | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre cidambarāsatīkṛtam ||93|| mandiraṃ me śobhate’tra paśya gaganaśṛṃgavat | nityaṃ prātarhi sā rājñī snātvā sampūjya māṃ tataḥ ||94|| sabhāyāṃ brahmavijñānāṃ samāyāti hi nityaśaḥ | brahmakathāṃ sadā tatra karoti godalāyanaḥ ||95|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ karoti vācanam | kīrtanaṃ jāyate paścāt tataścāpi visarjanam ||96|| sādhūnāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca satsaṃgo jāyate śubhaḥ | brahmaśīlaparāṇāṃ vai sevā hṛdyā prajāyate ||97|| nityaṃ bhavanti pañcāpi yajñāstasyā hi rāṣṭrake | ityevaṃ dhyāyamānā māṃ karoti rājyanirvaham ||98|| divyā divyaramātulyā cidambarā haripriyā | hariṃ patiṃ prabhuṃ prāpya vairāgyavṛttimāśritā ||99|| bhajantāṃ bhagavantaṃ taṃ prāṇeśaṃ parameśvaram | prayāntu śāśvataṃ dhāma labhantāṃ mudamuttamam || 3.60.10 0|| ityevaṃ sā prajāḥ sarvāḥ śikṣāṃ śrāvayati dhruvām | dhruvapuṇyaphalāṃ sādhvī divyadehavatī hyabhūt || 10 1|| etādṛśīnāṃ bhaktānāṃ rakṣāṃ karomi sarvadā | dadāmi pārśvavāsaṃ ca sevāṃ caraṇayostathā || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ mahābhāgavatabhaktacihnāni cidambarārājñyāḥ parīkṣaṇaṃ bhaktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 60 ||
<3.61> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ bhaktāyā rakṣaṇaṃ tathā | gadayā ca kṛtaṃ tatte vakṣyāmi cādbhutaṃ mahat || 1 || ekadā bhadrako nāma rākṣaso’bdhinivāsakṛt | śrutvā jñātvā striyā rājyaṃ godalaṃ paścarāṣṭrakam || 2 || cidambarāṃ nijāṃ nārīṃ kartumanāḥ sa rākṣasaḥ | kāmarūpadharo bhūtvā rājanyaśatamohanaḥ || 3 || yuvā bhūtvātiramaṇaḥ puṣṭaḥ saundaryarājitaḥ | klṛptavaiṣṇavatilakaḥ klṛptarākṣasasādhubhiḥ || 4 || klṛptaviprajanairyukto yātrāluveṣaśobhitaḥ | rājasmṛddhiyuto godalākhyaṃ puramupāyayau || 5 || kilāsanāyāṃ vāṭyāṃ sa saṃgharūpo hyuvāsa ha | rājñyā vṛttāntamājñāya rakṣo bhūtvā tu vaiṣṇavaḥ || 6 || nṛpo yayau rājasaudhaṃ rājñīṃ dadarśa śobhanām | rājñyā vijñāya rājanyaḥ satkṛtaḥ svāgatādibhiḥ || 7 || yayāce sa tato rājñīṃ rājyaṃ cāṅgamohitaḥ | rājñī nyaṣedhayat tūrṇaṃ gantuṃ rāṣṭrād bahistadā || 8 || śīghramājñāpayaccāpi rākṣaso’pi tu vai drutam | natvā svakān janān nītvā samudraṃ prayayau tataḥ || 9 || ekākī tvāgataḥ kālāntare rātrau nṛpīṃ prati | śayānāṃ tāṃ samuttolya skandhe nināya cāmbare || 3.61.1 0|| prayayau vai drutaṃ rakṣo rājñī connidritā yadā | dadarśa rākṣasaṃ vyomni svāṃ nayantaṃ satī tadā || 1 1|| sasmāra tāṃ gadāṃ kaumudakīṃ gadā drutaṃ puraḥ | āgatā ca tato rājñyā tvājñaptā rakṣaṇāya vai || 1 2|| rākṣasaṃ cāpi hantuṃ vai tāvad gadā bhayaṃkarī | ambare tu samuḍḍīya rakṣaḥskandhe papāta ha || 1 3|| mastake pṛṣṭhabhāge ca bāhvoḥ sakthnośca pādayoḥ | bhadrakasyāvayaveṣu cotpatyotpatya vai muhuḥ || 14|| jaghāna rākṣasaṃ so’pi pṛthvyāṃ papāta tāḍitaḥ | mūrchitaścābhavat kilāsanodyānasamīpataḥ || 15|| gadayā sahitā rājño smṛtvā māṃ parameśvaram | saprāṇaṃ rākṣasaṃ tyaktvā nijālayamupāyayau || 16|| rākṣasaḥ prayayau naijaṃ sthānaṃ sāmudramadhyagam | rājñīrakṣāṃ samākarṇya prajā magnāstadābhavan || 17|| āśīrvādaiḥ prajā rājñīṃ vardhayāmāsurutsukāḥ | rājñī pūjāṃ hareḥ kṛtvā gadāpūjāṃ cakāra ha || 18|| evaṃ rakṣā kṛtā rājñyā gadayā rākṣasāt tadā | rākṣaso’pi punaḥ kālāntare cāyāt sasainyakaḥ ||1 9|| āhartuṃ tāṃ nṛpīṃ rājyaṃ naijaṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ | bahubhiḥ sainyabhāgaiḥ saḥ purīmāvṛttya garjanām ||3.61.20|| cakāra vyomamārgeṇa yuddhavādyānyavādayat | rājñī tuṣṭāva māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gadāṃ pupūja candanaiḥ ||21|| bhojanairhāragandhādyaiḥ rakṣāṃ vavre tataḥ param | gadotthāya nijasthānādambare sābhavat kṣaṇāt ||22|| koṭisūryāgnisampannā babhūva kṣaṇamātrataḥ | udvamatsuvahniśikhā sagarjanā muhurmuhuḥ ||23|| rodasī nādayamānā śuśubhe vijayāvahā | yayau śīghraṃ bhadrakasya sainyaṃ ca bhadrakaṃ prati ||24|| bhadrakaṃ mārayāmāsa mūḍhamāreṇa sā gadā | tataḥ sainyaṃ gadādevī mārayāmāsa mūḍhavat ||25|| sainyaṃ bhagnaṃ rākṣasānāṃ rākṣaso’pi vimūrchitaḥ | papāta bhūtale tāvad gadā maunamupasthitā ||26|| rākṣasaḥ prāṇarakṣāṃ ca kṛtvā palāyanaṃ vyadhāt | sainyaṃ dudrāva śiṣṭaṃ ca jayakāro’bhavat striyāḥ ||27|| sā śāntā ca gadā sthānamāgatya niṣkriyābhavat | rājñī pupūja vidhinā naivedyādi dadau tathā ||28|| atha kālāntare yāte rākṣasā bahavo’bdhijāḥ | militvā mantraṇāṃ cakrū rājñīrāṣṭropalabdhaye ||29|| astraśastravidaścānye māyāmantravido’pare | antardhānavidaścāpi bahurūpavidastathā ||3.61.3 0|| siddhimanto rākṣasāśca rākṣasyo’pi sahasraśaḥ | yuddhasāmagrikāyuktāścāyayurgodalāṃ purīm ||3 1 || vyomamārgeṇa rakṣāṃsi vinedurjayakāṃkṣiṇaḥ | yuddhaśabdān pracakruścāvādayan dundubhīn muhuḥ ||32|| śaṃkhaśabdān pracakruśca raṇavādyānyavādayan | kilakilādiśabdānāsphoṭādīm̐śca vyadhustadā ||33|| evaṃ śrutvā rākṣasānāṃ ghoṣān bhayaṃkarān prajāḥ | santresū rājasainyāni santresuścāti bhūstare ||34|| pradhānādyā nṛpīṃ gatvā jñāpayāmāsurulbaṇam | upadravaṃ samarārthaṃ rākṣasānāṃ samīhitam || 35|| rājñī śīghraṃ samutthāya snātvā gadāṃ pupūja sā | dhūpadīpasunaivedyairnīrājanairavardhayat ||36|| gurvī gadā tadā nārīrūpā divyā raṇeśvarī | bhūtvā sarvāstraśastrādyaiḥ sampannā samuvāca ha ||37|| ahaṃ bhāgavatīśaktiḥ rakṣārthaṃ te’smi yojitā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena paramātmanā ||38|| adyāparādhinaṃ cainaṃ trivāraṃ samupāgatam | raṇaṃ datvā vividhaṃ ca tato vai prāṇanāśanam ||39|| kariṣye’sya mahārājñi namaste svasti te śubham | ityuktvā sarvaśaktyāḍhyā raṇeśvarī gadā tadā ||3.61.40 || svadehāt suṣuve puṣṭān yoddhṛn raṇāvisahyakān | yojayāmāsa tān sarvān vyomagatīn gaheśvarān ||41|| kṛtvā sainyāni sāstrāṇi saśastrāṇi ca te’mbare | uḍḍīya rakṣaḥsainyāni samāskanditavanti vai ||42|| rākṣasā rākṣasīvrātāścāpi peturmaholbaṇāḥ | śastrairgadābhirdaṇḍaiśca tomarairlohagolakaiḥ ||43|| prastaraiścopalābhiśca bhūśūṇḍīśaktibhirdrumaiḥ | nārācaiśca śarairbāṇaiḥ khaḍgairbhallaiśca golakaiḥ ||44|| atha dṛṣṭvā rākṣasānāṃ sannāhaṃ cātiveginam | gadeśvarāścābhipeturvyomnā samaradurmadāḥ ||45|| śastrairastrairgolakaiśca gadābhistomarādibhiḥ | nijaghnuḥ rākṣasān vīrā gadādevīpraṇoditāḥ ||46|| parasparaṃ nijaghnuśca śastrairvividhadhāribhiḥ | mārayāmāsurugrāste dvibhāgān rākṣasān vyadhuḥ ||47|| kaṇṭhataḥ skandhataścāpi kaṭitaḥ karatastathā | sakthito bhedayāmāsurnāśayāmāsurāsurān ||48|| cūrṇayāmāsurugrān vai rākṣasān hi gadeśvarāḥ | pātayāmāsurasubhirviyujyāmbaratastalam ||49|| gale dhṛtvā karābhyāṃ ca cūṣayāmāsurāsurān | agniṃ vibhāvya rakṣāṃsi jvālayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ||3.61.50|| vimardo vai mahāñjāto rakṣasāṃ bhūnipātinām | tadā sa bhadrakaścakre māyāṃ rākṣasajīvanīm ||51 || rakṣāṃsyujjīvayāmāsa sarvaśastrāstrakovidān | utthāyotthāya te jaghnurgadeśvarān bhaṭān muhuḥ ||52|| māyikān vai gajānuṣṭrān makarān vyāghrabhallukān | siṃhān jhaṣān śarabhām̐śca dvipino vyālapuṃgavān ||53|| bhūtapretapiśācām̐śca parvatān vaidyutān bhaṭān | meghaśilāḥ samutpādya māyayā jaghnurīśvarān ||54|| vātavṛṣṭiṃ pracakruśca rajovṛṣṭiṃ vyadhustathā | vahnivṛṣṭiṃ vyadhuścāpi śilāvṛṣṭiṃ vyadhustathā ||55|| śalabhānāṃ mahāvṛṣṭiṃ vṛścikānāṃ pravarṣaṇam | vyālānāṃ kṛkalāsānāṃ godhānāṃ varṣaṇaṃ vyadhuḥ ||56|| viṣavṛṣṭiṃ vyadhuścāpi raktavṛṣṭiṃ vyadhustathā | uṣṇodakānāṃ dhārābhiḥ prajānāṃ pīḍanaṃ vyadhuḥ ||57|| kardamānāṃ varṣaṇaṃ ca hastināṃ varṣaṇaṃ tataḥ | vṛkṣāṇāṃ varṣaṇaṃ cāpi siṃhānāṃ varṣaṇaṃ vyadhuḥ ||58|| agnīnāṃ varṣaṇaṃ cāpi rākṣasānāṃ ca varṣaṇam | vyadhuste rākṣasāstatra bhayaṃkarapravarṣaṇam ||59|| śastrāṇāṃ varṣaṇaṃ cāpi vyadhurdehavibhedinām | evaṃ vināśarūpaṃ te cakrū raṇaṃ hi rākṣasāḥ ||3.61.60|| brahmajit kratujiccāpi devāntako narāntakaḥ | kumbhagartaḥ śaṃkurathaścāyomukhaḥ śatāhvayaḥ ||6 1|| indrajidekacakraśca prāpaṇaśca puruṇḍakaḥ | cūrṇanābhaścāsilomā kuṃbhamāno mahodakaḥ ||62|| śvalabhastālaketuśca savyāsivyaḥ supuñjikaḥ | kālanābho yajñahāśca śrāddhādo vajrahāstathā ||63|| vidyutputraśca rasano vapāśo raktakarṇakaḥ | vṛttākṣāḥ piṅgalāścāpi hyaṣṭadaṃṣṭrā mahodarāḥ ||64|| sthūlaśīrṣā hrasvajaṃghāstāmrasyāścordhvamūrdhajāḥ | gartākṣā lambajihvoṣṭhā lambabhrūsthūlanāsikāḥ ||65|| hatāstatra gadābhiśca ta ete rakṣasāṃ gaṇāḥ | rākṣasyo vikacā brahmadhānā ālambikādikāḥ ||66|| gadotthābhirgadābhiśca hatāstā yuddhabhūmiṣu | gadāsainyāni māṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ prabhum ||67|| smṛtvā smṛtvā nipetuśca rākṣasānāṃ hi mūrdhasu | cūrṇitāni śirāṃsyeva vakṣāṃsi rakṣasāṃ tadā ||68|| nihanmaḥ sarvarakṣāṃsi yamakṣayāya sarvadā | notthānāya punaḥ śapāmahe saṃkarṣaṇāhvayā ||69|| ityuktvā mārayāmāsū raṇeśvaryo gadāstadā | ātyantikaṃ ca nidhanaṃ prapeduḥ rakṣasāṃ gaṇāḥ ||3.61.70|| māyayā vṛṣṭayaḥ sarvā vilīnāśca tato’mbare | pṛthvī rakṣogaṇadehaiḥ śavaiḥ sarvāvṛtābhavat ||71 || bhadrakastvāyayau dhartuṃ dhāvan raṇeśvarīṃ gadām | tamāpatantaṃ parito gadāśataṃ babhūva ha ||72|| mārayāmāsa parito mūḍhamāreṇa bhadrakam | raktasrāvaṃ cakārāpi vamanaṃ raktajaṃ tathā ||73|| kṛtvā bhagnaśiro vakṣāḥ papāta hāvadan kṣitau | bhadrako nidhanaṃ yāto rākṣasā ye’pare’bhavan ||74|| raṇaṃ vihāya śataśaḥ palāyanaṃ pracakrire | gadāḥ pṛṣṭhe patitvaiva jaghnustān jīvadānataḥ ||75|| nipetuste prāṇahīnāḥ prasārya karajānujān | vyādāyānakukṣīm̐śca kāladharma prapedire ||76|| naiko’pi śeṣatāṃ bheje sarvaṃ śatasahasrakam | sainyaṃ rākṣasavaryāṇāṃ nidhanaṃ gadayārpitam ||77|| atha rājñī prasasmāra patiṃ nārāyaṇaṃ hi mām | śuddhyarthaṃ jīvanārthaṃ ca prajānāṃ raṇabhūmiṣu ||78|| śīghraṃ mayā tadā lakṣmi mama pādajalāmṛtam | arpitaṃ kalaśe’gādhe cidambarātmake drutam ||79|| sā bhūmau vyomamārgeṇa prajājīvanahetave | prokṣaṇaṃ pracakāraiṣā prajā jīvantu me mṛtāḥ ||3.61.80|| iti saṃkalpitāstatra raṇe yā yāḥ prajāstadā | prasahya madhye bhūbhāge nidhanaṃ gamitāśca tāḥ ||81|| tāḥ sarvā jīvanaṃ prāptā nidrotthitā yathā punaḥ | rākṣasānāṃ tu dehānāṃ gadābhirvahninā tadā ||82|| bhasmatā vai kṛtā tatra mamecchayā hi padmaje | evaṃ gadāḥ paraṃ kṛtvā raṇaṃ hatvā tu rākṣasān |||83||| raṇeśvaryaḥ purastānme rājñyāḥ saudhe samāyayuḥ | āśīrbhirvardhitāstāśca varadānāya noditāḥ ||84|| vavrire tāḥ kanyakā vai patiṃ māṃ parameśvaram | cidambarāpi muditā raṇeśvarībhireva sā ||85|| sahitā pūjayāmāsa māṃ tadā varamālayā | raṇeśvaryaḥ sahasraṃ vai varayāmāsureva mām ||86|| gadeśvarāstathā ramyaṃ vavrire varadānakam | pārṣadā bhavituṃ dhāmni mayā tathāstviti dhruvāḥ ||87|| svīkṛtāḥ pārṣadāḥ sarve yayurdhāma mamākṣaram | raṇeśvaryastathā lakṣmi mama priyāḥ pare’kṣare ||88|| vartante tāśca vai muktānikāḥ paramadhāmani | cidambarāpi me bhaktā gadeśvarāya yogine ||89|| mama bhaktāya saumyāya pārṣadāya samastakam | rājyaṃ datvā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ mama parātparam ||3.61.90|| gadeśvaro mahārājo brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ | cakāra lakṣavarṣāṇi rājyaṃ vaiṣṇavadharmavān ||91|| bhaktiṃ me kārayitvā ca kṛtvā prajāśca vaiṣṇavīḥ | yajñayāgādikān kṛtvā santṛpya devatā pitṝn ||92|| mama vimānamāruhya yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ mama | taddāyādo’bhavaccāpi yogeśvaro’pi bhaktarāṭ ||93 || sādhudharmā sādhuvarmā sādhusādhvīsamarcakaḥ | mama bhaktiṃ kārayitvā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||94|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi mama bhaktasya gauravam | rakṣaṇaṃ mama bhaktāyā yathā karomi vai tathā ||95|| yatra bhaktā ca bhakto me tatra vasāmi gocaraḥ | agocaro’thavā tiṣṭhe sāmarthyena hi hetinā ||96|| pārṣadena prabhāveṇa rakṣayāmi mamāśritām | naro nārī napuṃ vāpi mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ||97|| madātmā matkriyaḥ samyag rakṣyate cāntarātmanā | mayā nivasatā pārśve hṛdaye vāntike puraḥ ||98|| pṛṣṭhe cordhve’dhobhūmau ca madhye cāvayaveṣvapi | mama vāsena bhaktāyā rakṣā bhavati sarvathā ||99|| vadhvaḥ parādhīnabhāvā mama bhaktā hi tā yadi | rakṣyante nityadā tābhiḥ sākaṃ sthitena vai mayā || 3.61.10 0|| anāthānāṃ hi nātho’haṃ karomi rakṣaṇaṃ sadā | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktiśca rakṣaṇam || 10 1|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ cidambarārājñyāḥ bhagavadgadayā kṛtaṃ bhadrakādirakṣaḥsaṃghātād rakṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 61 ||
<3.62> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sarvātmakaṃ narāyaṇam | sarvakriyānvayaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vidyāddhi māṃ tu yā || 1 || nārāyaṇaṃ japennityaṃ namenmāṃ puruṣottamam | svāpe nārāyaṇaṃ yāne gamane māṃ narāyaṇam || 2 || sthāne nārāyaṇaṃ māṃ bhojane nārāyaṇaṃ ca mām | unmeṣe ca nimeṣe ca nārāyaṇaṃ hi māṃ smaret || 3 || jāgaraṇe’pi māṃ nārāyaṇaṃ namet smarettathā | bhojyaṃ peyaṃ ca lehyaṃ ca namo nārāyaṇeti yā || 4 || pāvayitvābhibhuṃkte yā sā yāti paramāṃ gatim | anyānabhijanām̐ścāpi prāpayatyeva sadgatim || 5 || mama nāmasmṛtisaṃkīrtanāḍhyāyāstu yoṣitaḥ | tvaṃ lakṣmīrmama sarvasvarūpā kṛṣṇasyavallabhā || 6 || gṛhe kṣetre tathā vāse tasyā vasasi varṣmaṇi | ṣoḍaśākṣaramantraṃ me paṭhamānā purendrajā || 7 || jayantī janmamūkā sā sārvajñyaṃ ca sarasvatīm | prāpa pāṇḍityamutkṛṣṭaṃ bṛhaspatisamābhavat || 8 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | ityevaṃ japakartryā vai naipuṇyaṃ jāyate matau || 9 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | iti japaṃ prakurvantyāḥ saubhāgyaṃ susthiraṃ bhavet || 3.62.1 0|| kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt | śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava || 11 || ityevaṃ japamānāyā nātho nārāyaṇastvaham | bhūtvā dadāmi me dhāmākṣaraṃ śāśvatamodanam || 1 2|| brāhmyahaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktāsmi śāśvatī | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me || 13|| ityevaṃ japamānā vai lakṣmīrūpāṃ karomyaham | bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ || 14|| pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako’stu saḥ | ityevaṃ japamānā vai brahmapriyāṃ karomyaham || 15|| śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mama sarvadā | ityevaṃ japamānāyā nāśayāmyaghasaṃcayam || 16|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | parabrahmākṣarātīto’vatārāṇāṃ svarūpadhṛk || 17|| antaryāmī sadāsmāsu bhagavān sarvakāraṇam | sarvāntarātmā sarveśo nirlepo mokṣadaḥ sa hi || 18|| pāvanaḥ sevito bhuktimuktidaśca sadāvatu | ityevaṃ japamānāyai dadāmi kamalāpadam || 19|| brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca rādhālakṣmyādiyoṣitaḥ | parabrahmasvarūpāśca parabrahmārdhamūrtayaḥ ||3.62.20 || parabrahmārthasarvasvā divyā bhuktipramuktidāḥ | tatsambandhikriyāścāpi nirguṇā mokṣadāḥ sadā ||21 || ityevaṃ japamānā vai muktānīṃ prakaromyaham | yo yo yā yā bālakṛṣṇaṃ tatpriyāśca bhajatyapi || 22|| sa sa sā sā tatsvarūpā divyā mokṣapradā sadā | ityevaṃ japamānāyā divyarūpaṃ prajāyate ||23|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | ityevaṃ japamānā sve rūpe’ntarbhāvayāmyaham ||24|| oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ me’ itimanum | japantyāḥ sādhayāmyeva puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam ||25|| kṛṣṇasyapriyabhaktāhaṃ śrīhariṃḥ śaraṇaṃ mama | śrīkṛṣṇasarvavidyābdhiḥ śrīsvāmī śaraṇaṃ mama |26| śrīkṛṣṇo vallabhasvāmī śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama | itimantrān japantyā me nityavāso’sti sā mayi ||27|| ime mantrā mayā lakṣmi svamūrtayaḥ prakāśitāḥ | matsamā matsvarūpāste madvatkāryārthasādhakāḥ |||28||| śrīkṛṣṇovallabhonāthaḥ śaraṇaṃ me’ iti manuḥ | sarvārthado dvādaśārṇastanmāhātmyaṃ vadāmi te |||29|| vedhaḥputrī samutpannā sarasvatī subālikā | sarvavidyāparipūrṇā vedavedāṃgasaṃbhṛtā | tataśca śāradā kanyā cotpannā brahmaṇaḥ sutā ||3.62.30|| sarasvatī vadatyeva saṃskṛtāmuttamāṃ giram | śāradā na śaśākāpi kṛtopanayanāpi sā | mūkābhavattadā jihvā spandate naiva yatnataḥ ||3 1|| khinno’bhavad vidhātā ca sāvitrī kheditābhavat | tato vai śāradā kanyā śuśoca manasā hyati | yayau sarasvatīpārśvaṃ darśayantī svajihvikām ||32|| sarasvatī vicāryaiva dvādaśākṣaramantravat | jalaṃ pramantrya pradadau tajjihvāyāṃ tu pāvanam ||33|| śrīkṛṣṇavallabhācāryaḥ śaraṇaṃ me’ iti muhuḥ | jalaṃ pramantrya pradadau tajjihvāyāṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||34|| tāvattu śāradādevyā vāṇī jihvāgatābhavat | svaravyañjanavākyāni vedavedāṃgakāni ca ||35|| bhūtabhavyāni sarvāṇi jagau mantrapratāpataḥ | evaṃ divyābhavadvāṇīyuktā vai śāradā satī ||36|| prasanno’bhūd viśvasṛṭ ca sāvitrī ca sarasvatī | etadvai kathitaṃ lakṣmi dvādaśākṣaravaibhavam ||37|| paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ cāpi dhruvaṃ vai paramaṃ padam | api pāpasamācārā dvādaśākṣaratatparā ||38|| prāpnoti paramaṃ sthānaṃ me śubhaṃ tvakṣarābhidham | omityekākṣaraṃ mantraṃ japan yāti parāṃ gatim ||39|| kṛṣṇe’tidvyakṣaraṃ mantraṃ japan golokamṛcchati | śrīkṛṣṇatryakṣaraṃ mantraṃ japan golokamuttamam ||3.62.40|| vāsudevetimantraṃ vā rādhākṛṣṇeti vā japan | caturvarṇaṃ manuṃ yāti tvayā kṛtaṃ nijālayam ||41|| oṃ nārāyaṇapañcārṇaṃ japan śvetākṣaraṃ padam | namo nārāyaṇāye’tijapan brahmākṣaraṃ padam ||42|| oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ japan yātyakṣaraṃ padam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇaśrīromiti gṛṇan vikuṇṭhakam ||43|| anādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’tyapi cākṣaraṃ padam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇetidivyamakṣaram ||44|| oṃ māṇikīśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti parākṣaram | padaṃ yāti japan dehi lakṣmi dhāmottamottamam ||45|| oṃ sukhadālakṣmīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’ti matpadam | prāpnoti japavān bhakto bhaktānī japasaṃyutā ||46|| śrīkṛṣṇovallabhaḥsvāmī śaraṇaṃ me’ manuṃ tvimam | manumūrdhanyamutsāhājjapan yāti mamāntaram ||47|| oṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ, oṃ nārāyaṇāya namaśca | oṃ vāsudevāya namaḥ, oṃ mahāviṣṇave namaḥ ||48|| oṃ viṣṇave namaśce’ti oṃ sadāśivāya namaḥ | o hiraṇyagarbhāya namaḥ, oṃ śivāya namastathā ||49|| oṃ rāmādityāya namaḥ, oṃ nṛsiṃhāya namaśca | oṃ kapilāya namaḥ, oṃ śrīharaye namaśca ||3.62.50|| oṃ dattātreyāya namaḥ, omṛṣabhāya namaśca, | oṃ vāmanāya namaśca, oṃ parśurāmāya namaḥ|||91 || oṃ yajñāya namaśca, oṃ sanatkumārāya namaḥ | oṃ vyāsāya namaśce’ti, oṃ buddhāya nama,stathā ||52|| oṃ naranārāyaṇāya namaḥ, oṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ | oṃ parabrahmaṇe namaḥ, omantaryāmiṇe namaḥ ||53|| oṃ mādhavāya namaśca, oṃ govindāya namaśca | oṃ keśavāya namaśca, oṃ śrīpataye namaśca ||54|| oṃ svāmine namaśca, omakṣarātītāya namaḥ | oṃ puruṣottamāya namaḥ, oṃ paramātmane namaḥ ||55|| omanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya vidmahe | gopālakṛṣṇātmajāya dhīmahi | tannaḥ kambharāśrīsutaḥ pracodayāt ||56|| ete mantrāḥ sadā lakṣmi bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ | tattaddhāmapradāḥ sarve pāpatāpapraṇāśakāḥ | sarvapumarthadāścāpi sarvecchāpūrakāstathā ||57|| sahasraṃ cāyutaṃ cāpi lakṣaṃ koṭirjapā matāḥ | yathāśraddhaṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ yathāvegaṃ phalapradāḥ ||58|| oṃ śriyai namaḥ, oṃ lakṣmyai namaḥ, oṃ ramāyai namaḥ | oṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ, oṃ nārāyaṇyai namaśca vai ||59|| oṃ brāhmayaiva namaḥ, oṃ puruṣottamyai namaśca tathā | oṃ vaiṣṇavyai namaḥ, oṃ kamalāyai namaḥ, oṃ māyai namaḥ ||3.62.60|| oṃ vāsudevyai namaḥ, oṃ kṛṣṇāyai nama ityapi | oṃ mādhavyai namaḥ, oṃ parameśvaryai nama iti ||61 || oṃ śivāyai namaḥ, omantaryāmiṇyai nama iti | oṃ mahāvaiṣṇavyai namaḥ, oṃ padmāyai namastathā ||62|| oṃ kambharālakṣmyai namaḥ, oṃ prajñāyai namastathā, | oṃ rādhāyai namaśca oṃ brahmapriyāyai namaśca ||63|| oṃ hariṇyai namaḥ, oṃ haripriyāyai namastathā | oṃ hiraṇyamayyai namaḥ, oṃ kārṣṇavāllabhyai namaḥ ||64|| oṃ pārvatyai namaḥ, oṃ māṇikyāyai nama ityapi | oṃ sukhadālakṣmyai namaḥ, oṃ śivarājñīśriyai namaḥ ||65|| oṃ nārāyaṇīśriyai namaḥ, oṃ dhāminyai namaḥ | oṃ sukhadālakṣmyai vidmahe nārāyaṇīśriyai dhīmahi | tannaḥ śivarājñīśrīḥ pracodayāt ||66|| ā kṛṣṇāya vidmahe vallabhāya dhīmahi prajñā tannaḥ pracodayāt | om ācāryāya vidmahe gurave dhīmahi pārvatī naḥ pracodayāt ||67|| ete mantrāḥ sadā lakṣmi bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ | yāvatpumarthadāḥ sarvasukhavāñcchāprapūrakāḥ ||68|| śataṃ sahasraṃ cāyutaṃ niyutaṃ koṭirityapi | japtāḥ śraddhānvitāstvāṃ māṃ smṛtvā śāśvatakāmadāḥ ||69|| tvamahaṃ tvamahaṃ lakṣmi so’haṃ so’haṃ japecca yaḥ | smṛtvā māṃ cāpi tasmai ca tasyai dadāmyahaṃ nijam ||3.62.70|| mamāsanaṃ mama dhāma mamātmānaṃ dadāmi ca | madbhaktārthaṃ mama sarvaṃ śeṣayāmi na cārpaṇe ||71 || bhaja lakṣmi bhaja rādhe māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vallabhaṃ patim | bhaja kānte bhaja cānte prakāśe ca rahasyapi ||72|| bhaja dehe bhaja gehe prāṇapriyaṃ tathāntare | bhaja gupte bhaja supte śāśvatānandakṛtsukham ||73|| bhajanaṃ bhaktiratyantaṃ premasevā vinodinī | dravyasampadvāṭikādyairvāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ | seveta paramātmānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ māṃ pareśvaram ||74|| pratyakṣaṃ vartamānaṃ māṃ severan vai narāḥ striyaḥ | ahaṃ divyasvarūpo’smi paramākṣaradhāmagaḥ | sa evātra bhavāmyadya saurāṣṭre kaṃbharātmajaḥ ||75|| śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasya nandanaḥ parameśvaraḥ | manvantareṣu vai lakṣmi sthāsyāmyatraiva sarvathā ||76|| pāvano’haṃ gururūpo yathāsmi lomaśastathā | dhātupāṣāṇamūrtyādau yathāhaṃ nivasāmi vai ||77|| tathā cāsmi vaiṣṇavācāryeṣu svayaṃ paraḥ prabhuḥ | ye ye gurusthale yogyā abhiṣiktā narāḥ striyaḥ ||78|| teṣu tāsu nivatsyāmi sākaṃ tvayā hi padmaje | tasmādvai guravo loke divyā mamaiva mūrtayaḥ ||79|| darśanāt sparśanāccapi sevanāt tārakā hi te | māṃ vinā pṛthivī naiva riktā prajāyate kvacit ||3.62.80 || pravāhāṃśāveśarūpaiḥ pravarte’haṃ vasāmi ca | cetanā mūrtayaḥ sarvā gurvātmikā jagattraye ||8 1 || akṣare’haṃ sadā muktamuktānīpatirasmi ca | goloke’haṃ gopikānāṃ gopānāṃ patirasmi ca ||82|| vaikuṇṭhe’haṃ pārṣadānāṃ pārṣadīnāṃ patistathā | avyākṛte’pi caivāsmi tathāmṛte bhavāmi ca ||83 || śrīpure dhīḥ svayamasmi kailāse śaṃkaro’smi ca | satye brahmā guruścāsmi pitṛloke tathāryamā ||84|| bṛhaspatiḥ suraloke mānave sādhurasmi ca | daityānāmuśanāścāsmi brāhmaṇānāṃ vasiṣṭhakaḥ | sādhvī cāsmi yoṣitāṃ ca narāṇāṃ dhiṣṇyaśobhanaḥ ||85|| sarpāṇāṃ śeṣa evāsmi paśūnāṃ vṛṣabho’smi ca | yādasāṃ kacchapaścāsmi krūrāṇāṃ śarabho’smi ca ||86|| kalpalatā tu vallīnāṃ śākhināṃ kalpapādapaḥ | vidyārthināṃ śikṣako’smi vadhūnāṃ patimātṛkā ||87|| evaṃ gururevaṃ sarvatra mama sattāmayaṃ priye | varte’haṃ sarvadā tatra gurau tīrthottamottame ||88|| guruṃ māṃ gocaraṃ jñātvā yo bhajeta nirantaram | tasya nānyatra me gaveṣaṇaṃ kartuṃ hi śiṣyate ||89|| gurau sthitvā divyarūpaḥ pratīkṣāmi hi sevinaḥ | ye yā yathā prapadyante tām̐stām̐stathā bhajāmyapi ||3.62.90 || sarvakāmān pūrayāmi śraddhābhāvasamanvitān | premasnehārdrasaṃdṛbdhān karomi saphalān sadā ||9 1 || bāndhavo’haṃ bandhahartā gurau tiṣṭhāmi sarvathā | bandhāstu vāsanārūpā vāsanā vṛttisaṃbhavā ||92|| vṛttayo yogalabhyāśca saṃyogo bhogyavastujaḥ | bhogyadravyādyalabdhiśca viyoge vai sahāyinī ||93|| vṛttīnāṃ tena vilayo vāsanāvilayastataḥ | nirbandhatā bhavettena yatitavyaṃ tathā sadā ||94|| guroryogo hi nirbandho bhāvanāpādakaḥ sadā | mokṣasthānaprāpakaśca mahānandapradastathā ||95|| divyatāpādakaścāpi satsaṃgaḥ śevadhirguroḥ | evaṃ lakṣmi sadāvāpyo bhavāmi premabhaktitaḥ ||96|| baddhān sarvān mocayāmi nirbandho’haṃ guruḥ priyaḥ | tārayāmi mahāpāpān narānnārīrnapuṃsakān ||97|| paśūn pakṣigaṇān vārinivāsān vanino’pi ca | drumān vallīstārayāmi surān pitṝn munīnapi ||98|| śaraṇāgatasantrātā bhavāmi bhagavānaham | kāryaṃ me sukhadānaṃ ca duḥkhāt trāṇaṃ hi dehinām ||99|| tadeva sarvasṛṣṭyādau karomi cāpi sṛṣṭiṣu | sṛṣṭyante’pi tathaivāhaṃ vidadhāmi prarakṣaṇam || 3.62.10 0|| ityetat kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yathā pṛṣṭaṃ priye tvayā | vadhūgītāmayaṃ jñānaṃ sarvāsāṃ mokṣakṛt priye || 101 || paṭhanācchravaṇādasya jñātavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate | bhuktimuktipradaṃ me vai tādātmyasampradaṃ tathā || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ bahuvidhānāṃ divyamantrāṇāṃ gurorbalasya ca nirūpaṇanāmā dvāṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 62 ||
<3.63> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca ke dāsā vaiṣṇavāḥ kṛṣṇakānta priya kṛpānidhe | ke bhaktā kīdṛśāścāpi kīdṛśo mahimāpi ca || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca dehasevāvidhātāro mama dāsā hi te matāḥ | rahasyasevinaḥ śreṣṭhā niḥśaṃkā divyadṛṣṭayaḥ || 2 || ahaṃ mānuṣarūpeṇa vicarāmi janaiḥ saha | janā māṃ vīkṣya laukīyaṃ sevante naiva śaṃkitāḥ || 3 || manvate nijavat kāmakrodhasvabhāvasaṃbhṛtam | na manvate hi bhaktānāṃ saṃkalpapūrakaṃ prabhum || 4 || sarvāṇi me caritrāṇi dehajāni śubhāni vai | smṛtānyapi vīkṣitāni mokṣadāni na saṃśayaḥ || 5 || tatra saṃśayakartāro na sevante hi māṃ khalāḥ | adivyaṃ māṃ pramanvānā nindāṃ kurvanti me tataḥ || 6 || tena pāpena niraye tiryakṣvapi prayānti ca | āsuratvaṃ na vai teṣāṃ lakṣmi kvacinnivartate || 7 || dāsyaṃ hi kaṭhinaṃ lakṣmi mahat sarvārpaṇātmakam | naro vā yadi vā nārī dehaṃ daihikamarpayet || 8 || niḥśaṃkaṃ cārpayet sarvaṃ taddāsyaṃ cottamottamam | tarkamūhaṃ saṃśayaṃ vā na madhye kārayet kriyāt || 9 || dharmaṃ lajjāṃ vyavahāraṃ na madhye sthāpayenmama | nārāyaṇakṛto dharmo lajjā nārāyaṇaśritā || 3.63.1 0|| nārāyaṇavyavahāro mokṣadā netare iti | matvā mama kriyāṃ sarvāṃ dharmātmikīṃ vicintayet || 11 || kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca moho madaśca narma ca | aślīlaṃ cāghaṭitaṃ ca mama divyaṃ hi sarvathā || 12|| na me kāmo nārakī vai na me krodho hi ghātakī | na me lobhaḥ pāpabhṛcca na me moho hi vañcakaḥ || 13 || na me mado bandhakṛcca na me narma vṛṣojjhitam | na me’ślīlaṃ kṣudrakṛcca na me’ghaṭitamasti yat || 14|| sarvaṃ divyaṃ kṛtaṃ muktipradaṃ prajāyate hi tat | tasmād dāsyaṃ hi kaṭhinaṃ kartuṃ sarvairjanairiha || 15|| narā nāryaśca yā dāsyaṃ kartumicchanti me sadā | taiśca tābhiḥ sadā bhāvyamāśaṃkāvarjitaistathā || 16|| āśaṃkāvarjitābhiśca patnībhirbhāvyamityapi | lakṣmīrādhāramākāntātulyābhirbhāvyamityapi || 17|| tato dāsyaṃ prakartavyaṃ nirāvaraṇamuttamam | sarvaṃ premabhṛtaṃ dāsyaṃ śobhate vardhate’tyati || 18|| bhedabhāvaṃ vinā dāsyaṃ vardhate nityameva ca | śaṃkā vinā paraṃ dāsyaṃ mahānandapradaṃ bhavet || 19|| parameśe patikṛṣṇe svāmini paramātmani | kathaṃ śaṃkā kathaṃ prātikūlyaṃ vivekino bhavet ||3.63.20|| yat karoti svayaṃ kṛṣṇo mokṣadaṃ sarvameva tat | yat karoti svayaṃ kṛṣṇo dharma eva hi puṇyakṛt ||21|| tasmād dāsyaṃ hi tādātmyapradaṃ kāryaṃ satījanaiḥ | tādātmye cāvaraṇāni bhedakāni priye śṛṇu ||22|| aikyabhāve bhedabhāvaścāvaraṇaṃ hi tanmatam | ahamanyā hariścānyaśceti bhānaṃ dvitīyakam ||23|| āvaraṇaṃ vighnakartṛ dāsye kṣatiṃ karoti tat | ahaṃ nārī naraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ paraśca puruṣo hyayam ||24|| parāhaṃ ceti bhānaṃ cāvaraṇaṃ tat tṛtīyakam | hareḥ pārśve sthitāyāśca bhayamanyasya yad bhavet ||25|| tadapyāvaraṇaṃ turyaṃ dāsye kṣatiṃ dadhāti vai | nāyaṃ vai samayaścāsti pañcamāvaraṇaṃ hi tat | nātra naiva mano me’sti ṣaṣṭhamāvaraṇaṃ hi tat ||26|| arthārthitvaṃ saptamaṃ cāvaraṇaṃ cāpi vidyate | mānaṃ dāsye mahadvighnaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ taddhi gadyate || 27|| navamaṃ svārthasiddhiśca rodhikā dāsyakarmaṇaḥ | daśamaṃ cādivyatā ca rodhikā sevane sadā |||28|| yatheṣṭaviniyogaśca dāsye bhavati padmaje | sa cennāsti tadā dāsyaṃ cotkṛṣṭaṃ naiva padyate ||29|| svatvaṃ dāsyaṃ tvadīyatvaṃ tatparatvaṃ tadātmatā | pañcakaṃ dāsyasandṛbdhaṃ śobhate dāsyameva tat ||3.63.30 || yathā lakṣmi tava dāsyaṃ śobhate sarvameva ha | tathā dāsyaṃ narāṇāṃ vā nārīṇāṃ śobhate kṛtam ||3 1|| bhaktiyuktaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ saprema śobhate mayi | sarvāvaraṇavarjyaṃ sa śobhate modate mayi ||32|| brahmakriyāratā nityaṃ mama sevāparāyaṇāḥ | śaṃkhacakrādyaṃkitāśca modante mayi vaiṣṇavāḥ ||33|| satāṃ sevāparāścāpi sādhvīsevāparāstathā | viṣṇupūjāparāścāpi modante mayi vaiṣṇavāḥ ||34|| harerdāsā hareścāpi priyā haryarthavartinaḥ | sarvadā mama bhaktyāḍhyā modante mayi vaiṣṇavāḥ ||35|| mahotsāhaparāścāpi mahānaivedyabhojanāḥ | sarvaprasādayoktāro modante mayi vaiṣṇavāḥ ||36|| viṣṇorayaṃ yataścāste tasmādvai vaiṣṇavo mama | nārāyaṇasya me cāste tato nārāyaṇīyakaḥ ||37|| sarveṣāmuttamo bhakto nārāyaṇīya eva ha | brahmaṇo’yaṃ brāhmabhaktaścākṣarasya tathākṣaraḥ ||38|| kṛṣṇasyāyaṃ kārṣṇabhakto modante mayi vaiṣṇavāḥ | nārāyaṇīyā brāhmāśca tathākṣarā mamānugāḥ ||39|| brahmarūpadharā bhaktā brāhmaṇāste prakīrtitāḥ | yataḥ sakāśāt sañjātā brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ ||3.63.40|| sādhavaste sanakādyā guravo brāhmaṇāḥ purā | viprādīnāṃ guravaste sādhavo brahmayoginaḥ ||41|| brahmaṇā nirmitāḥ pūrvaṃ sanakādyā hi sādhavaḥ | brahmaśīlā yatayaśca skandaśca hanumām̐stathā ||42|| evamete pratisṛṣṭisādhavo guravaḥ sadā | śūdrāṇāṃ hi dvijāḥ santi guravo gṛhamedhinām ||43|| dvijādīnāṃ brāhmaṇāśca guravo gṛhamedhinaḥ | brāhmaṇānāṃ sādhavaśca guravo mokṣadā yataḥ ||44|| sādhavaḥ sarvataḥ śreṣṭhāḥ surarṣipitṛpūjitāḥ | surebhyaḥ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā maharṣibhyastathottamāḥ ||45|| pitṛbhyaḥ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā bhūsurebhyaḥ sadottamāḥ | trailokye nāsti tacchraiṣṭyaṃ yacchraiṣṭhaṃ satsu vidyate ||46|| satītaḥ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā yatayo brahmadarśanāḥ | gobhyaśca sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā nityaṃ brahmaparāyaṇāḥ ||47|| bhūdevītaścottamāśca santo vai kṣamayānvitāḥ | mūrtibhyaḥ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā jñānadānapramokṣaṇaiḥ ||48|| devatāyatanebhyaśca śreṣṭhāḥ santo hi tārakāḥ | pativratābhyaḥ śreṣṭhāśca santaḥ śrīpatisevinaḥ ||49|| ṣaḍaṃgavediviprebhyaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ santo haripriyāḥ | vedebhyaḥ sādhuvākyāni śreṣṭhāni kṛṣṇayojanāt ||3.63.50 || vedebhyaḥ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā vedāḥ sādhutvasaṃśrayāt | tīrthebhyaḥ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ śīghraṃ pāpavināśanāt ||51 || vratebhyaḥ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā yatheṣṭānantapuṇyadāḥ | pāvakāt sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā māyākalmaṣaśodhakāḥ ||52|| brahmarṣayo’pi sādhūnāṃ pūjayanti padāni vai | īśvarāḥ kṛṣṇarūpāśca parameśo’hamacyutaḥ ||53|| pūjayāmaḥ sato bhaktān sādhūn sarvasvapāvanān | santaste sadguṇaiścāḍhyā guṇāḍhyāḥ śreṣṭhino hi te ||54|| santaste brahmarājyena rājānaścakravartinaḥ | santaste jñānabhaṇḍārā vidvāṃso guravaḥ parāḥ ||55|| ācāryāḥ santa evaite mokṣadā mantradāstathā | santaste vedavidyādivijñāste brāhmaṇottamāḥ ||56 || ṣaṭkarmaniratāḥ santo viprā eva matā mama | lakṣmi santo mamātmānaścātmāhaṃ vai satāṃ sadā ||57|| satyaśaucakṣāntiyuktā rāgadveṣavivarjitāḥ | brahmavidyāvivekajñā vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||58|| agnihotraparāścāpi nityaṃ cātithipūjakāḥ | pitṛbhaktā mātṛbhaktā vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||59|| dayādharmādisaṃyuktāstathā puṇyaparāyaṇāḥ | śaṃkhacakrādicihnāḍhyāḥ vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||3.63.6 0|| kaṇṭhe mālā taulaseyī dhṛtā yaiścānane hariḥ | gītiḥ kṛṣṇasya kurvanto vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||6 1 || saṃhitāsu ratā nityaṃ makheṣu ca ratāstathā | sarvadharmeṣvādariṇo vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||62|| pāpāt pāpānmocayanti naiva nindanti mānavān | dehinaḥ sukhayantyeva vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||63|| gopālakṛṣṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hi mām | ye’rcayanti pratimāṃ me vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||64|| śālagrāmaṃ pūjayanti pūjayantyavatāriṇam | anādiśrīhariṃ māṃ ca vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||65|| gopālo’yaṃ ca kṛṣṇo’yaṃ rāmādityo’yamacyutaḥ | ityevaṃ māṃ pūjayanti vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||66|| kuṃkumavāpyāṃ rūpaṃ me yathā ca siddhapattane | yathā ca gokule tadvad yathā himālaye’pi ca ||67|| yathā ca nārmade tīre yathā rūpaṃ dhṛtaṃ mayā | tādṛgrūpaṃ pūjayanti vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||68|| caturbhujāṃ dvinetrāṃ ca śaṃkhacakragadābjagām | pītāmbarāṃ samuralīṃ vanamālādiśobhanām ||69|| mukuṭena yutāṃ ramyāṃ kaustubhodbhāsitāṃ tathā | rādhāramādisaṃyuktāṃ sauvarṇīṃ pratimāṃ mama ||3.63.70|| raupyāṃ tāmrodbhavāṃ cāpi paittalīṃ maṇijāṃ tathā | pratiṣṭhāpyāgamamantrairvedavākyairviśeṣataḥ ||71|| ṣoḍaśopacāramantraiḥ pūjayeyurvidhānataḥ | premabhaktyā hṛdayena vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||72||| sādhavaste vaiṣṇavā vai manmayāḥ puṇyarūpiṇaḥ | yathā viṣṇustathā sarve nāntaraṃ vartate manāk ||73|| evaṃ vijñāya rājaśri sādhūn sampūjayet sadā | ahaṃ viṣṇurahaṃ sādhuḥ satī cāhaṃ pativratā ||74|| ahaṃ mātā pitā cāhaṃ patiḥ sādhvī ca yoginī | ahaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sādhuḥ svāmī nārāyaṇī tvaham ||75|| rudro rudrīrajaścājī suraḥ surī bhavāmyaham | sarvabhūteṣu satataṃ vasāmi saṃbhavāmi ca ||76|| patikāmukayā pūjyaścāhaṃ patisvarūpavān | mokṣakāmukayā pūjyaścāhaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||77|| śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca kathaṃ kadā bhavān pūjyo vastubhiḥ kaiśca keśava | vidhinā kena bhagavan patikāmukayā vada ||78|| śrīpuruṣottama uvāca caitramāse śuklapakṣe hyekādaśyāṃ prage śubhe | gatvārāme grahītavyā divyā damanamañjarī ||79|| gurvājñayā prakartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ damanasya vai | damane tiṣṭhate kāmadevaśca ratisaṃyutaḥ ||3.63.80|| kāmadeva namaste’stu tvaṃ sadā puruṣottamaḥ | hariṃ kāmaṃ vicinomi kṛpāṃ kuru mamopari ||8 1|| gītavāditranirghoṣairānetavyo gṛhaṃ prati | adhivāsanapūrvaṃ ca sarvatobhadramaṇḍale ||82|| sthāpayitvā hariṃ kāmaṃ ratiṃ ca damanadrumam | ācchādya śvetavastreṇa pūjayet kanyakā priye ||83|| klīṃ kāmadevāya namo hrīṃ ratyai ca namonamaḥ | pūrvasyāṃ hrīṃ ca kandarpaṃ pūjayāmi niśāgame ||84|| gandhapuṣpākṣatadhūpadīpanaivedyakaiḥ śubhaiḥ | ārārtrikādibhirdaivaṃ pūjayāmi patiṃ prabhum ||85|| madanāya namaḥ prācyāṃ manmathāya namo’gnike | kandarpāya namo yāmye’naṃgāya namo nairṛte ||86 || vāruṇyāṃ mohanāya namaḥ smarāya namo’nile | kauberyāmīśvarāya namaḥ puṣpabāṇāyeśānyāṃ namaḥ ||87|| sarvadikṣu namaskṛtya māṃ kanyā pūjayet tataḥ | oṃ kandarpapuruṣāya vidmahe kāmadevāya dhīmahi | tanno’naṅgaḥ pracodayāt ||88|| iti cāṣṭottaraśatajapān kuryāddhi sannidhau | namo’stu kāmapataye puṣpaśarāya te namaḥ ||89|| manmathāyānandadātre namo ratikarāya te | prītidāya namaste’stu sarvabījāya te namaḥ ||3.63.90|| kāntāya kāntarūpāya sarvavāsāya te namaḥ | puruṣottamarūpāyānaṃgadevāya te namaḥ ||91|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa vāñcchitakāmada | hṛtsthāna pūraya kāmānme prabho kāmeśvarīpriya ||92|| stutvaivaṃ mañjarī vāri dātavye mama pādayoḥ | gītavāditranṛtyaiśca kartavyaścotsavo mahān ||93|| jāgaraṇaṃ prakuryācca prātaḥ snātvārcayeddharim | guruṃ cāpi draviṇādi vastrālaṃkārabhojanam ||94|| dāne’rpayeddhi gurave sahāśnīyācca vaiṣṇavaiḥ | bhūmidānaṃ dhenudānaṃ mahādānaṃ tu bhūriśaḥ ||95|| sarvadānaṃ tayā dattaṃ mañjaryāḥ pūjanena me | gosahasrapradānasya phalaṃ damanakārcane ||96|| mallikākusumairmāṃ yā vasante kāntamuttamam | arcayetparayā bhaktyā sā kāntaṃ labhate dhruvam ||97|| madhukaśca damanakaścātiprītikarau hareḥ | tābhyāmahaṃ pūjito drāk patiṃ dadāmi yoṣite ||98|| kanyāyai ratirūpāyai prasannaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | patiṃ dadāmi tadyogyaṃ kāntaṃ kāntinidhiṃ śubham ||99|| kāmadevasamaṃ ramyaṃ savayaskaṃ madātmakam | saumyaśīlaṃ ca nīrogaṃ sampadyukta guṇākaram || 3.63.100 || prītipātraṃ premapātraṃ dadāmi patimuttamam | ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi muktidaṃ bhuktidaṃ vratam || 10 1|| pūjanaṃ mama loke’tra bhajanaṃ cāpi cottamam | gurutīrthaṃ sādhusādhvīrūpaṃ cāpi tathottamam || 1 02|| dāsadāsīvaiṣṇavādisvarūpāṇi tathā priye | anāvaraṇasevā ca kathitā mama labdhaye || 1 03|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇāt karaṇāttathā | avaśyaṃ phalamāpnoti bhaktā bhakto yathoditam || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparayugasantāne vadhūgītāyāmanāvaraṇasevādāsyasāghusādhvīśraiṣṭhyadamanakavratādinirūpaṇanāmā triṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 63 ||
<3.64> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca hare nārāyaṇa kṛṣṇa parameśa sanātana | kasyāṃ tithau kiṃsvarūpo bhavān pūjyaḥ pravedaya || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca pratipaddhanadasyoktā tatra pūjyo’hameva ha | kuberamūrtirūpo vai dhanado’haṃ bhavāmi hi || 2 || lakṣmyāste vai dvitīyāsti tvaṃ pūjyā puruṣottamī | sarvalakṣmīpradā tvaṃ syā madātmikā narāyaṇī || 3 || tṛtīyā pārvatīdevyāstithiḥ proktā śubhā priye | tatra pūjyā pārvatī tu saubhāgyadā hi sā matā || 4 || gaṇeśasya caturthī vai pūjyo vighnaharo hi saḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpo lābhādisamprado’pi saḥ || 5 || candrasya pañcamī proktā pūjanīyaḥ śaśī hyaham || govṛṣavāṭikādātā bhavāmi cāmṛtānnadaḥ || 6 || kārtikasya tithiḥ ṣaṣṭhī kārtikaṃ pūjayettadā | jayaprado grahahartā bhavāmi kārtikātmakaḥ || 7 || saptamī tu raverbodhyā sūryaḥ pūjyastadā priye | sūryanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ tejo dadāmi naikadhā || 8 || durgāyāstvaṣṭamī bodhyā durgā pūjyā śubhapradā | sarvakaṣṭaharā sā ca mama śaktiḥ sanātanī || 9 || navamī caiva mātṝṇāṃ pūjyā vai mātaraḥ śubhāḥ | rakṣākaryo bhavantyeva kṣemaṃkaryo hi vaṃśinām || 3.64.10 || yamasya daśamī bodhyā yamaḥ pūjyastadā śubhaḥ | pāpanirayaduḥkhaghno yamo’haṃ saṃbhavāmi vai || 11 || ekādaśī kamalāyāḥ śrīḥ pūjyā tatra sarvathā | śreyasāṃ padamāpnoti dadāmi śrīṃ samarcine || 1 2|| dvādaśī me mādhavasya pūjito’haṃ tadā priye | madhu sarvavidhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dadāmi rasasaṃbhṛtam || 13 || trayodaśī ca kāmasya pūjyo’haṃ tatra sarvadā | kāmān dadāmi sampūrṇān sarvakāmaprapūrakaḥ || 14|| caturdaśī harasyāsti mahādevamayo hyaham | pūjanīyaḥ smṛddhidaścaiśvaryaprado hi śaṃkaraḥ | | 15 || paṃcadaśī vedhaso’sti vedhāḥ pūjyaḥ śubhapradaḥ | vaṃśavṛddhipradaścāpi pitṛvacchreyasāṃpradaḥ || 1 6|| adhikā tithirācyutī puruṣottamasaṃjñikā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pūjyo’hameva ca || 17|| sarveṣṭasampradaścāsmi parameśaḥ purātanaḥ | amāvāsyā tu devānāṃ tithiḥ pūjyā hi devatāḥ || 18|| āvāhanaṃ samārabhya visarjanāvadhi dhruvam | sarvopacāraśobhāḍhyaṃ pūjanaṃ sarvadā matam || 19 || snānamambaramābhūṣā mantramālārdracandanam | dhūpadīpasunaivedyavāritāmbūlatoṣaṇam || 3.64.20 || namaḥ kṣamā dakṣiṇā cetyāvaśyakaṃ hi pūjane | aṣṭottaraśatavastukṛtaṃ prapūjanaṃ bhavet || 21 || sarvasampatpradaṃ lakṣmi sarvasiddhipradaṃ tathā | sarvakāmapradaṃ cāpi bhuktimuktipradaṃ bhavet || 22|| evaṃ me mahatīṃ pūjāṃ kuryād bhaktā prasādinīm | yayā kṛtayā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prasīdāmi priyaṃkaraḥ || 23 || dīpamālā pradātavyā mama saudhe ca mandire | caturvidhaṃ ca naivedyamannaṃ dadyāt sumiṣṭakam || 24|| vastrālaṃkāravidhinābhyarcya māṃ pūjayed gurum | mantrabhaktividhihīnaṃ pūjitaṃ pūrṇamastu te || 25|| dhanyāhaṃ kṛtakṛtyāhaṃ saubhāgyā dharaṇisthitā | yāṃ māmaṅgīkṛtya nāthaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo muktido’sti me || 26 || sarvavāsanānirmuktā divyā rāghāsamādya vai | jātāsmi gauravaṃ prāptā guroḥ pratāpato bhuvi || 27 || namaste gurave kṛṣṇātmakāya paramātmane | pratiṣṭhādivyamūrtistvaṃ guruḥ kṛṣṇo hi tārakaḥ ||28|| sarvānandaprado muktipradastvaṃ me gururhariḥ | sarvabandhaprahartā ca pāpatāpavināśakaḥ ||29|| brahmakaivalyadātā me paramākṣaradhāmadaḥ | paramātmasvarūpastvaṃ namaste paramātmane ||3.64.3 0|| dhanyāsmi kṛtakṛtyāsmi saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ ca me | majjanmani nidāne ca dhanyau tau pitarau mama ||31 || yanmayānādibhagavān vallabhaḥ samupārjitaḥ | tvayā kṛṣṇa viyuktāhaṃ yathā na syāṃ tathā kuru ||32|| dānaṃ tapo vrataṃ bhaktiḥ sevā pūrvaṃ kṛtā mayā | yayāhaṃ kṛṣṇakāntaṃ vai labdhavatyadya bhūtale || 33 || bahupuṇyapratāpena labdhavatī hariṃ gurum | gurau sannihito viṣṇuḥ svabhakteṣveva sarvathā ||34|| gurāvāste hariśceti mahimānaṃ vibhāvayet | gururdṛṣṭaḥ praṇamitaḥ snāpitaḥ pūjitastathā ||35|| yajñakoṭisamaṃ puṇyaṃ dadāti gurusevine | doṣayuktāpi yā nityaṃ bhaktibhāvānvitā satī ||36|| gurvīmūrtiṃ pūjayet sācyutā bhavati dhāmani | gurvīmūrtirmahāhatyāpāpātipātanāśinī || 37|| smṛtā saṃkīrtitā dhyātā pūjitā ca namaskṛtā | gurvīdevīpratimā sā dhāmākṣarapradāyinī ||38|| ācāryāṇīṃ satīṃ gurvīṃ sādhvīṃ brāhmīṃ pativratām | harivratāṃ yoginīṃ ca prāpyāsevya pramucyate || 39|| siṃhīṃ vīkṣya yathā yānti mṛgyo bhayāttathā tviha | māyāḥ sarvāḥ pāpamayyo gurvīprāptyā viyanti hi ||3.64.40|| namaskaroti yā śiṣyā gurustrīṃ pāvanīṃ satīm | bhaktyā vā yadi vābhaktyā sā puṇyā muktigāminī ||41|| vaivasvatabhayaṃ nāsti tasyā maraṇajanmanoḥ | yā karoti satī sevāṃ pūjanaṃ guruyoṣitaḥ ||42|| gandhapādyārghanaivedyairdīpairdhūpairvilepanaiḥ | gītairvādyaistathā stotrairguvīṃṃ devīṃ prarañjayet ||43|| arcayate mānavī māṃ satībhaktiparāyaṇā | kalpakoṭyayutānyeṣā ramate mama sadmani ||44|| gurudevanamaskāro bhāvenāpi yayā kṛtaḥ | sā devī mānuṣe loke mamānugrahapātrikā ||45|| madbhaktibaladarpasthā mama sādhuparāyaṇā | gurvīsevāparā sādhvī modate mama dhāmani ||46 || gurudevapratimāyāṃ lakṣmi sadā vasāmyaham | padmakoṭisahasraistu viṣṇupūjāphalaṃ tu yat ||47|| gurudevasya pūjāyāṃ phalaṃ tallabhate satī | na kṛtaṃ martyaloke yairgurudevārcanaṃ janaiḥ ||48|| te mṛtā eva ca muhurjāyante karmabhāginaḥ | gurudevasya nikaṭe sarvaṃ yāti pavitratām ||49|| bhuktvā guroḥ prasādaṃ ca yajñakoṭiphalaṃ bhavet | guroḥ pādodakaiḥ pītairhatyākoṭirvinaśyati ||3.64.50 || kāśīvāso yugānyaṣṭau dinaikagurusevanāt | tasmād guroḥ pūjanaṃ vai kartavyaṃ mokṣakāmyayā ||5 1 || gurudevasvarūpaḥ śrīpatiryatra hi tiṣṭhati | tatra devāḥ surāḥ sādhvyaśceśvarāśca vasanti vai ||52|| surāṇāṃ kīrtanaiḥ sarvaiḥ koṭibhiryat phalaṃ bhavet | tatphalaṃ śrīhareścāpi gurośca kīrtanād bhavet ||53 || gurudevamukhe hutvā sakṛt piṇḍena tarpitāḥ | pitarastṛptimāyānti śāśvatīṃ cāmṛtānvitām ||54|| ye pibanti janā vāri guroścaraṇapāvitam | pañcagavyasahasraistu prāśitaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam ||55|| prāyaścitte samutpanne kiṃ dānaiḥ kimupoṣaṇaiḥ | cāndrāyaṇaiśca vā kiṃ vai pītvā pādodakaṃ guroḥ ||56|| yo dadāti gurave’tra ghṛtaṃ dugdhaṃ ca śarkarām | teneṣṭaṃ sarvamiṣṭānnaisteneṣṭaṃ kratubhiḥ śataiḥ ||17|| gṛhe’pi vasatastasya tīrthasnānaṃ dine dine | dīkṣāsya sarvayajñeṣu yena santoṣito guruḥ ||58|| svarge martye ca pātāle guravaḥ santi tārakāḥ | gurudevasamaṃ nāsti trailokye pāvanaṃ param ||59|| mānuṣe subhage loke saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ yataḥ | guroḥ prāptiḥ kṛtā yena yayā vā sevanaṃ guroḥ ||3.64.60|| patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ vastraṃ dravyaṃ ca bhojanam | jāyate meruṇā tulyaṃ gurudevasamarpaṇāt ||61|| vidhihīnāpi yā nārī kriyāmantrādivarjitā | gurubhaktārcayed bhaktyā tasyāḥ śāstroditaṃ phalam ||62|| nivasāmi sadā tatra dehe gurorgurau sadā | skandhe yāne guruṃ kṛtvā yo’dhvānaṃ vahate janaḥ ||63|| tasya mārgo hyaniruddho mama dhāmno’sti sarvadā | gurudevasthitiryatra tatra sannihito hariḥ ||64|| tatra tīrthaṃ mahādānaṃ kurukṣetraṃ ca naimiṣam | puṣkaraṃ ca prayāgaṃ cāpyaśvapaṭṭasarastathā ||65|| bālakṛṣṇasaraścāpi viṣaturyasarastathā | tatra nārāyaṇī cāpi tatrerāvatikā nadī ||66|| menakāṃgā ca tatraiva brahmaputrāpi tatra ca | yatra gurornivāso’sti sarvatīrthāni tatra vai ||67|| brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ yatkiṃcijjāyate jane | tatsarvaṃ nirdahatyāśu gurudevaprasevanam ||68|| gurormūrtirharermūtiryatrobhayorhi saṃgamaḥ | tatra dvāravatī bodhyā muktidā bhaktirācyutī ||69|| gurvarcane na mantrāśca na japo na ca bhāvanā | na dravyaṃ na hīrakādi nopadā netarattvapi ||3.64.70|| na stutirnāpi dainyaṃ ca premamātramapekṣate | akṛtyasyāpyabhakṣyasyāpeyasya grahaṇe kṛte ||71 || yatpāpaṃ tad vinaśyedvai santuṣṭe śrīgurau harau | pūjanaṃ kurute gurvyā nityaṃ śiṣyā tu yā satī ||72|| sevanaṃ kurute gurvyāḥ pādasaṃvāhanādikam | anantottarakālaṃ sā vaidhavyaṃ vindate na vai ||73 || kṛṣṇasaubhāgyamāpannā padminī jāyate ramā | guroḥ chāyāṃ samāśritya dadyād dānāni vai sadā ||74|| na jahyācca guroḥ pārśvaṃ yāmyabhīto janastviha | guroragre yamadūtā na cāyānti kadācana ||75|| guroḥ sevā hareḥ sevā patyuḥ sevā yayā kṛtā | saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ tasyā yasyā gehe trayaṃ sadā ||76|| sanniyamyānyato vṛttīrgurudevasya toṣaṇam | yā kuryānmānavī sādhvī bhaktyā sevāṃ ca pūjanam ||77|| yathāyogyaṃ vastūnāmarpaṇaṃ nivedanaṃ jalam | śraddhayā gurave datte puṣpe puṣpe’śvamedhajam ||78|| phalaṃ sā vindate śiṣyā sākṣād guruhariśritā | janmaduḥkhajarārogairmuktā sā mokṣagā matā ||79|| gavāmayutadānena yatphalaṃ prāpyate tviha | gurave padmamālāṃ vai samarpyeyāddhi tatphalam ||3.64.80|| durlabhaṃ cāpi duṣprāpaṃ trailokye sacarācare | tadapi prārthitaṃ lakṣmi gurusevā dadāti vai ||8 1|| aiśvaryaṃ santatiṃ jñānaṃ rājyaṃ ca sukhasampadaḥ | gurukṛpā dadātyeva sevālabhyā hi sā matā ||82|| merumandaratulyāni pāpāni sarvathā layam | yānti guroḥ sevanāddhi sākṣāddharirgururhi saḥ ||83|| namo nārāyaṇāyeti namaḥ śrīgurave tathā | uktvā nityaṃ nameddevaṃ guruṃ hariṃ patiṃ prabhum ||84|| vrajet sā paramātmānaṃ dhāmākṣaranivāsinam | śāśvatānandadātāraṃ hyanāmayapadasthitam ||85|| gurornāma harernāma paṭhate yā muhurmuhuḥ | yāti sā paramaṃ dhāma punarjanma na vindati ||86|| kule tasyāśca ye jātāḥ śataśo’tha sahasraśaḥ | te’pi yānti paraṃ dhāma yayā santoṣito guruḥ ||87|| mahotsaveṣu sarveṣu guruṃ sampūjayet satī | pūjayitryā gṛhe nityaṃ bhaveyurvai mahotsavāḥ ||88|| āṣāḍhe bhāvanābhijñā pūrṇāyāṃ pūjayed gurum | tatphalaṃ labhate nārī saubhāgyaṃ śāśvataṃ satī ||89|| snāpayeduṣṇasalilairgandhadravyairvilepayet | mardayed gandhatailaiśca svacchadravyaiḥ pramārjayet ||3.64.90 || abhiṣekaṃ kārayecca dhārayedambarāṇi ca | śṛṃgārayecca śṛṃgārairarcayedakṣatādibhiḥ || 91 || puṣpacandanamālyaiśca samarcayed guruṃ satī | vibhūṣā dhārayeccāpi dhūpadīpādi kārayet ||92|| phalāmiṣṭānnapānādi dadyācchrīgurave tataḥ | dakṣiṇāṃ prārpayeccāpi yathāvaibhavamuttamam ||93|| pādāmṛtaṃ pibeccāpi pādasaṃvāhanaṃ caret | gurvyāḥ sadāṅgamardādi kuryācchiṣyā satī śubham ||94|| yāne kṛtvā vāṭikāyāṃ mahodyāne gṛhe tathā | guruṃ gurvīṃ nayedvāpi toṣayed bhaktisaṃbhṛtā ||95|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ paramaṃ gurum | evaṃ prasādayet sādhvī vadhūryā śrīnarāyaṇi ||96|| anyā vā svapatiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prasādayeddhi bhāvataḥ | tathā yā svaguruṃ prasādayedvai sevayā satī ||97|| sarvāstā brahmarūpā vai mokṣagāḥ santi padmaje | divyā divyasvarūpāśca parāyā divyatāpradāḥ ||98|| svasyāḥ samāgamaṃ prāptā yā yā bhavanti yoṣitaḥ | tāstā divyāstathā bhūtvā prayāsyanti paraṃ padam ||99|| hariścāhaṃ sadā divyaḥ śaktirdivyā ca me sadā | sā ca tvaṃ śrīstathā rādhā ramā prajñā ca māṇikī || 3.64.1 00|| lakṣmīrgaṃgā ca virajā padmāvatī ca mādhavī | evamādyāḥ śaktayo me divyā brahmapriyā hi tāḥ || 101 || haripriyā na me bhinnā abhinnāstāḥ sadā mama | vasanti śaktayaḥ sarvā gurvyāṃ gurau sadā priyāḥ || 1 02|| ahaṃ śaktisahito vai nivasāmi vadhūjane | svāmijane nivasāmi sādhau patyau vasāmi ca || 1 03|| pūrayāmi manaḥkāmān tattadgurutvamāsthitaḥ | evaṃ śrīśivarājñīśri māṃ prasevaya mādhavam || 1 04|| paṭhanāchravaṇādasya smaraṇād vandanādapi | bhāvagrāhādapi muktirbhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ sarvatithiṣu harerbhinnarūpasya pūjāgururūpasya sadā pūjā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuṣṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 64 ||
<3.65> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri māhātmyaṃ parameśituḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya gururūpiṇaḥ || 1 || mamaiva khalu māhātmyaṃ yathāvat pravadāmi te | na ca tṛpyāmyahaṃ vaktuṃ nārīdayāvaśaṃvadaḥ || 2 || nityaṃ sampūjayet sādhvī mokṣasaubhāgyakāṃkṣiṇī | snāpayeta jalairbhaktyā madhukṣīraghṛtena mām || 3 || pañcagavyena salilairgandhacandanavāribhiḥ | candanena sugandhena kuṃkumena gulālakaiḥ || 4 || abīreṇa tathā kāśmīreṇa kesaravāribhiḥ | karpūrośīramiśreṇa lopayenmāṃ draveṇa ca || 5 || arcayed ruciraiḥ puṣpairgandhadhūpasamanvitaiḥ | guggulaṃ goghṛtāktaṃ vai dadenme sannidhau satī || 6 || dīpakaṃ ca divārātrau dadyād ghṛtena sundarī | naivedyaṃ dugdhapānādi kṣīrānnaṃ paramarpayet || 7 || evamabhyarcayenmāṃ ca praṇamyābhipraṇamya ca | oṃ namaḥ kṛṣṇakāntāya japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 8 || juhuyācca ghṛtābhyaktaistilavrīhiyavādibhiḥ | tathaiva nāmnā mahyaṃ vai sarvamuktābhitṛptaye || 9 || kamalairmama caraṇau pūjayed bhaktivardhinī | bilvapatrairjānudeśaṃ pūjayenme vilāsinī || 3.65.1 0|| jaghanaṃ me pūjayecca rājacampakapuṣpakaiḥ | vakṣo me pūjayetsādhvī sthalapadmasupadmakaiḥ || 1 1||, mastakaṃ pūjayed rāmā mālatyā vṛndayā tathā | candanena samagraṃ ca śarīraṃ pūjayenmama || 1 2|| dehabuddhiṃ parityajya haribuddhyā prapūjayet | sarvavidhāṃ mama sevāṃ brahmacaryayutācaret || 1 3|| patnībhirbhartṛvākyena kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ mama | vidhavābhirmama vākyānmokṣasaukhyavivṛddhaye || 14|| sarvakāmasamṛddhyarthaṃ kanyābhiḥ pūjanaṃ mama | sarvasmṛddhipralābhārthaṃ naraiḥ kāryaṃ prapūjanam || 15|| etādṛśaṃ pūjanaṃ me mokṣadaṃ smṛddhidaṃ priye | nārīvikrayapāpasya nāśakaṃ pūjanaṃ tvidam || 16|| pūjā bhaktiḥ kathitā te lakṣmi śreṣṭhāṃ ca tāṃ śṛṇu | mallīnacittā yā bhaktiḥ sā bhaktiḥ paramā matā || 17|| premapravāhamagnāyā madvirahāsahiṣṇutā | matsvarūpākāracittā bhaktiḥ sā paramottamā || 18|| uttamā cātmanā bhaktirmadhyamā manasā tu sā | kaniṣṭhā varṣmaṇā bhaktistredhā bhavati mokṣadā || 19|| muktānāmātmanā bhaktiryogināṃ mānasī tathā | ajñānāṃ dehajā bhaktistredhāpi mokṣadā matā ||3.65.20|| ātmabhaktyā sukhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ manasā madhyamaṃ sukham | dehena vai sukhaṃ svalpaṃ tredhā vibhidyate sukham || 21 || ātmanā brahmarūpeṇa hyānandaḥ śāśvato mama | manasā divyabhāvena hyānando yogasāvadhiḥ ||22|| dehena kriyayānando dehakṣaṇādyapekṣakaḥ | svārthānandaparā bhaktistāmasī mama sā matā ||23|| ubhayānandagarbhā sā rājasī bhaktirācyutī | haryānandaparā bhaktiḥ sāttvikī svārthavarjitā ||24|| gurorbhaktirharerbhaktistādātmyena kṛtā yadi | śīghraṃ sā phaladā lakṣmi sākṣādgururhi vai hariḥ ||25|| bhaktimatyāḥ striyā nityaṃ śāntiṃ kurvanti devatāḥ | kṣemaṃ kurvanti śaṃbhvādyāḥ svasti yacchanti sādhavaḥ || 26 || puṇyaṃ yacchanti ṛṣayaścāśīrvādaparāyaṇāḥ | śubhaṃ yānti grahāścāpi śubhaṃ yānti piśācakāḥ ||27|| rākṣasāśca śubhaṃ yānti prasannā munayo’pi ca | lakṣmīḥ sthirā gṛhe tasyātiṣṭhatyeva sadā śubhā ||28|| rasāstiṣṭhanti tasyā vai madhūni mandire yathā | miṣṭāmṛtāni tiṣṭhanti sudhā bhaktiyutāgṛhe ||29|| pīyūṣāṇi samastāni tiṣṭhanti ca mahotsavāḥ | sarvavidhāni svargāṇi tiṣṭhanti bhaktiyuggṛhe ||3.65.30|| bhaktimatī sadā nārī rādhā lakṣmīrmatā mama | śāradā kamalā kāntā śrīḥ padmā sā matā mama ||3 1|| yā kāpi jātisampannā bhajate māmananyagā | sā mamaiva priyā bhaktā mokṣe muktānikā bhavet ||32|| yasyā darśanamātreṇa brahmahā api śuddhyati | tadgṛhaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ vāsarūpaṃ varaṃ matam ||33|| yatra bhaktaitādṛśī syānnārī nārāyaṇī śubhā | iyaṃ sā kamalāmūrtirbhaktā vai pāpahāriṇī ||34|| kaivalyaphaladā sā vai yathā gaṃgā ramā yamī | tiṣṭhatyetādṛśī bhaktā yatsthāne yatra mandire || 35|| yatkule bhūtale vāpi sarvaṃ mokṣapradaṃ hi tat | kimatra bahunoktena bhaktā ramā ramā hi sā ||36 || ramāṃ matvā mama bhaktāṃ yā namiṣyanti satstriyaḥ | tāsāṃ darśanamātreṇa brahmaghnī śuddhyati hyapi ||37|| dāsī bhāvena yā tasyāḥ sevanaṃ kurute’balā | tasyāḥ puṇyaṃ na jānāti brahmāpi khalu padmaje ||38|| śaṃkhacakrānvitāṃ bhaktāṃ pūjayed yā tu vaiṣṇavī | pūjitaṃ tena vai sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam ||39|| sa eva divaso dhanyo dhanyā mātāpi tatkulam | pitā dhanyastathā sādhvyā yayā bhaktā prapūjitā ||3.65.40 || sarvā dhanyatamā sādhvyo mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ | tāsāṃ darśanamātreṇa mahāpāpaṃ vilīyate ||41 || upapāpāni sarvāṇi prakīrṇakāni tāni vai | sarvāṇyeva vinaśyanti vaiṣṇavīnāṃ hi darśanāt ||42|| pāvakā iva pāvanyo viṣṇubhaktāḥ striyaḥ sadā | ārdraṃ śuṣkaṃ laghu sthūlaṃ nāśayanti hi kalmaṣam ||43|| prāmādikaṃ hi yatpāpaṃ jñānājñānakṛtaṃ tathā | saṃsargajaṃ ca pāpaṃ ca naśyati drutameva ha ||44|| satīnāṃ darśanāllakṣmi sādhūnāṃ sevanāttathā | svargaṃ prayānti niṣpāpāḥ pāpiṣṭhā yānti śuddhatām ||45|| saṃsārakarmapāśānāṃ mokṣaṇe vai viśāradī | pāvanī pāvanānāṃ ca mama bhaktā sadā śubhā ||46|| pratyaha mama bhaktā yā māṃ prasmaratyaharniśam | sā tu madrūpiṇī bodhyā hariṇī sā na saṃśayaḥ ||47|| bhrājatkarpūraśubhraṃ māṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇam | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmamīnadhvajadhanurdharam ||48|| pītāmbaraṃ virājantaṃ kaustubhena samujjvalam | śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ puṣṭaṃ vanamālādibhūṣitam ||49|| svarṇakuṇḍalabhāvyāptakapolavadanaṃ harim | valayāṃgadanūpurakirīṭaraśanānvitam ||3.65.50|| prasannavadanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhuṃ vibhum | vāmasakthisthapāṇḍuraśrīcihnapravirājitam ||5 1 || sapādapañcaṣaṣṭyaṃgulordhvamāna pumuttamam | caturbāhuṃ candraśubhrānanaṃ bhrūśararājitam ||52|| māmanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dhyāyati yā satī | sā bhaktā vaiṣṇavīrūpā śrīrūpā matsvarūpiṇī ||53 || tasyāstu darśanenāpi bhaktyā vā bhojanena ca | pūjanena kamale vai muktigā jāyate sakhī ||54|| tṛṣāturā yathā vāri tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi | himākulā yathāgniṃ ca tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||55|| yathā patiṃ patidharmā tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi | bhītā yathā svagoptāraṃ tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||56 || lobhavatī yathā dravyaṃ tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi | putrakāmā yathā putraṃ tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||57|| vivāsitā yathā gehaṃ tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi | cātakī ca yathā meghaṃ tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||58|| brahmavettrī yathā brahma tadvanmāṃ sā
