smaratyapi | pitaraśca yathā piṇḍaṃ devā havyaṃ yathādhvare ||59|| ṛṣayaśca yathā mantrān mānavāḥ sampado yathā | haṃsāśca mānasaṃ yadvat tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||3.65.60|| kāmukī kāminaṃ yadvad bhaktā bhajantameva yam | mātāpatyaṃ yathā tadvanmāṃ sā smarati sādhvikā ||61 || bhaktimanto yathā kṛṣṇaṃ bhaktiṃ ca vaiṣṇavā yathā | paśavaśca tṛṇaṃ yadvat tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||62||| santo dharmaṃ sādhavaśca kṣamāṃ śreṣṭhī samarhaṇām | prāṇī prāṇān vadhuścātmā tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||63|| jīvāścāyurbhramarāśca puṣpaṃ sūryaṃ tu cāṭikā | vallabhā vallabhaṃ yadvat tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||64|| rātristhāśca yathā jyotiḥ śramārtāḥ śrāntimeva ca | nidrāṃ jāgariṇo yadvat tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||65|| anālasā yathā siddhiṃ kariṇo’raṇyabhūmikām | siṃhā gāḍhavanaṃ yadvat tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||66|| sūryakiraṇamāsādya sūryakānte’nalo yathā | evaṃ sādhvīsusatsaṃgāddharau premavatī bhavet ||67|| candrakiraṇayogena candrakāntaḥ sravetsudhām | evaṃ vai vaiṣṇavīyogāddharau bhaktistavo bhavet ||68|| kaumudīṃ prāpya ca yathā kumudaṃ saṃvikāsate | gurvīṃ bhaktāṃ tathā prāpya hṛtpadmaṃ saṃvikāśate ||69|| yathā kīṭī bhramarīṃ ca smṛtvā bhramarī jāyate | yogasmṛtyā tathā sādhvī smṛtvā māṃ matsamāyate ||3.65.70|| vadhvaśca kāmabuddhyaiva kṛṣṇarūpaṃ paraṃ gatāḥ | tathā gopī ca māṃ smṛtvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyate ||71|| kāciddhāsyāyate māṃ ca kācit snehāyate ca mām | kācit spṛhāyate māṃ ca kācit svāmyāyate satī ||72|| premāyate ca kācicca kṛṣṇāyate ca bhāminī | evaṃ māṃ bhaktiyogena samīpe vindate kṣaṇāt ||73|| sānnidhye’pi sthitaścāhaṃ dūre bhaktiṃ vinā sadā | bhaktiyogena dṛśyeya bhaktābhiḥ parameśvaraḥ ||74|| devādyairamṛtaṃ prāptaṃ tathāpi duḥkhino hi te | bhaktimevāmṛtaṃ prāpya duḥkhaṃ sarvaṃ vinaśyati ||75|| bhaktyā vaikuṇṭhamāsādya modate viṣṇusannidhau | anyatsarvaṃ parityajya mama bhaktiṃ samāśrayet ||76|| prāpya dehaṃ vinā bhaktiṃ kriyate yad vṛthā hi tat | viṣṇubhaktiṃ vinā naiva saṃsārābdhitarirbhavet ||77|| duḥkhadāvānaladagdhaṃ mama bhaktiḥ praśāmyati | janmāntare’pi bhaktirme māmakīṃ vidadhāti vai ||78|| bhūtvā ca māmakī dāsī lakṣmīḥ prajāyate tataḥ | reṇumātramapi bhaktermama dhāma dadāti vai ||79|| śataiśca śrūyate bhaktiḥ sahasrairapi budhyate | lakṣaiśca bhajyate tatra bhaktā kācid ramā bhavet ||3.65.80|| buddhidā bahavo loke bhajamānastu kaścana | tatrāpi ca tadātmatvaṃ prāptaḥ koṭigaṇe’dvayaḥ ||8 1 || pūjayā hasyate bhaktirjapairhāsayate tathā | bhaktyā bhaktiḥ śaṃsyate ca mayā bhaktiḥ pragṛhyate ||82|| mūle siktasya vṛkṣasya śākhādalaphalodbhavaḥ | tathā sikto harirbhaktyā bhaktānandaphalodbhavaḥ || 83|| yasyā vṛttiryādṛśī sā tathā bhaktiṃ karoti vai | bhajanādeva me lakṣmi phalamagre hyavāpyate ||84|| pānīyahāriṇī yadvad ghaṭe tīre prakarṣaṇe | cittaṃ dadāti tadvaccenmayi dadāti mucyate ||85|| yathā loke sthitaṃ vyoma bhūtairnaiva hi lipyate | tathā loke sthitā bhaktā karmabhirnahi lipyate ||86|| divārātrau hi me bhaktā mamānandopajīvinaḥ | te’trasthā api dhāmasthā divyā muktā hi te matāḥ ||87|| sarvamedhādiyajñānāṃ phalaṃ svargaṃ prapātavat | mama bhaktyadhvaraphalaṃ punarāgamavarjitam ||88|| dṛṣṭamānantyamevāsyā bhakterme matprasādataḥ | pāṣāṇo jalamadhyastho jalena lipyate na saḥ ||89|| bhakto māyāntarastho’pi māyayā lipyate na saḥ | me bhaktasyāntare śaityaṃ vinā jalena madvaśāt ||3.65.90|| darduro vasati nīre gandhaṃ vetti na padmajam | bhramaro’raṇyavāso’bjagandhaṃ pravetti vai sa tu ||91 || ahaṃ vasāmi hṛdaye bahirvṛttirna vetti mām | premabhaktiyuto dūrastho’pi vetti hṛdi sthitam ||92|| gaṃgātaṭe vasantyeke vasantyanye’rbudācale | māhātmyavit phalaṃ tvatti tathā bhaktiyuto janaḥ ||93|| gardabhaścandanabhāraṃ vahate gandhameti na | bahiḥsthaścāntarasthaṃ māṃ na vetti naiti matsukham ||94|| mṛgā jighranti rasyāni kastūrīgandhavedinaḥ | svanābhisthaṃ na jānanti tathā māṃ vai bahirmukhāḥ ||95|| mūrkhāṇāṃ jñānaśūnyānāmupadeśo nirarthakaḥ | tathā madbhaktiśūnyānāmānando’pi nirarthakaḥ ||96|| sarpapītaṃ payaḥ kṣveḍaṃ śaṭhabhaktistathāvidhā | andho dīpaṃ vīkṣate na tathā māṃ vai bahirmukhaḥ ||97|| veṣeṇa ca yathā carmaṃ carmaṇā varṣma saṃvṛtam | varṣmaṇendriyakaṃ yadvattathendriyairhi vāsanā ||98|| tayāvṛtaśca jīvātmā tenāhaṃ vai samāvṛtaḥ | aṇoraṇīyān cāntaḥstho vasāmyātmā na caiti mām ||99|| dugdhe ghṛtaṃ tile tailaṃ vidyate’haṃ tathā vidhaḥ | vidye sarvatra māṃ naiva jānanti bahiricchavaḥ || 3.65.10 0|| ekasūtre yadā protā maṇayo mayi tattathā | sṛṣṭayaḥ sarvathā protāścātmāno na vidanti mām || 10 1|| yathā kāṣṭhādigo vahnirmathanād dṛśyate bahiḥ | tathā tvātmasthitaścāhaṃ dṛśye bhaktipramanthanāt || 1 02|| yathā dīpāt prabhavanti dīpāścānye hyapekṣitāḥ | tathā guroḥ prajāyante sarvajñā bhaktimuktigāḥ || 1 03|| yathārkasyodaye jyotiḥ sarvatraiva prakāśate | tathā bhāgyodaye svāmī guruḥ svayaṃ prakāśate || 104|| yathā vāyuḥ sarvagaśca sarvagandhavahastathā | gururhariḥ sarvagaśca karmabhaktiphalāvahaḥ || 1 05|| nīraṃ yādṛgrasāḍhyaṃ vai tādṛgraso mukhe bhavet | ātmā yādṛkpremapūrṇastathānandaraso nije || 106 || pṛthvī naikarasairyuktā nānāsasyasvarūpiṇī | ātmā naikasukhāḍhyaśca nānābrahmasukhānvitaḥ || 1 07|| saccidānandarūpo’yaṃ hyātmā bhakto’timodavān | mamānandena saṃyukto mahānandī prajāyate || 108|| mamānandaṃ mama bhaktiṃ lakṣmi yā vetti vai hṛdi | sā bhaktā kamalātulyā mama dhāmābhiyāyinī || 109|| ahaṃ vasāmi sarvatra lokā jānanti naiva mām | avidyayā na jānanti cābhaktyā na vidanti mām || 3.65.11 0|| sarvakarmāṇi cet kuryurviṣṇudaivatakāni vai | taireva nirguṇairyogaiścāpnuvanti puraḥsthitam || 11 1|| evamuktaṃ mayā lakṣmi mama sānnidhyamadbhutam | vicārya prāpya vijñāya bhajitvā māmavāpnuyāt || 1 12|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ bhagavaduktabhaktimāhātmyotkarṣanirūpaṇanāmā pañcaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 65 ||
<3.66> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri caiko’haṃ bahudhāpi ca | nāmarūpavibhedena yugabhedena vai tathā || 1 || bhaktabhedena ca kāryabhedena saṃbhavāmi vai | pratyātmaniyataścāsmi sarvajantuṣu sarvadā || 2 || madicchā hi mahāmāyā mūlaprakṛtireva sā | rādhā lakṣmīrmama śaktidvayaṃ madātmakaṃ hi tat || 3 || pradhānaṃ triguṇaṃ cāpi mayā tādṛgvidhaṃ kṛtam | tatra jīvā anantā vai cetanā nivasanti hi || 4 || pradhānāt prabhavantyeva bhūtāni dehahetavaḥ | dehāstasmātprajāyante jīvādīnāṃ gṛhāṇi vai || 5 || sattvamāyāmayo viṣṇuścāhaṃ bhavāmi padmaje | rajomāyāmayo brahmā cāhaṃ bhavāmi padmajaḥ || 6 || tamomāyāmayaḥ śaṃbhuścāhaṃ bhavāmi bhālajaḥ | tatra sarvatra vai cāhaṃ parameśo vasāmi ca || 7 || ataḥ sarvagataścāhaṃ tridevasṛṣṭimaṇḍale | avidyayā na jānanti gūḍhaṃ lokā guhāśayam || 8 || vidyayā vai prajānanti sādhavo yatisattamāḥ | brahmajñānaṃ hi sā vidyāparā yatra mamāśrayaḥ || 9 || vedāvasānamevaitad yatrāhaṃ varṇitaḥ priye | ātmanā cāpyate brahma paraṃ vibhu sanātanam || 3.66.1 0|| manasā cintyate brahma cakṣuṣā dṛśyate tathā | dehenāśliṣyate brahma kṛpayā prāpyate hariḥ || 1 1|| śuddhena manasā yuktātmanā saṃsevyate hariḥ | manasā bandhunā grāhyaṃ parabrahma sanātanam || 12|| manasā bandhunā tyājyaṃ māyāyāḥ paṭalaṃ khalu | manasā bandhunā jīvāstīryante brahmayoginā || 13|| manasā śatruṇā jīvāḥ pātyante viṣayārthinā | divyena manasā dhyātvā śrīpatiṃ māṃ pareśvaram || 14|| divyāṃ kriyāṃ prakurvan vai kurvannapi na lipyate | padmapatraṃ yathā nīragataṃ vārbhirna lipyate || 15|| mano māyāgataṃ cāpi madyogi lipyate na vai | yadā brahmarasaṃ vetti tadānyallavaṇāyate || 16|| yadā bhaktirasaṃ vetti tadānyad garalāyate | yadā sevārasaṃ vetti rājyaṃ tasya malāyate || 17|| yadā premarasaṃ vetti sarvamanyad ghṛṇāyate | yadā mūlyaṃ mama vetti sarvaṃ vai kaccarāyate || 18|| yadānandāśanaṃ vetti muktyādyasya na rocate | mamānandapravāhasthaṃ cānyadvetti na vai yadā || 1 9|| tadā pravāhabhāvena dravatāmeti mānasam | dravabhaktyā prāpya māṃ tādātmyayogamṛcchati ||3.66.20 || guroryogācchāstrayogājjñānaṃ divyamavāpyate | vijñānaṃ cāpyate’bhyāsaistato jñeyamavāpyate ||21 || jñeyo’haṃ paramātmā ca śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | yadā prāptastadā śūnyaṃ māyāmayaṃ prajāyate || 22|| bhāvaśuddhiścāgrapadā manaḥśuddhistataḥ parā | ātmaśuddhiścordhvapadā tābhiścāvāpyate hariḥ ||23|| nāryo bahuvidhāḥ santi hyāśliṣyanti ca naikadhā | yathā bhāvaśca sambandhastathā phalaṃ kriyādikam ||24|| āliṅgyate nijā kāntā yathā bhāvastathā phalam | āliṅgyate harirjīvairyathā bhāvastathā phalam ||25|| samprāpyate yayā buddhyā tathā cāvāpyate phalam | yathā buddhyā hi māmeti tathā dadāmi vai phalam ||26 || śreṣṭhaṃ cātmānandaphalaṃ prāptavyaṃ sevayā sadā | prasannatāprayojyo vai mahānandā mayārpyate ||27|| prasannatānukūlyena prātikūlyavivarjanāt | aśaṃkasevayā bhaktyā prasannatā prajāyate ||28|| na sā krayeṇa labhyā vā na vā kṣaṇādibuddhibhiḥ | na vā tātkālikī prāpyā svārthavṛttyā na labhyate ||29|| na mānena na vai cāturyeṇa naipuṇyakena na | na sā sveṣṭamanovṛttyā kintu sarvārpaṇe na sā ||3.66.30|| sarvājñāpālanenaiva dainyabhāvena labhyate | kaiṃkaryeṇa ca dāsyena tadīyatvena labhyate ||3 1|| so’haṃ matvā madīya taṃ tāṃ ca vai tādṛśīṃ satīm | matvā prasannatāṃ kurve prāpto bhavāmi vai tataḥ ||32|| yenāhamasmi prāptavyastena bhāvyaṃ nivedinā | svopānaddhāraṇe yadvat pṛthvī niṣkaṇṭakā tathā ||33|| svasmin dāsye’rjite māyā nirbandhā divyatāpradā | svasmin bhṛtye’rjite māyā svāmitāvirahāsya vai ||34|| svasmin dainye’rjite māyā sattāśūnyāsya sarvathā | svasmin sarvārpite prāpte māyā nirāśatāṃ vrajet ||35|| buddhirbrahmavidhā syāccenmāyākāryaṃ vilīyate | māyāmayī tu yā buddhiḥ sā jagajjanmadāyinī ||36|| viṣavallī dugdhasiktā viṣabhāvaṃ na muñcati | buddhirāsurabhāvā cedāsuratāṃ na muñcati ||37|| śarkarārasapāno’pi nimbaḥ kaṭutaro bhavet | tathāsurasvabhāvo vai māṃ na kadāpi rocate ||38|| tādṛśānāṃ jagajjānāṃ śāstravrāto nirarthakaḥ | naiva svabhāvaṃ tyajati satsaṃgaṃ na karotyapi ||39|| bhaktirna rocate yasya sneho naisargiko na ca | mumukṣutā na yasyāsti nāstikatvaṃ pramodate ||3.66.40|| tasya śāśvatamodāśā vyomapuṣpāyate sadā | chitvā cāmradrumaṃ kasmāt phalaṃ puṣpaṃ samīyate ||41 || bhittvā bhaktiṃ ca sevāṃ ca kathaṃ sukhamavāpyate | indriyāṇāṃ sukhārthitve vṛthā janma hi dehinaḥ ||42|| chitvā karpūrakhaṇḍāni kutṛṇāni prarakṣati | rasapuṣpādihīnāni vṛthā yatno’sya tatra vai ||43|| satāṃ sevāṃ vinindyaiva duṣṭasevāṃ karoti ca | puṇyakarmavihīnāṃ vai vṛthā yatno’sya sarvathā ||44|| svarṇasthālyāṃ vṛṣalena pacyate saramāmiṣam | naradehe tu pāpena pacyate yamayātanā ||45|| janmarogī vṛthājanmā māyārogī vṛthāmanuḥ | vṛthāśramo’gṛhakośī vṛthāmṛtyurhariṃ vinā ||46|| vṛthā vāco mahāmūrkhe cāsaṃyame vṛthauṣadham | hariṃ vinā vṛthā yātrā viḍvāhi janma vai vṛthā ||47|| sarvanāthaṃ hariṃ tyaktvā vānaraṃ sevate tu yaḥ | tattulyo dehamātrasya poṣako mokṣavarjitaḥ ||48|| vinā bhaktiṃ bahuvidyāgamasyāpi phalaṃ nu kim | yenātmaśāntirnaivāsti tasmācchāntipradaṃ bhajet ||49|| kiṃ tena lakṣmi dehena candanādiprasevinā | yena sevāharernaiva naiva satāṃ na mokṣaṇam ||3.66.50 || śvapaco’pi yadi bhaktiyuto janmāsya sārthakam | vipradeho’pi nirbhakto janmāsya nirayapradam ||51|| maṇikaṃkaṇamābaddhvā darpaṇaṃ niṣphalaṃ yathā | satāṃ satsaṃgamāsādya vṛthā tadanyasādhanam ||52|| dṛḍhāśritā na gṛhṇanti dattaiśvaryaṃ surādibhiḥ | dṛḍhabhaktā na gṛhṇanti dattaiśvaryaṃ harerapi ||53|| anicchukasya bhaktasya jayaścāste pade pade | na taṃ pralobhituṃ śaktaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇo’pi vai ||54|| icchayā badhyate dehī tṛṣṇayā tu vinaśyati | dvābhyāmūrdhvasthitāyātra dātuṃ nālaṃ hyapi prabhuḥ ||55|| nityatṛptasya śāntasya dhairyaṃ tyājayituṃ hyalam | nirbhayasyāpi bhaktasya kaścinnāsti jagattraye ||56|| bhaktaṃ caitādṛśaṃ naijaṃ rañjayituṃ narāyaṇaḥ | bhavāmyahaṃ dṛśyavacca yena dhyāto bhavāmi ca || 57|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dhyātvā ca māṃ janāḥ | sākāraṃ divyarūpaṃ vai śāśvataṃ dhāmagaṃ hi mām ||58|| asaṃkhyadehino bhaktā gatā me paramākṣaram | pūjāṃ bhaktiṃ divyasevāṃ vidhāya bhṛtyatāṃ tathā ||59|| dāsatāṃ savidhāyāpi pātivratyaṃ vidhāya ca | vidhāya mama dāsītāṃ gatā nāryo mamākṣaram ||3.66.6 0|| śūnye bhaktirna bhavati bhaktirbhavati sākṛtau | ādhārarūpe nāthe śrīpatau mayi pareśvare |||6 1 || vidhāya premabhaktiṃ vai śrīvanmāṃ svāminaṃ patim | prāpuḥ pūrvatarā nāryo jārabhāvamupāśritāḥ ||62|| kiṃ punarnijayoṣāśca sarvasvārpaṇasaṃśritāḥ | tasmāllakṣmi svayaṃ svāmī sākāro’haṃ prabhuḥ patiḥ ||63|| sukhadaḥ śāśvatānandaprado bhūtvā nayāmyapi | kāsāñciddarśane snehaḥ kāsāñcitsparśane’dhikaḥ ||64|| kāsāñcidramaṇe snehaḥ kāsāñcit svapane’pi ca | kāsāñcitkāmasaṃbhoge kāsāñcidrāsakarmaṇi ||65|| kāsāñcid bhojane snehaḥ kāsāñcit snānakeliṣu | kāsāñciccūmbanādau ca kāsāñcittu mahotsave ||66|| kāsāñcitsahavāse ca kāsāñcit tvaviyojane | kāsāñcinnijaśayyāyāṃ kāsāñcinnarmakarmasu ||67|| kāsāñcittu rahasye vai sneho mayi vibhāvyate | tāsāṃ sampūrya kāmām̐śca namāmi dhāma me’kṣaram ||68|| guṇī tāṃ guṇavadbhāryāṃ muktānikāṃ vidhāya vai | nayāmi kāntarūpo’haṃ śāśvatānandadhāma me ||69|| sevāraso hi sākāre labhyate sundarīgaṇaiḥ | bhaktaiḥ sevārasaḥ pūrṇaḥ prāpyate mayi dhāmani ||3.66.70|| mamaiva hi prasādena romāñcitaśarīriṇī | nayanānandasalilā muktidāsī vadhūrbhavet ||71 || vāṇyā gāyati māṃ dāsī manasā māṃ smaratyapi | karmaṇā māṃ harṣayati kaṭidānārpaṇādibhiḥ ||72|| pūjājapārcanasevāpādasammardanādibhiḥ | | rahasyārpaṇabhāvaiśca labhate śāśvataṃ sukham ||73|| sākāre mayi bhaktā me dehabhāvaiḥ prasevayā | sarvendriyairmahāsaukhyaṃ labhate lokavat sakhī ||74|| vadhūrbhūtvā varaṃ kāntaṃ sevate māṃ patiṃ prabhum | sarvān kāmān pūrayāmi kāmadvārā hi yoṣitaḥ ||75|| na me kāmo ratirnaiva na me kāmasukhaṃ priye | pūrṇakāmasya me ratyā kiṃ kāmena prayojanam ||76|| sarvānandaparipūrṇamūrterme nāstyapūrṇatā | nendriyādhīnatā cāpi kiṃ kāmena prayojanam ||77|| kāmo mayā kṛtaḥ pūrvaḥ karmiṇāṃ sukhalabdhaye | māyāmayo hi kāmo vai ratirmāyāmayī tathā ||78|| tayā tena na me kāryaṃ prayojanaṃ hi māyikam | kintu dehavaśā lokā narā nāryo nijāniva ||79|| kāmān bhāvān kalpayanti mayi pūrṇe sanātane | taistairbhāvaistathā tām̐stāḥ saṃgṛhya kāmabhāvitāḥ ||3.66.80|| kāmadvārāpi me yogaṃ datvā nayāmi dhāma me | mokṣapadaṃ prāpayāmi kāmināmapi sundarīḥ ||8 1|| kṛpā me tādṛśī bodhyā saṃsāro hi tathāvidhaḥ | aindriyikā hi me bhaktāḥ saṃmatāḥ santi bhūtale ||82|| vaiṣayikāstathā bhaktāḥ sthale sthale vasanti vai | ātmikā brahmabhāvāstu kvacitsanti hi paṇḍitāḥ ||83|| ato ye māṃ yathā yānti tathā tān prāpya tadvidhaḥ | mokṣayogaṃ pradatvaivaṃ nayāmi dhāma me’kṣaram ||84|| prāyaśo yoṣitāṃ siddhiṃ kartuṃ bhavāmi kāmavān | tāsāṃ kāmaprasaktānāṃ kathamuddharaṇaṃ bhavet ||85|| tasmād dayāvaśo bhūtvā seve kāmīva tāḥ sadā | divyarūpā vidhāyaiva nayāmi mokṣamuttamam ||86|| vadhūḥ kanyā yuvatīśca vṛddhā vāpi pativratāḥ | napuṃsakī ca vidhavā sadhavā brahmacāriṇī ||87|| yatinī yoginī sādhvī satī cāryā virāgiṇī | sanyāsinī vicittā ca tāpasī vānaprasthinī ||88|| tyāginī sāṃkhyayogasthā śaktirvā gaṇikāpi vā | puṃścalī svairiṇī cāpi kāminī kāmavarjitā ||89|| raṇḍā ṣaṇḍhā ratiśūnyā rajaḥsthā cārajo’nvitā | gaurī vā rohiṇī cāpi kumārikā śavātmikā ||3.66.90 || saṃskṛtā cāsaṃskṛtā vā śuddhāśuddhā ca varjitā | tyaktā mantravatī cāpi dīkṣitā vā ca nyakkṛtā ||91|| vivāsitā vanahāristrī yadvā śvapacī khasī | pramadā vā nirmadā vā vyabhicāraparāyaṇā ||92|| muṇḍā vā keśinī vāpi durbhāgyā subhagāthavā | kubjā hrasvā sendriyā vā nirindriyā hyudāsinī ||93|| yādṛśī tādṛśī vāpi sūtikā pāśavī ca vā | godharmā vā mṛgīdharmā yā vā kā vā bhavatyapi ||94|| kāṣāmbarā vā raktā vā viraktā haridambarā | dhvajāmbarā vā devī vā daityānī rākṣasī ca vā ||95|| dānavī nāginī nagnā pakṣiṇī jāntavī ca vā | vārkṣī vā vallikābhāvā śarabhī siṃhikāpi vā ||96|| śvāpadī vā bahupadī pṛṣṭhapadī piśācikā | ārṣī brāhmī paitṛkī vā mātā vā kṣetrarakṣikā ||97|| pakṣiṇī kinnarī vāpi gāndharvī nartakī ca vā | veśyā vāpi vyavāyasthā sahasraliṃginī ca vā ||98|| īśvarī vā mānavī vā bhūtī pretī ca ḍākinī | nikṛṣṭā pāpakartrī vā yā kācinmāmupāgatā ||99|| yathā bhāvena tāṃ labdhvā pāvayitvā nṛpīmapi | aśuddhāṃ saṃskṛtāṃ kṛtvā nayāmi dhāma me’kṣaram || 3.66.100 || tadarthaṃ puṃsvarūpo’haṃ bhavāmi mānavo hariḥ | samuddhartuṃ yoṣitāṃ vai gaṇām koṭisahasraśaḥ || 101 || rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ te’tra lakṣmi kāmaguṇo vṛṣaḥ | māmāsādya hi dharmātmā kāmo bhavati mokṣakṛt || 1 02|| nārīṇāṃ yonisambandhaścotkṛṣṭasnehakārakaḥ | tathā kṛtvā nayāmyeva nārīḥ sarvā pare’kṣare || 1 03|| śrutvā cāpi paṭhitvedaṃ rahasyaṃ divyatāpradam | nārāyaṇīyaṃ mokṣāḍhyaṃ dhāma yāsyanti matpadam || 104|| saṃśayaṃ tvatra yā nāryo narā vā yānti tāstu te | puṇyaṃ pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ hitvā hyadho yāsyanti doṣiṇaḥ || 1 05|| apātrāṇāṃ saṃśayā vai bhavanti lokavādinām | matpātrāṇāṃ saṃśayā no bhavanti divyavedinām || 1 06|| vadhūgītārahasyaṃ vai yaccāste hṛdaye mama | vadhūmokṣapradaṃ te’tra niḥsaṃkocena bodhitam || 1 07|| vadhūmūlyaṃ mamāvāsādākṛṣṭiḥ priyatāpi ca | boddhavyaṃ śiṣyate naivādhikaṃ loke hi yoṣitām || 1 08|| kāmabhāvena yuktānāṃ mokṣado’haṃ na saṃśayaḥ | nijadharmaṃ prathamaṃ vai puraskṛtya bhajeddharim || 1 09|| nārīdharmo hi ratyāsti kāmadharmaḥ puraskṛtaḥ | madyoge brahmacaryaṃ tat kāmo nāryāṃ vrataṃ param || 3.66.11 0|| svadharme maraṇaṃ śreyaḥ harerdharmo hi mokṣadaḥ | svadharme mokṣaṇaṃ syādvai hareyogānna saṃśayaḥ || 111 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ vadhūbhaktirahasyanirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 66 ||
<3.67> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ hṛdyaṃ nivedayāmi te | ahaṃ vai sarvajīvānāṃ sādhāraṇo mahāprabhuḥ || 1 || māmārādhyaiva sarve’tra sṛṣṭāvaiśvaryaśālinaḥ | bhavantyeva tatastebhyo dadāmyaiśvaryamarthitam || 2 || yathākarmaphalaṃ deyaṃ nyāyo’yaṃ mama sarvadā | prasannatā phalaṃ riktaṃ viśeṣo’yaṃ mama gṛhe || 3 || paritoṣikarūpā me prasannatā hi sevake | kāryakare yatnavati prasannatā nisargajā || 4 || nāryā nare ca vā sṛṣṭau karomi yatra tatra vā | pārvatyāṃ cāpi sāmudryāṃ dvīpinyāṃ vānyayoṣiti || 5 || hārityāṃ vāpyamaryāṃ vā gauryāṃ paryāṃ ca vā tathā | rāśiyānyāṃ ca vā brāhmyāṃ raudryāṃ vaninyāṃ yoṣiti || 6 ||. mānasyāṃ vā tatheśānyāṃ daridrāyāṃ tathā ca vā | antyajāyāṃ pūrvajāyāṃ madhyajāyāṃ tathāpi vā || 7 || dhīvaryāṃ vā śabaryāṃ vā yavanyāṃ vā tathā punaḥ | piśaṃgyāṃ prācīnakāyāṃ cābriktāyāmathāpi vā || 8 || śvetāyāṃ vāpi kṛṣṇāyāṃ citrāyāṃ vāpi yoṣiti | tathāvidhe nare vāpi bhakte deve tathārṣake || 9 || īśvare vāpi mukte vā yatra prasannatā mama | tatra tatra hi sarveṣāṃ ratnānāṃ syādasaṃkhyatā || 3.67.1 0|| aiśvaryāṇāṃ samastānāṃ siddhīnāṃ syādasaṃkhyatā | sampadāṃ ca samastānāmṛddhīnāṃ syādasaṃkhyatā || 11 || ānandānāṃ sukhānāṃ ca pramodānāmasaṃkhyatā | utsavānāṃ tathotsāhavilāsānāmasaṃkhyatā || 12|| lakṣmīnāṃ śreyasāṃ cāpi bhogyānāṃ syādasaṃkhyatā | sarveṣāmapi kāmānāṃ tṛptīnāṃ syādasaṃkhyatā ||13|| yatrāhaṃ ca prasannaḥ syāṃ pāritoṣikarūpavān | tatrākṣaraṃ padaṃ me ca svarg paraṃ vasatyapi || 14|| vada lakṣmi kathaṃkāraṃ nyūnatvaṃ saṃbhavettataḥ | sarvaṃ divy bhavatyeva sarv sarvottamaṃ mama || 15|| bhaktagṛhaṃ mama gṛhaṃ bhakto’haṃ cāhameva saḥ | ityevaṃ vartate hṛdyaṃ tatkuṭumbaṃ mamaiva ha || 16|| mama sarvaṃ ca bhaktasya bhedo manāṅ na vidyate | kā māyā kaśca kālo vā prabhurvai manniveśane || 17|| yatrāhaṃ saṃvasāmyeva dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ hi tat | mṛttikāgṛharūpaṃ vai śāśvataṃ tatparaṃ padam || 18|| yatrāhaṃ nāsmi tatsaudhaṃ vimānamapi nārakam | yatrāhaṃ na vasāmyeṣā bhūmiḥ śmaśānarūpiṇī | yatrāhaṃ sevito naiva ramaṇī sāpi rākṣasī || 19|| nāśliṣṭo’haṃ yayā lakṣmi sā bhūtī ca piśācinī | yenāhaṃ vandito naiva samāśliṣṭo na mādhavaḥ ||3.67.20|| sa cātra vidyate bhūto rākṣaso janmakhādakaḥ | māmāśritya piśācāśca bhavanti devatottamāḥ || 2 1|| piśācinyo’pi māṃ prāpya jāyante brahmayoṣitaḥ | doṣāḥ piśācāstadvatyaḥ piśācinyo bhavanti vai ||22|| guṇā muktā hi tadvatyo muktānyastā bhavanti vai | ahaṃbrahmetijñāninyo brahmapatnyo bhavanti vai ||23|| parabrahmaśritāḥ sarvā haripatnyo bhavanti vai | hariṃ māṃ vai parityajya tapo duḥkhaṃ kathaṃ caret ||24|| pareśena vinā kācinnaiva siddhimavāpnuyāt | brahmaṇā nirmitā dehā dehadharmā hyanantakāḥ ||25|| brahmadharmā dehadharmā mano dharmāstathāntarāḥ | lokadharmāstathā tena nirmitāḥ sarvasaukhyadāḥ ||26|| mama dharmāstu nityā vai brahmāpi nirmito mayā | mama nityān parān dharmānāśritya māṃ prayāti saḥ ||27|| mama prasannatā hyeva dharmo me divyatāpradaḥ | brahmadharmān susatkṛtya mama dharmān samācaret ||28|| kartavyaṃ vidyate nāsyā mama dharmārthayoṣitaḥ | svadharmo’yaṃ mama dharmaḥ śuklaśca nirguṇaśca saḥ || 29|| śukladharmeṇa vai stheyaṃ śuklaṃ deyaṃ na me sadā | svalpaṃ śuklaṃ ca me dattamānantyāya prajāyate ||3.67.30|| śuklaṃ madarthamevātra līlayāpi kṛtaṃ ca vā | indriyādyaiḥ kṛtaṃ vāpi śuklaṃ dhāmani cāpyate ||3 1|| puṇyaṃ śuklaṃ mama kāryaṃ tadvato’ghaṃ na jāyate | duḥkhaṃ naiva tathā māyā naiva janma kuto mṛtiḥ ||32|| tasmāt stheyaṃ sadānandapūrṇatayā madāśritaiḥ | māmanāśritya bandhena karmaṇātra vahanti ye ||33|| bhāraṃ vai vāsanājanyaṃ te bhavanti punaḥ punaḥ | śākhāmṛgo yathā yāti prativṛkṣaṃ tathā hi saḥ ||34|| nīyate karmaṇā jīvaḥ saṃsāravanayoniṣu | krīḍārthaṃ kanduko yadvat kṣipyate raṃgabālakaiḥ ||35|| tathāyaṃ karmabhiḥ kṣetre kṣipyate māyike stare | baddho’śvo na svatantro’sti vihartuṃ yātumeva vā ||36|| karmabaddho na svatantraḥ surarṣipitṛmānuṣe | manuṣyā bhūtale śreṣṭhāḥ kintu te pakṣavarjitāḥ ||37|| pakṣiṇo vyomagāścāpi hastasādhanavarjitāḥ | devā divyasvarūpāśca kṣitisthaulyādivarjitāḥ ||38|| nāryo rūpaguṇāḍhyāśca niyāmyāstāstathākṛtāḥ | vṛddhāḥ pūjyā nirmitāśca kintvadhikāravarjitāḥ ||39|| sādhikārā yuvānaśca dīrghānubhavavarjitāḥ | gajo hi balavānāste kintu sādhanavarjitaḥ ||3.67.40|| siṃho vai balavān rājā paśustāmasasattamaḥ | hariṇaḥ pāvanaścāste kintu vanyaḥ paśuḥ kṛtaḥ ||41 || viprā vidyānidhayo’pi dāridryaroṣapīḍitāḥ | kākāḥ śakunacaturāḥ kintu malinayonijāḥ ||42|| maṇayo mauktikāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ kintu te durlabhāḥ kṛtāḥ | kaṭutṛṇāni bahūni miṣṭāni durlabhāni vai ||43|| sulabhā vai kāpuruṣā durlabhāḥ sādhavaḥ priye | satyaḥ sādhvyo durlabhāśca sulabhā vārayoṣitaḥ ||44|| patrāṇi santi bahūni phalāni durlabhāni vai | bhoginaḥ santi sulabhā durlabhāstu virāgiṇaḥ ||45|| kīṭakāḥ santi sarvatra phaṇādhrā durlabhāḥ priye | maraṇaṃ sulabhaṃ lakṣmi cāmṛtaṃ durlabhaṃ bahu ||46|| kalahaḥ sulabho lakṣmi melanaṃ durlabhaṃ bahu | svārthaḥ sarvatra sulabhaḥ parārtho durlabhaḥ sadā ||47|| bhogastu sulabho lakṣmi mokṣo’sti durlabhaḥ sadā | pumāṃsaḥ sulabhā lakṣmi pumuttamastu durlabhaḥ ||48|| puruṣaḥ sulabhaścāste durlabhaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | nāryaḥ sarvatra labhyante nārāyaṇī tu durlabhā ||49|| udyogaḥ sarvathā prāpyaḥ sevā tu durlabhā priye | dehastu bahudhā labhyaścātmā vai durlabhaḥ priye ||3.67.50|| gṛhaṃ tu sulabhaṃ labhyaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ tu durlabham | garbhastu sulabho lakṣmi hiraṇyagarbho hi durlabhaḥ ||51 || khanayaḥ sulabhā lakṣmi brahmaśṛṃgaṃ hi durlabham | vāsanāḥ sulabhā lakṣmi vāsudevo hi durlabhaḥ ||52|| patayaḥ sulabhā lakṣmi durlabhaḥ śāśvataḥ patiḥ | svāminaḥ sulabhā loke parasvāmī hi durlabhaḥ ||13|| sarvaṃ vai sulabhaṃ lakṣmi kṛṣṇo’haṃ durlabhaḥ sadā | māyā vai sulabhā loke māyeśo’haṃ tu durlabhaḥ ||54|| samarthasvāminā lakṣmi karmayonirnirasyate | karmabaddhaṃ jagatsarvaṃ kṛṣṇo’haṃ tārayāmi vai ||55|| toyaṃ sarvatra sulabhaṃ viṣṇupadvāri durlabham | durlabheṣu samasteṣu viṣṇupadaṃ hi durlabham |||56|| durlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ bhaktimatāṃ karomi sarvathā | evaṃ kṛtvā sevināṃ me karma sarvaṃ hi muktidam ||57|| vada lakṣmi kṛpā me’tra kāraṇaṃ pāritoṣikam | tallabdhvā puṇyamutkṛṣṭaṃ mamānandapadaṃ vrajet ||58|| mayi tyāgo durlabho vai tadanyaḥ sulabhaḥ khalu | mayi nyāso durlabho vai tadanyaḥ sulabhaḥ sadā ||59|| anyārpaṇaṃ tu sulabhaṃ mayyarpaṇaṃ hi durlabham | anyayatno’pi sulabho madarthaḥ sa tu durlabhaḥ ||3.67.60 || anyārthatā hi sulabhā madarthatā hi durlabhā | anyavadhūtvaṃ sulabhaṃ vadhūtvaṃ mama durlabham ||61 || māyikaṃ sulabhaṃ sarvaṃ madīyaṃ durlabhaṃ priye | kṛtaśrayā vijānāti hyaśramāyā na vedanam ||62|| kiyadyatnena labhyo’haṃ jānāti śrīrnarāyaṇī | satī haimī vijānāti kathaṃ labhyo hi śaṃkaraḥ ||63|| māṇikyāśvī vijānāti kathaṃ dhārmirhi labhyate | rādhā kṛṣṇā ca kamalā vijānanti pariśramam |||64|| gāyatrī naiva jānāti naiva jānāti cābdhijā | padmāvatī vijānāti kathaṃ labhyaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||65| labdhakṛpāṃśavanitā na jānāti tapaḥśramam | jānanti yogino yuktāḥ sādhvyo jānanti tacchramam ||66|| yoginyaśca vijānanti tāpasyo dehaśoṣikāḥ | tvaṃ lakṣmi kiṃ vijānāsi hanūmatparvate tapaḥ ||67|| kṛtvā śrameṇa labdhavatyasi māṃ puruṣottamam | mṛtyorvinimaye labhyo bhavāmi nānyathā priye ||68|| bāhyaṃ ca mānasaṃ sarvaṃ madarthaṃ yasya jīvitam | madarthaṃ tyajanaṃ sarvaṃ sa māṃ prāpnoti vai śramāt ||69|| madarthaṃ yasya sarvasvaṃ yasyā madarthinī kṛtiḥ | yasyāstyāgā madarthāśca sā māṃ prāpnoti vai śramāt ||3.67.70|| śuddhagehāptakāyā ca yoginī yogiputrikā | madarthakṛtasarvasvā māṃ prāpnotīva bhārgavī ||71|| yoge māṃ yoginaṃ vetti dhyānaṃ māṃ ca smaratyapi | madarthakṛtasarvasvā padmevāpnoti sā hi mām ||72|| svalpayatnāpi kalyāṇī madarthavirahāturā | cidānandamayaṃ māṃ sā hyavāpnotīva mādhavī ||73|| sarvakāmakṛtā yajñā mayyeva sarvasaukhyadāḥ | nityaṃ saukhyaṃ labhante tā bhaktimatyo mayi sthitāḥ ||74|| sarvākṣarapadaṃ rājyaṃ sarveśvaragataṃ sukham | sarvāvatārānandādi labhate mama bhāminī ||75|| yasyā matirna bhidyeta madanyakāmanādibhiḥ | sā māṃ tu durlabhaṃ kāntaṃ kṛtvā sulabhameti vai ||76|| kṛṣṇasevāparāṃ nārīṃ kālo yamaśca muñcataḥ | aparādhasahasrāṃ vā karomi doṣavarjitām ||77|| rakṣako’haṃ hṛdayastho bahistiṣṭhāmi satvaram | durlabho’pi bhavāmyeva sulabho gopaveśmavat ||78|| durlabho’pi bhavāmyeva sulabho vāmano yathā | sudūro’pi bhavāmyeva nikaṭastho gajārthavat ||79|| adṛśyo’pi bhavāmīva dṛśyo prahlādakāṣṭhagaḥ | agamyo’pi bhavāmyeva gamyaḥ svapatirīśavat ||3.67.80|| sarvaṃ snehārpaṇāllakṣmi dadāmi vitarāmi ca | durlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ sarvaṃ sevikārthaṃ karomi ca ||81|| tvadarthaṃ kriyate sarvaṃ bhaktārthaṃ kriyate tathā | brahmapriyārthaṃ kriyate sarvaṃ bhaktyā vaśena ha ||82|| ityevaṃ māṃ viditvaiva yā janmāntaṃ karoti sā | divyaśrīriva sampannā madīyā jāyate’kṣare ||83|| svapanti mohanidrāyāṃ śarīrasukhamohitāḥ | upadeśena me cedvai jāgṛtiṃ yānti bodhitāḥ ||84|| tadā labhyaṃ patiṃ kāntaṃ māṃ prayānti pumuttamam | narā nāryaḥ sadā muktā bhavanti divyavigrahāḥ ||85|| divyānandabharā nityaṃ nyūnasaukhyaṃ na vidyate | paripūrṇaṃ sukhaṃ sarvaṃ tatra loke pravidyate ||86|| manmūrtāviva sākṣācca mayyevānandaśevadhiḥ | ānandānāṃ pravāhā vai sravante mama mūrtitaḥ ||87|| madbhaktānānandayitvā praviśanti ca te mayi | manmūrtito hi niryānti prakṛṣṭānandavārdhayaḥ ||88|| madbhaktāsu ciraṃ sthitvā punaścāyānti vai mayi | ete sarve mahānandā hrāsaṃ vrajanti naiva ha ||89|| nyūnā bhavanti naivāpi sāntā bhavanti naiva ca | pravāhāṇāṃ pravāhāśca svecchājanyā bhavanti vai ||3.67.90|| akṣayā vardhamānāśca mama mūrtisuyogajāḥ | brahmānandaḥ sa evāste muktānāṃ mama dhāmani ||91|| bhuṃkṣva taṃ paramānandaṃ sarvābhiḥ saha padmaje | etāstvatkaragā ālyaḥ sakhyaste svasṛsaṃjñitāḥ |||92|| sapatnyaḥ koṭyabjalakṣārbudā manmayamūrtayaḥ | tvadabhinnā hi tāḥ sarvā madabhinnā bhavantyapi ||93 || tato bhinnā hi me mūrtermadātmikā guṇātmikāḥ | macchaktayaśca tāḥ sarvā mayājñaptāḥ striyo’bhavan ||94|| māṃ ca prāpya mayā naijasvarūpātmatvamāpitāḥ | mayā sarvapṛthivyāṃ vai gatvā svayaṃ hi mārgitāḥ ||95|| anviṣya nijakāntātvaṃ prāpitā mama śaktayaḥ | vadhūdharmān puraskṛtya bhuñjantāṃ nanditaṃ hi mām ||96|| akṣaraṃ cākṣayaṃ cāpyavyayaṃ śāśvatamuttamam | sarvānandanidhānaṃ māṃ bhuñjantāṃ parameśvaram ||97|| yā kācinmāṃ puraskṛtya kṛtvā māṃ hṛdi sarvathā | vadhūgītāṃ maduktāṃ ca śrutvā kāntaṃ sanātanam ||98|| icchiṣyanti nijānandaṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam | tāsāṃ prāpto bhaviṣyāmi grahīṣyāmi ca tatkaram ||99|| neṣyāmi paramaṃ dhāma kariṣye svāminīṃ hi tām | muktānikāṃ brahmapriyāṃ kariṣye tāṃ haripriyām || 3.67.100 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ hareḥ kṛpāsarvasvaphalanirūpaṇanāmā saptaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 67 ||
<3.68> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca bhagavan bhavatā proktā vadhūgītā hi mokṣadā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptipradākhilā || 1 || tasya te kāntavaryasya mantraṃ śrotuṃ samutsukā | bhavāmi bhavarogāṇāṃ bheṣajaṃ parama manum || 2 || śrīhare kena mantreṇa gamyate paramaṃ padam | tanme brūhi kṛpāsindho sarvāsāṃ mokṣahetave || 3 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri mantraṃ mantravaraṃ śubham | diṣṭyāhaṃ te’tra vakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ mama cottamam || 4 || na jānanti surāḥ sarve ṛṣayaśceśvarā api | sargādau proktavām̐ścāhaṃ brahmaṇe parameṣṭhine || 5 || vairājāya tathā mahāviṣṇave bhūmna ityapi | vāsudevāya kṛṣṇāya nārāyaṇāya coktavān || 6 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya me parātmanaḥ | īśvarībhirdevikābhiḥ saha pāraṃ na yanti te || 7 || tebhyo’rthitāndadau mantrān bhaktoddhāraṇatatparān | mama rūpasvarūpātmabalaiśvaryasamanvitān || 8 || mantro’haṃ mantrarūpo’haṃ purāṇapuruṣottamaḥ | sakṛduccāraṇātteṣāṃ milatyeva paraṃ padam || 9 || bhuktimuktīṣṭadā lakṣmi puraścaraṇamantarā | maddevatā mamaivaive’vatārā mantrasattamāḥ || 3.68.1 0|| śṛṇu lakṣmi ca mantrāṇāṃ mantraratnaṃ śubhāvaham | satkṛtsmaraṇamātreṇa dadāti dhāma cākṣaram || 1 1|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti śaraṇāgatam | prapāti dharmakāmārthamokṣado manuruttamaḥ || 12|| daśārṇo’yaṃ mahāmantro daśāvatārasaṃyutaḥ | akāro matsyarūpo’sti nakāro narakeśarī || 13|| dakāro’tra varāhaśca śakāro hayamastakaḥ | kakāraḥ kṛṣṇarūpaśca ṇakāro vāmanaḥ prabhuḥ || 14|| nakāraḥ paraśudhrak ca rakāro rāmabhūpatiḥ | yakāro bodhakṛdviṣṇuḥ ṇakāraḥ kalkanāśakaḥ || 15|| evaṃ daśāvatārātmā mantro me sarvakāmadaḥ | asyoccāraṇamātreṇa paratuṣṭo’smi sarvadā || 16|| śṛṇu lakṣmi tathānādiśrīstvaṃ mantre virājase | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ virāje puruṣottamaḥ || 17|| yugalārtho’pi mantro’yaṃ yugalānāṃ sukhapradaḥ | dampatīsukhasampattisaubhāgyarddhipramodadaḥ || 18|| vaṃśavṛddhikaro japto dhanadhānyādivardhakaḥ | nirvighnabrahmalokādimahānandaprado manuḥ || 19|| ārogyakīrtisattāśrīrājyasvargādisampradaḥ | mahāmantro yugalātmā sarveṣṭānandapūrakaḥ ||3.68.20 || śṛṇu lakṣmi tatra mantre rājate tu catuṣṭayam | anādiśrīḥ svayaṃ rādhā kṛṣṇo golokabhāskaraḥ ||21 || anādiśrīśca lakṣmīrvai nārāyaṇo vikuṇṭhagaḥ | tābhyāṃ tābhyāṃ sametābhyāṃ catuṣṭayayuto manuḥ ||22|| sarvakāmaphalāvāptiprado dhāmapradaḥ paraḥ | sarvasaubhāgyadaścāpi manuḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ ||23|| śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā tatra mantre paraṃ catuṣṭayam | anādino hi ye muktāḥ śriyo muktānikāgaṇāḥ ||24|| gopā gopyaśca vai tābhiryuktaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | nārāyaṇastathā cāhaṃ catuṣṭayamidaṃ hi tat ||25|| muktamuktānikāyuktanārāyaṇo’hameva ca | gopagopīyuktakṛṣṇo golokavāsavām̐stathā ||26|| śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā tatra mantre ṣaṭkaṃ paraṃ sthitam | aśabda oṃvācakaśca nādo brahmaparastathā ||27|| nādo’syāstīti nādī vai vedaḥ svayaṃ tathā mataḥ | nādino vai sarvavedā oṃviśiṣṭāḥ sadā śubhāḥ ||28|| śriyaḥ sarvāḥ śaktayaścāṃganā brāhmyo matisthitāḥ | yidyātmikā hi tā bodhyā brahmavidyātmikā hi tāḥ ||29|| kṛṣṇaśca mokṣadāḥ sarve’vatārāścātra kīrtitāḥ | nārāścātra samagrāśca santaḥ sādhvyaśca mokṣadāḥ ||3.68.3 0|| tatra sarvatrāyanaṃ vai yasya śrīparamātmanaḥ | oṃkāre cāpi vedeṣu vidyāsvavatāreṣu ca ||3 1|| sādhusādhvīṣu vāsī yaḥ so’haṃ mantre nirūpitaḥ | śṛṇu lakṣmi trayaṃ tatra mantre sthitaṃ vadāmi te ||32|| anādi cākṣaraṃ dhāma śrīkṛṣṇāśceśvarālayāḥ | nārā brahmāṇḍavrātāśca tatrāyanaṃ karomyaham ||33|| evaṃ sṛṣṭitrayāntaḥsthaścāhaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | sarvakāmapradaścāsmi nibodhārthaṃ parārthakam ||34|| śṛṇu lakṣmi dvyarthamatra jaḍacetanasaṃjñitam | anādiśrīrmahāmāyā prakṛtiḥ śaktirācyutī ||35|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ tatrasthaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | ityevaṃ tatra mantrārthe jñānadaṃ bodhayedapi ||36|| śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā tatra svatantramarthamityapi | akāro vāsudevaśca naśca nārāyaṇastathā ||37|| daśca devāḥ samastāśca śrīśca sarvā hi śaktayaḥ | kṛśca kṛṣṇādyavatārāḥ ṣṇaḥ ṣirā nālajohyajaḥ ||38|| no vā niyāmyamuktādyāḥ raśca ṛṣigaṇāstathā | yaśca yogīśvaraḥ śaṃbhuḥ ṇaśca niyāmako’pyaham ||39|| viśiṣṭaṃ sarvamevaitanmantrārthe veśitaṃ priye | śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā cānyaṃ mantrārthaṃ śobhanaṃ śubham ||3.68.40|| ādirjanma ca tadyeṣāṃ nāsti te śāśvatā matāḥ | śrīśca tvaṃ śāśvatī lakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇo’haṃ śāśvatastathā ||41 || nṛṣyātmasu nivasāmi śrīkṛṣṇo’haṃ manusthitaḥ | śāśvataścāntaryāmī ca mantrārthaḥ śobhanaḥ śubhaḥ ||42|| śreṣṭho’yaṃ mantramūrdhanyastubhyaṃ me kathito manuḥ | nāsmātparo bhavenmantraḥ sarvamantrottamottamaḥ ||43 || athāparo manurlakṣmīnārāyaṇo’pi me mataḥ | lakṣmīstvaṃ śrīḥ hariścāhaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ ||44|| lakṣmaṃ matpātivratyaṃ vai yāsāmastīti tāḥ striyaḥ | lakṣmyo brahmapriyāḥ sarvā mama patnyastu koṭiśaḥ ||45|| nārā nāryo mama sarvā muktānikā haripriyāḥ | lakṣmīṣu cāpi nārāsu ayanaṃ mama sarvathā ||46|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ so’haṃ mantrārthaste niveditaḥ | lakṣmaṃ mattilakaṃ cihnaṃ śaṃkhacakrāṃkanādi ca ||47|| tadvanto lakṣmiṇaḥ sarve bhaktā nārīnarādayaḥ | tādṛśā ye cetanā vai nārāḥ sarve mamāśritāḥ ||48|| teṣu prāptamayanaṃ me tenāhaṃ mantrahṛdgataḥ | lāntikarmaphalaṃ yasmāt lāśca brahmāṇḍavāsinaḥ ||49|| kṣamante cāpi puṣyanti kṣāścaiśvaryapareśvarāḥ | mīyante brahmaloke ye māśca muktādayastathā ||3.68.50|| nārā māyājatattvāni teṣu prāpto’yanaṃ tu yaḥ | so’haṃ pareśvaro lakṣmi viśiṣṭo mantrahṛdgataḥ ||51|| athāparo manuḥ śrīmannārāyaṇe’ti me mataḥ | śrayante māṃ cetanāśca jaḍāścāśrayamāgatāḥ ||52|| tadvān śrīmānahaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | śrīstvaṃ tadvānahaṃ nārā nāryo me koṭiśastviha ||53|| tvayā sākaṃ pratiṣṭho’haṃ tāsu madhye sadā prabhuḥ | śrīmānahaṃ jale cāsmi kṣīrode tena vā tathā |||54|| śrīmannāraṃ cākṣaraṃ me dhāma tatra sthitirmama | tena tayā bhavāmyeva śrīmannārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||55|| śrīkṛṣṇovallabhaśceti mantro’yaṃ prāptibodhakaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇavat labhyate yaḥ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||56|| narāṇāṃ cāpi nārīṇāṃ kṛpayā sulabho’smi vai | puruṣottamamāse’pi sulabhaḥ kṛpayāsmi ca ||57|| sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭau tathā kalpe kalpe kṛṣṇo bhavāmyaham | gopīnāṃ sulabhaścāsmi gopānāṃ cānyadehinām ||58|| golokasthaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo yathāhaṃ sulabhaḥ kṣitau | tathā cākṣaradhāmasthaḥ sulabho’haṃ pareśvaraḥ ||59|| kalpe kalpe bhavāmyatra kṣitau kṛpālabhaḥ svayam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣāttamaḥ ||3.68.60|| evaṃ vai sulabho lakṣmi mantraḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇo vallabho me’sti rūpaṃ dhṛtaṃ mayā hi tat ||61 || rādhāyā rañjanādyarthaṃ gopīnāṃ modakārakam | sarveṣāṃ sulabhaṃ rūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo vallabho’pyaham ||62|| svāmī vai vallabhaḥ kāntaḥ patiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | so’hamākṛṣya madbhaktān nayāmi dhāma me param ||63|| so’haṃ svāmī patiḥ śrīyuk kṛṣṇo brahmaparaḥ prabhuḥ | śrīkṛṣṇovallabhaścāhaṃ mantrārthe’smi hariḥ svayam ||64|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | mantroccāraṇamātreṇa parituṣṭo’smi sarvadā ||65|| sarve varṇā āśramāśca narā nāryo napuṃsakāḥ | mantrādhikāriṇaḥ sarve saṃkarāścāpyasaṃskṛtāḥ ||66|| nāgāḥ sarpā dānavāśca daityāśca rākṣasā api | mantrādhikāriṇaḥ sarve kiṃ punarmānavāḥ kṣitau ||67|| paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi jantavaḥ pādapā api | dehinaḥ sarva evaite mantrādhikārayoginaḥ ||68|| śrāvito’yaṃ tiraścāṃ hi mokṣado mama vai manuḥ | yakṣagandharvasūtāśca piśācāḥ kinnarāḥ khagāḥ ||69|| kiṃpuruṣāḥ puṇyajanā bhūtāḥ pretāśca devatāḥ | vināyakāśca vetālā gaṇāśca gaṇikāstathā ||3.68.70|| yoginyaśca yatinyaśca sādhvyaḥ pativratāstathā | snuṣā vṛddhāśca bālāśca bālakāḥ stanyapā api ||7 1 || vasavaśca ṛṣayaśca rudrāḥ sūryāśca candramāḥ | kāmaśca manavaścāpi mahendrādyāḥ surā api ||72|| lokapālāśca dikpālā nakṣatrāṇi grahāstathā | tārakā mānavāścāpi siddhāśca cāraṇāstathā ||73 || nṛpāḥ prajā yamaścāpi yamadūtāstatheśvarāḥ | īśvarāṇyo brahmaśīlāstāmasā rājasāstathā ||74|| sattvavanto dhāmavāsāḥ sarve mantrādhikāriṇaḥ | guroḥ prāpya paraṃ mantraṃ cātmānaṃ mocayed bhavāt ||75|| mantrādhikāriṇaḥ sarve mama bhaktā mamāśritāḥ | śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇānāṃ ca tathaivānanyasevinām ||76|| ananyasādhanānāṃ ca sādhanaṃ mantra uttamaḥ | ārttānāmāśu phalado japtaḥ sakṛtacca vā muhuḥ ||77|| dīptānāṃ dehināṃ cāpi janmāntaranivārakaḥ | sarveṣāṃ mokṣadaścāpi mantro mama caturvidhaḥ ||78|| duḥkhī svārthī vivekī vā tadicchuko’dhikāravān | śaraṇaṃ prāpyāpya manuṃ muktiphalamavāpnuyāt ||79|| dīkṣitaścāpi bhaktaśca nirmānī cāstikaḥ kṛtī | kṛtajñaḥ śraddhayā yuktaḥ śuśrūṣurdoṣavarjitaḥ ||3.68.80|| mattādātmyakriyāyogyo gṛhṇīyānmanumuttamam | pāpināmapi vaktavyaḥ śodhako bhavanāśakaḥ ||81 || api māṃsādanaḥ śuddhyet kiṃ punardharmamārgagaḥ | api vyavāyakṛcchuddhyet kiṃ punaḥ śīlamārgagaḥ |||82|| api cauryaparaḥ śuddhyet kiṃ punarnyāyamārgagaḥ | surāpaścāpi śuddhyedvai kiṃ punarvipradharmavān ||83|| deśakālādiniyamo vidyate grahaṇe’sya na | snānadānādiniyamo vidyate grahaṇe’sya na ||84|| vratotsavādiniyamo vidyate grahaṇe’sya na || nārīnarādiniyamo vidyate grahaṇe’sya na ||85|| gurorgrāhyo vaiṣṇavādvai gurvyāśca niyamo’sya vai || grahaṇe sati bhaktena bhāvyaṃ bhaktyā sadā mama ||86|| maccihnāṃkitadehena madīyārādhanena ca | mayi karmārpaṇenaiva me śaraṇāgatena ca ||87|| mayi phalārpaṇenāpi mayi viśvastavartinā | ananyasādhanenāpi sarvārpaṇena vai mayi ||88|| ananyadevatākena bhāvyaṃ bhāgavatena vai | ityevaṃ niyamāḥ pālyā bhaktena mantragrāhiṇā ||89|| tasyānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhamṛṣiḥ prabhuḥ | devatāśca śriyā yuktā brahmapriyā mamāṃśajāḥ ||3.68.90|| brahmapriyāśrīsahitaḥ paro devo’smi vai manau | chando gāyatrītibodhyo daśākṣaro manurhi me ||91 || ṣaḍakṣarastathā ṣaḍakṣaraḥ ṣaḍakṣarastathā | manavo me trayaścānye tān cāṃgeṣu niyojayet ||92|| daśākṣaraṃ daśāṃgeṣu mūrddhanetrānaneṣu ca | grīvābāhuhṛdayeṣūdarakaṭyūrupatsu ca ||93|| ṣaḍakṣaraṃ cottamāṃge grīvāyāṃ bhujayorhṛdi | udare cāpi sakthnośca pādayośceti vai nyaset ||94|| dhyānaṃ lakṣmīsahitasya nārāyaṇasya me matam | tathā yathārthadevānāṃ dhyānaṃ madanvitaṃ matam ||95|| kambharābālakaṃ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇanandanam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ pūjayettataḥ ||96|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmapāṇinaṃ kamalāpatim | śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastiyutaṃ harim ||97|| vāmāṃkasthaśriyā yuktaṃ lakṣmīśaṃ parameśvaram | pūjayed gandhapuṣpādyairnaivedyaiścāmbarādibhiḥ ||98|| vibhūṣaṇaiśca śṛṃgārairnīrājanaiḥ stavādibhiḥ | pradakṣiṇairdakṣiṇābhirnṛtyakīrtanagāyanaiḥ ||99|| visarjanādyaiścaivaṃ me kuryāt prapūjanaṃ priye | dānaṃ dadyād yathāśakti sadbhyaḥ satībhya uttamam || 3.68.10 0|| bhojayed rāmayeccāpi rañjayet sevayet tathā | vaiṣṇavatvena tiṣṭhecca varteta dāsyabhāvataḥ || 10 1|| kuryādvai bhajanaṃ nityaṃ mantrairiṣṭaiḥ sahasrakam | śatamālā japedvāpi mālāmekāṃ japecca vā || 1 02|| daśavāraṃ japedvāpi nityaṃ prātarniśāmukhe | madhyāhe’pi japedvāpi mokṣado’haṃ bhavāmi vai || 10 3|| sakāmānāṃ sampadāṃ vai pradātāhaṃ bhavāmi ca | niṣkāmānāṃ śreyasāṃ vai pradātāhaṃ bhavāmi ca || 1 04|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi rahasyaṃ me manostava | japennārī naro vāpi dadyācca dehine’rthine || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mahāmantrarahasye mantratadarthanyāsādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 68 ||
<3.69> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca śreṣṭhamuktaṃ tvayā kānta rahasyaṃ manusaṃbhṛtam | mahāmantrasya sāmarthyaṃ sarveṣṭapūrakaṃ mahat || 1 || tvaṃ prabhustvaṃ patistvaṃ ca lokānāṃ gurureva ca | tvaṃ svāmī tvaṃ sakhā nāthastvaṃ gatistvaṃ sahāyakṛt || 2 || tvaṃ bhoktā tvaṃ tārayitā trātā poṣṭā suhṛt sadā | tvaṃ janako’si lokānāṃ garbhadhrastvaṃ hi dehinām || 3 || ahaṃ śiṣyā vadhūḥ patnī kāntā sakhī tavāsmi ca | dāsī bhṛtyā kiṃkarī ca bhāryā yoṣittavāṅganā || 4 || imā brahmapriyāḥ sarvāstavārdhāṃgasya śaktayaḥ | haripriyāśca vai tadvacchaktayaḥ santi te parāḥ || 5 || sarvāsāṃ me’pi ca kṛpākarastvaṃ śāśvato’dhipaḥ | mantradātā bhavāneva dīkṣādātā bhavānapi || 6 || mantradīkṣāvidhiṃ māṃ tvaṃ brūhi lokahitecchayā | prāpya dīkṣāṃ mahāmokṣaṃ prāpsyantīti kṛpāṃ kuru || 7 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu kānte pravakṣyāmi mantradīkṣāvidhiṃ hi te | yadā bhaveddhi saṃkalpaḥ satsaṃgasya balena vai || 8 || pūrvapuṇyabalenāpi cānyasampreritena vā | tadā snātvā hariṃ smṛtvā śīghraṃ gacched guruṃ prati || 9 || sadgururdharmasampannastyāgavān saṃyatendriyaḥ | mahābhāgavato bhakto vidvān bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 3.69.10 || ācāryo vedavinmantratattvārthavid rahasyavit | mantrajāparataścāpi matsampradāyasaṃyutaḥ || 11 || parabrahmasampradāyadīkṣāvān matpadāśritaḥ | brahmavidyāsu niṣṇātaścānanyadaivataḥ śuciḥ || 12|| sādhuḥ sādhvī satī vipro gurupādāśrito’pi yaḥ | gurvarthakṛtasarvasvaḥ śāsitā mokṣado guruḥ || 13|| etādṛśaṃ śreṣṭhaguruṃ yadvā mantravidaṃ gurum | abhigacchedarcyapāṇirjñānadaṃ divyamūrtikam || 14|| ācāraśāsakaṃ bhaktiśāsakaṃ brahmadāyakam | ācāryaṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ guruṃ gacchennamettathā || 15|| ācāryaṃ nijasaṃkalpaṃ mantrārthakaṃ nivedayet | yathoktavacanaṃ matvā mama janmāṣṭamīdine || 16|| ūrjakṛṣṇe’thavā corje dvādaśyāṃ śuklake dale | yadvāpuṇyadine yadvā yadecchedvai tadā dine || 17|| tīrthajalaṃ kare dhṛtvā hareḥ pādāmṛtaṃ jalam | ācamanaṃ vidhāyaiva niṣīdedvai guroḥ puraḥ || 18|| gurustasmai harernāma śrāvayitvā punaḥ punaḥ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmacihnāni dāpayejjalaiḥ || 19|| yadvā vahniṃ sthāpayecca vahnimantravidhānataḥ | sthaṇḍilādau juhuyācca gavājyaṃ mantrasaṃyutam ||3.69.20|| aṣṭottarasahasraṃ vā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ ca vā | juhuyādvai mahāmantrasaṃyutaṃ ca phalādibhiḥ ||21 || mantraiḥ puruṣasūktādyairlakṣmīsūktādibhistathā | pāyasaṃ ca ghṛtādyaṃ ca juhuyānme’bhidhānakaiḥ ||22|| tato vai rājataṃ yadvā sauvarṇaṃ tāmrameva vā | śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ pañcāmṛtaiḥ niṣecayet ||23|| pūjayecca tato vahnau tāpayenmudraṇocitam | daśahomān prakuryācca ṣaṭhomān vā tataḥ punaḥ ||24|| uddhṛtya cakraṃ bāhvorvai cāṃkayed gururāśritam | dakṣe cordhve cakrameva śaṃkhaṃ tūrṇaṃ hi vāmake ||25|| gadāṃ dakṣe hyadhobhāge padmaṃ vāme ca nimnake | evaṃ bāhvoraṃkayitvā tīrthakalaśavāriṇā ||26|| mantreṇaivābhimantryaiva śiṣyamūrdhnyabhiṣecayet | ācamanaṃ pradadyācca hyūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ prakārayet ||27|| sacandrakaṃ kauṃkumaṃ ca mantramadhyāpayettataḥ | trivāraṃ dakṣakarṇe vai nāryā vāme vaded guruḥ ||28|| mantrārthān bodhayet sarvān nirbhayatvaṃ dadettataḥ | japasya niyamān dadyād dadyāt kaṇṭhīṃ ca taulasīm ||29|| japamālāṃ pradadyācca parihāraṃ samāpayet | śiṣyastato’rcayedbhaktyā guruṃ bhūṣāmbarādibhiḥ ||3.69.30|| evaṃ mantrayutaḥ śiṣyo natvā yāyād gṛhaṃ nijam | idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ lakṣmi te samudāhṛtam ||3 1|| mantracatuṣṭayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ muktidaṃ divyatāpradam | tajjapādvai bhavenmokṣo yāvatkṛtyanikṛntanaḥ ||32|| pūrvoktaṃ mantradaśakaṃ tathedaṃ ca catuṣṭayam | sarvabhuktisarvamuktitādātmyādipradaṃ mama ||33|| trayodaśa tathā mantrāścāpare prāṅnidarśitāḥ | te ca mokṣakarā lakṣmi bhuktimuktipradāḥ śubhāḥ ||34|| trayastriṃśattathā mantrā gāyatryantā udīritāḥ | sarve te siddhidā lakṣmi puruṣārthapradāḥ śubhāḥ ||35|| trayastriṃśattathānye te mantrā lakṣmi prakīrtitāḥ | tava gāyatrikāntāste puruṣārthapradāḥ śubhāḥ || 36|| tato ramāyāḥ pārvatyā gāyatrīdvayamuttamam | tato mantratrayaṃ svāmīkṛṣṇovallabhadaivatam ||37|| sarvārthasādhakaṃ lakṣmi sarvamantrottamottamam | atha gāyatrikāścāpi śṛṇu mokṣapradāḥ śubhāḥ ||38|| parameśāya vidmahe pumuttamāya dhīmahi | tanno’vatārī pracodayāt ||39|| gopīśvarāya vidmahe śrīrādheśīya dhīmahi | tannaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pracodayāt ||3.69.40|| nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi | tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt ||41 || tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ||42|| tatpuruṣāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahi | tanno rudraḥ pracodayāt ||43|| padmodbhavāya vidmahe vedavaktrāya dhīmahi | tannaḥ sraṣṭā pracodayāt ||44|| mahāviṣṇave vidmahe hiraṇyagarbhāya dhīmahi | tanno bhūmā pracodayāt ||45|| etāḥ sapta matsvarūpāḥ śṛṇu tvadrūpagā api | gāyatryaḥ śubhadāḥ sarvapuruṣārthapradā rame ||46|| brahmapriyāyai vidmahe haripriyāyai dhīmahi | tanno brāhmī pracodayāt ||47|| nārāyaṇyai vidmahe vāsudevyai ca dhīmahi | vaiṣṇavī naḥ pracodayāt ||48|| mahālakṣmyai ca vidmahe viṣṇupatnyai ca dhīmahi | tanno lakṣmīḥ pracodayāt ||49|| hiraṇyavarṇāyai vidmahe śriyai hariṇyai dhīmahi | tanno lakṣmīḥ pracodayāt ||3.69.50|| mahāmbikāyai vidmahe pārvatyai satyai dhīmahi | tanno gaurī pracodayāt ||51|| mahāsāvitryai vidmahe vedagāyatryai dhīmahi | tanno vāṇī pracodayāt ||52|| sukhadālakṣmyai vidmahe śivarājñīśriyai dhīmahi | tannaḥ kārṣṇī pracodayāt ||53|| nārāyaṇyai vidmahe māṇikyāyai dhīmahi | tanno rādhā pracodayāt ||54|| nārāyaṇyai vidmahe ramādevyai dhīmahi | tanno lakṣmīḥ pracodayāt ||55|| nārāyaṇyai vidmahe padmāvatyai dhīmahi | tanno vibhvī pracodayāt ||96|| nārāyaṇyai vidmahe ramādevyai dhīmahi | tannaḥ prabhvī pracodayāt ||97|| dharmadevāya vidmahe bhaktidevyai dhīmahi | tanno hariḥ pracodayāt ||58|| ityetā dvādaśagāyatryaśca lakṣmi tavābhidhāḥ | dharmārthakāmamokṣākhyapumarthasampradāḥ śubhāḥ ||59|| ityevaṃ sakalā mantrāḥ śataṃ ca daśa paṃca ca | pañcadaśordhvaśataśaktidevatā madātmakāḥ ||3.69.60|| rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ te’tra parameśaparāyaṇam | japitvā tānnaro nārī caikaṃ vā manumityapi ||61|| yāyāt svargātparaṃ svargaṃ dhāmno dhāma parātparam | utsavādutsavāḍhyaṃ cānandānandasaṃbhṛtam ||62|| puruṣottamato devaḥ paro nāsti pramuktidaḥ | mama sevā tataḥ kāryā puruṣottamasaṃjñinaḥ ||63|| mama mantrāḥ sadā japyā yathāśakti divāniśam | mama dīkṣā grahītavyā dhāryāṇyaṃkāni me sadā ||64|| tattvaṃ nārāyaṇaścāhaṃ vāsudevastathā tvaham | paramātmā parabrahma parajyotiḥ pareśvaraḥ ||65|| viṣṇuḥ parātparaścāhaṃ kṛṣṇo vai puruṣottamaḥ | śāśvatātmāntarātmā ca sākṣī cāhaṃ janārdanaḥ ||66|| hṛṣīkeśastathā yajñaścāhaṃ līlāpatiḥ prabhuḥ | sarvamūrdhā sarvacakṣuḥ sarvapād bhagavānaham ||67|| viśvātmā śrīpatiścāhaṃ savitā ramaṇo’pyaham| sarveśvaraśca sarvajño jagannātho’hameva ca ||68|| sarvavidyāntarastho’haṃ sarvāyudhadharo’pyaham | sarvaśāstā sarvacetyaścāhaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||69|| mama cihnaṃ prasiddhaṃ vai cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ śubham | ūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ ca tilakaṃ śaṃkhādīni tathāpi ca ||3.69.70 || dhāraṇīyāni bhaktena pūjyo’haṃ puruṣottamaḥ | śaṃkhacakrādicihnāḍhyaḥ kuryānme pūjanaṃ priye ||71|| dhārayitvaiva cihnāni brahmakarma samācaret || bāhvordhārayitā dhartā yāti matparamaṃ padam ||72|| aṃkayitvā japanmantraṃ bhavapāśātpramucyate | sudarśanayutaṃ bhaktaṃ śrāddhādau bhojayet satī ||73|| pitaro nityatṛptā vai bhavanti vaiṣṇavāśanāt | dadyādgobhūhiraṇyādi cakrāṃkitabhujāya vai ||74|| cakrāṃkitāḥ pāpamuktāḥ prayānti matparaṃ padam | cakrādyairaṃkite dehe pāvane vaiṣṇave priye ||75|| sarvatīrthāni yajñāśca vasanti muktakoṭayaḥ | mantrasiddhyai ca pūjārthaṃ cakraṃ dhāryaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||76|| vaiṣṇavatvasya siddhyarthaṃ jñānasiddhyai viśeṣataḥ | mama bhṛtyatvasiddhyarthaṃ cakraṃ dhāryaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||77|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmarekhā bāhvornyaset sadā | mīnaśūladhvajadhanurbāṇasvastikadaṇḍakān ||78|| rekhātmakānnyasennityaṃ cāndanān taptakām̐śca vā | pavitracakrarekhāḍhyāstareyuḥ pātakāmbudhim ||79|| pavitraṃ caraṇaṃ nemirhareścakraṃ sudarśanam | tena taptaśarīrā vai prayānti mama dhāma ha ||3.69.80|| śuddhena vahnitaptena brahma tena punīhi naḥ | yatte pavitramarcivadagne tena punīhi naḥ ||81|| yena devā pavitreṇa ātmānaṃ punate sadā | tena sahasradhāreṇa pāvamānyaḥ punantu mām ||82|| prājāpatyaṃ pavitraṃ tacchatodyāmaṃ hiraṇmayam | vayaṃ brahmavidastena pūtaṃ brahma punīmahe ||83 || sanemicakraṃ satataṃ cākṣarasya mahātmanaḥ | tasmim̐ścakravṛte dehe mahonnatipadaṃ yayau ||84|| evaṃ mamaiva vākyāni śrutayo me vadantyapi | rekhāstā vidhivad dhāryā śaṃkhacakrādihetayaḥ ||85|| kalatrāpatyabhṛtyādyairdhāryāśca paśubhistathā | vṛkṣavallyādibhiścāpi gṛhārāmādibhistathā ||86|| yānavāhanapeṭādyairdhāryā rekhādihetayaḥ | āntare mama mūrtiśca bāhye cihnāni me tathā ||87|| ananyabhaktiyogaśca sarvārpaṇādipūrvakaḥ | kartavyaścāpi dhāryaśca te me dāsā hi vaiṣṇavāḥ ||88|| urdhvapuṇḍraṃ tathā bhāle lakṣmyā bindvyā yutaṃ caret | lakṣmi sākaṃ tvayā cāhamūrdhvapuṇḍre vasāmi vai ||89|| ūrdhvapuṇḍrayuto deho mama divyaṃ hi mandiram | ūrdhvapuṇḍrayutaḥ snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu vidyate ||3.69.90|| dīkṣitaḥ sarvayajñeṣu sarvalokeṣu pūjitaḥ | vimānavaramāruhya yāti me paramaṃ padam ||9 1|| ūrdhvapuṇḍradharaṃ bhaktaṃ dṛṣṭvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate | namaskṛtyāthavā bhaktyā sarvadānaphalaṃ labhet ||92|| śrāddhe’sya bhojane kalpakoṭitṛptiṃ prayānti vai | pitaro’sya gayāśrāddhakṛtaṃ phalamavāpnuyuḥ ||93|| yajñadānatapaścaryājapahomādyanantakam | puṇyavajjāyate cordhvapuṇḍrabhālasya yoginaḥ ||94|| ekāntino mahābhāgāḥ sādhavo brahmacāriṇaḥ | sāntarālaṃ prakuryurvai puṇḍraṃ mama padākṛti ||95|| mama padākṛti puṇḍraṃ mandiraṃ me sacandrakam | madhye tiṣṭhāmi bhāle’haṃ śriyā sākaṃ tvayā hariḥ ||96|| puṇḍraṃ kuryurjanā nityaṃ kṛṣṇasālokyasiddhaye | tīrthamṛdā candanena kuṃkumena draveṇa vā || 97|| jalādyairvā prakuryuśca hyūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ sacandrakam | dhṛtvā puṇḍrāṇi cāṃgeṣu mama sāyujyamāpnuyuḥ ||98|| lalāṭe māṃ hariṃ dhyāyen nārāyaṇamathodare | vakṣaḥsthale śriyaṃ dhyāyet kaṇṭhe śrīpuruṣottamam ||99|| bāhvornaraṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ kandhare māṇikīpatim | pārśvayoḥ śrībhūpatiṃ māṃ pṛṣṭhe janārdanaṃ tu mām || 3.69.1 00|| karayośca ramāpadmāvatīnāthaṃ smareddhi mām | evaṃ dvādaśapuṇḍrāṇi bhakto me dhārayet sadā || 10 1|| mahābhāgavatī nārī mahābhāgavato naraḥ | ūrdhvapuṇḍrasucandrāḍhyo matsvarūpo na saṃśayaḥ || 1 02|| evaṃ lakṣmi mayoktā vai mantrāḥ sahordhvapuṇḍrakāḥ | sacandrakāśca te sarve tulasīmālikāyutāḥ || 1 03|| matsmṛtiprasahitāśca bhavanti matpradapradāḥ | narā nārāyaṇā nāryo nārāyaṇyo bhavanti vai || 1 04|| kimvadhikaṃ pravaktavyaṃ mama priyā bhavanti vai | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya mokṣamārgo bhavet dhruvaḥ || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mahāmantrādigāyatryādisacandrakordhvapuṇḍrādimahimanirūpaṇanāmā navaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 69 ||
<3.70> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ grāhayet sadgurormanūn | sahasraśākhādhyāyī ca sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ || 1 || tāpaso vipravaryo’pi na guruḥ syādavaiṣṇavaḥ | mahābhāgavato yaśca mama dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 2 || bhaktimārgapradeṣṭā vaiṣṇavo gururbhaved budhaḥ | ācāryaḥ sadguruḥ sādhurbhavabandhavidārakaḥ || 3 || tasmānmantrān hi gṛhṇīyādoṃkārasahitān śuciḥ | ādau sarvatra mantrāṇāṃ yojayet praṇavaṃ prabhum || 4 || oṃkāro’haṃ paravrahma praṇavo mantranāyakaḥ | omityekākṣaraṃ pūrvaṃ caturthyantā mamābhidhā || 5 || tataśca dvyakṣaraṃ nāma namaḥ ityevaṃ pūrayedapi | oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanandajāya namaḥ evaṃ vaded guruḥ || 6 || mantracatuṣṭayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mantradaśakamuttamam | sapta dvādaśa ca dve ca gāyatryaścottamā mama || 7 || trayodaśa tathā mantrāstrayaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ sadā mama | trayastriṃśadavatāramantrāḥ śreṣṭhāstathā mama || 8 || trayostriṃśacchriyo mantrāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ sarve matā mama | eko vā sarva evāpi hyaneke vā yatheṣṭakam || 9 || grāhyā mantrā hi śiṣyeṇa guruḥ parīkṣya vārpayet | pañcadaśordhvaśatamantradevo’smi hariḥ svayam || 3.70.1 0|| trayastriṃśanmama mantrāścānye madrūpavarṇinaḥ | rūparūpitādātmyādvai yujyante mayi sarvaśaḥ || 11 || yo bhakto yatsvarūpasya tanmantraṃ śṛṇuyād guroḥ | parabrahmataroḥ śākhāḥ śataṃ ca daśa paṃca ca || 12|| tāni tāni ca rūpāṇi tattanmantraiḥ prapūjya ca | ārādhya matsvarūpāṇi yāsyantyeva hi māṃ harim || 13|| parabrahmasampradāyāḥ sarve meṃ’gāni padmaje | madutpannamidaṃ sarvaṃ matto naivātiricyate || 14|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe protā mayīśvarāḥ | avatārāstathā muktā jīvāḥ protā harau mayi || 15|| avatāriṇya evemāḥ śaktayo mayi saṃsthitāḥ | sarvā mantrasvarūpiṇyaḥ protā mayi harau prabhau || 16|| itivijñāya mantrāṇāṃ śataṃ paṃcadaśādhikam | vidvān vijñāya dadyādvai viduṣe tvadhikāriṇe || 17|| sa syād ācāryasamrāṭ vai sarvamantraprado guruḥ | parabrahmasampradāyācāryasamrāṭa nigadyate || 18|| nyūnamantrapradā nyūnā ācāryāste bhavanti vai | svataḥprakāśobhagavān sthāpyate vai mayā guruḥ || 19|| parabrahmasampradāyācāryasamrāṭ manupradaḥ | sarvamanūpadeṣṭā sa matsvarūpo bhavatyapi ||3.70.20|| tvaṃ lakṣmīśca tathā gurvī sthāpyate vai mayā priye | parabrahmasampradāyācāryasamrājñī mantradā ||21|| sarvamanūpadeṣṭrī tvaṃ matsvarūpātmikā hyasi | kiṃ ca lakṣmi śṛṇu cānyanmantre yannāma vidyate ||22|| sa tanmanostathācāryaḥ, madaṃśo vartate sadā | sā tanmanostathācāryāṇī ca bodhyā madājñayā |||23|| evaṃ manūn niyuñjīta gṛhṇīyācca gurormukhāt| | sabījo’yaṃ bhavenmantro gurostaijasabhāsuraḥ ||24|| daivabalo gurorbalī manurmokṣaprado bhavet | śiṣyabalo’dhikaḥ syādvai manurbhuktipramuktidaḥ ||25|| bījaṃ sarvatra mantreṣu kṛṣṇakānto’hameva tu | nityānapāyinī śaktiḥ śrīrlakṣmīrvidyate manau ||26|| oṃkāro me’bhidhānaṃ śri akārāhaṃ pareśvaraḥ | ukāraḥ śrīstvamevāsi makāro bhakta eva me ||27|| akāro’haṃ parātmā ca ukāraśceśvarā matāḥ | makāraśca jīvavṛndā tadātmā oṃ mato mama ||28|| akāraścāniruddhaśca ukārastu pradyamnakaḥ | makāraḥ saṃkarṣaṇastredhā omityahaṃ śrīhariḥ ||29|| akāraśca svayaṃ viṣṇurukāraḥ śaṃkarastathā | makāraśca viśvasṛḍ vai tredhāhaṃ parameśvaraḥ ||3.70.3 0|| akāraścākṣaraṃ brahma ukāro muktakoṭayaḥ | makāraścāvatārā me tredhāhaṃ puruṣottamaḥ ||3 1 || akāro brahmasṛṣṭirme ukāraśceśvarasṛjiḥ | makāro jīvasṛṣṭiśca tredhāhaṃ parameśvaraḥ ||32|| akāro’haṃ parabrahma uśca brahmapriyā mama | maśca haripriyāḥ sarvāstredhāhaṃ paramaḥ prabhuḥ ||33|| ahaṃ svāmī svāminī tvaṃ śeṣā dāsāstathā pare | evaṃ me vidyate hārdaṃ praṇavārthe hi dāsatā ||34|| dāsā dāsyo mama bhaktāḥ paratantrāḥ sadā mama | dehendriyamano’haṃdhīguṇā bhaktasya me vaśāḥ ||35|| mayyarpitā hi te divyā mattantrā matprajīvanāḥ | ato mama padasthasya madicchādhīnavartanam ||36|| mamaiva sarvasaṃkalpāt prārabdhaṃ tasya vidyate | mamaiva lakṣmi sāmarthyānnālabhyaṃ tasya vidyate ||37|| mayyarpitabharaḥ śrīśe matkarmaiva samācaret | paramātmā hyahaṃ svāmī bhaktastu dāsa eva me ||38|| icchayā viniyoktavyo bhaved dāso hi sarvadā | dāsī bhṛtyā kiṃkarī ca niyoktavyā mamāśritā ||39|| mamāhaṃ matsvarūpau vai mama bhaktasya netarau | tasmād dehādibandhaiḥ sa mukto nityo mamāśrayāt ||3.70.40 || kurvannapi hi karmāṇi matkṛtānyeva tāni vai | na lepaṃ labhate taiśca bhakto me bandhavarjitaḥ ||41 || māyā bhaktasya me divyā bhaktaṃ rañjayati dhruvam | ānandayati divyā sā mokṣārthaṃ yojayatyapi ||42||| evaṃ lakṣmi mama manormāhātmyamudita tava | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ cākṣarādhipaḥ ||43|| puruṣottamasaṃjño’haṃ cāvatārī pareśvaraḥ | parameśvara evāhaṃ paramātmā sanātanaḥ ||44|| pūrṇabrahma parabrahma bhagavān sarvakāraṇam | mamāvatārāḥ kṛṣṇādyā vāsudevādayo’pi ca ||45|| bhūmādayo’pīśvarāśca rādhālakṣmyādiśaktayaḥ | mamāṃśā viṣṇurudrājā devāścāṃśakalāṃśakāḥ ||46|| mānavādyāstadaṃśāśca tiryañcaḥ pādapāstathā | kiṃcidaṃśāṃśasaṃbhūtāḥ sṛṣṭayaḥ santi caiva me ||47|| tatra nārāyaṇaścāhaṃ nārā ityātmasaṃhatiḥ | tatrāyanaṃ karomyeva tato nārāyaṇo’smyaham ||48|| narājjāteṣu tattveṣu vāsī nārāyaṇo’smyaham | nāre carācare loke’ntaḥstho nārāyaṇo’smyaham ||49|| sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt | yasmānmattaḥ samutpannaḥ so’haṃ vai parameśvaraḥ ||3.70.50|| yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyaṃ ca yasmāt sarvaṃ pareśvarāt | amṛtatvasya ceśānaḥ so’haṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||5 1 || vāsudevo yato bhāti hiraṇyagarbha ityapi | savitā ca yato bhāti so’haṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||52|| vedādiśca parā vāṇī yasya bhāṣā susaṃskṛtā | svaro yasya prakaṇṭhādvai so’haṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||53|| paramātmā tu yaścāste māyī ca māyayārcitaḥ | māyeśo māyayā śūnyaḥ so’haṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||54|| pāde sṛṣṭistripāde cākṣaraṃ dhāmāsti yasya vai | bhūlīlāśrīpatiryo’sti so’haṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||55|| yajñanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ sarvanārāyaṇo’smi ca | bhinnanārāyaṇarūpaḥ so’haṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||56|| yanmūrtermūrtayaḥ santi viprādyā mānavāḥ surāḥ | candraḥ sūryo’gnirdyurvidyut so’haṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||57|| etādṛśasya me dāsyaṃ naranārībhirādarāt | mantraṃ labdhvā prakartavyaṃ rahasyaṃ mokṣadaṃ hi tat ||58||| viśvataḥ pāṇipādo’haṃ cakṣuṣmān viśvatastathā | viśvāni bhuvanānyeva dhāmāni tvapi santi me ||59|| evaṃ bṛhatsvarūpo’haṃ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | īśvaryā vai tvayā sākaṃ divyamaṃgalarūpavān ||3.70.60|| bṛhaddeho mānavarjyo yuvā hariḥ patistava | reme reme tvayā lakṣmyā śriyā sākaṃ hi śāśvataḥ ||6 1|| ahaṃ jagajjananyā vai kumāro nityayauvanaḥ | kandarpāṃrbudalāvaṇyastiṣṭhāmi parame pade ||62|| muktisthānaṃ paraṃ vyoma muktamuktānikāśritam | śāśvatānandasaukhyādisaṃbhṛtaṃ cākṣaraṃ mama ||63|| golokaścāpi vaikuṇṭho’vyākṛto’mṛta ityapi | bhogārthāni hi dhāmāni mayā kṛtāni santi vai ||64|| hiraṇmayāstathā vairājādyāśca māyikāstathā | sādāśaivā vaiṣṇavāśca prādhānikāścabhūmayaḥ ||65|| āvaraṇāni sarvāṇi satyādimānavādayaḥ | pātālāntāśca līlāyāḥ krīḍāsaubhāgyasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||66|| sarve lokā mama krīḍālīlādyarthā mayā kṛtāḥ | bhoge nityā sthitirme dhāmasvavatārarūpiṇaḥ ||67|| līlāṃ tu saṃhare lakṣmi māyāmayaṃ hi tad yataḥ | tripādvyāpyakṣaraṃ dhāma paramaṃ me hi śāśvatam ||68|| tripād vibhūtirnityā sā tatra dhāmāni yāni me | golokādīni sarvāṇi nityānyeva parāṇi hi ||69|| pādo’syaiśvarajaivādilokā anityasaṃjñakāḥ | līlātmakā hi te sarve krīḍārthaṃ vai mayā kṛtāḥ ||3.70.70|| nitye’kṣare ca goloke vaikuṇṭhe’vyākṛte’mṛte | acyutaḥ śāśvato divyaḥ sadā yauvanamāśritaḥ ||71|| tiṣṭhāmyanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇaśca tathā nārāyaṇo bhūmā tathā prabhuḥ ||72|| vāsudevaḥ sadā lakṣmi tava rūpaiḥ samanvitaḥ | muktānikābrahmapriyāharipriyābhiḥ saṃyutaḥ ||73|| rādhāvirajāgopībhirgoloke mama śaktibhiḥ | lakṣmīhariṇīkamalādisevito vikuṇṭhake ||74|| ramāśrīpārṣadānībhiḥ sevito’vyākṛte prabhuḥ | vāsudevīpadminībhiḥ sevito’mṛtadhāmani ||75|| muktairgopaiḥ sevakaiśca pārṣadairabhisevitaḥ | avatārasvarūpo’haṃ bhinnarūpo vasāmi vai ||76|| nityasaṃbhogamīśvaryā śriyā lakṣmyā ca rādhayā | tvayā ca ramayā vāsudevyā kamalayā saha ||77|| vinde’haṃ sarvadā lakṣmi bhūmyā ca divyayā sadā | nityā sā tvaṃ jaganmātā mama śrīranapāyinī ||78|| sarvagatā sadā vibhvī hīśānāṃ jagatāṃ sadā | sarvataḥ pāṇipādāḍhyā sarvato’kṣiśiromukhī ||79|| parameśī jaganmātā nārāyaṇī hiraṇmayī | tvattanāvāsthitaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṃgamam ||3.70.80|| jagatsthitilayau syātāṃ tavonmīlanamīlanāt | sarvasyādyā mahābrāhmī mahālakṣmīḥ pareśvarī ||8 1 || lakṣyālakṣyasvarūpā tvaṃ kṛtsnaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitā | vibhūtistvaṃ pare dhāmni rādhā golokavāsinī ||82||| lakṣmīrvaikuṇṭhavāsā ca ramāvyākṛtavāsinī | padmāmṛtanivāsā ca vibhūtiścākṣarī mama ||83|| īśvarāṇāṃ ca lokeṣu jīvānāmaṇḍakeṣu ca | līlaiśvaryavapustvaṃ vai bhavasi bhūmikātmikāḥ ||84|| īśvarāṇāṃ bhūmayaścālayāḥ prāsādakoṭayaḥ | smṛddhayo vāṭikāḥ kṣetradivyaviṣayabhūmayaḥ ||85|| bhavatyeva bhavatīti līlā me sarvasampadaḥ | āvaraṇāni tattvāni tvaṃ sādāśaivagāni ca ||86|| vaiṣṇavāni ca tattvāni māyikānyapi yāni ca | hairaṇmayāni tattvāni vairājādīni yāni ca ||87|| satyādidyunivāsāni mānavānyapi yāni ca | pātāleṣu tathā yāni tattvāni bhogabhūmayaḥ ||88|| jalabhūtaijasavāyumayāni yāni santi ca | tāni sarvāṇi te lakṣmi līlārūpāṇi santi vai ||89|| rūparasagandhasparśarūpā tvaṃ svararūpiṇī | lakṣmīrūpatvamāpannā dhanadravyādināmikā ||3.70.90|| evaṃ jagatsvarūpā tvaṃ jagataḥ śrīḥ śritā himām | vedā vedyaṃ samastaṃ vai tava rūpaṃ hi padmaje ||91|| strīrūpamakhilaṃ lakṣmi tava rūpaṃ vapustava | saundaryaṃ śīlamaujjvalyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ mārdavaṃ sukham ||92|| lāvaṇyaṃ cāpi saugandhyaṃ cākarṣaṇaṃ rasādikam | tavaivaṃ rūpaṃ kamale sarvanārīṣu saṃsthitam ||93|| brāhmī nārāyaṇīśrīścākṣarī muktānikā ramā | brahmapriyā ca kamalā haripriyā ca māṇikī ||94|| rādhā lakṣmīḥ parāvidyā ramā śrīśca narāyaṇī | vidyā sarasvatī mātā vaiṣṇavī padminī satī ||95|| padmā ca padmajā cābdhiputrī raṃbhā ca rādhikā | bhūrlīlā sukhadālakṣmīrhariṇī mādhavīśvarī ||96|| gaurī kārṣṇī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇī svāhā svadhā ratiḥ | sampat smṛddhirvāsudevī virajā ca hiraṇmayī ||97|| bhārgavī śivarājñīśrī rāmā śrīkāntavallabhā | etāni tava nāmāni sadā prātaḥ paṭheddhi yaḥ ||98|| sa smṛddhiṃ mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ śriyamāpnotyanāśinīm | hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīṃ suvarṇarajatasrajām ||99|| jyotsnāṃ hiraṇmayīṃ lakṣmīṃ vindate matsvarūpiṇīm | utkṛṣṭagandharūpādisvarūpāṃ puṣṭivardhinīm || 3.70.100|| tava dātā prabhuḥ śrīmān puruṣottama eva ca | paranārāyaṇaḥ svāmī vātsalyakaruṇārṇavaḥ || 10 1|| suśīlaḥ subhagaḥ pūrṇakāmaśca sarvaśaktimān | svargāpavargasukhadaḥ śaraṇaṃ sarvadehinām || 1 02|| so’haṃ me dāsabhaktāya dāsyai sākaṃ tvayāpyaham | māṃ cārpayāmi deveśi parasparātmaveditām || 1 03|| śrīmannārāyaṇaḥ svāmī śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so’haṃ gatiḥ parā || 1 04|| śaraṇaṃ mandiraṃ vāso bandhuḥ pitā patiḥ suhṛt | mātā bhrātā rakṣitā ca pālako jagatāṃ prabhuḥ || 1 05|| kalyāṇaguṇavān śrīśaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ | prākṛtaguṇaśūnyo’haṃ nirguṇo divyamūrtimān || 1 06|| divyāsaṃkhyaguṇaiśvaryarūpalāvaṇyasaṃyutaḥ | amṛte śāśvate divye’nante’kṣare pare pade || 107|| nivasāmi brahmaloke brahmānandasukhānvite | atitejomaye śuddhe pralayādivivarjite || 1 08|| asaṃkhye cājare nitye jāgratsvapnādivarjite | samānādhikarahite’ntādyavirahite śubhe || 1 09|| atisarvotkṛṣṭatejobhṛte cānandasāgare | yadakṣaraṃ vedavedyaṃ yasmin devāḥ sādhyā niṣeduḥ || 3.70.1 10|| adhiviśve niṣeduśca devā vidustadāsate | tadakṣaraṃ me paramaṃ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ || 111 || yatra gāvo bhūriśṛṃgā ayāsa āsate’bhitaḥ | te ha nākasya mahimānaṃ viduḥ sādhyayoginaḥ || 1 12|| tiṣṭhāmastatra satataṃ yuvānau śrīnarāyaṇau | yatra svasāro yuvatyastvadādyā mama vallabhāḥ || 1 13|| tatprāpya na nivartante paramākṣaradhāma me | etanmokṣapadaṃ divyaṃ prayānti mantravedinaḥ || 1 14|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mahāmantragūḍhārthajñānaprāpyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 70 ||
<3.71> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ tripādvibhūtivistaram | asaṃkhyātāni dhāmāni śuddhasattvamayāni vai || 1 || brahmānandasukhāḍhyāni nityāni tāni santi ha | nirvikārāṇi sarvāṇi heyādirahitāni ca || 2 || divyahiraṇmayānyeva śuddhāni taijasāni ha | avatārapadāmbhojabhaktimatsevitāni vai || 3 || nityamuktairdivyarūpaiḥ puruṣaiḥ strībhirityapi | vāsitāni vanodyānasaronagaravanti ca || 4 || taddhāmānyupabhoktavyānyakṣarabrahmasevinām | svātmajānandasaukhyāni mandirāṇi bhavanti ca || 5 || niḥśreyasāni nirvāṇakaivalyāni ca yāni vai | śrīśāṃghribhaktisevaikarasabhogayutāni ha || 6 || nityamuktā mahādivyā mama pādaprasevinaḥ | sevikāśca vasantyeteṣveva nityasanātanāḥ || 7 || mantrajñāḥ paramāṇyeva yānti dhāmāni tāni vai | brahmasukhapradānyeva mama yogapradāni vai || 8 || tatra tatra sthitaścāhamavatārasvarūpavān | avatārī tvakṣare vai pare dhāmni bhavāmi ca || 9 || mahāmāyā prakṛtiryā sā māṃ stauti punaḥ punaḥ | namaste’kṣaravāsāya parameśāya te namaḥ || 3.71.1 0|| avatārasvarūpāyāvatāriṇe ca te namaḥ | māyāhaṃ bhavataḥ śaktirmāyālokāśca te prabho || 11 || īśvarāṇāmālayāśca tavaiva bhūmikāstvimāḥ | tattvāni ca samastāni tavaiva kāryakāṇi vai || 12|| purāṇapuruṣastvaṃ vai sarvakāraṇakāraṇam | śrībhūlīlāramānātha māṇikīmuktikāpate || 13 || prajñāpadmāvatīkānta namaste sukhadāpate | lakṣmīpadmāpate tubhya namo nārāyaṇāya vai || 14|| sarveśvarasvarūpāya sarvadevātmane namaḥ | anantamūrtaye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa hare namaḥ || 15|| te’cyutāya ca kāntāya parameśāya te namaḥ | sarvajñāya samastāya gopālātmaja te namaḥ || 16|| sarvasṛṣṭyātmane tubhyaṃ namaste paramātmane | brahmaṇe jyotiṣe tubhyaṃ namaste śucivarcase || 17|| prasavitre namaḥ pitre sargasthityantahetave | nārāyaṇāya ca namaḥ sarvātmāntaravartine || 18|| anantadivyaguṇavan namaḥ pumarthadāyine | vyūharūpāya ca namaḥ pañcāvasthasvarūpiṇe || 1 9|| prasīda bhagavan viṣṇo sarvalokahitāya vai | ātmāno jñānahīnā vai nirākārā nirindriyāḥ ||3.71.20|| sarvānuṣṭhānarahitā vartante ca nirāśrayāḥ | teṣāṃ lokām̐śca dehām̐śca dātumarhasi vai mayi ||21 || līlāvibhūtiṃ śrīkṛṣṇa yathāpūrvaṃ prakalpaya | cetanācetanaṃ kṛtsnaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam ||22|| paśya līnaṃ māyikaṃ vai mayi suptaṃ prabodhaya | prakṛtyā vai mayā sārdhaṃ sṛjasva parameśvara || 23|| dharmādharmau sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhāvayitvā mayi prabho | māmadhiṣṭhāya vai līlāṃ śriyā kartuṃ tvamarhasi ||24|| ityevaṃ cārthitaścāhaṃ lakṣmi pūrve hi māyayā | tasyāmeva hi māyāyāṃ jagat sraṣṭuṃ pracakrame ||25|| svecchayā dhāmamukto vai puruṣo yuyuje tayā | prakṛtipūruṣaḥ proktastasmāt pradhānapūruṣaḥ || 26|| pradhānaṃ vai mahattattvaṃ buddhirityevamīśvarī | pradhānapuruṣāttasmādahaṃkāraḥ prajāyate ||27|| so’yaṃ hiraṇyagarbho vai mahāviṣṇurnigadyate | tasmānmanaḥ prabhavati tanmātrāṇīndriyāṇi ca ||28|| ṣoḍaśako gaṇaḥ so’yaṃ vairājo nāma pūruṣaḥ | vairājājjāyanta īśā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ||29|| brahmā pṛthvī jalaṃ viṣṇuḥ rudrastejo mahattaram | prāṇo’nilo’tha hṛdayaṃ gaganaṃ khaṃ vyajāyata ||3.71.3 0|| ebhyaḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitaraḥ surā bhūtāśca mānavāḥ | asurā dānavā daityā nāgāḥ sarpāśca sṛṣṭayaḥ ||3 1|| tiryañco jantavaḥ sarve vyajāyanta yathāyatham | sarve karmānusāreṇa yujyante yogyayoniṣu ||32|| sadā sthitā hi prakṛtau prabhavantocchayā hareḥ | evaṃ lakṣmi mama līlāṃ māyāmayīṃ vibhāvaya ||33|| tvameva sā mahāmāyā divyā madyogamāśritā | matsvarūpā mamecchaiva śaktistvaṃ sarvarūpiṇī ||34|| mama cārdhāṃganā brāhmī nārāyaṇī maheśvarī | mahālakṣmīrvāsudevī vaiṣṇavī kamalā ramā ||35|| rādhā lakṣmīḥ priyā kāntā śrīstvaṃ sukhapradā sadā | sarvasṛṣṭisthajīvānāmudbhavādividhāyinī ||36|| mama śaktiṃ vinā sṛṣṭernonmeṣo vidyate kvacit | ato yāvajjagatprāṇamayī tvaṃ parameśvarī ||37|| prāṇāyāḥ prāṇarūpo’haṃ patiste parameśvaraḥ | sarvasadguṇapūrṇo’haṃ parameśaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||38|| śrīkṛṣṇo’haṃ bhavāmyeva rādhākāmaprapūrtaye | nārāyaṇo bhavāmyeva lakṣmīkāmaprapūrtaye ||39|| vāsudevo bhavāmyeva paripūrṇastrirūpadhṛk | pradyumnamūrtistasmādvai sarvaiśvaryasamanvitā ||3.71.40 || bhūmnaścāpīśvarāṇāṃ ceśvareśānāṃ prabhuḥ khaniḥ | kālasyāpi śāsakaśca sṛṣṭiṃ caiśīṃ karoti hi ||41 || antaryāmitvamāpanno mahākālānuveśitaḥ | harerme prabalaiśvaryaṃ mahākālasvarūpadhṛk ||42|| prabalo mama saṃkalpaścaiśvaryaṃ kālakāraṇam | mahākālasya putro vai kālasaṃjño bhavatyapi ||43|| tadantarbhāvamāsādyāniruddho lokasarjakaḥ | mama jñānaṃ dadau tasmai nityavedātmakaṃ purā ||44|| aniruddhasyāṃśabhāgā brahmāṇaḥ saṃbhavanti hi | vāsudevāttataścānyaḥ pradyumnaḥ saṃvyajāyata ||45|| macchaktitejaaiśvaryānvitaḥ pālanakarmakṛt | aiśīṃ sṛṣṭiṃ pālayati sthitiṃ sañcālayatyayam ||46|| tadaṃśātmā viṣṇurūpaḥ pāti sarvaṃ jaganmuhuḥ | vāsudevāttato jātaḥ saṃkarṣaṇo vināśakṛt ||47|| vidyābalāstraśastrādiyuto yadaṃśasaṃbhavāḥ | rudrādyā nāśakarmāṇo bhavanti sṛṣṭilopakāḥ ||48|| evamete madaṃśā vai lakṣmi sadā bhavanti hi | tadaṃśāścāpi tatpatnyo bhavanti mama vāñcchayā ||49|| matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaśca narasiṃho’tha vāmanaḥ | rāmo rāmaśca kṛṣṇaśca buddhaḥ kalkiśca te daśa ||3.71.50|| avatārā mama lakṣmi jāyante sarvasṛṣṭiṣu | mama kāryakarā ete āvaśyakānubhāvinaḥ ||51|| ahaṃ bhavāmyavatārī svecchayā sahitastvayā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||52|| mama bhaktyā mama ghāmākṣaraṃ padaṃ prayānti vai | avatārarūpabhaktyā golokādi prayānti vai ||53 || gatvā caiṣu na vai muktā nivartante samā mayā | matsamānasukhāḥ sarve yathā tvaṃ sukhinastathā ||54|| madicchayā prajāyante lokakalyāṇahetave | na karmabandhanaṃ janma manmuktānāṃ hi bhūtale ||55|| mama cānucaratvaṃ hi mokṣa eva na cetaraḥ | mama dāsyaṃ bandhanaṃ vai sadāsukhaṃ sadākṣaram ||56|| punaste mama dhāmasthā yāsyanti dhāma cecchayā | brahmapriyā mahāmuktā haridāsā nirāmayāḥ ||57|| anye’pi karmabandhasthā mantraṃ labdhvā mamāpi vai | viṣamiśrāśanaṃ lokasukhaṃ tyaktvā bhajanti cet ||58|| māmeva te prapadyante nāmakīrtanapūjanaiḥ | bhaktyā tvananyayā māṃ saṃbhajeyuḥ karuṇālayam ||59|| rakṣāmi tānparamātmā bhaktavātsalyaśevadhiḥ | nayāmi vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma sahasrasūryaraśmini ||3.71.60|| vimāne tāmavasthāpya bhagavān śrīhariḥ svayam | mama mantraprajaptṝn vai mama bhaktiparāyaṇān ||6 1 || śrīpateḥ śrīharerme’tra mantroccāraṇamuttamam | sarvāmṛtamayaṃ divyamauṣadhaṃ paramauṣadham ||62|| sarvodvegādiśamanaṃ māyāpāśaharaṃ param | hyetadrasāyanaṃ divyaṃ māyāgadaharaṃ śubham ||63|| vidyamāne kṛṣṇamantre mahauṣadhe’tra bhūtale | mānavā nopagṛhṇanti hāniḥ sā mahatī matā ||64|| pūrvasañcitaduṣṭāste bhramamāyāntare sthitāḥ | ye pibanti na vai mūḍhā harināmarasāyanam ||65|| haripūjopacāreṇa dhyānena sevayā ca me | satyadāsyena dānena kāyātmaśuddhisaṃbhavaḥ ||66|| tato vāso hṛdaye me tathātmani nirantaram | mandiraṃ bhaktahṛdayaṃ kṛtvā nayāmi dhāma me ||67|| lakṣmi brahmapriyāḥ sarvā haripriyāstathāparāḥ | śṛṇvantu mama līlādyā juṣantāṃ māṃ priyaṃ patim ||68|| vrajantu supathaṃ me ca bhāvaiḥ sarvaiḥ samarpitaiḥ | sevābhirjñānavijñānairdhyānaistapobhirityapi ||69|| vratairyajñaiśca dānaiśca śṛṃgāraiścandanādibhiḥ | hāvabhāvavilāsaiśca bhajantāṃ māṃ priyaṃ patim ||3.71.70|| paśyantu māṃ ca sarvatra śuṣkeṣvārdreṣu sarvadā | sthāvareṣu jaṃgameṣu bhūmāvabhreṣu mūrtiṣu ||71 || svakāryeṣu paravarṣmasvapi māṃ puruṣottamam | māmuddiśya dadatvapi dānāni vividhāni ca ||72|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ japata māṃ sadā | yajadhvaṃ māṃ ca manmantraṃ smarantu sārthakaṃ ca mām ||73 || pibantu vaiṣṇavarasaṃ mantrāmṛtaṃ pibantu ca | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāmṛtaṃ pibantu ca ||74|| ājñāmṛtaṃ premarasaṃ sevārasaṃ pibantu ca | muktirasaṃ kāntarasaṃ kāntāḥ sarvāḥ pibantu ca ||75|| bhaktirasaṃ yogarasaṃ cātmarasaṃ pibantu ca | brahmarasaṃ dāsyarasaṃ priyarasaṃ pibantu ca ||76|| sneharasaṃ tānarasaṃ sarvarasān pibantu ca | arcayantu sadā kāntaṃ dhyāyantu madhusūdanam ||77|| gāyantu māṃ mahākṛṣṇaṃ japantu śrīhariṃ sadā | tapyantāṃ mama toṣārthaṃ maddhyānā matparāyaṇāḥ ||78|| evaṃ yā ye kariṣyanti bhaktiṃ madarthikāṃ bhuvi | tāste vai mānavādyāstu sarve bhāgavatāḥ parāḥ ||79|| mama prabhāvato lakṣmi pūjāstotramanugṛṇāḥ | ādhihīnā bhavantyeva bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||3.71.80|| vītaśokāśca puṇyāśca bhaviṣyanti nirāmayāḥ | sarvaiśvaryasamāpannāḥ sarvarogādivarjitāḥ ||81 || amarā nirjarāścāpi dhanadhānyasamṛddhayaḥ | mama cātiprasādena putrapautrādyalaṃkṛtāḥ ||82|| mama bhaktāgārabhāge hṛdaye cāpi mānase | satyavrataṃ sadā cāste sarvaratnopadāyakam ||83|| bhaktānāṃ mantrayuktānāṃ gṛhadvāreṣu nityadā | kalpadrumā bhavantyeva sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ ||84|| sarvakāmadughā gāvaḥ sacintāmaṇayastathā | kalpalatāḥ kalpapātrāṇyāsate bhaktamandire ||85|| mama prasādato lakṣmi amarāste bhavanti ca | sarvasaubhāgyasampannāḥ puṇyamaṃgalaśobhanāḥ ||86|| dānajñānadhyānaparāyaṇā ānandasaṃbhṛtāḥ | na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhirnākālamaraṇaṃ bhavet ||87|| vaiṣṇavā yatra me bhaktā mama vrataparāyaṇāḥ | maddhyānā majjapā lakṣmi mama bhāvaparāyaṇāḥ ||88|| eṣāṃ gṛhāṇi divyāni puṇyāni mokṣadānyapi | tīrthāni samajāyante mamākṣaranibhāni vai ||89|| yadgṛheṣu gadācakradhvajadhanūṃṣi santi me | śūlamīnaśarasvastikāni cihnāni santi me ||3.71.90|| bhittibhāgeṣu sarveṣu pratimā me bhavanti ca | gṛhadvāreṣu sarveṣu puṇyasthāneṣu sarvathā ||9 1|| mama līlācaritrāṇāṃ divyacitrāṇi santi ca | tulasīrādhikālakṣmīmāṇikīpratimāyutaḥ ||92|| prajñāpadmāvatīpadmāsukhadāśrīsamanvitaḥ | ahaṃ yatra citrito vai bhavāmi parito gṛhe ||93|| abhito vaiṣṇavo bhāvo maṃgalaṃ bahu dṛśyate | viṣṇubhaktāstathā nāryo bhittiṣu citritāḥ śubhāḥ ||94|| vidyante yatra saudheṣu tīrthāni tadgṛhāṇi me | jalakrīḍāpratimāśca rādhārāsasya maṇḍalam ||95|| brahmapriyāvivāhasya pratimāścitritā gṛhe | tadgṛhaṃ divyarūpaṃ me bhaktasya muktitīrthakam ||96|| gobhiryutaṃ ca rūpaṃ me vidyādhyayanacitrakam | vimānasthaṃ citrakaṃ me yajñadīkṣādicitrakam ||97|| kuṃkumavāpikācitraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro’nvitam | lomaśāśramasaṃśobhaṃ citraṃ śrīkambharāyutam ||98|| gopālakṛṣṇacitraṃ ca sarvadevādipūjitam | bhaktarakṣākarāścāpi pratimā me śubhāspadāḥ || 99|| sarvā mokṣapradā lakṣmi tīrthaṃ manmūrtiyuggṛham | tripañcāśanmūrtayo me’vatāriṇastvayā saha || 3.71.10 0|| sarvāstā mokṣadā yeṣāṃ gṛheṣu santi padmaje | tadvaṃśavaṃśavaṃśānāṃ mokṣaḥ prajāyate dhruvaḥ || 10 1|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne tripādvibhūtiḥ, māyāprārthanayā kṛtaikapādalīlāvibhūtāvapidivyatādinirūpaṇanāmaikasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 71 ||
<3.72> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ bhajanaṃ mama mokṣadam | kṛṣṇa viṣṇo hare rāma mukunda madhūsūdana || 1 || nārāyaṇa hṛṣīkeśa puruṣottama keśava | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa lakṣmīpate prabho || 2 || padmanābhākṣaravartin cātmārāma kṛpānidhe | vāsudeva muktikeśa śrīdhara śrīpate vibho || 3 || rādhāramāpate jiṣṇo prajñāpadmāvatīpate | śrīda śrīśa śrīnivāsa mokṣakṛnmāṇikīpate || 4 || kambharānandana brahmapriyākānta janārdana | gopālabāla viśveśa sukhadāśrīpate’dhipa || 5 || prāṇeśa kāntakānteśa parameśvara mādhava | ityevamuccarantyo vai nāryo nāmāni me bhuvi || 6 || narāścāpi prayāntyeva dhāma me jaraṭhā api | bālā vṛddhāḥ kumārāśca mama nāmaparāyaṇāḥ || 7 || praṇamanti hariṃ māṃ ye gṛhakarmaratā api | āsane śayane yāne dhyāne jñāne hi māṃ ghavam || 8 || krīḍamānāḥ praṇamanti te yānti dhāma me’kṣaram | divārātrau sumadhuraṃ bruvanti yatra nāma te || 9 || kṛṣṇasya dṛśyate bhāvo yatra gṛhe bhuvastale | viṣṇulokasya samatā mama dhāmnaśca tulyatā || 3.72.1 0|| tadgṛhasya sadā lakṣmīrnātra kāryā vicāraṇā | nāntaraṃ tatra paśyāmi bhaktagṛhe’kṣarālaye || 11 || mamoccāraṃ prakurvanti nityaṃ dhāmnyakṣare mama | tathā pṛthvyāṃ mama nāma gṛṇanti yatra tadgṛham || 12|| divyaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ bodhyaṃ viśeṣo’tra na vidyate | ubhayorlokayorbhāvaḥ samastena samānatā || 13|| jarārogabhayaṃ nāsti mṛtyuhīnā yato janāḥ | yatra mannāmagānaṃ ca manmantraraṭanaṃ tathā || 14|| kimvadhikaṃ vadeyaṃ vai māyā divyā mamāśrayāt | gāvo divyā hi bhaktasya mahiṣyaśca tathā śubhāḥ || 15|| gṛhodyānāni divyāni gṛhaṃ divyaṃ śubhaṃ sadā | gṛhopakaraṇānyasya divyāni bhojanānyapi || 16|| gṛhāṃgaṇaṃ sadā divyaṃ putrapautrādayo’pi ca | sadā bhaktasya divyā vai pātrāṇi ca dhanāni ca || 18 || vṛkṣāśca vallikā divyā khaṣṭvādyāstaraṇāni ca | peṭikāmbarabhūṣādyā divyā bhaktasya me sadā || 18|| bhaktagṛhasya dhūlī ca rajāṃsyapi jalāni ca | dhānyānyapi ca divyāni yatrāhaṃ parameśvaraḥ || 1 9|| api tadgṛhabhoktāraḥ pakṣiṇaḥ paśavo’pi ca | divyā atithayaścāpi mama prasādapāvitāḥ ||3.72.20|| tīrthāni tāni sarvāṇi bhaktabhogyāni sarvathā | vastūni bhogyajātāni pāvanāni hi pāpinām ||2 1 || ityevaṃ vidyate lakṣmi pāvanaṃ mama vāsataḥ | nirguṇaṃ puṇyadaṃ mokṣapradaṃ bhaktagṛhādikam ||22| śṛṇu lakṣmi yayātervai nāhuṣasya kathānakam | mama bhaktasya loke’tra pāvanaṃ lokamokṣadam ||23|| yayātirbhagavadbhakto hyaśvamedhaśataṃ tathā | vājapeyaśataṃ cakre vaiṣṇavaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ||24|| dadāvanekarūpāṇi dānāni śraddhayā nṛpaḥ | gavāṃ lakṣasahasrāṇi tathā koṭiśatāni ca ||25|| koṭihomām̐ścakārāpi bhūmidānādikaṃ dadau | varṣāṇāṃ tu sahasrāṇi hyaśītirjīvito hi saḥ ||26|| śuśoca vai yayātiḥ sa deho’yaṃ karmabandhanaḥ | bhasmānto vā viḍanto vā mṛdanto vā bhaviṣyati ||27|| anena cārjyate pāpaṃ narakaṃ ca phalaṃ tataḥ | anena cārjyate puṇyaṃ svargaṃ rājyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||28|| anena cārjyate bhaktirmokṣo yayā bhaved dhruvaḥ | tasmāt sa eva sādhyo’tra rājye sthitvā vivekinā ||29|| vicāryetthaṃ harernāmnāmārebhe bhajanaṃ nṛpaḥ | hare kṛṣṇa hare viṣṇo kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho ||3.72.30|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa dāmodarācyuta | evaṃ bhajan nijadūtānādideśa śubhaṃ vacaḥ ||3 1|| yāntu dūtā mama rāṣṭraṃ samudrāntaṃ hi maṇḍalam | ādiśantu prajābhyaśca kurvantu bhajanaṃ hareḥ ||32|| paśyantu paramātmānaṃ gṛṇantu nāmakīrtanam | pūjayantu hariṃ nityaṃ bhajantāṃ parameśvaram ||33|| karaṃ naiva grahīṣyāmi bhaktaprajābhya eva ha | nāmāmṛtaṃ harereva kīrtayantu sadā prajāḥ ||34|| dūtādiṣṭāḥ prajāścāpi cakrurvai bhajanaṃ tathā | dhyāyanti sma hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gāyanti sma janārdanam ||35|| japanti sma ca tapyante yajante sma ca māṃ sadā | maddhyānā madvyavasitā mama pūjāparāyaṇāḥ ||36|| yāvadbhūmaṇḍalaṃ sarvaṃ babhūva vaiṣṇavaṃ tadā | matpratāpena sañjātā mānavā ādhivarjitāḥ ||37|| vītaśokāśca puṇyāśca sarvarogavivarjitāḥ | sarvaiśvaryasamāpannā dhanadhānyasamanvitāḥ ||38|| putrapautrādisadvaṃśā nirāmayā nirītayaḥ | gṛhadvāre kalpavṛkṣāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ ||39|| sarvakāmadughā gāvaścintāmaṇayaścāpi vai | abhavan rājyavṛddhyādyāḥ sampadaścāvitarkitāḥ ||3.72.40|| sarvasaubhāgyasampannā jñānadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ | prajāścāsan supuṇyāśca bhaktipūjāparāyaṇāḥ ||41 || na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhirnākālamaraṇaṃ nṛṇām | vaiṣṇavā mānavāḥ sarve mama dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ ||42|| majjapā madbhaktisevānāmakīrtanatatparāḥ | sarvatra vaiṣṇavo bhāvo gṛhe vṛkṣe paśuṣvapi ||43|| gṛhe gṛhe mandirāṇi bhāsvanti mama cābhavan | gṛhabhittiṣu citrāṇi mamaivāsan tvayā saha ||44|| madbhaktābhiśca nārībhirgīyante gītayo mama | prabhajanti prajā māṃ ca bālavṛddhakumārakāḥ ||45|| gṛhakarmaratā nāryo bhajante māṃ pareśvaram | āsane śayane yāne pāne sthāne ca bhojane ||46|| krīḍāyāmutsave kāme māṃ bhajanti hariṃ prabhum | bruvanti śrīharernāma mānayanti sma mokṣadam ||47|| evaṃ vaikuṇṭhatulyaṃ vai bhūtalaṃ sarvato’bhavat | sarve bhaktiparā lakṣmi mama snehaparāyaṇāḥ ||48|| yayātinopadiṣṭāste sañjātā vaiṣṇavā bhuvi | jarāmaraṇaśūnyāścābhavan mama prasādataḥ ||49|| mama lokaṃ na te yānti vaiṣṇavā dīrghajīvinaḥ | ye ca yānti vimānena vaiṣṇavaṃ mama dhāma te ||3.72.50|| apyabdalakṣadehāste vṛddhā api narāḥ striyaḥ | pañcaviṃśābdikāḥ sarve dṛśyante kṛpayā mama ||51|| sthirakāyāśca sukhino jarārogādivarjitāḥ | teṣu bhakteṣu sarveṣu viṣṇudūtā hareḥ śritāḥ ||52|| vicaranti tāḍayanti dṛṣṭvā yamasya pārṣadān | rudantaste tāḍitāśca yāmyā yayuryamaṃ prati ||53|| kathayāmāsurevaite ceṣṭitaṃ bhūbhṛtaḥ kṣitau | amṛtyubhūtalaṃ jātaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ sarvameva ha ||54|| yayātinā mahābhaktyā vaikuṇṭhābhaṃ kṛtaṃ khalu | tāḍyante yamadūtā vai viṣṇudūtaiḥ kṣitau yama ||55|| kiṃ kurmo naiva gacchāmo bhūtalaṃ dharmarāja vai | dharmarājaḥ śrutavām̐śca cintayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ||56|| asya rājño bhavedantastathā kāryaṃ mayā dhruvam | rājño nāśe prajāḥ sarvā bhaviṣyanti kumārgagāḥ ||57|| yāmyamārgaḥ sātithiko bhaviṣyati punastathā | vicāryetthaṃ yayau viṣṇuṃ vaikuṇṭhe prārthayat prabhum ||58|| nanāma daṇḍavaccāpi pupūja parameśvaram | nyavedayaddhariṃ dharmarājo yayātivartanam ||59|| tava bhaktena bhagavan ruddhaḥ panthā yamasya me | mānavā bhūtale sarve vaiṣṇavāstena vai kṛtāḥ ||3.72.6 0|| tasmāddhare nijabhaktaṃ śīghramatra samāhvaya | pāpināṃ daṇḍarodho’pi bhaveduddhāṭitastataḥ ||61|| idānīṃ tu bhaktayogāt pāpino’pi vrajanti tat | dhāma pāpāni nirdhūya riktaṃ yāmyagṛhaṃ mama ||62|| ityarthito hariḥ prāha satyaṃ mama tathāsti tat | madbhaktānāṃ saṃgamādvai pāpino’pi hi pāvanāḥ ||63|| bhavantyeva na sandeho bhūrvaikuṇṭhasamā hi sā | kintu bhaktādhīna eva bhavāmi nānyathā yama ||64|| bhaktasyecchāviruddhaṃ yannācarāmi kadācana | svasti te’stu bhaja māṃ tvaṃ mā bhaktivighnamācara ||65|| yadvā satye brahmaloke yāhi tvaṃ parameṣṭhinam | nivedaya yathārthaṃ ca sa te buddhiṃ pradāsyati ||66|| ityukto yamarājaśca lakṣmi yayāvajaṃ prati | nanāma pupūja yamo nyavedayacca tattathā ||67|| śrutvā brahmā yamaṃ prāha bhakto rājā hi vaiṣṇavaḥ | parābhāvyo na vai syāddhi mā yatnaṃ kuru tatra vai ||68|| kintu te cāsti hṛdayaṃ yāmyamārgaṃ pravartitum | kuru yatnaṃ tathā dharma yāhīndra prati vai divam ||69|| ardhāsanaṃ mahendrasya rājñe dānāya vedaya | evaṃ kṛte sadā rājā svarge sthāsyati na kṣitau ||3.72.70|| bhaktirmandā prajāyāṃ ca bhaviṣyati tato yama | dharmo mandastena mārgastava pūrṇo bhaviṣyati ||71 || ityuktaḥ prayayau dharmarājaścendraṃ divaṃ prati | samāyāntaṃ dharmarājaṃ dadarśa surarāṭ drutam ||72|| samutthāya dadāvardhāsanaṃ papraccha cāgamam | dharmarājo’bravīt sarvaṃ yayāteścaritaṃ śubham ||73|| nahuṣasyātmajenāpi yayātinā mahītale | vaiṣṇavena kṛtāḥ sarve vaiṣṇavā dhārmikāḥ khalu ||74|| vaikuṇṭhatulyarūpaṃ vai rājate bhūmimaṇḍalam | mānavā amarā jātā jarārogavivarjitāḥ ||75|| apāpāḥ satyaśīlāśca krodhādidoṣavarjitāḥ | bhaktiśīlā dharmaparāḥ samarcanti narāyaṇam ||76 || dūrvā vaṭā yathā bhūmau vistāraṃ yānti vaṃśagāḥ | tathā prajā vistṛtāśca putrapautraiḥ prapautrakaiḥ ||77|| yamamārge na cāyānti yānti vaikuṇṭhameva tāḥ | kāryahīno’smi sañjāto vyāpāreṇa vivarjitaḥ ||78|| etajjñātvā mahendra tvaṃ prajāyā me’pi vai hitam | samācāra pravāhasya vedhaḥsargasya vai gatim ||79|| ityuktvā prayayau dharmarājaḥ svasyālayaṃ tataḥ | mahendro mātaliṃ cāha sārathiṃ yāhi bhūtalam ||3.72.8 0|| nāhuṣaṃ nṛpatiṃ bhaktaṃ yayātiṃ vada madvacaḥ | ardhāsanaṃ mahendro vai bhavate dāsyate nijam ||8 1|| yāhi svargaṃ sukhaṃ bhuṅkṣva kalpāntaṃ divi bhūpate | varṣāṇāṃ tu sahasrāṇi rājyaṃ bhuktaṃ tvayā nṛpa ||82|| svargaṃ bhuṅkṣva punaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ śāśvataṃ ca tataḥ padam | putrāste santi catvāro ruruḥ puruḥ kururyaduḥ ||83 || tebhyo rājyaṃ samarpyaiva vimānenaihi ca divam | ilaḥ purūravā vipracitiḥ śivirmanustathā ||84|| sagaro nahuṣaste’pi pitānye ca nareśvarāḥ | svarge tatra pramodante cāyāhi tvaṃ tathāvidhaḥ ||85|| śakreṇa saha modasva svargadharmeṣu saṃsthitaḥ | nṛpāśītisahasrāṇi varṣāṇi bhūtale tava ||86|| dānayajñavṛṣabhaktibhirgatāni śubhāni ha | pañcātmakaśarīrasya bhūmau tyāgaṃ vidhāya vai ||87|| divyaṃ rūpaṃ samagṛhya bhuṅkṣva svargasukhāni tu | śrutvovāca yayātiśca mātale śṛṇu madvacaḥ ||88|| yena kāyena saṃsiddhyet sukṛtaṃ muktisādhanam | bhaktiśca jāyate kṛṣṇe kathaṃ tyājyaṃ kalevaram ||89|| satyadharmātmakaṃ puṇyaṃ yena kāyena mānavaḥ | samarjayati muktiṃ ca tat kasmāt saṃvisarjayet ||3.72.90|| ātmā kāyaśca dvāvetau mitrarūpāvubhāvapi | tasmānnaiva parityājyamātmanā svakalevaram ||91 || śrutvaitanmātaliścāha rājan satyaṃ tavoditam | kintu kālavaśo dehaḥ karmapoṣyaḥ sthitastviha ||92|| bhūtapañcakarūpaśca pārthivastu viśeṣataḥ | āyuṣyakarmanāśe vai tyaktavyo’yaṃ prasahya vai ||93|| bhavatyeva sadā lokaiḥ sthitireṣā hi vidyate | jarāsya jāyate paścānnaśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||94|| tasmāt tyājyasvabhāvaṃ vai dehaṃ tyaktvā divaṃ vraja | śrutvā prāha yayātirvai mātale sā jarā nanu ||95|| kadotpannā kathaṃ pīḍākarī vada yathātatham | śrutvā ca mātaliḥ prāha śṛṇu rājan svabhāvajam ||96|| mahākālo hareḥ śaktiḥ śrīpateḥ paramātmanaḥ | mahākālasya mṛtyurvai putrī tasyā jarā sutā ||97|| sā māyākṛtatattveṣu samutpattau sahasthitā | utpannānnirṇītakālānāviśati kṣayaṃkarī ||98|| kṣīyate hi pradhānaṃ vai mahattattvaṃ vināśavat | ahaṃkāraḥ kṣīyate’pi mano’pi kṣīyate’pi ca ||99|| vairājaḥ kṣīyate cāpīndriyāṇi viṣayāstathā | bhūtāni cāpi kṣīyante bhautikāni tayā muhuḥ || 3.72.10 0|| rasāḥ poṣaṇakartāraḥ kṣīyante dehasaṃsthitāḥ |
