sarasāḥ sarvadehā vai prakāśante prapoṣitāḥ || 101 || rasāḥ śukrasvarūpā vai rasādhikye tu yauvanam | nārīprasaṃgato rājan rasanāśo bhavatyapi || 1 01|| nāryā naraprasaṃgena rasanāśo hi vṛddhatā | raso vīrya kāmanā tannāśe sarvavṛddhatā || 1 03|| śukraśoṇitayornāśe śūnyadehaḥ prajāyate | vivarṇo duḥkhasantapto jarāvyāptastadā bhavet || 1 04|| palitaṃ jāyate tena jvaratāpaḥ prajāyate | nāśamāyānti jīrṇāste maraṇaṃ tattathā dhruvam || 1 05|| iti rājan vicāryaiva dehaṃ tyaktvā divaṃ vraja | vimānaṃ cendrasaubhāgyamānītaṃ tvatkṛte mayā || 106|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne bhagavannāmamantrabhajanena yayāternṛpatya prabhāveṇa sarvaprajāvaiṣṇavītvādinirūpaṇanomā dvāsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 72 ||
<3.73> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tva yayāteruttarāṇi vai | mānave divi vā satye viśeṣo naiva vai mṛtau || 1 || tasmāddehaṃ vihāyāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi na vai divam | naiva kāyo vinā prāṇaṃ prāṇā jīvaṃ vinā na ca || 2 || jīvo nātmānamṛte ca hyātmā hariṃ vinā na ca | etatsarva vihāyātra svarga me naiva rocate || 3 || yeṣāṃ prasādabhāvena sukhamaśnāmi bhūtale | tān saṃtyaktvā svargabhogaṃ bhokṣye’haṃ naiva sarvathā || 4 || paśya me puṇyabhaktyāḍya kāyaṃ viṃśativarṣavat | aśītivarṣajīrṇo’haṃ bhaje dehaṃ navaṃ yathā || 5 || naiva glānirna me hānirna bhramo vyādhayo na ca | vardhate dharmabhaktibhyāṃ balavān kāya eva me || 6 ||. sarvāmṛtamayaṃ divyamoṣadhaṃ bhaktisaṃyutam | dharmākhyaṃ kriyate cātra pāpavyādhipraṇāśanam || 7 || śrīhareḥ kīrtanenaiva kāyo mayā hi śodhitaḥ | etadrasāyanaṃ nityaṃ pibāmi pācayāmi ca || 8 || tena me ca jarāmṛtyū vidyete naiva tadbalāt | ye pibanti mahābhaktāḥ kṛṣṇanāmarasāyanam || 9 || teṣāṃ deho divyarūpo jāyate vai yathā mama | harerdhyānena bhaktyā ca pūjayā sevayā tathā || 3.73.1 0|| satyena dānapuṇyena mantrajapena mātale | bhaktisaṃsthāpanenāpi kāyo me’sti nirāmayaḥ || 11 || āśīrvādaiḥ satāṃ jāto māyākālādinirbhayaḥ | hareḥ kṛpāvaśādatra svargātsvargaṃ mamāsti vai || 1 2|| hareḥ pūjopacāreṇa bhaktyā dhyānena kīrtanaiḥ | satyadānaniyamādyaiḥ kāyo me divyatāṃ gataḥ || 1 3|| nāhaṃ svargaṃ gamiṣyāmi svargamatra karomi vai | yāhi cendraṃ yathārthaṃ vai mayoktaṃ sannivedaya || 14|| śrutvā ca mātalistūrṇaṃ yayāvindraṃ nyavedayat | indro’pi cintayitvaiva klṛptānāṃ cāparāṃ tataḥ || 15|| vyaracayannṛpaṃ mohayituṃ cāha ca mātalim | śṛṇu tvaṃ mātale rājā viṣṇubhakto dṛḍho’sti vai || 16|| sa tu bhaktiṃ parityajya divaṃ nāyāsyati kvacit | kintu sadeha evāsāvāmantraṇīya ādarāt || 17|| vijñāpanīyo vinayairdevādyaiḥ sṛṣṭinītitaḥ | atha vai mātaliścājñāṃ prāpya yayau nṛpaṃ prati || 18|| rājā cakre ca sammānaṃ mātaliḥ prāha vai sphuṭam | rājannindro varuṇaśca mamaḥ kuberako’nalaḥ || 1 9|| īśānaścāpyanilaśca nirvṛtaśca guruḥ kaviḥ | sarve tvāṃ mānayāsurnijadhiṣṇyārhameva ca ||3.73.20|| sarve nivedayāmāsurlokahitārthameva yat | sadehenāpi vai svarge devahitārthamityapi |||21 || āgantavyaṃ tvayā rājannityāmantraṇamasti naḥ | dṛṣṭvā śrutvā yatheṣṭaṃ ca sammilitvā surādikān ||22|| punargantavyamevātha bhūtale ca yathecchayā | ityuktaḥ sa tu rājarṣiḥ sammānya daivataṃ vacaḥ ||23|| vimānavaramāruhya yayau mātalinā divam | dikpālānāṃ sabhāyāṃ sa nṛpaḥ sammānitaḥ suraiḥ ||24|| surānnatvā niṣasāda yathārhaṃ ca tataḥ param | maitrīṃ sāptapadīnāṃ ca kṛtvā parasparaṃ tataḥ ||25|| indro jagāda rājānaṃ śṛṇu rājan hitāvaham | lokā vai māyayā vyāptā mānavā devatāsurāḥ ||26 || tvayā lokā nirjitāśca viṣṇubhaktyā hi bhūtale | nṛpe dharmayute tasya prajā bhavati dhārmikī ||27|| nṛpe bhakte bhaktiyuktā duṣṭe duṣṭā bhavatyapi | bhūtalaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma tvayā kṛtaṃ śubhaṃ khalu ||28|| kintu rājan yamamārgaḥ svargamārgo’pi sārgalaḥ | idānīṃ vartate bhaktyā vaikuṇṭhaṃ yānti mānavāḥ ||29|| dikpālānāṃ ca ye lokā nirjanā vai bhavanti yat | brahmaṇā ca kṛtaḥ sṛṣṭeḥ pravāho’pi niruddhyate ||3.73.30|| devānāṃ cāpi pitṝṇāmāśā luptā bhavatyapi | vaṃśavistārabhāvāśca pravardhante hi vaiṣṇavāḥ ||3 1 || sarve yāsyanti vaikuṇṭhaṃ na svargaṃ na yamālayam | na janaṃ na tapaścāpi na satyaṃ brahmaṇo gṛham ||32|| evaṃ vai vartamāne tu ṛṇānubandhitā nṛpa | luptaiva syāttato rājan pravāho na yathā kṣayet ||33|| tathā vicārya sarveṣāmānukūlyaṃ vidhehi vai | icchāmo bhavate dātumapsaroratnamuttamam ||34|| gṛhāṇa bhuṅkṣva bhūlokaṃ yathā rājā tathā prajāḥ | bhaviṣyanti tato mārgā yamādīnāmanargalāḥ ||35|| śrutvā prāha yayātirvai nāhaṃ kāpathago nṛpaḥ | koṭipuṇyottarāṃ bhaktiṃ kṛtvā nārāyaṇapriyām ||36|| nimaṃkṣyāmi na saṃsāre sarvathālokite punaḥ | mama puṇyaṃ vinaśyecca bhaktiḥ syād vyabhicāriṇī ||37|| saṃsārapāramāptasya punarme patanaṃ bhavet | viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kuprasanno bhavenmama || 38|| sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ me vyarthaṃ syāt tannecchāmyapsarovarām | ityuktvā maunamāsthāya sthitastāvat surādayaḥ ||39|| sasmarurviṣṇumīśānaṃ brahmāṇaṃ tatra vai drutam | prāyayurdevavaryāśca pūjitā devatādibhiḥ ||3.73.40|| niṣeduścāsaneṣveva vijñāpitāḥ kathāṃ prati | śrutvā viṣṇustadā prāha yayātiṃ tu nijānugam ||41 || rājan gṛhāṇa devānāṃ vākyaṃ hitaṃ yamasya ca | gṛhāṇa cāpsadoratnaṃ prajāte tādṛśī tadā ||42|| bhaviṣyati mohayuktā dharmādikāryavarjitā | yamādisṛtayaścāpi bhaviṣyantyapyanargalāḥ ||43|| mama vākyaṃ gṛhāṇedaṃ svasti te saṃbhaviṣyati | brahmaharau tathaivaiva prāhatustaṃ nṛpaṃ tadā ||44|| nṛpo natvārthayāmāsa bandhanaṃ pāpameva me | bhavettasmāt kṛpāsindho samuddhāraṃ kuru prabho ||45|| viṣṇuḥ prāha na te bandho’psarasā vai bhaviṣyati | karma sarvaṃ tava rājan nirguṇaṃ vai mamājñayā ||46|| tāmasānāṃ rājasānāṃ mohanārthaṃ samācara | apsaroratnamāsādya kāmabhogān samācara ||47|| muktiste bhavitā rājannātra kāryā vicāraṇā | asmadvākyaṃ hi vedo’sti vidhirdharmaḥ sa eva saḥ ||48|| asmadvākyavidhānena muktirmuktiḥ śubhā gatiḥ | asmadvākyavirodhena duḥkhaṃ bandho hyadhogatiḥ ||49|| ityuktaḥ sa tu rājarṣiḥ svīcakārāpsarovarām | devatāḥ pūjayāmāsū rājānaṃ vākyavartinam ||3.73.50|| viṣṇū rakṣākaraṃ mantraṃ dadau naijaṃ tu nirguṇam | viṣṇuprayojitaścāhaṃ karomi karma yadvidham |||51|| sarvaṃ samarpitaṃ viṣṇau nirbandhaṃ viṣṇave svāhā | enaṃ mantraṃ tadā labdhvā nītvā cāpsarasaṃ nṛpaḥ ||52|| bindumatīṃ cātha natvā surān viṣṇuṃ prapūjya ca | āyayau bhūtalaṃ rājā vimānavaramāsthitaḥ ||53|| reme sākaṃ tayā lakṣmi mohamāpto’bhavattataḥ | cireṇāyaṃ dharmakarmabhaktyādīn vismṛto’bhavat ||54|| prajā vīkṣya nṛpaṃ tadvad dharmakarmavivarjitāḥ | cireṇāpyabhavan lakṣmi yathā rājā tathā prajāḥ ||55|| bindumatī ratiputrī cāpsarogaṇamadhyagā | rājapatnī hi rājānaṃ mohe cikṣepa sarvadā ||56|| kāmabhogaiśca vārdhakyaṃ hyavāpa nṛpa eva saḥ | satṛṣṇasyāntikād bindumatī cādṛśyatāṃ yayau ||57|| rājā śokaṃ cakārāsyāḥ kṛte cāpi divāniśam | atha sā dadṛśe rātrau rājānaṃ prati bhāvukī ||58|| vṛddhastvaṃ dṛśyase rājan naiva yogyo’si matkṛte | yauvanaṃ prāpya vartethāstvāṃ seviṣye tadā nṛpa ||59|| rājā kāmāturaḥ putrānāhūya vākyamāha tat | turuṃ yaduṃ kuruṃ puruṃ spaṣṭamāha nṛpastadā ||3.73.60|| eko’pi gṛhyatāṃ putrā jarā me’śaktikāriṇī | dhīro bhūtvā tato naijaṃ tāruṇyaṃ mama dīyatām ||61 || mānasaṃ me’tisantaptaṃ stryāsaktaṃ bahucañcalam | jarāyāścopagrahaṇaṃ kariṣyati sutastu yaḥ ||62|| sa bhunakti tu me rājyaṃ bhuvaṃ sandhārayiṣyati | vipulā santatistasya yaśaḥ kīrtirbhaviṣyati ||63|| śrutvā putrāstamūcurvai bhavān dharmaparo nṛpa | kasmātte cāpsaroyogādīdṛśī bhāvanādhamā ||64|| yayātiḥ prāha mohānme bhāvanā cedṛśī sutāḥ | avaśyaṃbhāvino bhāvā bhavanti prakṛtervaśāḥ ||65|| evaṃ jñātvā prakartavyaṃ yatsukhaṃ mama putrakāḥ | turuḥ prāha śarīraṃ prāpyate pitṛprasādataḥ ||66|| dharmaḥ sevā ca śuśrūṣā pitrostenaiva jāyate | tena viṣayabhogaśca jāyate ca yunā sadā ||67|| so’yaṃ me dānakālo na na dāsye yauvanaṃ hi te | bhavān vṛddhatvamāpanno yogyo’yaṃ samayastathā ||68|| śrutvā rājā śaśāpainaṃ taruṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ sutaṃ tadā | apadhvastastvayādeśo mamaivaṃ pāpacetana ||69|| tasmāt pāpī bhava tvaṃ vai sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ | vedācāravihīnaśca brahmaghno madyapo bhava ||3.73.70|| sarvabhakṣaśca durmedhā mlecchācāro bhaviṣyati | putrāḥ pautrāḥ prapautrādyāstādṛśāste bhavantviti ||71 || evaṃ śaptvā turuṃ cāpi niṣkāsya rājyamaṇḍalāt | yaduṃ prāha pradehi me yauvanaṃ bhuṃkṣva rāṣṭrakam ||72|| yaduḥ prāha na śaknomi dātuṃ te yauvanaṃ nṛpa | jarāyā hetavaḥ pañca cintā vṛddhastriyastathā ||73|| kadannaṃ nityamadhvā ca śītajāṭharapīḍanam | sā jarā rocate me na bhogakālo hyayaṃ mama ||74|| śrutvā rājā śaśāpainaṃ rājyahīnaḥ savaṃśajaḥ | tejohīnaḥ kṣatradharmavarjitaḥ paśupālakaḥ ||75|| bhaviṣyasi na sandeho yāhi rājyād bahirmama | ityuktvā ca kuruṃ prāha śarmiṣṭhābālakaṃ nṛpaḥ ||76|| dehi me yauvanaṃ putra gṛhāṇa tvaṃ jarāṃ mama | kuruḥ prāha kariṣyāmi bhajanaṃ śrīhareḥ sadā ||77|| kaḥ pitā ko’tra vai mātā sarve svārthaparā bhuvi | na kāṃkṣe tava rājyaṃ vai na dāsye yauvanaṃ mama ||78|| ityuktvā pitaraṃ natvā himālayavanaṃ yayau | tatra tepe tapaścāpi vaiṣṇavo dharmabhaktimān ||79|| kṛṣiṃ cakāra dharmātmā saptakrośamitakṣiteḥ | halena karṣayāmāsa mahiṣeṇa vṛṣeṇa ca ||3.73.80|| ātithyaṃ sarvadā cakre nūtnadhānyādibhiḥ sadā | viṣṇurviprasvarūpeṇa yayau kuroḥ kṛṣiṃ prati ||81|| ātithyaṃ ca gṛhītvaiva mokṣapadaṃ dadau tataḥ | kurukṣetraṃ ca tannāmnā kṛtaṃ nārāyaṇena ha ||82|| sarvamokṣakaraṃ ramyaṃ pāpatāpapraṇāśakam | atha rājā puruṃ prāha dehi me yauvanaṃ suta ||83|| bhuṃkṣva rājyaṃ mayā dattaṃ supuṇyaṃ hatakaṇṭakam | pururnatvāha rājyaṃ vai bhoktavyaṃ daivayogataḥ||84|| jarāṃ dehi gṛhāṇāpi yauvanaṃ me pitardrutam | tṛptiṃ yāhi mahārāja yatheṣṭāṃ yauvanena me ||85|| tavaiva yauvanaṃ tvetat tavaivāṃśo’hamasmi ca | svatvaṃ tavaiva mayyasti gṛhāṇa yauvanaṃ mama ||86|| ityuktvā jalamādāya dadau haste piturjalam | yauvanaṃ tāmravarṇaṃ vai tūrṇaṃ dehād vyapāsarat ||87|| praviveśa yayātestu śarīre sa ca vai yuvā | babhūva ca jarā prāptā puruṃ putraṃ piśācinī ||88|| purumāha tato rājā prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ | mama rājyaṃ prabhuṃkṣva tvaṃ mayā dattaṃ mahāmate ||89 || yauvanaṃ te’pi cādyaiva punarbhavatu me’pi ca | viṣṇoḥ prasādataḥ putra jarāvyapagamastava ||3.73.9 0|| āvayoryauvanaṃ nityaṃ viṣṇubhaktiprabhāvataḥ | sarvadāstu jagādaivaṃ putro yuvā babhūva ha ||9 1 || yayātiśca yuvā jātaḥ paśya lakṣmi balaṃ mama | pitṛbhaktibalaṃ cāpi cāpsaraḥsaṃgamaṃ tathā ||9 2|| sarvametat phaladaṃ vai svānurūpaṃ kṣitau matam | puruḥ rājyaṃ cakārāpi yayātirbhogamāptavān ||93|| dhanūrājyaṃ ca chatraṃ ca gajamaśvaṃ dhanaṃ dharām | kośaṃ veśaṃ balaṃ sarvaṃ cāmaraṃ vyajanaṃ gṛham ||94|| dadau rājā hi purave bindumatīpatistadā | yayāvudyānabhāgaṃ covāsaikānte tayā saha ||95 || atha bindumatī prāha śṛṇu tvaddūṣaṇaṃ nṛpa | śarmiṣṭhā devayānī ca tava bhārye hyubhe hyapi ||96|| anyāśca rājakanyāste bhāryāśataṃ bhavatyapi | sāpatnakena bhāvena bhavān bhartā pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||97|| sasarpo’si mahārāja candanasya drumo yathā | varamagnipraveśaṃ ca śikharātpatanaṃ varam ||98|| taṃ varaṃ naiva paśyāmi sapatnīviṣasaṃyutam | ahaṃ rājan prabhoktrī syāṃ tava kāyasya bhūpate ||99 || ityarthe pratyayaṃ dehi mama vai svakare nṛpa | yatra kvāpi nivāsena nātra sapatnikāgṛhe || 3.73.100 || rājā dadau pratyayaṃ ca tato vanādiṣu svayam | yayau sārdhaṃ bindumatyā parvateṣu digantare || 101 || vai viṃśatisahasrāṇi varṣāṇyasya gatāni hi | athāpsaro’bhavad garbhavatī caicchad divaṃ prati || 1 02|| gantumindragṛhaṃ kāmagṛhaṃ piturniveśanam | rājānaṃ cāpi netuṃ sā mahāgrahaṃ cakāra ha || 103 || devānāṃ darśanaṃ rājan kariṣyasi divaṃ vraja | ityuktaḥ sa tu rājarṣiḥ śuśoca vai kṣaṇaṃ hṛdi || 1 04|| sarvaṃ kālena bhavati kālo’yaṃ me hyupāgataḥ | pṛthvyāstyāge vacanaṃ me satyaṃ kāryaṃ bhavedataḥ || 1 05|| evaṃ vicāryaṃ ca puruṃ jarāyuktaṃ sutaṃ nṛpaḥ | āhūya nijatāruṇyaṃ dadau jagrāha vai jarām || 1 06|| rājyārthaṃ ca samādiśya bhaktimādiśya vaiṣṇavīm | prajābhyaśca svajanebhyaścāśīrdatvā yayau divam || 1 07|| bhaktimatyaḥ prajā nārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā ca tatparāḥ | abhavan saha gantuṃ vai nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ || 1 08|| divyadeho’bhavad rājā prajā divyāśca koṭiśaḥ | abjakharvasahasrāṇi janāste parijagmire || 1 09|| svargaṃ gatvā ca tatraiva bindumatīṃ ratigṛhe | nidhāya vaiṣṇavaiḥ sākaṃ viṣṇunā cānumoditaḥ || 3.73.11 0|| yayātiḥ prayayau viṣṇorvaikuṇṭhaṃ vaiṣṇavaiḥ saha | brahmalokaṃ yayuḥ sarve pūjitāścāmarādibhiḥ || 11 1|| evaṃ bhaktiprabhāvo’sti lakṣmi nirbandhakṛt sadā | ahaṃ nayāmi vaikuṇṭhaṃ golokaṃ cākṣaraṃ param || 1 12|| bhaktaṃ karmasu magnaṃ vai nirbandhaṃ prakaromi ca | rājā vaikuṇṭhamāsādya neme varāya yojitaḥ || 1 13|| yayāce sarvathā dāsyaṃ mayā dattaṃ hi śāśvatam | dikpālānāmabhūt kāryaṃ prajāpravāha ityapi || 1 14|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇācca vicintanāt | dharmo jñānaṃ virāgaśca bhaktirmokṣo bhavantyapi || 1 15|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne yayāteḥ svargataḥ pṛthivyāmadhikabhaktyādilābha iti tasya pṛthivyāstyāgārthamindrakṛtabindumatyāḥ pradānaṃ putrato yauvanapraptiścānte vaikuṇṭhagamana cetyādibhaktiprabhāvavarṇananāmā trisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 73 ||
<3.74> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ māhātmyaṃ cādhikaṃ mama | bhuktimuktipradaṃ cāpi nairguṇyadivyatāpradam || 1 || kena me tu bhavet prītiḥ kathaṃ tuṣṭo bhavāmi ca | tuṣṭena ca mayā tūrṇaṃ divyo vidhīyate’nugaḥ || 2 || kathayāmi samāsena śṛṇu tvaṃ parameśvari | prajānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ yena kṛtaṃ sevā kṛtā yayā || 3 || satāṃ ca pūjanaṃ yena kṛtaṃ me pūjanādikam | mokṣaścodghāṭito yena jñānopadeśakīrtanaiḥ || 4 || teṣāṃ tuṣyāmi kamale sādhūnāṃ maṇḍale’smi ca | sādhūnāṃ toṣaṇāllakṣmi tuṣyāmyahaṃ sadā priye || 5 || sajjanānāṃ parivādo mama vidveṣaṇaṃ mahat | sajjanānāṃ pūjanena pūjito’haṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 6 || nityabhivādyāḥ santaśca bhojanīyā nirantaram | sevanīyāḥ sādhavaste pratimā mama mūrtayaḥ || 7 || teṣāṃ tuṣyāmi bhaktānāṃ satsevāṃ ye pracakrire | na teṣāmaśubhaṃ kiñcitkalmaṣaṃ cāpi vidyate || 8 || sādhuṃ sādhvīṃ satīṃ devaṃ pūjayennityamutsukaḥ | pūjitaṃ hi jagattena sadevāsuramānuṣam || 9 || tena rūpeṇa pūjāṃ vai gṛhṇāmyahaṃ sadā prabhuḥ | pūjā mamaiṣā na tvanyā satsu sādhvīṣvahaṃ sthitaḥ|| 3.74.1 0|| yatra pratiṣṭhā me cāste tān vihāyetaraṃ vṛthā | sābhimānā janā vegāt pūjayantyajñasattamāḥ || 11 || nāhaṃ tatpratigṛhṇāmi na sā tuṣṭikarī mama | mama sambandhamāptā ye teṣāṃ pūjā garīyasī || 12|| cakraṃ me pūjanīyaṃ vai pādau pūjyau sadā mama | vārāhādyavatārā me pūjanīyāśca sādhavaḥ || 1 3|| cakreṇa nihatā daityāḥ padbhyāṃ krāntā vasundharā | vārāhādyavatāraiśca hyasurā vinipātitāḥ || 14|| sādhurūpairjanānāṃ ca mokṣadānaṃ dadāmyapi | sādhvī dharmavatī nārī bhaktaśaktirnigadyate || 15|| tathā dharmo rakṣyate me pitā janma vahāmyaham | mātā sādhvī sadā bodhyā bhaktirūpā na saṃśayaḥ || 16|| dāsī lakṣmīsvarūpā ca sarvadā mama dhāriṇī | parituṣṭo bhavāmyeṣāṃ pūjanāt sarvato’dhikaḥ || 17|| teṣu māṃ pūjayiṣyanti nāsti teṣāṃ parābhavaḥ | api sādhuṃ satīṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmacāriṇamāgatam || 18|| natvā datvāhutiṃ bhuñjyādamṛtaṃ taddhi bhojanam | sādhvīṃ sandhyāmupāsitvā sādhvādityaṃ namettataḥ || 19|| sarvatīrtheṣu sa snāto mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ | sādhurūpaṃ dharmadevaṃ pālayet svagṛhe sadā || 3.74.20|| satsaṃgaṃ dharmamevāpya pālayed bhaktarāṭ mama | satāṃ prasannatā me ca yena dharmaḥ sa vai mataḥ ||21|| satāmudvegajananaṃ hyadharmaḥ sa tu me mataḥ | mama bhaktā na tuṣyanti yena tena nu kiṃ hi me ||22|| yena tuṣyanti me santastadeva mama saddhanam | kalye hyutthāya satataṃ spraṣṭavyāḥ sādhavo mama ||23|| gāvo ghṛtaṃ dadhi cāhaṃ sarṣapāḥ sādhikāstathā | spraṣṭavyāḥ prātarutthāya yena kalmaṣanāśanam ||24|| strīghnā goghnāḥ kṛtaghnāśca brahmaghnā gurutalpagāḥ | śuddhyanti sādhusaṃsparśāt sādhośca sevanānmama ||25|| santo gāvo’nalāḥ sādhvyaḥ spraṣṭavyā na padā dvijāḥ | pādena sparśane puṇyaṃ spraṣṭuḥ sarvaṃ vinaśyati ||26|| paramānnaṃ pradātavyaṃ bhojane tebhya uttamam | miṣṭānnaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ śāśvatītṛptidaṃ śubham ||27|| ātithyaṃ satataṃ kuryād dīpaṃ dadyāt satāṃ gṛhe | sato vandet praseveta hyeṣaḥ śreṣṭhatamo vṛṣaḥ ||28|| api kratuśatairiṣṭvā kṣayaṃ gacchati taddhaviḥ | na tu naśyanti te dharmāḥ sādhavo yaiḥ pratoṣitāḥ ||29|| yo yajetāśvamedhena vājapeyaśatena ca | avākśirāvalambeta satraṃ kuryānnirantaram ||3.74.3 0|| na yasya hṛdayaṃ śuddhaṃ sādhavo me na sevitāḥ | mama sevā kṛtā naiva māyānirayago hi saḥ ||3 1|| sādhusevā śuddhatā ca hṛdayasya hi mokṣade | śuddhena manasā kṛtvā svalpamapi pramucyate ||32|| śraddadhānena kartavyaṃ gurūṇāṃ vacanaṃ sadā | satāṃ sevā prakartavyā tejasvī tena jāyate ||33|| ahanyahani yo dadyāt kapilāṃ dvādaśīḥ samāḥ | māsi māsi ca satreṇa yo yajeta sadā janaḥ ||34|| gavāṃ śatasahasraṃ ca yo dadyājjyeṣṭhapuṣkare | tato’dhikaṃ phalaṃ tasya tuṣyanti yasya sādhavaḥ ||35|| śrūyante yāni tīrthāni jalasthalamayāni vai | siddhadevādijuṣṭāni sevitāni maharṣibhiḥ ||36|| abhiṣekaḥ samasteṣāṃ sādhucaraṇavāribhiḥ | alpaṃ śītaṃ jalaṃ dattaṃ sādhave’nnaṃ samarpitam ||37|| dātuḥ puṇyodakā nāma nadī praite vidhīyate | akṣayaṃ salilaṃ tatra śītalaṃ hyamṛtaṃ bhavet ||38|| annaṃ tathāmṛtaṃ tatra padyate paralokinaḥ | anyaccāpi pradattaṃ tatparaloke’bhipadyate ||39|| loke hyucchiṣṭakāḥ prāyo bahucchidrā hi mānavāḥ | tyaktaśīlasamācārān praviśanti piśācakāḥ ||3.74.40|| mānavā ye satāṃ sevāparāyaṇāḥ śubhāśrayāḥ | tān piśācā nāviśanti bhaktān puṇyakṛtānnarān ||41 || sādhujano yatra yatra bhunakti devatārpitam | sādhyā rudrāstathādityā viśvedevāstathāśvinau ||42|| maruto vasavaścāpi pratibhuñjanti tadgatāḥ | ṛṣīṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ me harestathā ||43|| muktānāmīśvarāṇāṃ ca prasādālaya eva saḥ | yo bhavet sādhusādhvīnāṃ sevākṛt toṣakṛttathā ||44|| kṛtvāpi pāpakaṃ karma matsādhuśaraṇaṃ gataḥ | mucyate pāpakoṭibhyaḥ pūto bhavati pāvakaḥ ||45|| pāpinaḥ pāvayet sādhurmama sevājitātmavān | mama saṃgaṃ sadā kuryāt pāpisaṃgaṃ vivarjayet ||46|| brahmadṛṣṭyārpayed dānaṃ sādhudṛṣṭyārpayettathā | haridṛṣṭyārpayellakṣmi taddānaṃ śāśvataṃ bhavet| ||47|| annadānaṃ vāridānaṃ jñānadānaṃ śubhaṃ param | abhīdānaṃ brahmadānaṃ mokṣadānaṃ parātparam ||48|| ātmadānaṃ sadā deyaṃ tatsamaṃ netarad bhuvi | dattātreyo hariḥ sādhuḥ śiṣyebhyo brahmanirguṇam ||49|| dāne datvā yayau dhāmākṣaratulyaṃ svakaiḥ saha | kapilaśca tathā sādhurharirdatvā vivekajam ||3.74.50|| jñānaṃ mokṣaṃ ca śiṣyebhyo yayau dhāma nijaṃ param | ṛṣabho’pi samādiśya śiṣyebhyo brahma śāśvatam ||51|| hariḥ so’pi yayau dhāma nijaṃ sarvasukhāspadam | evamanye’pi santaśca yayurdānaparāyaṇāḥ ||52|| brahmadānapradānena śāśvataṃ cākṣaraṃ padam | sādhuvratāśca rājāno brahmabhāvaṃ vilokya ca ||53|| adeyamapi dattvaiva brahmaṇe svargiṇo’bhavan | śibirauśīnaraḥ prāṇān priyasya tanayasya ca ||54|| brahmiṣṭhārthamupākṛtya mahatsvargamito gataḥ | pratardanaḥ kāśikeśaḥ pradāya tanu vai nijam ||55|| brahmiṣṭhāyātulāṃ kīrtiṃ labdhvā mokṣapadaṃ gataḥ | rantidevaśca sāṃkṛtyo vasiṣṭhāya mahātmane ||56|| arghyaṃ pūjāṃ pradāyaiva yayau mokṣapadaṃ śubham | devāvṛdho yayau dhāma dattvā chatraṃ ca kāñcanam ||57|| brahmiṣṭhāya mahāyajñe śataśalākamuttamam | ambarīṣo’pi rāṣṭraṃ vai dattvā sarvaṃ prabhoḥ kṛte ||58|| brahmalokaṃ yayau bhaktyā mahābhāgavataḥ śubhaḥ | vṛṣādarbhiśca sarvasvaṃ dattvā dhāma yayau mama ||59|| nimi rāṣṭraṃ haraye me dattvā dhāma yayau mama | kanyāṃ datvā hyagastyāya vaidarbhirmokṣamāptavān ||3.74.60|| parśurāmaḥ kṣitiṃ dattvā viprebhyastīrthamāvasat | vāmano’pi kṣitiṃ dattvā viprebhyaśca tataḥ param ||61|| svargaṃ dattvā hi devebhyo yayau dhāma nijaṃ hariḥ | rāmādityo’pi viprebhyaḥ kṣitiṃ dattvākṣaraṃ yayau ||62|| kanyāmāṃgirase dattvā marutto’pyakṣaraṃ yayau | mitrasaho vasiṣṭhāya bhāryāṃ dattvā divaṃ yayau ||63|| sahasracityo rājarṣiḥ prāṇān dattvā divaṃ yayau | śatadyumnaḥ kṣitiṃ dattvā maudgalyāya divaṃ yayau ||64|| śāṇḍilyāya kṣitiṃ dattvā sumanyurdhāma me yayau | dyutimān pṛthivīṃ dattvā ṛcīkāyākṣaraṃ yayau ||65|| madirāśvaḥ sutāṃ dattvā hiraṇyāyākṣaraṃ yayau | śāntāṃ datvā lomapādaḥ ṛṣyaśṛṃgāya svaryayau ||66|| bhagīrathaḥ sutāṃ haṃsīṃ datvā kautsāya svaryayau | pṛthvyāmanye bhaviṣyanti rājāno dānayoginaḥ ||67|| sādhubhyo dānamarpayya yāsyanti paramaṃ padam | lakṣmi sakhīstava sarvā dattvā mahyaṃ prajeśvarāḥ ||68|| yātā yāsyanti maddhāma nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ | matsādhūnāṃ sevakā ye sevikā dharmasaṃyutāḥ ||69|| bhaktiyutā bhāvayutāstādātmyena sthitā mayi | narā nāryaḥ prayāsyanti mama dhāmākṣaraṃ param ||3.74.70|| dharmādarthādbhayātkāmātkāruṇyātsādhave sadā | deyaṃ svalpaṃ ca bahu vā taddhi mokṣāya kalpyate ||71 || dharmārthaṃ svargalokārthaṃ dātavyaṃ sukhakīrtaye | punaścāsmācca labdhavyaṃ bhaviṣyatīti tatphalam ||72|| evamarthārthinā deyaṃ sādhave’nantasatphalam | vipatkāle bhaye prāpte nāśe prāpte ca vastunaḥ ||73|| dātavyaṃ vastu sarvasvaṃ sādhave cāphalecchunā | priyatārthaṃ pradātavyaṃ sakāmaṃ sādhumūrtaye ||74|| dīnāya ca daridrāya dātavyaṃ karuṇānvitam | sādhave mama bhaktāya viprāyāpi śubhaṃ śubham ||75|| hareḥ prasannatārthaṃ ca dātavyaṃ mokṣadaṃ hi tat | kartavyaṃ mama caitadvai vicāryetthaṃ samarpayet ||76|| sādhave nirguṇaṃ caitannārāyaṇāya me’pi ca | dadyānnārāyaṇasyedaṃ nedaṃ mameti nirguṇam ||77|| anantaphaladaṃ tadvai mahānandapradaṃ bhavet | dhāmni me tatphalaṃ dāsye dadāmi bhūtale’pi ca ||78|| dātre dadāmi cāsaṃkhyānandavārdhiṃ pare’kṣare | evaṃ lakṣmi satāṃ sevākarturme paramaṃ padam||79|| śāśvataṃ cāyatau cāsti mamaiśvaryādisaṃbhṛtam | svalpaṃ bahutamaṃ kṛtvā dadāmyakṣaradhāmani ||3.74.80|| śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca kīdṛk svalpasya dattasya phalaṃ dadāsi darśaya | kṛpayā me hare kṛṣṇa pareśvara kṛpāṃ kuru ||8 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca paśya lakṣmi samāyāntaṃ vipraṃ bhaktaṃ mamāntikam | svalpadānena tasmai vai dāsyāmyahaṃ hyanantakam |||82|| ityukte dīnavad vipro nāmnā paraśucandrakaḥ | kadaryo gṛhasarvasvaṃ samādāya samāyayau ||83|| patnīputravihīno vai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ japan | skandhe koṣṭhalikāṃ sthālīkalaśasruksamanvitām ||84|| vahan kaṭyāṃ jīrṇavastraṃ baddhvā yaṣṭiṃ kare dadhan | tandulān prasthamānām̐śca dhautraṃ prāvaraṇaṃ tathā ||85|| śirastrāṇaṃ dadhan mūrdhni hyetāvanmātrasampadā | yuto nārāyaṇa kṛṣṇa puruṣottamamādhava ||86|| gṛṇan cāgre vastujātaṃ dhṛtvā ca pādayostadā | rakṣa śaraṇya kṛṣṇa tvaṃ mokṣaṃ dehi pade tava ||87|| ityayācata tandulān dadau ca bharjitān hi tān | cakāra daṇḍavattatra luloṭha prārpya mastakam ||88|| netre pramīlya ca kṣaṇaṃ suṣvāpa bhūtale puraḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ ||89|| kiṃkaromyasya bhaktasya śaraṇāgatarakṣakaḥ | vada lakṣmi mṛtaścāyaṃ prāṇān tyajati sannidhau ||3.74.90|| ityuktvā taṇḍulān svalpān mukhe kṣiptvā hyabhakṣayam | paśyaitasya phalaṃ cāsmai dadāmi dhāma cākṣaram ||9 1|| tāvattatra samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ pārṣadānvitam | āruroha sa vipro’pi divyadehaḥ kṛpānvitaḥ ||92||| vimānaṃ vyomamārgeṇa smṛddhaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau | paśya lakṣmi mama dhāmni prāsādo’sya kṛte mayā ||93|| klṛptaḥ smṛddhiyuto bhakṣyabhojyapeyādikānvitaḥ | divyadṛṣṭyā paśya sarvaṃ smṛddhaṃ phalaṃ mayārpitam ||94|| kāmagaṃ ca vimānaṃ vai tasyārthe cārpitaṃ mayā | brahmāmṛtaṃ tathānantaṃ cārpitaṃ tāndulaṃ phalam ||95|| peyaṃ sarvavidhaṃ cāpi svarṇāmbarāṇi vai tathā | śaraṇāgatabhaktasya bhogyārthaṃ cārpitāni vai ||96|| athālokya prasannā śrīrlakṣmīrmumoda cāntare | vipradehaḥ sarasyeva kṛṣṇecchayā mamajja ha ||97|| svayaṃ gatiyuto bhūtvā vilayaṃ tatra vai gataḥ | mahāścaryaṃ ca sarvābhyo lakṣmīścoktavatī tvidam ||98|| sarvā brahmapriyādyāścālokayāmāsureva tam | divyadṛṣṭyā mahimānaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya me ||99|| paśyaivaṃ mahimā me’sti sarvasyāpi mahatphalam | paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ cāpi tathaiva phalamuttamam || 3.74.1 00|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne’nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktasya mahimakathane harestuṣṭisādhanānāṃ varṇanaṃ, kadaryasya paraśucandrakasya viprasyālpadānasyānantaphalaprāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 74 ||
<3.75> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇa mahāścaryaṃ nirvṛttāsmi ca vai tathā | bhūyo’pi tava māhātmyaṃ vada me ca pradarśaya || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca paśya lakṣmi mahāścaryaṃ mukhānme’gnirajāyata | ityukte vahnirutpanno vyāpnot pārśvavane’bhitaḥ || 2 || jvālāmālāsamākūlo’dahad vyāghravanaṃ kṣaṇāt | sadrumaṃ satṛṇaṃ virullatāsasyādisaṃyutam || 3 || sapakṣigaṇasaṃghātaṃ saśvāpadasarīsṛpam | evaṃ vahnirmahājvālo dagdhvā vanamaśeṣataḥ || 4 || hareḥ puro mūrtimān sa cāyayau śiṣyavattadā | anamatpādayoścāpi tirobabhūva vai harau || 5 || atha vana sarvathaiva dagdhaṃ dṛṣṭvā haristvaham | saumyerdṛṣṭinipātaistat punaḥ prakṛtimānayam || 6 || tathaiva tadvanaṃ bhūyaḥ prapuṣpitalatādrutam | sapakṣigaṇasaṃghuṣṭaṃ saśvāpadasarīsṛpam || 7 || abhavat paśya lakṣmi tvaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ yathāsthitam | dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ ca papraccha kāntaṃ lakṣmīrnarāyaṇam || 8 || ko’yamagniḥ kathaṃ kṛṣṇa vartate tvayi sarvadā | śrutvā nārāyaṇaḥ prāha śṛṇu tejo hi māmakam || 9 || bahudhā vartate mūrtau saṃkarṣaṇātmakaṃ hi tat | tathā rudrātmakaṃ cāpi śaṃkarātmakamityapi || 3.75.1 0|| sarvasaṃhārakṛt tadvai mahākālasvarūpavat | sarvaṃ caiśvaryarūpaṃ me vartate mayi sarvadā || 1 1|| yadā yadā pralayāśca bhavanti lokināṃ tadā | aiśvaryaṃ tadidaṃ me vai pravartate’ti sṛṣṭiṣu || 12|| saṃharāmi samagraṃ vai tenaiva sādhanena tat | sṛjāmi ca punaḥ śaktyā yathāvatkalpanākṛtam || 13|| sṛṣṭyaiśvaryaṃ ca tanme’sti yathā sṛṣṭaṃ vanaṃ punaḥ | bhavatyo brahmarūpiṇyaḥ sṛṣṭā mayā mamāṃśataḥ || 14|| etajjagat samagraṃ vai sṛṣṭaṃ tathā mayāṃśataḥ | mama caryāparītasya me sādhūnāṃ prasevayā || 15|| kālātmāgnirna dahati me saṃkīrtanakāriṇaḥ | paśyainaṃ lomaśaṃ tyaktvā tyaktvā tadāśramaṃ tathā || 16|| ṛṣīṇāmāśramām̐styaktvā vyāpnod vahnirna cāśramān | evaṃ me bhaktabhaktānāmaniṣṭaṃ kartumakṣamaḥ || 17|| ye māṃ bhajanti manujāsteṣāṃ kālo na vidyate | māyā na vidyate teṣāmudvego nāpi vidyate || 18|| tredhā tāpā na vai teṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ teṣāṃ na vidyate | teṣāṃ kaṣṭamahaṃ sarvaṃ bhakṣayāmi na saṃśayaḥ 19|| kālakālo’hamevāsmi jīvayāmi mamāśritān | kālamājñāpayāmyeva bhogān bhaktasya śāśvatān ||3.75.20|| mā saṃhara kadācit tvaṃ mā jarāṃ prāpaya kvacit | ityevaṃ mama bhaktānāṃ tiṣṭhāmi rakṣaṇe sadā ||21 || ityetad darśitaṃ lakṣmi sāmarthyaṃ mama gauravam | mahimā mama bhakteśca darśitaste mahābalaḥ ||22|| ahiṃsā satyavacanaṃ sarvabhūtānukampanam | vrataṃ dānaṃ ca śāntiśca dharmā vai bhaktisaṃśritāḥ ||23|| upavāso’pi vai bhaktyā gatārtho bhavati dhruvam | brahmacaryaṃ ca bhaktyaiva gatārthaṃ mayi jāyate ||24|| vedavrataṃ cāgnikāryaṃ gurukāryaprasādhanam | svādhyāyaśceti dharmāḥ syurgatārthā bhaktikāriṇaḥ ||25|| atithivratatā cāpi prasādabhojanaṃ ca me | bhukte parijane paścād bhojanaṃ samaśīlatā ||26|| dampatyoreva gṛhiṇo surebhyo’nnanivedanam | satāṃ sevāniśaṃ cāpi gatārthā bhaktikāriṇaḥ ||27|| pālanaṃ dānamudyogo yajñaśca bharaṇaṃ tathā | pitṛsevā svāmisevā gatārthā bhaktikāriṇaḥ ||28|| gavādeḥ pālanaṃ cāgnihotraṃ satpathavartanam | tyāgo damaḥ svāgataṃ ca gatārthā bhaktikāriṇaḥ ||29|| śuśrūṣā ca śubhācāro dīnatā bhṛtyatādikam | dāsītā dāsatā ceti gatārthā bhaktikāriṇaḥ ||3.75.30|| sādhavo lokasārā vai sanatkumārapūrvajāḥ | dhātrā sṛṣṭāḥ purā loke lokakalyāṇahetavaḥ ||31|| mayā lakṣmi sādhavastu bhaktimanto vinirmitāḥ | bahavaścātra saṃsāre mama māhātmyabodhakāḥ ||32|| lokām̐stārayituṃ kṛtsnān śaktāḥ kṣitau hi devatāḥ | brahmavidyā bhajanaṃ ca matkathā dhyānamutsavaḥ ||33|| manmantradānamityetat karmaṣaṭkaṃ satāṃ sadā | śaraṇāgatarakṣā ca mokṣaśca pāpanāśanam ||34|| bhaktidānaṃ brahmaśīlaṃ kartavyapañcakaṃ satām | vidvattā śāstraśīlatvaṃ svādhyāyo japanaṃ śrutam ||35|| ācāraśceti ṣaṭkaṃ vai satāṃ svābhāvikaṃ bhavet | śamaścoparatiḥ satsu prītiḥ satkṛtirityapi ||36|| hareḥ smṛtiḥ sadā brahmasthitiḥ satāṃ mahān vṛṣaḥ | mānakrodhādirāhityaṃ snigdhavāṇīmano’ntaraḥ ||37|| abhyāgataratiḥ śeṣaprasādabhojanaṃ tathā | kṣamā tṛptiśca santoṣaḥ satāṃ guṇāḥ svabhāvajāḥ ||38|| paricaryā tu vṛddhānāṃ gavāṃ dyuvāsināṃ hareḥ | nivṛttiḥ svāduvastubhyo dharmo mokṣāya tiṣṭhati ||39|| āśāpāśavimokṣaścāsaṃgitādhyātmacintanam | snehapāśavihīnatvaṃ cātmanyātmasamarpaṇam ||3.75.40 || parivrajati sādhuryo mokṣadṛṣṭena karmaṇā | mukto hyaṭati sarvatra mayi sthiro bhavet sadā ||41 || eṣa mokṣavidāṃ dharmo gatārtho bhaktikāriṇaḥ | bhakteḥ parataraṃ nāsti śāśvatānandadharmabhṛt ||42|| aduḥkhamuttamasukhamajarāmaramavyayam | sādhormokṣapadaṃ cāste sahaiva bhaktikāriṇaḥ ||43|| te suraiḥ samatāṃ yānti dyotayanti jagattrayam | bhaktidayādharmaparāstapasā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ ||44|| santaścakradharāḥ puṇyā mama lokacarāḥ śubhāḥ | mālācakradharā ghnanti pāpāni pāpināṃ kṣitau ||45|| kaṇṭhe kaṇṭhīdharā haste mālādhrā maddharā hṛdi | bhāle puṇḍradharā dehe śīladhrā bhaktikāriṇaḥ ||46|| citte kṣamādharā bhāve snehadhrāḥ prītivṛttayaḥ | buddhau mokṣapriyāścātmanyeva brahmadharāḥ sadā ||47|| āśriteṣu ca vātsalyadharā dhīdhrā vivecane | matkathāyāṃ rasadhrāśca bhūteṣūdāsitādharāḥ ||48|| bhogye’nāsaktiyuktāścāvaśyake yātrikā yathā | mayi tādātmyamāpannā brahmāmbarāḥ prapāvanāḥ ||49|| upāstipakṣayuktāśca satāṃ saṃgakarāḥ sadā | āśritārpitasantṛptāḥ sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ ||3.75.50 || eṣāṃ samāśrayāllakṣmi gatārthaṃ mokṣasādhanam | kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyeta dhāmasthānāṃ samāgamāt ||5 1 || ṛṣidharmaḥ sādhudharmaḥ satye śīle sadā ratiḥ | na stambhī na ca mānī syānnāprasanno na vismitaḥ |||52||| pitṛdevārcane rakto rātrimmanyo divā sadā | svāpammanyo jāgratau ca nimnammanyo guruttame ||53|| tamomanyaḥ prakāśe ca viṣammanyo rasottame | hāsammanyo mahāvṛddhau dainyammanyaḥ sagarvake ||54|| sampatsu vipadammanyo mṛtimmanyaśca jīvane | dharmammanyo hareḥ saṃge ratimmanyo hṛdantare ||55|| bhaktimatsu sukhammanyo janammanyo vanādiṣu | gatimmanyo’cyutagotre tārayatyeva sajjanaḥ ||56|| sādhustārayitā lakṣmi sādhvī tāraṇikā matā | tyāge mūlyaṃ na me cāsti mūlyaṃ bhaktau hi madgṛhe |||57|| bhaktimatāṃ sādhūnāṃ pūjayāmi caraṇau sadā | bhaktānāṃ cāpi sādhvīnāṃ sammānaṃ prakaromyaham ||58|| mayi bhaktistadā syādvai nivṛttiścānyato yadā | śame ratirmayi svāpaḥ kriḍākāṇḍo’pi vai mayi ||59|| ṛṣīkeśāḥ sādhavaste sādhvyaścāpi tathāvidhāḥ | mama bhaktibhṛtānandasandohāplavasamplutāḥ ||3.75.60|| deśeṣu mama vāseṣu nadīnāṃ nirjhareṣu ca | sravantīnāṃ nikuñjeṣu parvateṣu vaneṣu ca ||6 1|| bhaktālayeṣu vā santo vasanti mama yoginaḥ | yogacaryāparāścāpi vyomaśayyāsanāstathā ||62|| vṛkṣāśleṣāśanā nityaṃ vanyaparijanāḥ sadā | cīravalkalasaṃvītā mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ||63|| sukhaṃ vasanti nirvighne sadbhirdevagaṇaiḥ saha | sattvasthāḥ sarvamutsṛjya dīkṣitā mayi mādhave ||64|| evaṃvidhāḥ sādhuvṛttāḥ sādhuśīlā madāśrayāḥ | narā nāryaḥ priyā me vai teṣāṃ lokāḥ sanātanāḥ ||65|| sthitāḥ pāpe samutsṛjya pāpaṃ kurvanti satkriyām | puṇyaṃ bhaktiṃ tadā te’pi sādhutvamupayanti vai ||66|| sthito brahmiṣṭhadharmeṇa brāhmaṇyamupayāti ca | yaḥ ko’pi mama yogena brahmabhūyaṃ sa gacchati ||67|| adhyātma naiṣṭhikaṃ sadbhirbrahmakāmairniṣevyate | vanaṃ nārāyaṇaścāhaṃ satāṃ vāso mayi dhruve ||68|| vanaṃ gurustathā bodhyo gurau vāsaḥ satāṃ sadā | havanaṃ me ca naivedyaṃ yajño’haṃ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ||69|| cāturmāsyaṃ satāṃ cāhaṃ vratānyahaṃ satāṃ sadā | evamācāravanto vai sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ ||3.75.70|| vimuktāḥ sarvapāpaiste caranti sādhavo mayi | santaḥ satpathanityāste prayānti paramāṃ gatim ||7 1 || brahmalokaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ divyarddhimat suśāśvatam | prayānti munayaḥ siddhā lakṣmi matpadasaṃśrayāḥ ||72|| svayaṃ te nirbhayāścātra dadatyabhayadakṣiṇām | bhaktilābhaparā nityaṃ sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ ||73|| sarvabhūtānukampāśca sarvabhūtārjavavratāḥ | sarvabhūtātmabhūtāśca sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ ||74|| sarvavedeṣu vā snānaṃ sarvabhūteṣu darśanam | sarvātmasamatā yeṣāṃ te santaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ ||75|| ārjavaṃ vai satāṃ dharmo hyadharmo jihma eva ha | ārjavena yutā loke devatāḥ santi gocarāḥ ||76|| vyapetamāyo bhaktātmā prītyā satpathamāśritaḥ | cāritraparamo buddho brahmabhūyāya kalpate ||77|| śṛṇu lakṣmi māṃ vihāya karoti satkriyāmapi | aihikaṃ hi phalaṃ tasya vinā bhaktiṃ hi naśvaram ||78|| upavāsavratairyānti gandharvalokamuttamam | maṇḍūkavajjaleśāyī nāgalokaṃ prayāti vai ||79|| śaṣpapatrādibhakṣī tu pragacchatyamarāvatīm | śaivālaparṇabhakṣī tu vāruṇaṃ lokamṛcchati ||3.75.80|| phalamūlānilādastu yakṣalokaṃ pragacchati | agnitapaḥparo rājā prāṇaroddhā nṛpo bhavet| ||8 1 || anaśane rato rājā svarge divi pramodate | jalābdhau dehamaraṇe vāruṇaṃ lokamṛcchati ||82|| aśmanā caraṇau bhittvā mṛto bhavati guhyakaḥ | hatvāgnau dehamutsṛjya vahniloke prajāyate ||83|| vīrarītyā gato lokaṃ śaktasya sa tu vindate | kāmagena vimānena modate sa surādibhiḥ ||84|| yogidīkṣāṃ gṛhītvā ca rudralokaṃ prayāti saḥ | dhanadānāni dattvā tu kuberālayamṛcchati ||85|| svarṇadānāni ca datvā sūryalokaṃ prayāti saḥ | peyadānāni dattvā ca candralokaṃ prayāti saḥ ||86 || vastradānāni dattvā tu grahalokān prayāti saḥ | kanyādānāni dattvā tu cāpsarolokamṛcchati ||87|| yānadānāni dattvātra yāti vaimānikaṃ gṛham | annadānāni dattvātra pitṛlokaṃ prayāti saḥ ||88|| brahmadānāni dattvātra satyalokaṃ prayāti ca | aiśvaryādipradānena yātīśvarālayān sa vai ||89|| bhaktyā sarvasvadānena mama lokaṃ prayāti saḥ | yadi māṃ smarati tatra cānyathā yāti taijasam ||3.75.90|| vairājapadamevāyaṃ madbhaktyā tu padaṃ mama | tāni sarvāṇi dānāni mahyaṃ tatrāntarātmane || 91 || smṛtvā dadāti bhaktyā cennayāmi brahma śāśvatam | evaṃ me mahimā lakṣmi bhāvanāmātragocaraḥ ||92|| bhāvanābhakṣakaścāhaṃ bhāvanātantubandhanaḥ | bhāvanārūpapatreṇa copatiṣṭhāmi sannidhau ||93|| sādhvyaḥ santo bhāvanāḍhyāstato manmayamūrtayaḥ | madācārā mama dehāstārakāḥ pāpināṃ sadā ||94|| tebhyo nāṇuḥ prabhedo’sti mama sarvārthayojane | ta evāhamahaṃ te ca hārdaṃ te kathitaṃ mama ||95|| bhavatyo bhaktimatyo me sarvā brahmapriyāḥ striyaḥ | sādhvya eva sadā sthātra tārikā mokṣadāḥ śubhāḥ ||96|| bhavatīnāṃ nivāso’trākṣaraṃ dhāma tadeva hi | bhavatīnāṃ sannidhānaṃ satsaṃgaḥ śāśvato hi saḥ || 97|| bhavatīnāṃ sevanaṃ ca sadātmasevanaṃ param | bhavatīnāṃ darśanādi sadā muktipradaṃ śubham ||98|| bhavatīnāṃ kriyāḥ sarvā madyogād brahmasaṃjñikāḥ | bhavatīnāṃ śarīrāṇi puruṣottamavanti vai ||99|| bhavatīnāṃ ca sarvasvaṃ cāhaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | tataḥ śrīpuruṣottamyo bhavatyaḥ santi sarvathā || 3.75.1 00|| na me manāg bhavatībhyo bhedo’tra ca paratra ca | yūyaṃ cāhamahaṃ yūyaṃ sarvaṃ me bhavatīkṛtam || 10 1|| evaṃ matvāparā yā madbhaktiyuktā bhaviṣyati | tadā tasyā bhavatīnāṃ tulyatā vai bhaviṣyati || 1 02|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya jñānasya śravaṇādapi | sādhvībhāvodayaḥ syācca brahmapriyātvamṛcchati || 1 03|| rādhāramāsamānatvaṃ bhaved bhaktyā na saṃśayaḥ | brahmamuktasamānatvaṃ bhaved bhaktyā na saṃśayaḥ || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vahniprakāśanatirobhāvau, sādhupratāpo, vividhaphalaprāptiḥ, sādhusaṃgame mama prāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 75 ||
<3.76> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ māhātmyaṃ me tato’dhikam | bāleṣu cāghaśūnyeṣu hyanātheṣu vasāmyaham || 1 || bālānāṃ hṛdayaṃ śuddhaṃ māyājihmatvavarjitam | vāsanādirahite’smin sādhuvannivasāmyaham || 2 || bālāḥ sarve mūrtayo me svacchā ādarśasadṛśāḥ | brahmāvasthāstato bālā yogāvasthā yathā janāḥ || 3 || mūrtyavasthāśca me bālā bālikāścāṣṭavarṣagāḥ | ete sarve sādhavo vai sanakādyā yathā purā || 4 || sādhudharmāḥ sādhavaste gṛhadharmāstu yauvane | yuvabhāvavihīnāstu sādhavo brahmacāriṇaḥ || 5 || sādhutvaṃ śīlavartitvaṃ gṛhitvaṃ kāmayogataḥ | kāmajaye hi sādhutvaṃ kāmino’pi prajāyate || 6 || akāmino’pi saṃbhoge kāme gārhasthyameva tat | na strīyogo na puṃyogo gārhasthye kāraṇaṃ bhavet || 7 || ratiprayogo gārhasthyaṃ taddhīnatvaṃ ca sādhutā | sā ca nāryāṃ nare cāpi bhavenniṣkāmabhāvane || 8 || akāmaḥ satyakāmo vai sarvakāmaḥ prajāyate | sa eva brahma vijñeyo brāhmaṇyaṃ sādhutānvitam || 9 || brahmiṣṭhatvaṃ durlabhaṃ śri sādhutvaṃ durlabhaṃ tathā | matkṛpāto bhavatyeva brahmiṣṭhatā ca sādhutā || 3.76.1 0|| sādhvītā matkṛpātaśca jāyate mokṣadā śubhā | vaṃśoddhāraṇakartrī ca sādhvītā ca yathā tvayi || 1 1|| satyadharmaratā sādhvyaḥ santo brahmaparāstathā | yadṛcchālābhasantuṣṭā haṭhāḍambaravarjitāḥ || 1 2|| dharmalabdhārthabhoktāraḥ parameśasamarpakāḥ | nirbandhāḥ svacchahṛdayāḥ sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ || 1 3|| guṇakarmatapobhiḥ śri naro nārāyaṇo bhavet | mālinyaṃ samparityajya nīco’pyuccataro bhavet || 14|| yathā janmāntare śūdraḥ karmaṇā dharmasaṃbhṛtā | uttare janmani vipro jāyate puṇyayogataḥ|| 15|| tathaikasmin janau cāpi brahmācāraistu brāhmaṇaḥ | jāyeta brāhmaṇetaro vipro’pi śūdratāṃ vrajet || 16|| śubhāśubhakriyāsaṃgapāpapuṇyabalaṃ mahat | vivartayati dharmān vai sattvādhiko hi bhūsuraḥ || 17|| rajo’dhiko bhaved rājā tamo’dhikastu śūdrakaḥ | sattvarajobhyāṃ saṃspṛṣṭo vaiśyo bhavati śobhanaḥ || 18|| rajastamobhyāṃ saṃspṛṣṭo vaiśyo bhavatyaśobhanaḥ | tamomātrābahulastu ghātakī śvapaco bhavet || 19|| sattvamātrābahulastu vipraḥ sādhuḥ satī bhavet | brahmayogabahulastu mukto bhavati vai kṣitau ||3.76.20|| ityetat kathitaṃ lakṣmi cotkṛṣṭatvaṃ śubhāvaham | mama yogaparaścātra nārāyaṇo’pi jāyate ||21 || tadyogena tathā cānye nārāyaṇā bhavantyapi | evaṃ paramparā nārāyaṇānāṃ mama yogataḥ ||22|| bhavatyeva prabhāveṇa mamaiśvaryādilābhataḥ | nārāyaṇā narāḥ sarve nārāyaṇyaḥ striyastathā ||23|| upāsanayā jāyante mamaiva paramātmanaḥ | devatā vasavo rudrā jāyante viṣṇavastathā ||24|| upāsanayā jāyante brahmāṇaśceśvarāstathā | īśvarāṇyaśca jāyante mamopāsanayā rame || 25|| vītarāgā vimucyante karmabhiḥ karmabandhanaiḥ | yaiśca nārāyaṇāste vai jāyante samanuṣṭhitaiḥ ||26|| tāni sarvāṇi karmāṇi madupāstimayāni hi | ṛte copāsanāṃ me vai bali karma nāsti vai ||27|| upāsanā sakāmānāṃ kāmanāpūrikā bhavet | niṣkāmānāmahaṃ smṛddhaḥ smṛddhidātā prasahya vai ||28|| karmaṇā manasā vācā māmupāste hi bhaktimān | na sajjane ca kartavye bandhanaṃ naiva gacchati ||29|| prāṇayātrātipātādvai viratāḥ śīlayoginaḥ | tulyadveṣapriyā dāntā mucyante karmabandhanaiḥ ||3.76.30 || sarvabhūtadayāvanto viśvāsyāḥ sarvadehinām | kṛtabhaktisamācārā lokāste dhāmagāminaḥ ||3 1 || svārthaśūnyāḥ parakāryasahāyadā nirāśayā | dharmalabdhapratuṣṭāśca lokāste dhāmagāminaḥ ||32|| nārīvargeṣu paśyanti mātṛsvasṛduhitṛvat | naravargeṣu paśyanti pitṛmātṛsuputravat ||33|| yathoktasādhusevāḍhyā mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ | astenā bhāgyajīvāśca lokāste dhāmagāminaḥ ||34|| naijabhogyaratā ye ca dharmakālābhisāriṇaḥ | agrāmyasukhalubdhāśca hṛccakṣustejasānvitāḥ ||35|| indramārgānusārāścendriyāvaśyātmasaṃsthitāḥ | mama bhaktau kṛtāvāsā lokāste dhāmagāminaḥ ||36|| akaṣāyakṛto mārgo dānadharmatapomayaḥ | śīlaśaucadayāḍhyaśca bhaktisevārpaṇānvitaḥ ||37|| āśīḥprasannatādaśca satsaṃgaphalavardhanaḥ | nairmalyadhīprakarṣāḍhyaḥ sevanīyaḥ sadā budhaiḥ ||38|| ātmahetoḥ parārthe vā narmahāsyāśrayācca vā | mṛṣābhāvavihīnā ye yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||39|| vṛttyarthaṃ dharmahetorvā kāmakārācca ye janāḥ | bhāṣante nānṛtaṃ te vai yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||3.76.40 || miṣṭāṃ vāṇīṃ bādhaśūnyāṃ pāpaleśavivarjitām | hārdasnehāṃ ye bhāṣante yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||41|| apaiśūnyaratāḥ santo mitrābhedapravartanāḥ | adrohāḥ ṛtamaitrāśca yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||42|| śāṭhyaśūnyāḥ saumyavācaḥ kopabhāvavivarjitāḥ | hṛdvidāraṇaśūnyāste yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||43|| sāntvayuktā hitavācaḥ satyaguṇā hariśritāḥ | sādhavaḥ sādhvikā lakṣmi yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||44|| manasāpi na vāñcchanti nirjane’pi dhanaṃ param | nyastaṃ vā militaṃ ye te yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||45|| grāme gṛhe’pi pārakyaṃ nābhivāñcchanti vai kvacit | ajātaśatravo ye te yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||46|| śrutavanto bhaktimantaḥ satyadayāprapālakāḥ | nityatuṣṭā virāgāste yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||47|| maitrīcittaratāḥ śraddhāsnehopakārasammukhāḥ | phalavipākavijñāste yantyakaṣāyasatpathe ||48|| nyāyyāgrahāḥ svargaśīlāḥ samutthānaparāyaṇāḥ | ātmaniṣṭhā matparāste yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||49|| mahāprājñā brahmaparā jñānavijñānabhāvinaḥ | tarkaśāstraparā ye te yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||3.76.50|| pāpatrāsānvitāścāpi śreyaḥsādhanatatparāḥ | ānṛṇyābhilaṣukāste yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||51 || ye tu śuklābhijātīyāścātmadrohavivarjitāḥ | jantutrāsākarāścāpyabhayadānapradāstayā ||52|| ātmavatsnehabhāvāśca devavatsughaṭāḥ śubhāḥ | daivācārāḥ saumyabhāvā yāntyakalmaṣasatpathe ||53|| suvṛttāḥ satkarmiṇaśca prāṇidrohavivarjitāḥ | dīrghāyuṣo bhavantīha yāntyakalmaṣasatpathe ||54|| dātā satāṃ ca satkartā dīnārtakṛpaṇādiṣu | bhakṣyabhojyānnapānānāṃ dātāmbarādidāyakaḥ ||55|| bhaktiyogakṛtāvāso jñānadānapradāyakaḥ | śaraṇāgatarakṣaśca yātyakalmaṣasatpathe ||56 || pratiśrayān sabhāḥ kūpān kuryāt puṣkariṇī prapāḥ | āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ gṛhaṃ ratnaṃ dhanaṃ manaḥ ||57|| sasyajātāni sarvāṇi gāḥ kṣetrāṇi ca kanyakāḥ | yaśca prītamanā dāne prayacchati ca pātrake ||58|| sarvasvārpaṇakartā vai yātyakalmaṣasatpathe | devatādvijasādhūnāṃ satīnāṃ pūjakastathā ||59|| namaskartā praśritaśca sarvapriyakaraḥ śuciḥ | sarvahitaḥ sumukhaśca yathārhasatkriyāparaḥ || 3.76.60|| sanmārgadarśī gurvarcī yātyakalmaṣasatpathe | sammataḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ ||61 || udāttakulajātīya udāttābhijanastathā | maitradṛṣṭiḥ pitṛsamo viśvāsyaḥ sarvajantuṣu ||62||| bhaktimān me mahāpuṇyo yātyakaṣāyasatpathe | evaṃvidhaḥ sadā lakṣmi nirbādhaṃ sukhamedhate || 63|| eṣa śreṣṭhaḥ satāṃ panthā bādhā yatra na vidyate | sādhūn vai vedaviduṣaḥ siddhān bhaktiyutāṃstathā ||64|| sevante ye bhāvayutā varjayantyaśubhaṃ sadā | teṣāṃ śāśvatasaukhyāḍhyaḥ panthā brahmagatipradaḥ ||65|| eṣāṃ samāgamairlakṣmi kalyāṇāni bhavanti vai | śreyāṃsi sarvarūpāṇi svargāṇyasaṃkhyakāni ca ||66 || pratipadyanta evātra satāṃ dharme sthitasya vai | nṛṇāṃ hitārthamevātra mayā te samudāhṛtam ||67|| hitaṃ cātmā vivekastho nijaṃ jānāti cāntare | paraṃ kartuṃ na śaknoti vinā sadgurusaṃśrayam ||68|| puṇyaṃ labdhuṃ samicchanti mānavāḥ sarvadā priye | puṇyahetūnna kurvanti mūḍhāḥ satyapi vaibhave ||69|| satāṃ saṃgānmamasaṃgāt sādhvīsaṃgācchubhaṃ param | śreyaḥ paraṃ bhavatyeva jānantyeva ca tattathā ||3.76.70 || tathāpi pāpabādhābhirbādhitāstarkanimnagāḥ | abhimānamahāduṣṭagrāsānanagatāḥ sadā ||71 || na sevante sataḥ sādhvīrnārcayanti ca māṃ tathā | viṣayeṣvabhirāgāśca patanti nirayādiṣu ||72|| na taranti pāpaduṣṭā māyānadīṃ manoharām | nāstikā dānaśūnyāśca bhāvaśūnyāḥ pradūṣakāḥ ||73|| bhaktibhāvavihīnāśca divyabhāvavivarjitāḥ | duṣṭabhāvayutā nityaṃ dehadṛṣṭiyutāḥ sadā ||74|| nikṛṣṭakarmasu ratāḥ svārthamātraparāyaṇāḥ | udarendriyasutṛptā bāhyasaukhyābhidṛṣṭayaḥ ||75|| anātmamātraniratā yānti nirayameva te | ātmamātraratāḥ sādhudharmaratāśca sevakāḥ ||76|| ājñāpālanakartāro yāntyakalmaṣamatpathe | varṇāstathāśramā lakṣmi ye ke’pi syurnarāḥ striyaḥ ||77|| vṛddhāśīrvādasaubhāgyāḥ prayānti svargameva te | vadhvaḥ kanyāḥ kumāryo vā svāminyo vā saputrakāḥ ||78|| aputrā vāpi vṛddhāśīrvādasthāḥ svaḥ prayānti tāḥ | pradhānā vāpi rājāno bhṛtyā vā dīnavartinaḥ || 79|| sasattā vāpyasattā vā nityaṃ vṛddhopasevinaḥ | ṛjavo namratāsārāḥ svaḥ prayānti na saṃśayaḥ ||3.76.80|| ye’tra loke yaśobhāgāḥ sevakāḥ svargabhāginaḥ | te gantāraḥ padaṃ cordhvaṃ mamānugrahasaṃbhavāt ||81 || sādhuśīlāḥ sādhuvṛttāḥ kṣamiṇaḥ sevinastathā | sevābhiḥ sukhadātāro dyugatā yānti matpadam ||82|| yeṣāṃ mukhe harernāma hṛdaye śrīhariḥ svayam | vṛddhājñāvacanāścāpi matpadāśrayiṇo hi te ||83 || gosutāsutadātāro vāṭikākṣetrasaudhadāḥ | kaṭisakthyaṃkadātāro dyugatā yānti matpadam ||84|| gāṃ viprāya sutāṃ kumārāya sutaṃ ca sādhave | vāṭīṃ devāya me kṣetraṃ saudhaṃ kuṭumbiyogine ||85|| kaṭiṃ balaṃ ca bhītāya śaraṇaṃ sakthi kaṣṭine | aṃkaṃ dravyaṃ daridrāya datvā yānti divaṃ janāḥ ||86|| tato bhaktiṃ mamāsādya mahyamarpaṇakāriṇaḥ | ta eva sādhavo yānti matpadaṃ kamalāśritam ||87|| keśauṣṭhagaṇḍadātāro vakṣaḥpṛṣṭhakarapradāḥ | grīvājaṃghāpādadāśca yānti svargaṃ ca matpadam ||88|| keśān brahmeśaviṣṇūm̐śca datvā sannyāsamāśritāḥ | prayānti mama bhaktāste svargaṃ tato’mṛtaṃ padam ||89|| oṣṭhau cādeśamantrau ca dattvācāryapadaṃ śritāḥ | prayānti bhaktimanto me svargaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ tataḥ ||3.76.90|| gaṇḍau premasnehabhāvau hārdikau bhaktipūrvakau | datvā me mama bhaktāḥ śri prayānti svastato’kṣaram ||9 1|| vakṣo viśvāsamevāpi kṛtvā datvā ca taṃ mayi | viśvasto yāti vai svargaṃ tato matpadamakṣaram ||92|| pṛṣṭhaṃ sāhāyyamārpyaiva paralokapradaṃ śubham | svarge pūrvaṃ tato bhaktyā yāti maddhāma cottamam ||93|| karau sevāṃ ca dāsyaṃ ca kṛtvā datvārpaṇaṃ mayi | svargaṃ yāti tato bhaktyā mama dhāma prayāti saḥ ||94|| grīvāṃ sarvasvamevāpi jīvadānamathāpi vā | prāṇadānaṃ ca me dattvā yāti svargaṃ tato’kṣaram ||95|| jaṃghe sampat kulaṃ cobhe datvā me svaḥ prayāti hi | tato’rpayya samastaṃ ca mama dhāma prayāti saḥ ||96 || pādau dhanaṃ jīvikāṃ ca yo dadāti mahātmane | svargatvā mama bhaktyā ca prayāti dhāma cākṣaram ||97|| evaṃ dānāni vai lakṣmi jñātvā nāryā nareṇa ca | yathārthāni ca guptāni deyāni mokṣakāṃkṣayā ||98|| yoṣādānaṃ pradātavyaṃ bahubhāvena vai sadā | yoṣā māyā samākhyātā yā uṣā rajanīmukhā ||99|| bandhayitrī hi jīvānāṃ sā deyā paramātmane | svayaṃ māyāvihīnaḥ san prayāti paramaṃ padam || 3.76.10 0|| kanyādānaṃ pradātavyaṃ kumārāya sukhapradam | kanyā tṛṣṇā sukhāśā sā kumārāya parātmane || 101 || śārṅgiṇe māraśūnyāya datvātmā dhāma saṃvrajet | godānaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ goḥ jñānaṃ śrīhareḥ śubham || 1 02|| datvā dātā grahītā ca yātārau dhāma cākṣaram | ityevaṃ lakṣmi vijñāya māhātmyaṃ mama ye tviha || 1 03|| karmabhūmau prakurvanti vicaranti vimuktaye | śāśvatānandabhoktāro bhavanti matpadāśraye || 1 04|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ te’tra māhātmyaṃ mama yogajam | adhikaṃ paṭhanāccāpi śravaṇād bhuktimuktidam || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne brāhmaṇyasādhutvaprāpakasādhanāni dhāmagamanasādhanāni cākaṣāyasatpathasādhanāni divyadānādīni hareryogaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 76 ||
<3.77> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca sādhvīdharmān samastān vai vaktumarhasi mādhava | sādhvyaḥ sarvā bhavaddehājjātā māyāparā hi tāḥ || 1 || loke’tra vai kathaṃ tābhirvartitavyaṃ nirantaram | kṛṣṇadhavā hi tyāginyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginya eva tāḥ || 2 || haripriyāśca tāḥ sarvāḥ kṛṣṇakāntā hi yoṣitaḥ | brāhmyastāśca mahābhāgavatyaḥ sāttvatya eva tāḥ || 3 || sarvathātmanivedinyo varteran kena cādhvanā | pātivratyaṃ kathaṃ tāsāṃ vinā vivāhitaṃ patim || 4 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ tyāgadīkṣitayoṣitām | dīkṣā vivāha evāsti mayā sākaṃ hi yojitaḥ || 5 || oṃnamaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | iti mantreṇa sā sādhvī vivāhitāgnisannidhau || 6 || homaṃ kṛtvā dīkṣitā sā mama mūrtyā samaṃ tadā | pūjayitvā ca māṃ prāptā niveditāgnimaṇḍape || 7 || mama kāṣāyāmbarāṇi svīcakāra ca sā satī | gurvājñayā ca me kāntā jātāsti dīkṣitakṣaṇāt || 8 || ataścāsyāḥ kṛṣṇa eva patiścāsmi narāyaṇaḥ | vivāhitaiva sā cāste pātivratyaṃ sadā mayi || 9 || pālanīyaṃ tayā sādhvyā pāvanyā mama yoṣitā | mamādhvanā hi gaccheyurvarteram̐śca mamādhvanā || 3.77.10 || divyabhaktyā ca varteran mokṣādhvanā sadadhvanā | sādhusevāṃ prakuryuśca sādhavo mama mūrtayaḥ || 1 1|| niṣkāmavṛttyā varteran sevayeyustathaiva ca | sarvathātmanivedinyo bhaveyurmama mūrtiṣu || 1 2|| sādhvīdharmāḥ strīdharmāste vivāhe ṛṣibhiḥ kṛtāḥ | sahadharmādicāriṇyo bharturbhavanti lagnake || 13|| tasmāllagnavatī patnī yathā patyurnideśinī | tathā tyāgavatī sādhvī patyurme’sti nideśinī || 14|| agniṃ sākṣiṇamāsādya guruṃ ca pitarāvapi | gaṇeśaṃ ca tathā māṃ ca patnī sādhvī same hyubhe || 15|| pātivratyaṃ paraṃ dharmaṃ gṛhṇītaḥ sa vṛṣaḥ samaḥ | pātnīvratyaṃ tathā patyurharerme ca samaṃ tathā || 16|| sahadharmacarī bharturbhavatyagnyādisannidhau | sahadharmacaraḥ patnyā bhavatyagnyādisannidhau || 17|| sahadharmacaraṃ kāntamanusmaret sadārpitā | susvabhāvā suvacanā suvṛttā sukhadarśanā || 18|| ananyacittā sumukhī bhartuḥ sadharmacāriṇī | bhavet saddharmaparamā bhavet saddharmabhāginī || 19|| devadevaṃ svabhartāraṃ sādhvī nityaṃ vilokayet | śuśrūṣāṃ paricaryāṃ ca kuryād divyakriyānvitā ||3.77.20|| nānyabhāvā hyavimanāḥ subhāvā sukhadāyinī | putravaktramivābhīkṣṇaṃ bhartrānanaṃ vilokayet ||21 || namet suniyamāḍhyā ca bhartāraṃ dharmacāriṇī | jñātvā dampatīdharmāṃśca sahadharmān nijāśritān ||22|| matvaiva dharmaparamā bhavet bhartusamavratā | devadevaṃ hi bhartāraṃ seveta śāntisaṃyutā ||23|| suprasannamukhī bharturbhavedevāpi śikṣitā | tāḍitoktā paruṣāṇi vaśyā tathāpi nityadā ||24|| nānyaṃ naraṃ spṛśet sādhvī nirīkṣeta na kāmataḥ | hāsyabhāvādibhiścāpi nānyena saha vartayet ||25|| bhartṛvarjaṃ priyaṃ nāsti yasyā ucchiṣṭameva tat | bhartṛyuktaṃ priyaṃ sarvaṃ mahāprasāda eva tat ||26|| bhartrājñā bhagavatsvājñā bhartā śrīparameśvaraḥ | bhartrārohā bhaved yā sā bhavedvai dharmacāriṇī ||27|| daridraṃ vyādhitaṃ dīnaṃ duḥkhitaṃ śramitaṃ mṛdum | patiṃ kāntamupāste yā sā bhaved dharmabhāginī ||28|| putriṇī kanyakā mātā cānapatyā ca niṣphalā | patipriyā patiprāṇā yā sā syād dharmabhāginī ||29|| dāsyaṃ bhṛtyatvamevāpi kaiṃkaryaṃ kurvatī ca yā | śuśrūṣaṇaṃ paricaryāṃ kurvatī dharmabhāginī ||3.77.30|| vinītā komalavṛttiḥ snigdhā patyau sthirāśayā | patyarthakṛtasarvasvā sā bhaved dharmabhāginī ||3 1|| na kāmeṣu na bhogeṣu naiśvaryeṣu sukheṣu na | spṛhā yasyā yathā kānte sā sādhvī dharmabhāginī ||32|| prāgutthānapriyā prātargṛhasevāparāyaṇā | sammārjanapralepādiśuddhiparā ca yā sadā ||33|| agnikāryaparā cāpi devakāryaparā tathā | kartavyārthaparā yā syāt sā bhaved dharmabhāginī ||34|| devatātithibhṛtyānāṃ patyurvṛddhajanasya ca | yathāpekṣaṃ pradattvaiva jalādi toṣayettu yā ||35|| tān sarvān bhojayitvaiva śeṣānnaṃ bhuṃkta eva yā | tuṣṭapuṣṭakuṭumbā ca sā bhaveddharmabhāginī ||36|| śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ pādau sevamānā natā sadā | mātṛpitṛparā nityaṃ sā bhaveddharmabhāginī ||37|| sādhūn dīnānanāthām̐śca bibhartyannādibhistu yā | yathāśakti svāmidharmā sā bhaveddharmabhāginī ||38|| brahmiṣṭhāvat patisthā yā patyanyaṃ puruṣaṃ kvacit | api catuḥkhanisthaṃ vai nekṣate baddhanetrikā ||39|| durlabhā tādṛśī loke vinā lakṣmīṃ hṛdi sthitām | vinā satīṃ śaṃbhuhṛtsthāṃ cādṛśyabhāvamāsthitām ||3.77.40|| vrataṃ carati yā svāmyaṃ duścaraṃ patinoditam | paticittā patihitā sā bhaveddharmabhāginī ||41|| puṇyametat svargametat tapaścaitad vrataṃ ca tat | bhartā hyeva paro devo yasyā nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||42|| patirdevo hi nārīṇāṃ patirguruḥ patirgatiḥ | patirbanghuḥ patirbhāgyaṃ patiḥ prāṇaḥ parāyaṇaḥ ||43|| patiprasādaḥ svargo’sti nirayaḥ patyatoṣaṇam | akāryaṃ cāpyadharmaṃ vā prāṇanāśakaraṃ ca vā ||44|| patirbrūyāt tathā kuryāt pātivratyaṃ paro vṛṣaḥ | dāridryaṃ vyādhirāpadvā śatrutā śāpadagdhatā ||45|| vicittatvaṃ ca vā patyuḥ sarvaṃ svānuguṇaṃ kriyāt | subhāgyaṃ sarvamevaitanmatvā seveta vai patim ||46|| evaṃ sarvasvārpaṇā yā vartate patigāminī | āpaddharmānanuprekṣya sā prātivratyayoginī ||47|| patiścāhaṃ sadā sādhvyā yathā loke vivāhitaḥ | sādhvī madarthamevātra varteta matparāyaṇā ||48|| madarthasnānaśuddhiśca madarthāmalatānvitā | madarthaṃ ca kṛtaveṣā madarthaṃ rūpaśālinī ||49|| madarthasarvasaṃskārā sādhvī me vai pativratā | raktāmbarā madarthaṃ kāṣāyavastrā madarthinī ||3.77.50|| puṇḍracandrādiyuktā ca madarthaṃ gandhayoginī | madarthaṃ puṣpahārā ca madarthaṃ mālyadhāriṇī ||51|| madarthaṃ kaṇṭhapaddhastabhūṣā sādhvī pativratā | madarthaṃ bhojanāhārā madarthaṃ pānayoginī ||52|| madarthaṃ kṛtaśṛṃgārā madarthaṃ bhogavāhanā | madarthaṃ kṛdalaṃkārā sādhvī sā me pativratā ||53|| madarthaṃ keśaveṣā ca madarthaṃ kṛtakañcukī | madarthaṃ kṛtaśāṭī ca madarthaṃ kaṭivastriṇī ||14|| madarthaṃ karapādā ca madarthakṛtamastakā | madarthakṛtkabandhā ca madarthāntaracāriṇī ||55|| madarthaguṇabhāvā ca madarthānandavarṣiṇī | mannāmaguṇamagnā ca sādhvī sā me pativratā ||56|| madarthanityasattvasthā madarthanityarājasī | madartharodhasaṃyuktā madarthasneharakṣiṇī ||57|| madarthahṛdayā nityaṃ madarthakāmakāriṇī | evaṃ vai vartamānā yā sā me harivratā satī ||58|| api puṇyamapi dharmaṃ karma cācaraṇaṃ śubham | yadvānyat kurvatī sādhvī śīlasaubhāgyayoginī ||59|| matparā syānmadviśrāntā matprāṇā mallayānvitā | manmūrtireva varteta sā sādhvī me harivratā ||3.77.6 0|| madarthatyāgadharmā ca madarthasatyaśālinī | madarthaṃ ca kṛtasvāpā madarthaṃ jāgrati sthitā ||6 1 || madarthaṃ vyāpṛtā cāste madarthaṃ vinivṛttikā | evaṃ madarthasantoṣā madarthāhiṃsanavratā ||62|| madarthayajñasannyāsā madarthahomasatkriyā | madarthaṃ brahmacaryasthā madarthaṃ cāparigrahā || 63|| madarthaśaucācārā ca madarthaṃ tapaāsthitā | madarthaṃ svādhyāyaparā madarthopāsanāyutā ||64|| madarthendriyavyāpārā madarthamānasā sadā | madarthāhaṃ cantanā ca madarthanirṇayānvitā ||65|| madarthasattvayatnā ca madarthabhāvanāśrayā | madarthaiśvaryasiddhiśca madarthadhyānasaṃsthitā ||66|| madarthaśuklamārgasthā madarthātithipūjanā | madarthapācanakāryā madarthāhāragocarā ||67|| madarthagṛhaśālāḍhyā madarthagītikīrtanā | madarthaṃ nṛtyabhāvasthā madarthaṃ ca kathāśravā ||68|| madarthaṃ ca mahotsāhā madarthatīrthacāriṇī | madarthaṃ kṛtayātrā ca madarthapuṣpavāṭikā ||69|| madarthaṃ kṛtavyāpārā madarthakrayavikrayā | madarthaṃ kṛṣiyatnāḍhyā madarthaṃ rāṣṭrarakṣiṇī ||3.77.70|| madarthaṃ sevanaṃ yasyā madarthaṃ bhṛtyatānvitā | madarthaṃ dāsyamāpannā madarthaṃ sarvasaṃvidhā ||7 1|| madarthagamanādānā madarthālocanānvitā | evaṃ madarthatāṃ prāptā sādhvī sā me harivratā ||72|| madarthaṃ kārtikavratā madarthaṃ pauṣatāpasī | madarthaṃ caitrapuṇyāḍhyā madarthaṃ śrāvaṇīsthitā ||73 || madarthaṃ dīpadā cāpi madarthaṃ paṃktibhojanā | madarthaṃ śiṣyatāṃ prāptā madarthaṃ gurutāṃ gatā ||74|| madarthaṃ sarvaśiṣyābhiḥ samanvitāpi sevikā | gurvī gurupadaṃ prāptā manmūrtiścāpi sā satī ||75|| sādhvī sādhvīsamācārā sā sādhvī me harivratā | evaṃvidhā tyāgadharmā mama lakṣmi pativratā ||76|| rādhāsakhyastathā lakṣmīsakhyaḥ śrīsakhya ityapi | māṇikīsakhya evāpi satīsakhyaśca yāḥ śubhāḥ ||77|| sāvitrīsakhya evāpi sītāsakhyaśca yāstathā | bhaktisakhyaśca yāḥ sarvā nārāyaṇyaśca yā matāḥ ||78|| vāsudevyastathā kārṣṇyo brahmapriyāśca yāstathā | vaiṣṇavyo bhagavatyaśca brāhmyo muktānya ityapi ||79|| yāstathā pārameśvaryaṃ īśānyaścāpi yoṣitaḥ | īśvaryaścāpi sarvāstāḥ sādhvyo me vai pativratāḥ ||3.77.80 || yāsāṃ yadarthaṃ sarvasvaṃ kāntārthaṃ sarvameva me | ityanyonyaṃ sādhusādhvībhāvo’haṃ parameśvaraḥ ||81|| māṃ vinā nahi sādhvyastāstā vinā nahi cāsmyaham | parasparānuyogasthā bhogamuktipradā nṛṇām ||82|| devānāmīśvarāṇāṃ ca siddhānāṃ brahmavādinām | sarveṣāṃ dehinaḥ cāpi bhogadā muktidā vayam ||83|| nibodha lakṣmi māhātmyaṃ te sakhīnāṃ tavāpi ca | mamāpi mama muktānāṃ māhātmyaṃ cāvadhehi tat ||84|| ahaṃ san bhagavān sākṣātparabrahmapareśvaraḥ | cit sādhvī tvaṃ satīvargā brahmapriyā haripriyāḥ ||85|| tadyogena sadānando mahānandāsti cāvayoḥ | śāśvatānanda evāsti tadbhoktā mukta eva ha ||86|| ahaṃ sādhuḥ ramā sādhvī lakṣmīḥ satī sadāsti vai | śrīḥ sampat māṇikī saukhyaṃ pañcaitad daivataṃ param ||87|| sādhuḥ sarvavidhaṃ saukhyaṃ dadāti ca karoti ca | sādhvī sarvavidhaṃ saukhyaṃ dadāti ca karoti ca ||88|| satī satyaṃ vartayati sampad bhadratvamuttam | rakṣatyeva tataḥ saukhyaṃ pravartata hi śāśvatam ||89|| sarvadā muktitulyaṃ vai parabrahmabhṛtaṃ mahat | evaṃ lakṣmi sadā sādhvī pārabrāhmī satī mama ||3.77.90 || sarvānandaparipūrṇā modate svāminā mayā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena paramātmanā ||91 || dehaścāyaṃ naro nārī nātmā nārī naro’pi vā | ātmārāmā munayaśca sādhavaḥ sādhvikāstathā | |92|| brahmātmaniṣṭhā madyogā madbhāvā macchrayāstathā | narā nāryaḥ śeṣabhūtāsteṣu nārāyaṇo’smyaham ||93 || naramāśrayati yā sā nārī cātmā madāśritaḥ | evaṃ sarve tathātmāno nāryaścāśrayadharmataḥ ||94|| āśrayado naraścāhaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ | evaṃ tattvaṃ viditveha sādhvī saubhāgyayoginī ||95|| mama kāntāṃ viditvā svāṃ pātivratyaṃ sadācaret | alokakāntā sā sādhvī kṛṣṇakāntā pativratā ||96|| loke yuvā bhavet kānto yuvatyā dehayogataḥ | ahantu sarvadā kānto garbhe bālye ca yauvane ||97|| vārdhakye maraṇe cāpi prete lokāntare’pi ca | saṃsāre svargalokādau mokṣe’pi kānta eva ha ||98|| sarvātmanāṃ bhavāmyeva sarvātmanā hi śāśvataḥ | ātmanyahaṃ sadā cāsmi niyāmako’ntare sthitaḥ ||99|| tathā tatrāpi nityaṃ vai kānto’smi kāntatā mayi | kāntātvaṃ mama yogena cātmasveva hi vidyate || 3.77.10 0|| evaṃ śāśvatikaḥ kāntaḥ sarvāsāṃ saṃbhavāmyaham | matkāntyā kāntimanto vai muktāḥ sarve tatheśvarāḥ || 101 || devāśca mānavādyāśca tiryañcastaravo’pi ca | jaḍāśca cetanāścāpi māyā ca māyikā api ||; 102|| matkāntyā kāntimanto ye tāḥ kāntā me nisargataḥ | evaṃ kāntātmakaṃ sarvaṃ vaidhavyaṃ nāsti vai kvacit || 10 3|| tasmāt sādhvyo bhajeyurmāṃ kāntaṃ saubhāgyayojitāḥ | evaṃ lakṣmi rahasyaṃ vai sādhvīnāṃ tu mayeritam || 1 04|| sarvātmanāṃ ceritaṃ ca gūḍhaṃ tattvārthasaṃbhṛtam | tasmānmado na kartavyaḥ pumānahamiti kvacit || 1 05|| ātmāhamiti kṛtvaiva bhajanīyaḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ patiḥ paraḥ || 1 06|| sādhvīrahasyametadvai jñātvā ye yāstathā prajāḥ | maṃsyante cācariṣyanti te prāpsyanti parāṃ gatim || 1 07|| bhuktiṃ muktiṃ tathāpsyanti sukhaṃ cānandamityapi | mama yogaṃ śāśvataṃ ca nirvāṇapadamuttamam || 108|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne satīsādhvīnāṃ pātivratyaparākāṣṭhādivijñānanirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 77 ||
<3.78> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sādhvīkathāṃ hyanuttamām | saurāṣṭre jālakapuryāmabhūd gopī sucandrikā || 1 || gopaścāsyāḥ patiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhajatyapi | bhakto’bhavat sadā snānaparaśca govrajānugaḥ || 2 || gopālo gopavāsāśca gopavāsaśca māṃ sadā | sevate bālakṛṣṇaṃ vai vane vanyādibhiḥ sadā || 3 || pāyasairdugdhapākaiśca kṣīrairdadhnā ghṛtādibhiḥ | navanītena puṣpaiśca jalaiḥ pūjayatīti mām || 4 || sa ca jvareṇa vai varṣākāle tyaktvā nijaṃ vapuḥ | yayau svargaṃ sakāmo me bhakto daurhṛdalakṣaṇām || 5 || gopīṃ patnīṃ parityajya hyardhāyurvigame sati | gopālo vai kṛpayā me vimānavaramāsthitaḥ || 6 || apsarobhiśca sahito rājate dhenubhiḥ saha | sarve sarvopakaraṇairbhakṣyabhojyādibhiryute || 7 || bhūtale cāsya patnī sā bhaktā me garbhabālakā | sagarbhāpi nijakāntamanu martuṃ samicchati || 8 || pativratā patiṃ vinā duḥkhaṃ soḍhumaśaktikā | yayau citāṃ svāminaśca tadā lokairnivāritā || 9 || garbhasya nāśane gopi pāpaṃ bahuguṇaṃ tava | patyuḥ svargaṃ tava jātaṃ svargavimānakam || 3.78.10 || rakṣa garbhaṃ putravatī bhaviṣyasi samāntare | patyuḥ pṛṣṭhe maraṇe tu puṇyaṃ vai patiyoṣitaḥ || 11 || agarbhāyā bhavatyeva sagarbhāyāstu dūṣaṇam | tasmānmā kuru ghātaṃ svaṃ sukhinī vasa govraje || 12|| ityevaṃ vāryamāṇāpi papāta patinā saha | citāyāṃ tāvadevāyaṃ patistasyā vimānagaḥ || 1 3|| dadṛśe vyomamārgeṇa mā maivaṃ gopi mā kuru | niṣiṣedha svahastenottolayāmāsa tāṃ priyām || 14|| adagdhāṃ tāṃ samāśvāsya dāhaṃ praśāmya tatkṣaṇam | vimāne tāṃ samāgṛhyopādiśad garbharakṣaṇe || 15|| putrasya rakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā vivāhya ca tataḥ param | samāyāhi mama svargaṃ mā kṛthāścānuyātrikām || 1 6|| ityuktā sā praśāntā ca sukhinī pativākyagā | pṛthvyāṃ vimānāt patinā prāpitā śokavarjitā || 17|| citāṃ natvā patiṃ natvā yayau gṛhaṃ hi gopikā | bhajate māṃ hare kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa sma ca || 18|| dharmaṃ bhaktiṃ vrataṃ śīlaṃ pālayatyeva gopikā | suṣuve ca sutaṃ gopī sucandrikā śubhānanam || 1 9|| vavṛdhe bālakaścāpi yuvā jāto vivāhitaḥ | gopī putrāya ca tato nyavedayat purābhavam ||3.78.20|| sarvaṃ vṛttaṃ nijapatyuḥ putro’pi mumude tataḥ | atha svargaṃ pragantavyaṃ mayā te pitaraṃ prati ||2 1 || ityuktvā sā gośakṛtopalipya bhūtalaṃ tataḥ | upāviśat kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā patiṃ tatyāja varṣma tat ||22| tāvatpatyurvimānaṃ tad devadevīsamanvitam | samāyātaṃ vyomataścārohayāmāsureva tām ||23|| sucandrikāṃ jayavākyairvardhayantyo’psarovarāḥ | gopaputro vadhūyukto vyalokayad vihāyasi ||24|| pitaraṃ devarūpaṃ ca prāṇamanmātaraṃ tataḥ | vimānaṃ kṣaṇamātreṇa gataṃ cāmbaramūrdhani ||25|| vimānasthā mañjughoṣāpsarovarā tu gopikām | apṛcchat sucandrikāṃ ca bhartuḥ sannidhimeva ha ||26|| kena vratena kalyāṇi kenācāreṇa vardhitā | gopī vidhūya pāpāni devaloke samāgatā ||27|| vahnyujjvalāmbaradharā svarṇacampakaśobhanā | jvalamānā ca tejobhirdivyā kathaṃ svarāgatā ||28|| nālpena tapasā gopi dānena niyamena vā | svargaṃ lokamanuprāptā kathaṃ vada samāgatā ||29|| śrutvā sucandrikā gopī mañjughoṣāṃ samabravīt | kathaṃ vai prāpyate svargaṃ vada me tatra kāraṇam ||3.78.30|| mañjughoṣā tataḥ prāha gopīṃ śṛṇu ca kāraṇam | kāṣāyavasanā yā syāt tyāgamārgaparāyaṇā ||3 1|| muṇḍā vā jaṭilā vā syāttathā valkaladhāriṇī | tāpasī dānaparamā bahudā puṇyaśālinī ||22|| sarvapradātithaye yā sādhave ca mahātmane | sā svargagā bhavet sādhvī pātivratyaparāyaṇā ||33|| patirdevaḥ patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ patireva paro vṛṣaḥ | patyājñā paramo vedaḥ patyustuṣṭirvṛṣaḥ striyāḥ ||34|| evaṃ yā vartate sādhvī sā svargaṃ vindate’cyutam | śrutvā prāha tadā gopī śṛṇu vimānavāhini ||25|| nāhaṃ kāṣāyavasanā nāpi tyāgaparāyaṇā | na muṇḍā na jaṭilā vā nāpi valkaladhāriṇī ||36|| aurṇāmbarādidhartryāsmi nāpi vai tāpasī tathā | vanavāsā dugdhadānā kintvatithiṃ na vedmyapi ||37|| sādhusevākarī cāsmi gopī gopānuyojitā | patisevāparā cāsaṃ yena devītvamāgatā || 38|| āhitāni paruṣāṇi kadācinnābruvaṃ patim | śrīkṛṣṇadevasādhūnāṃ pūjane’haṃ ratābhavam ||39|| patyurgavāṃ sevikā ca śvaśrūśvaśuravartinī | paiśunye na pravarte ca na kāpaṭya manasyapi ||3.78.40|| asthāne na ca tiṣṭhāmi cāślīlaṃ pravadāmi na | asadvā hasitaṃ vāpyahitaṃ vā pāpasaṃbhṛtam ||41 || rahasyaṃ cārahasyaṃ vā na vai karomi sarvathā | gavāmarthe nirgataṃ me bhartāraṃ gṛhamāgatam |||42|| jalānnāsanadānādyaiḥ sevayāmi sadānugā | yadannaṃ rocate nāsya yadbhojyaṃ rocate na ca ||43|| bhakṣyaṃ lehyaṃ ca peyaṃ ca sarvaṃ tad varjayāmyaham | kuṭumbārthe samagraṃ vai kāryaṃ sadā karomi ca ||44|| maṃgalāni mama sarvavidhāni svāminaḥ kṛte | aṃjanaṃ rocanāṃ snānaṃ mālyānulepanādikam ||45|| prasādhanaṃ ca niṣkrānte nābhinandāmi bhartari | notthāpayāmi bhartāraṃ sukhasuptaṃ kvacit khalu ||46|| āntarāṇyapi kāryāṇi karomyahaṃ sukhānvitā | nāyāsayāmi bharttāraṃ tena tuṣyati me manaḥ ||47|| guptaguhyā sadā cāsmi tadājñāvaśavartinī | evaṃ prapālya vai patyuścitāyāṃ nidhanottaram ||48|| niviṣṭāpi niṣiddhā cottolitā jīvitāhitā | pṛthvyāṃ putraṃ savadhūkaṃ sampādya divamāgatā ||49|| evaṃ vai mañjughoṣe’haṃ divametatsamāgatā | patiḥ prāpto mayā cātra putro me vartate bhuvi ||3.78.50|| etādṛśyo vividhā vai gopyo bhavanti bhūtale | kṛṣṇagopyaśca tā jātāḥ kalpakalpāntareṣvapi ||5 1|| bhajitvā śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tathā patim | evamahaṃ patiṃ devaṃ bhajitvātra samāgatā ||52|| śrutvaivaṃ mañjughoṣā sā prahṛṣṭā praśaśaṃsa tām | anyā apsarasaścāpi śaśaṃsustāṃ pativratām |||53|| bahukālamuṣitvā ca bhogān bhuktvā hyanekaśaḥ | satyalokaṃ yayau sādhvī patyā sākaṃ sucandrikā ||54|| sāvitrī cātra cāpṛcchat svargād gacchanti vai surāḥ | martyalokaṃ cāvaśeṣaṃ bhoktaṃu tvaṃ kathamatra vai ||55|| satyaṃ samāgatā sādhvi vada tatra hi kāraṇam | sucandrikā ca sāvitrīmuvāca hṛṣṭamānasā ||56|| svarge dṛṣṭaṃ mayā sarvaṃ sukhaṃ bhogātmakaṃ param | parantvaniyamaṃ taddhi śīlavratavivarjitam ||57|| devānāṃ nāsti vai śīlaṃ na śīlaṃ devayoṣitām | apsarassu vyavāyaśca vidyate paramo divi ||58|| deveṣu cāpi devīnāṃ prāyaśo’pi tathā vidhā | rītirvai vidyate tatra sāvitri kiṃ vadāmyaham ||59|| kāmarūpadharā devā devyaścāpi tathāvidhāḥ | viharanti yatheṣṭaṃ vai maryādāvarjitāḥ khalu ||3.78.60|| pātivratyaṃ na devīṣu patnīvrataṃ na nākiṣu | evaṃvidhā bhuktaśeṣā vrajanti mānavālayam ||61 || pradhāneṣu ca deveṣu patnīvrataṃ na vidyate | kā kathā cālpadevānāṃ te mṛtā yānti martyakam |||62||| saṃjñā cāndrī rohiṇī ca paulomī ṛṣiyoṣitaḥ | etāścānyāḥ svalpasaṃkhyā bhavanti vai pativratāḥ ||6 3 || mayā svarge mama patyurvimāne vai pativratam | pālitaṃ sarvathā nityaṃ yathā pṛthvyāṃ tathā divi ||64|| hareḥ pūjā kṛtā nityaṃ vṛṣaścāpi prapālitaḥ | ananyanarasaṃspṛśyā bhavāmi pūrvapuṇyataḥ ||65|| śrīhareḥ kṛpayā cāpi sāvitri tadbalādaham | saha patyā satyalokaṃ cāyātā nānyakāraṇam ||66|| atroṣitvā prayāsyāmi kṛpayā svāminastava | vaikuṇṭhaṃ tu jalordhve yat patyurharervratena ca ||67|| ityevaṃ cāvadat sādhvī nyūṣatustatra vai ciram | tato yayaturvaikuṇṭhaṃ viṣṇoḥ pādāmbuje hyubhau ||68|| gatvā tatra mahāsādhvī neme lakṣmīṃ haripriyām | nanāma viṣṇuṃ gopaśca vavandatuśca tau mudā ||69|| pṛṣṭā lakṣmyā kathaṃ sādhvi satyalokādupāgatā | sucandrikā śriyaṃ prāha kāntabhaktyā samāgatā ||3.78.70 || kānto’yaṃ me hi gopālo viṣṇuścāyaṃ pareśvaraḥ | kāntaṃ bhajāmi nityaṃ vai kāntakāntaṃ ca śāśvatam ||71||| sādhvīdharmaṃ samāpannā pātivratyaparāyaṇā | kāntadharmabalenāhaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ samupāgatā ||72|| atha tatrāpyuṣitvā sā ciraṃ patyā samanvitā | yayau golokamevāpi gopī gopena śobhitā ||73|| neme gopī rādhikāṃ ca gopaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nanāma ca | ūṣatustatra loke tau gopīgopagaṇeṣvapi ||74|| rādhā sucandrikāmāha kathaṃ cātra samāgatā | vada me kāraṇaṃ gopi kena puṇyena cāgatā ||75|| sucandrikāha rādhāṃ vai kṛṣṇakāntasya sevayā | kāntasya sevayā kāntakāntasyāpi ca sevayā ||76|| pātivratyena dharmeṇa kṛṣṇadharmeṇa gogṛham | āgatāhaṃ rādhike’tra sādhvīdharmeṇa yojitā ||77|| pātivratyaṃ paro dharmaḥ sarvadharmottamottamaḥ | kṛṣṇadharmaḥ paro dharmaḥ sādhvīdharmottamottamaḥ ||78|| mayā nityaṃ mama kāntaḥ pūjito gopasattamaḥ | gopānāmapi gopaśca kṛṣṇaḥ sadā prapūjitāḥ ||79|| tena puṇyena loke’tra cāgatā rādhike tava | uṣitvā ca ciraṃ paścād yāsyāmyakṣaradhāma vai ||3.78.80|| kṛṣṇājñayā tu sā sādhvī kāntayutoṣitā ciram | pātivratyaṃ pālayitvā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ tataḥ ||8 1|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrayaṃ parātparam | brahmahrade cāplutā ca mahāmuktānikābhavat ||82|| mukto’bhavat patiścāpi brahmabhāvānvitastadā | māyākāryāṇi sarvāṇi līnāni vai dvayostadā ||83|| ekabhāvāni tattvāni jātāni ca dvayostadā | ātmatattvaṃ samastaṃ vai samūrtaṃ śobhanaṃ param ||84|| puruṣottamarūpeṇa rūpitaṃ cābhavattadā | puṃstrībhāvau gatau tatra divyabhāvāvupāgatau ||85|| śrīharestatra sārūpyaṃ sālokyaṃ sārṣṭitābhavat | sāmīpyaṃ cābhavattatra nematuḥ puruṣottamam ||86|| ūṣatuścākṣare dhāmni japantau puruṣottamam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīparameśvara ||87|| parabrahma hare kṛṣṇa śrīkṛṣṇa puruṣottama | ityevaṃ tau tato lakṣmi muktau jātau mamākṣare ||88|| pūrvaṃ tau lomaśāt prāptau mama mantrān bhuvastale | tadbalānmama bhaktiśca vyavardhata tayościrāt ||89|| pativratyaṃ hārivratyaṃ patnīvrataṃ ca śobhanam | vyavardhata sadā gopyā gopasyāpyuttarottaram ||3.78.90|| me sādhūnāṃ sevayā ca śīlena sarvathā tathā | sarvalokeṣu me bhaktyā prāptavanto hi māṃ patim ||9 1|| māṇikyā me priyā dhāmni jayā ca lalitā tathā | papracchustāṃ gopikāṃ vai kathaṃ cātra samāgatā ||92|| sucandrikāha māṇikyāṃ muktāṃ śrīparameśvari | | patiśuśrūṣayā sādhvīdharmavṛttyā tathā śubhe ||93|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇapātivratyabhaktyā samāgatā | patirme’yaṃ mahāmukto brahmahrade samaplavāt ||94|| sañjātaścāhamevāpi brahmapriyāsmi sarvathā | jātā muktānikā sādhvī muktarūpā hi māṇiki ||95|| kṛpālabhyā parāmuktiḥ sarvathā naiva saṃśayaḥ | satāṃ sevā hi satsaṃgaḥ sevayā puṇyaśevadhiḥ ||96|| puṇyapuñjairvivekaśca bhavedātmaparātmanoḥ | vivekādātmakalyāṇe pravṛttirjāyate tataḥ ||97|| pāpanāśaḥ pāvanatvaṃ tābhyāṃ bhaktirudeti ca | bhaktyā ca nāmadhāmādismaraṇaṃ snehasaṃbhṛtam ||98|| snehārpaṇeneṣṭasiddhiḥ savividhā prajāyate | paramātmā sadeṣṭaścānādinārāyaṇo hariḥ ||99|| so’yaṃ samprāpyate siddhaḥ patiḥ kṛṣṇo’tivallabhaḥ | evaṃ mayā hariḥ kāntaḥ prāpto’trākṣaradhāmani || 3.78.100 || ityuktā māṇikī tuṣṭā praśaśaṃsa sucandrikām | sakhīṃ śīlavatīṃ prāpyānanditā sā babhūva ca || 101 || sucandrikā sadā muktā hyuvāsa śrīrivāparā | haripriyākṣare dhāmni lakṣmi bhaktā priyā mama || 10 2|| ityevaṃ darśitaṃ te’tra sādhvīmāhātmyamuttamam | sasvāminyā hi bhaktāyā me sādhvyā mokṣakṛtparam || 103 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sucandrikākhyagopyāḥ pātivratyena haripātivratyabhaktyā ca sapatikāyāḥ svargasatyavaikuṇṭhagolokākṣaradhāmagamanamityādisādhvīcamatkāranirūpaṇanāmāṣṭasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 78 ||
<3.79> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca sādhvī pativratā kṛṣṇa gārhasthye vartate yadi | ṛddhimāpnoti kiṃ kṛtvā vada me kānta saukhyakṛt || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca sādhvyā gārhasthyamāśritya śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ | ārādhanīyaḥ satataṃ sa vai ṛddhiṃ dadāti ha || 2 || ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā manuṣyāḥ sādhavo dvijāḥ | vṛddhāścātithayaḥ sādhvyaḥ pūjanīyā viśeṣataḥ || 3 || pūjāyajñena devām̐śca sadātithyena mānavān | ṛṣīn pitṛn śrāddhapiṇḍaiścāgnau hutvā samarcayet || 4 || payomūlaphalaiḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryācca bhojayet sataḥ | dvijebhyo’pyarcayed dravyaṃ bhojanaṃ cāmbarādikam || 5 || atithīn bhojayet sādhvī sādhvīḥ satīśca bhojayet | ṛtvijaṃ snātakaṃ sādhuṃ guruṃ śvaśuramityapi || 6 || svāminaṃ ca patiṃ miṣṭairmadhuparkaiḥ samarcayet | śvabhyaśca śvapacebhyaśca vayobhyaścāvaped bhuvi || 7 || dadyānnārāyaṇāyeha svāhetivacanānvitā | gobhyo dadyād ghāsapūlān bālebhyaḥ śarkarādikam || 8 || jalaṃ dadyācca vṛkṣebhyo matsyebhyaścaṇakādikān | kaṇān pakṣigaṇebhyaśca prasādaṃ pārśvavartine || 9 || dadyādevaṃ yathāśakti kathāśravaṇamācaret | mālāvartanamevāpi kuryācca devadarśanam || 3.79.1 0|| jaladānaṃ prakuryācca snānadhyānārcanādikam | nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ kuryād bhajanaṃ smaraṇaṃ tathā | | 11 | | dehaśuddhiṃ dharmaśuddhiṃ manaḥśuddhiṃ samācaret| | satāṃ sevāṃ satīsevāṃ kuryācchaktyā yathāyatham | | 12 | | sumanodhūpadīpānāṃ dānaṃ dadyād yathāvidhi | somāṃśā oṣadhayaśca sadāmṛtasamanvitāḥ | | 13 || viṣaṃ tāpodbhavaṃ cograṃ haranti puṣpajātayaḥ | amṛtaṃ manasaḥ prītiṃ sadyastṛptiṃ dadatyapi | | 1 4| | viṣaṃ haranti puṣpāṇi sugandhena hi dehinām | hlādayanti mano lakṣmīṃ kurvanti sumanāṃsi vai | | 15 || puṣpaistuṣyanti devādyāstuṣṭāḥ puṣṭiṃ dadatyapi | iṣṭagandhāni devānāṃ puṣpāṇīti vibhāvaya | | 16 | | akaṃṭakānāṃ śvetāni deveṣṭāni sumāni vai | jalīyapadmamālyāni yakṣagandharvabhoginām | | 17 | | kaṭukaṇṭakaraktāni puṣpāṇyabhicarārthinām | tīkṣṇavīryāṇi bhūtānāṃ kṛṣṇāni kaṇṭakāni ca | | 8 | | manonayananandāni mānuṣāṇāṃ priyāṇi vai | aśuddhabhūmipuṣpāṇi varjyāni sarvathā priye || 19 | | gandhena devāstuṣyanti darśanād yakṣarākṣasāḥ | nāgāḥ samupabhogena tribhireva tu mānuṣāḥ || 3.79.20 | | sadyo devān prīṇayanti gandhāḥ pauṣpāśca cāndanāḥ | prītāśca bhāvayantyetān martyān siddhīśca sampadaḥ || 21 | | dhūpo niryāsarūpo vai gugguluḥ pravaro mataḥ | devāstuṣyanti dhūpena gārhasthye sampadāṃ pradāḥ | | 22 | | aguruḥ śreṣṭha evāpi yakṣarākṣasabhoginām | daityānāṃ kṛtrimā dhūpāḥ sallakīyāśca tadvidhāḥ | | 23 | | haridrāyā dhūpadānairbhūtāstṛptāḥ prayānti ca | sarjarasādidhūpāśca mānaveṣṭā bhavanti vai | | 24 || dīpadānaṃ sadā tejovardhanaṃ jāyate priyam | andhaṃ tamaśca tāmisraṃ dakṣiṇāyanameva ca | | 21 | | parābhāvyottaramārgaṃ dīpo dadāti cārṣitaḥ | dīpastūrdhvagaterdātā tamonāśasya bhaiṣajam | | 26 || dīpadānena vai devāḥ prabhāvantaḥ prakāśakāḥ | tejasvinaḥ svargaloke jātā dīpaṃ tato’rpayet | | 27 | | ālokadānāccakṣuṣmān buddhiprakāśavān bhavet | dīpahartā bhavedandhastamogatiḥ prabhākṣayaḥ | | 28 | | haviṣā cauṣadhīnāṃ ca rasairniryāsakaistathā | pūrṇacandrapratīkāśā dīpadāḥ saṃbhavanti vai || 29 | | yāvadakṣinimeṣāṇi jvalanti tāvatīḥ samāḥ | dṛṣṭimān rūpavān śaktimān pradīpaprado bhavet ||3.79.3 0 || tasmād dīpāḥ pradātavyāḥ sādhvyā gārhasthyalagnayā | tapaścāpi prakartavyamuttarāyuṣi sarvathā ||3 1 || yena vai tapasā brahmākṣaradhāmagatirbhavet | śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi sādhvīdharmamanuttamam ||32 || yat kṛtvā mokṣamāgacchet pūrvakalpakathānakam | pūrvakalpe’bhavattvādyo manurnāmnā hariprathaḥ ||33|| tasya brahmaprathā patnī sādhvīdīkṣānvitābhavat | kaṇḍāyanamaharṣervai putrī brahmaparāyaṇā ||34|| kaṇḍāyanagṛhe sā ca mānasī saṃvyajāyata | jñānapūrṇā tapaḥpūrṇā manovikāravarjitā ||35|| yuvatī vanavāsā ca sādhvīdīkṣāṃ piturgṛhe | jagrāha brahmacaryasthā yatinī sābhavad gṛhe ||36|| akṣatadehā cāspṛṣṭā nareṇa kenaciddhi sā | vane vai vaiṣṇave sādhvī candrojjvalā nadītaṭe ||37|| snātuṃ pitrā samaṃ yātā snātārdravastradhāriṇī | puṣṭā yuvatī śīlasthā tyāgadharmānvitāpi sā || 38|| dṛṣṭā vyomnā hi manunā hariprathena gacchatā | brāhmī brahmatapobhābhirvyāptā manoharā śubhā ||39|| devī divyā yathāyogyā gṛhaśobhākarī satī | tejasā vyāptadehā ca sūryakāntyatikāntikā ||3.79.40|| sarvaśrīsaṃbhṛtā savaiśvaryalakṣmīnivāsinī | sarvanārāyaṇīstrīṣu mūrddhanyā rūpabhādibhiḥ ||41 || vilokyaiva vicāryaiva nadītīre drutaṃ nṛpaḥ | avātarad vimānādvai tamṛṣiṃ prāṇamanmudā ||42|| pitṛvat pūjayāmāsa dadau paricayaṃ nijam | śrutvā kāṇḍāyanarṣiśca jaharṣādya manuṃ tadā ||43|| rājānaṃ vaidhasaṃ putraṃ dṛṣṭvā pratipupūja tam | kanyāpi tūrṇamāgatya manoḥ satkāramācarat ||44|| mithaśca kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭvā praśaśaṃsurhi darśanam | manuśca brāhmaṇaṃ natvā maunaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sthiro’bhavat ||45|| ṛṣiścovāca tūrṇaṃ vai mano kiṃ karavāṇi te | manuḥ prāha hṛdaye me vāñcchā yā vartate guro ||46|| yadi śakto bhavasyatra tāṃ pūrayitumarhasi | ṛṣirdhyānena nitarāṃ vijñāya mānasaṃ manoḥ ||47|| putrī papraccha sādhvīṃ tāṃ tyāginīṃ dānahetave | vada putri manustu tvāṃ samīhate karomi kim ||48|| putrī prāha same dharmo pitrādeśo yathā bhavet | śīlaṃ me rocate śaśvat sādhvīdharmaṃ yato gatā ||49|| tathāpi pitṛvaśagā kanyā pitṛvacaścaret | pitṛvacanamāsādya patyadhīnā hi kanyakāḥ ||3.79.50|| satyaḥ sādhvyo bhavantyeva vadhvastāśca pativratāḥ | yatheṣṭaṃ cara cātrārthe prasannāsmi nideśane ||51|| kāṇḍāyanaḥ prasanno’bhūd dadau manave putrikām | mānyo’bhavat trilokeṣu manoḥ sambandhayogataḥ ||52|| brahmaprathāṃ vivāhyaiva ninye manurnijālayam | brahmaprathāyai trailokye dadau rājyanirīkṣaṇam ||53|| manuvanmanupatnī sā rājyaṃ cakāra cottamam | gṛhasaṃskāravaśagā sadāsevata vai sataḥ ||||54||| sādhvīrasevatāpyeṣā jagrāhāśīrvacāṃsi ca | manoḥ kāle cakāraiṣā yajñān sarvavidhān satī ||55|| dānavratāni śreṣṭhāni puṇyāni vividhāni ca | sarvasatkārakarmāṇi śobhanāni cakāra sā ||56|| sādhusādhvīsevanaṃ sā maharṣisevanaṃ tathā | tyāginītāpasīsevāṃ tapasvisevanaṃ vyadhāt ||57|| manoścādhikārapūrṇe samaye manunā saha | yayau sādhvī vimānena dhāmākṣaraṃ harermama ||58|| tatra pṛṣṭā mayā sādhvī satkṛtā muktakoṭibhiḥ | kena puṇyenākṣaraṃ tvaṃ cāyātā vada sundari ||59|| sā ca prāha mahābhaktā sātvatī sādhusevikā | bhagavan kānta kānteśa pūjayāmi nanāmi ca ||3.79.60|| sarvajño’si hare kṛṣṇa tathāpyājñākarī tvaham | yathāniyuktā kāntena svāminā paramātmanā ||61 || bhavatā hi tathā sarvaṃ nivedayāmi me śṛṇu | śatasahasrasauvarṇamudrādānaṃ dvijātaye ||62|| adadāṃ ratnadānāni rūpyakārbudakārpaṇam | brāhmaṃ vrataṃ cākaravaṃ nehāgāṃ tatphalādaham ||63|| yajñān pañcadaśarātrān daśaikarātrānadhvarān | jyotiṣṭomaśataṃ cakre’pīha nāgāṃ hi tatphalāt ||64|| gaṃgātaṭe śatavarṣaṃ tapastaptvā sudāruṇam | adadāmaśvalakṣaṃ ca nāhamāgāṃ hi tatphalam || 65|| daśāyutāśvān viṃśatyayutagāśca payasvinīḥ | nārīpuramadāṃ dāne nāhamāgāṃ hi tatphalāt || 66 || svarṇacandrānvitakanyāsahasramadadāṃ tathā | sarvabhūṣābhūṣitastrīṣaṣṭisahasrakāṇyapi ||67||| daśārbudānyadadāṃ gāḥ savatsā gosaveṣu ca | svarṇakāṃsyādiyuktāśca nāhamāgāṃ hi tatphalāt ||68|| āptoryāmeṣu niyataṃ godaśakaṃ dvijāyate | prādāṃ lakṣaṃ daśaguṇaṃ gavāṃ nāgāṃ hi tatphalāt ||69||| daśāyutāśvānadadāṃ bāhlijātān manoramān | hemamālāpallahāḍhyān nāhamāgāṃ hi tatphalāt ||3.79.70|| aṣṭādaśakoṭihemamudrā prādāṃ tathānvaham | ekaikasmin kratau cāpi nāhamāgāṃ hi tatphalāt ||71 || vājināṃ śyāmakarṇānāṃ haritānāṃ pareśvara | prādāṃ hemasrajāṃ kṛṣṇā koṭīrdaśa ca pañca ca ||72|| padmino’nyān sahasrāṇi prāṃśūn mahāśarīriṇaḥ | dīrghadantān svarṇabhūṣān prādāṃ daśa ca pañca ca ||73|| kāñcanāṃgarathān svalaṃkṛtān daśāyutāni ca | vājiyuktān svarṇabhūṣābhūṣitānadadāṃ makhe ||74|| dakṣiṇāṃvayavām̐ścāpi vedoditān tathā parān | vājapeyeṣu daśasu prādāṃ cāṃgasamanvitām ||75|| niṣkakaṇṭhān mahādāsān dāsīśca dakṣiṇāstathā | rājasūyadaśake vai prādāṃ nāgāṃ hi tatphalāt ||76|| srotaśca brahmaputrāyāśchanno’bhūd dakṣiṇādibhiḥ | svarṇadānai ratnadānairnāgāmatra hi tatphalāt ||77|| grāmārbudaṃ ca viprebhyaḥ saptadvīpeṣu cādadam | śamyākṣepairayajaṃ ca sādyaskaniyutaiḥ surān ||78|| trayodaśadvādaśāhaiḥ pauṇḍarīke kratau tvaham | tathāpi tajjapuṣpaiśca nāhamatra samāgatā ||79|| kakudmyaṣṭasahasrāṇi dvijebhyaścādadāṃ kratau | śvetām̐śca vṛṣabhān śvetā gāśca svarṇavibhūṣitāḥ ||3.79.80|| hiraṇyaratnanicayānadadāṃ mauktikadrumān | sadhānyasasyavāṭīśca khaṇḍadānaṃ tathādadām ||8 1|| ekādaśāhairayajaṃ dvādaśāhaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ | sadakṣiṇairaśvamedhaiḥ ṣoḍaśārkāyaṇaistathā ||82|| yojanānāṃ śataṃ dīrghamaraṇyaṃ parvatānvitam | niṣkaikakaṇṭhapratyagraṃ mahodyānāni cādadam ||83|| tathāpi tajjapuṇyaiśca nāhamatra samāgatā | vratāni cākaravaṃ ca nittyanaimittikānyapi ||84|| triṃśadagnīnayajaṃ cāṣṭābhistathā ca somakaiḥ | sarvamedhairnaramedhaiḥ saptabhirdaśabhistathā ||85|| aṣṭottaraśataviśvajidbhistathājamedhakaiḥ | na cāpi teṣāṃ puṇyaiśca bhagavanniha cāgamam ||86|| gaṃgāyāṃ brahmaputrāyāṃ ceravatyāṃ tathā punaḥ | menakāṃgāmahānadyāṃ bālakṛṣṇasarasyapi ||87|| śvetavārdhau śītavārdhau nārāyaṇyāṃ tathā punaḥ | tapastaptavatī cāhaṃ sādhusevāparāyaṇā ||88|| tatra tatra sevitā vai sādhavaḥ kṛṣṇabhūṣaṇāḥ | sādhvyaśca sevitā santoṣitāḥ sarvapradānakaiḥ ||89|| bhojitāḥ pūjitā dṛṣṭāḥ spṛṣṭā deheṣu marditāḥ | saṃvāhitāḥ pādayośca natāśca paricāritāḥ ||3.79.90|| hare kṛṣṇa hare viṣṇo kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama ||91 || evaṃ kīrtanagātāraḥ santaḥ sādhvyo hyanusṛtāḥ | sādhavo me tatastuṣṭāḥ sādhvyastuṣṭāḥ sadā mama ||92|| viprāśca ṛṣayaścāpyatithayo bhaktiśālinaḥ | sāttvatā bhagavatyaśca yoginya sampratoṣitāḥ ||93|| pitā pratoṣitaścāpi vaco’nuvartanena vai | teṣāṃ tāsāṃ mahatībhirāśīrbhiḥ puṇyamāpya ha ||94||. siddhā sādhvī pāvanī ca divyā jātāsmi tatkṣaṇāt | divyadehā hariyajñairjātā brahmapriyāsakhī ||95|| priyeṇa patinā sārdhaṃ māyāpāraṃ gatāsti ca | sādhusādhvībhiruktāsmi yāhi dhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ ||96|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ | sāhaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa pareśvara ||97|| imaṃ lokamanuprāptā sevayā toṣalābhayā | gṛhāṇa me karaṃ kṛṣṇa nivāsaya sadātra mām ||98|| vidhehi svāṃ kiṃkarīṃ māṇikyāsakhīmanuttamām | ityuktā ca tato lakṣmi mayā sakhī kṛtā ca vaḥ ||99|| sādhusevāsamaṃ nāsti paraṃ kartavyameva ha | ṛddhidaṃ mokṣadaṃ cāpi svargadaṃ śāntidaṃ tathā || 3.79.10 0|| ityetat kathitaṃ te’tra dānottaraṃ hi sevanam | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktirmuktirbhavettathā || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sādhvyāḥ kartavye pūjādānādiḥ, hariprathamanorbrahmaprathāyāḥ patnyāḥ sādhvyāḥ svarge sthityuttaraṃ sādhusādhvīsevāphalaṃ cākṣaradhāmagamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 79 ||
<3.80> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sādhusevāphalaṃ param | pūrṇāyuḥsampradaṃ śaśvat sādhusādhvīprasevanam || 1 || ācāralakṣaṇo dharmaḥ santaścāritralakṣaṇāḥ | sādhūnāṃ yad yathāvṛttametadācāralakṣaṇam || 2 || apyadṛṣṭaṃ śravādeva santaṃ saddharmacāriṇam | bhaktikarmāṇi kurvantaṃ prajāḥ smaranti dūragāḥ || 3 || satāṃ dharmaṃ pālayedvai yadīcched bhūtimātmanaḥ | api pāpaśarīrasya pāpaṃ hanti satāṃ vṛṣaḥ || 4 || sadācārād bhavetpūrṇamāyuḥ kṛte daśāyutam | tretāyāmayutavarṣaṃ dvāpare tu sahasrakam || 5 || tiṣye śataṃ samāścāpi pūrṇāyurjāyate sadā | sadācārāt sadā lakṣmīrgṛhe śrīrvasati dhruvā || 6 || kīrtiśceha paratrāpi sadācārasya jāyate | satāṃ prasannatā hetudīrghāyuṣṭve matā mama || 7 || anyat sarvaṃ bādhyate vai bādhyate na satāṃ vacaḥ | mama bhaktiyutāḥ śīlavratinaḥ śāntamūrtayaḥ || 8 || mamārādhanakāryāśca sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ | tārayanti mṛtām̐ścāpi jīvataḥ pāvayanti ca || 9 || durācāro hi puruṣo nehāyurvindate mahat | yatastrasyanti bhūtāni trāsaścāyurvināśakaḥ || 3.80.1 0|| ye nindakāḥ satāṃ krūrā guruśāstrābhilaṃghinaḥ | adharmasthā durācārāste bhavanti gatāyuṣaḥ || 11 || viśālā bhinnamaryādā hiṃsrā viṣayiṇaśca ye | alpāyuṣo bhavantyeva bhaktihīnāśca nistrapāḥ || 1 2|| sarvalakṣaṇaśūnyo’pi hyudārācāravān janaḥ | śraddhābhaktiyutaḥ sādhuḥ pūrṇavarṣāṇi jīvati || 1 3|| anasūyuḥ satyavādī krodhaśāṭhyādivarjitaḥ | ajihmaścāpyahiṃsaśca pūrṇavarṣāṇi jīvati || 14|| loṣṭhamardī tṛṇacchedī nakhakhādī malāvṛtaḥ | asthiramānasaścāpi nehāyurvindate param || 15|| vyabhicārī vyavāyī ca dīrghaṃ naiva hi jīvati | nahīdṛśamanāyuṣyaṃ loke sarvatra vidyate || 16|| yādṛśaṃ puruṣasyeha paradāropasevanam | gurudrohī pitṛdrohī sādhudrohī na jīvati || 17|| strīdrohī mātṛdrohī ca devadrohī na jīvati | vāharāgī nadītāraḥ śastrābhyāsī na jīvati || 18|| surāpāyī cāmiṣādaściraṃ naiva hi jīvati | vāksāyakavadanaśca marmatudo’tirogavān || 1 9|| śāpadagdhaḥ sāhasī ca ciraṃ naiva hi jīvati | abhicārī ghātakī ca pūjyapūjāvilopakaḥ ||3.80.20|| śaraṇāgataghātī ca vaśyaghātī ca sarvathā | viśvāsaghātī bālaghnaściraṃ naiva hi jīvati |||21|| pāśī śūlī muṣkanāśī bhagabandhī ca garbhahāḥ | ṛtunāśī jantunāśī madhuhāśca na jīvati ||22|| vyādhakarmā tathā cakrī sūnī dīrghaṃ na jīvati | viṣī bhūtī vāyurogī kṣayī pramehavān kaphī ||23|| śvāsī raktī mandapācī codvejako na jīvati | prasahyahartā cāgnido vyomayānī na jīvati ||24|| pravāsī satataṃ yaśca pratārakaśca mādakī | ahiphenavyasanī ca ciraṃ naiva tu jīvati || 25|| mātāpitaramācāryaṃ guruṃ sādhuṃ satīṃ patim | devaṃ vṛddhaṃ pūrvamevotthāya yaścābhivādayet || 26|| pathyaṃ bhuñjīta satataṃ yaściraṃ sa ca jīvati | ghṛtādaśca prasādādo dīrghamāyurhi vindati || 27||| prāṅmukho bhojanaṃ bhuṃkte hyāyuṣyaṃ vindate mahat| | pathyaghṛtāktānnabhojī dīrghajīvī bhavet khalu ||28|| ārdrapādastu bhuñjāno pūrṇāyurjīvati dhruvam | catustejāṃsi nocchiṣṭa ālabheta kadācana ||29|| agniṃ gāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sādhuṃ tathā hyāyurna riṣyati | ūrdhvaṃ prāṇā hyutkrāmanti yūnaḥ sthavira āyati ||3.80.3 0|| pratyutthānābhivādābhyāṃ punastān pratipadyate | ucchiṣṭo na spṛśecchīrṣaṃ sarve prāṇāstadāśrayāḥ ||3 1|| na cābhīkṣṇaṃ śiraḥ snāyāttathāsyāyurna riṣyati | tilasṛṣṭaṃ na cāśnīyāttathāsyāyurna riṣyati ||32|| abhyasyati tvanadhyāye hyāyustasya prahīyate | pratyādityaṃ pratyanalaṃ pratigāṃ ca pratistriyam ||33|| ye mehanti ca panthānaṃ te bhavanti gatāyuṣaḥ | gurunindā dahatyāyurmanuṣyāṇāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||34|| dīrghajijīviṣurvipraṃ kṣatraṃ sarpaṃ na duḥkhayet | santaṃ sādhvīṃ satīṃ gāṃ ca devaṃ gharmaṃ na kutsayet ||35|| patitaistu kathāṃ necchet taddarśanaṃ vivarjayet | tatsaṃsargaṃ na vai kuryāt tadāyurvindate mahat ||36 || na divā maithunaṃ gacchenna kanyāṃ na ca bandhakīm | na cāsnātāṃ striyaṃ gacchet tadāyurvindate mahat ||37|| pūjyā vṛddhāḥ sādhavaśca sādhvyo devā guruttamāḥ | gṛhe vāsayitavyāste dhanyamāyuṣyameva tat ||38|| mahātmanāmavamānamāyuḥkṣayakaraṃ sadā | mahātmano’tiguhyāni na
