vaktavyāni karhicit ||39|| sampraśaṃset satīḥ sādhūn tathāyurvindate mahat | sandhyāyāṃ na svapet kvāpi japecciraṃ sa jīvati ||3.80.40 || kārayecchamaśrukarma prāṅmukha udaṅamukho’thavā | parivādaṃ na ca brūyāttathāyurvindate mahat ||41 || anāyuṣyā bhavedīrṣyā pūjyanindā ca tādṛśī | anāyuṣyaṃ divāsvapnaṃ pāradāryaṃ tathāvidham ||42|| ācāro bhūtijananaścācāraḥ kīrtivardhanaḥ | ācārād vardhate hyāyurācāro hantyalakṣaṇam ||46 || ācāraprabhavo dharmo dharmādāyurvivardhate | satāmāśīrvacanāni dīrghāyuḥsampradāni vai ||44|| mārkaṇḍeyasya dīrghāyurmattvaṃ saptarṣivākyataḥ | vedhaso vākyataścāpi nidarśanaṃ paraṃ hi tat ||45|| pituḥ krodhānnāciketā mṛtyumavāpa vai tathā | vānarā rāmacandreṇojjīvitā ye raṇe hatāḥ ||46|| vapurdvedhā bhautakaṃ ca yaśorūpaṃ tathā rame | bhautikaṃ tvāyurāpekṣaṃ yaśaścācārabandhanam ||47|| āśīrvādaibhautikasya śubhāyurvardhate tviha | sadācāraiḥ sevayā ca vardhate tu yaśaḥ śubham ||48|| satkarmabhiḥ puṇyapuñjo vardhate yaśasā saha | bhaktyā dvayaṃ jāyate ca vardhate śāśvataṃ yathā ||49|| kule sādhurbhavet kaścit sādhvī vā brahmayoginī | kulaṃ tad yaśasā loke dhruvaṃ kīrtiṃ pravindati ||3.80.50|| puṇye kule hi puruṣāḥ khyātācārā bhavanti hi | pāpe kule tu pāpā vai jāyanta bahudhā khalu |||51||| sarve’narthā kule yatra jāyante pāpapūruṣāḥ | akīrtiṃ janayantyeva kīrti te lopayantyapi ||52|| vidvāneko bhavet putro bhaktaḥ kīrtiṃ karoti saḥ | sadācāraḥ sa evātra tārayatyeva bāndhavān ||53|| sadācārā yadi sādhvī bhavet kanyā vadhūśca vā | kulaṃ sarvaṃ pāvanaṃ ca kṛtvā tārayati dhruvam ||54|| nārāyaṇo hariryasya yasyā hṛdi sthitaḥ prabhuḥ | tārakastena lokān sā sa vā tārayati dhruvam ||55|| dīrghāyuśca kulaṃ tasya yaśaściraṃ pratiṣṭhati | muktiścāpi dhruvā tasya tasyāḥ prajāyate śubhāḥ |||56|| daśācāryebhya evātropādhyāyaḥ śreṣṭha ucyate | daśopādhyāyataḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pitā bhavati sarvathā ||57|| daśapitṛbhyaśca mātā śreṣṭhā sadā garīyasī | daśāmātṛsamā gurvī sādhvī satī pativratā ||58|| śīlayuktā brahmacaryaparā brahmapriyā hi sā | matsvarūpā sadā sādhvī vaiṣṇavī sā narāyaṇī ||59|| kārṣṇī sā mādhavī lakṣmīḥ śaktirvai pauruṣottamī | sādhurūpaḥ sadā cāhaṃ saṃvarte sarvasṛṣṭiṣu ||3.80.60|| sādhavo matsvarūpā vai sādhvyaśca mama śaktayaḥ | mama dhāmapradāḥ sarve sarvāśca pāvanāḥ priye ||6 1|| sādhubhyastu paraṃ nāsti pāvanaṃ sarvasṛṣṭiṣu | sādhusevāsamaṃ nāsti puṇyaṃ tapaśca sarvathā ||62|| dhanāḍhyāstu dhanenaiva sevante pūjyadehinaḥ | daridrāḥ sādhusevāḍhyā labhante brahma śāśvatam ||63|| dhanāḍhyā yānti vai svargaṃ daridrā yānti dhāma ca | adhanā varṣmaṇā sevāṃ kurvanti bhāvataḥ satām ||64|| upavāsān prakurvanti koṭiyajñaphalapradān | ato dravyamayād yajñāt sevāyajño viśiṣyate ||65|| sadā tīrthaṃ sevanīyaṃ tārakaṃ cātmanāṃ mudā | sthūlaṃ tīrthaṃ bhūjalādi sūkṣmaṃ sādhuprasevanam ||66|| divyaṃ tīrthaṃ manaḥśuddhistattīrthāsevanaṃ caret | manastīrthe tu yaḥ pūtaścātmatīrthe pramucyate ||67|| agādhe vimale śuddhe satyatoye dhṛtahrade | snātavyaṃ mānase tīrthe sattvamālambya śāśvatam ||68|| tīrthaśaucaṃ pravadāmi śṛṇu lakṣmi pramokṣadam | sādhutvaṃ jāyate yena yena māyāvināśanam ||69|| agrāhitvamanarthitvamārjavaṃ satyamityapi | ahiṃsā mārdavaṃ śāntirānṛśaṃsyaṃ damaḥ śamaḥ ||3.80.70|| nirmamāhaṃkṛtitvaṃ nirdvandvatvaṃ niṣparigrahaḥ | śucitvaṃ ca guṇā yatra tīrthībhūtā hi sādhavaḥ ||71|| brahmavettā mahattīrthaṃ tārakaṃ pāpanāśakam | sarvatyāgeṣvabhiratā bhaktijñāḥ samadarśinaḥ ||72|| kaṣāyarahitāḥ śāntāḥ sādhavastīrthabhūṣaṇāḥ | manaḥśaucaṃ paraṃśaucaṃ snātastatra pramucyate ||73|| nodakaklinnagātro vai snāta ityabhidhīyate | sa snāto yo damasnātaḥ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ śuciḥ ||74|| gataṃ naivānuśocanti pratyakṣe nirmamāḥ sadā | spṛhā notpadyate yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ śaucaṃ hi tīrthavat ||75|| niṣkiṃcanatvaṃ dehasya manasaśca prasannatā | jñānaśaucaṃ cātmanaśca tīrthāni trīṇi caiva ha ||76|| vṛttaśaucaṃ śarīrasya vrataśaucaṃ tu mānasam | tīrthaśaucamātmanaśca trīṇi mokṣakarāṇi vai ||77|| jñānotpannaṃ paraṃ śaucaṃ brahmajñānajalātmakam | snāti yo mānase tatra mokṣaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ ||78|| tattvāropitaśaucastu nityaṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ | sevāsadguṇasampannastīrthameva janaḥ sadā ||79|| kīrtanāccaiva tīrthasya snānācca pitṛtarpaṇāt | sarvapāpāni dahyanti tato yātyakṣaraṃ padam ||3.80.80|| parigrahācca sādhūnāṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya manorgrahāt | bhaktisaritkṛtāplāvāt taranti prākṛtaṃ tamaḥ ||8 1|| sādhavastīrthavaryā vai sādhutā tīrthasattamā | ubhayoreva yaḥ snāyāt sa siddhiṃ śīghramāpnuyāt ||82|| sadācāraḥ paro dharmastīrthaṃ cottamameva tat | satāṃ dharmaṃ saha nītvā yāti vyaktiḥ parāṃ gatim ||83|| dharma eko manuṣyāṇāṃ sahāyaḥ pāralaukikaḥ | sa ced divyaḥ kṛtaścātra sādhūnāṃ sevayā tadā ||84|| mokṣado dhāmadaścāpi śāśvatānandadaḥ paraḥ | mokṣadharmasamo dharmo mūrdhanyo nāsti sṛṣṭiṣu ||85|| sarvatīrthamayo dharmo mokṣadharmo’sti sādhuṣu | sādhavaḥ pālitā yena sevitāśca prasāditāḥ ||86|| sarvo dharmaḥ kṛtastena paramātmā prasāditaḥ | sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya sarvabhūtāni paśyataḥ ||87|| sādhusevātatparasya paraṃ mokṣapadaṃ bhavet | yathā nāgapade’nyāni padāni saṃviśanti vai ||88|| tathā sarvāṇi dharmāṇi viśanti sādhusevane | teṣāṃ sādhusevināṃ vai brahmaloko vidhīyate ||89|| nābhāgenāmbarīṣeṇa gayena citraketunā | āyunā cānaraṇyena dilīpena ca bhūbhṛtā ||3.80.90|| śibinā mucukundena māndhātrā bharatena ca | janakena tathā rukmāṃgadenālarkabhṛbhṛtā ||91|| pṛthunā sāgareṇāpi lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā | ebhiśca rājabhirnityaṃ sādhavaḥ saṃprasevitāḥ ||92|| sādhvyaḥ satyaḥ pūjitāśca paramātmāhamarcitaḥ | ātmatīrthakṛtasnānāḥ sādhvāśīrvādavardhitāḥ ||93|| sādhudharmaparā bhūtvā prayātāḥ paramāṃ gatim | sarvendriyāṇāṃ vṛttīnāṃ śāntiryāvanna jāyate ||94|| tāvadbhavati saṃsāro bhavamṛtyupravāhakṛt | vṛttilaye hi sādhutvaṃ sādhutve muktiruttamā ||95|| nārāyaṇasya dūtā vai sarve santīha sādhavaḥ | kārayitvā kīrtanāni nayanti dhāma cākṣaram ||96|| sādhvyo nārāyaṇasyaiva śaktayaḥ santi tārikāḥ | kārayitvā hareḥ sevāṃ nayanti dhāma cākṣaram ||97|| brahāpriyāḥ samastā ye sādhvyaḥ santi pativratāḥ | bhāgavatyaśca sāttvatyastattaddeśeṣu līlayā ||98|| madicchayā samutpannā deśakalyāṇahetave | janatāsu mama bhaktipravartanārthameva tāḥ ||99|| yūyaṃ sarvā mama patnyaḥ samutpannā hi sādhvikāḥ | sādhvīdharmān pālayantu śrīkṛṣṇe svāmini dhruvāḥ || 3.80.1 00|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe mayi parātmani | śāśvatāyuṣyabhoginyo mattulyāḥ stho dhruvāḥ sadā || 101 || mama dhāmanivāsinyo mama pārśve stha eva ha | dvitīyena svarūpeṇa bhūsthāḥ stho’tra mayā saha || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne dīrghāyuḥpradasādhanaṃ mokṣasādhanaṃ ca satāṃ sevānādikamityādinirūpaṇanāmāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 80 ||
<3.81> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sāghusaṃgatisatphalam | ahaṃ bhadrāvatītīre vihārārthaṃ gato’bhavat || 1 || gṛdhrā māṃsāśanāstatra kṣetre tīre’bhavan śatam | śaucārthaṃ kalaśaṃ dhṛtvā kṣetramadhye gato’bhavam || 2 || gṛdhrāṇāṃ madhyato mārgaṃ kṛtvāhamagamaṃ puraḥ | gṛdhrāste miṣṭaśabdena cocurvākyāni vīkṣya mām || 3 || tiṣṭhanto yatra tatraiva viśvastā nirbhayāḥ sukhāḥ | aho’smākaṃ mahad bhāgyaṃ bhūtale samupasthitam || 4 || ayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādasmanmadhye samāgataḥ | sādhurūpaḥ sādhuśīlo muktido muktidastathā || 5 || pragṛhṇantu caraṇayoścāsya rajāṃsi pakṣayoḥ | mūrghni mukhe jalaṃ cāsya kalaśādapi pāvanam || 6 || brahmakamaṇḍalūvāri sahasrāṃśe na tatsamam | mokṣo’smākaṃ bhavitaiva spṛśantvasya pade hyubhe || 7 || pakṣābhyāṃ vījayantven śrīkāntaṃ puruṣottamam | susvaraiḥ kīrtayantven nārāyaṇa narāyaṇa || 8 || mastakaiḥ praṇamantvenaṃ pāpaprajvālakaṃ harim | padbhyāṃ tamabhigacchantu pradakṣiṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 9 || cakṣurbhyāṃ śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vilokayantu satpatim | santaṃ satāṃ patiṃ sādhvīnāthaṃ pakṣipatiṃ prabhum || 3.81.10 || ityevamuccarantaścāyayuḥ samantataśca mām | nemuḥ pādau pasparśuśca cakruśca darśanaṃ muhuḥ || 11 || prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ mokṣārthaṃ pakṣiyonitaḥ | ūcuśca vayamāsan vai śūdrā vyādhā hi mānavāḥ || 1 2|| abrahmaṇyā nṛśaṃsāśca kadaryāḥ pāpajīvinaḥ | apahārakāścaurāśca dveṣṭāro dehināṃ tathā || 1 3|| mithyācārā vyabhicārā parasvaharaṇe ratāḥ | devapitṛmakhadveṣṭāraśca bhīdā hi dehinām || 14|| dhanadhānyādisampattiṃ dṛṣṭvānyasyerṣyavastathā | tena pāpena jātāḥ smo gṛdhrajātīyapakṣiṇaḥ || 15|| pakṣiṣu śvapacāḥ sarve durgandhiśavabhakṣiṇaḥ | nikṛṣṭā nijapāpaistānnaḥ kṛpāṃ kuru coddhara || 16|| vyādhatve’pi vane sādhūn dṛṣṭvā datvā phalāni ca | āśīrvādān gṛhītvā cārjitavantaḥ supuṇyakam || 17|| tatpuṇyena smṛtirnāsmān vijahāti hare prabho | ityarthitastadāhaṃ tānavocaṃ saṃgaterbalāt || 18|| satāṃ sevāphalaṃ tvetat prāgjanmasmaraṇaṃ tathā | mamāpi darśanaṃ cātra tiryagjanmanivārakam || 1 9|| atha yūyaṃ ca rājāno bhaviṣyatha tataḥ param | viprā bhūtvā tato devāstato brahmarṣayaḥ śubhāḥ ||3.81.20|| satyaloke ciraṃ sthitvā prayāsyathākṣaraṃ mama | tatra tatra hi sādhūnāṃ samāgamo bhaviṣyati ||21 || ityuktāste mayā lakṣmi gṛdhrāḥ sarve mṛtiṃ gatāḥ | jātāste kṣatriyāḥ sarve mṛtvā viprāstato’bhavan || 22|| tato devāśca ṛṣayastato dhāmākṣaraṃ yayuḥ | ityevaṃ sādhusaṃgasya phalaṃ te’bhihitaṃ mayā ||23|| tiraścāmapi yanme’pi darśanaṃ sulabhaṃ hyabhūt | yenāvāpuḥ padaṃ gṛdhrāḥ pūrṇaṃ brahma sanātanam ||24|| tasmāt samāgamaḥ kāryaḥ pāpināpi satāṃ muhuḥ | pāpakṣālanamevāpi puṇyaṃ muktiśca saṃbhavet ||25|| ekadā lomaśo bhūmau padbhyāṃ sādhuśatairyutaḥ | vicacāra hi śreyo’rthaṃ lokānāṃ śuddhikāmyayā ||26|| mārge śrutvā padānāṃ vai śabdān jīvaṭakīṭakaḥ | adhāvad vāṭadeśādvai bahirgantuṃ tvarānvitaḥ ||27|| lomaśaḥ paripapraccha dṛṣṭvā jīvaṭakīṭakam | kathaṃ tvaritastrasto’si gamyate kva tvayā vada ||28|| śrutvā jīvaṭakīṭaśca prāhāhaṃ vīkṣya maṇḍalam | satāṃ tu bahusaṃkhyākaṃ śrutvā pādasvanām̐stathā ||29|| bhayaṃ prāpto mṛtyujātaṃ pādakaccaramardanāt | dhāvāmi satvaraṃ mārgād yathā bahiḥ prayāmi vai ||3.81.3 0|| gṛhaṃ me vidyate pārśve strīputrādisukhānvitam | akālamaraṇaṃ me na bhavecchūnye kuṭumbinaḥ ||3 1|| ekalasya mṛtiḥ śūnye kuṭumbarahitasya me | asadgatipradā syādvai śoceyurmama bāndhavāḥ ||32|| tasmācchīghraṃ pravadāmi mṛtyorduḥkhaṃ paraṃ yataḥ | tvarayāmi jīvanārthaṃ jīvataḥ sukhamuttamam ||33 || lomaśastu samākarṇya jīvaṭaṃ prāha te kutaḥ | kīṭayonau sukhaṃ cāste duḥkhayonau vadātra me ||34|| duḥkhayonestu maraṇaṃ tava śreyo bhavediha | nābhijānāsi vai śreṣṭhān sparśabhogasukhottamān ||35|| na ca vetsi rasamiṣṭān yānavāhanasūtsavān | tasmātpāpe’tra dehe te śreyo vai maraṇaṃ bhavet ||36|| jīvaṭaḥ prāha śrutvaiva lomaśaṃ dīrghadarśinam | dehī sarvatra susukhī yatra dehe pravartate ||37|| vanaṃ paśyāmi vividhaṃ vividhān dṛśyasaṃbhavān | kuṭumbaṃ strīsutāḍhyaṃ ca paśyāmi cotsavānvitaḥ ||38|| spṛśāmi strīṃ sutaṃ putrīṃ kuṭumbino’tra bhūtale | śṛṇomi vividhā gītīścāraṇye svajanādiyuk ||39|| bhakṣayāmi rasān miṣṭān vṛkṣavallīsamudbhavān | jighrāmi bahudhā gandhān bhuṃjāmi viṣayān bahūn ||3.81.40|| yathādehaṃ viṣayā me vartante cottamottamāḥ | sakuṭumbo bhavāmyatra kuṭumbaṃ cottamaṃ mama ||41||| ityākarṇya ṛṣiḥ prāha śṛṇu kīṭa vadāmi te | alpāyustvaṃ lakṣyase’tra kṛtayatno’pi sarvathā ||42|| mṛtyustava hi nikaṭe dhṛtapāśaḥ pratiṣṭhati | tasmān mā vaha vāñcchāṃ vā jīvanārthaṃ sukhāya vā ||43 || sādhusamāgamaḥ kīṭa bahupuṇyāya kalpate | mṛtyuste vidyate’vaśyaścādya kṣaṇe na saṃśayaḥ ||44|| yadi me darśanāt kīṭa śreṣṭhaṃ janma samicchasi | vada te tad dadāmyatra śubhaṃ janma satāṃ balāt ||45|| etān sādhūnnamaskāraṃ kṛtvā yāhi mṛtiṃ tataḥ | kalyāṇaṃ te kariṣyāmi vada kiṃ te mano’tra ha ||46|| jīvaṭaśca tataḥ prāha yadyevaṃ maraṇaṃ mama | pārśve mama kuṭumbasya sannidhau mṛtirastu me ||47 || mānavaśca tato deho bhavatvatra ca bhūtale | yena śreyo vividhaṃ me satāṃ yogād bhaviṣyati ||48 || ityuktvā tūrṇamevāsau vāṭapārśvamupāgataḥ | tṛṇamūle kṛtāvāsān kuṭumbinaśca gartagān ||49 || ājuhāva drutaṃ kīṭaḥ sammilya tān mṛtiṃ yayau | tajjīvaṃ sthāpayāmāsa kṣattragarbhe surāṣṭrake ||3.81.50 || paurarājyakule jāto rājā prajāniyāmakaḥ | lomaśaśca tato bhūyo yayāvabdhitaṭe mudā ||5 1 || dadarśabhūpaṃ bhūyo’pi jātismaro’rcayanmunim | jagrāha caraṇau bhaktyā provāca sarvameva tu ||52 || ṛṣe te kṛpayā kīṭānnirgatyāsmi nṛpo’bhavan | nāryo gajāśca turagā uṣṭrā yānāni sampadaḥ |||53 || bhavanti mama bhogyāste kṛpayātra guro sadā | sādhukṛpāphalaṃ caitat prāśnāmi miṣṭamuttamam ||54|| śreṣṭhaśayyātale rājñīsevitaśca svapimyapi | jāgarmi vanditaḥ sūtādyaiśca devo yathā hariḥ ||55|| dāsyo dāsā hyasaṃkhyā me’mātyāścājñāvahāḥ śubhāḥ | namaste’stu guro sādho kiṃ karomi vadātra me ||56 || śrutvā hṛṣṭo lomaśastaṃ nṛpaṃ vai jīvacandrakam | prāha rājam̐stvayā rājadehād gantavyameva ha ||57|| bhogā bhuktāstvayā rājan bahudhā me hyanugrahāt | atha tvaṃ bhava vipro vai śreṣṭhajanma gṛhāṇa ca ||58|| mama te darśanaṃ jātaṃ tadeva sukṛtaṃ punaḥ | vaiṣṇavastvaṃ bhava mantraṃ gṛhṇa śreyo bhaviṣyati ||59 || tyaja mohaṃ kuṭumbasya rājyasya strījanasya ca | sādhukṛpāṃ gṛhāṇātra mā pramādī bhavātra vai || 3.81.60 || ityuktaḥ sa nṛpastūrṇaṃ jagrāha mantramuttamam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||6 1 || atha śrīlomaśastatra dadhyau nārāyaṇaṃ hṛdi | tāvad rājā śarīraṃ svaṃ tatyāja sarvasannidhau || 62 || saurāṣṭre cābhavad vipro’kṣarakṣetre’tra cottame | kuṃkumavāpikātīrthe cāśvapaṭṭasarontike | |6 3 || yogāyano maharṣiḥ sa jātismaro’ti bhaktimān | janmataḥ siddhimān dharmī brahmiṣṭhaḥ pāvanaḥ paraḥ || 64|| atha śrīlomaśastaṃ ca kumāraṃ pratyapadyata | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhaja mahāmate ||65|| mama yogāt kṣetrayogānmuktiste bhāvinī śubhā | parameśvarabhakteśca phalaṃ te syānmahottamam ||66|| baṭuḥ sa vaiṣṇavaśreṣṭhaḥ sarvamantrān ṛṣermukhāt | jagrāha ca tato naijāṃ jananīṃ tu kalāvatīm ||67|| pitaraṃ cāryaśīlākhyaṃ nanāma bhāvatastadā | ājñāṃ labdhvā tatastūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tīrthaṃ supūjanam ||68|| māmabhigamya ca naijaṃ dehaṃ tyaktvā vimānagaḥ | mama sālokyamagamad brahma dhāma sanātanam ||69|| avāpa sa padaṃ lakṣmi mama dhāmākṣaraṃ param | sādhoḥ samāgamādevaṃ mokṣapadaṃ hi labhyate ||3.81.70|| sādhavo matpādajuṣaścakṣurdadati cāntaram | vidhūnvanti ca pāpāni janmahrāsaṃ dadhatyapi ||71|| karmakṣayaṃ kārayanti kṛpayā puṇyaśevadhim | dadatyapi svānugāya bhaktāya prahitātmane ||72|| bandhanāni vicitrāṇi dṛḍhāni yāni cātmanām | tāni vibhedayitveha vitaranti śubhāni ca ||73|| svargasukhāni ramyāṇi satyakalpodbhavāni ca | devatulyāni varṣmāṇi bhogyānīśvarabhāni ca ||74|| śāśvatadivyamūrtiṃ ca kṛtvā dhāmākṣaraṃ mama | preṣayanti pratāpena naijena mama sādhavaḥ ||75|| sādhvyaścaiva śubhācārā mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ | svayogamāgatān jīvān preṣayanti padaṃ mama ||76|| śṛṇu lakṣmi vinodinyā viprāyāśca kathāṃ śubhām | dhārāgrāmanivāsinyā bhaktāyā mama pāvanīm ||77|| pativratā patiṃ sādhvī siṣeve ceśavat sadā | bhāgavataṃ śatānandanāmānaṃ vipramuttamam ||78|| daśasāhasravarṣāṇi tayorgatāni bhūtale | brahmaparāyaṇayorvai bhaktayoranapatyayoḥ ||79|| śatānandastvekadāṃ tāṃ patnīṃ prāha śubhāśayaḥ | kathaṃ sādhvi ṛtusnātā dharmeṇa sevitāpi vai ||3.81.80|| garbhe vaṃśakaraṃ naiva ghārayasyatra me vada | kāraṇaṃ vā vibhāgyaṃ vā vandhyātvaṃ vāpi vetsi cet ||8 1 || mama doṣo’thavā cāste mama bhāgyaṃ na cāsti vā | kathaṃ putravatī naiva cireṇāpi vilokyase ||82|| śrutvā patnī patiṃ prāha kāraṇaṃ bhaktarāṭ śṛṇu | garbhavāso mahad duḥkhaṃ jīvasyānalapācane ||83|| janmaduḥkhaṃ dehaduḥkhaṃ mṛtyorduḥkhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | aśuddhiśca punarduḥkhaṃ niraye gamanaṃ punaḥ ||84|| vāsanāpi mahadduḥkhaṃ snehaduḥkhaṃ punastathā | evaṃ duḥkhāni cālokyānapatyatve paraṃ sukham ||85|| matvā nāhaṃ dhārayāmi garbhaṃ māyāviḍambanam | śrutvā tāṃ ca patistvāha ṛṇaṃ pitṛkṛtaṃ priye ||86|| yāvannottīryate tāvat pitṝṇāṃ duḥkhamityapi | mama duḥkhaṃ ca te duḥkhaṃ punnāmanarakodbhavam ||87|| vandhyātvasyāpavādaṃ ca nirvaṃśatvādikiṃkathām | apākartumapi sādhvī garbhaṃ dhartuṃ tvamarhasi ||88|| śrutvaivaṃ sādhvikā prāha yadyevaṃ kānta saṃśṛṇu | putrā ye ye bhaveyuste preṣaṇīyā hariṃ prati ||89|| bhaktāḥ syuḥ sādhavaścaite muktiṃ dāsyanti me ca te | ityevaṃ vāgbandhanena dhārayāmi ca daurhṛdam || 3.81.90|| tathāstviti patiḥ prāha ṛtusnātā ca sevitā | dadhāra garbhaṃ patitaḥ suṣuve kālataḥ sutam ||91|| vavṛdhe ca śanairbālo bodhitaścātmavid yathā | mātrā vivekavān putraḥ kṛtopavītasaṃskṛtiḥ ||92|| niveditaśca mahyaṃ vai sādhutvārthaṃ samarpitaḥ | muktyāyano mayā nāmnā kṛtaḥ sādhurviraktimān || 93 || śatānandaḥ prasanno’bhūt putraṃ sādhuṃ vilokya ha | atha patnīṃ dvitīyaṃ ca garbhaṃ dadhāra kālataḥ ||94|| suṣuve kālataścāpi vardhayāmāsa bhāvataḥ | bodhayāmāsa vijñānairdadau mahyaṃ ca taṃ sutam ||95|| so’pi sandīkṣito nāmnā brahmāyanaḥ kṛto mayā | kavirjāto mahān sādhurmokṣamārgaparāyaṇaḥ ||96|| śatānandaśca taṃ vīkṣya prasannaḥ samajāyata | dadau tṛtīyagarbhaṃ ca patnyai prasannamānasaḥ ||97|| suṣuve sā ca taṃ putraṃ śikṣayāmāsa sevanam | jñānaṃ gānaṃ dadau mahyaṃ sādhudīkṣārthameva ca ||98|| mayā tu dīkṣito nāmnā premāyanaḥ kṛtaḥ sa ca | gītikākuśalaḥ sādhuḥ so’pi mokṣaparo’bhavat ||99|| putrāḥ pañcaśatānyevaṃ samajāyanta vai cirāt | sarve te sādhavo jātā mama dīkṣāparāyaṇāḥ || 3.81.100 || divyā divyavihārāśca divyakriyā hi sādhavaḥ | tīrtharūpāḥ samastāste śīlavrataparāyaṇāḥ || 10 1|| jīvānāṃ mokṣadāḥ sarve jñānadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ | mama bhaktiyutāḥ saumyā sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ || 1 02|| vidyāvantaḥ śīlavanto mama mūrtiparāyaṇāḥ | aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre vasantyete hi yoginaḥ || 103|| śatānandasya putrāste mahābhāgavatāstvime | vartante bhaktikartāraścākṣare kṣetrake mama || 1 04|| athānte śrīśatānandaḥ patnīṃ prāha sutaṃ tu me | dehyekaṃ vaṃśakartāraṃ mā taṃ sādhuṃ vidhehi vai || 1 05|| ityuktvā brāhmaṇī vinodinī putraṃ tu cāntimam | viśvāyanaṃ dadau saṃśikṣitaṃ kāntāya padmaje || 1 06|| viśvāyano’bhavannityaṃ gṛhadharmānvito hi saḥ | vivāhito vaṃśakartā maharṣirlomaśāśrame || 1 07|| mahābhāgavato dīkṣāyuto vedāṃgapāragaḥ | atha vinodinī ceyaṃ sādhvīdīkṣāsudīkṣitā || 1 08|| amṛtākhyā brahmasakhī vartate tyāgamāśritā | śatānando’pi sādhutve vartate cāśrame mama || 1 09|| mama sevāparo divyagatimān padmaje sadā | ityevaṃ kathitaṃ te’tra vinodinyāḥ kathānakam || 3.81.1 10|| mokṣārthaṃ samavartinyāḥ sarvaputrārpaṇātmakam | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya mokṣamārgo bhaveddhruvaḥ || 111 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sādhusaṃgatyā gṛdhrāṇāṃ mokṣo jīvaṭakīṭasya mokṣo vinodinyāḥ paṃcaśataputrāṇāṃ sādhutvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 81 ||
<3.82> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇa prabho vibho | svairiṇyāścāpi kāminyāḥ puṃścalyāścāpi yoṣitaḥ || 1 || savāsanāyāḥ pāpāni naśyeyurvai kathaṃ vada | kā gatirvāpi tasyāḥ syāt kena śuddhiśca jāyate || 2 || kathaṃ vā sadgatiḥ syācca dayāṃ kṛtvā vadasva me | anāthāyā hi nāthastvaṃ cābalāyā balaṃ bhavān || 3 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ kalyāṇakṛdvacaḥ | dayayā hi tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ tasmād ṛju vadāmi te || 4 || saṃgād balācca puṣṭeśca madād rasācca yauvanāt | jāyante vāsanāstīvrā bhogātmikyo hi kāmanāḥ || 5 || ṛtavo dhātavaścāpīndriyadārḍhyaṃ sukheṣaṇā | uttejakā hi kāmānāṃ tṛṣṇātantuvivardhakāḥ || 6 || aṃgānāṃ darśanāddhāsyādekāntasya prasevanāt | prāyaśo hi vivardhante sparśādeḥ kāmavāsanāḥ || 7 || ayogyā api yujyante dehābhyāṃ vai parasparam | lokaśāstravyavahārān parityajya svatantrataḥ || 8 || kāminītvaṃ puṃścalītvaṃ svairiṇītvaṃ tato bhavet | kāmakāreṇa loke’tra yoṣitāṃ lagnamantarā || 9 || puruṣāṇāṃ ca svairatvaṃ strīcalatvaṃ ca kāmitā | bhavatyevātikāmena tṛṣṇayā māyayāpi ca || 3.82.10 || teṣāṃ pāpavināśārthaṃ sādhanāni bahūnyapi | bhavanti padmaje prāyaścittāni ca vratāni ca || 1 1|| duṣkarāṇi tathā yāmyavedanāni bahūnyapi | dehadaṇḍāni cānyāni rājadaṇḍāni santyapi || 12|| tyāgāśramāṇi ramyāṇi tāpasāśramaṇāni ca | tīrthāni vividhānyeva bhavanti śuddhaye’pi ca || 1 3|| tadeteṣāṃ paraṃśreyaḥkaraṃ tu śaraṇāgatiḥ | naitādṛśaṃ paraṃ cāsti sādhanaṃ cetarat tviha || 14|| pāpānāṃ nāśakaṃ sarvapuṇyānāṃ dāyakaṃ tathā | sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ tatra vāsanākṣālakaṃ matam || 15|| satsaṃgo jñānadastatra moharāganivārakaḥ | kṛpā cātmonnatiprāptikāraṇaṃ vai satāṃ matā || 16|| prasādabhojanaṃ pādavāryamṛtādipānakam | satāṃ sadyaḥ punātyeva pāpakoṭiyutaṃ janam || 17|| santaḥ pratyakṣatīrthāni santaḥ pratyakṣavahnayaḥ | santaḥ pratyakṣavarṣā ca santaḥ sākṣātsudhāmṛtam || 18|| santaḥ sākṣād dharmadehāḥ santo’haṃ bhagavān svayam | santo yajñā gocarā vai santo devādhidevatāḥ || 19|| santo vratāni sarvāṇi santo nāvo bhavāmbudhau | santo’ nārāyaṇāḥ sarve santastejāṃsi śārṅgiṇaḥ || 3.82.20||| santastapāṃsi sarvāṇi santo brahma hi pāvanam | santaḥ kāmadughā bodhyāḥ santo vai kalpapādapāḥ ||21 || santaśca kalpalatikāḥ santaścintāmaṇīśvarāḥ | santaścākṣayapātrāṇi puṇyānāṃ dharmakarmaṇām ||22|| santaścāvyayakośāśca śāśvatānandavāridheḥ | tārakā dhārakāḥ santaḥ pāpānāṃ kṣālakā drutam ||23|| harergṛhāṇi santo vai mūrtayaḥ sādhavo mama | teṣāṃ samāgamāttūrṇa mahāpāpābdhayo’pi ca ||24|| anale tṛṇavad bhasmībhavanti sparśamātrataḥ | mahāpāpābhirevātra strībhirnaijaviśuddhaye ||25|| sarvasvārpaṇabhāvena sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ | mama mantrān śaraṇādipradān sadbhyo’vagamya ca ||26|| mahābhāgyavatīrītyā praseveta sato janān | darśanaṃ sparśanaṃ natiṃ paricaryā ca pūjanam | | 27|| bhojanaṃ mardanaṃ pānaṃ snānaṃ ca śravaṇaṃ hareḥ | satāṃ cāpi prakuryācca yeṣāṃ svāmī bhavāmyaham || 28 || tadā lakṣmi svāmivatpāvanāḥ santo matā mama | santa iva ca śaraṇāgatāśca sevakāḥ khalu | | 29 || sevikāśca bhavantyeva sudivyā nirguṇāstathā | niṣpāpā pāvanāḥ sarve viṣṇuḥ santaśca sevakāḥ || 3.82.30 || ityetatparamaṃ guptaṃ rahasyaṃ mama te priye | abalānāṃ kṛte coktaṃ sulabhaṃ pāvanaṃ param || 31 || yadāśritya satāṃ yogājjāyante vahnisannibhāḥ | brahmanibhā bhavantyeva nāryo niṣpāpavigrahāḥ || 3 2|| śṛṇu te’tra kathayāmi pratyakṣaṃ te nidarśanam | vārāṇasī purī lakṣmi śiveśvarasya te pituḥ || 33 || yatra gaṇāśca gaṇikāḥ sahasraśaḥ pitustava | sevakāḥ sevikāścāpi vidyante cāvivāhitāḥ || 34 || yatheṣṭakāmacārāśca śivasya bhaktikāriṇaḥ | svairiṇyaścāpi puṃścalyaḥ kāminyo gaṇikāḥ khalu || 3 5|| vasanti te pituḥ puryāṃ pumāṃse’pi tathāvidhāḥ | gaṇā bhāṇḍā nartakāśca gāyakā vādakā api || 36 || nagnā gaṇāstathā nagnā yoginyo gaṇikāstathā | yathākāmaṃ pravartante yogiśaṃkarasaṃśrayāḥ | | 37 || teṣāṃ tāsāmekadā vai gaṃgāyāstu jale’bhavat | samājo hi tu naukāsu gānakīrtananartanaiḥ || 38 || gaṇikānāṃ nartanāni bhāṇḍānāṃ hasanāni ca | vṛndalānāṃ ca narmāṇi prāvartanta niśāmukhe || 39 || pravṛddhamaṃgalanāmnā jāyate sa mahotsavaḥ | tatra vai prekṣakā rātrau lakṣaśo mānavā api ||3.82.40 || abhavan saṃghaśo vārau naukāsu sarvatodiśi | kṛtvotsavān sāptadainān vyaramanta pitustava || 41 || viśvanāthasvasūpasya mandire nartanādibhiḥ | athātra bhagavān yogī vātsyāyano mahānṛṣiḥ ||42 || ājīvaṃ brahmacaryasthaḥ sādhudharmaparāyaṇaḥ | ūrdhvaretāḥ śaṃbhuvacca mahāyogīndrasattamaḥ || 43 || samājagāma tatraiva dharmāraṇyāt sutīrthakṛt | vivastro bhānahīnaśca sarvāṃgadhūlidhūsaraḥ | | 44| | avikāro yuvā cāpi vārdhakyavṛttibhūṣitaḥ | sarvaṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ ca yasya dṛṣṭau pravartate ||45|| naranārītibhāhīnaḥ svayaṃ sādhuḥ suśobhanaḥ | dadarśa śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ gaṇān pūjanatatparān ||46|| gaṇikāśca samastā vai yuvatīrbhūṣitāstathā | śṛṃgāritā yathā tāśca svairiṇīriva saṃsthitāḥ ||47|| puṃścalīḥ kāminīścāpi sarvaceṣṭāsamanvitāḥ | utsave te pituḥ prasannatāprāptyai suyatnitāḥ ||48|| vahnikanyā iva ramyā devīriva samujjvalāḥ | ratnahīrakamauktikādyalaṃkṛtāḥ suśobhanāḥ ||49|| vīkṣya sarvāṃ ṛṣirvātsyāyanaḥ sādhurnanāma ha | harabhaktānikāḥ sarvā vīkṣya śāntaṃ sthitaṃ munim ||3.82.50|| yuvānaṃ raktapuṣṭaṃ ca nagnaṃ śaṃkarasadṛśam | dhyānamagnaṃ dehabhānavarjitaṃ sūryabhāsvaram |||5 1 || mohotpādakarūpaṃ ca bhogyamānasasaṃśrayam | puṇyapuñjaṃ sparśamātrāt pāpapuñjapradāhakam ||52|| etādṛśaṃ varaṃ vīkṣya mugdhā niścitya śaṃkaram | mūrtimantaṃ cāgataṃ vai pasparśuḥ gaṇikāgaṇāḥ ||53|| yadyapi kāmabhāvena mohabhāvena kāścana | kāścana devabhāvena sādhubhāvena kāścana ||54|| pādau cucumburdevasya ṛṣerligaṃ ca netrayoḥ | sparśayāmāsuratyarthaṃ menire ca kṛtārthatām ||55|| āścaryaṃ tatra tāsāṃ vai jātaṃ śṛṇu hi padmaje | ṛṣistu tiṣṭhate stabdho jaḍavat susamādhigaḥ ||56|| yāḥ spṛśanti gaṇikāstaṃ tāsāṃ rājasavṛttayaḥ | yāścāsan prāksamastāstā vyalīyanta spṛśeḥ ṛṣeḥ ||57|| niṣkāmatāṃ gatāḥ sarvāḥ sattvapūrṇāḥ śubhāśayāḥ | kāmavṛttivihīnā vai sparśamātrāt kṣaṇāntare ||58|| cāñcalyaṃ sarvathā naṣṭaṃ gaṇikānāṃ samantataḥ | yonīnāṃ ca vikārā vai vegā nirvegatāṃ yayuḥ ||59|| mānasāni samastānāṃ nirvikārāṇi cābhavan | saṃkalpā vāsanāḥ kāmā rāgā ratiśca kāmanā ||3.82.60 || sarve līnāḥ kṣaṇāt tāsāṃ yogisparśagayoṣitām | divyāśca dṛṣṭayastāsāmabhavan śaṃbhuyoṣitām ||61 || athākāśe mahāścaryaṃ vyalokayam̐stataśca tāḥ | lakṣaśaśca samudbhūtā vāgurikā hyadhomukhāḥ ||62|| gatāścākāśamārgeṇa gaṃgānugā himālayam | gaṇikāstatra sañjātāḥ sarvāvaraṇavarjitāḥ ||63|| divyāśca divyadehāśca satīrādhāramā yathā | tatastāḥ śuddhimāpannāḥ sarvāḥ pāpavivarjitāḥ ||64|| antardṛṣṭyā vilokyainaṃ vātsyāyanaṃ hi yoginam | brahmarūpaṃ pāpanāśakaraṃ sparśena sarvathā ||65|| viditvā taṃ munīndraṃ vai sādhuṃ sādhuvibhūṣaṇam | natvā spṛṣṭvā punaḥ santaṃ papracchurvinayānvitāḥ ||66|| sādho puṇyapratāpātte divyā no dṛṣṭayastviha | dehāścāpi ca divyā no jātāḥ sparśanadarśanāt ||67|| kāmā hṛdayyā naṣṭāśca yuvatītvaṃ hi cañcalam | sarvaṃ līnaṃ bhavadyogāt pādadhūlipravāhaṇāt ||68|| vayaṃ sarvāḥ pāvitāśca svairiṇyo gaṇikāstviha | puṃścalyaścāpi kāminyo yathā sādhvyaḥ sma eva ha ||69|| śaṃkarasya prapūjāyāḥ phalaṃ mahotsavasya ca | prāptaṃ tvadya hi loke’tra hṛndi yannirmalāni naḥ ||3.82.70|| paraṃ pṛcchāma evātra sādho vāgurikāśca yāḥ | ambare tāḥ samuḍḍīya lakṣaśo vigatāstvitaḥ ||71 || kāstāḥ kathaṃ samāyātāḥ kva gatāśca kutaśca tāḥ | vada nastad yathārthaṃ vai tvaṃ nau nairmalyakārakaḥ ||72|| śrutvā vātsyāyanaḥ prāha sādhvyaḥ śṛṇuta madvacaḥ | mama sparśo bhavatībhiryena kenāpi karmaṇā ||73|| yena kenāpi bhāvena vihito’trāṃganāstataḥ | bhavatīnāṃ vāsanā yāḥ kāmapāpātmikāstathā ||74|| tṛṣṇāḥ pāpātmikāścāpi pāpānyasaṃkhyakāni ca | gaṇikākṛtakarmāṇi tāni sarvāṇi yāni ca ||75|| mama pādasparśanena malliṃgasparśanena ca | maddhūlidhāraṇenāpi dehebhyo nirgatāni vai ||76|| bhavatīnāṃ śarīrāṇāṃ pāvanatvaṃ vilokya ca | aśaktāni hi saṃsthātuṃ niryātāni samantataḥ ||77|| tāni sarvāṇi pāpāni vāgulikātmakāni ca | bhūtvā yātāni sarvāṇi himālaye tu mānasam ||78|| sarastatra bhaviṣyatyaddhā tanmokṣo vilīnatā | mama yogena sarvāsāṃ pāpāni nirgatāni vai ||79|| atha yūyaṃ samastāśca gṛhṇata mantramuttamam | ityuktvā pradadau mantraṃ gaṇikābhyo manuṃ mama ||3.82.80|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | gṛhītvā gaṇikādevyo mantraṃ tūrṇaṃ caturbhujāḥ ||81|| bhūtvā śrīvaiṣṇavīdevyo divyadehāḥ suśobhanāḥ | nārāyaṇyo vimānaiśca yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||82|| sahasraśo gaṇikāstā haripriyāstato’bhavan | vartante cākṣaredhāmni mama sevāparāyaṇāḥ ||83|| ityevaṃ sādhusaṃgena lakṣmi puṃścalikā api | sadyaḥ śuddhyati dharmāḍhyā divyā bhavati sevikā ||84|| tasmāt pāpātipāpānāṃ śodhakaṃ sevanaṃ satām | yena kenāpi bhāvena sevitāḥ śodhayanti te ||85|| athānyā gaṇikāḥ śrutvā cāyayustamṛṣiṃ prati | śuddhyarthaṃ ca tadā tābhyaḥ kāmaśāstraṃ jagāda ha ||86|| śrāvayitvā śikṣayitvā sevāṃ datvā nijāṃ tataḥ | tāsāṃ mokṣaṃ cakārāpi vātsyāyano mahānṛṣiḥ ||87|| śaṃkaraśca svayaṃ mūrtimān bhūtvā gocaro’sya ca | abhavat prāha dhanyo’si gaṇikāmokṣakṛd ṛṣe ||88 || sādho sādhusvarūpo’si kāmaṃ kṛtvā sucintitam | api kāmena naiva tvaṃ lipto’si kāmaśāstrakṛt ||89|| yathāhaṃ dāhakaścāsmi kāmasya jīvako’pi ca | yathā kṛṣṇo vijetāsti kāmasya ramayannapi ||3.82.90|| tathā tvaṃ ca vijetāsi kāmasya varṇayannapi | bhava sādho muktidātā pāpaṃ vināśya yoṣitām ||91|| śāstraṃ te tava nāmnaiva khyātaṃ loke bhaviṣyati | ityuktvā śaṃkaro devo tirobhāvaṃ pitā tava ||92|| yayau kāśyāṃ ca sādhuḥ sa vyacacāra mahītale | mokṣayan jīvajātāni vātsyāyano hi vaiṣṇavaḥ ||93|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāt sevanādapi | mahāpāpāni naśyanti mokṣagatirdhruvā bhavet ||94|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi rahasyaṃ sādhusevanam | bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyabhāvapradaṃ kathānakam ||95|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne svairiṇīkāminīpuṃścalīnāmapi gaṇikānāṃ kāśyāṃ sādhuvātsyāyanasamāgamena pāpanāśottaraṃ muktiprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 82 ||
<3.83> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca kena vai hetunā sādhurnārāyaṇo nigadyate | yadyapi bahavastatra hetavaḥ syurdṛḍhavratāḥ || 1 || tathāpi saralaṃ hetuṃ yadvā śreṣṭhamanuttamam | duṣkaraṃ vāvagantuṃ taṃ samicchāmi tathā vada || 2 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mahataśca hetūn bahuvidhānapi | kṣamā śīlaṃ virāgaśca śāntistathāparigrahaḥ || 3 || vaitṛṣṇyaṃ svādaśūnyatvaṃ cātmaniṣṭhatvamityapi | alolupatā dveṣādirāhityaṃ sarvamitratā || 4 || ātmasādhanakartavyaṃ mayi sarvasamarpaṇam | asneho bandhaśūnyatvaṃ māyākaiṃkaryavarjanam || 5 || dehendriyādiyātrātanmātranirvāhaṇārjanam | pratīkṣā mokṣalokasya mamāhaṃvarjanaṃ tathā || 6 || navonmeṣārambhahāniḥ sthairyaṃ cātmani netare | śīlaṃ manaso nairmalyaṃ sādhutve kāraṇāni vai || 7 || paropakāro yasyāsti mokṣamārgapradarśanam | vrataṃ śīlaṃ ca yasyāsti nārāyaṇārthamuttamam || 8 || tapaścograṃ ca yasyāsti māyābandhanavarjitam | vṛttayaścāpi sarvā vai yasya madgocaraḥ sadā || 9 || hyetaccatuṣṭayaṃ lakṣmi sādhutve mukhyakāraṇam | nahi kāṣāyavastrāṇi nahi cihnāni bāhyataḥ || 3.83.10|| nahi dīkṣā nahi vāsaḥ sādhutve śreṣṭhahetavaḥ | ātmamokṣavidhātāro māyāmokṣādyabhīpsavaḥ || 1 1|| parabrahmaṇi niṣṇātāstāpasāḥ sādhusattamāḥ | sādhvyaścāpi satīdharmaparāḥ śīlaparā mama || 12|| rāgaśūnyā bhaktimatyaḥ sādhvyaḥ sādhvīvibhūṣaṇāḥ | śarīre bhogaśūnyatvaṃ sādhusopānamādimam || 1 3|| indriyarāgaśūnyatvaṃ sopānaṃ ca dvitīyakam | antaḥkaraṇavaśatā sopānaṃ ca tṛtīyakam || 14|| ātmanaścārpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇe sopānaṃ taccaturthakam | jñāne manmūrtivāsaśca sopānaṃ pañcamaṃ ca tat || 15|| mokṣaphalaprayatnaśca sopānaṃ ṣaṣṭhameva tat | turyāvasthāsthitirnityaṃ sopānaṃ cāntimaṃ hi tat || 16|| saptasopānamārūḍhaḥ sādhureva saduttamaḥ | api sādhvyastathācārāḥ sādhvyuttamā matā mama || 17|| ta ete hyuccakakṣāsthāḥ santaḥ sādhvyo mayoditāḥ | madhyakakṣāgatām̐ścāpi darśayāmi nibodha me || 18|| dehendriyādirāgasthāstajjanyasukhalipsavaḥ | kintu sarvārpaṇāḥ kṛṣṇe mayi cātmanivedinaḥ || 19|| māyāyā gauṇabalino madbale cottamāspadāḥ | evaṃvidhā madhyamāste sādhavaḥ sādhvikāḥ priye ||3.83.20|| atha tato’pi nimnasthān śṛṇu lakṣmi madarthakān | sarvathā rāgayuktāśca dehendriyādiyoginaḥ ||21|| labdhadīkṣā api svārthaparāyaṇā madāśrayāḥ | kṛtvo’gre māṃ pradarśyāpi tyāgāśramanivāsinaḥ ||22|| tyāgagandhasya mātrāṃ ca svalpāṃ naiva vidanti ca | tathāpi kaṣṭamāsādya tyāgamārge sthitā iva || 23 || vartante ye nimnacittā jālāvṛttā haridhvajāḥ | ta ete nāmataḥ sarve sādhavo vai bhavanti hi || 24|| yathā kāṣṭhakṛto hastī yathā vyāghraśca carmajaḥ | tathāmbareṇa yaḥ sādhustrayaste vyarthaśaktayaḥ || 25 || ajñānāṃ bhayadāścaite vijñānāmupalā iva | āśritānāṃ neṣṭadāste trayo viśvāsaghātakāḥ || 26 || niścitārthavighātāste samunnativirodhinaḥ | asatkācasamāścaite saṃgād bhaṃganirūpakāḥ || 27|| tapaḥ śrutaṃ ca śaktiścāpyetat sādhutvalakṣaṇam | kṣamā bhaktirvirāgaśca sādhutve kāraṇāni vai || 28 || etādṛśe tu sādhau vai tṛpte tṛptāḥ surādayaḥ | yathā hi sulabhe kṣetre phalaṃ vindati karṣukaḥ || 29 || tathā samarpya sādhau vai phalaṃ dātā samaśnute | asādhau dattamevaitanmoghaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 3.83.30 || adannasādhurhantyannamadyamānaṃ ca hanti tam | taṃ cānnaṃ pāti yaḥ sādhuradannannaṃ ca rakṣati || 31 || rakṣaṇaṃ paraloke’pi pātre’rpitaṃ karoti tat | prabhurhyannamadan sādhurdātāraṃ poṣayatyapi || 3 2|| puṇyena karmaṇā tasmāt satpātre’nnaṃ niyojayet | yadeva dadataḥ puṇyaṃ tadevaṃ pratigṛhṇataḥ || 23 || yadyubhe sādhurūpe vai pātre syātāṃ hi nirmale | yatra vai sādhavaḥ santi śrutavṛttopayoginaḥ || 34|| tatra dānaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ jāyate vai sahasradhā | ye brahmaśuddhāḥ satataṃ śīlaśuddhāśca sādhavaḥ || 35 || tapasyabhiratāścāpi bhaktāḥ pūjyatamā hi te | taiśca sadbhiḥ kṛtaḥ panthā divya eva na saṃśayaḥ | | 36 || tena yātā na muhyanti māyāyāṃ caiśvare sthale | paraṃ pāraṃ pragacchanti brahmavāhā hi sādhavaḥ | | 37 || duranvayaṃ duḥpradharṣaṃ durāpaṃ duratikramam | sadāśīrvādataḥ sarvamabhyeti nātra saṃśayaḥ || 38 || surāpo bhrūṇahāḥ stenau gurutalpaniṣevaṇaḥ | sādhunā tīryate sarvamenasaśca pramucyate || 39 || sarvapūjyāḥ pūjyadhanā vidyāvanto hi sādhavaḥ | tapasvino dānaratā bhaktimanto hi tārakāḥ ||3.83.4 0 || imaṃ ca brahmalokaṃ ca mokṣasthānamanuttamam | sādhusevāsukṛtinaḥ prapadyante tu laukikāḥ ||4 1 || pūjitāḥ pūjayantyete mānitā mānayantyapi | prajvālya pāpipāpāni tārayanti hi sādhavaḥ |||42|| yo bhartā sevakaistuṣṭo bhartustuṣṭāśca sevakāḥ | yatraivaṃ sādhubhāvo’sti tatra kalyāṇakoṭayaḥ ||43|| adbhirgātrānmalamiva tamo’gniprabhayā yathā | sādhośca sevayā tadvat sarvapāpamapohati ||44|| svasti karoti sarvasya pāvayatyapi dehinaḥ | etatkriyāparaḥ sādhuḥ śreyaḥkartā jagattraye ||45|| jīvānāṃ muktaye lakṣmi mayā sāma vinirmitam | sādhavaḥ sāma gāyanti bodhayanti janāniha ||46|| upadiśanti mantrādīn kīrtayanti ca māṃ muhuḥ | varṇayanti kathāṃ me ca caritrāṇi bahūni ca ||47|| guṇānme mama kāryāṇi nirūpayanti sarvathā | evaṃ sāmnā gītikābhirvācayanti hi sādhavaḥ ||48|| vidvāṃso māṃ śāstramukhaiḥ prasaṃgāyanti nityadā | kavayanti ca kavayaḥ stuvanti cārthasādhakāḥ ||49|| evaṃ sāmnā hi bahudhā māmarjayanti mānavāḥ | sāmnā gurormukhātprāpya māṃ ca dānena sādhayet ||3.83.50 || dānaṃ samastabhāvena samarpaṇaṃ niveditā | ātmasamarpaṇaṃ dānaṃ tenārjayecca māṃ sadā ||51 || sādhavo dānayogena cārjayanti dadatyapi | jñānadānaṃ mantradānaṃ nāmadānaṃ harestathā ||52|| prasādadānaṃ mālādipradānaṃ śikṣaṇārpaṇam | lābhadānaṃ sukhadānaṃ mokṣadānaṃ parātparam ||53|| dadatyabhayaṃ dānaṃ tat tapodānaṃ śubhāspadam | puṇyadānaṃ prakurvanti sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇaḥ |||54|| kṛpādānaṃ tathā ramyāśīrvādānāṃ pradānakam | darśanasya pradānaṃ ca sevādānaṃ śubhāvaham ||55|| sadguṇānāṃ pradānaṃ ca tena tena hi sādhavāḥ | māṃ hariṃ cārjayantyeva bhaktebhyaśca dadatyapi ||56|| dīkṣādānaṃ cātmadānaṃ kṛtvāpi tārayanti te | bhaktidānaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā tārayanti janān bhavāt ||57|| antataścāśrayadānaṃ caraṇāmṛtadānakam | vāgdānaṃ sākṣitādānaṃ kṛtvāpi tārayanti te ||58|| manodānaṃ snehadānaṃ pāvitryādipradānakam | sadācārakriyāśikṣādānaṃ smṛtipradānakam ||59|| kaṇṭhīdānaṃ cihnadānaṃ kṛtvāpi tārayanti te | mūrtidānaṃ pātradānaṃ kṛtvāpi tārayanti te ||3.83.60|| atha bhedaṃ yojayanti dānaṃ sāma ca yatra na | deho’yaṃ malasaṃyukto malinaḥ kṣaṇabhaṅguraḥ ||6 1|| ātmā śuddho harerbhakto muktiyogyo hi śāśvataḥ | evaṃ bhedaṃ vivekaṃ vai yojayanti ca sādhavaḥ ||62|| atha daṇḍaṃ vartayanti prāyaścittaṃ vidharmiṇi | amārgagaṃ janaṃ santo niyamayanti sadvrataiḥ ||63|| prāyaścittaiḥ kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādibhiḥ kriyātmakaiḥ | dravyavyayātmakairyajñamahotsavaiḥ sukhotsavaiḥ ||64|| annasatrairbhojanādyaiḥ pūjādānārpaṇādibhiḥ | śreyaskaraistathāyāsairyojayanti viśuddhaye ||65||| dharmakarmādibhiścāpi yojayanti prasahya tān | yadvā prabaladaṇḍena niyamayanti sādhavaḥ ||66 || yathā pāpāni naśyeyurmokṣaṃ vindeyureva ca | evaṃ hitātmadaṇḍena yojayanti hi sādhavaḥ ||67|| garviṣṭhānāṃ tu vai krūraṃ daṇḍaṃ kurvanti vai kvacit | teṣāṃ niṣkalmaṣatārthaṃ muktyarthaṃ cāpi sādhavaḥ ||68|| daivikaṃ vā śubhaṃ daṇḍaṃ prerayanti japādikam | yena niṣkalmaṣatvaṃ ca prāpya yānti paraṃ padam ||69|| pāpī vā puṇyaśālī vā miśrito vobhayādibhiḥ | bhaktimān vā hyabhakto vā nāstiko vāstiko’pi vā ||3.83.70|| yaḥ kaścidvā bhaved dehī nayanti śaraṇaṃ puraḥ | saṃskṛtyopāyabhedaiśca pāvayanti punaḥ punaḥ ||71|| prasādayitvā satataṃ kṛtvā śuddhaṃ sanātanam | nijatulyaṃ tataḥ santo nayanti dhāma cākṣaram ||72|| evaṃ satāṃ sadā lakṣmi paropakāraśālitā | apratidānalabhyā vai tayā śuddhyanti dehinaḥ ||73|| yathā cāhaṃ tathā te vai guravo lokatārakāḥ | ānakhaśikhaṃ santastu pavitrā mama mūrtayaḥ ||74|| yathā vai śarkarākhaṇḍaḥ sarvathā miṣṭasadrasaḥ | bhāgatyāgo na tatrāsti tathā te sādhavo mama ||75|| yathā vā navanītasya piṇḍaḥ snehātmako’khilaḥ | bhāgatyāgo na tatrāsti tathā te sādhavo mama ||76|| yathā vā mauktikaḥ śuddhaḥ svaccho vā sphaṭikastathā | kaustubho vā maṇiryadvat tathā te sādhavo mama ||77|| yathā vā kāmadhenurgauryathā dugdhaṃ ca nirjalam | yathā vā kanakaṃ śuddhaṃ tathā te sādhavo mama ||78|| yathā cintāmaṇiḥ śreṣṭho yathā kalpataruśca vā | kalpavallī yathā śreṣṭhā tathā te sādhavo mama ||79|| yathā me hṛdayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yathā mūrtiśca me parā | yathākṣaraṃ paraṃ dhāma tathā te sādhavo mama ||3.83.80|| yathā viṣṇuḥ sadā śuddhaḥ yathā śīlaṃ vratottamam | yathā śāntirmahaddravyaṃ tathā te sādhavo mama ||81|| yathā kṣetraṃ kaṇisasyānvitaṃ gauḥ prasavonmukhī | yathā yajño dakṣiṇāntastathā te sādhavo mama ||82|| yathā vṛkṣāḥ phalāḍhyāśca puṣpāḍhyā vallayo yathā | camatkārī yathā tyāgī tathā te sādhavo mama ||83|| yathā ratnamayī pṛthvī māyā guṇamayī yathā | ātmā cāśatrayāḍhyaśca tathā te sādhavo mama ||84|| yathāhaṃ sarvasāmarthyo yathā lakṣmīrhi sampadaḥ | yathā kṛṣṇātmakaṃ sarvaṃ tathā te sādhavo mama ||85|| yathā sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ yathā daṇḍo yamasya ca | yathā prasannatā viṣṇostathā te sādhavo mama ||86|| yathā śaṃbhukṛtā bhaktiryathā sevā satīkṛtā | yathā snehaḥ kāmakṛtastathā te sādhavo mama ||87|| yathā kṣamā sādhuniṣṭhā yathā bhaktagataṃ vacaḥ | dāsyaṃ sādhvīgataṃ yadvat tathā te sādhavo matāḥ ||88|| vrataṃ patnīgataṃ yadvat tṛptirnistṛṣṇagā yathā | gaṃgāmbhaḥ pāvanaṃ yadvat tathā te sādhavo mama ||89|| yathā vaṃśaḥ putragato dānaṃ kanyāgataṃ yathā | pūjā gaṇeśagā yadvat tathā te sādhavo mama ||3.83.90|| yathāhaṃ sādhurevāsmi sādhvī tvaṃ ca virājase | yathā yogaścāvayorvai tathā te sādhavo mama ||9 1|| kimvadhikaṃ vedayāmi praśaṃsā nātralabhyate | bhagavantaḥ sādhavo me bhakto’haṃ sarvathā satām |||92||| anarpya mama sadbhyo yo bhuṃkte svodarasaṃbharaḥ | jāyate sa kṛśe deśe kṛśo vai brahmarākṣasaḥ ||93|| sādhūcitaṃ pūjanaṃ cākṛtvā yo modate gṛhe | svagarvāt so’pi dehānte jāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ ||94|| dhanaiśvaryayutaścāpi sevate na sato janān | nindati cāvajānāti sa bhaved brahmarākṣasaḥ ||95|| guṇābhimānasandṛbdho prājñān paśyati vai sataḥ | daridrām̐ścāvajānāti sa bhaved brahmarākṣasaḥ ||96|| ajeyānapi sādhūm̐śca tiraskārān karoti yaḥ | mithyādoṣān prāhiṇoti sa bhaved brahmarākṣasaḥ ||97|| ajātaśatrūn sādhūn yaḥ kleśe yojayatīśvaraḥ | sampanno’pi mṛtaḥ paścājjāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ ||98|| vidvānapi sataḥ śāntānavamatya jugupsati | hīyamāno’pi durvṛttaiḥ sa bhaved brahmarākṣasaḥ || 99|| yastu mitramukhaḥ śatrurbhavati śvāsaghātakaḥ | anāryaścāryavidveṣṭā jāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ || 3.83.100 || ayatsu vartamānaśca sato bhāvaṃ viḍambate | praśaṃsati duṣṭabhāvān jāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ || 101 || mahadguṇaistu yo hīno mahat prārthayate’khilam | sato’vamantā tadyoge jāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ || 1 02|| tapasvinaṃ kṣamāyuktaṃ guruṃ vijñāninaṃ prabhum | prasahya cāvamantā yo jāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ || 103 || sādhūn vanecarān vīkṣya nottiṣṭhate purastu yaḥ | nātmahitaṃ cared yastu jīvan vai rākṣaso hi saḥ || 1 04|| rākṣaso’pi harerbhaktān sādhūnnatvā prasevate | prasādayati sevābhiścāśīrvādān suvindati || 1 05|| sadguṇān sukhadān lakṣmi yo gṛhṇāti sato janāt | sa eva jāyate loke sādhurvai sādhuvartanaḥ || 106 || na janma nāpi yatnaśca na veṣaḥ sādhutārjakaḥ | sādhusatsaṃgasevādi kāraṇaṃ sādhutāgrahe || 1 07|| ta eva tārakā lakṣmi darśanāt sparśanādapi | sevanāt paricaraṇāt taranti dehino bhavāt || 1 08|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sādhutve vividhaprayojakakāraṇādi sādhustavanāstavanaphalādi cetikathananāmā tryaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 83 ||
<3.84> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca kṛpāsindho jīvabandho cātmaprāṇapate vibho | karmakṣetre naranārīdehe prāpte śubhāvahe || 1 || śreyo’rthinā daridreṇa bhāgyahīnena sarvathā | yatra naiva tu sādhūnāṃ labhyate’pi samāgamaḥ || 2 || tatra kṛtvā vidhiṃ kiṃ ca prāpyeta mokṣaṇaṃ nijam | ātmakalyāṇavāñcchāvān kalyāṇaṃ labhate katham || 3 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pṛcchasi śobhanam | karmakṣetramidaṃ cāste labdhvā mānuṣamuttamam || 4 || mātuḥ sevāṃ prakurvīta gṛhatīrthasya sarvathā | yathā yathā nijā mātā prasannā syāttathā tathā || 5 || sevayitvā cārjayedvai tadāśiṣaḥ supuṇyadāḥ | dāridryanāśikāścāpi śreyasāṃ sampradāḥ śubhāḥ || 6 || mātuśca sevayā bhāgyaṃ bhāgyahīnasya vardhate | mātā nārāyaṇī brāhmī śreyaḥ karoti cāśiṣā || 7 || evaṃ pituḥ śubhā sevā kartavyā tīrtharūpiṇaḥ | tadāśīrvādalābhena śreyaḥ puṇyaṃ hi labhyate || 8 || bhāgyaṃ bhavedviśālaṃ ca sampannaṃ śreyasā bhṛtam | athaivaṃ sevayā bhāgyodayena syāt satī matiḥ || 9 || śāstrārthacintane yogyā tato jñānaṃ samarjayet | jñānottaraṃ vivekaśca tato dhyeyaṃ hariṃ tu mām || 2.84.10 || dhyāyīta bhaktiṃ kurvīta mamaiva sarvadā śubhām | bahudhā yatra nairmalyaṃ sthairyaṃ ca manaso bhavet || 11 || nāmajapaṃ prakurvīta hare kṛṣṇa narāyaṇa | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama || 12 || evaṃ vai kīrtanaṃ kurvan kārayan bhajanaṃ param | sakhāyaṃ saṃvidadhīta sakhīn bhaktān vivardhayet| || 13 || satsaṃgamaṇḍalaṃ paścāt sthāpayet saṃbhajeta mām | kīrtanaṃ me sadā kuryāt sāyaṃ caikatra maṇḍalam || 14|| harerbhaktā maṇḍale ye te bodhyāḥ sādhavastadā | śāstraśravaṇalābhena vṛddhavākyena vā sadā || 1 5|| sādhuguṇān sakhīn prāptvā satsaṃgaṃ vardhayet tataḥ | evaṃ kṛtvā viśālaṃ vai vidadhīta svamaṇḍalam || 16 || mahāpuṇyapratāpena khalu satsaṃgamaṇḍalāt | mumukṣutā bhavecchreṣṭhā tato bhaktyā subhāvayā || 17|| bhajitvā mātmakalyāṇaṃ prakurvīta sa bhaktarāṭ | evaṃ lakṣmi balaṃ naijaṃ sabījaṃ vardhayet sadā || 18|| satsaṃgapoṣakaṃ yena bhuktirmuktirbhavettataḥ | nāmakīrtanatulyaṃ vai sulabhaṃ sādhanaṃ nahi || 1 9|| alabdhasādhusaṃgasya nāmakīrtanamuttamam | sādhvī jihvā nijā bodhyā tatsamāgamamācaret || 2.84.20 || sādhvī matirnijābodhyā tayā manvīta mādhavam | manaḥ sādhu nijaṃ bodhyaṃ tena manvīta māṃ sadā ||21 || devaḥ sādhuritikṛtvā tena seveta keśavam | evaṃ saṃgatimāsādya māṃ bhajeta sanātanam || 22 || ācāryā vā guravaśca koṭikalyāṇakāriṇaḥ | evamātmabalenaiva terurbhavārṇavāt svayam || 23 || tārayāmāsuranyām̐śca śrīhareḥ kṛpayā tviha | yatamānaṃ nijaṃ bhaktaṃ sāhāyyavarjitaṃ hariḥ ||24|| svayaṃ tatrāvatīryaiva coṣitvā hṛdaye’pi ca | bhaktamaṇḍalamadhye vā coṣitvā śreya arpayet || 25|| nahi kīrtanakṛt kaścidaniṣṭaṃ vindati priye | sa eva tatra sādhurvai kīrtanena prajāyate ||26|| ayi lakṣmi śvapaco’pi gṛhe saṃkīrtayam̐śca mām | sudūro’pi sādhumanāḥ sādhusnigdho hi sādhuvat || 27|| carmakāro’pi śīlāḍhyo mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ | sādhusnigdhaḥ sādhureva kīrtayanmāṃ svakarmakṛt ||28|| mleccho’pi śīlayuktaścenmama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ | sādhusnigdhaḥ sādhureva kīrtayanmāmahiṃsakaḥ ||29 || ghātakī vyādha evāpi śīlavratastyajan hatim | sādhusnigdhaḥ sādhureva kīrtayanmāmahiṃsakaḥ ||2.84.30|| dhvajī cakrī ca vā sādhuḥ sādhusnehaparāyaṇaḥ | śīlavrato’hiṃsakaśca kīrtayanmāmaharniśam ||3 1 || gaṇikā ca vyavāyī ca sādhusnehaparāyaṇau | sādhūśīlavratau kīrtayantau māṃ kāmavarjitau ||32|| dhīvaraścāpi matsyādaḥ śīlavrato’pyahiṃsakaḥ | sādhusnehaparaḥ sādhuḥ kīrtayanmāṃ pareśvaram ||33|| jallādo hārakaḥ stenaḥ sādhusnehaparāyaṇāḥ | śīlavratāḥ karmaśūnyāḥ sādhavaśced raṭanti mām ||34|| bhujiṣyā vṛndalo vāpi sādhū śīlaparau yadā | sādhusnigdhau kīrtayantau māṃ hariṃ puruṣottamam ||35|| bhāṇḍā naṭā nartakāśca kuśīlavāśca sādhavaḥ | śīlavratāḥ sādhusnigdhāḥ kīrtayantaśca māṃ harim ||36|| bahurūpā narmakārāḥ śavahārāśca sādhavaḥ | śīlavratāḥ sāghusnigdhāḥ kīrtayantaśca māṃ harim ||37|| sarvādā gaṇikeśāśca godhādāḥ sarpabhojanāḥ | sādhavaḥ śīlavratinaḥ sādhusnigdhā raṭanti mām ||38|| jālagrāhāḥ piśitādāḥ santyajya krūravartanām | sādhavaḥ śīlavratinaḥ sādhusnigdhā raṭanti mām || 39|| agnidā garadāḥ śūlapradāḥ pāśapradā api | raṭanto māṃ sādhuśīlā sādhusnigdhā hi sādhavaḥ ||2.84.40|| śastrajīvī cikitsākṛcchavāṃgibhedino yadi | raṭanto māṃ sādhuśīlāḥ sādhusnigdhā hi sādhavaḥ ||41 || bhārṣṭrabhaṭṭhīkarāścāpi vanāraṇāvighātinaḥ | śīlaparāḥ sādhusnigdhāḥ sādhavo hi raṭanti mām |||42||| unmattaśca vicittaśca śaṭhaḥ svārthī hi sādhavaḥ | sādhusnigdhāḥ śīlaparā māṃ raṭanti vidurguṇāḥ ||43|| āsurā rākṣasā daityā dānavāḥ pāpino’pi ca | sādhusnigdhāḥ śīlavantaḥ sādhavo māṃ raṭantyapi ||44|| bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācādyā raṭanto māṃ hi sādhavaḥ | śīlaparāḥ sādhuvratāḥ sādhusnigdhāstathā mayi ||45|| mādhukaghnā matsyahārāḥ śakunighnā hi sādhavaḥ | sādhuśīlā sādhusnigdhāḥ karmaśūnyā raṭanti mām ||46|| paśuvāhāḥ pañjariṇo viśvāsaghātakāśca te | raṭanto māṃ sādhuśīlāḥ sādhusnigdhā hi sādhavaḥ ||47|| tiryagvṛttaya ātmastrīraktavikrayiṇo’pi tu | raṭanto māṃ sādhuśīlāḥ sādhusnigdhā hi sādhavaḥ ||48|| yantriṇāścakriṇaścāpi śastriṇaḥ sādhavo hi te | raṭanto māṃ sādhuśīlāḥ sādhusnigdhā hi sāttvikāḥ ||49|| rājabhaṭādhipā nyāyādhipā nṛpā hi sādhavaḥ | raṭanto māṃ sādhuśīlā sādhusnigdhā hi sāttvikāḥ ||2.84.50|| muṣkacchedakarā daṃṣṭrāhārāśca liṅgakṛttinaḥ | raṭanto māṃ sādhuśīlā sāghusnigdhā hi sāttvikāḥ ||51|| akarmāṇo vikarmāṇo nṛśaṃsā api sādhavaḥ | raṭanto māṃ sādhuśīlā sādhusnigdhā hi sādhavaḥ ||52|| daurhṛdanāśakā dhātubhojinaḥ śaucavarjitāḥ | raṭanto māṃ sādhuśīlā sāghusnigdhā hi sādhavaḥ ||53|| yeṣāṃ vai pañcakaṃ siddhaṃ sādhavaste sadā matāḥ | niṣkāmatā hyalobhitvaṃ nirmānitvaṃ niḥsvāditā ||54|| niḥsnehitā ca sarvatra santastatpañcavṛttayaḥ | kāmavāsanāhīnatvaṃ niṣkāmitā yathāyatham ||55|| āvaśyakātiriktecchāhīnatvaṃ lobhavarjitā | agarvaḥ sarvathā nirmānitvaṃ stabdhatvavarjitā ||56|| prāṇayātrārthabhojyāptirniḥsvāditvaṃ hi tat smṛtam | evaṃ śīlaparāḥ sādhurbhaktimārgaparāyaṇaḥ ||57|| tarati tārayatyanyān mahābhāgavato hi saḥ | yeṣāṃ vā pañcakaṃ cānyanmumukṣutvaṃ kathāśrutiḥ ||58|| bhaktasādhoḥ saṃgatiśca sevābhaktipravartanam | ātmanivedanaṃ ceti pañcavatsādhavo matāḥ ||59|| yeṣāṃ vā pañcakaṃ cānyat prātaḥsnānaprapūjanam | madhyāhne haraye bhojyanivedanaṃ sadānvaham ||2.84.60|| upārjanasya viṃśāṃśo’rpaṇīyo haraye tathā | mālikāvartanaṃ nityaṃ cānte tvātmanivedanam ||61|| ta ete sādhavaḥ syuśca gṛhe vane ca nirjane | samāje vāpi jīvānāṃ tārakāste bhavanti vai ||62|| duṣṭaguṇān vihāyaiva sadguṇānarjayettu yaḥ | sādhuratra bhavet so’pi bhajate ceddhariṃ sadā ||63|| māyā pāpaṃ pāpavanto jīvā māyāvinaḥ khalu | māyādurguṇamutsṛtya sadguṇān prāpya madratāḥ ||64|| dharmavaśāśrayā loke sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ | saṃsāriṇastu ye jīvāḥ sarve durguṇasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||65|| paścātprāpya satāṃ śreṣṭhaguṇān bhavanti sādhavaḥ | māyāmalena hīnāste santo bhavanti nirmalāḥ ||66|| dīyamānāni ratnāni kambalānyambarāṇi ca | sampadaḥ sukhabhogyāśca nāvekṣate hṛdāpi yaḥ ||67|| bhogyabhoktṛtvavṛttiśca yasya nāvartate muhuḥ | sādhuvṛttiḥ sa vijñeyastāpaso doṣatāpanaḥ ||68|| jaihvayaṃ śaiśnyaṃ jitaṃ yena jitaṃ sarvaṃ mahātmanā | aśrāvyo badhiro yaścāpyaprekṣye netravarjitaḥ ||69|| aspṛśye tvagvihīnaścāpyaghreye ghrāṇavarjitaḥ | akathye jihvayā hīnaścābhakṣye rasanākṣayaḥ ||2.84.70|| agrāhye hastaśūnyaścāpyagamye pādavarjitaḥ | atyājye pāyuśūnyaścāpyayogye kāmavarjitaḥ ||71 || aliṅgye liṅgaśūnyaśca sarvathā matparāyaṇaḥ | videhaḥ sādhurevāyaṃ parasyāpi gatipradaḥ ||72|| āsyabhūrmṛgavadyasya śayyā cājagarī yathā | nidrā ca jalavad yasya kalpanā vyomapuṣpavat ||73|| dehaśchāyāsamo yasya vastujātaṃ tu svapnavat | smṛddhayo bhasmavad yasya samutsavaḥ śmaśānavat ||74|| astitvaṃ nāstitātulyaṃ sādhuḥ so’yaṃ saduttamaḥ | yasya sarvaṃ mayi cāste mattulyaḥ sādhureva saḥ ||75|| yathākāśagataṃ cāmbhaṃ vidyudvegāt pravarṣati | tathā sādhoḥ prasaṃgācca bhaktaḥ snehena varṣati ||76|| yathā meghā vilīyante vāyuvegena cāmbare | tathā sādhoḥ prasaṃgena līyante pāpakoṭayaḥ ||77|| yathā vai jāgrataḥ svāpnaṃ līyate tatkṣaṇaṃ tathā | sādhoryogena līyante kaṣāyāstatkṣaṇaṃ rame ||78|| yathā tamovināśo vai sūryabhābhiḥ prajāyate | tathā sādhoścamatkārairlīyante kalmaṣāṇi vai ||79|| yathā putraprasavena līyante śokakoṭayaḥ | tathā sādhuprasaṃgena līyante śokakoṭayaḥ ||2.84.80|| yathā lagnaprasaṃge ānandā bhavanti sotsavāḥ | tathā sādhuprasaṃgena mokṣānandotsavodbhavāḥ ||8 1|| yathā māturdarśanena sukhaṃ bālasya jāyate | tathā sādhordarśanena sukhaṃ bhaktasya jāyate ||82|| yathā miṣṭānnalābhena modante bālabālikāḥ | tathā vai sādhulābhena modante bhaktakoṭayaḥ ||83|| yathā varṣartumāsādya kekā vadanti kekinaḥ | tathā sādhvartumāsādya kīrtayanti harerjanāḥ ||84|| yathaikaputranāśena vṛddhapitrorvidehatā | tathā satāṃ viyoge tu bhaktānāṃ syād videhatā ||85|| yathā vandhyā putralābhe harṣonmattā prajāyate | tathā sādhorgṛhe lābhe harṣonmattā mamāśritāḥ ||86|| yathā sugandhasārādyaiḥ praphullaṃ mānasaṃ tathā | śrīkṛṣṇasādhudharmādyairbhaktamanaḥ praphullati ||87|| yathātīṣṭasya lābhena sarvānandā bhavanti vai | tathā sādhorāgamane sarvānandā bhavanti hi ||88|| yathā nāṭyagataṃ pātraṃ raṅgaṃ prasannayatyati | tathā sādhoḥ sevakaśca sādhūn prasannayatyati ||89|| yathā sādhvī hariṃ kāntaṃ sadā prasevate sukhā | tathā bhakto hariṃ sādhuṃ sevate ca mudā sukhaḥ ||2.84.90|| yathā vyādhasya putrādau snehaḥ sadā prapoṣaṇe | tathā bhaktasya sādhvādau snehaḥ sadā pramokṣaṇe ||9 1|| yathā gaurvatsamāsādya dadāti dhārayā payaḥ | bhaktaḥ sādhūn samāsādya sarvasvaṃ pradadāti ha ||92|| yathā vṛkṣā jalaṃ pītvā praphullitā navāṅkurāḥ | tathā bhaktāḥ sataḥ prāpya bahvārpaṇanavāṃkurāḥ ||93|| yathā nadyaḥ pūravṛddhyā hyunmattā āptumapnidhim | tathā bhaktā bhaktivṛddhyā hyunmattā āptumīśvaram||94|| yathā ca nāpito rājasevā prāpya pramodate | tathā bhaktaḥ sādhusevāṃ prāpya sadā pramodate ||95|| yathā yuvā ca yuvatīṃ prāpyaiti tattadātmatām | tathā bhakto hariṃ sādhuṃ prāpyaiti tattadātmatām ||96|| yathā rājājñayā bhṛtyā vartante namramārgiṇaḥ | tathā sādhvājñayā bhaktā vartante dharmamārgiṇaḥ ||97|| yathā dīpo rātriyoge prakāśate svayamprabhaḥ | tathā bhaktaḥ sādhuyoge prakāśate hariprabhaḥ ||98|| yathā pakvaṃ phalaṃ vṛkṣaṃ jahātyeva hi kālataḥ | tathā pakvaphalo bhakto jahātyeva tu māyikam ||99|| yathā patnī dharmaśīlānusaratyeva satpatim | tathā sādhvīṃ ca vā sādhumanuvrajati bhaktarāṭ || 2.84.10 0|| nārāyaṇanivāsena yathā nārāyaṇāyate | tathā sādhutvavāsena vyaktirvai sādhavāyate || 10 1|| yadvadbhaktinivāsena bhakto bhavati mānavaḥ | lakṣmi sādhutvavāsena sādhurbhavati mānavaḥ || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sādhusamāgamarahitasyāpimokṣopāyāḥ sādhulābhaḥ sādhutvalābhastadvividhatā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 84 ||
<3.85> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sādhudharmaṃ sanātanam | dhāryante yena lokāḥ saḥ satāṃ dharmo hariḥ svayam || 1 || harerlīlācaritrāṇi smartavyāni sadā mama | sādhudharmaḥ sadā kṛṣṇo rakṣaṇīyo nije hṛdi || 2 || mahāyaśaphalaṃ cāpi sarvadānaphalaṃ tathā | gavāṃ phalaṃ tīrthaphalaṃ vratānāṃ phalamityapi || 3 || etatphalamavāpnoti yo janaḥ sādhudharmavān | mokṣakāryaṃ sadā sādhornārāyaṇasamāśrayāt || 4 || bandhahānistathā kāryaṃ sādhoreva prakīrtitam | vaktāro bhaktikartāro yeṣāṃ śuddhaṃ ca mānasam || 5 || teṣāṃ vyaktaṃ jitā lokāḥ sādhūnā sādhusaṃginā | mucyate kilbiṣāccāpi na sa pāpena lipyate || 6 || dharmaṃ ca labhate nityaṃ sādhusaṃgī śarīravān | mokṣaṃ tataśca labhate sādhorhareḥ kṛpākaṇāt || 7 || mānavāstu sadā lakṣmi bāliśā iva mohanaḥ | sādhūnnindanti madrūpān yānti te narakān bahūn || 8 || krūrāśca mānavā loke dayāhīnāśca ghātakāḥ | sādhūnnirarthakānmatvā tyajanti bhārarūpiṇaḥ || 9 || teṣāṃ gatirna vai syāddhi satī kvāpyathasañcayāt | asādhunindakāḥ krūrāstāmasādisvavartanaiḥ || 3.85.10 || tiryagyonigatān satvān jīvān hiṃsanti mohitāḥ | kīṭān pipīlikān sarpān vṛścikān paśupakṣiṇaḥ || 11 || api cet te śaraṇaṃ vai satāṃ yāntyaghanuttaye | praseveyuḥ sataścedvai dehena manasā yadi || 12|| tadā pāpaiḥ pramucyante na ceddhiṃsanti vai punaḥ | satāṃ prasevayā puṇyaṃ jāyate balavattaram || 1 3|| puṇyena śubhasaṃkalpāḥ śanaiścāpi śubhakriyāḥ | asatkriyāṇāṃ santyāgaḥ satsaṃgātipravīṇatā || 14|| paścāttāpaḥ svakṛtyānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ tapaḥ param | upavāsādikaṃ bhaktiryajanaṃ dānamarpaṇam || 15 || pūjanaṃ devatādīnāṃ japadhyānasukīrtanam | tīrthayātrā jñānalābhastvevaṃ bhavanti dharmiṇaḥ || 16|| tataḥ svargagatiḥ paścānmokṣagatiḥ prasaṃbhavet | etat sarvaṃ satāṃ yoge tūrṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prajāyate || 17|| santo nārāyaṇāḥ sarve pāpaghnā mokṣadāyinaḥ | teṣu sadā virāje’haṃ śāśvataḥ puruṣo hariḥ || 18|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | śrīvatsāṃko hṛṣīkeśaḥ sarveśvarādipūjitaḥ || 19|| sarvajñaḥ sarvasaṃśliṣṭaḥ sarvagaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ | paramātmā hṛdayasthaḥ sarvavyāpī sanātanaḥ || 3.85.20|| nāyakaḥ sarvasṛṣṭīnāṃ dhāmnāṃ dhāmajuṣāmapi | śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ śrīgarbhaḥ śrīsahoṣitaḥ ||21|| śārṅgacakrādicihnaśca damaśīlaśamānvitaḥ | parakrameṇa vīryeṇottamena darśanena ca ||22|| utsāhena pramāṇena dhairyeṇārjavasampadā | kṛpayā snehabhaktyā ca nijān prati samanvitaḥ ||23|| yogamāyaḥ samastākṣo brahmaṇyaśca śaraṇyakaḥ | bhayahartā bhayārtānāṃ dīnānāṃ pālane rataḥ || 24|| śrutavānarthasampūrṇo varadaśca varārthinām | parameśo rameśaśca meśo brahmapriyāpatiḥ ||25|| sarvāḥ sukhaṃ saṃśritāśca śarīre mama devatāḥ | so’haṃ pareśvaraḥ sākṣācchrībhūlīlāramāpatiḥ ||26|| yo hi māṃ draṣṭumicchedvai cāvatārāvatāriṇam | draṣṭavyāstena me santaḥ sādhvarthāḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ ||27|| dṛṣṭeṣveteṣvahaṃ dṛṣṭo na me bhedo’tra vidyate | santo nārāyaṇāḥ sarve iti viddhi mama priye ||28|| so’haṃ śrīpuṇḍarīkākṣo yasya prīto bhavāmi ca | tasya devagaṇaḥ prītaḥ sarvārthāstasya hastagāḥ || 29|| yaśca māṃ mānave loke saṃśrayiṣyati mānavaḥ | tasya kīrtirjayaścaiva svargaścātra bhaviṣyati ||3.85.3 0|| dharmāṇāṃ deśikaḥ pūjyaḥ sa bhaviṣyati dharmabhāk | sādhureva sa mantavyo namaskāryaḥ sadā janaiḥ ||3 1 || dharma eva paraḥ sa syād yasminnabhyarhito’smyaham | so’haṃ prajāhitārthaṃ vai sādhukoṭīrasarjayat ||32|| brahmāyanādīn sarvāṃśca saccidānandaprabhṛtān | sanatkumāramadhyām̐śca pūrvān pūrvatarānapi ||33 || so’haṃ sādhusvarūpo’smi harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | bhagavān sarvarūpāṇāṃ dhartā karttā vināśitā ||34|| vandito’haṃ ca vande taṃ mānito mānayāmyapi | arhitaścārhayāmyenaṃ pūjitaḥ pūjayāmi tam ||35|| dṛṣṭaḥ paśyāmyajasraṃ taṃ saṃśritaḥ saṃśrayāmi tam | evaṃ me dhyānakartuśca dhyātāhaṃ satataṃ priye ||36|| evaṃ me’sti vrataṃ nityaṃ tādṛśāḥ sādhavo mama | sajjanācaritaṃ tvetad vrataṃ me nāparairiha ||37|| tasmāt santo mama rūpāstārakā dehināmiha | karmaṇā manasā vācā sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ ||38|| sādhūn dṛṣṭvā mamāpyeva darśanaṃ jātameva hi | samastāśca surā nityaṃ sādhudehe vasanti vai ||39|| sureśvarastathā viṣṇuścāhaṃ sādhau vasāmi ca | sarvārāmaḥ surāmo’haṃ rameśaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||3.85.40|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre nivasāmi tvayā saha | brahmapriyābhiḥ sahito haripriyānusevitaḥ ||41|| kīrtirlakṣmīrdhṛtiḥ śāntiḥ puṣṭistuṣṭiḥ ratiḥ ramā | bhuktirmuktiḥ śrīrlīlā ca yatra tatrāhameva ca ||42|| mama sādhuṣu vartante sadā kīrtyādayaḥ priye | nivasāmi sadā teṣu madrūpāḥ sādhavastataḥ ||43|| prabhāvaṃ sādhupūgasya yaśca jānāti sarvathā | sa tu sārdhaṃ samāśritya prāpya māṃ yāti matpadam ||44|| bhavantyeva ca tasyaiva sarve kāmā yathepsitāḥ | ye vā nāma raṭantyatra mama lakṣmi samāhitāḥ ||45|| teṣāṃ kīrtanabhaktānāṃ saṃsiddhyanti manorathāḥ | pūjyāḥ kīrtanabhaktā me tānnamasyāmi cāpyaham ||46|| sārdhaṃ muktaṃ satīṃ sādhvīṃ brahmapriyāṃ haripriyām | santaṃ cāśvapaṭṭabhūmiṃ ye namanti namāmi tān ||47|| lakṣmīṃ rādhāṃ ramāṃ śrīṃ ca māṇikyāṃ sukhadāṃśriyam | ramāṃ padmāvatīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ ye namanti namāmi tān ||48|| avatārām̐śca me vyūhān bhaktāṃśca pārṣadānapi | mūrtīrme ye namasyanti tannamasyāmyahaṃ sadā || 49|| varuṇaṃ bhāskaraṃ vāyuṃ vahniṃ candraṃ balāhakam | śivaṃ viṣṇumajaṃ devān ye namasyanti tānname ||3.85.50|| durgāṃ sarasvatīṃ bhūmiṃ śāradāṃ virajāṃ tathā | maṃgalāmamṛtāṃ ye ca namasyanti namāmi tān ||5 1 || bṛhaspatiṃ nāradaṃ ca sanatkumāramacyutam | naraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ ye ca namasyanti namāmi tān ||52|| tapodhanān maharṣīṃśca bhaktidhanān sato janān | vidyādhanām̐śca viduṣo ye namanti namāmi tān ||53|| abhuktvā daivakarmāṇi kurvate ye prabhupriyāḥ | santuṣṭāḥ kṣamiṇaḥ santastān namāmi punaḥ punaḥ ||54|| yajñe yajanti ye ceṣṭīrjitendriyāḥ suśāntayaḥ | prātarbhajanti sāyaṃ ye tānnamāmi suhṛtpriyān ||55|| dharmaṃ bhaktiṃ ca pitarau gāśca guruṃ namāmyaham | ye vai saṃyaminaḥ śāntā vane mūlaphalāśanāḥ ||56|| asaṃcayāḥ sādhavastān namāmi satataṃ priye | bhṛtyapoṣā atithīnāmāśrayā vighasāśinaḥ ||57|| satyavāco brahmacārāstānnamāmi sadā sataḥ | prasannahṛdayāḥ sarvasattveṣu madvivekinaḥ ||58|| svādhyāyadhyānaniratāstānnamāmi sato janān | guruprasāde madbhaktau yatnavantaḥ sthiravratāḥ ||59|| śuśrūṣavo’nasūyantastānnamasyāmi sajjanān | suvratā sunayo bhaktā brahmiṣṭhā brahmadāyinaḥ ||3.85.60|| voḍhāro me prasādasya tānnamāmi sadā sataḥ | bhaikṣacaryāsu niratā dīnā gurukulāśrayāḥ ||61|| nirghṛṇāścācyutadhanā nirmamā gatavāsanāḥ | brahmavaktāra aiśā ye tānnamāmi sato janān ||62|| ahiṃsāniratāḥ satyavratā dāntā vitṛṣṇakāḥ | kapotavṛttikā gṛhyāstānnamāmi sato janān ||63|| caturvargasthitāḥ śāntā api niṣkāmayoginaḥ | śiṣṭācārapravṛttāśca namāmyetān rame sadā ||64|| brāhmaṇā brahmatanavo bhaktiparāḥ supuṇyinaḥ | sudhābhakṣā vratayuktāstānnamāmi sadāśritān ||65|| ayonīnagniyonīm̐śca brahmayonīn sadudbhavān | acyutagotrān śrīgotrānnamāmi satataṃ sataḥ ||66|| akṣaraṃ cāpi golokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ padam | avyākṛtapadaṃ ye ca gantumicchava aiśvaram ||67|| vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma vā sādhvāśramān jigamiṣūm̐stathā | namasyāmi satastān vai sarvānahaṃ hi padmaje ||68|| lokajyeṣṭhān kulajyeṣṭhān tamoghnān lokabhāskarān | kṛṣṇadhāmapradān sādhūnnamāni bhavapāradān ||69|| pūjārhān hitadhātṛm̐śca sukhadān poṣakāmapi | rakṣakān kālamāyādernamāmi sajjanān sataḥ ||3.85.70|| atrāmuṣmin sukhadāste harerbhaktā hi sādhavaḥ | ye sarvātithayo nityaṃ tānnamāmi sadā rame ||71 || etādṛśeṣu bhakteṣu sādhuṣu brahmayogiṣu | anusṛtāścābhiratā durgāṇyatitaranti te ||72|| teṣu śāntiparāsteṣāṃ praśaṃsakāśca sevakāḥ | anasūyakā bhaktāśca durgāṇyatitaranti te ||73|| sarvān sato namaskurvan devān vṛddhān śubhāvahān | śraddhāvān bhaktimām̐ścāpi durgāṇyatitaratyapi ||74|| tapasvinaḥ sādhavo vai kaumārabrahmacāriṇaḥ | bhaktyā prabhāvitātmānastārayantyaghino janān ||75|| mātrāpitrorgurujane bhaktyā vasanti ye janāḥ | sadāśīrvādanetāro durgāṇyatitaranti te ||76|| yathā tvaṃ vartase lakṣmi vartante sādhavo yathā | brahmapriyāśca vartante vartante ca haripriyāḥ ||77|| yathā kuṃkumavāpīsthā vartante ca narāḥ striyaḥ | sarve muktā brahmavāsāḥ santaḥ sādhvyo hi me matāḥ ||78|| caturdaśasu lokeṣu narṣayastādṛśāstathā | pitaro munayo naiva na surā mānavāstathā ||79|| nānye viprā yathā caite pāvanā matsvarūpiṇaḥ | kṣetraṃ kukumavāpīyaṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāma me’sti yat ||3.85.80|| tatrasthāḥ sarvamuktāśca muktānyaḥ śaktayo mama | sarvā brahmapriyā nāryaḥ sarve muktā narāstviha ||81|| pādapāścāṇḍajā jarāyūjāścānye’pi jantavaḥ | svedajā vāpi sarve cākṣarakṣetre vasanti ye ||82|| divyā muktā hi te sarve sarvapūjyā bhavanti te | ta eva sādhavaḥ sarve muktidā vāsamātrataḥ ||83|| kalpadrumasya cāṃgāni sarvāṇi pāvanāni vai | tathā cākṣarabhūmeśca vāsinaḥ pāvanā hi me ||84|| sādhavaste śaraṇyā vai śaraṇāgatarakṣiṇaḥ | yathāhaṃ ca tathā te vai dayāpūrṇā vimuktidāḥ ||85|| sarvasvaṃ cāpi dattvaiva rakṣanti śaraṇāgatān | śṛṇu lakṣmi samākhyānaṃ sādhorvṛṣāyanasya ha ||86|| vṛṣāyano hi sādhurme dīkṣāṃ prāpya vane vasan | bhajate māṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ ||87|| videha iva rājan vai tejasā bhāskaro yathā | dayayā cābhayadātā jīvānāṃ śreyasi sthitaḥ ||88|| vyāghrāraṇye nimbataroradhovāso virājate | tatraikadā tu śyenena pātyamānā bhayāturā ||89|| caṭakā śaraṇaṃ prāptā vṛṣāyanākhyayoginam | sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā nirādhārāṃ trāsādaṃkamupāgatām ||3.85.90|| āśvāsyāha bhayaṃ mā te caṭake’stviha me’ntike | ityuktvā caṭakā hastatale dhṛtvā tadāsane ||9 1|| agre tāṃ rakṣayāmāsa tāvacchyena uvāca tam | ṛṣe sādho mama bhakṣyaṃ caṭakeyaṃ pradīyatām ||92|| prayatnānmahato labdhā tyajaināṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ mama | asyā māṃsaṃ tu me cādya paryāptaṃ syātpratoṣaṇam ||93 || kṣudhā me bādhate sādho bhojyaṃ me dīyatāṃ drutam | mayā hyanusṛtā tveṣā mamaiva bhakṣyarūpiṇī ||94|| sādhunā nātra vayasoḥ sthātavyaṃ madhyapātinā | audāsīnyasthiteste’tra ko lābho dveṣarāgayoḥ ||95|| samavṛttirbhavet sādhuḥ pakṣapāto na te vṛṣaḥ | kṣudhito’haṃ cāti sādho’nyathā me maraṇaṃ bhavet ||96|| dayālo tvaṃ dehi bhakṣyaṃ caṭakāṃ mannipātitām | caṭakāyā rakṣaṇe te me hatyāpāpamāpatet ||97|| mama jīvanadāne tu caṭakādhvaṃsapātakam | te bhavediti cātrārthe bhavaudāsīnavṛttimān ||98|| ityākarṇya kṣaṇaṃ vṛṣāyanaścintāmavāpa ha | dvayoścābhayadānaṃ ca vicāryetthamuvāca tam ||99|| vada śyena nijārthaṃ vai yathā te kṣunnivartanam | bhavedeva tathā kurve muñcāmi caṭakā nahi || 3.85.1 00|| śaraṇaṃ sā jīvanārthaṃ tvāgatā māṃ prarakṣiṇam | na muñcati mamāṃgāni paśya rakṣārthinīṃ tvimām || 10 1|| tatrāpi vidyate nārī na hantavyā kadācana | garbhiṇī vidyate cāpi na hantavyā tvayā dvija || 1 02|| phalaṃ mūlaṃ cānnamiṣṭaṃ bhikṣāgataṃ dadāmi te | ānayāmi tvadarthaṃ vai miṣṭānnaṃ tatprabhakṣaya || 1 03|| śyenaḥ prāha na me kāryaṃ phalamūlairna bhikṣayā | yastu devena vihito bhakṣyo me caṭakātmakaḥ || 1 04|| māṃsaṃ bhakṣyaṃ śyenajāteḥ rītistveṣā purātanī | yadi sādho caṭakāyā snehaste pakṣapātavat || 1 05|| tatastvaṃ me prayacchādya svamāṃsaṃ caṭakāmitam | tulayā tolitaṃ me syātparyāptaṃ nādhikaṃ khalu || 1 06|| vṛṣāyanaḥ prasanno’bhūcchrutvā tūrṇaṃ tamāha ca | mahānanugrahaścāyaṃ khaga tvayā mayi kṛtaḥ || 1 07|| tataḥ kṛtvā parṇapuṭyau tulāṃ kṛtvā yathocitām | utkṛtyotkṛtya māṃsaṃ svaṃ śyenārthaṃ samatolayat || 1 08|| caṭakābhāramāṃsaṃ svaṃ dadau śyenāya bāhujam | śyeno labdhvā prabhuktvā ca pītvā jala vanaṃ yayau || 1 09|| caṭakā rakṣitā jātā prasannābhūt sunirbhayā | śanaiḥ sā tu ṛṣiṃ natvā pārśve vane yayau tataḥ || 3.85.11 0|| sandhinīṃ pūraṇīṃ śreṣṭhāmoṣadhiṃ prāpya cāyayau | sādhorhaste dadau patrarasaṃ bāhuḥ prapūritaḥ || 11 1|| yathāpūrvamabhavacca nīruk sāpi tataḥ param | sevāyāṃ sarvadā sādhoḥ pārśve’vasat supakṣiṇī || 11 2|| phalapatrāṇi cādāya sādhave’rpaṇameva ha | karoti cātha kālena suṣuve’ṇḍāni pañca ca || 1 13|| sevāphalena te sarve bālā bhūtādivedinaḥ | trikāladarśinaḥ sarve jātāḥ śvetasvarūpiṇaḥ || 1 14|| dīpotsavīghoṭakākhyā maharṣiṇā hi te kṛtāḥ | śakunajñāḥ śakuntāste pūjyante daivavedibhiḥ || 1 15|| caṭakā sā tataḥ kāle vārdhakye mṛtyumāgatā | vimānena yayau svargaṃ jātāpsarovarā śubhā || 1 16|| nāmnā cālambuṣā tvindrasevikā ca tataḥ param | muktiṃ prāptā brahmaloke sādhoḥ sevāphalena vai || 1 17|| evaṃ paropakārārthadattasarvasvasādhavaḥ | rakṣanti cāpi mokṣaṃ ca preṣayanti ca dehinaḥ ||1 18|| bhaktānāṃ rakṣitā cānuraktānāṃ śaraṇārthinām | yaḥ sa sādhurdayāluśca sukhaṃ dadāti vidanti || 1 19|| sādhuvṛtto janaścātra sādhutvamanutiṣṭhati | kiṃ na prāptaṃ bhavettena madarthatyāgavarṣiṇā || 3.85.120|| vṛṣāyano hi bhagavān vartate’śvasarovare | yadāśrayeṇa bahavo yānti dhāmākṣaraṃ mama || 121 || paśya lakṣmi sthitaṃ vāritaṭe dhyāne madarthini | evaṃ me sādhavo loke bhavanti śreyasāṃ pradāḥ || 122|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sādhormukhyadharmo nārāyaṇastena sādhutvam | sādhave nārāyaṇanatiḥ, vṛṣāyanena sādhunā caṭakābhāramāṃsaṃ śyenāya datvā caṭakā rakṣitā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 85 ||
<3.86> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca kiṃ kṛtveha tu rājānaścānye dhanamadāstayā | balagarvāśca vai lokā aśnuvate paraṃ sukham || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca brahmiṣṭhānāṃ sadā sevā kartavyā sukhamicchatā | sādhūnnārāyaṇabhaktān vṛddhām̐ścāpyabhipūjayet || 2 || paurajānapadām̐ścāpi sādhujanān bahuśrutān | bhaktyā dānena sevābhirnamaskāraiḥ samarcayet || 3 || yathātmānaṃ yathā putrām̐stathā sādhūn prasevayet | ye cāpyeṣāṃ pūjyatamāstān viśeṣeṇa pūjayet || 4 || santaḥ pūjyā namaskāryā mānyā devā yathā bhuvi | teṣu tuṣṭeṣu rājyādisampadaḥ susukhāḥ sadā || 5 || kṛṣṇadhyānaprasaktānāṃ brahmabhaktiṃ prakurvatām | dharmajñānāṃ satāṃ nityaṃ sevāṃ kīrtiṃ samācaret || 6 || devaiśca pitṛbhiścāpi gandharvairbrāhmaṇaistathā | vasubhiśca tathādityai rudraiśca pūjitā yataḥ || 7 || adaivaṃ daivataṃ kuryudaiṃvataṃ cāpyadaivatam | yamiccheyuḥ sa devaḥ syād yo naṣṭaḥ sa parābhavet || 8 || parivādaprakartāro naśyeyurnātra saṃśayaḥ | tasmātsādhūnpūjayecceśvarān vai sukhaduḥkhayoḥ || 9 || ete bhojyāśca pūjyāśca kimicchavaiḥ suvastubhiḥ | namaskāraiścārpaṇādyai rakṣyāśca pitṛvannṛpaiḥ || 3.86.1 0|| ītīnāṃ cāpi vighnānāṃ śāntiḥ sadbhiḥ prajāyate | brahmavarcasvinaḥ santo yajñāḥ sākṣād bhavanti vai || 1 1|| brahmiṣṭhaṃ bhaktisampannaṃ dharmaśīlaguṇānvitam | vāsayeta gṛhe rājā santaṃ mokṣapradaṃ sadā || 1 2|| satāṃ mukhe havirdattaṃ pratigṛhṇanti ceśvarāḥ | pitaro devatāścāpi muktāstṛpyanti yoginaḥ || 13|| ṛṣayo vasavaḥ siddhā manavo bhāskarāḥ śivāḥ | surāśca viṣṇavo brahmāṇaśca sādhyā marudgaṇāḥ || 14|| vālakhilyāśca gandharvāḥ kinnarāḥ puruṣottamāḥ | avatārāḥ sata āviśyānnaṃ sukhāḥ prabhuñjate || 15 || yatra no bhagavadbhaktā utsave vā mahotsave | tāḥ sampadastathānandāḥ śmaśānāntāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 16|| yatrotsaveṣu santaśca vidyante śubhadarśanāḥ | ta utsavā ūrdhvagatipradāḥ puṇyamayāḥ śubhāḥ ||17|| santaṃ vinā mahārājyaṃ śmaśānaṃ yāmyapuṣṭikṛt | satā yuktaṃ vanaṃ cāpi divyaṃ golokamuktidam || 18|| sādhuṃ yatra sthale santaṃ viharantaṃ sthitaṃ ca vā | paśyanti yamadūtāśca nābhiyanti sthalaṃ hi tat || 19|| sādhuṃ janaṃ vilokyaiva vighnā viyanti dūrataḥ | rogā māyāḥ kālavegāstrastā viyanti dūrataḥ ||3.86.20|| yena yenaiva santo’tra haviṣā tarpitā muhuḥ | ye santamanuvṛttāśca teṣāṃ puṇyamanantakam ||21|| na te pretya vinaśyanti na te yānti parābhavam | yadvai satāṃ mukhātprāptaṃ pratigṛhṇanti sadvacaḥ ||22|| pāpino’pi janāste vai na prayānti parābhavam | yatkiñcid dṛśyate loke śrūyate paṭhyate tathā ||23|| sarvaṃ tacchrīmatāṃ puṇyasatāmāśīrvacobhavam | bhūmiḥ papraccha pūrvaṃ vai śvetavārāhamīśvaram ||24||| gṛhiṇāṃ pāpakarmāṇi kena naśyanti mūlataḥ | vārāhaśca tadovāca dhyātvā śreṣṭhatamaṃ vacaḥ ||25|| sādhūn saṃsevamānānāṃ pāpaṃ sarvaṃ vilīyate | sādhūn sadā praseveta pavitrān lokadhārakān ||26|| ebhyo bhūtiśca kīrtiśca smṛddhirbuddhiḥ prajāyate | bhaktiḥ prajāyate tena pāvanī matirīyate ||27|| mahāyajño harerbhaktaḥ sādhureva na saṃśayaḥ | sādhuṃ seveta satataṃ bhūme sarvavibhūtaye ||28|| viprebhyaśca pare santi guravastūpadeśakāḥ | gurubhyaścopadeṣṭṝbhya upādhyāyā pare matāḥ ||29|| tebhyaḥ parā sadā cāryā ācāryebhyastu śīlinaḥ | brahmacārebhya utkṛṣṭā bhaktāḥ śrīparamātmanaḥ ||3.86.30|| bhaktebhya uttamāḥ santi sadā cātmanivedinaḥ | ātmārpitebhya utkṛṣṭāḥ sādhavo mama mūrtayaḥ ||3 1 || apareṣāṃ pareṣāṃ ca parebhyaścāpi te pare | matto’pi paramāḥ santaḥ satāṃ dāso bhavāmyaham ||32|| sādhavo yaṃ praśaṃsanti sa naro mādhavo bhavet | sādhūnākrośayati yaḥ parābhavati so’cirāt ||33|| yathā mahārṇave kṣiptaṃ lavaṇaṃ saṃvilīyate | tathā pāpāni sādhau vai kṣiptāni yanti līnatām ||34|| sādhavo yaṃ praśaṃsanti sa jāto’tra pravardhate | yaśasā sampadā smṛddhyā puṣṭyā lakṣmyā striyā sutaiḥ ||35|| sādhavaḥ saṃvidantyeva mārgaṃ svargasya vai tathā | mokṣasyāpi nirayasya karmaṇāṃ ca gatiṃ tathā ||36|| bhāgyānāṃ ca gatiṃ cāpi vidanti sādhavo janāḥ | āgatānāgate cāpi vidanti janmakarmabhiḥ ||37|| sarveṣāṃ kṣatravargāṇāṃ tejāṃsi prabalāni ca | brāhmaṇeṣu praśāmyanti brāhmaṇānāṃ tu sādhuṣu || 38|| sādhūn vai sevamānānāṃ rajaḥ sarvaṃ praṇaśyati | icchan kīrtiṃ ca bhūtiṃ ca lokām̐ścāpyuttamottamān ||39|| satāṃ cānumate tiṣṭhed rājā śreṣṭhī tathetaraḥ | janmanaiva camatkārī brahmiṣṭho yastu jāyate ||3.86.40 || namasyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sa sādhuścācyutātmajaḥ | sarvathā suhṛdaḥ santaḥ śreyo mātravidhāyakāḥ || 41 || smṛtibhiḥ kṛṣṇayuktābhirgīrbhiśca maṃgalādibhiḥ | āśritānāṃ suśreyāṃsi cānudhyāyanti pūjitāḥ | | 42 | | śrīśca vṛddhiśca tejaśca vibhūtiśca pratāpinī | lakṣmyaḥ sarvavidhāḥ sādhusaṃkalpena bhavanti hi | | 43 | | sādhavo vividhāḥ santi durāsadāḥ parārthinaḥ | kecinnārāyaṇasattvāḥ śīlasattvāśca kecana || 44 || vratasattvāstapaḥsattvā dhyānasattvāstathāpare | vairāgyasattvā vidyādisattvā bhaktibalāḥ pare | | 45 || dharmasattvāstathaudāsīnyādimukhyā bhavantyapi | api sevyāḥ sarvavidhāḥ sāro grāhyo mumukṣuṇā | |46 || siṃhasattvāḥ santi kecin mṛgasattvāstathāpare | sarpasattvāḥ parecāpi kapisattvāstathāpare ||47 || agnisattvāstathā cānye jalasattvāstathāpare | kṣmāsattvā vāyusattvāśca bhayantyevaṃprakāriṇaḥ || 48 | | asahāḥ siṃhasattvā vai sarvasahā mṛgā iva | dveṣagarāḥ sarpatulyā hārakāḥ kapisadṛśāḥ | | 49 || pāpaghnā vahnisattvāste śāntidā jalasattvinaḥ | kṣamante kṣmāsamāścāpi guṇagrāhā marutsamāḥ | | 3.86.50 | | siṃhasarpakapitulyān yāvadarthaṃ samāśrayet | mokṣārthaṃ cetarān sarvānāśrayenmatimān janaḥ | |5 1 || sādhavo hi mahātmāno devānāmapi devatāḥ | satataṃ pūjayet sādhūn dāsyena paricaryayā || 52 | | ekadā mālatīdevī papraccha svapatiṃ nṛpam | citraketuṃ namaskṛtya trailokyapūjitaṃ satī | | 53 | | kena vṛttena rājam̐stvaṃ trailokyamadhitiṣṭhasi | śraiṣṭhyametādṛśaṃ kena prāptaṃ brūhi vratena vai | | 54 | | citraketustu tāṃ prāha sādhusevāvrataṃ mama | vandhyaṃ dinaṃ na me yāti sādhusevāmṛte kvacit | | 55 || agrataḥ sādhavo me vai pṛṣṭhataḥ sādhavo’tra me | pārśvayoḥ sādhavaḥ santi sabhāyāṃ sādhavaśca me | | 56 | | yātrāyāṃ sādhavo me ca bhojane cotsavādiṣu | ārambhe sādhavo me vai vartante brahmaśīlinaḥ | | 57 | | teṣāṃ dāsyaṃ vrataṃ me’sti tena bṛhadvratena vai | adhitiṣṭhāmi lokāṃstrīn harerbhaktiṃ karomi ca | |58 || anyāni me śṛṇu patni vṛtāni śobhanānyapi | loke yairmānyatā cāste cāpradhṛṣyatvamityapi ||59 || nāsūyāmi kvacit sādhūn sammanye tān yathāsukham | brahmiṣṭhānnāvajānāmi nāparādhyāmi karhicit ||3.86.60 || abhyarcyābhyanupṛcchāmi sevāṃ karomi nityadā | sadaṇḍavannamaḥ kṛtvā pādau gṛhṇāmi vāri ca ||61 || yāmājñāṃ te nirdiśanti vahāmi toṣayāmi tān | sato nityaṃ śṛṇomyeva kathāmṛtaratān prabhūn ||62|| etacchreṣṭhamamṛtaṃ vai divyaṃ cakṣuśca pāragam | yad brahmiṣṭhamukhād vākyaṃ śāstraṃ cājñā pravartate ||63|| brahmiṣṭhāstapasā bhaktyā sidhyanti dhībalāḥ sadā | ātmabalāṃ mama balairyuktāste tārayantyapi ||64|| vasanto brāhmīrvasatīryatayaḥ samadarśanāḥ | nirvāṇasthā hi te bhūmau śreyapradāḥ sukhapradāḥ ||65|| bhūmistaṃ vai nigirati yo brahmiṣṭhaṃ na sevate | abhimānaḥ śriyaṃ hanti smṛddhasyāpyalpamedhasaḥ ||66|| abhimānaṃ tato hitvā hitvā rājamadaṃ tathā | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ nityaṃ karomi vai satāṃ mudā ||67|| māṃ ca bhaktaṃ citraketuṃ śrutvā śrutvā hi sādhavaḥ | bhūbhāgāt svargabhāgācca pātālāt sāgarādapi ||68|| satyalokāt samāyānti nāradādyā hi pāvanāḥ | dhanyaṃ bhāgyaṃ mama cāste yaḥ koṭistrīpatirnṛpaḥ ||69|| sādhubhakta iti khyāto yaṃ pratiyanti sādhavaḥ | yadgṛhaṃ sādhusampannaṃ yannāryaḥ sādhusevikāḥ ||3.86.70|| yo rājā vighasāśyasmi tato dhanyetaro nu kaḥ | yo yo vai yācate kiṃcid dadāmyeva tu tatkṣaṇam ||71 || pratoṣayāmi satataṃ sādhūn viprām̐śca yoginaḥ | rājyaṃ yathā svendriyārthaṃ sādhvarthaṃ me mataṃ bahu ||72|| brahmiṣṭhārthaṃ mama rājyaṃ mokṣārthaṃ vartate priye | apīḍayan rājavargaṃ pradadyāṃ sarvamaihikam ||73|| yathā me sādhavaḥ pūjyāstathānu brāhmaṇā api | ṛtvikpurohitācāryāḥ śiṣyāḥ sambandhibāndhavāḥ ||74|| striyo bālā bālikāścānāthā nirāśrayāstathā | śaraṇāgatalokāścābhyāgatā bhikṣukāstathā ||75|| anādhārāśca me pūjyā vanino gṛhiṇo’pi ca | satkarmāṇaḥ sadā pūjyāḥ śrutavanto harerjanāḥ ||76|| ato’nyathā vartamānā daṇḍyāḥ śāstranayena vai | bhaktidharmaḥ sadācāro jñānaṃ cātmavivecanam ||77|| ahiṃsā satyamasteyamārjavaṃ dama īśitā | akrodhaścānabhimānaścādroho hrīḥ kṣamā damaḥ ||78|| titikṣā vāsanānāśastṛṣṇānāśaḥ pavitratā | yasminnetāni dṛśyante na tvakāryāṇi vai priye ||79|| satpātraṃ tadbhavelloke sarvadā mānamarhati | apūrvaṃ cāpi pūrvaṃ vā pārakyaṃ naijameva vā ||3.86.80|| yadvā viśeṣitaṃ vāpi saṃpratyāgatameva vā | brahmiṣṭhaṃ śreyasisthaṃ yat tatpātraṃ mānamarhati ||81|| loke bhavanti bahavaścābhimānabharā janāḥ | asūyādveṣayuktāścāsahamānāḥ parānnarān ||82|| parakhyātiṃ sahante na parasaukhyaṃ paronnatim | na sahante ca dahyanti tato nindanti sajjanān ||83 || aprāmāṇyaṃ satāṃ vākye vaidike lokasammate | matvātilaṃghanaṃ cāpi kurvanti dharmasetuṣu ||84|| avyavasthāṃ ca kurvanti svayaṃ paṇḍitamāninaḥ | hetuvādān bruvantaśca satsu drohaṃ prakurvate ||85|| ākroṣṭārastathā śāstraviruddhavādinaḥ khalāḥ | mūḍhāḥ kaṭukavācaśca narāḥ pāpaparāyaṇāḥ ||86|| svatulyān suhitān sṛtvā śuno’rcayanti vai khalāḥ | mālati tādṛśā dambhā naraśvāno jagattraye ||87|| kalyāṇaṃ naiva kurvanti nāśayanti nijān parān | ātmanāśaṃ cāhvayanti te daṇḍyāḥ sarvathā nṛpaiḥ ||88|| yathā śvā bhaṣituṃ caiva khādituṃ cāvasajjate | tathā te lokamaryādāṃ nāśayituṃ jvalanti vai ||89|| tasmād rājñi lokamelaṃ dharmaṃ cātmahitaṃ śubham | hṛdayaṃ deśakālau ca vīkṣyājñāṃ vartayejjanaḥ ||3.86.90|| evaṃ nityaṃ vartamānaḥ śāśvatīrvardhate samāḥ | rājāno vā dhanino vā balino vā janāstviha ||9 1 || tathaiva vartamānāścennābhibhavanti vai kvacit | ṛṇamuktā harerbhaktā bhūtvānte yānti mokṣaṇam ||92||| ityevaṃ citraketurvai mālatīṃ prāha sāpi tu | harerbalaṃ paraṃ prāpyāsevatāharniśaṃ sataḥ ||93|| abhajatparamātmānaṃ sevāpūjanakīrtanaiḥ | naijaṃ karmakalāpaṃ sā cakāra vai satāṃ kṛte ||94|| nṛpājñayā hi satataṃ bheje satpuruṣān śubhān | bhojanairdānasevābhirjalavastraphalārpaṇaiḥ ||95|| sā ca bhaktyārūḍhabhāvā dadarśa māṃ pareśvaram | pūjāyāṃ divyarūpaṃ vai caturbāhuṃ vimānagam ||96|| yayāce mokṣaṇaṃ cāpi tvājñāmādāya bhūbhṛtaḥ | tūrṇaṃ ca bhautikaṃ tyaktvā cāruroha vimānakam ||97|| divyā caturbhujā jātā lakṣmīsakhī śubhānanā | mālatī vartate dhāmni brahmapriyā narāyaṇī ||98|| evaṃ sādhuprasaṃgena rājā sādhurhi citrakṛt | patyuḥ sādhoḥ prasaṃgena mokṣamārgamavāpa sā ||99|| mokṣagatimavāpyaiva mālatī tu ramāsakhī | jātā brahmapriyā lakṣmi satsaṃgo yāvadarthakaḥ || 3.86.10 0|| nirdhano vā dhanavām̐śca saguṇo nirguṇo’pi vā | sādhvāśrayaṃ samālambya bhavatyeva narāyaṇaḥ || 101 || madaṃśo bhaktivegena jāyate cordhvakīrtimān | tārakaḥ sarvalokānāṃ dhārakaḥ sarvadharmiṇām || 1 02|| prāpakaścākṣarasyāpi rakṣakaśca nijāntike | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne dhanamadibalagarvinṛpādīnāmapi paramaśreyasi citraketormālityā dṛṣṭāntena sādhupratāpaphalādivarṇananāmā ṣaḍaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 86 ||
<3.87> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca brahmaputrā brāhmaṇā ye tanavaste bhavanti me | pāvanāḥ sarvathā loke sarvavarṇottamā yataḥ || 1 || kāmakrodhamahāmohalobhapāśāvṛtāḥ sadā | nārīvanto gṛhadharmā āśātṛṣṇādisaṃvṛtāḥ || 2 || te śreṣṭhā vā nirālambā virāgāḥ sādhavastava | kāmakrodhādiśūnyāśca tṛṣṇāśādivivarjitāḥ || 3 || lobhapāśādiśūnyāśca śubhāḥ sarvāśramottamāḥ | agṛhadharmā nirdoṣā mokṣamārgaparāyaṇāḥ || 4 || santa_ śreṣṭhā dvayormadhye śraiṣṭhyaṃ kutra vada prabho | ubhe te vai śarīre sto dvayorbhedo’sti vā na vā || 5 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi hitaṃ tathyaṃ pathyaṃ pratyakṣadarśanam | akāmebhyastu niṣkāmāḥ śreṣṭhatamā bhavanti vai || 6 || sastrīkebhyo yatayastu sadā śreṣṭhatamāḥ priyāḥ | kāmakrodhamahāmohā nārīyoge bhavanti vai || 7 || ratipriyā me tanavaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ śreṣṭhatamāstu na | śreṣṭhatamāḥ sādhavo me sarvamāyāvivarjitāḥ || 8 || māyāvanto gṛhasthā vai nityaṃ nirayayoginaḥ | śmaśānāni narakāṇi nityaṃ bhajanti nārakāḥ || 9 || māyāśūnyā yatayo vai nityaṃ mādhavayoginaḥ | vaikuṇṭhasamayadvāsān sevante hariyoginaḥ || 3.87.1 0|| tyāgāśramāttu gārhasthyaṃ nimnaṃ bhavati sarvadā | varṇeṣu brāhmaṇāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ strīmatsu na tu sarvathā || 1 1|| varṇāśrameṣu vai śreṣṭhatamā me sādhavo mama | brahmacaryaṃ sadā śreṣṭhaṃ sādhutvaṃ śreṣṭhameva ca || 1 re|| vānaprasthāśramaḥ śreṣṭho manāk na tu ca sādhuvat | ratipriyā vṛthā mānaṃ vahante nārakā yathā || 1 3|| sannyāsavanmahatsthānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kvāpi na vidyate | māyā māyikakarmāṇi nikṛṣṭāni svabhāvataḥ || 14|| amāyikavratasthā vai sādhavaḥ sarvato’dhikāḥ | īśvarā api dārasthāḥ pūjayanti sato janān || 15|| dvijā nṛpāḥ surāścāpi sādhūn prapūjayanti hi | sevāvṛtticarebhyastu kṛṣikārāḥ sadottamāḥ || 16|| karṣukebhyo rakṣakāśca rakṣakebhyastu tāpasāḥ | tāpasā brāhmaṇāstebhyo dāravarjyā hi sādhavaḥ || 17|| brahmaparā ātmaparā muktiparā hi sādhavaḥ | doṣahīnā cordhvavīryā brahmasattvā hi sādhavaḥ || 18|| varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭho brāhmaṇānāṃ tu sādhavaḥ | viprāṇāṃ pūjanīyāśca pāvanānāṃ hi pāvanāḥ || 1 9|| tāmasyo me tanavastu rākṣasā daityadānavāḥ | rājasyo me tanavaśca kṣatriyādyā nijārthinaḥ ||3.87.20|| sātvikyo me tanavaśca vidyāvanto dvijātayaḥ | nirguṇā divyatanavaḥ sādhavo me pramuktidāḥ ||21|| tataḥ śreṣṭhatamā lakṣmi sādhavo’ti na tu dvijāḥ | kṣatratejāṃsi sarvāṇi vipratejasi yanti hi ||22|| vipratejāṃsi sarvāṇi sādhutejasi yanti hi | sādhutejāṃsi sarvāṇi līyante mayi mādhave ||23|| matsadṛśāḥ sadā santo viprāṇāṃ tārakā bhuvi | pāpaprajvālakāḥ santo mokṣadā dārayoginām || 24|| tapastejo vrataṃ satyaṃ camatkāraḥ suśīlatā | puṇyaṃ sravanti caitāni nārīyogena dehinaḥ ||25|| sādhūnāṃ tāni sarvāṇi vardhante śīlayoginām | nārāyaṇā iva santo jāyante vai narāyaṇāḥ ||26||| tataḥ śreṣṭhā brāhmaṇāśca santaḥ śreṣṭhatamāḥ sadā | brahmā ruṣṭaḥ purā sanatkumārāya hi sādhave ||27|| tolayāmāsa vai śraiṣṭhyaṃ sādhutvabrāhmaṇatvayoḥ | sādhutvaṃ śreṣṭhatamatāṃ prāptaṃ dvijatvasannidhau || 28 || paścātpunaścaikatulāmadhye nyadhāddhi vipratām | kṣatriyatāṃ vaiśyatāṃ ca śūdratāṃ brahmacāritām || 29 || gṛhitāṃ vanitāṃ cāpi tato’nyasyāṃ nyadhādajaḥ | sādhutvaṃ kevalaṃ satye paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām || 3.87.30 || sādhutvaṃ gauravaṃ prāptaṃ saptabhyaścaiva sarvathā | tasmācchreṣṭhatamaṃ sṛṣṭau sādhutvaṃ mokṣaṇeṣvapi || 31 | | śreṣṭhaṃ pātraṃ brāhmaṇā vai śreṣṭhatamaṃ tu sādhavaḥ | mahābhāgavatāḥ śreṣṭhā gṛhiṇasteṣu sādhavaḥ || 32 || tyāgavantaḥ sadā śreṣṭhā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ | bhāravāhā na vai śreṣṭhā gandhajñā uttamā yathā || 33 || tathā dāravahā naiva śreṣṭhāḥ śreṣṭhāstu sādhavaḥ | lakṣmi cāhaṃ gṛhastho’smi pūjayāmi sato janān || 34|| muktā ye brahmalokasthāḥ sarve te sādhavo mama | tān japāmi pūjayāmi nārāyaṇanarāyaṇān || 35 || vipraviprān brāhmaṇānāṃ brāhmaṇān brahmayoginaḥ | śīlināṃ śīlinaścāpi yatīnāṃ ca yatīnparān || 36 || asvādarasalubdhām̐śca hyanindriyasukhān sataḥ | apramadāgandhasahān pūjayāmi nirantaram | | 37 || na me lakṣmi rocate’yaṃ gṛhāśramo hi kalmaṣī | bhaktānīnāṃ bhavatīnāmicchayā cābhavaṃ gṛhī || 38 || ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃstathaiva bhajāmi vai | pratijñā me sadā cāste bhaktecchāpūrako hyaham || 39 | | kāminīnāṃ kāmadānaiścārtānāṃ cārtināśanaiḥ | arthārthināmarthadānaiḥ pūrayāmi manorathān ||3.87.4 0 || jñānināṃ nirguṇo bhūtvā karomi mokṣaṇaṃ priye | sādhavo me’vatārā vai teṣu vasāmi nityadā | |4 1 || satsu vasāmi yāvām̐śca viśeṣataḥ samastataḥ | anyatra tu yathākāryaṃ yathājoṣaṃ yathāphalam ||42 | | tasmācchreṣṭhatamā nityaṃ sādhavaḥ śīlayoginaḥ | athaikadā svayaṃ viṣṇurlakṣmīyukto yayau vanam ||43 | | tapaścacāra bahudhā varṣapūgasahasrakam | sevāyāṃ vartate lakṣmīstāṃ na pasparśa tāpasaḥ ||44|| tadā lakṣmīrnamrabhāvā papraccha parameśvaram | kathaṃ na spṛśasi viṣṇo kāraṇaṃ nu vadātra me ||45|| viṣṇuḥ prāha vrataśreṣṭhaṃ nārīsparśo na yatra tu | brahmacaryaṃ vrataṃ tapaḥsiddhipradaṃ parātparam ||46 || stryasparśaḥ sādhutā śreṣṭhā sādhutvaṃ tapasāṃ balam | sādhutve jāyate siddhistapasāṃ cāparājitā ||47|| lakṣmīḥ sandehamāpannā svayaṃ nārāyaṇo’pi san | nirdoṣo’pi kathaṃ vakti prabhuḥ prākṛtajīvavat ||48|| atha viṣṇustapaḥpūrṇasiddhyuttaraṃ śriyaḥ khalu | sandehanāśanārthaṃ vai yayau vaikuṇṭhameva tu ||49|| tatra nārāyaṇo devo lakṣmyā sākaṃ virājate | so’pi nityaṃ sataḥ sādhūn pūjayatyeva yoginaḥ ||3.87.50|| ityevaṃ sampradarśyaiva lakṣmīṃ tato yayau param | golokaṃ śrīkṛṣṇadhāma tatra kṛṣṇaḥ sarādhikaḥ ||51 || nityaṃ sādhūnarcayatītyevaṃ pradarśya vai tataḥ | yayau viṣṇuścākṣarākhyaṃ dhāma dhāmottamaṃ param ||52|| tatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo brahmapriyānvitaḥ | sādhūn muktān pūjayati darśayāmāsa tacchriyam ||53|| tato lakṣmyāstu sandeho nivṛtto mūlataḥ khalu | atha viṣṇurnije rūpe lakṣmīmantarvibhāvya ca ||54|| lakṣmyai sandarśayāmāsa lakṣmyā rūpaṃ sanātanam | brahācaryasvarūpaṃ yacchīlaṃ sā lakṣmīreva ha ||55|| icchayā vartate nārī vastutaḥ śīlarūpiṇī | abhinnā bhagavatyeva sā tvaṃ lakṣmi mama priyā ||56|| vartase śīlarūpeti sādhvīrūpeti matpriyā | brahmaśīlaṃ cāti cāti priyaṃ me nāparaṃ tathā ||57|| tadrūpā tvaṃ priyā nityaṃ netaranme priyaṃ tataḥ | tvatsvarūpāśca me santaḥ sarve priyatamā mama ||58|| sādhavo hṛdayaṃ me’sti lakṣmīrme hṛdayaṃ tathā | kaustubho me hṛdaye’sti śrīvatso hṛdaye ca me ||59|| śrīvatsāḥ sādhavo me vai hṛdaye me vasanti hi | śrīpatiśca yathā cāhaṃ satpatiśca tathāsmi ca ||3.87.60|| premapatiḥ sadā cāsmi śīlapatiḥ sadāsmi ca | sādhupatiḥ sadā cāsmi lakṣmīpatiḥ sadāsmi ca ||61|| lakṣmi cihnaṃ premarūpaṃ śīlākhyaṃ mayi vartate | tadyatra vidyate taddhi lakṣmīti parikīrtyate ||62|| tadvatī tvaṃ madicchāsi sādhavo mama mūrtayaḥ | śīlaṃ mama guṇaḥ śaśvat so’haṃ sādhusvarūpavān ||63|| ataḥ śreṣṭhatamāḥ santaḥ sarvasṛṣṭibhya eva ha | kiyanto brāhmaṇāstatra nārīkalmaṣayojitāḥ ||64|| na devā neśvarāścāpi sādhutulyāḥ kathañcana | narṣayaḥ pārṣadāścāpi nārīyogamupāgatāḥ ||65|| tebhyo me sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhatamā lakṣmi parātparāḥ | śīlayuktaṃ tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ tādṛktapastu sādhuṣu ||66|| tasmād vai sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhāstava pūjyāḥ sadā rame | atha te saṃśayo mā syāt kathaṃ śreṣṭhā hi sādhavaḥ ||67|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre bhaja sādhūn samāgatān | atithīn tyāgayogām̐śca sammānaya samarhaṇaiḥ ||68|| teṣāmāśīrvacobhiśca paramaṃ śreya īyate | teṣāṃ prasannatājanyaṃ puṇyaṃ bhaveddhi śāśvatam ||69|| teṣāṃ sevāphalaṃ koṭigolokānandasadṛśam | jāyate ca tataḥ sarvā brahmapriyā haripriyāḥ ||3.87.70|| sādhusevāṃ prakurvantu toṣayantu sato janān | nirvikārān mokṣadāṃśca māyāpārakarān gurūn ||7 1 || durgā caṇḍī mahākātyāyanī hatvā mahāsurān | mahiṣādīṃstataḥ śaṃbhuṃ papraccha parameśvarī ||72|| ahiṃsā paramo dharmaḥ svayaṃ śaṃbho nigadyase | hiṃsā kṣayakarī sā ca mayā kṛtātidāruṇā ||73 || nipātitā hi bahavo vidāritā hi kāśyapāḥ | dānavāścāsurā daityā ye ye raṇe samāgatāḥ ||74|| teṣāṃ pāpaṃ tathā teṣāṃ nārīṇāṃ rodanādikam | vaidhavyajaṃ ca me pāpaṃ bālānāthanikandanam ||75|| kathaṃ vai
