parihartavyaṃ mayā kena hi śodhinā | karmaṇā vā vratenāpi prāyaścittena vā vada ||76|| śrutvā śaṃbhustadā prāha tvaṃ sākṣātpārameśvarī | divyā brāhmī mahāśaktiryatra pāpaṃ na vidyate ||77|| nityaśuddhasvarūpāsi tvaṃ lakṣmīstvaṃ ramā ratiḥ | tvaṃ māyā tvaṃ mahālakṣmīḥ pāpaṃ te naiva vidyate ||78|| ahaṃ saṃhārakṛd rudro rudrāṇī tvaṃ vināśinī | mahākālī mahāśaktiḥ pāvanī lokabhakṣiṇī ||79|| matsvarūpā sadā tvaṃ vai brahmāhaṃ parameśvaraḥ | nārāyaṇī jagaddhātrī śivā puṇyamayī śubhā ||3.87.80|| satī sādhvī vahnirūpā śuddhāsi pauruṣottamī | tathāpi te manaḥśāntyai lokasaṃgrahahetave ||81 || darśayāmi tathā tattvaṃ samācara maheśvari | pāpakṣālanaśaktaṃ vai tīrthaṃ vrataṃ tapastrayam ||82|| tebhyaśca balavad durge sādhusevanamuttamam | sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ sparśanaṃ sampratoṣaṇam ||83|| vandanaṃ dāsyamevāpi pādasaṃvāhanādikam | prasannatākaraṃ sarvaṃ sadyaḥpāpapraṇāśakam ||84|| tat tvaṃ yāhi viśālāṃ ca sādhuryatra svayaṃ hariḥ | dharmaputraḥ paramātmā nārāyaṇo virājate |||85|| sadā vratī tāpasaśca brahmacārī gururmama | tatsevayā mahāpāpādīnāṃ nāśo bhaviṣyati ||86|| tatrānye sādhavo divyā mahābhāgavatāḥ sati | vartante bhaktisampannā darśanānmokṣadāyinaḥ ||87|| pāvanā brahmarūpāśca nityamāyānti tatra ca | nāradādyāstathā sanatkumārādyā hi sādhavaḥ ||88 || lomaśādyāḥ sādhavaśca teṣāṃ darśanasevanāt | badaryāśramavāsāt syāt sarvakalmaṣanāśanam ||89|| ityuktā prāha śaṃbhuṃ tu satī yāmi tavājñayā | yadi te rocate śaṃbho hyāgantavyaṃ tvayā prabho || 3.87.90 || tathāstviti haro matvā yayau devyā samaṃ gaṇaiḥ | badarīṃ vyomamārgeṇa neme nārāyaṇaṃ gurum || 91 || satī neme tato nārāyaṇāya vinivedya tat | sādhusevātmakaṃ sarvaṃ sevanaṃ pracakāra sā ||92|| nārāyaṇasyāsanasya badaryāḥ sannidhestathā | bhūbhāgasya sadā prātarmārjanaṃ ca jalārpaṇam || 93|| patrapuṣpārpaṇaṃ mālārpaṇaṃ dhyānaṃ ca darśanam | japaṃ cetyādi durgā sā pracakāra yathāyatham || 94|| śaṃbhuścāpi maharṣīṇāṃ sevanādi cakāra ha | sādhūnāṃ ca yathāpekṣaṃ svāgatādi cakāra ha || 95|| evaṃ vai māsamātraṃ śrīnārāyaṇasya sadguroḥ | satī sevāṃ pracakāra prasanno bhagavān hariḥ || 96 || uvāca tāṃ vada durge kathaṃ kiṃ samapekṣase | durgā prāha kṛpāsindho tavāsmi vaiṣṇavī sutā || 97|| śaṃbhoḥ prāptā mayā dīkṣā pāvanī dīkṣayā sadā | tathāpi lokarakṣārthaṃ daityānāṃ nāśakāriṇī || 98|| jātāsmi tena hatyādimahāpāpābhiśaṃkinī | harājñayā kṣālayituṃ śaraṇaṃ te samāgatā || 99|| sādhornārāyaṇasya śrīhareste sevayā prabho | sarvapāpāni naśyantu cecchā me hṛdi vartate || 3.87.100 || śrutvaivaṃ śrīharirnārāyaṇaḥ prāha śive tvayi | pāpaleśo na caivāsti brāhmī tvaṃ pārameśvarī || 101 || vartase śivaśaktistvaṃ mahāpātakanāśinī | tathāpi lokalābhārthaṃ karoṣi tādṛśaṃ vratam || 10 2|| tava pāpāni sarvāṇi daityahatyātmakāni vai | śāntāni pāvanī tvaṃ vai sādhormamaiva darśanāt || 103 || sādhvarṣīṇāṃ sevanācca naṣṭānyadyāni te sati | ityuktvā bhagavānnārāyaṇo vāri dadau tadā || 1 04|| kamaṇḍaloḥ prasādākhyāmṛtaṃ vāri papau satī | atha śivā śivo naijagaṇaiḥ sākaṃ hariṃ prabhum || 1 05|| prapūjyājñāṃ samādāya kailāsaṃ prati jagmatuḥ | ityevaṃ śaṃbhunā lakṣmi māhātmyamuttamaṃ satām || 1 06|| sevāyāḥ phalarūpaṃ ca darśitaṃ pāpanāśakam | svargamokṣapradaṃ bhuktipradaṃ muktipradaṃ tathā || 1 07|| dhanasampatpradaṃ cāpi sādhusevanamuttamam | vaṃśapradaṃ tārakaṃ ca dāridryaduḥkhanāśakam || 10 8|| ajñānatimiraghnaṃ ca nārāyaṇāptikārakam | sukhadaṃ dhāmadaṃ cāpi sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ rame || 1 09|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇādvācanādapi | bhuktiḥ svargaṃ bhaveccāpi muktiḥ syātpārameśvarī || 3.87.11 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vipragṛhibhyaḥ sādhavaḥ sarvathā śreṣṭhatamā ityarthe viṣṇornidarśanaṃ durgāyā api sādhusevānidarśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 87 ||
<3.88> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca bhagavan sādhurūpastvaṃ śrīpate puruṣottama | itijñātvā praharṣāmi viśeṣato bhavanmukhāt || 1 || sādhavastārakā loke sādhvyo’pi bhavatārikāḥ | viraktāstyāgamārgasthā jīvoddhārapradāḥ sadā || 2 || pūjyante te kṛpāleśādasmābhirnityameva ha | brahmapriyāḥ satāmāśīrvādaiḥ pramuditāḥ sadā || 3 || vartāmahe bhavadyogairvividhaiścātilaukikaiḥ | naḥ puṇyānāṃ na pāro’sti yāsāṃ kānto harirbhavān || 4 || athātra jñātumicchāmi sahadharmeti yadvratam | pāṇigrahaṇataścordhva dampatyoḥ sarvadā matam || 5 || so’yaṃ dharmaḥ kīdṛśo’sti kṣaṇikaḥ śāśvato’pi vā | vaidikaḥ kalpito vāpi caindriyakaṃ athāsuraḥ || 6 || atraiva vā paratrāpi dampatyorvartate katham | karmabhedāttu dampatyormaraṇaṃ yugapannahi || 7 || gatiścaikatra nāstyeva sahadharmaḥ kuto bhavet | aicchiko vā sahadharmo niyato vā prasahya vā || 8 || kīdṛśaḥ kiṃphalaśceti nikhilena bravīhi me | yena śrutena sarvāsāṃ dharmalābho bhavediha || 9 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi sahadharmaṃ sanātanam | vivāhāgnikṛtasākṣye varo gṛhṇāti yatkaram || 3.88.1 0|| yā dadāti karaṃ naijaṃ varahaste’tiharṣitā | tayordharmaḥ sahadharmo yāvajjīvanameva ha || 11 || svecchayā vā dvayoryoge pitrorvā vāñcchayā tathā | sambandhināṃ vāñcchayā vā prasahya vā kvacit tathā || 12|| prasahyapūrvasammelād dvayorvā sahadharmakaḥ | dānadharmaḥ sutāyā vā kumārasya tathā ca vā || 13|| evaṃ pravartate lakṣmi dampatyoḥ sahadharmakaḥ | dvayoraikyaṃ manobhyāṃ ca tanubhyāṃ karmabhistathā || 14|| guṇairaikyaṃ dhanairaikyaṃ gṛheṇaikyaṃ dvayorapi | upakaraṇairaikyaṃ ca bhogyairaikyaṃ samastakaiḥ || 1 5|| āhāraiśca vihāraiśca narmamantrānumantraṇaiḥ | aikyaṃ vratairdānatīrthairaikyaṃ hṛdbhyāṃ tathendriyaiḥ || 16|| aikyaṃ jāgaraṇasvāpairaikyaṃ sāhāyyasevayā | aikyaṃ prāṇairmamāhaṃbhyāmaikyaṃ snehānubandhanaiḥ ||17|| aikyaṃ cāntarabhāvaiśca bāhyairdvandvaiḥ phalādibhiḥ | aikyaṃ puṇyādibhiścaiva tathāyavyayarakṣaṇaiḥ || 18|| yānavāhanaśṛṅgārairbhūṣāsvarṇāmbarādibhiḥ | smṛddhisampatkṣetravāṭīrājyāpaṇādibhistathā || 19||| aikyaṃ bālasutāpatyairaikyaṃ duḥkhasukhādibhiḥ | yathāyathaṃ viśeṣaiśca śāntaghorapramūḍhakaiḥ ||3.88.20|| ānandaiśca pramodaiśca mahotsavaiḥ savādibhiḥ | puṇyaiḥ kāryaiḥ samastaiśca dampatyoraikyameva yat ||21 || sahadharmaḥ kathito’yaṃ pātivratyapuraḥsaraḥ | patnīvratānvitaścāpi sampūrṇaśced dhṛto bhavet| || 22|| dampatyoḥ sahakālena sahayātrā divaṃ prati | bhavedeva yatheṣṭaṃ vai dharmasāmarthyayogataḥ ||23|| sahadharme kṣatirlakṣmi yāvatī tāvadeva tu | dvayorvibhinnakālīnaṃ maraṇaṃ ca gatistathā ||24|| vibhinnā ca bhavatyeva yonyantare yathā divi | lokāntare tathā syācca gatirbhinnā vidharmiṇoḥ ||25|| sahadharmaḥ kṣatyabhāve śāśvatiko bhavet sadā | ubhau yāta itaḥ svargaṃ tataḥ satyaṃ tataḥ param || 26||| vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāpi golokaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ mama | ubhau sahaiva mokṣaṃ ca vindate sahadharmiṇoḥ ||27|| yadi kṣatiyuto dharmaḥ sahadharmo dhṛto’tra vai | tadā viyogo dampatyorbhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ||28|| ataḥ saḥ kṣaṇiko dharmo na tu śāśvatarūpavān | vaidikaḥ sahadharmo’yaṃ deśakālānusārataḥ ||29|| na cāsti kalpito lakṣmi sāpekṣā kalpanā yataḥ | apekṣā deśakālādervaiṣamye jāyate yadi ||3.88.30|| sahadharmastadā gauṇaḥ kvacid vipatsu vartate | naitāvatā tatra hāniḥ prāyaścittena śudhyati ||3 1|| aindriyikaḥ kevalo na pāramārthika ityapi | ātmārthaḥ sahadharmo’sti loke tu dehamāśritaḥ ||32|| paraloke cātmaniṣṭho mokṣe mukte vyavasthitaḥ | icchāyā ceddhi dāmpatyaṃ caicchikaṃ tatprakathyate ||3 3|| prasahya yattu dāmpatyaṃ cāsuraṃ tatprakathyate | dāmpatyaṃ yena kenāpi vartmanāptaṃ taduttaram ||34|| sahadharmaḥ pūrṇarūpaḥ pālitaḥ sa tu śāśvataḥ | apālitaḥ kṣatimān syād viyogasyaiva kāraṇam ||35|| yathā yāvatpālitaḥ syāt tāvatphalaprado hi saḥ | kaniṣṭhaḥ pālitaścet sa kaniṣṭhaphalado bhavet ||36|| madhyo madhyamaphaladaścottamaḥ śreṣṭhasatphalaḥ | sṛṣṭyārambhe yugalāni brahmaṇā nirmitāni vai ||37|| yugalāni samutpādya sahadharmeṇa tatparam | saha yanti paraṃ lokaṃ mṛtvā mokṣaṃ divaṃ ca vā ||38|| pātivratyabalenaiva patnīvratabalena ca | atha kālasya daurbalye daurbalyaṃ sahadharmaṇi ||3 9|| daurbalyaṃ sahayoge ca daurbalyaṃ pāralaukikam | evaṃ hrāse samutpanne bhinnamārgā narāḥ striyaḥ ||3.88.40|| bhinnayonigatā naijakṛtāni bhuñjate’yujaḥ | ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi sahadharmarahasyakam ||41|| daiviprajāḥ pālayanti nāparāḥ svārthamātragāḥ | bhinnā mārgā hi tāsāṃ tā bhramanti bhavasāgare ||42|| aparasparasambaddhā aparasparabhāginaḥ | aparasparadharmajñāḥ śmaśānaśīlino muhuḥ ||43|| lakṣmīrādhāramātulyā viyujyante na karhicit | satīpadmāprathātulyā viyujyante na karhicit ||44|| māṇikyāśrīratitulyā viyujyante na karhicit | paulomītūlasītulyā viyujyante kvacit kvacit ||45|| bhṛtyātulyā viyujyante yujyante tu kvacit kvacit | pārakīsadṛśī naiva yujyate vigatā punaḥ || 46|| evaṃ cakraṃ vartate’tra loke lakṣmi durantakam | dharmacakraṃ rakṣakaṃ vai yogasya balavad yathā ||47|| tadeva nirbalaṃ sattu yogaṃ rakṣati naiva ca | viyogastena sarveṣāṃ dampatīnarayoṣitām || 48 || adharmaḥ kāraṇaṃ lakṣmi viyoge ṛṇakāritā | kecid vivāhya tūrṇaṃ vai viyujyante viyanti ca ||49 || kecit kālena kecicca madhyakāle’ntime’pare | viyujyante ṛṇavāhā yathā yeṣāmṛṇaṃ sthitam | | 3.88.50 || sva eva kāraṇaṃ tatra yoge viyojane rame | tasmāccared vṛṣaṃ vīkṣya sahadharmamakhaṇḍitam || 5 1| | sahadharmaṃ parityajya tyaktvā śāstraṃ gurorvacaḥ | vyavahāravṛṣaṃ tyaktvā yānti ye vipathena tu ||52|| prayānti nirayaṃ ghoraṃ duḥkhadāridryasaṃbhṛtam | daivaṃ paitryaṃ na kurvanti gṛhasthāḥ svodaraṃbharāḥ || 53 || nātithipūjakā ye te yānti nirayamulbaṇam | dānahīnāḥ śaucahīnā maṃgalācāravarjitāḥ ||54|| kaligrahā rajobhraṣṭāḥ śvavṛttijīvinaśca ye | rodanakleśakalahavyāptā yānti hyadhogatim || 55|| bhagavannāmaśūnyāśca parocchiṣṭaprabhojinaḥ | durātmāno mantrahīnā yānti nirayamulbaṇam || 56 || kriyāhīnāḥ śrāddhahīnā bhaktihīnā nirīśvarāḥ | mahotsavādihīnāśca yānti nirayamulbaṇam | |57 || patitāśca jaḍonmattāḥ kuṣṭhinaḥ śvitriṇastathā | klībā yakṣmahatāścāpi pāpā yānti hyadhogatim || 58 || cikitsakā devalakā vṛthā niyamadarśakāḥ | rogiṇo nindakā bhaktihīnā yānti hyadhogatim | | 59 || gāyakā nartakāścāpi kūrdakā vādakāstathā | kathakā yodhakā bhaktihīnā yānti hyadhogatim || 3.88.60 | | bhraṣṭadharmā bhraṣṭavratā bhraṣṭakulakuṭumbakāḥ | parasaṃkīrṇakā bhaktihīnā yāntyadhamāṃ gatim || 61 || homahīnāḥ śrāddhaśūnyā vyabhicāraniṣeviṇaḥ | nāstikādhyāpakā bhaktihīnā yānti hyadhogatim || 62 || brahmavikrayiṇaścāpi strīvikrayiṇastathā | pativikretryaśca bhaktihīnā yānti hyadhogatim ||6 3 || sarvasaṃgābhimantāraḥ śavaśaucayutāstathā | stenāḥ putrījīvinaśca pāpā yānti hyadhogatim ||64|| vadhūjīvā mātṛgotrajīvāścājñātajīvanāḥ | ṛṇino hārakā bhaktihīnā yānti hyadhogatim ||65|| prāṇivikrayakārāśca strīpaṇyādiprajīvanāḥ | veśyānāthā ajapāśca pāpā yānti hyadhogatim ||66|| vratahīnā nijapatnīkleśadāḥ pāśavā janāḥ | ayuktakāryakartāraḥ pāpā yānti hyadhogatim ||67|| parasparaṃ vimantāraḥ parasparaṃ pratārakāḥ | anarjavaḥ śaṭhā bhaktihīnā yānti hyadhogatim ||68 || asāvitrā mṛṣāvāṇijyādiniṣṭhā mṛṣāvṛṣāḥ | mṛṣāvāco’satyakāryāḥ pāpā yānti hyadhogatim ||69|| daridrāḥ parabhāgyāśca hiṃsrāḥ kalkayutāḥ khalāḥ | kalaṃkinaḥ kalaṃkadāḥ pāpā yānti hyadhogatim ||3.88.70|| kitavāścāvṛttikāśca sarvabhakṣyā vihāriṇaḥ | dāruṇakarmagā bhaktihīnā yānti hyadhogatim ||71 || mithyāśapathinaścāpi māṃsāśanāḥ surāpibāḥ | avedavratacāritrāḥ pāpā yānti hyadhogatim ||72|| gurvabhayādikāryārthaṃ varjayitvā punaḥ punaḥ | anṛtavākkriyācittāste vai nirayagāminaḥ ||73|| parasvanāśakāḥ parastryapahārakarā janāḥ | paiśunyavādinaḥ pāpāste vai nirayagāminaḥ ||74|| prapāśālāsabhāgārachāyāsatrādibhedinaḥ | anāthapramadābālavṛddhabhītapravañcakāḥ ||75|| sādhusādhvītāpasīvañcakā nirayagāminaḥ | jīvikāgṛhamitrastrīviśvāsadharmaghātinaḥ ||76|| maryādānyāyasatkarmadānayajñavibhedinaḥ | kṛtaghnā dūṣakāścāpi janā nirayagāminaḥ ||77|| pākhaṇḍāniṣparīkṣāśca viṣavikrayiṇo janāḥ | abhicārāgnigaradāḥ pāpā nirayagāminaḥ ||78|| āśāghnāśca pratijñāghnā bhaktighnāḥ śramaghātinaḥ | bhedakāśca śubhaghnāśca janā nirayagāminaḥ ||79|| śastraśalyādiyoktāro gokanyāstrīpraghātinaḥ | bālajantvādighātāśca janā nirayagāminaḥ ||3.88.80|| mārgāṇāṃ rodhakā ye ca kīlaśilāprakaṇṭakaiḥ | bhṛtyabhaktastrītyajaśca janā nirayagāminaḥ ||81 || vṛṣaṇocchedakā nāsābhedakā dantapātakāḥ | paśūnāṃ duḥkhakartāro ghātakā nirayāyinaḥ ||82|| agoptāro nṛpāścāpi dānahīnā dhaneśvarāḥ | āśritatyājino mūḍhā narā nirayagā matāḥ ||83|| āśritādīnadattvā ye bhuñjategresarā janāḥ | ayogyaśāsakāḥ pāpā janā nirayagā matāḥ ||84|| pūjāhīnā devahīnā bhaktihīnā asevinaḥ | snehahīnā mṛṣācārāḥ pāpā yānti hyadhogatim ||85|| sahadharmā na vai teṣāṃ tāsāṃ vā vai vidharmiṇām | adharmiṇāṃ tu pāpānāṃ pāśavaṃ jīvanaṃ hi tat ||86|| iha loke sukhaṃ nāsti dharmo nāsti vrataṃ na ca | dānaṃ puṇyaṃ dayā nāsti paśutulyāḥ kathaṃ sukhāḥ ||87|| paraloke’pi te pretā duḥkhino vai bhavanti ca | aprāptajalabhakṣyānnāḥ kuṭumbādarśinastathā ||88|| ekalāḥ parajālasthā yānti nirayamandiram | sahadharmaṃ na jānanti tṛṣṇāviṣayavedinaḥ ||89|| paraduḥkhaṃ na jānanti svasaukhyārthaṃ hi tāmasāḥ | sarpatulyā viṣavāhā yānti nirayamandiram ||3.88.90|| strīrakṣāṃ naiva jānanti gorakṣāṃ na vidanti ca | dāsadāsīsukhaṃ naivecchanti yānti hyadhogatim ||91 || dhanahārā vratahārā dharmahārāḥ pradūṣakāḥ | satyamasatyaṃ kurvanto yānti pāpā hyaghogatim ||92|| sahadharme na tu tṛptā vidharme ca vahanti ye | parārthaṃ naiva paśyanti bhaktihīnā hyadhogamāḥ ||93|| jāravad gaṇikāvad ye vartante gṛhavāsinaḥ | paravatsvārthivad ye ca te sarve vai hyadhogamāḥ ||94|| hiṃsravaccauravaddhūrtavacca kitavavattathā | kālavanmṛtyuvad ye ca vartante te hyadhogamāḥ ||95|| sahadharmottaraṃ yatra vaimanasyaṃ dvayorgṛhe | pratyakṣaṃ nirayaṃ tatra paraloke’pi tattathā ||96|| asnehaścāpi vairaṃ ca tiraskāro’vamānanam | parājayo’tinindā ca pratyakṣanirayāṇi vai ||97|| mahārogo nirdhanatvaṃ kārāgāraniṣevaṇam | bhojyabhūṣādirāhityaṃ pratyakṣanirayāṇi vai ||98|| anapatyatvamevāpi bahuśatrutvamityapi | atipariśramajīvitvaṃ sākṣānnirayāṇi vai ||99|| cintāpiśācinī yasya bhāryā piśācinīsamā | dāridryākhyapiśācaśca rauravaṃ tasya mandiram || 3.88.10 0|| tasmād vicārya medhāvī sahadharmān samācaret | kṣatīḥ sarvāḥ parityajya kuśalaḥ san sukhī bhavet || 10 1|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sahadharmasvarūpavarṇanaṃ cāsahadharme nirayagāmitvamityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 88 ||
<3.89> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca nanu sākṣānnarakāṇi cintāśokakarāṇi vai | yāni bhavanti tānyatra mamācakṣva hare prabho || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ cintāśokakarāṇi vai | nistejasvitvakārśyādirogaśoṣakarāṇi ca || 2 || yāni sākṣānnarakāṇi duḥkhamātrāṇi santi vai | saṃbhāvitasya sarvāṇyasaṃbhāvane bhavanti vai || 3 || suhṛnmitraṃ vinā patnīṃ vinā kuṭumbamantarā | videśe yā sthitiḥ sā ca nirayaḥ khalu gocaraḥ || 4 || sādhūpacaritaiścāpi kuṭumbināmatoṣaṇam | dhikkāraścāvamānaṃ ca nirayaḥ so’tra gocaraḥ || 5 || dhanaiśvaryādyadhikaiśca janairjñātijanairapi | kṛtāvamānasahanaṃ nirayaḥ so’tra gocaraḥ || 6 || svaguṇeṣvadhikeṣvanyāguṇino mānanaṃ bahu | sannidhāveva jāyeta nirayaścātra gocaraḥ || 7 || jīvikāmantarā bhikṣālajjābhayena yā kṣudhā | raktaṃ dahyati nityaṃ sa nirapaścātra gocaraḥ || 8 || vivāde śreṣṭhabhāve’pi kaniṣṭhena jito bhavet | parājayo’yaṃ satataṃ nirayaḥ so’tra gocaraḥ || 9 || kliṣṭā janā bhaveyuśca yasya mitrāṇi nityadā | duḥkhadā bhayadāścāpi nirayastasya gocaraḥ || 3.89.1 0|| prajñāsaṃbhāvitaścāpi mūrkhairmukhīkṛto janaḥ | durvṛttairdharṣaṇaṃ yacca nirayaḥ so’tra gocaraḥ || 11 || mitramukhaścārisaṃgho vañcanātatparo’bhitaḥ | tena vai vañcanaṃ cāpi nirayaścātra gocaraḥ || 12|| rahasyakuśalaścāpi sarvārthagatiko’pi ca | tajjñairna pūjyate tasya nirayaścātra gocaraḥ || 1 3|| asatsu bahuṣu pārśvagateṣu ca guṇā nijāḥ | asadbhirdurguṇāyante nirayaścātra gocaraḥ || 14|| dhanabuddhiśāstrahīnā api vīkṣya mahājanān | mahattvāśāgnidagdhā vai nirayaścātra gocaraḥ || 15|| kṛtabuddhiṃ kṛtasiddhiṃ kṛtapāṇḍityamānanam | bāndhavā nābhinandanti nirayaścātra gocaraḥ || 16|| svabhāryāyāḥ prātiveśyo balī dhanī yuvāparaḥ | vartate svānabhipreto nirayaścātra gocaraḥ || 17|| yasya vākyasya vai mūlyaṃ yathārthasyāpi naiva hi | jñātṛmadhye’pi jāyeta nirayaścātra gocaraḥ || 18|| mūrkhamadhye sadā vāso nindakeṣu nivāsanam | īrṣyāsūyāyugjaneṣu vāso’pi nirayastviha || 1 9|| svāmī cāsañjayitvā yaṃ kṛtye paścāddhanādikam | nityamarthayate yasmāt tasya vai nirayastviha ||3.89.20|| antargatamabhiprāyaṃ darśayituṃ na śakyate | jāḍyād bhayācca śaithilyānnirayaścātra gocaraḥ ||21|| nirguṇatve’pi guṇino jetumicchati cerṣyayā | vīkṣya guṇānna sahate nirayastasya gocaraḥ ||22|| avidvān bhīruralpārtho yaśaścecchati yo mahat | jvalati cintayā nityaṃ nirayastasya gocaraḥ ||23|| cirābhilaṣitaṃ naiva prāpyate yasya duḥkhinaḥ | prāptaṃ cānyairapahṛtaṃ nirayastasya gocaraḥ ||24|| abhiśaptaḥ striyā mātrā vipraiśca sādhubhiśca vai | ātmadoṣeṇa dhigbhāvaṃ gato yo nirayī tviha ||25|| sādhūn dṛṣṭvā muktajanān gālīdānaṃ karoti yaḥ | pāpaṃ karoti tasyātra nirayaḥ svālayo mataḥ ||26|| anyaduḥkhādi vīkṣyāpi hartumaśakta eva yaḥ | śocati dhruvamarthaṃ ca nirayastasya gocaraḥ ||27|| anājñāvartinaḥ putrā nārī vaco’vamāninī | śiṣyā viruddhācārāśca tasyāsti nirayastviha ||28|| duṣṭadattān prabhuktvaiva jīvati svālayaṃ vinā | āhiḍyate’ṭavī yena nirayastasya gocaraḥ ||29|| pāpaṃ pravardhate yasya kalyāṇaṃ cāvasīdati | garhāpātraṃ mato yaśca nirayastasya gocaraḥ || 3.89.30|| śatrūṇāṃ karago yaśca suhṛdebhyo viyojitaḥ | akasmājjīvanaṃ yasya nirayastasya gocaraḥ ||3 1|| duṣṭāridhyānaniṣṭhasya cāprāpyecchāvatastathā | cintayānasya pārakyaṃ nirayastasya gocaraḥ ||32|| sarājyasya dhaninaścānapatyatā ca rugṇatā | akīrtiśca vicittatvaṃ nirayāstviha gocarāḥ ||33|| sādhorjanasya sādhvyāśca bhogecchā nirayastviha | ācāryāṇāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca dhikkāro nirayastviha ||34|| mandāgniḥ sarvadā dīrgharogāśca nirayāstviha | yauvane strīrahitatvaṃ kāntahīnatvamityapi ||35|| vaidhavyaṃ ca vidhuratvaṃ gocarā nirayāstviha | satsu putreṣu bhṛtyatvaṃ parādhīnasvapoṣaṇam ||36|| vārdhakye ca parādhīnatvaṃ ceti nirayāstviha | anindriyasya dīrghāyuḥ sabalasya daridratā || 37|| dāridrye bahvapatyatvaṃ sākṣādvai nirayāstviha | aniketanivāsitvaṃ paragṛhanivāsitā ||38|| parabhāgyopajīvitvaṃ sadā bhikṣukavṛttitā | gṛhasthasyeti loke’tra pratyakṣā nirayā rame ||3 9|| patyurasnehitā nāryāṃ putrā vimārgagāstathā | kanyānāṃ garbhavattā ca pratyakṣā nirayāstviha ||3.89.40 || pradhānāmātyavargasya doṣe nigaḍapātanam | rājñyā rājakumārasya sato deśagurostathā ||41 || kārāgāranivāsaśca rājño dvijasya ca striyāḥ | devajanasya viduṣaḥ pratyakṣā nirayāstviha ||42|| apūrṇabhojyalābhaśca hyapūrṇaṃ ca dhanārjanam | arasaṃ śuṣkamucchiṣṭaṃ bhojyaṃ vai nirayastviha ||43|| sati vṛddhe tvapatyānāṃ nāśo’pi nirayastviha | pretapraveśanādyaṃ ca pratyakṣā yamayātanā ||44|| rājadaṇḍādi kaṣṭaṃ ca pratyakṣā yamayātanā | ītayaścāpi duḥkhāni pratyakṣā yamayātanāḥ ||45|| sāpatnyaṃ duḥsahaṃ nityaṃ tāḍanaṃ paravaśyatā | pāśavaṃ jīvanaṃ sarvaṃ pratyakṣā yamayātanāḥ ||46|| duṣkālāvṛtatā cāgnigarapāśādipātitā | jalagarttordhvapātāśca pratyakṣā yamayātanāḥ ||47|| śūlaśastrāstraghātāśca rodhanaṃ gahvarādiṣu | garbhapīḍā prasavārttiḥ pratyakṣā yamayātanāḥ ||48|| asahyakāmabhogāśca hyapathyabhojanāśanam | tridoṣajvarabādhādyāḥ pratyakṣā yamayātanāḥ ||49|| pākāḥ śarīre kledāśca sadā viḍudaraṃ vapuḥ | śleṣmākaphādisātatyaṃ pratyakṣo nirayastviha ||3.89.50|| aśāntiḥ sarvadā citte tathā deśavivāsanam | apamṛtyurasahāye pratyakṣo nirayastviha ||51 || kevalakanyakāvattvaṃ putraśūnyatvameva ca | napuṃsakatvaṃ ṣaṇḍhatvaṃ pratyakṣo nirayastviha |||52|| śvapacatvaṃ malavāhitvaṃ ca kledādiyogitā | durgandhālayavattā ca pratyakṣo nirayastviha ||53 || udvegaḥ sarvadā citte tṛṣṇājvālādavānalaḥ | śāntiḥ sukhaṃ na vai yasya pratyakṣo nirayastviha ||54|| bālyaṃ caivātivārdhakyaṃ maithunārūḍhatā tathā | mṛjjalābhyāṃ na cecchuddhiḥ pratyakṣā nirayāstviha ||55|| madyaṃ māṃsaṃ ratiḥ kāmaḥ pratyakṣā nirayāstviha | vipatkālā hi nirayāḥ sampatkālāḥ sadāmṛtāḥ ||56 || snehaḥ svargaṃ nirayastu dveṣa evātra padmaje | jñānaṃ svargaṃ vivekaśca dyaurgaurdharmaḥ svarājyakam ||57|| santoṣaḥ śāśvataṃ svargaṃ mokṣastu vāsanākṣayaḥ | ityetat sarvamājñāya tyājyaṃ tyajet subuddhimān || 58 || grāhyaṃ samarjayet tuṣṭyā vivekī śreyaāśayaḥ | sādhuḥ svargo hariḥ svargo bhaktiḥ svargo hi śāśvataḥ ||59|| brahmasthitiḥ paraḥ svargo brahmāptiḥ svargamuttamam | nirbhayatvaṃ mahat svargaṃ jīvato’pi sadā rame || 3.89.60 || śṛṇu caiko bhṛtyapariśramī divākriyāparaḥ | nityavetanalābhena kṛṣikāryakaro hyabhūt ||6 1 || nāmnā viśrāmagupto’sau kṣetre sasyādipoṣakaḥ | nityaṃ prayāti sa prātaḥ śramaṃ kṣetre karoti ca ||62|| sāyaṃ prāpyaṃ naitikaṃ ca dhanamannaṃ ca karṣukāt | labdhvā naijaṃ gṛhaṃ yāti dvāraprākāravarjitam || 63 || parṇakāṇḍādijanyaṃ ca bhūśayyāśobhanaṃ tathā | mṛdbhāṇḍadvitriśobhaṃ ca calacullīvirājitam ||64|| asaṃskṛtatripāṣāṇe dhṛtvā bhrāṣṭraṃ ca vahninā | roṭakaṃ pācayitvā ca bhuktvā lavaṇavāriṇā || 65|| marīcakena saha vā mūlakenāthavāniśam | kandena vā prabhuktvātha pītvā vāri tadāhṛtam ||66 || prakṣālya mṛttikāpātraṃ kṛṣṇanāma japan bhuvi | svapityevaikacīrṇotthakhaṇḍaprāvaraṇānvitaḥ || 67 || nirbhayaścāpi niścintaḥ puṣṭo nīroga udbalaḥ | na śaityaṃ bādhate cāsya na viṣāktātapo’pi ca ||68 || brahmacārī sadā śete sarvacintāvivarjitaḥ | aparigrahatastasya cauryabhayaṃ na vidyate ||6 9 || vinamrasya ca bhṛtyasya śatrubhayaṃ na vidyate | anicchostasya nidrā vai śāntasyāprātareva tu || 3.89.70 || nigāḍhā sā bhavatyeva svāpnacintāvivarjitā | prātarmānavanādaiśca jāgarti sahasā tataḥ ||7 1 || kṛtvā śīghraṃ roṭakaṃ ca saha nītvā prayāti ca | kṣetraṃ śramayutastatra yathākālaṃ ca khādati ||72|| evaṃ vai vartamānasya sukhino darśanena vai | sannidhau saṃvasan somacandrākhyo vaṇiguttamaḥ ||73 || paropakāracittātmā duḥkhinaṃ gaṇayan hi tam | karṣukabhṛtyamāhūya dadau dravyaṃ dayāvaśaḥ ||74|| rūpyakadviśataṃ dānaṃ sahāyyaṃ jagṛhe’pi saḥ | atha cintā samutpannā rakṣaṇārthaṃ gṛhe nije ||75|| yathānyo naiva jānīyāt tathā rarakṣa koṇake | thūtkārasya sthale dhūlyāṃ khātvā cikṣepa gartake ||76|| nikṣipya ca tato nityaṃ yāti kāryārthameva saḥ | kṣetre gato’pi smarati dravyaṃ gṛhe surakṣitam ||77|| madhyāhne ca tata āgatyāpi dṛṣṭvā prayāti ca | sāyamāgatya vīkṣya kṣmāṃ bhuktvā svapiti nityavat ||78|| rātrau nidrāti vai svapne tūrṇaṃ jāgarti śabdane | cintayā caurahāryasya rakṣaṇārthaṃ vicintakaḥ |||79|| evaṃ nityaṃ sukhā nidrā kṣīṇābhavacchanaiḥ śanaiḥ | apācanaṃ jāṭhareṇa balakṣayo’pi saṃvṛtaḥ ||3.89.80|| asthairyaṃ mānasasyāpi dravyalagnasya sarvathā | kārye kṣetre’pi karmālagnatā jātā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||8 1 || kāryaṃ sampadyate nyūnaṃ vicittasya dine dine | tadā vai svāminā pṛṣṭaḥ karṣukeṇa mahātmanā ||82|| kathaṃ tvaṃ vartase bhrānto vihvalo bhūtaveśitaḥ | kṛṣeḥ karmāpi pūrṇaṃ tvaṃ karoṣi naiva sarvathā ||83|| vetanaṃ naityakaṃ cānnaṃ dāsye nyūnaṃ yathākriyam | ityuktaḥ sa ca bhṛtyastu kṣaṇaṃ vicintya karṣukam ||84|| prāhātra kāraṇaṃ cāste rūpyakāṇāṃ śatadvayam | vaṇijārpitamevāste parṇagṛhe mamaiva tat ||85|| taccintācintitaścāhaṃ vibhrāntako bhavāmi ha | dravyaṃ vai nirayaḥ sākṣānnidrānāśo yato’bhavat ||86|| puṣṭināśaḥ śāntināśaḥ kriyānāśo yato’bhavat | dravyaṃ sākṣādbhayaṃ cāste mṛtyurdravye pratiṣṭhati ||87|| kālo dravye rājate ca kṣayo dravye virājate | pratyakṣaṃ narakaṃ dravyaṃ tṛṣṇātantuvivardhakam ||88|| parigraho hi nirayastyāgaḥ svargaṃ paraṃ matam | śāntirādhyātmikaṃ svargaṃ tyāgo bāhyaṃ svaramṛtam ||89|| dravyaṃ labdhvā mayā svargaṃ nāśitaṃ vā vivāsitam | tato’haṃ tu yathāpūrvaṃ sukhībhavāmi varjanāt ||3.89.90|| ityuktvā karṣukāyaiva saha nītvā ca karṣukam | darśayāmāsa koṇe tatpratyakṣaṃ nirayaṃ hyagham ||91 || duḥkhaṃ duḥkhakaraṃ śāntiharaṃ śatadvayātmakam | niṣkāsya gartāt tatsarvaṃ dadau ca vaṇije punaḥ ||92|| dravyaṃ pratyakṣanirayaṃ naiva me rocate vaṇik | gṛhāṇa tvaṃ nirayaṃ vai dravyarūpaṃ sukhakṣayam || 93|| ityuktvā sampradāyaiva sukhaṃ śete yathāgatam | punaḥ sukhī hyabhavatsa vitṛṣṇo niṣparigrahaḥ ||94|| sarvasampūrṇakāryāḍhyo yathāpūrvaṃ tathābhavat | tasmāllakṣmi cehaloke duḥkhadā nirayāḥ khalu ||95|| parigrahā hi te sarve duḥkhadā nirayāstviha | sādhoḥ svargaṃ sadā cāste sahaiva sukhinastataḥ ||96|| nārāyaṇastathā cāhaṃ vasāmi sādhumānase | mamānandena muditā nijānandena nanditāḥ ||97|| tārayanti janānanyān preṣayantyakṣaraṃ padam | prajvālayanti pāpāni nirayān praharanti ca ||98|| upādiśanti tattvāni vivekaṃ ca dadatyapi | bhaktiṃ me kārayitvā ca vidhāya divyabhāvanāḥ ||99|| nārāyaṇasvarūpām̐śca kārayitvākṣaraṃ padam | prāpayanti subhaktān vai sadā svargapradā hi te || 3.89.10 0|| sevanīyā hi satataṃ sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇādapi muktibhāk || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne pratyakṣanirayāṇāṃ varṇanam, karṣukabhṛtyadṛṣṭāntena dravyādayaḥ pratyakṣanirayā iti pradarśanam, pratyakṣasvargaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 89 ||
<3.90> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ yeṣāṃ svargaṃ hi śāśvatam | dānadharmayutā nityaṃ devabhaktāḥ śubhāśayāḥ || 1 || tapaḥsatyaparāḥ śuddhā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam | guruśuśrūṣāvadātā vidyāśīlasuśobhanāḥ || 2 || pratigrahāgharucayo yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam | svārthāt kīrterbhayād vyādheḥ kaṣṭād dāridryadūṣaṇāt || 3 || jñānāllobhādāśrayācca snehāt sambandhayojanāt | sahavāsādbhaktimanto yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 4 || kṣamādhairyatitikṣāḍhyāḥ satkāryeṣu sadotthitāḥ | pūjādyācārasampannā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 5 || madyamāṃsavyavāyādinivṛttāścauryavarjitāḥ | devaprasādabhoktāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 6 || dharmaśālāprakartāro deśoddhārādikāriṇaḥ | drumodyānāśramapāśca yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 7 || grāmanagarapātāraḥ prajārakṣāvidhāyakāḥ | āpatsahāyadāḥ sarve yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 8 || bhūṣāmbarapradātāraścānnapānapradāstathā | kuṭumbasevakāḥ sarve yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 9 || hiṃsādrohādinivṛttāḥ soḍhāraścāpadāṃ sadā | śaraṇasya pradāḥ sarve yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 3.90.10 || āśrayadāstathāpekṣyaparyaṃkaśayanapradāḥ | yānavāhanadātāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 11 || grāmakṣetrādidātāro gṛhagovṛṣadāstathā | pātropakaraṇaprādā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 12 || vṛddhaṃ guruṃ suraṃ kāntaṃ mātaraṃ pitaraṃ harim | śuśrūṣayanti sādhvīṃ ca yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 13 || snehavanto yathāyogyaṃ hitakārāḥ kuṭumbinām | parārthasādhakāḥ sujñā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 1 4|| dharmāḍhyā mādhavabalā jitatṛṣṇā jitecchavaḥ | ārādhanaratā dhīrā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 15 || aparādhidayāvanto vatsalā mārdavānvitāḥ | adaṇḍaroṣāḥ śāstrajñā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 16 || ātitheyāḥ śaraṇyāśca sahasradāḥ susādhavaḥ | anekatrāṇakartāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 17 || svarṇarūpyakaratnānāṃ dātāro vāsasāṃ tathā | mauktikānāṃ pradātāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 18 || mahotsaveṣu dravyāṇāṃ vastūnāṃ cārpakāstathā | yautakādipradātāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 19 || vaivāhikānāṃ vastūnāṃ dīkṣāṃgānāṃ tathā pradāḥ | dāsadāsīpradāścāpi yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 3.90.20 || prapārāmasabhākūpasarasāṃ ca vidhāyakāḥ | dīrghikāsatrakartāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 21 | | kṣetravasatisaudhānāṃ gahvarasaritāṃ tathā | jalāśayānāṃ dātāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 22 || kaṇānāṃ dvidalānāṃ ca dhānyānāṃ dāyinastathā | rasānāṃ ca pradātāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 23 || miṣṭānnānāṃ phalānāṃ ca kandānāṃ patriṇāṃ tathā | śākānāṃ ca pradātāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 24|| duḥkhānāṃ hārakā ye ca tāpasantāpanāśakāḥ | vipadvināśakā lakṣmi yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 25 | | yatra kvāpi kule jātā api snehasvabhāvinaḥ | vaṃśavistāravantaśca putrapautrasutānvitāḥ || 26 || dayāvantaḥ sādhuśīlā lajjāmaryādayā sthitāḥ | amṛṣāhṛdayāḥ śāntā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 27 || parāniṣṭāprakartāro nindādveṣāspṛśo janāḥ | santuṣṭyā gurusevāḍhyā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||28|| āśīrvādagṛhītāraḥ puṇyakāryaniṣeviṇaḥ | puṇyasāhāyyakartāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||29|| pratiṣṭhāyāmalubdhāḥ svagaurave snehavarjitāḥ | nirmānā dāsavadbhāvā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||3.90.30|| nirapekṣā dhanānāṃ ca mahāsantoṣasaṃbhṛtāḥ | aparigrahasarvasvā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||3 1|| parigrahe sadā cāpyakṛtalambakarānanāḥ | luñcābhakṣyādiśūnyāśca yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||32|| sarvaghātādiśūnyāśca tathātmaghātavarjitāḥ | brahmaghātādiśūnyāśca yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||33|| sahadharmasthitā nityaṃ gṛhasthā dharmikarmiṇaḥ | bhaktidānaparāḥ śuddhā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||34|| śīlavratinaḥ satataṃ vanavratina eva ca | sannyāsavrataśīlāśca yānti svargraṃ nirāmayam ||35|| kṛtasyāghātakāścāpi viśvāsasyāpyaghātakāḥ | īṣṭasyāghātakāḥ puṇyā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||36|| lokopakārakārāśca mokṣopakārakārakāḥ | hitopakārakārāśca yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||37|| śāstropakārakārāśca kalopakārakārakāḥ | udyogopakārakārā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||38|| navīnayojanāvanto deśavighnanivārakāḥ | prajāsaukhyaprakartāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||39|| aghātā ye sadā santi cāhiṃsāvrataśīlinaḥ | devāśritāścātmatṛptā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||3.90.40 || aghātayitvā ye santi ghātakākhyā janāstviha | teṣāṃ saṃgaṃ na kurvanti yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||41|| śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca aghātayitvāpi ca ye ghātakāḥ santi mānavāḥ | tām̐stān veditumicchāmi pradarśaya hare’tra me |||42|| śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi tādṛśān mānavānapi | ahiṃsayitvāpi janā hiṃsakāḥ saṃbhavanti tān ||43|| ghātavaduḥkhado yaḥ syād ghātakaḥ sa tu kīrtitaḥ | ghātavat phaladaścāpi ghātakaḥ samprakīrtyate ||44|| bhikṣukaṃ svayamāhūya bhikṣārthe tithivarjitam | brūyānnāstīti yaḥ kāle vidyād bhikṣuhaṇaṃ tu tam ||45|| nyāyasthitaṃ tu yo rājā daṇḍyaṃ matvā tataḥ param | vṛttiṃ harati tasmāt sa jīvahā vṛttihārakaḥ ||46|| tṛṣitānāṃ gavāṃ vighnaṃ tathānyeṣāṃ karoti yaḥ | jalahā goghna evāpi prāṇahā sa bhavediha ||47|| yaśca śāstraṃ niyamām̐śca śāsanaṃ copadeśanam | hanti cājño dūṣayati nyāyahā śāstrakārahā ||48 || nijaputrīṃ yuvatīṃ ca samaye sadṛśe vare | na prayacchati kanyāhā dharmahā sa bhavediha ||49|| adharmiṣṭhaśca yaḥ sādhudvijapūjyādidehiṣu | marmabhedaṃ kriyācchokaṃ pūjyahā sa mato bhavet ||3.90.5 0 || paṃgorandhasya mūrkhasya nāryāścānāthadehinaḥ | sarvasvahartā bhavati jīvahā sarvahā tathā ||51 || grāmāraṇyavanādau cāśramakṣetragṛhādiṣu | agnidātā sarvahā vai grāmahā brahmahā mataḥ ||52|| viṣadaścāstranikṣeptā rodhayitā ca mardakaḥ | pāśado bhayamārgadarśako’niṣṭauṣadhipradaḥ ||53 || abhicāraprado mithyākalaṃkado yaśaḥprahā | rājyahā ca kalāyantrasādhanādyapahārakaḥ ||54|| aṅguṣṭhahā ṛtuhā ca dharmahā yajñahā tathā | lagnahā pāṭhahā pūjāghātako bhaktighātakaḥ ||55|| garbhahā netrahā hastaghātako liṃgahā tathā | bījahā muṣkahā jīvyapaśuhāraka iṣṭahā ||56|| gurūṇāṃ dhikpravaktā ca sarve te prāṇaghātinaḥ | mokṣahā cātmahā prokto nāstiko brahmahā mataḥ ||57|| śīlahā dharmahā proktaḥ pāpakṛt svargahā mataḥ | satītvadūṣako nārīghnaścokto dharmahā api ||58 || brahmaṇaḥ śrīharerbhītiṃ tyaktvā me paramātmanaḥ | hano bhavanti te tasmāt sarve’pi brahmaghātinaḥ ||59 || nirayā yāmyalokā vai teṣāṃ tu śāśvatīḥ samāḥ | pretabhāvāstathā garbhavāsāstiryagbhavādayaḥ ||3.90.6 0 || nārakāste narakasthā yatra kvāpi bhavanti vai | sarvadā duḥkhabhoktāraḥ sukhaleśavivarjitāḥ ||6 1 || nahi teṣāmayaṃ lokaḥ svargaṃ naiva kuto’kṣaram | kintu madbhaktimāsādya taranti kṛpayā cirāt ||62|| śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca nanu pāpakarāṇāṃ te kṛpā vai jāyate katham | tatrāpi ghātakānāṃ vai krūrāṇāṃ lokanāśinām ||63 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ yathā me jāyate kṛpā | kramaṃ te viśadaṃ cātra vakṣyāmi yena mokṣaṇam ||64|| ghātakānāṃ tīvravegavatāṃ śāpā bhavanti vai | prāṇināṃ śāpaniḥśvāsaiḥ puṇyahānirdrutaṃ bhavet ||65|| śīghraṃ ca duḥkhabhogānāmānantyamupatiṣṭhati | gṛhaṃ dvārā sutāḥ putryaḥ kuṭumbaṃ paśavo dhanam ||66|| acirādeva naśyanti dāridryaṃ jāyate’saham | rogā bhayaṃkarāścāpi sarvanāśo’pi jāyate ||67|| annasalilavastrāṇāṃ prāptiḥ sarvā vilīyate | bhikṣukāḥ kiṃkarā yadvat kadaryāste bhramanti ca ||68|| dhikkārāmaṃgalāḥ sthānahīnā vivāsitāstataḥ | śvavalloke vibhramanti duḥkhadāridryadharṣitāḥ ||69|| duḥkhānyetāni saṃbhuktvā ciraṃ dhairyavivarjitāḥ | titikṣārahitā duḥkhadaṇḍairmārdavamāgatāḥ ||3.90.70 || śocanti sutarāṃ kvāpi bhāgyaṃ daivaṃ hariṃ tathā | hṛdaye śaraṇaṃ yānti duḥkhanivārakaṃ prati ||7 1 || idaṃ duḥkhamasahyaṃ me līyatāṃ nācare punaḥ | aho nārāyaṇa duḥkhaṃ mama nāśaya cāsaham ||72|| śaraṇaṃ te patito’smi cāsahyaṃ tvaṃ nivāraya | dānaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthayātrāṃ kariṣye satkriyāṃ śubhām ||73 || japaṃ sevāṃ satāṃ vāpi kariṣye mānatāṃ hareḥ | vrataṃ tapo guroścāpi prāyaścittaṃ karomi ca ||74|| ityevaṃ śubhasaṃkalpāḥ prajāyante’vaśasya vai | rājadaṇḍairlokadaṇḍairdevadaṇḍairvipadgaṇaiḥ ||75|| duḥkhadaṇḍairyāmyadaṇdairmahākaṣṭātikaṣṭakaiḥ | prajāyante śubhā buddhistato yāti hṛdā harim ||76|| dharmaṃ puṇyaṃ vrataṃ bhaktiṃ japaṃ dānaṃ śubhaṃ prati | evaṃ śubhaprasaṃgena śubhakriyāvidhāyinā ||77|| manākpuṇyaṃ prāpyate vai pāpadhvaṃso manāṅ manāk | śanaiḥ puṇyakriyābhiśca suyogāḥ saṃbhavanti ca ||78 || satāṃ sevā tīrthasevā paropakāra ārjavam | bhajanaṃ ghātapāpebhyo bhayaṃ me smaraṇaṃ tathā ||79|| evaṃ cireṇa karaṇairyāti me śaraṇaṃ satām | sādhavo mama bhaktāśca mantradānaṃ ca mālikām ||3.90.80|| nāmakīrtanabhaktiṃ ca satsaṃgaṃ kārayanti tam | evaṃ puṇyodaye citte nairmalye ca mumukṣutā ||8 1|| jāyate līyate bubhukṣatā sampadyate śritaḥ | śiṣyaḥ sa vaiṣṇavaḥ syācca jijñāsati hariṃ gurum ||82|| kathāsatsaṃgasevābhirvardhate bhajane’niśam | ārādhanāyāḥ sopānaṃ yathā yathādhirohati ||83|| tathā tathopāsanā me vardhate prabalā sukhā | evaṃ dagdhāgha eva syāt puṇyaśevadhirityapi ||84|| tato dāsyaṃ mama cāptastataścātmaniveditām | tataḥ kṛpā me bhavati jāyate paṃktipāvanaḥ ||85|| sādhurvā jāyate bhakto mukto vā jāyate śubhaḥ | paradhāmārha evāpi jāyate ca maheśvaraḥ ||86|| evaṃ lakṣmi naro nārāyaṇo bhavati sā kṛpā | kāraṇaṃ tatra boddhavyā mokṣadā manniyojitā ||87|| pāpāḥ pāpatamāścāpi tarantyeva cireṇa ha | yātanāduḥkhabhogāścāsahyāste gurusadṛśāḥ ||88|| daṇḍā nivartane loke bhavanti hetavaḥ kvacit | evamārttāḥ prāyaśo māṃ bhajanti bahuduḥkhitāḥ ||89|| arthārthinaśca vai tadvat tarantyapi na saṃśayaḥ | sādhavastārakāḥ śīghraṃ cen milanti kṛpāvaśāḥ ||3.90.90|| tebhyo datvā manaḥprāṇām̐staranti pāpino’pi ca | prātaḥ sampūjya sādhūm̐śca vṛddhān praṇamya sarvadā ||9 1|| gurūn samarpya viprām̐śca taranti pāpakoṭitaḥ | arpayed vastujātaṃ ca toṣayet sādhusattamān ||92|| mama bhaktāḥ śīladharmā niḥspṛhāḥ svādavarjitāḥ | puṇyābdhayaḥ sādhavo ye tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ||93|| kāmakrodhādirahitāḥ sarvasahā jitendriyāḥ | tāpasā hitamaitrāśca tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ||94|| arāgā jñānavijñānapāragāḥ satyasadvratāḥ | mokṣamārgaratāḥ santastebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ||95|| yeṣāṃ śiṣyāḥ pratīkṣante suvṛṣṭimiva karṣukāḥ | tebhyo dattaṃ prajāyeta sahasraguṇitaṃ tviha || 96|| śīlacāritrayuktā ye kṛśāyajīvikādayaḥ | bhikṣukāḥ sādhavo viprāsteṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam ||97|| svabhaktāḥ svagṛhāvāsāḥ svabalāḥ svāśrayā dvijāḥ | pāvanāścārthinaścet syusteṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam ||98|| yasya satrāṇi vidyante baṭavaḥ sādhavo gṛhe | bhuñjate yasya tasyāpi satre dattaṃ mahāphalam ||99|| hṛtasarvavidhasvāśca bhaktimātraparāyaṇāḥ | anāthāḥ sādhavo ye syusteṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam || 3.90.1 00|| pārāyaṇasthitā yajñasthitā mahotsavasthitāḥ | tebhyaḥ pūrtyarthamevāpi dattaṃ sarvaṃ mahāphalam || 101 || āpatkāle kṛśaprāṇāḥ kṛśadravyāḥ kṛśavratāḥ | tathāpi sādhuśīlā ye tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam || 1 02|| tyāgavantaśca niḥsnehā dambhamānavivarjitāḥ | sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣā ye tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ||1 03|| jāpakā brahmasarvasvā bhaikṣācārāstapasvinaḥ | santo mṛṣāgandhaśūnyāstebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam || 1 04|| bālāparādhaśūnyāśca cātmāparādhavarjitāḥ | brahmāparādhaśūnyā ye tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam || 1 05|| satāṃ ye tu kṛpāpātrāṇyapi bhaktā harestathā | sādhvīsantoṣapātrāṇi tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam || 1 06|| ityevaṃ kamale dattvā sādhubhyo dānamuttamam | annajalāmbarayogyavastvātmakaṃ taret tataḥ || 1 07|| naukā vai sādhavaḥ santi pāpinaḥ prastarāḥ khalu | sādhunaukāstarantyeva tārayantyapi cāśritān || 1 08|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya ghātapāpapraṇāśanam | sādhusevāphalaṃ prāpya svargaṃ labheta śāśvatam || 1 09|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne svargagāminaḥ, aghātayitvāpi ghātakinaḥ, kṛpayā kramoddhāraḥ satsevayoddhāraścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 90 ||
<3.91> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca ghātakināṃ satāṃ yogo yadi naivopajāyate | kathamuddharaṇaṃ teṣāṃ bhavet kathaya cottamam || 1|| śrīpuruṣottama uvāca sādhavaḥ sarvataḥ śreṣṭhā mileyurna tadā bhuvi || śreṣṭhatīrtheṣu gantavyamadhvarāvabhṛthe ca vā || 2 || kuṃbhasūrye pragantavyaṃ tīrthe snātvā pramucyate | kuṃkumavāpikātīrthe gomatītīrthamityapi || 3 || svarṇarekhā mahattīrthaṃ nārāyaṇahṛdaḥ svayam || hiraṇyāsaṃgamastīrthaṃ somanāthe mahattamam || 4 || narmadāsāgarayogaścoṃkāreśvara ityapi || śrīśailaścāpi sahyādriḥ paṃpāsarastathottamam || 5 || dakṣiṇodadhibhūtīraḥ setuḥ kanyākumārikā || godāvarī candrabhāgā kāverī sarayūstathā || 6 || gaṃgā ca yamunā brahmaputrā sindhuḥ sarasvatī || candravīnā śālavīnā mānapīṃgā tathā sarit || 7 || menakāṃgī ca śikṣāṃgī hyaṃgaśikṣāṃgikā tathā | hoyāṃgahā cāmurā ca vīnā yānākṣikā tathā ||8|| bālakṛṣṇasaraścāpi dvikalākhyasarastathā | ovī ca terimā dvīnā volgā ca nīparā tathā || 9 || nārāyaṇī sarvadīrghā viṣaturyasarovaram | kaṅgūnadī nāyajīrā cittaṃ tuṃgānikaṃ saraḥ ||3.91.10|| āmajānā sariccāpi miśūrī mīnakaṃjhukī | sulīvanasaro vinipegaṃ supārayaṃ saraḥ ||11|| erasaraḥ kāruliṃgī tathānyāḥ saritaḥ śubhāḥ | yatra yatrāhaṃ munibhiḥ saha snātaḥ saritsu vai ||12|| sarovareṣu khāteṣu samudreṣu kṣitau rame | tatra tatraiva tīrthasya vidhinā snānatastathā ||13|| ghātapāpani naśyanti punaścennācared yadi | matpratimāmṛtavārbhiḥ snātaḥ śuddhyati tatkṣaṇāt ||14|| matprasādāśanenāpi mama sevādibhistathā || devālayādinirmityā sadyaḥ śuddhyati ghātakaḥ ||15|| mandirādervinirmātā manmūrtisthāpakastathā || sādhvarthe prāṇadātā ca dharmārthe prāṇadāyakaḥ ||16|| śuddhyatyeva mahāpāpād ghātakākhyāt samūlataḥ || puṣkaraṃ mānasaṃ cāpi himālayo girīśvaraḥ ||17|| badrikāśramatīrthaṃ ca pāvanāni samastataḥ | mātṛtīrthaṃ pitṛtīrthaṃ niṣeveta hyatandritaḥ ||18|| gurutīrthaṃ satītīrthaṃ niṣeveta prayatnataḥ || kāntatīrthaṃ jñānatīrthaṃ cātmatīrthaṃ tataḥ param ||19|| bhaktitīrthaṃ paraṃ tasmādahaṃ sarvottamottamaḥ || māṃ niṣeveta satataṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||3.91.20|| yasya ghātaḥ kṛtastasmai svarṇadānaṃ samarpayet || hastidānaṃ rājyadānaṃ grāmadānaṃ samācaret ||21|| vaṃśasya jīvikādānaṃ kanyādānaṃ tathācaret | godānaṃ pṛthivīdānaṃ dadyād ghātavināśakam ||22|| dadyād yadvā svayaṃ svaṃ ca bhṛtyaṃ yathānugaṃ yathā | dāsaṃ yathā yathā śiṣyaṃ yathā krayyaṃ tathārpayet ||23|| tenāpi ghātapāpasya nāśo bhavati padmaje | yathā toṣo bhavet tacca dadyāt sarvaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||24|| gṛhaṃ bhūṣāmbarasampatpaśūn dadyāt samastataḥ || ghātapāpasya nāśo vai tena saṃjāyate’pi ca ||25|| prabhāsaṃ naimiṣāraṇyaṃ gandhamādanaparvatam | nīlādriṃ cāpi kailāsaṃ kṣetraṃ ca pauruṣottamam ||26|| śuklatīrthaṃ bhṛgutuṅgaṃ dharmāraṇyaṃ ca daṇḍakam | vyāghrāraṇyaṃ vipāśāṃ ca karatoyāṃ ca gaṇḍakīm ||27|| karmanāśāṃ devadāruvanaṃ kālaṃjaraṃ tathā | brahmasaro rāmahṛdaṃ citrakūṭa ca vindhyakam ||28|| evamādīni tīrthāni kṛtvā pāpaṃ vinaśyati | vikhyāto himavān puṇyaḥ siddhanārāyaṇāśritaḥ ||29|| tatra prāṇī yadi yānti prapūjya devatāmunīn | śuddhaḥ siddho divaṃ yāyād brahmalokaṃ sanātanam ||3.91.30|| kāmaṃ krodha lobhamohau madaṃ jitvārcya mātaram || pitaraṃ ca guruṃ natvā gaṇeśaṃ tīrthamāviśet ||31|| tasya pātakanāśaśca tīrthābhigamanād bhavet | agamyāni tu tīrthāni smṛtvā pāpamapānudet ||32|| brahma medhyaṃ brahma puṇyaṃ brahma svargyamanuttamam || sādhavo brahma cetyuktāḥ pāvanaṃ brahma sarvadā ||33|| tadāśrayaṃ prakuryādvai pāvanāḥ sādhavaḥ sadā || devāstu sādhavo yajñamayajanta hariṃ hi mām ||34|| yajñena karmaṇā nityabhajanena ca sevayā || sevātmakāni dharmāṇi prathamānyuttamāni ca ||35|| āsam̐stairdharmakāryaiśca māhātmyaṃ prasacanta hai || nākaṃ nityānandayuktaṃ dhāma cāpurhi sādhavaḥ ||36|| yatra sādhyā nityamuktā devā vasanti sevakāḥ || anādinaśca vai pūrve pūrvatamā vasantyapi ||37|| teṣāmāśrayakaraṇānmuktireva na saṃśayaḥ || idaṃ rahasyaṃ me lakṣmi śrīpateḥ paramātmanaḥ ||38|| brahmavidyā bhajanaṃ ca matkathā dhyānamutsavaḥ || manmantradānamityebhistārayanti nijāśritān ||39|| śaraṇāgatarakṣā ca mokṣaśca pāpanāśanam | bhaktilābho brahmaśīlaṃ bhavanti sādhusaṃgamāt ||3.91.40|| idaṃ lakṣmi mataṃ kaścinmama śrīparamātmanaḥ || śṛṇuyāt sa labheddhāma bhajitvā māṃ sataśca me ||41|| santaścāhaṃ nivasāmi viśvapaṭṭasaro’bhitaḥ || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanāmadhṛk ||42|| yatreme lomaśādyāśca ṛṣayaḥ sādhavo’pare || svataḥprakāśāḥ ṛṣayo vasanti cākṣare tale ||43|| sa deśaḥ pāvano lakṣmi jalaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || tapasā brahmacaryeṇa yajñaistyāgena sevayā ||44|| gatiṃ tāṃ na labhedaśvapaṭṭaṃ saṃsevya yāṃ labhet || spṛṣṭānyaśvapaṭṭasarojalairgātrāṇi dehinām ||45|| yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ bhavenmuktirākṣarī me kṛpālavāt | sarvāṇyaśvapaṭṭasarojalaiḥ kāryāṇi dehinām ||46 || karmāṇi te bhuvaṃ tyaktvā yāsyanti paramaṃ padam | ghātapāpāni sarvāṇi naśyantyaśvasarovare ||47|| yāvadasthi manuṣyasya sarovare’tra tiṣṭhati || tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaṃ bhuktvā pramucyate ||48|| cāndrāyaṇasahasrāṇi cāśvapaṭṭajalena vai | | tulyāni naiva jāyante śreṣṭhaṃ cāśvasarojalam ||49|| kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram || lomaśasyāśramaścaite saccidānandarūpiṇaḥ ||3.91.50|| agnau nikṣiptatṛṇavat pāpānyatra sarovare || snātasyaiva vinaśyanti mokṣabhāk sa bhavediha ||51|| bhūtānāmiha sarveṣāṃ duḥkhopahatacetasām || gatimanveṣyamāṇānāṃ cāśvasaro’dhikā gatiḥ ||52|| anācārāśca ye kecidadharmaśaraṇāśca ye || teṣāṃ muktipradaṃ cāśvasarovaraṃ mayāśritam ||53|| aghaiśca prabalairvyāptān pāpinaḥ puruṣādhamān || patato narake cāśvasaraḥ smṛtaṃ hi tārayet ||54|| amaṃgalā aśivāśca kalmaṣaiḥ kṛṣṇatāṃ gatāḥ || te’śvapaṭṭajale snātvā śivāḥ śuklā bhavanti vai ||55|| kuṃkumavāpikādhūliṃ jano mūrdhnā bibharti yaḥ || so’rkarūpastviha bhūtvā yāti brahma sanātanam ||56|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetrānilaḥ spṛśati yaṃ janam || tasya pāpmā bahurūpaḥ sadyo naśyati mūlataḥ ||57|| vyasanaiścāpadābhiśca vināśonmukhamānavam || darśanādākṣaraṃ kṣetraṃ rakṣatyatha punāti tam ||58|| vāṅmanaḥkarmaṇāṃ pāpairgrastaṃ janaṃ tu pāpinam || kuṃkumavāpikā tūrṇaṃ smṛtā tārayati dhruvam ||59|| saptāvarān saptaparān pitṝn tārayate saraḥ || śrutaṃ pītaṃ vīkṣitaṃ ca spṛṣṭaṃ tathāvagāhitam ||3.91.60|| darśanāt sparśanāt pānācāśvapaṭṭetikīrtanāt || punātyapuṇyān puruṣān śataśaśca sahasraśaḥ ||61|| utkrāmadbhiśca yaḥ prāṇaiḥ smaret lomaśīṃ bhūmikām || namet hṛdāpi sahasā sa gatiṃ paramāṃ vrajet ||62|| na kālācca bhayaṃ tasya na pāpebhyo yamāttathā | aśvapaṭṭasaraḥsnātasyaiva mokṣārthinastviha ||63|| śṛṇu lakṣmi dvijatvaṃ vipratvaṃ sādhutvamityapi | guṇaiḥ sañjāyate samyagguṇāstīrthaniṣevaṇāt ||64|| tīrthaṃ tu sthāvaraṃ cāpi jaṃgamaṃ cātmasaṃsthitam | sthāvaraṃ mama yogena jaṃgamaṃ sādhavo mama ||65|| ātmastho’haṃ cāntarātmā tīrthatrayaṃ hi tārakam || guṇāḥ puṇyena cāyānti doṣāḥ pāpena dehinām ||66|| puṇyaṃ satkāryakaraṇaiḥ santi kāryāṇi vai śṛṇu | mama pūjā mama dhyānaṃ mama kīrtanamuttamam ||67|| mama karmakalāpaśca mama sevā nirantaram | mama satāṃ sevanaṃ ca puṣpahārārcanādibhiḥ ||68|| jalabhojanadānādyaiḥ pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ | naivedyārpaṇagandhāḍhyāmbarakuṃkumasatphalaiḥ||69|| ārārtrikanamaḥ pradakṣiṇastutikṣamāpanaiḥ | yajñayāgādayaścāpi homā atithisevanam ||3.91.70|| anāthabālādisevā satīsādhvīprapūjanam | mahīmānasvāgatādi goviprādiprasevanam ||71|| bhaktānāṃ jaraṭhānāṃ ca pitrorgurośca sevanam | mālājapaśca lokānāmupakāravidhāpanam ||72|| ityevamādīni kāryāṇi kūpasarovidhāpanam || udyānaśālākaraṇaṃ viśrāntidrumaropaṇam ||73|| prapāsatrādikaraṇaṃ dānakṣetrādirakṣaṇam | vṛddhānāṃ mānanaṃ nityaṃ cāśritānāṃ ca rakṣaṇam ||74|| daivaṃ paitryaṃ sādhavaṃ ca satkāryaṃ sveṣṭadaivikam || daiśikaṃ jñānadānādi bhaktidānādikaṃ tathā ||75|| evamādīni kurvīta satkāryāṇi śubhāni vai || tena guṇābhavantyeva śīlavratādayaḥ śubhāḥ ||76|| guṇaiḥ sādhutvamevāpi brahmiṣṭhatvaṃ ca jāyate || bhuktirmuktiḥ kare tasya kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||77|| purā kaścid dvijāputro nāmnā kṛśāṃga aicchikam | mahiṣaṃ navadhuryaṃ covāha śakaṭayojitam ||78|| daṇḍena tāḍayāmāsa tīvraśaṃkuyutena vai || rudhiraṃ tena nirbhidya niḥsṛtaṃ tannitambataḥ ||79|| tad dṛṣṭvā mahiṣī mātā saśokā putragṛddhinī | śocantaṃ taṃ sutaṃ prāha mā śucaḥ putra pāpini ||3.91.80|| nāyaṃ dvijo bhavatyeṣaścāṇḍālo vāhakastava | dvije dāruṇatā nāsti dvijo maitro bhavet sadā ||81|| dvijaḥ sattvayutaḥ syāddhi dayāvān rakṣakastathā || ahiṃsro bhaktisampannaḥ sarveṣvātmasamaḥ śuciḥ ||8|| adoṣe daṇḍapāte tu cāṇḍālo lubdhako’thavā | pravartate ghātakaśca krūro nirdaya udvṛṣaḥ ||83|| ayaṃ pāpo dayāhīnaḥ svajātiṃ tvanuvartate || śrutvaivaṃ dāruṇaṃ vākyaṃ mahiṣyāstu kṛśāṃgakaḥ ||84|| papraccha mahiṣīṃ natvā brūhi jānāsi māṃ yadi || mātā me brāhmaṇī cāste kena vā dūṣitā bhavet ||85|| cāṇḍālo hi kathaṃ cāhaṃ mahiṣi śaṃsa me drutam | mahiṣī prāha viprāyāṃ vṛṣalena janistava ||86|| kṣetre sasyānvite rātrai śayyāyāṃ te pitustadā | pitari nirgate kṣetre supto’bhūd vṛṣalo’nugaḥ ||87|| karmacārī svavāṭyāśca sastrīko’pi tadaikalaḥ || andhakāre hyanāvīkṣyāgatya te jananī tadā ||88|| śayyāyāṃ saha suptā ca kāmabhāvaṃ gatā satī | labdhavatī tato garbhaṃ daivāt tvaṃ vṛṣalastataḥ ||89|| jānāmyahaṃ samīpasthā kṣetre baddhā ca bālikā | sa tvaṃ vṛṣalād viprāyāṃ jātaścāṇḍālako hyasi ||3.91.90|| durguṇāste niṣekādvai vartante ghātamārakāḥ || śrutvā kṛśāṃgakastūrṇaṃ natvā ca jananīṃ tadā ||91|| mahiṣīṃ ca tato natvā kṣamāpya mahiṣaṃ tataḥ || pāpajanmavināśārthaṃ tapasyeva sthito’bhavat ||92|| śatavarṣaṃ tatra bhūmau kṣetre tepe sudāruṇam || tāpayāmāsa devām̐śca mahendrastamupāyayau ||93|| kṛśāṃga tapsyase kiṃ tvaṃ kṛṣiṃ tyaktvā sukhapradām | varaṃ dadāmi vada me hyanavāpyaṃ dadāmi te ||94|| kṛśāṃgaḥ prāha cāṇḍālaścāhaṃ vipratvakāṃkṣayā | tapāmi dehi vipratvaṃ pitṛdoṣaṃ nivāraya ||95|| mahendraḥ prāha taṃ cāho vipratvaṃ durlabhaṃ tava || pitṛdoṣeṇa bījaṃ tvaṃ śuddho bhavituṃ nārhasi ||96|| pravinaṃkṣyasi pratyuta tadupārama yatnataḥ || pāvitryaṃ prāpyate cāpi cāṇḍālatvaṃ na naśyati ||97|| evamuktvā yayāvindraḥ kṛśāṃgastu sthitastathā || tapasyeva nidhanārthaṃ vaipryārthaṃ vā dṛḍhakriyaḥ ||98|| atiṣṭhadekapādenāparaṃ varṣaśataṃ tathā | punaścendraḥ samāgatyovāca virama yatnataḥ ||99|| brāhmaṇyaṃ durlabhaṃ caitat sāhasena vinaṅkṣyasi | nahi śakyaṃ niṣekasthaṃ vṛṣalatvaṃ vyapohitum ||3.91.100|| evaṃsthite tapoyatnaḥ śīghraṃ tvaṃ na bhaviṣyasi || tiryagyonigataḥ sarvo yadi mānuṣyamṛcchati ||101|| kenacit puṇyayogena cāṇḍālo jāyate purā || tataḥ sahasrakālānte śūdratvaṃ vindate muhuḥ ||102|| atha kālāntare vaiśyo muhurbhūtvā tataḥ param || kṣatriyaḥ puṇyayogena jāyate ca tataḥ param ||103|| brahmabandhuśca kālena tato vipraḥ prajāyate | tataḥ kālāntare syācca śrotriyaśca tataḥ param ||104|| vipradharmān pālayitvā titikṣuḥ sādhutāṃ vrajet || tatra ceddharṣaśokau ca kāmadveṣau kṛśāṃgakaḥ ||105|| atimānātivādau cāviśete pātyate tu taiḥ || tasmātte vṛṣalotthatvaṃ dūraṃ na syāt kadācana ||106|| ityuktvā prayayāvindraḥ kṛśāṃgaśca tato dṛḍhaḥ | sahasravarṣamaparaṃ caikapadā hyatiṣṭhata ||107|| brahmacaryaparaḥ śuddho gṛṇan brahma sanātanam | athāyayau mahendraśca prāha varaṃ vṛṇu dhruvam ||108|| kṛśāṃgaḥ prāha śīlaṃ me sahasravarṣamuttamam || tena me dīyatāṃ vipratvaṃ mahendra na cāparam ||109|| indraḥ prāha paraṃ kāmaṃ vṛṇīṣva mā tu vipratām || cāṇḍālabījajātasya vṛthā te’yaṃ pariśramaḥ ||3.91.110|| ityuktvā prayayāvindraḥ kṛśāṃgaśca tataḥ param || aśvapaṭṭasaraḥ prāpyātiṣṭhad varṣasahasrakam ||111|| vāyumātrāśanaḥ kṛśo’bhavacchuṣkastaruryathā | papātorvyāṃ maraṇāya tāvadindra upāyayau ||11|| jagrāha patitaṃ cainaṃ varadānadayāparaḥ || prāha varaṃ vṛṇīṣvātra dadāmi te kṛśāṃgaka ||113|| kṛśāṃgako varaṃ vavre brāhmaṇyaṃ dehi me sadā || indraḥ prāha na te tadvai durlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ kvacit ||114|| koṭivarṣatapobhiśca prāpyate na tu sarvathā | brāhmaṇebhyo’nutṛpyante pitaro devatādayaḥ ||115|| bhūdevo brāhmaṇaścāste brāhmaṇyaṃ tava durlabham || anyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇīṣva tvaṃ pūjyatvaṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ ca vā ||116|| kṛśāṃgaḥ prāha cendra tvaṃ samartho naiva dṛśyase || kiṃ māṃ tudasi duḥkhāḍhyaṃ mṛtaṃ mārayase katham ||117|| dvijatvaṃ tu tribhirvarṇaiḥ prāpyate guṇakarmabhiḥ | dvijatvaṃ cāpi vipratvaṃ samānaṃ guṇakarmabhiḥ ||118|| upavītena dvijanmā vijñānena ca vipratā| brahmayogena tatraiva brāhmaṇatvaṃ prakīrtitam ||119|| niṣṭhayā brahmaṇi brahmiṣṭhatā mokṣe tu sādhutā | ityevaṃ guṇayogena sarvaṃ bhavati sādhitam ||3.91.120|| vahnipākena . pṛthivī bahuratnottamottamā || puṇyapākena dehāśca viprasādhusvarūpiṇaḥ ||121|| guṇaiḥ paśurguṇairyakṣo rākṣaso’pi guṇairiha | vipro guṇaiḥ kṣatriyādiḥ sādhurguṇaiśca muktarāṭ ||122|| naro nārāyaṇaścāpi karmaguṇaiḥ prajāyate | śocyastvaṃ naiva jānīṣe brāhmaṇyaṃ dhanamuttamam ||123|| labdhvāpi naiva jānīṣe kṣatro bhavasi mānavān | na yogyastvaṃ varaṃ dātuṃ yāhi śakra nijālayam ||124|| vipraguṇān samāsthāya kathaṃ nārhāmi vipratām | tapasā me mātṛdoṣaḥ pitṛdoṣaḥ kṣayaṃ gataḥ ||125|| brāhmaṇo’smi na sandeho yāhi śakra nijālayam | evamukto mahendro vai lakṣmi dadau varaṃ śubham ||126|| kṛśāṃga tvaṃ tapobhiśca śuddho’si pāvito’syapi | kṛśānuragnirūpastvaṃ brahmakṣatrātmako bhava ||127|| sarvapūjyo brāhmaṇānāṃ sadā pūjyaḥ surottamaḥ | viprottamaśca brahmiṣṭho bhava kalpāntareṣvapi ||128|| guṇaistvayārjitaṃ cātra vipratvaṃ ca guṇaistataḥ | brahmiṣṭhatvaṃ sadā prāptaṃ cāgnitvaṃ prāptameva ha ||129|| ityevaṃ varadānaṃ tu datvā śakro yayau divam | kṛśāṃgo’bhūt kṛśānuśca hyaśvapaṭṭasarovare || 3.91.130|| kṛśānutīrthamatrāste rame brahmiṣṭhatāpradam | sādhutvaṃ pāvanatvaṃ nirlepatvaṃ prāpyate’tra vai ||131|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne ghātakināṃ tīrthayogena pāvanatvaṃ, jaṃgamatīrthaṃ sādhujanādayaḥ, aśvapaṭṭasarovare purā dvijāputrasya kṛśāṃgasya vṛṣalodbhavasya cāṇḍālatve’pi tapobhiścendravareṇa brahmiṣṭhatvabrāhmaṇyamayaṃ kṛśānutvaṃ cābhavadityādinirūpaṇanāmā caikanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 91 ||
<3.92> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ vacanādapi | anyajāteḥ purā jātaṃ tathā loke bhaviṣyati || 1 || divodāso mahābhakto’bhavad vārāṇasīnṛpaḥ | haihayairekadā yuddhe jito yayau prayāgakam || 2 || bharadvājaṃ bṛhaspateḥ putramṛṣiṃ nanāma saḥ | duḥkhaṃ nivedayāmāsa tataḥ ṛṣiḥ pratāpataḥ || 3 || putreṣṭyā ca suto jāto divodāsasya yoṣiti | pratardanaḥ sa gatvā ca yuvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm || 4 || yuyudhe haihayaiḥ sākaṃ parājitāstu haihayāḥ | palāyanaparā bhṛgoḥ śaraṇaṃ cāśrame gatāḥ || 5 || pratardano yayau pṛṣṭhe prāha bhṛguṃ praṇamya ca | dehi me śatrubhūpālān vītahavyādihaihayān || 6 || teṣāṃ vadhād bhaviṣyāmyanṛṇaḥ pituḥ kṛpāṃ kuru | bhṛguḥ prāha kṛpāviṣṭaḥ kṣatriyā nātra santi vai || 7 || pratardanaḥ pratyuvāca kṛtakṛtyo’smi vai bhṛgo | rājāno’pi ca vīryeṇa svajātiṃ tyājitā mayā || 8 || pratardano bhṛguṃ natvā vītahavyaṃ nṛpaṃ dvijam | vipraṃ bhṛgorvacanena prāṇarakṣaṇahetave || 9 || tyaktvā yayau nijāṃ rājadhānīṃ vārāṇasīṃ tataḥ | bhṛgorvacanamātreṇa vītahavyo’pi haihayaḥ || 3.92.10 || bhayena kṣatrabhāvaṃ saṃtyaktvā brahmarṣitāṃ gataḥ | tasya putro gṛtsamado viprarṣirvaidiko’bhavat || 11 || tasya dvijaḥ sutejāśca vihavistasya vai dvijaḥ | tasya vitatyastasya tu satyastasya śravādvijaḥ || 1 2|| tasya ṛṣistasya putraḥ prakāśastasya vācikaḥ | tasya pramitirvipraśca tasya ruruḥ suviprakaḥ || 13 || tasya śunakastasyaiva śaunako viprasattamaḥ | evaṃ sādhormaharṣeśca vacanād vipratā tathā || 14|| brahmaṇyatā bhavatyeva dīkṣayāpi bhavettathā | dīkṣayā trivarṇajātā bhavanti brāhmaṇottamāḥ || 15 || sādhavo vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve viprā acyutagotrajāḥ | evaṃ guṇairvacasā ca dīkṣayā vipratā bhavet || 16 || brāhmaṇasya gṛhe tiṣṭhannābālyād yadi saṃskṛtaḥ | brāhmaṇo jāyate so’pi gṛhītoṃ’ke dvijena saḥ || 17|| stanyapo bālako yena vardhito’nnajalādibhiḥ | tajjātiṃ samavāpnoti brāhmaṇe brāhmaṇo bhavet || 18|| tapasā ca camatkārairāśīrvādaiśca vai dvijāḥ | jāyante brāhmaṇāścāpi dharmakarmādiśobhanāḥ || 1 9|| śṛṇu lakṣmi tathānyacca samartho vyākaroti hi | śaṃkareṇa kṛto nandī mānavo’pi gaṇo nijaḥ ||3.92.20 || ramābdhijā tu hariṇā kṛtā nārāyaṇī nijā | viśvāmitreṇa narapaḥ triśaṃkurdevatākṛtaḥ ||2 1|| kṛtā harādyāḥ kṛṣṇena goloke gopikāḥ striyaḥ | māsi māsi ca sudyumno’bhavannaro’balā tathā ||22|| ardhanārīśvaraḥ śaṃbhurviṣṇuśca mohinī tathā | narabījaṃ sarvasṛṣṭau sutā suto’pi jāyate || 23|| devaputrā mānavāśca kāśyapyaḥ sarvaśaḥ prajāḥ | evaṃ bīje’pi vaivarttyaṃ jāyate jātirodhakam || 24|| svedajāścāpi jāyante sarve vijātayaḥ khalu | jaḍebhyaśca jaḍāścāpi vijātayo bhavantyapi |||25|| tasmājjātirna niyatā sāpekṣā guṇakarmabhiḥ | sādhutvaṃ sarvataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ prāptavyaṃ śubhakarmabhiḥ || 26|| śṛṇu lakṣmi nahuṣo’bhūt sarpastenaiva varṣmaṇā | agastyasya praśāpena vahamānasya taṃ nṛpam ||27|| kalpāṣapādaḥ sahasā vaśiṣṭhaśāpato’bhavat | rākṣaso dvādaśavarṣāṇyacarat sa vanāntare |||28|| ahalyā cābhavat patyuḥ śāpācchilā punaśca sā | vṛndābhavattūlasī sā vṛkṣarūpā kṣaṇāntare ||29|| hariḥ śālagrāmarūpaḥ kālī gaurī tathābhavat | śanaiścaraḥ pannatitvaṃ prāptaścendro biḍālatām ||3.92.3 0|| harirmatsyādirūpaśca vahniḥ suvarṇarūpadhṛk | bhaṃgāsvanastathā rājā vane snātvā sarovare ||3 1 || śataputrajanako’pi strītvamāpto yathārthataḥ | punaḥ sā ṛṣibhāryābhūcchataputraprasūrvane || 32|| śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca kathaṃ bhaṃgāsvano rājā naro nārī tathābhavat | śrotumicchāmi kāntātra kathāṃ tāṃ vada me hare || 33 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca purā bhaṃgāsvano nāma rājarṣirdharmavān śuciḥ | anapatyaḥ sa putreṣṭiṃ samācarat kratuṃ śubham ||34|| indrapradhānabhāvasyāsattvādindro ruṣā jvalan | vighnaṃ kartumiyeṣāpi randhraṃ nāvāpa vai tataḥ || 35|| yajñānte tu kvacidrājā mṛgayārthaṃ vanaṃ yayau | indraśchidraṃ paraṃ labdhvāgatyāviveśa bhūbhṛti ||36|| aśvatthaṃ taṃ nṛpaṃ dūre’raṇye nināya bhrāntigam | rājā ca tṛṣitastatrāpaśyacchreṣṭhaṃ sarovaram ||37|| so’śvaṃ saṃpāyayāmāsa jalaṃ babandha pādape| svayaṃ pītvā jalaṃ paścāt snānaṃ cakre sarovare ||38|| avagāhanamātreṇa drutaṃ strītvamavāptavān | dṛṣṭvātmānaṃ strīkṛtaṃ ca vrīḍito’bhavadeva ca ||3 9|| vyacintayanmukhaṃ kīdṛg darśayiṣye pure mama | śataputrā mama santi tānpravakṣyāmi kintvidam ||3.92.40|| evaṃ sa duḥkhito rājā cāśvamāruhya kṛcchrataḥ | lajjāṃ vihāya nagarīṃ yayāvaśvena vai ca tam ||41 || putrā dārāśca bhṛtyāśca paurā jānapadāstadā | dṛṣṭvā kiṃ tvidamevetyāścaryaṃ ca vismayaṃ gatāḥ ||42|| sa uvāca mṛgayārthaṃ vanāntarasarovare | gataḥ snātastāvatāhaṃ strītvamāpanna eva ha ||43|| putrebhyo mama rājyaṃ sampradadāmi vanaṃ tataḥ | prayāmītyabhidhāyaiva dattvā rājyaṃ yayau vanam ||44|| strīrūpā sā ṛṣeḥ patnī hyabhavat svarvahasya tu | svarvaharṣeḥ śata putrā rājñyāṃ tasyāṃ tato’bhavat ||45|| sā tānādāya rājyaṃ svaṃ yayau pūrvasutān prati | prāha yūyaṃ puruṣatve sutāḥ strītve sutāstvime ||46|| ekatra bhujyatāṃ rājyaṃ bhrātṛbhāvena putrakāḥ | pitṛmātṛvaco matvā rājyaṃ bubhujire saha ||47|| athendrastatra cāgatya bhedayāmāsa pūrvajān | pitṛputrā rājyayogyāḥ strīputrā na kadācana ||48|| strīputrāḥ santi viprā vai na te’rhanti nṛpāspadam | tata uttarajānāha bhavantaścottamāḥ khalu ||49|| pūrvajāḥ kṣatriyāḥ santi bhavaddāsā hi te matāḥ | mā rājyaṃ te prakurvantu rājyayogyā hi bhūsurāḥ || 3.92.50 || ityanyonyaṃ kārayitvā vairaṃ yuddhena nāśitāḥ | śrutvā tu tāpasī mātā ruroda śokasaṃplutā ||51 || indrastvāgatya tāmāha kena duḥkhena rodiṣi | viprarūpaṃ tu taṃ prāha mama putraśatadvayam ||52|| yuddhena naṣṭaṃ viprendra śocāmi tām̐śca rodimi | indraḥ prāha purā rājñā tvayā yajñaḥ suteṣṭikaḥ ||53|| vihito māmanādṛtya mama duḥkhaṃ tvayā kṛtam | vairaṃ niryāpitaṃ rājñi mayā mā rodanaṃ kuru ||54|| śrutvā rājñī nipapāta pādayoḥ kṣama cāha vai | indro varaṃ dadau tasyai jīvantu ke sutāstava ||55|| sā prāha strīsamutpannā jīvantu mama putrakāḥ | indraḥ prāha kathaṃ pūrve na jīvantu vadātra me ||56|| masāha striyāḥ paraḥ sneho’patyeṣu na narasya vai | tasmāduttarajātā me sarve jīvantu putrakāḥ |||57|| indraḥ prāha śate dve vai sarve jīvantu te sutāḥ | kṛpayā jīvayāmyetān rājyaṃ kurvantu te mithaḥ ||58 || ityuktā jīvitāḥ sarve satyavaktryā suputrakāḥ | athendro varadānārthaṃ punaḥ prāha striyaṃ prati ||59|| varaṃ vṛṇu naratvaṃ nārītvaṃ vā yat prakāṃkṣase | strī prāha me sadā strītvaṃ cāstu naiva naratvakam ||3.92.6 0 || indraḥ prāha kathaṃ strītve viśeṣābhiniveśanam | sāha striyā narayoge prītirabhyadhikā sadā || 61 || kāmasukhaṃ ca daśadhā tuṣyāmi strīsvarūpiṇī | tathāstvindro varaṃ datvā yayau divaṃ ca sā satī ||62 || strīrūpā svarvahaṃ kāntaṃ bhaṅgāsvanāpyasevata | papraccha strīsvabhāvām̐śca kāntaṃ kānto jagāda tām ||63 || striyo mūlaṃ hi doṣāṇāṃ laghucittā vināśikāḥ | pañcacūḍāpsarovarā nāradāyāha pṛcchate ||64|| nārada strīsvabhāvo’sti caṃcalaḥ puruṣāśrayaḥ | abalā cehate kāntaṃ rāmakaṃ ramaṇotsukam ||65 || kulīnā rūpavatyaśca nāthavatyaśca yoṣitaḥ | maryādāsu na vartante doṣo’yaṃ pramadājane ||66 || strītvaṃ sadābhivāñcchanti puruṣādhīnatākaram | gṛharājyaṃ stryadhīnaṃ vai pumān stryadhīna eva ca ||67 || aprayatnāḥ sadā bhogyajātāni bhuñjate striyaḥ | pūjyante mānamarhanti mohagarvaṃ vidanti ca ||68|| āyodyamādiniścintāḥ sadā cecchanti bhogyatām | strītvamicchanti saubhāgyaṃ dārḍhyametat striyāḥ sadā ||69|| anukūlānṛddhimataḥ surūpān svavaśe sthitān | parānantaramāsādya bhuṃjate svān vihāya ca ||3.92.7 0 || ayaṃ doṣo hi nārīṇāṃ mahānāste hyagocaraḥ | striyaṃ hi yaḥ prārthayate dadātīṣṭaṃ punaḥ puna ||7 1 || iṣañca kurute sevāṃ nirlajjāstaṃ hi bhuñjate | naiva milati yāvadvai vimārgavāhako naraḥ ||72|| bhayaṃ naiva kuṭumbasya maryādā netarasya ca | rājadaṇḍabhayaṃ cenna vyavāyaṃ yānti tāstadā ||73 || nāgamyo’sti naraḥ ko’pi nāsāṃ vayasi goravam | na rūpādau dārḍhyabhāvaḥ pumānityeva bhuñjate ||74|| yā rakṣyante sarvadānaiḥ sarvamānasapūraṇaiḥ | tathāpi samprasajjante kubjāndhajaḍavāmanaiḥ ||75 || kāmadoṣo mahānāsāṃ pravartante mithaḥ striyaḥ | calasvabhāvā duṣpūryā durniyamyāḥ svabhartṛbhiḥ ||76|| kāmānāmapi dātāraṃ manasāṃ priyakāriṇam | pālakaṃ na gaṇayanti kāntaṃ nāryo hyanargalāḥ ||77|| ratyanugraha evāsāṃ mukhyaḥ pumartha iṣṭakṛt | dharmārthamokṣāstamanu matāḥ strīṇāṃ tu yauvane ||78|| sāhasaṃ kapaṭaṃ mauḍhyaṃ lobho guptirhaṭho’nṛtam | aśaucaṃ krūratā cāpi doṣā bhavanti yoṣiti ||79|| āśrayaḥ svīyatā sevā titikṣā prāṇadāyitā | mārdavaṃ snigdhatā vaśyaṃ guṇā hyete tu yoṣiti ||3.92.8 0 || duḥkhe duḥkhaṃ sukhe saukhyaṃ hṛdayaikyaṃ dhanaikatā | ātmaniveditā dāsyaṃ nārīṣu prāyaśo guṇāḥ ||8 1 || dharmavṛttirvratavṛttiścāstikyaṃ pūjanaṃ hareḥ | ātithyaṃ svajanakīrtirguṇāḥ śreṣṭhā hi yoṣiti ||82|| dānaṃ śraiṣṭhyaṃ kuṭumbasya kāntanindāśrutirna ca | kṣamā pālanaśaktiśca guṇāḥ santi hi yoṣiti ||83 || gṛhakāryakāriṇītvaṃ copārjanamatistathā | vyayabhīrutvamevāpi guṇāḥ santi hi yoṣiti ||84|| rāsanaṃ ca sukhaṃ svādaścāṃgamardanamityapi | samudvignamanaḥśāntirguṇāḥ santi hi yoṣiti ||85|| vaṃśavistārakāritvaṃ bālarakṣā gṛhāvanam | paropakāraśīlatvaṃ guṇāḥ santi hi yoṣiti ||86|| hasantaṃ prahasantyetā rudantaṃ prarudanti ca | udvignaṃ priyavākyaiśca santoṣayanti māyayā ||87|| vānarīṇāṃ tu cāñcalyaṃ mārjārīṇāṃ tu guptatā | kalahaścakravākīnāṃ mūṣikāṇāṃ caritratā ||88|| pipīlikānāṃ cayanaṃ mārgaṇaṃ gṛdhrapakṣiṇām | sūryodayasya prākaṭyaṃ hyānandasya tu mūrchanā ||89|| śoko mṛtaikaputrasya maurkhyamuṣṭrasya vai tathā | mārdavaṃ coraṇasyāpi taikṣṇyaṃ kṣurasya vai tathā ||3.92.90|| ete dharmāḥ pramadāsu vartante vai viśeṣataḥ | pūrve sarge tadā nāryaḥ sādhvyaḥ satya ihābhavan || 91 || svayaṃ prajā devasamā āsan yānti divaṃ hi tāḥ | tato mānavamohārthamasādhvīrviśvamohinīḥ ||92|| brahmāsṛjat kriyāhīnāḥ kāmakrodhaparāyaṇāḥ | śayyāsanamalaṃkāramannapānamanāryatām ||93|| durvāgbhāvaṃ cograratiṃ dadau strībhyaḥ prajāpatiḥ | tairdharmaiḥ rakṣituṃ śakyā naiva nāryaḥ kathaṃcana | |94|| tathāpi lakṣmi jāyante tapovratopavāsanaiḥ | satāṃ sevādibhirnāryaḥ pavitrā lokapāvanāḥ || 96|| kṛṣṇapātivratyaparāḥ sādhvyo bhavanti yogataḥ | doṣān dagdhvā hṛṣīkāvanmuktā jāyanta eva tāḥ ||96 || yatra kvāpi kule jātā viprāśritā dvijāstu tāḥ | sādhvīdīkṣānvitāstāstu sādhvyaḥ satyo dvijāśca tāḥ || 97| | yogadīkṣānvitā viprā yoginyastā hi devatāḥ | sāṃkhyayogānvitāstāstu muktānyo brahmayoṣitaḥ ||98|| hareḥ patnītvamāpannā brāhmaṇyastā haripriyāḥ | tyāginyastyāgamāpannā brahmapriyāḥ sadā matāḥ ||99|| gopālakanyā brahmāṇaṃ prāpya gāyatrikābhavat | pūjyā vandyā brāhmaṇī sā brahmāṇī lokamātṛkā || 3.92.100 || śvapacasya sutā prāpya vasiṣṭhaṃ brāhmaṇī śubhā | ārṣī cārundhatīnāmnī pūjyā pativratābhavat || 101 || kanyāstu bahuvarṇānāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prāpya ca gopikāḥ | kārṣṇyo jātāḥ kṛṣṇarūpā striyaḥ śuddhyanti yogataḥ || 1 02|| rākṣasyo devamāsādya devyo bhavanti sarvathā | paulomī vai mahendraṃ tu samāsādya hi devatā || 1 03|| devyapi devayānī ca kṣatramāsādya mānavam | yayātergṛhiṇī bhūtvā mānavī sā vyajāyata || 1 04|| dakṣaputryaśca kāścittu cāndryo devyo’bhavan divi | dharmapatnyo devatāśca brāhmaṇyaḥ ṛṣiyoṣitaḥ || 1 05|| manupatnyastu mānavyaḥ kāśyapyo bahujātayaḥ | jātāstasmānna vai strīṇāṃ jātitvaṃ niyataṃ kvacit || 1 06|| kimatra bahunoktena mama patnyo’rvudārbudāḥ | sarvabhūsvaḥsatyamadvarjanapātāladehijāḥ ||107|| sarvajātisamutpannā madyogād viprajātayaḥ | yajñopavītadhāriṇyo brahmapriyā ramā iva || 1 08|| bhavatya santi cātraivākṣarakṣetre mayā saha | brāhmaṇyaḥ sarvapūjyā vai divyā madrūpadhārikāḥ || 1 09|| sarvā vai pārameśvaryaḥ pauruṣottamya īśikāḥ | pāvanyaḥ sarvasṛṣṭīnāṃ śrībhūgaṃgā iva priyāḥ || 3.92.11 0|| tasmāllakṣmi mama yogānnārāyaṇī yathā bhavet | devayogācca devī vai sādhavī sādhuyogataḥ || 111 || viprayogācca viprāṇī brāhmaṇī brahmayoginī | muktayogācca muktānī siddhiḥ siddhaprayogiṇī || 1 12|| gaṇayogācca gaṇikā yogiyogācca yoginī | īśayogādīśvarāṇi manoryogāttu mānavī || 113 || nāryaścaivaṃ prajāyante satyayogāt satī sadā| tatra sarvatra śreṣṭho’haṃ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 1 14|| mama yogena ca pauruṣottamītvaṃ parātparam | prāptavyaṃ māṃ bhajitvaiva sādhvītvaṃ sādhusevayā || 1 15|| mokṣa eva bhaved yasmāt tadgṛhaṃ śāśvataṃ sadā | aśāśvataṃ vihāyaiva śāśvataṃ samupāśrayet || 1 16|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya brāhmītvaṃ ceha jāyate | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi nārāyaṇītvamīyate || 1 17|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne’nyajātīnāmapi guṇavratācāradīkṣāvaraśāpalagnādiyogena tattajjātiparivartanaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ ca jāyate’trārthe’nekanidarśanāni bhaṅgāsvananṛpasya nārītve nidarśanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvānavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 92 ||
<3.93> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmīha saṃsāre durlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ vrataiḥ | tapobhiścāśiṣā cāpi sevayā cārpaṇena ca || 1 || brahmayogabalasyāgre balānyanyāni sarvaśaḥ | nimnāyante brahmacaryabalāgre iva padmaje || 2 || kathayāmi kathāṃ pūrvabhavāṃ śīlaprarakṣiṇīm | śiṣyeṇa yoginā bhāryā guroḥ śīle prarakṣitā || 2 || devaśarmāṃbhavad vipro maharṣirvai surāṣṭrake | tasya patnī rucināmnī rūpeṇa rādhikāsamā || 4 || guṇairlakṣmīsamā divyayauvanā devatottamā | tasyā rūpeṇa conmattā devāḥ siddhāśca mānavāḥ || 5 || ajāyanta viśeṣeṇa mahendro mohamāptavān | vyacintayat sadā tāṃ tu samārabdhuṃ kṣaṇāntare || 6 || devaśarmāpi nārīṇāṃ svabhāvajño yathābalam | rarakṣa tāṃ nijāvāse naikāntaṃ pradadau kvacit || 7 || indro muhuḥ samāyātyāśramopānte gaveṣukaḥ | tasyā lābhārthamevāpi naivālabhata tatkṣaṇam || 8 || bibheti vipraśāpādvai dṛṣṭipathaṃ na gacchati | pracchannaśca prayātyeva rūpāntarairanekadhā || 9 || devaśarmā tapoyogājjānātīndraṃ gaveṣiṇam | kāmukaṃ viharantaṃ ca vanopānte vicāriṇam || 3.93.10 || athaikadā ṛṣirlakṣmi vrataṃ kartumanā nijam | śiṣyamāhūya vipulaṃ dayitaṃ brahmayoginam || 11 || samarthaṃ rakṣaṇe cāpi dharmasthaṃ vacanasthitam | vrate me vartate vṛttiścāśvapaṭṭasarovare || 12|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre gamiṣyāmi vratānvitaḥ | cāturmāsyaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā cāgamiṣyāmi vai tataḥ || 13 || ruciṃ surūpāṃ patnīṃ me mahendro bhoktumicchati | nityaṃ rakṣasva cainaṃ tvaṃ śīlabhaṃgo na vai bhavet || 14|| pātivratyaṃ na naśyeccāpramatto bhava cendrakam | indraścātra samāyāti bahurūpadharo’niśam || 15|| kvacit kirīṭī vajradhṛk kvaciddhanvī ca daṇḍavān | muhūrtena tu cāṇḍālaḥ śikhī vipro jaṭī vratī || 16|| cīravāsāḥ kvacit sthūlaḥ kṛśo’tithiḥ kvacittathā | tāpaso gauravarṇo vā śyāmaḥ kvacidvanecaraḥ || 17|| bālo vṛddho vicitto vā kṣatro vaiśyo’pi dāsakaḥ | śuko vā vāyaso haṃso mṛgo vyāghro bhavatyapi || 18|| rājā devo’thavā daityo bhavatyeva ca mūṣakaḥ | yathā rucyo bhaved yogastathā pravartate hi saḥ ||1 9|| makṣikā maśakaścāpi puṣpavallī bhavatyapi | evaṃbhūto mahendraḥ sa dṛśyate yogacakṣuṣā ||3.93.20|| sa tvaṃ yogyo’si rakṣaināṃ cāpramatto hi taṃ prati | yathā ruciṃ nāvalihet tathendraṃ prati jāgṛhi ||21 || vipulaśca gurorvākyaṃ matvā cintāparo’bhavat | māyāvī vīryavānindro durdharṣo bahurūpadhṛk ||22|| kathaṃ mayā rakṣitavyā gurvī vidhāya cāśramam | vicārya bahudhā kāyāveśaṃ śreṣṭhamamanyata ||23|| anyairna pauruṣeṇeyaṃ na śakyā rakṣituṃ yataḥ | so’haṃ yogabalenaināṃ rakṣiṣyāmi vapusthitaḥ ||24|| iti nirṇīya vipulaḥ praviveśa samādhinā | kalevare gurupatnyā uvāsa ca samāhitaḥ ||25|| asaktaḥ padmapatrasthajalabindusamo’bhavat | gurvyā dehe nijaṃ sūkṣmaṃ dehaṃ kṛtvā samantataḥ |||26|| sthalaṃ tu vyāpakaṃ dehaṃ līnaṃ kṛtvā tu yogataḥ | sthūlenāpi viveśāsau gurvīdehe’bhitaḥ khalu ||27|| evaṃ viṣṭabhya vipulo hyuvāsa sā viveda na | cāturmāsyaṃ tu sampūrṇaṃ mātaraṃ so’bhyarakṣata ||28|| uvāsāceṣṭamānaḥ sa chāyevāntarhito’niśam | indro divyasvarūpaḥ san praviveśa yuvāśramam ||29|| lobhanīyatamo bhūtvā sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhanaḥ | ruciṃ kamalapatrākṣīṃ candrakāntisamadyutim ||3.93.3 0|| komalāṃ yuvatīṃ cāgre dṛṣṭvā mohamavāsṛjat | sūkṣmātisūkṣmavastrāntopasthadarśanamohitā ||3 1 || vismitā cātirūpeṇa ko’sīti vaktumicchukī | pratyutthātumiyeṣāpi viṣṭabdhā vipulena sā |||32||| utthātuṃ na śaśākaiva nigṛhītā samādhinā | indrastāṃ samprahasyāha yuvatīṃ dattamānasām ||32|| tvadarthaṃ tvāgataścātra mahendro devatādhipaḥ | ratiṃ dehi samāyāhi vimāne śīghrameva me ||34|| kintu sā na śaśākaivotthātuṃ vaktuṃ ca kiṃcana | vipulaḥ sarvamājñāya dvayostatra viceṣṭitam ||35|| babandha yogabandhaiḥ sa tasyāḥ sarvendriyāṇi ha | athāceṣṭāṃ nirvikārāṃ dṛṣṭvendro vrīḍito’pi tām || 36|| ehyehīti punaḥ prāha tadā tu vipulaḥ khalu | śarīrasthaḥ pratyuvāca bhoḥ kimāgamanaṃ tava ||37|| purandaro vicāryaiva nirmanaskottaraṃ tadā | avaikṣata divyadṛṣṭyā dehasthaṃ vipulaṃ munim ||38|| ghoratapasvinaṃ dṛṣṭvā śāpabhītaḥ purandaraḥ | pravepatābhavat stabdho jaḍatulyaḥ kṣaṇaṃ tadā ||39|| tūrṇaṃ tu vipulo dehānniṣkramyendraṃ samabravīt | duṣṭamānasa duṣṭātman pāpabuddhe surādhama ||3.93.40|| mānuṣīṃ brāhmaṇīṃ dharmād bhraṃśayitumanā bhavān | samāgato’sti daṇḍyo’sti kintu tyajāmi gaccha vai ||41 || gautamena bhagāṃkastvaṃ kṛtastadvismṛtaṃ nu kim | jāne tvāṃ duṣṭaceṣṭaṃ tanmayeyaṃ rakṣyate tataḥ |||42|| yāhi śīghraṃ gururme tvāṃ mā nirdahed ruṣāgninā | mā kadācitpunaścaivaṃ kuru kṣayanimantraṇam ||43|| amarasyāpi mṛtyurvai tapasākasmiko bhavet | na devo na ca vipro vā sādhoragre pratiṣṭhati ||44|| sādhuścāhaṃ brahmaśīlo yogo nārāyaṇāśrayaḥ | guroḥ sevāṃ karomyatra gurvyāśca rakṣaṇaṃ sadā ||45|| brahmacārī bhavāmyeva tava nigrahaṇe kṣamaḥ | yāhītyuktaśca devendraḥ santrastaḥ prayayau divam | |46|| evaṃ sa vipulo nityaṃ rakṣatyeva hi mātaram | athaikadā tu sandhyāyāṃ rākṣaso lomamarṣaṇaḥ ||47|| āgatastāṃ satīṃ hartuṃ vipulastatra tiṣṭhati | tūrṇaṃ gurvī samuttolya skandhe kṛtvāmbare yayau ||48 || vipulaḥ sahasā vīkṣyotapātāmbaravartmanā | jagrāha rākṣasaṃ lomamarṣaṇaṃ ca gale tadā ||49|| pāśaṃ kṛtvā rurodhāsya prāṇān gurvīṃ rarakṣa ca | rākṣasaśca vyasurbhūtvā papātorvyāṃ bhayaṃkaraḥ | |3.93.50 | | gurvīmuttolya cākāśe śanairurvyāmavātarat | vipulaḥ praṇanāmāpi mātaraṃ ca rarakṣa ha | |51 | | athaikadā samudrasthaḥ kapardako mahāsuraḥ | bhramannākāśamārgeṇa dṛṣṭvā ruciṃ nijāśrame | |52 | | viharantīṃ vṛkṣamūle jalasecanakāriṇīm | avātatāra sahasā vyomno mohagataśca tām | |53 || prasahya parijagrāha ruciṃ yayau tato’mbare | vipulo vegataḥ pṛṣṭhe vyomavāṭena cādravat | |54 | | sahasāgṛhya taṃ duṣṭaṃ kapardakaṃ punarbalāt | muṣṭighātena śirasi mārayāmāsa naikadhā ||55 || brahmarandhaṃ bibhedāsya kapardakasya cāmbare | mastakaṃ veśathāmāsa galāntare tato’suraḥ ||56 || mṛtiṃ yayau nijāṃ gurvīṃ nītvā vyomnā drutaṃ hi saḥ | vipulaścāyayau parṇakuṭīṃ śānto’bhavattadā || 57 || evaṃ rarakṣa tāṃ devīṃ cāturmāsye muhurmuhuḥ | ekadā sa gurustasya parīkṣārthaṃ surūpiṇī ||58 || dvitīyā tu rucirbhūtvā nirjane tu tamomaye | vipulaṃ parijagrāha dhotraprānte ratīcchayā ||59 || vipulaḥ śīlasampanno jñātvā rucyāstu vikṛtim | svayaṃ pāṣāṇarūpo’bhūd yogaiśvaryeṇa puttalaḥ ||3.93.6 0 || athāpi sā ruciḥ samāśliṣat pāṣāṇaputtalam | tadā vahniṃ puttalādvai dāhakaṃ ca bhayaṃkaram || 61 || śīghramutpādayāmāsa vipulaḥ sā dadāha ca | tatyāja vipulaṃ rucisvarūpo gururutsukaḥ || 62|| evaṃ vai śīlarakṣāyāṃ sāvadhānaṃ suśiṣyakam | vīkṣya tutoṣa gururāṭ tataścādṛśyatāṃ yayau ||6 3 || nedaṃ jānāti vipulo rakṣatyeva ruciṃ sadā | evaṃ tu vigataṃ cāturmāsyaṃ vrataṃ gurostataḥ ||64|| vratotthitāya gurave nyavedayat samastakam | yathā vighnānyāgatāni yathā dūrīkṛtāni ca || 6 5|| tutoṣa gururāṭ samyak śrutvā śīlasya rakṣaṇam | prāha prīto’smi te śiṣya śīlaṃ rakṣitavān yataḥ ||66 || kṛtavān yogarītyā cāviśyāpi strītanau sthitam | rakṣaṇaṃ duṣṭadevācca rākṣasebhyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||6 7|| svayaṃ spṛśasi naivāpi spṛhāvatīṃ ruciṃ tathā | ato’haṃ te prasanno’smi sadā muktaḥ sukhī bhava ||68 || yadi tvahaṃ tvāṃ durvṛttamadrākṣaṃ śiṣyasattama | śapeyaṃ tvāmahaṃ tatra kintu tvaṃ dharmadhairyavān ||69|| vijayaṃ sarvathā prāptaḥ sādhustvameva vartase | tvādṛśānāṃ sevanācca mokṣo dhruvo bhaviṣyati ||3.93.70|| tvādṛśāḥ sādhavo loke durlabhā mohavarjitāḥ | svayaṃ prāptā parityaktā rucistvayopalātmanā ||7 1|| svajano puruṣaṃ nāryo bhrāmakaśced bhaveddhi saḥ | sādhuścet sa bhavet tatra nārī dharme vasettadā ||72|| sādhusaṃgaḥ sādhutāṃ ca karoti śīlarakṣiṇīm | asādhusaṃgamo hanti satītvaṃ sādhutāṃ tathā ||73|| asādhusaṃgatirdharmanāśinī duḥkhadāyinī | asatsaṃgo vṛṣaṃ hanti cāvṛṣaṃ satkaroti ca ||74|| adharmāgamato vṛttirbuddhirmano’ghakarmasu | pravartante tataścātmā kalmaṣeṇa tu hanyate ||75|| tasmāt kuryāt prasatsaṃgaṃ dharmadāṃ sādhusaṃgatim | satsaṃgaḥ śāśvataḥ kośaḥ satsaṃgaḥ śevadhiḥ paraḥ ||76|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇād vartanāttathā | dharmabhaktyādiśīlādyairbhuktimuktirbhavennṛṇām ||77|| ityuktvā virarāmāpi devaśarmā tu padmaje | vipulo’pi siṣeve ca guruṃ gurvīṃ ca niḥspṛhaḥ ||78|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sarvabalādhike brahmayogabale rucibrāhmaṇyāḥ śīlarakṣaṇe vipulākhyaśiṣyasya yogino vijayaḥ, indrasya parājayaḥ, lomamarṣaṇakapardakarākṣasayorvināśaḥ, guroḥ prasannatāśīrvādaḥ, sādhutvagauravaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 93 ||
<3.94> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ mahatāmāśrayāt sadā | mahattvaṃ cāpi kalyāṇaṃ jāyate dharmarakṣaṇam || 1 || satāṃ yogena vai sarvaśreyāṃsi saṃbhavanti hi | atrārthe te kathayāmi purāvṛttaṃ śubhāspadam || 2 || ājanābhamidaṃ varṣaṃ daśasāhasrayojanam | sahyādreḥ paścimaṃ mātrāgaskarākhyaṃ ca yāvatā || 3 || siṃhāraṇyaṃ madhyabhāgaṃ bhūbhāgaṃ tīrthamuttamam | gokarṇākhyaṃ maharṣīṇāṃ nivāsāḍhyamabhūt purā || 4 || sagarasya sutaiḥ khātā pṛthivī paścimā hi sā | dakṣiṇā pṛthivī khātā hyaṣṭasāhasrayojanā || 5 || avaśeṣo’sya khaṇḍasya dve sahasre’vaśiṣyate | pṛthvīkhātottaraṃ tīrthe gokarṇe cirakālataḥ || 6 || sāmudraṃ jalamāpannaṃ bhūmagnā kṣāravāribhiḥ | tīrthaṃ gokarṇasaṃjñaṃ ca śārabhaṃ tīrthamityapi || 7 || siṃhāraṇyaṃ samastaṃ ca jalamagnaṃ tato’bhavat | sārdhayojanavistāraṃ gokarṇaṃ bhūtalaṃ hyabhūt || 8 || gokarṇākhyaṛṣeḥ kṣetraṃ harāvatārarūpiṇaḥ | tatrāsaṃkhyāni tīrthāni munidevālayāstathā || 9 || avasan siddhasaṃghāśca munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ | nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ prāptāḥ punarāvṛttivarjitam || 3.94.1 0|| tatkṣetre sarvadā lakṣmi prītyā bhūtagaṇaiḥ saha | devyā ca sakalairdevairnityaṃ vasati śaṃkaraḥ || 11 || siddhikāmā vasanti sma munayastatra kecana | acireṇaiva tatsiddhiṃ prāpnuvanti sma tadbalāt || 12 || ambhodhisalile magnaṃ vīkṣyāśramādi bhūtalam | tapasāṃ nidhayaḥ santastathā prajājanā api || 13 || sahyādriṃ pūrvabhāgasthaṃ nilayarthaṃ samāruhan | vasantastatra te santaḥ sampradhārya parasparam || 14|| uddhāropāyamatyantaśreṣṭhaṃ sādhusamāśrayam | mahendrādau tapasyantaṃ rāmaṃ gantuṃ pracakramuḥ || 15|| malayācalavāsāśca tathā nīlādrivāsinaḥ | deśabhūvāsinaścāpi rāmaṃ gantuṃ pracakramuḥ || 16|| śuṣkasumitradharmādyā munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ | yayurdidṛkṣavo rāmaṃ mahendramacalaṃ prati || 17|| atītya subahūn deśān vanāni droṇamāpagāḥ | āseduracalaśreṣṭhaṃ dadṛśūrāmamaṇḍalam || 18|| praśāntasarvasattvāḍhyaṃ sarvartudrumaśobhitam | āśramaṃ sampraviśyaiva dadṛśuḥ paraśuprabhum || 1 9|| ajine tu sukhāsīnaṃ śiṣyaiḥ parivṛtaṃ prabhum | vavandire mahāmaunaṃ pupūjārghyādibhirharim ||3.94.20|| kṛtātithyānṛṣīn rāmaḥ smitapūrvamabhāṣata | svāgataṃ vo mahābhāgāḥ pāvito’haṃ śubhāgamaiḥ || 21 || sevāṃ mamārhām ṛṣayo darśayantu karomi vai | śrutvā maharṣayaḥ prāhurgokarṇākhyaṃ tu bhūtalam ||22|| khanadbhiḥ sāgarajanyaiḥ patitaṃ sāgarāmbhasi | utsāritārṇavajalaṃ kṣetraṃ tat sarvapāvanam ||23|| upalabdhumabhīpsāmo bhavatastu kṛpāṃ kuru | viṣṇoraṃśo bhavānāste sādhuḥ satāṃ balodayaḥ ||24|| bhṛgoḥ putrasyarcikasya jamadagniḥ suto’malaḥ | tasya tvaṃ brahmadharmāsi samartho’si mahāprabhuḥ ||25||| tasmāt kartumaśakyaṃ tatte kiñcinnaiva vidyate | vāñcchitārthapradaṃ tvāṃ cābhiyācituṃ samāgatāḥ ||26 || sa tvamātmaprabhāveṇa samutsāryārṇavodakam | kṣetraṃ gokarṇamityākhyaṃ siṃhāraṇye jale plutam ||27|| dātumarhasi bhagavannaḥ sarvānṛṣisattamān | iti śrutvā tato rāmaḥ prāha yogyaṃ tapodhanāḥ ||28|| karaṇīyaṃ satāṃ kāryaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | kintu śastrāṇi sannyasya tapaḥ kartuṃ samāgataḥ ||29||| vinā śastraṃ tadasādhyaṃ kiṃ kartavyaṃ diśantu mām | śuṣkādyāḥ ṛṣayaḥ prāhuḥ śrutvā rāmoditaṃ hiṃ tam ||3.94.3 0 || satāṃ saṃrakṣaṇārthāya śastrasaṃgrahaṇaṃ tu yat | vrataṃ pratijñāṃ dharmaṃ vā satyaṃ poṣayati dhruvam ||3 1 || na cyāvayate satyādvā na dharmādvā vratānna vā | tasmāt sādhurhitārthāya bhavatā grāhyamāyudham || 32|| tapa eva mahattacca kṛtaṃ te’tra bhaviṣyati | dharma eva mahāṃstena caritaste bhaviṣyati ||33 || ityuktaḥ paraśudhrak ca vicārya sādhurakṣaṇam | paraṃ bhāgavataṃ dharmaṃ saśastraḥ saha cāyayau ||34|| tapastyaktvā satāṃ rakṣātapo dhṛtvāmbare yayau | sahyādriṃ cāyayau paścānmalayācalamāyayau || 35|| varuṇaṃ tvāhvayāmāsa meghagambhīrayā girā | ahaṃ munigaṇaiḥ sārdhamāgatastvaddidṛkṣayā || 36|| tasmāt svarūpadhṛk mahyaṃ praceto dehi darśanam | punaḥ punaścāpi samāhūto yadā na cāyayau ||37|| nistoyamarṇavaṃ kartumiyeṣa ruṣito hariḥ | ācamya ca dhanurdhṛtvāropya jyāghoṣamācarat || 38|| svarṇapuṃkhaṃ viśikhaṃ ca bhārgavaṃ vahnidaivatam | samantrāstraṃ mahāghoraṃ sandadhe ca mumoca ha ||3 9|| tataścacāla vasudhā saśailavanakānanā | prakṣobhaṃ paramaṃ jagmuḥ sarvalokāśca vārdhayaḥ ||3.94.40|| sadigdāhābhrapaṭalairabhavan saṃvṛtā diśaḥ | astrāgnijvālitā āpo vināśaṃ prayayustadā ||41 || babhūva varuṇo devo garviṣṭho’pi śarāgninā | dagdhastūrṇaṃ bhasmasādvai samudraḥ śuṣkatāṃ yayau ||42|| tāvad brahmādayastatrāyayustuṣṭuvurīśvaram | alaṃ cālaṃ hare śāntiṃ gṛhāṇa parameśvara ||43|| asādhyaṃ te na vai kiñcicchrīpateḥ paramātmanaḥ | varuṇo dagdhatāṃ yāto jalaṃ naṣṭaṃ prajāyate ||44|| jalahīnaṃ jagat sarvaṃ nāśaṃ kṣaṇāt prayāsyati | prasīda tvaṃ kṛpāsindho nivārayāstramulbaṇam ||45|| ujjīvaya ca varuṇaṃ jalahetuṃ suraṃ prabho | namaste rudrarūpāya saṃkarṣaṇāya te namaḥ ||46 || mahākālasvarūpāya mṛtyurūpāya te namaḥ | sarvasaṃhārakṛtkṛṣṇasādhurūpāya te namaḥ ||47|| kṣatrāntakāya devānāṃ hitāya ca namo namaḥ | satāṃ hitāya rāmāya śrīharaye te namaḥ ||48|| itistuto haristatra vīkṣya devān puraḥsthitān | śāntimāsādya vahnyastraṃ nijagrāha nivṛttaye ||49|| saṃhṛtyāstraṃ sthito rāmo varuṇo nāśatāṃ gataḥ | ujjīvanārthaṃ tasyaivāśvinībālau surādayaḥ ||3.94.50 || sasmarustūrṇamāyātau brahmājñayā rasauṣadhaiḥ | vāruṇaṃ bhasmacayanaṃ siṣicatuḥ samantrakaiḥ |||51 || varuṇo bhasmatastatrojjīvanaṃ prāpya cotthitaḥ | kṛtāñjalirbhīta eva papāta rāmapādayoḥ ||52|| uvāca rakṣa māṃ rāma kṛpayā śaraṇāgatam | aparādhamimaṃ naiva pragaṇayya praśādhi mām |||53|| evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ varuṇaṃ rāmaḥ prāha jaleśvaram | tvattoye medinīṃ pūrvaṃ khanadbhiḥ sagarātmajaiḥ ||24|| adho nipātitaṃ tīrthaṃ gokarṇamṛṣisevitam | eṣāṃ vāsāya tat kṣetraṃ pradehi pūrvavacchubham ||55|| mā jalaṃ tatra cāyātu yojanānāṃ śatadvaye | gokarṇe cāpi ca śūrpārake tīrthe kadācana ||56|| bhavatīrthe satītīrthe tīrthe tathā ca śārabhe | śrutvā varuṇa omityaṃgīkṛtya saṃprapūjya ca ||57|| bhuvaṃ datvā jīvanaṃ ca labdhvā yayau suraiḥ saha | vyasmayanta tu munayo dṛṣṭvā rāmasya vikramam ||58|| ṛṣayaḥ sthānamāsādya praseduścātiharṣitāḥ | kṛtakṛtyā bhaśaṃ rāmamāśiṣā samapūjayan ||59|| tairājñapto yayau rāmo mahendraparvataṃ prati | tattoyaniḥsṛte kṣetre nyūṣurmaharṣayaḥ prajāḥ ||3.94.6 0|| dvīpāścāntarjale te ca vartante tīrtharūpiṇaḥ | munayo vyomamārgeṇa vicaranti hi yoginaḥ ||61 || ityevaṃ sādhuyogena rāmayogena padmaje | tvatpitā pradadau bhūmiṃ jīvanaṃ varuṇāya ca || 6 2|| hariḥ pradadau tatraiva tīrthalābho bhavatpunaḥ | sarvaṃ dadāti sādhurvai bhuktiṃ muktiṃ samunnatim ||63 || paropakāraśīlā vai sādhavo hyanivartinaḥ | śṛṇu cānyāṃ kathāṃ cāpi sādhujanyāṃ hitāvahām | | 64 | | sūryaputro babhūvāpi cekṣvākurnṛpasattamaḥ | ayodhyāyāṃ ca tadvaṃśe kuvalāśvo’bhavannṛpaḥ | | 65 | | dhārmikaśca mahāśūro yajvā sādhuprarakṣakaḥ | himālayasya nikaṭe hyuttaṃkasyāśramāntike | | 66 | | dhundhunāmā madhoḥ putro rākṣaso’bhavadulbaṇaḥ | tannāśārthaṃ kuvalāśvaṃ yuyojottaṃka eva ha | | 67 || sajjo’bhavat kuvalāśvo dhundhuṃ nāśayituṃ saruṭ | sahasrairekaviṃśatyā putrāṇāṃ saha satvaraḥ | | 68 || tamāviśattato viṣṇurbhagavān svena tejasā | uttaṃkasya niyogena lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā | | 69 | | divyaiḥ puṣpaiśca taṃ devāḥ samantāt samavākiran | dhundhuścāsīd vālukāyāmantastale hi bhūtale || 3.94.70 || tatra gatvā ca rājā svatanayaiḥ saha bhūtalam | viśālaṃ khanayāmāsa dhundhurāsāditastale ||7 1 | | dhundhurmukhena vahniṃ vai hyavāsṛjad bhayaṃkaram | vahninā kuvalāśvasya putrā dagdhāḥ samastataḥ || 72 || trayo dūraṃ sthitāstatrorvaritā jīvasaṃyutāḥ | kuvalāśvo jalāstreṇa śamayāmāsa cānalam || 73 | | dhundhuṃ ca mārayāmāsa śaivāstreṇa hiṃ satvaram | uttaṃkaṃ darśayāmāsa mṛtaṃ taṃ rākṣasaṃ nṛpaḥ ||74| | uttaṃko’pi prasanno’bhūd varaṃ dadau tu bhūbhṛte | dadataścākṣayaṃ vittaṃ śatrubhiścāpyadhṛṣyatām ||75|| dharme ratiṃ ca satataṃ svarge vāsaṃ tathākṣaye | putrāṇāṃ cākṣayān lokān ye cātra rākṣasā hatāḥ | | 76 || uttaṃkasya prasādena cāyayurdevatāstadā | vimānāni samādāya putrāste caikaviṃśatiḥ ||77|| sahasrāṇi divyadehā bhūtvā vimānasaṃsthitāḥ | yayuḥ svargaṃ paśyatāṃ vai sarveṣāṃ jayanādinām | | 78 || evamṛṣeḥ pratāpena rājā vijayamāptavān | putrāṇāṃ cākṣayaṃ svargaṃ sādhoḥ pratāpato’bhavat ||79 || athaivaṃ kuvalāśvasya dṛḍhāśvo jīvavān sutaḥ | tasya vaṃśe’bhavadrājā satyavrato mahābalaḥ | | 3.94.80 || sa ca vidarbhanṛpatervivāhe maṇḍape yayau | pāṇigrahaṇakāle vai yuddhaṃ kṛtvā mahābalaḥ ||8 1 || kāmād balācca mohācca saṃharṣeṇa balena ca | bhāvino’rthasya ca balād bhāryāṃ jahāra maṇḍapāt ||82|| devān viprānavamatya pāpaṃ vai kṛtavān sa ca | tena trayyāruṇākhyena pitrā tyakto hyadhārmikaḥ ||83|| kathitaścāpi vāsāya śvapākaiḥ saha vai bahiḥ | uvāsāpi bahirgatvā śvapākāvasathāntike ||84|| atha dvādaśavarṣāṇi nāvarṣat pākaśāsanaḥ | viśvāmitrastadā deśe tapaścakāra dāruṇam ||85|| viśvāmitrasya patnī ca bahuputrasamanvitā | kuṭumbabharaṇārthāya vyakrīṇānmadhyamaṃ sutam ||86|| jñātvā satyavratastadvai mokṣayāmāsa taṃ sutam | datvā bahūni cānnāni satyabalodbhavāni ca ||87|| evaṃ satyavratastasyā bharaṇaṃ hyakarottadā | viśvāmitrasya tuṣṭyarthamanukampārthamityapi ||88|| viśvāmitrasuto yaśca mocito gālavo hi saḥ | maharṣiścābhavacchūro vratabhaktisamanvitaḥ ||89|| tasya vratena bhaktyā ca kṛpayā ca pratijñayā | viśvāmitrakalatrādīn satyavrato babhāra ha ||3.94.90|| vasiṣṭhaścābhavad rājye trayyāruṇinṛpasya vai | ayodhyāyāṃ satyavrate vimanā iva sarvathā ||91|| itihetorvasiṣṭhe vai satyavratasya bhāvanā | nāsīnmanāgapi tatra bhāvino’rthasya vai balāt ||92|| satyavrato’tha vai roṣād vasiṣṭhasyāśramaṃ yayau | bhojyādīni samagrāṇi jahāra bālavattadā ||93|| bhojayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ viśvāmitrasya cātmajān | vasiṣṭhastaṃ tadā prāha tripāpastvaṃ sadāsi vai ||94|| kanyāstrīharaṇaṃ tvekaṃ cāṇḍālena niveśanam | mama bhojyādiharaṇaṃ triśaṃkustvaṃ tato mataḥ ||95|| viśvāmitrastu tapasā nivṛtto jñātavānidam | prasanno’bhūd varaṃ prādād devavat prasukhī bhava ||96|| atha vavre satyavratastriśaṃkuḥ puṇyavānapi | saśarīro vraje svargaṃ bhuktvā rājyamakaṇṭakam ||97|| trayyāruṇau mṛte rājye’bhyaṣicat taṃ triśaṃkukam | rājyaṃ kṛtvā yayau tena varṣmaṇā divameva saḥ ||98|| miṣatāṃ devatānāṃ ca vasiṣṭhasya ca kauśikaḥ | viśvāmitraḥ saśarīraṃ divamāropayannṛpam ||99|| saṃbhavo’saṃbhavasyāyaṃ tadadbhutamivābhavat | viśvāmitraprasādena triśaṃkurdivi rājate || 3.94.10 0|| pratāpo’yaṃ mahānāste sādhoḥ ṛṣestapasvinaḥ | tasmādvai sādhavaḥ sevyā uddharttāro hi pāpinām || 101 || tasya satyaratā bhāryā suṣuve haricandrakam | rohitastasya putraśca viśvāmitrakṛpālayāḥ || 1 02|| tāritā bahukaṣṭaiśca viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā | śāśvatakīrtayo loke kṛtāḥ strīputrabhūbhṛtaḥ || 1 03|| etatte kathitaṃ lakṣmi sādhorāśrayaṇe sadā | kalyāṇaṃ vividhaṃ cāpi jāyate mokṣaṇaṃ hyapi || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne paraśurāmāśrayeṇa siṃhāraṇyavāsināṃ sāgaramagnasya gokarṇatīrthasya punarlābhaḥ, uttaṃkarṣeḥ kṛpayā kuvalāśvasya dhundhumāratvam, viśvāmitrasya kṛpayā satyavratākhyatriśaṃkoḥ sadehasvargagāmitvamityādisādhupratāpavarṇananāmā caturnavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 94 ||
