<3.95> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca kiṃ japyaṃ sarvadā kānta bhāminībhiḥ svamuktaye | kaḥ pūjyaḥ ko namaskāryo vada me strīkṛpāvaśaḥ || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca bhāminībhiḥ sadā japyaṃ śrīkānteti sukhapradam | mama nāmottamaṃ nāma muktiṃ dadāmi tena vai || 2 || vidhavābhirhare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho pate | itijapyaṃ mama nāma punaḥ punaḥ svamuktaye || 3 || kanyakābhiḥ sadā japyaṃ rādhāvaretināma me | vṛddhābhiḥ sarvadā japyaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇeti vai || 4 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti japa uttamaḥ | sarvābhiḥ pramadābhiśca kartavyaḥ sarvasiddhaye || 5 || ahaṃ pūjyo namaskāryaḥ śrīkṛṣṇovallabhaḥ patiḥ | svarṇādipratimāyāṃ ca patyāvahaṃ pareśvara || 6 || śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca sarvadā mānavairyatra vrate mahotsave gṛhe | mandire devapūjāyāṃ śrāddhe pravāsane tathā || 7 || prasthāne vā praveśe vā vivāhe śubhakarmaṇi | gṛhāraṃbhe kṛṣikārye hyudyame vijayārthini || 8 || abhyudaye tathā svāsthye vaimanasye hyaniṣṭake | śubhāśubhādau kiṃ jāpyaṃ sveṣṭaphalādilabdhaye || 9 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca sarvatra lābhadaṃ śāntipuṣṭidaṃ bhayanāśanam | rakṣākaraṃ śatruvighnanāśakaṃ sādhusammatam || 3.95.1 0|| brahmaśaraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpavināśakam | yatra kvacijjapan dehī sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 11 || āyuṣmān bhavate cainaṃ śrīḥ samupaiti cottamā | akṣarabrahmaṇā sāmyaṃ dhāmni yanmamatuṣṭaye || 12|| muktānāṃ maṇḍalaiḥ sākaṃ vihitaṃ vāṅmayaṃ tadā | yadāhamagamaṃ sṛṣṭau tvayā sākaṃ tu padmaje || 1 3|| namaḥ śrīparameśāya namo’kṣarādhipāya ca | namo muktādhināthāya namo brahmapriyājuṣe || 14|| haripriyādipataye namo namo’vatāriṇe | namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya paramātmane ||15|| nama īśvaranāthāyeśvarīṇīsvāmine namaḥ | namo vyūhādhināthāya vaiṣṇavīsvāmine namaḥ || 16|| namo nārāyaṇīśāya śrīlakṣmīśāya te namaḥ | namo’ntaryāmiṇe vedanidhaye te namo namaḥ || 17|| namaḥ sahasraśīrṣāyāsaṃkhyanāmne ca te namaḥ | viṣṇave śaṃbhave’jāya trirūpāya ca te namaḥ ||18|| ādityebhyo namaścāpi vasubhyaśca namo namaḥ | aśvibhyāṃ ca namaḥ sarvasurebhyaśca namo namaḥ || 1 9|| yajñadevebhya evāpi kālāya mṛtyave namaḥ | viśvadevebhya evāpi pitṛbhyaśca namo namaḥ ||3.95.20 || siddhebhyaśca munibhyaśca sādhubhyaśca namo muhuḥ | gaṇeśvarebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pārṣadebhyo namo namaḥ ||21 || sādhvībhyaśca satībhyaśca devībhyaśca namo namaḥ | mātṛbhyaśca janakebhyo vṛddhebhyaśca namo namaḥ ||22|| viprebhyaḥ pūjyavargebhyastīrthebhyaśca namo namaḥ | kambharāyai mahālakṣmyai santuṣṭāyai namo namaḥ ||23|| māṇikyāyai prabhāvatyai prajñāyai ca namo namaḥ | lakṣmyai śriyai rādhikāyai kamalāyai namo namaḥ ||24|| śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇāya te mahāviṣṇave namaḥ | saptarṣibhyo mānavebhyo brāhmaṇebhyo namo namaḥ ||25|| camatkāripuruṣebhyaḥ sadgurubhyo namo namaḥ | dharmāya bhaktyai kṛṣṇāya haraye ca namo namaḥ ||26|| narāya tatpūrvajāya vṛṣajebhyo namo namaḥ | dikpālebhyaḥ samastebhyo lokapālebhya ānamaḥ || 27|| gurubhyo mokṣadebhyaśca śāntidebhyo namo namaḥ | pālakebhyaḥ pavitrebhyaḥ pāvanebhyo namo namaḥ ||28|| pāvakebhyaśca tattvebhyaścaiśvaryebhyo namo namaḥ | sarvābhyo brahmavidyābhyo muktidābhyo namo namaḥ ||29|| gurvībhyaḥ kāmadhenubhyaḥ sadbhyo muhurnamo namaḥ | tāpasebhyaḥ śīladharmibhyo yogibhyo namo namaḥ ||3.95.30 || sarvātmane’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te namaḥ | svataḥprakāśarūpāya mantrāṇāṃ nidhaye namaḥ ||3 1 || ete brahmasvarūpāstān kīrtayet kīrtivardhanān | avatārām̐stathā muktānīśvarān kīrtayet surān ||3 2|| śrīkṛṣṇaṃ paramaṃ brahma sarvaśāstraprabodhitam | maṃgalaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ pavitraṃ kīrtayeddhi mām ||33|| vyādhipraśamanaṃ siddhipradaṃ ca puṣṭidaṃ tathā | kalpaṃ sāyaṃ sadā rātrau kīrtayenmāṃ dine’niśam ||34|| ta ete devatāḥ sarvakāryasiddhipradā nṛṇām | rakṣanti cābhivarṣanti kāmān puṣṇanti kīrtitāḥ ||355|| ete tu nāyakāḥ sarve sākṣiṇaḥ karmaṇāmapi | kīrtitāste tatastuṣṭā vyapohantyaśubhaṃ nṛṇām ||36|| evaṃ kalpaṃ samutthāya namaskārān muhuścaret | nāgnicaurabhayaṃ tasya na mārgapratirodhanam ||37|| aśubhaṃ na bhavettasya śubhaṃ syādvai pade pade | duḥsvapno na bhavettasya svastimān syātkṣaṇe kṣaṇe ||38|| naśyanti sarvapāpāni supuṇyānyudbhavanti ca | naśyanti vyādhayo rogāḥ kule svastyayanaṃ caret || 39|| ātmanaśca sutānāṃ ca dārāṇāṃ ca kuṭumbinām | dhanānāmoṣadhīnāṃ ca rakṣāṃ brahmaśaraḥ kriyāt ||3.95.40|| raṇe naśyanti ripavo vijayaḥ syāt prapāṭhinaḥ | daive paitrye paṭhanīyaṃ tṛpyanti pitaraḥ surāḥ ||41|| kaṣmalaṃ dūrameva syānnairmalyaṃ ca bhavet sadā | pravāse śubhakārye ca brahmaśarasya pāṭhanāt ||42|| parā siddhirbhavet sveṣṭakāryāṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ | na ca rājabhayaṃ tasya śvāpadānāṃ bhayaṃ na ca ||43|| na bhayaṃ śatrutastasya piśācoragarakṣasām | nāgnyambupavanākāśād bhūkampād grahato bhayam ||44|| yatra brahmaśaraḥ stotraṃ duḥkhaṃ tato vilīyate | na tatra mriyate bālaḥ sampannāśo na jāyate ||45|| dhanaṃ śevadhiḥ paṭhato gāvo’sya bahuvatsikāḥ | etādṛśaṃ brahmaśarastotraṃ śaravad rakṣakam ||46|| tubhyaṃ lakṣmi samākhyātaṃ tathyaṃ brahma sanātanam | hṛdayaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ śrutirme vāk sanātanī ||47|| divaṃ yānti surān japtvā mahāviṣṇuṃ tathaiśvarān | lokān yānti prakīrtyātrāvatārān yānti dhāma ca ||48|| māmanādiṃ hariṃkṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prakīrtya tu | mamākṣarapadaṃ yānti lakṣmīṃ prakīrtya sampadaḥ ||49|| japtvā rādhāṃ tathāśvinau rūpaṃ yānti parottamam | dharmaṃ smṛtvā vṛṣaṃ yānti brahma smṛtvākṣayaṃ sukham ||3.95.5 0 || sādhūn smṛtvā paraṃ puṇyaṃ nairvighnyaṃ yānti sarvadā | japyaṃ brahmaśarastotraṃ sarvakāryārthasiddhaye ||5 1 || pūjanīyāḥ sādhavaśca sarvapāpopaśāntaye | sādhūnāṃ tu paribhavaḥ sādhayedapi ceśvarān ||52|| sādhujanān samprasādya kadācana na riṣyati | santaḥ pūjyā namaskāryāḥ sevanīyāḥ pareśavat ||53 || sādhujaneṣu satataṃ vartitavyaṃ tu dīnavat | santo lokānimān sarvān dhārayanti dayālavaḥ ||54|| bhaktiyuktā bhajanena rakṣanti śaraṇāgatān | santo vai bhagavadyogānmahānto dharmasetavaḥ ||55|| strīdhanatyāginaḥ santo vāṇīsaṃyamayoginaḥ | darśanīyāśca bhūtānāṃ śīlayuktā dhṛtavratāḥ ||56 || pramokṣakāśca lokānāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ pālakāstathā | lekhakā darśakāścāpi dharmodyamaparāyaṇāḥ ||57|| tapo bhaktirdhanaṃ yeṣāṃ śrīharirvipulaṃ balam | āśrayāḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ sādhavo divyadarśinaḥ ||58|| mokṣakāmāḥ sthitā bhaktau dharme ca dharmasetuṣu | yān samāśritya jīvanti prajāḥ sarvāśca dehinaḥ ||59|| sādhavo brahmasopānāḥ panthāno muktigāminām | yajñapuṇyapradātāro bhojanārthaṃ sanātanāḥ ||3.95.6 0 || pitṛdevoddhārakāśca havyakavyāgrabhojinaḥ | āśīrvādena lokām̐rstrīstrāyante māyikād bhayāt ||6 1 || sūryāḥ sarvapralokānāṃ netrāṇi netriṇāṃ tathā | sarvakathāśrūtidhanā nipuṇā mokṣadāyinaḥ ||62|| gatijñāḥ sarvasattvānāmadhyātmagaticintakāḥ | ārambhāntādiboddhāro gantāraḥ paramāṃ gatim ||63 || parāvarādivijñānā ātmabodhādiśobhanāḥ | vimuktāḥ pāparahitā dhūtapāpāśritālayāḥ ||64|| nirdvandvā bandhanahīnā arāgrā niṣparigrahāḥ | mānārhā mānitāḥ sadbhirmahātmabhiḥ pravaiṣṇavaiḥ ||65|| paṃke lepe candane ca samāmiṣṭe kaṭau rase | kṣaume’jine dukūle ca samā anaśane ratāḥ ||66|| śoṣayeyuśca gātrāṇi tapobhirvidyayā vrataiḥ | adaivataṃ prakuryuste sadaivataṃ dhanānvitam ||67|| lokānanyān sṛjeyuśca tapobalāddhi sādhavaḥ | viprāṇāmapi ye viprā devānāmapi devatāḥ ||68|| pramāṇānāṃ pramāṇāni sādhavaḥ śāstrabhūṣaṇāḥ | yeṣāṃ vṛddhaśca bālaśca nirdhano’pi dhanānvitaḥ ||69|| nārī vāpi naro vāpi samaṃ mānaṃ samarhati | tapovidyāviśeṣāttu paraṃ mānaṃ samarhati ||3.95.70|| avidvān brahmavidvān vai sādhuḥ pātraṃ mahatparam | vidvān sādhuḥ parabrahma pāvanaṃ pātramuttamam || 71 || avidvām̐ścaiva vidvām̐śca sādhurvai daivataṃ mahat | śmaśāne hyapi tejasvī pāvako naiva duṣyati ||72|| tathā saṃsāracakre vai sādhuḥ kvāpi na duṣyati | yajñe havirlihan vahniryathā sādhuḥ praśobhate |||73 || viprāṇāṃ tu sahasreṣu saṃbhujatsu mahādhvare | sādhorasattve vyarthaṃ syāt sādhurnārāyaṇo yataḥ ||74|| sādhavaḥ somasūryādiprapūjyā īśvareśvarāḥ | sādhūnāṃ vai prapūjāyāmāyuḥ kīrtiryaśo balam ||75|| bhaktirmuktirdaivataṃ ca vardhante’harniśaṃ sadā | lokālokeśvarāḥ sādhupūjakāḥ saṃbhavanti ha ||76|| dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu yaśaḥśrīrogaśāntiṣu | devatāpitṛpūjāsu santoṣyāḥ sādhavo’malāḥ ||77|| sādhavo hi mādhavāste loke cātra paratra ca | tārayeyurjagat sarvaṃ santuṣṭāḥ śrīpatiryathā ||78|| kaśyapasya gṛhe sādhurvaiṣṇavastāpaso yatiḥ | praṇadbrahmābhidhaścāsīnmānaso vedhasaḥ sutaḥ ||79|| śīlavrato jaṭī kṛśo mahaiśvaryādisiddhimān | mālājape’timagnaśca prāyo maunaparāyaṇaḥ ||3.95.80|| mārīcaḥ kaśyapastaṃ tu prātaḥ prasevate sadā | pādasaṃvāhanādyaiśca bhojyapānādikārpaṇaiḥ ||81 || sādhuścāyaṃ bhajan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hariṃ ca mām | dhyāne prāyo vartate vai mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ||82|| sa svairaṃ carate lokān divyān nāgāṃśca mānuṣān | punaścāyātyālayaṃ ca kaśyapasya mahātmanaḥ ||83|| praṇadbrahmaikadā prāha kaśyapaṃ māṃ prabhojaya | dugdhapākaṃ hyapūpām̐śca kaśyapastamabhojayat ||84|| praṇadbrahma tataḥ prāha kaśyapaṃ sevakaṃ munim | mamāṃgāni pralimpasva pāyasena muhurmuhuḥ ||85|| kaśyapaḥ kṛtavān sarvaṃ pāyasena vilepanam | asnāpayat pāyasena praṇadbrahmamahāmunim ||86|| athotthāya praṇadbrahmocchiṣṭena pāyasena tu | kaśyapasyānanaṃ mūrdhānaṃ cālepayadityapi ||87|| athāntike sthitāṃ dṛṣṭvā yuvatīmaditiṃ tathā | hastena samparigṛhyālimpata pāyasena tām ||88||| mukhe vakṣasi kaṭyāṃ ca sakthnoḥ pṛṣṭhe nitambayoḥ | vyasṛjacca tatastāṃ sa praṇadbrahma munīśvaraḥ ||89|| athāditiṃ punaḥ prāha pāyasānvitavigrahām | vaha skandhe nidhāyaiva māṃ bahiḥ sarvasannidhau ||3.95.90|| aditistaṃ nidhāyaiva skandhe yayau bahistadā | pallatābhistāḍayati munistāṃ bālayauvanām ||91 || sāpi sādhujanaṃ skandhe kṛtvā cacāra sarvataḥ | paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ cāyayau svagṛhaṃ pratiṃ ||92|| muniḥ sa rājamārgeṇa skandhasthaścāyayau gṛham | kaśyapasya stokamapi duḥkhaṃ nāsīnna cāditeḥ ||93|| gṛhe tvāgatya munirāṭ patito bhūtale drutam | skandhāttadā kaśyapaścāditistathānyayoṣitaḥ ||94|| paricaryā pracakruśca prasīda bhagavanniti | tataḥ sa munirāṭ svastho vilokya kaśyapaṃ tathā ||95|| aditiṃ prāha tuṣṭātmā devamātā bhaviṣyasi | jitakrodho bhavān yasmāt kaśyapo’sti tatastviha ||96|| pitā sarvaprajānāṃ tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ | tava vaṃśe sādhavaśca koṭyarbudā hi mādṛśāḥ ||97|| vaṃśoddhārakarāḥ sarve brahmadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ | bhaviṣyanti tathā dārayujo gṛhādimedhinaḥ ||98|| sarvavidhānyapatyāni bhaviṣyanti tavaiva ha | puṇyā kīrtistava nityā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||99|| tava vaṃśo hareścāpi prākaṭyāni punaḥ punaḥ | bhaviṣyanti hi lokānāmuddhārārthaṃ hi kaśyapa || 3.95.10 0|| na tvāṃ jarāṃ vā rogo vāditiṃ cāpi lagiṣyati | sarvastrīṇāṃ pradhānā tvamadite saṃbhaviṣyasi || 10 1|| eṣaiva te buddhirastu sādhūn prati sadā tava | ityuktvā virarāmāsau snātvā śuddho babhūva ha || 1 02|| prāhāmṛtaprabhoktāraḥ putrāste devatāḥ śubhāḥ | bhaviṣyanti pāyasānnaphalabhājaḥ sadādite || 1 03|| anyāsāṃ daivayogena prasādabhāginaḥ kvacit | bhaviṣyanti tava strīṇāṃ kaśyapatvaṃ sukhī bhava || 1 04|| sarvasmṛddhibhṛtānyeva gṛhāṇi kaśyapasya vai | bhavantviti muniḥ prāha tattathā tāni cābhavan || 1 05|| evaṃ lakṣmi praṇadbrahmasādhoścāśīrvacāṃsi vai | sevāśca saṃśayaśūnyāḥ phalitāḥ kaśyapasya ha || 1 06|| aditeḥ phalitāścāpi sādhoḥ sevā hariprasūḥ | devaprasūraditirvai jāyate nāparā muhuḥ || 1 07|| sādhoḥ sevāphalaṃ lakṣmi bhogamokṣapradaṃ bhavet | sarvasampatpradaṃ cāpi kāmanāpūrakaṃ bhavet || 1 08|| pūjyante satataṃ sarvaiḥ sādhavo devatādibhiḥ | mānavaiścāpi lokeśairdikpālaiśceśvarādibhiḥ || 1 09|| ekataḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sevanaṃ caikataḥ satām | satāṃ sevāphalasyāgre’nyāni nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 3.95.110|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya satāṃ sevāphalaṃ labhet | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheccāpi śāśvatānandabhāg bhavet || 111 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne pūjanīyanamaskaraṇīyasādhujanamāhātmye praṇadbrahmasādho rāśīrvādena sevayā ca kaśyapasyāditeśca devatā mātrapitṛtvādilabdhiritinirūpaṇanāmā pañca navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 95 ||
<3.96> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca santo harirbhavān dharmaḥ satī mokṣaśca sādhanam | bhaktiścetyādiṣu kānta pramāṇāni tu kāni vai || 1 || nahyapramāṇasaṃghuṣṭaṃ hṛdaye cādhyavasyati | tasmāt prāmāṇikaṃ kartuṃ pramāṇaṃ teṣu kiṃ matam || 2 || vada me lokanātha tvaṃ sarvavidyādiśevadhiḥ | yatra me saṃśayo na syāllokānāṃ tu hitāya vai || 3 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri pramāṇaṃ jyeṣṭhameva tu | pratyakṣaṃ svena yadvastu tvālocitaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 4 || paricayenendriyaiśca sākṣānnirṇāyakaṃ hi tat | santaḥ śīlavratā bhaktimanto nirvāsanāstathā || 5 || parīkṣaṇīyāḥ suptvāpi śayyāyāṃ śīladharmaṇi | sahavāsena bhaktau ca bhogadānena vāsane || 6 || parīkṣaṇīyāḥ santo vai sākṣānna tvanyathā kvacit | āliṃgane prayāse vā vikṛtiryasya naiva ha || 7 || śīlinaste mahāsanto nārāyaṇāḥ svayaṃ tviha | satataṃ bahudhāyāṃ tu bhaktau yasya śramo na vai || 8 || nartane gāyane sevādau ca lajjā na ruddhyati | bhaktimantaśca te sākṣād boddhavyāḥ sādhavaḥ śubhāḥ || 9 || bhogā bahuvidhā deyā ghaṭitānyāstu sādhave | na bhuṃkte nirmanāśca syāt sākṣāt sādhutvanirṇayaḥ || 3.96.10 || vāsanā rasanā liṅgaṃ parīkṣāviṣayādi vai | pratyakṣaṃ tu bhavettatra nirṇāyakaṃ hitāvaham || 1 1|| gatānugatikā vāṇī na vaktavyā kadācana | nānumānaṃ hi nirdoṣaṃ sadā saddhenumantarā || 12|| asaddhetusamāpannaṃ niścāyakaṃ na tadbhavet | harau kṛṣṇe mayi sākṣāccihnānāṃ darśanaṃ mama ||13|| hastayoḥ pādayoścāpi mūrtau cihnādidarśanam | pratyakṣaṃ tu bhagavattve pramāṇaṃ cātra kīrtitam || 14|| cihnānāṃ tu pramāṇaṃ vai śāstraṃ paramparāgatam | āptavākyātmakaṃ cāpi tanmūlaṃ vaidikaṃ tathā || 15|| vedāścāpi pramāṇaṃ vai yanmūrteścāyudhaṃ ca yat | likhitaṃ divyacakṣuṣkairdṛṣṭvā matpārśvavartibhiḥ || 16|| tadāyudhasya rekhā syāt kare yasya ca vā pade | sa eva bhagavān sa syānmānavādisvarūpadhṛk || 17|| yathāhaṃ matsyaśūlādyairasmi kare pracihnitaḥ | sākṣād divyasvarūpaśca koṭyabjaśrīramāpatiḥ || 18|| ṣoḍaśacihnavān varte pādayoścāpi varṣmaṇi | asaṃkhyacihnavānasmi sākṣāccakragadādimān || 1 9|| evaṃ pramāṇairboddhavyo bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ | dharmo lokavyavahārasaukhyārthaṃ pūjyamānavaiḥ ||3.96.20|| eṣā rītiḥ saraṇīyā cetyevaṃ niścitaḥ sa vai | dānaṃ paropakaraṇaṃ vivāhaḥ pararakṣaṇam ||21 || śuddhirnyāyārjanaṃ cāpi pūjanaṃ codyamastathā | ityevamādyā mārgāśca deśakālānusārataḥ ||22|| saukhyārthaṃ cāpyavighnārthaṃ niścito dharma eva saḥ | āptavākyaṃ cāptakarma dharmarūpaṃ prakāśate ||23|| satī sādhvī sadā bodhyā pātivrapyādisadvṛṣaiḥ | sahavāsena sā sahavāsinyā buddhyate sadā ||24|| satyaiśvaryāṇi śāstreṣu likhitāni bhavanti vai | camatkārāstathā yāsu dṛśyante tāḥ satīstriyaḥ ||25|| mokṣaścātmani riktatvaṃ kleśādyaiścātra buddhyate | sadā śāntiḥ sukhaṃ naijaṃ śāśvataśca tathā bhavet ||26 || ityevaṃ sukhalokānāṃ śāśvatānandadāyinām | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāpi mayāpi ca || 27|| akṣarādisthalānāṃ ca nivāsatvena cārjanam | mokṣaścaiva śāstrarītyā pratyakṣeṇāpi vai manāk ||2 8|| niścetavyaḥ sadā lakṣmi bhaktyā prāpyaḥ sa vai mataḥ | jñānamārgeṇa vā bhrāntināśe vijñamayī sthitiḥ ||29|| vijñeyā mokṣarūpā sā śāstraṃ tatra pramāṇakam | camatkārasamaṃ mānaṃ vidyate nāparaṃ priye |||3.96.3 0|| camatkāre namaskārastatra sarvaṃ vilumpati | pratyakṣamanumānaṃ vopamānaṃ śabda ityapi ||3 1|| arthāpattiścopalabdhiḥ saṃbhavaścetihāsanam | ceṣṭā maunaṃ cābhivittiḥ svapnaṃ daivaṃ ca mānasam || 32|| caturdaśāpi mānāni camatkāre layanti vai | tasmāt siddhisvarūpaṃ vai pramāṇaṃ balavattathā ||33|| pratyakṣaṃ siddhamevāpi siddhyānyathayate punaḥ | kā vārtā tatra cānyānāṃ pramāṇānāṃ tu padmaje ||34|| sādhujanān prasevasva lakṣmi satkṛtya mānataḥ | satsu bhuktistathā muktiḥ sadgatiḥ satsu sarvathā ||35|| harirdharmaśca bhaktiśca mokṣaḥ satsu pravartate | sādhutā ca satītā ca sarvaṃ satsu pravartate ||36|| jñānaṃ sevā mama bhaktirdānaṃ sarvavidhaṃ tathā | dharmā hyete sarvamūrddhanyāśca santoṣaṇānvitāḥ ||37|| sukhaṃ teṣu pramodaśca teṣvānandaḥ paro mataḥ | mokṣasteṣu hareryogaḥ sādhuṣveva bhavet priye ||38|| rajasā tamasā vyāptā nāstikāḥ sādhunindakāḥ | nirayaṃ pratipadyante sādhudharmādyasūyakāḥ ||39|| ye tu sādhūn sādhudharme sevāṃ sādhorupāsate | satyārjavaparāḥ santaste bhūtvā yānti matpadam ||3.96.40|| dharmabhaktirgatisteṣāṃ matsevopāsanād bhavet | bhaktimanto mama dhāma prayānti sādhavo hi te ||41 || puṇyamātrāḥ svargalokaṃ prayānti gṛhamedhinaḥ | sādhavaḥ śīlasampannāḥ śiṣṭācārā upāsakāḥ ||42|| pañcānāmaśanaṃ datvā śeṣamaśnanti sādhavaḥ | gāṃ devaṃ bhāskaraṃ sādhuṃ satīṃ guruṃ tapasvinam ||43|| vipraṃ vṛddhaṃ dhārmikaṃ ca ye kurvanti pradakṣiṇam | atithīnāṃ ca bhṛtyānāṃ kuṭumbināṃ ca yoṣitām ||44|| āśritānāṃ śaraṇe cāgatānāṃ rakṣakāśca ye | guroḥ sevāratāścāpi vṛddhānāṃ sevakāśca ye ||45|| sadā hyekāntaśīlāśca tīrthavāsā haripriyāḥ | jñānavantaśca santuṣṭāḥ sadā cātaḥ sukhabhṛtāḥ ||46|| vṛddhavacaḥprakartāraḥ svādhyāyaniratāstathā | nivṛttendriyaviṣayā vinā śrīpuruṣottamam ||47|| vyādhitānāṃ ca sarveṣāmāyuṣyādyabhinandinaḥ | tvaṃkāravācā rahitāḥ sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ ||48|| yathā lavaṇamambhobhirāplutaṃ pravilīyate | tathā sadbhyo’rpitaṃ pāpaṃ sarvaṃ sadyo vinaśyati ||49|| buddhaḥ pāpaṃ na gūheta gūhamānaṃ vivardhate | kṛtvā sādhuṣu cākhyeyaṃ te tatpraśamayanti hi ||3.96.50|| bhaktiyuktaṃ careddharmaṃ na dharmadhvajiko bhavet | dharmavāṇijakāḥ svargaṃ bhuktvā punaḥ patanti yat ||51 || arced devānadambhena sevetāmāyayā sataḥ | gurūnanusared bhaktyā mokṣārthaṃ dānamācaret ||52|| bhāgyaṃ samarjayed bhaktyā sevayā tapasā vrataiḥ | bhāgadheyaṃ tato vindetāyatno’pi vinā śramam ||53|| nālābhakāle labhate prayatne’pi kṛte sati | lābhakāle sataḥ prasevyārjayet tatparaṃ padam ||54|| kṛtaṃ kāle hyanākṛṣṭaṃ svayamāgatya tiṣṭhati | niṣphalā na bhavet sevāśīrvādaiḥ saha karhicit ||55|| adhītya nītiśāstrāṇi nītiyukto na ced yadi | adhītaṃ viphalaṃ tasya nirayāṇāṃ pradāyakam ||56|| samprāpya mānuṣaṃ janma kartavyārādhanā mama | yadi neha kriyāttāṃ cet kṛtamanyattu niṣphalam ||57|| vidyāyukto na cedvidyāmātmārth yojayetyapi | aśāntaḥ kṛtatṛṣṇaśca vidyā tasya hi niṣphalā ||58|| vidvān śānti parityajya vihāyātmapramokṣaṇam | lokadṛṣṭyā cedvahati niṣphalaṃ tasya jīvanam ||59|| idaṃ kṛtaṃ kariṣye’pi kurvanti rājasādayaḥ | sāttvikāścettathāmārgā niṣphalaṃ tatprajīvanam ||3.96.6 0|| paropakāraṃ lokebhyo darśayatyeva mānitam | svasamebhyaḥ śikṣayitvā vācayatyeva sadyaśaḥ ||61 || bhaktimārgaṃ na kurvanti dehikhyātiṃ gatāḥ khalāḥ | ta eva dharmahantāro bahirdṛśā na cāntare ||62|| yadi vidyāmupāśritya janaḥ śāntiṃ samaśnute | sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ phalaṃ tasya sampannaṃ nādhikaṃ tataḥ ||63|| na vidvān vidyayā hīnaṃ vṛttyarthamupasaṃśrayet | na vidvān dhanino mūḍhān stuvīta kṣudrakāmyayā ||64|| viduṣaḥ kṣudrakāmā na vidyā kṣudramaterna ca | nityasantoṣavān vidvān sādhurbrahmapramodavān ||65|| sādhuviduṣoḥ samatā santoṣe cātmadarśane | satye ca vacane bhaktau brahmiṣṭhatve pareśvare ||66|| athecchati samāraṃbhān sāhāyyaṃ cenna vindati | ugraṃ tapaḥ samāroheddhyanuptaṃ na prarohati ||67|| dattamāsādyate paścāt sevā smṛddhiṃ dadāti ca | adroheṇa ca dīrghāyurbhaktyā satāṃ paraṃ padam ||68|| sadbhyo dadyāttu vipulaṃ seveta satataṃ sataḥ | priyaṃ kuryād dehināṃ ca jayaṃ labdhvākṣaraṃ vrajet ||69|| kaṃjuṣo naiva yāceta daridreṣu vasenna ca | khalamaitrīṃ na vai kuryāt sādhūn seveta muktaye ||3.96.70|| sukhaṃ cātmasthitaṃ bhuñjyād dāyādaḥ syāt sadā hareḥ | putro bhavet satāṃ vaśyo mokṣamicchet pare’kṣare ||71|| satīḥ sādhvīrnamaskuryād bhajeta māṃ hariṃ prabhum | arpayet svasamastaṃ vai mayyeva matparāyaṇaḥ ||72|| anarpitaṃ vinaśyecca viphalaṃ cārjitaṃ śramāt | samarpya tadvidhāyaiva śāśvataṃ mokṣaṇe labhet ||73|| dānaṃ dharmasya śānteśca pramodasyotsavasya ca | ānandasya ca kartavyaṃ cāmṛtasyāpi labdhaye ||74|| sevādānaṃ prakartavyaṃ sampadāmapi sarvathā | gṛhakuṭumbadānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ tattadāptaye ||75|| satkārye cāśvasītaiva nāsatkārye kadācana | dharmabuddhāvāśvasīta pravarteta drutaṃ tadā ||76|| dharmaḥ śīghraṃ tvācarito bhaktau manaḥ pravartayet | bhaktiṃ kurvannavāpnoti putraṃ māṃ parameśvaram ||77|| evamevātmanātmānaṃ prāpayanti hi dhārmikāḥ | paramātmārjanaṃ syādvai dharmo vai vijayapradaḥ ||78|| pañcabhūtaśarīrāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ sadṛśātmanām | yatra dharmo dhruvo naijastatrāhaṃ niyato hariḥ ||79|| sarveṣāṃ tulyabhāvānāṃ dehināṃ dharmavartmanām| bhaktiḥ sevā mokṣadātryau guroḥ sataḥ piturhareḥ ||3.96.8 0 || sādhuvaṃśasya sevā vai śreyaḥ paramamucyate | vipāpmā ca bhavettadvat sukhameti prasevanāt ||8 1 || kalmaṣāṇāṃ nāśakaṃ vai sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ śubham | ahotpannaṃ varṣmaṇā vendriyaiḥ pāpaṃ tathāntaraiḥ ||82 || jñātvājñātvāpi sarvaṃ tallīyate sādhusevayā | rātrau sandhyādikāle vā jātaṃ japato naśyati ||83 || sādhusevā japo me ca kurvāte svastiyoginam | tiryagyonirvinaśyedvai narakaṃ saṃkarādikam ||84|| na bhayaṃ na maraṇaṃ cākasmikaṃ satprasevayā | sarvagurustvanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’smyaham ||85 || sarvaprāṇaścāntarātmātmanāṃ patiḥ pareśvaraḥ | smaraṇīyaḥ sadā lakṣmi tathāvatārakoṭayaḥ ||86|| mahāviṣṇurvāsudevo nārāyaṇo’pi viśvasṛṭ | viṣṇuḥ śivaḥ satī lakṣmīḥ rādhā sūryaśca candramāḥ ||87|| smaraṇīyā naranārāyaṇau tatpārṣadā api | yamo dhūmorṇayā sākaṃ gauryā sākaṃ jaleśvaraḥ ||88 || ṛddhyā dhaneśvaraścāpi gauḥ surabhirmarudgaṇaḥ | vālakhilyāḥ ṛṣayaśca nāradādyā maharṣayaḥ ||89|| urvaśī śrīhareḥ putrī smaraṇīyā prage sadā | ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sāśvinaḥ pitaro’pi ca || 3.96.90 || dharmaḥ śrutaṃ tapo dīkṣā bhaktirbṛhaspatistathā | aśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi prabhāsaṃ gomatī tathā ||9 1 || gaṃgā revā gaṇḍakī ca yamī sarayūrgauttamī | nārāyaṇī cendratoyā brahmaputrī hiraṇvatī ||92|| puṣkaraṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca saraścāpi sarasvatī | merurhimālayo vindhya uralo raivatastathā || 93 || mahendro malayaḥ sahyo gandhanamādana ityapi | samudrāścāpi tattvāni smaraṇīyāni sarvadā || 94|| pāntu sarve divyadevāḥ kīrtitākīrtitā api | pāntu sarve sādhavaśca sādhvyaḥ pāntu sadā tu mām || 95 || kambharāśrīḥ sadā pātu pātu gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ | pātu māṃ pārvatī devī prajñā pātu ca rādhikā || 96|| brahmapriyāḥ sadā pāntu haripriyāḥ prapāntu ca | bhagavām̐śca śukaścāpi vallabhaśca prapāntu mām || 97|| patnīvrato brāhmaṇarṣiḥ svataḥprakāśa īśvaraḥ | lomaśaśca gururvṛddhaḥ sarve pāntu sadā tu mām || 98|| kuṃkumavāpikā devī kṣetraṃ cākṣarasaṃjñakam | sādhulālāyanādyāśca pāntu māṃ parameśvarāḥ ||99|| ityevaṃ kīrtayānaśca mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ | stuvam̐śca pratinandam̐śca mucyate sarvatobhayāt || 3.96.1 00|| mamāśritānāṃ sādhūnāṃ saṃhitāgaditātmanām | līlāḥ smṛtvā labhante vai paraṃ padaṃ mamākṣaram || 101 || madāśritānāṃ nārīṇāṃ sādhvīnāṃ brahmayoṣitām | smṛtvā divyacamatkārān labhante paramaṃ padam ||1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne śrīharisatpuruṣadharmasatījanamokṣasādhanabhaktyādiṣu pramāṇānāṃ gatiḥ sādhūnāṃ samāgamo balavatpramāṇaṃ camatkāro balavattamaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṇṇavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 96 ||
<3.97> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca kiṃ kartavyaṃ mānavena lokavyāyāmaśālinā | dehayātrāṃ lokayātrāṃ kiṃdharmaḥ san vibhāvayet || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca drohaṃ vihāya stainyaṃ ca tyaktvā vyavāyamityapi | tyaktvā kāyena pāpāni śreṣṭhaṃ sarvaṃ samācaret| || 2 || grāmyavārtā ca pāruṣyaṃ paiśūnyaṃ ca mṛṣāvacaḥ | vācā catvāri santyajya satyaṃ saṃvyāharet sadā || 3 || parasvānāmanākāṃkṣāṃ sarvadehiṣu mitratām | karmaphalādāvāstikyaṃ manasā dhārayet sadā || 4 || vāsanā nodbhāvayecca tṛṣṇāṃ tyajet parigraham | bhayadaṃ ca vihāyaivātmanā sādhuṃ samāśrayet || 5 || sarvasvārpaṇamāsādya navadhābhaktimācaret | premṇā dhyānena māṃ labdhvā vrajettu paramaṃ padam || 6|| evaṃ sadācarecchreṣṭhaṃ śubhaṃ hitaṃ ca satphalam | aśubhaṃ viparītaṃ ca nācarettu kadācana || 7 || mātuḥ sevāṃ pituḥ sevāṃ patyuḥ sevāṃ striyāstathā | guroḥ sevāṃ gavāṃ sevāṃ kuryād vṛddhasya sevanam || 8 || devasevāṃ satāṃ sevāṃ satīsevāṃ samācaret | ātithyaṃ ca paropakārādikaṃ cācaret sadā || 9 || bhajanaṃ me prakuryācca dīnasevāṃ samācaret | lokasevāṃ rāṣṭrasevāṃ prajāsevāṃ samācaret || 3.97.1 0|| tīrthasevāṃ brahmasevāṃ mokṣasevāṃ samācaret | śṛṇu lakṣmi purā tīrthaṃ prasevya sādhumaṇḍalam || 11 || ālambāyanasaṃjñaśca maharṣirmokṣamāptavān | siṃhāraṇye mahātīrthe gokarṇe ṛṣirāṭ svayam || 1 2|| lakṣavarṣāṇyavasat saḥ sādhūnāṃ sevayā sukhī | daśavarṣo’bhavad yāvattāvat saurāṣṭradeśajaḥ || 1 3|| keśariṇīṃ nijāṃ natvā prasūṃ prāha sa bālakaḥ | mātarme jāyate cecchā satāṃ samāgame muhuḥ || 14|| anityaḥ khalu saṃsāro mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ tathā | harerbhaktirdurlabhā ca durlabhaḥ satsamāgamaḥ || 15|| gṛhaṃ ca vāṭikā patnī bāndhavāśca dhanānyapi | gāvo bhṛtyāśca sulabhāḥ paraṃ bandhanakāriṇaḥ ||16|| durlabhāḥ sādhavo bhaktirnārāyaṇāśrayastathā | mokṣo’pi durlabho mātaḥ sādhayettān pumān budhaḥ || 17|| evaṃ me vartate buddhiryathā śādhi karomi tat | mātā prāha sutaṃ dhanyo vartase tvaṃ hi devatā || 18|| ābālyātte tu saṃkalpā vivekasaṃbhṛtāḥ suta | dhanyāhaṃ jananī te’pi pitā dhanyo’pi te suta || 19|| yatputro bhagavadbhaktiṃ kartumicchasi sevanam | satāṃ mokṣamavāptuṃ ca matiste dhanyapātriṇī ||3.97.20 || adya putra samākarṇya pārameśvaramuttamam | vivekaṃ te bahupuṇyā bhavāmi mokṣakāṃkṣiṇaḥ ||2 1 || saṃkalpāste bhavantyeva pūrṇā bhaktau hareḥ śubhāḥ | sevāyāṃ ca satāṃ putra nairvighnyaṃ te sadāstu ca || 22|| bālyakrīḍādikaṃ tyaktvā tyaktvā yuvatvakalpanām | rāgādikamanādṛtya mokṣe buddhistavāsti yat ||23|| prasannāhaṃ mama putra tārako’si kuṭumbinām | mānuṣaṃ janma mokṣārthaṃ tadanyāni bhavābdhaye ||24|| bhavābdhidāni santyajya saphalīkuru mānavam | vinivedya janakāya labdhvājñāṃ pāragāminīm ||25|| yāhi cāpunarāvṛttilābhāya satpadālayam | yatra te sādhavo dhīrā śrūyante brahmapāragāḥ ||26 || nirguṇā brahmaguṇakā mokṣadā yāhi tatra vai | smara mā māṃ prasūṃ kvāpi pitaraṃ bāndhavān gṛham ||27|| bandhanāni vicitrāṇi janmabhuvaṃ sakhīṃstathā | mā smara viṣayān putra mā dhyānaṃ dehi laukike ||28|| mā pravāhe rasānāṃ cāsvādānāṃ pata karhicit | mā prasaṃgaṃ viṣayāṇāṃ kvāpi te putra jāyatām ||29|| mokṣamārgaśca te putra nirvighno’ntaṃ pravartatām | mānavasya tu dehasya satsevāyāṃ samarpaṇam ||3.97.30|| sadaiva kuru putra tvaṃ niḥśreyaḥ śubhamāpnuyāḥ | ante nārāyaṇaprāptiste’stu dhāmni nivāsitā ||3 1 || pitaraṃ brahmatāraṃ te pṛṣṭvā yāhi śubhaṃ kuru | ityuktvā putramūrdhānamajighrad dhanyamānasā ||32|| bhojanaṃ kārayāmāsa dhairyaṃ cograṃ dadau prasūḥ | tyāgāśramārthaṃ putrāyāpreṣayat pitaraṃ prati ||33|| putro yayau tu pitaraṃ sukhāsīnaṃ nanāma ca | sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa brahmatārāya yogine ||34|| brahmatāro’pi vipro vai prāha putraṃ śubhātmakam | aho dhanyo’smi satataṃ yadgṛhe putra īdṛśaḥ ||35|| bhagavadbhaktitānaśca sādhusatsaṃgamānasaḥ | abhogo bhogakāmādirahito bālyataḥ śubhaḥ ||36|| pūrvapuṇyena vai putro jāyate bhaktimān vratī | sādhurvirāgavām̐ścāpi naiṣṭhikaścaurdhvaśīlavān ||37|| bhaja putra hariṃ nityaṃ prasevaya satojanān | gokarṇe tīrthake gatvātmānaṃ mokṣe niveśaya ||38|| saphalaṃ śreṣṭhaphalakaṃ mānavaṃ varṣma saṃkuru | putravānasmi putreṇa tvādṛśena suyoginā ||39|| śatajanmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ yadodeti tadā bhavet | jijñāsā mokṣamārge vai sādhusevāpathe’pi ca ||3.97.40|| bandhanaṃ tu dṛḍhaṃ sevātmakaṃ kuṭumbibandhuṣu | chitvā śūro bhavet kaścinmokṣasaṃgarasaṃplutaḥ ||41 || kīṭe pataṃgake deve dānave mānave khage | sarīsṛpe paśau siddhe ṛṣau bhogāḥ samāḥ khalu ||42|| ta eva vārijāḥ kledā bhautikāste prabhojanāḥ | indriyāṇi samānāni prāṇāstulyāśca vāyujāḥ ||43|| divasāśca samānā vai prayānti dehināṃ tathā | nidrālavo yatante na mokṣārthaṃ daivavarjitāḥ ||44|| nirayārthāsta evātra paratra santi nirmitāḥ | mokṣaḥ pumartha ātmārtho’nye dehārthā na muktaye ||45|| trirāśīn yaḥ samuttīryottare tūrye viśettu vai | sa eva deva evātra ceśvaraḥ so’pi muktarāṭ ||46|| sa eva kṛtakṛtyo’sti sādhurevāsti so’pi ca | nārāyaṇaḥ sa evāsti tārako gurureva saḥ ||47|| durjayaṃ kāmasaṃkalpaṃ durjeyaṃ strīdhanādikam | durjeyaṃ mānasaṃ svasya durjayā vāsanā tathā ||48|| tṛṣṇā cāpi ca durjeyā jitā tvayā kṛtātmanā | jitaṃ yenātra śiśnaṃ ca rasanā yena sañjitā ||49|| manorājo jito yena sarvaṃ jitaṃ jitātmanā | prāpnuhi vijayaṃ putrāsāre māyāmaye drutam ||3.97.50|| prāpnuhi vijayaṃ pare brahmaṇyapi sanātane | śreyaste’stu śubhaṃ te’stu pramodaste’stu sūtsavaḥ ||51 || śāśvatānandamagnaśca bhava mukto hareḥ pade | tvāṃ dṛkṣyāmyakṣare dhāmni yuktamaṇḍalamadhyagaḥ ||52||| patnīyuto hi tvāṃ putra nārāyaṇasvarūpiṇam | ityuktaḥ kṛtatilakaḥ kṛtasnehaḥ suto’pi ca ||53|| natvā pitroḥ pādajalaṃ pītvā kṛtvā ca maṃgalam | bhrātṛśataṃ tathā natvā yayau gokarṇatīrthakam ||54|| hare kṛṣṇa hare viṣṇo hare kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa | hare rādhāpate lakṣmīpate hare hare prabho ||55|| ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ kurvan karatālena vai tataḥ | padbhyāṃ yayau jālikātaḥ somanāthaṃ sutīrthakam ||56|| bhavanāthaṃ śarabhaṃ ca satītīrthaṃ tato yayau | tatastīrthaṃ ca gokarṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ pupūja sādaram ||57|| divyakarṇābhidhaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ natvā tato yayau | svargalakṣmīmahātīrthaṃ tato brāhmīṃ mahānadīm ||58|| tato gokarṇaśaṃbhuṃ ca ṛṣivāsām̐stato yayau | nārikeladrumāṇāṃ sa vane vāsaṃ tato’karot ||59|| ārādhanāṃ hareścakre sādhusevāṃ cakāra saḥ | japaṃ cakāra me nāmnāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho ||3.97.60 || bhajanaṃ pracakāraivaṃ satataṃ māṃ smaram̐stathā | satāṃ bhikṣānnalābhena dehayātrāṃ nyavartayat ||61 || navāyutasamāścāsīdbhikṣānnaparipoṣakaḥ | tataḥ sahasravarṣāṇi kandamūlāśano’bhavat ||62|| pañcasāhasravarṣāṇi tataḥ śuṣkadalāśanaḥ | athābhavattato vāyvāhāro’tiṣṭhat samādhigaḥ ||63|| ātmānamātmani dhyāyan yuyuje paramātmanā | lakṣavarṣe prayāte tu sampūrṇe cāmbarāttataḥ ||64|| viṣṇorvimānamāyātaṃ pārṣadairdivyaśobhanaiḥ | sahitaṃ tadvilokyāyamālambāyanasādhurāṭ ||65|| vihāya bhautikaṃ tūrṇaṃ divyadeho’bhavattadā | caturbhujaḥ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmādicihnakaḥ ||66 || viṣṇoḥ pārṣadavaryaśca natvā ṛṣigaṇān muniḥ | yayau dhāma harekṛṣṇa vadan vismāpayan janān ||67|| atha prayāṇe ṛṣayaścāstuvan taṃ munīśvaram | asmānnaya mahābhakta dhāma vaikuṇṭhamuttamam ||68|| sa cāha ṛṣayaḥ sarve sajjā bhavantu satvaram | gatvā vaikuṇṭhamevāhaṃ cāgacchāmi vimānakaiḥ ||69|| sahito bhavato netuṃ pṛṣṭvā viṣṇuṃ narāyaṇam | omityuktaśca ṛṣibhiryayau tūrṇaṃ harergṛham ||3.97.70|| pārṣadaiḥ satkṛtaścāyaṃ vimānādavatāritaḥ | vaikuṇṭhe divyasaudhāgrye nyāviśat saudhamuttamam ||71 || adṛṣṭvā śrīhariṃ saudhe tūrṇaṃ viniryayau bahiḥ | mārgayāmāsa taṃ saudhaṃ yatrāste śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ||72|| gatvā kṛtvā daṇḍavacca pūjāṃ cakāra vai hṛdā | jaya nārāyaṇakṛṣṇetyuvācāpi punaḥpunaḥ ||73|| netrāśrūṇi mumocāpi gadgadaścābhavatkṣaṇam | papāta pādayorviṣṇoḥ papau pādāmṛtaṃ tataḥ ||74|| svāgatena hariṇāsau pṛṣṭo jagāda hṛdgatam | kṛpayā te prabho prāptaścaraṇau śāśvatau mudā ||75|| gokarṇe nivasantaśca munayo ye tapodhanāḥ | prayāṇakāle māmāhuḥ sahayānāya dhāma te ||76|| mayā tvabhihitaṃ cāste gatvā tvāyāmi sarvathā | ājñāṃ hareḥ samādāya sajjā bhavantu sarvaśaḥ ||77|| ityuktāste pratīkṣante vaikuṇṭhāgamanaṃ prati | yadyājñā te bhaved yāmi cānayāmi tavāntikam ||78|| nārāyaṇastadā prāha yogyaṃ bhakta tvayā kṛtam | paraṃ nibodha me kiñcit sārāt sārataraṃ param ||79|| mama bhaktiṃ vinā syānna vāso vaikuṇṭhake mama | gokarṇe santi ṛṣayastapodravyāstapaḥpriyāḥ ||3.97.80|| manonigrahavantaścendriyanigrahiṇastathā | ātmamātraratā nityaṃ jñānamātraparāyaṇāḥ ||81 || vratamātraparāścāti bahavo rāgavarjitāḥ | yogakriyāparāścāpi śuṣkatapasivartinaḥ ||82|| mama bhaktivihīnāste vinā vai madupāsanam | kathamarhā bhaveyuścāgamārthaṃ mama dhāma te ||83|| abhaktānāṃ na vaikuṇṭhaṃ yadyapi tapatāṃ sadā | karmaṭhānāṃ na vaikuṇṭhaṃ hyanārādhanavedinām ||84|| mama dhāmāgame hetuḥ snehabhaktiḥ sadā mama | mama bhaktasya vai sevā mayi cātmaniveditā ||85|| dhyānaṃ me bhajanaṃ cāpi kīrtanaṃ satataṃ mama | tapasāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca dānānāṃ mayi cārpaṇam ||86|| sarvakarmārpaṇaṃ cāpi dīkṣāyā grahaṇaṃ mama | mama mantrasya divyasya grahaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ tathā ||87|| mamārādhanamevāpi vaikuṇṭhāgamane yataḥ | apakvā ye yoginaste tapanti cirakālinaḥ ||88|| daśalakṣasamāḥ kecit kecillakṣasamāstathā | anye bahuyugāḥ santi sahasraśaścirāyuṣaḥ ||89|| yāhi tebhyaḥ pradehyenaṃ mantraṃ mokṣapradaṃ mama | dīkṣāṃ datvā nāmasatraṃ pravartaya mahāmakham ||3.97.90|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo me śaraṇaṃ patiḥ | mantrametaṃ pradatvātha dīkṣāṃ dehi prasāttvikīm || 91 || kaṇṭhe tu taulasīṃ kaṇṭhīṃ mālāṃ ca japamālikām | tilakaṃ candrakaṃ cāpi cakrādyaṃkanamityapi ||92|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama | rādhālakṣmīpate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa vibho prabho ||93|| evaṃ satataṃ sādhūnāṃ kīrtanaṃ samprakāraya | divāniśaṃ mahāyajñaṃ tatra tiṣṭhantu dīkṣitāḥ ||94|| yeṣāmārādhanā pūrṇā bhaktiḥ pūrṇā bhaviṣyati | tānahaṃ nityadā naijavimānena suvarcasā || 95|| samāneṣye hi vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāhi satraṃ pravartaya | ityukto bhaktarāṭ natvālambāyano hi pārṣadaḥ ||96|| āyayau divyadehena vimānena purālayam | gokarṇaṃ tejasā tūrṇaṃ prakāśitaṃ tadābhavat ||97|| dudruvuḥ saṃbhramayuktāḥ ṛṣayastaṃ tu pārṣadam | sajjībhūtān sato natvādideśa viṣṇubhāṣitam ||98|| nāmasaṃkīrtanasatraṃ kurvantvatra sudīkṣitāḥ | ṛṣayo’pi tathā cakrurvaikuṇṭhalabdhaye śubhāḥ ||99|| vividuste ca māhātmyaṃ bhakteḥ śreṣṭhaṃ tapobalāt | bhaktā bhūtvā dīkṣitāśca labdhvā te japamālikām || 3.97.1 00|| savādyakīrtanaṃ cakrurdivāniśaṃ hi muktaye | lakṣaśo munayaścāpi prajālokāstathāpare || 10 1|| śrutvā tatkīrtanaṃ tatra militvā bhajanaṃ vyadhuḥ | tattīrthaṃ vaikuṇṭhasatranāmnā khyātiṃ gataṃ tataḥ ||1 0 2|| māsānte ye bhaktipakvā jātāsteṣāṃ kṛte hariḥ | āyayau svavimānena lakṣmīśrīsahitaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 03|| ninye sahasrasādhūm̐śca vaikuṇṭhe parameśvaraḥ | evaṃ māsāntarānte ca trimāsānte’pi kām̐ścana || 1 04|| catuṣpaṃcādimāsānte ninye lakṣajanān hariḥ | pakvāḥ pakvāḥ prabhūtvā ca ṛṣayo yānti dhāma te || 105|| gokarṇasthāḥ sādhavaste varṣānte sarvaśo gatāḥ | vaikuṇṭhaṃ paramaṃ dhāma mahāścaryamabhūddhi tat || 1 06|| nāmasatraṃ samārabhya devādyā mānavāstataḥ | gokarṇe tīrthake yānti vaikuṇṭhaṃ parameśvaram || 1 07|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi bhaktimāhātmyamuttamam | sādhoḥ saṃgena bhagavān kārayitvā tu kīrtanam || 1 08|| pāvayitvā tāpasām̐śca ninye dhāmottamaṃ nijam | varṣānte sādhurevāyaṃ nāmasatraṃ samāpya ca || 10 9|| yayau dhāma harerdivyadeho divyavimānagaḥ | koṭiśaḥ sādhavastatra siṃhāraṇye tato’bhavan || 3.97.110 || viṣṇudhāmasamaṃ dhāma gokarṇaṃ tadabhūnmahat | evaṃ lakṣmi satāṃ sevā phalatyeva cireṇa ha || 111 || satsaṃgo’pi phalatyeva cireṇāpi nṛjanmanām | tasmāt satāṃ susatsaṃgaḥ kartavyaḥ phalado bhavet || 11 2|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇānmuktido’pi ca | satsaṃgayogo bhavati lakṣmi śāśvatamokṣadaḥ || 11 3|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne lokavyāyāmaśālibhirapi satsaṃgena muktirlabhyate tāpasairapi tathetyarthe ālambāyanasādhoḥ saṃgena lakṣādhilakṣamānavānāṃ gokarṇe muktiprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 97 ||
<3.98> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca mahatyāpadgatasyāpi yathoddhāro drutaṃ bhavet | tathā me darśaya kṛṣṇakānta lokahitāya vai || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca praṇamāmi sadā sadbhyo yeṣāṃ brahmaparaṃ dhanam | yeṣāṃ karatale svargo mokṣo’pi vacane sthitaḥ || 2 || ye bālā vā yuvāno vā vṛddhā vā sādhavo’malāḥ | udvahanti harerbhakterdhuraṃ namāmi tānaham || 3 || brahmavidyāsu niṣṇātā vinītā vaśamānasāḥ | brahmabhāṣāḥ śrutavanto vratinaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ || 4 || akṣarabrahmarūpāṇāṃ saṃsatsu brahāvādinaḥ | māṃgalyarūpā rucirā ye tānnamāmi sajjanān || 5 || ye teṣāmapi saṃsevyā brahmasadasi cāgragāḥ | vijñānadhyānasampannāstebhyo’dhispṛhayāmyaham || 6 || satsu śuśrūṣamāṇeṣu pretya ceha sukhaṃ mahat | sarvāpadāṃ vināśaśca ta uddhārakarāḥ śubhāḥ || 7 || susaṃskṛtāni cānnāni śītāni salilāni ca | ramyāṇi cāmbarāṇyebhyo dātavyāni sadā rame || 8 || dhanyaḥ syād yaḥ sādhukule janma labheta puṇyavān | bhaved yaścottare kāle koṭidehipramokṣadaḥ || 9 || na me tvattaḥ priyatarā lakṣmi kāpi bhuvastale | brahmapriyāḥ priyāḥ sarvāḥ santa priyatamā mama || 3.98.1 0|| na me pitarau kamale tathā priyatarau tviha | yathā me sādhavaḥ śāntāḥ priyottamottamāḥ sadā || 1 1|| mahatyāpadgatasyāpi sādhavo’tra śubhāvahāḥ | bhajanīyāḥ pūjanīyāḥ surāṇāmapi devatāḥ || 12|| sāttvataśceti māṃ lokāḥ prāhustuṣyāmi tena ca | satāṃ yogena sādhvīśaṃ māmāhurbhaktikāriṇaḥ || 13|| yathā bhartrāśrayo dharmo nārīṇāṃ vidyate tathā | sarveṣāṃ tu sadācāraḥ sādhvāśrayo vṛṣo mataḥ || 14|| viprakṣatraviśāṃ cāpi sādhavo guravo matāḥ | devavat kṛṣṇavat pūjyāḥ sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ || 15|| agnivat sevanīyāste brāhmaṇaiḥ sādhavo’malāḥ | sādhūnāṃ sevanaistiṣṭhed brāhmaṇyaṃ sarvapāvanam ||16|| patyabhāve yathā nārī devaraṃ kurute patim | prajāstathā sādhvabhāve pratimāṃ kurute prabhum || 17|| ṛjūn sataḥ satyaśīlān sarvaprāṇihite ratān | suhṛdaḥ sarvajīvānāṃ sādhūn paricaret sadā || 18|| rājā svajanakaṃ yadvad rakṣet sāghujanaṃ tathā | āśrame cānvavekṣeta kiṃsvidastīti jīvanam || 19|| brahmiṣṭhān brahma ca tathā sarvathā pālayed dhanī | bhikṣātṛptasatāmāśīrvādānāsādayeddhanī ||3.98.20|| pratiśrutya na dātavyaṃ tadeva narakaṃ mahat | āśāhanturhi yatpāpaṃ sarvasukṛtanāśakam ||21 || hutaṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ cāśāhanturvihanyate | āśādānaṃ tvaśvamedhayajñapuṇyaṃ karoti vai| ||22|| āśāpūrtirviṣṇuyāgasahasraphaladā bhavet | tasmādāśāṃ pradāyaitāṃ pūrayecca yathābalam ||23|| ekadā śvapacagṛdhrau śmaśāne militau tadā | gṛdhraṃ parāsuṃ khādantaṃ papraccha śvapacaḥ śanaiḥ ||24|| kiṃ tvayā vai kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yadaśnāsi prapūtikam | kutsitaṃ mṛtakaṃ cātidurgandhaṃ kleditaṃ tviha ||25|| gṛdhraḥ prāha purā cāhamabhūvaṃ lobhavān dhanī | pratiśrutyāpi ca dadau naiva vāpūrṇameva vā | tena pāpena saṃjāto gṛdhraścātra śmaśānagaḥ ||26|| tasmādevaṃ cātiduṣṭaṃ bhakṣayāmi bubhukṣitaḥ | paraṃ te śvāpacaṃ janma kathaṃ jātaṃ nu me vada ||27|| śvapaca prāha pūrve’haṃ dhanadhānyayuto’pi san | sādhūnāṃ nindakaścāsaṃ brāhmaṇo’pi ghṛṇī sati |||28|| dṛṣṭvā sādhūn dhikkaromi tiraskaromi narma ca | na dadāmi kvacid bhikṣāṃ vārayāmi paraṃ hyapi ||29|| tena pāpena sarvasvaṃ gṛhadārasutādikam | naṣṭaṃ vahniprakopena dagdhaṃ dagdho’hamityataḥ ||3.98.3 0|| yamalokaṃ gatastatra yāmyairandhatamisrake | nikṣiptau bahuvarṣāṇi niṣkāsya netrajihvike ||3 1|| athāhamabhavaṃ vāgurikā viṣṭāmukhī tataḥ | sarpo’hamabhavaṃ paścād ghūkastato’tha godhikā ||3 2|| tato’smi jātaścāṇḍālaḥ sādhūnāṃ nindanāt khalu | tasmānna sādhavaḥ kvāpi tiraskāryā hareḥ priyāḥ ||33|| bhikṣā naiṣāṃ vāraṇīyā dānaṃ vāryaṃ na vai kvacit | teṣāṃ vastu na hartavyaṃ deyaṃ teṣāṃ tu tuṣṭaye ||34|| brahmiṣṭhaiḥ sādhubhiḥ sākaṃ sādhvībhiśca tathā janaiḥ | samaṃ vivādo moktavyo dātavyaṃ ca pratiśrutam ||35|| na kāryaṃ nindanaṃ teṣāṃ śravaṇīyaṃ na karhicit | vipratvasya na vai garvaḥ kartavyaḥ sannidhau satām ||36|| viprā ye gṛhiṇaste tu strīśmaśānaprasevinaḥ | sādhubhyo nimnamārgasthā vipraiḥ pūjyā hi sādhavaḥ ||37|| ye mūtraklinnasaṃsaktāste vai nirayagāminaḥ | tānuddhartuṃ samarthāste sādhavaḥ śīlayoginaḥ ||38|| na stenastārayet stenamasteno yaḥ sa tārayet | na kāmī tārayet kāmādakāmastārayed ratam ||39|| na hartavyaṃ sādhuvastu kṣantavyaṃ teṣu nityaśaḥ | bālāśca nāvamantavyāḥ kṛpaṇā vāpyaśaktayaḥ ||3.98.40|| āśā kāryā na satataṃ sādhubhyaḥ svārthasādhikā | naiva sādhūn niyuñjīta bhṛtyavad bhojanāptaye ||41 || jalāptaye tathā khaṣṭvāgendukādyupalabdhaye | āsanārthaṃ ca vāsārthaṃ cāśrayārthaṃ ca mandire ||42|| nāyāse yojayet sādhuṃ yataḥ puṇyaṃ vinaśyati | sādhuvāse gṛhasthairvai vastavyaṃ nahi karhicit ||43|| satsaṃgārthaṃ pragantavyaṃ kleśārthaṃ nahi karhicit | nidrārthaṃ malamūtrādityāgārthaṃ vā sadāśrame ||44|| gantavyaṃ naiva naijīyāṃgikakāryanivarttaye | sādhūnāṃ śāntikāle vā vikṣepaścalatā tathā ||45|| ayogyācāra evāpi kartavyo na kadācana | sādhūnāṃ sannidhāvuccāsane stheyaṃ na karhicit ||46|| vivādo naiva kartavyo vācā dhanena karmaṇā | jñānena svasya nirvāhārthaṃ vā balena lobhinā ||47|| duṣṭamānuṣasaṃgena vādaḥ kāryo na sajjanaiḥ | taddhanāśā na kartavyā vaśe kāryā na sādhavaḥ ||48|| nirīkṣaṇaṃ hi sādhūnāṃ kāryaṃ na daihikaṃ kvacit | rāgadveṣasvabhāvāḥ svāḥ prayoktavyā na sādhuṣu ||49|| sādhvāśrame grāmyakathāḥ kleśakathā mṛṣākathāḥ | bhogakathā na kartavyā noccāryaṃ cāpamānakṛt ||3.98.50|| yojanīyo na garvaśca balaṃ sattā na sādhuṣu | nimnīkāryā na vai santo yataḥ puṇyaṃ vinaśyati |51 || ahaṃ jānāmi sādhuḥ kiṃ jānatītyeva garvitā | kartavyā naiva vai kvāpi garvaḥ patanakāraṇam ||52|| sādhuṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇameccānamanaṃ puṇyaghātakam | svasya kāmādikān doṣān nārīdoṣān nijātmakān ||53|| svasvabhāvasya kāluṣyaṃ na prayuñjīta sādhuṣu | sādhvāśrame pragantavyaṃ guṇalābhārthameva ha ||54|| bahavaḥ santi loke’tra khaleśvarā janā api | svasya viṣayatṛptyarthaṃ sparśatṛptyarthamityapi ||55|| dṛṣṭitṛptyarthamevāpi yānti strīsaṃghabhūsthalīm | mandire cotsave tīrthe yatra strījanamardanam ||56|| sammarde samprayāntyeva līlākhyānakathādiṣu | doṣān gṛhṇanti tatraiva sādhūnāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā ||57|| tena pāpena jātyandhāḥ kuṣṭhinaśca napuṃsakāḥ | jāyante dīrgharogāśca daridrāḥ kṛpaṇāstathā ||58|| nāryo’pi ca tathāceṣṭā jāyante rogasaṃbhṛtāḥ | apatyādivihīnāśca dhanadhānyādivarjitāḥ ||59|| tasmād doṣānna gṛhṇīyāt sādhvīnāṃ ca satāmapi | guṇāneva hi gṛhṇīyāt sukhadān puṇyadān śubhān ||3.98.60 || yathekṣudaṇḍataḥ sūkṣmakaṇṭakām̐ścamarān dalān | tvakkūrcān saṃvihāyaiva rasaṃ gṛhṇanti mānavāḥ ||6 1 || yathā bhojyagatān śāke kṣiptān dagdhamarīcakān | patrādikān parityajya śākamātraṃ prabhuñjate ||62|| yathā phalagatān bījatvagādīn saṃvihāya vai | bhuñjate garbhamātraṃ vai rasān cūṣanti dehinaḥ ||63|| yathā vṛkṣagatān doṣām̐styaktvā gṛhṇanti tatphalam | yathā vallīgatān doṣām̐styaktvā gṛhṇanti puṣpakam ||64|| tathā sādhugatām̐styājyām̐styaktvārjayeta tadguṇān | evaṃ vai vartamānasya puṇyaprāptiḥ pade pade ||65|| āyurvidyāyaśovṛddhirdhanadhānyarddhisampadām | anantatvaṃ prajāyeta sādhusadguṇasaṃjuṣām ||66|| sādhavo hi yadā tuṣṭāḥ pratinandanti sevakam | tadgṛhaṃ saṃbhavatyeva sarvaratnopabṛṃhitam ||67|| putrān pautrān paśūm̐ścāpi bāndhavām̐śca kuṭumbinaḥ | grāmaṃ janapadaṃ cāpi sādhutuṣṭiḥ prapoṣayet ||68|| sādhujanasya dattena dhruvaṃ svargo hyanuttamaḥ | mokṣaścārjayituṃ śakyaḥ sādhusevā parā kriyā ||69|| sadbhyo dattena jīvanti devatāḥ pitaro’pi ca | muktāstuṣyanti bhagavān bhuṃkte sādhujaneṣu vai ||3.98.70|| tasmād dānāni deyāni sādhubhyaḥ pravijānatā | tīrthaṃ sudivyamevāste sādhumūrtiḥ sucetanā ||71 || adhamoddhārakāḥ santi sādhavo mama mūrtayaḥ | anāthānāṃ sanāthāste duḥkhināṃ duḥkhahārakāḥ ||72|| pāpānāṃ kṣālakāścāparādhināṃ doṣanāśakāḥ | tiraskṛtānāṃ śaraṇapradātāro hi sādhavaḥ ||73|| śṛṇu pūrvakathāṃ vacmi sādhubhistārito dvijaḥ | himālaye’bhavad ramyamāśramamṛṣisevitam ||74|| ṛṣidhāmāśramaṃ nāma siddharṣivipraśobhitam | vratibhistāpasaiścāpi niyamibhiśca dīkṣitaiḥ ||75|| kṛtātmabhistathā sādhuyatibhiḥ sanniveśitam | ṛṣestu dīrghatapaso dvijaśreṣṭhasya yoginaḥ || ||76|| tatra kaścit samāyātaḥ śabaro vanajīvanaḥ | dadarśarṣigaṇān devakalpām̐staporatān śubhān ||77|| niścikāya tapastaptuṃ papraccha dīrghatāpasam | dharmaṃ me bhagavan vaktuṃ pravrājayitumarhasi ||78|| śūdro’hṛṃ kartumicchāmi śuśrūṣāṃ te prasīda me | dīrghatapāstadovāca śūdrastvaṃ vartase yataḥ ||79|| pravrājayituṃ śakyaṃ na hyadhikāravivarjanāt | āsyatāṃ caivamevātra śuśrūṣāṃ kuru rocate ||3.98.80|| śuśrūṣayā parām̐llokānavāpsyasi vanecara | ityuktaḥ sa śabaro’pi mumude cāśramāntike ||81|| vṛkṣādhobhāgake naijāṃ sthalīṃ kṛtvā hyuvāsa ha | bhojanaṃ phalapuṣpādi cakre śuśrūṣaṇamṛṣeḥ ||82|| ekadā svasvabhāvena vanyaṃ śaśaṃ dadhāra saḥ | mārayitvādanaṃ cakre ṛṣerāśramasannidhau ||83|| athainaṃ hiṃsakaṃ śūdraṃ tatyajuḥ ṛṣayaśca te | śepuśca rākṣaso bhūtvā bhava duḥkhī vanāntare ||84|| tūrṇaṃ sa rākṣaso bhūtvā vikṛto vyacaradvane | kṣudhātṛṣātiduḥkhāḍhyo yayau gaṃgātaṭe tataḥ ||85|| tatrānena tapomagnaḥ sādhurbhaktiparāyaṇaḥ | nāmnā nārāyaṇamunirdṛṣṭo vaiṣṇavasattamaḥ ||86|| sādhuṃ bhakṣayituṃ tūrṇaṃ rākṣasaḥ prayayau taṭam | sādhurdṛṣṭvā rākṣasaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭyā vyalokayattathā ||87|| jalaṃ cikṣepa śirasi rākṣasasya ca varṣmaṇi | pavitro bhava dharmātmā duḥkhād virahito bhava ||88|| śāpamukto bhavātraiva sādhorme sannidhau hyaghin | ityevamuktaḥ śabaro jalasparśena satvaram ||89|| vihāya rākṣasaṃ bhāvaṃ divyo babhūva mānavaḥ | atha coddhārakaṃ sādhuṃ nārāyaṇamuniṃ tataḥ ||3.98.90|| siṣeve parayā prītyā pāvanī lokapāvanaḥ | śūdro’pi sādhuyogena bhaktimānabhavattataḥ ||91 || sādhorājñāṃ gṛhītvaiva yayau vanāntaraṃ prati | bheje nārāyaṇaṃ nityaṃ tapaścacāra dāruṇam ||92|| śabaraḥ sa tu dehānte rājyaṃ śreṣṭhamavāptavān | ujjayinīnṛpo vīravikramo hyabhavaddhi saḥ || 93|| bhuktvā bhogān hareścāpi kṛtvā bhaktiṃ tathottamām | yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ mukto babhūva satprasaṃgataḥ ||94|| tatkuṭumbaṃ sāghusevāṃ kṛtvā yayau paraṃ padam | tasmād gṛdhra sadā sevyāḥ sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ ||95|| āgacchātrasamīpe’sti sādhuḥ kṛṣṇastavābhidhaḥ | tamāśritya bhaviṣyāvo dhūtapāpau hi pāvanau ||96|| ityuktvā lakṣmi yayatuḥ kṛṣṇastavābhidhaṃ prati | nematustuṣṭuvatuścārthayāmāsatureva ca ||97|| mokṣaṇaṃ cātha sādhustau pāyayāmāsa vāri ca | prasādaṃ bhojayāmāsa kṛtavān pāvano drutam ||98|| pāpaṃ prajvālayāmāsa śrāvayāmāsa kīrtanam | nāma nārāyaṇaṃ cāpi dadau tūrṇaṃ hi tāvubhau ||99|| bhautikau tu tadā dehau tyaktvā sādhupratāpataḥ | yayatustau pāpahīnau svargaṃ devau babhūvatuḥ ||3.98.1 0 0|| sādhvāśrayeṇa vai svargaṃ bhuktvā prasādasatphalam | kālena tau yayatuśca vaikuṇṭhaṃ paramātmanaḥ || 10 1|| lakṣmītyevaṃ sādhusaṃgo lavamātraṃ kṛto’pi vai | pāvayatyeva puṇyānāṃ puñjaṃ dadāti satvaram || 1 02|| rājyaṃ svargaṃ dadātyeva mokṣaṇaṃ ca dadātyapi| prayacchati mahānandaṃ satsaṃgaḥ kṛṣṇayoginām |||1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne āpadgatasyāpi sādhusaṃgatiḥ kalyāṇadetyarthe gṛdhraśvapacayoḥ śabarasya ca svargādyuttaraṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 98 ||
<3.99> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca satyaṃ tadbhagavan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jagatprabho | yatra te sādhavaḥ santi tatra pumarthasiddhayaḥ || 1 || ye ca santo nirmalā me patyuḥ priyatamā janāḥ | teṣāṃ pādarajaścāhaṃ vahāmi śirasā sadā || 2 || teṣāmājñāmarthakarīṃ śubhāṃ vāpyathavāśubhām | vahāmi sarvadānena niḥśaṃkā tava kāraṇāt || 3 || satāṃ vāṇī satyapūtā yādṛśī tādṛśī hyapi | satāṃ vāṇī paro vedo bhavān yatra pratiṣṭhati || 4 || maunavrataṃ sadā cāste satāṃ vaikharyanāvṛtam | santo vinārthaṃ paramaṃ vadantyeva na laukikam || 5 || mukhamastīti vaktavyaṃ nisargo’yaṃ na vai satām | sūkṣmā gatirhi satyasya durjñeyā hyakṛtātmabhiḥ || 6 || mūḍharucyanusāreṇa vaktavyaṃ na satā kvacit | vacane doṣasaṃkrāntistato maunaṃ varaṃ satām || 7 || mānavāstādṛśā loke jāyante ca bhavanti ca | guruścāpyupadeṣṭāpi svamataṃ cedvaded yadi || 8 || tadā sa gururāṭ śreṣṭho’nyathājñaḥ parikīrtyate | etādṛśā bhavantyeva śiṣyā ghoratamovṛtāḥ || 9 || svamatamanudveṣṭā vai gururgururna cānyathā | tasmātte nārakāścātra paratrāpi bhavanti hi || 3.99.1 0|| ataḥ śiṣyābhirevātra śiṣyairvā yanmataṃ matam | tanmataṃ ced viruddhaṃ vai śāstradharmādibādhakam || 1 1|| tadā na guruṇā grāhyaṃ tyājyāḥ śiṣyāstu tādṛśāḥ | prāyaśo bahavo loke mṛṣāpaṇḍābhimāninaḥ || 12|| vijñaṃmanyā bhavantyeva śiṣyā guruniyāmakāḥ | apathe gamyamānāste patantyeva hyadho hyadhaḥ || 13|| asadvāṇī mahāpāpā na vaktavyā kadācana | tatra sadbhirna vaktavyā kasyacit kiñcidagrataḥ || 14|| varāṃ maunena munayo dīkṣāṃ kurvanti saṃyame | duruktasya bhayāt kṛṣṇa nābhāṣante vṛthā mṛṣā || 15|| dhārmikā guṇasampannāḥ satyabhaktisamanvitāḥ | satyopadeśairmunayaḥ prāpayanti paraṃ padam || 16|| duṣkṛtaṃ dārayantyeva śrotṝṇāṃ brahmadānataḥ | ānandābdhiṃ prārpayanti parameśaprasaṃgadāḥ || 17|| apātraṃ śaraṇaṃ yāyāt parīkṣaṇīyaṃ sarvathā | upadeśo na kartavyaḥ sahasā sthitimantarā || 18|| apātre copadeśāt tatpāpaṃ saṃkramate gurau | vimṛśya jñānadānaṃ vai kartavyaṃ satyasaṃjuṣā || 1 9|| anṛte cāpyapātre copadeśaḥ svaṃ hinasti hi | tādṛgbodhaḥ pradātavyo yena satyaṃ prarakṣayet ||3.99.20|| yena sanātano devo nārāyaṇaḥ prasādyate | etādṛśāḥ satyaśīlāḥ satyanārāyaṇāśritāḥ ||2 1|| satyasanātanabhaktāḥ sādhavo guravo mama | vasāmi bhagavam̐statra yatra me guravo’malāḥ ||22||| pūjyante bhavatā sākaṃ subhagā brahmavedinaḥ | pragalbhā bhaktidakṣāśca śrīharivyavasāyinaḥ ||23|| devabhaktāḥ kṛtajñāśca jitendriyāśca sāttvikāḥ | puruṣārthaparā divyāḥ santo yatra vasāmyaham ||24|| yatra kānto mama nārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | bhavānāste nivasāmi tatra sarvasvadānataḥ ||25|| na vasāmyapumarthāḍhye nāstike kṛtaghātini | dharmasāṃkarike naiva bhinnasetau vasāmi na ||26|| nṛśaṃse nindake duṣṭe caure guruṣvasūyini | sādhūnāṃ dveṣiṇi dṛpte naiva vasāmi sarvathā || 27|| alpatejasi sattvena vihīne balavarjite | kliṣṭe kruddhe na tiṣṭhāmi cāsthire sthitivarjite ||28|| aprārthini svabhāvena vihate’lpapratoṣiṇi | bahuvyaye vyasanini nāhaṃ vasāmi sarvadā ||29|| dharmāḍhye dharmaviduṣi dānte vṛddhopasevini | kṣāntipare kṛtakṛtye nivasāmi mahotsave ||3.99.3 0|| satyasvabhāvāsu dāntāsvabalāsu vasāmi ca | ārjavāḍhyāsu sādhūnāṃ sevikāsu vasāmi ca ||3 1|| dehadvijagurusvāmipūjikāsu vasāmi ca | malināṃ cāsthirāṃ naijakāryālasāṃ virodhinīm ||32|| pratikūlasthitiṃ bhartuḥ parapakṣasahāyinīm | alajjāṃ cāsahamānāṃ varjayāmi sadā tvaham || 33|| pāpāmasādhusevāḍhyāṃ kruddhāṃ dhairyavivarjitām | śaṭhāṃ kalahamūlāṃ ca bahunidrāṃ tyajāmi ca ||34|| satyavratāsu divyāsu guṇasaubhāgyadāsu ca | pativratāsu śīlāsu vasāmi bhūṣitāsu ca ||35|| yāneṣu sādhuyukteṣu bhaktāsu kanyakāsu ca | yajñeṣu sādhuyukteṣu mandire ca vasāmyaham ||36|| puṣpeṣu sasyagātreṣu gajeṣu mandurāsu ca | goṣṭheṣu sādhupādeṣu paṃkajeṣu vasāmyaham ||37|| nadīyuktapradeśeṣu tapasvisiddhayogiṣu | vṛṣabhe gomaṇḍale ca narendre sajjane tathā ||38|| uccāsane ca havyāde suragobrahmapūjake | ātithyaśobhane saudhe nityaṃ vasāmi mādhava ||39|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe sādhau ca te’nuge | sādhvyāṃ bhaktajane cāpi vasāmi nityamūrjitā ||3.99.40|| prasannāścādṛśyabhāvā yatra vasāmi keśava | tvadājñayā vardhayāmi dharmayaśo’rthakāmanaiḥ ||41 || bhagavan me rahasyaṃ tu kathayāmīha sarvathā | sādhavo yatra sevyante tatra vasāmi sarvadā ||42|| sādhavo bhagavadrūpā mama nāthasya mūrtayaḥ | teṣāṃ sevādilābhārthaṃ tava prasannatāptaye ||43|| nityaṃ vasāmi sādhūnāṃ sevikāyāṃ ca sevake | yatra gopālakṛṣṇaśca yatra śrīkaṃbharāsatī ||44|| santuṣṭā yatra vai cāste yatra śrīharivallabhaḥ | tatra vasāmi nityaṃ vai yatra pūjā harestava ||45|| sarvasvārpaṇabhāvena bhajante ye janā harim | svārthabhāvavihīnāstān naiva tyajāmi karhicit ||46|| yatra sādhvannasatrāṇi yatra sādhvāśramāḥ sadā | yatra satāṃ śubhā sevā tatra vasāmi vṛddhidā ||47|| yatra niṣkapaṭā buddhirvartate sevake jane | nirdoṣā ca matiryatra tatra vasāmi sarvathā ||48|| gṛhadārasutāputradhanebhyaścādhikāstathā | yasya santo matāstasya gṛhe vasāmi sarvathā ||49|| patidevaśvaśurebhyo’dhikā yatra hi sādhavaḥ | pūjyante yoṣitāṃ tāsāṃ gṛhe vasāmi sarvathā ||3.99.50|| sādhūnāṃ raṭaṇaṃ yatra sādhūnāṃ yatra darśanam | sneho yatra sadā satsu tatra vasāmi sarvathā ||51|| bhagavān bhagavantaśca hariśca sādhavastathā | svāmī ca sevakā yatra tatra vasāmi sarvadā ||52|| yatra svāmī na me cāste na tadbhaktā hi sādhavaḥ | sūryavat puṇyayogenodayitvāstaṃ prayāmyaham ||53|| yadgṛhe divaso yāti vinā tvannāmakīrtanam | tadgṛhaṃ santyajāmyeva mūrchayā pīḍitā satī ||54|| yatra te satpūruṣāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ vidyate na vai | tadgṛhaṃ gahvaraṃ matvā śmaśānavattyajāmyaham ||55|| yatra sādhujanapādaṃ varṣe’pi naiva dṛśyate | tadgahaṃ puṇyaśūnyaṃ vai śmaśānavat tyajāmyaham ||56|| yatrotsavo na kṛṣṇasya varṣāntare’pi jāyate | tadgṛhaṃ santyajāmyeva tavotsavavivarjitam ||57|| yatra bhaktā na te santi vasanti naiva ca kvacit | tatra me rocate naiva vāsaḥ kardamasāgare ||58|| yatra saudhe mandire vā bhavane devatālaye | patirnārāyaṇo nāsti tatra naiva vasāmyaham ||59|| yatra svarṇālaye svarṇakośe rājyāsane’pi vā | nārāyaṇārpaṇaṃ prātarnāsti naiva vasāmyaham ||3.99.6 0 || yatra hareḥ pūjanāgre ghṛtadīpo na vidyate | dhūpaścārārtrikaṃ nāsti tatra naiva vasāmi ca ||6 1 || yatra naivedyakaṃ viṣṇoḥ kṛte nāsti jalaṃ na ca | yatra viṣṇujanaḥ kvāpi na bhuṃkte na vasāmyaham ||62|| yatrāṣṭamījayantyāśca trayodaśyā mahotsavaḥ | ūrje kṛṣṇe na cāstyeva tatra naiva vasāmyaham ||63|| yatrāvatāragāthāste naiva śrūyanta aiśvaram | pūjanaṃ vā pratimānaṃ nāsti naiva vasāmyaham ||64|| śaṃkhacakrādicihnāni tulasīvṛkṣamityapi | yatra naiva pravidyante tatra naiva vasāmyaham ||65|| yatra lakṣmyavatārāṇāṃ kathā mūrtirna cāsti ca | nārāyaṇāvatārāṇāṃ nāpi tatra vasāmi na ||66|| yatra satāṃ na satkāro vṛddhānāṃ sevanaṃ na ca | gavāṃ sammānanaṃ nāsti tatra naiva vasāmi ca ||67|| yatra śrāddhaṃ na devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ jīvatāṃ ca vā | puṇyadānaṃ na yatrāsti tatra naiva vasāmi ca ||68|| yadgṛhe bālakā naiva rakṣyante bhojanādibhiḥ | uttāpyante striyo yatra tatra naiva vasāmi ca ||69|| paṃktibhedo gṛhe yatra cāśritānāṃ prapīḍanam | paśūnāṃ rodhanaṃ yatra tatra naiva vasāmi ca ||3.99.70|| gopure yannagarasya nārāyaṇapratikṛtiḥ | vidyate naiva tatrāpi ciraṃ naiva vasāmyaham ||7 1 || yatra sarasvatī lakṣmīrhastikamalamālinī | rājate candraśālādau tadgṛhe nivasāmi ca ||72|| yatra gaṇeśo nāsti na santi śrīmātaraḥ kṛtāḥ | bindurūpāstatra naiva vasāmyahaṃ ciraṃ kvacit ||73|| yatra nare ca nāryā ca vaimanasyaṃ sutādiṣu | bhṛtyasvāmiṣu caudāsīnatā tatra vasāmi na ||74|| yatrāste rakṣakaḥ svāmī bhakṣako dharmavarjitaḥ | nārāyaṇasya vai dveṣī caurastatra vasāmi na ||75||| yatra vāṭyāṃ devavṛkṣā vidyante naiva sarvathā | yajñīyā vallayo vṛkṣā naiva tatra vasāmi na ||76|| yatra kṣetre sasyaśobhe satāṃ vicaraṇaṃ nahi | tatra kaṇeṣu naivāhaṃ saṃbhavāmyativartinī ||77|| yatra santo na sarasi nadyāṃ nade taḍāgake | kūpe snānti kvacittatra jale rase vasāmi na ||78|| yatra lokasamāje vā tathā devasamājake | viduṣāṃ ca samāje na sādhustatra vasāmi na ||79|| yatra rājasamāje vā prajāsamājake tathā | tīrthe vā nāsti bhaktātmā tasmādapasarāmyaham ||3.99.80|| yā sabhā sādhuśūnyā yā kṛtirharyarpaṇaṃ vinā | prāptiryā dānaśūnyā ca tato’pyapasarāmyaham ||8 1|| yatrendro vijayo lakṣmīryūpe stambhe gṛhe tathā | yatra śrīśaḥ svayaṃ cāste tatra vasāmi keśava ||82|| yatra rātrau na dīpo’sti divā nivedanaṃ na ca | yatra snehyāgamo nāsti tataścāpasarāmyaham ||83|| dāridryaṃ rājate yatra dharmakarmārhaṇādiṣu | jīrṇadānaṃ ca yatra syāt tato’pyapasarāmyaham ||84|| yatra sītā ca vṛṣabhāḥ pūjyante na kṛṣikṣaṇe | bhūmirna pūjyate yatra tatra naiva bhavāmyaham ||85|| yatra bhāle na candro’sti kauṃkumaścāndano’pi vā | saubhāgyabhūṣaṇaṃ nāsti tataścāpasarāmyaham ||86|| yatrāste cābhayadānaṃ mokṣamārgapradarśanam | bhaktagāthācaritrāṇi tatra vasāmi keśava ||87|| satāṃ śīlasvabhāvānāmaparigrahayoginām | vāci hṛdi pādayośca vasāmi muditā sadā ||88|| hareḥ pūjāvaśiṣṭe ca jale patre sume kaṇe | prasāde’nne’mbare dravye vasāmi sarvavastuṣu ||89|| dīkṣite sāttvate bhakte sādhvyāṃ ca brahmayoṣiti | haryarthaṃ pācikāyāṃ ca nivasāmi hyatandritā ||3.99.90|| patnīvrataḥ sadā tvaṃ vai nārāyaṇo bhavasyataḥ | maddhastamantarā naiva gṛhṇāsyanyasamarpitam ||91|| tasmāt samarpake tūrṇaṃ nivasāmi niyogataḥ | nivedako matsvarūpaḥ sevako yo’pi ko’pi vā || 92|| yā vā kā vā sevikā te lakṣmīrūpā na saṃśayaḥ | sādhavaḥ sevakāste vai sarvathātmanivedinaḥ || 93 || teṣu mayāpi vasatiḥ sarvadācaryyate prabho | harerbhaktāśca ye nārīnarāścāpi bhavanti ca || 94|| devāśca pitaraścāpi maharṣayaśca mānavāḥ | nāgā daityā rākṣāśca dānavā bhaktikāriṇaḥ || 95|| sādhyā viśve marutaścādityā rudrā vasūttamāḥ | siddhāśca kinnarāḥ sūtā māgadhā bandinastathā ||96|| kimpumāṃsaśca gandharvā apsaraso’pi ceśikāḥ | yoginyo mātaraścāpi śaktayaḥ sādhikāstathā ||97 || gaṇikāśca gaṇāścāpi kanyāḥ kumārakāstathā | yakṣāśca lokapālāśca dikpālāstīrthakoṭayaḥ || 98|| tiryañco vā taijasāśca tāmasā vā catuṣpadāḥ | kīṭā vā pakṣiṇaścāpi ye ke’pi jaḍacetanāḥ || 99|| tava bhaktyarthamevaite udyatāstatra tatra ca | śīghraṃ vasāmi gatvaiva karomi pāvanām̐śca tān || 3.99.100 || tato gṛhṇāsi taddattaṃ nārāyaṇa karānmama | etādṛśaṃ nijapatnīvrataṃ nānyatra vidyate || 101 || pātivratyaṃ tathā lakṣmyāṃ tadanyatra na vidyate | santaste sarvadā satyapātivratyānvitāḥ khalu || 10 2|| yathā lakṣmīstathā santaḥ santo lakṣyastava priyāḥ | ato nigadyase kṛṣṇa lakṣmīkāntaḥ satāṃ patiḥ || 103 || ato’haṃ matsapatnīnāṃ satāṃ deheṣu sarvadā | abhinnā saṃvasāmyeva naitajjānāti cetaraḥ || 1 04|| namastasmai bhagavate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te | sādhubhyaśca namo lakṣmyai lakṣmyāḍhyebhyo namo’pi ca || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sādhujaneṣu sadā lakṣmīnivāsaḥ lakṣmīnivāsasthānāni,pāpiprabhatiṣvanivāsaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 99 ||
<3.100> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca parameśa kṛpāsindho sādhūnāṃ paramaṃ dhanam | muktānāṃ jīvanaṃ kṛṣṇo devānāṃ daivataṃ param || 1 || kṛpayaiva bhavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’tra bhūtale | samāyāsyathavā cānyat kāraṇaṃ vidyate nu kim || 2 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca kṛpātra kāraṇaṃ mukhyaṃ śivarājñīpriye sadā | icchaiva kāraṇaṃ sṛṣṭau mamāgamasya sarvathā || 3 || tathāpi niyataṃ hetumudbhāvayāmi cāparam | yadā yadā samāyāmi sṛṣṭyantare ca kalpake || 4 || ādau kvacinmaharṣeśca bhṛgornimittamāpya ha | samāyāmi muhuśceti bhaktānāmicchayāpi ca || 5 || śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca bhṛgoḥ kiṃ kāraṇaṃ jātaṃ yadarthaṃ vai tvayā prabho | muhurmānuṣabhāve’tra prākaṭyaṃ gṛhyate vada || 6 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi purāvṛttaṃ tu kāraṇam | bhṛgustrīkhyātivadhato bhṛguśāpena mānuṣe || 7 || prākaṭyaṃ sarvathā viṣṇorbahuvāraṃ prajāyate | devakāryārthalagnasya divyaiśvaryasya śārṅgiṇaḥ || 8 || yugadharme parāvṛtte śithile ca vṛṣe tataḥ | kartuṃ dharmavyavasthānaṃ jāyate viṣṇuravyayaḥ || 9 || hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo rājye trilokamaṇḍale | śāstābhavatpurā rājā daśakoṭisamāstathā || 3.100.1 0|| dvāsaptatilakṣāṇi varṣāṇyanyāni vai tathā | tathāśītisahasrāṇi samrāṭ nirāmayo’bhavat || 1 1|| tato daśayugaṃ rājā prahlādaścābhavad bhuvaḥ | tato rājā baliścāsīd daśakoṭisamāstathā || 12|| triṃśallakṣāṇi ca ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi samā bhuvaḥ | trayaste indrā vikhyātā daityānāmabhavam̐stadā || 1 3|| daityasaṃsthamidaṃ sarvamāsīd rājyaṃ trilokagam | atrāntare ca saṃgrāmāḥ surāsurakṣayāvahāḥ || 14|| āsan dvādaśa cogrāśca viṣṇuryatra surārthitaḥ | daityān vyanāśayad divyacakreṇa saṃgato muhuḥ || 15|| vārāhakalpe te sarve saṃgrāmāstān priye śṛṇu | prathamo nārasiṃhastu hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ || 16|| dvitīyaścāpi vārāho yatra hato hiraṇyadṛk | prahlādo nirjitaścāpi tṛtīyo’mṛtamanthane || 17|| virocanaścaturthaśca hato vai tārakāmaye | tārakā sā bṛhaspateḥ patnī candreṇa cāhṛtā || 18|| tannimittaṃ tu tadyuddhaṃ babhūva romaharṣaṇam | vāmanena balirbaddho yuddhaṃ mahadabhūttadā || 1 9|| ṣaṣṭhe hyāḍībako jambho hataḥ śakreṇa viṣṇunā | saptame śaṃbhunā daityāstripurādyā vināśitāḥ ||3.100.20|| aṣṭame cāndhako nighātitaḥ sadaityadānavaḥ | navame vipracittyādyā lakṣaśaḥ śakrasūditāḥ ||21|| vṛtrāsuro ghātitaśca daśame vajrapāṇinā | ekādaśe tu rajinā daityāḥ sarve vināśitāḥ ||22|| dvādaśe ca suraiḥ ṣaṇḍāmarkādyā vinipātitāḥ | ete devāsurāṇāṃ vai saṃgrāmā dvādaśābhavan || 23|| viṣṇustatra ca sarvatra sāhāyyo’bhūd dyuvāsinām | paryāyeṇa ca samprāptaṃ trailokyaṃ pākaśāsanam ||24|| tato yajñasya bhāgāṃśca yajñe devā hyupāgaman | yajñanārāyaṇaścāpi devapakṣī tato’bhavat ||25|| yajñe devānatha gate śukraṃ prāhurhi dānavāḥ | daityāścāsuramūrdhanyāstrāsamāptvā hi nirbalāḥ || 26|| sthātuṃ na śaknumo bhūmau praviśāmo rasātalam | evamukto’suragururviṣaṇṇaḥ sāntvayan girā ||27|| mābhaiṣṭa dhārayiṣyāmi tejasā svena vo’surān | vṛṣṭimoṣadhīn bhojyāni rasānsudhāḥ sukhāni ca ||28|| yuṣmadarthaṃ pradāsyāmi dhārayitvā svatejasā | yāsyāmyahaṃ mahādevaṃ mantrārthe vijayāya ca ||29|| yuṣmānanugrahīṣyāmi punaḥ paścādihāgataḥ | yūyaṃ tapaścaradhvaṃ vai saṃvṛtā valkalairvane ||3.100.3 0|| no ced devā haniṣyanti yāvadāgamanaṃ mama | ataścogrān mahāmantrān samprāpyāhaṃ maheśvarāt ||3 1|| āgacchāmi tato yotsyāmahe jeṣyāma eva tān | piturbhṛgoścāśramasthāḥ sampratīkṣata dānavāḥ || 32|| saḥ sandiśyāsurān kāvyo mahādevaṃ prapadya ca | samprapūjya svāgataṃ prāpya praṇamyovāca śaṃkaram ||33|| mantrānicchāmi śaṃbho tvat ye na santi bṛhaspatau | parābhavāya devānāmasureṣvabhayāvahān || 34|| śrutvā maheśvaraḥ prāha caravrataṃ mayoditam | pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ vai kuṇḍadhūmamavākchirāḥ ||35|| pāsyasi brahmacārī saṃstato mantrānavāpsyasi | tayoktaḥ śukra evāsau dhūmrapastāpaso’bhavat ||36|| vaṭaśākhāṃ samālambya kailāse’vākśirāḥ sadā | tasmin chidre tadāmarṣād devā daityānupādravan ||37|| pragṛhītāyudhā bṛhaspatipurogamā drutam | atha jetuṃ surānnaiva śakṣyāma iti dānavāḥ ||38|| natvā yayustadā śukramātaraṃ khyātimeva ha | śaraṇaṃ bhītabhītāste prāpadyanta tadābhayam ||39|| cakre rakṣāṃ bhṛgoḥ patnī kintu devā ruṣānvitāḥ | asurān jaghnuḥ paritaḥ khyātiḥ kruddhābhavattadā ||3.100.40|| pātivratyabalenendraṃ saṃstabhyābhyacarat satī | saṃstambhito drutaṃ cendro vaśīkṛto jaḍo’bhavat ||41|| vyadravanta vilokyainaṃ devāstato diśo daśa | atha viṣṇuḥ prāha śakraṃ śīghraṃ tvāṃ nyasya vai mayi ||42|| praveśayitvā rakṣāmi mābhaiṣīstvaṃ surottama | indraṃ viṣṇuḥ svamūrtau prāveśayitvā rarakṣa ha ||43|| viṣṇunā rakṣitaṃ vīkṣya khyātiḥ kruddhā vaco’vadat | eṣā viṣṇuṃ mahendraṃ ca dahāmi kṣaṇamātrataḥ ||44|| indraḥ śrutvā hariṃ prāha śīghraṃ kuru pareśvara | jahi sudarśanenaināṃ yāvanno na dahet satī ||45|| viṣṇuḥ sasaṃbhramaścakraṃ mumoca prāṇahetave | khyāteściccheda mūrdhānaṃ patitā sā mṛtābhavat ||46|| svastrīvadhaṃ samākarṇya bhṛguścukopa satvaram | śaśāpa strīvihantā tvaṃ mānuṣeṣu punaḥ punaḥ ||47|| janma dhṛtvātiduḥkhāni cānubhava muhurmuhuḥ | strīnimittāni duḥkhāni bhuṃkṣva loke punaḥ punaḥ ||48|| evaṃ bhṛgoḥ pratāpena jāyate viṣṇuracyutaḥ | naṣṭe dharme lokakāryahitārthaṃ mānuṣeṣviha ||49|| atha bhṛguḥ śiro dhṛtvā kāye drāk samayojayat | yadi kṛtsno mayā dharmaścirito jñāyate’pi vā ||3.100.50|| patnīvrataparaścāhaṃ tvaṃ pativratatatparā | tena satyena jīvasva jīvasva viṣṇusannidhau ||51 || ityuktvā prokṣya vārbhiśca jīvayāmāsa tāṃ bhṛguḥ | khyātistūrṇaṃ gatanidrevābhibubodha tatkṣaṇam ||52|| indrasya staṃbhanaṃ viṣṇurnāśayāmāsa yogataḥ | bhṛguḥ śānto’bhavat paścāt tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ||53|| kṣamāṃ yayāce satataṃ bhojanādi dadau śubham | viṣṇurnaiva hi jagrāha bhṛguṃ prāha hi mādhavaḥ ||54|| tava putrī mama patnī bhāvinī bhārgavī yadā | tadā grahīṣyāmyāgatya tayā sākaṃ hi bhojanam ||55|| ityuktvā prayayau viṣṇustyaktvā daityādikām̐stadā | indraḥ svastho yayau svargaṃ devā yayurnijālayān ||56|| daityādyāśca bhṛgoḥ kṣetre svasthā āśramasannidhau | tapanti ca pratīkṣante śukrasyāgamanaṃ prati ||57|| śukro’pi harapārvatyoḥ sannidhau vaṭavṛkṣake | adhaḥśirāstapaścograṃ karoti śaṃkarājñayā ||58|| pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu vigate śaṃkaraḥ svayam | divyarūpeṇa nikaṭe’dṛśyatāgatya vai vaṭe ||59|| śakrastuṣṭāva śaṃbhuṃ taṃ lambamāno vaṭe’pi ca | namo’stu śitikaṇṭhāya kapardine ca śaṃbhave ||3.100.60 || mīḍhuṣe vasuvīryāya rudrāya rohitāya te | girīśāyārkanetrāya takṣakakrīḍanāya ca ||61|| pinākine ca śvetāya bhīmāyogrāya te namaḥ | mahādevāya śarvāya mṛgavyādhāya te namaḥ ||62|| sthāṇave bahurūpāya trinetrāya ca mṛtyave | tryambakāya namaste’stu śaṃkarāya śivāya ca ||63|| dhyānine vyāpine sadyojātāyeśāya te namaḥ | vāmadevāya ca kṛttivastrāya prabhave namaḥ ||64|| bhaganetravihantre te paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ | bhūtānāṃ pataye pūṣāhantaghnāya ca te namaḥ ||65|| arkarūpāya ca nyagrodhāya kālāya te namaḥ | saṃkarṣaṇāya rudrāya vahnaye yogine namaḥ ||66|| pṛthivyādyaṣṭarūpāya liṃgāyāliṃgine namaḥ | pārvatīpataye tubhyaṃ gopataye namo namaḥ ||67|| maheśāya ca ḍamarūvāditrāya ca te namaḥ | kailāsasthāya devānāṃ stutyāya te namo namaḥ ||68|| mahāvaiṣṇavasannāmne gaṇānāṃ pataye namaḥ | brahmiṣṭhāya ca śukrasya pitre bhūyo namo namaḥ ||69|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau śukrastaṃ prāha śaṃkaraḥ | mā tapaḥ kuru viprendra saṃkalpaste bhayāvahaḥ ||3.100.70 || tathāpi vatsarānte’haṃ pūrayiṣye tu śīline | śīlavratāya te śukra dāsye yatheṣṭamantrakān ||71|| ityuktvā śaṃkaro devastatraivāntaradhīyata | athendreṇa nijākanyā jayantī preṣitā tadā ||72|| kathitā putri śakro vai dāruṇaṃ carate tapaḥ | anidrārthaṃ trilokyāṃ vai tato yāhi drutaṃ ca tam ||73|| śukraṃ prasevayasvainaṃ śayyāsevādibhirdrutam | taistairmano’nukūlaiśca hyupacārairatandritā ||74|| śrutvā surūpā kanyā sā jayantī prayayau hi tam | pitrā yathoktaṃ vākyaṃ sā śukre kṛtavatī satī ||75|| śukrastāṃ prāha suśroṇi daśavarṣāṇi vai mayā | saha tiṣṭhādṛśyarūpā samprayogaṃ ca me kuru ||76|| ityājñaptā daśa samāḥ śukreṇa saha sā sthitā | śukravat tāpasī bhūtvā sūkṣmayogavatī sadā ||77|| atha bṛhaspatirdaśavatsareṣu nijaṃ vapuḥ | śukrarūpātmakaṃ kṛtvāsurānaśikṣayattadā ||78|| atha śukro daśavarṣottare daityānupāgamat | ahaṃ śukro’smi daityendrā madvacaḥ sannibodhata ||79|| daityāḥ prāhurna naḥ svāmī bhavān śukro na vai ṛtaḥ | daśavarṣāṇi naḥ svāmī satyo’yaṃ śukra eva ha ||3.100.80|| ityevamasuraiḥ śukro’vamānitaḥ śaśāpa tān | daityā yūyaṃ satyaśukraṃ bodhitā nābhyanandatha ||81 || tasmāt praṇaṣṭavīryā vai parābhavamavāpsyatha | iti śaptā asurāste jñātvā śāpaṃ ca devatāḥ ||82|| yuyudhurdānavādyaiśca hatavanto’surān bahūn | kāvyaśāpābhibhūtāśca śukrādhāravivarjitāḥ ||83|| asurā hanyamānāste viviśuśca rasātalam | devānāṃ vijayo jāto viṣṇunā tu sahāyinā ||84|| etatte kathitaṃ lakṣmi viṣṇorjanmasu kāraṇam | bhṛgornimittamālambya viṣṇuḥ saṃjāyate muhuḥ ||85|| dharmānnārāyaṇo jātaścākṣuṣe ca manau hariḥ | vaivasvate pṛthurviṣṇurvāmanaścāditeḥ sutaḥ ||86|| dattātreyo’bhavatso’pi parśurāmo’pi caiva saḥ | rāmādityastathā viṣṇurvyāso bhavati sarvadā ||87|| vāsudevo’pi viṣṇuśca kalkī viṣṇurbhaviṣyati | evamanye’pyavatārā viṣṇorbhavanti mānavāḥ ||88|| daityānāṃ tu vināśārthaṃ dharmarakṣaṇahetave | kvacinnārīnimittena kvacitsurāvanāya ca ||89|| kvaciddharmanimittena kvacicca kṛpayā kila | ete sarve mama lakṣmi hyavatārā vibhūtayaḥ ||3.100.90|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ puruṣottamaḥ | icchayānugraheṇāpi cāyāmi hitavān satām ||9 1|| sādhūn viprān vṛṣaṃ gāśca rakṣāmi mānavo muniḥ | sādhavo me’vatārāśca hetayo’pi tathāvidhāḥ ||92|| aiśvaryāṇi cāvatārāḥ śaktayo’pi tathāvidhāḥ | muktā me hyavatārāśca bhaktāścāpi tathāvidhāḥ ||93|| devāścāpyavatārā me dharmāvanāya sarvathā | ājñayā sṛṣṭilokeṣu jāyante’ntarbhavanti ca ||94|| mūrtayo mama yāḥ santi divyāḥ sarvā hi tāstu me | avatārāḥ sadā sevāgrāhakā bhaktavatsalāḥ ||95||| mamāvatārayogaṃ ye labdhavantaḥ surāsurāḥ | daityāśca dānavā yakṣā rākṣasāśca narāḥ striyaḥ ||96|| paśavo vāhanātmāno gajāśca vājino’pi ca | uṣṭrāśca vṛṣabhāścānye mama yogamupāgatāḥ ||97|| matsādhuyogamāpannā yātā yānti paraṃ padam | ityevaṃ me kṛpā cāste svabhāvo me’pi tādṛśaḥ ||98|| madyogaṃ samavāptasya mattulyatvaṃ prajāyate | sādhuyogātsādhurbhavati daivayogāśca devatā ||99|| mama yogādbhavatyeva mādṛśo bhaktarāṭ svayam | nārāyaṇasya yogena naro nārāyaṇo bhavet || 3.100.10 0|| nārī nārāyaṇī syācca muktānikā ramā yathā | yathā padmāvatī jātā nārāyaṇyau priye mama || 101 || śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin pate mama | jijñāsāṃ pūraya jāte nrāyaṇyau tu ramābjake || 1 02|| kathaṃ kena nimittena saṃjātā saṃgatistava | padmāvatyā ramāyāśca sphuṭaṃ kṛṣṇa vadātra me || 1 03|| śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sarvajñāsi hi mādṛśī | tathāpi mānavaṃ bhāvamāpya jijñāsasi tvidam || 1 04|| kathayāmi purā vṛttaṃ yena ye saṃgamo’nayoḥ | kakupsūryātmajayorvai kuṭumbe kārave’bhavat || 1 05|| purā sūryo yadotpannaḥ sahasrakiraṇo’bhavat | uccāvacapradeśaśca brahmāṇḍadāhakāgnikaḥ || 106 || asahyatejāścātyugro vivarāṇyajvalan yataḥ | sūryaṃ tejasvinaṃ jñātvā yārpitā viśvakarmaṇā || 1 07|| saṃjñānāmnī kanyakāpi sā jajvālārkatejasā | vihāyeyaṃ patiṃ svasyāḥ chāyāṃ kṛtvā nijāṃ striyam || 1 08|| svadhiṣṇye tāṃ samāsthāya niryayau sā gṛhānnijāt | kliṣṭacittā gūhatī svāṃ viśvakarmālayaṃ yayau || 1 09|| pitropadiṣṭā sūryasya gṛhe gantuṃ tathāpi sā | na yātā vaḍavā bhūtvā himādrau vyacarat satī || 3.100.11 0|| tadārkastāṃ mārgayituṃ samāyāddhimaparvate | aśvo bhūtvārabdhavām̐stāṃ sā na kāmaṃ dadau tadā || 11 1|| mukhaṃ dadau tadā sūryo dhātuṃ nasorvyasarjayat | nāsikādvayato jātāvaśvinyāḥ sukumārakau || 1 12|| tataḥ sā prayayau sākaṃ sūryeṇa sūryamaṇḍalam | kintu sūryasya tejobhirjajvālaiṣā purā yathā || 113 || sovāca pitaraṃ sūryamandatārthaṃ pitā tataḥ | viśvakarmā divānāthaṃ śāṇollīḍhaṃ cakāra ha || 1 14|| śātitaścābhitaḥ sūryaścātirūpo’timohakaḥ | sahyatejāḥ samabhavat saṃjñā tasmin sthirābhavat || 1 11|| tadā surūpaṃ sukhadaṃ sahyaṃ bhogapradaṃ suram | vīkṣya cakame yuvatī diśā bhūtvā sukanyakā || 116 || hāvabhāvavilāsādyaiśceṣṭābhistaṃ digicchati | rantukāmāṃ sumugdhāṃ ca pārśve prāptāṃ rajonvitām || 1 17|| sūryastāṃ vīkṣya tatrāha digdevate kimacchasi | digdevī sveṣṭamāhāsmai kāmaṃ dehi sutṛptidam || 1 18|| sūryaḥ prāha na me bhogo vyarthaḥ syāt tadvicāraya | yadīṣṭaste’sti ced garbho gṛhāṇa mama saṃgamam || 1 19|| tadā diśā svayaṃ devī garbho neṣṭa iti svayam | vicāryāpi mahāmugdhā bhogamaicchad dinādhipāt || 3.100.120|| sūryaḥ prāha priye devi bhogaṃ dāsye phalānvitam | kadācinmānave bhāve tvaṃ kanyā saṃbhaviṣyasi || 1 21|| tadā te mānavīnāryai madyogaḥ saphalo bhavet | yadānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 1 22|| pṛthvyāṃ mānavarūpeṇa vicariṣyati kāmadaḥ | gopālabālakaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kaṃbharānandanaḥ prabhuḥ || 123 || tadā te janmasāphalyaṃ sarvathā saṃbhaviṣyati | ityuktvā virarāmārko diśā kanyā tiro’bhavat || 1 24|| atha sūryaḥ śvaśuraṃ svaṃ prasannaḥ prāha sāñjaliḥ | varaṃ vṛṇu pradātye’tra yanmano’nugataṃ priyam || 125|| viśvakarmā tadā prāha prasanno’si yadi prabho | jāmātā putrarūpo vai tathāpi putravāñcchayā || 1 26|| arthayāmi varaṃ ramyaṃ putro me bhava bhāskara | sūryastathāstviti prāha prajagāda ca tatparām || 1 27|| yadānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pṛthvyāṃ bhaviṣyati | gopālabālakaḥ satyāḥ kambharāyāḥ sukhātmajaḥ || 128|| tadā tadyogalābhārthamahaṃ cecchāmi janma vai | adya vā ca yugānte vā yugānāmayute’pi vā || 1 29|| śrīhareryogalābhārthaṃ bhaviṣyāmi sumānavaḥ | tatra kāle viśvakarman bhavatā pṛthivītale || 3.100.130|| prākaṭyaṃ mānave kāryaṃ matpitṛtvasya siddhaye | bhavantaṃ pitaraṃ prāpya kāruyonau tvadātmajaḥ || 13 1|| bhaviṣyāmi suputraste pūrayiṣye manoratham | ityetat samayaṃ prāpya pṛthvyāṃ yadā hariḥ svayam || 1 32|| gopālabālako’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’bhavat | kabharāśrīgṛhe tatra viśvakarmāpya vai kṣaṇam || 133 || maṃkaṇakasukārorvai gṛhe bālujaśilpirāṭ | viśvakarmā svayaṃ jajñe jaṭilāpatirityayam || 1 34|| bālujaṃśilpinaṃ viśvakarmāvatāramuttamam | pitaraṃ samprakalpyaiva sūryaḥ putro’bhavattataḥ || 135|| nākamicchilpirāṭ sarvaśilpivaryaḥ suyogirāṭ | tasyāsya pūrṇarūpasya bhāryābhavattu sā kakub || 1 36|| yā jātā kanyakā digaṃśātmikā mānavī satī | ambāmātā śilpivaryamanojitputrikā śubhā || 1 37|| vivāhitā digaṃśā sārkāṃśanākajitā bhuvi | dampatyoḥ putrikā jātāḥ pañca jyeṣṭhātra cābjikā || 1 38|| diśāmaṃśasvarūpā yā sāmbāyāḥ putrikāgrajā | padmāvatī satītulyā kṛṣṇakāntasya satpriyā || 1 39|| sūryaprabhā svayaṃ sūryajanyā harau sumohitā | hariṃ patiṃ prakartuṃ sā sūryaputrī tu mānavī || 3.100.140 || vyajāyata surūpā vai sūryamānavaputrikā | dvitīyā sā ramā jātā sūryāṃśanākajitsutā || 141 || sūryaputrī ramā sāmbādevyāṃ vyajāyatottamā | padminīrūpasaubhāgyaguṇayuktā haripriyā || 142|| brahmaṇo ye purā putryau ramāpadmāvatībhidhe | puruṣottamamāsasya trayodaśyā vratena vai || 143 || prāpte’kṣaraṃ paraṃ dhāma te punaḥ śrīharīcchayā | bhuvi śrībhagavatsevākaraṇāyārkaputrikā || 144|| ramā jātātha dikputrī jātā padmāvatī tathā | mānave tu harau patnīrūpeṇobhe’rpite bhuvi || 145|| pārṣadau me dhāmasaṃsthau bhargo hemanta ityamū | sevārthaṃ nītavānetau sahāhaṃ tau sahodarau || 146 || prajātau tau yatra patnījanma tatra gṛhe tvimau | bhargo’bhavaddhi bhagavān hemanto hemasaṃjñakaḥ || 147|| siṣevāte hariṃ māṃ tau parabrahmaparāyaṇau | bhagavān sa suto madhye jāto vai bhagavadgaṇaḥ ||148|| hemantaśca tato jāto’nujo hemasamottamaḥ | tatastisraḥ sutā yā mālatī haṃsī ca sadguṇā || 149|| vaikuṇṭhasakhyastisrastā abhavannambikāsutāḥ | evaṃ sarvaṃ bhaktiyuktaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrayam || 3.100.150|| kuṭumbaṃ devatārūpaṃ jātaṃ bhaktyarthamuttamam | sevārthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaivābhavat kṣitau || 151|| ityeṣaḥ kathitaḥ pūrvavṛttāntaste’tra matpriye | padmāvatyāramā yāśca priyayormama sarvadā || 152|| yathā lakṣmīrjayā rādhā māṇikyā lalitā, priyā | yathā śrīstvaṃ tathā padmāvatī ramātra me priyā || 153|| brahmapriyāṣṭakaṃ tvetat koṭyarbudāṅganottamam | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhettathā || 154|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne bhagavadavatārāṇāṃ sṛṣṭāvāgamane kṛpā vā bhṛgoḥ śāpo nimittaṃ, daityānāṃ dvādaśasaṃgrāmāḥ, padmāvatīramākuṭumbasya prāgvṛttāntādiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 100 ||
<3.101> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca bhagavan yasya sādhūnāṃ yogastvatra babhūva na | pretasya tasya coddhāraḥ kathaṃ syād vada taddhitam || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu śrīśivarājñīśri pretasya pṛṣṭhato janaiḥ | śrāddhe santo bhojanīyāḥ pūjanīyāḥ suvastubhiḥ || 2 || vastrabhūṣāratnarūpyasuvarṇadhanavāhanaiḥ | santoṣaṇīyāḥ santaśca viprāśca brahmavedinaḥ || 3 || godānāni pradeyāni gāvo vai tārikā sadā | godānācchāśvatān lokān prāpnuyāt preta utthitaḥ || 4 || gaurhi nyāyāgatā dattā sadyastārayate kulam | māndhātāraṃ purā prāha bṛhaspatiḥ śṛṇuṣva tat || 5 || santaṃ prapūjya vipraṃ ca guruṃ prapūjya gāṃ tathā | pretanāmnā pradadyācca gāṃ pātrāya mahātmane || 6 || gaurme mātā pitā cokṣā tatra svargaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | sāyaṃ goṣṭhe vratī sthitvā gosevādiparāyaṇaḥ || 7 || prātarutthāya godānaṃ kuryāt smṛtvā paretakam | pretastūrṇaṃ divaṃ yāti kamale nātra saṃśayaḥ || 8 || vasedekāṃ niśāṃ gobhiḥ samasakhyaḥ samavrataḥ | aikātmyabhāvayukto yaḥ kaluṣāt sa vimucyate || 9 || dogdhryaḥ savatsikā deyā prātaḥ sūryasya darśane | yuvatyo rūpaśālinyo’mṛtagarbhāḥ prarohadāḥ || 3.101.1 0|| eno gāvaḥ praṇudantu svargayānāya santu me | mātṛvanmāṃ prarakṣantu santvāśīrvādasampradāḥ || 11 || roganāśe pare mokṣe svarge smṛddhau sukhe dhane | gāvaḥ prasannā udayaṃ dadatu śreyasāṃ pade || 12|| sarvadevāśrayāḥ puṇyā diśadhvaṃ gatimuttamām | ātmanā manasā yuktā dadatvātmārpaṇaṃ phalam || 13|| arghyaṃ vastraṃ suparṇaṃ ca vasu tāvata odanān | ūrdhvāsyāṃ suprasannāṃ gāṃ savatsāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ dade || 14|| gopradātā samuccārya dadyāt phalaṃ labhet param | godaḥ śīlīpūjakaśca dātārghasya ca sevakaḥ || 15|| sādhubhaktaḥ pitṛbhakto gurubhaktaḥ surārhakaḥ | satyaśīlastāpasaśca na syurvai duḥkhinaḥ kvacit || 16|| snānābhyāsī kathāhṛṣṭo brahmabhajanatatparaḥ | gosevāḍhyaśca catvāro vaiṣṇavā dhāmayoginaḥ || 17|| govratī gopradātā ca gavyāśano gavāyanaḥ | vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo bodhyo gomātā viṣṇudaivatā || 18|| devavratī vedavratī govratī sādhusadvratī | gomedhādivratī cāgryān vindate taijasālayān || 1 9|| kāmadhenupradātātra kāmān sarvān mahotsavān | havyakavyādibhugdattān bhuṃkte bhaumām̐śca taijasān ||3.101.20 || yavān pibed gavyayuktān kṣitau svapyād gavāyane | śīlī dogdhrīṃ pradadyādgāṃ sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet ||21 || sādhave sādhudīkṣārthaṃṃ putraṃ dadyācchubhakriyam | tenāpi kṛtapuṇyenoddhriyante pretadehinaḥ ||22|| sādhvyai dadyāt kanyakāṃ ca satīṃ vairāgyaśālinīm | yuvatīṃ jñānasampannāṃ saṃsāroddhāraśālinīm ||23|| śīlaparāyaṇāṃ gṛhidharmarāgavivarjitām | tyāgavṛttiṃ tathācāryāṇīsthānaśobhanāṃ śubhām ||24|| rājā dadyāttu gurave dāsīṃ dāsaṃ dvijāya ca | dvijaputraṃ pradadyācca vipraṃ dadyāt subhūbhṛte ||25|| yo bhavedvai gurutulyo vidyāsatsaṃgaśevadhiḥ | tādṛcchīlasvabhāvasya dānaṃ kuryād dvijasya ca ||26|| viprakumāradānaṃ tu mataṃ godānasadṛśam | uddhārako bhavedvipraśceha paratra sarvadā ||27|| vipraputrasya pitre vai dadyāt svarṇaṃ dhanaṃ bahu | evaṃ viprasutaṃ krītvā dadyād dānaṃ dvijātaye ||28|| yajñakāryanirvahārthaṃ pāṭhaśālārthamityapi | rājyagurutvalābhārthaṃ gṛhṇīyāccānapatyakaḥ ||29|| sutadānaṃ sutādānaṃ godānaṃ svarṇadānakam | ātmadānaṃ mokṣadānaṃ mokṣadāni matāni vai || 3.101.3 0|| vatsalāṃ sattvasampannāṃ taruṇīṃ ca vibhūṣitām | gatvā gāṃ ca sutāṃ dāne sarvapuṇyaiḥ suyujyate ||3 1 || duḥkhadāridryalokān sa gāṃ datvā naiva gacchati | dantahīnā valīyuktā līnakṣīrā ṛtukṣayā ||32|| jaraṭhā rogiṇī ruṣṭā duṣṭā deyā na karhicit | sarvāsu kapilā śreṣṭhā sā dātavyā viśeṣataḥ ||33|| devāḥ sūryaśca vai vṛṣṭiṃ kurvanti yajñatarpitāḥ | yajñīyaṃ karma gavyaiśca jāyate dugdhasarpiṣā ||34|| prajāpatiḥ svayaṃ tṛptimagacchat sarpiṣā purā | golokasthagavāṃ paścādasṛjallokamātṛkāḥ ||35|| suvarṇavarṇāḥ kapilāḥ sravantīrdugdhanirjharān | kṣīrāmṛtaṃ sravantyetā dhenavo jīvabhojanam ||36|| dadau tāśca ṛṣibhyo’tha devebhyaḥ sa prajāpatiḥ | mānavebhyo dadau cāpi dugdhādhvarādihetave ||37|| viprebhyaḥ pradadau cāpi daivakāryārthasiddhaye | kapilānāṃ pradānaṃ vai tataḥ śreṣṭhatamaṃ matam ||38|| dugdhadāḥ puṇyadāḥ prāṇapradāḥ pretapramokṣadāḥ | gāśca datvā sarvakāmapradaḥ syādiha vā pare ||39|| havyaṃ kavyaṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca śāntiṃ yānaṃ tathāmbaram | vṛddhabālāditṛptiṃ cāpnuyād gopradamānavaḥ ||3.101.40|| gāvaḥ surabhigandhinyastathā guggulagandhayaḥ | gāvaḥ pratiṣṭhā lokānāṃ gāvaḥ svastyayanaṃ mahat ||41 || na duṣyatyanilo nāgnirna suvarṇaṃ na codadhiḥ | na dugdhaṃ nāmṛtaṃ nātapo gauḥ sādhurna neśvaraḥ ||42|| gāvo dhanaṃ nityalabhyaṃ gāvaḥ puṣṭiḥ sanātanī | gāvo lakṣmyāḥ paraṃ mūlaṃ sampadāṃ mūlameva tāḥ ||43|| annaṃ hi paramaṃ gosthaṃ devānāṃ paramaṃ haviḥ | svāhāvaṣaṭ gosthitau ca goṣu dattaṃ hi śāśvatam ||44|| gāvo yajñaphalaṃ cāpi goṣu yajñāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ | gobhyo rasāḥ pravardhante bālāḥ pāyasajīvinaḥ ||45|| yāni kāni tu pāpāni svalpānyatikṛtāni vā | dhenuṃ dadati ye te vai taranti yānti mokṣaṇam ||46 || kapilāṃ ye prayacchanti savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanām | sabhūṣāṃ vastrasaṃvītāmubhau lokau jayanti te ||47|| śaṃkarāya purā kṛṣṇo vṛṣabhaṃ pradadau tataḥ | vṛṣabhasya pradānaṃ vai pravṛttaṃ tūttamaṃ bhuvi ||48|| yuvānamucchritaṃ śvetaṃ bhūriśṛṃgamalaṅakṛtam | vṛṣabhaṃ ye prayacchanti bhavantyaiśvaryaśālinaḥ ||49|| gāḥ smṛtvā ca hariṃ santaṃ smṛtvā svapyāt sadā niśi | utthāya tān smareccāpi namasyet puṣṭimāpnuyāt ||3.101.50 || aniṣṭaṃ svapnamālakṣya gāṃ muhuḥ samprakīrtayet | gokarīṣaiḥ pācayecca gomayaiḥ śuddhimācaret ||51 || goghṛtena juhuyācca ghṛtena svasti vācayet | ghṛtaṃ dadyād ghṛtaṃ prāśnīyāt gavāṃ puṣṭimaśnute ||52|| gaurme cāgre sadā cāstu pṛṣṭhe pārśve sadāstu ca | sarvaratnamayī dhenuṃ tāṃ dadāmi śubhāptaye ||53 || gāvo māmupatiṣṭhantu hemaśṛṃgyaḥ payomucaḥ | surabhyaḥ saurabheyyaśca gāvaḥ paśyantu māṃ sadā ||54|| gāvaḥ satyo devatāśca sādhvyo lakṣmyaḥ pativratāḥ | santo muktā īśvarāśca guravaḥ sādhavaḥ śurāḥ ||55|| bhaktiḥ puṇyaṃ vṛṣaḥ sevā dattaṃ taptaṃ hyupakṛtam | mahābhayeṣu rakṣanti sameṣu viṣameṣu ca ||56 || śṛṇu lakṣmi paśavo’pi dhenavo bhuvamāgatāḥ | tapaścakruḥ purā sarvā gacchema śreṣṭhatāmiti ||57|| sarvābhyo dakṣiṇābhyo’pi vayaṃ śreṣṭhatamā tviti | sarvapāpapraṇāśinyo limpāmo dūṣaṇairna ca ||58|| asmadgavyādibhiḥ sarvo janaḥ pūyeta vai tathā | śakṛtā cāpi mūtreṇa pūtāḥ syuḥ sarvadehinaḥ ||59|| godātāraśca golokaṃ gaccheyuriti padmaje | tāpasībhyo varān brahmā dadau dhenubhya uttamān ||3.101.60 || evaṃ bhavata yoginyo lokām̐stārayateti ca | sarvathā ca pavitrāḥ stho mokṣadā bhavateti ca ||6 1 || lakṣmīrvasatu gośakṛti tān varān dadāmyaham | evaṃ datvā varān brahmā yayau satyaṃ tataśca tāḥ ||62|| prātarnamasyāḥ pūjyāśca sarvathā puṣṭidāḥ śubhāḥ | lokakalyāṇakāriṇyo babhūvurbhavatārikāḥ ||63|| samānavatsāṃ kapilāṃ dhenuṃ datvā payasvinīm | saumyāṃ bhūṣāmbarayutāṃ brahmaloke mahīyate ||64|| lohitāṃ tādṛśīṃ datvā sūryaloke mahīyate | śabalāṃ tādṛśīṃ datvā somaloke mahīyate ||65|| śvetāṃ ca tādṛśīṃ datvā śakraloke mahīyate | kṛṣṇāṃ ca tādṛśīṃ datvā vahniloke mahīyate ||66 || dhūmrāṃ ca tādṛśīṃ datvā dharmaloke mahīyate | pāṇḍurāṃ tādṛśīṃ datvā vāruṇaṃ lokamaśrute ||67|| vādalavarṇāṃ gāṃ datvā vāyuloke mahīyate | hiraṇyavarṇāṃ piṃgākṣīṃ datvā kuberatāmiyāt ||68|| pītāṃ datvā tādṛśīṃ tu pitṛloke mahīyate | karburāṃ tādṛśīṃ datvā viśvadevaḥ prajāyate ||69|| gaurīṃ ca tādṛśīṃ datvā vasulokamavāpnuyāt | pāṇḍukambalavarṇāṃ gāṃ datvā sādhyasuro bhavet ||3.101.70|| viśālapṛṣṭhāṃ datvā gāṃ marullokān prapadyate | ratnāḍhyāṃ tādṛśīṃ datvā gandharvatāmavāpnuyāt ||71 || anaḍvāhaṃ mahokṣaṃ vā sarvaratnairalaṃkṛtam | datvā yuvānaṃ tu loke prajāpatermahīyate ||72|| godātā yāti paramaṃ svargaṃ golokamityapi | vimānenārkavarṇena vṛṣayānena vāmbare ||73|| svarge taṃ gopradātāraṃ sahasrasurayoṣitaḥ | sevante satataṃ prātarbodhayanti sukīrtanaiḥ ||74|| yāvanti dhenuromāṇi tāvadvarṣāṇi modate | dhenudaśca tato bhūmau gobhūpālo bhavatyapi ||75|| ghṛtakṣīrapradā gāvo ghṛtadehā ghṛtodbhavāḥ | ghṛtanadyo ghṛtāvarttāḥ santu me satataṃ gṛhe ||76|| gāvo me hṛdaye nityaṃ gāvo nābhyāṃ tathātmani | gāvaḥ sarvatra dehe me gāvo vasantu mānase ||77|| ghṛtaṃ tāsāṃ mama dehendriyaprāṇeṣu tiṣṭhati | gāvaḥ santvagrato me ca pṛṣṭhataḥ santu dhenavaḥ ||78|| sarvataḥ santu gāvo me gomadhye’haṃ vasāmi hi | evaṃbhāvayamānasya kṣīyante pāpakoṭayaḥ ||79 || yatra kānakasaudhāśca svarṇāgamo hyamāpakaḥ | devyo gāndharvakuśalā yatrāmṛtaṃ samṛddhayaḥ ||3.101.80|| dadhikulyā ghṛtakulyā payaḥkulyāśca yatra ca | navanītakulyā yatra tatra yānti gavāṃ pradāḥ ||81 || sahasragopradātā tu svarge deveśvaro bhavet | lakṣagodānakṛt samrāṭ trailokyasya bhaved rame ||82|| koṭigodānakartā tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti mokṣabhāk | arbudagopradātā tu golokaṃ yāti mokṣabhāg ||83 || abjadhenupradātā tvakṣaraṃ dhāma prayāti vai | daśagodānataḥ preto mucyate sṛṣṭibandhanāt ||84|| mātaraṃ pitaraṃ smṛtvā patnīṃ smṛtvā pitāmahān | godātā tatkulānyekādaśoddhārayati dhruvam ||85|| gāṃ smṛtvā tiladānena jaladānena vāpi ca | pretasya yamaloke vai nirasyati tu yātanāḥ ||86|| mātaro dugdhadātryo me devavāsā hi dhenavaḥ | gāvo māmupatiṣṭhantāmiti nityaṃ prakīrtayet ||87|| godānaṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ phalaṃ ca śāśvataṃ yataḥ | kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyeta svargārthaṃ gopradāyinaḥ ||88|| gāvo dāne yamuddiṣṭāstārayanti hi taṃ janam | dhārayanti bālakām̐śca vardhayanti payo’mṛtaiḥ ||89|| gāvo vai mānave loke svarge satye bhavanti vai | aiśvare cāpi vaikuṇṭhe goloke ca bhavanti hi ||3.101.90|| akṣare bhūriśṛṃgāśca gāvo’yāso vasanti vai | gāvo yajñasya yajñatvaṃ daivataṃ dyusadāmapi ||9 1 || gāvaḥ pratiṣṭhā bhūtānāṃ gāvaḥ puṇyaṃ parāyaṇam | gāvaḥ samāsata satraṃ siṣāsantyaḥ śaphām̐stathā ||92|| śṛṃgāṇi cāpi daśame māsi vedhāstato dadau | tāsāṃ śṛṃgāṇyajāyanta yāsāṃ yādṛṅmatāni vai ||93||
