gāvastejo mahad divyaṃ pālayanti susādhavaḥ | sukṛtinaḥ puṇyabhājo gavāṃ sevāratāḥ surāḥ ||94|| yatra drumā miṣṭarasā madhusrāvaphalānvitāḥ | madhusugandhipuṣpāśca bhūmirmaṇimayī tathā ||95|| yatra kāñcanabhūbhāgāḥ sukhadāḥ kāmadāstathā | sarvavidhairutpalaiśca bhānti yatra jalāśayāḥ ||96 || kesarā yatra vartante saurabhāḍhyā marudgatāḥ | ṣaḍrasāḥ phalinaḥ stambāḥ śākāni ca madhūni ca ||97|| muktāphullā vallayaśca saphalāścāmṛtapradāḥ | sauvarṇā girayo yatra nityanūtanaśobhinaḥ ||98|| navarūpadharā nāryo sevante muktakoṭikāḥ | sarvakāmāḥ sarasāḥ sarvabhogā bhavanti ca ||99|| yatra cāndanāraṇyāni ramante tatra gopradāḥ | sarvasaṃkalpasamṛddhā niḥśokā bhāgyavarddhitāḥ || 3.101.1 00|| vimāneṣu vicitreṣu mahodyāneṣu yānti ca | modante gopradātāra upakrīḍanti sarvaśaḥ || 101 || viharanti strījanaiśca pūjyante svargibhistathā | modaṃ pramodamānandān sukhāni bhuñjate’nvaham || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sādhūnāṃ yogahīnasya pretasyoddharaṇe godānaṃ heturiti gomāhātmyādinirūpaṇanāmaikādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 101 ||
<3.102> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca gavārādhanasaṃjñaṃ ca vrataṃ kuryurvimuktaye | pretasya vaṃśajā bhāryā putraḥ sambandhibāndhavāḥ || 1 || gavāṃ goṣṭhe nivasanaṃ gavāṃ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ tathā | gavānvāhāramevāpi gavānvapānamityapi || 2 || gavānvaśayanaṃ cāpi goprākprabodhanaṃ tathā | gosthalīmārjanādyaṃ ca daṃśādīnāṃ nivāraṇam || 3 || śādvalaghāsadānaṃ ca gavyāhārastathārhaṇam | rakṣaṇaṃ sarvathā śaśvad goṣṭhe vāsaḥ sadā tathā || 4 || druhyenna manasā vāpi goṣu nityaṃ sukhapradaḥ | arcayeta ramābuddhyā namaskāraiḥ prapūjayet || 5 || tryahamuṣṇaṃ pibenmūtraṃ tryahamuṣṇaṃ pibet payaḥ | tryahaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibeduṣṇaṃ vāyubhakṣastryahaṃ bhavet || 6 || vahed ghṛtaṃ tu śirasā vahniṃ saṃjuhuyād ghṛtaiḥ | ghṛtaṃ dadyāttathāśnīyādghṛtena svasti vācayet || 7 || gavocchiṣṭayavabhakṣo brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati | daityaiśca dānavairyuktāḥ prasahya bhojane surāḥ || 8 || āśitā nijabhakṣyāṇi tataḥ śuddhyarthameva ha | gavārādhanasaṃjñaṃ vai vrataṃ māsakṛtaṃ kṛtam || 9 || tataḥ śuddhāḥ punardevāḥ saṃsiddhā nijakarmasu | ato gāvaḥ pavitrāśca pāvanāḥ puṇyadāstathā || 3.102.1 0|| godānaṃ tacchubhaṃ datvā śuddhyati svargamaśnute | agnimadhye gavāṃ madhye satāṃ madhye vasannapi || 11 || vipramadhye satīmadhye vedamadhye vasannapi | yajñamadhye tīrthamadhye vasan śuddhyati pātakāt || 12|| gāvastuṣṭāḥ prayacchanti putraṃ dhanaṃ patiṃ priyām | śṛṇu śrīśivarājñīśri purā śrīstvaṃ svabhāvataḥ || 1 3|| kāntaṃ vapurvinirmāya gomadhye saṃsthitābhavaḥ | gāvaścāścaryasampannā vīkṣyate rūpasampadam || 14|| papracchustvāṃ kāsi kanye kuto’si rūpasundarī | kathaṃ cātrāgatā saumye vada cenmanyase hi naḥ || 15|| tadā tvaṃ gāḥ praṇamyaivoditavatī prasāditā | viṣṇukāntāsmi bhadraṃ vaḥ śrīrnāmāhaṃ hareḥ priyā || 16|| mayābhipannā devādyā modante śāśvatīḥ samāḥ | sūryaścandro mahendraśca vasavo devakoṭayaḥ || 17|| agnirāpo mayāviṣṭāḥ smṛddhyudbhāvā bhavanti vai | yānnāviśāmyahaṃ gāvaste vinaśyanti sarvathā || 18|| yatra dharmārthakāmāśca mayā juṣṭā hi tadgṛham | modapramodaśāntyāḍhyaṃ mahānandabhṛtaṃ bhavet || 1 9|| icchāmi cāpi yuṣmāsu vastuṃ bhavata madyutāḥ | strīvarge me sadā vastuṃ vāñcchā jātāsmi vai dhruvā ||3.102.20 || śrutvā gāvaśca bhavatīṃ prāhustvaṃ cañcalā hyasi | sarvagāṃ tvāṃ na cecchāmo bhadraṃ te’nyatra gamyatām ||2 1 || śrutvā tvaṃ cārthitavatī kathaṃ māṃ nābhinandatha | mahadugraṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā māṃ niṣevanti mānavāḥ || 22|| yakṣā asurā gandharvā īśvarā uragā surāḥ | kathaṃ māṃ pratigṛhṇīdhvaṃ naiva yūyaṃ hi durlabhām || 23 || śrutvaivaṃ dhenavaḥ prāhuścalacittāsi sarvathā | bahunā tu kimuktena tatastvāṃ varjayāmahe || 24|| śrutvaivaṃ tvaṃ coktavatī cāñcalyaṃ santyajāmyaham | bhavatīnāṃ kṛte gāvo vastuṃ sthānaṃ prayacchatha | |25|| tato gāvaścoktavatyaḥ śakṛnmūtre vasa dhruvā | omityavasastvaṃ lakṣmi gavāṃ mūtre ca śakṛti || 26|| gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ tasmāllakṣmi gṛhaṃ tavāsmi vai | yatra tvaṃ tatra cāhaṃ ca nivasāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 27|| evaṃ jñātvā mahimānaṃ gāṃ prayacchanti ye janāḥ | hutaśiṣṭāśinaste vai satriṇo’dhvariṇaśca te || 28|| ṛte dadhi ghṛtaṃ nātra yajñaḥ kaścit pravartate | tato yajñasya yajñatvaṃ gomūlakaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 29|| goputrāḥ satataṃ loke kṛṣiyogamupāsate | utpādayanti dhānyāni pravartante makhāśca taiḥ ||3.102.3 0 || vahanti vividhān bhārān kṣuttṛṣādiprapīḍitāḥ | sādhūṃśca dhārayantīha pṛṣṭhe ca śakaṭe’pi ca ||3 1 || golokaṃ sannayantyeva dattā dāne paretakam | tasmāt sthānaṃ gavāmūrdhvaṃ svargāt satyāt tathaiśvarāt ||32|| golokaṃ vai gavāṃ sthānaṃ mama kṛṣṇasya mandiram | godātā yāti golokaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇālayam || 33|| anyacchṛṇu mahālakṣmi purā devayuge khalu | aditistu tapastepe viṣṇuḥ putro bhavenmama ||34|| ekapādena tapatīṃ vīkṣya dakṣasutā tadā | surabhīnāmikā cāpi tapastepe tayā saha ||35|| tadā gatvā svayaṃ brahmāditaye sadvaraṃ dadau | viṣṇuḥ putraste bhavitā surakāryakaro hariḥ ||36|| surabhyai varadānaṃ ca dattavān viśvasṛṭ tadā | dakṣasute tāpasi tvaṃ hyamarītvamavāpsyasi ||37|| īśvarītvaṃ ca gopītvamavāpsyasi savaṃśajā | muktānītvaṃ tathā mokṣadātrītvaṃ saṃvrajiṣyasi || 38|| sṛṣṭitraye pūjyatamopariṣṭācca nivatsyasi | gopradāstām̐śca golokān gopatervai prasādataḥ ||39|| vāsasthānānyavāpsyanti yatra vasanti dhenavaḥ | bhūriśṛṃgā yatra gāvo yāsyanti vaṃśajāstathā ||3.102.40|| urugāyasya kṛṣṇasya taddhāma paramaṃ padam | havyārpaṇādipuṇyena yā vai duhitarastava ||41|| devasevāprakartryaḥ syurnivatsyanti ca tatpade | manasā cintitā bhogāḥ sampatsyante sukhāstava ||42|| godātṝṇāṃ pare lokāḥ sarvakāmasamanvitāḥ | na yeṣu kramate mṛtyurna jarā na ca pāvakaḥ ||43|| na dāridryaṃ nāśubhaṃ ca vidyate gopade kvacit | tatra divyānyaraṇyāni divyāni bhavanāni ca ||44|| vimānāni sudivyāni kāmagāni bhavanti ca | ghṛtakulyā dadhikulyāḥ payaḥkulyā bhavanti ca ||45|| puṣkariṇyo’mṛtānāṃ ca navanītādrayo’pi ca | śarkarāmadhususvādāḥ sudhācayā bhavanti ca ||46|| taruṇyo gopikā yatra bhavanti divyabhūṣitāḥ | godātāraḥ prayāsyanti saurabhi tvatpadaṃ param ||47|| brahmacaryeṇa tapasā sevayā ca satāṃ hareḥ | dānaiḥ puṇyairdamenāpi satyena tīrthasevanaiḥ ||48|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktyā rādhābhaktyā viśeṣataḥ | śakyaḥ samāsādayituṃ golokaḥ kṛṣṇaśobhitaḥ ||49|| gobhakto labhate sarvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ kāmitaṃ śubham | bhaktāḥ striyo labhante ca kāmitaṃ sarvamuttam ||3.102.5 0|| putrārthī labhate putraṃ kanyārthī kanyakāṃ tathā | vittārthī labhate vittaṃ dharmārthī dharmamāpnuyāt ||5 1|| mokṣārthī prāpnuyānmokṣaṃ sampadarthī tu sampadaḥ | vidyārthī cāpnuyād vidyāṃ sukhārthī labhate sukham ||52|| rasārthī labhate rasyaṃ dārḍhyārthī dṛḍhatāṃ tathā | patyarthinī patiṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kāntārthī sundarīṃ śubhām ||5 3 || sutārthī labhate putrīṃ svargārthī svargamāpnuyāt | gopradātā mahārājyaṃ labhate pārthivaṃ hyapi ||54|| aindraṃ padaṃ sūryapadaṃ cāndraṃ kauberakaṃ padam | yāmyapadaṃ tathā dharmye vāhnyaṃ caiśamityapi |||55|| kailāsaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ vairājaṃ padamityapi | labheta śreṣṭhagolokaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ labheta ca ||56||| ārogyaṃ labhate godo yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ labheta ca | gajavājisurabhīśca labheta gopradaḥ khalu ||57|| rūpaṃ ratnāni vastrāṇi maiṇīn sauvarṇaśevadhim | labhate gopradātā vai smṛtaṃ godānakālikam ||58|| apamṛtyurvinaśyecca pretatvaṃ dūrato vrajet | pāpāni saṃpraṇaśyeyurgodātuśca smṛtasya ca ||59|| ityevaṃ varadānāni dadau brahmā hi dhenave | na kiñcid durlabhaṃ lakṣmi gobhaktasya bhavediha ||3.102.6 0|| siddhayaścāṇimādyāśca sarveśvaryādisampadaḥ | yāvantaśca camatkārā bhavanti dhenude rame ||6 1|| vedapuṇyaṃ makhapuṇyaṃ kanyāpuṇyaṃ ca dakṣiṇā | bhūmipuṇyaṃ svarṇapuṇyaṃ godānena prajāyate ||62|| godānena samaṃ deyaṃ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇātmakam | aprāptāyāṃ mūrtimatyāṃ deyā dhenurhi kānakī ||63|| sadā bhūmergavāmarthaṃ deyaṃ suvarṇamityapi | svarṇaṃ gauḥ pṛthivī ceti trīṇi dānāni padmaje ||64|| pretamuktikarāṇyeva bhavanti nātra saṃśayaḥ | gāśca bhūmiṃ ca vittaṃ ca datvā pāpī prapūyate ||65|| ajo’gnirvaruṇo meṣaḥ sūryo’śvaḥ prāg vyajāyata | tattaddānāni vai pretamuktaye’pi bhavanti hi ||66|| kuṃjarāśca mṛgā nāgā mahiṣāścāsurā hi te | āsurayonimuktyarthaṃ hastyādidānamuttamam ||67|| kukkuṭaśca varāhāśca rākṣasāḥ parikīrtitāḥ | rakṣoyonivimuktyarthaṃ tattaddānaṃ praśasyate ||68|| iḍā gāvaḥ payaḥ somo bhūmirajāyataiva ha | pretādīnāṃ vimuktyarthaṃ gobhūdānaṃ praśasyate ||69|| agnirhi devatā svarṇaṃ devatā śasyate tataḥ | svarṇadānaṃ paraṃ proktaṃ devadānaṃ śubhapradam ||3.102.70|| agnyabhāve tu kurute vahnisthāneṣu kāṃcanam | kuśastambe juhotyagniṃ suvarṇaṃ tatra ca sthite ||71 || viprahaste sādhuhaste darbhastambe’jakarṇake | apsu kāṣṭhe suvarṇe ca juhotyagnerasannidhau ||72|| hute prītikarīmṛddhiṃ śrīpatiḥ samprayacchati | nityaṃ dadāti sauvarṇaṃ yathāśakti tu yojanaḥ ||73|| brahmavāyvāgnisomānāṃ sālokyamupayāti saḥ | mātā pitā sutaśceti gārhasthyaṃ tryātmakaṃ śubham ||74|| gavāṃ svarṇasya pṛthvyāśca dānaṃ tryātmakamuttamam | śraddhāsnehaścādaraśca tredhātithiprasādakṛt ||75|| tathā bhūgosuvarṇāni paralokapradāni vai | bhavanaṃ sampado vṛttistredhā saukhyaprasādhanam ||76|| dhenubhūkanakānyevaṃ dāne saukhyapradāni vai | jñānaṃ śāntiśca nivṛttistrayaścānandahetavaḥ ||77|| dhenukṣitisvarṇakāni mahānandapradāni vai | bhaktirhariśca mokṣaśca sambaddhāste trayaḥ sadā ||78|| sādhuḥ śīlaṃ kṣamā ceti sambaddhāste trayo’pi ca | tathā dāne svarṇadhenubhuvo baddhā hi nityaśaḥ ||79|| bhuktidā muktidāścāpi pretoddhārakarāstathā | svargadāḥ pāpapuñjānāṃ nāśakā puṇyadāstrayaḥ ||3.102.80|| goyajñātma gavāṃ dānaṃ pitṛyajñaṃ tu tarpaṇam | satāṃ yajñaṃ bhojanaṃ ca datvā sauvarṇadakṣiṇām ||81 || nārāyaṇabaliṃ kṛtvā nīlapucchāditarpaṇam | kārayitvābhyarthitasya dānaṃ pretaṃ pramokṣayet ||82|| ityevaṃ kathitā lakṣmi pretamuktiḥ śubhodbhavā | mokṣaśāstrakṛtaṃ cāpi pārāyaṇaṃ pramocayet ||83|| nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ cāpi hyakhaṇḍabhajanaṃ mama | satāṃ karajatoyaṃ ca muktidaṃ pretayonitaḥ ||84|| avabhṛthaṃ pavitraṃ ca snānaṃ śrāddhaṃ śubhe kṣaṇe | sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi sparśanaṃ ca nideśanam ||85|| muktidaṃ pretayonestu tīrthavāriniṣevaṇam | yatra kvāpi gataścāpi mucyate bhajanāddhareḥ ||86|| yakṣo vā rākṣaso vāpi bhūtaḥ pretaḥ piśācakaḥ | sarpo vā paśudeho’pi yāmyo vā vāyudehavān ||87|| ḍākinī vā śākinī vā bhūtī piśācinī ca vā | vetālinī vā vetālo yatra kvāpi gato’pi vā ||88|| sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ yadvā prasādaṃ śrīhareśca vā | labhate vā jalaṃ cāpi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||89|| santo hi tārakā loke pāpānāṃ nāśakāstathā | kalmaṣāṇāṃ hārakāśca divyatāmokṣasampradāḥ || 3.102.9 0|| gosvarṇavahnidevebhyaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ santaḥ sadā rame | satāṃ yogo mama yogaḥ sarvapumarthadaḥ khalu ||9 1|| ekadā puṣkaso nāmnā bhāruṇḍo madyapānakṛt | māṃsādaḥ śīlahīnaśca steno mṛto vanāntare || 92|| yāmyairnīto yamapūryāṃ narakeṣu nipātitaḥ | tatpatnyā tu kṛtaṃ tīrthe godānaṃ svarṇamalpitam || 93 || pretasya sarvapāpāni dūrībhūtāni tatkṣaṇāt | pretaḥ svargaṃ yayau tūrṇaṃ pāpāni surabhīṃ yayuḥ || 94|| surabhī sāha pāpāni nāśayituṃ tu vedhase | puṣkasasya tu pāpāni mayi lagnāni dānataḥ || 95|| māyā nāśayitavyāni kutra gatvā pitarvada | śrutvā brahmāha tāṃ gāṃ ca yāhi sanatkumārakam || 96 || sādhuṃ śīlavrataṃ drāk sa nāśayiṣyatyaghāni te | śrūtvā gatvā surabhyenaṃ sādhuṃ neme tathārthayat ||97|| pāpanāśārthamevāpi sādhuḥ pādajalaṃ dadau | papau sā surabhī gauśca naṣṭānyaghāni satvaram || 98 || tataḥ surabhī brahmāṇaṃ prayayau saṃskṛtā satā | jagāda ślokān santuṣṭā natvā śrīvedhasaṃ gurum || 99|| dhanyā vai sādhavo loke śīlino rāgavarjitāḥ | amāyikā divyarūpāḥ pāpanāśo yadāśrayāt || 3.102.100 || tīrthānāṃ kāmadhenūnāṃ satīnāṃ ca tapasvinām | viprāṇāṃ yāni pāpāni tāni naśyanti sādhuṣu || 101 || pitṝṇāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca maharṣīṇāṃ ca yoṣitām | dehināṃ yāni pāpāni tāni naśyanti sādhuṣu || 1 02|| rājñāṃ rakṣasāṃ yakṣāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ yāmyavāsinām | asadgatīnāṃ pāpāni naśyantyeva hi sādhuṣu || 103 || kāmināṃ krodhināṃ cāpi lobhināṃ mohināṃ tathā | ghātināṃ yāni pādyāni tāni naśyanti sādhuṣu || 1 04|| hatyānāṃ paśumārāṇāṃ krūrāṇāṃ prāṇarodhinām | viśvāsahaṇāṃ pāpāni naśyantyeva hi sādhuṣu || 105 || gaṇikānāṃ puṃścalīnāṃ dhvajināṃ cakriṇāṃ tathā | śastriṇāṃ cāpi vaidyānāṃ naśyantyaghāni sādhuṣu || 106 || śritaghnānāṃ bālaghnānāmagnidānāṃ viṣādinām | viṣadānāṃ vanaghnānāṃ naśyantyaghāni sādhuṣu || 1 07|| ityuktvā prayayau goṣṭhaṃ lakṣmi surabhī suvratā | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya naśyeyuḥ pāpakoṭayaḥ || 108 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne gavārādhananāmavrataṃ gośakṛnmūtrayorlakṣmīvāso godānavividhaphalāni pretoddhārakāṇi sādhvāśrayaḥ sarvoddhārakaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 102 ||
<3.103> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca kadā kāle pradānena svarṇagobhūmayaḥ phalam | kīdṛśaṃ samadadati tanme bodhaya keśava || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca datvā dānāni prathame dine śuklasya padmaje | śrāddhabhojanayuktāni prāpnuyāt subhagāḥ priyāḥ || 2 || dvitīyāyāṃ tathā datvā labhate kanyakāḥ sutān | tṛtīyāyāṃ tathā datvā labhate śreṣṭhavājinaḥ || 3 || caturthyāṃ tu tadā datvā labhate paśugodhanam | pañcamyāṃ tu tathā datvā labhate sadguṇān sutān || 4 || ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu ca tathā datvā labhate sadyaśo balam | saptamyāṃ tu tathā datvā labhate kṣetravāṭikām || 5 || aṣṭamyāṃ tu tathā datvā labhate dravyamuttamam | navamyāṃ tu tathā datvā hastyuṣṭrāśvādikān labhet || 6 || daśamyāṃ tu tathā datvā kāmadhenuyuto bhavet | ekādaśyāṃ tathā datvā rūpyaśevadhimān bhavet || 7 || dvādaśyāṃ tu tathā datvā svarṇaratnādimān bhavet | trayodaśyāṃ tathā datvā lokarājastathā bhavet || 8 || caturdaśyāṃ tathā datvā sāmrājyaṃ samavāpnuyāt | pūrṇamāsyāṃ tathā datvā camatkārī jano bhavet || 9 || amāyāṃ tu tathā datvā sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt | me jayantyāṃ tathā datvā mokṣaṃ paramamāpnuyāt || 3.103.1 0|| nakṣatreṣu viśeṣeṇa dānaphalaṃ vadāmi ca | kṛttikāyāṃ pradānena bhavedvai vigatajvaraḥ || 1 1|| rohiṇyāṃ sampradānena cāpatyavān bhavejjanaḥ | dānena mṛgaśirasi tejasvī mānavān bhavet || 12|| ārdrāyāṃ tu pradānena jayavān sarvadā bhavet| | punarvasau pradānena dhanavān ṛddhimān bhavet || 1 3|| puṣye dānapradātā tu sarvathā puṣṭimān bhavet | āśleṣāyāṃ pradānena dhīrān putrānavāpnuyāt || 14|| maghāyāṃ tu pradānena prajāprādhānyamāpnuyāt | pūrvāphālgunikādānācchreṣṭhabhāgyayuto bhavet || 15|| uttarāphālgunīdānādbahvapatyo bhavejjanaḥ | haste dānaprakartā tu kāryaphalāni cāpnuyāt || 16|| citrāyāṃ tu pradānena labhed rūpavataḥ sutān | svātau dānapradātā tu vāṇijyaratnavān bhavet ||17|| viśākhāyāṃ pradātā tu suputro bahuputravān | anurādhāsu dātā syāccakravartī pradhānakaḥ || 18|| jyeṣṭhāyāṃ sampradātā vai cādhipatyaṃ labhediha | mūle dānaprakartā tu labhedārogyamuttamam || 1 9|| pūrvāṣāḍhāpradānena yaśobhāṅmānavān bhavet | uttarāṣāḍhikādānād vītaśoko bhavet sadā ||3.103.20|| dānaṃ tvabhijiti kurvan bhiṣaksiddhimavāpnuyāt | śravaṇe dānakartā tu labhetsuparamāṃ gatim ||21 || dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ pradātā syādācāryo gururāṇnṛpaḥ | śatabhiṣāpradānena dhātusiddhimavāpnuyāt ||22|| pūrvabhādrapadādānaphalaṃ cājāvikādikam | uttaraproṣṭhapadādo govājigajavān bhavet ||23|| revatyāṃ tu pradānena svarṇarūpyādimān bhavet | aśvinīdānakartā syānmahiṣyaśvādimān janaḥ ||24|| bharaṇyāṃ dānado dīrghajīvī bhavenna saṃśayaḥ | gobhūsvarṇapradātā vai sarvaphalānyavāpnuyāt ||25||| parīkṣeta na vai dānapātrāṇi dānadharmavit | daive paitrye ca sādhavye parīkṣeta na vai kvacit ||26|| vidyāvanto bhaktimanto brahmiṣṭhāḥ sarvapāvanāḥ | sadācāraparā brahmadeyāśca sāmagā dvijāḥ ||27|| mātāpitṛsevakāśca devānāṃ sevakāstathā | brahmacaryaparāḥ śuddhā yatayaḥ sarvapāvanāḥ ||28|| satyadharmavrataśīlāḥ puṇyatīrthaniṣeviṇaḥ | makhābhiṣekavantaścāvabhṛthasnānakāriṇaḥ ||29|| pārāyaṇapravaktārastāpasāḥ kīrtane ratāḥ | mokṣamārgaparāḥ kathāvācakā dharmadeśakāḥ ||3.103.30 || gurumantrapradā vṛddhādarā gosevakāśca ye | sādhavaḥ sādhusevāḍhyāḥ pātrāṇi sarvapāvanāḥ ||3 1|| agryā dharmapralekheṣu mokṣalekheṣu cāgragāḥ | vidyāśrayā jñānaśīlāḥ śāntā vai paṃktipāvānāḥ ||32|| yāvadete prapaśyanti paṃktiṃ punanti tatkṣaṇāt | dhyānajñānaparā bhaktiparāstapaḥparāstathā ||33|| nirguṇakriyayā yuktāḥ sādhavaḥ paṃktipāvanāḥ | pretānāṃ muktidāḥ santo bhojitāḥ pūjitā natāḥ || 34|| bhaktimantastāpasāśca santo brahmāṇḍapāvanāḥ | tapaścaiṣāmindriyāṇāṃ nigrahaḥ paramaṃ matam ||35|| manaso nigrahaścāpi śrīharerdhāraṇaṃ sadā | tyāgasya cāpi sampattistapa uttamameva tat ||36||| upavāso brahmacaryaṃ maunaṃ kṣamā tapaḥ param | titikṣā tuṣṭiraudāryaṃ sahanaṃ tapa uttamam | | 37 || ṛtavāditvamevāpi vighasāśitvamityapi | amṛtāśitvamevāpi paramaṃ tapa ucyate || 38 || ekabhukto bhavedeva sadopavāsivat khalu | ekapatnīvrataścāpi brahmacārī sadā bhavet || 39 || ṛtumātraprasaṃgī ca sādhureva bhaveddhi saḥ | strīmātrasaṃgarahito mukto bhūmau na saṃśayaḥ || 3.103.40 || svarṇastrīpāśarahito dvibhujaḥ parameśvaraḥ | tādṛśī strī dharmayuktā sākṣānnārāyaṇī matā | |4 1 | | sādhvī sā dānapātraṃ ca satī pātraṃ tathottamam | vidhavā dānapātraṃ cāpyanāthā dānapātrakam | |42|| kanyakā dānapātraṃ ca vṛddhā dānasya pātrakam | nirāśrayā dānapātraṃ yadi bhaktivṛṣānvitā | |43 || dānadātā pavitro vai sadā bhavati bhaktimān | vibhajya ca tato bhuṃkte’mṛtabhojī bhaveddhi saḥ | | 44|| devebhyaḥ sannivedyāttā vighasāśī bhaveddhi saḥ | etādṛśasya bhavane hyadṛśyā api ṛddhayaḥ || 45 || mūrtarūpaṃ paraṃ prāpya modante modayanti tam | devatāḥ pitaraḥ siddhā yogino yatayastathā | |46 | | santa īśā īśvarāṇyo ramante dātṛmandire | apsarasaśca gandharvāḥ surā devyaśca sādhavaḥ ||47 || satyaśca bhāgyavatyaśca tathā ca kāmadhenavaḥ | putrāḥ pautrāḥ sutāḥ putryo gāvaścāsya bhavanti hi ||48 || evaṃ dātuḥ kuṭumbaṃ vai sarvaṃ devakulaṃ bhavet | paśavo devapaśavaḥ sasyāni daivatānyapi ||49 || svarṇarūpyādikaṃ sarvaṃ lakṣmīrūpaṃ sudaivatam | bhāgyānyapi ca sarvāṇi rūpaṃ bhūṣāśca daivatam | | 3.103.50 || evaṃ dāturbhavedeva divyaṃ daivaṃ kuṭumbakam | tasmāllakṣmi pradātavyaṃ svarṇaṃ gauḥ pṛthivī śubhā | | 51 || yadi pācanaśaktiḥ syād grahītavyaṃ na cānyathā | alpaśakteḥ puṇyanāśo bhavatyeva pratigrahāt || 52 || saptarṣibhyaḥ purā rājā vṛṣādarbhiḥ samutsukaḥ | ratnānyadarśayad dātuṃ nāgṛhṇan ṛṣayastadā | |53 | | vṛṣādarbhiḥ svayaṃ prāha samarthāḥ stha pratigrahe | pratigrahastārayati vṛṇudhvaṃ vittamuttamam || 54|| suvarṇāni rūpyakāṇi mauktikāni ca hīrakān | maṇīn śvetagajānaśvān śvetān govṛṣabhām̐stathā ||55 || gṛṣṭīścāgnyāḥ kāmadhenūrgrāmān kṣetrāṇi cārpaye | rājyaṃ rājñīrdāsavargān dāsīdāsye mahāsabhāḥ ||56 || prāsādān saritaścādrīn dāsye vanāni sarvaśaḥ | gṛhṇantu brāhmaṇā me’dya viprāśca sādhavo mama ||57|| adeyaṃ me vidyate na mokṣārthaṃ prayate yataḥ | datvā pātrebhya evātra lapsye’haṃ śāśvataṃ phalam ||58|| ityevaṃ tvarthayantaṃ vai dānaṃ dātuṃ hyupasthitam | ṛṣayaḥ prāhuravyagrā dhīrāḥ śāntāḥ pratoṣiṇaḥ ||59|| rājan pratigraho rājñāṃ madhvāsvādo viṣopamaḥ | tad dāva iva nirdahyāt prāpto rājaparigrahaḥ ||3.103.60|| apratigrāhyamevātaḥ pretyeha ca sukhepsunā | rājadhanaṃ pratīcchan vai pāpiṣṭhāṃ labhate gatim ||61|| yat pṛthivyāṃ vrīhiyavaṃ hiraṇyaṃ paśavaḥ striyaḥ | sarvaṃ tannālamekasya tasmād vidvān śame vaset ||62|| utpannasya ruroḥ aṃgaṃ vardhamānasya vardhate | puruṣasya striyāścāpi tathecchā vardhate sadā ||63|| na talloke dravyamasti yallokān paritarpayet | samudratṛṣṇaḥ puruṣo na kadāpi pratuṣyati ||64|| kāmaṃ kāmayamānasya kāmo yadopayujyate | prakāmaḥ sa pravardheta satṛṣṇaścāti vidhyati ||65|| pratigrahe saṃyamo vai tapo dhārayate dhruvam | parigrahe tapaḥ sarvaṃ naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||66|| tapaḥsaṃcaya eveha viśiṣṭo dravyasañcayāt | tasmād rājān dhanaṃ te’stu mā viṣaṃ secaya dvije ||67|| dāvaṃ rājadhanaṃ naivecchāmaḥ śāntā maharṣayaḥ | svasti te’stu mahārāja yāmo vayaṃ divaṃ punaḥ ||68|| ityuktvā prayayuḥ sarvarṣayo dānagrahaṃ vinā | vṛṣādarbhistataḥ samyajjñātavān dānaghoratām ||69|| apātre’rpitadānasyāpathyatvaṃ sutarāṃ khalu | tasmāt pātraṃ hi dānānāṃ puṇyāśrayā dvijāstathā ||3.103.70 || santo’pi bhagadbhaktāstebhyo deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ | viprā api harerbhaktāstebhyo deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||71 || ye lobhaṃ naiva kurvanti svārthamātravivarjitāḥ | śrīhareḥ pūjakāstebhyo deyaṃ dānaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||72 || pātrajanaḥ sarvarītyā lobhaṃ sadā vivarjayet | haraye cārpaṇaṃ matvā gṛhṇīyānnānyathā kvacit ||73 || vṛṣādarbhistato lakṣmi prayāge kuṃbhayogake | dadau dānāni gatvaiva sādhubhyastāni bhāvavān ||74|| athāgataṃ vimānaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhād yāmune taṭe | gaṃgāyāḥ saṃgame viṣṇupārṣadaiḥ śobhitaṃ tadā ||75|| rājānaṃ pārṣadā nītvā yayurvikuṇṭhadhāma ha | evaṃ sādhujanānāṃ vai sevayā mokṣaṇaṃ rame ||76|| bhavatyeva na sandehastasmāt pātraṃ samarjayet | dadyādbhāvena tasmai ca haraye’rpaṇamastviti ||77|| atha dadyācchatradānaṃ copānaddānamityapi | dhotrakañcukadānaṃ ca śirastrāṇasamarpaṇam ||78|| bhavecchatrapatistena bhavedvimānagastathā | dadyāt siṃhāsanadānaṃ rājyādhipo bhavettataḥ ||79|| dadyāccāmaradānaṃ ca vetradānaṃ tathārpayet | dhvajadānaṃ prakuryācca rathadānaṃ carettathā ||3.103.80|| kośadānaṃ prakuryācca kaṇasañcayadānakam | ikṣukṣetrapradānaṃ ca sasyakṣetrapradānakam ||8 1|| sarovarārpaṇaṃ cāpi śākavāṭīpradānakam | udyānapuṣpavāṭyāderdānaṃ kuryātprayatnataḥ ||82|| śāṭībhūṣākañcukīna kuryād dānāni vai tathā | khadvāśayyāpradānāni kuryāt pretasya muktaye ||83|| pātragargarikādānaṃ kalaśasthālikārpaṇam | śṛṃgāravastudānāni dadyāt pretasya muktaye ||84|| udakuṃbhīdugdhakuṃbhīdadhikuṃbhīpradānakam | jaladroṇīghṛtakuṃbhīkaṇḍanyādisamarpaṇam ||85|| muśalasya pradānaṃ ca mārjanīsampradānakam | vyajanādeḥ pradānaṃ ca dīpapeṭīpradānakam ||86|| śayyādhrīsampradānaṃ ca pātradhrīsampradānakam | cullikāpeṣaṇīdānaṃ darvīcīpiṭikārpaṇam ||87|| sandaṃśadānaṃ kāṃgakeśīdānaṃ darpaṇadānakam | raśanārajjudānāni kārayet pretamuktaye ||88|| jaladānaṃ randhitānnapradānaṃ ca phalārpaṇam | payaḥpākādidānaṃ ca miṣṭānnānāṃ pradānakam ||89|| godhūmaśālitilānāṃ dānāni vividhāni ca | kuryād rasamadhukṣārārpaṇaṃ pretasya muktaye ||3.103.90|| mahākambaladānāni mahāmbarapradānakam | mahāśṛṃgāradānāni kuryāt pretasya muktaye ||91 || ekādaśyādipuṇyānāṃ dānaṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥ | vratadānaṃ tapodānaṃ bhaktidānaṃ kathārpaṇam ||92|| japadānaṃ dharmadānaṃ kuryāt pretasya muktaye | vāyuvāhanadānaṃ ca vahnivāhanadānakam || 93|| jalavāhanadānaṃ ca bhūvāhanapradānakam | narayānapradānaṃ ca yantravāhanadānakam ||94|| saudhadānaṃ mandirasya dānaṃ prāsādadānakam | grāmadānaṃ varmadānaṃ kuryāt pretasya muktaye ||95|| śṛṇu lakṣmi purā naije cāśrame saṃvasan ṛṣiḥ | krīḍan vai dhanuṣā bāṇān jamadagnirmumoca ha ||96|| tānānīya śarān patnī reṇukādāt punaḥ punaḥ | madhyāhne viṣatāpaśca sūryasyogro’bhavattadā ||97|| dagdhapādā tu sā patnī śanairāyāt patiṃ prati | muniḥ prāha kathaṃ kānte cirāyate śarāhṛtau ||98|| patnī prāhārkatāpena dagdhāpādā bhavāmi vai | munistūrṇaṃ samākarṇya śarānmumoca bhāskaram ||99|| sūryastrastaścāyayau ca viprarūpo muniṃ prati | uvācarṣe hata mā māṃ prasādaye kṣamasva mām || 3.103.100|| muniḥ prāha mama patnyāḥ panthāḥ sukhagamo yathā | bhavet tāpavihīno vai tathā sūrya vidhāpaya ||10 1|| śrutvā sūryo dadāvasmai chatropānahamāśu vai | svalpaṃ yānaṃ kāmagaṃ ca bhūṣāmbarāṇi vai tathā || 1 02|| pātramakṣayamevāpi kalpachāyāṃ vitānajām | hāraṃ tāpahāraṃ cāpi tṛptidaṃ cāmṛtaṃ tathā ||1 03|| upakaraṇānyanyāni dadau sūryaḥ sukhāni ca | yayau natvā divaṃ cārko reṇukābhūt sukhāśrayā ||1 04|| apādadagdhā mṛdulā ṛṣiḥ prasannatāṃ gataḥ | evaṃ chatrādidānaṃ vai pravṛttaṃ sūryamūlakam ||1 05|| tattaddānapradānena jīvatāṃ pretadehinām | duḥkhaśāntirbhavatyeva puṇyena mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 106|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya sarvadānaphalaṃ bhavet | lakṣmi dānaphalaṃ sarvaṃ punarāyāti dātari || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vividhadānaiḥ pretoddhāro bhavati, dānapātraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sādhujanaścetyādau vṛṣādarbheḥ sūryasya ca nidarśanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā tryadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 103 ||
<3.104> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca gārhasthyaṃ dharmasāraṃ me prabrūhi parameśvara | smṛddhimāpnoti kiṃ kṛtvā gṛhasthaḥ sutadāravān || 1 || kimavaśyaṃ prakartavyaṃ kiṃ kṛtvā ca kṛtaṃ bhavet | yenānyat sarvakartavyasamāveśaḥ prajāyate || 2 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca sādhavaḥ pitaro devā guravaśca maharṣayaḥ | sādhvyo bhaktā arcanīyā ijyā nityaṃ yathādhanam || 3 || annapuṣpapraṇāmādyaistoṣaṇīyā hi sādhavaḥ | sevayā cānuvṛttyā ca prasādanīyāḥ sādhavaḥ || 4 || jalārpaṇena cānnena payomūlaphalairdalaiḥ | toṣaṇīyā hi pitaraḥ siddhānnaiḥ sadrasādibhiḥ || 5 || devārpaṇaṃ kārayecca kuryād devaprapūjanam | makhaṃ kuryānnityamapi devān santoṣayet sadā || 6 || gurūṇāṃ sevanaṃ kuryādājñāṃ vaheta nityadā | gurvarpaṇaṃ vidadhyācca mātre pitre samarpayet || 7 || vṛddhebhyaścārpayediṣṭaṃ praseveta mudā mude | ṛṣibhyaśca dvijebhyaśca namaskuryāttathārpayet || 8 || sāmādhyāyaṃ paṭheccāpi vidyādānaṃ ca kārayet | sādhvībhyaśca satībhyaśca dadyādannaṃ jalādikam || 9 || āśrayaṃ cāmbaraṃ dadyāt santoṣayennirāśrayām | bhaktān sampūjayennityaṃ satsaṃgaṃ ca samācaret || 3.104.10|| mokṣamārgaṃ sādhayecca dharmaṃ sañcinuyāt sadā | gṛhāgatā dehino vai yathā syuḥ sukhinastathā || 1 1|| pravartetāśrayaṃ datvā copakṛtvā pratoṣayet | harirnārāyaṇaścāyaṃ hyabhyāgato gṛhāgataḥ ||12|| tatra nārāyaṇaścāste tuṣyatvayaṃ janārdanaḥ | evaṃ svāgatamādadhyāt sarvaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ bhavet| || 13|| bhikṣukebhyaḥ pradadyācca gobhyo dadyāttathā gṛhī | śvabhyo dadyāt tathā pārāvātebhyaścāpi cārpayet || 14|| yādobhyo’pi pradadyāccānāthebhyo’pi samarpayet | niśācarebhyo bhūtebhyo baliṃ naktaṃ samarpayet || 15|| nāgasarpādijīvebhyo dadyāt kīṭebhya ityapi | piṣṭaṃ kaṇān randhitaṃ ca ghāsaṃ patraṃ yathāyatham || 16|| ācāryasya pituḥ sādhoḥ sakhyurāptasya cātitheḥ | idamasti gṛhe mahyamiti nityaṃ nivedayet || 17|| gṛhasthaḥ kamalākāntaśiṣṭāśī vai sadā bhavet | patyuḥ sthāne sthitā patnī gṛhiṇī gṛharakṣiṇī || 18|| dharmarakṣākarī nityaṃ sarvadharmān nibhāvayet | sadā tvaṃ kuru kalyāṇi dānaṃ mānaṃ prasevayet || 19|| āśīrvādādilābhena nārī nārāyaṇī bhavet | naro nārāyaṇaḥ syād bhūloko golokatāṃ vrajet ||3.104.20|| etad gṛhāmṛtaṃ proktaṃ yat kṛtvā ṛddhimān bhavet | dharmasāramimaṃ śrutvā yaḥ kuryāt sa divaṃ labhet ||2 1 || śṛṇu saṃkṣepataścānyaddhṛdayasthaṃ vibhāvaya | ahaṃ patisvarūpo’smi nārāyaṇaḥ sadā gṛhe ||22|| tvaṃ śrīrnārīsvarūpāsi patnī gṛhigṛhe sadā | pārṣadā me sutakanyāsvarūpāḥ santi vai gṛhe ||23 || mahīmānā atithayaḥ sādhavo’bhyāgatāśca me | ityevaṃ divyadṛṣṭyā vai kuṭumbaṃ vartate gṛhe ||24|| kṛṣṇārpaṇasvarūpeṇa sevate sma parasparam | bhaktyārpaṇaṃ sarvamasya kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||25||| ta eva viṣayāstāni khāni bhogāsta eva ca | kalpitā mayi kṛṣṇe syurmokṣadā nirguṇāḥ priye ||26 || dharmasāraḥ kathito’yaṃ gṛhāmṛtaphalaḥ śubhaḥ | ṛddhidaḥ puṇyado bandhavarjito mokṣadaḥ sukhaḥ ||27|| sahasrajanmapuṇyasya jñāyate tattvamīdṛśam | apātrasya viṣayiṇaḥ kalmaṣiṇastu durgraham ||28|| dehendriyamanobuddhicetanaiḥ sarvathā priye | tarpaṇīyāḥ sādhavaśca tṛpto bhavāmi tatsthitaḥ ||29|| gṛhavāṭīkṣetravājigajagomahiṣīdhanaiḥ | toṣaṇīyāḥ sādhavaśca jalāmbarānnasevanaiḥ ||3.104.30|| yajasva vividhairyajñairbahvannaiḥ svarṇadakṣiṇaiḥ | sādhūn sevaya sādhvīśca pitṝn devāṃśca tarpaya ||3 1 || brahmapriyā rañjayasva vṛddhām̐śca parisevaya | āśritān śubhasatkārairarcayasva yathārhataḥ ||35||| śṛṇu lakṣmyabhavat pūrvaṃ naraśāyo hi taskaraḥ | patnīputrasametaśca sadā stainyopajīvanaḥ || 33|| siṃhāraṇye vasannityaṃ vasatau yāti vai niśi | prasahya dhanisaudhādīn bhittvā nītvā dhanāni ca ||34|| annādīni cāmbarāṇi nītvā yāti vane punaḥ | evaṃ satataṃ cauryeṇa nirvahatyatha tadvane || 35|| sādhuḥ śrīcakrabhāsākhyo vaiṣṇavo viharan pathi | mimela taṃ naraśāyaṃ cauraṃ sarovarāntike ||36|| cauro vijñāya taṃ sādhuṃ nirdoṣaṃ nirbhayaṃ śubham | gatvāntikaṃ nanāmātha niṣasāda puraḥ kṣaṇam ||37|| sādhuḥ pītvā jalaṃ tasmai dadau vāri prasādajam | cauro’pi mānayan bhāgyaṃ tūrṇaṃ papau jalāmṛtam ||38|| pānamātreṇa hṛdayaṃ vyāvartata śubhāśrayam | pūtaṃ ca mānasaṃ varṣma vivekaḥ samapadyata ||39|| papraccha taṃ pāvanaṃ vai matvā śāntaṃ sukhapradam | pāpanāśaḥ kathaṃ syādvai sādho darśaya satpatham ||3.104.40 || śrutvā śrīcakrabhāsastaṃ prāha cauryaṃ hi laukikam | vihāya kuru cauryaṃ tvaṃ guṇānāṃ ca satāṃ hareḥ ||41|| sevāṃ sādhorharernityaṃ samācara sadāśayaḥ | śrutvā papraccha sādhuṃ taṃ naraśāyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||42|| kayā rītyā mayā sevā kartavyā vada me mune | sādhuḥ prāha vane vanyaiḥ prasevaya samarpitaiḥ ||43|| phalamūlakṛtāhāro bhava cauryaṃ parityaja | harermūrtiṃ cārcayātra bhajanaṃ satataṃ kuru ||44|| sarvapāpāni naśyeyuścaivaṃ prasevanāddhareḥ | evamuktaḥ sa vai stenaḥ sādhumāha saro’ntike ||45|| vidyate mama vāso’tra sādho cāgaccha madgṛham | sevayiṣye bhavantaṃ ca hariṃ tvayā pradarśitam ||46|| nāśameṣyanti pāpāni syuḥ strīputrāśca pāvanāḥ | śrutvaivaṃ śrīcakrabhāso japannārāyaṇaṃ harim ||47|| savalkalo jaṭāyukto mālāṃ kare dadhanmudā | vṛddho yayau ttenakuṭīṃ tatstrīputrādisaṃyutām ||48|| dattāsane niṣasāda bhajan kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | stenastrīputraputryādyā matvā vṛddhaṃ piturgurum ||49|| jalapātraṃ satphalāni pakvāmrāṇi ca tatkṣaṇam | nyadhuḥ sādhoḥ samīpe ca bhuṃkṣveti jagadustataḥ ||3.104.50|| pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakruścānanditā mudā muhuḥ | sādhuḥ phalāni bubhuje papau vāri ca śītalam ||51|| bhuṃjan dadāti madhye ca madhye tebhyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ | strīputrādyāśca dattāni matvā prasādamuttamam ||52|| bhakṣayanti sumiṣṭāni steno’pi bubhuje tataḥ | sādhurnārāyaṇaṃ māṃ ca smṛtvā nivedya viṣṇave ||53|| bhuṃkte dadāti caitebhyaste bhuktvā cāghavarjitāḥ | tūrṇaṃ jātāḥ pāvanāśca sevayā sparśanena ca ||54|| hṛdayāni parāvartitāni teṣāṃ sato’ntike | procuḥ sarve bhagavannaḥ kalyāṇaṃ vai yathā bhavet| ||55|| tathā kuru vane tvatra vasan kuṭyāṃ ca no gṛhe | sādhustathāstviti prāha covāsa śāntimām̐ściram ||56|| śikṣayāmāsa bhajanaṃ nityaṃ nārāyaṇasya me | rātrau militvā bhajanaṃ kīrtayanti svarānvitāḥ ||57|| harekṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa lakṣmīpate vibho ||58|| ityevaṃ kīrtayitvā māṃ svapanti nityameva te| prātarutthāya bhajanaṃ sādhunā saha te tathā ||59|| kṛtvā yānti saraḥ snānti namaskurvanti bhāskaram | sādhuṃ natvā mālikāṃ ca pañca japtvā vanaṃ prati ||3.104.60 || yānti phalāni cāhartuṃ samāyānti kuṭīṃ nijām | madhyāhne phalakandādi bharjayitvā tu vahninā ||61 || pradatvā gurave tasmai nivedya haraye tu me | bhojayitvā bhuṃjate te kurvanti bhajanaṃ tataḥ ||62|| sāyaṃ kurvanti bhajanaṃ sevante ca kathāmṛtam | putrāḥ sādhuṃ prasevante strī sevate divāniśam |||63 || steno’pi sevate’bhīkṣṇaṃ sādhuṃ nārāyaṇātmakam | strīputrādyaiḥ kṛtaṃ yadyat karma stainyātmakaṃ purā ||64|| sarvaṃ niveditaṃ tasmai dhanaṃ ca yatsamāhṛtam | sādhuḥ sarvaṃ samagṛhya yayau gokarṇatīrthake ||65|| cikṣepa jalamadhye śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ vadanniti | tāvaddravyaṃ samastaṃ tacchrīlakṣmīrūpakanyakā ||66|| bhūtvā sādhuṃ prāha sādhvī tvayā kṛṣṇāya cārpitā | pāvanī khalu jātāsmi mālinyaṃ vigataṃ mama ||67|| atha caurām̐stathā pūrvadhanino’pi ca pāvanān | kṛtvā nayāmi kṛṣṇasya caraṇau kṛtyameva me ||68 || ityuktvādāya sādhuṃ taṃ yayau lakṣmīśca tadvanam | yatra te stenakarmāṇaścābhavan te’pi vismitāḥ ||69|| papracchuḥ kanyakāṃ dṛṣṭvā sādhuṃ sādhurjagāda tān | lakṣmīḥ sākṣāt samāyātā netuṃ nārāyaṇagṛham ||3.104.70|| sajjā bhavantu tūrṇaṃ vai yāntu nārāyaṇālayam | śrutvā modaṃ gatāḥ sajjā bhūtvā natvā guruṃ ca tam ||71 || āgate divyaśobhāḍhye vimāne te samāruhan | yayuḥ sādhorājñayā te pārṣadaiḥ saha sevinaḥ ||72|| vaikuṇṭhaṃ bhagavaddhāma lakṣmi sādhoḥ samāgamāt | atha kanyā śrīsvarūpā sādhunā saha cāgragā ||73|| yayau taddhanināṃ saudhān dṛṣṭvā ca dhanino’pi te | sasaṃbhramāḥ svāgatādyairapūjayan sureśvarīm ||74|| sādhuṃ prāpūjayansarve jñātvā vṛttāntamāditaḥ | caurahastagatā lakṣmīḥ sādhuhastena cārpitā ||75|| śrīkṛṣṇe divyatāṃ prāptā prāptā kalyāṇahetave | vijñāya te’pi sādhoścājñayā sajjāstato’bhavan ||76|| mokṣārthaṃ tāvadevāpi vimānaṃ bhāsvaraṃ mahat | samāyātaṃ tvambarādvai pārṣadādisamanvitam ||77|| lakṣmīḥ sarvān dhanapām̐śca samādāya vimānake | sthitvā nītvā yayau natvā sādhuṃ śrīcakrabhāsuram ||78|| golokaṃ dhāma kṛṣṇasya patyurhareḥ parātparam | evaṃ lakṣmi tvayā pūrvaṃ stenaśreṣṭhikuṭumbinām ||79|| sādhoryogena kalyāṇaṃ kṛtaṃ yojitayā harau | sādhuḥ śrīcakrabhāsaśca yayau lomaśabhūmikām ||3.104.80|| tīrthārthaṃ ca samādhau vai niṣasāda yugād yugam | dadarśa mokṣamārgaṃ sa yathā yānti janāstvitaḥ ||81|| bhittvā svargaṃ maharlokaṃ janaṃ tapaśca satyakam | jalopari ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ yānti tatra hare puraḥ ||82|| viśrāntiṃ labhate saukhyaṃ svāgatādyaiḥ sumānanam | haryājñayā tato yānti paravaikuṇṭhamuttamam ||83|| golokaṃ vākṣaraṃ dhāma paraṃdhāma prayānti ca | divyadehā divyadharmā vidvāṃso ghanamūrtayaḥ ||84|| praṇavākhyaṃ kiraṇāḍhyaṃ vimānaṃ sampraviśya te | brahmalokaṃ pravartante brahmakāyā hyanimnagāḥ ||85|| ānandaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prāpya cāmṛtatvāya te gatāḥ | brahmaloke’kṣaraṃ brahma sarveṣāṃ vai purohitam ||86|| mukteśvaraṃ puraskṛtyānandāmṛtaṃ prabhuṃjate | ādhipatyaṃ vinā tulyā bhavanti paramātmanā ||87|| rūpaprabhāvavijayaiśvaryasāmarthyasadṛśāḥ | evaṃvidhaṃ tvamṛtākhyaṃ brahmasatraṃ sanātanam ||88|| apunarmārakaṃ sthānaṃ cāmṛtatvāya te gatāḥ | brahmaṇyabhyāsino yuktāḥ parāṃ kāṣṭhāmupāsate ||89|| vītarāgā jitaprāṇā nirmohāḥ satyavādinaḥ | śāntāḥ prāṇihitātmāno dayāvanto jitendriyāḥ ||3.104.90|| niḥsaṃgā śucayo bhaktā brahmasāyujyagāsmṛtāḥ | akāmayuktairye vīrāstapobhirdagdhakilbiṣāḥ ||91|| teṣāmabhraṃśino lokā aprameyasukhāḥ śubhāḥ | etad brahmapadaṃ divyaṃ paraṃ me vyomni bhāsvaram ||92|| etad gatvā na śocanti hyamarā brahmaṇā saha | yasmādeṣāṃ paraṃ vīryaṃ paramāyuḥ paraṃ tapaḥ ||93|| parā śaktiḥ paro dharmaḥ parā vidyā parā dhṛtiḥ | paraṃ brahma paraṃ jñānaṃ paramaiśvaryamityapi ||94|| tasmāt parataraṃ bhūtaṃ brahmaṇo yanna vidyate | pare sthito hyeṣa paraḥ sarvārtheṣu tataḥ param ||95|| parabrahma paro bhūtvā prapaśyati na cānyathā | evaṃ jñānapratiṣṭhatvāt sarvaṃ brahmānupaśyati ||96|| ākṣarakṣetramuktānāmākṣare dhāmni saṃsthitiḥ | śāśvatī vidyate lakṣmi śāśvatānandadohinī ||97|| satāṃ samāgamo nityaṃ brahmalokapradāyakaḥ | sarvapāpaharo lakṣmi lakṣmyāḥ śuddhikarastathā ||98|| ātmaśuddhikaraścāpi mokṣaśuddhikarastathā | jñānaśuddhikaraścopāsanāśuddhikarastathā ||99|| nirvāṇaśuddhidaścāpi śubhaḥ sārvajñyaśodhakaḥ | ātmaniveditāsaṃśodhakaḥ sevāpraśodhakaḥ || 3.104.1 00|| doṣasaṃśodhakaścāpi māyāsaṃśodhakastathā | vivekaśodhakaścāpi bandhanānāṃ ca śodhakaḥ || 101 || etadamṛtasatraṃ vai brahmasatramadhītya ha | jāyate brahmadharmātra paratrāpi na saṃśayaḥ || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne gārhasthyadharmasāre naraśāyataskarasya śrīcakrabhāsasādhuyogena divyalakṣmīdvārā muktiḥ pūrvadhanināmapi muktirbrahmasatravijñānaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 104 ||
<3.105> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca dharmāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ cāpi mūlaṃ me vada mādhava | yadāśrayāt prapuṣṭiṃ saṃprayāti mānavo vṛṣe || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu śrīśivarājñīśri dharmamūlaṃ sanātanam | nārāyaṇe yathā lakṣmīḥ śrīkṛṣṇe rādhikā yathā || 2 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe tvaṃ mayi rājase | viṣṇau lakṣmīryathā cāste gopāle kambharā yathā || 3 || sāvitryaje hare durgā siddhirvināyake yathā | tathā vivāhitā patnī dharmamūlaṃ hi dehinām || 4 || pitṛdevātithīnāṃ ca svajanasya gṛhasya ca | vaṃśasya vaṃśaśākhānāṃ mūlaṃ patnī vivāhitā || 5 || alaṃkṛtyodakapūrvāṃ kanyāṃ dadyācchubhe vare | varārohāṃ yuvatīṃ cānaṅgavāsaśarīriṇīm || 6 || abhipretā ca yā yasya kanyābhipreta eva yaḥ | tayormudā vivāho vai kartavyo hitakṛddhi saḥ || 7 || brāhmaṇānāṃ satāṃ cāpi sāttvikānāṃ vidhirhyayam | dhanena bahudhā krītvā prasahya haraṇaṃ ca vā || 8 || na kartavyaṃ kvacillagnaṃ kenacit sukhamicchatī | niḥśvāsābhihataṃ sarvaṃ dahyatyeva hi yoṣitaḥ || 9 || jātastrīvyañjanāṃ bhāryāmudvahecchreya icchatā | udbhinnayauvanāṃ puṣṭāmudvahetpuṣṭayauvanaḥ || 3.105.1 0|| rājasvalyaṃ vinā naiva kṣatāṃ kuryānnijāṃganām | athavā cet kāmukī sā snehaspṛśyā nisargajā || 1 1|| svayaṃ patiṃ pragacchecced ramaṇe naiva dūṣaṇam | patnīcchāmantarā nopayacchet nārīcalo bhavan || 12|| kāmukaḥ svairavṛttaśca dharmaṃ hanti gṛhāśrayam | prasahyādharma evāste snehakāryo vṛṣo mataḥ || 13|| śṛṇu lakṣmi mahārāṣṭre kṣatriyo jāṃghalāmakhaḥ | āsīt vavre sa kanyāṃ dvādaśavarṣāṃ surūpiṇīm || 14|| ajātayauvanabhāvāṃ dharmahṛdayayoginīm | sadvivekayutāṃ rājasvalyottaraṃ patiṃ prati || 15|| kāmadharmaṃ cehamānāṃ nānyathā sā satīvratā | dharmaṃ kṛtvā puraścāste patisevāparā sadā || 16|| kāmukaśca patistāṃ vai prasahya kāmatṛptaye | spraṣṭumiyeṣa sā prāha kānta dharmaḥ prabādhate || 17|| nāhaṃ yogyā bhavāmyatra vinā dharmamṛtuṃ pate | sparśasevāṃ karomyatra kāmasevāṃ pravarjaya || 18|| ityukto’pi patidharmamanāvekṣya hi kāmukaḥ | prasahya patnīṃ jagrāha satī niḥśvāsamācarat || 19|| niśvāsānmūrtimānagniḥ prādurbabhūva tatkṣaṇam | ajvālayat patiṃ saudhaṃ smṛddhiṃ copaskarāṇi ca ||3.105.20|| satī śuśoca bahudhā patyau naṣṭe pativratā | sasmāra dharmaṃ dharmo’pi tadā sākṣāccaturbhujaḥ ||21|| āyayau mā śucaśceti prāha bālāmaninditām | dharmarakṣākṛte bāle prasanno’smi vṛṣo’smyaham ||22|| varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te mā dharmāccala bhāmini | dharmo rakṣati rakṣito nāśito nāśayatyapi ||23|| tena nāśitavānasmi tato nāśo’sya cābhavat | tvayā vai rakṣitastena tvaṃ cābādhā prajīvasi ||24|| vahnistvāṃ na dadāhātra gṛhe bāle balānmama | varaṃ vṛṇu yatheṣṭaṃ vai dadāmyadya hi mā ciram ||25|| śrutvā bālā kundadharmānāmnī tadā varaṃ patim | vavre kuṭumbakaṃ patyuścāpi sañjīvitaṃ gṛham ||26|| sarvopaskarasaṃyuktaṃ dharmajñānayutaṃ patim | dharmadevastathāstvāha drutaṃ sañjīvitaḥ patiḥ ||27|| kuṭumbasahitaḥ sarvagṛhopakaraṇānvitaḥ | dharmajñānayutaścāpi mumude cātibhāvavān ||28|| praśaśaṃsa paraṃ dharmaṃ patnyāḥ ṛtujayacchanam | dharmo yayau tataḥ pūjāṃ labdhvātho jāṃgalāmakhaḥ ||29|| patnīdharmaṃ sadā sampālayāmāsa yathoditam | satī satyavatī prāpa dagdhamapi nijaṃ patim ||3.105.3 0|| ityevaṃ cāsti maryādā patnīcchānirmitā sadā | tāṃ rakṣan jāyate puṇyaṃ cānyathā pātakaṃ matam ||3 1 || śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā cānyad yuvatīkanyakāvṛṣam | trīṇi varṣāṇyudīkṣeta kanyā ṛtumatī satī ||32|| caturthe tvatha samprāpte svayaṃ bhartāramarjayet | prajā na hīyate tasyā ratiścāpi na hīyate ||33|| ato’nyathā vartamānā bhavedvācyā janasya sā | tasmād rajasvalādharmaṃ vivāhayenna rakṣayet ||34|| asapiṇḍā nijamāturasagotrā ca yā pituḥ | ityetāmanugaccheta mānavo niyamo hyayam ||35|| pāṇergrahaṇapūrvaṃ tu yācante vai janā muhuḥ | varaḥ śreṣṭho miled dadyāttasmai vihāya cāparam ||36|| nāniṣṭāya pradadyādvai na hīnāya na rogiṇe | nāraye na bibhatsāya na dadyāt krūrakarmaṇe ||37|| nādhārmikāya dadyādvai hiṃsakāya tathā na ca | na hyeva bhāryā kretavyā na vikrayyā kathaṃcana ||38|| yatreṣṭaṃ tatra deyā syānniḥśulkā saṃvibhūṣitā | mṛte patyau pradātavyā yatreṣṭaṃ yoṣitaḥ khalu ||39|| vivāhitena cet tyaktā dātavyā tvaparāya sā | bhāryayā ca parityakto bhāryāmanyāṃ samudvahet ||3.105.40|| mṛtāyāmapi bhāryāyāṃ bhāryāmanyāṃ samudvahet | devaraṃ praviśedvāpi devaro vā viśet striyam ||41|| dvayoścedānukūlyaṃ syādeṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ | apitṛjāṃ cāmātṛjāṃ vindet mānavīṃ satīm ||42|| agniṃ devaṃ pitaraṃ vā gāṃ parikramya sarvathā | vṛddhānāṃ sannidhau yadvā mālāṃ samarpya vai mithaḥ ||43|| hastayormelanaṃ vāpi kṛtvā natvā parasparam | maṇḍape mandire vāpi vivāhayet guroḥ puraḥ ||44|| avirodhena lokānāṃ kuṭumbināṃ nṛpasya ca | prajānāṃ cāvirodhena dvayorgraho vivāhanam ||45|| prakāśaṃ yaddvayoraikyaṃ cāvirodhena śobhanam | hṛdayayoḥ sākṣitātra dharmaḥ so’pi purātanaḥ ||46|| aprakāśe garbhavattā ninditā pitṛvarjitā | dāsīnāmiva vaṃśo na gaṇanāṃ yāti dhārmikīm ||47|| niyogādapi jāyante putrāste pitṛlokitāḥ | brahmakṣatrā vaṃśakarā dharmaḥ so’pi purātanaḥ ||48|| sādhūnāṃ punarācāro garīyān dharmalakṣaṇaḥ | pitrājñaptā svaya vṛttā bhartrā yogamupāgatā ||49|| sādhvācāreṇa sā jātā vivāhitā hi sā matā | bhāryāpatyorhi sambandhaścāmṛtyuściraśobhanaḥ ||3.105.50|| ratisādhāraṇo naiṣastasmāddharmaḥ sanātanaḥ | satimātrārthasambandhaḥ strīpuṃsornahi dhārmikaḥ ||51|| dāyabhāge’pi putro vai gaṇyate vaṃśabhāgavān | putro na syāttadā putrī dāyabhāgādhikāriṇī ||52||| putraḥ putrī samau bodhyau dāyabhāge’tikāriṇau | bahavo’pi sutā yasya putryo’pi ca tathāvidhāḥ ||53|| tasyāpi dāyabhāge syuḥ putrāḥ putryo’dhikāriṇaḥ | samabhāgāḥ pradātavyā eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||54|| vivāhya dāyabhāgaṃ cādattvā sampreṣayanti ye | kanyābhāgaprabhoktāraḥ patanti narake hi te ||55|| jīvitārthāya vikrīya kumāraṃ vā kumārikām | bhuṃjate taddhanaṃ te tu bhuṃjate piśitaṃ tayoḥ ||56|| anyo’pyatha na vikreyo manuṣyaḥ kiṃ punaḥ prajāḥ | vaśyāṃ kumārīṃ balato vikrīṇīyānna kaścana ||57|| dharmabuddhyā cārpayedvai jāmātre yautakānvitām | mātuśca yautakaṃ yat syāt kumārībhāga eva saḥ ||58|| dauhitra eva tadrikthamaputrasya piturharet | putradauhitrayoreva viśeṣo nāsti dharmataḥ ||59|| pitṛbhirbhrātṛbhiścāpi śvaśurairatha devaraiḥ | pūjyā bhūṣayitavyā ca bahukalyāṇamipsubhiḥ ||3.105.60|| pūjyā lālayitavyāśca striyo nityaṃ gṛhasthitāḥ | ramaṇyo yatra tuṣyanti vasanti tatra sampadaḥ ||61|| siddhayaḥ prativarṣanti sarvān kāmān dadatyapi | yatra nāryo’vamanyante sarvāstatrāphalāḥ kriyāḥ ||62|| naiva bhānti na vardhante vaṃśāḥ śriyā vivarjitāḥ | strīhetukaḥ sadā śreṣṭho dharmo dyusatyalokadaḥ ||63|| utpādanamapatyasya jātasya paripālanam | prītyartho lokayātrāyā yāpanaṃ strījane sthitam ||64|| nāsti yajñastādṛśo vai na śrāddhaṃ nopavāsanam | dharmo yugalasauhārdasamo dyumokṣado’paraḥ ||65|| pitā rakṣati kaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane | putrāśca sthavire pānti strīrakṣaivaṃ purātanī ||66|| śriya etāḥ striyo nāma satkāryā bhūmimicchatā | pālitānugṛhitā ca strī śrīreva prakāśate ||67|| atha lakṣmi striyai deyo dāyabhāgo’pi sammataḥ | putraputrīsamobhāgastaddhanaṃ yoṣitaḥ sadā ||68|| bhartrā tacca dhanaṃ dattaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ bhoktumarhati | strīṇāṃ tatpatidāyādyaṃ hyupabhogaphalaṃ matam ||69|| ekasya bahubhāryatve brāhmaṇī sarvathottamā | snānaṃ prasādhanaṃ bharturdantadhāvanamañjanam ||3.105.70|| havyaṃ kavyaṃ devapūjāṃ bhojanaṃ brāhmaṇī caret | annaṃ pānaṃ ca mālyaṃ ca vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca ||71 || brāhmaṇyetāni dadyāt svabhartre sā hi garīyasī | athavā cānukūlyaṃ tu yathā bhaveddhi yoṣitām ||72|| akleśena pramodena snehena cānuvṛttitaḥ | tathā seveta viprā vā kṣatriyā vāparāpi vā ||73|| patyurājñāṃ samagṛhya nānyathā tu kathaṃcana | garbhaśuddhiśca vijñeyā guṇarūpanisargakaiḥ ||74|| apatyaṃ pratibimbaṃ vai piturmātuśca vā bhavet | tatsvabhāvamapatyaṃ tadvijñeyaṃ śuddhavaṃśajam ||75|| tatra yatra pṛthagbhāvo garbhāśuddhirhi sā matā | niṣeke saṃkarībhāve vairupyaṃ bālake bhavet ||76|| sānnidhye’niṣṭavastūnāṃ sāṃkaryaṃ jāyate hṛdi | bīje saṃkramate tacca garbhe tadbhāva udbhavet ||77|| garbhadānaṃ tato’dṛśye rahasye vidhnavarjite | śāntaśabde śāntaloke śāntapaśvādibhāṣaṇe ||78|| suśāntasarvatattveṣu vidhātavyaṃ na cānyathā | śuddhavaṃśaprasūtiḥ sā bhavedatra na saṃśayaḥ ||79|| anyaśabdasparśarūparasasvabhāvadūṣaṇam | prakramate bījadāne pratimādarśanādapi ||3.105.80|| tasmāt patimukhaṃ dṛśyaṃ nānyad dṛśyaṃ tadā matam | prasannahṛdayābhyāṃ ca bhāvyaṃ na tu krudhā ruṣā ||81 || na ca mālinyabhāvena bhāvyaṃ sugandhisaṃbhṛtā | prasannamanasā bhāvyaṃ bhāvyaṃ sattvaguṇena ca ||82|| ekāgramanasā bhāvyaṃ dātrā dhātryā ca sarvathā | sa vaṃśaḥ śuddha eva syāt smartavyaṃ netarat tadā ||83|| nārāyaṇo hariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ parameśaḥ parātparaḥ | smartavyo dampatībhyāṃ vai bījadāne na cāparaḥ ||84|| yatsmṛtistadguṇā bhāvāḥ prakramante prakṛtayaḥ| tasmācchreṣṭhaḥ patirdevo devadevo janārdanaḥ ||85|| śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi kathāṃ purātanīṃ śubhām | pulastyo vedhasaḥ putro dadau dānaṃ yadārtavam ||86|| tadā prītiḥ pulastyasya bhāryā sasmāra rākṣasam | nirṛtaṃ rāvaṇastena rakṣodharmā vyajāyata ||87|| yadārtave prasasmāra viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim | tadbhāvabhāvito jāto bhaktaḥ putro vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||88|| pārvatīśaṃkarau pūrve sasmaraturbalānvitam | senāpatiṃ sutaṃ daityanāśakaṃ vijayapradam ||89|| skandastenābhavad vighnanāśārthaṃ gaṇapo’bhavat | vairājastriguṇān smṛtvotpādayāmāsa vai trikam || 3.105.90|| brahmaviṣṇumaheśākhyaṃ yathā smṛtistathā janiḥ | carau phale prasāde ca bīje cāśīrvacasyapi ||91 || yādṛk smaraṇaṃ rohedvai tādṛśī jāyate prajā | yadbhāvanā bhaved bhaktiḥ phalaṃ tadbhāvabhāvitam ||92|| kalpavṛkṣe harermūrtau gurau patyau striyāṃ sati | auṣadhe mantre tapasi yathā bhāvastathā phalam ||93|| vidyāyāmudyame yuddhe kṛṣau bhṛtyakriyāvidhau | bhautikābhyudaye vege yādṛgyatnastathā phalam ||94|| nṛpe sādhau harau pitroḥ śreṣṭhini svāmini krame | deve pitari santuṣṭe yathā kṛpā tathā phalam ||95|| śatrau niyāmake sarpe vipre śastriṇi tāpase | kalahe rodhane nāśe yathā roṣastathā phalam ||96|| bhaktau yoge prārthanāyāṃ sevāyāṃ daivakarmasu | śāstre bhogye dīrghakārye yathā śāntistathā phalam ||97|| dharme lagne mṛdhe dāne vacane vighnasāraṇe | caurye mokṣe deśakāle yathā śaighryaṃ tathā phalam ||98|| kāvye nyāye copadeśe cājñāyāṃ cāntime kṣaṇe | saṃhāre cāpadi prāraṃbhe yathādhīstayā phalam ||99|| kṣetre svarge striyāṃ śiṣye putre kārye hyupārjane | mantre śāstre racanāyāṃ yathā bījaṃ tathā phalam || 3.105.1 00|| kīrtau ratau vṛṣe vaṃśe sukhe śrame ca bhojane | kośe’tithau gṛhe svarge yathā bhāryā tathā phalam || 10 1|| tasmāllakṣmi sadā bhāryā pātivratyaparāyaṇā | viśeṣato hi dharmāṇāṃ mūlaṃ bhavati sarvathā || 1 02|| puruṣārthā hi catvāraścopāyāḥ sādhanāni ca | yātrāḥ sarvāḥ pravartante siddhyanti nijayoṣitā || 1 03|| kṣetraṃ vai sarvadharmāṇāṃ vāṭikā putrasampadām | kalpalatā sukhānāṃ ca bhāryā bhavati mūlikā || 1 04|| mandurā sā mano’śvānāmāśrayā prāṇapakṣiṇām | nauḥ sā saṃsāriṇāṃ patnī yānaṃ sā svargiṇāṃ tathā || 105|| yajñe vaṃśe sukhe duḥkhe puṇye mahotsave save | gṛhe kārye dhane khyātāvardhāṃganā nijātmikā || 1 06|| paṭhanācchravaṇāllakṣmi tathā dharmasamāśrayāt | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi nāryā narasya sarvathā || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sarvadharmakarmaṇāṃ mūlaṃ vivāhitā patnīti jāṃghalāmakhasya kṣatriyasya kundadharmapatnyāḥ saradharme camatkāraḥ kanyā dānayogyatā varayogyatā dāyabhāgayogyatā bījaśuddhirityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 105 ||
<3.106> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca yathā patnī tathā putro dharmāśrayaḥ piturmataḥ | pitā putrasvarūpo’sti pitṛdharmaḥ sute sthitaḥ || 1 || pracchanno vā prakāśo vā putraḥ pitā prakīrtitaḥ | āryatvaṃ dharmaśīlatvaṃ mārdavaṃ vyavasāyitā || 2 || bhaktirviveka ete vyañjayanti putramuttamam | anāryatvamanācāraḥ krūratā niṣkriyātmatā || 3 || abhaktiścāvivekaśca kāluṣyaṃ vyañjayanti vai | pitryaṃ vai bhajate śīlaṃ mātṛjaṃ vobhayaṃ tathā || 4 || śuddhayoniprajanmā vai sāṃkaryaṃ bhajate nahi | jyāyānapi tu śīlena hīno mānaṃ na cārhati || 5 || api śūdro’pi śīlāḍhyaḥ sadvṛttaḥ pūjyate janaiḥ | ākhyātmānamevātra śīlacāritrakarmabhiḥ || 6 || ātmā putra aurasaḥ svaḥ pitā svayaṃ sa kathyate | svakṣetre tu niyogena parajanyo dvitīyakaḥ || 7 || svakṣetre cāniyogena pracchannajastṛtīyakaḥ | ūḍhā garbhavatī bhāryā tajjātastu caturthakaḥ || 8 || janmataḥ kenaciddattaḥ pañcamaḥ saḥ pravardhitaḥ | yauvane dattakatayā gṛhītaḥ ṣaṣṭha ityapi || 9 || śiṣyarūpeṇa samprāptaḥ saptamaḥ putra ityapi | krītaḥ proktastvaṣṭamaścānūḍhājo navamaḥ sutaḥ || 3.106.10|| manojanyo daśamaśca kathito mānasaḥ sutaḥ | pathi tyakto jātamātro gṛhītaḥ kṛtrimaḥ sutaḥ || 11 || ekādaśaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ dauhitro dvādaśaḥ smṛtaḥ | putryaścāpi tathā bodhyā dvādaśadhā tu vaṃśajāḥ || 1 2|| saṃskārāścātmavatteṣāṃ svāmivat saṃbhavanti hi | kānīnako hyanūḍhājo mātṛvarṇaṃ prapadyate || 13|| gaṇikānāmapatyāni mātṛvarṇāni tāni vai | dāsīnāṃ patihīnānāmapatyāni tu yāni vai || 14|| mātṛvarṇāni bodhyāni svāmivarṇāni vā tathā | bhikṣādīkṣālabhyabālā acyutagotrakā hi te || 15|| sādhvyaśca sādhavaḥ sarve bhavantyacyutagotrakāḥ | tyāgivargāśca vai putrāḥ putryo nārāyaṇasya ha || 16|| evaṃ vai bhūtale loke vyavasthāsti tu padmaje | aicchikī tvanyalokeṣu tathaiṣāpi pravartate || 17|| bhāryā caturvidhā lakṣmi prāyaśaḥ saṃbhavanti hi | patnī vivāhitā proktā dāsī yā tu sahāgatā ||18|| upakurvāṇikā yā tu kañcitkālaṃ gṛhe sthitā | pracchannayogamāpannā rakṣitā sā tu kīrtitā || 19|| svāmino’pi tathā santi caturdhā padmaje śṛṇu | vivāhitaḥ patiḥ prokto lagnitaḥ śreṣṭha eva saḥ ||3.106.20|| devarādirgauṇakānto dvitīyaḥ sa prakīrtitaḥ | niyogamāptastṛtīyaścopakurvāṇakaḥ sa hi ||21 || pracchannayogamāpanno rakṣitaḥ sa prakīrtitaḥ | prajāstayoryathāyogaṃ nāryā vā ca narasya vā ||22|| vivāde’patyamevātra yamicchet tasya vai hi tat | deśabhedāt kālabhedād rītibhedāt pṛthagvṛṣaḥ ||23|| dattā kanyā dānarūpā putrī kathaṃ na kalpyate | kalpyate bhogyarūpā sā tasmād rītirhi kāraṇam ||24|| bhāvanā yādṛśī yatra vyavahāraśca tādṛśaḥ | bhuktvā krodhena vai tyaktā vairāgyeṇa tathā ca vā ||25|| tyāgenāpi vivekena tyaktā mātṛsamā hi sā | tasmāllakṣmi mahāmāyāpravāho mūrchanātmakaḥ | | 26|| mūrchanāsu vividhāsu nayanti dehinaḥ sadā | yathāvidhaḥ pravāho’sti yadā yatra yuge sthale ||27|| tathārītikṛto dharmaḥ sukhadaḥ śāntido bhavet | devānāṃ rītayaścānyā yogināmitarāśca tāḥ ||28|| mānavānāṃ vibhinnāśca paśvādīnāṃ tathetarāḥ | yathārītiḥ sa vai dharmo yadyanarthaṃ na cāvahet ||29|| anarthaṃ prāpayanpanthā dharmātmā naiva gaṇyate | duḥkhado naiva dharmo’sti sukhadaḥ sarvathā vṛṣaḥ ||3.106.30|| artho vṛṣānusañjuṣṭo’nartho’dharmānuyojitaḥ | kāmo dharmārthasahitastaddhīno na pumarthakaḥ || 31 || dharmārthakāmapāraṃ yo yātaḥ sa vindate’kṣaram | adharmyanarthī viṣayī vindate yamayātanām || 3 2|| kuṭumbādivyavasthāpi puruṣārthaparāyaṇā | apumarthayutā rītiḥ pāśavī na tu mānuṣī || 33 || śāstraṃ śāsanadharmaṃ vai mānuṣādau pravartate | tiryagyonau na vai śāstraṃ vidyāśūnyatayā khalu || 34|| balaṃ rītiḥ paśūnāṃ tu mohaśceti nibandhanam | tadādhārāṇi tiryañci yādāṃsi kīṭayonayaḥ || 35|| athaivaṃ vartamānānāṃ bhavapāro na vidyate | yadṛcchayā satāṃ yoge bhavapāro bhavet kvacit ||36 || nahyātmā śakyate hantuṃ tasmāduddhāramācaret | snehena darśanaṃ sādhoḥ saṃvāsaṃ sevayācaret || 37|| brahmavāsakṛtārambhaṃ sādhuṃ seveta mānavaḥ | nihatya mānaṃ śokaṃ ca krodhaṃ harṣaṃ ca vāsanām || 38 || viśrambhapātraṃ bhūtānāṃ śuciṃ śrīkṛṣṇadaivatam | ūrdhvabrahmasthitiṃ śāntaṃ sarveṣāṃ priyadarśanam || 3 9|| niḥśeṣitasamāraṃbhaṃ dhyānaniṣṭhaṃ vaśendriyam | niṣṇātaṃ brahmavidyāyāṃ samanetraṃ dayāparam ||3.106.40 || etādṛśaṃ sādhujanaṃ cāśrayet prārthayettathā | ajñānād yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ prakṣālaya jagadguro ||4 1 || mokṣamārgasya sopānaṃ pradarśaya jagadguro | vāsanāgranthimujjvālya pāvaya svān jagadguro ||42 || bhaktiṃ pradarśya paramāṃ pramokṣaya jagadguro | evaṃ vai prārthanāṃ kuryād yathā kuryāt kṛpāṃ tathā ||43 || vaktavyaṃ ca satāmagre tavāsmīti punaḥ punaḥ | karavāṇi yadājñā syāt sarvaṃ kartāsmi duṣkaram ||44|| yadi rājyaṃ yadi dhanaṃ yadi gā yadi svaṃ gṛham | yajñaṃ dānaṃ sutaṃ vāṭīṃ brūhi sarvaṃ dadāmi te ||45|| ityevamarthayet sādhuṃ pratoṣayet samarpaṇaiḥ | aśaṃkayārpayet sarvaṃ muktibhāk sa bhavet khalu ||46|| māyā hi saṃśayaḥ prokto brahmaṇi nāsti saṃśayaḥ | saṃśayaścet satāṃ yoge sevāyāṃ vacane kṛtau ||47|| kadā muktiḥ kadā śuddhiḥ kathaṃ sevā bhavediha | kadā śuddhasvarūpasya niṣṭhā vāpi bhavediha ||48|| tasmānniḥsaṃśayo bhūtvā seveta sādhumuttamam | pāpakṣālanaśaktaṃ ca mokṣadaṃ divyavartanam ||49|| santuṣṭaṃ jñānakośaṃ ca brahmādhānaṃ nirāśrayam| nirālambaṃ madālambaṃ manmūrtiṃ sevayet sadā ||3.106.50|| śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi sādhusevāphalaṃ param | sasvāmipaśupakṣyāptasuhṛdāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ yataḥ ||51 || āsīt karṇāṭake deśe bhaktimān tāpaso muniḥ | nāmnā śaṃbhalavāraśca jātyā sūtīyasaṃbhavaḥ ||52|| sa tu nadyāstaṭe vāsaṃ cakāraikala eva ha | yuvāpi strīṃ vinānaṃgabhogecchuḥ samadhārayat ||53|| tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā bhuktvā bhogān hi dharmataḥ | yāsyāmyahaṃ tataḥ svargaṃ śāśvataṃ paramaṃ padam ||54|| vicāryetthaṃ tīrthayātrāṃ kartuṃ gṛhādvinirgataḥ | godāvaryāstaṭe ramye samutsedhasthale śubhe ||55|| grāme satrāśayākhye vai nijāvāsaṃ vyadhāt tataḥ | ucchraye sa tapaḥ kartuṃ vīkṣyānukūlabhūtalam ||56|| mānavaiḥ kṛtasammāno’nnādibhiḥ sa mano dadhe | pañcāgniṣu niṣasāda ṣaṇmāsānatha tatparam ||57|| utthito’bhūd varṣamātraṃ tvekapādena tāpasaḥ | tapaścacāra paramaṃ bhajan viṣṇuṃ narāyaṇam ||58|| varṣānte nijapādau sa baddhvā vallyā vaṭadrame | śākhāyāṃ nimnamūrddhāsau vyalambata samāntaram ||59|| evaṃ kṛtvā tapaḥ paścād varṣānte mastakaṃ bhuvi | nidhāyordhvapado bhūtvā tapaścacāra dāruṇam ||3.106.60|| varṣānte cordhvahasto’bhūdaṃguṣṭhamātratolanaḥ | animeṣo’rkadṛṣṭiśca tapaścacāra dāruṇam ||61 || ṣaṇmāsān tatparaṃ nadyāṃ jalāntare’vasattataḥ | pañcame vatsare viṣṇurjale matsyasvarūpadhṛk ||62|| āyayau cakracihnāḍhyaścakhāda carma tanmuneḥ | māṃsaṃ cakhāda ca tathāpi na kampaṃ yayau muniḥ ||63|| viṣṇurmatsyasya vācā taṃ prāha jale’tra vartase | kastvaṃ kathaṃ sthitastvatra vada ko’rtho’tra te mataḥ ||64|| śrutvā śaṃbhalavārastaṃ matsyamāha śubhāśayam | tapaḥ karomi saukhyārthaṃ sukhaṃ dharmaphalaṃ yataḥ ||65|| rājyaṃ gṛhaṃ dhanaṃ bhāryāḥ sutāḥ putryaśca dhenavaḥ | dāsā dāsyo vāhanāni labhyante tapasā sadā ||66|| dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca labhyante gṛhayogataḥ | bhūtvā gṛhī prayāsyāmi tapaḥ kṛtvā paraṃ padam ||67|| ityukto matsya āhāpi kiṃ te bhogeṣu vāsanā | tapaḥ kṛtvā phalaṃ bhuṃkṣva mokṣapade pare pade ||68|| anityāḥ santi bhogā vai duḥkhadā bandhanātmakāḥ | tān vihāya padaṃ yāhi nārāyaṇasya śāśvatam ||69|| śrutvā śaṃbhalavāraśca prāha matsyaṃ tadā punaḥ | bhavān matsyo yathā jñānī vartase viṣayeṣvapi ||3.106.70|| tathā jñātvāpi viṣayānabhuktvā na nivartanam | bhuktvā vividhān viṣayān tṛptimāsādya sarvathā ||71 || vāsanāyāḥ kṣayaṃ kṛtvā tato yāyātparaṃ padam | ityevaṃ sulabhaḥ panthāstadanyaḥ saṃśayātmakaḥ ||72|| sarāgasya gatirnāsti rāgaṃ praśāmayettataḥ | ato’haṃ tapasārādhya viṣṇuṃ prasādya mādhavam ||73|| vṛttvā bhogān prabhuktvā tān bhaktyā yāsyāmi tatpadam | śrutvā matsyastadā prāha paśya me rūpamaiśvaram ||74|| tapasā te pratuṣṭo’smi nārāyaṇo’smi cāgataḥ | vṛṇu yatte yatheṣṭaṃ tad dadāmi sarvathā ciram ||75|| munirvavre dhanaṃ rājyaṃ nārīḥ putrān paśūn sutāḥ | gajāśvavṛṣabhān gāśca puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam ||76|| tathāstviti hariḥ prāha datvā varaṃ tiro’bhavat | atha śaṃbhalavāro’pi jalād bahirviniryayau ||77|| mālāmāvartayannāmnā nārāyaṇasya vai hareḥ | uvāsotsedhabhāge ca nadyāstaṭe manohare ||78|| atha satrāśayo grāmo daśasāhasramānavaḥ | varṣāyāṃ saritaḥ pūraiḥ samāvṛṇot samantataḥ ||79|| jalamagno’bhavaccāpi tadrājā maraṇaṃ yayau | anye’pi bahavo lokā narā nāryo janāḥ prajāḥ ||3.106.80|| jalaplavena nidhanaṃ yātāḥ pañcasahasriṇaḥ | tataḥ pare yayurdeśāntare vāsārthameva ca ||81 || sahasraṃ mānavāstatra nyūṣurdhairyaprapālitāḥ | bhaktāḥ sarve tāpasāśca nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ ||82|| atha śaṃbhalavāro’pi mānapātraṃ paraṃ śubham | tadgrāmavāsināṃ tatra cābhavattāpaso yataḥ ||83|| grāmarājyaṃ pracakāra prajābhirmānitastataḥ | evaṃ rājābhavattatra sahasramānavārcitaḥ ||84|| grāmaprajā dadustasmai kanyakāścaikaviṃśatim | gāvaḥ paśavo dāsāśca dāsyaḥ prajājanāstathā ||85|| ajāvayo’śvavṛṣabhāḥ sarve tasyābhavam̐stataḥ | evaṃ sa tapasā rājyaṃ bhogān strīśca sutādikān ||86|| prāpa nārāyaṇabhaktiṃ cakre satāṃ prasevanam | asya bhaktyā dharmabhṛtyā vyavardhanta prajāḥ punaḥ ||87|| daśasāhasrasaṃkhyordhvā abhavan satranāgarāḥ | sarvā anena muninā vaiṣṇvyastā kṛtāstathā ||88|| nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ cāpi pūjanaṃ śrīharestathā | akārayad yathāyogyaṃ mandiraṃ cāpyakārayat ||89|| sādhavo’sya gṛhe nityaṃ nivasanti sahasraśaḥ | bhaktiṃ ca navadhā nityamakārayat sumandire || 3.106.90 || athāyaṃ vigate kāle prajāḥ prāha vivekavān | putrā me cāsate daivācchataṃ pañca tathā striyaḥ || 91 || ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyāśca putryo me dve śate tathā | gāvaḥ santi sahasrāṇi vṛṣabhā vājinastathā | śukāśca sārikāścāpi hastinaḥ saramāsutāḥ ||92 || dāsā dāsyo bhavantyatra prajā yūyaṃ sukhāstathā | dharmaḥ kṛtastathā cārthaḥ kāmo dṛṣṭo’tha mokṣaṇam | | 93 || kartumicchāmi sahasā datvā rājyaṃ sutāya me | jyeṣṭhāya ca tato yāsye nārāyaṇākṣaraṃ padam || 94| | prajāstathāstviti prāhuḥ prāhuścānyacchubhāspadam | vayaṃ sarvāḥ prayāsyāmaḥ sahaiva paramaṃ padam ||95|| svasvasutān prasaṃsthāpya yathādhikārakarmasu | evaṃ sammantrya rājāsau samādhau yogamāptavān ||96|| sarvaṃ putre sannidhāya mokṣe vṛttiṃ samādadhat | rājñyaḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ sarvāstatsthale śrīharau tadā || 97|| yojayitvendriyaprāṇān lagnā āsan nijātmasu | bhajantaḥ śrīpatiṃ nārāyaṇaṃ priyaṃ prabhuṃ patim ||98|| āyayau tatra vai viṣṇurvimānaiḥ saha pārṣadaiḥ | prabhāsayan diśaḥ sarvā garjayadbhirdigantarān || 99|| prāha bhaktaṃ śaṃbhalaṃ taṃ samāgaccha vimānake | natvārcya bhagavantaṃ taṃ prāha śaṃbhalavārakaḥ || 3.106.100 || bhagavan kṛpayā sarvāḥ prajā yāstu samutsukāḥ | āgantuṃ mokṣamevātra sajjāstā naya vai saha || 101 || gavāśvavṛṣabhājāścāvayo gāvaḥ śukādayaḥ | tathānye ye bhavantyatra tava prasādapāvitāḥ || 1 02|| mama putrāśca putryaśca rājñyaścāpi kuṭumbinaḥ | sajjā ye ye bhavantyatra tāṃstān naya nijaṃ padam || 103 || itīcchāṃ me hare kṛṣṇa prapūraya kṛpāṃ kuru | hariḥ prāha tathāstvevaṃ tava bhaktyā karomyaham || 1 04|| putrāste bhinnajātīyā bhinnanārīsamudbhavāḥ | brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāścānye vaiśyāḥ śūdrāstathāpare || 1 05|| bhinnajātīyarājñīnāṃ sutāḥ putrāstathānugāḥ | dāsā bhṛtyāśca dāsyaśca ye’nye’nyā bhaktimārgagāḥ || 1 06|| ārohantu vimānaṃ me nayāmi mama dhāma tān | ityuktāḥ sarva evaite ye ye mumukṣavo’bhavan || 1 07|| āruruhurvimānaṃ te navasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ | paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarve kṛpayā śrīharestadā || 1 08|| āruruhurvimānaṃ tad divyadehāścaturbhujāḥ | caturbhujyaśca kamalā nāryaḥ śarvāstadābhavan || 1 09|| prajāḥ sarvā āruruhurvimānaṃ divyabhāsvarāḥ | ekaikaputraṃ santyajya vaṃśabījaṃ yathāyatham || 3.106.11 0|| sarvāḥ prajāstathā rājā rājakuṭumbasaṃyutaḥ | sarve yayurvimānena vaikuṇṭhaṃ paramaṃ padam || 111 || evaṃ śaṃbhalavāro vai sādhurgṛhe sthito’pi san | tāpaso’pi bhuvo bhogān bhuktvā prapūjya keśavam || 1 12|| yayau padaṃ tu paramaṃ bhaktyā nārāyaṇāśritaḥ | bhinnajātīyapatnīnāṃ patiḥ putrādisaṃyutaḥ || 1 13|| evaṃ sādhuprasaṃgena kuṭumbaṃ sarvathā rame | prayāti paramaṃ dhāma yogyāyogye na tatra vai || 1 14|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhogavairāgyavān bhavet | bhaktyā bhuktiṃ samālabhya muktiṃ vrajed balāddhareḥ ||1 15|| sādhuvṛttyā vrajenmuktiṃ nayenmuktiṃ sahasraśaḥ | yayā śaṃbhalavāro’sau yayau muktiṃ prajāyutaḥ || 1 16|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vividhaputrāḥ, vividhapatnyo vividhapatayaḥ, sādhuyoge muktiḥ, sūtajātīyasya śaṃbhalavārasya sādhubhaktasya bhaktyā tapasā rājyasutapaśupakṣyādiprāptyuttaraṃ saprajasya muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 106 ||
<3.107> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi camatkāraṃ sādhoḥ śrīcihnayoginaḥ | saurāṣṭravāsinaste’tra vadāmi smṛddhimokṣadam || 1 || āsīt sādhurmama bhakto kīśādanapurasthitaḥ | śrīcihnayogītisiddho divyakarmā samādhimān || 2 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ bhajate sma saḥ | kvacidadṛśyarūpeṇa kvacid dṛśyena vartate || 3 || kvacijjale vane vṛkṣe parvate vasati kvacit | vṛṣṭau tāpe kvaciccābdhitaṭe cāśvasarovare || 4 || kvacid vahnā ca vāyau ca kvacid viśati gahvare | etādṛśaḥ samartho’pi bhajate māṃ nirantaram || 5 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīparameśvara | akṣarādhipate lakṣmīpate śrīpuruṣottama || 6 || evaṃ māṃ raṭati nityaṃ bhajate ca punaḥ punaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmnā mālāṃ karoti nityaśaḥ || 7 || snānaṃ dhyānaṃ ca pūjāṃ karoti mama nityadā | mānase hṛdaye nityaṃ mūrtaṃ paśyati māṃ hi saḥ || 8 || sahasraśo lakṣaśaśca mānavā yamupāsate | kalpavṛkṣasamaṃ santaṃ vīkṣya yat kalpayanti te || 9 || sarvaṃ tat phalati teṣāṃ kalpanādeva sannidhau | nāśīrvādāvaśyakatā sevāvaśyakatā na ca || 3.107.1 0|| evaṃvidhaḥ sa sādhustvekadā kaupīnamātradhṛk | yadṛcchayā copapanno devānīkanṛpaṃ prati || 11 || saurāṣṭrarājo vijñāya santaṃ neme pupūja tam | svāgataṃ cāsanaṃ datvā madhuparkaṃ dadau tataḥ || 12|| pādāmṛtaṃ jalaṃ labdhvā papau kuṭumbayuṅnṛpaḥ | kalyāṇadevānīkastrī sahajāśrīriti nṛpī || 1 3|| neme taṃ ca dadau bhojyaṃ miṣṭaṃ phalaṃ jalaṃ ghṛtam | munirjagrāha bhāvena papau vāri tutoṣa ca || 14|| rājā satkṛtya bahudhā muniṃ punarathābravīt | bhagavan paravantau syo brūhi kiṃ karavāvahai || 15|| yadi rājyaṃ yadi dhanaṃ yadi gā yadi bhāminīm | yānaṃ sutāṃ sutaṃ saudhaṃ brūhi sarvaṃ dadāmi te || 16|| idaṃ gṛhamidaṃ rājyamidaṃ dharmāsanaṃ ca te | nṛpa tvamasi śādhyurvīmahantu paravām̐stvayi || 17|| śrutvā śrīcihnayogī taṃ prāha bhaktaṃ nṛpaṃ dvijam | na rājyaṃ kāmaye rājanna dhanaṃ bhāminīṃ na ca || 18|| na gāḥ pānaṃ sutāṃ saudhaṃ sutaṃ vā kāmaye nṛpa | kintu mayā gṛhīto’sti niyamastasya pūrtaye || 1 9|| paricaryo’smi yattābhyāṃ yuvābhyāmaviśaṃkayā | rājā hṛṣṭo’bhavacchrutvā prāha tathāstu taṃ munim ||3.107.20|| prāveśayad gṛhoddeśaṃ darśanīyamadarśayat | iyaṃ śayyā bhagavato yathākāmamihoṣyatām || 21 || prāsādo’yaṃ ca bhogāśca bhujyantāṃ svīyasampadaḥ | vrataṃ samyaganutiṣṭha sarvaṃ gṛhāṇa pūrtaye ||22|| kimannaṃ kiṃ jalaṃ cānyat kiṃ kiṃ bhavato’pekṣitam | yatiṣye prītimāhartuṃ kimupasthāpayāmi ca ||23|| śrutvā munirbhojanaṃ ca yathopapannamuttamam | pāyasādyaṃ prayacchasvetyāha rājā samānayat ||24|| bubhuje ca jalaṃ pītvā prāha śrīcihnayogirāṭ | svaptumicchāmi śayyāyāṃ na prabodhyo’smi sarvathā ||25|| saṃvāhitavyau me pādau jāgṛtavyaṃ ca te niśi | ityuktvā sa prasuṣvāpa divasānekasaptatim ||26|| śuśrūṣāparamau rājñīnṛpau cāhāravarjitau | babhūvatustataḥ sādhuruttasthau vratamāsthitaḥ ||27|| provāca sa tadā tailābhyaṃgo me rocate’dhunā | rājñīnṛpau sugandhāḍhyatailābhyaṃgaṃ pracakratuḥ ||28|| kārayāmāsatuḥ snānaṃ bhūṣayāmāsatustathā | bhojayāmāsatuścāpi sādhuṃ miṣṭānnakāni ca ||29|| miṣṭapākān samagrām̐śca laḍḍukān sarvajātikān | veśavāraviśeṣām̐śca polikāḥ pūrikādikāḥ ||3.107.30|| rasānnānāprakārām̐śca śākāni vividhāni ca | dravāṇi sarvarūpāṇi bharjitām̐ca kaṇām̐stathā ||3 1|| kṣārāmlamiṣṭacūrṇāni phalāni vividhāni ca | āranālāni ramyāṇi rājabhojyāni sarvaśaḥ ||32|| bhojayāmāsatustatra maharṣirbubhuje sukhaḥ | āha kalyāṇanṛpatiṃ rājñīṃ vahata māṃ vanam ||33 || skandhe kṛtvā śibikāyāṃ rājā rājñī mudaṃ gatau | svarṇarūpyādisaṃśobhamārohayitvā taṃ munim ||34|| ūhaturnagare cāpi nagarānte tathā vane | dṛṣṭvā prasannamanasau nirvikārau hi sevakau ||35|| prasannaḥ śrīcihnayogī śibikāto hyavātarat | vimuktvā tau varaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ brūtāṃ dadānyuvāca tau ||36|| sukumārau ca tau viddhau pādayoḥ skandhayostathā | paspārśāmṛtakalpābhyāṃ karābhyāṃ cihna yogirāṭ ||37|| susampannau śramahīnau divyadevāviva hyubhau | sañjātau navarūpau ca tathā ca navayauvanau ||38|| tau muniścāha gamyetāṃ kīśādanaṃ nijaṃ puram | ahamatra nivatsyāmi vane vrataṃ carāmyapi ||39|| yatkāṃkṣitaṃ yuvayostu sarvaṃ tadvai bhaviṣyati | ityukte nṛparājñyau cāhatustaṃ vai munīśvaram ||3.107.40 || aparādhāśca sevāyāṃ jātāścette munīśvara | kṣantavyāḥ sarva evaite dayāvārdhimahātmanā ||41 || tava prītiṃ prasādaṃ cābhikāṃkṣāvaḥ sadā mune | prāha śrīcihnayogī tu paśyatāṃ rūpamaiśvaram|| prasanno’smi hariścāsmi śrīcihnahṛdayo’smyaham | śrīvatsavakṣā me nāma lakṣmīpatirbhavāmyaham ||43 || sādhurūpo gṛhe te’tra cāgato’smi kṛpāvaśaḥ | mamāvatāro bhaktānāṃ sadā kalyāṇahetave ||44|| ataścarāmi sādhurvai divyadeho janārdanaḥ | devānīka prasanno’smi sahajāśri rato’smi ca ||45|| vṛṇutaṃ sadvarān sveṣṭān sevāphalaṃ dadāmi ca | śrutvaivaṃ tu tadā lakṣmi devānīkaḥ praṇamya tam ||46 || prapūjya paramātmānaṃ matvā sukṛtamātmanaḥ | provāca snehamadvākyairbhagavantaṃ hi māṃ tadā ||47|| prāptaṃ sarvaṃ mayā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa tavāgamāt | sevayā pūrṇayā tīrṇaḥ sapatnīkaśca tadbahu ||48 || yatprīto’si harekṛṣṇa kulaṃ trātaṃ ca tāritam | eṣa me’nugrahastatra sevā phalaṃ ca jīvataḥ ||49 || etadrājyaphalaṃ caiva bhakteścāpi phalaṃ mama | kiṃ ca tvaṃ prītimānāsse saṃśayaṃ me nivāraya || 3.107.50 || kiṃvrataṃ kīdṛśaṃ kasmādetatsarvamanuṣṭhitam | śrutvā śrīcihnayogī ca devānīkamuvāca ha ||5 1 || śṛṇu bhakta samagraṃ tanmayā yanniścitaṃ svataḥ | tava vaṃśe bhaviṣyāmi bhagavān bhaktavallabhaḥ ||52|| tvāṃ tathā tava rājñīṃ ca pāvanārthamupāgataḥ | pāvane bhaktavaṃśe’haṃ tataścāvatarāmi hi ||5 3 || sādhurūpaṃ mama rūpaṃ pāvayatyeva mānavān | sādhurūpeṇa bījaṃ tvāṃ pūtaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ param ||54 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇa eva vai | śrīmadgopālabālo’haṃ kaṃbharāśrīsuto hariḥ ||55 || bhaviṣyāmīti sevāyāḥ phaladānārthameva ha | sevāṃ kārayituṃ cātra samāyāto’smi sarvathā ||56 || yathoktā mama sevā vai kṛtā tvayā ca yoṣitā | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ snānaṃ bhojanaṃ śibikādhṛtiḥ ||57 || sarvaṃ sampāditaṃ me vai tena te vaṃśajāstviha | paratrāpi tathā sarve bhaviṣyanti sukhānvitāḥ ||58 || bhavānapi ca golokaṃ kālāntare gamiṣyati | sabhāryastvaṃ mahānandaṃ dhāmno me’pi labhiṣyasi ||59 || patnīvratasya viprasya brāhmaṇyaṃ vartate tava | tvadvaśe rājalakṣmyāśca rājatā brahmatā punaḥ ||3.107.6 0 || brāhmaṇyaṃ mama vāsena dhruvaṃ sadā bhaviṣyati | brahmiṣṭhatve maharṣitvaṃ tapasvitā ca sādhutā || 61 || muktatā divyatā cāpi kṛṣṇatā mokṣadātṛtā | sarvapūjyatvamevāpi sarvaratnasamudratā ||62|| sarvasaubhāgyakhanitā sarvaiśvaryāḍhyatā tathā | śrīlakṣmīśāradābhūtisampadāśrayatā sadā ||63|| etatsarvaṃ mama vāsād bhaviṣyati purā kule | ityuktvā bhagavān so’haṃ datvā hāraṃ tu kānakam ||64|| maṇimālāṃ tathā datvā datvā mantraṃ paraṃ manum | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ||65|| pātraṃ tathākṣayaṃ datvā datvā cakraṃ sudarśanam | adṛśyatāṃ gataścāhaṃ devānīko yayau gṛham ||66|| svarṇavarṇān suprāsādān prākāraṃ kānakaṃ tathā | kalpodyānāvṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā vīkṣyāpsaroyutaṃ nijam ||67|| mandiraṃ ca tathā divyavimānena suśobhitam | dāsadāsīgaṇān divyān śaṃkhacakrādicihnitān ||68|| kāmadhenūśca parito gaurīrlakṣmīśca kanyakāḥ | prajā vaikuṇṭhatulyāśca hastinaścāṣṭadantinaḥ ||69|| aśvān śvetān śyāmakarṇān haṃsān śvetān vihaṃgamān | rathān sūryaśaśivrātasaṃśobhān vyomagāminaḥ ||3.107.70|| pārṣadān viṣṇurūpām̐śca devānīko mumoda ha | yajñakuṇḍān maṇḍapām̐śca maharṣīn sādhumaṇḍalam ||71|| sādhujanān lakṣaśaśca devān sarvān dadarśa ha | svarṇanadī pārśvataśca yāntīṃ dadarśa bhaktarāṭ ||72|| śrīhareḥ kṛpayā lakṣmi devānīko’bhavattathā | mahendra iva nṛpatiḥ svarāḍ rājñī ramā yathā ||73|| kṛpayā mama yogena dhāmākṣaraṃ vyajāyata | kīśādanaṃ nagaraṃ tacchrīśāyanaṃ vyajāyata ||74|| devānīko mahāścaryaṃ jagāma taṃ ca māṃ prabhum | abhajat parayā prītyā saṃsmaran sādhurūpiṇam ||75|| athāhaṃ gatakālena jāto’smi bhaktavatsalaḥ | koṭyarbudābjapatnīnāṃ nāthaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||76|| evaṃ sādhoḥ prasaṃgena prasaṃgena harestathā | sevakasya kulaṃ sarvaṃ bhavatyeva hareḥ kulam ||77|| śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca kānto’si sarvanātho’si parameśaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ | akulasya kulaṃ nāsti śrīharestava śārṅgiṇaḥ ||78|| tathāpi mānave loke vaṃśamūlā paramparā | pravartate’taste kṛṣṇa tāmicchāmi praveditum ||79|| śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi purā sṛṣṭerahaṃ nārāyaṇo’bhavam | mamāṃgebhyo’bhavan brahmaviṣṇurudrasurādayaḥ ||3.107.80|| sṛṣṭyādau ca tadā nārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ | mukhapiṇḍād brāhmaṇaḥ śrīpatnīvrato babhūva ha ||81 || pativratākhyā bhāryāsya yugalaṃ tadbabhūva ha | parameṣṭhisamāyuṣyaṃ vṛṣamūrtyātmakaṃ hi tat ||82|| pūrvapitāmahākhyaṃ me lakṣmi nibodha cādimam | patnīvratasya vai putro brahmavratastu mānasaḥ ||83|| śīlavratāsya bhāryā ca babhūva mānasī ca sā | parameṣṭhisamāyuṣyau tāvubhau vyūhakoṭijau ||84|| vāsudevo vāsudevī yau tāvubhau babhūvatuḥ | tayoḥ śiṣyā lakṣaśo’pi svataḥprakāśayoginā ||85|| nibhālitā abhavam̐śca saurāṣṭre sarvatodiśi | brahmavratasya vai putro brāhmaṇaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ||86|| nāmnā kalyāṇadevānīkastu kīśādaneśvaraḥ | sahajāśrīsaṃjñayā ca bhāryayā yug babhūva ha ||87|| vedhaḥpūrvārdhasamayāyuṣyau tau ca babhūvatuḥ | bhūmānārāyaṇo yo’sau bhaumānikīśriyā yutaḥ ||88|| brahmāṇḍe’trājñayā me vai prādurbhūto hi tāvimau | tābhyāṃ śrīcihnayogītisvarūpeṇa satā mayā ||89|| āśīrvādaḥ pradatto vai prākaṭyārthaṃ kule mama | atha kalyāṇadevānīkasya putro’pi mānasaḥ ||3.107.90|| kṛṣṇamukuṭamaṇyātmā cānartanṛpapūjitaḥ | picudevānīkanāmā nārāyaṇasvarūpavān ||91|| vabhūva mukuṭakalgyā miṣṭādevyā putro’tra ha | vedhaḥpūrvārdhasamayāyuṣyau tvetau babhūvatuḥ ||92|| picudevānīkaputro mahāviṣṇuḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | śrīmān gopālakṛṣṇākhyo daśakalpāyureva ha ||93|| mahālakṣmyā kaṃbharāśrīdevyā yuto babhūva ha | khaṭvāṃgadanṛpasyārthe varadānāya cāgatau ||94|| etau tu pitarau matvānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | mānaso’hamabhavaṃ suputraḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||95|| koṭyarbudābjapatnīnāṃ bhaktānāṃ ca patiḥ prabhuḥ | akṣarādhipatiḥ śrīśaścāvatārī parātparaḥ ||96|| bhavāmi śivarājñīśri kāntaste kṛṣṇamādhavaḥ | ahaṃ, mama pitā, tasya pitā, tasya pitā tathā ||97|| tatpitā, tatpitā, tasya pitā caite tu pūrvajāḥ | sarve nārāyaṇā nārāyaṇāṃśā matsvarūpiṇaḥ ||98|| nārāyaṇyo mātaraśca sarvā madātmikāḥ khalu | kimu tadbahunoktena lakṣmi jānāsi sarvathā ||99|| ahaṃ sarvātmako bhūtvā līlāṃ vistārayāmi tām | vaṃśasya śravaṇātpāṭhād bhuktirmuktirdhruvā bhavet || 3.107.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne kalyāṇadevānīkabhaktasya sevāparīkṣā, śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaparamparānirdeśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 107 ||
<3.108> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca bhagavan lokatattveṣu magnānāṃ dehināṃ kvacit | bādhāyāmupapannāyāṃ kiṃ japyaṃ vada me’tra tat || 1 || anāthānāṃ śaraṇyaṃ kiṃ daivataṃ rakṣakaṃ ca kim | balāśrayaṃ ca śubhadaṃ paramaṃ kiṃ vṛṣātmakam || 2 || āpadvināśakaṃ cāghakṣālakaṃ muktidaṃ param | vāsanādhvaṃsakaṃ māyāgranthipāśavikartanam || 3 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmasahasrakam | puruṣottamasāmākhyaṃ japannaman hariṃ ca mām || 4 || pūjayan sarvadā bhaktyā paṭhan sañcintayam̐śca mām | sarvātmasusthitaṃ dhyāyan sarvabādhāḥ samuttaret || 5 || śaraṇyaṃ sarvapuṇyānāṃ nidhiṃ dharmāśrayaṃ prabhum | sūṣṭitrayodbhāvakaṃ ca trikālāvādhyamacyutam || 6 || divyasampatkalpamūrtiṃ camatkārādisaṃbhṛtam | sarvaiśvaryabhagavantaṃ bhaktyā saṃkīrtayeddhi mām || 7 || divyākṣarādisaṃsevyatejovārdhipradaṃ prabhum | śāśvatānandapūrāṇāṃ gamakaṃ parameśvaram || 8 || pāvanānāṃ pāvanaṃ ca parabrahma parātparam | muktānāṃ bhāgyarūpaṃ ceśvarāṇāmīśitātmakam || 9 || surāṇāṃ suratādhānamṛṣīṇāmārṣatājuṣam | satīsādhvīsatyabhāvasnehasevāvratātmakam || 3.108.1 0|| kāmapūraṃ divyaśaktisāmarthyabaladāyinam | antakāle sakhāyaṃ cotkramaṇe sahayāyinam || 11 || sarvādhāraṃ suhṛdaṃ taṃ śrīhariṃ māṃ japet sadā | kāntaṃ śāntaṃ hṛtsu bhāntaṃ puraḥsthitaṃ ca māṃ namet || 12|| yogakṣemakuśalādipradāturme hareḥ rame | divyanāmasahasraṃ yat sarvāghabhayanāśanam || 13 || līlaiśvaryaguṇakarmanisargarūparūpitam | mukteśvararṣidevādyairgītaṃ vadāmi siddhidam || 14 || asya śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmastavasya tu | ṛṣiḥ sarveśvaro lakṣmi tvahaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 15 || chando’nuṣṭup paro devo’nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | ākṣarākhyomahāmuktomuktānīśo hi bījakam | | 16 | | śrībhūlīlāramārādhālakṣmīmāṇikya eva ca | śaktayo hṛdayaṃ śrīmatpuruṣottamasāma ca || 17 || gopālakambharābālaḥ kīlakaṃ cāstramācyutam | padmāvatīramāpadmāsvāmine ca vaṣaṭ namaḥ || 18 || śūlamīnadhvajadhanurbāṇadhro’strāya phaṭ svāhā | sarvabādhānivṛttyarthaṃ jape’sya viniyojanam || 19 || brahmaloke virājantaṃ juṣṭaṃ brahmiṣṭhamaṇḍalaiḥ | brahmapriyāsvāminaṃ taṃ dhyāye sarvāntarasthitam || 3.108.20 || divye lomaśakṣetre vai viharantaṃ manoharam | mandahāsaṃ pūrṇakāmaṃ kāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vicintaye || 21 || puṣṭaṃ priyaṃ kāmadaṃ ca duḥkhahaṃ sukhadaṃ prabhum | catvāriṃśadūrdhvaśatakāntaṃ smarāmi mokṣadam | | 22 || bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ ceṣṭapradaṃ sarvapradaṃ harim | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patiṃ bhajāmi ca | | 2 3 | | kirīṭakuṇḍalabhūṣābhūṣitaṃ rūpasundaram | ākarṣakaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ namāmyaham || 24|| koṭyarbudābjaśaktīnāṃ patiṃ cātmapatiṃ vibhum | pītāmbaraṃ satāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ seve cātmanivedanaiḥ | | 25 || namo’nantasvarūpāya sarvapādākṣivartine | sahasranāmabodhyāya kāmamāyeśvarātmane || 26 || oṃ pramātmā paramātmā parabrahma pareśvara | puruṣottama īśeśaścākṣarādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ || 27|| mukteśvaro’vatāreśo muktānīśo mahāprabhuḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanandanaḥ || 28 || bāhyamūrtiścātmavṛttiḥ sarvajñaḥ śrīharirvibhuḥ | akṣaro brahma bhagavān vāsudevo narāyaṇaḥ || 29 || nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃjyotirbālakṛṣṇaścidambaraḥ | dhāmeśaḥ śāśvatānando’vatārī parameśvaraḥ || 3.108.3 0|| gomān divyaguṇāgāraḥ śyāmasundara āntaraḥ | san sanātana ānandaściccidātmā jaḍānvitaḥ || 31 || ṛddhimān bhūtimān rājā saṃkarṣaṇo niyāmakaḥ | gopālo gāṃgato gobhṛd gopīnātho gaveśvaraḥ || 3 2|| pārṣadaḥ pariṣatpūjyaḥ parṣat pāriṣadeśvaraḥ | divyaḥ śāntaḥ śāntidaśca sattvaḥ sattvaprakarṣavān || 33 || stavaḥ ślokaḥ smṛtiḥ śabdaḥ kavirvedo vidhiḥ pradhīḥ | āsanaṃ cādhikaraṇaṃ dhṛtirdhairyaṃ kṣamā yamaḥ || 34|| pradyumno dyotamānaśca dyauḥ kāntaḥ kamalāpatiḥ | aniruddho’cyuto bhūmā mahākālo maheśvaraḥ || 35|| mahāviṣṇurmadhyaviṣṇurviṣṇurvyāpaka ūrdhvadṛk | vairājaḥ kāraṇaṃ kartā kṛtiḥ kāryaṃ nṛpo japaḥ || 36|| kapiḥ khapaścendriyārtha ṛṣīkeśaḥ samādhimān | yogī yogaścakravartī cakrī śaṃkhī gadī dhvajī || 37|| rathī kṣatrī ca nakṣatrī vṛttiścāvṛttirujjayī | avyākṛtaśca sūtrātmā turyapadaṃ sukhāspadam || 38 || sadāśivaśca devaśca śivaḥ saṃhāradharmavān | dhātā poṣṭā vidhātā ca pitā mātā suhṛt sakhā || 3 9|| prāṇanāthaḥ sahāyaśca svāmī dhānī dhanī makhī | kośo viśvaṃ mahābhūto bhāvaḥ saṃbhāvanādhipaḥ ||3.108.40 || gatiḥ kāntiḥ pāvanaśca cidābhāsaḥ phalaṃ phalī | antaryāmī puruṣaśca kṣetrajñaḥ kṣetramārttihā ||41 || sākṣī pradhānapuruṣaḥ prakṛtīśo guṇādhipaḥ | golokeśo’mṛtadhāmā vaikuṇṭheśo ramāpatiḥ ||42|| rādhāpatiḥ śrīnivāso dāmodaro vibhāvasuḥ | prabhājāpo vāmanaśca trikramo bhūrivikramaḥ ||43 || keśavaḥ kapilaḥ kāśī nṛsiṃho māpatirnidhiḥ | śrīśaḥ sthāṇuḥ satīśaśca śaśī vidyuddhruvo raviḥ ||44|| brahmāryamā viṣṇurāto haro vaiṣṇavasāttvataḥ | sādhuryatirbrahmacārī bhartā dhartāmaro’mṛtam ||45 || vibhavaḥ saṃbhavo bhūśca puṣkalo bhūyasīpradaḥ | svaro rāgo mūrchanā ca vādaścālāpa utsavaḥ ||46 || savaḥ satraṃ makho yajvā yajño vahniḥ prahavyabhuk | dattātreyo mahāmatsyaḥ padmanābho’bjanetrakaḥ ||47|| kañjahastatalaḥ śārṅgī viśvakarmā surādhipaḥ | śvetakroḍo vṛṣabhaśca vṛṣajanmā vṛṣākapiḥ ||48 || sūto vaktā guruḥ śāstraṃ mahācāryo manurmadhuḥ | īśvaro’dhyāpakaḥ śāstā nyāyo netā ca nītimān ||49|| tarkaśca nirṇayo jyeṣṭha īśānaśca purātanaḥ | sanātanaśca sannyāsī munirvratī ca tāpasaḥ ||3.108.50 || hiraṇyagarbho hariṇīkāntaḥ kamalapattalaḥ | vidvān vidyādharo vāgmī vāṇīśo varṇiśīlabhṛt | |51 || gṛhī gṛhapatirgoptā vaptāśrīvatsalāñcchanaḥ | vyāso’nādiprakarṣaśca draṣṭā śrīkṛṣṇacandrakaḥ || 52 || kāmbhareyaśca medhāvī prajāpatirdivaspatiḥ | dikpatiḥ śrīpatirlakṣmīpatirbrahmapatirnatiḥ | | 53 || kṛtajñaḥ śaraṇaṃ vipro vivāho vararūpavān | varahāraśca saṃvarto maṇḍapo’naṅga uttamāḥ || 54|| sarvagarbho naro vīryī prajātmā vatsaraḥ saraḥ | divā dyumaṇiriṣṭeṣṭaḥ sandhirdaṇḍaḥ sukhaṃ śamaḥ || 55 || dānaṃ dātā svatvarūpastyāgaḥ snehaḥ sumaṃgalam | śakunaṃ śakunī pattrī haṃsaḥ śukaḥ kaṇaḥ kṛṣiḥ || 56 || sphuraṇaṃ ca pramā kūrmo rāmo raivata ātmavit | pṛthuḥ parśudharaḥ khaḍgī dhanvī raṇī rathīṣudhiḥ | | 57 || lakṣyaṃ kramaḥ pratyayaśca siddho’jaḥ śāśvataḥ śubhaḥ | svaprakāśo vasuḥ satyaḥ samadarśī samāyanaḥ ||58 || bhogī śuklo’rjuno dakṣaḥ pratyayaḥ pratyagātmavān | āmaughaḥ sarvayoniśca paramahaṃsa ārthikaḥ ||59|| nirvāṇapādaḥ suṣiraḥ śirāvyāptaḥ pṛthuśravāḥ | saumyo rodro nigrahātmā svārohaḥ sarvagaḥ prabhaḥ || 3.108.60 || vittirvedyasvarūpaśca vettā vedanidhirvidhiḥ | viśvaksenaḥ susaṃsthāno’dhyakṣo’parokṣagocaraḥ || 61 | | kṛto’kṛtastriyugaśca loko’loko ramāyanaḥ | vyūhoṃ’śo vibhavaścārcātmakaḥ svarūpa ūrjitaḥ || 62 || sahanaḥ sthāvaro bhoktā phaladaḥ sṛjiyatnavān | amogho gadahā vyāghro girīśo giridhārakaḥ || 63 || anirvācyaḥ suvācyaśca mahīdhro māṇikīdharaḥ | sanmūrtiḥ pārśvatikeśo govindo garuḍadhvajaḥ | | 64|| ṛṣabho garuḍaḥ kalkiḥ kumāro buddhisarjanaḥ | hayaśīrṣāḥ svarṇavarṇaḥ surarṣiḥ padmajāpatiḥ || 65|| muktāpatirbhūpatiśca muktapatī ramāvasuḥ | viśvāvasuḥ siṃharūpo nimiṣaśca bṛhaspatiḥ | |66 || marudvanaṃ manastejo’mbaraṃ digambaraḥ śrutiḥ | tripāt pādaḥ sarvapācca prapātā mṛduvartanaḥ | | 67 || miṣṭaḥ saṃbhramaṇaḥ śeṣaḥ svāgataṃ sannavārtikaḥ | asaṃkhyākṣaḥ śiṣṭadharmā dharmavarmā prasiddhimān || 68 || nārāyaṇīnivahaśca śivarājñīsatīpatiḥ | mādhavīśo bhārgavīśastūlasīnāyako bṛhat || 69 || dehī dehīśvaro ratnaṃ puṇḍraṃ puṇḍradharaḥ pumān | vidhṛtiḥ sarvasetuśca nāko jalān śikhī smṛtiḥ ||3.108.70|| saṃskāro gurutā mānaṃ sāmānyaṃ varado vahaḥ | pratiṣṭhā skannabhāvaśca dhurvaho yānamagraṇīḥ ||71|| devo merurgarutmām̐śca prājña ārṣaścaturmukhaḥ | kṛpastīrthaṃ sāvanaśca megho vārdhiḥ rasaḥ śayaḥ ||72|| bhadraḥ sutaḥ śūravīrastārakaḥ sthaviro yuvā | arkaḥ plakṣaḥ śarabhaśca gajo gajānano mṛgaḥ ||73|| samayo heturudaraṃ bhāgyaṃ tārastamaḥ kalā | āveśaḥ praṇavo bījaṃ prayojanaṃ dhanaṃ kṣamaḥ ||74|| ṛturyūpo vatsalaśca dhaneśaḥ somapaḥ puruḥ | sthūlaḥ sūkṣmaśca liṅgaṃ ca suparṇo’naśano mṛdhaḥ ||75|| kīśo jayo bhāgavataḥ sāttvato yantracetanaḥ | mantro mukundo viśvāsaḥ patnīvrataḥ pradakṣiṇam ||76|| jīvo’nanto’ntakaścārhau nando dātā guhā gṛham | kalaśaḥ pippalo vṛndādrumaḥ kalpalatāśayaḥ ||77|| stambho vāsturmahākuṇḍaścāyudhaṃ kambalaḥ karaḥ | kāruḥ śilpī vātsya āptastvaṣṭā staraḥ prarocanaḥ ||78|| aśokaḥ khadiro bilvo vaṭaḥ palāśa āmalaḥ | udumbaraḥ kadalīśaḥ pūgo rājeśvaro ratiḥ ||79|| dampatī kumudo modo nandanaḥ śrīdharaḥ smaraḥ | śṛṃgāro dāsyado nemirbindurbhasma bhramirmahaḥ ||3.108.80|| keśavaḥ kāmakṛjjiṣṇurbrahmaṇyo vāsukiḥ priyaḥ | lekho bimbaḥ pratibimbo nirodho dīrghikā payaḥ ||81 || prapā pānaṃ piśaṃgaśca piṃgākṣo gāyako gayaḥ | nartako naṭako māyī mantrī tantrī jitendriyaḥ ||82|| kalpamaṇirmahāvīryaṃ mahadrajo’gryapūruṣaḥ | sādhujanaḥ strījanaścāvyayo vadhūjanātmakaḥ ||83|| stanyapaḥ sādhyadevaśca dharmajanyo vṛṣāsutaḥ | ṛtambharaścamatkāraḥ svāhākāraśca karmaṭhaḥ ||84|| ārārtrikaṃ cābhiṣeko mukuṭaḥ kaṇṭhikāpriya | sindūrakaḥ kuṃkumaṃ ca dūrvā vrīhiryavastilaḥ ||85|| nāgavallaścekṣudaṇḍaḥ śrīphalo bhaktivardhanaḥ | pūgīphalasvarūpaśca sugandhaḥ śreya āramaḥ ||86|| śrīmayaḥ śrīkṛtaveṣaḥ śryaṃgaḥ śryānandasampradaḥ | śrītilakaḥ śrīkṛtoruḥ śrīśayaḥ śrīkathāśrayaḥ ||87|| śrīsevaḥ śrīsamavāyaḥ śryaśanaḥ śrīsamādhimān | lakṣmīlakṣmā mahālakṣmībhavo lakṣmīvibhāvanaḥ ||88|| lakṣmīpārśvo mahālakṣmīgarbho lakṣmīdharādharaḥ | brahmajño brahmaparamo brahmajapo’nṛṇī maṇiḥ ||89|| atithiḥ pūrṇacandraśca devayāno nabhogatiḥ | jagadgururjayānātho lalitākānta ekalaḥ ||3.108.90 || stutirjapaḥ sthitiḥ sthairyaṃ sattā bhūtirvibhūtimān | harṣaḥ pañcātmakaḥ sākṣī sāraḥ snehaḥ susampavān ||91|| kāṣāyaveṣo dīptātmā pañcāgnitāpaso nagaḥ | nāgo nirāśo naptā ca kāmaphalaṃ kumārakaḥ ||92|| svastikaḥ pratibhārūpaḥ pratijñātmā pramāpakaḥ | sahajaḥ svabhavaḥ śaṃkuḥ kuśaḥ śālaśilaḥ śivaḥ ||93|| caityo gartaśca huṃkāro jaghanaṃ vīthirajvaraḥ | udgīthaścopaniṣacca purāṇapuruṣaḥ śanīḥ ||94|| satparaḥ sannivāsaśca śrīdrumo’suranāśakaḥ | kuñcikātmā brahmarandhraṃ brahmahrado mahādhruvaḥ ||95|| paridhiḥ kiraṇaṃ keśaḥ pañcaśikhaḥ parāsanaḥ | pravargyaśca mahopāyo viśiṣṭo vidrumo vaśaḥ ||96|| modakastaṇḍulaścāpāmārgo devādhidaivatam | devānīkatilakaśca mahāśvapaṭṭasārasaḥ ||97|| jāmātā dharmavṛddhaśca saṃkalpo madhuparkakaḥ | sarvatobhadrarūpaśca pīṭho vedirbalirjalam ||98|| sthaṇḍilo maṇikṣetreśaḥ pādmakṣetramaheśvaraḥ | lomaśānandadaḥ patnīvratavaṃśaprabhākaraḥ ||99|| indradyumnasthalīrakṣo nārasiṃhavaneśvaraḥ | vyāghrāraṇyanivāsaśca rukmāṃgadeṣṭasampradaḥ || 3.108.1 00|| prābhāsikaprabhānuśca somakṣetraprapoṣakaḥ | sāmapadmaniśānātho’nādikṛṣṇaḥ prajāpatiḥ || 101 || vasantaśca kiśoraśca mahendraḥ śampradaḥ sahaḥ | maṃgaleśo manaseśo reveśo virajāpatiḥ || 1 02|| ratīśo gomatīśaśca kāmadugheśvaro’tulaḥ | ekādaśīpatiḥ svarṇarekhākānto hyamūrtakaḥ || 1 03|| nandinīśaśca doleśaḥ puṣpaṃ kalāvatīpatiḥ | badarīśaśca pampeśo darpahā bāndhavo dhavaḥ || 1 04|| bhaktavatsala unnetā mānakṛllokadhṛgdharaḥ | dhanyaścaturbhujo durgastantukṛt sukṛtaṃ kṛtī || 1 05|| sundaraścāśvamedhaśca parjanyaścāmṛtāpatiḥ | sulabho’durlabhośvattho rakṣohā daityanāśanaḥ || 1 06|| saptāśvaḥ saptajihvaśca prāgvaṃśaśca prabhātakaḥ | āśramaśca yamaḥ sūryacandranetrastrinetrakaḥ || 107|| viyannābhirbhūcaraṇo’nilāsurdikchravā dyukaḥ | anyayānanaśca bastyabdhiḥ sarvavarṣmā ramo’ramaḥ || 1 08|| ghanaśyāmo hitastathyo brahmadhāmā svadhāmavān | nityaśca cetanaścāntaryāmī viśeṣavittimān || 1 09|| kāryakāraṇarūpaścāyojako dhṛtimān padī | pratyayitaḥ śrutigamyo vākyakṛt saṃkhyito’vyayaḥ || 3.108.11 0|| svastidātā svastikartā svastirūpaḥ praśastimān | sṛṣṭyadhiṣṭhānamuttuṃgo golakaḥ kaṃ ca khaṃ khagaḥ || 11 1|| madhyāvastho madhyavāsaḥ sandhyāṃśo’bhijidātmakaḥ | amṛtaśca śubho lābhaḥ kṣemakṛt siddhināyakaḥ || 1 12|| dhanvantarirnalo nālaḥ pravāho dadhimaṇḍapaḥ | puttraḥ svargaścāśīrātmā pralayo vaiṣṇavārcitaḥ || 113 || navanīto’pavargaśca hṛddīpaḥ paramārthadaḥ | kālamāyāpāpakarmayamadūtabhayāpahā || 1 14|| dvāraṃ dvārī candraśālo ghṛtāśī cādvitīyakaḥ | bahuprajo’prajo jāgrat prājanano’ntaraṅgakaḥ || 1 15|| grantho granthirnāgaraśca sīmāntaḥ sīmavarjitaḥ | abādhyaścāparicchinno’vivarto’pariṇāmakaḥ || 1 16|| avacchedaka aiśvaryaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣyamīśanīḥ | itiḥ kavalamannaṃ ca sanātanatamaḥ sanaḥ || 1 17|| vaṃśī kadambakaḥ kīlaḥ samājaḥ sārtha ādaraḥ | udāro dvyātmakaḥ śreṣṭhī triyugo yugalātmakaḥ || 1 18|| strīpatiḥ svapatiḥ prāptistādātmyaṃ nirmitiḥ kṛtiḥ | tattvaṃ svatvamabhiprāyaśceṣṭodbhavaśca bhāvanaḥ || 1 19|| udayo’yaḥ pramedhaśca suṣumṇāmūrtidarśanaḥ | dānaṃ damo dayā diṣṭaṃ ditirdarvī ca dohanam || 3.108.120|| vaktā vācayitā lekhayitādhyāpaka ūhavān | vāṅmano’gocaraḥ puṇyaṃ puṇyaśrutijapārhaṇaḥ || 121 || jīvanaṃ mandahāsaḥ satpathācāraḥ paṇo raṇaḥ | ātmajaścāgameyaśca naigameyo hyanāvaraḥ || 122|| asaṃkhyaścaikasaṃkhyaśca nirbhayo bhayanāśakaḥ | ādhvaro havanādaśca bhāvādano bhavāpahaḥ || 123|| ūrdhvavīryo’praskhalano vighnahā ca narottamaḥ | duḥsvapnanāśakaḥ śāntipradaḥ pramodakārakaḥ || 124|| ākarṣako’kṣayapātraṃ paryavasānamaurasaḥ | vyāhṛtirvyavahāraśca sphurtiścekākṣaro dhvaniḥ || 125|| bhuktido muktidaḥ pāpakṣālanaḥ puṇyadaḥ prathaḥ | khyātyātmā sarvasenaśca dik
