tāro nāda īpatiḥ || 1 26|| sphoṭo naukā phalaṃ puṣpaṃ piṣṭaṃ sadasadātmakaḥ | brahmasūtraṃ kaṃkaṇaṃ ca saddhetuḥ sarvahetimān || 127|| mūlaṃ mūlottaraṃ mūlādimaḥ sarvāntasaṃsthitaḥ | ālayaśca talaṃ sarvodaraḥ sarvaśarīrakaḥ || 1 28|| anvayo vyatirekaśca nityayukto namaḥpuraḥ | sampanno vikasadbhāvo viśvasadbhāva oṃnamaḥ || 129|| itīdaṃ pāvanaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvabādhāvināśakam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmnāṃ sahasrakam || 3.108.1 30|| puruṣottamasāmākhyaṃ stotraṃ lakṣmi mayoditam | śroturvaktuḥ kīrtayiturmanturnaśyatyaghāni vai ||1 31|| ihāmutra na bādhā syād vighnanāśo drutaṃ bhavet | vipro vidvān brahmavit syācchūraḥ kṣatro jayī bhavet || 1 32|| dhanī śreṣṭhī vaiśyavarṇo bhavecchūdraḥ sukhī bhavet | brahmacārī camatkārī gṛhī strīsampadanvitaḥ || 133|| vanī vanyarddhisampanno bhavet sādhuḥ praśāntimān | vindeddharmaṃ dharmaruciścārthecchurarthavān bhavet || 134|| kāmecchuḥ kāmasampattiṃ mumukṣurmokṣamṛcchati | rājyārthī rājyamāvindet prajārthī tu prajāṃ labhet || 135|| putrārthī putramṛcchedvai bhāryārthī strīṃ labhennavām | kanyārthī kanyakāmṛcchet patyarthikā patiṃ labhet || 136|| vidyārthī prāpnuyād vidyāṃ dhanārthī dhanamāpnuyāt | vṛttyarthī vṛttimān syācca bhogārthī bhogavān bhavet || 1 37|| iṣṭārthī ceṣṭamṛcchecca gṛhārthī gṛhamāpnuyāt .| nityaṃ prātaḥ paṭhed bhaktyā śuddhāntaḥkaraṇastu yaḥ || 138|| pradhānatāṃ yaśaḥ khyātiṃ śriyaṃ śreyaśca vindati | bhayaṃ naiva bhavatyasya tejo vīryaṃ ca vardhate || 1 39|| nīrogo jāyate pāṭhāt puṣṭo balī guṇī bhavet | rūpavān jāyate ramyaḥ kāmyo bhavati pāṭhanāt || 3.108.140|| bandhanaṃ śīryate vakturbhayaṃ naśyati sarvathā | āpattayo vinaśyanti naśyanti śatravo’pi ca || 141|| durgāṇi sugamānyeva bhavanti stuvataḥ khalu | puruṣottamaśaraṇaḥ puruṣottamabhaktimān || 142|| māyāñjanarahitātmā labhate puruṣottamam | madbhaktasyāśubhaṃ nāsti saṃsārasya bhayaṃ na ca || 143|| durītaṃ janma mṛtyuśca vyādhirjarā na rugṇatā | moghatābhibhavo naiva madbhaktasya prajāyate || 144|| etatpāṭhād bhavedātmasukhaṃ śāntiḥ susampadaḥ | smṛddhiḥ śrīḥ kīrtiraudāryaṃ prādhānyaṃ puṣṭirīśitā || 145|| muktā īśāḥ pitaraśca siddhā devā maharṣayaḥ | etatstotrajapenaiva siddhiṃ paramikāṃ yayuḥ ||146|| āyuṣmān bhavate śrutvā niṣpāpaḥ paṭhanādbhavet | śraddhābhaktiyuto vaktā pretya ceha pramodate || 147|| mayānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇena te prabhāṣitam | lakṣmi stotraṃ matparaṃ tatpāṭhānmatparamo bhavet ||148|| api ślokaikapāṭhena pāṭho’syāpi kṛto bhavet | śṛṇu lakṣmi camatkāramayaṃ ślokaṃ vadāmi te ||149|| namāmi sṛṣṭitrayasaṃvidhāyine bhajāmi koṭyarbudaśaktiśāline | dhyāyāmi cātmāntarasanniyāmine’ rpayāmisarvatvamathātmavedine || 3.108.150|| namo’nantasvarūpāya namo’saṃkhyapramūrtaye | namo yugalarūpāya namaḥ śrīparamātmane || 151 || namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | namaḥ śrīkambharālakṣmīgopālajanuṣe namaḥ || 152|| namo’nāthādhināthāya namaḥ kāntākṛpālave | namo dharmādhigoptre te bālakṛṣṇāya te namaḥ || 153|| śivarājñīsvāmine te nārāyaṇīśvarāya ca | ramāpadmāvatīśāya nārāyaṇāya te namaḥ || 154|| namo brahmapriyeśāya śrīkṛṣṇāya ca te namaḥ | sarvajñadeśikeśāyācāryeśvarāya te namaḥ || 155|| stavaścāyaṃ paṭhitaścārpitastvayi phalāptaye | sarvadastvaṃ pāhi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa namo namaḥ || 156|| sahasrapāṭhataścāsya puraścaraṇamācaret | mahāpado vinaśyanti mahāsaukhyaṃ bhaveddhruvam || 157|| vijñānaṃ sarvatattvānāṃ vardhate’sya prapāṭhanāt | sārvajñyakalpatā syācca kṛṣṇasya karuṇākaṇāt || 158|| rājā pradhānaḥ pṛthivīpradhānaḥ svargapradhāno dhanadapradhānaḥ | vidyāpradhāno’rhaṇatāpradhāno bhavet stavasyāsya supāṭhakṛjjanaḥ ||159|| nityamekaprapāṭhena sarvakāmasamṛddhimān | jāyate me kṛpāleśāllakṣmi tadgṛhamāvasa ||3.108.160|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sarvabādhānāśakaṃ sarveṣṭadaṃ śrīpuruṣottamasāmākhyamanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmasahasrastotrakathananāmāṣṭādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 108 ||
<3.109> śrīnārayiṇīśrīruvoca bhagavan prāptamutkṛṣṭaṃ stotraṃ te bhavapāradam | bādhānāśakaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ param || 1 || karmaṭhāḥ stotrapāṭhena kṛtakarmaphalaṃ prabho | bhuktvā yāntyathavā cāpyabhuktvā mokṣaṃ prayānti te || 2 || yadi bhuktvā prayāntyeva kva kīdṛg bhuñjate phalam | kasya vā karmaṇaḥ kīdṛg bhuktvā phalaṃ prayānti te || 3 || satkarmiṇāṃ tu ye lokāstām̐śced bhuktvā prayanti vai | brūhi te kīdṛśā yatra mohaḥ punarna jāyate || 4 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri vakṣyāmi satphalānyapi | jñātāni ca punarmohaṃ ganturnādadhate param || 5 || tapaḥ karma hi mūrdhanyaṃ karmaṇāṃ bhavate sadā | svargaḥ śreṣṭho hi tapasā labhyate kīrtisaṃbhṛtaḥ || 6 || dīrghāyuṣyaṃ śreṣṭhabhogā labhyante ca tapobalāt | sampado rūpamārogyaṃ vidyā vijñānamuttamam || 7 || ādhipatyaṃ paraṃ dravyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ vaṃśavistaraḥ | labhyante tapasā śreṣṭhadevatvaṃ tapasāpyate || 8 || tāpasaḥ sarvametadvai bhuktvā ciraṃ tapaḥphalam | paścāt stotraphalaṃ bhuṃkte brahmaloke hi śāśvate || 9 || maunavrataṃ tapaḥ proktaṃ pālitaṃ yena tasya tu | vāksiddhirjāyate cājñāpradatvaṃ jāyate tathā || 3.109.1 0|| bahūnāmupadeṣṭā syād gururācārya ityapi | rājagururbhaveccāpi senāpatistathā bhavet || 11 || dharmaśāstā bhaveccāpi niyāmakastathā bhavet | atra loke svargaloke phalaṃ bhuktvā stavasya ca || 12|| phalaṃ bhoktuṃ prayātyeva dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ hareḥ | dānakartā bhavet svarge deveśo bhūtale dhanī || 13|| rājā bhavedupabhogān bhuktvā stotraphalaṃ labhet | parame’kṣarasaṃjñe vai rājate sarvasaukhyabhāg || 14|| brahmacaryavrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tapa ānandavarjanam | cirāyuḥ sa bhavelloke balī puṣṭo dṛḍho yuvā || 15|| apradhṛṣyo’parābhāvyo bhaved brahmasameśvaraḥ | phalaṃ bahusamā bhuktvā tataḥ stotraphalaṃ labhet || 16|| brahmalokaṃ prayātyeva modate brahmavedibhiḥ | ahiṃsāpi tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ niyamākhyaṃ nigadyate || 17|| aduḥkhaṃ sukhamātraṃ ca labhate svarahiṃsakaḥ | sukhaṃ tatra paraṃ bhuktvā tataḥ stotraphalaṃ labhet || 18|| yāti dhāmākṣaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ modate brahmavādibhiḥ | dīkṣā dharmayutā tapoyuktā tapaḥ paraṃ matam || 19|| dīkṣito bhaktiyuktaśca pārameṣṭhyapadaṃ labhet | bārhaspatyapadaṃ cāpi mahācāryapadaṃ labhet ||3.109.20|| pūjanīyakule janma satāṃ kule’cyutagṛhe | labhate dīkṣitastatra bhuktvā bhogān tataḥ param ||21|| stotraphalaṃ sukhaṃ bhuṃkte’kṣare me dhāmasattame | phalamūlāśanaṃ cāpi tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ nigadyate ||22|| tatphalaṃ rājyamāsādya svargaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pravindati | parṇāśanaḥ payobhakṣā yānti svargaṃ samṛddhidam ||23|| phalaṃ bhuktvā tato yānti stotraphalaṃ madakṣaram | svarṇadānena sāmrājyaṃ cakravartitvamityapi || 14|| yatra kvāpi labhelloke tato’kṣaraṃ prayāti saḥ | stotraphalaṃ tatra bhuṃkte śāśvatānandaśevadhim ||25|| guroḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ sevā tapaḥ paraṃ nigadyate | sevayā labhyate vidyā prasannatāśiṣaḥ śubhāḥ ||26|| puṇyaṃ sarvottamaṃ svargaṃ yadiṣṭaṃ taddhi labhyate | mātāpitrośca vṛddhānāṃ patyuḥ patnyāḥ kuṭumbinām ||27|| gavāṃ satāṃ surāṇāṃ cātithīnāṃ paravāsinām | rugṇānāṃ cāpyanāthānāṃ dīnānāṃ sevanaṃ śubham || 28|| tapo vai paramaṃ proktaṃ phalaṃ sarvottamaṃ sukham | yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke sarvaṃ vindati sevayā || 29|| sārvajñyaṃ sevayā prāpya svargaloke mahīyate | svarge satye phalaṃ bhuktvā stotraphalaṃ pravidanti ||3.109.3 0|| śāśvatānandasampūrṇasukhānāṃ sevitā bhavet | akṣare parame dhāmni mahāmukto bhavet sadā ||3 1 || śrāddhaṃ kuryāttu yaścātra dadyāt pitṛbhya uttamam | kavyaṃ havyaṃ dvijātibhyo bhojanaṃ dakṣiṇādikam ||32|| phalaṃ svargaṃ ciraṃ bhuktvā pitṛlokaṃ pragacchati | tatra ciraṃ phalaṃ bhuktvā stotraphalaṃ tato labhet ||33|| satyalokaṃ vihāyaivākṣaraṃ lokaṃ prayāti saḥ | atra santatibāhulyaṃ śrāddhakarturbhavatyapi ||34|| vaiṣṇavaṃ tatkuṭumbaṃ syād bhajitvā parameśvaram | naivedyaṃ ye samarpyāpi nityaṃ prapūjya bhāvataḥ ||35|| stotrasyāsya pratāpenākṣaraṃ dhāma prayāti ca | evaṃ vaṃśapravaṃśā vai śrāddhadātuḥ prajā rame ||36 || prayānti cākṣaraṃ dhāma stotravaktā pramodate | pramodante vaṃśajāśca sahavāsāḥ sadākṣare ||37|| gavāṃ prasevayā yāti svargaṃ satyaṃ tataḥ param | golokaṃ paramaṃ yāti stotrapuṇyena cākṣaram ||38|| striyastriṣavaṇaṃ snātvā labhante cottamān varān | viprāṇītvaṃ ca devītvaṃ yānti stotreṇa cākṣaram ||39|| vāyvāhārastapaḥkartā labhed yajñaphalaṃ divam | stotreṇa ca tato yāti paramākṣaramuttamam ||3.109.40|| nityasnāyī buddhimān syānmedhāvī sphurtimān janaḥ | prāṇāyāmaparo yāti svargaṃ stotreṇa cākṣaram ||41|| sthaṇḍile śayanāḍhyastu labhate mandirāṇi vai | rājayogyāni vai svarge stotreṇa yāti cākṣaram ||42|| cīravalkalavastrāḍhyaḥ praiti bhūṣāmbarāṇi ca | śayyāsanāni ramyāṇi labhate ca tataḥ param ||43|| stotreṇa yāti me dhāmākṣaraṃ modaṃ pravindati | agnisnātaḥ prayātyeva sūryalokaṃ tataḥ param ||44|| vahnilokaṃ tataḥ stotrabalād yātyakṣaraṃ padam | rasānāṃ niyame yāti saubhāgyaṃ svargamuttamam ||45|| anāmiṣādaḥ svaryāti cirāyurjāyate divi | tataḥ stotreṇa vai dhāmākṣaraṃ yāti sukhāspadam ||46|| udavāsī nṛpaḥ syācca samudrādhipatirbhavet | bhūtvā ca varuṇaḥ stotrabalād dhāmākṣaraṃ tataḥ ||47|| satyavratī prayātyeva svargaṃ stotreṇa cākṣaram | pānīyadānamātreṇa svarge’mṛtādano bhavet ||48|| annado’pi prayātyeva svargaṃ bhogāḍhyamuttamam | kāmabhogān prabhuktvā stotreṇa yātyakṣaraṃ padam ||49|| sāntvadaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yāti satyaṃ padaṃ śubham | devaśuśrūṣayā yāti siddhalokaṃ tu vaidhasam ||3.109.50|| stotreṇa ca tato yātyakṣaraṃ matparamaṃ padam | dīpadātā divyadṛṣṭirbhavatyeva susiddhimān ||51|| satyaloke ciraṃ sthitvā stavena yāti cākṣaram | ādarśādipradātā ca vairājyameti satpadam ||52|| gandhamālyādidānena gāndharvaṃ caiti rājasam | pañcakeśākṣaurakarmā vaṃśavistāravān bhavet ||53|| kanyādānavidhātā tu svargaṃ vairājasatpadam | labhate caiśvaraṃ bhāvaṃ dāsīdāsasahasrakam ||54|| alaṃkārān mahābhogān divyān prāsādasattamān | yajñaiścānaśanādyaiśca svargaṃ pitṛpadaṃ tathā ||55|| phalapuṣpādidānena tūdyānādipatirbhavet | tiladhenupradātā tu vasulokaṃ prayāti vai ||56|| bhūmidātāvyākṛtaṃ ca dhāma yāti sukhāspadam | dhuryadānena ca vasulokaṃ yāti sukhāśrayam ||57|| chatradānena caiśatvaṃ kailāse labhate janaḥ | upānaho pradānena yānavimānavān bhavet ||58|| gandhadānena surabhirbhavedīśvarakoṭikaḥ | sapuṣpaphalavṛkṣasya dātāmṛtapadaṃ vrajet ||59|| rasadātāmṛtaṃ dhāma gacchedīśvarakoṭikaḥ | sragdhūpalepadānena vaikuṇṭhaṃ labhate param ||3.109.60 || śayyādānavidhātā vai golokaṃ yāti bhaktarāṭ | tatra tatra mahānandān bhuktvā stotreṇa cākṣaram ||6 1 || prayātyeva pratāpānme lakṣmi dhāmottamottamam | taḍāgasya pradātā vai prayātyamṛtadhāma saḥ ||62|| tatra bhogānparān bhuktvā stotreṇa yāti cākṣaram | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ dātṛ sarovarārpaṇam ||63|| taḍāgena pradeśasya śriyo yānti vikāsatām | caturdaśastaravāsāḥ saṃśrayanti jalāśayam ||64|| agnihotraphalaṃ svargagodānasya phalaṃ tathā | agniṣṭomaphalaṃ cātirātrayajñaphalaṃ tathā ||65|| vājimedhaphalaṃ cāpi labhate sarasaḥ pradaḥ | gāvaḥ santo janāḥ pakṣivarāḥ prāṇapradhāriṇaḥ ||66|| paśavaḥ pādapā vāri pibanti jantavo’pi ca | vibhramanti taṭe tatra snānti ca kṣālayanti ca ||67|| evaṃ taḍāgadāturvai phalaṃ tvanantakaṃ bhavet | sarvadāneṣu vai jyeṣṭhaṃ pānīyaṃ śāntidaṃ param ||68|| jaladātāmṛtabhoktā jāyate caiśvare pade | virajāyāstaṭe sthitvā ciraṃ golokameti ca ||69|| bhuktvā bhogān subahudhā tataḥ stotreṇa cākṣaram | prayātyeva prabhakto me stotraphalaṃ parākṣaram ||3.109.70|| atha vṛkṣapradātā ca divyavṛndāvanaṃ śubham | golokasthaṃ sametyeva gulmadātā latārpakaḥ ||71 || vallīprado vaṃśadātā tṛṇado yāti tatpadam | devalokaṃ śubhaṃ bhuktvā pitṛlokaṃ prayāti ca ||72|| vṛkṣāḥ puṣpaiḥ suragaṇān pitṝn phalaiḥ rasādibhiḥ | atithīn chāyayā patraiḥ prāṇinaḥ pūjayanti vai ||73|| dadatyāśrayamutkṛṣṭaṃ dehibhyo vṛkṣajātayaḥ | bṛkṣadaṃ putravad vṛkṣāstārayanti paratra tu ||74|| vṛkṣaropī ceṣṭayajñaḥ satyavādī jitendriyaḥ | svarge satye ca vairāje’mṛte’vyākṛtadhāmani ||75|| vaikuṇṭhe cāpi goloke mahīyante’timodinaḥ | te’pi lakṣmi stavenaiva prayāntyakṣaramuttamam ||76|| abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo datvābhayaṃ pare’kṣare | prāpnotyeva stavenāpi śāśvatānandabhāg bhavet ||77|| vyasaneṣvapi lokānāmanugrahaḥ paro vṛṣaḥ | duḥkhahā vyasanakṣeptā svargaṃ yāti sukhāspadam ||78|| yaccābhilaṣitaṃ dadyāt tṛṣitāyābhiyācate | dattaṃ tūrṇamupayuktaṃ grahītā toṣaṇaṃ vrajet ||79|| śreṣṭhaṃ taddānamevātra dātāramupagacchati | svarṇadānaṃ dhenudānaṃ pṛthivīdānamuttamam ||3.109.80|| prāsādadānaṃ kanyāyā dānaṃ vidyāpradānakam | annavāripradānaṃ ca bhūṣāmbarapradānakam ||81|| gṛhopakaraṇānāṃ ca dānaṃ śṛṃgāradānakam | yānavāhanadānaṃ cābhayadānaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||82|| viśvāsadānaṃ dravyāṇāṃ dānaṃ kumāradānakam | vṛṣabhāṇāṃ gajānāṃ ca vājināṃ dānamuttamam ||83|| chatrāsanādidānaṃ ca vetradānaṃ paraṃ matam | siṃhāsanapradānaṃ ca gajāsanapradānakam ||84|| jñānadānaṃ bhaktidānaṃ puruṣārthapradānakam | kāmadānāni caitāni pavitrāṇyuttamāni ca ||85|| sādhubhyo daivatavadbhyo dattānyetāni padmaje | nityadā khalu dātāraṃ pāpāt pramokṣayanti hi ||86|| puṇyapuñjairyojayanti nayanti divamuttamam | satyalokaṃ ca vairājān lokān nayanti tāni ha ||87|| viṣṇulokān sadāśivalokān nayanti tāni ha | māyālokānīśalokān golokān prāpayanti ca ||88|| lakṣmīlokān muktalokān śrīlokān prāpayanti ca | avyākṛtāmṛtadhāmaviśeṣān prāpayanti ca ||89|| pārṣadānāṃ mahālokānnārīlokānnayanti ca | sādhvīlokān satīlokān dātāraṃ prāpayanti ca ||3.109.90|| vahnilokān dharmalokān candralokānnayanti ca | yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke yacca syād dayitaṃ priyam ||91 || tattad deyaṃ supātrāya phalamakṣayadaṃ hi tat | priyakṛllabhate nityaṃ priyaṃ priyaprado bhavet ||92|| priyo bhavati bhūtānāmiha cāpi paratra ca | amitramapi dīnaṃ ceccharaṇaiṣiṇamāgatam ||93|| vyasane yo’nugṛhṇāti sa vai nārāyaṇo mataḥ | kṛśāyādhītavidyāya vṛttikṣīṇāya sīdate ||94|| dadyāt kaṣṭaṃ nāśayecca sa vai nārāyaṇo mataḥ | satkarmaparamān sādhūn putradārakuṭumbinaḥ ||95|| ayācamānān dadyācca sarvopāyaiḥ pratuṣṭaye | lālasā naiva bhogeṣu svargeṣvapi prakurvate ||96|| nityatuṣṭā nirāśāśca kṛtāvasathavāsinaḥ | brahmaparā pradātavyāḥ sarvasmṛddhibhirādarāt ||97|| yadi te pratigṛhṇīyuḥ śraddhāpūtaṃ pradāpitam | dattaṃ tat koṭipuṇyānāṃ pradaṃ mokṣapradaṃ bhavet ||98|| dhārmikā bhaktimanto vai vidvāṃso vratino janāḥ | tāpasāḥ śīlayogāśca dāntāḥ pātrāṇi sādhavaḥ ||99|| teṣu dattaṃ mahāyajño nityaṃ brahmamakho bhavet | viśiṣṭaḥ sarvayajñebhyaścānṛṇyasampradaḥ sadā || 3.109.10 0|| kupyanti naiva cālābhe lubhyanti na tṛṇeṣvapi | tuṣyanti sukhino dṛṣṭvā modante varddhayanti ca || 10 1|| nārāyaṇaṃ ca māṃ nityaṃ smaranti kīrtanaiḥ sadā | sādhavo brāhmaṇā brahmadharāśca ṛtvijo’malāḥ || 102|| purohitāstathācāryāstādṛśyaḥ sādhvikāḥ striyaḥ | mātaraḥ putrakalyāṇakartryaḥ pūjyatamāśca yāḥ || 1 03|| vittādinā sadā pūjyā namaskāryā yathāyatham | dātavyāścarddhibhirnityaṃ devā devyo hi tā matāḥ ||1 04|| yathā svāmyāśrayo dharmaḥ strīṇāṃ loke sanātanaḥ | tathā svāmyāśrayo dharmo dānātmā devatāśrayaḥ || 1 05|| sādhubhyaḥ prathamaṃ dadyād brahmavidbhyaḥ śubhaṃ muhuḥ | anāthebhyastato dadyād bhikṣukebhyastataḥ param || 1 06|| viprebhyaśca tato dadyānnārībhyaśca tataḥ param | brāhmaṇebhyastato dadyādanyebhyaśca tataḥ param || 1 07|| dāsādibhyastato dadyādevaṃ dātā pramodate | dānaphalaṃ ca lokeṣu bhuktvā brahma prayātyanu || 1 08|| puruṣottamasāmākhyastotreṇaityakṣaraṃ padam | sarvadānaphalaṃ saukhyaṃ modamānandamutsavam || 1 09|| labhate śāśvatamūrtirbrahmasāyujyamāsthitaḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya brahmasāyujyabhāg bhavet || 3.109.11 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne dānaphalabhogottaraṃ puruṣottamasāmajapaphalamakṣaradhāmasthaśāśvatānandātmakaṃ bhuṃkte dātetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 109 ||
<3.110> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca vidyā cācaraṇaṃ lakṣmi janma dīkṣā śubhāśrayaḥ | ete yatra pravidyante dānapātraṃ taduttamam || 1 || yācate yatpradattaṃ tacchreya eva nigadyate | ayācate pradattaṃ tu dānaṃ svasvatvavarjitam || 2 || brahmiṣṭho dānapātraṃ vai sādhuḥ pātraprabhūṣaṇam | labdhvā sādhuḥ suvidvān yat prīṇāti devatā gurūn || 3 || yācanā sarvathā lakṣmi nikṛṣṭodvegakāriṇī | prakāśadasyuryācamāno bhavatyevāghakṛddhi saḥ || 4 || yācanā tu bhavenmṛtyurmṛtyureva tu yācanā | sā tu duḥkhapradā tasmād yācato dānameva na || 5 || dātṛtvaṃ jīvanaṃ proktaṃ yācate dīyate yadi | jīvanaṃ śreya evāsti dātā śreyaśca vindati || 6 || grahītā śreyasā yukto bhavatyeva tathādharmaḥ | uttamo vai pradātā syāttasmāddānaṃ praśasyate || 7 || yācate dīyamānenānṛśaṃsatvaṃ vibhāvyate | ayācate tu dānena svargaphalaṃ vibhāvyate || 8 || pūjyā hi jñānavijñānatapobhaktiyutā janāḥ | yoginaḥ sādhavaḥ pūjyāstebhyo deyaṃ samastakam || 9 || dattamatithaye vidyāvate śīlavate’rthine | akṣayaṃ vai phalaṃ tasya jāyate śāśvataṃ divam || 3.110.10|| yeṣāṃ śiṣyāḥ sutā dārāḥ pratīkṣante’nnavāriṇī | tebhyo dattaṃ prabhuñjānāstretāgniṃ prīṇayanti te ||1 1 || sādhubhyo brahmacāribhyo dattaṃ prabhuñjate tu te | brahmāgniṃ te prīṇayanti savanaṃ paramaṃ hi tat || 12|| madhyandinaṃ tu savanaṃ bhikṣukebhyo’rpaṇaṃ sadā | devebhyaścāpi pitṛbhyo’rpaṇaṃ tadvaiśvadaivikam || 1 3|| savanaṃ tu tṛtīyaṃ tad yajñāstrayo divaṃpradāḥ | nārāyaṇāya mahyaṃ yad dattaṃ divyamakho hi saḥ || 14|| ātmārpaṇātmako lakṣmi kartavyo’yaṃ vijānatā | adrohaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃvibhāgo’nuyāyinām || 15|| sevā tuṣṭirdamastyāgo yajñā bhavanti sāttvikāḥ | ta ete’vabhṛthāyante śraddhāpūtāḥ sadakṣiṇāḥ || 16|| pāpakṛtāṃ janānāṃ na pratigṛhṇanti sādhavaḥ | tasmād dravyamaye yajñe dātavyaṃ pāpanāśanam || 17|| yadi gṛhṇanti santo’sya pāpinaḥ pāvanaṃ hi tat | pāpaprakṣālanaśaktaṃ pātrabalāt prajāyate || 18|| brāhmaṇām̐starpayed dravyaistattadiṣṭatamārparṇaiḥ | maitrān sādhūn vedavidaḥ śīlavratatapojuṣaḥ || 1 9|| tarpayed bahudhā dānaiḥ svādvannairdakṣiṇādibhiḥ | prajāvato bhaktajanān prajāvān jāyate hi ke ||3.110.20|| yāvataḥ sādhudharmān vai santaḥ saṃvardhayanti hi | te bhartavyā bahudānairjīvakalyāṇakāriṇaḥ ||21 || dhenavo vṛṣabhā bhūṣā ambarāṇi dhanāni ca | ājyānyannāni yānāni chātraṃ vāsāṃsyupānahau ||22|| aśvavanti ca yānāni veśmāni śayanāni ca | ete deyāḥ sādhusadbhyaḥ svargadā mokṣadā hi te ||23|| dātā pāpairvinirmuktaḥ pūtaḥ svargaṃ prayāti hi | upachannaṃ prakāśaṃ vā vṛttyā sādhūn prapālayet ||24|| rājasūyāśvamedhānāṃ phalabhāk sa bhaved dhruvaḥ | yogaṃ kṣemaṃ vindate’pi śāśvataṃ cākṣaraṃ padam ||29|| sādhavo yaṃ na śaṃsanti tanna kuryāt kadācana | dadyādvai mahato bhogān kṣudbhayaṃ praṇudet satām ||26|| yatra deśe prapaśyanti svādubhojyāni bālakāḥ | prapaśyantyeva nāśnanti sa deśo’ghamalātmakaḥ ||27|| yatra deśe sādhavaścānāthāḥ striyaśca bālakāḥ | kṣudhā sīdanti deśaḥ sa nāśamāyāti sarvathā ||28|| krośantyo yatra vai deśe dhriyante tarasā striyaḥ | gāvaścāpi prajāścāpi sa deśo maraṇonmukhaḥ ||29|| tasmādabhayadānākhyaṃ dānaṃ paramakaṃ matam | abhayasya pradātā vai yāti cābhayamakṣaram ||3.110.30|| puruṣottamasāmnaścodgātā yātyabhayākṣaram | pṛthivīdānakṛllakṣmi yāti kṣmāmakṣarātmikām ||3 1|| dattātra kṣmā divyarūpaṃ dhṛtvottiṣṭhati cākṣare | acalā cākṣayā dogdhrī divyakāmādipūraṇī ||32|| ratnavāsāṃsi ramyāṇi sudhāvrīhiyavāmṛtān | sarvavidhānyamṛtāni labhate bhūmido’kṣare ||33|| bhūmidaḥ sarvalokeṣu śāśvatīredhate samāḥ | yāvadbhūmerihāyuśca tāvadbhūmida edhate ||34|| bhūmiṃ daduśca ye dāne bhūmiṃ te bhuñjate parām | bhūmirbhūtirmahālakṣmīrdātāraṃ kurute priyam ||35|| yathādānaṃ tathā bhogo dānaṃ śrīḥ paramā matā | api pāpasamācāre brahmaghne bhaktivarjite ||36|| kṣitiḥ kṣiptā punātyeva grahītā sādhubhistu cet | sā manyate dhanyabhāgyaṃ sādhuhastagatā satī ||37|| dātāraṃ kurute śuddhaṃ svāpatyaṃ jananī yathā | pṛthvyā nāmāsti dharmākhyaṃ priyadatteti sārthakam ||38|| bhūmiṃ tu sādhave datvā bhūmiṃ divyāṃ pravindate | yaḥ sādhorbhūmimādatte na bhūmiṃ vindate hi saḥ ||39|| sādhorbhūmiḥ śasyate’tra sā tu nārāyaṇī matā | pāpī gocarmamātreṇa bhūmidānena pūyate ||3.110.40 || yo yajetāśvamedhena dadyādvā sādhave mahīm | mahīdānaṃ praśastaṃ śāśvatānandaphalapradam ||41 || suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ maṇimuktāvasūni ca | sarvametad dattavān syād yo dadāti vasundharām ||42|| tapo yajñaḥ śrutaṃ śīlaṃ guroḥ sevā gavārcanam | sādhudaivatapūjā ca etā bhavanti bhūmide ||43 || dātṛniḥśreyase yuktā śreyaḥ paraṃ dadāti sā | yathā jananī putraṃ svaṃ kṣīreṇa bharate’nvaham ||44|| tathā puṣṇāti dātāraṃ sarvagandharasairmahī | mṛtyuḥ kālo yamadaṇḍo māyā vahnirjvaro hyariḥ ||45|| pāśo bādhāśca vighnāśca bhayaṃ durītamityapi | akasmātā ītayaśca nopasarpanti bhūmidam ||46|| pitṝn devān maharṣīṃśca siddhān yogijanān satīḥ | sādhvīryuktān brahmakāntāḥ santarpayati bhūmidaḥ ||47|| kṛśāya vṛttihīnāyānāthāya sīdate kṣitim | jīvikājananīṃ datvā sarvasatrī bhavejjanaḥ ||48|| yathā dhenuḥ svavatsaṃ vai yacchati vatsalā payaḥ | poṣayatyeva tadvat kṣmā dātāraṃ poṣayatyati ||49|| sasasyāṃ vā sabījāṃ vā sakaṇāṃ yaḥ prayacchati | śreṣṭhaṃ gṛhaṃ cārpayati bhaved brahmā sa dānakṛt ||3.110.50|| yathā candramaso vṛddhiḥ śukle pratyahameva ha | tathā bhūdaḥ parāṃ vṛddhiṃ sasye sasye pravindati ||51|| pṛthvī mūrtimatī prāha pṛthvīsvāmina eva sā | māmādāya ca māṃ datta datvā māṃ māmavāpsyatha ||52|| prāyaścittaṃ mahīdānaṃ punātyubhayato daśa | sa kulīnaḥ sa puruṣaḥ sa bandhuḥ sa hi puṇyakṛt ||53|| sa dātā sa makhī sādhuryo dadāti vasundharām | yathā sasyāni rohanti tathā kṣmādasya kāmanāḥ ||54|| bhūmirmātā pitā lakṣmīrannaṃ jīvanamityapi | bhūmau bhavanti puṣṭāśca niṣṭhāṃ vrajanti vai bhuvi ||55|| ādityā varuṇā rudrā brahmāṇo viṣṇavo’nalāḥ | vasavaḥ śaśino devā bhūmiṃ datvābhavan surāḥ ||56|| suvarṇadānaṃ godānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ gṛhārpaṇam | dadannetān sādhave’tra sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||57|| bharturniḥśreyase yattā pativratārdhadehinī | bhūdānamācaret tena bhartā yātyakṣarama padam ||58|| ratnopakīrṇāṃ vasudhāṃ sarvakāmaguṇānvitām | dadyād rājādhirājaḥ syāt puṇyaḥ svarge mahīyate ||59|| sarvakāmadughāṃ dhenuṃ mahīṃ kāmapravarṣiṇīm | kanyāṃ vaṃśakarīṃ sādhvīṃ dadan svarge mahīyate ||3.110.60|| madhusarpiḥpravāhiṇyaḥ payodadhivahāstathā | saritastarpayantīha pare tu vasudhāpradam ||61|| mahīṃ śastrajitāṃ datvā yuddhapāpaṃ vyapohati | na tasya lokāḥ kṣīyante svarge modanta eva te ||62|| bhūtiṃ cecchan pradadyād kṣmāṃ puṇyāmṛddhirasānvitām | sāgarān saritaḥ śailān kānanāni ca sarvaśaḥ ||63|| taḍāgānyudapānāni srotāṃsi ca sarāṃsi ca | snehān sarvarasāṃścaiva dadāti vasudhāṃ dadan ||64|| oṣadhīrvīryasampannā nagān puṣpaphalānvitān | kānanopalaśailām̐śca dhātūn khanīśca sarvathā ||65|| jīvikāṃ sarvajīvānāṃ dadāti vasudhāṃ dadan | ikṣubhiḥ santatāṃ bhūmiṃ yavagodhūmaśālinīm ||66|| go’śvavāhanapūrṇāṃ ca nidhigarbhāṃ sasādhanām | dadāti yo’kṣayalokān labhate sa mahāsukhān ||67|| bhūmisatraṃ bhavettasya sarvakaluṣanāśakam | satāṃ loke pare divye sadbhirdātā mahīyate ||68|| śataṃ divyā yoṣito’pi divyamālāvibhūṣitāḥ | sampadaścopatiṣṭhanti brahmaloke dharāpradam ||69|| śaṃkhabhadrāsanaṃ chatraṃ varāśvāvaravāhanam | dharmapuṇyāni puṣpāṇi hiraṇyanicayām̐stathā ||3.110.70|| ājñāṃ sadāpratihatāṃ jayaśabdān vasūni ca | hiraṇyapuṣpāścauṣadhīn kuśakāñcanaśādvalāḥ ||71|| amṛtaprasavāṃ bhūmiṃ bhūtiṃ kṣmādaḥ prapadyate | nāsti bhūmisamaṃ dānaṃ nāsti mātṛsamo guruḥ ||72|| nāsti satyasamo dharmo nāsti dānasamo nidhiḥ | nāsti sādhusamaṃ pātraṃ nāsti mokṣasamaṃ sukham ||73|| nāsti muktipradaṃ stotraṃ puruṣottamasāmavat | dānakṛt stotravaktā ca yāti dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||74|| dānaphalaṃ paraṃ bhuktvā svarge satye tathaiśvare | divyaloke tato yāti stavāddhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||75|| yathā bhūmistathā cānnaṃ śasyate dānarūpakam | lokayātrā bhavatyanne prāṇā anne pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||76|| annaṃ tat prathamaṃ brahma jīvakaṃ tṛptidaṃ sadā | annabhūrjaskara śaktipradaṃ dhārakameva tat ||77|| tāpasā bhikṣavaḥ santo gṛhiṇo’nne pratiṣṭhitāḥ | kṣudhitāyānnadātā tu paratra nidhimān dhruvaḥ ||78|| atithiṃ cāgataṃ śīghraṃ jalānnaiḥ pūjayed gṛhī | annado labhate svarge ceha vāmṛtamuttamam ||79|| annaṃ śvapāke śuniṃ vā dattaṃ na vipraṇaśyati | dadyādadṛṣṭapūrvāya sa mahaddharmamāpnuyāt ||3.110.80|| pitṝn devānṛṣīn viprān sādhūn nārīranāthakān | atithīn prīṇayatyannaistasya puṇyamanantakam ||8 1 || annadānaṃ sarvavarṇe śasyate puṇyadaṃ hi tat | na pṛcched gotracaraṇaṃ svādhyāyaṃ deśamityapi ||82|| bhikṣukāya pradadyādvai yācito’nnaṃ samuttamam | annadasyānnasasyāni sarvadā phaladāni vai ||83|| bhavanti cehāmutrāpi sudhāsvāduphalāni hi | pitaro’pi pratīkṣante kule’nnado bhaveddhi naḥ ||84|| santo viprā anāthāśca vyaṃgā annasya bhikṣavaḥ | satkṛtāśca nivartante datvā puṇyāni daivatam ||85|| nityaṃ miṣṭānnadāyī tu svarge vasati satkṛtaḥ | annadaḥ paśumān putrī dhanavān bhogavānapi ||86 || prāṇavān rūpavām̐ścāpi jāyate pūjyate suraiḥ | kṣetraṃ kṣudhāyutaṃ pātraṃ tatropyate prarohati ||87|| pratyakṣaṃ prītijananaṃ cāmṛtaṃ puṇyasatphalam | bhokturdāturbhavatyeva jīvanāṃkurameva ha ||88|| dhātumūlaṃ kāmamūlaṃ garbhamūlaṃ sadānnakam | prasavaścāpi dharmārthau roganāśo’nnato matāḥ ||89|| anne bhūḥ svaḥ satyalokaḥ sarve tiṣṭhanti padmaje | annābhāve prabhidyante śarīre pañcadhātavaḥ ||3.110.90|| balaṃ rūpaṃ praśaktyādyā naśyantyannanirodhanāt | utsavāśca vivāhāśca yajñāścānnairbhavanti hi ||9 1 || sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ yacca sarvamanne pratiṣṭhitam | jaḍaṃ ca cetanaṃ cāpi puṣṭitattvamapekṣate ||92|| api yantrāṇi tailāpo’pekṣante kā kathātmanaḥ | bhavanāni prakāśante divi cānnapradātmanām ||93|| tārāsaṃsthāni jāyante candraśubhrāṇi tāni vā | taruṇādityavarṇāni kiṃkiṇījālavanti ca ||94|| anekaśatabhaumāni sāntarjalacarāṇi ca | vaidūryārkaprakāśāni raupyarukmamayāni ca ||95|| sarvakāmaphaladāśca vallīvṛkṣāśca teṣvapi | vāpyo vīthyaḥ sabhāḥ kūpā dīrghikāḥ santi teṣu ca ||96|| ghoṣavanti vimānāni labhyante bhavaneṣvapi | bhakṣyabhojyamayāḥ śailā vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca ||97|| kṣīranadyo dadhinadyo ghṛtanadyo’tra santi ca | prāsādā divyakāntāśca suśayyāḥ kāñcanojjvalāḥ ||98|| devyo manoharā yogyāḥ prāpyante tatra mandire | annadānāṃ sadā lakṣmīrvardhate’mṛtavarṣiṇī ||99|| sudhānadyaḥ prasravanti pīyūṣavārdhayastathā | evaṃ bhuktvā śubhān lokān yathāpuṇyamataḥ param || 3.110.1 00|| puruṣottamasāmnā vai lakṣmi yāti padaṃ mama | akṣaraṃ dhāma paramaṃ bhuṃkte kāmān mayā saha || 101 || sādhūn viprām̐starpayedvai sarpiṣā pāyasena ca | kṛsaraiḥ polikādyābhiḥ sūpodanaiśca tarpayet || 10 2|| tilapakvānnakairbhakṣyaiḥ phāṇitaiḥ pāyasaiḥ śubhaiḥ | śākaiḥ phalairmūlakaiśca kandairdalaiśca saktukaiḥ || 1 03|| rājamāṣaiśca miṣṭānnairlaḍḍukaistarpayet sataḥ | dakṣiṇāyāṃ svarṇadānaṃ rūpyakaṃ cārpayettathā || 104|| svargān bhuktvā sāmapāṭhādakṣaraṃ saṃvrajatyapi | śāśvataṃ paramānandaṃ bhuṃkte lakṣmi mayā saha || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne dānapātre dānaphalaṃ bhūdānaphalamannadānaphalaṃ puruṣottamasāmaphalaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā daśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 110 ||
<3.111> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ jalaṃ tu jīvanaṃ sadā | jaladānaṃ jīvadānaṃ kīrtitaṃ cāmṛtātmakam || 1 || śītalaṃ madhuraṃ vāri miṣṭaṃ kṛtvā sugandhayuk | śārkaraṃ pāyayet sādhūn viprānanyām̐stṛṣānvitām || 2 || prapāḥ kuryāt kārayecca pāyayet sujalāni vai | kūpān vāpītaḍāgām̐śca kārayellokatṛptidān || 3 || jaladānaṃ rasadānaṃ pare loke prapadyate | ardhaṃ pāpasya harati jalaṃ dattaṃ sutṛptidam || 4 || jalaṃ sākṣisvarūpaṃ ca varuṇātma pradīvyati | cetanaṃ brahma vāryāste deyaṃ puṇyatamaṃ jalam || 5 || gāvo viprāḥ sādhavaśca sādhvyo’nye dehino’pi ca | yasya khāte pibantyaṃbhastārayanti kulāni te || 6 || yathā vāri tathā puṇyaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadyāt prabhakṣaṇe | sādhudvijātithibhyo’pi rūpavān rasavān bhavet || 7 || phalaṃ puṣṭiṃ yaśaḥ snehaṃ cāmṛtaṃ labhate divi | balaṃ gāśca mahiṣīśca labhate ghṛtadānakṛt || 8 || dadyād dāne pāyasaṃ ca sarpirdadyād viśeṣataḥ | ghṛtadāturgṛhaṃ rakṣoyamādyā dharṣayanti na || 9 || pipāsayā na mriyate karakāvāridānakṛt | śakaṭasya pradātuśca bhavanti vāhanāni vai || 3.111.1 0|| svargayānāni ramyāṇi vimānāni śubhāni ca | upānatsaṃpradātuśca naśyanti kaṇṭakāḥ sadā || 11 || śakaṭaṃ damyasaṃyuktaṃ dattaṃ bhavati tasya vai | tiladānaṃ prakartavyaṃ pitṛbhojyāḥ śubhāstilāḥ || 12|| sarvasatrairyajate sa yastilān samprayacchati | pauṣṭikān rūpadām̐ścāpi tathā pāpavināśakān || 1 3|| yatra ghṛtaṃ vrīhirnāsti nāsti phalāni pāyasam | tatra tilaiḥ prahotavyaṃ tṛpyanti pitaraḥ surāḥ || 14|| tiladasyāmṛtaṃ svargaṃ copatiṣṭhati sarvadā | tiladātānnadaḥ proktaḥ phaladaścāpi kathyate ||15|| evaṃ lakṣmi bhūmidātā yajñaṣaṣṭhāṃśamṛcchati | na sīdati sa kṛcchreṣu na ca durgāṇi gacchati || 1 6|| śītavātātapasahāṃ gṛhabhūmiṃ suśobhitām | yo datte modate svarge puṇyānte’pi na cālyate || 17|| pratiśrayapradātā vai svarge yāti pramodate | dharmaśālāvidhātā ca svargaloke pramodate || 18|| yasya saudhe pāṭhaśālā sādhuśālā gavāṃ kulam | sa dātā svaśca vairājaṃ prādhānikaṃ gṛhaṃ labhet || 19|| āśatāni kulānyeva tārayatyāśrayapradaḥ | kṣetradaḥ satatāṃ lakṣmīṃ ratnado vaṃśavistaram ||3.111.20|| udyānadaḥ phalarasān tīrthado mokṣamuttamam | godo yāti tu golokaṃ viprado brahma cākṣaram ||21 || kumārado bhūmalokaṃ kanyādaḥ śrīsthalīṃ śubhām | dāsīprado’psarolokaṃ dīpadaḥ sūryasannidhim ||22|| ghṛtadaḥ somalokaṃ ca dugdhado’mṛtadhāma ca | ratnado’vyākṛtaṃ dhāma strīdo viṣṇupadaṃ param ||23 || gṛhadaḥ satyalokaṃ ca ṛddhidaḥ prākṛtaṃ sthalam | bhūṣādo vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma prayāti śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ||24|| godaḥ prāṇapradaḥ proktaḥ śaraṇyasya pradastathā | gosahasrāṇi daśa yo dadātīndratvamṛcchati ||25|| svāyaṃbhuvaṃ mahatsthānaṃ kaṇadaḥ samagacchati | lomaśaśca guruḥ prāha prāṇadānaṃ paraṃ matam || 26|| yena prāṇāḥ prarakṣyante prāṇadānaṃ hi tanmatam | annenāpi jalenāpi tathauṣadhādibhiḥ kvacit ||27|| śaraṇenābhayenāpyāśrayeṇa prāṇarakṣaṇam | tāni dānāni kamale prāṇadānāni sarvadā ||28|| dātavyāni cirāyuṣṭvaphalāni svargadāni ca | jalaṃ surāṇāmamṛtaṃ jāyate dattamatra yat ||29|| nāgānāṃ tat sudhārūpaṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca svadhātmakam | vatsānāṃ cāpi bālānāṃ jalaṃ dugdhātmakaṃ bhavet ||3.111.3 0|| jaladānaṃ sadā dadyād yadīcched bhūtimātmanaḥ | dānānyetāni dhanyāni cāyuṣyāṇi sukhāni ca ||3 1 || sarvakāmapradānyeva pretyānandapradāni ca | etaddānāni datvātra bhogān bhuktvā triviṣṭape ||32|| uṣitvā cirakalpām̐ścākṣaraṃ stotrāt prayāti ca | puruṣottamasāmnaśca phalaṃ tvakṣaradhāma vai ||33||| nijadānaṃ pradātavyaṃ gṛhiṇā tyāgine śubham | sarvaṃ tyaktvā sādhave svārpaṇakartākṣare pade ||34|| modate brahmavidbhakto mukto bhūtvā nirantakaḥ | pūrve nṛpāstathā viprāḥ svārpaṇaṃ tyāgine rame ||35|| gurave cārpaṇaṃ cakrurnaijaṃ tyāgāśramāya ha | bhūtvā vanī tato nyāsī gacchedvai paramaṃ padam ||36|| puruṣottamasāmnā vai labhetākṣaradhāma ca | śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ dīrghaśīlasya brāhmaṇasya vai ||37|| śatruṃjayāyāḥ saritastaṭe grāme virāmaṇe | dīrghaśīlo’bhavadvipro vasantye’pi bhūsurāḥ || 38|| atha prāha yamaḥ kaṃcid dūtaṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ nijam | yāhi virāmaṇaṃ dīrghaśīlaṃ samānaya ||39|| bhāradvājaṃ gotrataśca snānapūjāvivarjitam | nāstikaṃ nindakaṃ śāstramṛṣāvādinameva tam ||3.111.40|| mā cānyamānayethāstvaṃ nāmnā gotreṇa sadṛśam | dānaśīlaṃ dīrghaśīlaṃ vasantaṃ vai virāmaṇe ||41 || sa gatvā tvānayad dūto niṣiddhaṃ dānaśīlinam | grāme kolāhalo jāto mṛto vai dīrghaśīlavān ||42|| sambandhinaḥ suhṛdaścāyayustadubhayorgṛham | bhrāntā nyavartayam̐ścāpi dṛṣṭvā jīvantamekakam ||43|| kecidāhuryamadūto’smābhirdṛṣṭo bhayaṃkaraḥ | dīrghaśīlaṃ sunītvaiva gacchan vyomagatistvaran ||44|| śrutvā trāsaṃ jagāmāpi nāstiko maraṇaṃ nijam | antike tvāgataṃ kintu dūto vismṛtya māṃ param ||45|| āstikaṃ hṛtavāneva tato dānaṃ karomi ca | dattavān drutamevāyaṃ gotilāmbarabhūṣaṇam ||46|| gṛhaṃ ghṛtaṃ subhojyānnaṃ jajāpa ca punaḥ punaḥ | puruṣottamasāmāpi bhīyukto maraṇasya saḥ ||47|| tatpuṇyaṃ bahudhā jātaṃ sarvapāpavināśakam | pratīkṣate yamadūtaṃ tvāyāsyantaṃ muhurdiśam ||48|| atha saṃyaminīpuryāṃ gataścāstikabhūsuraḥ | dṛṣṭo yamena dharmeṇa nataścotthāya pūjitaḥ ||49|| madhuparkādibhiḥ samyak satkṛto vanditastathā | bhojitaścāmṛtānnaiśca kṣamāṃ prati tato’rthitaḥ ||3.111.50 || atha dharmanṛpo dūtaṃ prāha nāyaṃ sa daṇḍabhāk | pūjito nīyatāmeṣaḥ so’nya ānīyatāmiti |||51|| evamukte tu vacane tvāstikaḥ prāha dharmajam | nirviṇṇo’haṃ śeṣakālaṃ vaseyamiti sarvadā ||52|| nāhamicchāmi duḥkhāḍhye dehe nivasituṃ yama | dharmān śrāvaya bhadraṃ te yān prapālyāpyate sukham |||53|| dharmarājastataḥ prāha śṛṇu tattvaṃ hi bhūsura | bhūmidānaṃ sarvadānasamaṃ sarvasukhapradam ||54|| gṛhadānaṃ sarvasādhyasādhanaiścopabṛṃhitam | sukhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ svargapradaṃ vipra paraṃ matam ||55|| udyānavāṭikādānaṃ rasadānaṃ paraṃ matam | sarvarasānavāpnoti phalapuṣpādanāni ca ||56|| taṭākasaritāṃ dānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tṛptipradaṃ matam | godānaṃ paramaṃ vipra svargamokṣapradaṃ matam ||57|| vaitaraṇītārakaṃ ca māyābandhananāśakam | bhavābdhitārakaṃ pāpakṣālakaṃ hi gavārpaṇam ||58|| svargadānaṃ bhūṣaṇādisamarpaṇaṃ paraṃ matam | śṛṃgārāmbaradānaṃ ca smṛddhidaṃ paramaṃ matam ||59|| kanyādānaṃ ca dāmpatyapradaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ divampradam | dāsadāsīpradānaṃ ca dhanadānaṃ tathā śubham ||3.111.6 0 || sarvagārhasthyabhogānāṃ sampādakaṃ tu nāṇakam | tiladānaṃ ghṛtadānaṃ dīpadānaṃ paraṃ tathā ||61 || śarkarāgūḍadānaṃ ca yavagodhūmadānakam| chatropānatpradānaṃ ca svargarājyapradaṃ matam ||62|| tāni sarvāṇi deyāni deyaṃ cābhayadānakam | mokṣadānaṃ paratamaṃ sarvebhyo vai viśiṣyate ||63 || vipra tvayā pradattāni bahūnīmāni sarvathā | puṇyavānasi samyak tvaṃ kuru śreyo hi dehinām ||64|| puruṣottamasāmākhyaṃ stotraṃ japa punarmuhuḥ | mokṣadaṃ śāśvatānandapradaṃ mokṣapramodadam ||65|| nityasukhapradaṃ pāpadhvaṃsakaṃ cākṣarapradam | puruṣottamasāmnastu pāṭhakaṃ pūrvapāpinam ||66|| daṇḍaṃ nāhaṃ dadāmyatra pāvanaḥ sa tu kīrtyate | adaṇḍyo me bhaved vipra mahāpāpyapi pāṭhakaḥ ||67|| yāhi vipra sukhenaiva kṣantavyaścāpi dharmarāṭ | ityukto dīrghaśīlaśca dūtena saha satvaram ||68|| natvā dharmaṃ cāyayau vai nijaṃ dehaṃ vineśa ha | prasannā bāndhavā jātā vipro dānāni vai dadau ||69|| yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ cānte japtvā stotraṃ mama priyam | puruṣottamasāmākhyaṃ sarvabādhānivartakam ||3.111.70|| yamadūto nāstikaṃ taṃ nītvāyayau yamaṃ prati | daṇḍāyāvedayāmāsa citraguptaṃ tu dharmarāṭ ||71|| dṛṣṭvāha citragupto’pi puṇyaṃ vivardhate’sya vai | pāpānyadyāni sarvāṇi durītāni kṛtāni tu ||72|| vilīnāni samagrāṇi puruṣottamasāmataḥ | puṇyapuñjāḥ pravardhante sarvadānādibhistviha ||73|| tato daṇḍyo’sti nāyaṃ vai pūjanīyo’sti sarvathā | śrutvā śrīdharmarājo’pi pupūja dīrghaśīlinam ||74|| bhayena puṇyakartāraṃ japtāraṃ stavanasya ca | arghyaṃ cācamanaṃ pādaprakṣālanajalaṃ dadau ||75|| svāgataṃ cārhaṇaṃ bhojyaṃ madhuparkādikaṃ dadau | kṛtvā ca saṃvidaṃ tena visasarja tadā hi saḥ ||76 || papraccha dharmarājaṃ taṃ kṛtaṃ naṣṭaṃ kathaṃ mama | nāstiko’haṃ nindakaścāgharmī pāpī bhavāmi ca ||77|| tathāpi naiva daṇḍo me mahāścaryamidaṃ mama | vada me dharmarāja tvaṃ kathaṃ daṇḍo na vai mama ||78|| śrutvāha dharmarājastaṃ kṛtaṃ tu bhujyate sadā | niyamo’sti sadā loke prajvalitaṃ na bhujyate ||79|| annaṃ vastraṃ gṛhaṃ yānaṃ śayanaṃ pāpakaṃ vṛṣaḥ | prajvalitā na bhujyante te pāpaṃ jvalitaṃ dvija ||3.111.80|| puruṣottamasāmākhyastotrapāṭhena sarvathā | dānānāṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ codbhūtaṃ tava bhūsura ||81|| bhuṃkṣva puṇyaṃ kṣitau dīrghamuṣitvā svastataḥ param | tataḥ satyaṃ ca vairājaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca tataḥ param ||82|| tato’kṣaraṃ śāśvataṃ ca yāhi bhuṃkṣva mahāsukham | puruṣottamabhaktānāmaśubhaṃ vidyate na vai ||83|| kālamāyāpāpakarmabhayā naśyanti sarvathā | puruṣottamabhakteṣu nādhikāro’sti me’pi ca ||84|| pūrvanāstikavipro’sau papraccha ca tato yamam | gatvā tatra mayā yadyat kartavyaṃ tad vadātra me ||85|| yathāśakti kariṣyāmi kārayiṣyāmi śobhanam | śrutvāha yamarājo’pi vipraṃ dharmamayaṃ vṛṣam ||86 || śṛṇu vipra prakartavyaṃ mandiraṃ paramātmanaḥ | sthāpanīyo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śriyā saha ||87|| sevāḥ sarvavidhāścāsya karaṇīyā yathākṣaṇam | bhojanīyāḥ sādhavaśca sevanīyā nirantaram ||88|| pādasaṃvāhanādyaiśca dānaiśca sarvavastubhiḥ | doṣaṇīyāḥ sadā santo mokṣadā bhavatārakāḥ ||89|| mandire dīpadānaṃ ca jalaprasravaṇārpaṇam | na vedanārpaṇaṃ cāpi pūjādravyārpaṇaṃ tathā ||3.111.90|| yānavāhanadānaṃ ca vāṭikodyānakārpaṇam | dhvajārpaṇaṃ kalaśānāmarpaṇaṃ pātrakārpaṇam ||91 || śayyārpaṇaṃ rasānāmarpaṇaṃ gandhārpaṇaṃ tathā | svarṇabhūṣārpaṇaṃ divyāmbarādyarpaṇamityapi ||92|| śākapatrārpaṇaṃ cāpi tāmbūlakādikārpaṇam | vyajanādyarpaṇaṃ cāpi kambalādyarpaṇaṃ tathā ||93|| pūjāpravāhavastūnāṃ dravyāṇāmarpaṇaṃ tathā | vāditrāṇāṃ śubhaṃ dānaṃ veṣāṇāmarpaṇa tathā ||94|| mahāsthālyādidānaṃ ca gargarīdānamityapi | paryaṃkādipradānaṃ ca mahāsanasamarpaṇam ||95|| govājigajadānaṃ ca vṛṣabhārpaṇamityapi | maṇiratnādidānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ mandire sadā ||96|| dātavyaṃ gurave sarvaṃ ceṣṭadevārhaṇāya vai | dāsīdāsapradānaṃ ca sabhāśālāpradānakam ||97|| kūpavāpītaḍāgādidānaṃ kāryaṃ tu mandire | chatracāmaradānaṃ tu siṃhāsanādikārpaṇam ||98|| pustakārpaṇamevāpi peṭikādyarpaṇaṃ tathā | kaṇānāmarpanaṃ cāpi godhūmataṇḍulārpaṇam ||99|| evaṃvidhāni dānāni jalānnasahitāni vai | dātavyāni viśeṣeṇa gṛhiṇā bhūsureṇa ha || 3.111.100 || snānaṃ sandhyājapaṃ bhaktiṃ stotrapāṭhaṃ samācaret | mokṣadaṃ cātmavijñānaṃ brahmavidyāṃ paṭhettathā || 101 || pitroḥ prasevanaṃ kuryāt paropakāramityapi | brahmaśīlo bhaveccāpi bhaktiśīlo bhavettathā || 102|| rāgahīno bhaveccāpi doṣān pravarjayet sadā | viṣṇupūjāṃ prakuryācca mokṣaśāstrarato bhavet || 103|| kīrtayet satataṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram | dhyāyettaṃ śrīpatiṃ lakṣmīpatiṃ muktapatiṃ harim || 1 04|| vandeta śrīparameśaṃ puruṣottamasāmagaḥ | evaṃ kṛtvā sukarmāṇi puṇyāni mokṣadāni ca || 1 05|| jitvā māyāṃ tathā kālaṃ mṛtyuṃ jitvākṣaraṃ vrajet | ityevaṃ vipra gatvā tvaṃ kuru devārcanaṃ sadā || 1 06|| pitrarcanaṃ satāṃ pūjāṃ vidhehi svātmavat sadā | vijayaste sadā bhāvī svarge satye tathākṣare || 1 07|| ityuktaḥ padmaje vipro yayau gṛhaṃ cakāra tat | ante svargāṇyanekāni bhuktvā dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau || 1 08|| śrutvā smṛtvā paṭhitvāpi kṛtvā devārcanaṃ tathā | bhūtvā mamāśritaḥ prāṇī labhate me’kṣaraṃ rame || 1 09|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne jaladānabhūdānavividhadānakartuḥ puruṣottamasāmajāpakasya dīrghaśīlasyāstikasya dīrghaśīlasya nāstikasyāpi yamadvāropadeśo mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 111 ||
<3.112> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśriṃ tvaṃ gaurdeyā vidhinā sadā | gaurbodhyā trividhā śreṣṭhā pṛthvī dhenuḥ sarasvatī || 1 || śiṣyāya deyā vidyāgaurbrāhmīvidyā mumukṣave | kalājñānaṃ śilpine ca, bhautikaṃ rasavedine || 2 || khajñānaṃ gaṇakāyāpi nāryai pākakalāmapi | śāstrajñānaṃ ca viduṣe deyaṃ gobhūsamaṃ hi tat || 3 || dhenudānaṃ pradātavyaṃ mātaro dhenavaḥ sadā | vṛddhimākāṃkṣatā nityaṃ gāvaḥ kāryāḥ pradakṣiṇāḥ || 4 || santāḍyā nahi pādena devyaḥ pūjyāḥ sumaṅgalāḥ | govāhakā gavādāśca rākṣasā nirayaṃgamāḥ || 5 || tṛṣitāḥ kṣudhitā gāvo janaṃ hanyuḥ sabāndhavam | pitṛsadmāni saudhāśca devatāyatanāni ca || 6 || pūyante śakṛtā yāsāṃ pūtaṃ kimadhikaṃ tataḥ | ghāsamuṣṭiṃ cānnamuṣṭiṃ varṣaṃ dadyād gave tu yaḥ || 7 || akṛtvā svayamāhāraṃ vrataṃ tat sārvakāmikam | phalaṃ putrān yaśo’rthāśca śriyaṃ cāpyadhigacchati || 8 || vinaśyatyaśubhaṃ tasya duḥsvapnaṃ naiva jāyate | duṣṭāya gaurna dātavyā lubdhāya nāstikāya na || 9 || vatse dayārahitāya krūrāya ghātine’pi ca | ghāsasevārahitāya na dātavyā kadācana || 3.112.1 0|| gṛhasthānarahitāya tṛṇādirahitāya ca | bhaktidharmavihīnāya na dātavyā kadācana || 1 1|| sādhave bahuputrāya bhikṣave devatārthine | kṣetravate pradātavyā tṛṇasevākṛte ca gauḥ || 1 2|| gosevā gurusevā ca pitṛsevā sadā rame | ghnanti pāpaprapuñjāni tārayanti samarpakān || 1 3|| satāṃ samāgamo lakṣmi tathā tārayati dhruvaḥ | alābhe tu gavāṃ dadyād ghṛtadhenuṃ śubhāvahām || 14|| tasyaitā ghṛtavāhinyaḥ kṣaranti vatsalā iva | ghṛtālābhe kṣīradhenuṃ dadyādutsāhaśraddhayā || 15|| sa kaṣṭāttārito dhenvā kṣīranadyāṃ pramodate | kṣīrālābhe tiladhenuṃ dadyāttilaiḥ pramodate || 16|| tilālābhe phaladhenuṃ dadyāt phalaiḥ pramodate | phalālābhe kaṇadhenuṃ dadyādannaiḥ pramodate || 17|| annālābhe gūḍadhenuṃ dadyānmiṣṭaiḥ pramodate | gūḍābhāve’mbaradhenuṃ dadyād vastraiḥ pramodate || 18|| sarvābhāve jaladhenuṃ dadyānnadīṣu modate | ekāpi kapilā dattāmṛtāpagāsya jāyate || 19|| apyekā sādhave dattā devatārcanayoginī | prāpayatyevākṣaraṃ me dātāraṃ dhāma śāśvatam ||3.112.20|| gopradātā yatra yāti lokāste nityamodinaḥ | na tatra kramate kālo na jarā na ca pāvakaḥ ||21 || aśubhaṃ tatra nāste ca na vyādhirna ca vai klamaḥ | yadicchantyupatiṣṭhanti gavāṃ puṇyabalena vai ||22|| kāmagāḥ kāmacāriṇyo gāvastatropayanti ca | vāpyaḥ sarāṃsi sarito ghṛtadugdhamayāstathā ||23|| gṛhāṇi parvatāścāraṇyāni vanāni yanti ca | manojñamiṣṭaṃ miṣṭaṃ ca rasopetaṃ prapadyate ||24|| tatra sarvasahāḥ kṣāntā godātāraḥ prayānti ha | guruśuśrūṣakā yānti dānino’tithipūjakāḥ ||25|| na pāpā goprahartāraḥ puṇyalokaṃ prayanti vai | dāyadravyeṇa gāṃ krītvā prayacchecchreyasāṃ kṛte ||26|| śramāptanāṇakaiḥ krītvārpayenmokṣārthameva tu | dyūte jitvā dhanaṃ tena krītvā dadyāt svarāptaye ||27|| dāyabhāgāṃ ca gāṃ dadyād dadyād dānāgatāṃ ca vā | satyavratasya godātuḥ sahasragosamaṃ phalam ||28|| nityaṃ prātarnamed gāṃ ca tṛṇagrāsām̐stathārpayet | jalaṃ prapāyayed yaśca rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ||29|| anāhāro’grabhaktaṃ yo gave dadyāddhi govratī | varṣeṇa gosahasrasya phalaṃ labhate sevayā ||3.112.3 0|| ekabhakto hi gāṃ krītvā dadyādvai gurave sa tu | tasyā yāvanti romāṇi tāvadgophalamāpnuyāt ||3 1|| yastvātmavikrayaṃ kṛtvā dhenuṃ krītvā prayacchati | romṇi romṇi dhenudāturlokā bhavanti cākṣayāḥ ||32|| araṇye gāṃ bhūsuraṃ ca sādhuṃ yastrāyatīti saḥ | aśvamedhakratostulyaṃ phalaṃ labhate modate ||33|| mṛtyukāle yathecchāsya bhaved divyavibhūtigā | tatsarvaṃ samavāpnoti paritrāṇena rakṣakaḥ ||34|| suvarṇaṃ paramaṃ dānaṃ dakṣiṇā ca gavā saha | dātavyā vai yathāśakti smṛddhidā pāvanī sadā ||35|| daridro nirdhanaścaivāparigrahastu yo bhavet | kuryād vrataṃ vratānyeva labheta sa paraṃ padam ||36|| indriyāṇāṃ niyamo vai vrataṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ rame | jitendriyo brahmabhakto brahmaloke pramodate ||37 || damaḥ sukhaprado dāntā nirvṛttā viṣayavrajāt | pratyāhṛtya manovegaṃ brahmaṇi yānti pāvitāḥ ||38|| vikrameṇa ca tapasā yajñairdānaiḥ prasevayā | bhaktyā śāntyā vidyayā ca santi lokāḥ sanātanāḥ ||39|| ṛṣilokān devalokān siddhalokān gavāṃ gṛhān | muktalokānīśalokān śīlavratāḥ prayānti hi ||3.112.40|| adhyāpako homakartā gurusevāparastathā | satīsādhvīpūjakaśca yāti dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||41 || bhaktau dharme vrate śūrā dāne’dhyayanakarmaṇi | yajane saṃgare śuśrūṣāyāṃ copārjane’pi ca ||42|| dame śūrāḥ ṛte jñāne’raṇye tyāge gṛhe’pi ca | śame ca niyame śāntāvārjave śūrakarmiṇaḥ ||43 || gurormātuḥ pituḥ patyuḥ śuśrūṣāyāṃ tathāpare | bhaikṣye’tithau tapasyeva śūrāḥ santi ca kecana ||44|| sarve yāntyaiśvarān lokān yathākarmaphalabhṛtān | satyavratino bhaktāśca yānti vaikuṇṭhamuttamam ||45|| ājanmamaraṇād yastu brahmacārī bhavediha | na tasya kiñcidaprāpyaṃ nārāyaṇasya vai yathā ||46|| brahmacaryaṃ dahed doṣān sarvapāpānyupāsitam | brahmadhāmagataḥ syādvai brahmacārī balaidhitaḥ ||47|| mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vāpi gurumācāryamacyutam | sevate yastasya dhāmākṣaraṃ me śāśvataṃ padam ||48|| nābījaṃ jāyate kiñcinna bījena vinā phalam | yādṛśaṃ vapate bījaṃ labhate tādṛśaṃ phalam ||49|| bījaṃ puruṣākaro vai sevātmako vṛṣātmakaḥ | kṣetraṃ sadguravo mātā pitā gaudaivateśvaraḥ ||3.112.50|| bhaktaśca karṣuko yādṛg vapate caiti tādṛśam | śubhena karmaṇā saukhyaṃ duḥkhaṃ pāpena karmaṇā ||51|| kṛtaṃ labhate sarvatra svargaṃ svargasukhāni ca | rūpaṃ bhāgyaṃ prasaubhāgyaṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca ||52|| tārakāstridaśāḥ siddhā yakṣāścandrārkamārutāḥ | sarve kṛtena dharmeṇa mānuṣyād devatāṃ gatāḥ ||53|| nādātāraṃ bhajantyarthā niṣkriyaṃ na bhajantyapi | apuṇyaṃ na bhajantyarthā bhajanti tvarthakāriṇam ||54|| akṛtvā mānuṣaṃ yatnaṃ daivamātraṃ pratīkṣate | na tasya siddhiḥ kamale klībapatnyā ivobhaye ||55|| sevāyāṃ śūratā yasya balaṃ śīlamayaṃ tathā | yatno daivaṃ yasya cāste siddhistasyāñjalisthitā ||56|| na kevalaṃ rame daivaṃ puṣṇātyavati rakṣati | nijayatnasamāyuktaṃ daivaṃ sādhu vivardhate ||57|| niḥsnehaḥ khalu vai dīpaḥ svayameva praśāmyati | vinā puṇyaṃ vinā yatnaṃ bhāgyaṃ svayaṃ praśāmyati ||58|| tasmāllakṣmi sadā yatnaḥ kartavyastapasi vrate | puṇye dāne’rjane bhaktau sevāyāṃ bhūtimicchatā ||59|| dhanaṃ vipulaṃ bhogāṃśca yoṣito bhojanāni ca | puṇyahīno na vai bhoktuṃ samartho jāyate kvacit ||3.112.60|| vyayaśīlaṃ dānaśīlaṃ copaiti vipulaṃ dhanam | pūrvadattena cāyāti vinā yatnaṃ kvacit priye ||61 || dātavyaṃ sarvathā sarvaṃ yad yadiṣṭatamaṃ bhavet | dānasyaiva phalaṃ bhuṃkte loko’yaṃ karmabandhanaḥ ||62|| nādattā prāpyate lakṣmīrnādattā prāpyate priyā | nādattā prāpyate dhenurnādattā prāpyate mahī ||63|| nādattā prāpyate buddhirnādattā smṛddhirāpyate | nākṛtā prāpyate sevā nādattaṃ prāpyate sukham ||64|| nākṛtaṃ prāpyate cāyurnādattaṃ rājyamāpyate | nādattaṃ cāpyate lakṣmi sukhamaindriyikaṃ bahu ||65|| tasmād dānāni deyāni bhūṣāmbaragṛhāṇi ca | bhojyapreyaprabhogyāni yāni sveṣṭatamāni vai ||66|| mayā sṛṣṭīḥ samutpādyāvatāreśvaradevatāḥ | kanyādānaistoṣitā vai tatphalaṃ stryarbudābjakam ||67|| yadyapyahaṃ samartho’smi nityapuṇyāśrayo hariḥ | mamāṃgāt pramadya vāmājjāyante’rbudakoṭayaḥ ||68|| na me dānaphalāpekṣā samarthasya parātmanaḥ | tathāpi lokarakṣārthaṃ nidarśanaṃ pradarśitam ||69|| sarvaṃ jagaccharīraṃ me narā nāryo’rdhamūrtayaḥ | narā nārāyaṇārdhā me nāryo me’rdhāṃganāstathā ||3.112.70 || evaṃ saṃsāranirvāho dānenāsādyate phalam | taponiyamasaṃyuktāḥ sādhavaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ ||71 || phalaṃ prāpya bhavantyeva nārāyaṇasameśvarāḥ | yena lokāstrayaḥ sṛṣṭā mayā śrīpatinā purā ||72|| so’haṃ tapāmi kṣīrode badaryāṃ ca ciraṃ rame | so’haṃ kṛtvā darśayāmi kurvantu tapa uttamam ||73|| vāmano’haṃ kṣitiṃ prāpya parśurāmastathā pṛthuḥ | dānaṃ pṛthvyāścakāraiva rāmādityo’pi vai purā ||74|| śikṣayāmāsa bhagavān bhūtvāpi dānamuttamam | prajābhyo yajñakāryaiśca yajñanārāyaṇo’pyaham ||75|| mayā rādhā pradattā vai śrīkṛṣṇāya madātmane | nārāyaṇī tathā dattā nārāyaṇātmane tu me ||76|| bhūrdattā ca varāhāya śrīrdattā viṣṇave purā | lakṣmīrmahāviṣṇave ca sāvitrī brahmaṇe’rpitā ||77|| prakṛtiryā mūlarūpā puruṣāya purārpitā | evaṃ kṛtvā saṃkalanaṃ dānarītiḥ pravartitā ||78|| tasmāllakṣmi dānaphalaṃ pramodāḥ sarva eva ha | yena yena śarīreṇa yadyad dānaṃ karoti yaḥ ||79|| tena tena śarīreṇa tattat phalamupāśnute | yasyāṃ yasyāmavasthāyāṃ yatkaroti śubhāśubham ||3.112.80|| tasyāṃ tasyāmavasthāyāṃ bhuṃkte kartā tu tatphalam | cakṣurdadyānmanodadyād vācaṃ dadyādṛtaṃbharām ||81|| ātmānaṃ sampradadyādvai seveta satataṃ gurum | evaṃ dānaṃ paraṃ proktaṃ dehaṃ dadyād yathocitam ||82|| evamapi pradānena taratyabdhiṃ hi karmaṇām | śṛṇvatra kathayāmyeva jñānena dānamuttamam ||83|| yatphalaṃ brahmalokākhyaṃ prāptā brahmasatī purā | yoginyāsīd brahmasatī brāhmaṇī sā kumārikā ||84|| somanāthe śubhe tīrthe bhajamānā tu śaṃkaram | yuvatī ca surūpā ca śīlayuktā tapodhanā ||85|| sarasvatyāṃ karotyeṣā triṣavaṇaṃ japādikam | tairthikāḥ sūryatulyāṃ tāṃ paśyanti yanti mugdhatām ||86 || sā na dṛṣṭiṃ dadātyeva kvāpi kutrāpi sarvathā | ekadā tāṃ tu saṃvīkṣya daityaḥ sthaṇḍilaghoṣakaḥ ||87|| ujjahāra balenaiva vyomnābdhau nijamandiram | tasyā bhogaṃ prasahyāpi cakre vai brahmayoṣitaḥ ||88|| sāpyanāthā ca nirviṇṇā jñātrī dehavirāgiṇī | śokaṃ tathāpyaśokaṃ ca mene cātmapratiṣṭhatā ||89|| śīlaṃ vrataṃ sadā rakṣyaṃ tadbhaṃgaḥ śoka eva saḥ | āpatkāle na ced rakṣā deho’haṃ netyaśocanam ||3.112.90|| vivekena śarīrādvai bhinnātmānamamanyata | dehaṃ bhinnaṃ tathā matvā śokaṃ jahau parāśrayā ||91|| evaṃ vidhāṃ tu tāṃ vīkṣya daityaḥ papraccha tāṃ muhuḥ | kathaṃ na kuruṣe śokaṃ pradharṣitāpi bhāmini ||92|| sā tu prāha malino’yaṃ deho vai dharṣitastvayā | nāhaṃ pradharṣitā daitya śuddhāhaṃ cetanātmikā ||93|| tvayi nārāyaṇaścāste brahma yatparamaḥ prabhuḥ | tadadhiṣṭhitadehena bhukto deho na cetanaḥ ||94|| tvamajño vartase daitya nāhamajñāpadi sthitā | śocanīyaḥ sadā dehastaṃ śocāmyavaśā katham ||95|| ātmā na strī pumānnaiva pṛthvīpāṣāṇarūpiṇau | dehau tathābhidhāno vai tatra kā paridevanā ||96|| śrutvaivaṃ sthaṇḍilaghoṣastvāścaryaṃ paramaṃ yayau | jñānamāsādya ca tato yayāce karmaṇaḥ kṣamām ||97|| tāṃ skandhe sve nidhāyaiva somanāthaṃ samānayat | jñānayogena daityo’pi tapobhaktiṃ cakāra ha ||98|| tasyā yogena tapasā śuddho bhūtvā harasya saḥ | kālena gaṇatāṃ prāpto yayau kailāsamuttam ||99|| brahmasatī śuśocāpi yatra me paravaśyatā | tatrādhīnābhavaṃ cābdhau daityahastagatā tadā || 3.112.1 00|| jñānāgninā mayā pāpaṃ jvālitaṃ kintu laukikam | prāyaścittaṃ vidhātavyaṃ na lupyeta vṛṣo yathā || 101 || sā yayau yoginaṃ śāntaṃ kirīṭinaṃ harāśritam | papraccha śaucaṃ śīlasya kirīṭyuvāca tāṃ tadā || 1 02|| rūpaṃ te vidyate sādhvi śaṃkarasyāpi mohakam | tasmāt punaḥ punarvighnaṃ te bhaviṣyati yauvane || 1 03|| tasmādāśraya kāntaṃ tvaṃ sveṣṭaṃ brahmavidaṃ janam | yena vighnavilopaḥ syāt pāpaṃ śāntaṃ bhavettataḥ || 1 04|| dehaśuddhyā tathā caivodvāhena vidhināpi ca | prāyaścittaṃ tavaiva syād rājasvalyaṃ ca śodhakam || 1 05|| ityuktā sā jñānakośā bhaktā tameva yoginam | kirīṭyākhyaṃ patiṃ vavre guruṃ patiṃ cakāra sā || 1 06|| dīkṣāṃ jagrāha gārhasthyaśobhanāṃ śaṃkarāntike | pārvatyā kṛtatilakā dattasaubhāgyacandrikā || 1 07|| samarthā yoginī jātā divyā śaṃbhoḥ śubhāśiṣā | evaṃ dehenārpitā sā gaṇapatnī suyoginī || 1 08|| divyā sāmarthyasampannā vyavartata hi śāśvatī | ekadā śaṃbhunā sākaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ gatā satī || 1 09|| tayā dāsīsvarūpā sā nītā brahmasatī saha | nārāyaṇaṃ tu māṃ dṛṣṭvā mumoha sa ca bhāminī || 3.112.1 10|| satyā niveditā mahyaṃ sā muktā saṃbabhūva ha | divyarūpeṇa vai nityā ramayā saha rājate || 11 1|| brāhmīsatītināmnaiva patnī me sābhavattataḥ | apareṇāpi rūpeṇa kirīṭasyāpi bhāminī || 1 12|| vartate nityakailāse modate śaṃbhusevikā | ityetat kathitaṃ lakṣmi rahasyaṃ te’rpaṇe vidhau || 1 13|| dehadānaṃ prakartavyaṃ labhyate cennarāyaṇaḥ | nārāyaṇapradātā ca labhyate mokṣadaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 14|| dehadānaṃ vidhātavyaṃ mokṣārthaṃ sārvakālikam | anyairyo bhujyate deho bhujyatāṃ paramātmanā || 1 15|| tadarpaṇena vai lakṣmi lakṣmītāṃ labhate satī | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirgatirbhavet || 1 16|| rahasyaṃ paramaṃ tvetat kathitaṃ te purābhavat | tataścānyā rūpavatyaścārpaṇaṃ cakrurātmanām || 1 17|| nārāyaṇe’bhavan sādhvyaḥ koṭiśo vai śubhāṃganāḥ | mama yogena saṃsāraṃ tīrtvā brahmapadaṃ yayuḥ || 1 18|| brahmapriyāśca tāḥ sarvā vartante’tra tavāgrataḥ | brahmapriyāsu yoginyo muktānyo divyavigrahāḥ || 11 9|| apātrābhyo na dātavyaṃ jñānametannarāyaṇi | śrutvā ca nindikābhyaśca na dātavyaṃ kadācana || 3.112.1 20|| mokṣārthakṛtasarvasvābhyo dātavyaṃ śubhaṃ tvidam | yatprāpya matpadaṃ divyaṃ labhante māmanuśritāḥ || 121 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne godānagokalpadānavividhavratācārārpaṇaphalanirūpaṇe brahmasatyā yoginyā dehadānanidarśanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 112 ||
<3.113> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ tapāṃsi vividhāni vai | kevalāni tathā bhaktiyutāni pravadāmi te || 1 || yatkṛtena bhavet svargaṃ puṇyaṃ ca sampado’malāḥ | bhaktiyuktena tenaiva labhyate dhāma me’kṣaram || 2 || audāryaṃ paramaṃ proktaṃ tapo vyayātmakaṃ sadā | dhanaṃ dadyād vanaṃ dadyād gṛhaṃ dadyācchubhāśrayam || 3 || kulaṃ dadyāt kaṇān dadyādaudārye dānamāsthitam | udārasya bhavelloko dānināṃ dhanadādhikaḥ || 4 || bhaktiyuktaṃ mahaudāryaṃ mama dhāmapradaṃ bhavet | sthaṇḍile śayanaṃ nityaṃ tapaḥ paramakaṃ matam || 5 || tasya phalaṃ mahat svarge prāsādāḥ svarṇaśobhanāḥ | śayanāni ca ramyāṇi jāyante’mṛtadānyapi || 6 || cīravalkaladhāritvaṃ tapaḥ paraṃ prakathyate | phalaṃ tasya bhaved ramyavāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca || 7 || yogacittaṃ tapaḥśreṣṭhaṃ phalaṃ vimānakāni vai | vāhanāni tathā divyāḥ siddhayaḥ svargavāsitā || 8 || agnitāpastapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ phalaṃ rājyaṃ divaṃ bhavet | rasānāṃ varjanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tapastasya phalaṃ śubham || 9 || saubhāgyaṃ tu bhavennāryā gṛhaṃ rasābhipūritam | anāmiṣaṃ vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ phalaṃ vaṃśasutādikam || 3.113.1 0|| avākśirā vased yaśca tasyendrapadamuttamam | udavāsaṃ vased yaśca candraloko’sya satphalam || 11 || brahmacārī bhaved yaḥ sa brahmalokaṃ prayāti vai | pādyamāsanamannaṃ ca jalamāśrayamityapi || 1 2|| dadyādatithaye yajñaḥ pañcāṃgo’yaṃ tapaḥ param | etāni bhaktiyuktāni mamākṣarapradāni vai || 13 || devārthe ca gavārthe ca gurvarthe vīraśāyanam | tapaḥ prāṇapradānaṃ tanmokṣadaṃ svargadaṃ param || 14|| maunaṃ vrataṃ paraṃ proktaṃ cādrohaḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ | anindā cāvitaṇḍā ca tapaḥ paramakaṃ matam || 15|| tenāvicchinnagatikaścājñāpako bhaved divi | upavāsastapaḥ śreṣṭhamupabhogāḥ phalaṃ matam || 16|| saṃyamena tu śīlena dīrghāyurbalavān bhavet | ahiṃsā ca tapaḥ śreṣṭhamaiśvaryārogyarūpadā || 17|| phalamūlāśanaṃ cāpi tapo rājyapradaṃ matam | parṇādasya bhavet svargaṃ vighasāśī hariṃ vrajet || 18|| prāyopaveśinaḥ syādvai sarvatra sukhamuttamam | śākadaḥ śākavān syācca mahodyānasamanvitaḥ || 19|| goprado dhenumān syācca tṛṇādo’mṛtabhāg bhavet | snānaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ śreṣṭhataraṃ tapaḥ phalaṃ param ||3.113.20 || divyāḥ striyo bhavantyasya trikālasnāyinaḥ kila | vāyvāhāraḥ tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ phalaṃ yajñaphalaṃ bhavet ||21|| satyavrataṃ tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ svargaṃ ratnānvitaṃ bhavet | dīkṣā tapaḥ śreṣṭhatamaṃ kulaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ bhavet ||22|| jalāśanaṃ tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ sadā sudhāśanaṃ phalam | agnihotraṃ tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ cāgnilokaṃ phalaṃ bhavet ||23|| mantrajāpastapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ rājyaṃ svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam | ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ svargottamaṃ phalaṃ matam ||24|| dīkṣopavāsaḥ kamale tapaḥ svargapradaṃ matam | abhiṣekastapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ gurutvāpādakaṃ hi tat ||25|| vidyārjanaṃ tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ bārhaspatyaṃ sa vindati | mānasaṃ tu caran dharmaṃ dharmalokaṃ samaśnute ||26|| tṛṣṇānāśastapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ sukhaṃ vaikuṇṭhasadṛśam | pūjanaṃ ca tapo nityaṃ yāyād golokadhāma saḥ ||27|| pitā brahmā prasūḥ pṛthvī gururbrahma sanātanam | trayaḥ santoṣitā yena sarvaṃ tena kṛtaṃ tapaḥ ||28|| sarve dharmāḥ kṛtāstena vratānyapi kṛtāni ca | bhaktyā yuktāni caitāni mamākṣarapradāni vai ||29|| nāryā kṛtāḥ sarvadharmāḥ patiryayā prasāditaḥ | patināpi kṛtā dharmā yena patnī pratoṣitā ||3.113.3 0|| rājñā sarve kṛtā dharmā yena prajāḥ pratoṣitāḥ | prajābhiśca kṛtā dharmā yābhirnārāyaṇo’rcitaḥ ||3 1|| hiṃsakasya vṛthā mantro makho vṛthā hyadakṣiṇaḥ | vinā mantraṃ vṛthā homaḥ satyahīnaṃ vrataṃ mṛṣā ||32|| bhāvaṃ vinā vṛthā sevopāstirvṛthā hariṃ vinā | śīlaṃ vinā vṛthā dharmo vṛthāstitvaṃ sukhaṃ vinā ||33|| sādhuṃ vinā vṛthā dānaṃ bhaktiṃ vinā vṛthā janiḥ | vṛthā gṛhaṃ vinā lakṣmīṃ vinā mokṣaṃ vṛthā mṛtiḥ ||34|| vinā pātraṃ vṛthā jñānaṃ jayaṃ vinā vṛthā mṛdhaḥ | vṛthā sarvaṃ vinā snehaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā vṛthārjanam ||35|| santaṃ vinā vṛthā vāsaḥ puṣṭiḥ prasūṃ vinā mṛṣā | vṛthā dṛṣṭirvinā devaṃ vṛthā karṇo vinā kathām ||36|| vṛthā tvak śrīhareḥ sparśaṃ vinā rūpavatī hyapi | vṛthā jihvā vinā kṛṣṇaprasādastharasādanam ||37|| vṛthā vāk kīrtanaṃ kṛṣṇaguṇānāmantarā tathā | vṛthā ghrāṇaṃ harergandhaṃ vinā dhīḥ smaraṇaṃ vinā ||38|| dehatattvāni sarvāṇi nirarthakāni māṃ vinā | balaṃ vyarthaṃ dhṛtirvyarthā yaśo vyarthaṃ ca māṃ vinā ||39|| vidyā ca vāgmitā tarkabuddhirmatiśca śemuṣī | vyarthaṃ sarvaṃ vinā cārādhanaṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ ||3.113.40|| ṣaṇḍhe yadvad bhavennārī yuvatyapi ca niṣphalā | tathā sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ vai ṣaṇḍhe mayā nirākṛte ||41 || māṃ vinā ca tathā lakṣmi mama santaṃ vinā tu yat | rājyaṃ smṛddhaṃ kulaṃ mānaṃ prāṇānte niṣphalāyate ||42|| śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ purātanīṃ vaivartabhūbhṛtaḥ | pūrveṇa tapasā rājyamāsamudrāntamasya yat ||43|| smṛddhamāsīt samagraṃ vai tvekacakraṃ hi śāsanam | vyomavārtāvahā dūtāścāsan rājye’sya cetanāḥ ||44|| śāsakāni ca śāstrāṇi naisargikāṇi cābhavan | tejasāṃ supravāhāśca bhāskarāścābhavan sadā ||45|| śrāvakā vyomadūtāśca rāṣṭre’sya sarvato’bhavan | jaladūtā jalayāneṣvadhovāhāstathābhavan ||46|| vimānānyabhavam̐ścāsya lokāntaragatānyapi | sarvaṃ puṇyapratāpena mānavaṃ daivamityapi ||47|| tādātmyamiva cāpannaṃ rājye tasya tadābhavat | jaḍaṃ cetanarūpāḍhyaṃ karmacāraṃ sadābhavat ||48|| smṛtismarābhavadvṛṣṭiramṛtaṃ ca smṛtismaram | smṛtismarāṇi sasyāni smṛtismarāḥ samṛddhayaḥ ||49|| smṛtismarā yoṣitaśca dāsā dāsyaḥ smṛtismarāḥ | upatiṣṭhanti bhogyāni smṛtismarāṇi cāsya vai ||3.113.50|| etādṛśo’bhavat siddho vaivarto nāma bhūpatiḥ | rājñī tasyaikadā prāha nāmnā kālaṃdharā satī ||51|| rājan yatheśvaraścāste bhūtale’dyāsamo bhavān | tapasā cārjitaṃ sarvaṃ viṣṇuneva tvayā kṣitau ||52|| tathāpi śvetadugdhābhaṃ vartate sāramantarā | uddhṛtanavanītaṃ vai yathā dugdhaṃ tathā tvidam ||53|| vinā nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā santaṃ vṛṣaṃ vinā | vinā yajñaṃ vinā dānaṃ vinābhyāgatasatkṛtim ||54|| vinā bhaktiṃ hareścāpi niḥsāraṃ bhāsate mama | tasmānnārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaja bhaktān prasevaya ||55|| ātmamokṣavṛṣaṃ kṛtvā yāsyasyevaṃ paraṃ padam | ityuktaḥ sa tu bhūnātho mene naiva priyoditam ||56|| sa siṣedhaiva sarvaṃ tannāstikyena punaḥ punaḥ | na devo mānavaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sādhurvā kasyacit pradaḥ ||57|| tapasā labhyate sarvaṃ tadanyattu mṛṣātmakam | tapasaiva gamiṣyāmi svargaṃ svargottamaṃ punaḥ ||58|| idaṃ svargaṃ kṣitāvāste dvitīyaṃ tārakāmayam | saṃlapsyāmi tapasaiva mā cintāṃ kuru bhāmini ||59|| ityevaṃ mānabhānena bhrānto nāgaṇayat priyām | nāstikyena ciraṃ kālaṃ yāpayāmāsa rājyakṛt ||3.113.60|| athāyuṣyasya vigame bhuktapuṇye hyaśeṣite | niryayau nijadehādvai kālapāśapraṇoditaḥ ||61|| sahāyā nābhavannasya kecit kālāddhi rakṣaṇe | prajā rājñyaḥ pradhānāśca putrāḥ putryaḥ sahasraśaḥ ||62|| tasthureva vilokyaiva rudantaḥ śokasamplutāḥ | nāstikasyāsya tatkāle na devā guravo na ca ||63|| nāyayuḥ sādhavaścāpi pretaṃ netuṃ paratra ha | na dharmo nāpi puṇyaṃ ca na devyo nāpi sadgatiḥ ||64|| mṛtaṃ netuṃ nāyayurvai bhraṣṭaṃ rājyācca dehataḥ | gatirogho’bhavattasya vinā puṇyaṃ pare sthale ||65|| nendriyādhiṣṭhitaṃ sūkṣmaṃ śaktaṃ gantuṃ tadābhavat | na mano’haṃmatiprāṇā gantuṃ ca prabhavo’bhavan ||66|| dehānnirgatya jaḍavat saudhāgre sa sthito’bhavat | pratīkṣate tu puṇyārthaṃ puṇyaṃ dharmaṃ paretakam ||67|| nāstikasya na vai svargaṃ nāyaṃ lokaḥ kathaṃ paraḥ | devayāno’sya naivāsti dhūmrayāno’pi nāsti ca ||68|| agatirmūrchito mṛtvā duḥkhitaṃ svamamanyata | śuśoca na mayā dattaṃ jalānnaṃ na makhaḥ kṛtaḥ ||69|| nopakāraḥ kṛtaḥ kvāpi na santaścāpyupāsitāḥ | na devārhaṇanaivedyastavanādi kṛtaṃ mayā ||3.113.70|| anāthā rakṣitā naiva toṣitā nāpi bhikṣukāḥ | nābhyāgatāḥ pūjitāśca sādhvyaḥ satyo na satkṛtāḥ ||71|| na godānaṃ svarṇadānaṃ bhūdānaṃ ca kṛtaṃ mayā | sarvarddhisaṃbhṛtaścāhaṃ kṛtavānna kutarkitaḥ ||72|| adya puṇyavihīnasya gatirme nāsti sarvathā | nopatiṣṭhanti yānāni vimānāni mamāpi vai ||73|| vikṛto naiva tiṣṭhanti pūrvaṃ yā mama cābhavan | śastrāṇi nopatiṣṭhanti cetanāni yathābhavan ||74|| sāmrājyarddhiḥ parā sattā lupteva naiva dṛśyate | gataṃ sākaṃ sthūlatattvairvarṣmaṇā saha yogi tat ||75|| sūkṣmayogi kṛtaṃ naiva nāyāti ca sahāyadam | kṛtaṃ vai labhyate sarvaṃ tapo me vyayatāṃ gatam ||76|| sthūlaṃ mataṃ nāsti sūkṣmaṃ kāraṇaṃ kevalaṃ tu yat | niḥsāmarthyaṃ vartate’dya kiṃ tena me gatiśca kā ||77|| turyo nopāsito devaḥ kā gatirme’dya tiṣṭhati | na cāpi yamadūtā me dṛṣṭipathaṃ patantyapi ||78|| yenāhaṃ dharmarājasya purīṃ gacchāmi noditaḥ | nāstikasya gatirnāsti nāstyakṛtasya sarvathā ||79|| subhagā vā vibhagā vā naikā naivāparā gatiḥ | aho pretaśarīraṃ me bhāvyaṃ tadapi nāsti vai ||3.113.80|| vāyurūpaṃ paripūrṇaṃ bhūtapretātmakaṃ na ca | na cakṣurme pūrṇamatra na karṇau na ca jihvikā ||81|| na pādau nāpi hastau ca śaktihīno bhavāmi ha | manomātraṃ bhavāmyadya sarvasāmarthyavarjitaḥ ||82|| yathā kalalabhāvasya garbhasthasya tathā gatiḥ | bhānaṃ me nirvikalpābhaṃ taccāpi bhāvanojjhitam ||83|| svapne me darśanaṃ dātuṃ vaktuṃ cāpi na vā prabhuḥ | yena patnyai kathayāmi gatyarthaṃ puṇyadānakam ||84|| aho nāsti gatiścādya samrājo bhūpatermama | gataṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ naiva pratāraṇena muṣṇatā ||85|| patnyā me kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ smara nārāyaṇaṃ harim | taṃ smarāmi prabhuṃ cādyādhamoddhāraṃ sa tārayet ||86|| ityevaṃ manasi kṛtvā nirvikalpe dadhāra mām | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||87|| yathā yathā sa dadhyau māṃ tathā tathā tadāntaraḥ | prakāśaḥ samabhūttasya tatra mayoditaṃ tadā ||88|| adṛśyena svarūpeṇa yathā vyomagirā tathā | puṇyaṃ tvayā kṛtaṃ naiva kṛtaṃ naiva tathāparam ||89|| gatistena ca ruddhā te yāmyā gatiśca te na vai | tādṛk pāpaṃ tvayā naiva kṛtaṃ yāmyagatirbhavet ||3.113.90|| tasmād garbhaṃ tava patnyāḥ punaryāyā hi devarāt | tava bhrātānujo rājñīṃ spṛśet putro bhaviṣyasi ||91 || karasparśena putrasyotpattiryugānusāriṇī | bhavatyeveti tādṛk tvaṃ bhava putro’nujasya ha ||92|| nijakṣetre tataḥ kṛtvā bhajanaṃ dānapūrvakam | makhān kṛtvā sādhupūjāṃ paropakṛtimuttamām ||93|| godānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ ca svarṇadānamanuttamam | datvā kṛtvā vratānyeva jātismaro’tha vai ciram ||94|| bhuktvā bhogān bhajitvā māṃ tato yāsyasi mokṣaṇam | yāhi svapne tava patnyāstathā tavānujasya ca ||95|| kaivarttasya tataḥ putraḥ kathayitvā tathā bhava | evamuktvā virarāma garbhavāṇī tadāmbare ||96|| vaivarttaḥ śaktiyug bhūtvā rātrau svapne jagāma ha | anujāya tathā rājñyai tathyaṃ nyavedayat tataḥ ||97|| kaivartena kareṇāpi spṛṣṭā rājñī ṛtūttarā | kālaṃdharābhidhānā sā garbhavatī babhūva ha ||98|| suṣuve cāpi kālena sutaṃ jātismaraṃ hi tam | so’pi bālyādeva padme bhaktiṃ cakāra śārṅgiṇaḥ ||99|| dānāni pradadau sarvavidhāni nijamuktaye | makhām̐śca kārayāmāsa taḍāgāni samantataḥ || 3.113.10 0|| annasatrāṇi ramyāṇi prapāsthānāni sarvaśaḥ | dharmaśālā vedaśālāḥ kārayāmāsa sarvataḥ || 101 || gobhūhiraṇyadānāni dadau kanyārpaṇāni ca | gṛhadānāni devānāmālayān pracakāra ha || 1 02|| mama lakṣmi mandirāṇi racayāmāsa tatra ca | sādhuvāsān kārayitvā sevayāmāsa cātmanā || 10 3|| evaṃ rāṣṭraṃ samagraṃ vai tato bhaktiyutaṃ śuci | saṃvidhāya prabhuktvā ca bhogān bahuvidhān sukhān || 1 04|| saṃvartto nāma rājarṣirbhūtvā tyaktvā vapurnijam | yayau cānte mama bhaktyā dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ padam || 1 05|| tasmād dānāni deyāni sevanīyāśca sādhavaḥ | pūjanīyā devatāśca makhāḥ kāryā yathādhanam || 1 06|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāt karaṇāttathā | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ divyagatiṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vividhatapasāṃ phalāni, tānyeva bhaktiyuktāni mokṣadāni, vaivartanṛpasyanāstikyena gatyabhāve nijapatnyāṃ devarāt punarjanma, tata āstikakarmabhirbhaktyā ca mokṣa ityādinirūpaṇanāmā trayodaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 113 ||
<3.114> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri sādhvāśrayeṇa mokṣaṇam | sādhvāśrayeṇa vai rakṣāṃ jīvanaṃ ca tathā śubham || 1 || āsīd romapado nāma paśupālo vanottame | ojasvatyāstaṭe deśe saurāṣṭre siṃhasevite || 2 || romapādaḥ paśuvadvai vartate dharmavarjitaḥ | na snānaṃ bhajanaṃ dānaṃ karoti gṛhadharmyapi || 3 || dugdhadadhyannavanyādyaiḥ prāṇayātrāṃ karoti ca | vanyapaśūn mārayitvā māṃsādanaṃ karotyapi || 4 || anyasattākamannādi dūraṃ gatvā niśāmukhe | kṣetrādibhyaścānayati cauryaṃ karoti vai muhuḥ || 5 || evamadharmamārgasya putro’bhavad vṛṣaṃgamaḥ | vavṛdhe sa yuvā jāto mahiṣīpālako’bhavat || 6 || pitrā sākaṃ kadācit sa yayau vane paśuvrataḥ | pitrā tvāsāditastatra hariṇaḥ sañcaran vane || 7 || śvabhiḥ pitrā kṛṣṇamṛgo nipātito vane’ntike | vṛṣagamo’pi pitrā yuk tūrṇaṃ yayau mṛgaṃ prati || 8 || mṛgasya mriyamāṇasya śvabhirvipāṭitasya ha | krandamānasya duḥkhaṃ ca pādānāṃ bhūmighātanam || 9 || vīkṣya dayāparo bhūtvā trāsaṃ paraṃ jagāma saḥ | kampaṃ cāti jagāmāpi tatyāja taṃ mṛgaṃ hi saḥ ||3.114.1 0|| jagṛhe na mṛgaṃ tatra nisargadayayārditaḥ | nāhaṃ māṃsaṃ bhakṣayiṣye mārayiṣyāmi na kvacit || 1 1|| pāpaṃ cedṛk prasahyaiva prāṇānāṃ tyājanātmakam | kaḥ kuryādudarasyārthe mānavo nirdayo yathā || 1 2|| ityevaṃ dayayā yuktastatyāja prāṇihiṃsanam | vṛṣaṃgamastato yātaḥ kvacidvai kārtike svayam || 1 3|| somanāthasya tīrthārthaṃ sasnau dadarśa śaṃkaram | ātmakṛtaṃ ca tatpāpaṃ harāya sannyavedayat ||14|| pāpaṃ tasya vinaṣṭaṃ ca śuddhirjātā hṛdo’sya ca | sādhavastatra cāyātā dṛṣṭāstena natāstataḥ || 15|| pūjitāḥ sevitāścaiṣāṃ satsaṃgaśca kṛtastathā | prāpto mantra oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo gatirmama || 16|| tulasyā mālikā prāptā bhaktiḥ prāptā śubhāśrayā | anivedya śrīharaye bhoktavyaṃ na kadācana ||17|| sādhusatībhyo dātavyaṃ dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ tathā | sevanīyāḥ sādhavaśca bhajanīyo janārdanaḥ || 18|| evaṃ labdhvā sa niyamān nijagṛhamupāyayau | vartate sā tathaivāpi bhajate śrīnarāyaṇam || 19|| sādhavastatra cāyānti varṣe sakṛd vanāntare | sevāṃ labdhvā prayāntyeva grāmāntaraṃ vanāntaram ||3.114.20|| vṛṣaṃgamo’pi cānnasya roṭakasya pradānakam | payasāścāpi dadhnaśca dānaṃ karoti vai tadā ||21 || evaṃ dānaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ bahvasyātivyajāyata | athaivaṃ prāptakālo’sya pitā mṛtyumupāgataḥ ||22|| yamadūtāḥ śastrahastā āyayurvai bhayaṃkarāḥ | cukrośa bahudhā trasto mārayantīti vai muhuḥ || 23|| mocayantu ca māṃ ke’pi yāmyebhyo bāndhavā mama | mama nāḍīstroṭayanti praharanti ca mudgaraiḥ ||24|| rakṣayantu janā māṃ vai māṃ gṛhiṇi prarakṣaya | putra māṃ rakṣaya dīnaṃ tāḍyamānaṃ yamānugaiḥ || 25|| ityevaṃ krośamānaṃ taṃ putra uvāca re pitaḥ | nārāyaṇaṃ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ smara rakṣāṃ kariṣyati ||26||| japa mantraṃ oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo gatirmama | ityevaṃ pradadau mantraṃ pitre lakṣmi sa putrakaḥ ||27|| harekṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho | hare viṣṇo hare svāmin śrīpate puruṣottama ||28|| evaṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ cakre tāvad dūtā bhayaṃ gatāḥ | visṛjya pitaraṃ tasthurdūre ca jagadurmithaḥ ||29|| asmadbhāgo hyayaṃ gopaḥ putreṇa vipramocitaḥ | mantra datvā harerasmai bhajanena ca pāvitaḥ ||3.114.30|| ityevaṃ pravadantyeva yamadūtā yadā tadā | sādhūnāṃ maṇḍalaṃ tatra yadṛcchayā samāgatam ||3 1 || putraḥ svāgatasammānaṃ pracakāra ca satvaram | sādhavo vīkṣya kālāntaṃ dadau vāri prasādajam ||32|| pitā papau haristāvat samāyāto gajasthitaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ svayameva ha ||33|| romapādaṃ viniṣkāsya dehānninye paraṃ padam | putrayogena sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ cāntakālikam ||34|| piturjātaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ ca dānaphalaṃ subhaktiyuk | evaṃ lakṣmi bhaktiyogād bhaktayogāt kṣaṇāntare ||35|| pāpināmapi mokṣaḥ syāt kāryo’taḥ satsamāgamaḥ | vṛṣaṃgamo’pi dehānte mama dhāma gato hyanu ||36|| śṛṇu tvanyāṃ kathāṃ lakṣmi rakṣaṇaṃ sādhusaṃgataḥ | āsīdeko mahān cauro nagrabhaṃgo’tidāruṇaḥ ||37|| viṃśaticaurayug rātrau sahetiluṇṭati gṛhān | yeṣāṃ śrutaṃ mahādravyaṃ tacchidraṃ cintayatyatha ||38|| prāpte’nukūlasamaye cauryaṃ karoti dāruṇam | mārayitvā tāḍayitvā mardayitvā janān dhanam ||39|| svarṇarūpyamayaṃ ratnamayaṃ harati modate | evaṃ vai vartamānasyaikadā kāryavaśād dine ||3.114.40|| rājasaudhe svarṇabhūṣānirmātā svarṇakārakaḥ | ciramitraṃ dṛṣṭipathaṃ rājapathe tadā ||41|| nagrabhaṃgo’pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā saharṣo militaḥ pathi | kuśalaṃ cāpi papracchodyogaṃ papraccha vai tataḥ ||42|| svarṇakāraḥ samastaṃ svaṃ vṛttāntaṃ prāha taṃ nijam | adya māse tu nṛpaterbhūṣāracanakāryakṛt ||43|| gacchāmi rājasaudhaṃ ca yatrāste svarṇakoṭikam | mauktikānāṃ sahasrāṇi ratnānāmayutānyapi ||44|| yatra kośe bhavantyeva tatpārśve śubhamandire | svarṇaśilpāḥ svarṇakārāḥ kurmastvābharaṇāni vai ||45|| nagrabhaṃgastataḥ prāha yadi te rocate vacaḥ | kathayāntaḥpraveśasya rātrimārgaṃ tu nirjanam ||46|| corayāmi suvarṇādi bhāgaṃ dāsyāmi te’pi ca | ityuktaḥ svarṇakāro vai darśayāmāsa tatpatham ||47|| sthānaṃ ca niḥsṛtiṃ cāpi guptadvārāṇi yāni ca | upayuktāni śastrāṇi dṛḍhahetīnadarśayat ||48|| yuktaguptahārikāṃ cādarśayannirgamaṃ tathā | tato rātrau svasārthena nagrabhaṃgo viveśa tam ||49|| saudhaṃ dhanaṃ svarṇarūpyaratnamauktikamuttamam | corayitvā cāti gupto dudrāvālakṣito janaiḥ ||3.114.50|| datvā sarvaṃ sahāyebhyo’preṣayattān vanāntare | bhūgarte tad vinikṣeptuṃ samādiśad drutaṃ nijān ||51|| sa tu śramāpanodārthaṃ gañjāpānārthamutsukaḥ | śanairbrāhme muhūrte vai yayau śrīnagarād bahiḥ ||52|| yatrāsan sādhavaḥ śaivā gañjāpānāgnitāpasāḥ| | tatra gatvā yayāce vai pānaṃ tāmālagāñjikam ||53|| neme bhaktyā kṛtrimayā cakāra daṇḍavattathā | niṣasāda samīpe ca mudrāmupāyanaṃ dadau ||54|| sādhavo’pi yathā bhaktaṃ tathā matvānusevakam | labdhvā mudrāṃ ca pūjāyāṃ dadustasmai tamālakam ||55|| papau nidrāṃ kṛtavām̐śca prātaḥ sūryodayaṃ prati | jajāgāra tatastatra tasthau mādhyandināvadhi ||56|| bhojanādi cakāraiva śramaṃ cāpanudattathā | sārthacaurāḥ samastāste garte nikṣipya taddhanam ||57|| yayuste vanamārgeṇa nijagrāmaṃ hi yojanam | tāvannṛpagṛhe vyaktaṃ jātaṃ cauryaṃ dhanasya tat ||58|| pādacikitsakān kṛtvā cāgre rājñastu sainikāḥ | caurān mārgayituṃ prātarnirgatāḥ śastradhāriṇaḥ ||59|| śrīnagarādaśvavārāḥ saha pādacikitsakaiḥ | vane gatvā jagṛhustān gacchataḥ kheṭakaṃ nijam ||3.114.60 || tāḍayāmāsuratyarthaṃ cānayāmāsureva tān | nṛpaṃ prati tathā kārāgāre rurudhurulbaṇān ||61 || atha sādhuprasaṃgena nagrabhaṃgastu rakṣitaḥ | rājaikagārikaścāpi rājabhaṭairna lakṣitaḥ ||62|| anye caurā nigaḍeṣu nikṣiptā daṇḍitā hatāḥ | śrutvāyaṃ nagrabhaṃgastu jīvanaṃ sādhusaṃgataḥ ||63|| nirbādhaṃ vai nijaṃ matvā sādhūnaprārthayanmudā | sādhudharmo mayā pālyo dīkṣā grāhyā ca sādhavī ||64|| sādhusevā prakartavyā sādhurbhavāmi cādyataḥ | vacmyahaṃ niṣkapaṭaṃ me kṛtyaṃ sādhujanāgrataḥ ||65|| caurye bahuvidhaṃ cāhaṃ kṛtavānasmi vai muhuḥ | taddoṣaiśca yathā mukto bhavāmi kuruto’naghāḥ ||66|| śaraṇāgatarakṣārthamudyatāḥ sādhavaḥ sadā | teṣāṃ prasaṃgataścāhaṃ jīvāmyanye mṛtāḥ kila ||67|| tasmādvairāgyamāsādya bhajāmi parameśvaram | sādhusevāṃ kariṣye’pi sādhurbhūtvā nirantaram ||68|| ityarthitāḥ sādhavaste cidambarāyanādayaḥ | prāyaścittaṃ kārayitvā kṣālayitvāghasañcayān ||69|| pāvayitvā nagrabhaṃgaṃ dīkṣāṃ bhāgavatīṃ vyadhuḥ | so’pi pāpavinirmukto nāmnā bhāgavatāyanaḥ ||3.114.70|| bhakto’bhavat sadā sādhuścābhajanmāṃ pareśvaram | sādhusevāṃ parāṃ kṛtvā tīrthārthaṃ cākṣarasthalīm ||71 || āyayau kuṃkumavāpīṃ mokṣaṃ yayau sarastaṭe | ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi sādhusaṃgena rakṣaṇam ||72|| svātmārpaṇena mokṣaśca mayā tasya kṛto’tra vai | athānyatte kathayāmi kathānakaṃ purābhavam ||73|| āsīt purā mahāsādhuḥ śukāyano’tidhārmikaḥ | bhajate māṃ sadā rātridinaṃ śroparameśvaram ||74|| aparigrahasarvasvo digvāsā matparāyaṇaḥ | āmravṛkṣatale vāsaṃ kurute bhojanaṃ phalaiḥ ||75|| vanyaiḥ patrairdalaiḥ kandaiḥ kusumairvahate’danam | kuṃkumavāpikāpūrve vane vasati sarvadā ||76|| śaityaṃ tāpaṃ ca sahate vṛṣṭiṃ sahate kṣuttṛṣām | nityaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ prātaḥ snātvā ca kurute saraḥ ||77|| evaṃ madhyāhnake bhikṣāmekabhuktāṃ karoti ca | sāyaṃ me kīrtanaṃ divyaṃ kṛtvā svāpaṃ karoti ca ||78|| mūrtiṃ me tvāmravṛkṣasya stambe citramayīṃ sadā | saṃrakṣati prapūjyaināṃ dhyāyati hṛdaye’nvaham ||79|| āmravaṇaṃ paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ priyaṃ cāsya sadābhavat | so’pi cāmraphalānyeva nivedayati me muhuḥ ||3.114.80|| evaṃ vai vartamānasya cāmravṛkṣaprapoṣiṇaḥ | ekadā daivayogena vane vahnirvyajāyata ||81|| tṛṇapuñjāḥ stambapuñjāḥ patrapuñjāstathauṣadhiḥ | jvalitā jvālayā sarvā vṛkṣāśca jvalitāstadā ||82|| nijasthānasya niyataścāmro’pi jvalitastadā | tato vahniḥ samantādvai prajajvālātivegataḥ ||83|| vāyunā preritastīkṣṇo bhayaṃkaro’tidāruṇaḥ | sādhuścāyaṃ sthito dhyāne’cintayanmāṃ hariṃ tadā ||84|| mayā tvākāśavāṇyā vai bodhitaḥ sa muhurmuhuḥ | yāhi dūraṃ vihāyaitān vṛkṣān dagdho’tra mā bhava ||85|| sa cāha vāṇīṃ naivāhaṃ tyaktvā yāsyāmi cāśrayān | yatrāhaṃ sarvathā naijaṃ sthānaṃ ca jīvanaṃ gṛham ||86|| āśrayaṃ ca sukhaṃ bhakṣyaṃ prāpnomi tām̐styajāmi na | ime me bāndhavāḥ sarve pitaro vāpi bālakāḥ ||87|| mātaro vallikāḥ sarvāstāḥ kathaṃ cotsṛjāmi vai | nāhaṃ kṛtaghnaḥ svārthaśca nāhaṃ pāpo bhavāmi ca ||88|| yeṣāṃ phalaiḥ sujīvāmi yacchāyāyāṃ vasāmi ca | yadrasaiḥ poṣaṇaṃ yāmi tām̐styaktvā kva prayāmyaham ||89|| neme bandhanakartāro jaḍā vijātayastvime | na me kuṭumbinaḥ kintu kṛtasevā ime mama ||3.114.90|| tādṛśān sevakān nityaṃ paropakāraśālinaḥ | divāniśaṃ sahāyām̐śca madāśrayāniva sthitān ||9 1 || sadguṇaśālino vanyān kathaṃ dagdhvā prayāmyaham | dagdho bhavāmi cātraiva nāhaṃ yāsyāmi cāparam ||92|| sādhuścāhaṃ titikṣuśca titikṣavo drumā ime | sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣāśca tām̐styaktvā na vrajāmyataḥ ||93|| yadvā tadvā bhavatvatra bhasma vā jīvanaṃ ca vā | sahayogena bhāvyaṃ vai sahapoṣyeṇa sādhunā ||94|| ityuktvā noccacālāpi nottasthau dhairyaśevadhiḥ | brahmadhyātā niṣasāda yathā tathaiva cāsthitaḥ ||95|| dayā snehaśca sādhūnāṃ mahān dharmo bhavet sadā | samarthamupajīvyemaṃ tyajeyaṃ kakṣamadya vai ||96|| nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa śrīpate puruṣottama | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa rakṣa drumānimān ||97|| ityevaṃ śrāvayan vāṇīṃ sādhurjajāpa mānase | māṃ dhyātvā ca tadā pratyayaikatānena bhāvataḥ ||98|| athāgnirdāhayāmāsa pārśvabhāgaṃ hi yoginaḥ | pādau hastau jaṭāṃ skandhau romāṇi carma sarvataḥ ||99|| tathāpi māṃ bhajam̐stasmāt sthānāccacāla naiva ha | athāhaṃ taṃ satyasādhuṃ śaraṇāgatarakṣakam || 3.114.10 0|| dehādyanādaradharmaṃ cātmaniṣṭhāparāyaṇam | bhaktaṃ me ca videhaṃ taṃ jñātvāvocaṃ varaṃ vṛṇu ||1. 1 || prasanno’smi virāgātte sādhudharmasamanvitān | dayādharmasya bāhulyād bhakterme mānase sthiteḥ || 1 02|| varaṃ vṛṇu samartho’smi so’haṃ sākṣānnarāyaṇaḥ | yaṃ tvaṃ vidvan dhyāyasi vai yadarthaṃ tvaṃ niveditaḥ ||1 03|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | ānṛśaṃsyaṃ tava vṛttāntakaṃ dṛṣṭvā pratoṣitaḥ || 1 04|| varaṃ vṛṇīṣva sādho tvaṃ dadāmi sarvamiṣṭakam | sādhuśca manasā vavre vṛkṣasya ca vanasya ca || 1 05|| saṃbhavaṃ rasasampannaṃ yatharddhaṃ prāk tathaiva ha | ahaṃ jñātvā dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ tatsādhau parasaukhyadām || 1 06|| prīto’haṃ cāmṛtadṛṣṭyā siktavān cāmramuttamam | sarvān drumān vallikāśca kṣetraṃ vanaṃ samastakam || 1 07|| siktavān pīyūṣadṛṣṭyojjīvayaṃ vanamuttamam | tataḥ phalāni patrāṇi śākhāḥ puṣpāṇi sarvaśaḥ || 1 08|| vane pūrvasthiteścāpi smṛddhāni cābhavan punaḥ | vahniḥ śāntiṃ gataḥ sarvo bhasmāpi tatra nāsti ca || 1 09|| sarvaṃ vahnikṛtaṃ karma līnaṃ matkṛtirudgatā | evaṃ divyaṃ vanaṃ cāmravaṇaṃ jātaṃ saro’ntike || 3.114.1 10|| bhāgavatāyanaṃ sādhuṃ bhaktimantaṃ samāśritam | sarvārthasiddhimāpat tadvanaṃ tathā satastu yaḥ || 11 1|| āśritaḥ sa labhet siddhiṃ sādhunā kalpitāṃ śubhām | sādhuḥ so’yaṃ bhāgavatāyano me dhāmni rājate || 11 2|| muktiṃ gato hi kālena kṛpayā bhajanena me | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavettathā || 1 13|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sādhvāśrayeṇa romapādapaśupālasya mokṣaṇaṃ, nagrabhaṃgākhyacaurasya sādhusamāgamena rājabhayād rakṣaṇam, āmravaṇavṛkṣādinām vahnidagdhānāṃ bhāgavatāyanasādhusahavāsena punarujjīvanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturdaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 114 ||
<3.115> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca ahaṃ jātā bahuvāraṃ sṛṣṭau vai bhavatā saha | lakṣmīrnārāyaṇī śrīśca bhārgavī mādhavī ramā || 1 || vṛndā ca tulasī śivarājñīśrīḥ kamalā pramā | padmā vidyāparā padmāvatī śatasahasraśaḥ || 2 || mama rūpāṇi loke’tra vidyante śrīhare prabho | jijñāsā me samutpannā mahālakṣmīḥ kadā katham || 3 || samutpannā ca kinnāmnī pṛthvyāṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa | yadyapyahaṃ vijānāmi śvaśrūṃ me jananīṃ tava || 4 || mahālakṣmīṃ cātha gajānanāṃ surāṣṭrake’parām | camatkārapure jātāṃ kṣīrodasāgarodbhavām || 5 || dvitīyāṃ tāṃ vijānāmi tathā mahāhiraṇmayīm | tṛtīyāṃ tāṃ vijānāmi tadanyā yadi bhūsthitā || 6 || mahākāryakarī cāste cet tāṃ mahyaṃ prakīrtaya | yāṃ śrutvā sampraharṣāmi yadbalaṃ ca camatkṛtim || 7 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi vartamānāṃ tu bhūtale | camatkārakarīṃ pūjyāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ tu dakṣiṇe || 8 || kāñcanyāṃ tu nagaryā sā mātā vai rājate satī | purā śaṃbhormohanārthaṃ kāmadevaḥ samāyayau || 9 || kailāse daivakāryārthaṃ śaṃkareṇa sa bhasmitaḥ | citrakarmā gaṇo bhasma kiñcid dhṛtvā tu puttalam || 3.115.1 0|| racayāmāsa tatraivāveśayāmāsa jīvanam | bālakaścetanaḥ so’pi sañjāto roṣavānati || 1 1|| śatarudrīyapāṭhī ca papāṭha śaṃkarāntike | śaṃbhurbhūtvā prasannastaṃ varārthaṃ prāha vai tadā || 1 2|| varaṃ vavre sa me rājyaṃ trailokye syādakaṇṭakam | pratiyoddhrastraśastrāṇi vṛthā bhavantu sarvathā || 1 3|| mamāstraśastramantrāśca mā bhavantu vṛthā kvacit | tathetyāha tadā śaṃbhuḥ rājyamasmai tathā dadau || 14|| ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi rājyaṃ bhavatvakaṇṭakam | tadā vīkṣya svayaṃ brahmā bhaṇḍāsuretināmataḥ || 15|| bhaṇḍāsphoṭo hyayaṃ jāta iti matvā jagāda ha | athāyaṃ rudrabhālasya krodhānalāt prabharjitaḥ ||16|| bhasmotpannaḥ punastasmād rudrajo dānavo’bhavat | vavṛdhe śīghramevāsau śukraṃ samāhvayat gurum || 17|| mayaṃ samāhvayat pūjāṃ cakre tayostataḥ punaḥ | mayaṃ taṃ śilpinaṃ prāha purātanī purī tu yā || 18|| daityeśvarāṇāṃ cāste tāṃ bhagnāṃ punarnavāṃ kuru | tacchrutvā tu mayo gatvā cakre navaṃ puraṃ hi tat || 19|| yatra sthitvā tu daityena trailokyaṃ śāsitaṃ purā | tatrābhiṣiktaḥ śukreṇa daiteyaiḥ sa mahābalaiḥ ||3.115.20|| śuśubhe parayā smṛddhyā tejobhiśca balādibhiḥ | hiraṇyakaśipuryaṃ vai kirīṭaṃ prāk dadhāra ha ||21 || kirīṭaṃ taṃ sajīvaṃ cāvināśyaṃ śukradhāritam | dadhau bhaṇḍaścāmare dve sajīve śaktiśobhite ||22|| na rogo na ca duḥkhāni jāyante yanniṣevaṇāt | ātapatraṃ dadhau yasya chāyāsthān nāstrakoṭayaḥ ||23|| bādhante na vināśo na parājayo na jāyate | vijayākhyaṃ dhanuḥ śaṃkhaṃ ripughnaṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca ||24|| siṃhāsanaṃ taijasaṃ cākṣayaśauryaṃ dadau kaviḥ | evaṃ rājā samāvṛttastasyāṣṭau tu mahābalāḥ ||25|| pradhānāḥ sainyapūjyāścābhavan trilokigāminaḥ | indraśatruramitraghno vidyunmālī vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||26|| ugrakarmogradhanvā ca vijayaḥ śrutipāragaḥ | sarve vai vedaśāstrajñāḥ karmakāṇḍaparāyaṇāḥ ||27|| yuddhaviśāradā māyāviśāradāḥ pratāpinaḥ | atha daityaṃ viśukraṃ sa dakṣāṃsena sasarja ha ||28|| vāmāṃsena viṣāṃgaṃ sa sasarja duṣṭaśekharam | dhūminīṃ bhaginīṃ cāpi kaṇṭhāt sasarja bhaṇḍakaḥ ||29|| sumohinī kumudvatī citrāṃgī sundarī tathā | catasro vanitāstasya daityaputryo’rpitāstadā ||3.115.30|| syandanāsturagā nāgā vimānāni sahasraśaḥ | sambabhūvurjitalokāḥ śukrācāryamatānugāḥ ||31 || bhaṇḍo babhūva bhakto’sau śaṃkarasya sadaityakaḥ | gṛhe gṛhe rudrayajñāstadā cāsan samantataḥ ||32|| ṛco yajūm̐ṣi sāmāni tantrāṇi ca pratigraham | pravartante sma daityānāṃ samūhe’pi tathādhvare ||33|| tadā yajñeṣu daityānāṃ bubhujurhavyabhojinaḥ | bhrātṛbhyāmugravīryābhyāṃ pradhānaiśca balaistathā ||34|| diśo jigāya sarvāśca reje mahendravattadā | brahmāṇḍaṃ khaṇḍayāmāsa śauryavīryasamucchritaḥ ||35|| bahuvāraṃ devatādyā nirjitā raṇamūrdhani | brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāstaṃ dṛṣṭvā dīptatejasam ||36|| palāyanaparāḥ sarve sve sve dhāmni sadāvasan | kecitpātālagarbheṣu kecidambudhivāriṣu ||37|| kecid digantakoṇeṣu kecit kuñjeṣu bhūbhṛtām | vilīnā bhṛśavitrastā viceruśchannaveṣiṇaḥ ||38|| pitṝn siddhānsādhyadevān nāgān yajñān digīśvarān | brahmāṇaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca rudraṃ vajriṇamityapi ||39|| matvā tṛṇāyitān sarvān lokān bhaṇḍaḥ śaśāsa ha | evaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtavato bhaṇḍasya jitakāśinaḥ ||3.115.40|| ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi vyatītāni tataḥ param | hīyamānabalān devān samprekṣya kamalāpatiḥ ||41|| ugraṃ bhaṇḍāsuraṃ hantuṃ trailokyaṃ cāpi rakṣitum | sasarja sahasā māyāṃ svātmarūpāṃ vimohinīm ||42||| nijarūpā lalitā sā babhūva paradevatā | mahālakṣmīḥ svayaṃ yāsti kaṃbharā jananī mama ||43|| pāśāṃkuśadhanurbāṇapariṣkṛtacaturbhujā | sā mātā paramā śaktiḥ parabrahmasvarūpiṇī ||44|| yā mahāvaiṣṇavī daityavrātavilayakāriṇī | tāmuvāca harirmāyāṃ bhaṇḍaṃ daityaṃ niṣūdaya ||45|| evamājñāṃ samāsādya sā yayāce’psarogaṇam | harirdadāvapsarasaḥ sāpi viśvācikādibhiḥ ||46|| yayau yā himagiriṃ yatrāste bhaṇḍakāsuraḥ | tatra sā tu mahālakṣmīrmūle campakaśākhinaḥ ||47|| nivāsamakarod ramyaṃ gāyantīṃ madhurasvaram | śrutvā daityaścāgatastāṃ yayāce madanāturaḥ ||48|| sāpi hāvām̐stathā bhāvān ceṣṭā vārtāśca mañjulāḥ | kṛtvāharaddhi daityānāṃ manāṃsi bhaṇḍakasya ca ||49|| visasmarustadā bhaṇḍo daityāḥ sāyaṃ śrīśaṃkaram | sandhyāṃ stotraṃ pūjanaṃ ca vṛddhānāṃ sevanādikam ||3.115.50|| vijahuste yajñakāryaṃ tathā sarvaṃ śubhāvaham | evaṃ śukraṃ nijācāryaṃ visasmaśca pūjanam ||51|| iyaṃ devī mohayitvā rurodha daityapuṃgavān | avamānahataḥ śukraḥ kopito’bhūttadā muhuḥ ||52|| daityānāha na vai yogyā bhavanto rājyaṛddhaye | patantu pararājyādvai mado vo yātu saṃkṣayam ||53|| jaḍībhūtānasurām̐śca māyākṛtān vilokya tu | indrādyāḥ kṛtasannāhāstapo’rthaṃ yamunāṃ yayuḥ ||54|| makhamāraṃbhayāmāsurvaiṣṇavaṃ baladaṃ śubham | nārāyaṇyā mahālakṣmyāḥ pūjāṃ cakrurhi devatāḥ ||55|| ugre tapasi saṃsthānā japadhyānaparāyaṇā | ananyamānasā lakṣmīḥ sāvadhānā babhūva sā ||56 || bahvabdeṣu vyatīteṣu svayaṃ śukraḥ purohitaḥ | daityānāha bhavatāṃ vai vināśārthaṃ surādayaḥ ||57|| yajñaṃ dhyānaṃ tapaścāpi kurvanta yamunātaṭe | jātimātraṃ hi bhavatāṃ haniṣyati surādayaḥ ||58|| hariḥ sarvān bhavatpakṣān haniṣyatyacirāt khalu | tenaiva nirmitā māyā mahālakṣmīsvarūpiṇī ||59|| tasyāṃ mugdhān bhavataśca vīkṣyendrādyāstapanti vai | gatvā śīghraṃ tatra vighnaṃ samācarata vai drutam ||3.115.60 || śrutvā bhaṇḍāsurayuktā daityā yuddhaviśāradāḥ | yamunātaṭamāsādya vighnaṃ cakrurmahāraṇam ||61 || tapovighnakarān daityān vīkṣya bhaktārthakāriṇī | mahālakṣmīrakarodvai mahāprākāramujjvalam ||62|| alaṃghyaṃ dānavaidaityairindraprasthābhidhaṃ dṛḍham | taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaṇḍakaścāpi viṣaṇṇaḥ svapuraṃ yayau ||63|| śrutavarmā sakhā bhaṇḍaṃ prāha rājan vacaḥ śṛṇu | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇāṃ rājyaṃ tava śivārpitam ||64|| tato’ntastava rājyasya kālo’yaṃ śivanoditaḥ | aśakyapratikāryo’yaṃ tasmāt kālaṃ prayāpaya ||65|| kāle tu bhogaḥ kartavyaḥ kāle nivṛttiruttamā | ityupadeśaṃ saṃśrutvā vireme bhaṇḍakāsuraḥ ||66|| devatā indraprasthe vai viśāle vanavistare | kuṇḍaṃ suyogyavistāraṃ kṛtvā vahniṃ nidhāya ca ||67|| kṛtvā dṛḍhāṃ pratijñāṃ vai mahālakṣmīṃ prapūjya ca | parito havanaṃ cakruḥ prītyarthaṃ tu śriyā hareḥ ||68|| brahmabhūtā bhaviṣyāmo bhokṣyāmo vā triviṣṭapam | ityevaṃ havanaṃ cakrustāvat prādurbabhūva ha ||69|| cakrākāraṃ mahattejastanmadhye pārameśvarī | jaganmātā jīvadātrī nārāyaṇī pareśvarī ||3.115.70|| vyūhatejomayī brahmānandinī harisundarī | pāśāṃkuśekṣukodaṇḍapadmamālā lasatkarā ||71 || dṛṣṭvā tāṃ mumuhurdevāḥ praṇemurvigatajvarāḥ | tuṣṭuvuḥ śrīmahālakṣmīṃ lalitāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ prasūm ||72|| jaya lakṣmi jaganmātarjaya lakṣmi parātpare | jaya kalyāṇanilaye jaya sarvakalātmike ||73|| jaya brāhmi mahālakṣmi brahmātmike parātmike | jaya nārāyaṇi śānte jaya śrīlalite rame ||74|| jaya śrīvijaye
