sādhuśālāvrataṃ tvidam ||35|| sādhubhyo dhenavo deyā dogdhryo vatsīsamanvitāḥ | vṛṣabhā vāhanārthaṃ ca sādhudhenuvrataṃ tvidam ||36|| gajoṣṭraturagā deyāḥ siṃhavyāghramṛgādayaḥ | sādhave tu samarthāya sādhuvāhanasadvratam ||37|| vātagā ca vimānaṃ ca haṃsayānaṃ jale tarīḥ | śakaṭī naravāhaṃ ca śibikā rakṣikā vaśā ||38|| gantrī ca pādukā siṃhāsanaṃ deyaṃ gajāsanam | phalakāsanamevāpi sādhuyānavrataṃ tvidam ||39|| udyāno vāṭikā kṣetraṃ jīvikā varṣavṛttikā | āyabhāgaḥ pradeyaśca sādhuvṛttivrataṃ tvidam ||3.123.40|| vādyaṃ kāṃsyaṃ jhallarī ca paṭahastantrikā śubhā | vaṃśī vīṇā mṛdaṃgādi mūrajaṃ tāratumbikā ||41|| jalavādyaṃ svaravādyaṃ karatālaṃ ca dundubhiḥ | vidyudvādyaṃ pradeyaṃ ca sādhuvādyavrataṃ tvidam ||42|| siṃhacarma gajacarma vyāghracarma mṛgasya ca | ajīnaṃ pāvanaṃ deyaṃ sādhucarmavrataṃ tvidam ||43|| mauktikaṃ hīrako ratnaṃ maṇiḥ kācaḥ śilottamā | mardalī muśalaṃ deyaṃ sādhusādhanasadvratam ||44|| peṭikā koṣṭhalī jolī tumbikā kalaśī tathā | rajjuśca bandhanī deyā sādhujolīvrataṃ tvidam ||42|| bhikṣā mādhukarī deyā kaṇṭhī mālā ca taulasī | pūjāsāmagrikā deyā sādhupūjāvrataṃ tvidam ||46|| vyajanaścāmaraṃ deyaṃ trabhāṇaṃ cottarāpaṭam | paṭṭo galantikā deyā sādhusandhyāvrataṃ tvidam ||47|| oṣadhaṃ cāpi cūrṇaṃ ca vaṭikā golikā tathā | kvāthā lehyāni deyāni sādhusvāsthyavrataṃ tvidam ||48|| chatraṃ dātraṃ śirastrāṇaṃ pattrāṇaṃ dhotramambaram | kaupīnaṃ paṭako deyaḥ sādhutrāṇavrataṃ tvidam ||49|| bhasma puṇyaṃ dantadhāvaṃ yajñopavītamityapi | kaṭibandhaṃ gātrikaṃ ca deyaṃ sādhuvṛṣavratam ||3.123.50|| sādhvapekṣitadānaṃ yat tatsādhvapekṣitavratam | sādhūnāṃ vacanaṃ grāhyaṃ sādhvājñāpālanaṃ vratam ||5 1 || sādhuprasādo bhoktavyaḥ sādhupuṇyāmṛtaṃ vratam | sādhupādajalaṃ peyaṃ sādhuvāryāmṛtaṃ vratam ||52|| sādhoḥ prasannatā labhyā sādhvanugrahasadvratam | sādhoḥ prāsādikaṃ vastu grāhyaṃ sādhvāśrayavratam ||53|| lakṣmyevaṃ te kathitāni sādhuvratāni vastutaḥ | athānyāni kathayāmi sevātmakavratānyapi ||54|| yeṣāṃ tu karaṇe samyak siddhirbhavati dehinām | prāpte duḥkhe tu sādhūnāṃ sevārthaṃ mānatā tu yā ||55|| kartavyā bhṛtyatā rūpā dāsatārūpiṇī ca vā | sarvārpaṇātmikā yā tu dravyārpaṇātmikā ca vā ||56|| dīpārpaṇātmikā yā ca naivedyārpaṇarūpiṇī | tailārpaṇātmikā yadvā bhūṣārpaṇātmikā ca yā ||57|| vastrārpaṇātmikā yā ca putrīputrārpaṇātmikā | sādhvyai ca sādhave yogyā mānatā sevanātmikā ||58||| sā sarvā duḥkhadāridryanāśikā sādhvarpaṇavratam | nāryā kāryā mānatā sā sādhvīsevātmikā śubhā ||59|| nareṇa sā tu kartavyā sādhusevātmikā śubhā | yathā dharmasya rakṣā syāt puṇyaṃ vardheta saukhyadam ||3.123.60|| yathā nārī naro vāpi puṇyaṃ samprāpnuyāt param | gurorvāpi ca gurvyāśca sādhoḥ sādhvyāśca vai tathā ||6 1|| sevāṃ kuryācchraddhayā vai niḥsaṃśayena vartmanā | mānatā yā kṛtā pūrvaṃ tayā seveta sadgurum ||62|| sādhusevā hi sā proktā sādhuvrataṃ śubhaṃ param | duṣṭasvapne tu sañjāte kartavyā mānatā śubhā ||63|| sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ cāhaṃ kariṣye sevanaṃ kṣaṇam | phalaṃ duṣṭasvāpajanyaṃ mā bhavenme kadācana ||64|| jāte tvapaśakune’pi kartavyā mānatā śubhā | sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ kṛtvā tvāśīrvādavacaḥ śubham ||65|| prāpsyāmyapaśakunasya phalaṃ me mā bhavediti | śatrorbhaye samutpanne kartavyā mānatā śubhā ||66|| sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ pūjāṃ paricaryāṃ dvyahaṃ śubhām | kariṣyāmyāśrame sthitvā śatrorbhayaṃ na me bhavet ||67|| rājabhaye tu samprāpte kartavyā mānatā śubhā | sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ sevāṃ kariṣye pañcavāsarān ||68|| bhojayiṣye sato dravyaṃ dāsyāmi vipulaṃ sate | devasevāṃ dharmadānaṃ kariṣye mā nṛpād bhayam ||69|| prajābhaye samutpanne kartavyā mānatā śubhā | sādhvarthe vṛttikāṃ dāsye kṣetravāṭyādi śobhanam ||3.123.70|| māsamātraṃ sevayiṣye sādhūn prajābhayaṃ na me | ābhicārabhaye jāte kartavyā mānatā śubhā ||71|| bhūtāveśādyabhicāro vinaśyenme yadā tadā | sādhusevāṃ pañcadinaṃ kariṣye bhajanaṃ tathā ||72|| malinopadrave jāte prāṇaghātasame tadā | kartavyā mānatā cāharniśaṃ sādhvāśrame maṭhe ||73|| uṣitvā māsaparyantaṃ sevayiṣye sato janān | kariṣye bhajanaṃ bhaviṣyāmi vai nirupadravaḥ ||74|| prakṛtivikṛtau jāyamānāyāṃ mānatā śubhā | kartavyā sādhusatsaṃgaṃ kariṣye pakṣasevanam ||75|| prakṛtirme bhavet svasthā bhojayiṣye sato janān | vāyuroge prakartavyā mānatā sādhusaṃgatim ||76|| kariṣye daśadivasān naśyedunmattatā mama | viṣiprāṇikṛte daṃśe kartavyā mānatottamā ||77|| viṣaṃ naśyejjīvanaṃ me sthiraṃ bhavettadarthakam | sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ māsaṃ kariṣye’harniśaṃ sadā ||78|| śastraghātādijātāyāṃ pīḍāyāṃ mānatā śubhā | kartavyā duḥkhanāśārthaṃ kariṣye pūjanaṃ satām ||79|| dravyadānādikaṃ cāpi bhojyadānādikaṃ tathā | māsamātraṃ sādhuvāse vatsyāmi sevanotsukaḥ ||3.123.80|| hṛtpīḍāyāṃ ca mūrchāyāṃ tridoṣe vṛttisaṃhṛtau | kartavyā mānatā śreṣṭhā jīvāmi yadi ghātataḥ ||8 1|| sādhurbhūtvā sādhumaṭhe vatsyāmi bhaktilabdhaye | yadvā sevāṃ satāṃ samvatsaraṃ divāniśaṃ śubhām ||82|| kariṣye manasā dravyairdehena tanmayātmanā | jvarādiroganāśārthaṃ kartavyā mānatā śubhā ||83|| dvyahaṃ sevāṃ satāṃ vāse kariṣye roganuttaye | mahāpūjāṃ kārayiṣye sarvatobhadrakaṃ tathā ||84|| maṇḍalaṃ kārayiṣye’pi krūrarogāpanuttaye | bhojanaṃ vividhaṃ sadbhyo dāsye pīḍāpanuttaye ||85|| aṃgabhagnādipīḍāyāṃ kartavyā mānatā śubhā | aṃgasvāsthyaṃ bhavenme cet kariṣye rūpyakārpaṇam ||86|| gṛhārpaṇaṃ jīvikāyā arpaṇaṃ sādhusevanam | dehe śastracikitsāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ bhiṣajāṃ varaiḥ ||87|| kartavyā mānatā syāṃ cet sajīvano nirāmayaḥ | ṣaṇmāsān sādhusevāyāṃ sthāsye’nnadhanado bhavan ||88|| pūravāhe’bhimadhye vā vivare kardame’pi vā | evamādisthale magne kartavyā mānatā śubhā ||89|| yadyahaṃ jīvanāḍhyaḥ syāṃ durnivāryāpadastadā | sarvasvaṃ me ca vārdhaṃ vārpayiṣye devamandire ||3.123.90 || sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ māsaṣaṭkaṃ divāniśaṃ maṭhe | kariṣye’nnadhanavastradehamānasaśaktibhiḥ || 91|| yuddhe vijayalābhārthaṃ kartavyā mānatā śubhā | grāmān deśān sampadaśca svarṇarūpyādihīrakān ||92|| yānavāhanabhūṣāśca chatracāmarapaṭṭikāḥ | arpayiṣye śrīharaye sadbhthaścāpi yathāyatham ||93|| dāsavacca satāṃ sevāṃ kariṣye māsapañcakam | yajñe sādhūn bhojayiṣye kārayiṣye ca mandiram ||94|| pāśabaddhena kartavyā nigaḍasthena mānatā | etasmācced vimucyeyaṃ kariṣye sādhusevanam || 95|| dvimāsaṃ tu maṭhe sthitvā datvā bhojyaṃ yathābalam | vairyāvṛtaḥ prakuryādvai mānatāṃ jīvanārthinīm ||96|| yadyahaṃ jīvavān syāṃ ced dāsye svarṇabharāṃ tanūm | rūpyabhāraṃ śarīraṃ svaṃ śarkarābhārakaṃ ca vā ||97|| cauryahṛtadhanādestu prāptyarthaṃ punareva ha | kartavyā mānatā śreṣṭhā yadi prāpyeta taddhanam ||98|| dāsye’rdhaṃ parameśāya sādhave dharmakarmiṇe | yajñadānādikaṃ cāpi kariṣye taddhanāttadā ||99|| patnīsutāputrapitṛmātṛsvasṛkuṭumbinām | kṛte’paharaṇe dviṣṭaiḥ kartavyā mānatottamā || 3.123.10 0|| jīvitāḥ punarevātrāgaccheyuścākṣatā yadi | tadā vatsaraparyantaṃ kariṣye sādhusevanam || 10 1|| dāsye dravyaṃ bhojanādi kariṣye yajanaṃ śubham | ariṣṭaśāntiṃ paramāṃ kariṣye rakṣaṇātmikām || 102|| lakṣmītyevaṃ sādhusevāvratāni kathitāni te | kartavyāni narairnārībhiśca pīḍāharāṇi vai || 103 || athāpyanyāni sarvāṇi kathayiṣye samāsataḥ | yeṣāṃ karaṇe vighnāśca pīḍā yānti vidūrataḥ || 1 04|| sādhusevāsamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vrataṃ sṛṣṭau na vidyate | āśīrvādena tūrṇaṃ vai pīḍā naśyatyanāśinī || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sarvavratottamavrataṃ sādhusevāmānatātmakamitinirūpaṇanāmā trayoviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 123 ||
<3.124> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śrūyatāṃ śivarājñīśri nārāyaṇīrame śṛṇu | sādhusevāvratavrātān kathayāmyadhikān hivām || 1 || gomahiṣyavyajoṣṭrīṇāṃ dogdhrīṇāṃ doharodhane | abhicāre kṛte’nyena sādhuvrataṃ samāśrayet || 2 || sādhupādarajo labdhvā prasavetyabhidhāya ca | paśoḥ pṛṣṭhe nyasettenābhicāro naśyati dhruvam || 3 || dogdhuṃ dadāti sahasā dogdhrī nārī tu pāśavī | yadvā caikadinaṃ sādhvāśrame dugdhaṃ samastakam || 4 || dadyāt sevāṃ prakuryācca satāṃ dogdhuṃ tadārpayet | paśūnāṃ rogapīḍāyāṃ kartavyā mānatā tadā || 5 || paśvarpaṇaṃ kariṣye’haṃ yadi rogo vinaśyati | yadvā sādhūn sevayiṣye’harniśaṃ bhṛtyavanmaṭhe || 6 || gajavājigaruḍānāṃ haṃsavṛṣabhapakṣiṇām | vāhanānāṃ tu pīḍāyāṃ kartavyā mānatā śubhā || 7 || pīḍānāśe vāhanaṃ vai kārayitvā satāṃ tadā | arpayiṣye vāhanaṃ tad yadvāharniśayādarāt || 8 || satāṃ maṭhe praseviṣye sato janān yathāsukham | niṣādya vāhane sādhūn neṣyāmi vāṭikāṃ prati || 9 || svagṛhaṃ cāpi cānāyya pūjayiṣye’mbarārpaṇaiḥ | arpaṃyiṣye dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ paśurakṣā bhaved yadi || 3.124.1 0|| gṛhakoṇe catvare me rathyāyāṃ bhūtasañcaraḥ | yo’sti tasya vināśārthaṃ kartavyā mānatā śubhā || 1 1|| sādhūnāṃ bhojanaṃ cātra pūjanaṃ harikīrtanam | kārayiṣye jalasekaṃ prasādāmṛtavarṣaṇam || 12|| mūtrendriyādistaṃbhe tu kartavyā mānatā śubhā | māsaṃ maṭhe sthitiṃ kṛtvā seviṣye sādhusattamān || 13|| bhojayiṣye pūjayiṣye vartiṣye tadvacasyaham | sasyakaṇiśayoge cejjanturogaḥ prajāyate || 14|| kartavyā mānatā tatra janturogāpanuttaye | dhānyānāṃ daśamo bhāgo dātavyo devamandire || 15|| sādhūnāṃ bhojanaṃ cāpyatithidīnānnadānakam | mayā kāryaṃ tathā śreṣṭhaścānnakūṭasamutsavaḥ || 16|| mayā kāryaḥ supākaṃ me kṣetraṃ bhavatu ṛddhimat | udyāneṣu phalivṛkṣādiṣu rogāpanuttaye || 17|| kartavyā mānatā śreṣṭhā yadi rogo vinaśyati | sādhubhyaḥ satphalānyevārpayiṣye vai daśāṃśataḥ || 18|| kandamūlādisatpāke yadi hāniḥ pradṛśyate | patrapuṣpādipāke ca śākapāke tadā śubhā || 19|| kartavyā mānatā pākaḥ samṛddho me bhavedyadi | sādhubhyaḥ prathamaṃ nityaṃ dāsye kandadalādikam ||3.124.20|| sādhuvāsaṃ kārayiṣye kṣetramadhye śubhāśraye | ikṣupāke śṛgālondurvādikṛte hyapakṣaye ||2 1|| mānatā tatra kartavyā tadupadravaśāntaye | ikṣukhaṇḍān pratyahaṃ vai dāsye sādhubhya uttamān ||22|| pañca vā daśa vā tvekādaśyāṃ vā pratyahaṃ tathā | gūḍaṃ cotpannaphalato daśāṃśaṃ sādhave śubham ||23|| arpayiṣye śarkarādi kārayiṣye mahotsavam | vyāpāre lābhabhāgaḥ syādutkṛṣṭo vipulo yadi ||24|| tadā daśāṃśaṃ sādhubhyo dāsye devāya vā dhruvam | adhikaśced dhāraṇāto lābho me vai bhaviṣyati ||25|| tadā dāsye’rdhamevāpi bhāgaṃ śrīharaye sate | sarvanāśakṣaṇe kāryā mānatā sarvadānikā ||26|| mṛtyorbhaye samutpanne kartavyā mānatā śubhā | samarpito bhaviṣyāmi sādhave haraye ca vā ||27|| yadi jīvan rakṣito’tra bhaveyaṃ kālavegataḥ | kuṣṭhe śuṣke jaḍībhāve raktasrāve vibhedane ||28|| dhāturoge phullaroge pākaroge jalodare | bhagandare’rśe raktoṣṇavikṛtau pradare vṛṇe ||29|| pramehe kṣīṇabhāve vā kartavyā mānattottamā | ebhyo rogebhya evāhaṃ yadi mukto bhavāmi ca ||3.124.30 || tadā sādhūn sevayiṣye cāturmāsye maṭhe sthitaḥ | dehasevāṃ cānuvṛttirūpāṃ prasannatāpradām ||3 1 || kariṣye sarvathābhāvairdāsyabhāvamupāśritaḥ | ṛṇī kuryānmānatāṃ vai ṛṇamukto bhavāmi cet ||22|| daśāṃśaṃ vā viṃśāṃśaṃ vā pañcamāṃśaṃ dhanasya me | dhānyādervā sampradāsye sādhubhyaḥ sunavārjanāt || 33|| dvyahaṃ māse satāṃ sevāṃ kariṣye dāsyatāṃ tathā | śuśrūṣaṇaṃ maṭhe sthitvā kariṣye dinapañcakam ||34|| nirvaṃśasyānapatyasya putryādyarthaṃ tu mānatā | kartavyā garbhalābhārthaṃ godānaṃ sādhusevanam ||35|| maṭhasammārjanaṃ cāpi devālayasya mārjanam | lepanaṃ sādhuvāse ca jalāharaṇamityapi ||36 || āmānnārpaṇamevāpi nityaṃ satāṃ ca darśanam | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cāpyāśīrvādagrahaṇaṃ sadā ||37|| evaṃ kṛte bhavatyeva garbhādhānaṃ tataḥ param | mānatā tatra kartavyā garbharakṣaṇahetave ||38|| samvatsaraṃ nityameva dīpadānaṃ ghṛtārpaṇam | āmānnasampradānaṃ ca kariṣye haraye sate ||39|| prasavopadrave kāryā mānatā sukhajanmane | putrabhāreṇa sauvarṇaṃ rajataṃ śarkarāṃ ca vā ||3.124.40|| vitariṣyāmi bālebhyaḥ sadbhyaḥ sadbhojanaṃ tathā | dravyadānaṃ ca haraye bālikābhyo dhanārpaṇam ||41 || satāṃ gamāgamaṃ devadarśanaṃ kaṇṭhikārjanam | bālakasya kārayiṣye manugrahaṇamityapi ||42||| sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ dinapañcakaṃ tanmaṭhe vasan | kariṣye sevanaṃ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ putravivṛddhaye ||43|| garbhasrāvo na me bhūyāt putramṛtyurna me bhavet | kartavyā tu tadarthaṃ vai mānatā devatārhaṇā ||44|| mahāpūjāṃ kārayiṣye satāṃ pūjāṃ ca bhojanam | tīrthayātrāṃ kariṣye’haṃ satāṃ dāsyaṃ daśāhakam ||45|| mandire bhṛtyatāṃ cāpi kariṣye mahiṣīgavām | bhaktānāṃ sevanaṃ cāpi kariṣye japakīrtanam ||46|| dhānyasauvarṇadānaṃ ca kariṣye vai satāṃ maṭhe | bahuṣvapi ca putreṣu kariṣye putrakārpaṇam ||47|| yadi rogo bhavennaiva prāṇanāśo bhavenna ca | vighnaṃ cāpi bhavennaiva kariṣye putrakārpaṇam ||48|| sādhuvāse sukūpādiṃ kārayiṣye prapāsthalīm | chāyāvāsaṃ kārayiṣye śāntiśālāṃ tathottamām ||49|| sādhuvāsaṃ parṇakuṭīṃ kārayiṣye sadāśrayam | sabhāsthānaṃ kārayiṣye vyākhyānapīṭhamuttamam ||3.124.50|| arpayiṣye svagurave sādhave tu tadiṣṭakam | ciraṃ jīvetyāśiṣaśca dāpayiṣye sutasya me ||51|| yajñopavītavidhyarthe yadi vighno vilokyate | kartavyā mānatā tatra kariṣye makhamuttamam ||52|| sādhūnāṃ bhojanaṃ sveṣṭadevasya tu nivedanam | vedyaṃ vividhaṃ cāpi jalaṃ phalaṃ dalādikam |||53|| dānaṃ cāmbarabhūṣāṇāṃ śṛṃgārāṇāṃ tu yoṣite | sādhvyai tvaṃ devabhaktāyai sukhayiṣye dhanārpaṇāt ||54|| vāgdāne lagnake vivāhotsave punarāvṛtau | vighno vilokyate cedvai kartavyā mānatā śubhā ||55|| vāgdānaṃ lagnakaṃ cāpi vivāhanaṃ punargṛham | nirvighnaṃ ced bhavenme’tra kariṣye mandire’rpaṇam ||56|| sahasrādisuvarṇānāṃ rūpyakāṇāṃ tathārpaṇam | yadvā ṣaṇmāsaparyantaṃ satāṃ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ sadā ||57|| mandirasya tathā sevāṃ kariṣye dehasaṃbhavām | naivedyajīvikāṃ sveṣṭadevārthaṃ cottamottamām ||58|| prathamo mama putro vā devārpito bhaviṣyati | kanyā vā sādhvikādevyarpitā mayā bhaviṣyati ||59|| gavāṃ dānāni bahūni kariṣye vā susādhave | kṣetrārpaṇaṃ gajāśvānāṃ kariṣye vā samarpaṇam ||3.124.6 0|| dāsadāsyarpaṇaṃ vāpi grāmārpaṇaṃ parātmane | mandirāya sate cāpi gurave ca dvijātaye ||61 || anāthebhyaśca dīnebhyo dāsye vṛttyarpaṇaṃ tathā | nārībhyaśca kumārībhyo dāsye’nnadhanabhūṣaṇam ||62|| apatyānāmabhicāraparābhave kudṛṣṭike | upadrave’pare jāte kartavyā mānatā śubhā ||63|| apatyaṃ me bhavet svasthaṃ dāsye tadbhāraśarkarām | mahāpūjāṃ kārayiṣye satāṃ ca bhojanaṃ tathā ||64|| yadvā dinadvayaṃ sevāṃ kariṣye sādhumandire | yadvā godhūmataṇḍulayavān dāsye tu sādhave ||65|| pitāputravaimanasye kuṭumbakleśane ca vā | bāndhavānāmasammele kartavyā mānatā tathā ||66|| yadi caiṣāṃ saumanasyaṃ sauhārdaṃ ca parasparam | bhavettarhi kariṣye’haṃ sādhave haraye’thavā ||67|| dhanabhojyārpaṇādyaṃ ca jñātisammelana śubham | devasevādikaṃ cāpi kariṣye ca yathāyatham ||68|| dampatyostu vivāde vā vaimanasye viyojane | mānatā tatra kartavyā saumanasyārthamuttamā ||69|| mahāpūjāṃ kārayiṣye sādhūnāṃ tryahasevanam | bhojanaṃ mālikāvartanaṃ ca sevāṃ ca mandire ||3.124.70|| niṣkāsitā svapatinā tiraskṛtāvamānitā | kuryādvai mānatāṃ tatra snehodbhāvanakāriṇīm ||71 || mahāpūjāṃ kārayiṣye kariṣye sādhusevanam | devasevāṃ dhanādyaiśca kariṣye’nnādidānakaiḥ ||72|| mantrajapaṃ mālikāvartanaṃ puṣpadalārpaṇam | sarvārpaṇaṃ kariṣye māṃ patirnibhālayiṣyati ||73|| gṛhasya mānavaḥ kaścid digbhrameṇa digantaram | kumārgago bhraman bhraṣṭo gato’nāgamanāya cet ||74|| mānatā tatra kartavyā tadāgamanakāriṇī | gṛhāyāte kariṣyāmi godānaṃ devamandire ||75|| sādhoḥ sevāṃ dvyahaṃ miṣṭabhojanādyaiśca pūjanam | kanyāyā apaharaṇe manuṣyaharaṇe tathā ||76|| kartavyā strīharaṇe’pi mānatā cāgamārthinī | gṛhāgate kariṣyāmi mahāpūjāṃ satāṃ tathā ||77|| bhojanaṃ pañcadivasān sevāṃ maṭhe ca mandire | dravyārpaṇaṃ svarṇaratnādyarpaṇaṃ harikīrtanam ||78|| jīvikākāryarodhe tu kartavyā mānatā śubhā | jīvikāyāḥ pravāho me yadyaruddho bhaviṣyati ||79|| yadvānyajīvikālābho bhaviṣyati tadā tvaham | pañcāhaṃ sādhusevāṃ ca prathamāyadhanārpaṇam ||3.124.80|| mahāpūjāṃ kariṣyāmi sādhūnāṃ bhojanādikam | vyāpārārambhaṇe kāryā mānatā lābhadāyinī ||8 1 || yāvān lābhastaddaśāṃśaṃ dāsye nārāyaṇāya vai | dharmārthaṃ ca vyayaṃ samyak kariṣye sādhusevanam ||82|| rājyālaye nyāyavāde vivāde pañcasākṣiṇi | svalābhārthe tu kartavyā mānatā sādhusevanam ||83|| lābhārthe haraye dāsye sādhubhyo bhojanādikam | vijaye tu śubhaṃ dravyaṃ datvā navaṃ sumandiram ||84|| sādhvāśramaṃ kārayiṣye tathānnasatramuttamam | devodyānaṃ kārayiṣye mahotsave ghanārpaṇam ||85|| rathārpaṇaṃ gopradānaṃ gṛhadānaṃ sthalārpaṇam | akasmādiṣṭalābhe tu kartavyaḥ sumahotsavaḥ ||86|| nāmakīrtanavādyādyaiḥ śobhito bhojanātmakaḥ | pūjotsavāḥ kāraṇīyā dhvajadānārpaṇaṃ tathā ||87|| nārikelādyarpaṇaṃ ca tailārpaṇaṃ ghṛtārpaṇam | laḍḍūkānāmarpaṇaṃ ca saṃyāvādyarpaṇaṃ tathā ||88|| karanaktakagucchānāṃ puṣpāṇāmarpaṇaṃ tathā | ākasmike bhaye prāpte bhayanāśārthameva ha ||89|| kartavyā mānatā śreṣṭhā guroḥ sevātmikā tathā | hareḥ sevā sādhusevā dhanadhānyārpaṇatmikā ||3.124.90|| upādhau jāyamāne tu lokānāṃ bhajanādiṣu | tannāśārthaṃ prakartavyā mālāvarttanamānatā ||9 1|| durbhikṣopadrave kṛṣṇanāmakīrtanamānatā | yajñakāryasya viprāṇāṃ bhojyadānasya mānatā ||92|| sādhūnāṃ svāgatādyaṃ ca prasannatāsamarjanam | pativratāyāḥ satkāro gavāṃ grāsārpaṇādikam ||93|| mahāmāryādyupaplave deśopaplavane tathā | rakṣārthaṃ sarvadevānāṃ grahāṇāṃ śrīharestathā ||94|| devīnāṃ ca satāṃ sevāpūjābhaktyātmamānatā | kartavyāharniśaṃ nārīnarādyaiḥ prāṇahetave ||95|| sāmudre yānabhaṃge vā rakṣārthaṃ mānatā śubhā | ākāśe yānabhaṃge vā bhajanaṃ satataṃ hareḥ ||96|| guruṃ sādhuṃ sevayiṣye ṣaṇmāsān mandire sthitaḥ | kartavyā mānatā cāpi hyutpāteṣvanivartiṣu ||97|| utpātānāṃ vināśe’haṃ kariṣye makhamuttamam | sādhūnāṃ bhojanaṃ cāpi devānāṃ tu prapūjanam ||98|| devatānāṃ tu naivedyaṃ yathocitaṃ yathādhanam | kārāgrahādiduḥkhānāṃ nivṛttaye hi mānatā ||99|| kartavyā svārpaṇaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’khilam | sādhūnāṃ bhojanaṃ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇasya pūjanam || 3.124.10 0|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mama sevanam | rājyalābhe tu tadyogyā mahatī mānatā matā || 101 || prāṇalābhe tu tadyogyā matā sarvārpaṇātmikā | sampallābhe vaṃśalābhe yathāyogyā hi sā matā || 1 02|| sarvatra sādhusādhvīnāṃ sevāśuśrūṣaṇātmikā | mānatā cottamā śīghrasiddhidānugrahātmikā || 1 03|| kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt | śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava ||104|| bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ | pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako’stu saḥ || 1 05|| śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mama sarvadā | sādhavo me rakṣakāśca santu duḥkhāpahārakāḥ || 1 06|| evaṃ me śaraṇaṃ gatvā yatra kvāpi sthale jale | gagane gartake vahnau vāyau rakṣaṇamarthayet || 1 07|| dhyātvā kṛṣṇaṃ guruṃ sādhuṃ devaṃ dharmaṃ sanātanam | dhyātvāntaryāmiṇaṃ cāpi kuryād rakṣārthamānatā || 1 08|| hānau lābhe sukhe duḥkhe kartavyā mānatā rame | sādhudevādipūjādi rakṣatyeva sukalpitā || 10 9|| antaryāmī virāje’haṃ śṛṇomi hṛdayaṃgatam | dīnabhaktādirakṣāṃ vai drāk karomi samarpaṇāt || 3.124.11 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sukhaduḥkhādau sādhudevādisevāvratamānatādinirūpaṇanāmā caturviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 124 ||
<3.125> sādhuvrataṃ śubhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣadam | śrutaṃ te kṛpayā kṛṣṇa śrotavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate || 1 || tathāpi tu gṛhasthānāṃ dharmavartmānuvartinām | lokaiṣaṇādisiddhyarthaṃ jijñāsā dānadharmiṇī || 2 || jāyate’to gṛhasthānāṃ hitārthaṃ parameśvara | mahādānaṃ bhaved yacca sarvadānottamottamam || 3 || tādṛśaṃ vidyate yadvā tādṛśāni bhavanti cet | mahyaṃ nivedaya kṛṣṇakānta lokahitāya vai || 4 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri kathayāmi tathāvidham | bahudhā vidyate tacca mahādānamanuttamam || 5 || sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ sarvaduḥsvapnanāśanam | puṇyaṃ pavitramāyuṣyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham || 6 || yattat ṣoḍaśadhā proktaṃ satpātre pratipādanam | nyāyopārjitasampatterdānaṃ dānaṃ taduttamam || 7 || ādyaṃ tatsarvadānānāṃ tulāpuruṣasaṃjñakam | hiraṇyagarbhadānaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ parikīrtitam || 8 || brahmāṇḍadānaṃ tṛtīyaṃ mahādānamanuttamam | kalpapādapadānaṃ ca caturthaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam || 9 || pañcamaṃ gosahasrādyarpaṇaṃ dānamanuttamam | hiraṇyakāmadhenūnāmarpaṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhamuttamam || 3.125.1 0|| hiraṇyāśvapradānaṃ ca dānaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ matam | hiraṇyāśvarathadānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tadaṣṭamaṃ tathā || 11 || hemahastirathadānaṃ navamaṃ śreṣṭhamucyate | pañcalāṅgalakaṃ dānaṃ daśamaṃ paramaṃ matam || 12|| dharādānaṃ śreṣṭhamekādaśaṃ mahattamaṃ matam | viśvacakrapradānaṃ tu mahaddānamanuttamam || 13 || kalpalatāpradānaṃ ca trayodaśamanuttamam | saptasāgaradānaṃ ca caturdaśamudāhṛtam || 14|| ratnadhenupradānaṃ ca pañcadaśaṃ hyanuttamam | ṣoḍaśaṃ tu mahābhūtaghaṭadānaṃ paraṃ śubham || 15|| sarvāṇyetāni dānāni rakṣākarāṇi sarvathā | svargadāni mokṣadāni bhavantīṣṭapradāni vai || 16|| tāni vighnasahasrebhyo mahādānāni sarvathā | rakṣanti devarūpāṇi hyekaikamapi bhūtale || 17|| eṣāmanyatamaṃ kuryāt parameśaprasādataḥ | mahādānamakhaṃ kuryāt sādhuviprādipūjitaḥ || 18|| atha lakṣmi samāsena vidhinā tāni te punaḥ | kathayāmi yathā yatra yadvā deyāni tāni vai || 1 9|| tulāpuruṣadānaṃ tu dātavyaṃ viṣuve’yane | dinakṣaye vyatīpāte puṇye vratadine śubhe ||3.125.20 || yugādyadivase rāhugrahe manvādyaheṣu ca | saṃkrāntau vaidhṛtau pañcadaśyāṃ caturdaśīdine ||21 || aṣṭamyāṃ dvādaśikāyāmekādaśyāṃ ca parvaṇi | yajñotsavavivāheṣu duḥsvapnādbhutadarśane ||22|| dravyabrāhmaṇadevānāṃ lābhe satāṃ samāgame | tīrthe ca mandire goṣṭhe kūpārāmasaritsu ca |||23|| gṛhe nave taḍāge ca śraddhāpātre ca pāvane | sādhau dīne’nāthabāle bālāyāṃ vidhavājane ||24|| nirāśraye mahābhakte tāpase cāparigrahe | daive samarthapuruṣe taijase ca narāyaṇe |||25|| nārāyaṇāṃśe vimale yogini pārṣade hareḥ | sādhvyāṃ satyāṃ ca yoginyāṃ devyāṃ yoṣiti durbale ||26|| evamādyeṣu deyāni mahādānāni tāni ca | snātvā śubhe kṣaṇe kṛtvā puṇyaṃ brāhmaṇavācanam ||27|| ṣoḍaśāratnimātraṃ vā daśa dvādaśa vā karān | maṇḍapaṃ kārayettatra caturbhadrāsanaṃ śubham ||28|| kṛtvā vedīṃ saptahastāṃ madhye pañcakarāṃ tathā | kṛtvā madhye toraṇaṃ ca sāradārumayaṃ śubham || 29|| kuryāt kuṇḍāni catvāri caturdikṣu śubhāni vai | mekhalāyoniyuktāni pūrṇakuṃbhān nidhāpayet || 3.125.3 0|| āsanāni pavitrāṇi viṣṭarāṇi śubhāni ca | yajñapātrāṇi sarvāṇi tāmrapātradvayaṃ tathā ||31 || tilājyadhūpapuṣpopahārāṇi śobhanāni ca | nidhāpayet sannidhau vai tataḥ pūrvottare sthale || 32|| grahādidevapūjārthaṃ vedīṃ hastamitāṃ caret | tatrārhaṇaṃ mama kārya puruṣasya parātmanaḥ ||32 || vāsudevādirūpāṇāṃ kṛṣṇādyānāṃ samarhaṇam | brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ phalamālyāmbarādibhiḥ || 34|| patākāḥ sadhvajā deyā maṇḍape kiṃkiṇīsvane | toraṇāni prakāryāṇi dvāreṣu śobhanāni vai ||35|| catvāri kṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ pratidvāraṃ ghaṭadvayam | sraggandhākṣatadhūpārghāmbararatnaphalānvitam ||36 || śāleṅgudīdevadāruśrīparṇibilvacandanaiḥ | priyakāñcanakaiścāpi kṛtaṃ stambhadvayaṃ tathā || 37|| hastayugāvakhāte tat kṣiptvā kṛtvā dṛḍhaṃ ca tat | pañcahastocchritaṃ madhyabhūmirhastacatuṣṭayam ||38 || stambhopari dṛḍhaṃ tulāvalambanaṃ subhāradhṛk | madhyabhārākhyakāṣṭhaṃ ca nyasya kṛtvā sthiraṃ ca tat || 39 || tanmadhye ca tulā dhāryā dīrghā hastacatuṣṭayam | daśāṃgulāyate sthālyau svarṇapaṭṭasuśṛṃkhale ||3.125.40 || lohapāśayute cāpi ratnamālāvibhūṣite | mālyalepanayukte ca candanādiprapūjite ||4 1 || dvayoḥ sthālyormadhyabhāge likhet kuṃkumapadmake | tulāpātrikayostatra vikīret puṣpakāṇi ca || 42|| tulādaṇḍikamadhye ca phalamālambayecchubham | athartvijo vedavidaḥ sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ ||43 || dvijendrā guravaḥ santaścācāryomantrasampradaḥ | sitāmbaro mama bhaktastiṣṭhettulāntike sthale || 44|| pūrva ṛcāṃ vidāvāstāṃ dakṣe yajurvidau tathā | paśce sāmavidāvuttare tvatharvavidau tadā ||45 || tataḥ sūktajapaḥ kāryo homaścāgnau ghṛtādibhiḥ | gaṇeśagrahalokeśā vasvādityamarudgaṇāḥ ||46 || brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca tarpaṇīyā havādibhiḥ | parameśastathā kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo narāyaṇaḥ ||47|| vāsudevo’vatārāśca mahāviṣṇurvirāḍ hariḥ | tarpaṇīyā havanaiśca devyo lakṣmyaḥ samastikāḥ ||48|| homottaraṃ gurustūryanādairāvāhayet surān | baliṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca kṛtvā manūn vadettathā || 49 || ehyehīndrovajradharo rakṣādhvaraṃ namo’stu te | ehyehyagne havyavāha tiṣṭhādhvare namo’stu te ||3.125.5 0 || ehyehi dharmarāja tvaṃ pāhi makhaṃ namo’stu te | ehyehi nirṛtadeva pāhi makhaṃ namo’stu te |||5 1 || ehyehi vāruṇadeva pāhi cāsmānnamo’stu te | ehyehi prāṇanātha tvaṃ vāyo makhe namo’stu te ||52|| ehyehi tvaṃ kuberātra namo’stu dhanadhāriṇe | ehyehi tvaṃ maheśāna gṛhāṇārho namo’stu te ||52 || ehyehi nāgarāja tvaṃ mamādhvaraṃ prapālaya | ehyehi dhātarviśvātmannatra makhe namo’stu te ||54|| trailokye yāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca | brahmaviṣṇuśivaiḥ sārdhaṃ rakṣāṃ kurvantu tāni me ||55 || devadānavagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ | ṛṣayo manavo gāvo devamātara ityapi ||56|| sarvā devyo ramā lakṣmyo brahmapriyā haripriyāḥ | muktānyaśceśvareśāśca rakṣāṃ kurvantu me’dhvare ||57|| baliṃ miṣṭaṃ sunaivedyaṃ gṛhṇantu hi mayārpitam | pūjāmārārtrikaṃ cāpi gṛhṇantvapi ca dakṣiṇāḥ ||58|| ityāvāhya surān pūjayitvā nīrājanottaram | ṛtvigbhyo homabhūṣādi dadyādanyāni cāpi vai ||59|| kuṇḍalāni ca haimāni sūtrāṇi kaṭakāni ca | aṅgulīyapavitrāṇi vāsāṃsi śayanāni ca ||3.125.6 0|| dviguṇaṃ gurave dadyād bhūṣaṇācchādanāni ca | japeyuḥ śāntipāṭhām̐śca jāpakāḥ sarvatodiśam ||6 1 || kṛtvādhivāsanaṃ sarve kuryād brāhmaṇavācanam | snātvā maṃgalasalilaiḥ kuryācca triḥpradakṣiṇam ||62|| dhṛtvā puṣpāñjaliṃ tulāṃ prārthayecchvetavastrakaḥ | namaste dharmaśakte ca satyarūpe tapodhane ||62|| sākṣibhūte jaganmātaste namo’stu ramāsame | dharmādharmaparīkṣārthaṃ kṛtāsi brahmaṇā purā ||64|| pramāṇaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dāne’si pāramārthike | māṃ tolayantī saṃsārāduddharasva namo’stu te ||65|| yo’ntaryāmī pareśo’sti jīvātmā yaśca tattanuḥ | tābhyāmadhiṣṭhitā tvaṃ vai tasyai devyai namo namaḥ ||66|| lūtā māyā prakṛtiryā tasyā jālaṃ prapañcakam | tad vināśya pare loke prahiṇoti yatastulā ||67|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa tauleya te namaḥ | tulāpuruṣarūpastvaṃ saṃsārāt tārayasva naḥ ||68|| evaṃ tulāṃ namaskṛtya pūjayitvā pradakṣiṇam | kṛtvāruhyāt svayaṃ sthālyāṃ tulāyāṃ dānakṛjjanaḥ ||69|| nijaveṣayutaḥ samyak sarvābharaṇahetiyuk | dharmadevaṃ tathā sūryaṃ śrīhariṃ cāvalokayet ||3.125.70 || sādhuṃ satīṃ devamūrtiṃ prapaśyettāvadeva saḥ | karābhyāṃ baddhamuṣṭibhyāṃ namet kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||7 1 || kuṭumbinaḥ svarṇamayaṃ rūpyamayaṃ ca vetarat | nijabhāraṃ dravyameva nyaseyuḥ śarkarādikam ||72|| tulyādabhyadhikaṃ yāvat kāṃcanaṃ rajataṃ dhanam | śarkarāṃ vā nyaseyuśca sarvapāpāpanuttaye |||73 || puṣṭikāmaḥ prakurvīta bhūmisaṃsthāṃ dhṛtestulām | tolayitvā kṣaṇaṃ tatra vandeta parameśvarīm ||74|| namaste te mahālakṣmi dhārmiki dharmasākṣiṇi | sanātani sarvapāpanāśinī puṇyadāyinī ||75|| svarṇabhare kambhare tvaṃ rūpyabhare pramuktide | rasāḍhye rasade devi mātarlakṣmi tule namaḥ ||76|| tvayā dhṛtaṃ jagat sarvaṃ sarvadānaphalaprade | hareḥ priye mama śuddhiṃ prakāraya samarpitā ||77|| ityuktvā cāvatīryātha gurave’rddhaṃ nivedayet | ṛtvigbhyo vai paramardhaṃ dadyādudakapūrvakam ||78|| gurave grāmaratnāni ṛtvigbhyaścārpayettathā | teṣāṃ tadājñayā svarṇādyanyebhyo’pi paraṃ diśet ||79|| dīnānāthanirādhārān satīsādhvīsuyoṣitaḥ | bālāṃśca bālikāścāpi samarcya sādhusajjanān ||3.125.80 || brāhmaṇān bhikṣukān viprān brahmiṣṭhān pārṣadānprabhūn | dānapātrāṇi tatra syurye ye tāṃstān tato’param ||81|| svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ śarkarādi bhaktyā sampūjya cārpayet | na ciraṃ dhārayed gehe dhanaṃ dānārthatolitam ||82|| prokṣitaṃ kalpitaṃ vāpi svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ dhanaṃ ca vā | tiṣṭhed bhayāvahaṃ yasmācchokavyādhikaraṃ bhavet ||83|| śīghraṃ parasvīkaraṇācchreyaḥ prāpnoti dānavān | svagṛhe dānapūtaṃ yad devasvaṃ vipranāṇakam ||84|| sādhutvaṃ ca satītvaṃ ca vidhavāsvaṃ pracoritam | dhanaṃ yattannijīyaṃ svaṃ nāśayitvaiva gacchati ||85|| upabhuktaṃ na saukhyāya rogāya sajjate hi tat | kulahāniphalaṃ tasya nirvaṃśatvakaraṃ hi tat ||86|| tasmād devadhanaṃ sādhudhanaṃ vipradhanaṃ tathā | dharmadhanaṃ na vai bhakṣyaṃ dīnanārīdhanaṃ ca vā ||87|| na vā sthāpyaṃ dhane naije sarvanāśaphalaṃ yataḥ | śuktako’bhūt purā vipro devasādhuprapūjakaḥ ||88|| sādhubhiḥ saha devasya pratimādiprapūjane | bhaktārpitaṃ dhanaṃ bhuṃkte ḍhabbukaṃ śarkarādikam ||89|| pakṣapātena nityaṃ sa bhuṃkte’datvodaraṃbharaḥ | tena pāpena tasyābhūt puṇyakṣayaḥ samantataḥ ||3.125.90|| pratyuta pāpavān jāto dāridryaduḥkhaduḥkhitaḥ | gṛhalakṣmīrvinaṣṭā ca patnī naṣṭā sutādayaḥ ||9 1 || kṣetraṃ ca vāṭikā naṣṭā ṛṇavān samajāyata | kṣudhāvṛto’tidīnaśca bhikṣukaḥ samajāyata ||92|| netrahīno dharmahīno bubhukṣitaḥ pade pade | pāpavṛttiścābhavacca mṛtyumukhaṃ gato’bhavat ||93 || yāmyaduḥkhānyanubhūya śvapacatvaṃ tato gataḥ | kālāntare punastiryagyonyādau samajāyata ||94|| evaṃ lakṣmi dhanaṃ sādhvyā devyā devasya yoginaḥ | hānidaṃ na gṛhe rakṣyaṃ samūlāpahṛtipradam ||95|| tulādānaṃ hi vidhinā nijabhāraṃ dhanādikam | evaṃ dadyād yo manujo mahendrādipadaṃ labhet ||96|| lokapālādhināthaḥ syāt śāśvataṃ svargamṛcchati | vimānenārkavarṇena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā ||97|| pūjyamāno devatābhirbhuktvā svargaṃ mahāciram | satyalokaṃ mahālakṣmīlokaṃ śrīnagaraṃ vrajet ||98|| viṣṇupuraṃ harerlokaṃ golokaṃ sa vrajettathā | bhaktimān yāti vaikuṇṭhaṃ cākṣaraṃ satpadaṃ labhet ||99|| dīyamānaṃ mahādānaṃ prapaśyati praśaṃsati | nivedayati lokebhyaḥ kālāntare smaratyapi || 3.125.10 0|| śṛṇoti vā prapaṭhati bhaktibhāvayuto janaḥ | nārī vā bhaktiyuktā sā rājā rājñī sakhā sakhī ||1 01 || vipro viprāṇikā cānyā dāsī dāso’paro’pi vā | taddaśāṃśaṃ phalaṃ tatra labhate dānaśaṃsakaḥ || 102|| svarge dānaphalaṃ bhuktvā bhaktyā yāsyati matpadam | tulādānaphalaṃ caivaṃ viśiṣyate samastataḥ || 103 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mahādānaṣoḍaśakeṣu tulāpuruṣadānavidhinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 125 ||
<3.126> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mahādānaṃ hiraṇyagarbhasaṃjñakam | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyapradaṃ deyaṃ śubhāptaye || 1 || pavitraṃ divasaṃ dṛṣṭvā tulāpuruṣadānavat | ṛtviṅmaṇḍapasaṃbhārabhūṣāpātrāmbarāṇi ca || 2 || saṃgṛhyopoṣitaḥ prātardevāvāhanamācaret | puṇyāhaṃ vācayet vipraiḥ kārayitvādhivāsanam || 3 || pratimāṃ kānakīṃ dharmadevasya parameṣṭhinaḥ | kuṃbhaṃ tu kānakaṃ tadvad rājataṃ maṇḍape nyaset || 4 || dvisaptatyaṃgulocchrāyāṃ hemapaṃkajagarbhakam | tribhāgahīnavistāraṃ ghṛtakṣīrādipūritam || 5 || ratnapallavataṇḍulavastraphalābhiśobhitam | tatpārśve sthāpayed dātrīṃ sūcīṃ ca hemanālakam || 6 || pīṭhakaṃ bahirādityaṃ vastraṃ tathopavītakam | haimaṃ daṇḍaṃ pidhānaṃ ca kamaṇḍaluṃ śubhaṃ navam || 7 || muktāvalīṃ padmarāgān sthāpayed ghaṭasannidhau | tiladroṇānvitasthālīṃ sthāpayecca ghaṭopari || 8 || ghaṭaṃ tu maṇḍape vedīmadhye saṃsthāpya pūjayet | maṃgalairvedamantraiśca brahmaghoṣaiḥ stavaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 9 || prokṣitaḥ snāpitaḥ sarvauṣadhivāribhirādarāt | yajamānaḥ śuklamālyāmbaradhṛg bhūṣaṇānvitaḥ || 3.126.1 0|| kusumāñjalimābaddhyoccārayet stavanaṃ namaḥ | namo’kṣarādhināthāya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te ||1 1 || namo nityahiraṇyāya hiraṇyavarṇine namaḥ | namo hiraṇyakeśāya hiraṇyāpraṇavātmane |||12|| namo hiraṇyānāthāya hariṇyāḥ pataye namaḥ | namo hiraṇyagarbhāya hiraṇyakavacāya ca || 1 3|| namaḥ suvarṇavarṇāya svarṇaśmaśrupraśobhine | namo mahāmahānārāyaṇīnāthāya te namaḥ || 14|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāva paramātmane | dharmadevāya te cāpi vedhase’pi ca te namaḥ || 15|| sṛṣṭitrayādhināthāya jagaddhātre ca te namaḥ | sarve lokāstava garbhe vyāpakasya vyavasthitāḥ || 16|| sarve devāstava dehe mādhavasya vyavasthitāḥ | sarvā devyastava dehe lakṣmyātmakasya saṃsthitāḥ || 17|| namaste viśvarūpāya pareśatanave namaḥ | namaste bhuvanākāra bhuvanādhāra te namaḥ || 18|| bhuvanāśraya sarvātman namaste garbharūpiṇe | namo hiraṇyagarbhāya brahmagarbhāya te namaḥ ||1 9|| sampadgarbhasvarūpāya puṇyagarbhāya te namaḥ | muktigarbhāya kṛṣṇāya svargagarbhāya te namaḥ ||3.126.20|| tridevā yasya garbhe syustasmai devāya te namaḥ | sarvātmā śrīharistvaṃ vai bhūte bhūte vyavasthitaḥ ||21 || sarvabhūtātmabhūtātman māmuddhara bhavārṇavāt | evaṃ kṛtvā namaskāraṃ stavanaṃ kānakaṃ tataḥ ||22|| muṣṭibhyāṃ parisaṃgṛhya dharmarājacaturmukhau | jānumadhye śiraḥ kṛtvā tiṣṭheducchvāsapaṃcakam ||23|| tadā kuryād dvijastatra saṃskārān vaidikān śubhān | garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanaṃ tathā ||24|| hiraṇyagarbhadevasya brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ | dharmadevasya ca tatra ghaṭapātre sthitasya ca ||25|| gītamaṃgalamantrādyaistata utthāpayed guruḥ | jātakarmādisaṃskārāḥ kartavyāḥ ṣoḍaśo’pi ca ||26|| tataḥ śuddhaṃ pūrṇamūrtiṃ vedhasaṃ ca vṛṣaṃ namet | sūcyādika tu gurave dadyād vai sādhave’pi vā ||27|| namaskāraṃ prakurvan vai stutiṃ kuryādimāṃ śubhām | namo hiraṇyagarbhāya sāvitrīpataye namaḥ ||28|| mahālakṣmyadhināthāya hariṇīpataye namaḥ | namaste viśvagarbhāya svarṇagarbhāya te namaḥ ||29|| carācarasya jagato gṛhabhūtāya te namaḥ | sākṣirūpāya devāya brahmarūpāya te namaḥ ||3.126.3 0|| yathāhaṃ janitaḥ pūrvaṃ martyadharmā tathā punaḥ | tvadgarbhajananāccāhaṃ divyadeho bhavāmi ca ||31|| ityabhyarthayamānastu caturbhiḥ kalaśairdvijāḥ | snāpayeyuryajamānaṃ mantrāśīrvādatatparāḥ ||32|| adyajātasya te’ṅgāni cābhiprekṣyāmahe vayam | divyenānena vapuṣā ciraṃjīva sukhī bhava ||33|| pāpahīnaḥ puṇyanidhiḥ svargādhikāravān bhava | bhaktimān muktimān cānte śāśvatānandabhāg bhava ||34|| brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradadyācca dakṣiṇāḥ svarṇarājatīḥ | ratnamayīrdhanamayīrvastrānnapānarūpiṇīḥ ||35|| atha śrīgurave dadyāddhiraṇyagarbhamuttamam | dharmaṃ dadyāt sādhave ca ghaṭān dadyāttu bhikṣave ||36|| viprebhyaḥ svarṇamudrāśca kalaśān rūpyakām̐stathā | pātrāmbarāṇi dadyācca bhojanānyuttamānyapi ||37|| viprāśca sādhavaḥ pūjyā bahudānaparāyaṇaiḥ | tatropakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ gurave vā nivedayet || 38|| upānatpādukāchatracāmarāsanabhājanam | grāmaṃ vā viṣayaṃ śālāṃ gṛhaṃ vā mandiraṃ śubham ||3 9|| evaṃ hiraṇyagarbhasya dātā brahmāṇḍadānataḥ | viśeṣadaḥ sadā bhūtvā brahmaloke mahīyate ||3.126.40|| kalpakoṭiśataṃ yāvad brahmaloke mahīyate | pureṣu lokapālānāṃ pratimanvantaraṃ vaset ||41 || indrarājyaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā sūryarājyaṃ tathāparam | candrarājyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dhruvarājyaṃ tataḥ param ||42|| parameṣṭhipadaṃ bhuktvā bhaved vairājyarājyavān | śrīpurākhyaṃ mahālakṣmyā rājyaṃ prāpya sanātanam ||43|| bhūmarājyaṃ vāsudevarājyaṃ bhuktvā tataḥ param | yāti vai cākṣaraṃ dhāmānādinaḥ paramātmanaḥ ||44|| lalitāśrīmahālakṣmyā nārāyaṇyāḥ padāmbuje | bhakto bhūtvā ca māṃ śrīśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||45|| prāpyāśnute sarvakāmān saha nārāyaṇena saḥ | hiraṇyagarbhadānaṃ tad bhuktimuktipradaṃ rame ||46|| pitṝṇāṃ tārakaṃ vaṃśapradaṃ putrasutāpradam | nārakāṇāṃ tārakaṃ ca sarvavighnavināśakam ||47|| ariṣṭānāṃ nāśakaṃ ca tathā durbhāgyanāśakam | kleśānāṃ nāśakaṃ cāpi siddhibuddhisukhapradam ||48|| pāṭhakasya tathā śrotuḥ paṭhamānasya vai tathā | madhutulyaṃ sudhātulyaṃ phaladaṃ siddhamānadam ||49|| hiraṇyagarbhadānārthaṃ matiṃ dadyāddhi dehine | so’pi devāpsarobhiśca pūjyate nāyako bhavan ||3.126.50 || śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā cānyanmahādānamanuttamam | brahmāṇḍadānamityetat sarvapātakanāśakam ||51 || sarvasmṛddhipradaṃ sarvasāmrājyaśrīpradaṃ tathā | brahmapadapradaṃ cāpi svargapradaṃ sukhapradam ||52|| puṇyaṃ dinaṃ samāsādya maṇḍapaṃ kārayettataḥ | ākārayed ṛtvijaśca saṃbhārān klṛptayettataḥ ||53|| bhūṣāmbaradhanaratnasvarṇarajatahīrakān | dānārthaṃ sthāpayettatra svarṇādikalaśām̐stathā ||54|| phalaṃ jalaṃ svarṇamālāṃ dānadravyāṇi yāni ca | sarvāṇi sthāpayettatra maṇḍape havyakāni ca ||55|| annāni vividhānyeva rasām̐śca vividhāṃstathā | śrīhareḥ śrāmahālakṣmyā āvāhanaṃ prakārayet ||56|| lokapālān devagaṇānavatārān samāhvayet | gandhāmṛtajalapuṣpākṣatacandanakuṃkumaiḥ ||57|| pūjayed vidhinā sarvān svarṇamūrtimayām̐stathā | adhivāsanakaṃ kuryād devānāṃ śrījuṣāṃ tadā ||58|| suvarṇasyāthavā rūpyakasya viṃśapalādhikam | brahmāṇḍaṃ kāritaṃ tatra maṇḍape sthāpayecchubham ||59|| kalaśadvayasaṃyuktaṃ śeṣakacchapaśobhitam | diggajāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ ṣaḍvedāṃgasamanvitam ||3.126.60|| lokapālāṣṭakopetaṃ madhyasthitacaturmukham | śivācyutārkacandrādidevālayavirājitam ||61|| umālakṣmīsatībrāhmīsāvitrīmāṇikīyutam | prajñāpadmāvatīkṛṣṇārādhāśrībhūsamanvitam ||62|| vasvādityamarudrudranidhisiddhisamāśritam | caturdaśastaragarbhaṃ merudaṇḍavirājitam ||63|| ratnakhaniprarājacca mahādhātusamanvitam | vitasteraṅgulaśataṃ yāvadāyāmavistaram ||64|| kauśeyavastrasaṃvītaṃ tiladroṇoparinyaset | tathāṣṭādaśadhānyāni samantāt parisannyaset ||65|| pūrveṇānantaśayanaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ nyaset | agnau nyasyed devadevaṃ pradyumnaṃ parameśvaram ||66|| dakṣiṇe prakṛtiṃ māyāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ tu kambharām | nirṛte śrīmahārājaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ prabhuṃ nyaset| ||67|| paścime caturo vedān vedāṅganānvitān nyaset | vāyavye śrīpatiṃ cāniruddhaṃ devaṃ samanyaset ||68|| sauvarṇ vahnidevaṃ tūttare śrīsevita nyaset | agnau śrīmadvāsudevaṃ vāsudevīyutaṃ nyaset ||69|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ madhye ramāpatim | samantācchrīrādhikākāntaṃ śrīkāntaṃ narānvitam ||3.126.70|| vāsudevannayanaṃ ca sthāpayet svarṇanirmitān | samantād guḍapīṭheṣu sthāpayet kalaśān daśa ||71 || pañcapallavaratnāḍhyān phalākṣatasamanvitān | nārikelayutān vastrasaṃvītān jalapūritān ||72|| daśadhenūḥ sthāpayecca svarṇarājataśārkarāḥ | yathāśakti samūrtā vā savatsā dugdhadottamāḥ ||73|| svarṇaśṛṃgayutā rūpyaśaphavatyambarānvitāḥ | tāmrapṛṣṭhayutāścāpi kāṃsyadohasamanvitāḥ ||74|| ghāsagrāsādisaṃyuktāḥ śṛṃgāritāḥ prapūjitāḥ | upānatpādukāchatracāmarāsanadarpaṇaiḥ ||75|| bhakṣyabhojyānnadīpekṣuphalamālyānulepanaiḥ | pūjayet sarvadevāṃśca dhenūśca brāhmaṇānapi ||76|| sādhūn sādhvīḥ pūjayecca sarvapūjanavastubhiḥ | rājayogyairgandhasārairmālāhārāmbarādibhiḥ ||77|| ārārtrikaṃ prakuryācca brahmāṇḍasya pradakṣiṇam | namaskāraṃ prakuryād gā devānsādhūn satīrdvijān ||78|| ghṛtāktatilapuṣpāḍhyavrīhihomān śatottarān | kārayitvā tataścādhivāsanānte samantrakam ||79|| snānaṃ tīrthajalairviprā yajamānasya pāpaham | kalaśānāṃ jalaiḥ samyak kārayeyuḥ supuṇyadam ||3.126.80|| pradakṣiṇaṃ prakuryācca yajamānastrivārakam | tataḥ samprārthayed devaṃ brahmāṇḍākhyaṃ narāyaṇam ||8 1 || namo’nantamahāsṛṣṭigarbha viśvātmavāsada | viśvadhāma jagatkṣetra brahmāṇḍa te namo namaḥ ||82||| parārdhaṃ te parabrahmādho’rdhaṃ te śrīnarāyaṇī | dvayormadhye’kṣaraṃdhāma sarvasṛṣṭisamanvitam ||83 || sarvāvatāradhāmāni sarveśvaravibhūtayaḥ | sarvadevavihārāśca sarvamānavamūrtayaḥ ||84|| sarve madhye nivasanti brahmāṇḍodaravāsinaḥ | sarvasṛṣṭimayī mūrtirnārāyaṇī pareśvarī ||89|| brahmāṇḍa tvaṃ rājase’tra dānaṃ te vitarāmyaham | sarvapāpāni naśyantu bhavantu puṇyakāni me ||86|| pitaro me bhavantyeva muktāste dānato dhruvam | duḥkhitāḥ sukhinaḥ santu dāridryaṃ nāśametu ca ||87|| rogāḥ sarve vinaśyantu bhavantu sampado gṛhe | ṛddhayaḥ sarvadā santu bhūtayo me gṛhe sadā ||88|| svarṇaraupyamahāratnahīrakāḥ santu me gṛhe | vaṃśavistāravām̐ścāpi bhavāmi tava dānataḥ ||89|| pāpadoṣā layaṃ yāntu kuṭumbināṃ mamāpi ca | saubhāgyaṃ sarvadā cāstu nārīṇāṃ matkuṭumbake ||3.126.90 || namo’stu brahmarūpāya svāhā nārāyaṇāya te | ityuktvā praṇamedaṇḍaṃ sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ ca vā ||91 || gurave sādhave dadyāt satpātrāya dvijāya vā | anyopakaraṇānyeva dadyācchrīgurave tathā ||92|| anyaratnāni sauvarṇamudrā dadyād dvijātaye | bhikṣukebhyaścāpi dadyād rūpyamudrā yathādhanam ||93|| yadvā vibhajya daśadhā brahmāṇḍaṃ ca tataḥ param | bhāgadvayaṃ śrīgurave śeṣabhāgān dvijātaye ||94|| brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradadyācca bhikṣukebhyo’paraṃ dhanam | evaṃ brahmāṇḍadānaṃ vai kṛtvā saṃbhojayet sataḥ ||95|| sādhūn sādhvīrbhojayecca bālām̐śca bālikām̐stathā | dīnānāthān bhojayecca vidhavā bhikṣukīstathā ||96|| vidyārthinīrbhojayecca vidyārthino’pi bhojayet | brahmiṣṭhān bhojayeccāpi bhaktān saṃbhojayettathā ||97|| evaṃ brahmāṇḍadānena puṇyaṃ brahmāṇḍadānajam | svargarājyaṃ mahārājyaṃ pārameṣṭhyapadaṃ param ||98|| naikavimānasāmrājyaṃ divyasiddhisukhānvitam | vairājaṃ vā padaṃ labdhvā golokaṃ prāpya śāśvatam ||99|| vaikuṇṭhaṃ vā paraṃ lokaṃ muktamuktānikāyutam | nityakailāsalokaṃ vā golokaṃ prāpya śāśvatam ||3.126.1 0 0|| tatrānantasamayaṃ saḥ prāpayitvā pitāmahān | jananīkulavaṃśām̐śca sahasrāṇi kuṭumbinaḥ ||1 0 1|| tārayitvākṣaraṃdhāma prayāti dānakṛjjanaḥ | yaḥ śṛṇoti prapaṭhati smaratyeva vidhiṃ tvimam || 1 02|| tasya puṇyaṃ hi dānasya jāyate svargamuttamam | anyasmai dānakāryasya matiṃ dadāti yo’pi ca || 103|| tasya svargaṃ bhavedante puṇyabhāgena rājyabhāg | punardānaṃ paraṃ datvā yāti vai paramaṃ padam || 1 04|| ityevaṃ śivarājñīśri brahmāṇḍadānakaṃ param | kathitaṃ te bhuktimuktipradaṃ parapadapradam || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mahādāneṣu hiraṇyagarbhadānasya brahmāṇḍadānasya ca vidhernirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 126 ||
<3.127> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ mahādānamathāparam | kalpapādapadānākhyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 || pavitradivasaṃ prāpya tulāpuruṣadānavat | kārayenmaṇḍapaṃ ramyaṃ ghaṭādibhiḥ suśobhitam || 2 || śṛṃgāritaṃ puṣpavastraiḥ kadalīstambhatoraṇaiḥ | kuṇḍavedīyutaṃ ramyaṃ viprāsanavirājitam || 3 || sarvopakaraṇādyaiśca tīrthajalaghaṭairyutam | pūjāvidhānasāmagryādibhiḥ pūrṇaṃ ca sadhvajam || 4 || dvāradeśān toraṇasthān devān dikpāladevatāḥ | śākhasthān devadevām̐ścāvatārān parameśvaram || 5 || mahālakṣmīprabhṛtiśrīdevīśca yāvatīstathā | āvāhayed yathāsthānaṃ puṇyāhaghoṣapūrvakam || 6 || kāṃcanasya śubhaṃ vṛkṣaṃ patrapuṣpaphalānvitam | pakṣivrātakṛtaśobham mañjaryaṃkurarājitam || 7 || vastrabhūṣāchādanāditantuvallīsamanvitam | śaktitastripalādūrdhvamāsahasrapalātmakam || 8 || evaṃ tatkalpavṛkṣasya guḍaprasthe suropaṇam | kṛtvā sitāmbarayugmaṃ dadyācchākhāsu cottamam || 9 || brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyairdevaiḥ suśobhite drumam | pañcaśākhaṃ copaśākhaṃ bhāsuraṃ śvetaraktakam || 3.127.1 0|| haridvarṇadalāḍhyaṃ ca raktāṃkurasamanvitam | śvetamūlaṃ piśaṃgādistambabhāgasamanvitam || 11 || śṛṃgārayitvādhastācca mahāsvarṇāsane śubhe | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ saṃkalpapūrakam || 1 2|| sthāpeyanmāṃ kamaleśaṃ sakalatraṃ suvarṇajam| mamāvatārān sarvāṃśca pitaraṃ mātaraṃ mama || 13|| sarvā lakṣmīḥ sthāpayecca kāmadevaṃ sabhāryakam | aṣṭasiddhīḥ sthāpayecca kalpavallīḥ prakalpayet || 14|| kalpastabakān paritaḥ kalpayettu navāṃkurān | śṛṃgārayet samastām̐stān kuṃkumābīracandanaiḥ || 15 || mahāvṛkṣasya putrākhyān vṛkṣān svalpān suśobhitān | santānarūpān paritasturīyāṃśena kalpayet || 16|| ghṛtapiṇḍamupanyasya ghṛtapātraṃ ca vā pṛthu | pūrvabhāge hyupanyasya svalpakalpadrumaṃ śubham || 17|| nyasyed ghṛtopariṣṭhādvai kalpavallīṣu śobhitam | mandāraṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve śriyā sārdhaṃ nyasedapi || 18|| godhūmānāṃ samudāye kalpastambādiśobhite | atha paścimabhāge’pi pārijātadrumaṃ śubham || 1 9|| sauvarṇaṃ kalpapuṣpāḍhyavallīyuktaṃ nyasecchubhe | taṇḍulānāṃ samudāye tṛṇāṃkurādiśobhite ||3.127.20 || sāvitryā jīrakapuñjasthitayā saha sannyaset | athottare sugandhāḍhyaṃ tilapuñje suśobhitam ||21 || kundastabakayuktaṃ ca haricandanamuttamam | vrīhipuñjopaśobhaṃ ca pūjāsāmagrikānvitam ||22| sthāpayet koṇabhāgeṣu bakulaṃ caiśadigbhavam | agnau tu campakaṃ ramyaṃ nairṛte nārikelajam ||23||| vāyavye pūgikāvṛkṣaṃ nāgavallīsamanvitam | elādistambayuktaṃ ca kṛtvodyānaṃ suśobhanam ||24|| ikṣudaṇḍān ropayecca phalamālyāmbarānvitān | kauśeyavastramūlām̐śca kṛtvaivaṃ vāṭikāṃ śubhām ||25|| āmradruprāntabhāgāṃ vai mayūrakokilāśritām | gogopavṛṣayuktāṃ ca jalavāpīsamanvitām ||26|| saṃśobhayitvā tatrāṣṭau nyasyet pūrṇaghaṭān śubhān | ratnapallavavastrāḍhyān phalavārisamanvitān ||27|| pāduke cāmare chatraṃ vetraṃ vitānakaṃ ratham | vimānaṃ vāhanaṃ cāpi sthāpayet tatra sannidhau ||28|| pātraṃ naivedyadānārthaṃ sthālī cāśanabhājanam | jalapānārthakalaśaṃ sthāpayet pādapāntike ||29|| dīpaṃ dhūpaṃ prakuryācca phalaṃ miṣṭaṃ rasānnyaset | tathā samastadhānyāni cāṣṭādaśavidhāni vai ||3.127.3 0 || yathāśakti nyasettatra maṇḍape pādapāntike | godhūmān taṇḍulān kaṅgūḥ jvārikā barjarām̐stathā ||3 1 || baṇṭikā śīṇikā mudgān caṇakān rājamāṣakān | kulatthikā vaṭāṇām̐śca māṣām̐śca kodravām̐stathā ||32|| yavān tuvarīrdhānyāni ṣoḍaśopanyaset puraḥ | nivārān rājagurukān śṛṃgāṭakāṃśca cirbhaṭān ||33|| āmrānikṣūn nārikelānamṛtān bilvakām̐stathā | panasān jāmbukām̐ścāpi licikām̐śca kaliṃgarān |||3||| śarkarāḥ kharbūcakām̐śca karkaṭīḥ ṣoḍaśa nyaset | atha homām̐śca kuṇḍāgnāvaṣṭottaraśataṃ caret ||35|| pāyasānnaiḥ phalaiścāpi vividhaiḥ rasasaṃbhṛtaiḥ | suvarṇasya gaṇeśaṃ ca sapatnīkaṃ prapūjayet || 36|| kuryānmūrterharerme’dhivāsanaṃ sadrumasya ca | vṛkṣaṃ saṃsnāpayenmāṃ ca kuryāt triḥsampradakṣiṇam ||37|| namaskuryāt stavanaṃ cācaret samprārthayettataḥ | namaste parameśāya kalpadrumātmakāya ca ||38|| kalpavallyadhināthāya cintitārthapradāyine | sarvarasagandharūpavibhūtimūrtaye namaḥ ||39|| viśvambharāya devāya namaste pūrtimūrtaye | sarvānnapūrṇadevāya sarvāmṛtāya te namaḥ ||3.127.40|| sarvasudhānivāsāya pīyūṣarūpiṇe namaḥ | tvameva parameśo’si nārāyaṇo’si mādhavaḥ ||41 || saṃkarṣaṇo’niruddhastvaṃ pradyumnastvaṃ vibhāsi ca | sūryaścandro’gnirindrastvaṃ jāṭharastvaṃ sanātanaḥ ||42|| brahmaṇo mānasodyāneśvarastvaṃ ca vanaspatiḥ | mūrtarūpo’pyamūrto’si bījavṛkṣātmako’si ca ||43|| naranārīsvarūpo’si mahālakṣmīyuto’si ca | sanātanasvarūpo’si sṛṣṭirakṣaṇanāśakṛt ||44|| santānavallikāvṛkṣairyuto’smān pāhi sarvataḥ | svargaṃ dehi vibhūtīśca pradehi sampadaḥ śubhāḥ ||45|| siddhīrdehi vimānāni vaṃśoddhāraṃ tathā kuru | pitṝṇāṃ mokṣadastvaṃ vai teṣāṃ tṛptiṃ vidhehi ca ||46|| ante śrīkṛṣṇakṛṣṇasya padaṃ dehi mahāsukham | evamabhyarthya taṃ dadyād gurave kalpapādapam ||47|| caturbhyaścātha ṛtvigbhyaḥ santānādīn samarpayet | anyadānāni sarvāṇi sādhubhyaśca dvijātaye ||48|| dadyāt prabhojanaṃ ramyaṃ kārayed bhikṣuyoginām | na vittaśāṭhyaṃ kurvīta dadyāddhanaṃ yathocitam ||49|| phalamūlāni dhānyāni dadyād yogyebhya eva tu | namaskuryāt prasādyaiva visarjayettataḥ svayam ||3.127.50|| prasādabhojanaṃ kuryādevaṃ dānapradaḥ pumān | sarvapāpavinirmuktaścāśvamedhāyutodbhavam ||91 || puṇyaṃ labhate dharmātmā sapatnīkaḥ sabāndhavaḥ | sakuṭumbo mahārājyaṃ bhuktvātrātha divaṃ vrajet ||52|| mahatsvargaṃ ca vai bhuktvā satyalokaṃ vrajettataḥ | vairājaṃ ca padaṃ bhuktvā yāyād vaikuṇṭhameva ca ||53|| bhūtān bhāvyān śatagotrān tārayenmānavān sa hi | stūyamānān divaḥ pṛṣṭhe pitāputraprapautrakān ||54|| vimānairarkatulyaiśca viṣṇulokaṃ parātparam | preṣayatyeva tatpuṇyairdhāmākṣaraṃ tataḥ param ||55|| nārāyaṇabalopeto nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ | nārāyaṇakathāsakto nārāyaṇaprasevakaḥ ||56|| yajamāno’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇapadaṃ vrajet | śrotā vaktāsya ca smartā mahendro jāyate dhruvam ||57|| śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri mahādānaṃ tathāparam | gosahasramahādānaṃ sarvapuṇyapradāyakam ||58|| puṇyāṃ tithiṃ samāsādya yugamanvantarādikīm | jayantīṃ devadevīnāṃ nārāyaṇasya me tathā ||59|| maṇḍapaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ vai kṛtvā kuṇḍaṃ śubhaṃ tataḥ | homavastūni saṃgṛhya devānāvāhayettataḥ ||3.127.60|| samarcayeddhariṃ māṃ cāvatārānīśvarīstathā | sarvā lakṣmīḥ pūjayecca gomūrtiṃ svarṇakāritām ||61 || pūjayed yajamānastāṃ payovratī tryahaṃ ca vā | ekāhaṃ vā tato vipraiḥ puṇyādaṃ vācayedatha ||62|| agnau ca havanaṃ kuryād ghṛtavrīhiphalādibhiḥ | sahasravāraṃ havanaṃ kṛtvā gavāṃ sahasrakam ||63|| bahiḥsthitaṃ pūjayecca praṇamecca pradakṣiṇam | vastramālyāmbarabhūṣāśṛṃgakhurasudohanaiḥ ||64|| śṛṃkhalākuṃkumapṛṣṭhācchādanaiḥ pūjayettataḥ | suvarṇaśṛṃgābharaṇā raupyapādasamanvitā ||65|| suvarṇaghaṇṭikāyuktāḥ kāṃsyadohanakānvitāḥ | suvarṇatilakopetā hemapaṭṭādyalaṃkṛtāḥ ||66|| kauśeyavastrasaṃvītā mālyagandhādikārcitāḥ | ghāsagrāsayutā daṇḍaiścāmarairupaśobhitāḥ ||67|| upānatpādukāchatrabhājanāsanasaṃyutāḥ | nandikeśvarayuktāśca vatsavatsatarīyutāḥ ||68|| yadvā sauvarṇagomadhye nandiko’pi suvarṇajaḥ | daśagomadhyago vastrābharaṇādivibhūṣitaḥ ||69|| lavaṇadroṇaśikhare mālyekṣuphalasaṃyutaḥ | palaśatordhvasauvarṇaḥ śatatrayamito’thavā ||3.127.70|| śaktitaḥ palasāhasratritayodbhāvito’thavā | sthāpanīyaḥ pūjanīyastathā godaśakaṃ śubham ||71|| sauvarṇaṃ pūjanīyaṃ vai daśāṃśaṃ pūjayecca vā | gītamaṃgalanādaiśca snāpayitvāmṛtodakaiḥ ||72|| pradakṣiṇaṃ ca triḥkṛtvā gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ | pūjayitvā gavāṃ vṛndaṃ namaskṛtyārthayettataḥ ||73|| namo’stu brahmamūrtibhyo viśvamātṛbhya ānamaḥ | lokādhivāsinībhyaśca rohiṇībhyo namo namaḥ ||74|| gavāmaṃgeṣu tiṣṭhanti sṛṣṭayastisra eva ca | caturdaśabhavanāni vedhasaḥ sṛṣṭirityapi ||75|| viṣṇoḥ sadāśivasyāpi cāṣṭāviṃśatibhūstarāḥ | ṣaṭpañcāśacca māyāyā lokāstiṣṭhanti goṣu tu ||76|| rohiṇyo drogdhrya īśvaryo mātaraḥ pāntu māṃ sadā | gāvo mamāgrataḥ santu gāvaḥ santu ca pṛṣṭhataḥ ||77|| gāvaḥ śirasi me nityaṃ gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham | vṛṣo’yaṃ dharmarūpaśca bhavatyapi sanātanaḥ ||78|| harermūrtau vasanpātu māṃ sadā sakuṭumbakam | svargaṃ satyaṃ ca vairājaṃ bhaumaṃ vaikuṇṭhamuttamam ||79|| śrīpuraṃ cāmṛtaṃ cāvyākṛtaṃ golokamakṣaram | brahmadhāma vṛṣo gāvo dadatveva ca me śubham ||3.127.80|| iti samprārthya sauvarṇīṃ dhenuṃ śrīgurave’rpayet | nandīśvaraṃ pradadyācca dharmamūrtiṃ sate tathā ||8 1 || ṛtvigbhyo dhenumekaikāṃ dadyāt śṛṃgāritāṃ śubhām | anyagāvaḥ pradadyācca viprebhyo’pi yathocitam ||82|| naikā bahubhyo dātavyā kleśadā syāttataḥ khalu | bahvyastvekasya dātavyā dhīmatārogyavṛddhaye ||83|| sarvābhūṣaṇayuktāśca dātavyā gurave śubhāḥ | bahvyaḥ śrīgurave deyā yadi bādho na vartate ||84|| vividhāni dhanānyeva dhānyāmbarāṇi yāni ca | svarṇarajatarūpyāṇi deyāni bhikṣukādiṣu ||85|| payovratī brahmacārī haribhaktiparāyaṇaḥ | śrāvayecchṛṇuyāddhenukathāṃ kuryājjapaṃ hareḥ ||86|| vipulāṃ śriyamāpnoti pāpahīno bhavettathā | bahupuṇyo vimānena sūryasahasraśobhinā ||87|| dehānte nākapṛṣṭhaṃ ca gatvā satyaṃ tataḥ param | lokapālaiḥ pūjitaśca vaṃśavistāraśobhitaḥ ||88|| bhuktvā bhogān divyasaṃjñān vairājalokasaṃsthitān | vaiṣṇavaṃ yogamāsthāya tato yātyakṣaraṃ padam ||89|| śatamekottaraṃ so’yaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tārayed budhaḥ | mātāmahānāṃ tadvacca tārayecchatavaṃśajān ||3.127.90 || pitaraścābhinandanti gosahasrapradaṃ sutam | api syāt sa kule’smākaṃ putro dauhitra eva vā ||91 || gosahasraprado bhūtvā narakāduddhariṣyati | tasya karmakaro vā syādapi draṣṭānumodakaḥ ||92|| saṃsārasāgarādasmāt so’pi nastārayiṣyati | mṛtasyāgre yānti gāvo yāmyalokasṛtāvapi ||93|| vaitaraṇyāṃ tārayanti dharmarājagṛhe’pi ca | svarge vā satyaloke vā maheśvaranivāsane ||94|| viṣṇorvāse tatheśānīvāse śrīpurake’pi ca | mahālakṣmyā nivāse cāvatārāṇāṃ nivāsane ||95|| sarvatra yānti gāvaśca tārikāḥ poṣikāḥ śubhāḥ | yatra gaustatra vai devā īśvarāḥ pārṣadā mama ||96|| sarvā lakṣmyo brahmapatnyo yatra gāvo vasanti vai | yatra brahmākṣaraṃ cāpi goloko yatra vartate ||97|| gavāṃ yogena golokaḥ me kṛṣṇasya vyajāyata | yatra gāvastatra cāhaṃ lakṣmīḥ rādhā ca māṇikī ||98|| prajñā padmāvatī śrīśca mahālakṣmīḥ pareśvarī | tatrāmṛtā purī divyā śrīpurī dhāminī śubhā ||019|| nityā sarvaprabhogāḍhyā divyopakaraṇānvitā | divyaśaktigaṇākīrṇā divyavaibhavaśobhanā || 3.127.10 0|| śāśvatānandasandohā divyabhojyasupānikā | divyavāsodyānavāṭīśayyāvihārasaṃbhṛtā || 101 || evaṃvidhāṃ śrīpurīṃ vai labhate gosahasradaḥ | golokaṃ labhate cāpi labhate cākṣaraṃ padam || 1 02|| labhate sa mamaiśvaryaṃ śivārājñi samastakam | labhate sa rasān sarvān nārāyaṇi na saṃśayaḥ || 1 03|| labhate vividhāḥ śaktirduḥkhahe sukhasaṃbhṛtāḥ | aśnute sarvakāmāṃśca brahmaṇā saha dhāmani || 1 04|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇādupadeśanāt | preraṇād bhuktimuktī sa labhate yajamānakaḥ || 1 05|| naro nārī satī sādhvī sādhurdevo guruḥ prabhuḥ | godānasya prado yāti śāśvataṃ brahma matpadam || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne kalpavṛkṣamahādānagosahasramahādānavidhinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 127 ||
<3.128> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri mahādānaṃ tathāvidham | hiraṇyakāmadhenostat sarvasaṃkalpasādhakam || 1 || maṇḍapaṃ kārayed ramyaṃ kuṇḍatoraṇaśobhanam | āsanaiścopakaraṇairhavyairvahnyādibhiryutam || 2 || lokapālān devatāśca parameśaṃ ramāpatim | lakṣmīḥ sarvāstathāvāhya pūjāṃ homaṃ ca kārayet || 3 || yajamānastatastatrādhivāsanaṃ samācaret | puṇyavedastavaghoṣān viprāḥ kuryuśca sādhavaḥ || 4 || kāṃcanasyātiśuddhasya dhenuṃ vatsāṃ ca kārayet | uttamāṃ palasāhasrīṃ tadardhena tu madhyamām || 5 || kanīyasīṃ tadardhena tripalādūrdhvamityapi | kārayitvā maṇḍape tāmānāyya mṛgacarmaṇi || 6 || vedyāṃ guḍopari sthāpya mahāratnādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ | śṛṃgakhurapṛṣṭhavaṃśe svarṇabhūṣādibhistathā || 7 || lalāṭe kuṃkumādyaiśca pūjayettāṃ savatsikām | kuṃbhāṣṭakaṃ ratnapatrajalataṇḍulaśobhitam || 8 || sthāpayenmaṇḍape tatra dhānyānyaṣṭādaśāpi ca | ikṣudaṇḍāṣṭakaṃ tadvat phalāni vividhāni ca || 9 || pātrāṇi dohapātraṃ ca rajjuṃ ca śṛṃkhalāṃ śubhām | khānapātraṃ rasyaghāsaṃ sthāpayenmaṇḍape tathā || 3.128.10|| kauśeyāmbarayugalaṃ bhūṣāchatrapradīpakān | kuṇḍalacāmaraghaṇṭāsvarṇaśṛṃgādikāstathā || 11 || vibhūṣā rūpyakhurikāḥ sarvarasān nyasecchubhān | haridrāṃ phalapuṣpāṇi kastūrīṃ candanaṃ tathā || 12|| karpūraṃ śarkarāḥ saumyaṃ vitānakaṃ tathāmbaram | evaṃ sarvāḥ śubhā divyāḥ sāmagrīstīrthavāri ca || 1 3|| darbhaṃ cākṣatakām̐ścāpi tulasīpatrakāṇi ca | saṃsthāpya maṇḍape tatra yajamānaḥ śuciḥ svayam || 14|| puṣpahastaḥ pūjayed gāṃ vipro vedān samuccaret | maṃgalaiḥ stavanairyuktaḥ triḥpradakṣiṇamācaret || 15 || stavanaṃ ca prakuryādvai tiṣṭhan gosannidhau tadā | mātastvaṃ sarvadevānāṃ mandiraṃ sarvayoginām || 16 || dehināṃ tāriṇī tvaṃ vai śaktīnāmāśrayāśubhā | svargamārgapradā mokṣapradā sampatpradāsi ca || 17|| pāpanāśakarī cāste sukhade tvāṃ namāmyaham | yatheṣṭaphalade mātarduḥkhasantāpanāśinī || 18|| kāmadheno mahānandapradātri parameśvari | mokṣadātri harernityaṃ prītikari namo’stu te || 19|| kānakī tvaṃ hariṇī tvaṃ hiraṇyā tvaṃ ca candrikā | śrīstvaṃ lakṣmīrmahālakṣmīḥ kamalā tvaṃ haripriyā ||3.128.20|| nārāyaṇī tvaṃ rasadā saṃkalpapūrikā ramā | padmā tvaṃ dhāmaśaktistvaṃ jayā tvaṃ laliteśvarī ||2 1|| śāradā tvaṃ māṇikī tvaṃ prabhā tvaṃ parameśvarī | duḥkhahā tvaṃ pāśavatī padmajā tvaṃ ca tūlasī ||22|| mādhavī tvaṃ ca gāyatrī kārṣṇī tvaṃ śāṃkarī satī | vaikuṇṭhā tvaṃ cākṣarī tvaṃ brāhmī tvaṃ kanakeśvarī ||23|| svargiṇī tvaṃ tāpasī tvaṃ satyā tvaṃ vaiṣṇavī priyā | medinī tvaṃ prasūstvaṃ ca vāṭikā tvaṃ hi śāśvatī ||24|| rakṣayitrī prāpayitrī puṇyasya śāśvatasya vai | mocayitrī hi pāpānāṃ dātrī mokṣasya pāvanī ||25|| tvaṃ dheno māṃ viniṣpāpaṃ kṛtvā kuṭumbasaṃyutam | smṛddhaṃ svargaṃ sadā datvā tato mokṣaṃ pradāsyasi ||26|| kṛpayā te gatāḥ svargaṃ pitaro me purātanāḥ | gamiṣyantyapare pretāḥ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ pradānataḥ ||27|| eṣā bhavatī dattāsi gurave brāhmaṇāya ca | satpuruṣāya divyāya sādhave haraye’pi ca ||28|| ityuktvā ca jalaṃ kṣiptvā dadyād gāṃ gurave tadā | maṇiratnāni mudrāśca rūpyakāṇi dhānāni ca ||29|| dhānyāni vastrajātāni dadyādanyebhya ādarāt | bhojanāni vicitrāṇi miṣṭānnānyuttamāni ca ||3.128.3 0|| pāyasāni sugandhāni bhojayed viprayoginaḥ | dīnānāthasatīsādhvīsādhubālān prabhojayet ||3 1 || dadyād dānāni bahūni cānyānyapi yathādhanam | evaṃ svarṇadhenudātā yāti brahma sanātanam ||32|| svarṇadhenupradāne yaḥ śakto nāsti sa rājatīm | savatsāṃ gāṃ pradadyācca tatrāśaktastu vatsikām ||3 3|| vatsikādānakaraṇe’pyaśakto mānavastu yaḥ | dānapraśaṃsāṃ kuryācca bodhayetprerayetparān || 34|| śṛṇuyācchrāvayeccāpi kīrtayet tatphalaṃ vrajet | athānyatte pravakṣyāmi lakṣmi dānamanuttamam || 35||| mahādānaṃ hiraṇyāśvapradānaṃ svargarājyadam | mokṣadaṃ śvetavāhānāṃ vaihāyasavimānadam ||36|| puṇyadinaṃ samāsādya maṇḍapaṃ kārayecchubham | vedikāṃ vā śubhaṃ kuṇḍaṃ homārthaṃ tatra kārayet ||37|| sarvopakaraṇyānyeva sthāpayet sannidhau tathā | dānasāmagrikāḥ sarvāḥ svarṇarūpyakahīrakān ||38|| annavastrabhājanāni sthāpayet pūjanārthikāḥ | sāmagrīścāpi sarvāśca candanākṣatamālikāḥ ||39|| naivedyārārtrikavastūnyapi pārśve nyasettataḥ | tīrthajalena pūrṇaṃ vai kuṃbhaṃ nyasecca maṇḍape ||3.128.40|| puṇyāhavācanaṃ tatra kārayedviprasattamaiḥ | lokapālādidevānāmāvāhanaṃ prakārayet ||41 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya śrīpatestathā | avatārapramuktānāṃ śaktīnāṃ sarvayoṣitām ||42|| āvāhanaṃ kārayecca pūjayecca vidhānataḥ | sthāpayed vedikāmadhye kṛṣṇājinatilopari ||43|| kauśeyavastrasaṃvītaṃ sauvarṇaṃ śreṣṭhavājinam | tripalāttu samārabhyāsahasrapalasūdbhavam ||44|| svarṇapalyāṇapṛṣṭhaṃ ca svarṇahārasukalgikam | suvarṇaraśanāyuktaṃ suvarṇapaṭṭaśobhitam ||45|| suvarṇanetrapaṭalaṃ hīrakaśāvirājitam | sacchatraṃ satpādabandhaṃ sacchaphaṃ sumanoharam ||46|| yadvāśvinīṃ suvarṇasya savatsarīṃ vibhūṣitām | sthāpayet saumyavarṇāṃ vā dānārthaṃ maṇḍape tile ||47|| upānatpādukāchatracāmarāsanabhājanam | sthāpayenmaṇḍape tatrekṣudaṇḍān kalaśāṣṭakam ||48|| mālyataṇḍulapatrādiratnaśrīphalasaṃyutam | jalapūrṇaṃ hi sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmrajaṃ ca vā ||49|| anyāni dānayogyāni vastūni subhagānyapi | hīrakamāṇikyaratnānyanekadhānyakāni ca ||3.128.50|| vastrālaṃkārapātrāṇi dānārthaṃ tatra vinyaset | śayyāṃ paryaṃkasahitāṃ śirodhānādisaṃyutām ||51 || pārśvadhānopadhānopaskarādiśobhitāṃ nyaset | sthālīṃ ca kalaśaṃ ramyāṃ vāṭikīṃ ca nyasedapi||52|| miṣṭānnāni ca peyāni dugdhādīni nyasedapi | phalānyanekamiṣṭāni supakvāni nyasedapi ||53|| kandāni mūlakandāni dalaśākāni sannyaset | evaṃvidhe maṇḍape vai yajamānaḥ śuciḥ śubhaḥ ||54|| vipraiḥ sarvauṣadhisnānasnāpitaḥ kusumāñjaliḥ | triḥ pradakṣiṇamāvṛtya vahnimaśvaṃ guruṃ tataḥ ||55|| prārthayet paramātmānaṃ sarvavājivirājitam | namaste sarvavājāḍhya sarvātman vājihṛdgata ||56|| vedāharaṇakartastvaṃ cāśvinīputra te namaḥ | svarṇāśvarūpamūrte te divyamūrte ca te namaḥ ||57|| sūryāśvamūrte kalkyaśvamūrte tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ | uccaiḥśravase devāśvarūpiṇe te namo namaḥ ||58|| indriyāśvasvarūpāya mānasāśvāya te namaḥ | aśvatthasāmyarūpāya mahāśvāya ca te namaḥ ||59|| śvetāśvarūpadhartre te pāpaghnāya ca te namaḥ | vājirūpo haristvaṃ māṃ pāhi saṃsārasāgarāt ||3.128.60|| svargaṃ mokṣaṃ mahārājyaṃ dehi ṛddhiṃ sanātanīm | dehi me sampadaḥ sarvā mokṣaṃ dehi tataḥ param ||61 || tava dānena viśvātmā tṛpto bhavatu mādhavaḥ | evamuccārya paritaścaikaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ caret ||62|| aṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ hutvā tato dāne’rpayeddhayam | namaskṛtya hi gurave tamaśvaṃ vinivedayet| ||63|| anyānyapi ca vastūni dadyād dāne yathocitam | ṛtvigbhyaścārpayed dravyaṃ bhikṣave’nnaṃ dhanādikam ||64|| datvā pāpakṣayād divyo jāyate yajamānakaḥ | sūryalokaṃ satyalokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca prayāti saḥ ||65|| saṃhitāśravaṇaṃ kuryād bhojanādi prakārayet | viprebhyaścāpi sādhubhyaḥ sādhvībhyo’nnāni cārpayet ||66|| anāthabālabālābhyo gobhyo’śvebhyo tṛṇāni ca | dadyād bhāvabharo bhūtvā bhojayedannakāṃkṣiṇaḥ ||67|| lakṣmi svarṇāśvadānaṃ yo dadātyevaṃ yathādhanam | sampūjyamāno deveśairmukto yāti padaṃ hareḥ ||68|| svarṇavimānamārūḍho yātyarkalokamuttamam | śṛṇuyādvā kathāṃ cemāṃ so’pi yātyarkasadgṛham ||69|| vācayecchrāvayeccāpi so’pi yātyarkasannidhim | abhinandanadaścāpi yāti svargaṃ sukhāśrayam ||3.128.70|| śṛṇu lakṣmi mahādānaṃ puṇyamaśvarathātmakam | puṇyaṃ dinaṃ samāsādya maṇḍapaṃ kārayecchubham ||7 1 || vedīṃ kuṇḍaṃ kārayecca pūjāvastūni cāharet | lokapālān devatāśca parabrahmāvatārakān ||72|| īśvarānīśvariṇīścāvāhayenmaṇḍape śubhe | aṣṭādaśa ca dhānyāni pātrāṇi ca dhanāni ca ||73|| vastrabhūṣaṇarūpyāṇi sthāpayenmaṇḍape’bhitaḥ | gaṇeśādyām̐stathā devān śrīpatiṃ māṃ janārdanam ||74|| bālakṛṣṇaṃ tathā kṛṣṇāṃ brahmapriyāṃ haripriyāḥ | āvāhayetpūjayecca suvarṇarathamāharet ||75|| aśvasaptakayuktaṃ ca catuścakraṃ tato’dhikam | aindranīlena kuṃbhena varūthena dhvajena ca ||76|| kūbareṇa sūryamukhyā sūtena ca virājitam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ kamalāyutam ||77|| sthāpayedrathamadhye paṭṭarājñīsamanvitam | pārṣadānme sthāpayecca chatracāmaraśobhitān ||78|| vetradharān hetidharān pūjāsevanatatparān | sādhūn sādhvīḥ sthāpayecca rathe matpārśvatastathā ||79|| devarṣipitṛsaṃghātān sthāpayed rathasattame | mahālakṣmīṃ kaṃbharāṃ ca śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakam ||3.128.80|| santuṣṭāṃ sthāpayeccāpi sarvā devīḥ śubhāśrayāḥ | lalitāṃ sthāpayettatra sarvaśaktisamanvitām ||8 1|| ratnāni hīrakān hārān svarṇabhūṣā rathe nyaset | siṃhacarmopari droṇatilān tato’dhikāṃśca vā ||82|| ādhārapaṭakān kṛtvā teṣu saṃsthāpayed ratham | ṣoḍaśa vā caturo vā saratnapallavākṣatān ||83|| bastrajalaphalapūrṇān kalaśāṃstatra vinyaset | kauśeyavastrasaṃyuktān pūjayedbhāvataḥ surān ||84|| rathe māṃ pūjayellakṣmi mannāmnā cādhivāsanām | kuryād yathānyavastūnyāhared dānārthameva ca ||85|| chatraṃ ca cāmare cāpi kauśeyāmbaramityapi | upānahau pāduke ca gāḥ śayyā pātramityapi ||86|| mañcakaścāparāṇyeva vastūni śobhanāni ca | hemasiṃhaṃ kārayecca rathena saha śobhanam ||87|| dvābhyāṃ vā ca caturbhirvā vājibhiḥ sahitaṃ ratham | cakrarakṣākarau sāśvau sahetī pārśvagau tathā ||88|| rathaṃ sahasrasauvarṇaṃ tadanyattu yathādhanam | yadvā rathaṃ tripalordhvaṃ pūjayet triḥpradakṣiṇam ||89|| śuciḥ svayaṃ yajamāno gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ | śuklamālyāmbaradharaḥ kṛtvā me havanaṃ ghṛtaiḥ ||3.128.90 || athānyaphalapuṣpādyaistato rathaṃ pradakṣiṇam | kṛtvārthayed rathaṃ māṃ cābhedena śrīpadaṃ prabhum ||9 1 || namo dhāmābhigataye namo nārāyaṇāya te | namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpāya yogine ||92|| brahmāṇḍapāragāyāpi sarvalokātmakāya te | namo dhāmnāmadhīśāya sarveśvararathāya te ||93|| mahākālo mahāmṛtyuścāyane ṛtavo hyarāḥ | sarve te gaticakrākhyāstebhyo māṃ trātumarhasi ||94|| dehi svargaṃ śāśvataṃ me dehi ca dhārmikīṃ gatim | dehi me paramaṃ dhāma kālamāyāvivarjitam ||95|| pitṝṇāṃ me kuṭumbānāṃ mokṣaṃ kuru rathottama | divyo vimānarūpastvaṃ bhūtvā nayākṣaraṃ padam ||96|| muktāstava dhvaje santi dhāmākṣaraṃ tu paṭṭake | īśvarā daṇḍadehe ca varūthe śaktayo’khilāḥ ||97|| antarbhāge svargalokā madhye nārāyaṇo hariḥ | parito devatāḥ sarvā sarve devā bahiḥsthitāḥ ||98|| adhaḥ saptatalavāsāścakrayośca yamo vṛṣaḥ | agre puṇyaṃ tathā bhaktirguravaste vasanti ca ||99|| teṣāṃ sākṣye dadāmyeva rakṣa māṃ bhavasāgarāt | ityuktvā gurave deyo rathaścānyadhanānyapi || 3.128.100 || anyat sarvamanāthebhyo deyaṃ dānaṃ yathāyatham | bhojayetsarvasādhūm̐śca viprām̐śca bālabālikāḥ || 101 || visarjayettataḥ sarvān parihāraṃ vidhāpayet | śrāvayet saṃhitāṃ dānakathāṃ cānyān diśettathā || 1 02|| upadeṣṭānumantā ca phalaṃ tulyaṃ hi vindati | divyarathe’dhiruhyaiva yāti dhāmākṣaraṃ mama || 103|| sarvasvargaviśeṣām̐śca bhuktvā kuṭumbayuk ciram | īśvaro’pi mahān bhūtvā yāti dhāma rathārpakaḥ || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mahādāneṣu svarṇakāmadhenudānahiraṇyāśvadānahiraṇyarathadānavidhinirūpaṇanāmā aṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 128 ||
<3.129> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi vadāmyatra hemahastirathārpaṇam | yatpradānād divyapadaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ labhate janaḥ || 1 || puṇyadinaṃ samāsādya maṇḍapaṃ kārayecchubham | vedīṃ kuṇḍaṃ havyavastūnyupanyasecca maṇḍape || 2 || āsanāni jalaghaṭān viprānāhūya tatra ca | tīrthānyāvāhayeccāpi tathā puṇyāhavācanam || 3 || maṃgalāni samastāni gāpayed yajamānakaḥ | devatāvāhanaṃ kuryāt pūjayecca yathāvidhi || 4 || hemahastirathaṃ puṣpākāraṃ maṇyādimaṇḍitam | valabhībhirvicitrābhiḥ kārayed daśacakrakam || 5 || sadhvajaṃ savarūthaṃ ca sopaskaraṃ suśobhanam | chatracāmararatnāḍhyaṃ vetradharādiśobhitam || 6 || candradarpaṇapūrvasthaprabhāśobhāvirājitam | vyāghracarmaṇi śārdūlacarmaṇi sthāpayettilān || 7 || tatra rathaṃ sthāpayecca deyavastūni cāpi vai | rathe nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sthāpayenmāṃ ramāpatim || 8 || avatārānīśanīśca māṇikyāṃ duḥkhahāśriyam | rādhikāṃ ca prabhāṃ pāśavatīṃ lakṣmī jayāṃ ramām || 9 || lalitāṃ kamalāṃ padmāṃ padminīṃ tulasīṃ satīm | sāvitrīṃ kaṃbharāṃ līlāṃ gāyatrīṃ mañjulāṃ bhuvam || 3.129.1 0|| mahālakṣmīṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ sarasvatīṃ ca mādhavīm | bhārgavīṃ suguṇāṃ haṃsīṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivām̐stayā || 1 1|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃśrīkṛṣṇamādhavam | brahmapriyāharipriyānvitaṃ māṃ sevitaṃ nyaset || 12|| muktānme pārṣadām̐ścāpi sthāpayettatra vai rathe | sarvāyudhāni divyāni divyadhānyāni yāni ca || 1 3|| bhājanāni vicitrāṇi candanākṣatadarbhakān | jalakuṃbhān ratnayuktān pañcapallavarājitān || 14|| dīpaṃ copānahau chatraṃ darpaṇaṃ pāduke tathā | śayyāṃ mañcaṃ kalaśaṃ ca vastrāṇi vividhāni ca || 15|| phalānyapi vicitrāṇi bhojyayogyānnakāni ca | dhanāni svarṇarūpyāṇi dānārthaṃ tatra vinyaset || 16 || dhvajaṃ sagaruḍaṃ kuryāt kūbaraṃ savināyakam | savitānaṃ suhārālīsaṃśobhitābhigarbhakam || 17|| ṣoḍaśaghaṭasaṃyuktaṃ ṣoḍaśagobhiranvitam | ṣoḍaśahemamātaṃgairmuktādāmavibhūṣitaiḥ || 18|| svarṇakūthakṛtapṛṣṭhaiḥ svarṇadantasucakrakaiḥ | svarṇāmbālikapṛṣṭhaiśca pādabhūṣādirājitaiḥ || 1 9|| kvaṇaddhaṃṭāsvaraśobhairyuktaṃ kṛtvā rathaṃ śubham | pūjayecchrīhariṃ tatrasthitaṃ māṃ devatādikān ||3.129.20|| pradakṣiṇaṃ ca triḥkṛtvā namaskārādi vai caret | stutiṃ kuryāt kusumānāmañjaliṃ vidadhan puraḥ ||2 1|| namaste brahmarūpāya nārāyaṇāśritāya ca | sarveśvaranivāsāya muktakoṭimayāya ca ||22|| akṣarabrahmarūpāya koṭiśaktiśritāya te | namo brahmanivāsāya svargamokṣātmakāya ca ||23|| tava dānena yajñānāṃ tīrthānāṃ vratarūpiṇām | śīlānāṃ sarvadānānāṃ puṇyaṃ me jāyatāmiha ||24|| sarvadevamayastvaṃ vai sarvayajñamayo’pyasi | sarvalakṣmījuṣṭadevanivāso’si prapāhi mām ||25|| punīhi pāpavrātebhyo rakṣa saṃsārasāgarāt | gatiṃ dānena me dehi svargīyāṃ cākṣarīṃ tataḥ ||26|| yasya pādau praṇamanti sureśvareśvareśvarāḥ | avatārāstathā muktāstena juṣṭo’si vai jaya ||27|| adhvapāraprāpakastvaṃ bhavāṭavyā hariśritaḥ | sampatprado bhavāneva vartate bhavayoginām ||28|| pitṝṇāṃ tārakastvaṃ ca vaṃśānāṃ vardhako hyasi | sukhānāṃ yojakastvaṃ ca kṛṣṇaratha namo’stu te ||29|| ityabhyarthya caturthaṃ ca kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ namet | havanaṃ cānale kuryādaṣṭottaraśataṃ harau ||3.129.30|| tato dānaṃ carecchrīmadgurave sādhave tataḥ | anyadānāni dadyācca hyucitāni sate tadā ||31|| viprebhyo bhikṣukebhyaśca bālebhyaḥ sadbhya ityapi | dadyād dānānyanekāni bālikābhyo’mbarāṇi ca ||32|| miṣṭānnāni vicitrāṇi dugdhasārāṇi yānyapi | pātrāṇi bhojanānyeva dhānyāni rūpyakāṇi ca ||33|| dadyād yathādhanaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhaṃ śālāṃ ca vāṭikām | sahasrapalanirmāṇo rathaḥ sāmrājyado mataḥ ||34|| lakṣasvarṇakṛtaścaindrapadaprado’jabhūpradaḥ | daśapalādūrdhvameva datto dadāti sampadaḥ ||35|| nārāyaṇe mayi nyasto dhāma dadāti cākṣaram | mahāsādhujane nyasto dadāti padamaiśvaram ||36|| nirguṇe mama bhakte tu nyasto dadāti matpadam | evaṃ datvā divaṃ bhuktvā dātānte yāti matpadam ||37|| śravaṇātkīrtanāccāsya smaraṇācchrāvaṇāttathā | anumodakaraṇācca rathadānaphalaṃ labhet ||38|| śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā cānyanmahādānamanuttamam | pañcalāṃgalakadānaṃ pāpahaṃ sarvapuṇyadam ||39|| puṇyadine yajamāno maṇḍapaṃ kārayettataḥ | kuṇḍaṃ vedīṃ cāsanāni homadānārthakāni ca ||3.129.40|| vastūni hīrakaratnādīni pūjārthakāni ca | candanākṣatapuṣpāṇi sarvopakaraṇāni ca ||41|| maṇḍape sthāpayettatra jalakuṃbhān saratnakān | sadalān saphalām̐ścāpi pañca sauvarṇadhātujān ||42|| sthāpayenmaṇḍape tatra dhānyāni vividhāni ca | yathāśakti ca bhojyānnamiṣṭānnāni ca sannyaset ||43|| vastrābhūṣaṇadravyāṇi dānārthāni ca sannyaset | sāradārumayān pañca kārayitvā halān śubhān ||44|| dhurayuktān rajjunaddhān sitāsitādhraśobhitān | muṣṭikṛṣṭiyutān ramyān vṛṣabhaiḥ puruṣairyutān ||45|| daṇḍaraśmyādiyuktām̐śca kāñcanān rājatām̐śca vā | pañcapalāt samārabhyāsahasrādipalāvadhi ||46|| kārayitvā halānevaṃ vṛṣabhān daśa tadyujaḥ | dhurandharān kārayitvā sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhitān ||47|| rūpyapādāgratilakān raktakauśeyajhullikān | muktāhārāḍhyasatkaṇṭhān ghurghurādivibhūṣaṇān ||48|| svarṇaśṛṃgān suśobhāḍhyān maṇḍape cādhivāsayet | śakaṭāni suyogyāni yathāśakti prakārayet ||49|| kharvaṭaṃ kheṭakaṃ grāmaṃ kṣetraṃ ca sasyaśālinam | gṛhaṃ ramyaṃ ca vā vāṭīṃ svarṇapātre prakārayet ||3.129.50|| rakṣayettatra sānnidhye maṇḍape ca tataḥ param | svastipuṇyāhavācaśca vācayed viprakovidaiḥ ||51|| āvāhayeddhariṃ māṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣikaraṃ tathā | kārṣṇīṃ rādhāṃ mahālakṣmīmāvāhayecca karṣiṇīm ||92|| avatārām̐stathā muktānīśvarīrdevatāḥ surān | dharaṇyādityarudrādīn lokapālān samāhvayet ||53|| samidbhistilamiṣṭaiśca phalairdalaiśca pāyasaiḥ | vahnau homām̐ścaredaṣṭottaraśataṃ smaram̐śca mām ||54||| dharaṇyādityarudrebhyaḥ pāyasaṃ nirvapeccarum | gururdadyāttathā tebhyaḥ pālāśasamidho ghṛtam ||55|| kṛṣṇatilāḥ śarkarāśca vrīhīm̐ścāpi phalāni ca | pṛthvī sākṣānmahālakṣmīḥ sitā lakṣmīḥ pratuṣyati ||56 || dharaṇyāḥ putrikā devī sitā pṛthvīvidāriṇī | dārikā putrikā cāpi garbhaṃ bhittvotthitā hi sā ||57|| tasyai deyaṃ pāyasaṃ vai tuṣṭaye havane tadā | homottaraṃ vipradāmpatyaṃ samāhūya pūjayet| ||58|| divyāmbaravibhūṣādyairhemasūtrāṅgulīyakaiḥ | sādhuṃ sādhvīṃ pūjayecca yathocitapradānakaiḥ ||59|| maṇḍape’ṣṭādaśadhānyānyapi dhenuṃ payasvinīm | śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ cekṣudaṇḍādiśobhitāṃ nyaset ||3.129.60|| halān pradakṣiṇīkṛtya gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ | prārthayet paramātmānaṃ halasthaṃ māṃ vidāriṇam ||61|| sitāsitāyāṃ sitādhre śivaśceṣāsthito halī | dhure dharmadharo viṣṇū rajjvāṃ nārāyaṇī priyā ||62|| vṛṣabheṣu dharmadevo bhaktiryaṣṭyāṃ sthitāsti ca | sarvatra śrīhariścāste namaste parameśvara ||63|| sarvadevā ghurāḍhye ca tvayyāsate ca te namaḥ | bhūvanaspatimūlānāṃ rasajñāṃ cintaye sitām ||64|| kṛṣṇāya kṛṣikārāya namaḥ śrīhaladhāriṇe | halātmane brahmaṇe te vyāpakāya namo namaḥ ||65|| dāne’rpito bhavānatra pañcalāṅgalarūpadhṛk | svargaṃ satyaṃ mahārājyaṃ vairājyaṃ bhaumamityapi ||66|| dehi me tatphalātmāpi tathānte mokṣaṇaṃ param | ityevamuktvā natvā ca mukhe pañcalāṃgalān ||67|| arpayed vṛṣabhādyuktānupaskaraṇaśobhitān | anyānyapi ca dānāni dadyād bhikṣujaneṣu vai ||68|| viprebhyaśca yathāyogyamṛtvigbhyaścārpayettathā | pañcalāṅgalakṛṣyarhāṃ pañcaśatavighāṭikām ||69|| bhūmiṃ yadvā nyūnabhāgāṃ saha dadyāt savāṭikām | svarṇabhūmiṃ ca vā dadyād gṛhaṃ dadyāddhi śāntaye ||3.129.70|| annajalādikaṃ dadyād dāne yathādhanaṃ tadā | bhojanāni tatastatra kārayed dvijayoginaḥ ||71 || sādhvīsādhubālabālāpāṃgāndhādyabalājanān | evaṃ dadyād yathāśaktidānaṃ pāpavināśakam ||72|| svargadaṃ syād rājyadaṃ syāt parameṣṭhipadapradam | bhūmau yāvanti sasyāni tāvadyugāni vai divi ||73 || modate sakuṭumbaśca tato yāti hareḥ padam | pitṝṇāmuddharaṇaṃ ca bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||74|| pañcalāṅgaladānena puṇyaṃ vai pañcakalpajam | jāyate tena vai svarge muhurdivaspatirbhavet ||75|| gobhūmihalavṛṣabhārpako vaikuṇṭhamāpnuyāt | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya tādṛśaṃ phalamāpnuyāt ||76|| atha lakṣmi dharādvīpamahādānaṃ vadāmi te | pāpaghnaṃ puṇyadaṃ cāpyamāṃgalyanāśakaṃ sukham ||77|| puṇyadinaṃ samāsādya maṇḍapaṃ kārayecchubham | kuṇḍaṃ vedīṃ kārayecca sthāpayejjalabhṛdghaṭān ||78|| saratnapallavavastrān aṣṭasauvarṇakāritān | dānayogyāni vastūni homayogyāni yāni ca ||79|| pūjāyogyāni sarvāṇi sarvadhānyāni sannyaset | haimīṃ kṣitiṃ jambudvīpātmikāṃ sīmādriśobhitām ||3.129.80|| madhye meruyutāṃ ramyāṃ navakhaṇḍasamanvitām | sāgarairveṣṭitāṃ cānte nadīnadasaro’nvitām ||81 || sarvaratnakhaniyuktāṃ vārāhadevapārśvagām | hemnaḥ palasahasreṇa tadardhena tadaṃśakaiḥ ||82|| pañcapalairūrdhvameva kārayitvā nyaseddhi tām | madhye māṃ śrīhariṃ tatra sthāpayecchrīramāpatim ||83|| avatārānmama muktān muktānikā nyasettathā | brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca haripriyāstathābalāḥ ||84|| īśvarānīśvarāṇīśca devāndevīḥ ṛṣīṃstathā | mahālakṣmīṃ śrīgopālakṛṣṇaṃ kuṃkumavāpikām ||85|| aśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi mandiraṃ me śubhaṃ tathā | lomaśasyāśramaṃ cāpi kārayitvā nyasettathā ||86|| bhūṣācchādanavastrāṇi dhanāni vividhāni ca | bhojyānnadānayogyāni sthāpayettatra maṇḍape ||87|| siṃhacarma nyasettatra mṛgacarma nyasecca vā | tileṣu tatra dhānyāni rasām̐śca śarkarāḥ śubhāḥ ||88|| phalānyapi nyaseccāpi kauśeyaṃ ca vitānakam | āvāhayellokapālān diśāṃ pālān sureśvarān ||89|| adhivāsanamākuryācchuklāmbaradharaḥ śuciḥ | pradakṣiṇaṃ kṣiteḥ kṛtvā gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ ||3.129.90|| pūjayetprārthayeccāpi bhāvanābhāvitāntaraḥ | namaste sarvalokātman kṣityātman bhagavan hare ||9 1 || tvaṃ kṣitistvaṃ dharitrī tvaṃ dhātrī pāhi vasundhare | vasumatyai namaste’tra vasūn dehi ca me sadā ||92|| anantaśeṣamūrddhasthānantāyai te namo namaḥ | tvaṃ lakṣmīstvaṃ mahālakṣmīḥ santuṣṭā tvaṃ narāyaṇī ||13|| gāyatrī tvaṃ śivā tvaṃ ca māṇikyā tvaṃ mamāntike | duḥkhahā tvaṃ ca lokānāṃ garbhadhātrī ca pāhi mām ||94|| tvaṃ jyotsnā tvaṃ prabhā buddhirmedhā viśvaṃbharā satī | dhṛtiḥ sthitiḥ kṣamā kṣauṇiḥ pṛthvī rasā ca janmadā ||95|| pāhi svargaṃ mahadrājyaṃ dehi me śāśvataṃ padam | pitṝnmokṣagatānsarvān vidhehi cārpitā satī || 96|| evaṃ natvārpayet kṣmāṃ tāṃ sauvarṇāṃ gurave sate | viprebhyo’rdhāṃ pradadyād vā ratnānyanyāpi capi vai ||97|| bhojayedatha bhikṣūm̐śca satīḥ sādhūn samāgatān | dadyād dānāni dhānyāni vastrāṇi ca phalāni ca ||98|| homaṃ prakārayedaṣṭottaraśataṃ sukhapradam | pāpaṃ naśyati tenaiva puṇyaṃ dānena labhyate ||99|| sampadṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ yāti dharādānapradaḥ pumān | vimānenārkavarṇena pitruddhārasamanvitaḥ || 3.129.1 00|| prayāti śrīpuraṃ nārāyaṇapuraṃ ca śāśvatam | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya muktadeho’bhijāyate || 101 || vairājarājyaṃ bhuktvā ca yāti dhāmākṣaraṃ mama | evaṃ te kathitaṃ lakṣmi mahādānaṃ dharātmakam || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne hemahastirathamahādānapañcalāṃgalakamahādānahemadharāmahādānanirūpaṇanāmā navaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 129 ||
<3.130> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ mahādānamataḥ param | viśvasudarśanacakramahādānaṃ mahattamam || 1 || śreṣṭhaṃ palasahasreṇa tadardhena tu madhyamam | tadardhena kaniṣṭhaṃ vā kārayeccakramujjvalam || 2 || ṣoḍaśāraṃ cāṣṭanemiṃ rūpyakapaṭṭarājitam | viṃśatiphalataścordhvaṃ kārayeccakramuttamam || 3 || tannābhau śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ racayecchubham | caturbhujaṃ samukuṭaṃ caturāyudhaśobhitam || 4 || ādyanemau brahmapriyeśvarīrhi kānakīḥ śubhāḥ | vinyasyed rādhikāṃ lakṣmīṃ prajñāṃ padmāvatīṃ satīm || 5 || māṇikyāṃ lalitāṃ haimīṃ jayāṃ ceti mama priyāḥ | dvitīyanemau tadvattu pūrvato jalaśāyinam || 6 || kambharāśrīyutaṃ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaṃ prabhum | pativratāyutaṃ patnīvrataṃ guruṃ narāyaṇam || 7 || lomaśaṃ kuṃkumavāpīsahitaṃ sadguruṃ śubham | sāvitrīsahitaṃ cājaṃ śivāyuktaṃ śivaṃ tathā || 8 || matsyaṃ kūrmaṃ ca vārāhaṃ narasiṃhaṃ ca vāmanam | rāmaṃ parśudharaṃ rāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ buddhaṃ ca kalkinam || 9 || tṛtīyanemau mātṛkāḥ sapta vasvaṣṭakaṃ tathā | gaṇeśaṃ sakuṭumbaṃ ca kārayed vāhanānvitam || 3.130.1 0|| caturthe dvādaśādityān vedām̐ścatura ityapi | pañcame pañcabhūtāni rudrāścaikādaśāpi ca || 11 || lokapālāṣṭakaṃ ṣaṣṭhe diṅmātaṅgām̐śca kārayet | saptame’strāṇi sarvāṇi svastikādīni cāpi vai || 1 2|| aṣṭasiddhīraṣṭame cāṣṭaiśvaryāṇi ca vinyaset | evaṃ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ kārayitvā tu maṇḍape || 13|| kārite kadalīstaṃbhādyaiśca mahati cānayet | vedikāsannidhau cakraṃ kṛṣṇājinatilopari || 14|| vinyasyet sarvasaṃbhārabhūṣaṇācchādanāni ca | tathāṣṭādaśadhānyāni rasām̐śca lavaṇādikān || 15|| pūrṇakuṃbhāṣṭakaṃ cāpi ratnamaṇyambarāṇi ca | mālekṣuphalapuṣpāṇi dānavastūni yāni ca || 16|| bhojyapeyāni śreṣṭhāni śarkarāśca dhanāni ca | gāṃ kanyāṃ tulasīṃ cāpi rakṣayedanalaṃ tathā || 17|| tato maṃgalavādyāni vādayet snānaśuddhimān | śuklāmbaradharo bhūtvā yajamānastu maṇḍape || 18|| āsane copaviṣṭaśca ṛtvigbhiḥ saha sādaram | ācamanādikaṃ kṛtvā cāvāhya devatāstataḥ || 19|| vidhinā pūjayitvāthāṣṭottaraṃ homakām̐ścaret | kṛtvādhivāsanaṃ cāpi puṣpāñjaliṃ samarpayet ||3.130.20|| pradakṣiṇaṃ homacakraṃ kṛtvā samprārthayedapi | namaḥ ṣaṭackrarūpāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ ||21|| viśvacakrasvarūpāya sudarśanāya te namaḥ | namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇahastāṅgulisthita ||22|| namaste pāpapuñjānāṃ jvālakāya dayājuṣe | hemacakrapradānena bhuktiṃ muktiṃ pradehi me ||23 || paramānandamūrte te namo nārāyaṇātmane | tejomayāya divyāyāsurapāṭanaśaktaye ||24|| hṛdayasthāya ca guṇātītāya te namo namaḥ | nārāyaṇe sthitaṃ cakraṃ cakramadhye hariḥ sthitaḥ ||25|| dvayormadhye mahālakṣmīstasyai devyai namo namaḥ | āyudhaṃ bhaktarakṣārthaṃ vartase māṃ prapāhi ca ||26 || evamuccārya gurave dadyāccakraṃ sudarśanam | anyāni dānayogyāni dvijātibhyo’rpayettathā ||27|| dīnāndhakṛpaṇebhyaśca yoṣidbhyo’pyarpayettathā | bālebhyo bālikābhyaśca dadyād dānāni vai tadā ||28|| bhojayet sarvabhojyāni ārārtrikaṃ tathācaret | parihāraṃ prakuryācca visṛjed bhūsurādikān ||29|| evaṃ pradātā cakrasya mucyate bhavabandhanāt | viṣṇuloke pare svarge satye vairājabhūstare ||3.130.30|| bhuktvā bhogānanantām̐śca bhūtvā nārāyaṇātmakaḥ | vaikuṇṭhalokamāsādya caturbāhuḥ sanātanaḥ ||3 1 || ciraṃ vasettato yāti golokaṃ dhāma cottamam | tato brahmapuraṃ yāti cākṣaraṃ dhāma me param ||32|| nityaṃ vai kānakaṃ cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ hariśritam | kārayitvā gṛhe bhaktaḥ pūjayet kusumākṣataiḥ ||3 3|| viśvacakraṃ taret so’pi hareścakrasya pūjanāt | sudarśanaṃ gṛhe yasya tasyāghacakrakāṇi tu ||34|| naśyantyeva na jāyante jāyante puṇyaparvatāḥ | rakṣāṃ karoti satataṃ gṛhasthaṃ vai sudarśanam ||35|| vardhayatyeva cāyuṣyaṃ dadāti vipulāṃ śriyam | sāmrājyacakraṃ yadvāpi cakravartitvamityapi ||36 || atha te śivarājñīśri kathayāmi tathottamam | māhātmyaṃ mama cakrasya rahasyaṃ sarvato’dhikam ||37|| yasya dehe gṛhe haste vastre vāṭyāṃ ca vastuṣu | sudarśanaṃ bhaveccakraṃ tatra pāpaṃ na tiṣṭhati ||38|| yāmyadūtā na cāyānti rākṣasā vidravanti ca | bhūtapretapiśācādyāḥ palāyante’pi dūrataḥ ||39|| rogā jvarādikāḥ sarve na tiṣṭhanti kadācana | vāsanā nirmūlatāṃ ca gacchatyeva sudarśanāt ||3.130.40|| rājadevādibādhāśca naśyantyeva sudarśanāt | sarpavṛścikabādhāśca viṣāṇyanyāni yāni ca ||41 || naśyanti tejasā tūrṇaṃ sudarśanasya śārṅgiṇaḥ | ṛddhayaḥ sarvathā tatra nivasanti surakṣitāḥ ||42|| bālagrahādayaścāpi pīḍayanti na tadgṛhe | akālamaraṇaṃ tatra jāyate na sudarśanāt ||43|| anapatyagṛhaṃ naiva bhaved yatra sudarśanam | utpātā na bhavantyeva yatra sudarśanaṃ mama ||44|| akasmātā na ca syuśca yatra me vai sudarśanam | vijayaḥ sarvadā syācca sarvathā me sudarśanāt ||45|| cauravyāghrabhayādyāśca naiva jāyanta eva tu | jalavahnibhayāścāpi bhūkampabhayamityapi ||46|| naiva tatra prajāyante yatra me’sti sudarśanam | garbhasrāvabhayaṃ cāpi strauvaidhavyabhayādikam ||47|| sampannāśabhayaṃ naiva prajāyante sudarśanāt | kleśā naiva prajāyante jantubhayaṃ na jāyate ||48|| śastrabhayaṃ bhavennaiva ghātabhayaṃ na jāyate | grahapīḍā bhavennaiva yatra me’sti sudarśanam ||49|| rūpasaundaryasaubhāgyasamṛddhisadrasādikam | sudarśanapratāpena jāyate’cintitaṃ bahu ||3.130.50|| śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā cakraṃ mālācakraṃ mahattamam | svarṇamālā tulasyā vā mālikā cakramuttamam ||51 || brahmacakramidaṃ proktaṃ sudarśanaṃ hi tatparam | aṣṭottaraśatāraṃ tat sādhucakraṃ mahattamam ||52|| sādhuhastagatā mālā nikṛntati hyaghāni vai | māyādurgāṇi sarvāṇi nikṛntati samūlataḥ ||53|| janmamaraṇabhārāṇi cottārayati mastakāt | gale mālā dhṛtā yena mastakaṃ tasya pūjyate ||54|| haste mālā dhṛtā haste padmāsya saṃvaset sadā | bhuje mālā prakoṣṭhe vā dhṛtā prajāyate ramā ||55|| lakṣmīvāso bhavettasya prakoṣṭhaḥ sarvadā priyaḥ | mālācakraṃ gṛhe yatra tadgṛhaṃ rakṣitaṃ bhavet ||56|| nārāyaṇena sahasā mayā sarvātmanā rame || mālājāpena daityānāṃ duṣṭendriyanivāsinām ||57|| kalmaṣāṇāṃ samastānāṃ vilayo jāyate dhruvam | evaṃ brahmamahācakraṃ paraṃ mālāsudarśanam ||58|| sarvadā rakṣakaṃ lakṣmi dāne deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ | svarṇāṃ mālāṃ rājatīṃ vā sphāṭikīṃ mauktikīṃ ca vā ||59|| taulasīṃ vārpayed dāne svargadā mokṣadā hi sā | sate sadgurave dadyājjāpakāya mahātmane ||3.130.60|| pūjayitvā candanādyairmālikāṃ hṛdayaṃgamām | śrīharerhṛdaye cāste mālā sphāṭikasaṃbhavā ||6 1|| taulasīmālikā haste lakṣmīto mānatāṃ gatā | seyaṃ lakṣmīrmahālakṣmīrmālikā malanāśinī |||2|| svargamālāpradā bhuktimuktipradā samujjvalā | aṣṭottaraśatamaṇiśobhitā svargatantunā ||6 3|| sphāṭikena suramyeṇa meruṇā rājatena vā | śobhitā brahmagranthyādinaddhā śrīvāsinī satī ||64|| saccidānandarūpā sā mālā deyā vidhānataḥ | saṃsthāpya sarvatobhadramaṇḍale kalaśopari ||65|| śarkarādiyutā deyā gomukhī vastraśobhitā | āsanena yutā deyā pracchādanapaṭānvitā ||66|| phalasugandhayuktā ca pradeyā divyapārikā | divyamaṇisusampannā hīratantuvirājitā ||67|| sadakṣiṇā pradeyā vai dhanadhānyasamanvitā | mṛgājine ghaṭe sthālyāṃ vinyasya mālikāṃ ca tām ||68|| śrīharerme pratimāyāḥ kare datvā prapūjayet | candanākṣatapuṣpādyaiḥ snāpayenmālikāṃ mama ||619|| candanādyaiḥ pūjayitvā punarhaste tu me’rpayet | ārārtrikaṃ dhūpadīpau kṛtvā natvā ca māṃ tataḥ ||3.130.70|| naivedyaṃ me samapyāpi mālāyai bhojayettataḥ | cid devī mālikā me’sti lalitā lalanā mama ||71 || sadāśaktirmahādivyā sarvapuṇyapradāyinī | svastikena saha dadyād dhanadhānyādibhiḥ saha ||72|| gurave vai namaskṛtya dadyānnatvā punaḥ punaḥ | prārthayed gurave tatra mālādānaṃ karomi yat ||73|| tena puṇyena me kṛṣṇaparamātmā prasīdatām | mālayā rādhayā lakṣmyā rakṣyo’haṃ sarvadā tathā ||74|| mama pāpāni naśyantu mālādānena sadguro | mādhavo mālayā nityaṃ prasanno me’stu saukhyadaḥ ||75|| ityevaṃ mālikācakraṃ dadyād dāne bhayāpaham | mālācaturthabhāgaṃ ca yatra vai saptaviṃśatiḥ ||76|| maṇayaḥ syuḥ śubhaṃ vā rakṣakaṃ dadyātu rājatam | vā vikalpaśca sandehastasmād rakṣati saṃkhyayā ||77|| so’yaṃ vārakṣakastasyāḥ sutastamapi cārpayet | mālādānaṃ mahādānaṃ sarvapāpavināśakam ||78|| mālayā nityajāpaḥ syānnārāyaṇasya me priye | tena duṣṭāni pāpāni naśyantyeva kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ||79|| mayi nyastasamagrasya japato nāsti pātakam | cakradvayamidaṃ proktaṃ dadato nāsti pātakam ||3.130.80 || mahācakradvayaṃ proktaṃ sudarśanaṃ ca mālikā | mālikā bhavahantrī ca daityaghnaṃ tu sudarśanam ||8 1 || athāpi ca tṛtīyaṃ vai cakraṃ cāṃgulibhūṣaṇam | svarṇabhūṣormikācakraṃ dāne deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 2|| ūrmikāsampradātā vai samrāḍ bhavati bhūtale | sarvām̐gulīyakadātā svarge rājā bhavatyapi ||8 3 || ūrmikāṃgulīyakādipradātā viśvasṛṭ bhavet | svarṇarūpyādibhiḥ kṛtvā pūjayitvā guruṃ dvijam ||87|| sādhuṃ satīṃ mahāsādhvīṃ pativratāṃ ca sadgurum | ācāryaṃ vedavidvāṃsaṃ sādhuṃ nārāyaṇātmajam |85|| acyutagotrakaṃ vāpi namaskṛtyārpayettataḥ | ūrmikāṃṅgulīyakāni pūjayitvā sukuṃkumaiḥ ||86 || arpayeddakṣahastena cāṃguṣṭheyaṃ ca bhūṣaṇam | tatrāste sarvadā svarṇahāriṇī kamalā ramā ||87|| pūjayitvā prārthayettāmūrmikāṃgulibhūṣaṇam | saṃsārasāgarajanyormibhyo rakṣa sadā hi mām ||88|| mama haste sadā svarṇe bhavatyeva ca mokṣaṇam | dehi me bhagavannāmayute bhagavati priye ||89|| pāpapuñjāni sarvāṇi mama vināśya cormike | brahmānandormisaṃmagnaṃ kuru māṃ kṛṣṇavallabhe ||3.130.90|| ityabhyarcya ca samprārthya dadyād dāne śubhormikām | trivalīṃ pañcavalikāṃ saptavalīṃ suśobhanām ||9 1|| svarṇamātrakṛtāṃ ramyāmekāṃ vā daśa vā tathā | viṃśatiṃ vā samarthaśced dadyād dāne dvijātaye ||92|| sādhave viṣṇubhaktāya pradadyācca subhaktitaḥ | caturthaṃ valayaṃ haste kaṭakaṃ vā suvarṇajam ||93|| cakratulyaṃ ratnanaddhaṃ
