maṇihīrakaśobhitam | mauktikamāṇikyanaddhaṃ khacitaṃ kaustubhena ca ||94|| siṃhāsanaṃ pradadyācca sarvadāridryanāśakam | sarvasampatpradaṃ lakṣmīpradaṃ patnīpradaṃ tathā ||95|| svargarājyapradaṃ cāpi satyalokapradaṃ tathā | brahmalokapradaṃ cāpi bhuktimuktipradaṃ tathā ||96|| evaṃ lakṣmi pradadyāttu pādaprakoṣṭhabhūṣaṇam | kāmbikāṃ kadalīṃ cāpi śṛṃkhalā baṃgaḍīṃ tathā ||97|| svarṇarajatanirmāṇaṃ samaṇiyoktikānvitām | sarvaśobhāsyadāṃ cāpi kiṃkiṇījālaniḥsvanām ||98|| evaṃ lakṣmi tathā dadyān natthikāṃ svarṇavālikām | suvarṇavartulavālīṃ saratnāṃ śobhanāṃ diśet ||99|| etāni sarvacakrāṇi proktāni te mayā priye | dātavyāni yathāśakti dāne puṇyakarāṇi vai || 3.130.10 0|| svargadāni mahāsmṛddhipradāni mokṣadānyapi | dāridryarogavaimatyanāśakāni sukhāni ca || 10 1|| divyavaṃśapravaṃśādivistārakārakāṇi ca | divyanārīpatiputrasaubhāgyavardhakāni ca || 1 02|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇāccānumodanāt | dānānyetāni sarvāṇi bhuktimuktipradāni vai || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne viśvasudarśanamahācakradānasya mālikāmahācakradānasya vārakṣakadānasya ūrmikāṃgulīyakāṃgadakaṭakaśṛṃkhalābiṃgiḍīkaṃkaṇanatthikādimahācakradānānāṃ ca nirūpaṇanāmā triṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 130 ||
<3.131> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu śrīśivarājñīśri mahādānamanuttamam | mahākalpalatākhyaṃ ca dānaṃ suvarṇavallikam || 1 || puṇyāṃ tithiṃ samāsādya kārayenmaṇḍapaṃ śubham | vediṃ kuṇḍaṃ kārayecca sthāpayeddhavanārthakam || 2 || vastughrātaṃ brāhmaṇaiśca kārayet svastivācanam | dānavastūnyupādāya maṇḍape tatra sannyaset || 3 || ṛtvija_ sarvasaṃbhārabhūṣaṇācchādanādikam| āsaneṣu ca devānāṃ nārāyaṇasya me śriyaḥ || 4 || devīnāṃ ca tathā kuryādāvāhanaṃ prapūjayet | maṇḍape tatra sauvarṇīrdaśa kalpākhyavallikāḥ || 5 || daśottarasuvarṇotthāḥ sthāpayet phalapuṣpitāḥ | ratnāṃśukādisaṃyuktā bhūṣitāḥ śobhitāstathā || 6 || vidyādharībhiḥ saṃyuktāḥ suparṇaiḥ śobhitāstathā | prativalli prakuryācca dikpālāṣṭakayoṣitaḥ || 7 || śarkarāparvate vallī sarvāścābhyadhirohayet | aindrīṃ hastisthitāṃ śaktimāgneyīṃ meṣasaṃsthitām || 8 || yāmyāṃ mahiṣīniṣṭhāṃ ca nairṛtiṃ gardabhīsthitām | vāruṇīṃ makarasthāṃ ca vāyavīṃ hariṇīsthitām || 9 || kauberīṃ svarṇayānasthāmīśānīṃ vṛṣabhasthitām | tathā ṣoḍaśadhānyāni sthāpayet tatra maṇḍape || 3.131.10 || lakṣmīṃ śivāṃ ca sāvitrīṃ māṇikyāṃ duḥkhahātmām | kambharāśrīmahālakṣmīṃ santuṣṭā bhaginīṃ hareḥ || 11 || rasān gandhān miṣṭarasāna ghṛtakuṃbhān nyasettathā | āsahasramitasvarṇaiḥ kṛtvā nyaseddhi maṇḍape || 12|| aṣṭadhenūścāṣṭakuṃbhān ratnasalilapūritān | vastrataṇḍulapatrādyaiḥ śobhitān sthāpayedapi || 13|| pūjayettān vidhānena vallikāḥ pūjayettathā | vedaghoṣaiḥ pūjayitvā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇatrayam || 14|| prārthayettā vallikāśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇānvitāḥ | vināśinībhyaḥ pāpānāṃ pālinībhyaḥ svasañjuṣām || 15|| namo’stu phaladābhyaśca kalpābhyo vai namo namaḥ | sarvasampatpradābhyaśca sarvarddhibhyo namo namaḥ || 16|| mahālakṣmīsvarūpābhyaḥ sarvātmikābhyo vai namaḥ | svargāmṛtaṃ śrīpuraṃ ca vairājaṃ ca gavāyanam || 17 || vaikuṇṭhaṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāma vitarantu ca naḥ sadā | bhavatyo dānarūpāśca dattā rakṣantu naḥ sadā || 18|| iti prārthya punaḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ samarpayet | gurave sādhave cārdhamardhāścānyebhya eva tu || 19|| ratnahīrakarūpyāṇi gā vastrāṇi ca yāni ca | taddhi dadyād bhikṣukebhyo’nāthahīnebhya ityapi ||3.131.20 || havanaṃ vidhivat kuryād bhojayet sādhubhūsurān | bālośca bālikāścāpi bhojayeccārpayeddhanam ||21 || parihāraṃ tataḥ kuryād visṛjetpraṇamet priye | evaṃ kalpalatādānaṃ kuryāttasya phalaṃ bahu || 22|| sāmrājyaṃ jāyate pitruddhāro bhavatyapi | kṣitiḥ sasyādisampūrṇā sadā tasyopatiṣṭhate ||23 || siddhayaścāṇimādyāśca latādāturbhavanti hi | svarge kalpalatāstāścāpsaraso’sya bhavanti ca ||24|| evaṃ lakṣmi mahādānaṃ saṃkalpapūrakaṃ hi te | kathitaṃ sarvalokeṣu mahārājyapradaṃ śubham ||25|| tathā kalpapriyādānaṃ kartavyaṃ śṛṇu tadvidhim | svarṇabhārasahasraistu kartavyā puttalī śubhā ||26|| vastrālaṃkārasaṃyuktā sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhitā | rūpavatī yuvatī ca putraputryādiśobhitā ||27|| gomahiṣīgajavājiyuktā śayyādiśobhitā | dhanadhānyādiyuktā ca rasabhojyaphalānvitā ||28|| maṇḍape nyasya tāṃ patnīrūpāṃ tatra mahāramām | āvāhayed vedikāgre pūjayet sarvavastubhiḥ ||29|| ārārtrikaṃ prakuryācca sunaivedyaṃ jalaṃ diśet | yādṛśī ceṣyate patnī yathāsāmagrikānvitā ||3.131.3 0|| tādṛśī sā tu kartavyā śṛṃgāradravyaśobhitā | dāsadāsīsakhīyuktā gṛhasaubhāgyaśobhitā ||3 1 || tāṃ prapūjya ca havanaṃ kuryād vahnau śatottaram | dadyāt sā svakare dhṛtvā kṛtvānalaṃ pradakṣiṇam ||32|| gurave cāpi viprāya sādhave haraye’thavā | kumārāya sate vāpi prārthayecca tataḥ param ||33|| eṣā dattā mayā patnīrūpā dāne dvijātaye | sarvagārhasthyopakaraṇādiyuktā vibhūṣitā ||34|| nārāyaṇī mahālakṣmīstvameva parameśvarī | dānaphalaṃ ca dāmpatyaṃ mama dehi sadā rame ||35|| svarge satye ca vairāje vaikuṇṭhe patnikā mama | saṃyuktā sahagā syācca tathā dehi phalaṃ mama ||36|| evamābhāṣya viprasya gurorhaste nyaset priyām | bhuktidā muktidā sā syāt svarṇaputtalikā priyā ||37|| janmāntarasahasreṣu dāmpatyaṃ syādakhaṇḍitam | sarvasmṛddhipradaṃ lakṣmi śāśvatānandadāyakam ||38|| sarvabhogapradaṃ putrapautravaṃśavivardhanam | kalpapatnīmahādānamidaṃ proktaṃ mayā tava ||39|| yathāsaṃkhyā yoṣitaśceṣyante divi kṣitau ca vā | tathāsaṃkhyāḥ pradātavyāḥ puttalyaḥ patnikā nijāḥ ||3.131.40|| maṇḍape tā nidhāyaiva vahneḥ samīpataḥ khalu | vivāhavidhinā sarvā vivāhayed dvijaiḥ purā ||41 || varamālābhisannaddhā hastakṛtaparigrahāḥ | sarvābharaṇaśobhāśca sarvālaṃkārasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||42|| nijapatnīkṛtāḥ sarvāstato dāne’rpayed budhaḥ | evaṃ dattā hi vidhinā ceha paratra tāḥ striyaḥ ||43|| bhavantyeva na sandeho mahādānamidaṃ param | svarṇastrīdānamevaitat svastrīpratinidhiprakham ||44|| nārī dāne na vai deyā deyā sauvarṇaputtalī | nārīdānaṃ mahādānaṃ tadevoktaṃ hi vedhasā ||45|| evaṃ lakṣmi suvarṇasya patiṃ dāne’pi cārpayet | sarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ sarvasmṛddhisuśobhitam ||46|| svarṇakāntamahādānaṃ patisaubhāgyadaṃ hi tat | vidhiṃ te kathayāmyatra yatkṛtena kadāpi vai ||47|| vaidhavyaṃ jāyate naiva patisaubhāgyameti sā | suvarṇaputtalaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍape tatra pūjayet ||48|| āvāhayettatra nārāyaṇaṃ śrīpatimīśvaram | sthāpayenmaṇḍape cāpi vivāhavidhinā tataḥ ||49|| taṃ strī pariṇayenmatvā patiṃ naijaṃ tu kānakam | varamālāyutā hastagrāhottaraṃ patiprakham ||3.131.50 || pradakṣiṇakṛtasvātmapatiṃ dāne’rpayettataḥ | anyānyapi samastāni vastūnyapi tadārpayet ||51 || yādṛśaḥ svapatiśceṣṭo janmajanmāntare’pi ca | tādṛśaḥ sarvasampanno dātavyo viprayoṣite ||52|| etaddānaṃ mahādānaṃ patidānaṃ prakīrtitam | sarvasaubhāgyadaṃ nityagārhasthyasampradaṃ śubham ||5 3 || svargamokṣapradaṃ cāpi śāśvatānandasampradam | putradānaṃ bhrātṛdānaṃ svarṇaputtalikodbhavam ||54|| evameva vidhātavyaṃ cāvāhya māṃ pareśvaram | vidhivad dīyamānaṃ tat putrarūpaṃ phalatyapi ||55|| bhrātṛrūpaṃ phalatyeva yad dattaṃ tatprajāyate | harermūrteḥ pradānena harirmilati mādhavaḥ ||56|| kāntadānapradānena kṛṣṇaḥ kānto bhavatyapi | evametāni dānāni deyāni vidhinā tataḥ ||57|| dāsīdāsapradānena dāsīdāsā milanti ca | nādattaṃ prāpyate kiñcit tasmād deyaṃ hi bhūtale ||58|| atra vāpi paratrāpi dattamatropatiṣṭhate | sukhadaḥ sukhavān syācca duḥkhado duḥkhavān bhavet ||59|| puṇyadānaṃ pradātavyaṃ jalaṃ muktvā kuṭumbine | rogiṇe ca daridrāya paralokavidāyine ||3.131.60|| maraṇonmukhajīvāya puṇyaṃ deyaṃ vratādijam | evamanyāni puṇyāni yāni tapomayāni tu ||6 1 || makhātmakāni puṇyāni mahotsavodbhavānyapi | pārāyaṇādipuṇyāni japapuṇyāni yāni ca ||62|| dānapuṇyāni sarvāṇi satraprapodbhavāni ca | devapūjotthapuṇyāni gurusevodbhavāni ca ||63|| dāne deyāni vidhinā patisevodbhavāni ca | pātivratyādidharmāśca deyā dāne sukhapradāḥ ||64|| patnīvratādidharmāśca sādhudharmāḥ sukhāvahāḥ | paropakāradharmāśca deyā dāne vidhānataḥ ||65|| vidyāpuṇyaṃ khātapuṇyaṃ ceṣṭāpūrtādipuṇyakam | oṣadhādyupakārotthaṃ dāne puṇyaṃ sukhapradam ||66|| śaraṇyapuṇyaṃ satyotthaṃ tathā dayodbhava śubham | ahiṃsotthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ dāne deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||67|| kaṇṭhadānodbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ kaṭidānodbhavaṃ tathā | hārdadānodbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ dāne deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||68|| śaraṇāgatarakṣotthaṃ nirāśritāśrayodbhavam | jīvadānamahāpuṇyaṃ deyaṃ dāne viśeṣataḥ ||69|| sarvadānamahādānaṃ brahmadānaṃ parātparam | jñānadānaṃ harerdānaṃ mokṣadānaṃ tato’dhikam ||3.131.70 || abhayasya pradānaṃ vai sarvadānottamottamam | pradeyaṃ sarvatobhāvairyasmātparaṃ na vidyate ||71|| candrasūryapradānaṃ vai netrayostejasā pradam | vijñānasya pradānaṃ vai hṛdayasya prabhāpradam ||72|| muktidānaṃ cātmanastu śāśvatānandadāyakam | abhītidānamevaitad deyaṃ muktimabhīpsatā ||73|| dehadānaṃ prakartavyaṃ śubhadehādilabdhaye | gehadānaṃ prakartavyaṃ bhavanādisulabdhaye ||74|| ghṛtadānaṃ prakartavyaṃ dehapuṣṭisulabdhaye | bījadānaṃ prakartavyaṃ dharmavaśādivṛddhaye ||75 || jaladānaṃ prakartavyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ svasya tṛptaye | gurudānaṃ vidhātavyaṃ gurormūrtiṃ tu kānakīm ||76|| vidhāpya vidhinābhyarcya śṛṃgārasahitāṃ ca tām | gurumāvāhya samprārthya svātmatāraṇahetave ||77|| pradadyāttāṃ dhārmikāya sādhave pūjakāya ca | yasyāḥ pūjāṃ nityameva kartuṃ yaḥ śakta eva ha ||78|| tasmai deyā gurormūrtiḥ pūjāphalaṃ hi labhyate | apūjyāyāḥ pratyavāyabhāgitā syāt pradātari ||79|| devānāṃ mūrtayaścāpi svarṇarājatasaṃbhavāḥ | maṇiratnādijanyā vā tarucitrādinirmitāḥ ||3.131.80|| pradātavyā vidhinaiva pratiṣṭhāpūrvikā hi tāḥ | sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyāḥ sarvaveṣopasaṃyutāḥ ||81 || sarvaśṛṃgārasahitāḥ saumyā rūpābhirūpikāḥ | pradātavyāḥ pātrayutā gandhārhaṇopavastubhiḥ ||82|| sahitā hārahārālībhūṣotsavārhahetibhiḥ | gaṇeśasya hanūmato viṣṇoḥ śaṃbhoḥ ravestathā ||83|| vāstośca lokapālānāṃ gaṇānāṃ svāmināṃ tathā | pārṣadānāṃ satāṃ deyāḥ pratimāḥ śobhanāḥ śubhāḥ ||84|| sarvābharaṇayuktāśca sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhanāḥ | yogyaveṣābhisampannā yogyāyudhasamanvitāḥ ||85|| yogyavāhanayuktāśca yogyabhṛtyasamanvitāḥ | nijaśaktiyutāścāpi dāne deyāḥ sukhapradāḥ ||86|| mahānārāyaṇī brāhmī mahālakṣmīḥ ramāmṛtā | kamalā śrīḥ prabhā deyā kānakī māṇikī tathā ||87|| sauvarṇā kaṃbharālakṣmīrlalitāśrīḥ śubhānanā | gajānanā mahālakṣmīrdeyā śobhābhiśobhitā ||88|| gaṃgā durgā pāśavatī satī kanyākumārikā | santuṣā jānakī deyā ramā jayā ca padminī ||89|| sāvitrī vijayā deyā duḥkhahā vedamātṛkā | saṃjñā svāhā vahniyuktā caṇḍī deyā vibhūṣitā ||3.131.90|| kātyāyanī mahākālī deyā tadveśaśobhitā | gaurī deyā ca tulasī vṛndā vivāhaśobhitā ||91 || evamādyāḥ surāṇyaśca tatheśānyaśca mātaraḥ | yoginyaścāpi muktānyo deyā dāne janārdane ||92|| pūjārthaṃ sādhave deyā bhaktāya ca dvijātaye | mahotsāhena deyāstā mūrtayaḥ supratiṣṭhitāḥ ||93|| veṣālaṃkāranaivedyapātrāmbarādiśobhitāḥ | tāsāṃ nivāsayogyāni deyāni mandirāṇyapi ||94|| udyānāśca mahāsmṛddhāḥ phalamālyamadhubhṛtāḥ | vāṭikā sasyayuktāśca kṣetrāṇi cekṣuvanti hi ||95|| śākapatrādiyuktāni deyāni vividhāni ca | araṇyāni pradeyāni kūpā vāpyaḥ sarāṃsi ca || 96|| upabhogyāni sarvāṇi gandharasādanāni ca | dhānyāni dhanakośāśca deyā dāsāśca dāsikāḥ ||97|| yad dīyate labhyate tannādattaṃ labhyate kvacit | tasmād deyāḥ pratimāśca kṛtvāpi dāradāsikāḥ ||98|| evaṃ datvā labhetāpi paraṃ saukhyaṃ gṛhāśrame | iha loke sukhī bhūtvā sāmrājyaṃ vindate punaḥ ||99|| svarge satye ca vairājye vaikuṇṭhe śrīpure’kṣare | goloke jāyate dhāmeśvaranārāyaṇaprabhaḥ || 3.131.100 || sarvavilāsasampannaḥ sarvabhogābhibhogavān | sarvānandamahānandapluto bhavati śāśvataḥ || 101 || paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccānumodanāt | dāne praperaṇāccāpi tulyapuṇyāśrayo bhavet| || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mahākalpalatāsuvarṇavallīdānasya kalpapriyādānasya svarṇakāntadānasya puṇyadānasyābhayādidānānāṃ gurudevadevīmahādānānāṃ mandirakṣetravāṭyalaṃkārādimahādānānāṃ ca vidhinirūpaṇanāmaikatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 131 ||
<3.132> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ saptasāgaradānakam | mahādānamidaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ svargadhāmadam || 1 || pavitraṃ dinamāsādya kārayenmaṇḍapaṃ śubham | vedīṃ ca kārayed ramyāṃ dānavastūni cāharet || 2 || svastiśabdān puṇyadinaṃ vācayed vedakovidaiḥ | āsaneṣu maṇḍape cāvāhayellokapālakān || 2 || parameśaṃ hariṃ māṃ ca śrīramāmudadheḥ sutām | saptakuṇḍāni ramyāṇi kārayenmaṇḍape khalu || 4 || kāñcanāni saptapalādūrdhvāṇi śobhanāni ca | āsahasrapalātmāni sthālītulyāni tatra ca || 5 || prathamaṃ pūrayet kuṇḍaṃ lavaṇena tu kāṃcanam | dvitīyaṃ payasā tadvat tṛtīyaṃ tu ghṛtena vai || 6 || caturthaṃ tu guḍenaiva dadhnā tu paṃcamaṃ tathā | ṣaṣṭhaṃ śarkarayā cāpi saptamaṃ miṣṭavāribhiḥ || 7 || ete saptasamudrā vai pūjanīyā viśeṣataḥ | brahmāṇaṃ kāñcanaṃ cādye samudre sthāpayecchubham || 8 || dvitīye keśavaṃ māṃ ca tṛtīye tu haraṃ tathā | caturthe bhāskaraṃ cāpi pañcame candramityapi || 9 || ṣaṣṭhe lakṣmīṃ mama patnīṃ saptame pārvatīṃ satīm | sthāpayed dāsadāṃsīśca ratnahīrakamauktikān || 3.132.1 0|| sarvadhānyānyuttamāni dānavastūni yāni ca | homaṃ vāruṇamantraiśca kṛtvā sampūjayet surān || 1 1|| triḥpradakṣiṇamāvṛtya prārthayenmāṃ sasāgaram | sarvarasān samutpādya bhavantaḥ sāgarāḥ sadā || 12|| sarvasṛṣṭiṃ sukhayanti tathā kuruta māṃ sukham | bhavatāṃ vāribhiḥ sarvapāpāni yānti saṃkṣayam || 13 || sampadaśca pravardhante mamāpi kuruta śriyam | dattā dāne bhavantaśca vardhayantu mama śriyam || 14|| mama kośāḥ svarṇarūpyamayāḥ syuḥ sāgarā iva | mama saukhyaṃ cākṣayaṃ ca bhavatvatra paratra ca || 15|| bhavanto’trārpitāḥ santu madarthaṃ divyadehinaḥ | bhuktimuktipradāḥ sarve mahāsāmrājyadāyinaḥ || 16|| svargasatyapradāścānte bhaumavairājalokadāḥ | śrīpurāmṛtadhāmāvyākṛtadāścākṣarapradāḥ || 17|| rādhāputrā bhavanto vai golokaṃ no dadatvapi | ānandānāṃ sāgarāṃśca dadatveva ca me sadā || 18|| pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaścāpi bhavantūddhārakāriṇaḥ | sarvavaṃśapravaṃśānāṃ bhavantu sukhadāyinaḥ || 19|| ityabhyarthya pradeyāste kāñcanāḥ saptasāgarāḥ | gurave sādhave cāpi haraye svāmine tathā | |3.132.20|| dīnāndhakṛpaṇebhyastu deyāni vividhāni ca | annaratnāmbarapātradhanāni ca yathāyatham ||21 || bhojayed viprasādhūm̐śca satīḥ sādhvīśca yoṣitaḥ | bālāṃśca bālikāścāpi dadyād dānāni sarvaśaḥ ||22|| ityevaṃ dānakṛllakṣmi yāti vairājadhāma ha | śrīpuraṃ cāmṛtaṃ dhāma golokaṃ cākṣaraṃ tataḥ ||23|| brahmalokaṃ paraṃ lokaṃ prayati śāśvataṃ padam | svarṇavarṇavimānena cāpsarobhiḥ prasevitaḥ ||24||| pārṣadairmānito yāti padaṃ me śāśvataṃ priyam | tatrānandamahābdhau ca modate sumahīyate ||25|| śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā cānyanmahādānamanuttamam | ratnadhenvātmakaṃ dhenulokapradaṃ sukhapradam ||26|| pavitradinamāsādya maṇḍapaṃ kārayecchubham | vedīṃ kuṇḍaṃ kārayecca ratnāni sannyasettathā ||27|| dānavastūni sarvāṇi tathā ratnāni sannyaset | gopradānārthayogyāni kṛṣṇājine nyased budhaḥ ||28|| lavaṇe droṇapuñje ca mṛgacarmaṇi vai tadā | ratnadhenuṃ sthāpayecca savatsāṃ cāpyalaṃkṛtām ||29|| rājā kuryānmahatīṃ vai dhenuṃ sarvārthakāmadām | sthāpayet padmarāgāṇāmekāśītiṃ mukhe tu goḥ ||3.132.30|| puṣparāgaśataṃ cāpi ghoṇāyāṃ parikalpayet| lalāṭe hematilakaṃ muktāphalaśataṃ dṛśoḥ ||3 1 || bhrudvaye vidrumaśata śuktī ca karṇayostathā | kānakāni tu śṛṃgāṇi śiro vajramaṇikṛtam ||32|| grīvāyāṃ paṭakaṃ cāpi gomedādiśatodbhavam | indranīlaśataṃ pṛṣṭhe pārśve vaidūryaśobhite ||33|| sphāṭikairudaraṃ cāpi saugandhiśatakaiḥ kaṭim | khurān rājatarūpām̐śca pucchaṃ muktāvalīkṛtam ||34|| sūryakāntendukāntau ca ghrāṇe karpūracandane | kauṃkumāni ca romāṇi raupyanābhiṃ ca kārayet ||35|| gārutmataśataṃ pucchamūle staneṣu sanmaṇīn | tathānyānyapi ratnāni yathāśakti prakalpayet ||36|| jihvāṃ ca śarkarārūpāṃ guḍaṃ gomayarūpiṇam | ghṛtaṃ mūtrasvarūpaṃ ca dadhidugdhe svarūpataḥ ||37|| pucchāgre cāmaraṃ cāpi tāmradohaṃ samīpataḥ | kuṇḍalāni ca haimāni bhūṣaṇāni yathādhanam ||38|| ghāsagrāsān dhānyakām̐śca rakṣayettatra sannidhau | caturthāṃśena vatsīṃ ca sarvadhānyāni sannyaset ||39|| ikṣupādān kārayecca pañcavarṇāṃ tu jhullarīm | nānāphalāni ramyāṇi maṇḍape sannyasettathā ||3.132.40|| homaṃ kṛtvānale devāvāhanaṃ kārayettathā | pūjayed vidhinā māṃ ca devān dhenuṃ pradakṣiṇam ||41 || kṛtvārthayed dānakartā natvā viprān hariṃ ca gām | tvaṃ devi sarvadevānāṃ vāsarūpāsi tāriṇī ||42 || kāmadhenusamastānāṃ pratimāyai ca te namaḥ | sarvakāmaprade mātargolokavāsini priye ||43|| pāpahe puṇyade mokṣaprade mātaśca te namaḥ | māmasmātsāgarāllakṣmīrūpe tāraya sarvathā ||44|| sarvasampatprade kṛṣṇapriye tāraya sāgarāt | svargaṃ dehi ca vairājaṃ śrīpuraṃ cāmṛtaṃ tathā ||45|| golokaṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāma pradehi kamale hi me | iti samprārthya dātavyā gurave sādhave hi sā ||46|| viprāya yogyapātrāya dātavyā vaiṣṇavāya ca | anyaratnāni dhānyāni deyavastūni yāni ca ||47|| tāni sarvāṇi deyāni bhikṣukebhyo’tibhāvataḥ | bhojanīyāḥ sādhavaśca viprāśca bālabālikāḥ ||48|| evaṃ dānapradānā syāt svargabhāk mokṣabhāk tathā | bhuktimuktimahāmuktisampanno jāyate sadā ||49|| pitṛṇāṃ tārakaścāpi kuṭumbināṃ ca tārakaḥ | sarvapuṇyasupātraṃ vai brahmānandamayo bhavet ||3.132.50|| athānyatte pravakṣyāmi mahādānaṃ tathā rame | mahābhūtakalaśākhyaṃ paraṃ sarvārthasādhakam ||591|| pavitratithimāsādya kṛtvā maṇḍapamuttamam | svastivācaśca puṇyāhavācanaṃ kārayettataḥ ||52|| kuṇḍasya sannidhāvājyavrīhyādīn samupanyaset | dānasambhārabhūṣādyācchādanānnaphalādikam ||53 || saṃsthāpya lokapālānāṃ mamāvāhanamācaret | pūjayed vidhinā sarvān svarṇaghaṭaṃ ca vinyaset ||54|| mahāratnādisaṃyuktaṃ pañcapallavaśobhitam | prādeśādaṅgulaśatapramāṇamānaśobhitam ||55|| kṣīrājyapūritaṃ kalpāmbarapuṣpādisaṃyutam | sthāpayet pūjayeccāpi tatra tīrthāni cāharet| ||56|| pṛthvīṃ vārāhasahitāṃ kamalādyairalaṃkṛtām | sthāpayenmaṇḍape tatra vināyakaṃ prapūjayet ||57|| indramagniṃ yamaṃ rakṣo varuṇaṃ cānilaṃ tathā | kuberaṃ ca maheśānaṃ pūjayeddhānyapuñjake ||58|| akṣasūtrayutaṃ tatra ṛgvedaṃ pūjayet tathā | padmayuktaṃ yajurvedaṃ sāmavedaṃ viṇāyutam ||59|| atharvāṇaṃ sruksruvāḍhyaṃ padmāḍhyaṃ pūjayettathā | brahmāṇaṃ rudramevāpi viṣṇuṃ sampūjayettataḥ ||3.132.6 0|| māṇikyāsahitaṃ māṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | pūjayed bhaktibhāvena tataścārātrikaṃ caret ||61 || sarvadhānyāni bhūṣāśca ratnāni vividhāni ca | upānatpādukāchatracāmarāsanadarpaṇam ||62|| śayyāṃ kuṃbhān dīpikāṃ ca dravyāṇi vividhāni ca | dānārthakāni sarvāṇi kṛtvā māṃ triḥpradakṣiṇam ||6 3|| dadyād dāne tu vidhinā prārthayet kalaśaṃ tadā | namo brahmāṇḍarūpāya kṛṣṇavāsāya vedhase ||64|| rudrarūpāya śāntāya viṣṇave kalaśāya te | namaḥ sarvādhivāsāya mokṣadāya namo namaḥ ||65|| namo’mṛtādhivāsāya suvarṇasvargadāya ca | śrīpurākṣaradātre te svarṇakalaśa te namaḥ ||66|| sarvadevanivāso’si sarvadevīsamāśritaḥ | sarvarddhibhūtisampadbhiryukto’sya te namo namaḥ ||67|| pañcabhūtātmarūpo’si dadāmi dānarūpiṇam | sāmrājyaṃ me pradehyatra paratra mokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ||68|| iti prārthya ca gurave sādhave yogine tathā | haraye me pradātavyo ghaṭaḥ svarṇamayaḥ śubhaḥ ||69|| anyāni sarvadānādi deyāni ca yathocitam | bhojanāni pradeyāni sarvebhyo maṇḍapāntike ||3.132.70|| mahotsavaṃ prakuryād ya evaṃ ghaṭārpaṇātmakam | tasya rājyaṃ mahārājyaṃ bhuvi svarge bhaved dhruvam ||71|| satye vairājake loke vaiṣṇave śrīpure’mṛte | vaikuṇṭhe’vyākṛte dhāmni goloke cākṣare’pi ca ||72|| mahāmuktiṃ prapadyeta bhogān bhuktvottamottarān | pitṝn sarvān mocayecca bhavet vimānagaḥ sadā ||73|| svalpasyāpi kalaśasya dānaṃ kuryād yathādhanam | mahāghaṭasya haṇḍasya droṇyā golyāḥ samarpaṇam ||74|| kusulāyāḥ pradānaṃ ca kośasyāpi pradānakam | kuryāttena bhaved bhuktirmuktiścāpi sukhapradā ||75|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇāccānumodanāt | ghaṭadānaphalaṃ syādvai sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||76|| athānyatte pravakṣyāmi dānaṃ lakṣmi nibodha me | lakṣmīdānaṃ mahādānaṃ kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ||77|| maṇḍapaṃ kārayecchreṣṭhaṃ maṇiratnādibhūṣitam | sarvapallavakadalīstambhatoraṇaśobhitam ||78|| citrāmbarādarśayuktaṃ svarṇakalaśaśobhitam | sadhvajaṃ vedikāyuktaṃ kuṇḍāsanavirājitam ||79|| dhānyabhūṣāmbararatnamaṇimāṇikyarājitam | deyavastūpasampannaṃ ṛtvigādikṛtasthalam ||3.132.80 || jalakuṃbhayutaṃ pūtrāyogyasāmagrikānvitam | tatra madhye suvarṇasyāsane lakṣmīṃ mahāsatīm ||81 || kānakīṃ sthāpayed ramyāṃ yathādhanaṃ vinirmitām | sarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktāṃ sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhitām ||82|| sarvabhūṣāmbarayuktāṃ nārāyaṇasamanvitām | svarṇanārāyaṇamūrtiṃ caturbhujāṃ sabhūṣaṇām ||83|| varayogyāṃ sthāpayecca svastivācanamācaret | nārāyaṇaṃ tathā lakṣmīṃ pūjayecca vidhānataḥ ||84|| snānādyārabhya kuryādvai puṣpāñjalyantamarhaṇam | vivāhavidhinā sarvaṃ vidhiṃ kuryād yathocitam ||85|| varamālāṃ hareḥ kaṇṭhe nidhāpayecchriyāḥ karaiḥ | naivedyaṃ ca jalaṃ tāmbūlakamārārtrikaṃ caret ||86|| kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ juhuyādghṛtādisupāyasam | tato dānaṃ mahālakṣmyā dadyānnārāyaṇāya vai ||87|| prārthayed vidhinā lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ prabhum | yuvāṃ mātāpitarau sthaḥ, rakṣakau pālakau prabhū ||88|| lakṣmīdānena bhagavan mama sampad vivardhatām | pāpānāṃ sarvabhāgānāṃ layo bhavatu vai dhruvam ||89|| mahārājyaṃ ca vairājyaṃ padaṃ me’stu tavārpaṇāt | pitṝṇāṃ mama mokṣo’stu vaṃśavṛddhistathāstu me ||3.132.90|| vaikuṇṭhadhāmalābho me tato me’stvākṣaraṃ padam | sarvavidhāḥ śriyaḥ santu madgṛhe te kṛpāvaśāt ||91 || iti samprārthya dātavyā lakṣmīrnārāyaṇāya vai | lakṣmīnārāyaṇamūrtistato deyā sate’rthine ||92|| gurave sādhave deyā mandirāya śubhārthine | anyaratnādikaṃ sarvaṃ dātavyaṃ bhikṣuvargiṇe ||93|| sādhūn viprān bhojayecca bālān dīnān subālikāḥ | anāthāndhān dvijān bhaktān yogino bhojayed vadhūḥ ||94|| annadānādikaṃ kuryād vastradānādikaṃ api | dhanadānādikaṃ kuryād yathāśraddhaṃ yathādhanam ||95|| evaṃ lakṣmīpradānena lakṣmīdānaphalaṃ bhavet | kanyādānaphalaṃ cāpi patnīdānaphalaṃ vrajet ||96|| vratayajñaphalaṃ cāpi satreṣṭāpūrtijaṃ phalam | sarvadānaphalaṃ cāpi cāturmāsyaphalaṃ vrajet ||97|| sāmrājyaṃ ceha loke’pi bhuktvā lakṣmīprasādataḥ | svargarājyaṃ satyarājyaṃ vairājaṃ padamāpnuyāt ||98|| tataḥ śrīpurarājyaṃ ca bhuktvā golokamāpnuyāt | vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca paraṃ bhuktvā tato yātyakṣaraṃ padam ||99|| brahmānandahrade magno brahmaloke mahīyate | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ yatheṣṭāṃ vai labhate dānakṛttathā || 3.132.10 0|| evamuktāni te lakṣmi mahādānāni yāni vai | tathānyāni bhavantyatra dānāni vividhānyapi || 101 || sūryadānaṃ candradānaṃ mahendradānamityapi | brahmadānaṃ viṣṇudānaṃ śaṃbhudānaṃ tathā param || 1 02|| kuberadānamevāpi yamadānaṃ śubhāspadam | prāṇadānaṃ cendriyādidānaṃ svarṇapratikṛtim || 10 3|| dadyāt tatraiva sarvatra yantradānaṃ yathocitam | ākṣarabrahmadānaṃ ca golokadānamityapi || 1 04|| vaikuṇṭhadānamevāpi śrīpurasyārpaṇaṃ tathā | evamanyāni dānāni yāni sveṣṭāni santi ca || 1 05|| tāni dadyāt samagrāṇi labdhyarthaṃ vai bhavāntare | mokṣārthaṃ vā pradadyācca bhaktidānaṃ mahottamam || 1 06|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccānumodanāt | dānapuṇyaṃ bhavet sarvaṃ yathāśraddhaṃ yathāśuci || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne saptasāgaramahādānasya ratnadhenumahādānasya mahābhūtakalaśadānasya lakṣmīmahādānasya tathānyamahādānānāṃ vidhinirūpaṇanāmā dvātriṃśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 132 ||
<3.133> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca kṛṣṇakānta mama kānta śrutaṃ dānamahatphalam | puṇye dine pradātavyaṃ yaduktaṃ bhavatā prabho || 1 || puṇyāśca divasāḥ sarve jñātāstvayoditā mayā | teṣu puṇyatamaṃ cāharjñātumicchāmi tadvada || 2 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya yatra bhūtale | prākaṭyaṃ me dine jātaṃ dinaṃ puṇyatamaṃ hi tat || 3 || ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamī saiṣā sarvottamā pradānake | dāturjanmadinaṃ cāpi śreṣṭhaṃ dātuḥ kṛte matam || 4 || kalpanāmnā ca divasāḥ śreṣṭhatamā bhavantyapi | brahmaṇo māsadivasāḥ śreṣṭhā bhavanti dānake || 5 || māsāhatriṃśannāmāni kathayāmi nibodha me | yeṣāṃ tu kīrtanādeva vedapuṇyena yujyate || 6 || pratipat śvetakalpastu dvitīyo nīlalohitaḥ | tṛtīyo vāmadevastu turyo rāthantarābhidhaḥ || 7 || pañcamo rauravākhyaśca ṣaṣṭho devadinābhidhaḥ | saptamo bṛhadākhyaścāṣṭamaḥ kandarpanāmakaḥ || 8 || navamaḥ sadyanāmā ceśānastu daśamo mataḥ | ekadaśastamonāmā sārasvato dvayaṃdaśa || 9 || trayodaśa udānākhyo gāruḍastu caturdaśaḥ | pañcadaśastu kaumāryaḥ ṣoḍaśo nārasiṃhakaḥ || 3.133.10 || saptadaśaḥ samānākhyaścāgneyo’ṣṭādaśātmakaḥ | ekonaviṃśaḥ somākhyo viṃśatirmānavo mataḥ || 1 1|| tatpumānekaviṃśaśca divaso brahmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | vaikuṇṭho dvāviṃśakaśca lakṣmīstriviṃśakastathā || 1 2|| caturviśastu sāvitrī pañcaviṃśastvaghorakaḥ | vārāhaḥ ṣaḍviṃśakaśca vairājaḥ saptaviṃśakaḥ || 13 || aṣṭāviṃśastu gaurīti navaviṃśo maheśvaraḥ | triṃśastu pitṛkalpo vai yā kuhūrbrahmaṇo matā || 14|| eteṣu yāni bhagavaddināni śrīdināni ca | śivādināmatithayaḥ puṇyāstā dānakariṇaḥ || 15|| harerjanmadinānyeva hariṇījanmarāśayaḥ | puṇyāḥ santi vratāhāśca dānayogyāḥ sadā rame || 16|| nahi kartuṃ samarthā vai sarve kṣudrahṛdo janāḥ | kurvantyudāramanaso dānānyuktāni yāni ha || 17|| yadā yasya bhaved buddhirdānadharmaparāyaṇā | tadā tasmin dine kāryaṃ dānaṃ dātrā tu satvaram || 18|| gatā śraddhā gataḥ kālo gata utsāha ityapi | gataṃ pātraṃ gataṃ vastu punarnāyāsyati kvacit || 19|| gatvarāḥ sampadaḥ sarvā gatvaraṃ jīvanaṃ tathā | gatvarāścāpi saṃkalpāstān satkārye niyojayet ||3.133.20|| nārāyaṇaṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ māmakṣarapatiṃ prabhum | avatārānīśvarām̐śca surānṛṣīn sutoṣayet |||2 1 || grahān santoṣayed dānairlakṣmi mama svarūpiṇaḥ | sarvakāmāptaye nityaṃ grahaṃ śāntaṃ vidhāpayet ||22|| śrīkāmaḥ śāntikāmo vā grahayajñaṃ samācaret | nijāyuḥpuṣṭikāmo vā vaṃśecchuḥ sukhabhāvanaḥ ||23|| puṇye’hni viprakathite kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam | grahān grahādidevām̐śca saṃsthāpya homamācaret ||24|| grahayajño’yutahomo lakṣahomastathā mataḥ | koṭihomastathā cāpi yathākāryabalānukṛt ||25|| ayutenāhutīnāṃ tu navagrahamakho mataḥ | gartasyottarapūrveṇa vitastidvayavistṛtām || 26|| vipradvayāvṛtāṃ vediṃ vitasyucchrayaśobhanām | caturasrāmudaṅmukhāṃ kṛtvāgninayanaṃ tataḥ ||27|| āvāhayet surām̐stasyāṃ sūryaṃ somaṃ ca maṃgalam | budhaṃ guruṃ kaviṃ śanaiścaraṃ rāhuṃ ca ketukam ||28|| madhye sūryaṃ dakṣiṇe maṃgalaṃ guruṃ tathottare | budhaṃ pūrvottare śukraṃ pūrve saṃsthāpayettathā || 29|| dakṣapūrve candramasaṃ śaniṃ tu paścime tathā | rāhuṃ tu dakṣapaśce tu ketuṃ paścottare tathā ||3.133.3 0|| taṇḍuleṣu sthāpayedvā tathopadevatāḥ śubhāḥ | sūryasyeśaṃ śaśinaśca pārvatīṃ copadevatām ||3 1|| skandaṃ bhaumasya ca hariṃ budhasyāpyupadevatām | brahmāṇaṃ ca gurorindraṃ śukrasyāpyupadevatām ||32|| yamaṃ śanestathā rāhoḥ kālaṃ tathopadevatām | citraguptaṃ ca ketorvai sthāpayedupadevatām ||33|| atha pratyupadevām̐śca sthāpayettatra tatra ca | kramādagniṃ jalaṃ pṛthvīṃ viṣṇumindraṃ śacīṃ tathā ||34|| prajāpatiṃ bhoginaśca brahmāṇaṃ sthāpayecca tān | vināyakaṃ ca durgāṃ ca vāyumākāśamityapi ||35|| āvāhayed vyāhṛtibhistathaivāśvikumārakau | dhyāyedraviṃ raktavarṇaṃ maṃgalaṃ raktamityapi ||36|| somaśukrau śvetavarṇau budhagurū tu piṃgalau | śanirāhū kṛṣṇavarṇau dhūmraṃ ketuṃ smarettadā ||37|| grahavarṇāni deyāni puṣṇāṇi cāmbarāṇi ca | surabhirdhūpa evātra vitānakaṃ tathopari ||38|| phalapuṣpādi pūjārhaṃ sarvaṃ dadyāt samarhaṇe | guḍaudanaṃ tu sūryāya somāya ghṛtapāyasam ||39|| maṃgalāya tu saṃyāvaṃ budhāya kṣīrakullarīm | dadhyodanaṃ tu gurave śukrāya tu guḍaudanam ||3.133.40|| śanaiścarāya kṛśarāṃ māṣām̐stu rāhave tathā | citraudanaṃ tu ketubhyastataḥ samarcayet surān ||41 || prāguttareṇa kalaśaṃ dadhyakṣatasamanvitam | cūtapallavasaṃyuktaṃ phalavastrayugānvitam ||42|| pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ sthāpayed varuṇaṃ nyaset | tīrthāni ca samudrām̐ścāvāhayet tatra vai jale ||43|| gajāśvarathyāvalmīkacatvarahradagokulāt | mṛdamānīya ca sarvauṣadhivārisamanvitām ||44|| snānārthaṃ vinyaset tatra yajamānasya bhūsuraḥ | homaṃ samācaret sarpiryavavrīhitilādibhiḥ ||45 || arkaḥ pālāśakhadirāvapāmārgaśca pippalaḥ | audumbaraḥ śamī durvā kuśāśca samidhaḥ kramāt ||46|| ekaikasyāṣṭakaśatamaṣṭāviṃśatimeva vā | hotavyā madhusarpirbhyāṃ dadhnā ca samidhā tathā ||47|| tatkāṇḍān prādeśamātrānaśākhānapalāśinaḥ | kalpayet samidhastatra juhuyād devamantrataḥ ||48|| pakvaṃ caruṃ ghṛtābhyaktāṃ samidhaṃ bhakṣyaprabhṛti | daśāhutīḥ prahutvā juhuyād vyāhṛtibhistathā ||49|| mantritaṃ ca caruṃ tasmai tasmai devāya cārpayet | pūrṇāhutiṃ tato dadyāt snāpayet yajamānakam ||3.133.50|| surāstvāmabhirakṣantu sarve ye cātra pūjitāḥ | tathānye pūjanārhāśca tvāmavantu samantataḥ ||5 1 || iti snapitaḥ sastrīko yajamānastu dakṣiṇām | dadad viprebhya evāpi gṛhebhyaścāpi tāṃ yathā ||52|| sūryāya kapilāṃ dhenuṃ śaṃkhaṃ candrāya cārpayet | bhaumāya vṛṣabhaṃ raktaṃ budhāya kanakaṃ diśet ||53||| gurave pītavastraṃ ca śukrāya śvetavājinam | kṛṣṇāṃ gāṃ śanaye dadyādāyasaṃ rāhave tathā ||54|| chāgaṃ dadyāt keśavāyāthavā gāvastu yāvatām | suvarṇaṃ vā pradadyācca gururyathā pratuṣyati ||55|| deye vastuni devasya mamārādhanapūrvakam | dānaṃ śreṣṭhatamapuṇyapradaṃ prajāyate rame ||56|| mātastvaṃ pṛthvīrūpā dhenuḥ kṛṣṇasya vatsalā | puṇyā pāpaharā me’stu nityāṃ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||57|| śaṃkhastvaṃ puṇyapuñjānāṃ mūrtirmaṃgalarūpiṇī | kṛṣṇahastasthito nityaṃ śāntiṃ prayaccha me’niśam ||58|| dharmadevo vṛṣaḥ kṛṣṇamūrtau pratiṣṭhate bhavān | sarvānandapramodānāmadhiṣṭhānaṃ dadhātu mām ||59|| kanaka tvaṃ vahniputra hemabījaṃ vibhāvasoḥ | anantapuṇyaphaladaṃ śāntimṛddhiṃ prayaccha me ||3.133.6 0|| pītāmbaraṃ sadā śreṣṭhaṃ divyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavallabham | śāntiṃ ca sampadaṃ dehi kuru māṃ kṛṣṇavallabham ||61 || hayagrīvo bhavān viṣṇuramṛtauṣadhivīryapaḥ | dehi me cāmṛtaṃ śāntiṃ māṇikyāśvīpatiḥ prabhuḥ ||62|| kṛṣṇe go tvaṃ kṛṣṇapatnī kārṣṇī nārī vyajāyathāḥ | kṛṣṇasya dhāriṇī cāste māṃ prapoṣaya nityadā ||6 3|| dhātūnāmāyasaṃ dāsaḥ sarvakiṃkarakāryakṛt | sitāśarādideva tvaṃ nityāṃ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||64|| chāga tvaṃ kālarūpo’si svapne dṛṣṭo bhayāvahaḥ | vahnivāha sadā śāntiṃ me prayaccha prapūjitaḥ ||65|| gāvaḥ kṛṣṇasvarūpā vai sarveśvarasurāśrayāḥ | sarvoddhārasamarthāśca śriyai me santu sarvathā || 66|| śayye kṛṣṇena saṃbhuktā pāvanī tvaṃ sutapradā | sampatpradāstu me nityamaśūnyāstu mama striyā ||67|| sarvaratnāni devānāṃ vāsātmakāni vai yataḥ | ratnavāsaṃ gṛhe me’tra prakurvantvarpitāni ha ||68|| bhūmidānaṃ paraṃ dānaṃ tathā suvarṇadānakam | annarddhiṃ ca dhanarddhiṃ ca kurutaṃ me samarpite ||69|| ityabhyarthya ca samprārthya dāne dadyād viśeṣataḥ | sarvān kāmānavāpnoti pretya svarge mahīyate ||3.133.70|| yastu pīḍākaro nityamalpavittasya vā grahaḥ | taṃ tu yatnena sampūjya toṣayeccheṣasaṃyutam ||71|| varmavaccopaghātānāṃ śāntirbhavati pūjanāt | sampūrṇāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet ||72|| vivāhotsavayajñeṣu pratiṣṭhādikriyādiṣu | nirvidhnārthaṃ praśāntyarthaṃ kuryādudvegaśāntidam ||73|| navagrahamakhaṃ bhakto’yutahomātmakaṃ śubham | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakamahādhvaram ||74|| prārthayed yajamāno’tra māṃ devānīśvarān satīḥ | yajamānastīrthajalaiḥ snāpito vedavijjanaiḥ ||75|| snāpayitṛdvijā dadyurāśīrvādān surakṣakān | anādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo nārāyaṇīyutaḥ ||76|| muktamuktānikāyuktastvāṃ sadā rakṣatu dhruvam | śrīkṛṣṇo rādhikāyukto nārāyaṇaḥ śriyā saha ||77|| vāsudevādayo vyūhā rakṣantu tvāṃ prapūjakam | brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca mahendrādyā digīśvarāḥ ||78|| dharmapatnyaḥ samagrāśca sūryādyāśca navagrahāḥ | vasavo nidhayo rudrāḥ ṛṣayo munayo vṛṣāḥ ||79|| devadānavagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ | devapatnyo drumā nāgā daityāścāpsarasā gaṇāḥ ||3.133.80 || bhūtapretapiśācādyā rudrā gaṇā gaṇeśvarāḥ | yoginyaḥ śaktayaḥ sarvāḥ śastrāstravāhanāni ca ||81 || ratnauṣadhāni vighnāśca kālaḥ kālasya vaṃśajāḥ | sarve’pi kālāvayavāstīrthāni nikhilānyapi ||82|| ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu rakṣantu vardhayantvapi | evamāśīrvardhitaśca śuklāmbaradharo’rpayet ||83|| dakṣiṇā vividhāḥ sarvā viprebhyo gurave sate | bhojayed bahudhā viprān sādhūn sādhvīśca yoṣitaḥ ||84|| bālām̐śca bālikām̐ścāpi dīnāndhakṛpaṇām̐stathā | bhikṣukān daivavṛttīṃśca miṣṭānnapāyasādibhiḥ ||85|| homānayutasaṃkhyākān kārayed viprapuṃgavaiḥ | yadvā svayaṃ prakuryācca brahmaśīlavratānvitaḥ ||86|| tataḥ kuryāt parihāraṃ grahādhvarasya sarvathā | grahaśāntirbhavettena pīḍā naśyet sukhī bhavet ||87|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne puṇyatamadinapradarśanaṃ grahaśāntipūjādipradarśanaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā trayastriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 133 ||
<3.134> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇunārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ lakṣahomagrahādhvaram | sarvakāmapradaṃ sarvavighnaśāntikaraṃ sukham || 1 || pitṝṇāṃ vallabhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam | grahatārābalaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam || 2 || gṛhasyottarapūrveṇa maṇḍapaṃ kārayennavam | dvādaśahastavistāraṃ caturasramudaṅmukham || 3 || daśahastamaṣṭahastaṃ ca vā prakārayettu tam | prāgudakplavanāṃ bhūmiṃ kārayet sarvarakṣiṇīm || 4 || kuṇḍaṃ samekhalaṃ kuryāccaturasraṃ sayonikam | prāguttare maṇḍapādhobhāge raṃgādirañjitam || 5 || caturaṃgulavistārāṃ mekhalāṃ tadvaducchrayām | dvihastavistṛtaṃ tadvaccaturhastāyataṃ śubham || 6 || lakṣahome racayedvai kuṇḍaṃ śobhāvahaṃ tathā | tasya cottarapūrveṇa vitastitrayamānakam || 7 || prāgudakpravaṇaṃ tacca caturasraṃ samantataḥ | viṣkambhādhocchritaṃ kāryaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ śilpakarmaṇā || 8 || saṃsthāpanāya devānāṃ vapratrayasamāvratam | dvyaṅgulordhvaḥ prathamastu vapraḥ kāryaḥ śubhāvahaḥ || 9 || vapradvayaṃ cāṃgulordhvaṃ pratyekaṃ vai tathopari | daśāṃgulocchritā bhittiḥ sthaṇḍile vai tathopari || 3.134.1 0|| tatra tvāvāhayet devān puṣpataṇḍulakāsane | sūryādīnadhidevādīṃstathā pratyadhidevatāḥ || 11 || garutmānadhikastatra sampūjyaḥ śriyamicchatā | viṣṇubhakto mahābhakto viṣapāpaharo’si vai || 1 2|| sukhado viṣṇubhaktānāṃ śāntimṛddhiṃ prayaccha me | kuṃbhamāmantrya vidhinā lakṣahomān samācaret || 13|| samitsaṃkhyādhikān homān samācaretpraśāntaye | ghṛtakuṃbhavasordhārāṃ pātayedanalopari || 14|| audumbaryā bāhumārgadīrghayā juhuyāt sruvā | śrāvayet sūktamāgneyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ raudramaindavam || 15|| mahāvaiśvānaraṃ sāma jyeṣṭhasāma ca vācayet | snānayed yajamānaṃ ca svastivācanamuccaret || 16|| sudadyād dakṣiṇāścāpi bhūyasīḥ śāntacetasā | ṛtvigbhyaśca caturbhyo vā dvābhyāṃ vā dakṣiṇāṃ dadet || 17| | bhakṣyabhojyāni dānāni goratnāni tathārpayet | śayanāni savastrāṇi haimāni kaṭakāni ca || 18|| kaṇāṃgulipavitrāṇi kaṇṭhahārān suvarṇajān | bhūṣaṇāni dhanaṃ dadyād vittaśāṭhyaṃ na cācaret || 19|| annadānaṃ prakuryācca subhikṣavarṣadāyakam | sādhūn viprān bālabālā bhojayed vividhānnakam ||3.134.20|| annahīno dahed rāṣṭraṃ mantrahīnastu ṛtvijaḥ | yaṣṭāraṃ dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ nāsti yajñasamo ripuḥ ||21 || sakāmo lakṣahomām̐śca kṛtveṣṭakāmamāpnuyāt | putrārthī labhate putrān dhanārthī labhate dhanam ||22|| bhāryārthī śobhanāṃ bhāryāṃ patyarthinī patiṃ priyam | bhraṣṭarājyastathā rājyaṃ śrīkāmaḥ śriyamāpnuyāt ||23 || mānaṃ labhate mānārthī prādhānyaṃ lokavanditam | vijayārthī jayaṃ cāpi labhate sārvakālikam ||24|| yaṃ yaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ caiśvaryaṃ siddhimityapi | taṃ taṃ labhate yajñena grahāṇāṃ samanugrahāt ||25||| niṣkāmaḥ kurute yajñaṃ sa parabrahma gacchati | tatra bhuṃkte parān bhogān sukhamānantyamaśnute ||26|| atha nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śṛṇu yajñaṃ tatodhikam | asmācchataguṇo yajñaḥ koṭihomaḥ prajāyate ||27|| āhutibhiḥ śraddhayā ca dakṣiṇābhiḥ phalena ca | maṇḍape grahadevānāvāhayedupadevatāḥ ||28|| pratyupadevānāvāhya śuddhisnānādi cācaret | koṭihome caturhastaṃ caturasraṃ samantataḥ ||29|| yonivakradvayopetaṃ kuryāt kuṇḍaṃ trimekhalam | prathamā dvyaṅgulordhvā tryaṅgulordhvā tu dvitīyakā ||3.134.30 || ucchrāyavistarābhyāṃ tu tṛtīyā caturaṃgulā | vitastimātrā yoniśca ṣaṭsaptāṃgulavistṛtā ||31 || kūrmapṛṣṭhonnatā madhye pārśvayoścāṅgulocchritā | gajoṣṭhasadṛśī tadvadāyatā chidraśobhitā ||32|| aśvatthapatratulyābhākṛtirekhādirājitā | vedī caturvitastiḥ syāccaturasrā trivapriṇī ||33|| vaprapramāṇaṃ pūrvoktaṃ vedyucchrayo’pi tadvidhaḥ | maṇḍapaḥ ṣoḍaśahastaścaturmukhaḥ suśobhitaḥ ||34|| maṇḍape pūrvagadvāre bahvṛcaṃ sthāpayed dvijam | yajurvidaṃ dakṣiṇe ca paścime sāmavedinam ||35|| uttare’tharvavijñaṃ ca tathāṣṭau homakārthinaḥ | evaṃ dvādaśa viduṣaḥ pūjayed bhaktisaṃbhṛtaḥ ||36|| kuṃkumākṣatabhūṣādyairvastramālyānulepanaiḥ | rātrisūktaṃ rudrasūktaṃ pavamānaṃ sumaṃgalam || 37|| śāntipāṭhaṃ vācayet prāṅbahvṛcānanataḥ purā | śāntaṃ śākraṃ ca saumyaṃ ca kauṣmāṇḍaṃ śāntimeva ca ||38|| pāṭhayed dakṣiṇaviprānanād yajurvido hyatha | suparṇaṃ cāpi vairājamāgneyaṃ rudrasaṃhitām ||39|| jyeṣṭhaṃ sāma tathā śāntiṃ paṭhedvai paścimo dvijaḥ | śāntiṃ sūktaṃ ca sauraṃ ca tathā śākunakaṃ param ||3.134.40|| pauṣṭikaṃ ca mahārājyamuttarasthaḥ paṭhed dvijaḥ | pañcabhiḥ saptabhiścātra homaḥ kāryo dvijottamaiḥ ||41 || vasordhārāvidhānaṃ ca daśottaraṃ hi pūrvataḥ | evaṃ kṛtvā koṭihomān sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt ||42|| viṣṇupadaṃ vrajeccāpi padamindrasya gacchati | vairājaṃ ca padaṃ labdhvā yāti dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||43|| aśvamedhādhvarāṇāṃ yaścāṣṭādaśasahasrakam | kṛtvā yatphalamāpnoti koṭihomāt tadaśnute ||44|| brahmahatyāsahasrāṇi bhrūṇahatyārbudāni ca | koṭihomādhvareṇaiva naśyanti mama yogataḥ ||45|| grahayajñatrayaṃ kuryād yastu prasannatāṃ mama | icchan so’pi vrajecchāntiṃ pīḍānāṃ me prabhāvataḥ ||46|| ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādvāpi śrāvayecca smaredapi | na tasya grahapīḍā syād vartamānā tu naśyati ||47|| grahayajñatrayaṃ gehe likhitaṃ yasya vidyate | na pīḍā tatra bālānāṃ na rogo na ca bandhanam ||48|| śṛṇu lakṣmi grahamūrtīryathā kāryāḥ suvarṇajāḥ | padmāsanaḥ padmakaraḥ padmagarbhasamadyutiḥ ||49|| saptāśvaḥ saptarajjuśca dvibhujaśca kirīṭavān | kuṇḍalāḍhyaḥ saparidhiḥ sūryaḥ kāryaḥ prabhānvitaḥ ||3.134.50 || śvetaḥ śvetāmbaradharaḥ śvetāśvaḥ śvetavāhanaḥ | gadāpāṇirdvibāhuśca kartavyo varadaḥ śaśī ||51 || raktamālyāmbaradharaḥ śaktiśūlagadādimān | caturbhujaḥ śvetaromā varado maṃgalo mataḥ ||52|| pītamālyāmbaradharaḥ karṇikārasamaprabhaḥ | khaḍgacarmagadāpāṇiḥ siṃhastho varado budhaḥ ||53|| bṛhaspatiśca śukraśca pītaḥ śvetaḥ kramāttathā | caturbhujau daṇḍinau ca sākṣasūtrakamaṇḍalū ||54|| indranīlaprabhaḥ śūlī varado gṛdhravāhanaḥ | śaradhanuṣyadhārī ca kartavyo vai śanaiścaraḥ ||55|| nīlasiṃhāsanasthaśca rāhuḥ kṛṣṇaprabho mataḥ | dhūmrā dvibāhavaḥ sarve gadāyutā ruṣānvitāḥ ||56|| gṛdhrāsanāḥ ketavaḥ kartavyāśca varadāstathā | sarve kirīṭinaḥ kāryā ūrdhve’ṣṭayukśatāṃgulāḥ ||57|| śṛṇulakṣmi purā vaiśyo dhanadhānyasamṛddhimān | lohāṃgāraitināmnābhavad deśe tu mālave ||58|| vyāpāreṇa mahāśreṣṭhī rājyakośābhirakṣakaḥ | deśaprajādravyapātā dravyadātābhavattathā ||59|| yasyābhavan gṛhe vājigajāśca vāṭikāstathā | udyānāni vicitrāṇi bhavanāni śubhāni ca ||3.134.60 || svarṇasiṃhāsanānyeva kalaśāḥ svarṇarājatāḥ | nāryaḥ sauvarṇabhūṣāḍhyā ratnahārāvalīyutāḥ ||61 || vimānenārkatulyena viharanti pare’mbare | dāsā dāsyaḥ śataṃ yasya bhṛtyā lakṣaṃ tu nityaśaḥ ||62|| karmacārā bhavantyasya dravyopārjanatatparāḥ | prajārājāmātyavargeṣvasya mānaṃ mataṃ bahu ||63|| sarvamāsācchubhaṃ kintu grahā duṣṭā yadāsya tu | duṣṭasthāne śaniścānye’bhavam̐staiḥ pīḍito hyayam ||64|| rogī jāto mṛtaprāyo lakṣmīrdravyāṇi bhūbhṛtā | luṇṭhitāni samagrāṇi putrāḥ kārāgṛhe kṛtāḥ ||65|| bhavanāni cāgnidagdhānyeva jānāti vai tadā | vyāpārāḥ sarva evaite naṣṭaprāyāstadābhavan ||66|| kalaṃkena yaśohānirjātāsyāpi prajāsvapi | samantato mahākaṣṭaṃ samāyātaṃ bhunakti saḥ ||67|| athāsyāsīd gururvipro maharṣiścāmṛṣāyanaḥ | yogī trikāladarśī ca vedavid grahapūjakaḥ ||68|| nārāyaṇasya bhakto’pi vrataśīlopaśobhitaḥ | sādhuḥ sāttvikabhāvāḍhyaḥ satyavrato’tividyakaḥ ||69|| lauhāṃgāraṃ nijyaśiṣyaṃ śrutvā kaṣṭapramagnakam | draṣṭuṃ gṛhe samāyātaḥ kṛpayā preritastadā ||3.134.70 || vīkṣya śiṣyaṃ kaṣṭamagnaṃ naṣṭadravyaṃ vinā yaśaḥ | putradaṇḍaṃ tathā rogaṃ dayāṃ parāmavāptavān ||71 || prāha lohāṃgārakaṃ taṃ kuru śāntiṃ grahasya vai | gṛhaśāntyā grahamakhaiḥ kaṣṭaṃ dūraṃ gamiṣyati ||72|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | bhajānanyamanaskastvaṃ paraṃ saukhyamavāpsyasi ||73|| ityuktaḥ so’pi sahasā bhaktibhāvasamanvitaḥ | tathaiveti samagṛhya kārayāmāsa maṇḍapam ||74|| kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāmūrjamāse kuṇḍaṃ cakāra śobhanam | grahamūrtīḥ kānakīśca mama mūrtiṃ ca kānakīm ||75|| tvayā lakṣmyā ca sahitāṃ cakārātipraśobhanām | vastrābhūṣaṇaśṛṃgārādyabhiśobhitavigrahām ||76|| adhidevān pratyadhidevatāśca maṇḍape tataḥ | āsaneṣvāvāhayāmāsārcayāmāsa vaidhataḥ ||77|| aṣṭottaraśataviprān vavre japārthameva saḥ | koṭijapān vedavidbhiḥ kārayāmāsa sarvathā ||78|| pūjānte pradadau dānaṃ guptaṃ pṛthvyāḥ pragartataḥ | niṣkāsya lakṣasauvarṇamudrāṇāṃ lakṣyavarjitam ||79|| aprakāśaṃ yadāsīttad ratnamāṇikyahīrakān | dadau dāne tu viprebhyo gogajāśvādikaṃ tathā ||3.134.80|| naivedyāni yathoktāni dadau peyāni yāni ca | devebhyo balidānāni sāttvikāni dadau tathā ||81 || bhojayāmāsa viprām̐śca sādhūn sādhvīśca yoṣitaḥ | bālām̐śca bālikāścapi dīnakṛpaṇaduḥkhinaḥ ||82|| nirāśritān nirdhanām̐śca kaṃgālām̐śca daridrakān | puṇyān puṇyajanām̐ścāpi bhojayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ||83|| sarvaṃ cakāra vidhinā pūjanaṃ mama te’pi ca | grahaśāntyā yajñapuṇyairmama te ca prasādataḥ ||84|| lohāṃgārasya dehādvai rogo’naśyad drutaṃ tadā | svasthobhavattato rājā dayāmagno’bhavacca tam ||85|| samāhūya dadau mānaṃ pūrvato’bhyadhikaṃ bahu | mahāmātyapadaṃ tasmai prāyacchad devalādhipaḥ ||86|| prajāścāpi namaścakrurmānayāmāsurādarāt | putrān rājā svayaṃ kārāgārādamocayattadā ||87|| atha caurāśca bhagnāśāstrastā rājyabhayaṃ gatāḥ | coritaṃ sarmamevāpi cikṣipurniśi catvare ||88|| prakāśaṃ prajayā prātardṛṣṭaṃ cāsmai niveditam | prāptaṃ sarva dhanaṃ cāpi grahaśāntyā tadā rame ||89|| evaṃ sā prāpya sarvaṃ tat kalpayāmāsa dānakam | svarṇaṃ ratnāni māṇikyaṃ hīrakān rūpyakāṇi ca ||3.134.90|| vaiṣṇavaṃ ca mahāyajñaṃ samārebhe dvijātibhiḥ | sarvaṃ pratyāgataṃ dravyaṃ dadau sa dakṣiṇāḥ śubhāḥ ||91|| ahaṃ prasanno hyabhavaṃ tasya tasya gurostathā | dadau svadarśanaṃ lakṣmi tvayā sākaṃ hyavabhṛthe ||92|| varārthaṃ deśitaḥ so’pi varaṃ vavre hi bhṛtyatām | mayoktaṃ kuru ramyaṃ me mandiraṃ māṃ ca mandire ||93|| pratiṣṭhāpya sadā sevāṃ bhṛtyatāṃ kuru sarvathā | kṛtvā tūrṇaṃ sa evaṃ vai dāsyaṃ cakre kuṭumbavān ||94|| ātmaniveditāṃ cakre bheje māṃ puruṣottamam | vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo bhūtvā rājānaṃ devalābhidham ||95|| vaiṣṇavaṃ pracakārāpi prajāśca vaiṣṇavīstathā | cakāra nijayogena bhaktimatīḥ śubhakriyāḥ ||96|| lakṣavarṣaṃ kṣitau sthitvā svargaṃ bhuktvā yugāṣṭakam | satyalokaṃ koṭivarṣaṃ vairājaṃ tu parārdhakam ||97|| bhuktvā vaikuṇṭhamevāpi yayau me tvakṣaraṃ padam | pūrvakalpe mahālakṣmi katheyaṃ sampravartitā ||98 || adya me vartate dhāmni pārṣadaḥ sakuṭumbakaḥ | evaṃ grahādhvaraṃ kṛtvā svargaṃ mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||99|| duḥkhanāśe sukhaṃ modaṃ pramodaṃ labhate’nvaham | aniṣṭānāṃ vināśaṃ ca sveṣṭānāṃ labhate sthitim ||3.134.1 00 || nityaṃ rājan pūjayed yastasya śāntirhi śāśvatī | grahapīḍā na jāyeta yakṣarakṣobhavāpi na ||1 01 || caurakālakṛtā nāpi nāpi devakṛtāpi ca | grahe śaktipradātāhaṃ rakṣāmi vaiṣṇavaṃ mama ||1 02|| śravaṇātpaṭhanādasya smaraṇāccānumodanāt | grahaśāntisamāṃ śāntiṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne grahamakhe lakṣajapahomakoṭijapahomādividhiḥ, lohāṃ gārakavaiśyasya sarvasvanāśottaraṃ grahaśāntyā punarlabdhirityādinirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 134 ||
<3.135> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ purā dakṣeṇa vanditā | prākaṭyāni lalitāyā lakṣmyoścoktavatī svayam || 1 || dakṣaḥ papraccha mātaste prākaṭyānyatra bhūtale | kāni kutra ca vartante vartsyante tāni me vada || 2 || yatpūjābalataścāhaṃ vighnān vināśaye sadā | grahadoṣān karmadoṣān vināśaye tavārhaṇāt || 3 || tadā tvaṃ nijapūjāyāḥ phalaṃ coktavatī śubham | lalitākhyamahālakṣmyāḥ pūjakasyāśubhāni vai || 4 || vinaṃkṣyanti na sandeho mama pūjāprakāriṇaḥ | yāni yāni svarūpāṇi yatra yatra bhavanti ca || 5 || tāni vakṣyāmi te dakṣaprajāpate niśāmaya | ahaṃ tvakṣaradhāmasthā śrīdevī puruṣottamau || 6 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇī śrīparameśvarī | brahmamuktānikā brāhmī kārṣṇī nārāyaṇī ramā || 7 || vāsudevī ca vairājī hiraṇyā hariṇī prabhā | mahālakṣmīḥ kaṃbharāśrīrlalitā kamalā calā || 8 || īśvarī vaiṣṇavī cāndrī hiraṇmayī ca devatā | ārṣī siddhā yoginī ca sādhvī satī pativratā || 9 || prabhvī dhāmā jayā bhaumī maheśī bhūrnarāyaṇī | pāśavatī ca māṇikyā mārūpā śrīharipriyā ||3.135.1 0|| duḥkhahā śivarājñīśrī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇī satī | brahmapriyā brahmadhāmni mahālakṣmīśca śrīpure || 11 || lakṣmīḥ kuṃkumavāpyāṃ ca mahālakṣmīstu raivate | vyāghreśvarī māhiṣe ca gokarṇe dhenukarṇikā || 1 2|| santuṣṭā cākṣare kṣetre camatkāre tu mādhavī | vārāṇasyāṃ viśālākṣī naimiṣe liṅgadhāriṇī ||1 3|| prayāge lalitā cāsmi kāmākṣī gandhamādane | mānase kumudā devī viśvakāyā cidambare || 14|| gomante gomatīnāmnī mandarādrau tu kāmagā | madotkaṭā caitrarathe jayantī vārahāhvaye ||15|| gaurīnāmnī kānyakubje raṃbhā tu malayācale | ekāmrake kīrtimatī viśvā viśveśvare’smi ca ||1 6|| puṣkare puruhūtāsmi kedāre mārgadāsmi ca | himācale ca nandāsmi bilvake bilvapatrikā ||17|| sthāneśvare bhavānyasmi śrīśaile padminī sadā | bhadrā bhadreśvare cāsmi jayā vārāhaparvate || 18|| kāmalā kamalābhūmau raudrī ca rudrakoṭike | kālī kālaṃjare cāsmi markoṭe mukuṭeśvarī ||19|| mahāliṃge kapilāsmi śivalige jalapriyā | śālagrāme mahādevī māyāpuryāṃ kumārikā ||3.135.20|| santāne kāñcikāpuryāṃ lalitā durgapattane | utpalākṣī sahasrākṣe kalamākṣe mahotpalā ||21 || gaṃgāyāṃ maṃgalā durgā vimalā puruṣottame | vipāśāyāmamoghākṣī pāṭalā puṇḍravardhane ||22|| nārāyaṇī supārśve’smi vikūṭe bhadrasundarī | vipule vipulānāmnī kalyāṇī malayācale ||23|| koṭitīrthe koṭavī ca sugandhā mādhave vane | kubjāmrake trisandhyāsmi gaṃgādvāre ratipriyā ||24||| śivakuṇḍe sunandāsmi nandinī devikātaṭe | rukmavarṇā dvāravatyāṃ rādhā vṛndāvane’smi ca ||25|| madhurāyāṃ devakanyā pātāle parameśvarī | citrakūṭe tu sītāsmi vindhye vindhyācalī tathā ||26 || sahyādrāvekavīrāsmi harmacandre tu candrikā | ramaṇā rāmatīrthe’smi yamunāyāṃ mṛgāvatī ||27|| karavīre mahālakṣmīrumādevī vināyake | aromā vaijanāthe’smi mahākāle maheśvarī ||28|| abhayāsmi coṣṇatīrthe amṛtā vindhyakandare | māṇḍavye māṇḍavīnāmnī svāhā māheśvare pure ||29 || chāgale’smi pracaṇḍāhaṃ caṇḍikā makarandake | someśvare varārohā prabhāse puṣkarāvatī ||3.135.3 0|| sarasvatyāṃ devamātā pārā pārātaṭe’smi ca | mahālaye mahābhāgā payoṣṇyāṃ piṃgaleśvarī ||3 1 || siṃhāraṇye siṃhikāsmi kārtikeye yaśaskarī | utpalāvartake lolā subhadrā śoṇasaṃgame ||32|| mātā lakṣmīḥ siddhapure aṅganā pulahāśrame | jālandhare viśvamukhī tārā kiṣkindhaparvate ||33 || devadāruvane puṣṭirmedhā kāśmiramaṇḍale | himādrau bhīmikādevī puṣṭirviśveśvare’smi ca ||34|| kapālamocane śuddhirmātā kāyāvarohaṇe | śaṃkhoddhāre dharādevī dhṛtiḥ piṇḍārake’smi ca ||35|| māṇikyānartake nārāyaṇīśrīrasmi nāgare | kālāsmi candrabhāgāyāmacchode śivakāriṇī ||36|| veṇāyāmamṛtānāmnī badaryāmurvaśī tathā | oṣadhiścottarakurau kuśadvīpe kuśodakā ||37|| manmathā hemakūṭe tu mukuṭe satyavādinī | aśvatthe vandanīyāsmi nidhiśca śravaṇālaye ||38|| gāyatrī brahmaṇā sākaṃ pārvatī śivasannidhau | devaloke tathendrāṇī brahmāsye’smi sarasvatī ||39||| sūryabimbe prabhā dhairye pāśavatī tu vaiṣṇavī | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’smi sukhadā ramā ||3.135.40|| arundhatī satī cāsmi tilottamāpsarogaṇe | citte brahmakalā cāsmi kāntā kānteṣu sarvaśaḥ ||41 || bhaṃgā nīlagirāvasmi vijayāsāmabhūtale | kāmarūpe ca kāmākṣyā brahmadeśa irāsmi ca ||42|| khāsīneṣu brahmaputrī patatkāye tu pāvanī | śyāmā śyāmapradeśe’smi prācīne menakāṃginī ||43 || uccīne yāgaśikṣāṃgī tryaṃguleṣu tu kāramī | kārākāre kṛṣṇavarṇā elune khanirasmi ca ||44|| mūkī maṃgolake cāsmi khiṃgane mañcchikāsmi ca | stenāvāse pāraśavī rāśiputrī tu rāśane ||45|| uralā coralādrau ca raktā cāraktabhūtale | nārāyaṇī sudāne’smi cālpā cālpe ca parvate ||46|| iṅgitajñā ketumāle parī cāsmi balāyate | hāritī piṃgadeśe ca amarī kiṃpumātmake ||47|| rākarī mānakaṃgau ca parīnārī tu dakṣake | saṃhārā najare’drau ca kāmarūpā kamāraṇe ||48|| māsāmbā sāmbaśaile’smi kalihārā tu mitrape | trihotre hotriṇī cāsmi jhambe māṃjhāmbikāsmi ca ||49|| navadeśe maṇikāntā uṣṭrālaye mahordhvikā | kalagaralī śvānāyāṃ cāliśī kvāthaparvate ||3.135.50|| evamādisvarūpaiśca bhūtale saṃvasāmyaham | dakṣa sarvatra matpūjāṃ kuru bhuktipramuktidām ||51 || ityāha śrīmahālakṣmīstadā dakṣaṃ prajāpatim | ataste tu mahālakṣmyāḥ pūjanaṃ sarvaśāntikṛt ||52|| pūjāyāṃ sarvanāmāni dve śate tava yo japet | sarvāśca siddhayastasyopatiṣṭhantu yatheṣṭadāḥ ||53|| grahāṇāṃ cāpi yakṣāṇāṃ rakṣasāṃ vairiṇāṃ tathā | kaṣṭāni yāntu nāśaṃ vai tava śāntimakhādibhiḥ ||54|| maṇḍapaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kamalākāramuttamam | vartulaṃ kārayitvā yaḥ kuṇḍaṃ kamalavattathā ||55|| śatadvayena saṃsmṛtya nāmnāṃ tvāṃ parameśvarīm | taṇḍuleṣu samāvāhya pūjayet kamalādibhiḥ ||56|| tasya pīḍā samastā vai nāśameṣyanti madvarāt | homān kṛtvāṣṭasaṃkhyān vai pratyekanāmasaṃyutān ||57|| ghṛtapāyasamiṣṭānnaistato dadyānmahāhutim | ghṛtadhārābhirevāpi phalairvrīhyādibhistathā ||58|| nārikelaphalādyaiśca samidbhiḥ śarkarādibhiḥ | yastasya mānaseṣṭaṃ yat tatsarvaṃ vai bhaviṣyati ||59|| rājyaṃ svargaśca mokṣaśca sarvaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati | strīputrapatilābhādirdhanakīrtī bhaviṣyataḥ ||3.135.60 || suvidhānaṃ tatra vacmi lakṣmīyajñe yathāyatham | śataṃ ca viṃśatiścāpi hastānāṃ parimaṇḍalam ||61 || maṇḍapārthaṃ tu gṛhṇīyād daśastaṃbhamayaṃ śubham | maṇḍapaṃ racayettatra caturdvāraiḥ suśobhitam ||62|| toraṇaiḥ suvitānena vartulaśikhareṇa ca | sauvarṇakalaśaiścāpi dhvajena śobhitena ca ||63 || raktavastradhvajenāpi śobhitaṃ kārayecchubham | paritastava śastrāṇi toraṇeṣu likhettathā ||64|| aṣṭādaśa vibhinnāni pūrvato dakṣiṇakramāt | khaḍgaṃ carma karavālaṃ daṇḍaṃ pāśaṃ paviṃ dhanuḥ ||65|| paraśuṃ ca śaraṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ śaṃkhaṃ mahāṃkuśam | kamalaṃ mālikāṃ śaktiṃ kṣepaṇīṃ cābhayaṃ tathā ||66|| evametānyāyudhāni toraṇeṣu nidhāpayet | pratistambhaṃ kalaśām̐śca dhvajānapi vidhāpayet ||67|| dvāraśākhāsvaṣṭadevīḥ sthāpayeccāṅgadevatāḥ | pūrvaśākhādvaye śrīṃ ca māṇikyāṃ sthāpayettathā ||68 || dakṣiṇe ca ramāṃ pāśavatīṃ saṃsthāpayettathā | paścime maṃgalāṃ caivāmṛtāṃ saṃsthāpayettathā ||69|| uttare tu vijayāṃ ca jayāṃ saṃsthāpayettathā | madhyastambheṣu caiśāne durgāṃ satīṃ ca vinyaset ||3.135.70 || agnistambhadvaye svāhāṃ svadhāṃ cāvāsayettathā | nairṛte saṃhāriṇīṃ ca vaśinīṃ sthāpayettathā ||71 || vāyavye śāradāṃ vāṇīṃ sthāpayecchobhanāṃ śubhām | sāvitrīṃ cāpi gāyatrīṃ sarasvatīṃ tathā yamīm ||72|| vaiṣṇavīṃ ca varāhīṃ caṇḍikāmaindrīṃ ca vāruṇīm | bhuvaṃ saṃjñāṃ kaumudīṃ ca nandāṃ nārāyaṇīṃ ramām ||73|| santuṣṭāṃ ṣoḍaśaśaktiḥ sthāpayettu vitānake | stambhāntaracarusthāneṣvatiśṛṃgāraśobhitāḥ ||74|| dvihastāḥ sarvabhūṣāḍhyāḥ pūjayettīrthavāribhiḥ | kuṃkumākṣatatailādyaiḥ sugandhicandanādibhiḥ ||75|| kuṇḍaṃ tu vartule hastadaśakaṃ vai yathā bhavet | tathā ṣoḍaśadalavat padmarūpaṃ vidhāpayet ||76|| sayoniṃ kārayettatra mekhalātrikamityapi | lakṣahomān koṭihomān kārayediṣṭasiddhidān ||77|| dve śate tava rūpāṇi cāvāhayed prapūjayet | mahālakṣmīṃ tava mūrtiṃ pronnatāṃ tu śubhānanām ||78|| ṣaṭpañcāśadaṅgulāṃ samukuṭāṃ hārarājitām | svarṇasiṃhāsanasthāṃ vai kānakīṃ vānyadhātujām ||79|| kārayet tatsakhīnāṃ tu yathāyogyāṃ prakārayet | pañcāmṛtaistīrthajalaiḥ saṃsnāpya parameśvarīm ||3.135.80|| gandhasugandhaśṛṃgārairvibhūṣābhiścidambaraiḥ | kusumābharaṇairdehāvayavānāṃ suśobhanaiḥ ||81 || candanākṣatatulasīkastūrīgandhasārakaiḥ | pūjayitvā vividhāni naivedyāni samarpayet ||82|| miṣṭānnāni samastāni pāyasānnāni yāni ca | miṣṭarasān śākabhājā naivedye vai samarpayet ||83|| jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ dadyādārārtrikaṃ tataścaret | pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā prārthayet praṇamettathā ||84|| janmahantri bhavahantri rogahantri pareśvari | vāsudevi kṛṣṇadevi mahālakṣmi namo’stu te ||85|| pārabrāhmi sarvabhūtahṛdayasthe parātpare | sarvadevīsvarūpe te rakṣayitri namo muhuḥ ||86 || tava bhaktasya me kaṣṭaṃ daivaṃ vā mānuṣaṃ tathā | karmajaṃ kālajaṃ vāpi prārabdhajaṃ grahotthitam ||87|| svabhāvajaṃ mānasaṃ vā yadasti jāyate’thavā | janiṣyate ca yatkaṣṭaṃ śāpād drohātpramādataḥ ||88 || ajñānāccāpi vai yacca duṣprārabdhaṃ ca me bhavet| | avaṃśatvaṃ cāputratvaṃ niḥstrīkatvaṃ vimānatā ||89|| sarvaṃ rogabhayaṃ cāpi mama nāśaṃ prayātu tat | saukhyaṃ tavaiva kṛpayā modo bhavatu cāniśam ||3.135.90 || śāśvataṃ śrīpuraṃ svargaṃ cāmṛtaṃ padamastu me | ante’kṣaraṃ paraṃ dhāma mamāstu paramaṃ padam ||91 || ityabhyarthya kusumānāmaṃjaliṃ vitarettataḥ | aparādhān kṣantumevārādhayitvā mahāsatīm ||92|| visarjayet tathā dāsīścopadevīvisarjayet | dadyācca devatāṃ lakṣmīṃ gurave brahmamūrtaye ||9 3 || mandire sthāpayedvāpi mahālakṣmīṃ sthire dṛḍhe | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena sahitāṃ ca vā ||94|| śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇena mahāviṣṇvātmanā yutām | sthāpayet svarṇaśikharaiḥ śobhite devatālaye ||95|| suvarṇamudrādānāni rūpyakām̐ścārpayettathā | māṇikyahīrakaratnabhūṣāvastrāṇi cārpayet ||96|| miṣṭānnāni diśeścāpi nārīvastrāṇi cārpayet | ramyaśṛṃgārabhūṣāścopakaraṇāni cārpayet ||97|| dhanadhānyāni sarvāṇi gṛhadānāni kārayet | evaṃ kṛtvā parihāraṃ tato bhojanamācaret ||98 || bhojayet sādhuviprām̐śca dīnāndhakṛpaṇām̐stathā | bālān prabālikāścāpi yoṣito’nāthanirdhanīḥ ||99|| sataḥ satīśca sādhvīśca bhojayetpūjayettathā | nityaṃ lakṣmīṃ pūjayecca bhojayet vidhinā tathā || 3.135.100 || evaṃ karturna vai duḥkhaṃ santāpo vā bhavet kvacit | bhuktiḥ sampanmahāmuktiḥ sāmrājyaṃ ca bhavet sadā || 101 || akhaṇḍānandabhoktṛtvaṃ devīvṛndādhikāntatā | bhavet kṛṣṇasamānatvaṃ śrīpate kṛpayā śriyāḥ ||1 02|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi tavārhaṇaṃ praśāntidam | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya mahāsaukhyaṃ bhavet sadā || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne dakṣaprajāpataye mahālakṣmyuktāni svīyāni śatadvayanāmarūpāṇi lakṣmīmakhe śāntipūjā mahālakṣmīpratimā tanmaṇḍalādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 135 ||
<3.136> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ lakṣmīnāmnāṃ śatadvayam | purā japtvā samārādhya tapaḥ kṛtvā tavopari || 1 || acchodā nāma pitṝṇāṃ kanyakā mānasī śubhā | amāvasuṃ hi balinaṃ patiṃ prāptavatī tataḥ || 2 || pitṝṇāṃ ca mahālakṣmyā āśīrvādamavāpa sā | matsyayonisamutpannā vasoḥ rājñaḥ suvīryajā || 3 || kanyakā dhīvarapoṣyā sasyavatī bhaviṣyasi | parāśarasya vīryeṇa putramekamavāpsyasi || 4 || dvīpe tu badarīprāye bādarāyaṇamacyutam | viṣṇormātā svayaṃ bhūtvā tataḥ paraṃ vivāhitā || 5 || samudrāṃśena bhūpena śantanunā suputriṇī | bhaviṣyasi sutau citrāṃgadavicitravīryakau || 6 || utpādya ca tataḥ pitṛlokaṃ prayāsyasi drutam | prauṣṭhapadyaṣṭakārūpā pitṛloke bhaviṣyasi || 7 || nāmnā satyavatī loke pitṛloke tathāṣṭakā | āyurārogyadā nityaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradā || 8 || bhaviṣyasi tataścāpi nadītvaṃ saṃvrajiṣyasi | acchodānāmataścāpi pitruddhārakarī sadā || 9 || ityevaṃ sā pitṛkanyā lakṣmīśāntivratena vai | khyātimatī vyāsamātā varadānamavāpa ha || 3.136.10 || gīyate dve śate nāmnāṃ yenāṣṭamyāṃ ca pūjane | godāne śrāddhadāne vā bahuputro bhaveddhi saḥ || 11 || dve śate te tathā lakṣmi tīrthānyapi bhavanti ca | sṛṣṭitraye’pi tatrāpi snātā brahmādhigacchati || 12|| pitarastasya santṛptāstaranti brahma yāntyapi | atha cānye barhiṣadaḥ pulastyasya sutā divi ||1 3|| pitaraḥ śataśaḥ santi tāsāṃ kanyā tu mānasī | pīvarī nāmataḥ sādhvī cakre lakṣmi vrataṃ tava ||14|| lakṣmīśāntikaraṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ tapaśca dāruṇam | tvāṃ labdhvā gocarāṃ divyāṃ harikṛṣṇayutāṃ vane ||15|| varaṃ cāvāpa tatraiva tvattaḥ patimatī bhava | patiste śukradevo vai mahāyogī bhaviṣyati || 16|| vyāsasutastasya bhāryā bhavatī mānasīṃ sutām | kṛtvīnāmnīṃ lapsyase ca yoginīṃ divyaśobhanām ||17|| dāsyasi tvaṃ sutāṃ rājñe pāñcāleśāya vai tataḥ | putrāste’pi ca catvāraḥ kṛtvyanujā maheśvarāḥ ||18|| kṛṣṇo gauraḥ prabhuḥ śaṃbhurbhaviṣyanti pramuktidāḥ | patiputrādisahitā cireṇa mokṣameṣyasi ||19|| ityevaṃ pīvarī prāptā varadānaṃ tava vratāt | atha cānye pitaro’pi marīcigarbhanāminaḥ ||3.136.20 || eteṣāṃ mānasī kanyā yaśodā nāmataḥ śubhā | kṛtvā vrataṃ tava lakṣmi patnī hyaṃśumato’bhavat ||21 || jananyapi dilīpasya bhagīrathapitāmahī | ajāyata tataḥ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ gatāpi sundarī ||22|| athājyapānāṃ kanyāpi nāmnā tu virajā purā | lakṣmīśāntivrataṃ kṛtvā nahuṣasya priyābhavat ||23|| yayāterjananī sā ca aikāṣṭakābhavattataḥ | brahmalokagatā tatra modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ||24|| atha mānasapitṝṇāṃ kanyā tu narmadā satī | lakṣmīśāntivrataṃ kṛtvā nadīrūpā pramodate ||25|| pramodate sadā svarge pitṛloke’pi modate | pūjyate triṣu lokeṣu harernarmapradā sakhī ||26|| atha gauḥ pitṛkanyāpi lakṣmīśāntivratena vai | śukrasya dayitā patnī sādhyamātā virājate |||27||| evaṃ svarge tathā satye bhūtale’pi sthalesthale | lakṣmīśāntivratenaiva modante sampadarddhibhiḥ ||28|| atha lakṣmi śukaputrī nāmnā kṛtvī tu yoginī | pitṛmānasakanyāyāḥ pīvaryāḥ putrikā purā ||29|| lakṣmīśāntivrataṃ cakre nārāyaṇasamanvitam | putrārthaṃ tatpatiścāpi pañcālādhipatirnṛpaḥ ||3.136.3 0|| anagho nāma vaibhrājo hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ ramām | lakṣmīśāntivratenaiva toṣayāmāsa vai tataḥ ||3 1 || lakṣmījanārdanau tuṣṭau prāhatustau varāya ca | vavrāte tau varaṃ putraṃ nārāyaṇasamaṃ tadā ||32|| pāragaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ dhārmikaṃ yoginaṃ varam | sarvabhūtarutajñaṃ ca mahābalaparākramam ||33|| evamastviti cārpayya varadānaṃ tirogatau | so’yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāttasya putro’bhavattadā ||34|| brahmadattābhidhāno vai dayāluḥ sattvasadbalaḥ | tasya bhāryābhavallakṣmīrnāmnā sannatirityatha ||35|| viśvakseno’bhavattasyāḥ putro’pi bhagavān svayam | evaṃ lakṣmīvratapuṇyaṃ mahāphalapradaṃ sadā ||36|| atha kardamapatnī yā sinīvālī purābhavat | lakṣmīśāntivrataṃ kṛtvā devahūtī tato’bhavat ||37|| kapilaṃ śrīhariṃ putraṃ prāptavatī vratena te | dyutistaptvā tapaḥ kṛtvā lakṣmīśāntivrataṃ purā ||38|| vibhāvasuṃ patiṃ lebhe pavamānādikān sutān | tuṣṭistepe tapaścāpi lakṣmīśāntivrataṃ vyadhāt ||39|| patiṃ prāpa hi dhātāraṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtam | prabhā kṛtvā vrataṃ lebhe patiṃ prabhākaraṃ harim ||3.136.40 || kuhūḥ kṛtvā vrataṃ lebhe haviṣyantaṃ patiṃ śubham | kīrtirjayantaṃ bhartāraṃ vasurmārīcakaśyapam ||41 || dhṛtiḥ prāptā patiṃ nandiṃ purūravasamurvaśī | urvaśī tvekadā lakṣmīsvayaṃvare nanarta ha ||42|| lakṣmīśāntivrataṃ cakre sutānaṣṭāvajījanat | āyuṃ dṛḍhāyumaśvāyuṃ dhanāyuṃ sadhṛtiṃ vasum ||42||| śucividyaṃ śatāyuṃ ca tato divaṃ yayau hi sā | atha lakṣmi vṛṣaparvasutā śarmiṣṭhikā śubhā ||44|| lakṣmīśāntivrataṃ kṛtvā yayātiṃ prāpa satpatim | śukraputrī devayānī cakre lakṣmīvrataṃ tataḥ ||45|| guruputraṃ kacaṃ daityavṛkairattamajīvayat | punardaityairmadirāyāṃ cūrṇitaṃ pāyitaṃ kacam ||46|| śukrāya sa ca śukro’pi sañjīvanīṃ kacāya vai | dadāvudarasthāyāpi devayānyāḥ śubhāgrahāt ||47|| lakṣmīśāntivrataṃ kṛtvā kacaḥ pitṛgṛhaṃ yayau | sañjīvanīṃ svaśiṣyebhyo’dhyāpayāmāsa tadbalāt ||48|| atha vai jyāmaghabhāryā caitrā lakṣmīvratena vai | putraṃ vidarbhasaṃjñaṃ cāvāpa sadguṇaśālinam ||49|| snuṣā patiṃ hyavāpātha lakṣmīvratena taṃ tathā | yā jitā raṇasaṃgrāme jyāmaghena snuṣā kṛtā ||3.136.50|| lakṣmīśāntivrataṃ cakre dṛśadvatī hyuśīnarāt | śibimauśīnaraṃ putraṃ lebhe vai cakravartinam ||51 || baleḥ patnī sudeṣṇā ca kṛtvā lakṣmīvrataṃ purā | aṃgaṃ vaṃgaṃ kaliṃgaṃ ca puṇḍṃ suhmaṃ sutān śubhān ||52|| dīrghatamasaḥ saṃlebhe brāhmaṇān rājyabhoginaḥ | śakuntalā vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe tu bharataṃ sutam ||53|| mamatā tu vrataṃ kṛtvā bharadvājaṃ sutaṃ śubham | avāpa tu bṛhaspaterbharatāya dadau ca tam |||54|| hiraṇyanābhinaḥ śiṣyaḥ kauśalyasya mahātmanaḥ | kṛtāyano vrataṃ kṛtvā lakṣmīprasādatastataḥ ||55|| caturviṃśatidhāścakre divyā vai sāmasaṃhitāḥ | ahalyā tu divodāsabhaginī vai śaradvatāt ||56|| śatānandamṛṣiṃ putraṃ lebhe lakṣmīvratāt kila | kāverī kṛṣṇaveṇī ca narmadā yamunā tathā ||57|| godāvarī vitastā ca candrabhāgā irāvatī | vipāśā kauśikī cāpi śatadrūḥ sarayūstathā ||58|| sītā manasvinī cāpi hradinī pāvanā nadī | lakṣmīśāntivrataṃ kṛtvā dhiṣṇyān putrān hi lebhire ||59|| evamanyā yoṣito’pi kṛtvā lakṣmīvrataṃ tvidam | lebhire sampadaḥ putrīputrān svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam ||3.136.60|| śṛṇu lakṣmi vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ saubhāgyaśayanaṃ tvapi | purā kṛtaṃ tvayā tvetat sarvakāmaphalapradam ||61 || purā dagdheṣu lokeṣu bhūrbhuvaḥsvarmahaḥsu ca | saubhāgyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ piṇḍībhūtaṃ tadābhavat ||62|| vaikuṇṭhaṃ tat samāsādya viṣṇorvakṣaḥsthale sthitam | punaḥ sṛṣṭau prajāyāṃ tat saubhāgyaṃ gantumicchukam ||63|| harervakṣaḥsthalāllakṣmīrūpaṃ prādurajāyata | sarvasaukhyapradaṃ taccābhavaddhareranujñayā ||64|| lakṣmīrūpaṃ vihāyaiva rasarūpaṃ sudhātmakam | brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca ye sṛṣṭervai dhurandharāḥ ||65|| te saubhāgyaṃ papustatra rasaṃ devīsamanvitāḥ | rūpalāvaṇyasaubhāgyatejobalādivardhanam ||66|| śeṣaṃ sarvaprabhūtārthamaṣṭadhā samajāyata | rasāt saptābhavan modāḥ sapta saubhāgyadāyinaḥ ||67|| ikṣavo guḍapiṇḍāvā niṣpāvā jīrakāni ca | gokṣīrādi kusumbhaṃ ca sindūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ tathā ||68|| lavaṇaṃ ceti saubhāgyaṃ vardhante tāni tadvratāt | nārāyaṇena saubhāgyātmakaṃ svenāpi rakṣitam ||69|| lālanāt sābhavattasya lalitā nāma sundarī | lokān saubhāgyarūpān sā lālayatyeva sarvadā ||3.136.70|| lokānavāpya lālityāllalitāśrīstaducyate | trailokyasundarīmenāmupayeme mahāprabhuḥ ||71 || yā loke saubhāgyamayī bhuktimuktiphalapradā | tvameva lakṣmi sañjātā mahālakṣmīḥ subhāgyadā |||72||| tvāmārādhya naro nārī bhaktyā kiṃ kiṃ na vindati | ārādhanaṃ vrataṃ te tad vakṣyāmyatra hitāvaham ||73|| vasantamāsamāsādya tṛtīyāyāṃ tu śuklake | pūrvāhṇe yajamānastu tilaiḥ snānaṃ samācaret ||74|| saubhāgyā lalitā devī vavre nārāyaṇaṃ tadā | tayā sahaiva māṃ nārāyaṇaṃ sampūjayet prage ||75|| tṛtīyāyāṃ phalaiḥ puṣpairdhūpairdīpairnivedanaiḥ | pañcagavyena ca tīrthatoyaiḥ saṃsnāpayecchriyam ||76|| namo lakṣmyai mahālakṣmyai lalitāyai tu mastake | namo devyai mahādevyai lalitāyai mukhe namaḥ ||77|| namo brāhmyai mahābrāhmyai vaiṣṇavyai hṛdaye namaḥ | namo mātre mahāmātre nārāyaṇyai tathodare ||78|| namaḥ śriyai mahāśriyai vāsudevyai kaṭisthale | namo bhāgyai mahābhāgyai saubhāgyāyai urau namaḥ ||79|| namo bhūmnyai mahāśūnyai vyāpikāyai ca pādayoḥ | namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnyai samantataḥ ||3.136.80|| saubhāgyabhavanāyai te namaḥ kāntāvibhūtaye | namo yugalarūpāyai dampatyai te namo namaḥ ||8 1 || sarvasaubhāgyayuktāyai lalitāyai namonamaḥ | evaṃ saṃsnāpya vidhinā vastrālaṃkāramarpayet ||82|| bhūṣaṇāni samastāni śṛṃgārāṇi samarpayet | ghṛtaṃ sindūrakaṃ kṣīraṃ kuṃkumaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā ||83 || jīrakaṃ kajjalaṃ cāpi candanaṃ raktacandanam | haridrāṃ karpūrakaṃ ca kastūrīṃ kaṃkaṇāni ca ||84|| śṛṃkhalāṃ natthikāṃ tantīṃ nūpurormikasaṃyutām | niṣpāvān patrikāṃ pūgīphalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tathā ||85|| śarkarāṃ ca lavaṃgaṃ ca elāṃ saṃsthāpayet puraḥ | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ dadyājjalaṃ sugandhi ca ||86|| ārārtrikaṃ prakuryādvai lalitāyāḥ pradakṣiṇam | namaskāraṃ punaḥ kuryāt puṣpāñjaliṃ samarpayet ||87|| prārthayellalitāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dīyetāṃ bhāgyamuttamam | dampatīrūpamevāpi hyakhaṇḍitasukhāvaham ||88|| rasadhānyādibhojyāni miṣṭānnāni sadā gṛhe | sūpaudanāni śākāni dadhyodanāni yāni ca ||89|| kṣīrodbhavāni sarvāṇi cekṣubhavāni yāni ca | veśavārādikaṃ cāpi mukhavāsādikāni ca ||3.136.90 || śayyāstaraṇayānāni veṣaśṛṃgārakāṇi ca | bhūṣāmbarāṇi sarvāṇi vividhābhūṣaṇāni ca ||91 || yānavāhanarathakā govājigajasadvṛṣāḥ | dāsadāsībhṛtyasakhīvargāḥ svarṇālayāstathā ||92||| bhavanāni vicitrāṇi kṣetrāṇi vāṭikāstathā | mahodyānāni sarvāṇi vaṃśaḥ putrāḥ sutāstathā ||93||| snuṣāśca bāndhavāścāpi yaśo kīrtiśca sampadaḥ | ṛddhiḥ śāntiḥ ratnagajā ārogyaṃ dharma uttamaḥ ||94|| bhaktirjñānaṃ ca dīyantāṃ kṛṣṇau dhāmākṣaraṃ tataḥ | evamabhyarcya tau tatra sthāpayenmaṇḍape tvatha ||95|| havanaṃ tu prakuryādvai cāṣṭottaraśatātmakam | dakṣiṇāṃ ca tato dadyād bhojayedviprasajjanān ||96|| dīnānāthān bhojayecca dadyāddānāni vai tataḥ | parihāraṃ prakurvīta madhyāhne punareva ca ||97|| bhojayed vividhaṃ bhojyaṃ jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ diśet | svāpayedghaṭikāmutthāpayet kṛṣṇāṃ narāyaṇam ||98|| jalaṃ phalaṃ pradadyācca sāyaṃ rātrau prapūjayet| | ārārtrikaṃ sotsavaṃ ca kārayed bhojayettataḥ ||99|| svāpayed bhagavantau tau śayane mṛdule śubhe | sahaiva śayanaṃ caitat saubhāgyaśayanaṃ vratam || 3.136.10 0|| prātarutthāpayed devau pūjayed vidhinā tataḥ | tathā ca dvijadāmpatyaṃ pūjayed vastrabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 101 || saubhāgyāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ suvarṇacaraṇadvayam | dvayoścatuṣṭayaṃ dadyād viprāya sādhave tadā ||1 02|| lalitāṃ gurave dadyāt kṛṣṇaṃ dadyāttu sādhave | yugalaṃ sādhave dadyāt saubhāgyaciratāptaye || 1 03|| evaṃ samvatsaraṃ yāvat tṛtīyāyāṃ samācaret | vatsarānte prakuryācca sūdyāpanaṃ mahattamam || 1 04|| caitre śṛṃgāṭakaṃ dadyād vaiśākhe ghṛtapāyasam | jyeṣṭhe mandārakusumaṃ vṛndāpatraṃ śucau tathā || 1 05|| śrāvaṇe dadhi dadyācca nabhasye tu kuśodakam | kṣīramāśvayuje māsi kārtike navanītakam || 1 06|| mārge māse dvidalāṃ ca pauṣe ghṛtaṃ saśarkaram | māghe kṛṣṇātilān dadyāt pañcagavyaṃ tu phālgune || 1 07|| tulasīkamalādīni sarvamāse matāni vai | evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ nārī kumārī vidhavāpi vā || 1 08|| vratānte śayanaṃ dadyāt sarvopaskarasaṃyutam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇau haimau śayane sthāpayettataḥ || 1 09|| dānaṃ dadyād brāhmaṇāya sādhave vā supūjine | dhānyālaṃkāragodānaṃ dhanaṃ dadyād dvijātaye ||3.136.1 1 0|| evaṃ karoti yaḥ samyak saubhāgyaśayanavratam | sarvān kāmānavāpnoti padaṃ cānantamaśnute || 111 || yastu dvādaśavarṣāṇi saubhāgyaśayanavratam | karoti strī naro vāpi devyanugrahalālitau || 1 12|| pūjyamānau vasetāṃ svaḥ yāvatkalpāyutatrayam | śṛṇuyādvā paṭhedvāpi pradadyādatha vā matim ||1 1 3||| so’pi deveśvaro bhūtvā svarge vasenna saṃśayaḥ | bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnoti śāśvatānandasampadaḥ || 1 14|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne lakṣmīśatadvayanāmajapena pitṛkanyakādīnāṃ sveṣṭaphalāvāptiḥ, lakṣmīsaubhāgyaśayanavratavidhiścetinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 136 ||
<3.137> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ ghaṭalakṣmīvrataṃ tava | ghaṭalakṣmīvratinastu kramāt saptadivaṃ bhavet || 1 || bhūloko’yaṃ divaṃ proktaḥ sampatsukhapramodanaiḥ | bhuvarloko’pi ca divaṃ siddhimatāṃ hi yoginām || 2 || svargādayo divaṃ santi satyāntāḥ sarva eva te | devalokā hi saptaite yato divyagatipradāḥ || 3 || paryāyeṇa tu sarveṣāmādhipatyaṃ tava vratāt | ghaṭalakṣmīvratādeva jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 4 || iha loke śubhaṃ rūpamāyuḥ saubhāgyamuttamam | lakṣmīśca vipulā sampajjāyate te vratādiha || 5 || śṛṇu cātra kathāṃ divyāmagastyasya mahātmanaḥ | purā vahniḥ samājñapto mahendreṇa suradviṣām || 6 || vināśārthaṃ tato vahnirdadāha koṭidānavān | nirdagdhebhyo’vaśiṣṭā ye dānavāstu sahasraśaḥ || 7 || palāyamānāstrastāśca samudraṃ viviśuḥ khalāḥ | tārakaḥ kamalākṣaśca kāladaṃṣṭraḥ parāvasuḥ || 8 || virocanaśca te cābdhau sanniveśamakurvata | aśaktāste ceti matvā vahninā samupekṣitāḥ || 9 || atha kālāntare daityā balamavāpya vai punaḥ | sampīḍayanti te devān manuṣyān saha jaṃgamān || 3.137.1 0|| viprān sādhūn prasampīḍya praviśanti punarjalam | evaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi vīrāḥ pañca ca sapta ca || 11 || jaladurgabalāllakṣmi pīḍayanti jagattrayam | tataḥ punarmahendro’pi vahnaye samupādiśat || 12|| acirād daityanāśārthamabdhireṣa viśuṣyatu | yasmādasmaddviṣāmeṣaḥ śaraṇaṃ varuṇālayaḥ 13|| tasmād bhavān drutamasya kṣayaṃ vidhātu śoṣaṇāt | agniḥ prāha tataḥ śukraṃ samudraśoṣaṇaṃ prati ||14|| adharma eva devendra sāgarasya praśoṣaṇam | asya yojanamātre’pi jīvakoṭiśatāni vai || 15 || nivasanti hi jīvānāṃ mahān prasaṃkṣayo bhavet | pāpaṃ cāsīmakaṃ syānme tatkathaṃ prakaromyaham ||1 6|| evaṃ śrutvā mahendrastu prāha roṣād vacastadā | na dharmādharmasaṃśleṣaṃ prāpnuvantyamarā divi || 17|| bhavān dāhakaro devaḥ pāpalepavivarjitaḥ | tathāpi nājñāṃ vahase śaṣāmi mānuṣo bhava ||18 || athāha pavanaṃ cendrastvaṃ praśoṣaya sāgaram | pavano’pi tathā prāha pāpakṛtyaṃ karomi na || 1 9|| tadendrastaṃ śaśāpāpi bhava tvaṃ mānuṣo’nila | evaṃ śāpaṃ gatau tau ca vaśiṣṭhāgastyanāmakau ||3.137.20 || vahnirjāto’gastyamunirvāyurvasiṣṭha eva ca | kuṃbhād dvau sahajātau vai mitrāvaruṇavīryataḥ ||21 || urvaśī śrīnaranārāyaṇaputryapsarovarā | mitreṇāmantritā kāmād gacchantī cāmbare yadā ||22|| paścād dṛṣṭā varuṇena dhṛtā kāmārthamityapi | kintu sā satyamārgasthā varuṇaṃ nābhyanandata ||23|| mitreṇāhaṃ vṛtā pūrvaṃ tasya bhāryā bhavāmi ha | te bhāryā dharmato nāsmi hyadhunā varuṇa prabho ||24|| āha tāṃ varuṇaścittaṃ mayi nyasya pragamyatām | sāpi mitraṃ gatā mitraḥ śuśrāva ca tayoditam ||25|| cittanyāsaṃ samākarṇya kruddhastatyāja tāṃ tadā | veśyādharmaṃ śritavatī dvābhyāṃ tyaktā hi sā yayau ||26|| saṃkalpajaṃ dhātumugraṃ mitraśca varuṇo’pi ca | urvaśīdarśanotthaṃ vai ghaṭamadhye sasarjatuḥ ||27|| etasminneva kāle tu niminā śrīvasiṣṭhakaḥ | śapto videhabhāvatve videhaḥ san ghaṭe sthitaḥ ||28 || agastyo’pīndraśāpena ghaṭe tatra sthito’bhavat | agniragastyo ghaṭata utpannastatra bālakaḥ ||29|| vāyurvaśiṣṭho ghaṭata utpannastatra bālakaḥ | varuṇāṃśo’gastyakaśca mitrāṃśastu vasiṣṭhakaḥ ||3.137.30 || utpannau jātamātrau tau jātismarau pravedinau | cakratuḥ śāpamuktyarthaṃ ghaṭalakṣmīvrataṃ hyubhau ||3 1 || maṇḍapaṃ kadalīstabhaiḥ kārayāmāsatuśca tau | hāratoraṇamālābhirvastrapuṣpaphalādibhiḥ ||32|| mṛttikākalaśādyaiśca kuṇḍavedībhiranvitam | homasāmagrikāyuktaṃ kāṣṭhāsanādirājitam ||33 || pūjopahārayuktaṃ ca svarṇakalaśarājitam | mṛttikāyā ghaṭaṃ vāriyutaṃ svayonimuttamam ||34|| maṇḍape cānayāmāsatuśca dvau tau pupūjatuḥ | mātaraṃ śrīmahālakṣmīmāhvayāmāsatuśca tau ||35|| sthāpayāmāsatustatra ghaṭe sauvarṇakāritām | pañcāmṛtairjalaiścāpi snāpayāmāsatustataḥ ||36||| bhūṣayāmāsatuḥ śṛṃgārayāmāsaturīśvarīm | veṣayāmāsatū raktāmbarādyairmātaraṃ hi tām ||37|| pūjayāmāsatuḥ puṣpākṣatakuṃkumakajjalaiḥ | sarvavastubhirabhyarcyārārtrikaṃ cakratustathā ||38|| miṣṭānnaṃ pāyasānnaṃ ca bhojayāmāsaturmudā | jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ cāpyarpayāmāsaturādarāt ||39|| suvarṇakalaśaṃ pārśve mālyavastravibhūṣitam | pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ ghṛtapātrasamanvitam ||3.137.40|| tilapatraphalayuktaṃ sthāpayāmāsatuśca tau | aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ paramaṃ brahma śāśvatam ||41 || anādiśrīhariṃ māṃ sthāpayāmāsaturatra ca | dhānyāni vastrabhūṣāśca pātraratnāni sarvathā ||42||| vinyasya pūjayāmāsatuśca gāṃ vatsikāyutām | sarvābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyāṃ śṛṃgakhuraiḥ suvarṇajām ||43 || sakāṃsyadohapātrāḍhyāṃ ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitām | pūjayāmāsatuścāpi puṣpāñjaliṃ nyavāpatuḥ ||44|| tataḥ prasannā mātā śrīghaṭalakṣmīrmahāsatī | pratyakṣābhūttayoragre varārthaṃ tau nyayojayat ||45|| vavrāte tau varaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mātastava prasādataḥ | janmano’smād bhavenmuktirmānuṣāttat tathā kuru ||46|| lakṣmīḥ prāha tadāgastyaṃ daityā vasanti vāridhau | abdhipānottaraṃ muktirmānuṣātte bhaviṣyati ||47|| vasiṣṭho’yaṃ divyadehastvayā sākaṃ bhaviṣyati | lakṣmīḥ prāha punaścāpi varārthaṃ ca tadā muniḥ ||48|| vasiṣṭhaḥ samprayayāce ghaṭalakṣmīvrataṃ śubham | agastyodayadivase prātaḥ śuklatilādibhiḥ ||49|| tīrthajalaiḥ snānamāptaḥ śuklāmbaradharo gṛhī | mṛdghaṭe vā svarṇaghaṭe lakṣmīṃ tvāṃ pūjayettu yaḥ ||3.137.50|| śrīhariṃ ca vasiṣṭhaṃ cāgastiṃ ca pūjayettu yaḥ | āsaptarātraṃ vāpi ca saptadaśasamāśca vā ||51 || pūjayedarghamapyatra dadyāttasya kramāt khalu | bhūrloke ca bhuvarloke svarge mahari vai jane ||52|| tapoloke satyaloke vāso bhavecciraṃ khalu | kalpaṃ kalpaṃ prabhuktvā sa bhogān yāyāttato’kṣaram ||53|| saptārghyakartā prāpnuyāt saptalokān samṛddhikān | namo lakṣmyai mahālakṣmyai viṣṇupatnyai namo namaḥ ||54|| arghyaṃ gṛhāṇa sarveśi dehi saukhyāni sarvaśaḥ | namo nārāyaṇāya śrīpataye haraye namaḥ ||55|| arghyaṃ gṛhāṇa bhagavan dehi saukhyāni sarvaśaḥ | kāśapuṣpapratīkāśāvagnimārutasaṃbhavau ||56|| mitrāvaruṇayoḥ putrau kuṃbhayonī namo’stu vām | evamarghyaṃ ca pūjāṃ ca puṣpāñjaliṃ samarpayet ||57|| tasya lokāḥ śāśvatāste lakṣmi bhavantu sarvadā | yāvadāyuśca yaḥ kuryāttasya vāso’kṣare bhavet ||58|| ityarthitā vaśiṣṭhena kuṃbhalakṣmīḥ prasūstadā | tathāstviti prāha tābhyāṃ śīghraṃ līnābhavat prasūḥ ||59|| munī kṛtvā parihāraṃ tepaturduścaraṃ tapaḥ | tataḥ kālena daityānāṃ vīkṣyopadravamulbaṇam ||3.137.60|| agastyaḥ pītavānabdhiṃ daityā nāśaṃ yayustadā | indrādidevavṛndena hatā naṣṭāḥ suradviṣaḥ ||61 || tato devāḥ prasannā vai brahmādyāścāyayurmunī | yatra tapastepāte tau varārthaṃ preritau ca taiḥ ||62|| agastyaśca varaṃ vavre yadabhīṣṭaṃ tadābhavat | yāvad brahmasahasrāṇāṃ pañcaviṃśatikoṭayaḥ ||63|| vaimānikau bhaviṣyāvo dvāvāvāṃ svargagāminau | vasiṣṭhaḥ saptamadhye syādagastyo dakṣiṇāpathe ||64|| asmattārodaye kuryād yaḥ kaścit pūjanaṃ tu nau | sa saptalokasamrāḍ vai paryāyeṇa bhavediti ||65|| devāḥ prāhustathāstveva yayuste ca yathāgatam | vasiṣṭhāgastyakau cāpi malayādrau gatau tadā ||66|| tataḥ kālāntare’gastyaṃ parśurāmaḥ pratāpavān | samudrasya prapānārthaṃ sarṣigaṇo nyavedayat| ||67|| gokarṇatīrthabhūmyarthaṃ tadāgastyaḥ punaḥ papau | evaṃ kṛtvā mahatkāryaṃ svargaṃ yayatustau munī ||68|| ityetat kathitaṃ lakṣmi ghaṭalakṣmīvrataṃ tava | saptadinaṃ phalāhārātmakaṃ pūjātmakaṃ tava ||69|| agastyasyodaye kāryaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam | evaṃ lakṣmi tava pūjāṃ bhādrapade’ṣṭamīdine ||3.137.70 || mārgaśīrṣe ca vaiśākhe ūrje vā śuklapakṣake | maṇḍapodyānasaṃyuktāmudyāpanasamanvitām ||71 || kariṣyanti narā nāryo yāsyanti te parāṃ gatim | pañcagavyena kṣīreṇa puṣpagandhodakena ca ||72|| madhunā snāpayettvāṃ sampūjayet phalapuṣpakaiḥ | śṛṃgārayed veṣayecca vibhūṣayennīrājayet ||73|| bhojayecca tataḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyāt sumūrtaye | kṣamāṃ yāceta ca namet prārthayed gurave’rpayet ||74|| mahālakṣmyai namaḥ pādau tava gulphau namaḥ śriyai | śokahantryai namo jaṅghe ramāyai jānunī namaḥ ||75|| ūrū maṃgalakāriṇyai vakṣaḥsthalyai namaḥ kaṭim | padmāyai nama udaramuraḥ kāmaśriyai namaḥ ||76|| karau saubhāgyalakṣmyai te bāhūdaramukhaṃ śriyai | kamalāyai namo nāsāṃ padminyai locane namaḥ ||77|| puṣṭyai lalāṭamalakān hiraṇyāyai śiro namaḥ | hariṇyai sukhadālakṣmyai lalitāyai namo namaḥ ||78|| nārāyaṇyai vāsudevyai sampadāyai namo’stu te | sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyaṃ dehi me mātarīśvari ||79|| sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyavratena tava padmaje | mameṣṭaṃ sarvamevāstu kṛpayā tava cābdhije ||3.137.80|| gītamaṃgalanirghoṣān kārayed yajamānakaḥ | suvāsinyaḥ kanyakāśca kuryurgītāni tatra ca ||8 1 || pūjayeyū raktavastrai raktamālyānulepanaiḥ | kusumairakṣatairvārbhirnamaskāraiḥ prabhojanaiḥ ||82|| sindūrakuṃkumatailasārakastūrikāñjanaiḥ | evaṃ sampūjya tāṃ mūrtiṃ dadyācchrīgurave śubhām ||83 || guruṃ sampūjayeccāpi kamalaiścandanādibhiḥ | parihāraṃ tataḥ kuryād bhojayed bālabālikāḥ ||84|| sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyalakṣmīvratamidaṃ param | yaḥ kuryāttasya māṃgalyaṃ bahudhā vai vased gṛhe ||85|| sarvapāpavināśaśca saubhāgyārogyavardhanam | sarvāmodapramodeṣṭānandasaukhyapradaṃ vratam |||86|| athāpyanyad vrataṃ lakṣmi vadāmi sāṃkhyayaugikam | sāṃkhyayogakṛtadīkṣāyutāṃ tvāṃ tatra pūjayet ||87|| pūrṇimāyāṃ tathā caikādaśyāṃ śukle tu pakṣake | sarvamāseṣu sauvarṇāṃ kṛtvā lakṣmīṃ śubhānanām ||88|| raktāmbarāṃ raktalepāṃ raktacandanacarcitām | pāṭalāṃ tvāṃ rattavarṇāsane samyak prapūjayet ||89|| raktakuṃkumasalilaiḥ snāpayet tvāṃ vibhūṣayet | raktapuṣpāmbarai raktahārai raktgphalādibhiḥ ||3.137.90 || raktapuṣpaiḥ pūjayecca raktāṃ nārāyaṇe mayi | bhojayetpūjayeccāpi nīrājayennamettathā ||91 || prārthayed pūjikā tvāṃ ca sāṃkhyayogavratasthitā | raktavastre mahālakṣmi rakte nārāyaṇe sthite ||92|| svāsthyaṃ tyāgaṃ mahāśāntiṃ hareryogaṃ pradehi me | anyebhyaśca viraktāhaṃ raktāhaṃ śrīpatau prabhau |||93|| sāṃkhyayogamahālakṣmīvrataṃ te’tra karomyaham | anena mama saubhāgyaṃ taveva bhavatāddharau ||94|| sarvavighnavināśo’stu sarvānandā bhavantu me | sarve rasāḥ sarvaśreyaḥkalyāṇāni bhavantu me ||95|| ityabhyarthya diśellakṣmīṃ gurave kānakīṃ tathā | ratnabhūṣāmbaradhānyapātrādīni samarpayet ||96|| evaṃ vrataṃ prakartryāstu harerdāsyaṃ prapadyate | bhuktirmuktirbhaveddhastagatā nārāyaṇāśrayāt ||97|| sopavāsaṃ prakartavyaṃ sāṃkhyayaugavrataṃ tvidam | sarvapāpaharaṃ divyadehapradaṃ haripriyam ||98|| haripriyā bhavet sādhvī vratakartrī videhinī | camatkāramayī divyākṣaradhāmagatā bhavet ||99|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne ghaṭalakṣmīvratasyāgastyakṛtasya sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyalakṣmīvratasya, sāṃkhyayogalakṣmīvratasya ca nirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 137 ||
<3.138> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca rasakalyāṇalalitāvrataṃ lakṣmi ca te śṛṇu | dvādaśyāṃ maṇḍapaṃ kuryāt sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam || 1 || pūrayed bahudhānyaiśca kalaśān sthāpayecchubhān | madhyame kalaśe sthāpyā sauvarṇī bhūṣaṇānvitā || 2 || rasakalyāṇalalitālakṣmīḥ rasapradāyinī | māghamāse śuklapakṣe dvādaśyāṃ lalitāṃ śriyam || 3 || snāpayenmadhunā cekṣurasena ca ghṛtena ca | dadhnā dugdhena ca tīrthajalaiḥ saṃsnāpayettataḥ || 4 || bhūṣāmbarāṇi dadyācca candanākṣatakuṃkumam | śṛṃgāradravyamevāpi diśet puṣpādikāni ca || 5 || dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ nīrājanaṃ tathārpayet | prārthayed dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt puṣpāṃjaliṃ samarpayet || 6 || evaṃ sampūjya vidhivat sādhūn viprān prapūjayet| | pūjayed dvijadāmpatyaṃ dadyād dānaṃ dhanādikam || 7 || bhojayedannapānādyairmadhureṇa rasena ca | suvarṇakamalaṃ vastrayugalaṃ kalaśaṃ diśet || 8 || kalaśaṃ śarkarāpūrṇaṃ rasapūrṇaṃ diśecca vā | rasaṃ vidyād ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi madhu ca śarkarām || 9 || laḍḍukān bhojayeccāpi saṃyāvamatha pūrikāḥ | ghārikāmapyapūpām̐śca piṣṭāpūpām̐śca maṇḍakān ||3.138.1 0|| kṣīraṃ śākaṃ pāyasānnaṃ dadhyannaṃ bhojayettathā | kamale mādhavi lakṣmi mātaḥ rame samudraje ||1 1 || bhadre jaye kambhare śri mahālakṣmi sukhaṃ kuru | padmini padmaje kṛṣṇe nārāyaṇi narāyaṇi ||12|| ādye śrīlalite kṛṣṇapriye brāhmi namo’stu te | vāsudevi mahādevi hiraṇye dhanarūpiṇi ||13|| sarvarase sarvasukhe sarvakalyāṇadāyini | sampadaṃ modamatyantaṃ dehi me tvadvratena vai ||14|| evamabhyarcya sauvarṇāṃ lakṣmīṃ rasapradāyinīm | rasakalyāṇalalitāṃ dāne śrīgurave diśet ||15|| pañcaratnādisahitāmaṅguṣṭhamātranirmitām | caturbhujāṃ cakraśaṃkhamālāpūjāsamanvitām || 16|| tathā gomithunaṃ dadyād viprāya tu mahātmane | sālaṃkāraṃ savastraṃ ca sadohaṃ dugdhadaṃ śubham || 17|| anena vidhinā yastu rasakalyāṇinīśriyaḥ | vrataṃ kuryāt sa pāpebhyastat kṣaṇādeva mucyate || 18|| navārbudasahasrāṇi samāḥ svarge mahīyate | suvarṇaṃ kamalaṃ lakṣmīṃ māsi māsi dadannṛpaḥ || 1 9|| agniṣṭomasahasrasya phalaṃ svarge samaśnute | nārī kanyā ca kurute vidhavā vā satī ca yā ||3.138.20 || agniṣṭomaphalaṃ prāpya saubhāgyārogyamāpnuyāt | matidātāpi vai svarge modate devatāgṛhe ||21 || śṛṇu lakṣmi vrataṃ cānyat tavaiva daśamīdine | āṣāḍhe śuklapakṣe vai cāturmāsyāgrage dine ||22|| prātareva samutthāya snātvā dhyāyeddhariṃ prabhum | tataścārdrānandalakṣmīṃ sauvarṇīṃ pūjayed vratī ||23|| aṃguṣṭhamātrāṃ sadvastrāṃ bhūṣāśṛṃgāraśobhitām | nārāyaṇīśriyaṃ darbhagandhodakaiḥ sucandanaiḥ ||24|| snāpayecchuklapuṣpaiśca kuṃkumākṣatabhojanaiḥ | naivedyairbhojayeccāpi nīrājayet kṣamāpayet ||25|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena sahitāṃ śriyam | prārthayedbhāvahṛdayaiḥ sveṣṭadaṃ sveṣṭadāṃ tadā ||26|| mahālakṣmyai namaḥ pādau mahāviṣṇo namo’stu te | śokahantryai namo jaṅghe sukhadāya namo’stu te ||27|| kamalāyai namaścorū ānandāya namo hare | īśvariṇyai namaḥ kaṭiṃ sampatpradāya te namaḥ ||28|| mādhavyai ca namo nābhau svarṇavarṇāya te namaḥ | stanau poṣaṇakāriṇyai namo viśvaṃbharāya te ||29|| kaṇṭhe namaḥ sarasvatyai nīlakaṇṭhāya te namaḥ | karau kamaladhāriṇyai nārāyaṇāya te namaḥ ||3.138.30 || bāhū namo rakṣayitryai sudarśanadharāya ca | cāndryai candrānane naumi hariṃ vahnimukhāya ca ||3 1 || netre kṛpāpravarṣiṇyai karuṇānilayāya ca | bhruvau namaḥ kṣemadāyai kuśalakāriṇe namaḥ ||32||| lalāṭe dhanarūpāyai svarṇavarṇāya te namaḥ | mukuṭe sarvaratnāyai sakaustubhāya te namaḥ ||33|| sarvakāyau sarvavāsau sarvaiśvaryasamanvitau | sarvakāmapradau vande ārdrāśryānandamādhavau ||34|| sampadā copakaraṇairdhanairdhānyai rasādibhiḥ | bhūṣāmbarādibhiścāpi gṛhamārdraṃ prapūritam ||35|| kurutaṃ strīdāsadāsībhṛtyāpatyasuśobhitam | divyasādhanaśobhaṃ ca dhenuvājigajānvitam ||36|| udyānavāṭīkṣetrāḍhyaṃ yaśomānapravardhitam | yānavimānavāhāḍhyaṃ śiṣyapraśiṣyasatprajam ||37|| modapramodasaukhyāḍhyaṃ samutsāhotsavānvitam | vādyagītimahāsatradānapānasamanvitam ||38|| dharmakarmādhvarayuktaṃ nityaṃ ca bahudakṣiṇam | vighnaśūnyaṃ pañcayajñaparaṃ kurutaṃ madgṛham ||39|| snuṣābhiḥ parito ramyāṃ sādhusādhvīvirājitam | parameśamahābhaktipravāhitaṃ nirantaram ||3.138.40|| ante divyarasāḍhye vāmakṣare vasatiṃ ca me | evamabhyarthya ca puṣpāñjaliṃ datvā visarjayet ||41 || lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ cārdrānandau śrīgurave diśet | ratnahīrakadhānyāni dvijātibhyo diśettathā ||42|| bhojayed bālabālādyā diśecca dakṣiṇāḥ śubhāḥ | śaṃkhacakre sakaṭake svastikāṃkuśacāmarān ||43|| dadyāt satpuruṣāyāpi miṣṭānnāmbarakāṇi ca | ghṛtapātrāṇi pātrāṇi sahiraṇyakāni sandiśet ||44|| śarkarāsaktupātrāṇi caturmāsaṃ diśettathā | tilapātrāṇi pūrṇāni rasapātrāṇi yāni ca ||45|| gandhodakaṃ puṣpavāri candanaṃ kuṃkumodakam | apakvaṃ dadhi dugdhaṃ ca gośṛṃgodakamityapi ||46|| tulasīṃ kamalaṃ dadyāccāturmāsye sadārcane | dāne sarvaṃ pradadyācca vadeccāpi śriyāḥ puraḥ ||47|| lakṣmi me prīyatāṃ nityaṃ pāpanāśāya mādhavī | saubhāgyāya prasannāstu lalite me sukhāya ca ||48|| evamuktvā diśet sarvaṃ kārtike daśamīdine | hiraṇyakamalaṃ datvā caikādaśyāṃ prage punaḥ ||49|| pūjayitvā vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ kuryād diśed dvijātaye | satūlāvaraṇāṃ śayyāṃ lakṣmīrme prīyatāmiti ||3.138.50 || ārdrānanaramānārāyaṇavrataṃ tvidaṃ mahat | tenehāmutra ca sadānandamāpnoti sampadaḥ ||51 || bhuktvā svargān cirasthām̐śca paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt | śroturvaktuśca saṃsmartuścāpyānando bhaved dhruvaḥ ||52|| gṛhe sve mahadānandaśatāni cānubhūya ca | bhūyo lakṣmīpadaṃ yāti śrīpuraṃ dhāma caiśvaram ||53|| śṛṇu lakṣmi vrataṃ te’nyacchāradeyavratottamam | bṛhaspatestu divase kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ tava ||54|| maṇḍapaṃ subhagaṃ kṛtvā toraṇādisamanvitam | sauvarṇakalaśairdhānyaiścāsanādibhirūrjitam ||55|| tanmadhye kārayed ramyaṃ gajāsanaṃ suvarṇajam | tatra pīṭhe sthāpayecca śāradākhyāṃ ramāṃ satīm ||56|| dvibhujāṃ lalitālakṣmīṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām | vīṇākamalahastāṃ ca mukuṭādisuśobhanām ||57|| atha pārśve sthāpayecca gāyatrīṃ ca sarasvatīm | vādyayuktāṃ divyarūpāṃ vedapustakadhāriṇīm ||58|| evaṃ devītrayaṃ tatra pūjayed gandhakuṃkumaiḥ | akṣataiḥ śvetapuṣpādyairdhūpadīpādivastubhiḥ |||59|| kṣīraṃ ca pāyasaṃ siddhānnaṃ miṣṭaṃ bhojayettathā | miṣṭavāri sugandhāḍhyaṃ pāyayecchītalaṃ tathā ||3.138.60|| tāmbūlakaṃ pradadyācca nīrājanaṃ tataścaret | prārthayecchāradālakṣmīṃ vāṇī me
