prīyatāmiti ||61 || kṛpayā te bhaviṣyāmi vidyāvārinidhiḥ paraḥ | rasanāgre mama nityaṃ sarasvatī vasatvapi ||62|| iha loke sadānandamavāpnuyāṃ tathā kuru | vedāḥ śāstrāṇi śastrāṇi gītanṛtyādikaṃ ca yat ||63|| na vihīnaṃ tvayā vāṇi tathā me santu siddhayaḥ | vāṇī medhā dharā puṣṭirgaurī tuṣṭiḥ prabhā matiḥ ||64|| etābhiḥ pāhi cāṣṭābhistanūbhirmāṃ narāyaṇi | evaṃ samprārthya dānāni dadyāt puṣpāñjaliṃ tathā ||65|| bhojayed bālabālāśca sādhusādhvīśca yoṣitaḥ | dhanavastrāṇi dadyācca kamaṇḍaluṃ ca pustakam ||66|| vādyadānaṃ prakurvīta śṛṃgārābharaṇārpaṇam | parihāraṃ prakurvīta gurave śriyamarpayet ||67|| maunavratena bhuñjīta sāyaṃ prātaśca ca vai vratī | guruvāre pratimāsaṃ māsāstrayodaśa vratam ||68|| sandhyāyāṃ ca tathā maunaṃ rakṣan vratī samācaret | nāntarā bhojanaṃ kuryāt samāpte ca vrate tataḥ ||69|| udyāpanaṃ paraṃ kuryānmahotsavasamanvitam | vastrayugmaṃ striyai dadyād viprāyai bhojanānvitam ||3.138.70|| godānaṃ gṛhadānaṃ ca kuryād yathādhanaṃ vratī | anena vidhinā kṛtvā pāyasādi prabhojanam ||71 || vidyāvān dhanavān miṣṭakaṇṭho vratī prajāyate | śāradāyāḥ prasādena brahmaloke mahīyate ||72|| naro nārī kumārī vā kurute śāradāvratam | brahmaloke vased brāhmī yāvatkalpāyutatrayam ||73 || vidyādānaṃ prakuryād yo vrataṃ kṛtvā dhanārpaṇaiḥ | vidvān vidyāṃ pradadyācca śāradāvratavāṃśca yaḥ ||74|| vidyādharapure so’pi vaset kalpāyutatrayam | ante lakṣmīpuraṃ yāti brahmākṣaraṃ vrajettataḥ ||75|| athānyatte śubhaṃ lakṣmi kalyāṇīkamalāvratam | aśeṣayajñaphaladamaśeṣāghavināśanam ||76|| aśeṣaduṣṭaśamanamaśeṣasurapūjitam | pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca maṃgalānāṃ sumaṃgalam ||77|| daivataṃ daivatānāṃ ca purāṇānāṃ purātanam | māghaśuklaikādaśikāvrataṃ kalyāṇadaṃ śubham ||78|| ghṛtenābhyañjanaṃ kṛtvā daśamyāṃ ca tilairjalaiḥ | snātvā prātarharikṛṣṇaṃ pūjayet sarvavastubhiḥ ||79|| namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pādayornamaḥ | sarvātmane namaḥ ke ca vaikuṇṭhāya namo mukhe ||3.138.80|| śrīvatsadhāriṇe vakṣaḥsthale namo muhurmuhuḥ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmavaradānapradhāriṇe ||8 1 || namo bāhuṣu sarveṣūdare dāmodarāya ca | meḍhre namaḥ sukhadāya ūrvoḥ saubhāgyadāya ca ||82|| jānvornamo bhūtadhrāya jaṃghayormokṣadāya ca | pādayoḥ pāpanāśāya śrīkṛṣṇāya namo namaḥ ||83|| namaḥ kalyāṇakāriṇyai kamalāyai namo namaḥ | namaḥ śrīlalitālakṣmyai jayālakṣmyai namo namaḥ ||84|| namaḥ śrīmāṇikīlakṣmyai nārāyaṇīśriyai namaḥ | namaḥ śrīsukhadālakṣmyai śivarājñīśriyai namaḥ |||85|| namaḥ śrīpārvatīlakṣmyai kāntāpramāśriyai namaḥ | namaḥ śrīkambharālakṣmyai mahālakṣmīśriyai namaḥ ||86|| namaḥ śrīsantuṣṭilakṣmyai kārṣṇīśriyai namo namaḥ | namaḥ śrīrādhikālakṣmyai ramālakṣmyai namo namaḥ ||87|| evaṃ natvā ca govindaṃ śriyaṃ natvā punaḥ punaḥ | sarvopacārakaiścobhau kalyāṇadau prapūjayet ||88|| gandhairmālyairdhūpadīpairbhakṣyairnānāvidhairapi | jalaistāmbūlakaiścārārtrikaiḥ puṣpārpaṇaistathā ||89|| prīyatāṃ mama gopālaḥ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | prīyatāṃ mama kalyāṇīmahālakṣmīnarāyaṇī ||3.138.90|| evamuccārya śayane sthāpayet parameśvarī | madhyāhne pūjayeccāpi bhojayecca niśāmukhe ||91 || sotsavaṃ pūjayeccāpi bhojayet pāyasādikam | suptvā caikādaśīprātarutthāya snānamācaret ||92|| pūjayed vidhinā lakṣmīṃ kalyāṇīṃ maṇḍape śubhe | sarvatobhadrake ramye maṇḍale viṣṇunā saha ||93 || pūjayitvā ca godāne śayyādānaṃ ghaṭārpaṇam | lakṣmyarpaṇaṃ ratnabhūṣāmbarapātradhanārpaṇam ||94|| dhānyabhojanabhogyādyarpaṇaṃ kuryād vratī prage | bhojayechrīmahālakṣmīṃ dugdhaṃ phalādikaṃ śubham ||95|| madhyāhne pūjayeccāpi bhojayet pāyasādikam | sāyaṃ sampūjayeccāpi rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret ||96|| dvādaśyāṃ prātarevāpi prapūjya vidhinā diśet | gurave sādhave sādhvyai dānāni ca dvijātaye ||97|| bhojayet sumṛṣṭamiṣṭānnāni viprān satastathā | bālakān bālikā nārīḥ sādhūn saṃbhojayettathā ||98|| dadyād dānāni bahūni parihāraṃ tataścaret | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāmimāṃ vadet ||99|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccānumodanāt | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi kalyāṇāni bahūni ca || 3.138.1 00|| purājanmani cābhīrīkanyā kalyāṇinīvratam | kṛtvā nārāyaṇaputrī ūrvaśī samajāyata || 101 || purā vaiśyakuṭumbotthā pulomakanyakā tvidam | vrataṃ kṛtvā mahendrāṇī vyajāyata diveśvarī || 10 2|| purā kṛtvā vrataṃ caitat suraputro dvijastataḥ | sūryo babhūva svargeśaḥ sahasraraśmivān prabhuḥ ||1 03|| tasmāt kalyāṇikālakṣmīvrataṃ sveṣṭottamapradam | māghe dinatrayaṃ kāryaṃ sarvakalyāṇasampradam || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne rasakalyāṇalalitāvratasya, ārdrānandaramānārāyaṇavratasya, śāradeyavratasya, kalyāṇīkamalāvratasya ca nirūpaṇanāmā aṣṭatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 38||
<3.139> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca āgatānāṃ hi śokānāmapanodārthameva yat | vrataṃ syāttatkathayātra dayayā me hare prabho || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca puṇye cāśvayuje māsi śukle dvādaśikāvratam | śokanāśārthamevāsti viśokadvādaśīvratam || 2 || daśamyāṃ laghubhug bhūtvā pṛthvīśayanamācaret | brahmacārī bhaveccāpi prātarutthāya māṃ smaret || 3 || snātvā sampūjayenmāṃ caikādaśyāṃ vratamācaran | nirāhāraḥ phalāhāraścaikabhojī ca vā bhavet || 4 || aśokalalitāṃ svarṇamayīṃ śrīkṛṣṇaśobhitām | kārayitvā pūjayitvā bhojayitvā gajāsane || 5 || svāpayejjāgaraṃ kuryānmaṇḍape kadalīkṛte | dvādaśyāṃ prātarutthāya snātvā saṃpūjayetpunaḥ || 6 || snānaṃ sarvauṣadhaiḥ kuryāt pañcagavyajalairapi | pītāmbaradharo lakṣmīṃ pūjayecchrīśamutpalaiḥ || 7 || viśokāyai namaḥ pādau varadāyai tu jaṅghayoḥ | jānvoḥ śriyai namaścāpi sakthnorabdhijayoṣite || 8 || gupte viśokakartryai ca kaṭyāṃ māyai namo namaḥ | udare poṣayitryai ca namo bhāyai ca pārśvayoḥ || 9 || nābhau namaḥ sarvadhartryai hṛdaye’rdhāśriyai namaḥ | kaṇṭhe vāṇyai namo vakṣaḥsthale kāntāśriyai namaḥ || 3.139.10 || bāhvornamo rakṣayitryai lalitāyai tu hastayoḥ | cāndryai mukhe namaścāpi kamalāyai tu netrayoḥ || 11 || nāsāyāṃ surabhidevyai lalāṭe mohinīśriyai | karṇayorvyāpikāyai te namo mūrdhni mahāśriyai || 12|| maṇḍale sthaṇḍile lakṣmīpratimāsannidhau harim | svarṇamūrtiṃ pūjayecca śrīpatiṃ māṃ viśokinam || 1 3|| namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pādayornamaḥ | namaḥ kṛṣṇāya kāntāya jaṃghayoste namo namaḥ || 14|| namaḥ śrīvāsudevāya jānvoste ca namo namaḥ | namo nārāyaṇāyeti sakthnoste bhagavannamaḥ || 15|| namaścānandarūpāya meḍhre te ca namo namaḥ | namaḥ kaṭyāṃ naranārāyaṇāya te namo namaḥ ||16|| udare te namo viśvaṃbharāya bhagavannamaḥ | pārśvayoḥ rāmakṛṣṇābhyāṃ namo namaḥ namo namaḥ || 17|| nābhau te padmanābhāya hṛdaye haṃsayogine | kaṇṭhe te nīlakaṇṭhāya vakṣasi brahmaṇe namaḥ ||18|| bāhvoścakradharāyāpi karayoḥ śaṃkhadhāriṇe | mukhe rūpābhirūpāya netrayoḥ kamalākṣiṇe || 1 9|| nāsāyāṃ sarvagandhāya lalāṭe gururūpiṇe | karṇayoḥ śrutikartre te namo mūrdhni śikhāvate ||3.139.20 || ityabhyarcyāpi govindaṃ phalamālyānulepanaiḥ | śūrpaṃ saṃsthāpya purato lakṣmīṃ māṃ tatra sannyaset ||21 || namo mokṣapramodānāṃ dātṛbhyāṃ sarvasampadām | namaḥ śokaparihārakartṛbhyāṃ sarvadā namaḥ |||22| viśokau duḥkhanāśāya viśokau varadau ca me | viśokau mama sampattyai viśokau sarvasiddhaye ||23|| bhavatāṃ mama śokānāṃ sarveṣāṃ nāśakau prabhū | śuklāmbaraiḥ samāveṣṭya śūrpaṃ sampūjayet phalaiḥ ||24|| vastrairnānāvidhaistadvat suvarṇakamalena ca | pūjayitvā bhojayecca dugdhapākādikaṃ śubham ||25|| trikālaṃ pūjayeccāpi kamalairbhojayedapi | rajanyāṃ ca vratī śītaṃ darbhodakaṃ pibecchuci ||26|| tatastu jāgaraṃ gītanṛtyavādyānvitaṃ caret | prātaḥ prapūjayellakṣmīmaśokāṃ śrīpatiṃ tathā ||27|| dampatīṃ pūjayeccāpi viprāṇāṃ vidhinā tataḥ | vastrabhūṣābhojyapātraśṛṃgāraśāṭikā diśet ||28|| dhanadānāni ratnānāṃ dhenūnāmarpaṇāni ca | yathāśakti prakuryācca bhojayed bālabālikāḥ ||29|| sādhūn sādhvīrbhojayecca dadyādannāni sarvataḥ | parihāraṃ prakuryācca dakṣiṇaḥ pradiśettathā ||3.139.30 || anena vidhinā kuryād viśokālalitāvratam | viśokādvādaśīrūpaṃ śokā naśyanti tasya vai ||31 || dhenudānaṃ sopadhānaśayyādānaṃ dhanārpaṇam | prakuryācca lalitāśrīlakṣmīṃ stuvīta bhāvataḥ ||32|| yathā na lakṣmīḥ sampacca māṃ parityajya gacchati | tathā surūpatārogyamaśokaḥ santu me sadā ||33 || yathā bhaktirbhavedagryā śrīkṛṣṇavallabhe mama | yathā kṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇaḥ salakṣmīko mama gṛhe ||34|| sadā vasettathā śūrpalakṣmīdānaṃ karomi ca | suvarṇakamalaṃ ramyaṃ karavīraṃ ca kuṃkumam ||35|| ketakīṃ sinduvāraṃ ca mallikāṃ kesaraṃ tathā | kajjalaṃ cālaktakaṃ ca candanaṃ ca kadambakam ||36|| rañjanaṃ gandhitailaṃ ca gandhasāraṃ dadāmi ca | sarvaśṛṃgārapuṣpāṇi dadāmi saukhyahetave ||37|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇātkaraṇādapi | bhuktirmuktirbhavedeva viśokalalitāvratāt ||38|| atha kṛṣṇalālanākhyaṃ vrataṃ vacmi ca te rame | vibhūtayo bhavantyeva kṛṣṇalālanasadvratāt ||39|| kārtike caitrake vaiśākhake mārge ca phālgune | āṣāḍhe śuklake dinatrayātmakaṃ vrataṃ tvidam ||3.139.40|| sulaghubhug daśamyāṃ tu rātrau śīlavratī bhavet | kṛtvā sāyantanīṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇīyānniyamaṃ vratī ||41 || ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraṃ kariṣye’haṃ vrataṃ tviti | namo nārāyaṇāyeti prātarutthāya cintayet ||42|| snātvaikādaśikāprātarmaṇḍape pūjayet prabhum | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ puruṣottamam ||43|| śuklapuṣpākṣatavārikuṃkumacandanādibhiḥ | namo vibhūtaye pādau namo’śokāya jānunī ||44|| namaḥ kṛṣṇayetyūrū ca viśvamūrte namaḥ kaṭim | kandarpāya namo meḍhraṃ phalaṃ nārāyaṇāya ca ||45|| dāmodarāyetyudaraṃ vāsudevāya ca stanau | mādhavāyetyuro viṣṇoḥ kaṇṭhamutkaṇṭhine namaḥ ||46|| śrīdharāya mukhaṃ keśān keśavāyeti mastakam | pṛṣṭhaṃ śārṅgadharāyeti śravaṇau śrutivedine ||47|| haraye śaṃkhacakrāsigadājalajapāṇaye | śiraḥ sarvātmane tasmai nama ityabhipūjanam ||48|| matsyamutpalasaṃyuktaṃ haimaṃ kṛtvā tu śaktitaḥ | udakuṃbhe nyasettacca dāne prapūjya vai diśet ||49||| guḍapātraṃ tilairyuktaṃ sitavastrābhiveṣṭitam | phalāni vividhānyeva dāne prapūjya cārpayet ||3.139.50|| ārārtrikaṃ prakuryācca vibhūtiśrīśrīkṛṣṇayoḥ | naivedyāni vicitrāṇi prātarmadhye niśāmukhe ||51 || datvā prasvāpayeccāpi gītavāditrakotsavaiḥ | jāgaraṇaṃ vratī kuryāt prātaḥ snātvā prapūjyet |||52|| dvādaśyāṃ prārthayeccāpi padmaṃ dadyād dvijāya tu | udakuṃbhaṃ saratnaṃ ca gāṃ dadyād gurave tathā ||53|| yathā na mucyase kṛṣṇa sadā sarvavibhūtibhiḥ | tathā māmuddharāśeṣaduḥkhasaṃsārasāgarāt ||54|| śayyāṃ dadyād dhanaṃ dadyād grāmaṃ kṣetraṃ gṛhādikam | guruṃ sampūjya vidhivad bhūṣāvastrāṇi cārpayet |||55|| adhanaḥ pūjayetpuṣpairbhojanānnaṃ diśed vratī | anena vidhinā yastu kṛṣṇalālanasadvratam ||56|| vibhūtisampradaṃ kuryāttasyarddhayaḥ pade pade | pāpāni tasya naśyanti pitṝṇāṃ tārayecchatam ||57|| janmanāṃ śatasāhasraṃ na śokaphalabhāg bhavet | na tu vyādhirbhavettasya na dāridryaṃ na bandhanam ||58 || yāvad yugasahasrāṇāṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ bhavet | tāvat svarge vaseccāpi bhūpatiḥ saḥ punarbhavet ||59|| vrataṃ kṛtvā harerdhāma prayātyeva na saṃśayaḥ | sarvān kāmānaśnute ca kṛṣṇena hariṇā saha ||3.139.60|| śṛṇu lakṣmi kalpe rathantare’bhūllubdhako hyaghī | paruṣākhyaḥ sa māṃsado durgandhaścātipāpavān ||61 || bhāryāpyasyātiduṣṭā ca vyabhicāraparāyaṇā | jīvahiṃsāparau tau tvekadā vane sarovarāt ||62|| padmānyādāya bahūni vikrayārthaṃ tu vaidiśam | nagaraṃ yayatuścāpi vikrayo na vyajāyata ||63|| nirāśau tāvatā rātrau kṣudhitau śramitāvubhau | prāsādasannidhau mārge suptau śuśruvatuḥ śanaiḥ ||64|| maṇḍape śrīhareḥ pūjāśabdān veśyākṛtān śubhān | māghe rātrau śuklapakṣe caikādaśyāṃ varāṃganā ||656|| gaṇikānaṃgavatīti jagau tadā sugītikāḥ | pūjayitvā tadā rātrau dānaṃ dadau tu sā bahu ||66 || gurave sādhave vedaviprāya śayanādikam | lavaṇācalamevāpi mūrtiṃ viṣṇostu kānakīm ||67|| dhanānyapi bahūni ca dhānyāni vividhāni ca | alaṃkṛtya hṛṣīkeśaṃ sauvarṇāmbarapādapam ||68|| tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā tatastābhyāmidaṃ hi pariniścitam | imāni kamalānyatra pūjāyāṃ dadva eva ha ||69|| evaṃ bhaktyā dattavantau veśyāpi ca dhanaṃ śatam | dātuṃ samārabhatāpi tau tu jagrahaturna tat ||3.139.70|| dattamannaṃ bhojanārthaṃ tau tu jagrahaturna tat | prasaṃgādupavāsasya māhātmyaṃ saṃviditya vai ||71 || jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtavantau prātardvādaśikābhavat | prabhāte veśyā dattā śayyā salavaṇācalā ||72|| gṛhāṇi gurave bhaktyā viprebhyo dvādaśāpi ca | vastrālaṃkārasaṃyuktā gāvaśca vatsikāyutāḥ ||73|| bhojanaṃ ca suhṛnmitradīnāndhakṛpaṇaiḥ samam | lubdhakena tathā nāryā dṛṣṭametatprapūjanam ||74|| śrīharerdvādaśikāyāṃ prasādaḥ śarkarātmakaḥ | caraṇāmṛtasalilaṃ gṛhītaṃ ca tataḥ param ||75|| yayatuḥ svagṛhaṃ tau ca veśyāpi svagṛhaṃ gatā | bhaktimantastrayaste vai kālena nidhanaṃ gatāḥ ||76|| puṣkaraprārpaṇāttatra keśavārpaṇasatphalāt | vinaṣṭāśeṣapāpaśca puṇyavān lubdhakaḥ sa tu ||77|| puṣkaravāhano rājābhavat puṣkarakhaṇḍake | rājño nāmnā mahākhaṇḍaḥ puṣkarākhyo’bhavat purā ||78|| bhaktyā tuṣṭena hariṇā kṛṣṇalālanasadvratāt | vratasantuṣṭayā lakṣmyā vibhūtyā bhūbhṛte’rpitam ||79|| kamalaṃ kāñcanaṃ ramyaṃ kāmadaṃ kāmagaṃ param | lokaiḥ samastairnagaravāsibhiḥ kamalena saḥ ||3.139.80|| vimānākhyena nākaṃ sadvīpāni vyacarannṛpaḥ | saptamaḥ puṣkarasyāsya dvīpaḥ puṣkaranāmakaḥ ||81|| puṣpavāhananāmāpi puṣkarāsana ityapi | khyātiṃ prāpa tathā rājñī nārīsahasrapūjitā |||82|| nāmnā lāvaṇyavatīti babhūva kamalāsamā | putrāstasyāmayutaṃ sambabhūvuḥ puṣkarasya vai ||83|| yā ca veśyā sāpi jātā sapatnī bhūbhṛto vadhūḥ | dehānte nṛpatiścāpi lavaṇyā ca priyā hyubhau ||84|| yayatuścākṣaraṃ dhāma mama lakṣmi paraṃ padam | sapatnī yā tu veśyābhūt sā tyaktvā yoṣito vapuḥ ||85|| kāmadevasya vai patnī prītiḥ ratyāḥ sapatnikā | lokeṣvānandajananī vyajāyata sureśvarī ||86|| kṛṣṇalālanasaṃjñaṃ ca vibhūtidvādaśīvratam | puṣkarapuṣpasaṃjñaṃ vā vratametadudīritam ||87|| yathākathañcitkamale kamalairdvādaśī tithiḥ | hariṃ prapūjya kartavyā deyaṃ dānaṃ ca dakṣiṇāḥ ||88|| na vittaśāṭhyaṃ kurvīta bhaktyā diśed yathādhanam | suvarṇakamalaṃ yadvā deyaṃ padmaṃ jalodbhavam ||89|| deyaṃ vā sthalakamalaṃ kamaleśaḥ prasīdati | dadāti sārvabhaumaṃ ca rājyaṃ svargaṃ divaṃ param ||3.139.90 || satyaṃ dadāti vā sauraṃ cāndraṃ brāhmaṃ padaṃ ca vā | vairājaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vāpi padaṃ śrīpuramityapi ||91 || vaikuṇṭhaṃ vāpi golokaṃ cāvyākṛtaṃ tathāmṛtam | akṣaraṃ paramaṃ dhāma brahmadhāma dadātyapi ||92|| ahaṃ vibhūtinātho’smi dadāmi pūjakāya vai | anantaguṇakaṃ lakṣmi vibhūtidvādaśīvrataiḥ ||93|| cakravartinṛpā lakṣmi ye ye bhavanti bhūtale | jātāḥ pūrveṣu kalpeṣu vibhūtidvādaśīvrataiḥ ||94|| kamalaṃ kamalāsthānaṃ sauvarṇaṃ tu mayā saha | kamalasya pradānena kamalāsahitastvaham ||95|| vasāmi dātari cāpi mamāṃśena cirāyuṣi | cakracihnaṃ pradadāmi kare vai cakravartinaḥ ||96|| madhyāṃgulidvayoḥ śaṃkhau śeṣāṇāṃ cakrakāṣṭakam | sākṣānnārāyaṇasyaivaṃ santi cakrāṇi padmaje ||97|| padmaṃ kare pade padmaṃ cakraṃ vā cakravartinaḥ | evaṃ kare dhvajacihnaṃ dhvajadāturdadāmi vai ||98|| triśūlārpaṇakartuśca triśūlaṃ pradadāmi ca | dhanuṣyadātuḥ saśaraṃ dhanuṣyaṃ pradadāmi ca ||99|| matsyadātuḥ kare matsyaṃ dadāmi sarvaśobhanam | svastikasya pradātuśca svastikaṃ pradadāmi ca || 3.139.10 0|| suvarṇānāṃ dhvajādīnāṃ dātre dadāmi sarvathā | sasāgarāṃ pṛthivīṃ vai cakravartitvamityapi || 101 || yasya dakṣakare syuśca dhvajaḥ śūlo dhanuḥ śaraḥ | mīnaḥ svastika ete ṣaṭ so’haṃ nārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 1 02|| lakṣmi sādhusvarūpeṇa hṛdaye tvāṃ nidhāya ca | vāmasakthni pāṇḍurābhāṃ dhṛtvā vasāmi bhūtale || 1 03|| adṛśyā tvaṃ janairlakṣmi matsevāyā virājase | tadā sādhusvarūpe cādhunā tvaṃ pṛthageva yā || 1 04|| tvaṃ vibhūtisvarūpāsi vratairvibhūtidāyinī | vāmahaste daṇḍadīrgharekhā me| dharmabodhinī || 1 05|| pādayorubhayorurdhvarekhe me vyāpike dvayoḥ | dhāmasṛṣṭyorantarātmabodhinyau te’pi tadvidhe || 1 06|| madbhaktasya kṛpayā me cihnametad bhavedapi | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya vibhūtiphalamāpnuyāt || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne viśokalalitādvādaśīvratasya, vibhūtilalitākṛṣṇalālanavratasya ca nirūpaṇam puṣkaravāhanākhyasya cakravartino dṛṣṭāntaḥ cakravarticihnāni ceti nirūpaṇanāmā navatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 139 ||
<3.140> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca bhagavan pāvanānyeva vratāni kathitāni me | navanavāni cānyāni śiṣṭānyapi nivedaya || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca bahūni santi kamale vratāni mokṣadānyapi | bhuktidānyapi bahudhā vadāmi śṛṇu tānyapi || 2 || phalecchayā vihitāni bhogadāni bhavanti vai | mama prasannatārthaṃ tu kṛtāni mokṣadāni hi || 3 || samvatsaraṃ naktabhojī naktavrataṃ samīritam | kārtikādvā hyaṣāḍhādvā samārabheta tadvratī || 4 || ekādaśīṃ samārabhya varṣe pūrṇe tu dhenuyuk | cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ haimaṃ dadyācchrīgurave’rpaṇe || 5 || susādhūn bhojayeccāpi vratodyāpanamācaret | vastradānāni dadyācca viṣṇuloke sa modate || 6 || ekabhaktaṃ vrataṃ kuryānmadhyāhne bhojanātmakam | devāya sarvaṃ prārpyaiva bhuñjīta nānyayā kvacit ||7|| varṣavrataṃ bhavedetad varṣānte ca mahotsavam | udyāpanaṃ kārayecca vṛṣabhaṃ kānakaṃ diśet ||8|| bhojanāni diśeccāpi sādhubhyo gāṃ diśedapi | ekāntaravrataṃ cāpi varṣamātraṃ prapālayet || 9 || ekāntaritabhojī syād vratānte ca mahotsavam | svarṇapadmaṃ diśed dāne hyudyāpanaṃ samācaret || 3.140.1 0|| śarkarāpūrṇapātraṃ ca dadyāt prabhojayet sataḥ | vratī yāti mahāpuṇyaṃ cānte’pi vaiṣṇavaṃ padam || 11 || cāturmāsye varjayecca dehābhyaṃgaṃ sutailajam | abhyaṃgavarjanaṃ tvedat vrataṃ proktaṃ tapaḥ param || 12|| vratānte tailadānādi dadyācca bhojanyānyapi | mama prītikaraṃ tvetattena yāti hareḥ padam || 1 3|| rasānāṃ varjanaṃ cāpi rasavrataṃ prakīrtitam | madhunārikelavāridadhikṣīraghṛtaikṣavam ||14|| varjayed vatsarānte vā hyudyāpanaṃ samācaret | rasadānādi dadyācca sūkṣmavastrāṇi cārpayet || 15|| kāmavrataṃ prakuryācca sadā śokavināśakam | cāturmāsye brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ sadā bhavet || 1 6|| pūrṇe vrate kāṃcanasyāśokavṛkṣaṃ samarpayet | ikṣuṃ samarpayeccāpi vastrāṇyapi samarpayet || 17|| udyāpanaṃ caredbhuktvā bhogān viṣṇupadaṃ vrajet| | nakhānāṃ kartanaṃ cāturmāsye vratī hi varjayet || 18|| keśānāṃ vapanaṃ cāpi cāturmāsye vivarjayet | akartanasaṃjñaṃ caitad vrataṃ kṛtvā mahotsavam || 1 9|| kuryādudyāpanaṃ cānte bhojayet pāyasaṃ sataḥ | kānakānnakhakeśām̐śca dāne dadyād dvijātaye ||3.140.20||| saumyāṃ mūrtiṃ mama lakṣmi tava pratidinaṃ diśet | māsaparyantamevaitat saumyavrataṃ prakīrtitam ||21 || vaikuṇṭhe saumyamuktaḥ syādatra vai candramā bhavet | bahudānāni ratnānāṃ dadyāttu śrāvaṇāntake ||22|| kārtike kānakīṃ mūrtiṃ gṛhopaskaraśobhitām | dadyāt sampūjya gurave saubhāgyavratamucyate ||23 || viṣṇormūrtiṃ śriyā mūrtiṃ dadyācchrīgurave tadā | anyadānāni kurvīta śrīhariḥ prīyatāmiti || 24|| sārasvataṃ vrataṃ kuryāt sandhyāyāṃ maunameva tu | samvatsaraṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā ghṛtakuṃbhaṃ tilān ghaṭam ||25|| vastrayugmaṃ ca pātraṃ ca ghaṇṭāṃ dadyād dvijāyate | godānaṃ gurave dadyāt pustakānāṃ pradānakam ||26|| sārasvatavrataṃ cedaṃ vidyārūpādidāyakam | atha sampadvrataṃ kuryāt pañcamyāṃ mādhavīṃ satīm ||27|| lakṣmīṃ nityaṃ pūjayecca varṣānte hemapadmakam | kamalaṃ gurave dadyāddhenuṃ dogdhrīṃ savatsikām ||28|| sa vaiṣṇavaṃ padaṃ yāti lakṣmīvān janmajanmasu | nityaṃ vai mārjayet sarvaṃ mandiraṃ śrīpate prabhoḥ ||29|| varṣānte pradiśeddhenuṃ dogdhrīṃ jalaghaṭaṃ tathā | janmāyutaṃ sa rājā syāttato viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet ||3.140.30 || etadāyurvrataṃ nāma pāpamārjanakārakam | atha kīrtirvrataṃ kuryādekabhuktaṃ sadācaret ||3 1 || varṣānte dhenudaśakaṃ dadyād vṛkṣaṃ hiraṇmayam | aśvamedhaphalaṃ syācca bhūtikīrtiphalaṃ bhavet ||32|| atha sāmavrataṃ proktaṃ nityaṃ stotraṃ prakīrtayet | hareragre trikālaṃ vai tiladānaṃ ca nityadā ||33|| puṣpākṣatapradānaṃ ca haraye pūjanārthakam | samvatsarānte pūrṇe ca hemapadmaṃ diśenmahat ||34|| aṣṭāṃgulaṃ tiladhenuṃ dadyādyāti paraṃ padam | atha vīravrataṃ kuryānnavamyāmekabhuktakaḥ ||35|| kanyakā bhojayed varṣaṃ varṣānte hemakañcukīḥ | śāṭīrhaimaṃ keśariṇaṃ dadyācchrīgurave tathā ||36|| kanyakābhyo yathāyogyabhūṣāmbarādi cārpayet | janmārbudaṃ surūpaḥ syāccānte dhāma harervrajet ||37|| samvatsaraṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ payovratī bhavettathā | samānte pañcadhenūśca dogdhrīrdadyāt savatsikāḥ ||38|| vāsāṃsi ca piśaṃgāni jalakuṃbhayutāni ca | sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tārayecchatam ||39|| pitṛśrāddhaṃ kārayecca pitṛvratamidaṃ matam | atha caitrādimāseṣu caturṣu śītalaṃ jalam ||3.140.40|| pāyayet sarvalokāṃśca vratānte maṇikaṃ diśet | annavastrāṇi dadyācca tilapātraṃ suvarṇakam ||41 || jalānandavrataṃ tvetat kalpānto bhūpatirbhavet | atha kuryād dhṛtivrataṃ pratyahaṃ śrīhariṃ tu mām ||42|| pañcāmṛtena subhagaṃ snapanaṃ kārayettataḥ | varṣānte śaṃkhadānaṃ ca kuryād yāti hareḥ padam ||43|| mā hiṃsyāt sarvabhūtāni varṣānte vratakṛjjanaḥ | godānaṃ hemahariṇapradānaṃ cācaret tvidam ||44|| ahiṃsāvratametena kalpānto bhūpatirbhavet | atha māghasnānameva kuryācchītena vāriṇā ||45|| sūryaṃ nityaṃ pūjayecca dadyād dānaṃ dvijātaye | dhānyavastravibhūṣādi sūryavrataṃ taducyate ||46 || cāturmāsye mahāviṣṇuṃ mahālakṣmīṃ ca pūjayet | godānaṃ bhojanaṃ cāpi yathāśakti diśed vratī ||47|| sa vaiṣṇavapadaṃ yāti viṣṇuvratamidaṃ śubham | atha vrataṃ śīlanāma śīlārogyaphalapradam ||48|| varṣaṃ pūrṇaṃ brahmacaryaṃ pālayet strīḥ naro’pi vā | ghṛtadhenuḥ pradadyācca puṣpamālāḥ sadārpayet ||49|| susādhūn ghṛtamutkṛṣṭaṃ pāyasaṃ bhojayettathā | udyāpanaṃ vatsarānte kuryād dhānyadhanaṃ diśet ||3.140.50 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇākṣaraṃ prayāti saḥ | atha varṣaṃ na bhuñjīta tailaṃ yacchetpradīpakam ||51 || svarṇaṃ dīpaṃ kāñcanaṃ ca cakraṃ dadyād dvijātaye | vastrayugmaṃ pradadeta yāti brahmapadaṃ hi saḥ ||52|| dīpavratamidaṃ proktaṃ dīptidaṃ rūpadaṃ tathā | atha kārtikamārabhya naktaṃ bhuñjīta pāyasam ||53|| varṣānte gāṃ pradadyācca pāyasākhyavrataṃ tvidam | kalyāṇakārakaṃ pṛthvyā rājyapradaṃ pramokṣadam ||54|| atha gandhānulepādi varjayed vatsaraṃ sadā | nirgandhākhyaṃ vrataṃ proktaṃ varṣānte gandhadānakam ||55|| atha kāntivrataṃ kuryād godānaṃ pratyahaṃ diśet | lavaṇaṃ naiva bhuñjīta samvatsaraṃ tataḥ param ||56|| udyāpanaṃ prakuryācca kāntikīrtiphalapradam | rājā bhūtvā kalpapūrṇaṃ viṣṇuloke vased dhruve ||57|| brahmavrataṃ tataḥ kuryād brahmāṇḍaṃ kāñcanaṃ śubham | svalpaṃ tilasamāyuktaṃ puṇye dine dvijāyate ||58|| dadyāt tridivasān tilāśano bhaved vratī tathā | mālyavastravibhūṣāṇāṃ dānaṃ kuryād vratī param ||59|| brahmalokaṃ prayātyeṣo nirvāṇapadamāpnuyāt | śaktitastripalādūrdhvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ parikīrtitam ||3.140.60|| atha dhenuvrataṃ kuryāt tryahaṃ payovratī bhavet | kāñcanaṃ ca vṛṣaṃ dhenuṃ dadetobhayatomukhīm ||61 || taṇḍulān samprayacchecca palordhvaṃ kānakaṃ vṛṣam | datvā brahmapadaṃ yāti golokaṃ dhenusadvratāt || 62|| atha kalpavrataṃ kuryāt palordhvaṃ kalpapādapam | kṛtvā dadyāt sādhave ca taṇḍulān dvidalānvitān ||63|| kalpadānena kalpānte svargād gacchati matpadam | atha māsopavāsī syāt prayacchenmahiṣīṃ śubhām ||64|| dogdhrīṃ śrīgurave caitanmāhiṣaṃ vratamucyate | dadyād viṃśatipalordhvaṃ pṛthivīṃ kāñcanīṃ śubhām ||65|| dharāvratamidaṃ proktaṃ tvaikabhojī dine bhavet | saptakalpaśatānyeva vasati śrīśamandire ||66|| tato yātyakṣaraṃ dhāma dharāvratakaraḥ pumān | madbhakto māṃ prayātyeva pārṣadaḥ san prasevate ||67|| māghe caitre guḍaṃ dadyād guḍavrataparāyaṇaḥ | guḍabhojī guḍapāyī tilairguḍaiḥ prapūjayet ||68|| māṃ lakṣmīṃ ca guḍadāne dadyād guḍamayīṃ guḍam | guḍavratamidaṃ proktaṃ muktidaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā ||69|| atha pakṣopavāsī syāt kapilāyugalaṃ diśet | udyāpanaṃ prakuryācca paramānandakārakam ||3.140.70|| kalpānte rājarājaḥ syāt kapilāvratameva tat | atha varṣaṃ caikabhojī nityabhojyajalapradaḥ ||71 || viṣṇuloke vasedante prāptivratamidaṃ matam | naktāśī cāṣṭamīṣu syād vatsarānte ca dhenudaḥ ||72||| svargaṃ yāti tataścānte brahmapadaṃ prayāti saḥ | sugativratamevedaṃ procyate sadgatipradam ||73|| viprāyendhanado yastu vatsaraṃ dhenudastathā | vaiśvānaravrataṃ cedaṃ tatkartā brahma gacchati ||74|| ekādaśyāṃ vratakartā dvādaśyāṃ kāñcanīṃ śubhām | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtiṃ dadāti ca ||75|| samānte vaiṣṇavaṃ haimaṃ cakraṃ dadāti yo vratī | etatkṛṣṇavrataṃ kṛtvā kalpānte rājyabhāg bhavet ||76|| varṣānte māṃ pradāyaiva mama dhāma hyavāpnuyāt | pāyasāśī samānte tu dadyād viprāya goyugam ||77|| lakṣmīlokamavāpnoti śrīvrataṃ caitaducyate | saptamyāṃ yaḥ pradadyācca dhenuṃ payasvinīṃ śubhām ||78 || sūryalokaṃ prayātyeva bhānuvrataṃ taducyate | caturthyāṃ naktabhuk dadyādabdānte hemahastinam ||79|| vrataṃ vaināyakaṃ nāma bhuktimuktiphalapradam | cāturmāsye svarṇarūpyaphalāni cārpayed vratī ||3.140.80 || phalavrataṃ viṣṇulokapradaṃ tvetanmahābalam | yaścopavāsī saptamyāṃ samānte haimapaṃkajam ||8 1 || gāśca dadyāt svarṇaghaṭe sauravrataṃ prakīrtitam | sūryalokapradaṃ caitat sūryadānaṃ diśedapi ||82|| dvādaśa dvādaśīryastu samāpyopoṣaṇena ha | govastrakāṃcanabhūṣā dadyācchrīgurave vratī ||83|| paraṃ padamavāpnoti viṣṇuvratamidaṃ rame | kārtikyāṃ tu vṛṣotsargaṃ kṛtvā naktaṃ samācaret ||84|| śaivapadaṃ samāpnoti vārṣavratamidaṃ matam | gopadāni suvarṇāni dadyād dāne padavratam ||85|| saptarātroṣito dadyād ghṛtakuṃbhaṃ tu sādhave | ghṛtavratamidaṃ proktaṃ brahmalokaphalapradam ||86|| ākāśaśāyī varṣāsu cānte dhenuṃ payasvinīm | dadyādākāśasaṃjñaṃ ca vratamindrapadapradam ||87|| anagnipakvabhojī ca tṛtīyāyāṃ tataḥ param | godānaṃ tu prakuryādvai māsānte yaḥ payasvinīm ||88|| śreyovratamidaṃ proktaṃ golokadaṃ sukhapradam | haimaṃ paladvayādūrdhve rathaṃ cāśvayujaṃ śubham ||89|| dadāno drāg vaset svarge kalpaśataṃ rathavratī | kalpānte rājarājaḥ syāttato yāti paraṃ padam ||3.140.90|| ṣaṣmāsānupavāsān yaḥ kuryādekāntaraṃ dinam | samānte gopradaḥ syācca vāruṇaṃ vratamucyate ||91 || vāruṇaṃ rājyamāsādya tato yāti paraṃ padam | cāndrāyaṇaṃ vrataṃ kuryāddhemacandraṃ diśet sate ||92|| candravratamidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ candralokaphalapradam | jyeṣṭhe pañcatapā nityaṃ hemadhenuprado bhavet ||93|| tapovratamidaṃ proktaṃ sāmrājyaṃ labhate tataḥ | vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāpi golokaṃ cākṣaraṃ labhate tataḥ ||94|| devālaye vitānaṃ tu dadyāt paṭādibhiḥ kṛtam | vitānado divaṃ yāti vitānavratasatphalāt ||95|| māghe ninyārdravāsāḥ syāt saptamyāṃ goprado bhavet | rājā bhaved divaṃ yāti cārdravratī pramuktigaḥ ||96|| śreṣṭhaṃ tu bhavanaṃ dhāma dadāti phālgune tu yaḥ | dhāmavratī prayātyeva parameśvaramandiram ||97|| sādhuṃ sādhvīṃ prapūjyaiva bhojayedmiṣṭamuttamam | svayaṃ prasādaṃ bhuñjyācca prasādākhyavrataṃ tvidam ||98|| sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyapradaṃ mokṣapradaṃ tathā | pāvanaṃ sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ vai paṃktipāvanamuttamam ||99|| pratipadyekabhaktāśī samānte kapilāpradaḥ | nityaṃ vaiśvānarapūjākartā yāti vibhāvasum || 3.140.10 0|| vaiśvānaravrataṃ cedaṃ divyatādaṃ sukhapradam | daśamyānekabhaktāśīṃ samānte daśadhenudaḥ ||1 01 || suvarṇapatrikāṃ dadyād brahmāṇḍādhipatirbhavet | viśvavrataṃ procyate vai lakṣmi puṇyasya sāgaraḥ || 1 02|| kīrtanaṃ sarvadā kuryāt kīrtanākhyaṃ vrataṃ tvidam | kathāṃ ca sarvadā kuryāt kathākhyaṃ tu vrataṃ tvidam || 10 3|| bhajanaṃ sarvadā kuryād bhajanākhyaṃ vrataṃ tvidam | ekaṣaṣṭivratānyevaṃ lakṣmi te kathitāni vai || 1 04|| lokānāmupakārārthaṃ yato lokastriraṃgavān | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇāt karaṇādapi ||1 05|| anumodanadānācca sahāyyakaraṇādapi | vratapuṇyaṃ labhetaiva bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt || 106|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne prakīrṇakānāmekaṣaṣṭivratānāṃ saṃkṣepato nirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 140 ||
<3.141> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca akṣarādhipate’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇeśa me | golokādhipate kṛṣṇa vaikuṇṭheśa narāyaṇa || 1 || bhūmannavyākṛtanātha vāsudevāmṛteśvara | śrīpate śrīpuravāsin vratāni yāni tāni vai || 2 || kartuṃ naiva hi śakto yastasya muktiḥ kathaṃ bhavet | striyā bālasya vṛddhasya rugṇasya paśupakṣiṇām || 3 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca mama nāmasmaraṇena tasya muktirbhaved rame | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīkṛṣṇasatpate || 4 || śrīkṛṣṇa śrīpate śrīmannārāyaṇa narāyaṇa | govinda mādhava viṣṇo svāminnareśvarācyuta || 5 || harikṛṣṇa nīlakaṇṭha mahālakṣmīsukhāvaha | bālakṛṣṇa dayāsindho śrīmadgopālanandana || 6 || kaṃbharāśrīnandana tvamaśvapaṭṭasaro’dhipa | kuṃkumavāpikātīrthakṛtāvāsa hṛdi sthita || 7 || rāma śrīpuṇḍarīkākṣa brahmapriyāpate vibho | haripriyādhinātha tvaṃ rakṣa mokṣaya bandhanāt" || 8 || ityevaṃ mama nāmnāṃ vai kīrtanaṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet | athāpi mama vāsasya kṣetrasyākṣarasaṃjñinaḥ || 9 || aśvapaṭṭasarasaśca kuṃkumavāpikābhuvaḥ | tīrthasyāsya ca māhātmyaṃ śṛṇuyācca gṛṇīta ca ||3.141.1 0|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ śṛṇvīta vai kathāḥ | ślokānāṃ lakṣamekaṃ ca tadūrdhvaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ ||1 1 || sahasrāṇīti śṛṇuyāt sapādalakṣasaṃhitām | dharmārthakāmamokṣecchāpūrikāṃ bhuktimuktidām || 12|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ saṃhitātmakaḥ | dvitīyenāgamenaiva rūpeṇāsmi sthito bhuvi || 13 || jīvalokeṣu sarvatreśvaralokeṣu vai tathā | akṣare’pi saṃhitātmā sthito’smi śabdamūrtikaḥ || 14|| adhyāyaṃ vā prakaraṇaṃ santānaṃ ślokameva vā | yaḥ paṭhiṣyati bhūtātmā muktātmā sa bhaviṣyati || 15|| śroṣyati sthiracittātmā brahmātmā sa bhaviṣyati | vācakaṃ ye namasyanti me bhaviṣyanti pāvanāḥ ||16|| pūjāṃ cāsya kariṣyanti te yāsyanti divaṃ param | lomaśasyāśramaḥtīrthaṃ gatvā vatsyanti ye’niśam || 17|| teṣāṃ bhuktistathā muktiḥ kṛpayā me karaṃ gatā | arkavarṇavimānena prayāsyanti parākṣaram || 18|| praśaṃsāṃ ye kariṣyanti te yāsyanti śriyāḥ puram | nāryastīrthaṃ kariṣyanti yāsyanti lalitāpuram || 19|| nārāyaṇyā śriyā sākaṃ modiṣyante’kṣare hi tāḥ | śivarājyā tathā lakṣmyā sākaṃ sthāsyanti dhāmani ||3.141.20 || kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ ca māṃ labdhvā modiṣyante nirantaram | ahaṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ lakṣmi tvaṃ tīrthaṃ mama sadṛśam ||21 || āvayorvāsabhūmiśca tīrthaṃ cākṣarasadṛśam | saurāṣṭre ānartadeśe cāśvapaṭṭasaro’bhitaḥ ||22|| bhadrāvatyā dakṣiṇe ca śatruṃjayāyāḥ paścime | raivatādreḥ pūrvabhāge vyāghryāraṇyottarakṣitau ||23|| śatakrośapravistāravartulakṣetrameva me | mokṣadaṃ pāpahaṃ lakṣmi puruṣārthasamastadam ||24|| aśvapaṭṭasaraḥsnātā divaṃ mokṣaṃ prayānti vai | maṇḍalaṃ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetrātmakaṃ harirhyaham ||25|| rakṣāmi sarvathā devairmuktairīśānakoṭibhiḥ | kuṃkumavāpikābadrīṃ rakṣāmyahaṃ priyāṃ mama ||26||| tāṃ smaran pāpadāhe vai śakto bhavati mānavaḥ | darśanāt tadbadaryāstu nāmasaṃkīrtanādapi ||27|| mṛttikālaṃbhanāttasyā naraḥ pāpātpramucyate | yojanānāṃ sahasreṣu badaryāḥ smaraṇānnaraḥ |||28|| nārī vā bālabhāvo vā labhate paramāṃ gatim | badarīpatrapuṣpāṇāṃ sparśād bhadrāṇi vindate ||29|| avagāhya ca pītvā tu punātyāsaptamaṃ kulam || manasā cintayan badrīṃ kāmānāpnoti puṣkalān || 3.141.30|| kuṃkumavāpikāṃ gatvā badrīśrīsamaśobhitām | brahmacārī vasenmāsaṃ pitṝn devāṃśca tarpayet || 31 || īpsitāṃllabhate kāmān yatra yatra sa jāyate | devadānavagandharvā ṛṣayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ ||32|| badrīṃ dṛṣṭvā jalaṃ pītvā prayātā dhāma me’kṣaram | ārtānāṃ ca daridrāṇāṃ niścitavyavasāyinām ||33|| kuṃkumavāpikābadrītulyaṃ cānyanna mokṣadam| vyādhito yadi vā dīno vṛddho badrīniṣevaṇāt ||34|| badaryāḥ sannidhau yadvā prāṇām̐styajettu daivataḥ | dīptakāñcanavarṇābhaivimānaiḥ sūryasannibhaiḥ ||35|| kṛṣṇadhāmāni yātyeva modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ | īpsitān labhate sarvān kāmān bhogyādisaṃbhṛtān ||36|| sarvaratnamayairdivyairnānādhvajasamāyutaiḥ | vimānaiścāṃganākīrṇairmodate śāśvate pade || 37|| sarvakāmaphalā vṛkṣā mahī yatra hiraṇmayī | sarvarasāśca kṣitayastatra loke mahīyate ||38|| badarīṃ smaramāṇo’pi tathā kuṃkumavāpikām | prāṇaṃ tyaktvā brahmalokaṃ prayātyeva parātparam ||39|| karmaṇā manasā vācā dharmasatyāvalambanaḥ | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre yastu gāṃ samprayacchati ||3.141.40|| suvarṇamaṇimuktāśca dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tathāmbaram | svakārye pitṛkārye ca devārhaṇe’pi vārpayet ||41 || anantaguṇitaṃ tasya sampadyate’kṣare sthale | gavāṃ śatasahasrebhyo dadyādekāṃ payasvinīm ||42|| putrān dāsām̐stathā bhṛtyān gaurdattātraiva tārayet | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre yastu kanyāṃ prayacchati ||43|| vivāhavidhinā tasya dhāmni puṇyamanantakam | śrīkṛṣṇasya maṇiścāyaṃ saurāṣṭro nityavigrahaḥ ||44|| pralaye’pi na nāśo’sya mama vāsena padmaje | aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ ||45|| snātvā phalaṃ labhyate vai śāśvataṃ cāpunarbhavam | daśatīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyastathā rame ||46|| vasanti tāni sarvāṇi mama vāsātmake’tra tu | svarṇanārīpradātātra svargago jāyate tataḥ ||47|| urvaśīsadṛśīnāṃ tu kanyānāṃ labhate śatam | madhye nārīsahasrāṇāṃ bahūnāṃ sa patirbhavet ||48|| aśvapaṭṭasaro yatra siddhakṣetraṃ hi tanmama | tatrāvaluṇṭhya pāpātmā jāyate paṃktipāvanaḥ ||49|| pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca maṃgalānāṃ sumaṃgalam | mokṣadānāṃ mokṣadaṃ ca kuṃkumavāpikāsthalam ||3.141.50|| sarasaścottare bhāge pātālādakṣayāpagā | śvetadvīpamahāgaṃgā lakṣmīnārāyaṇeritā |||51 || vahatyantarjale śvetā bhuktimuktipradāyinī | viṣṇupadī svayaṃ svargādadṛśyātra nimīlati ||52|| brahmahradaśca me pādānnityaṃ taṭāgago’sti ca | sudhāsarid divaḥ sthānād vāriṣvasya pravartate ||53|| amarāstena sarve vai vartante’śvasaraḥkṣitau | anāśakaphalaṃ cātra labhate tīrthakṛjjanaḥ ||54|| māsamekaṃ tu yaḥ snāyādaśvapaṭṭasarojale | mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ sa gacchetparamaṃ padam ||55|| ajñānena tu yasyeha tīrthayātrādikaṃ bhavet | sarvakāmasamṛddhe sa svargaloke mahīyate ||56|| hyekadā lomaśo devo yayau prayāgabhūtalam | prayāgastatra nāsīdvai bharadvājo’bhavanmuniḥ |||57|| bharadvājāya cāpṛcchallomaśastīrtharājakaḥ | kva yāto’dya mune tasya darśanaṃ me na jāyata |||58|| bharadvājastadā prāha kuṃbhayogena mānavaiḥ | mahāpāpātipāpāni snātvārpitāni yāni tu |||59||| tāni kṣālayituṃ yātaḥ prayāgo’śvasarovaram | yatra kuṃkumavāpīti tīrthaṃ lakṣmīḥ svayaṃ sthitā ||3.141.60|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yatra vasatyapi | tatra gataḥ prayāgo’sti paśya cāyāsyati drutam ||61 || lomaśastatra vāṭaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā muhūrtamāvasat | prayāgastāvadāyāto vidhūyāghāni sarvathā ||62|| lomaśastaṃ prapūjyaiva yayau badarikāvanam | tatra nāsīddhi badarī divyā nārāyaṇāśrayā ||63 || nālokitā lomaśena tadā tanuṛṣiḥ svayam | pṛṣṭhaḥ kva badarīyātrā kadā cāpyāgamiṣyati ||64|| tanuḥ prāha gatā cāste saurāṣṭre’śvasarovaram | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ||65|| prāṇapatiṃ sevayituṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ priyaṃ prabhum | kanyārūpā vartate sā brahmapriyāsu śobhanā ||66 || vadhūrbhūtvā harerdāsī lakṣmyā saha virājate | tāpasī sā kvacittatra kuṃkumavāpikātaṭe ||67|| badarīvṛkṣarūpeṇa vartate muktakoṭikā | dīrghikāyā uparyaiva vimānaṃ vai vitanvatī ||68|| uttare bhūtale cāste yacchākhā dīrghikopari | vartante chatrarūpā vai śrīkṛṣṇapreritā sadā ||69 || viśālākṣī hareḥ patnī yā sā tatra virājate | badarī sā svayaṃ yātra sā tatra rājate mune ||3.141.70|| rūpāntareṇa cātrāpi vartate bhagavatkṛte | harernivāsavelāyāṃ chāyāpradātra jāyate ||71 || seyaṃ madhyāhnavelāyāmatrāgamiṣyati drutam | evaṃ tanormaharṣervai jñātvā śrīlomaśo muniḥ |||72|| tasthāvāmadhyadivasaṃ kanyā sā badarī satī | tūrṇaṃ vyomapathenāpyāyātā badarikābhavat ||73|| lomaśastāṃ prapūjyaiva tadadhaḥ śrīnarāyaṇam | prapūjyaiva yayau bālakṛṣṇasarovaraṃ mahat ||74|| mānasaṃ ca saraḥ snātvā vyomnā saurāṣṭramāyayau | niścitaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvovāsa nityaṃ mamālaye ||75|| aśvapaṭṭasarobhūmau māhātmyaṃ pravidan kṣiteḥ | badarī sā mahālakṣmīrnārāyaṇena vai mayā ||76|| nityaṃ sthātuṃ samājñaptā vartate dīrghikātaṭe | kālāntare dṛśyarūpāpyadṛśyāpi bhaviṣyati ||77|| bhaktānāṃ samavāye tu punardṛśyā bhaviṣyati | brahmapriyāstathānyāśca badarīrūpadhārikāḥ ||78|| dīrghikāsahasakhyastu bhūtvā tajjalavṛttayaḥ | dṛśyāstatra bhaviṣyanti riktā bhūmirna jāyate ||79|| haripriyāstathā devyo vartante cātra vallikāḥ | anārakalikānāmnī dāḍimīrūpadhāriṇī ||3.141.80|| uttejinī mama patnī ciñcārūpeṇa vartate | snehilī subhagā ceti hīṅgudīdvayamasti ca ||81 || jāmbuvatī mama patnī jāmbikā tatra vartate | rāviṇī gāyikā tatra rāvaṇikāpi vartate ||82||| evamanyā mama kāntāḥ sakhyastāsāṃ tathāparāḥ | dugdhikānāmavallī ca kanyakā tatra vartate ||83|| puṣpikā hyudyānarūpā bahvyaḥ santi drumālikāḥ | sevante māṃ sadā muktānikā divyasuvigrahāḥ ||84|| kvacittā vṛkṣavallyaśca kvacit kāntāḥ suvigrahāḥ | kvacid dṛśyā bhavantyevādṛśyāḥ kvacid bhavantyapi ||85|| kvacinme śayane santi kvacinme vai gajāsane | kvacinme vyomayāne tā viharanti mayā saha ||86|| kvacit pārśve rāsabhūmau kvacinme maṇḍape’pi ca | kvacinme hṛdaye līnā bhavantyānandabhakṣikāḥ ||87|| ekarasyaṃ kvacitprāptā modante mattadātmikāḥ | bhojane krīḍane pāne pṛthag bhavanti sevane ||88|| lakṣmi yathā vartase tvaṃ hṛdi pārśve ca sannidhau | tathā tā mama vartante tvādṛśāḥ kamalāḥ śubhāḥ ||89|| tāsāṃ yatra nivāso’sti sā bhūmiścākṣaraṃ mama | sarvatīrthottamaṃ lakṣmi tīrthamūrdhanyamuttamam ||3.141.90|| kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ kalpe kalpe surāṣṭrake | madicchayā bhavatyeva brahmāṇḍādau mayā kṛtam ||91|| surāṣṭraṃ tava rājyaṃ ca svatantraṃ dvīpakalpake | kṛṣṇabhūmiḥ kṛṣṇatulyā kārṣṇī sā matsvarūpiṇī ||92|| mokṣadvāravatī bhūmiryuge yuge’pi pāvanī | subhadrā bhadrikānāmnī nadī yatrāsti matkṛtā ||93|| yajjalasya smaraṇācca sparśanāt kaṇabhakṣaṇāt | pāpanāśo bhavatyeva svargaṃ tathākṣaraṃ vrajet ||94|| mamārdhasya narasyāpi mama viyogini kṣaṇe | yadaiśvaryāṇi līyante luṭyante strīvibhūtayaḥ ||95|| dasyubhiśca tadā bhadrā subhadrā sariduttamā | narapatnī mahattīrthasvarūpā vartate jale || 96|| snātṝṇāṃ bhadradā nityaṃ sarvabhadraprakāriṇī | kāryarūpā nadī cāste mūrtiḥ śrīpuruṣottame ||97|| divyarūpā badaryāṃ ca santuṣṭā ca svasā mama | muktānikā mama dhāmni pañcarūpā pravartate ||98|| sāgarāḥ sāgaratulyasarāṃsi saritastathā | puṇyāḥ kuṃkumavāpyāṃ me vartante brahmarūpikāḥ ||99|| sarve vedāśca yajñāśca mūrtimanto’kṣare’tra vai | maharṣayaḥ pitaraśca siddhāśca sādhavo’malāḥ || 3.141.1 00|| satyaḥ sādhvyaścakradharyaścakradharāśca pārṣadāḥ | māmanādimupāsante śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam || 101 || siddhikṣetraṃ mahaccaitaddhāmakṣetraṃ parātparam | idaṃ dhanyamidaṃ svargyamidaṃ satyamidaṃ sukham || 1 02|| idaṃ puṇyamidaṃ dharmyaṃ pāvanaṃ kārṣṇyamuttamam | śrutvāpyetattīrthatīrthaṃ nākapṛṣṭhe sumodate || 1 03|| jātismaratvaṃ labhate sarvasmaratvamityapi | traikālikaṃ pravetti yat sārvajñyaṃ cāpi vindati || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne kuṃkumavāpikātīrthasmaraṇadarśanādibhirapi pāpināṃ mokṣaṇamiti nirūpaṇanāmaikacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 141 ||
<3.142> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca nārāyaṇa jagatkānta sarvarakṣaka sarvaga | kathaṃ trikālajaṃ mṛtyuṃ jayati mānavo bhuvi || 1 || mṛtyuraniparāvṛtto balavān kena vāryate | kena rūpeṇa vā mṛtyurmānavān paridhāvati || 2 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu śrīśivarājñīśri nārāyaṇīrame’pi ca | lakṣmi samudraje cāpi śṛṇu cākṣaramāṇiki || 3 || garuḍo mama bhakto vai samāsīno’bhavadgṛhe | japan mālāṃ mama dhyāyan manmūrtiṃ divyarūpiṇīm || 4 || pṛṣṭastadā janakena kaśyapena suto nijaḥ | kathaṃ putra mahābhakta yogin mṛtyurnivartate || 5 || kena rūpeṇa mṛtyurvai samāyāti haratyapi | kathaṃ niḥsparśanaṃ tasya dehinastviha caryate || 6 || śrutvā pakṣī ca pitaraṃ samuvāca vadāmi tat | bhaktyā nivartate mṛtyurāśrayātparamātmanaḥ || 7 || daṇḍī śastradharo bhikṣurnagnādiḥ kāladūtakaḥ | samāyāti varṣma dhṛtvā taddaṃśena na jīvati || 8 || citāvalmīkaśailādau kūpe ca vivare taroḥ | daṃśe daṃṣṭrātrayaṃ lagnaṃ daṣṭo dehī na jīvati || 9 || ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca karkaṭe meṣe mūlāśleṣāmaghādiṣu | kakṣāśroṇigale sandhau śaṃkhakarṇodarādiṣu || 3.142.1 0|| vaktre bāhau ca grīvāyāṃ pṛṣṭhe daṣṭo na śrīpati | śeṣo’rkaḥ phaṇipaścandrastakṣako bhauma īritaḥ || 11 || karkoṭo jño guruḥ padmo mahāpadmastu bhārgavaḥ | śaṃkhaḥ śanaiścaro rāhuḥ kulikaśceti te grahāḥ || 12|| tattadgraheṣu tajjātisarpadaṣṭo na jīvati | pādāṃguṣṭhaḥ pratipadaḥ syāt pādapṛṣṭhau dvitīyakā ||1 3|| gulphau nu vai tṛtīyā syājjānunī ca caturthikā | liṃgaṃ bhagaṃ pañcamīti nābhiḥ ṣaṣṭhīstithirmatā || 14|| hṛdayaṃ saptamī proktā stanau cāṣṭamikādinam | kaṇṭhastu navamī proktā daśamī nāsikāpuṭau || 15|| netre caikādaśī bodhyā karṇau dvādaśikā matā | bhruvau trayodaśīrūpe śaṃkhaścaturdaśī matā || 1 6|| mastakaṃ pañcadaśikā tattithau tatsthale daśet | tadā kālakavalena daṣṭo dehī na jīvati || 17|| puṃso dakṣiṇabhāge tu nāryā vāme tvidaṃ matam | etādṛśakṣaṇe daṣṭā na jīvanti kadācana ||18|| kintu oṃ garuḍa svāhā japellakṣapravartanam | japan spṛśetpadāṃguṣṭhe tale pṛṣṭhe ca gulphake || 19|| jaṃghāyāṃ jānubhāge ca sakthnoliṃge bhage kaṭau | jaghane nābhideśe ca nitambe codare hṛdi ||3.142.20|| stanayoḥ pārśvadeśe ca bāhvośca karayostale | aṃguliṣu kaphoṇe ca kaṇṭhe gale kṛkāṭake ||21 || hanau mukhe gaṇḍake ca nāsāyāṃ ca kapolake | karṇayoḥ karṇapṛṣṭhe ca lalāṭe netrayorbhruvoḥ ||22|| kapāle mastake cāpi śikhāyāṃ vinyasenmuhuḥ | sa eva garuḍo dehī jāyate mantramantraṇāt ||23|| nākramanti ca tacchāyāṃ svapne’pi viṣapannagāḥ | kālarūpāścāpi sarpāstadbhayād vidravanti vai ||24|| viṣaṃ mantrasya vinyāsāt sarvaṃ naśyati līyate | oṃ śeṣeśvara nāginīpate garuḍapṛṣṭhaga ||25|| āstīkavākphalada śrīhare viṣiviṣaṃ hara | itimantraṃ lakṣavāraṃ japet siddho bhavettataḥ ||26| prayuñjīta mahākālo’pyapi dūrāyate bhayāt | mamānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmajapāttadā ||27|| mahākālo’pi saṃyāti viprakṛṣṭo bhayānmama | jīvāyogyo’pi dehyatra jīvatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||28|. śrīdharasyārcanaṃ kuryāt parivārānvitasya me | dhyātvātmānaṃ śrīdharākhyaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam ||29||| oṃ śrīmate puruṣottamāya namaḥ parātmane | akṣarāya namaśceti māṇikyāyai namo namaḥ || 3.142.30|| padmāvatyai jayāyai ca lalitāyai namo namaḥ | sukhadāyai ca prajñāyai lakṣmyai cāpi namo namaḥ ||3 1 || rādhikāyai kriyāyai ca jñānāyai ca namo namaḥ | icchāyai kamalāyai ca mahālakṣmyai namo namaḥ ||3 2|| oṃ hrīṃ śrīdharāyāpi viṣṇave me namo namaḥ | abhiṣekaṃ tathā vastraṃ tato yajñopavītakam ||33|| gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ dīpamannaṃ pradakṣiṇam | dadyājjapenmanuṃ me ca dhyāyenmāṃ ca hṛdi sthitam ||34|| śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham | prasannavadanaṃ saumyaṃ sphuranmukuṭakuṇḍalam ||35|| kirīṭinamudārāṃgaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam | parabrahmasvarūpaṃ me cintayecchobhanaṃ param ||36|| śrīnivāsāya kṛṣṇāya namaḥ śrīpataye namaḥ | śrīdharāya saśārṅgāya śrīpradāya namo namaḥ ||37|| śrīvallabhāya śāntāya śrīmate te namo namaḥ | śrīparvatanivāsāya namaḥ śreyaskarāya ca ||38|| śreyasāmpataye cāpi śrīviśrāmāya te namaḥ | namaḥ śreyaḥsvarūpāya śrīkarāya namo namaḥ ||39|| śriyā sākaṃ śayānāya śaraṇyāya namo namaḥ | puṣpāñjaliṃ tato datvā śrīśvaraṃ vai visarjayet ||3.142.40 || evaṃ pūjāprakartā ca nirviṣo jāyate dhruvam | sa vidhūyeta pāpāni me prayāti paraṃ padam ||41 || oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīdharāya śrīviṣṇave jiṣṇave namaḥ | sarvavyādhiharaścāyaṃ sarvapīḍāharo manuḥ ||42|| sarvapāpaharaścāpi bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ | sarvagaralasaṃhartā hyabhicāravināśakaḥ ||43|| sarveṣṭapūrakaścāpi mama dhāmaprado’pi ca | matsvarūpaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā japejjīvenna saṃśayaḥ ||44|| yanmāse yadṛtau yaśca sūryeṇa saha bhogavān | sarpo’pi vartate tasya nāmnā śapathamādiśet ||45|| tena sarpaviṣaṃ tūrṇaṃ śāmyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi māsasarpārkaprabhṛtīn ||46|| saptakaṃ saha vasati vyūhaṃ sūryātmano hareḥ | ekaḥ sūryaḥ kriyākalpairbahudhā varṇyate tathā ||47|| dhātā sūryo’psarā puñjikasthalī hetirākṣasaḥ | nāgo vāsukī rathakṛdyakṣaḥ pulastyaṛṣīśvaraḥ ||48|| tumburuścāpi gandharvaścaitre’nuvartayanti te | sūryo’ryamāpsarā puñjikasthalī hetirākṣasaḥ ||49|| nāgaḥ kacchanīro’thaujā yakṣaḥ pulaho vai ṛṣiḥ | nāradaścāpi gandharvo vaiśākhe vartayanti te ||3.142.50|| mitraḥ sūryo’psarā menakā pauruṣeyarākṣasaḥ | nāgastakṣako rathasvano yakṣo’triḥ ṛṣistathā ||51 || hāhā caivāpi gandharvo jyeṣṭhe’nuvartayanti te | varuṇaḥ sūryo’psarā raṃbhā citrasvanastu rākṣasaḥ ||52|| śukro nāgaḥ sahajanyo yakṣo vaśiṣṭhakaḥ ṛṣiḥ | hūhūścaivāpi gandharvaścāṣāḍhe vartayanti te ||53||| indraḥ sūryo’psarā pramlocā varyo rākṣasastathā | nāga elāpatraḥ śrotrā yakṣo’ṅgirāḥ ṛṣistathā ||54|| viśvāvasuśca gandharvaḥ śrāvaṇe vartayanti te | vivasvān sūryo’psarānumlocā vyāghrastu rākṣasaḥ ||55|| śaṃkhapālo nāga āsāraṇo yakṣo bhṛguḥ ṛṣiḥ | ugrasenastu gandharvo bhādrapade bhavanti te ||56|| pūṣā sūryo’psarā ghṛtācī vāto rākṣasastathā | nāgo dhanañjayo yakṣaḥ surucirgautamaḥ ṛṣiḥ ||57|| suṣeṇaśceti gandharvo māghamāse bhavanti te | parjanyo’rko’psarā senajitī varcāstu rākṣasaḥ ||58|| nāga airāvato yakṣaḥ ṛturbhāradvājaḥ ṛṣiḥ | viśvo gandharva ityete phālgune’nuvrajanti vai ||59|| aṃśuḥ sūryo’psarā corvaśī vidyucchatrurākṣasaḥ | nāgo mahāśaṃkhastārkṣyo yakṣaśca kaśyapaḥ ṛṣiḥ ||3.142.60 || ṛtusenaśca gandharvo mārgaśīrṣe bhavanti te | bhagaḥ sūryaḥ pūrvacitirapsarāḥ sphūrjarākṣasaḥ ||6 1 || nāgaḥ karkoṭaka ūrṇo yakṣa āyuḥ ṛṣistathā | ariṣṭanemirgandharvaḥ pauṣe’nuvartayanti te ||62|| tvaṣṭā sūryo’psarāstilottamā brahmāpetarakṣaḥ | nāgaḥ kambalaḥ śatajidyakṣo jamadagniḥ ṛṣiḥ ||63||| dhṛtarāṣṭrastu gandharvaścāśvine vartayanti te | viṣṇuḥ sūryo’psaro raṃbhā makhāpetastu rākṣasaḥ ||64|| nāgo’śvataro yakṣaḥ satyajidviśvāmitraḥ ṛṣiḥ | sūryavarcāstu gandharvaḥ kārtike vartayanti te ||65|| sthānābhimānino hyete gaṇā dvādaśasaptakāḥ | sūryā bhinnāni tejāṃsi pākān praracayanti ca ||66|| apsarasaśca gandharvā nṛtyagītiṃ caranti vai | vidyāgrāmaṇito yakṣā rathaṃ saṃyojayantyapi ||67|| sarpāste rajjavo bhūtvā yanti vai rathabandhanam | rākṣasāḥ pṛṣṭhato yāntaḥ prerayanti rathaṃ khalu ||68|| ṛṣayo vedamantraiśca stuvanti rathinaṃ prabhum | vālakhilyādayaste vai cāstaṃ prati nayantyapi ||69|| eteṣāmeva devānāṃ yathāvīryaṃ yathātapaḥ | yathāyogaṃ yathādharmaṃ yathātattvaṃ yathābalam ||3.142.70|| tathā tapatyasau sūryasteṣāmiddhastu tejasā | bhūtānāmaśubhaṃ sarvaṃ vyapohati svatejasā ||71 || mānavānāṃ śubhairetairhriyate duritantu vai | duritaṃ śubhacārāṇāṃ vyapohati mamājñayā ||72|| tapantaśca japantaśca hlādayantaśca vai prajāḥ | gopāyanti sma bhūtāni cehante hyanukampayā ||73 || tasmāllakṣmi smṛtāḥ sūryā rakṣanti dinakālataḥ | apsarasaśconmādanavibhramād rakṣayanti ca ||74|| rākṣasā niśi rakṣaughai rakṣanti duṣṭakālataḥ | nāgā nāgaviṣādyaiśca rakṣanti pūjitāstadā ||75|| yakṣā rakṣanti ca yakṣavāsādyairvivaraiḥ sadā | ṛṣayastapasā mantrai rakṣanti pūjitāśca te ||76|| gandharvāḥ pūjitā lokān rakṣanti sampadāmpradāḥ | evaṃ kālamayāḥ sarve svasvakālena yojitāḥ ||77|| pūjitā vanditāścāpi prasannā rakṣayanti te | atha lakṣmi kathayāmi mantraṃ mṛtyuñjayaṃ varam ||78|| yena mṛtyurbhavejjanmavatā japtena sañcitaḥ | ahaṃ nārāyaṇo’nādiḥ parameśo’sti madvapuḥ ||79|| mahākālo mama śaktistatputrī mṛtyureva ha | mamaiśvaryasya putrī sā mṛtyurmayā vinirmitā ||3.142.80 || kālajidahaṃ bhagavān mṛtyujidahaṃ mādhavaḥ | mama nāma japennityaṃ mṛtyuñjayeti vai naman ||8 1 || oṃ namo mṛtyuñjayāya svāhā japedaharniśam | tena mṛtyuḥ svayaṃ tasmānnivartate na saṃśayaḥ ||82|| duḥsvapnāni praṇaśyanti duṣṭāri śakunānyapi | duṣṭagrahā nivartante durbhāgyaṃ līyate’pi ca ||83|| mahābhayaṃ vilīyeta cetayo yanti vai layam | upadravāḥ praṇaśyanti daivāśca bhautikāśca ye ||84|| ādhyātmikā vyādhayaścādhayo naśyantyupādhayaḥ | ākasmikāni duḥkhāni vilīyante dravanti ca ||85|| yatrāhaṃ tatra vai nāsti duḥkhaṃ manāk kuto’ti ca | smṛto’haṃ satataṃ lakṣmi pūjito’haṃ vasāmi ca ||86|| hṛdaye tatra cānandaḥ śāśvato vai mayā saha | bhavatyeva hi bhaktānāṃ yatra śrīstatra modanam ||87|| ahaṃ tvaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahma muktā vasanti taddhṛdi | kālo mṛtyuśca pāpāni pāvanāni hi tatra tu ||88|| sukhadānyeva jāyante sadbhāgyāni bhavanti ca | abhaktasyaiva loke’tra pīḍā grahādisaṃbhavā ||89|| nāgādisaṃbhavā cāpi duḥkhadāridryasaṃbhavā | anāśritānāṃ duṣṭāśca bhavanti pīḍakā rame ||3.142.90 || mamāśritebhyastvaritaṃ palāyante hi pīḍakāḥ | yamadūtāḥ palāyante nimittāni ca mṛtyavaḥ ||91 || ātmānamātmanā sākaṃ yojayed bhaktivarmakaḥ | antarātmātmako bhūtvā tādātmyenāsthito bhavet ||92|| karmaṇā manasā vācā dehenendriyadhārayā | mama tādātmyamāptasya kālagandho na vartate ||93|| māyāgandho na cāste’sya mṛtyugandhastataḥ kutaḥ | modate mama pārśve’yaṃ mamāṃśo mamatāṃ gataḥ ||94|| yathā śrīmordate loke ramā lakṣmīḥ pramodate | ananto modate yadvad garuḍo’pi pramodate ||95|| sanatkumāraḥ satataṃ śaṃkaro modate yathā | yathā viṣṇurmodate ca nārāyaṇaḥ pramodate ||96|| naro nārāyaṇaścāpi hariḥkṛṣṇo’pi modate | tathā pramodate bhaktaḥ kālapāśavivarjitaḥ ||97|| nārī nāmajapā yā sā māṇikyā sadṛśī bhavet | māṇikyāśrīḥ sadādhiṣṭhānātmikā mama padmaje ||98|| yatrāhaṃ tatra sarvāṇyaiśvaryāṇi mama santi hi | kālamāyādike tatra karma duḥkhaṃ na vidyate ||99|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya oṃ namo namaḥ | ityevaṃ japato lakṣmi pātakaṃ na spṛśet kvacit || 3.142.100 || ityuktaṃ me mantrabalaṃ bādhyate durlabhaṃ balāt | mama nāmabalaṃ sarvabalādhikaṃ pravidyate || 101 || mama mūrtibalaṃ sarvabalādhikaṃ sadā priye | madbalaṃ cāpi sarvebhyo balebhyo’dhikameva ha || 1 02|| tadādāya jayet kālaṃ māyāṃ pāpaṃ ca karma ca | saṃsārasya viṣaṃ cāpi śatrūn viṣayagocarān || 1 03|| sarvaṃ viṣaṃ vijityaivāmṛtaṃ pītvā madātmakam | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhenmartyo’maraḥ prajāyate’kṣare ||1 04|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccintanādapi | kālamāyābhayaṃ tyaktvā modate matkṛtāśrayaḥ ||1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne kālamṛtyusvarūpatadbalapradarśanaṃ tajjayārthaṃ tattanmantrajapasya parameśvarādipūjanaprakārasya ca nirūpaṇanāmā dvācatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 142 ||
<3.143> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca parameśa kṛpāsindho kṛte dharmāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ | tretāyāṃ ca tato’pyanye bhavatā pūrvamīritāḥ || 1 || dvāpare kīdṛśāḥ santi yatra lokāśca śraddhayā | pravartamānā dharmārthakāmamokṣān prayanti vai || 2 || mantrānnāmāni bhaktiṃ ca kurvāṇāste kathaṃvidhāḥ | satyahīnā api muktiṃ vrajiṣyanti divaṃ ca vā || 3 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ satyadharmāstu muktidāḥ | tretādharmāḥ svabhāvātta mahaiśvaryapradatvataḥ || 4 || pradadatyaiśvarān lokān bhaumavairājavaiṣṇavān | dvāparasya vṛṣā lakṣmi nikṛṣṭā kalmaṣaspṛśaḥ || 5 || tannāśārthaṃ kṛṣṇarūpo bhavāmi dvāpare muhuḥ | mama yogena pāpā vai taranti sādhusaṃgamāt || 6 || śṛṇu dvāparadharmāṇi hrāsaṃ gatāni pūrvataḥ | yatra bhaktipradhānā vai taranti netare janāḥ || 7 || tretāsiddhayaḥ sarvāstu naśyanti dvāpare yuge | lobhau dhairyarahitatvaṃ vāṇijyaṃ kapaṭānvitam || 8 || atattvaniścayaścāpi varṇānāṃ dhvaṃsa ityapi | viparyayastu sarveṣu karmaṇāṃ svasvayoginām || 9 || yātrā vadhaḥ paro daṇḍo māno darpo balaṃ kṣatiḥ | akṣamā ca rajastamo bhūyo dvāparake yuge ||3.143.1 0|| āśramāścāpi dharmārthāḥ saṃkīryante vṛṣāvarāḥ | śrutiśāstreṣu vaimatyaṃ bahutarkakṛtārthatā ||1 1 || dvaidhamutpadyate tena niścayo nādhigamyate | anirṇītārthayogena dharmatattvaṃ hasatyapi ||1 2|| vaimatyena kṛto dharmo vyākūlaścāvasīdati | vedaścaturdhā kṛṣṇena vyāsena vyasyate tataḥ ||1 3|| ṛṣiputraiḥ punarvedā bhidyante dṛṣṭivibhramaiḥ | saṃhitā nūtanāścāpi jāyante tu maharṣibhiḥ ||14|| dvāpareṣu pravartante bhinnārthaistaiḥ svadarśanaiḥ | evamādhvaryavaṃ karma prasthānairvividhaistataḥ ||15|| vikalpaiḥ saṃkṣayaiścāpi gauṇairmukhyaiḥ prakāṇḍakaiḥ | vibhinnaguṇakaṃ tatra tatra deśe pravartate ||16 || evaṃ śraddhā ca viśvāso dhāraṇā bhāvanārhaṇā | naśyanti kālayogena satyaṃ cāpi vinaśyati ||17|| niyāmyatvaṃ sthitiścātra nītirnaśyanti chadminī | kāpaṭyaṃ cāpyasatyaṃ ca pratāritvaṃ vivardhate ||18|| evaṃ viparyayotpannā kudṛṣṭirdvāpare bhavet | maraṇaṃ vighnajātāni jāyante ca muhurmuhuḥ ||19|| upadravā vyādhayaśca cintāścākasmikodbhavāḥ | viṣayābhisandhayaśca jāyante dvāpare’dhikāḥ ||3.143.20 || vṛkṣagulmauṣadhayaśca prasahya tu yathābalam | svakīyāśca prakurvanti prajāstu dvāpare tadā ||21 || oṣadhayo vilokyaitat praviṣṭāstu dharāṃ prati | phālakṛṣṭāḥ prarohanti dvāpare vai tataḥ param ||22|| madhye tu dvāpare tatra nārohantyoṣadhīgaṇāḥ | vinā bījaṃ tadā bījakṛṣiḥ samantato bhavet ||23|| bījaṃ mūlaṃ ca śākhāṃ ca kandaṃ daṇḍaṃ ca nālakam | phalaṃ patraṃ mañjarīṃ ca granthiṃ tadaṃkuraṃ ca vā ||24|| jaṭāṃ tvacaṃ ca kāṇḍaṃ ca ropayanti tadā kṣitau | tadvaṃśā oṣadhayastā jāyante dvāpare tataḥ ||25|| jīvikā tadadhīnā ca sarveṣāṃ jāyate tadā | vyāpārāścauṣadhīnāṃ ca jāyante dvāpare tataḥ ||26|| anyathā jīvitaṃ tāsāṃ nāsti tretāyugātyaye | vārtāvṛttiṃ kṛṣiṃ cāpi vāṇijyaṃ cāśrayanti te || 27|| hastodbhavā āpaścāpi bhavanti bhūkhanestadā | kūpāśca dīrghikāścāpi pravartante tadābhitaḥ ||28|| svatvayuktā balinaśca prajāyante’dhipāstadā | durbalā janahīnāśca svatvahīnā bhavanti ca ||29|| luṭyante balibhirvṛkṣavallīprabhṛtijīvikāḥ | striyaḥ kṣetrāṇi putryaśca sutā dhanāni dhenavaḥ ||3.143.30 || maryādāyāḥ pratiṣṭhārthaṃ brahmā kṣatraṃ mahābalam | kṣatāt trātuṃ prajāmūrdhni sthāpayatyeva bhūbhṛtam ||3 1 || varṇāśramapratiṣṭhāṃ ca karoti nirbhayāṃ tadā | avṛṣṭirmaraṇaṃ vyādhiḥ pravartante’bhitastadā ||32|| dharmasargo yathā cāste tathā cādharmasargakaḥ | samatulo dvāpare vai mānaveṣu pravartate ||33 || ardhadvāparaparyantaṃ tretādharmāḥ kvacit kvacit | vidyante te’pi naśyanti dvāparārdhe gate sati ||34|| satyaṃ cānṛtasahitaṃ cāsteyaṃ steyamiśritam | ahiṃsā hiṃsayā miśrā śīlaṃ duḥśīlayojitam ||35|| parigraho lobhayukto nītiranyāyasaṃspṛśā | śaucaṃ cāśaucasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ santoṣastṛṣṇikānvitaḥ ||36|| tapaḥ praśaṃsāsaṃbhinnaṃ svādhyāyo dhanakāmanaḥ | īśadhyānaṃ kaṣṭanāśārthakaṃ bhaktirnijārthikī ||37|| sutadārādikaṃ cārdhasvārthaṃ cārdhavṛṣārthakam | bhṛtyāstathāvidhāścārdhasvārthāścārdhaparārthakāḥ ||38 || rājāno’pi nijasyārdhasvārthāścārdhaparārthakāḥ | ṛṣayopi tathā cārdhasvārthatapaḥparāyaṇāḥ ||39|| dvāpare samprajāyante sambandhāścārdhanaijikāḥ | dharmakāryāṇi yajñāśca svārdhārthasādhakārthakāḥ ||3.143.40|| vṛṣṭyā cārdhaṃ kūpajalairardhaṃ bhojyānnamīyate | dvāparottarabhāge vai niścitāyurna vidyate ||41|| vṛddhe jīvati putrādyā mriyante’rdhānṛtā yataḥ | vṛkṣāścārdhāḥ phalantyeva vallikāśca striyastathā ||42|| puruṣāścārdhadhṛtayo bhavanti dvāparārdhake | ardhaviśvāsino lokā mitho vyavaharanti ca ||43|| jāyamāne śubhe kārye tadarthaṃ phalati dhruvam | nadīvegāstathārdhāpaḥ ṛtavaścārdhasatphalāḥ ||44|| tretārdhāyuṣyajanatāḥ kvacit kvacidbhavanti ca | saṃkalpāt satyayuge vai sṛṣṭirasti sthale sthale ||45|| tretāyāṃ darśanāccāpi sṛṣṭirītiḥ pravartate | tretānte sparśanāt sṛṣṭirdvāpare mithunādapi ||46|| dvāparārdhe gate sṛṣṭirmithunād viphalā kvacit | evaṃ sarvā hi khanayo bījādhānyo bhavanti vai ||47|| puruṣā moghavīryāśca vāsanārdhapravartanāḥ | viṣayārdhakṛtasnehāḥ pravartante’rdharāgataḥ ||48|| ardharugṇāḥ prajāścāpi balārdhavatya ityatha | ardhahrasvāḥ pūrvataśca pravartante dvaye yuge ||49|| mantrāścārdhaṃ phalantyeva guravaścārdhabodhinaḥ | dānaṃ vrataṃ dayā dharmaścārdhabhāvaṃ bhajanti vai ||3.143.50|| śiṣyāścārdhanideśasthā vartante’rdhasvamāninaḥ | nāryaścārdhaṃ pātivratyaṃ samāsthāya vadhūṭikāḥ ||51 || kuṭumbaṃ sarvamevātra dvāpare’rdhārthasādhakam | āśramāścārdhavṛṣiṇo varṇāścārdhanijaprathāḥ |||52|| devāścārdhaphaladāśca svāmino’rdhasurakṣiṇaḥ | yuddheṣu cārdhavijayaścārdhabhaṭāḥ ṛtaṃjayāḥ ||53 || pradhānāścārdhagauṇāśca rājyaṃ cārdhaṃ prakāśate | bhāgyaṃ cārdhaṃ phalatyeva nirṇayo’rdhaṛtaṃbharaḥ ||54|| ardharasāḥ prajāyante pūrṇarasāḍhyamūlinaḥ | dvāpare śapathāścāpi lakṣmi cārdhayathārthakāḥ ||55|| vacanāni śreṣṭhināṃ ca tathaivārdhasthirāṇi ca | viśvāso mahatāṃ cāpi tathaivārdhakṛtāspadaḥ ||56|| satyalokāddhi siddhanāmardhāḥ sarvatra gāminaḥ | pitaraścāpi tadvacca bhavanti cārdhagāminaḥ ||57|| surāścāpi tathā bhūmau samāyāntyardhasaṃkhyayā | pātālādisthitāścāpi tathaivārdhavihāriṇaḥ ||58|| aśaktāḥ sarvaśastatra dvāpare’rdhaprajā rame | oṣadhayaścārdhabalā bhiṣajo’rdhaparīkṣakāḥ ||59|| daivajñāścārdhaboddhāraścikitsārdhāścikitsakāḥ | yantratantrāṇi cārdhāni tathārdhakāryadāni vai ||3.143.60|| madhye bhagnāni jāyante’ntarāle lambayanti ca | vārdhakyādārḍhyabhāve’pi kṣīṇadarśanaśaktayaḥ ||61 || kṣīṇādānagatiprāyāḥ kṣīṇānandā bhavanti ca | kṣīṇaśravaṇasparśādyāḥ kṣīṇāsvādanagandhinaḥ ||62|| kṣīṇasattvārdhabalino dvāpare saṃbhavanti ca | satyagṛhaṃ surāvāsā gurukulāni dhārmikā ||63|| prāyaśo’rdhaṃ vinaśyanti dvāpare’rdhe gate kṣitau | yajñaśālā utsavāśca devālayāśca sādhavaḥ ||64|| satyamānasaratnāni satyatīrthāni yāni ca | ardhaṃ tāni vinaśyanti dvāpare’rdhe gate kṣitau ||65|| pavitratārdhanāśā ca spṛśyāspṛśyārdhanāśanam | vandyāvandyārdhanāśaśca pūjyapūjārdhanāśanam ||66|| bhogyabhogārdhanāśaśca peyapānārdhanāśanam | dhyeyadhyānārdhanāśaśca dvāpare’rdhe gate kṣitau ||67|| puruṣārthārdhanāśaśca kalpitārdhavināśanam | dārḍhyaṃ cārdhāstitvaphalaṃ prārbhāścārdhagocarāḥ | |68|| medhā cārdhavicārā ca yatnaścārdhaphalāvahaḥ | mitrāṇi cārdhabhāvāni dāsyaṃ cārdhaṃ pravartate ||69|| paśavaścārdhaviśvāsāḥ pakṣiṇaścārdhasevinaḥ | bhāṣāṇāmardhavijñānaṃ dvāpare’rdhe gate bhavet ||3.143.70|| ardhākarṣaṇarūpāṇi cārdhākarṣaṇaśaktayaḥ | snehāspadādi cārdhāni dvāparerdhe gate kṣitau ||71 || rājyadaṇḍairniyamitāḥ prajāstiṣṭhanti nītigāḥ | prakāśaṃ cārdhamevāpi karma tatkarma gaṇyate ||72|| pracchannaṃ gaṇyate naiva cārdhaṃ dvāparibhirjanaiḥ | daivabhayaṃ prayātyeva dvāpare’rdhaṃ prajāsu vai ||73|| pāpabhayaṃ tathā cārdhaṃ gaṇyate naiva tadyuge | drohabhayaṃ tathā mithyābhayaṃ cārdhaṃ na gaṇyate ||74|| asatkarmabhayaṃ naiva gaṇyate’ghaṃ na manyate | ardhamevaṃ jāyate vai dvāpare’rdhe hi padmaje ||75|| taṃ raścottarakāle tu tryaṃśaṃ satyaṃ prajīvati | tribhāgāścāpi satyādernaśyantyeva dvaye’ntime ||76|| dvāpare’nte caturthāṃśāyuṣyavanto hi dehinaḥ | sahasrārdhaṃ samāraṃbhe tadardhaṃ madhyadvāpare ||77|| tadardhaṃ tryaṃśake yāte caturthāṃśe tadardhakam | āyurvai hrāsamāpannaṃ sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ rame ||78|| aṣṭatālā mānavā vai satye bhavanti cocchritāḥ | tretāyāṃ te ṣaṭṭālordhvā dvāparaṃ caturūrdhvakāḥ ||79|| dvāparārdhe tadardhāśca tato’rdhā daśahastakāḥ | vṛkṣāścaturguṇordhvāśca hastinaśca drumārdhakāḥ ||3.143.80|| hastyardhordhvā ghoṭakāśca tadasamā govṛṣādayaḥ | dvāpare te bhavantyeva bale tryaṃśavivarjitāḥ ||81 || dvāparānte nirbalāśca prāraṃbhāccaturaṃśinaḥ | siddhimantastu ye santi te bhavantyūrdhadīrghakāḥ ||82|| punarhrasvāḥ svalpadehāstato’lpaparīṇāhakāḥ | bhojanaṃ tu daśamāṇaṃ pañcamāṇaṃ tato’rdhakam ||83|| māṇamātraṃ tadardhaṃ ca dvāparānte bhavettadā | divase tu pravāso vai satyayuge’mbare’sti ca ||84|| caturdaśasu lokeṣu pṛthvyāṃ dvīpāntare’pi ca | tretāyāṃ tu pravāso vai vimānāpekṣa eva ha ||85|| divase ca tadā yānti mānavāḥ śatayojanam | dvāpare tu tadardhaṃ ca dvāparārdhe tadardhakam ||86|| dvāparānte tadardhaṃ ca tato’rdhaṃ ca tataḥ param | evaṃ hrasvaśarīrāṇāṃ pādakramo vikuñcitaḥ ||87|| prāṇāyāmairvinā teṣāṃ vyomagatirna vidyate | bhvādhārā bhūnivāsaśca bhūkramā bhūprabhojinaḥ ||88|| evaṃ bhūmātarastatra dvāparānte prajā rame | kṣudhātṛṣātitāpāḍhyā dvāpare’nte janā rame ||89|| asadāḍhyāḥ śāṭhyayuktāḥ svārthāhaṃkārasaṃbhṛtāḥ | kalmaṣairbahubhiryuktā jāyante dvāpare’ntake ||3.143.90|| kṣudracittā dhairyahīnā gāmbhīryavarjitāstathā | jāyante mānavā lakṣmi dvāpare’nte samastataḥ ||91 || striyaḥ śrīvarjitāścāpi maryādārdhavihantrikāḥ | nijārdhasvatvamamatāhaṃkāragarvitāstathā ||92|| bhavantyeva kleśadāśca tathārdhadharmavarjitāḥ | śriyastato varjayanti lakṣmyo viyanti tadgṛhāt ||93|| sampadaścāpasaranti ṛddhayo’pasaranti ca | śiṣṭāśca sampadābhāsā bhavanti vai kusampadaḥ ||94|| janāḥ śiṣṭāḥ svaśiṣṭatvaṃ tyajanti dvāpare’rdhakam | dvāparānte na śiṣṭatvaṃ kalmaṣairhanyate hi tat ||95|| kālaścāpi purā yaḥ sa kleśārdhātmā pravartate | kāladūtā bhavaneṣu parābhavanti mānavān ||96|| vahnayo vāmabhāgārdhaṃ gatvā yānti pradakṣiṇam | dvāpare’nte’rpitaṃ dravyaṃ pūjārthaṃ līyate’rdhakam ||97|| naijaṃ sarvaṃ bhaved dvedhā paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ parārthakam | parabhāvena sambhinnaṃ cittaṃ naijaṃ hi dvāparam ||98|| evaṃ lakṣmi vividhān vai dharmān śrayanti mānavāḥ | pāpaṃ cārdhaṃ tathā cārdhaṃ puṇyaṃ kurvanti tatprajāḥ ||99|| arthaṃ kāmaṃ cehamānāḥ prajā hrāsaṃ vrajantyapi | tatra mantraṃ japenme ca gāyatryākhyaṃ nirantaram || 3.143.1 00|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ, śrīghanaśyāmāya vidmahe | nīlakaṇṭhāya dhīmahi, tanno hariḥ pracodayāt || 10 1|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ, śrībālakṛṣṇāya vidmahe | anādikṛṣṇāya dhīmahi, tannaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pracodayāt || 1 02|| oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ, śrīnārāṇāya vidmahe | vāsudevāya dhīmahi, tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt || 1 03|| oṃ śrībrahmapriyāvallabhāya svāhā namaḥ japet | oṃśrīharipriyāvallabhāya namaḥ japet tathā || 1 04|| ṣaṭlakṣajapakartā vai taratyeva bhavārṇavāt | dvāpare mantramenaṃ vai tato japet pramuktaye ||1 051|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇa śriyaḥpate | rādhāpate parabrahma gopīpate jayāpate ||1 06|| lalitāśrīpate prajñāpate padmāvatīpate | sukhadāśrīpate lakṣmīpate śrīmāṇikīpate ||1 07|| haṃsagaruḍavāraṇaturagādhipate prabho | satāṃpate satīsādhvīpate sarvapate vibho ||1 08|| bhagavan puṇḍarīkākṣa tārayāsmān bhavārṇavāt | dvāparād ghorarūpādvai cāntimasamayātmakāt ||1 09|| ityarthayed bhagavantaṃ parameśaṃ sanātanam | pūjayenmāṃ dhārayecca hṛdaye mayi cārpayet || 3.143.110 || evaṃ mokṣaṃ dvāpare’nte cāpnuyurmānavā rame | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi saṃhitāyā mamāpi ca || 111 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne dvāparayugadharmakarmasvabhāvāstathāvidhamānavānāṃ mokṣārthaṃ mantrādibhajanapradarśanamitinirūpaṇanāmā tricatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 143 ||
<3.144> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca yugadharmā hare nityā āhosvit parivartinaḥ | yuge’nye cānyayugajā pravartante na vā vṛṣāḥ || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca yugadharmā rame nityā yugo dharmātmako hi saḥ | kintu baliṣṭhapuruṣairvivartyante’nyayaugikāḥ || 2 || kalmaṣāḥ kalidharmā vai vivartyante ṛtaṃbharaiḥ | dehadharmā vivartyante baliṣṭhairyogibhistathā || 3 || kāladharmā vivartyante satībhiḥ sādhvikādibhiḥ | doṣadharmā vivartyante siddhaiśca sādhubhistathā || 4 || deśadharmā vivartyante samarthācāryapuṃgavaiḥ | prajādharmā vivartyante rājabhiśca praśāsakaiḥ || 5 || yatidharmā vivartyante camatkāryavatārakaiḥ | kanyādharmā vivartyante samājairlokapūjitaiḥ || 6 || utsavādyā vivartyante siddhavāgbhirjanairiha | varṇadharmā vivartyante varṇāgryanītivedibhiḥ || 7 || āśrayāḥ parivartyante tyāgividehibhirjanaiḥ | mānasāni vivartyante tvākarṣaṇaparairjanaiḥ || 8 || satyadharmā yatra satyaṃ puruṣe tatra santi vai | tretādharmā rajoyuktaṃ sattvaṃ yatra pravartate || 9 || dvāparasya rajoyuktaṃ tamo manāk pravartate | kalerdharmāstāmasā vai tamo yatra pravartate || 3.144.1 0|| sāttvike sattvadharmā vai tāmase kaliyojitāḥ | sattvarajoyute tretārajastamoyute dvikaḥ || 11 || kṛte yuge catuṣpādvai lakṣmi dharmaḥ pravartate | prāpyate bhagavām̐stena dharmakāmārthamokṣadaḥ || 1 2|| dharmo hi bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ pūjā kṛṣṇo hi tarpaṇam | homaḥ sandhyā tathā dhyānaṃ dhāraṇā sakalaṃ hariḥ ||1 3|| pādā dharmasya catvāraḥ satyaṃ dānaṃ tapo dayā | dharmapātā hariścāhaṃ pādāḥ satyādayo mama || 14|| tretāyuge tripāddharmaḥ satyadānadayātmakaḥ | yajñayāgādayaḥ sarvaṃ tretāyāmapyahaṃ rame ||15|| dvāpare dvicaraṇaśca dānadayātmakastvaham | kalau dānaṃ pādamekaṃ dānātmako’smyahaṃ rame || 1 6|| satye śveto bhavāmyeva tretāyāṃ raktavarṇavān | dvāpare’haṃ piśaṃgaśca kalau kṛṣṇo bhavāmyaham || 17|| sattvaṃ rajastama iti vartante puruṣe guṇāḥ | pūruṣanoditāste’pi parivartanta ātmasu || 18|| prabhūtaṃ tu yadā sattvaṃ manobuddhīndriyāṇi ca | tadā kṛtayugaṃ vidyājjñāne tapasi yadratiḥ ||1 9|| yadā karmasu kāmyeṣu śaktiryaśasi dehinām | tadā tretā hṛdaye vai rajobhūtirmato bahiḥ ||3.144.20|| yadā lobhastvasantoṣo māno daṃbhaśca matsaraḥ | kāmyakarmaratiścāpi dvāparaṃ tadrajastamaḥ ||21 || yadā sadānṛtaṃ nidrā hiṃsā kleśaśca tandrikā | śokamohau bhayaṃ dainyaṃ tiṣyastadā tamo mataḥ ||22|| dvāpare vigate lakṣmi janāḥ kaṭukabhāṣiṇaḥ | kāmapradhānabhāvāśca deśā dasyuviśeṣakāḥ ||23|| dharmāḥ pākhaṇḍapūrṇāśca prajābhakṣā nṛpāstadā | śiśnodarasparśatṛpāḥ prajā bhūbhṛta ārthikāḥ ||24|| avratā baṭavo’śaucā vibhavaśca kuṭumbinaḥ | tapasvino grāmavāsā nyāsino hyarthalolupāḥ ||25|| mahāhārā mahātṛṣṇāḥ kalau tu sādhavastadā | tyajanti svāminaṃ bhṛtyāstāpasastyajati vratam ||26|| śūdrāstu pratigṛhṇanti vaiśyāstapaḥparāyaṇāḥ | udvignāśca janāstiṣye piśācasadṛśīprajāḥ ||27|| anyāyabhojakā devātithipūjāvivarjitāḥ | strīparāstu narāḥ sarve pitryudakavivarjitāḥ ||28 || bahuprajālpabhāgyāśca bhavantyeva kalau striyaḥ | śiraḥkaṇḍūyanaparā ājñāṃ bhindanti sarvathā ||29|| tathā māyāmasūyāṃ ca vadhaṃ cāpi tapasvinām | sādhayanti svārthaparāḥ pāpena vyākulendriyāḥ ||3.144.30 || kalau pramādako rogaḥ satataṃ kṣudbhayāni ca | anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ ghoraṃ deśānāṃ ca viparyayaḥ ||3 1 || anṛtaṃ bruvate lubdhāṃ durācārairduriṣṭakāḥ | sarveṣāṃ mānavānāṃ tu sambandhāḥ sarvajātiṣu ||32|| śayanāsanabhojyāni caikakīrṇāni sarvathā | bhrūṇahatyā vīrahatyā sādhuhatyā sthale sthale ||33|| svalpāyuṣye’pi mriyante kramaṃ vinā kuṭumbinaḥ | alpatejobalāścāpyanṛtaprāyā adhārmikāḥ ||34|| rājavṛttisthitāścaurāḥ kāmācārāśca pārthivāḥ | ekapatnyo na śiṣyanti vardhante cābhicārikāḥ ||35|| kāṣāyiṇaśca niḥkacchā vṛttyarthaṃ daivaliṅginaḥ | upahṛtya parānnādi sādhayanti nijārthakam ||36|| śvapacā rājyakartāro viprāsteṣāṃ hi sevakāḥ | sevante śvapacān viprāḥ śrutabhāgyabalākṣayāḥ ||37|| vedaśāstrāgamadharmā vighnarūpāḥ kalau rame | utsāditā bhavantyeva dharmasaṃkaratātra vai ||38|| yajñā naiva bhavantyeva vivāhā na tadā kalau | manaḥprasannatāheturdāmpatye sveṣṭacāritā ||39|| mlecchācāraṃ prajāḥ sarvāḥ kalau śreṣṭhaṃ vadanti hi | citravarṣī tadā devaḥ sasyānāṃ citrapākatā ||3.144.40 || sarve lobhavaṇigvṛttāḥ kapaṭaivikrayārthinaḥ | nāvyāhṛtakrūravākyo nārjavī nānasūyakaḥ ||41|| nopakārī na ca pratyupakārī pāpake yuge | nṛpaśūnyā vasumatī na ca dhānyadhanāvṛtā ||42|| nindakāśca patitāśca kalau bhavanti sarvathā | maṇḍalāni bhavantyeva deśeṣu nagareṣu ca ||43|| rājakāryakarāṇyeva dharmaghnāni kalau yuge | alpodakā cālpaphalā vasuhīnā vasundharā ||44|| goptāraścāpyagoptāro luṇṭakāścāpyaśāsakāḥ | hartāraḥ paravittānāṃ parastrīputrayoṣitām ||45|| sāhasrapriyaduṣṭāśāḥ pranaṣṭacetanā janāḥ | mukhe miṣṭā hṛdi duṣṭā bhavanti suhṛdaḥ kalau ||46|| caurāścaurasvahartāro harturhartā kalau paraḥ | kīṭamūṣakasarpāśca dharṣayanti kalau hi tān ||47|| bahavaścaiva panthānaḥ sampradāyāḥ kalau yuge | pracchannādharmabhoktāro bahiśceṣṭapradarśinaḥ ||48|| devasādhuyatiyogisādhvīdhanānnabhoginaḥ | kṣuttṛptā mānavā puṣṭiṃ kurvanti kupathasya vai ||49|| satye śatābdiko dharmastretāyāṃ vārṣikaḥ sa tu | dvāpare māsikaḥ so’pi kalau cāhnika eva saḥ ||3.144.50|| āhnikaṃ cāpi dharmaṃ taṃ jahatyeva kalau janāḥ | vyākulāśca paribhrāntāḥ parasparabhayārditāḥ ||51|| svān prāṇān parirakṣanto niṣkāruṇyāḥ sudukhitāḥ | nirmaryādā nirākrāntā niḥsnehā nirapatrapāḥ ||52|| udyamavarjitāścāpi māṃsāhārā janāḥ kalau | samudratīravāsāśca matsyāhārāstu sarvathā ||53|| aniketā valkalāḍhyā bhūśayyā mānavāstadā | paśavo mānavā daivāḥ pakṣiṇo jalacāriṇaḥ ||54|| samavṛttāḥ prāyaśo vai kalau sāṃkaryabhoginaḥ | ahaṃ nārāyaṇastatra prerayāmi nijāśritān ||55 || divyadehān pārṣadānme ṛṣirūpān hi tāpasān | dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya te vasanti hyagocarāḥ ||5 6 || parvateṣu śubhācārā vanyamūlaphalāśinaḥ | yugalāni prajāyante tebhyo dharmamayāni ca ||57|| sarvaiśvaryasamarthāni vedabhaktiyutāni ca | mamāvatārairbahavo hanyante duṣṭajātayaḥ ||58|| ativātātivṛṣṭyādyairnaśyanti cābdhitīragāḥ | tato vanānāmṛṣayo mama putrāśca pārṣadāḥ ||59||| pravartante kārtavīryā bhūmau santānakāriṇaḥ | evaṃ kṛtasya santānaḥ kaleścaiva kṣayastathā ||3.144.60|| kṛtasya yogyatāyuktā jāyante pārṣadarṣayaḥ | upabhogasamarthāśca divyadehāḥ ṛtavratāḥ ||61 || vairāgyayoginaḥ sarve cātmabodhaparāstathā | santuṣṭāstapaāsthāśca dharmiṣṭhā bhaktiśīlinaḥ ||62|| saptarṣayastadā svargādāgatyaiṣu vasanti ca | satyaṃ saptarṣayo dharmaṃ kathayantīha teṣu ca ||63|| tiṣṭhanti ye kalau siddhā adṛṣṭā viharanti ca | prakāśaṃ te samāyānti hyācāryāste bhavanti hi ||64|| guravo lokarakṣārhāḥ prajāsu viharanti ca | yogyabrahmamahāvaṃśotthebhyo rājyaṃ dadatyapi ||656|| evaṃ kṛtaṃ yugaṃ lakṣmi punastatra pravartate | tvaṃ kalau kṣīṇatāṃ yātā satye punaḥ pravardhase ||66|| śuddhiṃ tvaṃ labhase lakṣmi sādhusādhvīsamāgamāt | āsurī yātudhānī ca paiśācī yakṣarākṣasī ||67|| tiṣyā tvaṃ satyarūpā vai daivī lakṣmīḥ prajāyase | yugalāni tadā satye prāyaśo gṛhadharmiṇaḥ ||68|| yatitulyāśca yatayo brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ | akāmāścātiniṣkāmā ātmānandavihāriṇaḥ ||69|| saṃkalpamātrayogāśca strīdṛṣṭimātrayoginaḥ | mānasyaśca prajāścāpi putrapautrādayaḥ punaḥ ||3.144.70 || sādhusādhvīsvarūpāste bhavanti cāgate kṛte | devāsuramanuṣyāśca yakṣagandharvarākṣasāḥ ||71 || dharmavratāḥ prajāyante satyayugabalāddhi te | pariṇāhocchraye tulyā jāyante pūrvavatpunaḥ ||72|| bale yoge tathaiśvarye sampatsu ca samādhiṣu | vyomagatau jalagatau jāyante pūrvavatpunaḥ ||73 || medhāyāṃ ca vikāse ca bhautikeṣu yathā purā | tathā kṛte prajāyante mama saṃkalpanoditāḥ ||74|| paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi dhenavaḥ kāmadhenavaḥ | taravaḥ kalpataravo vallikāḥ kalpavallikāḥ ||75|| mānavā divyadehāśca yoṣito divyayoṣitaḥ | tathā kṛte prajāyante yathā pūrve kṛte’bhavan ||76 || kintu lakṣmi brāhmasaṃjñānmuhūrtāt prātarūnakam | prātaḥkālāt saṃgavaśca tato madhyāhnakaṃ tathā ||77|| tato’parārdhārdhakālaḥ sāyaṃ nyūnabalaṃ tataḥ | evaṃ kṛtā yugāḥ sarve pūrvapūrvatarūnakāḥ ||78|| manāksvalpabalāścāpi manāk hrāsapramarditāḥ | uttarottarahrāsayuktāstatastulyā na sarvathā ||79|| sṛṣṭyāraṃbhasthasatyādvai pare satyayugāstataḥ | nyūnabalā bhavantyeva nādisatyasamā hi te ||3.144.80|| mama yogabalaṃ pūrṇaṃ yatra tatrādisadṛśāḥ | mannyūnabalavadvyaktau nyūnabalaṃ kṛtaṃ yugam ||81 || evameva vijānīhi madvinā nirbalaṃ jagat | yatrāhaṃ tatra sarvatra gārhasthye’pi hi sādhutā || 82|| yatra nāhaṃ tatra lakṣmi sādhutve’pi na sādhutā | yasmin kasmin yuge lakṣmi yenāhaṃ samupārjitaḥ |||83|| tenārjitaḥ satyayugaḥ sarvaṃ tenārjitaṃ priyam | lakṣmi santaḥ pravakṣyāmi sādhūnatha tataśca vai ||84|| saṃyujya brahmaṇā hyantastena santaḥ pracakṣate | santaṃ śrīparamātmānaṃ tanvanti ye prajāsu ca ||85|| santaste sādhnuvanti svakāryaṃ mokṣātmakaṃ tathā | pareṣāṃ mokṣakāryaṃ ca sādhayanti ha sādhavaḥ ||86 || divyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ lakṣmi sādhanāt sādhurucyate | brahmaṇi caraṇāllakṣmi brahmacārī sa eva saḥ ||87|| gurorhitaḥ svahitakṛt satye hite sadā rataḥ | sādhurvai brahmacārī ca hitakṛt sādhusattamaḥ ||88 || kāraṇāt sādhanāccaiva gṛhasthaḥ sādhurucyate | satyayuge gṛhasthāste sādhutulyā hi sādhavaḥ ||89|| tāpasāste tathāraṇye vaikhānasā hi sādhavaḥ | yatamānā yatayaśca sādhavo yogasādhanāt ||3.144.90 || dharmaścoccagatiḥ proktaḥ kuśalānāṃ pradāyakaḥ | nārāyaṇena ṛṣiṇā brahmaṇā nirmito vṛṣaḥ ||91 || dārāgnihotrapūjādirvarṇāśramavibhāgaśaḥ | sadbhirācaritastasyācchiṣṭācāraḥ sa ucyate ||92||| śiṣṭā me pārṣadāḥ putrāḥ śiṣyā maharṣayastathā | śiṣyante ye’tra dharmārthaṃ lokasantānakāriṇaḥ || 93 || pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraiḥ śiṣṭairācaryate punaḥ punaḥ | pūrvaiḥ pūrvairmatatvācca śiṣṭācāraḥ sa śāśvataḥ ||94|| dānaṃ satyaṃ tapo bhaktirvidyejyā pūjanaṃ damaḥ | aṣṭaitāni caritrāṇi śiṣṭācāro hi sammataḥ ||95|| brahmacaryaṃ tapo maunaṃ nirāhāratvamityapi | sevanaṃ nijapitrośca gurorāśrayaṇaṃ tathā ||96|| ṣaṭkametatsādhudharmo gṛhasthāḥ sādhavastataḥ | māyāpravāhamāsādya no vahate taratyapi ||97|| tārakaḥ sādhurevāyaṃ gṛhastho’pi hi sajjanaḥ | śiṣṭācārapravṛddhaśca vṛṣo vai sādhusammataḥ ||98|| karmaṇāṃ mayi nyāsastu sannyāsaḥ sādhudharmakaḥ | brahmastotraṃ vidhistotraṃ guṇastotraṃ harermama ||99|| pravartyante pūrvarītyā śiṣṭaiḥ sadbhiḥ sudhārmikaiḥ | jñānaṃ vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ dharmaśceti catuṣṭayam ||3.144.1 00|| sāṃsiddhikāni yeṣāṃ vai sādhavaḥ ṛṣayaśca te | ṛṣante paramaṃ brahma tataste ṛṣayo mataḥ ||1 01 || gatyarthādṛṣaterdhātoḥ sārthakatvaṃ hi sādhuṣu | īśvarāṇāṃ sutā ye ca mānasāścaurasāstathā || 1 02|| ṛṣiputrāḥ ṛṣīkāśca ṛṣayaste tapodhanāḥ | brahmaputrā brāhmaṇāśca kṣatriyāśca viśastathā || 103|| ṛṣiputrāḥ ṛṣayaste lokasantānahetavaḥ | ityevaṃ lakṣmi bahudhā satyadharmā hi sādhavaḥ ||1 04|| satye punaḥ pravartante gṛhasthā api sādhavaḥ | teṣāmāśrayaṇānmokṣo bhuktiśca jāyate dhruvam ||1 05|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇāt sādhusaṃgateḥ | phalaṃ bhuktimokṣarūpaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 06|| sarveṣvapi yugeṣveva guṇaścaiko mahān rame | kṛṣṇasya me kīrtanādvai bhavedeva hi mokṣaṇam ||1 07|| kṛte yajñe harirlabhyastretāyāṃ japato’rjyate | dvāpare sevayā prāpyo hariḥ kalau tu kīrtanāt || 1 08|| kalirdoṣanidhistatra guṇo hariprakīrtanam | dvāparo’rdhadurito’pi guṇavān mama janmataḥ || 1 09|| satyādau nātijanmāhaṃ sarvāḥ sādhuprajāyataḥ | bhavāmyahaṃ kalau bhūyaścānyayugavyapekṣayā ||3.144.1 1 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne yugadharmāṇāṃ parivartanavivecanādinirūpaṇanāmā catuścatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 144||
<3.145> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca kīrtanaṃ te kathaṃ kāryaṃ vada me bhagavam̐stathā | yayā prahvībhāvanayā bhavettava prasannatā || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca kīrtanaṃ me susvareṇa miṣṭagarbheṇa cācaret | savādyena tathā gatirītyā saṃgītakena ca || 2 || tālītālena ca nṛtyenāpi kiṃkiṇikādibhiḥ | anekarāgarāgiṇyādibhirmāṃ kīrtayed rame || 3 || gāndharvaṃ te pravakṣyāmi yāthātathyena saṃśṛṇu | saptasvarāstrayo grāmā mūrchanāstvekaviṃśatiḥ || 4 || tānāścaikonapañcāśadityetat svaramaṇḍalam | ṣaḍjarṣabhau ca gāndhāro madhyamaḥ pañcamastathā || 5 || dhaivataśca niṣādaśca svarāste saptakīrtitāḥ | sauvīrā madhyamā hariṇāśca grāmāstrayo hi te || 6 || mūrchanāste vadāmyatra divyā mūrchāvidhāyikāḥ | hayamedhā hreṣiṇī vai prathamā parikīrtitā || 7 || agniṣṭomā tu cāgneyī dvitīyā parikīrtitā | vājapeyā tṛtīyā tu śyenī sā parikīrtitā || 8 || rājasūyā rāṇikā sā caturthī parikīrtitā | yavarātā vaṃśinī sā pañcamī parikīrtitā || 9 || jātaraupī suvarṇī sā ṣaṣṭhī mūrchā prakīrtitā | gosavanā rāṃbhaṇī sā saptamī mūrchanā matā ||3.145.1 0 || jhaṃjhāvātī varṣiṇī sāṣṭamī vai mūrchanā matā | brahmadānā garjinī sā navamī mūrchanā matā || 11 || prājāpatyā lālinī sā daśamī mūrchanā matā | dāgayākṣī tu kṣautī saikadaśī mūrchanā matā || 12 || pānakrāntā bhaṣiṇī tu dvādaśī mūrchanā hi sā | mṛgākrāntā citkarī sā trayodaśī hi mūrchanā ||1 3 || viṣṇukrāntā dhāriṇī sā caturdaśī hi mūrchanā | santakokilikā conmādinī pañcadaśī tu sā ||14|| sūryakrāntā kālarohiṇikā ṣoḍaśī caiva sā | sarvatobhadrikā modamādinī sāptadāśikī ||15|| pūrvabhadrā bālakaṇṭhī cāṣṭādaśī hi mūrchanā | ālambuṣī hāṃsinī sā navadaśī hi mūrchanā ||16|| sāgarā vijayā kokilikī viśā manoharā | nāradī mānavī ceti mūrchanāścaikaviṃśikī || 17|| anyāścāpi bhavantyeva gauṇyo vai mūrchanāḥ priye | mānavyaścāpi pākṣiṇyaḥ pākṣavyaścāpyanekaśaḥ ||18 || sarvāstāḥ śāradā vetti sarasvatī ca bhāratī | brāhmyo gāṇyaśca paryaścāpsaryo māyūrakīvidhāḥ ||19 || yākṣyaḥ kainnaryaśca hāṃsyo nāginyaścāpi vāḍavāḥ | paitryo daivyastathā kṣautyastāḍinyo bhauṃkinīvidhāḥ ||3.145.20||| mainākyaḥ paikya evāpi śaukyaḥ kilāyikāstathā | etā yathāyathaṃ buddhvā gāyikā gītimācaret |||1 || hrasvaṃ dīrghaṃ plutaṃ jñātvā svaraṃ gāne prayojayet | atha tānān prayuñjīta pravāhe satataṃ muhuḥ ||22|| tānāḥ starā iti proktāḥ pravāhe kṣaṇayoginaḥ | vibhidyante kṣaṇabhedāt sphoṭatānānuyāyinaḥ ||23|| brahmatānaḥ prathamastu garbhatāno dvitīyakaḥ | vyajyaḥ sañcaraṇo’ṇuśca yogaścārohaṇastathā ||24|| tanuḥ puṣṭo viśālaśca vikāsaḥ stanapastathā | kumāro vāmanaścāpi dvistaro vikṛtastathā ||25|| dṛḍho dugdhaḥ kalāpaścāvarttakaśca taraṃgakaḥ | nimnaḥ samaścordhvakaśca tiryak tathaiva kātaraḥ ||26|| kalitaścāgritaścaiṣitaśca taptastu triṃśakaḥ | śṛṃgī ca toraṇī staṃbhī muṣṇako līna ityapi ||27|| udbhavaścāṃkurakaśca granthikaḥ śākhikastathā | bahumūlaśca hastaśca vartulaścocchrayastathā ||28|| śṛṃgo guruścāvaroho vegaḥ sthitirghaṭodaraḥ | ete tānāstava proktā gauṇān tānāṃstathā śṛṇu ||29|| skandaḥ kākuḥ puṣkalaśca ropaḥ santārakastathā | taraṇiḥ saṃgamaścāti vigamaḥ kṣepaṇo mṛdhaḥ || 3.145.30|| prokṣaṇo miśraṇaścāpi galikaḥ kartanastathā | ullekhaśca rayaścāpi ṣoḍaśaḥ saprakīrtitaḥ ||31|| uccaraḥ śaśavinyāso lakṣadhārastu viṃśakaḥ | sahāsavaḥ sahayāno nimnayānastathordhvagaḥ ||32|| garbhayānaḥ paryayaśca viparyayo’bhisañcaraḥ | setubandho dhārabandhastriṃśo’yaṃ parikīrtitaḥ ||33|| agaḥ supto mūrchitaśca kampaḥ kūrdana itkṛtaḥ | akṛtaḥ saṃhṛtaścāpi jīvanaśca videhakaḥ ||34|| uttārakastālavāso dvicatvāriṃśako mataḥ | piṇḍakaḥ kīrṇako yukto bhaṃgī laharanāmakaḥ ||35|| samavāyo’nuvāyaścetyevaṃ tānā guṇātmakāḥ | athānye tāratārādyāstāratamādayastathā ||36|| vidyante tānasantānā śaṃsarodanaharṣaṇā | vibhinnabhāvukā lakṣmi tān jñātvā kīrtayettataḥ ||37|| sthānayatnān prakurvīta śvāsakramānuccāvacān | hāvabhāvānugām̐ścāpi dehaceṣṭāyutām̐stathā ||38|| aṃgaceṣṭāyutām̐ścāpi pratyaṃgakarmayojitān | āntarajñānasphurttyādiprayuktān kīrtayed rame ||39|| nāmānyetāni bhidyante kalpe kalpe caturyuge | jānāmyetāni sarvāṇi tattvarūpābhidhānakaiḥ ||3.145.40|| purā śrīnārado yogī gītyarthaṃ māmupāgataḥ | śrutaṃ sarvaṃ mayā tasya kintu nyūnāṃgakaṃ hi tat ||41 || mayā tadopadiṣṭaḥ sa śikṣaṇārthaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | tava śiṣyo’bhavallakṣmi bhavatyā śikṣitaściram ||42|| sarvāṃgopāṃgasampūrṇaṃ cāgāyata puro mama | bhavatyāḥ sannidhau lakṣmi brahmapriyāsabhāntare ||43|| koṭyarbudābjanārīṇāṃ garvaharo’bhavaddhi saḥ | prasannena mayā nibhālitaḥ śrīnārado muniḥ ||44|| mama gāyakarūpaśca mayā naijīkṛtastataḥ | vetsi tvaṃ sarvamevaitad yato nārāyaṇī hyasi ||45|| śāradāpi tadā vāṇī śrutvā nāradagāyanam | kṣaṇaṃ stabdhābhavattatra kā kathā cānyayoṣitām ||46|| dhūnayāmāsa bahudhā mastakaṃ rasavedinī | sarasvatyaḥ samagrāścābhavan pramohitāḥ kṣaṇam ||47|| praśaṃsābhūdgurostatra lakṣmyāste bahudhā khalu | nāradāya mayā tatrārpitaṃ satpāritoṣikam ||48|| cintāmaṇistathā hāraścakraṃ sudarśanaṃ mama | śaktirmayārpitā divyā mamaiśvaryaviśeṣiṇī ||49|| tataḥ śrīnārado jātaścāvatāroṃ’śarūpakaḥ | nārāyaṇo nārado vai kṛpayā nāvajāyata ||3.145.50|| sabhāyāṃ nāradaścāpi praśaśaṃsa kṛpāṃ tava | yayā praśikṣitā vidyā tāṃ tvāṃ śaśaṃsa sarvathā ||51 || tata ārabhya patnyo me gītirītiḥ punaḥ punaḥ | samabhyasan sakāśātte’psarasaścāpi padmaje ||52|| prāvartata tato vidyā saṃsāre bahudhā priye | śaṃkaro vaiṣṇavo bhūtvā sakāśātte’vidat kalām ||53|| kīrtanasya tato nṛtyaṃ cakāra gītiśobhitam | prasannena mayā tasmai dattaṃ yogavibhūṣaṇam ||54|| smara lakṣmi purā sarvaṃ bhavatyā yat pravidyate | ityuktā ca prasasmāra sarvaṃ dadarśa cātmani ||55|| saṃgītaśālāṃ mahatīṃ sahasrayojanāyatām | śrīpure caiśvare dhāmni bhinnakakṣāsahasrikām ||56|| dadarśa tatra cātmānaṃ sahasrarūpadhāriṇīm | śikṣikāṃ śikṣaṇārūḍhām vādyasaṃgītakāriṇīm ||57|| śikṣyante tatra gopyaśca pārṣadānyaśca muktayaḥ | brahmapriyāstatheśānyaśceśvarāṇyaśca kanyakāḥ ||58|| ālāpām̐stāḥ prakurvantyaḥ śikṣyante cāpsarogaṇāḥ | devyaśca siddhayaścāpi yoginyaḥ śāradāgaṇāḥ ||59|| gāyatryaścāpi sāvitryo brāhmyaśca devakanyakāḥ | gandharvyaścāpi yakṣāṇyaḥ kinnaryaśca parīgaṇāḥ ||3.145.60|| śiṣyante dhanadānārtho bhaktānyaḥ kaśyapātmajāḥ | gandharvāstatra śikṣyante bahavaḥ pūrvasṛṣṭijāḥ ||6 1 || daityakumārikāścāpi dānavyo’suraputrikāḥ | mānavyaścārṣya ākalpajīvinyaścāpi kanyakāḥ ||62|| śikṣyante gītaśālāyāṃ śikṣikāṃ ca nijāmapi | nāgakanyāḥ samastāśca dadarśa śikṣaṇārthinīḥ ||63 || evaṃ vilokya sahasā divyavidyālayān svayam | mahāścaryaṃ gatā tatra pūjitā sarvadaivataiḥ ||64|| sarvāsāṃ goravīsthāne sthitāṃ svāṃ kṛtakāriṇīm | amanyatātimānārhāṃ mahimānaṃ viveda ca ||65|| tatra patiṃ tu māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gāyantaṃ gītikāmapi | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vīkṣya prabhuṃ nijam ||66|| utthāya pādayorlakṣmīḥ patitā vyājahāra ha | namaste bhagavan kṛṣṇa svāṃganānugrahānvita ||67|| kṛpāsindho hare kānta darśitaṃ me’tigauravam | paśyāmi sarvamevaitat kṛpayā te janārdana ||68|| śrīpure’smi śikṣikā vai saṃgītagītikāriṇī | yā yā nāryo narā loke gandharvā devayoṣitaḥ ||69|| śāradāśca sarasvatyaḥ śiṣyā me santi te khalu | śikṣante koṭiśo mattaḥ sarvāḥ saṃgītamandire ||3.145.70 || matsvarūpāt prabhavanti svarā grāmāśca mūrchanāḥ | brahmaṇyeva vilīyante yathāhaṃ hṛdaye sthitā ||71 || etat sarvaṃ mayi cāste gītīcchā vartate mama | yadyājñā gāyanaṃ sarvāṃgopāṃgādisamanvitam |||72|| kartumicchāmi sarvābhiḥ sakhībhiḥ parameśvara | ityuktaḥ śrīpatiścāhaṃ kamale’karaṇaṃ śubham ||73|| maṇḍapaṃ suviśālaṃ cāsanāni cāpyayojayam | vāditrāṇi samāhṛtyāsthāpayaṃ maṇḍape śubhe ||74|| lakṣmyādyāśca bhavatyo vai sarvā brahmapriyāḥ śubhāḥ | āyayurmaṇḍape tatra yathāvatsthānamāsthitāḥ ||75|| cakruḥ saṃgītakaṃ lakṣmi prasanno’haṃ tato’bhavam | varadānaṃ dadau cāpi bhūtale tu punaḥ punaḥ ||76|| kariṣyatha susaṃgītaṃ mama patnyo bhaviṣyatha | itisatyena kamale cāśvapaṭṭasarovare ||77|| brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca haripriyāstathā striyāḥ | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre bhavatya santi matpriyāḥ ||78|| ityevaṃ jāyamānāyāṃ vārtāyāṃ divyadarśane | tirobhavattadā sarvaṃ vyadṛśyatāśvasārasam ||79|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ mandiraṃ kānakaṃ nijam | yathāsthitāṃ mandire tāṃ svāṃ sakhīḥ kāntamityapi ||3.145.8 0|| vilokya mumude lakṣmīrmahāścaryaparābhavat | harṣapūrṇā samutthāya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ||81|| āśliṣya saṃgītikāṃ ca pracakāra mudānvitā | virarāma tato lakṣmīrnārāyaṇo haristadā ||82|| jalaṃ pātuṃ samīyeṣa lakṣmīrjalaṃ dadau tataḥ | māṇikyāśrīḥ sumiṣṭānnaṃ cakre sūpaudanaṃ tathā ||83|| bubhuje śrīhariḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇī jalaṃ dadau | padmāvatī dadau tāmbūlakaṃ prajñā ca naktakam ||84|| virarāma prabhuḥ kṛṣṇaḥ paryaṃke svarṇanirmite | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre lakṣmīḥ padmāvatī tathā ||85|| prajñā ca māṇikī dehasaṃvāhanaṃ pracakratuḥ | anyā brahmapriyāścāpi svasvagṛhe hariṃ patim ||86|| tathaiva sevayāmāsurharirviśrāntimāpa ha | tataḥ sarvā jagṛhuśca prasādabhojanāni vai ||87|| jalapānāni cakruśca madhyāhne modamuttamam | prāpuḥ patikṛpāleśaṃ gṛhakāryāṇi cakrire ||88|| ityevaṃ śivarājñīśri pūrvavṛttaṃ mayā tu te | kathitaṃ sarvamevātra gītavādyādiyogajam ||89|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇāt kīrtanādapi | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ pralabheta sarvānandabhṛto bhavet ||3.145.90|| kīrtanaṃ ye kariṣyanti smṛtvā māṃ tvāṃ haripriyāḥ | brahmapriyāstathā lakṣmi tariṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||91|| dehaṃ kṛtvā viyuktaṃ vai jñānena māyikaṃ tu yaḥ | indriyāṇi pṛthakkṛtvā kṛtvā divyanavāni ca ||92|| āntarīṃ bhāvanāṃ divyāṃ kṛtvā dagdhvā ca vāsanām | praṇavānvitasaṃgītaṃ mama divyacaritrakam ||93|| ātmanā brahmarūpeṇa yaḥ kariṣyati mānavaḥ | devo daityo’thavā yakṣo rākṣaso’sura eva vā ||94|| sarpaḥ paśuḥ patatrī ca kinnaro guhyako’pi vā | hutvātmānaṃ cidānande mayi yogaṃ vidhāya ca ||95|| nāmakīrtiṃ mama lakṣmi kariṣyanti tu ye’pare | te sarve mama bhaktyaiva lapsyante paramaṃ padam ||96|| mama mūrteḥ smaraṇena kṛtaṃ kīrtanamalpakam | divyaṃ prajāyate lakṣmi mokṣadaṃ pāpanāśakam ||97|| sarvātmanā mayā caikībhūya kuryāddhi kīrtanam | saphalaṃ tad bhavedeva pūrṇānandapradāyakam ||98|| tīvravegavatāṃ tīvraphaladaṃ kīrtanaṃ mama | nṛtyāmyahaṃ tadā lakṣmi yadā nṛtyanti
