gāyikāḥ ||99|| gāndharvaiḥ saha gāyāmi na māṃ paśyanti carmiṇaḥ | pramodaṃ mama bhaktānāṃ vardhayāmyarjayāmi ca ||3.145.1 00 || snehaṃ pravardhya tānante nayāmi cākṣaraṃ padam | prasahya te samāyānti na māṃ tyajanti kāmadam ||1 01 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne saṃkīrtane saṃgītikāsvaragrāmamūrchanoddeśo lakṣmyāḥ saṃgītaśālādivyadarśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ|| 145 ||
<3.146> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ bhaktasya gāyakasya me | japato me’bhidhānāni divyatā cātra jāyate || 1 || yatra me gāyanaṃ lakṣmi bhajanaṃ mama kīrtanam | mahotpātā na vai tatra jāyante’pi kadācana || 2 || mama bhaktivihīnānāṃ mahotpātā bhavanti vai | teṣāṃ śāntiḥ prakartavyānyathā naśyanti mānavāḥ || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca mahotpāteṣu jāteṣu kā śāntisteṣu vidyate | sarvadehihitārthaṃ me brūhi śāntiṃ tathāvidhām || 4 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi mahotpātā divyāntarikṣabhūmijāḥ | jāyante yatra ye teṣāṃ śāntiṃ vadāmi tattvataḥ || 5 || saumyā śāntistu divyeṣu hyantarikṣeṣu cābhayā | vaiṣṇavī śāntiriṣṭā ca bhaumotpāteṣu padmaje || 6 || vijigīṣuḥ paraṃ śatruṃ bhūtikāmaśca yo bhavet | parairabhicāritaśca śatrunāśecchukaśca yaḥ || 7 || mahadbhayavināśārthamabhayāṃ śāntimācaret | sādhubhiścāpi vipraiśca kārayecchāntimuttamām || 8 || rājayakṣmābhibhūtastu kṣatakṣīṇo’tirogavān | yajñakāmo dharmakāmaḥ saumyāṃ śāntiṃ prakārayet || 9 || bhūkampe’nnavināśe ca durbhikṣe cātivarṣaṇe | śalabhādibhayotpanne caurapramattaje bhaye ||1 0|| śāntiṃ tu vaiṣṇavīṃ tatra viṣṇubhaktaḥ prakārayet | paśūnāṃ māraṇe prāpte narāṇāmapi māraṇe || 11 || dehināṃ dāruṇe mṛtyau raudrīṃ śāntiṃ vidhāpayet | yajñaṃ ca havanaṃ cāpi cared rudrādipūjanam || 12|| vedanāśe śāstranāśe nāstikeṣu janeṣu ca | apūjyapūjane jāte brāhmīṃ śāntiṃ samācaret || 1 3|| parameṣṭhiprapūjādi kārayed vedavedibhiḥ | bhaviṣyatyabhiṣeke ca paracakrabhaye’pi ca || 14|| svarāṣṭrabhede’rivadhe raudrīṃ śāntiṃ prakārayet | tryahātirikte pavane jhaṃjhāvāte’tidāruṇe ||15|| sarvavigarhite bhakṣye vātaje vikṛte bhaye | vyādhau vā vātaje jāte vāyavīṃ śāntimācaret ||16|| anāvṛṣṭibhaye jāte cātivṛṣṭibhaye’pi ca | vikṛtivarṣaṇe jāte vikṛte ca jalāśaye || 17|| jalotpanne bhaye tatra vāruṇīṃ śāntimācaret | abhiśāpabhaye jāte mantraśāpabhaye’pi ca ||18|| mithyāśāpabhaye prāpte bhārgavīṃ śāntimācaret | jāte prasavavaikṛtye garbharoge ca prasrave || 19|| śuṣke ca prasave kuryācchāntiṃ prājāpatīṃ rame | upaskārāṇāṃ vaikṛtye bhavanānāṃ tathā rame ||20|| śakaṭānāṃ vāhanānāṃ tvāṣṭrīṃ śāntiṃ samācaret | bālānāṃ bālikānāṃ ca vikṛtau ca bhaye’pi ca ||21 || vināśe cājīvane ca kaumārīṃ śāntimācaret | dāvabhaye vahnibhaye tvāgneyo śāntimācaret ||22|| ājñābhaṃge tu sañjāte jāte bhṛtyādisaṃkṣaye | aśvādīnāṃ vikāre tu rogātmake hyupasthite ||23|| gītikādau vikāre ca kaṇṭhādipatane’pi ca | galaroge vraṇādau ca gāndharvīṃ śāntimācaret ||24|| gajānāṃ tu vikāre’pi śāntimāṅgīrasīṃ caret | piśācādibhaye jāte bhūtapretādivalgane ||25|| ḍākinyādikṛte kaṣṭe nairṛtīṃ śāntimācaret | apamṛtyubhaye prāpte duḥsvapne cāvalokite ||26|| nārake vā tādṛśe vā prāpte duḥkhe yamādibhiḥ | asadgatau yāmyavāse yāmyāṃ śāntiṃ vidhāpayet ||27|| dhananāśe dravyanāśe bhūṣāratnādināśane | sampadāṃ ca vināśe tu kauberīṃ śāntimācaret ||28|| vṛkṣāṇāṃ cāpi sasyānāṃ kandānāṃ phalināṃ tathā | vallīnāṃ ca kaṇānāṃ ca mūlānāṃ phalavaikṛtau ||29|| arthānāṃ bhūtiyogānāṃ nāśe śāntiṃ tu pārthivīm | kārayed vedavidbhistāṃ śāntikarmābhivedibhiḥ ||3 0|| prathame dinayāme ca rātrau vā samupadrave | haste svātau ca citrāyāmāditye cāśvine tathā ||31|| aryamṇi cāpi jāte vā tathānyopadraveṣu ca | adbhuteṣvapi jāteṣu vāyavīṃ śāntimācaret ||32|| dvitīye dinayāme tu rātrau vā samupadrave | puṣyāgre ca viśākhāsu pitryāsu bharaṇīṣu ca ||33|| utpāteṣu tathā bhāgye tvāgneyīṃ śāntimācaret | tṛtīye dinayāme ca rātrau ca samupadrave ||34|| rohiṇyāṃ vaiṣṇave brāhme vāsave vaiśvadaivate | jyeṣṭhāyāṃ ca tathā maitrye hyupadraveṣu sarvathā ||35|| aindrīṃ śāntiṃ kārayecca viprairmantrapravedibhiḥ | caturthe dinamāne tu rātrau vā samupadrave ||36|| sārpe pauṣṇe tathārdrāyāmahirbudhnye ca dāruṇe | mūle varuṇadaivatye vārūṇīṃ śāntimācaret ||37|| mitramaṇḍalavelāsu jāyamāne hyupadrave | adbhuteṣu vicitreṣu śāntidvayaṃ prakārayet ||38|| śāntirvarma bhavatyeva rakṣatyupadravāditaḥ | śāntiḥ patnī hi dharmasya dakṣasya duhitā matā ||39|| dharmayuktā mayā cāpi yuktā balena yojitā | mama śaktisvarūpā ca madbalenābhiveśitā ||40|| tattaddevabalaiḥ puṣṭā haratyadyānyupadravān | upaghātāḥ palāyante śāntināmakakarmabhiḥ ||41 || janāpacārānniyatamaparajyanti devatāḥ | devanāmaparāgācca hyupasargaḥ pravartate ||42|| divyāntarikṣabhaumākhyastacchāntistatra śāntidā | graharkṣavaikṛto divyaścopasargaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||43|| ulkāpāto diśāṃ dāhaḥ pariveṣastathaiva ca | gandharvanagaraṃ cāpi vṛṣṭistu vikṛtā tathā ||44|| raktavṛṣṭirviṣatāpaścāntarikṣopasargakāḥ | carasthirabhavau bhaumo bhūkampaścāpi bhūmijaḥ ||45|| jalāśayānāṃ vaikṛtyaṃ bhaumaḥ so’pyupasargakaḥ | bhaume tvalpaphalaṃ jñeyaṃ cireṇa sa vipacyate ||46|| abhrajo madhyaphalado madhyakālaphalapradaḥ | adbhute tu samutpanne yadi vṛṣṭiḥ śivā bhavet ||47|| saptāhābhyantare jñeyamadbhutaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet | adbhutānāṃ nivṛttistu vināśāntyā na jāyate ||48|| tribhirvaṣairadbhutaṃ syāt sumahadbhayakāraṇam | rājñaḥ śarīre loke vā puradvāre purohite ||49|| pākamāyāti putreṣu tathā kośe ca vāhane | ṛtusvabhāvājjāyante hyadbhutā upasargakāḥ ||50|| śāntikarmopaśamitāḥ śubhāvahā bhavanti te | kālamāsaprabhede tu śubhāste śāntimantarā ||51 || vajrāśanimahīkampāsasthanirghātanisvanāḥ | pariveṣarajodhūmaraktārkāstamayodayāḥ |||52|| drumodbhedakarasneho bahuśaḥ saphaladrumaḥ | gopakṣimadhuvṛddhiśca śubhāḥ phālgunacaitrayoḥ ||53|| ṛkṣolkāpātakaluṣaṃ kapilārkendumaṇḍalam | kṛṣṇaṃ śvetaṃ ca pītaṃ ca dhūsaraṃ dhvānnalohitam ||54|| raktaṃ puṣpāruṇaṃ sāndhyaṃ namaḥ kṣubdhārṇavopamam | saritāṃ cāmbusaṃśoṣaścaite grīṣme śubhāvahāḥ ||55|| śakrāyudhapariveṣo vidyudulkādhirohaṇam | kampodvartanavaikṛtyaṃ hasanaṃ dāruṇaṃ kṣiteḥ ||56|| nadyodapāne sarasāṃ vidhūnataraṇaplavāḥ | śṛṅgiṇāṃ ca varāhāṇāṃ varṣāsu śubhadā hi te ||57|| śītānilatuṣārāśca nardanaṃ mṛgapakṣiṇām | rakṣobhūtapiśācānāṃ darśanaṃ vāgamānuṣī |||58|| diśo dhūmāndhakārāśca sanabhovanaparvatāḥ | uccaiḥ sūryodayāstau ca hemante cecchubhāvahāḥ ||59|| divyastrīrūpagandharvavimānādbhutadarśanam | grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ darśanaṃ vāgamānuṣī ||60|| gītavāditranirghoṣo vanaparvatasānuṣu | sasyavṛddhī rasotpattiḥ śaratsu cecchubhāvahāḥ ||61 || himapātānilotpātavirūpādbhutadarśanam | kṛṣṇāñjanābhamākāśaṃ tārolkāpātapiñjaram ||62|| citragarbhodbhavaḥ strīṣu go’jāśvamṛgapakṣiṣu | patrāṅkuralatānāṃ ca vikārāḥ śiśire śubhāḥ ||63|| devatārcāḥ pranṛtyanti vepante prajvalanti ca | vamantyagniṃ tathā dhūmaṃ snehaṃ raktaṃ tathā vasām ||64|| āramanti rudantyetāḥ prasvidyanti hasantyapi | uttiṣṭhanti niṣīdanti pradhāvanti dhamanti ca ||65|| vikṣipanti bhuñjate vā kośapraharaṇadhvajān | avāṅmukhā vai bhavanti sthānāt sthānaṃ bhramanti ca ||66|| evamādyā hi dṛśyante vikārāḥ sahasotthitāḥ | liṅgāyatanavapreṣu tatra vāsaṃ na rocayet ||67|| rājñī vā vyasanaṃ tatra sa ca deśo vinaśyati | devayātrāsu cotpātān dṛṣṭvā deśabhayaṃ vadet ||68|| pitāmahasya harmyeṣu tatra vāsāṃ na rocayet | paśūnāṃ rudrajaṃ duḥkhaṃ nṛpāṇāṃ lokapālajam ||69|| senāpatīnāṃ vai skandaviśākhādisamudbhavam | lokānāṃ viṣṇuvasvīndraviśvakarmasamudbhavam ||70|| vināyakodbhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāyakānāṃ ca śāsinām | devapreṣyānṛpapreṣyādevastrīṇāṃ nṛpastriyāḥ ||71 || vāsudevodbhavaṃ grahodbhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ na cānyathā | devatāgataduḥkheṣu śrutivettā purohitaḥ ||72|| devatārcāṃ snāpayeccācchādayecca vibhūṣayet | pūjayed gandhamālyānnamadhuparkādisampadā ||73|| upatiṣṭhecca vidhivajjuhuyāt saptarātrakam | agnau tato nityameva bhojayed brāhmaṇān sataḥ ||74|| sādhūn sādhvīrmiṣṭabhojyamiṣṭapānaiḥ sadakṣiṇam | prāpte’ṣṭame dine dhenubhūratnadānamācaret ||75|| kāṃcanāni pradadyācca grahaśāntiṃ samāpayet | śāntipāṭhān kārayitvā pāpaṃ samupaśāmayet ||76|| evaṃ kṛte tu te vighnāḥ śāntiṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ | athānagnirdīpyate ced rāṣṭre yasya nirindhanaḥ ||77|| na dīpyate cendhanavān tadrāṣṭraṃ pīḍyate nṛpaiḥ | prajvaledapsu māṃsaṃ vā tathārdraṃ vāpi kiñcana ||78|| prākārastoraṇaṃ dvāraṃ nṛpaveśma surālayam | etāni yatra dīpyante tatra rājño bhayaṃ bhavet ||79|| vidyutā vā pradahyante tadāpi nṛpaterbhayam | svāmino vā bhayaṃ tatra yatrāgniścāsthale bhavet ||80|| anaiśāni tamāṃsi syurvinā pāṃsurajāṃsi ca | dhūmaścānagnijo yatra tatra vidyānmahābhayam ||81 || taḍit tvanamre gagane bhayaṃ syād ṛkṣavarjite | divā satāre gagane bhayaṃ tathaiva jāyate ||82|| grahanakṣatravaikṛtye tāraviṣamadarśane | puravāhanayāneṣu catuṣpānmṛgapakṣiṣu ||83|| āyudheṣu ca dīpteṣu dhūmāyatsu tathaiva ca | nirgamastu ca kośāttu saṃgrāmastumulo bhavet ||84|| vināgniṃ visphuliṃgāśca dṛśyante yatra kutracit | svabhāvāccāpi pūryante dhanūm̐ṣi vikṛtāni ca ||85|| vikāraścāyudhānāṃ syāt tatra saṃgrāmamādiśet | trirātropoṣitastatra juhuyādvai purohitaḥ ||86|| samidbhiḥ kṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ sarṣapaiśca ghṛtena ca | agnimantrairhavanena śāntisteṣāṃ prajāyate ||87|| sādhūn satīrbrāhmaṇām̐śca bālām̐śca bālikāḥ striyaḥ | bhojayet pūjayed devān mahotsavaṃ prakārayet ||88|| suvarṇaṃṃ dhanaratnāni dadyād gā bhuvamambaram | agnijopadravāṇāṃ śastrāṇāṃ śāntistadā bhavet ||89|| pureṣu yeṣu dṛśyante pāde pāde pragāminaḥ | rudanto vā hasanto vā sravanto vā rasān bahūn ||90|| arogāśca vinā vātaṃ śākhāṃ muñcanti vai drumāḥ | phalaṃ mūlaṃ tathā kālaṃ darśayanti trihāyanā ||91 || evaṃ vai svaṃ darśayanti phalaṃ puṣpaṃ tathāntare | kṣīraṃ snehaṃ tathā raktaṃ madhu toyaṃ sravanti ca ||92|| śuṣyantyarogāḥ sahasā śuṣkā rohanti vā punaḥ | uttiṣṭhantīha patitāḥ patanti ca tathotthitāḥ ||93 || evaṃ tatra phalaṃ lakṣmi śṛṇu bhinnaṃ vadāmi te | rodane vyādhirāyāti hasane deśaviplavaḥ ||94|| śākhāprapatane syādvai saṃgrāmo yodhṛnāśakaḥ | bālānāṃ maraṇaṃ kuryād bālavallī prapuṣpitā ||95|| svarāṣṭrabhedaṃ kurute phalapuṣpamathāntare | kṣayaḥ syād gokṣīre cāpi snehe durbhikṣamāpatet ||96|| vāhanāpacayo madye rakte saṃgrāma āpatet | madhusrāve bhaved vyādhirjalasrāve na varṣati ||97|| arogaśoṣitā vṛkṣā durbhikṣaṃ sūcayanti vai | śuṣkeṣu samprarohastu vīryamannaṃ hinasti ca ||98|| utthāne patitānāṃ ca bhayaṃ bhedakaraṃ bhavet | sthānāt sthānaṃ tu gamane deśabhaṃgastadā bhavet ||99|| jvalatsvapi tu vṛkṣeṣu rudatsyapi dhanakṣayam | etat pūjitavṛkṣeṣu sarvaṃ rājño vipadyate ||1 0 0|| puṣpe phale vā vikṛte rājñau mṛtyuṃ drumo diśet | evaṃ vṛkṣeṣu jāteṣu śīghramācchādya taddrumān ||1 01 || gandhamālyādibhiḥ sarvān bhūṣayetpūjayettathā | vṛkṣopari mahacchatraṃ kuryāt pāpopaśāntaye || 1 02|| śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ śriyaṃ śivāmabhyarcayed drumeṣu vai | paśuṃ cānnaṃ tvarpayecca rudraśāntiṃ prakārayet || 10 3|| rudrebhya iti vṛkṣeṣu hutvā rudro japettataḥ | pāyasājyamadhvāḍhyaiḥ prapūjya bhūdānamācaret ||104|| gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ prakuryācca rudraśāntistato bhavet | evaṃ lakṣmi prajārājabhayaṃ sarvaṃ vyapohati ||1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne daivāntarikṣabhaumotpātānāṃ śāntikarmācārādikathananāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 146 ||
<3.147> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca ativṛṣṭiranāvṛṣṭirdurbhikṣādibhayaṃ matam | anṛtau tu divānantā vṛṣṭirbodhyā bhayapradā || 1 || anabhre vaikṛtāścāpi vijñeyā rājamṛtyave | śītoṣṇānāṃ viparyāse nṛpāṇāṃ ripujaṃ bhayam || 2 || śoṇitaṃ varṣate yatra tatra śastrabhayaṃ bhavet | aṃgārapāṃsuvarṣāyāṃ nagarasya vināśanam || 3 || majjāsthisnehamāṃsānāṃ janamārabhayaṃ mahat | dhānyapuṣpaphalānneṣu tathā śatrubhayaṃ mahat || 4 || pāṃsuvarṣā phalānāṃ tu rogabhītikarī matā | akāle cānnavarṣāyāṃ sasyānāṃ bhayamāpatet || 5 || virajaske ravau vyabhre yadā chāyā na dṛśyate | dṛśyate cet pratīpā vai tadā deśabhayaṃ bhavet || 6 || akāle karakāvṛṣṭau duṣkālasya bhayaṃ bhavet | nirabhre vā tathā rātrau śvetaṃ yāmyottareṇa tu || 7 || indradhanustathā colkāpāto gandharvapattanam | digdāhaḥ pariveṣaśca diśāṃ malinatāpi cet | paracakrabhayaṃ syādvai svadeśopadravo’pi ca || 8 || tacchāntyarthaṃ sūryayajñaṃ candrayajñaṃ prakārayet | parjanyayajñaṃ ca tathā marudyajñaṃ prakārayet || 9 || dhanaṃ dravyaṃ kāṃcanaṃ ca gā dadyāt tatra dakṣiṇāḥ | utpātāste śāntimāpya phaladā na bhavanti vai || 3.147.10 || śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā cānyānutpātān duḥkhaśaṃsakān | nagarādupasarpante samīpamupayānti vā || 11 || nadyo hradāḥ prasravāṇi virasāśca bhavanti vā | vivarṇaṃ kaluṣaṃ taptaṃ phenavajjantusaṃkulam || 12|| snehaṃ kṣīraṃ surāṃ raktaṃ vahante vā kulodakāḥ | ṣaṇmāsābhyantare tatra paracakrabhayaṃ bhavet || 1 3|| jalāśayā nadante vā prajvalanti yathānalaiḥ | vimuñcanti tathā lakṣmi jvālādhūmarajāṃsi ca || 14|| yadvā teṣu jalotpattiḥ susattvā vā jalāśayāḥ | saṃgītaśabdāḥ śrūyante janamārabhayaṃ bhavet || 15|| tacchāntyai madhutailājyairhavanaṃ tvācarennṛpaḥ | japettu vāruṇānmantrān jāpayed viprakovidaiḥ || 16|| jale homo jale cāpyabhiṣecanaṃ ghṛtādibhiḥ | madhvājyapāyasaṃ dadyād bhojane sādhuyoginām || 17|| śvetāmbarayutā gāśca dadyācchrīgurave tathā | jalakuṃbhān pradadyādvai ratnamauktikamarpayet || 18|| śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā cānyannārīṣu vikṛtiṃ yathā | akālaprasavā nāryaḥ kālātītaprajāstathā || 1 9|| vikṛtaprasavāścāpi yugmatriprasavāśca vā | amānuṣā hyatuṇḍāśca sañjātavyasanāḥ striyaḥ ||3.147.20 || hīnāṃgā adhikāṃgāśca prasūyante vasanti ca | paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi jantavaśca sarīsṛpāḥ ||21 || yatra deśe’thavā grāme kule vā tādṛśā yadi | vināśastasya deśasya grāmasya vā kulasya vā ||22|| nṛpastādṛśahīnāṃgānnarānnārīrvivāsayet | svarāṣṭre sūyamānāśca strījātīḥ śāntayeddhavaiḥ |||23|| nārīyajñaṃ prakuryādvai havanaṃ bhojanādikam | nārīṇāṃ bālikānāṃ ca vastrālaṃkārakārpaṇam ||24|| mātṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca devīnāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā | yoginīnāṃ satīnāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ||25|| rādhālakṣmīprabhāpāravatīnāṃ pūjanaṃ caret | māṇikyāduḥkhahālakṣmīmahālakṣmīprapūjanam ||26|| lalitāyamunāgaṃgāratibhaktiprapūjanam | kuladevīprapūjāṃ ca kuryāttathaiva kārayet |||27||| kasyecchakaiḥ prakuryācca vipratarpaṇamityapi | tataḥ śāntirbhavellakṣmi hyapapadravo na jāyate ||28|| śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ yānopadravasūcanām | yānti yānānyayuktāni yuktānyapi na yānti ca |||29||| nodyamānānyapi pṛṣṭhe yānti tatra mahadbhayam | vāhyamānā na vāhyante vāhyante nātyanāhatāḥ || 3.147.30 || acalāśca calantyeva na calanti calāni ca | ākāśe tūryanādāśca gītagāndharvaniḥsvanāḥ |||3 1 || kāṣṭhadarvīkuṭhārādi vikāraṃ kurute yadi | gāvo lāṅgūlahananaiḥ striyaḥ strīśca pratāḍayet ||32|| upaskarādivikṛtau ghoraṃ śastrabhayaṃ bhavet | tacchāntyarthaṃ vāyupūjāṃ kārayed viprapūjanam ||3 3 || saktūn dadyādambarādi miṣṭānnāni tu vāyave | pavamānamahāmantrān mārutām̐śca manūn japet ||34|| paramānnaṃ bhojayecca havanaṃ pāyasādibhiḥ | dakṣiṇā bhūyasīrdadyāttena śāntirbhaved rame ||35|| śṛṇu śrīśivarājñīśri tathānyat paśusūcanam | praviśanti yadā grāmamāraṇyā vanapakṣiṇaḥ ||36|| araṇyaṃ yānti vā grāmyāḥ sthalaṃ yānti jalaukasaḥ | sthalaukaso jalaṃ yānti ghoraṃ vāśanti nirbhayāḥ || 37|| rājadvāre puradvāre śivā ghūkāḥ śvajātayaḥ | dine rātriṃcarā yadvā rātrau dinacarāstathā ||38|| grāmyāstyajanti vai grāmaṃ śūnyatā tatra vai phalam | dīptā vāśanti sandhyāsu maṇḍalāni ca kurvate ||39|| vāśanti visvaraṃ yatra tatrāpi śūnyatā phalam | kākā ghūkā mastakasyordhe vāśanti divā yadi ||3.147.40 || tasyāpatkāla āgacched vahnirvākasmiko bhavet | maraṇaṃ cāpyakīrtiśca sthānatyāgo bhavecca vā ||41 || āpatkālo bhavettasya prajākuṭumbibhiḥ kṛtaḥ | pradoṣe kukkuṭo vāśeddhemante yatra kokilaḥ ||42||| arkodaye tvabhimukhī śivā rauti bhayaṃ diśet | gṛhaṃ kapotaḥ praviśet kravyādo mūrdhni līyate ||43|| makṣikāśca madhu kuryurmṛtyurgṛhapaterbhavet | prākāradvārageheṣu toraṇāpaṇavīthiṣu ||44|| ketucchatrāyudhādyeṣu kravyādaḥ prapatet yadi | jāyante vātha valmīkā madhu vā syandate yadi ||45 || sa deśau nāśamāyāti rājā ca mriyate tathā | mūṣakāḥ śalabhāścāpi śukāḥ kṣudrāstṛṇādanāḥ ||46|| dṛśyante’saṃkhyakā yatra kṣunmārabhayamāpatet | kāṣṭholmukāsthiśṛṃgāḍhyāḥ śvāno markaṭavedanāḥ ||47|| viṣaśvānaścābhito’pi bhramanti yatra pattane | kākā dhānyakhale dhānyamukhāḥ patanti vā pure ||48|| durbhikṣavedanā tatra bodhyā dehikṣayaṃkarī | raṇasenābhayaṃ syācca prajānāṃ ca vā tatra ca ||49 || kāko maithunasakto vai divase yadi dṛśyate | rājā vā mriyate tatra sa ca deśo vinaśyati ||3.147.50|| uḍḍīyante niśi kākā gṛhabhaṃgo bhavet khalu | ulūko dṛśyate yatra nṛpadvāre tathā gṛhe ||51 || jñeyo gṛhapatermṛtyurdhananāśastathaiva ca | mṛgapakṣivikāreṣu kuryāddhomaṃ sadakṣiṇam ||52|| devāḥ kapotā rakṣantu grāmaṃ gṛhaṃ kuṭumbinaḥ | rudramantrānindramantrān japeyuḥ pañcaṣā dvijāḥ ||53 || gāvo deyā hyavanānte grahaśāntiṃ makhaṃ caret | viṣṇuyajñaṃ prakuryācca rudrayajñaṃ ca vā caret ||54||| bhautikīṃ śāntimevāpi kārayeddvijapuṃgavaiḥ | śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā cānyadbhautikaṃ sūcanādikam ||55|| prāsādatoraṇāṭṭāladvāraprākāraveśmanām | nirnimittantu patanaṃ dṛḍhānāṃ rājamṛtyukṛt ||56|| rajasā vātha dhūmena diśo yatra samākulāḥ | ādityacandratārāśca vivarṇā bhayavṛddhidāḥ ||57|| rākṣasā yatra dṛśyante brāhmaṇāśca vidharmiṇaḥ | ṛtavaśca viphalā vai hyapūjyaḥ pūjyate janaiḥ ||58|| nakṣatrāṇi viyogīni mahadbhayapradāni vai | ketūdayoparāgau ca chidraṃ vā śaśisūryayoḥ |||59|| graharkṣavikṛtiryatra tatra deśe mahadbhayam | striyastu kalahāyante bālā nighnanti bālakān ||3.147.60|| kriyāṇāmucitānāṃ ca vicchittiryatra jāyate | hūyamānastu yajñāgnirdīpyate naiva śāntiṣu || 61 || pipīlikāśca kravyādā yānti cottaratastathā | pūrṇakuṃbhāḥ sravante ca havirvā vipralupyate ||62|| maṃgalyāśca giro yatra na śrūyante samantataḥ | kṣavathurbādhate yatra hasanti puttalāni ca ||63|| bādhante bhojyajātāni sravante pātrataḥ payaḥ | deveṣu satsu vipreṣu daivataṃ dṛśyate na ca ||64|| devasādhubrāhmaṇeṣu bhāvanārahitāḥ prajāḥ | mandaghoṣāṇi vādyāni vādyante visvarāṇi ca ||65|| gurumitradviṣo yatra śatrupūjāratā janāḥ | pūjyānmānyān śreṣṭhajanān jano yatrāvamanyate ||66|| śāntimaṃgalahomeṣu nāstikyaṃ yatra jāyate | rājā vā mriyate tatra deśo vā sa vinaśyati ||67|| rājño yatra tu durbhāgyaṃ tatra cihnāni vai śṛṇu | prajā nijāḥ nṛpo dveṣṭi prajājanairviruddhyate ||68|| prajāsvaṃ balato dhatte prajājanān jighāṃsati | kṛtaghnatāṃ darśayati yācitaśca prakupyati ||69|| karoti nindanaṃ satāṃ praśaṃsāṃ nābhimanyate | asahyaṃ tu karaṃ lobhād balāt pātayate jane ||3.147.70 || evaṃ vai vikṛte bhāve śakrayāga samācaret | sapatnīkaṃ sureśaṃ ca tathā devān pratarpayet ||71 || bhojanāni dvijātibhyaḥ surebhyo balayastathā | sadbhyaḥ pūjā satībhyaśca śṛṃgārādipradāpanam ||72|| bālikābhyo bhojanāni bālebhyo’pi śubhāni ca | godānaṃ bhūkāñcanādidānaṃ vastrārpaṇādikam ||73|| kartavyaṃ havanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tena śāntirbhavet khalu | yatra deśe’thavā grāme randhitānnaṃ tu māṃsavat ||74|| dṛśyate dadhi raktābhaṃ naśyed grāmaḥ pradeśakaḥ | grāmādhyakṣasya vai dhiṣṇyaṃ patettu kāraṇaṃ vinā ||75|| bhagnaṃ bhaved gṛhaṃ vāpi nṛpanāśo bhavettadā | raktapāṣāṇavarṣā cet śvarodanaṃ samantataḥ ||76|| deśagrāmavināśaḥ syād viṣṇuyāgaṃ tataścaret | bhūkampo garjanāyukto durbhikṣasya prasūcakaḥ ||77|| dakṣiṇāduttaraṃ yāti sāmrājyasya bhayaṃ mahat | pūrvāttu paścimaṃ yāti nṛpaghāto bhaved dhruvam ||78|| pūrva tu paścimād yāti yuddhaṃ nṛpeṣu jāyate | uttarād dakṣiṇaṃ yāti subhikṣaṃ jāyate tadā ||79|| ādyaprahare rogaḥ syād dvitīye dhananāśakṛt | tṛtīye dhānyadhanakṛccaturthe madhyamapradaḥ ||3.147.80|| sandhyāyāṃ bhūkmpane tu sarvasvanāśasūcanam | prayāṇe kaṇṭake vṛkṣe kleśadaṃ kākabhāṣaṇam ||81 || prayāṇe sanmukhaṃ kākaścāyāti vāhane sthitaḥ | yadvāmbare tadā mṛtyuḥ pravāsaṃ naiva kārayet ||82|| dakṣapārśve pakṣakṣepe gantavyaṃ naiva taddiśi | gataḥ punarna vyāyāti maraṇaṃ syāddhruvaṃ rame ||83|| vāmād dakṣaṃ prayāte tu kāke vadhaśca bandhanam | uttaraṃ tārākṣaraṇaṃ durbhikṣakṛnmahad bhavet ||84|| mahāmārīrogajanma prajānāṃ kadanaṃ mahat | tārakayordvayoścābhimukhye kṣaraṇaṃ yuddhakṛt ||85|| saśikhasyodaye chatrabhaṃgo bālādināśanam | sapucchasyodaye nāśo paśūnāṃ vai samāpatet ||86|| khagrāse grahaṇe yuddhaṃ durbhikṣaṃ vā bhaved bhuvi | prayāṇe sauṣadho dehī kṛṣṇadhānyaṃ kapāsakam ||87|| śuṣkatṛṇāni ca karīṣāṇi śuṣkaṃ ca kāṣṭhakam | bhasma tailaṃ guḍaṃ bhāgyahīno janaḥ satailakaḥ ||88|| nagno vikīrṇakeśā strī rugṇaḥ kāṣāmbarastathā | vicitto jīrṇakanthādi śvapaco malapātrakam ||89|| mṛtapakṣī lohavastu vidhavā kardamastathā | carma carmakaraścāpi takraṃ śavaṃ ca garbhiṇī ||3.147.90 || kārāgārī kṛṣṇavṛṣaḥ sarpo maṇḍūka ityapi | kṛkalāso vanagodhā śaśastuṣāśca sūkaraḥ ||91|| tṛṇānyasthi raktapuṣpaṃ mārjāro hiṃsrakaḥ paśuḥ | lohakāro yantrapiṣṭā muṇḍī ca durjano’pi vā ||92|| jaṭī khañjaśca mahiṣo vyaṃgaśca gardabhastathā | rodanaṃ ca yatiścāpi śatruśca bandhito janaḥ |||93 || śvayuddhaṃ ca lutājālaṃ mahatpipīlikādayaḥ | pipīlikāpravāsaśca pāṣāṇo lavaṇaṃ tathā ||94|| kṣuvanaṃ gokṣuvanaṃ ca vandhyā rajakaścāpriyam | abhimiled yadi mārge na gacchettatra vai kvacit ||95|| maraṇaṃ vā mahāduḥkhaṃ kāryāsiddhirviḍambanā | vāmāṃgāni puruṣasya nāryā dakṣāṃgakāni tu |||96|| sphureyuryadi vidyādvai mahāpattiṃ vināśanam | gamane yaṣṭikāpātaḥ śastrapāto’thavā bhavet ||97|| mukuṭādeḥ prapāto vā patanasyaiva sūcakaḥ | patanaṃ svasya harmyāgre sopānādau ca vā yadi ||98|| parājayo bhavettūrṇaṃ maraṇaṃ duḥkhamityapi | evaṃ jāteṣu tatkālaṃ śāntikarmāṇi cācaret ||99|| viṣṇuyāgaṃ rudrayāgaṃ devapūjāṃ grahārcanam | japadānavratādyaṃ ca kuryācchāntirbhaveddhruvā || 3.147.100 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne bahuvidhotpātānāṃ śāntikarmādikathananāmā saptacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 147 ||
<3.148> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyāṇīśri tvaṃ hṛdutthavaikṛtāni tu | śarīrotthāni cānyāni śakunasphuraṇāni ca || 1 || śarīre sphurite mūrghni pṛthvīlābho bhavedapi | lalāṭe sthānavṛddhiḥ syānbhrūnasoḥ priyasaṃgamaḥ || 2 || netrasphurtau bhṛtyalābho dṛgupānte dhanāgamaḥ | ūrdhve madhye cāpagamo dravyasyaiva prajāyate || 3 || dṛṅmūle sphurite lakṣmi jayaḥ śīghraṃ bhavediti | adhaḥsphurtau striyā bhogaḥ śravaṇānte priyā śrutiḥ || 4 || nāsikāyāṃ prītisaukhyaṃ prajāptiradharoṣṭhaje | kaṇṭhasphurtau bhogalabdhirbhogavṛddhistathāṃsayoḥ || 6 || bāhvoḥ sphurtau suhṛtsneho hastayostu dhanāgamaḥ | pṛṣṭhasphutau na vijayo vakṣaḥsphurtau jayo bhavet || 6 || kukṣisphurtau prītilābhaḥ stane strīprasavo bhavet | nābhisphurtau sthānahānirantrasphurtau dhanāgamaḥ || 7 || jānusandhau paraiḥ sandhirbalibhiśca samāgamaḥ | jaṅghāsphurtau khaṇḍabhāgevināśaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ || 8 || pādayoḥ sphuraṇe lakṣmi dhiṣṇyasthānamavāpnuyāt | pādatalasphure cādhvapravāso lābhakṛd bhavet || 9 || vāme nāryā sadā lābhā dakṣe puṃsaḥ sphurādayaḥ | alābhadā viparyastā bhaveyurnātra saṃśayaḥ || 3.148.10 || aniṣṭasphurtijanane havanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā | suvarṇena prakartavyaṃ dānaṃ ca bhojanādikam || 11 || śāntistatra vaiṣṇavī vā raudrī kāryā sukhāptaye | atha hṛdutthavikṛtākārān nidrāmayān śṛṇu || 1 2|| aniṣṭān duṣṭaphaladān dṛṣṭvā śāntiṃ prakārayet | nābhiṃ vinānyagātreṣu tṛṇavṛkṣāṃkurodbhavaḥ || 1 3|| cūrṇanaṃ mūrdhni kāṃsyānāṃ muṇḍanaṃ nagnatā tathā | malināmbaradhāritvamabhyaṃgaḥ paṅkamardanam || 14|| paṃke ca magnatā coccaiḥ pāto dolādhirohaṇam | arjanaṃ pakvalauhānāmaśvānāṃ māraṇaṃ tathā || 15|| raktapuṣpadrumāṇāṃ ca maṇḍalasyādhirohaṇam | varāharkṣakharoṣṭrāṇāṃ tathā cārohaṇakriyā || 1 6|| bhakṣaṇaṃ pakvamāṃsānāṃ tailasya kṛsarasya ca | nartanaṃ hasanaṃ cāpi vivāho gītamityapi || 17|| tantrīvādyavihīnānāṃ vādyānāmabhivādanam | sroto’vagāhanaṃ cāpi snānaṃ gomayavāribhiḥ || 18 || paṃkena snānamevāpi dhūlītoyena vāpi ca | mātuḥ praveśo jaṭhare citārohaṇamityapi || 1 9|| indradhvajābhipatanaṃ patanaṃ candrasūryayoḥ | divyāntarikṣabhaumānāmutpātānāṃ ca darśanam ||3.148.20 || devadvijātibhūpālagurūṇāṃ krodhanaṃ tathā | āliṅganaṃ kumārīṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ tu maithunam ||21 || hāniścāpi svagātrāṇāṃ virekavamanādikam | dakṣiṇāśābhigamanaṃ vyādhinābhibhavo’pi ca ||22|| puṇyahāniḥ phalahāniḥ svapne gṛhasya mārjanam | gṛhasya patanaṃ krīḍā piśācairvānaraiḥ saha ||23|| ṛkṣakravyādakunaraiḥ kustrībhī ramaṇaṃ tathā | parādabhibhavaścāpi parācca duḥkhasaṃbhavaḥ ||24|| kāṣāyāmbaradhāritvaṃ kāṣāyistrīsamāgamaḥ | snehapānaṃ snehamagnatā raktapuṣpalepanam ||25|| bhojanānāṃ bhraṣṭatā ca kāṣṭhānāṃ darśanaṃ tathā | gantrīṇāṃ mārgabhraṃśaśca bahusaṃyāvabhojanam ||26|| veśyānāṃ darśanaṃ tāsāṃ stanyapānaṃ tathā khalu | śataghnīnāṃ sphoṭanādi tathocchiṣṭādibhojanam ||27|| raṃgakāragṛhāṇāṃ ca darśanaṃ ghātakasya ca | taḍāgānāṃ pravāheṣu patanaṃ sasyadāhanam ||28|| kalahaśca jalairnaukābharaṇaṃ cāndhadarśanam | kālīkaṭyāṃ niṣadanaṃ hyupānat mastake sthitam ||29|| viruddhākṣaravinyāsā pravāse nijadarśanam | citramūrtyadṛśyatā ca gaṇeśaśavamastakam ||3.148.30|| uṣṭrasya darśanaṃ bhojyabhakṣaṇe vighnatā tathā | muṇḍanaṃ cābdhipatanaṃ liṃgād raktasravastathā ||3 1|| jīrṇāmbaradharatvaṃ ca gurorviprasya kruddhatā | bhaṣamāṇaśvāvalokaḥ phaṇādhragrahaṇaṃ mṛtiḥ ||32|| candraśālāditaścāpi śilāsu patanaṃ tathā | vanimārjārāvalokaḥ kṛṣṇapuṃkṛtalakṣyakam ||33|| niśānaṃ dhūṣkṛtīnāṃ ca mṛṣāyudhasya sphoṭanam | takrakṛsarāprāśaśca vastūnāṃ vigamo’pi ca ||34|| śatrūṇāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi viṣṭāyāṃ pādapātanam | ṣaṭapadīyajantūnāṃ ca viṣṭhāyāṃ darśanaṃ tathā ||35|| yavanādyaiḥ kṛtaṃ karṇanāsikayośca kartanam | nagnaṃ svadarśanaṃ tailāktaṃ raktastrīsuyojanam ||36|| mukuṭādeḥ paścabhāge vivartanaṃ prapātanam | śikhāprapātanaṃ kalgeḥ prapātanaṃ datāmapi ||37|| liṃgasya patanaṃ cāpi patnīprajvalanaṃ tathā | galapāśāvalokaśca tāḍane maraṇaṃ tathā ||38|| gostrīvadhādikaṃ svapne mahotpātādidarśanam | pitṝṇāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi paradeśapalāyanam ||39|| sarvaiḥ kṛtastiraskāraḥ śavādhirohaṇaṃ tathā | śatrubhiśca dhṛtaścāpi dravyasya tu bhuvastalāt ||3.148.40|| bhūtvā pipīlikā yānaṃ vṛścikā vā tathāvidham | patnyāḥ palāyanaṃ cāpi sarvasvanāśasūcakam ||41 || kanyāvaidhavyabhāvaśca devālayavināśanam | raktasrāvo raktarogaḥ kṣayarogasya darśanam ||42|| mṛtagarbhaprasavaśca garbhiṇīmaraṇaṃ tathā | vimānapatanaṃ cāpi śakaṭībhaṃga ityapi ||43|| vyāghradhṛtiḥ siṃhakṛtaṃ māraṇaṃ svasya vai vane | makarairdharṣaṇaṃ cāpi gahvare patanaṃ tathā ||44|| khāte rodhastathā naije bhavane rodhanaṃ tathā | pādayorbandhanaṃ cāpi vidāyaṃ bahubhirjanaiḥ ||45|| cāṇḍālībhoga evāpi cāṇḍālabhoga ityapi | bhūtānāṃ darśanaṃ svapne bhayadāraṇyadarśanam ||46 || hiṃsrāṇāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi vahnimadhye praveśanam | yānena svargagamanaṃ śmaśānagamanaṃ tathā | | 47 || yāmyāvalokanaṃ cāpi kālapuruṣadarśanam | pretasya darśanaṃ svapne pāśadharasya darśanam | |48 || rājadūtasyāvaloko garuḍasyāpi darśanam | tulasībhakṣaṇaṃ cāpi gomayairbhūvilepanam ||49 | | jhaṃjhāvātenohyamānatvaṃ ca yantreṇa karṣaṇam | samāje karcanaṃ cāpi pādaiḥ pradalanaṃ tathā | |3.148.5 0 || vamanaṃ raktakamiśraṃ vamane kīṭadarśanam | kṛṣṇasarpasya daṃśaśca bhojane kṛmidarśanam | |5 1 || adrīṇāṃ cālanaṃ cāpi bhavanānāṃ ca cālanam | kanyānāṃ bālasūtiśca strīṇāṃ vikṛtasūtitā || 52 || narāṇāṃ śmaśruprapātaḥ strīṇāṃ śmaśruprarohaṇam | narāṇāṃ strīveṣavattvaṃ strīṇāṃ puruṣaveṣitā ||5 3 || astanītvaṃ tathā strīṇāṃ narāṇāṃ stanayuktatā | svapne ced dṛśyate tvetad deśahānirmahābhayam || 54|| rājā svapne hato dṛṣṭo rājyanāśo bhaveddhruvam | vṛkṣāṇāṃ gamanaṃ cāpi vallīnāṃ gamanaṃ tathā || 55 || kanyānāṃ gamanaṃ cāpi videśaṃ prati dṛśyate | lakṣmīhāniśca durbhikṣaṃ bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ | |5 6|| saritāṃ gamanaṃ cāpyudvelatābdheḥ samantataḥ | jalena pralayastatra khaṇḍasya ca kṣiterapi ||57|| pṛthivyā vā pralayaḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā | devālayānāṃ gamanaṃ cādrīṇāṃ gamanaṃ tathā ||58 || śilāsainyavihāraśca deśanāśaphalo bhavet | durge śabdāstu jāyante’jñātā bhayāvahā yadi ||59 || durganāśabhayaṃ tatra rājyanāśabhayaṃ bhavet | kakṣāsu garjanā rātrāvākasmikī bhaved yadi || 3.148.60 || rogavyāptirmahāmārī prajānāśo’ti jāyate | hasanti gṛhakoṇeṣu vānarāḥ ṛkṣakā yadi || 61 || gṛhaṃ śūnyaṃ bhavedeva māsānte nātra saṃśayaḥ | muṇḍī raktāmbaraḥ svapne dṛśyate daṇḍadhṛg yadi || 62 || maraṇaṃ tatra jāyeta vināśaḥ sampadāmapi | vanadevyo yatra śuṣkāḥ kṣīṇāśca vṛddhakanyakāḥ || 63 | | sagarbhā śuṣkadehāśca dṛśyante svapnake yadi | bhagnapādāśca khañjyaśca vṛkṇyaḥ śṛṃgakakudmikāḥ || 64|| anāvṛṣṭihatā lokā mriyante’tra na saṃśayaḥ | gāvo yatra viśasyante mlecchaiḥ svapne’valokyate ||65|| tatra mlecchopadravāśca jāyante nātra saṃśayaḥ | kravyādā yatra dṛśyante nagaropari yūthaśaḥ ||66|| nagarasya vināśaḥ syād rakṣā rudramakhairbhavet | ujjvalā ujjalāḥ kanyā rudanti yānti yatsthalāt ||67|| tatra vidyāvināśaḥ syādudyogānāṃ vināśanam | kalākauśalyanāśaśca dāridryaṃ raṃkatāpatet ||68|| vidhavānāṃ maṇḍalāni dṛśyante yatra cābhitaḥ | kabandhānāṃ maṇḍalāni tatra nāśo hi saṃgarāt ||69|| anṛtau paśavo yatra skhalanti pāśavīṣu vai | dharmabhaṃgo bhaved deśe mlecchācāravivardhanam ||3.148.70|| evamādīni cānyāni kuṣṭhādidarśanaṃ tathā | duḥsvapnāni bhaveyuśca drāk teṣāṃ kathanaṃ varam ||71 || bhūyaḥ prasvāpanaṃ cāpi kalkasnānaṃ tilairapi | homovahnau brāhmaṇānāṃ satāṃ pūjā surārcanam ||72|| stutiḥ śrīharikṛṣṇasya vāsudevasya pūjanam | nāgendramokṣaśravaṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇasya pūjanam ||73|| rudrayāgo viṣṇuyāgaścotsavo harikīrtanam | kārayet svagṛhe lakṣmī kathāṃ nārāyaṇāśritām ||74|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ pārāyaṇaṃ mahat | bhaye mahati samprāpte kāraṇīyaṃ bhayāpaham ||75|| svapnaṃ tu prathame yāme samvatsare phalapradam | ṣaḍbhirmāsairdvitīye tu tribhirmāsaistṛtīyake ||76|| caturthe māsamātreṇa prātardaśāhakṛtphalam | svapnadvaye śubhāśubhe rātrau syātāṃ tadā phalam ||77|| paścād dṛṣṭasya jāyeta prāgdṛṣṭaṃ lopamīyate | eteṣāmasatāṃ svapne darśane tannivāraṇam ||78|| grahayajñaṃ viṣṇuyajñaṃ rudrayajñaṃ satīmakham | pitṛyajñaṃ bhojyayajñaṃ dānapuṇyaṃ samācaret ||79|| rājñā dharmaprasaktena prajānāṃ ca hitepsunā | grahayajñāḥ prakartavyā lakṣahomasamanvitāḥ ||3.148.80|| nadīnāṃ saṃgame cāpi devānāmagratastathā | taṭākasannidhau daivatīrthe bhūmiṃ parīkṣayet ||81 || khanet kuṇḍaṃ hastamātraṃ cāṣṭottarasahasrakam | havanaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ śāntistena prajāyate ||82|| dviguṇaṃ lakṣahome ca koṭihome caturguṇam | aṣṭau vai ṛtvijaḥ kāryā mūlakṣīraphalāśanāḥ ||83|| ratnāni dānayogyāni maṇḍape sannidhāpayet | gāyatryā daśasāhasraṃ mānastokena ṣaḍguṇaḥ ||84|| triṃśad grahādimantraiśca catvāro viṣṇudaivataiḥ | kuṣmāṇḍairjuhuyāt pañca kusumādyaistu ṣoḍaśa ||85|| hotavyā daśasāhasraṃ bādarairjātavedasi | śriyo mantreṇa hotavyāḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa ||86|| śeṣāḥ pañcasahasrāṇi hotavyāstvindradaivataiḥ | hutvā śatasahasraṃ tu puṣyasnānaṃ samācaret ||87|| kuṃbhaiḥ ṣoḍaśasaṃjñaiśca sahiraṇyaiḥ sumaṃgalaiḥ | snāpayed yajamānaṃ tu tataḥ śāntirbhaved dhruvam ||88|| hastyaśvarathayānāni bhūmivastradhanāni ca | anaḍudgośataṃ dadyāt ṛtvijāṃ cātra dakṣiṇām ||89|| māse pūrṇasamāptau tu lakṣahomaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | koṭihomavidhānaṃ tu śṛṇu lakṣmi nadītaṭe ||3.148.90|| ṛtvijaḥ ṣoḍaśa tatra dīkṣā sāmvatsarī matā | caitre vā kārtike homāraṃbhaṃ kṛtvā tu vatsaram ||91 || kārayet yajamānastu payobhakṣī phalāśanaḥ | yavādivrīhayo māṣāstilāśca sarṣapāstathā ||92|| pālāśāḥ samidhaḥ śastā vasordhārā tathopari | ādyamāse tu ṛtvigbhyo dadyādvai kṣīrabhojanam ||93|| dvitīye kṛsarāṃ dadyāddharmakāmārthasādhinīm | tṛtīye māsi saṃyāvaṃ caturthe modakān śubhān ||94|| pañcame dadhibhaktaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhe tu saktubhojanam | pūpām̐śca saptame dadyādaṣṭame ghṛtapūpakān ||95|| miṣṭaudanaṃ ca navame daśame yavamiṣṭakam | ekādaśe māṣavaṭān dvādaśe ṣaḍrasān diśet ||96|| ahatavāsāḥ saṃvīto dinārdhaṃ juhuyācchuciḥ | indrādyādisurāṇāṃ ca prīṇanaṃ sārvakāmikam ||97|| sarvadānāni devānāmagniṣṭomaṃ ca kārayet | vidhinā kārayettatra pūrṇāhutiṃ śate śate ||98|| sahasre dviguṇā deyā yāvacchatasahasrakam | puroḍāśo devatābhyo deyaḥ samarcayed dvijān ||99|| surān pitṝn tarpayecca piṇḍārpaṇairvidhānataḥ | homānte dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāttulā śikyadvayānvitām || 3.148.10 0|| badhvātmānaṃ tolayecca patnīṃ ca tolayettathā | suvarṇena rajatena śarkarābhiśca hīrakaiḥ ||1 01 || dadyād dānaṃ rājasūyaphalaṃ syād vighnanāśakam | prīyatāṃ śrīharikṛṣṇaḥ sarvayajñeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ || 1 02|| ityuktyā praṇamed viprān bhojayellakṣamānavān | sarvopaghātā naśyanti puṇyānyasya bhavanti ca ||1 03|| na śocejjanmamaraṇe kṛtākṛtavicāraṇe | yathāśakti prakuryādvā grahādimakhamuttamam || 1 04|| sarvatīrthavidhānasya sarvayajñavidheḥ phalam | evaṃ kṛtvāpnuyāllakṣmi śravaṇātpaṭhanādapi || 1 05|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne duḥsvapnādyupaghāta tacchāntyarthakagrahayajñādinirūpaṇanāmā aṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 148 ||
<3.149> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri svapne dṛṣṭe śubhe śubham | phale sañjāyate draṣṭuḥ punarnidrāṃ na cācaret || 1 || śailaprāsādanāgāśvavṛṣabhārohaṇaṃ śubham | drumāṇāṃ śvetapuṣpāṇāmārohaṇaṃ śubhaṃ matam || 2 || drumatṛṇodbhavo nābhau tathaiva bahubāhutā | tathaiva bahuśīrṣatvaṃ phalitadrusamudbhavaḥ || 3 || śuklamālyāmbaradhṛtiḥ sarvāgaparimārjanam | candrārkatārakāsparśaḥ śakradhvajādhiliṃganam || 4 || śakradhvajocchrāyakarma śatrūṇāṃ vadhadarśanam | bhūmyambudhīnāṃ grasanaṃ vāde dyute mṛdhe jayaḥ || 5 || bhakṣaṇaṃ cārdramāṃsānāṃ matsyānāṃ pāyasasya ca | darśanaṃ rudhirasyāpi snānaṃ vā rudhireṇa ca || 6 || surārudhiramadyānāṃ pānaṃ kṣīrasya cāpi vai | antrairvā veṣṭanaṃ bhūmau nirmalavyomadarśanam || 7 || mukhena dohanaṃ gośca mahiṣyā hastiyoṣitaḥ | siṃhīnāṃ vaḍavānāṃ ca vyāghrīṇāṃ dohanaṃ śubham || 8 || prasādo devasādhūnāṃ gurūṇāṃ yogyayoginām | viprāṇāṃ ca prasādo’pi satīnāṃ dharmayoṣitām || 9 || aṃbhasā tvabhiṣekaśca gavāṃ śṛṃgāśritena vā | cāndrajalena vā gaṃgājalena vyomavāriṇā || 3.149.1 0|| so’yaṃ rājyaprado bodhyaścābhiṣekaḥ śubhāvahaḥ | svapne rājyābhiṣekaśca ghiṣṇyābhiṣeka uttamaḥ || 1 1|| chedanaṃ śirasaścāpi vighnanāśābhibodhakam | labdhiśca rājyacihnānāṃ tantrīvādyabhivādanam ||1 2|| tathodakānāṃ taraṇaṃ tathā viṣamalaṃghanam | kareṇuvaḍavānāṃ ca gavāṃ ca prasavo gṛhe ||1 3|| ārohaṇamathāśvānāṃ hastināṃ rohaṇaṃ tathā | vṛṣabhārohaṇaṃ cāpi vimānārohaṇaṃ śubham || 1 4|| varastrīṇāṃ tathā lābhaścāliṃganaṃ suyoṣitaḥ | suvarṇaiḥ pūjanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dehe viṣṭhānulepanam || 15 || jīvatāṃ bhūbhṛtāṃ pitrorgurūṇāṃ darśanaṃ satām | sādhvīnāṃ svapriyāyāśca darśanaṃ saumyamuttamam || 1 6|| darśanaṃ devatānāṃ ca vimalānāṃ tu yoginām | vārīṇāṃ nirmalānāṃ cotsavānāṃ darśanaṃ śubham | | 17 | | vṛkṣāṇāṃ phalapuṣpaiśca yuktānāṃ darśanaṃ varam | vallīnāṃ darśanaṃ śreṣṭhamudyānānāṃ śubhapradam | | 18 || vāṭikānāṃ sasasyānāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ darśanaṃ śubham | sajalānāṃ ca saritāṃ meghānāṃ sarasāṃ tathā | | 19 || darśanaṃ cāpi haṃsānāṃ pikānāṃ darśanaṃ śubham | cātakānāṃ mayūrāṇāṃ garuḍānāṃ ca darśanam | | 3.149.20 | | menānāṃ citrapakṣāṇāṃ śuklānāṃ darśanaṃ śubham | hariṇānāṃ hanūmatāṃ gavayānāṃ ca darśanam || 21 || khaḍgamṛgāṇāṃ ca tathā gaṇḍakānāṃ ca darśanam | śubhadaṃ raktasarpāṇāṃ daṃśanaṃ darśanaṃ varam || 25 || nāṇakānāṃ rūpyakāṇāṃ suvarṇānāṃ ca darśanam | bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca hārāṇāṃ divyāmbarāṇāṃ darśanam | | 23 || śubhaṃ candanakuṃkumākṣatadarbhādidarśanam | cāpi śṛṃgāravastūnāṃ māṃgalikādidarśanam || 24|| gaṇikādarśanaṃ nṛtyakāriṇīdarśanaṃ tathā | rājñīnāṃ darśanaṃ devīdarśanaṃ brāhmaṇīkṣaṇam || 25 || kanyakādarśanaṃ sādhudarśanaṃ devadarśanam | mandirālayabhavanānāṃ tu vai darśanaṃ śubham || 26 || bhaktānāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi divyaprāsādadarśanam | ārārtrikādyutsavānāṃ darśanaṃ kīrtanaśravaḥ || 27 || kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ cāpi maṇḍapādipradarśanam | pūjyānāṃ darśanaṃ svapne pūjyaiḥ pādābhimardanam || 28 || guruṇā cāpi pitrā vā nijadehābhimardanam | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cāpi sarvakāryajayapradam || 29 || gaṇeśadarśanaṃ cāpi hareḥ pārṣadadarśanam | varayātrādarśanaṃ ca yajñayāgādidarśanam || 3.149.30 || pratiṣṭhotsavavīkṣā ca sammānaṃ prajayā kṛtam | strīvargairakṣatādyaiśca vardhanaṃ cāśiṣā muhuḥ | | 31 || svarṇāmbarādidhṛtikā divyamālādidhāraṇam | lekhanaṃ pūjanaṃ priyāratipradarśanaṃ tathā || 32 || puṣpāṇāṃ varṣaṇaṃ cāpi śubhakṛt svapnavīkṣitam | ityevamādivīkṣā vai svapne sarvārthasādhikā ||33|| tathā lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi yātrāyāṃ śakunāni te | saphalā vai bhaved yātrā prajānāṃ nṛpaterapi ||34|| sādhūnāṃ cāpi nārīṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ saphalā bhavet | aduḥkhā ceṣṭaphaladā ṛddhidā ca bhavettathā ||35|| śvetāḥ sumanasaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ pūrṇakuṃbhāstathābalāḥ | kanyakā bhūṣaṇaśobhā jalajāḥ pakṣiṇastathā ||36|| sagarbhā śapharī māṃsaṃ mātsyāśca yugalaṃ vadhūḥ | gāvasturaṃgamā nāgā buddha ekaḥ paśurvṛṣaḥ ||37|| ajastveko vararājastridaśāḥ suhṛdaḥ striyaḥ | viprāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ santaḥ saśikhāśca sapuṇḍrakāḥ ||38|| vahniḥ prakāśito jvālāyuto rājā ca sadguruḥ | vidvān dharmī vratī śreṣṭhī nirdaṃbho dānadakṣiṇaḥ ||39|| gaṇikā ca satī sādhvī dūrvā cārdraṃ ca gomayam | rukma rūpyaṃ ca tāmraṃ ca māṇikyaratnahīrakāḥ ||3.149.40 || mauktikāni sphaṭikāni bhūṣaṇāni navāmbaram | navaṃ yānaṃ navā strīśca navaṃ vāhanamityapi ||41 || navānnaṃ ca yavāḥ siddhārthakā oṣadhamityapi | nṛyānaṃ bhadrapīṭhaṃ ca svarṇarājatavastukam ||42|| devaratho vādyagītinṛtyamaṇḍalamutsavaḥ | khaṅgaṃ chatraṃ patākā ca niśānaṃ bherikādikam ||43|| āyudhāni mṛdaścāpi sasyābhāraḥ phalidrumaḥ | rājacihnāni sarvāṇyācāryacihnāni yāni ca ||44|| ghṛtaṃ dadhi payaścāpi phalāni vividhāni ca | sabhūṣo mānyapuruṣo svastikaṃ vardhamānakam ||45|| tāmbūladarśanaṃ cāpi nandyāvartaṃ ca kaustubhaḥ | hārāḥ pātrāṇi ramyāṇi vāditravādanaśravaḥ ||46|| gāndhāraṣaḍjaṛṣabhāḥ svarā miṣṭāśca gītikāḥ | pṛṣṭhe vāyupravāhāścānukūlāḥ sukhadāḥ sadā ||47|| kravyādāḥ susvarāścāpi meghānāṃ garjanāstathā | vidyataḥ śakracāpaṃ ca gajabṛṃhaṇamityapi ||48 || prasannatā śubhaśrutiḥ pūjyānāmabhivandanam | gurvāśīrvādavācaśca manastuṣṭirmanaḥpriyam ||49|| ekataḥ sarvacihnāni manasastuṣṭirekataḥ | maṃgalānāṃ kuṃkumānāmakṣatānāṃ ca darśanam ||3.149.50 || gauḥ savatsā cāśvavāro hariṇaḥ kṛṣṇa ityapi | menā śukaḥ sārikāśca kokilo maṇḍukadhvaniḥ ||51 || pitrorvacaḥ pṛṣṭhataśca gurorvākyaṃ tathāvidham | candrakaḥ puṣpahārādiḥ patraṃ dalaṃ ca bhojanam ||52|| miṣṭānnāni vicitrāṇi pūjakaḥ kathakastathā | sevakaḥ śreṣṭhabhakto’pi dadhi dīpaḥ sudhūpakaḥ ||53||| vedaghoṣāḥ stavanāni bālānāṃ khelanādikam | kanyakānāṃ narmahāsyaṃ vadhūṭīnāṃ nirīkṣaṇam ||54|| tālikāvādanaṃ cāpi jayaśabdaśravastathā | samājasaṃghasanmānaṃ cāhvānaṃ tu prasanmukhāt ||55|| godhūmāṃkuraśaṣpāṇāṃ darśanaṃ pūrṇapātrakam | namaskāro harṣanādo daivādabbhrakaṇāgamaḥ ||56|| puṣpāṇāṃ patanaṃ cāpi mañjarīṇāṃ drumāttathā | yātrākāle svaśirasi maṃgalaṃ lābhasūcakam ||57|| lājānāṃ varṣaṇaṃ cāpi pūjāsthālīpradarśanam | uḍḍayanaṃ hayānāṃ ca maṃgalaṃ jayasūcakam ||58|| śubhavārtāśravaṇaṃ ca devagurvāgamo hutam | dhvajānāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi devavādyaśravastathā ||59|| gālavādyaśravaścāpi navapallavadarśanam | mudrāṇāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi saubhāgyāḍhyāṅganekṣaṇam ||3.149.60 || kāntasya darśanaṃ patnyāḥ kāntāhvānaṃ priyaṃ vacaḥ | ājñāvacanamevāpi nārāyaṇābhidhāśravaḥ ||61|| samastajātibhūtānāṃ bālyapoṣaṇabhojanam | stanyapānayutaṃ bālaṃ vatsaṃ paśuṃ ca pakṣiṇam ||62|| kaṇādyādi bhakṣayantaṃ samātṛkaṃ hi darśanam | grāmagrahapaśupakṣijīvānāṃ ratikarma ca ||63|| dīyamānāni dānāni śṛṃgāraścāpi gopure | prākāre cāpi śṛṃgāro gṛhāgre raṅgavallikā ||64|| candraśālā dhvajāyuktā dṛśyate taddhi maṃgalam | caityadrumā dhvajāyuktāścaityabhautikabhūmayaḥ ||65|| toraṇāni ca patrāṇāmārdrāṇāṃ maṃgalāni vai | candanaiḥ kṛtalepāśca bhittayo rājamārgakāḥ ||66|| sugandhivārisekaśca maṃgalāyatano hi saḥ | pādukādarśanaṃ cāpi gurormūrteḥ pradarśanam ||67|| samudradarśanaṃ cāpi saritāṃ pūradarśanam | divyakumāravīkṣā ca divyakumārikekṣaṇam ||68 || navīnayantravīkṣā ca gurumantrāgamastathā | ākhyānaśravaṇaṃ cāpi pūrvajasmaraṇaṃ tathā ||69|| avatārasmṛtiścāpi mahotsavādidarśanam | pakvaphalāni sarvāṇi saśākhāpakvakānyapi ||3.149.70|| saśimbikaṇiśāḍhyāśca stambāḥ śākhāśca vai drumāḥ | navapallavaśobhāśca darśane sampadāṃ pradāḥ ||71 || masīpātrānmasīprasravaṇaṃ masyāḥ prapātanam | kuṃkumakṣaraṇaṃ cāpi nitambasphuraṇaṃ tathā ||72|| upadārpaṇamevāpi dravyasthālārpaṇādikam | sarvaṃ miṣṭaṃ ca yātrāyāṃ mukhe kavalarūpi ca ||73|| maṃgalaṃ jāyate lābhapradaṃ jayapradaṃ tathā | siṃhacarma mṛgacarma vyāghragajādicarmakam ||74|| svarṇapaṭṭaḥ paṭṭikā ca ghaṇṭā siṃhasya garjanā | hastināṃ cinninādāśca maṃgalāni bhavanti hi ||75|| haste dravyārpaṇaṃ tvanyaiḥ kṛtaṃ ratnārpaṇādikam | kuṃkumākṣatadānaṃ ca tālikādānamityapi ||76|| karapradānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ca manodānaṃ tathottamam | etādṛśeṣu yogyeṣu maṃgaleṣu tu maṃgalam ||77|| jayo lābho vardhanaṃ sammānaṃ sthānaṃ yaśo balam | udayaśconnatirlakṣmīḥ sukhamṛddhirapatyakam ||78|| ityevamādyā jāyante gārhasthye tu viśeṣataḥ | viparītān kathayāmi śṛṇu lakṣmi bhayapradān ||79|| vāyuḥ saśarkaro rūkṣaḥ sammukhe vāti duḥkhadaḥ | śatrurnīco duṣṭajano dṛśyate cedbhayapradaḥ ||3.149.80|| musaladhāravarṣā tu pratilomā na śobhanā | anulomā grahāḥ śastā bṛhaspatirviśeṣataḥ ||81 || candramāḥ sanmukhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhā kanyā ca sanmukhe | prayāṇe dhvajavastrāṇāṃ yaṣṭeśchatrasya pādayoḥ ||82|| pādukāyā bhūṣaṇādeḥ patanaṃ duḥkhadaṃ matam | śastrādeḥ patanaṃ copakaraṇāderdurantakṛt ||83|| nirgatasya dvāradeśe śirasaścābhighātitā | padāgrāghātanaṃ cāpi kṣuvanaṃ kutsapraśnatā ||84|| pṛṣṭiḥ kvagamanādyā cāmaṃgalaṃ duḥkhadaṃ hi tat | skhalanaṃ vāhanānāṃ ca vastrasaṃgastu kīlake ||85|| dhvaje kravyādasya duṣṭaṃ niṣadanaṃ hi duḥkhadam | kva yāsi tiṣṭha mā gaccha pṛṣṭhato gacchaśabdatā ||86|| kiṃ te gatasya tatra syādityevamadhikṣiptatā | bāhyaśabdastrāsayukto bhinnabhairavajarjaraḥ ||87|| aniṣṭāḥ śāpaśabdāśca duḥkhāmaṃgalakāriṇaḥ | purataḥ śabda ehīti śasyate na tu pṛṣṭhataḥ ||88|| raktāni cāpi bhāṇḍāni mṛtaṃ śṛṃgi śavaṃ tathā | tuṣabhasmakapālāsthibhinnabhāṇḍāmbarāṇi ca ||89|| vadhakāḥ pāpakarmāṇo raṇḍā tu garbhiṇī tathā | cāṇḍālaḥ śvapacaścāpi jallādāḥ pāśadhāriṇaḥ ||3.149.90|| tathaivoddhṛtasārāṇi piṇyākādīni yāni ca | khaṇḍitāni phalādīni keśabandhanacarmakam ||91|| ayaḥ paṃkaḥ ṣaṇḍha unmattaśca kaṃgāla ityapi | vikīrṇakeśā rujārtā gairikāmbaramityapi ||92|| tailākto malino muṇḍī nagno’gārastathendhanam | kārpāsaṃ ca tṛṇaṃ śuṣkaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ śuṣkaṃ ca gomayam ||93|| dhānyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ cauṣadhāni bhraṣṭāni dūṣitāni ca | kadaryadarśanaṃ cāpi klinnavastupradarśanam ||94|| hastenākarṣaṇaṃ paścād vastūnāṃ vismṛtistathā | cauryaṃ copakaraṇānāṃ vigamo mukhyavastunaḥ ||95|| avamānaṃ cāśrupātaḥ skhalanaṃ luṇṭhanaṃ svapiḥ | jvaro nirodhaścakrāderbhaṃgo hetisravastathā ||96|| gudāviṣṭhādarśanaṃ ca tathā śaṣpādidarśanam | evamādīni sarvāṇi duḥkhadāni prayāṇake ||97|| prayāṇāraṃbhasamaye mahīmānāgamastathā | pradhānāgama evāpi vighnakṛd vighnaduḥkhadaḥ ||98|| evamādīni vijñāya gacchennaiva nivartayet | harerme pūjanaṃ kṛtvā kālāntare pravāsayet ||99|| śāntikarma prakartavyaṃ homo japaḥ prapūjanam | bhojanaṃ sādhuviprāṇāṃ dānāni ca mahotsavaḥ || 3.149.10 0|| devānāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā | ṛṣīṇāṃ yajanaṃ cāpi bhautikānāṃ sutṛptatā || 101 || evamādīni kāryāṇi nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ | kathāyajñāḥ prakartavyāḥ śāntikarmāṇi yāni ca ||1 02|| lakṣmi caivaṃ kṛte nāśaṃ yānti duritakāni ha | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi duritāni viyanti vai | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi śāntikarmādibhiḥ sadā ||1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne yātrārthaprayāṇe śubhaśakunasvapnādīni viparītānāṃ nivṛttyarthaṃ pūjāśāntiyajñādiścetinirdeśanāmā navacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 149 ||
<3.150> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca vanastho’raṇyavāsaśca parvatādisthito’pi vā | agrāmastho nirjanastho mucyetopadravāt katham || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri vanastho’dristhito’pi vā | nirjanastho’pi kaṣṭārto mucyate smaraṇānmama || 2 || madbhaktānāṃ smaraṇācca pūjanād vandanādapi | nirjane’pi pramucyeta bandhanāt sarvatovidhāt || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca tvadbhaktā bahavaḥ santi balavān śīghrapuṣṭidaḥ | sahāyadaḥ kaṣṭaharaḥ ko’sti me kṛpayā vada || 4 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca tvaritaṃ smṛtamātro’pi vinā sevāṃ prapūjanam | vinā cārādhanāṃ bhaktiṃ hanūmān kaṣṭanāśakaḥ || 5 || paropakāro dharmo’sti śaraṇyatvaṃ hanūmataḥ | avyājaduḥkhahantṛtvaṃ hanūmati virājate || 6 || dhūpamātreṇa cāyāti stotramātreṇa dṛśyate | smṛtimātreṇa cāgatya karotyāśrayavāñcchitam || 7 || bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ ḍākinyādikuyoṣitām | bālavyomagrahāṇāṃ ca hanūmān harate rujam || 8 || brahmacaryaṃ naiṣṭhikaṃ vai hanūmati virājate | brahmarūpaṃ mama rūpaṃ brahmacaryaṃ sadā matam || 9 || brahmaṇo balamāsādya bhaktibalasamanvitam | hanūmān kurute kāryaṃ tapassu te sahāyadaḥ || 3.150.10|| adṛśyo’pi marudrūpaḥ samāgatya drutaṃ prabhuḥ | bhūtapretādikān hatvā mocayatyāścitaṃ rujaḥ || 11 || yatrāste śrīhanumān vai pratiṣṭhāvidhinā sthitaḥ | yatra pratikṛtistasya tatra pīḍā na jāyate || 1 2|| yadvane yadaraṇye’pi parvate nagare pure | grāme kheṭe kharvaṭake ghoṣe ca vasatāvapi || 1 3|| pulīne cocchraye kroḍe sīmni kṣetre jalasthale | gṛhe mārge catvare ca vṛkṣe khāte ca mandire || 14|| hanūmān taddhvajaścāpi pratimā tasya yatra ca | tatra vane sthalādau vā prākāre śibire’pi vā || 15|| nāyānti bhūtavargādyā jvarā vighnā grahādayaḥ | ḍākinī śākinī bhūtā bhairavāśca piśācakāḥ || 16|| kṛtyā vīrāśca rogāśca tāpā niśācarādayaḥ | kaṣṭāni ca kabandhāśca pretāśca brahmarākṣasāḥ ||17|| ripavo yakṣakuṣmāṇḍā yantrā mantrāśca tantrikāḥ | abhicārā vidravanti cendrajālāśca sarvaśaḥ || 18|| yoginyo mātaraścāpi daityā gaṇāśca dānavāḥ | vidravanti vīkṣya devaṃ hanūmantaṃ mahābalam ||1 9|| kākinī kāminī brahmagrahāścauragrahāstathā | mārīgrahā vinaśyanti śrutvā stotraṃ hanūmataḥ ||3.150.20|| vyāghrāḥ sarpāśca rājāno nāryaśca śatravastathā | sabhā pāpāni badhyante śrīmaddhanūmataḥ smṛteḥ ||21 || āyurārogyaiśvaryādivṛddhirbhavati tadbalāt | śiraḥśūlaṃ gulmaśūlaṃ nāgapāśādikaṃ tathā ||22|| kuvidyāścāpyariṣṭāni duritāni ca yāni ca | hanūmataḥ stotrapāṭhānnaśyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||23|| yātudhānāḥ pramathāśca ghoradṛṣṭaya āsurāḥ | ketavaḥ śreyasāṃ pratīpakāḥ sarīsṛpādayaḥ ||24|| ghorāṇyaghāni kṛcchrāṇi daṃṣṭriṇaścāpadastathā | upadravāḥ kalahāśca naśyanti hanumatstavāt |||25|| śṛṇu lakṣmi pūjanādi kathayāmi hanūmataḥ | kārtike kṛṣṇapakṣe tu caturdaśyāṃ prage vratī ||26|| snātvā sampūjya devāṃśca pitṝn natvā samarhaṇān | kārayenmaṇḍapaṃ ramyaṃ kadalīstaṃbhaśobhitam ||27|| hāraiśca hīrakādyaiśca mauktikaiḥ patratoraṇaiḥ | raṅgavallīdhvajādyaiśca kalaśaiḥ śobhitaṃ śubham ||28|| caturdvāraṃ dvādaśastaṃbhaṃ suvastrairvitānitam | gadācihnaṃ dhvajāyāṃ vai kārayenmaṇḍape’pi ca ||29|| kuṇḍaṃ madhye kārayettu hastadvayapramāṇakam | trisetuṃ ca yathāyogyaṃ sindūrābilakuṃkumaiḥ ||3.150.30 || suśṛṃgārya tailapātraṃ sindūraṃ māṣabhojanam | vaṭakān laḍḍukām̐ścāpi caṇakān vrīhitaṇḍulān ||3 1 || tilām̐śca dugdhasārām̐śca pāyasaṃ kṣīramityapi | rājamāṣān ghṛtaṃ miṣṭānnakaṃ phalāni roṭakān ||32|| dugdhakṛtāḥ pūrikāśca guḍaṃ cāpi nidhāpayet | guḍaudanaṃ dugdhapakvaṃ maṇḍape tatra vinyaset ||33|| nārikelān khārikāśca kharjūraṃ panasaṃ tathā | puṣṭānnāni samastāni puṣṭaphalāni yāni ca ||34|| yathāśakti maṇḍape ca vratī samuparakṣayet | puṇyāhaṃ maṃgalavāco vācayitvā dvijaistataḥ ||35|| prāyaścittaṃ kārayecca saṃkalpaṃ kārayedapi | sarvāniṣṭavināśārthaṃ sarveṣṭaprāptaye tathā ||36|| hanūmataḥ pratiṣṭhāṃgamakhaṃ karomi śāntaye | hanūmataḥ prasādena yātu nirvighnapūrṇatām ||37|| gaṇeśaṃ pūjayeccāpi rudraṃ saṃsthāpayettathā | hanūmatkalaśaṃ tatra sthāpayenmukhyadaivatam ||38|| añjaniṃ mātaraṃ cāpi marutaṃ pitaraṃ tathā | śaṃkaraṃ dhātupitaraṃ skandaṃ ca brahmacāriṇam ||39|| sādhūn sanatkumārādīn sthāpayenmātṛkāstathā | rudrān vasūm̐stathādityānnidhīn brahmavrataṃ tathā ||3.150.40|| brahmacaryaṃ sthāpayecca vāstudevaṃ sadaivatam | dikpālām̐llokapālām̐śca saptarṣīn sthāpayettathā ||41 || garuḍaṃ śeṣasarpa ca vyūhaṃ śrīvāsudevajam | śrīlalitāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ rāmādityaṃ nareśvaram ||42|| vānarām̐statsajātīyān sthāpayetpūjayettathā | pannatiṃ pādasaṃsthāṃ ca gadāṃ sarvāghanāśinīm ||43|| sthāpayed brahmamālāṃ ca vardhinīkalaśaṃ tathā | tatrāvāhya ca tīrthāni ratnāni nikṣipedatha ||44|| pañcāmṛtāni sarvāṇi homapātrāṇi yāni ca | pūjādravyāṇi sarvāṇi prokṣayettīrthavāriṇā ||45|| evamāvāhya devāṃśca pūjayeccandanādibhiḥ | ṣoḍaśopasuvastvādyaistato vahniṃ nidhāpayet ||46|| kuṇḍe suhavanaṃ dadyādghṛtamiṣṭānnapāyasaiḥ | samidbhiścārkapuṣpaiśca tathārkādisamindhanaiḥ ||47|| grahāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā juhuyāt sarvadaivatam | ājyaṃ vrīhi phalaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ ca śarkarādikam ||48|| vedikāyāṃ mukhyadevaṃ hanumantaṃ suvarṇajam | rājataṃ vātha tāmraṃ ca ratnajaṃ prastarodbhavam ||49|| ānāyya sthāpayettatra puṇyāhaṃ vācayetpunaḥ | pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayecca mardayettailagandhibhiḥ ||3.150.50 || abhiṣekaṃ kārayecca mārjayeccāmbaraṃ diśet | śṛṃgārayed vāyuputraṃ rathe cārohayettataḥ ||51|| bhrāmayennagare vādyotsavairgītaiḥ samantataḥ | pūjayetpraṇamet sarvaprajā ca gṛhamānayet ||52|| prapūjya vedikāsthāne jale samadhivāsayet | svāpayedekarātriṃ ca prātarutthāpayettataḥ ||53|| devapūjāṃ samastāṃ ca kārayet havanaṃ tathā | jāpayeddhanumanmantrān vedamantraiḥ samanvitān ||54|| śṛṇu lakṣmi mahāmantraṃ kathayāmi hanūmataḥ | oṃ namo hanumate duḥkhabhaṃjanāya sukhaṃ kuru phaṭ svāhā ||55|| daśasāhasravāraṃ vai viṃśatyakṣarapāṭhanam | ekamāsaṃ japennityaṃ sarvaduḥkhapraṇāśanam ||56|| omasya śrīhanumanmahāmantrasya śrīkṛṣṇanārāyāṇaḥ ṛṣiḥ, śrīhimācalahanumān devatā, mama samasteṣṭaprāptyarthaṃ, samastāniṣṭanāśārthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprasannārthaṃ śrīhimācalahanumatstotramantrajapamahaṃ kariṣye ||57|| oṃ namo bhagavate mahābalavate sarvādhikavīryavate mahāhanumate vajradehāya kumārabrahmacāriṇe yakṣarākṣasabhūtapretapiśācakuṣmāṇḍavināyakavetālaḍākinīśākinīkākinīyoginīvetālinīkṛtyāgrahagaṇabandhanāya rogādibandhanāya ehi ehi āgaccha āgaccha āveśaya āveśaya praveśaya praveśaya sphura sphura sarvamukhabandhana śatruṃ me vaśamānaya klīṃ klīṃ klīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ hrīṃ mardaya mardaya māraya māraya cūrṇaya cūrṇaya oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ hraiṃ hrauṃ hraḥ phaṭ svāhā ||58|| oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ oṃ namo bhagavate brahmahanumate rudramarudañjanijātāya sarvaduḥkhanivāraṇāya sarvavidhajvarān chindhi chindhi sarvakaṣṭānyuccāṭaya uccāṭaya oṃ hrāṃ śrīṃ oṃ namo bhagavate śrīhimācalamahāhanumate duḥkhahālakṣmīpūjitāya oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hruṃ hraiṃ hroṃ hraḥ āṃ hāṃ hāṃ hāṃ hāṃ jauṃ sauṃ ehi ehi ehi oṃ haṃ oṃ haṃ oṃ haṃ oṃ namo balavate gadāvate sarvaviṣaṃ hara hara vyomavanaṃ bhedaya bhedaya chedaya chedaya māraya māraya śoṣaya śoṣaya mohaya mohaya jvālaya jvālaya prahāraya prahāraya sarvāṃ māyāṃ bhedaya bhedaya oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ oṃ namo bhagavate mahālāṅgūlavate sarvabalāni kṣobhaya kṣobhaya sakalabandhamokṣaṇaṃ kuru kuru sarvaśūlān nirmūlaya nirmūlaya sarvapāśān śithīlaya śithīlaya duṣṭāvidyāśchedayachedayaṃ nijavidyāḥ prakaṭaya prakaṭaya sarvāriṣṭāni nāśaya nāśaya asādhyaṃ sādhaya sādhaya atra mūrtau vāsaṃ vidhehi vidhehi camatkāraṃ pradarśaya pradarśaya adrivīra tanuman hanuman mama sarvaśatrūn bhasma kuru kuru han han huṃ phaṭ svāhā ||59|| aṣṭottaraśatavāraṃ japet saṃjuhuyāttataḥ | pūjayecchrīhanumantaṃ parihāraṃ tataścaret ||3.150.60|| tṛtīya divase prātaḥ pūjayitvā surām̐stathā | havanaṃ kārayitvā cotthāpya kīśaṃ prapūjayet ||61 || vimāne taṃ prasaṃsthāpya mandirāgre samānayet | pradakṣiṇaṃ vidhāyaiva prāṅmukhe vottarānane ||62|| mandirāgre nidhāyaiva pūjayed balimarpayet | aṅganyāsān prakuryācca tathā tattvāni sannyaset ||63|| netrāñjanaṃ prakuryācca vastrabhūṣādi cārpayet| | prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kuryācca bījavarṇanināditām ||64|| oṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅa āṃ pṛthivyaptejo vāyvākāśātmane oṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ | oṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ aṃ iṃ śabdasparśarūparasagandhātmane īṃ śirasi svāhā | oṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ uṃ śrotratvakcakṣūrasanāghrāṇātmane ūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | oṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ eṃ vākpāṇipādapāyūpasthātmane aiṃ kavacāya hum | oṃ paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ oṃ vacanādānaviharaṇotsargānandātmane auṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | oṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ saṃ haṃ laṃ kṣaṃ taṃ aṃ manobuddhyahaṃkāracittātmane aḥ astrāya phaṭ ||65|| atha devaṃ spṛṣṭvāoṃ āṃ hrīṃ krauṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ saḥ devasya prāṇa iha prāṇāḥ | oṃ āṃ hrīṃ krauṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ saḥ devasya jīva iha sthitaḥ | oṃ āṃ hrīṃ krauṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ saḥ devasya sarvendriyāṇīha | oṃ āṃ hrīṃ krauṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ saḥ devasya vāṅmanaścakṣuśrotraghrāṇaprāṇāḥ iha tiṣṭhantu svāhā ||66|| arcāhṛdi aṃguṣṭhaṃ datvā japet asyai prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhantu asyai prāṇāścarantu ca | asyai devatvamarcāyai māmaheti ca kaścana ||67|| praṇavena sannirudhya dhyātvā sajīvameva tam | hanumanmantramevāsyāḥ karṇe japennamettataḥ ||68|| sthāpayenmandire siṃhāsane samprārthayettathā | sarvāniṣṭāni deva tvatsthāpanena layaṃ param ||69|| yāntu sarvān kuru kīśa sukhinaḥ sarvatomukhān | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ dadyāttāmbūlakaṃ jalam ||3.150.70 || nīrājanaṃ prakuryācca puṣpāñjaliṃ diśettataḥ | kārpāsavartīḥ prājvālya nīrājanamidaṃ vadet ||71 || atra nīrājanam jaya kape balavam̐stvaṃ jaya kape balavam̐stvam | suranaramunijanavanditapatkaja hanumam̐stvam ||72|| prauḍhapratāpa pavanasuta tribhuvanajayakārin | asuraripumadagañjana bhayasaṃkaṭahārin || jaya0 ||73|| bhūtapiśācavikaṭagrahapīḍā te japanāt | hanumadgarjitaśravaṇān naśyati tharakampāt || jaya0 ||74|| raghuvarasahāyollaṃghya sāgaramatidīrgham | sītāśodhanamāptvā laṃkāṃ prājvālayat || jaya0 ||75|| rāmacaraṇaratidāyaka śaraṇāgatatrātaḥ | pūrṇānandita hanuman vāñcchitaphaladātaḥ || jayaḥ ||76|| pūrṇāhutiṃ diśet parihāraṃ ca kārayettathā | viprān sādhūn satīrbhaktān bhojayed dakṣiṇāṃ diśet ||77|| nityaṃ saṃpūjayed devaṃ sa nāśayedaniṣṭakam | dhvajādidarśanaṃ kuryātpaṭhenmantraṃ nirantaram ||78|| sindūratailārkapuṣpamālā dhyātvārpayet sadā | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi lakṣmi manuṣyatāṃ vrajet ||79|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne hanumanmantratajjapahanumatprāṇapratiṣṭhādividhinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 150 ||
<3.151> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca parameśa kṛpāsindho’vatārī tvaṃ svayaṃ hariḥ | jāto’si jagatāmuddhārārthaṃ jānāmi sarvathā || 1 || tava yogaṃ na ye prāptāstādṛśā bhāgyavarjitāḥ | teṣāṃ pañcamahāpāpapāpināmuddhṛtiḥ katham || 2 || brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ svarṇasteyaṃ satīratiḥ | tatprasaṃgī kathaṃ kṛṣṇoddhareyuste vadātra me || 3 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi pravadāmi teṣāmuddhārasādhanam | kṛpā me pāpipāpānāṃ prajvāliketi niścitam || 4 || mayā vai kṛpayā loke tīrthāni sukṛtāni hi | sajīvāni tathā nirjīvāni camatkarāṇi ha || 5 || yatsparśād darśanāccāpi pāpāni prajvalanti vai | aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 6 || nārmadaṃ śuklatīrthaṃ vai bhagukṣetraṃ tathā param | oṃkāraṃ ca mahat tīrthaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 7 || somanāthaṃ dvārikā ca gomatī svarṇalekhikā | nārāyaṇahradastīrthaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśakam || 8 || bhadrāvatī sābhramatī godāvarī sarasvatī | kāverī tāmraparṇī ca gaṃgā ca yamunā tathā || 9 || gokarṇaṃ mādhuraṃ kṣetraṃ kapālamocanaṃ tathā | haridvāraṃ viśālā ca kauravaṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā || 3.151.10 || saṃbhalaṃ brahmaputrā ca gaṇḍakī kāñcanī sarit | gāgarā sindhurevāpi tathā pampāsarovaram || 11 || setubandho jagannāthaḥ kāpilaṃ tīrthamuttamam | mānasākhyasaraścāpi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 12 || kedāraṃ ca patatkāyaṃ cerāvatī mahānadī | menakāṃgī ca śikṣāṃgī bālakṛṣṇasarovaram || 13 || kṛṣṇānadī ca kauberaṃ saro mannāmikānadī | cāṃgaśikṣāṃgikā śālavīnā tryaṃgisarovaram || 14 || nārāyaṇasaraścāpi śrīstanākhyasarovaram | dvikalākhyasaraścāpi līnā yānākṣiṇī nadī | | 15 || obī coralakākhāto yūralā nīparā nadī | nārāyaṇī mahādīrghā sarvapātakanāśinī || 16 || volgā śāvanarī cāpi ahamambarikā nadī | dvīnadī rānanā cāpi pralayāyasarovaram || 1 7|| nāyajharānadī śreṣṭhā tathā caṇḍasarovaram | kaṅgūnadī cāmajhānā parīmā ca sarittathā || 1 8|| supāravaryakasaro mekāṃjhī ca mahānadī | vinipādasaraścāpi sulavākhyasarovaram || 19 || evamādīni tīrthāni mayā kṛtāni padmaje | mahāpāpādipāpānāṃ nāśanāya bhuvastale || 3.151.20 || sarvakhaṇḍeṣu deśeṣu kṛpayoddharaṇāya vai | tatra snātā janā yānti śuddhiṃ muktiṃ parāṃ mama || 21 || yatra yatrāvatārā me yatrāvatārabhūmayaḥ | tatra tīrthakṛto lokā mucyante sarvapātakaiḥ || 22|| yatra mūrteḥ pratiṣṭhā me yatra yajñā bhavanti ca | snānaṃ cāvabhathaṃ yatra mucyante tatra pātakaiḥ || 23 || yatra devā vicaranti santaśca paṃktipāvanāḥ | satyo yatra nivasanti mucyante tatra pātakaiḥ || 24|| brahmacārijanā yatra yatayo yatra santi ca | sādhavo brahmaśīlāśca mucyante tatra pātakaiḥ || 25|| brahmaprasādo yatrāste yatra vai brahmabhojanam | vaiśvadevā bhuṃjate ca mucyante tatra pātakaiḥ || 26|| pitṛtīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ mātṛtīrthaṃ tato’dhikam | gurutīrthaṃ tataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ mucyante tatra pātakaiḥ || 27|| pativratā paraṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ patnīvrataḥ patiḥ | gurusevi śiṣyatīrthaṃ mucyante tatra pātakaiḥ || 28 || videhāḥ sādhavo yatra brahmaniṣṭhāśca dehinaḥ | kīrtanaṃ mandiraṃ yatra mucyante tatra pātakaiḥ ||29||| tapo dhyānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo yatra santi ca | gāvo yatra prapūjyante mucyante sarvapātakaiḥ ||3.151.30 || brāhmaṇārthe gavārthe vā sādhvarthe’sūn parityajet | devārthe cāpi pitrarthe mātrarthe’sūn parityajet ||3 1 || svāmyarthe cāpi patyarthe satyarthe’sūn parityajet | dharmārthe cāpi yajñārthe mokṣārthe’sūn parityajet ||32|| tadā sarvāṇi pāpāni naśyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ | kuryādanaśanaṃ vāpi bhṛgoḥ patanamityapi ||33|| jvalantaṃ vā viśedagniṃ jalaṃ tīrthe viśecca vā | tadā sarvāṇi pāpāni vinaśyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||34|| datvā cānnaṃ tu viduṣe yaścājīvanameva ha | tasya pāpāni naśyanti brahmahatyā vyapohati ||35|| yajñānāmavabhṛthake snātvā mucyeta pātakaiḥ | sarvasvaṃ viduṣe dadyāt sādhave harimūrtaye ||36|| tasya pāpāni naśyanti dānāt satāṃ prasevanāt | triveṇyāṃ snānamātreṇa naśyantyaghāni sarvaśaḥ ||37|| sadā triṣavaṇaḥ snāti namati sarvadevatāḥ | ekabhukto vartate’sya naśyantyaghāni sarvaśaḥ ||38|| hareḥ pādodake snātvā mucyate brahmahatyayā | pañcagavyaṃ varṣamātraṃ pītvā mucyeta madyapaḥ ||39|| svarṇasteyī muśalena hato nṛpaiḥ pramucyate | agamyāgamanaḥ kuryāccāndrāyaṇāni pañcaṣāḥ ||3.151.40|| patiteṣu prasaṃgī ca kuryād vratāni tāni vai | taptakṛcchraṃ caredvā tu saṃvatsaramatandritaḥ ||41 || sarvasvadānaṃ vā dadyāt sarvapāpapraśodhakam | puṇyakṣetre gayādau ca gamanaṃ pāpanāśakam ||42|| amāvāsyātithiṃ prāpya pūjayed yo hariṃ tu mām | sādhūn viprān bhojayitvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||43|| upoṣitaścaturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe tu śārṅgiṇe | vaivasvatāya kālāya sarvabhūtakṣayāya ca ||44|| yamāya dharmarājāya mṛtyave cāntakāya ca | pratyekaṃ tilasaṃyuktān dadyādaṣṭa jalāñjalīn ||45|| pūjayeddharmadevaṃ ca sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate | brahmacaryamadhaḥśayyāmupavāsaṃ sato’rcanam ||46|| prakurvīta smaret kṛṣṇaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ | ṣaṣṭhyāmupoṣitaḥ śukle saptamyāṃ sūryamarcayet ||47|| sataḥ saṃbhojayeccāpi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ | ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya hariṃ tu mām ||48|| dvādaśyāṃ bhojayet sādhūnmucyate sarvapātakaiḥ | nityaṃ japettīrthasevāṃ devasādhuprapūjanam ||49|| kuryādvai śraddhayā nityaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ | grahaṇādau grahaṇānte dadyād dānāni cāpi yaḥ ||3.151.5 0|| hīrakaratnadhānyānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ ca bhuvāmapi | gṛhāṇāṃ bhojanānāṃ ca mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||51 || yo mahāpāpayukto’pi puṇyatīrtheṣu bhāvitaḥ | niyamena tyajet prāṇānmucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||52|| brahmaghnaṃ vā kṛtaghnaṃ vā mahāpātakadūṣitam | bhartāraṃ coddharennārī pativratā satī śubhā ||53 || pativratā tu yā nārī bhartuḥ śuśrūṣaṇotsukā | na tasyā vidyate pāpamiha loke paratra ca ||54|| parabrahmaparaḥ sādhuḥ sādhvī lakṣmīparāyaṇā | śiṣyo gurubrahmasevī mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||55|| phalgutīrthādiṣu snātaḥ sarvapuṇyaphalaṃ labhet | mamājñāyāṃ tu yaḥ snāto mahāpāpān samuddharet ||56|| sarvasvaṃ sādhave dadyād dadyācchrīharaye tu me | dadyāllakṣmyai mahālakṣmyai mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||57|| sampado nidhirūpāśca dadyād devāya viṣṇave | yajñārthaṃ cāpi dadyācca mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||58|| brahmagṛhād bahirnaiva gantavyaṃ yasya vai kvacit | yadṛcchālābhasantoṣī spṛśyate nahi pātakaiḥ ||59|| svayaṃ duḥkhāni saṃvāhya parān sukhān karoti yaḥ | sarvāśīrvādapātraṃ sa spṛśyate pātakairna vai ||3.151.60|| vighasāśī bhaved yastu guruprasādabhojakaḥ | bhikṣābhojanasantuṣṭaḥ pātakaṃ nāsya vidyate ||6 1 || sādhuvṛttistathā caivāyācitavṛttiko bhavet | yadṛcchālābhasantuṣṭaḥ spṛśyate naiva pātakaiḥ ||62|| sadā kṛṣṇakathāmagno brahmajñānaprado janaḥ | satsaṃgabodhamiṣṭānno mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||63|| brahmātmā brahmavitsevī brahmiṣṭhasevitastathā | ātmavivekavān yaḥ sa spṛśyate naiva pātakaiḥ ||64|| yathāpekṣāgrahaścāpi yathātyāgaviḍambanaḥ | yathādhyānarataścāpi spṛśyate naiva pātakaiḥ ||65|| iṣṭāniṣṭe tṛṣāśūnyo lābhālābhe kṣudhākṣayaḥ | grāhyāgrāhye kriyāśūnyaḥ spṛśyate nahi pātakaiḥ ||66 || dīno vā nirdhano vāpi dhanāḍhyo nṛpatiśca vā | yathāśakti praseveta sataḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate ||67|| navanidhīn pradadyādvai yajñe pāpaiḥ pramucyate | padmaṃ cāpi mahāpadmaṃ makaraṃ kacchapaṃ diśet ||68|| mukundaṃ cāpi nandaṃ ca nīlaṃ śaṃkhaṃ tathārpayet | mahāśaṃkhaṃ pradadyācca mucyate sarvabandhanāt ||69|| na saṃkhyayā nidhirbodhyaḥ kintu dānena karmaṇā | dīno’pi datvā devāya padmānidhipatirmaṃtaḥ ||3.151.70 || mahāśaṃkhadhanī vāpyadātā kadarya ucyate | śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi dātāraṃ tu nidhīśvaram ||71 || svalpavitto’pi yo dadyāt prayatnena nijaṃ dhanam | devārthe ca makhārthe ca satyarthe yataye sate ||72|| viṣṇubhaktāya puṇyārthe brahmaniṣṭhāya sādhave | tad dravyaṃ padmasaṃjñaṃ vai padmanidhipatirhi saḥ ||73|| svalpaṃ vā bahulaṃ dravyaṃ sarvasvaṃ vai nijaṃ dhanam | yātrānirvāhamātraṃ tu vihāya yaḥ samarpayet| ||74|| devādibhyo dhanaṃ tasya mahāpadmanidhirmatam | sāttvikaṃ taddhanaṃ proktaṃ dātāpi sāttviko hi saḥ ||75|| asaṃkhyaṃ paraloke’sya dhanaṃ lakṣmīḥ karoti vai | madbhaktārthaṃ prasannātvaṃ sarvaṃ tasmai dadāsi hi ||76|| tasmād vai devabhaktānāṃ nirlobhānāmamū nidhī | akṣayau divyanāmānau padmākṛpāprapūritau ||77|| śṛṇu vai makaraṃ vacmi dravyaṃ kleśairupārjitam | svayaṃ svārthaparo bhuṃkte dāne dadāti naiva hi ||78|| dadyād vivṛddhaye varṣe kusīdārthaṃ pralobhavān | navāṃ navāṃ ca maitrīṃ vai kṛtvā jīrṇāṃ vihāya tu ||79|| evaṃ dravyasya nāśo vai pūrvapūrvaiḥ prajāyate | khaḍgabāṇādiśastrāṇāṃ saṃgrahe’pi vinaśyati ||3.151.80 || adānakaṃ svārthamātraṃ dravyaṃ tanmākaro nidhiḥ | maraṇe sati sarvasvaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ tatparairbhavet ||81 || śṛṇu vai kacchapaṃ lakṣmi bahuyatnaiḥ samarjitam | na bhuṃkte na dadātyeva lobhena viśvasenna ca ||82|| kṣipatyeva hi bhūgarte koṣe nirupayogi tat | sañcite tvekapuruṣaṃ maraṇānte parairapi ||83|| rājabhiścauralokairvā hriyate kacchapaṃ hi tat | mākaraṃ rājasaṃ proktaṃ kācchapaṃ tāmasaṃ sadā ||84|| mākaraṃ tvardhapāpaṃ ca kācchapaṃ pūrṇapāpakam | śṛṇu lakṣmi mukundaṃ ca nidhiṃ yatnaiḥ samarjayet ||85|| kintu kośe pṛthivyāṃ vā nikṣipyāpi punaḥ punaḥ | uddhṛtyoddhṛtya veśyāsu nartakīgāyikāsu ca ||86|| bhāṇḍeṣu vyasane kleśe vyayaṃ karoti nityadā | evaṃ pāpaparā sampad dravyaṃ mukundanāmakam ||87|| pāpakṛñcāpi vai bodhyo mukundakośabhṛnnidhiḥ | śṛṇu nandaṃ nidhiṃ cāpi vakṣyāmi padmaje hi te ||88|| rajastamomahānandī hyādhāraḥ syāt kulasya vai | sarve kuṭumbino dravyaṃ bhuñjate premabhāvataḥ ||89|| stutayaścāpi jāyante bahubhāryā bhavanti ca | svārthārthaṃ dravyabhogaśca paropakṛtaye’pi ca ||3.151.90|| pūrvamitreṣu śaithilyaṃ prītimanyaiḥ karoti ca | evaṃvidhaṃ nijaṃ dravyaṃ nandanidhyātmakaṃ hi tat ||91 || śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi nīlaṃ nidhiṃ tathottaram | nīlena svadhanenāpi sāttviko vai bhavet sadā ||92||| vastradhānyādisaṃgrāhī taḍāgādi karoti ca | tripauruṣo nidhiścāyaṃ tvāmrārāmādi kārayet ||93|| dharmakāryaṃ karotyevodyānaṃ dadāti viṣṇave | śaṃkhaṃ nidhiṃ kathayāmi śṛṇu lakṣmi vipatpradam ||94|| ekasyaiva dhanaṃ śaṃkhaḥ svayaṃ bhuṃkte dhanāntakam | na kulaṃ na ca vaṃśo’pi bhuṃkte yasya dhanaṃ rame ||95|| kadannabhuk parijano na ca śobhanavastradhṛk | svārthapoṣaṇamātrecchurdadyātparanare vṛthā ||96|| śṛṇu lakṣmi mahāśaṃkhaṃ nidhiṃ bhogārthameva na | pareṣveva hi vartante dhanāni na gṛhe manāk ||97|| evaṃ bodhyā hi nidhayo jñātvā tān vyayamācaret | tīrthadevasatāṃ kārye sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||98|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sarvamahāpāpādināśopāyānāṃ nirūpaṇaṃ, navanidhīnāṃ dhanaviniyogādiprayojyanāmakatvaṃ ceti kathananāmā ekapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 151 ||
<3.152> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ pāpoddhārakarān sutān | dharmasya balayuktān vai yadāśrayena mokṣaṇam || 1 || dharmadevāttu kāmaṃ vai śraddhā tu suṣuve sutam | madarthaṃ yojitaḥ kāmo mokṣāya parikalpate || 2 || dharmadevāttu darpaṃ vai śrīḥ putraṃ suṣuve śubham | madarthaṃ yojito darpo mokṣāya parikalpate || 3 || dharmadevāttu niyamaṃ dhṛtistu suṣuve sutam | madarthaṃ yojitaścāyaṃ mokṣāya parikalpate || 4 || dharmadevāttathā tuṣṭiḥ santoṣaṃ suṣuve sutam | madarthaṃ yojitaścāyaṃ mokṣāya parikalpate || 5 || dharmadevāttathā puṣṭirlobhaṃ tu suṣuve sutam | madarthaṃ yojito lobho mokṣāya parikalpate || 6 || dharmadevāttathā medhā śrutaṃ tu suṣuve sutam | madarthaṃ yojitaścāyaṃ mokṣāya parikalpate || 7 || dharmadevāttathā putraṃ daṇḍaṃ tu suṣuve kriyā | madarthaṃ yojito daṇḍo mokṣāya parikalpate || 8 || daṇḍānujaṃ nayaṃ cāpi vinayaṃ ca nayānujam | trayaste yojitā matto mokṣāyaite bhavanti vai || 9 || dharmadevāttathā buddhirbodhaṃ tu suṣuve sutam | madarthaṃ yojito bodho mokṣāya parikalpate ||3.152.1 0|| dharmadevāttathā lajjā sunayaṃ suṣuve sutam | sunayo yojitaḥ kṛṣṇe mokṣāya parikalpate || 11 || dharmadevāttathā vapurvyavasāyamasūyata | madarthaṃ vyavasāyaśca yojito mokṣado bhavet ||12|| dharmadevāttathā śāntiḥ kṣemaṃ tu suṣuve sutam | madarthaṃ yojitaḥ kṣemo mokṣāya parikalpate || 13|| dharmadevāttathā siddhiḥ sukhaṃ tu suṣuve sutam | sukhastu yojitaḥ kṛṣṇe mokṣāya parikalpate || 14|| dharmadevāttathā kīrtiḥ suṣuve ca yaśaḥ sutam | yaśaḥ saṃyojitaṃ kṛṣṇe mokṣāya parikalpate || 15|| dharmapautrāśca vai sarve madarthaṃ yadi yojitāḥ | te sarve’pi tu mokṣāya bhavanti pāpanāśakāḥ ||1 6|| kāmaputro mahānando harṣaputro’timānakaḥ | niyamasya virāmastu santoṣasya tu tarpaṇaḥ || 17|| lobhasya sañcayaḥ putraḥ śrutasya nirṇayaḥ sutaḥ | daṇḍasya kṛcchrasaṃjñaśca nayasya vardhanaḥ sutaḥ || 18|| vinayasya sutaścābhyudayo bodhasya śantanuḥ | sunayasya sutastejo vyavasāyasya āyakaḥ ||1 9|| kṣemasya rakṣaṇaṃ putraḥ sukhasya modasaṃjñakaḥ | yaśasaścotsavaḥ putraḥ pautrā dharmasya vai mayi ||3.152.20 || yojitā mokṣadāḥ sarve pāpānāṃ nāśakā rame | satāṃ yogena yoktavyā divyāste tārayanti vai ||21 || śṛṇu lakṣmi pāpadān vai puṇyakṣayakarānapi | adharmasya sutān duṣṭakriyācārapravartakān ||22|| hiṃsā patnī tvadharmasya tasyāṃ jajñe’nṛtaṃ sutaḥ | asatyamanṛtaṃ proktaṃ duḥkhadaṃ pāpakāri tat ||23|| tasya svasā nirṛtiśca tatsutau narakaṃ bhayam | māyā ca vedanā ceti kanyake dve tathā mate ||24|| māyāsutastathā mṛtyuḥ sarvabhūtāpahārakaḥ | vedanāyāḥ sutaścāpi duḥkhākhyaḥ samajāyata ||25|| mṛtyorvyādhijarāśokatṛṣṇākrodhāśca jajñire | nirṛtiḥ saṃprajajñe ca vināśaṃ duḥsahaṃ sutam ||26|| brahmā tu nirṛteḥ putraṃ duḥsahaṃ kṣudhitaṃ kṛśam | kākasvanaṃ nimnamukhaṃ samuvāca vaco hitam ||27|| mā tvaṃ khāda jagaccedaṃ vṛttiṃ dadāmi te suta | adhārmikasya vāsaste vāso bhavatu sarvadā ||28|| paryuṣitaṃ sakīṭaṃ ca tathā śvabhiravekṣitam | bhagnabhāṇḍagataṃ cāpi mukhavātopasaṃhatam ||29|| ucchiṣṭaṃ svinnamevāpi cāvalīḍhamasaṃskṛtam | udakyopahataṃ bhuktamudakyā tava tad bhavet ||3.152.30 || aśraddhayā hutaṃ dattamasnātairyadavajñayā | tyaktaṃ duṣṭaṃ ca sarvaṃ te mayā yakṣa samarpitam ||3 1 || paṃktibhede ca kapaṭe pākabhede pratāraṇe | kalahe ca kumele ca bhavitā vasatistava ||32|| apoṣyamāṇe vṛddhe ca baddhe gavi hyapoṣite | bālānāṃ poṣaṇahīne gṛhe vāsaḥ sadā tava ||33|| vṛthopavāsino martyān dyūtastrīvyasanasthitān | baiḍālavṛttikām̐ścāpi śaṭhānabhibhaviṣyasi ||34|| duḥkhadānāṃ tu pāpānāṃ tathā viśvāsaghātinām | śaraṇārthiviruddhānāṃ gṛhe vāsaḥ sadā tava ||35|| tvayā gehe nirdaye vai sadā stheyaṃ hi duḥsaha | na stheyaṃ dhārmike gehe devagehe kadācana ||36|| yaḥ saṃskṛtādo vidhinā śucirantastathā bahiḥ | alolupo jitakāmastadgehaṃ cāpavarjaya ||37|| yatra maitrī gṛhe bālavṛddhayoṣinnareṣu ca | tathā svajanavargeṣu gṛhaṃ taccāpi varjaya ||38|| yoṣito’bhiratā yatra na bahirgamanotsukāḥ | lajjānvitāḥ sadā gehaṃ yakṣa tatparivarjaya ||39|| vayaḥsambandhayogyāni śayanānyaśanāni ca | yatra gehe satāṃ sevā tadgṛhaṃ tvaṃ vivarjaya ||3.152.40|| yatra kāruṇikā nityaṃ sādhukarmasvavasthitāḥ | sāmānyopaskarairyuktāstadgṛhaṃ saṃvivarjaya ||41 || yatrāsanasthāḥ sahasottiṣṭhanti gurusannidhau | vṛddhānāṃ sannidhau cāpi tadgṛhaṃ saṃvivarjaya ||42|| tarugulmādibhirdvāraṃ na viddhaṃ yasya veśmanaḥ | udyānaśobhaṃ bhavanaṃ śreyastatparivarjaya ||43|| yatra puṃsāṃ marmabhedo jāyate na dhvanirgṛhe | vāṇī vā tādṛśī nāsti tadgṛhaṃ parivarjaya ||44|| devatāpitṛmartyānāmatithīnāṃ ca pūjanam | tatprasādāśanaṃ yatra tadgṛhaṃ parivarjaya ||45|| satyavākyān kṣamāśīlānahiṃsrānnānutāpinaḥ | puruṣānpramadāścāpi tyajethāścānasūyakān ||46|| bhartṛśuśrūṣaṇe yuktāmasatstrīsaṃgavarjitām | kuṭumbabhartṛśeṣānnapuṣṭāṃ ca tyaja yoṣitam ||47|| brāhmaṇaṃ vedavijñānaṃ sāttvikaṃ devapūjakam | adhvarādiparaṃ tuṣṭaṃ śāntaṃ tyaja sadā śubham ||48|| kṣatriyaṃ rakṣakaṃ cāpi dātāraṃ dharmamārgagam | nyāyamātraparaṃ bhaktaṃ tyaja duḥsaha sadbalam ||49|| vaiśyaṃ tu vyavasāyasthaṃ satyadharmaparāyaṇam | ahiṃsakaṃ dānaparaṃ bhaktaṃ gosevakaṃ tyaja ||3.152.50|| śūdraṃ sevāparaṃ bhaktaṃ śāntiṃ niṣkapaṭaṃ tyaja | patnī patiryatra ratau parasparasahāyinau ||51 || dharmaparau mokṣaparau tadgṛhaṃ sarvathā tyaja | yatra putro guroḥ pūjāṃ devānāṃ ca tathā pituḥ ||52|| patnī ca bhartuḥ kurute tatra duḥsaha mā vasa | prātaḥ sāyaṃ kṛtalepaṃ devapūjābhisaṃskṛtam ||53|| gṛhaṃ satāṃ pādapūtaṃ na tvaṃ śaknoṣi vīkṣitum | bhāskarādṛṣṭaśayyāni nityāgnisalilāni ca ||54|| sūryāvalokadīpāni dānadvārarddhimanti ca | satāṃ prasādapātrāṇi lakṣmyā gehāni bhājanam ||55|| yatra nārāyaṇaścāpi lakṣmīścāpi prapūjyate | yatra vai sādhavaḥ sādhvyastatrālakṣmībhayaṃ kutaḥ ||56|| yatrokṣā candanaṃ vīṇā ādarśo madhusarpiṣī | miṣṭājyatāmrapātrāṇi tadgṛhaṃ na tavāśrayaḥ ||57|| yatra kaṇṭakino vṛkṣā yatra mādakavallikāḥ | bhāryā vivāhaśūnyā ca valmīka tatra saṃvasa ||58|| yatra gṛhe narāḥ pañca strītrayaṃ gotrayaṃ tathā | andhakāro niragniśca tadgrahaṃ vasatistava ||59|| ekacchāgaṃ dvivāleyaṃ trigavaṃ pañcamāhiṣam | ṣaḍaśvaṃ saptamātaṃgaṃ gṛhaṃ śoṣaya duḥsaha ||3.152.60 || kuddāladātrapitakaṃ tadvat sthālyādi bhājanam | sarvāṇyupakaraṇāni musalolūkhalau tathā ||61 || strīṇāṃ khaṭvī tathā cānyat kṣiptaṃ yatra ca tatra ca | amārjitaṃ ca malinaṃ gṛhaṃ tava pratiśrayam ||62|| musalolūkhale strīṇāmāsanaṃ cāpyudumbare | avaskare mantraṇaṃ ca tadgṛhe vasa duḥsaha || 63 || laṃghyante yatra dhānyāni pakvāpakvāni veśmani | tadvacchātrāṇi tatra tvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ cara duḥsaha ||64|| sthālīpidhāne yatrāgnirdatto darvīphalena vā | gṛhe tatra hi riṣṭānāmaśeṣāṇāṃ samāśrayaḥ ||65|| mānuṣāsthi gṛhe yasya divārātraṃ mṛtasthitiḥ | tatra duḥsaha vāsaste tathānyeṣāṃ ca rakṣasām || 66|| yatra padmamahāpadmau yuvatī modakāśinī | vṛṣabhairāvatau yatra tadgṛhaṃ tyaja sarvathā ||67|| aśastrā devatā yatra saśastraścāhavaṃ vinā | kalpyante manujairarcyāstat parityaja mandiram ||68|| paurajānapadā yatra prākprasiddhamahotsavāḥ | kriyante pūrvavadgehe tatra gṛhe na saṃvasa ||69|| śūrpavātaghaṭo’mbhobhiḥ snānaṃ vastrāmbuvipruṣaiḥ | nakhāgrasalilaiścāpi tān yāhi hatalakṣaṇān ||3.152.70 || deśācārayutaṃ jñātidharmayutaṃ ca sotsavam | japahomaparaṃ devamaṃgaleṣṭiyutaṃ gṛham ||71 || śaucācārayute lokaśasyaṃ pūjyaṃ sadāśrayam | gṛhaṃ mā spṛśa tatratyān mā vilokaya duḥsaha ||72|| ityevaṃ duḥsahasyādau lakṣmi brahmā dadau gṛham | nivāsārthaṃ hyadharmasya sahayug duḥsaho’bhavat ||73|| duḥsahasyābhavadbhāryā malinīnāma nāmataḥ | kaliputrī kalahajñā kleśadharmāvalambinī ||74|| tasyāḥ putrā aṣṭasaṃkhyāḥ kanyāścāṣṭau bhayapradāḥ | dantākṛṣṭistathoktiśca parivartastṛtīyakaḥ ||75|| aṅgadhṛk śakuniścāpi gaṇḍaprāntaratistathā | garbhahā sasyahā ceti kanyānāmānyapi śṛṇu ||76|| niyojikā tu prathamā dvitīyā tu virodhinī | svayaṃhārakarī cāpi bhrāmaṇī ṛtuhāriṇī ||77|| smṛtihantrī bījahantrī vidveṣiṇī tathāṣṭamī | bhayadāstāstadeteṣāṃ tāsāṃ kāryāṇi me śṛṇu ||78|| dantākṛṣṭiḥ prasūtānāṃ bālānāṃ daśanasthitaḥ | karoti sa jvarotpādaṃ tacchāntiḥ sitasarṣapaiḥ | śayanasyoparikṣiptaiḥ kṣaumavastravidhāraṇāt ||79|| tathoktināmako vakti duḥsahasyāstu saṃsthitiḥ | tacchāntyarthaṃ tu māṃgalyaṃ kīrtanīyo janārdanaḥ ||3.152.80|| parivartaḥ karotyeva garbhāṇāṃ parivartanam | rakṣāṃ kurvīta rakṣoghnamantraiśca sitasarṣapaiḥ ||81 || aṅgadhṛk sphuraṇaṃ duṣṭaṃ cāṃgānāṃ prakaroti vai | kuśaistasyāṃkasaṃsparśānnivṛttirjāyate tadā ||82|| kākādipakṣisaṃsthaśca śakuniḥ śakunaṃ sadā | karoti duṣṭamevātra kāryatyāgo nivartanam ||83|| gaṇḍakālakṣaṇānte ca gaṇḍaprānto vasatyapi | sarvārambhān prahantyeva devastutyā nivāraṇam ||84|| gomūtrasarṣapasnānaistadṛkṣagrahapūjanaiḥ | dhamotsavādikaraṇairgaṇḍavān yāti vai layam ||85|| garbhahā garbhanāśī vai nityaṃ śaucād vinaśyati | daivamālyādirakṣādimantrebhyaḥ sa tu naśyati ||86|| sasyahā kṣetrabhūbhāge sasyarddhimupahanti ca | tasmād rakṣāṃ prakurvīta jīrṇopānadvidhāraṇāt ||87|| tathāpasavyagamanāccāṇḍālasya praveśanāt | bahirbalipradānācca satāṃ caraṇavāsanāt ||88|| cauryavyavāyamadyādau niyojikā tu mānavān | niyojayati tacchāntiṃ kuryāt sādhusamāgamāt| ||89|| dīkṣādigrahaṇāddharmād vratāttīrthaniṣevaṇāt | virodhinī kurute vai dampatyośca virodhanam ||3.152.90|| bandhūnāṃ suhṛdāṃ pitroḥ putraiḥ parasparaṃ sadā | tasyāḥ śāntiṃ prakurvīta śāstrācāraniṣevaṇāt ||91 || svayaṃhārakarī kanyā dhānyaṃ khalāddharatyapi | gobhyaḥ payastathā sarpiḥ payaso’pi haratyapi ||92|| samṛddhimṛddhimaddravyādapahanti mahānasāt | ardhasiddhaṃ tathānnaṃ ca yadannāgārasaṃsthitam |||93|| saṃpariveṣitaṃ cānnaṃ sārdha bhuṃkte ca bhuṃjatā | uccheṣaṇa manuṣyāṇāṃ haratyannaṃ hi sā tathā ||94|| karmāntāgāraśālābhyaḥ siddharddhiṃ sā haratyapi | gostrīstanebhyaśca payaḥ kṣīrahartrī tadaiva sā ||95|| dadhno ghṛtaṃ tilāttailaṃ surāgārāt tathā surām | rāgaṃ kusuṃbhakādīnāṃ kārpāsāt sūtramityapi ||96|| tacchāntyarthaṃ prakuryācca dvandvaṃ śikhaṇḍinoḥ śubham | kṛtrimāṃ ca striyaṃ tatra gṛhe nyaset sthale’pi ca ||97|| rakṣāmantraṃ tathā lakṣmyā rakṣāmantraṃ samuccaret | lakṣmi lakṣmi mahālakṣmi lalite kambhare sati | hārikāṃ hana duṣṭāṃ tvaṃ hārikā nāśametu ca ||98|| iti prārthya gṛhe bhasma sthale goṣṭhe nidhāpayet | homāgnidevatādhūpabhasmādibhirvinaśyati ||99|| udvegaṃ janayatyanyā hyekasthānanivāsinaḥ | puruṣasya tu duḥkhadā bhrāmaṇī sā bhavatyapi ||3.152.1 00 || tasyātha rakṣāṃ kurvīta vikṣiptaiḥ sitasarṣapaiḥ | āsane śayane corvyāṃ yatrāste sa tu mānavaḥ || 101 || atha puṣpaṃ haratyanyā strīṇāṃ sā ṛṇahāriṇī | kurvīta tīrthadevaukaścaityaparvatasānuṣu || 1 02|| nadīsaṃgamakhāteṣu snapanaṃ tatpraśāntaye | cikitsāśaḥ prayuñjīta varauṣadhamṛtupradam || 1 03|| smṛtiṃ harati nārīṇāṃ narāṇāṃ smṛtihā hi sā | viviktadeśasevitvācchrīharerbhajanāttathā || 1 04|| snigdhabhojanapānāñca tasyāścopaśamo bhavet | bījāhāpariṇī cānyā vīryaṃ rajo haratyapi || 1 05|| hareḥ prasādamedhyānnabhojanaistīrthayātrayā | tasyāścopaśamaḥ prokto haste kāmaphaladhṛteḥ || 1 06|| dveṣiṇī dveṣamādadhyācchāntyarthaṃ juhuyāttilān | madhukṣīravṛtāktāṃśca mitravindeṣṭimācaret || 1 07|| eteṣāṃ tu kumārāṇāṃ kanyakānāṃ ca padmaje | anyānyapi hyapatyāni vacmi nāmakriyādikam ||1 08 || dantākṛṣṭeḥ kanyake dve vijalpā kalahā tathā | ubhe kleśaprade śāntiḥ kartavyā homakarmaṇā || 1 09|| dūrvāṃkurānmadhughṛtakṣīrāktān balikarmaṇi | vikṣipejjuhuyāccaivānalaṃ mitraṃ ca kīrtayet || 3.152.110 || tathokteḥ kālajihākhyaḥ putro’sādhūn prabādhate | parivartasutau dvau tu virūpavikṛtau rame || 111 || tau tu vṛkṣāgraparikhāprākārāṃbhodhisaśrayau | garbhahānikarau tasmād garbhiṇī nābhirohayet || 11 2|| vṛkṣamaṭṭaṃ parikhāṃ ca prākāraṃ ca mahodadhim | aṅgadhṛgaḥ suto lakṣmi piśuno nāma nāmataḥ || 11 3|| so’sthimajjāgataḥ puṃsāṃ balamarttyajitātmanām | śakuneḥ pañcaputrāśca śyenaḥ kākaḥ kapotakaḥ || 1 14|| gṛdhraścolūka ityete śyeno mṛtyuprado mataḥ | kaḥ kālakaraścāpi hyulūko rākṣasapradaḥ ||1 15|| gṛddho vyādhipradaścāpi kapoto yamamārgadaḥ | tasya śyenādayo yasya nilīyeyuḥ śirasyatha || 11 6|| narastadvarjayed gehaṃ kapotākrāntamastakam | śyenaḥ kapoto gṛdhraśca kākolūkau gṛhe rame || 1 17|| praviṣṭaḥ kathayedantaṃ vasatāṃ tatra veśmani | svapne’pi hi kapotāderdarśanaṃ nahi śasyate || 1 18|| gaṇḍaprāntarateḥ putrā rājasvalyanivāsinaḥ | śrāddhaparvanivāsāśca nābhigacchettadā striyam || 11 9|| garbhahasya suto nighno mehinī cāpi kanyakā | praviśya garbhamattyeko bhuktvā mohayate’parā || 3.152.120 || jāyante bālakāstasmānmaṇḍukāḥ kacchapāḥ sṛpāḥ | purīṣaṃ vā bhavatyeva tasmād garbhavatī satī || 121 || śmaśānakaṭabhūmiṃ catuṣpathaṃ varjayenniśi | vṛkṣacchāyāṃ varjayeccottarīyaṃ na parityajet || 1 22|| śasyahasya sutaścaikaḥ kṣudrako hanti ṛddhikām | amaṃgalyadine vaptuḥ kṣetraṃ phalati naiva ha || 123|| niyojikāyāḥ kanyāśca mattonmattā pramattikā | navā ceti viśantyetā nāśāya sarvadehinām || 1 24|| adharmādyairyojayanti parastrīnarasaṃgame | virodhinyāstrayaḥ putrā nodako grāhakastathā ||1 25|| tamaḥpracchādakaśceti hyācāravarjite gṛhe | paiśunyaṃ kurute tvādyo gṛhṇāti grāhako hi tat || 1 26|| tṛtīyastamasā krodhaṃ janayantyatiduḥkhadāḥ | svayaṃhāryāstrayaḥ putrāścauryeṇa janitā rame || 127|| sarvahāryardhahārī ca vīryahārī tathaiva ca | anācāragṛhe kleśagṛhe vasanti te sadā || 128|| bhrāmaṇyāḥ kākajaṃghākhyaḥ putro dharmavivarjite | ramate gāyati cāpi bhunakti hāsyameti ca || 129|| kanyātrayaṃ ca kucahā vyaṃjanahā ca jātahā | yasyā na kriyate lokaḥ samyag vaivāhiko vidhiḥ || 3.152.1 30|| kālātīto’thavā tasyā haratyekā kucadvayam | vṛddhiśrāddhamadatvā ca tathānarcya ca mātaram || 131 || vivāhitāyāḥ kanyāyā harati vyaṃjanaṃ parā | tṛtīyā tvamvagnimadhye vidhūpe sūtikāgṛhe || 1 32|| adīpaśastramusalebhūtisarṣapavarjite | praviśya jātamapatyaṃ harate tadvinaśyati || 133|| sā jātahāriṇī nāma sughorā piśitāśanā | tasmāt surakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ yatnataḥ sūtikāgṛhe || 1 34|| smṛtihāputrako nāmnā pracaṇḍaścāttukāmanaḥ | līkāśca caṇḍaputrāste sarve cāṇḍālayonayaḥ ||1 35|| līkāstvadharmavaṃśaṃ vai vāsayanti haranti ca | bījahā bījanāśārthaṃ yatate śuddhivarjite ||1 36|| vidveṣiṇīsutau puṃsāmapakāraprakāśakau | ekastu svaguṇān loke prakāśayati pāpyapi || 1 37||| dvitīyastu guṇān maitrīṃ lokasthāmapakarṣati | ityete dausahāḥ sarve yaiḥ prajāḥ kaṣṭamāpnuyuḥ || 1 38|| teṣāṃ śāntiḥ prakartavyā tattadbalikriyārhaṇaiḥ | makhai raudrairvaiṣṇavaiśca daivairbhautaiśca cāṇḍikaiḥ || 1 301|| hareḥ sampūjanairbhaktyā vratairārādhanairapi | satāṃ sevāviśeṣaiśca camatkārisadarhaṇaiḥ || 3.152.140|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi pāṣānāṃ pāpanāśanam | śāntyādikarmabhiścāpi prasaṃgād riṣṭakāni ca ||141 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne dharmavaṃśavarṇanamadharmavaṃśavarṇanaṃ duḥsahasya nivāsasthānāni duḥsahavaṃśānāmupadravādivarṇanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 152 ||
<3.153> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca yātrāyāṃ kā diśā śreṣṭhā kaniṣṭhā kā kadā matā | prasthānaṃ ca kadā śreṣṭhaṃ kadā kiṃ karma śobhanam || 1 || aśobhanaṃ kadā syācca nakṣatravārayuktithau | tatsarvaṃ me samācakṣva lokakalyāṇahetave || 2 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca kṛttikā tvagnidaivatyā rohiṇī brahmadevatā | mṛgaśirā somadevā cārdrā tu rudradevatā || 3 || punarvasuḥ sūryadevā puṣyaṃ tu gurudaivatam | aśleṣā sarpadaivatyā maghā tu pitṛdevatā || 4 || pūrvāphālgunikā bodhyā padmaje bhagadevatā | uttarāphālgunī bodhyā padmaje’ryamadevatā || 5 || hastā savitṛdevā ca citrā tu tvaṣṭradevatā | svātī tu vāyudaivatyā viśākhendrāgnidevatā || 6 || anurādhā mitradevā jyeṣṭhā tu śakradevatā | mūlā nirṛtidaivatyā pūrvāṣāḍhāpyadevatā || 7 || uttarāṣāḍhikā vaiśvadevatā parikīrtitā | abhijit brahmadaivā ca śravaṇā viṣṇudevatā || 8 || dhaniṣṭhā vasudevā vāruṇadevā śatabhiṣā | ajadevā pūrvabhādrottarabhādrāhirbudhnikā || 9 || puṣādevā revatī cāśvinīdevā tathāśvinī | bharaṇī yamadevā ca proktāste ṛkṣadevatāḥ || 3.153.10 || brahmāṇī saṃsthitā pūrve pratipannavamītithau | māheśvarī cottare ca dvitīyādaśamītithau || 11 || pañcamyāṃ ca trayodaśyāṃ vārāhī dakṣiṇe sthitā | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ cāpi caturdaśyāmindrāṇī paścime sthitā || 12|| saptamyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca cāmuṇḍā vāyukāṣṭhikā | aṣṭamyamāvāsyadine lakṣmīstvīśānagā matā || 1 3|| ekādaśyāṃ trayodaśyāmagnikoṇe tu vaiṣṇavī | dvādaśyāṃ ca caturthyāṃ tu kaumārī nairṛte satī ||14|| yoginīsammukhe naiva gamanādi prakārayet | aśvinī revatī cāpi mṛgā mūlā punarvasuḥ || 15|| puṣyā hastā tathā jyeṣṭhā prasthāne śreṣṭhatāpradāḥ | hastyādipañcaṛkṣāṇi hyuttarātrayamityapi ||16|| aśvinī rohiṇī puṣyā dhaniṣṭhā ca punarvasuḥ | vastraprāvaraṇe śreṣṭhā saubhāgyavardhakā api || 17|| kṛttikā bharaṇyaśleṣā maghā mūlā viśākhinī | tisraḥ pūrvā adhovaktrā adhaḥkāryāṇi tatra vai ||18|| vāpīkūpataḍāgādibhūmikhanipragahvaram | devāgārasya khananaṃ nidhānakhananaṃ tṛṇam ||19|| gaṇitaṃ jyotiṣārambhaṃ khanibilapraveśanam | kuryāttānyeva siddhyanti cādhaḥkāryāṇi sarvathā ||3.153.20|| revatī cāśvinī citrā svātī hastā punarvasuḥ | anurādhā mṛgo jyeṣṭhā hyetāḥ pārśvamukhā matāḥ ||21 || gajoṣṭrāśvabalīvardadamanaṃ mahiṣasya goḥ | bījānāṃ vapanaṃ kuryānnāvādīnāṃ pravāhaṇam ||22|| cakrayantrarathānāṃ ca gamanaṃ cāgamādikam | rohiṇyārdrā tathā puṣyā dhaniṣṭhā cottarātrayam ||23|| śatabhīṣā śravaṇaṃ ca nava tūrdhvamukhā matāḥ | āsu rājyābhiṣekaṃ ca paṭṭabandhaṃ prakārayet ||24|| ūrdhvamukhānyucchritāni sarvāṇyetāsu kārayet | caturthī tvaśubhā ṣaṣṭhī cāṣṭamī navamī tathā ||25|| amāvāsyā pūrṇimā ca dvādaśī ca caturdaśī | atha śubhā pratipattu kṛṣṇā budhe dvitīyakā ||26|| tṛtīyā maṃgalayuktā caturthī śanivāsare | gurau tu pañcamī, ṣaṣṭhī śubhā maṃgalaśukrayoḥ ||27|| saptamī budhasomasthāṣṭamī maṃgalasūryagā | navamī somavārasthā daśamī guruvārikā ||28|| ekādaśī guruvyāptā dvādaśī budhavāsare | trayodaśī śukrabhaumau śanau śreṣṭhā caturdaśī ||29|| paurṇamāsyapyamāvāsyā śreṣṭhā bodhyā bṛhaspatau | dvādaśīṃ dahati
