jāto vivarṇaḥ patanonmukhaḥ | ruṣā yukto mānavām̐śca nārāyaṇabaledhitaḥ ||38 || svaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ manyamānaśca pratyāha vacanaṃ saruṭ | jayāprajñāpāśavatīmāṇikyāścāparāḥ striyaḥ ||39|| yā māṃ patasva prāhurvai tāḥ patantvapi vedhasaḥ | brahmāṇḍe yatra kutrāpi bhuvaṃ phalaṃ viyogajam | |3.161.40 || harerviyogajaṃ duḥkhaṃ dhāmaviyogajaṃ tathā | ityevaṃ ca mitho vākye śāpātmake tu niḥsṛte ||41 || tacchrutvā śrīlalitākhyā lakṣmīstatra drutaṃ yayau | vṛttāntaṃ sakalaṃ jñātvā kṣaṇaṃ śuśoca bhāminī ||42|| balaścāpi jayādyāstāṃ patane’pi vimuktaye | prārthayāmāsuratyantaṃ śāpanivṛttimityatha | |43 || lalitāśrīḥ samuvāca madicchayā hyajāyata | sammardaḥ patanādyaṃ ca śokastatra na vidyate ||44|| mayāpi tatra gantavyaṃ yatra yūyaṃ sakhīstriyaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||45|| tatra deśe svayaṃ cāpyāgamiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | lokoddhāraṇakāryārthe sakhīmānasapūrtaye ||46 || prajñeyaṃ ca jayeyaṃ ca pāśavatīyamityapi | māṇikyeyaṃ kṛṣṇapatnyo bhaviṣyatha mayā saha ||47|| patanasya viyogasya duḥkha na syāddhi bhūtale | kṛṣṇayogena satataṃ sukhavatyo bhaviṣyatha ||48 || aparaṃ ca balaścāyaṃ pārṣado hariṇoditaḥ | madgopure niyuktaśca ruṣā śāpamavāptavān ||49 || so’pi kṛṣṇecchayā hyālpo madicchayāpi vai tathā | balo’yaṃ roṣayukto vai brahmāṇḍe vedhasaḥ khalu ||3.161.5 0|| āsureṇa tu bhāvena roṣeṇa sahito janu | grahīṣyatīti devādyairmṛto mokṣamavāpsyati ||5 1 || taccharīrotthadhātūnāṃ pariṇāmātmakā bhuvi | svarge cāpi sumaṇayo ratnāni bhautikāni ca ||52|| bhaviṣyantīti sarvatra pūjārhāṇi samantataḥ | ityeva sumahatkāryakaraṇārthaṃ mayāpi ca ||53|| nārāyaṇenāpi devyāḥ patanaṃ cābhivāñcchitam | balasya patanaṃ cābhivāñcchitaṃ maṇihetave |||54|| yathābhilaṣitaṃ me’pi tattathaiva bhaviṣyati | balo’yaṃ pārṣado divyo nārāyaṇasya bhaktarāṭ ||55|| mahābhāgavataśreṣṭhaḥ pāvano lokapāvanaḥ | tasya pāvanadehotthā maṇayo’pi ca pāvanāḥ |||56 || dhṛtāśca pāvanā lokān pāvayiṣyanti pāpataḥ | rakṣayiṣyanti duḥkhebhyaścopadravebhya ityapi ||57|| vibhūṣāśca bhaviṣyanti ratnāni dehajāni vai | maṇimūrtihariścāpi nivatsyati tu bhūtale ||58|| evaṃ mokṣo balasyāpi devairnārāyaṇena vai | punaḥ śīghraṃ tataḥ sakhyo bhaviṣyati drutaṃ bhuvi || 59 || ahaṃ lalitārūpeṇa bhaviṣyāmyapi bhūtale | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadāsī nṛpātmajā ||3.161.60 || dakṣiṇe lalitālakṣmīrbhaviṣyāmi tu kāñcike | anekoddhārakāryārthaṃ sarvaṃ yogyaṃ bhaviṣyati ||6 1 || ityuktvā lalitālakṣmīḥ śrīpure dhāmni gopure | uktvā yayau svāsanaṃ ca jayādyā nyapatan drutam |||62|| brahmāṇḍe bhūtale cātra yatheṣṭaṃ janma cāpnuvan | balo’pi cātra loke cāsurabhāvo vyajāyata ||63|| diteḥ putraḥ kaśyapādvai balako nāmato’bhavat | mahāsuro hi daiteyaḥ sukeśyādyagrajo mahān ||64|| tapastepe samutpanno jātismaro’tiharṣitaḥ | śatavarṣe merupṛṣṭhe viṣṇuṃ samabhidhyāya ca ||65|| pṛthvyāṃ tu mastakaṃ kṛtvā pādau kṛtvā tathāmbare | samādhimiva cāpanno vallikājālasaṃvṛtaḥ || 66 || pādayorvallikāpṛṣṭhe pakṣinīḍo vyajāyata | vallībaddhaḥ śatavarṣaṃ niścalo’tiṣṭhipattathā ||67|| śuṣkamāṃso’bhavaccāpi nārāyaṇaṃ hadi smaran | tadāhaṃ purato yātastasya śāpavimuktaye ||68 || mayā tā vallikāḥ sarvāḥ svahastena vidūritāḥ | hastābhyāṃ ca mayā sṛṣṭaḥ kiñcijjñānamavāpa saḥ ||69 || viveda mama hastau sa komalau sparśamātrataḥ | mayā cāplāvitastūrṇamūrdhvānano babhūva ha ||3.161.70 || cakāra daṇḍavaccāpi rurodāśrūṇi saṃtyajan | premavihvalagātraścārthayanmokṣaṃ viyonitaḥ ||7 1 || viṣṇuḥ prāha sadā me tvaṃ bhakto’si pāvanastathā | datvā svadarśanaṃ bhakta pāvito’si tato’dhikaḥ ||92|| śṛṇu śīghraṃ hi dānavyā yonervimokṣyase tvitaḥ | tapastyaktvā cendralokaṃ yāhi balaṃ ca darśaya ||73 || daityaṃ bhaktaṃ vijetuṃ vai na śaktā devakoṭayaḥ | bhaviṣyanti yadā sevāṃ kariṣyanti ca te tadā ||74|| prasannastvaṃ varadānaṃ tebhyo dāsyasi cottamam | yajñe samit svarūpastvaṃ yācito vai bhaviṣyasi ||75 || tadvā te hananaṃ sarve kariṣyanti ca saṃhatāḥ | tava dehasamutthāśca bhaviṣyanti tu hīrakāḥ ||76|| maṇayo vividhāścāpi ratnāni vividhāni ca | mokṣaste ca tadā tūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 77 || ityuktvā mama cakraṃ tu datvādṛśyo’bhavaṃ sa tu | tapastyaktvā yayau svarge yuddhaṃ cendrādayācata ||78 || samare dattavān yuddhaṃ mahendro nirjito’munā | sūryaścandro’pi vijitau dikpālā vijitā api ||781|| lokapālā jitāścāpi viṣṇusudarśanena vai | indrādyā nirjitāstena tairnirjetuṃ na śakyate ||3.161.8 0|| devāḥ paravaśā bhūtvā balasevāṃ pracakrire | sevayā sa balo’tyantaṃ prasādito varāya tān ||8 1 || surān sa prairayatte’pi surā vicārya vai tadā | viṣṇuvākyaṃ prasaṃsmṛtyāyācanta lābhakṛnnijam ||82|| yadi deyo varo no’sti yadi satyavaco bhavān | yadi sevāpratuṣṭo’si bhaktimām̐śca narāyaṇe ||83 || tadā dehi vare sarvasureṣṭamekamuttamam | yajño nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāttatra samit svayaṃ bhava ||84|| asmābhirdevadaityaiśca nāgaiḥ sarpaiśca dānavaiḥ | militvā homamāpanno mokṣastvaṃ vai gamiṣyasi ||85|| ityukto balako daityaḥ prasannaścātyajāyata | viṣṇorarthe samit prāha bhāgyaṃ yat paramaṃ mama ||8 6|| devārthe maraṇaṃ sarvārpaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhavediha | mṛtyuśīlo hi saṃsāro maraṇaṃ devatārthakam ||87|| yadi labhyet go’rthaṃ ca gurvarthaṃ mādhavārthakam | dharmārthaṃ dharmakāryārthaṃ tato lābhaḥ parastu kaḥ ||88 || aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ mama cādya paraṃ sthitam | yadahaṃ viṣṇudevasya mukhagaḥ kalpitaḥ suraiḥ ||89|| ātmaniveditā me’dya sampatsyate suśobhanā | vicāryetthaṃ tathāstvevaṃ varadānaṃ dadau tadā ||3.161.90 || surāśca varadānaṃ tat prāpya merostu paścime | nitambe makhabhūmiṃ ca kārayāmāsurutsukāḥ || 91 || ākāritāstatra devā daityāśca dānavāḥ khagāḥ | maharṣayaśca pitaro mānavā vṛkṣavallayaḥ || 92|| yakṣāśca rākṣasāścāpi piśācā bhūtayonayaḥ | kuṣmāṇḍāḥ kinnarā nāgā gandharvā bhoginastathā |||93|| sarpā āsuramūrdhanyā apsarasastathāpagāḥ | samudrāśca tathāraṇyānyapi bhūbhṛta ucchrayāḥ || 94|| meghāśca vidyutaścāpi khanayaścauṣadhivrajāḥ | tattvānyāmantritānyevāyayustatra mahādhvare || 95|| yajñakāryaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyaiḥ pravartitam | balo dadau samidhrūpaṃ nijaṃ tatra tadā kṣaṇe || 96 || niṣasādādhvareyāvat prokṣito vardhinījalaiḥ | tāvat samitsvarūpaḥ sa mahānadrisamo’bhavat || 97|| mahāpuṃjo yathāvṛkṣavallīsasyodbhavo’bhavat | vrīhipuṣpaphalāḍhyaśca ghṛtamiṣṭaraso’bhavat ||98 || na jñāyate prāṇirūpo havyarūpo’bhavattadā | sarvahavyāni cādrau vai dṛśyante tatra vai tadā ||99|| havyasya parvatākāraṃ balaṃ matvā vivartitam | kṛtvā tu pāvanaṃ prokṣya devā homaṃ vyadhustadā || 3.161.100 || vahnāvāhutayastasya lakṣaśo vai tadābhavan | bījakaṇājyaphalasadrasātmikā sugandhayaḥ || 101 || tasya viśuddhasattvasya balasyāvayavāḥ śubhāḥ | vahnau samidhaḥ kṣiptāstā ratnabījāni cābhavan || 102|| sūryacandrasamābhāni bījāni kuṇḍake tadā | dṛṣṭvā surādayastām̐śca jagṛhurmūlyavedinaḥ || 103|| devānāmatha yakṣāṇāṃ siddhānāṃ pavanāśinām | mānavānāṃ maharṣīṇāmadhvariṇāṃ samantataḥ || 1 04|| ratnabījamayo grāhaḥ sumahānabhavattadā | kuṇḍād gṛhṇanti devādyā utplutyāmbaramārgataḥ || 1 05|| saṃpragṛhya dūraṃ yānti vimānairvai nijān gṛhān | parasparāvakarṣaiśca sammardo’bhūttadā mahān || 1 06|| ambare ratnabījārthamāskandanaṃ mahatvabhūt | āskandite vyomamārgāt peturbījāni yāni ca || 1 07|| vegātpatatāṃ vimānairhastābhyāṃ patitāni ca | parvateṣu samudreṣu saritsu kānaneṣvapi ||1 08 || vṛkṣeṣu meghamārgeṣu bhūmau sarovareṣvapi | tattadguṇaiśca bījāni ratnāni cābhavam̐stadā || 109 || ādheyaguṇayuktāni vividhāni tadābhavan | ityevaṃ ratnajātānāmudbhavo vaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 3.161.11 0 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne valākhyapārṣadasya śrīpuradhāmno jayādibhiḥ parasparaśāpena patanaṃ baladaityasya yajñe samitsvarūpiṇaḥ kāyatattvebhyo ratnānāmutpattirityādinirūpaṇanāmā ekaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 161 ||
<3.162> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇvantu śrīramādyāśca jayādyā mama vai priyāḥ | tāni ratnāni sarvāṇi mahāguṇāni santi vai || 1 || bhūtarakṣoviṣavyālavyādhighnānyavahānyapi | bhavanti guṇayuktāni tathaiva viguṇānyapi || 2 || vajrā muktāḥ padmarāgā marakatā maṇīśvarāḥ | indranīlāśca vaidūryāḥ puṣparāgāśca jātayaḥ || 3 || karketanāḥ sapulakā rudhirāḥ sphaṭikāstathā | vidrumā mauktikāḥ kācā maṇayaste bhavanti vai || 4 || ākāraṃ ca tathā varṇaṃ guṇaṃ doṣaṃ ca tatphalam | parīkṣya mūlyameteṣāṃ nirṇīyate na cānyathā || 5 || kulagneṣūpayujyante yāni copahate’hani | doṣāḍhyāni bhavantyeva viyojayanti sampadā || 6 || tasmāt parīkṣya ratnāni gṛhṇīyād dhārayedapi | śubhe kāle śubhānyeva parāṃ śriyaṃ tato labhet || 7 || vajramaṇiḥ samasteṣu mahāprabhāvavān bhavet | balāsthisamidbījāni nipeturyatra tatra ca || 8 || vajrāṇi vajranāmāni jātāni vividhāni ca | haimamātaṃgasaurāṣṭrāḥ pauṇḍrakaliṃgakosalāḥ || 9 || veṇātaṭāśca sauvīrā deśā vajrodbhavānvitāḥ | ātāmrā himaśailotthā mātaṃgotthāḥ kapīśinaḥ || 3.162.1 0||| saurāṣṭrajāstu tāmrāste śyāmāḥ puṇḍrabhavā matāḥ | kaliṃgotthāḥ svarṇavarṇāḥ pītaprabhāstu kosale || 11 || veṇātaṭīyāḥ śaśibhāḥ sauvīre meghakāntayaḥ | samyak sama tu pārśveṣu guṇavadvarṇavallaghu || 1 re|| rekhābindukākapadakalaṃkatruṭivarjitam | paramāṇumātramapi vajraṃ vajrottamaṃ hi tat || 1 3|| yadi tīkṣṇāgradhāraṃ tat tasmin devasamāśrayaḥ | lābhadaṃ cāvitathaṃ tat sarvasaukhyapradaṃ dhṛtam || 14|| yathāvarṇastathā devanivāsastaijaso yathā | tathāmūlyaṃ tathā devābhidhānaṃ cāpi kalpyate || 15|| varṇabhedena vajreṣu bhinnā devā vasanti hi | haritsu harirevāste śveteṣu varuṇaḥ svayam || 16|| pīteṣu śakraevāste piṅgeṣu tu hutāśanaḥ | śyāmeṣu pitaraḥ santi tāmreṣu marutastathā ||17|| vipraḥ kumudasphaṭikaśaṃkhābhaṃ dhārayeddhitam | kṣatriyaḥ śaśababhrvakṣisadṛśaṃ dhārayenmaṇim || 18|| vaiśyaḥ kadalīdalabhaṃ dhārayelābhadaṃ maṇim | śūdraḥ svacchakaravālanibhaṃ sandhārayenmaṇi || 1 9|| japāvidrumaśoṇaṃ vā haridrārasasannibham | dvau vajravarṇau rājāno dhārayeyurhitapradau ||3.162.20 || sarvaraṅgamayaṃ vajraṃ rājā vai dhārayenmaṇim | adharottaravṛtto’pi bahuvarṇayuto maṇiḥ |||1 || rājayogyo netareṣāṃ varṇānāṃ kaṣṭado hi saḥ | vajro vibhūtirguṇināmanyeṣāṃ vyasanapradaḥ ||22|| yasya śṛṃgaṃ dalitaṃ vā viśīrṇaṃ lokyate yadi | saguṇo’pi na vai dhāryaḥ śreyo’rthibhiḥ kadācana ||23|| viśīrṇasphuṭitaśṛṃgo malapṛṣatamadhyakaḥ | vajraḥ śriyaṃ nāśayati na rakṣyo bhavane kvacit ||24|| yadekadeśo raktābho yadvā lohitavarṇavān | sa kuryānmṛtyurevāyaṃ maṇirdhāryo na vai kvacit ||25|| koṭyaḥ pārśvāni dhārāśca ṣaḍaṣṭau dvādaśeti ca | uttaṃgasamatīkṣṇāgrā vajrasyākarajā guṇāḥ ||26|| ṣaṭkoṭiśuddhamamalaṃ prasphuṭatīkṣṇadhārakam | laghu varṇānvitaṃ doṣaśūnyaṃ tathā supārśvakam ||27|| indrāyudhāṃśuraṃgāḍhyakṛtābhivyomamaṇḍalam | durlabhaṃ dhārayed vajramāyuḥstrīdhanavardhakam |||28| | sampadgopaśudhānyānāṃ sampadāṃ ca pravardhakam | vyālavahniviṣavyāghrataskarāmbubhayāpaham ||29|| ātharvaṇābhicārāṇāṃ dūrānnivartakaṃ maṇim | viṃśatitaṇḍulabhāraṃ vajraṃ guṇāgryamūlyakam |||3.162.30|| guṇaiḥ prabhayā snehena gurutvenāṃśahīnakam | vajraṃ nyūnaṃ mataṃ tadvai mūlye lābhe sukhādiṣu ||3 1 || ardhe tvardhaguṇaṃ proktaṃ pādaṃ pādaguṇaṃ bhavet | pādārdhaguṇakaṃ cāpi mūlye pādārdhakaṃ bhavet ||32|| triṃśadbhāgaṃ śatāṃśaṃ cāśītibhāgaṃ tathā hyapi | sahasrabhāgaṃ vajra syāt sūkṣmaṃ guṇe’pi śaktimat |||33|| aṣṭābhiḥ sarṣapaiścāpi vajrāṇāṃ gurutā bhavet | yattu sarvaguṇairyuktaṃ vajraṃ tarati vāriṣu ||34|| ratnavarge samaste’pi dhāraṇaṃ tasya vidyate | svalpamātrāpi gurutā dhāraṇe tvanumīyate ||35 || kartavyaṃ dhāraṇaṃ tasmāt paramāṇorapi dhruvam | alpo’pi doṣavān vajro daśāṃśamūlyavān bhavet ||36|| prakaṭānekadoṣastu śatāṃśamūlyavān bhavet | bahudoṣasya vajrasya mūlyaṃ svalpaṃ vibhūṣaṇe ||37|| sannahya dhāryate tādṛk sadoṣaṃ laghuhānidam | alaṃ sadoṣavajrasya bhūṣāyāṃ dhāraṇaṃ hyapi |||38 || nāryā vajramadhāryaṃ vai saguṇaṃ hyapi karhicit | putraprasavamicchantyā naiva dhāryaṃ kadācana || 39 || dhāryaṃ tu dīrghaṃ cipiṭaṃ hrasvaṃ vajraṃ ca nirguṇam | ayasā puṣparāgeṇa tathā gomedakena ca ||3.162.40 || vaidūryeṇa sphaṭikena kācaiścāpi pṛthagvidhaiḥ | pratirūpāṇi jāyante kuśalairvajrasannibhāḥ ||41 || kṣārollekhanaśālābhisteṣāṃ kāryaṃ parīkṣaṇam | pṛthivyāṃ yāni ratnāni ye cānye lohadhātavaḥ |||42|| sarvāṇi vilikhed vajraṃ tacca tairna vilikhyate | gurutā sarvaratnānāṃ śreṣṭhatve ca prabhācchatā ||43 || kāraṇaṃ vajrake heturlaghutā ca prabhācchatā | vajrajātirajātiṃ vai vilikhanti samantataḥ | |44|| vajreṇa likhyate vajraṃ vajraṃ nānyena likhyate | vajrāṇi muktāmaṇayo ye ca kecana jātayaḥ ||45 || na teṣāṃ pratibaddhānāṃ bhā bhavatyūrdhvagāminī | tiryakkṣatatvāt keṣāṃcit kathañcid yadi dṛśyate ||46|| tiryagālikhyamānānāṃ sā pārśveṣu vihanyate | viśīrṇakoṭivajro vivarṇaḥ sarekhabindukaḥ ||47|| sendrāyudhaścet putrādīn dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ dadāti saḥ | vidyutprabhamindravajraṃ dadhāno nṛpatiḥ khalu ||48 || parākrameṇa tasyaiva sāmrājyaṃ labhate bhuvi | kathitaṃ vajraratnaṃ vo brahmapriyāstataḥ param ||49 || muktāphalātmakaṃ ratnaṃ kathayāmi nibodhata | acchāḥ svacchāḥ sāndrabhāśca malabhāśca pṛthak pṛthak ||3.162.50 || hastimedhakroḍaśaṃkhamīnāhiśuktiveṇujāḥ | pṛdhvīsalilajā muktā maṇayaḥ saṃbhavanti vai ||51 || śuktyudbhavaṃ muktakaṃ tu śreṣṭhaṃ sarveṣu gaṇyate | śuktyudbhavaṃ bhaved vedhyaṃ śeṣāṇyavedhyakāni hi | | 52|| veṇuhastimatsyasūtaṃ śaṃkhajaṃ ca varāhajam | bhāsāhīnaṃ yadyapi syānmaṃgalaṃ tat praśasyate ||5 3 || śaṃkhodbhavaṃ gajotthaṃ ca muktāratnaṃ kaniṣṭhakam | gajakuṃbhamadhyavarṇaṃ pītaṃ vā niṣprabhaṃ tathā |||54|| vṛhatkoṇapalamānaṃ śāṃkhaṃ cāpi kaniṣṭhakam | śreṣṭhāḥ śaṃkhā hastinaśca śuddhavaṃśyāstu ye matāḥ || 55 || teṣu vṛttāni pītāni jāyante niṣprabhāṇyapi | mīneṣu yāni jāyante suvṛttāni laghūnyapi ||56|| atisūkṣmāṇi pāṭhīnapṛṣṭhavarṇāni tāni ca | matsyānaneṣu jāyante payodhermadhyataḥ khalu || 57|| vārāhadaṃṣṭrāprabhāvaṃ daṃṣṭrāṃkurasamānabham | bhūtalotthaṃ ca muktākhyaṃ kvacit tādṛṅ mataṃ śubham || 58 || upalotthaṃ ca tadvarṇaṃ vaṃśotthaṃ tatsamānabham | veṇavo’pi bhavyajanairbhogyāḥ sarvatra naiva te || 59 || bhujaṃgajāni ratnāni vṛttāni cojjvalāni ca | dhautānīva bhavantyeva khaḍgadhārāprabhāṇi ca || 3.162.6 0|| bhaujaṃgamamauttikadhṛk puṇyavān tejasānvitaḥ | rājyaśrīmān bhavedeva prabhāvāḍhyo bhavedapi || 61 || ratnamūlyasya jijñāsuḥ śubhe muhūrtake khalu | rakṣitaṃ sumahat kṛtvā sthāpayed bhavanopari || 62|| tadāmbare mahāghoṣā bherīnādā bhavanti hi | vidyuto visphuraṇāni ghanāścāpi bhavanti hi || 63|| etādṛśaṃ mauktikaṃ tu yatra koṣe gṛhe’sti vā | na tatra sarpā vighnāni yātudhānāśca nādhayaḥ ||64|| upasargā vyādhayo na yatra bhujaṃgamauktikam | atha meghodbhavaṃ yat syānmauktikaṃ tattu devatāḥ || 65|| vyomamārgāddharantyeva tvādityārcisamaprabham | rātrau bhāti divāvattad yatrāste prabhayā svayā || 6 6|| etādṛśasya ratnasya mūlyaṃ svarṇamayī mahī | api naiva suparyāptā yatastat svarṇaratnadam || 67|| yasyāgre ratnametat syād bhuṃkte sa kṣitimaṇḍalam | prajānāṃ nṛpateścāpi vardhante bhāgyakāntayaḥ ||68|| yojanānāṃ sahasreṣu hyanarthā yānti naiva tu | etādṛśāni muktāni balasya dantarūpikāḥ ||69|| samidho yāḥ kṛtāstatrādhvare tābhyastadā tadā | bījāni yāni jātāni vicitravarṇākāni vai | |3.162.70 || samudrāṇāṃ jale yāni nipetuḥ śuddhakāni hi | candrāṃśukāntiramyāṇi śuktijāni hi tāni vai ||7 1 || dvīpe tu saiṃhale tāni saurāṣṭre tāmraparṇake | pāraśave pāraloke kaubere pāṇḍyadeśake |||72 || hāṭake hemake ceti jāyante śuktijāni vai | śuktyutthaṃ nātinikṛṣṭavarṇaṃ guṇaprabhāyutam | |73 || saṃsthānamānayuktaṃ ca jāyate vardhanādiṣu | vardhane pārasīke ca pātāle siṃhale’pi ca ||74|| śuktijasyaikasya muktāphalasya śāṇayoginaḥ | mūlyaṃ mudrāḥ sahasre dve rājatyaḥ saṃbhavanti hi ||75 || māṣārdhahīnaratnasya daśāṃśahīnamūlyakam | māṣakatrayaguru yat sahasradvayamūlyakam | |76 || sārdhadvayamāṣakasya mūlyaṃ sārdhasahasrakam | māṣakadvayaguru yanmūlyaṃ sahasramudrakam | |77| | sārdhamāṣakaguru yanmūlyaṃ pañcaśatāni vai | ṣaḍguñjāguru yad ratnaṃ tasya sārdhaśatadvayam | | 78 || caturguñjāguru yattanmūlyaṃ śatadvayaṃ matam | guñjādvayaguru yat tanmūlyaṃ śataṃ mataṃ tathā ||79 || guñjaikagurumūlyaṃ tu pañcāśanmudrikāḥ khalu | ṣoḍaśaguñjādharaṇaṃ dārvikākhyaṃ bhaveddhi tat | |3.162.8 0 || triṃśadgruñjādharaṇaṃ tu śikyaṃ ratnaṃ taducyate | nikṛṣṭāni tu ratnāni triṃśanmūlyāni tāni vā | |8 1 || viṃśatimūlyakānyeva daśamūlyāni vā tathā | athāsya saṃparīkṣā tu bhāṇḍe jāmbīrajaṃ rasam |||882|| nikṣipya pacyate ratnaṃ ghṛṣyate piṇḍamūlakaiḥ | sarekhaṃ syāt kṛtrimaṃ tannikṛṣṭaṃ vā bhavet kila | |8 3 || mṛllipte puṭake madhye nikṣipya cānale pacet | dugdhe tataśca payasi ghṛte punarjaleṣu ca ||84|| tato vastrairgharṣaṇena guṇakāntiyutaṃ bhavet | tacchreṣṭhaṃ satyameveti mauktikaṃ kṣativarjitam ||85 || śvetakācasamaṃ hemanaddhaṃ dhāryeta bhūṣaṇam | kṛtrimaṃ ceti sandehe kāryaṃ punaḥ parīkṣaṇam ||8 6 | | uṣṇe salavaṇe snehe niśāṃ tad vāsayejjale | vrīhibhirmardanīyaṃ tacchuṣkavastrāntarīkṛtam ||87|| yadi nāyāti vaivarṇyaṃ vijñeyaṃ tadakṛtrimam | sitaṃ pramāṇavat snigdhaṃ guru svacchaṃ sunirmalam | |88 || tejo’dhikaṃ suvṛttaṃ ca mauktikaṃ guṇavaddhi tat | nāsya bhartārameko’pi doṣo’narthaṃ upaiti vā ||89|| evaṃ muktāmaṇayo vai mayoktā vo haripriyāḥ | padmarāgān pravakṣyāmi śṛṇutaitān yathodbhavāna ||3.162.90 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vajramaṇermuktamaṇeścotpattimūlyaśraiṣṭhyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 162 ||
<3.163> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca sūryadevo balasyāsṛksamidhaṃ prāpya bījakam | yayāvākāśamārgeṇa laṃkādhipo rurodha tam || 1 || samudre cāpi rāvaṇagaṃgāyāṃ bījakāni vai | nipetustajjaratnāni jātāni dīptimanti ha || 2 || ujjvalāścārurāgāste padyarāgā hi toyajāḥ | saugandhikotthā guṇinaḥ kuruvindodbhavāstathā || 3 || sphāṭikajāḥ prabhāvanto bahuvarṇāstathāpare | jātā bandhūkaguñjendragopajapāsṛksannibhāḥ || 4 || dāḍimakiṃśukapuṣpasindūrotpalasannibhāḥ | padmakuṃkumalākṣājarasavarṇāḥ prabhāyutāḥ || 5 || rāge sāndrāḥ svaprabhayā bhānti ye sphuṭamadhyinaḥ | sphāṭikajāḥ sūryabhābhiḥ pārśvāni rañjayanti te || 6 || kusuṃbhanīlamiśrābhā ugraraktāmbujaprabhāḥ | anye puṣkarapuṣpābhā hiṃgulavattviṣo’pare || 7 || cakorapīkasārasanetrabhāścāpare’pi ca | kokanadottamapuṣpatviṣaścānye bhavantyapi || 8 || prabhāvakāṭhinyagurutvakaiḥ prāyaḥ samā ime | sphāṭikajāḥ padmarāgāḥ nīlaraktaprabhāyutāḥ || 9 || ete saugandhikotthāstu maṇayaḥ prāyaśaḥ samāḥ | etebhyo raṃgato nyūnā maṇayaḥ kuruvindajāḥ || 3.163.1 0|| nirarciṣo’ntarbahulā nātiprabhāvaśālinaḥ | tatsadṛśā āndhradeśe tumburudeśake tathā || 11 || sadharmāṇaḥ prajāyante svalpamūlyā hi te matāḥ | raṃgādhikyaṃ gururevaṃ ca snigdhatā samatācchatā || 12 || arciṣmattā mahattā ca maṇīnāṃ śraiṣṭhyabodhakāḥ | ye tu karkarasadṛśāśchidramalādiyoginaḥ || 13 || prabhāhīnāḥ saparuṣā vivarṇāste na cottamāḥ | sadoṣaṃ maṇimābaddhya śokacintāmayām̐stathā || 14|| mṛtyuṃ duḥkhaṃ vittanāśaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ| padmarāgasamā vijātīyā bhavanti pañca ca || 15|| kalasapurajāścāpi tumburudeśajāstathā | muktapāṇīyajātāśca siṃhalotthāḥ śrīpūrṇakā || 16|| kalasotthāstuṣayogā bhavanti maṇayo hi te | tāmravarṇāstumburutthā kṛṣṇāḥ siṃhaladeśajāḥ || 17|| muktā namaḥsvabhāvāśca śrīpūrṇā dīptivarjitāḥ | tuṣayoge tāmravarṇā bhavanti snehino’pi ca || 18 || ye praghṛṣṭā varjayanti dīptiṃ te nimnajātikāḥ | aṃgulyākrāntamūrdhā yo bibharti pārśvakṛṣṇatām | | 1 9| | anyasya sannidhisthasya guṇān yaśca bibhartyapi | nikṛṣṭamūlyavān sa syānmuktāmaṇiḥ samo’pi vai || 3.163.20 | | jāte kṛtrimasandehe śāṇe taṃ parilekhayet | svajātakasamutthena vilikhecca parasparam || 21 || vajraṃ vā kuruvindaṃ vā vimucyānyena kenacit | na śakyaṃ lekhanaṃ kartuṃ padmarāgendranīlayoḥ |||2| | yatra lekhaḥ sa nimno vai maṇirnottama ucyate | yadvā kṛtrima evāpi rekhāyukto bhaved yadi ||23 || kṛtrimo doṣavām̐ścāpi dhāryo naiva maṇiḥ kvacit | satyena maṇinā sākaṃ kaustubhena samaṃ ca vā || 24|| caṇḍālastveka evāpi dvijātīm̐stu bahūnapi | dūṣayatyeva tadvacca duṣṭo hanti guṇānapi || 25|| satyapadmarāgadhartā sapatneṣu vasannapi | nāpadbhirabhibhūyeta na vighnairabhibhūyate || 26|| nopadravairnopasargairna doṣairabhibhūyate | varṇadīptiyutaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ taddhīnaṃ hīnameva tat |||27|| śreṣṭhaṃ ratnaṃ sadā dhāryaṃ na kaniṣṭhaṃ kadācana | mūlyahīnasya dhartāraṃ mūlyahīnaṃ karoti tat || 28 || atha brahmapriyā vo’tra marakatān vadāmi tu | balapittasamidbījaṃ gṛhṇan vāsukirambare || 29|| pradudrāva yadā tatra garuḍastamarodhayat | bījāni nyapatam̐ścāpi māṇikyaparvatasthale ||3.163.3 0 || turuṣkapādapeṣvevaṃ nalikāvanavalliṣu | śvetasāgaratīre ca marakatāstato’bhavan ||3 41 || garuḍasya cañcurandhrād bījāni patitānyapi | tebhyo jātāḥ śukakaṇṭhaśirīṣapuṣparaṅgiṇaḥ |||32|| khadyotapṛṣṭhasadṛśāḥ śaivalaśādbalaprabhāḥ | kalhāraśaṣpatulyāśca bhujaṃgabhujasataprabhāḥ ||3 3|| patraraṃgāstathā pittajātāste maṇayo matāḥ | bhujaṅgabhogabījotthairviṣaṃ sarva praśāmyati ||34|| sarvauṣadhimantragaṇairyanna śakyaṃ cikitsitum | mahāhidaṃṣṭrāprabhavaṃ viṣaṃ tvetaiḥ praśāmyati ||35 || atyantaṃ tu haridvarṇaṃ komalaṃ saprabhaṃ tathā | kāñcanacūrṇamadhyābhaṃ ratnaṃ taduttamaṃ matam ||36|| sarvasaṃsthānaguṇavat samānarūpavattathā | guru sūryakarasparśāt pradīpayati cāśramam ||37|| vidutprabhāyā yogād yaccāntardīptiyutaṃ bhavet | bhavecca śādvalanibhaṃ haritaṃ śreṣṭhameva tat ||38|| varṇā yatra tu bahulā madhye svacchakarāśrayam | sābhraṃ snigdhaṃ viśuddhaṃ ca barhiprabhaṃ samantataḥ ||3 9|| tannyūnaṃ pūrvato bodhyaṃ kiñcicchreṣṭhaṃ hiṃ gaṇyate | śabalaṃ rūkṣaṃ malinaṃ kaṭhoraṃ karkaraṃ yathā ||3.163.40 || miśraṃ śilotthajatunā marakataṃ na tūttamam | mārakataiḥ kaṇaiḥ klṛptaṃ sandhitaṃ vā tathāvidham ||41 || śreyaskāmairna taddhāryaṃ jetavyaṃ tanna vai kvacit | bhallātakasya pavanairvaiṣamyaṃ yānti yatprabhāḥ |||42||| kṛtrimāste marakatā naiva dhāryāḥ kadācana | vajratulyāstathā muktāstulyā marakatā api ||43 || yeṣāṃ prabhā cordhvagā vai ṛjvī vā vakragāminī | tiryagālocyamānānāṃ sadyo vā sā praṇaśyati ||44|| ete vijātayo bodhyā marakatāḥ śubhāvahāḥ | snānācamanajapyeṣu rakṣāmantrakriyāvidhau ||45|| gohiraṇyādidāneṣu sādhane’nuṣṭhite’pi ca | daivapaitryātitheyeṣu gurusaṃpūjaneṣu ca ||46|| bādhyamāneṣu vividhairdoṣajātairviṣodbhavaiḥ | doṣahīnaṃ guṇavacca kāñcanapratiyojitam ||47|| saṃgrāme jayakārye ca dhāryaṃ marakataṃ sadā | padmarāgādhikaṃ mūlyaṃ mārakataṃ prakīrtitam ||48|| doṣādhikye mūlyahānirmārakate’pi jāyate | evaṃ mārakatāḥ proktā nīlamaṇīn vadāmi vaḥ ||49|| netrayugmasamidbījaṃ balasya yatpapāta ha | siṃhale kacchadeśe ca sā bhūmirbahuṣābhitaḥ ||3.163.50 || indranīlavatī jātā nīlāste naikajātayaḥ | nīlābjabhṛṃgaśārṅgābhā harakaṇṭhasamā api ||5 1 || giriśṛṃganibhā vārdhijalābhāḥ śikhiraṅgiṇaḥ | nīlīraṃgā pīkakaṇṭhasamābhāste mahāguṇāḥ ||52|| mṛtpāṣāṇaśilārandhrāḥ karkarāstruṭisaṃyutāḥ | abhrikāpaṭalacchāyā varṇaduṣṭā bhavantyapi ||53|| padmarāgaguṇān sarvānāpnoti cendranīladhṛk | padmarāge parīkṣā yā saivendranīlave’pi ca ||54|| vahnau kṣiptaḥ padmarāgo vahniṃ krameta yāvatā | tato’dhikaścendranīlaḥ kṣiptaḥ krameta cānale ||59|| parīkṣā saiva boddhavyā yathārthasya maṇeḥ śubhā | tathāpi na parīkṣārthaṃ guṇānāṃ nāśakārake ||||56 || vahnau maṇirnidhātavyo yato duṣṭo bhaveddhi saḥ | so’narthāya bhaved bhartuḥ kartuḥ kārayitustathā ||57|| kācotpalakaravīravaidūryasphaṭikādayaḥ | indranīlasamāstvete maṇayo’pi bhavanti hi |||58||| kāṭhinyagurutādhikye śraiṣṭhyameṣāṃ prajāyate | indranīlastāmravarṇaḥ karavīrotpalaprabhaḥ ||55|| yasya madhyagatā bhāti nīlasyendrāyudhaprabhā | tamindranīlamityāhurmahārhaṃ bahudurlabham ||3.163.60|| yasya varṇasya bhūyastvāt śrīre śataguṇe sthitaḥ | nīlatāṃ tannayet sarvaṃ mahānīlaḥ sa ucyate ||61 || padmarāgasya yanmūlyaṃ māṣamātrasya dhāryate | tanmūlyaṃ cendranīlasya dhāryate guṇabhāmataḥ |||62|| atha lakṣmyaḥ pravakṣyāmi vaidūryasyodbhavādikam | balāsurasya nādātmasamidbījodbhavā hi te ||63|| anekavarṇā śobhābhirāmakāntiyutāḥ khalu | vidūre parvate kāmarūpakāmākṣikīkṣitau ||64|| vaidūryāste maṇayaśca prāvṛḍghanāvabhāsinaḥ | visphulliṃgasamā jātāstejasvino’pi vai śubhāḥ ||69|| śreṣṭhā mayūrakaṇṭhābhā veṇudalanibhāstathā | cāpapakṣanibhāste’pi praśastā varabhāgyadāḥ ||66|| girikācāḥ śiśupālāḥ kācāśca sphaṭikāstathā | dhūmrāśceti ca vaidūryajātayo’pi samā yathā ||67|| likhyābhāvāt kācasaṃjñaḥ śiśupālo laghutvataḥ | girikācastvadīptitvāt sphaṭikaścojjvalatvataḥ ||68|| paladvayagurormūlyamindranīlasamaṃ matam | nāmābhāguṇabhedairhi bhedo mūlye prajāyate ||69||| snehalaghutāmṛdutā bhede liṅgāni sarvadā | maṇibandhe dhṛtā lābhapradāścenmūlyaṣaḍguṇāḥ ||3.163.70|| etanmūlyaṃ tvākareṣu bhūdeśe bahulaṃ bhavet | suvarṇaḥ ṣoḍaśamāṣastatsaptāṃśastu saṃjñakaḥ ||71 || śāṇaścaturmāṣamāṇo māṣakaḥ pañcakṛṣṇalaḥ | palasya daśamo bhāgo dharaṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||72|| dharaṇe’dhikatāṃ prāpte mūlyamadhikaṃ gauravāt | atha lakṣmyaḥ puṣparāgānmaṇīn vadāmi bodhataḥ ||73|| balāsurasya tvaksamidbījāni himaparvate | patitāni tato jātāḥ puṣparāgā mahāguṇāḥ ||74|| āpītapāṇḍarāḥ padmarāgāḥ pāṣāṇajātayaḥ | āpītalohitāste tu kauruṇḍakābhidhānakāḥ ||79|| svacchalohitapītāstu kāṣāyakābhidhānakāḥ | ānīlaśuklasnigdhāste somānakābhidhānakāḥ ||76|| atyantalohitāste ye padmarāgā hi te matāḥ | sunīlāste puṣparāgā indranīlābhidhānakāḥ ||77|| mūlya vaidūryasadṛśaṃ dhāraṇād yoṣitāṃ sadā | putrarūpaṃ phalaṃ śuddhaḥ prayacchati na saṃśayaḥ ||78|| atha lakṣmyaḥ pravakṣyāmi karketanān maṇīniha | vāyurbalasya tu nakhasamidbījamupāgamat ||79|| padmavaneṣu cikṣepa karketanāstato’bhavan | madhusomarudhirābhāstāmrapītānalopamāḥ ||3.163.80 || nīlaśvetaparuṣāśca vyādhyādidoṣahārakāḥ | snigdhāḥ śuddhāḥ samavarṇāḥ pītāścitrā gurutvinaḥ ||8 1|| rekhāvraṇadoṣahīnāḥ karketanāste pāvanāḥ | svarṇapatreṇa veṣṭayitvā tāpayedanalena ca ||82|| prakāśameti cet karketanaḥ sa roganāśakṛt | kleśanāśakaścāpyāyuṣpradaśca sukhavaṃśadaḥ ||83|| alaṃkṛtau dhṛtaścāyaṃ dhana dhānyaṃ dadāti ca | pūjāṃ ca bāndhavām̐ścāpi dadātyujjvalatāmapi ||84|| eke nīlāśca vikṛtā mlānāḥ kaluṣiṇastathā | tejodīptihīnavarṇā bhavanti karkasadṛśāḥ ||85|| aguṇāste duḥkhadā vai na dhāryā hi kadācana | sūryakiraṇamāsādya tejaḥ paridhiyoginaḥ ||86|| jāyante ye te’gramūlyāḥ karketanā bhavanti vai | atha brahmapriyā vo’tra bhīṣmaratnāni vacmyaham ||87|| balāsurasya vai vīryasamidbījaṃ himālaye | taduttare pradeśe cāpatad bhīṣmāṇi vai tataḥ ||88| śaṃkhābjābhāni bhāvanti syonākasannibhāni ca | jātāni kaṇṭhadhṛtyā tu sampatpradāni tāni vai ||89| bhīṣmamaṇidharaṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyante tu dūrataḥ | vṛkā dvīpinaḥ śarabhā vyāghraśārdūlakuṃjarāḥ ||3.163.90| bhīṣmamaṇiścāṅgulīyo guṇayukto dhṛto yadi | pitṛtarpaṇakārye ca bahutṛptiprado hi saḥ || 91 || sarpāṇḍajākhuvṛścikaviṣāṇi yānti śaṃ tathā | jalāgnicauravairibhīrnaśyatyevāsya dhāraṇāt| || 92|| meghaśaivalaraṅgaṃ ca paruṣaṃ pītamaprabham | vivarṇaṃ malinaṃ dūrād varjayeddhānido yataḥ || 93 || mūlyaṃ yathāguṇaṃ kalpyaṃ deśakālādiśobhanam | atha vai pulakān vacmi maṇīn brahmapriyā hi vaḥ || 94|| balāsurasya nakharasamidbījaṃ bhujaṅgamāḥ | cikṣipuḥ parvateṣūrdhvaṃ nimnagātvapi cottare || 956|| deśe tato hi maṇayaḥ pulakāstu vijajñire | dāśārṇe vāgade melakake kālagake’pi ca || 96 || guñjāñjanakṣaudravarṇā mṛṇālābhāstathābhavan | gandharpavahnikadalībhāsāḥ śreṣṭhāstathābhavan || 17|| śaṃkhābjabhṛṃgārkatulyacitrabhaṃgā arekhakāḥ | maṅgalāste vṛddhidā vai pulakāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 18 || kākaśvarāsabhajambūkavṛkograsvarūpiṇaḥ | samāṃsagṛdhramukhabhā mṛtyudāste dhṛtā yadi || 19|| mūlyameṣāṃ palabhāre śatāni pañca mudrikāḥ | atha lakṣmyo rudhirākhyaṃ ratnaṃ vaḥ kathayāmyaham || 3.163.100 || balāsurasya rūpākhyasamidbījaṃ hutāśanaḥ | ninye cikṣepa revāyāṃ nimnakṣitāvapi dhruvam || 101 || indragopanibhāścāpi śukacañcunibhāstathā | puṣṭā rudhiravarṇāste rudhirāścābhavan hi te || 102 || madhye candrapāṇḍurāste śuddhavarṇāstulābhinaḥ | indranīlasamāścāpi bhṛtyaiśvaryapradā hi te || 103 || pakvāste suravajrākhyā lābhadā sampadāṃ pradāḥ | atha lakṣmyaḥ sphaṭikākhyāna maṇīn vacmi śubhāvahān || 1 04|| kāverīvindhyayavanacīnanepālabhūmiṣu | balāsurasya medākhyasamidbījaṃ tu lāṅgalī || 1 05|| cikṣepākāśamārge’pi tailaṃ tat sphaṭikaṃ hyabhūt | mṛṇālaśaṃkhadhavalāḥ kiñcidvarṇāntarānvitāḥ || 10 6|| pāpanāśakarā yogyaguṇamūlyā hi te’bhavan | atha śeṣo balāntrān vai samidbījasvarūpiṇaḥ | | 1 07|| keralādau pracikṣepa vidrumāste tato’bhavan | śaśalohitavarṇāśca guñjājapānibhā api || 108 || sunīlā devakaromā jātā bhinnā hi te tathā | prasannaṃ komalaṃ snigdhaṃ surāṃgaṃ vidrumaṃ hitam | | 1 09| | dhanadhānyaṃkaraṃ loke viṣārtibhayanāśanam | evaṃ jātāni ratnāni jāyante bījavaṃśataḥ | | 3.163.110 | | khanijāśca prajāyante vāhneyā maṇayo’pi ca | brahmapriyāḥ samastā vo maṇayaḥ kathitā mayā | | 111 | | balasya mama bhaktasya nirmittena samudbhavāḥ | dhāraṇādvācanāccāpi mama smaraṇakārakāḥ | | 11 2| | balastato vimānena yayau dhāma mamaiva saḥ | jayādyāśca bhavatyo’tra vartante yoṣito mama | | 11 3 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne padmarāga marakatendranīla vaidūrya puṣparāga karketana bhīṣma pulakarudhira sphaṭika vidrumamaṇīnāmudbhavaguṇādinirūpaṇanāmā triṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 163 ||
<3.164> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca kānta bhagavatā proktā manavo ye caturdaśa | teṣu tavāvatārā ye tān sakāryān vadasva me || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu śrīśivarājñīśri tatra daityavināśakān | avatārān kathayāmi sahetūn dharmarakṣakān || 2 || svāyaṃbhuvo manuścādya indraśca viśvabhuk tadā | tathā daityo bāṣkaliśca tapastepe sa dāruṇam || 3 || agnidhrādīnmanoḥ putrān daityo vaśe cakāra ha | sa marīcyatryaṃgirasapulastyapulahakratūn || 4 || vasiṣṭhaṃ ceti saptarṣīnapi svavaśagān vyadhāt | jayānamitān śukrām̐śca yāmān devān vaśe vyadhāt || 5 || api viṣṇurnāradena bodhito daityachittaye | sudarśanaṃ mahācakraṃ prerayad raṇamūrdhani || 6 || cicched mastakaṃ daityasyātha devānamocayat | aya viṣṇusvarūpo me’vatāraḥ prathamo rame || 7 || atha svārociṣe manvantare dvitīyake punaḥ | purukṛsaro daityo vai tvindraṃ vipaścitaṃ surān || 8 || apīḍayattathā corjaṃ stambaṃ prāṇaṃ ca niścalam | ṛṣabhaṃ cārvavīraṃ ca dambholimapyapīḍayat || 9 || saptarṣīn tuṣitān pārāvatān devānapīḍayat | manuputrān caikalaṃ ca vinataṃ vidyutaṃ ravim || 3.164.10 || bṛhadguṇaṃ ca karṇāntaṃ nabhase tānapīḍayat | jalamadhye vasantaṃ ca megharūpeṇa vā kvacit || 11 || vartamānaṃ vihantuṃ vai mahendraprārthdhito’pyaham | śvetahastisvarūpaṃ vai sapakṣaṃ parvataprabham || 12 || caturdantaṃ dviśuṇḍhaṃ ca dadhāra sahasā vane | yuddhyamānaṃ saśastraṃ ca daityaṃ raṇe prasahya ca || 13 || ahamamārayaṃ dantaiḥ śuṇḍhābhyāṃ pādamardanaiḥ | gajanārāyaṇaḥ so’haṃ bhavitāsmi tadā kṣitau || 14|| prasiddhaḥ pūjito lokairmokṣado bhuktido’pi ca | dvitīyaścāvatāro me gajākhyaḥ kathito rame || 15 || auttame ca manau tṛtīyake pralambadānavaḥ | mahābalo mahendraṃ ca svaśāntināmakaṃ tathā || 16 || rathaujasaṃ cordhvabāhuṃ śaraṇaṃ tvanaghaṃ maṇim | śaṃkuṃ sutapasaṃ saptarṣīṃśca duḥkhākariṣyati || 17|| vaśavṛttān svadhāmnaśca śivān satyān pratardanān | devāṃstān yodhayitvā sa svavaśān praṇayiṣyati || 18 || manoḥ putrān paraśuṃ ca vinītamājamityapi | śuciṃ suketuṃ suvalaṃ devāvṛdhaṃ sumitrakam || 19 || mahotsāhārjitaṃ tām̐śca yudhe sarvān vijeṣyati | mahājalāntare gatvā dānavo vāsameṣyati |||3.164.20 || tadārthito’haṃ manunā bhaviṣyāmi jalāntare | matsyarūpo hi bhagavān mārayiṣyāmi lambakam ||2 1 || tṛtīyaścāvatāro’yaṃ mama matsyasvarūpadhṛk | caturthasya manostāmasākhyasya samaye bhuvi || 22|| bhīmaratho’suro bhaimarathāsuraiḥ samedhitaḥ | vijitaye śibināmānamindraṃ tathā manoḥ sutān || 23|| jānujaṃghaṃ nirbhayaṃ ca navakhyātiṃ nayaṃ tathā | vivikṣipaṃ priyabhṛtyaṃ haviṣkandhiṃ kṛtaṃ tathā || 24|| kṛtabanghuṃ prastalākṣaṃ daśa vaśe cakāra saḥ | ṛṣīn jyotirdhāmakaṃ ca dhṛṣṭaṃ kāvyaṃ ca hemakam || 25 || agniṃ cetaṃ caitrakaṃ ca vaśe cakāra vai tadā | devān surāgān svadhīṃśca harīn haritakān vaśe || 26 || cakārātha suraiḥ samprāthiṃtaścāhaṃ tadā rame | bhīmarathaṃ samudrasya talasthaṃ taṃ mahāsuram || 27|| haniṣye kūrmarūpeṇa jalamadhye mahāvapuḥ | caturthaścāvatāro’yaṃ mama kūrmasvarūpadhṛk || 28 || pañcamasya raivatasya manostu samaye kṣitau | indre tu vibhunāmānaṃ babandha śāntaśatrukaḥ || 29|| daityau daityagaṇairyuktastathā manoḥ sutānapi | mahāprāṇaṃ sādhakaṃ ca pratyaṃgaṃ naramitrakam || 3.164.3 0 || śuciṃ paraghnaṃ ca vanabandhuṃ dṛḍhavrataṃ tathā | ketuśṛṃgaṃ vijigye’sau saptarṣīṃścāpyapīḍayat || 31 || devaśriyaṃ vedabāhumūrdhvabāhuṃ svadhāmakam | hiraṇyaromakaṃ parjanyakaṃ ca satyanāmakam ||32|| evaṃ devānabhūtarajaso’śvamedhakām̐stathā | vaikuṇṭhānamṛtām̐ścāpyapīḍayad bahudhābhitaḥ ||33 || ṛṣibhiścārthitaścāhaṃ tadāraṇyanivāsavān | haṃsarūpadharo bhūtvā jaghāna śāntaśatrukama |||34|| pañcamaścāvatāro’yaṃ mama haṃsasvarūpadhṛk | cākṣuṣasya tu ṣaṣṭhasya manostu samaye tataḥ || 35|| mahākālo mahādaityo devaduḥkhaprado’bhavat | indraṃ manojavākhyaṃ sa jitvā manoḥ sutānapi || 36 || uruṃ puruṃ śatadyumnaṃ tāpasaṃ satyabāhukam | kṛtimagniṣṇumatirātraṃ ca sudyumnakaṃ naram | |37 || etān jitvā tathā devānāryān bhāvyān pralekhakān | pṛthukān prasutām̐ścāpi tathā jitvā ṛṣīnapi || 38 || haviṣmantaṃ ca sutanuṃ svadhāmānaṃ ca vairājam | abhimānaṃ sahiṣṇuṃ ca madhuśriyaṃ hi sapta tān || 39 || jitvā trailokyarājyaṃ vai mahākālaḥ kariṣyati | tadā lokaiḥ prārthito’haṃ hayagrīvasvarūpadhṛk ||3.164.40 || bhūtvā daityaṃ mahākālaṃ nāśayiṣyāmi padmaje | ṣaṣṭho’yamavatāro me hayagrīvasvarūpavān ||41 || saptame ca manau vaivasvate lakṣmi mahān khalaḥ | hiraṇyākṣo mahādaityo jigāya sarvadevatāḥ ||42 || maruddevām̐stathādityān vasūn sādhyān gaṇām̐stathā | viśvedevānaśvinau ca rudrānāṅgirasān surān ||43 || tathā tejasvināmānaṃ cendraṃ jigāya daityarāṭ | ṛṣīṃśca pīḍayāmāsa bharadvājaṃ ca gautamam ||44|| viśvāmitraṃ kaśyapaṃ ca jamadagniṃ vaśiṣṭhakam | atriṃ ceti tathā manoḥ putrān vaśe cakāra ha ||45|| ikṣvākuṃ ca laviṣyantaṃ nediṣṭaṃ nāmakaṃ nabham | pāṃśuṃ viṣṭiṃ ca sarjātiṃ karūṣakaṃ pṛṣadhrakam | | 46 || sudyumnaṃ ceti sarvān vaiṣṇavām̐ścakre nijānugāna | tadā tu bhaktayā pṛthvyā prārthito’haṃ hariḥ svayam || 47 || vārāharūpavān hiṃsiṣyāmi hiraṇyanetrakam | saptamo’yaṃ cāvatāro vārāho bhvādirakṣakaḥ || 48|| aṣṭame ca manau sāvarṇyākhye cendro balirnṛpaḥ | virocanasuto daityo mahābhakto babhūva ha ||49|| tadvaśe ca tadā devā amṛtābhāḥ sutāpasāḥ | mukhyāśceti gaṇāḥ sarve vartante sma balādiva ||3.164.50|| aśvatthāmā kṛpo vyāso gālavo dīptimānapi | ṛṣyaśṛṃgaḥ parśurāmaḥ ṛṣayaste’pi tadvaśe || 51 || sāvarṇestu sutā arvavīro vijayaḥ satyavāk | kṛtirnirdehaḥ sagatirvariṣṭhaśca gariṣṭhakaḥ ||52|| vācaśceti baleḥ sarve vaśyāśca duḥkhino yadā | tadāhaṃ devaṛṣibhiścārthito vāmanākṛtiḥ ||53|| bhūtvā ca yācako vipro grahīṣye śakradhiṣṇyakam | baliṃ mokṣaṃ preṣayiṣye divaṃ dāsyāmi jiṣṇave ||54|| aṣṭamo’yaṃ me’vatārastrivikramo hi padmaje | navame dakṣasāvarṇau manau tu kālakākṣakaḥ ||55 || devaśatrurvaśe ninye cendramadbhutanāmakam | kārtikeyāṃśamindraṃ taṃ tathā manoḥ sutānimān ||56|| dhṛṣṭaketuṃ dīptiketuṃ padmahastaṃ nirākṛtim | pṛthuśravasamṛcikaṃ bṛhaddyumnaṃ bṛhadguṇam ||57|| tathā ninye vaśe saptarṣīṃśca medhātithiṃ vasum | jyotiṣmantaṃ sabalaṃ ca dyutiṃ kavyaṃ ca havyakam ||58|| tathā pārān sudharmākhyān marīcigarbhakān surān | tadāhamarthito devaiḥ padmanābho bhavāmi ca ||59|| kālakākṣaṃ haniṣyāmi kariṣyāmi sukhān surān | navamo’yaṃ padmanābho’vatāro me hi padmaje || 3.164.60 || daśame brahmasāvarṇau baliśatrurmahāsuraḥ | śāntināmakamindraṃ ca saptarṣīn vaśamānayat ||6 1 || āpomūrtiṃ haviṣmantaṃ satyaṃ sukṛtinaṃ tathā | nābhāgaṃ cāpratimaṃ ca vasiṣṭhaṃ ceti tānṛṣīn ||62|| manoḥ putrān sukṣetraṃ ca bhūmisenaṃ jayadratham | anamitraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ ca śatānīkaṃ suparvakam ||63 || suvīryamauttamaujaskaṃ vaśe ninye mahāsuraḥ | sukhāsīnānniruddhām̐śca prāṇān devān vaśe vyadhāt ||64|| devaistadārthitaścāhaṃ harirūpadharaḥ svayam | gadayā baliśatruṃ taṃ ghātayiṣyāmi vai rame ||65 || daśamo’yaṃ harirūpo’vatāro mama padmaje | ekādaśe dharmasāvaṇau mano vṛṣamindrakam ||66 || daśagrīvo mahādaityo vaśaṃ cakāra devatāḥ | vihaṃgamān kāmagamānnirmāṇarucikām̐stathā ||67|| ekaikarucikām̐ścāpi devānatha manoḥ sutān | sarvatragaṃ suśarmāṇaṃ devānīkaṃ puruṃ gurum ||68|| kṣetravarṇaṃ dṛḍheṣuṃ cārdrakaṃ ca putrakaṃ tathā | saptarṣīṃśca vaśe cakre’gnitejasaṃ haviṣyakam ||69|| viśvaṃ viṣṇuṃ vistaraṃ ca haviṣmantaṃ ca vāruṇam | ṛṣibhiḥ prārthitaścāhaṃ śrīrūpo mohakārakaḥ ||3.164.70 || bhūtvā mugdhaṃ harantaṃ māṃ haniṣyāmi mahāsuram | ekādaśo’vatāro me śrīnārīrūpavān rame ||71 || dvādaśe rudrasāvaṇau ṛtadhāmānamindrakam | tārakākhyo’suraśreṣṭho vaśe cakāra vai svayam |||72||| manoḥ putrān devavantamupadevaṃ vidūratham | devaśreṣṭhaṃ mitravantaṃ mitradevaṃ savīryakam ||73 || mitrabinduṃ mitravāhaṃ pravāhaṃ ceti vai tathā | devān svadharmaṇaścāpi rohitakān haritakān ||74|| surārīn sutapasaśca saptarṣīnityapīti ca | tapasvinaṃ sutapasaṃ tapomūrtiṃ taporatim ||75 || tapodhṛtiṃ dyutiṃ vidyutiṃ ceti vai tataḥ surāḥ | cakrire prārthanāṃ me ca tārakasya samāptaye ||76|| tārako’pi śaṃkarasya varadānānmahābalaḥ | naro vai cetanaṃ tattvaṃ nārī māyā jaḍaṃ tu tat ||77|| tābhyāṃ mṛtyurna me syādvai varaṃ labdhvā nirāmayaḥ | jigāya sarvabhūtāni rājyaṃ cakre trilokajam ||78|| tato’haṃ tasya nāśāya napuṃsakatvamāptavān | tena rūpeṇa kamale nāśayiṣye hi tārakam ||79|| napuṃsakahariścāyamavatāro navīnakaḥ | napuṃsakātmikī sṛṣṭistato’bhavanmaduttarā ||3.164.8 0 || dvādaśaścāvatāro’yaṃ mama lakṣmi prakīrtitaḥ | napuṃsakahariṃ dhyātvā bhajitvā mānavāstadā ||8 1 || yāsyanti paramāṃ muktiṃ strīpuṃliṃgavivarjitām | trayodaśe devasāvarṇau raucye tu divaspatim ||82|| indraṃ vaśe cakārāpi daityaṣṭiṭṭibhasaṃjñakaḥ | manoḥ putrān citrasenaṃ tapodharmarataṃ dhṛtim ||83|| vicitraṃ gharmapaṃ kṣetravṛttiṃ dṛḍhaṃ sunetrakam | vaśe cakre tatharṣīṃśca sunayaṃ tattvadarśinam ||84|| dhṛtimantamavyayaṃ ca niśārūpaṃ nirutsukam | nirmāṇaṃ cetyatha devān svaromakān svadharmakān ||85|| svakarmakānamarām̐śca vaśe cakre tu ṭiṭṭibhaḥ | meruvāsaṃ ṭiṭṭibhaṃ taṃ nāśayituṃ surādayaḥ ||86 || prārthayan māṃ mayā dīrghaṃ rūpaṃ māyūrakaṃ dhṛtam | māyūrakeṇa rūpeṇa ghātayiṣyāmi ṭiṭṭibham ||87|| trayodaśo’vatāro’yaṃ mama lakṣmi prakīrtitaḥ | māyūro’haṃ mahārājaḥ pūjāṃ prāpsye tadā yuge ||88 || caturdaśendrasāvarṇau bhautye śucirmahāsuraḥ | indro bhūtvā sārvarājyaṃ pracakāra trilokajam ||89|| manoḥ putrān gabhīraṃ ca dhṛṣṭamūruṃ tarasvinam | abhimānaṃ gabhīraṃ ca grāhaṃ jiṣṇuṃ pravīrakam ||3.164.90 || durlabhaṃ saṃkrandanaṃ ca vaśe tān sa cakāra ha | saptarṣīnagnibāhuṃ cāgnidhraṃ śuciṃ ca māgadham ||91 || śukramajitaṃ muktaṃ ca vaśe cakāre sa svayam | cākṣuṣān karmaṭhām̐ścāpi pavitrān bhrājinaḥ surān | |92|| vācāvṛthān devagaṇān vaśe cakre tathā svayam | sāyaṃkāle hariścāhaṃ prārthito brahmaṇā yadā ||93 || pralayāya vināśāyāsurasyendrasya vai tathā | sudarśanena cakreṇa ghātayiṣyāmi śakrakam ||94|| sudarśanahariścāyamavatāro mamāntimaḥ | kalpānte kathito lakṣmi madhye’nye bahavo’pi ca ||95||| kāryavaśād bhavantyeva me’vatārā asaṃkhyakāḥ | yasya haste’thavā pādatale matsyo dhanurdhvajaḥ ||96||| śaraḥ śūlaṃ svastiko vā cakraṃ padmaṃ ghaṭo’pi vā | so’haṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādasmi pracchannarūpavān || 97|| vartāmi sādhudharmāhaṃ sādhukarmā samastavid | saiśvaryaścāpyanaiśvaryo divyo’pyadivyavartanaḥ ||98 || saṃgāt samāgamād yogād darśanāt sparśanādapi | sahavāsāt smaraṇādvā sevanānmuktido dhruvam || 99||| bhāgyavanto dehino māṃ jñātvā prasādya sevayā | mokṣamārge cārjayanti mamānandamalaukikam || 3.164.10 0|| abhāmyāstu manuṣyaṃ māṃ matvā yānti vidūrataḥ | āsurāste pāpavanto maherṣyavo’parādhinaḥ || 10 1|| muktimārgasthitāścāpi yāsyanti nirayān bahūn | cihnaiścāpi ca sārvajñyaistathā divyaguṇādibhiḥ || 10 2|| māṃ viditvāśrayiṣyanti ye te yāsyanti me’kṣaram | narā nāryaśca paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ śūdrayonayaḥ || 10 3|| apyadharmaparāścāpi madyogāt pāvanā hi te | kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho mānaṃ madaśca matsaraḥ || 1 04|| durguṇāḥ puṇyapāpe ca nirguṇā mama yogataḥ | yena kenāpi bhāvena yujyante ye mayā saha || 1 05|| nityayuktā hi te jātā viyujyante na karhicit | mama yogo mokṣado vai suramānavarakṣasām || 106|| śūdrapakṣipaśūnāṃ ca daityadānavayoṣitām | mayā saṃkalpamātreṇa tāryante tvaṇḍarāśayaḥ || 107|| mama manāk suyogena pūyante pāpakarmiṇaḥ | yā kriyā pāpanāmno sā kṛtā mayi tu pāvanī || 108|| svatantro’haṃ mamāmnāyā upadiśanti vai vṛṣān | ayaṃ vṛṣo bhavatvevaṃ dhārayāmi vṛṣo hi saḥ || 10 9|| avṛṣo’pi vṛṣaḥ syānme saṃkalpādvā vṛṣo’vṛṣaḥ | vicāryetthaṃ prasevante māṃ mūrtaṃ parameśvaram | | 3.164.110 || teṣāṃ muktiḥ kare tvāste’mutrātra sarvakarmasu | paṭhanācchravaṇādasyādhyāyasya mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 111 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne caturdaśamanvantareṣu hareścaturdaśāvatāraprayojanādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥṣaṣṭayadhika śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 164 ||
<3.165> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca jīvatā tu janenātra satkāryaṃ kīdṛśaṃ śubham | kartavyaṃ yena sarvatra paratra sa sukhī bhavet || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca mama pūjā prakartavyā paratra parasaukhyadā | pitṛpūjā prakartavyā devapūjā tayā śubhā || 2 || dānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prakartavyaṃ jīvacchrāddhaṃ tathā śubham | yatkṛteneha hastena labhyate’mutra tatphalam || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca jīvacchrāddhaṃ kathaṃ kīdṛk kartavyaṃ tadvidhiṃ vada | tatra yadyatpradātavyaṃ tatsarvaṃ me prabho vada || 4 || śrīpukṣottama uvāca devālaye satāṃ vāse maṭhe ceśvarasannidhau | vidyālaye yajñabhūmau parvate ca nadītaṭe || 5 || vane tīrthe caityadeśe pāvane ca sthale’pi vā | svagṛhe nūtane kuryājjīvacchrāddhaṃ sukhapradam || 6 || yadā tu cintayeddharmaṃ śrāddhaṃ kartavyamādarāt | śraddhayā svakareṇaiva hṛdā bhāvanayārpyate || 7 || śrāddhaṃ tat sarvathā bodhyaṃ pañcadhā tatprakīrtyate | pārabrāhmikaṃ ca paitryaṃ daivamaiśvaraṃ bhautikam || 8 || bālye vā yauvane vāpi vārdhakye mṛtisannidhau | yadākadācitkartavyaṃ pañcadhāpi śubhairjanaiḥ || 9 || jīvacchrāddhe kṛte jīvo jīvanneva vimucyate | karma kurvannakurvan vā hyajñānī jñānavānapi || 3.165.10 || śrotriyaścāpyaśrotriyaścāturvarṇyo hi mānavaḥ | āśramastho’pi vā tyāgī kuryācchrāddhaṃ hi pañcadhā || 11 || paraṃbrahma hariṃ smṛtvā mandireṣu mahatsu tu | haraye nityanaivedyaṃ dadyājjīvan jano bhuvi || 1 2||| śrīkṛṣṇāya mahānaivedyakaṃ dadyānnavaṃ navam | ṣaṭapañcāśadbhogarūpaṃ jīvanmokṣe phalāya tat || 1 3|| nityaṃ prātarbhagavate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya ha | mudgalaḍukadugdhādi śarkarāṃ cārpayettathā || 14|| nāgavallīdalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ dadyāttu tṛptaye | tatphalaṃ paraloke syāt svasmai dātre’kṣayaṃ sukham || 15|| madhyāhne’pi pradadyācca miṣṭānnāni śubhāni ca | ghṛtājyaśarkarāktāni pakvānnāni samarpayet || 16|| śākāni dvidalāḥ sūpaṃ bhaktaṃ vividhapācitam | polikāḥ pūrikāḥ dugdhapākaṃ kṣīrādi cārpayet ||17|| āranālāni ramyāṇi veṣavārayutāni ca | bhakṣyabhojyāni lehyāni coṣyāṇyapi phalāni ca || 18|| kandapuṣpadalapatragranthīn dadyāttu bhojane | devadevāya kṛṣṇāya sarvaśrīsahitāya vai || 1 9|| nityamevaṃ rājabhogān dadyāt svarṇādinirmite | sthāle pātre ca pātreṣu pratyakṣaṃ śrāddhameva tat || 3.165.20 || jīvatā jīvikā dattā vṛttirūpā tu śārṅgiṇe | phalatyevākṣare dhāmni goloke śrīpure’pi sā ||21 || parameśāya dattaṃ tat sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam | prāpyate muktabhāve’pi pratyarpitaṃ tu śārṅgiṇā ||22|| goloke vāpi vaikuṇṭhe’vyākṛte’pyamṛte’pi ca | dattamatra tadīśāyānantaguṇamavāpyate ||23|| evaṃ jalāni miṣṭāni śītāni madhurāṇi ca | dātavyāni śrīharaye sarvartuvāñcchitāni ca || 24||| vṛttyātmakāni dattāni prāpyante tāni tṛptaye | evaṃ lakṣmi pradeyāni mukhavāsāni śuddhaye |||25|| tānyapi tvaṅalavaṃgailākapūrravīṭikāstathā | pūgīcūrṇakhadirādicūrṇamiṣṭaphalāni ca ||26|| athotthānasamaye’pi jalaṃ phalaṃ dalaṃ tathā | bhojanārthaṃ pradeyāni coṣṇaśītāni yāni ca ||re7|| ghṛtapakvāni sarvāṇi tailapakvāni yāni ca | vahnipakvāni sarvāṇi sūryapakvāni yāni ca ||28|| ṛtupakvāni bhakṣyāṇi sugandhirasavanti ca | pradeyāni śrīharaye tṛtīyaprahare sadā ||29|| sāyaṃ bhojanapānārthaṃ pūrikāḥ polikāstathā | dugdhaṃ śākaṃ cāranālaṃ dadyācchrīharaye jalam ||3.165.30|| nityameva pradadyādvai vṛttyarthaṃ vāṭikāṃ diśet | kṣetrāṇi cārpayet saudhaṃ bhavanāni tathārpayet ||3 1 || grāmān gṛhaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ dadyājjīvanavṛttidām | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya paramātmane ||3|| jīvikāṃ bandhayet pūjāpravāhārthaṃ dhanairapi | evaṃ yaḥ śraddhayā kuryājjīvacchrāddhaṃ taducyate ||33|| varṣe varṣe tvekavāraṃ bhojanaṃ jalasaṃyutam | yadvā bhavettathā dadyāt sthālanaivedyanāṇakam ||34|| pratimāsaṃ ca vā dadyāt pratyutsavaṃ tathārpayet | pratipakṣaṃ diśedvāpi pratiparva diśedapi ||35|| evaṃ śrīharaye dattā jīvikā vṛttiruttamā | akṣayāya phalāyaiṣā nityatṛptipradā bhavet ||26|| pārabrāhmaṃ śrāddhametallakṣmi proktaṃ mayā tu tai | aiśvaraṃ cāpi vai śrāddhaṃ kathayāmi tu tacchṛṇu ||37|| yatra yatra me’vatārapratimāḥ santi mandire | vāsudevādayo vyūhāḥ kapilādyāśca sādhavaḥ ||38|| śriyo lakṣmyaḥ pārṣadāśca pārṣadānyaśca yāḥ śubhāḥ | vairājādyā īśvarāśca tebhyo dadyānnivedyakam ||39|| miṣṭānnaṃ ca jalaṃ peyaṃ phalaṃ kandaṃ dalādikam | tāmcūlakādikaṃ kṣīraṃ dadyājjīvanmadhu tviha ||3.165.40|| tatsarvamaiśvaraṃ proktaṃ dattaṃ pratiphalāya tat | paitryaṃ vadāmi te lakṣmi pitṛbhyaḥ pratipāditam ||41 || jale vā darbhamūle vā vṛkṣamūle’tha bhūtale | viprahaste vipramukhe jīvan dadyāttu tṛptaye ||42|| āmapiṇḍān pakvamiṣṭānnāni dadyāttu bhojane | śākapatraphalakandān kṣīraṃ dadyāttu tṛptaye ||43|| daivaṃ cāpi pradadyācca śrāddhaṃ devebhya ādarāt | ādityebhyaśca rudrebhyo’śvibhyāṃ vasubhya ityapi ||44|| tathānyadevatābhyaśca dadyād yatheṣṭakaṃ śubham | daivaṃ śrāddhaṃ hi tatproktaṃ vidhiṃ vadāmi saṃśṛṇu ||45 || parīkṣya bhūmiṃ vidhivad gandhaparṇarasādibhiḥ | aśalyāyāṃ prakuryādvai sthaṇḍilaṃ saikataṃ śubham ||46|| madhyato hastamātraṃ vā kuṇḍaṃ suśobhanaṃ param | upalipya vidhānena cālipyāgniṃ vidhāya ca ||47|| anvādhāya yathāśāstraṃ parigṛhya ca sarvataḥ | paristīrya yathāśāstraṃ pāramparyakramāgatam ||48|| samāpyāgnimukhaṃ sarvaṃ sampūjya sthaṇḍile’nalam | juhuyāt samidādyaiśca caruṇā ca pṛthak pṛthak ||49|| ghṛtenāpi juhuyāccoddhṛtyātmanā surādiṣu | sarvatastattvabhūtāni juhuyāt tṛptaye tadā ||3.165.50|| oṃ bhūrnamo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya śārṅgiṇe | oṃ bhūranādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya ca svāhā ||51 || oṃ bhuvaścāvatārebhyo nama īśvarebhyastathā | oṃ bhuvaścāvatārebhyaḥ svāhā īśvarebhyastathā ||52|| oṃ svarnamo jīvasṛṣṭibhyaḥ pitṛdevatādibhyaḥ | oṃ svaḥ svāhā jīvasṛṣṭibhyaḥ pitṛdevatādibhyaḥ ||53|| oṃ bhūrvedhase’stu namaḥ oṃ bhūrvedhase svāhā | oṃ bhuvarviṣṇave namaḥ oṃ bhuvarviṣṇave svāhā ||54|| oṃ svaḥ śaṃkarāya namaḥ oṃ svaḥ śaṃkarāya svāhā | oṃ mahaḥ sureśāya namaḥ oṃ mahaḥ sureśāya svāhā ||55|| oṃ janaḥ pitṛbhyo namaḥ oṃ janaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svāhā | oṃ tapaḥ prakṛtaye namaḥ oṃ tapaḥ prakṛtaye svāhā ||26|| oṃ satyaṃ haraye namaḥ oṃ satyaṃ haraye svāhā | oṃ kṛṣṇadharāṃ me gopāya ghrāṇe gandhaṃ devāya kṛṣṇāya bhūrnamaḥ ||57|| oṃ kṛṣṇadharāṃ me gopāya ghrāṇe gandhaṃ kṛṣṇāya bhū svāhā | oṃ kṛṣṇadharāṃ me gopāya ghrāṇe gandhaṃ kṛṣṇasya patnyai bhūrnamaḥ svāhā ||58|| oṃ kṛṣṇadharāṃ me gopāya ghrāṇe gandhaṃ kṛṣṇapatnyai bhūḥ svāhā | oṃ hare jalaṃ me gopāya jihvāyāṃ rasaṃ haraye bhuvo namaḥ ||59|| oṃ hare jalaṃ me gopāya jihvāyāṃ rasaṃ haraye bhuvaḥ svāhā | oṃ hare jalaṃ me gopāya jihvāyāṃ rasaṃ hareḥ patnyai bhuvo namaḥ ||3.165.60|| oṃ hare jalaṃ me gopāya jihvāyāṃ rasaṃ hareḥ patnyai bhuvaḥ svāhā | oṃ pareśāgniṃ me gopāya netre rūpaṃ pareśāya svaro namaḥ ||61 || oṃ pareśāgni me gopāya netre rūpaṃ pareśāyasvaḥ svāhā | oṃ pareśāgni me gopāya netre rūpapareśapatnyai svaroṃ namaḥ ||62|| oṃ pareśāgniṃ me gopāya netrerūpaṃ pareśapatnyai svaḥ svāhā | oṃ brahma vāyu me gopāya tvaci sparśaṃ brahmaṇe devāya maharnamaḥ ||63 || oṃ brahma vāyuṃ me gopāya tvaci sparśaṃ brahmaṇe devāya mahaḥ svāhā | oṃ brahma vāyuṃ me gopāya tvaci sparśaṃ brahmapatnyai maharoṃ namaḥ || 64|| oṃ brahma vāyuṃ me gopāya tvaci sparśaṃ brahmapatnyai mahaḥ svāhā | oṃ paravyoma suṣiraṃ me gopāya śrotre śabdaṃ paravyomne jano namaḥ || 65|| oṃ paravyoma suṣiraṃ me gopāya śrotre śabdaṃ paravyomne janaḥ svāhā | oṃ paravyoma suṣiraṃ me gopāya śrotre śabdaṃ paravyomapatnyai jano namaḥ || 66|| oṃ paravyoma suṣiraṃ me gopāya śrotre śabdaṃ paravyomapatnyai janaḥ svāhā | oṃ mukteśarajo me gopāya dravye tṛṣṇāṃ mukteśāya tapo namaḥ || 67| | oṃ mukteśarajau me gopāya dravye tṛṣṇāṃ mucośāya tapaḥ svāhā | oṃ mukteśarajo me gopāya dravye tṛṣṇāṃ mukteśapatnyai tapo namaḥ | | 68 | | oṃ mukteśarajo me gopāya dravye tṛṣṇāṃ mukteśapatnyai tapaḥ svāhā | oṃ bālakṛṣṇa satyaṃ me gopāya śraddhāṃ dharme bālakṛṣṇāya satyaṃ namaḥ || 69|| oṃ bālakṛṣṇa satyaṃ me gopāya śraddhāṃ dharme bālakṛṣṇāya satyaṃ svāhā | oṃ bālakṛṣṇa satyaṃ me gopāya śraddhāṃ dharme bālakṛṣṇapatnyai satyaṃ namaḥ ||3.165.70 || oṃ bālakṛṣṇa satyaṃ me gopāya śraddhāṃ dharme bālakṛṣṇapatnyai satyaṃ svāhā | oṃ jīvapate jīvanaṃ me gopāya ceṣṭaṃ paratra jīvapataye jīvanaṃ namaḥ | |71 || oṃ jīvapate jīvanaṃ me gopāya ceṣṭaṃ paratra jīvapataye jīvanaṃ svāhā | oṃ jīvapate jīvanaṃ me gopāya ceṣṭaṃ paratra jīvapatepatnyai namaḥ svāhā | |72|| oṃ jīvapate jīvanaṃ me gopāya ceṣṭaṃ paratra jīvapatipatnyai jīvanaṃ svāhā | o parabrahmaṇe namaḥ śrīpuruṣottamāya svāhā ||73|| oṃ pitre namaḥ pitre svāhā prapitre namaḥ prapitre svāhā | oṃ prapitāmahāya namaḥ prapitāmahāya svāhā ||74|| oṃ bhūtebhyo namo bhūtebhyaḥ svāhā | oṃ sūkṣmebhyo namo mātrābhyaḥ svāhā ||75|| omindriyebhyo nama indriyebhyaḥ svāhā | oṃ prāṇebhyo namaḥ prāṇebhyaḥ svāhā ||76|| omantaḥkaraṇebhyo namo’ntaḥkaraṇebhyaḥ svāhā | omātmane nama ātmane svāhā ||77|| oṃ kṛṣṇa dharāṃ ye chindhi ghrāṇe gandhaṃ chindhi me’ghaṃ bhūḥ svāhā bhuvaḥ svāhā svaḥ svāhā ||78|| evaṃ pṛthak pṛthak hutvā kevalena ghṛtena vai sahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tu vā ||79|| mahālakṣmīṃ ghṛtenaiva śatamaṣṭottaraṃ pṛthak | prāṇādibhiśca juhuyād ghṛtenaiva ca kevalam ||3.165.80 || oṃ prāṇe niviṣṭo’mṛtaṃ juhomi | harirmāviśa pradāhāya prāṇāya svāhā | prāṇādhipataye śrīharaye parabrahmaṇe kṛṣṇāya svāhā ||81 || oṃ bhūḥ svāhā bhuvaḥ svāhā svaḥ svāhā bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā | evaṃ krameṇa juhūyāt śrāddhoktaṃ ca yathāyatham ||82|| pūrṇāhutiṃ tato dadyāt tṛptaye paramātmanaḥ | paramātmapatnyāścāpi tṛptaye cārpayettataḥ ||83|| samāpyaivaṃ surān pitṝn svaṃ nāmnā cāpi vai diśet | bhūtādīn sampradadyācca ṛṇavadbhyastathārpayet ||84|| anṛṇī ca tato bhūtvā yogīndrān bhojayed bahūn | sādhūn sataḥ satīḥ sādhvīrbhojayed bālabālikāḥ ||85|| bāndhavān bhojayeccāpi divyān gurūn prabhojayet | vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca pātrāṇāṃ vastrābharaṇakambalān ||86|| vāhanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ kāṃsyatāmrādibhājanam | haimaṃ ca rājataṃ dhenuṃ tilān kṣetraṃ ca vaibhavān ||87|| dāsīdāsagaṇām̐ścāpi dadyācca dakṣiṇāmapi | piṇḍaṃ ca surasaṃ dadyāt pṛthagaṣṭaprakārataḥ ||88|| tryahaṃ śrīviṣṇave dadyāccaruṃ ca kṣīrabhojanam | mṛte kuryānna kuryādvā jīvan kuryānmṛto labhet ||89|| evaṃ kṛtvā mṛtasyātra śaucāśaucaṃ na vidyate | jīvanmukto yataḥ so’sti tasya vai sūtakaṃ nahi ||3.165.90|| dāhakānāṃ snānamātraṃ sūtakaṃ nādhikaṃ tataḥ | tadvaṃśe kanyakā putro yaḥ ko’pi vaṃśavardhanaḥ ||91 || so’pi mukto bhavatyeva pitruddhārakaro bhavet | mucyante jīvataḥ śrāddhāt pitaro narakādapi ||92|| mucyate karmaṇānena mātāpitṛṛṇādayam | kālaṃ prāpte gartavāso dahanaṃ jalavāhanam ||93|| yadbhavet sarvamevāsya mokṣārthaṃ doṣavarjitam | svenaiva svakṛtaṃ kāryaṃ tasmādṛṇaṃ vilīyate ||94|| bhautikaṃ gopaśubhyaśca dadyācchukādipakṣiṇe | kīṭapataṃgaprāṇibhyo matsyādibhyo diśedapi ||95|| vṛkṣādibhyo dadedvāri kaṇān dehibhya ityapi | bhikṣukebhyo’rpayedannaṃ vastraṃ pātraṃ samarpayet ||96|| yathāśakti diśed yastu svena hastena sarvathā | mṛtasyāsya dvādaśāhapratīkṣā naiva vidyate ||97|| yāti śīghraṃ vimānena puṇyaloke vṛṣesthitaḥ | ātivāhikadevāstaṃ yadvā nayanti cordhvagāḥ ||98|| evaṃ lakṣmi prakartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ jīvatpradānakam | bhuktimuktipradaṃ syāttat svakaropārjitārpaṇam ||99|| svenahastena pacanaṃ svena hastena bhakṣaṇam | svena hastenārjanaṃ ca svena hastena dānakam ||3.165.1 00|| yaḥ karoti jayatyatra paratrāpi jayatyapi | etacchravaṇataścāpi tathāpuṇyayuto bhavet || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne jīvacchrāddhavidhinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 165 ||
<3.166> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca amṛtaṃ ca viṣaṃ ceti dvayaṃ loke pravartate | sudhāmṛtaṃ garaṃ viṣaṃ rasyaṃ taddvayameva hi || 1 || arasya tadbhavedvā na bhaveccet kīdṛśaṃ hare | yaj jñātvāyaṃ lokajano virajyeta dadhīta vā || 2 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca samudramathane pūrvaṃ samutpannaṃ mahāviṣam | papau śrīśaṃkaro yogī tamastuvan maharṣayaḥ || 3 || atyugraṃ kālakūṭākhyaṃ saṃhṛtaṃ bhagavan hara | tvayā surakṣitaṃ sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ kṛpānidhe || 4 || samartho’si maheśo’si rakṣako’si viṣādana | sadā jaya suyogim̐stvaṃ brahmāsi saṃgavarjitaḥ || 5 || śrutvaivaṃ prahasan śaṃbhurviṣaṃ prāhetaranmunīn | na viṣaṃ kālakūṭākhyaṃ saṃsāro viṣamulbaṇam || 6 || saṃharet tadviṣaṃ yastu sa samartho hyanena kim | yogī sarvaprayatnena saṃharenmāyikaṃ viṣam || 7 || māyikasya ye viṣasya hartāraste hi śaṃkarā | śaṃ kurvanti guravo vā devāḥ santo’tinirmalāḥ || 8 || yogino vā mahātmānaḥ śāntidā mokṣadā hi te | saṃsāraviṣahartāraḥ samarthāste hi sādhavaḥ || 9 || sanakādyāḥ sādhavaste śukādyā yoginastathā | satyaśca brahmacāriṇyo vāsanākṣayakārikāḥ || 3.166.1 0|| saṃsāro’yaṃ dvividho’sti mūrtaścāmūrta ityapi | mūrto vai dampatīrūpo’mūrtastu vāsanātmakaḥ || 11 || mithyājñānaṃ vāsanāyāḥ kāraṇaṃ vāsanābalāt | gārhasthyaṃ viṣayāṇāṃ ca bhogavattvaṃ sarāgiṇām || 1 2|| rāge dveṣaḥ sakhārūpaḥ sāhāyyado’pyaniṣṭake | etau dvau bhavato doṣau pravartakau nivartakau || 1 3|| saguṇā sā pravṛttiśca nivṛttiśca kriyākarī | sakriyasya bhavedādyakṣaṇasambandha udbhavaḥ || 14|| vṛddhiḥ puṣṭirdṛḍhatā ca hrāsaḥ kṣayo layādikam | punaḥ karmānusāreṇodbhavo layāntako bhavet || 15|| evaṃ saṃsāracakre’tre bhramannapi vivekavān | rāgadveṣādirahito mukto bhavati bandhanāt || 1 6|| garāṇi santi bahūni vadāmi śṛṇu padmaje | miṣṭaṃ garaṃ kuṭumbasyābhimānaṃ janmato bhavet ||17|| mātā pitā sakhā bandhuścābhimānaṃ mahad garam | gṛhaṃ me vāṭikā me ca kṣetraṃ me peṭikā ca me || 18|| dhanaṃ me ca suvarṇaṃ me’mbaraṃ me garamuttamam | mānyaṃ mama vaco nitya maduktaṃ satyameva tat || 19|| agryaṃ vākyaṃ cāpradhṛṣyaṃ mamaiva mānyameva tat | vijayo me niścayo me mānyo nānyasya kasyacit || 3.166.20 || nirṇītaṃ ca mayā yat tat svīkāryaṃ sarvathā janaiḥ | garaṃ caitanmahatproktaṃ yanmadena prapīḍyate ||21 || balaṃ viṣaṃ paraṃ proktaṃ kleśada yuddhakṛddhi tat | kalājñānaṃ garaṃ cāpi sampadgaraṃ nu nāśakṛt ||22|| viṣayāstu garaṃ lakṣmi mahānirayapātinaḥ | viṣayā viṣamevāsti yadāveśo’pratikriyaḥ || 23 || tṛṣṇā viṣaṃ paraṃ lakṣmi rāgo viṣaṃ mahattaram | dveṣo viṣaṃ vahnirūpaṃ cintā garaṃ tu nāśakṛt ||24|| kāmo garaṃ samastānāṃ viṣāṇāṃ viṣamulbaṇam | nirayotthaṃ nirayāṇāṃ pradaṃ nirayavāsadam || 25|| moho viṣaṃ tathāniṣṭakaraṃ duḥkhapradaṃ mahat| | mugdhaḥ kṛtyaṃ na jānāti mohadagdho vinaśyati || 26 || sattā viṣaṃ paraṃ cāste rājyaṃ viṣaṃ tu mārakam | jihvāśiśnodaragṛdhnā viṣaṃ kālaprakūṭakam ||27||| nāstikatvaṃ guroḥ pitroravamānaṃ viṣaṃ guru | hanyate yena sahasādhogatiṃ nāśameti ca || 28 || śāpo viṣaṃ duḥkhitānāṃ satāmasnigdhatā viṣam | adharmaśca viṣaṃ svargadāhakaṃ bhūtināśakam || 29 || nindā cauryaṃ balātkāro viṣāṇīmāni mūlataḥ | nikṛntanāni karturvai vināśakāni cācirāt || 3.166.30 || matsaro’sahanaṃ cerṣyā netraṃ hṛnmānasaṃ tu taiḥ | nijaṃ nijaṃ tu bhavanaṃ kṛtaṃ ca dahyate pumān || 31 || evaṃ viṣairāvṛto’yaṃ cāvidyāpariveṣṭitaḥ | nārakī sarvathā cāste viṣametad durantakam || 32 || udbhijjaḥ svedajaścāpi tathāṇḍajo jarāyujaḥ | tyāgābhāvād bhramantyevājñānavāsanakarmabhiḥ || 33 || ṣāṭkauśikaṃ sagaraṃ ca bhajatyeva kalevaram | prathamaṃ pitṛto janma bījadānātmakaṃ matam || 34|| garbhājjanma dvitīyaṃ ca bālarūpaṃ tu tanmatam | tṛtīyaṃ brahmasūtrācca vivāhāśca caturthakam || 35|| pañcamaṃ sarvasannyāsāt ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu maraṇottaram | saptamaṃ mokṣabhāktvaṃ ca tato janma na vidyate ||36|| baijikaṃ pāśavaṃ cāpi mānavaṃ karmabandhanam | ācyutaṃ praitakaṃ cāpyapunarbhavaṃ hi saptamam || 37|| evametāni janmāni viṣāktāni bhavanti hi | bījamātrasya cādhānaṃ baijikaṃ janma cocyate || 38 || paśuvad bhrūṇajanmāptaṃ pāśavaṃ bālajanma tat | manuṃ mantraṃ ca gāyatrīṃ yajñopavītamityapi || 39 || mānavām̐śca vṛṣāneti mānavaṃ janma ceti tat | vivāhaḥ karmabandhaśca kārāgārasamā sthitiḥ ||3.166.40 || karmabandhanarūpaṃ tajjanma dāmpatyarūpakam | sarvaṃ tyaktvā virāgaḥ san sanyāsaṃ labhate tu yaḥ ||41 || tasya janmācyutaṃ proktaṃ hareḥ śaraṇayāyinaḥ | dehatyāge pretabhāve sūkṣmaśarīrayogakṛt |||42||| dharmādharmayuto dehī bhramatyeveti janma tat | praitakaṃ procyate punarbhavārthaṃ yatra tatra vā ||43|| mokṣārthaṃ nirguṇāṃ bhaktiṃ kṛtvā tyaktvā ṛṇāni ca | chitvā bandhān saṃvilīya vināśya garalāni ca ||44|| yaḥ prayāti harerdhāmāpunarbhavaṃ hi janma tat | anuttaraviṣādaḥ sa mahāmṛtāda eva saḥ ||45|| saptamaṃ janma cāsādya maraṇaṃ nāsya vidyate | evaṃ lakṣmi ṣaḍviṣāṇi viśālāni bhavanti vai ||46|| krūrāṇi dāhakānyeva pācakāni samantataḥ | garbhe duḥkhānyanekāni yonimārge’pi vai tathā ||47|| bhūtale cāpi śayyāyāṃ kaumāre yauvane tataḥ | bhoge yoge vyavahāre vārdhake pāravaśyage ||48|| aśaktau nirdhane roge maraṇe pretake tathā | yāmye khanau viṣāktāni duḥkhānyeva vivekinaḥ ||49|| tiryakṣu mānave yākṣe paiśāce rākṣase sure | pitṛgaṇe bhogavatsu gāndharve cāpsarogaṇe ||3.166.50|| aindre brāhme prākṛte vairāje prajāpatigṛhe | pauruṣe kālakavale duḥkhaṃ viṣaṃ mahattamam ||51 || pārthivaṃ ca tathāpyaṃ ca taijasaṃ cāpi mārutam | vyaumaṃ ca mānasaṃ cāpi bauddhaṃ tathābhimānikam ||52|| prākṛtaṃ ca viṣaṃ duḥkhaṃ cādau madhye tathāntake | vartamānāni duḥkhāni bhaviṣyanti garāṇi ca ||53|| deśe kāle kriyāyāṃ ca duḥkhāni vividhāni ca | chinnamūlataruryadvat tvavaśaḥ patati kṣitau ||54|| puṇyavṛkṣakṣayād devā gāṃ patanti parā api | pāpajanyaṃ tathā duḥkhaṃ prasahya duḥkhamityapi |||55||| nārakāṇāṃ narake’pi rājñāṃ cāprāpya mānasam | vihitākaraṇāccāpi yatīnāṃ varṇināṃ tathā ||56|| saṃsārabhayamagnānāṃ duḥkhaṃ virāgiṇāmapi | kīṭapakṣimṛgāṇāṃ ca paśūnāṃ gajavājinām ||57|| garaṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhavaccātyajato duḥkhameva tat | vaimānikānāṃ sarveṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ kalpādhikāriṇām ||58|| sthānābhimānināṃ cāpi manvādīnāṃ viṣaṃ sthalam | devānāṃ cāpi daityānāmanyonyavijigīṣayā ||59|| rakṣasāṃ ca nṛpāṇāṃ ca viṣaṃ duḥkhaṃ jagattraye | śramārthamāśramāḥ santi viśrāmo vidyayā bhavet ||3.166.60|| vidyā duḥkhamapātre ca tasmāt satpātratāṃ labhet | sādhusaṃgena satataṃ jāyate satyapātratā ||6 1 || tayā dhāryaṃ bhaved brahma kṛpayāpi satāṃ rame | netre dhāryaṃ parabrahma karṇe dhāryo haristathā ||62|| kṛṣṇo dhāryastvacāṃ yoge viṣṇurdhāryo rasāśraye | ghrāṇe dhāryaḥ parameśaḥ pade dhāryaḥ prabhuḥ svayam | pāyau liṅge cāntarātmā dhāryo vyāpaka īśvaraḥ ||63|| dhāryo manasi māyeśo hṛdi dhāryo narāyaṇaḥ | buddhau dhāryo mādhavaśca ṛṣīkeśastu cintane ||64|| pṛthvyāṃ dhāryaḥ paramātmā jale dhāryo jaleśayaḥ | dhāryastejasi dhāmeśo vāyau dhāryo virāṭpatiḥ ||65|| mahāviṣṇuścāmbare ca dhāryo’haṃ tu nijātmani | draṣṭavyo’haṃ tato lakṣmi śrotavyo’haṃ tathā hariḥ ||66|| ghrātavyaśca rasitavyaḥ sparśitavyo’hameva ca | mantavyaścāpi boddhavyo’haṃkartavyo’pyahaṃ hariḥ ||67|| cetayitavya evāhaṃ vaktavyo’haṃ tathā prabhuḥ | ādātavyaśca gantavyaḥ sargāyitavya ityaham ||68 || ānandayitavya evāhaṃ tattve tattve sthito’smyaham | prāṇe prayāṇe yāne ca pāne sthairye sthito’smyaham ||69|| sarvātmānaṃ carantaṃ māṃ samupāsīta cātmavān | annasthaṃ cāpi vāristhaṃ prāṇasthaṃ mānase sthitam ||3.166.70|| vijñānasthamupāsīta māṃ hariṃ puruṣottamam | indriyasthaṃ ca mātrāsthaṃ kālasthaṃ jīvasaṃsthitam ||71 || sarvasthaṃ māmupāsīta saṃsāraviṣachittaye | amṛtaṃ cākṣareśaṃ māṃ paramātmānamāntaram ||72|| prasannaṃ harimīśeśaṃ sahasthaṃ sahajaṃ prabhum | ajñānaṃ tu malaṃ kṣveḍaṃ tyaktvā māṃ jñānagocaram |||73 || cāparokṣaṃ viditvaivāmṛtatvaṃ tvāpnuyād bṛhat | jñānamevābhyasennityaṃ madgocaraṃ pradhānataḥ ||74|| jñānenaikena bhāyukto bhaktisnehānuyojitaḥ | tyaktasaṃgaviṣo mukto māmupaiti na saṃśayaḥ ||75|| iha loke pare vāpi kartavyaṃ nāsya vidyate | jīvanmukto yatastasya vāsanāpi layaṃgatā ||76 || jñānabhaktirataścāyaṃ brahmavitparamārthataḥ | evaṃ sa muktaḥ saṃsārād duḥkhaviṣādivarjitaḥ ||77|| gurvāśraye sthito yāti dhāmākṣaraṃ parātmanaḥ | yoginaḥ sarvapāpāni jīryante garalāni ca ||78|| krīḍannapi na lipyeta garairnānāvidhairapi | dhyānaṃ nirviṣamevāste śrīhareḥ sarvadā rame ||79|| brahmaśīlo mama dhyānaṃ kuryād guroḥ prasaṃgamāt | mayi tattānatābhāvaṃ prānte mallīnatāmapi ||3.166.80 || vindatyeva hi madbhakto garaṃ tvasyāmṛtaṃ bhavet | evaṃ garāṇi sarvāṇi cāmṛtānyasya bhānti ha ||8 1 || bhūtāni sūkṣmamātrāṇi viṣayā viṣayodbhavāḥ | aguṇāśca guṇāścāpi kriyā garāṇi yāni tu |||82|| tāni sarvāṇyamṛtāni kalpitāni pare mayi | evaṃ vai viṣapo bhaktaḥ samartho netaraḥ kvacit| ||83||| pṛthvīṃ jalaṃ ca tejaśca dhartuṃ śakto hyayaṃ bhavet | vāyuṃ vyoma tathā dhartuṃ cāṣṭāvṛttīstatheśvarān ||84|| dhartuṃ śakto bhaveccāyaṃ prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ hyapi | kālaṃ dhartuṃ samarthaśca bhavet tadātmako mama ||85|| akṣarātmā bhaveccāpi muktān dhartuṃ prabhurhyapi | yathāhaṃ tu tathā so’yaṃ prāraṃbhāvananāśanam ||86|| kartuṃ jāyeta śakto madātmakaiśvarabhāvavān | pārameśapadaṃ prāpya sarvaṃ kartuṃ prabhurbhavet ||87|| viṣaṃ vidyādanubhūtyā parihāraṃ vicintayet | aviṣaṃ vā cograviṣaṃ bhuktvā viṣaṃ vināśayet ||88|| aviṣāḥ sādhavaḥ proktā ugraviṣo haristvaham | sādhusaṃgānmama pānānnirviṣo jāyate viṣī ||89|| aviṣasya mama snehādbhaktyā mama prasādanam | prasādena drutaṃ muktiḥ pratijñaiṣā rame mama ||3.166.90|| garbhastho jāyamāno vā bālo vā taruṇo’pi vā | vṛddho vā mucyate dehī prasādātparamātmanaḥ ||91 || aṇḍajaścodbhijja uta svedajo’pi pramucyate | jarājo vā naro nārī mucyate me prasādavān ||92|| mamaivāṃśā dehino’pi mama yogaviśeṣiṇaḥ | mama bhāvena sampannāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim ||93|| mayā nibhālitā bhaktā mamāṃśā matpadāśritāḥ | kṛpāpātrāṇi taranti saṃsāraviṣasāgaram ||94|| yathā tailaṃ jalayoge taratyevordhvamudgatam | tathā dehī kṛṣṇayoge taratyevordhvamudgataḥ ||95|| yathā vahniḥ svabhāvena yātyūrdhvamedhito hyati | tathā dehī subhaktyā me yātyūrdhvaṃ vardhito hyati ||96|| yathā yogī mahaiśvaryairbrahmadvāraṃ prayāti vai | tathā so’yaṃ mamaiśvaryaiḥ parabrahma prayāti hi ||97|| yathā gopī hyajaṃ prāpya gāyatrītvamupāgamat | tathā gopo hariṃ prāpya golokaṃ samavāpnuyāt ||98|| yathā lakṣmīrhariṃ prāpya hṛdaye vāsamāpa sā | tathā bhakto hariṃ prāpyākṣare vāsamavāpnuyāt ||99|| yathā māyā hariṃ prāpya harau sā pravilīyate | tathā bhakto hariṃ prāpya harau sampravilīyate || 3.166.100 || yathā patnī kāntalagnā pṛthaktve naiva vetti saḥ | tathā bhakto harau lagno bhedaṃ naijaṃ na vetti ca ||1 01 || yathā tu śarkarā dugdhe rasatāmupayāti ca | tathā kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇakarmā bhaktau dugdhatvamṛcchati ||1 02|| yathā snigdhaṃ mānasaṃ vai snehapātre milatyapi | tathā snigdho mama bhakto mayyapṛthaṅ milatyapi || 1 03|| yathānandaḥ pramodaśca sukhānyātmani cāpṛthak | tathā bhakto divyarūpaḥ paramātmani cāpṛthak || 1 04|| ityevaṃ te mayā lakṣmi viṣahāratvamīritam | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya viṣaṃ sarvaṃ vyapohati || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne saṃsāraviṣāṇāṃ taddharaṇopāyānāṃ ca nirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 166 ||
<3.167> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca āpadgatasya bhaktasya bhaktāyāstava keśava | āpannāśaḥ kathaṃ syācca pāpanāśaḥ kathaṃ bhavet || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca avratasyāpyaśaktasya jñānahīnasya dehinaḥ | āpatpāpādināśārthaṃ stotraṃ vyāpahanaṃ matam || 2 || ekāgramānaso bhūtvā stuvīta parameśvaram | avatārām̐stathā muktānīśvarān pitṛdevatāḥ || 3 || ṛṣīn gurūn bhāgavatān sādhūn bhaktān stuvīta ca | ananyaśaraṇo bhūtvā prārthayet sukhavān bhavet || 4 || sarvasiddhipradaṃ stotraṃ divyaṃ vadāmi te rame | śroturvakturvācayituḥ sarveṣṭānāṃ drutaṃ pradam || 5 || namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya paramātmane | mahābhagavate muktākṣareśāya parātmane || 6 || sṛṣṭitrayādhināthāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ | parabrahmaṇe puruṣottamāya cāvatāriṇe || 7 || sarvavit sarvavāsaḥ śrīnivāsaḥ sarvasaṃsthitaḥ | parākṣarastho mukteśaścāpatpāpaṃ vyapohatu || 8 || avatārī parabrahma divyātmā śrīnarāyaṇaḥ | parameśo hi bhagavānāpatpāpaṃ vyapohatu || 9 || anādyanantaḥ sarveśaḥ sarvavidyādharo hariḥ | sarvapradaḥ sukhadaśca pāpāpado vyapohatu || 3.167.1 0|| aṇoraṇīyānmahato mahīyān viśvapūjitaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pāpaṃ vyapohatu || 1 1|| brahmapriyāpriyaḥ kāntaḥ śāntaḥ snehabharaḥ prabhuḥ | haripriyāmanohārī pāyāpado vyapohatu || 12|| muktamaṇḍalasaṃsevyo muktānikāprasevitaḥ | kamanīyaḥ paraḥ kāntaḥ pāpāpado vyapohatu || 13|| avatārī paripūrṇaḥ parabrahma parātparaḥ | parāvareśaḥ paramaḥ pāpāpado vyapohatu || 14|| śrīpatiḥ śrīdharaḥ śrīhṛt śrīmān śrīdaḥ śriyānvitaḥ | śrīpādaḥ śrīhariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pāpāpado vyapohatu || 15|| lakṣmīpatirlakṣmīdharo lakṣmīhṛt lakṣmadānvitaḥ | lakṣmīsevātisantuṣṭaḥ pāpāpado vyapohatu || 16|| rādhāpatiśca rādhādhṛg rādhāhṛdrādhikānvitaḥ | rādhātmā rādhikākṛṣṇaḥ pāpāpado vyapohatu || 17|| māṇikīvāhano māṇikīśvaro māṇikīprabhuḥ | māṇikyābhinavahāraḥ pāpāpado vyapohatu || 18|| golokeśo gopikeśo gopīgopaprapūjitaḥ | gopālakṛṣṇo godhṛṅ me pāpāpado vyapohatu || 1 9|| nṛvaro nṛpatirnātho nārāyaṇo narottamaḥ | vaikuṇṭhavāsī bhagavān pāpāpado vyapohatu ||3.167.20|| vasudo vāsudevaśca dharmārthakāmamokṣadaḥ | amṛtādo’mṛtado ye pāpāpado vyapohatu ||21 || bhūmido bhūsthito bhūmā bhūmatāṃ bhāgyavardhanaḥ | bhūsattāvyākṛtasvāmī pāpāpado vyapohatu ||22| vedāvano dharādhṛkca mandradhṛg jñānadhṛg hariḥ | godhṛg godohano haṃsaḥ pāpāpado vyapohatu ||23|| tāpaso vatsalaḥ sādhurbhikṣuḥ krūro’dhvaro vanī | bālo bhiṣagvaraḥ kleśī pāpāpado vyapohatu ||24|| samrāṭ śāstrī kṛṣṇakāntaḥ prājño’vatārakāraṇam | āveśoṃ’śaḥ kalā bhūtiḥ pāpāpado vyapohatu ||25|| pūrṇaḥ paro vyūha aiśo’ntaryāmyarcā svarūpakṛt | vibhavaścaityaḥ sunyāsī pāpāpado vyapohatu ||26|| sarvadhāmanivāso yo’nekarūpaḥ pareśvaraḥ | jaḍacetanaśāstā me pāpāpado vyapohatu ||27|| nārāyaṇī śrīpureśī mādhavī puruṣottamī | kārṇīṃ śrīlalitālakṣmīḥ pāpāpado vyapohatu ||28|| bhārgavī duḥkhahālakṣmīḥ śivarājñī ca vaiṣṇavī | padminikā padmajā me pāpāpado vyapohatu ||29|| kaṃbharāśrīrmahālakṣmīrvāsudevī pareśvarī | ākṣarī śrīrbhagavatī pāpāpado vyapohatu ||3.167.30|| pauruṣī prākṛtī devī māyeśī pārvatī prabhā | pārabrāhmī ramā mātā pāpāpado vyapohatu ||3 1 || bhūmnī padmā ca vairājī gaṃgā revā sarasvatī | gāyatrī gomatī gopī pāpāpado vyapohatu |||35|| sādāśaivī ca māheśī brāhmī brahmapriyā satī | sādhvī ca svāminī cāndrī pāpāpado vyapohatu || 33|| hiraṇmayī kānakī ca hariṇī svarṇarūpiṇī | vaikuṇṭhā tūlasī vṛndā pāpāpado vyapohatu ||34|| siddhā paitrī siddhirūpā camatkṛtiḥ sudhainavī | sudhāmṛtā pāśavatī pāpāpado vyapohatu ||35|| prabhā saurī pārṣadānī caiśvarī devatā ratiḥ | prītirbhaktirvratarūpā pāpāpado vyapohatu ||36|| saumyā purātanī divyā santuṣṭā tṛptirabjikā | kamalāmbā śāradā me pāpāpado vyapohatu ||37|| aindrī cānandamātrā ca cicchaktirjñānarūpiṇī | yoginī naiṣṭhikī hṛtsthā pāpāpado vyapohatu ||38|| mohinī nandinī padmekṣaṇorvaśī pativratā | jananī svarṇavarṇā me pāpāpado vyapohatu ||39|| puṇyā ca pāvanī vidyā dhanadā vittadhāriṇī | ārttihābdhisutā śāntā pāpāpado vyapohatu ||3.167.40 || bhāvajñā bhuktimuktyādipradā bhaktābhayaṃkarī | sarvārdhāṃgā jīvanī śrīḥ pāpāpado vyapohatu ||41 || saubhāgyayuktā śobhāḍhyā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā | sarvaśṛṃgāradīptāṃgā pāpāpado vyapohatu ||42|| sasyalakṣmīḥ ratnalakṣmīḥ sampallakṣmīḥ kuṭumbinī | dhānyānnadhāriṇī gaurī pāpāpado vyapohatu |||43|| rohiṇī poṣaṇakartrī kanyakā navayauvanā | rāmayitrī surāmā me pāpāpado vyapohatu ||44|| sattvamayī sattvadātrī sattvadhrā sattvayoginī | sāttvikī saccidānandā pāpāpado vyapohatu ||45|| muktāśca pārṣadā bhaktā bhaktānyaḥ sādhya īśvarāḥ | īśvarāṇyo mahāmuktā vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||46|| śaṃkhaścakraṃ gadā padmaṃ kaustubho mukuṭo hareḥ | vanamālā puṣpamālā vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||47|| yaṣṭiśchatraṃ cāmaraṃ cāṃgadaśca kaṭakastathā | śṛṃkhalā raśanā kārṣṇī vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||48|| guṇaiśvaryāṇi sarvāṇi camatkārāśca siddhayaḥ | śaktayaḥ śrīhareḥ sarvā vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||49|| śālagrāmastathā śālaṃkāyanarṣiśca gaṇḍakī | triveṇī śālavṛkṣaśca vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||3.167.50|| badarī badarīvāsāḥ ṛṣayaśca naro hariḥ | gaṃgā himāśrayo haimā vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ |||51 || śeṣaśāyī kṣīranidhiḥ kṣīrajā śvetabhogirāṭ | nirannamuktabhaktāśca vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ |||52|| brahmā viṣṇuḥ śaṃkaraśca gaṇeśaśca prabhākaraḥ | gaṇā rudrāśca rudrāṇyo vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||53 || siddhā yakṣāśca gandharvāścandrastārāśca taijasāḥ | grahāśca ketavaścāpi vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||54|| haṃso garuḍo vṛṣabhaḥ siṃhaśca hariṇo gajaḥ | śeṣaḥ śikhī ṭivyavāhā vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ |||55|| kārtikeyo mahākālo mahāvajraṃ triśūlakam | kāladaṇḍo hetayaste vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ |||56|| ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvināvīśvareśvarāḥ | dikpālā lokapālāśca vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ |||57|| gaganaṃ sparśanaṃ tejo rasaśca pṛthivī tathā | tanmātrāṇi tathā prāṇā vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||58|| sādhyā viśve marutaśca kinnarā guhyakāstathā | gandharvā kiṃpuruṣakā vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||59|| devānāṃ mātaraścāpi gaṇānāṃ mātarastathā | bhūtānāṃ mātaraḥ sarvā vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||3.167.60 || apsarasastathā devyo rāśayastithayastathā | pakṣā māsā vatsarāśca vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||61 || jvarā rogāśca ṛtavaḥ ṛṇāni rākṣasāstathā | daityāśca dānavā duṣṭā vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||62|| sāgarāḥ saritaḥ kūpāstaḍāgāni ca dīrghikāḥ | vāpyaḥ sarāṃsi varuṇo vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||63|| gāvo yāḥ kāmavarṣiṇyaḥ kalpapūrāśca vallikāḥ | tathā ca kalpataravo vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||64|| yajñā yajñakriyāścāpi vidhayaḥ śratayo’pi ca | ṛcaḥ sāmāni chandāṃsi vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||659|| sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt | sahasrabāhuḥ sarvajño vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||66|| pāvakaḥ pāvano vahniḥ saptārciḥ saptajihvikaḥ | svarṇapitā brahmamukhaṃ pāpāpado vyapohatu ||67|| dānaṃ damo dayā daivaṃ devā devyaśca sādhavaḥ | santaḥ satpuruṣāḥ puṇyā vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||68|| vṛddhā vandyā bhāgavatā bhaktāścaikāntino hareḥ | daivajñā devapuruṣā vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||69|| vratāni puṇyakarmāṇi sukṛtāni prasevanam | sevā śraddhā bhāvanā ca vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||3.167.70 || yogā jñānāni sarvāṇi satyaṃ vairāgyamīśitā | upāsanā harerājñā vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||71 || gṛhadevā grāmadevāḥ kṣetradevāśca sīmagāḥ | dvāradevā bahirdevā vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||72|| vāstudevāḥ śrāddhadevā makhadevā mahotsavāḥ | tīrthāni devavāsāśca vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||73 || devālayā mandirāṇi maṭhāḥ kathāsthalāni ca | muktikṣetrāṇi sarvāṇi vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||74|| mātaraḥ pitaraḥ śreṣṭhā bāndhavāśca satīśriyaḥ | bhaktā bālā bālikāśca vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||75|| prāyaścittāni sarvāṇi darbhāśca devahetayaḥ | havyakavyāni daivāni vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||76|| devarathā devayānā devamārgāśca devatāḥ | ātivāhikadevāśca vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||77|| vidyutaśca ghanā meghā bhūkampā ītayastathā | balihārāśca ye devā vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||78|| nidhayaśca diśāścāpi manavaśca kalāstathā | caturdaśabhavanāni vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||79|| vyāhṛtayaḥ prāṇayamā yāmyāśca dharmavaṃśajāḥ | dharmadevaśca tatpatnyo vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||3.167.80|| kuṇḍamaṇḍapadevāśca dhvajaśākhānivāsinaḥ | samitpātrādidevāśca vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||8 1|| sadguroścaraṇau lakṣmi caraṇāmṛtavāri ca | gurubhuktaprasādaśca vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||82|| satīpatipādavāri sādhucaraṇavāri ca | viṣṇupādodakaṃ puṇyaṃ vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||83|| satāṃ samāgamaḥ sevāśrayaścājñāvacāṃsi ca | prasannatāśīrvādāśca vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||84|| mātṛtīrthaṃ pitṛtīrthaṃ gurutīrthaṃ tathottamam | patitīrthaṃ satītīrthaṃ vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||85|| gotīrthaṃ cāvabhṛthatīrthaṃ paṃktitīrthaṃ ca dakṣiṇam | sanyāsatīrthaṃ mantraśca vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||86|| yajñopavītakaṃ kaṇṭhī taulaseyī samarpaṇam | ātmaniveditākhyaṃ ca vyapohantvaghamāpadaḥ ||87|| yogitvaṃ sādhutā naiṣṭhikatā śrotriyatā tathā | brahmasattā bhaktatā ca pāvayantu hi māṃ sadā ||88 || pāvanī kuṃkumavāpī pāvanaḥ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ | pāvanīśrīḥ pāvayantu māṃ sadā śaraṇāgatam ||89|| dharmo viṣṇuḥ śrīśca bhaktiḥ sevā māṃ pāvayantviha | eṣaḥ samarpitaścāsmi taṃ māṃ bhaktaṃ punantviha |||3.167.90 || evaṃ stuvan named bhūmau lakṣmi pāvanavṛttimān | āpadastasya naśyanti nivartante hyaghāni ca ||91|| vyapohanastavaṃ divyaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādapi | patraṃ puṣpādyarpayeśca śuddho bhavati tatkṣaṇāt ||92|| kanyārthī labhate kanyāṃ jayakāmo jayaṃ labhet | arthakāmo labhedarthaṃ putrakāmaḥ sutān labhet ||93|| vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ bhogārthī bhogamāpnuyāt | sampadarthī sampadaśca rājyārthī rājyamāpnuyāt ||94|| svargārthī svargamādadyānmokṣārthī mokṣamāpnuyāt | duḥkhanāśābhilāṣī ca duḥkhanāśamavāpnuyāt ||95|| patyarthinī patiṃ ramyaṃ dhanārthinī dhanaṃ labhet | sukhārthinī sukhaṃ cāpi saubhāgyaṃ labhate tathā ||96|| yaśo’rthinī yaśaścāpi prādhānyaṃ labhate tathā | yān yānarthayate kāmān sarvānavāpnuyāt stavī ||97|| paṭhyamānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yamuddiśya tu paṭhyate | tasya rogā na bādhante vātapittādisaṃbhavāḥ ||98|| nāmṛtyurbhavettasya na daṃṣṭrāviṣasaṃgamaḥ | nākāladuḥkhavām̐ścāpi bhaved vyapohanastavī ||99|| sarvatīrthaprapuṇyāni yajñapuṇyāni yāni ca | dānavratānāṃ puṇyāni labhed vyapohanastavī || 3.167.10 0|| goghnaḥ kṛtaghno vīrahā brahmahā bālahā tathā | śaraṇāgatahā mitraviśvāsaghātako’pi ca || 101 || mātṛhā pitṛhā nārīhā tathā paśughātakaḥ | vyapohya sarvapāpāni śuddho bhavati saṃstavī || 1 02|| bhaktiṃ kṛtvā sarvapuṇyo yāti mokṣapradaṃ tataḥ | agatikasya gatidaṃ stotraṃ vyapohanaṃ tvidam || 1 03|| lakṣmi stutvānena māṃ tu namet praprārthayettataḥ | dhyātvā brahmamayo bhūtvā mucyate bandhanāditaḥ || 1 04|| etaduccārya bhāvena stotavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate | tasmādāpatprade kāle vyapohanaṃ samuccaret || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sarvāpatpāpabandhanādināśārthakaṃ vyapohanastavanamuktamiti saptaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 167 ||
<3.168> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sarvapāpavināśakam | sarvapuṇyapradaṃ puṇyaṃ makhe kanyāpradānakam || 1 || yajñaṃ kṛtvā bhojayitvā toṣayitvā sato dvijān | bhikṣukān bālikā bālān datvā ca dakṣiṇāvarāḥ || 2 || kanyādānaṃ diśet koṭiyajñapuṇyaṃ labheddhi saḥ | maṇḍape kuṇḍake vahnau juhuyāt pāyasaiḥ phalaiḥ || 3 || miṣṭānnaiśca kaṇādyaiśca samidbhirājyakaiḥ śubhaiḥ | ghṛtānāṃ puṣṭadhārābhistarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ || 4 || tataścāvāhayettatra maṇḍape tu kumārakam | vidvāṃsaṃ ca surūpaṃ ca kīrtimantaṃ suvaṃśajam || 5 || sampannaṃ ca yuvānaṃ ca kanyāmānasamodanam | subhāgyaṃ pūrvavijñātaśīladharmaguṇādikam || 6 || samājasya prakāśe taṃ niṣādya vahnisannidhau | viprāṇo sākṣikārye ca vahneḥ sākṣye ca maṇḍape || 7 || devānāṃ yajñabhoktṝṇāṃ sākṣye kanyāpitā tadā | pūjayed vāripuṣpādyairnāmagotrādi kīrtayet | | 8 || dānārthaṃ pātratāṃ vīkṣya vācayet svastivācanam | dehaśuddhiṃ kārayecca dadyād yajñopavītakam || 9 || mantraṃ pradāpayed yajñe vaiṣṇavaṃ pārameśvaram | tulasīṃ rakṣayet tatra tilakaṃ kārayettataḥ || 3.168.10 || candrakaṃ kārayedakṣatāktakuṃkumacandanaiḥ | puṣpahārān śubhaṃ veṣaṃ dhārayed varaśobhanaḥ || 11 || vibhūṣāścārpayettasmai pādau prapūjayettataḥ | madhuparkaṃ dāpayecca prāśayet suprasādakam || 1 2|| yajñīyaṃ pāyasādyaṃ ca havanaṃ kārayedapi | atha vādyāni ramyāṇi vādayed gāpayettathā || 1 3|| gītikā vedamantrām̐ścoccārayed vaidikairdvijaiḥ | sarvadevān hariṃ lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ narāyaṇīm || 14|| vahniṃ viprānnamaskṛpya pitā kanyāmupasthitām | bhūṣitāṃ bahubhūṣābhiḥ śṛṃgāritāṃ susārakaiḥ || 15|| veṣitāṃ divyavastrādyai rañjitāṃ mānadānakaiḥ | prasāditāṃ vivāhārthaṃ samānītāṃ tu maṇḍape || 16|| prakāśe sarvalokānāṃ sthāpayed varavāmake | vahniṃ named dvijān sādhūnṛṣīn vṛddhān samājakam || 17|| kumāraṃ praṇameccāpi puṣpākṣataiḥ pravardhayet | kuṃkumākṣatacaṃdraṃ ca kuryāt kumārabhālake || 18|| nārāyaṇaḥ prīyatāṃ me gaṇeśaḥ prīyatāmiti | prīyantāṃ devatāḥ sarve vidhīyantāṃ mameṣṭakam || 1 9|| vadedathāsane kanyā niṣadya bhūsurārpitam | jalaṃ dhṛtvā nije haste kuryāt saṃkalpamuttamam ||3.168.20 || ahaṃ kanyā kumāryasmi nārāyaṇasamīpataḥ | devānāṃ sannidhau yajñe tvarpaṇārthamupāgatā ||21 || pitā yasmai pradāsyeta tasyāhaṃ vahnisannidhau | bhaviṣyāmi dharmapatnī nirvighnaṃ me bhavatviha ||22|| ityuktvā tajjalaṃ pṛthvyāṃ vimuñcet sā hi kanyakā | athāsyā janako yadvā bhrātā mātātha bāndhavaḥ ||23|| viproktarītyā hi jalaṃ gṛhṇīyāt svakare tadā | kumārasya kare cāpi jalaṃ dadyād gurustadā ||24|| saṃkalpaṃ kārayeccāpi puṇyāhaṃ vācayettathā | kanyādātṛtvādhikāraṃ khyāpayejjalasākṣikam ||246|| kumārasya dānagrahaṇārhatāṃ vācayettadā | eṣo’haṃ cāmukagotranāmādirmaṇḍape makhe ||26|| kanyādānaṃ grahīṣyāmi dharmārthaṃ vahnisākṣikam | iti saṃkalpya ca jalaṃ kumāraḥ prakṣipet kṣitau ||27||| rakṣiṣyāmi mama patnīṃ kanyāmājīvanaṃ tvimām | sahadharmān cariṣyāmi nārāyaṇasya sākṣike || 28||| ityuccārādyuttaraṃ ca pitā saṃkalpamuccaret | kanyādānaṃ dadāmyasmai kumārāya varāya ha ||29|| amukagotranāmne vai devavahnyādisākṣiṇā | datteyaṃ mama kanyāsya patnīrūpā prajāyatām ||3.168.30 || ityuktvā kanyakādvārā varamālāṃ varasya vai | kaṇṭhe cārpayya ca namaḥ kārayet kanyakākaram ||3 1 || vāmaṃ pradāpayed dakṣe haste varasya śobhane | kāmaphalena saṃśobhe saṃśobhaṃ kanyakārpayet ||32|| eṣāhaṃ bhavataḥ patnītyevaṃ saṃkalpayet hṛdi | eṣo’haṃ ca bhavatyāstu patiśceti varo vadet ||33|| puṣpaiḥ saṃvardhayeyuśca maṇḍapasthā dvijādayaḥ | varo mālāṃ kanyakāyāḥ kaṇṭhe dadyānnijasthitām ||34|| ubhau samālau cotthāya vastragranthiyutau tadā | vahniṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya caturvāraṃ nijāsane ||35|| sthitvā kṛtvā praṇāmādīn niṣadya havanaṃ tataḥ | prakuryātāṃ ghṛtādyaiśca pitā dadyād dhanādikam ||36|| svarṇaṃ vastrāṇi bhavanaṃ yānaṃ vāhanamuttamam | anye dadyuśca dānāni yautakāni śubhāni ca ||37|| evaṃ yajñe nijakanyādānaṃ daivavivāhanam | devānāṃ sākṣikatve vai śreṣṭhamuttamamuttamam ||38|| peṭikādipradānena svargadānaphalaṃ bhavet | atra droṇīpradānena haṇḍadānena vā tathā ||39|| gagarīsampradānena brahmāṇḍadānajaṃ phalam | gobhūdhānyahiraṇyādipradānenādhvare tadā ||3.168.40|| dampatībhyāṃ phalaṃ pṛthvīmerudānādijaṃ bhavet | hemaśṛṃgī khurai rūpyairdivyavastreṇa saṃyutā ||41 || sakāṃsyapātrā dātavyā kṣīriṇī gauḥ savatsikā | sadakṣiṇā pradātavyā golokadānajaṃ phalam |||42|| yāvad vatsasya pādāḍhyamukhaṃ yonyāṃ pradṛśyate | tāvadgauḥ pṛthivī jñeyā dātā sāmrājyamāpnuyāt ||43|| śrāntasaṃvāhanaṃ rogiparicaryā surārcanam | pitrarcanaṃ vṛddhapūjā satsevā patisevanam ||44|| satīpūjā tathā devālayasya mārjanādikam | ucchiṣṭabhvādipātrādimārjanaṃ sādhuyoginām ||45|| viprāṇāṃ toṣaṇaṃ ceti sarvaṃ tad gopradānavat | pāpaghnaṃ puṇyadaṃ svargapradaṃ mokṣapradaṃ tathā ||46|| sādhave svamabhīṣṭantu datvā mokṣamavāpnuyāt | dvijāya svamabhīṣṭantu datvā svargamavāpnuyāt ||47|| dampatībhyāṃ pradānena svargamokṣāvavāpnuyāt | bhūdīpām̐ścānnavastrāṇi sarpirdatvā vrajecchriyam ||48|| gṛhadhānyacchatramālyavṛkṣayānaghṛtāni ca | jalaṃ śayyāmanulepaṃ datvā svargamavāpnuyāt ||49|| brahmadātā brahmalokaṃ prāpnoti suradurlabham | vedārthayajñaśāstrāṇi dharmaśāstrāṇi yāni ca ||3.168.50|| saṃhitāśca tathā datvā brahmalokamavāpnuyāt | samartho yo na gṛhṇīyād dātṛlokānavāpnuyāt ||51 || ayācitāgataṃ grāhyaṃ hyapi duṣkṛtakarmaṇām | kuśāḥ śākaṃ payaścājyaṃ dadhi vāri ca pāvanam |||52 || vastraṃ tailaṃ candanaṃ ca kuṃkumaṃ cāmbarādikam | ayācitāhṛtaṃ prāptaṃ grāhyaṃ nārāyaṇecchayā ||53 || nārāyaṇīcchayā prāptaṃ grāhyaṃ satā vipaścitā | asaṃgena virāgeṇa grāhyaṃ deyaṃ tathāpare ||54|| dampatībhyāṃ tathā yajñe dattaṃ svalpamapi dhruvam | akṣayaṃ cānantaphalaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |||95 || yajñe dattā tu yā kanyā lakṣmīrūpā prajāyate | nārāyaṇasvarūpo’pi grahītā sa varo mataḥ ||||56|| ācyute’dhvarabhavane kṣetre tu pāvane tadā | dānaṃ devādisākṣye vai jāyate cācyutaṃ hi tat ||57|| evaṃ dānaṃ pradātavyaṃ daivo vivāha eva saḥ | sarvapāpāni naśyanti sarvapuṇyodayo bhavet ||58 || etādṛśaṃ paraṃ dānaṃ bhūloke naiva vidyate | śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā cānyat kṛtapāpavināśanam ||59|| kṛtānāṃ karmaṇāṃ kṛṣṇe’rpaṇaṃ pāpavināśakam | arpaṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ proktaṃ bhogāya naiva jāyate || 3.168.60 || doṣān vā saṃvaded vipre gurau deve ca rājani | kṣamāṃ yāceta natvaiva dakṣiṇaṃ śravaṇaṃ spṛśet ||61 || punaścādoṣatāsthityai dadyācca vacanaṃ tathā | evaṃ kṛte’pi doṣāṇāṃ daṇḍastasya na vidyate || 62 || devārthe prāṇasahitaṃ dadyāt sarvasvameva yaḥ | tasya naśyanti karmāṇi hyapi cogrāṇi karmaje || 63 || athānyatte pravakṣyāmi sannyāsagrahaṇaṃ śubham | kālamāyāpāpakarmayāmyabhayādināśakam ||94|| kṛtvā makhaṃ tu gṛhṇīyāt sannyāsaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ param | ātmani veditāṃ labdhvā sarvāghāni vyapohati || 65 || karmasanyāsamāsādya pāpānyapi vyapohati | sādhutīrthaṃ prasevyāpi sarvapāpāni mārjayet || 66 || athānyatte pravakṣyāmi vināyakopasarjanan | duṣṭātiduṣṭaduḥkhānāṃ nivārakaṃ sukhapradam || 67 || svapne’vagāhate’tyarthaṃ jalaṃ muṇḍām̐śca paśyati | viphalāraṃbhaṇaṃ cāpi saṃsīdatyanimittataḥ || 68 || rājā rājyaṃ tu nāpnoti kumārī ca patiṃ tathā | gurviṇī nāpnoti putraṃ kaṣṭe tvevamupasthite || 69 || vidhipūrvaṃ prage puṇye kṣaṇe snapanamācaret | gaurasarṣapagandhājyairudvartanottaraṃ śiraḥ ||3.168.70 || sarvauṣadhaiḥ sarvagandhairvilipet svasti vācayet | hradāccaturbhiḥ kalaśairāhṛteṣu jaleṣu tu ||71 || mṛttikāṃ rocanāṃ gandhān guggulaṃ nyasya tajjalaiḥ | bhadrāsane snāpayecca svapnavantaṃ hi dehinam ||72|| indramṛṣayo’snāpayam̐ścāmocayan purā hyaghāt | tathā tvāmabhisiñcāmaḥ pāvamānyaḥ punantu tvām ||73 || bhagavān varuṇo rājā bhagaṃ sūryo bṛhaspatiḥ | bhagamindraśca vāyuśca bhagaṃ saptarṣayo daduḥ ||74|| yatte keśeṣu daurbhāgyaṃ sīmante yacca mūrdhani | lalāṭe karṇayorakṣṇornāśaṃ tadyātu te sadā ||75|| snātasya sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ śravaṇe mastake’rpayet | sājyān kuśān parigṛhya juhuyācchāladuṇḍakaiḥ ||76|| kuṣmāṇḍaṃ rājaputrām̐śca svāhāsamanvitām̐stathā | dadyāccatuṣpathe bhūmau kuśānāstīrya sarvaśaḥ ||77|| taṇḍulaudanamapakvaṃ puṣpaṃ citraṃ sugandhavat | surāmannaṃ pāyasaṃ
