ca ghṛtaṃ dadhi guḍaudanam ||78|| bhūmau datvā śivaṃ natvā bhojayedambikāṃ satīm | dūrvāsarṣapapuṣpaiśca svasti saṃprārthayet satīm ||79|| rūpaṃ dehi yaśo dehi bhāgyaṃ dehi subhāgyade | putrān śriyaṃ sarvakāmān dehi me vighnamuktatām ||3.168.80|| viprān sādhūn toṣayecca dānabhojanacandanaiḥ | guruṃ grahān pūjayeccārpayellakṣmīṃ narāyaṇam ||8 1 || yadvā lakṣmi duḥkhamūrti kṛtvā dukhaṃ prapūjayet | kṛśaṃ paṅguṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ puṣṭahastaṃ śucānvitam ||82|| nimnanetraṃ cāndhatulyaṃ kṣudhitaṃ dhamanisphuṭam | śvetakeśaṃ ca kadrūpaṃ cintāyutaṃ malānvitam ||83 || adharmaputra kaṣṭa tvaṃ dūraṃ yāhi prapūjitaḥ | baliṃ labdhvā kṛsarānnaṃ piṇyākaṃ ca sukhī bhava ||84|| evaṃ prapūjya puṣpādyaiḥ kṛṣṇavastrayutaṃ tataḥ | visarjayennadīvārau nārāyaṇapade’thavā ||85 || visarjitaḥ pūjitaḥ sa duḥkhadevaḥ prayāti vai | evaṃ lakṣmi pāpadevaḥ pūjanīyaḥ sukhārthibhiḥ ||86 || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ puṣṭapādo lambahastastamo’kṣimān | kṛṣṇānano bhayavyāptaḥ krūrakarmā sahiṃsakaḥ ||87|| kṛṣṇapuṣpaiḥ kajjalaiśca pūjayitvārpayet balim | māṣādikaṃ pāyasādi visarjayettato vane ||88|| evaṃ kṛte prayātyeva dūre vai pāpapūruṣaḥ | evaṃ lakṣmi pūjayecca sukhaṃ devaṃ sukhena vai ||89 || prasannavadanaṃ saumyaṃ puṣṭaṃ śvetaṃ subhūṣaṇam | svarṇāmbaraṃ samastāṃgakṛtaśobhaṃ suyauvanam ||3.168.90|| sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ puṣpākṣatādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ | pāyasaṃ cāpi miṣṭānnaṃ phalādi cārthayed balim ||91 || dharmayutaṃ bhaktiyutaṃ śīlavratādisaṃyutam | pūjayitvā śubhe puṇye mandire cālaye tathā ||12||| jale visarjayed bhaktyā samprārthya ca praṇamya ca | sarvātman sarvalokānāṃ mahānandaprada prabho ||93|| tava vāsena me nityamahānandaḥ prajāyate | avimukto mama nityaṃ bhava vāsaṃ sadā kuru || 94|| tava dṛṣṭyāpi lokeśā bhavanti ceśvarā divi | pṛthvyā te kṛpayā deva sukhinaḥ santi mānavāḥ ||95|| tenāhaṃ ca sukhī syāṃ vai prasanno varado bhava | ityabhyarthya sukhaṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā praṇamya ca ||96|| visarjayejjalamadhye pūjakaḥ sukhavān bhavet | naro nārī ca vā nānyataro’pi coktarītitaḥ ||97|| pūjayitvā labhellakṣmīṃ sampadaṃ dhanamuttamam | putraṃ paśuṃ kṣitiṃ nārīṃ vaṃśavistāramityapi ||98|| aduḥkhaṃ labhate nityaṃ mahotsavān prapadyate | atraloke bhaveccāpi mahāsmṛddhaḥ paratra ca ||99|| mahābhogān prasampādya mokṣalokaṃ prayāti saḥ | na tasya jāyate hāniścākasmātto na jāyate ||3.168.1 0 0|| pīḍā cākasmikī cāpi dāridryaṃ naiva jāyate | nityaṃ sampat sukhaṃ sarvaṃ vardhate bhoga uttamaḥ || 101 || paṭhanācchravaṇādasya pūjanasya phalaṃ bhavet | sukhavān dhanavān syācca dātā bhavet punaḥ punaḥ || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne yajñe kanyādānaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ sannyāsagrahaṇaṃ vināyakopasarjanam pāpaduḥkhasukhapuruṣaprapūjanaṃ ceti mahāphalapradamityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 168 ||
<3.169> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca kathaṃ nityā api jīvā jñānavanto’pi dehinaḥ | jānanto’pi mṛtyupadaṃ prayānti kāraṇaṃ vada || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca sarvaṃ jihmaṃ mṛtyupadaṃ jihmā mṛtyuṃ prayānti hi | kuṭilāṃ vṛttiṃ kurvanti kāmādyāste hi mārakāḥ || 2 || ta eva nijadehasthāḥ śatravo ghātakāḥ sadā | taddhīnānāṃ na vai mṛtyuryogināṃ ca satāṃ rame || 3 || mṛtyurvai narakaḥ proktaḥ sa ca janmādinirmitaḥ | janma karmabalāt prāptaṃ karma vāsanayārjitam || 4 || sā cennirdahyate śāntyā damena sevayā satām | harerbhaktyā kṣālayeccātmānaṃ viśadatāṃ diśet || 5 || tato mṛtyuḥ kaṣṭarūpo maraṇākhyo na jāyate | divyabhāvamupāyāto yāti brahma sanātanam || 6 || ciraṃjīvo bhavatyeva śāśvataiśvaryavān bhavet | mṛtyuśīlā dhātavo’sya divyā bhavanti madbalāt || 7 || pramādaścāpi mohaśca vinaśyato’sya sarvathā | tāveva mṛpyurūpau hi nāsyāviśato vai kvacit || 8 || māyāhīnasya bhaktasya mama yoge sthitasya ca | māyā divyā jāyate’pi bandhanādivivarjitā || 9 || tato’sau nityamuktātmā brahmaṇyeva pravartate | evaṃ lakṣmi bhavatyeva tvaṃ yathā cābdhijā hyapi || 3.169.1 0|| vartase mama yogena divyā māyāvivarjitā | nityā susamasaṃsthānā vṛddhihāsavivarjitā || 1 1|| yathāhaṃ ca tathā tvaṃ vai tathā bhakto bhavatyapi | madicchā tādṛśī lakṣmī tayā tathaiva jāyate || 12|| ātmanastu purāhaṃkāreṇa yuddhamavartata | ahaṃkāreṇa deho’yaṃ nijarājyātmakaḥ kṛtaḥ || 13|| sugandhaśca hṛtastena sarvo’pi nijarājyajaḥ | durgandhaścāvaśiṣṭaśca mṛtyudo duḥkhado garaḥ || 14|| cidātmā vīkṣya duṣkṛtyaṃ jñānanāśātmakaṃ hyapi | anātmyācaraṇaṃ vīkṣya śastraṃ vivekamādadhe ||15|| ahaṃkārasya duṣṭasyāvāsṛjanmṛtyudasya tat | vadhyamāno’pyahaṃkāraḥ śastreṇa cātiveginā || 1 6|| viveśa pṛthivīṃ tyaktvā jalabhāgaṃ nirāmayam | surasaśca hṛtastena sarvo’pi nijarājyajaḥ || 17|| druṣṭaraso’vaśiṣṭaśca mṛtyudo duḥkhado garaḥ | ātmā śastraṃ punastasyāvāsṛjad vadhahetave || 18|| vadhyamāno viveśāhaṃkāro jyotiḥpradeśakam | tatra rūpaṃ surūpaṃ ca jagrāha nijarājyagam ||1 9|| kurūpaṃ cāvaśiṣṭaṃ ca cidātmā punareva ca | tīkṣṇaṃ śastraṃ vivekākhyamasya cāvāsṛjattataḥ ||3.169.20|| tāḍyamāno’pyahaṃkāro viveśa vāyubhūstaram | tatra sparśaṃ suṣṭusaṃjñaṃ jagrāha nijarājyagam ||21|| kusparśaścāvaśiṣṭo vai taṃ vilokya punastathā | śastraṃ cāvāsṛjattasya vināśārthamathāpi saḥ |||22|| ahaṃkāro’viśad vyoma śabdaṃ jagrāha tadgatam | kuśabdaścāvaśiṣṭaśca vīkṣya taṃ tu punastathā ||23|| cidātmā śastramāgṛhya mārayāmāsa yāvatā | ahaṃkāro viveśāpi cidātmani nirāśritaḥ ||24|| cidātmā ca gururbhūtvopādideśāpyahaṃkṛtim | ahaṃ brahmasvarūpo’smītyahaṃkāro’pi tad dadhau ||25|| tato brahmasvarūpasyābhimatyā brahmatāṃ yayau | māyiko’pi gurorvākyādupāstyā brahmatāṃ yayau || 26|| cidātmā taṃ vivekena jaghānāpi na vai hatim | yayau cātmasthitastasmājjāto mṛtyuvivarjitaḥ ||27|| svasvabhāvaṃ parityajya cidātmarūpatāṃ gataḥ | avadhyabhāvamāsādya divyāhaṃbhāvamāśritaḥ ||28|| buddhiṃ divyāṃ samāśritya paramātmānamāptavān | avadhyaḥ sa sadā jāto divyabuddhyātmasaṃsthitaḥ ||29|| parameśa parābhaktyā muktabhāvamupāgataḥ | muktānāṃ divyatattvānāṃ vyāghāto naiva jāyate ||3.169.30|| evaṃ lakṣmi vināśo vai mṛtyorbhavati cārpaṇāt | ātmārpaṇaṃ samastānāmindriyāṇāṃ ca karmaṇām || 31 || vṛttīnāṃ cātmanā sākaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ hi nirguṇam | nirguṇe mayi nāstyeva mṛtyurlokābhiduḥkhadaḥ ||32|| vyādhayo dvividhā lakṣmi śārīrā mānasāstathā | teṣāṃ parasparaṃ janma parasparamapekṣiṇām ||33||| vātapittakaphānāṃ tu vaiṣamye dehajā hi te | avaiṣamye svasthabhāvaścārogyaṃ gīyate hi tat ||34|| oṣadhena yathāmṛdyaṃ mṛdyate tadvirodhinā | uṣṇena mṛdyate śītaṃ śītenoṣṇyaṃ ca mṛdyate ||35|| mānase’pi tathā doṣe mṛdustīkṣṇena mṛdyate | harṣeṇa bādhyate śoko harṣaḥ śokena bādhyate ||36|| sattvarajastamasāṃ cet sāmyaṃ svāsthyaṃ tadātmanaḥ | vaiṣamyaṃ vyādhirevāyaṃ tatra mardanamiṣyate ||37|| duḥkhavān yatate saukhye sukhī duḥkhaṃ smaratyapi | guṇajau tāvubhau bhāvau mānasau na tu cātmanaḥ ||38|| tathāpi vegamāsādya vahate tatpravāhaṇe | saṃgaṃ ca labhate dehī manute mānasānnije ||39|| yadi cellabhate prajñāṃ purāṇīṃ sadgurormukhāt | saccidānandabhāvāṃ svāṃ mano nāśaṃ tadecchati ||3.169.40|| yatate tadvināśārthaṃ prajñāśastreṇa cātmanaḥ | ātmā yoddhā svayaṃ syācca brahmarathe niṣadya vai ||41 || pārabrahmapadaṃ lakṣmi tadā cātmā vijeṣyati | bāhyaṃ sarvopakaraṇaṃ vaiśyaṃ dravyaṃ samutsṛjet |||082|| asaṃgaścāparigrahastataḥ siddhiṃ pralapsyate | mameti jāyate yāvanmṛtyustāvadupasthitaḥ ||43|| na mameti yadā bhāvo mṛtyustasya gato mṛtim | so’haṃ brahmeti tasyaiva śāśvataṃ samprakāśate ||44|| etādṛśasya tu vivekino lakṣmi hyasīmakam | brahmāṇḍarājyamasyāsti jaṃgamasthāvarātmakam ||45|| tathāpi nāsya mamatā mṛtyustaṃ kiṃ kariṣyati | mṛtyumūrdhapadaṃ kṛtvā sa yātā brahma śāśvatam ||46|| kāmaṃ vai vasato lakṣmi vane vanyena jīvataḥ | mamatāmatyajatastu mṛtyuḥ keśeṣu tiṣṭhati ||47|| bāhyāntarāṇāṃ mamatāṃ māyāṃ vīkṣyāntarātmanā | antarbrahmasvarūpeṇa sthāturmuktirmahābhayāt ||48|| sarvāḥ pravṛttayo loke kāmodbhāvyā bhavanti tāḥ | vicāryākāmago bhūtvā yadi saṃharate manaḥ ||49|| kāraṇasyaiva saṃhārād bhūyo’bhyāsabalaidhitaḥ | māyāpravāhamuttīrya yāti brahmasanātanam ||3.169.50|| sāramārgaṃ pralambeta dānaṃ vrataṃ tapo makham | sāramapi hyasāraṃ cākāmaṃ kṛtvānusañcaret ||5 1 || haryarpaṇaṃ mahāsāraṃ kṛtvā yadvānusañcaret | sarvaṃ tasyottaraṇāya bhaveduta sahāyakṛt ||52|| nigraho mokṣabījaṃ vai pragraho bhavabījakam | śṛṇu lakṣmi purāgāthāṃ vṛttāṃ jīvātmano yathā ||53|| ātmā sukhī svayaṃ pārśvasthitaṃ papraccha caikadā | abhimānaṃ sukhe vighnakartāraṃ balinaṃ muhuḥ ||54|| kathaṃ kena vināśaste yadi satyavrato bhavān | vad me yena prayate tvannāśe sukhavānaham ||55|| tadāhaṃkārapuruṣaḥ śmaśrubalaṃ pradarśayan | saroṣaṃ dehinaṃ prāha śṛṇu satyaṃ vadāmi tat ||56|| na kaścinmama nāśaṃ vai kartumatra bhavotthitaḥ | ṛte nārāyaṇaṃ yadvā mahābhāgavataṃ janam ||57|| nāhaṃ śakyaḥ saṃgavatā hantu bhūtena kenacit | yadbalena hanyate tadbalaṃ praharaṇaṃ ca vā |||58|| na māṃ hantuṃ samarthaṃ vai yāvattvena bhavatyuta | bījapuṣṭikaraṃ syād yat punaḥ prādurbhavāmyaham |||59||| yajñādyairdakṣiṇāḍhyairmāṃ hantu prayatate yadi | dharmecchāsya mama puṣṭistayā prādurbhavāmyaham ||3.169.60|| japena cāpi maunena māṃ hantuṃ yatate yadi | sāhaṃbhāvo’tra puṣṭirme tayā prādurbhavāmyaham ||61 || vedāntairjñānamārgairvā māṃ hantuṃ yatate yadi | mayā hatetyahaṃpuṣṭistayā prādurbhavāmyaham ||62|| sannyāsena virāgeṇa māṃ hantuṃ yatate yadi | pramādo’nyatra puṣṭirme tayā prādurbhavāmyaham ||63|| pramādino bahiścittāḥ piśunāḥ kalahotsukāḥ | sannyāsino’pi vartante devasandūṣitāśayāḥ ||64|| dhṛtyā brahmavratenāpi māṃ hantuṃ yatate yadi | jayābhimānabījākhyapuṣṭyā punarbhavāmyaham ||65|| tapasaiśvaryalabdhyā māṃ prahantuṃ yatate yadi | madhumatyādibhiścamatkṛtibhiryāṃgasiddhibhiḥ ||66|| bījātmikābhiratyarthapuṣṭyā punarbhavāmyaham | mokṣārthaṃ sādhanaiścāpi māṃ hantuṃ yatate yadi ||67|| tamajñaṃ sādhanatuṣṭaṃ nṛtyāmi ca hasāmi ca | evaṃvidhābhilaṣiṇāmavadhyo’haṃ sanātanaḥ ||68|| mamatvaṃ viparīte vā sveṣṭe manāg bhaved yadi | tatrāhaṃ jīvanaṃ labdhvā bhavāmi bhavabandhakṛt ||69|| mamatā manaso bhāvo manonāśe vinaśyati | kācabhāve kṣiterdoṣā vinaśyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||3.169.70|| tathāpi bhagnatābhāvaḥ kācasyāpi na naśyati | tathātmano mamatātmā bhāvo’ntato na naśyati ||71 || pralayaṃ tu samāsādya pṛthvī jale vilīyate | evaṃkrameṇa tattvānāṃ mahattattve layo bhavet| ||72|| manasaśca laye māyālaye jīvatvarodhane | ātmatvabhāsane mṛtyurmama syādapunarbhavaḥ ||73|| ātmāvabhāsaḥ sahasā parameśakṛpāvaśaḥ | tadarpaṇena sarvasya mama nāśo yato mataḥ ||74|| evamuktaḥ purā cātmābhimānena garīyasā | so’yaṃ lakṣmi yatetaiva parameśe mayi dhruve ||75|| sarvārpaṇādibhāvena tadāhantā vinaśyati | mamatā līyate cāpi patitā paramātmani ||76|| lavaṇasya yathā pāte samudre līnatā sadā | na praroho bhavet kvāpi tathā kṛṣṇo’sya nāṃkuram ||77|| jñātvaivaṃ yatate sādhuḥ sarvātmārpaṇamuttamam | dehendriyamanaḥprāṇāhaṃkāramahatāmapi ||78 || sattvarajastamasāṃ ca saccidānandadharmaṇām | astitvasyārpaṇaṃ cāpi sarvārpaṇaṃ karoti hi ||79|| mayyarpaṇena bhaktānāṃ sarvaṃ madyogataḥ kila | matsvarūpaṃ bhavatyeva na tadbandhāya jāyate ||3.169.80 || śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi mama bhaktasya vai kathām | bhakto nāmnā sādhubhāvāyanaścātra sarastaṭe ||81 || saṃkucya vṛttīḥ sarvāstu samādhau saṃsthito’bhavat | tāvattasya samīpastho’haṃkārapuruṣo’bhavat ||82|| vikarālaścograrūpaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇo’tipuṣṭimān | hasannuvāca taṃ sādhubhāvāyanaṃ hṛdantare ||835|| kastvaṃ kasmādito māṃ vai niṣkāsayasi madgṛhāt | vrate cāhamahaṃkāro puṇyaviṣayasaṃsthitaḥ ||84|| dāne cāhamahaṃkāraḥ svargadharmavyavasthitaḥ | yajñe cāhamahaṃkāraḥ kartṛvṛttivyavasthitaḥ ||85|| dakṣiṇāviṣayaścāpi yajamānatvasaṃsthitaḥ | tīrthe cāhamahaṃkāraḥ pāvitryaviṣayasthitaḥ ||86|| sevāyāmapyahaṃkāraḥ karomītyeva saṃsthitaḥ | jape cāhamahaṃkāro’ghanāśavṛttimāsthitaḥ ||87|| brahmacarye’pyahaṃkāro vratī cāhamitisthitaḥ | vidyāyāmapyahaṃkāro vidvāniti vyavasthitaḥ ||88 || vairāgye cāpyahaṃkāro hyadoṣo’hamiti sthitaḥ | sannyāse cāpyahaṃkāraḥ saṃsārakṣapaṇo nvaham ||89|| dhyāne cāpi hyahaṃbhāvo dhyātāhaṃ yogavānaham | samādhāvapyahaṃkāraścaiśvaro’haṃ vimāyikaḥ ||3.169.90|| evaṃ me vigame caike’pare pakṣe tu jīvanam | vartate ceti tasmānna mṛto bhavāmi karhicit ||9 1 || ekenārpaṇabhāvena gacchāmi cārpite śraye | puṇyaṃ karma phalaṃ bhaktiścātmā vṛttiśca mānasam ||92|| arpitāni matiścāhaṃ yadi śrīparamātmani | tadā sarve pragacchāmo’rpaṇāśraye śubhāśraye ||93|| arpitāraṃ vihāyaiva gacchāmo dānakarmaṇā | tasmāt sādho’rpaya buddhiṃ māyāṃ triguṇaśobhanām ||94|| avidyāṃ ca tathā vidyāṃ mahattattvaṃ vṛṣāśrayam | dharmādikān sarvabhāvān mānasaṃ cāpi dharmavat ||95|| indriyāṇi samastāni devatā vṛttīrantaram | bāhyaṃ ca karaṇaṃ sarvaṃ tanmātrāṇi ca gocarān ||96|| viṣayān pañcabhūtāni bhautikāni gṛhāṇi ca | golakān tatphalaṃ cāpi guṇān karmāṇi yāni ca ||97|| sarvāṇi ceṣaṇāḥ sarvā vāsanāścāpi bhāvanāḥ | sambandhām̐śca tathā sarvasaṃskārānapi cārpaya ||98|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe bhaktyārpaṇaṃ kuru | tadāhaṃ svakuṭumbena yuto yāsyāmi nānyathā ||99|| śrutvaivaṃ sahasā mitraṃ matvotthāya samādhitaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe mayi samarpaṇam || 3.169.100 || sarvasya karmakāṇḍasyākarot sādhubhavāyanaḥ | madbhāḥva sarvathā bhūtvārpayaccātmaniveditām || 101 || evaṃ yogasamādhyādīṃstyaktvā śrīpauruṣottamīm | sevātmikāṃ kriyāṃ sarvāṃ nārāyaṇe samārpayat ||1 02|| abhimānastadā tasya vilīnaḥ paramātmani | nityamukto’bhavat so’pi madātmākṣaravāsakṛt || 1 03|| evaṃ sarvārpaṇaṃ lakṣmi sādhanaṃ duḥkhanāśanam | mokṣasya sādhanaṃ caitanmamārpaṇaṃ samastataḥ || 1 04|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya nirmamatvaṃ prajāyate | anādimuktatā cāpi jāyate vartanāttathā || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mṛtyupradakāraṇāni tadvināśasādhanaṃ sādhubhāvāya narṣidṛṣṭāntenābhimānasya kṛṣṇārpaṇavidhayānāśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 169 ||
<3.170> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca muktidharmān kṛṣṇakānta mohacchedanakārakān | jīvānāmanukampārthaṃ vadatrā sarvasammatān || 1 || śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sarvasakhīsamanvitā | siddhidān muktidān dharmān vakṣyāmi hitakāriṇaḥ || 2 || akṣaraṃ paramaṃ vyoma saccidānandalakṣaṇam | muktisthānaṃ paradhāma mamāsti lakṣmi vetsi tat || 3 || mayā śrīkṛṣṇarūpeṇa golokaḥ sevyate sadā | rādhādigopikāvṛndaiḥ sevitena nijātmanā || 4 || prathamaṃ paramaṃdhāma dvitīyaṃ cākṣaraṃ padam | golokastṛtīyaṃ dhāma muktisthānaṃ mamāsti tat || 5 || vaikuṇṭhe tu caturthe vai nārāyaṇo vasāmyaham | lakṣmyādibhiḥ pārṣadādyaiḥ sevitaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 6 || pañcame vāsudevo’haṃ saṃkarṣaṇādibhiḥ saha | vasāmyavyākṛte dhāmni muktisthāne sadā priye || 7 || ṣaṣṭhe’mṛtākhye loke’haṃ bhūmā nāmnā vasāmi ca | īśvarāṇāṃ nyāyakartā mahārājādhirājakaḥ || 8 || saptame śrīpuradhāmni vasāmi lalitāpatiḥ | mahālakṣmīpūjito’haṃ mahāviṣṇusvarūpadhṛk || 9 || yeyaṃ śrīkambharālakṣmīrgopālakṛṣṇasaṃyutā | bhūtale vartate cādya mātā me bhāgyaśālinī || 3.170.10 || aṣṭame prākṛte dhāmni māyāmaye tu pauruṣe | nivasāmi patiścāhaṃ prakṛteḥ puruṣātmakaḥ || 11 || mahāpuruṣarūpasya muktisthānaṃ hi tattathā | sādāśaivaṃ navamaṃ ca nityakailāsanāmakam || 12|| vaiṣṇavaṃ daśamaṃ dhāma śrīviṣṇurūpasevitam | vairājaṃ dhāma vai caikādaśaṃ tvīśvarakoṭikam || 1 3|| dvādaśaṃ mātsyamevāpi kaurmaṃ trayodaśaṃ tathā | caturdaśaṃ tu vārāhaṃ paścadaśaṃ tu kāpilam ||14|| ṣoḍaśaṃ cāpi hāreyaṃ vāsudevīyakaṃ tataḥ | aṣṭādaśaṃ tu pārthaṃ vai dāttātreyaṃ tataḥ param || 15|| viṃśaṃ haṃsāśritaṃ dhāmaikaviṃśaṃ nārasiṃhakam | ārṣabhaṃ dvāviṃśakaṃ ca trayoviṃśaṃ tu vāmanam || 16|| caturviṃśaṃ parśurāmāśrayaṃ yājñaṃ tataḥ param | rāmadhāma tataścāpi saptaviṃśaṃ kumāravat || 17|| aṣṭāviṃśaṃ hāyagrīvaṃ nāradaṃ tu tataḥ param | triṃśaṃ tu rājarājāḍhyaṃ vyāsasya tvekatriṃśakam || 18|| bauddhaṃ dvātriṃśakaṃ trayastriṃśaṃ tu mohinīśritam | nāpuṃsakaṃ catustriṃśaṃ tathāsaṃkhyāni cākṣare || 1 9|| akṣarasya pradeśeṣu sīmasvetāni santi vai | bahūni me svarūpāṇi cāvatārāstathā rame ||3.170.20|| anantāśca tato dhāmānyapyanantāni santi me | bhaktānāṃ bhāvanāpūrtyai kṛtāni tāni tattathā || 21 || muktisthānāni sarvāṇi yathābhakti yathāsthiti | prāpyante mānavaistānyupāsanābalibhiḥ priye ||22| evamanyāni loke’tra bhavanti ca bahūnyapi | jalāvaraṇavaikuṇṭhaṃ satyaṃ dhāmāpi vedhasaḥ || 23|| badaryāśramamevāpi naranārāyaṇasya me | tataḥsthānaṃ śubhaṃ muktipradaṃ laukikamuktidam ||24|| śvetadvīpābhidhaṃ dhāma nirannamuktasevitam | śeṣe yatrāhamevāsse lakṣmīrevādisevitaḥ || 25|| cāndraṃ sthānaṃ tathā sauraṃ sthānaṃ me yatra rājate | mūrtirhiraṇmayī divyā vahnau cāpi tathā sthitā ||26|| kauberaṃ cāpi yāmyaṃ ca mārutamaindramityapi | aiśānaṃ cāpi kailāsaṃ śaivaṃ ca vāruṇaṃ jale ||27|| merau sthānānyasaṃkhyāni muktitulyasukhāni vai | pātāleṣu tathā santi sthānāni sukhadānyapi ||28|| aihikamuktiyogyāni bhavanti tāni padmaje | sāntāni tāni sarvāṇi brahmāṇḍasthāni yāni vai ||29|| cirasthasukhadānyeva muktitulyāni santi hi | aiśvarāṇyapi dhāmāni sāntāni pralaye khalu ||3.170.30 || prākṛtāni samastāni nāśayogyāni tāni hi | ciramuktipraśastāni bhavanti mama vāñcchayā ||31 || vinākṣarapadaṃ lakṣmi bṛhaddhāma vināpare | lokāḥ sthānāni divyāni kāśante’ntarbhavanti ca ||32|| parabrahmasvarūpo’haṃ yadā bhavāmi yogavān | rādhāyukto ramāyuktastadā dhāmāni matkṛte ||33|| sarvāṇyāvirbhavantyeva brahmato’kṣaradhāmani | brahmātmakāni sarvāṇi brahmāntāni hi padmaje ||34|| kvaciccākṣaradhāmāpi mayi sarvaṃ vilīyate | paradhāmasthite’nādiparabrahmaṇi svāmini ||35|| paradhāma sadā me’sti yato’kṣarādayo muhuḥ | āvirbhavanti kāśante muktānāṃ koṭayo’pi ca ||36|| mamāśritāśca vā ye tu mamāvatāramāśritāḥ | mameśvarānāśritā vā mama mūrtimupāśritāḥ ||37|| mamāṃśānāśritā ye vā madvibhūtimupāśritāḥ | matsādhūnāśritā ye vā macchaktiṃ samupāśritāḥ ||38|| madbhaktidhyānaniratā mama sevāparāyaṇāḥ | matsādhusevane saktā matsādhvīsevane tathā ||39|| matkalāmāśritā ye vā madāveśamupāśritāḥ | madvaṃśamāśritā ye ca mama patnīrupāśritāḥ ||3.170.40|| madarthamātmasarvasvaniveditvamupāśritāḥ | te sarve mama mārgasthā mama mārgamupāśritāḥ ||41 || mama mārge pravṛttāśca mama mārge pragāmiṇaḥ | mama snehabharāḥ sarve mama sānnidhyamāgatāḥ |||42|| mama muktiṃ prayāntyeva mayā maddhāma prāpitāḥ | kramamārgādhirūḍhāste prayānti paramaṃ padam ||43|| mānavāḥ ṛṣayo devāḥ pitaro munayastathā | santaḥ siddhāḥ satpuruṣāḥ satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ pativratāḥ ||44|| ātmanivedino ye ca vaiṣṇavā matsuyoginaḥ | teṣāmāśrayamāptā ye te sarve kramaśaḥ khalu ||45|| madaṃśopāsanāśaktyā māmeṣyanti śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | muktidharmaḥ kramavām̐śca puṣṭo bhavati tairiha ||46|| sākṣānmāṃ ye cāśrayanti vedasaṃhitayā vidaḥ | teṣāṃ kramaṃ vinā prāptirdhāmnaḥ purasya me bhavet ||47|| evaṃ vai bahavo yātā māmupāśritya matpadam | matsvarūpopāsakāstu kramād yāsyanti matpadam ||48|| evaṃ lakṣmi mayā loke muktimārgaḥ kṛpākṛtaḥ | taṃ sṛtvā laṃghayiṣyanti bhavāraṇyaṃ mamāśritāḥ ||49|| ekadāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe śrīmānaso muniḥ | niṣaṇṇo brahmavṛkṣādho bhūtale prajapan harim ||3.170.50|| dadarśa yogipuruṣaṃ jñānavijñānapāragam | sarvatattvārthakuśalaṃ sukhaduḥkhavivekinam ||51 || jātismaraṃ puṇyapāpakovidaṃ cātmavedinam | jñātāraṃ ca gatīnāṃ vai karmaṇāṃ dehivartinām ||52|| carantaṃ muktavat siddhaṃ praśāntaṃ ca jitendriyam | dīpyamānaṃ śriyā brāhmyāntardhānavidyāvedinam ||53|| tathādṛśyairbhāgavatairbhaktairyāntaṃ śanairanu | śrīmānasaḥ samutthāya yoginaṃ prāṇamat puraḥ ||54|| svāgatādyaiścidānandābhidhaṃ taṃ paryatoṣayat | bhāvena śraddhayā bhaktyā sevayā tuṣṭa eva saḥ ||546|| cidānandaḥ samuvāca yogyaṃ śrīmānasaṃ munim | śṛṇu sādho kṛpayātra vadāmi kṛṣṇapreritaḥ ||56|| kṛṣṇasyaiva jagat sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārthaṃ parikalpitam | kṛṣṇārthaṃ yojitaṃ sarvaṃ muktaye divyatāptaye ||57|| kṛṣṇaṃ vihāya cānyasmai yojitaṃ laukikāptaye | laukikāptipradaṃ syāttanna tu śāśvatamuktaye ||68|| vividhaiḥ karmabhirlokāḥ puṇyayogaiśca kevalaiḥ | prayāntyeva śubhāṃ martyā devalokādisaṃsthitim ||59|| na tatra sukhamatyantaṃ na tatra śāśvatī sthitiḥ | sthānāttu mahato bhraṃśo duḥkhalabdhāt punaḥ punaḥ ||3.170.60 || aśubhā gatayaḥ prāptāstādṛśyaśca mayā tvayā | purā bahvyo nipātāntāḥ kaṣṭāḥ pāpābhisaṃbhṛtāḥ ||61 || kāmakrodhamahāmohatṛṣṇārāgādisaṃbhṛtāḥ | yatra muhurhi maraṇaṃ mananaṃ yatra vai muhuḥ ||62|| āhārā vividhā bhuktāḥ pītāḥ stanā asakhyakāḥ | mātaro vividhā dṛṣṭāḥ pitaro’pi pṛthagvidhāḥ ||63|| sukhāni ca vicitrāṇi narāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā | duḥkhānyapi vicitrāṇi rodanāni bahūnyapi ||64|| vakṣaḥkuṭṭāni bahudhā kṛtāni tatra tatra ca | śirastāḍanamevāpi cātmaghātā hyanekadhā ||65|| priyairvivāsā bahudhā saṃvāsāścāpriyaiḥ saha | duḥkhāptānāṃ sañcitānāṃ dhanānāṃ nāśanāni ca ||66|| avamānāḥ sukaṣṭāśca nṛpebhyaḥ svajanāditaḥ | śārīrā mānasā vāpi vedanāścātidāruṇāḥ ||67|| tiraskārāścograrūpā vadhā bandhāśca dāruṇāḥ | pāravaśyātikaṣṭāni rogakaṣṭāni vai tathā ||68|| yātanā yamajāścāpi niraye patanānyapi | janmarogāśca bahavo jarārogāśca dāruṇāḥ ||69|| vyasanāni samastāni trāsadāni muhurmuhuḥ | loke’sminnanubhūtāni dvandvajāni mayā tvayā ||3.170.70 || tvayānādikṛṣṇayogāt tyaktaṃ jālaṃ hi mānasam | daihikaṃ ca sadā tyaktaṃ śrīharau paramātmani ||71 || sukhī cāsse’tra parame pāvane caraṇe hareḥ | aśvapaṭṭasarakṣetre mokṣade divyamuktavat ||72|| ahaṃ vicārya ca sarva paraṃ vairāgyamāptavān | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādamupāśritaḥ ||73 || lokatantraṃ tyaktavām̐śca duḥkhārttaḥ sādhuvṛttimān | sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ cānubhūya tvimaṃ mārgamanuṣṭhitaḥ ||74|| tataḥ siddhimavāpāpi prasādātparamātmanaḥ | athāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīvallabhaṃ prabhum ||75|| dṛṣṭvā natvā pūjayitvā prayāmi paramaṃ padam | nāhaṃ punarihāgantā tīrthaṃ kṛtvā prayāmyaham ||76|| tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca punaḥ siddhirdivyā me’tra vyajāyata | āsiddherāprajāsargādātmano’pi gatīḥ śubhāḥ ||77|| nopalabdhāsmyuttare vai tatheyaṃ siddhiruttamā | śubhaṃ sarvaṃ mayā nyastaṃ nārāyaṇe parātmani ||78|| na me tataḥ śubhaṃ cāpi bhoktavyamavaśiṣyate | itaḥ paraṃ gamiṣyāmi śrīhareḥ paramaṃ padam ||79|| parabrahmapadaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mā te bhūdatra saṃśayaḥ | nāhaṃ punarihāgantā sṛṣṭilokaṃ hi dukhadam ||3.170.80|| tvāṃ divyaṃ tu paraṃ bhaktaṃ dṛṣṭvā gurorhareriha | prīto’smi te cātmavedin brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te ||8 1 || kālo’yaṃ vidyate śubhro bhakte’rpayituṃ mānasam | ātmanivedibhaktasya sevayā sarvamāpyate ||82|| prasādena mahāmuktirāpyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | yathā tvaṃ syāḥ prasanno’tra tathā sevāṃ pradarśaya ||83|| bhṛśaṃ prīto’smi bhavato bhaktyopāsanayā hareḥ | paripṛcchasva bhāṣeyaṃ sarvaṃ yattava vāñcchitam ||84|| bahu manye ca te bhaktiṃ bhṛśaṃ tvāṃ pūjayāmi ca | yenāhaṃ kṛtakṛtyo’smi kiṃ dadāmi drutaṃ vada ||85|| ityuktaḥ śrīmānaso’pi prapūjya taṃ suvastubhiḥ | cidānandaṃ divyajanaṃ papraccha bahudhāmatim ||86|| kathaṃ dehaḥ kṣayameti kathaṃ dehaḥ prapadyate | kathaṃ dehī saṃsaram̐śca saṃsārātparimucyate ||87|| kathaṃ māyā līyate ca kathaṃ māyāṃ prapadyate | ekaṃ dehaṃ parityajya kathamanyaṃ prapadyate ||88|| kathaṃ nijārjite cātmā śubhāśubhe bhunakti ca | śubhāśubhe prabhuktvā ca kathaṃ brahmābhipadyate ||89|| videhasyāsya jīvasya karma kva vā pratiṣṭhati | karmaṇāṃ phalanāśārthaṃ kasyāśraya upāsyate ||3.170.90|| kathaṃ kena pratāpena divyatātra samarthyate | kathaṃ vā nityamuktatvaṃ kathaṃ vākṣaravāsitā ||91 || kathaṃ sārūpyamevāpi bhavettāni nirūpaya | ityevaṃ lakṣmi papraccha cidānandaṃ hi mānasaḥ ||92|| cidānandastu kṛpayā smṛtvā māṃ parameśvaram | sarvān praśnān yathāyuktān vicāryottaramāha ha ||93|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne muktidharmeṣu vividhadhāmnāṃ nirdeśaḥ śrīmānasacidānandayoginormithaḥ praśnāścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 170 ||
<3.171> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca evaṃ sampreritaścidānando yogī pratāpavān | śrīmānasaṃ sarvapraśnottarāṇyāha kramād rame || 1 || ānupūrvyeṇa kamale tāni me gadataḥ śṛṇu | āyuḥkarāṇi karmāṇi yāvad dehī prasevate || 2 || tāvadāyuḥprasandhānaṃ cehaiva jāyate’gragam | puṇyaṃ sabhājanasevā sādhusevā śubhāśiṣaḥ || 3 || dānaṃdamaścendriyāṇāṃ brahmacaryaṃ tapaḥ śubham | yogābhyāso bhajanaṃ ca sarvāṇyāyuḥkarāṇi vai || 4 || vahnisevauṣadhasevāpyahiṃsā ghṛtabhojanam | vighasāśitvamityetānyāyurvṛddhikarāṇi vai || 5 || satītīrthaṃ mātṛtīrthaṃ dharmatīrthaṃ surārcanam | arāgitvaṃ hyabhogitvaṃ caitānyāyuḥkarāṇi vai || 6 || ṛṣyarpaṇaṃ tathā devārpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ tathā | nityamuktārpaṇaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ cāyuḥkarāṇi vai || 7 || svargiṇā saha maitrī ca ravargāyuḥsampradā bhavet | evamāyuryaśodātṛ sevate karma bhāgyavān || 8 || āyuḥkṣayaparītātmā viparītāni sevate | buddhirvyāvartate tasya vināśe samupasthite || 9 || balaṃ śaktiṃ samāśritya garvaṃ cāpyabhimānakam | atyantaṃ bhogamādatte viruddhamapyanātmavān || 3.171.1 0|| niṣevate’tikaṣṭāni bhuṃkte’dhikāni śaktitaḥ | duṣṭānnāmiṣapānāni viruddhāni mitho guṇe || 11 || bhuṃkte’mitāni gurūṇi hyajīrṇe’pi punaḥ punaḥ | balātirekaṃ vyāyāmaṃ vyavāyaṃ cātisevate ||1 2| satataṃ dhanalobhācca bhāravāhitvamṛcchati | vegavāho bhavatyeva nitarāṃ jayakāṃkṣayā || 13|| vikṛtaiśca rasairyuktamannamatyaśnute jane | mūtramalādivegaṃ ca ruṇaddhi karmapāśitaḥ || 14|| yogyāṃ nidrāṃ sevate na divā nidrāṃ prasevate | ādatte cāpyapakvām̐śca rasān rasanayāhataḥ || 15|| rogavyādhimayo bhūtvā dehakṣayaṃ pravindati | atirugṇo’pyanutsāhaḥ parājito’tikaṣṭakaiḥ || 1 6|| dhairyaṃ vihāya sahasā maraṇābhimukho bhavet | api cedbandhanādīni viparītāni vindate || 17|| evaṃvidhairviparītaiḥ śarīraṃ cyavate drutam | uṣmāruddhaḥ kūpitaśca vāyunā cātivegitāḥ || 18|| bandhān vicchidya sahasā prāṇān kṣipati koṣṭhalāt | bhinatti marmasthānāni jīvasvāsthyakarāṇyapi || 1 9|| tataḥ sadyo jñānanāśe jīvaḥ pracyavate sthalāt | kṣaraṃ dehaṃ tyajatyatra sthūlaṃ sūkṣmābhisaṃvṛtaḥ ||3.171.20 || jātimaraṇasaṃvijñaḥ punaścānyatra yāti hi | anye paśyanti taṃ yāntaṃ tyajantaṃ sthūlavarṣma ca ||21|| tathāpi naiva vairāgyaṃ labhante na bhajanti mām | mriyante tattathaivaite tyajanti sarvamatra ca ||22|| labhante maraṇe pīḍāṃ marmaṇāṃ ghātanādiṣu | garbhasaṃkramaṇe cāpi labhante vedanāṃ tathā ||23|| janmakṛtāṃ dehakṛtāṃ punarmaraṇayojitām | labhante vedanāṃ jīvāḥ pārastasyā na vidyate ||24|| yadā dehaṃ jahātyeva nirucchvāsaśca dṛśyate | sa nirūṣmā nirucchvāso niḥśrīko hatacetanaḥ ||25|| mayā ca brahmaṇā tyakto mṛtātmetyucyate tadā | srotobhiryairvijānāti cendriyārthān śarīrabhṛt ||26|| teṣāṃ prāṇanirodhena srotasāṃ pralayo bhavet | srotasāṃ marmavāsānāṃ bhinneṣu marmasu priyaḥ ||27|| apriyo jāyate gacchan nābhijānāti kiñcana | prāṇayuktaḥ sūkṣmadehasahitastrirucchvasya ca ||28|| niṣkrāman kampayatyāśu sthūlaṃ manāgacetanam | kāyāt pracyuta evāsau karmabhiḥ svaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ||29|| amitaiḥ pāpakaiḥ puṇyaiḥ sahitaḥ sūkṣmadehavān | prayāti gatimanyāṃ sa tredhā klṛptāṃ yathākṛtām ||3.171.30|| puṇyapāpasamaprāptāṃ gatiṃ prayāti mānavīm | ihaivoccāvacān bhogān prāpnotyeva svakarmabhiḥ ||3 1 || aśubhaiḥ karmabhirlokā hyarvāggatiṃ prayānti vai | niraye yatra pacyante karmaphalaiḥ prayānti tam ||32|| puṇyabhājastūrdhvagatiṃ tārāmayīṃ prayānti ha | candramaṇḍalamevāpi sūryamaṇḍalamityapi ||33|| evamādyāni ramyāṇi bhuktvā puṇyakṣaye punaḥ | cyavante pṛthivīṃ yānti punarjanma punarmṛtim ||34|| punaḥ svargaṃ vā narakaṃ prayānti karmayojitāḥ | na ca svarge’pi santoṣo dṛṣṭvā dīptatamāṃ śriyam ||35|| nīcoccamadhyamā devāḥ spṛhayanti haranti ca | vicāryetthaṃ buddhimām̐stu sūkṣmaṃ dehaṃ harau prabhau ||36|| kṛtvārpaṇaṃ prayātyeva divyo bhūtvākṣaraṃ padam | netraṃ netrasya vṛttiṃ ca golakaṃ devatāṃ tathā ||37|| viṣayaṃ rūpamevāpi jñānaṃ bodhaṃ ca veditām | mananaṃ nirṇayaṃ cābhimatiṃ bhogaṃ samastakam ||38|| tathātmānaṃ ca saṃskārān smaraṇaṃ cāpi keśave | ātmaniveditaṃ sarvaniveditaṃ vidhāya ca ||39|| sūkṣmaṃ dehaṃ tathā divyaṃ vidhāya vā vihāya ca | saṃyogaṃ prakṛtestyakttvā brahmayogaṃ nidhāya ca ||3.171.40|| vāsanāṃ sarvathā dagdhā mama bhāvanayā rame | prayātyeva parabrahma māṃ hariṃ puruṣottamam ||41|| evaṃ dehatrayaṃ tyaktvā labhate brahmaśāśvatam | sarvagandhādiviṣayān bahiḥsrotāṃsi sarvathā |||42||| antaḥsrotāṃsi tadvacca phalaṃ bhogaṃ tathā mayi | sarvaṃ nyasya trikaṃ tyaktvā yāti māṃ parameśvaram ||43|| karmakṣaye sthūladehakṣayo bhavati padmaje | puṇyāpuṇyakṣaye sūkṣmadehakṣayaḥ prajāyate ||44|| brahmānandapravāheṇa vāsanākṣaya eva ca | vāsanā liṃgadeho’yaṃ mama bhāvena līyate ||45|| ajñānākhyakāraṇasya dehasya vilayo’pi ca | śṛṇu dehasya vai prāptirātmanastu yathā bhavet ||46|| saccidānandarūpasyādevasyādehinastathā | kāraṇairvividhairlakṣmi dehayogaḥ prajāyate ||47|| ātmāyaṃ svacchadivyo’sti sa yatrāste’kṣare’thavā | akṣarasya pradeśe vā sīmni māyārthasannidhau ||48|| sannidhidharmamādatte sphaṭikavat svabhāvataḥ | ta eva dharmā pārakyāḥ pārakyairyāti vācyatām ||49|| kāśapravṛttiniyamā māyādharmā bhavanti tān | labdhvā prakāśitaścāhaṃ pravṛtto niyamānvitāḥ ||3.171.50|| ityevaṃ manute cātmā māyātattvādivṛttibhiḥ | nirṇayaṃ cābhimānaṃ vā cintanaṃ mananaṃ ca vā ||51 || māyāprabhātmakaṃ naijaprabhātmakaṃ sa vetti vai | vedanaṃ naijamevāpi miśraṃ māyāprabhātmakam ||52|| miśraṇaṃ cāsya bhrāntiścāvidyājñānābhidhaṃ hi tat | tena pravartate cātmā puṇyapāpātmakarmasu ||53|| śubhāśubhāni jāyante karmāṇi māyayāsya tu | śubhāśubhānāṃ lepaśca jāyate’sya pravedane ||54|| jñāne lepāttatprajanyasaṃskāreṣvapi lepitā | saṃskāre dharmarūpe yo lepaḥ sa svaccharūpiṇi ||55|| ādhāre jāyate jīve tairjīvaḥ saṃsaratyapi | sveṣṭabhogādilabdhyarthaṃ sūkṣmayukto’pi cehate ||56|| tena sūkṣmaiḥ sameto’yaṃ labhate sthūlabhautikam | sthūlaṃ jāḍyaṃ samāsādya sthūlaiḥ pakvo’tijāḍyavān ||57|| sthūlabhāvairbhogavām̐śca karmalubdho bhavatyasau | prāpya prāpya ca karmāṇi kṣetraṃ kṣetraṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||58|| bhuṃkte bhogān bhogamayān bhāgyasaṃskāradān punaḥ | labhate ca phalaṃ dīrghaṃ cirasevyaṃ ca taistataḥ ||59|| anekajanmabhoktavyaṃ cākṣayaṃ labhate phalam | evaṃ lakṣmi hyasaṃgo’pi cākarṣaṇasvabhāvataḥ ||3.171.60|| ākṛṣya cānyadharmān sa svārājyaṃ sthāpayatyapi | arājā ca balī rājyamāhṛtya rājyavān yathā ||61 || tathāyaṃ jāyate dehī samākarṣaṇayogavān | amāyo’pi māyiko’yaṃ jāyate na nivartate ||62|| gāḍhād gāḍhataraṃ bhāvaṃ prapadyate na mucyate | carmakāro yathā kuṇḍaṃ durgandhaṃ hyapi nojjhati ||63|| carmolbāvṛta evāsau duṣṭaṃ dehaṃ na muñcati | śubhaṃ tathāśubhaṃ karma miśraṃ vāyaṃ prapadyate ||64|| yathā prasūyamānastu phalī dadyāt phalaṃ bahu | tathāsya syād bahu puṇyaṃ sattvena manasā kṛtam ||65|| pāpaṃ cāpi tathā caiti pāpena manasā kṛtam | manoyutastataścāyaṃ mahālasaḥ pravartate ||66|| manobhṛtyo yathā cāsmai dadāti bhuṃkta eva saḥ | punaścecchati bhogāṃśca tāvadāyurnivartate ||67|| kāmanāpreritaścāyaṃ garbhavāse praṇīyate | manasā puṇyapāpaiśca garbhe svapiti nirbalaḥ ||68|| śukraṃ śoṇitasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ kalalaṃ dehapūrvajam | garbhāśaye samāpnoti śubhāśubhādisadṛśam ||69|| kaścid viśati kalale pūrvakarmānusārataḥ | kaścidviśati budbude svasya karmānusārataḥ ||3.171.70|| kaścidviśati māṃse ca kaścit peśyāṃ svakarmataḥ | kaścit karaṇḍe viśati kaścidaṃgāḍhyaputtale ||71|| kaścit pratyaṃgamūrtau ca kaścid bhrūṇe viśatyapi | pūrvakarmānusāreṇa drutaṃ vā yadi vā ciram ||72|| prasūnālaprapuṣṭe vai kālenoṣṇyādipoṣite | saprāṇe puttale jīvo viśatyeva svakarmataḥ ||73|| saukṣmyādavyaktabhāvācca jīvaḥ sūkṣmaśarīravān | viśatyevāntaraklṛpte karmaṇā tatra sajjate ||74|| tatra brahma mahaccāste bījasyāpi prarakṣakam | bījabījaṃ parabrahma nivasāmi sahāpyaham ||75|| kartā kārayitā poṣṭā dhātāvitā nibhālakaḥ | sākṣī cāsaṃgavān tasya karmaphalapradāyakaḥ ||76|| sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ cāhaṃ bījabījaḥ sanātanaḥ | āpūrakāṇāṃ tattvānāṃ prerayitā vasāmi ca ||77|| prāṇendriyādijīvāturmayā jīvanti jantavaḥ | sa jīvaḥ sarvagātrāṇi garbhasyāviśya vai tadā ||78|| dadhāti prajñayā sadyaḥ prāṇādhāre vyavasthitaḥ | tena spandayate’ṅgādi sajīvo’yaṃ nigadyate ||79|| yathā svarṇadravaḥ svalpaḥ kṛtsnāṃ tāmrasya puttalīm | karoti vai svarṇamayīṃ tathā jīvamayīṃ tanum ||3.171.80|| karoti cetanaścāyamidaṃ jīvapraveśanam | yathā vahnirlohapiṇḍe praviśya svasvarūpayet ||81|| tathā jaḍe praviśyāyaṃ caitanyena nirūpayet | yayā gṛhe pradīpo’pi dīpyamānaḥ prakāśate ||82|| ekasthānasthitaścāpi svaṃ cānyaṃ prati kāśate | evaṃ hṛtstho’pi puruṣastridehaṃ prati kāśate |||83 || pūrvakṛtaṃ garbhayogyaṃ tatrolbe bhuṃkta ā nava | daśame karmaṇāṃ tatra pūrvasya janmanastathā ||84|| jñānaṃ prajāyate cāpi tato bahiḥ prayāti saḥ | garbhakarma kṣayaṃ prāptaṃ bālyakarma samāgatam ||85|| bhogārthaṃ tena vaśago bālo bhuṃkte kṛtaṃ nijam | atha yuvā jāyamāno nisargaviṣayecchukaḥ ||86|| pravartate’tiviṣaye pāpaṃ punaḥ prajāyate | nivartate viṣayebhyaḥ puṇyamasya prajāyate ||87|| dānaṃ vrataṃ brahmacaryaṃ sevā brahmapradhāraṇam | damaḥ śāntirdayā tīrthaṃ vrataṃ ca saṃyamo yamaḥ ||88|| vyalīkānācaraṇaṃ ca parasvānāṃ vivarjanam | mātāpitrośca śuśrūṣā devatātithipūjanam ||89|| gurupūjāpyahiṃsā ca śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ | śubhānāṃ cācaraṇaṃ ca satāṃ vṛttena vartanam ||3.171.90|| etāni yadi kurvīta dharmaḥ puṣṭaḥ prajāyate | dharmaḥ saṃrakṣitaścainaṃ pāti vaṃśaṃ tathā divam ||91 || satāṃ sevāṃ prakurvīta kuryāt satsu dhruvāṃ sthitim | ācāraṃ pālayet sarvaṃ yatra śāntirnirantarā ||92|| enaṃ dharmaṃ pālayed yo na sa durgatimāpnuyāt | udayaṃ labhate nityaṃ dharmasya cetanasya ca ||93|| ācārā niyamā uktā abhyudayārthameva ha | evaṃ niyamyate loko gurubhiḥ śāstravedibhiḥ ||94|| niyame vartamānaśca dehī yogī bhavediha | viṣavidyāvidaṃ naiva viṣaṃ spṛśati vai tathā ||95|| niyame vartamānaṃ saṃsāraḥ spṛśati naiva ha | yoge sthitaṃ na spṛśati māyā karma phalāni ca ||96|| yogī mukto jīvanmukto bhūtvā dehātpramucyate | sarvalokeṣu yogastho mukto dehī viśiṣyate ||97|| guruḥ sa mokṣado loke saṃgahīno yato hi saḥ | śubhaṃ ced dharmamārgeṇa samarjitaṃ tu dehinā ||98 || śubhabhogottaraṃ yadvā kālena mahatāthavā | saṃsārāttaraṇaṃ cāsya sādhuyogena saṃbhavet ||99|| pāpabhogottaraṃ yadvā paśupakṣyādijanmasu | satāṃ yogena sahasā pāpanāśaḥ prajāyate || 3.171.10 0|| yānavāhanachāyādau patrapuṣpādiyogataḥ | satāṃ sevāprasaṃgena puṇyamasya prajāyate ||1 01 || tataḥ sajjanmanā prāptiḥ svargasya vā parasya vā | tataścaiśvaralokasya tato mokṣaṃ prayāti vā ||1 02|| evaṃ lakṣmi kṛtaṃ prāptaṃ bhuktvā karma pramucyate | purā sṛṣṭau mamaivādeśataḥ pumān hyajāyata ||1 03|| śarīramātmanaḥ kṛtvā sa trailokyaṃ samasṛjat | sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ ceti prakṛtiṃ triguṇātmikām ||1 04|| mama māyāsvarūpāṃ ca sṛṣṭvā puṃse tadā dadau | prakṛtiḥ sā śarīrāṇāṃ yayā vyāptamidaṃ jagat ||1 05|| māyāśabalaḥ puruṣaḥ pradhānaṃ cāsṛjat tataḥ | puṃyogena pradhānācca tattvāni vividhāni vai ||1 06|| hiraṣmayasvarūpāṇi hyajāyanta tato virāṭ | tato brahmā tato devā mānavādyā imāḥ prajāḥ || 1 07|| māyāmayamidaṃ sarvaṃ kṣaraṃ tatparamakṣaram | amṛtaṃ dhāma ca tadūrdhvaṃ paraṃdhāma me sthitam ||1 08|| mayādiṣṭā īśvarāstu sṛṣṭimīśvarakoṭikām | asṛjan tatsamīkṣyāpi brahmāsṛjaccaturvidhān || 1 09|| teṣāṃ kālaparimāṇaṃ vidhāya ca pitāmahaḥ | sarjanaṃ pralayaṃ cāpyakalpayat sukhahetave || 3.171.11 0|| sukhaṃ tu duḥkhasammiśraṃ kāyamamedhyamityapi | dehāḥ sarve nāśamukhāḥ saṃsāro ghorakaṣṭadaḥ ||1 11 || jātimaraṇayogāḍhyo dustaro’tiviḍambibhiḥ | asaṃgaiḥ sujayaścāpi satāṃ saṃgayutairapi || 11 2|| nirvidyante vivekaiśca mārgamāṇāḥ paraṃpadam | ta eva prāptametadvai varṣma tyaktvā prayānti vai ||1 1 3|| ityetat kathitaṃ lakṣmi te’tra dehasya mokṣaṇam | yathā ca dehalabdhiśca mokṣaprāptiryathā ca tat || 1 14|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne muktidharmeṣu dehakṣayakāraṇāni dehaprāptikāraṇāni dehānmuktikāraṇāni cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāya || 171 ||
<3.172> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā māyālayo yathā prajāyate | vidyayā tīryate janturavidyāṃ jayate yataḥ || 1 || brahmavidyā parāvidyā cātmavidyā hi yā matā | paramātmopāsanayā hyavidyā sā viśīryate || 2 || nirṇayaḥ snehasahito mananaṃ ca tathāvidham | māhātmyajñānasahitaṃ cintanaṃ śrīharestathā || 3 || svarūpavedanaṃ sampadabhimatyā yutaṃ muhuḥ | vidyātmakaṃ parabrahmaprāpakaṃ tannigadyate || 4 || sā vidyā tu yayā parabrahmādhigamyate rame | avidyāṃ sā nirasyaiva parabrahma dadāti hi || 5 || suvarṇasya viśuddhirvai caturbhirjāyate yathā | śilayā chedanaiścāpi tāpanaiścābhighātanaiḥ || 6 || ātmano’pi tathā māyāvigamaścaturarjanaiḥ | satsaṃgena ca jñānena vairāgyeṇa prabhaktibhiḥ || 7 || satsaṃgena guṇānāṃ vai pravāhasya nirodhanam | vijñānena saṃskārāṇāṃ śanaiḥ śanairvivartanam || 8 || vairāgyeṇa vāsanānāṃ kṣayo harau pravartanam | snehabhaktyā harau saktirasaṃgo māyayā tataḥ || 9 || evaṃ māyāvigamaḥ syāllakṣmi kṛpayā sadguroḥ | anugraheṇa kṛṣṇasya māyālopo drutaṃ bhavet || 3.172.10 || harervāsena māyāyā nivṛttistu nijātmani | siṃhavāsena sarveṣāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ vigamo yathā || 11 || nṛpavāsena kṣudrāṇāṃ dehināṃ vigamo yathā | mṛtyuvāsena dehasthakaraṇānāṃ gamo yathā ||1 2|| bilādvai sarpavāsena mūṣakāṇāṃ gamo yathā | bhayavāsenotsavānāṃ hṛdayādvigamo yathā ||1 3|| udvegānāṃ vigamaśca mahotsave yathā bhavet | tathā harernivāsena māyāyā vigamo bhavet || 14|| ahaṃ yatra vasāmyeva tatra māyā na tiṣṭhati | mama bhakte nivasāmi māyā tatra na vidyate || 15|| yaḥ syādekāyane kṛṣṇe līno brahma vicintayan | tūṣṇīṃ sarvavikārebhyo madanyannaiva dhārayan || 1 6|| pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ parityajet sa tared bhavabandhanāt | adrohaśca kṣamāvām̐śca śāntacitto jitendriyaḥ || 17|| dainyadveṣavihīnaśca nirbhayo brahmaṇo’rjane | jitacitto jitabhāvo bhakto me mucyate rame || 18|| sarvajīveṣu nijavacchuddhabhāvanayā yutaḥ | anahaṃbhāvamānādiḥ sarvato mukta eva saḥ || 19|| jīvane maraṇe sthairye duḥkhe sukhe ca mūrchane | lābhe’lābhe priye dveṣye samo yaḥ sa hi mucyate |||3.172.20|| na kasyacit spṛhayati nāvajānāti kañcana | nirdvandvo vītarāgādiḥ sarvathā mukta eva saḥ ||21 || ajātaśatrurnirbandhuranapatyo’pyabhāryakaḥ | tyaktadharmārthakāmaśca nirākāṃkṣī pramucyate ||22| puṇyāpuṇyāvarahitaḥ prārabdhamātrayāpakaḥ | dehārambhakatattvānāṃ kṣayavān śāntacittakaḥ |||23|| advaitaśrīharau juṣṭaḥ premabhāvena sevayā | ātmaveditvamāpanno madātmā sa vimucyate ||24|| āśālayo divyadṛṣṭirjagatpaśyedaśāśvatam | aśvatthasadṛśaṃ janmamṛtyujarāsamanvitam ||25||| vairāgyaśāntabhāvādyairupeto doṣavarjitaḥ | ātmabandhaṃ prajahāti mokṣaṃ yātyacirāt sa vai || 26|| divyagandharasasparśaśabdarūpapramodinam | māyāmūrtivihīnaṃ māṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣipraṃ pramucyate ||27|| asthūlaṃ cāpyasūkṣmaṃ cākāraṇaṃ tatparaṃ prabhum | aguṇaṃ guṇabhoktāraṃ māṃ dṛṣṭvā drāk pramucyate |||28||| vimucya sarvakāmāṃśca buddhyā cāntarbhavānapi | mama bhāvānvito bhaktaḥ śanairnirvāṇamṛcchati |||29||| bāhmābhyantarasaṃskārairmukto dvandvavivarjitaḥ | niṣparigraha evāyaṃ niḥsaṃgo mukta eva saḥ ||3.172.30|| tāpaso mama bhāvāḍhyaścānyasaṃskāravarjitaḥ | brahma sanātanaṃ labdhvā nityamakṣaramūrdhvagam ||3 1 || śāntaḥ san māṃ samabhyeti paravrahma parātparam | ātmanyātmānaṃ sa māṃ vai paśyan yāti paraṃ padam || 32|| sarvendriyāṇi saṃhṛtya vṛttīrmanasi dhārayet | mano’haṃbhāvane dhṛtvāhaṃ buddhau dhārayettataḥ || 33|| buddhiṃ niyamya satataṃ smaraṇaṃ ca tathāvidham | saṃskāreṣu pradhārya saṃskārān juhuyādātmani || 34|| ātmānaṃ juhuyāt kṛṣṇe’nādau śrīpuruṣottame | evaṃ madyogamāpanno nityamuktāya kalpate ||35|| etādṛśaḥ paraḥ sādhurekāntaśīla eva saḥ | bhavan paśyannije rūpe māṃ madānandamaśnute ||36|| antaścakṣuḥsahitena prakāśenānivartinā | paśyatyātmani cātmānaṃ māṃ patiṃ puruṣottamam ||37|| evaṃ lagno nijātmanātmānaṃ māṃ tatra paśyati | yathā hi puruṣaḥ svapne svaṃ vai paśyatyasāviti || 38|| tathāyaṃ sve svarūpe māṃ sādhvātmānaṃ prapaśyati | dehe snātasya tu yathā lagnaṃ jalapaṭaṃ tu yat ||39|| niṣkṛṣya kuśalaḥ kaścit tatpṛthak cet pradarśayet | dehaṃ cāpi tathākṛṣya sūkṣmād bhinnaṃ pradarśayet ||3.172.40|| sūkṣmaṃ kāraṇādākṛṣya pṛthaktayā pradarśayet | kāraṇaṃ cāpi māyātaḥ pṛthakkṛtvā pradarśayet ||41 || māyāṃ jīvāt pṛthakkṛtvā tathā kaścit pradarśayet | jīvaṃ hareḥ pṛthakkṛtya tathā yogī pradarśayet |||42|| ātmānaṃ vai pṛthakkṛtya yathā yogī pradarśayet | tathā māṃ paramātmānaṃ pṛthakkṛtya pradarśayet ||43|| tathāpi sa na yuktātmā pṛthag bhūmno bhaveddhi mat | vyāpako’haṃ samastānāṃ tasyāpyaiśvaryarodhakaḥ ||44|| taṃ mayyantaḥprabhāvyaiva niyāmayāmi sarvathā | māmāpanno mama mukto mamaiśvaryāṇi cāśnute ||45|| māyāsya vinivṛttā vai māṃ yātaḥ so’kṣare pare | tatra māyā vidyate na yathā tatra tathātra na ||46|| yatra kvāpi vartamāno madbhakto hyastyamāyikaḥ | nirguṇo divyaguṇavān nirvāṇapadabhājanaḥ ||47|| yadā hi yuktamātmānaṃ mayā paśyati dehabhṛt | na tasyeheśvaraḥ kaścit trailokyasyāpi sa prabhuḥ ||48|| ekadhā bhavati dvedhā tredhā daśadhā sahasradhā | anyānyāśca tanū ramyā yatheṣṭaṃ pratipadyate ||49|| na tasya rogo na jarā na mṛtyuḥ śoka ityapi | devānāmapi devatvaṃ so’yaṃ kārayate vaśī ||3.172.50|| parabrahma hyavāpnoti hitvā videhabhāvanām | brahmabhāvaṃ gatasyāsya nāśabhayaṃ na jāyate ||5 1 || kliśyamāneṣu naṣṭeṣu bhūteṣvasya na vai bhayam | na kleśairduḥkhaśokaiśca ghoraiḥ saṃgādikodbhavaiḥ ||52|| vicālyate na yuktātmā niḥspṛhaḥ śāntisaṃbhṛtaḥ | nainaṃ mṛtyurvidhyati vai nainaṃ kālo grasatyapi |||53|| nātaḥ sukhataraṃ kiñcilloke’syānyad vilokyate | samyag yuktvā nijātmānaṃ mayi kṛṣṇe pratiṣṭhate ||54|| vinivṛttatṛṣāduḥkhaḥ sukhaṃ svapiti cātmani | rūpaṃ yatheṣṭamabhyeti hitvemāṃ mānuṣīṃ tanum ||55|| tato muktena nirvedaḥ kartavyo na vidhīyate | ātmadraṣṭā spṛhayate naiva bhogānmahaiśvarān ||56|| ātmaniṣṭho mahāmukto jīvanmukto videhavān | niṣīdennagare cāpi mano bāhyaṃ na muñcati ||57|| nagarābhyantare tiṣṭhannijāvasathe saṃvaset | mano naivāvasathe’pi bāhyaṃ mukto vimuñcati ||58|| yatra kuṭyāṃ vaseccāpi pārśve mano na muñcati | yatra dehe vasatyeva tatrāpi svamano bahiḥ ||59|| dehātmake’pi viṣaye kṣaṇaṃ naivāpi muñcati | indriyeṣu golakeṣu tanmātreṣu na muñcati || 3.172.60|| mūlādhārādicakreṣu manaḥ kṣaṇaṃ na muñcati | sūkṣme’pi cānyatattve’pi kṣaṇaṃ mano na muñcati ||61 || kāye trividhe sarvatra vāsanāvarjito yataḥ | antare bahirekātmā māṃ hariṃ paripaśyati ||62|| paripūrṇaṃ yato’syātra sarvaṃ tena sa sadṛśam | paripūrṇatamaṃ māṃ vai lokayatyeva netarat ||63|| sarvataḥ pāṇipādāntaḥ sarvato’kṣiśiromukhaḥ | sarvataḥ śrutimān bhūtvaitādṛśaṃ māṃ prapaśyati ||64|| dhārayannapi dehaṃ svaṃ caṣṭe vai brahma kevalam | ātmānaṃ cāpya vimānaṃ pramodasaṃbhṛtastadā ||65|| vimānamāśrayaṃ kṛtvā mokṣaṃ yāti tato mayi | naitadetatsuvijñeyaṃ vyāmiśreṇāntarātmanā ||66|| kriyāvatāṃ devaloko jñānināṃ vyoma śāśvatam | siddhānāṃ satyabhavanaṃ bhaktānāṃ brahma śāśvatam ||67|| parā hi sā gatirlakṣmi yattad brahma sanātanam | yatrāmṛtatvaṃ kuśalaṃ sukhaṃ pramodanaṃ sadā || 68|| imaṃ sādhanamāśritya pāpāḥ striyo’ntimasthitāḥ | sarve yānti parāṃ prāptiṃ kiṃ vai punarbahuśrutāḥ ||69|| ye svadharmaniratāḥ sādhubhaktāḥ parārthinaḥ | brahmavido naiṣṭhikāśca nityaṃ brahmaparāyaṇāḥ ||3.172.70|| mama lokātparaṃ tvanyat sukhaṃ kiñcinna vidyate | jñātvā tyaktvā ca sammohaṃ parāṃ gatimavāpnuyāt ||71 || etanmāyāvilayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ te pradarśitam | mamaiva sādhyasya yogād yujyate parame pade ||72|| nāsya lakṣmi tṛṣā cāste māṃ vihāyānyagocarā | tata eva hi bhakto’sau rājate matpare pade ||73|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne muktidharmaṃ māyāvilayanasādhanaṃ parabrahmadhāmaprāpaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 172 ||
<3.173> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ dampatyoryoginoḥ purā | samvādaṃ kathayāmyatra śravaṇārhaṃ gatipradam || 1 || purā śrutiphalānāmnī yoginī yoginaṃ patim | sadvidyāyananāmānaṃ jñānavijñānapāragam || 2 || papraccha saṃśayārūḍhā lokaśikṣārthameva sā | dehatrayasamādhisthā varte’haṃ nātha sarvadā || 3 || patisevāparā cāpi varte’haṃ harisevinī | dehadharmaparā trāpi varte’haṃ kāmadharmiṇī || 4 || devasevāparā cāpi varte’haṃ śuddhabhāvanā | mokṣajñānaparāsaṅgā varte’haṃ patibodhitā || 5 || athāpi mānasaṃ kānta dehaviṣayamārgagam | kvacit kvacid dhātupuṣṭyā pravartate hi nimnagam || 6 || adhaḥsrotasvabhāvaṃ tanmānasaṃ māṃ vikarṣati | ūrdhvasrotovatī nātha bhaviṣyāmi kadā tataḥ || 7 || kadā muktiṃ gamiṣyāmi kadā vai śāśvataṃ sukham | kaṃ vā lokaṃ gamiṣyāmi tvāṃ kāntaṃ tu samāśritā || 8 || bhavānāste tyaktakarmā yogyapi kāmavānapi | bhāryā tvananyagatikā bhartāramantarā sadā || 9 || sāhaṃ yogaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca patiyogena vai vṛṣam | pālayāmi tathāpyeṣā karmabandhanatā mama || 3.173.1 0|| na bhogayogamāpannaḥ kaścinmokṣaṃ pravindate | nātha tvaṃ vetsi sarvaṃ tat kathaṃ karmaṇā mokṣaṇam || 11 || bhāryāḥ patikṛtām̐llokānāpnuvantīti naḥ śrutam | patiścellokahīno’tra bhāryāyāstatra kā gatiḥ || 1 2|| tvādṛśaṃ patimāsādya kā gamiṣyāmi vai gatim | itipṛṣṭo muniśreṣṭhaḥ sadvidyāyananāmakaḥ || 1 3|| prāha śrutiphalāṃ patnīṃ śāntātmā tu hṛdā hasan | na me kāmo na me bandho dehadharmo na me mataḥ || 14|| nāyamātmā bhavet patnī nāyamātmā patiḥ smṛtaḥ | puṃso dehaḥ patiśceti nārīdehastu patnikā || 15|| eva loke vyavahāraḥ kṛtaḥ so’yaṃ bhavaḥ smṛtaḥ | saṃsārabandhanaṃ cāpi dāmpatyaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ || 1 6|| sāpatyakatvaṃ tato’pi bandhanāya prakalpyate | kāmā yogo vāsanādyā dehadharmā na cātmanaḥ || 17|| paśya tvaṃ māṃ divyadehaṃ nārāyaṇasvarūpiṇam | patirbrahmā patirviṣṇuḥ patirdevo maheśvaraḥ || 18|| patiṃ matvā parabrahma sevate sā pramucyate | gopyaḥ kāmāt pramucyante pratikalpaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 19|| śrīkṛṣṇasya prayogeṇa lakṣmīrnārāyaṇasya ca | evaṃ māṃ tvaṃ brahmarūpaṃ matvā sevaya bhāmini ||3.173.20|| tadā lokaṃ yoginīnāṃ satīnāṃ prāpsyase dhruvam | nairguṇyaṃ vā samāśritya bhaja māṃ parameśvaram || 21 || tadā tvaṃ brahmanirvāṇaṃ hyavāpsyasi na saṃśayaḥ | ityuktvā nijadehāt sa yogī kāmaṃ surūpiṇam ||22|| pṛthakkṛtvā dadāhaiva kāmo bhasmanibho’bhavat | kāmapiṇḍaṃ susampannaṃ dadau patnyai tu nirguṇam ||23|| tatsparśenābhavad divyo muktaḥ sumūrta eva saḥ | kāmo divyasvarūpo’bhūt sadvidyāyanavāñcchayā ||24|| camatkāraṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā śrutiphalāha taṃ patim | aho nātha jitāmarṣa jitakāma jitendriya ||25|| jitasarvasva tvayātse divyaṃ jānāmi sāmpratam | śaṃkā me kāmanājanyā nivṛttā divyadarśanāt ||26|| paśyāmi tvāṃ kṛṣṇarūpaṃ caturbhujātmakaṃ prabhum | kriyāḥ sarvāśca te divyāḥ prapaśyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ||27|| cāñcalyaṃ mama vigataṃ strībuddhiścādya nirgatā | divyāṃ ratiṃ samāsādya divyā bhavāmi te balāt ||28|| vada me tu yathāyogyā tathā jñānaṃ sukhāvaham | ityuktvā sā praṇanāma kāmo’pi divyamūrtimān |||29|| viveśa sahasā dehe sadvidyāyanavāñcchayā | vīkṣya śrutiphalā tatra niḥsaṃśayābhavattataḥ ||3.173.30|| yathā kṛṣṇe tathā bhakte divyāste dehavartinaḥ | bhavantyeva guṇāḥ sarve durguṇā api sadguṇāḥ ||3 1 || kāmaḥ snehaḥ sukhaṃ sevā poṣaṇaṃ ramaṇaṃ śubham | yojitāḥ śrīharau bhakte divyā bhavanti sādhuṣu ||32|| ye saṃgāḥ strīputrabandhuputrokuṭumbiṣu kṛtāḥ | ta eva sādhuṣu kṛtā mokṣadvāramapāvṛtam ||33 || yogī patirmayā prāpto dhanyāhaṃ divyatāṃ gatā | dehakriyā na me cāsti divyāhaṃ nāsmi bhāminī ||34|| ātmāhaṃ naiva yoṣidvai muktāhaṃ nityamodinī | deho dehārthasampannaścātmātmārthavibhūṣitaḥ ||375|| dvayoḥ panthā vibhinno’sti kā naisargikavedanā | evaṃ brahmasvarūpā sā kṣaṇamātreṇa bhāminī ||36|| brāhmaṇī brahmavettrī ca sampannā saṃgavarjitā | āhaivaṃ jñānamāpannāṃ patnīṃ vidyāyanastataḥ || 37|| subhage dehasaṃlagnā kriyā sarvā na cātmani | grāhyaṃ dṛśyaṃ bhavet karma karmajñānendriyairiha || 38|| dehātmā karmakarmeti vyavasyatīti bandhanam | mohaṃ tatrāpi cāpnoti karmapradhānabhāvataḥ ||39|| jñānahīno janaḥ sarvo dehabandhanamohavān | naiṣkarmyaṃ nāsya jāyeta yāvaddehābhimānitā ||3.173.40|| dehendriyairmānasādyaiḥ śubhāśubhāni vindati | janmabhogajarāvyādhikarāṇi bandhadāni ca ||41|| tattvānāṃ vai svabhāvo’sti naiṣkarmye na vasanti vai | tiṣṭhanti karmayuktāni bhūteṣu karma vartate ||42|| dehabhedān prāpayanti karmāṇi sargajāni vai | agnihotrādikaṃ vipre vedādhyayanamityapi ||3 || śāsanaṃ kṣatriye vaiśye vāṇijyaṃ kṛṣirityapi | sevā śūdre brahmaśīle svādhyāyo havanādikam ||44|| sadāre satkṛtirdānaṃ copārjanaṃ prapoṣaṇam | vanye vane vanyavṛttiḥ sādhau bhikṣāṭanādikam ||49|| brahmaśīlanamevāpi naiṣkarmyaṃ naiva vidyate | naisargikī cañcaleyaṃ prakṛtirdeharūpiṇī ||46|| vikṛtayaścañcalāśca mānasaṃ cañcalaṃ tathā | buddhirindriyastabakaścittaṃ viṣayacañcalam ||47|| saṃskārāḥ kośavallolā jñānadhārāpi cañcalā | jñānecchākṛtibhāvāśca dveṣādyā gocarāśritāḥ ||48|| viṣayānanujīvanti cāñcalyaṃ dharmaṇi sthitam | kriyāsvabhāva sarvaṃ vai tattvajaṃ markaṭaṃ tvidam |||49||| kathaṃ kriyāvihīnaṃ sattiṣṭhecchāntipralabdhaye | tasmāttatparivṛttyarthaṃ niścāñcalyaṃ samāśrayet ||3.173.50|| niścaṃcalapraveśena niścañcalatāṃ vrajet | sarvatra paripūrṇaṃ tatparabrahma tathāvidham ||51 || niścañcalaṃ sadā saumye saumyaṃ tadarthamāśrayet | karmaṇā manasā vācā hṛdātmanā samastakaiḥ ||52|| evaṃ yathā nivātasthaḥ kusūlastho nirodhitaḥ | cañcalo’pi pradīpo vai svayaṃ mūrcchā hi tailajaḥ ||53|| gacchatyeva tathā syācca cāñcalyarahitaḥ kṣaṇam | layaṃ gacchecca vā tatrāmbare niṣkriyatāṃ vrajet ||54| evaṃ cāyaṃ cañcalaiścāvṛto’pi cetanaḥ svayam | cidambare nirodhaṃ tu samprāpya niṣkriyo bhavet ||55| sthiro bhavecca maṇivanmaṇipradīpabhāsamaḥ | naisargikaprabhāyukto maṇidīpo yathā sthiraḥ ||56| vāyustailaṃ bhavedvā na bhavet tadapi bhāyutaḥ | vartate sarvadā kāntipradastathāyamacyutaḥ ||67| vāyutulyā hi viṣayāḥ saumye dehasthitāḥ sadā | bhujyante vā na bhujyante maṇistu nirapekṣakaḥ |||58| dehadharmāstathā patni bhujyante vā na vāpi ca | ātmā maṇistu te me’pi nirapekṣo na karmavān ||19| parabrahma samāsādya kathaṃ lokān viśaṃkase | kva gamiṣyāmītiśaṃkāṃ tyaja mukte pareśvari ||3.173.60 || ahaṃ brahma sadā cāsmi yāsyāmi ca paraṃ padam | jñānopāsanabhaktyādyaistvaṃ mayā saha yāsyasi ||6 1|| gṛhadharmā hi dharmāste nādharmā na hi nārakāḥ | ṛtudharmā manodharmā madyoge divyatāṃ gatāḥ ||62|| jñānayogena yogena brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ | divyo’haṃ mama yogena tvaṃ patni divyatāṃ gatā ||6 3 || etāṃ guptāṃ tu paramāṃ sarahasyāṃ nijāṃ sthitim | mokṣadāṃ bandhanahīnāṃ ko bhoktā cābhidhāsyati ||64|| abhoktuḥ paramāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ daśāṃ bhoktā na vindati | kutaḥ prābhikathayed yā mayā te’bhihitā priye ||65|| rakṣāṃsi sarvavighnāni bhavanti sarvadehinām | brahmamārge svargamārge tāni tyaktvā sukhī bhavet ||66|| ātmasthaṃ paramātmānaṃ samāśritya mayā priye | rakṣāṃsi kāmarūpāṇi vaśe kṛtāni sarvathā ||67|| bhruvormadhye gurordhyānaṃ labdhaṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ | yatra tatparamaṃ brahmānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||68|| sarvadā dṛśyate bhārye taṃ bhajasvātinirguṇā | iḍā ca piṅgalā cāpi suṣumṇā sṛtayastvimāḥ ||69|| yathā priyayā saṃgamya brahmādayo’pi devatāḥ | yadakṣaraparaṃ kṛṣṇamupāsate maharṣayaḥ ||3.173.70|| vidvāṃsaḥ suvratāḥ śāntā jitārthā yamupāsate | tamupāssva sadā subhru tyaja daihikacintanam ||71 || ghrāṇena na tadāghreya nāsvādyaṃ cāpi jihvayā | sparśanena tadaspṛśyaṃ cakṣuṣā dṛśyameva na ||72|| śravaṇācca paraṃ tadvai parabrahma prasevaya | ātmanā manasā sākaṃ buddhyā brahmagṛhītayā ||73 || prāpyate kṛpayā tasya tatparabrahma sevaya | agandhamarasasparśamarūpaṃ śabdavarjitam ||74|| yataḥ pravartate tantraṃ yatra punaḥ pratiṣṭhati | pravartante ca marutaḥ prāṇādyā yadvyapekṣayā ||75|| taṃ sarvasākṣiṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram | bhajasva bhāmini svāmyuttamaṃ śrīpatimacyutam ||76|| nāhaṃ patirna bhāryā tvaṃ patiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | āvayorātmanordivye bhaja taṃ puruṣottamam ||77|| hṛdi prāṇaṃ gude’pānaṃ samānaṃ nābhisaṃsthitam | udānaṃ kaṇṭhadeśasthaṃ vyānaṃ sarvaśarīragam ||78|| vijitvā teṣu cātmānaṃ parameśaṃ vibhāvaya | saptadhāgnirvaiśvānaraḥ prāṇeṣu dehacāriṣu ||79|| ghrātā ghrāṇena ghreyaṃ vai gandhaṃ pṛthvyāṃ samaśnute | pātā rasanayā peyaṃ rasaṃ jale samaśnute ||3.173.80|| draṣṭā netreṇa dṛśyaṃ tu rūpaṃ tejasi cāśnute | spraṣṭā tvacā spṛśyaṃ sparśaṃ mārute vai samaśnute ||81 || śrotā karṇena śravyaṃ śabdamākāśe samaśnute | mantā manasā mantavyaṃ viṣayaṃ manute nijam ||82|| boddhā buddhyā tu boddhavyaṃ viṣayaṃ bodhayatyapi | ātmā parātmanā sarvaṃ bhuṃkte bhoktavyameva tat ||83|| parātmanā tu yad bhuktaṃ divyaṃ tanna tu laukikam | laukikaṃ syād bandhanāya divyaṃ mokṣāya cārpitam ||84|| anenaiva prakāreṇa caraṇābhyāṃ gatiḥ kriyā | hastābhyāṃ cāpyupādānaṃ vācā saṃvādaśabdanam ||85|| pāyunotsarga upasthenānandānubhavādikam | gantādātā ca vaktā visraṣṭānandayitā hi saḥ ||86|| vaiśvānaro’ntarātmā hi paramātmā karoti tat | nāhaṃ kartā na tvaṃ kartrī tato na karmabandhanam ||87|| vijñātṛtvābhimānaṃ vai parātmani samarpayet | bhoktṛtvābhimatiṃ cāpi parātmani samarpayet ||88|| evaṃbhāve naro nāhaṃ nārī na tvaṃ kadāpi vai | yaścāhaṃ sa eva tu tvaṃ dvāvāvāṃ parame sthitau ||89|| paramātmātiriktatvaṃ nāvayorasti kiñcana | ātmā tvaṃ ca tathātmāhaṃ paramātmani tiṣṭhataḥ ||3.173.90|| yatra tiṣṭhāva etasmin dhāryaṃ sarvaṃ samarpitam | evaṃ sati kuto me te karmāpi cāvaśiṣyate || 91 || niṣkarmātmani deveśe sarvaṃ parisamarpyate | satyevaṃ tasya yo lokaḥ sa loko’pyāvayoḥ sadā ||92|| paraṃ padaṃ cidākāśo’kṣaradhāma hi śāśvatam | parabrahmaṇa evāsti tadasti cāvayorapi ||93|| yatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | tatrāhaṃ cāpi tatra tvaṃ gamiṣyāvo na saṃśayaḥ ||94|| bhaja tvaṃ taṃ parātmānaṃ patyātmakaṃ prabhuṃ patim | tyaja dainyaṃ saṃśayaṃ ca bhayaṃ nimnagatipradam ||95|| gṛhṇa jñānaṃ ca vairāgyaṃ dharmaṃ bhaktiṃ nirāmayām | nirbhayā paramasyaiva dhāmno dātrīṃ vidhehi vai ||96|| ityuktā sā nijapatnī śrutiphalātivedinī | harṣaṃ tu paramaṃ lebhe brahmabodhābhimodinī ||97|| nanāma pādayoḥ patyurlakṣmi lakṣmīrivābhavat | divyā madarpaṇenaiva kriyāṇāṃ sarvathā tataḥ ||98|| śrutivad vartate nityaṃ bhajate māṃ pareśvaram | labhate paramānandaṃ brahmarasaṃ samaśnute ||99|| gṛhayuktāpi satataṃ gṛhālubdhā tato’bhavat | patiyuktāpi satataṃ kṛṣṇayuktā sadābhavat || 3.173.10 0|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne śrutiphalāpatnyāḥ sadvidyāyanarṣiṃ patiṃ prati kṛtasya kvalokagamānādipraśnasya naiṣkarmyasarvasamarpaṇavidhayā parabrahmalokagatirityādipratyuttaramitinirūpaṇanāmā trisaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 173 ||
<3.174> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ yathā dehaṃ prapadyate | kevalātmāpi karmāḍhyaḥ kathayāmi yathātatham || 1 || ātmāmbare karmabhiḥ svaiḥ sūkṣmeṇa saha vartate | saṃkalpājjāyate harṣastena kāme pravartate || 2 || śukraśoṇitasaṃsṛṣṭastataḥ prāṇaḥ pravartate | prāṇena vidhṛte śukre tatrāpānaḥ pravartate || 3 || apānāt preryate śukraṃ rajaścākarṣayatyapi | samānastena miśre ca jāyate bījatādharaḥ || 4 || udānaścodare garbhaṃ prati nayati miśraṇam | nālārthaṃ miśraṇaṃ sthāne nābhau yojayati dhruvam || 5 || vyānaśca miśraṇe tatra vyāpnoti pākahetave | pakvaṃ cāpatyarūpaṃ vai puṣṭaṃ nālena yoṣitaḥ || 6 || janma prāpya bahiryāti ṣāṭkauśikaṃ hi tanmatam | mātṛto romalohitamāṃsāni santi tatra ha || 7 || pitṛtaḥ snāyvasthimajjā santi tatra balānvitāḥ | evaṃvidhe bhautike’tra dehe māyā nirucyate || 8 || deho māyātmanaḥ proktā nirdeho’māyikaḥ sa tu | māṃ yāti nityadā cendriyādyairātmā prapuṣṭaye || 9 || ahaṃ dehaḥ poṣyadharmo māyārūpo’smi tena vai | mama dehasya sattvena jīvātmāsti samaśnute || 3.174.1 0|| tasmāddehaḥ sadā māyā sarvaviṣayamodikā | ātmā svakarmaṇā prāṇairdehabandhaṃ prapadyate || 11 || caturhotraṃ varṣma cetaddhotā bandhanamṛcchati | karaṇaṃ karma kartā ca mukta etaccatuṣṭayam || 12|| catvāra ete hotāraḥ pratyekaṃ sapta sapta vai | ghrāṇaṃ jihvā ca cakṣuśca tvak śrotraṃ mana ityapi ||1 3|| buddhiścetikaraṇāni saptaite guṇahetavaḥ | gandho rasaśca rūpaṃ ca sparśaḥ śabdaśca vai tathā || 14|| mantavyaṃ cāpi boddhavyaṃ karmaite karmahetavaḥ | ghrātā bhakṣayitā draṣṭā spraṣṭā śrotā tathā hyapi ||15|| mantā boddhā ca kartāraḥ saptaite kartṛhetavaḥ | evaṃvidhā nijān bhāvān bhakṣayanti ca juhvati || 16|| saptasveteṣvasaṃgo yaḥ saptadhā mukta eva ha | kāraṇādivihīno’haṃ karmālipto bhavāmyaham || 17|| kartṛtvaṃ me na caivāsti tasmānmuktaḥ sadāsmyaham | ahaṃmamatvahīno’haṃ muktabhāvaṃ bhajāmyaham || 18|| anyathā tu caturhotro māyābaddho bhavāmyaham | adannannāni cāvidvān mamatvena vihanyate || 1 9|| dehārthe bhakṣayannannaṃ poṣayan mamatānvitaḥ | anātmabhakṣaṇaṃ kurvanmāyayāyaṃ vihanyate ||3.174.20 || māyā tṛṣṇā tṛṣārūpā viṣayāṇāṃ vivardhate | apeyapānaṃ kurvaṃśca māyayāyaṃ vihanyate ||21 || apeyaṃ nārpitaṃ deve hyabhakṣyaṃ cāniveditam | yadvāpeyaṃ rasyametad daihyamaindriyikaṃ jalam ||22|| abhakṣyaṃ svādu caitadvai daihyaṃ bhautikamityapi | ātmārthe pācayannāyaṃ badhyate na tu mucyate ||23|| manasā gamyate sūkṣmaṃ bhakṣyaṃ peyaṃ śubhāśubham | vācā vā cakṣuṣā cāpi śrotreṇa ca tvacāpi ca ||24|| jihvayā gṛhyate yacca ghrāṇena yattu gṛhyate | kareṇa padbhyāṃ liṃgena pāyunā yacca gamyate ||25|| buddhyā cittena cāhaṃkāreṇa yadbāhyagolakaiḥ | gṛhyate bhujyate vyastaiḥ samastairvāpi yad yadā ||26|| svapne jāgrati cānte vā madhye cādau ca yad yadā | sarvaṃ bhakṣyaṃ ca peyaṃ ca svārthaṃ māyāmayaṃ hi tat ||27|| pacyamānaṃ dehinaṃ vai hanti pāśakaśādibhiḥ | tatsarvaṃ tyajyate svārthaṃ vihāya paramātmani ||28|| bhakṣyaṃ peyaṃ bhavatyeva tadeva khalu nirguṇam | evaṃ nirguṇayogajñaṃ jñānavahniḥ pravartate |||29|| sarvabhasmakaraścāpi māyābandhananāśakaḥ | hareryogamakhaścāpi sarvasvatyāgadakṣiṇaḥ ||3.174.3 0|| satsevāvabhṛthasnāno mokṣanadyavagāhanaḥ | na tasya vidyate cāyaṃ saṃsāro bhakṣyapānajaḥ || 31 || sakriyo vartamāno’pi niṣkriyaḥ sa tu pūruṣaḥ | puruṣottamayogena koṭimokṣaprado’tra saḥ ||32|| kāminyā vartamāno’pi kāmanāsya na māyikī | patyā ca vartamānāyā ratirnāsyāstu māyikī ||33 || ātmārthaṃ cāpi kṛṣṇārthaṃ paravrahmārthameva ha | dehāntaragamaḥ svārthaḥ śubhāśubhaprabhogakṛt ||34|| kṛṣṇārthaḥ sarvathā lakṣmi parabrahmālayapradaḥ | svārthe tṛṣṇāmaye jīve savāsane sarāgake ||35|| karma tiṣṭhati pūrvārjyaṃ madāśrayeṇa naśyati | mayi sarvārpaṇenaiva karmaphalaṃ vinaśyati ||36|| sādhūnāṃ mama mūrteścāśrayeṇa divyatā bhavet | yathā yathā mama yogastathā tathā hi divyatā ||37|| puṃyogena yathā patnyā divyatā laukikī śubhā | sūryayogenāmbarasya divyatā suprabhānvitā ||38|| svarṇayogena tāmrāṇāṃ divyatā ramaṇīyatā | guṇayogena lokānāṃ divyatā vidyayā kṛtā ||39|| veṣayogena rājñāṃ ca divyatālaṃkṛtikṛtā | svarṇayogena devānāṃ puṇyena pitṛvargiṇām ||3.174.40 || aiśvaryeṇa tu siddhānāṃ tapobhiśca tapasvinām | śiṣyāṇāṃ dāsavargāṇāṃ divyatā sevayā kṛtā ||41 || gandharvāṇāṃ gītikābhiḥ sādhūnāṃ tvacyutārpaṇāt | divyatā tu satīnāṃ vai satyena ca vratena ca ||42|| brahmavratena sarvatra divyatā brahmacāriṇām | īśvarāṇāṃ padaprāptyā muktānāṃ mama yogataḥ ||43|| divyatā sarvadā cāste lakṣmīnāṃ tu mamāṃgataḥ | mama sā divyatā lakṣmi śāśvatī svanisargagā ||44|| etādṛśaṃ tu māṃ prāpya bhakto me divyatānvitaḥ | śāśvatīṃ divyatāṃ prāpya modate mama dhāmani ||45|| māyendriyāntaḥkaraṇabhūtamātrādayo’sya ca | mama yogena divyāste tato nārāyaṇo hyaham ||46|| mama yogena vai jīvā anantāḥ śivatāṃ gatāḥ | madyogena narā bhaktyā nārāyaṇāstvasaṃkhyakāḥ ||47|| jātāścāpi ca jāyante vaikuṇṭhavāsino hi te | golokavāsinaścāpi paradhāmanivāsinaḥ ||48|| akṣare vāsakartārastathānyadhāmavāsinaḥ | īśalokanivāsāśca māyālokanivāsinaḥ ||49|| viṣṇurūpā viṣṇavaśca jāyante’saṃkhyakoṭayaḥ | brahmāṇaścāpi jāyante vairājāścāpyasaṃkhyakāḥ ||3.174.50|| pradhānapuruṣāścāpi jāyante’nantasaṃkhyakāḥ | muktāścāpi prajāyante’nantasaṃkhyā hi dhāmagāḥ ||51 || gāyantyapi pramodante nṛtyanti harṣitā harau | kā tatra tu kathā lakṣmi māyāyāḥ sparśaleśikā ||52|| māyāpi modate tatra māmāsādya maheśvarī | ākṣarī paramā vidyā māyāpi parivartate ||93|| evaṃ divyavidhānaṃ yo jānāti bhaktarāḍ yadi | asya yogaḥ sadā divyastatra kā paridevanā ||54|| evaṃ mama pratāpena yogātmakena divyatā | sarvotkṛṣṭā bhavatyeva nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā ||55|| ekaḥ śāstā hṛdayasthaḥ so’haṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ | mayā yukto mama bhakto vahatyatha karoti ca ||56|| eko gururhṛdayasthaḥ so’haṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | mayānuśikṣito bhakto vahatyatha karoti ca ||57|| eko bandhurhṛdayasthaḥ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | tena mayānuśiṣṭo’yaṃ vahatyatha karoti ca ||58|| ekaḥ svāmī hṛdayastho’nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | tena mayānusaṃśliṣṭo bhaktaścānandamaśnute |||59|| ekaścāntarniyantāhaṃ paramātmā hṛdi sthitaḥ | mayā saṃpreritaścāyaṃ pravartate karoti ca ||3.174.60 || ekaḥ śrotā bhakṣayitā boddhā mantāhameva ha | ghrātā spraṣṭā tathā draṣṭā rasayitāhameva ha ||61 || ānandayitā grahitā gantotsraṣṭāhameva ca | mayānubhukta evāyaṃ bhuṃkte vetti pramodate ||62|| ahaṃ guruḥ parabrahma mayi vāso’sya sarvathā | gurvarpaṇavidhātāyaṃ karmaṇā nahi lipyate |||63|| evamasya bhavedatra jīvato jīvamuktatā | dehānte mama dhāmnyeva syādasya nityamuktatā ||64|| ahaṃ dadāmyakhaṇḍaṃ me dhāmākṣaraṃ sukhāśrayam | nityaṃ cāsya bhavet sarvasaukhyāḍhyākṣaravāsitā ||65|| mama dhyānena mukto’yaṃ matsārūpyaṃ prapadyate | madaiśvaryāṇi sarvāṇi labhate madanugrahāt ||66|| eṣā brāhmī mahāvidyā lakṣmi te’tra niveditā | yāṃ prāpyaiva naro nārī brahmarūpaḥ prajāyate ||67|| etadarthaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ mama vidyātra golake | omityekākṣaraṃ brahma dakārākhyā pravartitā ||68|| śreyaḥpradāṃ ca tāṃ prāpyāsuradevarṣibhoginaḥ | prāpya te prādravan sarve yathāsvabhāvamādarāt ||69|| nānāvyavasitāḥ sarve sarpadevarṣidānavāḥ | dakāraṃ vividhaṃ matvā yathāsvabhāvamāsthitāḥ ||3.174.70|| sarpāṇāṃ tu dakāreṇa daṃśane bhāva udgataḥ | pravṛttastvasurāṇāṃ vai dambhabhāvaḥ svabhāvajaḥ ||71 || devānāṃ tu tadā dāne bhāvanābhūt svabhāvajā | maharṣīṇāṃ svabhāvāttu dame’bhūd bhāvanā tadā ||72|| satāṃ tadanu bhāvastu dayāyā samajāyata | mānavānāṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ tato bhāvo vyajāyata ||73|| nārīṇāṃ darśane bhāvo dakāreṇa vyajāyata | śṛṃgāramācarantyeva sarvāgryaṃ tāḥ svabhāvajam ||74|| rājñāṃ tu dohane bhāvaḥ pṛthvyā rāṣṭrasya cāpyabhūt| | rakṣasāṃ cāpi daityānāṃ daṇḍe bhāvo vyajāyata ||75|| gurūṇāṃ tu dakṣabhāve bhāvaḥ svabhāvajo’bhavat | karmiṇāṃ daivabhāve tu bhāgye’bhūd vyavasāyinām ||76|| kṛpaṇānāṃ dainyabhāvo dakāreṇa svabhāvajaḥ | īśvarāṇāṃ divyabhāvaḥ svabhāvajastato’bhavat ||77|| piśācānāṃ tu durgandhe bhāvaḥ svabhāvajo’bhavat | kitavānāṃ tu duṣṭatve bhāvaḥ svabhāvajo’bhavat ||78|| ācāryāṇāṃ deśanāyāṃ bhāvaḥ svabhāvajo’bhavat | dānavānāṃ dorbalatve digjaye bhāvanābhavat ||79|| gṛhasthānāṃ daurhṛdatve suputre bhāvanābhavat | paśūnāṃ dantaviṣaye bhakṣye sā bhāvanābhavat ||3.174.80 || pitṝṇāṃ darśaparvādiśrāddhe bhāvastato’bhavat | prajānāṃ deśavasatau bhāvanā dotthitābhavat ||8 1 || evaṃ lakṣmi vividhā vai dabrahmabhāvanāstadā | svabhāvajā hi sarveṣāmabhavat karmakāriṇī ||82|| keṣāmapi na tvabhūtsā divyamokṣābhigāminī | tato mayā punarbrahma hyupadiṣṭaṃ sa ityapi ||83|| sakāreṇa mumukṣūṇāṃ sādhusevā svabhāvajā | gṛhasthānāṃ sādhubhāvo mokṣadaścetyabhūttadā ||84|| sannyāsaḥ sarvakarmādidharmāṇāṃ ca tato’bhavat | satyaṃ vrataṃ satyadharmaḥ satyalokaḥ sadātmatā ||85|| sanātanatvamevāpi saccidānandatā tathā | sarvātmakatvaṃ sākāramūrtitvaṃ saguṇatvakam ||86|| saubhāgyaṃ sumanaskatvaṃ satītvaṃ samatā tathā | samadarśitvamevāpi sāragrāhitvamityapi ||87|| siddhimattvaṃ srāvaśūnyabrahmacaryavrataṃ tathā | sureśvarārhaṇaṃ sevā śrīhareḥ sarvadarśinaḥ ||88|| so’haṃ japastathā sauropāsanā tu hiraṇmayī | sanātanārṣavṛttiśca sāyujyaṃ sārṣṭimityapi ||89|| sālokyaṃ cāpi sārūpyaṃ sahabhāvo’pi sarvathā | svāmisevakabhāvaścetyevaṃ dharmān sakārajān ||3.174.90|| jagṛhurmānavā devāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitaro’pi ca | munayo bhaktajīvāśca mokṣamārgaṃ hi jagṛhuḥ ||9 1 || śravaṇaṃ sevanaṃ sarvārpaṇaṃ samarpaṇaṃ vyadhuḥ | evaṃ guruṃ parabrahma mokṣadaṃ prāpyate tataḥ ||92|| nijātmānaṃ brahmabhāvāpannaṃ matvā tu bhejire | parameśaṃ nijasthaṃ ca samanubhūya bhejire ||93|| evaṃ lakṣmi jīvaloko yathāsvabhāvamātmanaḥ | guroḥ sakāśāllabdhvāpi santamasantamaśnute ||94|| śubhena vicaran lokaḥ śubhacārī prajāyate | brahmacārī sadaivaiṣo ya indriyajaye rataḥ ||95|| pāpena vicaran lokaḥ pāpacārī bhavatyuta | kāmacārī tu kāmena ya indriyasukhe rataḥ ||96|| dharmacārī tu dharmeṇa yajñayāgādike rataḥ | puṇyacārī tu tapasā yastu vratādare rataḥ ||97|| apetavratakarmā tu kevalaṃ brahmaṇi sthitaḥ | brahmarūpaścaran loke brahmaniṣṭho bhavatyapi ||98 || brahmacaryaṃ brahmarūpaṃ brahmaśīlaḥ sadā sukhī | brahmaiva samidhaścāsya brahmāgnirbrahmasaṃbhavaḥ ||99|| sarvaṃ brahma samavāpya parabrahmādhigacchati | ātmā brahma gururbrahma sa brahmaṇi samasthitaḥ || 3.174.100 || samāhitaḥ pare tatra brahmaṇi brahmaśīlavān | parabrahma brahmacaryaṃ tadrato māṃ prapadyate || 101 || naro vāpi tathā nārī napuṃ vā na mānavaḥ | yaḥ ko’pi syājjātigantā jātismaraḥ pravittimān || 10 2|| parabrahma samavāpya modate hi mayā saha | atra vā tatra vāpyasya kriyāḥ sarvā hi mokṣadāḥ || 10 3|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyaṃsaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne muktidharme yathādehaprāptiḥ śubhāśubhakarmabhogo brahmāvāptiḥ karmapratiṣṭhānaṃ phalārpaṇaṃ divyatālābho nityamuktatākṣaravāsitā sārūpyāvagamaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catusaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 174 ||
<3.175> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca ityevaṃ padmaje patnīṃ śratiphalāṃ patiḥ svayam | sadvidyāyanasaṃjño vai prāha muktivṛṣān bahūn || 1 || prāhaivaṃ cāpi saṃsāravāridhiṃ gādhatojjhitam | indriyajhaṣasaṃjīvaṃ taraṃgāntarvilolitam || 2 || bhūtanaukākṛtamārgaṃ viṣayāśānusandhitam | tanmātrāhāramatsyāḍhyaṃ śokaharṣādimārutam || 3 || kāmakrodhādimakaraṃ mohabhramādidigbhramam | rāgadveṣādikāvarttaṃ vāsanājalaśaityadam || 4 || apāraṃ puṇyapāpādikarmākhyataraṇānvitam | samatītya hareryogāt praviṣṭo’smyaparāṃ sthalīm || 5 || divyāṃ divyaguṇopetāṃ divyagomadvirājitām | śāśvatīṃ svarṇavarṇāṃ vai nirbhayāṃ nigamocitām || 6 || sukhamayyo yatra nadyo yatrānandabhṛto drumāḥ | pramodakalpalatikā yatra sneharasālayāḥ || 7 || yatrotsavāḥ svāminā vai sarvasadguṇaśālinā | nityayauvanasaundaryavātsalyapremaśālinā || 8 || nāsti tasmāt sukhado’nyo nāstyanyatra sukhaṃ tvidam | na taṃ samprāpya śoko’sti na duḥkhaṃ na bhayaṃ tathā || 9 || na tatrānityabījaṃ vai na triśākho’sti tatra ha | na saptāpyupaśākhāśca nāntaśākhāśca ṣoḍaśa || 3.175.10 || nātra jaṭilāḥ ṛṣayo mānasāhvānayoginaḥ | na vaṃśastambavāṭyaśca na gotrocchrayabhūtalam ||1 1|| na kaṇṭakāstīkṣṇadhārāḥ kaṃkarā na ca tatra vai | nātapaḥ sauramūlottho na śaityaṃ candrikākṛtam || 12|| na dhūmaścāpi vāhneyo na chāyāpi vitānajā | na meghāstatra mehāśca pañcāgnayo na santi ca || 1 3|| na raṃgāḥ saṃgamiśrotthā na ca śṛṃgārarāśinaḥ | na tatra pāśavaṃ kṣetraṃ pāśāstatra na rodhinaḥ || 14|| padmarāgādimaṇayo na ca tatra bhavanti hi | pañcaraṃgāṇi puṣpāṇi trirasāni phalāni ca || 15|| na tatra santi vṛkṣāśca pādapāḥ santi tatra te | padmarāgā madhurasā haṃsā vasanti tatra ha || 16|| mauktikāhāratṛptāste so’haṃ so’haṃ pravādinaḥ | anāvṛtāḥ prabhāstatra bhavanti sīmavarjitāḥ || 17|| bhūriśṛṃgāstatra gāvo bhavanti kāmapūritāḥ | nārāyaṇyo mahāsatyo bhavanti tāpahārikāḥ || 18|| kṛṣṇadevā atithayo bhavanti vyomavāsinaḥ | dīkṣitāścekṣitāścāpi svāminā nityadarśinā || 19|| nityotsavāḥ sakhīnāṃ vai tatra bhavanti śāśvatāḥ | iṣṭapatiprayogeṣu vilāsāstṛptivarjitāḥ ||3.175.20|| akampāṃ cāvikārāṃ cākṣarīṃ sthalīṃ parātparām | prapanno’smīti sadvidyāyanaḥ śrutiphalāṃ jagau ||21 || hā3u hā3u praphullitaḥ smaran śubhasthalīm | jagau punaḥpunaḥ prāha sthalīṃ śrutiphalāṃ smaran ||22|| nanarta cāpi tālena vadannupadiśannapi | ārdrabhāvaṃ prāpa cāpi śrutiphalāntike tadā ||23|| svastho bhūtvā punaḥ prāha dhanyā tvaṃ parameśvarī | yo’haṃ sā tvaṃ so’haṃ sa tvaṃ hyayamātmā pareśvaraḥ ||24||| ye’dhigacchanti santastaṃ teṣāṃ nāsti bhayaṃ kvacit | ūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca tiryak ca sthalyā nānto’dhigamyate |||25||| hareḥ pādapāraṇyāni santi divyāni tatra vai | yatra trimukhī pramadā hyavāṅmukhī na rohati ||26|| girayāḥ parvatānāśca santo vasanti tatra ha | snānti brahmavahānadyāṃ saṃgame pārameśvare ||27|| snānatṛptāḥ kṛśāśāśca suvratā devabhāsurāḥ | ātmanyātmānamāviśya parātmānamupāsate |||28||| viharanti ramante’tra pādapāraṇyavedinaḥ | etādṛśaṃ padāraṇyaṃ brahmiṣṭhā vividuḥ param ||29||| prāpto’haṃ mama yogena tvaṃ prāptā śrutisatphale | vidyāyanaṃ parabrahma prāpto’smi nirbhayo’smi ca ||3.175.30 || rūkṣaṃ gandhaṃ na gṛhṇāmi rūkṣaṃ rasaṃ na vedmi ca | rūkṣaṃ rūpaṃ na paśyāmi brahmānandapariplutaḥ ||3 1 || rūkṣaṃ sparśaṃ na spṛśāmi rūkṣaṃ śabdaṃ śṛṇomi na | rūkṣaṃ na saṃkalpayāmi brahmānandapariplutaḥ ||32|| kāmaye nāpyaniṣṭaṃ ca dveṣyaṃ tatra na vidyate | brahmajāle nivasāmi brahmānandapariplutaḥ ||33|| brahmayajñe juhomyeva parameśe samastakam | pārthivaṃ vā jalīyaṃ vā brahmānandapariplutaḥ ||34|| taijasaṃ vāyavīyaṃ vā gaganīyaṃ guṇādikam | saukṣmyaṃ vā cāntaraṃ vāpi karma vā saṃvidaṃ ca vā |||35|| svabhāvaṃ vā kṛtrimaṃ vā jaḍaṃ vā cetanaṃ ca vā | caitanyaṃ vā juhomyeva brahmānandapariplutaḥ ||36|| kṣaraṃ svabhāvaṃ hutvaivākṣarabhāvena cācyute | juhomi māṃ vimukto’smi brahmānandapariplutaḥ ||37|| samasya sarvabhūteṣu nirmāyasya jitātmanaḥ | samantātparimuktasya bhayaṃ me vidyate na vai ||38|| sadbhireva hi saṃvāso muktaireva samāgamaḥ | bhaktaistādātmyabhāvaśca śrīharau cāpyabhinnatā ||39|| evaṃ labdhvā parān lābhān pramodamemi sarvathā | śrutiphale phalaṃ miṣṭaṃ svāde sadvidyayāplutaḥ ||3.175.40|| evaṃ patnīṃ brahmarūpāmupadeśena sarvathā | lakṣmi cakre śrutiphalāṃ sadvidyāyana eva ha ||41 || athaikadālarkanāmā mahābhāgavato nṛpaḥ | madālasāyāḥ putro vai jitvā vai sakalāṃ mahīm |||42|| vṛkṣādhobhūtale sthitvā śāntyarthaṃ sa mano dadhe | cintayāmāsa śāntyarthaṃ jitā vai sakalā mahī ||43|| niṣitairmārgaṇaiḥ śastraistathāpi śāntireva na | mano vai capalaṃ duṣṭaṃ tajjitvā śāntimuttamām ||44|| prāpsyāmīti śaraistīkṣṇaireṣaḥ chinadmi mānasam | indriyāṇi karaṇāni chinadmi mārgaṇairiha ||45|| vicāryetthaṃ sūkṣmasūkṣmān bāṇān dhanuṣi sandadhe | manaḥ samūrtaṃ bhūtvātha tadagre samupasthitam ||46|| bāṇānāmaviṣayaṃ tat prāhālarkaṃ tu padmaje | neme bāṇā haniṣyanti māmalarka nirāvaram ||47|| niṣphalāste parāvṛttya bhetsyanti tvāṃ mariṣyasi | anyān bāṇān pramuñcasva yairahaṃ syāṃ niṣūditam ||48|| śrutvālarkaḥ pratyuvāca manastvaṃ ghrāṇasaṃyutam | bahūn gandhān pragṛhṇāsi tatsahāyaṃ tu jīvasi ||49|| tataḥ ghrāṇaṃ haniṣyāmi tīkṣṇabāṇaiśca te mṛtiḥ | ghrāṇaṃ śrutvā tadālarkaṃ pratyuvāca hi nirbhayam |||50|| neme bāṇāstava rājan māṃ haniṣyantyagocaram | pratyāvṛtya tava marma bhetsyanti tvaṃ mariṣyasi ||51 || anyān bāṇān pramuñcasva yaistvaṃ māṃ sūdayiṣyasi | śrutvālarkastataḥ prāha jihveyaṃ hi sahāyadā ||52|| manasaḥ priyasatkartrī rasadānena sarvadā | tatheyaṃ tvak priyakartrī sparśadānena vai sadā ||53|| tathedaṃ śravaṇaṃ cāsmai śabdārjanasahāyadam | tathedaṃ netramevāpi rūpārjanasahāyakṛt |||94||| tathaivemāni sarvāṇi liṃgādīnyaparāṇi ca | indriyāṇi manaso vai sāhāyyakāni santi hi ||55||| iyaṃ buddhirmano dattaṃ gṛhṇāti cauryakarmiṇī | ahaṃkāro’pi teṣvatra milito’śnāti garvavān ||56|| tānetān sarvathā sūkṣmairhaniṣyāmi prasāyakaiḥ | śrutvaivaṃ sarvasahitā buddhiralarkamāha yat ||57|| naite bāṇāstavālarka spṛkṣyantyapi ca naḥ kvacit | sthūlā hyete vayaṃ sūkṣmā na sparśo na mṛteḥ kathā ||58|| viphalāśca vivṛttāste tvāṃ haniṣyanti roṣiṇaḥ | mumocāpi tadā bāṇān pratyāvṛttāśca te’phalāḥ ||59|| alarkaṃ tu prajaghnuste’larko mūrchāṃ jagāma ha | sasmāra śrīhariṃ māṃ sa dattātreyasvarūpiṇam ||3.175.60|| āvirbhūya mayā tasmai jīvanaṃ dattameva ha | bāṇā niṣkāsitā dehāt samutthito’bhavaddhi saḥ ||61 || dadau bāṇānahaṃ tasmai caikāgryabalarūpiṇaḥ | draṣṭṛdṛśyādyanāraktān svarūpamātraniṣṭhitān ||62|| yogabāṇānmama mantrairyutān brahmāstrayojitān | muktāstraplāvitān sūkṣmānāntarān so’pi tān śitān ||63 || prāpyātmanā mumocāśu sarvendriyādikān prati | nijaghnuste drutaṃ sarvān kecit palāyitā hyapi ||64|| tān punaḥ pāśabaddhām̐śca kṛtvā samādhiraśmibhiḥ | brahmahrade nicikṣepa te ca tatra layaṃ yayuḥ ||65|| atha divyāni bhūtvaivālarkaṃ muktaṃ siṣevire | tato divyasvarūpaḥ san siddhiṃ paramikāṃ gataḥ ||66|| mātrā sākaṃ bhrātṛbhiśca saha mokṣaṃ jagāma ha | vadannevaṃ hyupadeśaṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi vivekadam ||67|| aho sarvamadhruvaṃ vai bāhyaṃ bāṇairvinirjitam | daihyamanuṣṭhitaṃ sarvamadyāvadhi na cāntaram ||68|| sadguroḥ kṛpayā tvadya jitāni doṣavanti tu | indriyādīni sarvāṇi guṇavanti tu vai pṛthak ||69|| brahmahrade vinikṣipya divyatāṃ prāpitāni ha | tathā divyasvarūpo’haṃ bhūtvā bhajāmi keśavam ||3.175.70|| sarvārpaṇaṃ vinā nāsti cānyatra vai sukhaṃ kvacit | kṛṣṇe svātmārpaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śāśvataṃ sukhamāpyate ||71 || śāśvato vijayaścāpi māyākṛte raṇe bhavet | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe yoganiṣevayā || 72| evaṃ lakṣmi nṛpo’larkaḥ śāntiṃ jagāma śāśvatīm | śrutiphalāpi śāntiṃ vai jagāma patisevayā ||73 || śṛṇu lakṣmi triśatrūn vai triguṇān sarvataḥ sthitān | sattvaṃ rajastamaśceti māyāpreritabandhadān ||74|| trayaste ripavo loke trirāvṛttā navāpi te | praharṣaḥ prītirānandastraprayaste sattvabālakāḥ ||75||| tṛṣṇā krodho dveṣaveśastrayaste tu rajodbhavāḥ | śramastandrā ca mohaśca trayaste tu tamobhavāḥ ||76|| navaite śatravo dehe cetanaṃ rodhayanti hi | svasvabhāveṣu nityaṃ vai kevalaṃ kurvate na tam ||77|| kaivalyagoṣṭhī puruṣo yadā tān jetumicchati | puraṃ hātumutsahate tadā tānarpayenmayi ||78|| ta eva vijitā yāvattāvanmuktaḥ prajāyate | lobho nāma mahān doṣo yadi naiva jito bhavet ||79|| anyeṣāṃ vijaye lakṣmi naiṣphalyaṃ tṛṣṇayā bhavet| | yatprayukto janaḥ kvāpivai tṛṣṇyaṃ naiva vindati ||3.175.80|| tṛṣṇārtta iha nimnāni dhāvamānaḥ patatyapi | budhyate nāpyakāryaṃ hi nimnānnimnaṃ prasevate ||81 || tataścintā bhayadā ca rājasī ca gatistataḥ | tāmasī ca tato bhūyo jāyate karma cehate ||82|| janmakarmakṣaye mṛtyuḥ punarjanma punarmṛtiḥ | lobhajaye tu vaitṛṣṇyaṃ mahāsukhaṃ hi śāśvatam ||83|| sāmrājyaṃ cātmanastattu brahmānandapradaṃ tataḥ | mahārājyaṃ divyarājaṃ parabrahmapriyātmakam ||84|| rājā pareśvaraḥ kṛṣṇastadrājyaṃ mama rājyakam | manute tu yathāvadvai rājā vātmā bhavan svayam ||85|| yadi cetparamātmānaṃ satyaṃ nṛpaṃ vihāya vai | jīvo rājā bhavatyevaṃ nirmūlo bhrāmako hi saḥ ||86|| kimatra rājyaṃ jīvasya pitṛpaitāmahāgatam | pṛthvī vā pārthivaṃ varṣma karma vā dharma eva vā ||87|| yadbhogastadbhavedrājyaṃ yatsattā nṛpatiḥ sa vai | na rājyaṃ vai śarīre’sti na rājyaṃ mānase’pi ca ||88|| na rājyaṃ cendriyavarge na rājyaṃ viṣayeṣvapi | sarvādhīno jīva eva jīvādhīnāṃ na te matāḥ ||89|| kuto rājyaṃ hi jīvasya rājatvaṃ vā vṛṣe’pi ca | naikāntato hyadhīnāste jīvasya santi karhicit| ||3.175.9 0 || tato rājyaṃ tvanavāpya tyaktvā ca viṣayaṃ mṛṣā | rājānaṃ paramātmānaṃ samāśritya sukhī bhavet ||91|| antavatyaḥ sadāvasthāḥ karmajanyā hi dehajā | bhautikyaścāpi tādṛśyastatra rājyaṃ na cātmanaḥ ||92|| mamedamiti manvāno mṛṣā tadavalambate | apṛṣṭvā taṃ yadā yāti nāśaṃ tadāvabuddhyate ||9 3 || na me rājyaṃ na me kiñcinna me dehaḥ kuto’param | evaṃ matvā divyarājyaṃ cinuyājjñānavāñjanaḥ ||94|| na svārthaṃ gandhamaśnīyādbhūmiḥ sā vaśamāgatā | na svārthaṃ rasamādadyādāpastā vaśamāgatāḥ ||95|| na svārthaṃ rūpamādadyāttejastad vaśamāgatam | na svārthaṃ sparśamādadyād vāyuḥ sa vaśamāgataḥ ||96|| na svārthaṃ śabdamādadyād vyoma tad vaśamāgatam | na svārthaṃ mananaṃ kurvaṃ mano me vaśamāgatam ||97|| na svārthaṃ mama yatno’sti hyātmā me vaśamāgataḥ | devārthaṃ cāpyatithyarthaṃ bhūtārthaṃ ca pitrarthakam ||98|| samārambhā mama sarve’rpaṇaṃ mokṣārthamityapi | brahmārpaṇaṃ mama sarvaṃ dharmo’pi muktaye mama ||99|| evaṃ matvā jano lakṣmi mucyate bhavasāgarāt | evamuktvā nijapatnyai sadvidyāyananāmakaḥ ||3.175.1 00 || punarāha śrutiphale tathā vartāmi sarvadā | vipro’smi cāpi mukto’smi gṛhasthadharmako’smi ca || 101 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaparāyaṇo’smi ca | nāhamasmi yathā māṃ tvaṃ paśyasi kāmanāyutam || 1 02|| rājyaṃ śrīkamaleśasya sarvaṃ mayi tvayi kṣitau | tathābuddhirbhavatī ca vetsyatīdaṃ na cānyathā || 103 || dhanaṃ nārāyaṇo me’sti tenāhaṃ dhanavān priye | ekaḥ panthāḥ parabrahma yena gacchanti tadvidaḥ || 1 04|| gṛheṣu vanavāseṣu guruvāseṣu bhikṣuṣu | tathānyeṣu nivāseṣu rājyaṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ || 105|| tatra sthitvā vidāyaṃ ca labdhvā gantavyamuttaram | divyasthalaṃ divyadhāma madhye nānyasthalād bhayam ||1 06|| śrutiphale priye bhārye brahmiṣṭhe brahmavādini | sadvidyāyanayogena paralokabhayaṃ na te ||1 07|| madbhāvabhāvaniratā mamaivātmānameṣyasi | ahamātmā parātmānaṃ samprāpto’smi na saṃśayaḥ ||108|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne muktidharme saṃsāravāridhitaraṇavijñānādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 175 ||
<3.176> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śrutiphalā punaḥ śrutvā papraccha svāminaṃ punaḥ | kṛtārthāsmi tathāpyeṣa gahano jñānamārgaṇaḥ || 1 || nedamalpātmanā śakyaṃ vedituṃ vartituṃ ca vā | bahu cālpaṃ ca saṃkṣiptaṃ muktidharmaṃ vadātra me || 2 || evaṃ lakṣmi sadvidyāyanarṣiḥ śrutvā priyāvacaḥ | sarvāsāṃ yoṣitāṃ cāpi hitakṛtprāha vai sphuṭam || 3 || araṇiḥ strībuddhirūpā guruḥ patiḥ paro’raṇiḥ | tapaḥśrate’bhimathnīto jñānāgnirjāyate tataḥ || 4 || buddhirnārī naraścātmā dampatīti nigadyate | tayorāntaravāsaśca paramātmā paro guruḥ || 5 || sarvakriyābhirātmātmā toṣaṇīyo janārdanaḥ | nārīdehasthitābhyāṃ nṛsthābhyāṃ tābhyāṃ tu vā sadā || 6 || eṣā saṃkṣepato vidyā brahmavidyā mayoditā | sā tvaṃ bhavasi nityaiva muktā buddhyā pravardhitā || 7 || ahaṃ bhavāmi muktaśca buddhyā saṃvardhitaḥ sadā | patiścātmā priyā buddhistābhyāṃ brahmābhigamyate || 8 || śrutiphalā bhaved buddhiḥ sadvidyāyanaścetanaḥ | tayorātmā parabrahma lakṣmyahaṃ puruṣottamaḥ || 9 || māmupāśritya vijñānaṃ muktaṃ divyaṃ prajāyate sadvidyāyanakaścātmā mahāmuktaḥ prajāyate || 3.176.1 0|| śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi guruśiṣyakathāṃ śubhām | muktistotāyanākhyasya guroḥ śikṣāṃ sutaṃ prati || 11 || siddhiveśāyanaḥ śiṣyaḥ papraccha svaguruṃ priye | kiṃsvicchreyaḥ paraṃ proktaṃ paraḥ kaścāparaśca kaḥ || 12|| kutaścāhaṃ kutastvaṃ ca kiṃ satyaṃ paramaṃ sukham | kuto jātāni bhūtāni kena jīvanti jantavaḥ || 13 || kiṃ satyaṃ ca tapaḥ kiṃ ca ke guṇāḥ sadbhirīritāḥ | ke panthānaḥ śivāḥ syuśca kiṃ sukhaṃ śāśvataṃ matam || 14|| etat sarvaṃ brūhi vidvan yena muktiḥ prajāyate | saṃsārabhīravo lokā mokṣakāmā bhavanti ca || 15 || guravastārakāḥ santi mokṣadā vai dayālavaḥ | śaraṇāgatasaṃrakṣākartāraḥ pāvanā yataḥ || 16 || muktisrotāyanaḥ śrutvā siddhiveśāyanasya tat | mumukṣānvitakośāya śiṣyāyopādideśa ha || 17|| śṛṇu siddhiveśa sarvaṃ kathayāmi yathātatham | parameśopāsanā vai paraṃ śreyo mataṃ mama || 18|| paraḥ sa eva bhagavān sarvakāraṇakāraṇam | parabrahma paramātmānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 19 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇamādhavaḥ | māyākṣarādiśāstā cāvatārakāraṇaṃ prabhuḥ ||3.176.20|| sādhusvabhāvāḥ sannyāsāḥ svarūpāṇi harestathā | sādhavaścāvatārāśceśvarā vyūhāśca te’parāḥ ||2 1 || aparaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahma muktāścāpyaparā hi te | aparāścāpi sarve ye mumukṣavastato’pi ca |||22|| ātmānaścāparāḥ sarve bubhukṣavaḥ satṛṣṇakāḥ | ātmatattvaṃ paraṃ proktamanātma tvaparaṃ sadā || 23|| ahaṃ jāto hyahaṃkāro mahattattvāt trimāyikaḥ | tvaṃbhāvo’pi tato jāto bhedadṛṣṭyā hyanātmani || 24|| ahaṃ tvaṃ ceti nirdeśo māyiko na tu cātmanaḥ | jāyamānaṃ mahattattvamahaṃkāramavāsṛjat | | 25 || ahaṃkārādbhedabhāvo bhrāntirūpo’sti sarvathā | tattyāge’hantvamamatātyāge nijātmanaḥ sukham || 26 | | paramātmanārpitaṃ bhuṃkte cātmā tatparamaṃ sukham | trikālābādhyamevaitacchrīhareryogato hi tat || 27 | | satyaṃ sukhaṃ hi tatproktaṃ bhagavadyogajaṃ sadā | na nāśyaṃ nāpi hāryaṃ ca na kṣayyaṃ na viśīryate | | 28 || etādṛśaṃ mahānandasandohātmakameva tat | tallabdhvānyannirmanaskaṃ nīrasaṃ jāyate’tra vai | | 29 || taddātā bhagavān sākṣācchrīhariḥ parameśvaraḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpatiracyutaḥ || 3.176.30 | | tato’vatārā jāyante hīśvarā api vai tataḥ | īśvaryaścāpi tasmādvai māyā tataḥ prajāyate | | 31 || ṛṣayaśca tathā devā mānavāḥ sthāvarādayaḥ | khanayaṃścāpi sarvā vai sarvabhūtāni dehinaḥ | | 32| | jāyante śrīhareste vai jīvanti tatpraveśitāḥ | āpūrakeṇa tattvena māyayā sanniveśitāḥ | | 33 | | parāpmanāntaravyāptā jīvanti tu cirāciram | jīvanaṃ karmasaṃghātaḥ puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ nijārjitam | | 34| | yāvadbhavanti karmotthādṛṣṭāni tāvadeva te | jīvanti cātha tannāśe mriyante dehinaḥ sadā | | 35| | satyaṃ brahma tu paramaṃ satyā muktiḥ sadā matā | satya ātmā cidānandaḥ satyā śrīranapāyinī | | 26 | | satyaḥ dharmaḥ satāṃ nityo mokṣado yo nigadyate | tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ hi sādhutvaṃ sannyāsastapa uttamam || 37 || sāmarthye sati sahanaṃ paramaṃ tapa ucyate | jñānaṃ vidyā tapaḥ proktaṃ mokṣadaṃ tat sadā bhavet| || 38 | | yo vetti brahmasaṃvāsaṃ vivāsaṃ prakṛtestathā | tathā cidacitorbhedaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim | | 39 | | yo na kāmayate kiñcinna kiñcidabhimanyate | iha loke sthitaścaiva brahmabhūyāya kalpate | | 3.176.40 || cidānandasya parame kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe mayi | kṛtvā samarpaṇaṃ tiṣṭhenmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | |4 1 | | purā brahmarṣibhirbrahmā pṛṣṭo naiḥśreyase pare | kathaṃ karma kriyāt sādhu kathaṃ mucyeta kilbiṣāt ||42 || ke panthāna śivā naśca kau mārgau dakṣiṇottarau | śrutvā jagāda tān brahmā gurusevāṃ sadā kriyāt ||43|| guravo mokṣadātāraḥ santaḥ sādhujanāḥ śubhāḥ | pāpaprakṣālakāḥ sarve puṇyaśevadhidāyinaḥ ||44|| hite cāpreritā ye syuste santo guravo’malāḥ | tairdattā ye copadeśā grāhyāste te guṇā matāḥ ||45|| sattve cittve tathānande puṣṭiṃ yaiścetano vrajet | te guṇā divyarūpā vai tadanye durguṇā iti ||46|| guṇaiḥ sampreritaścātmā kriyāt karma sukhāvaham | paralokapradaṃ yadvā paradhāmapradaṃ śubham ||47|| paradhāmaprada karma sādhu sādhuttamaṃ matam | paralokapradaṃ karma sādhu sādhutaraṃ matam ||48|| iha dharmayutaṃ karma satkarma sādhu kathyate | brahma satyaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ ca gurusevanam ||49|| satyaṃ sādhu nijaṃ karma tena mucyeta kilbiṣāt | tīrthasevā satāṃ sevā pitṛsevā hi pāvanī ||3.176.50 || ātmajñānaṃ harerjñānaṃ bhaktiḥ kilbiṣanāśinī | mātṛsevā ca gosevā satīsevā hi pāvanī ||51 || devabhaktirgurorbhaktiḥ samādhiḥ kilbiṣāpahā | brahmacaryaṃ ca sannyāsaḥ sarvakilbiṣanāśakau ||52|| gārhasthyaṃ svargadaṃ cāpi mayyarpitaṃ tu mokṣadam | vānaprasthaṃ virāgāṇāṃ māyāvṛttivināśakam ||53 || śraddhālakṣaṇamityevaṃ dharmaṃ jñātvā caranti tam | dānaṃ sevā dakṣiṇā ca satyaṃ puṇyaṃ ca sādhutā |||54|| paropakārastīrthāni devayānā bhavanti te | jñānaṃ virāgaścaiśvaryaṃ dhyānaṃ samādhirarpaṇam |||55|| mantrajapo’tisantoṣaḥ siddhayānā bhavanti te | upāsanā parā bhaktiḥ prītiścārādhanā tathā ||56|| prapattiḥ śaraṇe pāto muktiyānā bhavanti te | śivāḥ sarve te panthāno hariḥ śivatamaḥ sadā ||57|| tatsukhaṃ śāśvataṃ divyaṃ gatvā dhīraḥ samaśnute | nārāyaṇamayo bhūtvā sarvāmṛddhiṃ samaśnute ||58|| uktāste tu panthānaḥ proktāścānyāṃstathāparān | dakṣiṇān garbhadātṝm̐śca kathayāmi sucakriṇaḥ ||59|| mānavaṃ puṇyamādāya devo bhavati vai ciram | śeṣamādāya cāyāti mānave dakṣiṇe pathi ||3.176.60||
