pāpamādāya yāmyaṃ vai rājyaṃ yāti nivṛttaye | śeṣamādāya tiryakṣu tato vā mānave kvacit ||61|| evaṃ vai dakṣiṇe mārge caturaśītilakṣake | āvartate cakravacca dakṣiṇo mārga eva saḥ ||62|| tatra tattvāni tiṣṭhanti dakṣiṇe dehamārgake | avyaktaṃ mūlamāyā vai triguṇātmā pratiṣṭhati || 63 || sāmyāvasthaṃ pūrvabhāgaṃ viṣamāvasthamuttaram | dhruvaṃ cāpūrakaṃ tattvaṃ sthiraṃ prasavadharmi ca || 64|| guṇebhyo viṣamebhyastu mahattattvaṃ prajāyate | dehe buddhisvarūpaṃ tat strīrūpaṃ vai cidātmanaḥ | | 65| | tato’haṃkāranāmā vai putrastryavasthavartanaḥ | triguṇo jāyate sarvadeheṣvapi pravartate ||6 6 || tasmāt prajāyate sūkṣmabhūtānīndriyakāṇi ca | mano’pi jāyate tasmād vyoma prāṇastato’pi ca || 67|| tato tejo jalaṃ tasmāt tataḥ pṛthvī prajāyate | tāni sarvāṇi dehe’tra bhavanti dakṣiṇāpathe ||68 || udghāṭitanavadvāraṃ naddhadvāradvayaṃ tathā | ekadvārādhikaṃ yadvā nyūnadvārādikaṃ ca vā || 69 || ṣāṭkauśikaṃ pañcarūkṣaṃ susūkṣmaikonaviṃśatim | sacetanaṃ cāṣṭadharmaṃ bahudharmaṃ sadharmakam || 3.176.70 || asamānadharmavacca kalmaṣaṃ malinaṃ sadā | trīṇi srotāṃsi dharmāṇi cāpyānte punastvidam ||7 1 || śuklakṛṣṇāśuklakṛṣṇātmakāni saṃskṛtāni ca | saṃskāraistāni nityaṃ vai navodbhavāni santi hi || 72 || sattvaṃ dīpo bhavatyeva rajo gatiṃ dadāti hi | tamo nirodhaṃ kurute hyevaṃ sakriyameva tat | | 73 || sattvaguṇe vartamāne prītirānanda utsavaḥ | sukhaṃ prakāśa udayaścaudāryaṃ nirbhayatvakam ||74 || śraddhā kṣamā dhṛtiḥ satyaṃ santoṣaṃ ārjavaṃ tathā | dayā samatā cāhiṃsā śuddhirdākṣyaṃ sukarmatā ||75 || vrataṃ sevā paricaryā hyakāmo hrīstitikṣaṇam | viśvāsaścopakāraśca tyāgastuṣṭiḥ pramodanam || 76 || sādhuvṛttitvamanaghaṃ śāntaṃ karma śubhekṣaṇam | upekṣā brahmacaryaṃ ca mamāhaṃkāravarjitā ||77|| dānaṃ makho’dhyayanaṃ cetyete guṇāstu sāttvikāḥ | ebhirguṇairdhīrabhāvā jāyante sādhuvṛttayaḥ || 78 || viśokā dharmabahulāḥ svargaṃ yānti surāśca te | bhūtveśitvaṃ vaśitvaṃ ca laghutvaṃ labhate divi || 79 || ūrdhvasrotasa ityete devāḥ śreṣṭhā matā hi te | yadyadicchanti tatsarvaṃ bhajante vibhajanti ca ||3.176.8 0 || atha rājasabhāvān vai kathayāmi samāsataḥ | pravartanaṃ vyavahāraścotsāho vega udyamaḥ ||8 1 || santāpo rūpamāyāso duḥkhamātapa ūrdhvatā | aiśvaryaṃ melanaṃ hetuvādo ratirbalaṃ madaḥ ||8 2 || śauryaṃ roṣaśca kalahaḥ piśunaṃ pālanaṃ raṇaḥ | īrṣyepsā bandhanaṃ ghāto vikrayaśca nikṛntanam || 83 || paracchidrāvamarṣaśca cintā ca matsaro mṛṣā | nindā stutiḥ praśaṃsā ca vikalpo dharṣaṇaṃ tapaḥ || 84|| śuśrūṣā ca paricaryā bhṛtyatā ca parigrahaḥ | pramādaḥ parivādaśca nayo vyūho namaskriyā |||85|| āśīrvādāḥ paurttakarma svāhāsvadhāvaṣaṭkriyāḥ | vidyā ca maṃgalaṃ sneho mamedamitilālasā ||8 6|| mānaṃ māyā jugupsā ca jāgaraḥ stainyamityapi | daṃbho darpo’tha rāgo’pi bhaktirmodaśca kāmanā ||87 || dyūtaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca gītaṃ cepyevamādyāstu rājasāḥ | dharmo’rthaḥ sampadaśceti rājasyo vai bhavanti hi | |88 || tairguṇaiḥ sahitā yānti dharmādyaiśvaryayojitāḥ | atraiva mānave loke modante mānavāstu te || 89 || paralokaṃ samīhante tarpayantyapi juhvati | dadati pratigṛhṇanti jāyante ca punaḥ punaḥ | | 3.176.90 | | atha te tāmasān vacmi guṇān tamaḥsamutthitān | moho bhayaṃ ca lobhaśca svapnaḥ stambhaḥ pradūṣaṇam || 91 | | atyāgaścāpyathājñānaṃ ḍolanaṃ smṛtivibhramaḥ | nāstikyaṃ bhedavṛttiścāndhatvaṃ jāḍyaṃ ca sannatā | | 92 || mṛṣāmānaṃ vairabhāvo vikṛtirmūḍhabhāvanā | pāpaṃ paravaśitvaṃ cālasyaṃ dhūmranibhājñatā | | 93 || nāśo nirodhanaṃ bhaṃgo layaśceti tu tāmasāḥ | sarvakārye niyamyante pravṛttayo hi tāmasaiḥ || 94 || parivādakathā manyuratyāgaścābhimānitā | akṣamā matsaraśceti tāmasāste bhavanti vai | | 95 || vṛthārambhā vṛthādānaṃ vṛthābhakṣaṇamityapi | aśraddhā khaṇḍanaṃ ceti tāmasāste bhavanti vai || 96 || manuṣyā bhinnamaryādā daityāśca rākṣasāstathā | avāṅnirayamāpannāstiryaṅnirayagāminaḥ || 97 || dānavāścāsurāḥ pretā bhūtāḥ piśācakādayaḥ | krūrāśca hiṃsakā māṃsabhakṣaṇāḥ saṃbhavantyapi | | 98 || sthāvareṣu jaṃgameṣu paśuṣvapi bhavanti te | vāhaneṣu kharoṣṭreṣu kravyādeṣu bhavanti te | | 99 | | daṃdaśūkāḥ kṛmayaśca kīṭā vihaṃgamāstathā | aṇḍajā jantavaścāpi bahupadāścatuṣpadāḥ || 3.176.100 || unmattā badhirā mūkāḥ pāparogāvṛttāśca ye | arvāksrotasa ityete magnāstamasi tāmasāḥ ||1 01 || evamete guṇavṛttā bhavanti dehinaḥ khalu | satāṃ yogena loke’smin yathākathaṃcideva ha || 10 2|| puṇyavatāṃ prasaṃgena samāyāntyūrdhvamāśrayāt | caṇḍālādyāḥ pāpapūrṇā ghātakā hiṃsakāśca vā || 103| jāyante te’pi ca punardharmayogena śobhanām | yonimāsādya paryāyādūrdhvamāyānti vai kvacit || 1 04|| viprarṣayaḥ surāḥ santo munayaḥ sukhimānavāḥ | tatau yānti divaṃ dharmaḥ sattveneśvaravāsitām || 1 05|| bhaktyā samarpaṇenāpi sevayā kṛpayāthavā | mokṣapadaṃ prayāntyeva cireṇa śaraṇāgatāḥ || 10 6||. ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ lakṣmi dehādiyojanam | siddhiveśāyanāyaiva muktisrotāyanena vai || 1 07| labdhvā vimalavijñānaṃ śāntimavāpa cottamām | śiṣyo divyatamāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ cāvāpa pārameśvarīm || 108 | iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne saṃkṣiptamuktidharmāṇāṃ dehadharmāṇāṃ māyikādīnāṃ ca nirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 176 ||
<3.177> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca uktaṃ māyodbhavaṃ sargaṃ jānam̐llakṣmi na muhyati | sarvataḥ pāṇipādo yaḥ sarvato’kṣiśiromukhaḥ || 19 sarvataḥ śrutimān yaśca taṃ jānan vai pramucyate | mahāprabhāvaḥ puruṣottamaḥ sarvahṛdi sthitaḥ || 2 | sarveśānaḥ sarvajyotiṣprado’cyutaḥ pumuttamaḥ | prasannaḥ śrīhariścāhaṃ māṃ jñātvā saṃpramucyate || 3 || viṣṇurevādisarge’haṃ svayaṃbhūḥ śaṃkaro’pi ca | bhavāmiti ca māṃ jñātvā mucyante brahmabhāvinaḥ || 4 | adhyātmajñānatṛptānāṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām | svādhyāyakratusiddhānāṃ mama lokaḥ sanātanaḥ || 5 | mama smaraṇamantā ye dhīrā brahmaparā janāḥ | kriyākaraṇanirlepāsteṣāṃ lokaḥ sanātanaḥ || 6 | indriyāṇi vaśe yasya viṣayo rāgavarjitaḥ | viśuddhaṃ ca mano yasya buddhiravyabhicāriṇī || 7 | jñānaṃ bhaktiryasya pārśve sevā yasmin sadā sthitā | sa tadbrahma śubhaṃ yāti tato bhūyo na jāyate || 8 || dahyaṃ grāmaṃ jayet pūrvaṃ tato brahma prakāśate | sarvaṃ mayā kṛtaṃ caivaṃ viditvā santyajet tataḥ || 9 || śrotraṃ tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā cāpi pañcamī | pādau pāyurupasthaśca hastau vāg daśamī tathā || 3.177.10 || mana ekādaśaṃ cittamahaṃ buddhiścaturdaśī | ākāśaṃ prathamaṃ bhūtaṃ śrotramadhyātmamucyate || 11 || adhibhūtaṃ tatra śabdo diśastatrādhidaivatam | pavano dvitīyabhūtaṃ tvagadhyātmaṃ tu tatra ca || 1 2|| spraṣṭavyamadhibhūtaṃ ca vidyut tatrādhidaivatam | tejastṛtīyaṃ bhūtaṃ ca cakṣuradhyātmamucyate || 13 || rūpaṃ tatrādhibhūtaṃ ca ravistatrādhidaivatam | jalaṃ caturthaṃ bhūtaṃ ca rasanādhyātmamucyate || 1 4|| raso’dhibhūtaṃ tatrātha candramāścādhidaivatam | kṣitirbhūtaṃ pañcamaṃ ca ghrāṇaścādhyātmamucyate || 1 5|| gandho’dhibhūtaṃ tatraiva vāyustatrādhidaivatam | pādāvadhyātmamityeva gantavyamadhibhūtakam || 1 6|| adhidaivatamevātra viṣṇureva sanātanaḥ | arvāggatimadapānī pāyuradhyātmamucyate || 1 7|| visargo’dhibhūtameva mitrastatrādhidaivatam | prajanaḥ sarvalokānāmupastho’dhyātmamucyate || 18 || śukraṃ rajo’dhibhūtaṃ ca daivataṃ tu prajāpatiḥ | hastāvadhyātmamevātrādhibhūtaṃ karma caiva hi | | 19 || śakro’dhidaivataṃ tatra bodhyamādānakārakam | vaiśvadevī ca yā pūrvā vāk sādhyātmamihocyate || 3.177.20 || vaktavyamadhibhūtaṃ ca vahnistatrādhidaivatam | adhyātmaṃ mana evāpi saṃkalpaścādhibhūtakam || 21 || candramāścādhidevaśca manorājyaṃ hi tanmatam | ahaṃkārastathādhyātmaṃ sarvasaṃsārakārakaḥ || 22|| abhimāno’dhibhūtaṃ ca rudrastatrādhidaivatam | cittamadhyātmamityeva vāsudevo’dhidaivatam || 23 || cintanaṃ cādhibhūtaṃ ca cintā vai pralayaṃkarī | buddhiradhyātmamevāpi sarveṣāṃ mahatī prasūḥ || 24|| adhibhūtaṃ tu boddhavyaṃ brahmā tatrādhidaivatam | caturthaṃ daivatānāṃ ca daivataṃ parameśvaraḥ || 25 || so’haṃ sarvanivāso’smi sarvadevādhidaivatam | etajjñātvā trayaṃ tyaktvā caturthaṃ toṣayet tribhiḥ || 26|| cetanastatra phalabhāṅ mucyate matpratoṣaṇāt | guṇādiṣu hyanāsaṃgo brahmacaryā madarpaṇam ||27||| etad brahmamayaṃ vrataṃ caikapadaṃ sukhaṃ param | tatra sthitaścetano’yaṃ sarvato mukta eva saḥ ||98 || kāmānātmani saṃyamya kṣīṇatṛṣṇo madarpaṇaḥ | sarvabhūtātmadarśī ca brahmabhūyāya kalpate ||29||| sarvendriyanirodhena hyadhyātmāgniḥ samidhyate | prakāśate cidātmā ca prasannātmā pravardhate ||3.177.30 || svayaṃjyotiḥ parajyotiḥ sarvatejāṃsyatītya saḥ | māyācakraṃ kālacakraṃ karmacakraṃ vyatītya ca |||31 || jagat sarvamatikramya tyaktvā dustyajapūruṣam | brahma vyoma cidākāśaṃ prāpnoti sthānamūrdhagam ||32|| sarvamāyāvinirmuktastato mukteṣu saṃsthitaḥ | brahmahrade kṛtasnāno divyasajātiśobhanaḥ ||3 2||| sarvajña iva saṃśobhan tvekadhā bahudhā bhavan | modate cākṣare dhāmni ramate svāmini dhruve ||34|| taṃ muktā viprasaṃghāśceśvarā devā maharṣayaḥ | pitaro mānavā bhūtāḥ sadā stuvanti muktaye || 35|| ahaṃ brahmaparaḥ svāmī mattaḥ paro na vidyate | rājādhirāja sarveṣāṃ yuktānāṃ paramo hariḥ ||26||36 sādhavo rakṣitā yena muktā bhaktāśca rakṣitāḥ | te’smiṃlloke pramodante sukhaṃ pretya ca bhuñjate ||37 || sannyāsī jñānibhakto vai prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim | nirdvandvo bhaktimān snehī mayi māmeva gacchati ||38||| vimuktaḥ sarvasaṃskāraiḥ sarvadvandvavivarjitaḥ | vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim ||9|| catvāra āśramāḥ santi sarve gārhasthyajīvinaḥ | gārhasthyāntagamana vai śreyastatra pratiṣṭhataḥ ||3.177.40 || sapatnīkasya tu pañcamahāyajñā vimuktaye | devatātithiśiṣṭāśī vighasāśī na lipyate ||41 || vaiṣṇavīṃ dhārayenmālāṃ dīkṣāṃ bhikṣāṃ matiṃ striyam | adhītya māṃ svakarmāṇi kurvannapi vimucyate ||42|| gṛhastho vā nivṛttau vā ya icchenmokṣamātmanaḥ | abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo datvā naiṣkarmyamācaret ||43||| sarvabhūtasukho maitraḥ sarvendriyayato muniḥ | haryarpitasvavyāpāraḥ prayāti paramāṃ gatim ||44|| lābhena yo na vai hṛṣyennālābhe vimanā bhavet | abhipūjitalābhād yo jugupsāṃ yāti mānase ||45|| asaṃrodhena bhūtānāṃ pravarteta nirantaram | pratiśrayārthaṃ seveta nirvighnāṃ pārvatīṃ guhām ||46 || pūtābhirbuddhibhiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ naijaṃ kurvīta mokṣavit | viśvāsyaḥ śrīhareścāyaṃ jāyeta mokṣamarjayet ||47 || gṛhadharmāśritaścāpi vijñānicaritaṃ caret | amūḍho mūḍharūpeṇa cared bhaktiṃ mamottamām ||48 || ya eva vratasampanno mucyate sarvabandhanaiḥ | dhyāyenmāṃ kāntamāsthāya mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||49|| yo na kāmayate kiñcinna kiñcidavamanyate | iha lokasya evāpi brahmabhūyāya kalpate ||3.177.50 || tyaktvā guṇamayaṃ sarvaṃ karma śrīparamātmani | snehena mayi saṃsakto mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||51 || ucchvāsamātramapi yo hyantakāle smareddharim | sa māṃ tadopasaṃgamya hyamṛtatvāya kalpate ||52|| nimeṣamātramapi cet saṃyamyātmānamātmani | bhajate māṃ mayā dṛṣṭo hyamṛtatvāya kalpate ||53 || iha loke janāḥ kecidicchanti dharmameva ha | kecijjñānaṃ ca vijñānaṃ kecidvirāgameva ha ||54|| kecid deśaṃ ca vā kālaṃ kecid daivaṃ vadantyapi | kecit snānaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ kecidasnānamityapi | |55 || anye tvāhāramevāpi pare cānaśanaṃ tathā | karmaṇyeva ratāścānye śānto ratāstathāpare ||5 6 || kecinmuktiṃ praśaṃsanti kecid bhogān pṛthagvidhān | kecidarthān svarṇarūpyān kecittu niṣparigrahṛm ||5 7|| upāsanaṃ pare cāpi kecid yajñaparāyaṇāḥ | keciddhiṃsāmahiṃsāṃ vā puṇyaṃ vrataṃ tathā pare || |58 || tīrthaṃ cānye pare sevāmupakāraṃ tathetare | sadbhāvaṃ cāpare dhyānaṃ kecittapaḥ prakurvate ||9 9 || svādhyāyaṃ pūjanaṃ dānaṃ cānye satyaṃ vadantyapi | sannyāsamapare cāpi bhṛgoḥ pātaṃ tathāpare ||3.177.6 0 || tyāgaṃ cānye viraktiṃ ca gārhasthyaṃ cāpare tathā | anye nirdvandvavāsaṃ ca tathānye yāvadarpaṇam || 61 || sarve dharmaviśeṣāste lakṣmi śreyaḥpradāḥ śubhāḥ | mama sambandhayuktāścenmokṣadāḥ sarva eva te || 62 || mama yogena hīnāstu saṃsārakardamārpakāḥ | śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ miśraṃ yadarjyate tu taiḥ kṛtaiḥ || 63 || bhoktavyaṃ ceha vānyatra nābhuktaṃ tad vinaśyati | bhogārthaṃ dehasambandhaḥ saṃsārastena vai dhruvaḥ || 64|| teṣveteṣu tu vijñānaṃ niḥśreya iti sarvathā | bhaktiśca mokṣadā kṛṣṇe śāśvatī sukhakāriṇī ||65|| āśīryuktāni karmāṇi cānyāni kurvate tu ye | te’tra loke pramodante jāyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||66|| phalaṃ tyaktvā harau ye kurvate te sādhudarśinaḥ | upabhuṃkte samastaṃ saḥ kintu puṣkarapatravat ||67|| savairbhogaiḥ susampanno hyapi vidvānna lipyate | jalabinduryathāsaṃgī patrastho’pi na lipyate ||68|| evaṃ cāyaṃ cidātmāpi mayyarpito na badhyate | sarvārpaṇayuto bhaktaḥ pralipto’pi na lipyate ||69|| sahasraṇāpi durmedhā na bodhamadhigacchati | caturthenāpyathāṃśena buddhimān sukhamedhate ||3.177.70 || upāyajño hi medhāvī sukhamatyantamaśnute | yāvad rathapathastāvad gantavyaṃ rathavarṣmaṇā ||71 || kṣīṇe rathapade cāgre gantavyaṃ rathinātmanā | padasṛtau ca līnāyāṃ gantavyaṃ haṃsagāminā ||72|| garuḍagāminā hastigāminā vyomagāminā | sarvatra gāminā cāpi gantavyaṃ guruśārṅgiṇā ||73 || yāvajjalaṃ tu bāhubhyāṃ nāvā vāgre sareddhrade | pāraṃ prāpya tato nāvamutsṛjya yānataḥ saret ||74|| bhūtalaṃ sarvamullaṅghya vimānenāgrataḥ saret | vimānasyāviṣaye tu viṣṇunā saha sañcaret ||75|| viṣṇorapyaviṣaye tu muktaiḥ sahāgrataḥ saret | māyāmayaṃ samutsṛjya mukto gacchetparāṃ gatim ||76 || tapa oṣadhamutkṛṣṭaṃ vidyā mātrā tathottamā | bhaktirasaḥ puṣṭikṛcca taiḥ puṣṭo yāti matpadam ||77|| yaddurāpaṃ ca durdṛśyaṃ durādharṣaṃ duranvayam | tatsarvaṃ tapasā sādhyaṃ sevayā kṛpayā ca me ||78 || dhyānayogena śuddhena bhaktyā premāḍhyayā tathā | āpnuvanti mahātmāno madīyaṃ lokamuttamam ||79|| mama dhyānaṃ dhruvaṃ kṛtvā prasannamatayo janāḥ | śāśvatānandasampūrṇaṃ māṃ prayāntyātmadarśinaḥ ||3.177.80|| karma vai maraṇaṃ proktaṃ naiṣkarmyamamṛtaṃ matam | ya evamamṛtaṃ nityaṃ śāśvataṃ cākṣaraṃ sukham ||81 || vaśyamātmasthamāsvādya māṃ veda na mṛto bhavet | amṛtāśanamāsādyāmṛto bhavati muktarāṭ ||82|| vyatītya sarvasaṃskārān saṃyamyātmānamātmani | parabrahma viditvātra paratra tatpadaṃ vrajet ||83 || prasāde khalu sattvasya sādhusevāratirbhavet | prasādaṃ prāpya sādhūnāṃ sādhupatiṃ labheddharim ||84|| vijñānapariniṣṭhānāṃ muktānāṃ gatirīdṛśī | viraktānāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ gatireṣā sanātanī ||885||| bhaktimatāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ saiva gatiḥ sanātanī | ityevaṃ lakṣmi ṛṣirāṭ sadvidyāyananāmakaḥ ||86|| śrutiphalāṃ bahukathāṃ kathayāmāsa muktaye | śrutiphalā tu papraccha kathaṃ bandhe pratiṣṭhase ||87|| vidyāyanastataḥ prāha dharmo hyeṣa yugārthinaḥ | api kīṭapataṃgānāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ pakṣiṇāmapi ||88|| sarīsṛpāṇāṃ dharmo’yaṃ patnyāstu bharaṇaṃ priye | striyo rakṣyāśca poṣyāśca na tyājyā grahaṇottaram ||89|| prapated yaśaso dīptāddharmāt strītyāgavān priye | dharmakāmārthakāryāṇi śuśrūṣā kulasantatiḥ ||3.177.90|| sarvaṃ patnyadhīnakaṃ tad gṛhasthasya sadā priye | ato’haṃ tava bandhe’smi vivāhitā yato hyasi ||91 || na vetti bhāryādharmaṃ yaḥ svadharmaṃ dampatībhavam | ayaśo mahadāpnoti narakām̐ścaiva gacchati |||92|| evameva ca nārīṇāṃ patirdharmaḥ paro mataḥ | bhartuḥ prasādānnārīṇāṃ ratiputraphalaṃ sadā ||93|| pālanāddhi patiḥ prokto bhartā ca bharaṇādapi | putradānād varadaśca patirdharmaḥ paro mataḥ ||94|| ityevaṃ sukṛtaṃ manye tasmād bandhe bhavāmyaham | bhavatī paripālyā me sarvadaiva prayatnataḥ |||955||| satāṃ nityaṃ kāṃkṣitaṃ yannaijānāṃ paripālanam | utpādya putraṃ hi pitā kṛtakṛtyo bhavet sadā ||96|| sā tvaṃ putravatī bhūtvā ṛṇānmāṃ parimocaya | ityuktā jñānaniratā naiṣkarmyamapi bodhitā ||97|| divyatāṃ prati gamitā kalpayāmāsa satsutam | mānasastatra vai drāk ca putrastasyā vyajāyata ||98|| nirvāṇākhyaḥ śāśvato vai dīkṣitaḥ sahasā tayā | pitrā cāpyupanītaśca vavṛdhe bodhadāyakaḥ ||99|| nirmohinīṃ śubhāṃ kanyāṃ vaikhānasasutāṃ śubhām | pariṇeme tato lakṣmi śrutiphalāyutaḥ patiḥ || 3.177.10 0|| sadvidyāyanaṛṣirāṭ kṛtvā samādhimuttamam | yayau brahmapadaṃ divyaṃ mama dhāma paraṃ sukham || 101 || paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya mananāddhāraṇādapi | nirbandho jīvavānmukto bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||1 02|| sahasraśo janānnārīḥ svakīyaśaraṇāgatān | bhuktān kartuṃ samarthaḥ syānmuktidharmādaro hi yaḥ || 1 03|| bhogān bhuktvāpi satataṃ jñānavairāgyavān bhavet | māyāśirasi caraṇau datvā yātyakṣaraṃ mama ||1 04|| iṣṭalābhān pralabdhvaiva paraṃ mokṣapradaṃ vrajet | nāryapi muktidharmāḍhyā divyā nārāyaṇī bhavet || 1 05|| jīvanmuktā bhavedatra sarvabhogavatī hyapi | dehānte paramaṃ dhāma gantrī me kṛpayā bhavet ||1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne’dhyātmādhibhūtādhidaivādhidaivatādinirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 177 ||
<3.178> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 7vṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi kathāṃ bhaktasya śobhanām | gṛhasthasya sadā cātmanivedinaḥ pramuktidām || 1 || āsīd bhakto bhikṣuko me bhikṣāyano munīśvaraḥ | ayācitāñjalināmnī bhāryā tasyābhavacchubhā || 2 || bhikṣāyanastriṣavaṇaṃ snāti nityaṃ sarovare | aśvapaṭṭe ca tatpatnī jalaṃ cādāya mandire || 3 || karoti mama pūjāṃ vai nityaṃ triṣavaṇe sthitā | evaṃ tayorhi dampatyormandire mama sarvadā || 4 || pūjayatormama mūrtiṃ vṛttistu jīvikātmikā | nirvahate bhaktalokairdattairannajalāmbaraiḥ || 5 || prātaḥ prapūjya tau māṃ ca mandirasya prasevanam | mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ dhūpadānaṃ dīpaprakāśanam || 6 || puṣpādyāharaṇaṃ cāpi pācanaṃ pātramarṣaṇam | ārārtrikaṃ tathā sthālanivedanaṃ jalārpaṇam || 7 || tāmbūladānakaṃ cāpi kuruto’tha visarjanam | nityamevaṃ cātmaniveditvaṃ kuruta ādarāt || 8 || ahamābhyāṃ pratyahaṃ vai bhikṣāyogaṃ karomi ca | kaścid bhaktaḥ samāgatya yātrālurvā paro’pi vā || 9 || arpayatyeva bhojyādi praṇirbṛhatastāvubhau | santuṣṭau mama bhaktau tau yadṛcchālābhatoṣiṇau || 3.178.10 || gārhasthyadharmamevāpi samācarata ādarāt | kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho moho nātmārthametayoḥ || 11 || māṃ harimurarīkṛtya matvā cāntaḥsthitaṃ sadā | kurutaḥ sarvakāryāṇi dehajānītarāṇi ca || 12|| bhojanaṃ jalapānaṃ ca tailābhyaṃgaṃ śaṅgārakam | sadveṣaṃ cotsavaṃ cāpi pramodaṃ ramaṇaṃ tathā || 1 3|| sarvaṃ māmeva saṃsmṛtya kuruto divyadṛṣṭitaḥ | ātmārpaṇaṃ vinā kvāpi naivācarata aicchikam || 14|| vyavasāyo’pi sarvo vai madātmakastayorabhūt | yadā bhikṣāṃ gṛhṇatastau kavale kavale harim || 15|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ smarataśca tau | śayyāyāṃ cāpi dolāyāṃ prayāse cetare’pi ca || 1 6|| māṃ smṛtvaiva pravartete na māṃ vihāya karhicit | ātape mama prītyarthaṃ jalakaṭādibandhanam || 17|| śītavāripradpānādi madarthaṃ kurutaḥ sadā | śaitye coṣṇasalilaṃ ca tathoṣṇabhojanādikam || 18|| madarthe tau hi kurutaścorṇavastrādikārpaṇam | varṣāyāṃ chatradānādi caikādaśyāṃ ca jāgaram || 1 9|| vrateṣu phalapuṣpāṇāṃ madarthānayana tathā | gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ vādyaśabda tālaṃ ca rañjanādikam || 3.178.20 || madarthaṃ kuruto nitya kathāṃ ca kuruto mama | evaṃ vai vartamānau tau kathāṃ saṃśṛṇuto mama ||21 || kāmo vai nirayo loke vāsanāmūlako mataḥ | kāmināṃ naiva mokṣo’sti tasmāt kāmaṃ parityajet ||22|| ayācitāñjaliḥ patnī śrutvā papraccha taṃ munim | bhūdeva bhikṣukaścāsse patirme bhavatārakaḥ ||23|| sandehaṃ kathayā jātaṃ pṛcchāmi taṃ nivartaya | kāmanā narakaṃ proktaṃ kāmināṃ muktireva na ||24|| āvāṃ gārhasthyadharmasthau kāmastatra tu vidyate | kathaṃkāraṃ bhavenmuktistyājyastasmānmanobhavaḥ ||25 || bhikṣāyanastu tacchrutvovāca patnīṃ nijāṃ priyām | satyaṃ bhārye nirayā vai lokāḥ sarve tu māyikāḥ ||26|| haryarpaṇamṛte patni haryarpaṇe tu nirguṇāḥ | kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca tyaktavyo lobha ityapi || 27|| nārāyaṇe pare tattve nirguṇatāṃ bhajeddhi saḥ | svātmasukhārthamevāyaṃ bandhano nirayapradaḥ ||28|| parātmanyarpito bhārye paramātmaprasaṃgadaḥ | hareḥ prasaṃgato bhārye māyā tatra vinaśyati ||29|| amāyikāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā bhavantyeva hi nirguṇāḥ | yathā śākādikaṃ sarvaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ salilaṃ phalam ||3.178.30|| māyikaṃ bhautikaṃ cāpi kṛṣṇārpitaṃ tu nirguṇam | tathā cakṣuḥ karo vakṣaḥ pādau kaṭirmanastathā ||3 1|| haryarpitaṃ kriyādyaṃ ca sarvaṃ bhavati nirguṇam | āvābhyāṃ śrīharernityaṃ pūjane sevane priye ||32|| dehendriyasvabhāvādyā arpyante nirguṇā hi te | tato nāsti nirayo naḥ kintu dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||33||| tena sevādidharmeṇa puṇyaṃ hareḥ prasaṃgataḥ | bhikṣuko’haṃ bhikṣukī tvaṃ bhikṣā hareḥ sadā hi nau ||34|| āvayorbhikṣukaḥ kṛṣṇo nirguṇaḥ parameśvaraḥ | tadyogenāvayośceṣṭā kṛṣṇātmikā tu nirguṇā ||35|| tasmāt patni sarvakārye smara kṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram | na māṃ na tvāṃ kintu kṛṣṇaṃ śleṣe viśleṣaṇe’pi ca ||36|| evaṃ naivāsti loke’tra dehe vā bandhanaṃ tava | mamāpi bandhanaṃ nāsti parārthakarmaṇoḥ priye ||37|| ityevaṃ bodhyamānāpi lakṣmi sā munibhikṣukī | sādhvī viśvāsamāpannā manāgapi ca vai tataḥ ||38|| punaḥ sañcintayāmāsa kāmo’yaṃ kalmaṣātmakaḥ | pāpamevāsti nirayaprado duḥkhaprado’pi ca ||39|| evaṃ cintayate nityaṃ bhajate māṃ satī sadā | ekadāhaṃ tayoḥ sākṣādabhavaṃ netragocaraḥ ||3.178.40 || tasyāḥ śaṃkāvināśārthaṃ cāspṛśaṃ svakareṇa tām | sā mumoha svarūpe me sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhite ||41 || samāściṣattūrṇameva māṃ mugdhā patisannidhau | mayā tasyai vinā bhogaṃ sparśamātreṇa sarvathā ||42|| sarvānandāḥ pradattā vai sukhinī sā parābhavat | divyābhavattata ārabhyaiva niṣkāmabhāvanā ||43 || saṃkalpaḥ kāmanājanyastasyā naṣṭo’ntarāt sadā | niṣkāmā sā muktarūpā brahmavratorjitābhavat ||44|| bhikṣuko’pi tayā spṛṣṭo niṣkāmaḥ sarvathābhavat | brahmaśīlavratau tau tu tadārabhyārkabhāsvarau ||45|| vilakṣaṇau devapūjyau lokapūjyau babhūvatuḥ | evaṃ nityaṃ sevayā me mayā niṣkāminau kṛtau ||46|| mama yogena nāryo’pi narāścāpi hyakāminaḥ | bhavantyeveti te sarve prayānti paramaṃ padam ||47|| kālena nidhanaṃ prāptau divyavimānasaṃsthitau | muktarūpau tu tau bhūtvā yayaturdhāma me’kṣaram ||48|| evaṃ lakṣmi cātmanivedinoḥ strīnarayoriha | sarvadoṣānnāśayāmi guṇān divyān karomi ca ||49|| sarvaṃ kartuṃ samarthasya dayāloḥ paramātmanaḥ | bhaktāya tvāgamo loke bhaktān santārayāmi vai ||3.178.5 0 || bhikṣā bahuvidhā lakṣmi dātavyā pataye tu me | sarvā sā nirguṇā tena jāyate mama yogataḥ ||5 1|| samākarṇaya kamale vividhāṃ kathayāmi te | yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ svasya sarvaṃ bhikṣātmakaṃ matam |||52|| svapne jāgrati sauṣupte turye muktau yadiṣṭakam | anarpitaṃ na vai grāhyaṃ mahyaṃ datvā samālabhet ||53 || bhojanaṃ rāsanaṃ sarvaṃ miṣṭaṃ miṣṭaṃ diśenmayi | pānaṃ svādu yadiṣṭaṃ ca dadyānmahyaṃ mamāśrayī ||54|| vastrāṇi yāni ramyāṇi veṣāśca bhūṣaṇādikam | svarṇarūpyahīrakādi ratnāni cārpayenmayi ||55|| abhyaṃgādi sugandhādi kajjalādi diśenmayi | mukuṭādi śayanādi gendukādi ca me’rpayet |||56|| vitānādi cāsanādi yānādyapi ca me’rpayet | mandirādi vāhanādi vimānādi ca me’rpayet ||57|| dhūpadīpādi puṣpādi candanādīni me’rpayet | gajavājigavādīni dāsadāsīśca me’rpayet ||58|| rūpāṇi sarvaramyāṇi śabdān śrāvyām̐śca me’rpayet | sparśān sarvavidhām̐ścāpi grāhyān sarvāṃśca me’payet |||59 || gantavyān sukhabhājaścānanditavyām̐śca me’rpayet | miṣṭānnāni samagrāṇi tulasīmañjarīrdiśet ||3.178.60 || tailasārān karpūrādi dadyānmahyaṃ tu bhikṣave | putraṃ putrīṃ patiṃ patnīṃ sarvasvaṃ me’rpayet sadā || 61 || mahyaṃ sarvāṇyāyughāni sarvayantrāṇi me’rpayet | yajñayāgādikāryāṇi havanādīni me’rpayet || 62|| arpayenme’pi sasyāni kaṇiśām̐śca kaṇām̐stathā | miṣṭarasāḍhyauṣadhīśca madhvādīni ca me’rpayet ||63 || aṣṭaṣaṣṭikalāścāpi navavastūni me’rpayet | prakāśaṃ cāprakāśaṃ ca sarvaṃ mahyaṃ diśejjanaḥ ||64|| āyaścotpādanaṃ sarvaṃ vṛddhirdravyasya vastunaḥ | hārdikaṃ daihikaṃ cāpyaindriyakaṃ me samarpayet ||65|| patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ vāri mahyaṃ datvā suyojayet | vidyāṃ jñānaṃ vivekaṃ ca kauśalyaṃ guṇaśālitām ||66|| nyāyaṃ paropakāraṃ ca sarvaṃ mahyaṃ samarpayet | saṃkalpā viphalā ye ca ye cānte phaladāyinaḥ ||67|| kṛtayaścāpi yatnāśca tānme sarvān samarpayet | aiśvaryāṇi samastāni sarvāṇyapi balāni ca || 68|| avasthāścāpi sarvāśca camatkārāḥ samastakāḥ | saundaryaguṇayogāśca tānme sarvān samarpayet || 69 || ahaṃ parārtho bhavatāṃ bhikṣuścānantasaṃkhyadaḥ | gṛhītvā pradadāmyeva śāśvataṃ bhikṣayārthitam ||3.178.70|| rājyaṃ svargaṃ divyalokān bhogām̐śca sampado navāḥ | sukhāni cotsavānmodān harṣān pratidadāmyaham ||71 || dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ cāmbarāṇi bhavanānyuttamāni ca | godhanaṃ dāsadāsīśca putrān putrīrdadāmyaham |||02|| dhiṣṇyaṃ cāpi ca māhendraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmamityapi | dikpālatvaṃ caiśvaraṃ vā vairājaṃ padamuttamam ||73|| aiśaṃ vā lokapālatvaṃ maharṣitvaṃ guroḥ padam | dhrauvyaṃ vā sauramevāpi cāndraṃ rājyaṃ dadāmyaham ||74|| vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ cāvyākṛtaṃ golokamakṣaram | śrīpuraṃ brahmalokaṃ vā paraṃdhāma dadāmyaham ||75|| bhikṣayāmi bhavadbhyo’haṃ sarvaṃ me rocate sadā | dāne labhe bhunajmyetad bhuktvā dadāmyanantakam ||76|| puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ śubhaṃ cāpyaśubhaṃ saṃbhikṣayāmyaham | aniṣṭaṃ janatādattaṃ labdhveṣṭaṃ pratisandade ||77|| alābhaṃ prāpya lābhātmaṃ phalaṃ pratidadāmyaham | svalpaṃ prāpya ca bahudhā yatheṣṭaṃ pradadāmyaham ||78|| lakṣmīṃ dadāmi vipulāṃ sampadaścātivarculāḥ | śaktīrdadāmi bahudhā jayaṃ dadāmi nityadā ||79|| madīyaṃ yadbhavet sarvaṃ sarvaṃ tasmai dadāmyaham | yo mahyaṃ prārpayet sarvaṃ mama bhūtvā ca vartate ||3.178.80|| lakṣmītyevaṃ samartho’smi sarvaṃ dātumanantakam | bhikṣukāścenmadarthaṃ vai bhikṣayantyarpayanti ca ||8 1 || tataśca bhuñjate tebhyaḥ phalaṃ dadāmyanantakam | bahavo nāma rājāno viprāścarṣaya ityamī ||82|| tapaso’nte tu bhikṣayāmāsurmāmeva putrakam | putro’bhavaṃ bhikṣukāṇāṃ muhurvai bhikṣito mudhā ||83|| gaṇeśo’haṃ śaṃkarasya hariḥ kṛṣṇo vṛṣasya ca | aditervāmanaścāpi kapilaḥ kardamasya ca ||84|| vasudevasya gopālo nābheḥ ṛṣabha ityapi | kaṃbharāyā anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’smi ca ||85|| datto’trerjamadagneśca parśurāmastathābhavam | rāmaḥ śatarathasyāpi kumāro brahmaṇastathā ||86|| evamādyāni janmāni bhikṣārūpāṇi tāni vai | bhikṣāyāṃ vartate sarvaṃ bhikṣāyāṃ cāhamityapi ||87|| bhikṣukā me’tivātsalyapātrāṇi mama rūpiṇaḥ | bhikṣāyāṃ bhṛguṇā dattā bhārgavī tvaṃ pareśvarī ||88| padmāpi bhikṣayā labdhā nārāyaṇo tathaiva ca | duḥkhahāśrīstathā labdhā lakṣmīśca māṇikī tathā ||89 || prajñā padmāvatī labdhā bhikṣāyā kamalā ramā | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhogavān mokṣavān bhavet || 3.178.90 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne bhikṣā yanarṣeḥ ayācitāñjalināmabhāryāyā gārhasthye’pi śrīharyarpaṇakriyādibhirmuktirbhikṣāmahimā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā aṣṭasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 178 ||
<3.179> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi bhāvukākhye pure vaiśyo hyanāthakaḥ | ābālyānmṛtajanako jananīpoṣito hyamum || 1 || mātā nityāśrayānāmnī putraṃ tu veśinaṃ sadā | pālayatyekameveyaṃ vaṃśavṛddhipramūlakam || 9 || nityaṃ sā vidhavā kṛṣṇamandire viprasannidho | kathāṃ śrotuṃ prayātyeva yayā duḥkhaṃ praṇaśyati | 9 || kathājñānena sahasā dhairyaṃ prajāyate śubham | tāpā naśyanti duḥkhāni cintālayo bhavatyati || 4 || sā saṃhitāṃ praśuśrāva lakṣmīnārāyaṇābhidham | varṣadvayaṃ praśuśrāva sarvākhyānāni bhāminī || 5 || kathāstā vividhāḥ śrutvā brahmarūpā vyajāyata | satī sādhvīdharmayuttā vartate sā videhinī || 6 || nityāśrayeti svanāmno’rthaṃ viveda tato hi sā | nitye harau svāmideve tvāśrayo mama vidyate || 7 || hariḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ svāmī patnī tasya bhavāmyaham | sevanīyaḥ sadānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 8 || gopālabālakaḥ sākṣāt kambharānandano’vyayaḥ | koṭyarbudābjalakṣmīnāṃ patiḥ śrīpatirīśvaraḥ || 9 || sa eva nijabhaktānāṃ sarvakāmaprapūrakaḥ | bhuktimuktipradaḥ svāmī nārāyaṇaḥ priyaḥ patiḥ || 3.179.10 || evaṃ jñānaṃ samāpannā vrataṃ tapasi saṃsthitā | cakre’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtiprasevanam || 11 || tayā vai tāmrapatre me kāritā pratimā śubhā | tatpūjā vai vrataṃ nityaṃ pālitaṃ svārpaṇātmakam || 12 || śṛṇu lakṣmi yathāsevāṃ kṛtavatī tu sābhavat | prātarutthāya pṛthvyāṃ sā oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇa || 13 || itināmnāmaṣṭottaraśataṃ japati mālayā | tato dhyānaṃ mama mūrteḥ karoti śayane sthitā || 14|| pādau jaṃghe jānunī ca sakthinī jaghanādikam | kaṭi nābhimudaraṃ ca vakṣaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ dvipārśvakam || 15|| kaṇṭhaṃ mukhaṃ kapolau ca gaṇḍau bhālaṃ ca cakṣuṣī | karṇau śikhāṃ dhyāyatīti tataḥ snānaṃ karoti sā || 16|| anāthamātā bhaktā me’nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇa | nāmajapaṃ karotyeva snāne vārighaṭaṃ tu sā || 17|| sūryāya pitṛbhyaścāpi dadāti dyunivāsine | tulasīpatrapuṣpāṇi stambebhyaḥ svayameva hi ||18|| ācitvā candanaṃ ghṛṣṭvā nīravā cāyāti vai gṛham | mūrtiṃ me tvāsane nyasyāvāhanaṃ cāsanādikam ||1 9|| pādyamarghyamācamanīyakaṃ jalaṃ dadāti me | jalena candanenāpi vāriṇā kusumaistathā ||3.179.20||| vinā pañcāmṛtaṃ pañcāmṛtanāmnārcayatyapi | vastraṃ yajñopavītaṃ cāmalakaṃ bhūṣaṇārthakam ||21 || taṇḍulān sarvaśṛṃgārārthaṃ ca kuṃkumamuttamam | arpayatyeva me sādhvī dhūpaṃ candanacūrṇajam ||22|| dīpaṃ tailenārpayati naivedyaṃ caṇakādikam | phalaṃ vā tilapātraṃ vā gūḍaṃ vā prātareva sā ||23|| dadātyapi yathālabdhaṃ jalaṃ tathārpayatyapi | nīrājanaṃ karotyeva ghaṇṭīnādaprapūrvakam ||24|| pradakṣiṇāṃ namaskāraṃ stutiṃ visarjanaṃ śubham | puṣpāñjaliprapūrvaṃ ca karotyevaṃ sadā prage || 25|| tato vai gṛhakāryaṃ sā karoti bālalālanam | bālasya rakṣaṇaṃ stanyadānaṃ bālasya bhojanam ||26|| bhṛtyatālabdhasantuṣṭā poṣaṇaṃ sā karoti vai | annavastrādisantuṣṭā patiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prasevate ||27|| tato dāsīsvarūpā sā bhṛtyā bhṛtyatvakarmaṇe | yāti śreṣṭhigṛhe pātramañjanādividhitsayā ||28||| bhṛtyākāryaṃ vinirvartya madhyāhne’nnaphalādikam | prāpyate śreṣṭhibhāryātastadādāya gṛhaṃ nijam ||29|| samāyāti madbhajanānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇa | nityaṃ śreṣṭhikuṭumbaṃ tacchṛṇoti nāmakīrtanam ||3.179.3 0|| madbhaktaṃ tadabhūt sarvaṃ śreṣṭhī vṛddho’pi rūpaśaḥ | kālena nidhanaṃ yātastadā nityāśrayā gṛhe ||3 1 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti dhunyamācarat | ahaṃ tayā samākṛṣṭo yayau vai śreṣṭhino’ntikam |||32|| sākṣādabhavaṃ tasyāgre tasyāścāgre striyāstathā | divyaṃ me marśanaṃ datvā ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ hi tam ||3 3|| vimānena sudivyena kuṭumbaṃ tad vyalokayam | sarvaṃ madbhaktimajjātaṃ tayā hyanāthayā rame ||34|| madhyāhne hyevameveyaṃ nityaṃ śreṣṭhigṛhakriyām | kṛtvāyāti gṛhaṃ naijaṃ bhojayitvā nijaṃ sutam ||35|| dugdhaṃ saṃpāyayitvā ca bhuṃkte kṛṣṇasmṛtisthitā | sāyaṃ nirājanaṃ cāpi karoti bhajanaṃ mama ||36|| bhojanaṃ sā tato datvā mahyaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ hyapi | svapiti bālakaṃ kṛtvā pārśve’pare ca māmapi ||37|| evaṃ nityaṃ bhajate māṃ nityāśrayā tu vaiṣṇavī | bālo’pi mātṛbhaktiṃ vai dṛṣṭvā bhaktatamo’bhavat ||38|| yathā mātā tathā putraḥ saṃskṛtaścātmavedanaḥ | mahābhāgavato bālye rome’rhaṇādikhelanaiḥ ||39|| kṛtrimāṃ mṛttikāmūrtiṃ saṃsthāpyavālukāsane | kardamādicandanādyaiḥ pupūja pratimāṃ mama ||3.179.40|| tṛṇapatrāṇi bhūsthāni dhṛtvārpayati bhāvataḥ | puṣpāṇīti pramatvaiva mātṛvat salilaṃ tathā ||41 || mṛttikābhagnapātrādau samarpayati sādaram | bhojanaṃ nimbapakvasatphalaṃ cānyad dadāti ca ||42|| pradakṣiṇāṃ daṇḍavacca karoti mālikāṃ tathā | kṣamāṃ samprārthayatyeva dayāṃ prasannatāṃ hareḥ ||43|| visarjayati sarvaṃ tat tato mitraiḥ sahāpi ca | ramate tu gṛhāgre vai bhajannārāyaṇaṃ tu mām ||44|| evaṃ kāle gate so’pi yuvābhavatprabhaktarāṭ | mātāpi bhajate māṃ ca prasanno’haṃ tayostadā ||45|| abhavaṃ cāgatastatra viprarūpadharo hariḥ | bhikṣāṃ tatrārthayāmāsa nityāśrayā tu māṃ tadā ||46|| dadau vai roṭakaṃ tvekaṃ takraṃ dadau prabhuktaye | ahaṃ gṛhāṃgaṇe tatra niṣadya bhuktavān manāk ||47|| ardhaṃ tu roṭakaṃ tasmai bālāya cārpayaṃ tathā | takraṃ pradadau svalpaṃ ca dugdhaṃ tatkṛtavānaham ||48|| yuvā putro vismitaścovāca tvamātaraṃ muhuḥ | mātastakramidaṃ dugdhaṃ jātaṃ vipraprasādataḥ ||49|| roṭako’yaṃ miṣṭamiśro ghṛtākto’pi vyajāyata | so’yamataścamatkārī vidyate brāhmaṇottamaḥ ||3.179.50|| mātāścaryaṃ paraṃ śrutvā mugdhā vyalokayat prabhum | dṛṣṭyā dṛṣṭiṃ samprayojya tāvaccaturbhujo’bhavam ||51|| divyo divyāvayavaśca divyasarvāṃgabhūṣaṇaḥ | divyacihno’bhavaṃ lakṣmīsahitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||52|| tadā sā māṃ vilokyaiva śrīpatiṃ parameśvaram | papāta pādayorme ca trāyasva vyājahāra ca ||53 || putraḥ keśīsaṃjñakaśca jñātvā māṃ parameśvaram | anāthanāthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ papāta pādayormama ||54||| tuṣṭāva māṃ bālakaśca mātā tuṣṭāva vihvalā | kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇakṛpāsindho hyanāthanātha mādhava ||55|| tava svo bhavasaṃsārāt tāraya śrīrhare pate | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkṛṣṇamatprabho ||56 || bhavatā viprarūpeṇa tāritau mātṛputrakau | anāthānāṃ bhavān nāthaśceti satyaṃ vacastava ||57|| mayā kathā hi bahudhā śrutā te parameśvara | virāgaṃ paramaṃ prāpya sevito’si janārdana ||58 || jñānaṃ prāpya patiṃ jñātvā tvāṃ bhajāmi ca nityadā | bālo’yaṃ bhavato nātha tvaṃ nibhālaya putrakam ||59|| māṃ dhāmākṣarasaṃjñaṃ te naya śrīpuruṣottama | svāmin kānta suhṛd bandho rakṣaka śrīhare’va mām || 3.179.60 || ityevamuktvā sā lakṣmi puṣpāñjaliṃ dadau mayi | pādau jagrāha me cāpi ruroda premavihvalā || 61 || plāvitau mama pādau tu tadaśrubhistayā rame | putro’pi cātmanivedī premāśrūṇi mumoca ha ||62||| muktiṃ dehi kṛpāsindho parameśa śriyaḥ pate | ityuvāca karau dhṛtvā vakṣo vakṣo niyujya ca || 63 || āśliṣṭavān yathā putraḥ pitaraṃ tattathā sa mām | mayāśrūṇi pramuktāni putraṃ bhaktatamaṃ prati || 64|| sa tairāpluta evābhūd divyadṛṣṭistato’bhavat | nibhālitā ca tanmātā kṛpādṛṣṭyā mayā rame || 671|| sāpi divyā divyadṛṣṭistadā tūrṇaṃ vyavartata | trikālajñau kṛpayā me nirbandho siddhisaṃśritau ||66 || lakṣmīvanmuktavat tau tu jātau divyavihāriṇau | divyopakaraṇaistatra saṃkalpitaiḥ samāhṛtaiḥ || 67|| pūjayāmāsaturmāṃ ca mumucaturna māṃ hi tau | atra vāsaṃ kuru kṛṣṇetyāhatustau muhurmuhuḥ || 68 || yadvā naya nau sahaivetyeva jagadatustadā | ahaṃ rūpaṃ susaṃkucya viprarūpaḥ punastadā ||69|| abhavaṃ tau siṣevāte vyajanena karaistathā | ahaṃ vicārya muktiṃ vai tayordivyasvarūpiṇau ||3.179.7 0 || sahaiva nītvā sūryābhe vimāne cādhyarohayam | putraṃ tu keśinaṃ prasūṃ nityāśrayāṃ hyanāthinīm ||7 1 || prāpayāmāsa tūrṇaṃ me dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ padam | evaṃ lakṣmi hyanāthānāṃ nātho’haṃ bhavatārakaḥ ||72|| vallabho’smi prabhaktānāṃ mokṣadaḥ sudayāvaśaḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhavecchubhā ||73|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne anāthāyā nityāśrayāyāstatputrasya keśinaśca bhāgavatīṃ bhaktiṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavatā dattaṃ darśanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 179 ||
<3.180> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ cānyāṃ mama bhaktasya śobhanām | māyākhye nagare tvāsīd bhakto me vyāghrasaṃjñakaḥ || 1 || ābālyād daivabhāvaśca sādhuṣu snehavān śuciḥ | yatayo ye samāyānti vaiṣṇavā nyāsinīpi ca || 2 || darśanārthaṃ prayātyeva sādhūnāṃ śīghrameva saḥ | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ vārisamānayanamityapi || 3 || karoti pātraśuddhyādi mārjanaṃ ca sadāśrame | prasādaṃ ca samaśnāti sevate ca sataḥ sadā || 4 || evaṃ bhaktiyuto bhakto mahāśīrvādamāpa ha | ciraṃ jīva ciraṃ tiṣṭha sukhī bhava samṛddhimān || 5 || athāyaṃ sādhusevāyāṃ vartamāno’pi caikadā | bālabhāvena lobhena patitāṃ svarṇaśṛṃkhalām || 6 || jagrāha cauryarūpeṇa vāsudevavibhūṣaṇam | sādhavastu gatāścānyagrāmaṃ vyāghrastu śṛṃkhalām || 7 || mārjanādau labdhavām̐ścāprakāśe’rakṣayaddhi tām | ānīya svagṛhe svarṇaśṛṃkhalāṃ nidadhe puṭe || 8 || naiva jānāti kaścidvai tathāyaṃ samarakṣayat | mātā vai tvasya peṭāyāṃ naiva jānāti śṛṃkhalām || 9 || pitāpi cāraṇo nāmnā kūṭadevo na śṛṃkhalām | jānāti tadvidhāṃ svarṇaśṛṃkhalāṃ kāṣṭhapeṭake || 3.180.1 0|| dhṛtāṃ svayaṃ vijānāti cāprakāśe prapaśyati | punaśca tatra peṭāyāṃ guptāṃ tāṃ nidadhāti ca || 11 || atha sādhuḥ śyāmanāmā viṣṇumūrteḥ prapūjakaḥ | grāmāntare tu pūjāyāṃ yāvadicchati śṛṃkhalām || 1 2|| adṛṣṭvā pūjane kāle’tarkayat patitā bhavet | pṛcchāṃ cākārayad bhaktairdvārā māyāpure muhuḥ || 1 3|| vyāghraṃ bhaktāḥ samapṛcchan vyāghro dṛṣṭā na ceti vai | pratyuttaraṃ dadau tebhyo lobhena ca bhayena ca || 1 4|| evamasatyabhāvasya vyāghrasya cauryapāpataḥ | svarṇacaurasya karayodvayaścāṃgulikāsu tu || 1 5|| galatkuṣṭhānyabhavam̐ścāṃguṣṭhayorapi sarvathā | śarīra śvetakuṣṭhāścābhavan cauryāghajaṃ phalam || 16 || bhajate bhagavantaṃ māṃ tathauṣadhaṃ karotyapi | kuṣṭhā naiva vilīyante duḥkhī cātīva so’bhavat || 17 || sādhusevāphalabhāk ca svarṇacauryāghabhāgapi | śuśrāva sa kathāṃ lakṣmīsaṃhitāyāśca tatra ha || 18 || śrutavān svarṇacauryasya phalaṃ kuṣṭho bhavediti | prāyaścittaṃ tasya cāpi śrutavān svarṇadānakam || 19 || brahmakṛcchravrataṃ cāpi brahmakūrcavrataṃ tathā | saptāhikaṃ prakuryāccet svarṇasteyī pramucyate || 3.180.2 0 || athāyaṃ cāprakāśe vai chadmanodarapīḍanam | bahiḥ prakāśayitvaiva brahmakūrcavrataṃ vyadhāt || 21 || papau vāri dine tvādye khadirapatrapācitam | dvitīye tu papau vāri kiṃśukapuṣpapācitam || 22|| tṛtīye tu papau vāri bilvapatraprapācitam | caturthe tu papau vāri padmaphalaprapācitam || 23 || pañcame tu papau vāri hyudumbaraprapācitam | ṣaṣṭhe papau darbhapatrapācitaṃ ca tataḥ param || 24|| upoṣaṇaṃ saptame tu cakāra māṃ bhajan muhuḥ | ārādhanā cakārāpi mūrtyagre mama cāghahām || 25 || hare svarṇaṃ mayā cāptaṃ mārjanaṃ tatra kurvatā | tatpāpa kuṣṭharūpaṃ vai lagnaṃ me tatkṣamāpaya | | 26 || svarṇamālāṃ pradāsyāmi tasmai tu sādhave punaḥ | brahma kūrcavratenāpi prāyaścittaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā || 27 || rogo’yaṃ me nāśametu bhaktārthaṃ tvaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru | trāhi pāhi jagannātha śrīhare puruṣottama || 28 || pāpyuddhāraprakartastvaṃ bhaktaṃ māṃ parirakṣaya | evaṃ māṃ cārthayāmāsātyarthamaśrūṇi vāhayan | | 29 | | cintayāmāsa maraṇaṃ yadā kuṣṭho na naśyati | suṣvāpaivaṃ cintayānaḥ svapne’haṃ tasya sannidhau | | 3.180.30 | | darśayāmāsa rūpaṃ me śaṃkhacakragadādharam | hasannahaṃ jagādainaṃ bhakta śocasi kiṃ vada | | 31 || sa āha māṃ kṛpāsindho lobhāt svarṇasya śṛṃkhalā | sādhorviṣṇormayā cāptā patitā bhūtale tu sā || 32 || rakṣitā me gṛhe cāste phalaṃ bhunajmi kuṣṭhakam | śrutvā kathāṃ svarṇacauryaprāyaścittaṃ mayā kṛtam ||33|| brahmakūrcavrataṃ kṛṣṇa pāpaṃ nāśaya me prabho | ityevaṃ prārthayāmāsa tato’haṃ tasya sannidhau || 34|| svapnaṃ vilupya sahasā jāgare taṃ samānayam | so’pi tatrotthitastūrṇaṃ māṃ vilokya pareśvaram ||35|| premagadgadapūrṇo’bhūttuṣṭāva daṇḍavattathā | nanarta premapūrṇaśca yayāce ca kṣamāṃ tathā ||36|| tato’haṃ tasya doṣasya nuttaye taṃ jagāda ha | svarṇasya śṛṃkhalā mahyaṃ dehi te’ghaṃ gataṃ khalu ||37|| atha vyāghro dadau mahyaṃ samutthāya tu śṛṃkhalām | mayā dhṛtā svakaṇṭhe sā tāvat sā śṛṃkhalā tadā ||38|| te sādhavo yatra gatā abhavam̐statra tatsthale | mūrtikaṇṭhe gatā cāsīt sādhustu dṛṣṭavām̐śca tām ||39|| jaharṣa tāṃ svarṇamālāṃ vilokya ca muhurmuhuḥ | kathayāmāsa sarvebhyaścamatkāraṃ hareḥ param ||3.180.40 || bhaktārthaṃ bhagavāneva yogaṃ kṣemaṃ karoti hi | sampadi vipadi cāpi cintayatyeva bhaktakam ||41 || yo yasya vai bhaved bhaktastadarthaṃ bhagavān svayam | bhagavattvaṃ dadātyeva naijaiśvaryaṃ samastakam ||4 || evaṃ lakṣmi pareśasya kṛpayā vyāghrabhaktarāṭ | drāgeva kuṣṭhatāhīno jātaḥ pāpavivarjitaḥ ||43|| subhago rūpavām̐ścāpi yathāpūrvaṃ vyajāyata | tasmādahaṃ svayaṃ nārāyaṇo rakṣāmi cāśritam ||44|| pāpinaṃ vā kalmaṣāḍhyaṃ māyādoṣābhisaṃplutam | vāsanāśatakoṭyāḍhyaṃ dharmakarmādivarjitam ||45|| api māṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptaṃ madarthatyaktajīvitam | madarthasarvavyāpāraṃ madarthadhyānapūjanam ||46 || mayi sarvasvārpaṇaṃ ca rakṣāmi sarvathā janam | śṛṇu cānyāṃ kathāṃ divyāṃ pāpatāpapraṇāśinīm ||47|| dhanagrāme’bhavad vipro grāmayājaka uttamaḥ | uttamākhyaḥ sakuṭumbaḥ karmakāṇḍapradhānakaḥ ||48|| sarvavarṇajanānāṃ vai karmakāṇḍaprasādhakaḥ | nṛpasyāpi guruḥ so’pi nṛpakāryaṃ karoti ca ||49|| nṛpānnaṃ vai guru proktaṃ caurāṇāmannamityapi | adātṝṇāṃ janānāṃ ca patitānāṃ tathā guru ||3.180.50|| bhuktaṃ na jīryati lakṣmi pītaṃ cāpi na jīryati | vastrapātrādikaṃ dāne gṛhītaṃ nāpi jīryati ||51 || śayyāgosvarṇadānādiḥ parigraho na jīryati | grāmayājakaevāsāvuttamo nāma bhūsuraḥ ||52|| lobhena sarvavarṇānāmagrāhayaddhanādikam | bhuṃkte pibati cāśnāti ramate modate gṛhe ||53|| sampattiścāsya vai śreṣṭhābhavannṛpādhikā gṛhe | ratnahārāḥ svarṇamālāḥ svarṇaparyaṃkakāsanam ||54|| bhavanāni vicitrāṇi dāsā dāsyo hyanekaśaḥ | gomahiṣyādikāścāpi gajavājirathādayaḥ ||55|| sarvamasyābhavad ṛddhaṃ putrāḥ putryo’pi saukhyadāḥ | bhāryāpi bhaktisampannā dharmayutā pativratā ||56|| athāsya dānabhāreṇa pāpināṃ dravyasañcayaiḥ | pāpināmannapānādyairjalodaraṃ daro’bhavat ||57||| udaraṃ pīḍyate tena mahodaraṃ hi lambate | pacyate nahi bhuktaṃ vā pītaṃ jīryati naiva ca ||58|| sukhaṃ nāsya kṣaṇaṃ cāpi jāyate ṛddhibhistadā | vaidyāśramān yayau rogaśāntyarthaṃ ca tathāpyapi ||59|| auṣadhānāṃ prayogeṣu bahuṣvapi jalodaram | naṣṭaṃ naiva hi pratyuta vyavardhata dine dine ||3.180.60|| athaikadā yayau devāyanarṣiṃ prati bhūsuraḥ | nyavedayannijaṃ rogaṃ sādhave prapraṇamya saḥ ||6 1 || sādhurdadau harernāma mālāṃ ca tulasījanim | ohare śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa māṃ nirujaṃ kuru ||62|| iti jāpaṃ bhūsurāyopādideśa sahasrakam | nityameveti so’pyevaṃ jajāpa pratyahaṃ mudā ||63|| bhajate māṃ sadā so’yaṃ roganāśārthameva ha | ārto bhajate māṃ nitya vaibhavī bhajate na vai ||64|| vaibhavyārto bhajate māṃ svārthārthaṃ so’bhajad yathā | evaṃ varṣottare kāle bhaktiṃ prakurvataḥ puraḥ ||65|| dayayāhaṃ darśanaṃ svaṃ dadau rogapraśāntaye | sādhūnāṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā yayau tasya gṛhaṃ prati ||66|| so’pi rogapraśāntyarthaṃ bhojanādi dadau mudā | svarṇarūpyāmbarādyaṃ ca sādhubhyo vividhaṃ dadau ||67|| prārthayāmāsa cātyarthaṃ rogaśāntyarthamityapi | ahaṃ sādhugururbhūtvā hastaṃ tasyodare’dadham ||68|| camatkāro yathā syādvai tathāsyodaratastadā | jalodaro mahān rogo mūrtimān samapāsarat ||69|| kadrūpaḥ sabhayaścāpi dudrāva ca dadhāva ca | gato rogo bhūsuraśca svastho’bhavat kṣaṇāntare ||3.180.70 || jalaṃ śuṣkaṃ tadā jātaṃ jāṭharaścābhavacchubhaḥ | vayaṃ sarve sādhavastu śīghramadṛśyatāṃ gatāḥ ||71 || so’pi vijñāya māṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tato’bhajan muhuḥ | evaṃ lakṣmi mayā bhakto nirāmayastadā kṛtaḥ ||72|| so’pi cānte yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ me paramātmanaḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsyārogyaṃ bhuktiśca mokṣaṇam ||73 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne kuṣṭhino vyāghrākhyasya svarṇacaurasya cāraṇabhaktasya kuṣṭhitānāśanam uttamākhyasya grāmayājakaviprasya bhaktasya jalodaranāśanaṃ bhagavaddarśanaṃ muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā aśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 180 ||
<3.181> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ virālasya kathāṃ śubhām | virālanāmako bhakto māñjuṣṭhagrāmavāsakṛt || 1 || abhūt kuṭumbasahito dhanāḍhyo vaiśya eva saḥ | annānāṃ cāmbarāṇāṃ ca pātrāṇāṃ vikrayādikṛt || 2 || lakṣādhidravyavān dharmī sādhusevāparāyaṇaḥ | yena nirmāpitā ramyā dharmaśālātiśobhanā || 3 || yatrātithayaścāgatya viśrāntiṃ yānti sādhavaḥ | pravāsino yatayaśca sādhvyo yātrālavastathā || 4 || yenānnasatraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ca tatra nirmāpitaṃ śubham | yatra miṣṭaṃ rasayuktamannaṃ dugdhaṃ tathaudanam || 5 || pūrikāḥ sūpaśākādi labhante bhikṣavaḥ sadā | bhuñjate śataśo nityaṃ dadātyāśīrvacāṃsi ca || 6 || nityaṃ virālavaiśyo’pi svahastena tu dakṣiṇām | dānaṃ dadāti bālebhyo’nāthebhyaḥ strībhya ityapi || 7 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo kīrtanaṃ kārayatyapi | pūjanaṃ me karotyevaṃ kārayatyapi pratyaham || 8 || putrāstasyābhavan pañca putryaḥ sapta striyāvubhe | sarve te māṃ pūjayanti śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam || 9 || sāyaṃ militvā me’gre te kīrtanaṃ vidadhatyapi | kathāṃ kurvanti ca ramyāṃ śṛṇvanti ca parasparam || 3.181.10 || evaṃ vai puṇyayuktasya virālasya susampadaḥ | anatiprāptavṛddhatve rājayakṣmā daro’bhavat || 11 || nityaṃ vivardhamānena rogeṇa śuṣkatāṃ gataḥ | oṣadhāni bahūnyeva kṛtāni mānatāstathā || 1 2|| kṛtā bahvyaḥ sādhavaśca tadarthama sevitā hyati | rogo nāśaṃ na ca yāti śreṣṭhī cintāparo’bhavat || 13 || kuṭumbaṃ cintayā grastaṃ pitā pūjyo mariṣyati | kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ rakṣārthama tu pituḥ khalu || 14|| evaṃ vicintayatāṃ tu kuṃkumavāpikā śubhā | tīrthaṃ rogaharaṃ cāste sākṣād yatra śriyaḥ patiḥ || 15|| ityevaṃ mānasaṃ jātaṃ tataste janakena vai | sahitāḥ prayayustīrthamaśvapaṭṭasarovaram || 1 6|| kīrtayanto mama nāma smaranto māṃ prabhuṃ tathā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ rogaharaṃ harim || 17|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīraṃ samāgatya ca te tataḥ | niṣedurvaṭavṛkṣādho māṃ smaranto jalaṃ papuḥ || 18|| akṣayyaghāṭamāsādya sasnuḥ sarve prabhāviṇaḥ | dānāni svarṇarūpyāṇi cāmbarāṇi dadustadā || 19 || pātrāṇyannāni miṣṭāni kambalāni dadustathā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo naḥ prīyatāmiti ||3.181.20 || athāhaṃ bhaktimālokya viprarūpadharo hariḥ | aśvapaṭṭasarastīraṃ jagāma tasya sannidhau ||21 || kṣayī virālanāmā sa matvā tīrthamṛtiṃ tadā | sasmāra māṃ svahṛdaye nārāyaṇaḥ prarakṣatu ||22|| mayā gatvā sannidhau vai pṛṣṭo virālakastadā | kutaḥ kasmāt kathaṃ cātra samāyāto’si bho dhanin ||23|| kathaṃ rogaḥ kiyatkālād vartate tava tīrthakṛt | virālako’tikaṣṭena mṛtyuṃ smṛtvā ruroda ha |||24|| śuśoca bahudhā tatra papraccha māṃ tu bhūsuram | namaste vipra vṛddho’si yadi jānāsi daivatam ||25|| vada me bahupuṇyasya kathaṃ rogo vyajāyata | nātra janmani bhūdeva pātakaṃ vai kṛtaṃ mayā ||26|| puṇyadānāni bahudhā kṛtāni vividhāni vai || ābālyāt sādhusevyasmi śrīhareḥ pūjako’smi ca ||27|| kuṭumbaṃ me bhaktiyutaṃ parameśe sadāsti vai | vratāni bhaktiyuktāni karomi sakuṭumbakaḥ ||28|| tathāpi kṣayarogo me kathaṃ prāptaḥ pradarśaya | śrutvāhaṃ viprarūpastu virālasya samastakam ||29|| vṛttāntaṃ pūrvajanmīyaṃ samuvāca hi padmaje | śṛṇu śreṣṭhin supuṇyo’si sarvathā cātra janmani ||3.181.3 0 || purā kṛtaṃ tu yatkarma kenāpi na viyujyate | pūrvajanmani viprastvaṃ nāmnā gaṃgeśvaro’bhavaḥ || 31 || sābhramatītaṭe puṇye viṣṇostu mandire’bhavaḥ | pūjakastatra vai pārśve sasyakṣetrāṇi vāṭikāḥ ||32|| āsan vaiśyasya ramyāśca vaiśyastu mṛtimāptavān | tatpatnī mandire dāsī bhūtvā sevāṃ tato’karot || 33 || gāśca vṛṣāśca sā tatra mandire pradadau satī | kṣetrāṇi vāṭikāścāpi mandire pradadau tathā ||34|| aśaktā sā kṛṣiṃ kartuṃ bhūtvā bhṛtyā tu mandire | avasaddevaśaraṇe tvadādhārā nirāśrayā || 35|| govṛṣāṇāṃ tṛṇādyaiḥ sā sevanaṃ dohanādikam | karotyeva tathā vāryāharaṇaṃ mārjanādikam ||3 6|| gaṃgeśvarasya te sevāṃ karotyājñāsuvartinī | dhānyaśākaphalādīni jāyante yāni bhūmiṣu || 37|| tānyāhṛtya ca prathamaṃ dadāti bhūsurāya te | tvaṃ prapācya sumiṣṭānnaṃ naivedyaṃ viṣṇave sadā || 38|| datvā tasyai prasādaṃ ca tato jagrahithādanam | puṣpahārādikaṃ bhṛtyā kṛtvārpayati viṣṇave || 39|| evaṃ sā sevate nityaṃ tvāṃ tathā viṣṇumīśvaram | niśchadmā bhaktiyuktā ca sarvārpaṇā vṛṣānvitā ||3.181.40 || atha tvaṃ rasanālubdho miṣṭānnaṃ prakaroṣi yat | nivedya viṣṇave śreṣṭhaṃ pracchannaṃ mandirāntare ||41 || bhuktvā tṛptiṃ samāsādya tato dadāsi yoṣite | bhṛtyāyai tadapi rūkṣamannaṃ godhūmapolikāḥ ||42|| evaṃ tvaṃ kṛtavānnityaṃ pakṣapātaṃ tu dātari | dātre deyaṃ tu prathamaṃ tat tvayā na kṛtaṃ tadā || 43 || paṃktibhedaḥ kṛtastatra tatpāpaṃ te purābhavat | ekadā vṛṣṭibāhulye sābhramatyā mahājalam ||44|| kṣetraṃ ca vaṭikāṃ cāpi mandiraṃ vyāpya cāgatam | udvelaṃ tu mahāvegaṃ vyavardhata druta hi tat ||45||| gāvaśca vṛṣabhā bhṛtyā mandirasyocchraye sthale | jagatyāṃ susthale sarve’dhyarohan subhayārditāḥ ||46 || bhṛtyā sā karṣukī bhītā tvāṃ vavalge jalāgate | āśliṣṭā tvāṃ jīvanārthaṃ prāṇarakṣaṇalālasā ||47|| tvaṃ tathā sā karṣukī vai ratnamālā ca ghenavaḥ | vṛṣāśceti jīvanārthaṃ sasmarurmāṃ tu mūrtigām ||48|| vyacintayaṃ tadā cāhaṃ rakṣārthaṃ bhaktayoginām | kintu śreṣṭhin cāntakāle samāgate’pi dehinaḥ ||49|| mano malinaṃ prabalaṃ durnirgrāhyaṃ savāsanam | nāryā dehasya saṃsparśe vikṛtiṃ vindati drutam ||3.181.50 || tatte manastadā tatra vikṛtiṃ prajagāma ha | vāripūre samāśleṣe kāmanādharṣito bhavān ||51 || mayā jñātvā parityakto bhṛtyāpi varjitā tadā | rakṣārthamāgatenāpi rakṣā te tatra na kṛtā ||52|| dharmanāśaṃ vilokyāhaṃ rakṣāṃ na kṛtavān dvija | pūravegena karṣukyā saha tvaṃ vāhito’bhavaḥ ||53|| gāvaśca vṛṣabhāścāpi pūre tatra pravāhitāḥ | mṛtāḥ sarve puṇyayuktā manākpāpasamanvitāḥ ||54|| gaṃgeśvaro bhavān vipraḥ paṃktibhedakarastadā | idānīṃ tvaṃ hareḥ sevāpuṇyavān dhanavānkila ||55|| kṣetradeyaṃ karṣukī ca bhṛtyā te gṛhiṇī kila | dvitīyā tava patnīyaṃ brāhmaṇī yā tava mṛteḥ ||56|| anantaraṃ mṛtā śokāt seyaṃ śreṣṭhin virājate | pañca putrā vṛṣāste vai ye mṛtāḥ pūravāriṣu ||57|| sapta putrya imāḥ śreṣṭhin gāvau mṛtāśca vāriṣu | mama pūjāphalenaiṣā sampat smṛddhirhi vartate ||58|| rogo’yaṃ paṃktibhedena svārthamiṣṭānnabhojinaḥ | tavādya vartate śreṣṭhin niśchadmeyaṃ tu modate ||59|| karṣukī kṣetravāṭyādidānapuṇyaṃ samaśnute | brāhmaṇī dharmapuṇyaṃ tu pātivratyaṃ samaśnute ||3.181.60 || devadhanaṃ paśavaśca mānuṣyaṃ bhuñjate sukham | pūjakastvaṃ dhanadhānyaratnastrīvaṃśasaṃyutaḥ ||6 1 || paṃktibhedasya pāpasya kṣayarogaṃ phalaṃ gataḥ | ahaṃ te ca kuṭumbasya bhaktiyogena vai punaḥ ||62|| tīrthāgatasya mokṣārthaṃ samāyāto’smi mādhavaḥ | vada virālaka tvaṃ me mokṣaṃ vā tu nīrugṇatām |||33|| kimicchasīti dāsye’tra viprarūpadharo hariḥ | pāpaṃ pracchannabhojyasya kṣayaṃ neṣyāmi sarvathā ||64|| nirāmayo bhava śreṣṭhin mokṣago vā bhavātra vai | śrutvaivaṃ sahasā hṛṣṭaḥ praṇamya puruṣottamam ||65|| māṃ papraccha sa loke’trāyuṣyaṃ me vartate na vā | so’hamāha na te cāyuvidyate’taḥ paraṃ manāk ||66|| kintu bhakto’si madvāse cāgato’syapi tairthikaḥ | roganāśecchayā tasmāt kṛpayā te dadāmi tat ||67|| āyurvā mokṣaṇaṃ vāpi hyubhayaṃ cāpi vāñcchasi | janmamṛtyujarāvyādhīn harāmi śaraṇārthinaḥ ||68|| ityuktaḥ śreṣṭhivaryo’sau viprarūpāya me tadā | dattvāsanaṃ tathārghyaṃ ca pādyaṃ jalaṃ phalāni ca ||69|| kastūrīṃ kuṃkumaṃ cāpi karpūraṃ kesarām̐stathā | candanaṃ gandhasārām̐śca ratnahārām̐stathottamān ||3.181.70|| puṣpahārān kambalāni mukuṭaṃ kaṭake tathā | kuṇḍale cormikāścāpi śṛṃkhalāḥ svarṇanirmitāḥ ||71 || sugandhasārān chatraṃ ca cāmare svarṇapāduke | upadā vividhāścāpi putrān putrīḥ striyāvubhe ||72|| sarvaṃ śreṣṭhī tadā lakṣmi cārpayāmāsa me dhanam | pūjayāmāsa vidhinā tavāsmīti jagāda ha ||73|| trāhi pāhi dayāsindho yatheṣṭaṃ kuru te’smi vai | ityevamuktavān virālakastadāhamacyutaḥ ||74||| prāha taṃ sarvathā śreṣṭhin nīrogī bhava satvaram | varṣamātraṃ bhūtale tvaṃ tiṣṭha tataśca mokṣaṇam ||75|| yāsyasyeva na sandehastīrthaṃ kṛtvā gṛhaṃ vraja | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patirmama ||76|| mantramenaṃ japa nityaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhajasva vallabham | smara māṃ nityadā śreṣṭhin pañcatīrthī vidhehi ca ||77|| nityaṃ satāṃ ca sādhūnāṃ sādhvīnāṃ sevanaṃ kuru | devayajñaṃ pitṛyajñaṃ bhūtayajñaṃ tathā kuru||78|| dānaṃ ca havanaṃ cāpi naivedyaṃ me’rhaṇaṃ kuru | asāre cātra saṃsāre sāraṃ sevā hareḥ sadā ||79|| satāṃ sevā paraṃ sāraṃ satāṃ saṃgo hi bheṣajam | mama sevā mokṣadā vai vāsanākṣayiṇī satām ||3.181.80|| satāṃ sevābalenātra vāsanā layameti ha | anantajanmapāpānāṃ nāśopāyaḥ sadarhaṇam ||81|| prārabdhānāṃ daridrāṇāṃ nāśakṛcca sadarhaṇam | vighnānāṃ rogajālānāṃ nāśakṛcca sadarhaṇam ||82|| santaścintāmaṇitulyāḥ prayacchanti sucintitam | santaḥ kalpaprataravo dadatyarthitamuttamam ||83|| santo vai kalpavallyaścāmṛtaṃ phalaṃ dadatyapi | sādhavaḥ kāmagāvaste duhanti śāśvataṃ sukham ||84|| santaḥ siddhipradāścāpi sampadāṃ ca pradā hi te | āśīrvādaiḥ svalpabhāgyaṃ bahubhāgyaṃ dadhatyapi ||85|| divyatāṃ mama yogena prāpayantyakṣaraṃ padam | yāmyadūtān vārayanti santaste hṛdayaṃ mama ||86|| prajvālayanti pāpāni puṇyāni vardhayantyapi | saubhāgyāni cārpayanti haranti cāpado hi te ||87|| teṣāṃ sevā sadā śreṣṭhin kuru prasādadāyinīm | pañcayajñān sadā saumyān vidhehyapi ca bhāvataḥ ||88|| gosevāṃ dharmasevāṃ ca kuru svargapradāyinīm | ātmajñāne kathāsevāṃ sadā prāpnuhi gaṅgaka ||89|| mamārādhanamevāpi sadā vidhehi bhāvavān | ante te darśanaṃ datvā neṣye dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||3.181.90|| brahmahatyāsurāpānavyavāyāścauryamityapi | bhrūṇahatyetipāpānāṃ yāmye niṣkṛtirityapi ||9 1 || sādhusevā kṛtā yena prāptā prasannatā tathā | āśīrvaco yena labdhaṃ sarvārpaṇena satsu yat ||92|| teṣāṃ teṣāṃ tu pāpānāṃ dagdhatā jāyate drutam | niṣkṛtiḥ sarvathā sādhoḥ sevātulyā na cāparā ||93|| yāmyaloko nāsya lakṣmi sevāmagnasya vai satām | api kīṭapataṃgādyāḥ śvapacā ghātakā api ||94|| gaṇikā hārakāścāpi satsevābhiḥ samuddhṛtāḥ | paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi vṛkṣāśca vallikā drumāḥ ||95|| sādhuyogena kamale paraṃ śreyaḥ prabhejire | kṛṣṇabhaktermahāmārgaḥ sādhuṣveva pravartate ||96|| sādhubhyaḥ sarvalokeṣu pravartate tataḥ param | lokāstaranti saṃsāraṃ pāraṃ prayānti tasya ca ||97|| mama lokaṃ prayāntyeva satāṃ sevāparāyaṇāḥ | bhuktvā svargānyanantāni tathaiśvarapadānyapi ||98|| modante cāpi vaikuṇṭhe goloke’kṣaradhāmani | evaṃ mayopadiṣṭaḥ sa virālako’hi bhaktarāṭ ||99|| madājñayā yayau naijaṃ gṛhaṃ santoṣavān dhanī | bheje māṃ sarvathā tatra varṣānte mṛtyumāptavān ||3.181.1 0 0|| sādhusevāṃ parāṃ kṛtvā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ mama | evaṃ lakṣmi vrajeddhāma śrotā vaktāsya bhāvavān || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne virālanāmakasya vaiśyasya prāgjanmakathā, kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre śrīhareḥ prāptiḥ, tasya rājayakṣmanāśaḥ, muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 181 ||
<3.182> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca ākarṇaya kathāṃ nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ tathāparām | āsīt karṇapure rājā pṛthvīdharābhidhaḥ purā || 1 || khaṇḍarājyaṃ pālayan sa prajāṃ rarakṣa dharmataḥ | prātaryasyāṃgaṇe nityaṃ bhikṣukāstu śatādhikāḥ || 2 || tṛpyanti tvannalābhena hyanāthā bālabālikāḥ | hyanāthā vidhavāścāpi bhuṃjate’syānnasatrake || 3 || viṣṇostu mandire gatvā rājā pṛthvīdharaḥ svayam | nārāyaṇasya mūrtervai pūjanaṃ tulasīdalaiḥ || 4 || sahasraikamitairnityaṃ karoti viṣṇave namaḥ | vadan dhyāyan smaran māṃ vai śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam || 5 || dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tathā | nīrājanaṃ stutiṃ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā ca daṇḍavat| || 6 || śatarūpyakadānaṃ cāmbarāṇāṃ śatakaṃ tathā | ekāṃ gāṃ ca dadātyeva dāne nityaṃ tataḥ param || 7 || puṣpāñjaliṃ śrīharaye datvā yāti nijālayam | evaṃ māṃ bhajate nityaṃ manniveditabhojanaḥ || 8 || vartate sma sadā bhakto hiṃsāvyavāyavarjitaḥ | yasya puṇyaṃ purājanmakṛtaṃ tasya tu bhaktatā || 9 || dharme matiśca bhavati satyapi rājyavaibhave | evaṃ lakṣmi sadā pṛthvīdharaḥ kṛtvā śubhāhnikam || 3.182.1 0|| yāti nyāyālayaṃ tatra dadātyeva ca nirṇayam | atha sāyaṃ nityameva kathāṃ śṛṇoti māmakīm || 11 || lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ satāṃ sabhāgataḥ | santo’sya sādhavo dhīrāḥ chindanti saṃśayān bahūn || 12|| satāṃ pādajalānāṃ ca pānaṃ gṛhṇāti bhūpatiḥ | kathānte kīrtanaṃ vādyasahitaṃ prakaroti saḥ ||13|| sahasraśo janā nāryo narāḥ kurvanti kīrtanam | hare kṛṣṇa hare kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa hare hare || 14|| hare viṣṇo hare jiṣṇo’nādikṛṣṇa hare hare | evaṃvidhaṃ bhajanaṃ te satālādyaṃ pracakrire || 15|| atha santaḥ prayāntyeva maṭheṣu ca nṛpastataḥ | sāyaṃ devārcanaṃ kṛtvā labdhvā sadbhojanaṃ tataḥ || 16|| dhyānamagno bhavatyeva mālāmāvartayanmama | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇetyevaṃ japanmuhuḥ || 17|| svapityeveti rājāpi sādhucaryāṃ prasevate | asya rājñī madhuvindānāmnī bhaktā tu vaiṣṇavī || 18|| pātivratyānvitā yadvat sādhvī viprā satī yathā | bhajate māṃ parātmānaṃ matvā saṃsāramulbaṇam ||1 9|| bandhanaṃ duḥkhadoṣāḍhyaṃ vāsanāvāsitaṃ kṣayam | nityaṃ tu paramātmānaṃ muktiṃ cātmānameva sā ||3.182.20|| manute mokṣadātṝm̐śca sato janān prasevate | śāntaśīlā nṛpavatsā bhajate māṃ janārdanam ||21 || yathā rājā tathā lakṣmi prajā guṇavatī bhavet | asya putrādayaścāpi bhejire māṃ śriyaḥ patim ||22|| prajāḥ sarvāḥ sarvavarṇā bhajante sma ca māṃ tathā | dānaṃ kurvanti ca japaṃ kurvanti sma prasevanam ||23|| satāṃ ca sādhuvāsādau mārjanādi dadhatyapi | evaṃ vai vartamānānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ nirantaram ||24|| prasanno bhagavānnāste parjanyaścāpi varṣati | sampadaḥ sampramodante yathā lakṣmyaḥ sacetanāḥ ||25|| dhenavaḥ kāmavarṣiṇyo vṛkṣāśca phaladāyinaḥ | sasyāni kaṇadānyeva rasadā ca rasābhavat ||26|5 mama bhaktasya tasya śri ripavo nābhavam̐stathā | ītayo nābhavam̐ścāpi sukhāḍhyaḥ so’bhavannṛpaḥ || 27|| tasya putro’bhavat kāle janmāndhaḥ prathamaḥ sutaḥ | janmotsavāḥ kṛtāstena yathākālaṃ sutaḥ sa tu ||28|| netre noddhāṭayatyeva janmāndho vidito’bhavat | rājñā viṣṇoranuṣṭhānaṃ kṛtaṃ vai vaiṣṇave makhe ||29||| cakṣuṣoruddhāṭanārthaṃ sūryacandraprapūjanam | ghṛtasya dīpadānaṃ cākhaṇḍitaṃ devamandire ||3.182.30|| kṛtaṃ ca vatsaraṃ tasya gataṃ cāndhye tato nṛpaḥ | āśāṃ vihāya sahasā tapasyeva mano’karot ||3 1 || rājasaudhaṃ vihāyaivodyāne vṛkṣaghaṭāntare | chāyāyāṃ cāsanaṃ kṛtvā niṣasāda tapasyayam ||3 2|| mālāmāvartayatyeṣo raṭan kṛṣṇanarāyāṇam | phalāhāro’bhavad rājā tvekabhukto hi nirjane ||33|| śālagrāmaṃ puro dhṛtvā bhajate māṃ smaratyapi | valkalāmbara evāpi mṛgacarmāsanastathā ||34|| sarvabhogavihīnaśca putranetrasamīhanaḥ | divārātrau bhajate māṃ tatrāśrame drumālaye |||35||| varṣā śaityamātapaṃ ca sahate bhajate ca mām | pūjāṃ karoti bhāvena śālagrāmasya me nṛpaḥ ||36 || karoti triṣavaṇaṃ ca sūryaṃ namaskaroti ca | pañcakeśī pitṛpūjī samvatsaraṃ vyavartata ||37|| evaṃ varṣottare rājā rātrau dhyātvā tu māṃ muhuḥ | astaut kṛṣṇa tava nāma hariḥ duḥkhaharaṃ hi tat ||38|| kathaṃ bhaktasya me duḥkhaṃ naiva harasi mādhava | kartumakartumanyathākartuṃ śakto’si sarvathā ||39|| puṇyaṃ yattattava kṛṣṇa prasannatā hyanugrahaḥ | pāpaṃ yattattava kṛṣṇa prātikūlyaṃ hyudāsitā ||3.182.40|| yadi bhaktaṃ prati caivamaudāsīnyaṃ pradarśyase | kā gatistarhi bhaktasya tyaktasya rakṣakena vai ||41|| rakṣāṃ kuru sutasyāpi cakṣurdānena mādhava | pāpaṃ vidhūya tasyaiva sadṛṣṭiṃ taṃ vidhāpaya ||42|| ityuktvā daṇḍavaccakre śrutvāhaṃ prārthanāṃ drutam | tapo vilokya putrasya netrārthaṃ tvāgato’bhavam ||43|| jaṭilo daṇḍavān sādhurbhasmākto mṛgacarmavān | kamaṇḍaluṃ kare dhṛtvādṛśye vai vṛkṣamaṇḍale ||44|| hare nārāyaṇa viṣṇo vadan satsannidhau yayau | jayo’stu yoginaḥ kṣitipatestāpasaveṣiṇaḥ ||45|| ityahaṃ śabdamuccārya kamaṇḍalujalaṃ śubham | dadau tasmai sa rājāpi vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ||46|| ākasmikaḥ sādhuveṣaścātithiḥ kuta āgataḥ | bhavedvā me manaḥpūrtikaro divyo’yamacyutaḥ || 47|| atithiḥ pūjanīyo vai sādhustatra viśeṣataḥ| vicāryetthaṃ samutthāya rājā papāta pādayoḥ ||48|| āsanaṃ pradadau cārghyaṃ madhuparkaṃ dadau tathā | pūjanaṃ pracakārāpi puṣpagandhaphalādibhiḥ ||49|| namaskāraṃ vidhāyātha papracchāgamanaṃ prati | dhanyo’haṃ kṛtakṛtyo’haṃ sādhujanasya darśanāt ||3.182.50|| tīrtharūpaṃ paraṃ vāri prāptaṃ yasya kamaṇḍaloḥ | darśanaṃ pāvanaṃ labdhaṃ sarvendriyapavitrakṛt ||51|| sparśanaṃ pāpahāraṃ ca labdhaṃ sādhupadasya ha | sevanaṃ ca prasādaṃ ca lapsye’dya bhāgyavaibhavāt |||52|| kṛpayā cāpi ca divyānugrahāt puṇyasañcayāt| | ityuktvā maunamāsthāya tasthāvagre kṛtāñjaliḥ | ||53|| ahaṃ sādhusvarūpaścāvadaṃ śreyoyuto bhava | kuśalaṃ te bhūpa kiṃvā brūhi tapasi kāraṇam |||54|| rājovāca hi sādhūnāṃ kṛpayā kuśalaṃ mama | putravān dhanavānasmi bhaktimānasmi sādhuṣu ||55|| tathāpyakuśalaṃ cāste putraḥ paśyati naiva me | janmāndho vidyate sādho vad kiṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavet ||56|| tasya vai dṛṣṭimatvārthaṃ tapaḥ karomi mādhave | ārādhanātmakaṃ nānyakāṃkṣā me vartate prabho ||57|| putro’cakṣurbhaved yasya rājyamandhaṃ tu tasya vai | anandhasya gṛhe cāndhyaṃ vaṃśe cāndhyaṃ hi duḥkhadam | |58|| āndhyametat kathaṃ dūraṃ yāyājjānāsi darśaya | kṛtakṛtyo bhavāmyevaṃ sādhoste’tra samāgamāt ||59|| sādhūnāṃ vacanaṃ divyaṃ satyārthaṃ siddhidaṃ sadā | sādhūnāṃ hṛdayaṃ saumyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ khalu ||3.182.60||| sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ sevanaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā | sarvāśāpūrakaḥ sādhoranugrāhaḥ samarjitaḥ ||61 || ityuktvā virarāmāsau lakṣmi cāhaṃ tadāvadam | śṛṇu rājam̐stava putraḥ pūrvajanmani tāpasaḥ ||62|| yathāhaṃ tāpasaveṣastathā sa tāpaso’bhavat | nāmnā durvoḍhako vipro daridro rājyavāñchayā ||63|| akarot sa tapo revātaṭe tīrthe tu śuklake | bahavo yatra cāyānti yānti tīrthārthimānavāḥ ||64|| narā nāryastatra tīrthe snānti prayānti pārśvataḥ | durvoḍhakaḥ prapaśyan vai tapaḥsthale pratiṣṭhati ||65|| balavaccendriyaṃ lakṣmi mānasaṃ balavattathā | viṣaye purato yāte cāgate cañcalaṃ bhavet ||66|| tannirodhastāpasena kartavyaḥ sarvadā rame | indriyāṇāṃ manasaścāniroghe niṣphalaṃ tapaḥ ||67|| pramāthi mānasaṃ kasmin kṣaṇe neṣyati duṣpatham | niścayaścāpi viśvāso nāsti tanmanasaḥ sadā ||68|| ekadā tvaṃ svayaṃ rājā tīrthārthaṃ sakuṭumbakaḥ | yathāpekṣitavastvāḍhyaḥ parimeyapuraḥsaraḥ ||69|| gato revāṃ prati śuklatīrthaṃ snātuṃ tu parvaṇi | yatrāyaṃ tāpasaḥ sādhurviprastapati tatsthale ||3.182.70|| manāg dūre cāmravaṇe tvaṃ nivāsaṃ tadākaroḥ | jñātvā tapasvinaṃ sādhuṃ jaṭilaṃ tvaṃ ca tatpuraḥ ||71 || sapatnīko namaskāramakaroḥ pūjanaṃ tathā | phalādikaṃ cārpayaśca rājñī ca bhāvapūritā ||72|| sādhoścaraṇau prakṣālya jalaṃ papau tava priyā | rūpayauvanasaundaryapuṣṭiśṛṃgāraśālinīm |||73 || vīkṣya tāṃ moha utpanno viprasyāsya tapasvinaḥ | sakāmaṃ cāpi pracchannaṃ cakṣurdvayaṃ prayojitam ||74|| tena vipreṇa śiṣyāyāṃ rājñyāṃ tadā tu tīrthake | puṇyāyāṃ sevikāyāṃ ca tathaiva rājamātari ||75|| sakāmastapasi dṛbdho rājyārthaṃ lālasānvitaḥ | ajitendriyacittaśca dṛṣṭipāpaṃ tadā vyadhāt ||76|| bhavanti khalu jātyandhā janmāndhā rāgiṇastu te | parastriyāṃ tu ye mugdhā duṣṭacakṣuḥ prayuñjate ||77|| evametasya viprasya tāpasasya tadā khalu | rūpasaundaryamugdhasya mohapāpaṃ tadā hyabhūt ||78|| tasmānmohānudbhavārthaṃ rūpavatyaḥ striyaḥ sadā | dharmarakṣārthamevāpi darśayanti mukhaṃ nahi ||79|| lajjāvastraṃ prāvaraṇaṃ mukhopari prakāśane | sadā rakṣanti sannāryaḥ pātivratyādiguptaye ||3.182.80|| darśanaṃ mohakṛttasmāddarśanaṃ na dadatyapi | asūryampaśyāstiṣṭhanti prāvaraṇena cāvṛtāḥ ||8 1 || atha rājan tāpasaḥ sa kālena nidhanaṃ gataḥ | tava putro hyayaṃ jāto yasyāṃ mugdhastadgarbhajaḥ ||82|| tapaḥphalaṃ rājyametallabdhaṃ tena mahātmanā | duṣṭacakṣurdṛṣṭiphalaṃ janmākhyaṃ labdhameva ca ||83|| tapasā te prabhaktasya pūjādibhiḥ pratoṣitaḥ | samāyāto’smi bhagavān śālagrāme tu yaḥ sthitaḥ ||84|| so’haṃ nārāyaṇakṛṣṇo bhavāmi te hyabhīṣṭadaḥ | brūhi rājan dadāmyatra yatte manasi rocate ||85|| bhaktārthaṃ tvāgato’smyatra yadicchasi dadāmi te | ityuktaḥ sa tu rājarṣiḥ pṛthvīdharābhidhastadā ||86|| yayāce sutadṛṣṭiṃ ca bhaktiṃ me pādayostathā | ante dhāmākṣaraṃ cāpi vaṃśaṃ ca bhaktameva ha ||87|| śrutvāhaṃ pradadau tasmai tathāstvevaṃ bhaviṣyati | jalaṃ kamaṇḍalordatvā tirobhāvaṃ tataḥ sthalāt ||88|| rājā prasannacittastu tapaḥ pūrṇaṃ vidhāya ca | yayau savalkalo naijaṃ grāmasthaṃ bhavanaṃ prati ||89|| prajābhiḥ pūjitaścāpi lakṣito varapātrakaḥ | prāptamanorathaścāpi jayaśabdaiḥ pravardhitaḥ ||3.182.90 || yayau svabhavanaṃ tāvad vādyāni cottamāni vai | avādyanta samantāttu rājñī prasannatāṃ hyagāt ||9 1 || rājā sutaṃ prati gatvā mayā dattaṃ jalaṃ drutam | putranetre dadau netraṃ jalasparśāt sadṛṣṭikam ||92|| dakṣaṃ hyabhūt tato vāmaṃ jalasparśāt sadṛṣṭikam | jātaṃ mahotsavaścāsīttapaḥphalaṃ samarjitam ||93|| atha putro yuvā jāto jātismaro hi sarvadā | duṣṭacakṣuḥphalaṃ naijaṃ smaratyeva sadā tataḥ || 94|| mahābhāgavataḥ so’pi jāto dharmasamanvitaḥ | nāmnā citradhvajo rājā sādhubhaktaḥ pratāpavān ||95 || bhajate māṃ sadā lakṣmi rājyaṃ pitrā samarpitam | sañcālayati nītyā vai prajāstoṣayatyeva saḥ ||9 6 || pitāsya nidhanaṃ yāto vimānena tadāpyaham | svadhāmākṣaramevainaṃ prāpayāmāsa vaiṣṇavam || 97|| evaṃ mayā svabhaktasya tapasā hyedhitasya ca | icchāpūrtiḥ kṛtā putracakṣurdānena viṣṇunā ||98|| bhaktānāṃ sarvathā lakṣmi cāndhyaṃ bāhyaṃ ca vāntaram | nāśayāmi prasanno’haṃ bhaktivaśyo bhavan bhuvi ||99|| ātmaprakāśaṃ divyaṃ ca dadāmi jñānaśevadhim | yena māyātamastīrtvā prayānti paramaṃ padam || 3.182.10 0|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇād bhajanānmama | bhuktimuktirbhaveccāpi sampat saukhyaṃ pramokṣaṇam || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne pṛthvīdharābhidhanṛpaterjanmāndhaputrasya prāgjanmavṛttāntaṃ bhagavatākṛtasadṛṣṭikatvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 182 ||
<3.183> puruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śatrūṃjayānadītaṭe | āsīd bhaktaḥ sāgarākhyaḥ śūdro’raṇyaprapālakaḥ || 1 || saputraparivāro’yaṃ saśastro’raṇyarakṣaṇam | karoti pālikātāne pālikārājyayojitaḥ || 2 || ekadāraṇyabhāgeṣu pālikātānajo nṛpaḥ | yayau vai mṛgayārthaṃ saḥ parimeyasubhṛtyayuk || 3 || araṇyaṃ tatpraviṣṭo’yaṃ rājā ca sāgaraṃ tu tam | bhṛtyaṃ ninye saha tatra mṛgādimārgadarśakam || 4 || śūdro’pyayaṃ harerbhakto hiṃsāṃ naiva karoti saḥ | ahiṃsako hi rājānaṃ hiṃsāpāpabhayāt khalu || 5 || udvāṭaṃ mṛgaśūnyaṃ vai pradeśaṃ prati nītavān | atra mṛgāḥ samāyānti prayānti ca vasantyapi || 6 || ityuktvā nītavān kṣmeśaṃ vanapālābhidhaṃ nṛpam | yatra jalaṃ vanaṃ ramyaṃ pradeśāścāpi sundarāḥ || 7 || kvacit kvacijjanavāsāstaṃ pradeśaṃ tu nītavān | āsāyaṃ tu samāraṇye’ṭavīto’pyaṭavīṃ bhraman || 8 || atra mṛgastatra mṛgaścetyevaṃ sampradarśayan | rājānaṃ bhrāmayāmāsa japan śrīpuruṣottamam || 9 || āntare prārthayan māṃ vai kṣamasva bhagavanmama | aparādhaṃ nṛpeṇātra sārdhaṃ vai mṛgayodbhavam || 3.183.1 0|| nāhamicchāmi vanajān mṛgān hantuṃ svayaṃ kvacit | anyadvārā tathā hiṃsā kārayituṃ kvacit prabho || 11 || ato mayā nṛpaścāyamudvāṭena praṇīyate | yatra mṛgā na prāpyante hiṃsā me na yathā bhavet || 12|| hiṃsāpāpaṃ naiva syāttattathā rakṣa hi mādhava | kaścidvanyaḥ paśustvatra mārge naiva milennṛpam || 13 || antaryāmiṃstathā sarvaṃ vidhehi klṛptanaṃ prabho | evaṃ māṃ prārthayan bhaktaḥ śūdro’pi dharmavān śuciḥ ||14|| yātyagre taṃ nṛpaṃ karṣan mṛgavāso’tra tatra ca | varṇanaṃ bahudhā kurvan rājan khaḍgo’tra vai bhavet || 15|| atra citramṛgaḥ syācca śṛṃgī sṛmaraścātra tu | gavayaścātra śaśako geṇḍuko vā bhavediha || 16|| tarakṣurvā kṛṣṇamṛgo varāho vā bhavediha | evamāśāṃ bandhayam̐śca yātyagre’gre samutsukaḥ ||17|| jalaṃ phalāni rājñeścārpayatyapi prasevate | tathāpi sa tu rājā na tuṣṭimeti mṛgān vinā || 18|| evaṃ sāyaṃ samayo vai vanāntare vyajāyata | mṛgālabdhau nṛpaścāpi nirāśo’pyabhavattadā ||1 9 || sarve te’staṃgate cārke viśaśramurvanāntare | sarastaṭe vaṭādho vai bubhukṣitā nirāśayāḥ ||3.183.20|| athātra bhāgyayogena vanecarastadā paraḥ | araṇyaṃ svaṃ bhramitvaiva svagṛhaṃ pratiyāti yaḥ ||21 || sa tatra vaṭavṛkṣādhaḥ śrutvā śabdām̐stu mānavān | pārśvasṛtyā nirgato’pi vaṭāśrayaṃ samāyayau |||22|| apaśyattatra rājānaṃ parimeyajanānvitam | nanāma bhāvataścaitān tasthau papraccha taṃ nṛpam ||23 || kathaṃ rājannatra rātrau viśrāmaścādya vidyate | dāsavargasya kāryaṃ cettiṣṭhāmi sevanājñayā ||24|| dāso’haṃ vanamārgajño vanyajño vanavāsakṛt | vane sarvaṃ vijānāmi nṛpājñāṃ vitarāmi ca ||25|| śrutvā rājā tu vṛttāntaṃ dinacaryāṃ ca niṣphalām | mṛṣāmṛgayābhramaṇaṃ sarvaṃ jagāda vai tadā ||26|| atha śrutvā dakṣagarvo’paro vanecaro nṛpam | rājannaitadvanaṃ tādṛṅ mṛgādhivāsitaṃ kvacit ||27|| kenāyaṃ darśitaḥ panthāḥ kevalakleśadāyakaḥ | vane’tra na mṛgāḥ santi kāṣṭhahārā bhramanti yat ||28|| mṛgāṇāṃ tu vanaṃ cānyad dakṣiṇe saritastaṭe | vartate tatra mṛgayāsāphalyaṃ jāyate sadā ||29|| kenacid bhrāmitastvaṃ vai rājannatra pravartase | vṛthāprayāso bhavato vane’tra kaṣṭameva ha ||3.183.3 0|| evamuktastadā rājā jñātavān svapratāraṇam | sāgareṇa hi śūdreṇa kṛtaṃ vṛthāṭanaṃ prati ||3 1 || aho viśvāsaghātā vai mānavā nṛpatiṃ kvacit | vimārge samprakṛṣyaiva nayanti maraṇaṃ prati |||32||| viśvāso naiva kartavyo vane gṛhe raṇe tathā | ajñātānāṃ kvacid bhūpairviśvāse kaṣṭamāpnuyāt ||33|| sāgareṇa vayaṃ cātra pratāritā mṛgārthinaḥ | amṛgāḍhye vane dūraṃ bhrāmitā niṣphalīkṛtāḥ ||34|| so’yaṃ daṇḍasya pātraṃ vai vidyate chadmavṛttavān | tyaktavyo daṇḍadānena śikṣā deyā mayātra ha ||35||| evaṃ vicārya nṛpatirdakṣagarvābhidhaṃ param | vanecaraṃ tadā prāha tiṣṭha vā yāhi te gṛham ||36|| prātaścātra samāyāhi mṛgayārthaṃ vane saha | dāsye’haṃ cepsitaṃ te vai pāritoṣikamuttamam ||37|| mṛgayāṇāṃ sulābhe vai nānyathā yāhi tiṣṭha vā | dakṣagarvo namaskṛtyāvaśyakatāṃ pradarśya ca ||38|| yayau naijaṃ gṛhaṃ rātrau nāyāt prātaśca tatsthalam | rājāpi krodhamāpannaḥ prātareva tu sāgaram ||39|| papraccha tvaṃ kathaṃ tvatra vane māṃ nītavān vada | mṛgayā yatra naivāsti vṛthāraṇye bhramo’bhavat ||3.183.40 || duḥkhaṃ tvayā kṛtaṃ tvetattasmāddaṇḍyo’si sarvathā | māsikaṃ vetanaṃ tvaṃ vai prāpnosi mama kośataḥ ||41 || ahaṃ pratāritaścātra tvayā bhṛtyena vai yataḥ | tato’haṃ prakaromyatra daṇḍaṃ te kapaṭārthinam ||42|| ityuktvā bhūpatiścānyān bhṛtyānāha drutaṃ vacaḥ | pāṣāṇairasya duṣṭasya prakoṣṭhau pādayoriha ||43||| cūrṇayantu nikṣipantu vaṭo’dho duṣṭamānavam | ityuktāste pare bhṛtyā bhaṭā āsan praroṣiṇaḥ ||44|| te dhṛtvā prastarān kaṣṭām̐ścūrṇayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ | pādayorghūṭike cobhe bhaṅktvā taṃ vaṭamūlake ||45|| prakṣipya prayayuḥ sarve sanṛpāste tataḥ sthalāt | mṛgayārthaṃ cāparaṃ vai vanaṃ garvānvitāḥ khalāḥ ||46|| athāyaṃ sāgarastatra matvā daivāt samāgatam | kaṣṭaṃ ruroda bahudhā smṛtvā māṃ puruṣottamam ||47|| kathaṃ he bhagavannatra bhaktarakṣāṃ karoṣi na | pāpināṃ tu tathā nāśaṃ kṛṣṇa kathaṃ karoṣi na ||48|| hiṃsāyāṃ tu mahatpāpaṃ viditvā mṛgarakṣayā | mayā rājā tūdvāraṃ vai pravartito dayālunā ||49|| tvadbhakto’haṃ dayāsindho dayāvān mṛgabālakān | mṛgān hantuṃ kathaṃkāraṃ nayāmi hiṃsakaṃ nṛpam ||3.183.50 || ahiṃsāyāḥ phalaṃ hiṃsātmakaṃ prāptaṃ mayādya tat | kaṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇa tvayā cāpi sahyate svāśritasya yat ||51 || āścaryaṃ paramaṃ tvetad bhaktarakṣāṃ karoṣi na | hare kṛṣṇa hare viṣṇo hare nārāyaṇa prabho ||52|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jiṣṇo’vanaṃ kuru | vane vaṭe’tra gahane yadi nāyāsyasi drutam ||53 || kaścijjano’pi divase tadā me mṛtyuratra vai | bhaveccaraṇakaṣṭena jalaṃ kaścinna dāsyati ||54|| prāṇāvane prayāsyanti gatirduṣṭā bhaviṣyati | kuṭumbino me naivāpi vetsyanti mṛtyumatra me ||55|| harenātha harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa prabho hare | hare śrīkambharāputra rādhāpate ramāpate ||56|| śīghramāyāhi kamalāpate lakṣmīpate prabho | padmāvatīpate prajñāpate śrīmāṇikīpate ||57|| muktapate brahmapate sṛṣṭipate jagatpate | bhaktapate dīnapate brahmapriyāpate hare ||58|| śīghramāyāhi bhagavan bhaktarakṣārthadehavān | saurāṣṭrādhipate śrīmadgopālabālakaprabho ||59|| kathaṃkāramidaṃ kaṣṭaṃ pādasandhipracūrṇajam | sahe vai bhagavannatra prāṇā mūrchā prayānti vai ||3.183.60|| ityuktā māṃ praṇamyaiva mūrchābhāvamupāgataḥ | lakṣmi yāvat sāgaro me bhaktastāvadahaṃ drutam ||61 || tatpārśve prayayau śīghraṃ vanecarasvarūpavān | patrāṇi sandhinīvallyā nītvā tadrasamuttamam ||62|| niṣkāsyāṅgulibhistatra dadau bhagnapradeśayoḥ | tāvat praghūṭike cāpi prakoṣṭhau sandhitau drutam ||63|| asthinī ca yathāpūrvaṃ jātau svasthau nīrugṇakau | saśaktau cāpi raktāḍhyau mayā spṛṣṭau punaḥ punaḥ ||64|| mūrchāyā vāraṇaṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ bhaktasya vai mayā | utthāpitaśca kaṣṭaṃ tad dūrīkṛtaṃ samastataḥ ||65|| bhojitaḥ suprasādaṃ ca jalaṃ tadā prapāyitaḥ | snehitaḥ premadṛṣṭyā ca prāpitaśca gṛhaṃ nijam ||66 || vanecarasvarūpaṃ māṃ pupūja bahubhāvataḥ | gṛhe ramyāsanaṃ datvā paricaryāṃ cakāra me ||67|| tasya patnī hīrukāpi putrāḥ putryaśca sevanam | cakrurme bahudhā lakṣmi madhyāhne bhojanādibhiḥ ||68|| mayā bhuktaṃ jalaṃ pītaṃ sevā cāṃgīkṛtā tathā | pādasammardanagātramardanādisvarūpiṇī ||69|| athāyaṃ sāgaro bhaktaḥ papraccha māṃ nijaṃ prati | hare nātha kṛpāsindho kaṣṭametat kathaṃ mama ||3.183.70 || pādabhañjanarūpaṃ vai kena pāpena cāgatam | na hiṃsitā mayā jīvā na māṃsamadirādikam ||71 || spṛśyate’pi harekṛṣṇa nāsatyaṃ kriyate kvacit| | na cauryaṃ pāradāryaṃ vā kriyate vai kadācana ||72|| prāṇirakṣākṛte tvetat pratāraṇaṃ nṛpasya tu | kṛtaṃ mayā prabho nātra pāpaṃ mayā kṛtaṃ bhavet ||73 || kathaṃ me pādahananaṃ kathaṃ kaṣṭaṃ janasya te | vada nātha yathārthaṃ me karma vā tādṛśaṃ bhavet ||74|| atra janmani naivāhaṃ kṛtavānna smarāmyapi | ajñātena kṛtaṃ cet syād vada me saṃśayāpaham ||75|| tadāhaṃ kamale tasmai nyavedayaṃ purākṛtam | nātra janmani tasyābhūt karma krūraṃ hi tādṛśam ||76|| tato’haṃ kathayāmāsa śṛṇu sāgara prākkṛtam | tvamāsīrvai hastipako rājño gajasya rakṣakaḥ ||77|| asya rājñaḥ piturdharmapālasya gajarakṣakaḥ | nāmnā dharodarastvaṃ vai śūdraḥ kuṭumbavāniha ||78 || bhṛtyatāṃ vidadhan hastipālane tvekadā bhavān | gajasya tu madaprākaṭye yuvānaṃ gajaṃ tadā ||79|| unmādinaṃ vaśaṃ kartuṃ prayatnaṃ bahudhā vyadhāt | gokṣurādyairlohajaiśca nyastaiḥ pādataleṣu vai ||3.183.80|| tathā lohārgalaiścāpi lohaśṛṃkhalikādibhiḥ | bhallaiścograiśca vaṃśaiśca dīrghaiśca lohajaiḥ phalaiḥ ||8 1 || pādau vibhidya kariṇaḥ kṛtvā śaktivihīnakam | gatiśūnyaṃ gataṃ tatra bhavān rurodha sarvathā |||82 || adhikaṃ pādayostasya mūḍhamāramamārayat | bhagnamasthi gajasyāpi pādasyaikasya vai tadā ||83 || athāpyutthātukāmaṃ taṃ hastinaṃ tu bhavān punaḥ | lohadaṇḍaiścāgrapade mārayāmāsa nirdayaḥ ||84|| asthi dvitīyapādasya cūrṇatāṃ pārśvato’gamat | evaṃ pādadvayāsthinī bhagne te krūratāvaśāt ||85 || hastinā tvaṃ tadā śapto rakṣako mārako bhavān | mamaiva tu kareṇaiva bhagnapādo bhaviṣyasi ||86 || sa tvaṃ kālena nidhanaṃ gato’si sāgaro’dya vai | hastī ca nidhanaṃ prāpro rājaputro’yamasti saḥ ||87|| vanapālābhidhaḥ so’yaṃ bhagnapādaḥ purā gajaḥ | rājādya vartate tvaṃ cāraṇyapālo’dya vartase ||88 || tava pādau tena bhagnau purābhagnasya tatphalam | mā śokaṃ kuru bhakto’si rakṣito’si mayādya vai ||89|| na kṛtaṃ tu purā karma kaṃcit tyajati dehinam | tvayā prāptaṃ kṛtaṃ karma phalarūpeṇa bhaktaka ||3.183.90|| kintu bhaktyā mayā rakṣā kṛtā cāhiṃsayā tava | rājño’parādhaḥ svalpo’pi nimitto’tra vyajāyata ||91 || araṇye pādabhaṃge te mā śokaṃ kartumarhasi | bhaja māṃ paramātmānaṃ paśya me rūpamaiśvaram ||92|| ahaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāccaturbhujo’smi cāgataḥ | yāhi tvadyaiva rājānaṃ sāyaṃ gṛhaṃ samāgatam ||93|| vada me sarvavṛttāntaṃ rakṣākaraṃ sukhapradam | so’pi śrutvā nṛpo me saṃbhajanaṃ vai kariṣyati ||94|| tava yogena muktiṃ vai kariṣyāmi nṛpasya ha | mā bhayaṃ kuru bhaktendra tvayā sākaṃ bhavāmyaham ||95|| ityuktvā bhagavām̐statra tirodadhe tu padmaje | bhakto yayau niśāyāṃ tu nṛpagṛhaṃ smaran harim ||96|| rājñe sarvaṃ tu vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa śobhanam | śrutvā rājā vismito’bhūd yayāce ca kṣamāṃ muhuḥ ||97|| bhaktarakṣākaraṃ māṃ ca tuṣṭāva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ | viditvā prāgjanma naijaṃ gajātmakaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ||98|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpya matvā dehaṃ tu gatvaram | bhakto bhūtvā prabheje māṃ kuṭumbasahito nṛpaḥ ||99|| pitā ca bāndhavāścāpi bhejire māṃ tataḥ sadā | kṛtvā rājyaṃ satāṃ sevāṃ bhaktiṃ kṛtvā yathākṣaṇam || 3.183.100 || prāpuste māṃ parameśaṃ śrīdhāmākṣarasatpadam | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya lakṣmi bhuktiśca mokṣaṇam || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sāgarākhyaśūdrasya bhagnapādasya bhagavatkṛtanīrujapādatvaṃ tatpūrvabhavavṛttāntaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 183 ||
<3.184> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ vṛkṇadevasya pāvanīm | bhaktasya me kathāṃ pūrve jātāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || 1 || dhruvālaye tu nagare jātyā śūdro’tidharmavān | vṛkṇadevābhidhāno’bhūd bhṛtyaḥ sandeśahārakaḥ || 2 || bhāvaśūrābhidhānasya nṛpaternāstikasya vai | vṛkṇadevo mama bhakto bhāvaśūrastu nāstikaḥ || 3 || dvayornityaṃ mitrayostu vivādaḥ parijāyate | vṛkṇadevaḥ sadā vakti bhaja rājan prabhuṃ harim || 4 || bhāvaśūraḥ prativakti bhaja bhāgyaṃ ca karma ca | vṛkṇadevo vrate prāpte mahotsave nṛpaṃ muhuḥ || 5 || vakti dānaṃ pūjanaṃ ca dharmakāryaṃ vidhehi vai | rājā sarvaṃ manyate vai mṛṣā dānaṃ ca pūjanam || 6 || na svargaṃ nāpi puṇyaṃ vā nāsti dharmādikaṃ tathā | svabhāvājjāyate sarvaṃ yathākṣetraṃ tathodbhavaḥ || 7 || yena kenāpi bījena rājñyā tu janitaḥ sutaḥ | rājā prajāyate tadvad vaṃśānukāriṇī sthitiḥ || 8 || rājabījaṃ daridrāyāṃ jātaṃ dīnaḥ prajāyate | svabhāvo vā nijaṃ karma bhāgyaṃ sarvatra tiṣṭhati || 9 || abhāgyasya kṛte naiva rājyaṃ samupatiṣṭhate | rājyabhāgyasya dāridryaṃ naiva kvāpyupatiṣṭhati || 3.184.10 || sūryasya kiraṇaṃ vārau praviṣṭaṃ śītatā vrajet | śītaṃ jalaṃ mahāvahneḥ prasaṃgāduṣṇatāṃ vrajet || 11 || pṛthvījanyaṃ samastaṃ vai pṛthvyāṃ pṛthvītvameti hi | evaṃ khaniprabhāveṇa nisargeṇa mahān laghuḥ || 12||| jāyate vai yathāklṛpta bhaktestatra na gauravam | bhāgyasya gauravaṃ yadvā karmaṇaścāsti gauravam || 1 3|| karma nisargajanyaṃ vai svabhāvavat pravartate | dvipado dvābhyāṃ yātyeva caturbhistu catuṣpadaḥ || 14|| śatapādaḥ śatenaiva tathā klṛptiḥ gatistathā | gajo bhuṃkte dvyānanābhyāṃ vṛkṣaḥ sahasramūlakaiḥ || 15|| ṣaḍānanaiḥ kārtikastu brahmācaturmukhaistathā | yathā klṛptistathā grāso vāḍavāgnestu sāgaraḥ || 1 6|| deśe kāle kṛtaṃ karma bhāgyarūpaṃ prajāyate | tena rājyaṃ sukhaṃ svaṃrga pitṛvaṃśāgataṃ milet || 17|| bhaktestatra na hetutvaṃ vṛkṇadeva nibodha tat | ityevaṃ nṛpatirnityaṃ vṛkṇadevaṃ nirasyati || 18|| athaivaṃ puṣkale kāle yāte nṛpatirekadā | papraccha vṛkṇadevaṃ tvaṃ kathaṃ vṛkṇo’si me vada || 1 9|| yadi bhaktiḥ kāraṇaṃ vai sukhe svaṣṭe tadā bhavān | kathaṃ bhakteḥ pratāpena vṛkṇatvaṃ na jahāti vai ||3.184.20 || vṛkṇadevastataḥ prāha bhāvaśūraṃ nṛpaṃ prati | vṛkṇatvaṃ karmaṇā jātaṃ bhaktyā mārṣṭuṃ hi śakyate ||21 || rājannārāyaṇo viṣṇurbhaktecchāpūrako’sti hi | bhaktaścecchati sāmrājyaṃ dadātyeva hariḥ prabhuḥ ||22|| bhaktaścecchati cārogyaṃ dadātyeva narāyaṇaḥ | yān yān kāmān kāmayate pūrayatyeva tān hariḥ ||23|| sakāmasya tu kāmānāṃ pūrakaḥ parameśvaraḥ | akāmasya mahānandapradātā parameśvaraḥ |||24|| satyaṃ vai vartate sarvaṃ bhaktyā tuṣyati mādhavaḥ | pratoṣito hariḥ sarvaṃ dadātyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||25|| bhāvaśūrastadā prāha sarvaṃ mṛṣā prabhāṣase | na vṛkṇatvaṃ tiroyāti svāsthyaṃ nāṃke pratiṣṭhate ||26|| bhaktau me nāsti viśvāso yathā karmaṇi vartate | tathāpi vṛkṇadevātra paṇaṃ kiñcitkaromi vai ||27|| ahaṃ rājāsmyavṛkṇastvaṃ bhṛtyo vṛkṇaḥ pravartase | karmaṇā niyataṃ tvetannaitad viparivartate ||28|| yadi bhaktibalaṃ heturbhaved viparivartane | avṛkṇavṛkṇabhāvasyāvayorvinimayo’stviha ||29|| tadā bhaktibalaṃ matvā kariṣye bhajanaṃ hareḥ | anyathā te vacaḥ satyaṃ naiva manye kathaṃcana ||3.184.30|| ityevaṃ nṛpatervākyaṃ śrutvā vṛkṇo’pi māṃ prabhum | sasmāra parayā bhaktyā sannidhau nṛpatestadā || 31 || prakāśe sarvalokānāṃ vyājahāra nṛpo yathā | tathā bhavatu sarvātmannevaṃ prāha punaḥ punaḥ ||32|| vṛkṇadevasya bhaktyaiva snehena vaśatāṃ gataḥ | ahaṃ lakṣmi tadā guptastiṣṭham̐statraiva vṛkṇatām ||33|| vṛkṇadevasya cākṛṣya nṛpahastadvaye’kṣipam | rājā tūrṇaṃ tadā vṛkṇo’bhavat prakoṣṭhayostathā ||34|| kaphoṇikayoḥ kubjaścābhavaścākṛṣṭanāḍikaḥ | śuṣkakāṣṭhāyitaṃ hastadvayaṃ tānāyitaṃ drutam ||35|| sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ tatra bhūmipatervyajāyata | vṛkṇadevasya hasto tu vṛkṇatāvarjitau drutam ||36|| abhavatāṃ yathākāryakarau nirbandhanāḍikau | suraktāḍhyau puṣṭiyuktau yatheṣṭakāryakāriṇau ||37|| etādṛśaṃ mahāścaryaṃ vīkṣya siṣmiyire janāḥ | rājā mene’tivādasya phalaṃ nāstikatodbhavam ||38|| bhaktiṃ mene tathā satyāṃ karmaṇāṃ parivartinīm | bhakterbalaṃ paraṃ mene nāstikyaṃ pramumoca saḥ ||39|| evaṃ vai vṛkṇatārogo janmajo’sya mayā rame | tadā bhaktergauravārthaṃ taddvayoḥ parivartitaḥ ||3.184.40 || atha rājābhavadbhaktastyaktvā garvaṃ tu karmaṇaḥ | svabhāvasya tathā garvaṃ tatyāja vṛkṇatābalāt ||41 || atha rājñī śīladharmānāmnī śuśoca vai tadā| putraputryaśca bhṛtyāśca prajāśca śuśucurhyati ||42||| vṛkṇadevo’pi nṛpatiṃ vīkṣya vṛkṇaṃ śuśoca ha | prārthayat paramātmānaṃ rājño rogasya nuttaye ||43|| rājāpi vṛkṇadevānme mantraṃ jagrāha vai tadā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||44|| jajāpa mālikāmātramaṣṭottaraśataṃ tadā | tāvadahaṃ bhaktarakṣākṛt prādurabhavaṃ kṣaṇāt ||446|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmavaijayantīdharaḥ prabhuḥ | śrīlakṣmīsahitastūrṇaṃ brahmatejo’ntare’mbare ||46|| rājā dadarśa māṃ divyaṃ vṛkṇadevo dadarśa mām | prajāḥ sarvāstadā māṃ cālokayāmāsurīśvaram ||47|| jayakāraṃ jagaduśca nemustuṣṭuvuracyutam | menire dhanyabhāgyaṃ ca darśanaṃ yatparātmanaḥ ||48|| ekabhaktasya yogena bahūnāṃ darśanaṃ hyabhūt| | mayā divyaṃ tu madrūpaṃ tirobhāvya śubhaṃ vapuḥ ||49|| kṛtvā rājñaḥ sannidhau ca gatvā spṛṣṭo nṛpastadā | nāstikyaṃ sahasā naṣṭaṃ rājā dharmaparo’bhavat ||3.184.50 || yathā bhaktastathā rājā dhārmikau tau babhūvatuḥ | rājā prajādayaḥ sarve paraṃ modaṃ prapedire ||51|| ānandamutsavaṃ cakrurmama darśanalābhataḥ | nārāyaṇaṃ ca māṃ sarve pūjayāmāsurādarāt ||52|| atha bhṛtyo vṛkṇadevaḥ papraccha māṃ tataḥ prabhum | kathaṃ me vṛkṇatā cāsīt kathaṃ gatā vadātra me ||53|| tadāhaṃ kamale sarvaṃ vṛttāntaṃ pūrvajanmajam | śrāvayāmāsa bhaktebhyo vṛkṇatādāyakaṃ hyagham ||54|| pūrvamāsīd bhavān kīśabhikṣukaḥ kīśarakṣakaḥ | vānarān khelayitvā ca vasatau ca prajājanāt ||55|| grāmīṇebhyo’nnavastrādyairlabdhairvṛttiṃ samācarat | bhallukau dvau nakulāśca pañca sapta tu vānarāḥ ||56|| dvau sarpau vṛścikā aṣṭau vaśe te hyabhavaṃstadā | teṣāṃ khelaviśeṣaistvaṃ kuṭumbavṛttimācaraḥ ||57|| kuṭumbinaste sarve’pi tattajjantupraśikṣakāḥ | āsam̐ste’pi ca tān jantūn khelayitvāmbarānnakam |||58|| upārjayam̐stadā vṛttiṃ jīvikāṃ cābhyavartayan | evaṃ vai vartamāneṣu grāmānte saṃsthiteṣu ca ||59|| rātrau supteṣu sarveṣu vṛko’raṇyāt samāgataḥ | tasya gandhaṃ viditvaiva vānaraḥ prathama drutam ||3.184.60 || aplavata bhayāttasyāpatattava tu vakṣasi | hastau kīśasya te bhāle netrayoḥ patitau tadā || 61 || nakhaiścarma lalāṭasya bhinnābhavattadā tava | tvaṃ sahasā nidrito’pi bhayaṃ matvā paraṃ paśum ||62|| apaśyan taṃ nijaṃ kīśaṃ lohayaṣṭyā hyatāḍayaḥ | bhagnau tvagrapadau tasya tāvattu bhalluko’pi ca ||63|| bhayaśabdaṃ sampracakre paśavo’nye’pi cukruśuḥ | tvayotthātha bhayaṃ prāpya vīkṣito bhayakṛd vanī ||64|| vṛkaḥ krūro vānarādo nātidūre hyupasthitaḥ | ākrośaṃ tvaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā tīkṣṇakuntena taṃ vṛkam ||65|| pradhāvya bhedayāmāsithaiva tvaṃ hṛdaye tadā | papātāpi mamārāpi vṛkastvaṃ nirbhayo’bhavaḥ ||66|| bhallukādyāḥ prāṇinaste nirbhayāśca tadābhavan | vānarasya sadā naijabandhanasthasya vai tadā ||67|| vinā vicāraṃ sahasā pādau bhagnau ruṣā tvayā | vānaraścāti vai kaṣṭaṃ prāpa tatra tavāśritaḥ ||68|| śaraṇasthāśritaścāpi jīvikāsādhanaṃ tathā | putravat pālitaścāpi lohadaṇḍena tāḍitaḥ ||69|| hastayorbhañjitastasya kaṣṭākrośanakāriṇaḥ | vastrakhaṇḍauṣadhādyaiśca pādaprasevanaṃ kṛtam ||3.184.70|| māsānte cāgrapādau tau nīrujau samajāyatām | kintu bhugnau vṛkṇarūpau vakrau sadā hyatiṣṭhatām ||71 || tatphalaṃ tu tvayā labdhaṃ cātra janmani vṛkṇatām | idānīṃ yāvadevaitad duḥkhaṃ te tad vyajāyata ||72|| athāpi tvaṃ vānarasya bhallukasya ca khelane | pūrvayugodbhavāṃ gāthāṃ jāmbavato hanūmataḥ ||73|| agāyathā yuddharūpāṃ droṇādryuddharaṇānvitām | mama sambandharūpāṃ vai bhaktibhāvasamanvitām ||74|| tena kīrtanapuṇyena vṛkṇo’pi tvaṃ susampadā | yukto bhavasi rājño’syāśraye’pi dhanavānasi ||75|| bhaktimān vartase cātra bhaktiṃ kārayasi dhruvām | bhaktibalaṃ tu te jātaṃ yenāhaṃ te vaśe’smi vai ||76|| āgatastava rakṣārthaṃ vṛkṇatā vāritā tava | śṛṇu cāyaṃ nṛpo yo’yaṃ vṛko mṛto vyajāyata ||77|| so’yaṃ sākaṃ tvayā cāste rājā nāstikabhāvavān | dveṣavān dharmakāryādau vartate prāk svabhāvataḥ ||78|| vṛkasyaiva nimittena kīśasya karabhagnatā | abhavat tatphalaṃ cārdhaṃ vṛkasyaiva bhavediti ||79|| rājño’sya vṛkṇatā prāptā tava pāpaṃ nṛpe gatam | śṛṇu cāpi vṛkaścāyaṃ kathaṃ vai nṛpatāṃ gataḥ ||3.184.80|| tṛtīye prāgbhave cāyaṃ krodhī vipro’bhavattadā
