| nāmnā prāṇadharaścāpi lokāḥ prāṇaharaṃ jaguḥ ||81 || udvejanaḥ kleśadaśca dharme karmaṇi cotsave | vivāhe vācane dāne balād gṛhṇāti cādhikam ||82|| atṛptaścātivādena haṭhena kalināpi ca | dhanaṃ cānnaṃ vastujātaṃ prasahyādatta eva saḥ ||83|| tapasvyapi tapastasya krodhena niṣphalaṃ yathā | tathābhavat satṛṣṇasya krodhitasya vṛthā tapaḥ ||84|| tathāpi devapūjādyairleśena tapasāpi ca | tathaiva pāpapuñjena mṛto yamālayaṃ yayau ||85|| citraguptaḥ śubhaṃ cāsyāśubhaṃ nyavedayattadā | pūrvaṃ kiṃ te prabhoktavyaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vada pāraye ||86|| ityevaṃ yamarājasya śrutvā vacotiroṣavān | jagād prathamaṃ pāpaṃ bhoktavyaṃ tu mayā yama ||87|| tato yāmyāni duḥkhāni bhoktuṃ yamena yojitaḥ | bhuktvā nirayaduḥkhāni śeṣeṇa vṛkatāṃ gataḥ ||88|| tatra tava kareṇāsya maraṇaṃ samajāyata | puṇyaiḥ pūrvakṛtairasya rājyaṃ svalpaṃ hi vartate ||89|| svabhāvāḥ prāgjanmajātāstyajyante naiva kenacit | pūrvasvabhāvadoṣeṇa kalahaścāsya rocate ||3.184.90|| tathāpi vṛkṇadeva tvaṃ nibodhayasi pratyaham | bhaktyarthaṃ śubhavākyādyaistenāsya vardhate śubham ||91|| śanaiḥ phalaṃ drumādau vai śanairghṛtaṃ payasyapi | śanaiḥ putraphalaṃ patnyāṃ śanaiḥ saṃskāraśodhanam ||92|| śanairjñānaṃ śanairvidyā śanairdravyārjanādikam | śanaiḥ samāgamai raṃgo jāyate’bhyāsavartinām ||93|| evaṃ rājño’sya kālena puṇyaṃ cāpi pravartate | pāpaṃ vṛkṇatvamātraṃ ca vartate’dya manāgapi ||94|| tathāpi bhaktayogena bhaktiyogena me tathā | mama yogena sarvaṃ tatpāpaṃ vināśameṣyati ||95|| śvaprātaścāsya nṛpatervṛkṇabhāvo gamiṣyati | krauryaṃ nāstikatā cāpi sarvaṃ naṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati ||96|| aikāntiko mama bhakto bhaviṣyati yathā bhavān | ubhayoścāpi me dhāmavāso’nte vai bhaviṣyati ||97|| vānarādyā ime putrā vṛkṇa te krūrabhāvanāḥ | idānīṃ mānavā jātāste’pi yāsyanti mokṣaṇam ||98|| ityevaṃ varadānaṃ vai datvāhaṃ ca tiro’bhavam | śvojāte prātarevāsya rājñastu vṛkṇatā gatā || 99|| bhajanaṃ me cakārāti hare kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa | kālena me dhāma divyaṃ bhāvaśūro nṛpo yayau || 3.184.10 0|| vṛkṇadevādayaścāpi muktiṃ kālena te yayuḥ | evaṃ lakṣmi prabhaktasya rakṣāṃ karomi nityadā || 101 || bhaktayogena jīvānāṃ kalyāṇaṃ jāyate dhruvam | bhaktayogena bhaktiḥ syānmama yogastathā bhavet| || 1 02|| pāpanāśo bhaveccāpi satsaṃgaḥ śevadhirnṛṇām | svalpaḥ kṛto’pi phalati śroturvaktuśca mokṣadaḥ || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vṛkṇadevākhyabhaktasya bhaktyā vṛkṇatānāśo bhaktayogena bhāvaśūranṛpatermokṣaṇaṃ prāgjanmavṛttāntādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā caturaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 184 ||
<3.185> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ bhaktasya śobhanām | nāmnā mañjulakeśasya halavādgrāmavāsinaḥ || 1 || halavānagare lakṣmi vipro mañjulakeśavān | vartate syātibhakto me dharme’tyantakṛtaśramaḥ || 2 || nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnāyī trisandhyāvandanārhaṇaḥ | viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca satīmarkaṃ prage’rcayan || 3 || stotrapāṭhaṃ prakurvaṃśca nityamarthayate harim | harekṛṣṇa hareviṣṇo tvadbhaktiḥ sarvadāstu me || 4 || māhātmyaṃ ca tava śreṣṭhamekāntikī tu dāsatā | bhakteṣu te tathā kṛṣṇa tvayi doṣamatirna me || 5 || tvadekāntikabhaktānāṃ satāṃ saṃgo’stu me sadā | darśanaṃ sarvadā cāstu mūrtīnāṃ te satāmapi || 6 || dharme matirdṛḍhā me’stu vyavasāyo mamāstu me | madyamāṃsādikasparśo’pi me māstu kadācana || 7 || abhakṣyāṇāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ me palāṇḍorlaśunasya ca | māstu māstu tathā caurye mano me cañcalaṃ kvacit || 8 || nindane tava bhaktānāṃ pravṛttirme ca māstvapi | devānāṃ nindane cāpi saṃkalpo’pi ca māstu me || 9 || āsurāṇāṃ nāstikānāṃ saṃgo māstvapi me kvacit | rāgo’pi viṣaye māstu snehastvayi sadāstu me || 3.185.1 0|| ātmaniveditā kṛṣṇa tvayi cāstu sadā mama | pātivratyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa tvayi sadāstu me ||1 1 || evaṃ kuṭumbasahito nityamarthayate hi mat | agālitaṃ jalaṃ naiva pibatyapyaniveditam || 12|| annaṃ phalādikaṃ naiva bhunaktyapyaniveditam | vastrāmbaravibhūṣādi na yuṃkte’pyaniveditam || 1 3|| yānaṃ vāhanamevāpi na yuṃkte cāniveditam | śṛṃgāraṃ copakaraṇaṃ yattad bhogyaṃ nivedya vai || 14|| upayuṃkte nijārthe vai mahābhāgavato yathā | karoti pūjanaṃ nityaṃ mama nārāyaṇasya saḥ || 15|| bhikṣārthaṃ ca tato yāti nagare prāpya bhikṣitam | gṛhamāgatya tat pacyaṃ pācayitvā nivedya me ||1 6|| bhuṃkte kuṭumbasahitastulasīpatrasaṃyutam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāṃ vācayatyapi || 17|| prajājanān cāgatāṃśca śrāvayatyeva cāśrame | patnīyuto’yaṃ bhūdevo lakṣmi putrādisaṃyutaḥ || 18|| mahābhāgavato dharmaṃ dṛḍhaṃ sampālayatyatha | kvacij jñātijanā jñātibhojane cāhvayantyapi || 19|| vipraṃ taṃ kintu vipro’sau bhuṃkte na jñātibhojanam agālitairjalaiścāpyasaṃskṛtānnādi randhitam ||3.185.20|| matvā bhuṃkte na tatrāpi palāṇḍavādipradūṣitam | laśunādivimiśraṃ vā bhuṃkte naiva kadācana ||21|| itihetorjñātijanā śoṣaṃ kurvanti taṃ prati | sa ca mañjulakeśo vai sahate sarvameva ha ||22|| athaikadā svasambandhigṛhe yayau tu mañjulaḥ | sambandhinastu taṃ prāhurbhavadarthaṃ tu śuddhimat ||23 || pācayitvā bhojanaṃ vai dāsyāmo bhuṅkṣva tṛptidam | viśvāsayitvaiva tato randhitānne manāgapi ||24|| surāṃ daduste jñātvaiva ruṣānvitāḥ subhojane | mañjulakeśo gandhena jñātvā pātrasthabhojane ||246 || surāsammiśraṇaṃ svalpaṃ śarkarākesarānvitam | tatyāja bhojanaṃ tadvai jalaṃ tatyāja tadgṛhe ||26|| viśvāsaghātaruṣṭaśca śaśāpa mañjulastadā | yo’yaṃ surāṃ dadau mahyaṃ viśvāsya bhojanena vai ||27|| so’yaṃ vicitto bhavatu pramattonmatta eva ca | evamukte tu sahasā janānāṃ sannidhau tadā ||28|| mañjulaputraśvaśuro vicittonmattatāṃ gataḥ | bhrāntacitto’bhavattūrṇaṃ maryādāṃ parihāya ca ||29||| vāṇīṃ duṣṭāṃ tathā ceṣṭāṃ duṣṭāṃ nirambarāṃ vyadhāt | nāmnā pāśupateśākhyaḥ śvaśuraḥ śāpadaṇḍitaḥ ||3.185.30|| vimanā bhraṣṭabhānaścopadravaṃ bahudhākarot | janānāṃ sannidhau tiṣṭhan vivastraśca pramehati ||3 1|| rauti nṛtyati tālaiśca kūrdatyapi ca dhāvati | ākrośati prahasati cāsambaddhaṃ pragāyati |||32||| pātravastrāṇi samprāpya vibhidya sphoṭayatyapi | avācyavācaṃ vadati ceṣṭāṃ karoti pāśavīm ||33|| evaṃ vai śāpadoṣeṇa vaicittyaṃ sahasā gataḥ | upadravān bahuśastu karotyatarkitānapi || 34|| kuṭumbaṃ bahudhā tasyodvignaṃ jātamupadravāt | prārthayāmāsa vipraṃ taṃ śāpanivṛttaye tadā ||35|| āha mañjulakeśo’pi tyajantvabhakṣyabhakṣaṇam | kurvantu śuddhimevāpi prāyaścittaṃ vrataṃ mahat ||36|| brahmakūrcākhyamevātaḥ śuddhyuttaraṃ makhaṃ śubham | vaiṣṇavaṃ samprakurvantu godānāni dadatvapi ||37|| mantrām̐śca vaiṣṇavām̐statra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ha | gṛhṇantu bhaktikāryārthaṃ tataḥ svāsthyaṃ bhaviṣyati ||38|| evaṃ tu kathitāḥ pāśupateśasya kuṭumbinaḥ | abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ tatyajuścakrurbrahmakūrcakam ||39|| vaiṣṇavaṃ ca makhaṃ cakrurdadurdānāni sadgavām | omanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me ||3.185.40|| itimantraṃ tathā cānyān mantrām̐śca jagṛhustadā | vaiṣṇavāste ca sañjātā harekṛṣṇa japanti ca ||41 || sarvametat kṛtaṃ cāpi vaicittyaṃ na nivartate | tadā mañjulakeśo’pi nirāhāro’tibhaktimān ||42|| saptāhaṃ cāsane tiṣṭhan bālakṛṣṇajapān vyadhāt | prārthayāmāsa cātyarthaṃ sambandhinaḥ sametya ca ||43|| athāhaṃ bhaktarakṣārthaṃ bhaktecchāpūraṇāya vai | yayāvadṛśyarūpaśca śuśrāva kīrtanādikam ||44|| saptāhe tu vyapagate’ṣṭame dine prage’rcane | ārārtrikottāraṇe’haṃ śālagrāme svarūpavān ||45|| divyarūpaṃ mama tebhyo’darśayaṃ śrīprasevitam | tejomaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ svarṇahārālirājitam ||46 || divyaveṣaṃ bhūṣaṇāḍhyaṃ kirīṭavaraśobhitam | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ cāśīḥpradaṃ śubham ||47|| prasannavadanaṃ kāntaṃ rakṣārthaṃ samupāgatam | etādṛśaṃ tu te māṃ saṃvīkṣya mohamupāyayuḥ ||48|| lagnāsteṣāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ śrīkṛṣṇe cittavṛttayaḥ | indriyāṇi samastāni līnāni mayi bhāsure ||49|| yathā samādhimāptāste tathā lagnāstadābhavan | mūrterme paramānandaṃ prāpuste’labhyamuttamam ||3.185.50|| sukhitā me sukhenaiva brahmānandayujo’bhavan | madanyasmṛtiśūnyāśca svarūpamātravedinaḥ ||51 || abhavam̐ste yathā muktā dhāmasthāḥ sthiracetanāḥ | evaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sukhaṃ datvā kṛtvā tejolayaṃ tataḥ ||52||| sādhurūpo’bhavaṃ tūrṇaṃ kāṣāyāmbaradhṛṅamuniḥ | mālāṃ kare dadhan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti saṃjapan ||53||| śrāvayan bhagavannāma cetayan bahirānayan | te sarve matsvaraṃ śrutvottasthuḥ samādhibhāvataḥ ||54|| agre vilokayāmāsuḥ sādhurūpaṃ hariṃ tu mām | praṇemuḥ premayuktāste vihvalā divyamānasāḥ||55|| śrīkṛṣṇakṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti japanto māmupāyayuḥ | cakrire daṇḍavat sarve nipetuḥ pādayośca me |||96|| mukhaṃ samādhau yad dṛṣṭaṃ tad dṛṣṭvā sādhuveṣiṇaḥ | aujjvalyaṃ cāpi tad dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā prasannatāṃ ca tām ||57|| yuvatvaṃ cāpi tad dṛṣṭvā niścikyuḥ prabhurāgataḥ | sādhurūpo rakṣaṇārthaṃ bhaktecchāpūraṇāya vai ||58||| arghyaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ ca śreṣṭhāsanaṃ jalaṃ daduḥ | phalaṃ ca bhojanaṃ yogyaṃ hṛdayāni ca te daduḥ ||59|| sarvasvamarpaṇaṃ cakrurnipetuḥ pādayormuhuḥ | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakrurbhujābhyāṃ māṃ samāśliṣan ||3.185.60|| prakṣālya payasā pādau dugdhaṃ papuśca te tadā | dhanyāḥ sma bhaktayogena bhagavantamupāgatāḥ ||61 || dhanyo mañjulakeśo’yaṃ bhaktaḥ putrīpateḥ pitā | dhanyo’smākaṃ ca jāmātā yatpitā haritatparaḥ ||62|| dhanyā putrī satī sādhvī kṛṣṇalīlābhidhānikā | yasyāḥ śvaśuro bhagavatprasannatāṃ samārjayat ||63 || aho bhaktaprasaṃgena śatānāṃ tu kuṭumbinām | sambandhināṃ śatānāṃ ca mokṣaṇaṃ jāyate dhruvam ||64|| yatra bhakto bhāgavato grāme’pi vasati prabhuḥ | grāmīṇāste bhaktayogānmuktiṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ ||65|| yatra bhakto bhaved grāme tatra pāpāni dehinām | naiva tiṣṭhanti kamale naśyanti bhaktakīrtanaiḥ ||66|| yatra bhaktasya sañcāro mārge vāṭyāṃ gṛhāntike | tatra vighnāni naśyanti māṃgalyaṃ tu pade pade ||67|| yadgrāme bhaktavasatistasya sīmno’ntare sthale | yāmyadūtā bhayaṃ prāptāḥ praviśanti na vai kvacit ||68|| yatra bhaktanivāso vai bhūtale vā jale’mbare | tattīrthaṃ sarvathā pāpidehināṃ tārakaṃ śubham ||69 || yatra bhaktastatra devāḥ samāyānti samarhitāḥ | muktā nārāyaṇo lakṣmyaḥ samāyānti vasanti ca ||3.185.70 || siddhayaścāpi yogāścaiśvaryāṇi vividhānyapi | vasanti bhaktasārthāste smṛddhayaḥ kalpapādapāḥ ||71 || vasavaḥ pārṣadāścāpi bhaktagṛhe vasanti ca | jaṃgamaṃ cetanaṃ tīrthaṃ bhakto bhavati sarvathā ||72|| jayastatra śriyastatra rasāstatra maharddhayaḥ | dharmastatra mahāmokṣo yatra bhakto virājate ||73||| bhaktāparādhakartāro bhaktasya kṛpayā hi te | pāpā api supuṇyāḥ syurbhaktā dayālavo yataḥ ||74|| asmākaṃ pāpabhāgyaṃ vai puṇyātmakaṃ vyavartata | adya bhaktaprasaṃgena dhanyo bhaktasamāgamaḥ ||75|| dveṣiṇāmapi muktirvai śrīkṛṣṇena vidhīyate | tathā no dveṣiṇāṃ muktirmañjukeśena kāryate ||76|| adya yajño’pi saphalo dānāni saphalāni ca | brahmakūrcavrataṃ cāpi saphalaṃ saphalaṃ januḥ ||77|| saphalāḥ smṛddhayo’smākaṃ cakṣūṃṣi saphalānyapi | yeṣāṃ gehe hariḥ sākṣāt sādhurūpo virājase ||78|| pāpaṃ kṣamasva bhagavan madyapānādijaṃ tu naḥ | bhaktāparādhaṃ bhagavan kṣamasva puruṣottama ||79|| śāpo mañjulakeśena dattaḥ pāśupateśake | vṛddhe conmattatārūpo nivartyatāṃ ramāpate ||3.185.80 || yathā svāsthyaṃ bhavedasya vilīyeta vicittatā | tathā sādho harekṛṣṇa śīghraṃ kṛpāṃ vidhehi naḥ ||81 || evaṃ te cārthayāmāsurmañjukeśo’pi māṃ tadā | pāśupateśavaicittyanāśārthamārthayanmuhuḥ |||82|| śrutvā bhaktasya vāñcchārthaṃ datvā kamaṇḍalorjalam | pāyayitvā drutaṃ pāśupateśaṃ viprameva ca ||83|| vaicittyaṃ nāśayāmāsa tadāhaṃ kamale drutam | atha svastho’bhavat so’pi sahasā bhānavān śuciḥ ||84|| pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre me tato daṇḍavannamaḥ | gadgadākṣaravāṇyā ca kṣamasveti jagāda ha ||85|| mokṣaṃ dehi kṛpāpārāvāra kṛṣṇeti cāha mām | mayā dhairyaṃ pradattaḥ sa pupūja paramādarāt ||86|| sāghuyogyaṃ samastaṃ vai dadau hṛdyaṃ tu bhāvanam | evaṃ vicittatāṃ tasya bhaktayogādapāharam ||87|| bhaktiṃ pradattavām̐ścāpi mantraṃ ca dattavām̐stadā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||88|| agṛhṇam̐ste mantramimaṃ jepuśca paramādarāt | grāmīṇāśca camatkāraṃ sādhuṃ śrutvā samāyayuḥ ||89|| sahasraśo janā lakṣmi viprādyā vīkṣya māṃ tathā | camatkāraṃ śubhaṃ sākṣād vīkṣya mā śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ||3.185.90|| sarve mantreṇa ca mayā saṃskṛtāste tu vaiṣṇavāḥ | bhūtvā māṃ bhejire lakṣmi mayāśīrvādayojitāḥ ||91 || athāhaṃ sampradāyaiva majjukeśāya sadvaram | yathecchasi tathā sarvaṃ vacanātte bhaviṣyati || 92|| ayaṃ pāśupateśo’pi kuṭumbasahitaḥ khalu | bhaktyā me cāntakāle vai muktimeṣyati cottamām ||93|| atra grāme tu ye bhaktā bhajiṣyanti pareśvaram | te te siddhīḥ susaṃsiddhāḥ prāpsyanti pāramārthikīm ||94|| atra yāmyā na yāsyanti vighnā yāsyanti dūrataḥ | bhaktiścātra pratāpātte bhakta lokeṣu vatsyati ||95|| ityuktvāhaṃ sādhurūpaṃ saṃjahāra tiro’bhavam | bhaktāste bhaktimāpannā bhajitvā māṃ tato’ntime ||96|| samaye ca vimānena pārṣadaiḥ saha pārṣadāḥ | bhūtvā dhāmākṣaraṃ me te yayurlakṣmi suvarculāḥ ||97|| mañjukeśo’pi bhakto me yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ mama | tadyogena manuṣyāśca pare’pi padavīṃ parām ||98|| nārāyaṇasya śaraṇaṃ vaikuṇṭhādau yayustathā | evaṃ bhaktasya kamale duḥkhahā sarvadāsmyaham ||99|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇānmananādapi | bhuktirmuktirbhavedeva śrīharerme pratāpataḥ || 3.185.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mañjulakeśākhyabhaktavipraśāpenonmattatā prāptasya pāśupateśaviprasya bhagavatā śāpamokṣaṇaṃ paramamokṣaṇaṃ ca kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 185 | |
<3.186> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ bhaktasya pāvanīm | vairāḍhyagrāmavāsasya nāmnā bāṇāṃgaṇasya tu || 1 || bāṇāṃgaṇo’bhavacchūdro hyasacchūdro dhvajīśvaraḥ | madyaṃ karoti vṛkṣāṇāṃ rasānāṃ bahudhā sa hi || 2 || vaṃśaparamparāprāptaṃ kurute karma nityadā | vikrayaṃ ca krayaṃ kṛtvā kuṭumbaṃ nirvahatyapi || 3 || athaikadā yayau sārthasaṃghātaṃ prāpya raivatam | tīrthaṃ kartuṃ tathā kartuṃ vikrayaṃ ca pradakṣiṇam || 4 || sahasraśo janā yānti kārtike revatācalam | saurāṣṭre vāmane tīrthe nārāyaṇahrade tathā || 5 || revatīkuṇḍake cāpi bhaveśvare mṛgīsthale | dāmodare nārasiṃhe svayaṃbhūparameṣṭhini || 6 || rādhālaye svarṇarekhānadyāṃ śrīhanumatsthale | gaṃgāyāṃ cāpi cāmbāyāṃ dattapāde vane vane || 7 || sītāvane rāmavane pūrvajāmbūvane tathā | boriyādroṇikāsthalyāṃ kāṣṭhahārivane tathā || 8 || devasarovare cāmravaṇe bhaveśvare punaḥ | kumudācalamāvṛtya pradakṣiṇaṃ dadhatyapi || 9 || bāṇāṃgaṇo’pi madyāni vikretuṃ śakaṭānvitaḥ | ayutāyutasaṃkhyākairmānavaiḥ saha yāti ha || 3.186.10 || tāmasā ye rudrabhaktāḥ śāktā vā bhairavāśritāḥ | madyaṃ pibanti bahudhā tīrthaṃ kurvanti kārtike || 11 || sādhvyaśca sādhavaścāpi gṛhasthā yatino’pi ca | vaiṣṇavā api tīrthārthaṃ yānti pradakṣiṇaṃ tadā || 1 2|| ṛṣayaḥ sādhavaḥ satyaḥ kathāśca vividhāḥ śubhāḥ | lakṣmyā nārāyaṇasyāpi satyāśca śaṃkarasya ca || 1 3|| sarasvatyā vedhasaśca gāyatryā raivatasya ca | revatyā vāmanasyāpi satīnāṃ ca satāmapi || 14|| dvijāśca paṇḍitāścāpi kurvanti ca sthale sthale | paṇḍitāścāpi vidvāṃso vṛddhāśca yoginastathā || 15|| yoginyo mātaraścāpi gāyanti kīrtanāni ca | bāṇāṃgaṇo divyadṛṣṭyā bhaktyā pānaṃ dadāti ca || 1 6|| ye tvāyānti nijānasaḥ samīpe bhikṣukā janāḥ | tebhyo dadāti pānāni puṇyadṛṣṭyā ca sevayā || 17|| atha rātrau tathā prātaḥ śṛṇoti kīrtanāni ca | bhajanāni vividhāni divyāni mokṣadāni ca || 18|| kathāyāṃ tatra vaiṣṇavyāṃ śuśrāva viṣṇukīrtitām | vāṇīṃ dharmātmikāṃ lakṣmi bhaktyanvitāṃ hitāvahām || 1 9|| tīrthaṃ sadā prakartavyaṃ saṃsāraṃ tartumicchukaiḥ | tīrthaṃ dvedhā bhavatyeva pṛthvyāṃ dvayaṃ hi labhyate ||3.186.20|| sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ceti tīrthadvayaṃ bhuvi sthitam | sthāvaraṃ jalatīrthādi parvatādi ca mandiram ||21 || arcā vanānyaraṇyāni vṛkṣāścaityāśca bhūmikāḥ | janmasthānāni devānāṃ satāṃ janmādibhūmayaḥ ||22||| tapaḥsthānāni viprāṇāṃ rajāṃsi gosthalāni ca | tīrthānyetāni sarvāṇi sthāvarāṇi bhavanti hi ||23|| teṣu gatvā snānapānāvagāhanavilokanaiḥ | taranti mānavāḥ śuddhabhāvāḥ sthāvarasevinaḥ ||24|| sthāvarebhyaḥ prathamaṃ vai pāpāni prajvalanti hi | tataḥ puṇyodayaścāpi tato bhaktirudeti ca ||25|| bhaktyā ca devatātuṣṭistuṣṭyā devādidarśanam | sākṣād divyaṃ jāyate vai divyatā ca tato bhavet ||26|| divyabhāvanayā bhakto vairāgyaṃ labhate’bhitaḥ | snehaṃ labhate cotkṛṣṭaṃ parāṃ bhaktiṃ pravindati ||27|| parābhaktyā bhavenmokṣaḥ śanaiḥ kālāntare’pi ca | tīvrasaṃvegino mokṣaḥ śīghraṃ sthāvarato’pi vai ||28|| bhavet kvacit kasyacittu sarveṣāṃ natu mokṣaṇam | tasmāt sthāvaratīrthāni na śīghramokṣadāni hi ||29|| mandamadhyādivegānāṃ śraddhāmāndye tu mandatā | mokṣe’pi jāyate lakṣmi cirapāvanalabdhitaḥ ||3.186.30|| tataḥ sthāvaratīrthebhyo jaṃgamānyuttamāni vai | mātātra jaṃgamaṃ tīrthaṃ pitā tīrthaṃ ca jaṃgamam ||3 1 || patistīrthaṃ jaṃgamaṃ ca satītīrthaṃ ca jaṃgamam | ṛṣitīrthaṃ jaṃgamaṃ ca sādhvītīrthaṃ ca jaṃgamam ||32|| sādhutīrthaṃ jaṃgamaṃ ca yogitīrthaṃ ca jaṃgamam | saṃghatīrthaṃ jaṃgamaṃ ca yātrātīrthaṃ ca jaṃgamam ||33 || bhaktatīrthaṃ jaṃgamaṃ ca tapasvitīrthamuttamam | ātmanivedibhaktastu tīrthaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ hi jaṃgamam ||34|| hareraṃśā devatāśca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | satīlakṣmīsarasvatyastīrthāni jaṃgamāni hi ||35|| yoginyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginyastīrthāni jaṃgamāni ca | kāmadughā dhenavaśca mānavā vrataśīlinaḥ ||36|| brahmacaryaparā māṃsamadyadoṣavivarjitāḥ | dharmāḍhyāśca janā bhaktāstīrthāni jaṃgamāni vai ||37|| punanti darśanādete sparśātprasevanāttathā | yeṣu madyaṃ tathā māṃsaṃ pāparūpaṃ na vidyate ||38|| ahiṃsāvratamāsthāya bhajante parameśvaram | satyaṃ vrataṃ samāsthāya kurvanti kīrtanaṃ kathāḥ ||39|| asteyavratamāsthāya dānaṃ kurvanti vastunaḥ | brahmacaryaṃ prapālyaiva sevante gurusattamān ||3.186.40 || dayāṃ vrataṃ samāsthāyānāthasevāṃ dadhatyapi | ācāryasevanaṃ guroḥ sevanaṃ dharmasaṃyutam ||41|| sarvārpaṇātmakaṃ puṇyaṃ kurvanti dhārmikā janāḥ | dehabhāvaṃ vihāyaiva sevante brahmabhāvanāḥ ||42|| ātmabhāvena sevante prabhubhāvena vai tathā | mokṣabhāvena sevante muktabhāvena vai tathā ||43|| evaṃ prasevitaṃ lakṣmi jaṃgamaṃ tīrthamuttamam | āśu dhunoti pāpāni mokṣamāśu dadātyapi ||44|| dṛṣṭāḥ spṛṣṭā natāścāpi pūjitā bhojitāstathā | pāyitā vāhitāścāpi sammarditāśca carcitāḥ ||45|| prasāditāścāmbaritāḥ śṛṃgāritāśca sādhavaḥ | ramitāścānanditāśca hāsitāḥ kīrtitāstathā ||46|| ārpitā āditāścāpi saṃvāhitāśca śāyitāḥ | bhūṣitā vanditāścāpi sevitā dhāritā hṛdi ||47|| sambandhitāḥ saṃsargitā āśliṣṭā nijavakṣasi | nīrājitā hāritāśca sugandhitā dravādibhiḥ ||48|| snāpitāḥ snehitāścāpi punantyāśu hi sādhavaḥ | vāsitā kṣamitāścāpi smṛtā ācāmitā hyapi ||49|| dhūpitā dīpitāścāpi kuṃkumitāśca candritāḥ | pradakṣiṇīkṛtāścāpi daṇḍavatpraṇatāstathā ||3.186.50|| hṛdaye sve dhṛtāścāpi punantyāśu hi sādhavaḥ | sādhutīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇātmakam ||51|| agnitīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ vai sūryatīrthaṃ tathāvidham | sādhutīrtha pāvanānāṃ pāvanaṃ paṃktipāvanam ||52|| sādhuprasādaḥ puṇyāḍhyaḥ sarvapāpavināśakṛt | sāghusparśo mahādīkṣā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī ||53|| sādhudarśanamevāpīndriyapāpapraṇāśakam | sādhūpadeśastīrthaṃ tu cātmakalmaṣanāśakam ||54|| sādhusaṃkalpa evāste hareḥ saṃkalpa uttamaḥ | sādhūnāṃ hṛdaye cāhaṃ lakṣmi vasāmi sarvathā ||55|| sādhūnāṃ caraṇe sarvatīrthāni nivasanti vai | sādhūnāṃ jaṃghayoḥ sarvapuṇyāni nivasanti ca ||56|| jānvostu vai satāṃ sarvayajñā vasanti puṇyadā | sādhusakthnoḥ sarvadevā vasanti devikāstathā ||57|| sādhugupte cāsti śīlaṃ vratāni ca tapāṃsi ca | sādhukaṭyāṃ siddhayaśca vasanti sarvasampadaḥ ||58|| sādhūdare sarvarṣayo vasanti jaṭhare’nalāḥ | sādhornābhau nivasanti yogaiśvaryāṇi sarvathā ||59 || sādhorvakṣasi pitaro nivasanti sudhārmikāḥ | pārśvayośca satāṃ sarvadānāni nivasanti vai ||3.186.60|| kukṣyoḥ satāṃ nivasanti sāgarāḥ sarva eva ca | sādhornitambayoḥ sarvadhiṣṇyāni nivasanti ha ||6 1 || sādhoḥ pṛṣṭhe meruśailaḥ sarvāśrayo vasatyapi | sādhostu skandhayoḥ sarvabalāni nivasantyapi ||62|| sādhoḥ kaṇṭhe brahmadhāma vasatyapi parātparam | bāhvoḥ satāṃ mahendrādyā dikpālā nivasanti vai ||63|| sādhoḥ kaphoṇikayostu vyūhā vasanti nityaśaḥ | sādhostu karayorlakṣmi śriyaḥ sarvā vasanti ca ||64|| sādhorhastatalayostu bhuktirmuktiśca vartataḥ | sādhoraṅgulikāsaṅghe candrasūryādayo grahāḥ ||65|| sāghornāḍīsu sarvāsu nadyaḥ sarvā vasanti ca | sādhoḥ romasu sarveṣu vasanti kalpapādapāḥ ||66|| sādhorgrīvāpṛṣṭhabhāge mahārudro virājate | sādhārmale mahāmāyā sādhorvīrye hiraṇmayaḥ ||67|| puruṣo rājate lakṣmi māyāpāśavivarjitaḥ | sādhostu karmaṇorlakṣmi cidākāśo virājate ||68|| sādhościbuke kamalā rājate smṛddhidāyinī | sādhoroṣṭhe divyavibhūtayo vasanti sarvadā ||69|| sādhormukhe’hamasmyeva sarvakāryapravartakaḥ | jihvāyāṃ tu satāṃ sarve vedā vasanti madgiraḥ ||3.186.70|| nāsikāyāṃ satāṃ bhūmā vairājaśca virājataḥ | kapolayoḥ satāṃ vaikuṇṭhaśca goloka ityubhau ||71 || gaṇḍayośca satāṃ mahāpuruṣaśca sadāśivaḥ | bhrukuṭau tu mahākālaḥ saṃkarṣaṇo virājate ||72|| netrayorbrahmavidyā ca sākṣātkāro’pi vartataḥ | lalāṭe brahmatejaśca sarvadhāmāni santi ca ||73|| mastake tvakṣaraṃ brahma brahmarandhre paraḥ pumān | keśeṣu sarvamuktāśca sādhūnāṃ nivasanti hi ||74|| icchāyāṃ śaktayaḥ sarvā mānase īśvarāḥ satām | buddhāvupāsanā cāste citte brahmapriyāḥ satām ||75|| sādhau śrībhagavānnāste nirvāṇaḥ sādhusaṃgatau | sādhoḥ prasannatāyāṃ vai sarvasvargāṇi santi hi ||76|| sādhoḥ śayane pralayāḥ prabodhane tu sṛṣṭayaḥ | samādhayaḥ suṣuptau tu dhyāne brahmapadaṃ satām ||77|| viveke copaniṣado mālikāyāṃ sudarśanam | brahmaśastraṃ tu vijñāne nārāyaṇāstramātmani ||78|| sarvāsthiṣvamṛtahradā virājante satāṃ sadā | sādhormūrtau divyabhāvāḥ kalpalatāstu pattale ||79|| vakṣormadhye dharmavaṃśaḥ panthānau stanayorubhau | āsane tu satāṃ sarvadevatānāṃ tu pīṭhikāḥ ||3.186.80|| kriyāyāṃ sarvadevyaśca vasanti hi satāṃ sadā | bhajane ca satāṃ tatra harestoṣo hi vartate ||81|| ityevaṃ vai kathāṃ ramyāṃ śuśrāva sa dhvajīśvaraḥ | madyavikrayapāpaṃ ca jñātavān śāstravākyataḥ ||82|| so’yaṃ śuśoca hṛdaye madyavikrayaṇaṃ mayā | tyaktavyaṃ sarvadā cānyodyamo grāhyo vikalmaṣaḥ ||83|| kulālasya yathā madyaṃ tathā mṛtpātraghaṭṭanā | kāryaṃ saṃvidyate tasmāt tyājyaṃ pāpaṃ tu madyakam ||84|| vicāryetthaṃ santadāsaṃ sādhuṃ bhaktiparāyaṇam | nārāyaṇahrade snātvā prārthayāmāsa madyapaḥ ||85|| sādho kulālakarmāsmi madyapo madyakārakaḥ | adya śrutvā kathāṃ snātvā nārāyaṇahrade tvaham ||86|| bhavaccharaṇamāpannaḥ śuddhaṃ kuru dhunotvagham | śrutvaivaṃ santadāsastu dadau vai vaiṣṇavaṃ jalam ||87|| prasādaṃ pradadau cāpi brahmakūrcavrataṃ dadau | dadau mantraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca mālāṃ ca taulasīṃ dadau ||88|| sakuṭumbasya tu bāṇāṃgaṇāya śaraṇārthine | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||89|| hare kṛṣṇa hare viṣṇo bālakṛṣṇa namo’stu te | itikīrtanamantraṃ ca dadau cakre suvaiṣṇavam ||3.186.90 || āśīrvādaṃ dadāvasmai gururharirmiliṣyati | āśīrvādaṃ paraṃ prāpya bāṇāṃgaṇo nijālayam ||91 || prayayau cāpi tatyāja madyasya vyavasāyakam | mṛttikāpātranirmāṇavyavasāyaṃ cakāra ha ||92|| bheje māṃ paramātmānaṃ nityaṃ karoti kīrtanam | kuṭumbasahitastasya snehibhaktasya vai mayā ||93|| bhaktirdṛṣṭā parā śuddhisahitā nityameva hi | bhajate māṃ me nivedya bhuṃkte pāti yunakti ca ||94|| cāturmāsyavrataṃ cakre sakuṭumbaḥ phalādibhuk | kārtike pūjanaṃ codyāpanaṃ cakre yathāvratam ||95|| ekādaśyāṃ ca vai rātrau cakre jāgaraṇaṃ tataḥ | dvādaśyāṃ prātarevāhaṃ prasanno’smai svadarśanam ||96|| dadau lakṣmi śriyā yuktaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ | vīkṣya māṃ daṇḍavaccakre pupūja paramādarāt ||97|| kuṭumbasahito me ca śaraṇaṃ patito muhuḥ | prārthayāmāsa ca tadā samuddhara bhavārṇavāt ||98|| hare kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa samuddhara bhavārṇavāt | athāhaṃ me caraṇasya vāri pāne dadau tadā ||99|| papau kuṭumbasahitaḥ puṇyātmā hyabhavattadā | nivṛttabandhanastūrṇaṃ muktyarthaṃ naddhamānasaḥ || 3.186.10 0|| tvarito’bhūttadā lakṣmi dehamatyājayaṃ tvaham | vimānavaramevainamadhyārohayamāśritam || 10 1|| apreṣayaṃ mama dhāmākṣaraṃ taṃ pārṣadaiḥ saha | athāsyāpi kuṭumbaṃ vai yathāyuṣyakṣayāgate || 1 02|| anayaṃ kramaśo dhāmākṣaraṃ me sadvacaḥsthitaḥ | evaṃ bhaktasya tasyaiva satāṃ yogena kalmaṣam ||1 03|| prajvālya sarvamevāsmai dadau dhāmākṣaraṃ mama | bāṇāṃgaṇo yayau mokṣaṃ kuṭumbaṃ cottarottaram || 1 04|| mokṣaṃ yayau vaiṣṇavaṃ tad bhūtvā pāvanamakṣaram | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇānmokṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne bāṇāṃgaṇākhyasya madyavikretuḥ sādhusamāgamena bhagavatā mokṣaḥ kṛtaḥ sādhoḥ mūrtervibhūtayaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaśītyadhikaḥ śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 186 ||
<3.187> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ tathā cānyakathāṃ śubhām | dhavalākhye pure tvāsīccarmakāro mṛtādanaḥ || 1 || grāmopaśalyavāsaśca mṛtānāṃ khuriṇāṃ sadā | paśūnāṃ grāmamadhyāt sa śavānāmapahārakaḥ || 2 || carmaśuddhikaraścāpyaspṛśyo dūre pratiṣṭhati | mṛtamāṃsādanaścāsīt sakuṭumbaḥ sadā hyaghī || 3 || kvacid vasatimāsādya kṛtvā tu carmavikrayam | prāptadhanena godhūmādyannaṃ śākaphalādikam || 4 || krītaṃ svagṛhamānāyya pācayitvā bhunaktyapi | kvaciccāraṇyamārjāraiḥ śṛgālaiḥ śaśakaistathā || 5 || vārāhaiśca tarakṣvādyaiḥ kvacit kacchapamatsyakaiḥ | vidadhāti kuṭumbasya bhojanaṃ piśitāśanaḥ || 6 || evaṃ jātyā karmaṇā ca bhojanenātikilbiṣī | mṛtādanākhyaścarmakṛd dūre tyājyo’vasat sadā || 7 || athaikadā tu varṣāyāṃ patitāyāmaharniśam | jalapūraṃ samāyātaṃ bahuvegaṃ samantataḥ || 8 || tatraike prāṇino jīvā uhyante vaninastadā | mṛtāśca jīvinaścāpi grāmyāśca paśavo’pi ca || 9 || ye caranti tṛṇakṣetre gocare te’pi kecana | pūravegena varṣāyāṃ gṛhaṃ mantuṃ na śekire ||3.187.1 0|| ekā gauḥ pūravegena cohyamānā tu jīvitā | carmakārasya vāsasyocchrāyasyaiva samīpataḥ || 11 || jalaiścākṛṣyamāṇā sā nirgatā vīkṣitā tadā | carmakāreṇa dayayoddhartuṃ gāṃ vai samīhitam ||12|| mṛtādanaḥ svayaṃ puṣṭastartuṃ śakto balī dṛḍhaḥ | śatahastamitāṃ rajjuṃ kaṭyāṃ badhvā jale’patat ||1 3|| rajjuprāntaṃ dvitoyaṃ tu datvā doṣṣu kuṭumbinām | aparāṃ ca dṛḍhāṃ rajjuṃ mukulitāṃ gale’kṣipat ||14|| patitvā sahasā vārivege vahati yatra gauḥ | tīrtvā vegena tasyāstu nimnabhāge puro’bhavat || 15|| pūreṇa cohyate dhenuścarmakāro’pi cohyate | tīrasthā rajukādhrā ye te’nudhāvanti taṃ taṭam ||1 6|| taratā carmakāreṇa hastasya lāghavena vai | mukulitāyā rajjvāstu prānto dhenugale kṛtaḥ || 17|| granthiḥ kṛtā ca sahasā śṛṃgayornihitā tu sā | rajjuṃ kṛtvā lambamānāṃ prāntaṃ kaṭyāṃ babandha saḥ || 18|| atha kuṭumbinaḥ prāhākarṣayantu balāditi | kuṭumbibhiśca sā rajjurākṛṣṭā svakaradhṛtā || 1 9|| carmakāraḥ pūravegāt taṭamākarṣito’bhavat | dhenuścāpi kaṭirajjuvaddhā cākarṣitābhavat ||3.187.20|| tīraṃ prati samākṛṣṭā militvā tu kuṭumbibhiḥ | carmakāreṇa sahitā sajīvā tīramāgamat ||21|| tadā gauḥ prāṇasaṃrakṣātuṣṭāśīrvādamāha tān | bhavatāṃ sarvapāpāni naṣṭāni mama rakṣaṇāt ||22|| godāne yatphalaṃ gojīvane yacca phalaṃ mahat | gosevāyāṃ phalaṃ yacca tatsarvaṃ bhavatāṃ bhavet ||23|| prasūyamānādhenvāśca dāne yat phalamucyate | tatphalaṃ bhavatāmastu mama prāṇaprarakṣaṇāt ||24|| svarṇadhenuphalaṃ yacca kapilādhenujaṃ phalam | gomedhe ca phalaṃ yat tadastu vo mama rakṣaṇāt ||25|| pṛthvīrakṣāphalaṃ yacca prajārakṣāphalaṃ tu yat | kanyārakṣāphalaṃ yattadastu vo mama rakṣaṇāt ||26|| satīrakṣāphalaṃ yacca bālarakṣāphalaṃ ca yat | viprarakṣāphalaṃ yattadastu vo mama rakṣaṇāt ||27|| sādhurakṣāphalaṃ yacca devarakṣāphalaṃ ca yat | śaraṇāgatarakṣotthaṃ vastadastu mamāvanāt ||28|| bhītarakṣāphalaṃ yacca prāṇarakṣāphalaṃ ca yat | mokṣadānaphalaṃ yattadastu vo mama rakṣaṇāt ||29|| dharmarakṣāphalaṃ yacca garbharakṣāphalaṃ ca yat | mātṛsevāphalaṃ yacca vo’stu tanmama rakṣaṇāt ||3.187.30|| devapūjāphalaṃ yacca mṛtyutrāṇaphalaṃ ca yat | gaṃgātīrthaphalaṃ yattad vo’stu mama prarakṣaṇāt ||3 1 || brahmahatyādipāpāni paśuhiṃsodbhavāni ca | māṃsabhakṣaṇapāpāni līyantāṃ mama rakṣaṇāt ||32|| gavārthe brāhmaṇārthe vā sādhvarthe ca satīkṛte | devārthe prāṇadātustu sarvapāpavināśanam ||33|| madarthe prāṇadā yūyaṃ madarthe kṛtajīvanāḥ | mama rakṣākarā yūyaṃ jīvantu ṛddhisevitāḥ ||34|| bhuktiṃ muktiṃ mahāsmṛddhiṃ bhuñjantu svargasadṛśīm | vaṃśo vo’stu sadā bhakto bhaktimān gavi gopātau ||35|| gopāle gopikākānte govinde gopabālake | gopālabālake sneho goloke vasatiśca vaḥ ||36|| ityevaṃ gaurdadau tebhyaścāśīrvādām̐stadā śubhān | kampamānā bhayodvignā śītārttā kṣudhitā tathā ||37|| atha śanaiśca tāṃ dhenuṃ sagarbhāṃ cāśrayecchukīm | nināya carmakāraḥ sa svālaye tāṃ rarakṣa ha ||38|| dadau ghāsottamagrāsān siṣeve tṛṇavāribhiḥ | nāsyāḥ kaścit samāyāti svāmī netuṃ na vidyate || 39|| tataḥ sā carmakārasya gṛhe vāsaṃ vyadhācca gauḥ | tṛṇānyattvā pārśvabhūmau sāyamāgatya tiṣṭhati ||3.187.40|| carmakāro nijāṃ matvā sevate tu yathābalam | daridro’pi yatitvāpi go’rthaṃ tṛṇaṃ jalaṃ muhuḥ ||41 || ānayatyeva kṣetrādvā vanādvā dūrabhūmitaḥ | evaṃ prasevamānasya mṛtādanasya tasya hi ||42|| gosevāyāḥ phalaṃ dhenorāśīrvādaphalaṃ tathā | prāptaṃ tenaikadā prātaḥ preritastu mṛtādanaḥ ||43|| adya gṛhaṃ vilimpāmi gauramṛdā ca śakṛtā | vicāryetthaṃ striyā sākaṃ nītvā sītāṃ khanitrikām ||44|| vaṃśapātradvayaṃ cāpi mṛdamāhartumeva ha | nadītīraṃ yayau yatra gauramṛd labhyate śubhā ||45|| sītayā ca khanitreṇa garte khanati mṛttikām | vitastimātraṃ khanitaṃ tīre pārśvagabhūstaram ||46|| tāvaccarustāmradhātoḥ svarṇarūpyakasaṃbhṛtaḥ | nirgato bhūtalamadhyācchobhano daivavāñcchayā ||47|| mṛtādanena śīghraṃ vai tasmāt svarṇasya mudrikāḥ | niṣkāsya vaṃśapātre mṛttikāguptāśca vai gṛham ||48|| ānītā pañcapātrāṇi na tu jānāti kaścana | gṛhāntare tu vivare sarvāḥ kṣiptāḥ sugopitāḥ ||49|| gosevāyāḥ phalaṃ matvā sevate gāṃ sabhāryakaḥ | tāmrapātraṃ tu garte vai yathāsīt tattathā punaḥ ||3.187.50|| riktaṃ nidhāya saṃgopya mṛdbhirgṛhaṃ gato hi saḥ | yathāpekṣaṃ nāṇakena bhuṃkte sukhāni sarvathā ||5 1 || bhuṃkte bhojanapānāni vastrāṇi modakāni ca | yathānye naiva jānīyustathā bhuṃkte’rjitaṃ dhanam ||52|| tena pathā samāyātānatithīn sevate’pi ca | goṣṭhe sthitān drumacchāyāpradeśe sevate’tithīn ||53|| phalāni śarkarāścāpi madhuparkaṃ dadātyapi | vastraṃ jalaṃ yathāpekṣaṃ dadāti caṇakādikam ||54|| ghṛtapakvaṃ tailapakvaṃ pakvaṃ ca vahnināpi yat | sūryapakvamṛtupakvamannaṃ dadāti sādhave ||55|| yogyaṃ dadāti nāyogyaṃ sevate sādhuyoginaḥ | kuṭumbaṃ sevate sādhūn śṛṇoti bhajanāni ca ||56|| kathāṃ śṛṇoti me ramyāṃ sādhūktāṃ pāvanīṃ parām | ahiṃsā paramo dharmo vighasāśī pramucyate ||57|| māṃsādanaṃ mahatpāpaṃ yāmyapurīprayojakam | matsyādaḥ sarvamāṃsāśī kadāpi naiva mucyate ||58|| abhakṣyabhakṣaṇād bhraṣṭo na yāti mokṣaṇaṃ kvacit | yāmyadūtāḥ pīḍayanti randhayanti yamālaye ||59|| taṃ tu māṃsādanaṃ nityaṃ pācayanti mahānale | nikṛntanti mārayanti narake pātayanti ca ||3.187.60|| madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā cauryaṃ vyavāyaśceti kalmaṣam | bhayaṃkaraṃ mahāghoraṃ kartavyaṃ naiva mānavaiḥ ||61 || janma cedaṃ mānavaṃ vai mokṣāya labhyate bhuvi | mokṣaḥ sādhyo mānavairvai tyājyā doṣā aghāni ca ||62||| bahuṣvapi tu deheṣu pakṣiṣu ca paśuṣvapi | madyamāṃsādayo bhuktāstatpāpānto na vidyate ||63|| asmin vai mānave bhāve puṇyaṃ kāryaṃ divaṃpradam | bhaktiḥ kāryā hareścāpi mokṣo gamyaḥ pare’kṣare ||64|| evaṃ kathāṃ pāvanīṃ ca carmakāraḥ śṛṇoti vai | tato’sya jātā sahasā mumukṣā sādhusaṃgataḥ ||65|| niyamān jagṛhe cāhiṃsāṃ ca māṃsādivarjanam | annabhojitvamevāpi nityaṃ śrīharisevanam ||66|| sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ gavāṃ sevanaṃ pāpavarjanam | dānaṃ yathārhaṃ pātrāya bhagavatkīrttanaṃ tathā ||67|| vratotsavām̐śca devānāṃ cāturmāsyavratāni ca | evaṃvidhān sa niyamān jagrāha mokṣadān sadā ||68|| atha sādhurdharmaśālāyano nāmnāṭavīṃ bhraman | nirambaraḥ samāyātaścarmakāragṛhāntikam ||69|| dadarśainaṃ carmakāro yoginaṃ yogamānasam | smarantaṃ paramātmānaṃ japamālānvitaṃ śubham ||3.187.70 || digambaraṃ praśāntaṃ ca nirvikāraṃ sthirāśayam | śīlavrataṃ rāgaśūnyaṃ surūpaṃ jaṭilaṃ munim ||71 || carmakārastu taṃ gatvā praṇāmamakaronmudā | svāgataṃ te mahābhāga sādho jayo’stu te sadā ||72|| āyāhi mama vāse’tra carmakāro’smi jātitaḥ | yadi tvaṃ manyase sādho gṛhaṃ pāvaya me’nagha ||73|| śrutvā śālāyanaḥ prāha kalyāṇaṃ satyavādinaḥ | tavāstu sādhubhaktasya bhaktasya bhagavānapi ||74|| vaśībhavati divyātmā tatra sādhostu kā kathā | pāvanā bhagavadbhaktā api cāṇḍālayonayaḥ ||75|| carmakārāḥ prajāḥ sarvāścarmanaddhā bhavanti hi | carmagarbhe carmayonau prajāyante hi carmataḥ ||76|| carmasnānaṃ kārayanti carma śṛṃgārayanti ca | carmaṇyeva ca tailādyaiḥ kurvanti mardanādikam ||77|| bhūṣāmbarāṇi dehāya carmiṇe cārpayantyapi | carmamayaṃ jagat sarva ko nāsti carmakārakaḥ ||78|| brahmā carmakāraścāste tatputrāścarmakārakāḥ | bhakta tvaṃ carmakāro’si carmakārasya vaṃśajaḥ ||79|| prajānāṃ carmakāratve viśeṣo nāsti kaścana | mugdhā ye carmaviṣaye carmakārā hi te matāḥ ||3.187.80|| amugdhāścarmaviṣaye brahmākārā hi te matāḥ | sādhavo brahmasadanā brahmākārā bṛhatpriyāḥ ||81 || ātmāyaṃ vidyate yāvad dehe sa carmakārakaḥ | adeho jāyate bhaktyā mokṣo sa brahmakārakaḥ ||82|| ahamātmā sādhurūpo brahmarūpo bhavāmi ha | harerbhaktyā snehamayyā brahmākāro bhavāmyaham ||83|| bhakta tvaṃ sādhuyogena brahmākāro bhavasyapi | sādhubhaktāḥ sādhurūpāḥ sādhukāriṇa eva te ||84|| sādhvarthaṃ yasya sarvasvaṃ brahmātmā cocyate hi saḥ | sa eva pāparahitaḥ puṇyātmā paṃktipāvanaḥ ||85|| ityevamuktvā sādhuḥ sa yayau tasyālayaṃ tadā | carmakāro bhaktarājaścakre’sya svāgataṃ śubham ||86|| āsanaṃ pradadau ramyaṃ pādaprakṣālanaṃ vyadhāt | papau pādāmṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kuṭumbasahito hi saḥ ||87|| pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre dehasammardanaṃ tathā | madhuparkaṃ dadau miṣṭaṃ śarkarāṃ saktumityapi ||88|| dadau phalāni śreṣṭhāni pakvāni vividhāni ca | jalaṃ ca śayanaṃ cāpi dadau viśrāntihetave ||89|| putrāḥ putryo dampatī ca sarvaṃ dehasya mardanam | bhojayitvā pracakrurvai mārgaśramanivṛttaye || 3.187.90|| sādhurnidrāṃ parāṃ lebhe sarve cakruśca mardanam | dehasaṃvāhanaṃ cāpi vyajanenānilārpaṇam ||9 1 || evaṃ sevāṃ pracakruste dharmaśālāyanasya vai | dharmaśālāyano nidrāṃ kṛtvā ca bubudhe tadā ||92|| jalaṃ pītvā niṣasādāsane mālājapānvitaḥ | mṛtādanādyāścāgre’sya niṣedurbhaktibhāvataḥ ||93|| sādhuḥ prāha sadā bhaktiḥ kartavyā paramātmanaḥ | gosevā sādhusevā ca kartavyā muktaye tviha ||94|| gṛhāṇa mantraṃ divyaṃ tvaṃ kuṭumbena yuto hi mat | svargaṃ divyaṃ tato mokṣaṃ lapsyase nātra saṃśayaḥ ||95|| ityuktaścarmakāraḥ sa kuṭumbasahitastadā | mantraṃ jagrāha sādhośca harekṛṣṇanarāyaṇa ||96|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | bālakṛṣṇaṃ tato bheje sādhūktapaddhatiṃ vrajan ||97|| tataḥ sa tīrthayātrāyāṃ sādhunā saha vai yayau | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ||98|| suvarṇaṃ bahudhā tatra dāne yajñe samārpayat | mandiraṃ kārayāmāsa sarastaṭe tathā ca saḥ ||901|| āśramaṃ racayāmāsa bhajanārthaṃ nijaṃ śubham | vaṃśena sahitastatra sādhunā saha cāvasat || 3.187.10 0|| athaikadāhaṃ kamale prasannastatra cāyayau | darśanaṃ svaṃ dadau tasmai caturbhujaṃ sutaijasam || 101 || kuṭumbaṃ pūjayāmāsa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ māṃ sanātanam | mṛtādano mama pādavāri prakṣālya saṃpapau || 1 02|| vimānaṃ tūrṇamāyātaṃ brahmadhāmno’tibhāsuram | tatra mṛtādanaścādhyarohan mama nideśataḥ || 1 03|| gavā sākaṃ tayā tatrānayaṃ taṃ mama dhāma vai | anyat sarvaṃ kuṭumbaṃ ca svarge devāstato’bhavan || 1 04|| puṇyaṃ bhuktvā dhenuvṛttaṃ yāsyanti dhāma me param | sādhusevāprapuṇyaṃ ca mama bhakteḥ phalaṃ tathā || 1 05|| bhokṣyante ruciraṃ lakṣmi śāśvatānandapūritam | evaṃ gosevayā māṃsādanapāpaṃ vināśitam || 1 06|| puṇyodbhavena ca sādhusamāgamo dhanāgamaḥ | tīrthavāsaḥ parāmuktiḥ sarvaṃ tasya vyavartata || 1 07|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇānmananādapi | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi śāśvataṃ padamarjyate || 1 08|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mṛtādananāmakacarmakārasya dhenoḥ prāṇarakṣaṇena māṃsādanādipāpanāśaḥ puṇyaprāptiḥ sādhoḥ samāgamaḥ svargaṃ mokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 187 ||
<3.188> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ stenasya mokṣaṇaṃ śubham | āsīt śaṃkudharākhyo vai steno mālavyapattane || 1 || stenāvāse kṛtāvāsaḥ stenamaṇḍalapuṣṭikṛt | stainyayātrāparaścāste rātrau śastrādidhārakaḥ || 2 || bhinnaveṣadharaścāpi bhinnakarmā bhavatyapi | bhedaṃ jñātvā praveśasya yathā yatnena sarvathā || 3 || rātrau kṛtvā ca saṃketaṃ dhanacauryaṃ karoti hi | kvacidaśve kvaciduṣṭre kvacittu dīrghagardabhe || 4 || dhanabhāraṃ nidhāyaiva dūraṃ yāti dravan hi saḥ | evaṃ deśāntare gatvā corayitvā dhanāni vai || 5 || ānāyya svagṛhaṃ caurairvibhajya svaṃ prarakṣati | utsavaṃ kurute cāpi bhuṃkte khādati modate || 6 || cauryaṃ tu sarvathā kāryaṃ cānyat kāryaṃ na vidyate | stainyodyamaḥ stainyacintaḥ stainyadhyānaparo’sti saḥ || 7 || stainyodarabharaścāste kuṭumbodarapūrakaḥ | kadācid yatra devānāmutsavo vā mahān bhavet || 8 || pāresahasraṃ janatā milanti yatra tīrthake | caitye vā mandire cādrau grāmānte vā nadītaṭe || 9 || devālaye ca vā tatra yātyayaṃ cauramaṇḍalaḥ | mārgayatyeva sarvatra dravyāṇi kutra santi hi ||3.188.1 0|| nirjanaṃ vā kadā kutra jāyate dhanino gṛham | kva mārgo vā praveśasya niḥsṛtirvā kva vā katham || 1 1|| kathaṃ labdhiḥ kathaṃ svasya rakṣā pracchannatā katham | evaṃ svadhyānanirataḥ sasārthaḥ śaṃkudhārakaḥ ||12|| anyānyapattane cauryaṃ kṛtvā cāharate dhanam | evaṃvidhasya tasyaivaikadā svapnaṃ niśottare ||1 3|| abhavat svarṇaratnānāṃ labdhyātmakamasīmakam | araṇye pūrvamevāsīd rājadhānītyalokayat ||14|| svapne tatra vane dūre nirjane koṣamuttamam | suvarṇaratnakhacitaṃ purā rājyaprarakṣitam || 15|| guptaṃ koṣaṃ na jānāti kaścidanyo yathā tathā | prātarutthāya bhuktvāyaṃ vihāravyājato yayau || 16|| svapne yathā dadarśāyaṃ vanaṃ mārgaṃ purāṇakam | vṛkṣaghaṭāṃ ca pāṣāṇān pṛthvīṃ prācyastarānvitām || 17|| prācīnavasatiṃ tatra darśayitrīṃ purāṅkanaiḥ | tathā sarvaṃ dadarśāyaṃ steno viśvāsamāptavān || 18|| pūrvajanmani ye coptāḥ saṃskārāścirakālinaḥ | aṃkurayanti kamale janmāntare na saṃśayaḥ || 19|| cauro’yaṃ pūrvakāle tu sahasravarṣapūrvage | rājñaḥ koṣādhyakṣa āsīt suhotrasya tu bhūbhṛtaḥ ||3.188.20 || suhotrasya tadā tatra nagarī pitṛnāmataḥ | kāṃcanena janakena kṛtāsīt kāñcanī purī ||21 || candravaṃśīyarājñaḥ sā koṣarakṣāmayī hyabhūt | atha kālāntare koṣā niṣkāsitāḥ sthalāntare || 22|| nītāśca nihitāḥ sarve tathāpi kapaṭena vai | apajāpakanāmnā vai koṣādhyakṣeṇa sarvathā ||23|| anye yathā na jānīyustathā koṣastu vai manāk | suvarṇānāṃ ca ratnānāṃ pṛthaktvasya nigartitaḥ ||24|| tatraiva śeṣito naijasvārthārthaṃ kapaṭena ha | atha kālāntare yāte ciraṃ kāle gate’pi vai ||25|| apajāpo na vai netuṃ śaśāka guptakoṣakam | evameva mṛtastatra mālavyapattane nave ||26|| cauryadoṣeṇa yāmyāṃ vai nagarīṃ prāpito yamaiḥ | lohadaṇḍaistāḍitaḥ sa duḥkhāyitaśca kuṇḍake |||27|| pāśaiśca mudgarairdaṇḍairdaṇḍāyito muhurmuhuḥ | pāpabhogottaraṃ mukto vane tatra hi nirjane ||28|| pretarūpo’bhavannānyaṃ gantuṃ dadāti tatsthalam | araṇye ramate nityaṃ koṣaṃ paśyati kevalam ||29|| bhuṃkte vanyaṃ samastaṃ ca koṣadrume vasatyapi | evaṃ tvaṣṭaśatānyasya varṣāṇāṃ vigatāni vai ||3.188.30|| pretasya nirjane tatra tadā prācīnabhūtale | tapastaptuṃ samāyato vipro nāmnā sumantukaḥ ||3 1 || vane vijñāya ramaṇīṃ tapoyogyāṃ śubhasthalīm | nirvighnāṃ vṛkṣavallyādistambāḍhyāṃ sujalāpagām ||32||| nātidūre vaṭavṛkṣacchāyāmāśritya tāpasaḥ | tapaścakre bhajan kṛṣṇaṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ||33|| atha samvatsare yāte preto’yaṃ puṇyaśālinam | matvā coddhārakarttāraṃ nijasyeti tu tāpasam ||34|| kirātarūpamāsthāya vaṭacchāyāṃ tu tatpuraḥ | yayau naman praśaṃsam̐śca tapastasya mahātmanaḥ ||35|| sumantustapasā tvenaṃ jānāti pretarūpiṇam | tathāpi taṃ svāgataṃ vai cakre vaṭagṛhāgatam || 36|| vaninaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ ca kṛśaṃ ca duḥkhinaṃ tu tam | papraccha munirāḍ dehin kuśalaṃ te vanin tviha ||37|| preto jagāda kuśalaṃ tāpasasya pratāpataḥ | muniḥ papraccha vāsaṃ ca grāmaṃ dharmaṃ ca karma ca ||38|| preto niṣkapaṭo bhūtvā vṛttāntamāha cāditaḥ | pūrvamāsaṃ tviha koṣādhyakṣaḥ kapaṭapāpavān ||39|| mṛtvā yāpyapurīṃ gatvā bhuktvā duḥkhāni yātanāḥ | pratāraṇaphalaṃ kiṃcidavaśiṣṭaṃ pralabhya ca ||3.188.40 || jāto’smyatra vane preto dayayā māṃ vimocaya | evaṃ sa upavām̐stasmai koṣaṃ nādarśayattadā ||41|| dayāluḥ sa ṛṣistasmai gāyatrīṃ prajapan jalam | dadau pretasya muktyarthaṃ pretatā vigatāsya ca ||42|| kintu cauryasvabhāvena kāpaṭyena tu mānave | mālavyapattane cāyaṃ cauraḥ śaṃkudharo’bhavat ||43|| pūrvasaṃskārasahitaścauryaniṣṇāta eva saḥ | evaṃ stainyaparasyāsya lakṣmi saṃskārasadbalāt ||44|| svapne’sya smaraṇaṃ jātaṃ koṣasya pūrvajanmanaḥ | taṃ koṣaṃ vai tato draṣṭuṃ yayau tu nirjane vane ||45|| sarvaṃ vilokayāmāsa sacihnaṃ svapnabhālitam | prasanno’bhūttadā cāsau mānavo lobhapuṣkalaḥ ||46|| vaṭaṃ dadarśa tatraiva tāpasasya purā sthalam | tapasvī tatra nāstyeva vaṭastu vidyate śubhaḥ ||47|| sumantukastu tapasā divyadeho yato’bhavat | vaṭe tirobhavannāste tapasvī divyavigrahaḥ ||48|| śaṃkudharastato naiva dadarśa taṃ tapasvinam | vaṭamātraṃ dadarśaiva neme vaṭaṃ purā smaran ||49|| yayau sthalaṃ tu koṣasya tṛptiṃ matvā suvarṇajām | āyayau suprasannaśca svagṛhaṃ sāyameva ha ||3.188.50|| athaikalaḥ svahṛdaye cintayāmāsa vai muhuḥ | kathaṃkāraṃ dhanaṃ tasmādāneyamatra vai mayā ||51 || yathā cānye na jānīyustathā cāhāryameva tat | vane tatra nivāsaṃ vai kṛtvā śanaiḥ śanairiha |||52|| mayā tvekākinā cānetavyaṃ vai chadmanā sadā | ityevaṃ samvicāryaiva cauryamiṣeṇa caikalaḥ ||23|| uktvā gṛhajanān śastrāṇyādāya tadvanaṃ yayau | yāvat khanati cauryaiṇa śanaiḥ śanaistamasyapi ||54|| āprātaḥ khananaṃ kṛtvā vaṭasyādho yayau kṣaṇam | viśrāmārthaṃ punastatrāgatyākhanacchanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||55|| nirbhayo vanamadhye vai hyekākī cāviśaṃkitaḥ | tāvadvaṭāttatra śabdaścāyāto mānavo yathā |||56|| śrutvā paśyatyabhitaḥ sa śaṃkitaśca drutaṃ tadā nāpaśyanmānavaṃ kaṃcit punaḥ punaḥ suśaṃkitaḥ ||57|| khanayāmāsa śanakaistāvatpāṣāṇabhāritā | śilā tatrāgatā tvekā tāmutthāpya śilātale ||58|| vyalokayattāmrapātrāṇyaṣṭa bhūtāni sarvathā | suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ bhūṣā mudrā ratnāni hīrakān ||59|| svapnadṛṣṭān samastām̐śca viśeṣān dravyasaṃjñitān | vilokya sarvathā sarvān śāntiṃ jagāma cottamām ||3.188.60|| athaitāni tu pātrāṇi pidhāya ca yathāyatham | tṛṇapatrādipuñjaṃ copari nyasyattataḥ sa ca ||61 || kaṇṭakadrumaśākhāśca cikṣepa copari drutam | atha vaṭaṃ punargatvā viśrāntimāpa vai kṣaṇam ||62|| smaran rātrau prakartavyaṃ dravyasya haraṇaṃ yathā | cintayan klṛptanāṃ sarvāṃ suṣvāpa kṣaṇameva saḥ |||63|| utthitaḥ sa ghaṭikānte tāvattu purato’bhavat | yogirāṭ mūrtimān sākṣāt sumantuko hasan muhuḥ ||64|| stabdho bhūtvā kṣaṇaṃ matvā maharṣiṃ tāpasaṃ tu tam | purā dṛṣṭaṃ drutaṃ pratyabhijñāya praṇanāma tam ||65|| prasannavadano bhūtvoddhārakaṃ taṃ munīśvaram | jātismaro drutaṃ prāha preto’bhavaṃ guro purā ||66|| atrāhaṃ bhavatā cāpyuddhṛto’haṃ mānavo’smi ca | śaṃkudharākhyaścauro’haṃ cauryakarmaparāyaṇaḥ ||67|| cauryeṇa kṛtanirvāho vicarāmi tu pāpavān | uddhāraṃ kuru viprendra pūrvaguro dayānidhe ||68|| yathā me syādabhyudayo mokṣaṇaṃ ca tathā kuru | śrutvaivaṃ śaraṇasthasya purābhaktasya vai muniḥ ||69|| sumanturdayayā prāha taduddhāraṃ vicintayan | kariṣye tava paramaṃ śreyo nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ||3.188.70|| pravadāmi yathā śiṣya tathā vidhehi sādaram | śṛṇu svalpamupadeśaṃ tava yogyaṃ vadāmi te ||71 || candravaṃśo bhavānāsīnmahākoṣapatiḥ purā | tato yāmyapure gatvā bhuktvā ca yātanāstataḥ ||72|| preto jātastato me’pi kṛpayā mānavo’si vai | tathāpi caurabhāvaste na naṣṭo’tra vadāmi te ||73|| tvayā yat khanitaṃ khātaṃ dravyaṃ tatra ca yad bhavet | tena yajñaṃ kuru tvatra sumantuhastakāritam ||74|| sumantuścāhamevātra vaṭādhastād vasāmi tu | sarve jānanti lokā māṃ tāpasaṃ siddhayoginam ||75|| sumantunā makhaścāpi kriyate vada cetyapi | prajāsu tvaṃ samastāsu viśvāsaṃ sampradāpaya ||76|| āgamiṣyanti ṛṣayo munayo devatāstathā | bhūsurā mānavāḥ santaḥ sādhvyaścātra makhe tataḥ ||77|| dravyavyayaṃ kariṣye’haṃ kariṣye makhamuttamam | evaṃ kṛte tava puṇyaṃ paraṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati ||78|| gṛhāṇa mantraṃ kṛṣṇasya pāvanaṃ paṃktipāvanam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||79|| harekṛṣṇa hareviṣṇo bālakṛṣṇa śriyaḥpate | parameśa kṛpāsindho lakṣmīpate ramāpate ||3.188.80|| evaṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ cāpi kuru rātrindivaṃ sadā | tava pāpāni sarvāṇi nāśameṣyanti sarvathā ||8 1 || yajñapuṇyaṃ tavaiva syānmamāśīrvādataḥ priya | ātmaśuddhistathā te syād bhaktiśca śrīharau mayi ||82|| bhaviṣyatīti me vācaḥ phaliṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ | bhuktirmuktiśca te kuṭumbināṃ cāpi bhaviṣyataḥ ||83|| ityuktvā tanmano jñātvā ṛṣirmantraṃ dadau tataḥ | preṣayāmāsa ṛṣirāṭ sumantukastamāśramān ||84|| viprāśramān munyāśramān sādhūn satīḥ prati drutam | vidvāṃsaḥ susamākarṇya yajñaṃ tatra samāyayuḥ ||85|| lakṣmi sumantumunirāṭ tadā saṃkalpamātrataḥ | cakre samagravastūnāṃ sañcayān parvatān nadīḥ ||86|| brahmādyā devatāstatra pratyakṣaṃ tvāyayustadā | maharṣayaḥ pitaraśca santaḥ sādhvyaḥ samāyayuḥ ||87|| viṣṇuyāgastu ṛṣiṇā saptāhena kṛtastadā | sumantorvāñcchayā viṣṇustatra sākṣāt sthito’bhavat ||88|| agnayastu tadā sākṣād jagṛhurhavyabhojanam | pūrṇāhutau sumantukaḥ sasmāra māṃ pareśvaram ||89|| bhaktakalyāṇakāryārthaṃ tadāhaṃ pragato’bhavam | bubhuje havyamevāpi sumantvādyaiḥ susatkṛtaḥ ||3.188.90|| atha khātajadravyāṇāṃ dānāni tu sumantukaḥ | adāpayacchaṃkudharahastena svarṇakoṭikam || 91|| rūpyakāṇāṃ koṭikāśca ratnānāṃ koṭikāstathā | hīrakāṇāṃ koṭikāśca camatkārairadāpayat ||92|| dhanaṃ kasmāt samāyātaṃ vividurnaiva kecana | camatkāraṃ hi manyante sumantoḥ sarvameva te ||93|| jayakāro mahān jāto dānaiśca dakṣiṇādibhiḥ | tṛptā devāśca pitaro mānavāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pare ||94|| dehino’pi samastāśca tṛptāstatra mahādhvare | avabhṛthe sumantuśca snāpayāmāsa śiṣyakam ||95|| prārthayāmāsa māṃ tatra dātuṃ bhaktasya darśanam | ahaṃ śaṃkudharāyāpi kuṭumbasahitāya vai ||96|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ svaṃ darśanaṃ dadau | pāvayāmāsa sarvāṃstān sumantorvacanāt khalu ||97|| sarvapāpāni bhaktasya vidhūya puṇyaśevadhim | datvā tasmai svargayāne cādhigṛhya divi dhruve ||98|| tārake tu mahat svargaṃ pradadau śaṃkudhāriṇe | sakuṭumbaḥ śaṃkudharo yayau vai paśyatāṃ satām ||99|| divyadehaḥ prabhūtvaiva druta dhruvālayaṃ yayau | vaiṣṇavasya hi yāgasya phalaṃ bhuktvā dhruvālaye || 3.188.10 0|| tato yāsyati vaikuṇṭhaṃ kuṭumbasahito hi saḥ | evaṃ lakṣmi sumantorvai pratāpena tu bhaktarāṭ || 10 1|| cauro’pi stainyarahito bhūtvā kṛtvā makhaṃ śubham | sādhostu kṛpayā me ca prasādena surottamaḥ || 1 02|| sarvalokairvanditaḥ san khyāto dhruvapadaṃ yayau | evaṃ sādhoḥ prasaṃgena pāpino’pi khalā api || 1 03|| pāpahīnāḥ prajāyante yānti vai paramaṃ padam | paṭhanāchravaṇāccāsya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vrajedapi || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne śaṃkudharanāmnaścaurasya sumantukarṣeryogena pāpanāśo yajñakaraṇaṃ mokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 188 ||
<3.189> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prasannatā hareḥ satām | anuvṛttyā bhavedeva nānyena sādhanena vai || 1 || sākṣātkāro hareścāpi kṛpayā sevayāthavā | dhyānena śāśvatenāpi bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ || 2 || vṛttisthairyaṃ harermūtau kaṭhinaṃ dehadhāriṇām | api tvabhyāsayogena siddhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 3 || mūrtiścintāmaṇirme’sti lakṣmi cintitasampradā | svargaṃ smṛddhiṃ mahānandaṃ mokṣaṃ dadāti cintitam || 4 || ātmasandarśanaṃ ceśadarśanaṃ brahmadarśanam | muktānāṃ darśanaṃ divyaṃ mamāpi darśanaṃ tataḥ || 5 || cintitaṃ yat samagraṃ tat prāpyate dhyānamūrtitaḥ | ahantāmamatāmāyā naśyatyeva ca cintanāt || 6 || smṛtayaścāpi naśyanti māyikyo dhyānakāriṇaḥ | triguṇā gṛhaputrastrīrūpā māyāpi naśyati || 7 || vāsanākhyā tathā māyā naśyatyeva tu dhyāyinaḥ | tṛṣṇānāśo bhavatyeva śāntilābhaḥ prajāyate || 8 || harerdhyānabalenaiva bhaktātmā tanmayo yadā | bhavatyeva nirutthānastadā dehasya pātanam || 9 || bhautikasya vikārāṇāṃ viyogaśca prajāyate | sūkṣmadehasya vai nāśastathā dhyānabalād bhavet || 3.189.1 0|| ātmanyeva cito dhārā dhyānavṛttiḥ pravardhate | caitanyaṃ divyamevaitad dravyarūpaṃ vivardhate || 1 1|| tadeva dhyānarūpaṃ vai bhūtvā mūrtau suyujyate | tadyogena tu jīvasya cetanasya tadātmanaḥ || 1 2|| dhāmotkramaṇakāle vai mūrtirmūrttyā samā hareḥ | samabhiniṣpadyate’sau cetanaḥ svayameva ha || 1 3|| brahmamūrtasvarūpo’yaṃ divyākāraḥ prakāśate | āvirbhavati mūrtātmā brahmātmā harisadṛśaḥ || 14|| śrīharericchayā lakṣmi muktottamo’bhikāśate | sneho’dhiko mahānande prayojako harau mayi || 15|| evaṃ snigdhāḥ sadātmāno mahātmānaśca sādhavaḥ | pāvanāḥ pāvayantyeva punanti pāpino janān || 16|| kṛpayaiva yatasteṣāṃ kāryaṃ muktipradānakam | pāpyuddhāraśca tatkāryaṃ nirvahanti madājñayā || 17|| tato muktiṃ prayāntyeva pāpino’pi sadāśritāḥ | satsaṃgena parāṃ muktiṃ prāpnuvantyeva dehinaḥ || 18|| gaṇikā hiṃsakāḥ stenā vyavāyinaśca ghātakāḥ | bhraṣṭā duṣṭā dveṣiṇo’pi satsaṃgena taranti te || 1 9|| yanmānaḥ kriyate loke cāsatsaṃgo muhurjanaiḥ | tārayatyeva tanmānaṃ satsaṃgaścet kṛto bhavet |||3.189.20|| guṇā grāhyāḥ satāṃ nityaṃ doṣāstyājyāḥ satāṃ sadā | guṇagrāhī taratyeva doṣagrāhī nimajjati ||21|| satāṃ sammānaḥ kartavyo nijasya tu vimānanam | satāṃ sammānakartāraṃ tārayanti hi sādhavaḥ ||22|| satāṃ tu ye hyavamānaṃ kurvanti te patanti vai | dagdhapuṇyāstu te bhūtvā prayāntyadhamayonikām ||23|| sādhordehasvabhāvaṃ ye vīkṣyāvasthodbhavaṃ kvacit| | gṛhṇantyavaguṇān sādhoste bhavantyapi nindakāḥ ||24|| avaguṇāḍhyā jāyante sadā vai doṣadṛṣṭayaḥ | kalpayanti ca pāpāni sādhujaneṣu nityadā ||25|| avaguṇān pravadanti yaśohānikarān sadā | kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca mānaṃ mohaṃ ratiṃ madam | matsaraṃ cādīrghadṛṣṭiṃ tathā satkāraśūnyatām ||26|| anaudāryamanāhvānamaudāsīnyaṃ satṛṣṇatām | abhimānaṃ cāniyamāvalokanaṃ vidṛṣṭitām ||27|| saparigrahatāṃ lolupatāṃ ca vāsanāṃ bahiḥ | bahirvṛttiṃ rājasatvaṃ tāmasatvamabuddhatām ||28|| rasanādhīnatāṃ śiśnodaratṛpatvamityapi | adharmaṃ rājayuktatvaṃ mamatāṃ cābhimānitām ||29|| ajñānitvaṃ yogyatāvarjanaṃ nidrāṃ ca phalgutām | mṛṣāsatyaṃ ca kapaṭaṃ śāṭhyaṃ chadmātibhakṣaṇam ||3.189.30|| maurkhyaṃ stainyaṃ mahālasyamevametām̐stu durguṇān | kalpayanti dveṣiṇaste nindakā durguṇānvitāḥ ||3 1 || pāpāḥ pāpaṃ kalpayanti pāpayuktā bhavanti te | manyante te yathā naijaṃ karma tathaiva sādhuṣu ||32|| yathā naijā vāsanā ca tathā tāmapi sādhuṣu | yathā vai duṣṭatā naijā tathā tāmapi sādhuṣu ||33|| pareṣu cāśriteṣvete praveśayanti durguṇān | avaguṇān grāhayanti cābhāvaṃ ca tiraskṛtim || 34|| abhāvanāṃ prerayanti guṇānniṣkāsayanti ca | sarvāḥ kriyāḥ satāṃ duṣṭāḥ sadoṣāḥ saṃvadanti ca ||35|| vartanaṃ sarvathā duṣṭaṃ vadantyācaraṇaṃ tathā | duṣṭaṃ pāpaṃ cāchamayaṃ daityā vā dānavā yathā ||36|| āsurā āsurabhāvaṃ kalpayanti hi sādhuṣu | sveṣu sarveṣu satsveva durguṇeṣvapi sadguṇān ||37|| netrairdveṣaṃ darśayanti gatyā dveṣaṃ dadhatyapi | namane darśane dveṣaṃ vāṇyāṃ dveṣaṃ vadantyapi ||38|| satāṃ kārye hyakāryatvaṃ duṣṭakāryatvamityapi | darśayantyaparebhyaśca kaliṃ kurvantyahetukam ||39|| anena sādhunā cedaṃ kṛtaṃ tad yogyameva na | ayaṃ sādhurhi naivāsti sādhutā cātra nāsti ca ||3.189.40 || tasya pādau spṛśet kastu ko vandeta tathāvidham | ko namettaṃ kaḥ seveta dṛṣṭā bahavastādṛśāḥ ||41 || bhavādṛśā vivalayā manvate tādṛśān sataḥ | nāsmādṛśāstu paśyanti teṣāṃ mukhānyapi kvacit ||42|| evaṃ nindāṃ prakurvanti gṛhṇantyavaguṇān sadā | grāhayantyavaguṇakān svetarān duṣṭavārtayā ||43 || tathā nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ samākarṇaya cāsurīm | rītiṃ tathāsurāṇāṃ vai yeṣāṃ sneho na sādhuṣu ||44|| yeṣāṃ ca kāmanādoṣaḥ krodhaścauryamasatyatā | kāpaṭyaṃ cāpi paiśunyaṃ vyavāyo rājasī sthitiḥ ||45|| te janā doṣavanto vai doṣām̐styaktuṃ tu nirbalāḥ | pratyuta doṣamagnāste viṣayāsaktacetasaḥ ||46|| atasteṣāṃ hi doṣāṇāṃ khaṇḍanaṃ sādhavo yadā | tyājayituṃ prakurvanti tadā te duṣṭamānasāḥ ||47|| sādhornindāṃ prakurvanti doṣakhaṇḍanakāriṇaḥ | vācāvācyānabhijño’yaṃ sādhurvaktuṃ na vetti vai ||48|| ekādeśijñānavām̐śca viśālajñānavānnahi | paṇḍitaṃmanyamānaḥ svaṃ vartate bhānavarjitaḥ ||49|| nānusarati māṃ kvāpi na gṛhṇāti mayoditam | svoktotkarṣapramantāyaṃ naśca khaṇḍanakāryasau ||3.189.50 || āśramaṃ naiva jānāti na jānāti vṛṣāṃśca naḥ | khaṇḍayatyeva bhogādīn gārhasthyocitavaibhavān ||51 || tasmād vivekahīno’yaṃ sādhurmūkho’yamasti vai | evaṃ nindanti sādhuṃ vai hitopadeśakāriṇam ||52| evaṃvidhānāṃ naiva syāt snehaḥ sādhuṣvapi kvacit | asnehena na viśvāso sādhuvākyeṣu jāyate ||53|| aviśvāsānna vai śraddhā māhātmyajñānavardhinī | aśraddhayā hyanabhyāso’nabhyāsād dhyānameva na ||54|| na sevā bhāvanā naiva na ca tādātmyaveditā | ākarṣaṇaṃ tato naiva māhātmyaṃ tu kutastadā ||55|| na kathāśravaṇe tasya na vārtāśravaṇe’pi mut | nājñāgrahaṇe cotsāhaḥ prītirgāḍhā kutastadā ||56|| śṛṇu lakṣmi yathā te’sti mayi svāmitvabhāvanā | tvayi dāsītvamevāsti tatra bhedo na vidyate ||57|| tāḍitā dharṣitākruṣṭā vanditā vā tiraskṛtā | tathāpi tvaṃ kadācinna viruddhā kintu sevikā ||58|| mayi sarvasvabhāvena cāsattā muditā sadā | nisargaguṇagṛhiṇī bhaktā dāsī prasevase ||59|| na tatra nimnatābhāvo mayi te svāmini kvacit | tathā yeṣāṃ sādhuvarge nimnabhāvo na vai kvacit ||3.189.60|| sāmyabhāvo’pi yeṣāṃ na kintūtkṛṣṭā hi bhāvanā | māhātmyaṃ divyatā yeṣāṃ nirguṇatvaṃ ca sādhuṣu ||61|| sādhukriyāsu sarvāsu kalyāṇadatvabhāvanā | śubhāśubhāyāṃ pravṛttau puṇyapradatvabhāvanā ||62|| yeṣāṃ vai vartate teṣāṃ svāmitvaṃ satsu vai sadā | bhāvitaṃ divyaphaladaṃ divyamokṣapradaṃ bhavet ||63|| māyākālādikarmādibandhacchedakaraṃ bhavet | yathā sneho nijapatnyāṃ yathā putre kuṭumbiṣu ||64|| yathā pitroryathā putryāṃ yathā bhṛtyāsu sevake | sevikāyāṃ yathā snehastathā kuryāddhi sādhuṣu ||65|| laukiko’pi snehabhāvo divyatāṃ yāti sādhuṣu | sādhoḥ prasannatālabdhyā sarvaṃ kāryaṃ prasiddhyati ||66|| yathā patnyā nije kānte dṛśyante dūṣaṇāni na | kuceṣṭāḥ kusvabhāvāśca dṛśyante sadguṇā yathā ||67|| tathā sādhuṣu vai lakṣmi yeṣāṃ dṛṣṭistu nirmalā | dṛśyante durguṇāścāpi sadguṇā eva sarvathā ||68|| te eva prāpya saṃyogaṃ prasannatāṃ satāṃ śubhām | āśīrvādān samarjyāpi sevālābhamavāpya ca ||69|| snehaṃ labdhvā tathā prītiṃ labdhvā cātmaniveditām | ātmaratiṃ parāṃ prāpya taranti bhavasāgarāt ||3.189.70|| teṣāṃ sneho bhavedeva sastu strīputrato’dhikaḥ | sa eva māyāṃ tarati sādhusnehena pāvitaḥ ||71 || naro vā strī ca vā ṣaṇḍhaḥ sādhau snehāt pramucyate | satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyetat sādhurūpo bhavāmyaham ||72|| manmāhātmyaṃ tu sādhubhyo jñāyate nānyataḥ kvacit | sādhavo hṛdayaṃ mahyaṃ sādhau vāsaḥ sadā mama ||73|| sādhusantoṣaṇe tṛptirmamaiva jāyate rame | sādhavaḥ pāvanāḥ santi nakhaśikhāntamūrtayaḥ ||74|| śṛṇu lakṣmi pare duṣṭā sādhūnudvejayanti vai | bhojane jalapāne cāsane satkārakarmasu ||75|| ātithye śuśrūṣaṇe ca śramayanti sato janān | bhṛtyatvaṃ kārayantyeva sādhūn gurūn mahājanān ||76|| dhīhīnāste pāpapuñjaṃ tvarjayanti tathākriyāḥ | kecit sādhūnnijapatnīsamān matvā subhojane ||77|| yojayanti svabhojyārthaṃ pācayanti ca bhojanam | kecijjalasya pānārthaṃ pātraṃ jalaṃ ca śītalam ||78|| ubhayaṃ taddhi yācante yathā bhṛtyāttathā sataḥ | kejidajñā gendukādi nijāsanaṃ tu suptaye ||79|| kārayanti sārayanti yathā dāsyāstathā sataḥ | kecidajñā ūṣṇajalaṃ tathoṣṇaṃ bhojanaṃ navam ||3.189.80|| kārayanti nijārthaṃ vai yathā bhṛtyāttathā sataḥ | kejidajñā vācayanti nijāṃ puṣṭiṃ sabhāsu vai ||8 1|| praśaṃsāṃ kārayantyeva yathā dūtāttathā sataḥ | yathā tu cāraṇāt tadvat sūtādvā ca tathā sataḥ ||82|| kecinmadānvitā naijāṃ peṭikāṃ vastugauravām | vāhayanti satāṃ hastairmastakenābhimāninaḥ ||83|| kecid duṣṭā dīnasādhūn nāmayanti prasahya vai | stavanaṃ tu nijaṃ duṣṭāḥ kārayanti muhurmuhuḥ ||84|| etādṛśāstu pāpā vai pāpaparvatasaṃbhṛtāḥ | dhanānnavarjitāścātra bhramanto viramanti ca ||85|| sādhudvāropadeśena sādhayanti svamarthakam | svārthaparāste kuśalāścānte yānti yamālayam ||86|| sādhuṣu nijasattāṃ ye dhārayanti ca māninaḥ | āhaṃkārikavṛttāntāste’pi yānti yamālayam ||87|| sādhvālaye cākasmikīṃ kurvanti mārgaṇāṃ tu ye | sādhuṣu ca mṛṣā doṣaṃ kalaṅkaṃ ca dadatyapi ||88|| kukhyātima ca prakurvanti sādhūnāṃ ye tu nirdayāḥ | dveṣṭāraḥ sādhuvargasya te yānti vai yamālayam ||89|| śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā sādhūn nindanti veṣadhāraṇe | jīrṇavastramapi khaṇḍaṃ naiva dadati ye kvacit ||3.189.90|| nindanti tu parairdattaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sumūlyamambaram | śuddhaṃ ca raṃgasaṃśobhaṃ nindantyuktvā tu rājasam ||91|| pātraṃ yānaṃ vāhanaṃ ca nindanti vai satāṃ tathā | sādhoḥ śālāṃ bhavanaṃ ca kuṭīṃ nindati vai tathā | |92|| aujjvalyaṃ cāpi nindanti nindanti dānamarpitam | dravyārpaṇaṃ ca nindanti gandhasāraṃ ca mardanam ||93|| oṣadhādyaṃ ca nindanti rakṣaṇaṃ ca yathākṛtam | nindanti gomahiṣyādidhanaṃ sādhubhirarjitam ||94|| paropakāraprabhṛti nindanti sādhusevitam | bhikṣāṭanaṃ tapaścāpi nindanti matsarānvitāḥ ||95|| prajvalanti samīkṣyaiva sato devālayaṃ satīḥ | divyasaṃsthā vilokyāpi projjvalantyāsurā janāḥ ||96|| ta ete kamale yānti dehānte pāpasaṃsṛtim | pīḍyante yāmyalokeṣu duḥkhiyoniṣu vai muhuḥ ||97|| tasmāt sādhuṃ mama veṣadharaṃ vai pūjayet sadā | māṃ vibhāvyābhiseveta prasannayet śubhārpaṇaiḥ ||98|| prasādayedanuvṛttyā sarvasvārpaṇakaistathā | bhaktiṃ kṛtvā hareścāpi prasādayet sato janān ||99|| guruṃ prasevayennityaṃ pitarau sevayet sadā | patiṃ prasevayedbhaktyā sādhuṃ bhaktyābhirañjayet || 3.189.100|| prabhuṃ bhajeta bhāvaiśca śraddhayā kīrtayeddharim | devārpaṇaṃ sadā kuryāt kuṭumbaṃ tu prapoṣayet || 101 || sarvaṃ kṛṣṇāya naivedyaṃ dhṛtvā bhuñjīta nānyathā | evaṃ vai vartamānānāṃ bhuktirmuktiḥ kare sthitā | ||1 02|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāddhāraṇādapi | sādhusevāphalaṃ syācca bhogānte mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet| ||1 03|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sādhusamāgamena bhagavaccintāmaṇilabdhyā sarvakāmanāpūrttyādinirūpaṇanāmā navāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 189 ||
<3.190> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ camatkāramayīṃ kathām | mahāsaurāṣṭradeśīyā bhaktāḥ saṅghagatāḥ śatam || 1 || kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ somanāthaṃ ca raivatam | svarṇavatīṃ kṛṣṇabhūmiṃ gopanārthaṃ ca sundaram || 2 || evamādīni tīrthāni kartuṃ saurāṣṭramāyayuḥ | mārge mahīṃ tathā vāpīṃ tīrtvā nāvā tataḥ param || 3 || sābhramatīṃ samuttīrya gopanāthaṃ samāyayuḥ | tato guptaprayāgaṃ ca kṛtvā siṃhavanaṃ mahat || 4 || praviśya yāvadāyānti somanāthaṃ prati drutam | siṃhāraṇye tadā prāptā luṇṭakāḥ śastradhāriṇaḥ || 5 || luṇṭakādhipatisteṣu nāmnā sāmāntavikramaḥ | aśvavāraiśca sahitaḥ śastrādiyugbhaṭānvitaḥ || 6 || yantranādānakarodvai sannidhau nātidūragaḥ | ākrośān bhayadām̐ścāpi cakrustasyānugāminaḥ || 7 || luṇṭanārthaṃ drutaṃ saṃghasyābhito bandhanaṃ vyadhuḥ | madhye cakrurbhayadānaiḥ saṃghasya śatamānavān || 8 || strīṇāṃ bhūṣā narāṇāṃ ca bhūṣādravyāṇi yāni ca | uttārayitvā tvekatra kārayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ || 9 || śubhāmbarāṇi sarvāṇi jagṛhuḥ saṃghavartinām | saṃghāgragaṇyavaṇijo babandhū rajjubhistadā ||3.190.1 0|| padmacandraṃ śaṃkhacandraṃ śṛṃkhalācandramityapi | vanacandraṃ vālicandraṃ babandhuste hi luṇṭakāḥ ||1 1|| anyān daṇḍaistāḍanādi pracakrurbhayahetave | bhītāste vaṇijaḥ sarve maunā babhūvurarditāḥ ||12|| daduḥ sarvasvametebhyo luṇṭakebhyo’titāḍitāḥ | athaiteṣu mama bhakto vaiṣṇavo vanacandrakaḥ || 13|| tasya patnī sukhādevī mama bhaktābhavad rame | ābālyāttau mama bhaktau bhajato māṃ nirantaram ||14|| sādhorme sāyanāyananāmno yogena vaiṣṇavau | vartete tau bhaktiyuktau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritau || 15|| āpatkāle tu tau bhaktau sasmaratustadā hi mām | anye’pi bālagopālā ruruduḥ sasmaruḥ prabhum || 16|| luṇṭakebhyo harekṛṣṇa prarakṣaya hi tīrthinaḥ | anāthānāṃ vane kṛṣṇanāthanārāyaṇo bhavān || 17|| trātā mocayitā duḥkhād rakṣayitā pitā bhavān | mātā gururharikṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇaḥ prarakṣatu || 18|| yato vayaṃ kṛtapāpā luṇṭyante’to vanāntare | tathāpi nijabhaktānāṃ rakṣāṃ vidhehi mādhava || 19|| tava bhaktiṃ kariṣyāmo dānaṃ dāsyāma eva te | sarvasvaṃ bhagavan viṣṇo rakṣa kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa ||3.190.20|| kuṃkumavāpikātīrthe’rpayiṣyāmo dhanādikam | yadi luṇṭakaduṣṭebhyo rakṣāṃ nastvaṃ vidhāsyasi ||21 || vibhūṣaṇāni sarvāṇi śreṣṭhāmbarāṇi yāni ca | rūpyakāḥ svarṇamudrāśca dāsyāmo’śvasarovare ||22|| vrataṃ kārtikamāsādya kariṣyāmo phalādibhiḥ | nityaṃ śataṃ mālikāścāvartayiṣyāma eva ca ||23 || satāṃ maṭheṣu vai māsaṃ māsaṃ sthitvā tu māghake | māse sevāṃ kariṣyāmaḥ satāmājñānusāriṇīm ||24|| ityevaṃ vanacandrādyā ārttā luṇṭakadharṣitāḥ | mānatā vividhāścakrurluṇṭhakebhyo vimuktaye ||25|| vanacandrasya bhāryāpi sukhādevī tathā striyaḥ | yā yāḥ saṃghagatāścāsan prārthayāmāsureva mām || 26|| he hare he vanavāsin vṛndāvanavihārakṛt | gopīsaṃghāntaragupta kṛṣṇa rakṣa svadāsikāḥ ||27|| abalānāṃ sabalo’si bhaktānāṃ bhagavānasi | dāsīnāṃ modakartāsi kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ ||28|| vane gopīvihāro’si rādhāsakho’si nirjane | śayane kamalānanda kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ || 29|| pralaye muktasevyo’si sṛṣṭau bhaktimatīpatiḥ | rāse sarvānurakto’si kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ ||3.190.3 0|| vipattau cārttadīneśa śaraṇāgatarakṣaka | arātikaṣṭahartastvaṃ kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ ||3 1 || garbhe bhrūṇasya poṣṭā tvaṃ bālye nirmalahṛtsthitaḥ | yauvane premapātraṃ tvaṃ kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ ||32| vārdhakye śiṣṭavarya tvaṃ yuddhe jayapradaḥ pumān | nirāśraye tvaṃ cādhāraḥ kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ || 33|| rohiṇāṇḍāsuraḥ pūrvamanādidyunarāyaṇaḥ | bhūtvā niṣūditaḥ kṛṣṇa tvayā naḥ sa prarakṣatu ||34|| anādiśrīmerunārāyaṇastvaṃ cābhavaṃ purā | nimnaṃ tu patamānasya meroḥ rakṣā tvayā kṛtā || 35|| sūryāgninā dahyamānabrahmāṇḍasya tvayā purā | rakṣā śāntiḥ kṛtānādiviṣṇunārāyaṇātmanā |||36|| dhūmrāsuravināśaśca candrarakṣā tvayā purā | vihitā śrīhare’nādidevanārāyaṇātmanā |||37||| tvayānādiyajñanārāyaṇa yajñāḥ pravartitāḥ | rudraśāstānādibrahmanārāyaṇo hyabhūḥ purā || 38|| devadhiṣṇyaniyamāyānādyādityanarāyaṇaḥ | bhavān purābhavat kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ ||39|| nāgaśāstānādigarutmannārāyaṇarūpavān | dhruvasthityai bhavānanādyārṣanārāyaṇo’bhavat ||3.190.40|| ṣurānandādidaityānāṃ parābhūtyarthameva ha | tvamanādiprājñanārāyaṇo’bhavaḥ pareśvara ||4 1 || tvamanādivīranārāyaṇo’bhavo vṛṣāvanaḥ | tvamanādibhadranārāyaṇo dagdhapramuktaye ||42|| tuṃgabhadrāsanāputrīpatirharinarāyaṇaḥ | abhavastvaṃ purā kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ ||43|| nāśārthaṃ kośastenākhyarakṣasastvaṃ purābhavaḥ | anādiśrībījanārāyaṇo bījasya rakṣakaḥ ||44|| dharmavratasya putrāṇāṃ mokṣārthaṃ tvaṃ purābhavaḥ | anādiśrīvaranārāyaṇo nā kṛṣṇa rakṣatu ||45|| sudarśanīmahāsādhvīśāpena strīmayaṃ jagat | rakṣārthaṃ tvamanādistrīpuṃnārāyaṇatāmagāḥ ||46|| anādiśrījalanārāyaṇastvaṃ mākarāsuram | hatvā lokānarakṣaḥ śrīkṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ ||47|| anādiśrīśīlanārāyaṇastvamabhavaḥ purā | sādhudharmaprarakṣārthaṃ kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ ||48|| anādiśrīvārdhinārāyaṇastvamabhavaḥ purā | vyāghrānalādināśārthaṃ kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ ||49|| tvamanādicaturmukhanārāyaṇo’bhavaḥ purā | rādhanikāpuṇyarātaviprayoriṣṭado bhavān ||3.190.50|| abhavacchrīchrīpuruṣottamanārāyaṇaḥ purā | tīrthapūtyarthamanāditīrthanārāyaṇo’bhavaḥ ||51|| bhaktyarthaṃ tvamanādiśrījīvanārāyaṇo’bhavaḥ |. yajñe tvaṃ śrīmadardhaśrīśvaranārāyaṇo’bhava|||52|| pitruddhartānādyardhaśrīpitṛnārāyaṇo’bhavaḥ | bhaktyā mokṣopadeśārthaṃ plakṣanārāyaṇo’bhavaḥ ||53|| naramedhe bhaktarakṣāmanādipuṃnarāyaṇaḥ | bhūtvākarostvaṃ deveśa kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ ||54|| sūryavarccanṛpadvārānādiśyāmanarāyaṇaḥ | abhavastvaṃ purā kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ ||55|| anādiśrīrājanārāyaṇastvaṃ cābhavaḥ purā | māyūrakāsurahantā kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ ||56|| anādiśrībrahmacārinārāyaṇo’bhavaḥ purā | naiṣṭhikatārakṣaṇārthaṃ kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ |||57|| hallakāsuranāśārthaṃ śivojjīvārthamityapi | anādiśrīśivanārāyaṇastvaṃ cābhavaḥ purā ||58|| anādiśrīsvarṇanārāyaṇastvaṃ cābhavaḥ purā | kuberasyojjīvanārthaṃ kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ ||59|| jvālāruṇācalavahnirasadagdhaprajāvanam | anādiśrīsvāminārāyaṇastvaṃ cākaroḥ purā ||3.190.60|| nirvāṇikārādhitayā lakṣmyā sākaṃ bhavān purā | anādisāvananārāyaṇo’bhavat sa rakṣatu ||61 || aṃśukramathanṛpaterbhaktyā tvamabhavaḥ purā | anādiśrīsādhunārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sa rakṣatu ||62|| śaptasya varṇiśālasya manorujjīvanāya vai | anādiśrībhaktanārāyaṇo’bhavaḥ sa pātu naḥ ||63|| varmadharakṣmeśamokṣārthaṃ tvaṃ purā svayaṃ prabhuḥ | anādiśrīmedhanārāyaṇo’bhavaḥ sa pātu naḥ ||64|| analādamahāsuravināśārthaṃ bhavān purā | anādiśrīvahninārāyaṇo’bhavat sa pātu naḥ ||65|| ilodaravināśārthaṃ rasanārāyaṇo’bhavaḥ | sa tvaṃ nārāyaṇakṛṣṇakṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ ||66|| anādiśrīcakranārāyaṇastvaṃ cābhavaḥ purā | daityanāśakaraḥ kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ ||67|| kṛtadharmasthāpanāyānādisatyanarāyaṇaḥ | adristhityarthamanādiśrīhiraṇyanarāyaṇaḥ ||68|| bhaktārthaṃ tvamanādiśrīnairañjaninarāyaṇaḥ | anādiśrīpuṇyanārāyaṇaścāpyabhavaḥ purā ||69| | puṇyavatīśāpanivartakaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sa pātu naḥ | anādiśrībṛhadbrahmanārāyaṇo’bhavad bhavān ||3.190.70 || apsarasāṃ manaḥpūrtyai kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ | anādiśrīgurunārāyaṇastvaṃ cābhavaḥ purā ||71 || brahmavidyāpradānārthaṃ kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ | bṛhaddharmabhūpayajñe sādhudīkṣāpradāyakaḥ ||72||| anādiśrīmadācāryanārāyaṇaḥ sa pātu naḥ | anādiśrīmahāvidyunnārāyaṇo’bhavaḥ purā ||73 || vidyutstāvadaityahantā kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ | anādiśrīmadhunārāyaṇastvaṃ cābhavaḥ purā ||74|| madhubhakṣāsurahantā kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ | anādiśrīnāthanārāyaṇastvaṃ cābhavaḥ purā ||75|| tiṣye daityavināśārthaṃ kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ | anādiśrīvibhunārāyaṇastvaṃ cābhavaḥ purā ||76|| svarṇotsave vedhasaḥ sa kṛṣṇa rakṣaya dāsikāḥ | anādiśrīmokṣanārāyaṇastvaṃ cābhavaḥ purā ||77|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastvaṃ kāntakeśava | brahmapriyādisvāminno luṇṭakebhyaḥ prarakṣaya ||78|| bālakṛṣṇa hare kṛṣṇa vallabheśa kṛpāṃ kuru| luṇṭakebhyo’vanaṃ śīghraṃ kuru te śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ||79|| ityuktvā tāḥ striyaścāpi lakṣmi dhyānaṃ vyadhurhareḥ | ahaṃ hariḥ svayaṃ tatrāgatyādṛśyo’bhavaṃ kṣaṇam ||3.190.80|| śṛṇvānaḥ stutivākyāni mama prākcaritāni vai | luṇṭakāśca saṃcinvanti tvekatra nāṇakādikam ||8 1 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mahāsaurāṣṭrayīsaṃghasya luṇṭakajanapradharṣitasya stavanamiti nirūpaṇanāmā navatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 190 ||
<3.191> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi bālikāśca bālakāścāpi vihvalāḥ | astuvanmāṃ svarakṣārthaṃ yadahaṃ śrutavām̐stadā || 1 || divodāsasutāṃ divyādevīṃ bhāgyavihīnakām | kaṣṭādvimucya naijāṃ yaścakre’kṣare’nayacca tām || 2 || bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa bhagavān naḥ prarakṣatu sevikāḥ | bhillībhillau tava sādhoryogānmokṣaṃ gatau purā || 3 || subāhunṛpatirbhāryāsahitaḥ sādhusaṃśrayāt | tava pratāpataḥ kṛṣṇa mokṣamārgaṃ yayau purā || 4 || aśokasundarīṃ kanyāṃ satīśaṃkaraputrikām | tvaṃ rarakṣa purā kṛṣṇa naḥ prarakṣaya sevikāḥ || 5 || vihuṇḍasya vināśārthaṃ nārīrūpo’bhavaḥ purā | kāmodāyāḥ patistvaṃ sa naḥ prarakṣatu sevikāḥ || 6 || śukamokṣapradastvaṃ naḥ prarakṣa nijabālikāḥ | khaśo nāmnā viṣṇudāso rāmaṇī cāsya bhāminī || 7 || līlāvatī ca tatkanyā puroddhṛtāstvayā prabho | gaṇikānāṃ purā kṛṣṇa pāpāni tu tvayā vibho || 8 || kṛtvā puṇyasvarūpāṇi puṇyajanān vyadhāstadā | gaṇikā yoginīścāpi kṛtavām̐stvaṃ purā prabho || 9 || rakṣānāmnyāḥ śvapacyāstvaṃ sumarasya tu yoṣitaḥ | muktidātābhavaḥ kṛṣṇa naḥ sa rakṣatu sevikāḥ || 1 0|| kauśikaṃ garuḍaṃ cakre gāyakaṃ yaḥ purā prabhuḥ | mālavaṃ nāma vaiśyaṃ ca tathānyān gānakovidān || 11 || brahmalokaṃ hyanayad yo naḥ sa rakṣatu sevikāḥ | harimiśraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ yo dadau mokṣaṃ sa pātu naḥ || 1 2|| cidambarāmahārājñyai jiṣṇupatnyai purā bhavān | gadāṃ samarpya rakṣāṃ cākarod bhadrakarākṣasāt || 1 3|| prajāśca jīvināstasyāḥ sa no rakṣatu sevikāḥ | raṇeśvaryaḥ kṛtā naijā brahmapriyā gadāsutāḥ || 14|| yena nārāyaṇenāpi kṛṣṇaḥ sa naḥ prarakṣatu | raṇeśvarāstathā muktāḥ kṛtā yena sa rakṣatu ||15|| bindumatyāḥ kṛto yena mokṣo yayātiyoṣitaḥ | sa hariluṇṭakebhyaścāvanaṃ karotu mādhavaḥ || 16|| paraśucandrako yena nārāyaṇena tāritaḥ | so’yaṃ kāntaguṇaḥ kṛṣṇo rakṣatu nijasevikāḥ || 17|| sucandrikāṃ gopapatnīṃ gopālaṃ tatpatiṃ tathā | anayad yokṣaraṃ dhāma sa kṛṣṇo naḥ prarakṣatu || 18|| hariprathamanoḥ patnī brahmapathākṣaraṃ pratiṃ | prāpitā yena hariṇā sa kṛṣṇo naḥ prarakṣatu || 1 9|| gṛdhrāṇāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ yena kṛtaṃ purā parātmanā | bālakṛṣṇo harikṛṣṇaḥ sa kṛṣṇo naḥ prarakṣatu ||20|| jīvacandrāya muktiṃ yo dadau kṛṣṇaḥ sa rakṣatu | śatānandavinodinyoḥ putrāṇāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kṛtam ||21 || yena śrīhariṇā kṛṣṇaḥ sa eva naḥ prarakṣatu | kāśīvārāṃganābhyo yo muktidaḥ sa prarakṣatu ||22|| vṛṣāyanena caṭakā yadbalena prarakṣitā | bālakṛṣṇo’nādikṛṣṇaḥ sa kṛṣṇo naḥ prarakṣatu ||23 || citraketośca mālatyā rājñyā muktiḥ kṛtā purā | yena śrībālakṛṣṇena kṛṣṇo naḥ sa prarakṣatu ||24|| śreṣṭhā yena kṛtāḥ santaḥ sa naḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prarakṣatu | kṛśāṃgakaḥ kṛto yena kṛśānuḥ sa prarakṣatu ||25||| bhaṃgāsvanaḥ kṛto yena naro nārī muhurmuhuḥ | sa eva bhagavān kṛṣṇo rakṣatvatra svasevikāḥ || 16|| vipulaṃ ca ruciṃ devaśarmāṇaṃ yo rarakṣa ha | mokṣado bhagavān kṛṣṇo duḥkhādasmāt prarakṣatu ||27|| gokarṇākhye purā tīrthe ṛṣayo yena vāsitā | sa eva bhagavānasmān luṇṭakebhyaḥ prarakṣatu || 28 || kuvalāśvaṃ tathottaṃkaṃ satyavrataṃ ca gālavam | śreyase kalpayāmāsa yaḥ sa kṛṣṇaḥ prarakṣatu ||29|| yatpratāpena ca praṇadbrahmasādhuḥ pratāpavān | samabhavat sa kṛṣṇo no luṇṭakebhyaḥ prarakṣatu ||3 0 || keśariṇīsutaścālambāyano muktimāpa vai | yatpratāpena kṛṣṇaḥ sa luṇṭakebhyaḥ prarakṣatu ||3 1 || gokarṇasthān lakṣasādhūn ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ tu yaḥ | bālakṛṣṇaṃ priyaḥ kānto naḥ prarakṣatu vallabhāḥ ||32|| śabaro rākṣaso yena mocito bhavabandhanāt | gṛdhraśca śvapacaścāpi sa kṛṣṇo’vatu sevikāḥ ||33|| khyātiṃ śāpaparāṃ vīkṣya cakarta yastu tacchiraḥ | sa naḥ kṛṣṇo luṇṭakebhyaḥ prarakṣatu svasevikāḥ ||34|| bhāruṇḍaḥ puṣkaso yena tāritaḥ sa prarakṣatu | vṛṣādarbhiḥ kṛto yena muktaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sa rakṣatu ||35|| naraśāyastaskarastu mocito yena cakriṇā | dhanino mocitā yena sa kṛṣṇo’vatu sevikāḥ ||36|| kundadharmāvitā yenāvitaśca jāṃghalāmakhaḥ | bālakṛṣṇo divyakāntaḥ kanyakā naḥ prarakṣatu ||37|| yena śaṃbhalavāro’pi prajayā saha mocitaḥ | bālaḥkṛṣṇo vallabho’tra prarakṣatu svasevikāḥ ||38|| devānīkadivyavaṃśe bālakṛṣṇo vyajāyata | sa eva bhagavānatra prarakṣatu svasevikāḥ ||39|| namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | namaḥ śrīkambharālakṣmīgopālajanuṣe namaḥ ||40|| dīrghaśīlo vipravaryo mocito yamapāśataḥ | yena śrīhariṇā so’yaṃ prarakṣatu svadāsikāḥ ||41 || brahmasatī brāhmaṇī yā mocitā paramātmanā | so’yaṃ no bhagavānnāthaḥ prarakṣatu svasevikāḥ ||42|| kālaṃdharā mahārājñī vaivartto nāma bhūpatiḥ | mocitau yena kṛṣṇena sa kṛṣṇo’vatu sevikāḥ ||43|| romapādasya vai putro vṛṣagamo’pi viṣṇunā | mocito yena kṛṣṇena sa kṛṣṇo’vatu sevikāḥ ||44|| nagrabhaṃgaḥ purā cauro mocito yena viṣṇunā | bālakṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo naḥ sa prarakṣatu ||45|| bhaṇḍāsuro hato lalitādvārā yena cakriṇā | sa cāsmānnatra kṛṣṇaśrīkṛṣṇo rakṣatu sevikāḥ ||46|| lalitāmānasīkanyāḥ koṭiśaḥ svīkṛtāḥ purā | yena śrīparameśena sa kṛṣṇo’vatu sevikāḥ ||47|| lohāṃgārasya vaiśyasya mokṣakṛnnaḥ prarakṣatu | pīvaryādyā vrate yena pūrṇakāmā nirūpitāḥ ||48|| so’yaṃ kṛṣṇo luṇṭakebhyo naḥ prarakṣatu dāsikāḥ | vasiṣṭhāgastyakau śāpānmocitau yena śārṅgiṇā ||49|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo naḥ sa prarakṣatu | paruṣo lubdhako yena mocito bhāryayā saha ||50|| puṣkaravāhanasyāpi mokṣakṛnnaḥ prarakṣatu | sarojinī kuṃbhakartrī satīśvarīkṛpānvitā ||5 1 || padminī sābhavad yasya kṛpayā kamalāsamā | sa śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prabhuścāsmān luṇṭakebhyaḥ prarakṣatu ||5 2|| dharmatapaso viprasya rakṣaṇaṃ kṛtavām̐stu yaḥ | surathasya manutvaṃ ca kṛtavān śrīpatistu yaḥ ||5 3|| dhanavarmā divaṃ yena preṣitaḥ paramātmanā | balīśvarastathā rājye sthāpito mānave dvijaḥ ||14|| ānandavarṇī yenāpi sthāpito mānave tathā | rājye ghṛṇeṣikaḥ śūdraḥ sthāpito yena mānave ||55|| bhūtiśca tarito yena kṛṣṇa rakṣatu sevikāḥ | asuro bālako yenoddhṛto’sya maṇayaḥ kṛtāḥ ||56|| bāṣkalirnāśito yena viṣṇurnaḥ saṃprakṣatu | gajanārāyaṇenāpi purukṛsaro ghātitaḥ ||57|| pralambo nāśito yena matsyātmakena śārṅgiṇā | bhīmaratho ghātitaśca kūrmarūpeṇa yena vai ||58|| śāntaśatrurghātitaśca haṃsarūpeṇa yena hi | mahākālo nāśitaśca hayagrīveṇa yena tu ||59|| hiraṇyākṣavihantā sa kṛṣṇo’vatu svasevikāḥ | vāmano’vatu kṛṣṇaśca kālakākṣavināśakṛt ||60|| baliśatrvasurahantā harirduḥkhaṃ vyapohatu | daśagrīvavihantā ca nārīrūpo’vatu prabhuḥ ||61 || tārakaghno harirnapuṃsakarūpo’pi rakṣatu | ṭiṭṭibho vihato yena māyūrarūpiṇā purā ||62|| śuciśca ghātito yena cakriṇā naḥ sa rakṣatu | sādhubhāvāyanarṣeśca tathā śrīmānasasya ca ||63|| cidānandasyāpi mokṣakṛt kṛṣṇo naḥ prarakṣatu | sadvidyāyanapatnīṃ yaḥ śrutiphalāṃ hyamokṣayat ||64|| alarkajananīmokṣaṃ kṛtavān sa prarakṣatu | muktisrotāyanaścāpi siddhiveṣāyanastathā ||65|| ayācitāñjalibhāryā bhikṣāyanaṛṣiḥ patiḥ | muktā yasyāśrayeṇaiṣaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo naḥ prarakṣatu ||66|| mātā nityāśrayā putraḥ keśī yena pramocitau | bālakṛṣṇo mahārājaḥ sa nastvatra prarakṣatu ||67|| mātā tu cāraṇī putro vyāghraśca yena tāritau | kūṭadevaḥ pitā sādhuḥ śyāmaśca yena tāritau ||68|| uttamaścāpi bhūdevo devāyanaṛṣistathā | kaṣṭāt pramocitau yena kṛṣṇo rakṣatu sevikā ||69|| yena virālako vaiśyaḥ sakuṭumbaḥ samuddhṛtaḥ | bālakṛṣṇaḥ priyaprāṇo luṇṭakebhyaḥ prarakṣatu ||70|| pṛthvīdharo nṛpo madhuvindā rājñī samuddhṛtau | tathā durvoḍhako dīnaścoddhṛto yena so’vatu ||71 || sāgaraḥ śūdrakaścāpi venapālābhidho nṛpaḥ | hīrukā śūdrapatnī ca rakṣitā yena so’vatu ||72|| vṛkṇadevo bhāvaśūraḥ śīladharmāsatī tathā | mocitā yena kṛṣṇena so’yaṃ rakṣatu sevikāḥ ||73|| mañjulakeśo bhūdevaḥ pāśupateśaviprarāṭ | bāṇāṃgaṇastathā śūdro rakṣitā yena so’vatu ||74|| mṛtādanaḥ santadāso dharmaśālāyanastathā | śaṃkudharaścoddhṛtāśca yena so’vatu sevikāḥ ||75|| luṇṭakādhipatiścāyaṃ nāmnā sāmantavikramaḥ | luṇṭayatyatisarvasvaṃ kṛṣṇa hā kṛṣṇa rakṣa naḥ ||76|| tava smo’tra tava smo’tra tvatsevikāḥ prarakṣaya | antarātman vyāpakātman bhūmannatra prarakṣaya ||77|| bālakāścāpi vai kṛṣṇastavanaṃ cakrire tathā | śrutvāhaṃ sahasā tatra śatarūpo’bhavaṃ rame ||78|| aśvavārā uṣṭravārāḥ saśastrā bhūbhṛto bhaṭāḥ | pañcāśadvegato dūrādāgatā rakṣaṇāya vai ||79|| uccairākrośamādadhyuḥ sajjāścaurā bhavantviti | mārayiṣyāma evātra jāyantāṃ mātṛputrakāḥ || 80|| evaṃ nādān śrāvayanto sphoṭayanto hi dhūṣkṛtīḥ | uṣṭrāśvādyaiḥ kṣaṇād dikṣu daśasvāvṛttayam̐śca tān ||81 || vartule cauralokām̐stānāvṛtya rājapārṣadāḥ | dharṣayituṃ daṇḍayituṃ tāḍayituṃ puro’gaman ||82|| tāvatte roṣamāpannā jīvanāśāṃ vihāya vai | dudruvurmadhyadeśācca dhūṣkṛtīsphoṭakāriṇaḥ ||83|| tadā me pārṣadairlakṣmi dhūṣkṛtayaḥ sphoṭitā drutam | yuddhaṃ parasparaṃ jātaṃ dhūṣkṛtīgolikāmayam ||84|| mayā te golikāyantrairviddhāḥ sarve’tigarvitāḥ | mṛtāste tatra pañcāśatsarve golyabhibheditāḥ ||85|| tān sarvānanayaṃ svargaṃ mama hastairmṛtānataḥ | mocitān bhaktavaṇijastato’haṃ samasāntvayam ||86|| te sarve śaraṇaṃ prāptā narā nāryaśca bālikāḥ | bālāśca petuścaraṇe mama sainyaparūpiṇaḥ ||87|| athāhamadadāṃ teṣāṃ sañcayātma dhanaṃ tathā | bhūṣāmbarādisarvasvaṃ yathā yeṣāṃ tathādadām ||88|| sarve te sukhino jātāstāḍitāṃgeṣu cāspṛśam | nīrujaste’bhavam̐ścāpi nīrbhayāścābhavam̐śca te ||89|| athāhaṃ sahasā lakṣmi vājyuṣṭrabhaṭavigrahān | tirobhāvyābhavam̐ścaikaścaturbhujo narāyaṇaḥ ||3.191.90|| vanacandraṃ sukhādevīṃ darśanaṃ svamakārayam | anyebhyaścāpi sarvebhyo darśanaṃ svaṃ dadau tadā ||91|| paramāścaryamāpannā nipetuḥ pādayośca me | sarve te śaraṇaṃ prāptā bhaktā bhaktasamāstathā ||92|| athāhamadadāṃ tebhyo mantraṃ me’raṇyamaṇḍale | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||93|| harekṛṣṇabālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇa | brahmapriyāpate rādhālakṣmīpate’vanaṃ kuru ||94|| vaiṣṇavīṃ vai mahādīkṣāṃ dattavān kamale tadā | sarvānaraṇyadeśām̐ścollaṅghayitvā tataḥ param ||95|| sarvānāpṛcchatha kuśalaṃ tīrthamārgaṃ pradarśya ca | tiro’bhavaṃ tatra lakṣmi te’pi śanaiḥ prabhāsakam ||96|| yayustato raivataṃ ca tato’śvapaṭṭamāyayuḥ | mānatā yāḥ kṛtāścāsam̐stīrthadānapratātmikāḥ ||97|| sarvasvārpaṇarūpāśca tāḥ sarvāste vyadhustadā | mama pūjāṃ pracakruśca satāṃ sevāṃ vyadhustathā ||98|| svasthāḥ sarve mama bhaktiṃ cakrustīrthaṃ samastakam | atha te svarṇanagarīṃ camatkārapurīṃ yayuḥ ||99|| prāpurdeśaṃ tato naijaṃ bhaktiṃ cakrurhi me sadā | tāritā rakṣitāścāpi dehānte mama dhāma ca | | 3.191.1 00|| prāpitāste mayā lakṣmi mama bhaktaprasaṃginaḥ | caurāste luṇṭakāścāpi mama svarūpavedinaḥ ||1 01|| prāpitā vai mayā svargādante vaikuṇṭhadhāma hi | evaṃ dayāparaścāhaṃ rakṣāmi ca nayāmi ca || 1 02|| mocayāmi bhavapāśāduddharāmi mamāśritān | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavettathā || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne luṇṭakebhyo rakṣārthaṃ strībālikāstutyuttaraṃ rājabhaṭādirūpadhāriṇāśrīhariṇāluṇṭakā hatā bhaktāstu rakṣitā ityādinirūpaṇanāmā ekanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 191 ||
<3.192> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ bhaktasya pāvanīm | purā dhaniṣṭhakoṣākhyo vipro’bhavad dhanādimān || 1 || yajñayāgakaraścāpi pañcāyatanapūjakaḥ | bhaktiparo’tidānī ca gosahasradhanastathā || 2 || kṣetravāṭyaraṇyapatirvyavasāyodyamānvitaḥ | lakṣāṇi svarṇarūpyāṇāṃ yatkoṣe santi vai sadā || 3 || rājamānyo’pi bahudhā yuddhapureśamānitaḥ | rājā mālavasiṃhaśca nityaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ śubham || 4 || dadātyasmai mahāsaudhe sabhāyāṃ gauravorjitam | rājyātidurvahe kārye’syaivānumatimṛcchati || 5 || yathāmukhyapradhānaṃ vai tathā vipraṃ samarhati | utsaveṣu samasteṣu vihāreṣu prapāsane || 6 || samājeṣu śubhe sarvavidheye manute dvijam | prajānāmanurāgaścābhavaddhaniṣṭhakoṣake || 7 || dhanānāṃ sa pradānaṃ vai sāhāyyārthaṃ prajāsu ha | prakaroti vinā lekhaṃ vacomūlyaṃ hi satyatā || 8 || dīnānāṃ ca daridrāṇāmanāthānāṃ ca yoṣitām | sādhūnāṃ bhikṣukāṇāṃ ca vastrānnādisahāyakṛt || 9 || gṛhadānāni bahūni mandirāṇi bahūnyapi | dharmaśālāḥ sādhumaṭhānuddadhāra sujīrṇitān || 3.192.1 0|| prapāstathānnasatrāṇi kārayāmāsa rājavat | rājāpi tena sarvatra sāhāyyado’sya vartate || 11 || dhaniṣṭhakoṣo nityaṃ māṃ bhajate parameśvaram | snātvā sampūjya māṃ bhūpaṃ militvātha tataḥ param || 12|| pañcadevādikānnatvā bhuṃkte nityaṃ na cānyathā | kuṭumbaṃ tasya bhaktaṃ me sadā māṃ bhajate rame || 1 3|| atha rājyamado lakṣmi mado dhanasya vai tathā | yauvanasya madaścāpi vipathaṃ nayate janam || 14|| indriyāṇāṃ pravegaśca viṣayāṇāmupasthitiḥ | manasaścāpi cāñcalyaṃ bhaktaṃ kṣipati kalmaṣe ||15|| nityaṃ nṛtyasya yoge vā nityaṃ vādyasamājake | nityaṃ śṛṃgārabhāvo vā rajobhāvo vivardhate || 1 6|| nityaṃ viṣayayogāśca nityaṃ padārthayogitā | harate vegavaccittaṃ nimnagamanaśāli yat || 17|| tathaivāsya subhaktasya rājasaṃsadi vartanam | vārāṃganādinṛtyeṣu hyupasthitirniśādiṣu || 18|| dāsīnāṃ sahavāsādyairmano vikāramāptavat | surūpā api lobhinyo dhanavāñcchāvimohikāḥ || 1 9|| vārayoṣā hāvabhāvaiḥ sevanaiḥ sahavāsanaiḥ | cikṣipurmama bhaktaṃ taṃ mohe dhaniṣṭhakoṣakam ||3.192.20|| viṣayeṣu suramyeṣu magnaṃ cakruḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | dhanahāryo dhanaṃ labdhvā bhogyāstiṣṭhanti tatpuraḥ ||21 || bhakto’pi mama bhaktiṃ ca vihāya rājasaṃgataḥ | rājodyāne sadāvāsaṃ prāyaśaścācarattataḥ ||22|| kuṭumbaṃ svaṃ kvacinnibhālayatyeva cireṇa saḥ | bahudhodyānavāsaṃ sa rājñā samaṃ karoti yat ||23|| rājāpi bālamitraṃ yat sadā taṃ sevate saha | pānabhojanakhelādyairnṛtyagāyanarañjanaiḥ ||24|| evaṃ bhaktasya saṃyoge viṣayairbāhyavṛttibhiḥ | pūjanaṃ paṭhanaṃ dhyānaṃ mama sarvaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||25|| kṣatimāptaṃ layaṃ prāptaṃ bhaktirme khaṇḍitābhavat | smarati māṃ kadācit sa viśeṣeṇa tu yoṣitaḥ ||26|| vārāṃganābhiḥ sañjuṣṭo vartate sa vyavāyakṛt | athāsya putrāḥ putryaśca patnī sādhvī sadharmiṇī ||27|| nāmnā snehalatādevī śuśoca svapatisthitim | mahābhāgavatī patnī bhajate śrīhariṃ tu mām ||28|| prārthayatyeva pūjāyāṃ patyurdharmasya rakṣaṇam | adharmasya parityāgaṃ yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ suvaṃśajām ||29|| bālakṛṣṇaharekṛṣṇa puruṣottamamādhava | tava bhaktasya citte yaccāñcalyaṃ tatpraśāmaya ||3.192.3 0|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkāntakeśava | mama patyurvyavāyasya vyasanaṃ tvaṃ pramocaya ||3 1 || rājāpi tava bhaktaḥ syāttathā kṛṣṇa vidhehi ca | gaṇikā api bhaktāḥ syuryathā te paramātmanaḥ ||32|| prajāścāpi ca bhaktāḥ syustathā kṛṣṇa kṛpāṃ kuru | vrataṃ cādyadināt te’haṃ varṣāntaṃ tvekabhojanam ||33|| kariṣye ca tathā sāghusatīsevā samāhitā | pratyahaṃ pūjanaṃ te ca kariṣye ghaṭikāvadhim ||34|| ṣoḍaśairupacāraiśca kārayiṣye tu sūtake | preṃkhāṃ svarṇamayīṃ cāpi mūrtiṃ svarṇamayīṃ ca te ||35|| kārayiṣye śriyā yuktāṃ rādhayā ramayā yutām | padmāvatyā yutāṃ yuktāṃ māṇikyayā ca śobhanām ||36|| lakṣmyā yuktāṃ tathā ramyāṃ vibhūṣāḍhyāṃ suyauvanām | śayyāparyaṃkamevāpi kārayiṣye śubhottamām ||37|| svarṇarājatajanyaṃ ca tavopakaraṇānyapi | vyajane cāmare chatraṃ pāduke bhūṣaṇāni ca ||38|| kārayiṣye svarṇaratnamayāni tava tuṣṭaye | nityaṃ sugandhasāraiśca tailasāraiśca mardanam || 39|| abhyañjanaṃ dravaiścāpi pūjanaṃ tulasīdalaiḥ | naivedyaṃ ghṛtamiṣṭānaiḥ kārayiṣye’tituṣṭaye ||3.192.40|| tavotsavān kārayiṣye vārṣikān kānta keśava | vaṇijaṃ me patiṃ vārāṃganāvyasanānmocaya ||41 || eṣā te śaraṇaṃ prāptā patitā tava pādayoḥ | mama patyustu pāpāni prajvālaya priyaṃ kuru ||42|| ityuktvā snehalatikā dīpotsavīdine hareḥ | kṛtvā me pūjanaṃ cāpyāsamvatsaraṃ vrataṃ vyadhāt ||43|| uktān sarvānniyamān sā pālayāmāsa bhāvukī | patisaṃskārakaṃ nāma vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ vyadhāddhi sā ||44|| udyāpanaṃ vratasyāpi cakre’nnakūṭavaddine | pratipadyeva kṛṣṇasyotsavaṃ ca vratapūrtaye ||45|| maṇḍapaṃ kārayāmāsa kadalīstambhaśobhitam | toraṇādiyutaṃ ramyaṃ kuṇḍavedīsamanvitam ||46|| siṃhāsanānvitaṃ vipradevatādivirājitam | havyakavyādisāmagrīdānasāmagrikāyutam ||47|| samidvahniyajñakarmavedamantradhvaniśrutam | sādhusādhvīviṣṇubhaktakṛtapāṭhādighoṣitam ||48|| vādyakīrtanagītyādyairghoṣitaṃ dānavardhitam | satyasvarādilokānāṃ vāsibhiḥ samadhiṣṭhitam ||49|| torthāgamairdivyabhāvaṃ kṛṣṇapārṣadarājitam | brahmapriyāvilasitaṃ dhvajapatākikānvitam ||3.192.50|| sarvatobhadranāmārthaśreṣṭhamaṇḍalaśobhitam | sthālīkalaśapātrādyaiḥ śayyādānādibhiryutam ||51|| pūjāsāmagrikābhiśca pūjyate yatra mādhavaḥ | hūyate yatra vahnau ca havyaṃ vividhajātikam |||52|| uccāryante vedaghoṣā mantrā yatra ca bhūsuraiḥ | dīyante yatra dānāni svarṇarūpyamayāni ca ||93|| bhujyante bhojanānīṣṭamiṣṭānnāni ca bhūsuraiḥ | dīyante tṛptacittaiścāśīrvādāḥ śreyasāṃpradāḥ ||54|| pūrṇāhutirghṛtānāṃ ca dhārābhirdīyate tadā | āyayau maṇḍape tatra vṛddho nārāyaṇo naraḥ ||55|| viprarūpo’titejasvī lakṣmi yo’haṃ sa eva saḥ | svāgataṃ cārhaṇaṃ cakrurdevā me ṛṣayo’pi ca ||56|| āsanaṃ me daduḥ śreṣṭhaṃ vahnirmāṃ cāpyapūjayat | upāviveśa tatrāhaṃ sarvasammānito dvijaḥ ||57||
