kasya yajña ityahaṃ vai cāpṛcchaṃ vedhasaṃ dvijam | somāyano dvijaḥ sopyuvāca māṃ cāṃgulidṛśā ||58|| asyāḥ snehalatikāyā vratodyāpanajo’dhvaraḥ | vidyate’dyeṣṭasiddhyarthamasyā iṣṭaṃ bhavatviha ||59|| bhavatviṣṭamiti drāk cāvadaṃ tatrādhvare’pyaham | śṛṇu lakṣmi mahāścaryaṃ tadodyāne vyajāyata ||3.192.60|| yatra saudhe mahān śreṣṭhī rājā bhṛtyā vasanti ca | saudhaḥ sa kampito jāto yathā bhūkampakampitaḥ ||61 || udyānasahitaḥ saudho nānyat kiñcittadā rame | madicchayaiva jātaḥ sa kampo bhayāvahastadā ||62|| saudhastu patitastena vārāṃganāḥ pracūrṇitāḥ | rājā śreṣṭhī saudhapāte madhyāvakāśake stare ||63|| patitau tatra bhagnāṃgau kintu prajīvitau dare | sahaiva patitau mūrchāvigame bhānasaṃyutau ||64|| parasparaṃ cāhvayataḥ kā daśā te dhanina nṛpa | dhanī prāha mama pādo bhagno jānupradeśataḥ ||65|| nṛpaḥ prāha mama hasto bhagnaḥ kaphoṇikāsthalāt | nānyad duḥkhaṃ vartate’tra prāṇāstiṣṭhanti cāvayoḥ ||66|| maraṇaṃ naiva jātaṃ vai parameśakṛtā tviyam | āvābhyāṃ śrīharermārgastyaktvā vārāṃganāgatiḥ ||67|| gṛhītā pāpadā tasyāḥ phalaṃ tvidaṃ vināśakṛt | tathāpi pūrvapuṇyena yadvā sambandhipuṇyataḥ ||68|| jīvāvo daramadhye’tra kṛṣṇadattāvakāśake | adyaprabhṛti veśyānāṃ saṃgaṃ tyakṣyāva eva ha ||69|| parameśaṃ bhajiṣyāvo kariṣyāvo vratāni ca | yadyetasmād durgamādvai durvibhāvyāvakāśakāt | |3.192.70|| nirgamiṣyāma evāvāṃ saprāṇau bhagnamadhyataḥ | nārāyaṇaṃ bhajāvo’tra sa nau rakṣāṃ kariṣyati ||71 || evaṃ tau nirṇayaṃ kṛtvā harekṛṣṇeti jepatuḥ | lakṣmi tau snehalatikādhvarapuṇyena rakṣitau ||72|| atha yuddhapure tūrṇaṃ yajñapūrṇāhuteḥ param | rājaprāsādapatanaṃ cāśrūyata prajāmukhāt ||73|| nāstikyastu prajāḥ prāhuryajñe vyutkramajaṃ phalam | vāstavikaṃ na tattatra vyutkramo nābhavanmakhe ||74|| madicchayā hi tajjātaṃ pāpena śreṣṭhino’pi ca | vārāṃganā mama bhaktapātanena sakalmaṣāḥ ||75|| mṛtā eva svapāpena bhaktastu rakṣito mayā | rājāpi bhaktayogena bhaktyarthaṃ rakṣito mayā ||76|| āstikāstu tadā prāhuḥ pāpā mṛtāḥ svapātakaiḥ | athāpi yajñapuṇyena na mṛtau śreṣṭhibhūbhṛtau ||77|| manuṣyāśca drutaṃ gatvā kāṭamālaṃ samastakam | śanaiḥ kṛtvā dūramevotsārya pāṣāṇamṛttikāḥ ||78|| kāṣṭhādhobhāgasaṃvāsau sajīvau śreṣṭhibhūbhatau | śanairnissārayāmāsurbhagnāṃgauṣadhamācaran ||79|| gaṇikāstu samastāstāḥ śavātmikāḥ prakūrcitāḥ | mṛtā evopalabdhāstā yāmyapuraṃ siṣevire ||3.192.80|| vṛddhaspṛṣṭau vaṇig rājā svasthapādakarau drutam | sampannau cādhvaravārtāṃ śrutvā praharṣitau hyati ||81 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vṛddhasvarūpadhṛk | hastābhyāṃ tau supasparśa mūḍhamāro vyalīyata ||82|| pīḍāpi vigatā sarvā maṇḍape tau samāgatau | dṛṣṭavantau puṇyakāryaṃ śrutavantau striyā vratam ||83|| patidevasya śuddhyarthaṃ rājñaḥ śuddhyarthamityapi | prajāyāścāpi śuddhyarthaṃ vrataṃ jñātvā striyāstadā ||84|| prajā rājā dhanī sarve praśaśaṃsuḥ pativratām | dhanyā nārī harerbhaktā mokṣārthinī ca pāvanī ||85|| śreyaso’rthe prajādīnāṃ yayā vrataṃ ciraṃ dhṛtam | yayā dravyāṇi naijāni daivakārye kṛtāni ca ||86|| asyāḥ puṇyena bhūpo’yaṃ śreṣṭhī ceti prarakṣitau | vayaṃ sarve bhajiṣyāmo nārāyaṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim ||87|| rājāpi maṇḍape tatra prakāśaṃ vyājahāra tat | śreṣṭhī tathā prajāścāpi vyājahrurmaṇḍape yathā ||88|| vyasanāni samastāni tyakṣyāma pāpakāni ca | bhajiṣyāmo hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ sanātanam ||89|| prāyaścittaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ kṛtānāṃ pāpakarmaṇām | bhaviṣyāmo vaiṣṇavāśca yāsyāmo’nte harergṛham ||3.192.90|| ityevaṃ lakṣaśastatrāyātā ye darśakā api | yajñārthaṃ cāpyakasmātārthaṃ ca te’pi narāḥ striyaḥ ||91 || rāṣṭrajā mānavāḥ sarve parivartitamānasāḥ | vṛddhaviprapratāpenādhvase vaiṣṇavadīkṣaṇam ||92|| jagṛhurvṛddhaviprātte vyasanāni ca tatyajuḥ | dadhruśca taulasīṃ kaṇṭhīṃ bālakṛṣṇeti nāma me ||93|| o namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | itimantraṃ jagṛhuścābhavam̐ste vaiṣṇavottamāḥ ||94|| vrataṃ cakruḥ kārtikasya śuklasya sarva eva te | ekabhuktastvamevāpi pratyahaṃ pūjanaṃ mama ||95|| dānaṃ nityaṃ tathānnānāṃ bhajanaṃ ghaṭikāvadhim athāhaṃ maṇḍape tatra darśanaṃ svaṃ dadau śubham || 16|| caturbhujaṃ divyarūpaṃ rādhālakṣmīramāyutam | padmāvatīmāṇikīśrīsahitaṃ sumanoharam ||97|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakaustubhahāraśobhitam | divyatejoparidhyāḍhyamukhaṃ keyūramaṇḍitam ||98|| divyamuktaiḥ pārṣadaiśca maharṣibhiḥ prasevitam | yajñānalairdevatābhirdevaiścābhiprapūjitam ||99|| snehalateṣṭapūrtyarthaṃ cāgataṃ parameśvaram | vīkṣya māṃ pūjayāṃcakruḥ pādajalaṃ papuśca me || 3.192.1 00|| yajñaprasādaṃ jagṛhurbubhujurmahīmānakāḥ | sarve samāptiṃ yajñasya cakruścāvabhṛthaṃ tataḥ || 101 || luṇīnadyāṃ prasasnuśca nṛpasya śreṣṭhinastathā | prajānāṃ yāni pāpāni prajajvalustadā rame || 10 2| avabhṛthaṃ mahāsnānaṃ sarvapāpavināśakṛt | tatra snātā hi śuddhyanti mahāpāpāparādhinaḥ || 1 03|| rājā śreṣṭhī sasmaraturmokṣārthaṃ vārayoṣitām | drāgeva madbalāt tatrāvabhṛthasnānapuṇyataḥ || 104 || rājñā ca śreṣṭhinā dattāt sarvā yāmyālayād drutam | āyayurmocitā dūtaistatra luṇyāstaṭe striyaḥ || 1 05|| papurvāri prasasnuśca mayā ca prokṣitā jalaiḥ | divyadehāstūrṇameva jātāstā pāpavarjitāḥ || 1 06|| vimānaiḥ prayayuḥ sarvāḥ svargaṃ ciraṃ tataśca tāḥ | prayāsyanti sthiraṃ dhāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ paramātmanaḥ || 107|| evaṃ tā mokṣitāścāpi prajāśca vaiṣṇavīkṛtāḥ | rājā śreṣṭhī nirvyasanau kṛtau bhaktiyutau striyā || 108|| tato’haṃ pūjanaṃ prāpya tirobhāvaṃ drutaṃ tataḥ | āyuṣyānte snehalatāṃ dvijaṃ somāyanaṃ tathā || 1 09|| dhaniṣṭhakoṣaṃ vaṇijaṃ mālavasiṃhabhūpatim | prajāśca vaiṣṇavīḥ sarvā yathākālaṃ mamākṣaram || 3.192.1 10|| anayaṃ bhaktiyuktām̐ścetyevaṃ vai pāradārikam | bhaktaṃ śuddhaṃ vidhāyāhaṃ lakṣmi muktiṃ nayāmi tam || 111 || paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇānmananādapi | api pāpasamācāraḥ śuddho yāsyati matpadam || 1 12|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne yuddhapurādhipena saha dhaniṣṭhakoṣasya śreṣṭhino vārāṃganāvyasaninaḥ svastrīkṛtabhaktivratārādhanādinā śrīhariṇā mokṣaḥ kṛta ityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvānavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 192||
<3.193> puruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ brahmaghnasya pramokṣaṇam | āsīd vāṭāsīnarākhye grāme rājīvabhūpatiḥ || 1 || rājñī tasyābhavat sādhvī nāmnā kundanadevikā | putrī putravatī dharmaparāyaṇā tapasvinī || 2 || bhaktā me śrīhareścāpi vratadhyānaparāyaṇā | asūryampaśyā cāspṛśyā narāntaraiḥ kvacid rame || 3 || pativratyaparā devapūjāsnānāditatparā | cāturmāsyavratakartrī haryutsavavidhāyinī || 4|| dānadharmaparā cāpi paropakāraśālinī | sādhusatkārasevārthaṃ kṛtasarvasvamaṃgalā || 5 || dīnānāthagavāṃ sevāvidhātrī sūryapūjikā | kanyakāmānakartrī ca mamārādhanatatparā || 6 || atithyabhyāgatādibhyo bhojanāmbaradāyinī | tīrthakartrī svāminaśca pādapūjāparā sadā || 7 || evaṃ saṃskārasampannā nityamālāprajāpinī | devadarśanaraktā ca nityaṃ kathāśravānvitā || 8 || kṣemaṃ ca kuśalaṃ cāpi vetti yā svaprajāsu vai | ahiṃsādharmaniratā satyavrataparāyaṇā || 9 || yasyāḥ puṇyena rāṣṭraṃ vai śobhate modate bahu | prajāścāsyā nirātaṃkā nirāmayāḥ susampadaḥ || 3.193.1 0|| atha lakṣmi suvarṇe vai sugandho na kṛto yathā | tathā suvarṇabhāryāyāmapi svāmī tvadhogatiḥ || 11 || rājāsyāḥ svapatiḥ krūro na devān manute svacit | dharmakarmādikaṃ vyarthaṃ jānātyevābhimānavān || 12|| na viprānna ca sādhūm̐śca gaṇayatyeva dhārmikān | avamānaṃ karotyeva pūjyānāṃ tvavivekavān || 1 3|| na snānaṃ naiva dānaṃ ca na pūjāṃ nāpi sadvratam | na tīrthaṃ nāpi satkāraṃ satkarmāpi karoti saḥ || 14|| devadravyaṃ vipradhanaṃ sādhudhanaṃ ca dhārmikam | nāṇakaṃ parakīyaṃ yallabhyate balato’pi vā || 15|| āharatyeva lubdhātmā naiva muñcati kasyacit | stainyād balāt karālluñcāyāśca yuddhāt prapīḍanāt || 1 6|| kapaṭācchadmato labdhaṃ sarvaṃ nyāyyaṃ sa vetti vai | anyāyaṃ nyāyamevāyaṃ jānāti nṛpakarma tat || 17|| prajānāṃ yaddhanaṃ sarvaṃ kṣetraṃ bhūmirgṛhādikam | vyāpārā āyabhāgāśca prajāśca me dhanaṃ hi tat ||18|| putrāḥ putryo dhenavaśca vṛṣabhā vājino gajāḥ | yānavāhanapaśavaḥ sarvaṃ rājñaśca vetti saḥ || 19|| rājyaṃ rājño na cānyasya jaḍaṃ vā cetanātmakam | pṛthvīpatiryato rājā pārthivāśca nṛpasya vai ||3.193.20 || pṛthvīṃ bhuṃkte yato rājā tato bhuṃkte hi pārthivān | sarvāṃścāpi vikārām̐ścetyevaṃ manute bhūpatiḥ ||21 || viśeṣatāsya vipreṣu dveṣaścāsīttu janmataḥ | viprā vṛthā nayantyeva laḍḍukān dakṣiṇāstathā ||22|| vṛthā bhikṣāṭanāśceti viprāḥ pratyakṣaluṇṭakāḥ | matvaivaṃ brāhmaṇān dṛṣṭvā niṣkāsayati dūrataḥ ||23|| daṇḍayatyeva bahudhā bhikṣitaṃ cāharatyapi | śṛṇu lakṣmyekadā viprāstīrthaṃkarāstu viṃśatiḥ ||24|| bahucarāprabhaktāste vāṭāsīnaramāyayuḥ | mārge viśrāntilābhārthaṃ rājñyā te satkṛtāstadā ||25|| bhojanāmbarapānādyairdakṣiṇādānavāhanaiḥ | rājñā jñātaṃ dhanaṃ teṣāmagre’pi cāsti vai tadā ||26|| rājñā dattaṃ ca vipulaṃ tīrthamiṣeṇa tatparam | lobhena nṛpatiḥ śrutvāhvayad viprān svasannidhau || 2 7|| luluṇṭa taddhanaṃ sarvaṃ viprāṇāṃ sa tato’pi ca | kārāgāre ruṣā sarvān nyavāsayacca taddine || 28|| atha viprāstu saṃkruddhāḥ śāpaṃ dadustadolbaṇam | rājyaṃ tava vinaṣṭaṃ syāt kuṭumbādivivarjitaḥ || 29|| āraṇyakaḥ kāpaṭī ca bhava kṣudro hi bhikṣukaḥ | phalaṃ viṃśativarṣāṇi bhuktvā ca pāśavīṃ tanum ||3.193.30 || prāpya duḥkhāni sarvāṇi bhuṃkṣva nāstika nirdaya | śāpo datto dine viprai rātrau vaṭodarādhipaḥ ||3 1 || sasainyastvāyayau yuddhenopāharat samastakam | rājye nijaṃ deśapālaṃ niyojya nigaḍe sthitān ||32|| viprān vimocayitvā ca rājñyai prādāya jīvikām | nṛpateśca kuṭumbaṃ ca saṃrakṣya tatra vai tataḥ ||3 3 || rājīvaṃ dhartumevāpyanveṣayāmāsa yadyapi | kintu svanagaraṃ tyaktvā guptamārgeṇa satvaram ||34|| niryayau rājīvabhūpo narmadāvanabhūsthalīm | viprāṇāṃ śāpadoṣeṇa viṃśativatsarāṇi saḥ || 35|| araṇye pāśavaṃ duḥkhaṃ labdhavān kṣudratānvitam | atha rājñī bhajate sma saputraputrikā tu mām ||36|| kundanadevītināmnā khyātā kṛṣṇaparāyaṇā | araṇyastho’pi rājīvo duḥkhito hi svapāpataḥ ||37|| pāpaṃ bahutaraṃ cakre luṇṭanaṃ paśumāraṇam | evaṃ vane pravasataścaiko viprastu narmadām ||38|| snātuṃ gacchan vane tatra milito’sya samīpagaḥ | rājīvaścāpi vipraṃ taṃ papraccha vada me’dhunā ||39|| kva yāsi kiṃ tavāgre’sti dehi sarvaṃ ca me’tra vai | vipraḥ prāha mamāgre’sti pātheyaṃ ca dhanaṃ manāk ||3.193.40 || yātrāmātropabhogārthaṃ na dāsye te vanecara | evaṃ vivadatostatra tayoryuddhamajāyata ||41 || rājīvena hato vipro pāṣāṇairmardito hṛdi | vipro’yaṃ narmadātīre pretastatra vyajāyata ||42|| rājānaṃ prāṇahantāraṃ vavalge brahmaghātinam | rājā śāpena durbhāgyo’dhiko’tha rakṣasārditaḥ ||43|| vicittonmattajaḍavad babhrāmāraṇyabhūmiṣu | athāpi kundanadevī brahmaśīlaparāyaṇā ||44|| nidrāyāmekadāraṇye dadarśa taṃ tu duḥkhinam | kṣudhātṛṣātisantaptaṃ rākṣasāviṣṭayunmadam ||45|| pāśavīṃ vṛttimāpannaṃ rākṣasīṃ rītimāsthitam | mṛtaṃ paśuṃ ca vā patatriṇaṃ khādantamityapi ||46|| smarantaṃ coccarantaṃ ca kundanā kundaneti ca | kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ romaśaṃ ca rūkṣajaṭādharaṃ tathā ||47|| anyamiva jñāyamānaṃ vivṛttākhilatattvakam | śabaraṃ vā pāradhiṃ vā ghātakaṃ śvapacaṃ ca vā ||48|| tadvad vilokyamānaṃ vai bhayadaṃ darśanādapi | atidurgandhiśarīraṃ malinaṃ jaraṭhaṃ yathā ||49|| kundanā kundanā ceti vyāharantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ | etādṛśaṃ pāpamūrti vanecaraṃ pravīkṣya sā ||3.193.50 || kṣaṇaṃ vicāramakarot svapne ko’yaṃ bhavediti | atha sā bhayamāpannā prāha kastvaṃ vanāntare ||51 || sa cāha rājīvanāmā kundanāpatirasmyaham | pīḍitaḥ śāpapāpena rakṣasāpi viśeṣataḥ |||52|| samuddharet kundanā māṃ tadā me sadgatirbhavet | yāvacchṛṇoti nidrāyāṃ kundanā nṛpanoditam |||53|| tāvannidrā gatā rājñyāḥ prātaḥ sā prabubodha ha | utthitā śokamāpannā patiduḥkhena duḥkhitā ||54|| hastāmalakavada dṛśyaṃ vīkṣamāṇā tvarānvitā | snātvā pupūja sādhvī māṃ śrīpatiṃ kaṣṭahāriṇīm ||55|| śokātiśokavadanottaptātitaptamānasā | uccāryāśrukṛtāvilanetrā tuṣṭāva māṃ satī ||56|| nātha tvaṃ pūrṇakāmo’si nāptavyaṃ ve hi śiṣyate | tathāpyatra hi saṃsāre kathamāyāsi me vada ||57|| bhaktecchāpūraṇārthaṃ cenmama vāñchāṃ prapūraya | yadi bhaktāsmi te śiṣyā dāsī veti ca manyase ||58|| mokṣaṇīyo’raṇyaduḥkhād rājīvo rakṣasā dhṛtaḥ | yadi pāpaprabhogeṇa karmanāśo’sti sarvathā ||59|| dayālo te dayālutvaṃ vyarthaṃ vyarthastavāgamaḥ | vyarthā bhaktiśca te sarvārthārthino’rthāprapūraṇāt ||3.193.60|| nārī tvarthārthinī hyasmi tathāpi tava dāsikā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇoddhāraṃ vidhāpaya ||61 || yadi pāpikṛte kṛṣṇa kṛpā te naiva jāyate | mama puṇyaṃ dadāmyasmai tena tvaṃ taṃ samuddhara ||62|| yadi brahmapradaṇḍena dagdhe dayā na te’sti cet | mayi kṛtvā dayāṃ kṛṣṇa matpatiṃ pātumarhasi ||63|| yadi bhūsurahantustu daṇḍaḥ pūrṇo vidhīyate | tadā taddaṇḍamadhunā mayi yoktuṃ samarthaye ||64|| tasya tvardhāṃganā cāsmi cārdhaśubhāśubhārthinī | mama bhakterjanyapuṇyaṃ tvardhaṃ tasya pratiṣṭhatu ||65|| tasya pāpaṃ cārdhakarma mamātrāpi pratiṣṭhatu | evaṃ nārāyaṇaviṣṇo nyāyena niyamena ca ||66|| api yogyavinimayenāpi taṃ pātumarhati | āsurāṇāṃ svayaṃ hantā muktido’pi bhavasyataḥ ||67|| rājīvasyāpi bhagavan sukhakṛd bhava keśava | bhaktāyā mama śāntyarthaṃ madarthitaṃ vibhāvaya ||68|| bhāmākṛte yathā pārijātodyamastvayohyate | bhāmāhaṃ tava dāsyasmi matpārijātamarthaye ||69|| kalpe kalpe tvayā kṛṣṇa bhāmā tuṣṭā vidhīyate | pārijātapradānena bhāmā tuṣṭā vidhehi mām ||3.193.70|| bhaktyā tvāṃ toṣayāmyatra tvaṃ dānena pratoṣaya | sevayā strī naraścārthapradānena parasparam ||71 || prasādayataḥ sarvatra tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi | sanāthāyā api nātha hyanāthāṃ sthitimīkṣase | kundanā kundanā ceti rājīvo’raṇyake vadan ||72|| uddhāraṃ tvarthayatyeva samuddhara kṛpāṃ kuru | yāvannoddhārayase tvaṃ cānaśane vasāmyaham ||73 || ityuktvā kundanādevī lakṣmi cānaśanaṃ vyadhāt | ekāsanā nirjalā ca nirāhārā nirāśayā ||74|| jitanidrā jitāhārā maraṇe kṛtaniścayā | netre pramīlya hṛdaye dhyānasthā sā babhūva ha ||75|| āvartayati mālāyāṃ māṃ jape tvanivartinī | dhāraṇādhyānavṛttibhyāṃ māṃ babandha hṛdantare ||76|| na cacāla kṣaṇaṃ kvāpi mahāvegadṛḍhīkṛtā | rājīvamokṣaṇaṃ kāṃkṣamāṇā matparamābhavat ||77|| ahaṃ tasyā mano jñātvā patimokṣārthameva tu | āntarastho bahistūrṇamupāyayau surūpavān ||78|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharo lakṣmīramānvitaḥ | sarvābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyastathā pārṣadasevitaḥ ||79||| prasannavadanaḥ śānto varadānapratatparaḥ | tejaḥparidhisaṃvyāptavigraho divyabhūṣaṇaḥ ||3.193.80|| evaṃvidhaṃ tu māmagre sthitaṃ sā kundanāntarāt | mayā sambodhitā tūrṇaṃ samādherbahirāgatā ||8 1 || vīkṣya māṃ paramātmānaṃ samutthāya satī drutam | papāta pādayorme drāk samāśliṣacca vakṣasi ||882|| mama sparśanamātreṇa divyadṛṣṭirvyajāyata | vyalokayadvane naijaṃ patiṃ svapne vilokitam ||83|| śīghraṃ māṃ lambahastena vyadarśayatpatiṃ nijam | duḥkhinaṃ rakṣasā vyāptaṃ mokṣayituṃ tadārthayat ||84|| ahaṃ tatraiva sahasā patyurmokṣārthameva ha | garuḍe saṃsthito bhūtvā nītvā sākaṃ ca kundanām ||85|| yatrāraṇye vartate sa rājīvastatra pakṣiṇā | āgacchaṃ cāvatīryāthāmbarāt sākaṃ tayā rame ||86|| rājīvaṃ tu bhramantaṃ svakamaṇḍalujalena vai | aprokṣayaṃ tatastatra rakṣo yo valgito’bhavat ||87|| jalaṃ pītvātha tūrṇaṃ vai divyadeho babhūva ha | māṃ stutvā matpratāpena vimānena divaṃ yayau ||88|| rājīvo’pi tadā svasthamanā suṣṭhuprabhānavān | bhūtvā jñātvā nijāṃ patnīṃ māṃ tathā parameśvaram ||89|| nanāma pādayorme vai praṇanāma ca daṇḍavat | kundanādevikā tasmai sarvaṃ vṛttaṃ nyavedayat ||3.193.90|| tato mayā punarvārbhiḥ prokṣitaḥ pāvano’bhavat | pāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ cakre’pāyayaṃ vāri matkaraiḥ ||91 || garuḍe taṃ samāropyānayaṃ vāṭāsanaṃ puram | rājñyā mantro dāpitaśca rājā tyaktvābhimānakam ||92|| jagrāha mama mantraṃ ca kaṇṭhīṃ ca taulasīṃ tathā | vaiṣṇavo bhagavadbhakto’bhavaccāstikabhāvanaḥ ||93|| putrāḥ putryastathā sarvāḥ prajāḥ prasannatāṃ gatāḥ | atha kṣemaṃ tathā teṣāṃ kuśalaṃ samvidhāya ca ||94|| ante mamākṣare loke gamanārthaṃ vaco mama | datvā tirobhavaṃ śīghraṃ vaṭodaranṛpaṃ prati ||95|| agacchaṃ brāhmaṇo bhūtvā bhikṣāmiṣeṇa tatra ha | yācito’tha sa rājā vai bhāskaravikramābhidhaḥ ||96|| vada vipra pradāsye te yadicchāviṣayaṃ tava | jagāda mahyaṃ ca tato’rthayaṃ rājīvarakṣaṇam ||97|| vāṭāsīnasya rājyaṃ pratyarpayituṃ punaḥ punaḥ | rājeśvarastathodāro nṛpastathāstviti drutam ||98|| uktvā patraṃ prāhiṇocca pradhānaṃ prati tadvidham | rājyaṃ pradāpayāmāsa rājīvāya dvijo’pyaham ||99|| punā rājñyai nṛpataye datvā me darśanaṃ tathā | tirobhāvaṃ gataścāhaṃ tataḥ kālāntare rame || 3.193.10 0|| rājīvaṃ kundanādevīṃ tathā putrān suputrikāḥ | vaiṣṇavaṃ tatkuṭumbaṃ ca dhāmākṣaraṃ samānayam || 101 || evaṃ mayā purā bhaktyā patnyāścārādhanena vai | pāpo’pi brahmahāścāpi rājīvo rakṣito vanāt || 1 02|| rākṣasānmocitaścāpi rākṣaso’pi pramocitaḥ | rājīvanṛpateḥ sarve kuṭumbaṃ mocitaṃ hyaghāt || 1 03|| kundanāyāḥ pratāpena vratenānaśanena vai | mamārādhanabhaktyā ca rājyaṃ svaṃ prāpitaṃ puna || 1 04|| evaṃ lakṣmi mama bhaktyā bhuktirmuktirbhavediha | paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhettathā || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vāṭāsīnāranṛpaterbrahmaghnasya rākṣasābhibhūtasya hṛtarājyasya kundanadevīrājñyāḥ paramabhaktyā bhagavaddarśanaṃ duḥkhamokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trinavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 193 ||
<3.194> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ bhaktāsarojinīpateḥ | caritraṃ pramadāghnasya devaviśrāmanāminaḥ || 1 || āsīccakradharo rājā virāmanagarādhipaḥ | tasyāmātyo’bhavad devaviśrāmākhyaḥ sudhārmikaḥ || 2 || rājyābhyunnatikartā sa prajodayābhilāṣukaḥ | rāṣṭrarakṣaṇayatnasthaḥ sadā devādipūjakaḥ || 3 || dharmamārgaparaścāpi satyadharmaparāyaṇaḥ | sādhusādhvīsatīsevāparāyaṇo’tisevakaḥ || 4 || ye kecid dravyahīnāste yācante devaviśramam | so’pi dadātyabhīṣṭaṃ ca toṣayatyeva bhikṣukān || 5 || arthino’pi pratuṣṭāśca mahāśīrvādavādinaḥ | svargaṃ rājyaṃ mahārājyaṃ tavāstviti vadanti ca || 6 || rājāpi dhārmiko nityaṃ sevate parameśvaram | na caurā nāpi dhūrtāśca na śaṭhā na pratārakāḥ || 7 || rocante nṛpateḥ svasya rājye nāpi chalapriyāḥ | yathā rājā tathāmātyaścaurādidaṇḍakṛt sadā ||8|| abhicāraparā ye ca mantratantrādijīvinaḥ | ghātakā mārakā ye te rocante nāsya vai kvacit ||9|| athaikadā bahucarāmātustu sevikā striyaḥ | yoginyo mantravettryaśca bhikṣārthaṃ niryayū rame || 3.194.10 || yatra dāneśvarā bhūpā yatra dānijanāstathā | śrūyante tatra tatraitā bhikṣante vai dhanaṃ rame || 11 || svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ cāmbarāṇi yānāni vāhanānyapi | hīrakān māṇikyavarṇān ratnāni vividhāni ca || 1 2|| vibhūṣāścāpi bhikṣante prāpayanti ca bhikṣitam | bahucarāṃ mahādevīṃ samarpayanti tāstathā || 13|| mātā bahucarā lakṣaguṇaṃ dāsyati dānine | evaṃ vacaḥ paraṃ smṛtvā dānaṃ gṛhṇanti tāḥ striyaḥ ||14|| atha yena dadatyābhyaḥ śreṣṭhino vā nṛpā janāḥ | tadā teṣāṃ gopureṣu gṛhadvāreṣu tāḥ striyaḥ || 15|| āsanāni sthirīkṛtya kīrtayanti tu saṃghaśaḥ | vrataṃ dhṛtvā hyanaśanaṃ kaliṃ kurvanti tāstapaḥ || 16|| jaya jaya mātarbahucare jaya jaya mātarbahucare | dāninastvaṃ dhanaṃkare jaya jaya mātarbahucare || 17|| evaṃ tālīṃ vādayantyaḥ pragāyanti gṛhāṃgaṇe | pañca vā sapta vāhāni tiṣṭhanti na prayānti tāḥ || 18 || gṛhādhīśāstataḥ prāpya parājayaṃ dadatyapi | tāśca gṛhṇanti bahudhā svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ dhanādikam || 1 9|| atha cennaivārpayanti dhanaṃ dravyaṃ yathepsitam | prasahyānaśanaṃ kṛtvā yatante kalahairapi ||3.194.20|| gṛhītvaiva prayāntyeva nānyathā haṭhataḥ striyaḥ | evaṃvidhāstāḥ sarvāśca yoginyo daśasaṃkhyakāḥ ||21|| haṭhaṃ cakrurdhanārthaṃ vai tadāmātyo dadau dhanam | śataṃ suvarṇamudrāṇāṃ labdhvāpi toṣavarjitāḥ ||22|| yathācire sahasraṃ vai suvarṇānāṃ tathetarat | ratnahīrakabhūṣādi nṛpādapi pṛthag dhanam ||23|| daśasahasramudrāśca maṇimauktikamālikāḥ | evaṃ haṭhena yuktāstā yayācire na niryayuḥ ||24|| atha yāte tu saptāhe dīyamāne sahasrake | sauvarṇātmakamudrāṇāṃ yadā toṣaṃ gatā na tāḥ ||26|| tadāmātyasya nāśārthaṃ mantraṃ cāpyabhicārakam | rājñaścāpi vināśārthaṃ mantraṃ malinaṃ cakrire ||26|| athāmātyastu patito vyagro’bhavat sumūrcchitaḥ | ghaṭyantare punaḥ saṃjñāṃ prāpya samutthito’bhavat ||27|| rājāpi ca tathāvasthāṃ prāpto mūrcchāṃ tataḥ punaḥ | utthitaśceti tatsarvaṃ kartavyaṃ cābhicārakam ||28|| amātyaścāsahamāno’sahamāno nṛpo’pi ca | svabhaṭairagrapūjyāyāḥ śiraśchedamakārayat ||29|| athānyā abalāḥ krūrā mṛtyubhayena dudruvuḥ | dattaṃ dhanaṃ gṛhītvaiva tyaktvā śavaṃ mṛtastriyāḥ ||3.194.30|| pradhāvanaṃ pracakrustāḥ prayayurnagarāntaram | loke prajāyāṃ sarvatra strīhatyāṃ kṛtavānnṛpaḥ ||3 1 || strīhatyāṃ kṛtavām̐ścāsyāmātyo’pītyayaśo’bhavat | agnidā garadā śastrodyatā mantrābhicārikā ||22|| tā etā ātatāyinyaḥ śāpadā śatrudā tathā | tāsāṃ nāśe na vai doṣaḥ prāṇahā hi vadhārhaṇā || 33|| ato lakṣmi tathārūpāvighāte naiva dūṣaṇam | tathāpi lokavādāśca jāyante strīhanātmakāḥ ||34|| ayaśobodhakāḥ sarve lokasya citritā gatiḥ | dhikkurvanti prajāścāsyāmātyasya nṛpaterapi ||35|| kāraṇaṃ cābhicārādi hyaviditvaiva vai mṛṣā | ayaśaḥ saṃpragāyanti strīghno’mātyo nṛpastviti ||36|| atha rājā cakradharo’mātyaṃ prāha śubhaṃ vacaḥ | devaviśrāmanāmānaṃ kalaṃkasyāpanuttaye ||37|| kathaṃkāryaṃ kuvadantyāḥ prakṣālanaṃ mahāmate | yathā prajāyāṃ santoṣaḥ pravādakṣālanaṃ bhavet ||38|| pāpaṃ yadyapi hanane nāstyabhicārayoṣitaḥ | tathāpi kuvadantyā vai śāntaye vratamācaret ||39|| yathā vicārya sukhadaṃ brūhi cāmātya śobhanam | kartavyaṃ tadyathāyogyaṃ dharmakāryaṃ yathā bhavet ||3.194.40 || amātyaḥ prāha bhūpa tvaṃ sabhāmāhvaya śobhanām | vṛddhaprajājanānāṃ ca tatrāvedaya mānasam ||41|| rājā śrutvā tathā cakre sabhāṃ tatra ca mānavāḥ | prajāvṛddhā āyayuśca narā nāryaḥ sahasraśaḥ ||42||| athāmātyena nirdiṣṭaḥ purohito’tidhārmikaḥ | bahuśrutastathā śāstrasampanno vedapāragaḥ ||43|| dharmaviddeśakālajñaḥ prerito’mātyavākyataḥ | rājñā cājñākṛto dharmān sabhāyāṃ vyājahāra saḥ ||44|| śṛṇvantu pūjyavargāśca vṛddhā nāryo narāstathā | dharmasya lakṣaṇaṃ vacmi yathāśāstrānusārataḥ ||45|| nodanālakṣaṇo dharmo’rthakṛnmokṣaprado’pi ca | anarthakṛd viruddhārthaścādhogatiprado’vṛṣaḥ ||46|| yamāryāḥ pālyamānaṃ vai praśaṃsanti vṛṣo hi saḥ | yaṃ tu nindanti lokāḥ sa tvadharmaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||47|| lokānāṃ dhāraṇaṃ yena poṣaṇaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ tathā | sukhaṃ kṣemaṃ ca kuśalaṃ bhaveddharmaḥ sa ucyate ||48|| deśe kāle ca satpātre sthitaścācāra eva yaḥ | sukhadaḥ syāt sa dharmaḥ syād duḥkhadaḥ syādadharmakaḥ ||49|| dharmeṇa jāyate kīrtiḥ sukhaṃ śāntiḥ sadā tathā | unnatiścodayaścāpi svargaṃ mokṣaśca śāśvataḥ ||3.194.50|| sa eva dharma udito yena rājā prajāḥ sukhāḥ | devapūjā tathā dānaṃ vrataṃ dayā ca dakṣiṇā ||51 || paropakāraḥ satataṃ dharmo’yaṃ sarvadehinām | snānaṃ japo devanamaskāro devārpaṇaṃ tathā || 92|| vṛddhābhipūjanaṃ dharmo nṛpābhipūjanaṃ tathā | ācāraḥ prathamo dharmo hyadharmastadviparyaye ||53|| satāmācāra evāsti dharmo na tvasatāṃ tathā | ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmavrataṃ tapo damaḥ ||54|| dharma eva paraḥ prokto vṛddhasevāpi durlabhā | sādhusevā ca satsaṃgaḥ paro dharmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 65|| bhūtānāmupakāraśca yathāśakti vṛṣo mataḥ | prasannīkaraṇaṃ dharmaḥ prasannatvaṃ hi durlabham ||56|| aprasādastathodvego’nupakāro hyasevanam | hiṃsānṛtaṃ prasahyāpaharaṇaṃ duṣṭasaṃgitā ||97|| adharma eva bhavati tyājyāścāyaṃ sadā janaiḥ | śraddhayā dīyate dānaṃ dharma eva mato hi saḥ ||98|| prasahya hriyate yattu sa tvadharmo hi luṇṭakṛt | abhicāro bhavenmantraiḥ prāṇānāṃ ghātako yadi |||99|| adharma eva rājñāṃ vā prāṇanāśo’pyadharmakaḥ | pradhānasyābhicāreṇa māraṇaṃ cāpyadharmakaḥ ||3.194.60|| deśe kāle ca pātre ca hiṃsā duṣṭāśayastathā | ātatāyikriyā cāpi hyadharma eva kīrtitaḥ ||61|| etādṛśo yadādharmo nare nāryāṃ ca bālake | vālāyāṃ vā pravarteta cātatāyisvarūpadhṛk ||62|| intavya eva śastrādyairadharmo’dharmavām̐stathā | ātatāyī prahantavyaḥ sarvathā prāṇarakṣaṇe ||63|| ātatāyī yadā naiva hanyate yena so’pi vai 3| drutaṃ hato bhavettasmāddhantavya ātatāyakṛt ||64|| etaddharmasvarūpaṃ vai mayoktaṃ bhavatāṃ puraḥ | bahucarāyā bhaktānāṃ strīṇāmatra prapūjanam ||65|| kṛtaṃ sahasramudrābhiḥ suvarṇānāṃ yathāyatham | tathāpi ca balānnāryo haṭhānnetuṃ dṛḍhāśayāḥ ||66|| abhicāraṃ pracakrustā nṛpe’mātye’timārakam | atastā ātatāyinyo mārikāḥ pūtanā yathā ||67|| rākṣasya eva tāḥ proktā hiṃsikāstāmasātmikāḥ | mantravettryaścātatāyyabhicārakāryayojikāḥ ||68|| hantavyā eva nāstyatra doṣo dharma itisthitiḥ | vadhārhāstāḥ samastā vai kintvekā vihatāsu tu ||69|| dayā kṛtā na krauryaṃ taddharma eva na cetaraḥ | dharma eva hi tatrāsti duṣṭānāṃ māraṇaṃ tu yat ||3.194.70|| prāṇahānāṃ prāṇanāśo dharma eva yataḥ prajāḥ | strīvadho dūṣaṇaṃ nāsti pūtanāvadha eva saḥ ||71 || kṛtyāvadhe na vai doṣo dharma taṃ vai nibodhata | siṃhyā nāmyāṃ tathā vyādhyā vṛścikyāṃ na dayālutā |||72|| prāṇaghnāyāṃ tu rākṣasyāṃ tathā dayā na sammatā | ata eva na ghātinyāṃ dayā kāryā kvacijjanaiḥ ||73|| pravṛttāyāṃ prāṇanāśe dayā kāryā na sarvathā | aprāṇanāśe pravṛttāvupekṣā tatra yujyate ||74|| evaṃdharmo bhavatyeva tasmāt prajāgragāminaḥ | bhavanto yadbravantvatrābhicāriṇīvināśane ||75|| pāpaṃ vā yadi vā puṇyaṃ nobhayaṃ cobhayaṃ ca vā | śrutvaivaṃ te sabhāpūjyā ūcuścātīva dhārmikam ||76|| ātatāyivadhe doṣo na ghātinyā vadhena ca | abhicāraparāyāśca vadhe doṣo na vidyate ||77|| kintu nārīti prahatetyevaṃvādaviśuddhaye | viṣṇuyajñaḥ prakartavyaḥ sarvāpavādaśāntidaḥ ||78|| ityasmākaṃ mataṃ puṇye kārye rājā karotvidam | prajājanānāṃ vacanaṃ lakṣmi bhūpena mānitam ||79|| amātyena svīkṛtaṃ ca sabhāyāṃ sarvaśuddhaye | athādāya muhūrtaṃ sa śubhaṃ makhamakārayat ||3.194.80|| maṇḍapaṃ kuṇḍamutkṛṣṭaṃ devānāṃ sthāpanāni ca | pūjanāni ca dānāni bhojanāni ghṛtāni ca ||81 || dakṣiṇā vividhāścāpi havyāni samidhastathā | viṣṇave pūjanādīni kavyāni hyambarāṇi ca ||82|| annadhanāni yogyāni rājāmātyaprajā daduḥ | pūrṇāhutiṃ pracakruśca tadā nārāyaṇo hyaham ||8 3 || agacchaṃ śvapaco bhūtvā bhojanaṃ cārthayaṃ tataḥ | amātyaḥ pradadau bhojyaṃ dūrānme tu tadā rame ||84|| tadā bhuktaṃ mayā cānnaṃ paṃktipāvanakāriṇā | culukaṃ ca kṛtaṃ hastaprakṣālanaṃ tathā kṛtam ||85||| jalaṃ prapītaṃ yāvadvai tāvad rājñastu dehataḥ | kṛṣṇavarṇo dhūmra eva nirgatyāmātyago’bhavat ||8 6|| amātyadehataḥ kṛṣṇā nārī pāpā hi nirgatā | mṛtā sā yoginī hatyārūpā strī hyabhavaddhi sā ||87|| ākṛṣṭā śvapacenaiva śvapace sā tirohitā | agnidagdhā drutaṃ tasya śvapacasya tu mastakāt ||88 || vidyudrūpā prabhutvaiva śīghraṃ sā vyomagābhavat | astaud divyasvarūpā ca śrīpatiṃ māṃ ramāpatim ||89 || abhicārikanāryā me mokṣārthaṃ bhagavān bhavān | upasthito’sti yajñe’tra pūrtyarthaṃ nṛpayajñayoḥ || 3.194.90 || bhaktahastena yā hatyā sāpi mokṣāya jāyate | pāpāyā mama hatyāpi tvadyogena divaṃpradā || 91 || mokṣapradā bhavatyeva puṇyaṃ me jāyate’dhunā | harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa śrīpate parameśvara || 92|| bahucarāyāste śakteḥ sevikāṃ māṃ samuddhara | ityuktvā bhagavaddṛṣṭyā tūrṇaṃ sā svargatiṃ gatā ||9 3 || kālāntare harerbhaktyā vaikuṇṭhaṃ sā yayau satī | atha rājā kuṭumbaṃ cāmātyo’pi parameśvaram || 94|| māṃ vijñāya hariṃ cāpi pupūjuśca prajājanāḥ | tadahaṃ drāk caturbāhurbhūtvādhvare śubhāsane ||95 || niveśito niṣasāda prasādaṃ me dadau tadā | sarvebhyaḥ kaṇakārūpaṃ carūsthaṃ te’pi jagṛhuḥ || 96|| pāvanāste samastā vai jātāḥ sarve mamāgamāt | evaṃ hatyākalaṃkaṃ vai mayā vināśitaṃ tayoḥ ||97|| kāṇḍikānāmikāyā vai yoginyā mokṣaṇaṃ kṛtam | rājāmātyau varadānaiḥ svargārthaṃ mokṣaṇāya ca || 98 || āśīrvādairyojitau ca kuṭumbe cāpi vai tayoḥ | atha kālāntare svargavāsinau tau mayā kṛtau || 99 || mokṣabhājau tathā tasmāt kṛtau lakṣmi nṛpānugau | evaṃ yajñottaraṃ sarvaṃ kṛpayā kṛtavānaham || 3.194.100 || tiro’bhavaṃ tvadhvare cākaṣaryan tanmanāṃsyapi | sasmarurthe narā nāryo’pi taṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ yayuḥ || 101 || evaṃ mayā strīhatyāyāḥ pāpaṃ vināśitaṃ priye | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhetāpi pāṭhakaḥ śrāvako’sya ca || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne cakradharanṛpājñayā devaviśrāmākhyāmātyasya kāṇḍikāyoginīstrīhatyāyāḥ pāpasya yajñe śrīhariṇā nivṛttiḥ kṛtetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturnavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 194 ||
<3.195> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ pāpavināśinīm | saurāṣṭe māyūrapuryāṃ matsyāyāḥ saritastaṭe || 1 || mahodyāne tadudyānapālo mālī kuṭumbavān | harṣulākhyo harerbhakto dharmakarmaparāyaṇaḥ || 2 || snānapūjanadānāditatparo’bhūt svaśaktitaḥ | hrarṣulasyābhavat patnī nāmnā vidrumavallakī || 3 || sāpi bhaktābhavat kintvanapatyā śokaśālinī | oṣadhīnāṃ prayogaiśca tathā mantrādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ || 4 || bahudhā mānatābhiśca nābhūt sā garbhaśobhanā | nirāśā sā sannihitavārdhakyā tu yadābhavat || 5 || tadā patistadāśāṃ ca vihāyānyāṃ striyaṃ śubhām | ardhāvasthagatāṃ patnīṃ cākarod vidhirītitaḥ || 6 || sā tu garbhavatī jātā nāmnā tu citrapallavā | harṣulo harṣamāpanno bhāviputrasya cintanaiḥ || 7 || dānaṃ dharmaṃ vrataṃ puṇyaṃ karoti putravāñcchayā | satāṃ prapūjanaṃ cāpi satkāraṃ phalabhojanaiḥ || 8 || karoti sarvathā cābhyāgatānāmapi pūjanam | āśīrvādān pragṛhṇāti putrārthī śraddhayānvitaḥ || 9 || phalādikaṃ nijodyānād devālayāya nityadā | prāpayatyeva bhaktātmā sevate mandirādikam || 3.195.1 0|| vidrumavallakī yāvat tathaiva citrapallavā | patibhaktimatī cāpi pāpabhītiyutāpi ca ||1 1 || vidrumavallakī nityaṃ svāpamānaṃ hi nityadā | manute hyanapatyatvād vārdhakyāśca viśeṣataḥ || 12|| sagarbhā citrapallī tu mānamarhati sarvataḥ | sāpatnyaṃ hi mahadduḥkhaṃ vidrumāyā upasthitam || 13 || tatrāpi putravatyāśca sapatnyā duḥkhamulbaṇam | matvā nityaṃ cintayati garbhapāto bhavediti || 14|| kaṭutīkṣṇoṣṇabhāvāni bhojanāni navāni sā | kṛtvā svādayutānyeva garbhavatyai dadāti hi ||15|| tathāpi garbhapāto nābhavattataśca sā punaḥ | garbhapātauṣadhaṃ tasyai bhojane pradadātyapi ||16|| garbhapāto na vai jāto māsāḥ pūrṇāḥ prasūtaye | putrajanmābhavanmālī harṣulo harṣamāptavān || 17|| citrapallī prasannābhūcchuṣkā vidrumavallakī | harṣulo’pi yathāśakti dānaṃ dadau dvijātaye || 18|| phalapuṣpāmbarāyāṃ ca svarṇarūpyakamūlinām | godānaṃ bhojanaṃ cāpi dadau yogyāya sādhave || 1 9|| jātakarmādikaṃ cakre putravān premavihvalaḥ | udyāne tata āramya cābhyāgatasya vai kuṭīm ||3.195.20 || akaroddharṣulastatrāgataṃ cābhyāgataṃ tu saḥ | atithiṃ vā satīṃ sādhuṃ sevate’nnaphalādibhiḥ ||21|| satsaṃgaṃ prakarotyeva vārdhakye putralābhavān | modate kīrtanaṃ nityaṃ gāyatyapi harestathā ||22|| mūrtiṃ me phalapuṣpādyaiḥ pūjayatyeva bhāvataḥ | evaṃ putrasya varṣaṃ vai vyatītaṃ sarvathā śubham ||23|| vidrumavallakī ruṣṭā śokāturātidāhataḥ | vyacintayad viṣadānaṃ sutasyerṣyābhisaṃbhṛtā ||24|| viṣamūlaṃ khanitveyaṃ kṛtvā rasaṃ manāgapi | dugdhapāne dadau sā tu bālanāśāya pāpinī ||25|| atha śrībhagavām̐ścāhaṃ bhaktarakṣākaro yataḥ | sādhurūpadharastasyā mahīmāno’bhavaṃ tadā ||26|| harṣulasya gṛhe tatrodyāne’gacchaṃ yathātithiḥ | harṣulo māṃ madhuparkaistathā phalajalādibhiḥ ||27|| miṣṭaiḥ satkārayāmāsa śubhānnaiścāsanādibhiḥ | citrapallī prasannā ca siṣeve māṃ mudānvitā ||28|| vidrumavallikā tvekā jānāti dugdhapānake | viṣamūlarasaṃ dattaṃ tena bālo mariṣyati || 29|| sāpi prasannamanasā sādhusevāparābhavat | pratīkṣate kadā mṛtyurbhaved bālasya pāpinī ||3.195.30|| bālaḥ supto dugdhapānottaraṃ śāntyā tu tatprasūḥ | jānāti tena sādhoḥ sā sevāyāṃ ciramāvasat ||31 || bālo viṣapravegeṇa viprāṇaḥ samajāyata | paryaṃke hyava naivānye jānanti harimantarā || 32|| sarve vai sādhusevāyāṃ tatparāśca yadābhavan | nandā vidrumavallī sā yayau śaucārthamityapi || 33|| tatraikāṃ mṛtagodhāṃ sā gṛhītvā kalaśe tadā | putraparyaṃkapārśve tvānāyyākṣipaddhi bhūtale ||34|| athānye naiva jānīyustathākṣipaddhi sā śanaiḥ | atha daṇḍaṃ samagṛhyākrośaṃ vyadhād balādati ||35|| dhāvantu cātra dhāvantu godhādaṣṭaḥ sutastvayam | godheyaṃ daṇḍaghātaiśca tāḍyate’tra mayā pate |||36|| bhagini drutamāgaccha putro daṣṭo’nayā tviha | evaṃ godhāṃ mṛtāṃ cāpi yaṣṭyā sā tāḍayatyapi ||35||| vidadhāti mahākrośaṃ yathā śṛṇvanti cāpare | kolāhalaṃ paraṃ śrutvā mṛṣā taddrohanaṃ hyapi ||38|| sādhunā sahitāḥ sarve dhāvamānāḥ sutālayam | yayuḥ prāṇavaśā yadvacchrutvā dṛṣṭvā mṛtaṃ sutam ||39|| ruruduścāpi sarve te mātā tu kurarī yathā | vinā putraṃ yathā śokavatī tato’pi cādhikā ||3.195.40|| prāptaputravināśena śokamagnābhavat satī | pitāpi śokamāpanno ruroda muktakaṇṭhataḥ ||41|| udyāne pārśvatastatra bahavaḥ karṣukādayaḥ | samāyayurhi śokārttāḥ śrutvā putrasya daṃśanam ||42|| mṛtyuṃ vilokya sahasā śokasāgaramajjitāḥ | kapaṭe vartamānāṃ ca vedmi vidrumavallakīm ||43|| sāpi bhayaṃ gatā tatra sādhuścāyaṃ pratāpavān | yadi vetsyati garalaṃ dattaṃ vidrumavallayā ||44|| tadā me prāṇanāśaṃ vai patirme saṃkariṣyati | ityevaṃ bhayamāpannā sādhoḥ pādau pragṛhya sā ||45 || śanairmardanasaṃjñāṃ ca karotyathāpi saṃjñayā | aṃgulīspārśanabhāvairmama doṣo’yamityapi ||46|| vijñāpayati rakṣārthaṃ mā prakāśaṃ vidhehi ca | mayāpi sā tadoktā vai sādhurhitakaro’smyaham ||47|| sarveṣāṃ hitamevātra kariṣye pāpavarjitam | mā śokaṃ putramṛtyośca kurvantu sādhusevakāḥ ||48|| ahaṃ śokāpanodaṃ vai kartuṃ śakto’smi sarvathā | bālaṃ mṛtaṃ vidyayā ca sañjīvanyā sajīvitam ||49 || kartuṃ śakto’smi tasmādvai mā rudantu satāṃpriyāḥ | godhāṃ cāpi jīvayiṣye labhantāmatra vai sukham ||3.195.5 0|| ityuktvā sahasā cāhaṃ kṛtvā mama kare jalam | mantrayitvā mama nāmnā mṛtabālamukhe’dadām ||5 1 || jalasya sparśamātreṇa prāṇayukto’bhavaddhi saḥ | jīvitaḥ sahasā bālo nirviṣaḥ samajāyata ||5 2|| godhāpi jalasaṃsparśāt kṣiptāt sajīvanābhavat | atha sā māṃ namaskṛtya svargād vimānamāgatam ||53|| samāruhya yayau godhā devī bhūtvā divaṃ śubham | vilokyaitanmahāścaryaṃ harbulādyāḥ prabhuṃ ca mām ||94 | matvāśrayaṃ paraṃ cakrurbhaktiṃ mantra ca jagṛhuḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||95| bhejurmāṃ sarvabhāvena hyayācanta kṣamāṃ tadā | utsavaṃ paramaṃ cakruḥ sarve te sādhusannidhau ||96|| ahorātramahaṃ sādhurnāmnā sañjīvanāyanaḥ | uvāsa tadgṛhe ramye mahodyāne prasevitaḥ ||57|| harṣulaḥ sa siṣeve māṃ putrāyuṣyavivṛddhaye | mayā lakṣapravarṣāṇi jīvatviti vaco’rpitam ||58|| lakṣavarṣāṇi putro’pi nāmnā sañjīvanaḥ kṛtaḥ | āyuṣyaṃ prāptavānmattaḥ kṛpā bhakte hyanantikā ||59|| citravallī ca santuṣṭā siṣeve māṃ punaḥ punaḥ | dehamardanasevābhiḥ putrāyuṣyātiharṣiṇī ||3.195.60|| duṣṭā vidrumavallī cāpyardharātre gate tu mām | āgatyovāca rahasi māmuddhara kṛpāṃ kuru ||6 1|| bālahatyā mahatpāpaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā hi yoṣitā | īrṣyayā sāpatnyabhāvaiḥ kṣamasva mā bahiḥ kuru ||62|| aprakāśaṃ ca me pāpaṃ vināśaya jagatpate | ityuktvā pādasaṃvāhaṃ cakre sā dehamardanam ||63|| bhaktāyāścāpi pāpasya nāśārthaṃ vai dayā kṛtā | mayā divyasvarūpeṇa divyadṛṣṭyā vilokitā ||64|| spṛṣṭā dorbhyāṃ śarīre sā tāvattasyāḥ śarīrataḥ | bālahatyā mūrtimatī niṣkrāntā vepathubhṛtā ||65 || mayā sā jaladānena śīghraṃ dagdhā layaṃgatā | vidrumavallikā tūrṇaṃ nirbhayā samajāyata ||66|| lakṣmītyevaṃ mama bhaktā citrikā vidrumā tathā | harṣulastatsutaścāpi godhā samuddhṛtā hyaghāt ||67|| avitā rakṣitāścāpi poṣitāśca pratoṣitāḥ | atha prātaḥ samutthāya labdhvā satkārabhojanam ||68|| gantumicchāmi yāvadvai tāvadbhaktastu harṣulaḥ | papraccha kiṃ vidheyaṃ tvatkṛte kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa ||69|| upādideśa tasmai ca nārībhyāṃ cāpi tatra ha | satāṃ samāgamaḥ kāryaḥ sevanīyo haristathā ||3.195.70|| deśe kāle viparīte rakṣatyeva janārdanaḥ | anādiśrībālakṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’smyaham ||71|| rakṣāṃ karomi bhaktānāṃ kṣatau dharmasya vai kvacit | sadoṣasyāpi bhaktasya doṣaṃ te gaṇayāmyaham ||72|| satāṃ prasaṃgamāptasya mama māhātmyavedinaḥ | sarvathā sevakasyāpi doṣaṃ na gaṇayāmyaham ||73|| satāṃ prasaṃgāt puṇyaṃ vai jāyate pāpanāśanam | ataśca sarvadā kāryaḥ prasaṃgaḥ śrīhareḥ satām ||74|| avatārā mamāpyevaṃ smartavyā sarvadā janaiḥ | tallīlā janmabhūbhāgāḥ smartavyaḥ pāpanuttaye ||75|| dehāntasamaye yadvā vaiṣamye deśakālayoḥ | smaraṇaṃ tu sadādīnāṃ pāpahaṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet ||76|| īrṣyā naiva hi kartavyā parotkarṣāsahiṣṇunā | hiṃsā pāpaṃ bhavet sarvamirṣyayā nindanaṃ mṛtiḥ ||77|| tato yāmyapradeśānāṃ yātrāpi duḥkhadāyinī | tasmādbhaktaiśca bhaktābhirirṣyā tyājyā prayatnataḥ ||78|| kāryā prasannatā nityaṃ paro karṣe sukhapradā | prasanno’haṃ bhavāmyeva paropakārakartari ||79|| sāpatnyaṃ sukhadaṃ neyaṃ netavyaṃ sukhadaṃ tathā | patyuḥ priyaṃ prakartavyaṃ tenāhaṃ tuṣṭa eva ha ||3.195.80|| tasmādbhaktimatā bhaktimatyā tyājyaḥ sa durguṇaḥ | dhyātavyā mama mūrtiśca rādhālakṣmyādisevitā ||81|| dhyāyamānā na dṛśyeta tathāpi śraddhayā muhuḥ | dhyātavyā hṛdye nityaṃ kṛpāṃ karomi taṃ prati ||82|| vaśyo bhavāmi tasyaiva yatheṣṭaṃ pradadāmi ca | vivekaḥ sa tu mantavyo bhaktānāṃ guṇadarśanam ||83|| svasminnaguṇavīkṣā ca guṇagrāhitvamipyapi | sādhunā hariṇā proktaṃ grahītavyaṃ hitaṃ tu tat ||84|| evamājñāṃkito bhaktaḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ mahatīṃ labhet | śrīhareśca satāṃ sevāparā indriyavṛttayaḥ ||85 || varteran yasya tasyāśu prasannatā harerbhavet | tasya tattvāni sarvāṇi śrīhareḥ samprasaṃgataḥ ||86|| pavitrāṇi prajāyante naśyantyaghādikoṭayaḥ | mama bhaktiḥ puṣṭimeti tataḥ prāpnoti vāñcchitam ||87|| tasmād yojyānīndriyāṇi śrīkṛṣṇe mayi satsu ca | sādhusaṃgaḥ sadā kāryaḥ pāvitryamuktisiddhaye ||88|| kusaṃgo naiva kartavyo hiṃsādrohātmakaḥ kvacit | nindā naiva prakartavyā vīkṣya dehakriyāṃ satām ||89|| tena dṛṣṭirbhaved divyā kṛṣṇe prītiśca vardhate | satsu sneho vardhate ca puṇyaṃ mokṣaṃ ca vindati ||3.195.90|| sākṣājjāte hareryoge hyapūrṇatāṃ na cintayet | narākṛtau dṛḍhaniṣṭhā mayi kāryā hi gocare ||91 || maddarśanādinātmā vai mantavyaḥ pūrṇakāmanaḥ | mama prasaṃgaḥ kartavyaḥ sarvathā bhaktivṛddhaye ||92|| evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya pūrayāmi manorathān | alaukikaṃ nijaiśvaryaṃ balāddadāmyanicchate ||93|| ataḥ pratyakṣamāsādya kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ patiṃ prabhum | sevayitvā puruṣārthāḥ sādhanīyāstato hareḥ ||94|| rāgadveṣakṣayo yāvanna syānno vāsanākṣayaḥ | tāvadekāntabhaktatvaṃ na syānme paramātmanaḥ ||95|| indriyāṇāṃ pravegeṇa sukhecchā vartate tu yā | sā sadā nāśayitavyā śrīkṛṣṇe vai samarpaṇāt ||96|| kṛtvā prasaṃgaṃ mahatāṃ hantavyā vāsanā khalu | kṛṣṇetarapadārthecchā naṣṭā yayā prajāyate ||017|| brahmarūpaḥ sa vai bhaktastamahaṃ saṃvṛṇomi vai | aikāntikaḥ sa me bhakto’saṃkhyadehipramokṣakṛt ||98|| antaryāmitayā cāhaṃ sarvecchāpūrako’smi ca | sarvakarmaphalādīnāṃ dātāhaṃ sampadāmapi || 99|| yasmāddehādyadutpattiryatkarmotthā tu nirmitā | taṃ tu tasmāccharīrāddhi samutpādya ca sañcitam || 3.195.100 || tasyaiva pūrvataścāptaṃ yathākālaṃ dadāmyaham | matsevāyāḥ phalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dadāmi cātirekyapi || 101 || tataḥ śraddhāyuktajanaiḥ sevā kāryā sadā mama | pūrayāmi tadabhīṣṭaṃ prārabdhavarjitaṃ hyapi || 1 0.|| āpadyapi satāṃ sevā kartavyā tu yathā mama | kalpalatāsamā sāsti śubhā sarveṣṭapūrikā || 1 03|| kalatraputravittāderadhikaṃ sevanaṃ mama | patyuḥ patnyāstathā pitroḥ sevanaṃ hyadhikaṃ mama || 1 04|| sevayā me sukhaṃ sarvaṃ dehe’tra yāti dehavān | prāpnoti mama dhāmāpi dehānte cākṣaraṃ param || 105 || ājīvanaṃ matiryasya yādṛśī mayi jāyate | gatimāpnoti cānte tāṃ tathārūpāṃ dadāmyaham || 10 6|| sākṣātprāptirmama yasya sevā sākṣāt kṛtā yayā | tasmai tasyai dadāmyeva gatiṃ parāṃ madāśrayām || 1 07|| sarvathā rakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ yamādibhyaḥ karomyaham | nāpamṛtyubhayaṃ tasya kālakarmabhayaṃ na vai || 1 08|| jaganniyantuḥ kṛṣṇasya mama bhakto hi nirbhayaḥ | taṃ nayāmi prasannaḥ san mama dhāmākṣarābhidham ||1 09|| dehānte mama bhakto vai yāti me dhāma sarvathā | smṛtyā vā mūrchayā vāpi pīḍayā vā prayātyapi ||3.195.1 10 || hareḥ satāṃ tu samprāptyā jñātavyaṃ śreya eva ha | śreyastasya paraṃ syāddhi loke’trāpi paratra ca || 111 || ato bhaktiḥ prakartavyā mamaiva ca satāmapi | hitvā snehaṃ madanyasmin bhaktatvaṃ durlabhaṃ yataḥ || 112|| bhaktasya lakṣaṇaṃ dāsyaṃ hitvā cāpyātmanaḥ priyam | kartavyaṃ svāmino nityaṃ priyaṃ rucyanusāri ca || 11 3|| anuvṛttiḥ pālanīyā bhuktimuktipradāyinī | evaṃ bhajantu māṃ bhaktā dāsye sarvaṃ nijepsitam ||1 14|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne harṣulākhyabhaktasya pūrvayā bhāryayā dvitīyapatnījanyaputrasya nāśe bhagavatā sādhurūpeṇa putrojjīvanaṃ bālahatyāpāpanāśanaṃ kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 195 ||
<3.196> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca evaṃ nārāyaṇīśri vai tadā mayā śubhāvaham | upadiṣṭaṃ mokṣadaṃ tatstrībhyāṃ ca harṣulāya ca || 1 || athāpi vidrumavallī vṛddhāpatyādivarjitā | māṃ papracchā harekṛṣṇa yathā putravatī tvaham || 2 || bhavāmyapi tathā kānta kṛpāṃ vidhehi vai mayi | ahaṃ tasyāstu bhaktāyā bhāgyaṃ prārthanayā tathā || 3 || sevayā ca navaṃ tatrākaravaṃ putradaṃ śubham | tathāstvevaṃ mayoktā sā prasannā samajāyata || 4 || upadeśo mayā tebhyaḥ punardatto’tiśodhanaḥ | bhaktiryasya bhavet kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe mayi prabhau || 5 || pratyakṣe tasya varteta kāryaṃ kṛṣṇavaco’niśam | kṛṣṇabhaktā vadeyuryat kāryaṃ tadapi satvaram || 6 || evaṃvidhābhilāṣī ca pratīkṣeta harervacaḥ | tathāmūrtiṃ mama citte dhārayedvai nirantaram || 7 || nityaṃ navanavaśraddho dhārayenna samutsṛjet | manyeta pūrṇakāmaṃ ca mama dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 8 || ciraṃ dhyāyanmaya mūrti tato yāti parāṃ gatim | sādhusevāṃ prakuryādvā tathā yāti paraṃ padam || 9 || sādhūnāṃ ca guṇāneva gṛhṇīyād durguṇām̐styajan | nnākṛtau parameśe ca sādhau cāpi guṇānnayet || 3.196.10 || satāṃ prasannatāhetuṃ sadācāraṃ caret sadā | ācāre vacane kārye satāṃ yoge prasevane || 1 1|| saṃśayaṃ naiva kurvīta kusaṃgaḥ saṃśayo hyataḥ | viśvāsena prakurvīta satāṃ ceṣṭaṃ harestathā || 1 2|| tadeva muktidaṃ syādvai niḥsaṃśayo jayaṃ vrajet | adhamoddhārakaścāhamuddharāmi madāśritam || 1 3|| sotsāhena tu sevāyāṃ vartitavyaṃ satāṃ hareḥ | sotsāhānāṃ sevakānāṃ naivāsādhyaṃ hi kiñcana || 14|| nānāvidhapadārthānāṃ prāptirmatprāptito bhavet | matsukhena sadānandavanto bhavanti macchritāḥ || 15|| antarā māṃ padārthānāṃ tyāgaṃ karoti sarvathā | sarvadā māṃ bhajate yaḥ sa muktaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ || 1 6|| nijendriyāṇāṃ vyāpārā arpaṇīyā parātmani | tadā divyakriyāḥ sarvā bhavanti matparāyaṇāḥ || 17|| vartate tasya tṛptiśca sākṣāt kṛṣṇasya yogataḥ | sākṣāddharestu saṃyogastathā brahmadaśā nijā || 18|| yasyāsti tasya kartavyaśeṣo nāsti pramuktaye | jñānendriyāṇi sarvāṇi yadgṛhṇanti nijādanam || 1 9|| adanaṃ taddhariḥ sākṣāddharerguṇāśca śāśvatāḥ | evaṃ karmakarāṇāṃ cendriyāṇāṃ viṣayo hariḥ ||3.196.20|| bhaved yasya tu tasyātrānando bhaveddhi śāśvataḥ | divyaguṇādisaṃprāptau sarvaṃ kṛṣṇamayaṃ bhavet || 21 || evamatraiva kartavyaṃ bhavitavyaṃ tathā sadā | rūpaṃ satāṃ hareścāpi rasaḥ satāṃ harestathā || 22|| gandhaḥ satāṃ hareścāpi śabdaḥ satāṃ harestathā | sparśaḥ satāṃ hareścāpi śuddhikṛnmokṣakṛt sadā ||23|| satāṃ harerdarśanaṃ ca sparśanaṃ dehasevanam | pādasammardanaṃ cāpi pāvanaṃ śodhakaṃ sadā ||24|| satāṃ harergṛhe vāsastadājñāpālanaṃ tathā | asaṃśayastadācāre pāvano mokṣadaḥ sadā ||25|| bhoktavyaṃ bhogyamevārpya śrīkṛṣṇe nānyathā kvacit | kṛṣṇāya kṛṣṇamūrtyātmasatpuruṣāya vārpayet ||26|| arpitaṃ divyatāṃ yāti tadbhoktā mokṣago bhavet | hareryogānnirguṇaṃ tattadbhoktā nirguṇo bhavet ||27||| sadyo’ntaḥkaraṇaṃ śuddhaṃ karoti nirguṇaṃ hi tat | bandhanaṃ naiva jāyeta nirguṇasyopabhogataḥ ||28|| evaṃ vijñāya pañcāpi tathānye viṣayā api | sevyāḥ śuddhikarā divyā prasādarūpiṇaḥ sadā ||29|| anarpitā na vai sevyāḥ parihāryā hi dūrataḥ | evaṃ vai vartamānānāṃ vikṣepo naiva jāyate ||3.196.3 0 || bandhanaṃ na bhaveccāpi puṇyā muktiḥ kare sthitā | śuddhyanti sarvakāmāśca siddhyanti kāmitāḥ sadā ||31 || mama vāsaḥ sadā tasyāntare bhavati saukhyadaḥ | evaṃ vivicya kartavyaḥ satāṃ saṃgo harestathā ||32|| satsaṃgaḥ sarvadā kāryo niḥśreyasaprado hi saḥ | nāsti tādṛk padārtho vā vastu yanmama yogataḥ ||33| nopeyād divyabhāvaṃ vā mokṣadaṃ na bhavediti | sarvaṃ pavitraṃ madyogācchreṣṭhaṃ nikṛṣṭamityapi ||34|| evaṃ jñātvārpaṇīyaṃ me sarvaṃ varṣma ca daihikam | evaṃ śaraṇamāptasyāpyahaṃ tasya bhavāmi hi ||25||| brahmātmaniṣṭhāyuktasya gurudharmayutasya ca | rāgaśūnyasya sarvatra snehayuktasya vai mayi ||36|| mama māhātmyavijñasya mama prasādaśevadheḥ | mamaiśvaryaṃ samastaṃ vai dhāmni tasya bhavatyapi || 37|| mama prasannatālabhyamaiśvaryaṃ tena cārjyate | satāṃ samāgamānnityaṃ siddhadharmaṃ samālabhet || 38|| muktidaḥ siddhadharmo vai tamarjayet satāṃ śrayāt | sādhyadharmo hariścāhaṃ prāpyo bhavāmi siddhataḥ ||39|| yasya sākṣāddhareḥ prāptiḥ sākṣād yogaḥ prasevanam | sarvadā darśanaṃ cāsti tathāpi māyikaṃ sukham ||3.196.40|| yadi vāñcchati tasyātmā na tṛpto nirayābhigaḥ | sa eva jñānahīno vai bodhyo yo na tṛṣāṃ tyajet ||41|| sadasadbodhamāsādya māyāsukhaṃ tatastyajet | ātmasukhaṃ parityajya māyāsukhe pramodate |||42||| tasya śāśvatakāryāṇi naiva siddhyanti kānyapi | ātmasthasya harerme ca sukhaṃ bhuṃkte tu yo janaḥ ||43|| sa eva vidvān muktātmā bhaktātmā sarvato’dhikaḥ | upāsanābalenāyaṃ jāyate hi narāyaṇaḥ ||44|| nārī nārāyaṇī syācca rādhā lakṣmīryathā ramā | satsamāgamamāptasya nijātmaparamātmanoḥ ||45|| sākṣād vai darśanaṃ divyaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | satsaṃgo vidyate yasya tasya cātmapradarśane ||46|| paramātmadarśane’pi svātantryaṃ kṛpayā bhavet | ātmadarśanayatnodyoginaḥ satsaṃgavartinaḥ ||47|| mama pratāpamālambya cāntardṛṣṭiṃ vidhāya ca | vīkṣate svasvarūpaṃ ced bhāsvadbhāsuramīkṣate ||48|| ātmaprakāśe vimale sākṣānmāṃ parameśvaram | vīkṣate bālakṛṣṇaṃ vai śāśvatānandavān bhavet ||49|| bhaktā tvaikāntikī yā ca nārī vāpi naro’pi vā | madarthakṛtasarvasvā māṃ prayāti pare pade ||3.196.50|| kriyāsu kriyamāṇāsu sarvāsvapi hariḥ svayam | cintanīyo dhāraṇīyo yathādṛṣṭo yathāśrutaḥ ||51 || bhojanīyaḥ sevanīyo rañjanīyo haristvaham | tena bhaktāḥ prayāntyeva brahmadhāmākṣaraṃ param ||52|| śāntacitte vīkṣaṇīyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo’ntardṛśā ciram | sarvānandāḥ prāpaṇīyā mama mūrtestadātmataḥ ||53|| jīvo’yaṃ dehināṃ dehe saṃsāre’pārasāgare | caturaśītilakṣeṣu deheṣu khaniyogiṣu |||54|| utpanno bahuvāraṃ vai strī vā pumān punaḥ punaḥ | narā bhuktāstathā nāryo bhuktāścānena vai muhuḥ ||55|| pītāni sarvadugdhāni garbhakuṭyo vilokitāḥ | maraṇaṃ jananaṃ cāpi dṛṣṭaṃ punaḥ punastathā |||56|| ahantā mamatā cāpi dehe daihikavastuṣu | kṛtāpi bahudhā yatra dehe sthitimavāptavān ||57|| vismṛtāni samastāni pūrvavarṣmāṇi tāni vai | idaṃ janmāntare prāpte vismaryate tathaiva ha ||58|| tadidaṃ cātra dehe vai saṃgastyājyo yathocitaḥ | ahantā mamatā tyājyā jñānena pūrvage yathā ||59|| vivekena viṣayeṣvāsaktiṃ tyaktvā harau mayi | sajjeta dehavān yaḥ sa mukto bhavati macchrayāt ||3.196.60|| muktyarthaṃ ca vivekārthaṃ māhātmyārthaṃ mamāpi ca | sevyāḥ santaḥ sadā pūtāḥ pāvanā matsyarūpiṇaḥ ||61 || sevayā ca tataḥ prāpyaikāntikatvaṃ ca divyatām | dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ prāpyākṣarasādharmyayogataḥ ||62|| sevante koṭiśo muktā yathā māṃ sevate tvayam | tanmuktapaṃktau sthātavyamityevaṃ māṃ prasevayet ||63|| sukhaṃ cānyat samagraṃ tu tucchaṃ ca kṣaṇikaṃ tathā | vicāryaikāntabhaktiṃ me kuryād rahasyavedinīm ||64|| alobhi svamanaḥ kāryaṃ māyike viṣaye tviha | yenātra ramyarūpādau lobho naiva prajāyate ||65|| tadbalena harerdhāma pratiyāne’pi mārgagāḥ | āyānti siddhayastāsu lobhaścāsya na vai bhavet ||66|| paraṃ pāraṃ prakṛteḥ sa prayātyeva mamāśritaḥ | ananyacetā bhūtvaiva bhuṃkte matsukhamūrjitam ||67|| yasya kriyāsu sarvāsu mama mūrtismṛtirbhavet | tasyaiva sthiratā syādvai sarvathā svāminī prabhau ||68|| yadyatsukhepsā yasya syāt tattat sukhaṃ madagrataḥ | grahaṇīyaṃ nānyatastu sarvaṃ dadāmi tasya vai ||69|| mama rājyaṃ bhaktarājyaṃ bhedastatra na vidyate | tasmād rājñyā sadā bhāvyaṃ na bhāvyaṃ veśyayā kvacit ||3.196.70|| ityevaṃ tu mayā lakṣmi hyupadiṣṭaṃ tataśca te | pupūjurmāṃ paramayā bhaktyā va snehārdramānasāḥ ||71 || phalānyuttamajātīni bhojayāmāsurutsukāḥ | athāpi sādhurūpaṃ māṃ prasādayitumutsukāḥ ||72|| sevayituṃ samutsāhā uṣituṃ cakrurāgraham | athāha sādhurūpo vai teṣāmāgrahatastadā ||73 || uṣituṃ ca divārātramadhikaṃ svīcakāra ha | divase tūṣṇavārbhiste snāpayāmāsurādarāt ||74|| puṣpāṇāṃ bahubhirhāraiḥ puṣpanirmitabhūṣaṇaiḥ | puṣpavastraiḥ puṣpaśṛṃgārakairarhaṇamādadhuḥ ||75|| mukuṭaḥ pītapuṣpāṇāṃ kaṭake cāṃgade tathā | vibhūṣāḥ pītapuṣpāṇāṃ kṛtāstaiśca dhṛtā mayā ||76|| ambarāṇi samastāni saptarūpasumāni vai | sugandhīni vicitrāṇi dhṛtāni ca mayā tadā ||77|| dolā kadambavṛkṣasya śākhāyāṃ rajjubhiḥ kṛtā | baddhā supallavapuṣpatoraṇādyairvibhūṣitā ||78|| niṣādya māṃ tu dolāyāṃ trayaste bhāvagarbhitāḥ | āndolayāmāsuriṣṭaṃ svāminaṃ prāṇarakṣakam ||79|| pāyayāmāsurikṣūṇāṃ rasaṃ nāraṃgiṇāṃ tathā | nālīkerajalaṃ cāpi miṣṭavāri sugandhi ca ||3.196.80|| rātrau vādyaviśeṣaiśca kīrtanaṃ cakrurutsukāḥ | sahasraśo janāstatrāyayurdarśanakāṃkṣiṇaḥ ||8 1 || pāvanāste tato jātā darśanasparśanādibhiḥ | prasādagrahaṇaiścāpi yayuste tu nijālayān ||82|| harṣulaścāpi tatpatnyau siṣevire ca māṃ niśi | sarvārpaṇena nirdoṣabuddhyā divyaprasevanaiḥ ||83|| atha yā śreṣṭhabhāryā sā nāmnā vidrumavallakī | sarvasuptyuttaraṃ cārdharātrottaraṃ rahaḥ svayam ||84|| pracchannaikākinī tatrāgatya māṃ parameśvaram | dehasammardanenaiva siṣeve putrakāminī ||85|| śanakairmama karṇe sā kṛtvānanaṃ ca maunavat | arthayāmāsa bhagavana putraṃ me dehi keśava ||86|| prasanno’haṃ sevayā ca bhaktāyāḥ sarvathā hariḥ | tathāstviti mayā spṛṣṭā putravatī bhaveti ca ||87|| samudghāṭitabhāgyā sā prasannā bahudhābhavat | yatheṣṭaṃ sevayāmāsa māṃ tato’dhikabhāvanā ||88|| supto’haṃ sā ca patyuśca sevāyāṃ pragatā tadā | landhamanorathā jātā sagarbhā śobhanā tathā ||89|| atha prāpte tu samaye suṣuve bālakaṃ śubham | putraṃ samujjvalaṃ tvekaṃ harṣulo harṣamāpa ha ||3.196.90 || vidrumavallakī tvevaṃ labdhvā putraṃ tataḥ param | mānapātraṃ sadā jātā sarvasaubhāgyasundarī ||91 || evaṃ lakṣmi mayā bhaktā tāritā sevayā tadā | prasannena mayā sāpi tāritā bālahatyayā ||92|| bālaścojjīvitaścāpi sevāpi svīkṛtā tathā | evameva hi bhaktānāṃ karomi rakṣaṇaṃ sadā ||93|| jīvāstu dehasaṃyuktā yāvantaḥ santi tāvatā | sadoṣā eva vartante kintu bhaktyā taranti te ||94|| bhaktyāhaṃ tārayāmyetān pāpām̐ścāpi narān drutam | athāhaṃ gantukāmaśca pūjito vanditaśca taiḥ ||95|| sādhuveṣeṇa sahasā cāntarhito’bhavaṃ kṣaṇāt | harṣulādyā yathādṛṣṭaṃ dhyāne sasmaruranvaham ||96|| bhaktiṃ cakrurbhāvataste sādhusevāṃ ca cakrire | bhuktvā bhogāṃśca vipulām yayuste svargamuttamam ||97|| svargāt svargottaraṃ prāpya mama dhāmākṣaraṃ yayuḥ | evaṃ niṣkāmasevābhiryānti brahma nirāmayam ||98|| sevayā labhyate putraḥ sevayā labhyate sukham | sevayā labhyate cāpyabhayaṃ niṣpāpatā tathā ||99|| sevayā bhogakoṭyaśca sevayā śāśvataṃ sukham | sevayā śrīhariścāhaṃ prāpyaḥ pūrṇeṣṭasampradaḥ || 3.196.1 00|| bhaktyā bhaktān tārayāmi gṛhṇāmi sevayā tataḥ | tādātmyenānandayāmi sarvaṃ dadāmi tatparam || 101 || paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇāt sevanāttathā | bhuktirmuktirbhavedeva smṛddhiśca śāśvatīrbhavet || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne harṣulākhyabhaktasyodyāne śrīharerupadeśo harṣulasya jyeṣṭhapatnyā api putralābhaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṇṇavatyadhikaśatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||196 ||
<3.197> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ pitṛhaṇaḥ kathāṃ tathā | saurāṣṭre karṣuko bhakto vṛddho’bhavat kuṭumbavān || 1 || koṭināranagarasyābhyāśe grāme paṭolake | nāmnā śāṇadharaśceti pañcaputraprapautravān || 2 || saptaputrīpitā cāpi vāṭikākṣetragodhanaḥ | bhajate śrīhariṃ māṃ ca nityaṃ kṛṣeśca karmasu || 3 || yadutpannaṃ bhaved sarvaṃ mahyaṃ nivedya vai tataḥ | bhuṅkte kuṭumbasahito navānnādīni yānyapi || 4 || śākapatrāṇi sarvāṇi pakvāpakvakaṇām̐stathā | kandamūlādi yadyogyaṃ bhājīpallavasatphalam || |9 || bhūṣāmbarādikaṃ dugdhadadhigūḍarasādikam | yadyat prāpnoti yatnena mahyaṃ samarpya sarvathā || 6 || bhuṃkte yānaṃ vāhanaṃ ca tathopakaraṇānyapi | nityaṃ nivedya mahyaṃ ca jalānnamapi sarvathā || 7 || gṛhṇātyeveti bhakto me śraddhābhaktiparāyaṇaḥ | mūlakṛṣṇapurītīrthaṃ prācīsārasvataṃ tathā || 8 || somanāthamahātīrthaṃ gopanāthāditīrthakam | svarṇarekhānadītīrthaṃ tathā kuṃkumavāpikām || 9 || prayātyeva pragacchan vai bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaḥ | evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya pūrvakarmakṛtaṃ tu yat || 3.197.1 0|| janmāntare ca tatprāptametajjanmani colbaṇam | pūrvamāsīt sa gopālo gorakṣātatparaḥ sadā || 11 || tadā tu vṛṣadaṃśān sa pragṛhya govṛṣāt tataḥ | pakṣau vicchidya sarvān govṛṣadaṃśān vipakṣakān || 11|| kṛtvā kṣipati bhūmau vai daṃśāste pakṣavarjitāḥ | bhūtale patitāḥ sarve kṣudhātṛṣārditāstathā || 1 3|| mriyante cātiduḥkhena śāpaṃ datvā punaḥ punaḥ | hastahīnān naḥ kuruṣe tathā tvaṃ bhava duḥkhitaḥ || 14|| daṃśānāṃ mriyamāṇānāṃ pratyahaṃ śāpakāraṇāt | atra janmani tasyāpi śāṇadharasya hastayoḥ || 15|| pādayoścāpi sarvāṃguṣṭhāṃgulīṣu gado mahān | galatkuṣṭhātmako jāto durgandhasrāvavāhakṛt || 16|| oṣadhāni kṛtānyeva vaidyānāṃ subahūnyapi | galatsrāvo na vai naṣṭo roganāśo manāṅ na ca || 17|| mānatā api devānāṃ bahudhā ca kṛtāstathā | dānapuṇyādikaṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ tu bahudhā muhuḥ || 18|| gadastathāpi vavṛdhe nakhā naṣṭāḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | aṃgulyagrāṇi naṣṭāni madhyabhāgā galanti ca ||1 9|| āmūlaṃ galitāḥ sarvāṅgulikāṃguṣṭhakāstataḥ | pūrvakarmānurodhena paraṃ duḥkhamavāpa saḥ ||3.197.20|| putrādyairvāṭikākṣetre ghāsagṛhaṃ vidhāya ca | tatra pitā sukhaṭvāyāṃ rakṣitaḥ sarvadā rame ||21 || ghṛṣṭvā ghṛṣṭvā nitambau sa prayāti pārśvabhūmiṣu | malaṃ ca kurute tatra mūtraṃ ca kurute’bhitaḥ ||22|| thūtkāraṃ cāpi kurute pārśve kaścinna gacchati | parito’tīva durgandhā bhūmirjātā ca tadgṛham ||23|| durgandhamalayuktaṃ ca makṣikākākavāsitam | evaṃvidhāya vṛddhāya putrāstu bhojanaṃ sadā || 24|| dūrāt kṣipanti salilaṃ dūrād dadatyabhāvitāḥ | makṣikāṇāṃ pakṣahīṇīkṛtānāṃ kramaśaḥ phalam ||29|| bhuṃkte śāpadharo vṛddho jīvo dehāt prayāti na | nirayaṃ ceha dehe’syāgataṃ bhogāya dāruṇam ||26|| mārjyate naiva kenāpi cikitsitaṃ tu vardhate | hastapādaphaṇāścāpi galatkuṣṭhena khāditāḥ || 27|| prakoṣṭhaprāntamāptaśca gado’pi vegavānati | lakṣmi cārājanā loke pakṣijantusarīsṛpān || 28|| paśūn kīṭān mārayanti kumṛtyunā hyaghaṃ mahat | unduruṃ nakulaṃ godhāṃ caṭakāṃ maṇḍūkaṃ ca vā ||29|| tatphalaṃ krūramevātra labhante sarvanāśakṛt | apatyāni ca jantūnāṃ mārayanti tathābudhāḥ ||3.197.30|| vṛthā niraparādhān vai śāpasteṣāṃ prajāyate | vāhanānāmaśvavṛṣagajoṣṭrāṇāṃ vṛthā hyapi ||31 || pravṛttānāṃ svakārye’pi kurvanti tāḍanaṃ muhuḥ | teṣāṃ śāpena sarvasvaṃ naśyati svāminaḥ sukham ||32|| nāryastvajñaiḥ pratāḍyante bālaiśca śvāna ityapi | teṣāṃ tāsāṃ praśāpena dagdhā bhavanti tāḍakāḥ || 33|| rogiṇaścāpi dīnāśca jalānnavarjitā api | daridrā dravyahīnāśca gṛhasampadvihīnakāḥ ||34|| kṛtaṃ karma ciraṃ vādyopatiṣṭhatyeva sarvathā | evamasya kṛtaṃ karma samupapannamulbaṇam |||35||| mriyate nātiduḥkhe’pi putrādyā bhagnamānasāḥ | kuṭumbaṃ bhagnavāñcchaṃ ca hatāśaṃ samajāyata ||36|| bhagnaśraddhāstataḥ putrā mantraṇāṃ sapracakrire | mriyate na pitā rugṇo vāṭikā rogavāyunā ||37|| rugṇasasyānnarūpā ca jātā rugṇasya vāsataḥ | galatpittasrāvakuṣṭhī mriyeta cecchubhaṃ bhavet || 38|| pūrveṣāṃ cāsya pāpānāṃ bāhulyānmaraṇaṃ na vai | samāyāti na rogo’pi śānto bhavati vardhate ||39|| kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ hyupāyo bhāsate na vai | athāpi hiṃsanaṃ kāryaṃ pituḥ putrairaśobhanam ||3.197.40|| mārayitavya evātra kṣeptavyo’nyatra gartake | jale pravāhaṇīyo vā jīvan piteti vaiśasam ||41|| rakṣaṇaṃ yujyate nātra kiṃ kāryaṃ duḥsahe vrate | ityevaṃ pañcaputrāṇāṃ vicāraḥ sampravartate ||42|| kanīyām̐statra sahasā dharmasnehayuto yataḥ | pitṛsevāphalaṃ jānan bhrātṛmadhye hyuvāca ha ||43||| pitā nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt pitā brahmā tathāparaḥ | pitṛtīrthaṃ paraṃ proktaṃ pitā sevyo hi vaṃśajaiḥ ||44|| putrāṇāṃ pitṛsevāyāḥ phalaṃ svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam | tasmāt prasevanīyaśca rugṇo durvṛtta ityapi ||45|| dvitīyo’pi tataḥ prāha śrutvā kanīyaso vacaḥ | yogyaṃ tvayoktaṃ śubhadaṃ kintu svāsthye suvartite ||46|| maraṇādadhikaṃ cāsya duḥkhamatra vilokyate | tasmāt sevā duḥkhadāsya sarvasvarogavardhinī ||47|| yo’sya sevāparaḥ syādvai tasya rogo bhavedapi | saṃkramaṇādijātīyo gado’yaṃ parasaṃkramaḥ ||48|| tasmāt sevāsya yogyāpi sarvārogyavināśinī | duṣṭaphalā bhavet tasmāttāṃ sevāṃ nānumodaye ||49|| tṛtīyastu tataḥ prāha sevāyāṃ tvaparaṃ janam | bhṛtyaṃ vā bhṛtyikāṃ nityaṃ yojayāmaḥ suvetanām |||3.197.50|| caturthaḥ prāha yogyaṃ tattathāpi pramadā naraḥ | kaścidapi na cāpyeta sevākṛd vetanairapi ||51|| tadā kartavyamevātra kiṃ bhavettad vicāryatām | pañcamaḥ prāha vai śreṣṭhastadā tu jīvanaḥ pituḥ ||52|| pravāhaṇaṃ tīrthajale nadyāṃ vā sāgare’pi vā | bhṛgupātā vividhā vai śāstreṣu darśitā yathā ||53|| parvatāt patanaṃ vahnau jvalanaṃ vārigāhanam | bhūmigarte śayanaṃ vānaśanaṃ tīrthabhūmiṣu ||54|| asādhyarogiṇāṃ virāgiṇāṃ ca nyāsināṃ tathā | svargecchūnāṃ bhagupātāstādṛśā iṣṭasiddhidāḥ ||55|| antataḥ khalu kartavyaṃ pitṛrbhṛguprapātanam | yadi bhṛtyo milennaiva na ca seveta vetanaiḥ |||56|| evaṃ vicārya pañcaite kanīyāṃsaṃ nyayojayat | sevāyāṃ kintu ghṛṇayā vimanāḥ sa vyajāyata ||57|| vītaśraddho’bhavaccāpi bhṛtyaṃ nyayojayattataḥ | bhṛtyāśca bahavo jātā dinaṃ vā dvidinaṃ ca vā ||58|| kecit pañcadinaṃ bhṛtyāścānye’rdhadinamātrakam | ghṛṇānvitā na kurvanti sevanaṃ te prayānti hi ||59|| evaṃ bhṛtyānabhilābhe putrāste pañca sammatāḥ | parvatāt pātanaṃ tvasya rocate’smai vidhīyatām ||3.197.60 || pṛṣṭaḥ pitāpi śrutvaiva netyuvācātirāgavān | vahnau prajvalanaṃ pṛṣṭastathāpi netyuvāca tān ||61 || galapāśaṃ pratipṛṣṭastathāpi netyuvāca tān | dehāhaṃbhāvayukto’yaṃ maraṇaṃ svīkaroti na ||62|| bhūgarte kṣepaṇaṃ pṛṣṭastathāpi netyuvāca tān | maraṇaṃ rocate nāsya saritpravāhaṇaṃ na ca ||63|| jīvanaṃ rocate tvasya rugṇadehasya vai pituḥ | atinikṛṣṭadehe’pi tasya jīvātmanastviha ||64|| nityāśrayatvaṃ snehaśca tādātmyaṃ vai paśoriva | manuṣyasyāpi devasya jñānino’pi pravartate ||65|| ajñānināṃ viśeṣeṇa kimāścaryaṃ hi saṃsṛtau | evaṃ pitāpi rugṇe svadehe vṛddhe galaddrave ||66|| tādātmyaṃ samabhiprāptastyaktuṃ notsahate sma vai | prāha putrān dīnavacca nāhaṃ martuṃ samutsahe ||67|| yathā me dīyate tvannaṃ jalaṃ ca dūratastathā | dīyatāṃ vāṭikāyāṃ vā pārśve vane’thavā tu me ||68|| ātmaghāto mayā naiveṣyate putrā bhayaṃ mahat | dṛśyate jāyate prāṇatyāge prasahya cāpyadhi ||69|| smariṣyāmi parātmānaṃ dūraṃ kṣipantu māmitaḥ | karmaphalaṃ prabhuktvaiva martumicchāmi sarvathā ||3.197.70|| ityuktāste sutāḥ prāhuścāntare kapaṭānvitāḥ | evamastu pitastvāṃ vai vane kṣipāma eva ha ||71 || dāsyāmastatra bhakṣyādi vāṭikāyāṃ tu naiva hi | kintu vai prathamaṃ tīrthaṃ kāraṇīyaṃ yataḥ śubham ||72|| puṇyaṃ bhavet samastaṃ ca pāpaprakṣālanaṃ bhavet | mūladvārāvatītīrthaṃ samudratīragaṃ tu yat ||73|| snāpayitvā pitastatra neṣyāmo vāṭikāntikam | vane saṃrakṣayiṣyāmo rogasaṃkramabhītitaḥ ||74|| ityuktvā te sutāḥ sarve tīrthachadmadharā hi te | śakaṭyāṃ pitaraṃ dhṛtvā yayuḥ samudrasannidhim |||75||| taṭaṃ gatvā tu velāyāṃ snāpayāmāsureva tam | prāhuḥ pitaḥ smagṇīyaṃ smara nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||76|| dravyādi bhūtale nyastaṃ garte vānyatra ced yadi | darśanīyaṃ kathanīyaṃ pradarśaya nivedaya ||77|| bhṛgupātaṃ samudrasya jale nikṣepaṇātmakam | kurmaste svargatidaṃ tanmanaḥ kṛṣṇe niveśaya ||78|| ityuktaḥ sa pitā prāha prārabdhaṃ mama tādṛśam | putrāścātra na vo doṣo maraṇaṃ tādṛśaṃ mama ||79|| bahūni pūrvapāpāni yatphalaṃ cedṛśaṃ tviha | satsu pañcasu putreṣu satyāṃ patnyāṃ sutāsu ca ||3.197.80|| samudre maraṇaṃ me yad rugṇasya vivaśasya ca | astvevaṃ kintu sauvarṇaṃ rūpyakaṃ nāṇakaṃ bahu ||81 || cullyā adho mayā pūrvaṃ nihitaṃ tad vidantvapi | lakṣādhikaṃ bhavatyeva bahuvarṣārjitaṃ tu tat ||82|| anye naiva prajānanti pañca jānantu me dhanam | ityuktvā śrīhariṃ dhyātvā hyekabandhuṃ prarakṣakam ||83|| sasmāra hṛdaye śīghraṃ sarvavṛttibhirekadhā | ekatānena māṃ kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇaṃ paraṃ prabhum ||84|| dehabhānaṃ tirobhāvyendriyavṛttīrvikuṃcya ca | āntaraṃ sarvathā bhānaṃ jīvātmani samādadhat ||85|| sve rūpe saccidānandaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim | lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rameśaṃ māṇikīpatim ||86|| padmāvatīśvaraṃ brahmapriyānāthaṃ satāṃ patim | tuṣṭāva svāminaṃ bhaktyā prāṇānte samupasthite ||86|| putrāstu taṃ samuttolya cikṣipurvārdhivāriṣu | vīkṣamāṇā hyatiṣṭhanta tīre sasnuśca tanmiṣāt ||87|| pitṛdeho jale magno jīvatastasya vai tadā | mṛto vā jantunā grasta ityamanyanta cātmajāḥ ||88|| rurudustatra putrāste snehādhīnotthamāyayā | parameśaṃ hariṃ māṃ ca sasmaruḥ pāpanuttaye ||89|| kṣamāṃ kuru harekṛṣṇa pitṛhatyā bhayaṃkarī | puṇyahantrī svargahantrī mokṣahantrī kṣayaṃkarī ||3.197.90 || sā kṛtāsmābhirabdhau vai tāṃ kṣamasva pareśvara | viṣṇuyajña kariṣyāmaḥ pitṛdravyeṇa bhūriṇā ||91 || pituruddharaṇaṃ svarge mokṣe vā saṃvidhehi vai | ityevaṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptā mama cānte piturmṛtau ||92|| sapta putryastathā patnī cānaśanaṃ gṛhe vyadhuḥ | avalāstā nirbalāścāśaktā vaktuṃ durantakam ||93|| balaṃ tvanaśanaṃ cakrurviditvā pitṛghātanam | pupūjurmāṃ gṛhe tāśca ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ ||94 || tuṣṭuvuḥ pitṛrakṣārthaṃ vratānāṃ mānatā vyadhuḥ | lakṣatulasīpatraiśca pūjāṃ me cakrire hi tāḥ ||95|| athāha sahasā lakṣmi bhaktānāṃ śubhakṛt prabhuḥ | prāvirāsaṃ samudre drāk pitṛdehasya sannidhau ||96|| mūrchāṃ prāpto jalamadhye spṛṣṭo mayā hi rogavān | rogo naṣṭastadā śīghraṃ sāṃgulihastapādavān ||97|| śāṇadharo’bhavad vṛddhaḥ puṣṭo divyavapurdharaḥ | uttolito mayā vārdhau jalopari tatastaṭam ||98|| putrāṇāṃ sannidhau kṣiptaḥ pūrṇāṃgo rogavarjitaḥ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ māṃ tatsutāśca saḥ ||99|| pupūjurādarāt sarve tirobhāvaṃ drutaṃ tataḥ | gṛhe cāvirbhūya tatrānaśanārthe sthitāstu yāḥ ||3.197.1 00 || striyastābhyo’vadaṃ śāṇadharaścojjīvito mayā | arugṇaścālayaṃ putraiḥ sākamāyāti satvaram ||1 0 1|| somanāthaṃ tatastīrthaṃ kṛtvā cāyānti te’tra vai | ityuktāstāḥ pupūjurmāṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vallabhaṃ prabhum ||102|| pratīkṣante sma vāṭaṃ svapituścāgamadaiśikam | tiro’bhavaṃ tataścāhaṃ dinānte tu pitā gṛham || 1 03|| āyayau putrasahitaścānandotsavayogakṛt | kuṭumbaṃ suprasannaṃ vai jātaṃ cānye janā api ||104||| mama māhātmyavettāro’bhavam̐ścāścaryasaṃbhṛtāḥ | bhaktiṃ te kāraṇaṃ prāhuścārogye prāṇarakṣaṇe || 1 05|| atha putraiḥ kṛto yajño mahān vaiṣṇavasaṃjñakaḥ | devarṣipitaraścāhaṃ tṛptāstatrārpitānnakaiḥ ||1 06|| dakṣiṇābhirdīnajanā bhojanairdehadhāriṇaḥ | bhaktyā cāhaṃ śrīhariśca prasannā hyabhavan makhe ||107|| evaṃ pitṛghātakānāṃ pituśca rakṣaṇaṃ mayā | kṛtaṃ lasmi prabhaktānāṃ dayālunā mahātmanā || 1 08|| athānte prāpitā mokṣaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ mama | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi || 10 9|| ārogyaṃ jāyate cāpi saubhāgyaṃ cāpi vardhate | vighnānāṃ ca vināśaḥ syācchatrunāśo bhavedapi ||3.197.1 10 || kṣemaṃ ca kuśalaṃ cāpi vindeta mama bhaktimān | svargaṃ smṛddhiṃ tathā sveṣṭaṃ jīvanaṃ ca labheta vai ||1 11 || bhaktyāhaṃ sarvathā tuṣṭo dadāmi samabhīpsitam | aiśvaryaṃ ca tathāyuṣyaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutaṃ sutām ||112|| sarva dadāmi bhaktāyai bhaktāyāpi samudraje | ityevaṃ bhaktivaśago varte saṃrakṣayāmi ca || 1 13|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne śāṇadharākhyakarṣukasya prāgjanmakarmabhirjātagalatkuṣṭharogasya bhayena putraiḥ samudre kṣiptasya bhagavatā roganāśo rakṣaṇaṃ pāpanāśanaṃ ca kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 197 | |
<3.198> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ nimbadevo dvijottamaḥ | saurāṣṭre tvabhavad bhaktaḥ sadālayākhyakharvaṭe || 1 || nityaṃ māṃ bhajate bhaktyā dharmajñānavirāgavān | paropakāranirataḥ sadā dānaparāyaṇaḥ || 2 || ahiṃsāṃ paramaṃ dharmaṃ satāṃ sevāṃ tataḥ param | hareḥ sevāṃ tato’tyūrdhvāṃ manute cātmaviddhi saḥ || 3 || gavāṃ sevāṃ ca kurute viprasevāṃ yathocitām | prajāsevāmatithīnāṃ sevāṃ karoti cādarāt || 4 || satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ sādhavaścābhyāgatā yātriṇastathā | ye cāyānti nijadvāre sevate tān subhāvanaḥ || 5 || annasatraṃ kṛtaṃ tena dīnāndhakṛpaṇārthakam | paśusatraṃ kṛtaṃ tena paṅguvṛddhapaśūpakṛt || 6 || evaṃvidho nimbadevo bhajate māmaharniśam | mandire mama gatvaiva dhyāyati puruṣottamam || 7 || mārjanaṃ dīpadānaṃ ca dhūpadānaṃ sumārpaṇam | jalārpaṇaṃ ca naivedyārpaṇaṃ karoti me sadā || 8 || hare kṛṣṇa hare kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo hare vibho || 9 || evaṃ māṃ kīrtayan yāti mandiraṃ pratiyāti ca | gṛhaṃ nijaṃ śrāvayam̐śca janān prapāvayan prajāḥ || 3.198.10 || atha grāme’bhavattatra vṛṣabho grāmapālitaḥ | mahākāyo’tibalavān puṣṭaḥ śvetaḥ padāṅkitaḥ ||1 1|| mahākakughnī ca mahāśṛṃgī ca surūpaśobhitaḥ | grāmopaśalye divase pippalīchāyite sthale ||1 2|| niṣīdati kvacid grāme rājapathe’pyaṭatyapi | rātrau carati kṣetreṣu sasyāni vāṭikāsvapi ||1 3|| punaḥ prātaḥ samāgatya tiṣṭhati grāmabhūmiṣu | etādṛśo’yaṃ vṛṣabho yadā yadā prapaśyati ||14|| nimbadevaṃ grāmamadhye mārge kṣetre ca catvare | upaśalye vāṭikāyāṃ yatra kvāpi prapaśyati || 15|| tāvaddrutaṃ catuṣpādaiḥ raudrarūpo’bhidhāvati | mārayituṃ nimbadevaṃ mardayituṃ vināśitum || 1 6|| pūrvavairaṃ smaran yadvanmarākrodhena dhāvati | vairaniryāpanārthaṃ kiṃ vāsya pūrvasya janmanaḥ || 17|| evaṃ jāte bahuvāre nimbadevo nijaṃ drutam | rakṣatyeva ca kauśalyādāpaṇe vā gṛhe viśan ||18 || vedyāmāruhya ca vṛkṣaṃ samāruhyoccasaṃstare | rakṣatyeva nijaṃ nityaṃ rathyāyāṃ yāti bhītavat ||1 9|| yatra tiṣṭhati vṛṣabhastāṃ rathyāṃ sa vihāya vai | anyayā rathyayā yāti kāryārthaṃ tu bahirgṛhāt ||3.198.20 || rājamārge catvare vā kṣetre vāṭyāṃ ca gopure | upaśalye bhūtalādau taddṛṣṭyagre na yāti vai ||21 || evaṃ bhītamanā nityaṃ nimbadevaḥ pravartate | vṛṣabho’pi sadā nimbadevaṃ sammārgayatyapi ||22|| kadā milenmārayāmi tathāsannaddhavatsthitaḥ | evaṃ kāle bahugate hyekadā devamandiram ||23|| darśanārthaṃ nimbadevaḥ prayāti yaṣṭivarjitaḥ | niśāmukhe’tha bhāgyena daivayogāttu sannidhau ||24|| rathyāyāṃ militaścāyaṃ vṛṣabhastaṃ nirāyudham | ativegena dudrāva ruṣā sa vṛṣabho balī ||25|| mārayituṃ nimbadevaṃ kurvan gogarjanāṃ tadā | paścāttu śakaṭaṃ cāyātyeva paścād dvitīyakam ||26|| mārge saṃkucite pārśvayoścāpi nāvakāśakaḥ | vidyate dhāvituṃ kvāpi vṛṣabho’bhipradhāvati ||27|| eva cobhayataḥpāśe mārge mṛtyupradāyake | drāgeva nimbadevastu hariṃ sasmāra māṃ tadā ||28||| dadarśa patitaṃ tatra grāvāṇaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ tathā | karatolyaṃ satvaraṃ taṃ coddhṛtya vai kare balāt ||29|| sarvavegena hastena vṛṣabhasya tu mastake | tāḍayāmāsa sahasā ghātayāmāsa sarvathā ||3.198.30|| bhedayāmāsa śiraso lalāṭaṃ vṛṣabhastadā | tāḍanena drutaṃ mūrchāmavāpya bhramaṇadvayam ||31|| nipapāta kṣitau tatra mamāra ca kṣaṇāditi | ātatāyivadhe doṣo nāsti cedaṃ tathābhavat ||32|| daṃṣṭriṇāṃ śṛṃgiṇāṃ kvāpi viśvāsaḥ śastriṇāṃ tathā | vicittānāṃ na kartavyaścaurāṇāṃ kṣuttṛṣārthinām ||33|| rājñāṃ cāpi ca veśyānāṃ śatrūṇāṃ kariṇāṃ tathā | nakhināṃ tāmasānāṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||34|| agnīnāṃ ca jalānāṃ ca grahāṇāṃ svārthināṃ tathā || kunārīṇāṃ kusādhūnāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na |35|| jīrṇānāṃ cāpi yantrāṇāṃ vāhanānāṃ vinodinām | hiṃsrāṇāṃ hāsyakartṝṇāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||36|| yūnāṃ ca rogiṇāṃ krodhāviṣṭānāṃ tyāgināmapi | bhikṣukāṇāṃ ca mūrkhāṇāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||37|| apakvaśemuṣīṇāṃ cālasānāṃ dharmaghātinām | nāstikānāṃ ratisthānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||38|| aparicitavargāṇāṃ śaṭhānāṃ lobhināṃ tathā | astrīkāṇāṃ kāmināṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na || 39|| meghānāṃ cātapānāṃ ca rajasāṃ marutāṃ tathā | tamasāṃ tāmasānāṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||3.198.40|| mohavatāṃ madavatāṃ bahunamrasvabhāvinām | antaḥpraveśaṃ dadhatāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||41 || yātriṇāṃ kṣaṇasārthānāṃ mahīmānādidehinām | svatantrayoṣitāṃ cāpi kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||42||| sapatnīnāṃ ca duṣṭānāmanavadhānaśālinām | anākṣāvartamāna|nā kāryo viśvāsa eva na |||42|| śraddhāśūnyajanānāṃ ca naṭanartakayoginām | dyūtasthānāṃ raṇasthānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||44|| snehaśūnyahṛdayānāṃ vijātīyopakāriṇām | nāpitānāṃ madyapānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||45|| chidravīkṣāsvabhāvānāmirṣyukāṇāṃ pramādinām | anabhyastanavīnānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||46|| bahumiṣṭavacasāṃ ca nītimārgavirodhinām | aśāstragāmināṃ cāpi kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||47|| amanaskāṅgīkartṝṇāṃ yaśaḥkīrtivināśinām | vivādaśālīmanasāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||48|| luñcāvṛttiprajīvānāmanṛtānyāyavartinām | satyarodhavatāṃ cāpi kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||49|| gahvarāṇāṃ vanānāṃ cāraṇyānāṃ sarasāṃ tathā | śāntendriyādivṛttīnāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||3.198.50|| asthirāṇāṃ ca dīrghāṇāṃ vāmanānāṃ vilambinām | kāṇānāṃ cāpi khañjānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||51 || saṃkucitapraṇāḍīnāṃ tyaktakuṭumbināṃ tathā | tyaktadeśaprajānāṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||52|| gaṇikānāṃ ca bhāṇḍānāṃ śaraṇāgatayoṣitām | rājasambandhinārīṇāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||53|| ativṛṣṭipradeśānāṃ śādvalānāṃ bhuvāṃ tathā | parvatānāṃ kardamānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||94|| ajñātavṛttavaidyānāṃ śmaśānānāṃ tarasvinām | ajñātānāmoṣadhīnāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||95|| śatrudāpitabhojyānāṃ śatrudāpitagandhinām | śatrupreṣitalokānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||56|| śanupoṣyaśukānāṃ ca śanupālitapakṣiṇām | śatrusambadhipatrāṇāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||57|| atikrodhitapatnīnāmatikrodhitasvāminām | atibhuktajanānāṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||568|| atijīrṇālayānāṃ ca tathātijīrṇadehinām | atijīrṇauṣadhānāṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||5 9|| mantratantraprasaktānāṃ rasāyanapravedinām | āsurāṇāṃ rakṣasāṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||3.198.60|| atra mānaṃ tatra mānaṃ ceti mānābhilāṣiṇām | dvijihvānāṃ caikalānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||61 || vidhurāṇāṃ vidhavānāṃ kūṭanīnāṃ ca yoṣitām | virāgiṇīnāṃ bhūtīnāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||62|| digbhramāṇāṃ pretabhūtāviṣṭānāṃ vāyurogiṇām | paracakragatānāṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||63|| sarīsṛpāṇāṃ jalināṃ yādasāṃ vakragāminām | bubhukṣitānāṃ lokānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||64|| cārāṇāṃ vanavāsānāṃ pararāṣṭrapraveśinām | asnigdhānāṃ cāśritānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||65|| pratiṣṭhāpitadevānāṃ tāmasānāṃ tu sarvathā | aparādhātmake kārye kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||66|| āpatkālābhibhūtānāṃ bāliśānāṃ vacassu ca | svārthasādhakalokānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||67|| anekagṛhabhṛtyānāṃ naikanṛpaiḥ suyoginām | sīmni kṛtālayānāṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||68|| rātricarāṇāṃ prasahya hāṭakāṇāṃ ca duḥkhinām | avijñātacaritrāṇāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||69|| udvegināṃ virāgāṇāṃ vratināṃ haṭhadharmiṇām | bāhyavṛttiparāṇāṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||3.198.70|| śaivālitakṣitīnāṃ ca bhagnanāvāṃ manasvinām | kṣaṇe ruṣṭapratuṣṭānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||71 || dehendriyādisaktānāṃ daityānāṃ parayoṣitām | samāje bahulokānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||72|| utsave cerṣyukāṇāṃ copapatyuścopayoṣitām | tathaiva copaputrāṇāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||73|| upamātṝṇāmandhānāṃ vaṇijāṃ ca kutarkiṇām | mama bhaktivihīnānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||74|| rogāṇāṃ ca kṣatānāṃ ca phullānāṃ kampināṃ tathā | bahusvapnavatāṃ cāpi kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||75|| ajñātānāmaśrutānāmanabhyastādikarmiṇām | anabhyastapācakānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||76|| ardhābhyāsavatāṃ nirmūlānāmapāravarṣmaṇām | ākāśālambanavatāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||77|| tatra tatra hi viśvasto duḥkhaṃ kṣatiṃ tathāpadam | maraṇaṃ vā prayātyeva lakṣmi nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ||78|| nimbadevastathā matvā jaghāna vṛṣabhaṃ tadā | gohatyā sāsya saṃlagnā nimbadevo vicittatām ||79|| upāgamad drutaṃ cāpi kṛṣṇatāṃ kuṣṭharogitām | yathākathañcit sahasā svālayaṃ samupāyayau ||3.198.8 0|| viprānāhūya hatyāṃ tāṃ nyavedayaddvijā api | ūcustaṃ viṣṇuyāgārthaṃ prāyaścittaṃ ca vatsaram ||8 1 || ekabhuktatvamevāpi sahasragopradānakam | so’pi sarvaṃ pracakre ca yajñānte dakṣiṇāṃ dadau ||82|| tathāpi śyāmavarṇo’sya vicittatā na nirgatā | atha khedaṃ jagāmāpi prasasmāra ca māṃ harim ||83|| bhaktaṃ jñātvā paraṃ nārāyaṇaścāhaṃ puro’bhavam | pratyakṣo divyarūpaśca pasparśa taṃ svabāhunā ||84|| drāgeva bhaktaḥ śveto’bhūt sucittaḥ svastha eva ca | tasmai datto mayā mantrastaṃ jagrāhātibhāvataḥ ||85|| bālakṛṣṇo hariḥ sākṣānmokṣado bhagavān mama | so’pi mantramuvācaivaṃ sarvadātha tataḥ sa tu ||86|| prāpte kāle yayau muktiṃ bhakto me nimbadevakaḥ | evaṃ hatyāghanāśo vai mayādhvare’sya vartitaḥ ||87|| nāśubhaṃ mama bhaktānāṃ tiṣṭhatyeva hi madbalāt | śṛṇu lakṣmi nimbadevasyāsīd bhṛtyaḥ sa prāgbhave ||88|| vetanaṃ paripūrṇaṃ ca labdhvāpi pūrṇakarma saḥ | karoti naivālasaḥ sa pramādī krodhano’pi ca ||89|| jvareṇa sa mṛto bhṛtyo balīvardo babhūva ha | jātismaro’yaṃ nityaṃ vai yāvat paśyati svāminam ||3.198.90 || nityaṃ kārye yojakaṃ svaṃ cādhikṣepiṇamityapi | dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā vairabhāvaṃ prakāśayati tatra ca ||91 || dhāvatyeva svāminaṃ svaṃ mārayituṃ krudhā ruṣā | evaṃvidho hi vṛṣabhaḥ svāmihastena vai mṛtim |||92|| prāpya ṛṇaṃ pradātuṃ ca punastasya suto’bhavat | śobhano jñānavām̐ścāpi bahukāryakaro’pi ca |||93|| nimbadevastu vārdhakye sarvaṃ datvā sutāya ha | bhajate māṃ prabhuṃ nityaṃ kuṭumbena yuto rame ||94|| suto’pi māṃ bhajate ca nāmnā gokulavardhanaḥ | anne muktiṃ hyavāpāpi bhaktyā me sa suto’pi vai ||95|| evaṃ lakṣmi kṛtā doṣā naśyantyeva pratāpataḥ | mama bhaktestathā dhyānāt kīrtanāccharaṇāgamāt ||96 || satāṃ sevāprasaṃgācca naśyantyaghāni sarvaśaḥ | bhaktānāṃ yoṣitāṃ cāpi sādhvīnāṃ sevanādapi ||97|| āśīrvādād vinaśyanti sarvāṇyaghāni sarvaśaḥ | sarvavighnāni naśyanti sarvāpannāśanaṃ tathā ||98|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne nimbadevākhyabhaktasya gohatyāpāpaṃ bhagavatā nivāritamityādinirūpaṇanāmā aṣṭanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 198 ||
<3.199> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kāruṇyāt pravadāmi yat | sarvairjanaiḥ sadā kāryaṃ sacchāstrāṇāṃ prasevanam || 1 || lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāścāsyāḥ prasevanam | nārībhiśca naraiścāpi kartavyaṃ sarvadehibhiḥ || 2 || mama bhaktiprakārāśca mokṣasya sādhanānyapi | svargasya hetavaścāpi sṛṣṭīnāṃ vartanāni ca || 3 || uktānyatra samastāni bahūni kṛpayā mayā | aikāntikā mama bhaktā uditā hi mayā śubhāḥ | | 4 || dehātmabuddhayaścāpi brahmātmabuddhayastathā | svārthaparāstathā coktāḥ parārthā divyadharmiṇaḥ || 5 || divyāstu dehatritayād bhinne cātmani niṣṭhitāḥ | ātmanyatiprakāśe te sākṣānmāṃ samupāsate || 6 || īkṣante te cātiprakāśātmarūpaṃ sanātanam | ātmarūpe bālakṛṣṇamīkṣante māṃ pareśvaram || 7 || atitejasvinaṃ sākṣād ramantaṃ cātmanā saha | ta ete divyadṛgvantaścātra loke sthitā api || 8 || brahmapurasthitāḥ santi yūyaṃ brahmapriyā yathā | brahmabhāvastu bhaktābhiḥ sādhanīyo’tisaukhyadaḥ || 9 || śrīpatau mayi yāsāṃ vā yeṣāṃ manuṣyabhāvanā | teṣāṃ tāsāṃ vighnabhayaṃ viraho me bhavediti || 3.199.10 || aprāptirmama dhāmnaśca kvacit syānmadabhāvataḥ | ato loke mama bhaktā naiva kurvanti vai mayi || 11 || manuṣyabhāvanāṃ kvāpi kurvanti divyabhāvanām | yathā tu bhāvanā divyā mayi tathā nije’pi ca || 12|| kartavyā bhāvanā divyā na tu dehātmabhāvanā | dehātmabhāvanā vighnapradā bhavati dehinām || 1 3|| brahmā mohaṃ gato vīkṣya pārvatīrūpameva ha | skhalitaśca tato jātā bālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ || 14|| śaṃkaro mohinīṃ māṃ tu dṛṣṭvā mugdho’bhavattathā | nārado dehabhāvena vivāhaṃ samiyeṣa ca || 15|| evamanye’pi bahavo mohaṃ muktā gatā api | mohātmakaṃ mahadvighnaṃ jāyate dehabhāvinām ||1 6|| divyabhāvayutānāṃ tu cātmaniṣṭhānivāsinām | śukavad brahmabhāvo vai jāyate sanakādivat || 17|| sarvā līlā mama divyā boddhavyā ratirāsajā | muktidā sā bhavatyeva mayi snehena yoginī ||18|| sneho gāḍhānurāgaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe mayi | premātirekaḥ satataṃ nijātmani sthirastu yaḥ || 1 9|| snehenānena bhaktānāṃ māyāsneho vilīyate | māyāsneha sthitiṃ kartuṃ dadātyeva na cāntare |||3.199.20|| dhyānaṃ snehena satataṃ kartavyaṃ mama nityadā | dhyānavṛttiḥ sthirā syācca mahāsamādhikāraṇam ||21 || vṛttisthairye bhavedekāntikatā mayi keśave | śāśvatānandasandohe mahāsukhaprade prabhau ||22|| sarvakriyāsu satataṃ mayi sthairyaṃ vidhāpayet | evamabhyasane jāte cātmā niruddhyate mayi ||23 || sendriyāntaḥkaraṇaḥ saṃpralagno jāyate mayi | evaṃ cittanirodhena sarvarodhe bhavenmayi |||24||| premātirekastatrāsti kāraṇaṃ netarad rame | bhaktānāṃ mānasaṃ snehāt sthiraṃ syānmayi tattathā ||25|| teṣāmātmasu sahasā vāso me ca bhaved rame | premṇā vāsastu mūrterme sākṣādvat smārako bhavet ||26|| mahātmyajñānamevāpi premṇā nityaṃ pravardhate | māhātmyajñānayukpremā brahmātmasthitimṛcchati ||27|| na sa māyāṃ prapaśyet saṃpaśyenmāṃ brahma śāśvatam | akṣaraṃ divyarūpaṃ ca saccidānandasaṃbhṛtam ||28 || tatra nijātmarūpe vai cākṣare brahmaśāśvate | sadaikarasacaitanyaprakāśe vyāpake’bhitaḥ ||29|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ parameśvaram | divyaṃ kāntaṃ samīkṣeta nānyamākāramīkṣate ||3.199.3 0|| eṣā brāhmī sthitirdivyā parāvidyāsthitistathā | divyajñānasthitiścāpi jñānapralayasaṃjñikā ||3 1|| sākṣātkṛṣṇe pare deve śāśvatasthiratātmikā | asyā nityaṃ samārambhaṃ yaḥ karoti tu dehabhāk ||32| | sa yāti paramāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ sthitiṃ lakṣmi yathā tava | pratyakṣasya mahimā me yāvaj jñāto’sti yena vai ||33 || tasya tāvān prakāśo’pi hṛdaye kṛpayā bhavet | cinmayaṃ taṃ prakāśaṃ ca vardhamānavekṣate ||34|| mahimānaṃ vardhamānaṃ yāvantaṃ vindate tathā | tāvantaṃ praṇavaṃ cāpi tāvadrūpaṃ ca me tathā ||35|| vardhamānaṃ brahmarūpe vindate kṛpayā mama | kramāt sarvatra sampūrṇaṃ prakāśaṃ paripaśyati ||36|| śṛṇoti mama nāmnāṃ vai nādānāṃ madhurān dhvanīn | brahmanādeṣu magnasya magnasya svātmani dhruve ||37|| amāyikasya muktasya brahmībhūtatvameva tat | mama māhātmyānubhavo yasyādhikyena yāvatā ||38||| tāvatā brahmabhāvasya parātmano mamekṣaṇam | parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ prapannasya mama māhātmyavedinaḥ ||39|| kālamāyāniyantṛtvādyaiśvaryaṃ samajāyate | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ matsamo’pi saḥ ||3.199.40|| sarvāvatāradhartāhaṃ kālamāyāniyāmakaḥ | guṇātīto nirvikāraḥ sarveśvareśvareśvaraḥ ||41 || śreyo’rthaṃ dehināmatra svecchayā bhāmi martyavat | martyavacca kriyāḥ sarvāḥ karomi bhaktahetave ||42|| tatra vimūḍhamatayaścālpajñāścarmacakṣuṣaḥ | nijadṛṣṭāntamāsādya doṣān prakalpayanti te ||43|| nirdoṣo’haṃ sadā lakṣmi cintāmaṇisamaḥ sadā | kalpakeṣu kalpyadoṣāḥ praviśanti hi te’khilāḥ ||44|| manyante kāminaṃ māṃ ye kāminaste bhavanti vai | krodhinaṃ māṃ kalpayanti krodhinaste bhavanti ca ||45|| manyante māṃ lampaṭaṃ ye bhavanti lampaṭāstu te | māyāvinaṃ tu jānanti māyāvino bhavanti te ||46 || adivyaṃ māṃ vijānanti hyāsurāḥ kṣudrabuddhayaḥ | divyaṃ cāpi manuṣyaṃ māṃ divyaṃ jānanti ye tu vai ||47|| te tu bhavanti divyāśca hyadivyā api devatāḥ | api nrākṛtimīśaṃ māṃ nirdoṣaṃ māṃ vidanti ye ||48|| sadoṣā api jāyante nirdoṣāste balānmama | vaśe yasya samastānīndriyāṇi cāntarāṇi ca ||49|| saṃkalpo’pi vaśe yasya pratyakṣakṛṣṇaniścayaḥ | sa eva pūrṇo dhanyaśca kṛtārthaśca mataḥ sadā ||3.199.50 || yathā muktastathā so’pi yathākṣare tathātra saḥ | yathā divyastathā cātra sarvaiśvaryānvito bhavet ||51 || manyeta sa nijaṃ bhāgyaṃ bhāgyena śrīhareḥ saha | miśritaṃ na pṛthak lakṣmi dhanyaṃ manyeta vai nijam ||52| kāmādidāvadagdhe’tra loke dhanyo’smi yanmama | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣānmimela ha ||53|| santastasya tu militā mokṣadā doṣanāśakāḥ | yatprasādena jeṣyāmi kāmādīnāntarānarīn ||54|| brahmarūpeṇa ca kṛṣṇopāsanāṃ mokṣadāyinīm | kariṣyāmi bhāgyayogaiḥ kṛpayā śrīharestathā ||55|| etādṛśā mama bhaktā bhāgyavanto rame matāḥ | prāptapūrṇaguṇāste vai cintāmaṇiprayogiṇaḥ ||56|| nahi teṣvastyapūrṇatvaṃ paripūrṇā mamāśrayāt | pratyakṣo’haṃ yadeteṣāṃ milito rādhikāpatiḥ ||97|| pūrvajanmotthasukṛtaṃ tveteṣāṃ bahulaṃ yataḥ | satsaṃgasya mahāyogo jāto’sya mokṣado yataḥ ||58|| prapannasya tu bhaktasyāpūrṇatā ced bhaved yadi | apaneyātmaniṣṭhāḍhyamāhātmyajñānatastu sā ||59|| ātmaniṣṭhā nirbalā cet samādhāvapi duḥkhadā | śrūyante tu yadā nādā brahmāṇḍabhedakā iva ||3.199.60 || samādhau tu tadā cātmaniṣṭhāhīno bibheti ha | ātmasatto nirbhayo vai brahmatādātmyameti ca ||6 1 || brahmāṇḍadāhakaṃ tejastatrekṣate samādhimān | tadā bibhetyasāvātmaniṣṭhāhīno vināśrayam ||62 || harirvā tasya tanmārge sahāyaḥ premabhāvitaḥ | ātmavidvā bhayaṃ naiti hareḥ sahāyavām̐śca vā ||63|| ātmavidaḥ pratruṭyanti sarvā viṣayavāsanāḥ | nirodhaṃ tvekavṛttitvāccittaṃ kṛṣṇe’sya vindati ||64|| sarvendriyapravāhāṇāṃ kṛṣṇe mayi visarjanam | kṛtvā stheyaṃ mama bhaktairvighnaṃ nāsya prajāyate ||65|| ekabalaṃ caikavṛtti cittaṃ bhaktasya susthiram | mayyeva tu yadā jātaṃ tadākraṣṭuṃ na śakyate ||66|| ramyaiścāpi padārthairvai yato nirvāsanaṃ hi tat | niruddhaṃ mama mūrtau tanmadanyacintanojjhitam ||67|| evaṃ satāṃ mānasaṃ vai mayi ruddhaṃ prajāyate | hitvānyat kṛṣṇapūrṇārthāḥ kurvate madupāsanam ||68|| evaṃ lakṣmi kṛpāsādhyo bhavāmi pūrṇakāmadaḥ | mahābhāgavatāḥ santo bhajante navadhā hi mām ||69|| brahmaniṣṭhā ātmavido mama māhātmyavedinaḥ | bhaktiniṣṭhaḥ sadā sevāniṣṭhasteṣāṃ pravardhate ||3.199.70|| tathā tādātmyaniṣṭhaśca sampadyate mayā saha | sadbhistathāpi nodricyaṃ hyudreke dagdhabījatā ||71 || hareḥ kṛpā tādṛśācca nivartate hi niṣphalā | tasmānmayyeva saṃsthāpyaṃ sarvaṃ cābhyudayādikam ||72|| buddhirmano’pyahaṃkāraścittaṃ cendriyavṛttayaḥ | deho dehaguṇāścāpi sthāpanīyā mayīśvare |||73|| rasikatvaṃ harāveva bālakṛṣṇe mayi prabhau | samarpaṇīyaṃ satataṃ śrīlakṣmīrādhikāpatau ||74|| gāyanasya rasaścāpi samarpaṇīya īśvare | kīrtanaṃ hāvabhāvāścārpaṇīyā parame mayi ||75|| mayyarpaṇaṃ vinā bhāvo raso’nyatra bhaved yadi || tatra syālagnatā tena bhraṃśaḥ syācchreyasāṃ pathaḥ ||76|| ekāntikasya bhaktasya rasikasya na saṃbhavet | rasaḥ kvāpi madanyeṣu padārtheṣu jagatsu vai ||77|| mama līlāguṇabhāji śabde yasya raso mataḥ | nānyatra sa eva me’sti śābdiko rasikaḥ priyaḥ ||78|| mamāṃgayogisaṃsparśe yad bhaktasya rato mataḥ | nānyatra spārśane kvāpi sparśīyarasikaḥ sa me ||79|| mamaivekṣā māmakānāmīkṣā yasya rasānvitā | nānyā yasyāsti didṛkṣā rūpīyarasikaḥ sa me ||3.199.8 0|| madarpitānnatāmbūlaprabhṛtisvādasadrasaḥ | yasyāsti na tvitaratra rasīyarasikaḥ sa me ||8 1 | madarpitasugandhāderghrāṇane yasya sadrasaḥ | nānyatra saurabhādau sa gandhīyarasiko mama ||82|| grahaṇaṃ mama divyānāṃ padārthānāṃ tu hastayoḥ | gamanaṃ mandirāṇāṃ me pradakṣiṇaṃ ca pādayoḥ ||83 || kathanaṃ matkathādīnāṃ vāco yasya rasātmakam | ānandādyaṃ mama yogānmadratau yasya sadrasaḥ ||84|| evamādyāni sarvāṇi madarthe rasabhāñji vai | mano buddhistathā cittamahaṃkāro’pi mārutaḥ ||85|| sarve madrasabhāvā vai yasya bhaktasya santi hi | pramodo yasya manmūrtau mūrteśca viṣayeṣvapi ||86|| bhāgavateṣu divyeṣu rasotkarṣo hi sarvathā | ātyantikī ruciścāpi mayyeva yasya vartate ||87|| jāgrataḥ svapato vāpi mūrchitasyāpi sarvathā turyāsthitasya mayyeva yasya sarvo raso mataḥ ||88|| tasya bhaktasya divyasya satyā rasikatā matā | evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya rasikasya sadā hṛdi ||89|| bhāse’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ divyamūrtimān | paśyato mama mūrtiṃ ca hṛdaye drāgalaukikīm ||3.199.90 || prakāśate brahmatejo bhāse tasminnahaṃ prabhuḥ | tasmād bhaktaiḥ pradhāryaṃ me rūpaṃ gāyanakīrtanaiḥ ||91 || mānasaṃ ca mama rūpe sātma śraddhāsamanvitam | yatra kvāpi praveṣṭuṃ na śakyetānyena vastunā ||92|| yataḥ samartho bhagavān māyikāni
