samastataḥ | dūrīkaroti vighnāni sarveśvareśvaro hi saḥ ||93 || vidhṛtā yena bhūgolāstārā vyomni tathā dhṛtāḥ | sūryācandramasoryenodayāstamane vai kṛte ||94|| meghāśca nirmitā yena vārivāhā jalapradāḥ | ṛtavo nirmitā yena vṛkṣavallīphalapradāḥ ||95|| abdhayo nijavelā na jahatyapi yadājñayā | dhātubindoḥ prajāyante sākārāpatyamūrtayaḥ |||96|| jīvo yenecchayā cātmā hyagocaraḥ samarthitaḥ | so’haṃ śrīmān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo manuṣyavigrahaḥ ||97|| bahiśca hṛdaye svāmī dhāmni cāpi bhavāmi ha | militaśceha bhaktānāṃ paraniḥśreyase prabhuḥ ||98|| etādṛśaṃ māṃ vijñāya māhātmyajñānagocaram | mama bhaktena bhaktirme kāryā bhītivivarjitā ||99|| evaṃvidhasya vijñasya brahmasthitirbhavediha | hṛdi tasya praveśaṃ na kurvanti māyikāni vai || 3.199.100 || divyā sthitirbhavatyeva sukhaduḥkhasamāsya vai | pūjane tāḍane hastyārohaṇe kharavāhane || 101 || śatrau mitre tathā svarṇe lauhe rūpe kurūpake | avamāne ca māne ca samatāsya hi vartate || 102 || etādṛśasya hṛdaye vāso me sarvadāsti vai | asya prapūjanaṃ devā īśvarā vidadhatyapi || 10 3|| saṃsāriṇāṃ samuddhartā bhavatyayaṃ bhavārṇavāt | ādhāro jagatāṃ cāyaṃ sāmarthyavān bhavatyapi || 1 04|| asaṃkhyaguṇakalyāṇairyukto mokṣaṃ dadātyapi | asya mūrtau mama mūrtirvasatyeva sadā rame || 1 05|| asyendriyeṣu sarvāṇīndriyāṇi me vasantyapi | asyāntaḥkaraṇe sarvaṃ madantaḥkaraṇaṃ rame || 106 || ataḥ sa sarvalokānāṃ netrādīnāṃ prakāśane | samartho vartate madvanmama tādātmyayogataḥ || 1 07|| tathāpi sādhutāsthityā sahate cāvamānakam | kṣudrajīvakṛtaṃ cāpi kṣamādharmo hi sādhutā || 1 08|| sa eva tu mahānātmā kṣamā sāmarthyamuttamam | etādṛśasya me sādhoḥ saṃgamād yāvadarpaṇāt || 1 09|| sarvāḥ siddhyanti vāñcchāśca svargaṃ mokṣaṃ labheta ca | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhed rame || 3.199.110 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne śrīhariṇā svaikāntikabhaktānāṃ brahmaniṣṭhataiśvaryādīni kathitānītyādinirūpaṇanāmā navanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 199 ||
<3.200> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ bhāṇḍabhaktasya vai kathām | bhāṇḍīyanagare bhāṇḍo’bhavacchūdro hi bhaktarāṭ || 1 || gāyane vādane śakto nāmnā kālīndaraḥ purā | kālīndaro’tikuśalaścābālyāda vādyarāgavān || 2 || vādyakalāṃ vijānāti gītigānānusāriṇīm | bhāṇḍāśca bahavastasya śālāmāgatya dūrataḥ || 3 || abhyāsaṃ vidadhatyeva vādyānāṃ tatra vāsinaḥ | nṛtyānāṃ gālatālānāṃ galatālātmakātmanām || 4 || kaṇṭhatālītālasakthikaratālātmakātmanām | nartakyaścāpi bahvyaścāgatyābhyāsaṃ tathāvidham || 5 || kurvanti tasya śālāyāṃ vārāṃganāśca kanyakāḥ | varṣe varṣe prakurvanti mahotsavaṃ ca te tataḥ || 6 || samāje tatra kurvanti śikṣaṇasya pradarśanam | evaṃ tatrātikuśalā gāyakā nartakāstathā || 7 || vādakā hāsakāścāpi bahurūpā narāḥ striyaḥ | prāpnuvanti yathāvidyaṃ pāritoṣikamuttamam || 8 || svarṇarūpyamayaṃ ratnamayaṃ bhūṣāmayaṃ ca vā | veṣamayaṃ vādyarūpaṃ samājena samarpitam || 9 || evaṃ samvatsare lakṣmi jāyate sumahotsavaḥ | prasiddhastena bhāṇḍaḥ saḥ kālīndaro vyajāyata || 3.200.1 0|| rājānaḥ sādhavaḥ satyaḥ śreṣṭhinaścādhikāriṇaḥ | samutsave samāyānti pāritoṣikasampradāḥ || 11 || teṣāṃ karoti satkāraṃ yathāyogyaṃ yathādhanam | bhāṇḍīranṛpatiścāpi nṛpādīnāṃ samarhaṇam || 12|| svāgataṃ cāpi yogyaḥ san karoti ca yathocitam | evaṃvidhe samāje’yaṃ kālīndaro’tibhaktarāṭ || 1 3|| mama mūrtiṃ tu sauvarṇī siṃhāsane sabhāgate | sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhāḍhye’vasthāpayati śobhanām || 14|| lakṣmīrādhāyutāṃ ramyāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇābhidhām | maṇḍape taijase śobhāyukte svargasabhāsame || 15|| gāyanādeḥ samārambhāt pūrvaṃ prapūjya māṃ tataḥ | nṛpān prapūjya sādhūm̐śca satīḥ prapūjya cāgragān || 1 6|| vṛddhān viprān śreṣṭhivaryānnatvā samājamādarāt | gītiṃ ramyāṃ prārthanāḍhyāṃ karoti prāk tadā mama || 17|| jayati nārāyaṇaḥ sarvakāraṇahariḥ śrīpatiḥ sarvalakṣmīśvaro’yam | jayati nārāyaṇo brahmapārāyaṇo rādhikākānta īśeśvaro’yam || 18|| jayati kamalāpatirbrahmalalanāpati rmuktamuktānikākānta īśaḥ | jayati dhāmeśvaraścāvatāreśvaraḥ kaṃbharābālako bālakṛṣṇaḥ || 1 9|| jayati gopālajo māṇikīnāyaka ścākṣarādhīśvaraśca prameśaḥ | sarvalokāntaraścāntarātmā prabhu rjayati kṛṣṇo hariḥ pārvatīśaḥ ||3.200.20|| jayati gopīpatirjayati naiṣṭhika patirjayati sarveśarājādhirājaḥ | jayati vai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mādhavaḥ svāmināṃ svāminātho vijayatu || 21 || bhaktarakṣākaro nijajaneṣṭadāyakaḥ śrīharirmāṃ samuddharatu kṛṣṇaḥ | bhāṇḍajātiṃ tathā nartakīyoṣito gāyikā uddharatvīśvareśaḥ ||22|| bhaktajanabhāvanāṃ pūrayatvacyuto yaḥ prabhurdīnamitraṃ viśeṣāt | stauti kālīndaraḥ kālamāyāparaṃ bhuktaye muktaye śāntaye tam ||23|| evaṃ gītiṃ nartakībhiḥ sahitasya janasya me | kālīndarasya śrutvāhaṃ prasannaścābhavaṃ muhuḥ ||24|| lakṣmīrādhādisahitastebhyo dātuṃ svadarśanam | kṛpāmakaravaṃ lakṣmi bhaktādhīno narāyaṇaḥ ||25|| tejaḥpuñjo mayā tatra pradarśito’tibhāsuraḥ | sabhāyāṃ tu samāje vai maṇḍape mama mūrtijaḥ || 26|| tatra śanairmama rūpaṃ śaṃkhacakragadābjavat | hārakeyūramukuṭakaṭakakaustubhādiyuk ||27|| divyaśṛṃgāraveṣāḍhyaṃ prasannavadanaṃ śubham | rādhālakṣmīyutaṃ divyaiḥ pārṣadaiśca samanvitam ||28|| adarśayaṃ kṣaṇaṃ tatra mugdhāḥ sarvāḥ striyo narāḥ | abhavam̐stejasā puñjaiḥ staṃbhanetrāśca vai kṣaṇam || 29|| tejo vilīya sahasā naranāṭyadharo’bhavam | tairdṛṣṭo rūpavānasmi tāvattiro’bhavaṃ kṣaṇāt ||3.200.30 || bhaktabhaktyā manāgevaṃ mayā rūpaṃ pradarśitam | sarvaḥ samājo rūpaṃ tad draṣṭumiyeṣa vai muhuḥ || 3 1|| kālīndaraṃ mahābhaktaṃ śiśriyuste tataḥ sadā | vaiṣṇavāḥ sarva evaite babhūburmayi śraddhayā ||32|| sarve nityaṃ bhajante māṃ prātaḥ kurvanti kīrtanam | kathāṃ madīyāṃ kurvanti pūjanaṃ mama vastubhiḥ || 33|| naivedyaṃ bhuñjate sarve mama prasādarūpi tat | sāyaṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ sarve kurvanti militāstathā ||34|| bhāṇḍaśālābhavallakṣmi bhaktaśālā hi sā sadā | ekabhaktasya yogena kṛpayā mama divyayā ||35|| nityaṃ sukīrtanaṃ tatra jāyate mama harṣakṛt | sādhavaḥ sādhvikāstatra nityamāyānti yānti ca ||36|| kālīndaratathā cānye bhaktā mama prapūjanam | nityaṃ kurvanti prātaśca madhye sāyaṃ suśobhanam ||37|| nityabhaktyā pāvanāste hyabhavan paṃktipāvanāḥ | hyekadā bhāṇḍīrapuraṃ sādhustu kamalāyanaḥ || 38|| mama bhakto yayau tīrthayātrāṃ kurvan niśāmukhe | kālīndaro mahān bhaktaḥ sādhūnāṃ sevako drutam ||39|| sādhave pradadau lakṣmi jalānnaṃ svāgataṃ vyadhāt | madhuparkaṃ dadau vāsaṃ sevāṃ cakāra bhāvataḥ ||3.200.40|| sāyaṃkālottaraṃ tatra samājo darśako’bhavat | tatra kālīndaro’pṛcchat sate niḥśreyasaṃ nijam ||41 || ātyantikaṃ sukalyāṇaṃ vada sādho kathaṃ bhavet | kamalāyanasādhustaṃ sabhāyāṃ vaktumārabhat ||42|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvātivallabhaḥ | hitāya dehināṃ cātra kṛpayā mānave kule ||43|| narākāraḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā viharatyeva bhūtale | tadāśritāḥ sādhavaśca dayālavaścarantyapi ||44|| lokānāṃ hitakartāraścopadiśanti tadguṇān | tadguṇān prasamākarṇya bhaktiṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ ||45|| bhaktyā śreyo bhavatyeva jāyate cākṣare gatiḥ | ye janāḥ samagṛhṇanti guṇān sādhoḥ parātmanaḥ ||46|| sevāṃ kurvanti sādhūnāṃ tathā śrīparamātmanaḥ | bhajante taṃ prabhuṃ sādhūn te taranti bhavārṇavam ||47|| ye tu doṣān pragṛhṇanti te patanti bhavāmbudhau | vardhante vāsanāstasya doṣagrahaṇapāpataḥ ||48|| ye tu divyadṛśā sādhorharerguṇān gatipradān | praśaṃsanti ca gṛhṇanti te yānti paramāṃ gatim ||49|| teṣāṃ hṛdaye nairmalyaṃ jāyate sādhusevinām | śataviprasamaḥ sādhuḥ śatasādhusamo hariḥ ||3.200.50|| yathā yathā divārātrau sādhusaṃgaṃ karotyayam | tathā tathā divyabhāvo harau sādhau ca vardhate ||51|| tathā tathā ca nairmalyaṃ satsaṃgaśca pravardhate | pravardhate mahāpuṇyaṃ paraniḥśreyasāṃpradam ||52|| indriyāṇāṃ tu pāpāni naśyanti sādhusaṃgataḥ | ataḥ sarvārpaṇaiḥ sevyāḥ sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ ||53|| sādhoḥ sevā hareḥ sevā tayā yāti paraṃ padam | yatra sādhornivāso’sti tadgṛhaṃ mokṣadaṃ sadā ||54|| yatra kṛṣṇanivāso’sti mandiraṃ tat pramokṣadam | sa deśo mokṣado yatra sādhurharirvirājate ||59|| sā khaṭvā pāvanī yatra sādhuḥ svapiti śāntimān | yasmin dine hareḥ sādhordarśanaṃ sevanaṃ bhavet ||56|| divasaḥ sa śubhaḥ prokto mokṣo’ghavināśakaḥ | sabhā samājaḥ śubhakṛd yatra sādhoḥ samāgamaḥ ||57|| bhaktānāṃ saṃgamaścāpi pāpaho mokṣadastathā | vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāṃ saṃgaḥ satīnāṃ sevanaṃ tathā ||58|| mokṣadaṃ saṃbhavatyeva satsaṃgaḥ śevadhirnṝṇām | dānaṃ puṇyaṃ bhojanādi dātavyaṃ sādhave sadā ||59|| śrīkṛṣṇāya pradātavyaṃ sarvasvaṃ mokṣakṛddhi tat | evaṃvidhābhiḥ sevābhirmokṣaṃ sampādayet sudhīḥ ||3.200.60|| asaddeśamasatkālamasatsaṃgaṃ vivarjayet | satsaṃgaṃ satkriyāṃ kuryāttena mokṣo bhavediha ||61 || asatsaṃgo bhavedbhakternāśakastaṃ parityajet | mokṣasya rodhakaṃ cāpi duṣṭasaṃgaṃ vivarjiyet ||62|| pūrvasaṃskārayogena nairmalyaṃ hṛdi jāyate | pūrvapuṇyodayenāpi nairmalyaṃ jāyate hṛdi ||63|| kṛpayā śrīhareścāpi nairmalyaṃ jāyate hṛdi | sādhūnāṃ kṛpayā cāpi nairmalyaṃ jāyate hṛdi ||64|| sevākhyena pauruṣeṇa sādhūnāṃ śrīharestathā | nairmalyaṃ jāyate śreṣṭhaṃ sarvasvārpaṇakarmaṇā ||65|| nirmalāntaḥkaraṇo yaḥ sajjate satsamāgame | sādhusevāṃ hareḥ sevāṃ kṛtvā kṛpāṃ prasādanam ||66|| prasannatāṃ harerlabdhvā labdhvā sādhoḥ prasannatām | varadānaṃ tato labdhvā hareḥ satāṃ mahātmanām ||67|| sadbuddhyā śrīhariṃ prāpya naranāṭyadharaṃ prabhum | sādhūnmokṣapradān prāpya kṛtvā saṃgaṃ hareḥ satām ||68|| tebhyaḥ prāpya paraṃ jñānaṃ tadbhaktyāpnoti divyatām | kṛpayā divyayānena bhakto yāti paraṃ padam ||69|| sakalpānāṃ vāsanānāṃ māyānāṃ ca nivartanam | mokṣābhigamanaṃ ceti hareḥ satāṃ prasaṃgataḥ ||3.200.70|| mano līnaṃ harau kṛṣṇe jāyate snehayoginām | tathaikāntikabhaktānāṃ syānniṣkaitavasevayā ||71 || sevābhaktiparaḥ śreṣṭho na nivṛttiparāyaṇaḥ | sevako’saṃkhyamokṣārthī nivṛttastvātmamokṣakṛt ||72|| dāsyena bhajamānasya bhaktiḥ kṛṣṇe’dhikā yataḥ | bhaktyādhikyabalaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ samartho’saṃkhyamokṣaṇe ||73|| nivṛtto durbalo hīnaḥ kṛṣṇastadbhaktasevayā | sevakaḥ sabalaḥ kṛṣṇājñāyāṃ dṛḍhasthitirmataḥ ||74|| tatra kaścid bhaved doṣo vākpāruṣyādiko’pi ca | na grāhyo divya evāsau taddoṣo guṇa eva saḥ ||75|| doṣadṛṣṭistu puruṣo dānavo vāsuro hi saḥ | kṛṣṇe doṣagrāhakaḥ sa nṛnāṭyamanukurvati ||76|| kalyāṇado hariścātra karoti bhaktavāñcchitam | nārīṇāṃ kāmanāpūro narāṇāmiṣṭado’pi ca ||77|| tata daityāḥ kalpayanti svadṛṣṭāntena karmajān | taccaritreṣu divyeṣu śrutimātrāghahāriṣu ||78|| doṣān kāmakrodhalobhān tena te yāntyadhogatim | naitāvatā hareḥ sādhorjagatkalyāṇakāriṇaḥ ||79|| doṣagandho’pi bhavati divyasya paramātmanaḥ | doṣadarśī tvāsuraḥ syāttasmāddoṣaṃ na kalpayet ||3.200.80 || mahatsvapi tu bhakteṣu svalpeṣvapi ca sarvathā | harau yathā tathā doṣaṃ svalpaṃ cāpi na kalpayet ||8 1 || kṛṣṇo divyaḥ kṛṣṇalīlā divyāḥ kalyāṇadāstu tāḥ | santo divyā satāṃ līlā divyāstadvaddhi mokṣadāḥ ||82||| divyā śrībālakṛṣṇasya cājñā tatra ca vartate | yaḥ sa divyo bhavedatra mahāneva mato hi saḥ ||83|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścākṣareśaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | sākṣātprāpto naranāṭyadharo’trājñāpravartakaḥ ||84|| itiniścitya bhaktāstu vartante tadvaco’nvitāḥ | teṣāṃ prasevayā muktirbhavatyevājñayā yathā ||85|| bhaktā ājñāṃkitāḥ santi mokṣārthā mokṣagāminaḥ | saṃsāriṇastvabhaktāste bhavanti viṣayaiṣiṇaḥ ||86|| bhaktānāṃ viṣayāḥ santi nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ | abhaktānāṃ tu viṣayāḥ kāmāsvādanatatparāḥ ||87|| grāmyaṃ gītaṃ rūpamiṣṭaṃ sparśo gandhaśca dehajaḥ | abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ ceti viṣayā viṣayaiṣiṇām ||88|| kṛṣṇagatiṃ kṛṣṇarūpaṃ kṛṣṇasparśo’tisaurabhaḥ | kṛṣṇasya gandha evāpi jalānnaphalabhūṣaṇam ||89|| kṛṣṇaprasādi tulasīdalaṃ cāmbaramityapi | vādyagāyanaśobhādi śṛṃgārahāsyagītikāḥ ||3.200.90|| ramaṇaṃ lāsanaṃ bhāvā bhaktānāṃ bhagavatkṛtāḥ | grāmyāstiṣṭhanti bāhyeṣu bhaktāstiṣṭhanti keśave ||91 || grāmyā hātuṃ na vai śaktā yathā grāmyān prabhogakān | bhaktā hātuṃ na vai śaktāstathā kṛṣṇaprabhogakān ||92|| samādhisthā api bhaktāḥ kurvanti śrīhareḥ kathām | ākṛṣyante guṇe gāne kṛṣṇasyaiva na cetare ||93|| satvasthitau harerdhyānaṃ jāyate śāntikṛt sukham | rājase tāmase bhāve kṛṣṇadhyānaṃ tu durvaham ||94|| dhyeyasphurtirbhavennaiva rājase tāmase hṛdi | bahiḥ kṛṣṇastadā dṛśyo darśanīyo nṛnāṭyadhṛk ||95|| sādhavo darśanīyāśca tadānīṃ bahireva ha | sevanīyā bahirbhāvai rājasaiḥ sukhasampadā ||96|| yadvā cātmasvarūpasya kāryaṃ sucintanaṃ tadā | jñānena līyate bhāvastāmaso rājaso’pi ca ||97|| mano’pi kīśavannaisargikaṃ calaṃ niruddhyate | anirodhe tu satataṃ kīrtanīyo harirbahiḥ ||98|| satālīvādanaṃ kuryāt kṛṣṇakīrtanamuttamam | saṃkalpāstena naśyanti rājasāstāmasāstathā ||99|| satāṃ sevā prakartavyā grāhyā vārtā satāṃ mukhāt | sādhayecchāntimamṛtapradāṃ saṃkīrtanena vai || 3.200.10 0|| āśrayo’tidṛḍhaḥ kṛṣṇe prasādasya pravartakaḥ | āśrayeṇa guṇavegāḥ śāmyanti bhaktayoginaḥ || 101 || viśvāsena prakartavyaścāśrayaḥ paramātmanaḥ | svārthena vā prakartavyaḥ snehena vā parātmanaḥ || 1 02|| jñānena vā prakartavyaścāśrayaḥ paramātmanaḥ | trayaḥ pūrvā nirbalā vai sabalo jñānajāśrayaḥ || 103 || satāṃ vākyeṣu viśvastā āśrayanti hariṃ janāḥ | rājyaiśvaryārogyadhanādyāptyai tu svārthikā janāḥ || 1 04|| rūpasauhārdasambandhasnehena snehino janāḥ | snigdhā bhūtvāśrayantyeva sahante virahaṃ na te || 1 05|| satsaṃgabalato jñātvā māhātmyaṃ paramātmanaḥ | āśrayanti hariṃ jñānivaryāste śāśvatāśrayāḥ || 1 06|| jñāninastu prajānanti hariṃ sarveśvareśvaram | sarvaguṇāguṇādhāraṃ divyamāyādhipaṃ tathā || 1 07|| doṣādoṣāśrayaṃ nyāyānyāyāśrayaṃ prabhuṃ vibhum | aṇuṃ mahāntaṃ dīrghaṃ ca kāmākāmāśrayaṃ tathā || 1 08|| aiśvaryānaiśvaryayuktaṃ bhayābhayasamanvitam | sadasatsarvakośaṃ ca yāvadāścaryasaṃbhṛtam || 1 09|| karmākarmāśrayaṃ cāpi sarvāśrayaṃ yathāyatham | asaṃbhavo harau nāsti yasya kasyāpi sarvathā || 3.200.11 0|| asuṣṭhoścāpi suṣṭhośca mahāśrayo harirhi saḥ | sarvaṃ ghaṭate kṛṣṇe vai sarvaśarīraśāyini || 111 || anvite tatra sarvatra ghaṭate dehavat kriyā | vyatireke’pi sarvaṃ vai ghaṭate māyayojjhitam || 112|| samāye māyayā tulyamamāye nijatulyakam | ghaṭate ca tato nāsyāśraye vighnaṃ prajāyate || 11 3|| evaṃ samāśritaḥ kṛṣṇo jñānena cet pareśvaraḥ | sarvakalānidhiḥ syāt sa sarvādhiśreyasāṃ pradaḥ || 11 4|| āśrayeṇa samastāni kṛtāni sādhanāni vai | bhavantyeva na saṃdehastaṃ prasādhya pramokṣayet || 1 15|| kālīndara sadā jñātvā kurvāśrayaṃ muhurmuhuḥ | śasyasyeva paraṃdhāma bhaja nārāyaṇaṃ harim || 11 6|| ityuktvā prayayau sādhuranyāṃ diśaṃ yathocitām | kālīndarādyā bhejuśca lakṣmi māṃ tadvacaḥsthitāḥ || 1 17|| athāhaṃ nītavām̐stām̐ścākṣaraṃ me paramaṃ padam | dehānte me dṛḍhamāśrayaṃ gatān bhaktibhāginaḥ || 1 18|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇād vartanāttathā | bhuktirmuktirbhavatyeva kṛpayā me rame sadā || 11 9|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne bhāṇḍīragrāmasthasya kālīndarabhāṇḍasya nartakyādisahitasya paramabhaktyā mokṣaṇaṃ kamalāyanamaharṣerupadeśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 200 ||
<3.201> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ bhaktasya nartakasya vai | nāmnā rāyaṇadevasya kathāṃ bhaktividhāyinīm || 1 || ākhoṭake mahāgrāme bhakto rāyaṇadevakaḥ | nyavasat sakuṭumbo vai bhajate sma ca māṃ sadā | | 2 || pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvatraivopatiṣṭhate | prāgjanmani mayūro’bhūd grāmagopurasannidhau || 3 || upaśalyatarau nityanivāsaścarate’bhitaḥ | sādhavo ye samāyānti tairthikā yātrikāśca vai || 4 || vihāriṇaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ye te vāṭe grāmamāpya ca | taruṣaṇḍe’vatiṣṭhantyāsate dinadvayaṃ ca vā || 5 || bhajanaṃ tatra kurvanti pācayanti ca bhuñjate | niveditaṃ haraye te jalaṃ pibanti sarvathā || 6 || ucchiṣṭāni ca pātrāṇi patrāṇi ca jalānnakam | kṣipanti taruṣaṇḍeṣu sthitapakṣyarthamityapi || 7 || ucchiṣṭānnāni pānīyaṃ paśavaḥ pakṣiṇastathā | kīṭādyā bhakṣayantyāpaḥ pibanti ca viyanti ca || 8 || hareḥ prasādānnavāri mayūro’tti pibatyapi | sādhoḥ prāsādikaṃ cāpi samyak pibati cātti ca || 9 || evaṃ prasādamāptasya tasya supuṇyamūrjitam | pāpaṃ tu pralayaṃ prāptaṃ mṛtaḥ kālena so’bhavat || 3.201.10 || hārītakākhyaśūdrasya patnyāṃ kastūrikāstriyām | garbhe viveśa puṇyena pakṣī mānavajanmavān || 11 || garbhe vāsottaraṃ tatrāṣṭame māsi subhaktimān | bodhāyano maharṣiśca sādhudharmā samāyayau || 1 2|| vipro bhikṣākṛte’gācca hārītakagṛhaṃ tadā | hārītakaḥ prārthayacca jñātvā daivajñabhūsuram || 1 3|| gṛhṇa bhikṣāṃ pāyasānnaṃ ghṛtaṃ ca śarkarāstathā | sthiro bhavātra divase saṃśayānme nirākuru || 14|| ityuktvā pradadau bhikṣāṃ miṣṭamannaṃ ghṛtaṃ payaḥ | piṣṭaṃ phalāni madhūni cāsanaṃ jalamuttamam || 19|| bodhāyanaḥ pācayitvā nivedya paramātmane | bubhuje’tha prasādaṃ ca śeṣaṃ sarvaṃ dadau tadā || 16|| hārītakakuṭumbāya bubhuje’pi kuṭumbakam | sāyaṃ svāsthye sthiravṛttau papraccha taṃ mahāmunim || 17|| patnyā garbhe bālako vā bālā vā kiṃ bhavediti | kathaṃguṇaṃ madapatyaṃ bhaviṣyatīti me vad || 18|| cirāyurvāpi vai svalpāyuśca bhakto bhavenna vā | kathaṃ nārāyaṇe deve bhaktiḥ śraddhā bhavedapi || 1 9|| kathaṃ mokṣo divyatā ca kathaṃ nārāyaṇāśrayaḥ | kathaṃ sādhoḥ prasaṃgaśca sevā dharmāvalambanam ||3.201.20|| kathaṃ muktiḥ kathaṃ tyāgaḥ kathaṃ saṃsāranāśanam | kathaṃ caiśvaratā syācca muktatā gṛhamedhinaḥ || 21 || ityetāni samastānyamṛtāni me prapāyaya | ityuktaḥ sādhuvaryastu bodhāyano hi bhaktarāṭ ||22|| pratyuvāca kuṭumbasya sannidhau yatra garbhiṇī | vartate sā śṛṇotyeva kathāṃ paramapāvanīm || 23|| śṛṇu hārītaka tvaṃ vai patnī te ca śṛṇotvapi | kuṭumbaṃ te śṛṇotvatra hitaṃ vacmi hitottamam ||24||| bālakaste hi bhavitā putraścoddhārakṛcchubhaḥ | sādhubhakto harerbhaktaḥ pūrvasaṃskāravāniha || 25|| mayūravat samastāni nṛtyāni prakariṣyati | sādhuprasādabhoktā ca cirāyurbhaktimān sadā ||26|| muktiṃ tava kuṭumbasya bhaktyā sa vai kariṣyati | lakṣmīpradaste satataṃ bhāgyaśālī bhaviṣyati || 27|| nārāyaṇapradaścāpi vaiṣṇavaḥ sa bhaviṣyati | parātparatare kṛṣṇe mahānandanidhau prabhau ||28|| lagnavṛttirhi bhavitā cābālyāttava bālakaḥ | prāgjanmāsya mayūrasya tato nṛtyakalāvidām ||29|| mūrdhanyo’yaṃ tava putro bhaviṣyati prabhaktarāṭ | tasya nṛtye ca ye nṛtyavido janāstathāpare ||3.201.3 0|| nartakyaścāpi sarvāśca miliṣyanti kalāvidaḥ | sarve tvatputrasaṃgena bhaviṣyantyapi vaiṣṇavāḥ ||3 1 || mokṣamārge śrayiṣyanti yāsyanti paramaṃ padam | api jīvā māyikā vai māyāsṛṣṭe jagatyapi |||2|| vartante bahavo nityaṃ nṛtyagītivilāsinaḥ | pūrvaṃ nārāyaṇenedaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ jagad yadā tadā ||33|| jagatpravāhasiddhyarthaṃ snehapāśo’pi nirmitaḥ | snehabaddhamidaṃ sarvaṃ kalayā bhramate jagat ||34|| narāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ prītiḥ sāhajikī tayā bhavet | snehasya kalayā putre patyau vitte gṛhe striyām ||35|| vāṭyāṃ kṣetre paśau lābhe kuṭumbe jāyate hi sā | prasvāṃ pitari māyaiva nihitā viśvavarddhinī ||36|| tādṛśyā māyayā baddhā jīvāḥ kalāvido’pi ye | tava putraṃ miliṣyanti te bhaviṣyanti vaiṣṇavāḥ ||37|| tava putrasya yogena bhaktiṃ mokṣapradāyinīm | kariṣyanti hareryogaṃ pralapsyanti ca nartane ||38|| māyāparo yo bhagavān janānāṃ śreyase bhuvi | āvirbhūya sadā cāste taṃ te bālo bhajiṣyati ||39|| pūrvapuṇyayutā lokā bhajiṣyanti hariṃ tadā | taruṣaṇḍe ca ye pakṣipaśavaśca tarumṛgāḥ ||3.201.40 || mṛtā ye te’bhitaścātra sādhuprasādabhojinaḥ | mānuṣyaṃ prāpya vartante pāvanāḥ puṇyayoginaḥ ||41 || sarve te vai nartakāśca gāyakā vādakā api | grāme’tra paragrāme vā jātāste vaiṣṇavottamāḥ ||42|| prākśrīkṛṣṇatadīyekṣāprasādādiprabhoginaḥ | saṃskāriṇaḥ prajātāste grāme’tra bālakāḥ śubhāḥ ||43 || teṣāṃ satāṃ prasaṃgena harervārtāśraveṇa ca | kṛṣṇabhaktirvartate ca vartiṣyate dṛḍhādhikā ||44|| te ca sarve militvaiva kariṣyanti satāṃ hareḥ | sevāṃ bhaktiṃ bhṛtyatāṃ ca paricaryāṃ pramokṣadām ||45|| śraddhāvanto bhaviṣyanti sarve te kṛpayā satām | atiprītiṃ gamiṣyanti sādhau ca parameśvare ||46|| samarthāśca bhaviṣyanti svīyasnigdhān parānapi | bhavapāśānmocayituṃ prītiṃ kārayituṃ harau ||47|| tena saṅkṣyanti vai tucchasukhe susādhuyoginaḥ | dṛḍhāḥ sarve satāṃ saṃge hareḥ saṃge’tiniṣṭhitāḥ || 48|| māyānāśakarāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti virāgiṇaḥ | bhaktyantarāyakṛtsarvaṃ tyakṣyanti brahmaniṣṭhitāḥ ||49|| cireṇa māṃ prasādyaiva phalamāpsyanti śāśvatam | akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ divyaṃ divyasvarūpiṇaḥ ||3.201.50 || satāṃ prasaṃgato bhaktirvardhate paramātmani | satāṃ prasaṃgato jñānaṃ jāyate paramātmanaḥ ||51 || harermāhātmyavijñānaiḥ śraddhā nityaṃ pravardhate | vivekena harau nityaṃ divyatā bhāsate na vā |||52|| satsu prakāśate cāpi divyatā bhagavannibhā | vivekena bhavet kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe dṛḍhāśrayaḥ ||53|| tasyāśrayeṇāśrayiṇāmāśrayo jāyate satām | sadācāraratasyaiva satsevāṃ kurvato bhavet ||54|| mahābhāgavatadharmālambanaṃ sevanādi ca | sevayā satataṃ pravartate kṛpā satāṃ hareḥ ||55|| kṛpayā muktatā tyāgaḥ saṃsāravilayastathā | nārāyaṇena tādātmyaṃ jāyate dhyānato hareḥ ||56|| aikāgryaṃ ca nirodhaśca samādhirjāyate harau | sarvānandamahānandabhogo’sya jāyate’niśam ||17|| tasmāt santo bhojanīyāḥ sevanīyā jalānnakaiḥ | kāryā ca dāsavat sevā dāsīvad bhṛtyavattathā ||58|| patnīvat putravaccāpi sevā kāryā satāṃ sadā | pitṛvanmātṛvaccāpi mānanīyāśca rājavat ||56|| svāmivat pativad bhrātṛvacca rakṣakavattathā | sevanīyāḥ sadā santo hariprasaṃgayoginaḥ ||3.201.60 || prasādanīyāḥ tato’tra vandanīyā muhurmuhuḥ | kṣamāpanīyāḥ satataṃ toṣaṇīyāstu devavat ||6 1 || pūjanīyā hi santo’tra rakṣaṇīyāstu putravat | satāṃ prasannatāṃ prāpya bhuktirmuktirbhavediha ||62|| satāmājñāṃ samālambya vartanīyaṃ hi satpathe | sarvato’pi samākṛṣyendriyāntaḥkaraṇāni ca ||63|| nidhātavyāni kṛṣṇe vai vrajeyuḥ kupathaṃ na yat | kupathaṃ ced vrajeyuśca samākṛṣya drutaṃ tadā ||64|| haṭhāt kṛṣṇe prayojyāni sukhade parameśvare | yādṛṅmānaṃ nyūnabhāvaṃ māhātmyaṃ śrīharerbhavet ||65|| tādṛgbalaṃ tu viṣaye yātyantaḥkaraṇaṃ bahiḥ | nyūnatāparihārārthaṃ kāryaḥ saṃgaḥ satāṃ sadā ||66|| kṛṣṇe eva ruciḥ sādhyā heyaḥ saṃgastu cāparaḥ | kupathe vrajato bhītiḥ kṛṣṇapathe tu nirbhayam ||67|| kṛṣṇaprāptau dehināṃ tu prāptavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate | kṛṣṇānandaparaḥ kaścidānando nāvaśiṣyate ||68|| taṃ hariṃ ced vihāyātra tucchasaukhyasya labdhaye | yatante cettadā bodhyā te janāstu bubhukṣavaḥ ||69|| saṃsāriṇasta evoktā nirayārthaṃ prajanminaḥ | lumpanti bhagavadvāṇīṃ satāmājñāṃ vahanti na ||3.201.70 || te prāpnuvanti satataṃ kleśaṃ tucchārthadhāvinaḥ | yadyapi syurbuddhimanto bahuśrutāḥ pratarkiṇaḥ ||71 || atha yaḥ svalpadhīścāpi sevate śrīhariṃ sataḥ | śreyo’dhvānaṃ śrayate’tra vartate satpumarthake ||92|| sadguṇān gṛhṇate nityaṃ sādhūnāṃ bhaktiyoginām | bhāgavataṃ mahādhvānaṃ divyaṃ samadhitiṣṭhati ||73|| sa eva buddhimān proktaḥ svarthamokṣaparāyaṇaḥ | sa eva sādhurevokto mokṣārthakṛtaniścayaḥ ||74|| bahubuddhistu nirayaṃ gamiṣyati prabhogavān | tucchārthadhāvanaparaḥ sādhumārgavinindakaḥ ||75|| hareḥ satāṃ guṇānāṃ sa dūṣako nāstikaḥ khalaḥ | dhiyā dūṣitayā prāpnotyeva pāpaṃ yamālayam ||76|| kṣīraṃ śarkarayā yuktaṃ viṣāktaṃ ced vināśakṛt | tathā dhīrdūṣitā śreyovighātinī mahatyapi ||77|| tayā yuktaḥ patatyeva drogdhā janmāntare bhavet | sadgatirna bhavettasya tatsaṃgino’pi naiva ca ||78|| na cāyaṃ bhāṣaṇayogyaḥ pātayatyeva bhāṣaṇāt | avaguṇān darśayitvā mālinyaṃ nidadhātyataḥ ||79|| alpamatirbhāvayuktaḥ sevakaḥ saṃgamocitaḥ | gṛhṇannāśīrvacāṃsyeva śreyomārge sthito hi saḥ ||3.201.80|| mānaṃ kapaṭaṃ krodhaṃ ca tatherṣyāṃ prajahāti yaḥ | sādhūnāṃ dāsabhāvena sevako vartate tu yaḥ ||81 || divyabhāvaṃ vidan satsu satāṃ kriyāsu sarvathā | sa evaṃ sādhuratroktaḥ sarvathā sevanocitaḥ ||82|| sa eko’nugrahapātraṃ satā hareśca sarvathā | āśritānāṃ samuddhārakartā hyapi pratāpavān ||83|| sa eva mokṣadaḥ syādvai yathā santo hariryathā | anyastvāsurabuddhirvai bhūtaḥ preto bhavediha ||84|| rākṣaso drohakartā vā bhaved daityo hi pāpakṛt| | naiva muktirbhavettasya drohiṇo vai hareḥ satām || 85|| vairabhāvena kṛṣṇe sa yujyate ca cireṇa vā | anugraheṇa kṛṣṇasya kvacijjahāti daityatām ||86|| tataḥ kālāntare kṛṣṇakṛpayā vaiti sadgatim | tasmāttucche padārthe tu prītiḥ kāryā na sarvathā ||87| | harau satsu sadā kāryā prītiḥ sevānuvṛttitā | yasya sarvaṃ jagat svarṇaṃ loṣṭhaṃ samaṃ divaṃ ca bhūḥ ||88 || sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ yasya taṃ praseveta dāsavat | dāsīvat sampraseveta sādhvī nārāyaṇī bhavet ||89| | ityevamupadiśyātha lakṣmi bodhāyano muniḥ | yayau deśāntaraṃ prāpya pūjāṃ kālena vai tataḥ ||3.201.90|| kastūrikā sutaṃ divyaṃ suṣuve bhaktayoginam | bodhāyanoktaṃ vijñānaṃ garbhe yaḥ śrutavān param ||91|| sarvajñānena sahito jajñe putraḥ pratāpavān | bhaktiṃ cakre hi bālyāt sa nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ tathā ||92|| kathāṃ cakre vivekāḍhyāṃ pūjāṃ karoti nityadā | bhajanaṃ kīrtanaṃ cakre sarvāṃ kṛṣṇamayīṃ kriyām ||93|| atha bodhāyano draṣṭuṃ samāyātaḥ punastvimam | bhaktaṃ vilokya śiṣyaṃ taṃ nāmnā rāyaṇadevakam ||94|| mumude dīkṣayāmāsa śataśiṣyairyutaṃ ca tam | śataśiṣyābhirevāpi sahitaṃ rāyaṇaṃ muniḥ ||95|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | dīkṣāṃ bhāgavatīṃ mantraṃ datvā muniryayau vanam ||96|| sarve rāyaṇadevādyā nartakāḥ sādhavastathā | gāyakāścāpi sādhvyaśca bhejurmāṃ nṛtyakīrtanaiḥ ||97|| sahasraśo janāścaiṣāṃ śiṣyāśca puruṣāḥ striyaḥ | sañjātā vaiṣṇavā lakṣmi mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ||98 || samāje tvekadā tebhyo darśanaṃ paramaṃ dadau | ahaṃ sākaṃ śriyā lakṣmyā nārāyaṇaścaturbhujaḥ ||99|| taiśca sampūjitaścāhaṃ pāyayāmāsa pajjalam | tebhyo muktiṃ divyagatiṃ dadau brahmamayīṃ parām || 3.201.100 || tacchiṣyāśca praśiṣyāśca vartante bhūtale’pare | te bhajante’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhuṃ ca mām ||1 01 || evaṃ mayā sāghuyogānnartakaścoddhṛto rame | uddhṛtāścāpi nartakyo mokṣamārgaṃ praṇoditāḥ || 1 02||| evaṃ mama balaṃ bhakteḥ sādhoḥ sevābalaṃ tathā | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavediha || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne rāyaṇadevasya nartakasya bodhāyanopadeśena garbhasthasya vijñānaṃ bhaktiśca haridarśanaṃ mokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||20 1 ||
<3.202> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ gāyakasya mahātmanaḥ | vratardinaḥ kathāṃ ramyāṃ mama prasannatānvitām || 1 || vratardīṃ tvabhavadbhakto nākirālākhyapattane | vaiśyo vīṇāmṛdaṃgādiyāvadvādyaviśāradaḥ || 2 || yasyāgre bahavaḥ śiṣyāḥ śiṣyikāśca vasantyapi | abhyāsārthaṃ gānakalādīnāṃ gāyanaśīlinaḥ || 3 || deśadeśāntarebhyaśca samāyānti vratardinam | gānavidyādhipaṃ śrutvā śikṣāṃ prāpya prayānti ca || 4 || atha rājābhavannimbaṭikānagarīśāsakaḥ | puṇḍravarmā dharmavām̐śca bhagavadbhaktitatparaḥ || 5 || saurāṣṭre gāyakaśreṣṭhaṃ śrutvā vratardinaṃ nṛpaḥ | āhvayāmāsa gītyarthaṃ rājadhānīṃ nijāṃ prati || 6 || dūto gatvāvedayattaṃ gāyakaṃ rājabhāṣitam | ehi rājotsave rājetyāha tvāṃ gāyakottama || 7 || vratardī pratyuvācetthaṃ na rājotsavagāyanam | kariṣye bhagavadbhakto bhavāmyātmanivedanaḥ || 8 || vinā hariṃ na me jivhā gāsyatyanyaṃ kadācana | vinā hariṃ na me netraṃ drakṣyatyanyaṃ kadācana || 9 || vinā hariṃ na me cittaṃ dhyāyatyanyaṃ kadācana | bhagavataśca bhaktānāṃ bhakto’haṃ dāsyasaṃhitaḥ || 3.202.10 || so’haṃ kathaṃ rājaguṇān gāyāmi māyikāniha | vada tvaṃ bhūbhṛte dūta nānyaṃ gāsyati gāyakaḥ || 11 || vratardī gāyakaḥ kṛṣṇagāyako nānyagāyakaḥ | mokṣagāyaka evāste bhaktānāmapi gāyakaḥ || 1 2|| abhaktānāṃ gāyako na vratardī bhavati kvacit | iti pratyuktadūtaśca yayau rājñe nyavedayat || 1 3|| rājā tutoṣa sahasā dhanyo’haṃ bhūpatiḥ sadā | mama rājye mahābhāgavato’sti kṛṣṇagāyakaḥ || 14|| mayā bhāgavatenāpi bhavitavyaṃ pramuktaye | vaiṣṇavena bhavitavyaṃ śrotavyaṃ kīrtanaṃ tataḥ || 15|| vratardinā pragītaṃ ca kṛṣṇakīrtanamuttamam | śrotavyaṃ sarvathā paścād bhūtvā satpātrabhūbhṛtā || 1 6|| vicāryetthaṃ prāha dūtaṃ bhāvyaṃ bhaktimatā mayā | tasmādāgaccha gehaṃ me māṃ prapāvaya bhūbhṛtam || 17|| kṛtvā ca vaiṣṇavaṃ bhaktaṃ tataḥ śrāvaya kīrtanam | ityevaṃ brūhi bhakteśaṃ vratardinaṃ prayāhi ca || 18|| śrutvā dūto yayau śīghraṃ rājoktaṃ tu vratardine | kathayāmāsa sarvaṃ sa śrutvā tutoṣa gāyakaḥ || 1 9|| sajjo bhūtvā yayau bhūpamandiraṃ gaṇamaṇḍitaḥ | rājā taṃ mānayāmāsa bhaktaṃ vratardinaṃ muhuḥ || 3.202.20 || yayāce tu tato vaiṣṇavatvaṃ ca dīkṣaṇaṃ nṛpaḥ | vratardī tūrṇamāśrutya dhṛtvā datvā jalaṃ kare || 21 || nṛpāya pradadau mantraṃ śrāvayāmāsa satvaram | omanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me ||22|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | rājā gṛhītvā mantraṃ ca kaṇṭhīṃ dadhāra taulasīm |||23|| mūrtiṃ me bālakṛṣṇasya jagṛhe gāyakārpitām | rājñī kanyāśca putrāśca rājñaḥ kuṭumbakaṃ tathā ||24|| sarve bhṛtyāstathā dāsyo’bhavam̐statra hi vaiṣṇavāḥ | haraye cārpitaṃ vāri phalaṃ cānnaṃ ca candanam ||25|| vratardī pradadau rājakuṭumbāya prasādakam | bhuktvā pītvā prasādaṃ ca sabhāṃ cakre tato nṛpaḥ ||26||| madhyasiṃhāsane kṛṣṇamasthāpayat suśobhitam | rājā kṛṣṇasya sevāyāṃ dhṛtvā chatramanuttamam || 27|| atiṣṭhattatkuṭumbaṃ ca cāmare vyajane tathā | vetraṃ ca naktakaṃ dhūpapātraṃ dhvajaṃ patākikām ||28|| darpaṇaṃ pānapātraṃ ca tāmbūlapātrakaṃ tathā | sugandhasārapātraṃ ca tailasāraṃ ca candanam ||29|| pūjāpātraṃ puṣpahārān dhṛtvātiṣṭhad yathāyatham | pūjayitvā bālakṛṣṇaṃ vratardī gāyanaṃ vyadhāt || 3.202.30|| ehi kṛṣṇa ehi kṛṣṇa kānta ehi ehi | dehi kṛṣṇa dehi kṛṣṇa darśanaṃ sudehin ||3 1 || navīnabhaktamaṇḍalaṃ vidhehi divyasatkulam | jahīhi janmavāsanāṃ pradehi dhāmavāsanam || ehi kṛṣṇa || 32|| tvameva muktasatpatistvameva dhāmasadgatiḥ | tvameva cāvatāradhṛk tvameva sarvasākṣadṛk || ehi kṛṣṇa ||33|| purā bhavān pumuttamastato bhavānnarottamaḥ | tato bhavān janārdanastato’sti sarvamardanaḥ || ehi kṛṣṇa ||34|| prasannamānaso bhavān susampadāṃ prado bhavān | nijārthyasaukhyado bhavān nijātmaśāntido bhavān || ehi kṛṣṇa ||35|| rādhāramāpatirbhavān pramāsatīpatirbhavān | satāṃ śriyāḥ patirbhavām̐śca māṇikīpatirbhavān || ehi kṛṣṇa ||36|| brahmapriyāpatirbhavān haripriyāpatirbhavān | ajāprajāpatirbhavān vratardinaḥ patirbhavān || ehi kṛṣṇa ||37|| nidhiśca tejasāṃ bhavān nidhiścamatkṛtāṃ bhavān | nidhiḥ parāmudā bhavān nidhiḥ parāvidāṃ bhavān || ehi kṛṣṇa ||38|| suto vṛṣasya vai bhavān sutaśca gopajo bhavān | sutaśca kāśyapo bhavām̐śca kambharāsuto bhavān || ehi kṛṣṇa ||39|| sadaiva citsu vartase’pyacitsu vartase hare | pravartase pravartase svabhaktamaṇḍale hare || ehi kṛṣṇa ehi kṛṣṇa kānta ehi ehi | dehi kṛṣṇa dehi kṛṣṇa darśanaṃ sudehin ||3.202.40|| ityevaṃ māṃ prārthayat sa lakṣmi gītipramaṃgalam | akaronmāṃ smaram̐statra vratardī premapūritaḥ ||41 || gāyikā gāyakāścāpyapūrayan gītikāsvarān | śrutvāhaṃ premaraśanākṛṣṭo mūrterdrutaṃ bahiḥ ||42|| āvirjāto’tisubhago manoharaḥ suyauvanaḥ | rūparūpānurūpaścāvayavaiḥ puṣṭa ujjvalaḥ ||43|| śriyā ca rādhayā yukto hāramukuṭaśobhitaḥ | sarvābhūṣābhirāmaśca sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhanaḥ ||44|| prasannahāsyavadano divyatejo’bhidīpitaḥ | sarvasugandhavātsalyalāvaṇyānandasaṃbhṛtaḥ ||45|| sarvakāmaprapūraśca sabhānandavivardhanaḥ | nirodhayan sabhāsthānāṃ cetāṃsi mayi saṃsthitaḥ ||46|| akṣare parame vyomni yatsukhaṃ paramātmanaḥ | tatsamastaṃ sabhāsthebhyo dadau kṣaṇaṃ kṛpāvaśaḥ ||47|| divyatāyāstirobhāvaṃ kṣaṇottaraṃ vyadhāṃ rame | rādhāramāyutaṃ māṃ te vyalokayan nṛpādayaḥ ||48|| mumuhurmama rūpe te hṛtsu nyadhuśca māṃ hi te | pupūjuḥ sarvabhāvaiśca varārthaṃ noditāśca te ||49|| vavrurmuktiṃ parāṃ sevāmadadāṃ ca tathāstviti | tirobhāvaṃ drutaṃ cāpi sabhāścaryaparābhavat ||3.202.50|| vratardinaḥ pratāpena hyavāpuḥ kṛṣṇadarśanam | bhejuste māṃ divyabhāvairananyabhāvanaiḥ sadā ||51 || pātivratyena māṃ bhejurnṛpādyā vaiṣṇavāstataḥ | parihāro’bhavad bhakto mumude darśanānmama |||52|| pāritoṣikamāsādya yayau samaṇḍalo nijam | ālayaṃ sa vitardī vai nṛpo nṛpālayaṃ yayau ||53|| atha kāle tataḥ prāpte nṛpādīn bhaktamaṇḍalam | ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ me ca vratardimaṇḍalaṃ tathā ||54|| tathā ye ye vaiṣṇavāścābhavan vai lakṣaśo janāḥ | camatkāraṃ smaranto me bhajanto māṃ nirantaram ||55|| ninye tānmekṣaraṃ lokaṃ śāśvataṃ dhāma cottamam | śṛṇu lakṣmi janā loke bhavanti tyāgavṛttayaḥ ||56|| tīvratyāgavirāgasya sneho mayyatiśobhate | rāgiṇastu smṛtirnityaṃ viṣayāṇāṃ prajāyate ||57|| tucchārthasnehabaddhāste kṛṣṇasnehaṃ na kurvate | kṛṣṇe snehavihīnāste mokṣaṃ phalaṃ na yanti vai ||58|| tasmāt snehaḥ sadā kāryo mayi śrīparamātmani | hātavyaścāntyajaḥ sneho mama māhātmyavedinā ||59|| ātmajñānena ca tyājyaḥ sneho māyikavastuṣu | ātmāyaṃ saccidānando jaḍādbhinnaḥ śarīrataḥ ||3.202.60 || nāsya deho na saudhaśca na kuṭumbaṃ na vāṭikāḥ | na jātirna kulaṃ yogo dhanaṃ nāsya ca sampadaḥ ||61 || māyāhīno bhavāmyevetyātmānaṃ cintayet sadā | etādṛśaṃ nijaṃ matvā daihikaṃ nahi saṃsmaret ||62|| kuṭumbino na smartavyāḥ pūrvajāścādyajā api | bhagavadbhaktihīnā ye ye tu bandhanakāriṇaḥ ||63|| yatsmṛtyā bandhanaṃ vai syāt smartavyā na tathā kvacit | śrāddhakāle prasmartavyāstṛptyarthaṃ muktaye’pi ca ||64|| yajñe dāne tīrthakārye dharmakārye vratādiṣu | smartavyāstṛptaye teṣāṃ muktaye mandire hareḥ ||65|| anyathā rāgavaśataḥ smartavyā na kadācana | smartavyāḥ sādhavo divyāḥ smartavyāḥ pratimā mama ||66|| brahmapriyāstathā sādhvyaḥ smartavyā mokṣasiddhaye | jñānibhirjñānavijñānairvismartavyāstu bāndhavāḥ ||67|| bandhanasya pradā nāryo narāścāpi kuṭumbinaḥ | viṣayā mokṣavighnāśca vismartavyāḥ samastataḥ ||68|| brahmadṛṣṭyā yena sarve putrādyā vismṛtāḥ khalu | tasya prītirharau syācca mokṣapradeṣu satsu ca ||69|| sarvai santo bhavantyeva divyā brahmanivāsinaḥ | yathā haristathā santaḥ smartavyā mokṣadā hi te ||3.202.70|| āśrayaṇīyāḥ satataṃ sādhavaśca haristathā | bhajanīyaḥ svayaṃ sākṣāddhariścāhaṃ janārdanaḥ ||71 || evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya bhīrna kālasya karmaṇām | māyāyā yamarājasya bhīrnāpi bandhanasya ca ||72|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchā bhaktayoginaḥ | prārabdhaṃ khalu mantavyaṃ netarat pāpijīvavat ||72|| etādṛśaḥ pravandyo vai sarveṣāṃ pūjya eva saḥ | gṛhastho vā yatirvā sa viśeṣo nātra vidyate ||74|| evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya samaloṣṭhādikasya ca | pattalābjarajo mūrdhnā dhārayanti surādayaḥ ||75|| sarvadā ca surairasya darśanaṃ kriyate prage | mama pratāpamālambya kurvan bhaktiṃ sthito gṛhe ||76|| tyāge bā prasthitaścāyaṃ pāraṃ yātyañjasāmbudheḥ | etādṛśo mama bhakto dehānte cinmayākṛtiḥ ||77|| brahmamukto divyadehaḥ sevāyāṃ dhāmni me bhavet | tasya vai darśanaṃ māyāpāpakālādināśakṛt ||78|| karmanāśakaraṃ lakṣmi tulyaṃ mamekṣayā matam | sarvakriyā madarthaṃ vai yasya tasyāhamacyutaḥ ||79|| sarvathā tu vaśībhūtaḥ pravarte tasya gocaraḥ | yo bhakto yaddināllakṣmi satsaṃgaṃ prakaroti vai ||3.202.8 0|| tata āramya kurute vivekaṃ guṇadoṣayoḥ | īdṛgguṇān labdhavām̐śca tyaktavān durguṇānimān ||8 1|| prativarṣaṃ vyatirekaṃ vicintayati lābhakṛt | satsaṃgasya pratāpena satāṃ hareśca sevayā ||82|| guṇāḥ prāptā ime sarve doṣā gatāśca te mama | śeṣāṇāṃ khalu doṣāṇāṃ nāśane yatnavān bhavet ||83|| śeṣāṇāṃ sadguṇānāṃ saṃgrahaṇe yatnavān bhavet | evaṃ prayatnaśīlasya guṇāḥ syurmama tuṣṭidāḥ ||84|| doṣāṇāṃ prakṣayaḥ syācca divyatātra bhavettathā | kṛṣṇasukhaṃ cottamaṃ ca jāyate’sya hi śāśvatam ||85|| mano nirvāsanaṃ syācca niḥsaṃkalpaṃ sthiraṃ bhavet | anekeṣu caritreṣu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya me ||86|| manaścāvartayennityaṃ ramamāṇaṃ mayi kriyāt | mahāśāntimayaṃ syād yat tyāgināṃ gṛhiṇāmapi ||87|| dehayātrāmātrarūpo vyavahārastu bāhyataḥ | kartavyo naṭavallakṣmi mano dhāryaṃ harau mayi ||88|| caritrāṇi satāṃ nārāyaṇasya kṛṣṇayoṣitām | bhaktānāṃ śrīhareścāpi cintanīyāni sarvadā ||89|| mano nirvāsanaṃ tena bhavenmokṣe yathā sukham | teṣāṃ samāgamaḥ kāryo mokṣakṛd yatphalaṃ bhavet ||3.202.90 || vratardinaḥ prasaṃgena gāyakasya nṛpottamaḥ | puṇḍravarmā yayau muktiṃ tathānye ca sahasraśaḥ ||91 || ataḥ sevyā mama bhaktāḥ satyāśconmūlitāśayāḥ | divyakriyā mama dhyānaparāścāśritatārakāḥ ||92|| antarāyavihīnāśca sarvavighnavivarjitāḥ | dharmaṃ bhāgavataṃ divyaṃ mama sevāṃ samāśritāḥ ||9 3|| satāmāśrayakaraṇāt prasannatāsamarjanāt | ājñānuvṛttikaraṇāddhāmākṣaraṃ kare bhavet ||94|| evaṃ lakṣmi bhūtale vā svarge satye vikuṇṭhake | goloke cākṣare śvetadvīpe śrīpurake’mṛte ||95|| avyākṛte badaryāṃ vā ye vartante madāśritāḥ | muktā muktānikāḥ sarve sarvasvārpaṇakṛṣṇakāḥ ||96|| śāśvatānandabhoktārastathā vratardigāyakāḥ | sarve muktiṃ mama prāptāḥ śāśvaṃtānandasevinaḥ ||97|| ye ye kalāvido loke’rpayanti tatkalā mayi | te te yāntyakṣaraṃ dhāma kṛpayā me na saṃśayaḥ ||98|| yeṣāmagre ca yo dharmo guṇaḥ kalā kriyā tathā | sādhanaṃ śrīhariṃ prasādayituṃ vai svakaṃ bhavet ||99|| tena prasādanīyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | prasādanīyāḥ santaśca naraiśca yoṣitāṃgaṇaiḥ ||3.202.1 00|| tadā divyo bhaved bhāvo deho manastathāntaram | guṇāḥ kriyā vartanaṃ ca sevā divyāḥ samastataḥ | | 101 || harerbhūtvā hariṃ prāpya modate sa samarpakaḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇāllakṣmi tathaiva modate mayi || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vratardināmakagāyakabhaktasya yogena puṇḍravarmanṛpasya saprajasya vaiṣṇavatvaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 202 ||
<3.203> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ vāyakasya kathāṃ śubhām | dhurilākhye pure nāmnā tūlavāyīti vāyakaḥ || 1 || nyavasat sakuṭumbo’yaṃ rājaprajādṛtaḥ sadā | sūkṣmatantvādivayane kuśalaḥ sūtranirmitau || 2 || sūkṣmātisūkṣmasūtrāṇi nirmāti kalayā nakhaiḥ | sūtrayantreṇa ca lūtātantusamā hi tantavaḥ || 3 || jjāyante kalayā tasya sūkṣmātisūkṣmapeśalāḥ | ambare tasya tantūnāṃ nirmitaṃ dhāryate’mbaram || 4 || dṛśyate naiva kiraṇeṣvevaṃ tanu prajāyate | svarṇormikāyāṃ śāṭīṃ ca prasārayituṃ śakyate || 5 || dhotraṃ tathottarīyaṃ coṣṇīśaṃ tādṛk prajāyate | rājñīveṣārhavastrāṇi tattantubhyo bhavanti vai || 6 || vāyako’yaṃ turīṃ vemānaṃ ca saṃyojikāṃ tathā | śalākāṃ ceti sūkṣmāṇi vayane saṃyunakti hi || 7 || sūkṣmatamāḥ sūkṣmatarā sūkṣmāśca sūkṣmasadṛśāḥ | sthūlasūkṣmā madhyasthūlāḥ sthūlāḥ sthūlatarāstathā || 8 || sthūlatamā jāḍyagātrāstantavaḥ saṃbhavanti vai | phālikā vividhā ramyāḥ kukaṭyaḥ saṃbhavanti ca || 9 || peṭikāścāpi tantūnāṃ śālāyāṃ tūlavāyinaḥ | utpadyante karajaiśca yantratarkaṭikādibhiḥ || 3.203.10|| ranṭakairbhramacakraiśca jāyante tantavaḥ śubhāḥ | nāryo narā hi bahavo bahvyaśca karmacārikāḥ ||1 1 || utpādayanti sūtrāṇi kārpāsānyaparāṇi ca | samanāḍikasūtrāṇi yathārthavalayāni ca || 1 2|| anyūnānatiriktāni granthitrūṭīviyuñji ca | sthūlasūkṣmādidoṣaiśca varjitāni śubhāni ca || 13|| eteṣāmeva tantūnāṃ prāyo vastrāṇi vai prajāḥ | rājānaḥ śreṣṭhinaścāpi dhārayantīti viśrutam || 14|| tūlavāyimahāmudrā mudryate mānavardhinī | sūtreṣu tajjavastreṣu śraiṣṭhyaṃ pradyotate sadā || 15|| evaṃvidhastūlavāyī viśālakāryakārakaḥ | tathāpi sarvakāryeṣu mama bhaktiṃ cakāra saḥ || 16|| yantreṣu śrīkṛṣṇanāma sādhaneṣvāyaseṣvapi | śrīkṛṣṇanāma sarvatra phālikākukaṭīṣvapi || 17|| vāse bhittau ca śālāyāṃ mudritaṃ kṛṣṇanāma ha | karmacārāḥ samastāśca karmacāriṇya ityapi || 18|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāma gṛṇanti hi | tūlavāyī svayaṃ nityaṃ bhajate māṃ narāyaṇam || 1 9|| snātvā prapūjya māṃ paścādudyame cānurohati | prasādaṃ mama naivedyaṃ cānnaṃ jalaṃ phalādikam ||3.203.20|| bhuṃkte kuṭumbasahitaścātmanivedivat sadā | vastrapātrāsanādyāni nivedya me yunakti ca ||21 || evaṃvidho bhaktarāṇme bhajate māṃ samāhitaḥ | athāyaṃ vāyako yantre’navadhānatayā drutam ||22|| cakravege gatahastaḥ patitaścūrṇitaḥ kare | skandhāt karaḥ pṛthagjāto mūrchito mama bhaktarāṭ ||23 || sasmāra māṃ drutaṃ so’pi hṛdi rakṣāmayācata | karmacārāḥ samastāśca jñātvā me nāmakīrtanam ||24|| cakruḥ pārśve samāgatya tatrāhaṃ cauṣadhapradaḥ | kuśalo vaidyarāṭ bhūtvā cikitsakaḥ samāgataḥ ||25|| sandhinīṃ raktarodhāṃ ca poṣiṇīṃ sthitisthāpikām | oṣadhiṃ saha nītvaiva tūrṇaṃ copasthito’bhavam ||26|| kareṇa tu jalaṃ datvānane mūrchāṃ nyavārayam | sandhinyā skandhamūlaṃ ca kabandhe sannyayojayam ||27|| raktarodhanikayā ca raktasthairyaṃ vyadhāpayam | poṣiṇyā bāhukarayoścāṃgulīnāṃ yathāyatham ||28|| puṣṭiṃ vidhāya ca sthitisthāpinyā sukaraṃ karam | akaravaṃ tathā dhairyaṃ datvāsane sthito’bhavam ||29 || atha te divyarūpaṃ māṃ vilokya mugdhamānasāḥ | viśvāsaṃ paramaṃ prāptā māṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ hi menire ||3.203.30|| tuṣṭuvuste vavanduśca pupūjuśca yayācire | kṣamāmuddharaṇaṃ cāpi māyāpāśavimocanam ||3 1 || satāṃ samāgamaṃ kṛṣṇe bhaktiṃ jñānaṃ yayācire | tathāstvityavadaṃ tebhyo jñānaṃ ca māmakaṃ param ||32|| adadāṃ lakṣmi sarvebhyo divyaṃ ca mama darśanam | tathāstvityadadāṃ tebhyo bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca sampadaḥ ||33 || tirobhāvaṃ tataḥ sthānādatha kālāntare punaḥ | dehānte kramaśastām̐śca nītavānakṣaraṃ mama ||34|| tūlavāyī yadā vṛddho’bhavannaddhaśca muktaye | punaścāhaṃ darśanaṃ svaṃ dattavān tūlavāyine ||35|| tūlavāyī samapṛcchanmāṃ hite jagatāṃ kṛte | kīdṛśo’sti bhavān dhāmni kīdṛśyo muktakoṭayaḥ ||36|| kīdṛśaṃ te gṛhaṃ dhāma kīdṛśā īśvarā api | kīdṛśyaścāvatāriṇya īśvaryaḥ satya ityapi ||37|| kīdṛśāḥ sādhavaste ca kīdṛśyo muktayastava | kīdṛśyaḥ siddhayaste’pi kīdṛśo’haṃ tavāśritaḥ ||38|| kathaṃkāro nivatsye te dhāmni me vada mādhava | ahaṃ lakṣmi tūlavāyijijñāsāṃ samaśāntayam ||39|| śṛṇu bhakto bhavāmyatra divyaste netragocaraḥ | so’haṃ dhāmni bhavāmyeva sarvathā divyamūrtimān ||3.203.40|| apāraguṇasaundaryalāvaṇyaujjvalyasāgaraḥ | sākāraḥ sarvamuktānāṃ nibhālanīyo mādhavaḥ ||41|| dvibhujaḥ sarvadā cāsmi rūpāntarāṇi cecchayā | dhārayāmi sahasrādibhujāni bahurūpavān ||42|| sarvarasaḥ sarvagandhaḥ sarvarūpo bhavāmyaham | sarvasparśaḥ sarvaśabdaḥ sarvānando bhavāmyaham ||43|| kiśoro’smi brahmapriyāsaṃkhyamuktānikāpatiḥ | haripriyāsaṃkhyamuktapatiḥ puṣṭaśarīravān ||44|| sevāyogyaḥ sarvakāmaprapūro’smi mamākṣare | akṣare dhāmni tatraiva vasanti muktakoṭayaḥ ||45|| sarve matparamā divyā matsamānasumūrtayaḥ | divyasarvaguṇāḍhyāste sākārāḥ sukhavārdhayaḥ ||46|| etādṛśā mama muktāḥ kiśorāścātisundarāḥ | tejasvino’tiramyāśca manoharā vasanti hi ||47|| mamākṣaraṃ paraṃ vyoma paraṃdhāma paraṃ gṛham | sahasrakoṭistambhālīsaṃśobhatsvarṇanirmitam ||48|| sahasrakoṭikalaśaṃ sarvarddhisiddhisaṃbhṛtam | sahasrakoṭikakṣāḍhyaṃ vartate bahuvistaram ||49|| sarvakāmāḥ sarvakalpā sumūrtāstatra santi vai | sarvabhogamayīśayyāḥ sarvasiṃhāsanāni vai ||3.203.50|| gajāsanaṃ mahārghyaṃ ca vidyate mama mandire | etādṛśaṃ paraṃ dhāma yatra vasāmi śaktibhiḥ ||51 || sahitaścāpi muktaiśca sahito divyavigrahaḥ | mattaḥ prāvirbhavantyevāvatārāḥ kṛṣṇakoṭayaḥ ||52|| nārāyaṇā asaṃkhyātā rāmā narāśca koṭayaḥ | munayo’saṃkhyadhāmāno bhavantyavataranti ca ||53|| vāsudevādayaścāpi hiraṇyagarbhakoṭayaḥ | vairājā īśvarā bhūmānaśca brahmāṇa ityapi ||54|| rudrāśca viṣṇuvaryāśca bhavantīśvarakoṭayaḥ | mattaḥ prāpya mahaiśvaryāṇyevāvatārakoṭayaḥ ||55|| bhavanti ceśvarāḥ śuddhasattvaprakarṣabhoginaḥ | teṣāṃ ca śaktayaḥ sarvā mayā vai prakaṭīkṛtāḥ ||56|| īśvarāṇyo bhavantyeva saṃsārasāraśaktayaḥ | ānandakhanayastāśca tataḥ satyo bhavanti ca ||57|| sādhvyastā brahmarūpiṇyo brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ | śīlavratārthidehinyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginya ityapi ||58|| avatāriṇya evāpi lakṣmyastāḥ kamalāḥ śriyaḥ | ramāstā rādhikāstāśca sampadastā bhavanti ca ||59|| evaṃvidhāni me dhāmni caiśvare maṇḍalāni vai | bhavanti tādṛśāllokādihāyānti tu pārṣadāḥ ||3.203.60|| tyāgamātraparā bhaktāste divyā mūrtayo mama | sādhavaste bhavantyeva sarvakalyāṇakārakāḥ ||61 || muktayaḥ sādhusevāyāṃ vartante divyavigrahāḥ | sālokyāḥ sārṣṭayaścāpi sārūpyāśca sayogikāḥ ||62|| etādṛśā bhavantyeva muktayo divyasaukhyadāḥ | siddhayaḥ sarvadarśinyaḥ sarvaśrāvaṇikāstathā ||63|| sarvaprāptisvarūpāśca satyakāmāvasāyitāḥ | sarvakāmadughāścāpi pūrṇānandabhṛtāḥ sadā ||64|| sumūrtāḥ sarvapūrṇāśca bhavanti sevikā mama | mukto bhūtvā bhavām̐statra tūlavāyin nivatsyati ||65|| mama mūrtisamākāro divyaiśvaryayuto’nvaham | pūrṇānandabhṛto divyaḥ kiśoraḥ saṃnivatsyati ||66|| tatra vasato bhavato nirvikalpā sthitiḥ parā | bhaviṣyati yathā nānyad dṛṣṭigataṃ ca te bhavet ||67|| brahmībhūtasya te tatra madanyannaiva gocaram | sarvaṃ khalu tvidaṃ brahma paraṃ nānyad vilokanam ||68|| mama tādātmyamāptasya muktāste’pi na gocarāḥ | akṣaraṃ gocaraṃ tena tvaṃ na tavāpi gocaraḥ ||69|| etādṛśīṃ parāṃ brāhmīṃ sthitiṃ tatra gamiṣyasi | sākāre mama rūpe tvaṃ sadā magno bhaviṣyasi ||3.203.70|| tava dṛṣṭyāṃ na vai muktā nākṣaraṃ kuta īśvarāḥ | kuto māyā kuto jīvāḥ sarvaṃ brahmātmakaṃ tava ||71 || evaṃsthitistava tūlavāyiṃstatra bhaviṣyati | kṛpayā me tava muktistādṛśī saṃbhaviṣyati ||72|| nirvikalpā videhā mattādātmyā sa sthitirmatā | atratyā ye mama muktāḥ santi jīvanamuktayaḥ ||73|| te tu māyāṃ prapaśyanti jīvām̐stattvāni sarvathā | īśvarān sarvadhāmāni savikalpasamādhayaḥ ||74|| vīkṣamāṇā api māyākālakarmasu naiva te | badhyante nāpi hanyante sajjante naiva teṣu ca ||75|| nirlepāste pravartante dehendriyādibhistviha | ta ete mama bhaktā vai bhavantyātmanivedinaḥ ||76|| dharmajñānavirāgāḍhyāṃ bhaktiṃ kurvanti me sadā | savikalpā bhaktimanto muktā me sādhavastviha ||77|| tathā ca gṛhiṇaścāpi yatayo nyāsavedinaḥ | sannyāsinyo virāgiṇyo bhavanti sādhvikā api ||78|| savikalpasthitayaste tāśca navavidhāṃ mama | bhaktiṃ kurvanti satataṃ premṇā sarvārpaṇātmanā ||79|| śravaṇaṃ me kathāyāśca mallīlānāṃ prakīrtanam | smaraṇaṃ mama mūrteśca mama pādādimardanam ||3.203.80|| sādhūnāṃ pādayoścāpi dehasyāpi pramardanam | arcanaṃ candanādyairme vandanaṃ vacanairmama ||81 || dāsyaṃ datvā samastaṃ me samīpe cāsanaṃ mama | sarvājñāpālanaṃ dāsyaṃ cānuvṛttyā hi vartanam ||82|| sakhyaṃ sauhārdabhāvaśca kriyaikyaṃ ca nirantaram | ātmanivedanaṃ cāpyātmīyasarvanivedanam ||83|| sarvathā sahavāsaśca patnīvad bhṛtyatā tathā | evaṃvidhā mama bhaktiḥ savikalpasya yoginaḥ ||84|| sarvathā manmayatvena bhavatyeva sukhapradā | evaṃvidhayā bhaktyā ca snehena sevayā mama ||85|| jñānenotkarṣabhāvena sānnidhyakaraṇaṃ tu yat| | upāsanā matā sā ca sarvadivyaprakāśinī ||86|| sarvavidhānāṃ jñānānāṃ pravāhāṇāṃ harau mayi | yojanaṃ bahudhā cāpi muhuścopāsanā hi sā ||87|| mananaṃ niścayaścāpi smaraṇaṃ śrīharermama | divyaḥ kiśoraḥ kṛṣṇo’haṃ koṭimuktādisevitaḥ ||88|| akṣare santi me vaṃśā muktā muktānikāḥ śubhāḥ | sarvabhūṣānvitaścāsmi sarvamanoharo hariḥ ||89|| anantaiśvaryasampadvānanantarddhiguṇāśrayaḥ | evaṃvidhasya me jñānaṃ vedanaṃ sā hyupāsanā ||3.203.90 || bhaktiṃ snehaṃ tathā sevāmupāsanāṃ vacaḥsthitim | saṃsādhayati yo dehī jīvanmuktaḥ sa ucyate ||9 1|| so’yaṃ bhavati loke’tra savikalpasamādhimān | tato brahmasthitiṃ labdhvā sajjate mayi mādhave ||92|| dehena manasā vācā kriyayendriyavṛttibhiḥ | ātmanā bhāvanayā ca saṃskārairvedanādibhiḥ ||93|| dhyānenāpi dhāraṇayārpaṇena rodhanena ca | tādātmyena dravībhāvenaikyena yo videhavat ||94|| videhī sa bhaved bhakto nirvikalpasamādhimān | prāpyaivaṃ paramāṃ divyāṃ mudaṃ sa modate mayi ||95|| evaṃ te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tūlavāyin drutaṃ kuru | yāhi me dhāma paramaṃ sarvānandabhṛtaṃ drutam ||96|| ityuktaḥ sa mayā lakṣmi tūlavāyī naman prabhum | dehaṃ vihāya divyo vai jāto muktaśarīravān ||97|| divyaṃ vimānamāruhya yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ mama | evamanye’pi bhaktā me tūlavāyisakarmiṇaḥ ||98|| mayā kālena sarve te prāpitā me’kṣaraṃ padam | evaṃ bhakto bhavellakṣmi bhaktimān madupāsakaḥ ||99|| tasmai datvā darśanaṃ me nayāmi dhāma me param | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ dadāmyeva rakṣāṃ karomi sarvathā || 3.203.1 00|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāt pālanāttathā | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheccāpi sukhaṃ me paramaṃ labhet || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne tūlavāyināmakasya sūtravāyakasya bhaktyā bhagavām̐stasya tatkarmacārāṇāṃ ca rakṣāṃ kṛtvā darśanaṃ datvā mokṣaṃ kṛtavānityādinirūpaṇanāmā tryadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 203 ||
<3.204> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kāṣṭhahārasya vai kathām | nāmnā jāṃgaladevasya mama bhaktasya śobhanām || 1 || niśāragrāmavāstavyo’bhavadbhaktaḥ kuṭumbavān | śūdro jāṃgaladevākhyaḥ kāṣṭhahāro’tibhaktimān || 2 || nityamutthāya kalye’yaṃ muhūrte brāhmasaṃjñake | kūpe snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā nivedya roṭakaṃ ca me || 3 || āranālena sākaṃ ca jalaṃ tataḥ praṇamya mām | sugandhikāṣṭhagundrādidhūpaṃ kṛtvā madagrataḥ || 4 || vanyaṃ phalaṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca patraṃ ca tūlasījanim | samarpya mahyaṃ bhakto’yaṃ patnīmāpṛcchya bālakān || 5 || rajjuṃ nītvā kuṭhāraṃ ca yātyaraṇya prage’nvaham | vividhāni ca śuṣkāṇi kāṣṭhanyācchidya yatnataḥ || 6 || bhāraṃ baddhvā ca madhyāhne vṛkṣacchāyāmaye sthale | sahanītaṃ roṭakaṃ ca smṛtvā māmatti manmanā || 7 || viśrāmaṃ prāpya vai paścāt tāpamāndye gṛhaṃ nijam | prayātyeva hi kāṣṭhānāṃ bhāraṃ dhṛtvā sa mastake || 8 || yadā vṛkṣe śuṣkakāṣṭhaṃ śuṣkaśākhāṃ chinatti saḥ | tadā tadā hariṃ smṛtvā natvā vṛkṣaṃ chinatti saḥ || 9 || patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ cet prāpyate mahyaṃ dadāti saḥ | vṛkṣa nārāyaṇayogaṃ yāhi ceti vadatyapi ||3.204.1 0|| harekṛṣṇa hareviṣṇo bālakṛṣṇa pareśvara | antaryāmim̐starorasya kalyāṇaṃ kuru vakti ca || 11 || etādṛśo hi me bhakto vṛkṣaśreyovicāravān | bhajate’raṇyamadhye’pi śrīpatiṃ māṃ pumuttamam || 12|| anye ca bahavaḥ kāṣṭhahārāḥ svayogamāgatāḥ | kṛtā bhaktā vaiṣṇavāśca nāmakīrtanatatparāḥ || 13|| araṇye pippalataroradhastād vedikopari | militvā kāṣṭhahāraiśca mūrtirme tu śilāmayī || 14|| darśanārthaṃ sthāpitā ca tatra puṇye kṣaṇe dine | milanti cāpi madhyānhe bhajante kīrtayanti mām |||15|| pūjayanti hariṃ māṃ ca phalairjalairdalādibhiḥ | vanyakandaistataḥ sarve bhuñjate yānti viśramam || 16|| śubhe dine prakurvanti mahotsavaṃ navaṃ navam | patramaṇḍapaśobhābhistoraṇaiḥ puṣpahārakaiḥ || 17|| pranṛtyanti kīrtayanti mṛdaṃgādibhirādarāt | evaṃ kīrtanabhaktānāṃ nṛtyaṃ ca kīrtanaṃ mama || 18|| priyaṃ jātaṃ tato lakṣmi pūjākāle ca nartane | kīrtane cādṛśyarūpo bhavāmyākarṇayam̐stadā ||19|| athāhaṃ sādhurūpo vai vanī bhūtvā yayau tadā | maṇḍale kāṣṭhahārāṇāṃ pippale vedikāsthale ||3.204.20 || satkṛtastaiḥ sādhurūpaḥ svāgataiḥ pūjitastathā | bhojitaḥ phalakandādyaiḥ pādorvāhitastathā ||21 || dehe sammarditaścāpi vandito’haṃ tadā janaiḥ | sthitastaiścāpi saṃpṛṣṭaḥ kathaṃ vai bhagavān prabhuḥ ||22||| nirākāro netralabhyo bhavedatra janārdanaḥ | kathaṃ mokṣo bhavet kāṣṭhahārāṇāṃ vanināṃ tvihi ||23 || tadāhaṃ kamale jñānaṃ pradadau tatra cottamam | kṛpayā ca prakāśaṃ vai hṛtsvakaravaṃ vaiṣṇavam ||24|| kāṣṭhānāṃ sañcaye nārāyaṇaḥ smartavya eva ca | kāṣṭhānāṃ haraṇe cāpi smartavyaḥ śrīhariṃ sadā ||25|| bhārasya bandhane cāpi smartavyaḥ parameśvaraḥ | vikraye’pi pravaktavyaṃ vikrīṇantu hariṃ janāḥ ||26|| rāmasamidhaḥ keśavasamidhaḥ kṛṣṇaśākhinaḥ | vikrīṇantu janāḥ kṛṣṇasamidhaḥ kṛṣṇakāṣṭhakam ||27|| ityevaṃ raṭanīyo’yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ pade pade | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mokṣapradaḥ prabhuḥ ||28|| smaraṇīyaḥ sadā śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaḥ śriyāḥ patiḥ | mokṣadātā sa evāste cāntarātmā dayānidhiḥ || 29||| svargadaḥ sukhadaścāpi sampadāṃ ca pradaḥ prabhuḥ | śāśvatānandadaścāpi sṛṣṭisāgaratārakaḥ ||3.204.30|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ | prajapantu sadā mantraṃ pāvanaṃ pārameśvaram ||3 1 || sarvārpaṇaṃ prakurvantu kāṣṭhahārā mayīśvare | naiṣkarmyaṃ puṇyadaṃ sarvaṃ bhaktyākhyaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ||32|| śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānasti sarvakāraṇakāraṇam | prakāśakānāṃ sarveṣāṃ prakāśasamprado hariḥ ||33|| yasya bhāsā sarvamidaṃ bhāsate ca vibhāti ca | sṛṣṭyādau cākṣare dhāmni vartate parameśvaraḥ ||34|| rādhālakṣmīpatirmuktapatirbrahmapriyāpatiḥ | prakṛtiḥ svecchayā tena vyaktiṃ nītā tathā pumān ||35|| tābhyāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ purā jātā nārāyaṇapraveśitā | pradhānapuruṣau tābhyāṃ tābhyāṃ hiraṇyapūruṣaḥ ||36|| tato virāṭ tato brahmā tato maharṣayaḥ surāḥ | mānavāśca tato jātāḥ paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo drumāḥ ||37|| evaṃ sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ kṛtaṃ śrīparamātmanā | bhūtendriyārthadevādyā vāsitā paramātmanā ||38|| yathāpātraṃ haristeṣu vasate cāntare’sti saḥ | prerakaḥ sa hariḥ kārye prakāśakaśca mādhavaḥ ||39|| nityasakhā hariḥ kṛṣṇo jīvasya pāralaukikaḥ | iha loke’pi lokānāṃ sakhā draṣṭā hariḥ svayam ||3.204.40 || jīvānāṃ tu kṛtaṃ karma vīkṣya phalapradaḥ prabhuḥ | phalaṃ dadāti jīvebhyo dehagehādisampadaḥ ||41|| svargaṃ vā narakaṃ cāpi yathākarma dadāti saḥ | evaṃ sākṣī sadā kṛṣṇo bhavatīti nibodhata ||42|| sākāro bhagavānevaṃ sarvāntaryāmitāṃ gataḥ | vyāpako vartate cāpi vartate netragocaraḥ ||43|| sādhurūpo vartate ca sādhurhariḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | sādhoḥ prapūjane kṛṣṇapūjā bhavati śāśvatī ||44|| sādhurūpo milatyeva harirdayānidhiḥ paraḥ | bhaktānāṃ pāvanaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛpayā satsu vartate ||45|| sādhusevāparā bhaktāstaranti sṛṣṭivāridhim | sādhavo brahmaparamā mokṣakā dehināṃ sadā ||46|| yeṣāṃ sarvamidaṃ brahmarūpaṃ dṛṣṭau pradīvyati | nirvikalpakacittāste tārakā pāpināmapi ||47|| ye tu jīveśamāyādīnnekṣante brahmadarśinaḥ | sukhinaste kṛṣṇasukhaiḥ sukhayanti śritān janān ||48|| kāmakrodhādirahitāḥ śrīharau lagnamānasāḥ | devyadehā api santo vicaranti janā iva ||49|| kārayanti harerbhaktiṃ janānupadiśanti ca | tārayanti janān sarvān narānnārīrnapuṃsakān ||3.204.50|| bhāvayanti kathāṃ ramyāṃ pālayanti vṛṣottamān | mokṣayanti bandhanātte sādhavaḥ kṛṣṇarūpiṇaḥ ||51 || jīvānāṃ bahuyonīnāṃ svasvakarmaphalāni vai | bhuñjānānāṃ pramoktāraḥ sādhavo bhavasāgarāt ||52|| yatra vasanti santaśca teṣu nārāyaṇaḥ svayam | mānuṣyavigrahaṃ dhṛtvā vasatyevāprakāśavān ||53|| sarvaprakāśayukto’pi naranāṭyaṃ samīhate | kvacit kṛpāvaśāddhatte hyatimānavasatkriyāḥ ||54|| mānavaṃ bhagavantaṃ taṃ santo jānanti netare | itare tu satāṃ yogājjānanti mādhavaṃ tataḥ ||55|| āśrayanti prasnihyanti ramante paramātmani | ye te vai saṃsṛtermuktā yāntyante brahmadhāma ha ||56|| tasmin kṛṣṇe’nurajyante dīvyanti tatra modinaḥ | ānandayanti tatraivāśnuvate sukhasampadaḥ ||57|| jānannajānannapi yaḥ kṛṣṇe snihyennarākṛtau | sa bhūtvaiva guṇātīto yātyante hyakṣaraṃ padam ||58|| kṛṣṇasya divyarūpatvāt tatsambandhāttadāśritāḥ | divyā divyasvarūpāśca bhavanti brahmagāminaḥ ||59|| māyeśasya harermāyārahitatvācchritā api | harerbalena māyāṃ vai taranti prākṛtā api ||3.204.60|| kāmabhāvena yā nāryo vrajāṅganā harau sadā | snigdhāstā api muktiṃ vai gatā nirguṇavigrahāḥ ||61 || brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca bālakṛṣṇanarāyaṇe | snigdhāstā nirguṇe kṛṣṇe nirguṇatvaṃ prapedire ||62|| kāmāt snehād guṇāt svārthāllagnāyāḥ paramātmani | jahurguṇamayān dehān sadyastāḥ kṣīṇabandhanāḥ ||63|| mādhavo nirguṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ saccidānandavigrahaḥ | tasya yogaṃ yayurye yā nirguṇā divyatāṃ gatāḥ ||64|| evaṃ harau satyarūpe snehānmokṣo bhaveddhruvaḥ | sādhau snehāttathā mokṣaḥ santaḥ kṛṣṇasya mūrtayaḥ ||65|| satāṃ yogāt prayāntyeva dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ hareḥ | harerekāntikā bhaktā vāñchanti sevanaṃ hareḥ ||66|| na svargaṃ nāpavargaṃ vā na lokaṃ paramātmanaḥ | naiśvaryāṇyabhivāñcchanti na vāñcchanti sarūpatām ||67|| sāmīpyaṃ nābhivāñcchanti naikatvaṃ tu kadācana | vāñcchāvantaḥ sakāmāḥ syurnimnakoṭaya eva te ||68|| sarvārpaṇātmabhaktau sā trūṭīreva nigadyate | ātmaniveditāyāṃ vai saṃkalpasyāpi cārpaṇam ||69|| kṛtaṃ yataḥ punarnaiva saṃkalpayanti svārthakam | ata eva hi niṣkāmāḥ sarvathā hyuttamottamāḥ ||3.204.70|| hareḥ samājñayā sevāṃ vāñcchanti svecchayā tu na | sevāphalaṃ paraṃ proktaṃ sarvaṃ tatra samāpyate ||71 || prasannatā phalaṃ kṛṣṇasevayā samavāpyate | nāsmāt phalaṃ paraṃ tvanyanniṣkāmānāṃ hṛdi sthitam ||72|| sevayā labhyate śreṣṭhaṃ kiṃ sālokyādibhistataḥ | ekatvaṃ tu sadā naiva vāñchanti dāsyahantṛ yat ||73|| ekībhāve kathaṃ sevā kathaṃ prasannatā sukham | tato niṣkāmabhaktā vai priyā harerbhavanti hi ||74|| bhaktānniṣkāminaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svāntike saṃprarakṣati | premṇā kṛtāṃ ca tatsevāṃ premṇā cāṅgīkaroti saḥ ||75|| anicchadbhyo’pi bhaktebhyaḥ prasanno bhagavān hariḥ | mahaiśvaryāṇi naijāni dadāti tvakṣare prabhuḥ ||76|| evaṃ santoṣiṇo bhaktāḥ kṛṣṇābhāḥ saṃbhavanti te | tatkṛpayā sadā sarvaiḥ sākaṃ ramate māpatiḥ ||77|| ātmavat tatpriyāste ca santuṣṭā jñāninaḥ sukhāḥ | niṣkāmā uttamāste vai bhaktā bhavanti tatpriyāḥ ||78|| bhojane śayane snāne gamane ramaṇe kṛtau | khelane helane vāṇyāṃ vinode hasane dhṛtau ||79|| niṣkāmān sahavāsām̐stān rakṣatyeva janārdanaḥ | asaṃśayāḥ sadā bhaktāḥ priyā bhavanti śārṅgiṇaḥ ||3.204.80 || ityevaṃ copadiṣṭāste lakṣmi sādhusuveṣiṇā | kāṣṭhahārā mayā sarve’bhavam̐ste jñānayoginaḥ ||8 1 || atha māṃ paramaṃ sādhuṃ jñātvā nārāyaṇātmakam | śiśriyuste mumuduścārthayāmāsurataḥ param ||82|| sādhorguroryogataśced darśanaṃ paramātmanaḥ | yogyā vayaṃ te śiṣyāḥ smastadā kāraya muktidam ||83 || athāhaṃ tānuvācedaṃ dhyānaṃ kurvantu vai hṛdi | drakṣyatho’traiva śrīnāthaṃ pareśaṃ mādhavaṃ harim ||84|| ityuktāste netravṛttīścitte nidhāya keśavam | dadhyustāvat sādhuveṣaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ māṃ vilulokire ||85|| sādhorveṣād divyarūpaṃ caturbhujaṃ pareśvaram | śrīkāntaṃ rādhikākāntaṃ pareśaṃ vilulokire ||86|| kāṣṭhahārāḥ samastāste’kṣaraṃ dhāma mahojjvalam | prapaśyan śrīharermuktaiḥ koṭyasaṃkhyairvirājitam ||87|| tatra siṃhāsanaṃ ramyaṃ gajāsanaṃ mahottamam | tatra sthitaṃ hariṃ māṃ śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ śriyānvitam ||88|| vīkṣayāmāsurīśeśeśvaraṃ rādhāpatiṃ prabhum | brahmapriyāpatiṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam ||89|| sevamānamanantaiśca muktairaikāntikaiḥ sukhaiḥ | evaṃ vilokya sahasā hṛdaye sādhurūpiṇam ||3.204.90|| punaste dadṛśuḥ sarve tato bahiḥsthitaṃ yatim | sādhuṃ vilokayāmāsuḥ sahasā snehasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||91 || utthāya māṃ parātmānaṃ jñātvāraṇye samāgatam | pupūjurāśliṣam̐ścāpi papuḥ pādajalaṃ tataḥ |||92||| prasādaṃ ca mayā dattaṃ cakhaduste’timoditāḥ | divyabhāvaṃ gatāḥ sarve daṇḍavat saṃpracakrire || 93|| utthāyotthāya dhanyaṃ ca manyamānāḥ pramodinaḥ | nanṛtustālikātānaiḥ kīrtanaṃ cakrire tathā ||94|| mama pādatale jihvābhiśca cakruḥ sulohanam | pādayorantike sarve luluṭurdhūlikāstare ||95|| atha śāntiṃ yayuścāpi vavandurmāṃ sanātanam | sevanaṃ cārthayāmāsurdhāmni dṛṣṭaṃ yathā tathā ||96|| tathāstvevaṃ samuccārya tiro’bhavaṃ druta tvaham | atha te nirvikalpā vai mamopāsanavedinaḥ ||97|| divyā bhaktā abhavam̐śca kālenāpi tanutyajaḥ | yayurme dhāma paramaṃ yatra sādhyā vasanti vai ||98|| evaṃ mayā kāṣṭhahārā uddhṛtā bhaktitatparāḥ | lakṣmi jāṃgaladevādyāḥ sahasraśo’pi tatparāḥ ||99|| sakāmāstatra ye tvāsan prāpitāste divaṃ prati | niṣkāmāḥ prāpitā lakṣmi vaikuṇṭhaṃ cākṣaraṃ tathā || 3.204.10 0|| kecittu prāpitā dhāma golokaṃ sumahojjvalam | kecicca prāpitā lakṣmi śrīpuraṃ lalitāgṛham || 101 || anye śrībadarīdhāma śvetadvīpaṃ tathāpare | kecidavyākṛtaṃ dhāma prāpitāścāmṛtaṃ pare || 10 2|| evamete mayā lakṣmi coddhṛtāḥ kāṣṭhahāriṇaḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhaveddhruvam || 10 3|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne jāṃgaladevādikāṣṭhahārāṇāṃ bhaktyā sādhurūpeṇa śrīharerdarśanaṃ cānte mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 204 ||
<3.205> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ bhaktasya paṇyakāriṇaḥ | nāmnā vātsalyadhīrasya kathāṃ paramapāvanīm || 1 || nāgaśālāyane grāme bhakto vaiśyo’bhavanmama | kuṭumbadhanavāṭyādidhenukṣetrādisampadā || 2 || vardhamāno’timānyaśca lokānāṃ ca nṛpasya ca | viprāṇāṃ pūjakaścātidhyānavṛttirharau mayi || 3 || pūjāpāṭhaparo nityaṃ bhaktikīrtanatatparaḥ | tīrthasādhusatīmantā gosevaḥ surasevakaḥ || 4 || vṛddhābhipūjakaścānnadānadharmaparāyaṇaḥ | dhanāḍhyaḥ sa dhanaṃ varṣe varṣe yajñārthamuttamam || 5 || dadātyeva tathā vṛkṣāropaṇārthaṃ dadātyapi | vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ khātārthaṃ ca dadātyapi || 6 || jīrṇadevālayādīnāmuddhāre vitaratyapi | anāthabāladīnānāṃ sahāyārthaṃ dadātyapi || 7 || govṛṣaśvaśukānāṃ ca pārāvātādipakṣiṇām | ghāsānnakaṇakān śreṣṭhī dadātyeva sudharmavān || 8 || vyadhādannādisatrāṇi dharmaśālāḥ śubhāśrayāḥ | prapāparvāṇi ramyāṇi vedikāścatvarādiṣu || 9 || sīmni jalānnasatrāṇi kuṭīścāśrayadāyikāḥ | akarot sa ca devānāṃ pūjāpravāhamuttamam || 3.205.1 0|| evaṃ nityaṃ tasya lakṣmi dravyaṃ dāne’pi dīyate | akṣayyaṃ vardhate nityaṃ vātsalyadhīranāṇakam || 11 || etādṛśaḥ sa bhakto me vrate mahotsavaṃ param | karoti rājavacchreṣṭhopacārairbahumūlyakaiḥ || 1 2|| vādyagāyanagītyādyaiḥ kīrtanairbhajanairapi | nṛtyotsavādibhiścāpi kārayatyeva sūtsavam || 13|| niveditānnasalilamiṣṭānnaphalapāyasaiḥ | tarpayatyeva sarvān sa mahotsave samāgatān || 14|| pūrve dattaṃ tataścātra labdhaṃ tato’pi dīyate | lapsyate cākṣayaṃ sarvaṃ nārāyaṇāya dīyate || 15|| evaṃ matvā dadātyeva dattaṃ cākṣayatāṃ vrajet | vṛddhiṃ yāyānna tu hrāsaṃ tasmād deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 16|| puṇyaṃ phalaṃ mahaccāpi dānasya svargamuttamam | prasannatā hareścāpi tṛptiścātmagatā bhavet || 17|| sukhadaṃ sarvathā dānaṃ rasānnadhanasampadām | gṛhakṣetravāṭikānāṃ dhenūnāṃ payasāṃ tathā || 18|| dravyāṇāmupakaraṇānāṃ ca dānaṃ tathākṣayam | dātavyaṃ sarvathā sampadyuktaiḥ sampanmiliṣyati || 19|| adattaṃ labhyate naiva nārīdhanagṛhādikam | dattamevāpyate sarvaṃ sukhaṃ cendriyadehajam ||3.205.20|| lakṣmi vātsalyadhīrastu satre satre sthale sthale | lilekha kṛṣṇanāmāni kapāṭeṣu prapāsu ca ||21 || kuṭīṣu bhittiṣu pātreṣvapi vastreṣu vastuṣu | japate śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīvallabham prabhum ||22|| evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya nityaṃ prapūjakasya me | gṛhaṃ cāhaṃ jagāmaiva bhūtvā tu jaṭilo yatiḥ ||23 || ahaṃ cākāritastena bhojanārthaṃ tṛṇāsane | mayā cābhihito bhaktaḥ pādaprakṣālanāya me ||24|| suvarṇakalaśe bhṛtvā jalaṃ sugandhimiśritam | snehenākṣālayat pādau papau vāri prasādajam ||25|| athāpi bhaktarāṭ tūrṇaṃ mayā punarniveditaḥ | dehasammardanārthaṃ vai tailaiḥ sugandhisārakaiḥ ||26|| so’pi prasannamanasā me’ṅgānyamardayattathā | mayoktaḥ sa tataścāpyuṣṇādbhiḥ snāpayituṃ tu mām ||27|| drāguṣṇādbhiḥ saha tatrāyayāvutsāhavān svayam | mayā nirākṛtaḥ so’pi yācitastatstriyaṃ prati || 28|| tūrṇaṃ sā sahasā mañjulikānāmnī pativratā | patyājñayopatasthe māṃ snāpayituṃ niḥśaṅkinī ||29|| prasannamānasā sādhvī dadau svarṇāsanaṃ tu me | ahaṃ kaupīnamātrāḍhyo niṣasāda śubhāsane ||3.205.30|| sā hastābhyāṃ satī sādhvī bhaktānikā ca māṃ muhuḥ | sarvāṃgeṣu prasammṛdya snapayāmāsa bhāvukī ||3 1 || mayā tasyai darśitā vai vikṛtirjāgratātmikā | tathāpi sā viśaṃkā māṃ snapayāmāsa sādaram ||32|| sparśaṃ punaḥ punaḥ kṛtvā sarvāṃgeṣu pativratā | prasannamānasā mañjulikā na vikṛtiṃ yayau ||33 || dhīrā sthirā dharmavatī tuṣṭāva ca kṛtāñjaliḥ | prasanno bhava muktātman yatte sevāṃ karomi te ||34|| patyurājñā yathā syātte sevāṃ kuryāṃ visaṃśayā | sādhurnārāyaṇaḥ sākṣād divyamūrtiḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ||35|| tasya sevā tu bhāgyena labhyate khalu yoṣitā | patyājñā cet tavāsmyeva yataścāsmi pativratā ||36|| uktaścaivaṃ tathāhaṃ ca lakṣmi tatpatimāhvayam | patnī te dīyatāṃ mahyaṃ bādhate mānasaṃ mama ||37|| patiḥ prapūjya pādau me tadā tathāstu saṃdadau | sāpi matparabhāvā ca vyajāyatājñayā rame ||38|| aspṛṣṭvā tāṃ tadā tūrṇaṃ divyaścaturbhujo’bhavam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||39|| sāpi dhanyāṃ manyamānā svāṃ papāta ca pādayoḥ | tasyāḥ patiśca vātsalyadhīro’pi premavihvalaḥ ||3.205.40|| sādhurūpaṃ hariṃ māṃ ca jñātvā papāta pādayoḥ | bhaktān samāhvayāmāsa sevāṃ cakre ca tatkṣaṇam ||41 || vastravibhūṣaṇaiścāpi candanaiḥ kuṃkumādibhiḥ | arpayāmāsa sarvaṃ me bhojanaṃ ca jalaṃ phalam ||42|| mañcaṃ svarṇāsanaṃ cāpi śṛṃgāraṃ ca parārhaṇam | nīrājanaṃ cakārāpi śayanaṃ me dadau tataḥ ||43|| atha sādhusvarūpo’haṃ sarvaiḥ sampūjitaḥ prabhuḥ | yayācire ca bhaktāśca tathā vātsalyadhīrakaḥ ||44|| bhuktirlabdhā divyagatirdīyatāṃ parameśvara | jñānaṃ māhātmyasampannaṃ dīyatāṃ te parātparam ||45|| ahaṃ lakṣmi dadau tasmai tebhyaśca jñānamuttamam | snehaḥ kāryo bhagavati mayi śrīparameśvare ||46|| sarvārpaṇaṃ vidheyaṃ ca niḥśaṃkaṃ mayi mādhave | niḥspṛhatvaṃ vidheyaṃ ca sāṃsārikeṣu sarvathā ||47|| vairāgyaḥ sarvathā rakṣyo bandhanasya vichittaye | kṛṣṇe mayyanurāgaśca prema sneho’tisnigdhatā ||48|| kartavyā sarvathā nārīnarairmadarpaṇāya vai | yatitavyaṃ nityaśaśca prāpto bhavāmi tena ha ||49|| snehena hṛdaye’khaṇḍaṃ smaraṇaṃ me harerbhavet | mama mūrteḥ sadā sphurtirvarteta tena saukhyadā ||3.205.50|| anyabhānāstu saṃkalpāścodayaṃ neyureva ha | vilīnā māyayā sākaṃ nirbījāste bhavanti vai ||51|| pūrṇapremavatāṃ pūrṇāḥ saṃkalpā mama gocarāḥ | nānyagocarā jāyante sarvadā bhaktiyoginām ||52|| viparīte deśakālasaṃgādau cet tu māyikaḥ | saṃkalpo yadyutpadyeta tadā vyathā bhaveddhṛdi ||53|| yathā netre tīkṣṇasūcīkṣepe vyathā bhavettathā | yathā tīkṣṇā śalyadhārā hṛdgatā vai vyathāṃ kriyāt ||54|| tathodbhūtānyasaṃkalpo vyathāṃ kuryājjanaṃ śritam | etādṛśaḥ paraḥ snehaḥ kartavyo mayi keśave ||55|| snehastu mama māhātmyajñānād bhavati vardhitaḥ | varamālāgrahaṇācca naisargiko bhavedapi ||56|| kaṇṭhī mālā varamālā mantro me ca varaḥ smṛtaḥ | tadādāne bhavet snehaḥ kanyāyā iva kāntake ||57|| adṛṣṭe’pi bhavet snehaḥ sarvādhāre hi rakṣake | tadarpaṇātmikā vṛttiḥ sarvā bhaktasya jāyate ||58|| karagrahe’pi saṃsparśe snehaścātīva vardhate | sarvātmanārpaṇe snehaḥ niḥsīmā sampravardhate ||59|| guroḥ prasaṃgataḥ sneho guruḥ sādhujano mataḥ | satāṃ prasaṃgamāsādya māhātmyaṃ cāpnuyānmama ||3.205.60|| dehe daihikaviṣaye sampatsvapi vivekavān | rāgaṃ hitvā harau kṛṣṇe mayi snehaṃ vivardhayet ||61 || jaḍaṃ dehaṃ daihikaṃ ca na mantavyaṃ nijaṃ kvacit | ātmāhaṃ cetano divyo bhagavaccharaṇāgataḥ ||62|| saccidānandarūpo’smi mukto’smi brahmasaṃsthitaḥ | māyā me nāsti loke’tra vinā hariṃ na kiñcana ||63|| evaṃ vivekavān kṛṣṇe snigdho bhavati sarvathā | ahantāmamatāhīnaḥ sarvarāgādivarjitaḥ ||64|| na mātā na pitā me’sti na strī na dravyamasti me | na putro na sutā me’sti na gehaṃ me na vāṭikā ||65|| pūrvabhaveṣu bahavo jātā vai janakādayaḥ | ajñānena mayā cātra vismṛtāstattathā tvime ||66|| ātmano nahi mātāsti kutaḥ pitā kuto gṛham | ahantāmamatārāgadveṣāścāpi kutastarāḥ ||67|| evaṃ vivekināṃ sarvā naśyanti mamatādikāḥ | mayyeva śrīharau cāhaṃmamatvaṃ tūpajāyate ||68|| satyaṃ tanmokṣadaṃ bhaktāstarantyetena majjanāḥ | vivekahīnāḥ saṃsāre badhyante na taranti te ||69|| yathā nāṭyagṛhe prauḍhāḥ kiśorā raṃgabhūkṛte | nāṭyasampādanārthaṃ vai veṣān vahanti cocitān ||3.205.70 || veṣāṇāṃ kuśalāsteṣāṃ dhārayanti suveṣakān | sajjayanti suśobhāḍhyān śṛṃgārayanti śobhanān ||71|| kiśorān strīsvarūpām̐śca klṛptayanti surūpiṇaḥ | tatra veṣadharo veṣasampādakān janān yadi ||72|| manyeta pitarau janmapradau mauḍhyāttadā tu saḥ | ajña eva bhavet sarvavivekādivivarjitaḥ ||73|| tathā dehopi veṣo’sti dehādau pitarau na tu | mantavyau cātmanā brahmarūpeṇa vartinā tviha ||74|| evameva yathā nānājātiṣu bahavo gatāḥ | dehasyotpādakāścāpi tathāsya varṣmaṇo’pi tau ||75|| evaṃ vivekaṃ kṛtvaiva strīputradhanasampadi | snehaṃ tyaktvā prakuryādvai snehaṃ mayi pareśvare ||76|| dehe’hantā vinaṣṭā syād daihike mamatā tataḥ | ātmaniṣṭhābalaṃ nityaṃ pravardhetākṣarapradam ||77|| varṇāśramābhimānaśca layaṃ yāyād vivekataḥ | muktiṃ pratyeva valayaṃ nijātmanaḥ samudbhavet ||78|| tad gṛhītvā bhujāyāṃ vai kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ samāśrayet | bhuktirmuktirbhavedasya karasthā naiva saṃśayaḥ ||79|| gṛhastho’pi bhaveccāpi mantavyaḥ sādhureva saḥ | bhajet kṛṣṇaṃ tu yastādṛgjñānaniṣṭho virāgavān ||3.205.80 || yasmāddharirna vai dūre durlabhaḥ sādhureva saḥ | tasmād bandhā vinaśyanti sevyaḥ sādhuḥ sa eva saḥ ||8 1 || brahmātmanā vartate’sau dehādibhāvavarjitaḥ | sarvārpaṇātmanā lakṣmi tasmāt kiñcinna śiṣyate ||82|| apityāgavatāṃ tyaktagehādīnāmapi kvacit | abhimānaṃ bhaveccettadasya yogād vilīyate ||83|| evaṃ sa paṇyakṛcchreṣṭhī lakṣmi mayā nibodhitaḥ | mahāsādhusamo jātaḥ patnīputrādisaṃyutaḥ ||84|| vyāpārān sarvathā kṛṣṇe’rpitān cakre kuṭumbayuk | viśeṣataścātmaniṣṭhāṃ māhātmyaṃ me viveda saḥ ||85|| atha vairāgyamāpannaḥ patnyā sākaṃ sa bhaktarāṭ | iyeṣa vaiṣṇavīṃ dīkṣāṃ sādhavīṃ sādhusammatām ||86|| mamājñayā sa pradadau putrebhyo dhanasampadaḥ | svayaṃ vātsalyadhīraḥ sa mañjulikāsatīyutaḥ ||87|| dīkṣāṃ jagrāha mantraṃ ca sādhuryatyāśramo’bhavat | sādhvī patnī ca tasyābhūt sāṃkhyayoginyataḥ param ||88|| vātsalyāyananāmāyaṃ mayā sādhustadā kṛtaḥ | vairāgyeṇa yutastīrthayātrārthamudyamaṃ vyadhāt| ||89|| tiro’bhavaṃ tvahaṃ drāk ca sādhuḥ prajāṃ praṇamya ca | putrānāpṛcchya tīrthārthaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro yayau ||3.205.90|| ākṣaraṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ prāpa kuṃkumavāpikām | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ prāṅnibhālitam ||96. || tīrthaṃ cakre’bhitastatrovāsa śrīlomaśāśrame | mañjulikā mahāsādhvī brahmapriyāsu cāvasat |||92|| ubhau tau sādhurūpau māṃ bhajete cātmavedinau | vartamānāvimau lakṣmi paśya mañjulikāṃ satīm ||93|| taveyaṃ sevikā cāste pāvanī bhaktisaṃbhṛtā | niḥsaṃśayābhavad yā sā sādhave me purā gṛhe ||94|| arpaṇārthaṃ sthitā patyurājñayātra tataḥ sthitā | divyā divyasvarūpādya vartate brahmayoginī ||95|| vātsalyāyanasādhuśca vartate brahmarūpavān | ātmaniṣṭhastathā samyagjñānī snehaparaṃ gataḥ ||96|| māyāṃ kālaṃ ca karmāpi gaṇayatyeva naiva saḥ | madbalāt sarvatattvānāmucchraye vartate hyasau ||97|| ākaśe’yaṃ prayātyeva dehenānena sarvathā | samudre parvate’raṇye meghe prayātyanargalaḥ ||98|| vahnau candre tathā sūrye lokālokācale divi | merau yāti punaryāti svāśrayaṃ yogapāragaḥ ||99|| mama mūrtiṃ sadā dhyāyati matkṛpayā sādhurāṭ | dhartuṃ kartuṃ ca saṃhartuṃ samartho vidyate’dhunā || 3.205.1 00|| mamopāsanayā lakṣmi sevayā cāpyaśaṃkayā | mama yogena divyatvaṃ prāpto’yaṃ muktavat sadā ||1 01 || evaṃ bhaktiṃ prakurvanto bhavanti divyavigrahāḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktistathā bhavet || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne paṇya kṛto vātsalyadhīrākhyabhaktasya tatpatnyā mañjulikādevyā bhaktyā prasanno bhagavān darśanaṃ dadau, sādhubhūtau tau ca vartete ityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 205 ||
<3.206> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ vanapālasya vai kathām | nāmnā tilakaraṃgasya śūdrasyāraṇyavāsinaḥ || 1 || mahākālavane lakṣmi vanapālo’tibhaktimān | āsīt tilakaraṃgākhyaḥ śivabhakto’tibhāvanaḥ || 2 || sureśikāsarittīre vṛkṣaṣaṇḍe kṛtālayaḥ | araṇyarakṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ bhraman karoti sāyudhaḥ || 3 || vanyakandaphalāhāraḥ kvacillabdhānnabhojanaḥ | ṛtupakvakaṇāhāro vartate sakuṭumbakaḥ || 4 || vanevāse’pi satataṃ prāṇihiṃsāvivarjitaḥ | dayādharmaparo yogye kāle śaṃkarapūjakaḥ || 5 || prātaḥ snātvā vārighaṭaṃ bhṛtvā śrīśaṃkarālayam | gatvābhiṣekaṃ carati bilvapatrāṇi candanam || 6 || karṇikāyāḥ kanakānāṃ puṣpārpaṇaṃ karoti ca | madhyānhe’pi jalādhārī datvā prapūjya śaṃkaram || 7 || tato naivedyaṃ prāpyaiva bhuṃkte sāyaṃ tathaiva ca | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ sunaivedyaṃ nīrājanaṃ pradakṣiṇam || 8 || ārādhanaṃ namaskāraṃ kṛtvā karoti kīrtanam | svapityeva tatastatra vedyāṃ śaṃkarasannidhau || 9 || prātarutthāya sammārjya gālavādanapūrvakam | kṛtvā smaraṇaṃ śaṃbhośca tataḥ snātuṃ prayāti ca || 3.206.10 || asya patnī śikhādevī tathaiva śaṃkarārhaṇam | nityaṃ karoti śaktyā vai liṅgaṃ saṃsnāpayatyapi || 11 || mandire vasati tatra divase bhaktiyoginī | vāṭapravāsinaḥ kecinnarā nāryo’pi mārgagāḥ || 12|| yadyāyānti viśrāmyanti tebhyo jalaṃ phalaṃ sthalam | dadāti sā śikhādevī satkaroti yathāyatham || 13|| śaṃkarasya guṇān dharmān camatkārān vadatyapi | śaṃkaro vai bhaktabhaktiṃ vilokya ca tutoṣa ha || 14|| ekadā vaiṣṇavo bhūtvā yātrālustatra cāgataḥ | kṛtavaiṣṇavatilakaḥ skandhe kṛtasupeṭikaḥ || 15|| kukṣau śālagrāmayukto nārāyaṇaṃ raṭan muhuḥ | śikhādevī tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā vāsaṃ vedyāṃ dadau tataḥ || 16|| nidhāya peṭikāṃ tatra snātuṃ sukeśikānadīm | yayau snātvā snāpayitvā śālagrāmaṃ prapūjya ca ||17|| āyayāvāsane vedyāṃ niṣasāda kṣaṇaṃ sthiraḥ | tāvat tilakaraṃgo’pi vanāntarādupāgataḥ || 18 || ānīya kandamūlāni nidadhe vedikopari | yātrāluṃ viṣṇuyuktaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā nanāma pādayoḥ || 19|| svāgatādi punaścakre phalamūlāni śaṃbhave | nivedya pradadau tasmai papracchāgamanaṃ kutaḥ ||3.206.20|| kva gamyate mahārāja yadīṣṭaṃ vasa madgṛhe | śrutvaivaṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha bhaktārthaṃ tvāgamo mama ||21 || gamyate yatra bhakto’sti tīrthaṃ madiṣṭaṃ sarvathā | yatra bhaktā nivasanti tatra vasāmi sādhuvat ||22|| tvaṃ bhakto’si vane nityaṃ satāmātithyakārakaḥ | tvadgṛhaṃ pāvanīkṛtya yāsyāmyanyat sutīrthakam ||23|| śrutvaitad vanapālo’pi papraccha punareva tam | kva tīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ sādho vidyate yatra gamyate || 24|| jaṭī prāha tadā bhaktaṃ tīrthaṃ satāṃ samāgamaḥ | yatra satsaṃga utkṛṣṭastatra vai gamyate mayā |||25| sādhavo bahavaḥ santi saṃsārānmokṣakāriṇaḥ | viṣṇordhyānaparāścāpi śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇakāriṇaḥ ||26|| tyāginaśca tapoyuktā nigrahe ca yame ratāḥ | sevābhaktiparāścāpi vanāraṇyanivāsinaḥ ||27|| yadgṛhe vartate viṣṇuḥ śaṃbhurvā śrīnarāyaṇaḥ | vāsudevo bālakṛṣṇastadgṛhaṃ tīrthamuttamam ||28|| yatra hiraṇyavarṇaśca hiraṇyakeśavān prabhuḥ | sarvaḥ suvarṇamūrtiḥ śrīharirvirājate sadā ||29|| tattīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ bhakta tatra tīrthe vasāmyaham | bhūritejodivyamūrtirbhagavān yatra rājate ||3.206.30|| yatra bhaktā hareḥ santi sādhvyaśca sādhavo’pi ca | tattīrthe pāvanaṃ bhakta tatra vai gamyate mayā ||31|| saccidānandarūpaṃ yat pūrṇaṃ brahma prakāśakṛt | mahātejo yataḥ saṃprakāśate’tra vasāmyaham ||32|| tameva puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam | dhyātvā parātparaṃ divyaṃ parameśamupaimyaham ||33|| tenedaṃ ca jagat pūrṇaṃ pūrṇena puruṣeṇa vai | taṃ śyāmasundaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇamupaimyaham ||34|| karmaphalapradātāraṃ jīvānāmīśvareśvaram | mukteśvaraṃ divyamūrtiṃ lakṣmīpatimupaimyaham ||35|| yasya mūrteścāti tejo mahad vyāpakamūrdhvagam | sarvasthaṃ brahmasaṃjñaṃ ca taṃ śrīpatimupaimyaham ||36|| yasyānvayena sarvatra mahaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ prakāśate | mūrtavat phaladaṃ cāste taṃ tejasvinamemyaham ||37|| īśvarā devatāḥ siddhā yatpratāpena mādhavāḥ | bhavanti taṃ divyamūrtiṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ samupaimyaham ||38|| yasya mūrtau samādhiṃ samprāptasya divyayoginaḥ | māyātatkāryatattvānāṃ layo’sti tamupaimyaham ||39|| cidākāśo’tisukhavān mahānandabhṛtaḥ sadā | yanmūrteḥ svacchatātmāste taṃ pareśamupaimyaham ||3.206.40|| yadakṣaraṃ brahmadhāma divyaṃ vyoma mahaḥ sukham | sarvānandapradaṃ yasya tamupaimi hariṃ prabhum ||41|| yadakṣaraṃ samasteṣu māyāyāṃ māyikeṣu ca | ātmatattveṣu cāpyāste taṃ prabhuṃ samupaimyaham ||42|| puruṣe prakṛtau kāle yadanvayatayā balam | samastakāryakāritvaṃ taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ samupaimyaham ||43|| sṛṣṭitrayaṃ ca yasmādvai śobhate layameti ca | sṛṣṭitraye vartamānaṃ taṃ hariṃ samupaimyaham ||44|| yatprasādād divyadṛṣṭirmānavo’pi suro’pi vā | sarvaṃ brahmekṣate taṃ māṇikīkāntamupaimyaham ||45|| anantāḥ śaktayo yasmādanantaiśvaryakoṭayaḥ | prabhavanti ca rudrādyāstaṃ pareśamupaimyaham ||46|| aṣṭāṃgayoginaḥ santaḥ sādhyā devāśca yaṃ prabhum | samādhau saṃprapaśyanti taṃ hariṃ samupaimyaham ||47|| yanmūrtau dehināṃ nāḍīprāṇāmbarāṇi sarvathā | saṃkucitānyākṛṣṭāni jāyante tamupaimyaham ||48|| īśvarā brahmarudrādyā mādṛśāḥ sādhavastathā | nārāyaṇā hyasaṃkhyātā yaṃ śritvaiśvaryaśālinaḥ ||49|| bhagavanto bhavantyeva nārāyaṇyo bhavantyapi | avatārāvatāriṇyastamupaimi pareśvaram ||3.206.50|| bhaja tvaṃ sarvathā taṃ ca devaṃ śrīpatimīśvaram | sarveśaṃ sarvaśaktīnāṃ dhartāraṃ rādhikāpatim ||51|| ahaṃ bhajāmi taṃ devaṃ viṣṇuṃ śrīparameśvaram | anye bhajitvā taṃ devaṃ paraṃ padaṃ purā yayuḥ ||52|| yānti yāsyanti cānye’pi bhaja taṃ parameśvaram | ityevamuktvā śānto’bhūd rudro vai bhaktavatsalaḥ ||53|| tato lakṣmi śikhādevī tathā tilakaraṃgakaḥ | jñātvā sādhuṃ brahmaniṣṭhaṃ rudrasamaṃ vavandatuḥ ||54|| aho sādho dhanyabhāgyamasmākaṃ vai kuṭumbinām | jñānametādṛśaṃ cādya labdhavanto yataḥ sataḥ ||55|| bhavādṛśasya sādhorvai darśanaṃ durlabhaṃ tviha | vanapānāṃ kathaṃ sādhusaṃgamo mokṣado bhavet ||56|| viṣṇorbhakto bhavānāste vayaṃ bhaktā harasya ca | harasya darśanaṃ kasmād bhavettadvada śobhanam ||57|| śrutvā śaṃbhustadā prāha śaṃbhostu darśanaṃ tava | vṛttīrniruddhya cātraiva bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||58|| antarvṛttīḥ samādhāya paśyantu māṃ hṛdantare | sādhumūrtau darśanaṃ te bhaviṣyati harasya vai ||59|| ityuktāste tilakādyā vanapāstatra cābdhije | antarvṛttīstadā kṛtvā dhyāyanti hṛtsu yāvatā ||3.206.60|| tāvat sādhuḥ svayaṃ rudrastriśūladhṛg vyajāyata | trinetro vyāghracarmadhṛk satīśrīpārvatīpatiḥ ||61 || harau magno’tisukhakṛt saumyarūpaḥ samujjvalaḥ | mahāyogī gaṇeśādyaiḥ sahitaḥ samadṛśyata ||62||| atha tatra hareḥ rūpaṃ caturbhujasya me śubham | lakṣmyā samaṃ mahādivyaṃ harasya hṛdaye param ||63|| vyadṛśyata mahānandabhṛtaṃ śaṃkarapūjitam | śaṃbhostu hṛdayāt tacca nirgataṃ śobhanaṃ bahiḥ ||64|| śaṃbhunā pūjyamānaṃ ca vyadṛśyata sukhapradam | evaṃ tu darśanaṃ datvā sādhurūpastu śaṃkaraḥ ||65 || viṣṇurūpaṃ nijarūpaṃ tirobhāvayadeva saḥ | sādhurūpo’bhavacchīghraṃ hṛdaye ca tataḥ param ||66|| sarvān tilakaraṃgādīn bahirvṛttīnakārayat | utthitā dadṛśuḥ sādhuṃ yathāpūrvaṃ jaṭādharam ||67|| jñānavantaśca taṃ śaṃbhuṃ sveṣṭadevaṃ satīpatim | nipetuḥ pādayoḥ sarve śaṃbhoḥ saṃvāhanaṃ vyadhuḥ ||68|| aparādhakṣamāṃ yayācire muktiṃ yayācire | śaṃbhuḥ prāha sadā cāsmi vaiṣṇavo bhaktavatsalaḥ ||69|| bhaktānāṃ śrīharau bhaktiṃ kārayitumihāgataḥ | nārāyaṇaṃ hṛdaye’haṃ rakṣāmi sarvadā prabhum ||3.206.70|| dhyāyāmi taṃ paraṃ brahma bālakṛṣṇaṃ śriyāḥ patim | bhavanto mama bhaktāśca bhajantu parameśvaram ||71 || ityuktvā pradadau lakṣmi mantraṃ tebhyaḥ svayaṃ haraḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |||72|| atha nārāyaṇapūjāṃ bhajanaṃ cādideśa tān | muktyarthaṃ vacanaṃ datvā sahasā sa tiro’bhavat ||73 || tatastilakaraṃgo’pi bheje śaṃbhoḥ samājñayā | bālakṛṣṇaṃ prabhuṃ māṃ vai patnīkuṭumbayuk sadā ||74|| vane vanyānmānavām̐śca tata ārabhya sarvathā | narānnārīścāhvayitvā kārayatyeva kīrtanam ||75|| harekṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa ramāpate | hareviṣṇo hare jiṣṇo’nādikṛṣṇa śriyaḥpate ||76|| evaṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ nityaṃ karoti kārayatyapi | vane vedyāṃ nityamevārcayatyeva janārdanam ||77|| phalapuṣpādibhiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ hariṃ tu mām | toṣayatyeva ca nīrājanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ param ||78|| nṛtyatyeva savādyaṃ ca premṇā sāyaṃ niśāgame | sādhuṣveva haraścāste hare harirvirājate ||79|| matvaivaṃ vanamadhye’pi sādhūn sadā prasevate | karmaṇā manasā vācā dehena ca dhanena ca ||3.206.80|| patrapuṣpaphalaistoyaiścātmārpaṇena sevate | sādhvarthaṃ kṛtasarvasvaḥ pratyakṣasādhusevanaḥ ||81 || pratyakṣaniścayaḥ samyak samarpya sevate sataḥ | bhāryā sukhārthinī sarvaṃ tyaktvā sukhaṃ virāgiṇī ||82|| yathā tathā sataḥ sādhvī sevate paramārthinī | putraputryādikāścāsya sevante sādhumīśvaram ||83|| sarvaṃ vai vartate sādhau haro harirnarāyaṇaḥ | brahma mokṣo mahānandaḥ sādhuṣu śāśvataṃ sukham ||84|| sādhureva paraṃbrahma sādhurdevo guruḥ paraḥ | sādhujano harermūrtiḥ sādhoḥ sevā hi muktidā ||85|| ityevaṃ te prasevante vanapā vanyavastubhiḥ | athaikadā kārtikasya kṛṣṇāṣṭamīdine tu te ||86|| mahotsavaṃ pracakrurvai vane kuñje tu dārave | vṛkṣaśākhānaddhadolāṃ vallīpallavapuṣpitām ||87|| śobhitāṃ saṃvidhāyaiva māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ te nyaṣādayan | āndolanaṃ pracakruśca kīrtanaṃ pūjanaṃ mama ||88|| janmamahotsavaṃ cakruranāderme tadā tvaham | nṛtyagītottaraṃ rātrau brahmapriyāsamanvitaḥ ||89|| divyakiśorarūpeṇa pratyakṣastvarito’bhavam | divyadivyātidivyāḍhyarūpabhūṣāmbarānvitaḥ ||3.206.90|| prāvirāsaṃ sudolāyāṃ tejaḥparidhisatprabhaḥ | prasannahāsyavadanaḥ kiśoro māṇikīpatiḥ ||91 || rādhālakṣmīpatiprajñāpramāśrīkamalāpatiḥ | āścaryaṃ te yayuḥ sarve kṣaṇaṃ cakruśca darśanam ||92|| atha mūrtisvarūpo’hamabhavaṃ ca drutaṃ tataḥ | pramodamagnāste sarve prārthayāmāsurutsukāḥ |||93|| harekṛṣṇa dayāsindho tārayāsmānnijāñjanān | saṃsārasāgarādasmāttava dhāma pradehi naḥ ||94|| tathāstvevamahaṃ tebhyo varaṃ dadau tadā rame | mūrtermukhād varadānaṃ datvā cāttvā tadarpitam ||95|| adṛśyo’hamabhavam̐śca te cakruḥ parihārakam | atha kālāntare prāpte tilakaraṃgayoginaḥ ||96|| śikhādevyāstathā cānyavanapānāṃ kṛpāvaśaḥ | muktidātā vimānena hyupasthito’bhavaṃ vane ||97|| divyadehān vidhāyaitān vimāne tānnyaṣādayam | agamaṃ divyadhāmordhvaṃ cākṣaraṃ paramaṃ mama ||98|| evaṃ muktiṃ dattavān vai vanapebhyaḥ paraṃ padam | anye’pi vanapāstatra bhajante mā hariṃ prabhum ||99|| prayānti cākṣaraṃ dhāma prāpte cāyuṣyasīmake | ye ye śaṃbhornideśena bhajante māṃ janārdanam || 3.206.100 || nayāmi tānmama dhāmākṣaraṃ lakṣmi parātparam | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi ||1 01 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne tilakaraṃgasya vanapasya śivabhaktasya sādhurūpaśivoktabhaktyā nārāyaṇopāsanayā paramamuktiprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 206 ||
<3.207> puruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kṣetrapasya kathāṃ śubhām | nāmnā nāñjakadevasya mama bhaktasya tāraṇīm || 1 || nāñjabhakto’bhavacchūraḥ sīmakṣetraprarakṣakaḥ | kuṃkume laumaśe kṣetre śastrāstravinmahābalaḥ || 2 || sīmni vasati nityaṃ sa nagare yāti cotsave | sasyarakṣākaro nāñjo vāṭikānāṃ ca rakṣakaḥ || 3 || khalasthānnakaṇagañjarakṣakaśca sa eva saḥ | rātrindivaṃ bhramatyeṣo rakṣārthaṃ paritaḥ kṣitau || 4 || caurāpahārakebhyaśca rakṣāṃ karoti sarvathā | karṣukāṇāṃ ca dhanināṃ nāgarikādisampadām || 5 || patrakāṇḍādikānāṃ ca sañcayānāṃ tu sīmasu | nityaṃ māṃ bhajate nāmnā śrīkṛṣṇaśrīnarāyaṇa || 6 || mālāmāvartayatyeva mārgeṣu sīmabhūmiṣu | nāñjasya nāma saṃśrutvā caurā nāyānti tāṃ diśam || 7 || bhakto bhaktau nipūṇo’ti dharme’pi pūjane’pi me | bhajane kīrtane dhyāne yatnavān vartate sadā || 8 || sādhūnāṃ rakṣaṇe śūro gavāṃ ca dīnayoṣitām | sādhvīnāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca vṛddhānāṃ rakṣaṇe tathā || 9 || devānāṃ daivavṛkṣāṇāṃ devabhuvāṃ ca rakṣaṇe | śraddhāvān sevakaścāyaṃ nirmāno dāsavat sadā || 3.207.1 0|| evaṃvidho’yaṃ bhakto me lakṣmi prātaḥ sadā mama | pūjanaṃ saṃvidhāyaiva vīkṣārthaṃ cāṭavīṃ prati || 11 || sarvadikṣu prayātyeva duṣṭānāṃ śāsanāya vai | ekadā pūrvadigbhāge prātaḥ krośadvayaṃ yayau || 12|| dūre’marāpurato vai mṛdaṃgapurasannidhau | tatra śatruṃjayādeśālluṇṭakāḥ samupāyayuḥ || 1 3|| bahavo’śvasamārohāḥ saśastrā annahāriṇaḥ | karṣukāṇāṃ khalabhūmerapahartuṃ khaleṣu te || 14|| viviśurvāṭikābhāge karṣukāstu bhayaṃ gatāḥ | rakṣakaṃ naiva cāsādya hyākruśya kaṇasañcayān || 15|| vihāya prayayurdūraṃ tatra nāñjaḥ samāyayau | kathaṃ vimanaso yūyaṃ nāñjaḥ papraccha karṣukān || 1 6|| karṣukā jagadustaṃ ca luṇṭakā annahārakāḥ | prasahya khalabhūmeśca harantyannāni no’dhunā || 17|| rakṣāṃ kuru balaṃ te celluṇṭakebhyaḥ prarakṣaka | śrutvā tūrṇaṃ harikṛṣṇaṃ smṛtvā māṃ puruṣottamam || 18|| aśvavāraḥ svayaṃ śīghraṃ dudrāva tatsthalīṃ prati | yatra te luṇṭakāścānnasañcayān vai haranti ha || 19|| aśveṣūṣṭreṣu cānnāni nikṣipya te vahanti vai | tān dṛṣṭvā śūrabhāṣābhirgarjanāṃ nāñjako vyadhāt ||3.207.20|| luṇṭakā balino yūyaṃ mātṛjāḥ pitṛjāḥ ṛtāḥ | māṃ vijitya tato yāntu jitānnānānyathā tviti ||21|| śrutvā balodbhavaṃ śabdaṃ sanmukhā yuddhavedinaḥ | abhavan śastrayuktāste nāñjasya vijayāya vai ||22|| śastrāṇāṃ sahasā kṣepaḥ sānnidhye samajāyata | prāvartata tadā yuddhaṃ bāṇaiḥ śastraiśca tomaraiḥ ||23|| eko nāñjastu viṃśatyā saha yuddhyati madhyagaḥ | śastrakṣato’pi bahudhā māṃ smaran bahu yuddhyati ||24|| nāñjasya bhallakairviddhā daśa vakṣassu vai mṛtāḥ | caurāstato hi caurāṇāṃ khaṅgāghātairmuhurmuhuḥ ||286|| nāñjo nipatito
