bhūmau mūrchāyāṃ māṃ smaran muhuḥ | tadāhaṃ tatsthale śūraḥ khaḍgadhraḥ pārśvato drutam ||26|| āvirāsaṃ mahādeho vajrāṃgo yuddhakovidaḥ | khaḍgaśastān śeṣacaurān bibhedātyavicārayan ||27|| sarve mṛtiṃ gatāścaurā viṃśatistatra vai drutam | ekaviṃśastvekacauro rāmarāmetisaṃvadan ||28|| mṛtyave saṃyayau mūrchāmāptaḥ śīghraṃ visaṃjñakaḥ | tato’haṃ dayayā spṛṣṭvā rāmanāmaparāyaṇam ||29|| ujjīvayan prabhaktaṃ taṃ nīrujaṃ samakārayam | utthitaḥ sa tato bhakto nāmnā mahāmayābhidhaḥ ||3.207.3 0|| prārthayanmāṃ tu nāñjasyojjīvanārthaṃ dayāvaśaḥ | tato nāñjaṃ karābhyāṃ saṃspṛśannahaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ||3 1 || mūrchāṃ tasya vyapanīyautthāpayaṃ taṃ sukhānvitam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca tau tadā ||32|| tuṣṭuvatuḥ sārdabhāvau mṛtānāṃ prāṇalabdhaye | aho nārāyaṇastvaṃ vai rāmo rākṣasamokṣakṛt ||33|| aho nṛsiṃho bhagavān bhavān daityavināśakṛt | aho kṛṣṇa hare rāma tvaṃ gajoddhārakārakaḥ ||34|| tvamevāsuranāśārthaṃ vartase bhaktavatsalaḥ | pāpināṃ pāpanāśaśca jāyate tava darśanāt ||35|| sparśanāt smaraṇāccāpi pāpino’tra taranti hi | viśvaṃbharo bhavānāste poṣako rakṣako’pi ca || 36|| hantā saṃkarṣaṇo rudraḥ kālo bhavān prakāśate | rakṣa rakṣa kṛpāsindho mṛtānujjīvayātra vai || 37|| caurayogena bhakto’pi saṃgāccauraḥ prajāyate | bhakto mahāmayaścāhaṃ cauryakārye’bhisaṃhataḥ ||38|| tathāpi rāmanāmnā tvaṃ bhaktaṃ rakṣitavāniha | nāñjaṃ rakṣitavānatra rakṣā tadyogato mama ||39|| jātātra bhagavan kṛṣṇa bhaktecchāsaṃprapūraka | bhaktayogaṃ gatāśceme rakṣaṇīyā dayālunā ||3.207.40|| mṛtāścejjīvitāḥ syuste bhajiṣyanti narāyaṇam | athavā te rucisteṣāṃ mokṣaṇe cettathā kuru ||41 || ityukto’haṃ tadā lakṣmi mṛtānāṃ mokṣahetave | svargavāsaṃ prathamaṃ vai kṛpayā samakalpayam ||42|| pāpānyeṣāṃ bhaktayogānmadyogādavināśayam | yāmyaduḥkhāni sarvāṇi tacchirobhyo vyanāśayam ||43|| smṛtvā devavimānaṃ ca kṛtvā tān devavigrahān | apreṣayaṃ divaṃ tūrṇaṃ viṃśatiṃ samare mṛtān ||44|| mahāmayaṃ tathā nāñjaṃ bhaktaṃ kareṇa vai muhuḥ | sparśaṃ kṛtvā ca nīrujaṃ yathāpūrvamakārayam ||45|| puṣṭau vigataduḥkhau tau bodhitau ca mayā tadā | anityo’yaṃ hi saṃsāro deho’nityo gṛhādayaḥ ||46|| anityāḥ sarvamāyotthāḥ padārthāḥ kṣayagocarāḥ | tathāpyajñā janā nītiṃ vihāyotpathagāminaḥ ||47|| hiṃsāyāṃ sampravartante’pahāre nāśane muhuḥ | satāṃ yogaṃ na kurvanti bhajante na pareśvaram ||48|| śāstrakathāṃ na śṛṇvanti pāpaṃ kurvantyasaṃśayāḥ | tena yāmyamahāduḥkhānyanubhavanti daṇḍitāḥ ||49|| paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ janmānyapi gṛhṇanti pāpinaḥ | duḥkhottaraṃ ca duḥkhaṃ samprāpnuvanti vidharmiṇaḥ ||3.207.50|| parānnaharaṇe janma mūṣakāṇāṃ prajāyate | ghṛtadugdhādiharaṇe mārjārajanmavān bhavet ||51 || śākamūlādiharaṇe māyūraṃ janma cāpyate | vastropakaraṇācchede māhiṣaṃ janma jāyate ||52|| phalapatrādiharaṇe vānaratvaṃ prajāyate | svarṇaratnādiharaṇe bhallukatvaṃ prajāyate ||53 || jalapānādiharaṇe pretatā nirjale vane | dārāputryādiharaṇe ṣaṇḍhatvaṃ gaṇikājanuḥ ||54|| vādyavāditraharaṇe bhāṇḍatvaṃ naṭatā tathā | viśvāsaghātakānāṃ tu vṛkatā kṛkalāsatā ||||55|| apahārakṛtāṃ cāśvajanma vāhanajīvinām | ṛṇināṃ tu vṛṣabhatvaṃ nindakānāṃ tu mūkatā ||56|| ṣaṇḍhokṣatvaṃ kāmināṃ ca kāminī tu piśācinī | pratārako bhikṣukaśca bhaved dāridryaduḥkhavān ||57|| devānnadhanabhoktā ca bhavecchvā kāka unduruḥ | kulahantā nakulaḥ syānnārīhantā tu rākṣasaḥ ||58|| dharmahantā bhāgyahīno vārāho jāyate vane | bhaktihantā nārakī syānnirvaṃśo yamadūtakaḥ ||59|| madyapo mūtrakīṭaḥ syād vṛściko viṣabhakṣakaḥ | kruddhaḥ sarpo bhaveccāpi nīlamarkaṭikastathā ||3.207.60 || ityevaṃ karmajanmāni jñātvā tāni vivarjayet | śubhaṃ kuryānmānavena dehena nāśubhaṃ kvacit ||61 || śubhaṃ dharmaṃ śubhaṃ jñānaṃ śubhaṃ vairāgyamityapi | śubhāṃ bhaktiṃ prakuryācca mokṣadaṃ satsamāgamam ||62||| nirdaṃbhaṃ satparicaryāṃ kuryāddhareḥ satāṃ sadā | kṛṣṇamandiravāṭyādi kārayellepamārjane ||63|| pādasaṃvāhanaṃ dehamardanaṃ ca satāṃ kriyāt | naivedyaṃ bhojanaṃ vāripānaṃ dadyāttu śārṅgiṇe ||64|| sadyo dadyād yatheṣṭaṃ ca seveta gurumaṇḍalam | kathāṃ ca śṛṇuyānnityaṃ nāmakīrtanamācaret |||65|| ātmaniṣṭhayā varteta brahmarūpeṇa cātmanā | jānīyānmāṃ hariṃ divyaṃ sarvadoṣavivarjitam ||66|| vārtāṃ madīyāṃ kuryācca snehaṃ kuryāt sadā mayi | māyāmāyikakāryeṣu rāgahīnastathā bhavet ||67|| sādhusevāṃ ca satsaṃgaṃ prakurvīta sadā śubham | viṣayeṣu prakuryāccāruciṃ cāntermatirbhavet ||68|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe matiṃ dṛḍhāṃ kriyāt | anyatra mānasaṃ naiva dhārayettu kadācana ||69|| premṇaiva kārayet kuryāt sevāṃ me’laṃkṛtiṃ tathā | mama mūrtiṃ dhārayecca mānuṣīṃ devatāṃ ca vā ||3.207.70|| mama bhakteṣu vai prītiṃ kuryānnānyatra kutracit | strīputrādau bandhanaṃ tu snehaṃ sadā vivarjayet ||71 || kṛṣṇasambandhinīṣveva kriyāsu vyāpṛto bhavet | kṛṣṇasambandhaśūnyābhyo nivarteta samāhitaḥ ||72|| nityaṃ pūjā mama kuryāt prārthayecca nijaṃ hitam | nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa viṣṇo svāmin pareśvara ||73|| adharmamārgagāllokāt pāhi māṃ nāstikāttathā | samāgamaṃ te bhaktānāṃ dehi nityaṃ śubhaṃ kuru ||74|| asatāṃ saṃgamo mā syāttathā rakṣāṃ sadā kuru | caurāṇāṃ pāpināṃ saṃgaṃ nindakānāṃ na me’rpaya ||75|| madyamāṃsāśanānāṃ ca saṃgaṃ vyavāyināṃ na me | mūrtikhaṇḍanakartṝṇāmupāsanāvināśinām ||76|| saṃgaṃ me mārpaya kṛṣṇa śaraṇāgatavatsala | bhaktiṃ vinā dinaṃ vandhyaṃ mā me yātu tathā kuru ||77|| manovṛttiḥ sadā kṛṣṇe tiṣṭhettathāvidhāpaya | sāṃsārikeṣu cittaṃ me virāgaṃ syāttathā kuru ||78 || satāṃ samāgamaṃ kṛṣṇa tava mūrteḥ samāgamam | ciraṃ ca darśanaṃ te ca dehi hṛdvāsamācara ||79|| bahirvā cāntare vā te darśanaṃ divyameva tat | sarvadā syāttathā kṛṣṇāntardṛṣṭi dehi me śubhām ||3.207.80 || ante dhāmākṣaraṃ dehi tava mūrtyā virājitam | arthayāmi tathā kṛṣṇa muktiṃ te sevanātmikām ||81 || ityevamarthayennityaṃ bhagavantaṃ hariṃ tu mām | bhaktau yuvāṃ yatastasmādahaṃ dṛṣṭipathaṃ gataḥ ||82||| kalyāṇaṃ bhavatorastu prayāmi mama mandiram | ityuktvā karṣukān dhairyaṃ datvā śrībhagavām̐stataḥ ||83 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | datvā mantraṃ karṣukebhyo bhaktābhyāṃ ca tiro’bhavat ||84|| karṣukāste camatkāraṃ vīkṣya cakrurmamāśrayam | pūjanaṃ bhajanaṃ ceti kṣetrapo’pi viśeṣataḥ ||85|| mahāmayo’pi sahasā nārāyaṇasamāgamāt | nirāmayo’bhavallakṣmi nāñjo’pi cāñjanojjhitaḥ | |86|| te sarve nityadā bhejurmāṃ śrīrādhāramāṃpatim | pūjanaṃ bhojane dhyānaṃ ramaṇe smaraṇaṃ mama ||87|| cakruśca kīrtanaṃ nityaṃ dehānte ca tataḥ param | vimānenāyayau cāhaṃ viṣṇuvimānaśobhanaḥ ||88|| pārṣadaiḥ sahitaścāśvapaṭṭasīmni tadā drutam | karṣukānnijalokaṃ ca ninye divyaśarīriṇaḥ ||89|| nāñjaṃ bhaktaṃ punarninye ninye nirāmayaṃ tataḥ | evaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ prāptā bhaktā me kṣetrapā api ||3.207.90| | lakṣmi kṣetrodbhavaṃ dhānyaṃ nūtanaṃ me samarpayet | cirbhaṭaṃ makkikāṃ cāpi patraṃ puṣpaṃ samarpayet ||91 || kandaṃ phalaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca miṣṭaṃ śākaṃ ca mañjarīm | stambaṃ nālaṃ ca kāṇḍaṃ ca śākhāṃ vā me samarpayet| ||92|| kaṇaṃ ca badaraṃ vāpi mṛdaṃ vā pāvanīmapi | arpayenmāṃ tu yo bhaktyoddharāmi taṃ samarpakam ||93|| samidhastulasīpatraṃ candanadruṃ phaladrumam | tṛṇaṃ darbhaṃ cāṃkuraṃ vārpayenme muktibhāktu saḥ ||94|| kārpāsaṃ pūlakaṃ vāpi śimbiṃ vā kośameva vā | gucchaṃ vā kuṇḍikāṃ vā me’rpayenmokṣagato bhaveta || 95|| tilān vā godhumakām̐śca caṇakān dvidalāstathā | nivārān vā sārikā vā kharjuraṃ vā samarpayet ||96|| śarkarāṃ vā haridrāṃ vā lavaṇaṃ cārdrakaṃ ca vā | āranālaṃ ca vividhaṃ laviṃgaṃ pūgikāphalam ||97|| elāṃ ca kesaraṃ vāpi me’rpayenmuktibhāg bhavet | āsanaṃ vāpi pātraṃ vā latāṃ vā vetramityapi ||98 || yānaṃ vastraṃ carvaṇaṃ ca tailaṃ sugandhamuttamam | śṛṃgāraṃ cārpayenmahyaṃ jāyate mokṣabhāgdhi saḥ ||99|| dugdhaṃ rasaṃ ca pakvānnaṃ miṣṭapānaṃ ca śītalam | vyajanaṃ vyañjanaṃ cāpi me’rpayenmokṣabhāg bhavet ||3.207.1 00 || ātmārpaṇena sarve vai kamale yānti matpadam | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇādapi mokṣabhāg ||1 01 | | iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne kṣetrapasya nāñjabhaktasya mahāmayabhaktasya karṣukāṇāṃ ca caurebhyorakṣaṇaṃ bhagavatā kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 207 ||
<3.208> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ bhaktaṃ kirātajātijam | sāgarākhyaṃ mahāśāṭīnagarīvāsinaṃ śubham || 1 || kuṭumbasahitaścāyaṃ mahīnadītaṭe vane | carati dehayātrārthaṃ kurute sañcayaṃ gṛhe || 2 || vanyānāṃ kandamūlānāṃ cānnānāṃ kaṇināṃ tathā | śimbīnāṃ ca phalānāṃ ca bījānāṃ rasināṃ tathā || 3 || kvacidannaṃ phalaṃ patraṃ kvacit kandaṃ bhunakti saḥ | dehayātrāsu nirvāhaṃ karoti bhajate ca mām || 4 || vāṭagānāṃ dhanāḍhyānāṃ bhāravāhī bhavatyapi | śreṣṭhināṃ bhṛtyatāṃ cāpi kvacit karoti bhīlakaḥ | | 5 || evaṃ kurvan sa nirvāhaṃ kvacinnāpnoti bhojanam | tadopavāse nirato bhajate māṃ mudā yutaḥ || 6 || mālikāvartanaṃ cāpi karoti kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa ca | vrataṃ sāhajikaṃ tadvai matvā ca jāgaraṃ niśi ||7 || karoti kīrtanaṃ rātrau kṣudhātṛṣānvitaḥ sa vai | patnī putrāstathā putryaḥ sarve kurvanti vai vratam || 8 || ekadā kamale teṣāṃ śravaṇe śuklapakṣake | ekādaśīdine naiva militaṃ bhojanaṃ manāk || 9 || vrataṃ jātaṃ sahajaṃ caikādaśījaṃ sajāgaram | nirjalaṃ te pracakruśca pūjanaṃ kīrtanaṃ ca me || 3.208.1 0|| atha prātastu te sarve bhājīṃ nivedya me rame | jalaṃ samarpya mahyaṃ ca bubhujurbhājīmeva ha | | 11 || papurjalaṃ kṛṣṇakṛṣṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho | gṛṇantaśca mudā lakṣmi tadāhaṃ karuṇālayaḥ || 12|| teṣāmagre godhumānāṃ śakaṭyā saha saṃyayau | te sarve māṃ vikrayiṇaṃ matvā śreṣṭhinamuttamam || 13 || nemurjalaṃ daduścāpi viśrāntyarthaṃ jaguḥ kṣaṇam | ahaṃ matvā ca tadvākyaṃ śakarīṃ tadgṛhāṃgaṇe || 14|| avasthāpya vṛṣabhau ca nirbadhya tatkṛtāsane | upāviśaṃ ca te sarve pādasaṃvāhanaṃ mama || 15 || vyadhuśca kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti vadanto magnamānasāḥ | atha pṛṣṭā mayā sarve kiṃvṛttāḥ kiṃprajīvanāḥ || 1 6|| te procurjīvanaṃ kṛ6ṇo dadāti jīvyate tathā | adya bhājyā kṛtaṃ kṛṣyapūjanaṃ ca jalena ca || 17|| bhuktā bhājī jalaṃ pītaṃ śāntistatra hi naḥ sadā | vartate sukhadā śreṣṭhin kiṃ lakṣaiḥ koṭibhirdhanaiḥ || 18|| bhajāmaḥ śrīhariṃ nityaṃ dadātyeva sa bhojanam | sarvārpaṇaṃ prakurmaśca haraye nirguṇāyitam || 19|| bhavān śreṣṭhī vartate’dya mahīmāno gṛhe’tra naḥ | bhavadyogyaṃ mahānnaṃ tu nāsti svāgatakārakam || 3.208.20 || tato bhājīṃ pradadmaste rocate saṃgṛhāṇa tām | ityukto’haṃ tadā lakṣmi premṇā bhājīṃ cakhāda tām |||1 || jalapānaṃ cakārāpi tṛptiṃ jagāma bhaktijām | athāhaṃ pradadau tebhyo godhumānāṃ samastakam | |22| dhanaṃ ca pradadau tebhyo sahasraṃ rūpyamudrikāḥ | tataste māṃ papracchuśca nāma grāmaṃ kuṭumbakam || 23|| ahamāha harikṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇo bhavāmyaham | grāmaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ me ca kuṭumbaṃ bhaktamaṇḍalam || 20|| teṣāṃ gṛhe mama yātrā mahīmāno bhavāmyaham | bhavadbhiryat kṛtaṃ tvekādaśyā vrataṃ sajāgaram ||25|| bhājyā cādbhistoṣito’haṃ rakṣārthaṃ samupāyayau | kṛpayā tvāgato’smyatra dātuṃ sarvāṃśca godhumān ||26|| akṣayāste mama hastaspṛṣṭā godhumakā ime | bhaviṣyanti kusule ca nikṣipyopari chādanam || 27|| kṛtvā chidrāt niṣkāsanīyā na cānyathā | akṣayāste bhaviṣyanti mama pratāpataḥ khalu ||28|| bhavantu sukhino bhaktā vaṃśaparamparābhavāḥ | yadā me pūjanaṃ naiva bhaviṣyati gṛhe’tra vai || 29|| tadā kṣayamavāpsyanti godhumāste mayārpitāḥ | ityuktvā pradadau sarvān darśanaṃ divyamityapi || 3.208.30 || dadau caturbhujaṃ me ca śriyā yuktaṃ manoharam | tuṣṭuvurmāṃ tu te sarve nipetuḥ pādayormama || 31 || mumucuḥ premabhāvenāśrūṇi sarve tu vihvalāḥ | vavrire rakṣaṇaṃ cāpi mokṣaṃ tvante paraṃ padam |||32|| ahaṃ dhairyaṃ vaco datvā śakaṭena samaṃ tathā | vṛṣabhābhyāṃ samaṃ lakṣmi tūrṇaṃ tatra tiro’bhavam ||3 3 || ājīvanaṃ kirāto me bhakto godhumapolikāḥ | kārayitvā nijapatnyā bhājyā sākaṃ nyavedayat ||34|| yatayaḥ sādhavaścānye satyaḥ sādhvyaśca bhikṣukāḥ | ye cāyānti labhante te bhājīṃ godhumapolikāḥ ||35 || annasatraṃ sāgarasya prāvartata nirantaram | tārthayātrālavo’pyasya gṛhe śāntiṃ prayānti hi ||36|| satāṃ sevāṃ mahālābhaṃ labhate sāgaraḥ sadā | bahupuṇyayuto jātaḥ sāgaraḥ sāgaropamaḥ || 28|| yadgṛhe munayo yānti devaprasādabhojinaḥ | devatāḥ sādhuveṣāśca bhoktuṃ godhumapolikāḥ || 38 || matvā prasādaṃ divyaṃ ca samāyānti hi bhikṣukāḥ | śrīkṛṣṇadattagaudhumyaḥ polikāḥ sudhayā samāḥ || 29|| bhujyante devatābhiśca pitṛbhirbhikṣukātmakaiḥ | siddhaiśca divyadehaiśca bhujyante puṇyapolikāḥ ||3.208.40|| prātarārabhya cāsāyaṃ pravartante hi polikāḥ | akṣayā godhumāḥ sarve vardhante kusulodare ||41 || sāgarasya gṛhaṃ tīrthaṃ jātaṃ jagatprasiddhakam | trailokyāṃ khyātamevāpi pāvanaṃ jāyate tadā ||42 || atha śrutvā tu durvāsā akṣayaṃ cānnasatrakam | daśasāhasraśiṣyaiścākasmāt prātarupāyayau ||3||| sāgareṇa kṛtamānaḥ kṛtasvāgata ādarāt | bhojanārthaṃ tataḥ paṃktīḥ kṛtavān samakālikīḥ ||44|| sāgaraścintayāmāsa bhītaḥ śrīpatimīśvaram | māṃ tadāhaṃ śriyā sākaṃ prāvirāsaṃ gṛhodare ||45|| sāgaraścātimumude dṛṣṭvā māṃ ca śriyaṃ tathā | lakṣmīrmayā tadājñaptā polikānirmitau drutam ||46|| sā nirmame tu pañcaiva polikāḥ sahasā ramā | culyāśca vahninā paktā mayā dhṛtā kareṇa sā ||47|| akṣayāḥ pañca caitāśca nyūnā bhavanti naiva ha | sāgareṇa kare dhṛtvā sthālīṃ tāḥ pariveṣitāḥ ||48|| ekaikasmai daśasakhyāḥ sahasrebhyaḥ samarpitāḥ | evaṃ daśasahasrebhyaḥ polikāḥ pariveṣitāḥ ||49|| bhājāpi sthālato dattā sarvebhyaḥ pariveṣitā | mayā spṛṣṭā svādavatī bhājā ca polikāstathā ||3.208.50|| bubhujuśca samastāste durvāsaso’nuyāyinaḥ | tṛptāste culukaṃ kṛtvā mahāścaryaṃ hi menire ||51 || atha sthālyāṃ polikāścāvaśiṣyante tu pañca vai | evaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāścaryaṃ durvāsā gṛhamāyayau ||52|| parākṣārthaṃ hariścāhaṃ lakṣmyā sākaṃ tiro’bhavam | durvāsāḥ kusulaṃ natvā natvā bhaktaṃ ca sāgaram ||53 || tatpatnīṃ sārikānāmnīṃ datvāśīrvādamuttamam | akṣayaṃ te dhanaṃ cāstu dhānyamakṣayamastu te ||54|| bhājā te cākṣayāpyastu śraddhā te’stu tathākṣayā | annasatraṃ cākṣayaṃ tai puṇyaṃ te cākṣayaṃ tathā ||55|| muktiste tvakṣayā cāstu bhaktiste cākṣayāpi ca | dānadharmaścākṣayaste bhavatvevaṃ prayāmyaham ||56|| ityuktvā pūjitaścātiprasannaḥ prayayau vanam | evaṃ lakṣmi mayā tatra sāgaraḥ parirakṣitaḥ ||57|| atha śrutvā vālakhilyā brahmaputrā maharṣayaḥ | aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi vāmanāstatra cāyayuḥ ||58|| prasādapolikā bhoktumamāyāṃ prātareva ha | teṣāṃ cakre sāgaraśca sammānaṃ svāgataṃ tathā ||59|| āmantraṇaṃ bhojanārthaṃ paṃktiśaste tato’bhavan | tadā nārāyaṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ sasmāra māṃ ca sāgaraḥ ||3.208.60|| drāgeva cāgatastatra lakṣmyā sākaṃ janārdanaḥ | brāhmaṇaścābhavaṃ tatra lakṣmīśca brāhmaṇī tathā ||61|| kṛtvā hastatalamānāḥ polikāḥ sahasā daśa | aṣṭāśītisahasrebhyaḥ pratyekaṃ daśa vai daśa ||62|| bhājayā sahitā adadāṃ bubhujuste’tiharṣitāḥ | tṛptāste vai tato jātāḥ kṛtvā ca culukaṃ yayuḥ ||63|| praśasantaḥ sāgarasya bhaktiṃ prasannatāṃ hareḥ | evaṃ lakṣmi mayā tatra tvayā sākaṃ sa sāgaraḥ ||64|| rakṣitaḥ susahāyena bhojitāḥ ṛṣayo’khilāḥ | atha jñātvā śaṃkarastadgṛhaṃ pāvanamuttamam ||65|| daśalakṣagaṇaiḥ sākaṃ madhyāhne samupāyayau | sarve sādhusvarūpāste jaṭācarmadharāḥ khalu ||66|| annasatraṃ paraṃ jñātvā cākṣayaṃ tad yayācire | bhojanaṃ polikānāṃ ca bhājānāṃ kṛṣṇapāvanam ||67|| sārikāsāgarau tatra bhītau sasmaratuśca mām | lakṣmyā sākaṃ tadā tūrṇamupasthito’bhavaṃ gṛhe ||68|| śataṃ ca polikāḥ kṛtvādadāṃ pratyekasādhave | daśalakṣayatibhyo vai dattavānahameva ha ||69|| bahurūpadharaścāha śataṃ tvante’vaśeṣitāḥ | bhuktvā te polikā bhājāstṛptāḥ praśaṃsya sāgaram ||3.208.70 || yayurnijaṃ hi kailāsaṃ śaṃkaro dhyānamācarat | dadarśa kāraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ śriyā yutam ||71 || āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpa bhaktādhīnaṃ vilokya mām | ityevaṃ vai mayā lakṣmi sāgaraścāvitastadā ||72|| atha śrutvā svayaṃ brahmā polikārthamupāyayau | koṭisiddhairupeto vai prasādalabdhaye drutam ||73|| yayāce vyomamārgeṇa prasādaṃ polikodbhavam | koṭisiddhapratṛptyarthaṃ sāgaraśca punarharim ||74|| sasmāra māṃ rakṣakaṃ copasthito’haṃ tadābhavam | lakṣmyā sākaṃ śriyā sākaṃ rādhayā sākamityapi ||75|| sākaṃ lalitayā cāpi māṇikyā ramayā saha | padmāvatyā saha brahmapriyābhiḥ saha vai tadā ||76|| koṭyarbudābhiḥ patnībhiścāmbare’vasthito’bhavam | sahasraṃ polikāḥ kārayitvā koṭipriyāyutaḥ ||77|| siddhebhyaścādadāṃ pratyekāya sahasrapolikāḥ | sahasraṃ cāvaśiṣṭāścetyāścaryaṃ viśvasṛṭ yayau ||78 || athaivaṃ sāgaraścāpi matvā bhāgyaṃ mahattamam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇādhīnaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā hi vartate ||79|| mahīmānasvāgataṃ ca rātriṃdivaṃ karoti saḥ | akṣayā kusulā tasya trailokye khyātimāpa ha ||3.208.80 || āyānti ca parāyānti mahīmānāstrilokataḥ | āyāsaṃ paramaṃ prohya sāgaraḥ sevate mudā ||8 1 || nāyācata sahāyārthaṃ cāparaṃ balamaiśvaram | māmeva smarati bhakto yadā bhītiṃ sa gacchati ||82|| evamātmanivedasya bhaktasya vīkṣya bhāvanām | sevāṃ trilokijīvānāṃ prasanno’haṃ tato’bhavam ||83|| viśeṣeṇa mayā bhaktakṛte tatra vicintitam | deyamasmai kalpapātraṃ yatrāsaṃkhyāstu polikāḥ ||84|| āvirbhaveyuḥ satataṃ bhājāpātraṃ tathāparam | bhājā yatrāpyanantāścāvirbhaveyuḥ supācitāḥ ||85 || vicāryetthaṃ dadau tasmai pātradvayaṃ sutaijasam | prātareva supaktvātra polikā bhājikāstathā ||86|| nityaṃ rakṣati cācchādya pātrayorubhayorapi | mayoktaḥ sāgarastatra tvaṃ vā te strī pativratā ||87|| pūrṇapātrāṇyanantāni yāvadiṣṭāni tāni vai | sakalpayasi tāvanti pūritāni śubhāni ca ||88|| nissariṣyanti ramyāṇi cābhyāṃ saṃkalpamātrataḥ | pariveṣaṇayatno vā pātradānakriyā api ||89|| kartavyā na bhaviṣyanti paṃktau yāsyanti vai svataḥ | evamuktvā pūjito’haṃ datvā jalasya bhājanam ||3.208.90|| tādṛśaṃ cākṣayaṃ pūrṇaṃ pūrṇakalaśakāraṇam | tiro’bhavaṃ tataḥ sthānāt sāgaro mumude hyati ||91 || atha jñātvā mahāścaryaṃ bhādrāmāvāsyasaddine | koṭyarbudāśca pitaro maharjanatapobhavāḥ ||92|| āyayuḥ suprasādasyecchayā tṛptyarthamutsukāḥ | śarīriṇaḥ samastāste paṃktiśo’vasthitāstadā ||93|| sārikā snānaśuddhā ca kṛtvā bhājāśca polikāḥ | dugdhapākaṃ śrāddhayogyaṃ nyadhāt tayostu pātrayoḥ ||94|| ācchādya viṣṇave prārpya yathoktaṃ samakalpayat | sāgaro’pi kṛtasnānaḥ pātrāntikamupāyayau ||95|| acintayat koṭyayutārbudapātrāṇi vai tadā | pūritāni hyasaṃkhyāni niryayuḥ pātrayugmakāt ||96|| pratyekapitṛdevāya pratyekaṃ samupasthitam | pātraṃ pūrṇaṃ polikābhiḥ pāyasānnaistathā rame ||97|| bhājābhiśca tathā vārikalaśaśceti tṛptidaḥ | koṭyarbudābjapitaro bhuktvā tṛptāstato yayuḥ ||98|| riktapātrāṇi vilayaṃ svabhāvāt samupāyayuḥ | evaṃ sa sāgaro bhakto mayā godhumasatrake ||99|| vardhito’tikṛpayā vai sarvasvāgatakṛd yathā | kirāto’nvabhavad bhaktyā devarāto hi sarvathā || 3.208.100 || atha kālāntare cāhaṃ dampatī divyapārṣadaiḥ | sahitaḥ suvimānenānayaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ mama || 10 1|| mahīśāṭīnagarī ca paścād godhumabhājikā | itināmnābhavallakṣmi tathā godhumasārikā || 1 02|| godhumarā tataścāpi kathyate pāvanī dharā | ityevaṃ tanmahattīrthaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā kṛpālunā || 1 03|| dampatyormokṣaṇe paścād rājñā godharasūriṇā | kusulā sā nijāyattā kṛtā tāvattu godhumāḥ || 1 04|| adṛśyatāṃ gatāḥ pātratrayaṃ cādṛśyatāṃ gatam | annasatraṃ samāptaṃ ca camatkāro layaṃ yayau || 1 05|| ityevaṃ godharasūrirvīkṣya daivakṛtaṃ hi tat | kusulaṃ nityadā riktaṃ hyapūjayat smaran hariḥ || 1 06|| tathāpi tu camatkāro gato yastu gato hi saḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya lakṣmi divyagatiṃ labhet || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sāgarākhyakirātabhaktasya bhaktyā prasannena śrīhariṇā śreṣṭhirūpeṇa godhumapuñjo’rpitaḥ kusulastho’kṣayaśca kṛtastatpolikābhājājalapātrāṇyakṣayāṇi kṛtāni mokṣaścakṛta ityādinirūpaṇanāmā aṣṭādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 208 ||
<3.209> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ hūṇabhaktasya satkathām | nāmnā sāraṃgasaṃjñasya bhūdharīgrāmavāsinaḥ || 1 || araṇye bhūdharīgrāme saurāṣṭre bhaktarāṇmama | kuṭumbasahito hūṇajātīyo vartate rame || 2 || karoti snānamādyaṃ ca prapūjya māṃ tataḥ param | mahiṣīmaṇḍalaṃ nītvā cāraṇārthaṃ tu śādvale || 3 || ghāsāraṇye prayātyeva sāyaṃ gṛhaṃ prayātyapi | araṇye santi siṃhāśca vyāghrāśca bhallukā api || 4 || vṛkāśca dvīpakāścāpi hiṃsrā vai prāṇino’pare | vyāghrāḥ siṃhā dharṣayanti kvacid gomahiṣīvṛṣān || 5 || mārayitvā bhakṣayanti trāsadā duḥkhadā hi te | hūṇaḥ sāraṃganāmā ca pañcāśanmahiṣīdhanaḥ || 6 || ghāseṣūttamamiṣṭeṣu mahiṣīścārayatyayam | atha madhyāhnasamaye pārśvadruṣaṇḍamadhyataḥ || 7 || karmadyaraṇyamārgeṇa siṃhāḥ pañca samāyayuḥ | mahiṣīṇāṃ ghāsacāravṛttīnāṃ maṇḍalopari || 8 || nipetuḥ sahasākasmāt siṃhāḥ pañcaiva śabditāḥ | balinaścātipuṣṭāścāpradhṛṣyāḥ kṣudruḍanvitāḥ || 9 || akasmāttā mahiṣyo’pi pṛṣṭhabinduṃ vidhāya ca | parito mukhacakraṃ saṃrakṣyāpatyāni madhyake || 3.209.10 || krudhā prāṇaprarakṣārthaṃ bhayena maṇḍalīkṛtāḥ | saṃbhūya grāmaracanāṃ vidhāya cakrire’vanam || 11 || siṃhā mahiṣīgrāmaṃ vai dṛṣṭvā prāpya bhayaṃ drutam | paścād vivṛtya te dūre mumucurvai muhurmuhuḥ || 12|| kugandhivātanivahān paśūnāṃ bhayahetave | yena svamaṇḍalād bhūtvā pṛthak ced vidravet tadā || 13 || siṃhāstā dharṣayeyuśca mārayeyuḥ svabhojanam| tathā cakrurgarjanāśca darśayāmāsurugratām || 14|| tathāpi tā mahiṣyastu sārthād bahirna niryayuḥ | evameva sthitau siṃhā garjantyeva bhayaṃkaram || 15|| śrutvā cānye daśa siṃhāścāyayurbhakṣyahetave | cakrakaṃ paritaścakraḥu siṃhāste daśapañca ca || 1 6|| mahiṣyastu samagrāstāḥ praticakre yathāsthitāḥ | na dravanti nissaranti nāpnuvanti na tāśca te || 17|| evamevābhavat sāyaṃ siṃhā dūre bhavanti na | atha sāraṃgahūṇaśca prajajvāla tadānalam ||18|| mahiṣīṇāṃ paritaśca samidhāṃ sañcaye pṛthak | vahnibhayena siṃhāśced dūre yāntīti cintayā || 19|| tathāpi krūrakālāste dūre yātā na sarvathā | paritaste bhramantyeva māraṇārthaṃ dravanti ca ||3.209.20|| niśāmukhaṃ samāpannaṃ sāhāyyastatra nāsti ca | rātrau siṃhabalaṃ cāti jāyate tamasi vṛte ||21 || mahiṣīṇāṃ vināśaḥ syāt kiṃ kartavyaṃ vipadbhuvi | vinā nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sahāyado na vidyate ||22|| rakṣako bhagavāneva mahāpatkāla āgate | matvaivaṃ tena vai labdhaṃ mantraṃ jajāpa tanmayaḥ ||23|| lomaśād yo mantravaraḥ prāpto’śvapaṭṭatīrthinā | tena purā ca taṃ mantraṃ jajāpa hūṇabhaktarāṭ ||24|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | aṣṭottaraśatavāraṃ japtvā neme’mbare harim ||25|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo jagadguro | bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa rakṣa rakṣaya māmiha ||26|| śaraṇāgatasaṃtrātaḥ pāhi siṃhāpadastviha | araṇye tvāṃ vinā kṛṣṇa rakṣako’nyo na vidyate ||27|| harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa śīghramāyāhi rakṣa naḥ | andhakāre vardhamāne mṛtyurnaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ ||28|| bhakto’smi cettava kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa prarakṣaya | prāṇināṃ jāyate mṛtyuḥ kvāpi naivātra saṃśayaḥ ||29||| kintu kṛṣṇa prasahyātra dehānāṃ nakhabhedanaiḥ | mahiṣīṇāṃ tvakāle’tra mṛtyuryogyo na me mataḥ ||3.209.3 0|| yāsāṃ dugdhaṃ hi bhagavan pīyate pratyahaṃ tvayā | prātarvai pūjane kṛṣṇa naivedye divase niśi ||31|| yadghṛtena pradīpaṃte kārayāmi niśāmukhe | tāsāṃ tvaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ cenna karoṣi nirdayo nu kim ||32|| yāsāṃ sumadhuraṃ cāpi picchalaṃ dadhi cottamam | āsvādayasi kṛṣṇa tvaṃ kathaṃ naiva prarakṣasi ||33|| śīghramāyāhi rakṣārthaṃ no ced bhaktastavāsmi yaḥ | sa eva prathamaṃ prāṇām̐styakṣyāmi paśuhetave ||34|| āśritānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ vai kāryaṃ prāk svāminā sadā | svāmināśe tato nāśaḥ svāmidoṣāya neṣyate || 35|| imā mahiṣyo māṃ kṛṣṇa vīkṣanti rakṣakaṃ prati | mayi kṛṣṇa hṛdaye tvaṃ sthitaḥ san kinna paśyasi ||36|| paśya paśya hare kṛṣṇa mahāpatpatitā imāḥ | bhakṣako bhakṣaka eva māstu cāstvapi rakṣakaḥ ||37|| ityuktvāśrūṇi lakṣmi saṃmumoca bhaktarāṇmama | sāraṃgahūṇo dīrghaṃ vai śvāsaṃ mumoca nispṛhaḥ ||38|| mṛtyuṃ gatā vayaṃ ceti matvā ruroda vai kṣaṇam | siṃhā balaṃ prakurvanti dūre vahnibhayāt sthitāḥ ||39|| sāraṃgo vahnibalavān vahnikāṣṭhāni cābhitaḥ | prājvālyāpyabhiprājvālya nikṣipati sthale sthale ||3.209.40 || yāvadbuddhibalaṃ yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇe | matvaivaṃ kurute yatnaṃ viṣṇoricchā balīyasī ||41 || haste kṛtvā jvalatkāṣṭhaṃ bhramam̐śca paritastadā | rakṣārthaṃ svamahiṣīṇāṃ bhajanaṃ kurute hyati ||42|| hare kṛṣṇa hare kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa śriyaḥ pate | hare viṣṇo hare jiṣṇo kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa ramāpate ||43|| ityevaṃ cordhvakaṇṭhena cakre me kīrtanaṃ rame | athāha tasya rakṣārthaṃ mahiṣīrakṣaṇāya ca ||44|| drāgeva siṃharājasya rūpaṃ kesariṇo mahat | saśuṇḍhaṃ sandadhāraiva yena bibhyati vai drutam ||45|| siṃhā vyāghrā gajāścāpi śarabhāḥ kimuta mṛgāḥ | atikrūraṃ vikarālaṃ śuṇḍhādaṇḍadharaṃ navam ||46|| mahākesarirājasya rūpaṃ dhṛtvā gato’bhavam | garjanāṃ meghavat kṛtvāraṇyaṃ paśūnakampayam ||47|| siṃhāste māṃ mahāsihaṃ vidyudbhācakṣuṣaṃ naram | samastasiṃhajātīnāṃ rājānaṃ ca bhayaṃkaram ||48|| śatordhvabalinaṃ śrutvā bhayaṃ cāpurmahāvane | athāhaṃ sahasāraṇyādutplutyākāśameva tu ||49|| śatahastāmbaraṃ vidhvā nyapataṃ siṃhasannidhau | tāvat siṃhā mahābhītinaṣṭadhairyā mamāgrataḥ ||3.209.50|| sahasā mṛtyurūpasya mukhātte samupādravan | araṇye viviśuḥ sarve madbhayena mṛgādhipāḥ ||51 || siṃhādhipo’haṃ sahasā vidrāvya tān mṛgādhipān | dhṛtamānavaveṣo’haṃ tūrṇamabhavaṃ gocaraḥ ||52|| prasannavadanaḥ śāntaḥ śaṃkhacakragadābjavān | sāntvayan bhaktamahiṣīrbhaktaṃ ca sāntvayannapi ||53|| antikaṃ prayayau sāraṃgo’pi dṛṣṭvā hariṃ ca mām | mumude prāptajīvaśca tuṣṭāva parayā mudā ||54|| papāta pādayoścāpi mahiṣīrnirbhayai ravaiḥ | bodhayāmāsa sarvāśca mahiṣyo nirbhayā api ||55|| mumuduḥ sukhavatyaśca jātāstatra naradvayāt | prāptadhairyāḥ samabhavannatha sāraṃgabhaktarāṭ ||56|| lakṣmi dugdhaṃ praduhyaiva pāyayāmāsa me tadā | papau cāhaṃ mahiṣīṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ dugdhamuttamam ||57|| tataḥ sāraṃgabhaktena sākaṃ mahiṣībhistathā | śanaiḥ śanairagacchaṃ taddhoṣaṃ bhūdharīgopure ||58|| āprātastatra mudito nyavasaṃ bhaktapūjitaḥ | bhaktānikayā tatpatnyā sevito’nyaiśca hūṇakaiḥ ||59|| nāmasaṃkīrtanādyaiśca pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ | jalārpaṇaistathā cānyamahotsavaiḥ pratoṣitaḥ ||3.209.60|| atha prātaḥ sādhurūpo’bhavaṃ sūryaprabhāgame | sevitastaiḥ samastaiśca bhojanaiḥ puṣpagandhibhiḥ ||61 || pṛṣṭo’haṃ hūṇabhaktaiśca kalyāṇāya tathā rame | pāpapraṇāśanārthāya tebhyaścopādideśa ca ||62|| śṛṇvantu mama bhaktāḥ stha sarve’pi sthūlabuddhayaḥ | tathāpi śreyase yatnaṃ kurvantaḥ sūkṣmabuddhayaḥ ||63|| bhavantaḥ khalu vidyante mokṣadhīḥ sūkṣmadhīrhi sā | svaśreyase ya udyuktāste vai susūkṣmabuddhayaḥ ||64|| laukikavyavahāreṣu nipuṇāścet svaśreyase | suptā yadi te mūrkhā vai sthūladhiyo matāḥ sadā ||65|| māyāvṛtā jaḍā mūrkhāḥ kathyante paśusadṛśāḥ | api rājā pradhāno vā gururvā śikṣako’pi vā ||66|| adhītavidyo vā syācced yatate na svamuktaye | sa eva sthūlabuddhirvai mūrkho yāmyaṃ gamiṣyati ||67|| mama bhaktau vartamānā divyāste mānavāḥ striyaḥ | abhaktā ye te tu bodhyā nirayasthāḥ paśuprabhāḥ ||68|| mama bhaktāḥ svanetrābhyāṃ labhante darśanaṃ mama | aprākṛte hi tannetre bādhye madyogataḥ sadā ||69|| bhaktacitte hariścāhaṃ vasāmi divyameva tat | bhaktānāṃ varṣma divyaṃ cendriyāṇi divyakāni ca ||3.209.70|| antaḥkaraṇaṃ divyaṃ ca kriyā divyāḥ sadā tathā | ahamakṣaradhāmastho vasāmi bhūtale kvacit ||71 || kvacidatra samāyāto bhavāmi bhaktasadṛśaḥ | tathāpi divya evāsmi bhavanto divyamūrtayaḥ |||72|| divyāśca mahiṣyaḥ sarvā bhaktā divyā narāḥ striyaḥ | sarvātmātmā svatantro’haṃ sarvaśaktipatiḥ prabhuḥ ||73|| parātparataraścāsmi rādhālakṣmīpatirhariḥ | sarvakāraṇarūpaśca vyatiriktaśca dhāmani ||74|| sa evāhaṃ sādhurūpo bhavāmyatra sugocaraḥ | mama yogena vallavyo hūṇyaśca divyatāṃ gatāḥ ||75|| vaśca bāhyānyāntarāṇi karaṇānyakhilānyapi | tādātmyaṃ prāpya māṃ sākṣātpaśyanti divyakāni tat ||76|| amāyikena dṛśyo’haṃ nānyathā tu kadācana | kṛpayā ca svayaṃ bhaktā grāhyo’smi netareṇa vai ||77|| māyātattvāni sarvāṇi divyatāṃ yānti matspṛśeḥ | pañcaviṃśo hi jīvātmā mukto bhavati madyujeḥ ||78|| ṣaḍviṃśo’haṃ ca bhagavān puruṣottama eva yaḥ | vaśe bhavāmi bhaktasya sarvāvatārakāraṇam ||79|| māyāguṇarahito’smi divyamadguṇamaṇḍitaḥ | īśvarādyaiḥ pūjitaśca bhaktamadhye ca tādṛśaḥ ||3.209.80 || māṃ bhajitvā sevayitvā matvā divyaṃ narāyaṇam | yānti dhāmākṣaraṃ bhaktā divyapārṣadasevitam ||8 1|| striyo madyogamāpannā bhavanti divyavigrahāḥ | gāvo mahiṣyo vṛṣabhā madyoge divyatāṃ gatāḥ |||82|| kanyakā mama yogena ṛṣayaḥ sādhavastathā | kumārā api gopālā divyatāṃ matsamā gatāḥ ||83|| api brahmapriyāḥ patnyo vṛkṣāśca vallikāstathā | mama yogena divyāstā matsamāḥ parivartitāḥ ||84|| māṃ bhajantu tato nityaṃ pāyayantu jalaṃ payaḥ | phalaṃ mūlaṃ ca kandaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ patramityapi ||85|| prātarbhaktiṃ prakurvantu madhyāhne sāyamityapi | rātrau divā ca māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ smarantu sarvakarmasu ||86|| sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ nityaṃ kurvantu cānnavāribhiḥ | bhajanaṃ kīrtanaṃ me ca kurvantu nityamutsukā ||87|| muktimante’kṣare loke dāsye gopīpatistvaham | svargabhogām̐stu nipuṇān sakāmebhyaḥ sukhāvahān ||88|| ityuktvā ca mahāśaṃkhaṃ datvā yaddhoṣataḥ sadā | hiṃsrā dūraṃ prayāsyantītyuktvā labdhvā prapūjanam ||89|| tiro’bhavaṃ vanāllakṣmi te ca sāraṃgahūṇakāḥ | sukhinaścābhavam̐ścānte dhāmākṣaraṃ prapedire || 3.209.90 || evaṃ ye vanavāsā vā grāmavāsāḥ pṛthaggṛhāḥ | dīnā vāpi narā nāryo ye bhajante hariṃ tu mām || 91 || tānuddharāmi kaṣṭādvai smṛtamātraḥ prabhustvaham | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ dadāmyevānanditāṃ śāśvatīṃ sthitim || 91|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇādapi pāpinām | pāpanāśo bhavenmuktirbhaved rakṣā ca śāśvatī || 92 || itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sāraṃganāmakasya hūṇabhaktasya mahiṣīpaśudhanasyāraṇye siṃhakṛtāpadaḥ śrīhariṇā rakṣaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ mokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 209 ||
<3.210> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ bhaktasya cāparām | puṣkaso nāmato yajñarādho virādhakheṭagaḥ || 1 || ānarteṣvabhavadbhaktaḥ samudrakhāḍikātaṭe | naukānāṃ vastupūrṇānāmāgamo vigamastathā || 2 || yatra prajāyate nityaṃ tatra mārjanakarmaṇi | niyuktaḥ sa mahānaukādhyakṣeṇa jīvikāvitaḥ || 2 || naukānāṃ taṭabhūmīnāṃ kaccarāṇāṃ pramārjanam | karoti nityamevāyaṃ patnyā sākaṃ sthale sthale || 4 || naukādhīśāstathā cānye śreṣṭhinaḥ karmacāriṇaḥ | śeṣānnabhojanaṃ cāsmai dadatyapi kṛpālavaḥ || 5 || śākaṃ patrādikaṃ cāpi roṭakaṃ ca payo’pi ca | bharjitānnaṃ ca pakvānnaṃ vastrādikaṃ dadatyapi || 6 || evaṃ prāptena bhakto’yaṃ tathā sadvetanena ca | nirvahatyeva nityaṃ vai svakāryakuśalaḥ sadā || 7 || yadyat saṃprāpyate tatra jalaprokṣaṇamuttamam | kṛtvā dhṛtvā ca tulasīdalaṃ smṛtvā ca māṃ tadā || 8 || samarpya mahyaṃ manasā bhuṃkte pāti na cānyathā | prātarnityaṃ pippalasya vṛkṣamūle hariṃ ca mām || 9 || pūjayatyeva saṃsmṛtvā jalānnaphalapatrakaiḥ | madhyāhne’pi tathā sāyaṃ māṃ smṛtvā sa bhunakti ha || 3.210.10 || rātrau kṛtvā militvaiva kīrtanaṃ māṃ smaram̐stathā | mālāmāvartayan bhakto nidrāti strī sutaḥ sutā || 11 || evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya nityaṃ vai vighasāśinaḥ | datvā śune gave kākebhyaśca puṣkasajātaye || 1 2|| pipīlikābhyo datvā ca datvāmbare surāya ca | bhuṃkte’yaṃ vighasāśī vai datvā matsyebhya ityapi || 13|| paśyatyeva hariṃ sarvaprāṇiṣu puṣkaso’pi saḥ | sarvavrahmātmavijñāno bhaktarājjñānavām̐stathā || 14|| puṣkasaṃ tu śarīraṃ vai sadā malasya bhājanam | sarvadehāstathā santi malapātrāṇi sarvathā || 15|| yadi śuddhā na manasi samānāḥ puṣkasā yataḥ | manaḥ śuddhaṃ yasya tasya puṣkasatvaṃ vilīyate || 1 6|| garbhe bālo na śuddho’sti cāśuddhadvārasevanaḥ | aśuddhāśca tathā janma janmottaramaśuddhimān ||17|| śaucahīnastathā nityamaśuddhaḥ kalmaṣānvitaḥ | manomālinyayuktaśca kāmakrodhādikalmaṣaḥ || 18 || svārthakāpaṭyabhāvaśca vāsanāvāsito malī | aśuddha eva dehāḍhyo mānerṣyāmatsarānvitaḥ || 19|| ahantāmamatāyuktaḥ pramādamohakarṣitaḥ | aśuddha eva strīputraparivāranibandhanaḥ || 3.210.20|| avidyārāgasaṃsaktyabhiniveśādikalmaṣaḥ | asmitādibhṛtaścāpi bhogavilāsapāpavān ||21 || rogavyādhijarāmṛtyumahākaṣṭānuyogavān | deho’yaṃ puṣkasaḥ proktaścidātmāhaṃ na puṣkasaḥ ||22|| sarve dehāḥ puṣkasā vai nātmā puṣkasaḥ karhicit | brahmātmā nirmalaḥ śāntaḥ śuddho bhaktaḥ samujjvalaḥ ||23||| parameśapratāpena saccidānandabodhavān | mukto bandhanahīnaśca sadāhaṃ mokṣabhāgiha ||24||| evaṃ lakṣmi prajānāti puṣkaso’pi nijaṃ sadā | muktavat vartate nityaṃ mama dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ||25|| bhagavanniṣṭha evāyaṃ tathātmaniṣṭha uttamaḥ | na svārtho’sya na vai vyādhirmānaso’pi manāgapi ||26|| etādṛśasya bhaktasya vada lakṣmi kathaṃ na vai | karomi rakṣaṇaṃ cittāhlādanaṃ ceṣṭapūraṇam ||27||| mama lakṣmi sadā tulyā jīvā devāstatheśvarāḥ | sarve putrā mamaivātra māyāyāṃ santi dehinaḥ ||28|| vipro nṛpo dīnajanaḥ puṣkasaḥ strī napuṃsakaḥ | paśuḥ pakṣī kīṭa ārto vṛkṣo vallī ca vai tṛṇam ||29||| sarvaṃ putrātmakaṃ me’sti yādaḥ pataṃga ityapi | bhajante māṃ tu ye sevāmagnāsteṣāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||3.210.30 || pitāsmi rakṣako dhātā pātā netā paraṃ padam | anyeṣāṃ tu kṛtasyaiva phaladaḥ sākṣirūpavān ||31|| athaikadā tu bhaktasya saṃkalpo’pi vyajāyata | nārāyaṇaḥ kathaṃ sākṣād bhavennetrasya gocaraḥ ||32|| śrutaṃ tena tataḥ sādhormukhāt sādhau hariḥ svayam | vartate satpuruṣasya sevayā gocaro bhavet ||33|| athāyaṃ yajñarādho vai mārgayatyeva sevanam | yatra sādhuḥ śrūyate ca tatsthale sa prayāti vai ||34|| camatkārapure śrutvā sādhum̐ nāgamatītaṭe | yayau tīrthasya miṣavān sasnau nadyāṃ tu bhāvataḥ ||35|| nāganāthasya tīrthe vai sādhuṃ dadarśa tāpasam | tryavasthāpāragaṃ divyaṃ brahmaniṣṭhaṃ haripriyam ||36|| nāmnā brahmāyanaṃ śāntaṃ maharṣiṃ tyāginaṃ munim | āsane dhyānamagnaṃ ca brahmaṇi dhyāninaṃ tadā ||37|| gatvā puro nanāmāsau daṇḍavat pracakāra ha | ghaṭīmātraṃ purastasthau kṛtāñjaliśca niścalaḥ ||30|| ghaṭikānte sādhuvaryo dhyānād bahirupāyayau | dadarśa purato bhaktaṃ puṣkasaṃ yajñarādhakam ||39|| yajñarādhaḥ praṇamyaiva tasthau kṛtāñjalistathā | sādhunā kuśalaṃ te’stu procya niṣadya bodhitaḥ ||3.210.40|| so’pi bhāvena bahunā niṣasāda puraḥ sataḥ | papraccha guṇavṛddhyarthaṃ satsaṃgatyarthamityapi ||41 || parameśasya lābhārthaṃ sākṣādvai sādhanāni hi | brahmāyano muniḥ śrutvā mumodātmaparātmavān ||42|| smṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ māṃ ca jagādopādideśa tam | śṛṇu bhakta satāṃ guṇān gṛhṇanti ye janāstviha ||43|| guṇavanto bhavantyete santo hi guṇasāgarāḥ | satāṃ doṣān pragṛhṇanti duṣṭāste tu bhavanti vai ||44|| satāṃ samāgame nityaṃ guṇā āyānti bhāvinaḥ | satāṃ guṇānāṃ grahaṇe māhātmyavedane’niśam ||45|| vardhante svaguṇā ramyāḥ siddhadaśāpradāḥ śubhāḥ | naiva grāhyāḥ satāṃ dehadoṣāḥ kvācitkasaṃbhavāḥ ||46|| doṣāgrāhā bhavantyeva guṇino’pi tu doṣiṇaḥ | acireṇa mahāpāpād guṇā naśyanti mūlataḥ ||47|| ataḥ satāṃ sadguṇā vai grāhyā na tvaguṇāḥ kvacit | svalpadurguṇagrahaṇe vinaṣṭirmahatī bhavet ||48|| satāṃ samāgamenaiva vardhante guṇakoṭayaḥ | bhāgavatāstathā dharmā vardhante satsamāgamāt ||49|| satāmekāntikānāṃ vai sevanād divyatā bhavet | satāṃ saṃgatiḥ snehena jāyate dehināmiha ||3.210.50|| sādhavo mokṣadāḥ santi sarvapāpavināśakāḥ | iṣṭadāḥ santi santaścetyavagatya satāṃ puraḥ ||5 1 || dāsavad vartate nityaṃ tasya satsaṃgatirbhavet | aikāntikāḥ sarvadharmāḥ puṣyanti satsamāgamāt ||52|| vairāgyaṃ jāyate cātmaparātmanośca vedanam | māhātmyajñānasahitā bhaktirharau bhavettataḥ ||53|| āśrayo’pi dṛḍhaḥ syācca kṛṣṇārthāḥ sakalakriyāḥ | bāhyāntaḥkaraṇānāṃ ca vyāpārā bhagavanmayāḥ ||54|| bhavantyeva hi bhaktasya mokṣadvāramapāvṛtam | jāyate dhāmadaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mahāmārgagatipradam ||55|| strīdhanādau mahāsaṃgo dehino durjaro’sti yaḥ | satsu tathaiva ca kṛto mokṣaṃ dadāti dehine ||56|| snehaḥ satsu sadā kāryaḥ strīputrādyadhikaḥ khalu | snehena satsu lagnānāṃ muktirbhavati śāśvatī ||57|| satsevāyāṃ mahāśraddhā kāryā nāryā nareṇa ca | sarvātmanā kṛtā sevā tārayatyeva māyinam ||58|| sarvārpaṇakṛtā sevā kṛtārthaṃ kurute janam | santaḥ prasannā dadyurvai dhāmākṣaraṃ ca divyatām ||59|| deśaḥ kālaḥ śubhau sevyau saṃgaḥ sevyaḥ śubhastathā | kriyā kāryā śubhā nityaṃ mantro dhāryaḥ śubhottamaḥ ||3.210.60|| dhyānaṃ kāryaṃ harernityaṃ santo dhāryā sadā hṛdi | dīkṣā grāhyā bhāgavatī śaraṇaṃ ca hareḥ sadā ||61 || evaṃ vai vartamānasya sākṣānnārāyaṇo bhavet | asaddeśādisaṃyoge naṣṭā bhraṣṭā matirbhavet ||62|| saddeśādisamāyoge śreṣṭhā śuddhā matirbhavet | baliṣṭhapuṇyayogena saddeśādi labhejjanaḥ ||63|| satsaṃgo jāyate tasya divyatā jāyate tataḥ | nirmalā yasya buddhirna deśādyā doṣiṇastathā ||64|| yasya bhavanti tasyātra pāpaṃ pūrvakṛtaṃ mahat | upasthitaṃ hi mantavyaṃ yena pāpe pravartate ||65|| yadvātra mahatāṃ tena satāṃ drohaḥ kṛto’sti yat | tatphalaṃ pāpabuddhirvai jātā pātakadāyinī ||66|| tāṃ vināśayituṃ sevāṃ kuryānniśchadmabhāvataḥ | satāṃ prasannatāṃ cāpi prāpnuyāt sevanaṃ hareḥ ||67|| atha yaḥ pāpavānasti sa tu drohaṃ karoti hi | vadatyeva ca nāstikyabhāvena nimnagaṃ vacaḥ ||68|| sādhūnāṃ kiṃ bhavedatra samāgamena vai bhuvi | dhūrtā hi sādhavaḥ santi mā kurvantu samāgamam ||69|| evaṃ vadanti duṣṭā vai tyājyāste dūrataḥ sadā | tasmāt saṃgaḥ satāṃ kāryaḥ satāṃ saṃgo hi bheṣajam ||3.210.70|| pāpisaṃgo na vai kāryaḥ pāpisaṃgo viṣaṃ param | duḥkhī bhajate śrīnāthaṃ duḥkhahānyarthameva tu ||71 || arthārthī tvarthasiddhyarthaṃ hyaiśvaryārthī sa vai bhavet | āpmaniṣṭho’pi bhajate kaivalyārthaṃ hariṃ sadā ||72|| jñānī tu bhagavanniṣṭhaḥ sevate parameśvaram | ātmanivedī bhagavanniṣṭho hareḥ priyo bhavet ||73 || sākṣātkāro bhavettasya hariniṣṭhasya bhūtale | asya māhātmyavijñānaṃ harerbhavati sarvathā ||74|| hareḥ sneho’sya bahudhā sarvathā vartate’niśam | kṛṣṇetarāḥ samastā vāsanā naṣṭā hi tasya vai ||75|| ekāntikānāṃ sevābhirnaṣṭāḥ samastavāsanāḥ | bhavantyeva tato jñānī bhūtvā satsaṃgamācaret ||76|| akṣarādhipateḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vedanam | māhātmyasahitaṃ kuryāt satāṃ prasaṃgataḥ sadā ||77|| mānaṃ nirmūlanīyaṃ ca satāṃ samāgamāt sadā | mānino na pravardhante divyā guṇāḥ kadācana ||78|| mānī sevāṃ na kurute satāṃ vai nimnakoṭigām | sadagre prāñjalirna syānna praśaṃsedgirā sataḥ ||79|| raṃkavadvartamānaṃ ca santaṃ na mānavānnamet | māno doṣo mahānasti mānastambho hi nāśakṛt ||3.210.8 0|| bhaktijñānavirāgādyā vardhante naiva māninaḥ | bhakto galitamānastu vardhamānamahāguṇaḥ ||8 1 || jāyate tasya hṛdaye sākṣānnārāyaṇo vaset | satāṃ hareśca nityaṃ vai sevayā paricaryayā ||82|| māno vilīyate tīvravairāgyāḍhyasya vai drutam | brahmātmabhāvanābhaktyā haristasmai prasīdati ||83|| prasannasya harermūrtiḥ prasannāsya hi dṛśyate | madhurā hṛdaye mūrtirbahiścāpi hi dṛśyate ||84|| nirmāno bhaktarāṭ śreṣṭho bhagavadbalavān mataḥ | bhajate śrīhariṃ mānaṃ hitvātmabrahmaniṣṭhitaḥ ||85|| ātmaniṣṭhā ca bhagavanniṣṭhā pakvāsti yasya vai | māyikaḥ sakalo vyādhistasyātraiva vilīyate ||86|| kathāyāḥ śravaṇenāpi satāṃ prasevayā tathā | bhaktyā nārāyaṇasyāpi tathopāsanayā hareḥ ||87|| siddhadaśāmāpnuvanti sārvajñyaṃ ceśatāṃ tathā | upāsanābalaṃ sveṣṭadevasya yasya yādṛśam||88|| tādṛśaṃ jāyate tasya mahaddivyaṃ sukhaṃ param | māyikaṃ duḥkhamatyantaṃ nāśameti na saṃśayaḥ ||89|| vrajāṃganāsamā prītiryeṣāṃ svāmini mādhave | jāyate sīmavajyaiṃṣāṃ kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||3.210.90|| satāṃ prasevayā kṛṣṇamāhātmyadṛḍhatā bhavet | upāsanāyāḥ siddhiśca dṛḍhā drāgabhito bhavet ||91 || akṣare parame dhāmni yo’sti golokadhāmani | vaikuṇṭhe śrīpure cāvyākṛte’mṛte ca dhāmani ||92|| brahmapatirharī rādhāpatiśca kamalāpatiḥ | lalitāśrīpatiḥ ramāpatiḥ śrīpatirīśvaraḥ ||93||| antaryāmī vallabhaśca sa eva bhagavān svayam | samādhau dṛśyate bhaktyā tato bahistu sevayā ||94|| milatyeva harirnārāyaṇo mānavavigrahaḥ | prākṛtena janenāpi samo bhavati mānave ||95|| yattejasākṣaraṃ brahma muktā īśvarakoṭayaḥ | sūryacandrādayastejasvino bhānti sa eva saḥ ||96|| dhṛtamānavarūpo vai pradīpena vilokyate | sūryacandraprabhāyāṃ sa dṛśyo bhavati mānavaiḥ ||97|| dehānte’pi mahāpāpī yannāmasmaraṇād drutam | śuddho bhavati niṣpāpo mokṣamārgāya kalpate ||98|| sa eva niśchadmabhaktabhaktyā bhavati gocaraḥ | bhaja taṃ paramātmānaṃ śrīśaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||99|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | japa mantraṃ tathā dhyāhi hṛdaye bālakṛṣṇakam || 3.210.10 0|| jalaṃ prāsādikaṃ nityaṃ piba khāda niveditam | smara brahmapriyānāthaṃ prabhuṃ mokṣamavāpsyasi || 101 || ityuktaḥ kamale tena brahmāyanena puṣkasaḥ | jñānaṃ labdhvā prapūjyainaṃ gṛhaṃ nijaṃ yayau tataḥ || 1 02|| yathoktarītyā bhajate dhyāyati sevate tathā | satāṃ sevāṃ karotyeva paśyati smarati prabhum || 10 3|| yajñarādhastvekadā tu pippalasya samīpataḥ | dadarśa sādhuṃ rūpāḍhyaṃ brahmāyanasamaṃ śubham ||1 04|| sahasā taṃ vīkṣya cakre daṇḍavat svāgatādikam | kuśalaṃ cāpi papraccha sādhustaṃ snehamāvahan || 1 05|| bhaktaḥ prāha kuśalo’smi sādhulābhād viśeṣataḥ | ājñāṃ kuru yathā sādho seve’haṃ sakuṭumbakaḥ ||106|| sādhuḥ prāha mayā cāsmātsthalād gantavyamasti hi | aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthaṃ yatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||107|| sahasārtho bhavān bhūtvā samāgacchatu vai mayā | tathāstviti puṣkasaḥ sa svīkṛtya niryayau saha ||1 08|| kuṭumbena samastena sahito’patyabālakaiḥ | tāvattūrṇaṃ vimānaṃ cāgataṃ divyaṃ tadāmbarāt || 1 09|| ahaṃ lakṣmi svayaṃ cāsaṃ mokṣado’smai kṛpāvaśaḥ | ādāya tān vimāne vai divyān kṛtvā hi pārṣadān ||3.210.1 1 0|| bhautikadehān tyājayitvāhaṃ ninye nijākṣaram | śāśvataṃ te padaṃ prāptā bhaktā me divyamūrtayaḥ ||1 1 1|| ityevaṃ kṛtavām̐steṣāṃ kalyāṇaṃ satsamāgamāt | sarve jīvā bhajante māṃ ye te bhavanti tādṛśāḥ || 1 12|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇācchrāvaṇādapi | bhuktirmuktirbhavatyeva divyagatiśca sampadaḥ || 11 3|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne yajñarādhanāmakapuṣkasasya sakuṭumbasya brahmāyanarṣisādhoḥ samāgamena śrīharibhaktyā mokṣaprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā daśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 210 ||
<3.211> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ caṇḍālasya kathāmapi | rāyaṇāgramavasaternāmnā kapikṣayasya vai || 1 || kapikṣayo hi cāṇḍālo raivatācalasannidhau | abhavat sakuṭumbaḥ sa rāyaṇāyāṃ sunītimān || 2 || prathamaṃ jātidoṣeṇa hiṃsro’bhavad vane bhraman | vānarān vanajān raktān mārayitvā sa khādati || 3 || atastvanyavanevāsaiḥ kapikṣayetibodhitaḥ | vānaramāranāmnaiva prasiddhimagamadvane || 4 || athaikadā vane vṛkṣaṣaṇḍe sthitaṃ tu maṇḍalam | vānarāṇāṃ mahadvīkṣya tān hantuṃ śaramādadhe || 45 || yāvanmukto na vai bāṇastāvadvānarasattamaḥ | divyavāṇyā jagādainaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ śvapacottama || 6 || śrutvā yatheṣṭaṃ yātrārthaṃ samācara nibodha me | purā tvaṃ vṛṣalīgāmī dvijo veśyārato’bhavaḥ || 7 || nāmnā prājñeśvaro vipro dharmakarmāditatparaḥ | śṛṃkhalāgrāmavāstavyo yatra hiṃsā janā api || 8 || vasanti sma ca tatsaṃgāt teṣāmannasya yojanāt | dānamānasahavāsānmanaste hiṃsrakaṃ hyabhūt || 9 || deśakālakriyāvāṇīsahāyānāmasattayā | asatte hṛdayaṃ jātaṃ pāpapriyaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||3.211.10|| brāhmaṇasya śubho dehastvayā veśyāsamāgamāt | adharmaṃ yojitaścāpyabhakṣyāpeyādibhistathā || 11 || kṣudrakriyāparo jāto madyamāṃsaparāyaṇaḥ | atha kālena maraṇaṃ tava jātaṃ tato bhavān || 1 2|| yayau yāmyapuraṃ tatra bhuktavān yamayātanāḥ | avaśiṣṭena pāpena cāṇḍālo’tra pravartate || 1 3|| sā veśyā vṛṣalī te’tra bhāryāpi sahagāsti vai | sahamitrāṇi pāpāni te te’tra sutabāndhavāḥ || 14|| vartante cāṇḍālayonau pāpāḥ pāpanibandhanāḥ | pāpāni tvaṃ purā kṛtvā cāṇḍālatvamupeyivān || 15|| brāhmaṇatvaṃ tvayā pūrvaṃ malavanmalinīkṛtam | vināśitaṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇaṃ tadā || 1 6|| idānīṃ ca punastvaṃ vai vartase māṃsabhojane | ghātako vānarāṇāṃ yannaraghno bhavasi dhruvam || 17|| vānarā naramānuṣyāstatpāpaṃ naraghātajam | bālaghātitvamevāpi strīghātitvamapi dhruvam || 18|| jāyate tava cāṇḍāla mānave durlabhe punaḥ | udarārthaṃ kuṭumbārthaṃ kuruṣe hiṃsrakarma yat || 19|| punaste yātanāḥ santi yāmyāścādhogatiḥ punaḥ | yaiḥ pūrve pātitastvaṃ vai tatkṛte yatase punaḥ ||3.211.20|| kīdṛśo mūrkhavaryo’si ko lābhaste nipātibhiḥ | paśya mūrkha manuṣyasya sārthakyaṃ dharmakarma vai ||21|| tathā paśya nijaṃ mokṣaṃ pāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ sukham | tīrthaṃ svarṇāvatīnadyāṃ dāmodaraṃ narāyaṇam ||22|| paśya puṇyaṃ kuru drāk ca tyaja hiṃsāṃ sukhī bhava | bhavātra pāvano bhakto bhaja kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||23|| nārāyaṇahrade snātvā kuru sarvāghanāśanam | saṃsnātvā revatīkuṇḍe kuṇḍe tathā ca vāmane |||24|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre cāśvapaṭṭasarovare | snātvā śrīsomatīrthe ca sarasvatyāṃ sukhī bhava ||25|| mūladvāravatīpuryāṃ snāhi yāhi divaṃ tataḥ | gopanārthaṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ kṛtvā yāhi gavāyanam || 26|| re mūḍha bhaja govindaṃ śrīpatiṃ kṛṣṇavallabham | dayāṃ kṛtvā vṛṣaṃ dhṛtvā kṛtvā bhaktiṃ harestathā || 27|| yāhi brahmaparaṃ lokaṃ sanātanaṃ ca śāśvatam | kuṃkumavāpikātīrthe vartate parameśvaraḥ ||28|| divyamānuṣadeho vai brahmapriyāpatiḥ kṛtiḥ | sa eva bhagavān jagatsraṣṭā pātāntarasthitaḥ ||29|| rādhālakṣmīpatiḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ | sevito naranārībhirvartate mānavo yathā ||3.211.30|| dehānte’pi mahāpāpī tasya smaraṇamātrataḥ | sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti dhāmākṣaraṃ param || 31 || taṃ gatvā bhaja gopālabālakaṃ kambharāsutam | ātmavantaṃ pareśaṃ taṃ samāśraya hṛdi sthitam ||||2|| rādhāramāpatestasya māhātmyajñānamañjasā | sākṣātkartavyamevāto muktirbhavati śāśvatī ||33|| gāḍhasnehād bhagavati prasannatvaṃ prajāyate | tena muktiḥ karagatā bhagavaddhāmadāyinī ||34|| snehaḥ kāryaḥ sarvathā vai śṛṇu cāṇḍāla vacmyaham | navoḍhāyā yathā patyau tathā cādye sute yathā ||35|| yathā mātari bālasya lobhinastu dhane yathā | kṣudhitasya yathānne ca bhayabhītasya rakṣake ||36|| yādasāṃ tu jale yadvat pataṃgasyānale yathā | tathā snehaḥ sadā kāryaḥ parameśe sukhaprade ||37|| tvacā spraṣṭavya īśeśo bhālanīyaśca cakṣuṣā | śrotavyaścāpi karṇābhyāmāsvādyaścūmbanādibhiḥ ||38|| gandhastasyaiva cādeyo rūpaṃ grāhyaṃ hare sadā | āśleṣaṇīyo bhagavān kīrtanīyaśca mādhavaḥ ||39|| ānandanīyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sarvārpaṇaṃ harau tathā | kartavyaṃ ca harerguṇagrahaṇaṃ kāryamanvaham ||3.211.40|| māhātmyaguṇavittyādyaiḥ snehaḥ kṛṣṇe prajāyate | yadvā sāhajikaḥ sneho bhaktasyaiva prajāyate ||41|| yathā strīputravittādau tathā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe | snehaṃ sāhajikaṃ prāpto brahmabhūyāya kalpyate ||42|| naisargikasnehavanto bhavanti divyabuddhayaḥ | divyakriyāśca haryarthaṃ snehasteṣāṃ prapuṣyati ||43|| snehasya poṣaṇe vighno mānaṃ cettatra vartate | nāśanīyaṃ sarvathā tacchreyo’dhvani vighātakṛt ||44|| duḥsvabhāvāḥ samastā vai nāśanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ | atiśatrudhiyā te vai nāśanīyā mumukṣuṇā ||45|| mitravad dehavāsā ye duḥsvabhāvāstu te yadi | mokṣe virodhinaḥ syuśceddhantavyāḥ satsamāgamaiḥ ||46|| satsaṃgaḥ sarvadā kāryaḥ satāṃ saṃgo mahauṣadham | ātmāsmi balavān kṛṣṇasahāyavān sudharmavān ||47|| yadicchati karotyeva samartho muktaye’pi ca | rajasāṃ tamasāṃ vegānunmūlayeddhariśritaḥ ||48|| dehādhyāsaḥ kusaṃgaśca pūrvakṛtkarmasañcayaḥ | māyāmohakarāḥ santi hantavyāḥ satsamāgamaiḥ ||49|| vivekena prahantavyo dehādhyāsaḥ satāṃ mukhāt | satsaṃgena kusaṃgaśca hantavyaḥ satsamāgamāt ||3.211.50|| pūrvajanmakṛtāḥ sarve saṃskārāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ | hantavyāste satāṃ nityaprasattyā mahatāmiha ||51 || atipāpasya puṃsastu pāpaphalaṃ prapīḍanam | āpadaśca samāyānti tadā tannāśahetave |||52| itastato dhāvati drāk samantāddhanado bhavan | tathāpi vipado yānti vṛddhiṃ dūre na yānti ca ||53|| atha bhagnamanā bhūtvā yāti duḥkhataraṃ janam | śrutvā sādhuṃ ca vā vṛddhaṃ nivedayati cāpadaḥ ||54|| sādhostu vacanaṃ prāpya karoti vratapūjanam | satsaṃgaṃ bhajanaṃ cāpi sevāṃ smaraṇaṃ śārṅgiṇaḥ ||55|| evaṃ bījabalenāsya līyante kalmaṣāṇi vai | akalmaṣaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ jāyate nirmalaṃ tataḥ ||56|| bhaktiyogyaṃ tatra kṛṣṇaḥ satāṃ vāṇyā virājate | prakāśate śanaiścāpi puṇyaḥ prajāyate janaḥ ||57|| evaṃ vai śubhatāṃ yānti saṃskārā malinā api | cāṇḍālo vipratāṃ yāti duṣṭaḥ sujanatāṃ tathā ||58|| prasādena satāṃ raṃko rājatāṃ labhate drutam | prasādena satāṃ mūrkhaḥ pāṇḍityaṃ labhate tathā ||59|| prasādena satāṃ pāpī puṇyaṃ svargaṃ pravindati | prasādena satāṃ duṣṭo jāyate paṃktipāvanaḥ ||3.211.60 || atiprasannatāprāptyai sādhūnāmagrataḥ sadā | niśchadma vartitavyaṃ vai yathānuvṛttimetya tu ||61|| yatra yatra rucisteṣāṃ tattat sādhyaṃ viśaṃkayā | yatra yatrārucisteṣāṃ tattat tyājyaṃ drutaṃ sadā |||62|| mānaṃ ca lokalajjāṃ ca guṇagarvaṃ vihāya vai | satāṃ dāsyaṃ prakartavyaṃ dhāryaṃ vacaḥ satāṃ hṛdi |||63|| satāṃ prasāde vighnā ye bhavanti sevane’pi ca | sarve te durguṇāstyājyā grāhyāḥ prasannatāpradāḥ ||64|| guṇā yaiḥ syuḥ prasannā vai santaste tu guṇā matāḥ | dharmaḥ sa eva cokto’sti yena prasannatā bhavet ||65|| satāṃ cāprītiheturyaḥ sa tu durguṇa eva vai | heyaḥ sa eva bhaktena kāryā prasannatā satām ||66|| anukūle dāsabhakte prasīdanti hi sādhavaḥ | satāṃ guṇānāṃ grahaṇairdoṣā naśyanti hṛdgatā ||67|| santo mahānta sevyāste divyatāsaṃvidhāyinaḥ | guṇānāṃ grahaṇe bhaktirvardhate paramātmani ||68|| satāṃ niṣkāmitvaguṇagrahe niṣkāmitāṃ vrajet | satāṃ niḥkrodhatāguṇagrahe niḥkrodhatāṃ vrajet ||69|| satāṃ nirlobhatāguṇagrahe nirlobhatāṃ vrajet | satāṃ nirmohatāguṇagrahe nirmohatāṃ vrajet ||3.211.70 || satāṃ divyarūpaguṇagrahe divyasurūpavān | bhavet satāṃ bhagavattvaguṇagrahe bhavettathā ||71 || mahaiśvaryādiśālī vai bhaved bhaktyā tathottamaḥ | anyatrārucirasyāsti kṛṣṇe satsu ruciḥ sadā ||72|| bhāvaḥ kṛṣṇe satpuruṣe’nyatrābhāvo’sya vartate | evaṃvidhasya vo dāsyaṃ harau satsu pravardhate ||73 || vardhamānaṃ paraṃ dāsyaṃ nirmalaṃ prītihetukam | vivartate vai svāmitve svāminaḥ kṛpayā kvacit ||74|| yathā śiṣye sevake vā svāmitvaṃ kṛpayā bhavet | tathā dāse dāsyabhāvaḥ svāmibhāvatvamāvrajet ||75|| hareragre satāmagre pakṣapāto na vidyate | strī śūdro vāpi cāṇḍālo bhaktyā yāti parāṃ gatim||76|| ityevaṃ vānareṇāpi lakṣmi kapikṣayo vanī | prabodhitastadāścaryaṃ prāptavān bodhamāptavān ||77|| kṛtakṛtyaṃ nijātmānaṃ mene vai puṇyabhāginam | yena vai vānarāllabdhaṃ jñānaṃ mokṣapradaṃ śubham ||78|| athāyaṃ pratipapraccha vānaraṃ ko bhavāniha | jñānado mokṣadaścāpi hiṃsādidoṣanāśakaḥ ||79|| māyādoṣaharaścāpi sarvājñānavināśakṛt | vane tvaṃ carasi ko’tra vada me tu yathātatham ||3.211.80 || dhanyo’haṃ kṛtakṛtyo’haṃ jāto’smi tava vākyataḥ | viśeṣato bhaviṣyāmi viditvā tvāṃ ca pāvanaḥ ||8 1 || śrutvaivaṃ vānaraḥ prāha vayaṃ ceme vanecarāḥ | vānarā raktavarṇā ye te sarve svargadevatāḥ ||82|| bhavāmo divyadehāśca sarve svarganivāsinaḥ | svargaṃ puṇyaṃ prabhuñjāmaḥ kṣayaṃ puṇyaṃ prayāti ca ||83|| nūtanaṃ nārjyate tatra bhogabhūmiryato divam | karmabhūbhiḥ pṛthivīyaṃ puṇyaṃ cātra kṛtaṃ milet ||84|| puṇyārthaṃ vānaraiḥ rūpaiḥ parvate raivatācale | phalapatrādikaṃ labdhvā devārpaṇaṃ prapūjanam ||85|| kṛtvā bhuṃkṣmaḥ prasādaṃ vai pāvanaṃ mokṣadaṃ śubham | jalaṃ ca svarṇarekhāyā nārāyaṇahradāttathā ||86|| dāmodarahradāt pītvā vardhayāmaḥ supuṇyakam | tīrthe snātvā bhāvimokṣaṃ cecchāmo mokṣakāminaḥ ||87|| na vayaṃ vānarāḥ kintu devā vānararūpiṇaḥ | svargānte mānave loke janma yathā na vai bhavet ||88 || mokṣo bhaved yathāsmākaṃ tathā kurmo’tra tīrthakam | bhavānapi tathā tīrthaṃ karotu vai phalādanaḥ ||89|| kuṭumbena sahitastvaṃ prayāsyasi parāṃ gatim | lomaśaṃ yoginaṃ gatvā cāśvapaṭṭasarovare ||3.211.90|| mantraṃ gṛhṇa harestatra pāvanatvaṃ bhaviṣyasi | ityuktaḥ sa praṇamyaiva cāṇḍālo devatāgaṇam ||91 || śīghraṃ nārāyaṇakuṇḍavāri pītvāśvasārasam | yayau lomaśanilayam praṇanāma jagāda ca ||92|| vṛttāntaṃ sakalaṃ paścādaśvapaṭṭasarovare | snātvā ca kṛpayā mantraṃ jagrāha lomaśāt tu saḥ ||93|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | kuṭumbena sahito’yaṃ bhakto’bhavaddharermama ||94|| aśvapaṭṭasaroyātrāṃ cakre jātaśca pāvanaḥ | pāpaṃ tasya gataṃ nāśaṃ bhaktyā me lomaśāśrayāt || 95 || atha kālāntare prāpte kāle tatyāja varṣma saḥ | bhāryāpatyāni sarvāṇi varṣmāṇi tatyajustadā || 9 6|| harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa lakṣmīkānta ramāpate | vadantaste divyadehā abhavan muktiyoginaḥ ||97|| vimānaṃ cāgataṃ tatra mama pārṣadasevitam | tatrāruhya yayuḥ sarve dhāmākṣaraṃ mama priyam ||98|| evaṃ bhaktasya kalyāṇaṃ kṛtaṃ kīśaprasaṃgataḥ | mayā lakṣmi kṛpayaiva cāṇḍālasya hi śāśvatam ||99|| evamanye’pi me bhaktyā satāṃ bhaktyā ca pāvanāḥ | sevante māṃ sataścāpi te’pi yānti parāṃ gatim || 3.211.10 0|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇād yānti mokṣaṇam | sakāmāḥ sampado yānti niṣkāmā matpadaṃ param || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne kapikṣayātmakasya cāṇḍālasya vānararūpadevopadeśena harau bhaktyā sakuṭumbasya mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 211 ||
<3.212> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ lohakārasya vai kathām | me pāvanasya bhaktasya nāmnā nālīkarasya vai || 1 || nālīkaro mama bhakto’vasad vakranadāhvaye | nagare lohakāro vai kuṭumbena samanvitaḥ || 2 || loṣṭhānāṃ śṛṃkhalā dīrghāḥ svalpāśca kīlakām̐stathā | paṭṭām̐śca kuṇḍalām̐ścāpi paṭṭikā loṣṭapatrikāḥ || 3 || loṣṭapātrāṇi bahūni lohopakaraṇānyapi | anasā ca grahāṇāṃ ca sādhanāni karotyapi || 4 || bhastrāyāścālane śvāse praśvāse śrīnarāyaṇam | lohaghnonnayane tasya pātane lohapīṭane || 5 || lohasandhānakāryādau smarate māṃ narāyaṇam | bhastrāṃ matvā ramādevīṃ vahniṃ matvā narāyaṇam || 6 || mālāṃ matvā cāladaṇḍaṃ bhajate māṃ hariṃ sadā | lohakūṭṭīṃ pāpapuñjakūṭṭīṃ māyāṃ vicintya ca || 7 || loṣṭāni māyikānyeva matvā hanti vimuktaye | lohaghātotthaśabdām̐śca praṇavān manute sa ca || 8 || evaṃ nālīkaro bhakto brahmadṛṣṭyātmabodhavān | vartate bhaktiyuktaśca mūrtiṃ me pūjayatyapi || 9 || prātaḥ snātvā gṛhe mūrtiṃ natvā dhūpaṃ karoti ca | dīpaṃ kṛtvā puṣpamālāṃ candanaṃ me’rpayatyapi || 3.212.1 0|| sugandhasāraṃ datvā me naivedyaṃ dugdhaśarkarām | polikāśca samarpyaiva jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tathā || 11 || samarpya me kṣamāṃ yācitvātha bhuṃkte pibatyapi | evameva tato lohaśālāyāmapi mādhavam ||12|| smṛtvā gatvā namaskṛtya dhūpaṃ kṛtvā ca dīpakam | puṣpamālāṃ śarkarāṃ ca tathānyat phalamuttamam || 1 3|| yathākālaṃ samarpyaiva tataḥ kāryaṃ karoti ca | lohakāryāṇi me bhaktyā karoti śuddhamānasaḥ || 14|| evaṃvidhasya bhaktasyaikadābhavat sucintanam | rātrau nityaṃ prakartavyaṃ bhajanaṃ bahubhiḥ saha ||15 || saṅghena bhajanaṃ kāryaṃ bahūnāṃ mokṣasādhanam | evaṃ śubhena manasā svagrāmajanabāndhavān || 1 6|| jagāda maṇḍalaṃ bhaktervidhātuṃ ca tadāpi te | praharṣeṇāsthāpayam̐śca bhaktamaṇḍalamuttamam || 17|| narā nāryo niśāraṃbhe militvā ghaṭikādvayam | nityamārebhire kṛṣṇanāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ śubham ||18|| sarve janā nagarasthāḥ śrutvā vīkṣya śubhakriyām | sahakāraṃ dadustatra yuyujurbhaktamaṇḍale || 19 || sahasraśo janā bhaktiṃ kurvantyutsāhasaṃbhṛtāḥ | utsavān śrīhareḥ sarvān vādyanṛtyādibhistathā ||3.212.20|| śṛṃgārapūjanādyaiśca jāgarādyaiḥ samutsukāḥ | kurvanti ca yathākālaṃ lakṣmi svaśreyase yatāḥ ||21|| teṣāṃ bhaktiṃ vilokyāhaṃ bhaktipravartakasya me | bhaktasya lohakārasya prasanno’haṃ tadābhavam ||22|| ekadā bhaktivṛddhyarthaṃ tejo mayātibhāsvaram | niryanmatpratimābhālād darśitaṃ tebhya ujjvalam ||23|| śāmitaṃ ca mayā tūrṇaṃ tena te bhaktigauravāḥ | viśeṣato mama bhaktimakurvan bhāvagarbhitām ||24|| jñātāraścābhavan mūrtau tiṣṭhato mama śārṅgiṇaḥ | mandiraṃ kṛtavantaste lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya ha || 25|| tatra pūjāpravāhādi cakrire ca yathādhanam | ahaṃ mūrtau nivasāmi tvayā sākaṃ samudraje ||26|| apaharāmi sarveṣāṃ duḥkhāni vipado’nvaham | mānatāste prakurvanti rogaduḥkhavināśinīḥ || 27|| ādhyātmikādhidaivādhibhautikādhivināśinīḥ | sarvāḥ pīḍā nāśayāmi svasthāste ca bhavanti vai ||28|| bhajante māṃ cātibhāvaiścamatkārādikīrtanaiḥ | athaikadā satītvaṃ ca jātā tāpasīveṣiṇī ||29|| ahaṃ ca tāpaso yogī bhūtvāgamaṃ niśāmukhe | bhaktamaṇḍalamālakṣya mandirasyāntike sthale ||3.212.30|| yathā dīnajano raṅkaḥ kaścid bhikṣuka udgataḥ | tvaṃ tathā dīnacittā ca bhikṣukī vratavarjitā ||3 1 || dharmasnānārhaṇaśūnyā malinā prākṛtī yathā | ahaṃ tathaiva malino darśakānāṃ tu cittahāḥ ||32|| ekaṃ tu bālakaṃ svalpaṃ malamūtrādisaṃbhṛtam | garuḍaṃ bālarūpaṃ taṃ kṛtvā kukṣau puro’bhavam ||33|| evaṃ trikaṃ ca te vīkṣya yācamānaṃ ca dīnavat | mandirāgre samāyātaṃ dayāparāstato’bhavan ||34||| āhūya vedikāyāṃ te nyaṣādayan sukhena ca | ayacchan bhojanaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaprasādajam ||35|| apatyāya payaścāpi daduste bhāvanānvitāḥ | kṛtvā ca bhojanaṃ pānaṃ vayaṃ lakṣmi sukhasthitāḥ |||36|| vitardikāyāmabhavan te cakrurnāmakīrtanam | catvare rāsamārebhustālavādyasunartanaiḥ ||37|| narā nāryo’saṃkhyajanā bhaktiṃ cakrurhi bhāvukāḥ | kṛtvā te kīrtanaṃ yāvat kṣaṇaṃ viśrāntimādadhuḥ ||38|| tadotthāya tvayā sākamahaṃ tatra hi catvare | karatālairmañjiraiśca sanṛtyaṃ kīrtanaṃ vyadhām ||39|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā dṛṣṭvā māṃ tvāṃ ca te tadā | prasannāste ca papracchuḥ śāntaṃ māṃ śreyase muhuḥ ||3.212.40|| sādho kalyāṇadaṃ kiñcid vadātra naḥ kṛpāṃ kuru | śrutvāhaṃ ca tadā lakṣmi jñānaṃ tebhyo dadau mama ||41 || premṇo hetuṃ bhagavati māhātmyaṃ nijagāda vai | māhātmyajñānavatpremṇi viśvāso’pi ca kāraṇam ||42|| māyāpuruṣakālānāṃ svabhāvaguṇakarmaṇām | jaḍacetanatattvānāṃ niyantāraṃ hariṃ śrayet ||43|| sarvasvatantrakartāraṃ sarvāvatārakāraṇam | sarvaśaktipradātāraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ hariṃ śrayet ||44|| premṇāśrayet parātmānaṃ māhātmyajñānavān janaḥ | prītyā saṃsevya taṃ nāthaṃ paradhāma samarjayet ||45|| kuryād vai vāsanānāśaṃ sarvathā tu vivekavān | laukikeṣu viṣayeṣu ruciricchāsti me tu yā ||46|| kiyatīti vivicyaiva hyapaneyā tu sā tataḥ | kiyatī vā harau cāste ruciricchā tu pāvanī ||47|| māyāyāṃ ca harau tulyā nyūnā vā cādhikāpi vā | vivicyeti harau vardhanīyā prayatnataḥ sadā ||48|| hasanīyā ca māyāyāṃ nirmūlā yāvatī bhavet | kṣayiṣṇutvaṃ duḥkhadatvaṃ bandhakṛttvaṃ tu māyike ||49|| padārthajāte bhavatītyevaṃ jñātvā vivarjayet | ruciṃ tyajenmāyikeṣu muktānāmapi bandhanīm ||3.212.50|| arucervāsanānāśo jāyate drutameva ha | satsaṃgāt kṛṣṇasambandhāt kṛṣṇakīrtanagāyanāt ||51|| kṛṣṇe rucirbhavatyeva sākṣād yogād viśeṣataḥ | evamabhyāsayogena kṛṣṇe prītirvivardhate ||52|| māyike malatulye ca bhogye ramye tathetare | rucernāśo bhavettūrṇaṃ bhagavadrasavedinaḥ ||53|| brahmamayaṃ bhāsate’sya divyaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam | bhagavanniṣṭhabhaktasya brahmabhāvaḥ paro vṛṣaḥ ||54|| sthitiḥ sā paramā mahābhāgavatī pramodinī | māyābhimānarahitā bhagavadbhāvaśobhitā ||55|| vāsanāyāḥ praṇāśārthaṃ prītyarthaṃ ca harestathā | sādhayedātmaniṣṭhāṃ ca vairāgyaṃ śreṣṭhamityapi ||56|| kṛṣṇamāhātmyātiśayavijñānaṃ svasamarpaṇam | sādhayed bhagavanniṣṭhāṃ satāṃ samāgamaṃ caret ||57|| nirvāsanātmaniṣṭhānāṃ satāṃ sevāṃ prasādhayet | prasannatāṃ satāṃ labdhvā jayenmāyāṃ paraṃ vrajet ||58|| atidhairyaṃ labhejjñānādāśrayātparamātmanaḥ | satāṃ satsaṃgasāhāyyāddhairyaṃ dṛḍhaṃ harau bhavet ||5 9|| ātmaniṣṭhāyujā bhaktyā dhairyasthairthaṃ tathā bhavet | dhīrasya muktabhāvasya vighnā naiva bhavanti ca ||3.212.60|| bhaktyantarāyarūpāśca siddhayo nopayāntyapi | pakvabhaktaparīkṣārthaṃ samāyānti hi siddhayaḥ ||6 1 || śrīharerājñayā tāstu lobhayanti muhuḥ śritam | tathāpi tā na paśyecca jitvā yāti paraṃ padam ||62|| evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya kṛṣṇo vaśe svayaṃ bhavet | māyāyā vāsanāśūnyo yaśca kṛṣṇārpitākhilaḥ ||63|| kṛṣṇārthakṛtasarvasvastasya prīto hariḥ sadā | kṛṣṇe’tipremavadbhaktahṛdayācchrīhariḥ kvacit ||64|| premarajjvā naddhavarmā gantuṃ śakto na jāyate | tasyaiva bhagavān pātā svāmī kāntaśca mokṣakṛt ||65||| māyāduḥkhaharaścāste hṛdaye sarvathā saha | etādṛśasya bhaktasya guṇā divyā bhavanti hi ||66|| satyaśaucādayo ye ca sarve kṛṣṇasamāśrayāt | kṛṣṇasya divyavijñānājjāyante bhaktimatyapi || 67|| kālakarmasvabhāvānāṃ māyāyāḥ puruṣasya ca | īśvarāṇāṃ niyantā śrībālakṛṣṇo’sti mādhavaḥ ||68|| kartā poṣṭā ca saṃhartā sṛṣṭīnāṃ śrīpatiḥ prabhuḥ | asti gopālabālaḥ sa sarveṣāṃ hṛdayeṣu saḥ ||69|| nirlepo vartate svāmī rādhāramāpradhīpatiḥ | evaṃ jñātvā harau kṛṣṇe sambandhaṃ prāptavān dṛḍham ||3.212.70|| yastasya śrīhareḥ sambandhino divyaguṇā api | āvirbhavanti bhakte vai sarvaiśvaryāṇi sarvathā ||71 || cakṣurdīpaprasaṃgena prabhāguṇaṃ pravindati | yathā tathā hareryogād bhakte guṇā viśanti ca ||72|| svatantro jāyate kṛṣṇatulyaḥ kṛṣṇaprasādataḥ | sarvaṃ kartuṃ siddhimām̐śca nityasiddho’pi jāyate ||73 || yathendra āyayau nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ tapaḥkṣatim | kartumapsarasāṃ vrātairnirastaścorvaśījaneḥ ||74|| evaṃ siddhyā siddhimanto nirasyante susiddhinā | bhaktena mūlamāyāpi nirasyate harerbalāt ||75|| devā bhaktā bhavantyeva bhagavadguṇayoginaḥ | āsurā na prajāyante bhagavadguṇinaḥ kvacit ||76|| mahatāṃ tu satāṃ kṛpāpārāvāre praviśya ca | pāpino bhagavadbhaktyā kvacid guṇā viśanti hi ||77|| prasannāḥ sevayā santo nāśayanti hi durguṇān | āsuratvaṃ nāśayanti kurvanti daivabhāvukam ||78 || yastu raṅkajanān garvādavajānāti bhaktakān | so’pi tatpāpapuñjena daivo’pyāsuratāṃ vrajet ||79|| śapto bhaved brahmadagdho guṇāstatra viśanti na | dīnāvamānaṃ tasmānna kartavyaṃ kvacideva ha ||3.212.80|| dīnāgre dīnavat stheyaṃ tena kṛṣṇaḥ pratuṣyati | garvavatsu kṛpāṃ naiva karoti bhagavān kvacit ||8 1|| guṇāsteṣu śubhā naiva jāyante drohiṣu kvacit | mṛdorbhaktasya dīnasya droheṇa puṇyasaṃkṣayaḥ ||82|| jāyate nātra sandeho nāvamānyā hi durbalāḥ | bāhyato malināścāpi hṛdaye śuddhabhāvanāḥ ||83|| bhaktā bhagavato mānyā mokṣadāḥ sādhavo hi te | teṣāṃ hṛdaye bhagavānantaryāmī virājate ||84|| sahaiva vartate dīnanātho hyanātharakṣakaḥ | bhaktānāmavamānena ruṣṭo bhavati mādhavaḥ ||85|| avamānayitustūrṇaṃ vināśaṃ kurute svayam | kārayatyāśu cānyena raṅkabhaktavaśaṃvadaḥ ||86|| nālīkara vayaṃ dīnā malinā makṣikāvṛtāḥ | sabhayāścātra bhojyārthaṃ hyāyātā dīnamānasāḥ ||87|| tiraskāro bhavadbhirna kṛtaḥ satkāra ādṛtaḥ | ataḥ prasannahṛdayā bhavāmo’tra sukhānvitāḥ ||88|.| yūyaṃ bhaktā bhagavataḥ satyā nirmānisevakāḥ | varadānaṃ cārthayantu rocate yadi mānase ||89|| ityuktvāhaṃ yadā lakṣmi mūrtiṃ natvā ca māmakīm | gantumiyeṣa dūraṃ ca tāvad bālo malaṃ vyadhāt ||3.212.90 || nālīkaro jalaṃ ninye dadau vai tasya yoṣite | tatstrī nāmnā kundanikā baliṃ labdhvā karāttava ||9 1 || malaprakṣālanaṃ cakre bhāvena bālakasya te | tāvanme’pi viśeṣeṇābhavat prasannatā hyati ||92|| bhaktebhyaḥ pradadau naijaṃ darśanaṃ divyamadbhutam| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ śrīśyāmasundaram ||93 || tava rūpaṃ sundaraṃ ca lakṣmi vyadarśayam̐stathā | bālakasya svarūpaṃ ca gāruḍaṃ samadarśayam ||94|| atha bhaktāḥ kṛtakṛtyā vyajāyanta hṛdantare | nanṛturdarśanaṃ kṛtvā pūjayāmāsurutsukāḥ || 95|| vavruste varadānaṃ ca mokṣārthaṃ netarattadā | tathāstviti varaṃ datvā tirobhāvaṃ kṣaṇāntare ||96|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇamūrtau viveśāhaṃ tvayā saha | garuḍaḥ pakṣimūrtau ca viveśa sahasā tadā ||97|| evaṃ svaṃ darśanaṃ datvā sukhaṃ tebhyo’dadāṃ param | atha kāle gate nālīkarasya lohakarmabhiḥ ||98|| vakṣasi śvāsarogo’bhūt sarvathā śvāsasañcaraḥ | damākhyena hi rogeṇa pīḍito bhaktarāṇnijam ||99|| kāryaṃ kartumaśakto māṃ prārthayāmāsa mūrtigam | drāgāvirbhūya hastena mayā dugdhaṃ prapāyitam ||3.212.1 0 0|| hastena tasya hṛdayaṃ spṛṣṭvā rogo vināśitaḥ | atha tūrṇaṃ tirobhūtvā mūrtau sadāvasaṃ rame || 101 || āyuṣyasya kṣaye nālīkaraṃ tathā striyam | kundanikāṃ vimānenānayaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ param || 1 02|| evamanyānapi bhaktānanayaṃ dhāma cākṣaram | ye bhajanti ca māṃ bhaktyā guṇān gṛhṇanti me tathā || 1 03|| satāṃ sevāṃ prakurvanti premabhāvena sarvathā | satāṃ prasannatā prāpya te prayāsyanti matpadam || 1 04|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇāt sevanādapi | bhuktirmuktirbhavatyeva yatheṣṭā paramā gatiḥ || 1 05|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne nālīkarasya lohakārasya bhaktyā śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇagaruḍadattadarśanaṃ tanmokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 212 ||
<3.213> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇunārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ carmakārasya śobhanām | kathāṃ nāmnā maṃgalasya mama bhaktisamanvitām || 1 || bhakto maṃgaladevākhyaścarmakāro’tisevakaḥ | abhavad droṇikāpuryāṃ kuṭumbī carmakāryakṛt || 2 || mahiṣīṇāṃ gavāṃ sāraṃgāṇāṃ kesariṇāṃ tathā | vyāghrāṇāṃ kariṇāṃ cānyajātīnāṃ paśuvarṣmaṇām || 3 || mṛtānāṃ carmaṇāṃ śuddhiṃ saṃskāraiḥ prakaroti saḥ | vikrīṇāti sumūlyaiśca carmāṇi saṃskṛtāni vai || 4 || carmaṇāṃ ca pavitrāṇāmāsanāni vidhāya tu | mṛgāṇāṃ ca mṛgendrāṇāṃ sādhubhyaḥ sa dadātyapi || 5 || sādhusamāgamaṃ nityaṃ gatvā sādhumaṭhe’nvaham | karoti catvarādīnāṃ mārjanaṃ gopurādiṣu || 6 || satāṃ pādarajo dhṛtvā mastake hṛdaye mukhe | dehe snātvā rajobhiśca dhūlīṣvapi luṭhatyapi || 7 || aho bhāgyaṃ satāṃ puṇyarajasā snāmi carmakṛt | satāṃ prasannatāṃ labdhvā prayāsyāmi paraṃ padam || 8 || evaṃ vadan mahimānaṃ pādajalaṃ pibatyapi | satāmucchiṣṭamannaṃ ca bhuṃkte patrāvalisthitam || 9 || aśuddhaścarmakṛddehaḥ śuddhaḥ prasādataḥ satām | sarvapāpāni naṣṭāni carmakṛttvaṃ gataṃ mama || 3.213.1 0|| aho santaḥ aho kṛṣṇaḥ aho janma mamātra ca | nīcajātāvadhikohaṃ bhāgyavān sevayāsmi vai ||1 1 || evaṃ jānan mahimānaṃ kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa smaratyapi | carmasu śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāma likhatyapi || 12|| dadāti dāne sādhubhyaḥ śreyaḥ svaṃ cārthayatyapi | carmajanyopakaraṇānyanyānyapi vidhāya ca ||13|| vikrīṇāti likhitvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇābhidhām | gṛhāṃgaṇe toraṇe cālikhat kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||14|| sarvaṃ kṛṣṇamayaṃ tasya bhaktasya vartate rame | āpaṇo’pi kṛtastena kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāpaṇaḥ || 15|| citritaścābhito bhittidvāratoraṇabhūmiṣu | rādhākṛṣṇa hare lakṣmīnārāyaṇa ramāpate || 16|| vallabha prabho kamalāpate śrīkaṃbharājane | gopālabālaka śrīmannārāyaṇa pareśvara || 17|| bhagavannaghahan puṇyaṃ cāvahan cāntare sthita | evaṃ nāmabhiḥ sarvatra tathā ca pratimādibhiḥ || 18|| citritaścāpaṇaḥ sarvo gṛhaṃ ca citritaṃ tathā | etādṛśo’yaṃ bhakto me snātvā pūjāṃ karoti me || 19|| samarpya dhūpadīpādi naivedyaṃ phalamityapi | tāmbūlaṃ jalamityādi parihāraṃ karoti ca ||3.213.20|| bhuktvā prasādajaṃ cānnaṃ tata udyamameti hi | karmacārāstasya bhṛtyāḥ sarve’pi pūjanaṃ mama ||21 || kṛtvā karmasamārambhaṃ vidadhatyaniśaṃ rame | rātrau saṃbhūya ca kathāṃ kīrtanaṃ racayantyapi ||22|| gāyanti mama gāthāśca modante ca yadutsavaiḥ | yadi vratāho bhavati jāgratyāprātareva ca ||23 || prātaḥ kurvanti militā udyāpanaṃ vratasya te | bhojayanti pūjayanti bhaktān carmakarān bahūn ||24|| anyānapi samāyātān satkārayanti vastubhiḥ | sādhavo ye tathāyogyā anye vā nagare nije ||25|| ya āyānti ca tebhyaste pādatrāṇe dadatyapi | evaṃ vai bahudhā sevāṃ kurvanti bhaktisaṃvidaḥ ||26|| prasannāḥ sādhavaścaiṣāṃ bhavantyāśīḥpradā yathā | bhavantu sukhino bhaktā bhaktau nirvighnasatphalāḥ ||27|| cirañjīvāḥ pāvanāśca sarvavipadvivarjitāḥ | satīnāṃ ca satāṃ santu sevakāḥ puṇyaśālinaḥ ||28|| evamāśīrvādamāptā bhavanti kṛpayā satām | athaikadā pūrṇimāyāmāśvinasya niśākare ||29|| sarvakalāprapūrṇe cāmbaraṃ prāpte mahotsavam | cakruste carmakārā vai kaumudyāṃ pratimāṃ hareḥ ||3.213.30|| avasthāpyāsane ramye jyotsnāyāṃ tāṃ samarcayan | candanai ramyavastraiścālaṃkāraiḥ śobhanaistathā ||3 1 || nīrājanādikaṃ cakrūrarnaivedyaṃ śarkarāyutān | dugdhamagnān pṛthukām̐śca samārpayat hi viṣṇave 32|| mahāsthāle prasādaṃ ca nidhāya tamanāvṛtam | rāsaṃ bhagavataścāgre khelayāmāsurutsukāḥ || 33|| hastapādāditālaiste | kīrtayāmāsuracyutam | premamagnā abhavam̐śca bhramanto valayākṛtim ||34|| cakrayanti hariṃ māṃ te gāyanti cotplavotsukāḥ | ālāpayanti tālaiśca kūrdanti vividhakramaiḥ ||35|| niṣadyotthāya ca bhrāntyā viluṭhyotthāya yānti ca | tālaṃ gṛhṇanti dadati sanmukhāḥ pratisanmukhāḥ ||36|| evaṃ pramodamānandaṃ bhuñjate mama sevakāḥ | lakṣmi yadā niśāmadhye cāndrīdugdhāyite sthale || 37|| tadāhaṃ bhagavān viṣṇurlubdho bhaktirasāyane | rāsaikāgramanā bhūtvā paśyāmi saṃśṛṇomi ca || 38|| mūrtāveva yathā te māṃ naiva paśyanti tattathā | prasanno’hamabhavam̐ ca premabaddhaḥ priyaḥ prabhuḥ || 39|| śṛṇu tatrābhavad yadvai gītilubdho bhujaṅgamaḥ | pārśvavāsaḥ samāgatya gṛhakoṇe sthiro’bhavat ||3.213.40|| śrutvā rāsarasāṃ gītiṃ śrutvā satālakīrtanam | ghrātvā sthālasthapṛthukān sadugdhaśarkarān śubhān ||41 || dṛṣṭvā nirjanasaṃsthām̐śca gatvā śanaiḥ śanaiśca tān | āsvādya jihvayā dugdhaṃ pītvā miṣṭaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||42|| prasādapāvitaḥ śīghraṃ sabhayaḥ prayayau daram | atha rāsāntaviśrāntiṃ prāpya prasādalabdhaye ||43|| paṃktiśaścābhavan sarve viṣāktān pṛthukān janāḥ | paryaveṣayan bhaktāstān paṃktau sahasradehinām ||44|| pṛthukān bhuktavantaste māhātmyavedino janāḥ | ābālavṛddhāḥ sarve te kṛṣṇasarpaviṣānvitān ||45 || sarve bhuktvā jalaṃ pītvā suptāḥ kṣaṇaṃ tu catvare | viṣamūrchāmagamam̐ste bahavo maraṇonmukhāḥ ||46|| abhavan viṣadagdhāste dehabhānavivarjitāḥ | athānye nyūnagaralasparśā vividurulbaṇam ||47|| viṣaprakopamanyeṣāṃ sveṣāṃ ca mastakabhramam | piśaṅganīlaharitaraṅgābhā netraraśmiṣu ||48|| te parīkṣāṃ pracakrurvai śīghraṃ ca vividurviṣam | prakāśaṃ jagaduḥ sarve pṛthukā garalānvitāḥ ||49|| bhakṣitā vai tato mūrchā mṛtyudā samupasthitā | sarve śīghraṃ ghṛtapānaṃ cakrurviṣanivṛttaye ||3.213.5 0|| vamanaṃ saviṣaṃ teṣāṃ jātaṃ viṣanivartanam | athāpi bahavo bhaktā viṣeṇa vai mṛtā iva ||51 || abhavam̐stān jīvayituṃ prārthayan māṃ pare janāḥ | rurudurbahavastatra strīputrāḥ patibāndhavāḥ ||52|| sasmarurmāṃ parameśaṃ prāṇadaṃ cāntarasthitam | teṣāṃ viklavabhāvaṃ ca rodanaṃ bhajanaṃ vratam ||53|| bhaktiṃ vīkṣya prasanno’haṃ tūrṇamāvirbabhūva ha | sādhurūpaḥ kṛtakukṣiviṣahauṣadhapeṭikā ||54|| atiṣṭhaṃ śokakartṝṇāṃ sannidhau vṛttasaṃśravaḥ | tūrṇaṃ vṛttāntamāvedya jalamādhāya vai ghaṭe ||55|| tatrauṣadharasaṃ kṣiptvādadāṃ cācamanīyakam | mūrchitānāṃ mṛtatulyāvasthānāṃ sahasā mukhe ||56|| tālau jalasya sparśena gatamūrchāstadābhavan | amṛtāste’bhavam̐ścāpi labdhāsujñānasañcarāḥ ||57|| uttasthurdrāk samastā vai bhajanto nidritā yathā | svasthāste svapnavattatra jñātavanto nijāpadam ||58|| viṣaṃ cāmṛtatāṃ prāptaṃ sādhoroṣadhivāriṇā | atha sarve militvā te sādhordadurhi bhojanam ||59|| pānaṃ ramyaṃ cāsanaṃ ca viśrāntyarthaṃ niśottare | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ tasya cakruste jīvitā janāḥ ||3.213.60 || sevāmagnā janāste tu papracchuḥ sādhumeva tam | bhagavanniṣṭhatāptānāṃ kathaṃ vighnaṃ prajāyate ||61 || tamuvāca tadā sādhurvighnaṃ kṛṣṇecchayā khalu | parīkṣārthaṃ jāyate vai na tu vighnaṃ hi tanmatam ||62|| kṛṣṇaprasannatādārḍhyaṃ bhaktidārḍhyaṃ bhavettataḥ | sarvavighnavināśaṃ ca sākṣādetya karoti saḥ ||63|| āpatkāle tu bhaktānāṃ smaraṇaṃ śrīharerbhavet | camatkāre darśite tu bhaktidārḍhyaṃ bhaved bahu ||64|| aho’yaṃ bhagavānasti sarvaduḥkhanivārakaḥ | tasya sevā prakartavyā mokṣadā sukhadā śubhā ||656|| evaṃ bhavanti saṃkalpā aiśvaryavīkṣaṇe sadā | athānaiśvaryavīkṣāyāṃ nṛnāṭyamanukurvati ||66 || kṛṣṇe khedo bhavedeva na cāyaṃ bhagavāniti | bahukālaṃ mayā sevā kṛtā sā viphalā tviha ||67|| yathāhaṃ nirbalaścāsmyasamarthaḥ pāratāntrikaḥ | tathāyaṃ nirbalaścāste hyaśaktaḥ pāratāntrikaḥ ||68|| mayi kāmastathā krodho lobho moho bhayaṃ yathā | tathā kṛṣṇe kāmalobhakrodhamohabhayāni vai ||69|| santi tasmānna vai cāyaṃ bhagavān kintu mānavaḥ | evaṃ prākṛtamatimān kṛṣṇe prākṛtamartyadhīḥ ||3.213.70|| doṣān svavat kalpayati sannaṣṭadivyabhāvanaḥ | tasmāddharau sadā bhāvyaṃ divyabhāvaprabhāviṇā ||71 || mantavyā pūrṇatā svasya na me prāpyaṃ hariṃ vinā | na me sādhyaṃ paraṃ kiñcicchiṣyate harisādhanam ||72|| atra vai militaḥ sākṣāddharistatrāsti tatpadam | brahmadhāmāpi tatrāsti muktāstatra vasanti ca ||73|| atra harau vidyamāne pṛthvyādi sarvamuttamam | divyameva sabhā divyā bhaktā divyā narāḥ striyaḥ ||74|| teṣāṃ yoge mamānando vartate bhagavanmayaḥ | dhanyo’haṃ kṛtakṛtyo’haṃ yadatra vartate hariḥ ||75|| sādhurūpo mūrtirūpo vartate bhagavāniha | evaṃ bhaktasya saṃkalpā jāyante cātmavedinaḥ ||76|| devāśceśā avatārā muktā yatsampadā sukhāḥ | sa eva bhagavānatra rājate puruṣottamaḥ ||77|| yadakṣaraṃ vyāpakaṃ ca brahmadhāma parātparam | tatparo bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastvihāgataḥ | |78|| milito’tra mahārājo madbhāgyānto na vidyate | tasya kṛṣṇasya yogena jīvanaṃ naḥ punaḥ khalu ||79|| divye nitye pare dhāmni yaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo virājate | nijatulyairmahāmuktairasaṃkhyātairupāsitaḥ ||3.213.80|| teṣāṃ vai divyamuktānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya pratāpataḥ | ekaikaromṇi tejo’sti koṭikoṭyarkasadṛśam ||81|| tādṛśānāmasaṃkhyānāṃ muktānāṃ teja ujjvalam | samastaṃ līyate tvekaromṇi tādṛk tadakṣaram ||82|| brahmadhāmāsti divyaṃ vai saccidānandalakṣaṇam | tathāvidhāni dhāmāni dhāmnāṃ tejāṃsi yānyapi ||83 || samastāni kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaikaromṇi līnatām | yāntīti tādṛśī bhūtirvartate paramātmanaḥ ||84|| tādṛśo bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ samartho’ti mahān hariḥ | kṛpāvaśo dehināṃ tu śreyase sarvaśaktiyuk ||85|| dhṛtadivyanarākāro naravannṛṣu jāyate | tirodhāya mahaiśvaryāṇyapi narākṛtirasti saḥ ||86|| tasya bhaktyā samastāni duḥkhāni yānti līnatām | kālasya karmaṇāṃ māyāyāśca tasya na bandhanam ||87|| sevayā śrīharestasya rakṣaṇaṃ jāyate sadā | yathā mayā satā rakṣā bhavatāṃ vihitātra vai |||88|| tathā kṛṣṇaḥ kārayati sādhudvārā nijāvanam | bhaktā jīvāścetanāśca māyā tattvāni yāni ca ||89|| sarvamasya śarīraṃ vai vyāpyaṃ cādhīnamityapi | vaśyaṃ cāpi bhavatyeva sarvamasya mahātmanaḥ ||3.213.90|| teṣu sarveṣu tattveṣu muktākṣareśvareṣvapi | vyāpako vartate kṛṣṇo māyājīvādikeṣvapi ||91|| sarveṣāṃ prerakaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svatantraśca niyāmakaḥ | savaiśvaryayutaḥ sarvaśeṣī kalyāṇakṛtprabhuḥ ||92|| āvirbhūya kṣitau nrābho nṛnāṭyaṃ vidadhāti saḥ | sevadhvaṃ taṃ hariṃ ye vai divyabhāvā narāḥ striyaḥ ||93|| te sarve śrīhareḥ sarvamaiśvaryaṃ prāpnuvanti ha | brahmarūpā brahmabhāvāḥ sapremasevino hareḥ ||94|| vrahmaloke’pi tadrūpāḥ sevante parameśvaram | tasmādatra hariḥ sevyaḥ sādhurūpo’tirakṣakaḥ ||95|| sādhau nārāyaṇaścāste bhaktecchāpūrakaḥ svayam | evaṃ maṃgaladevādyā lakṣmi proktā mayā tadā ||96|| vividuste mayi kṛṣṇaṃ māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kecidityatha | siṣevire’tibhāvena sādhurūpaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||97|| satī maṃgaladevasya patnī nāmnā vibhāvarī | siṣeve māṃ pādasaṃvāhanādyairatibhāvukī ||98|| athāhaṃ prārthitastaiśca mokṣārthaṃ vai punaḥ punaḥ | tathāstvevākathayaṃ svāṃ divyāmadarśayaṃ tanum ||99|| vīṇāyuktaṃ samukuṭaṃ śyāmasundaravigraham | koṭimanmatharūpātirūpaṃ kiśoramujjvalam || 3.213.1 00|| rādhādibhirvanditaṃ ca brahmapriyābhisevitam | koṭimuktamahāmuktānikājuṣṭaṃ śriyaḥ patim ||1 01 || etādṛśaṃ ca madrūpaṃ darśayitvā kṣaṇāntare | mūrtau tirobhavaṃ te tu mahāścaryaparāḥ punaḥ || 1 02|| nanṛtuḥ kīrtanaṃ cakruḥ sākṣāt kṛṣṇasya darśanāt | evaṃ nityaṃ bhejire te cātibhaktyā tu nityaśaḥ || 1 03|| prāpte kāle tu tān divyākṣaraṃ dhāma parātparam | vimānenānayaṃ cāsthāpayaṃ mukteṣu tatra ca || 104|| bhaktaṃ maṃgaladevaṃ ca patnīṃ vibhāvarīṃ tathā | arakṣayaṃ me sevāyāṃ pādayorakṣare sthale || 1 05|| evaṃ lakṣmi mayā rakṣā kṛtā carmakṛtāṃ tadā | tebhyo mantraṃ dattavām̐śca sādhurūpo dayāvaśaḥ || 1 06|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | jepurbhejuḥ sasmarurmāṃ yayurme paramaṃ padam || 1 07|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāt sevanādapi | bhajanāllabhate bhūtiṃ divyāṃ divaṃ ca mokṣaṇam || 1 08|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne maṃgaladevākhyacarmakārabhaktasya bhaktyā sākṣādāgatya bhagavatā viṣavāraṇaṃ kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā trayodaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 213 ||
<3.214> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ rathakārasya śobhanam | vṛttāntaṃ mama bhaktyāḍhyaṃ sutāragrāmavāsinaḥ || 1 || raṅgamayīsarittīre rathakāro’tipāvanaḥ | sutārapuryāmabhavanmama bhaktaḥ kuṭumbavān || 2 || kāṣṭhayānāni sarvāṇi gantrīśca śakaṭāni ca | anaścakrāṇi sarvāṇi kāṣṭhāsanāni maṃcakān || 3 || bṛsīḥ khadvāśca paryaṃkān kapaṭān prakaroti saḥ | kāṣṭhapātrāṇi ramyāṇi kāṣṭhaputtalaputtalīḥ || 4 || kāruvaryaḥ karotyeva naukā gajāśvagovṛṣān | vividhānyupakaraṇānyapi svakalayā tathā || 5 || karoti peṭikāścāpi peṭakān sucatuṣkikāḥ | tatra sarvatra kāryeṣu harernāma likhatyapi || 6 || svanāma haridāseti likhitvā ca tataḥ param | hariśceti hi sarveṣu vastuṣvayaṃ likhatyapi || 7 || gṛhe ca kāṣṭhaśālāyāṃ lilekha śrīhare prabho | gṛhajālāntare kāṣṭhapratimāṃ paramātmanaḥ || 8 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāsthāpayaddhi saḥ | prātaḥ samūjayatyenāṃ pratimāṃ mama śobhanām || 9 || śriyā sākaṃ puṣpapatracandanākṣatakuṃkumaiḥ | bhūṣāvastradravadhūpadīpanaivedyavāribhiḥ ||3.214.1 0|| evaṃ sampūjya nityaṃ vai prasādaṃ grasate tataḥ | anyebhyaḥ sampradāyāpi tataḥ kārye pravartate || 1 1|| udyame smarati māṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | harikṛṣṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ haridāsaḥ subhaktarāṭ || 1 2|| athaikadā vicāro’syābhavad devādigocaraḥ | anyodyogaṃ vihāyaiva pratimodyogamāvahe || 13|| yāsāṃ nirmāṇakārye vai dhyānaṃ devātmakaṃ bhavet | smaraṇaṃ cāpi devānāṃ rūparaṅgādikarmasu ||14|| satataṃ syāt kīrtanaṃ cārpaṇaṃ mūrtimayaṃ bhavet | evaṃ vicārya ca haridāso haryarthamutsukaḥ || 15|| harimūrtimayodyogaṃ samārabhata bhāvataḥ | puruṣottamamūrtiṃ sa vyaracayat suśobhanām || 16|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtiṃ samāṇikīm | rādhākṛṣṇayugalaṃ ca lakṣmīnārāyaṇobhayam || 17|| vāsudevaṃ śriyā sākaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca kamalāyutam | naraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ cāpi śeṣaśāyinarāyaṇam || 18|| śrīpatiṃ śrīgaruḍasthaṃ gajasthaṃ māṇikīsthitam | vimānasthaṃ rathasthaṃ cāracayad divyaśobhanam || 19|| duḥkhahāśrīsahitaṃ ca gobhiśca sahitaṃ prabhum | matsyaṃ kūrmaṃ ca vārāhaṃ kapilaṃ ca hariṃ tathā ||3.214.20|| vāsudevaṃ rājarājaṃ pṛthuṃ dattaṃ nṛsiṃhakam | haṃsamṛṣabhaṃ paraśudharaṃ yajñaṃ ca vāmanam ||21|| rāmaṃ kumāraṃ vyāsaṃ ca hayagrīvaṃ ca nāradam | bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca buddhaṃ ca kalkiṃ nārāyaṇīpatim |||2|| haraṃ satīṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ sāvitrīṃ ca sarasvatīm | prajñāṃ pārāvatīṃ durgāṃ gaṃgāṃ ca kālikāṃ tathā ||23|| sūryaṃ vahniṃ candramasaṃ gaṇeśaṃ kālabhairavam | nandaṃ sunandaṃ liṅgaṃ cāracayat pratimāḥ śubhāḥ ||24|| kāṣṭhānāṃ savanānāṃ vai sasarjānāṃ sāgaśākhinām | vaṭānāṃ śiṃśapānāṃ ca karoti pratimāḥ śubhāḥ ||25|| svalpā madhyāścottamāśca vividhāḥ sa karoti vai | raṃgaśṛṃgārayuktāśca saṃskṛtāścihnitatvacaḥ ||26|| bhajan raṭan hariṃ nāma nirmāti pratimāḥ sadā | yāsāṃ rūpāṇi hṛdaye bhāsante na tadā tu saḥ ||27|| raho niṣadya māṃ smṛtvā rūpaṃ dhārayate mama | hṛdaye sve caikatāno manmūrtau sa prajāyate ||28|| samastendriyavṛttīnāṃ layo bhavati vai mayi | yathā tathā sa yatate yogivad dhyāyati sthiraḥ ||29|| dinārdhaṃ vā dinaṃ yāti samādhāviva tasya vai | tathāpi premamagno’sau na niryāti samādhitaḥ ||3.214.30 || mūrtiścintāmaṇikalpā vartate mādhavasya yat | tasyāḥ sakāśāt saṃkalpāḥ pūrṇā bhavanti dhāritāḥ ||3 1 || itiniścayayuktasya haridāsasya sarvathā | yāvannodeti rūpaṃ vai kartavyapratimātmakam |||32|| tāvat samādhau manmūrtau sthirastiṣṭhati tanmayaḥ | icchan draṣṭuṃ nūtnarūpaṃ racanārhaṃ suśobhanam ||33|| atha me kṛpayā mūrteḥ rūpaṃ yadābhijāyate | kartavyapratimārūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ || 34|| abhyasya ca tato bhakto bahiryāti na cānyathā | yādṛg dṛṣṭaṃ svarūpaṃ vai sādhyamūrtestathāvidham |||35|| kāṣṭhācchilpakalābhiśca niṣkāsayati śobhanam | saumyaṃ suhāsyavadanaṃ sarvayogyasuśastrakam ||36|| yogyaśṛṃgārabhūṣāḍhyaṃ tathotkaroti kāṣṭhajam | dāravaṃ sundaraṃ rūpaṃ yādṛśaṃ hṛdi vīkṣitam ||37|| tādṛśaṃ saṃvidhāyaiva vikrīṇāti suraṃgitam | evaṃ samastadevānāṃ hanumadyatiyoginām ||38|| sādhvīnāṃ devatānāṃ ca kṛtvā karoti vikrayam | dhyāyati devatāḥ sarvā viśeṣatastu vallabham ||39|| lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ śrīśaṃ dhyāyati puruṣottamam | tato’haṃ matpratimātastadiṣṭaṃ pūrayāmyapi ||3.214.40|| khyātistasyābhavalloke haridāso harestanuḥ | rājānaścāpi tasmādvai kārayantīṣṭadevatāḥ ||41 || haridāso’pi kṛtvaiva dadātyeva śubhottamāḥ | haridāsena niyamaḥ kṛto nārāyaṇaṃ vinā ||42||| nārāyaṇāṃśaṃ ca vinā mānavī pratimā mayā | na vai kāryā kvacid bhaktivirodhinī tu māyikī ||43 || nimnacintanadā naiva kāryā mānuṣaputtalī | abhaktānāṃ naiva kāryā tathā mānuṣaputtalī ||44|| bhaktānāṃ tu śubhā kāryā tadiṣṭadevatāyutā | evamātmaniveditvaṃ rarakṣa nityadā hi saḥ ||45|| prasanno’haṃ tato lakṣmi parīkṣārthamupāyayau | cakravatīśvaro bhūtvā tīrthavyājena mārgagaḥ ||46|| hastyaśvarathavān pāresahasrasainikānvitaḥ | rājñīdāsīdāsavargasahasraparisevitaḥ ||47|| ratnahīrakahārādyairbhūṣitaśchatraśobhitaḥ | mahāśvetagajapṛṣṭhe svarṇāmbālikayānvite ||48|| niṣaṇṇaścāmarairyukto jayaśabdābhipūjitaḥ | astraśastradharaiścāpi bhaṭaiḥ samparivāritaḥ ||49|| gurvamātyapradhānādyairvanditaḥ sevitastathā | lakṣmi tvaṃ ca mama patnī sāmrājñī śobhanottamā ||3.214.50|| sahasraśobhanādāsīyuvatīgaṇamaṇḍitā | mayā preritabhṛtyābhirakṣitā bhṛtyapūjitā ||51 || mahāsauvarṇaratnāḍhyanarayānasthitā tathā | upāyayitha sākaṃ vai mayā pūrvaprapreṣitā ||52|| evaṃvidho’haṃ samrāṭ vai raṅgamayīnadītaṭe | tīrthayātrāmiṣeṇāgre vṛkṣaṣaṇḍe viniryayau ||53|| tīrthataṭaṃ mahāśālagrāmatīrthābhidhaṃ varam | samāśritya sthiratārthamavātaraṃ gajānmama ||54|| sasainyo’haṃ nyavasaṃśca snānapūjādimānasaḥ | athāyayuḥ sutārākhyanagarasthāḥ prajājanāḥ ||55|| guravaścāpi viprāśca bhikṣukāḥ sakutūhalāḥ | lipsayā dakṣiṇādeśca vikṣaṇecchānvitā api ||56|| āyayau nagaraṃ sarve draṣṭuṃ rājānamityapi | tathāpi bhaktarājo’sau nāyāti māyikaṃ vidan ||57|| athāhaṃ tīrthavidhinā kṛtvā tīrthaṃ tataḥ param | datvā dānānyanekāni śuśrāva pratimāḥ śubhāḥ ||58|| dadarśa pratimāścāpi tīrthataṭe sthirīkṛtāḥ | papraccha mānavām̐statrāgatān śilpivaraṃ prati ||59|| te prāhuratra nagare vartate śilpirāṇnanu | ākārito mayā dūtairharidāso’pi nāyayau ||3.214.60|| vinā bhāgavataṃ santaṃ vinā nārāyaṇaṃ harim | vinā bhaktaṃ hareranyasyāntikaṃ naimi so’vadat ||61 || tato’hamuktavānnāma madīyaṃ kṛṣṇadāsavat | śrīkṛṣṇadāsavaryāhaṃ kṛṣṇabhakto bhavāmi ha ||62|| āyāhi śilpivarya tvaṃ pratimārthaṃ madicchayā | dūtairgatvā tathaivoktaḥ so’pi śrutvā hyupāyayau ||63 || puṣpahārān gṛhītvaiva nyadhārayannṛporasi | rājānaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktaṃ vai jñātvā neme’tibhāvataḥ ||64|| rājāpi tasya sammānaṃ pracakāra suvijñavat | śilpī lakṣmi mayā rājñā pṛṣṭo mūrtividhāpane || 65|| krīṇanārthaṃ ca mūrtīnāṃ mūlye’pi pṛṣṭa eva saḥ | so’pi kṛṣṇasya mūrtiṃ vai dadau me rādhayā yutām ||66 || sahasrarūpyamudrābhistathā lakṣmīṃ narāyaṇam | labdhvāhaṃ mudrikā datvā svarṇaśataṃ tathottaram ||67|| pāritoṣikamevāpi datvākathayaṃ matkṛte | mamaikāṃ mama rājñyāśca mūrtimekāṃ vidhāpaya ||68|| dāsye yatheṣṭaṃ kanakaṃ ratnāni hīrakām̐stathā | sa prāha rājan bhakto’smi nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ||69||| nārāyaṇavibhūtīnāṃ nārāyaṇasya vai tathā | devānāṃ devatānāṃ ca karomi pratimāḥ sadā ||3.214.70|| mānavīṃ na karomyeva māyikīṃ na karomi ca | yasyāḥ saṃklṛptane vṛttirnārāyaṇaṃ na cintayet ||71 || māyāṃ ca māyikīṃ cāpi puttalīṃ na smare kvacit | tava rājanmahiṣyāśca puttalyāḥ karaṇe tu me ||72|| smaraṇaṃ mānavaṃ syādvai bhaktau kṣatirbhavenmama | tato’haṃ na kariṣye vai puttalīṃ te kṣamasva mām ||73|| yadyapi tvaṃ prabhakto’si tathāpi rājaso’si vai | rājño ceyaṃ mahāmāyā mohinī vartate tava ||74|| tatsmṛtiṃ na kariṣye’haṃ vinā lakṣmīṃ narāyaṇam | yadi lakṣmyā samaṃ rājñī tvaṃ sākaṃ mādhavena tu ||75|| bhaktāvivobhau tiṣṭhantau sevāyāṃ staśca rocate | te yadi tarhi kurve’haṃ mūrtiṃ śrīpatinā saha ||76|| kevalāṃ naiva kurve’haṃ necchāmi pāritoṣikam | namaste ca kṣamasvāpi rājā mānyaḥ prajājanaiḥ ||77|| ityuktvā bhaktarāṭ lakṣmi haridāso gṛhaṃ yayau | rājāhaṃ mama bhaktaṃ samparīkṣyaivaṃ tu pṛṣṭhagaḥ ||78|| padbhyāṃ tasya gṛhaṃ prāpto lokāścāścaryamāpnuvan | dadau sa
