bhaktarāṇmahyaṃ kāṣṭhāsanaṃ vivekataḥ ||79|| annaṃ jalaṃ śrīharaye’rpitaṃ dadāvadarśayat | pratimā me’samastāśca dhyānārthaṃ sa upāviśat ||3.214.80 || avigaṇayya me bhītiṃ dhairyaṃ dhṛtvā hareḥ śubham | samādhau hṛdaye magnastadāhaṃ hṛdaye’bhavam ||81 || rājarūpastathā lakṣmī rājñīrūpā yathāyatham | lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ māṃ ca jñātvā śīghraṃ samutthitaḥ ||82|| svāgataṃ daṇḍavaccāpi cakre pradakṣiṇaṃ tu mām | kīrtanaṃ sahasā cakre nanarta modavihvalaḥ ||83|| athānye tu janāstatra darśakā ye’bhavam̐stadā | sarve dṛṣṭvā mahāścaryaṃ śrutvā bhaktoditaṃ tathā ||84|| nārāyaṇo hi samrāṇme bhūtvā gṛhamupāgataḥ | lakṣmīrbhūtvā mahārājñī cāyayau bhāgyavānaham ||85|| aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ sutāragrāmavāsinām | aho bhāgyaṃ mama patnyāḥ śrīmānavyāḥ śubhottamam ||86|| kuṭumbasya ca me bhāgyaṃ bhṛtyānāṃ bhṛtyayoṣitām | bhāgyaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ tvadya yadgṛhe vallabhohariḥ ||87|| yadgṛhe śrīḥ samāyātā rājñīrūpā hareḥ priyā | śrīmānavyāḥ śreyase ca haridāsasya muktaye ||88|| aho pratimānirmātuḥ phalaṃ sākṣāddharirgṛhe | ātmaniveditālābhaścāho sākṣātprabhurgṛhe ||89|| kalā me sukalā jātā jīvanaṃ me sujīvanam | prāptaḥ sākṣānmayā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śriyā yutaḥ ||3.214.90|| śrutvaivaṃ janatāścāpi pupūjuḥ śrīpatiṃ nṛpam | daṇḍavat tāḥ pracakruśca bhaktaḥ papāta pādayoḥ ||91|| tāvallakṣmi mayā naijaṃ rūpaṃ caturbhujaṃ param | prakāśitaṃ tvayā lakṣmyā sākaṃ divyamanoharam ||92|| nadītaṭe tu yat sainyaṃ sarvaṃ tatra kṣaṇāntare | tattirobhāvitaṃ tatra mahāścaryaṃ tato’bhavat ||93|| gṛhe’haṃ bhagavān sākṣād datvā me darśanaṃ tataḥ | labdhvā pūjāṃ varadānaṃ mokṣārthaṃ sampradāya ca ||94|| prasannatāṃ samarpyaiva tatastūrṇaṃ tvayā saha | kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā jagādāhaṃ bhaktāya cātmavedine ||95|| yo māmevaṃ hi bhajate tatkṛte sarvathā tvaham | kalpalatāsamaścāsmi pūrayāmi manorathān ||96|| śilpino ye mama mūrtiṃ mama dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ | lobhasvārthavihīnāśca kariṣyanti śubhāśayāḥ ||97|| teṣāṃ mokṣaṃ kariṣyāmi yathā te bhaktarāḍiha | ityuktvā svasvarūpaṃ ca kṛṣṇe lakṣmyāṃ gṛhāntare ||98|| pūjanārthaṃ sthāpite ca sthāpitāyāṃ tirobhavam | atha bhakto’pi nityaṃ māṃ dhyāyati smarate tathā ||99 || kāle’prāpte vimānena tadgṛhaṃ samupasthitaḥ | śrīmānavīṃ striyaṃ tasya haridāsaṃ ca taṃ tathā || 3.214.10 0|| ārohayitvā divyau tau kṛtvānayaṃ mamākṣaram | anyān kālena tadvaccānayaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ mama || 101 || evaṃ lakṣmi mayā bhakto rathakāro hi tāritāḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhaved dhruvā ||1 02|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne haridāsākhyasya rathakārasya bhaktyā sakuṭumbasya bhagavatā mokṣaḥ kṛta ityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturdaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 214 ||
<3.215> puruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śilāhārakathāṃ tathā | nāmnā dāmaśilādau vai purā sudāmapattane || 1 || nyavasat sakuṭumbo’yaṃ khanyaśmavikrayodyamaḥ | śataśo vai janā bhṛtyā yatrodyamaṃ prakurvate || 2 || śilāstu mahatīrdīrghā niṣkāsayanti bhūstarāt | preṣayanti videśeṣu devarājālayārthikāḥ || 3 || śikharāṇi vicitrāṇi prāsādā bhinnajātayaḥ | śvetaśilāmayā divyāḥ śilpakalādiśobhitāḥ || 4 || jāyante śilpivaryāṇāṃ kalābhistacchilākṛtāḥ | pāṣāṇānāṃ hi khananaṃ divā tu khanibhūstare || 5 || satataṃ tadabhijñaistu kriyate dāmanoditaiḥ | draṣṭā dāmaśilādo vai pramātā mūlyakṛttathā || 6 || nirīkṣaṇaṃ yathākālaṃ kurute khanibhūstare | karmacārā yatante ca niṣkāsane’dhirohaṇe || 7 || śakṭyā gantrikāyāṃ ca bahusādhanasampadaḥ | tatra dāmaśilādo vai krayārthaṃ cāgatārthine || 8 || śilā dadāti mūlyena dāmnā yathocitāḥ śubhāḥ | mūrtiyogyā bahumūlyāḥ saudhayogyāstathāvidhāḥ || 9 || gṛhayogyā bhittiyogyāḥ starayogyāstathāparāḥ | vibhinnamūlyabhāvaiśca dadāti tāstadarthine || 3.215.1 0|| bhṛtyā dāmaśilādasya gantryāmārohayanti tāḥ | vṛṣabhairuṣṭrakairhastivaryaiśca geṇḍakaistathā ||1 1|| mahiṣairyantravayaiścākarṣayanti sugantrikāḥ | sarvatra rakṣaṇaṃ nārāyaṇo hi bhagavān svayam || 1 1|| karotyārohaṇe cāvarohaṇe ca prasāraṇe | utthāpane’pasaraṇe vivartane vidāraṇe ||13|| śatabhārāstatra kācit kācittato’dhigurviṇī | tadardhāśca tadardhāśca khanyante nityameva tāḥ ||14|| kvacicchilātibhāreṇa śakaṭī bhaṃgameti hi | śilātale hi śakaṭī cūrṇitā kaccarāyate ||15|| akasmādāpadādyāsu rakṣatyeva prabhurhariḥ | vicāryetthaṃ karmacārān dāmaśilāda uttamam ||16|| hare nārāyaṇa svāmin vallabha śrīpate hare | ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ ca raṭanaṃ hareḥ ||17|| upādideśa satataṃ rakṣaṇaṃ yena mokṣaṇam | svayaṃ karoti bhajanaṃ bhṛtyān prakārayatyapi ||18|| śilāsu kṛṣṇanāmāni guṇavanti nyayojayat | kṛṣṇaśilā rāmaśilā nārāyaṇaśilā tathā || 19|| lakṣmīśilā ramopalā rādhopalā haropalā | devopalā mandirāśmā mūrtyupalā satīśilā ||3.215.20|| viṣṇuśilā brahmaśilā parameśaśileti ca | devīśilā sūryaśilā tīrthaśilā gurūpalā ||21 || mokṣaśilā cātmaśilā muktiśileti vai tathā | avatāraśilā tadvad golokaprastarastathā ||22| vaikuṇṭhaśilā cakrāśmā śālagrāmaśilā tathā | bhagavatprastaraścāpi janārdanaśileti ca || 23|| yogaśilā jñānaśilā dhyānaśileti nāmabhiḥ | śilāvargāḥ kṛtāstena nārāyaṇaprasattaye ||24|| nārāyaṇaṃ raṭiṣyāmi śilāyogena mānavāḥ | śubhanāma grahīṣyanti pāpanāśakamuttamam ||25|| ityabhipretya nāmāni hareḥ suyojitāni vai | tena dāmaśilādena śilāsu mokṣadāni hi ||26|| mānavā api gṛhṇanti śilāvyājena śārṅgiṇaḥ | nāmāni bhṛtyavargāśca śreṣṭhinaḥ pāvanāni vai ||27|| evaṃ bhaktena sadbhaktiḥ kāritā kīrtanātmikā | pāvitāśca narā nāryaḥ prākṛtā api nāmabhiḥ || 28|| puṇyaṃ mahattamaṃ tasya jātaṃ prasannatātmakam | mamānugraharūpaṃ vai vardhate’pi nirantaram ||29|| bhaktabhaktiṃ samākarṇya tadgṛhaṃ mānavā rame | santo bhaktāḥ samāyānti dhārmikā yātribhikṣukāḥ ||3.215.30|| militvā te prakurvanti bhajanaṃ mama kīrtanam | śilājanyāṃ mama mūrtiṃ sampratiṣṭhāpya vai gṛhe ||31|| pūjayanti sadā bhāvairmahotsavaiḥ suvastubhiḥ | gāyanaṃ nartanaṃ gītiṃ kurvanti rāsamagrataḥ ||32|| dhūpadīpādikaṃ cāpi naivedyaṃ ca jalaṃ ca me | samarpya matprasādaṃ te gṛhṇanti ca viyanti ca ||33|| evaṃ satsaṃgasaṃgho vai dāmaśilādamandire | puṣṭiṃ prāptastadā lakṣmi prasanno’haṃ viśeṣataḥ ||34|| abhavaṃ ca pratimāyāṃ vartamāno nirantaram | kṛtāṃ sevāṃ ca gṛhṇāmi rakṣāṃ karomi sarvathā ||35|| athaikadā gṛhe bhaktaścāsīd bhṛtyāstu vai khanau | krośadūre’bhavan sarve śilāniṣkāsane ratāḥ ||36|| dīrghā mahopalā taiśca niṣkāsitā bahiḥ kṛtā | āropitā śakaṭyāṃ ca bhagnā sā śakaṭī drutam ||37|| śakaṭīpārśvagā bhṛtyāḥ karmacārāstu ye’bhavan | teṣu dvitrāḥ śakaṭyāṃ vai kaccaritāḥ śilātale ||38|| hāhā śokastadā tatra vyajāyata janeṣu vai | jalaṃ kaccaritāḥ pātuṃ prārthayāmāsureva te ||39|| dadurvāri tato mūrchāṃ prāpuste maraṇonmukhāḥ | athānye sasmarurnārāyaṇaṃ māṃ rakṣakaṃ prabhum ||3.215.40|| prayatna sahasā cakrarbhārākrāntāvanāya te | śakaṭīṃ ca śilāṃ cāpyuttolya sambhūya mānavaiḥ ||41 || niṣkāsitāḥ kaccaritā dvitrāste karmacāriṇaḥ | abhānā gatabhānāste mṛtyūnmukhāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ ||42||| vartante tāvadevāpi karmacārairniveditaḥ | bhakto dāmaśilādo vai gṛhe gatvā tu satvaram ||3|| āyayau sa khaniṃ yāvat smṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ hi mām | tāvadahaṃ sādhuveṣo’ṭavītaścāyayau khanim ||44|| bhojanārthaṃ bhikṣukaḥ san jalārthaṃ bhikṣayan jalam | vilokya tān kaccaritānāścaryaparamo’bhavam||45|| stabdho’bhavaṃ kṣaṇaṃ te tu prārthayāmāsuracyutam | hare kṛṣṇa dīnabandho samujjīvaya dīnanṝn ||46|| manuṣyahatyā bhaktasya yathā na syāt prarakṣaya | raṃkarakṣāvidhātā tvaṃ bhaktecchāpūrako bhavān ||47|| sarvaduḥkhaprahātā tvaṃ prarakṣaya nijāñjanān| nātrauṣadhaṃ bhavecchaktamasthikaccaracūrṇite ||48|| dehe raktātirikte’tra vinā tvāṃ jīvanaṃ nahi | camatkāraṃ vinā siddhiṃ vinā naiṣāṃ hi jīvanam ||49|| mṛtaprāyā mṛgāśceme nānyastvāṃ yoginaṃ vinā | navīkartuṃ samīkartuṃ sandhiṃ kartuṃ kṣamo’paraḥ ||3.215.50||| ityevaṃ vadamānānāṃ śṛṇvan sādhurjalaṃ kare | samādāya dadau tebhyo mukhe tvācamanīyakam ||51|| rakṣāṃ nidhāya kukṣisthaṃ bhasma dhṛtvā karadvaye | mardayāmāsa bhagnānāṃ deheṣvabhita ādarāt ||52|| tāvatte svasthatāṃ prāptāḥ sandhitā nīrujīkṛtāḥ | raktapūrṇā abhavam̐śca yathāpūrvaṃ tathaiva te | |53|| utthitāḥ svapnato yadvat praṇemuḥ sādhuyoginam | jīvanaṃ prāpya viśrāntiṃ lebhuḥ kṣaṇaṃ sataḥ puraḥ ||54|| sādhurbhikṣāṃ jagṛhe ca jalānnaṃ bubhuje tataḥ | te’pi sarve prasādaṃ ca samyag bubhujire mama ||55|| atha śāntyā niṣeduste sevamānāḥ padāmbuje | papracchurmāṃ pāpanāśakaraṃ sādhanamuttamam ||56|| nārāyaṇasya vijñānaṃ mūrtirūpaṃ tathottamam | ahaṃ vai kathayāmāsa sarvaṃ tebhyo yathātatham ||57|| satāṃ sevā harerbhaktistīrthānāṃ sevanaṃ tathā | pāpanāśakarāṇyeva bhavanti bhagavatkṛpā ||58|| satāṃ samāgamenaiva vijñānaṃ śrīharerbhavet | sacchāstrāṇāṃ śīlanena kathāyāḥ śravaṇena ca ||59|| pūrvasaṃskārabalato vijñānaṃ jāyate hareḥ | yogābhyāsena sahasā kalmaṣāṇāṃ vināśane ||3.215.60 || yogigatyā brahmagatyā kṛṣṇamūrtiḥ prakāśate | piṇḍe’sti ghaṭanā ramyā yādṛśī tādṛśī punaḥ ||61 || vairāje vartate cāpi sūkṣmā sthūletyabhedataḥ | dehe tu mānave nāḍyo brahmāṇḍe nadikāstu tāḥ ||62||| dehe tu kukṣayaḥ santi brahmāṇḍe cābdhayastu te | pādamūlaṃ tu pātālaṃ mūrdhā satyaṃ kaṭirhi bhūḥ ||63|| dehasthendriyanāḍīnāṃ vairājendriyanāḍikāḥ | kāraṇāni tataścaikyabhāvā bhavanti tā imāḥ ||64|| yogābhyāsaratā jihvāprāntaṃ yānti samādhinā | tadā vairājajihvāyā antaṃ paśyanti yoginaḥ | |65|| evaṃ sarvendriyāṇāṃ tu prāntaṃ yānti samādhinā | tadā vairājendriyāṇāmantaṃ paśyanti yoginaḥ ||66|| suṣumṇā vartate madhye dehe’tra nābhimūrdhvagā | vāme ceḍā piṃgalā tu dakṣe sthitā sadāsti vai ||67|| suṣumṇāntaṃ tu mūrdhānaṃ gatvā vairājamīkṣate | sā tu dīrghā brahmarandhrād vairājaṃ yogamṛcchati ||68|| tejaḥkiraṇarūpā vai vairājātpuruṣāvadhim | mahāpuruṣarandhrāt sā tejaḥkiraṇasaṃjñitā ||69|| akṣareṇa ca tādātmyaṃ gatā tato harau hi sā | pramātādātmyamāpannā vidyate kiraṇātmikā | ataḥ suṣumṇāmārgeṇa yogī yāti paraṃ padam ||3.215.70|| hareḥ kiraṇaṃ niryan syāt sarvāvatāramantagam | īśvareṣu ca jīveṣu vartate vyāpakaṃ hi tat | tadbrahma tacca vijñānaṃ sattvaṃ prakāśa eva tat ||71 || tasya bhāsā sarvamidaṃ vibhāti jñānadīptimat | snehātiśayataścaivaṃvidaḥ prabhā vivardhate |||72|| jāgrati vā svāpake vā suṣuptau vā yadā yadā | harau syāllīnatā yasya snehena tatra taṃ vrajet ||73 || saṃkalpena hareścāpi śaktyā cāpi harestathā | jñānaśaktyā kriyāśaktyā cecchāśaktyā harestathā ||74|| jīveśāḥ sampravartante jānantaḥ kriyayānvitāḥ | karmavaśā sarvajīvāḥ svatantrā nahi santi vai ||75|| harerjñānakriyecchābhiḥ kriyecchājñāninaḥ khalu | phalapradātā bhagavān karmaṇāmasti sarvathā ||76|| harestāḥ śaktayo nṝṇāṃ svasvakarmānusārataḥ | jñānādīn prerayantyeva tena sṛṣṭiḥ pravartate ||77|| sṛṣṭerjīvā harau dhyānābhyāsād divyā bhavanti vai | divyadṛṣṭaya evāpi tadā brahmasudarśanam ||78|| māyāguṇādiśūnyaṃ tannirguṇaṃ brahma taijasam | nijairdivyaguṇairyuktaṃ saguṇaṃ brahma śāśvatam ||79|| pareśaṃ paramātmānaṃ parabrahma sanātanam | prāpnuvanti mahātmānaḥ satāṃ satsaṃgasatphalāḥ ||3.215.8 0|| narākāraṃ divyamūrtiṃ śrīpatiṃ taṃ satāṃ patim | divyamūrtiṃ parātmānaṃ yānti tadyoginastvime ||81|| divyatāṃ yānti bahavastatsamā brahmarūpiṇaḥ | yathā brahmapriyā divyā yathā muktā hyasaṃkhyakāḥ ||82|| yathā lakṣmīryathā rādhā yathā satī sarasvatī | tathā divyā bhavantyeva narā nāryaḥ parātmagāḥ ||83|| tasmānnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo bhajanīyo hi rakṣakaḥ | mokṣadaḥ svargadaścāpi suṣumṇāmārgalabdhimān ||84|| khanau nārāyaṇo nityaṃ smaraṇīyo janārdanaḥ | satāṃ mūrtau hariścāste sevanīyaḥ satāṃ gatiḥ ||85|| ityuktvā nirbhayān kṛtvā dadau mantraṃ tadā tvaham | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||86|| atha te māṃ guruṃ matvā lakṣmi nijālayaṃ prati | ninyuḥ sādhusvarūpaṃ māṃ camatkārijanaṃ gurum ||87|| bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ pāyayāmāsuriṣṭakam | pāyasaṃ śarkarāyuktaṃ sevayāmāsurādarāt ||88|| pūjayāmāsurevāpi kṣamāṃ yayācire tataḥ | pādāmṛtajalaṃ me te papurmayāpi vai tadā ||89|| āśīrvādairyojitāśca kṛpayā bhaktigocarāḥ | bhuktirmuktirbhavatāṃ vai yatheṣṭā jāyatāṃ sadā ||3.215.90|| athāhamabhavaṃ lakṣmi jigamiṣustadā tu te | kṛṣṇapratyakṣalābhārthaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanalālasaḥ ||91|| yayācire mayā tathāstviti tatra niyojitāḥ | apaśyan māṃ śaṃkhacakragadābjadhāriṇaṃ harim ||92|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptāḥ pratyakṣayogino yathā | divyā divyasvarūpāste vyajāyanta tadā drutam ||93|| nanṛtuśca jaguścāpi mumuduścātiharṣulāḥ | pupūjurmāṃ parabrahma rakṣakaṃ prāṇarakṣakam ||94|| athāhaṃ tatra mūrtau me tiro’bhavaṃ hi paśyatām | teṣāṃ tadā samārabhya te’pi mūrtiniṣeviṇaḥ | |95| | sarvathātmanivedāścābhavan bhaktāḥ sahasraśaḥ | atha kāle samāyāte bhaktaṃ dāmaśilādakam ||96|| tasya bhṛtyān bahūn bhaktān tathā patnīṃ kalābhidhām | vimānenānayaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ me śāśvataṃ param ||97|| evaṃ lakṣmi mayā rakṣā kṛtā bhaktiśca kāritā | jñānaṃ dattaṃ ca sāmarthyaṃ muktiścāpi kṛtā śubhā ||98|| evaṃ madīyabhaktānāṃ prānte mokṣaṃ karomyaham | dadāmi divyatāṃ cāpi bhaktyā sādhyo yato’smyaham ||99|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāt stavanādapi | bhuktirmuktirbhavatyeva tatheṣṭā śubhadā gatiḥ | vallabhaḥ śrīguruḥ svāmī prabhuḥ sarvagatistvaham ||3.215.1 00|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne śilāhārasya dāmaśilādanāmakabhaktasya bhṛtyānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ dāmaśilādādeścānte mokṣaṇaṃ ca bhagavatā kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 215 ||
<3.216> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śilpakalāvidaḥ kathām | nāmnā sañjayadevasya mama bhaktasya śobhanām || 1 || kutarkapuravāso’bhūd bhakto nārāyaṇe mayi | kuṭumbasahito nityaṃ bhajate māṃ śriyaḥ patim || 2 || bahudhā śilpinaṃ vetti kāṣṭhapāṣāṇadhātujam || vṛkṣavallīstabakādi devarṣimānavādi ca || 3 || paśupakṣisarpakīṭādi ca tattvādikaṃ tathā | sarvavidhaṃ kalayā sa vijānāti yathāyatham || 4 || sarvavidhe śilpane sañjayadevo hariṃ tu mām | likhatyevāntare sūkṣmaṃ sūkṣmamūrtisvarūpiṇam | | 5 || yathānye naiva jānīyustathā vai nāntarīyakam | śilpe cāntaraśilpaṃ ca tadantare tu māṃ śubham || 6 || vidadhāti smaran māṃ sa sabījaṃ śilpinaṃ yataḥ | divyaṃ bhavati śrīkṛṣṇārpitaṃ kṛṣṇasuyogavat || 7 || evaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ bhaktaḥ karoti manmayaṃ sadā | sarvaṃ madātmakaṃ śilpaṃ saphalodyamaśobhitam || 8 || bhakto nijāntare bhaktiṃ manute tatkalātmikām | yatra nārāyaṇaścāhaṃ nirmītaḥ saṃbhavāmi ha || 9 || śilpakalāsu sarvāsu māṃ ca nārāyaṇaṃ harim | caṣṭe dhyāyati kurute namati pūjayatyapi || 3.216.10 || prātarnityaṃ samutthāya dhyātvārhaṇaṃ karoti me | mūrteḥ pañcāmṛtasnānaṃ tīrthasnānaṃ tathārghyakam || 1 1|| bhūṣāśṛṃgārāmbarāṇi samarpayanti me sadā | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ jalaṃ tathā || 12|| sugandhitailasāraṃ ca mahārhāsanamañcakam | samarpayati natvā me kṛtvā ca daṇḍavat stavam || 1 3|| nityamarthayati śreyaścaihikaṃ pāralaukikam | satāṃ samāgamaṃ kṛṣṇasevāṃ śrīkṛṣṇakīrtanam || 14|| karoti sañjayo nityaṃ keśavatyā svayoṣitā | putreṇa suradevena sākaṃ gṛhe niśāmukhe || 15|| nṛtyaṃ ca gāyanaṃ kṛṣṇacamatkārakathāśravam | karoti śubhanaivedyaṃ prasādasya pradānakam || 16|| bhuktvā prāsādikaṃ paścādudyoge vartate sadā | evaṃ sañjayadevo me bhaktiniṣṭho hi vartate || 17|| tasyājñāyāṃ śilpino’nye vartante karmacāriṇaḥ | te’pi sañjayayogena bhajante parameśvaram || 18|| athaikadā nṛpo nāmnā khaḍgavarmā vihārarāṭ | svasya nūtanasaudhasya nirmityai taṃ samāhvayat || 19|| sāptabhaumasya kakṣāsu koṇe koṇe sthale sthale | yāvatprasiddhajātīnāṃ puttalīsthāpanāya tu ||3.216.20 || ājñāṃ cakāra nṛpatirdhanavyaye’pyudāratām | pradarśayan dadānaśca toṣayan karmaśilpinaḥ ||21 || bhakto’yaṃ nṛpaterājñāṃ svīcakārātimodavān | śubhekṣaṇekṣitiṃ yogyavidhinā saṃprapūjya saḥ ||22|| khanitvā maṃgalaṃ tatra nṛpahastena saṃvyadhāt | prāsādaḥ saptabhaumo vai sampannaścendrasaudhavat ||23|| sthale sthale puttalāni prātiṣṭhipanmahāntyapi | ramyāṇi ca vicitrāṇi saumyamanoharāṇi ca ||24|| nārāyaṇasya kṛṣṇasya rādhāyāśca śriyāstathā | sarasvatyāśca lakṣmyāśca māṇikyā brahmayoṣitām ||25||| śrīhareravatārāṇāmīśvarāṇāṃ śubhānyapi | īśvarīṇāṃ pratimāśca maharṣisurayoginām ||26|| devīnāṃ devatānāṃ ca mānavānāṃ ca pakṣiṇām | paśūnāṃ vanyajātīnāṃ grāmīṇānāṃ ca dehinām ||27|| pāvanānāṃ maṃgalānāṃ khyātānāṃ pratimāstathā | udbhijjānāṃ suramyāṇāṃ dṛśyāni saritāṃ tathā ||28|| parvatānāṃ grahāṇāṃ ca vidyutāṃ vyomacāriṇām | meghānāṃ ca samudrāṇāṃ dṛśyānyapi vyadarśayat ||29|| evaṃvidhaṃ mahāsaudhaṃ racayitvā sthale sthale | sūkṣmaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ māṃ sa samasthāpayadacyutam ||3.216.30|| prasannamānaso bhakto vāstuṃ tasya nyavedayata | rājā viprān samāhūya vāstupūjāmakārayat ||3 1|| havanāni bhojanāni pūjanāni hyakārayat | dānāni dakṣiṇāḥ pāritoṣikāṇi dadau nṛpaḥ ||32|| śilpine svarṇaśṛṃgārairalaṃkṛtaṃ gajaṃ dadau | grāmāṇāṃ pañcakaṃ cāpi dāsān dāsīstathā dadau || 3 3|| śilpibhyaśca yathāyogyadhanādīni nṛpo dadau | athālaṅkṛtahastīndraṃ samāruhya gṛhaṃ nijam || 34|| yāvat sañjayadevastu prayāti tāvadeva tu | mārge gajaḥ pramatto’timadāviṣṭo’bhavad drutam ||35|| apradhṛṣyaścātibalo vicittonmattasañcaraḥ | aśāsanīyo’pyabhavanmahāvibhrama udvrataḥ ||36|| hastipakāniyamyaścāgamyo bhītikarastathā | mahābṛṃhaṇakartā ca mahāvegadravānvitaḥ ||37|| dhāvamāno’niyamito dudrāvotpathasañcaraḥ | mānavā dudruvurbhītāḥ prāṇarakṣārthameva ha ||38|| na ke’pi tatra tiṣṭhanti yatra yāti hi vāraṇaḥ | ambālikā sakūthā ca vivṛtā patitā kṣitau ||39|| patitaḥ sañjayaścāpi hastipakaḥ papāta ca | gajaḥ sañjayadevaṃ me bhaktaṃ nigṛhya śuṇḍayā ||3.216.40 || dūre cikṣepa sahasā bhaktaḥ papāta khātake | khātamadhye hyaniḥsāre pātapīḍātimūrchitaḥ ||41|| sasmāra māṃ hariṃ tatra hṛdaye bhaktarakṣakam | gajo dūraṃ gato yāvattataḥ khātaṃ tu mānavāḥ |||42|| āyayustasya vīkṣārthaṃ rakṣārthaṃ parito janāḥ | tatpūrvaṃ tu tadā lakṣmi bhaktapārśvaṃ gato’bhavam |||43||| hastābhyāṃ saṃspṛśam̐staṃ ca mūrchāṃ pīḍāmanāśayam | darśanaṃ me dadau tasmai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakam ||44|| haste dhṛtvā bahistaṃ cāniṣkāsayaṃ tu gartataḥ | svastho bhakto virogaśca bādhāpīḍāvivarjitaḥ ||45|| bhajanyāṃ ca rahan māṃ ca mohamāno hi mānavān | jagāda bhagavānatrāgato me rakṣaṇāya vai ||46|| tatkārābhyāṃ nīrujo’haṃ vipīḍo’tra bhavāmi ha | evaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ sarve bhajantāṃ parameśvaram ||47|| ityuktvādarśayat sarvānaṅgulyā māṃ puraḥsthitam | viprarūpadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tejovyāptasuvigraham ||48|| praṇemuste hariṃ māṃ ca divya mānavavigraham | kalyāṇaṃ prārthayāñcakruścopādideśa cāpyaham ||49|| kalyāṇaṃ jāyate kṛṣṇabhaktyā satāṃ prasevayā | sarvamityarthakartavyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaprītihetukam ||3.216.50|| satāṃ prasannatā labhyā guṇā labhyāḥ satāṃ tathā | devādhikāḥ sadā santo mānyā mumukṣubhiḥ śubhāḥ ||51 || viṣṇuvaccārcanīyāste sevanīyāśca viṣṇuvat | satāmājñā pālanīyā vacodhāryaṃ ca mānase |||52|| vartitavyaṃ ca niśchadma satāmagre tu dāsavat | kṛṣṇatulyān sato dṛṣṭvā namanīyaṃ tadagrataḥ ||||53||| mantavyaṃ hṛdaye naije santaḥ śrīkṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ | mahāntaste samarthāśca divyāḥ sarvātmanā śubhāḥ ||54|| pāvanāḥ śrīkṛṣṇarūpā vikriyāvarjitāḥ parāḥ | māyāpāragatāḥ santi māyāyāmahamasmi ca ||55|| mama māyāvilopo vai satsevayā bhaviṣyati | pāmarasya mama sarvāṇyaghānyeṣyanti saṃkṣayam || 56|| evaṃ satāṃ guṇagrāhī guṇasindhurbhavediha | ye tu loke duṣṭajanā nindanti sādhuyoginaḥ |||57|| kathayanti mitho nindāṃ satāṃ cāguṇavarṇanām | yatheme sādhavaḥ santi vivekavarjitāḥ khalu ||58|| loke sthātuṃ na jānanti bhoktuṃ pātuṃ ca bhāṣitum | paridhātuṃ ca vasanaṃ dātuṃ jānanti naiva ca ||59|| kartuṃ cābhyāgatasya svāgataṃ vidanti naiva ca | mahattvaṃ khyāpayituṃ svaṃ yatante copadeśadāḥ ||3.216.60 || kāmo lobho ratiḥ krodho vidyante’sya yathā mama | nāyaṃ sādhurmṛṣā sādhurevaṃ gṛhṇanti dūṣaṇam ||61 || etādṛśāścarmanetrā nirayālayabhoginaḥ | duḥkhino’tra prajāyante mṛtvā yāmyādhikāriṇaḥ ||62|| kadāpi te na jāyante guṇino mokṣasanmukhāḥ | āsurāste tu vijñeyāḥ satāṃ drohakarāstviha ||63|| yūyaṃ śilpakalājñā vai sañjayo’yaṃ viśeṣataḥ | yāvatkalāsu mūrtiṃ me dhārayatyeva sarvathā ||64|| tatra sarvatra bhaktirme bhavatyasya ca vastayā | tādṛśībhaktiyogena viprarūpī janārdanaḥ ||65|| samāyāto’smi rakṣākṛt prasannaḥ sevayā mama | sataḥ saṃsevya ca hariṃ yāntu mokṣaṃ paraṃ padam ||66|| kṛṣṇārcā kṛṣṇavat pūjyā mānyā sevyā ca kṛṣṇavat | santastathaiva sampūjyāḥ mānyāḥ sevyāśca kṛṣṇavat ||67|| kṛṣṇo mahāntaḥ santaśca sarvaiśvaryādisaṃbhṛtāḥ | sarvarakṣākarāḥ santi sarvagāḥ śaktiśālinaḥ ||68 || parakāyaṃ praviśanti rakṣantyāpadvipattitaḥ | kṛṣṇo mūrtiṃ samāviśya vartate rakṣaṇāya vai ||69|| mūrtau nijecchayā sākṣāt praviśyaiva virājate | sākṣānme tu yathā tadvanmaryādā sarvathā sadā ||3.216.70|| mūrteragre satāmagre pālanīyā hi gauravāt | satāṃ hṛdaye sākṣādvai svayamāviśya sarvathā ||71 || varte’haṃ vai tato nityaṃ sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ | maryādā pālanīyā vai satāṃ mūrteśca me samām ||72|| ye tu matvā hi pāṣāṇaṃ mūrtiṃ satastu mānavān | prākṛtān sādhupuruṣān matvā nindanti nāstikāḥ ||73|| mama vacāṃsi sādhūnāṃ vacāṃsi mokṣadānyapi | mānayanti mṛṣā nirarthakāni te tu māyikā ||74|| nindakāḥ pāpino yāsyantyeva duḥkhaṃ tu nārakam | teṣāṃ cātmaparātmādivijñānaṃ naiva jāyate ||75|| kṛṣṇasya niścayo naiva jāyate mūrtigasya me | kalyāṇaṃ tādṛśānāṃ vai naiva bhavati naiva hi ||76|| daurmatyaṃ khalu teṣāṃ tu mūrtāveveti naiva ca | kintu satsu tathā tadvat sveṣṭadeveṣu tādṛśam ||77|| anīśatvādināstikyaṃ jāyate bahupāpinām | īśvarānavatārām̐śca manvate naiva sarvathā ||78|| golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ śrīpuraṃ cākṣaraṃ padam | brahmapadaṃ ca vibhavān manvate naiva te khalāḥ ||79|| khalānāṃ samprasaṃgena jāyate khalatā tathā | pūrvapāpādiyogena jāyate khalatā hyapi ||3.216.80|| nāstikānāṃ vacobhiśca kathābhiḥ saṃgatastathā | kāmakrodhābhimānādyairdoṣaiśca khalatā bhavet ||81 || khalasya hṛdaye bhāvo na tiṣṭhate satāṃ hareḥ | tasmāt kharāditulyasya khalasya saṃgamaḥ kvacit ||82|| vartavyo naiva loke’tra mumukṣubhistu mānavaiḥ | śrotavyā sukathā divyā divyabodhapradā hareḥ ||83|| satāṃ kathā divyalīlā śrotavyā sevakaiḥ sadā | kartavyaḥ saṃgamaścāpi satāṃ nārāyaṇasya ca ||84|| divyatā ca satāṃ bodhyā bodhyā mūtau sthitirmama | vijñeyaṃ mama māhātmyaṃ satāṃ bodhyaṃ ca mādṛśam ||85|| evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya rakṣāṃ karomi sarvathā | yathā rakṣā kṛtā garte sañjayasya mayā tviha ||8 || mūrtau sthitvā parāṃ rakṣāṃ kariṣye māṃ bhajantviti | sarvajīveṣu kṛṣṇo’haṃ nivasāmītyahiṃsayā ||87|| sarvathā vartitavyaṃ me bhaktairdayāparairiha | adroho balavān dharmaḥ prīṇanaṃ dharma uttamaḥ ||88|| sarvasvārpaṇabhāvaiśca prīṇayenna tu hiṃsayet | kāyena vācā manasā kriyayā sevayāpi ca ||89|| prīṇayenmāṃ sataścāpi svargaṃ mokṣaṃ labhettataḥ | krodhāhaṃkāramānādyā doṣā varjyā hi hiṃsakāḥ || 3.216.90|| śāntatayā sadā stheyaṃ bhajanīyo janārdanaḥ | bhajanīyāḥ sādhavaśca bhagavatpādasadrasāḥ ||91|| ityuktvā mama bhaktebhyo datvā mantraṃ madāśrayam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |||92|| bhaktakṛtāṃ prapūjāṃ saṅgṛhya tiro’bhavaṃ drutam | gajastu rājapuruṣairdhṛtaścātiprayatnakaiḥ ||93|| śamitaścopacāraiśca sañjayāya tato daduḥ | atha smṛddhaṃ mama bhaktaṃ pūrṇāyuṣye’hamacyutaḥ ||94|| lakṣmi mokṣapradānārthaṃ pratyakṣastadgṛhe’gamam | hastiyāne tu bhaktaṃ taṃ samādāya tathāparān | |95|| pradarśya divyatāṃ me cānayaṃ pattīyutaṃ drutam | dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ divyaṃ tathāparān suśilpinaḥ | |96|| aprāpayaṃ paraṃ dhāma narānnārīśca bhāvukīḥ | evaṃ rakṣā mayā lakṣmi kṛtā garte ca hastitaḥ ||97|| mama mūrtiṃ śilpavidaḥ kurvanti pūjayanti mām | divyabhāvāstu te bhaktyā yānti me paramaṃ padam ||98|| yādṛśīṣu tādṛśīṣu śālagrāma śilāsvaham | satsu satīṣu sādhvīṣu yogiṣvapi vasāmyaham ||99|| sarvatrāvasthitaścāsmi pratiṣṭhāpitamūrtiṣu | viśeṣataḥ sthitaścāsmi bhaktamānasapūrakaḥ ||3.216.1 0 0|| yatra mama nivāso’sti kāṣṭhe kuḍye śilātale | sarvaṃ divyaṃ bhavatyeva divyasya me prasaṃgataḥ || 101 || māyā divyā mama yogānnārī naro drumādayaḥ | mama yogena divyāste jāyante mokṣadāḥ sadā | | 1 02|| doṣā guṇāḥ prajāyante jaḍāni cetanāni vai | mama yogena divyāni jāyante yāni kānyapi ||1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne śilpakarasya sañjayadevasya bhaktyā bhagavatā gajato rakṣaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣoḍaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 216 ||
<3.217> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ citrakṛtaḥ śubhām | nāmnā saṃbharadevasya mama bhaktasya pāvanīm || 1 || nimbakāle mahāgrāme saurāṣṭre sakuṭumbakaḥ | bhaktaḥ saṃbharadevākhyaścitrakalāviśāradaḥ || 2 || abhavat sarvacitrāṇāṃ svatantro rūpadhāyakaḥ | yathābhāvo mānavasya paśorvā pakṣiṇe’pi ca || 3 || kīṭānāṃ vṛkṣavallīnāṃ tattvānāṃ bhūjalādijaḥ | rūpaṃ raṅgaḥ svabhāvaśca dṛśyatā ca kriyā yathā || 4 || yathā prabhā yathā hāsyaṃ ceṣṭāvasthā yathā tathā | sarva citreṣu sahasā lekhinyā darśayatyatha | | 5 || paṭeṣu cāpi kuḍyeṣu nāṭakeṣu ca mūrtiṣu | prāsādeṣu mandireṣu saudhakakṣāsu sarvathā || 6 || kāgadeṣu ca kāṣṭheṣu puttaleṣu samastataḥ | prākṛtān guṇabhāvān sa prodbhāvayati citrakṛt || 7 || evaṃvidhakalāyukto bhajate māṃ nirantaram | sarvacitreṣu vai sūkṣmaṃ mama rūpaṃ karoti ca || 8 || sūkṣmātisūkṣmaṃ kṛtvā svaṃ kṛtakṛtyaṃ sa vetti vai | yatra citre harirnāsti taccitraṃ niṣphalakriyam || 9 || yatra citre harermūrtiścitra tat saphalakriyam | evaṃ kriyāpi tasyābhūt sadā śrīkṛṣṇamiśritā || 3.217.1 0|| vṛttiścitramayī kṛṣṇamayī tasyābhavat sadā | svapne’pi citrakaraṇe bhāsate śrīpatiḥ prabhuḥ || 11 || prātarutthāya me nāma gṛhṇāti he narāyaṇa | rādhākṛṣṇa harikṛṣṇa śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇa || 12| evaṃ smṛtvā raṭitvātha snātvā pūjayati prabhum | sarvalabdhopacāraiśca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ dadāti ca || 1 3|| naivedyaṃ daṇḍavad vāri nīrājanaṃ pradakṣiṇam | samarpya ca kṣamāṃ prārthya bhuktvā prasādamuttamam || 14|| citraśālāṃ prayātyeva karoti citralekhanam | anye’pi bahavastatra citrakṛto bhavanti ca || 15|| karmacārāsta evāpi bhajanti bhaktasaṃgataḥ | māmeva paramātmānaṃ śrīnāthaṃ kambharātmajam || 1 6|| gopālabālakaṃ brahmapriyeśaṃ māṇikīpatim | avatārapatiṃ muktapatiṃ duḥkhavināśakam || 17|| rātrau militvā sarve te kīrtayanti ramāpatim | nṛtyanti purato mūrtergāyanti gītikāstathā || 18 || tadā saṃbharadevo’pi bhaktamaṇḍalanoditaḥ | karoti varṇanaṃ mūrteḥ śrīkṛṣṇadhyānalabdhaye || 1 9|| śṛṇvantu citrakārā me bhāsate hṛdaye hariḥ | yathādṛṣṭaṃ varṇayāmi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ||3.217.20 || akṣareśaṃ brahmapriyāpatiṃ divyanarākṛtim | tejaḥparidhisaṃvyāptaṃ koṭikoṭyarkatejasam ||21 || sudhāsrāvisamastasatkaraṇairabhikāśitam | sapādapañcaṣaṣṭyaṃgulordhvaṃ suvarṇakeśinam ||22|| hiraṇyaśmaśruhiraṇyamūrtisarvasuvarṇakam | prasannahāsyavadanaṃ lambagolānanaṃ prabhum ||23 || ākarṇāyatanetraṃ ca koṭikāmabhraśobhanam | premasaṃbhṛtacakṣuṣkaṃ divyāparokṣadarśanam ||24|| viśālonnatabhālaṃ ca madhyoparitilānvitam | dakṣalalāṭaromordhvasīmasthitatilānvitam ||25|| dakṣabhālordhvakoṇe ca vāmabhālordhvakoṇake | samakṛṣṇatilaśobhilalāṭakojjvalam || 26 || vāmabhālordhvakeśāptasīmasūkṣmatiladvayam | vāmanetrāntanimnaśrīkapole tiladhāriṇam || 27|| dakṣakapolake sūkṣmatilacatuṣṭayānvitam | dvayośca karṇayorūrdhve sūkṣmaikaikatilānvitam ||28|| tilapuṣpasamanāsaṃ divyanetraṃ manoharam | lambaśaṣkulikātulyakarṇadvayavirājitam || 29 || sūkṣmadhavalakāntyāḍhyakundavaddantaśobhitam | pakvaraktabimbaphalabhāsauṣṭhadvayarājitam || 3.217.30 || puṣṭamukhaṃ sucibukaṃ sūkṣmapiṃgalakeśinam | bhāle kaisaratilakam madhyakuṃkumacandrakam || 31 || ubhaprāntāntasaṃvyāptadīrgharekhāḍhyabhālakam | ardhacandrasamarekhāmadhyabhālavirājitam ||32 || vāmagale sūkṣmatilo jatrūpari virājate | kaṇṭhakūpe kṛṣṇatilaḥ subhagaḥ saṃvirājate || 33 || jihvā raktasthalapadmanibhā sarasvatīśritā | kaṇṭhakūpādadhobhāgeṃ’gulanimne tilo’sti ca || 34|| dakṣaskandhe svalpatilastadadhaścāparastilaḥ | tadadhaśca bhujāyāṃ vai tilastṛtīya ityapi || 35|| tadadhaśca caturtho’pi vartate ca śubhastilaḥ | bhujāyāṃ sannidhau cāpi pañcamo vartate tilaḥ | kaphoṇikoparibhāge bhujāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhakastilaḥ || 36 || kaphoṇikāyāḥ sandhau ca sūkṣmasattilapañcakam | kaphoṇikopari pṛṣṭhabhāge tilaśca vartate | karanālyāṃ tilaḥ sūkṣmaḥ karabhe sutilo’sti ca || 37|| laḍḍukaṣaṭkguccho’sti karapṛṣṭhe tu śobhanaḥ | karatalematsyadhanurdhvajaśūlaśarāstathā || 38 || svasticakrarekhikāśca santi raktāḥ śaśiprabhe | aṃgulyaḥ komalāḥ santi raktonnatanakhānvitāḥ || 39 || romāvalyaḥ subhagāśca svarṇavarṇāḥ prabhānti tāḥ | madhyāṃgulyagre śaṃkho’sti cakrāṇi tu catusvapi ||3.217.40 || tarjanyāṃ yavarekhāsti hastaścandrojjvalo’sti ca | vāmaskandhe jatrumūle śyāmacihnaṃ suśobhate |||41 || tadadho vartate sūkṣmatilatrayaṃ bhujāntike | skandhapṛṣṭhe tilaścāste raktavarṇaḥ susūkṣmakaḥ ||42 || vāmodare nalapārśve tilaścaikaḥ praśobhate | nābhirnimnā gabhīrā codaramujjvalamityapi ||43 || nābhau trivallyo dyotante samodaraṃ praśobhate | udarasya dakṣapārśve tilatrayaṃ praśobhate ||44|| dakṣapṛṣṭhe tilaikaśca dakṣakukṣau tiladvayam | stanacihne śyāmavarṇe saromṇiśobhayā yute ||45 || śrīvatsacihnasahitaṃ vakṣo viśālamunnatam | vakṣo’dho vartate sūkṣmatilaḥ va samodaropari |||46 || vāmabhuje kukṣipārśve tilo ramyo hi vartate | vāmabhujāyāṃ tilakaḥ suśobhaścāpi vartate ||47 || vāmakaphoṇikāsandhau sūkṣmatiladvayaṃ tathā | prakoṣṭhe sutilaścāste karāṃgulinakhāḥ śubhāḥ ||48 | | madhyāṃgulau śaṃkharekhā cakrāṇi tu catussvapi | sthalapadmanibhaṃ raktaṃ hastatalaṃ nakhāstathā ||49 | | kāntimatī samaniryatprabhākṛtiḥ sumohikā | dhairyatyāgakarī strīṇāṃ koṭikandarpasundarā ||3.217.50 | | bharayauvanapūrṇā ca divyā mūrtirvirājate | yajñopavītayuktā ca kaṇṭhe kaṇṭhī virājitā ||51 || kare tu mālikāyuktā kvacittu lekhinīyutā | sacakrādyāyudhā mūrtirvirājate kathānvitā ||52|| jaghane bālakṛṣṇasya lakṣmīmūrtirvirājate | liṅge madhye hyuparyadhastiladvayaṃ virājate ||53|| dakṣe nitambe cāste ca tiladvayaṃ suśobhanam | dakṣasakthi hyadhobhāge tiladvayaṃ virājate ||54|| jānudvayaṃ suśobhaṃ ca vartulaṃ rājate tathā | jaṅghāyāṃ dakṣapādasya jānoradhastilo’sti ca ||55|| tathā madhye’ntaḥsupārśve kṛṣṇatilaḥ suśobhate | vāmasakthisandhibhāge tilaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ suśobhate ||56 || tatpārśve sakthibhāge tu mahaccihaṃ kṣatatya(sya?) vai | vartate’tha vāmanitambake tilaḥ susūkṣmakaḥ ||57|| vāmasakthna uparyāste śrīḥ pūrṇacandrasannibhā | adṛśyā hyujjvalā divyā sarvakāmaprapūrikā ||58|| hastikaranibhe puṣṭe jaṃghe staḥ paramātmanaḥ | ājānulambahastau ca vartete śrīramāpateḥ |||99|| vāmapādaprakoṣṭhe’dhastilaścaiko hi vartate | ghaṭikāyāḥ sannidhau vai pādaphaṇāntike śubhaḥ ||3.217.60|| dvitīyaḥ sūkṣmatilako rekhāyāṃ vartate śubhaḥ | ghūṭītrayaṃ ca pratyeke pāde bāhye hi vartate ||61 | | kammānikānibhe pādatale śirīṣakomale | raktābhe copari romāvalirājitapuṣṭake ||62|| agulyaṃguṣṭhaparvordhve romāṇi kānakāni vai | vidyotante tathā sarve nakhāścandranibhonnatāḥ ||63||| pādayostalayoḥ santi divyacihnāni śārṅgiṇaḥ | mūrtau sūkṣmāṇi cihnāni samudroktāni santi ca ||64|| navāṃgulaṃ phullaliṃgaṃ vartate paramātmanaḥ | pādayoścordhvarekhe ca vartete brahmage śubhe ||65|| kaṇṭhasvarastu madhuro’mṛtasrāvī hareḥ sadā | vartate bālakṛṣṇasyaudārya saundaryamuttamam | dayālutvaṃ ca lāvaṇyaṃ kalyāṇaguṇayogitā || 66|| vartate śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāvyayavīryatā | sarvaiśvaryāṇi santyeva samastaśaktayastathā ||67|| sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhāśca camatkārā bhavanti ca | sarvāścaryāṇi vidyante rājādhirājasampadaḥ ||68|| sarvā ākarṣaṇadharmiṇyaśca śriyo’sya santi hi | sarvamādhuryabhāvāśca sarvānandābdhayo’tra vai | |69|| sarvotsavapramodāśca vidyante paramātmani | sarvakāmaprapūrṇatvaṃ sarvāntaryāmitāsya ca ||3.217.70|| sarvakāntātikāntatvaṃ sarvadatvaṃ harāviva | sarvajñatvaṃ sarvarūpadhārakatvaṃ hareḥ sadā ||71 || pārśvasthāḥ śrīrādhikāpadmāvatīmāṇikīramāḥ | nārāyaṇīsukhadālakṣmīsatīkamalādikāḥ ||72|| brahmapriyāśca muktānyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginya ityamum | prasevante kumāryaśca gopyaścāpi haripriyāḥ ||73|| muktāśca pārṣadāścāpi vāhanāni ca hetayaḥ | aiśvaryāṇi prasevante vibhūtayaśca tatsamā ||74|| mokṣārthe sarvajīvānāṃ vartate mānave bhave | sa eva divyarūpo’sti mānavo vāpyamānavaḥ ||75|| sākṣāt sa bhagavānatra narākāro’pi vartate | dhāmnā svena tathā muktaiḥ pārṣadādyaiḥ samanvitaḥ ||76|| parivāreṇa sarveṇa vartate janagocaraḥ | nṛtvadivyatvayorbhedo naivāsti parameśvare ||77|| yatra kṛṣṇastatra dhāma santi muktāśca śaktayaḥ | sarve divyā mūrtimantaḥ sākārāḥ kṛṣṇasadṛśāḥ ||78|| narā nāryo divyarūpā divyamuktā bhavanti te | bhavantaḥ sarva evāpi divyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇayoginaḥ ||79|| tamanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīkāntavallabham | gopālakambharāputraṃ vaṃśīhastaṃ bhajantviha ||3.217.80|| raṭantu śrīpatiṃ nityaṃ dhyāyantu kamalāpatim | sevantāṃ māṇikīkāntaṃ prāpnuvantu paraṃ sukham ||81 || ityevaṃ mama bhaktaḥ sa bhaktamaṇḍalamadhyagaḥ | bhaktānupadiśatyeva nityaṃ kalyāṇadaṃ vacaḥ ||82|| bhaktāḥ saṃbharadevaṃ ca citrakāraṃ guruṃ nijam | manyante pūjayantyeva bhaktiṃ kurvanti sevanam ||83|| athaikadā prasanno’hamāṣāḍhapūrṇimādine | guroḥ pūjāṃ devapūjāṃ taiḥ kṛtāṃ vīkṣya tadgṛhe ||84|| drutaṃ saṃbharadevasya rūpamaghārayaṃ śubham | gṛhe saṃbharadevo’sti dvitīyo’haṃ tu catvare ||85|| tau dvau saṃbharadevau saṃvīkṣya prapūjakā janāḥ | citrakṛtaḥ samastā vai bhrāntimāścaryamiśritām ||86|| avāpuśca muhurgatvā paśyanti catvare gṛhe | kathaṃ rūpadvayaṃ cāste guroḥ satyaṃ pṛthak pṛthak ||87|| atha cakruḥ parīkṣāṃ te gṛhe satyo’tha catvare | ārārtrikaṃ pracakruste samakāle tadobhayoḥ ||88|| gṛhasthasya śarīrāntaḥprabhā sāvaraṇābhavat | catvarasthasya dīpānāṃ jyotirnirāvaraṇakam ||89|| vyapaśyam̐ste dehamadhye niścikyuścātvaraṃ harim| gṛhe tu gururūpaṃ taṃ prāhuḥ śrīguruve tataḥ ||3.217.9 0|| gṛhāt tūrṇaṃ bahirvedyāmāyayau saṃbharo harim | haristūrṇaṃ saṃbhare vai līno babhūva paśyatām ||91 || āścaryaṃ sumahaccaitanmatvā tuṣṭuvurutsukāḥ | hare kṛṣṇa hare viṣṇo nātha nārāyaṇa prabho ||62|| punastau darśanaṃ sākṣād yathā syāt satkṛpāṃ kuru | nanṛtuste guroragre kīrtanāni pracakrire || 93|| pūjanāni vividhāni gurau mūrtau ca cakrire | atha madhyāhnavelāyāṃ naivedyārpaṇasatkṣaṇe || 94|| prāvirāsaṃ punastatra gururūpaḥ svayaṃ rame | atha te māṃ vyapaśyam̐śca divyarūpaṃ guruṃ harim ||95 || tataścakrādicihnāḍhyaṃ caturbhujaṃ śriyaḥpatim | ujjvalaṃ sakirīṭaṃ ca guruvarṇitacihnakam || 96|| hārakuṇḍalakeyūrāpīḍormikādiśobhitam | śṛṃkhalāmaṇiratnāḍhyabhūṣāmbaraviśeṣṭitam || 97|| āharād bhojayāmāsurārārtrikaṃ vyadhustathā | jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ śreṣṭhasugandhaṃ ca dadurhi me| ||98 || pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakrurnarā nāryo’pi sarvaśaḥ | vavruścāśīrvacanaṃ me mokṣadaṃ pradadāvaham || 99 || proce pūjāṃ drutaṃ citrakṛto mūrtau tirobhavam | te sarve hṛṣṭamanaso bhejurmāṃ gururūpiṇam || 3.217.100 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīvallabhaṃ harim |. atha kālāntare prāpte saṃbharāyuḥprasaṃkṣaye || 101 || gajena sākaṃ cānetumāyayau divyavigrahaḥ | patnīṃ saṃbharadevasya darśayāmāsa madgajam || 1 02|| tato mama svarūpaṃ ca darśayāmāsa caiśvaram | tataḥ saṃbharadevāya pradadau darśana mama || 1 03|| divyadehaṃ vidhāyaiva bhaktaṃ taṃ saṃbharaṃ tathā | tappatnīṃ citrasaritābhidhāṃ ca divyavigrahām || 1 04|| vidhāyādāya sauvarṇāmbālikāyāṃ gajopari | ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tathānyān bhaktipākinaḥ || 105|| evaṃ lakṣmi mayā citrakāraḥ samuddhṛto’nugaḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhaved dhruvā || 106 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne saṃbharadevākhyacitrakārasya bhaktyā bhagavatā dattaṃ darśanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ ca kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 217 ||
<3.218> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāmaṃgārahāriṇaḥ | jharaṇābhūmivāsasya bhaktasya mauktikeśinaḥ || 1 || mauktikeśī mamabhakto pārthakulasakhātarāṭ | kulasānāṃ khanīnāṃ vai khātodyotakaraḥ sadā || 2 || sahasraśo janāstatrāṃgārakarmakarāḥ khanau | khanayanti kulasān vai pārthān kṛṣṇān divāniśam || 3 || prātarbhakto bhajitvā māṃ tato yāti khaniṃ prati | kṣaṇaṃ me bhajanaṃ tatra vidhāpayati bhṛtyakaiḥ || 4 || hare kṛṣṇa hare kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa hare hare | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīśa hare hare || 5 || evaṃ kṛtvā kārayitvā bhajanaṃ khanigahvare | praveśaṃ ca karmacāraiḥ samaṃ karoti satvaram || 6 || kṛṣṇaśilāṃgārabhedān nikhananti ca gahvare | bhajante bhagavantaṃ māṃ śrīpatiṃ śrāntisatkṣaṇe || 7 || madhyāhne bhojanaṃ kṛtvā viśrāmyanti tu karmiṇaḥ | tadā divyaṃ bodhayati mauktikeśī janān yathā || 8 || vinā kṛṣṇasya bhajanaṃ saṃsāro gahvaro mahān | tīryate naiva kenāpi hyagādho vāsanāmayaḥ || 9 || janmamṛtyujarāvyādhistarā asaṃkhyakoṭayaḥ | karmastarāstathā tatra bhinnavyāpāranodakāḥ ||3.218.10|| vinā bhaktiṃ harenaiva tadantaṃ labhate janaḥ | asaṃgī sādhusaṃgī ca vairāgyāllabhate’ntakam ||1 1|| vartete hṛdaye dvau tau viruddho bhinnagocarau | eko nayati māyāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ paramātmani || 12|| eko vadati bhuñjīya viṣayān māyikāniti | dvitīyo vadati naiva bhuñjīya māyikāniti || 13|| tatraikaṃ mana evāsti māyikaṃ māyikārthagam | dvitīyo jīvanāmātmā niṣedhaṃ kurute sadā || 14|| vivicyaivaṃ vijānīyādātmanā parameśvaram | santyajed viṣayānanyān mokṣarodhakarāniha |||15||| vāsanā manasā yuktā prerikā viṣayeṣvapi | lokaviṣayaśabdotthā bhuṃkṣveti sā vadatyapi || 16|| satāṃ kathāprasaṃgotthā bhāvanātmanivāsinī | mā bhuṃkṣveti niṣedhaṃ vai karoti māyikeṣu sā || 17|| niṣkāsanīyā lokoktirdhāryā sādhukathāsudhā | pitā mātā suhṛdbandhuḥ svasā bhrātā ca mātulaḥ || 18|| putraḥ patnī mahiṣī gauraśvo vastraṃ gṛhaṃ dhanam | mamedaṃ ca tavedaṃ cetyevaṃ laukikavāsanāḥ || 19|| ahantāmamatāhetubhūtāḥ kṣipanti gahvare | bhramanti karmakāṇḍaiśca jāyante ca punaḥ punaḥ ||3.218.20|| satāṃ kalyāṇadātṝṇāṃ dhṛtvā vākyāni vai hṛdi | neme pitā suhṛd bandhurmā bhrātā mātulaḥ svasā ||21|| putraḥ patnī mahiṣī gauraśvo vastraṃ gṛhaṃ dhanam | nedaṃ mama tavedaṃ na kintu tatparamātmanaḥ ||22|| pitā mātā suhṛd bandhuḥ patiḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | ahaṃ tu śrīharerdāsaḥ śāśvatiko’smi cetanaḥ ||23|| mokṣado vai pitā mātā taddāso’haṃ subhaktimān | na me bandho na me māyā na me’hantā na māmakam ||24|| nityaśuddho harerbhakto mukto’smi satsamāgamāt | vāsanā khalu bandho’sti mokṣo’sti vāsanālayaḥ ||25|| saṃsāre duḥkhabahule sukhaṃ kṛṣṇapade’sti vai | lokaśabdāḥ satāṃ śabdā yuddhyanti bodhakāriṇaḥ || 26|| tajje jñāne vivekākhye yuddhyato hṛdaye’niśam | yeṣāṃ balaṃ mahat syādvai tasyaiva vijayo bhavet ||27|| yatra nārāyaṇaścāste yatra santaśca mokṣadāḥ | tatraiva vijayaścāste māyābalaṃ tu niṣphalam ||28||| sādhūnāṃ hṛdaye kṛṣṇaḥ sādhūnāṃ vijayaḥ sadā | upadeśasvarūpā vai santo yeṣāṃ hṛdi sthitāḥ ||29|| kathādvārā tathā kṛṣṇo yeṣāṃ hṛtsu sadā sthitaḥ | teṣāṃ balaṃ ca vijayo jāyate mokṣalābhadaḥ ||3.218.30 || bāhyānāṃ tu satāṃ saṃgāt puṣyanti santa āntarāḥ | bāhyānāmasatāṃ saṃgāt puṣyantyasanta āntarāḥ || 31 || puṣṭānāṃ vardhate śaktirapuṣṭānāṃ kṣayo bhavet | ataḥ santaḥ poṣaṇīyā na tvasantaḥ kadācana |||32|| yathā yathā prasannāḥ syuḥ santo vṛttyaṃ tathā tathā | satāṃ prasannatā puṣṭistathā kṛṣṇaprasannatā ||33|| evaṃ jāte vijayo vai jīvātmanaḥ prajāyate | mokṣarājyaṃ labhate’pi kṛṣṇadāsyaṃ mahatsukham ||34|| kṛṣṇārthaṃ yatamānasya sādhusevārthamityapi | yuddhyamānasya bhaktasya draṣṭāsti bhagavān svarāṭ ||35|| yuddhe eva tu maraṇe draṣṭā prasīdati dhruvam | yuddhe mṛtyurvijayo’sti svāmī tasmai prasīdati ||36|| svāmipriyehayā mṛtyuṃ gato’yaṃ ceti vetti saḥ | parāṅmukho na vai jātastato jayaṃ samarhati ||37|| svāmī tasmai dadātyeva phalaṃ jayādhikaṃ hyapi | tasmād balibhiryoddhavyaṃ jaye sanmukhavakṣasā ||38|| martavyaṃ svāmiprītyarthaṃ yuddhe sanmukhavakṣasā | bhaktyā dharmeṇa martavyaṃ hṛdi sanmukhaśārṅgiṇā ||39|| satāṃ sevayā martavyaṃ dehe cānvitacakriṇā | narākṛterharerbhaktyā gantavyaṃ gahvarāntake ||3.218.40|| kusaṃgaḥ sarvathā tyājyaḥ satsaṃgaḥ kārya eva ha | satāṃ kathā śravaṇīyā dhāryaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sadā hṛdi ||41|| sadyo niḥśreyasāyaiva gantavyaṃ śaraṇe hareḥ | na vai śārīrasaukhyārthaṃ dhanaputrāptaye’pi na ||42|| na vā rājyādilobhena gantavyaṃ śaraṇe hareḥ | niṣkāmabhāvayuktena gantavyaṃ śaraṇe hareḥ ||43|| sakāmabhāvanā mokṣarodhinī jāyate yataḥ | icchāghāte śaraṇaṃ ca tyaktavyaṃ syādato na tat ||44|| sakāmaśaraṇaṃ grāhyaṃ grāhyaṃ tvakāmapūrvakam | jāyate tu dhruvā muktiryena grāhyaṃ hi tattathā ||45|| sakāmāḥ kāmasiddhau tu bhajante bhāvato harim | kāmāsiddhau tyajantyeva bhāvanāmapi sarvathā ||46|| satāṃ bodhaṃ tyajantyeva bhagavattvasya kā kathā | nāstikatvaṃ nindanaṃ ca kurvanti pratyutāpi te ||47|| patantyeva nirayeṣu svārthānarthaprayojitāḥ | tato niṣkāmabhāvena praseveta prabhuṃ harim ||48|| sakāmānāṃ hi saṃkalpān kṛpayā pūrayatyapi | bhaktānāṃ śaraṇasthānāṃ bhaktiśaraṇajaṃ phalam ||49|| dadātyevānantaguṇaṃ kṛtasāpekṣakaḥ prabhuḥ | mahad duḥkhaṃ tu bhaktasya svalpaṃ karoti tadvaśaḥ ||3.218.50|| karmaṇāṃ khalu maryādā baddhāstenaiva śārṅgiṇā | antarastho hariḥ prārabdhānusāraṃ phalaṃ sadā ||51|| samavṛttirdadātyeva kṛpayā tu viśeṣataḥ | svatantraḥ sarvakartāsti niyāmakaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||52|| atiduṣkarmiṇaścainaṃ bhaveyuryadi satprabhum | kṛpayā śrīharisteṣāṃ karmāṇi subahūnyapi ||53|| dīrghakālena bhogyāni duṣṭāni duḥkhadānyapi | karoti svalpakālena svalpabhogyāni tāni vai ||54|| śūlavyathāṃ kaṇṭakena nivārayati sarvathā | atidāridryaduḥkhaṃ nivārayatyannavastradaḥ |||55|| bhaktā hareḥ kṛpāṃ tvenāṃ prajānanti na cāpare | abhaktāstu harau doṣān kalpayantyaguṇānapi ||56|| anīśvaratvaṃ cākṣipya jahatyapi tadāśrayam | nindanti nijatulyeṣu vadantyavācyajalpakān ||57|| mayā matvā prabhuṃ dravyavyayo vai sarvathā kṛtaḥ | asya santaḥ pūjitāśca sarvasvārpaṇakāriṇā ||58|| tathāpyanena duḥkhaṃ me na hṛtaṃ kiñcidityapi | upakāro na me jñātaścāgre me kiṃ kariṣyati ||59|| tasmāt tyakto mayā cāyaṃ nārāyaṇapadārthavān | evaṃ tyaktvā prayātyeva māyāyāṃ niraye tataḥ ||3.218.60|| tasmāt kṛṣṇasya bhaktirvai kartavyā tu nirīhayā | śreyase tvātmano lakṣmi na kāmalabdhaye kvacit ||61 || sevā sakāmabhaktasya nāṅgīkaroti mādhavaḥ | sevake kāmanāvattvaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ lālasātmakam ||62||| tṛṣṇecchā lālasā tvekā hyaparādhasya mūrtayaḥ | na kartavyā harau kvāpi lālasā bhaktiśālinā ||63|| lālasāyā apūrṇatve drohaḥ syātparamātmanaḥ | drohaścāstyaparādho vai mahānnārāyaṇasya ha ||64|| drohaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca nindāṃ ca doṣānuvarṇanaṃ tathā | guṇānāṃ khaṇḍanaṃ mithyāropaṇaṃ kṣamate na saḥ ||65|| harervā haribhaktasyāparādhaṃ svalpamityapi | kṣamate na haristasmānna kāryaḥ sarvathā hi saḥ ||66|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyākārakhaṇḍanam | saguṇasya nirasanaṃ satāṃ ca khaṇḍanaṃ tathā ||67|| aparādho mahāneva mahānarakasampradaḥ | na kartavyaḥ kvacit jñātvāpyajñātvā saṃgaraṃgataḥ ||68|| parame divyaloke’yaṃ nije’kṣare pade prabhuḥ | divyākṛtiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’sti puruṣottamaḥ ||69|| divyāsaṃkhyabrahmamuktaiḥ sevito māṇikīpatiḥ | kṛpayā sa prabhuścātra vartate mānavātmakaḥ ||3.218.70 || divyo’pi dṛśyate cātra mānavo bhautiko yayā | na tvayaṃ bhautikaścāste kintu divyo yathākṣare ||71 || asmaccakṣurbhautikaṃ yat tadgrāhyo vartate svavat | kṛpayaiva hariścaiva darśayatyeva nastviha ||72|| yathā bhaktastathā tena grāhyaḥ kṛpāvaśo’sti saḥ | sa eva bhaktavargaistu boddhavyo divyavigrahaḥ ||73|| tasmātparaṃ na caivāsti prāptavyaṃ jñeyamityapi | yadīcchati svabhakto vai draṣṭuṃ dhāmāni sampadaḥ ||74|| tadā kṛpālurbhagavān darśayatyeva sarvathā | yad divyaṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāma tattu sahaiva vartate ||75|| vaibhavā hariṇā sākamaiśvaryāṇyapi santi ca | akṣareṇa nijadhāmnā parivāreṇa saṃyutaḥ ||76|| vartate bhūtale kṛṣṇo dṛśyate naracakṣuṣā | naravaccākṣaraṃ dhāma bhūvacceṣṭāsamā guṇāḥ ||77|| muktā mānavatulyāśca kriyāśca prākṛtā yathā | dhāmasthānāṃ ca bhūsthānāṃ manāg bhedo na vidyate ||78|| divyasamādhinetrāstu vicakṣate sudivyakān | yatra kṛṣṇastatra dhāma tatra muktāśca śaktayaḥ ||79|| te sarve mānavairbhaktairarpitānnajalāmbaram | dhanasampadgṛhādyaṃ ca gṛhṇanti mānavā iva ||3.218.80|| tathāpi nispṛhāste tu bhaktakalyāṇahetave | gṛhṇanti tāni divyāni jāyante tatprasaṃgataḥ ||81 || dātāro divyarūpaṃ tallabhante tvakṣare pade | kṛṣṇasyaivaṃ tathā tasya bhaktānāṃ ca satāṃ sadā ||82|| vedanīyaṃ hi māhātmyaṃ cetthaṃ divyapramuktidam | kṛṣṇamāhātmyayuktasya vipado na bhavanti vai ||8 3|| kṛṣṇabhaktaśca raṃko’pi nāvamānyaḥ kadācana | raṃkāvamanturnāśaḥ syāt tatsthakṛṣṇasya pīḍanāt ||84|| kṛṣṇakriyāḥ samagrāśca yathā divyāstathaiva ca | bhaktānāmapi divyāstā mantavyā bhaktivedinā ||85|| harirbhaktamanaḥprītyai ramate bhaktamānavaiḥ | kāmena ramate cāpi hāsyena ramate tathā ||86|| ceṣṭayā cāpi sadṛśyā ramate strījanaiḥ saha | tathāpi tūrdhvaretastvaṃ koṭistrīṇāṃ smayāvaham ||87|| dharate śrīhariḥ koṭirūpadhṛk kāmagarvahāḥ | narākṛtiḥ svabhaktārthaṃ karoti naravat kriyāḥ ||88|| kāmaṃ krodhaṃ bhayaṃ lobhaṃ mohaṃ śokaṃ ca matsaram | darśayati kvacittadvai sarvaṃ maṃgalakṛnnṛṇām ||89|| śrutaṃ ca kathitaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ dhyātaṃ cāpyanumoditam | caritaṃ śrīhareḥ sarvaṃ mānavānāṃ hi mokṣadam ||3.218.90|| narākāraḥ śrīkṛṣṇo vai nṛṇāṃ manāṃsi pūrayet | nṛṇāṃ sājātyabhāvena sevādharmo harau bhavet ||91 || tena niḥśreyasaṃ vindet sevitācca prasāditāt | raṃko’pi dāsyabhāvo’pi dāsyapi naguṇāpi ca ||92|| dṛḍhakṛṣṇāśrayasyaiva pramodanaṃ sadā bhavet | jātaṃ me paramaṃ śreyo mokṣyante mama saṃginaḥ ||93|| kṛtārtho’haṃ kṛtārthāste ye me vacanavartinaḥ | santaḥ santi mamātmānaścātmadarśī sadāsmyaham ||94|| hariṃ sato’nyannaivāsti draṣṭavyaṃ mama māyikam | evaṃ mama nivāso’tra bhūtale’pi pare’kṣare |||95|| vidyate nātra sandehaścaivaṃ jñātvā bhajantu tam | rakṣākṛd bhagavānatra paratrāpi tvaviṣyati ||96|| ityupādiśya saṃśrutvā yayuḥ khanau tu karmaṇe | haristeṣāṃ parīkṣārthaṃ khanibhittau jalāgamam ||97|| mahāsaritsvarūpeṇa gartaṃ kṛtvā samānayat | khātena bhittibhaṃgādvai mahāsaritpravāhavat ||98|| pravāhaḥ sahasā tatra gahvare samajāyata | sarve jñānena tṛptāste mṛtyubhayavivarjitāḥ ||99|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ sasmarū rame | jalaṃ tu gahvare tatra sarovarasamaṃ hyabhūt || 3.218.10 0|| bhagnā nimagnā bhaktāste bhajanto māṃ ramāpatim | ātmaniṣṭhā jñāninaśca dṛḍhāśrayāstu te hṛdi || 10 1|| dadhyurmāṃ tvantarātmānaṃ samādhāviva modinaḥ | mauktikeśī mama bhakto māṃ prasasmāra bhūkhanau || 1 02|| bhūgarbhe śrīpatiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ jalamagno’tibhaktimān | athāhaṃ duḥkhahīnānāṃ bhajatāṃ karmacāriṇām ||103|| prāvirāsaṃ khanau tatra jalamadhye jalārdanaḥ | sudarśanena cakreṇāśoṣayaṃ vāri sarvagam || 104|| kṣaṇenaiva palenaiva pravāhaṃ cāpyarodhayam | svasthāste mama bhaktā vai dṛṣṭvā cakraṃ sudarśanam || 1 05|| dṛṣṭvā māṃ te nimagnā vai kṣaṇaṃ sukhe tu śāśvate | atha māṃ pūjayāmāsuḥ prārthayāmāsurakṣaram || 10 6|| dhāma mokṣārthamevāpi tathāstvityavadaṃ tu tān | bhaktidārḍhyaṃ samādiśya tūrṇaṃ tirobhavaṃ tataḥ || 1 07|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | evaṃ mantraṃ dadau tebhyo mauktikeśī khanīśvaraḥ || 108|| sarve te jāpamātreṇa divyajñānā prajajñire | atha kālāntare mauktikeśinaṃ cānyamānavān || 1 09|| vimānenānayaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ me paramaṃ padam | evaṃ māyā kulasānāṃ khanikhātāḥ parīkṣitāḥ || 3.218.1 10|| rakṣitā mokṣitāścāpi lakṣmi kṛpānukarṣiṇā | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi || 111 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mauktikeśināmno bhaktasya śilāṃgārakhanīśvarasya bhaktyā parīkṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā aṣṭādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 218 ||
<3.219> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ lubdhakasya tathā kathām | bhaktasya piñjalagrāmasthitasya sādhusevinaḥ || 1 || nāmnā cakradharaścāsīllubdhako hiṃsane rataḥ | śūdravarṇaḥ kuṭumbasya bharaṇe cauryakārakaḥ || 2 || paśūnāṃ stena evāpi sasvāmināṃ mahānapi | āraṇyānāṃ paśūnāṃ ca śaśādīnāṃ ca hiṃsakaḥ || 3 || karoti krūratāpūrvaṃ hiṃsanaṃ prāṇatṛptaye | athaikadā vane’gacchaddhariṇāśāprakarṣitaḥ || 4 || vṛkṣastambavaṃśaṣaṇḍepaśyaddhariṇarūpiṇam | pautimāṣyaṃ maharṣiṃ ca tadbhāryāṃ hariṇīṃ tathā || 5 || nāmnā sāmakṛṣiṃ mṛgavadhūṃ mṛgīsvarūpiṇīm | patrapuṣpatṛṇabhakṣyau navāṃkuraphalāśinau || 6 || surūpau sumṛgau vīkṣya lubdhakaḥ śaramādadhe | tāvadṛṣirvilokyainaṃ tiro’bhavanmṛgīyutaḥ || 7 || cakradharo’pi sandihya vṛkṣaṣaṇḍe gatau hi tau | mārgayituṃ tūrṇameva kramānukramaṇaṃ yayau || 8 || tadāmbaragirā prāha maharṣistaṃ tu lubdhakam | mā pāpin pāpavānatra vṛthā mano niveśaya || 9 || nāhaṃ mṛgaḥ pautimāṣyo maharṣiścāsmi vanyabhuk | sabhāryo’tra vane nityaṃ vicarāmi sukhasthitaḥ || 2.219.1 0|| yāhyanyatra mahāpāpin mokṣātpatita ityapi | mānavaṃ dehamāsādya mokṣaṃ kathaṃ na vāñchasi || 11 || śrutvā tu lubdhakaścāha nityaṃ viṣayavāñchayā | māṃsādano bhavāmyatra kāmasya puṣṭilabdhaye || 1 2|| pautimāṣyastataḥ prāha kāmo nirayadastava | yatra hiṃsā hyadharmo’sti prāṇināṃ ghātabhakṣaṇam ||1 3|| sadā te narake vāso bhaviṣyatīti mā tathā | saṃbhavaṃ mānavaṃ kāme nikṣipya narakaṃ vaha || 14|| śṛṇu lubdhaka vārtā me rocate yadi te tadā | kathayāmi hitārthāya satāṃ saṃgo hi tārakaḥ || 15|| kāmo’yaṃ dehajo doṣaścānnapānādisaṃbhavaḥ | vīryarūpaḥ sthūlabhāgo jāyate dehadhātukaḥ || 16|| dehe sarvatra vīryasya kaṇā bhavanti puṣṭidāḥ | ta ete kāmadevasya sthūlarūpaṃ hi bhautikam || 17|| athāntaraṃ manaścāpi manovahāsthitaṃ sadā | dehe kṣaṇe kṣaṇe kṛtvā bhramaṇaṃ sarvadhātuṣu || 18|| vīryaṃ saṃkalpayathanairākarṣayati kukṣiṣu | sivanīnāḍikāmūle caikatritaṃ prajāyate || 19|| manasā sahitaṃ taccābhedamāpannamityapi | bhūtvā manasi samvyāptaṃ sūkṣmarūpamano’nvitam ||2.219.20|| hetubhirvāsanāvegaiḥ śiśne sravate karmaṇā | tasmāt kāmastrividho’sti trideho vartate sadā ||21|| kāraṇaṃ vāsanārūpaḥ sūkṣmastu mānasātmakaḥ | sthūlastu vīryarūpaḥ sa māyiko nātmanastu saḥ ||22|| ātmā brahmasvarūpo’sti sarvendriyaniyāmakaḥ | romalohitamāṃsāsthimajjāsnāyūvilakṣaṇaḥ ||23|| vīryaṃ ṣaṭkoṣadharmo’sti saptamo bhogavāhakaḥ | aśuddhadvāravāsaścāśuddhadvāravinirgamaḥ || 24|| aśuddhadehabandhaśca pāpayāmyapurapradaḥ | kāmāddhiṃsā krodhamohau vāsanāśuddhacintanam ||25|| janma karma ca maraṇaṃ duḥkhamudvejanaṃ tathā | jāyante taṃ duṣṭakāmaṃ tyaktvā dharmeṇa vartaya ||26|| ṛtudānaṃ pradātavyaṃ dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ | nādhiko bhoga āptavyo mokṣamārgavirodhakṛt ||27|| sādhavo munayaḥ satyo sādhvyastyāgaparāyaṇāḥ | ātmānandanimagnāste kāmaṃ tyajanti dūrataḥ ||28|| yogābhyāsena dehotthaṃ dhātuṃ rakṣanti sarvathā | mano niyamya satataṃ nirmūlayanti vāsanāḥ ||29|| ūrdhvavīryāḥ prajāyante naiṣṭhikā brahmacāriṇaḥ | prasvedasrāvaśūnyāste svāpnasrāvavivarjitāḥ ||2.219.30|| brahmātmānandamagnāste jāyante yatayo’malāḥ | īśavatte samarthā vai viṣṇuvat sampadīśvarāḥ ||31|| vedhovat sṛṣṭidhātāro jāyante pārameśvarāḥ | brahmacaryaparāṇāṃ tu pratyutthāyānalānilāḥ ||32|| mūrtimantaḥ svāgatārthaṃ prayānti mahimāvidaḥ | bhogānte brahmaparamaṃ cāptavyaṃ manudharmiṇā ||33|| bhogastṛṣṇāntako nāsti bhoge tṛṣṇā vivardhate | tasmād bhogān parityajya bhaja nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||34|| cakradhara hariṃ cakradharaṃ vai śaraṇaṃ vraja | māyācakraṃ vibhidyaiva brahmacakragato bhava ||35 || ityukto muninā cakradharo lakṣmi śubhāśayaḥ | upadeśairabhavacca vivṛttamānasaḥ khalu ||36|| aicchacca darśanaṃ tasya pautimāṣyasya vai guroḥ | prārthayad darśanārthaṃ ca gururmānavarūpadhṛk ||37|| dadau svadarśanaṃ tasmai jalapānamakārayat | pādajalaṃ dadau cāpi pāpāni samanāśayat ||38|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | mantraṃ datvā vaiṣṇavaṃ taṃ vṛndāpatrairvyadhāpayat ||39|| lubdhako’pi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bheje tataḥ param | gṛhaṃ gatvā tīrthapūtaḥ patnīṃ pūtāṃ vyadhāpayat ||2.219.40|| hiṃsāṃ cauryaṃ sadā tyaktvābhajanmāṃ parameśvaram | tulasīpādape kṛṣṇaṃ sadā pūjayate sa mām ||41 || vanyaphalārpaṇaiḥ prasādajairyātrāṃ vahatyapi | satāṃ sevāṃ vanyaphalaistata ārabhya nityadā ||42|| karoti sādhurūpo vai jaṭādharo’bhavattataḥ | patnī jaṭādharī bhasmadharī tulasīpūjikā ||43|| abhavadvratasampannā vighasāśitvaśālinī | evaṃ viśuddhamanaso bhaktyāhaṃ munivāñcchayā ||44|| tasya mokṣaṃ vidhātuṃ tu kālāgame hyupasthitaḥ | divyamūrtirhariścāhaṃ tena dṛṣṭaśca yoṣitā ||45|| nipetatuśca te pādau praṇamya rajasā plutau | mokṣārthaṃ tvaritau kṛtvā svāgataṃ mama vihvalau ||46|| premamagnau vanyaphalaṃ me samarpya drutaṃ gaje | dehau tyaktvāruruhatustadānīṃ divyavigrahau ||47|| vaikuṇṭhaṃ jagmatustau tu mayā saṃpreṣitau rame | evaṃ muktiḥ kṛtā lubdhakasya sadguruyogataḥ ||48|| tathaiva tu satāṃ ye syurbhaktāsteṣāṃ tu vāsanāḥ | vinaśyanti manaścāpi nirmalaṃ jāyate sadā ||49|| kāmakrodhādayo doṣā naśyantyaghāni yānyapi | bhūtvā divyasvarūpāste kṛpayā me satāṃ tathā ||2.219.50 || prayānti brahma paramaṃ lakṣmi śāśvatasaukhyadam | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi ||51|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne lubdhakasya cakradharasya pautimāṣyarṣisaṃgena hiṃsādipāpanāśe bhaktyuttara muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā navadaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 219 ||
<3.220> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ bhaktasya piśunasya vai | kathāṃ saṃbhalanagare sthitasyātmanivedinaḥ || 1 || nānnābhavad vāṭadharo bhakto nṛpasya sevakaḥ | sutārasiṃhanāmnastu sevakaḥ pṛthivīpateḥ || 2 || kuśalo rājanītyāṃ ca caturo rājarañjane | kṛtaśramo vyavahāre śāstre vinimayādiṣu || 3 || prasādabhūto rājñaśca rājñyā mānasya cāśrayaḥ | rāṇakuṭumbabhaktaśca khavāsavarṇamūrddhagaḥ || 4 || paśyati tīkṣṇayā buddhyā karoti matinā tathā | vicārayati jñānena prajñayā mantrayatyapi || 5 || arthāvadhāriṇī buddhirmatirāgābhigocarā | jñānaṃ vivekavaiśadyaṃ prajñā tu pratibhā navā |.| 6 || evaṃ vāṭadhare cāste vijñānaṃ kovide yathā | asādhyasya tu kāryasya vāṭaṃ mārgayati dhruvam || 7 || pāraṃ karoti kāryasya praśasto’to nṛpādiṣu | yathā vṛddho yathā mantrī yathā nyāyī yathā guruḥ || 8 || evaṃvidho’yaṃ vāṭadhro yadyapi śreṣṭhanītimān | tathāpi prakṛtivaśaḥ paiśunyaṃ carati kvacit || 9 || rājñyā nṛpāya nṛpate rājñyai nṛpasya mantriṇe | mantriṇastu prajābhyaśca rājñyai nṛpāya vai kvacit ||3.220.1 0|| aprakāśaṃ yathā tatsyānna jānīyu pare tu tat | eka eva vijānīyācchrotā tathā vadatyasau || 1 1|| athaikadā tu saṃkrāntau dānaṃ rājñī dadau bahu | viprebhyo dīnavargebhyaḥ sādhubhyo bhojanādikam || 1 2|| pracchannaṃ maṇiratnādi rājā jānāti naiva yat | nijahastagataṃ dvaipīrājñī dānaṃ dadau dhanam || 1 3|| vāṭadharo vijānāti dvaipyā dātuṃ niyojitaḥ | dānottaraṃ bhojanaṃ ca rājñī sadbhyo dadau śubham || 14|| sādhavo bhuñjate bhojyamiṣṭānnāni hariśritāḥ | tatra viraktaścaiko’bhūd ghaṭyayanābhidho yatiḥ || 15|| vasati ghaṭikāmātramekasthale tu nādhikam | tasya vai bhojane tatra jāyamāne tu paṃktiśaḥ || 1 6|| jātāsya ghaṭikā pūrṇotthāya vihāya bhojanam | yayau vṛkṣāntaraṃ tatra ghaṭikāṃ tasthivān punaḥ || 17|| jalaṃ pītvā punastasmādanyasthalaṃ yayau hi saḥ | eva sa ghaṭikāṃ sthitvā yāti sthalāntaraṃ muhuḥ ||18 || vāṭadharo vilokyainaṃ tyaktabhojyaṃ ca cañcalam | sāye sammṛgya yatrāste tatra taṃ prāptavān drutam ||19|| gatvā natvā phalaṃ prārpya vandanaṃ saṃvidhāya ca | papraccha kāraṇaṃ tatra cāñcalyasya naman muhuḥ ||3.220.20|| ghaṭyayanastu taṃ prāha lakṣmi cāñcalyakāraṇam | ekatra ghaṭikordhvaṃ tvasthāyitvaṃ sadguṇo’sti saḥ ||21|| bandhanaṃ na bhavet kvāpi rāgaḥ kvāpi na jāyate | mamatā jāyate naiva vairāgyaḥ sarvadā bhavet ||22|| aparigraha evāpi vrataṃ tena tu rakṣyate | ciraṃ vāsastu bandhāya ciravāsaṃ na cācaret ||23|| jale sthale pādape vā ciravāso bhayāvahaḥ | sādhūnāṃ godohamātraṃ ghaṭīmātraṃ sthirāsanam ||24|| ghaṭyāsanaṃ tu māyāyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇe śāśvatāsanam | viditvaivaṃ vivekena cāñcalyaṃ niyamo mama ||25 || saṃgāt sañjāyate snehaḥ snehācca mamatā bhavet | tayāsaktistayā tatra vāsanā jāyate muhuḥ ||26|| sahavāso bandhanaṃ vai viyogo mokṣaṇaṃ param | vāsanā sarvathā tyājyā saṃgastyājyo mahātmanā ||27|| nirvāsanatvamāptabyaṃ vairāgyeṇa vivekinā | bhagavanniṣṭhāyuktena cātmaniṣṭhāyutena ca |||28|| duḥkhadoṣānudṛṣṭyā ca vinirvāsanatā bhavet | ahamātmā harerbhakto na māyāyā na karmaṇām || 29 || saccidānandarūpo’haṃ bhinno naśvaravarṣmaṇaḥ | akṣareśasya kṛṣṇasya dṛḍhāśrayayuto’smyaham ||3.220.30|| māyāyāṃ me na vai rāgo raso nendriyagocare | āntare śrīvāsudeve vasāmyānandayāmi ca ||3 1 || evaṃ vivekino nityaṃ dṛḍhavairāgyaśālinaḥ | śreṣṭhaviṣayayoge’pi rāgāṅkuro na jāyate ||3 2|| ramaṇīye divyabhoge vartamāno’pi conmanāḥ | asaṃgyudāsīna āste sa nirvāsanako mataḥ || 3 3|| satāṃ guṇām̐śca gṛhṇīyurvijānīyuśca divyatām | te’pi divyaguṇāḍhyāḥ syurmāyāvijayinaḥ sadā ||34|| ye tu satāṃ pragṛhṇanti doṣānavaguṇām̐stathā | kāmādikām̐stuṃ te kāmādyāvṛttāḥ saṃbhavanti vai || 35|| kāmādyaiḥ pīḍyamānāste bhramanti cātiduḥkhinaḥ | na mokṣaṃ nāpi susvargamaihikaṃ vāpnuvanti te ||36|| āpnuvanti hi narakān nindakāḥ pāpinaḥ khalāḥ | narā nāryaḥ satāṃ saṃge manvate divyatāṃ tu ye ||37|| te yānti brahmaparamaṃ divyabhāvātivardhitāḥ | tadindriyāṇi māyāyāṃ kuṇṭhitāni bhavanti hi ||38|| rājā vā syād gṛhastho vā samṛddho bhogavānapi | jñānamīdṛk samālabhya viṣayordhve sa vartate || 39|| | prārabdhapuṇyayogena cāste viṣayamadhyagaḥ | tathāpi sādhuvaccāste yogīva lepavarjitaḥ |||3.220.40|| | bhuñjannapi hyabhoktaiva jalaṃ sarojanī yathā | ambladantaścaṇakānāṃ yathā karoti carvaṇam ||41|| tathā viṣayagrahaṇe śakto naiva prajāyate | vāsanā līyate tena kuṇṭhitasya tu māyikī ||42|| māyārasaṃ manāg vetti yastasya vāsanā nahi | apasarpati hṛdayānmāyārasaṃ tyajettataḥ ||43|| pratyakṣabhagavanmūrtau jānīyāt sarvapūrṇatām | tenaiva sarvakāryāṇi siddhyanti bhaktayoginaḥ ||44|| kṛtvā satsaṃgamevātra jñātavyaṃ tvetadeva yat | evaṃ jñāturhariḥ sarvaṃ sādhayatyeva vāñchitam | |45|| harau mano’rpayituśca naśyanti vāsanāstviha | yenārpitaṃ manaḥ kṛṣṇe tasya kṛṣṇaṃ vinā kṣaṇam ||46|| yugāyate viyoge vā dāhaḥ syāddhṛdaye mahān | kṛṣṇeprāpte bhavecchāntirdidṛkṣā vardhate’nvaham ||47|| kṛṣṇapratāpaśravaṇe prītirbhūritarā bhaveta | kṛṣṇasambandhikāryeṣu ruciḥ śreṣṭhatayā bhavet ||48|| kṛṣṇādeśasyācaraṇe sadā tatparatā bhavet | evaṃvidho dūrago’pi vartate mādhavāntike ||49|| ājñollaṃghanakārī tu premahīno hyanarpitaḥ | sahasthito’pi dūravad bodhyaḥ svārthī khalādhipaḥ ||3.220.50|| tasmād yathā svahṛdaye vasati mādhavaḥ prabhuḥ | tathātmanā vidhātavyo vāso’kṣare pade’sya vai ||51 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | evaṃ mantraṃ raṭa nitya pūjayācyutamīśvaram ||52|| hare kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa ramāpate | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo jagatpate ||53|| evaṃ nityaṃ bhajanaṃ śrīhareḥ śrāvaya saṃgine | prājñe rājñai prajābhyaśca tena śreyo bhaviṣyati ||54|| ityevaṃ lakṣmyupadeśaṃ dadau vāṭadharāya saḥ | dhaṭyayano harerdāsaḥ sādhuḥ sadguṇabhūṣaṇaḥ ||55|| vāṭadhro’pi gṛhaṃ gatvā bheje yathāniveditam | bhajanaṃ ca tathā cakre hare kṛṣṇeti nityaśaḥ ||56|| ghaṭyayanastu prayayau grāmāntaraṃ hariṃ smaran | vāṭadhrastu mahābhakto jāto mokṣakaro yathā ||57|| rājñe rājñyai prajābhyaśca dadau mantraṃ hi mokṣadam | bhajanaṃ kārayāmāsa hare kṛṣṇeti sarvathā ||58|| bhaktiyuktasya loke’tra sadguṇāḥ saṃbhavanti vai || tathāpi durguṇo jātisvabhāvo na nivartate ||59|| yadyapi syānmahābhakto yathā vai garuḍastathā |. sarpabhakṣitvametasya jātiguṇo na naśyati ||3.220.60|| vānarā rāmabhaktāśca paśudharmān tyajanti na | siṃho bhakto’pi pārvatyā hiṃsanaṃ na jahāti saḥ ||61|| kṣatriyo viṣṇubhakto’pi saṃgrāmaṃ na jahāti saḥ | kirāto viṣṇubhakto’pi vanyarītiṃ jahāti na ||62|| gauḥ śrīkṛṣṇasya bhaktāśca rambhaṇaṃ na jahatyapi | khavāso’yaṃ viṣṇubhaktaḥ piśunatvaṃ jahau na ca ||63|| paraguptaṃ śatrave vānyasmai guṇāguṇātmakam | pracchannamiva vaktavyaṃ tadvai piśunatā matā ||64|| yatphalaṃ jāyate kleśo yuddhaṃ kalaha ityapi | vaimanasyaṃ samudvegaḥ krodho vā nāśanaṃ hyapi ||65|| taramāt kāryaṃ na paiśunyaṃ kasyaciccāparāya ha | guṇānāṃ darśanaṃ kāryaṃ na tu doṣapradarśanam ||66|| guṇagrāhī sukhaṃ yāti jāyate puṇyavānapi | doṣagrāhī bhaved duḥkhī jāyate pāpavānapi ||67|| hānipradaṃ hi paiśunyaṃ śikṣaṇaṃ tu guṇapradam | paiśunyaṃ naiva kartavyaṃ kartavyaṃ śikṣaṇaṃ kvacit ||68|| yogyatā cedbhavettarhi nānyathā śikṣaṇaṃ hyapi | pitre mātre tathā bhrātre svasre nanāndre yoṣite ||69|| pataye bandhave śiṣyāyāpi putryai sutāya vā | vadhve vṛddhāya bālāya vaktavyaṃ piśunaṃ nahi ||3.220.70|| rājñe rājñyai hyamātyāya rājaputrāya sarvathā | prajābhyo naiva vaktavyaṃ paiśunyaṃ nṛpateḥ kvacit ||71 || khavāsajātidoṣeṇa paiśunyamekadākarot | rājñe nivedayāmāsa rājñyā dānaṃ kṛtaṃ tviti ||72||| guptaṃ hīrakaratnādi dattavatī dvijātaye | sādhubhyo bhojanaṃ cāpi bhūṣāśca pradadāviti ||73|| atha rājā guptadhanaṃ dāne dattaṃ viditya ca | rājñīmāhūya papraccha vada dattaṃ dhanādikam ||74|| anājñayā pradattaṃ yanneṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ hi tanmama | pracchannaṃ te dhanaṃ sarvaṃ tavārthaṃ rakṣitaṃ sadā ||75| na dānārthaṃ bhavettadvai dattaṃ tannocitaṃ kṛtam | nāryā vihāya patyājñāṃ na kartavyaṃ tu kiñcana ||76|| yātu tai pitaraṃ rājñi pracchannā na priyā priyā | pracchannavyayakartrī yā sā kvacit sarvanāśinī ||77|| prajāyeta mayā naitādṛśī rakṣyā gṛhe priyā | yāhi svapitaraṃ devi vasa tatra ciraṃ sukham ||78|| ityuktā sā bahuśokaṃ prāptā ruroda bhāminī | atha rājā khavāsasya dvārarūpasya dānake ||79|| daṇḍaṃ vyadhāddhi sarvasvahārakaṃ nigaḍe’karot | kartā kārayitā cānumodayitā samo’naye ||3.220.80|| iti rājā dadau daṇḍaṃ jahāra gṛhavāṭikāḥ | dhanadravyaṃ jahārāpi bhaktasya vāṭadhāriṇaḥ ||8 1 || vāṭadhro’pi hariṃ bheje nigaḍastho’tidīnavat | rājñī mānavihīnā ca svasaudhe’śanavarjitā |||82|| vratasthā hyabhavattūrṇaṃ martukāmā tu vaiṣṇavī | dānadharme na vai duḥkhaṃ kathaṃ duḥkhamupasthitam ||83|| duḥkhaharo harikṛṣṇo duḥkhaṃ me vyapakarṣatu | ityevaṃ mama mūrtyagre kṛtānaśanikā sthitā||84|| nigaḍastho’pi vāṭadhrastathaivānaśane sthitaḥ | dānakārye na vai daṇḍo bhavenmatvā hariṃ pratiṃ |||85|||| nivedya duḥkhamutpannaṃ dadhyau svahṛdaye prabhum | prakāśe’pi sa vṛttāntaḥ prasasāra prajādiṣu ||86|| prajāsu vipravargeṣu sādhuṣu pramadāsu ca | śoko viveśa sahasā rājñā yogyaṃ na tatkṛtam ||87|| evaṃ vārtā tu sarvatra prācarad dānaśaṃsinī | dānaṃ dharmo hi rājñāṃ vai rājñyā kṛtaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtam ||88|| rājño dravyasya nāstyeva nyūnatā rājyabhoginaḥ | ityevaṃ vai prajāsvevābhavad vārtātiśobhanā ||89|| rājñīduḥkhavināśārthaṃ vāṭadhārasya śāntaye | prajāścāpi hariṃ smṛtvāśīrvādān sukhadān daduḥ ||3.220.90|| vigate’naśane tatra saptāhe niśi mādhavaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ nigaḍālaye ||91|| bhaktarakṣākaro’gacchaṃ rājñyāśca mandire tathā | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakirīṭahāraśobhitaḥ ||92 || datvā svadarśanaṃ dugdhapānaṃ rājñyai dadāvaham | vāṭadhrāya dadāveva dugdhapānaṃ tataḥ param ||93|| āśvāsanaṃ pradāyaiva rājasaudhamupāyayau | viprarūpo’titejasvī dharmaśastravidāṃ varaḥ || 94|| rājāsanaṃ dadau me ca mayā pṛṣṭo nirāmayam | akleśaṃ ca kuṭumbasya sa cāha māṃ tu sāmayam ||95|| vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa kleśasya kāraṇaṃ nṛpaḥ | upādiśaṃ tato rājñe strīdhane strī svatantrikā ||96|| tatrāpi dānarūpe tu yogyā sā puṇyakāriṇī | patistarati nāryā vai dharmiṇyā bhaktiyoṣitā ||97|| godānaṃ ratnadānaṃ ca bhūṣādānaṃ hi tārayet | patiṃ nṛpaṃ mahāpāpaṃ śreṣṭhadānaṃ hi tārayet ||98|| tasmād rājan satīṃ nārīṃ pramānaya yathocitam | vāṭadhraṃ mānaya cāpi satkāryakāriṇaṃ tviha ||99|| ityuktvā taijasā vyāptamadarśayaṃ svayaṃ svakam | rupaṃ rājñe mumudāsau rājā papāta pādayoḥ || 3.220.1 00|| yayāce sa kṣamāṃ cāpi mokṣaṃ nārāyaṇālaye | adṛśyo’hamabhavaṃ ca pūjāmādāya yatkṛtām ||1 01|| rājā rājñīṃ khavāsaṃ ca mānayāmāsa satkṛtaiḥ | utsavaṃ kārayāmāsa dānaśaṃsāṃ śubhāṃ tathā || 1 02|| kalahaṃ śāntayāmāsa snehabhāṣaṇadānakaiḥ | pratyarpaṇaistu vāṭadhrāyāpi mānaṃ vyadhāttathā || 1 03|| evaṃ lakṣmi mayā bhaktā rājñī tadā surakṣitā | martukāmā mūrchitā sā kṣudhayā dugdhapāyitā ||1 04|| vāṭadharo’pi me bhakto rakṣito rājadaṇḍataḥ | atha kāle samāpanne rājānaṃ bhaktivedinam ||105|| rājñīṃ vāṭadharaṃ cāpi vimānenānayaṃ nijam | akṣaraṃ paramaṃ dhāma paiśunyavarjitaṃ tataḥ || 1 06|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāt pāpanāśanam | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheccāpi svargaṃ sveṣṭaṃ paraṃ rame ||1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vāṭadharasya piśunakhavāsasya tathā dvaipīrājñyāśca sutārasiṃhanṛpaterdaṇḍād bhagavatā kṛtaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā viṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 220 ||
<3.221> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ gṛhakārasya vai kathām | takṣaśilāyāṃ puryāṃ vai nāmnā śivajayo’bhavat || 1 || bhaktaḥ prāsādakuśalo mandiragṛhakṛtkalaḥ | nagarīracanāvijño devālayādikārakaḥ || 2 || śilpivaryaḥ sbabuddhyaiva kurute ca kalodbhavam | rājaprāsādanirmātāviṣkṛtanavaghaṭṭanaḥ || 3 || navākṛtikaraścāpi navakakṣādigocaraḥ | asaṃkhyanāṇakaiḥ saudhān nirmāti daivasadṛśān || 4 || ekadā vṛṣaparvākhyaḥ ṛṣistaṃ samupāyayau | mahābhāgavato bhaktaḥ sādhudharmā susaṃyataḥ || 5 || utthāya sahasā śivajayaḥ svāgatamācarat | arghaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ ca dadāvṛṣaye bhāvavān || 6 || nyaṣādayad ramyapūtāsane jalaṃ samārpayat | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cāṃgamardanaṃ ca vyadhādṛṣeḥ || 7 || ṛṣistasya tu kuśalaṃ papraccha prītamānasaḥ | so’pi tavāgamādatra kuśalaṃ me uvāca tam || 8 || yatra sādhoścaraṇau vai pūjyete śraddhayā gṛhe | tadgṛhaṃ divyaveti śmasānaṃ tu tadanyakam || 9 || adya me kuśalaṃ sarvaṃ naṣṭaṃ tvakuśalaṃ mama | dhanyo’smi daivapuruṣo rājate yadgṛhe’dya vai || 3.221.1 0|| ityuktvā maunamāsthāya vṛṣaparvāṇamāha saḥ | kuśalaṃ paramaṃ yattacchādhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam || 1 1|| atha lakṣmi vṛṣaparvā smṛtvānādinarāyaṇam | upādideśa bahudhā śivajayāya muktaye || 1 2|| śivajayākarṇaya tvaṃ snehaḥ kṛṣṇe tu mokṣadaḥ | asnehaścāpi māyāyāṃ nikṛṣṭatādibuddhitaḥ ||1 3 || snehaḥ kṛṣṇe tu jāyeta tadutkṛṣṭatvabuddhitaḥ | tadutkarṣo yathā parabrahma śrībhagavān svayam ||14|| savitāram sarvadhāmādhipaḥ satāṃ patiḥ | sarvamuktapatiḥ sarvaiśvaryapatiḥ ramāpatiḥ || 15|| yāvadbhagavatāṃ kṛṣṇo bhagavān bhagavattamaḥ | sarvopari cāntarātmā sarvakarmaphalapradaḥ ||16|| antaryāmī yamantarā kiñcit svatantrameva na | yadicchāmantarā śuṣke parṇe’pi pavano balī || 17|| pravartate na vai cālanārthaṃ preraka eva saḥ | sa eva bhagavānatra pṛthvyāṃ sādhusvarūpavān || 18|| yatheṣṭarūpavānāste bhaktamānasapūrakaḥ | divyo divyacaritraśca sarvathā divyavigrahaḥ || 19|| mokṣadā hi kriyāstasya sakalā dehajā api | evaṃ yasya hi māhātmyaṃ vidyate hṛdaye hareḥ ||3.221.20|| tasya bhaktasya vaṃśīyāḥ kuṭumbinaśca prākparāḥ | daśa daśa svaścetyekaviṃśatiruddharanti vai ||21 || gṛhṇīyuste guṇaṃ tasya bhaktasya yadi sarvathā | aho cāsmatkule kṛṣṇabhakto jāto hi pāvanaḥ || 22|| asmadbhāgyaṃ mahattena samuddhāro bhaviṣyati | tatkṛtabhakteḥ puṇyaṃ no bhaviṣyati kuṭumbinaḥ ||23|| ityevaṃ guṇamantārastaranti nātra saṃśayaḥ | anye’pi guṇamantāraḥ puṇyabhājo bhavanti ca ||24|| taṭantyeva ca saṃsāraṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ prayanti te | ye yo guṇapravaktāro guṇagrāhiṇa eva te |||25|| dhanyavādagrahitāro yānti kṛṣṇasya dhāma te | bhaktakathā bhaktaguṇagānaṃ bhaktasya vandanam |||26|| bhaktapraśaṃsanaṃ bhaktaprasādo mokṣadā ime | bhaktasya dveṣakartāraḥ sambandhinastathetare ||27|| ye vā ke vā prayāntyeva nirayaṃ yāmyanoditāḥ | krodhanānirṣyuko mānī kapaṭī kāmavānapi ||28|| dveṣī ca nindakaścaite prayānti nirayaṃ dhruvam | tān doṣān samparityajya ye bhajanti janārdanam ||29|| te prayānti harerdhāma kṛṣṇasnehaparāyaṇāḥ | bhagavatsnehasampūrṇā bhagavatsevane ratāḥ ||3.221.3 0|| bhagavadguṇatulyaiḥ sadguṇairyuktā bhavanti hi | bhagavadguṇavān bhakto bhavedāśritamokṣakṛt ||31 || svadharmaṃ pālayan rāgābhāvaṃ sampādayam̐stathā | ātmaniṣṭho hariniṣṭhaḥ snehī yāti paraṃ padam ||32|| śubhe deśe samaye vā jāgradādau śubhāśraye | aśubhe vā viparīte bhaktastu dehamutsṛjan ||33|| prayātyeva paraṃ dhāma kṛṣṇakṛpānumoditaḥ | abhakto vā harerdveṣī satāṃ dveṣī vinindakaḥ ||34|| dharmādiśūnyako yo vai śubhe deśādike’pi ca | dehaṃ tyaktvāpi yātyeva ghoraṃ yamālayaṃ sadā |||35||| abhyastā yā matiścānte gatirjāyeta tādṛśī | śobhano’śobhano mṛtyurna hetuḥ sadasadgatau ||36|| bhaktasyordhvagatiścāsti tadbhinnasya tu durgatiḥ | sarvadarśī guruḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ kṛpāprabhuḥ ||37||. bhaktaṃ nijaṃ nayatyeva dhāmākṣaraṃ na saṃśayaḥ | yadvā bhakto nijanārāyaṇasyopāsanābalāt ||38|| bhajan kṛṣṇaṃ svayaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ yāti svatantrakaḥ | īśavat sa samartho’sti brahmāṇḍānāṃ laye’laye ||39|| kiṃmātramasya dehasya dhāraṇaṃ tyajanaṃ ca vā | etādṛśaśca bhakto’tra bhūtale khalu durlabhaḥ ||3.221.40|| bhāvyaṃ tādṛśabhaktena nyūnatā yatra no bhavet | bhāvyaṃ tādṛśavijñena sneho’nyatra na vai bhavet ||41 || bhāvyaṃ tādṛśavratinā pātivratyaṃ harau bhavet | bhāvyaṃ tādṛśaguṇinākṣarabrahmagatirbhavet ||42|| bhāvyaṃ tādṛśadivyena māyālokordhvadṛṣṭinā | muktakoṭau bhavedvāsaḥ śāśvatānandavarṣaṇaḥ ||43|| | tadeva kuśalaṃ śivajayānyat kuśaletarat | śṛṇu sarvakuśalāni śrutvā tāni samācara |||44|| samayo yasya haryarthaḥ prātaḥ sāyaṃ tathāparaḥ | pūjanaṃ yatra kṛṣṇasya samayaḥ kuśalo hi saḥ ||45|| gṛhe yasya harermūrtiścāpaṇe mandire bhuvi | kṣetre vāṭyāṃ samudyoge sa deśaḥ kuśalo mataḥ ||46|| yā kriyā tu śrīkṛṣṇārthā sādhyarthā ca surārthikā | ātmārthā cāpi muktyarthā sā kriyā kuśalā matā ||47|| yaḥ saṃgaḥ khalu satsaṃgo dharmajñānasukhāvahaḥ | vāsanānāśakṛt kṛṣṇe snehakṛt kuśalo hi saḥ ||48|| yo mantro mohahā jñaptipradaḥ prakāśakṛddhṛdi | kṛṣṇanāmayuto divyaḥ pāpaghnaḥ kuśalo hi saḥ ||49|| dīkṣā yā brahmapadadā pāvanī pāpanāśinī | jñānakarī kṛṣṇapātivratyadā kuśalā hi sā ||3.221.50|| dhyānaṃ yacchāntidaṃ māyāduḥkhodvegādināśakam | śāśvatānandadaṃ divyabhāvadaṃ kuśalaṃ tu tat ||51 || yo gururdivyatādhāyakastathā doṣanāśakṛt | tārakaḥ kṣālako mokṣe hitakṛt kuśalo hi saḥ ||52|| yā mātā śrīkṛṣṇadugdhāmṛtapānaprakāriṇī | bhaktipuṣṭikarī mokṣadarśinī kuśalā tu sā |||53|| yaḥ pitā dharmakarmādipālanodyogaśikṣakaḥ | brahmalokamahāmārgapālakaḥ kuśalo hi saḥ ||54|| yo bhrātā muktidaṃ karma bibharti kārayatyapi | dadāti bhrājanaṃ divyaṃ mokṣadaṃ kuśalo’pi saḥ ||55|| yā svasā bhojanaṃ bhrātre dadāti brahmaṇe’rpitam | brahmamuktipradāśīrvādapradā kuśalā hi sā ||56|| yā patnī śrīhareryogapradāyinī tu sevikā | kṛṣṇabandhanakartrī śrīpradā sā kuśalā matā ||57|| yaḥ putrastārayet kṛṣṇabhaktyā svapitaraṃ vrataiḥ | prasannatāmarjayecca pituḥ sa kuśalo mataḥ ||588|| yaḥ patiḥ sampradadyādvai brahmānandaṃ subhaktimān | brahmarasaṃ pāyayonnirvāṇadaṃ kuśalo hi saḥ ||59|| kuṭumbinastu ye māyāṃ kāṭavīṃ duḥkhadāyinīm | tyājayeyurdāpayeyurmuktiṃ te kuśalāḥ sadā ||3.221.60|| prajārājādayastadvanmokṣe ye tu sahāyinaḥ | amokṣaṇāttu vyāvṛttāḥ sarve te kuśalā matāḥ ||61 || guṇā ye sukhadāḥ sādhusevāpradā haripradāḥ | anyānandapradā mokṣakarāste kuśalā matāḥ ||62|| yāḥ sampado haryarthāḥ sādhvarthāḥ puṇyayogadāḥ | paropakāralābhārthā mokṣadāḥ kuśalā matāḥ ||63|| smṛddhayo yāstu yajñārthā devārthā dānadharmadā 5 | bhaktārthāścāpi gurvarthā divyāstāḥ kuśalāḥ sadā || 64|| gomahiṣyo vṛṣabhāśvā gajā yānāni dāsikāḥ | kṛṣṇārthā yasya sādhvarthā mokṣadāḥ kuśalāstu tāḥ ||65|| yo dehaśca mano vāṇīndriyāṇi vaibhavādayaḥ | haryathā yasya sādhvarthā mokṣadāḥ kuśalā hi te ||66|| yāḥ śayyāḥ sumṛdvyaścāpi svarṇapātrāṇi hīrakāḥ | ratnarūpyamaṇirdravyaṃ kṛṣṇārthaṃ kuśalaṃ tu tat ||67|| yadānandāśca saṃbhogā utsavāḥ suprasaṃgakāḥ | haryarthā yasya sādhvarthā mokṣadāḥ kuśalā hi te ||68|| ye’bhyāsāśca kalā vidyā vijñānaṃ jñātṛtottamā | āviṣkārāśca haryarthāḥ sādhvarthāḥ kuśalāstu te ||69|| āyavyayau tu haryarthau sādhyarthau mokṣamārgiṇau | māyābandhakṣapaṇakau divyau tau kuśalau matau ||3.221.70|| dānaṃ vrataṃ ca niyamā ācāro lokasammatiḥ | āśramaśca paddhatiśca haryarthāḥ kuśalāstu te ||71 || dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca haryarpitāstu ye sadā | yasya pumartharūpāste mokṣadāḥ kuśalāḥ sadā ||72|| śāsanaṃ dīnatā dāridryaṃ ca vanecaratvakam | mahāprāsādavasatirharyarthāḥ kuśalāstu te ||73|| vyāpārā yasya kṛṣṇārthā jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiṣu | turyāyāṃ brahmamuktau ca mokṣārthāḥ kuśalāstu te ||74|| atisnigdhāḥ sādhavaśca hariśca yasya santi vai | mokṣārthaṃ ca samāraṃbhāḥ kuśalaṃ tasya sarvathā ||75|| bhaktiryasya sadā gehe hṛdaye ca kuṭumbiṣu | harau sādhau mokṣamārge kuśalaṃ tasya sarvathā ||76|| yasya gehe hareḥ pūjā sādhūnāṃ svāgataṃ tathā | devānāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca kuśalaṃ tasya sarvathā ||77|| yasya gehe harernityaṃ prasādaścaiva bhojanam | vighasāśitvamutkṛṣṭaṃ kuśalaṃ tasya sarvathā ||78|| haryarthaṃ kṛtasarvasvaṃ cātmaniveditātmakam | niṣkāmabhaktiyogaśca kuśalaṃ tasya sarvathā ||95||| māyādṛṣṭirna vai yasya divyadṛṣṭiḥ śubhā sadā | sarvathā guṇagrāhitvaṃ kuśalaṃ tasya sarvathā ||3.221.80|| sādhuvākye harervākye viśvāsastasya pālanam | mokṣārthe sarvayatnaśca kuśalaṃ tasya sarvathā ||8 1 || viśvāso varaṇaṃ nyāsaḥ kārpaṇyaṃ sthiratā harau | dāsyaṃ raucyaṃ bhaved yasya kuśalaṃ tasya sarvathā ||82||| vacmyathākuśalānyatra yāni hānikarāṇi vai | nāstikatvamadharmitvaṃ bhaktiśūnyatvamudvratam ||83|| nindanaṃ drohakaraṇaṃ hiṃsā cākuśalāni vai | abhakṣyabhakṣaṇapānaṃ dinavandhyatvayāpanam ||84|| kusaṃgapāpisaṃgaśca mohābhimānagarvatāḥ | paraduḥkhapradāyitvaṃ sadaivākuśalāni vai ||85|| parastrīlampaṭatvaṃ ca paradravyābhikāṃkṣitā | paiśunyaṃ cāpi kāpaṭyaṃ sadaivākuśalāni vai ||86|| dharmabhaktivihīnatvamātmasādhanavarjitā | ajñānaṃ māyiko mohaḥ sadaivākuśalāni vai ||87|| tṛṣṇerṣyābhayalobhāśca satkriyāvarjanaṃ tathā | karmānubandhigamanaṃ sadaivākuśalāni vai ||88|| evaṃ viditvā satataṃ vidhehi kuśalāni vai | tyajākuśalāni śivajaya yāsyasi mokṣaṇam ||89|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | japa mantraṃ raṭa nāma harekṛṣṇa hare hare ||3.221.90|| māyāṃ tīrtvā brahmalokaṃ paraṃ padaṃ prayāsyasi | ityuktyā vṛṣaparvā saṃgṛhya pūjāṃ yayau vanam ||91 || bheje lakṣmi śivajayo’cyutaṃ māṃ puruṣottamam | sarvaṃ vyadhāt kuśalaṃ vai tatyājākuśalāni ca ||92|| mahābhāgavato jāto dhyāne’rpaṇe ca pūjane | anye śilpivarāścāsya gṛhe bhajanti mādhavam ||93|| satsaṃgaṃ te prakurvanti vratotsavān mahattamān | athaikadā tu dvādaśyāṃ prātarvratottaraṃ tu te ||94|| cakrurme pūjanaṃ rātrau jāgaraṇottaraṃ tathā | udyāpanaṃ pracakruśca kīrtanaṃ nartanaṃ tathā ||95|| tatrāhaṃ prādurabhavaṃ divyatejāścaturbhujaḥ | śrīkāntaṃ māṃ hariṃ vīkṣya jahṛṣuḥ parito’pi te ||96|| pupūjurmāṃ hṛdayotthaiḥ premāktavastubhistadā | mokṣaṃ te cārthayāmāsustathaityuktvā tirobhavam ||97|| atha kālāntare śivajayo bhaktasamanvitaḥ | dehaṃ tyaktvā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ matpārṣadāhṛtaḥ ||98|| evaṃ lakṣmi mama bhaktā yānti dhāmākṣaraṃ mama | bhajanāt pūjanādātmanivedanāt samāgamāt ||99|| satāṃ yogāt prayāntyeva divyā divyaṃ paraṃ padam | suśravāḥ pāṭhakāścāpi prayānti śreyasaṃ param || 3.221.100|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vṛṣaparvanāmarṣiyogena prāsādakārasya śivajayasya mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 221 ||
<3.222> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ jālakārakathāṃ tathā | jālakāraḥ kamalākhyāsarittīre vihārakṛt || 1 || vihāre cābhavanmatsyapāśajālavidhāyakaḥ | pakṣiṇāṃ bandhanaṃ pāde paśūnāṃ śṛṃgapādayoḥ || 2 || matsyādīnāṃ yathā dehe bhavet tādṛśajālikāḥ | karoti sūtrarajjūnāṃ vikrīṇāti samantataḥ || 3 || tadutpādyadhanādyaiśca nirvahatyeva bhojanam | nāmnā saṃgarayādasko nirmātṛnagare sthitaḥ || 4 || pāśavantaḥ samakrītvā jālānyasmāttu saṃgarāt | badhnanti jalajān vṛkṣavāsān vanajān dehinaḥ || 5 || ekadā saṃgarayādaḥ kṛtvā skandhe tu jālakān | kretuṃ yayau tu nagare krīṇantu jālakāniti || 6 || uccairvadati śrāvārthaṃ kukṣau poṭalikāṃ vahan | athāsya samayo jāto madhyāhnaśca kṣudhābhavat || 7 || krītvā bhakṣyaṃ cāpaṇādvai nagarād bahirāyayau | kamalāyāstaṭe gatvā prabhuṃjan sa jalaṃ papau || 8 || tāvad dṛṣṭvā bhikṣuko vai bhikṣecchayā hyupāgataḥ | nāmnā śuklāyanaḥ sādhurdadhan mālāṃ kare gale || 9 || raṭannāma harekṛṣṇa mukhe kṛṣṇaṃ hṛdi smaran | dhārayannahiṃsādharmaṃ vivekaṃ tu vicintayan || 3.222.1 0|| yātrāmātraṃ vahamāno nirdvandvastaṃ hyupāyayau | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 11 || aśrāvayat purā paścānniṣasāda tadantike | vāsasā varṣmaṇā cāpi malino’pi hṛdojjvalaḥ || 1 2|| ākarṣayanmanastasya saumyadṛṣṭyā vyalokayat | athecchanniva vāñchan vai maunaṃ dhṛtvā sthiro’bhavat || 1 3|| dhairyabhṛtaṃ suviśvāsyaṃ vīkṣya viraktayoginam | aprerito’pi daivena preritaḥ prāha jālakṛt ||14|| namaste sādhave sādho kutaḥ kathaṃ kimicchasi | sādhuḥ prāha namaścāntaryāmiṇe kuśalaṃ tava || 15|| icchāmi bhojanaṃ kiñcijjalapānasahāyadam | jālakāraḥ prasannātmā dadau bharjitatandulān || 16|| caṇakān bharjitām̐ścāpi manāk lavaṇayojitān | śubhaṃ te syāttathā nityaṃ nirāmayaṃ sukhodakam || 17|| sukhanidrā bhavatātte me tandulacaṇārpaṇāt | ityuktvā śrīhariṃ smṛtvā nivedya cāntarātmane ||18|| bubhuje tandulādīṃśca pītvā tṛptiṃ yayau tataḥ | papraccha vyavasāyaṃ ca jālakārasya vai tadā ||19|| jālakāro’vadajjālavyavasāyaṃ yathātatham | śrutvā sādhuḥ kṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dhyātvopadeśamācarat ||3.222.20|| śṛṇu saṃgarayādaska hitaṃ te vacmi sarvathā | caturaśītikhanayo bhavanti dehināmiha || 11 || tatra mānuṣadeho vai mokṣāya kalpitaḥ paraḥ | bahūnāṃ janmanāmante puṇyapuñjairhi mānuṣam ||22|| dehaṃ labhate dehīti tataḥ puṇyena vai divam | bhaktyā mokṣaṃ svadharmeṇa smṛddhiṃ saukhyaṃ vivekataḥ |||23|| dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca sādhayenmānavaḥ sadā | paśuprāyaṃ jīvanaṃ tu hiṃsakaṃ parivarjayet ||24|| hiṃsayā labhyate yāmyaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca narakālayaḥ | pāpa droho’pyaniṣṭaṃ ca hiṃsayā jāyate tathā || 25 || sāṃkaryaṃ jāyate cāpi dāridryaṃ janasaṃkṣayaḥ | hiṃsakānāṃ jāyate’dhogatirnirayagāmitā ||26|| hiṃsakānāṃ pāśadasya hiṃsāpāpaṃ prajāyate | jālakṛto’pi prāṇināṃ hiṃsāpāpaṃ prajāyate ||27|| mārakaḥ khādakaścāpyanumodakaḥ sahāyakaḥ | śastradaḥ pāśadaścāpi jāladaḥ samabhāg bhavet ||28|| jālakṛtastvavaśyaṃ te hiṃsāpāpaṃ prajāyate | jālabaddhā dehinastvāṃ niḥśvasantīva jālakam ||29|| jāladharaṃ jālakṛtaṃ śapanti santu duḥkhinaḥ | tasmāt sādhurahaṃ te’tropadiśāmi sukhāya te ||3.222.3 0|| prāṇatrāṇaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ tatphalaṃ sukhamuttamam | prāṇihiṃsāphalaṃ pāpaṃ tatphalaṃ duḥkhamulbaṇam ||3 1 || jālakāryaṃ jālakarma tyaktvā vastrāṇi saṃkuru | vastraiścāvaraṇayogyaiḥ pāpaṃ nodbhavati kvacit ||32|| ātmasādhanamāsādya kuru kalyāṇamātmanaḥ | snānaṃ dhyānaṃ hareḥ pūjāṃ paropakṛtimarpaṇam ||33 || sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ kṛtvā labdhvā puṇyaṃ divaṃ vraja | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ saṃpūjya bhāvataḥ || 34|| vratotsavām̐śca dānāni kṛtvā svargaṃ paraṃ vraja | mā hiṃsākārakaṃ jālaṃ saṃviracaya pāpadam ||35|| mānuṣajīvanaṃ sārthaṃ kuru mokṣādyupārjanāt | śāstrakathāṃ sadā śrutvā nārāyaṇaṃ samarjaya ||36|| nārāyaṇaṃ viditvaiva paraṃ padaṃ prayāhi ca | smara nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śrīpatiṃ kamalāpatim | |37|| akṣareśaṃ māṇikīśaṃ rādheśaṃ puruṣottamam | sa eva bhagavānatra mānave bhūtale’pi ca ||38|| divyadhāmeśvaraḥ sākṣājjāyate mānavākṛtiḥ | tasya sarvacaritrāṇi śubhāśubhāni yāni ca ||39|| divyānyeva bhavantyeva cintanīyāni tāni vai | mokṣadāni mahāśāntipradāni śubhadāni ca ||3.222.40|| kāmaḥ krodho bhayaṃ śokaḥ prītirjayaḥ parājayaḥ | kṣudhā tṛṣā kṛtirnidrā tatsarvaṃ tasya maṃgalam ||41 || nindyaṃ vācyaṃ nikṛṣṭaṃ ca nṛśaṃsyaṃ tasya karma yat | sarvaṃ kalyāṇadaṃ bodhyaṃ na doṣo vidyate harau ||49|| harernirguṇabhāvatvād divyatvāttasya sādhuṣu | hareḥ sambandhamāpteṣu nirguṇatvaṃ ca divyatā ||43 || vartate ceti vijñāya sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ | sādhuṣu snehamāsādya harau snehaṃ vidhāya ca ||44|| anyarāgaṃ vihāyaiva sthairyaṃ labhet pareśvare | evaṃ nityaṃ samabhyāsāt saṃskāro balavān bhavet ||45|| tena snehātiśayitā kṛṣṇe prajāyate muhuḥ | tathā satyeva bhaktasya jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiṣu ||46|| śrīharerdivyamūrtestu darśanaṃ samprajāyate | atisnehena sādhvīnāṃ tathā vīkṣā harerbhavet ||47|| atikāmena patnīnāṃ gopīnāṃ harivīkṣaṇam | atidveṣeṇa śatrūṇāṃ daityānāṃ harivīkṣaṇam ||48|| atisvārthena devānāṃ muhurvai viṣṇudarśanam | atitādātmyayogena yogināṃ brahmadarśanam ||49|| atijñānena viduṣāṃ sarvathā brahmadarśanam | evaṃ dāsyena bhavati sevayā kṛṣṇadarśanam ||3.222.50|| atyanuvṛttidharmeṇa hareḥ prasannatā bhavet | kṛpayā jāyate vīkṣā sarvadā śrīharestathā ||51 || satāmāśīrvacobhiśca nairmalye sati sarvathā | bhaktānāṃ hṛdaye bāhye sarvatra haridarśanam ||52||| harau ca kṛṣṇabhakteṣu pakṣapāto’sti yasya vai | kuṭumbiṣu yathā tadvat tatsatsaṃgo hi śāśvataḥ ||53|| evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya naśyanti doṣakoṭayaḥ | vāsanāśca vinaśyanti prodbhavanti satāṃ guṇāḥ ||54|| vinā snehaṃ harau satsu satsaṃgo naṣṭamūlakaḥ | yastu syānmānahīnaśca mumukṣurdivyadṛṣṭimān ||415 || mahimānaṃ vidan hareḥ sādhūnāṃ bhaktayoṣitām | tasya bodhyastu satsaṃgaḥ sadaiva dṛḍhamūlakaḥ ||16|| etādṛśānāṃ bhaktānāṃ virahaṃ cāsahan prabhuḥ | akṣarastho’gocaro’pi śreyase kṛpayā tviha |||77|| svecchayaiva narākāraṃ gṛhṇan carati bhūstare | tasyānuvṛttimāśritya vartitavyaṃ nirantaram ||58|| anuvṛttirasandehā hariprasādarādhanam | hareḥ prasādo yasyāsti tasya satāṃ prasannatā ||59|| prasannatāyā labdhyarthaṃ naiṣṭavyaṃ varṣmaṇaḥ sukham | satsaṃgo vapuṣā tanvā poṣṭavyo manasāpi ca ||3.222.60|| ayaṃ sākṣātprabhuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagadguruḥ | avatārī parabrahma śrīmadgopālanandanaḥ ||61|| ime santo harerbhaktā akṣaravyomavāsinaḥ | muktāḥ sarve’tra santyeva yoṣito’pi ramāsamāḥ ||62|| iyaṃ bhūścākṣaraṃ dhāma bālakṛṣṇasya yogataḥ | vayaṃ sarve divyamuktā nārāyaṇaprasaṃgataḥ ||63|| yatra kṛṣṇastatra dhāma muktā muktānikāstathā | mahadbhāgyamidaṃ naśca yad divyānāṃ samāgamaḥ ||64|| ebhiḥ samaṃ nivāso naḥ sarvaṃ divyaṃ yato mama | sevanīyo hariścāpi sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ ||65|| ājñāsteṣāṃ pālanīyāstato divyatvamāpyate | sādhuguṇāḥ samāyānti sādhvājñā pālanāt khalu ||66|| sādhūn seveta satataṃ devavat kṛṣṇavattathā | kṛṣṇadhyānaṃ paraṃ kāryaṃ kāryā bhaktiranekadhā ||67|| duḥsvabhāvāstathā pāpaṃ tyājyaṃ satāṃ prasevayā | śreyaḥśaktirvardhanīyā jetavyāścāntarārayaḥ ||68|| pratyakṣe vā parokṣe vā kṛṣṇo bodhyo nijāntike | pratyakṣadraṣṭā sarvatra vyāpako naikarūpadhṛk || 39|| antarātmā paramātmā lakṣmīśrīmāṇikīpatiḥ | pratyakṣaṃ cekṣate sarvaṃ sarvatrāsti paraḥ prabhuḥ ||3.222.70 || sthāvare jaṃgame cāsti sthūle sūkṣme tathetare | na tadvāñcchā vinā patracālane sabalo’nilaḥ ||7 1 || sarvakarmaphaladātā sarvaṃ dhṛtvā sa tiṣṭhati | pṛthvyāṃ dhāraṇaśaktirvai tasyaivāsti tathā jale ||72|| tṛptiśaktistasya cāsti gagane vidhṛtistathā | candrārkāgniprakāśānāṃ dātā sa parameśvaraḥ ||73|| etādṛśaḥ samartho’yaṃ vartate mānavo’tra vai | datte svadarśanaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kaṃbharāśrīsuto hariḥ ||74|| evaṃ nirantaraṃ citte cintanīyo hariḥ prabhuḥ | sa eva svāśritānāṃ tu duḥkhānyapākaroti hi |||75|| paritrāṇe samartho’sti vartate divyabhāvavān | kvacinmānavabhāvaistu sahate kaṣṭamityapi || 76| | bhayameti kāmayate kṣamate rauti vai kvacit | sarvāḥ kriyā hareratra kalyāṇadā hi pāvikāḥ ||77|| tasya prabhoḥ sādhavo’pi santi svātmeva tatpriyāḥ | aho’yaṃ bhagavān bhaktavaśo’tra vartate’pi ca ||78|| tatpratāpāttasya bhaktāḥ santi kalyāṇakāriṇaḥ | sādhavo mokṣadā naścetyevaṃ māhātmyamarjayet ||79|| alaukikī yasya buddhirharau satsu sadā yathā | sā vardhanīyā satataṃ na kubuddhiṃ prasaṃgajām ||3.222.80||
