svabhāvadoṣaṃ paśyenna divyaṃ paricayaṃ caret | tenāsadvāsanādoṣo hṛdayādapasarpati ||81 || bhaktiṃ vivardhayet sacca dehendriyamanaḥkṛtām | sarvasvārpaṇarūpāṃ tāṃ mahāmokṣapadāyinīm || 82|| mokṣasya sādhanaṃ mukhyaṃ satāṃ dāsyaṃ mataṃ padam | āpatkāle’pi satataṃ sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ ||83|| sādhukathāṃ harervārtāṃ śṛṇuyāt pāpanuttaye | mokṣāya cārpayet sarvaṃ dehaṃ gehaṃ dhanādikam ||84|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīmāṇikīpatim | jānīyāt paramātmānaṃ śrīpatiṃ rādhikāpatim ||85|| vāsudevādayo vyūhāḥ keśavādyāśca mūrtayaḥ | matsyādyā avatārāśca bālakṛṣṇasya santi vai ||86|| evaṃ māhātmyamāsādya satīva saṃśrayet patim | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhet kṛṣṇāt patnīva śaraṇī janaḥ ||87|| evaṃ saṃgarayādaska tyaktvā jālakriyāṃ bhavān | samācaratu vastrāṇāṃ vayanaṃ ca kaṭādikam ||88 || bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ parabrahma labha muktiṃ paraṃ padam | yāhi dhāmākṣaraṃ divyaṃ śāśvataṃ tvaṃ subhaktimān ||89|| iti śuklāyanaḥ sādhurupaviśya nadītaṭe | āśīrdatvā ca taṃ kṛtvā vaiṣṇavaṃ bhaktisevinam ||3.222.90 || tirobhavaddhi sahasā saṃgaro nijajālakam | gṛhe gatvā vibhidyeva rajjanāṃ dīrghanāḍakam ||9 1 || kṛtvā rarakṣa ca gṛhe tatyāja jālakāritām | bheje māṃ sakuṭumbaḥ sa bahubhaktān vyadhāpayat ||92|| bhajanaṃ me pūjanaṃ ca lakṣmi mokṣapradaṃ yathā | tadārabhyādrohadharmaṃ pālayāmāsa sarvathā ||93|| mūrtau māṃ gocaraṃ cakre dāsyasnehādibhiḥ sa ca | atha kāle samāyāte rathena saha mādhavaḥ ||94|| prayayau tadgṛhaṃ cāhaṃ netuṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ mama | rūpāvatīṃ tu tatpatnīṃ saṃgaraṃ ca rathe tvaham ||95|| niṣādya divyadehaṃ ca kṛtvā dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau | anye’pi bhaktasaṃghā me mayā nītā yayuḥ param ||96|| sarvapāpasamūhāstu mayā prajvālitā rame | bhaktānāṃ sādhubhaktānāṃ nairmalyaṃ kṛpayādadhe || 97|| api pāpāḥ pāpasaṃgā ajñā viṣayiṇo’pi ca | satāṃ yogena jāyante pāvanā brahmabhoginaḥ ||98|| striyo vā paśavaścāpi jaḍā vā malinā api | āsādya sādhusevāṃ saṃjāyante paṃktipāvanāḥ ||99|| na viprā na surā gāvo vratāni niyamā yamāḥ | na tīrthāni tathā śreṣṭhāḥ santaḥ śreṣṭhatamā yathā || 3.222.1 00|| sanmūrtirānakhaśikhaṃ sarvā divyā hi pāvanī | yathā nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāllakṣmīrnārāyaṇī yathā ||10 1 || satāṃ prasādo divyo’sti satāṃ sparśastathottamaḥ | satāṃ sevā hi sukhadā duḥkhahantrī haripradā || 102|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccintanādapi | pāpanāśaḥ puṇyalābho bhuktirmuktirbhavettathā ||1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne saṃgarayādaskabhaktasya jālakāryaṃ tyājayitvā śuklāyanasādhunā bhagavatprāptiḥ kāritetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 222 ||
<3.223> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvamajapālakathāṃ tathā | candrprabhāyāḥ sarito nikaṭe nandipattane || 1 || udyamaśrīsamākhyo’bhūd bharavāṭo hyajādhanaḥ | pañcaśatāni santyasyājānāṃ śataṃ gavāṃ tathā || 2 || uraṇānāṃ pañcaśataṃ gardabhānāṃ śataṃ tathā | śunāṃ tu daśakaṃ cāpi mahiṣīṇāṃ tu viṃśakam || 3 || cārāṇāṃ bhṛtyakāryāṇāṃ daśakaṃ tasya vidyate | patnīṣaṭkaṃ putraputrīsaptatiścāsya vidyate || 4 || sīmni nadītaṭe’raṇye śādvale ghāsasampadi | nibīḍauṣadhisaṃśobhe puṣkalatṛṇabhūtale || 5 || vasati nandipurato nātidūre suvṛttike | yatrānyabharavāṭānāṃ vasatiḥ paśurakṣiṇī || 6 || ghoṣātmikā vidyate vai vanyabhakṣyādikāriṇī | udyamaśrīrmahānāste yaśasā ca tathāyuṣā |7 || paśudhanena ca kuṭumbenātithiprasevayā | yasya vāse samāyānti vanino bahavo muhuḥ || 8 || svāgataṃ so’pi sarveṣāṃ karoti payaādibhiḥ | sādhavo yatayaḥ siddhāḥ samāyānti ca yoginaḥ || 9 || sādhvyaścāpi samāyānti sevābhāvigṛhe muhuḥ | satkārayati sarvān saḥ prasannayati bhojanaiḥ || 3.223.10 || dānamānaiḥ susanmānaiḥ pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ | striyaḥ putrāśca putraśca bharavāṭyo’pi nityadā || 11 || sevante sādhupuruṣān sādhvīśca bahubhāvataḥ | sarvasvārpaṇabhāvena sādhūnmatvā prabhuṃ harim || 12|| sādhuṣvāste hariḥ sākṣāt sādhvīṣvāste ramā svayam | abhyāgateṣu devāścāsate pūjyā yato hi te || 1 3|| evaṃ sevāṃ kurvatastu bhajamānasya māṃ prabhum | gṛhe tasyāyayuḥ sādhvyo viṃśatiḥ sāṃkhyayogagāḥ || 14|| yatinyastāśca vaiṣṇavyo vṛddhā bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ | tāsāṃ dugdhādibhiścāpi vanyabhojanasampradaiḥ || 15|| sanmānaṃ svāgataṃ cakre vāsaṃ kāṇḍagṛhe dadau | uṣustāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktānikāḥ striyaḥ || 1 6|| divyā divyaguṇopetāḥ snātvā nadyāmapūjayan | harikṛṣṇaṃ prāṇapatiṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam || 17|| tatastā bhojanaṃ cakrurnivedya paramātmane | viśrāntiṃ ca samālabhya sāyaṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ vyadhuḥ ||18|| ārārtrikaṃ caritrāṇāṃ kathāṃ cakruśca vārtikāḥ | vallavyo bālakāḥ kanyāḥ kathāṃ śrotuṃ sahasraśaḥ || 1 9|| āyayuḥ parito jñātvā sādhvīmaṇḍalamuttamam | mātarastā harermūrtau vimagnavṛttayaḥ sadā || 3.223.20 || bhajante ca raṭantyenaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vallabhaṃ prabhum | tāsu gurupadaṃ prāptā satīśvarītināmikā |||21 || sādhvī kathāṃ hareścakre śuśruvurgopikāstriyaḥ | vallavāśca tathā sarve śraddhayā bhaktibhāvayā ||22|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ sumokṣadām | pāpaprajvālikāṃ satīśvarī jagāda śobhanām ||23|| manaḥ kṛṣṇe dhṛtaṃ yena jitaṃ tena jagat khalu | jitaṃ bhavenmanastadvai yad dhṛtaṃ paramātmani ||24|| indriyāṇi viṣayeṣu prayānti manasā saha | ajitaṃ tu manastadvai viṣayaṃ prati yadgatam ||25|| parāvṛttya manovṛttimindriyavṛttikā harau | dhārayettanmanaścendriyāṇi jitāni tattadā ||26|| rāganāśe virāgaḥ syāttena mano jitaṃ bhavet | harau prītyā ca nānyatra gacchenmano jitaṃ bhavet ||27|| brahmasthityā vinaśyedvai rāgaśca kāmanādayaḥ | bhogabuddhirvinaśyecca manastena jitaṃ bhavet ||28|| śrīhareḥ śrīpaterdivyasukhe yasya tu magnatā | māhātmyajñānayuktasya tasya mano jitaṃ bhavet ||29|| dehabhāvavināśena cidbhāvo yasya vartate | manastasya jaḍaṃ nirutsāhaṃ jitaṃ bhavedapi ||3.223.30|| nityatṛptirhareḥ kāntānmāyikāttu nivartanam | tasya tṛptaṃ sthiraṃ cittaṃ mano jitaṃ sadā matam ||3 1 || dehābhimānanāśena cātmaniṣṭhābalena ca | rāgavāsanātyāgena mano jitaṃ sadā bhavet ||32|| nārīrūpaṃ manaḥ proktaṃ jīvātmā nararūpadhṛk | mano bhogaṃ jahātyeva mano jitaṃ bhavet svataḥ ||33|| ātmāhaṃ cetano nārī paramātmā naro mama | patirbhoktā sukhadātā nānyo me bhogakṛtparaḥ ||34|| sākṣātkṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇo hariḥ śrīkāntavallabhaḥ | pātā dhātā vidhātā saḥ priyaḥ prāṇapatiḥ patiḥ ||35|| svāmī dhāmī ca niṣkāmī sarvānandapariplutaḥ | mamānandapradaḥ kāntaścetyayaṃ puruṣottamaḥ || 36|| īśvarāṇāmavatārāvatāriṇīnāṃ śāsakaḥ | golokādhipatiḥ so’yaṃ vallavīsvāmitāṃ gataḥ || 37|| vaikuṇṭhādhipatiḥ so’yaṃ pārṣadāṇīpatiḥ prabhuḥ | muktānikāpatiḥ kṛṣṇo’kṣaradhāmavirājitaḥ || 38|| śrīpure’vyākṛte’mṛte śrīlakṣmīkamalāpatiḥ | lalitāmāṇikīnāthaḥ prabhāpadmāvatīpatiḥ ||39|| brahmapriyāpatiścāyaṃ haripriyāpatiḥ sa ca | viśālābadarīnāthaḥ śvetadvīparamāpatiḥ ||3.223.40|| kṣirodaśāradāsvāmī sītāpatiḥ satīpatiḥ | sarvasādhvīpatiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kumbhakārīpatiḥ sa hi ||41 || sarvamuktapatiḥ sādhupatiḥ sarvasakhīpatiḥ | sarvadāsīpatiḥ prāṇamātrapatiḥ paraḥ pumān ||42|| evaṃ jñātvā hariṃ kāntaṃ bhajet sarvasukhāśrayam | tasya mano bhavellagnaṃ kṛṣṇe tadvai jitaṃ matam ||43|| sa cāyaṃ bhagavānāste hṛdaye me madātmani | sañcidānandarūpaśca sādhusādhvīṣu rājate ||44|| śrīmadgopālabālaśca rājate’kṣarakṣetrake | sarvasukhanidhiḥ sākṣād vāsudevaḥ sa eva saḥ ||45|| mānavānāṃ ca devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ siddhayoginām | īśvarāṇāmavatārakoṭīnāṃ susukhāni vai ||46|| muktānāṃ brahmadhāmnāṃ ca yāni yāni sukhāni vai | tāni sarvāṇi kṛṣṇasya śrīkambharātmajasya tu ||47|| romṇa ekasya tu prānte vartante cedṛśaḥ prabhuḥ | sarvasukhanidhiḥ svāmī kṛṣṇo yo milito’sti naḥ ||48|| tasya dhāmnaḥ sukhasyāgre dhāmnāṃ sukhāni yāni vai | sarveṣāṃ lokapālānāṃ vyūhānāmīśadhāminām ||49|| grahāṇāṃ marutāṃ viśvedevānāmaśvinorapi | sādhyānāṃ ca vadhūnāṃ ca rudrāṇāṃ dyusadāmapi ||3.223.50|| sūryāṇāṃ vrahmaviṣṇūnāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ paraukasām | sthānāni nirayāṇyeva dhāmnaścāsya parātmanaḥ ||51|| tamimaṃ śrīpatiṃ kāntaṃ hitvā tu nirayābhidhān | kathamanyān sukhasaṃjñān bhaje’haṃ parameśvarī ||52|| evaṃ vijñāya māhātmyaṃ divyabhāvayutā satī | tyajenmohaṃ nirayāṇāṃ jitaṃ tasyā manaḥ sadā |||53|| vāsanā vilayaṃ yānti māyikyaḥ satataṃ tadā | etādṛśyā dehavāñcchā bhogavāñcchā ca māyikī ||54|| na jāyate sadā dagdhā jātā nirmūlikā hi sā | etādṛśaṃ mahimānaṃ yā na vetti harestviha ||55|| tasyā nare bhaved vṛttiḥ prākṛte’pi sakāmanā | putre mitre kalatrādau patyau sneho’pi bandhanam ||56|| manaso vartate tasyāḥ svārthavartanayoṣitaḥ | sā tyajet paramātmānaṃ kuṭumbasnehakarṣitā ||57|| rogādipīḍayā vā ca viṣayāprāptitastyajet | keśave tu manastasyā viṣayārthaṃ caret sadā ||58|| alābhe viṣayāṇāṃ tu pāmarā sā bhavettataḥ | patatyeva harerbhaktermokṣamārgaṃ na vindati ||59|| tasmāt sneho harau kāryaḥ svārthaśūnyo nisargajaḥ | na vai rūpānna vai kāmānna lobhānnaiva lābhajaḥ ||3.223.60|| na svārthādvā prakartavyaḥ snehaḥ kintu nisargajaḥ | divyaguṇacamatkāramāhātmyajñānasaṃbhavaḥ ||61 || kartavyo vai sadā sneho yasya nāśo na karhicit | guṇā divyā harau santi satyaśaucasukhādayaḥ ||62|| apāraṃ cāpi vātsalyaṃ mādhuryaṃ ca suśīlatā | sauhārdaṃ ca kṛpā sneho dayā śāntiḥ kṣamā ratiḥ ||63|| prītirhitakaratvaṃ ca sahanaṃ divyatā dhṛtiḥ | audāryaṃ śāśvatānanditvaṃ ca śaraṇarakṣitā ||64|| ete guṇāḥ samāyānti bhakteṣvapi prasevanāt | sadvārtāśravaṇenāpi guṇāḥ prāvirbhavanti hi ||65|| evaṃguṇiṣu bhakteṣu snehaḥ kṛṣṇasya jāyate | vapuṣā manasā vāṇyā dāsyaṃ kāryaṃ harestataḥ ||66|| hareḥ rucyanusāreṇa vartitavyaṃ tu varṣmaṇā | tapa ādi prakartavyaṃ hareḥ rucyanusārataḥ ||67|| hareḥ satāṃ yogināṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ śraddhayā sadā | śuśrūṣaṇaṃ prakartavyaṃ kṛṣṇe sneho dṛḍho bhavet ||68|| vacaḥ kaṭu na vaktavyaṃ satyaṃ vācyaṃ hitaṃ tathā | mahadbhirna vivādo’pi kartavyo na jayo’pi ca ||69|| nirmānaṃ komalaṃ vācyaṃ pramāṇaṃ namratānvitam | utkṛṣṭā vāk pravaktavyā mānyaṃ cājñāvaco hareḥ ||3.223.70 || ādarāt kaṭhinaṃ cāpi grāhyaṃ vaco hareḥ sadā | kriyānarhamasaṃbhāvyaṃ grāhyameva vaco hareḥ ||71 || evaṃ bhaveddhareḥ snehaḥ satāṃ snehastathā bhavet | darśane śravaṇe dhyāne pūjane sevane hareḥ ||72|| sannidhau śrīharermūrtāvaikāgryaṃ ceṣṭasiddhikṛt | muhurnavaṃ navaṃ yadvaddarśanaṃ cāpyalaukikam |||73||| sthiraṃ ciraṃ prakuryācca nānyat paśyettadā khalu | etādṛśaṃ darśanaṃ vai hareḥ snehasya kāraṇam ||74|| bahirvā cāntare vedṛg darśanaṃ snehakāraṇam | caladṛṣṭijane prītirjāyate naiva śārṅgiṇaḥ ||75|| satāṃ cāpi bhavennaiva prītiścānyavilokini | nare nāryāṃ paśau citre kapāṭe caladṛṣṭike ||76|| bahudhāreṇa manasā dṛṣṭiḥ kriyate cañcalā | tayā dṛṣṭyānyatra ganturna tatprītiḥ prajāyate ||77 || yathā kāmī janaḥ paśyet kāmukīṃ tvekacetasā | premaikatānabhāvena tathā paśyet prabhuṃ patim ||78|| antarā tvāgataṃ kiñcinnānusandheyamaṇvapi | ādyakṣaṇe yathā patyurvadhūṭyā darśanaṃ navam ||79|| dṛḍharūpadhṛtiprāptikaraṃ sphuraṇadāyakam | tathā nityanavaṃ tadvai darśanaṃ snehakāraṇam ||3.223.80 || kathāyāḥ śravaṇe tvevamaikāgryaṃ kāryameva yat | sphureccaritraśravaṇād bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ ||81 || sarvendriyeṣu cakṣurvā karṇo vā mana ityapi | cañcalāni viśeṣeṇa niyantavyāni tāni vai .||82|| kāmendriyaṃ tathā tebhyo’dhikaṃ vai cañcalaṃ yataḥ | mano niyamya kāmo’pi niyantavyo manoyutaḥ ||83|| anyathā śrīharerdhyāne pūjane grāmyamūrtayaḥ | viṣayāḥ kleśadāścāpi sphureyurvighnakāriṇaḥ ||84|| prabalaṃ cenmano liṅgaṃ cakṣuḥ karṇaḥ prayāti vai | viṣayeṣu tu grāmyeṣu tadā kāryaṃ vicāraṇam ||85|| hariṃ tyaktvānyaviṣaye gamane lābha eva na | viṣayā duḥkhadāḥ sarve māyābandhakarā yataḥ ||86|| ānandamūrtiḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīvallabhaḥ | tatra stheyaṃ śāśvatasyānandasya parilabdhaye ||87|| siddhadaśā divyadaśā modapramodaśevadhiḥ | sarvaṃ kṛṣṇādbhavatyeva tasmāllabha sukhaṃ mahat ||88|| anyatra yatamānasya kiñcit sukhaṃ bhavedapi | sarvaṃ duḥkhabahulaṃ tannirayasya pradaṃ tathā ||89|| tasmācchṛṇu kathāṃ paśya kṛṣṇaṃ cintaya sarvathā | ānandaṃ yāhi tasmādvai kṛṣṇāt kāntānna cetarāt ||3.223.90 || evaṃ kṛṣṇe kṛtasnehād vāñchitāṃ siddhimāpnuyāt | vibhūtiṃ sampado rūpaṃ śrīrādhāmāṇikīprabhum ||91 || viṣṇunārāyaṇatulyaṃ sarvamāpnoti tadrateḥ | sadehe sarvamāpyeta mṛtau vā dhāmni sarvathā ||92|| tasmāddharau sadā stheyaṃ cakṣuṣā manasā girā | karṇena hṛdayenāpi kāmena yāvadātmanā ||93|| evaṃ nityamanuvṛttyā kṛṣṇe prītimataḥ khalu | prītimatyā yoṣito vā syāt kṛṣṇaprītipātratā ||94|| kṛṣṇavat saṃsthitirdivyā lakṣmīvadvā bhavettataḥ | na nyūnaṃ syāddharestasya tasyāḥ śriyorna nimnatā ||95|| evaṃ lakṣmi mahāsādhvī satīśvarī tu vallavīḥ | vallavān bhagavatsnigdhānupādideśa muktaye ||96|| vallavyo vallavāścāpi bharavāṭāstathāpare | udyamaśrīprabhṛtayo jagṛhurbhaktimuttamām ||97|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | itimantraṃ satīśvaryā jagṛhurnāma cottamam ||98|| bālakṛṣṇa hare kānta rādhāpate ramāpate | mokṣakṛt vallabha sarvakāmaprada pumuttama ||99|| itināmāni jagṛhuḥ kīrtanaṃ cakrurādarāt | sādhvyastu bhajanaṃ kṛtvā prātarbhuktvānyakheṭakam || 3.223.10 0|| prayayurbharavāṭāśca bharavāṭyastathā muhuḥ | bhajanaṃ pūjanaṃ cakrurbālakṛṣṇasya sarvadā || 10 1|| tāsāṃ bhaktyā hi bhagavān rādhayā ramayā saha | prādurbabhūva sahasā māṇikyā ca śriyā saha || 1 02|| caturbhujasvarūpaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahotsave gṛhe | mandire vratadivase dvādaśyāṃ prātareva ha || 1 03|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpuḥ sahasraśo janāstadā | datvā svadarśanaṃ cāpi prasādaṃ pāyasaṃ śubham || 104|| mokṣārthaṃ varadānaṃ ca datvā tiro’bhavat prabhuḥ | so’haṃ lakṣmi tataḥ kāle prāpte udyamaśrījanam || 1 05|| bharavāṭān bhaktavaryān gopīśca premasaṃplutāḥ | ninye’haṃ mama dhāmaiva golokaṃ nityamuttamam || 1 06|| evaṃ sādhvīprasaṃgena bharavāṭyaśca vallavāḥ | tāritā māyikāllokāt snehabhaktyā kṛpālunā || 1 07|| evaṃ nāryo narā ye māṃ bhajiṣyanti samarpitāḥ | sarve yāsyanti paramaṃ matpadaṃ kāntasevanam || 1 08|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccaraṇādapi | bhuktirmuktirmahāsaukhyaṃ bhavenmayā samarpitam || 1 09|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne udyamaśrīprabhṛtigopālakānāṃ satīśvarīsādhvīsevayābhaktirmokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayoviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 223 ||
<3.224> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvamuṣṭrapālo marudbhuvi | nāmnābhavad dīrgharaṃbho grāme citrordhvasaṃjñake || 1 || uṣṭrā yasyābhavan pāreśataṃ śamīprabhojanāḥ | uchrāyabhūnivāsaśca kramelakorṇavikrayī || 2 || uṣṭravikrayakartā ca dhānyavyāpārakṛttathā | ekadeśādanyadeśe dhānyaprāpaṇakārakaḥ || 3 || prāyaśo vai vane vāsaṃ kurvannuṣṭrābhirakṣakaḥ | vane rātrau nivasati daśoṣṭrapālakaiḥ saha || 4 || śamīvane’titarale carantyuṣṭrāḥ samantataḥ | dīrgharaṃbhādayaḥ kṛtvā vahniṃ tadabhitastadā || 5 || niṣadya kambalairyuktā gṛṇanti rāmakīrtanam | devānāṃ ca kathāgītiṃ kurvanti militāstathā || 6 || pibantyuṣṭrāpayaścāpi nivedya prabhave hṛdi | khādanti roṭakān kṛtvā śamīśimbyāranālakaiḥ || 7 || nirgacchanti vanyamārge yadi kecitpravāsinaḥ | tebhyo dadati satkṛtya dugdhaṃ ca roṭakādikam || 8 || paropakāraḥ kartavyaścānnakambaladānakaiḥ | matvaivaṃ te cārpayanti kambalānapi cottamān || 9 || sādhavo vā tīrthayātrālavo milanti tatpathi | tebhyo’rpayantyannavāri kurvanti svāgatādikam || 3.224.10 || rāmabuddhyaiva satataṃ puṇyasatkarmavāñcchayā | yatheṣṭaṃ bhaktibhāvena sevante sādhumaṇḍalam || 11 || athaikadārbudayātrākaraṇāya tripuṣkaram | prāgacchanmaṇḍalaṃ sādhusādhvīnāṃ pathi cāgatam || 12|| kīrtayad vādyaghoṣaiśca rāmakṛṣṇajanārdana | narasiṃha hara viṣṇo kṛṣṇanārāyaṇācyuta || 1 3|| dṛṣṭvā tāṃstu dīrgharaṃbho gatvā pratipraṇamya ca | dugdhaṃ ca roṭakān tebhyo dadau madhyāhnake jalam ||14|| sāyaṃ te sādhavastatra viśrāntiṃ prāpurutsukāḥ | rātrau sarve tūṣṭrapālā asevanta sato janān || 15|| nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ kathāṃ rāmasya śuśruvustathā | atha sādhuvaraṃ rāmāyaṇākhyaṃ vaiṣṇavottamam || 1 6|| papraccha svātmakalyāṇaṃ kathaṃ syāditi cānataḥ | rāmāyaṇaḥ pratyuvāca tadā kalyāṇasādhanam || 17|| sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ cāpi rāmanāmnāṃ sukīrtanam | bhaktiṃ viṣṇornavadhāṃ ca kalyāṇasādhanāni hi || 18|| rāmasya vandanaṃ nityamarcanaṃ bahuvastubhiḥ | mānasairupacāraiścāpyarcanaṃ hṛdaye’nvaham ||1 9|| kalyāṇasādhanaṃ ceti dhyānaṃ rāmasya cintanam | premṇā pulakitagātro gadgadākṣaravāk tathā ||3.224.20|| tatsvarūpaikacintaśca bhavedbhakto’rcane hareḥ | bāhyapūjākaro yadvā cāntarārhaṇakārakaḥ || 21|| viśiṣyate’yaṃ bhaktau vai sarvebhyo bhaktasammataḥ | aikāgryarahitaḥ sneharahitastu na śasyate ||22|| pūjane sevane yasya śraddhā bhavati bhūyasī | kathāyāṃ kīrtane yasya śraddhādarau viśeṣataḥ ||23|| māhātmyaṃ yasya cotkṛṣṭaṃ bhakte yasya sumitratā | yasya rāmārcanādau vai bhūrikālo yathā kṣaṇaḥ ||24|| navadhāpi hareḥ sevā yasya nūtnānuvāsaram | na gauṇī yasya jīrṇā na kvacit kvāpi bhavediyam ||25|| śraddhābhaktiryasya nityaṃ nūtanā nūtanojjvalā | sa mukto’tra ca muktā sā naro nārī hi bhūtale || 26|| dūrasthā api bhaktā īdṛśāḥ kṛṣṇāntikasthitāḥ | yadi naitādṛśāḥ pārśvasthitāste dūravanmatāḥ ||27|| tasmāt prītyudayasiddhyai yatitavyaṃ nirantaram | śravaṇe manane nididhyāsane divyadarśane ||28|| kṛṣṇe tādātmyamāpannāt sādhormukhāddhareḥ kathā | śrotavyā śrīhareḥ smṛtyā sahitārthasya dhāriṇī ||29|| śrutārthasya tu mananaṃ punaḥ punarvicāraṇam | sapremamūrtisahitaṃ kartavyaṃ vāsanāpaham ||3.224.30|| tataḥ saṃskārajaṃ śuddhaṃ smaraṇaṃ nididhyāsanam | kartavyaṃ śraddhayā prītyā prasannastasya mādhavaḥ ||31|| bhavettena hareḥ sphūrtiḥ sahajā nityamāntare | sākṣātkāro bhavet sphūrtau divyamūrterhareḥ sadā ||32|| evaṃ prītirharau kāryā tayā prītirharerbhavet | parasparaprītimatostādātmyaṃ jāyate tataḥ ||33|| brahmacaryamātmaniṣṭhā vairāgyaṃ śravaṇādayaḥ | kṛṣṇāśrayaśca sākṣātkārahetavasta īritāḥ ||34|| mananaṃ ca nididhyāso bhakteṣṭasiddhidāyakau | kevalaṃ śravaṇaṃ naiva sākṣātkāraphalapradam ||35|| vāsanā nahi naśyanti nididhyāsanamantarā | hṛdgranthayo vinaśyanti kṛṣṇākhaṇḍavicintanāt ||36|| nididhyāsanayuktasya pratyakṣadraṣṭureva ha | pūrṇakāmatānandāśca vartante netarasya tu ||37|| bāhyaṃ kṛṣṇasya draṣṭurvai mantuśca hṛdaye tathā | smartuḥ rūpaṃ ca satataṃ drutaṃ sphurati keśavaḥ ||38|| anevaṃvartamānasyānevaṃyatnakṛto’pi ca | naiva sphurati viśvātmā divyātmā bhagavān hṛdi ||39|| tasmāt kṛṣṇasya hṛdye sākṣātkārasya sādhanam | śravaṇaṃ mananaṃ nididhyāsanaṃ prītirucyate ||3.224.40 || prītyā satatasandhātryā sphurati kāntavaddhariḥ | tasmācchrutasya dṛṣṭasya harestu mananaṃ tathā ||41|| smaraṇaṃ premasahitaṃ śraddhānvitaṃ samācaret | tasyopari hareḥ prītirjāyate dhāmayojikā ||42|| dehe jīvasya tādātmyaṃ yāvadvai vartate ca tat | kṛṣṇe snehe mahāvighnaṃ bodhyaṃ saṃsārajanmakṛt ||43|| tasmād dehādayamātmā bhinna ityavabodhanam | guroḥ sataśca śāstrācca prāptavyaṃ ca vivekinā ||44|| bhramo nāśayitavyaśca tādātmyasya jaḍātmanoḥ | svarūpāṇi jaḍasyāpi cetanasyāpi sarvathā ||45|| dharmāścāpi praboddhavyā yairvailakṣaṇyametayoḥ | sphurettena tu tādātmyabhrāntirnaśyet samūlikā ||46|| jaḍo duḥkhamayo rugṇo naśvaro vikṛtaḥ kṣayī | lālāmūtramalavyāpto janmamṛtyujarānvitaḥ ||47|| khaṇḍanaddho bahvavastho māyiko bhautikaścayī | piṇḍo hrāsī naikarūpo deho’yaṃ vartate sadā ||48|| indriyāṇi samagrāṇi sūkṣmadehaguṇāni vai | duḥkhadoṣodvegacintākarāṇi tādṛśāni ca ||49|| etādṛśo nāhamasmi cidrūpaḥ sukhavānaham | arogī śāśvato nirvikāraḥ kṣayavivarjitaḥ ||3.224.50|| saccidānandarūpo’smi janmamṛtyujarātigaḥ | akhaṇḍaḥ sthira eko’haṃ divyo māyāvivarjitaḥ ||51 || abhautikaścayaśūnyaḥ prakāśī hāsavarjitaḥ | ekarūpo nirmalaścāsaṃgī draṣṭāmaro’smi ca ||52|| śaktayo mama divyāścendriyaśaktipraprerikāḥ | etādṛśo bhavāmyeva cetano mokṣadharmavān ||53 || ityātmānātmanoḥ samyag vivekaṃ samacintayet | satāṃ mukhācchāstrato vā jñātvā taṃ pariśīlayet ||54|| pakve jñāne dehadharmasāṃkaryaṃ nātmadharmasu | ātmaniṣṭho bhavettena bhagavanniṣṭha ityapi |||55|| brahmarūpo bhavedeva muktarūpo’tra mānavaḥ | na tasya vāsanā tiṣṭhenna bhramo nāpi yātanāḥ ||56|| ātmānātmaviveko’yaṃ yasya nāsti dṛḍhīkṛtaḥ | sa dehadharmairduḥkhādyaiḥ pīḍyate bhramanoditaḥ ||57|| yāvadabhyāsaśaithilyaṃ tāvaddehātmadhīvaśaḥ | paśuvat pāśavīṃ vṛttiṃ caratvahaṃmamātmikām |||58|| dehendriyādyaikyarūpāṃ kāmasaṃkalpamohinīm | strīpuṃvittarasāsaktiduḥkhatṛṣṇāghasaṃbhṛtām ||59|| miṣṭabhokṣye garavat sā duḥkhadā cātmamodane | tayā vṛttyā nirayān sa prayātyeva tu māyikān ||3.224.60 || nirayeṣu gatirnaiva yathā syāt prayateta tat | ātmaniṣṭhāṃ sādhayīta hareḥ satāṃ prasevayā ||61 || premṇā māhātmyavittyā ca dehaniṣṭhāṃ parityajet | śraddhayā sampraseveta sādhūn bhaktyā janārdanam ||62|| ājñāyāṃ cāti tiṣṭhecca hareḥ sādhornirantaram | śāstradharmān pālayecca māhātmyajñānamarjayet ||63|| evaṃ nirvāsanatvaṃ syāt kṛṣṇe snehāttu tad drutam | māhātmyajñānasahitā bhaktiḥ kṛṣṇe vivardhate ||64|| māhātmyajñānahīnasya naśyanti bhaktidā guṇāḥ | māhātmyajñānayuktasya guṇāḥ kalyāṇakāriṇaḥ ||65|| sarve tvāgatya vartante hṛdaye tu yathā satām | guṇānāmāgame sarvā naśyanti vāsanā drutam ||66|| bhajamānasya bhaktasya vāsanāśeṣasaṃbhave | mṛtyuścejjāyate tasya janma devādiṣūjjvalam ||67|| sampadbhogakaraṃ syādvai bhaktānāṃ ca gṛhe tataḥ | vāsanānāśamāsādya tato muktirbhavet dhruvā ||68|| savāsanasya bhaktasya yāmyagatirna vidyate | bhaktiphalaṃ devaloka īśaloko’thavā mataḥ ||69|| mahācakravartirājā bhakto bhūtvākṣaraṃ vrajet | apārakaruṇaḥ kṛṣṇo bhaktasya paramā gatiḥ ||3.224.70|| sa taṃ nirvāsanaṃ kṛtvā svabhaktaṃ parirakṣati | kṛṣṇadhāmnaḥ sakāśāttu māyikā vaibhavā api ||71 || bhaktānāṃ nirayā eva bhāsante cātmavedinām | bhuktvā tyaktvā tataste tān prayānti cākṣaraṃ padam ||72|| rāmanāma japan kṛṣṇaṃ spṛśan paśyan narāyaṇam | divyaśca nirmalo brahmarūpo bhūtvā paraṃ padam ||73|| prayāti yogināṃ sthānaṃ muktānāṃ padamuttamam | satāṃ maṇḍalamadhyastho’śnute’kṣare mahāsukham ||74|| bhaktā yadvāpyabhaktā vā sākṣāddharestu darśanam | sparśanaṃ sevanaṃ kuryuste divyāḥ saṃbhavanti vai ||75|| abhaktāścet samanaskāḥ sevante prītisaṃbhṛtāḥ | tadā te vāsanāṃ tyaktvā prayānti paramaṃ padam ||76|| api bhaktā nirmanaskāḥ sevante śrīpatiṃ prabhum | tadā te’pi śanairjanmāntare yāsyanti tatpadam ||77|| tīvrasaṃvegabhaktānāmāsannatama īśvaraḥ | mandasaṃvegabhaktānāṃ dūratamo janārdanaḥ ||78|| nirmanaskaṃ harernāmakīrtanaṃ darśanaṃ spṛśiḥ | sevanādyaṃ tu naiva syāt sampūrṇaphaladaṃ kvacit ||79|| nirmanaskaṃ tu yaddhyānaṃ sphūrtihīnaṃ tu tadbhavet| | yatra nārāyaṇamūrtirnaiva bhāseta karhicit ||3.224.80 | tasmād bhaktā ubhayathā bāhye vā cāntare’rhaṇe | sapremaikāgryavṛttyādyaiḥ śīlayeyurmahāprabhum ||81 || te śrīkṛṣṇapratāpena dehānte sadya eva ha | yayuḥ śrīkāntagolokaṃ muktāḥ syurdivyavigrahāḥ ||82|| anye tu puṇyamāsādya bhaktyādīnāṃ punarjanum | samāsādya samāpyaiva puṇyaṃ yāsyanti tatpadam ||83|| gopīnāmiva sarvasvārpaṇairyeṣāṃ tu sevanam | sparśamīkṣā kīrtanaṃ ca vyavasthātrivapuḥkṛtam ||84|| te prayānti drutaṃ kṛṣṇātmakaṃ divyaṃ pramokṣaṇam | smṛtiṃ vinā kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ mokṣadaṃ na tat ||85|| uṣṭrapālā bhavanto vai kurvantu tat tathāvidham | premṇā prītyā manasā ca sarvārpaṇena vai hṛdā ||86|| sevanaṃ kīrtanaṃ cāpi sparśanaṃ śrīhareḥ satām | tīvrasnehāḍhyabhaktānāmāśu muktirbhaviṣyati ||87|| vanināṃ kīrtanaṃ sevā bhaktiśca muktisādhanam | viprāṇāṃ karmaṣaṭkaṃ ca bhaktirnavadhā muktaye ||88|| satāṃ snānaṃ dhyānamiṣṭaṃ pūjā prasevanaṃ tathā | vairāgyaṃ cātmaniṣṭhā ca kṛṣṇaniṣṭhā ca muktaye ||89|| nārīṇāṃ kāntabhāvena sevanaṃ snehapūritam | sarvārpaṇaṃ cānuvṛttirdāsītvaṃ muktaye harau ||3.224.90|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | japantu paramaṃ mantraṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ raṭantvapi ||9 1|| pūjanaṃ mānasaṃ dhyātvā kurvantu paramātmanaḥ | smarantu taccaritrāṇi tato muktiṃ vrajantvapi |||92|| ityuktvā sādhavaḥ sarve rāmāyaṇādayo rame | viremuḥ pūjitāścāpi bhojitāḥ prayayustataḥ |||93 || dīrgharaṃbhādayaḥ sarve bhejuḥ sādhūktarītitaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīvallabhaṃprabhum ||94|| harekṛṣṇa harerāma hareviṣṇo hareprabho | bālakṛṣṇa hare sītāpate rādhāpate vibho ||95|| evaṃ te bhajanaṃ cakruruṣṭrapālā vane gṛhe | sambhūya satataṃ snehabhaktyā lakṣmi prabhormama ||96|| atha kālāntare yāte dīrgharambhādikānaham | muktiṃ netumāyayau ca divyarūpaścaturbhujaḥ ||97|| vaikuṇṭhādhipatiḥ rāmaḥ sītayā saha śobhanaḥ | vimānena tu divyenānayaṃ taṃ cetarānapi ||98|| uṣṭradānāni sādhubhyo dattāni yāni tānyapi | divyarūpadharānuṣṭrānādāya samupāyayau || 99|| sarvabhūṣādharān ramyān svarṇavarṇān vihaṃgamān | kikiṇīghurghuraśabdān nītvāhaṃ samupāyayau || 3.224.1 00|| ye ye bhaktā uṣṭrapālāstām̐stān divyān vidhāya ca | ārohayitvā coṣṭreṣu divyadhāmānayaṃ mama || 101 || evaṃ muktā uṣṭrapālāḥ rāmāyanaprasaṃgataḥ | mayā sarve kṛtā divyā lakṣmi bhaktyā kṛpālunā || 1 02|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccintanādapi | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi tatheṣṭarddhiśca sampadaḥ || 103|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne rāmāyanākhyasādhuyogena dīrgharavādīnāmuṣṭrapālānāṃ mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 224 ||
<3.225> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ ratnaprabheti nāminaḥ | kharapālasya bhaktasya kathāṃ mokṣapadāṃ śubhām || 1 || lūṇīnadītaṭe lūṇīnagaryām̐ kṣatriyottamaḥ | ratnaprabhābhidhaścāsīt sahasrakharapālakaḥ ||2 || lambakarṇaiḥ karotyeva dhānyādīnāṃ praṇāyanam | deśād deśāntaraṃ grāmād grāmāntaraṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 3 || śreṣṭhināṃ ca nṛpādīnāṃ vyāpārān gardabhaiḥ sa tu | karotyānayanaṃ cāpi nayanaṃ śramamūlyataḥ || 4 || evaṃ dhānyāni bahūni pātrāṇi samidhastathā | araṇyāt kṣetrakhalato nagarānnagarāntarāt || 5 || grāmāntaraṃ grāmamadhyaṃ prāpayatyeva gardabhaiḥ | śramamūlyaṃ grahītvaiva gṛhayātrāṃ dadhāti vai || 6 || athaikadā sa godhūmān sahasradvayakoṣṭhalīḥ | kharapṛṣṭheṣu nītvaiva lūṇīgrāmād viniryayau || 7 || catvāriṃśatkharapālairbhṛtyairyutaśca nirbhayaḥ | yuddhapurīṃ rājadhānīṃ yayau sūryātape dine || 8 || mārge tu gacchatastasya śramo’bhavattadātape | gardabhānāṃ śramo’pyevaṃ viditvā śrāntimālabhat || 9 || taruṣaṇḍe jalanālīpārśve ghaṭīdvayaṃ hi saḥ | tatra vai vasati sādhumaṇḍalaṃ vanyanirbharam ||3.225.10|| ratnaprabhastathā cānye pāyayitvā jalaṃ kharān | roṭakādyaśanaṃ kṛtvā sādhūnāmagrato yayuḥ ||11|| natvā jayaśrīrāmeti samuccārya puraḥ sthitāḥ | sādhavaḥ svāgataṃ cakrurāśīrvādān dadustadā ||12|| gamanāgamane jñātvā jñātvā vyāpārajaṃ śramam | hitārthe dyayā prāhurnārāyaṇāśrayaṃ śubham ||13|| sādhuvaryo narasiṃhasvāmīti sādhusevitaḥ | upādideśa sarvebhyo ghaṭikāmātramacyutam ||14|| aho sarve kṛtaṃ loke na kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇasevanam | tarhi sarve niṣphalaṃ vai garbhasyeva hi dehina: ||15|| yathā candanabhārāḍhayaḥ kharo bhāraṃ pravetti vai | sugandhaṃ naiva vettīti tadānandavivarjitaḥ ||16|| tathā śramaparo loke kṛṣṇabhaktivivarjitaḥ | bhāravettā na tu cātmarasavettā nigadyate ||17|| dvayoḥ śramavahatvena kharamānavayornahi | viśeṣo dṛśyate tatra mānavaḥ kharavaddhi saḥ || 18|| kulālasya vaśaṃ yānti rāsabhāḥ paśavo yathā | svakarmaṇāṃ vaśaṃ yānti kulālāḥ paśavo’pare ||19|| bhaktihīnā dharmahīnāḥ puruṣārthavivarjitāḥ | dānapuṇyavihīnāstu mānavā rāsabhā iva ||3.225.20|| tīrthasevāvihīnāśca snānapūjāvivarjitāḥ | sādhusevādirahitā mānavā rāsabhā iva ||21|| ātmakalyāṇahīnāśca saṃsaktā rāsanādiṣu | śiśnodaratṛpā loke mānavā rāsabhā iva ||22|| kuṭumbabhāravoḍhāraḥ śreyomārgavihīnakāḥ | viṣayaghāsagrāsāśca mānavā rāsabhā iva ||23|| maryādāśūnyavartmānaḥ pitṛsevāvivarjitāḥ | sarvātmabuddhihīnāśca mānavā rāsabhā iva ||24|| āhāramātrayatnāśca tapovratavivarjitāḥ | bhasmāvaguṇṭhā nirvastrā mānavā rāsabhā iva ||25|| upāsanāleśaśūnyāḥ pañcadeveṣu nāstikāḥ | | gurau pūjyatvarahitā mānavā rāsabhā iva ||26|| gṛhiṇo’pi śrāddhahīnā yajñanaivedyavarjitāḥ | vyavāyaparamā lubdhā mānavā rāsabhā iva ||27|| catuṣpadā bālapucchā bhogasthānābhivṛttayaḥ | devasmaraṇahīnāśca gṛhiṇo rāsabhā iva ||28|| aślīlaśravaṇe lambakarṇāḥ kleśe virāviṇaḥ | dhāvamānā viṣayārthe gṛhiṇo rāsabhā iva ||29|| aśāntā viṣayairvātaiścaranto māyikaccarān | kṣapayanti vṛthāyuṣyaṃ gṛhiṇo rāsabhā iva |3.225.30|| sādhutīrthe snānavanto hyapi śāstrajalaplutāḥ | | amāhātmyavidaścājñā luṭhanti pāpa bhasmasu ||31|| satsu saptasu putreṣu gardabhī bhāravāhinī | satsu satsu tārakeṣu gṛhiṇyo bhāravāhikāḥ ||32|| satsu saptasu putreṣūṣṭrasya bhāro na hīyate | satsu gṛhiṣu putreṣu piturbhāro na hīyate ||33|| uṣṭrasya jaraṭhasyāpi śatakrośapradhāvanam | vṛddhasya mānavasyāpi śatākrośapradhāvanam ||34|| carati rāsabho grāme carati mānavo gṛhe | carati na harau kvāpi ko bhedo gardabhe nare |35|| lambagalaḥ sadoṣṭro’sti khādye lambagalo naraḥ | sāmyāhāre nare coṣṭre ko bhedo bhaktivarjite ||36|| tāḍanaṃ lakuṭairnityamekasyānyasya vācikaiḥ | acintakau duḥkhahāneḥ ko bhedo mānave khare ||37|| khare khaścendriyārthaśca tāni raltīti vai kharaḥ | nare no nārāyaṇārthastaṃ rātīti naraḥ smṛtaḥ || 38|| nārāyaṇaṃ narastyaktvā narakaṃ cet samṛcchati | khare nare ca ko bhedo nakhaśaphādidehajaḥ ||39|| gatiścānargalā yasya kharasya ca narasya ca | amaryādā karmaṇāṃ ca ko bhedo vai khare nare ||3.225.40|| snāti cenna naraḥ kharo naiva snāti kadācana | gṛṇāti na harernāma naraḥ kharaḥ sa eva saḥ ||43 || tasmāt prātaḥ samutthāya snātvā raṭennarāyaṇam | pūjayetparamātmānaṃ bhojayecchrīpatiṃ prabhum ||42|| tato bhuñjīta puṇyaṃ tatprasādaṃ ca jalaṃ pibet | seveta sādhupuruṣān bhajeta śrīhariṃ sadā ||43|| abhyāsaṃ vidadhītāpi nāmasaṃkīrtanasya vai | svapne jāgrati suptau ca kṛṣṇamūrtiṃ vibhāvayet ||44|| indriyāṇāṃ bahirvṛttimattve jāgrat prakīrtitam| tadā bāhye harermūrtirdraṣṭavyā sādhavo’pi ca ||45|| bāhyaiḥ sarvaprayatnaiśca sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ | vivekena sevanīyāḥ sattvapradhānajāgrati ||46|| bhrāntyāpi te sevanīyā rajaḥpradhānajāgrati | śokaśramādinā sevyāstamaḥpradhāna jāgrati ||47|| indriyāṇāṃ vṛttayastu hṛdayaṃ kaṇṭamāśritāḥ | golakānāgatāḥ saiṣā svapnāvasthā hi nidritā ||48|| vivekena tadā svapne sevanīyā hri sādhavaḥ | tadā hariḥ sevanīyaḥ svapne sattvapradhānake ||49|| bhrāntyā buddhayā sevanīyāḥ svapne rajaḥpradhānake | śokaśramādinā sevyāḥ svapne tamaḥpradhānake ||3.225.50|| vṛttīnāṃ hṛdaye manāg vāsaścārdhasuṣuptikā | kṣaṇaṃ samānasevā vai kartavyāḥ sattvasuptike||51 || kṣaṇaṃ vibhrāntasevā tu kāryā rājasasuptike | kṣaṇaṃ layārpaṇasevā kāryā tāmasasuptike ||52|| arthāllayo’pi kṛṣṇe tatsatsu bhramaṇamityapi | manāg bhānaṃ harī satsu nānyatra māyike tadā ||52 || tata ātmani parame sarvalayaḥ suṣuptikā | ātmanaḥ śrīharau caikyaṃ turyapadaṃ suṣuptikā ||54|| tadbhogastadratistasmin cetanārpaṇamityapi | ānandārpaṇamevāpi jīvanārpaṇamityapi ||55|| prāṇārpaṇaṃ tathā sarvasaṃskārārpaṇamityapi | sarvabhogārpaṇaṃ pūrṇasuṣuptiḥ sā harau sadā ||56 || kartavyā bhagavadbhaktairyatra brahmasukhaṃ mahat | ahantāmamatānāśaḥ kartṛtāvetṛtālayaḥ ||57|| harau nārāyaṇe viṣṇau vāsudeve nijātmanaḥ | tadā hariḥ parabrahmāntaryāmī karmadarśakaḥ || 58l draṣṭā bhavati cātmasthasturyapadaṃ paraṃ hi tat | tatrāpi bhagavān sevyaḥ samādhāviva turyake ||59I santastathā sevanīyā mūrtau līnā hi turyake | dhāmadṛṣṭayā dhāmaśaktyā dhāmendriyaiśca tejasā || 3.225.60|| dhāmakriyābhirbhagavān sevanīyo nijātmanā | brahmātmanā parabrahma sevanīyaḥ pare pade ||61|| divyayā caikarasayā tanvā brāhmayā narāyaṇaḥ | sevanīyastadā turyapad nijātmanā śriyaḥ ||62|| eṣā mokṣasthitiścātra dhāmno mokṣeṇa miśritā | ānandanīyā sā kṛṣṇe’nādiśrīkṛṣṇavallabhe ||63|| sarvāvasthā arpaṇīyā nārāyaṇe pareśvare | bālyaṃ ca yauvanaṃ vārdhakyaṃ ca deyaṃ parātmani || 64|| nārītvaṃ va naratvaṃ ca deyaṃ vai paramātmani | kanyātvaṃ va kumāratvaṃ dampatītvaṃ vanitvakam || || yatitvaṃ maraṇaṃ cāpi samarpaṇīyaṃ mādhave | vimarśaśca tathā bindurnādo dhvaniḥ padāni ca || 66|| parā hyaparā paśyantī madhyā vaikhariketi ca | arpaṇīyā harau sarvā brahmajā brahmamūrtayaḥ ||67|| parā vāṇī samastā yā brahmavarṇanarūpiṇī kṛṣṇasya ca satāṃ vārtā kīrtanagāyanātmikā || 68|| harerlīlā caritrāṇāṃ varṇanaṃ bhaktivarṇanam || varṇanaṃ cāvatārāṇāṃ praśaṃsā tatsatāmapi || 69|| bhaktānāṃ varṇanaṃ cāpi parā vāṇī nigadyate | mokṣadā divyaśabdā yā sarvā parā prakīrtitā ||3.225.70|| arpaṇīyā harau sāpi hareḥ prītikarī sukhā | athānyā lokaviṣayā vyavahāraniyojikā ||71 || yathārthā satyarūpā ca ṛtaphalāpi puṇyadā | paśyantī sā sadā vāṇī cārpaṇīyā harau sadā ||72|| īśvarāṇāṃ ca devānāmṛṣīṇāṃ sā sadā matā | sattvaprakāśasukhadā cārpaṇīyā pareśvare ||73|| athānyārthaparā yāpi nindāpraśaṃsanātmikā | lokasvārthasādhanā ca bhrāntiviparyayāṃśajā ||74|| madhyā sā bhāratī puṇyāpuṇyaphalāphalapradā | arpaṇīyā harau kṛṣṇe sarvathā bhaktiśālinā ||75|| athetarārthaśūnyā vā duṣṭārthodvegakāriṇī | nikṛṣṭā prākṛtī vāṇī vitaṇḍā niṣphalobhayā ||76 || śroturvaktuḥ phalaśūnyā bhaṃgamātraparāyaṇā | kleśamātrānvitā sā tu vaikharī cādhamā sadā ||77|| sāpi kṛṣṇe cārpaṇīyā deśakāloditā yadi | athānyā niścitaikārthā bahvarthā cāparā api ||78|| aspaṣṭārthā ca spaṣṭārthā caturdhāpi sarasvatī arpaṇīyā sadā kṛṣṇe tato divyā hi muktidā ||79|| padavākyapramāṇāni deyāni paramātmani nyāyasiddhisvarūpāṇi deyāni paramātmani ||3.225.80|| bhūtabhautikatattvāni deyāni paramātmani dhyeyadhyānadhyātṛvargā deyāste paramātmani ||81|| bhogyabhogabhoktuvargā deyāste paramātmani | bhagaṃ bhaktirbhajamāno deyāḥ śrīparameśvare ||82|| aindryamindra indriyāṇi cārpaṇīyāni mādhave | naratā vā kharatā vā nikṣeptavyā harau prabhau ||83|| divyā sā tu tadā bhūtvā kuryānnakharatāṃ jane | nasya nārāyaṇasyaiva khaṃ divyaṃ vyoma cākṣaram ||84|| tatra ratāṃ prītimeva kuryānnakharatāmiti | evaṃ lakṣmi vopadiṣṭā ratnaprabhādayastadā ||85|| narasiṃhasvāminā vai sādhunā hariyoginā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |86|| datvā mantraṃ kṛtāḥ pūtā vaiṣṇavā mama bhaktigāḥ | atha matvā guruṃ devaṃ nṛsiṃhasvāminaṃ ca te ||87|| pūjayāmāsuratyarthaṃ bhojayāmāsurādarāt | āśīrvādān jagṛhuśca tebhyaḥ kalyāṇakāriṇaḥ || 88|| sādhūnnatvā yayurgrāmāntaraṃ rāsabhapālakāḥ | svīyālaye hyuktarītyā hariṃ bhejurhare hare ||89|| bhajanena tathā bhaktyā jñānena gurusevayā | drutaṃ cāhaṃ prasannaścābhavaṃ rāsabhapālinām || 3.225.90|| ekadā rāsabhaṃ kṛtvā garuḍaṃ rāsabhe sthitaḥ | mārge tān yāta evāhamagrato militaḥ puraḥ ||91|| saśmaśruḥ kṣatriyaveṣo yātrāluriva śobhanaḥ | tebhyo mayā jaya kṛṣṇa jaya rāma janārdana ||92|| jaya nārāyaṇa viṣṇo jaya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa | ityevaṃ nāmabhiḥ saṃsmāritaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||93|| namanaṃ ca kṛtaṃ śīghramavatīrya tu rāsabhāt | te’pi śrutvā hṛrernāma prasannā mimilurhiṃ mām ||94|| yathā priyā bāndhavā vā putrāśca pitaro’thavā | māṃ niruddhya niṣādyāpi kambalāsanake drutam ||95|| jalaṃ phalaṃ tathānnaṃ va dadurmārge’tiharṣitāḥ | pṛṣṭhavanto gṛhaṃ me cāgamanaṃ karma cetyapi || 96|| mayā divyaṃ paraṃ vyoma gṛhaṃ me darśitaṃ tadā | karma nārāyaṇākhyānaṃ tīrthārthāgamanaṃ tathā ||97|| śrutvā cātiprasannāste lakṣmi nārāyaṇaṃ tu mām | asevanta paraṃ bhaktaṃ jñātvā hṛdāṃgamardanaiḥ ||98|| cakruste daṇḍavañcāpi matvā sādhūttamaṃ tu mām | athaitebhyo mayā tūrṇaṃ caturbhujaṃ tu darśanam ||99|| garuḍena sahitaṃ tu dattaṃ tatraiva satpathe | prasādaṃ dattavām̐stebhyo bhakṣitaṃ yat phalādikam ||3.225.100|| skandhakambalavantaste hastayaṣṭidharāstathā | pādeṣu carmopānadvantaste nanṛturutsukāḥ ||101|| mastake dīrghapaṭakā dhṛtakañcukadhotrakāḥ | nanṛtuścātiharṣeṇa cakrurbhūloṭanaṃ muhuḥ ||102|| mokṣaṃ dehi padaṃ dehi hare rāsabhavāhana | divyaṃ dhāma naḥ pradehi kṛṣṇa garuḍavāhṛna ||103|| evamuccārya sahasā nyadhuḥ pādarajo mukhe | cakrurme darśanaṃ tvekatānamugdhāḥ samādhivat ||104|| tiro’bhavaṃ tato lakṣmi te ca kṣaṇāntare prabhām | āsādya varṇayanto māṃ dhanyabhāgyāni menire ||105|| tatra mārge pracakruste nārāyaṇasya vedikām | nityaṃ bhaktiṃ pracakruste luṇīnadītaṭe sadā ||106|| prāpte kāle garuḍena sahasraśo’pi tānaham | krameṇa nītavān dhāmākṣaraṃ mokṣapadaṃ rame ||107|| evamuddhāritā bhaktāḥ sādhuyogena vai mayā | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirdhruvā bhavet ||108|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne bhaktasya rāsabhapālasya ratnaprabhasya nṛsiṃhasvāmisādhuyogena bhagavatprāptirmokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 225 ||
<3.226> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvam ājīvanīnadītaṭe | saurāṣṭre tvabhavadvaidyo nāmnā gadārdaneśvaraḥ || 1 jīradurgakṛtāvāsaścauṣadhitattvamarmavit | vipraḥ kuṭumbasahito jīradurge nijāpaṇam || 2 kṛtvā karoti rugṇānāṃ cikitsāṃ cauṣadhaṃ tataḥ | nāmābhavaddhi vikhyātaṃ roganāśakalāvidaḥ || 3 parito grāmavargeṣu deśalokeṣu cāpyati | prajājanāḥ samāyānti tadgṛhaṃ roganuttaye || 4 so’pi nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ smṛtvā dadāti cauṣadham | suphalaṃ tadbhavatyeva guṇakṛdrogahārakam || 5 yajñabhasmānvitaṃ devaprasādaśarkarānvitam | tulasīpatracūrṇāḍhyaṃ kāṣṭhauṣadhaṃ ca dhātujam || 6 bhasmādi ca rasān vahnipakvān śarannivartakān | kaphanāśakarān jīrṇajvaraghnānāsavām̐stathā || 7 | virecakān gūṭikāṃśca pācakān vāyunāśakān | śaktidān dhātupuṣṭikṛdvṛkṣabījāni yāni ca || 8 | jantujān cūrṇitān rogaharām̐stuṣām̐śca mūlajān | patrajān puṣpajām̐ścāpi tvacāṃ cūrṇāni yānyapi || 9 | dadāti rogiṇe rogānnāśayatyeva sarvathā | viṣaṃ harati śīghraṃ ca sarpādīnāṃ rasodbhavam || 3.226.1 0|| evaṃvidhasya vaidyasya śālāyāṃ mānavā daśa | kurvanti peṣaṇaṃ cāpi mardanaṃ pācanaṃ tathā || 11 || sāraniḥsāraṇaṃ cūrṇanaṃ ca prajvālanaṃ sadā | auṣadhāni yathāyogyaṃ sampādayanti yatnataḥ ||12|| varṣāraṃbhe svayaṃ gadārdanaḥ kṣetre nadītaṭe | yāti kācādipātrāṇi nītvā jantumaye sthale || 1 3|| sarīsṛpām̐stāmrakaṇaśendragopān pipīlakān | raktapuṣṭikarān jantūn dhṛtvā dadhāti pātrake || 14|| sahasraśaḥ prāṇaraudhairvyasavaste bhavanti hi | uttejakāni tailāni kartuṃ gartādigodhikāḥ ||15|| dhṛtvā kāce tu nikṣipya vyasūn karoti vaidyarāṭ | nirdayo nijalābhārthaṃ paraprāṇavighātakaḥ || 16|| vipro’pi rākṣasadharmā hiṃsāmārgaparo’bhavat | nāṇakāṇāṃ pralobhena tṛṣṇayā hiṃsako’bhavat || 17|| evaṃ gadārdanaḥ kāle kāle jantuvināśakaḥ | auṣadhārthaṃ koṭijantunāśakṛddhiṃsako’bhavat || 18|| jantavo’pi mūrchitā arditāḥ śapanti taṃ dvijam | naḥ prāṇaghnasya te prāṇān hariṣyantyapi jantavaḥ || 19|| caturaśītilakṣāsu yoniṣveva muhurmuhuḥ | asmadvadduḥkhamāsādya mṛtyuṃ yāhi punaḥ punaḥ || 3.226.20|| śaptaścaivaṃ bahuśāpaistīvravegaiḥ sa vaidyakaḥ | karmavipākakālena jvarāviṣṭo’bhavacchanaiḥ ||21|| jvaranāśāya sahasāyujat sa gūṭikādikam | jvaraḥ śāntiṃ na cāyāti pratyuta saṃpravardhate ||22|| prārabdhāgatavighnaṃ hi koṭyupāyairna naśyati | śāpāgataṃ mahāduḥkhaṃ tvanyopāyairna līyate ||23|| vaidyasya yamarājasya devasya ca vṛṣasya ca | īśvarasya samarthasya mānavasya tu kā kathā ||24|| līyate śāpadasyaiva prasādena na cānyathā | atra te jantavo naṣṭāḥ prasādaḥ kuta ālabhet ||25|| jīrṇajvaro hi vaidyasya balavattvamupāgamat | nityaṃ gadārdanaraktaṃ śoṣayatyeva bhūtavat ||26|| athāyaṃ tannirāsārthaṃ kvāthān pibati nityaśaḥ | aprārabdhahatāḥ kvāthā viparītā bhavanti yat ||27|| raktanāśakarāścāpyuṣṇatāvivardhakāstathā | nāḍīṣu māṃsapiṇḍeṣu sūkṣmachidrakarā api || 28|| vyavartanta samastāste kvāthāḥ kṣatakarāstataḥ | mūtre male ṣṭhīvane’sya raktabhāgaḥ sravatyapi ||29|| nirvṛttātyupacāro’pi vaidyo rugṇataro’bhavat | na buddhirna balaṃ dravyaṃ nopacārā vibhāgyake || 3.226.30|| mahāpāpe prabhavanti yojitāḥ kuśalairapi | lakṣmi prasiddhavaidyasya kṛtaśramasya śāntaye ||3 1 || anye vaidyāścāyayuśca cikitsārthaṃ vidūrataḥ | kṛtvā mūlacikitsāṃ te prayojayanti cauṣadham ||32|| tathāpyaghahatasyāsya leśalābho na dṛśyate | āśāhatāśca te bhūtvā prayānti nijamandiram ||33|| raktasrāvā hi vaidyasya na śāntiṃ pragatāḥ khalu | tatrauṣadhaiḥ kṛtairlakṣmi pratyutādhikatāṃ gatāḥ ||34|| varṣaṃ tvevaṃ gataṃ tasya yāmyasadṛśaduḥkhinaḥ | tato mātrā tu bhasmotthā bhakṣitā bhiṣajā svayam ||35|| sāpi vikṛtimāsādya visphoṭān parito vyadhāt | pācapūrṇaṃ ca durgandhaṃ sphuṭitaṃ varṣma cābhitaḥ || 36|| pācasrāvi kleditaṃ ca nārakaṃ kuṇḍavaddhyabhūt | na pārśve ke’pi gacchanti vaidyo roditi śūlitaḥ ||37|| utpannakīṭajantukṛddaṃśairardita ityadhī | ākrūśyatyatiduḥkhena jantukhāditamāṃsakaḥ ||38|| etādṛśamahāduḥkhaṃ prāptavān vaidyarāṭ rame | duḥkhī māṃ bhajate nityaṃ duḥkhanāśāya kevalam ||39|| śāpaduḥkhavināśe’haṃ samartho na bhavāmi vai | śāpadasya hṛdaye’haṃ sthitastadā samarditaḥ ||3.226.40|| śāpadastvahamevāsmi kathaṃ cāśāpakṛt punaḥ | vinā taṃ śāpadaṃ jantuṃ prabhavāmi nivṛttaye ||41 || evaṃ vidhasya vaidyasya bhajamānasya māmapi | duḥkhaṃ nivartate naiva maraṇaṃ nāpi jāyate ||482|| bhojanaṃ prāṇadhāraṃ cādatte’sya jāṭharo laghu | tena prāṇā na prayānti śāpabhogaprabandhinaḥ ||43|| bahudānāni puṇyāni kṛtavān vaidyarāḍapi | prāṇāḥ sthānaṃ na muñcanti yāmyapurīsamaprabhāḥ ||44|| oṣadhānāṃ prayogaiśca manāk svāsthyaṃ pradṛśyate | māsaṃ svāsthyaṃ dṛśyate ca māṃsamajjā vivardhate ||45|| punaśca jantavastatra jāyante ca sahasraśaḥ | kīṭā daśanti bahudhā yāmyakuṇḍo yathā tviha ||46|| evaṃ muhuḥ śāpavaśādasya vaidyasya vartate | daśavarṣāṇi caivaṃ vai vyatītānyasya rogiṇaḥ ||47|| yāvanto jantavastena māritāstāvadeva tat | duḥkhaṃ sākṣādatra jātaṃ yāmyaṃ tathāpi śiṣyate ||48|| madhye lakṣmi tathā tasya putrāḥ ṣaṭ pāpisaṃgataḥ | atiriktātisāraiśca śanaiḥ kramānmṛtiṃ yayuḥ ||49|| vidhvastā vidhavā jātāḥ ṣaḍevāpatyavarjitāḥ | gadārdanasya putryaśca sapta tāḥ saṃgadoṣataḥ ||3.226.50|| sarvā api tu vidhavā jātāḥ pitṛprapāpataḥ | āsanācchayanādvāsād bhojanāt sahakarmaṇaḥ ||51 || utpādād dāyabhāgācca pāpaṃ saṃkramate jane | jantūnāṃ māraṇe teṣāṃ kuṭumbināṃ yathā bhayam ||52|| duḥkhaṃ cābhūttathā śāpādasya kuṭumbināṃ tathā | sarvamatraiva sañjātaṃ duḥkhaṃ tīvrapraveginaḥ ||53|| evaṃ nirvaṃśatāṃ prāptā patnī tvekāvaśiṣyate | sāpi cintāparā bhrātṝn nijānāhūya sarvathā |||54|| dravyaṃ sarvaṃ dadau tebhyo gṛhaṃ śūnyamivābhavat | patnī bhrātara evāpi dravyapāśena pāśitāḥ ||55|| rugṇāḥ sarve’bhavam̐stūrṇaṃ mṛtāste dravyabhoginaḥ | nirvaṃśāste’pi jātā vai pāpadravyaprasaṃgataḥ ||56|| vaidyasyānnaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ prāyaścittī yato bhavet | lakṣmi śataghno vaidyo vai tadannaṃ pāpadaṃ matam |||57|| paśya vaidyā nirdayā vai yamadūtasamāḥ sadā | chedane ghātane mṛtyudāne śavādisevane ||58|| nagnaśavābhyasane ca nagnaśavāvalokane | nagnadurgandhakīṭāḍhyaśavānāṃ nityadarśane ||59|| rogasaṃskārakaraṇe pācakledādiśīlane | yamadūtasamā vaidyā aśuddhāḥ prāṇapāragāḥ ||3.226.60|| anubhūtiṃ vinā ye te pāpinaḥ prāṇahārakāḥ | teṣāmannaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ vinaṣṭikṛt tadannakam ||61|| nahi sarve tviha loke dhanvantarisamāḥ khalu | tattvajñā yadi puṇyāḥ syurahiṃsakāstu pāvanāḥ ||62|| aśvinīputrasadṛśāḥ pūjyāste tu matāḥ sadā | lokakalyāṇakartāro hiṃsāmārgavivarjitāḥ ||63|| yathāpekṣauṣadhānāṃ tu prayogiṇaḥ subhaktayaḥ | jantuhiṃsāvihīnāśca kāṣṭhadhātvādiyoginaḥ ||64|| durlabhāste devavaidyāsteṣāṃ pūjā tu puṇyadā | atha lakṣmi gate kāle patnī gadārdanasya sā ||65|| kṣayarogeṇa vai vyāptābhavannāmnā mukundinī | vaiṣṇavī patibhaktā ca śraddhābhāvaguṇānvitā ||66|| sā tvābālyāddharerbhaktābhavat snātrī prapūjikā | bhaktimatī dharmavatī pātivratyaparāyaṇā ||67|| vratadānatapaḥkartrī nityaṃ sādhuprasevikā | kṛṣṇakathāyā raktā ca śaucasantoṣaśobhanā ||68|| tanvā manasā vāṇyā ca karmabhiḥ sādhusevikā | kṛṣṇasevāparā nityaṃ navadhābhaktisaṃyutā ||69|| hāranaivedyadhūpādividhātrī viṣṇupūjikā | ātmanivedinī mahābhāgavatī haripriyā ||3.226.70|| śīlasatyaparā sādhvīdharmayuktātmanaiṣṭhikī | divyā divyaguṇopetā bhagavannaiṣṭhikī sadā ||71 || dhyānaparā ca sarvasvārpaṇaparā harau mayi | lakṣmi tvetādṛśī bhaktā kintu saṃgāt suduḥkhitā ||72|| patyurardhaṃ samastaṃ vai bhujyate nijayoṣitā | saivaṃ duḥkhaparā rugṇā vartate bhajate tu mām ||73|| tasyā varṣe gate kṣīṇāyāstu patirmṛto’bhavat | parādhīnā ca vidhavā ruroda kurarīva sā ||74|| patyurasadgatiṃ vīkṣya smṛtvā putrīsutādikān | mṛtān bhrātṝm̐śca vai smṛtvā svasyā asadgatiṃ tathā ||75|| cukrośākrandanairdhairyavarjitā kṣayarogiṇī | śrutvā cākrośanaṃ devāḥ kṣaṇaṃ stabdhāstadābhavan ||76|| ṛtavaścāpi tattvāni kṣaṇaṃ jaḍāni cābhavan | athāhaṃ sahasā lakṣmi cāntarātmā nijānumaḥ ||77|| mukundinyā hṛdayastho vatsalo duḥkhito’bhavam | dhairyaṃ dadau cāntarātmā sadvicāreṇa cāpyaham ||78|| sāpi vijñānamāsādya dhairyamālambya māṃ harim | asmarad bahudhā lakṣmi nātha nātha kṛpāṃ kuru ||79|| bhaktāyā cāpi duḥkhāyāṃ vidhavāyāṃ kṛpāṃ kuru | sarvasvanāśayuktāyāṃ śeṣāyāṃ vatsalo bhava ||3.226.80|| duḥkhānāṃ nāsti me sīmā samuddhara bhavārṇavāt | prathamaṃ māṃ mārayitvā tataḥ patiṃ pramāraya ||81|| sadhavāyā gatirme syād vidhavāyā gatirnahi | eṣāhaṃ vahnimutpādya sajīvā prajvalāmi vai ||82|| satītvaṃ sarvathā yogyaṃ vidhavātvaṃ bhayāvaham | kṛpā te’sti samāyāhi jīvayainaṃ nirogiṇam ||83 || naivaṃ cenmaraṇaṃ dehi yugapattūbhayorapi | ityuktyā sā mama bhaktā kṣaṇaṃ dadhyau tu māṃ hṛdi ||84|| tāvanmayā pārṣadā me preṣitāstatpatiṃ prati | yāmyadūtairnīyamānaṃ duḥkhinaṃ śaraṇaiṣiṇam ||85|| pārṣadairme drutaṃ gatvā viyojito yamārthibhiḥ | gṛhītaścānīta eva dehaṃ praveśitaḥ punaḥ ||86|| utthitaḥ sahasā deho’kasmād bandhanabandhitaḥ | śavārthino’bhavan stabdhā mahāścaryasamanvitāḥ ||87|| kecijjagaduḥ pāpānāmapūrṇaṃ pāpabhoganam | punaḥ pāpaprabhogāyāgato yāmyairna rakṣitaḥ ||88|| apare tu tadā prāhuḥ satyāḥ patnyāstu bhaktitaḥ | utthitaścātibhaktyā vai nīrogo’yaṃ bhaviṣyati ||89|| anye prāhurvāsaniko vartate’yaṃ hi pāpavān | na yāti paralokaṃ svāṃ patnīṃ vihāya caikalaḥ ||3.226.90|| itare tu tadā prāhuḥ karmarekhā hi durgamā | ityevaṃ te viremuśca nirbandhanaṃ vyadhuśca tam ||91|| atha lakṣmi tadā cāhaṃ patnyā bhakteḥ pratāpataḥ | puro divyamabhavam̐śca mūrtimān pārṣadaiḥ saha ||92|| caturbhujo divyadehaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | avadaṃ ca mukundinyai varaṃ vṛṇu madagrataḥ ||93|| sāpi cotthāya sahasā patitā pādayormama | gadārdano’pi māṃ vīkṣya nīroga iva nidritaḥ || 94|| utthāya nyapatacchīghraṃ pādayormama bhūtale | varadānāya ca mayā niyuktāvūcatuśca tau ||95|| mokṣaṃ dehi kṛpāsindho parameśa ramāpate | sarvaṃ kālena nītaṃ nau hyāvāṃ nirvāsanau kṛtau ||16|| vaidyavaidyo mahākālastadvaidyaḥ parameśvaraḥ | yāmyahūtau drāvitau tvatpārṣadairiha sarvathā ||97|| mokṣaṃ dehi yatheṣṭaṃ vā niyojaya pareśvara | evaṃ prārthayamānābhyāṃ tathetyuktvā vimānake ||98|| adhyāropya divaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ preṣayāmāsa pārṣadaiḥ | satībhaktipratāpena satī mukundinī tadā ||99|| divaṃ tyaktvā satīlokaṃ patyā saha yayau drutam | pārṣadā me tu tāṃ svāmisahitāṃ vai mukundinīm || 3.226.100 || avasthāpya satīlokaṃ prayayurmama dhāma ha | evaṃ kālāntare prāpte tau yāsyataḥ paraṃ padam || 101 || lakṣmi bhaktāpratāpena vaidyo yāmyaṃ vihāya ca | satīlokaṃ yayau yasya pāpapuñjo’bhavanmahān || 1 02|| tathāpi strīpratāpena kṛpayā me layaṃ gataḥ | ardhāṃganākṛtaṃ puṇyamardhaṃ tu labhate patiḥ || 1 03|| vratadānādikaṃ bhaktiḥ sarvamardhaṃ prapadyate | evaṃ sambandhinaḥ putrāḥ striyo mitrāṇi cāpare || 1 04|| kurvanti pretanāmnāpi puṇyaṃ prete prapadyate | tasmācchrāddhaṃ makhaṃ dānaṃ kurvanti pṛṣṭhato janāḥ || 1 05|| bhaktitulyaṃ mokṣadaṃ vai sādhanaṃ netarad rame | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktiśca vai bhaveta || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne gadārdaneśvaranāmakavaidyasya pāpairduḥkhāni tatpatnyā mukundinyā bhaktyā ca mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 226 ||
<3.227> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ bhaktasya śobhanām | kīśanakulapālasya nāmnā deśyāvanasya vai || 1 || deśyāvano’bhavad yogī candrāvanasya cātmajaḥ | gomaṇḍalyāścāpagāyāstaṭe gauvādikheṭagaḥ || 2 || pitrā putraḥ śikṣito vai kīśanakulapālane | kīśayornartane cāpi nakulayostu yodhane || 3 || vānaro bhavati rājā vānaro ghargharīyutā | śāṭīdharā ca lajjāyāṃ vartate kīśasannidhau || 4 || rājñīva vartate cāpi nṛtyasyeva praśikṣitā | nṛtyakṣatau vānarastāṃ tāḍayatyeva roṣataḥ || 5 || bānaro’pi tataḥ khātavaṃśayormadhyarajjugaḥ | naṭavat saṃprayātyeva sthālyā chatradharo naṭaḥ || 6 || vānarī ḍamarūvādyaṃ vādayatyeva raṃgagā | janān pradarśayatyeṣā yaṣṭyā hastena vānaram || 7 || janā dṛṣṭvā magnacittā arpayanti dhanānnakam | athāpi vānaraścādho’vatīrya śakaṭīṃ navām || 8 || āyuktvā tu śṛgālau dvau tatrāropya tu vānarīm | svayaṃbhūtvā sūtakarmā cālayatyeva rājavat || 9 || nakulau vānarīpārśve pārṣadāviva tiṣṭhataḥ | cāmare śobhite dhṛtvā vīkṣante kautukaṃ janāḥ || 3.227.1 0|| śṛgālau vahamānau tau kīśo yaṣṭyā pratāḍanam | yāvat karoti jambukau kruddhau pratimukhau dhuri | 11 || bhūtvā nirgatya dhurataścotplutyākruśya roṣataḥ | vānareṇa samaṃ samyag yudhyataḥ saṃprapaśyatām || 12|| janānāṃ tatra kīśena yuddhyatyekastu jambukaḥ | dvitīyo vānarīkarṇe dhṛtvā nītvātigo’bhavat || 1 3|| deśyāvanastadā tyaktvā raṃgaṃ dudrāva vānarīm | ānetuṃ ca śṛgālāṃ tu tāvat kīśo’pi dhāvati ||14|| ānetuṃ vānarīṃ tāvajjambuko’pyanudhāvati | nakulī pṛṣṭhatastatra vaṃśayoradhirohataḥ ||15|| prapaśyato hi vānaryā haraṇaṃ kroṣṭṛṇā kṛtam | yuddhaṃ tatra punastāvad deśyāvanakṛtāvanam ||16|| punā raṃgānayanaṃ ca śṛgālasya kṣamārthanam | bhikṣāṃ janebhyaḥ purikānāstī tatstrī prayācate || 17|| evaṃ deśyāvano nityaṃ nagare kharvaṭe pure | gatvā gatvā hāsyanāṭyaṃ kārayatyeva pāśavam || 18 || tadutpannānnavastrādyairdhanaiḥ piṣṭādibhiḥ sadā | nirvahatyeva satataṃ patnyā sākaṃ pratiṣṭhati || 19|| paśūnāṃ poṣaṇaṃ cāpi karoti dayayā yutaḥ | naisargiko bhaktadharmā deśyāvanaḥ prage’nvaham ||3.227.20|| snāti kṛṣṇaṃ citrachaviṃ namati ca prapaśyati | jalaṃ phalaṃ ca dharati bhojanaṃ purikākṛtam ||2 1|| nivedya viṣṇave datvā paśubhyo nijayoṣite | tato bhuṃkte nānyathaiva nārāyaṇaṃ tu māṃ smaran ||22||| lakṣmi sarvatra bhaktā me saṃskṛtāścāpyasaṃskṛtāḥ | ye’pi ke’pi bhajante māṃ yathā tathāpi ceśvaram ||23|| teṣāṃ manaḥprapūrtyarthaṃ prayate bhaktikarśitaḥ | purikāpi tu śūdrāṇī snātvā māṃ sevate’nvaham || 24|| śakaṭyāṃ mama mūrtiṃ ca rakṣatyeva chaviṃ śubhām | nānyadharmaṃ prajānāti jānāti śaraṇāgatim ||25|| chavistho bhagavān kṛṣṇa uddhāraṃ naḥ kariṣyati | tadarpaṇaṃ vinā naiva bhoktavyaṃ jalamityapi ||26|| harerbhaktiṃ vinā vandhyo netavyo divaso na vai | antarātmā hariścāste kīśe nakule kroṣṭari ||27|| nāryā nare ca sarvatra vṛkṣe jaḍe ca cetane | evaṃ tau budhyato lakṣmi kīśanakulapālakau ||28|| atastau pāvanau snigdhau bhaktau me mama sammatau | dine khelaṃ viracayyotpādyopārjanabhojane ||29|| yathālabdhe susantuṣṭau rātrau kurutaḥ kīrtanam | ḍamarūvādyasahitaṃ kṛṣṇa rāma ramāpate ||3.227.3 0|| evaṃ nityaṃ hi kuruto bhajanaṃ vai niśāmukhe | pūrṇimāyāṃ tu miṣṭānnaṃ nivedayato matpuraḥ || 31 || paśubhyaḥ sampradāyaiva tatastau matprasādajam | bhuñjāte pratimāsaṃ tau vrataṃ tvetannirantaram ||35||| tulasīmiśritaṃ vāri pibatastau sadā rame | nahi bhaktau kāraṇaṃ vai vanaṃ sthalaṃ gṛhaṃ dhanam ||33|| snehastu kāraṇaṃ tatra hṛdayaṃ bhaktikāraṇam | śraddhā ca kāraṇaṃ tatra puṇyaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ mahat ||34|| evaṃ gomaṇḍalītīre vasatoścobhayorapi | ekadā sādhusaṃgho vai yātrārthī pārśvato’gamat ||35|| tāvubhau sahasā gatvā nematuḥ sādhupādayoḥ | viśrāntyarthaṃ ghaṭikāṃ cārthayāmāsaturīśvarān ||36|| sādhavo’pi nadītīraṃ vṛkṣachāyāṃ vilokya tu | kṣaṇaṃ viśrāntimāpuste papurjalaṃ tu śītalam ||37|| pūrṇimāsīd bhāgyayogānmiṣṭamāsīt kṛtaṃ tadā | saṃyāvaṃ śrīharaye vai niveditaṃ samastakam ||38|| sādhubhyo dadaturbhaktyā bhuktavantaśca sādhavaḥ | mama smṛtiyutā lakṣmi saṃyāvo vṛddhimāptavān ||39|| mayāntaryāmiṇā jñātvā saṃyāvo vardhito hyati | viṃśatiḥ sādhavaḥ sarve tṛptāstāvān sa cābhavat ||3.227.40|| saṃyāvaḥ pūrvamāno vai nyūnatāṃ nāvrajanmanāk | sādhavo’pi vividurvai bhakteḥ pratāpameva tam ||41 || tanmadhye maṇḍalīśo yaḥ sādhurnāmnā sudhāmaraḥ | upādideśa vākyāni matvā bhaktaṃ tu pātrakam ||42|| śṛṇu bhakta sadā sevyo hariśca tasya sādhavaḥ | nārāyaṇaḥ satsu cāste kāmasaṃkalpapūrakaḥ ||43|| na jātirna dhanaṃ rājyaṃ kṛṣṇaprasādasādhanam | snehabhaktiḥ sādhusevā kṛṣṇaprasādasādhanam ||44|| sādhavo bhagavanniṣṭhā tathā śrībhagavān svayam | kṣetraṃ vai naimiṣāraṇyaṃ kuṇṭhitaṃ yatra mānasam ||45|| indriyāṇi kuṇṭhitāni nivṛttāni sthirāṇi ca | viṣayebhyaḥ parāvṛtya jāyante śāntidāni ca ||46|| tatra kṣetre sāghurūpe tathā nārāyaṇātmake | satsaṃgasalile snātvā puṇyayajñān samācaret ||47|| āśu siddhirbhavettatra mokṣadharmasya cottamām | dhyānaṃ siddhistathā śīghraṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ prajāyate ||48|| vānarā indriyāṇyeva tvahaṃmanasī jambukau | pūrvakarmāṇi nakulāstān vaśān sannayet sadā ||49|| dharme jñāne ca vairāgye bhaktau sādhuprasevane | harermūrtau ca tiṣṭheyustathā vaśān vidhāpayet ||3.227.50|| parotkarṣāsahiṣṇvākhyāmirṣyāṃ tyajet sadā sudhīḥ | mānaṃ tyājyaṃ prayatnena sudhiyā sarvarodhakam ||51 || sattvena bhāvyaṃ satataṃ dharme ruciryato bhavet | sattvaṃ proktaṃ kṛtayugaṃ yatra dhyānaṃ bhaveddhareḥ ||52|| rajovegān rodhayedvai kāmyakarmapraperakān | rajastretāyugo bodhyaḥ sevā kāryātra daihikī ||53|| rajastamobhyāṃ yuktātmā dvāparātmā prakathyate | tatra lojārjanatṛṣṇā tyajet sevāṃ careddhareḥ ||54|| tamomayaḥ kalirbodhyo yatra māyānṛtādikam | tatra samāgamaḥ kāryaḥ satāṃ ca bhajanaṃ muhuḥ ||55|| uccaiḥ saṃkīrtanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kalervego nivartate | pūrvakarmānusāreṇa pravartante yugā hṛdi ||56|| ato dhyānaṃ cātmaniṣṭhā māhātmyabuddhiruttamā | sādhanīyā viśeṣeṇa yugadharmādirodhinī ||57|| śrīkṛṣṇaṃ bhajato bhītirnāstyeva kālakarmajā | kṛtārtho’smīti matvaiva seveta sādhusattamān ||58|| bhaktiṃ kuryānnavadhāpi sarvasvārpaṇabhāvanām | kṛṣṇasādhvāśrayeṇaiva kalirnaśyati vai hṛdaḥ ||59|| yatra kṛṣṇanivāso’sti tatra kalirna vidyate | yatra santaḥ sthitāḥ santi tatra māyā na vidyate ||3.227.60|| mahābhāgavato dharmo mahāvaiṣṇavatātmakḥ | sarvanivedanātmā sa pālanīyaḥ sadā śubhaḥ ||61 || cauryaṃ piśunatā dambhaḥ kartavyā naiva sarvathā | satāṃ samāgamaḥ kāryo viśvāso’pi sadā satām ||62|| maryādā ca satāṃ pālyā yathā kṛṣṇasya sā tathā | sevā satāṃ sadā kāryā yathā kṛṣṇasya sā tathā ||63|| yeṣu hiṃsā madaścauryamanṛtaṃ kapaṭaṃ tathā | nāstikatvaṃ ca māyā ca te na viśvāsabhūmayaḥ ||64|| te tu ruciṃ na kurvanti satsaṃge satsu vā harau | druhyantyeva te satataṃ kalipriyāstu pāpinaḥ ||65|| ato mumukṣuṇā sevyāḥ santo naiva tu nāstikāḥ | satāṃ yogena sarveśa bhajitvā muktimarjayet ||66|| satsaṃge śraddhayānanyabhāvena bhajate tu yaḥ | dehānte sa vrajatyeva dhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ param ||67|| golokaṃ vāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ vrajennārāyaṇāśramam | śvetadvīpaṃ vrajedvāpi śrīpuraṃ cāmṛtaṃ vrajet ||68|| divyadṛṣṭimatāṃ tāni cāntike santi sarvathā | bāhyadṛṣṭimatāṃ tāni dhāmāni santi dūrataḥ ||69|| dehe jīvo yathā tatra jīve śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | vartate tanmayīdṛṣṭyā paśyeddhāmāni cāntike ||3.227.70|| yatra kṛṣṇo’sti hṛdaye bahirvā tatra santi vai | sarvadhāmāni kṛṣṇasyaiśvaryāṇi nikhilānyapi ||71 || evaṃvijñāstu ye bhaktāste śrīkṛṣṇasamā matāḥ | teṣāṃ darśanajaṃ puṇyaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanasadṛśam |||72|| anyaiḥ sarvairīdṛśānāṃ samāgamena mokṣaṇam | prāpyate durlabhaṃ yadvai sulabhaṃ satprasādataḥ ||73|| satsu snehena santaḥ svāśritān nayanti cākṣaram | vāsanāḥ kṣapayitvaiva nayanti paramaṃ padam ||74|| strīvargaṃ naravargaṃ vā sakāmaṃ vāpi dehinam | santo viśodhya divyaṃ taṃ kṛtvā nayanti cākṣaram ||75|| śṛṇu deśyāvana tvaṃ vai smara nāṭye prabhuṃ harim | vaṃśarajjvā dhāma divyamakṣaraṃ smara sarvathā ||76|| rajjusthe vānare viṣṇuṃ smara chatre tu chatrakam | vaṃśe pūrve tu golokaṃ dvitīye tu vikuṇṭhakam ||77|| smara divyaṃ rathaṃ taṃ tu yatra sā vānarī sthitā | brahmarathaṃ smara tatra māyāṃ viṣṇostu vānarīm ||78|| kroṣṭāraṃ cāpyahaṃkāraṃ dvitīyaṃ mānasaṃ smara | tābhyāṃ sā sajjate māyā tāṃ samarpaya viṣṇave ||79|| nakulaṃ tu guruṃ sarvadraṣṭāraṃ smara tatra hi | rajjvakṣarasthito divyo gurustvāṃ tārayiṣyati ||3.227.80|| ḍamarūtthaṃ mahānādam oṃnārāyaṇamādhavam | vidhehi satataṃ sarvajīvānāṃ śravaṇāya vai ||8 1 || paśya sevātmikāṃ bhaktiṃ raṃgarakṣākarīṃ naṭīm | paśya bhikṣāṃ mokṣayātrāṃ nityadravyamayīṃ tathā ||82|| bhikṣāpradān śaraṇe vai samāyātān śarīriṇaḥ | paśya sādhoḥ saṃgamena pāvanān dattacittakān ||83|| sādhuṃ sudhāmaraṃ māṃ tvaṃ paśyāntaryāmiṇaṃ harim | jñānadaṃ mokṣadaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hitārthinam ||84|| deśyāvanaṃ nijātmānaṃ paśya kīśādipālakam | svāminaṃ ca niyantāraṃ raṃgakhelavidhāyinam ||85|| raṃgabhūmiṃ paśya jātiṃ dehaṃ gehaṃ samastakam | khelāntaṃ paśya maraṇaṃ visarjanaṃ tu karmaṇām ||86|| darśakānāṃ manorañjanaṃ tu paśya śamādikam | evaṃ kṛtvā tava tṛptiṃ jātāṃ paśya tu śāśvatīm ||87|| ityevaṃ nityamīkṣam̐stvaṃ paraṃ padaṃ prayāsyasi | hṛdaye brāhmīmupaniṣadaṃ prāpya bhayaṃ nahi ||88 || yāvadvai vāsanā cāsti tāvat khelaḥ pravartate | upaniṣannivāsena khelaḥ khelo bhavet sadā ||89|| parā śāntiḥ pravarteta deśyāvana tathācara | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||3.227.90|| hare kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa śrīpate puruṣottama | bhaja nityaṃ parameśaṃ tvevaṃ samāhito bhava ||91 || ityuktvā kamale sādhuḥ samaṇḍalaḥ supūjitaḥ | prasannamānaso bhūtvā datvāśīrvacanaṃ yayau ||92|| athāyaṃ deśyavacano vilokya pātrake dhṛtam | prasādātmakasaṃyāvaṃ sampūrṇaṃ tu yathātatham ||93|| camatkāraṃ mahāścaryaṃ mene kṛpāṃ harerapi | kuṭumbayug bubhuje’pi prasādaṃ tāvadeva saḥ ||94|| divyadṛṣṭirabhavadvai kuṭumbasahitaḥ khalu | agre pārśve pṛṣṭhataśca haristasyābhito’bhavat ||95|| yatra paśyati tatraiva viśvātmānaṃ prapaśyati | ūrdhve’dho bhūtale pātre vastre rathe ca vānare ||96|| jambuke nakule naṭyāṃ parātmānaṃ prapaśyati | divyabhāvo’bhavadbhaktaḥ kalpitaṃ labhate kare ||97|| nārāyaṇasya me mūrtiḥ sarvato gocarābhavat | kṛpā sā me guroḥ sādhoścāpi lakṣmi śubhā hi sā ||98|| yayā sarvamasya jātaṃ brahmadarśanamuttamam | atha vāksiddhamājñāya janāścāyānti saṃghaśaḥ ||99|| kṛtvā tu darśanaṃ tasya bhavanti pāvanā api | mantraṃ gṛhṇanti me tasmād bhaktād viyanti vai tataḥ || 3.227.100 || kṛtakṛtyāḥ prajāyante mahābhāgavatekṣaṇāt | atha kāle samāyāte tvāvirbhūto’bhavaṃ puraḥ | 101 || vimānena sahitaśca pārṣadaiśca samanvitaḥ | tvayā sākaṃ tathā lakṣmi divyadehānakārayam || 1 02|| kīśanakulakroṣṭṝm̐śca kīśapaṃ kīśapāṃ tathā | vimāne tām̐ścādhirohayitvānayaṃ mamākṣaram || 103 || evaṃ lakṣmi dadau muktiṃ muktamaṇḍalamadhyagām | mama prasādabhoktṛbhyaḥ sarvebhyo bhaktiyogataḥ || 1 04|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya mananādvartanāttathā | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheccāpi divyaṃ svargaṃ ca śāśvatam || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne deśyāvanasya kīśapālasya sudhāmarasādhoḥ prasaṃgena mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 227 ||
<3.228> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ cānyāṃ vadāmyaham | harṣadharmābhidho bhakto nāpitaḥ pārvatīpure || 1 || nyavasat sakuṭumbo vai rājabhṛtyatvakarmavān | rājā nāmnābhavattatra svarṇadhanvetiśāsakaḥ || 2 || tasya sevāṃ karotyeṣo nāpitaḥ sakuṭumbakaḥ | nāpitasyābhavadbhāryā nāmnā nigamikā satī || 3 || pātivratyaparā viṣṇubhaktiparā sudhārmikī | vratadānajapasevāparā nārāyaṇe ratā || 4 || sādhusevātatparā ca divyabhāvavatī sadā | putrāḥ pañcābhavam̐stasyāḥ pañcaputryaśca śobhanāḥ || 5 || sarve te bhagavadbhaktā vaiṣṇavā bhaktiśālinaḥ | raṭanti māṃ harikṛṣṇaṃ gopipatiṃ śriyaḥ patim || 6 || bhajante satataṃ cāpi gṛhe’rcananivedanaiḥ | ṣoḍaśopacārakaiśca nityaṃ māmarcayanti te || 7 || mūrtau sthitvā sadā teṣāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇāmi prītimān | nāpito’pi sadā snātvā pūjāṃ kṛtvā ca me tataḥ || 8 || naivedyaṃ me samarpyaiva bhuktvā yāti nṛpālayam | nṛpaṃ saṃsevate sarvātmanā bhṛtyo hi nāpita || 9 || nāpitasya tathā putrāḥ putryo rājakuṭumbinaḥ | sevante ca yathāyogyaṃ kṛtvā matpūjanādikam || 3.228.1 0|| pratyahaṃ nāpitabhāryā prātarnigamikā tu sā | prathamaṃ vai samutthāya snātvā gṛhādiśodhanam || 11 || kṛtvā matvā jalaṃ coṣṇaṃ kṛtvā saṃsnāpya keśavam | śālagrāmaṃ tu māṃ cāpi prapūjya sarvavastubhiḥ || 1 2|| phalaṃ cānnaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ roṭakaṃ dadhi dugdhakam | śubhaṃ coṣṇaṃ vidhāyaiva picchalaṃ me’rpayatyapi || 13 || tato nirājanaṃ kṛtvā parihāraṃ karoti ca | patimutthāpya saṃsnāpya patipādodakaṃ tathā || 14|| kṛṣṇapādodakaṃ pītvā patiṃ sampūjayatyapi | samarpayati paścācca patīṣṭaṃ yadapekṣitam || 15|| tato’tithaye sādhubhyo’nāthebhyo’pi prayacchati | annaṃ jalaṃ yathāyogyaṃ samarpya ca gave’pi ca || 1 6|| sūryāya ca jalaṃ datvā viṣṇave’rghyaṃ samarpya ca | datvā piṣṭaṃ pipīlikākulāya ca tataḥ param || 17 || pitṛbhyaścāpi datvaiva yatsarvaṃ śuddhimat punaḥ | pataye bhojanādyaṃ ca jalaṃ samarpya vai tataḥ || 18|| putryādibhyaḥ samarpyaiva bhojanaṃ ca jalaṃ phalam | svayaṃ bhuṃkte nigamikā prasādaṃ tvavaśeṣitam || 19|| kavale kavale kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya cārpaye | iti smṛtvā prabhuṃkte sā jalaṃ pibati vai tathā ||3.228.20|| madhye śvā nakulaḥ kīśaḥ śukaścaṭakā gaurvṛṣaḥ | mārjārikāpi cāgacched datvā tebhyo’tti nānyathā ||21|| evaṃvidhā tu bhaktā sā śrīkṛṣṇasyeva dāsikā | gṛhakāryāṇi sampādya prātareva suveginī || 22 || rājñyālayaṃ prayātyeva nigamikātidhārmikī | rājñīṃ nāmnā pañcadevīṃ suptāṃ śayanagāṃ śanai ||23||| sammardayati cāṃgeṣu saṃvāhayati pādayoḥ | rājñyāḥ kṛte jalaṃ coṣṇaṃ sampādayati satvaram ||24|| dantadhāvanacūrṇaṃ ca jalagaṇḍūṣakādikam | śaucādyaṃ nirvartayati saṃsnāpayati vāribhiḥ ||25|| sugandhamardanaṃ cāpi dehaśodhanamityapi | keśasaṃskaraṇaṃ cāpi keśaveṣādiśobhanam ||26|| śṛṃgāraveṣabhūṣādidhāraṇaṃ kajjalāñjanam | alaktakapradānaṃ ca nakhoṣṭhādiprarañjanam ||27||| sarvaṃ yathāvad datvaiva pūjayitvā śriyaṃ yathā | vyajanena mahārājñīṃ prasannayati vāyudā || 28|| gṛhakāryaṃ samastaṃ ca niṣpādayati śobhanam | mādhyāhnikaṃ tathā sāyaṃtanīyaṃ sevanādikam ||29|| rājñyāstāmbūladānāntaṃ sampādayati nāpitī | śayyāṃ kusumagandhāḍhyāṃ samāstṛṇāti nityaśaḥ ||3.228.30 || rājñī svapiti sukhinī samvāhayati nāpitī | rājñī nidrāṃ karotyeva gāḍhāṃ prayāti nāpitī ||31 || gṛhe gatvā patisevāṃ pādasamvāhanātmikām | karotyapi ca nityaṃ vai tataḥ svapiti nāpitī ||32|| kṛtabhūpasusevaśca patistvardhaniśātyaye | nityaṃ gṛhaṃ samāyāti sevate nāpitī tataḥ ||33 || dhanyā śraddhā sevakānāṃ tatrāpi dāsasevinām | tatrāpi yoṣitāṃ lakṣmi pātivratyānvitātmanām ||34|| karmabandhanaloko’yaṃ karmādhīnaḥ karoti hi | niṣkāmabhāvavaśagaḥ kaścit karoti bhaktarāṭ ||35 || nāpitī nāpitaścobhau jānītaḥ karmabandhanam | rājasevā karmabandhaṃ udyamo’yaṃ dhanāptaye ||36|| upārjanaṃ vinā dehayātrā naiva hi siddhyati | annaṃ dhanaṃ ca vastraṃ ca labhyate rājasevayā ||37|| tathāpi bhaktimantau tau mṛṣāsevādyapekṣayā | mama sevāṃ hi kurutaḥ śāśvatānandavāñcchayā ||38|| dehendriyārthaṃ kartavyaṃ karmavaśena dehinā | ātmārthaṃ tu prakartavyaṃ jñānena tu mumukṣuṇā ||39|| śrīharyarthaṃ tu kartavyaṃ sarvārpaṇena bhāvinā | evaṃ matvā tu kurutaḥ sevanaṃ mama tau sadā ||3.228.40 || rājagṛhe’pi kuruto bhajanaṃ mama tau sadā | kīrtanaṃ kuruto me’pi gopīgītaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||41 || rāsalīlāṃ ca vadataḥ kathāṃ ca kuruto mama | rājñī rājā tu tacchrutvā nidritaḥ kṛṣṇamānasau ||42|| evaṃ bhajete cānyām̐śca bhaktiṃ kārayato’pi ca | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||43||| japato jāpayataśca kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa muhurmuhuḥ | evaṃ bhaktimatornityaṃ niyamo rājasevane ||44|| vartate tvekadā sāyaṃ nāpite nirgate gṛhāt | rājñastasyaiva sevāyāmupasthite gṛhe hyanu ||45|| nāpitānyāstu vai nirgamasya kṣaṇe hi sādhavaḥ | sādhvyaścāpi daśasaṃkhyā mahīmānāḥ samāyayuḥ ||46|| mahābhāgyena puṇyena mahatāyānti sādhavaḥ | sādhūnāṃ svāgatārthaṃ vai sarvaṃ kartavyamādarāt ||47|| śatakāryāṇi santyajya sādhusevāṃ samācaret | ātitheyaḥ paro dharmo gṛhasthānāṃ sadā mataḥ ||48|| tatrāpi ca satāṃ sādhvīnāṃ kṛte cottamo vṛṣaḥ | sarvaṃ vihāya sevāyāṃ vartitavyamiti dhruvaḥ | | 49|| mokṣārthaṃ mānavo deho mokṣārthaṃ sādhavo bhuvi | teṣāṃ yoge tu sarvasvaṃ cārpaṇīyaṃ drutaṃ janaiḥ | |3.228.5 0 || anyathā mānave dehe ko lābhaḥ sevanaṃ vinā | yadgṛhe’tithayo yānti tuṣyanti svāgatādibhiḥ ||5 1 || tadgṛhaṃ pāvanaṃ lakṣmīnivāsārhaṃ sadā bhavet | yadgṛhe’tithayo bhagnamānasā vai bhavanti cet ||52|| asatkṛtā asantuṣṭāstadgṛhaṃ dagdhavat smṛtam | puṇyahīnaṃ bhavatyeva lakṣmīsampadvivarjitam | |53|| yadgṛhaṃ sādhusanyāsiyatiyogikṛtāśrayam | tadgṛhaṃ devavasatirdivyaṃ tīrthottamaṃ sadā |||54|| yadgṛhe sādhavo naiva naivātithiprasevanam | śmaśānaṃ tadgṛhaṃ proktaṃ sūtakaṃ tatra vai sadā ||55|| yadgṛhe sādhavaḥ santi tadgṛhe santi devatāḥ | vighnāḥ sarve nivartante vasanti tatra siddhayaḥ |||56|| tīrthāni tatra cāyānti sādhūnāṃ pādavāñcchayā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatra virājate | |57|| yatra nārāyaṇastatra rādhikā kamalā ramā | muktāstatra vasantyeva divyadehā haripriyāḥ ||58|| yatkuṭumbe kṛpā sādhostatkuṭumbaṃ videhavat | muktatāṃ bhajamānaṃ vai divyaṃ pāpaharaṃ matam |||59|| vaiṣṇavaṃ ca variṣṭhaṃ ca mokṣadaṃ tatkuṭumbakam | yadgṛhe sādhavo dhīrā bhuñjate ca pibanti ca || 3.228.6 0|| svapanti kīrtayantīśeśvaranāma narāyaṇam | putrāḥ putryaḥ striyaścāpi sevante yānti divyatām ||6 1 || sarve muktā bhavantyeva sādhusatsaṃgalābhataḥ | sādhusevā hyakṣayo’sti kośastvanyastu sakṣayaḥ ||62|| tasmāt sādhūn sevayitvā bhojayitvā tathā punaḥ | śāyayitvā tadājñāṃ saṃlabdhvā yāsyāmi vai tataḥ || 63 || rājñyāḥ sevārthamevāhaṃ ceti niścitya nāpitī | cakre satāṃ svāgataṃ ca madhuparkaṃ dadau mudā ||64|| āsanāni dadau cāpi samidhaśca dadau jalam | phalaṃ tathā ca miṣṭānnamuṣṇaṃ kṛtvā dadau mudā ||65|| bhojayāmāsa sarvāśca sādhūn sādhvīstataśca sā | dehasaṃvāhanaṃ cāpi sādhvīnāṃ ca satāmapi ||66|| cakre dhairyeṇa niratā kīrtayantyapi sādhavaḥ | satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ kīrtayanti rātryardhaṃ vigataṃ tataḥ || 67|| sarve suptāḥ sādhavaśca sādhvyaścātha tu nāpitī | cintāṃ cakre manāg rājñyāḥ sevāṃ kartuṃ susatvarā ||68||| natvā cājñāṃ gṛhītvā ca yayau rājñīṃ prati drutam | atha rājñyapi samaye vigate’pi tu nāpitī ||69|| nāgateti mahākruddhā daṇḍaṃ dātuṃ samicchati | śvaḥ sarvasvaṃ hareyaṃ vai nāpitānyā mayārpitam ||3.228.70 || niṣkāsayiṣye grāmādvā kariṣye nigaḍe sthitām | evaṃ kruddhā hyabhavatsā jānātīdaṃ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ||71 || lakṣmi tadāhaṃ bhagavān niśādyaprahare drutam | bhaktāyā nāpitānyā vai rūpaṃ dhṛtvā suśobhanām ||72|| kruddhārājñyāḥ praśāntyarthaṃ sevārthaṃ pramadāgamam | vicāryetthaṃ mama bhaktā sādhūn sādhvīḥ prasevate ||73 || bhaktāyā jīvikānāśaṃ rājñī kruddhā kariṣyati | tanmā bhūnmama bhaktāyāḥ sevikāyāḥ satāṃ tathā ||74|| mayā rakṣayitavyeyaṃ bhaktā me dharmaśālinī | kuṭumbaṃ ca samastaṃ tad rakṣaṇīyaṃ hi bhaktimat ||75|| vicāryetthaṃ bhaktarakṣākaraścāhaṃ tu nāpitī | bhūtvā niśādyaprahare yayau rājñīgṛhaṃ drutam ||76|| rājñyāḥ samastasevāstu kuśalinyā mayā kṛtā | nārīrūpeṇa rātryāṃ vai śṛṃgāro bhojanādikam ||77|| pātrāṇāṃ śuddhikaraṇaṃ pānaṃ bhakṣyaṃ sugandhi ca | śayyāvidhānaṃ ramyaṃ ca tāmbulādyarpaṇaṃ tathā ||78|| rājñyā dehasya samyag vai saṃvāhanaṃ sumardanam | vyajanena pavanasyārpaṇaṃ vārtāpralāpanam ||79|| upadeśādikaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā tadā niśi | śṛṇu lakṣmi copadeśaṃ kṛtavānahameva yam ||3.228.80|| śāstrakathā śravaṇīyā guruḥ pūjyo hi sarvathā | dānaṃ deyaṃ tathā rājñyā śraddhayā dharmayoṣitā ||81 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sevyaḥ sadā dhiyā | ahantāmamate tyājye garvaḥ kāryo na sarvathā ||82|| dīnānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ krodhaḥ kāryo na bhṛtyake | dāsīṣu ca kṛpā kāryā na hartavyaṃ kṣatāvapi ||83|| annaṃ dhanaṃ gṛhaṃ vāpi sevākṣatāvapi kvacit | bhajanīyaḥ paramātmā rājñyā tasyāṃ kṛpā hareḥ ||84|| bhavatyeva sadā tena mokṣo’kṣare prajāyate | nirañjanā mahāmuktā jāyate kṛṣṇasadṛśī ||85|| na baddhyate ramāvat sā karmabhiśca śubhāśubhaiḥ | atisnehena lakṣmīvat prāpnotyaikyaṃ harau tu sā ||86|| yadvā prasevate bhaktyā patnī bhūtvā pṛthak sthitā | hareḥ kṛpayā kāryeṣu svatantrā jāyate sadā ||87|| brahmaniṣṭhā brahmaśīlā muktimāpnoti cākṣare | yā tu bhogaparā rājñī kṛṣṇasevāvivarjitā ||88|| sā tu mṛtvā divaṃ gatvā bhuktvā martye’tra jāyate | mānuṣyevaṃ bahujanmasiddhā bhaktyā tu mokṣyate ||89|| sādhorguroḥ kṛpayā ca yāsyatyante’kṣaraṃ padam | kṛpayā śrīhareratra kṣayaṃ yānti hi vāsanāḥ ||3.228.90|| kṛtvā satsaṃgamevātra bhajitvā parameśvaram | mānuṣyaṃ sārthakaṃ kuryānmokṣātmanityarājyadam ||91 || ātmāyaṃ brahmarūpo’sti kṛṣṇaṃ paśyeddhi tatra ca | evaṃ lakṣmi tūpadiśya tāṃ rājñīṃ saṃprasevya ca ||92|| jāgradvannidritāṃ kṛtvā niragamaṃ tadālayāt | tāvattatra samāyātā nāpitānī niśārdhake ||93|| sevituṃ tāṃ mahārājñīṃ kampamānā bhayānvitā | śayyāsthale hyupasthitvā kṣamāmayācatānatā ||94|| mahīmānaprasaṃgena kālo me vigato bahuḥ | mahārājñyā kṣamā kāryā sevāyāṃ nāhamāgatā ||95|| śrutvāścaryaṃ paraṃ prāptā rājñī sandehamāgatā | yā sevitvā gatā bhṛtyā seyaṃ punaḥ kathaṃ nanu ||96|| samāyātā yācate ca kṣamāṃ vināparādhanam | vicāryetthaṃ jagādaināṃ nāpiti tvaṃ kathaṃ punaḥ ||97|| samāyātā kṣamāyāñcāṃ kuruṣe ca kathaṃ vada | idānīṃ tvaṃ samastaṃ me naiśikaṃ sevanādikam ||98|| kṛtvā yāsi nijaṃ gehaṃ kathaṃ vai yācase kṣamām | nāpitī prāha nāhaṃ vai tvāgatā sevane’dya vai ||99|| asmin kṣaṇe samāyāmi kiṃ bhrāntā vadasīva mām | pūjye mā kuru narmaivaṃ nāhamatra sthitābhavam || 3.228.10 0|| anyayā tu kayācitte kṛtā sevā hi sā bhavet | śrutvaivaṃ bhrāntimagamad rājñī kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ sukham || 101 || visṛjya nāpitīṃ nidrāṃ jagāma sā prajeśvarī | atha sā nāpitī naijaṃ gehaṃ yāti tu yāvatā || 1 02|| tāvatā svagṛhe nārīṃ dadarśa bahurūpiṇīm | rūpeṇa vayasā veṣeṇāpi svasadṛśīṃ tadā || 103|| kṣaṇamāścaryamāpannā papraccha smeraśobhanām | kā tvaṃ kathaṃ kutaścātra madgṛhe kamalāsamā || 104|| ahaṃ lakṣmi tadā naijaṃ rūpaṃ vyāvṛttya sundaram | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ viṣṇumadarśayam || 1 05|| tavārthe nāpitīrūpe bhūtvāhaṃ tāmasevayam | tvayā tu sevitāḥ santo rājñī kruddhābhavattadā || 1 06|| asevayā tava sarvaṃ hartavyaṃ niścikāya sā | mayā dhṛtvā tava rūpaṃ sevitā sā prajeśvarī || 107|| bhakte’haṃ bhagavānasmi śreyo’rthaḥ tava cāgataḥ | tvaṃ patiputraputryādyaiḥ sahitāsi sadā mama || 1 08|| nityaṃ dhyānaṃ mamaivaṃ tvaṃ samācara hi gocaram | neṣyāmi matparaṃ dhāma kuṭumbaṃ tava gocaram || 1 09|| ityuktvāhaṃ tayā ruddhaḥ śayyāyāmabhavaṃ kṣaṇam | mamānandaṃ paraṃ datvā tiro’bhavaṃ kṣaṇāntare || 3.228.11 0|| svapne tu nāpitaḥ putrāḥ putryaśca sādhavo’pi ca | sarve māṃ te vyapaśyan vai prātarjajāgaruśca te || 11 1|| parasparaṃ harermūrtervarṇanaṃ darśanātmakam | cakruste menire bhāgyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yad brahmadarśanam || 112|| atha prātaḥ punaḥ snātvā bhuktvā te sādhavo yayuḥ | grāmāntaraṃ ca sā nāpitānī divyakuṭumbinī || 11 3|| bhajate māṃ nāpito’pi bhajate tatkuṭumbakam | atha kālāntare sarvānanayaṃ sadvimānakaiḥ ||1 14|| dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ me vai lakṣmi kṛpāvaśo hariḥ | rājā rājñyādayaścāpi menire caritaṃ mama || 1 15|| divyaṃ taditi niścitya bhejurmāṃ saprajā hi tam | te’pi kālāntare dhāmākṣaraṃ yayurmamottamam ||1 1 6|| evaṃ lakṣmi mayā bhaktā uddhāritāḥ kṛpālunā | sādhoḥ kalyāṇadhāmnākhyasyāpi sevāmiṣeṇa ha || 1 17|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavettathā | yatheṣṭakāmanāpūrtirbhavenme kṛpayā rame ||1 18|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne svarṇadhanvanṛpateḥ sevakasya harṣadharmanāmakanāpitasya patnyā nigamikānāmnyā bhaktyā kalyāṇadhāmādisādhusādhvīsevāyāṃ sthitāyāḥ sevayā samprasanno bhagavān nigamikārūpo bhūtvā rājñīsevāmakarot, nāpitakuṭumbasya rakṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cākarodityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 228 ||
<3.229> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ bhaktānikodbhavām | ābhīrī mama bhaktāsīdārdraśṛṃgapure sthitā || 1 || vyāghrāraṇye siṃhavyāghrahiṃsraprāṇimaye sthale | nāmnā rūṭāṇakīdevī pūrvasaṃskārapāvanī || 2 || śṛṇu lakṣmi mahāścaryaṃ bhaktāyāḥ pravadāmi te | pūrvajanmani sā śūdrā dhīvarī saritastaṭe || 3 || dhīvarasya tu naukāyāṃ vartamānābhavat satī | śatruṃjayābdhisaṃgasthabhūmau vāsavatī sadā || 4 || gopanāthamahātīrthagāminaḥ sā tu mānavān | pratitīraṃ nayatyeva naukayā kṛṣṇamānasā || 5 || sādhavo ye samāyānti tān vai bhāvena sā satī | vinā dravyagrahaṇaṃ vai paraṃ tīraṃ nayatyapi || 6 || anyām̐stu dravyamādāya paraṃ tīraṃ nayatyatha | ekadā śrīharicaitanyākhyaḥ sādhustu yogirāṭ || 7 || paraṃ pāraṃ pragantuṃ tu sarittīramupāyayau | siddhaḥ sa sādhuvaryo vai pādukābhyāṃ jalopari || 8 || yāti svasiddhatapasā kvacid vyomnā prayātyapi | tathāpi svecchayā bhūmau viharan saritastaṭe || 9 || yadṛcchayāyayau taṃ ca dṛṣṭvā tu dhīvarī hi sā | namaskṛtya svanaukāyāmāgantumārthayad hudā || 3.229.1 0||| yogivaryastu dhīvaryāḥ śreyase nāvi māṃ bhajan | āruroha tatra copādideśa bhaktitoṣitaḥ ||1 1 || bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ bhaja nārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam | bhaja sādhūn satīḥ sādhvīḥ sadgatiṃ tva prayāsyasi || 1 2|| dehaste dhīvarīrūpa ātmā te citsvarūpavān | deho’yaṃ ca vaśe jīvātmanaḥ sadā hi vartate || 1 3|| yathā naukā vaśe te’sti tathā deho vaśe tava | yathā naukā dṛśyarūpā draṣṭrī tva prerikāsi ca || 14|| tathā deho dṛśyarūpo draṣṭātmā prerako’ti ca | deho duḥkhādinā vyāpto draṣṭā duḥkhādivarjitaḥ || 15| tatra draṣṭari sarvajñaḥ kaścidanyo virājate | yaḥ satkārye prerayati duṣṭakārye niṣedhati || 1 6| antarātmā sākṣirūpaḥ sa eva bhagavān hariḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāryakṛṣṇavallabhaḥ || 17| tameva bhaja yogīndrasādhusādhvīprapūjitam | bhaktyā hyananyayā snehamayyā taṃ saṃprasevaya || 18 | hṛdaye taṃ prabhuṃ kāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sadā nibhālaya | dhyānaṃ gopīpaternityaṃ kuru svarūpaśālinaḥ ||19|| bāhyaviṣayān santyajya hṛdaye paśya mādhavam | indriyāṇi samastāni tasmin kṛṣṇe samarpaya ||3.229.20|| parāvṛttyendriyavṛttīstasmin kṛṣṇe niyojaya | saccidānandasandohān mahānandaṃ samarjaya ||21 || kṛṣṇānandasya saṃbhoktrī bhava nityaṃ ramāsamā | kṛṣṇabhogasya samprāptyā bhogāścānye viṣaṃ yathā ||22|| tathā te vai bhaviṣyanti bhuṃkṣva kṛṣṇaṃ patiṃ prabhum | śrīkṛṣṇasya caritrāṇi divyāni mānuṣāṇi ca ||23|| saṃkīrtaya sadā bhaktyā svargamokṣapradāni vai | adbhutāni samastāni caritrāṇi ramāpateḥ ||24|| kāmaceṣṭācaritrāṇi yuddhāyojanakāni ca | utsavādyāni sarvāṇi smara nityaṃ śriyaḥ pateḥ || 25|| laukikālaukikānyeva nikṛṣṭānyuttamāni ca | tāni sarvāṇi divyāni caritrāṇi ramāpateḥ || 26|| jaḍaṃ kuryāścetanaṃ tu cetanaṃ tu jaḍaṃ hariḥ | evaṃvidhasamarthasya hareḥ saṃgaṃ sadā kuru ||27|| pramādaṃ ca mahālasyaṃ mahāmohaṃ madaṃ tyaja | ahantāṃ mamatāṃ tyaktvā cātmarūpā sadā bhava || 28|| saṃsārasāgaraṃ tartuṃ satsu nauṣu sthirā bhava | pativratā harau bhūtvā hariṃ patiṃ sadā bhaja ||29|| dehadaśāṃ vihāyaiva brahmadaśāṃ samāśraya | bhogān sarvān harau kṛṣṇe sthūlān sūkṣmān samarpaya ||3.229.30|| ātmāhaṃ na tu dehrosmītyevaṃ vai mananaṃ kuru | dāsyasi śrīpateścāhamipyevaṃ divyatāṃ vaha ||31|| evaṃvivekamāsādya nirbandhā karmabhirbhava | dehābhimānajaṃ pāpaṃ tyaja yāmyagatiṃ tyaja ||32|| bhajitvā śrīpatiṃ cānte dṛṣṭvā divyaṃ ramāpatim | tena sākaṃ vimānena divyākṣarapadaṃ vraja ||33|| dhīvarītvaṃ vihāyaiva buddhivarītvamāvaha | mama sādhoḥ prasaṃgena vaiṣṇavī paramā bhava ||34|| anena janmanā yadvā dvitīyenākṣaraṃ vraja | evaṃ lakṣmi tadā nāvi tūpadiṣṭā hi sādhunā ||35|| paraṃ bodhaṃ prāptavatī dhīvarī dhīmatī hyabhūt | paratīraṃ samāyātaṃ cāvatīrya tu sādhurāṭ ||36|| yayau tīrthaṃ ca dhīvaryai datvā jñānamanuttamam | atha sā śrīkṛṣṇanāma japatyaharniśaṃ tataḥ ||37|| matsyādā dhīvarī bhāgyavaśena kālayogataḥ | mṛtā sā mānavī jātā hyābhīrī mahiṣīvatī ||38|| punareva strīsvarūpā mahābhāgavatī satī | sādhūnāṃ sevikā bālyād brahmacaryaparāyaṇā ||39|| vivāhecchā yayā naiva kṛtā dagdhā tu kāmanā | yauvane vidyamāne’pi vārdhakye iva saṃsthitā ||3.229.40 || pūrvasaṃskāravaśato jātismarā tu yoginī | svabhāvataścātmaniṣṭhāparāyaṇābhavaddhi sā ||41|| nāmnā ruṭāṇakīdevī divyajñānaparāyaṇā | sādhusevāparā sādhvī sāṃkhyayoginikā sadā |||42|| ātmanivedinī tyāgavatī vairāgyaśālinī | mālāvartanamaniśaṃ karoti kīrtanaṃ hareḥ ||43|| mahiṣāṇāṃ tu dugdhāni sādhūn miṣṭāni nityaśaḥ | kṛtvā pāyasarūpāṇi bhojayatyeva bhaktitaḥ ||44|| snātvā prātarharikṛṣṇaṃ prapūjyārghyaṃ pradāya ca | sūryāyārghyaṃ ca pitṛbhyo datvā kṛtvā samarpaṇam ||45|| śrāddhaṃ pāyasasiddhānnaiḥ phalairjalaiḥ pradāya ca | tataḥ sā bhojanaṃ sādhūn kārayitvā satīstathā ||46|| bhuṃkte prāsādikaṃ nityaṃ vartate paṃktipāvanī | yathā lakṣmīryathā gaṃgā yathā devī sarasvatī ||47|| tathā sā brahmaparamā ruṭāṇakī hi dīvyati | yasya gṛhe nityameva samāyānti hi sādhavaḥ ||48|| sādhvyaścāpi samāyānti bhaktāṃ jñātvā tu sevikām | kīrtanāni prakurvanti rāsān mahotsavān śubhān ||49|| evaṃ vai bhajamānāyāḥ sevikāyā gṛhe kvacit | niśārdhe saṃvyatīte vai supteṣu sarvadehiṣu ||3.229.50 || daityo’raṇyāt samāyātaḥ kaścidāyasakuṇḍalaḥ | tāḍavaddīrghadehaśca kṛṣṇavarṇo’tiromavān ||91 || yuvā ca balavān puṣṭo vaṭavṛkṣa ivāparaḥ | sa tāṃ suptāṃ mahāsādhvīṃ jagṛhe tvatilāghavāt ||52|| nītvā yayau vyomamārge mahāraṇye gato’bhavat | avātatāra nibiḍe vṛkṣaṣaṇḍe’pi lāghavāt ||53|| pṛthvyāṃ nidhāya tāṃ ruṭāṇakīṃ surūpiṇīṃ śanaiḥ | prabodhayāmāsa daityaḥ sāpi bubodha yāvatā ||54|| dadarśa vanamadhye svāmānītāṃ vanavāsinā | āyasakuṇḍalanāmnā daityena svavaśīkṛtām ||55|| athāpi sā mahābhaktā dhairyavatī satīśvarī | mahābhāgavatī durgāsamā devī hi vaiṣṇavī |||56|| kṛṣṇabalavatī sādhvī bhayaṃ prāptā na vai manāk | sasmāra hṛdaye kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ jagatpatiṃ patim ||57|| yadyahaṃ tava bhaktāsmi tvayā naijā kṛtāsmi ca | tavaiva pātivratyena varte’haṃ śrīsamā yadi ||58|| tvayi cāsmi tvātmanivedinī vai sāṃkhyayoginī | tvayā karo gṛhīto’sti mama cet svāminā sadā ||59|| tava santaśca sādhyaśca sevitā vai mayā yadi | tvadarthakṛtasarvasvā yadi cāsmi tava priyā ||3.229.60|| tadā tvāyāhi viṣṇo tvaṃ kṛṣṇa śīghraṃ puro bhava | sākṣādāgatya rakṣāṃ me kuru daityāddhi dāruṇāt ||61 || yadi te’haṃ na jātāsmi bhavāmi bhaktivarjitā | tarhi daityo baliḥ sparśaṃ karotu yadi te ruciḥ ||62|| yatheṣṭaṃ kuru kānta tvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ nijanāṇake | yatnaṃ vidhehi bhagavannaudāsīnyaṃ ca vācara ||63|| ityuktvā hṛdaye mahyaṃ pūjāṃ dattavatī tadā | daityo’pi tāṃ tadā vācā rañjayan bahubhāvataḥ ||64|| vārtāṃ kartuṃ tu vividhāṃ prerayatyeva cotsukaḥ | tathāpi maunamāpannā maccittā na vadatyapi ||65|| daityo nanarta purato bahuhāsyakṛtirmuhuḥ | tathāpi kṛṣṇacittā sā bahirmano na vai vyadhāt ||66|| atha gṛhe’pi nidrāyāṃ sarve’bhavan jaḍā yathā | sādhavaścāpi sādhvyaśca jaḍāśca mahīmānakāḥ ||67|| ruṭāṇakyāḥ pitā nāmnā durvāraṇo’pi nidritaḥ | mātā nāmnā khaṭamiṣṭādevī tvāsīddhi nidritā ||68|| anye grāmajanāḥ sarve āsam̐stadātinidritāḥ | kaiścijjñātaṃ na haraṇaṃ ruṭāṇakyāstamomaye ||69|| atha mahiṣyaḥ paśavo gandhadṛṣṭaya eva tāḥ | vividurdaityagandhaṃ ca jāgrannidrāvinidritāḥ ||3.229.70|| bubudhustā mahiṣyo vai daityaṃ samāgataṃ tathā | nītvā ruṭāṇakīdevīṃ yāntaṃ vyomni tamomaye ||71 || raṇakāṭaṃ rambhaṇaṃ ca paśvākrośaṃ pracakrire | jajāgaruḥ samastāste śrutvā bhayaṃ samāgatam ||72||| cakruḥ paritaḥ kāṣṭhānāṃ vahnīn śārdūlaśaṃkayā | dīrghaśabdān mahānādān cakruste paritaḥ khalu ||73|| siṃhaśaṃkāmayāḥ sarve daityaṃ na vividustadā | evaṃ ghaṭikā vigatā kṛte’pi rakṣaṇe’bhitaḥ ||74|| mahiṣyo nābhavan śāntā garjanti vihvalā yathā | ekā tu mahiṣī rūṭāṇakyāsanaṃ drutaṃ yayau ||75|| śṛṃgābhyāmāsanaṃ nītvā bhramaṇaṃ pracakāra sā | āhūtā tu tadā sarvai rūṭāṇaki ruṭāṇaki ||76 || kva gatā tvāsanaṃ ceyaṃ mahiṣī nāśayatyapi | samāhūtā cāpi yadā na pratyuvāca bhāminī | |77|| na dṛśyate janamadhye gṛhe sādhvīsatīṣvapi | tadā śaṃkāspadā jātā nītā kenāpi putrikā ||78|| atha vai vihvalāḥ sarve rurudurmārgaṇāya ca | parito niryayuścāpi sīmni kvāpi na dadṛśuḥ ||79|| pratyāyayurgatāśāste sasmarurmāṃ pareśvaram | sādhvyaśca sādhavaḥ sarve nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ vyadhuḥ ||3.229.80|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāryakṛṣṇamādhava | tadā yayāvahaṃ cakragaruḍābhyāṃ yuto vane ||8 1 || nṛtyantaṃ daityarājaṃ taṃ cakartāhaṃ sulāghavāt | tattejo mayi tvākṛṣya kṛtvā tāṃ garuḍopari |||82|| ānandayitvā prītyā tāmanayaṃ tadgahaṃ drutam | sāpi divyatamā jātā sādhvī matsparśamātrataḥ |||83|| divyaiśvaryavatī lakṣmi yathā tvaṃ tvādṛśī hi sā | evaṃ tāṃ vyomamārgeṇa cārdraśṛṃgapure gṛhe ||84|| avasthāpya tathā sarvabhaktebhyo darśanaṃ mama | datvā tejomayaṃ divyaṃ sthitvā ca ghaṭikādhikam ||85|| sādhusādhvīkṛtāṃ sevāmaṃgīkṛtya ca pāyasam | bhojanaṃ pūjanaṃ vāripānaṃ tāmcūlakādikam ||86|| bhuktvā garuḍavāho’haṃ gantuṃ sajjo’bhavaṃ yadā | tadā bhaktāḥ premamagnāḥ prārthayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||87|| saha tvasmānnaya kṛṣṇa yadi te smo’tisevakāḥ | rūṭāṇakī sādhavaśca sādhvyaścāpi tathārthayan ||88 || ahaṃ lakṣmi tadā tebhyo mama mantraṃ dadau śubham | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||89|| pādajalaṃ prasādānnaṃ pāyasaṃ ca dadau tadā | apakvānmānavān bhaktiṃ kartumādiśya tatra ca ||3.229.90|| pakvān sādhvīḥ sādhujanān ruṭāṇakīṃ tathā satīm | mātaraṃ janakaṃ tasyāstathā tāṃ mahiṣīmapi ||9 1 || vidhāya divyadehām̐śca muktān muktānikāstathā | nidhāya gāruḍe pṛṣṭhe’nayaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||92|| anyānapakvān kālenānayaṃ vaikuṇṭhamuttamam | evaṃ lakṣmi mayā rakṣā kṛtābhīryā hi yoṣitaḥ ||93|| sā tu muktānikā jātā brahmapriyā madakṣare | rūpeśvarītināmnādya vartate tava maṇḍale ||94|| yuvatī mama patnīyaṃ paśyaināṃ madvivāhitām | anyāḥ sādhvyo yuvatyo’tra santi daśa striyo mama ||95|| mandārakalikādyāstāstava sakhyo’tra yoṣitaḥ | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre brahmapriyā mama priyāḥ ||96|| divyacakṣuṣa evaitāṃ kathāṃ vidanti netare | camatkāro mama divyaste rame kathito mayā ||97|| bhaktānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ caivaṃ karomi sarvathā sadā | pakvānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cāpi dhāmākṣarapradānakam ||98|| ye māṃ bhajeyuḥ satataṃ sarvasvārpaṇabhāvanāḥ | teṣāmahaṃ ca te me’pi sambaddhāḥ saṃbhavanti hi ||99|| madarpitānāmavanaṃ karomi sarvathā sadā | kālād yamāt karmataścendriyādibhyaśca doṣataḥ || 3.229.10 0|| paṭanācchravaṇādasya cintanāt kathanādapi | bhuktirmuktirbhavedeva mama prāptiḥ sukhapradā || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne pūrvajanmani dhīvaryā rūṭāṇakyā ābhīrībhaktāyāḥ sādhvīnāṃ ca daityād rakṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṇa ca śrīhariṇā kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 229 ||
<3.230> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ matsyapattanavāsinaḥ | matsyādasya dhīvarasya tathāpi bhaktikāriṇaḥ || 1 || kathāmuddhārakartrī vai sādhusamāgamodbhavām | pāpināṃ pāvanīṃ māyāmohanāśakarīṃ tathā || 2 || dhīraparvābhidhaścāsīd dhīvaro matsyapattane | śatanaukādhipaḥ kṛṣṇānadyabdhisaṃgame sadā || 3 || yasya nāvo bhṛtyayuktā matsyān gṛhṇanti jālikāḥ | brāhmamuhūrtādārabhyāsūryodayaṃ tu nityaśaḥ || 4 || nityaṃ vai lakṣamatsyānāṃ jālagrahaḥ prajāyate | sūkṣmasthūlasudīrghāṇāṃ bhinnaguṇādivarṣmaṇām || 5 || teṣāṃ hiṃsātmakaṃ pāpaṃ jāyate dhīraparvaṇaḥ | lakṣavarṣāyuṣyako’pi dhīraparvātihiṃsayā || 6 || āyuṣā hīyate nityaṃ śatāhapramitena vai | varṣadvayāntare tasya sahasrāṇi tu saptatiḥ || 7 || varṣāṇi cāyuṣaḥ pāpaiśchinnāni matsyaśāpataḥ | triṃśadvarṣottaraṃ tena matsyavyāpāra ādṛtaḥ || 8 || militvā lakṣavarṣāṇi dvātriṃśe vigatāni ha | dvātriṃśe cāntime māse varṣāyāṃ meghavarṣaṇam || 9 || saptāhaṃ satataṃ jātaṃ kṛṣṇādeśeṣu sarvaśaḥ |
