tuṃgabhadrāpradeśeṣu tathaiva meghavarṣaṇam ||3.230.1 0 || abhavat satataṃ lakṣmi mūśaladhārasadṛśam | jalāni pūravegāni mamurna saritostadā || 11 || sarinmārgaṃ vihāyaiva bhūmārgān viṣayān vyadhuḥ | bahavo mānavāstatrāraṇyasthāḥ sādhavo’pi ca || 12|| paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi jalapūraiḥ pravāhitā | mṛtāstu bahavasteṣu pūreṣu dūrakarṣitāḥ ||1 3|| nirādhārā mṛtāḥ sarve sādhārāḥ kāṣṭhalambanāḥ | vṛkṣādyālambanāścānye jīvantaḥ pūramadhyagāḥ || 14|| āyayurmatsyapaṭṭasya kṛṣṇasāgarasaṃgame | dehino jīvato vīkṣya mahājale’pi vai tadā ||15|| dhīraparvā nijabhṛtyān yantrinaukābhirakṣiṇaḥ | sarvānājñāpayāmāsa śatanaukādhināyakān || 16|| mā matsyagrāhaṃ kurvantu yāvannadyā upadravaḥ | jīvanmānavagrahaṇaṃ kurvantu pūramadhyataḥ || 17|| sarvathā prāṇadānaṃ vai prāṇamātraṃ tu jīvinām | pravāhavāhitānāṃ vai kartavyaṃ pralaye’tra tu || 18|| bhojanaṃ cāpi śuṣkānnaṃ bharjitaṃ caṇakādikam | dātavyaṃ kambalavastrādyaṃ śītaharaṇārthakam || 19|| evaṃ vai rakṣaṇaṃ tatra vihitaṃ dhīraparvaṇā | dhanānnāmbaranaukādipradānairbhṛtyamānavaiḥ ||3.230.20|| narā nāryo bālakāśca vṛddhā vā kāṣṭhasaṃgatāḥ | vaṃśastambamahāvṛkṣalagnāḥ śākhāvilambanāḥ ||21 || ghāsapeṭādisaṃsaktāścānye śavādikāśrayāḥ | taradvastusamādhārāḥ sahasraśo hi mānavāḥ ||22| yatayaḥ sādhavaḥ sādhvyo viraktā vaiṣṇavā api | bhaktā nārāyaṇaparā jīvanto rakṣitāstadā ||23|| teṣāmāśīrvādalabdhamahāpuṇyātisāgaraḥ | jīvadānamahāpuṇyodayaścāpi vyajāyata ||24|| puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ vinā bhogaṃ kṣapayituṃ na śakyate | āyuḥkṣayānnasaptāhe yogo’yaṃ samajāyata ||25|| pāpairāyuḥ kṣīyate vai puṇyairāyurvivardhate | pūrvasya pūrvabhogo vai paścimasya sa paścimaḥ ||26|| hiṃsāghātādikarmotthaṃ phalaṃ tu maraṇaṃ muhuḥ | ghātenaiva bhaveddhātakinastasya yamālaye ||27||| tīvrasaṃvegitaṃ karma matsyamārodbhavaṃ bali | pūrvaṃ bhogāya vai prāptaṃ kālapāśābhiyojitam |||28|| yāmyadūtaiśca saṃyuktaṃ koṭimatsyādighātajam | saptāhānte dine varṣāvege tu nyūnatāṃ gate ||29|| naukāyāṃ yantrayuktāyāṃ niṣadya bhṛtyasevitaḥ | patnīputrādisahito draṣṭuṃ velāṃ jale yayau ||3.230.3 0|| kṛṣṇāsāgarasaṃyoge mahāpravāhavegite | mahājale yayau yāvat krośadūraṃ tu sāgare ||3 1 || tāvannaukātale vṛkṣaśākhocchālanamadbhutam | acintitaṃ samāyātaṃ vāribhramo mahocchrayaḥ ||30|| acintitaḥ samutpanno mahāvicyudayo’pi ca | mitho mahājalabhittidvayatāḍanasaṃbhave ||33|| mahānaukāgrato bhāge khe tūtplutya suvegataḥ | adhogatāgrato yāvattāvat pṛṣṭhe mahājalaiḥ ||34|| utkṣiptā khe vegataśca tāḍavat sā tato’bhavat | naukāgraṃ jalabhittibhyāṃ nītaṃ cādho jalāntare ||35|| tāvatpārśvamahāvegijalairvyāvartitā hyavāṅ | nimagnā kṣaṇamātreṇa tatra samudravāriṣu || 36|| talaṃ gatā bhuvaḥ sā tu nirāśrayāsahāyinī | dhīraparvādayaḥ sarve mṛtā vāriṣu mūrchitāḥ ||37|| yāmyadūtairyamalokaṃ nītāste pāpino drutam | śavāstu bhakṣitā matsyairdhanāni bhṛtyamānavaiḥ ||38|| naukāstu nāvikairnītāḥ prāṇāstu yamapārṣadaiḥ | puṇyapāpāni nītāni mṛtaistaistu kuṭumbibhiḥ ||29||| pātheyāni yathā tāni cātmabhiḥ saha saṃyayuḥ | yathākālaṃ ca te dūtairnītā yamālayaṃ prati ||3.230.40|| citraguptena pāpāni śrāvitāni yamāntike | dharmarājā tu tān sarvānadaṇḍayad yathākṛtam ||41 || kālasūtre nyakṣipacca bahukālaṃ tataḥ punaḥ | galapāśākhyanarake nyakṣipanmatsyaghātinaḥ ||42 || tataḥ kṣārakardame ca nyakṣipaccirameva tān | tato viśasane kuṇḍe nyakṣipattān saśastrake ||43||| tataścāsipatravane nyakṣipattām̐ściraṃ tataḥ | nyakṣipattān vahnikuṇḍe mahājvālāsamākule ||44|| tatastānnyakṣipajjantubahule kuṇḍake’tra ca | vṛścikāḥ kṛkalāsādyā daṃśanti viṣapāyinaḥ ||45|| tato lālāmukhe tāṃśca nyakṣipad yamarājakaḥ | tato matsyādikuṇḍe ca kṣārasāgaranāmake ||46|| nyakṣipattān jālanaukāyāmyabhaṭaiḥ prapīḍite | matsyāste tvabhavam̐statra mahāmatsyādibhojanāḥ ||47|| matsyairutkartitāścāpi bhakṣitāste punaḥ punaḥ | ujjīvinaḥ punaścāpi bhūtvā kaṣṭāni yānti te ||588|| tato niṣkāsitāḥ sarve dīrghakālena kuṇḍataḥ | sarvapāpātidaṇḍasya prānte dharmājñayā ca te ||49|| pretā abhavan śuṣke vai mahāraṇye tu duḥkhinaḥ | sahasravatsarānte te bhuktvā tāḥ pretayātanāḥ ||3.230.50|| kṣārasamudrake jātā matsyāḥ kṛṣṇābdhisaṃgame | dhīvarairjālayantraiśca dhṛtāste bhakṣitāstataḥ ||51 || evaṃ kṛtānāṃ pāpānāṃ bhogāntaṃ prāpnuvam̐śca te | tataḥ puṇyastaraḥ prāpto manuṣyaprāṇadānajaḥ ||52|| sarve te matsyanagare vaiṣṇavānāṃ gṛhe’bhavan | viprāṇāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca naupatīnāṃ subālakāḥ ||53|| naukābhirye tu vastūnāṃ vyāpāraṃ bahudeśinām | kurvanti dhanadaṃ śreṣṭhamudyamaṃ na tu hiṃsanam ||54|| evaṃvidhānāṃ putrāste’bhavan bhaktiyutāḥ śubhāḥ | dhanadhānyarddhimadgehe yatra tatra sukhānvitāḥ ||55|| viprabhaktāḥ sādhubhaktāḥ ahiṃsādharmatatparāḥ | devapūjāparāścāpi dānino vighasāśinaḥ |||56|| gavāṃ sevāparāścāpi sādhusādhvīprapūjakāḥ | devālayādisevāyāṃ śraddhālavo nayānvitāḥ ||57|| kāritaṃ mandiraṃ taiśca nārāyaṇasya tatra vai | lakṣmyā sākaṃ haristatra vidhinā sthāpito dvijaiḥ ||58|| atha bhakto dvijo vipro nāmnā nirvāṇanāvikaḥ | gārhasthyaṃ samparityajya tyāgāśramaṃ viveśa ha ||59|| sādhurbhūtvāvasattatra mandire pūjakaḥ sadā | nirvāṇāyananāmāsau vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo yatiḥ ||3.230.60|| devasevāṃ bhaktasevāṃ satāṃ sevāṃ karoti ca | vaiṣṇavānutsavān divyān karoti kārayatyapi ||6 1 || kathāṃ karoti sāyaṃ ca mānavāśca narāḥ striyaḥ | śravaṇārthāḥ samāyānti nagaraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ hyabhūt ||62|| ekadāhaṃ tasya bhaktyā samākṛṣṭo dayāvaśaḥ | sādhūrbhūtvā vaiṣṇavāgryaḥ kathāṃ śrotuṃ yayau tadā ||63|| abhyāgataṃ ca māṃ vīkṣyopāveśya māṃ śubhāsane | svāgatādi cakārāpi mama sādhuḥ sa śobhanaḥ ||64|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathottaraṃ tvaham | upādideśa tatraiva sabhyebhyo dayayā hariḥ ||65|| kathāyāḥ śravaṇe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prasīdati | śrūyate yatkathā so’tra kṛṣṇaḥ sākṣāt prajāyate ||66|| kathāphalaṃ harau sneho māhātmyavedanena vai | ātmaniṣṭhā ca bhagavanniṣṭhā mokṣaśca dhāmani ||67|| māyāmohavināśaśca hareḥ sevārjanaṃ sadā | divyatā sarvadā śāśvatānandasaṃbhṛtā tathā ||68|| kathāphalaṃ tu tatproktaṃ śravyaivaṃ cādarāt kathā | premibhaktasya ghaṭikā kṛṣṇaṃ vinā na gacchati ||69|| kṛṣṇekṣaṇaṃ vinā sthātuṃ śaknuyānna kathaṃcana | jñānavān bhaktimām̐ścāpi vairāgyavān sa vartate | |3.230.70 || dṛḍhā sthitirharau tasya jāyate cānapāyinī | nāryā api śriyaḥ kānte prītiḥ syādanapāyinī ||71|| aikāntikī pūrṇabhaktā sadā mugdhā harau bhavet | svakāryasādhane raktā kṛṣṇādeva tadarthikā ||72|| mano nānyatra yātyeva vasatyeva harau sadā | svakāryaṃ kṛṣṇakāryaṃ ca bhaktyā sādhayati dhruvam ||73|| kṛṣṇakāntā kṛṣṇabhaktā sadā raktā harau bhavet | svārthaṃ vihāya kṛṣṇasya kāryaṃ sarvaṃ prasādhayet ||74|| sarvasvārpaṇabhāvā syāt sadārpitā harau bhavet| | evaṃ nāryo bhavantyeva mugdhā raktāḥ samarpitāḥ ||75|| tredhā tāsāṃ patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samuddhartā mahārṇavāt | tāsāṃ tu śreyase kṛṣṇo mānavo jāyate patiḥ ||76|| anugrahāya rājā vai ramaṇo mokṣado hariḥ | sādhūnāṃ tu śreyase sa tāpaso jāyate ṛṣiḥ ||77|| rājarūpaṃ sādhurūpaṃ patirūpaṃ prabhuṃ tu yāḥ | āśrayanti tu tā divyā bhavanti muktakoṭikāḥ |||7||| divyadṛṣṭyā harikṛṣṇaṃ vidanti parameśvaram | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māpativallabham ||79|| yathā miṣṭasamudrasya jalaṃ pibanti dehinaḥ | yathādehaṃ yathāśakti tṛpyanti ca yathābalam ||3.230.80|| pipīlikādikamahāmatsyāntāḥ sarvadehinaḥ | tathāpi te samudrasya pāraṃ na yānti vai kvacit | |8 1 || yathāmbarasya maśakādayaśca garuḍādayaḥ | yathāśakti sukhaṃ prāpyoḍḍayanaṃ racayanti hi ||82 || tathāpyantaṃ na yāntyeva vyomāpāraṃ nigadyate | tathā śrīkṛṣṇacandrasya pāraṃ yānti na ke’pyapi ||8 3|| yathā bhūmigato dehī candraṃ sthālaṃ prapaśyati | sa evāntikatāṃ prāpto mahāntaṃ taṃ prapaśyati ||84|| candragato janaścandramapāraṃ samprapaśyati | tathā bhaktaḥ samīpastho’pāraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pravindati ||889|| upāsanābalaṃ svalpaṃ dīpavat kathyate hi tat | tato’dhikaṃ balaṃ dāvavahnivajjāyate khalu | |86|| tato’dhikataraṃ tattu mahābhūtānalādivat | tato’dhikatamaṃ tattu brahmadhāmasamaṃ matam 87|| brahmatejobhirāpūrṇo bhakto vindati mādhavam | apāraṃ cātidivyaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ manoharam ||88|| brahmarūpo mahāmukto niṣevate parātparam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmiramāpatim ||89|| bhaktyabhyāsavaśā nārī prāpnoti māṇikīpatim | satāṃ patiṃ muktapatiṃ brahmapatiṃ mahāprabhum ||3.230.90 || yathā snehaprakāśāderādhikyaṃ jāyate tathā | kṛṣṇasukhaṃ mahaddivyamāpnoti muktatāṃ gataḥ || 91|| kṛṣṇātmā kṛṣṇamūrtiśca kṛṣṇānandapariplutaḥ | muktottamo jāyate vā naro nārī samarpitaḥ ||92|| bhaktyabhyāsapratāpena kṛṣṇaikyaṃ cāpi jāyate | lakṣmīvad rādhikāvacca māṇikīvat suśāśvatam ||93|| nityaṃ kṛṣṇo bhajanīyaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho | hare śrībālakṛṣṇaśrīpate’kṣarapate vibho ||94|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | mantraṃ japantu nityaṃ vai nārāyaṇasya sevakāḥ ||95|| ātmanivedinaḥ santu kṛṣṇārthasarvaniścayāḥ | ityuktvāhaṃ kathānte vai caturbāhustadābhavam ||96|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmamaṇikirīṭakuṇḍalaiḥ | tejobhiḥ śobhito lakṣmi sarvairjayetiśabditaḥ ||97|| pūjito hṛdayaiścāpi bhaktyā candanavāribhiḥ | vandito nijamokṣārthaṃ tathāstvityavadaṃ ca tān ||98|| manāṃsyākṛṣya sahasā tirobhāvaṃ cidambare | atha prāpte samaye tān anayaṃ dhāma me’kṣaram ||99|| kām̐ścit svargaṃ tathānyām̐śca satyaṃ vairājakaṃ padam | aparān śrīpuraṃ cānyānamṛtaṃ tvanayaṃ tathā || 3.230.10 0|| vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāpi golokamavyākṛtaṃ paraṃ padam | prāpayāmāsa bhaktām̐stānnāvikān jīvarakṣakān || 101 || sādhurakṣakarān sādhvīrakṣakān bālarakṣakān | jīvadānapradātṝm̐śca bhaktān dvitīyajanmajān || 10 2|| evaṃ lakṣmi mahāpāpān kadācid bhagavatkṛte | sādhvīsādhukṛte gavāṃ kṛte’pi puṇyakārakān || 10 3|| kālāntare’pi puṇyānāmudaye sādhuyoginaḥ | kṛtvā nayāmi dhāmordhvamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam || 1 04|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccintanādapi | bhuktirmuktirbhavatyeva yatheṣṭā ca gatirbhavet || 105|| pāpipāpāni naśyanti śrīhareḥ smaraṇādapi | bhaktānāṃ ca yaśogānaiḥ śuddhyantyaghāni sarvaśaḥ || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne pūrvajanmani dhīvarāṇāṃ matsyamārāṇāṃ dhīraparvādīnāṃ yāmyayātanottaraṃ pūrvālpapuṇyena naupatijanmāni tatra bhajanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 230 ||
<3.231> puruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śūlāropaṇakāriṇaḥ | jallādasya kathāṃ nāmnā tārakādarśakasya vai || 1 || cambāvatyāṃ nagaryāṃ vai rāvīnadyāstaṭāntike | mahākārāgāradurge śūlīdaṇḍavidhāyini || 2 || niyukto’bhūt tārakādarśakaḥ śūlyadhiropakaḥ | rājadaṇḍena ye daṇḍitāḥ syurmahāparādhinaḥ || 3 || strīghnā goghnāśca bālaghnā naraghnā mūrtibhañjakāḥ | devālayavineṣṭāraḥ sarve śūlyarhadaṇḍinaḥ || 4 || teṣāṃ śūlyagrādhirohaṃ karoti tārakādṛśiḥ | cambāpuryā mahārājo nāmnā vai supathānakaḥ || 5 || tārakādarśakaṃ jallādakaṃ rarakṣa śūlinam | durgamadhye śūlikāste yatra vaihāyasāḥ sadā|| 6 || patattriṇo bhramantyeva piśitāśanakāṃkṣiṇaḥ | yāṃ smṛtvā romakampo vai jāyate dhairyaśālinaḥ || 7 || dṛṣṭvā hṛtstabdhatā cāpi nirbalasya prajāyate | daṇḍaṃ śrutvā parameśaṃ smaranti sajjanā api || 8 || pāpino’pi prabhuṃ smarantīśeśa pāhi māmiti | yamālayo yathā tadvad bhayānakaṃ sthalaṃ tu tat || 9 || tatra jallādavāso’bhūd divāniśaṃ hi durgake | vetana labhate rājyāt prāṇayātrāṃ karoti ca || 3.231.10 || śūlīdaṇḍārhaduṣṭāya daṇḍadānakṣaṇāt puraḥ | śrāvayatyeva nāmāni kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti saḥ || 11 || rakṣa mādhava govinda punaḥ pāpāt prarakṣaya | eṣo’haṃ śūlikārūpe kṛṣṇe’rpito bhavāmi ca || 1 2|| mama pāpaphalaṃ cedaṃ bhuṃje nānyo’tra doṣabhāg | punarnaivaṃ kariṣye’ghaṃ pāpānmukto bhavāmi cet || 13|| śṛṇvantu mānavāḥ sarve’dhirohāmi svakarmaṇā | mā śocantu mama nāśaṃ śocantu pāpakarma vai || 14|| mā kurvantvapi pāpāni mā śūlīmadhiyantu ca | bāndhavāḥ pitaro mātā sambandhī putraputrikāḥ || 15|| suhṛdaśca prajālokā ye tu paśyanti māmiha | te dharmaṃ saṃpālayantu me vaktavyaṃ na cetarat || 1 6|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | iti sarvaṃ tadoccārayitvā taṃ daṇḍaśālinam || 17|| netrayoḥ paṭṭabandhaṃ ca kṛtvottolya janaiḥ śanaiḥ | śūlyagre tīkṣṇadhāre’vasthāpyate pṛṣṭhage tale || 18|| madhyabhāge pṛṣṭhavaṃśe samatole śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | uttānaṃ doṣiṇaṃ śūlaṃ yathā viśati pṛṣṭhake || 1 9|| tadā jallādako bhakto gṛṇāti kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa vai | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṛṣṇa saṃśrāvayati doṣiṇam ||3.231.20 || pāpanāśastathā mokṣo yadodayaḥ prajāyate | yadvā punaḥ śubhaṃ janma yathā syāddoṣiṇastathā ||21|| salilaṃ tulasīmiśraṃ tasmai dadāti doṣiṇe | oṣṭhayoścāntime prāṇayānakāle hariṃ gṛṇan ||22|| vādyāni bahudhā tatra vādayanti nṛpānugāḥ | duḥkhaśabdākrośanādi yathā śrūyeta naiva ha ||23|| atha prāṇe gate śūlācchavaṃ cottārya bhūtale | vahnigarte kṣipatyeva yadvā sambandhine tadā |||24|| kuṭumbine dadātyeva rājājñayā yathātatham | evaṃ sa tārakādarśo doṣiṇaṃ preṣayatyapi ||25 || yamalokaṃ ca vā kṛṣṇanāma saṃśrāvya vai divam | antarāmā harikṛṣṇo jānāmyahaṃ rame hi tat ||26|| bhakto me tārakādarśo vartate nāmakīrtane | evaṃ kṛtvā daṇḍakarma tataḥ snātvā ca mālikām || 27|| kare dhṛtvā kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa sahasraṃ sa japatyapi | prāyaścittaṃ tathā saptopavāsān sa karotyapi ||28|| kṣamāṃ prayācate kṛṣṇācchūlīpāpaṃ kṣamasva me | atha tīrthe śubhe rāvīnadyā jambupradeśake ||29|| snātvā dānaṃ dadātyeva vetanāttaddinodbhavam | sādhūn prasevate nityaṃ karoti smaraṇaṃ hareḥ ||3.231.3 0 || nityaṃ dhyānaṃ hareścāpi pūjanaṃ bhajanaṃ tathā | naivedyārpaṇamevāpi tāmbūlasalilārpaṇam ||3 1 || dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ namaskāraṃ nīrājanaṃ stavaṃ tathā | kṣamāyācanamevāpi kṛtvā visarjanaṃ namaḥ ||32|| karotyeva tato bhuktvā prasādaṃ tu niveditam | svabhṛtyatāniyuktau vai namraḥ samupatiṣṭhati || 33|| mālāmāvartayan haste nārāyaṇaṃ raṭam̐śca mām | bhaktān vīkṣya namaskāraṃ karoti cāntarātmane || 34|| sarvaṃ brahmādhivāsaṃ ca matvā magno hi vartate | evaṃvidho mama bhakto jallādastārakādṛśiḥ || 35|| bhaktau me dṛḍhatāṃ prāptaḥ sāyaṃ tu svagṛhāṃgaṇe | narānnārīḥ samāhūya kīrtanaṃ tu niśāmukhe ||36|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaviṣṇo jiṣṇo rādhāramāpate | govindamādhavavāsudevakṛṣṇa śriyaḥ pate ||37|| evaṃ raṭati ghaṭikādvayaṃ saṃbhūya mānavaiḥ | kīrtanānte mama pūjāṃ karotyārārtrikaṃ tathā ||38|| prasādaṃ sarvabhaktebhyo dadāti manniveditam | rātrau nidrāṃ karotyeva kaṇṭhe dhṛtvā tu mālikām ||39|| raṭan mannāma vai bālakṛṣṇakṛṣṇanarāyaṇa | evaṃ bhaktyā prasanno’haṃ sañjātastasya vai puraḥ ||3.231.40 || adṛśyo vai bhavāmyeva śṛṇomi kīrtanādikam | paśyāmi pūjanaṃ cāpi gṛhṇāmi snehataḥ sadā ||41|| athaikadā tu bhaktaṃ me tārayituṃ vyacintayam | asya deyaṃ mayā nityaṃ bhojanaṃ jalamambaram ||42|| ayaṃ mokṣayitavyaśca śūlīkarmavidhānataḥ | bhakto me rāgarahitaḥ śūlīkarmaṇi sarvathā ||43|| tathāpi prāṇayātrārthaṃ vetanārthī karoti tat | hiṃsanaṃ pāpamevāsti nimittaḥ śūlado’pi ca ||44|| tatrodvijate bhakto me prāyaścittaṃ karoti ca | tasmānmocayitavyo’yaṃ śūlīkarmādhikārataḥ ||45|| vicāryetthaṃ tadā lakṣmi kārāgārādhipo’bhavam | kārāgārādhiparūpaṃ dhṛtvāgacchaṃ nṛpaṃ prati ||46|| nyavedayaṃ ca rājñe’haṃ tārakādarśaceṣṭitam | śṛṇu rājan kathayāmi tato yad rocate kuru ||47|| tārakādarśakaścāyaṃ niyukto vetanena vai | śūlī daṇḍapradānārthaṃ duṣṭānāṃ bhavatā hyapi ||48|| bhakto’yaṃ dayayā yuktaḥ prāyaścittaṃ karoti saḥ | pāpaṃ tu manyate śūlyāropaṇaṃ daṇḍyadehinaḥ ||49|| kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti japati saptāhaṃ na bhunakti ca | mṛduhṛt sadayacittaḥ kvacid dayāvaśaṃvadaḥ ||3.231.50|| kvacidājñollaghanaṃ vai kariṣyatīti bhāti me | nāyaṃ yogyastatra kārye mṛdusvabhāvavān yataḥ ||51|| krūrastatra sadā yogyo niyoktavyo’paro janaḥ | yatra kārye suviśvāso yasya tasmād bhayaṃ na vai ||52|| asmāttu me bhayaṃ bhāti tatastaṃ tvapasāraya | araṇyarakṣaṇaṃ tasmai dehi yatra na hiṃsanam ||53|| yasmādbhayaṃ na bhaṃgasya svājñāyāśca nayasya ca | evamuktvā tathaivājñāpatraṃ tatraiva tattathā |||54|| lekhayitvāraṇyadakṣākaraṃ kṛtvā tiro’bhavam | patraṃ rājājñayā dūtadvārā prāptaṃ sukhāspadam |||55|| tārakādarśanenāpi prasādaḥ sa mato hareḥ | pāpasthalādapasāraḥ kṛṣṇecchayāsti vai mama |||56|| yogyaṃ karoti bhagavān bhaktarakṣākaro hariḥ | matvaivaṃ bhagavadvāñcchā tyaktvā śūlīsthalaṃ drutam ||57|| āraṇyādhikṛtiṃ tūrṇaṃ jagrāhādhikavetanaiḥ | mahāsukhaḥ sa sampanno vasatyaraṇyamaṇḍale ||58|| kuṭumbasahito nityaṃ rāvīnadītaṭe śubhe | vanyaiḥ phalaiśca kandaiśca patraiḥ śimbījabījakaiḥ ||59|| kaṇaiḥ śubhauṣadhairannai rasaiśca madhubhistathā | nirvahatyeva nūtnaiḥ sa prāṇayātrāṃ sukhodayām ||3.231.60 || viditvā me mahimānaṃ bhajate’dhikameva mām | uṣṭramāruhya rātrau sa divā cāpi bhaṭaiḥ saha ||61 || nirīkṣate mahāraṇyaṃ rājeva vartate sadā | āraṇyakā janā dugdhadadhimāyasamiṣṭakaiḥ ||62|| sammānaṃ saṃprakurvanti miṣṭānnaśarkarādibhiḥ | nūtnasasyodbhavaṃ bhakṣyaṃ cārpayanti vanecarāḥ ||63|| kṣetravāṭīśvarāścāpi sīmarakṣādhikāriṇe | yathā kaścinnarakādvā kārāgārād vimucya vai ||64|| rājyābhiṣekamādhatte tadvat sukhamavāptavān | evaṃ vai tārakādarśo’bhavat sukhī kṛpāvaśāt ||65|| bhaktau vṛddhimavāpaiva dhyāne ca bhajane’rhaṇe | nityaṃ mālāvarttanaṃ tu sahasraṃ prakarotyayam ||66|| parātmanā sukhaṃ dattaṃ kathaṃ bhaje na mādhavam | matvaivaṃ kṣemakuśale nārāyaṇaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||67|| bhajate mama bhakto māṃ bahudhā bhaktikarmabhiḥ | nijāśrame kṛtā mūrtirmṛṇmayī tena śobhanā ||68|| kṛṣṇāścamarīkśāśca keśāstatra suyojitāḥ | netre dvābhyāṃ kapardībhyāṃ yojite kṛṣṇabinduke ||69|| puṣpāvataṃsau gucchau ca karṇayornihitau tadā | padmabījakṛtā mālā guṃjāmālā tathārpite ||3.231.70|| sphaṭikā bhujabandhe ca prakoṣṭhe yojitāḥ śubhāḥ | ūrmikāśca kṛtā darbhapatraiśca muñjaśṛkhalāḥ ||7 1 || phalāhārā dhāritāśca vastrāṇi valkalānyapi | kambalo mṛgacarmāpi puṣpaśṛṃgārakāṇi ca ||72|| yathākālodbhavānyeva samarpitāni śārṅgiṇe | caturbhujaṃ svarūpaṃ tacchaṃkhacakragadābjadhṛk ||73|| tathā pārśve śubhā lakṣmīryuvatī suvibhūṣitā | sarvābharaṇayuktā ca kṛtā vanyasuvastubhiḥ ||74|| kuṃkumālaktakādyaiśca yathāsthānaṃ suśobhitā | pātrāṇi vanyapatrāṇi kuṭī vaṃśādisaṃbhavā ||75|| upacārāṇi vanyāni kṛtāni bhaktiyoginā | gāvastena sudogdhryaśca rakṣitā bhagavatkṛte ||76|| araṇye tṛṇaghāsādibāhulyena supoṣitāḥ | nityamevaṃ prage snātvā pūjayitvā ramāṃ prabhum ||77|| puṣpahārādibhiḥ samyak śṛṃgārya candanādibhiḥ | madhubhirmiṣṭagundraiśca vṛkṣasāraiḥ phalādibhiḥ ||78|| miṣṭarasairmiṣṭakandairnaivedyaṃ ca jalaṃ tathā | tāmbūlakaṃ ca dīpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ stutim ||79|| aparādhakṣamāṃ namo daṇḍavat kusumāñjalim | parihāraṃ vidadhāti nityamevaṃ karoti saḥ ||3.231.80|| madhyāhne bhojanaṃ sāyaṃ pūjānīrājanādanam | samarpya dhūpadīpādi karoti kīrtanaṃ sadā ||81 || tasya bhāryā kṛtaśalyā prātarutthāya nityadā | snātvā puṣpāṇi cānīya nirmāya mālikādikam ||82|| arpayatyeva kṛṣṇāya namatyapi śataṃ muhuḥ | tataḥ kṣamārthanāṃ kṛtvā patiṃ natvā gṛhakriyām ||83|| karoti sataṃ caivaṃ madhyāhne bhojanārpaṇam | sāyaṃ tathaiva naivedyārpaṇaṃ karoti miṣṭakam ||84|| śṛṃgārabhūṣāveṣādi cāvatārya śriyaṃ prabhum | yogyaveṣaṃ dhārayitvā nidrāpayati vai niśi ||85|| prātarveṣaṃ suśṛṃgāraṃ dhārayatyuttamaṃ navam | yatpakvaṃ pācitaṃ sarvaṃ nivedayati śārṅgiṇe ||86|| prasādānnajalaṃ śākaṃ tulasīdalamiśritam | bhuṃkte kuṭumbakaṃ nitya putraputryādisaṃhitam ||87|| evaṃ vai vartamānasya tārādarśasya cālayam | abhyāgatasvarūpo’haṃ jaṭī bhūtvā vanī yayau ||88|| sāyaṃkāle kuṭumbena snehena svāgataṃ mama | kṛtaṃ sādhuṃ viditvaiva japantama śrīnarāyaṇam ||89|| bhojito’haṃ pūjitaśca pāyito’ṅgeṣu marditaḥ | svāpitaḥ śayane prātarutthāpito namaskṛtaḥ ||3.231.90|| saṃsnāpitaḥ pūjitaśca bhojito dakṣiṇārpitaḥ | prasannatāṃ prati samyagarthito mokṣaṇaṃ prati ||91 || tathāstvevamuccaritaḥ prasthāpito’tibhāvukaiḥ | tadāhaṃ divyarūpeṇa saṃvartitaścaturbhujaḥ |||92|| śrīyuto divyatejobhirvyāptaḥ prasannatāyutaḥ | bhaktabhaktivaśo datvāśīrvādaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ prati ||93|| prasādaṃ puṣpahārām̐śca datvā daśakuṭumbine | tirobhavaṃ drutaṃ tatra pratimāyāṃ hi paśyatām ||94|| atyāścaryaṃ ca te prāptā divyadṛṣṭiṃ prapedire | tata ārabhya mūrtau māṃ lakṣmīyuktaṃ sudarśanam ||95|| nityaṃ divyaṃ prapaśyanti sākṣādvai pitarau yathā | kṛtakṛtyāśca te jātā divyā me’nugrahāt khalu ||96|| atha kāle prasaṃprāpte vimānena sutejasā | anayaṃ tānakṣaraṃ me dhāma lakṣmi parātparam ||97|| evaṃ bhaktasya mokṣo vai mayā kṛto dayālunā | mumukṣūṇāṃ hṛdaye’smi viśeṣato’vanārthakaḥ ||98|| pāpāḥ pāpasamācārāḥ pāpisaṃgāśca mānavāḥ | pāpanāśecchayā māṃ vāśrayeyuḥ sādhusattamān ||99|| vidhūya teṣāṃ pāpāni datvā puṇyāni sarvathā | pāvanān dehinaḥ kṛtvā datvā divyatanūstataḥ || 3.231.10 0|| nayāmi vā divaṃ satyaṃ śrīpuraṃ cāmṛtaṃ ca vā | avyākṛtaṃ vā vaikuṇṭhaṃ golokaṃ vākṣaraṃ padam || 101 || paraṃ padaṃ prāpayāmi rājādhirājaśobhanam | dadāmi sevanaṃ tatra pādayormama sarvadā || 1 02|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya sparśanād vartanādapi | bhuktirmuktirdivyagatirjāyate mokṣaṇaṃ rame || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne śūlīpradasya tārakādarśasya tatpatnyāḥ kṛtaśalyāyāśca bhaktyābhyudayau mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇānāmaikatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 231 ||
<3.232> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvamagnidasya kathāmapi | jvālāprasādanāmābhūcchūdro’raṇyaprapālakaḥ || 1 || vṛtraprasthavane kālindīsaritastaṭe purā | kuṭumbasahitastatra vane vāsaṃ karoti saḥ || 2 || vanyamūlaphalādaśca kāṣṭhavyāpārakṛttathā | ghāsavallītṛṇastambauṣadhivyāpārakṛttathā || 3 || ahiṃsakavicāro’pi prāṇayātrābhivṛttaye | nirarthakānāṃ kāṣṭhānāmaṃgārān vidadhāti saḥ || 4 || kāṣṭhānāṃ sañcayān kṛtvā vahniṃ dadāti tatra ca | aṃgārāḥ samprajāyante śāntānalāḥ sumūlyakāḥ || 5 || vikrīṇāti tvardhadagdhān maṭṭhīsthān kulasān sadā | taiśca dravyairdhanavān sa vartate dānapuṇyakṛt || 6 || jānātyayaṃ dārudāhe’saṃkhyajantuprajātayaḥ | dahyanti sañcaye tatra pāpaṃ tasya mahanmama || 7 || tacchāntyarthaṃ vidhātavyaṃ dānaṃ viṃśatikāṃśajam | dharmakāryaṃ prakartavyaṃ sādhvīsādhuprasevanam || 8 || utsavāḥ śrīhareḥ kāryāḥ pūjanaṃ vratamityapi | devālaye pradātavyaṃ deyamanāthadehine || 9 || nirāśritāye dātavyaṃ dātavyaṃ tīrthavāsine | paropakārāya dātavyaṃ dātavyaṃ makhine tathā ||3.232.1 0|| tadā pāpaviśuddhirvai jāyate nānyathā kvacit | matvaivaṃ nijavastūnāṃ svadhanānāṃ supātrake || 1 1|| samarpaṇaṃ karotyeva śraddhayā dhārmike jane | ye tīrthārthaṃ samāyānti tebhyo dadāti bhojanam || 1 2|| vastradānaṃ tathāraṇyakotthauṣadhyarpaṇaṃ tathā | karoti samidhāṃ dānaṃ sādhubhyo’naladhūnaye || 1 3|| nityaṃ bhajate śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rādhākāntaṃ ramāpatim | kamaleśaṃ prabheśaṃ śrīmāṇikīsvāminaṃ harim || 14|| yamunāyāṃ sadā snāti sūryāyārghaṃ dadāti ca | pitṛbhyaśca jalaṃ śrāddhaṃ phalaṃ cānnaṃ dadāti ca ||15|| dadātyatithaye yogyaṃ vanibhyo’pi dadāti ca | athāyaṃ kṛtavān kāṣṭhapratimāṃ śrīharermama || 16|| sākaṃ śrīmāṇikīdevyā śobhamānāṃ sutaijasīm | prasannavadanāṃ śāntāṃ raṃgaśṛṃgāraśobhitām || 17|| sarvāvayavasampūrṇāṃ divyābhūṣaṇacitritām | prātaścāyaṃ sadotthāya snātvā prasevate hi tām || 18|| kāṣṭhasiṃhāsane ramye sthāpitāṃ pārṣadairyutām | pādyamarghyamācamanaṃ snānaṃ tailādimarṣaṇam || 1 9|| godugdhaghṛtadadhyāḍhyaśarkarāmadhubhistathā | snapanaṃ cābhiṣekaṃ ca pādāṃguṣṭhe karoti saḥ ||3.232.20|| vastreṇa mārjanaṃ dantadhāvanaṃ gaṇḍuṣāṃstathā | kārayitvā vibhūṣādi divyāmbarāṇi yāni ca ||21 || śṛṃgārāṇi samastāni gandhacandanakuṃkumam | puṣpahāramukuṭādi puṣpaveṣān dadāti me ||25|| dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ phalānnamiṣṭamuttamam | jalaṃ dugdhaṃ pāyasānnaṃ dadhi pakvānnamuttamam || 23 || mahyaṃ dadāti tāmbūlaṃ mukhavāsaṃ tathottamam | pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavaccārārtrikaṃ namanaṃ stavam ||24|| aparādhakṣamāyāñcāṃ karotyātmasamarpaṇam | parihāraṃ ca pūjāyāḥ kṛtvā niveditānnakam ||25 || bhuṃkte prasādamevāyaṃ tatpatnī ca tathāvidhā | nāmnā prabhāvatīdevī putrāḥ putryastathāpare || 26 || bhuñjate tatprasādānnaṃ tato yāntyudyamāya te | madhyāhne’pi tathā rātrau pūjāṃ me vidadhatyapi ||27|| naivedyaṃ jalapānaṃ cārārtrikaṃ stavanaṃ tathā | kīrtanaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaviṣṇo bālakṛṣṇaramāpate || 588|| rādheśamāṇikīsvāmin śrīpate kamalāpate | kṛtvā ca parihāraṃ te nayanti purato mama ||29|| gāyanti gītikā ramyāḥ svapanti ca tataḥ param | evaṃ nityaṃ bhajamānā vartante sarva eva te ||3.232.30 || athaikadā mahāyogī nāmnā narāyaṇāyanaḥ | sādhusādhvīśatayuktaścāyayau tasya mandiram ||3 1 || prabhāvatī tathā jvālāprasādaḥ svāgataṃ satām | sādhavīnāṃ sādhuvaryasya vyadhātāṃ satkṛtiṃ tathā || 32|| āsanāni jalaṃ miṣṭaṃ miṣṭānnāni phalāni ca | madhūni ca rasām̐ścāpi kandān śimbīśca cirbhaṭān |||33|| bharjitānnāni śuṣkāṇi saktūm̐śca caṇakām̐stathā | śākāni patrabhājāśca dadatuścātiharṣitau ||34|| sādhusādhvyaḥ prasannāśca tṛptāścāsam̐stadā sukhāḥ | sāyaṃ snānaṃ bhojanādi dugdhapānaṃ ca pūjanam ||35|| śrīhareḥ kīrtanaṃ cakrurvādyagītisutālakaiḥ | tatrotsave janā rātrau bahavo vai samāyayuḥ || 36|| narā nāryaḥ sahasrāṇi sādhudarśanalālasāḥ | vṛtraprasthanagarasya prajāścāpi samāyayuḥ ||37|| araṇyaṃ yamunātīre svargavat tvabhavajjanaiḥ | sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭhanti mānavāstadā ||38|| niṣīdanti sabhāyāṃ ca kathāśravaṇalālasāḥ | nārāyaṇāyanastatropādideśa hitāya vai ||39|| snehena bhaktiyogena kṛṣṇasya tatsatāṃ ca vā | satīnāṃ sevayā mūrtipūjanairdevatārcanaiḥ ||3.232.40|| pavitratā bhaveccāpi divyatā mokṣaṇaṃ tathā | parameśasya sākṣādvai prāptirbhavecca sevayā ||41 || bhaktyā bhavati sānnidhyaṃ snehena paramātmanaḥ | māyānāśo bhavatyatra divyadṛgjāyate janaḥ ||42|| sākṣātpaśyati govindaṃ cāntare ca bahistathā | māyāvaraṇarahito jāyate īśvaro yathā ||43|| golokaṃ vīkṣate tvatra vaikuṇṭhaṃ cākṣaraṃ padam | sevayātastoṣaṇīyāḥ santaḥ sādhvyo haristathā ||44|| prasannānāṃ satāmāśīrvādaiḥ sākṣādbhaveddhariḥ | satsu nārāyaṇastvāste ravargamokṣasukhapradaḥ ||45|| divyānandasya lābhārthaṃ sevyāḥ santastathā hariḥ | śraddhayā ca vivekena satsaṃgaḥ kārya uttamaḥ ||46|| dharmo jñānaṃ virāgaśca satsevā mokṣadā ime | kalyāṇakāriṇaḥ sarve upārjanīyāḥ sadguṇāḥ ||47|| asatsu naiva sahasā viśvasitavyamarthinā | tathā sati vivardhante tṛṣṇādyā durguṇāḥ sadā ||48|| kṣārabhūmisamo martyo yo’sti nāstikyabhāvavān | tatra bījaṃ snehabhaktirnodeti dagdhatāmiyāt ||49|| asajjanaprasaṃgo hi patanasyaiva kāraṇam | mahān pāpmā samudeti kusaṃgijanasaṃgataḥ ||3.232.50|| satsaṃgaḥ sarvapuṇyānāṃ śevadhiḥ pāpanāśakṛt | sasaṃgamūlyāvijñāstu mānuṣyārthaviruddhagāḥ ||51|| kurvate ca kusaṃgaṃ vai tato yāntyadhamāṃ sthitim | kalahena vivādena nidrayā pāpakarmabhiḥ ||52|| akāryācaraṇaiścāpi mriyante doṣapīḍitāḥ | punarjanma ca maraṇaṃ nirayaṃ cāpyadhogatim |||53 || vindanti yāmyanagarīṃ yātanāstatra yojitāḥ | vivekinastu loke’tra viditvā jaḍavarṣma ca ||54|| indriyāṇi mano buddhiṃ jñātvā māyāmayāni ca | triguṇān prakṛtiṃ cāpi vāsanā vividhāstathā ||55|| jīvabandhapradā jñātvā bhaveyuḥ saṃgavarjitāḥ | nityābhyāsaparasyaiva naśyanti vāsanādayaḥ ||56|| tyāgino na prajāyante saṃskārā mūlavarjitāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’styeṣāṃ hṛdantare ||57|| praveṣṭuṃ na dadātyeṣo doṣān bhaktahṛdantare | dehābhimānayuktasya prabhurhṛdi na bhāsate ||58|| abhāse hṛdaye tamomaye māyā vivardhate | ahantāmamate puṣṭiṃ gacchatastena vāsanāḥ ||59 || prajāyante tu bahudhā tṛṣṇātanturvivardhate | punaḥ pāpāni jāyante tṛṣṇayā viṣayeṣviti || 3.232.60 || tasmādātmā cetano’smi dehādīnāṃ niyāmakaḥ | kṛṣṇabhakto brahmadhāmā matvaivaṃ tṛṣṇikāṃ tyajet || 61 || apramattena vijñena sadā bhāvyaṃ sukhārthinā | hareḥ sukhārthaṃ satataṃ yatitavyaṃ nijārthinā || 62|| doṣāstaṃ nārdayeyurvai te naśyanti harerbalāta | ātmaniṣṭhaṃ janaṃ nābhibhavanti vāsanādayaḥ || 63|| sādhusevārthinaṃ niṣkapaṭinaṃ bhaktamānatam | sādhuprasannatāśīrṇā doṣāḥ parābhavanti na || 64 || duṣṭasvabhāvaḥ satsaṃgānnaśyatyeva samūlataḥ | tena doṣā vilīyeran satsaṃginastu dehinaḥ || 61 || ābālyādeva kartavyaḥ satsaṃgaḥ prītiracyute | harerbhakteṣu vai snehaḥ kartavyo haridāyakaḥ || 66 || tāruṇye yena vai bhaktiḥ pravarteta dṛḍhā harau | bhaktibalena kāmādyā nārdayeyurhi dehinam || 67|| sādhūn śāntān praseveta vikāravarjitān sadā | vikāro vilayaṃ gacched yauvanaṃ taritaṃ bhavet || 68 || sādhujaneṣu vikṛtiṃ kalpayecca kadācana | doṣāṇāṃ kalpake doṣā āvirbhavanti pāpataḥ || 69|| avivekena doṣairvai kalpitaiḥ pīḍyate svayam | tasmād divyān prapaśyedvai sādhūnnārāyaṇātmakān | |3.232.7 0 | | yadi kaścitpratīyeta doṣaḥ satsu tadā svayam | doṣo nāyaṃ guṇaścāsti divya eva na saṃśayaḥ | |7 1 | | evaṃ divyaḥ kalpanīyaḥ svasya syād divyatā tathā | doṣagrāhī bhaved doṣī guṇagrāhī guṇī bhavet | |72|| dehatrayaṃ pṛthaṅamatvā śāntaṃ sādhuṃ niṣevayet | śāntiṃ vrajet sevayā ca śāśvatīṃ pārameśvarīm | |73| | niśchadmopāsanā kāryā hareḥ satāṃ śubhāvahā | hareḥ prasannatāprāptyā haritvaṃ jāyate’nuge | |74|| jñānadārḍhyaṃ snehadārḍhyaṃ harau satsu pramuktidam | sevā snehena bhavati prityā smṛtirhi śāśvatī | |75 | | satyeva tanmayatvaṃ syāt tryavasthāsu hi darśanam | sākṣātkāre tu sañjāte kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate | |76 | | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe mānavarūpiṇi | dehe prāgdarśanaṃ paścādindriyeṣu hi darśanam | |77| | tato’ntaḥkaraṇeṣveva tato jīve hi darśanam | evaṃ divyo hi bhagavānāste dehendriyātmasu ||78|| daihikīṃ prakṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇasya divyatāṃ tu yaḥ | mānasīṃ prakṛtiṃ jñātvā divyatāṃ manute ca yaḥ ||71|| ātmīyāṃ bhāvanāṃ bhāvya divyatāṃ cintayettathā | sarvā divyāḥ kṛṣṇalīlā mokṣadāśceti kalpayet ||3.232.80|| evaṃ kṛṣṇasya yogena āntaraṃ bāhyamityapi | karaṇaṃ varṣma sarvāṇi divyānyeva bhavanti hi ||81|| divyena divyabhagavān gṛhyate bhaktiyoginaḥ | nādivyena harirgrāhyo jāyate mānavo’pi san ||82|| bhaktā divyāstataḥ sarve divyakṛṣṇasya yoginaḥ | vyavasthā api divyāśca divyāḥ kāmādayo’pi ca ||8 3|| divyaṃ bhaktasya sarvaṃ vai yat kṛṣṇārthaṃ prakalpitam | jīvānāṃ śreyase kṛṣṇaḥ mahatyā kṛpayā prabhuḥ ||84|| akṣarātparamāllokādiha bhūmau prajāyate | kalyāṇāya janān naijaṃ satsaṃga kārayatyapi ||85|| narākṛtiśca naravat kurute laukikīḥ kriyāḥ | tā api tasya līlā vai divyā vidantu mānavāḥ ||86|| kalyāṇadā samastā vai divyā bhavantu darśakāḥ | evaṃ vai bhagavān svecchākṛtadivyānnijāśritān ||87|| dadāti darśanaṃ saṃgaṃ svasya bhaktasya kevalam | ato bhaktendriyādīni kṛṣṇabhāvaṃ prayānti hi ||88|| divyakṛṣṇasya sambandhād divyāni māyikāni na | yathā kṛṣṇo’sti divyo vai tathā divyāśca sādhavaḥ ||89|| adoṣagrāhakā bhaktā api divyā hi sādhuvat | narā nāryaḥ sadā divyā adoṣagrāhiṇastu ye ||3.232.90|| satsaṃgo divya evāsti santo divyā haristathā | nirdoṣā mokṣadāḥ sarve māyākāryavivarjitāḥ ||91 || yasya teṣu bhaved doṣagrahaṇaṃ tasya vai matiḥ | pitṛbhyāṃ śāpitā pūrvaṃ sādhubhistu tataḥ param | |92|| atikrameṇa sādhūnāṃ śāpād buddhiḥ praduṣyati | sādhavo dinavat santi durbalā bhagavatpriyāḥ ||93|| teṣāmardanakāle vai hṛdayastho hariḥ svayam | ardito jāyate tena śaptasya dhīḥ suśāpitā ||94|| dagdhā bhavati duṣṭā vai doṣagrāhā na nirmalā | tāṃ vināśayituṃ nityaṃ yateta sevane satām || 95|| tanvā manasā dravyaiścendriyaiśca sampadā sadā | sādhoḥ prasādalabdhyarthaṃ sevāyāṃ nirato bhavet ||96|| sarvasvārpaṇabhāvena sevate labhate sa tu | nairmalyaṃ niḥśāpatāṃ ca divyatāṃ guṇagrāhitām ||97| | śuddhiṃ labhettataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ prasādyākṣaramāvrajet | sādhūn prasādya ca divyaṃ nārāyaṇāśramaṃ labhet ||98|| tasmānnityaṃ sādhujanān prasevantu pramuktaye | jñānāgninā pradāhyedaṃ brahmāgnau juhvatu svakān ||99|| ityevaṃ tūpadiśyaiva dadau mantraṃ hareḥ rame | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 3.232.100 || pādavāryamṛtaṃ tebhyo dadau nārāyaṇāya naḥ | lakṣmi rātrau praviśramya prātaḥ snātvā ca sādhavaḥ || 101 || prapūjya padamātmānaṃ bhuktvā phalādikaṃ payaḥ | bhaktānāśīrvacaścoktvā yayustīrthāya sādhavaḥ || 1 02||| bhaktāste śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ kṛṣṇavallabham | bhejuḥ snehena satataṃ jvālāprasādabhāvitāḥ ||1 03|| athotsavaṃ pracakruste kārtike dvādaśīdine | śukle caikādaśīrātrau jāgaraṇe prage sati || 1 04|| nṛtyatāṃ kīrtayatāṃ ca prāvirāsaṃ puraḥsthale | caturbhujo māṇikīśrīsahito divyabhūṣitaḥ ||1 05|| taiḥ kṛtāmarhaṇāṃ sarvāṃ prāpya tiro’bhavaṃ kṣaṇāt | mūrtau tatraiva nityaṃ ca nyavasaṃ premapāśagaḥ ||1 06|| prāpte kāle mama dhāmānayaṃ jvālāprasādakam | prabhāvatīṃ ca tatpatnīṃ tathā bhaktān sahasraśaḥ || 1 07|| evaṃ lakṣmi mayā bhaktastārito bhavasāgarāt | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhavatāraṇamāpnuyāt || 1 08|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne jvālāprasādākhyasyāṃgārāgnikṛto bhaktasya bhaktyā nārāyaṇāyanasādhusamāgamena tasya tatpatnyāḥ sahasrāvadhidehināṃ ca mokṣaṇaṃ bhagavatā kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvātriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 232 ||
<3.233> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ garadasyāpi mokṣaṇam | kāśamitre ramyadeśe śrīnagare sukhāvahe || 1 || jhillimāsaritastīre’bhavadbhakto lavādanaḥ | kuṭumbavān vipravaryo’dhītavidyaḥ sudhārmikaḥ || 2 || khyātavaṃśī mahāmānaḥ śrīpurādhipamānitaḥ | rājā śrīnagarasyāsīnnāmnā śrīmānaveśvaraḥ || 3 || tena sammānito nityaṃ sabhāyāṃ kṛtaśekharaḥ | nyāyālaye’pi mūrdhanyaḥ prajāyāṃ cātimānavān || 4 || lavādano’paro rājā rājeva vartate tadā | kṛtarājyasamastābhyudayaḥ śikṣāvibhāgake || 5 || sainyasthānātikuśalo vyāpāre nipuṇastathā | buddhimān vartate caivaṃ rājñyāpyatīva mānitaḥ || 6 || evavidhaḥ pradhāno’yaṃ guruścāpi nṛpasya vai | karoti rājyakāryāṇi rāṣṭrakāryāṇi yānyapi || 7 || nṛpe prajāyāṃ sainye vā rāṣṭre kṣatiṃ pravīkṣya saḥ | niḥsaṃśayaḥ samānaśca buddhyā vārayati kṣatim || 8 || nṛpaṃ prajāśca sainyāni tvāpadgatāni rakṣati | āstiko devavalloke mānapātraṃ sa vartate || 9 || nityaṃ sūryaṃ haraṃ viṣṇuṃ candramasaṃ ca vedhasam | vahnimindraṃ suvarṇaṃ ca māyāṃ jīvaṃ sacārhati || 3.233.1 0|| daśāyatanabhakto’yaṃ daśadharmān karotyapi | jaladānaṃ carmadānaṃ lakṣmīdānaṃ tu naikadhā || 1 1|| oṣadhyarpaṇamābhūṣārpaṇaṃ ghṛtārpaṇaṃ tathā | dhanurdānaṃ svarṇadānaṃ kanyādānaṃ kathārpaṇam || 1 2|| evaṃ dharmān karotyeva tathānyānapi cocitān | gṛhakṣetrālayavāṭyudyānārpaṇaṃ karotyapi || 13 || rājyalakṣmīvyayādānasamartho vartate mahān | evaṃvidho’yaṃ bhaktaśca daśadevān prasevate || 14|| jñānavānapi dharmātmā kvacittāmasabhāvavān | karoti tāmasaṃ kāryaṃ daṇḍe hiṃsātmakaṃ mahat || 15|| rājānaṃ rājaputraṃ vā svaputraṃ vā paraṃ prajāḥ | daṇḍyaṃ daṇḍaṃ karotyeṣo dharmaśāstrānusārataḥ || 1 6|| atha kāle gate rājā prauḍho yuvātirājasaḥ | mṛgayāyāṃ pravṛtto’bhūd vyavāye ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 17|| prajāyāṃ savyavāyaṃ vai prasahya prakaroti hi | tenāsya mānaveśasya prajāsu nindanaṃ tathā || 18|| trāsaḥ prajāyate nityaṃ prajādharṣaṇakāraṇāt | putrā nṛpaterabhavan pañca putryaśca viṃśatiḥ || 19|| rājñyaḥ saptābhavam̐ścāpi yuvatyaśca tathāpi saḥ | kāmanābalasaṃkṛṣṭo vyavāye vartate sadā ||3.233.20|| madyāsavapiśatādaścātipāpaparo’bhavat | athāsya nigrahārthaṃ vai prajā lavādanāya ha ||21 || muhuḥ samprārthayāmāsurdharmadaṇḍapradānakam | lavādanaḥ śuśocāpi rājadroho bhavettathā ||22|| adaṇḍe tu prajādrohaḥ kartavyamatra kiṃ mayā | evaṃ vicāryamāṇe ca mārgaḥ śanairabudhyata ||23|| yuvarājāya dātavyaṃ rājyaṃ rājā nirarthakaḥ | śāsanīyaḥ svayameva bhaviṣyatyapasattayā ||24|| lavādanenaikadā tu rājñe sattvasthitāya ca | āveditaṃ śubhaṃ vākyaṃ jñānagoṣṭhyā hitāvaham ||25|| asāraḥ khalu saṃsārastatra sāro hi mokṣaṇam | sevayā tu satāṃ yadvā nārāyaṇasamāśrayāt ||26||| pāpanāśastathā mokṣaḥ prajāyate hi dehinām | rājyaṃ sampad bāndhavāśca prāṇayāne hyupāgate ||27|| na rakṣanti mahārājaṃ cakravartinamityapi | rakṣatyeva kṛto dharmo nādharmo rakṣati kvacit |||28|| dharma eva pare loke sevitaḥ sevate janam | adharmo bādhate tvatra pare loke’pi śatruvat ||29|| nivṛttiṃ prāpya bhagavān bhajanīyo hitaiṣiṇā | putre yogye dhuraṃ datvā mokṣaḥ sādhyaḥ sukhārthinā ||3.233.30|| kāmānāṃ naiva sīmāsti vardhante tṛṣṇayā saha | pātayanti niraye te’rdayanti jvālayanti ca ||3 1|| kāmām̐styaktvā hṛdayasthān nārāyaṇārpaṇaṃ caret | vyavahārasya bhakteśca kāmānāṃ na saha sthitiḥ ||32|| bhaktiṃ kartuṃ vyavahāraṃ kāmām̐styajet vṛṣārthavān | tasmād rājyaṃ kumārāya deyaṃ śānteśvarāya te ||33|| jyeṣṭhaputrāya yogyāya śobhanaṃ tad bhaviṣyati | śrutvā rājāntare vahnijvālayeva hyadahyata ||34|| satṛṣṇasya viṣaṃ sarvaṃ cāmṛtaṃ hyapi padmaje | hitavākyaṃ tyāgavākyaṃ viṣāyate na saṃśayaḥ ||35||| sa tu nītyāvadattaṃ svapradhānaṃ gurumuttamam | lavādana guro yogyaṃ bhavatā me niveditam ||36|| tathāpi kasyacit kālasyānte dāsyāmi tattathā | putre tu yogyatā pakvā tāvadrājye bhaviṣyati ||37|| abhyāsena tato rājyaṃ dāsye śaighryaṃ na vidyate | ityuttarito gururāṇ maunamāpyānamannṛpam ||38|| rājāpi kaitavaṃ nityamacintayannijārthakam | guruścāyaṃ rājyaguruḥ pradhānaśca sabhādhipaḥ ||39|| utsādanīyaḥ sthānādvai sthāpanīyo’paro guruḥ | tadā me bhavitā kṣemaṃ kuśalaṃ sarvadā tathā ||3.233.40|| vicāryetthaṃ trimāsānte sthānād dūrīcakāra tam | lavādano’pi daivecchāṃ matvātyajannijaṃ padam ||41 || nivṛttiṃ prāpya devān sa hyabhajad daśa tān sadā | rājā vyavardhata cātivyavāye svaprajāsu vai ||42|| prasahya kanyakā nītvā prajāyāstu surūpiṇīḥ | karoti kāmanāṃ tāsu vimuñcati kṛtārthakaḥ ||43|| ākrośaśca prajāsveva vyavardhatātiroṣataḥ | rājāyaṃ nāśanīyo vai pradhānasya vivāsakaḥ ||44|| ekaśabdaḥ śrūyate vai sarvaprajāsu sarvathā | prajāvyavāyavyasanī nāśanīyaḥ nṛpo’pi vai ||41|| anyathā mahatī hānirbhavedeva prajāsu vai | itiniścitya ca sarve prajāgryāstu lavādanam ||46|| mimilurnṛpanāśāya daivena noditā hi te | lavādanena sahitā yayuḥ senāpatiṃ prati ||47|| sūryakāntābhidhaṃ cāpi kathāyāmāsurudvratam | rājño vināśanaṃ syādvai yadi dharme na yāti saḥ ||48|| bhavān prajānāṃ śāstāpi nītimāśrayatu dhruvām | rājāyaṃ rājyapadato’vatārya eva sarvathā ||49|| sūryakānto marmavākyaṃ śrutvā tathāstu cāvadat | atha sarve yayuḥ śānteśvaraṃ tu yuvarājakam ||3.233.50 || rājāyaṃ vipathe tvāste padayogyo na vidyate | avatārya padāt tvaṃ ca sthāpyaḥ prajābhirādarāt ||51 || anyathā mahatī hānirbhaviṣyatīti viddhi vaḥ | kumāro’pi tathāstvevaṃ prāhātha mahiṣīṃ prati ||52|| śreṣṭhottamāṃ prati sarve’kathayannitinirṇayam | sāpi daivavaśāttathāstvevaṃ prāha vivekinī |||53|| atha prajābhirmahatī sabhā kṛtā nivṛttaye | tatra rājñī tathā rājñyaḥ kumārāśca prajottamāḥ ||54|| senāpatiḥ pradhānaścāyayurnirṇayahetave | pradhānāya navīnāya nirṇayaṃ te nyavedayan |||55||| gartamaṇiḥ pradhānastu nirṇayaṃ nābhyamodayat | utthāya prayayau bhūpaṃ nyavedayadaniṣṭakam ||56|| rājā roṣeṇa sahasā gartamaṇimuvāca ha | kārāgāre prakarotu senāpati kumārakam ||57|| rājñīṃ prajāḥ pūrvapradhānaṃ ca tathā virodhinaḥ | śrutvā gartamaṇinā vai rājabhaṭā nṛpājñayā ||58|| prahitā nigaḍe kartuṃ rājavirodhino drutam | śataśo’tha rājabhaṭā dudruvuḥ paritastadā ||59|| vidhṛtā bahavastatra kṛtāśca nigaḍeṣu vai | atha lavādanastatra rājñīṃ rājakumārakam ||3.233.60|| senāpatiṃ prasaṃprāpya mantraṇāṃ saṃvidhāya saḥ | garaṃ tīvratamaṃ nītvā rājānaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ||61 || puṣpahāraṃ sagaralaṃ kaṇṭhe rājño nyadhāttadā | rājā sugandhamāsādya śanairmūrcchāmavāpa ha ||62|| mṛtastūrṇaṃ tato gartamaṇiḥ saṃbhraṃśitaḥ padāt | lavādanaḥ pradhānasya pade prajābhirādṛtaḥ ||63|| kārāgārasthitāḥ sarve lavādanena mocitāḥ | śānteśvaro yuvarājo rājadhiṣṇye’bhiṣecitaḥ ||64|| mānaveśo mṛtaśceti ghoṣitaṃ vai prajāsvapi | rājñyastāśca kumārāśca nṛpaurdhvadaihikaṃ vyadhuḥ ||65|| yajño nṛpasya śuddhyarthaṃ kṛtavān sa lavādanaḥ | viprā anāthāḥ santaśca sādhvyaśca kanyakāstathā ||66|| prajājanā bhojitāśca toṣitāḥ svarṇadānakaiḥ | godānairgṛhadānaiśca kanyādānaiḥ kumārakāḥ ||67|| dharmakāryairmakhe rājā mṛtaḥ puṇyena yojitaḥ | yamapūryāṃ ca sūrmyādiyātanā bahuduḥkhadāḥ ||68|| bhuktvā svargaṃ yayau paścānmakhapuṇyena vai nṛpaḥ | yuvarājo’bhavad rājā rājyaṃ dharmyaṃ vyadhāddhi saḥ ||69||| sādhubhakto’bhavannityaṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ | sahasrasādhavastasya bhuṃjate nityameva tu ||3.233.70|| karoti rājyaṃ dharmyaṃ ca lavādanānumoditaḥ | atha sādhūttamo nāmnā kiṃśukāyanasadguruḥ ||71|| ātmaniṣṭho bhagavanniṣṭhito lavādanaṃ gurum | tathā śānteśvaraṃ bhūpaṃ senānī sūryakāntakam ||72|| prajāgryām̐ścopādideśa hitaṃ kalyāṇadaṃ tadā | karmabhirdehino loke jāyante ca viyanti ca ||73 || dharmo jñānaṃ virāgaśca bhaktirharau ca sādhuṣu | kṛtaṃ yat sevanaṃ puṇyaṃ dānaṃ saha prayāti vai ||74|| dharmī nṛpaḥ pitṛtulyo’dharmī daṇḍyastu śatruvat | dharmiṇā bhūbhṛtā śreyaḥ prajānāṃ nityadā bhavet ||75|| sāghusevāvidhātā vai rājā prajāsu rājate | biḍālabakavṛttistu prajābhiḥ paribhūyate ||76|| yastu nirmalahṛt kṛṣṇasevāparo jitendriyaḥ | prajārakṣākaro bhūpo vardhate’nugrahaiḥ satām ||77|| bālye kaścit sādhudharmā yauvane viparītakṛt | bālye duṣṭo’pi kaścittu yauvane dhārmiko bhavet ||78|| satāṃ samāgamairdehī tvābālyājjīvanāvadhim | satpumāneva jāyeta śreyomārgasthitaḥ sadā ||79|| asatpumānasatsaṃgādasannevābhivardhate | sahavāsavyavahārakhānapānāpamānataḥ ||3.233.80|| guṇā aguṇā dṛśyante bāle yuni viśeṣataḥ | bālye puṇyapratāpena dharmī yunyapi sabhavet ||8 1 || śamena manasaḥ śāntirdamena bāhyavājinām | tābhyāṃ doṣāḥ pradātavyāḥ kāmakrodhādayo’khilāḥ |||82|| ubhāvetau tyāgināṃ ca gṛhiṇāṃ hitakāriṇau | sādhusevāparāṇāṃ tu doṣā naśyanti mūlataḥ ||83 || jīvo vivekanipuṇo nāśayed doṣamaṇḍalam | sākṣī kṛṣṇaścāntarātmā prāpayeddhāma cottamam ||84|| kalyāṇamūrtirbhagavān jīvānāṃ śreyase bhuvi | prāvirbhavati śrīkāntastaṃ prasevya vimucyate ||85|| yadyapi śrīharirdhāmni sthita eva tu muktidaḥ | samartho’sti tathāpyatra premibhaktā bhavanti ye ||86|| nāryo narāḥ premiṇo vai teṣāṃ yo viraho hareḥ | asahyaḥ kṣaṇamātraṃ tu tannāśāya yathā sukham ||87|| tebhyo dātuṃ bhaktivaśo bhaktecchāpūraṇāya ca | tadihānupramodādipūraṃ rūpaṃ dadhāti saḥ ||88|| yogaṃ datvā pūrayati bhaktasarvamanorathān | sajātīyo hi bhavati premavṛddhyarthameva ha ||89|| kṛpaiva sā harerbodhyā bhaktajātīyajanmani | asaṃkhyadivyasadguṇaiśvaryapratāpatejasā ||3.233.90|| pūrayannaranārīṇāṃ manāṃsi tadvaśe sthitaḥ | putratvena patitvena suhṛttvena sakhitvataḥ ||91|| pitṛmātṛsatītvena sādhutvena pravartate | śiṣyatvena gurutvena nṛpatvena ca vartate ||92|| sukhayitvā yatheṣṭaṃ tān dharmasthāpanamuttamam | āsurāṇāṃ vināśaṃ ca kurvaṃstadānuṣaṃgikam ||93|| tirobhavati bhaktānāṃ tṛptyuttaraṃ nijecchayā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkambharātmajaḥ ||94|| gopālabālaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo bhaktyā grāhyaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ | kāmaṃ krodhaṃ chalaṃ lobhaṃ mānamirṣyāṃ ca matsaram ||95|| tyaktvā pāpāni sandahya bhajettaṃ māṇakīpatim | bhaktyā satāṃ sevayā ca sa prabhuḥ samprasīdati ||96|| agnidasya garadasya nārīhatyodbhavasya ca | pāpaṃ naśyati kṛṣṇasya sevayā tatsatāmapi ||97|| bālaghnasya dhenuhatyodbhavasya nṛpanāśinaḥ | mātṛghnasya tathā pāpaṃ līyate kṛṣṇasevinaḥ ||98|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | japantu satataṃ mantraṃ pāpaśuddhirbhaviṣyati ||99|| ityuktvā kamale kiṃśukāyanaḥ pradadau manum | lakṣaprajābhyastatraiva sarvān vyadhāt suvaiṣṇavān || 3.233.1 00|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhejuśca māṃ hi te | lavādano daśadevairmāṃ tataḥ puruṣottamam ||1 01 || viśeṣeṇābhajat sarve cānye rājaprajādayaḥ | bhejurmāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cātmanivedinaḥ || 1 02|| sādhavaḥ prayayurbadrīnārāyaṇaṃ tataḥ khalu | lavādanasya vārdhakye sevayā tuṣṭatāṃ gataḥ || 1 03|| ahaṃ lakṣmi puro divyamūrtirāvirbabhūva ha | garadasya mahatpāpaṃ vidhūya divyavarṣmaṇā || 1 04|| divyamuktaṃ vidhāyaivānayaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ mama | rājñīḥ sarvāstathā senāpatiṃ ca nṛpatiṃ navam || 1 05|| bhaktyā tuṣṭo’nayaṃ sarvānakṣaraṃ kramaśaḥ padam | prajāśca bhaktisampannāḥ pāvanīścānayaṃ padam || 1 06|| evaṃ mayā samastāste sādhudvārā vimocitāḥ | māyābandhanarahitāḥ kṛtā lakṣmi pare’kṣare || 1 07|| garadānamahatpāpaṃ sarvaṃ bhaktyā layaṃ gatam | evaṃ bhaktyā vilīyante pāpāni sarvathā rame || 1 08|| bhuktiṃ muktiṃ prayāntyeva bhajanasya balānmama | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavet sadā || 1 09|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne lavādanākhyapradhānasya rājñe garadasya bhagavadbhaktyā kiṃśukāyanasādhusevayā ca tasya ca rājñīnāṃ ca prajānāṃ ca mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā trayastriṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 233 ||
<3.234> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śastradharakathāṃ tathā | nāmnā vikhaṇḍalavarmā śastradhārī purābhavat || 1 || kṣattriyo nāndale grāme mahīnadītaṭe śubhe | vanasthānāṃ kirātānāṃ caurāṇāṃ śāsako mahān || 2 || luṇṭakānāṃ śāsakaśca dhanurbāṇadharastathā | pariṇītayugalānāṃ mārge nirbhayarakṣakaḥ || 3 || vivāhārthaṃ prayātānāṃ vāhinīnāṃ ca rakṣakaḥ | vyāpāriṇāmanasāṃ ca trātā nāmadharo’bhitaḥ || 4 || śrutvā tannāma caurāśca prayānti dūrataḥ sadā | evaṃ bhītipradaḥ śāstā śāsakānāṃ tu śāsakaḥ || 5 || kintu bhakto hi hṛdaye nītimārgamupāśritaḥ | rakṣaṇena pradattaṃ yacchreṣṭhibhiḥ rājabhistathā || 6 || vetanaṃ tena mātreṇa nirvahatyeva nānyathā | yāmyadūtasamo veṣe dayāyāṃ dharmavat sadā || 7 || rakṣaṇe rājavaccāpi nītimārge tu śukravat | bṛhaspatisamo bodhe bhaktau ye garuḍo yathā || 8 || sarvasvārpaṇabhāvena vartate cātmavedanaḥ | kintvanītiparāṃ vyaktiṃ prāpya daṇḍaṃ karoti saḥ || 9|| yathāyogyaṃ daṇḍayati naraṃ duṣṭaṃ śaṭhaṃ sadā | śastraghātena vā cātiduṣṭaṃ hanti balena vai ||3.234.1 0|| evaṃ ghātādipāpaṃ ca bhavatyeveti taddhṛdi | saṃkalpo jāyate nityaṃ pūjāyāṃ yācate kṣamām || 11 || prātaḥ snātvā mama mūrteḥ pūjāṃ ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ | kṛtvā nīrājanaṃ cānnaṃ miṣṭaṃ datvā nivedanam || 12|| jalaṃ datvā mukhavāsaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tataḥ param | śastraṃ madagre nikṣipya kṣamāṃ prayācate yathā || 13|| nāhaṃ krūro hiṃsakaśca nāhaṃ svārthī na lampaṭaḥ | śastraṃ me mā bhaved duṣṭaṃ patitaṃ doṣavarjite || 14|| nayānvite ca bhakte cādaṇḍye mā patitaṃ bhavet | ajñānena na me śastraṃ doṣaspṛṣṭaṃ bhavet prabho || 15|| duṣṭānāṃ śāsane caitanmā parājayamāpnuyāt | māhaṃ pāpena lipyeya nītibahiḥpravartinā || 16|| evaṃ satyapi mānuṣyājñānavegena karhicit | cedākrameta pāpaṃ vai mayi dīnāparādhataḥ || 17|| daṇḍyo’haṃ sarvathā kṛṣṇa kṣamyaścet kṣamyatāṃ tadā | ityevaṃ mama bhakto’yaṃ khaṅgabāṇādi matpuraḥ ||18|| samarpya nityamāvakti tato bhuktvā prasādajam | pītvā pādāmṛtaṃ yāti rakṣyarakṣaṇahetave ||19|| grāme vane khale vāṭyāṃ kṣetre rakṣati sarvathā | rakṣyavastūni sarvāṇi vikhaṇḍalaḥ pramodavān ||3.234.20|| madhyāhne me nivedyānnaṃ prasādaṃ cātti sarvadā | sāyaṃ sīmnaḥ samāgatya gṛhe karoti pūjanam ||21 || puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalamuttamam | nīrājanaṃ stavanaṃ ca tāmbūlakaṃ sugandhi ca ||22| mahyaṃ samarpya śastrāṇi nikṣipyāpi puro mama | punaḥ prārthayate nityaṃ kṣamasvājñānajaṃ hyagham ||23|| tavāsmi tava dāso’smi tava bhakto’smi tāmasaḥ | tava tādātmyamāpannastava śeṣo bhavāmyaham ||24|| evaṃ lakṣmi sadā mahyaṃ śastraṃ samarpya karma ca | samarpyaiva śayane vai nidrāṃ karoti māṃ smaran ||25||| tasya bhāryā harasatīnāmnī prasevate ca tam | mahābhaktā bālakṛṣṇe mayi śrīśanarāyaṇe ||26|| patyau nārāyagaṃ māṃ ca paśyatyeva na cetarat | patimūrtau sarvasevāṃ karoti mayi saṃsthite ||27|| pratimāyāṃ pṛthak sevāṃ karoti svāmino mama | snānaśṛṃgārabhūṣādi nīrājanaṃ subhojanam ||28|| pānaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ vāyudānaṃ dolābhidolanam | gītikāṃ miṣṭakaṇṭhotthāṃ mama līlābharāṃ tathā ||29|| parihāraṃ ca nidrāyāḥ kīrtanaṃ prakaroti ca | tato naijaṃ nityakāryaṃ nirvartayati bhāminī ||3.234.30 || evaṃ bhaktātisaṃsnigdhā bhajate māṃ nirantaram | sādhavaścāpi sādhvyaśca tadgṛhaṃ yānti pāvanam ||3 1 || bhuktvā pītvā śramaṃ tyaktvā prayānti tīrthamuttamam | athaikadā samāyācca sādhurnirmohanāyanaḥ ||32|| pūjito bhojitaścāpi rātrau saṃvāhitaḥ padoḥ | upādideśa tābhyāṃ sa mokṣasādhanamuttamam ||33|| kṣamāśastraṃ pare śastraṃ sarvaśāntipradaṃ śubham | kṣamā tejasvināṃ tejaḥ kṣamā tapastapasvinām ||34||| kṣamate sarvatāmyāni sa vai nārāyaṇo mataḥ | kṣamā pṛthvyāṃ sadā cāsti mātari sarvadehinām ||35|| kṣamā satsu sadā divyaguṇātmikā pravidyate | sā vai jayapradā loke svargamokṣasahāyinī ||36|| āpattīnāṃ samastānāṃ kṣamā śastraṃ nibarhaṇam | kāme krodhe made lobhe māne kṣamā hi śāntidā || 37|| nirbalasya kṣamā śastraṃ yadvacchastraṃ vivekinām | sādhūnāṃ ca kṣamā śastraṃ śāsakaṃ tārakaṃ hyapi || 38 || kṣamiṇāṃ hṛdye kṛṣṇaścāntarātmā sadāsti ca | sa eva kṛpayā rakṣāṃ karotyasya viśeṣataḥ ||39|| śāsakaṃ kathyate trātṛ śastraṃ taddhi mataṃ janaiḥ | māyākālabhayāt karmabhayācchāstṛ ṛtaṃ hi tat ||3.234.40|| dehasya śāsakaṃ naiva ṛtaṃ śastraṃ yathārthakam | indriyāṇāṃ śāsakaṃ vā tathaivāti ṛtaṃ na tat ||41 || dehendriyāṇi māyāyāḥ kāryāṇi naśvarāṇi ca | rakṣaṇe’yutadhā jāte’pyabhinaśyanti vai laye ||42|| vināśino rakṣaṇaṃ vai viphalaṃ tattadarthakam | śastraṃ ca viphalaṃ tvevaṃ yatno bhāraḥ phalojjhitaḥ ||43|| araṇyaṃ nāśaśīlaṃ vai sīmāpi ca tathaiva ha | kṣetravāṭyādisarvaṃ vai nāśaśīlaṃ pravartate ||44|| caurā maraṇadharmāṇaḥ sasyānyapi tathaiva ca | śāstā tvaṃ deharūpastu tathaiva nāśadharmavān ||45|| mṛtidharmā mṛtidharmaiḥ śikṣyate tat kutūhalam | varaṃ vai kardamāsparśaḥ paṃkaprakṣālanātpurā ||46|| tasmād dehasya śastrāṇi mokṣadāni na santi hi | mokṣadāni tu śastrāṇi gopanīyāni sarvathā ||47|| rakṣaṇīyāni dhāryāṇi yoktavyāni tu muktaye | vikhaṇḍala divyaśastrāṇyetāni me nibodha ha ||48|| yauvanaṃ śatrurūpaṃ vai tacchastraṃ tu vratārjanam | kāmaḥ śatrurmahām̐statra tacchastraṃ brahmacaryakam ||49|| vāsanā śātravī mātā tacchastraṃ cātmasaṃsthitiḥ | vivako bhedavijñānaṃ bhajana śrīharermuhuḥ ||3.234.50 || tyāgo vairāgyamevāpi caudāsīnyaṃ bahiḥ sadā | evaṃ śastrāṇi māyāyā nāśakāni bhavanti vai ||51 || śrīhareḥ śaraṇaṃ nityaṃ sādhusevāsamāgamaḥ | śrīharernavadhā bhaktirbhajanaṃ cātibhāvataḥ ||52|| amāyikānāṃ sādhūnāṃ sarvasvārpaṇasevanam | hṛdaye śrīharerdhyānaṃ dehenātmasamarpaṇam ||53|| manasā cintanaṃ nityaṃ buddhyā sphūrtiḥ sadā hareḥ | ānandādikriyāṇāṃ tu sarveśvare samarpaṇam ||54|| rasāsvādādikaṃ kṛṣṇaprasāde eva nānyathā | śabdasparśādayaḥ sarve kṛṣṇasyaiva na cetarāḥ ||55|| ebhiḥ śastrairbhavenmāyānāśaḥ karmalayastathā | niṣkāmakarmaṇā śāntirvitṛṣṇasya prajāyate ||56|| kāmasaṃkalpahīnāśca yasyāraṃbhā hi nirguṇāḥ | nairguṇyaṃ cāpyate tena sādhusaṃgena daivatam ||57|| hareḥ prāptyā tu divyatvaṃ sākṣādyogena mokṣaṇam | māhātmyajñānayuktasya harau snehaḥ prajāyate ||58|| harau snehena saktasya hareḥ sphuraṇamavyayam | pravarteta tataścendriyāṇi tadrūpakāṇyapi ||59|| jāyante’ntaḥkaraṇāni kṛṣṇasya mandirāṇi vai | ātmā siṃhāsanaṃ tasya nārāyaṇasya jāyate ||3.234.60|| tenātmā ramate śete’śnute harṣati modate | ānandayāti tādātmyabhāvairbrahmadaśāmayaḥ ||61 || vyavahāre vartamānaḥ sarvatra brahmabhāvanaḥ | karmabandhananirmukto brahmaiva nātra saṃśayaḥ ||62|| harau sthiramanā divyo brahmaiva brahmatanmayaḥ | kṛṣṇadṛḍhāśrayaḥ kṛṣṇe ramate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||63|| adhamoddhārakaḥ kṛṣṇo gṛhṇāti śaraṇe’rpitam | punāti patitaṃ cāpi dīvyati snehinā saha ||64|| satīṃ gatiṃ dadātyeva svasmin raktāya mādhavaḥ | ātyantikaṃ padaṃ śreya āpnoti mādhavārpitam ||65|| prakṛteḥ sarvakāryāṇāṃ laye cākṣaradhāmani | bhaktasya saccidānandamayaṃ tejaḥ prakāśate ||66|| tatra tejasyanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ | virājate cidacitāṃ niyāmako’ntarāsthitaḥ ||67|| divyamūrtirdivyavāsā divyabhūṣāvibhūtimān | sevyamāno mahābrahmabhūtamuktairasaṃkhyakaiḥ ||68|| anantaśaktibhiḥ rādhāramāmuktānikādibhiḥ | kṛtārcanapādasaṃvāhanānandapradāyibhiḥ ||69|| sa eva svacaraṇayoḥ sevāṃ dadāti sevine | sa eva vartate bhūmau kṛṣṇo brahmapriyāpatiḥ ||3.234.70|| niḥśreyasāya lokānāṃ divyaguṇārthavigrahaḥ | vicāryetthaṃ parabrahma puruṣottamamāśrayet ||71|| āśritāḥ pakvaniṣṭhāśca sākṣāt paśyanti taṃ tataḥ | sūkṣmadṛśo’ntarātmānaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paśyanti cāntare ||72|| sthūladṛśaḥ sthūlarūpaṃ sthūle paśyanti taṃ prabhum | māyā kāyānavacchinnā līnā sāmyā yadākṣare ||73|| tadā sūkṣmā tadā kṛṣṇaḥ sūkṣmarūpo’tra lokyate | cetanāśca yadā līnāstattvāntaravivarjitāḥ ||74|| tadā sūkṣmāstatra kṛṣṇaḥ sūkṣmarūpo vilokyate | māyā tu viṣamāvasthā cetanāḥ karmiṇastathā |175|| tadā sthūlāsteṣu kṛṣṇaḥ sthūlarūpo vilokyate | divyadṛṣṭimatāṃ kṛṣṇavīkṣaṇaṃ divyatānvitam ||76|| adivyadarśināṃ kṛṣṇavīkṣaṇaṃ prākṛtaṃ yathā | aiśvaryāṇi samastāni sūkṣmasthūlāni vai hareḥ ||77|| sūkṣmasthūlapadārtheṣu nihitāni tu śārṅgiṇā | aiśvaryaiḥ sakalā māyā cetanā vā parasparam ||78|| pṛthag vā samprakāśante saguṇā nirguṇāśca vā | sarvāstāḥ sampado’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ha ||79|| bhuṃkte bhakto’rpitasarvasvo’tibhāgavatottamaḥ | aiśvaryāṇi samastāni prāpnoti patibhaktimān ||3.234.80|| patitvamekaṃ deveśe mukteśe śiṣyate harau | anyat sarvaṃ nijaṃ tasmai bhaktāyārpayati prabhuḥ ||8 1|| snehaśastraṃ svāmino’pi vaśaṃkaraṃ vṛhat sadā | tenaiva snehaśastreṇa śāsanīyo harirhadi ||82|| bandhanīyaḥ snehapāśairhṛdi dūraṃ na saṃcaret | eṣaiva cākṣarī muktirdehināmiha divyatā ||83|| divyanāthapradabhogānandabhoktrī sthitistu yā | sā pratyakṣe gurau kṛṣṇe prāptavyeha kṣitau purā ||84|| tato brahmapure saiva vartamānā prakāśate | mohinī sā hareḥ prītirmahānandapradā sadā ||85|| koṭyabjakāmadevānāṃ sukhaṃ yatra harau sadā | tādātmyabhāvamāpanno labhate svāmini prabhau ||86|| netrasukhamanantaṃ ca sparśasukhamanantakam | cumbanānandamatulaṃ labhate svāmini prabhau ||87|| āliṅganamahānandaṃ labhate paramātmani | sarvendriyarasaṃ divyaṃ dikṣeyamāsvādanaṃ tathā ||88|| labhate ca tathā divyaprītipramodamutsavam | harṣaṃ divyaṃ tathā śāntiṃ śaityaṃ cāmṛtamiśritam ||89|| labhate śrīharau kānte svāmini śrīpatau prabhau | caturviṃśatitattvānāṃ ye cānandā bhavanti vai ||3.234.90|| sṛṣṭitrayāṇāmānandā ye ye yatra bhavanti vai | tān sarvān labhate mūrtau svāmini śrīparātmani ||91|| evaṃ lakṣmi copadeśaṃ kṛtvā nirmohanāyanaḥ | rātrimuṣitvā prayayau tīrthāntaraṃ supūjitaḥ ||92|| prātarvikhaṇḍalo bhaktiṃ cakāra ca yathoditām | jñānena sahitāṃ tasya patnyapi brahmarūpiṇī ||93|| vidadhe tādṛśīṃ bhaktiṃ snehayuktāṃ pravardhitām | mūrtervai pūjane sarvaṃ kurutastau yathocitam ||94|| tayorbhaktyā prasanno’haṃ prāvirbarbhūva tatpuraḥ | divyacaturbhujaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’tisundaraḥ ||95|| prahasan cārpitān sarvopacārān cottamottamān | ādade’haṃ ca naivedyaṃ bhuktvā dade prasādikam ||96|| tau bhuktavantau prītyā ca pītavantau jalāmṛtam | tāvad divyasvarūpau cājāyetāṃ matsamānakau ||97|| prārthitavantau mokṣāya nirmohināvubhāvapi | ahaṃ vimāne tau dhṛtvā divyau dhāmākṣaraṃ nijam ||98|| anayaṃ pārṣadaiḥ sākaṃ tayoḥ saṃkalpapūrakaḥ | muktau tau cākṣare dhāmni vartete kamale sadā ||99|| evaṃ sādhuprasaṃgena samuddhṛtau nijānugau | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya lakṣmi muktimavāpnuyāt || 3.234.10 0|| svargaṃ vā satyalokaṃ vā rājyaṃ vā caiśvaraṃ padam | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ yatheṣṭāṃ vā labhate bhaktimān mayi || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne nirmohanāyanasāghuprasaṃgena vikhaṇḍalākhyaśastradharasya tatpatnyā harasatyāśca bhagavaddarśanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 234 ||
<3.235> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ jīrṇodbhavasya satkathām | ārāmanagare vīṇānadītīre’tivistare || 1 || jīrṇodbhavābhidhaścāsīt karṣukaḥ kṛṣimānmahān | śataputraḥ śatabhṛtyo viṃśatistrīpatirbalī || 2 || śataputrīpitā pautracatuḥśatābhiśobhanaḥ | pautrīśatadvayaśobhanmahāsaudhanivāsakṛt || 3 || evaṃ viśālavaṃśāḍhyaḥ kṛṣīvalo’tipāvanaḥ | dharmadānarato nityaṃ gosevādiparāyaṇaḥ || 4 || pañcaśataṃ godhanaṃ tu mahiṣīdviśataṃ tathā | aśvaśataṃ vartate’sya vṛṣabhāṣṭaśatāni ca || 5 || kṣetrāṇi vāṭikā mahodyānāni sasyabhūmayaḥ | ghāsabīḍamaraṇyaṃ ca bhūmyucchrayo’sya santi ca || 6 || yojanaṃ bhūtalaṃ vīṇānadītīre’sya vartate | tatra kṛṣiṃ karotyeṣo bījādhānaṃ yathartu ca || 7 || dhānyāni vividhānyeva jāyante’nnāni sarvaśaḥ | dvidalāḥ kandamūlāni bhavanti puṣpapatrikāḥ || 8 || phalāni kaṇiśāḥ śimbyo bhavanti veṣavāṭakam | granthayo daṇḍasasyāni śākāni bhājikāstathā || 9 || āranālāni sarvāṇi tiktakaṭūni yāni ca | bhavantyasya mahāvāṭyādiṣu kṣetreṣu sarvathā ||3.235.1 0|| oṣadhayo’pi vividhāḥ prajāyante prasecitāḥ | narā nāryaḥ prayatante kṛṣyudyamaparāyaṇāḥ || 11 || utpādayanti bījoptyā khādyānnāni bahūnyapi | utpannebhyaḥ samastebhyo viṃśatyaṃśaṃ prapūrṇakam ||12|| dharmārthaṃ sa dadātyeva dānapūjādikarmasu | jīrṇodbhavagṛhe nityamanāthāḥ sādhavo dvijāḥ || 1 3|| bhikṣukā yātriṇaḥ sādhvyo dīnā adanti bhojanam | dadhīni picchalānyeva payāṃsi madhurāṇi ca || 14|| ghṛtāni puṣṭiyuktāni śarkarā gūḍakām̐śca vai | madhūni miṣṭagariṣṭānnāni śreṣṭhāni bhuṃjate || 15|| arpayanti haraye me pakvānyannāni te’nvaham | evaṃ dharmaprasaṃgena vardhante cāsya sampadaḥ || 16|| na hīyante puṇyavaśād bhujyamānāśca sādhubhiḥ | athāsya bhāgyamevāpi bahusmṛddhaṃ vyajāyata || 17|| yadgṛhe vai makhāḥ pañca sampādyante dvijaiḥ sadā | makhe’syābhyāgataḥ sādhurnāmnā caitanyakāyaniḥ || 18|| mahābhāgavato bhaktottamastyāgavirāgavān | āyayau svāgataṃ tasya jīrṇodbhavaścakāra ha || 19|| jalaṃ śubhāsanaṃ miṣṭaṃ madhuparkaṃ dadau naman | vāsaṃ ca hariśālāyāṃ dadau sevāṃ cakāra ca ||3.235.20|| rātrau devārcanaṃ kṛtvā bhuktvā caitanyakāyaniḥ | cakre’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇalīlādikīrtanam ||21|| brahmaṇo’sya tripañcāśadvatsareṣu harerjanim | akīrtayattatra tatra kṛtā līlāḥ pramokṣadāḥ ||22|| tataḥ sa stavanaṃ cakre śuśruvuḥ sarvakarṣukāḥ | yaḥ parabrahma bhagavān śrīkṛṣṇo vallabhaḥ prabhuḥ ||23|| akṣare parame vyomni rājate muktasevitaḥ | yasmād bhavanti sṛṣṭau vai prāvirbhāvā anekaśaḥ ||24|| so’yaṃ śrīkambharāputraścāste gopālabālakaḥ | saurāṣṭre kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre’śvapaṭṭasārase ||25|| yatra śrīlomaśaścāste brahmapriyā vasanti ca | sarvatīrthāni devāśceśvarā vibhūtayaḥ śriyaḥ |||26|| lakṣmīrādhāramāpadmāvatīśrīrmāṇikīpradhīḥ | haripriyā vasantyetāḥ śrīkṛṣṇabrahmayoṣitaḥ ||27|| asaṃkhyāḥ sādhavo yatra svataḥprakāśarūpiṇaḥ | divyā vasanti ṛṣayaḥ śaraṇyaṃ prabhajanti ca ||28|| namastasmai nṛnāṭyāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ | ābhyantarebhyaḥ śadhubhyo’vanaṃ karoti yo hariḥ ||29|| namastasmai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya paramātmane | ādhyātmikebhyastāpebhyaścādhidaivikatastathā ||3.235.30|| ādhibhūtādikaṣṭebhyo rakṣakāya namonamaḥ | sāmantavikramāt krūrālluṇṭakād vanacandrakaḥ ||31 || sukhādevī ca tatpatnī vaṇijo yena rakṣitāḥ | sāyanāyanasādhostu samāgamena mokṣitāḥ || 32|| sa kṛṣṇo vartate rakṣākarastasmai namonamaḥ | dhaniṣṭhakoṣaṃ vipraṃ ca vārāṃganāsu vartitam ||33|. snehalatāṃ ca tatpatnīṃ guruṃ somāyanaṃ tathā | nṛpaṃ mālavasiṃhaṃ ca rarakṣa mokṣaṇaṃ dadau ||34|| namastasmai pareśāya śrīkāntāya tu śārṅgiṇe | rājīvākhyaṃ nṛpaṃ rājñīṃ sādhvīṃ kundanadevikām || 35|| arakṣayat tathāmokṣayad yastasmai namonamaḥ | devaviśrāmasya rakṣāṃ kāṇḍikāyāśca mokṣaṇam ||36|| kṛtaṃ yena ca tasmai śrīharaye vai namonamaḥ | harṣulamālinaṃ patnīṃ tasya vidrumavallakīm ||37|| uddadhāra hariryaḥ śrīpatistasmai namonamaḥ | śāṇadharaṃ pitṛhaṇaṃ karṣukaṃ ca rarakṣa yaḥ ||38|| vṛṣahaṃ nimbadevaṃ ca tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ | bhāṇḍaṃ kālīndaraṃ sādhukamalāyanayogataḥ || 39|| mokṣaṇaṃ cāprāpayad yastasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ | nartakaṃ rāyaṇadevaṃ bodhāyanasya yogataḥ ||3.235.40|| gāyakaṃ nākirālākhye pattane tu vratardinam | rājānaṃ puṇḍravarmāṇaṃ ya uddadhāra te namaḥ ||41 || vāyakaṃ tūlavāyākhyaṃ samuddadhāra yaḥ prabhuḥ | kāṣṭhahāraṃ tathā jaṃgaladevaṃ te namonamaḥ ||42|| paṇyakṛdvātsalyadhīraṃ patnīṃ mañjulikāṃ tathā | sādhuṃ sādhvīṃ kṛtavān yastasmai tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ ||43|| tilakaraṃgaṃ vanapaṃ śikhādevīṃ ca tatpriyām | uddadhāra hariryaḥ sa hṛdayastho’pi rakṣatu ||44|| kṣetrapaṃ nāñjakadevaṃ tathā stenamahāmayam | uddadhāra hariryaśca tasmai kṛṣṇāya vai namaḥ ||45|| kirātaṃ sāgarākhyaṃ tatpatnīṃ ca sārikāṃ tu yaḥ | uddadhāra hariryaśca tasmai śrīpataye namaḥ ||46|| hūṇaṃ sāraṃganāmānaṃ rarakṣa yaśca te namaḥ | yajñarādhaṃ puṣkasaṃ ca brahmāyanaprasaṃgataḥ ||47|| kuṭumbayuktaṃ yaḥ kṛṣṇo’mokṣayatte namo namaḥ | kapikṣayaṃ tu cāṇḍālaṃ prājñeśvaraṃ dvijaṃ tathā ||48|| amokṣayaddhariryaśca tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ | nālīkaraṃ lohakāraṃ patnīṃ kundanikāṃ ca yaḥ ||49|| amokṣayad bhavapāśāttasmai śrīviṣṇave namaḥ | carmakāraṃ maṃgalākhyaṃ patnīṃ vibhāvarīṃ ca yaḥ ||3.235.50|| viṣād rarakṣa bhagavān yastasmai vai namonamaḥ | rathakāraṃ haridāsaṃ patnīṃ śrīmānavīṃ tu yaḥ ||51|| amokṣayat prabhave te vāraṃ vāraṃ namonamaḥ | śilāhāraṃ dāmaśilādakaṃ patnīṃ kalābhidhām ||52|| tadbhṛtyām̐ścāmokṣayad yastasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ | śilpinaṃ sañjayadevaṃ patnīṃ keśavatīṃ ca yaḥ ||53|| rājānaṃ khaḍgavarmāṇaṃ tathānyān śilpino’pi ca | uddadhāra haristasmai bālakṛṣṇāya vai namaḥ ||94|| citrakṛtsaṃbharadevaṃ ca citraṃsaritāṃ priyām | citrakārānaparān yo’mokṣayatte namonamaḥ |||55||| aṃgārahāriṇaṃ mauktikeśinaṃ tu nijāśritam | tathāparān karmacārān yo rarakṣa ca te namaḥ ||56|| cakradharaṃ lubdhakaṃ yaḥ pautimāṣyopadeśataḥ | amokṣayaddhi saṃsārāttasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||57|| vāṭadharaṃ piśunaṃ yo nṛpaṃ sutārasiṃhakam | ghaṭyayanaprasaṃgenāmokṣayatte namonamaḥ ||98|| vāṭadharaṃ savāsaṃ ca dvaipīrājñīmarakṣayat | amokṣayacca yaḥ kṛṣṇastasmai nityaṃ namonamaḥ ||59|| gṛhakāraṃ śivajayaṃ vṛṣaparvaprasaṃgataḥ | amokṣayattu yaḥ kṛṣṇastasmai śrīharaye namaḥ ||3.235.60|| yaśca saṃgarayādaskaṃ jālakāramamokṣayat | patnīṃ rūpāvatīṃ śuklāyanarṣisevayā hariḥ ||61 || tathā jātyā bharavāṭamudyamaśrītināmakam | satīśvarīṃ ca tatpannīṃ vallavīścoddadhāra yaḥ ||62|| uṣṭrapālaṃ dīrgharambhaṃ rāmāyanaprasaṃgataḥ | uddadhāra hariryastaṃ vallabhaṃ praṇame prabhum ||6 3|| ratnaprabhaṃ kharapālaṃ nṛsiṃhasvāmiyogataḥ | uddadhāra harirnārāyaṇastaṃ praṇamāmyaham ||64|| gadārdaneśvaraṃ vaidyaṃ tatpannīṃ ca mukundinīm | amokṣayaddhi saṃsārād yastaṃ namāmi māpatim ||65|| kīśanakulapālasya deśyāvanasya mokṣaṇam | tatpatnyāḥ purikāyāśca cakre yastaṃ namāmi vai ||66|| nāpitaṃ harṣadharmākhyaṃ patnīṃ nigamikāṃ ca yaḥ | bhūbhṛtaṃ svarṇadhanvānaṃ rājñīṃ ca pañcadevikām ||67|| kalyāṇadhāmasādhostu samāgamena tān prabhuḥ | uddadhāra harirnārāyaṇastaṃ praṇamāmi vai ||68|| yaśca rūṭāṇakīdevīmābhīrīṃ daityadharṣitām | arakṣayad brahmapriyāmadhye rūpeśvarīṃ tu tām ||69|| mandārakalikādyāśca tathānyā divyarūpiṇīḥ | vyadhācchrībhagavān patnīstaṃ namāmi janārdanam ||3.235.70 || dhīvaraṃ dhīraparvāṇaṃ nirvāṇāyanayogataḥ | kṛtvā tu pāvanaṃ kṛṣṇo’mokṣayattaṃ namāmyaham ||71 || tārakādarśakaṃ śūlāropakaṃ coddadhāra yaḥ | supathānakabhūpaṃ ca kṛtaśalyāṃ śūlyaṃganām ||72|| uddadhāra jaṭī bhūtvā hariśrīkṛṣṇanandanaḥ | gopālanandanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vallabha taṃ namāmyaham ||73|| jvālāprasādanāmānaṃ cāgnidaṃ ca prabhāvatīm | nārāyaṇāyanayogādamokṣayannamāmi tam ||74|| lavādanaṃ tu garadaṃ nṛpaṃ śrīmānaveśvaram | śānteśvaraṃ yuvarājaṃ sūryakāntaṃ tu sainyapam ||75|| kiṃśukāyanayogena samuddadhāra yaḥ prabhuḥ | śrīkṛṣṇaṃdeśikaṃ bhaktahṛdayasthaṃ namāmi tam ||76|| vikhaṇḍalaṃ śastradharaṃ bhāryāṃ harasatīṃ ca yaḥ | nirmohanāyanayogādamokṣayacca te namaḥ || 77|| evaṃ lakṣmi stavanaṃ vai sādhuścaitanyakāyaniḥ | cakre neme hariṃ sarvasthitaṃ ca paritastadā ||78|| śrutvā dṛṣṭvā karṣukāste parāścaryaṃ prapedire | jīrṇodbhavaḥ karṣukeśo natvā papraccha taṃ munim ||79|| yeṣāṃ rakṣā tathā muktiḥ kṛtā śrīparamātmanā | kimatra kāraṇaṃ tanme brūhi caitanyakāyane || 3.235.80|| śrutvā munistu tānāha mantraṃ nārāyaṇasya me | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||8 1 || japa mantramimaṃ nityaṃ japantvanye mumukṣavaḥ | bhuktirmuktirbhavedeva sākṣānnārāyaṇo bhavet | |82|| āpatkāle mahārakṣāṃ vidadhyātparameśvaraḥ | ityuktvā virarāmāsau nidrāṃ jagrāha māṃ smaran ||83 || karṣukā nidritāścāsan japanto mantrameva tam | prātarutthāya sādhustu snātvā prapūjya māṃ tataḥ ||84|| niveditānnaṃ bhuktvā ca prāpya pūjāṃ yayau vanam | karṣukāste nityameva japanti mantramuttamam ||85|| pūjayanti hariṃ māṃ ca kurvantyapi mahotsavān | cāturmāsye kṛtavanto vratāni vividhāni me ||86|| athāśvine vāṭikāsu kṣetreṣu vanabhūmiṣu | araṇyeṣu ca bīḍeṣu stambasasyatṛṇāni ca ||87|| phaladrūpāṇi sarvāṇi kaṇiśānyabhavan yadā | dhānyarddhisaṃbhṛtānyeva pakvaprāyāṇi sarvathā ||88|| caturyojanabhūmau vai kṣitiḥ sā sasyaśālinī | pakvapatrauṣadhibhiśca svarṇavarṇā praśobhate ||89|| atha vai daivayogena vāyuvegena sīmataḥ | uparisthapradeśādvai vahniḥ karṣukacullikām ||3.235.90 || tyaktvā ca vāyunotkṣiptaḥ sahasā sasyabhūmiṣu | śuṣkatṛṇeṣu cāvyāpnot tataḥ sasyeṣu sarvataḥ ||91 || tataḥ kṣetreṣu kaṇiśaiḥ sasyayukteṣu sarvataḥ | dāvāgnivat sa cāvyāpnot krośārdhaṃ prasasāra ha |92|| hāhākāraḥ karṣukasya prajāyāmabhavattadā | dudruvuḥ śāntaye vahneḥ sahasraśo hi mānavāḥ |||93|| kintu vāyupravegeṇa coḍḍīyoḍḍīya dūragaḥ | vyomnā bhūtvānyavāṭyāṃ ca pare kṣetre sasāra ha ||94|| niro’ddhuṃ śakyate naiva bhayadaḥ prasasāra vai | utpannakaṇanāśārthaḥ sarvatṛṇādidāhakaḥ ||95|| durbhikṣāpādakarūpaḥ prasasāra samantataḥ | kṛtayatnā janāḥ sarve nirāśāścābhavam̐stadā ||96 || caitanyāyanataḥ prāptaṃ mantraṃ jepuḥ prarakṣakam | ekaikāṃ mālikāmāvartayan yāvattu te sthirāḥ ||97|| smaranto hṛdaye rakṣākaraṃ māṃ duḥkhanāśanam | tāvanmayā hi rakṣārthaṃ cintitaṃ cāmbare drutam ||98|| meghamudbhāvya vṛṣṭiṃ vai vidyudgarjanayā yutām | akaravaṃ ghaṭikānte sasyāgniḥ praśaśāma ha ||99|| krośamātre bhasmasādvai jātaṃ yattatra sarvathā | viśeṣato’karavaṃ vai vṛṣṭiṃ sasyasamṛddhaye || 3.235.100 || punastatra hi sasyāni tṛṇāni kaṇiśāni vai | vyajāyanta yathāpūrvaṃ yathartvanusṛtāni vai || 101 || evaṃ mayā tadā lakṣmi vṛṣṭyagniḥ śāmitaḥ khalu | tataśca karṣukaiḥ sarvairannakūṭo navaḥ kṛtaḥ || 1 02|| nave varṣe sarvamiṣṭānnāni śākāni yāni ca | odanāni dvidalāśca kṣārānnāni parāṇi ca || 10 3|| bharjitānnāni rasyāni svādūni cottamāni ca | pakvānnāni sudhāktāni pāyasānyuttamāni ca || 1 04|| niveditāni sarvāṇi mahyaṃ viśālamandire | tatra mūrtāvahaṃ lakṣmyā sākaṃ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ || 1 05|| bubhuje sarvabhakṣyāṇi bhojyāni lehyakāni ca | coṣyāṇyapi ca peyāni tathā tāmbūlakāni ca || 1 06|| caturbhujaḥ prabhuḥ sākṣād bhuktvā datvā prasādajam | nīrājanāṃ tathā pūjāṃ labdhvā tūrṇaṃ tiro’bhavam || 1 07|| āścaryaṃ lebhire sarve vaiṣṇavā matprasādajam | bubhujire ca te divyā vyajāyanta ca pāvanāḥ || 1 08|| nityaṃ cakruśca me bhaktiṃ sarve kuṭumbinastu te | atha kāle cāgate ca yathākramaṃ yathocitam || 1 09|| anayaṃ svaṃ padaṃ divyamakṣaraṃ karṣukān rame | śataṃ tu kanyakāḥ sarvāḥ svāmivrataparāyaṇāḥ || 3.235.11 0|| bhajitvā māṃ prajātā vai brahmapriyāstavāśritāḥ | imāstā devamaṇikāprabhṛtayastvadālaye || 11 1|| vartante divyadehinyaḥ sarvathā kṛṣṇagopikāḥ | anye muktā abhavam̐śca mamārādhanayā rame || 1 12|| evaṃ lakṣmi mayā bhaktāḥ karṣukā mokṣitāstadā | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇādvartanādapi || 1 13|| jāyante muktasadṛśā mamānandaprabhogiṇaḥ | sarvakāmaprapūrāśca madanyūnā madātmakāḥ ||1 14|| śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca hare svāmin pate sarvasukhade snehapātrikā | bhaktā patnī tava toṣārthaṃ kathaṃ syāt surūpiṇī ||1 15|| śrīpuruṣottama uvāca sarvāṃgasundarī naijāṃ bhavituṃ vratamuttamam | mama kuryājjanmajayantyākhyamūrjāsitāṣṭamīm ||1 16|| upāvasettu vā phalaṃ payo dadhyādi bhakṣayet | yathālabdhopacārairmāṃ śrīyuktaṃ pūjayet satī || 1 17|| candravanmukhalābhārthaṃ svarṇacandraṃ dadettu me | netrabhrubhālaśobhārthaṃ svarṇapatratrayaṃ dadet || 118|| kapolakarṇanāsauṣṭhasauṣṭhavārthaṃ suvarṇajam | svarṇapatraśaṣkulīsatpuṣpabimbāni vai dadet || 1 19|| dantasvarasugandhārthaṃ svarṇakundapradā tathā | śarkarākesarakaiśarādipradā bhaved vrate || 3.235.120|| sustanārthaṃ dāḍimādiphale svarṇe dadet vrate | suśobhitakarārthaṃ tu svarṇekṣudaṇḍamarpayet || 121 || supārśvodaravakṣo’rthaṃ svarṇakalaśapaṭṭikāḥ | svarṇarūpyaphalakāni dadyāt saundaryadāni hi || 1 22|| raśanāstanukaṭyarthaṃ śroṇyarthaṃ dvau ghaṭau dadet | svarṇajau yonisaukṣmyārthaṃ svarṇormikāśca mauktikān || 1 23|| svarṇakapardikāṃ śaṃkhalikāṃ śuktiṃ dadettathā | alomajaghanārthaṃ tu dadet pātraṃ suvarṇajam || 124|| yonyārogyakṛte dadyāt kastūrīhīrakādikam | cārusakthikṛte dadyād rūpyakadalikādvayam ||125||| sveṣṭaliṅgapādajaṃghācārvarthaṃ kadalīphalam | vāhanaṃ pāduke svarṇe rajo’rthaṃ mauktikān dadet || 1 26|| lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ sādhvīṃ prasādya sarvamāpnuyāt | vratottaradine sādhūn bhojayet phalamāpnuyāt || 127|| iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ sarvakāmaprapūrakam | sarvā nāryo labheran me vrate dānena vāñcchitam ||1 28|| ityevaṃ te kathitāni caritrāṇi nijāni vai | bhaktarakṣākarāṇyeva ṣoḍaśe vatsare mama || 129|| tvayā śrutāni sarvāṇi mano’bhilaṣitāni vai | sādhumāhātmyayuktāni mahāmokṣapradāni ca || 3.235.1 30|| kṛpayaiva mayoktāni śreyase smaratāṃ rame | dhyāyatāṃ muktaye cāpi vadatāṃ pāpanuttaye || 131 || mahānandapradānyeva tādātmyabhāvayoginām | sarvasvārpitanārīṇā brahmapriyātvadāni ca || 1 32|| sarvasvārpitapuṃsāṃ tu brahmamuktatvadāni ca | sakāmānāṃ sarvakāmapūrakāṇi sukhāni ca || 1 33|| niṣkāmānāṃ kṛpayā me mattulyatāpradāni ca | lakṣmi līlā mama divyā divyā madyogimānavāḥ || 1 34|| sarvaṃ divyaṃ mama kṣetraṃ paradhāmātmakaṃ bhuvi | ṣoḍaśaṃ vigataṃ varṣaṃ mahānandapariplutam || 1 35|| saptadaśaṃ janmadine mamāyāti drutaṃ khalu | utsavo’tra mahān bhāvī lomaśādyaiḥ pravartitaḥ || 1 36|| viramāmi samastānāṃ patnīnāṃ śrāntaye’pi ca | oṃnamaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 1 37|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne jīrṇodbhavābhidhakṛṣīvalasya caitanyakāyanisādhuyogena bhagavaddarśanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ, strīsaundaryādipradavratadāna varṇanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 235 ||
<3.236> śrīpuruṣottama uvāca śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ saptadaśamahotsavam | mama janmadivasasya caturvyūhaḥ kariṣyati || 1 || vāsudevastathāsaṃkarṣaṇo’niruddha ityapi | pradyumnaśceti te sarve tatheśvarā maharṣayaḥ || 2 || kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre’kṣare divye mahāyate | āgatya śvo nivatsyanti sannaddhāḥ santu sevikā || 3 || ūrjakṛṣṇasya saptamyāṃ cāndre māse tu noditāḥ | lakṣmyaḥ sarvā brahmapatnyaḥ samārambhaṃ pracakrire || 4 || sabhādevyaḥ sabhāsthānaṃ sabhāsthānāni yāni ca | pracakrire hi sahasā yeṣu sṛṣṭyabhibimbanam || 5 || śṛṃgāradevikā divyaśṛṃgārāṇi pracakrire | dhāmadevyaḥ prakāśāni vanadevyo vanāni ca || 6 || udyānāni tarudevyo māyā dṛśyāni cakrire | rasadevyo rasān sarvān gandhadevyaḥ sugandhinaḥ || 7 || sarasvatyo gāyanāni niśā svargaṃ pracakrire | annapūrṇā gariṣṭāni miṣṭānnāni pracakrire || 8 || kalpalatāḥ puṣpapatradalāni saṃpracakrire | kalpamaṇayo bhūṣāśca vahniḥ svarṇaṃ pracakrire || 9 || bhūdevī ramyaśayyāśca vāyurvai vāhanāni ca | rasaśālāḥ kamalādyāḥ pānaśālāśca vāruṇī || 3.236.10 || lalitāśrīmahālakṣmīrdāsikābjābjamānayat | viṣṇustu pārṣadān muktānānayannijasevakān || 11 || yajñanārāyaṇo yajñamaṇḍapān saṃvyadhād drutam | oṣadhayaḥ samidhaścānayan sarvavidhā drutam || 1 2|| gāndharvā gāyakān vādyasahitān prasamānayan | nartakyaścāpi kinnaryo’psarasaścāyayurdrutam || 1 3|| muktāvatārā īśeśā īśvarāścāyayustadā | svāgatārthaṃ mahāsenāpatayaḥ śāṃkarādayaḥ || 14|| sotsāhāśca pratijagmurmaharṣayaḥ samāyayuḥ | vāsudevādayo vyūhā nārāyaṇāstathāyayuḥ || 15|| rudrā ajāḥ siddhajanā viṣṇavastatra cāyayuḥ | īśvarāṇyaśca muktānyaḥ sarvā ramāḥ samāyayuḥ || 16|| rādhāsakhyo ramāsakhyo brāhmīsakhyaḥ samāyayuḥ | vairājāśca hiraṇpuṃso māyātattvāni cāyayuḥ || 17|| devā devyaḥ pitaraśca dikpālā lokapālinaḥ | ṛṣayo mānavā bhaktāḥ kāśyapāśca samāyayuḥ || 18|| dhārmikāḥ sādhavaḥ satyo brahmaśīlāḥ samāyayuḥ | ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvāṇastīrthottamāni cāyayuḥ || 19|| ītirdhṛtiḥ śivā śaktirvedapatnyaḥ samāyayuḥ | samudrāḥ kṛṣṇapatnyaśca rādhādyāśca samāyayuḥ || 3.236.20 || yoginyaḥ śāṃkarāḥ sarve gaṇāścāpi samāyayuḥ | naranārāyaṇādyāśca tāpasāstatra cāyayuḥ || 21 || araṇyāni vanānyeva bhūgolāni samāyayuḥ | caityāśca ṛtavaḥ kālāḥ vatsarādyāḥ samāyayuḥ ||22|| puruṣottamamāso’pi mahābherīṃ ninādayan | āyayau cākṣare kṣetre sarvakalyāṇakṛcchubhaḥ ||23|| yogāḥ samāyayuryajñā bhaktiputrāḥ samāyayuḥ | vimānānāṃ na pāro’sti gajānāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ tathā ||24|| vāhanānāṃ na pāro’sti sūtamāgadhadehinām | bandīnāṃ bahurūpāṇāṃ manorañjanakāriṇām ||25|| ūrjasaptamikārātrāvāyayuḥ sarvadehinaḥ | teṣāṃ svāgatamutkṛṣṭaṃ devyo devāḥ pracakrire ||26|| pārṣadāḥ sādhavaścāpi brahmapriyāḥ pracakrire | pitā mātā ca bhaginī bhrātaraḥ saṃpracakrire ||27||| tathā samastaśiṣyāśca svayamārṣāśca īśvarāḥ | lomaśādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca lālāyanādyāḥ sādhavaḥ ||28|| svāgataṃ bhojanaṃ pānaṃ pracakrire dadustathā | sarvāḥ kāmadughā gāvaḥ payāṃsi ca dadustadā ||29|| sarvā dāsyo’pi dāsāśca mahīmānaprasevanam | niśīthe cakrire tatra nyūnaṃ nābhūddhi kiṃcana ||3.236.30|| prātarutthāya ca lakṣmi cāhaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | kṛtasnānaḥ kṛtaśṛṃgārakaḥ priyābhiranvitaḥ ||31 || mātrā pitrā vardhitaśca sabhāyāmagamaṃ drutam | tadā vādyānyavādyanta vāsudevādayastathā ||32|| avatārā īśvarāśca hīśvarāṇyastu sarvaśaḥ | muktāśca gopikā gopā āyayurmama maṇḍapam ||33|| divyasiṃhāsanasthasya kṛtvā me pūjanaṃ ca te | ārārtrikaṃ vyadhuḥ sarve’kṣatakuṃkumacandrakān ||34|| cakruścāśīrvacanāni jagurviprā maharṣayaḥ | dhāmakoṭyaśceśakoṭyo devarṣipitṛkoṭayaḥ ||35|| tatpatnyaścākṣatapuṣpairvardhayāmāsureva mām | mānavāḥ sarvatīrthāni tattvāni vedavedikāḥ ||36|| sarasvatyaḥ śāradāśca lakṣmyaḥ sarvā mamārhaṇam | cakruḥ sarvopadā me ca dadurdivyāḥ sabhāsthale ||37|| evaṃ madhyāhnaparyantaṃ pūjanaṃ bahuśobhanam | jātaṃ me tatra cāyātaṃ sarvaṃ dāne dadāvaham ||38|| bhojanāni mahīmānebhyaśca dattāni vai tataḥ | parihāraḥ kṛtaścāpi dakṣiṇāḥ prāpitāḥ śubhāḥ ||39|| pāritoṣikarūpāṇi dattāni yogyatā yathā | rātrau vādyamahāgītinṛtyarañjanakādikam ||3.236.40|| abhavattvardharātryantaṃ virāmaśca tato’bhavat | navamyāṃ ca mahīmānāḥ pūjitā bhojitāstathā ||41|| sammānitāśca prahitā yayurnijālayān prati | evaṃ saptadaśe varṣārambhadine’ṣṭamītithau |||42|| kṛṣṇe corje mama janmajayantyutsavitā rame | bhavatīnāṃ yaśaścedaṃ trisṛṣṭau samprakāśate |||43||| ṣoḍaśasya tu varṣasya camatkārā mamātra vai | tṛtīye dvāparasantānake saṃvarṇitā mama ||44|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ pareśvaraḥ | caritrāṇāṃ vidhātā ca kartā vaktā pralekhakaḥ ||45|| etattṛtīyakhaṇḍasya pārāyaṇaṃ karoti yaḥ | tasya sampad vividhā syād vaṃśo vistāravān bhavet ||46|| sauvarṇe garuḍe dhṛtvā dadyād dvāparapustakam | tena vai pṛthivīdānaṃ dattaṃ bhavenna saṃśayaḥ ||47|| asya kathākṣaṇe yadyat samarpyate’lpakaṃ hyapi | anantaguṇitaṃ tatsyānmahāsvargapradaṃ bhavet || 48||| godānaṃ vāṭikādānaṃ svarṇaratnapradānakam | kanyādānaṃ gṛhadānaṃ gajadānaṃ makhe’rpaṇam ||49|| sarvadānaphalaṃ tvasya dānena samprajāyate | vimānadānaṃ nagarīdānaṃ vanārpaṇaṃ tathā ||3.236.50|| sarvasvārpaṇamevāsya dānena samprajāyate | brahmadānaṃ vedadānaṃ mokṣadānamathottamam |||51||| ātmasamarpaṇamasya dānena samprajāyate | taranti pitaraścāpi bhavanti dhāmavāsinaḥ ||52|| sāmrājyārpaṇamevāsya dānena samprajāyate | rogā vighnāḥ praṇaśyanti duritāni hrasanti ca ||53||| durbhāgyāni vinaśyanti dvāparakhaṇḍadānataḥ | saptāhaṃ pākṣikaṃ vāpi māsikaṃ vā pravācayet ||54|| sādhūn viprān bhojayecca śrotṝn vaktṝn yathādhanam | sādhvī satīrbhojayeccānāthān dīnān samastataḥ ||55|| vācakaṃ varayānena bhrāmayennagare striyaḥ | viprāśca bhūbhṛtaścāpi śreṣṭhinaśca prajājanāḥ |||56||| kumāryaḥ kalaśairvāribhṛtaiśca nārikelajaiḥ | mauktikairāsinībhiśca suveṣairbhrāmayettathā |||57|| suvāsinyo gītikābhirakṣataiḥ puṣpakuṃkumaiḥ | pūjayed vardhayeccāpi bhrāmayennagare tathā ||58|| mahādānāni dadyuśca vācakāya mahātmane | yathā sādhuḥ prasannaḥ syāttattaddadyurhi sādhave |||59|| bhuktirmuktirbhavedasya śravaṇena ca divyatā | vāsanānāṃ praṇāśaśca kalmaṣāṇāṃ layo bhavet ||3.236.60|| tāpatrayavināśaśca śāntistu śāśvatī bhavet | putraṃ putrīṃ samīhānā dvāparakhaṇḍadānakam ||61|| nūtnaveṣṭanasahitaṃ svarṇamudrānvitaṃ caret | śatrubhīstena naśyedvai rājabhayaṃ na jāyate ||62|| kārāgāravimuktaḥ syādasya dānena bhāvataḥ | asādhyaṃ sādhyamevāpi bhavedasya śruteriha ||63 || sārvajñyaṃ bahudhā tvasya śravaṇena prajāyate | vallabhāryaḥkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī mahāprabhuḥ ||64|| rādhālakṣmīpatiḥ padmāvatīśrīmāṇikīpatiḥ | prajñāmuktāpatirnityaṃ sphuret svahṛdaye śravāt ||65|| sākṣānmileddhi varṣānte śṛṇuyānnityameva tam | miled rahasi viśvātmā svapne milenna saṃśayaḥ ||66|| āpatkāle rakṣayecca dvāparakhaṇḍasaṃsmṛteḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhiteyaṃ me pratimāsti hi ||67|| khaṇḍo’yaṃ dvāparasantāno me’styudaramāntaram | spṛṣṭvā dhyātvā sevayitvā manmūrtiṃ labhate’kṣare ||68|| yeṣāṃ yāsāṃ bhaved vāñcchā sākṣād yogyasya me hṛdi | taistābhiśca kathā śravyā japtavyaśca manurmama ||69|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | āgatyāhaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vai sukhaṃ dāsye ca darśanam ||3.236.70 || lakṣajapena siddhyedvai mantro’yaṃ mama nāmavān | daśāṃśahomaḥ kartavyo bhāvanīyo’māntare ||71 || kaustubhakirīṭayuktaḥ sarvabhūṣāvibhūṣitaḥ | prasannavadano lakṣmi kāntaḥ kandarpasundaraḥ ||72|| trailokye nāsti tadvastu yadvastu na dadāmyaham | sṛṣṭitraye’pi tannāsti yanna bhaktāya sandade ||73|| siṃhāsanaṃ tathāṅkaṃ ca dhāmākṣaraṃ madāsanam | mamaiśvaryāṇi sarvāṇi dadāmi mantrajāpine ||74|| etallakṣmi hṛdayaṃ me kṛpā me’nugrahaśca me | sarvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ dāsye vai tādātmyamantrajāpine ||75|| kalpavṛkṣāḥ kāmadughāḥ kalpavallyaśca yā matāḥ | kalpastambāstathā cintāmaṇayo’kṣayapātrikā ||76|| padmacihnaṃ camatkārāḥ siddhayaścāpi sarvaśaḥ | bhavanti hṛdaye tvasya tādātmyamantrajāpinaḥ ||77|| śṛṇoti dvāparasantānakaṃ japati manmanum | śāśvataṃ puṇyamevāsya kalpasiddhiśca śāśvatī ||78|| avyāhatagatistasya hyanāvaraṇadarśanam | mantrasiddhyā jāyate vai madicchayā na saṃśayaḥ ||79|| devatvaṃ vā munitvaṃ vā siddhatvaṃ ceśatāṃ ca vā | avatāratvamevāpi dvāparasya śravāllabhet ||3.236.80 || bhūmapadaṃ śivapadaṃ hiraṇmayapadaṃ tathā | mahāpuruṣadhiṣṇyaṃ vā dvāparasya śravāllabhet ||81 || śṛṇuyācchrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe kṛtvā manaḥsthiram | mahotsavena śṛṇuyāccatuḥpumarthadaṃ bhavet| ||82|| nityaṃ phalāni dhānyāni vastrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca | nityopayogivastūni dadyāt saṃśṛṇuyāt kathām ||83|| nindakānāṃ bhayaṃ tyaktvā nāstikānāṃ bhayaṃ tathā | viruddhānāṃ bhayaṃ tyaktvā śṛṇuyādvai mamāśraye ||84|| yatrāhaṃ tatra vijayo yatrāhaṃ tatra cotsavāḥ | yatrāhaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ tatra macchūnye bhayamasti hi ||85|| śrutvā śrutvā rasavettryo bhavantu buddhayo hi vaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mama gocarāḥ ||86|| adhyāyaṃ vāpyaikapadyaṃ ye śroṣyanti samāhitāḥ | teṣāṃ tāsāṃ tārako’haṃ kṛṣṇo’smi bhavasāgarāt ||87|| api pāpā nīcadehā nīcakarmāṇa eva vā | anācārāḥ satāṃ yogād yathā śuddhyanti sarvathā ||88|| tathāsya śravaṇāt pāpāḥ praśuddhyanti na saṃśayaḥ | madyogānnirguṇāḥ sarve śrotāraḥ saṃbhavanti hi ||89|| atra mānavarūpāste muktā muktānikā matāḥ | kathāsthānaṃ tvakṣaraṃ me dhāma bodhyaṃ na māyikam ||3.236.90|| vaktāsti mama rūpo’sya vadāmyahaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | śloke śloke mayā lakṣmi kṛpā pravarṣitā tviha ||91 || api manāk hariṃ kāntaṃ pratyabhiyānti bhāvataḥ | tān pratyahaṃ śataguṇamabhiyāmi pramoditaḥ ||92|| kṛteṣu sarvayajñeṣu yadyāpanna vyapohati | smarenmāṃ mama tādātmyamantraṃ japenmuhurmuhuḥ ||93|| sarvāpado vinaśyanti pratijñeyaṃ mayoditā | etaddvāparasantānakhaṇḍaśravaṇamānatām ||94|| kuryādvā vipadāṃ nāśaḥ saṃkalpakaraṇād bhavet | ekatastu kathāḥ sarvā ekatastu manurmama ||95|| manurviśiṣyate lakṣmi kathāyuktastu kiṃ punaḥ | śaṃ vo’stu śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya karuṇālavāt ||96|| ācāryaḥ kambharāputro’stu śaṃ gopālanandanaḥ | santuṣṭānujasaumyaśrīprajñāsārvajñyasaṃbhṛtaḥ ||97|| sarvajñaḥ sarvavit sarvāntarātmā sarvakāraṇam | śaṃ vo’stu śvetavyāsādiryāvadvyāseśvaro hariḥ ||98|| sarvadharmāśrayaḥ sarvāśramaḥ sarvārthavarṇavān | śaṃ vo’stu sarvakakṣāḍhyaḥ sarvakhanīśvaro’gragaḥ ||99|| yadvāsāt khalu saurāṣṭraṃ saurāṣṭratāṃ bhajatyati | so’haṃ so’yaṃ sākṣaparokṣakaḥ śaṃ vo’stu śāśvatam || 3.236.1 00|| ākṣarakuṃkumavāpīkṣetre lomaśasaṃśrite | devadeveśvaraḥ śaṃ vo brahmeśo’stu hariḥ sadā || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne’nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya saptadaśajanmadinajayantyutsavo dvāparasantānakathāśravaṇadānamantrajapamahimā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 236 ||
<3.237> śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca hṛdayasya priyaprāṇakāntacānandavāridhe | kṛpālo śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāhaṃ pāvanīkṛtā | | 1 || divyānāṃ śrībhavataḥ satkathānāṃ śrāvaṇena vai | imā brahmapriyāḥ sarvā haripriyāstathāparāḥ || 2 || paramaṃ pāvanaṃ bhāvaṃ prāptā bhavatkathāśravāt | sarvā muktānikā gopyo ramā lakṣmyaḥ śriyaḥ striyaḥ || 3 || īśvarāṇyaśca siddhānyo devyo mānavya ityapi | kāśyapyaśca talinyaśca kṛtakṛtyā hare’bhavan || 4 || aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ daityadānavarakṣasām | kanyakānāṃ kṛṣṇakāntātmikānāmiha no yathā || 5 || aho kṛpā hyaho cānugrahaḥ śrīparamātmanaḥ | śrottryaḥ patnyaḥ patirvaktā svayaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 6 || yāsāṃ bhāgyāni chinnāni sphuṭitāni ca vā prabho | tāsāṃ kṛṣṇamukhāmbhojakathāśravakṣaṇo na vai || 7 || śroṣyanti bahunāryaśca narāścāsya kathāmṛtam | saṃkṣepāccālpabuddhīnāṃ kathāsmṛtiṃ prakāraya || 8 || puruṣottama uvāca svalpakṣaṇāptaśraddhānāṃ smaraṇārthaṃ narāyaṇi | kathāyāmyasya khaṇḍasya kathābījāni saṃśṛṇu || 9 || adhyāyāścāsya khaṇḍakasya ṣaṭtriṃśacchatadvayam | ślokānāṃ tu sahasrāṇi pañcaviṃśatirityadhi || 3.237.1 0|| satyatretādvāparāṇāmadhyāyā vai ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ | tathā śataṃ sahasraṃ ca bhavanti mokṣadā rame ||1 1 || ślokāḥ khaṇḍatrayāṇāṃ tu lakṣaṃ tvekaṃ tathādhikāḥ | te dvādaśasahasrāṇi śataṃ santi bhuṅmukpradāḥ || 12|| eṣā saṃkhyā mānave’tra loke bodhyā na cetare | saṃhiteyaṃ viśālāsti prāgeva kathitaṃ tava || 1 3|| atra dvāparasantāne hyāraṃbhe śrīkṛtā stutiḥ | sṛṣṭikālasya gaṇanoditā tatastu vedhasaḥ ||14|| dvāpañcāśadvatsarākhyāḥ kalpākhyāḥ kathitāstataḥ | rohiṇāsuranāśārthaṃ śrīdyunārāyaṇo hariḥ || 15|| merudhartā merunārāyaṇaśca kīrtitastataḥ | raveḥ śātanakṛdviṣṇunārāyaṇaśca varṇitaḥ ||16|| dhūmrāsuravināśārthaṃ devanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | makhapravartako yajñanārāyaṇaśca kīrtitaḥ ||17|| rudraśāstā brahmanārāyaṇaśca kathitastataḥ | devadhiṣṇyaniyamārthamādityanrāyaṇastataḥ ||18|| nāgaśāstā śrīgarutmannārāyaṇaśca varṇitaḥ | ārṣanārāyaṇaścāpi dhruvasthairyakarastataḥ || 19|| thurānandapraśāstā śrīprājñanārāyaṇastataḥ | kathito naiṣṭhikavīranārāyaṇastu śīlavān ||3.237.20 || mokṣadaśca tato bhadranārāyaṇo’pi varṇitaḥ | tuṃgabhadrāsanāputryā lakṣmyā vivāhasūtsavaḥ ||21 || anādiśrīharinārāyaṇāvatāra īritaḥ | bījarakṣākaro bījanārāyaṇastataḥ param ||22|| dharmavratagṛhe jāto varanārāyaṇo hariḥ | sudarśanyāḥ śāpajātasamastastrīsvarūpiṇām ||23|| śāpamokṣakaraḥ strīpuṃnārāyaṇaśca kīrtitaḥ | mākarāsuranāśārthaṃ jalanārāyaṇastataḥ ||24|| sādhudharmasthāpanārthaṃ śīlanārāyaṇastataḥ | vyāghrāsuravināśārthaṃ vārdhinārāyaṇastataḥ ||25||| tataścaturmukhaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kathitaḥ sṛṣṭisadṛśaḥ | rādhanikāpuṇyavrātagṛhe śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||26|| avātarat kathā caiṣoditā tataḥ paraṃ rame | tīrthapāvanakṛttīrthanārāyaṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||27|| bhaktipravartaka ukto jīvannārāyaṇastataḥ | tato’rdhaśrīśvaranārāyaṇaḥ saṃvarṇito rame ||28|| tataścārdhapitṛnārāyaṇaḥ plakṣanarāyaṇaḥ | naramedhe puṃstvanārāyaṇastataḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||29|| tata uktaḥ śyāmanārāyaṇo vaṭaśriyā
