saha | māyūrāsuranāśārthaṃ rājanārāyaṇastataḥ ||3.237.30|| kāmabhasmottaraṃ brahmacārinārāyaṇastataḥ | śaṃbhūjjīvaka uditaḥ śivanārāyaṇastataḥ ||3 1 || kuberojjīvakaḥ svarṇanārāyaṇaśca varṇitaḥ | jvālādāhāvanakartā svāminārāyaṇastataḥ ||32|| nirvāṇikāgṛhe śrīsāvananārāyaṇastataḥ | sāghunārāyaṇaścāpi sādhvīlakṣmyā sahoditaḥ ||3 3|| varṇiśālamanorujjīvako bhaktanarāyaṇaḥ | aśvībhūtavarmadharanṛparakṣākṛte punaḥ ||34|| medhanārāyaṇo medhālakṣmyā sahoditaḥ prabhuḥ | analādavināśārthaṃ vahninārāyaṇastataḥ ||35|| ilodaravināśārthaṃ rasanārāyaṇastataḥ | daityahā śrīcakranārāyaṇastataḥ pravarṇitaḥ ||36|| satyadharmasthāpayitā satyanārāyaṇastataḥ | sthityarthaṃ parvatānāṃ hiraṇyanārāyaṇastataḥ ||37|| naiṣkiñcanīśriyā sākaṃ nairañjaninarāyaṇaḥ | puṇyavatīśāpaśāntyai śāpanārāyaṇastataḥ || 38|| apsarasāṃ manaḥpūrtyai brahmadbrahmanarāyaṇaḥ | brahmavidyāprakāśāya gurunārāyaṇastaḥ ||39|| bṛhaddharmanṛpataye sādhudīkṣāpradaḥ prabhuḥ | ācāryāṇīśriyā sākamācāryanrāyaṇastataḥ ||3.237.40|| vidyutsrāvādināśārthaṃ vidyunnārāyaṇastataḥ | madhubhakṣādināśārthaṃ madhunārāyaṇastataḥ ||41 || daityahā śrīnāthanārāyaṇaścāpi pravarṇitaḥ | sākaṃ vibhvīśriyā svarṇotsave vibhunarāyaṇaḥ ||42|| mokṣanārāyaṇaścāpi muktiśrīsahitastataḥ | śivarājīśriyā yuktaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastataḥ ||43|| koṭyarbudābjamahiṣīkāntaḥ prabhuḥ pravarṇitaḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇa dvandvadvādaśordhvasahasrakam ||44|| dvandranāmastavaścoktaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ | naranārāyaṇe parabrahmarūpapradarśanam ||45|| gṛhastrīṇāṃ vidheyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ varṇanaṃ tataḥ | vadhūṭīnāṃ sadācārā vadhūpālyā vṛṣāstathā ||46|| satīsatyabalaṃ coktaṃ bhaktiyogaśca nirguṇaḥ | puruṣottamayogaśca parabrahmaṇa ityapi ||47|| akṣarātītatādātmyaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇavratam | gurośca mahimā divyādevīpramokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ||48|| adattānna jaladāne subāhornṛpateḥ kathā | nahuṣasya kathā kuñjalasya śukasya vai kathā ||49|| kāmodāyāḥ kathā coktā cyavanasya kathā tataḥ | guroḥ rahasyakathanaṃ sadācārādivarṇanam ||3.237.50|| ṛṣidharmarṣiyogena brahmapriyātvamuttamam | līlāvatīsuśīlādisakhīnāṃ tatkathānakam ||51 || tato rakṣāśvapacyāstu mokṣaṇasya kathoditā | gurorharisvarūpatvaṃ sarvārpaṇastavastataḥ ||52|| vaiṣṇavottamatāyāṃ tu kauśikādinidarśanam | gānaśikṣarjanaṃ coktaṃ nāradasya tataḥ param ||53|| ulūkasya garuḍatvaprāptiruktā tataḥ param | mahā bhāgavatabhaktacihnānyuktāni vai tataḥ ||544|| parīkṣaṇaṃ cidambarārājñyā uktaṃ tataḥ param | bhagavadgadayā rājñyāḥ kṛtā rakṣā pravarṇitā ||55|| vidyāmantragurūṇāṃ ca balotkṛṣṭatvamīritam | anāvaraṇasevā ca vrataṃ damanakaṃ tataḥ ||56|| bhinnatithau bhinnarūpahareḥ pūjā prakīrtitā | bhaktermāhātmyakathanaṃ vadhūbhaktirahasyakam ||57|| hareḥ kṛpāyāḥ sarvasvaṃ phalaṃ pravarṇitaṃ tataḥ | mahāmantrarahasyāni sārthanyāsāni vai tataḥ ||58|| gāyatrī, cordhvapuṇḍrādi, gūḍhārthajñānamityapi | tripādvibhūtiścaikapāddivyatādi samīhitam ||59|| nāmabhaktyā yayāteśca prabhāvo varṇitastataḥ | hareḥ prasannatāsādhanānāṃ ca varṇanaṃ tataḥ ||3.237.60|| kadaryasya kathā, bhinnaphalaṃ, sādhusamāgamaḥ | brahmiṣṭhatāsādhanāni pativratāvṛṣāstathā ||61 || sucandrikāgopikāyāścamatkārakathoditā | manoḥ patnyāḥ kathā brahmaprathāyāstūditā tataḥ ||62|| dīrghāyusādhanaṃ coktaṃ śatagṛdhrapramokṣaṇam | vinodinyāḥ śataputratyāgitā coditā tataḥ ||63|| vātsyāyanaprasaṃgena gaṇikānāṃ tu mokṣaṇam | sādhutve hetavaścoktā mokṣopāyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||64|| vṛṣāyanena carakāvitā śyenādudīritam | citraketośca mālatyāḥ satsevāphalamīritam ||65|| viprebhyaḥ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā uktā viṣṇunidarśanāt | durgāyāścāpi dṛṣṭāntaṃ, sahadharmā udīritāḥ ||66|| pratyakṣanirayāḥ proktāḥ karṣukasya nidarśanam | svargagāmni uktāśca proktā ghātakinastathā ||67|| sādhavo jaṃgamaṃ tīrthaṃ proktaṃ sarvasya pāvanam | dvijāputrakṛśāṃgasya vṛṣalotpāditasya tu ||68|| brahmiṣṭhatvaṃ kṛśānutvaṃ tapobhiścendrakṛdvarāt | nidarśanāni bahūni jātīnāṃ parivartane ||69|| bhaṃgāsvananṛpasyāpi nārītve ca nidarśanam | nidarśanaṃ brahmayogabale viṣulayoginaḥ ||3.237.70|| lomakapardakarakṣonāśo rucervṛṣāvanam | indraparājayo guroḥ prasannatā ca varṇitā ||71 || abdhimagnasya gokarṇatīrthasyoddharaṇaṃ tataḥ | kuvalāśvakathā triśaṃkośca tataḥ kathoditā |||72|| praṇadbrahmakathā kaśyapasya tathā kathoditā | mokṣasādhanamānāni satāṃ samāgamo balam ||73|| ālambāyanasādhośca saṃgāllakṣapramokṣaṇam | gṛdhraśvapacayoścāpi śabarasya ca mokṣaṇam ||74|| satsu lakṣmīnivāsaśca śrīvāsā uditāstataḥ | avatāre bhṛgoḥ śāpaḥ svecchā hetustathoditaḥ ||75|| godānaṃ ca gavārādhanāvrataṃ kathitaṃ tathā | bhāruṇḍoddharaṇaṃ cāpi pretoddhārasya kāraṇam ||76|| vṛṣādarbheśca sūryasya dānapātre nidarśanam | naraśāyataskarasya śrīcakrabhāsasādhunā ||77|| muktiḥ kṛtā ca dhanināṃ brahmasatrāvabodhanam | patnī vivāhitā sarvadharmamūlaṃ pradarśitam ||78|| atrārthe jāṃghalāmakhanidarśanaṃ pravarṇitam | vividhāstu sutāḥ putryaḥ patayaḥ patnikāstathā ||79|| śaṃbhalavārasūtasya sādhubhaktasya mokṣaṇam | kalyāṇabhaktasevāyāḥ parīkṣaṇaṃ tathā tataḥ ||3.237.80 || bhūtale śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprākaṭyamīritam | śrīpuruṣottamasāma sahasranāmavarṇitam ||8 1 || puruṣottamasāmnaśca phalaṃ cākṣaralaṃbhanam | bhūdānādiphalaṃ cānnadānādijaṃ phalaṃ tathā ||82|| dīrghaśīlābhidhayorāstikanāstikayordvayoḥ | yamadvārā hyupadeśo mokṣaṇaṃ kathitaṃ tataḥ ||83 || brahmasatyāstu yoginyā dehadāne nidarśanam | vaivartabhūpateḥ patnyāṃ devarāt punarudbhavaḥ ||84|| romapādapaśupasya mokṣaṇaṃ kathitaṃ tataḥ | nagnabhaṃgākhyacaurasya satsaṃgād rakṣaṇaṃ tathā ||85|| bhāgavatāyanasādhukṛtamujjīvanaṃ punaḥ | dāvadagdhavanasyāpi camatkārastathoditaḥ ||86|| kāmadevajabhasmotthabhaṇḍāsurasya nāśane | lalitāśrīmahālakṣmīsainyānāṃ cāpi yodhanam ||87|| bhaṇḍāsuravināśaśca lalitāśrīstavastataḥ | pāritoṣikadānāni mandirāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa ||88|| cintāmaṇigṛhasthābhiḥ sevikābhiḥ prasevanam | kāñcīpuryormahālakṣmyā dvedhā svarūpatoditā ||89|| dīkṣāvidhānaṃ devatrayavāsastathoditaḥ | pañcatriṃśadūrdhvaśatanāmāni lalitāśriyāḥ ||3.237.90|| putroprāptipradaṃ dānaṃ vrataṃ ceti prakīrtitam | sādhusevāvrataṃ vratottamaṃ tata udīritam ||91 || tulāpuruṣadānaṃ ca hiraṇyagarbhadānakam | brahmāṇḍadānakaṃ kalpavṛkṣadānaṃ ca kīrtitam ||92|| gosahasramahādānaṃ svarṇakāmagavārpaṇam | hiraṇyāśvamahādānaṃ hiraṇyarathadānakam ||93||| hemahastirathadānaṃ pañcalāṃgaladānakam | hemadharāmahādānaṃ viśvasudarśanārpaṇam ||94|| mālācakrapradānaṃ ca bhūṣādānaṃ prakīrtitam | mahākalpalatādānaṃ kalpapriyāpradānakam ||95|| kalpakāntapradānaṃ ca gurudevādidānakam | mandirārpaṇamevāpi saptasāgaradānakam ||96|| mahābhūtapradānaṃ ca lakṣmīdānaṃ prakīrtitam | grahaśāntiprapūjādi vyakoṭijapādikam ||97|| lohāṃgārasya vaiśyasya grahaśāntau nidarśanam | mahālakṣmyā dve śate ca nāmānyuktāni vai tataḥ ||98|| mahālakṣmīpratimā ca tathā tanmaṇḍalaṃ tataḥ | pitṛkanyānāṃ nijeṣṭaphalāptirnāmasaṃstavāt ||99|| lakṣmīsaubhāgyaśayanavrataṃ ca vidhirīritaḥ | ghaṭalakṣmīvrataṃ sarvamaṃgalaṃ ca tathā vratam || 3.237.100|| sāṃkhyayogavrataṃ rasakalyāṇalalitāvratam | ārdrānandaramānārāyaṇavrataṃ ca kīrtitam || 101 || śāradeyavrataṃ coktaṃ kalyāṇīkamalāvratam | viśokalalitādvādaśīvrataṃ ca tathoditam || 1 02|| vibhūtilalitākṛṣṇalālanaṃ vratamīritam | puṣkaravāhananāmno nṛpasya ca nidarśanam || 103 || ekaṣaṣṭivratānāṃ ca nirdeśo’pi prakīrtitaḥ | pāpināṃ mokṣakṛttīrthaṃ kuṃkumavāpikātmakam || 1 04|| kālamṛtyubalaśāntyai mantrapūjādi ceritam | dvāparīyamānavānāṃ dharmakarmādi darśitam ||1 05|| yugadharmādibhinnatvaṃ cotpātaśāntikarma ca | duḥsvapnaśāntikarmāpi grahayajñastathoditaḥ||106|| śubhasvapnaśakunāni cāśubhe śāntikarma ca hanūmato manuścāpi pratiṣṭhādyaṃ ca varṇitam || 1 07|| mahāpāpādināśārthamupāyāḥ kīrtitāstathā | dharmādharmavaṃśayośca varṇanaṃ ca tataḥ param || 1 08|| duḥsahasya nivāsādi tadvaṃśopadravādi ca | kāryākāryavivekaśca nakṣatrādiṣu kīrtitaḥ || 1 09|| sarojinyāḥ kuṃbhakartryāścaturvaidhavyamityapi | satīśvarīsevayā padminītvaṃ ca ramātvakam || 3.237.110 || caturdaśamanūnāṃ ca janyādi ca tataḥ param | ruciprajāpaterākhyānakaṃ cāpi prakīrtitam || 111 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tu himālaye | brahmapriyādiyuktasya vihāro’pi nirūpitaḥ | | 11 2|| hīrakādisuratnānāmutpattirbalarākṣasāt | balasya pārṣadasyātra śāpena patanaṃ tataḥ || 11 3|| daityatvaṃ taccharīrācca ratnotpattiḥ prakīrtitā | sarvajātimaṇīnāṃ ca guṇādyapi nirūpitam || 1 14|| caturdaśāvatārāśca hareścāpi manuṣvapi | jīvacchrāddhavidhiścāpi saṃsārasya nivartanam || 1 15|| vyapohanaṃ tataḥ stotraṃ yajñe kanyādidānakam | mṛtyukāraṇanāśe vai bhāvāyananidarśanam || 1 16|| śrīmānasacidānandayoginośca vicāraṇam | muktidharme ca dehāptikṣayahetava īritāḥ || 1 17|| māyākhyasya hetuśca paradhāmagatistathā | sadvidyāyanapatnyāśca naiṣkarmye praśna uttaram || 118 || śubhāśubhādibhogaśca vijñānaṃ ca prakīrtitam | muktidharmavivekaśca hyadhyātmādivivecanam || 11 9|| bhikṣāyanamaharṣeśca gārhasthye nirguṇātmatā | nityāśrayāyāḥ putrasya bhaktyā mokṣaṇamīritam || 3.237.1 20|| kuṣṭhino vyāghranāmnaśca kuṣṭhanāśa udāhṛtaḥ | uttamasya grāmayājinaśca muktiḥ samīritā || 121 || virālasya rājayakṣmavināśo mokṣaṇaṃ tathā | pṛdhvīdharasya putrasyāndhasya dṛṣṭipradānakam || 1 22|| sāgarasya tu śūdrasyārugṇatā bhagnapādayoḥ | vṛkṇadevasya vṛkṇatvanāśo bhāvasya mokṣaṇam || 1 23|| pāśupateśaviprasya śāpamokṣakathā tataḥ | bāṇāṃgaṇo madyavikretā satsaṃgāt pramocitaḥ || 1 24|| mṛtādanaścarmakāro dhenusevaḥ pramuktigaḥ | sumantukarṣeryogena śaṃkudharo’pi muktigaḥ || 1 25|| mahāsaurāṣṭrīyasaṃgho luṇṭakebhyaḥ prarakṣitaḥ | dhaniṣṭhakeśavaṇijo vyavāyānmokṣaṇaṃ kṛtam ||126|| brahmaghnasya tu nṛpaterbhaktyā rākṣasamokṣaṇam | devaviśrāmasya kāṇḍikāstrīhatyāvimokṣaṇam ||1 27|| harṣulabhaktaputrasya mṛtasyojjīvanaṃ kṛtam | śāṇadharasya kuṣṭhino roganāśaḥ prarakṣaṇam ||1 28|| nimbadevākhyabhaktasya vṛṣahatyānivāraṇam | ekāntikānāmaiśvaryabrahmaniṣṭhādi ceritam ||1 29|| kālīndarasya bhāṇḍasya bhaktyā mokṣaṇamīritam | rāyaṇadevanṛtyajñe garbhasthe jñānasañcayaḥ || 3.237.1 30|| bodhāyanopadeśena mokṣaścāpi tathoditaḥ | vratarddigāyanajñasya puṇḍravarmanṛpasya ca || 131 || saprajasya vaiṣṇavatvaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tata īritam | tūlavāyisūtravāyakasya mokṣaśca varṇitaḥ || 1 32|| jaṃgaladevaprabhṛtikāṣṭhahārapramokṣaṇam | vātsalyadhīrabhaktasya sādhutvaṃ bhāryayā saha || 13 3|| tilakaraṃgavanapālasya muktirudāhṛtā | nāñjabhaktasya ca mahāmayabhaktasya rakṣaṇam || 1 34|| karṣukāṇāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ ca luṇṭakebhyaḥ prakīrtitam | sāgarākhyakirātasya kusulaścākṣayaḥ kṛtaḥ || 1 35|| sāraṃgahūṇabhaktasya mahiṣīrakṣaṇaṃ kṛtam | yajñarādhapuṣkasasya mokṣaprāptistato’pi ca || 1 36|| kapikṣayākhyacāṇḍālamokṣaṇaṃ kathitaṃ tataḥ | nālīkaralohakārabhaktamokṣaśca varṇitaḥ || 1 37|| maṃgaladevacarmakṛdviṣavāraṇamīritam | haridāsarathakāramokṣastataśca varṇitaḥ || 1 38|| śilāhṛddāmaśilādabhṛtyānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ kṛtam | śilpinaḥ sañjayadevasyāpi gajātprarakṣaṇam || 139 || saṃbharadevacitrakṛnmokṣaṇaṃ kathitaṃ tataḥ | mauktikeśiśilāṃgārakhanisvāmipramokṣaṇam || 3.237.140|| lubdhakasya cakradharākhyasya pāpādināśanam | vāṭadharasya ca piśunasya khasasya mokṣaṇam || 141 || dvaipīrājñyāḥ sutārasiṃhabhūpadaṇḍānmokṣaṇam | śivajayasya ca prāsādakārasya pramokṣaṇam || 142|| jālakṛtsaṃgarayādaskasya kṛṣṇasya darśanam | udyamaśrībharavāṭādīnāṃ ca mokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ || 143|| dīrgharavoṣṭrapālānāṃ sādhuyogena mokṣaṇam | ratnaprabhasyāpi sādhuyogenoktaṃ pramokṣaṇam ||144|| gadārdaneśavaidyasya mukundiyāśca mokṣaṇam | deśyāvanasya kīśasvāminaścāpi pramokṣaṇam || 145|| nigamikānāpitānyā rūpaṃ ca dhṛtavān hariḥ | svarṇadhanvanṛpateśca rājñyāḥ sevāṃ vyadhāditi || 146|| teṣāṃ pramokṣaṇaṃ cāpi prakīrtitaṃ tataḥ param | pūrvajanmani dhīvaryā ābhīrthā daityato hariḥ || 147|| ruṭāṇakyā rakṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ ca kṛtavāniti | matsyamāradhīraparvādīnāṃ tu yamayātanāḥ || 148|| tato naupatijanmāni mokṣaṇaṃ kathitaṃ tataḥ | śūlīpradatārakādarśakasya mokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ || 149|| jvālāprasādasaṃjñasyāṃgārakasya pramokṣaṇam | garadasya lavādanapradhānasya pramokṣaṇam || 3.237.150|| vikhaṇḍalākhyaśastradhṛṅmokṣaṇaṃ kathitaṃ tataḥ | jīrṇodbhavakṛṣīkṛtaḥ sādhuyogena mokṣaṇam ||151 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya me tu janmataḥ | saptadaśe vārṣikāhe jayantyutsava īritaḥ || 152|| asya dvāparasantānakhaṇḍasya śravaṇasya ca | dānasya ca mantrajapasyāpi māhātmyamīritam | | 153|| tato dvāparasantānakathānāṃ sāra īritaḥ | lakṣmi rādhe rame kṛṣṇe padmāvati ca māṇiki || 154|| nārāyaṇi vrahmapriyāḥ kamale cāmṛte rame | haripriyāḥ samastāśca mamātmā śrāvito mayā || 155|| madātmikāḥ kathāḥ sarvā bhavatyastāsu saṃsthitāḥ | santo narāścido nārya ānando’haṃ tayorapi || 156|| saccidānandarūpāśca kathā imāstrisaṃhitāḥ | brahma santo brāhmayaḥ sādhyaścittyastā yūyameva ha || 157|| tayostu tattvayoścāhamānandaḥ parameśvaraḥ | santa ātmāna evaite cicchaktiḥ prakṛtirmama || 158|| mūlā māyā divyarādhā tadānando’hameva ca | santaḥ sarve’vatārā me cittyastadaṃganā mama || 159|| tayorānandakṛcchrīmatpuruṣottama ityaham | sat satyaṃ kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ cit cetyaṃ kāryamityapi | |3.237.160|| tayorānandadātāhaṃ sarveśaḥ parameśvaraḥ | san vyatirekarūpo’haṃ cidanvayī bhavāmi ca || 161 || tayorantaravāsaścānandī śrīkṛṣṇarūpavān | so’haṃ sarvatra saralo durlabho’pi kṛpāvaśaḥ || 1 62|| bhavāmi bhaktabhaktānīgocaraḥ sarvasṛṣṭiṣu | brahmāṇḍeṣu samasteṣu hyasaṃkhyarūpadhṛk svayam || 163|| na rūpāṇāṃ svarūpāṇāṃ kāryāṇāṃ mama sarvathā | antaḥ saṃkhyā tatheyattā vidyate ceti vā kvacit || 164|| me bhaktānāṃ gaṇanā na caritrāṇāṃ na cāpi tu | na saṃkhyāsti kathānāṃ me brahmāṇḍeṣu kadācana || 165|| amṛtāni samastāni pīyūṣāṇi ca yānyapi | yāvatyaśca sudhāḥ santi khaṇḍe’tra sarvamiṣṭatāḥ || 1 66|| na samastapremāṇi snehā ye bhaktagocarāḥ | anugrahā hareḥ sarve khaṇḍe’tra nihitā rame || 1 67|| sādhanāni samastāni hetavaścākhilā api | kāraṇāni phalayūñji tadgatārthatvamatra vai || 1 68|| yāni phalāni yatnānāṃ yāni phalāni janmanām | yāni phalāni bhakteśca tatphalitātra sarvathā || 1 69|| yannairmalyaṃ tu muktānāṃ yannairmalyaṃ tu yoginām | yannairmalyaṃ svabhaktānāṃ tadevāsya prasevinām || 3.237.170 || pāpināṃ pāpanāśe ca yathā kṛṣṇasya tīvratā | tathaiva dvāparasantānasyāpi lakṣmi tīvratā || 171 || bhaktāstaranti bhaktyā vai snigdhāḥ snehena mādhave | pāpāstaranti yogena kṛpayā sādhusevayā || 172|| duṣṭā asurā daityāstu sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇayogataḥ | atha sarve’pi te dvāparasantānasya saṃśravāt || 173 || yāśca deveṣu daityeṣu mantreṣu siddhayogiṣu | siddhayastā bhavantyasya śroturvaktuśca modituḥ || 174|| yāni mokṣavimānāni gajādyāścātivāhakāḥ | siddhadevyastathā nettryastānyāyāntyasya saṃśrayāt || 175 || satyadharmaphalaṃ sarvaṃ tretādharmaphalaṃ tathā | dvāparasthadharmaphalaṃ sarvamasya tu saṃśravāt || 176|| narā nārāyaṇatvaṃ vai nārāyaṇītvamaṃganāḥ | anubhaye veṣabhūṣāditvaṃ yantyasya saṃśravāt || 177|| hareḥ kṛpā kṛpā sādhorlakṣmyā kṛpātiniṣṭhitā | jāyate dvāparasantānakāśrayiṇi dehini || 178|| ūrdhvapuṇyāni sarvāṇi sarvordhvadhiṣṇyakānyapi | ūrdhvordhvānandasandohāḥ śrotuścāsya bhavanti hi || 179|| duṣprāpaṃ durgamaṃ duḥsthaṃ yannirāśaṃ bhavedapi | suprāpaṃ sugamaṃ susthaṃ sāśaṃ tvasya śraveṇa vai || 3.237.180 || namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya cāvatāriṇe | cidacidātmavapuṣe sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ || 181 || ityekaślokamātreṇa phalaṃ dvāparakhaṇḍajam | labheta cāvaśo dehī mriyamāṇo’pi vā kvacit || 182|| yasya vā vidyate naiva śravaṇasya kṣaṇo vane | so’pi smaraṇamātreṇa mucyate kiṃ śravāt punaḥ ||183|| ityevaṃ dvāparasantānasya māhātmyamuttamam | kathitaṃ te mayā lakṣmi sarvābhyaścāpi sarvathā || 184|| athāyayau śvetapumān caturmukhaścaturbhujaḥ | catuṣpādo nanāmāsau prasannaḥ puruṣottamam || 185|| uvācāhaṃ satyayugo mokṣārho’haṃ bhavatkṛtaḥ | kṛtasantānayogena yāsyanti mokṣaṇaṃ janāḥ || 186|| athāyayau pītapumān trikandharastribāhumān | tricaraṇo nanāmāsau hasan śrīpuruṣottamam || 187|| jagādāhaṃ yugastretā mokṣārho’haṃ bhavatkṛtaḥ | tretāsantānayogena muktiṃ yāsyanti dehinaḥ || 188|| athāyayau dvicaraṇo dvibhujo dvimukhaḥ pumān | raktavarṇaḥ pramodāḍhyo neme śrīpuruṣottamam || 189 || aṭṭahāsyena sahito jagāda dvāparo’smyaham | bhavatā dvāparasantānakena mokṣadaḥ kṛtaḥ || 3.237.1 90|| yāsyanti dehino muktiṃ mama santānakena vai | athāyayau tato lakṣmi vimanā iva durbalaḥ || 191 || aphullahṛdayaścāpi sukhānandavivarjitaḥ | kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ saśokaśca dīna iva pumān paraḥ || 1 92|| aśrūṇi sahasā muñcan cakāra daṇḍavanmuhuḥ | aśuddha iva pāpātmā vivāsito yathā janaiḥ || 193|| jñāpayan svaṃ nijagāda kalmaṣo’haṃ kaliryugaḥ | na me sthānaṃ hi deveṣu maharṣiṣu na vai tathā || 1 94|| siddheṣu satsu sādhvīṣu na me sthānaṃ kadācana | duḥkhyahaṃ cātra sṛṣṭau te bhagavan māṃ samuddhara || 195|| yathā trayāṇāṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ yogena yānti mokṣaṇam | tathā mamāpi yogena dehino yāntu mokṣaṇam || 196|| svāgataṃ me ca devādau kṛpayā te’stu mādhava | yenāhaṃ pāpavānnatra bhavadyogena puṇyavān || 197|| bhavāmīti namāmyatra svāmine śrīdayālave | ityukto’haṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kṛpāvaśo’vadam ||198|| tiṣyasantānakaṃ khaṇḍaṃ racayitvā tavāpi ca | bhrātṛtrayasamānaṃ tvāṃ kariṣye mudito bhava || 1 99|| śrutvā natvā yayurlakṣmi catvāro bhrātaro yugāḥ | ataścetaḥ parastiṣyasantānako bhaviṣyati ||3.237.200|| yaḥ śrīparabrahma bṛhatparaḥ pumān, sarvāvatāraiśca vṛhatpramuktakaiḥ | īśaiśca jīvairabhivandito hṛdi, bahiścaso’vyātpuruṣottamo’tra vaḥ ||20 1 || yo bālakṛṣṇo bhuvi kambharāsuto, gopālakṛṣṇātmajasarvavallabhaḥ | sarvātmasṛṣṭyādidhṛtāvatārakaḥ, sarvāvatārī satataṃ prarakṣatāt ||202|| pañcaviṃśatisahasrāṇi śataṃ ṣaṣṭirdvayaṃ tathā | ślokā dvāparasantāne bhavanti śvetanirmitāḥ ||203|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne dvāparasantānasya viṣayakathoddeśo dvāparasantānaviśeṣamāhātmyaṃ caturyugasantānānāṃ pratyakṣāgamaḥ kalermokṣārhatvaprārthanātiṣyasantānaprastāva āśīrvādaścetinirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 237 ||
|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyo dvāparasantānakhaṇḍaḥ samāptaḥ ||
|| oṃ śrīparapuruṣottamabhagavadarpaṇamastu ||
<4.1> śrīśvetāyanavyāsa uvāca oṃ namo yugarūpāya namastiṣyādimokṣiṇe | bālayoginīnāthāya namaste bālayogine || 1 || namo’saṃkhyacaritrāya namaścānandavārdhaye | namaste bālakṛṣṇāya bālāntarātmane namaḥ || 2 || cidacidvapuṣe’nādiśrīkṛṣṇāya namonamaḥ | badrikāpataye naranārāyaṇātmane namaḥ || 3 || sarvasaukhyavidhātre te sarvadharmādhikāriṇe | yāvallīlādivāsyāya namaste sādhurūpiṇe || 4 || sādhvīśaktisumiśrāya svarṇarekhājaṭādhṛge | ekarasasvarūpāya sarojanījuṣe namaḥ || 5 || ekadhā daśadhā sahasradhā koṭyarbudābjadhā | kāntākānto’nvitaścāste pṛthak cāpi ca te namaḥ || 6 || yo dadhāra tu rādhāyāḥ kṛte kṛṣṇaṃ nijaṃ vapuḥ | yaśca śriyaḥ kṛte nārāyaṇo nārāyaṇeśvaraḥ || 7 || yaśca ramyaṃ vāsudevaṃ vyūhaṃ dadhāra sṛṣṭaye | yaśca hiraṇmayaṃ rūpaṃ viṣṇurūpaṃ dadhāra ca || 8 || tathā tiṣyārditānāṃ tūddhārāya tāpasāṃ vapuḥ | dharmād dadhāra bhagavān naranārāyaṇātmakam || 9 || sarvathā karuṇāpūrṇaṃ sādhuśīlasamanvitam | muktarṣisevitaṃ śāntaṃ taṃ namāmi pareśvaram || 4.1.1 0|| naranārāyaṇaṃ rūpaṃ vīkṣya kāntasya cakriṇaḥ | yā māṇikyā cākṣaraśrīstāpasī śīlayoginī || 11 || yā divyā divyaśaktiśca brahmacaryaparāyaṇā | manāk sparśaṃ na sahate yānyasya śrīhariṃ vinā || 1 2|| sā kāntaṃ tāpasaṃ saṃsevituṃ badarikābhavat | badrīśvarī māṇikī suprajñā pārvatikātmikā ||13|| rādhāramādisaṃpūjyā rājate nandasaccitiḥ | tryātmikāpyekarūpāsti chatrarūpā hareḥ sadā || 14|| yasyāḥ patreṣu devyaśca muktānikā vasantyapi | yasyā muktā badareṣu vasanti madhurātmakāḥ || 12|| akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ sākāraṃ badarīti tat | tejomayaṃ dhāmarūpaṃ tat drumātmakamatra vai || 16|| sevākṣarakṛtā mūrtimatī yāvāhanaṃ hareḥ | brahmacaryaṃ hareratra nararūpaṃ virājate || 17|| ṛṣayo bhagavatkeśāḥ sarve tapanti yatra ca | anyāścātra badaryo vai hareḥ śaktaya eva tāḥ || 18|| gaṃgā cidbuddhirūpātra vartate nrāyaṇāṃganā | ānandaiśvaryarūpāśca bhūmayo badarīvane || 19|| satsvarūpiṇya upalā dhavalā dāvanāśikāḥ | parṇakuṭyo’tra dhāmāni sabhā brahmavratātmikā ||4.1.20|| samādhirdhāraṇā dhyānaṃ vitāneṣu vasanti hi | rājate munibhāleṣu munibhāleṣu tūrdhvasrotastvamuttamam ||21 || jitendriyatvaṃ cihneṣu dhātusrāvaviyogiṣu | jitātmatvaṃ hṛdayeṣu rājate badrikāśrame ||22|| yatra nāsti kalervāsaḥ satyaṃ vasati sarvadā | satyadharmā satyasanto vidyante kṛtadharmiṇaḥ ||23|| yāvatsthāsyati bhūdevī yāvaddhimagiristathā | tāvacchrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sthāsyati tāpasaḥ ||24|| naranārāyaṇanāmnā badrīśvaraparaprabhuḥ | tāvat kṛtasya dharmā vai sthāsyanti badarīvane ||25|| dhanyo’yaṃ mānavo loko yadarthaṃ puruṣottamaḥ | kuṃkumavāpikānātho naranārāyaṇātmanā ||26|| badarīnātha evāyaṃ bhūtvā śaśvadvirājate | māṇikyāyāśvinī divyā vāhā ceyaṃ drurūpiṇī ||27|| badrī bhūtvā brāhmatanvī tena sākaṃ virājate | nārāyaṇī hi sā lakṣmīrbālakṛṣṇaṃ niṣevate ||28|| yairjanaiḥ samanudhyātā vanditā viditā tathā | yābhiśca kṛtasevā tāḥ kṛṣṇayogaṃ prayacchati ||29|| te narā yoṣitaḥ sarve māṇikyānugrahād bhuvi | saguṇā api jāyante nirguṇā mokṣabhāginaḥ ||4.1.3 0|| aho bhāgyaṃ bhuvanānāṃ yanmadhye badarīvanam | aho bhāgyaṃ mānavānāṃ ye vasanti vanābhitaḥ || 31 || badaryāḥ śītalā vātā yān spṛśanti janāspadān | te deśāḥ pāvanāḥ puṇyā jāyante badarīsamāḥ ||32|| dhanyeyaṃ badarīdevī pārijātāvahāsinī | pārijātastu vai varṣamuvāsa kṛṣṇamandire ||33|| iyaṃ tu badarīdevī hyākalpaṃ chatravaddhareḥ | rājate nityayogena muktānī śīlayoginī ||34|| kalpadrumo’pi yasyāgre notkṛṣṭatvaṃ prasevate | sakāmaḥ sa hi seyaṃ tu niṣkāmā śrīnarāyaṇī ||35|| tulasī bhāgyaśīlāpi vane vane vinā harim | sākṣāt patimṛte tvāste tato na badarīsamā ||36|| badrikeyaṃ tu bhagavadgṛhiṇī gṛharūpiṇī | yannāmnā śrīnārāyaṇālayaḥ prasiddhyati ||37|| vṛndāṃ tyaktvā yayau vṛndāvane kṛṣṇastu paścimām | dvārikāṃ tena sā vṛndā vṛkṣarūpā viyoginī ||38|| naināṃ badarīṃ bhagavām̐styajatyeva kvacit prabhuḥ | vṛndāyāṃ ca tulasyāṃ ca nirodho rājaso mataḥ ||39|| badaryāṃ brahmasattvaṃ vai sadā sāttvikatāṃ gatam | ketakī ca tapaḥ kṛtvā yayāvambaramūrdhvagam ||4.1.40 || sā tu kāpaṭyadoṣeṇa prakṣiptādhojagāma ha | mithyāsākṣyaṃ vedhasaśca kṛtvā hyapūjyatāṃ gatā ||41|| badarīyaṃ mahāmuktānikā cājñākarī hareḥ | mahāmāṇikyavarṇā sā muktānikā ca dāsikā |||42||| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya virahāsahā | naranārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ tāpasaṃ cānutāpasī ||43|| bhūtvā nārāyaṇīdevī bālakṛṣṇamanusṛtā | sadā bālasvabhāvā vai badarī bālayoginī ||44|| sarvaśreṣṭhā vidyate’tra nityakṛṣṇasuyoginī | kāmadughāḥ samastā vai gatvā śrībadarīvanam ||45|| natvā nārāyaṇīṃ badrīṃ chāyāyāṃ tāḥ samāsate | nārāyaṇaṃ payaḥ pāyayitvā yāntyanu taddivam ||46|| tā manvate dhanyabhāgyaṃ badaryāḥ kṛṣṇayojitam | kalpalatāḥ svargavallyaḥ śocante virahaṃ hareḥ ||47|| praśaṃsanti mahadbhāgyaṃ badaryā nityayojitam | phalāmṛtaṃ kvacit prāpya devā gaṃgāplavārthinaḥ ||48|| pramodante phalarase tiraskurvanti cāmṛtam | amṛtasya sadā pāne tṛptā devā bhavanti na ||49|| badarīphalamāsādya varṣaṃ tṛptā maharṣayaḥ | bodhivṛkṣo vane tyakto nārāyaṇena sādhunā |4.1.50|| so’pi nābhyudayaṃ dhatte dhatte badrī tu yādṛśam | yaṣṭikā śrīvāmanasya kṛtakārye layaṃ gatā ||51 || vinā sevāṃ vartate sā brahmaloke viyoginī | badarīyaṃ bhāgyavatī mahatī yaṣṭikāditaḥ ||52|| yajñanārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samidhārthaṃ drumān śubhān | vyaracayattathā yajñe juhāva tān purā svayam ||53|| tathāpi te na badarīsamā bhāgyayujo yataḥ | yajñānte te vane tyaktā nārāyaṇena yajñinā ||54|| badarīyaṃ sadā nārāyaṇena śirasi kṛtā | dhanyā tvaṃ māṇikīdevi dhanyā tvaṃ badarīśvari ||55|| yā tvaṃ kṛṣṇena na tyaktā cānte satyādikā yathā | dhanyā vai koṭiśo nāryaḥ kṛṣṇayogamupāgatāḥ ||56|| śaśvaddhanyā yathā tvaṃ vai tathā tā na kadācana | sarvālayaṃ gatāḥ paścād rājase tvaṃ tu badrike ||57|| tvanmūlāt khalu tīrthāni nadyo bhavanti badrike | tvaṃ lakṣmīstvaṃ ramā śrīśca kamalā tvaṃ haripriyā ||58|| tvaṃ nārāyaṇavāsena nārāyaṇī narāyaṇī | rādhā virajā hariṇī sarasvatī tvadāśrayāḥ ||59|| sarvāstvāṃ vīkṣituṃ yānti nityaṃ nārāyaṇājñayā | gaṃgā tvatpādamāplāvya tato yāti sthalāntaram ||4.1.60|| narmadā saptakalpā vai godā tu daśakalpikā | sarvakalpā badarīti nārāyaṇena nirmitā ||61 || yāvaccheṣaḥ kṣīranidhau ramā śvetanivāsinī | lakṣmīryāvacca vaikuṇṭhe tāvad badrī hi śāśvatī ||62|| yāvatīnāṃ drujātīnāṃ pādapānāṃ ca mūlinām | pāvanī badarīdevī nārāyaṇī pareśvarī ||63|| plakṣadvīpe plakṣadevālaye plakṣamahotsave | dvīpāntarebhyaścodbhijjā jātayaḥ samupāyayuḥ ||64|| kalpodbhijjāstu vai svargāt puṇyodbhijjāstu satyataḥ | śrāddhodbhijjā janādibhyo bhūmestu daivipādapāḥ ||65|| caityavṛkṣāḥ samidvṛkṣā aṃkurā darbhajātayaḥ | rasiṇaḥ śākinaścāpi phalinaḥ puṣpiṇastathā ||66|| dvīpanāmakarā jambuprabhṛtayaśca cāyayuḥ | oṣadhayo viṣahantryo jīvadāścāyayustathā ||67|| garbhiṇyaḥ prasaviṇyaśca vaṃśinyaśca samāyayuḥ | sandhinyo brahmacāriṇyo yugalāśca samāyayuḥ ||68|| plakṣapūjottaraṃ koṭyoṣadhīnāṃ maṇḍape tadā | kalpadrumo jagādaitān pādapān daivasaṃjñakān ||69|| plakṣotsavo’yaṃ sampannaḥ puṇyakṛt sarvaśākhinām | jijñāsaikā vartate me prakāśayāmi vaḥ puraḥ ||4.1.70|| vayaṃ tu pādapāḥ sarve karāgraphalaśālinaḥ | bhuñjante’nye naḥ phalāni vayaṃ tu tāpasāḥ sadā ||71|| pṛthivīgarbhabhoktāro devārpaṇavivarjitāḥ | pāpabhujastataḥ syāmo vṛtrahatyāghayoginaḥ ||72|| kledyakhādyaprabhoktāraḥ pūjādharmādivarjitāḥ | tīrthakāryavidhurāśca tāmasā jñānavarjitāḥ ||73|| kathaṃ duritanāśo naḥ saṃbhaved baddhaśākhinām | plakṣadrumo mahān vipra uddhāraṃ naḥ pravakṣyati ||74|| ityevaṃ tathyajijñāsāṃ śrutvā plakṣeśvaro drumaḥ | vicārya bahudhā sarvapādapānāṃ viśuddhaye ||75|| sāmarthyaṃ paramaṃ yatra vartate śrīhareḥ samam | avyāhataṃ śāśvataṃ ca manāk hrāsavivarjitam ||76|| taṃ śaraṇyaṃ mokṣadaṃ ca pāpaghnaṃ śāntidaṃ tathā | māyāśāntikaraṃ nārāyaṇamūrtyātmakaṃ drumam ||77|| satsabhāsaṃgataṃ nityaṃ badarīdrumamāha tān | śṛṇvantu śākhinaḥ sarve sarvapāpavināśakam ||78|| kṛṣṇatulyaṃ mokṣadaṃ ca naranārāyaṇāśrame | badarīvanamadhye vai tvāste yā bālayoginī ||79|| bālabadarīdevī yā māṇikyā pārameśvarī | badrīśvarī śīlaguptā sadaiva brahmacāriṇī ||4.1.80|| mahāmuktānikā koṭimuktamaṇḍaladhāriṇī | sā badrikā pādapānāṃ jātyuddhārakarī śubhā ||81|| darśanāt sparśanānnāmnā namaskārād vicintanāt | āśrayādyogataścāpi vartate pāpanāśinī ||82|| yāni vai vṛkṣajātīnāṃ pāpāni sahajāni ca | āgantukāni cānyāni sā badrī nāśayiṣyati ||83|| yatra nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣād brahmacaryārthatāpasaḥ | yadarthaṃ sā badrikāpi brahmaśīlā ca tāpasī ||84|| sarvapāpaharā divyā sarvakalmaṣanāśinī | vartate sarvasāmarthyānvitordhvā pārameśvarī ||85|| tatra pāpavināśārthaṃ gantavyaṃ tu yathāyatham | śākhibhiḥ pādapaiḥ sarvairyātrārthaṃ prativatsaram ||86|| nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ ca yoginastathā | phalapuṣparasādyaiśca sampūjya badarīṃ namet ||87|| spṛśed badarīṃ divyāṃ tāṃ vasettacchāyike sthale | milecca vakṣasā badrīṃ makarandaṃ grasettathā ||88|| tadvāyuṃ cāpi gṛhṇīyāt pradakṣiṇaṃ carettathā | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ samarpayet kṣamāṃ stutim ||89|| prakuryāt parameśi tvaṃ pāpajālaṃ vināśaya | vṛkṣayonermahākaṣṭānmocayāsmān pramokṣaya ||4.1.90|| evaṃ samprārthya tāṃ devīṃ natvā svaṃ svaṃ vanaṃ vrajet | saṃsmared badarīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||91 || vṛkṣāṇāṃ mokṣadā devī badrikā tvekajanmani | evaṃ yātrākṛto vṛkṣā yāsyanti paramāṃ gatim ||92|| tato vṛkṣairarthitā vai yātrārthaṃ calatā nijā | śvetadvīpe hareragre haristānāha sarvadā ||93|| sthirā bhavanto vṛkṣā vai tathāpi mokṣalabdhaye | sūkṣmadehena gantāro yātrārthino bhaviṣyatha ||94|| pādasyaikasya sūkṣmasya bhūgarbhe vastu lagnatā | bhaviṣyati tu yāvadvai tāvajjīvanamastu vaḥ ||95|| sūkṣme dehe gate cāpi badaryāṃ yātrayā punaḥ | svadehe sthūlasaṃjñe tvāgatya vāsaṃ vidhāsyatha ||96|| badarīyātrikāḥ sarve pādapā dhāmamokṣaṇam | prayāsyatho vadāmyeṣaḥ śvetanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||97|| evaṃ prāpya hareranugrahaṃ te pādapāstataḥ | badarīyātriṇo bhūtvā pūjayitvā narāyaṇīm ||98|| prajvālya nijapāpāni badrīpratāpato drumāḥ | yayurvai mokṣaṇaṃ tvekajanmanā yānti vai tathā ||99|| yāsyantyeva padaṃ divyaṃ badarīśīprasevanāt | badarīnāthayogena plakṣoktā mokṣadāyinī || 4.1.10 0|| sarvamokṣakarī divyā sākṣānnārāyaṇāśrayāt | jayate badarīdevī māṇikyā bālayoginī || 101 || sā papraccha kathā divyāstiṣye’pi mokṣakāriṇīḥ | naranārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ badaryāśrama uttame || 1 02|| yā yā badryāḥ kathāḥ pṛṣṭā naranārāyaṇaṃ prati | uttaritā naranārāyaṇena svāminā ca yāḥ || 1 03|| tāstādivyāstiṣyakhaṇḍe vidyante mokṣadāyikāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīvallabhāśritāḥ || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śrīnaranārāyaṇasya śrīmāṇikyātmakabadaryāḥ svarūpavartanaṃ māhātmyakathanaṃ kathāprastāvaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā prathamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||
<4.2> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīrame devi tava bhaktakathānakam | yathā tvaṃ bradarībhāvaṃ prāptā bhaktivaśānugā || 1 || badaro nāma rājarṣirhimabhūmau purābhavat | mahābhāgavato bhakto vaiṣṇavottama ūrdhvagaḥ || 2 || pṛthivyardhaṃ śaśāsāsau divyasāmarthyasādhanaiḥ | vimānānyabhavan yasya pāre lakṣaṃ sukhāni ca || 3 || sauvarṇāni kalpavṛkṣodyānopaśobhitāni hi | divyakanyānivāsāni smṛddhānyuccāvacāni ca || 4 || ekaikaṃ sūryavadbhāti candravattejasāṃ cayaiḥ | yatprabhābhirniśā pṛthvyāṃ līneva vartate tadā || 5 || bhrāntirnakṣatratārāṇāṃ jāyate’lpe vimānake | candrajyotsnā tu militā tadā dugdhāyate’mbare || 6 || indradhanuḥprakāśāścotprasaranti ghaneṣvapi | vimānānāṃ kiraṇānāṃ badarasya mahātmanaḥ || 7 || ekaṃ satyābhidhaṃ divyaṃ vimānaṃ satyasaṃcaram | brahmasabhāyāṃ nṛpatistena yāti hi yogirāṭ || 8 || dvitīyaṃ cāryamasaṃjñaṃ pitalokādisañcaram | tṛtīyaṃ tridivaṃ nāma caindrapadaṃ caturthakam || 9 || pañcamaṃ bhāskaraṃ nāma ṣaṣṭhaṃ kaumudakaṃ tathā | saptamaṃ dhruvasaṃjñaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ kailāsanāmakam || 4.2.1 0|| dharmasaṃjñaṃ navamaṃ ca merusaṃjñaṃ tato’dhikam | śvetavāhaṃ kṣīravāhaṃ talākhyānyaparāṇi ca || 11 || lokālokābhidhaṃ cāpi manojavāni tāni vai | yathābhidhānaguṇakānyatidigantagāni ca || 12|| sarvabhogyarddhipūrṇāni yathā dhiṣṇyāni tāni ha | teṣu sarveṣu ratnānāṃ suvarṇānāṃ ca mūrtayaḥ || 13 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya pratimāḥ śubhāḥ | śrīmāṇikyāmahālakṣmīyutā yugalavigrahāḥ || 14|| gajāsane sthāpitāḥ pūjitāḥ śrībadareṇa ha | sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyāḥ sarvagandharasārpitāḥ || 15|| devadūtāḥ pārṣadāśca bhūsurāḥ sādhavo’malāḥ | vaimānikāḥ pravidyante teṣu bhāgavatottamāḥ || 16|| mahābhāgavatīsatyaḥ sādhvyaḥ śīlaparāyaṇāḥ | candrānandāścandrakāntyānanāḥ svarṇaprabhānvitāḥ || 17|| mahābhaktānikāsteṣu vidyante badarasya ha | kīrtanaṃ satataṃ teṣu jāyate badarīśvari || 18|| yatprasaṃgena devādyā yānti brahma sanātanam | naitādṛśo’bhavad bhakto yena jagat prapūritam || 19|| harikīrtanabhaktyāḍhyamahāghoṣaiḥ samastakam | sthale sthale’sya nṛpaterjayaghoṣaḥ pravartate ||4.2.20|| badarasya vimānāni yaddiśaṃ yanti taddiśi | namanti devamunayo bhaktyā nṛtyanti tatstriyaḥ ||21|| pūjayanti vimāne śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇacchavim | nīrājayanti muditā datvopadāḥ prayānti ca ||22|| badarasya mahārājye grāme kheṭe purādiṣu | nagare pattane rājadhānyāṃ ghoṣe’pi sarvathā ||23|| sādhavo yatayaḥ sādhvyaḥ pūjyante’nnāmbarādibhiḥ | viprā dakṣiṇayā cāpi nirāśrayāḥ śubhāśrayaiḥ ||24|| anāthādyā yathāpekṣairnāryaḥ sveṣṭasamarpaṇaiḥ | grāme grāme brahmayajñā jāyante badarasya vai ||25|| annasatrāṇi bhūbhāge badarasya tu padmakam | prapādānāni sarvatra cāsan kalpalatāstathā || 26|| yātrālavo latāmāpya bhuṃjate bhikṣayā phalam | tṛptidaṃ ca rasaṃ miṣṭaṃ pibanti ca bhajanti mām ||27|| vaiṣṇavānāṃ maṇḍalāni hyāsan vai pratikharvaṭam | prātarmadhyāhnake sāyaṃ kīrtayanti bhajanti mām ||28|| devakathākarā bhūmāvāgatya ca kathāṃ mama | vācayitvā saṃhitāṃ ca bodhayanti bhajanti mām ||29|| utsavā uttamāḥ śreṣṭhā jāyante ca prajāsu vai | ūrjāsitāṣṭamīprabhṛtyahassu dvādaśīṣvapi ||4.2.3 0|| jayantīṣu samastāsu satsaṃgāḥ saṃbhavanti ca | vratotsavānāṃ sammānaṃ pālanaṃ pūjanādikam ||3 1 || udyāpanaṃ cādaraśca jāyante’sya prajāsvapi | nityaṃ gavāṃ tu bahvīnāṃ dānaṃ nṛpasya jāyate ||32||| śeṣo navaḥ kutaḥ svarṇamayo yena tu bhūbhujā | pratiṣṭhāpya ca taṃ śeṣaṃ nāgaṃ nītvā vimānake ||33|| yayau pātālake prāha pūrvaśeṣaṃ nivartaya | mama śeṣo baliṣṭho’yaṃ dhārayiṣyati ke bhuvam || 34|| mūlaśeṣaḥ parīkṣārthaṃ mumocādho hi golakam | sahasā svarṇanāgastaṃ bhūgolaṃ ke nyadhād drutam ||35|| mūlaśeṣasya mānaṃ vai nirmūlaṃ saṃvyajāyata | garvo naṣṭo’tha neme taṃ badaraṃ svarṇaśeṣiṇam ||36|| prārthayāmāsa mānārthaṃ dhāraṇaṃ nijamastake | anyathā bhūbhṛtā cāvamānitasya yaśolayaḥ ||37||| apratiṣṭhā bhavelloke yayāce golakaṃ punaḥ | dhartuṃ nijaphaṇāyāṃ vai tadā tu badaro dadau ||38|| pūrvaśeṣāya pṛthivīṃ svarṇaśeṣaṃ nijālayam | ānināya tataḥ svarṇaśeṣo vijñānavān yatiḥ ||39|| patañjalirmahāyogī vidyādharo vyajāyata | sarvayogakalābhiśca jagaduddhāramācarat ||4.2.40|| evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya badarasya gṛhe gṛhe | kṛṣṇadhūnyo’bhavan badri bhaktiścāsīd gṛhe gṛhe ||41 || śrīmāṇikyā sevitasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai | mama mūlasvarūpasyāśritaṃ sarvaṃ jagaddhyabhūt ||42|| śṛṇu badrīprabhe devi tadā rājyaṃ tu ṛddhimat | svargottaraṃ bhūtalaṃ tu vīkṣyānyabhvardhapālakāḥ ||43 || paspardhurbadaraṃ bhaktaṃ rājānaṃ smṛddhilālasāḥ | bahavo badaraṃ prāpyāyudhyan parājayaṃ hyaguḥ ||44|| bhakto bhaktyā hi jīyeta nānyayuddhaiḥ kadācana | yadgṛhe bhagavān sākṣād vasati durjayaḥ kutaḥ ||45|| rājñaḥ śarairhi bahavo hatā bhūpā virodhinaḥ | sarve te nihatā vārdhau himavārdhisamāhvaye ||46|| kiṃpuruṣapradeśānāṃ dakṣiṇe madhyasaṃsthite | dvisāhasrayojanātmavistṛte miṣṭavāriṇi ||47|| mānasākhyaḥ samudro’yaṃ miṣṭodo hyabhavattadā | sadā śītalajaladhiḥ sarvaratnasamanvitaḥ ||48|| yatrāste sāmprataṃ badri himālayo’drirāḍiha | śṛṇu badrīprabhe devi jetuṃ tu badaraṃ nṛpam ||49|| āyayau tvekadā vyomnā hemānalo’suro mahān | aparaṃ yat pṛthivyardhaṃ tasmādarbudasainyavān ||4.2.50|| vyomamārgeṇa sahasāyutairvimānakai saha | khaṇḍe kiṃpuruṣe yuddhaṃ badareṇa samācarat ||51|| badarasya vimānāni sasainyāni tadāmbare | abhipetuścāsurāṇāṃ sainyeṣu divyaśaktayaḥ ||52|| sahasraśo vimānāni naṣṭānyāsurakāṇi vai | sainyāni miṣṭajaladhau bhūtvā yādāṃsi cāviśan ||53|| hemānalo’suravaryo yuyudhe badareṇa ha | mithaḥ sainyāni yuyudhuḥ prāṇāntaniścayāni vai ||54|| divyāstravarṣaṇairdivyaśarairdivyaiśca hetibhiḥ | vidyutpravāhaṇaiścāpi pāśairvāruṇajaistathā ||55|| vajraiśca vividhairdaṇḍaiḥ kālacakrairviśālakaiḥ | mantraistantrairmahāyantrairmāyikairaindrajālikaiḥ ||56|| vāyvagnināgagavayairgarutmataiśca vṛścikaiḥ | parvataiścāpi vṛkṣaiśca yuyudhire tu kṛtrimaiḥ |57| himaśailaiśca vividhairgrahagolairanuttamaiḥ | gadābhiścāṇḍabhettrībhirjaghnuranyonyamudruṣaḥ ||58|| āsurāṇāṃ hi sainyāni mārayitvā muhurmuhuḥ | miṣṭābdhau te praviśanti svasthāstatra bhavanti ca ||59|| punarbalaṃ nīrugṇatvaṃ prāpya cāyānti saṃgare | badareṇa hatāste ca punarviśanti sāgare ||4.2.60|| athāyaṃ badaro rājā bhaktarāḍ vīkṣya jīvitān | samudrasthānāsurām̐śca cintayāmāsa cāntare ||61|| kathameṣāṃ samudre vai vināśaṃ pratipādaye | punarnaiva yathā svasthā nirgaccheyurbahiryudhi ||62|| jalaṃ sarvaṃ tvabdhirūpaṃ himaśailātmakaṃ bhavet | antaḥsthitā āsurāste syurmṛtāśca śilātmakāḥ ||63|| sañcintyaivaṃ badaro’yaṃ sasmāra candradevatām | tūrṇaṃ copasthitā tatra devakāryasahāyinī ||64|| āsurāṇāṃ suraghnānāṃ vināśārthaṃ matiṃ dadhe | āgatya sahasovāca badarāya mahātmane ||65|| vada rājan tava kāryaṃ surakāryaṃ tathā sukham | tūrṇaṃ karomi sādhyaṃ te duḥsādhyamapi sarvathā ||66|| badaraḥ śaśinaḥ pūjāṃ svāgataṃ vandanaṃ stutim | cakārāsanavaryaṃ ca dadau neme punaḥ punaḥ ||67|| kṛpālo śāntikṛt svargasudhākara mahāprabho | bhaktānugrahadhātastvaṃ jayase cāmṛtaprada ||68|| jīvanaṃ sarvalokānāṃ kalāsu tava tiṣṭhati | mādhuryaṃ cauṣadhīnāṃ ca tava yogātpravartate ||69|| vṛddhiḥ puṣṭistava yogājjāyate dāharodhanam | tvadādhārāścauṣadhayastadādhārāśca dehinaḥ ||4.2.70|| candra kaumudikānātha niśeśa priyasaṃgakṛt | śaśin nakṣatranātha tvaṃ jayase vai tamonuda ||71 || mṛgāṃka dugdhavarṇa tva himāṃśo jayase sadā | śītalābdhe sudhāmūrte bhaktakāryaṃ dadhātviha ||72|| asurā muhurāgatya samardayanti mānavān | devān pitṝnmunīn bhaktān kleśayanti muhurmuhuḥ ||73|| madbāṇairarditāścaite praviṣṭā himasāgare | te yathā syurmarditā vai himapāṣāṇaparvataiḥ ||74|| punarna te bahistvatrāyayustathā vidhehi yat | tvamoṣadhirhi lokānāṃ cāsurāṇāṃ nibarhaṇam ||75|| śītaṃ śastraṃ mato’syeva śīghraṃ tadoṣadhaṃ kuru | ityevamarthito rātrināthaḥ śrībadarīprabhe ||76|| dadau kaṇṭhāt samuttārya candrakāntamaṇiṃ śubham | badarāya svabhaktāya devakāryakarāya ca ||77|| prāha maṇiṃ nṛpa cātra śītābdhau sanniveśaya | śītābdhiḥ sahasā śītaśilātmako mahān giriḥ ||78|| atraiva śītalabhūmirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | tvaṃ vimāne vasa rājannambare na tu bhūtale ||79|| śītenābhibhavaṃ naiva vrajethāstattathā kuru | eṣo’haṃ saṃprayāmyeva śīghraṃ maṇiṃ jale kṣipa ||4.2.80|| evamuktastu badaro drutaṃ vimānamambare | kṛtvā candramasaṃ natvā cikṣepa maṇimabdhiṣu ||81|| tāvajjalāni sarvāṇi śītāgnipīḍitāni vai | piṇḍitānyabhavam̐statra śītābdhau śītalopalāḥ ||82|| śītābdhiḥ śītabhūbhāvaṃ himabhūtalatāṃ gataḥ | jalānyūrdhvaṃ coṣmaṇā cotkṣipyante paritastadā ||83|| śikharāṇi śvetahaimaśilātmakāni tāni ca | sañjātānyeva sahasā cāmbaraṃ śītatāṃ gatam ||84|| himānāṃ karakāvarṣāḥ sahasā peturambarāt | tābhiśca vardhamānāni śṛṃgāṇi pārvatāni vai ||85|| mahaḥsparśāni jātāni vardhamānāni tāni vai | evaṃ sa parvato jāto’yugasāhasrayojanaḥ ||86|| candrakāntena sampanno himavaddhimavarṣaṇaḥ | himāṃśumaṇinā bhūmau himādrirbadarīprabhe ||87|| āsurā yuddhakartāro jalopalāsu tattale | marditāśca niruddhāścopalābhāvaṃ gatā mṛtāḥ ||88|| upadravāḥ praśāntāśca mahataḥ parivartanāt | atha lokāśca ṛṣayo munayo devatāstathā ||89|| śrutvā himālayaṃ bhūmiṃ vīkṣituṃ tvāyayurmudā | rākṣasā asurā daityā dānavā mānavāḥ khagāḥ ||4.2.90|| pitaro lokapālāśca siddhāścāraṇanartakāḥ | gāndharvāḥ kinnarāḥ sūtā māgadhā bandinastathā ||91|| vidyādharā apsarasaḥ sādhyaḥ śaṃkarayoginaḥ | gaṇāśca gaṇadevyaśca mātaro vasavastathā ||92|| merusthāḥ paralokasthā divyadehāḥ samāyayuḥ | mumudurbahudhā haimaṃ śītaṃ cāndraṃ vilokyate ||93|| vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ bhūpatiṃ badaraṃ tathā | praśaśaṃsuśca te sarve dikpālā mānamādadhuḥ ||94|| brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca prasannāstvabhavan bahu | badarasyābhavad rājyaṃ sarvaṃ himālayātmakam ||55|| navaṃ tvaraṇyakaṃ tasya parito nābhavattadā | devādyā vāsayogyaṃ taṃ merutulyaṃ tu bhūbhṛtam ||96|| vīkṣya spṛhāṃ pracakruścārthayāmāsurnṛpaṃ muhuḥ | rājā vāsaṃ dadau devakoṭibhyastu himālaye ||97|| devajātayaḥ sarve ye te vāsān svakulocitān | cakruḥ śṛṃgeṣu haimeṣu devālayo babhūva saḥ ||98|| svargaṃ vai cāparaṃ bhūmau himālayo babhūva ha | kalpadrumāḥ kalpalatāstathā kalpatṛṇānyapi ||99|| himālaye’bhito devaiḥ ropitāni vanāni ca | bhūsandhau paritaḥ śatayojanānāṃ tu vartule || 4.2.1 00|| divyauṣadhīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ vanāni ropitāni vai | udyānāni vicitrāṇi phalapatrarasādibhiḥ || 1 01|| smṛddhāni svargalokād vai svasvalokāttathāparaiḥ | āhṛtyāhṛtya parito nihitāni śubhāni ca || 1 02|| saptarṣayo nyavasam̐śca śaṃkaro’pyavasattataḥ | brahmā viṣṇustathā devyo nyavasan cāpsarogaṇāḥ || 1 03|| gāndharvāścāraṇāḥ kiṃpumāṃsaśca kinnarāḥ surāḥ | anye’pi bahavo devā nyavasan vai himālaye || 1 04|| evaṃ himagirirjāto bhūmau candragirirmahān | bhūtalaṃ svargamiśraṃ ca jātaṃ divyāṃśaśobhitam || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne mahābhāgavatasya badarākhyarājarṣerākhyāna, hemānalāsurayuddhaṃ, badarabhayena bhūmadhyaśītavārdhau tvasurāṇāṃ praveśanaṃ, badarastutyā candrapradattacandrakāntamaṇeḥ śītavārdhau nikṣepeṇa śītopalātmakamahāhimādrirūpaparivartanaṃ, caturdaśalokavāsināṃ divyahimādrau nivāsākāṃkṣayā badarapradattavasatayaḥ svargīyauṣadhīnāṃ devādyairopitāni vanodyānāraṇyāni cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvitīyo’dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||
<4.3> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīrame pārvatike yajjātamulbaṇam | vidrāvakaṃ hi devānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ ca yathā punaḥ || 1 || susthireṣu tu deveṣu viśvaste tu himācale | yatra hemānalo haimaśilātale’rdito’bhavat || 2 || śikharaṃ tat sahasaivāmbare mūlāt parāpatat | bhūkampaścāpi śṛṃgeṣu cānyeṣu saṃvyajāyata || 3 || śabdo bhayaṃkaraścāpi pralayāgnerivābhavat | muhurbhūdhūnanaṃ jātaṃ śilāvarṣā bhuvo’bhavat || 4 || samutpatanti talataścopalā haimabhāsurāḥ | hemānalena talato noditāḥ kṣepitāstathā || 5 || hime śilātalāddhemāsuro balāt punastadā | uttasthau yogabalato mahāścaryamidaṃ hyabhūt || 6 || devā bhayaṃgatāścānye brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ | surādyā dehinaḥ sarve vīkṣyopadravamulbaṇam || 7 || sasmaruḥ śrībhagavantaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaṃ prabhum | tathā badaraṃ rājānaṃ mahābhāgavataṃ tadā || 8 || hemānalo’pi gadayā yoddhuṃ tadāmbare’bhavat | parvataprāyadehaḥ sa himopaleva bhāsuraḥ || 9 || yaṃ yaṃ devaṃ girau tatra vyalokayad vyapothayat | hāhākāro mahān jātastāvad vimānakaḥ prabhuḥ || 4.3.1 0|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrībadarīśvaraḥ| vimānenāgamattatra yatra hemānalo’suraḥ || 1 1|| vīkṣya divyavimānaṃ tad yoddhumupādravaddharim | bhagavān gadayā tūrṇaṃ sannaddhaśca tadābhavat || 12|| śriyaṃ ramāmavasthāpya vimāne bahirāyayau | badaro’pi mahārājastūrṇaṃ tatrāpyupāyayau || 13||| vīkṣya hemānalaṃ mahāsuraṃ cojjīvitaṃ punaḥ | mahāścaryaṃ prāpa rājā tenāyuddhyad gadākaraḥ || 14|| kṛṣṇena badareṇāpi tāḍito gadayāsuraḥ | jātaklamo’bhavad bhagnakaṭiḥ papāta bhūtale || 15|| badarastaṃ samuttolya jīvantaṃ tatra gartake | yatrābhavat sa tatraiva cikṣepa himagartake || 16|| himaśailaṃ punastatra sthāpayāmāsa mādhavaḥ | badaraśca tadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ prabhum || 17|| prārthayāmāsa bahudhā hyanutthāya vai punaḥ | bhagavānāha vai rājan śṛṇu haimānalīkathām || 18|| tapastepe purākalpe prasādāya sa cakriṇaḥ | haste kṛtvā harergṛti varṣasahasrakaṃ tadā || 19 || tato varṣasahasraṃ vai tvekapādena cotthitaḥ | tato varṣasahasraṃ vai vaṭaśākhāvalambitaḥ ||4.3.20|| adhomukhastapastepe haste paśyan hariṃ hi mām | tato varṣasahasraṃ sa prajvālyānalamūrdhani ||21|| lambamāno hi śākhāyāṃ tapastepe’tidāruṇam | anāhārastato vāyvāhāro varṣasahasrakam ||22| vaṭaśākhājaṭāmadhye protadeho’bhavaddhi saḥ | śuṣkamāṃsāsthikuṇapaḥ śākhājaṭāntare’bhavat ||23|| jaṭārūpo’bhavattatra pipīlikādhirodhitaḥ | mṛttikāvalmikairācchāditaśchannataro’bhavat ||24|| hastatale mama mūrti cātyajan valmiko’bhavat | daśavarṣasahasrānte cāhaṃ prasannatāṃ gataḥ ||25 || tasya kare sthitaścāhaṃ caitanyarasamādadan | vaṭadugdhaṃ dadam̐ścāpyāplāvayaṃ tasya varṣma tat ||26|| varṣāvegena ca dhūlīḥ sarvā dhūtābhavattataḥ | adhomukhaḥ prāptaraso’suro hemānalo’bhavat ||27|| śanaiḥ samprāptacaitanyaśconnidra iva cakṣuṣā | uddhāṭitena parito vyalokayattadā puraḥ || 28|| adarśayaṃ mama rūpaṃ caturbhujaṃ śriyānvitam | asuraḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā neme māṃ sa jaṭāntare || 29|| prāptamadviṣayajñānaḥ prasannamānaso’bhavat | jijñāsamāna iva tu vihvalo’bhūttu māṃ prati ||4.3.30|| mayā sambodhitaścāyaṃ varadānāya vai tathā | tapaḥsamāpanārthaṃ ca tadā vavre sa vihvalaḥ || 3 1|| yadi tvaṃ varadānāya kṛṣṇa pravartase tviha | yadi satyavratatvaṃ vai yadi yogyo’smi pātrakam || 32|| tadāhaṃ te śriyāḥ pādau vīkṣya mohaṃ gato’smyataḥ | śriyāḥ pādau komalau bhāsurau sarvaśubhāśrayau || 33|| suspṛśyau darśanīyau ca dehi me cāvyayau yathā | mama dehaṃ spṛśamānau bhavetāṃ caraṇau śriyāḥ ||34|| rājyaṃ tathā paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dehi vaibhavasaṃbhṛtam | sāmarthyaṃ ca tathā dehi bhūtaiḥ parābhavo na me ||315|| śriyo’dhīno bhavāmyeva nānyasya kasyacit kvacit | yadi dehi varaṃ taṃ vai tadā tyakṣyāmi vai tapaḥ ||36|| anyathā tvamasadvaktā viśvāsyo nāsi mādhava | yathāgatastathā yāhi tapaścarāmi vai ciram ||37|| ityevamarthitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ | sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ badri tathāstvevaṃ jagāda ha ||38|| prāpte karmavipāke te sarvaṃ satyaṃ bhaviṣyati | ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇastirobhavacchriyānvitaḥ ||39|| hemānalo’yaṃ sahasā tapastyaktvā gṛhaṃ yayau | merau gatvā sa gadayā yuddhārthaṃ ca viniryayau ||4.3.40|| pṛthivyardhaṃ kṛtaṃ tena kalpe’tra prāktapobalāt | samrāḍrājā vartate’yaṃ tadā viṣṇurivāparaḥ ||41 || sa cāyaṃ badarasyāpi rājyaṃ jetumupāyayau | śrītareṇa na kenāpi bhūtena bhautikena vā ||42|| parābhavaṃ tvāsuraḥ sa samavāpsyati vai kvacit| | evaṃ labdhavaraścāyaṃ himaśailaśilopamaḥ |||43||| utkṣipyāpi bhuvo garbhāduttasthau prāktapobalāt | so’yaṃ kṣipto badareṇa tvayā garte’tra vai punaḥ ||44|| kintu yāvacchriyā pādau taddehe na patiṣyataḥ | tāvannaiva parābhāvyaścāsuro’yaṃ bhaviṣyati ||45|| śriyāḥ padbhyāṃ niścalo’yaṃ bhūgarbhe sannivatsyati | avyayau caraṇau labdhvā niścalātmā bhaviṣyati ||46|| tasmād badara māṇikyāṃ śriyaṃ mama priyāṃ tviha | ārādhaya nivāsārthaṃ devakāryārthamityapi ||47|| mayā dattavarasyāpi yāthārthyāya jayāya ca | anyathā niṣphalaḥ sarvo yatnaste’tra bhaviṣyati ||48|| ityukto badaro rājā tuṣṭāva parameśvarīm | māṇikyāṃ śrīṃ mahāmuktānikāṃ śrībālayoginīm ||49|| namaścarācarasthāyai camatkāramayīśriyai | nārāyaṇyai hyabhedāyai bālakṛṣṇāṃgayoṣite ||4.3.50|| namaḥ śrīpuruṣottamyai hariṇyai brahmayoṣite | namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃganāyai te namaḥ ||51 || namo māṇikyavarṇāyai dhāriṇyai śrīharernamaḥ | namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇakāntāyai pārabrāhmyai namonamaḥ ||52||| bhaktakāryātisampādayitryai mātre namonamaḥ | prasannā bhava deveśi hemānalapraśāntaye ||53|| mahāsuro’yaṃ śrīkāntāmṛte mṛdho na jāyate | tvaṃ mātastanmardanaṃ vai kuru devārthasādhike ||54|| namastasyai sarvahantryai rakṣayitryai ca te namaḥ | mahānārāyaṇapatnyai māṇikyāyai ca te namaḥ ||55|| evamabhyarthya tāṃ śaktiṃ hṛdā pūjāṃ cakāra saḥ | arpayāmāsa puṣpāṇi māṇikyācaraṇe tadā ||56|| tāvat sā paramā lakṣmīścākṣarabrahmavāsinī | puro babhūva sahasā prasannāsyā hi suprabhā ||57|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpānurūpiṇī | yuvatī tejasā vyāptā cakrapadmādidhāriṇī ||58 || aṃkuśaṃ śūlamutkṛṣṭaṃ dadhānā karayostathā | kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ priyaṃ prāṇaṃ vīkṣamāṇā punaḥ punaḥ ||59|| ājñāṃ voḍhuṃ satvarā sā tatparā balaśālinī | tanvī prapūrṇapuṣṭāsyā navayauvanaśālinī ||4.3.60|| svarṇavarṇā kanakābhā padmāyatasulocanā | śukanāsā kundadantā bimbauṣṭhī śītalaspṛśā ||61 || vidyudbhāsvaravastrāḍhyā kaustubhena virājitā | karṇanāsābhālabāhuprakoṣṭhapādabhūṣaṇā ||62|| kaṭyāṃ raśanayā yuktā śṛṃgārakajjalānvitā | kabarīdhammilaśobhā sindūracandrakānvitā ||63|| sustanī sunitambā ca sumadhyā ca sugandhinī | tejaḥparidhisaṃvyāptā candrābhanakhaśobhitā ||64|| alaktakātisaundaryā svarṇaromāvaliśritā | premarasamahāpūrṇā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇī priyā ||65|| sugandhipuṣpahārālivyāptavakṣaḥsthalottamā | sthalapadmanibhasakthidvyaśobhāmanoharā ||66 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ tyaktuṃ necchāvatī sadā | gṛhītaśrīkṛṣṇakarā nityayuktā mahāsatī ||67|| bhagavatpremapātraṃ sā śrīkṛṣṇāṃganivāsinī | śītaśailasamā dehe tāpasīva pareśvarī ||68|| sarvaiśvaryādisampannā vātsalyaguṇasāgarā | lāvaṇyānantyasaṃjuṣṭā naikasakhīpravanditā ||69|| bhagavanmukhalagnākṣī pūrṇānandātimodinī | hasamānā badaraṃ sā jagād puruṣottamau ||4.3.70|| vada rājam̐stava śreyo vidhāsye sahasā tviha | surakāryaṃ kṛṣṇakāryaṃ vidhāsye drutamatra ca ||71|| śrutvā rājāsuracūrṇanārthaṃ vyajijñapacchriyam | nārāyaṇecchayā sāpi padbhyāṃ hantumupādravat ||72||| tāvad daityavaro garte himopalātmako’bhavat | nārāyaṇastadā lakṣmīṃ māṇikyāṃ prāha satvaram ||73|| nārāyaṇi drutaṃ tvatra padbhyāṃ tiṣṭhāsuropari | tava padbhyāṃ hataḥ spṛṣṭo’suraḥ punarna vai bahiḥ ||74|| udgamiṣyati duṣṭātmā varadānabalāttathā | kuru kāryaṃ badarasya devānāṃ ca hitāvaham ||75|| tadā tu khinnacittā śrīmāṇikyā tvavadat prabhum | kathamekākinī kṛṣṇamṛte nvatra vasāmi vai ||76|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastvaṃ me patiḥ sadā | patnī cāhaṃ tava kṛṣṇa pātivratyaparāyaṇā ||77|| patiṃ vinā kṣaṇaṃ sthātuṃ notsahe vijane hime | yatheṣṭaṃ kuru kṛṣṇa tvaṃ śādhi dharmyaṃ vrataṃ mama ||78|| śrūtvā vicāramakarod bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ | māṇikye tvaṃ bhava badrī bahupādā drumātmikā ||79|| aṃkuśaṃ śūlamevāpi kaṇṭakau te mahāyudhe | bhavatāṃ patrasahite sarvāsuravināśake ||4.3.80|| sadā tvaṃ tāpasī vārkṣī badarī bhava śobhanā | pādairhemānalaṃ spṛṣṭvā bhūgarbhe taṃ prapeṣaya ||8 1|| niścalā śāśvatī devī badrīdevī sadā bhava | badareṇa stutā rājñā vadareṇābhivāñcchitā ||82|| badareṇa tathākṛṣṭā tvāyātāsi yatastviha | badarītisadānāmnā saphalā tvaṃ bhaviṣyati ||83|| badrikāśrama evāyaṃ divyāvāso bhaviṣyati | ahaṃ nityaṃ badaryāste chāyāyāṃ tāpasottamaḥ ||84|| dharmaputro naranārāyaṇātmā saṃbhavāmi ca | jaṭī śīlī brahmacārī tvanmūlāvāsaśobhanaḥ ||85|| bhavāmyatra jagatkalyāṇārthaṃ naranarāyaṇaḥ | yāvaccandrastathāsūryo yāvat sthāsyati medinī ||86|| tāvattāpasaveṣo’haṃ tāpasī tvaṃ tu badrike | nivatsyāmo’tra dhavale śītale himakāśrame ||87|| hemānalo’pi bhūgarbhe tava pādatale sadā | saṃpiṣṭastava bhakto vai suṣuptaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ||88|| śreyo jagatāṃ paramaṃ tathā syāttattathā kuru | ityuktvā māṇikīdevī babhūva badrikā drutam ||89|| hemānalāsuramūrdhni kṛtvopalāpravarṣaṇam | pādām̐statra nidhāyaiva māṇikyā sā sthirābhavat ||4.3.90|| badrīramā mahādivyā vārkṣī devī tu śāśvatī | tāpasī tāpasenāpi nārāyaṇena saṃyutā ||91 || nyavasattatra sahasā dharmaputreṇa cakriṇā | upadravāḥ praśāntāścāsurabhītirlayaṃ gatā ||92||| devādyā niścalāstvāsan pupūjurbadarīśvarīm | naranārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ samarcayan ||93|| badrīnāthaṃ badrikāṃ ca badaraṃ ca nṛpaṃ tathā | badrikāśramamevainaṃ sthalaṃ prāhuḥ surādayaḥ ||94|| divyaṃ ca pāvanaṃ badrīśvari tvadvāsaśobhanam | tata ārabhya devā vai māsaṣaṭkaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||95|| tīrthaṃ kurvanti himavacchikhare badrikāśrame | māsadvayaṃ tu pitaraścaturmāsām̐śca mānavāḥ ||96|| badrikāśramayātrāṃ te kṛtvā hemānalāsuram | pāparūpaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ cārdayanti himālaye ||97|| bhūtvā te pāvanā badrīśvari te darśanāttathā | mamāpi darśanāt pūtā muktā bhavanti dehinaḥ ||98|| yathākṣare pare dhāmni brahmaloke vasāmyaham | māṇikyāsahitastadvaccātra badrikayā yutaḥ ||99|| vasāmi sarvathā badri lokānāṃ śreyasāṃ kṛte | evaṃ tvaṃ sarvathā śreṣṭhā sarvapādapapūjitā || 4.3.1 00|| tāpasī vartase tvatra himādrau matsadharmiṇī | nārāyaṇī tvaṃ badarī māṇikyā vāhinī mama || 101 || nārāyaṇo’haṃ bhagavān narayuk puruṣottamaḥ | naranārāyaṇanāmnā bhajanīyo bhavāmi ha || 1 02|| evaṃ te vai samākhyānaṃ proktaṃ śrībadarīśvari | badarasya subhaktasya bhaktyā saṃbhṛtamuttam || 1 03|| badaro’pi sadā bhaktyā rasarūpo vyajāyata | phalātmā te badaryā vai vartate te suto yathā || 1 04|| bījaṃ phale nararūpaṃ phalagarbhe vasāmyaham | tena tvanyā badaryo’tra prajāyante hi badrike || 1 05|| etatsthānaṃ pratīkaṃ me mūlaṃ sthānaṃ tu me girau | ito dūre divyarūpaṃ yasya yātrā na jāyate || 1 06|| paśya tvaṃ māṇiki taddhi mānavānāṃ na dṛṣṭigam | na gatirmānavānāṃ tu muktānāṃ gatirasti yat| || 1 07|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇānmokṣaṇaṃ bhavet | āsuropadravaśāntistathā brahmamayī gatiḥ || 1 08|| sarvaśreyaḥpradāśaktiḥ prajāyeta parā yathā | sarvāḥ śriyo vaseyuśca badrīkathāśravāntike ||1 09|| bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi na tiṣyasya parābhavaḥ | naranārāyaṇaścāhaṃ śrotuścitte vasāmi hi ||4.3.1 10 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne punaheṃmānalotthānaṃ, śikharakṣepādyupadravāḥ, badareṇa hariṇā ca garte nikṣepaḥ, hemānalasyapūrvatapaḥkathā, varadānaṃ śrīpādākrāntatvavaraprāptiḥ, śrīmāṇikyāyāstanmardanārthaṃ badarīrūpatā, tatpādairmardanaṃ, śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya naranārāyaṇarūpatā, badarasya phalarūpatā, narasya bījarūpatā, badrikāśramatīrthaprākaṭyaṃ, mūlaṃ badrikāśramaṃ tu bhinnaṃ dūre cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tṛtīyo’dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||
<4.4> śrībadrīśvaryuvāca naranārāyaṇaviṣṇo kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho | kṛṣṇakāntahare kṛṣṇaśrīmāṇikīramārttihan || 1 || kathaṃ sa badaro rājā badarīphalatāṃ gataḥ | naraśca bījatāṃ prāptastanme brūhi narāyaṇa || 2 || śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīrame devi tatkathāṃ pāvanīṃ śubhām | mokṣakarīṃ hi bhaktānāṃ pāpināṃ pāpanāśinīm || 3 || badaro vai mahābhakto rājyaṃ dhanaṃ gṛhādikam | sampadaḥ strījanaṃ yānavāhanāni prajāstathā || 4 || kośaṃ ratnāni bhūmiśca dehadaihikamityapi | sarvaṃ kṛtvā hi kṛṣṇārthaṃ vyavartata sa sādhuvat || 5 || nyayuṅakta dāsadāsīśca sādhusevāsu sarvadā | saudheṣu sādhavastasya nivasanti harerjanāḥ || 6 || kīrtanāni sadā tasyālaye bhavanti badrike | sarvasvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇabhaktayogārthaṃ tvakaroddhi saḥ || 7 || ātmaniveditāṃ prāptastvekadācintayannṛpaḥ | niveditaṃ mayā sarvaṃ haraye paramātmane || 8 || māyikaṃ sarvamevāpi tathātmāpi niveditaḥ | pārthivaṃ ca jalīyaṃ ca taijasaṃ prāṇa ityapi || 9 || sarvaṃ niveditaṃ śrīmannārāyaṇāya cakriṇe | gehaṃ yānaṃ bhojanādi vastrālaṅkārabhūṣaṇam || 4.4.1 0|| gandhasugandhatailādi kṛṣṇārthaṃ caupayogikam | sarvaṃ prajāyate yogyaṃ sevārhaṃ jaḍavastukam || 1 1|| kintu nikṛṣṭamatyarthaṃ varṣma durgandhisaṃbhṛtam | samalaṃ vikṛtaṃ kledyaṃ nopayogāya cakriṇaḥ || 12|| bhavatyevāśuci nityaṃ malamūtrasamanvitam | snāyyvasthimāṃsasaṃvyāptaṃ nyakkṛtaṃ kuṇapaṃ śavam || 13|| sarvathā nopayogārthaṃ svāmino me prajāyate | jīvacchavaṃ mṛtaṃ bhasma viṣṭā mṛd vā prakīrtitam || 14|| kathaṃ kṛṣṇakṛte kārṣṇasatāṃ kṛte’sya yojanam | upayogi kathaṃ syācca kathaṃ na syānnirarthakam || 19|| yanmayā poṣitaṃ lakṣavatsaraiḥ sevitaṃ śubhaiḥ | tasya kathaṃ satāmarthe hyupayogo bhavediha || 16|| sārthakyaṃ ca bhavedasya mānavasya hi varṣmaṇaḥ | karomi tapasā divyaṃ satāṃ bhogyaṃ harestathā || 17|| bhaktyā vā copayogasthaṃ kurve sevārhameva tat | nṛpāya sādhavaḥ sevāṃ diśanti na kadācana || 18|| nṛpadeho dīnavacca karoti sevanaṃ na ca | tasmānnṛpasya deho’yaṃ niṣphalo’dya pravartate || 19|| saphalaṃ taṃ karomyeva tapasārādhanena ca | yaddhiṣṇyaṃ na tu devāya taddhiṣṇyaṃ dhikkṛtaṃ matam ||4.4.20|| yacchiro devanamane nopayuktaṃ tu dhikkṛtam | ye netre na darśanārthe devānāṃ te’pi dhikkṛte ||21 || ye śrotre na śravaṇārthe devānāṃ te’pi dhikkṛte | yallalāṭaṃ na devārhacandanādiprasādavat ||22|| tannirbhāgyaṃ sadā bodhyaṃ bhālaṃ bhallukabhālavat | yā nāsā śrīharergandhagrāhiṇī naiva vartate ||23|| sā śuṣkatilapuṣpābhā gahvarāḍhyā na śobhanā | yanmukhaṃ śrīharervācaṃ na gṛṇāti kadācana ||24|| na kīrtanaṃ na modaṃ ca tanmukhaṃ mūrkhakarkavat | yā jihvā na rasaṃ vetti nārāyaṇaprasādajam ||25|| sā tu darvīva bodhyā vā dardurīva ca nirguṇā | yanmukhaṃ sundaraṃ ramyaṃ harerbhogyaṃ na cedyadi |||26| rāhugrastaṃ sadā tattu bodhyaṃ suyoṣitāmapi| narasya ca mukhaṃ tattu vānarāsyasamaṃ matam ||27|| yanmukhaṃ na harernārāyaṇāsyarasavedi tat | tāmbūlarasaśūnyaṃ ca tadbilaṃ mūṣakasya vai ||28|| yaḥ kaṇṭho na hareḥ kīrtigītimagno’tisusvaraḥ | sa bodhyaḥ kīcakavaddhi vṛthāsvananinādavān ||29|| yadvakṣo na hareryogyaṃ yannoraḥ śrīhareḥ śritam | yatra nāsti harervāsastadvakṣo vṛkṣanīḍakam || 4.4.30|| yadvakṣasi svayaṃ kṛṣṇo na śete hāravattu tat | śavavakṣo’śucibodhyaṃ vṛthāstanavilambitam || 31 || yau stanau śrīkṛṣṇakāntakarapadmatalāspṛśau | tau piṇḍau cāmaṃgalau vai rasālīgranthisadṛśau ||32|| yau skandhau kṛṣṇahastābhyāṃ nāśliṣṭau stambinau tu tau | yaḥ pṛṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇaśayane spṛṣṭo naiva sa kāṣṭhavat ||33|| udara yad ramākāntodaralagnaṃ na tad daram | nābhiḥ kṛṣṇena dṛṣṭā na sā gartaḥ khanirūpavat || 34|| kaṭirjaghanaṃ guptaṃ ca spṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇena naiva yat | tad yāmyaṃ cālayaṃ bodhyaṃ pāpāśrayaṃ samastakam ||35|| nitambau sakthinī jānū jaṃghe pādau ca pattale | kṛṣṇasparśamanāpanne vṛkṣastambanibhe tu te ||36|| mano yat kṛṣṇavirahaṃ rauravaṃ tattu vai matam | buddhiryā kṛṣṇaśūnyā sā kuṃbhipākātmikā khaniḥ ||37|| cittaṃ kṛṣṇavihīnaṃ yat tattu śṛgālasadṛśam | ahantā kṛṣṇaśūnyā yā sā vṛkīva vināśinī ||38|| guṇatrayaṃ kṛṣṇaśūnyaṃ tattu tridoṣarūpi yat | avasthātritayaṃ kṛṣṇaśūnyaṃ tvaghatrayaṃ hi tat ||39|| rūpaṃ kṛṣṇānapekṣaṃ yat tat śvitraṃ sarvadā matam | rasaḥ kṛṣṇavihīno yaḥ sa vai vaitaraṇī nadī ||4.4.40 || gandhaḥ kṛṣṇavihīnastu malapātranibhaḥ sa vai | śabdaḥ kṛṣṇena vidhuro ghūkaśabdo hi sarvathā ||41 || sparśaḥ kṛṣṇena hīnastu viṣānalasamaḥ sa hi | ratiḥ prītiḥ sukhaṃ modaḥ kṛṣṇahīnāstathotsavāḥ ||42|| sarve te nārakā bodhyā ānandā nirayātmakāḥ | kṛṣṇayuktaṃ samastaṃ vai svalpaṃ mahattu yad bhavet ||43|| tattu divyaṃ śāśvataṃ ca mokṣapradaṃ mahāmṛtam | śrīkṛṣṇasya satāmarthe yad bhavedupakārakam ||44|| cennikṛṣṭaṃ bhavet tattu cotkṛṣṭaṃ suravanditam | api majjāsthicarmādi kṛṣṇārthaṃ yojitaṃ bhavet ||456|| sarvaṃ divyaṃ muktidātṛ sārthakaṃ naravarṣma tat | vṛkṣāḥ kṛṣṇakṛte yānarūpā bhavanti sārthakāḥ ||46|| hastidantāstṛṇavallyo bhavanti bhūṣaṇāsanam | camarīpucchavālānāṃ cāmaraṃ jāyate śubham ||47|| kastūrikā mṛgasyāpi matā kṛṣṇopayoginī | mṛgasiṃhādicarmāṇi bhavanti cāsanānyapi ||48|| śuktyādīni ca ratnāni bhūṣaṇāni bhavantyapi | kandamūlaphalānāṃ ca naivedyaṃ jāyate hareḥ ||49|| kaṇānāṃ miṣṭabhojyāni jāyante paramātmanaḥ | dugdhādīni gavotthāni peyāni saṃbhavantyapi ||4.4.50|| mākṣikaṃ ca madhuraṃ ca madhu bhakṣyaṃ prajāyate | kauśeyaṃ kīṭajaṃ vastraṃ kṛṣṇārthaṃ caupayogikam ||51 || dhātavaḥ khanijāścāpi hetirūpā bhavantyapi | śaṃkhaḥ sāmudrajantūttho vādyarūpo bhavatyapi ||52|| maṇayo’pi śarīrotthā mauktikāni ca vai sraji | dhāryante kṛṣṇakāntena sarvaṃ tathaupayogikam ||53|| api haṃsasya pṛṣṭhaṃ ca garuḍasya gajasya ca | aśvasyāpi hareḥ śubhāsanayogyaṃ bhavatyapi ||54|| kintvayaṃ naradeho vai nāsti kṛṣṇaupayogikaḥ | satāṃ vā nopayogārthastato nirarthakaḥ sadā ||55|| evaṃ vyacintayad rājā bahudhā nijavarṣmaṇaḥ | api vai kajjalaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇanetrāsanaṃ bhavet ||56|| tattulyo’pi na vai deho narasyāto nirarthakaḥ | nārīdeho harerarthe dāsyā iva kṛtārthakaḥ |57|| tattulyo na naradeho yaḥ kṛṣṇārtho na vartate | tasmānmayā tu kṛṣṇārthaḥ sādhusādhvyartha ityapi ||58|| ṛṣimunyartha evāpi kartavyastāpasārthakaḥ | bhuktaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||59|| viśālākhyo yuvā putro yogyo’sti rājyakovidaḥ | tasmai samarpya rājyaṃ me kāryaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ tanu ||4.4.60|| vicāryetthaṃ sa badaraḥ samāhūya prajājanān | prakāśaṃ hṛdayaṃ kṛtvā prāpya prajāmatāni ca ||61|| mahotsavena putrāya viśālākhyāya vai dhuram | dadau rājyasya dharmyāṃ ca mano mokṣe’karottataḥ ||62|| naranārāyaṇaśālāṃ samāsādya himālaye | vyacintayannijaṃ dehaṃ satāṃ sevaupayogikam ||63|| nārāyaṇasya sevāyāṃ tathā yathaupayogikam | tasthau samādhau sahasātmanyātmānaṃ nidhāya saḥ ||64|| snehātiśayamāsādya naranārāyaṇaprabhau | tallīnaḥ sambabhūvaiva vismṛtya dehamātmanaḥ ||65|| brahmānalena sampūrṇo jñānāgninātibhāsuraḥ | snehaśikhinā dravito videhaḥ sahasābhavat ||66|| sarveṣāṃ munivaryāṇāṃ paśyatāṃ dravatāṃ gataḥ | romalohitamāṃsāni snāyvasthimajjikāstataḥ ||67|| vīryaṃ caitāni sarvāṇi rasātmakāni cābhavan | badaryāḥ śrīmāṇikīśrīrūpāyāḥ pādabhūsthale ||68|| rasaḥ sarvaḥ khādyarūpo vyalīyata tadā drutam | mahāścaryamidaṃ jātaṃ śrīpādayoḥ samarpitaḥ ||69|| yādṛśī bhāvanā cānte tathā bhavati dehyapi | tūrṇaṃ badaro rājāsau rasabhāvamupāgataḥ ||4.4.70|| dravakhādyasvarūpo vai badrīmūleṣvalīyata | badrīstambe cāviveśa rasarūpo’timiṣṭakṛt ||71 || śākhāsu sahasā vyāptaḥ puṣparūpo’bhavattathā | phalarūpo’bhavaccāpi badarāṇi tato’bhavan ||72|| mahāścaryamidaṃ jātaṃ badareṇa nijaṃ vapuḥ | kṛtvā rasaṃ dravitaṃ tat phalarūpaṃ prapāditam ||73|| badrīphalāni miṣṭāni tāni pakvāni sarvaśaḥ | sugandhīni surūpāṇi mahānti tṛptidāni ca ||74|| māṇikyāśrīgarbhajāni pāvanāni tadābhavan | prasādajāni sarvāṇi badarāṇi tadābhavan ||75|| naranārāyaṇo devo jagrāha kānicittadā | naivedye’bhuṅkta bhagvān madhurāṇi phalāni vai ||76|| athānye ṛṣayo devā gandharvā mānavāḥ surāḥ | ye ye tvāsan himādrau te cakhaduḥ satphalāni vai ||77|| ekaṃ phalaṃ varṣakālatṛptidaṃ tad vyajāyata | madhugarbhaṃ samastaṃ vai tāpasānāṃ hi tṛptikṛt ||78|| caturdaśasu lokeṣu praśaṃsā saṃvyajāyata | sudhāśreṣṭhāni himavadgirau badrīphalāni vai ||79|| nārāyaṇaprasādāni prāpyante tṛptidāni vai | paramparayā tvākarṇya pitaraḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ ||4.4.8 0|| ṛṣayo mānavā devāstathānye dehino girau | āyayuḥ phalalābhārthaṃ nārāyaṇo’pi sandadau ||81 || prāpya phalāni sarve’pi sudhordhvasvādavanti vai | attvā tṛptiṃ vārṣikīṃ cāvāpuḥ sarve sukhapradām ||82|| ye ye’danti phalānyasyāste te prayānti divyatām | balaṃ puṣṭiṃ ca vīryaṃ ca sahasradhāpnuvanti te ||83 || śrutvā śrutvā samāyānti nītvā nītvā prayānti ca | dṛṣṭvā himālayaṃ badrīṃ naranārāyaṇāśramam ||84|| badarāṇi vicitrāṇi modante tvaṇḍavāsinaḥ | mahotsavaḥ samastānāṃ jāto badarabhojinām ||85|| abdhau tu parvataṃ vīkṣya māṇikyāṃ badarīṃ tathā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vīkṣya naranārāyaṇātmakam ||86|| tāpasaṃ jaṭinaṃ cāpi navāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ hi menire | yātrārthaṃ tīrthavaryaṃ vai jātaṃ badārakāśramam ||87|| suvatārāḥ pārṣadāśca vyūhā īśvarakoṭayaḥ | īśvarāṇyaḥ surā devyaścāyayuḥ phalavāñcchayā ||88|| yathā yathā badarāṇi nīyante tu tathā tathā | drāgeva nūtanānyeva prodbhavanti drume’bhitaḥ ||89|| badaro’yaṃ mahārājaḥ snehabadarasadrasaḥ | phalarūpo’tibhaktyābhūt sarvabhogyaśarīrakaḥ ||4.4.90|| avyayaścākṣayaścāpi tathā saṃkhyāvivarjitaḥ | divyaraso brahmarasātmakaḥ śrīrasa uttamaḥ ||91|| vyajāyata kṛpayāpi naranārāyaṇasya vai | lakṣmyāśca kṛpayā cāpi phalaputrātmakaḥ sadā ||92|| māṇikyāphalarūpaḥ sa sadā divyaphalo’bhavat | badrīdevī saphalābhūd vṛkṣarūpāpi sarvadā ||93|| nārāyaṇo’pi bhagavān phalaputrānvito’bhavat | brahmacaryavratastho’pi badarasya pitābhavat ||94|| māṇikyāśrīḥ sadā śīlavratā ca bālayoginī | badarākhyaphalairvaṃśaputravatī sadābhavat ||95|| tānaumāni badarāṇi nārāyaṇātmakāni vai | lakṣyātmakāni divyāni muktabhojyāni cābhavan ||96|| tasmādbadrīphalabhoktā kṛṣṇamūrtermahāsukham | bhuṃkte mūrtyānandabhoktā sa eva badarīvane ||97|| amāyikāni sarvāṇi badarāṇi śubhāni vai | caikatattvamayānyeva santi tadbadarīdrume ||98|| evaṃ vai badarīdevi badaraḥ phalatāṃ gataḥ | atibhaktyā rasabhāvaṃ dravaṃ prāpya drume sthitaḥ ||99|| mahābhāgavatānāṃ hi sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ matam | divyaṃ sarvaṃ bhavatyeva śrīkṛṣṇānugrahāttathā || 4.4.1 00|| māyāpyamāyā bhavati deho’pyadeha ityapi | guṇāścāguṇatāṃ yānti jaḍaṃ divyaṃ sacetanam || 10 1|| kṛṣṇārpitaṃ samastaṃ vai kṛṣṇātmakaṃ prajāyate | evaṃ śrīmāṇikīdevi tava bhaktakathānakam || 1 02|| divyaṃ śrībadarīdevi mokṣakṛt kīrtitaṃ mayā | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ gatiṃ labhet || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne vadarākhyanṛpasya svadehasyaupayogikatāsiddhyarthaṃ badarīmūle tapasā bhaktyā rasātmakatā badarātmakaphalarūpatā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturtho’dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
<4.5> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīrame devi teto narakathāmapi | nirbīje badare tatra naro vai bījatāṃ yayau || 1 || dṛṣṭvā bhuktvāmṛtasvādūnyuttamāni phalāni vai | surā maharṣayo devā mānavā dehino’pare ||2|| naranārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ ca māṇikīm | prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ badrīṃ deśe ninīṣayā || 3 || naranārāyaṇaviṣṇo sarvopakārakaprabho | badarīyaṃ kalpavṛkṣottamā pīyūṣasatphalā || 4 || sampannā kṛpayā te’trākṣaradhāmanivāsinī | badaro’tra ca phalatāṃ prāptastṛptikaro rasaḥ || 5 || naitādṛśī sudhā svarge jane tapasi satyake | na mānave na pātāle merau lokācale’pi na || 6 || imāmakṣayyaphaladāmakṣayyatṛptidāmapi | dehi lokeṣu naḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇadayānidhe || 7 || yathā devā vayaṃ bhaktāḥ ṛṣayaśca mahārṣayaḥ | vanāraṇyanivāsā vai syāma caitatphalādanāḥ || 8 || bhavān lokasya sarvasya śreyo’rthaṃ tapati prabho | badarīlābhadānena paraṃśreyaḥ karotvapi || 9 || pāpā jīvā api loke badarāśanakāriṇaḥ | niṣpāpāste bhaviṣyanti yāsyanti paramaṃ padam || 4.5.1 0|| kṛpā kāryā hi lokeṣu phalaṃ naitādṛśaṃ param | mokṣadaṃ pāvanaṃ puṇyapradaṃ yajñaphalapradam || 11 || tapasvināṃ tapovṛddhikaraṃ śāśvatatṛptidam | devāmṛtātimiṣṭaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaṃ param || 12|| vanāraṇyanivāsānāṃ sādhūnāṃ sattvavardhanam | antaḥkaraṇanairmalyasampādakaṃ hareḥ priyam || 1 3|| brahmaphalaṃ hi badaraṃ divyāmṛtaphalaṃ tathā | lakṣmīphalaṃ tathā bhaktiphalaṃ śrīmāṇikīphalam || 14|| ākṣaraṃ satphalaṃ tvetannānyatra labhyate prabho | datvā nastvaṃ kṛtārthānnaḥ kuru kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa || 15|| badarākhyaphalaṃ tvetad badarākhyo nṛpastathā | lakṣmīśrīmāṇikībadrīpārvīramā haripriyāḥ || 16|| naranārāyaṇastvaṃ ca sarve lokopakārakāḥ | upakāraṃ prakurvantu badarārpaṇakarmaṇā || 17|| ityarthito hariḥ prāha sarvān badarabhikṣukān | bhavatāṃ mama bhaktānāṃ manaḥpūrttyai dayāvaśaḥ || 18|| dātumicchāmi badarāṇyavicchinnāni syuryathā | imāni divyarūpāṇi nirbījāni bhavanti vai || 1 9|| teṣāṃ dānena bhavatāṃ ciraprāptirna vai bhavet | vṛkṣastveko badaryāstu vidyate’vicalastathā ||4.5.20|| hemāsuropamardārthaścotkhātuṃ sa na śakyate | badarāṇāṃ yathā vaṃśaparamparā bhavettathā ||21 || mayā phalāni sarvāṇi kāryāṇi bījavanti ca | vinā bījaṃ na tajjātiravicchinnā pravardhate ||22|| mūlātstambātphalātpatrātkāṇḍānnālācca cakṣuṣaḥ | śākhāyāśca jaṭāyāśca granthervā vaṃśavardhanam || 23|| bījācchreṣṭhatarā vaṃśavṛddhiḥ sātra vibhāvyate | vaṃśajaiḥ pūrvajānāṃ tu samuddhāro vitanyate || 24|| hrāse nūtanasampattau kṣayaścāpi bhavenna vai | tataścātra badareṣu bījāni racayāmyaham ||25|| uktvaivaṃ badarīnātho nārāyaṇastu śīlavān | svāṃśaṃ naraṃ prasannātmā lokayāmāsa tatkṣaṇe ||26|| naro namro vinītaśca kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata | yadicchā te hare cāste kurve drutaṃ vadātra me || 27|| tvadicchayākṣare dhāmni śrīpuruṣottamāt purā | yadā rādhārbabhūva tadāhaṃ kṛṣṇatāṃ gataḥ ||28|| goloke rādhayā sākaṃ tvadājñayāvasaṃ sadā | yadā punaśca te mūrteḥ ramādevī vyajāyata ||29|| tadā nārāyaṇatvaṃ samprāpya vaikuṇṭhago’bhavam | yadā ramā tava mūrteḥ prāvirbabhūva vai tadā || 4.5.30|| vāsudevasvarūpo’haṃ vyūharūpo’bhavaṃ purā | yadā jātā mahālakṣmīrlalitā te svarūpataḥ ||3 1|| tadāhaṃ tu mahāviṣṇuḥ śrīpure tvabhavaṃ purā | lakṣmīryadā tava dehājjātā viṣṇustadābhavam ||3 2|| śrīśca jātā tava mūrtestadāhaṃ śeṣaśāyanaḥ | kamalā ca tava mūrterjātā yadā tvadājñayā ||33|| śvetadvīpe śvetanārāyaṇo’haṃ tvabhavaṃ tadā | yadā tvaṃ māṇikīṃ badrīṃ kṛtvā niṣevase hime ||34|| tadātrāhaṃ tava bhrātā naro bhavāmi te’nujaḥ | dharmaputro mānaso’smi vada yattatkaromyaham ||35|| dharmaputrā hi catvāro nārāyaṇā bhavanti ye | jyeṣṭho haristvakṣare’sti bhavān śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||36|| kṛṣṇo golokadhāmastho nārāyaṇo vikuṇṭhake | sa tvaṃ śīlasvarūpaśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||37|| māṇikyāsahitastvatra vartase parameśvaraḥ | tavāṃśo’haṃ naraścāsmi karomyājñāṃ pradarśaya ||38|| ityuktvā praṇanāmainaṃ badrīnāthaṃ narāyaṇam | tadā nārāyaṇaḥ prāha bhrātaḥ kalyāṇakṛdbhavān ||39|| lokopakārakartāsti matparākramarūpavān | vartase tvaṃ mama vīryabalaśaktyādimūrtikaḥ ||4.5.40|| ime devādayo bhaktāḥ prārthayanti hi badrikām | badarāṇi samicchanti nityabhojanasiddhaye ||41|| ekaiva badarī tvadya vartate mūladevikā | badarāṇi hyasaṃkhyāni jātānyasyāḥ phalāni vai ||42|| nirbījāni bhavantyeva surādyairarthitāni ca | tāni sarvāṇi dīyante bhakṣyante ca surādibhiḥ ||43|| ekavāraṃ tṛptidāni bhaviṣyanti na cādhikam | kintu vaṃśakarāṇyeva tāni syuryadi sarvadā ||44|| akṣayyavaṃśadānyeva tadā lokasukhaṃ bhavet | badaryā vaṃśavṛddhiśca tāpasānāṃ ca bhojanam ||45|| phalāhārātmakaṃ syācca bhūtale divi cāpare | sarvalokeṣu badarīvaṃśo bhavet parārthakaḥ ||46|| badareṣu tataścātra bījānīṣṭāni santi me | bhūtvā tvaṃ bījarūpo’tra phaleṣvāviśa cānuja ||47|| tvadātmakairbījamūlairbadaryaḥ koṭiśo’parāḥ | bhaviṣyanti vanāraṇyodyākṣetrāṭavīṣvapi ||48|| sarvalokeṣu bījāḍhyabadarāṇyuttamānyapi | bhaviṣyanti tavādeśād badare bījavadbhava ||49|| ityuktaḥ sahasā bhakto naro nārāyaṇājñayā | bījarūpo’bhavad badrīmūle viveśa ca drume ||4.5.50|| vadareṣu samasteṣu bījātmā sa vyajāyata | naro’yaṃ badarīgarbho vyajāyata suvaṃśakṛt ||5 1 || tāpasenāpi veṣeṇa pṛthak cāpi sthito’bhavat | nārāyaṇaḥ prasanno’bhūd dṛṣṭvā bījātmakaṃ naram ||52|| badarīśrīḥ prasannābhūd vaṃśavatī hyajāyata | atha nārāyaṇaḥ prāha devādibhyo’tigauravam ||53|| māhātmyaṃ badarāṇāṃ vai badaryāścāghanāśanam | etanmūlā badaryo vai bhaviṣyanti kṣitau divi ||54|| candre merau satyaloke jane tapasi mānave | lokāloke raivatādrau puṣkare dakṣiṇe kurau ||55|| brāhme parīpradeśeṣu prācīneṣvamarīśake | gaurīloke cābrikteṣu tathoṣṭreṣu ca bhūmiṣu ||56|| pātālādau munīnāṃ ca nivāseṣu śubheṣvapi | nadītīreṣvaraṇyeṣu siṃhāraṇyādikeṣvapi ||57|| dharmāraṇyeṣu sarvatra bhaviṣyanti hi badrikāḥ | sarvartuphaladāḥ kāścit svargādau cākṣayā sadā ||58|| kāścid deśādiguṇakā yathartuphaladā api | kāścid varṣāsu phaladāḥ kāścicchītaphalapradāḥ ||59|| kāściduṣṇartuphaladā bhaviṣyanti drumātmikāḥ | kāścitpauṣyastathā mādhyaḥ phālgunyaścaitrya ityapi ||4.5.60|| bhūbhāgeṣu bhaviṣyanti badaryaścāpi putrikāḥ | pakvamiṣṭāyatapuṣṭamahatphalapradāḥ śubhāḥ ||61 || māghe pūjāṃ badarīṇāṃ kariṣyanti tu ye janāḥ | teṣāṃ lakṣmīramāpūjāphalaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ||62|| vasantasya dine tvekādaśyāṃ vā pūrṇimātithau | amāyāṃ vā badaryāstu gatvā mūlasya sannidhau ||63|| phālgunaikādaśikāyāṃ phākanapūrṇimātithau | phālgunasyāmāvāsyāyāṃ gatvā śrībadarītale 1150|| pūjayedbadarīṃ devīṃ jalārpaṇena vai purā | gūḍaṃ dadyāccharkarāṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ mūlake’rpayet ||61|| dugdhaṃ samarpayeccāpi dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tathākṣatān | kuṃkumaṃ ca gulālaṃ ca candanaṃ jalamarpayet ||66|| yajñopavītakaṃ sūtraṃ śāṭīsūtraṃ ca kajjalam | sindūrakaṃ ca bhūṣārthaṃ puṣpamālāṃ samarpayet ||67|| ārārtrikaṃ prakuryācca pradakṣiṇaṃ namaḥkriyām | tāmbūlakaṃ pradadyācca phalaṃ dadyānmanoharam ||68|| badrīdevyai dhvajaṃ dadyānnārāyaṇyai namo’stu te | śrīmāṇikyai namastubhyaṃ ramāyai te namonamaḥ ||69|| namaḥ śrīpuruṣottamyai padmāvatyai namonamaḥ | namaste bālayoginyai kārṣṇyai devyai namonamaḥ ||4.5.70|| śūlāṃkuśadharāyai te himajāyai namo’stu te | tvaṃ lakṣmīstvaṃ satī śrīśca tvaṃ ramā rādhikā prabhau ||71 || tvaṃ pārvatī mahālakṣmīstasyai brāhmyai ca te namaḥ | namaste badarīśvaryai hariṇyai te namonamaḥ ||72|| tāpasānāṃ phaladātryai sudhādhartryai ca te namaḥ | trailokyavanditāyai te mātarbadri ca te namaḥ ||73|| tava chāyānādimāyāchāyānāśakarī matā | tava mūlaṃ brahmamūlaṃ mūlaprakṛtivārakam ||74|| tava śākhā dhāmaśākhā ullaṃghyākṣaradhāmadāḥ | tava patrāṇicchatrāṇi brahmasāmrājyadāni vai ||75|| tava phalāni bhuktāni yogināṃ phaladāni ca | sarvayogaphaladāni parabrahmapradāni ca ||76|| tava bījāni lokānāṃ vāsanākṣayakāṇi vai | tava vaṃśyā badaryaśca pāpināṃ pāpanāśikāḥ ||77|| tvatphalānāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ ca mokṣaphalādanapradam | tvatpatrāṇāṃ sparśanaṃ ca brahmānandagṛhapradam ||78|| tvanmūleṣu namanaṃ ca sarvāsuravināśanam | tvanmūrterdarśanaṃ badri pakhahmāvalokanam ||79|| tvatphalāḍhyajalaiḥ snānaṃ brahmahradāvagāhanam | tvadadhaḥśayanaṃ badri sarvatīrthādhivāsanam ||4.5.80|| tvanmūle jaladānādi pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidāyakam | tvatphalārpaṇamevāpi śrāddhe’yutādhitṛptidam ||8 1 || tvatphalānāṃ prapakvānāṃ dānaṃ brahmarasapradam | sarvarasapradaṃ badri sarvasampatpravardhanam ||82||| badarī yatra vai sthālyāṃ tatrākṣaraṃ padaṃ mama | yatra śrībadarīdevī tatra śrībadrikāśramaḥ ||83||| badrīvane gataprāṇo dehī mokṣāya kalpate | badrītale na vai yāmyā dūtā yānti kadācana ||84|| pāpināṃ pāpanāśāni badaryadho bhavanti vai | maraṇe badarīdraṣṭā svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca vindati |||85||| phalaṃ bhuṃjan badaryāstu mṛto yāti parāṃ gatim | badarīpuṣpasaṃvyāptaśayyo yātyakṣaraṃ padam ||86|| āpadgatasya badarīpūjayāpadvināśanam | duḥsvapnaṃ jāyate naiva badarīsevinaḥ kvacit ||87|| bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ naśyantyupadravāstathā | grahopapīḍā naśyanti badarīsevināṃ sadā ||88|| dhāryā badaramālā vai kaṇṭhe māghyāṃ śubhe dine | bhakṣyaṃ ca badaraṃ pakvaṃ miṣṭaṃ māghyāṃ śubhe dine ||89||| dehe badaragarbhaśca raso mṛdyaḥ śubhe’hani | snānaṃ kāryaṃ badarāḍhyajalaiścāpi vrate’hani ||4.5.90|| tena yāvanmakhānāṃ vai cāvabhṛthaphalaṃ bhavet | sarvayajñaphalaṃ badrīpūjanāt syānna saṃśayaḥ ||91 || badarīphalahārām̐ścārpayet pakvaphalakṛtān | devakāryārthamevāpi vadarīkāṣṭhamarpayet ||92|| havanārthaṃ badarāṇi pakvāni cārpayettathā | phalāhārārthamevāpi badarāṇi samarpayet ||93|| śarkarāsahitānyeva ghṛtayuktāni vai tathā | dugdhayuktāni yataye tāpasāya samarpayet ||94|| māghyāṃ gatvā badaryāstu tale bhojanamācaret | sarve devā bhuñjate tat tṛpyanti pitaro’pi ca ||95|| viprāya sādhave dadyād dānāni badarītale | anāthāya striyai dadyādakṣayāni bhavanti hi ||96|| purā pitre suśīlākhyo vipro datvā śubhaṃ phalam | badaraṃ pitṛkarayoḥ śrāddhe tvindrapadaṃ hyagāt ||97|| badaraṃ badarīnāthaṃ badrikāṃ badrikāśramam | badrībījaṃ vadan martyo brahmabhūyāya jāyate ||98|| smṛtvā badarīṃ badaraṃ vadrīśvaraṃ himāśramam | antakāle tyajan dehaṃ yāsyatyūrdhvo parāṃ gatim ||99|| nārīṃ śrībadarīdevīṃ smṛtvā yāsyati cākṣaram | bhaviṣyati hareḥ patnī māṇikyāyāḥ sakhīśvarī || 4.5.10 0|| naro yāsyati mokṣaṃ ca nārāyaṇapadāmbuje | paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi kīṭāśca jalajā api || 10 1|| tṛṇādyā badarīṃ śritvā mṛtvā yāsyanti mokṣaṇam | badarīyaṃ naranārāyaṇāṃ ganā pravartate || 102|| tasyā yogena bhuktiṃ ca muktiṃ svargādisampadaḥ | prāpsyanti kṛtapāpā vai bhaviṣyanti hi pāvanāḥ || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne devādīnāṃ satatabadarīphalāptivāñcchāyāṃ badaryāḥ sabījaphalavattvakaraṇaṃ, narasya bījarūpatā, badarīmāhātmyaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcamo’dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||
<4.6> śrībadrīśvaryuvāca anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanārāyaṇaprabho | naranārāyaṇaviṣṇo badrīnāthasutāpasa || 1 || suśīlākhyo bhūsuro vai kadā kutrābhavatpurā | pitṛtṛptirbadareṇa kṛtā yena divampradā || 2 || śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīrame devi suśīlasya kathānakam | vihārākhye śubhe deśe pulahāśramasannidhau || 3 || gaṇḍakyāḥ subhage tīre mauktikāhārapattane | suśīlo’bhūdvipravaryaḥ kuṭumbibahulaḥ khalu || 4 || pitā tasyābhavannāmnā śrīśīlaḥ karmaṭhaḥ sadā | vidvān lobhābhibhūtaśca vyayabhītiparāyaṇaḥ || 5 || kuṭumbārthe vyayahīno labdhadravyādisañcayaḥ | utsavādivihīnaśca vratotsāhādivarjitaḥ || 6 || mahīmānādisammāne kadarya iva nirvyayaḥ | veṣe yāne bhojane’pi rūkṣa iva vanecaraḥ || 7 || devapūjādikāryeṣu bhikṣopalabdhanirvahaḥ | ātithyādivihīnaśca śuṣkayajñaparāyaṇaḥ || 8 || apatyānāṃ dugdhapāne piṣṭamaṇḍapradāyakaḥ | śākādiśūnyamadhyāhnabhojano ghṛtavarjitam || 9 || kṛśarānnaṃ bhunaktyeva bhojayatyapi yoṣitam | putrādīn śākamātraṃ ca bhojayatyapi tadvidham || 4.6.1 0|| dānādivarjito vipraḥ śrīśīlaḥ karmaṭhaḥ pitā | nadītīre svayaṃ gatvā snātvā nītvā phalādikam || 1 1|| samidhaśca svayaṃ samāhṛtyāgnau prajuhoti vai | tatrāpi bindumātraṃ vai ghṛtaṃ dadāti nādhikam || 1 2|| kaupīnaṃ cāñcalaṃ dhatte nādhikaṃ vastramityapi | yajñapaṭṭena vai skandhe nirvahatyeva bhūsuraḥ || 1 3|| gṛhastho’pi lobhavaśāttāpaso hi muniryathā | tathāyaṃ vartate gehe paryuṣitena vai kvacit || 14|| bhājīṃ labdhvāthavā kandān mūlāni vā dalāni vā | vane’raṇye’pyaṭavyāṃ vānayatyayaṃ bhunakti tat || 15|| evaṃvidhasya viprasya putrā daśābhavan śanaiḥ | putryaḥ saptābhavam̐ścāpi brāhmaṇadharmaśobhitāḥ || 16|| jyeṣṭhaḥ suśīlanāmāsya suto vedādividyayā | khyātimāpa samasteṣu pārśvagrāmeṣu karmaṭhaḥ || 17|| udāro dānaśīlaśca dharmotsavaparāyaṇaḥ | bhojane chādane bhogye kuṭumbaparipoṣakaḥ || 18|| rājamānādipātraṃ ca prajāsammānasatkṛtaḥ | yajñakāryādiniṣṇāto vaiṣṇavo bhaktarāḍ yathā || 19|| satāṃ sevāvratavām̐śca sādhvīsevāparāyaṇaḥ | ātithyadharmo gosevāgrāmasevāparāyaṇaḥ ||4.6.20 || pāṭhako bālakānāṃ ca kathākāraśca sarvadā | evaṃvidhaṃ nijaṃ putraṃ lomadharmavivarjitam ||21|| vyayaśīlaṃ pitā vīkṣya gṛhāddūraṃ cakāra tam | tenāyaṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ tyaktvā yayau tu pattanāntaram ||22|| dārābhāgyābhidhaṃ rājyaṃ tadrājñā tu kṛtādaraḥ | uvāsa svasthacitto’yaṃ prajārājādimānitaḥ ||23|| dārābhāgyeśvaro rājā nāmnā dāreśvarābhidhaḥ | saudhaṃ vāsāya viduṣe suśīlāyārpaṇaṃ dadau ||24|| bhūmiṃ kṣetraṃ vāṭikāṃ ca mahodyānaṃ ca vāhanam | annaṃ nirvāhamātraṃ ca dadau dāne’rkaparvaṇi ||25|| vipro’yaṃ prāpya sanmānaṃ prasannaḥ śubhasampadā | śāntacitto hariṃ bheje śrīpatiṃ nijavallabham ||26|| jīvikāṃ nijayātrāyā yogyāṃ labdhvā tutoṣa ha | upādhiṃ sarvathopārjyagocaraṃ sa vihāya vai ||27|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ tu pratyaham | nagare vācayāmāsa prajāsaṃghasabhāsthale ||28|| nṛpo dāreśvaraścāpi pratyahaṃ tūpatiṣṭhati | ākhyānāni vividhāni bhaktabhaktiparāṇi hi ||29|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇākhyānāni yānyapi | śrutvā śrutvā modate vai vaiṣṇavāsyodgatāni ca ||4.6.30|| kathānte kārayatyeva savādyotsavakīrtanam | hare kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa śrīpate puruṣottama ||3 1|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇaṇanārāyaṇa śrībadarīśvara | evaṃ kṛtvā kīrtanaṃ ca naivedyaṃ vinivedya ca |||32|| prasādaṃ saṃvibhajyātha gṛhaṃ yānti sabhājanāḥ | vipraḥ sāyaṃ harerbhaktiṃ prātarbhaktiṃ karoti ca ||33|| madhyāhnabhaktiṃ kṛtvātha bhojanaṃ sa karoti vai | sāyaṃ prātarjanāstasya samāgamārthamutsukāḥ ||34|| āyānti śreyase nityaṃ mumukṣavaḥ sumānasāḥ | tebhyo mantraṃ vipravaryo dadāti mokṣadāyakam ||35|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | bahavo vaiṣṇavāścaivaṃ sampannāstatra pattane ||36|| narāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ cāpi bhaktisaṃghā sudhārmikāḥ | abhavan bhaktikarmāṇo bhajanti śrīprabhāpatim ||37|| pattane tu yathā tadvad grāmeṣu cetareṣvapi | bhaktasaṃghā abhavam̐śca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritāḥ ||38|| atha bhaktottamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vipraṃ bhāgavataṃ śubham | yogyaṃ matvāsmai svaputrīṃ rājā kundanikāṃ dadau ||39|| suśīlo’yaṃ bhāgyavām̐śca labdhvā kundanikāṃ satīm | patnīṃ nṛpasutāṃ divyāṃ mumude kṛpayā hareḥ ||4.6.40|| sāpi lakṣmīsamā dharmavatī bhaktimatī satī | bheje’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāryaṃ vallabhaṃ prabhum ||41|| udārā hi maharddhisaṃbhṛtā dāneśvarī priyā | kṛṣṇapriyā sadā kṛṣṇabhaktiparā vyajāyata ||42|| jāmātā rājabhavane śobhate bhāgyavardhitaḥ | kīrtiścāsyābhavad vyāptābhitaḥ śuśrāva tāṃ pitā ||43|| pitrā prahitāḥ putrāśca putryaścāpi sahodaram | jyeṣṭhaṃ draṣṭuṃ cāyayuśca mahotsāhasamanvitāḥ ||44|| mātāpi gālavīdevī putraṃ draṣṭumupāyayau | pitā tasthau gṛhe tvekastyāgadoṣātilajjitaḥ ||45|| dhanalobhaparaścāpi gṛhe dhanasya rakṣakaḥ | daivayogena viprasya śrīśīlasyābhavajjvaraḥ ||46|| āyuḥkṣayena maraṇaṃ prāpto gṛhe’tinirjane | jñātijanaiḥ śanairjñāte maraṇe tatkriyā kṛtā ||47|| pāpinaśca kadaryasya lubdhasya badarīśvari | mṛtiḥ śūnyā jāyate vai bahuṣvapi kuṭumbiṣu ||48|| lobhadoṣeṇa vipro’sau vāsanādripravāsitaḥ | pretatāṃ labdhavām̐statra gṛhe bhūtaśarīradhṛk ||49|| gṛhapṛdhvīgate dravye kṛtavāso hi tiṣṭhati | nānyaḥ praveśaṃ labhate praviṣṭaṃ pīḍayatyayam ||4.6.50|| khyāto’bhavat sa bhūto’sau pretaceṣṭāparāyaṇaḥ | adattadāno labhate naivānnaṃ bhojanaṃ jalam |||51|| kṣudhāyuktaḥ kvacid rauti rātryardhottarameva saḥ | kvaciddhasati sasphoṭaṃ garjayannambaraṃ bahu ||52|| kvacid viprātmako bhūtvā grāmamadhye’rdharātrike | samaye ca tadūrdhve ca viharatyatiduḥkhitaḥ ||53|| śrīśīlasya gatistvevaṃ jātā badrīprabheśvari | dārabhāmye’pi putrāśca putryaśca patnikā tathā ||54|| rājasammānamāsādya sukhaṃ labdhvā mahattaram | tatraiva jyeṣṭhabhrātuścājñayā nyūṣurnirantaram ||55|| devakanyāsamā rūpe yuvatyo viprakanyakāḥ | rājakuṭumbe bhāgyena vivāhitāstato’bhavan ||56|| mātābhavat susukhinī sutā rājñyo’bhavannapi | putrāścāpi khyātimanto nṛpakuṭumbayoginaḥ ||57|| nṛpakuṭumbikanyānāṃ patayaste tato’bhavan | bhaktiḥ kṛtā hi phalati satāṃ sevā phalatyapi ||28|| dānaṃ puṇyaṃ copakāraścāśīrvādāḥ phalantyapi | jyeṣṭhabhrātuḥ puṇyayogaiḥ sarve rājakuṭumbavat |||99|| jātaṃ yāne bhojane ca dāreṣu ṛddhivaibhave | yatra lakṣmīḥ prasannāsti yatra nārāyaṇo’pi ca ||4.6.60|| yatra devāḥ pratuṣṭāśca tatra nyūnaṃ na vidyate | kṛtaṃ kālena phalati nākṛtaṃ tvāpyate kvacit| ||61|| badrīprabhe suśīlo’yaṃ prajeśvara ivābhavat | mama bhaktyā kathayā ca kīrtanairdānapūjanaiḥ ||62|| athaikadā pitā preto nijapatnyāmupāyayau | āveśaṃ bahulaṃ prāpya ruroda bahudhā tataḥ ||63|| bhajanena kṛtaḥ sarvaiḥ sphuṭākṣaraśca ko bhavān | jagādāhaṃ pitā nāmnā śrīśīlo’smi mṛto’smi ca |||64|| atha śokaṃ gatāḥ sarve ruruduścāpi laukikam | kriyāṃ cakrustato rājña ājñāmāsādya te janāḥ ||65|| yayau laukikakāryārthaṃ śrāddhārthaṃ tanmṛtisthalam | pattanaṃ mauktikahāraṃ cakruḥ śrāddhādi karma ca ||66|| uddhārārthaṃ pitustatra bahudānāni te daduḥ | putrāścakrurhi bahudhoddhārapuṇyāni tatra ha ||67|| gaṇḍakyā cāsthivinyāsaṃ cakruste vārṣikaṃ vidhim | yaddhanaṃ tvarjitaṃ pitrā nihitaṃ bhūtale’pi ca ||68|| sarvaṃ dāneṣu putrāste daduḥ kadaryadūṣitam | tathāpi pretaviprasya sadgatirna vyajāyata ||69|| kṛte yajñe’pi badrīśi na muktirvāsanāvataḥ | kiṃ punardānakarmādi mokṣadaṃ vāsanāvataḥ ||4.6.70|| na mokṣaṃ samavāpāsau punaḥ patnyāmupāyayau | sakampaṃ ca mahākrośaṃ kṛtvovāca nijātmajān ||71|| na me muktiḥ prajātā vai vāsanā bādhate hi mām | bhojanasya suveṣāderlobhasya ca dhanasya ca ||72|| vāsanāparihārārthaṃ yāntu badarikāśramam | naranārāyaṇāvāsaṃ maharṣigaṇasevitam ||73|| śrāddhaṃ madarthaṃ tatraiva kurvantu badarītale | divyaṃ ca badaraṃ mahyaṃ bhojanārthaṃ dadatvapi ||74|| nārāyaṇārpitaṃ vāri phalaṃ ca badaraṃ mahat | tathā ca valkalaṃ vastraṃ kambalaṃ vā yathocitam ||75|| badarīphalakṛddhāraṃ badarīrasamityapi | śrāddhe mahyaṃ dadatveva tṛptirme śāśvatī tathā ||76|| bhaviṣyati kṣudhānāśastṛṣānāśo bhaviṣyati | vāsanā badrīśanārāyaṇāgre me vinaṃkṣyati ||77|| patnyāmāviśya badarīnāthaṃ tvāyāmi vai saha | kurvantu mama kāryāṇi divye badarikāśrame ||78|| ekasyapi badarasya dānena tarpaṇaṃ mama | mokṣadaṃ śāśvatatṛptipradaṃ syānme na saṃśayaḥ ||79|| anyathā me na vai mokṣaḥ koṭidānairapīha vai | kadaryāṇāṃ na vai mokṣastīrthāyute kṛte’pi hi ||4.6.80|| atha te prayayuḥ sarve padbhyāṃ badarikāśramam | saṃsnustatrādigaṃgāyā nemurnaraṃ narāyaṇam ||81|| badrīprabhāṃ praṇemuśca sādhvarṣīnārcayam̐stathā | sarvatīrthāni kṛtvaiva śrāddhaṃ cakruḥ samāhitāḥ ||82|| jyeṣṭhaputro dadau piṇḍān badarākhyaṃ phalaṃ tathā | gāṃgeyaṃ salilaṃ nārāyaṇapādaprasādajam ||83|| dadau suvarṇadānaṃ ca viprāya valkalaṃ tathā | godānaṃ ca tathā dānottamāni bhūmidānakam ||84|| gorasādipradānāni miṣṭānnāni ghṛtāni ca | ambarāṇi vicitrāṇi dadurnṛpocitāni hi ||85|| jagrāha śrīśīlavipraḥ sākṣādāgatya vai kare | badaraṃ ca jalaṃ ramyaṃ valkalaṃ śarkarāṃ tathā ||86|| anyat sarvaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ ca prāpya tṛptiṃ jagāma saḥ | patnyāṃ praviśya tatraiva prāha tṛpto’smi sarvathā ||87|| idānīṃ śāśvatā lokā madarthaṃ samupasthitāḥ | pretatā me gatā tvatra hyeṣa yāmi paraṃ padam ||88|| vāsanā me tadā naṣṭā māyā naṣṭā durantagā | pāpāni mama naṣṭāni puṇyaṃ jātaṃ ca muktikṛt ||89|| vimānaṃ ca madarthaṃ vai samāgataṃ sutaijasam | naranārāyaṇakṛṣṇapāṣadaiḥ śobhanaṃ param ||4.6.90|| sarve bhavantu sukhinaḥ putrāḥ putryaśca me priyā | ekena badareṇāhaṃ śāśvatīṃ tṛptimāptavān ||9 1 || eṣa yāmi svasti vo’stu tārito’haṃ vrajāmi vai | ityuktvā divyasadane tvadhiruhya vimānake ||92|| pārṣadairviṣṇubhaktaiśca
