sanmānito hi paśyatām | sarveṣāṃ nijaputrāṇāṃ putrīṇāṃ yoṣitastathā ||93|| maharṣīṇāṃ paśyatāṃ ca vimānenākṣaraṃ yayau | mahāścaryaṃ gatāḥ sarve naranārāyaṇāśrame ||94|| pitṛmuktiṃ vidhāyaiva nyavartanta sutādayaḥ | pūjayitvā badarīśīṃ badrīnāthaṃ narāyaṇam ||95|| naraṃ sampūjya badaraṃ sabījaṃ prāpya te tataḥ | avatīrya himādrestu nijālayaṃ yayurdrutam ||96|| mauktikāhāramāsādya datvā dānaṃ gṛhasya ca | sarveṣāmupakaraṇādīnāṃ dānaṃ pradāya ca ||97|| āyayuste sukhasthānaṃ dārābhāgyākhyapattanam | śvaśuraṃ nṛpatiṃ dāreśvaraṃ tathā prajājanān ||98|| bhaktān bhaktānikāścāpi prāhurvṛttāntameva te | āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā badarīśapratāpajam ||99|| evaṃ badaradānasya māhātmyaṃ mokṣadaṃ param | kathitaṃ te badrike vai sarvāpadvinivārakam || 4.6.1 00|| tataḥ śrutvā janasaṃghā dārābhāgyābhidho nṛpaḥ | prajāśca saṃghaśo bhūtvā kuṭumbasahitā yayuḥ || 101 || badaryāḥ khalu yātrārthaṃ naranārāyaṇāśramam | sarvasāmagrikāyuktā bhaktilagnaikamānasāḥ || 1 02|| bhajantaḥ śrībadrikeśaṃ dhyāyanto badarīśvarīm | prāpurhimālaye badrīprabhe badarikāśramam || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śrīśīlasya putrāṇāṃ dārābhāgyapattane rājasammānaṃ śrīśīlasya maraṇaṃ pretatā taduddhārāya badrikāśrame śrāddhe badarādidānaṃ pretamokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭho’dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||
<4.7> śrībadarīśvaryuvāca kāntanārāyaṇakṛṣṇa dārābhāgyo nṛpo hi me | badrikālayamāsādya kiṃ cakāra vadasva me || 1 || śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca ṛṣīkeśātsamārabhya pratikrośaṃ sa bhūpatiḥ | vyadhādvai daṇḍavad badrīnāthaṃ dānāni sandadau || 2 || padbhyāṃ yayau śanaiḥ sarvaprajābhiḥ sahito hi me | bhojyavyayaḥ samasto vai sahasradehināṃ nijaḥ || 3 || vrataṃ madhyāhnabhojitvaṃ cakre rājā prajānvitaḥ | sahasramālikāvarttanaṃ cakre pratyahaṃ nṛpaḥ || 4 || prajāścāpi tathā cakrurmālāvarttanakīrtanam | hare kṛṣṇabālakṛṣṇabadrīnātheśamādhava || 5 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapadmāvatīdhava | evaṃ saṃbhūya bhajanaṃ cakruste vācikaṃ pathi || 6 || tīrthavratāni te sarve pālayāmāsurutsukāḥ | bhūśāyitvaṃ brahmacaryaṃ caikabhuktatvamityapi || 7 || nārīṇāṃ ca narāṇāṃ ca mithaḥ sparśavihīnatām | satyavacanaṃ cādrohaṃ cānyagāthāvivarjanam || 8 || asteyaṃ ceśvaravṛttiṃ svādhyāyaṃ phalabhojanam | satāṃ sevāṃ hareḥ sevāṃ sādhvīnāṃ sevanaṃ tathā || 9 || kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ sāyaṃ kīrtanaṃ vādyasaṃyutam | vṛddhānāṃ vandanaṃ prātardevānāṃ pūjanaṃ prage || 4.7.1 0|| ahiṃsāṃ cāpi jīvānāṃ nocchedaṃ tṛṇaśākhinām | snānaṃ dhyānaṃ japaṃ cāpi havanaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam || 1 1|| pitroḥ prasevanaṃ patyuḥ sevanaṃ sādhusevanam | nityadānaṃ ca gosevāṃ viprasammānamarhaṇam || 12|| annavastrapradānaṃ ca dhūpadīpanivedanam | vratānyevaṃvidhānyeva cakrurmārge hi yātrikāḥ || 13|| sahasramānavāḥ sarve dārābhāgyanṛpānvitāḥ | badarīśa jaya viṣṇo naranārāyaṇa prabho || 14|| gaṃgā jayatu badrīśī himālayo jayatvapi | evaṃ jayādiśabdaiste sotsāhā ruruhurgirim || 15|| śikharāṇi kajjalāni dhavalāni kramāt tataḥ | vilokayanto bhaktau ca magnā yānti śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 16|| atha nārāyaṇasvāmī sādhurbhūtvā naro’pi ca | tathā śrībadarī sādhvī bhūtvā bhāgavatīprabhā || 17|| bhikṣukāṇāṃ veṣavanto yayuḥ saṃghena saṃyutāḥ | rātrau trayo militvā ca miṣṭasvaraiḥ sukīrtanam || 18|| naranārāyaṇasyaiva kurvanti snehagarbhitam | śṛṇvanti saṃghaśaḥ sarve namanti trīn gurūniva || 19|| bhojayanti pare cāpi sevante tvapare’pi tu | arpayanti yatheṣṭaṃ vai tribhyo yātrālavo muhuḥ ||4.7.20|| trikaṃ cāpi divyarūpaṃ bhāgavataṃ sthale sthale | āvedayati panthānaṃ pathyaṃ pātheyamityapi ||21|| vikretṛrūpamāsādya parvatīyaphalādikam | āpaṇe tviva dhṛtvā ca mārge tiṣṭhati vai puraḥ ||22|| evaṃ śrībhagavān badri saṃghena saha vartate | bhaktā yataḥ prasannāḥ syuḥ sevayā duḥkhavarjitāḥ ||23|| viyogaṃ nijabhaktānāṃ tatrāpi svaṃ prayāyinām | sahate na harikṛṣṇo bhaktāḥ sahanta eva na ||24|| tathā badrīprabho nārāyaṇo’haṃ vai tvayā saha | nareṇa sahitaḥ saṃghe yukte’bhavaṃ nijecchayā ||25|| muktido’haṃ hi bhaktānāṃ pārvatiko’ghanāśakaḥ | dayayā preritaḥ saṃghe vyacaraṃ sādhuveṣabhāg ||26|| sādhūnāṃ sevayā kṛṣṇasevayā tīrthayātrikā | saphalā jāyate badri darśanāt pādavāhanāt ||27|| atha rājñastu saṃghasya parīkṣārthaṃ mayā tadā | rugṇaṃ rūpaṃ mama badri darśitaṃ jvaraveśitam ||28|| calituṃ tvasamartho’haṃ jvarāgninā tadābhavam | mama bhrātāpi sahasā jvarāviṣṭo’bhavattataḥ ||29|| mama patnī satī nārī sādhvī rurodha vai bhṛśam | jvarāviṣṭau pumāṃsau dvau sevanīyau kathaṃ pathi ||4.7.3 0|| ekayā yoṣitā sādhvyā rugṇau pālyau kathaṃ pathi | śītāḍhye himamārge vai parādhīnau suduḥkhitau ||31|| bhikṣukyāḥ sannidhau tatra nāyānti dhanamāninaḥ | bhikṣukī rauti vijane niṣadya sannidhau tayoḥ ||32|| saṃghasthā mānavāḥ sarve dayāyuktāstu tairthikāḥ | ye ye tvāyānti tatpārśve tiṣṭhanti dayayānvitāḥ ||33|| sevante jvaranāśārthaṃ dehaṃ saṃvāhayantyapi | dhairyaṃ vadanti nāryai ca yatheṣṭaṃ saṃdadatyapi ||34|| kramaśaste sahasraṃ vai mānavā rugṇasannidhau | yātrāṃ nirudhya militāstyaktuṃ śaktā na cābhavan ||35|| rājāpi tvāyayau mārge nirgacchan tau vyalokayat | rugṇau sādhūsattamau ca duḥkhinīṃ sādhvikāṃ priyām ||36|| atiṣṭhat sahasā tatra niṣasāda purastayoḥ | papracchepsitamevāpi dhairyaṃ dadau dhanaṃ dadau ||39||| vacanaṃ pradadau tābhyāṃ sādhubhyāṃ nṛpatiḥ śubham | yāvad rogo na bhavatornivarteta tu tāvatā |38|| nāsmāt sthānāt prayāsyāmi tvagre badarikāśramam | saha nītvaina yāsyāmi mā khedaṃ kurutaṃ yuvām ||39|| sarve vayaṃ nivatsyāmaścātraiva svasthatāvadhim | yadvājñayā tu bhavatorvāṃ kṛtvā skandhavāhinau ||4.7.40|| yāsyāmo badarītīrthaṃ santo hi hṛdayaṃ hareḥ | na tyaktavyā mokṣaṇārthaiḥ prāptāḥ santaḥ kadācana ||41|| sādhvīyaṃ mā śucaṃ yātu tiṣṭhāmastvatsahāyinaḥ | badrīnātho drutaṃ cemau nīrugṇau vidadhātviha |||42|| evaṃ niścitya rājāpi prajāścāpi haripriyāḥ | sarve yātrāṃ vihāyaiva sādhvarthaṃ tūṣitāḥ pathi |||43|| atha bhojanapānādi phalādanaṃ pracakrire | sādhubhyāṃ dattavantaśca mudgapakvādimaṇḍakam ||44|| papatustau sukhaṃ sādhvī bhojanaṃ pracakāra ha | sarve’pi bhuktavantaste rātryāgamo’bhavattataḥ ||45|| rātrau sarve kīrtanaṃ ca pracakruḥ kaṇṭharāgiṇaḥ | savādyaṃ śrīnaranārāyaṇanāma pracakrire ||46|| athāpi himavarṣā vai niśārdhavigame’bhavat | śītānalo’bhavad vyāptaḥ saṃghe sarvatra bhūtale ||47|| rugṇau prātarmṛtau tyaktvā prāṇān pretau babhūvatuḥ | rurodha sādhvī sānāthā rurudurnṛpatatprajāḥ ||48|| himasya vigame jāte prātaḥprakāśanottaram | rājā sarvān yātrikām̐śca sambodhayannuvāca ha ||49|| yāvanmṛtau na jīvetāṃ tāvadannaṃ tyajāmyaham | maraṇaṃ sādhubhiḥ sākaṃ manye mokṣapradaṃ mama ||4.7.50|| śrutvaivaṃ yātrikāḥ sarve narā nāryo’pi bālakāḥ | pratijñāṃ tādṛśīṃ cakrurgṛhṇāmo bhojanaṃ nahi ||51 || yāvannaitau hi jīvetāṃ mariṣyāmo’tra nirjalāḥ | yāsyāmo brahmasadanaṃ sādhvarthe prāṇarodhinaḥ |||92|| kimatra yātrayā sādhūn tyaktvā svārthaparārthinām | niṣphalaṃ jīvanaṃ tasya sādhūm̐styaktvā tu jīvati ||553|| api prāṇān pradāyaiva sādhūn saṃrakṣayet sadā | gavārthe brāhmaṇārthe vā sādhvarthe ca satīstriyai ||54|| prāṇapaṇaṃ vidhāyāpi rakṣāṃ karoti yo janaḥ | tasya svargaṃ ca mokṣaśca śaraṇyasya dhruvau matau |||55||| api pañcamahāpāpaprasakto’pi satāṃ kṛte | prāṇān jahāti rakṣārthaṃ sarvapāpāt sa mucyate ||56|| sādhurakṣākṛtaḥ rakṣāṃ karoti bhagavān hariḥ | sādhuṣveva hariścāste sādhureva svayaṃ hariḥ ||57|| yā prītirnijaputreṣu patnyāṃ pitrośca bandhuṣu | tāṃ kṛtvā satsu dehyatra mucyate janmabandhanāt ||58|| yo yatnaḥ svakuṭumbasya bharaṇārthaṃ vitanyate | sa cet kṛtaḥ satāmarthe yatnavān mucyate hyaghāt ||59|| yathā lokaiḥ pakṣapātaḥ kriyate svakuṭumbiṣu | tathā kṛtaḥ satāmarthe tārayatyeva tatkṛtaḥ ||4.7.60|| yathā sneho nijadehe daihike vartate nṛṇām | tathā cejjāyate satsu mucyate bhavasāgarāt ||61 || yathā svārthe kṛtayatnaḥ pumānna manute śramam | tathā satāṃ kṛte yatne snehānna manute śramam ||62|| na pārakyaṃ ca manute manute mokṣakṛcchramam | sa eva labhate dhāmni nārāyaṇapadāmbujam ||63|| rugṇaṃ sādhuṃ tu yastyaktvā yāti dehī madānvitaḥ | sa yāti yāmyalokaṃ vai duḥkhaṃ yāmyanibhaṃ tviha ||64|| mātṛsevāphalaṃ pitṛsevāphalaṃ tathā satām | sevayā labhate kāntasevāphalaṃ hi śāśvatam ||65|| sarvatīrthāni sādhūnāṃ mūrtau vasanti sarvadā | sādhutīrthāvamantā na labhate tīrthajaṃ phalam ||66|| sādhvoretayormārge’tra gatāsvostyajanaṃ hyagham | tadarthaṃ prāṇadānena puṇyaṃ svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam ||67|| iti niścitya rājā ca prajā yātrāṃ vihāya vai | annaṃ jalaṃ vihāyāpi niṣeduḥ śavasannidhau ||68|| cakruste bhajanaṃ tatra satataṃ nāmakīrtanam | atha sādhvī satī nārī prāṇān hātuṃ samicchati ||69|| kṛtvā kāṣṭhāni caikatra śavau nidhāya tatra ca | yāvadagniṃ tatra kartuṃ yāti tāvannṛpaḥ svayam ||4.7.70|| utplutya kāṣṭhacayane nipapāta puraḥ striyāḥ | tato rājñī tathā nāryaḥ prajāścāpi śucākulāḥ ||71 || nipetuḥ sahasā kāṣṭhacitāyāṃ maraṇāya vai | nārī vahniṃ samutpādya śete tu yāvadeva ha ||72|| śerate bhūbhṛtādyāśca na nirgacchanti vahnitaḥ | tādṛśīṃ paramāṃ bhaktiṃ vilokya bhagavān svayam ||73|| citāyāḥ śāntavahnestu sajīvaḥ sanaro hariḥ | utthitaśca hasan divyavapuścaturbhujānvitaḥ ||74|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharo nareṇa śobhitaḥ | tathā lakṣmyā yutaḥ sādhvyā hasannāha nṛpādikān ||75|| bhavanto mama bhaktāḥ stha sarvasvārpaṇakāriṇaḥ | sādhusnehayutāstīrthapāvanāścātmasadṛśāḥ ||76|| ātmanivedinaḥ sarve sarvapāpavivarjitāḥ | vaikuṇṭhayogyā yūyaṃ stha mama prasannatānvitāḥ ||77|| parīkṣitā mayā sarve madarthakṛtayatnakāḥ | madarthaprāṇadātāro madarthakṛtajīvanāḥ ||78|| tyaktasaṃsāraputrādisnehāḥ sādhuparāyaṇāḥ | dhāmayogyā muktiyogyā bhavathātra himālaye ||79|| matprasādāddivyadehā bhavathātra sugandhinaḥ | vyomagāḥ saṃbhavantyeva sarve duḥkhavivarjitāḥ ||4.7.80|| ito dūraṃ na me badrikāśramo vidyate’naghāḥ | āyāntu vyomamārgeṇa sahasā tu mayā saha ||8 1 || ityuktvā bhagavānnārāyaṇo naraśca badrikā | vyomamārgeṇa sarvāṃstānninyurbadarikāśramam ||82|| badaryāṃ abhitastatra tasthuste bhagavatparāḥ | ūṣuḥ pakṣaṃ sevamānā badrīnāthaṃ naraṃ satīm ||83|| ṛṣīndevānpitṛgaṇāndivyāndivaḥ samāgatān | vīkṣayāmāsurūrdhvajñā muktā ivābhavam̐śca te ||84|| athaikaṃ tatra vipraṃ ca tapantaṃ tāpasaṃ munim | vyalokayan badaryagre nārāyaṇajapānvitam ||85|| nirāhāraṃ dhyānamagnaṃ divyamūrtiṃ jaṭānvitam | vyapaśyam̐śca dvijasyāgre tvāyātāṃ kanyakāṃ śubhām ||86|| badarīmūlato divyāmudbhūtāmadbhutāṃ prabhām | viprāya badaraṃ datvā vyalīyata drutaṃ tu sā ||87|| badaryāṃ sā līnabhāvamupayātā narāyaṇī | dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ tu paramaṃ prāptāste nṛpamānavāḥ ||88|| tīrthavidhiṃ tataścakrurnārāyaṇasya pūjanam | gaṃgāsnānaṃ badarasya phalāhāraṃ vyadhustadā ||89|| nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ cakrurnārāyaṇagatāsavaḥ | nīrājanaṃ hareścakruḥ prasādaṃ jagdhurutsukāḥ ||4.7.90|| ekāgramānasā jātāḥ kṛṣṇe snehadravānvitāḥ | tāvatteṣāṃ śarīrāṇi divyāni taijasāni vai ||9 1 || vyajāyanta kṣaṇād badri vimānaṃ cāgataṃ tataḥ | nirvikalpasamādhisthā divyendriyādivigrahāḥ ||92|| taireva vigrahairdivyairāruruhurvimānakam | sarve caturbhujā divyā narā nāryaśca bālakāḥ ||93|| vaikuṇṭhamārgaṃ vimalaṃ tvavicchinnaṃ tathāmbare | vyalokayan hariṃ natvā pārṣadaiḥ saha taijasaiḥ ||94|| yayurvaikuṇṭhadhāmātha jayaśabdāstadā divi | devānāmabhavan badri maharṣīṇāṃ śubhā ravāḥ ||956|| nārāyaṇāḥ sarvanarā nārāyaṇyaḥ striyastadā | divyā vaikuṣṭhayogyāste vaikuṇṭhaṃ viviśuḥ kṣaṇāt ||96|| sādhurūpasya kṛṣṇasya sevāphalaṃ hi mokṣaṇam | dārābhāgyanṛpādyām̐stān svapne dadṛśire prajāḥ ||97|| muktiṃ gatān vimānena mahotsavān pracakrire | evaṃ śrīmāṇikībadri badrikāśramayātrayā ||98|| muktiṃ yānti mānavā vai divyadehā vimānagāḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāt saṃstavādapi ||99|| bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhante vai badrīprabhetivādinaḥ | sākṣānnārāyaṇo yatra yatra tvaṃ badrikāprabhe || 4.7.100 || yatra maharṣayo divyā gaṃgā yatra ca pārvatī| tatra vaikuṇṭhamevāste pañcamaṃ tapasānvitam || 10 1|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne dārābhāgyanṛpasya sahasramānavayutasya badrikāśramayātrāyāṃ sādhusādhvīrūpabadarīnaranārāyaṇadarśanaṃ, parīkṣaṇaṃ, nārāyaṇārthaprāṇadānaṃ, prasannatā, vyomnā vadrikāśramaprāpaṇaṃ, divyadehavattvaṃ, mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptamo’dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||
<4.8> śrībadrīśvaryuvāca ko’sau vipro’bhavat tatra tāpaso badarīsthale | yasmai kanyā ca badaraṃ dadau brūhi hare kathām || 1 || śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca brahmadevo’bhavadvipro lūnīgrāmanivāsakṛt | saurāṣṭre vedavedāṃgapravīṇo makhakarmaṭhaḥ || 2 || prātaḥ snātvā pūjayitvā kṛṣṇaṃ daivatapañcakam | bhikṣārthaṃ sa prayātyeva grāmavasatisadgṛham || 3 || alaṃ prāpyodarapūrṇaṃ nivartate gṛhaṃ nijam | aprāpya pūrṇaṃ vasatigṛhāṃgaṇāni yātyapi || 4 || alaṃ labdhvā gṛhaṃ yāti pācayitvā striyā saha | nāmnā tu viśadākṣyā 3 bhuṃkte devārpaṇottaram |||5 || ityevaṃ vartamānasya gataṃ varṣasahasrakam | vyajāyata na cāpatyaṃ patnī śokāturābhavat || 6 || anapatyasya lokā na bhavanti sukhadāyinaḥ | uddhāro’pi bhavennaiva ṛṇānubandhinastathā || 7 || api mūrkho’pi vaṃśīyaḥ samuddharati pūrvajān | aputrasya gatirnāsti vandhyāyā nahi mokṣaṇam || 8 || tasmāt prayatitavyaṃ vai putrārthaṃ tapaādibhiḥ | vicāryetthaṃ patiṃ prāha viśadākṣī pratāpinī || 9 || gataṃ varṣasahasraṃ vai putro nāsti hi mānasaḥ | na garbhajo nāṃkajaśca na datto na ca rakṣitaḥ || 4.8.1 0|| vinā putraṃ gatirnāsti caiṣitavyaḥ sutastataḥ | sarvebhyaḥ khalu putrebhyo garīyān garbhajaḥ sutaḥ || 1 1|| auraso guṇasampannaḥ pitrośca pratibimbakaḥ | utpādanīyaścāvābhyāṃ putro garbhaja uttamaḥ || 12|| dehi garbhaṃ hariṃ dhyātvā kṛtakṛtyā bhavāmi yat | śrutvaivaṃ pramadāvākyaṃ vipraḥ prāha na me sutaḥ || 13|| lalāṭe likhitaścāsti na te putro bhaviṣyati | stheyaṃ tasmādaputrābhyāmāvābhyāṃ bhavasāgare || 14|| śrutvaivaṃ pramadā prāha bhāgyaṃ tapasā vardhate | putrecchayā tapaḥ kāryaṃ bhavatā vā mayā tviha || 15|| aputrayormaraṇaṃ vai narakāya bhavediti | ṛṇāni trīṇyapākṛtya mokṣe cittaṃ niveśayet || 16|| asādhyaṃ nāsti viprasya tapasvino viśeṣataḥ | tasmāttapaḥ paraṃ kāryaṃ putrārthaṃ kānta sarvathā || 17|| ityuktvā virarāmeyaṃ vipraścintāṃ cakāra ha | patnyā vākyaṃ yathārthaṃ vai nānapatyasya sadgatiḥ || 18|| saṃkalpapūrakaṃ kṣetraṃ divyaṃ badarikāśramam | gantavyaṃ tatra yātrārthaṃ putrārthaṃ tapase’pi ca || 19|| putraprāptirbhavedvā na mokṣasiddhirbhaviṣyati | tasmādubhayasiddhyarthaṃ gantavyaṃ badarīvanam ||4.8.20|| nirṇīyetthaṃ striyā sākaṃ yayau badarikāśramam | tīrthavidhiṃ vidhāyaiva kṛtvāsanaṃ prakāśake ||21 || tapastepe bhūsuro’sau patnyā sākamaharniśam | māsaṃ cakre phalāhāraṃ badarasyaiva kevalam ||22|| māsaṃ tasthau nirāhāraṃ himānilakṛtāśanaḥ | māsadvayānte badarīṃ smṛtvā stotraṃ cakāra ha ||23|| nārāyaṇī satī sādhvī māṇikī śrīḥ ramā ratiḥ | hariṇī kamalā lakṣmīḥ sadā jayatu mādhavī ||24|| mūlinī pattriṇī devī śākhāvatī himālayā | badarāḍhyā narabījā sadā jayatu mādhavī ||25|| śūlāṃkuśadharā sādhvī brāhmaṇī bālayoginī | sarvarṣidevavāsā śrīḥ sadā jayatu mādhavī ||26|| kārṣṇī kṛṣṇapriyā śītā hemānalanivāriṇī | haryaṃganā brahmaśīlā sadā jayatu mādhavī ||27|| sattvamayī bālakṛṣṇasvarūpā puruṣottamī | prajñānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇī jayatu mādhavī ||28|| pārvatī brahmamuktādijaganmātāvatāriṇī | śrīkṛṣṇe vallabhā goptrī sadā jayatu mādhavī ||29|| camatkārasthitā devī tāpasī parameśvarī | bhaktecchāpūrikā cāndrī sadā jayatu mādhavī ||4.8.30|| evaṃ stutvā namaḥ kṛtvopārarāma sa bhūsuraḥ | viśadākṣau tato gatvā pupūja badarīśvarīm ||3 1|| jalaṃ tathākṣatān puṣpāṇyuttamāni ca śarkarāḥ | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanaṃ ca kuṃkumaṃ ca tathāmbaram ||32|| samarpya badrikādevyai nīrājanaṃ samācarat| | aparādhakṣamāṃ cāpi yayāce viśadākṣikā ||33|| tataścākāśavāk tatra badaryūrdhvaṃ manoharā | aśrūyata viśadākṣi badarīvratamācara ||34|| nityaṃ prātarbadaryāstu mūle secaya vāri tu | badaryadhaḥśayanaṃ ca badaryadho nijāsanam ||35|| badrīpatraprapūtaṃ ca badarīphalabhojanam | badrīchāyāṃ samāsādya māsamekaṃ nivāsanam ||36|| badarīrasasammiśravārisnānaṃ tathottamam | badarīphalamālāyāḥ kaṇṭhe nityaṃ pradhāraṇam ||37|| prakoṣṭhe badarīpatraphalamālāvadhāraṇam | kaṭyāṃ badarīpatrāṇāṃ mekhalāyāḥ pradhāraṇam ||38|| badarīpuṣpagandhasya mañjaryā grahaṇaṃ tathā | dhammile badarīpuṣpamañjaryā dhāraṇaṃ tathā || 39|| sāyamārādhanaṃ badrīpramāyāḥ stotrakīrtanam | badrībhūmermārjanaṃ ca badrīgundrasya bhakṣaṇam ||4.8.40|| badrītvakcūrṇayuktasya jalasya pānamityapi | māsānte badarībījāṃkuraropaṇamityapi ||41|| udyāpanaṃ pūjanaṃ ca badarāṇāṃ pradānakam | yathāśaktisvarṇarūpyabhūṣāratnapradānakam ||4 2|| annavastrādidānaṃ ca smṛddhirājyapradānakam | yathā vaibhavadānaṃ ca pūjanaṃ ca visarjanam ||43|| sādhūnāṃ bhojanaṃ cāpi sādhvīnāṃ bhojanaṃ tathā | kanyānāṃ bhojanaṃ cāpi kumārāṇāṃ ca bhojanam ||44|| vadhūnāṃ bhojanaṃ cāpi garbhiṇīnāṃ ca bhojanam | śāṭikāṃ ghargharīṃ colīṃ kucalīṃ stanabandhinīm ||45|| dadyād dāne pramadābhyo mama prasādakāriṇīm | dhanaṃ tu dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt parihāraṃ tataścaret ||46|| evaṃ māsavrataṃ kuryāttasyāḥ putro bhavediti | putrī cāpi mayā tulyā bhavennāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ||47|| śrutvaivaṃ vyomavāṇī sā māsaṃ śrībadarīvratam | pracakāra yathāproktaṃ vipro’pi tapa ācarat ||48|| vratānte badarīdevī prasannā māṇikīramā | kanyārūpā svayaṃ bhūtvā nirjagāma drumāntarāt ||49|| badaraṃ sā kare dhṛtvā dadau tad viprayoṣite | viśadākṣī phalaṃ neme neme tāṃ badarīśvarīm ||4.8.50|| pataye phalalābhārthaṃ sā ceyeṣa hṛdantare | badarī sahasā bhāvaṃ jñātvā viprāya tad dadau ||51|| prathamaṃ badaraṃ divyaṃ sabījaṃ putradāyakam | dvitīyaṃ badaraṃ cāsyai brāhmaṇyai sā tato dadau ||52|| uvāca badarīdevī vipraṃ bhuṃkṣva sabījakam | putravān tvaṃ yathākālaṃ patnīdvārā bhaviṣyasi ||53|| viśadākṣīṃ tataḥ prāha putraste’pi tataḥ param | snuṣāsaṃkalpamātreṇa putrikāvān bhaviṣyati ||54|| putrikā sā mānasīti cākasmād bālayogini | matsamā śrīharerbhaktā nārāyaṇī bhaviṣyati ||55|| dvitīyaṃ badaraṃ tasmād rakṣa snuṣārthamavyayam | prasannāsmi bhava brāhmi vaṃśavistārayoginī |||56|| pautrīvaṃśo gānasaste bādarākhyo bhaviṣyati | ityāśīrvādamevaitāṃ brāhmaṇīṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tathā ||57||| datvā tiro’bhavad badrīnārāyaṇī nareśvarī | kṛtakṛtyo’bhavad vipro viprāṇī pūrṇamānasā ||58|| nārāyaṇaṃ badarīśaṃ badrīṃ prapūjya bhāvataḥ | udyāpanaṃ samastaṃ ca yathāśakti vidhāya ca ||59|| yātrāṃ pūrṇāṃ saṃvidhāya tapaḥpūrṇaṃ vidhāya ca | ṛṣīndevānprapūjyāpi gaṃgāṃ vigāhya vai tataḥ ||4.8.60|| śanairnatvā hariṃ smṛtvā nyavartatāmubhāvapi | ṛṣīkeśaṃ haridvāraṃ puṣkaraṃ siddhapattanam ||61|| kṛtvā tīrthāni tau māsacatuṣṭayottaraṃ mudā | saurāṣṭre tvāyayatuśca kṣetraṃ kuṃkumavāpikām ||62|| tīrthavidhiṃ vidhāyāpi dṛṣṭvā śrīlomaśaṃ munim | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prapūjya tāvubhau ||63|| prāpatuḥ svagṛhaṃ lūnīgrāmaṃ prasannamānasau | pūjābhiḥ pūjitau vāsaṃ cakruturgṛhadharmiṇau ||64|| viśadākṣī babhūvāpi patyurdaurhṛdalakṣaṇā | suṣuve sā susamaye kumāraṃ śubhalakṣaṇam ||65|| dadau dānāni vipraśca jātakarmādi cācarat | viśadākṣī putravatīgaṇanāṃ prajagāma ha ||66|| badrīpārvīramādevyāḥ kṛpayāpatyayoginī | jātā saubhāgyasampannā saphalā gṛhadharmiṇī ||67|| atha kāle prayāte ca suto yadā yuvābhavat | nāmnā nikāmadeveti khyātiṃ prāpa prajāsvapi ||68|| vivāhitaḥ sa pitrāpi dhūnīgrāme śubhālaye | girīśvarasya viprasya sutāṃ sureśvarīṃ satīm ||69|| kanyāṃ vivāhavidhinā jagrāha sa tu maṇḍape | sāpi mahendratulyaṃ vai badaryanugrahodbhavam |||4.8.70|| patiṃ tvāsādya mumude nikāmadevanāmakam | nikāmadevamātāpi snuṣāyai badaraṃ phalam ||71|| rakṣitaṃ cirakālena sopākhyānaṃ dadau mudā | sureśvarī snuṣā bhuktvā phalaṃ badarīdaivatam ||72||| divyajñānavatī jātā satyasaṃkalpaśālinī | yattat sureśvarī patnī kalpayatyeva mānase ||73|| tattat sarvaṃ bhavatyeva yathā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī | evaṃ te badrike proktaṃ sureśvarīkathānakam ||74|| athāgre’pi kathayāmi kathāṃ te bālayogini | tvameva badarī jātā putrikā bālayoginī ||75|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne lūnīgrāmasya brahmadevaviprasyānapatyasya badrikāśrame tapasā prāptavaradānabadaraphalābhyāṃ putrapautrīprāptiprabhṛtinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭamo’dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||
<4.9> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīrame devi kathāṃ bhaktasya pāvanīm | nāmnā nikāmadevasya saurāṣṭre dhūnivāsinaḥ || 1 || dhūnigrāme’vasad vipraḥ śvaśurasya gṛhe śubhe | raivatādreraraṇyeṣu vasatīnāṃ gururhi saḥ || 2 || vaidikaḥ karmadharmasthaḥ kriyākāṇḍaparāyaṇaḥ 1 pañcadevārcanarato yajamānasukhāvahaḥ || 3 || babhūva sa kriyā yatra saṃskāramūlikāstathā | vivāhādisvarūpiṇyo yatra saptāhavācanam || 4 || devotsavā vatsarasyotsavāstatra prajājanaiḥ | ākāritaḥ prayātyeva bahumānyapuraḥsaram || 5 || niṣpādayati kāryāṇi samastāni yathāvidhi | grāme grāme yajamānāḥ sahasraśo’sya cābhavan || 6 || yatra yatra prayātyeva tasmād draviṇamuttamam | vipulaṃ samavāpnoti gṛhaṃ nayati cotsukaḥ || 7 || annaṃ vastrāṇi bahūni vibhūṣā vindate’pi ca | yānavāhanapātrāṇi tathopakaraṇānyapi || 8 || gṛhītvā svagṛhaṃ yāti lobhapradhāna eva ha | nānyebhyaścāpi viprebhyo’nāthebhyaḥ pradadātyapi || 9 || sañcayaṃ kurute saudhe vastūnāṃ nityameva ha | svajñātīnāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ kāryārthaṃ na dadātyapi || 4.9.10 || gṛhamadhye bhavantyeva jīrṇāni śaradādibhiḥ | varṣābhiścāpi naṣṭāni jāyante cātapādibhiḥ || 1 1|| kīṭāḥ khādanti vastrāṇi cānnānyapi bahūni ca | tathāpi naiva lokebhyaḥ pradadāti hi lobhavān || 12|| nikāmadevaviprasya patnī nāmnā sureśvarī | bhaktābhūddānakāryeṣu mahodāryavatī tathā || 1 3|| bhikṣukebhyaḥ pradadāti yathā jānāti naiva saḥ | annaṃ vastraṃ ca pātraṃ ca dadātyanāthadehine || 14|| parameśaḥ prasanno’stu cāntarātmā hariḥ prabhuḥ | evamuccārya viprāṇī dehibhyaḥ pradadāti vai || 15|| kṛṣṇārpaṇavidhānena dadāti bhaktiyoginī | puṇyaṃ cāsyāstato nityaṃ jāyate śāśvataṃ bahu || 16|| antarātmā prabhuścāsyāḥ prasanno vartate hyati | pūjākāle ca viprāṇī yadarpayati śārṅgiṇe || 17|| mūrtau hariḥ samastaṃ tad gṛhṇāti divyarūpavān | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīvallabhaḥ svayam || 18|| śvaśrvārpitaṃ badaraṃ sā bubhuje putrikārthinī | putrīṃ tathehamānāyā viprāṇyāstu gṛhe kvacit || 1 9|| badrīrūpā navavarṣā kanyā kācit samāyayau | na me rakṣākaraḥ kaścinmātāpitṛvihīnikā ||4.9.20|| na kuṭumbaṃ vartate me rakṣa māṃ brahmapatnike | ityevamārthayat kanyā sureśvarī muhurmuhuḥ ||21 || sureśvarī tato badri snehaparā rarakṣa tām | kuru kāryāṇi sarvāṇi gṛhasyeva sutā mama |||2|| pālayiṣye sadā tvāṃ vai mānasī tvaṃ sutā mama | ityevaṃ svāśraye pṛṣṭvā patiṃ rarakṣa sā tu tām ||23|| kanyāpi sevate matvā mātaraṃ pitaraṃ ca tau | atha kāle gate prāpte yauvane bālayoginī ||24|| balaṃ prāpyāpīndriyāṇāṃ vikṛtiṃ na jagāma sā | pṛṣṭā vivāhaviṣaye netyevaṃ prāha bhūsurau ||25|| uvāca mātaraṃ tvādhyātmikaṃ prāgbhavayoginī | mātarmanuṣyadeho’yaṃ mokṣārthaṃ mukhyato’rjitaḥ || 26|| na mātrārthaṃ prayoktavyo bhavārthaṃ vā mumukṣuṇā | gatānyanekajanmāni tanmātrāṇi sukhāni ca ||27|| tatra bhuktāni sarvāṇi na tṛṣṇānto vilokitaḥ | bhoge tu jāyate tṛṣṇādhikā yā na nivartate ||28|| akṣatāyā na me tṛṣṇā vidyate jāyate’pi ca | abhuktāyāśca muktāyā mokṣo hastatale mama ||29|| brahma sampādyamevāsti vivāhyaśca narāyaṇaḥ | gantavyaṃ tvātmanā tatra śrīmannārāyaṇagṛhe ||4.9.30|| hareḥ saṃgo hi satsaṃgastadanyastu kusaṃgakaḥ | satsaṃgaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya labdhavyaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||3 1|| jīvo’yaṃ mānave loke bahudhā strīrvyajāyata | naro’pi saṃbabhūvaiṣaḥ kāmanāṃ tyaktavānnahi ||32|| yadā satsaṃgametyatra vijñānaṃ jñānamityapi | vivekaṃ bhedavijñānaṃ labhate bhaktimeti ca ||33|| pratyakṣe śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe śaktinidhau prabhau | tadā saṃsārapāraṃ vai yāti bhaktajano mudā ||34|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | vartate bhūtale mātargopālakṛṣṇabālakaḥ ||35|| divyo’nantabrahmapriyāpatiḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ | taṃ bhajitvā bhayaṃ nāsti kālamāyākukarmaṇām ||36|| ye bhajante parātmānaṃ tyaktadaihikavāsanāḥ | sādhavaste sadoktā vai sādhvyastā yoṣito’pi ca ||37|| kāmakrodhādayo yeṣāṃ santi naiva kadācana | bhakteṣu cet kvacit kāmo dṛśyetāpi na bandhakṛt ||38|| bhagavatsaṃgamāptasya divyāḥ kāmādayaḥ sadā | kṛṣṇamāhātmyayogena māyāpi caiti divyatām ||39|| ataḥ kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇabhakte durguṇo’pi guṇottamaḥ | divya eva bhavatyeva mokṣadaḥ pāpanāśakaḥ ||4.9.40|| yatra yatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yatra ca tatpriyāḥ | tadrajodhūsaraṃ dehaṃ vāñcchanti bhaktivedinaḥ ||41 || api vṛkṣāstṛṇagulmā vallikā paśupakṣiṇaḥ | kṛṣṇasambandhamāpannāste sarve divyatāṃ gatāḥ ||42|| devapūjyā bhavantyeva teṣāṃ saṃgāt pramokṣaṇam | kiṃ punarmānavā bhaktāḥ kṛṣṇasevāparāyaṇāḥ ||43|| sadā kṛṣṇadhyānapūjānāmasmṛtyādikārakāḥ | mātastvaṃ bhajase kṛṣṇaṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ||44|| tato’haṃ divyatāṃ prāptā sevayā te nirantam | nānyaṃ patiṃ samicchāmi śrīkṛṣṇakāntamantarā ||45|| sarvatra bhagavatprītihetustapa udīritam | prasādito vedhasāpi hariḥ pūrvaṃ tapomayaiḥ ||46|| niṣkāmārpaṇabhāvaiśca sanakādyaiḥ prasāditaḥ | anye vivekavanto’pi viṣṇostoṣaṇahetave ||47|| samācaranti bahudhā tapāṃsi saṃyamānapi | saṃyamena ca vartante bhagavatprītikāmukāḥ ||48|| badaryāṃ śvetabhavane tapaḥ kurvanti sādhavaḥ | bhagavatpremalabdhyarthaṃ sevāprāptyarthamityapi ||49|| anena vā paraiścāpi janmabhiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | yāvatprīto bhavettāvattapaḥ kuryāṃ hi śīlinī ||4.9.50|| harerdāsyapratāpena śivābrāhmīramāsamā | bhaviṣyāmi harerbhaktyā mātaste kṛpayāpi ca ||51 || srakcandanāṃśukābhūṣānaivedyasevanādibhiḥ | prasādya śrīhariṃ kāntaṃ prāpsyāmi svāminaṃ prabhum |||52|| ihāmutra ca sarvāsāṃ niḥśreyasakaraṃ hi tat | dāsyaṃ tapaḥsvarūpaṃ vai śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ ||53|| tatrodyuktasya vighnaughā bhavanti na kadācana | nānāvidhāni bhogyāni svarṇālaṃkārasampadaḥ ||54|| khādyapeyarasādyāśca jāyante bandhanāya na | mātarlokapravāho’yamandhānāmandhagāmivat ||55|| vahatyeva vinā jñānaṃ yatpāro naiva labhyate | kāminyo vidhavāścāpi kāmatṛṣṇākulāstu yāḥ ||56|| mṛtaṃ kāntaṃ praśocanti cāśrayanti narāntaram | kṛṣṇaikabhaktimatyastu taruṇyaḥ sadhavā api ||57|| kāmasukhaṃ tvavamapya bhajanti śrīhariṃ patim | eṣaṇā vāsanā cāpyavivekastatra bandhanam ||58|| divyatā bhāvanā cātmajñānaṃ niḥśreyasāṃ pradam | tasmāt prītaye kṛṣṇasya premabhaktiyutaṃ tapaḥ ||59 || kartavyaṃ mokṣadaṃ mātarmayā tvatsannidhāviha | kṛṣṇe prītiḥ prakartavyā mātaḥ preṣṭhatame mayā ||4.9.60|| yadyat priyaṃ bhavatyasya kāryaṃ tattanmayā sadā | tasya rucyanusāreṇa vṛttyaṃ nityaṃ mayā tathā ||6 1 || viprakṛṣṭe’ntike vāpi stheyaṃ tadājñayā sadā | nāpriyaṃ nijabhaktasya kvāpi kṛṣṇaḥ karoti hi ||62|| bhaktimatī yatra yatra vartate ca tadājñayā | tatra tatra hariryāti bhaktāyāḥ premasaṃvaśaḥ ||63|| ato naiva hi bhaktāyā viraho’sya bhavet kvacit | kṛṣṇo bhaktasya virahaṃ soḍhuṃ śakto na vai kvacit ||64|| mātaḥ śarīrametattu māyikaṃ jīvabandhakṛt | janmanaḥ kāraṇaṃ māyā tamo’jñānaṃ ca mohanam ||65|| satsaṃgaṃ samvidhāyaiva māyāmohādi nāśayet | premṇā dhyāyet parabrahma sākṣāddhariṃ ramāpatim ||66|| kṣetrajñeśaṃ parameśaṃ hṛtsthaṃ kāntaṃ manoharam | divyānandapradaṃ dhyāyed bālakṛṣṇaṃ jagatpatim ||67|| karṇābhyāṃ śṛṇuyāttasya līlācaritramutsavāt | harelīṃlā garīyasyastapodānebhya uttamāḥ ||68|| hareryogena mātarvai niṣkāmatvaṃ sadā bhavet | pūrṇakāmasya yogena sadā syāt pūrṇakāmatā ||69|| dṛṣṭvā naraṃ bālakaṃ vā yuvānaṃ vṛddhamityapi | vikriyāṃ prāpnuyānnārī māyāyuktā hi sā matā ||4.9.70|| narasya trividhasyāpi tvaṃgānāṃ darśane sati | vikriyāṃ tu manāk prāptā bhavet sāpi tu māyikī ||71 || paśuṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā tadvannaraṃ dṛṣṭvā na vikriyām | prāpnuyāt sā bhavejjitendriyā nārī virāgiṇī ||72|| raho vikāramāpannā madhyarāgā hi socyate | puṃso yoge’pi yasyā na vikṛtiḥ sā tu ceśvarī ||73|| brāhmī muktānikā bodhyā brahmapriyā haripriyā | mahāvairāgyasampannā divyanārāṇapriyā ||74|| etādṛśī tu yā nārī nārāyaṇapareśvare | vīkṣya kāmaṃ madaṃ krodhaṃ divyaṃ taṃ manute sadā ||75|| tasyā jñeyopāsanā tu merutulyā hi niścalā | tayāpnuyānmahāsiddhimuttamāmiha janmani ||76|| māyādoṣaiḥ kāmamānasvādairdagdhāśayastriyāḥ | kṛtārthatā na vai syāddhi prāptau satyāmapi prabhoḥ ||77|| māyādoṣā nāśanīyā amāyikaprasevanaiḥ | amāyiko hariḥ sākṣāttatsantaścāpyamāyikāḥ |||78||| teṣāṃ samāgamāt tyājyā māyā ca māyikārayaḥ | brahmabhūtayā vṛttyaṃ vai dāsyā kṛṣṇasya yoṣitā ||79|| na sthātavyaṃ kṣaṇaṃ cāpi vinā kārṣṇīṃ hi saṃgatim | narākāre harau stheyaṃ sarvānandaprade prabhau ||4.9.80|| sādhuvākyāni saṃgṛhya vṛttyaṃ śrīparameśvare | ahaṃmamate santyajya vartitavyaṃ mayā harau ||81 || kaṭhināni sadvacāṃsi hyapi grāhyāṇi sarvathā | aguṇāḥ saṃvinaśyanti prasādāt paramātmanaḥ ||82|| durguṇāśca vinaśyanti satāṃ prasādanāttataḥ | vṛttyaṃ tadagre niśchadmamanodehendriyādibhiḥ ||83|| sarvathā tatpriyaṃ kāryaṃ kāryaṃ naivāparādhanam | aparāghe kvacijjāte prasādanīyāḥ sevanaiḥ ||84|| santo yasyāḥ prasannāḥ syustasyāḥ kālabhayaṃ nahi | śreyaḥ paraṃ niścitaṃ ca tasyāḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ||85|| jñānavatī brahmarūpā na bibheti kutaścana | kṛtārthā kṛṣṇayogena mātarbhavati bhāminī ||86|| viśvastā śrīharau satsu na bibheti kutaścana | anādi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāsmītiniścitā ||87|| snigdhaprītimatī kṛṣṇe na bibheti kutaścana | kṛṣṇa eva varastasyāḥ pātivratyaṃ harau sadā ||88|| hṛdaye’syā bhayaṃ nāsti kṛtārthāyā hareḥ śriyāḥ | kṛṣṇasya vā satāṃ prītyai sarvaṃ jahyāddhi māyikam ||89|| rājyaṃ patiṃ ca bhogām̐śca gṛhaṃ kuṭumbinaḥ striyam | na tasyāḥ kvāpi kimapi bhayaṃ tvanyat prajāyate ||4.9.90|| dikkariṇī madonmattā yathā tathaiva sā bhavet | kṛṣṇagrahagṛhītātmā nānyadicchet kadācana ||9 1 || anenaiva hi dehena yāyāt sā paramāṃ gatim | saṃskṛtā cāsaṃskṛtā vā bhagavaddhāma yāti sā ||92|| brahmadhāmādhipaḥ kṛṣṇo virahākṣamiṇāmiha | sukhāyāyāti ca sukhayitvā nayati cākṣaram |||93||| evaṃ sarveṣu cāṇḍeṣu bhaktasukhāya jāyate | sukhayitvā sakhīn sakhīrnayatyakṣaradhāma saḥ ||94|| deveṣu jāyate kṛṣṇaḥ kvacidṛṣiṣu pitṛṣu | kyacinnareṣu nārīṣu yādassu paśupakṣiṣu ||95|| yāvadarthaṃ vinirvartya mūlarūpaṃ vrajatyayam | dvibhujaṃ tu nijaṃ rūpaṃ nrākṛti muktasevitam ||96|| bhaktecchayā kvacinnijecchayāpi bahubāhumān | gṛhastho vā virakto vā jāyate puruṣottamaḥ ||97|| śreyomūrtiḥ sarvathaiva mātaḥ so’sti pareśvaraḥ | bahurūpaṃ mahaiśvaryaṃ mātastasya kṛpānidheḥ ||98|| dāsyo jānanti nānyāstu kṛṣṇasya cāntarātmanaḥ | so’ntaryāmisvarūpeṇa sarvatrāste varaḥ prabhuḥ ||99|| tasmai samarpitā cāsmi mātaḥ kṛṣṇāya sarvathā | kṛṣṇāśrayabalā cāhaṃ nānyaṃ patiṃ vṛṇomi vai || 4.9.1 00|| hare kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa śrīkānta puruṣottama | tvameva me patirnityastavāsmi śaraṇaṃ gatā || 10 1|| ityuktvā sā virarāma badrike bālayoginī | sureśvarī ca mātāpi mahāścaryaparābhavat || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ sureśvarīviprāṇyai putrīrūpāyā badaryā bālayoginyā muktāyā brahmabhāvopadeśādiritinirūpaṇanāmā navamo’dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||
<4.10> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca tataḥ sureśvarī mātā punaḥ papraccha kanyakām | kathaṃ prāpyeta bhagavān punarme vada vistarāt || 1 || ityuktā sā punaḥ prāha prasannā bālayoginī | tatsarvaṃ te kathayāmi śṛṇu badrīrame hitam || 2 || mātaḥ prāpyo bhavet kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’tisevayā | dāsyena snehapūreṇa tadarthārpaṇakarmabhiḥ || 3 || dehastasya kṛte kāryastadarthānīndriyāṇyapi | tadarthaṃ mānasaṃ cāhaṃ cittaṃ buddhistadarthikā || 4 || kāmo modaḥ pramodaścotsavo mahastadarthakāḥ | ramaṇaṃ svapanaṃ keliḥ sparśaḥ śayyā tadarthikāḥ || 5 || antaraṃ vā bahiścāpi rahasyaṃ ca tadarthakam | guptaṃ prakāśaṃ sarvaṃ vā tadarthaṃ kāryamañjasā || 6 || tena labhyeta kamalākāntaḥ kāntatayā prabhuḥ | mayā tadarthaṃ sarvaṃ vai kṛtaṃ cāharniśaṃ mama || 7 || miliṣyatīti bhagavān bhaktāyāḥ snehapāśavān | bhagavantaṃ hṛdaye me paśyāmi saṃsmarāmi ca || 8 || śayane bhojane yāne mātaḥ paśyāmi taṃ manāk | hasamānaṃ kvacit kāntaṃ cāhvayantaṃ nijāntike || 9 || ramamāṇaṃ rāmaye taṃ ramamāṇā hi tanmayī | sa evaṃ me vyavasthāsu sahayukto vibhāvyate ||4.10.1 0|| nainaṃ tyaktvā paraṃ kaṃcit smarāmi mātaranvaham | khānapānagatisthānaśayanaśravaṇādiṣu || 1 1|| tameva śrīprabhākāntaṃ praseve sahayoginī | ramābhartuśca sādhūnāṃ kṛpayāhaṃ tathāvidhā ||12|| āhāraniyamaṃ prāptā nārāyaṇe parātmani | ātmanaḥ saṃyamaṃ prāptā mālatīśe parātmani || 1 3|| etādṛśī sadā sādhyā kṛṣṇekāntikatā sthirā | sarvābhiścāpi nārībhistadā mokṣaḥ kare sthitaḥ || 14|| brahmacaryavrataṃ tadvai yadvai brahmaṇi kāmanā | brahmacaryavratenaiva dharmāḥ siddhyanti sarvaśaḥ || 15|| mukhyaṃ kāryaṃ kṛṣṇayogo nārīṇāṃ sarvadottamaḥ | divyatāpādako mātarmokṣastena prajāyate || 16|| śrīkṛṣṇe kāntavṛttiryā parāvarttyā na sā kvacit | poṣaṇīyā sādhusaṃgāt prayatnena hi yoṣitā ||17|| kṛṣṇasyārucikṛd yattat parāvṛttyaṃ drutaṃ khalu | aprasādakaro bhāvastyājyo nisargajo’pi vai ||18|| nityaṃ sadanurodhena vartitavyaṃ suyoṣitā | sā jāyate saṃgayogyā divyamuktipradāyinī ||19|| dehābhimānaṃ mānaṃ vā tyājyaṃ kṛṣṇāntike sadā | evaṃvidhāyā bhaktāyā śreyaḥsiddhirbhavediha ||4.10.20|| satsaṃgastādṛśīnāryāḥ kartavyaḥ śreyasāmpradaḥ | yā kṛṣṇe yojayet snigdhā saiva mātā pitā prabhuḥ ||21|| yā kṛṣṇaṃ smārayennaiva yojayenna pareśvare | śreyohetuṃ bodhayenna śaithilyaṃ darśayeddharau ||22|| doṣān pradarśayet satsu śrīkṛṣṇe durguṇām̐stathā | pātayed bhagavadyogāt sā saṃgārhā na sarvathā ||23|| tasyā vacanaṃ mānyaṃ na stheyaṃ sākaṃ tayā na ca | nirayāṇāṃ pradātrī yā sā na mātā śubhāvahā ||24|| kṛṣṇaścyaveta yadvākyānmānyaṃ tasyā vaco nahi | kutarkāścet hṛdaye’pi bhaveyuḥ kṛṣṇabādhakāḥ ||25|| tadā kṛṣṇasya satataṃ kartavyaṃ kīrtanaṃ śubham | prārthanīyo’pi bhagavān dīnabandhurdayārṇavaḥ ||26|| hare nārāyaṇa kṛṣṇa tavāsmi pāhi māmiha | satāṃ nāmāni divyāni kīrtanīyāni vai tathā ||27|| ātmaniṣṭhā tathā kṛṣṇaniṣṭhā kāryā dṛḍhā sadā | divyatā ca bhavecchreṣṭhā kutarkāṇāṃ vināśinī ||28|| kṛṣṇasyākārasaṃsphūrtiryathā syāt kāryameva tat | yatra rūpe na vai kṛṣṇo draṣṭavyaṃ rūpameva na ||29|| yatra gandhe na vai kṛṣṇo ghrātavyo gandha eva na | yatra sparśe na vai kṛṣṇaḥ spraṣṭavyaḥ sparśa eva na ||4.10.30|| yatrānande na vai kṛṣṇa ānandayitavya eva na | yatra svāde na vai kṛṣṇa āsvādanīya eva na ||3 1|| yatra svāpe na vai kṛṣṇaḥ svapitavyaṃ na tatra ha | yatra sthāne na vai kṛṣṇaḥ sthātavyaṃ tatra naiva ca ||32|| yatra veṣe harirnāsti veṣo viṣāyate mama | yatra tattve na vai kṛṣṇaḥ sarvaṃ duḥkhāyate mama ||33|| īdṛgbhāvādisaṃsiddhyā kṛṣṇaḥ siddhyati kāntavat | īdṛk śrīkṛṣṇayogena mātarmuktā bhavāmyaham ||34|| muktayā ca mayā nityaṃ sevyate parameśvaraḥ | evaṃvidhā brahmavettrī paramāpnoti māpatim ||35|| bhaktyāśrayaṃ parabrahma pratyakṣaṃ puruṣottamam | bhaktyā tvananyayā mātaścāpnoti kṛṣṇakāminī ||36|| pṛthivī strī sadā bodhyā bījapradaḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ | sarvā nāryaḥ kṛṣṇapatnyaḥ pārthivyo mādhavāṃganāḥ ||37|| akṣaraṃ cāvatārāśca muktā muktānikāstathā | īśvarāśca surā māyā tattvāni cetanāstathā ||38|| śarīraṃ yasya kṛṣṇasya śarīraṃ tvaṃganātmakam | sa kṛṣṇaḥ sarvatattvātmā sarvarūpapatiḥ prabhuḥ ||39|| puruṣottamarūpaḥ sa brahmapureśvaro naraḥ | anantaiśvaryasampannaḥ sākṣāt sevyo’sti naḥ patiḥ ||4.10.40|| evaṃ jñānaṃ parajñānaṃ muktisādhanamuttamam | pūrṇajñānavatī sā syāt kṛṣṇasyaiva hi kāminī ||41|| cāñcalyavarjitā syāt sā kṛṣṇetarasmin sarvathā | kṛṣṇe netraṃ yojanīyaṃ tvak kṛṣṇe śrīrameśvare ||42|| hastapādāstathā kṛṣṇe yoktavyāḥ mādhavīśvare | indriyāṇi samastāni yoktavyāni rameśvare ||43|| cāñcalyaṃ sarvathā kṛṣṇe lagnaṃ sthirataraṃ bhavet | śraddhāyāstāratamyena yatnaśaithilyayogataḥ ||44|| tāratamyaṃ sthiratve’pi harau bhaktasya saṃbhavet | satsevāyāṃ parā śraddhā yasyāstasyā harāvapi ||45|| bhavatyeva na sandehaḥ sā divyā jāyate drutam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāstu satkathā muhuḥ ||46|| śrotavyāstābhirudayo bhakteḥ snehasya jāyate | harau snigdhā hariṇyeva nārāyaṇī prajāyate ||47|| gāḍhaḥ sneho harau nityaviyogāsahanātmakaḥ | jāyate yoṣito yasyāḥ sā svābhīṣṭaviyojane ||48|| prāṇān jahyād vinā kṛṣṇaṃ sarvaṃ tasyā viṣāyate | vikalā jāyate kṛṣṇaṃ vinā saukhyaṃ labheta na |||45|| raktāsthimalamāṃsādibhṛteṣu sarvadehiṣu | virāgabhāvamāpannā sthairyaṃ naiti hi kutracit ||4.10.50|| puruṣā durlabhā naiva śreyo’dhvaparipanthinaḥ | saṃsārabhramadātāraḥ paratrātra ca duḥkhadāḥ ||51|| duṣpūrakāmāḥ sarvasvahartāro na hitāḥ pare | bahujanmasu bhuktāste muhurjanmapradā narāḥ ||52|| eka eva hi satsaṃgaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo mokṣado mama | taṃ vinā puttalaṃ sarvaṃ kathaṃ puttalamāśraye ||53|| ātmaniṣṭhāvatī nārī narekṣaṇānna muhyati | nāpi kṣubhyati yuktātmā divyā kṛṣṇapriyā kvacit ||54|| ātmātmā nityasukhavān sa prāpyo mādhavīśvaraḥ | ātmāhaṃ brahmarūpāsmi dāsyasmi vai prabhāpateḥ ||55|| brahmātmāsaṃkhyasakhībhiḥ sevitasya priyāsmyaham | sa kṛṣṇo’sti narākāraḥ sa kṛṣṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ mama ||56|| evaṃvidhāyā bhaktāyā divyā dṛṣṭirvivardhate | ato na svargabhogānāmicchāstasyāḥ pravartate ||57|| tadā laukikadehānāṃ bhogatṛṣṇā kutastarām | etādṛśyā nityasādhvyā yoginyāḥ paramaṃ sukham ||58|| māyā tu duḥkharūpāsti hyabhaktāyāḥ kṛte sadā | bhaktāyāstu kṛte kṛṣṇe sevāyāṃ puṣṭidā hi sā |||59|| bhaktāyāḥ sukhadā kṛṣṇayogadā divyatāpradā | mokṣadāpi bhavatyeva kṛṣṇaprasādadāyinī ||4.10.60|| māyā bandhakarī yā vai hyabhaktānāṃ kṛte matā | bhaktānāṃ yoṣitāṃ sā tu bhaktipuṣṭikarī matā ||61|| dehena manasā vācārpaṇena kāmanādibhiḥ | sevante yoṣitaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ dehādyāstatra mokṣadāḥ ||62|| kṛṣṇaprasannatāprāptisādhanaṃ strīvapustataḥ | prasādito gopikābhirmokṣado mādhavīśvaraḥ ||63|| tathā mayā prasādyo’yaṃ ramākṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ | sarvātmākṣaranāthaśca kālakāleśvareśvaraḥ ||64|| yatra kṛṣṇācāryakānte vikalpo’nyo na jāyate | nirvikalpā sthitiḥ sā vai sādhanīyā hi yoṣitā ||65|| naravat kāmabhāveṣu pravarteta prabhuryadi | adhiko’pi pravarteta pravarteta tato’dhikaḥ ||66|| sarvaviṣayabhogeṣu pravarteta tato’tigaḥ | sarvalokavigarhyeṣu tathāpi mādhavīśvare ||67|| śaṃkā yasyā na jāyeta divyatā utajāyate | sarvakartari kṛṣṇe vai ghaṭate sarvakāraṇe ||68|| sarvameveti jānāti sevate sā haripriyā | haristu vahnivad vyomavattathā lepavarjitaḥ ||69|| koṭiśvarāṇībhoktāpi koṭimuktānikāpatiḥ | boddhavyaḥ sarvadā dhāmni rādhāprajñāramāpatiḥ ||4.10.70|| yaddivyaṃ bhagavaddhāma brahma cāmṛtamakṣaram | tatra mayā prāpaṇīyaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kāntaḥ priyaḥ patiḥ ||71 || evaṃvidhā mama prajñā pramā vikalpavarjitā | śrīkṛṣṇe sarvadā cāstu svāmiśrīmativallabhe ||72|| evaṃ śiṣyā nirvikalpaniścayāḍhyā hariprayā | kṛtakṛtyā nirbhayā ca kārṣṇī nārāyaṇī matā ||73|| kṛṣṇasampattiyuktādvai gurornijeṣṭasiddhayaḥ | prajāyante tataḥ sevyo gururnārāyaṇasthitiḥ ||74|| gurorbalena śiṣyāpi kaniṣṭhotkṛṣṭatāṃ vrajet | nirvikalpasthitiryasyāḥ sākṣātkṛṣṇapadāmbuje ||75 || sā naivākṛṣyate tvanyaiḥ kṛṣṇaśūnyaistaraṃgakaiḥ | bhagavantaṃ prapannā yā na tvanyamānasā kvacit ||76|| sā māyāpāramāpannā brahmapriyā na saṃśayaḥ | kṛṣṇe kṛṣṭaśarīrā sā jāyate puruṣottamī ||77|| kṛṣṇānande kṛṣṇapatnī bhūtvāśnute’tikāmanāḥ | kṛṣṇasevāṃ tu samprāptā modate kṛṣṇakāntake ||78|| evaṃ mātarmahānārāyaṇakṛṣṇaṃ bhajāmyaham | dāsī bhūtvāṅganārūpā seve śrīvallabham prabhum ||79|| arucirbhūyasī me’sti kṛṣṇahīne tu vastuni | atastu māyike tyāge sadāsti vai rucirmama ||4.10.80|| satsu prītirharau prītirnaisargikī mamāsti ca | śrīkṛṣṇe vallabhe sarvasvāmini rucirasti me ||81|| nityaṃ maṃgalamūrtirvai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhu | avatārī samastāvirbhāvānāṃ parameśvaraḥ ||82|| paritaścāntare bāhye so’yaṃ kānto mayekṣyate | divyo divyaguṇāgāraḥ sākāro divyabhūṣaṇaḥ ||83|| koṭimuktānikākāntaścātitejaḥprapūritaḥ | divyalāvaṇyamādhuryaujjvalyaśītalatānvitaḥ ||84|| divyacandanapuṣpādyairarcito brahmaśaktibhiḥ | atiprītyā vīkṣamāṇo māṃ kaṭākṣeṇa harṣakṛt ||85|| pratikṣaṇaṃ cekṣyate’yaṃ navo navo hariḥ patiḥ | tatra bhaktirmama mātarniṣkāmā niścalā sadā ||86|| putre dhane striyāṃ kānte iva sneho harau mama | evaṃ satsu hareścāpi prema sāhajikaṃ mam ||87|| teṣāṃ kīrtanavelāyāṃ mano me tatra dhāvati | śrīkṛṣṇe vallabhācārye gopīnāṃ vallabhe prabhau ||88|| tārābhe tvātmahṛdaye vidyudābhe’nalaprabhe | vāḍavābhe mahātejonibhe cātmani me dhavaḥ ||89|| mamānandapradaścāste brahmānandapravarṣakaḥ | sarvānandapradaścāste tādātmyena sadā mayi ||4.10.90|| nirāvaraṇarūpāhaṃ paśyāmi svāminaṃ mayi | mahāmodapradaṃ śuddhaṃ pūrṇaṃ paśyāmi matparam ||9 1|| etādṛśyā mama mātarmāyārāgo na vidyate | nairguṇye vartamānāyāḥ kuto vai guṇalepanā ||92|| kuto’tra vāsanāścāpi kutaḥ karmāśayāstathā | kutaḥ kośā bhautikāśca kuta saṃgo vināśinām ||93|| kuto drohaśca bhaktānāṃ kuto doṣekṣaṇaṃ satām | kuto’haṃmamatāsparśaḥ kuto bhedādi kalmaṣam ||94|| kuto mānaṃ sarvadoṣanikaraṃ satsu māpatau | rādhāramaṇayogena mātardivyaṃ samastakam ||95|| vidyate me śarīraṃ ca śārīro’pi susevakaḥ | etādṛśīnāṃ muktānāmanyāsāṃ kṛṣṇayoṣitām ||96|| mātarbhavāmi pattrāṇā rajodhūlyādidhūsarā | bhṛtyā dāsī preṣyadharmā dīnā ca sevikāpi ca ||97|| evaṃ māhātmyapānā ca matiḥ kṛṣṇāccalennahi | nāsyā duṣyati dāsītvaṃ kṛpāvedī tu sā hareḥ ||98|| nāsyāḥ patanaṃ dāsītvāt kṛṣṇakāntātvataḥ kvacit | sā śaktiḥ syāt parābrāhmī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇī priyā ||99|| tasyā bhayād vāti vātastapatyarko’pi tadbhayāt | meghāḥ ṛtūnāśrayanti tasyā bhayāt sadāmbare || 4.10.1 00|| abdhistiṣṭhati velāyāṃ bhayāttasya dhruvaḥ sthiraḥ | lokapālāstathā mṛtyuḥ kālo māyā ca tadbhayāt || 101 || vartante nijakāryeṣu yathāyuktā yathāyatham | etādṛśī mahāśaktirjāyate sā hariśritā || 1 02|| tamanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gopālanandanam | prāptāsmyanādikāntaṃ śrīpatiṃ śrīkāntavallabham || 1 03|| tathā varteta yā nārī prāpnuyāttaṃ patiṃ prabhum | tvaṃ mātastaṃ kṛṣṇakāntaṃ prāpnuhi śrīprasevitam ||1 04|| ityuktvā virarāmāpi sā kanyā bālayoginī | sureśvarī dadhārāpi hṛdaye badarīśvari ||1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ sureśvaryai bhagavatprāptisthitiprabhṛtibālayoginyuktamityādinirūpaṇanāmā daśamo’dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||
<4.11> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca badrīpriye śṛṇu tvaṃ ca tato devī sureśvarī | papraccha dāsyaṃ kanyāyai kiṃvidhaṃ tad vadāmi te || 1 || dāsyaṃ dānamayaṃ sarvamātmadānaṃ mahattaram | sukhadānaṃ manodānaṃ buddhidānaṃ tu śārṅgiṇe || 2 || cittadānaṃ mānadānaṃ sarvendriyapradānakam | prāṇadānaṃ dehadānaṃ dāsyaṃ sarvapradānakam || 3 || mātastvevaṃ dāsikā yā brahmapriyā tu sā matā | etādṛśīṃ parāṃ dāsīṃ mānavaścāmaro’pi vā || 4 || cālayituṃ samartho na kṛṣṇakāntāt pathāntare | dāsyāścaivaṃvidhāyāstu bhayaṃ manāṅ na vidyate || 5 || dāsī sā devadevasya śrīpateḥ padminīpateḥ | yathā tathā satāṃ dāsī prajñāvad bālayoginī || 6 || dhanyeyaṃ yā satāṃ yogaṃ hareryogaṃ ca vindate | naraṃ kāntaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ sevate bālayoginī || 7 || siddhaṃ kārya bhavet| tasyā mātardāsyaṃ cidambare | yadatrānubhūyamānaṃ vikāsate’kṣare pade || 8 || tadrūpaṃ caitadevāpi svasiddhaṃ paramātmanaḥ | śreyase cobhayaṃ rūpaṃ tathānantāni yānyapi || 9 || saccidānandarūpāṇi lāvaṇyasaṃbhṛtānyapi | divyaiśvaryapūritāni sarvālaṃkāravanti ca || 4.11.1 0|| koṭikāmasurūpāṇi cānantataijasāni hi | naikaśaktikalāvanti sarvāntaryamanāni ca || 1 1|| anantakoṭirādhāśrīlakṣmīkṣāsukhamuttamam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśanesti ve || 12|| sa kāryārthaṃ bahūnyeva dhatte rūpāṇi mādhavaḥ | yathopayogaṃ yojayitvā tirodhāpayati prabhuḥ || 13|| indriyātmā ca devātmā viṣayātmā samīkṣyate | māyikairna tu divyairvai dāsyaṃ prāptairhi dehibhiḥ || 14|| māyāmayīcchayā līlā nārāyaṇasya sāsti hi | sarvā kalyāṇarūpā sā divyadhāmapradā hi sā || 15|| narākāre bhāvanā sā divyā dāsītvabodhinī | narākāreṣu yā satsu divyā sā bhāvanottamā || 16|| kṛṣṇavat sarvathā kāryā kṛṣṇadāsitvabodhikā | nārīṣvapi ca sādhvīṣu divyā sā bhāvanottamā || 17|| kartavyā sarvadā mātardāsitvabodhikā tathā | brahmapriyātvaṃ cāpyeta tayā sarvordhvayā tataḥ || 18|| evaṃ bhāvanayā yuktaṃ dāsyaṃ pūrṇaṃ prakāśate | saṃsādhyaivaṃ paraṃ kāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ labhate nānyathā || 19|| dāsyāḥ kṛṣṇa indriyāṇi divyāni vidadhāti vai | kṛṣṇayogena saugandhyaṃ divyaṃ dehe prajāyate ||4.11.20|| kṛṣṇayogena ca nityaṃ nirāvaraṇatā bhavet | kṛṣṇayogena cānandapūrṇatāharniśaṃ bhavet ||21|| uttamāḥ sarvaviṣayāḥ kṛṣṇayogena kṛṣṇavat | jāyante śāntaye mātarniratyayāstathāvyayāḥ ||22|| asaṃkhyasṛṣṭināthasya sukhordhvaṃ tvākṣaraṃ sukham | tato’nantaguṇaṃ kṛṣṇakāntasya sukhamuttamam ||23|| brahmādyā īśvarāstasyāntike raṃkajanā iva | bhavanti sarvathā mātastaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hṛdi dhārayet ||24|| pūrṇānandanidhestveke sukhaṃ sarvaṃ samāpyate | na dūre tādṛśaṃ cāste tasmāt kṛṣṇe’rpitā bhavet ||25|| evaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇamūrtibhūryānandapariplutā | jātāsmi te kṛpayātra mātardāsyaṃ bhajāmi ca ||26|| tādātmyānubhavenaiva kṛṣṇakānto’dhibhujyate | nairguṇyabhāvamāpannā sevate yā tu dāsikā ||27|| sevinaṃ kṛṣṇakāntaṃ taṃ labhate sā nijānvitam | mahānandapradaṃ sarvabhogatṛptipradaṃ prabhum ||28|| alpāpi kṛṣṇakāntārthā yasyā buddhiḥ kriyāpi ca | sā divyā brahmaśaktyākhyā sarvasiddhipravarṣiṇī ||29|| nirguṇā kṛṣṇasambandhād divyākṣayākṣarābhidhā | darśanaṃ sparśanaṃ ghrāṇaṃ rasanaṃ śravaṇādi ca ||4.11.30 || svapanaṃ ramaṇaṃ dāsyamāśleṣaṇaṃ hareḥ prabhoḥ | kṛṣṇasyaiva sadā mātaḥ kāryaṃ dāsyā na cetarat ||31|| nānyatra preraṇīyāni dehendriyāṇi sarvathā | viśvastāni kṛṣṇayogāt pātayanti hi yoginīm ||32|| hare kṛṣṇa priyākṛṣṇa mādhavīkṛṣṇa sevikām | dāsīṃ māṃ rakṣaya cānyāt prārthayet parameśvaram ||33|| evaṃ samprārthitaḥ kṛṣṇakānto rakṣati dāsikām | brahmāṇḍe tādṛśo nāsti yādṛśaḥ kṛṣṇasadvaraḥ ||34|| akṣare brahmaṇi svīye rājate yo’tra vidyate | divyābhiḥ śaktibhirdivyapārṣadaiḥ sevitaḥ prabhuḥ ||35|| rādhāramādibhirbhaktyā sevyate puruṣottamaḥ | brahmāṇḍādhisvāmibhiśca prārthyate’ṇḍāgamāya saḥ ||36|| kṛpayā sa bālakṛṣṇastvāvirbhavati tatra tu | devamānavapaśvādau karoti tanmayīṃ kriyām ||37|| yugānurūpaṃ svāyuṣyaṃ dadhāti parameśvaraḥ | balaṃ sāmarthyamevāpi dehaṃ cāpi yathāyugam ||38|| guṇā doṣāśca dṛśyante divyā eva harau tu te | hitaṃ bhavennṛṇāṃ yadvad vartate sa tathā bhuvi ||39|| sajātīyaprasaṃgaṃ sa dadātyeva tathābhavan | tejaḥ saṃkocayitvaiva mānavaḥ san pravartate ||4.11.40|| divye tatra nātiprītirmānavānāṃ yato bhavet | tejasāṃ cāsahā lokāḥ saumanasyaṃ na yanti hi ||41|| kvacit kāryavaśānmātarmahaiśvaryaṃ dadhāti saḥ | pradarśayati bhaktebhyaḥ punarlīnaṃ karoti tat ||42|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāryaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | gopālanandano mātaḥ sarvāvatāradhṛk sa hi ||43|| tasyāśraye bhaved bhaktānikā sadākutobhayā | śarkarārasamūrtirvai yathaikatāttvikī bhavet ||44|| tathaikatattve śrīkānte saccidānandadhāmani | parabrahmaṇi me mātastādātmyaṃ vidyate’dhunā ||45|| yathā vahniḥ praviṣṭo vai tvayogole vilokyate | na lokyate’yogolastu tathā mātarmayi prabhuḥ ||46|| lokyate paśya sarveśaṃ nāhaṃ dṛṣṭipathāsmi hi | aitadātmyamidaṃ sarvaṃ cāhaṃ vyāptā mahātmanā ||47|| cidānandena kṛṣṇena yatra tyājyaṃ na vidyate | evaṃvettrī parābrāhmī jñeyā sā brahmavittamā ||48|| prāptā nirvikalpabhāvaṃ sthitaprajñātinirbhayā | aikāntikīṃ sthitiṃ prāptā kṛṣṇe nirodhitāṃ gatā ||49|| narākṛtau harau jātā dṛḍhasnehānubandhinī | snehamayī sadā bhaktā nirvikalpā matā sakhī ||4.11.50|| matiḥ kṛṣṇe dṛḍhā yasyāḥ kārṣṇī sā kṛtamokṣaṇā | vikalpaiḥ saha yoddhavyaṃ nirvikalpecchayā sadā ||51|| ayudhyamānā viṣayairākṛṣyate patatyapi | sarveśvaraṃ viditvāpi yeśvareśaṃ tyajatyapi ||52|| sā bhaved drohiṇī patyau kṛṣṇe kānte prabheśvare | evaṃ drohavidhātryāṃ vai kṛṣṇo naiva prasīdati ||53|| kālaṃ karma svabhāvaṃ vā māyāṃ vetti tukāraṇam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hitvā sā bhaved drohiṇī hareḥ ||54|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe muktā brahma kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe santi hyavatārā asaṃkhyakāḥ |55|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe sarvāḥ śaktayaśca tapāṃsi ca | aiśvaryāṇi makhāścamatkārāḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe ||56|| devā lokāśca gatayaḥ santi kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe | sṛṣṭayaśca samastā vai santi kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe ||57|| paraṃ tattvaṃ priyaṃ kāntaṃ viduryā jñānasāgarā | sā vettrī śrīkṛṣṇadāsau brahmī sā brahmavittamā ||58|| evaṃvidhāyāṃ bhaktāyāṃ bhavet kṛṣṇaprasannatā | snehātiśayamāptāyāṃ guṇāḥ sarve vasanti hi ||59|| māhātmyajñānayugbhaktā bhavedekāntinī prabhau | satāṃ sevāprasaṃgena kṛṣṇe bhaktiḥ prajāyate ||4.11.60|| manovāktanubhiḥ sevyāḥ santaḥ kṛṣṇasvarūpiṇaḥ | sevātmakena dharmeṇa sādhanena kṛtena vai ||61 || sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavedatra kartavyaṃ śiṣyate nahi | satāṃ yogena bhagavān bahiścāntaḥ prakāśate ||62|| pataṃgavat svayaṃ kṛṣṇastasyā vṛttimayo bhavet | ānandaṃ paramaṃ tena yāti mātarharerhi sā ||63 || dhṛtasya śuddhakāntasya hṛdi cātmani cākṣare | harermāyā sneharūpā sukhayatyeva tāṃ satīm ||64|| pratyakṣe bhagavatkānte rasalīnā prajāyate | kāntā kāntaṃ samāśliṣya brahmānande pramodate ||65|| nimajjati mahānande pare brahmaṇi svāmini | guṇātīte mahānande premarasaṃ pibatyapi ||66|| māyātītaṃ patiṃ prāpya māyātītā prajāyate | harau lagnā hariṃ yāti mocayatyeva tāṃ hariḥ ||67|| evaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prapannāyāḥ kamalātvaṃ prajāyate | yadyat sukhamabhīṣṭaṃ syādasyāḥ sarvaṃ pravarṣati ||68|| prapannāyā prapattirvai harermithaḥ prajāyate | mithaścaikāntikatāpi bhaktāyāścācyutasya ca ||69|| muktavat sarvakarmāṇi mithastayorbhavanti hi | evaṃvidhāyāṃ bhaktāyāṃ mātaḥ satyayugasya tu ||4.11.70|| sarve dharmāḥ pravartante saṃkalpāḥ satyasaṃbhṛtāḥ | mānasyastatra sarvā vai sṛṣṭayaśceṣṭadāyikāḥ ||71|| bhavanti kṛtakṛtyāyāṃ kṛṣṇayogena kṛṣṇavat | kṛpālurbhagavān kṛṣṇaścaudāryaṃ vitaratyapi ||72|| mayā sarvavarṣmavatāṃ kartavyaṃ śreya uttamam | evaṃ kṛpāṃ parāṃ kṛtvā narānnārīrnapuṃsakān ||73|| paśūn drumān pakṣiṇaścoddhārayatyeva yogadaḥ | api śatrūn rākṣasām̐śca daityānuddhārayatyapi ||74|| pāpasthān strīsamudāyān bhogenoddhārayatyapi | pāpāḥ prasaṃgamāsādya divyā muktā bhavanti hi ||75|| sarvatattvāni kṛṣṇasya cānupraveśato drutam | brahmatāṃ yānti māyāpi prayātyakṣarabhāvatām ||76|| netravṛttiḥ sthūlabhāvā raśmirūpāpi taijasī | bhautikyapi harau lagnā brahmabhāvamupaiti sā ||77|| ataḥ sā nirguṇā bhūtvā brahmaprakāśikā bhavet | kṛṣṇākārā mahānandasukhamodapariplutā ||78|| kṛṣṇe sā līyate divye tvātmāśnute sukhaṃ tu tat | evaṃ bhūtvā kṛṣṇarūpā kṛṣṇānandaṃ samaśnute ||79|| mahābhāgavataṃ mātaḥ sukhaṃ kṛṣṇāt prapadyate | samādhau divyanetrāptaṃ kṛṣṇasya darśanaṃ śubham ||4.11.80|| kṣaṇaṃ labdhamapi syāttat sahasrābdakṛtaṃ yathā | akhaṇḍaṃ nirguṇaṃ pūrṇabrahmānandabhṛtaṃ sukham ||81 || bhaktābhiḥ śāśvataṃ vyavasthāsu kṛṣṇe’nubhūyate | narākāre prabhau kṛṣṇe nṛpe vā sādhurūpiṇi ||82|| antaḥsthe divyarūpe vā tat sukhaṃ tvanubhūyate | tasya kṛpālayāḥ santo mileyusteṣu cānvaham ||83|| snehavṛttyā sevayāpi tādṛśaṃ sukhamāpyate | gurormūrteḥ paraṃ divyaṃ sukhaṃ tu sevayāpyate ||84|| gurordrohaḥ satāṃ drohaḥ kṛṣṇadroho vināśakṛt | guroḥ sevā satāṃ sevā kṛṣṇasevākṣarapradā ||85|| drogdhurbhavet kṛmikīṭaśilākāṣṭhādrilokatā | yatra mokṣārthayogo na tasmād drohaṃ vivarjayet ||86|| mānaṃ vivarjayeccāpi bhaktāgre kṛṣṇasannidhau | mānaṃ hi kāraṇaṃ cāsti mahāsurapadasya vai ||87|| āsuratvaṃ nirayāya jāyate dveṣakāritam | tena mānaṃ nayatyeva nirayādhvani sarvathā ||88|| māninastu harau sādhau kalpayantyaguṇān muhuḥ | āpakārṣṭyakhyāpanārthaṃ tato yāntyadhamāṃ gatim ||89|| mānadveṣādināśārthaṃ sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ | kṛṣṇābhinnāḥ sādhavaste pāvayantyapi dūṣitān ||4.11.90|| sādhau snehaḥ paraḥ kāryo yena doṣo na codbhavet | snigdhe doṣo bhavennaiva guṇagrāho bhavet sadā ||9 1 || satāṃ guṇagraheṇaiva kṛṣṇaguṇagraho bhavet | brahmātmadarśanaṃ tena sākṣāddhareśca darśanam ||92|| sarvadā yaugalaṃ bhāvaṃ hariṇā saha vindate | nāsyā nyūnaṃ bhavet sakhyāḥ sakhyuḥ patyuḥ samarjanāt ||93|| anantakoṭisūryenduvahnividyutsamaprabham | akṣarasthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sā labhate sakhī ||94|| pṛthvyāṃ sthitaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ sā labhate sakhī | mahāvīryaṃ mahārūpaṃ mahāśaktiprapūritam ||95|| ānandānāṃ mahāvārdhi kāntaṃ sā labhate sakhī | muktibījāni sarvāṇi labhate kṛṣṇakāntataḥ ||96|| divyonmattā vartate sā manute svakṛtārthatām | tasyā darśanakartṝṇāṃ śrotṝṇāṃ vacasāmapi ||97|| muktirdivyākṣaradhāmni bhaved yāntyakṣaraṃ hi te | mātaścaivaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim ||98|| prāptāsmi sarvahṛdayaṃ kṛtakṛtyāsmi sarvathā | na me kṛṣṇādṛte kaścit saṃsāro mānamarhati ||99|| madvidhā śrīpatiṃ nārāyaṇaṃ śrībadarīśvaram | yā bhajiṣyati bhaktānī muktānī sā bhaviṣyati || 4.11.1 00|| evamuktvā virarāma kṣaṇaṃ sā bālayoginī | badrīpriye punaḥ sā ca mātaraṃ prāha vacmi tat || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ dāsyena nārāyaṇīsvarūpatāprāptyādinirūpaṇanāmaikādaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||
<4.12> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca pārvatike śṛṇu badrīpriye ca bālayoginī | sāha mātre dharmabhṛtaṃ vartanaṃ śīlayoṣitām || 1 || yā satī śrīpatiṃ prāpya vartate sā vadhūriti | sarvasvārpaṇaśīlā ca kṛṣṇadharmā matā hi sā || 2 || kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ nijaṃ dehaṃ tathā sarvendriyāṇyapi | ekīkṛtyāntaḥkaraṇairabhinnā jāyate sadā || 3 || ākṛṣṭā śrīpatau nityaṃ loṣṭhaṃ vai cumbake yathā | tathā jāyeta magnā vai samādhau ca nimajjati || 4 || tatra koṭyarkabhāvyāptaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ samīkṣate | kṛṣṇābhinnasvarūpā sā yogasiddhā tapasvinī || 5 || bahurūpadharā divyā jāyate bālayoginī | śṛṇoti dhāmaśabdān sā brahmāṇḍāni ca paśyati || 6 || tathā svābhāvikānantaiśvaryāḍhyā jāyate sadā | yatra dātuṃ samicchet svadarśanaṃ svecchayā tu sā || 7 || tatra tatrāvirbhavati kṛṣṇavat kṛṣṇakāminī | yathā kṛṣṇastathā kārṣṇī vyāpinī jāyate parā || 8 || tasyā yogāt kupātraṃ yā nārī kṛṣṇātirekiṇī | vimukhāpi bhavet sadyaḥsamādhisthā kṛpākṛṇāt || 9 || vimucyate sadya eva sevayā kṛṣṇayoṣitām | mahāpāpānmucyate’pi sādhvīsevāparāyaṇā || 4.12.1 0|| atipuṇyavatī bodhyā tīrtharūpā hi sādhvikā | sādhvīsaṃyogamāpannā sādhvī satī prajāyate || 1 1|| daivīyogād bhaved daivī divyā muktānikā satī | anugraho’sti daivītve hetuḥ sādhvyāḥ kuyoṣiti || 1 2|| sevayā sādhavaḥ sādhvyastoṣaṇīyāḥ sadā tviha | prasādanīyāḥ sarvadānaiśca mokṣapradā yataḥ || 1 3|| kṛṣṇamado hi sādhūnāṃ bhaktisnehamado’pi ca | tanmadenāśritāṃ sādhvīṃ madayanti hi sādhavaḥ || 14|| kṛṣṇadhyānaikahṛdayāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe ratāḥ | kṛṣṇe cānyān veśayanti kārṣṇān kurvanti sarvathā || 15|| kṛṣṇetaraṃ sarvasṛṣṭisukhaṃ necchanti sādhavaḥ | mamāpi mātaḥ kṛṣṇasya sukhaṃ prarocate’nvaham || 16|| tadanyannirayaistulyaṃ bhāsate duḥkhamulbaṇam | yatra nāsti prabhākāntastatra duḥkhaṃ hi māyikam || 17|| yatrāsti mādhavīsvāmī tatrānando hi śāśvataḥ | jitendriyatā sā mātaḥ kṛṣṇe yadindriyasthitiḥ || 18|| yāvadarthaṃ praseveta kṛṣṇānvitaṃ jitendriyā | kṛṣṇasya bahudhā bhaktyā tasyā dināni yānti vai || 19|| nivṛttidharmaniratā sā kṛṣṇārthapravṛttikā | niḥsaṃgā pramadā cāste badhyate na hariṃ vinā ||4.12.20|| haryājñayā kriyāyāṃ sā vartamānāpi nirguṇā | nirvikārā bāhyarūpe jaḍevāntastu sanmatiḥ ||21|| kṛṣṇatadbhaktasambandhipravṛttau niratā hi sā | nivṛttidharmiṇī saiva bhaktiyuktā ca muktigā ||22|| kṛṣṇamṛte kriyā sarvā cāstyadhogatidāyinī | kṛṣṇārthakṛtasarvasvā tyāginī cottamā hi sā ||23|| pravṛttau vartamānāyāḥ kṛṣṇārthāṃ ca satāṃ kṛte | hareḥ kṛpāpātrikāyāḥ kriyā na bandhadāyinī ||24|| iṣṭaḥ patistu bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | rādhāprajñāpāśavatībadrīlakṣmīramāpatiḥ ||25|| akṣare cāpi goloke vaikuṇṭhe badarīvane | vartate śrīmahārājaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ ||26|| sa evānantakoṭyaṇḍasargasthityantakārakaḥ | vāsudevādirūpaḥ saḥ keśavādisvarūpadhṛk||27|| pratyakṣaḥ sa narākāraḥ koṭyarbudābjaśaktidhṛk | kṣetre kuṃkumavāpyāṃ vai bālakṛṣṇo virājate ||28|| badaryāṃ śrīnaranārāyaṇaḥ so’pi virājate | tasya śaktiḥ śīlasādhvī saivāsti bālayoginī ||29|| tasyā dharmā mama dharmā mātarviddhi sadā śubhāḥ | narākṛterbhagavato līlāḥ śravyā hi mokṣadāḥ ||4.12.3 0|| kāmakrodhādibhāvena yena kena bhayādinā | snehena svārthabhāvena kṛṣṇaṃ prāptā hi nirguṇāḥ ||3 1|| nirguṇaṃ janmakarmādi caritre śrīpateḥ prabhoḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasparśo’pi nirguṇaḥ ||32|| viditvā nirguṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ yātyakṣaraṃ padam | kṛṣṇalīlāḥ kṛṣṇabhaktairākṛṣṭaidivyatāṃ gataiḥ ||33|| vidhātavyāḥ smaraṇārthaṃ bādhikā yā na dehinām | lokānāṃ darśanārthaṃ vai sphūrtyarthaṃ bhaktiśālinām ||34|| pāpināṃ pāpanāśārthaṃ dhyānārthaṃ snehināṃ tathā | idaṃkārasmaraṇārthaṃ līlāḥ kāryā hareranu ||35|| nāṭakādi prakartavyaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktivivardhakam | yathākathañcijjīvānāṃ kṛṣṇabhaktirbhaviṣyati || 36|| gurogauṃravabodhārthaṃ bhartavyaṃ supradarśanam | vidheyadarśanaṃ cāpi yojanīyaṃ harerapi ||37|| evaṃ vai śrīkṛṣṇalagnacittānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet | pṛthivyāṃ naradehānāṃ sārthakyaṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā ||38|| kṛṣṇalīlādarśanena jāyate śreya ityapi | kṛṣṇastasya bhaktimanto bhaktāḥ śreyaskarāstu ye ||39|| teṣāṃ divyacamatkāralīlāḥ kāryā janairbhuvi | mumukṣūṇāṃ yathā bhaktirvivardheta viśeṣataḥ ||4.12.40|| vivekena śarīrādau nispṛhatvaṃ yathā bhavet | ekasmin śrīpatau sārarūpe svātmā yathā laget ||41 || saccidānandarūpasya harerdāsyaṃ yathā bhavet| | tyāgo bhaktirdivyatā ca bhaveyuśca yathā sadā ||42|| tathā kṛṣṇacaritrāṇi tvanukāryāṇi nānyathā | darśanaiḥ spārśanairbhāvairmuktiḥ syād dehināṃ yataḥ ||43|| brahmībhūtāśca divyāṃgāste na yānti punarbhave | āvirbhavanti celloke svātantryeṇa harīcchayā ||44|| teṣāṃ tu viṣayā divyā bhavanti bhagavanmayāḥ | vartante te prahitvaiva dehatrayasya bhāvanām ||45|| saccidānandarūpe sve cintayanti hariṃ patim | harerbalāttu teṣāṃ vai hṛtyu copaśamasthitiḥ ||46|| vartate’to na viṣayāḥ praveṣṭuṃ tatra vai kṣamāḥ | ye tvāyānti bhavantyeva divyāste bhagavanmayā |||47||| kṛṣṇasya ca satāṃ sevāparā divyā tathā bhavet | sthitiṃ copaśamākhyāṃ ca labhate śrīpatau sadā | vivekinyāṃ tu dāsyāṃ vai prīyante sutarāṃ hi te ||48|| prīṇanāttu satāṃ sādhvyā nopasargā bhavanti hi | ātmano divyatāṃ jñātvā modate sā narāyaṇī ||49|| ātmaniṣṭhā tathā mātaḥ kṛṣṇaniṣṭhā tu dehinaḥ | pakṣau dvāvambare gantuṃ cidākāśe hi cetanau ||4.12.50|| vijñānaṃ sneha evaitau parameśaprasañjakau | snehaḥ svapne suṣuptau ca turyāyāṃ kṛṣṇayojakaḥ ||51|| pātivratyaṃ vinā naiva mātaḥ kṛṣṇo’nusajjate | dāsyaṃ vinā na vai kṛṣṇo dāsīṃ gṛhṇāti vakṣasi ||52|| dāsyaṃ tu sarvathā cājñākaraṃ kintu nijārthakam | pātivratyaṃ tu kṛṣṇasyārthakaṃ svārthavivarjitam ||53|| dāsyācchreṣṭhaṃ pātivratyaṃ patyarthaṃ sarvathārpaṇam | tadadhīnatvamevedaṃ patnīva gṛhabandhanam ||54|| dāsyaṃ yāvanmano magnaṃ tāvat snehāt pravartate | mano viyuktaṃ ced dāsyā dāsītvaṃ vigamāyate ||55|| ato vadhvā vadhūṭītvaṃ pātivratyaṃ praśasyate | sarvasādhanamūrdhanyaṃ svāmivrataṃ praśasyate ||56|| hareḥ prasannatāprāptyai hareḥ prāptyai tu yoṣitā | āntaraṃ dīyate lakṣmīpataye tu yayā tayā ||57|| prāpta eva hariḥ kāntaḥ sādhitaśca nijīkṛtaḥ | āntaraṃ sarvathā dānaṃ svāmitāmarjayatyanu ||58|| svāmitvaṃ durlabhaṃ mātaḥ kṛṣṇe prākṛtayoṣitām | svāminītvaṃ tu sutarāmapuṇyāyā na jāyate ||59|| māṇikītvaṃ ca rādhātvaṃ lakṣmītvaṃ badarītvakam | akṣare cāpi goloke vaikuṇṭhe badarīvane ||4.12.60|| bahusnehena kṛṣṇasya parayā kṛpayārjyate | bhaktiryathā parokṣe vai deve bhavati dehinām ||61|| tathā sākṣāddharau kānte gurau kāryā hi yoṣitā | tasyāḥ sarve prasiddhyanti divyādyarthā hi śāśvatāḥ ||62|| satāṃ yogāddhareryogād guroryogāt punaḥ punaḥ | prāptavyaṃ labhyate sarvaṃ paraṃ padaṃ kṛtārthatā ||63|| sneho’sti madhunā tulyaḥ kṛtaḥ kṛṣṇe tu mokṣadaḥ | kṛṣṇayogena kāminyāḥ sanmātraṃ brahma bhāsate ||64|| ātmā brahmatvamāpnoti kāmanā nāvaśiṣyate | abhyāsavaśataḥ kṛṣṇe brahmaṇi brahmatāṃ vrajet ||65||| brahmībhūtāyāstu patnyāḥ kṛṣṇe kārṣṇeṣu cānvaham | sneharasaḥ pravarteta sauhārdaṃ ca pramodanam ||66|| harerguṇākṛṣṭacittāḥ śrīrlakṣmīḥ mādhavī priyā | māṇikyā rādhikā badrī kurvanti haritoṣaṇam ||67|| harerdayānidheryogāddhariṇyastāḥ sadābhavan | hareḥ satāṃ sevayā tā nārāyaṇyo’bhavan sadā ||68|| nāsāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā cānyad rocate bhayadaṃ na ca | nārāyaṇīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ vaśe sarvaṃ pravartate ||69|| etādṛśyastu yā nāryaḥ kṛṣṇakānte śamaṃ gatāḥ | kṛṣṇasaṃyogadārḍhyena yātāstāḥ paramāṃ gatim ||4.12.70|| yānti tathākṣaraṃ dhāma paraṃ sarvārthapūrakam | prākṛtā api dehinyaḥ kimu dāsyādiśobhanāḥ ||71|| dehe tvātmātmani śrīśo vartate puruṣottamaḥ | bhaktāyāḥ paramaṃ prītiṃ vīkṣya bahiḥ sa vartate ||72|| dadātyānandamutkṛṣṭaṃ nijasaṃgamasaṃbhavam | ramate ramayatyeva cāśliṣyannijamūrtikam ||73|| snehamāhātmyasaṃvyāptā sevā vighnairna hīyate | pātivratyaṃ kathaṃ nityādhīnaṃ tvabhibhaved dṛḍham ||74|| tannāmasmaraṇāt tasya kīrtanāttasya saṃsmṛteḥ | tatpraṇāmāttasya saṃgāttasya sparśāttadaṃkanāt ||75|| tadaṃśadhāraṇāttasya śayyāvāsāttadanvayāt | taddarśanāttadramaṇāt śvādāpi savanāyate ||76|| gaṇikāpi tasya saṃgānmuktāsu gaṇanāyate | kiṃ punaḥ pātivratyena dāsyena sevikā vadhūḥ ||77|| aho śvādā pramākṛṣṇa nāmayuktā garīyasī | aho tapāṃsi yajñāśca tīrthāni ca vratāni ca ||78|| kṛṣṇakāntasya nānaiva caritārthāni sarvaśaḥ | hareḥ sarveśvarasyaiva nāmnā nirbhayatā bhavet ||79 || dehināṃ kṛṣṇakṛṣṇetigṛhṇatāṃ bhīrnivartate | sevayā pādamūle vai viśatyeṣākutobhaye ||4.12.80|| mahatāṃ sevayā kṛṣṇe praveṣṭuṃ kṣaṇa āpyate | sakāmāpekṣayā mātarniṣkāmāyā mahatsukham ||81|| kṛṣṇārthaṃ tu sakāmāpi niṣkāmā parikīrtitā | ananyabhaktā sādhvīyaṃ kṛṣṇetaranna vāñchati |||82||| śreyase sā hariṃ prāptā tato hariḥ prasīdati | śreyo’rthayā subhaktyā śrīharistūrṇaṃ prasīdati ||83|| sākṣātkṛṣṇe prasanne siddhyanti sarvamanorathāḥ | sukhado nijabhaktānāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kārṣṇā na cetarāḥ ||84|| ataścātmamatiḥ kāryā kṛṣṇe kārṣṇeṣu sarvathā | tatpārśvaṃ sarvathā grāhyaṃ rakṣyaṃ dṛḍhaṃ nijaṃ yathā ||85 || soḍhavyaṃ svāpamānādi mṛtyurvā pārśvarakṣiṇā | teṣu prītirviśeṣeṇa kartavyā dehato’dhikā ||86 || abhāvo na grahītavyasteṣāṃ mātaḥ kadācana | evaṃvidhāyā bhaktāyā bhayaṃ nāsti yamādijam ||87|| tāṃ nābhibhavituṃ śaktā mahākālādayo’pi hi | ataḥ kṛṣṇe mano yojyaṃ vajrabhūvajrakīlavat ||88|| evaṃ kṛṣṇamānasā tu dehe satyasti dhāmani | kṛṣṇe kārṣṇeṣu yā maitrī sākṣarasya prayojikā ||89 || pārthakyaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktebhyo vighnaṃ tatra mahattaram | niḥsnehena vartanaṃ ca dhāmato dūratāpradam ||4.12.9 0|| ātmajñānaṃ harerjñānaṃ bhaktānāṃ jñānamityapi | gopuratrayamevāsti harerdhāmni praveśane ||9 1 || santaḥ sādhvyaḥ sadā jñānatraye tiṣṭhanti sotsukāḥ | sneho dāsyaṃ sevanaṃ ca trayaṃ cāntargatipradam ||92|| santaḥ sādhvyastrayaṃ labdhvā kṛṣṇāvāsaṃ prayānti hi | sarvārpaṇaṃ pātivratyaṃ viśvāsaḥ śayanaṃ trayam ||93 || santaḥ sādhvyastribhiryānti śrīhareḥ śayanaṃ prati | tādātmyaikarasaṃ te vai vidanti śayanaṃ gatāḥ ||94|| aparokṣānubhūtyā taṃ sākṣātpaśyanti sadrasam | kāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ mahānandaṃ cānubhavanti tanmayāḥ ||95|| evaṃvidhānāṃ bhaktānāṃ saṃsāraḥ kiṃkariṣyati | kriyāḥ sarvā bhavantyeṣāṃ divyā dehodbhavā api ||96|| brahmāṇḍanāśamāyāti bhaktānāśaṃ vrajanti na | bhaktāstathāvidhā divyā modante’kṣaramandire ||97|| vṛndāvanaṃ sadā divyaṃ divyaṃ ca tulasīvanam | badrīvanaṃ tathā divyaṃ divyā kuṃkumavāpikā ||98|| divyā sāketanagarī divyo vai rāsamaṇḍapaḥ | gopyo divyā brahmapatnyo divyā haripriyāḥ sadā ||99|| divyāste tvakṣare loke cātrāpi santi cāpṛthak | brahmapriyāḥ sadā divyā divyakāntena divyatā || 4.12.1 00|| kṛṣṇo divyaśca taddhāma divyaṃ vyāpakamatra ca | tatra ye ye sevakāścālayā bhogā vibhūtayaḥ || 10 1|| divyā eva tato mātardivyeyaṃ bālayoginī | tvaṃ divyā vartase nityaṃ mā bhautikīṃ vibhāvaya || 102|| śrīkṛṣṇaśaraṇaṃ prāptā divyā bhavanti dehinaḥ | brahmībhūtā bhavantyeva sakhītvaṃ ca vrajantyapi || 103|| nārāyaṇītvaṃ śaktitvaṃ vrajanti kṛṣṇasevikāḥ | viṣṇutvaṃ ca naratvaṃ ca vrajanti kṛṣṇasevakāḥ || 1 04|| evaṃ śrīkṛṣṇayogo’yaṃ mātaste kathito mayā | ityuktvā virarāmaiva badri sā bālayoginī || 1 05|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ nārīṇāṃ mahābhāgavatadharmāḍhyatādimattvamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvādaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||
<4.13> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tataḥ sā bālayoginī | svamātre yatpunaścāha bālayogavṛṣān śubhān || 1 || mātarbālatvamādyaṃ vai sarveṣāṃ dehināmiha | tatra kāmo na na krodho na svārtho nāpi rāgitā || 2 || na doṣāścātmani dhrovyā nāntaḥkaraṇe nendriye | na dehe nāpi tattveṣu vaiśadyaṃ bālake’nvaham || 3 || svacchadarpaṇavad bālyaṃ sadā pālyaṃ mumukṣuṇā | yauvanaṃ na spṛśed yasyāḥ sā sadā bālayoginī || 4 || kāmanā yauvane vṛttirlajjācauryādikāriṇī | bahvanarthāvahā sā tu vāsanādripravardhinī || 46 || vikārāśca svabhāvāśca kriyāḥ sarvāḥ kṛtistathā | vijātīyāḥ pravartante ceṣṭāstu yauvane khalu || 6 || ta eva doṣāḥ sarve vai nodbhavanti kadācana | śrīkṛṣṇakāntamāśritya yasyāṃ sā bālayoginī || 7 || tapo dharmo virāgaśca niyamaḥ saṃyamastathā | indriyāṇāṃ jaye heturmanojaye’pi vartate || 8 || bālyaṃ sarvajayakāraṃ sahajaṃ bālayogavat | bālakṛṣṇasya yogo vai sarvendriyajayapradaḥ || 9 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasakhyaṃ sukhāvaham | māyākālādijayakṛt karmaṇāṃ gaṇanā tu kā || 4.13.1 0|| ātyantikī mahāśaktirmātaḥ kṛṣṇe bhavet sadā | kṛṣṇe snehācca kārṣṇeṣu snehācchāntiḥ parā bhavet || 11 || avarāyāṃ ca bhaktāyā snehācchāntirhi dāsyavat | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktimatyāṃ śāntirhi śāśvatī || 12|| gurvyāṃ pūjyatayā śāntiḥ samānāyāṃ sakhītayā | evaṃ guṇān gṛhītvaiva bhajet kṛṣṇapadāmbujam || 13|| itastato bhramamāṇo jīvaḥ karmānubandhanaḥ | kyacinnārī kvacit klībaḥ kvacinnaro bhavatyapi || 14|| svatantraḥ paratantro vā duḥkhī sukhī kvacittathā | vane’raṇye pattane vā gṛhe bāhye kvacid raṇe || 15|| kārāgāre yāmyaloke svarge kvacittu mānave | evaṃ karmānucārasya kṛṣṇaprāptirhi durlabhā || 16|| sā cejātā tataścānyanneṣṭavyaṃ dehinā tviha | cakravartinṛpaddhistu malavat kardamādivat || 17|| saṃbodhyā siddhayaścāpi tṛṇavanmṛttikeva ca | ātmā kṛṣṇe yojanīyo girivad dhruvavattathā || 18|| mātarbaddhāsmi kamalākānte satsu ca sarvadā | snehapāśena hariṇā svāyattīkāritāsmi hi || 19|| ato nārāyaṇasaṃgaṃ satāṃ saṃgaṃ prasevanam | notsahe sarvadā tyaktuṃ śirodānaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ||4.13.20|| īdṛśyasmi harau tasya bhakteṣu prītisañjitā | tadvinānyatra lagnā na manovṛttirmamāsti hi |||1 || kṛṣṇasya kīrtane mātarmattatā me prajāyate | vihvalāyā mama kṛṣṇe jāyate dehavismṛtiḥ ||22|| tathāpi prājñavad dehe tiṣṭhāmi śaktiyoginī | dāsītvena harau cāsmi svāmitvena harirmayi ||23|| ataḥ svecchānusāreṇa prabhunaktu harirhi mām | vimāne vā gaje haṃse vaikuṇḍe vā kṣitāvapi ||24|| svarge badrīvane śvetadvīpe vā kṣīrasāgare | goloke śrīpure vāpi brahmaloke’kṣare pare ||25|| avyākṛte’mṛte vāpi harirnayatu māṃ sakhīm | ruciḥ syād yādṛśī tasya tathaiva vidadhātu mām ||26|| na me kṛṣṇapriyād bhinnaṃ naijaṃ priyaṃ hi vidyate | kṛṣṇasyaiva priyaṃ yattat priyaṃ me mānaruttamam ||27|| na vā kṛṣṇecchayā vṛttau viparītaṃ kvacinmama | na ca nārāyaṇecchātaḥ prārabdhaṃ tvaparaṃ mama ||28|| sarveśvare prabhau kṛṣṇe sadā prāptāsmi lagnatām | tataḥ sarvāsvavasthāsu brāhmī sthitirmamāsti hi || 29|| yāmāśritya parā nārī kṛṣṇaikāntikatā vrajet | tatprasādādbhayaṃ tasyā vighnajanyaṃ na cāsti hi || 4.13.3 0|| sāraṃ kṛṣṇetarannāsti sāraṃ bhayaṃ na vidyate | aśīlāyāṃ na sāro’sti kṛṣṇastatra na tiṣṭhati ||3 1|| śīlasthāyāṃ hariścāste jāyate bālayoginī | kārṣṇaṃ sukhaṃ māyikādvai divyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ca durlabham ||32|| prāptaṃ mayā tayā prāptaṃ sarvaṃ sāmrājyamuttamam | kṛpayaiva prajeśasya tatprāptaṃ sāmprataṃ mayā ||33|| brāhmī brahmapriyā jātā nārāyaṇī pareśvarī | bhūyasīṃ paramāṃ prītiṃ prāptāsmi badarīśvarī ||34|| yādṛśī tādṛśī vāpi kṛṣṇakāntāsmi saṃgatā | ikṣurasaṃ paraṃ prema prāptāsmi cāmṛtaṃ harau ||35|| antarāyakaraṃ kṛṣṇe mātastyajāmi dūrataḥ | āsañjanavidhātṛ yad gṛhṇāmi taddhi sādhanam ||36|| viśvāsinī harau nityaṃ bhavāmi bhavanāśinī | anāsaktā paratrāpi bhavāmi kṛṣṇakāminī ||37|| khānapānaśiraḥpāṇipādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ | sādhūnāṃ sevane raktā varte’haṃ kṛṣṇasevane ||38|| atipriyaṃ samastaṃ me’rpayāmi mādhavāya vai | arpayitvā satībhyaśca sādhubhyaścāpi sarvathā ||39|| upayogaṃ tatastasya vastunaḥ prakaromyaham | dayayā sampradāyaiva śeṣaṃ bhunajmi cājñayā ||4.13.40|| karomi śrīhareḥ sākṣād divyamūrteḥ samarhaṇam | mānasaṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi karomi ṛtuvattathā ||41 || pātivratyaṃ puraskṛtya karomi sevanaṃ hareḥ | pativratāyāḥ kāntānye svapne’pi nāsti cādaraḥ ||42|| patyāveva tathā kṛṣṇe prītiṃ karomi nityadā | kṛṣṇabhakteṣu caivāpi kṛṣṇasambandhatastathā ||43 || aikapatyaṃ harau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’smi me sadā | sarvāśceṣṭā prabheśārthaṃ niṣkāmā bandhanojjhitā ||44|| bharjitāni ca bījāni coptāni kṣetrake yathā | nāṃkurāya prabhavanti tathā karmāṇi mādhave ||45|| na janmādipradānyeva jāyante nirguṇāni hi | śrīkṛṣṇasya prasaṃgena jīrṇānīva bhavanti hi ||46|| vāsanāḥ praśamaṃ yānti saṃkalpā na bhavanti ca | naṣṭā bhavati sarvā caiṣaṇā viṣayagocarā ||47|| kriyāḥ sarvā harerājñāmayyo nānyā hi me kvacit | yayā tyaktaṃ jagat sarvaṃ kṛṣṇe prītiḥ kṛtā yayā ||48|| tasyā nānyad gṛhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā mātarhi vidyate | kṛṣṇārthaṃ yoginī jātā kārṣṇī sāhaṃ tathāsmi ca ||49|| jagaddhartā mato dharmaḥ sa me kṛṣṇo’sti netaraḥ | ātmaparicayo jñānaṃ sa me paricayo harau ||4.13.50|| snehaścākṛṣṭabhāvo me kṛṣṇe nānyatra kutracit | bhaktiḥ sevā sarvarītyā kṛṣṇasyaiva na cetarā ||51 || sā me sevā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe nivṛttiruttamā | hareḥ sambandhaśūnyastu dharmo janmāntarapradaḥ ||52|| pravṛttirvā nivṛttirvā nārāyaṇasuyoginī | mahābhāgavatī bodhyā dharmiṇī satkriyā hi sā ||53|| kṛṣṇārthaṃ kṛṣṇasādhvarthaṃ sevārhaṃ divyameva tat | prītiyogyaṃ tadevāsti heyaṃ cānyattu sarvathā ||54|| asaṃkhyānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ sammarde’pi hareḥ kṛte | vāsaṃ kartuṃ samicchāmi nānyathā tu vane’pi vai ||55|| kṛṣṇārthaṃ kṛṣṇasādhvarthaṃ vanaṃ me nagarāyate | yatra kṛṣṇastatra haṃsā dṛśyante tu mayā sadā ||56 || yatra kṛṣṇo na milati vyāghrāyante dvijā api | api badrīvanaṃ śītaṃ nārāyaṇena pattanam ||57|| smṛddhaṃ me vidyate mātaḥ sāmrājyaṃ netaranmama | yatra kṛṣṇaḥ pūjyate na tatsthalaṃ me sakaṇṭakam ||58|| bāṇaśayyā vinā kṛṣṇaṃ puṣpaśayyā tadanvitā | kṛṣṇaṃ vinā hyabhaktāyā jalānnaṃ rocate na me ||59|| akṛṣṇāyā na me prītirdīpo me mānaso hariḥ | hāro me hṛdaye kṛṣṇo maṇirme keśaveśane ||4.13.60|| kalpānando mānase me kṛṣṇaḥ kānto rahaḥpatiḥ | yāsu bhaktirhareścāste yāstvasti kṛṣṇavallabhā ||61|| tā me’pi vallabhāḥ santi mātarnānyāḥ kvacit khalu | śrīkṛṣṇavallabhācārā śrīkṛṣṇavallabhakriyā ||62|| śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaudāryā śrīkṛṣṇavallabhāntarā | śrīkṛṣṇo vallabho yasyā sā satī badarīśvarī ||63|| māṇikyā cākṣare dhāmni tvadgṛhe bālayoginī | nārāyaṇī camatkāre rādhā kṛṣṇasya mānase ||64|| lakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇasya pārśve sā himādrau badarīśvarī | sureśvaryā gṛhe kanyā varte’haṃ parameśvarī ||65|| yā pārvatī harapatnī sāhaṃ prabhośca badrikā | naranārāyaṇavāsā badarī bālayoginī ||66|| kārṣṇyo yā vaiṣṇavīdevyo bāndhavyo mama tāḥ sadā | sadā tābhiḥ saha vāso rocate me’tra vā pare ||67|| snigdhāḥ satyo durlabhā vai bhavanti mānave bhave | premabhaktiprapūrāśca sadā kṛṣṇārthakāmanāḥ ||68|| dāsībhāvena vā sādhvībhāvena kṛṣṇamāśritāḥ | cidrūpāsajjanaprāptyā cidrūpāstāḥ striyo narāḥ ||69|| paraṃ bhāgavataṃ sthānaṃ labdhvā cākṣaradhāmani | premṇā kāntaṃ prabhuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prasādayanti vai ||4.13.70|| snigdhayā bhaktayā bhāvyaṃ kṛṣṇe rasikayā mudā | niśchadmasevayā kṛṣṇaḥ prasādaṃ prakaroti hi ||71|| anuvṛttyā sādhavaśca prasannāḥ saṃbhavanti vai | mānyāḥ prasādyāḥ santaste namanādyairmuhurmuhuḥ ||72|| yathā yathā prasannāḥ syurvidhātavyaṃ tathā tathā | teṣāṃ prasādalabhyā vai mahatī padavī matā ||73|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmisantaḥ pūjyāḥ sadā mudā | mānasī cārhaṇā kāryā yathartusūpacārakaiḥ ||74|| mātaścāhaṃ sadā prātaḥ karomi pūjanaṃ hareḥ | uṣṇakāle śītavāri sugandhi cārpayāmi vai ||75|| snapayāmi śītajalaiḥ premṇā sammardayāmi ca | śītasugandhitailaiśca sugandhisārasadrasaiḥ ||76|| mārjayāmi hareḥ samastāṃgāni sūkṣmavāsasā | sūkṣmāṇi śobhanānyeva navāni cāmbarāṇyapi ||77|| sugandhipuṣpahārām̐śca śṛṃgāraṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca | rājādhirājavibhavān taṃ paridhāpayāmi ca ||78|| candanena harerbhāle tilakaṃ candrakaṃ tathā | kauṃkumaṃ saṃvidhāyaiva karapādatalārcanam ||79|| karomi candanairmātarvakṣaudarapūjanam | sakthijānuphaṇāgrāṇāṃ karomi pūjanaṃ tataḥ ||4.13.80|| dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ sunaivedyaṃ śrīkhaṇḍādi yathāruci | śītaṃ vāri polikādi samarpayāmi cakriṇe ||8 1 || uttarāpośanaṃ datvā datvā tāmbūlakaṃ tathā | ārārtrikaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā cāśliṣyāmi muhurharim ||82|| śīrṣṇi bhāle stanayośca dhārayāmi pade hareḥ | tallagnakuṃkumāktāni mamāṃgāni bhavanti vai ||83|| pariṣvaṃge tadaṃgasthacandanādyaiḥ sucihnitam | samastaṃ maccharīraṃ ca divyaṃ paśyāmi taddhṛtam ||84|| puṣpodyāne ramayāmi nikuñje svāminaṃ harim | viharantaṃ ramamāṇaṃ seve prasannamānasam ||85|| komale śayane puṣpadalālaṃkṛtaśobhane | svāpayāmi prabhuṃ kāntaṃ kāmayāmi yathāyatham ||86|| saṃvāhayāmi cāṃgāni prātarudbodhayāmi ca | varṣāyāṃ pūjanaṃ naijavallabhasya yathocitam ||87|| karomi tu yathā varṣāśaityaṃ tasya na bādhate | īṣaduṣṇajalaiḥ kāntaṃ snapayāmi tathāmbaram ||88|| iṣaddhanaṃ tathānyāni dhārayāmi śubhāni ca | kaisarāktaṃ candanaṃ ca dadāmi pūjane tadā ||89|| tatkālīnasupuṣpādyaiḥ pūjayāmi mameśvaram | bhojanāni samaśītoṣṇāni cāvātulānyapi || 4.13.90|| dadāmi svāmino mātaḥ sebe śayyāgataṃ harim | śītakāle paramoṣṇavāriṃ dadāmi sarvathā ||91|| uṣṇāmbarāṇi sarvāṇi tathoṣṇabhojanānyapi | uṣṇamiṣṭānnapakvānnānyarpayāmi tu śārṅgiṇe ||92|| śayyāyāṃ bālakṛṣṇasya pārśvalīnā bhavāmi ca | prātaryathā na vai śaityaṃ bādhate’sya karomi tat ||93|| evaṃ svasyā mahadbhāgyaṃ jānāmi kṛṣṇasevane | brahmānandaṃ mahānandaṃ sadā prāpnomi vai hareḥ ||94|| akṣare’pi pare dhāmni sevāprāptestu hetavaḥ | akṣarasyādhigamanecchāvattvaṃ satataṃ nijam ||95|| ātmaniṣṭhatayā jñānaṃ bhagavanniṣṭhabhāvanā | bhaktirbhagavataścāpi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ||96|| māyāyā varjanaṃ nityaṃ divyasvātmavicintanam | mṛṣājñānādivilayaḥ pramājñānodayastathā ||97|| snigdhatā mām̐satīnāthe pātivratyaṃ harau tathā | satsaṃgaḥ sādhusevā ca śrīkṛṣṇārādhanā sadā ||98|| evamādibhirhetubhiścākṣaraṃ dhāma labhyate | tatra kṛṣṇasnehapātrībhūtā prāpnoti sevanam ||99|| kṛṣṇāptau svārthadārḍhyaṃ vai yasyāstu vartate sadā | sā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ prabhuṃ kāntaṃ prāpnotyeva na muñcati || 4.13.10 0|| harermāhātmyajñānena jayatyeva hare priyā | harau prītimatī patnī vivardhate’tisadguṇaiḥ || 10 1|| śrutvā kṛṣṇaguṇān kṛṣṇaṃ cintayet kṛṣṇakāminī | viniścinuyāt hṛdaye pārvatīśaṃ narāyaṇam || 1 02|| taṃ tu bhuñjīta satataṃ divyaṃ pratyakṣatāṃ gatam | sa eva śrīharerbodhyaḥ prasādo bhoganāmakaḥ || 1 03|| raṃke vā rājasadṛśe samā prasannatā hareḥ | patrapuṣpārpaṇādyaiśca drutaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati || 1 04|| śraddhāsnehapremabhaktyādibhiḥ śīghraṃ prasīdati | ityevaṃ badrike bālayoginī mātaraṃ prati || 1 05|| bahudhoktvā sthitiṃ svīyāṃ virarāma harau kṣaṇam | punaśca bahirāgatya prabhokṛṣṇeti sañjagau ||1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ bālayoginyā kathitānāṃ bālayogadharmāṇāṃ nirūpaṇamityādināmā trayodaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 13 ||
<4.14> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca tato badrīpriye devi mātre śrībālayoginī | paramaṃ vaiṣṇavayogaṃ prāha te kathayāmyapi || 1 || vaiṣṇavā viṣṇuvanmānyā mātaḥ sarvapravaiṣṇavaiḥ | vaiṣṇavībhirviśeṣeṇa kṛṣṇavat kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ || 2 || sarvathā viṣṇusambandhikriyāsveva hi te ratāḥ | ātmanāṃ ca vaśe yeṣāmindriyāṇyāntarāṇyapi || 3 || brahmacaryaṃ harau yeṣāṃ brahmatā ca prabhau patau | kṛṣṇaikacetaso bhaktā mānyāḥ pūjyā hariryathā || 4 || naite mānavatulyā vā suratulyā na cāpi te | bhaktānikā na mānavyaḥ kamalāstā hi sarvathā || 5 || vaiṣṇavyaḥ sarvathā sevyā yoṣidbhiryoṣitastu tāḥ | dharmāṃśe pāragāminyaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśe sarvavartanāḥ || 6 || haryarthaṃ lokalajjādyāvaraṇādivivarjitāḥ | kṛṣṇetaropabhogādau doṣabhītisamavṛtāḥ || 7 || kārṣṇavaiṣṇavasevāyāṃ kṛṣṇavanmahimānvitāḥ | māyābandhanahīnāśca divyatāmodabhojanāḥ || 8 || kṛṣṇārthadehadānāśca vaiṣṇavārthapravartanāḥ | kārṣṇakuṭumbamodinyo vaiṣṇavīstrījanābhigāḥ || 9 || vaiṣṇavīmaṇḍalaśobhā vaiṣṇavīrucirañjitāḥ | vaiṣṇavyo hṛdaye yāsāṃ sevyāstāḥ kṛṣṇavat sadā || 4.14.1 0|| rādhāvat kamalāvattāḥ sevyāśca māṇikī yathā | badrikāvat prasevyāśca śrīrbhūlīlā satī yathā || 11 || lakṣmīvat padmāvatīvat sevyāstāśca prabhuḥ yathā | lalitāvanmahālakṣmīvat sevyāstā haripriyāḥ || 12|| tāstu śubhāśubhāśceṣṭāḥ kriyāḥ spṛśanti naiva ha | śreyase dehināṃ doṣavilayāya vimuktaye || 13|| hariḥ prajāyate loke tadyogāttā vibandhanāḥ | kṛṣṇavat kārṣṇavaccāpi kārṣṇīvaccāpi tāḥ sadā || 14|| divyāḥ sevyāstoṣaṇīyāḥ sevābhiścāntarārpaṇaiḥ | asaṃkucitabhāvaiścānāvaraṇānuvartanaiḥ || 15|| sevāyāṃ naiva mānaṃ vā garvaṃ cāhaṃkṛtiṃ guṇam | lajjāṃ cāvaraṇaṃ kuryād yā sā sakhī haripriyā || 16|| brahmapriyā sadā brāhmīmaṇḍalaṃ manute hṛdi | kṛṣṇavat sevate cāpi sarvasvadānasatkṛtaiḥ || 17|| vinītā vaiṣṇavīnāṃ tu sannidhau sarvathāmalā | ātmaprauḍhivihīnā ca brahmapriyā sadottamā || 18|| ānandamūrtau śrīkṛṣṇe divyā ānandavārdhayaḥ | romṇi romṇi bhavantyeva cāṇau cāṇau samastaśaḥ || 1 9|| mānaṃ vihāya saṃsevyā ānandā divyacakriṇaḥ | anyānandāḥ śeṣabhūtā sarvaśo’sya parātmanaḥ || 4.14.20|| sevayā samprasannasya prasīdanti hi sādhavaḥ | satyevaṃ sarvakāmāśca pūrṇā bhavanti sevinām ||21 || kāmayet susatāṃ prasannatāṃ kṛṣṇasya sarvadā | tadapriyaṃ prajahyācca prasannatāvarodhakṛt ||22|| prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā bandhanīyā na granthayo’parāḥ | kṛṣṇaprasannatāsādhikāstu dhāryāstadāptaye ||23|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇagranthiḥ parā granthirvivāhinī | tayā tu grathitā baddhā brahmarṣiṇī samucyate ||24|| saiva priyā saiva patnī saiva bhāryā sadharmiṇī |. saiva svasvāminī kāntā bhagavadgranthiyoginī || 25|| premāmbaraprāntajāṃ tu granthiṃ prāpya parātmanaḥ | vareṇyasya varārohā jāyate brahmarohiṇī ||26|| kṛṣṇārohā kṛṣṇapārśvā śrīkṛṣṇahṛdayā sakhī | kṛṣṇe śayanamāpannā kṛṣṇānande pramajjati ||27|| tasyāḥ sambandhataścānyāḥ sakhyo’pi svāminaḥ sukham | prāpnuvanti spṛhābhaktyā tatastathā bhavantyapi ||28|| kārṣṇyāḥ saṃsargayogena kārṣṇyo bhavanti kṛṣṇagāḥ | vinā yatnaṃ prajāyante mātastā brahmayogagāḥ || 29|| tata eva hareryogād bālayoginya eva tāḥ | nārāyaṇyaḥ prajāyante nārāyaṇārdhavigrahāḥ ||4.14.30 || kṛpayā sahayogena prajāyante haripriyāḥ | ātmārpaṇena jāyante brahmapriyāḥ sadā priyāḥ ||3 1 || śuṣkacittā doṣadṛśyo na jāyante hareḥ priyāḥ | pūrṇakāmo hi bhagavān pūrṇānandabharaḥ sadā ||32|| bhaktānāṃ sukhadāḥ kṛṣṇakāntaceṣṭā hi mokṣadāḥ | pūrṇānandasya mātrābhiścānyasṛṣṭiḥ sukhānvitā || 33|| svātmārāmasya kṛṣṇasyārāmo nāparapekṣakaḥ | anyārāmāḥ kṛṣṇakāntāpekṣakāḥ śāśvatāṃśakāḥ || 34|| evaṃmatyavahīnānāṃ bhavedajñānamulbaṇam | mama bhogena kṛṣṇo’yaṃ sukhamānandamaśnute ||35|| itidoṣavatī mātarnaiva syāt mādhavapriyā | sarvāvatāradhartṛtvaṃ veda yā svāminaḥ satī ||36|| sarvasaukhyapradātṛtvaṃ veda kṛṣṇasya bhāminī | sā tadagre mānadoṣahīnā jāyeta tatpriyā ||37|| evaṃvidhāyāḥ satataṃ sāhacaryaṃ tu śārṅgiṇā | kiṃkaryāṃ sarvadā syācca harerbhūriprasannatā ||38|| matsyasya jīvanaṃ vārṣu kiṃkaryā jīvanaṃ harau | sukhaṃ divyaṃ bhāgavataṃ kiṃkaryā jīvane’sti vai ||39|| jīvanaṃ prāṇade kānte sukhaṃ cāpi ca mādhave | ākarṣaṇaṃ taijasaṃ ca kānte prāṇaprade prabhau ||4.14.40 || kiṃkaryāḥ sarvathā cāsti mātaḥ śrīmādhavīśvare | sarvaṃ svatvaṃ harau tasyāstasyāṃ svatvaṃ harestathā ||41 || tyāginī vā gṛhiṇī vā kṛṣṇe taikṣṇyaṃ paraṃ param | yasyā āsvādasya tasyā brāhmītvaṃ śrītvamityapi |||42||| śīlavrataṃ brahmacaryaṃ tasyā evāstyakhaṇḍitam | vairāgyaṃ cātmaniṣṭhatvaṃ tasyāḥ sādhvītvamityapi ||43|| nyāsinītvaṃ ca muktatvaṃ tasyā divyātvamityapi | nārāyaṇītvaṃ kamalāsthānaṃ tasyāḥ sadākṣare ||44|| yasyāḥ prathamaṃ śravaṇaṃ māhātmyasya hareratha | tataḥ snehodbhavaḥ prītistato melanavṛttayaḥ ||45|| ākarṣaṇaṃ sphuraṇaṃ ca tadākārātmavartanam | suravānandapramodādivāñcchā tato’bhiyojanam ||46|| tataḥ prāptiḥ parokṣasya svapne vā sādhurūpiṇaḥ | tataḥ sākṣādbhavet prāptirmahānandasya śevadheḥ ||47|| āśleṣaṇaṃ caikatānānandasparśādijaṃ sukham | sarvaviṣayasaukhyaṃ ca svāmināthāt tadāpyate ||48|| evaṃ bhavet kṛṣṇaratiḥ kṛṣṇapriyā kramātpurā | satāṃ prasevayā kṛṣṇe bhaktyā tādātmyamāpnuyāt| ||49|| satsevayā tvatiprītyā sarvaṃ sampadyate striyāḥ | atiprītyaiva kṛṣṇe tā bhavanti rucivartanāḥ ||4.14.50|| vartanaṃ tyāgarūpaṃ tad divyaṃ nārāyaṇe’rpitam | dehakriyāsu sarvāsu dehabhānavivarjitam ||51 || sādhyo nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kāntaḥ patirmayārjitaḥ | bhāvanāḥ śrīharau kānte sarvā me santi nāparāḥ ||52|| madāśrayasthitānāṃ ca tathaiva santi bhāvanāḥ | tāsveva vāsato modo’nyatra dainyaṃ prasajyate ||53|| etādṛśīṃ sthitiṃ prāpya mano me modatetarām | yo’kṣare rājate svāmī śrīkāntaḥ kānta eva me ||54|| avatārā bhavantyasya śreyase bahavo’pi hi | sa eva bhagavān sākṣāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||55|| ākṣarībhirhi muktābhiḥ sevyamānapadāmbujaḥ | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre’smaddṛṣṭigocaro’sti saḥ ||56|| atyantakaruṇāpūrṇaḥ śrīmadgopālanandanaḥ | kaṃbharāśrīsutaḥ kṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇaḥ prabhuḥ patiḥ ||57|| sadā kiśorarūpaśca sarvakāmātikāmanaḥ | sarvecchāpūrakaḥ kāntaḥ sarvāsāṃ pāvanaḥ patiḥ ||58|| taṃ prabhuṃ śuddhahṛdayā paśyatyeva hṛdambare | varṇena vayasā kāntyā puṣṭyā śāntyā balena ca ||59|| yogyo’sti sarvakāntānāṃ samarthaḥ mādhavīpatiḥ | anubhavitrī jānāti karapāśādhiśāyinī ||4.14.60 || divyaṃ kṛṣṇasya kāntasya sukhaṃ vācāmagocaram | aparokṣaṃ vadhūrvetti vakṣaāśleṣapiṇḍitā ||61 || vadhvo bhavanti mātarvai kānte vividhavṛttayaḥ | kāścit kāntasya hāsye syuḥ prasannā lagnavṛttayaḥ ||62|| kāścit kāntasya vai narmavākyeṣu miṣṭavṛttayaḥ | kāścit kāntasya vai premapūrṇanetre’tivṛttayaḥ ||63|| kāścit kāntasya saundarye śṛgāre yauvane’tigāḥ | kāścid bhāveṣu hāveṣu praśaṃsāyāṃ ca keliṣu ||64|| kāścidekāntaramaṇe kāścid viharaṇe bahiḥ | kāścit prasannā jāyante dyūtajayaparājaye ||65 || kāścinmānapradāne ca kāścit sparśe sahādane | kāścit sahāsane kāścidājñāyāṃ vartane tathā ||66|| kāścittu jalakelyādau kāścit puṣpāvabhūṣaṇe | kāścit prasannā jāyante vāraṃ vāraṃ vilokane ||67|| kāścid yāne vimāne ca śayyāyāṃ ca nikuñjake | kāścid vijane sajane bhavantyākṛṣṭavṛttayaḥ ||68|| kāścidvakṣaḥsamāśleṣe kāścit keśādiveśane | kāścit pāne sugandhe ca kāścit tāmbulake priyāḥ ||69|| evaṃ kāścittu kalahe vaimanasye’tivṛttayaḥ | rājasyo vāpi tāmasyo bhavantyākṛṣṭavṛttayaḥ ||4.14.70|| evaṃ bhāvavaśā vadhvo bhavanti kāntavṛttayaḥ | kānto’pi bhagavān bhāvān vijñāyānandayatyapi ||71 || āntarastho bahistiṣṭhan yathābhāvaṃ nijapriyām | samākarṣayati svasmin mahānandaṃ dadātyapi ||72|| divyānandabharākāraḥ sarvānandapayodadhiḥ | pratyakṣakāntarūpaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’vati ||73|| tanmaryādāṃ mahāmuktā mahāmuktānikāḥ striyaḥ | avatārāstathā vyūhā īśvarā īśanīstriyaḥ ||74|| surāḥ siddhāḥ satīvargāḥ sādhvyaśca sādhavo’malāḥ | yoginyo yatayaḥ sarve pālayanti maheśvarāḥ ||75|| tanmaryādā mayā pālyā tatprītaye sadā śubhā | sa eva lokajīvānāṃ tārako’kṣaranāyakaḥ ||76|| adhamoddhārakaḥ kṛṣṇasvāmī patitapāvanaḥ | āśritāyā manovṛtteḥ pūraṇārthaṃ tathāvidhaḥ ||77|| svasya rītiṃ tirobhāvyāśritavṛttiṃ dadhāti vai | aho kṛpālutā tasyāśritāśrayitvamicchati ||78|| nijāyā api naijatvaṃ saṃvibhāvya pramodate | dhanyā mātarhi sā nārī yā tathā vindati prabhum ||79|| yasyā nānyatra vai śraddhā rucirvā kāntamantarā | puṃputrarasavittādimāyikāhatamānasā ||4.14.80|| patyarthaṃ cānyamantrādau śraddhā
