yasyā na vidyate | prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā yasyā rajanī rañjanī na vai ||81 || alaukikendrajālādipradarśayitṛmānave | yasyā na gauravaṃ śraddhā jāyate harimantarā |||82|| mayi saccitsvarūpe svātmanyeva rājate hariḥ | tatraiva tu camatkārāḥ siddhayaḥ santi matkṛte ||83|| labdhavyārthāḥ samastā me prabhau kānte bhavanti hi | bhramo yena bhavedanyo’nyatra nārāyaṇetare ||84|| evaṃvidhātimatimatpatnyāṃ prasannatāṃ vrajet | prabhuśca prabhuvatpuṇyāḥ santo mahānta uttamāḥ ||85|| satpathasthā harerbhaktā yāsu prasannavṛttayaḥ | tāsāṃ bhāgyaṃ mahaddivyaṃ tābhiḥ sāraḥ samarjitaḥ ||86|| athaivaṃ śrīkṛṣṇakāntasvāmyaṃke saṃniṣadya ca | śrīkṛṣṇetarakoṭyabdheśvaramānaṃ na vāñcchati ||87|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhinne na mohanam | naranārāyaṇasyeva mohanaṃ na striyāṃ nare ||88|| patiḥ ṛṣirnaranārāyaṇo me tāpasaḥ prabhuḥ | śīlavrato mahāmāyāpāravartī himālaye ||89|| nirmoho vartate mātarbadarīvanabhūtale | tathāhaṃ tāpasī mātarbadarīnāthabadrikā ||4.14.90|| varte’haṃ mokṣaśūnyātra gṛhe te bālayoginī | sadā śīlavratā kanyā lokakalyāṇakāriṇī ||9 1|| matphalaiḥ ṛṣayo yānti vinirdhūtāghakoṭayaḥ | madakṣaraṃ paraṃ dhāma svāmino me’kṣaraṃ padam ||92|| vyasanaṃ me harerjātaṃ tadvinā na kṣaṇaṃ mama | kevalaṃ vidyate mātarviśiṣṭaṃ tena vidyate ||93 || snehatādātmyatanvā me līnatā svāmini prabhau | sadāsti tadvinā mātarnāhaṃ bhavāmi sākṛtiḥ ||94|| sarvāvasthāsu sukhadaṃ sarvalokeṣu rakṣakam | prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ priyaṃ kāntaṃ kathaṃ muñcāmyasusthitam ||95|| ādhāramātmanaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sukhāspadam | śrīlakṣmīmāṇikīsevyaṃ lalitāvaramuttamam ||96|| prabhuṃ nāthaṃ badarīśaṃ pāśavatīpatiṃ harima | sarvadā śrīmahālakṣmīsevitaṃ pūjitaṃ tathā ||97|| kambharāśrīśvarīdhyātaṃ lālitaṃ pālitāṃ tayā | prāptaṃ kathaṃ vimuñcāmi vada mātarmanīṣayā ||98|| na śaithilyaṃ harau me’sti na māyāyāṃ pravartanā | nānyadehe ratirme’sti vadānyaṃ cintayāmi kim ||99|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau badrīśi bālayoginī | mātā bhāgyaṃ nijaṃ mene dhanyaṃ sureśvarī satī || 4.14.1 00|| vyacintayaddhareḥ prāptyai putrītaḥ sādhanānyapi | āśīrvādān dadau putryai jñātvā tāṃ badarīśvarīm || 10 1|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ paramavaiṣṇavīyogavivecananāmā caturdaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 14 ||
<4.15> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tataḥ śrībālayoginī | svamātre paramabrahmapremarasaṃ jagāda yam || 1 || mātarhṛdi sadā tiṣṭhed vāsudevasya bhāvanā | prītidārḍhyaṃ sumāhātmyaṃ śraddhā harau prabhūyasī || 2 || mahānandaḥ pramodaśca sukhaṃ virāma īśvare | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe śāntistiṣṭheyuḥ sarvathā prabhau || 3 || yasyāḥ sā bhavati brahmarasavettrī na cetarā | tasyā āpadi kaṣṭāyāṃ sthairyaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe || 4 || anuvṛtāyāḥ kṛṣṇasya kṛṣṇāśrayasatāmapi | sevābhāvayutāyāstu brahmapremaraso milet || 5 || śreyaḥsādhanamāptāyā brahmapremarasodbhavaḥ | ātmanaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśanaṃ vinā || 6 || kasyā api na śāntiḥ syāt sākṣād yogaṃ vināpi ca | yogaśca śrīharereva dhyānopāsanabhaktibhiḥ || 7 || tadvineṣṭarasaprāptyai vṛthā śramaḥ khalehavat | kṛpayā śrīhariryogaṃ dadāti bhaktiyoṣite || 8 || atīva ramaṇīyāṃgaḥ sarvasaundaryasaṃgrahaḥ | nityadivyaguṇāḍhyaśca sarvadehimanoharaḥ || 9 || kṛṣṇaḥ svāmī sevikāśca muktānikāḥ pumuttamam | bhajanti saṃprasevante sarūpāḥ samakāmanāḥ || 4.15.1 0|| asya yogena nairguṇyaṃ yānti guṇāḍhyadehinaḥ | antaryāmitayā sarveṣvavasthitasya cakriṇaḥ || 11 || sa jīvanaṃ cidacitāṃ kartā bhoktā patiḥ prabhuḥ | tathā svataḥsiddhabhūrimahaiśvaryakalānidhiḥ || 12|| tasya śrībālakṛṣṇasya yogaḥ saukhyapradaḥ sadā | saccidānandarūpāyā muktāyā atra cākṣare || 1 3|| paramānandakṛt kṛṣṇaḥ premṇā prasevitaḥ prabhuḥ | svamūrtau nijabhaktāṃ vai līnīkaroti tadrasaḥ || 14|| adya kālāntare vāpi kṛṣṇe līnatvamāpnuyāt | yadā tadā kṛṣṇapremarasamāsvādayet sakhī || 15|| ātmaniṣṭhābalaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārpaṇam | ubhayaṃ prāpya kānte vai līnatāṃ tu sadārjayet || 16|| sarvarājādhirājaśrīkṛṣṇe pramodamāpnuyāt | mahimānaṃ vijānīyād brahmarasamupāharet || 17|| caturdaśāvṛtijuṣṭaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ brahmaṇāvitam | asaṃkhyāṇḍāni santyeṣāṃ rājā virāṭ supūruṣaḥ || 18|| vairājāste hyasaṃkhyātā mahāviṣṇoḥ suputrakāḥ | evaṃ mahāviṣṇavo’pi pradhānapuruṣodbhavāḥ || 19|| asaṃkhyāste pradhāneśāḥ prakṛtipuṃsamudbhavāḥ | sā māyā sa pumān muktokṣare līnau laye matau ||4.15.20|| punaḥ prakāśatāṃ prāptau sṛṣṭyārambhe punaḥ punaḥ | evaṃvidhākṣarāṃśasya sukhamātrābhisaṃplutā || 21 || sṛṣṭiḥ sarvā sukhaṃ bhuṃkte’kṣaraṃ tu sukhavaddhareḥ | anantākṣaramuktāścānantadhāmāni dhāminām ||22|| avatārā asaṃkhyātā muktā muktānikāstathā | aiśvaryāṇi samastāni śaktayaḥ pārṣadāstathā ||23|| pārṣadānyaḥ samastāśca yanmūrteḥ sukhabhāginaḥ | tasyānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ ||24|| ekaikāṃge sukhānāṃ vidyate romaromasu | tasyāgre tvīśvarā jīvāścārkāgre visphuliṃgavat ||25|| atitucchā bhavantyeva brahmāṇḍapālakā api | sarve’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇadattaṃ prabhuñjate ||26|| sukhāṃśaṃ bhuñjate svalpamucchiṣṭaṃ māyikaṃ kṣayi | etādṛśārthaṃ tapasā yatante svargavāñcchayā ||27|| manvate durlabhaṃ cāpi rājasā mohavṛttayaḥ | tadā kārṣṇaṃ bhāgavataṃ sukhaṃ kiṃ varṇyagocaram ||28|| sahajaṃ śāśvataṃ yatra sukhaṃ cālaukikaṃ param | yadaṃśe yogino yogasamādhau yānti līnatām ||29|| sahasravatsarān tatra tiṣṭhantyavyaktamodinaḥ | mahāsuṣuptau turyāyāṃ bhavanti sukhino’pare || 4.15.3 0|| kāmanāyāṃ ratau cāpi bhavanti sukhino’pi ca | tathetarendriyajanyasukhairbhavanti nandinaḥ ||3 1|| īdṛksukhābdhirbhagavān svāmīśrīvallabhaḥ prabhuḥ | rāmakṛṣṇādirūpāṇāṃ dhartā śrīmādhavīpatiḥ ||32|| avatāryakṣareśaśca sarvamuktābhipūjitaḥ | sarvaparo bālakṛṣṇo’nantabrahmarasodadhiḥ ||33|| sarvabrahmapriyājuṣṭo haripriyābhinanditaḥ | yasya pādarajo rādhālakṣmībadarīśaktibhiḥ ||34|| brahmavirāṇmahāviṣṇupūruṣairuhyate sadā | yatra śrībhagavacchabdaḥ parabrahmeva vartate ||35|| yastveka eva sarveśo yatsamo nādhiko’paraḥ | yatsevayopāstibhiśca yatsādharmyaṃ vrajanti ca ||36|| tathāpi dāsavat sarve tasyāgre tantritā yathā | vartante te sarūpāśca sarūpiṇyo’pi śaktayaḥ ||37|| kālo māyā pūruṣādyā yadbhītāḥ kiṃkarā iva | yadājñāṃ prāpya kurvanti sṛṣṭyudbhavādi sarvadā ||38|| evamacintyavibhavo badarīśo janārdanaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo gopālanandanaḥ ||39|| mānavo vartate tvadya kuṃkumavāpikālaye | yena jalāṃśataścitrā haṃsā mayūrakāḥ śukāḥ ||4.15.40 || narāḥ patatriṇaḥ kīṭāḥ paśavaḥ svasajātayaḥ | nirmitā vaṃśarūpeṇa mahāścaryādilīlayā ||41 || tatkṛtaṃ nānyathākartuṃ kenāpi śakyate tviha | ityādisarvasāmarthyayuktena tena śārṅgiṇā ||42|| racayitvā sṛṣṭijīvān sukhāṃśaṃ pradadau nijam | tadrase rasavantaśca sarvā bhavanti sṛṣṭayaḥ ||43|| viditvā taṃ kambharāyāḥ sutaṃ śrīkamalāpatim | badarīśaṃ mādhavīśaṃ bhārgavīśaṃ prabhuṃpatim ||44|| mādhavīsvāminaṃ taṃ śrīlakṣmīnāthaṃ satīpatim | māṇikyādhipatiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ māyāpatiṃ harim ||45|| muktamuktānikānāthaṃ brahmadhāmādhipaṃ prabhum | rādhāramādhināthaṃ ca rāmakṛṣṇādikāraṇam ||46|| tatra kuryād ratiṃ prītiṃ snehaṃ mohaṃ samutsavam | ānandaṃ krīḍanaṃ mātarbrahmarasamavāpnuyāt ||47|| evaṃvidhā hi badarī māyike badhyate katham | baddhāpi mucyate kṛṣṇe muktānyatra na sajjate ||48|| nirmalā jāyate divyā badhnāti śrīharau ratim | eṣā tu bhāvanā mātaḥ puṣṇātyaṃgāni dugdhavat ||49|| eṣā brahmarasagāthā mātaḥ sarvārthasaṃbhṛtā | pītā yayā tayā pītaṃ navaṃ brahmarasāmṛtam |||4.15.50|| etādṛśīprabhaktāyāḥ saṃgaṃ karoti yā satī | sāpi brahmarasaiḥ pūrṇā bhavet kārṣṇī na saṃśayaḥ ||51|| bhaktiraikāntikī kṛṣṇe siddhyedasyāvadhāraṇāt | asyaiva śrīhareryogādanyatra saṃgavarjanāt ||52|| śṛṇu mātaḥ kathāṃ vacmi cāraṇyā divyayoṣitaḥ | nāmnā nāgamukhīdevī jātyābhavatta cāraṇī ||53|| raivatādreḥ paścime sā halamādanapattane | pārśvavane mahiṣīṇāṃ pālikābhūt svadharmiṇī |||54|| patiputravihīnā sā tvekalā janavarjitā | dadhidugdhaghṛtānnādinirvāhā dharmasaṃsthitā |||55|| sācintayat patirnaṣṭaḥ putrā naṣṭāśca pañca vai | putrī nāsti kuṭumbaṃ na jātistu vartate mama ||56|| cāraṇyo’pi bhavantyatra bahvyo gārhasthyamāśritāḥ | mriyante cāpi jāyante vinā tā bhaktimantarā |||57|| patayo bahavaḥ prāptāstābhiścānto na vidyate | patīnāṃ sutaputrīṇāṃ māyānto’pi na vidyate ||58|| kāmadevasya cānto na viṣayāṇāṃ layo’pi na | karmaṇāṃ naiva viratiḥ kathaṃ janmakṣayo bhavet ||59|| vāsanāḥ pratyahaṃ nūtnā jāyante bhogasaṃbhavāḥ | ātmanastatra mokṣo na kāmarasena yoṣitām ||4.15.60|| tasmāccharīramāsādya durlabhaṃ mokṣadaṃ tvidam | tena labhyaḥ śāśvato yo brahmaraso nirāmayaḥ ||61|| paramātmā sādhavaśca mūrtimanto dharātale | bhūtvā tu mānavāścāpi mānavyastasya śaktayaḥ ||62|| vicaranti śreyase dehināṃ tyāgasvarūpiṇaḥ | tasya mānavarūpasya śrīhareḥ sādhurūpiṇaḥ ||63||| sādhūnāṃ sevayā prasādena kiṃkarīcaryayā | brahmaraso hyavāpyeta nānyathā tu kathaṃcana ||64|| harirvā hariṇī vātra haribhaktāśca sādhavaḥ | parabrahmarasābdhisthāḥ pāyayanti parānapi ||65|| tasmānmayā sadā sevyāḥ sādhavaḥ kṛṣṇarūpiṇaḥ | sādhvyo lakṣmīsvarūpāśca rādhāramātmikāstathā ||66|| tatprasaṃgena bhagavān miliṣyati priyāpatiḥ | vinā mastakadānena sāmrājyaṃ nopalabhyate ||67|| vinā sarvasvadānena svāmitvaṃ durlabhaṃ khalu | karmacite karmaloke kṛtasya phalamaśnute ||68|| ahaṃ dadāmi sarvasvaṃ kṛṣṇāya kṛṣṇasevine | tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svasarvasvaṃ mahyaṃ dāsyati niścitam ||69|| na me vighnaṃ kuṭumbātma na me śāstā patistathā | na me bandho nṛpasyāpi svatantrāsmi sukhānvitā ||4.15.70 || mahadbhāgyodayo jāto yanmāyābandhanaṃ gatam | adhunā prāpya kṛṣṇasya bandhanaṃ tatsatāmapi ||71 || brahmānandamahānandaṃ prāpsyāmi śrīśasevanāt | vicāryetthaṃ nāgamukhī cāraṇī brahmacāriṇī |||72|| nijāvāse satāṃ sevāṃ cakre tīrthanivāsinām | sādhvīnāṃ satataṃ sevā cakre dugdhādibhirmudā ||73|| nāgamukhyā bhāvabhaktiṃ śrutvā cāyānti sādhavaḥ | nivasanti gṛhe tasyāḥ sevate tān mudānvitā ||74|| sādhuvrataṃ vidadhānā vartate sevikottamā | uṣṇodakaiḥ snapayati tailādyaṃgavimardanaiḥ ||75|| prātardugdhāni coṣṇāni saśarkarailāni bhāvukī | kesarāḍhyāni sādhūm̐śca saṃpāyayati cāraṇī ||76|| candanena satāṃ bhāle vakṣasyūrvośca pādayoḥ | pūjanaṃ prakarotyeṣā puṣpamālārpaṇaistathā ||77|| ārārtrikaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā madhyāhnabhojanādikam | pācayitvā miṣṭamiṣṭaṃ saṃbhojayati cāraṇī ||78|| sādhavo’pi prabhuktvaiva kurvanti bhajanaṃ hareḥ | sāyaṃ sā cāraṇī sādhūn bhojayitvā tataḥ svayam ||79|| pādasaṃvāhanaṃ satāṃ karotyasaṃśayā satī | sādhurūpaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāste milatyapi ||4.15.80 || sādhusevā nirguṇā ca divyā pāpavināśinī | mokṣadā ceti matvaiva śayyāyāṃ sāti modate ||81|| evaṃ sā cāraṇī devī sādhuvrataṃ karoti hi | śraddhayā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ raṭati nityadā ||82|| sādhusevodbhavaṃ cātmānandaṃ dehasukhādikam | parabrahmarasaṃ matvā tṛptā tatra pramodate ||83|| asmin sādhau parasmin vā cānyasmin vā hariḥ svayam | miliṣyati prasanno me sevayeti prasevate ||84|| athaikadānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śriyāḥ patiḥ | sādhurūpaṃ gṛhītvaiva bahusādhusamāyutaḥ ||85|| yayau tasyā gṛhaṃ mātarbālakṛṣṇasvarūpadhṛk | rūpe guṇe śarīre ca vilakṣaṇaśca tejasi ||86|| cāraṇyāstu manastatra lagnaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe | sarvān sādhūn bhojayitvā sevitvā dehamardanaiḥ ||87|| kṣaṇe kṣaṇe tu satataṃ sphurantaṃ taṃ vilakṣaṇam | rātryardhānte yayau suptaṃ tejaḥparidhimaṇḍitam ||88|| brahmānandabharaṃ śītaguṇaṃ candrātiśītalam | pīyūṣātisukhavārddhiṃ sundaraṃ puṣṭayauvanam ||89|| āśliṣya prathamaṃ sparśasukhaṃ lebhe tu cāraṇī | tāvacchrībālakṛṣṇasya mūrteḥ sarvendriyodbhavam ||4.15.90|| ākarṣaṇādisaṃpuṣṭapravāhānandasāgaram | mahāsukhaṃ cāraṇī sā lebhe sarvendriyodbhavam ||9 1 || tallīnā sā jaḍevāsīd dehabhānādivarjitā | līnābhavat kṛṣṇamūrtau yathā saṃsārapāragā ||92|| āprātaḥ sā harau saktā sarvāṃgasparśamodanā | nottasthau kṛṣṇasaṃśliṣṭaśayyātaścāraṇī tadā ||93|| daśasāhasrayugajaṃ brahmarasāmṛtāśanam | labdhvā tṛptiṃ gatā kṛṣṇecchayāpi brahmacāriṇī ||94|| aviplutā kṛṣṇavat sā kārṣṇī divyā vyajāyata | atha kṛṣṇaḥ prage prāha paśya me rūpamaiśvaram ||95|| ityuktvā darśayāmāsākṣaraṃ dhāma parātparam | anantamuktajuṣṭaṃ ca nijarūpaṃ suśobhanam ||96|| anantarādhālakṣmyādisevitaṃ badarīpatim | tato’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kuṃkumavāpyayam ||97|| bālakṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ ca darśayāmāsa sundaram | tatastūrṇaṃ tirobhāvyāvadat tāṃ cāraṇīṃ satīm ||98|| kimicchasi dadāmyatra tvayā santaḥ pratoṣitāḥ | ahaṃ phalaṃ pradātuṃ te samāgato’smi tvatpatiḥ ||99|| cāraṇī prāha bhagavan mahiṣīmaṇḍalena vai | sākaṃ cāhaṃ tava dhāmākṣaraṃ prayāmi dehi tat || 4.15.10 0|| tathāstviti prabhuḥ prāha tāvad vimānamāyayau | tenaiva divyadehena cāraṇīṃ nāgnakaisarīm || 101 || nāma kṛtvā vimāne ca saṃgṛhya parameśvaraḥ | paśudehān mahiṣīṇāṃ tyājayitvā ca tā api || 1 02|| divyadehā vidhāyaiva nāgnakaisarīdāsikāḥ | akṣaraṃ dhāma paramaṃ nināya kṛtavallabhaḥ || 1 03|| brahmahrade snapayitvā muktānikā vidhāya ca | brahmānandarasaṃ datvā mokṣapade rarakṣa tāḥ || 1 04|| evaṃ mātaścāraṇī sā premṇā satāṃ prasevayā | parabrahmarasaṃ prāpa divyā muktā babhūva ha || 1 05|| so’yaṃ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo rājate śrīpatiḥ patiḥ | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre lomaśasyāśramāntike || 1 06|| rājādhirājo bhagavān koṭyarbudābjaśaktidhṛk | vṛto mayāpi sa svāmī brahmarasaṃ labhāmyapi || 1 07|| ityuktvā badarīdevi kṣaṇaṃ sā bālayoginī | virarāma patiṃ svasyā vallabhaṃ saṃgatā hṛdi || 1 08|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ parabrahmapremarasavarṇanaṃ nāgnamukhīcāraṇyāḥ satāṃ sevayā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptirbrahmarasāptirmokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 15 ||
<4.16> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye tvaṃ yatprāha śrībālayoginī | narmakartrīsamākhyānaṃ mātaraṃ brahmarāsanam || 1 || tatte vakṣyāmi kṛṣṇasya brahmarasāśanapradam | yacchrutvāpi narā nāryastadrītyā yānti mokṣaṇam || 2 || āsīd grāme kāmayāne nāmnā devalako janaḥ | tasya bhāryābhavat sādhvī narmakāryavicakṣaṇā || 3 || audāsīnyagatasyāpi mahāduḥkhagatasya ca | hāsyavinodaśūnyasya hāsyaṃ janayate tu sā || 4 || tatkālocitalāvaṇyapūrṇavākyaistathetaraiḥ | yāvadrasaprayogaiśca narma janayate drutam || 5 || gṛhe samāgatā lokāḥ prasannamānasā hyati | jāyante vārtayā tasyāḥ samarpayanti copadāḥ || 6 || dhanaṃ bhūṣā ambarāṇi miṣṭānnāni śubhāni ca | dhānyāni copakaraṇānyapi sarve’rpayanti ca || 7 || rājā rājasabhāyāṃ ca mahotsave nijotsave | sūrikāvyottaraṃ tasyā hāsyarasaṃ yunaktyapi || 8 || sabhā prasannā bhavati modante mānavā hyati | rājā tasyai mahāpāritoṣikaṃ pradadātyapi || 9 || evaṃ sā devalabhāryā nāmnā vinodinī satī | saurāṣṭre subhage deśe prasiddhā saṃvyajāyata || 4.16.1 0|| hāsyakalābhyasanārthaṃ tvāyānti yoṣito narāḥ | tān sā yathāyathaṃ sarvān śikṣayatyapi sarvathā || 1 1|| athaikadāgamattasyā gṛhe satāṃ sumaṇḍalam | sādhvīnāṃ maṇḍalaṃ cāpi bhagavadbhaktikārakam || 12|| bhojitā vanditāḥ sarve gṛhe svāgatakarmabhiḥ | tayā prasevitāścāpi rātrau cakruḥ sukīrtanam || 1 3|| sādhūnāṃ kīrtanaṃ śrutvā sādhvīnāṃ gītikāstathā | parameśamatirjātā bhaktidharmaparāyaṇā || 14|| vinodinyā vicāro’bhūd vinodena hariḥ svayam | yathā satāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ kītanaiḥ suprasādavān || 15|| santuṣṭo jāyate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ paraprabhuḥ | tathā bhavet susantuṣṭo nityaṃ tathā karomyaham || 16|| vicāryetthaṃ brahmarasāyanākhyasādhutastu sā | jagrāha vaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ mokṣadaṃ tūlasīsrajam || 17|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ mūrtiṃ jagrāha citrajām || 18|| pupūja tāṃ harermūrtiṃ nityaṃ prasevate mudā | bhaktā jātā hareḥ śuddhā vinodinī vilāsinī || 19|| sā papraccha guruṃ sādhuṃ brahmarasāyanābhidham | brahmānandamahāmiṣṭānandarasāptisādhanam ||4.16.20|| atyādareṇa tāṃ śiṣyāṃ prāha brahmarasāyanaḥ | sarve rasā yatra caikībhavanti parame rase ||21|| śrīmatsvāmibālakṛṣṇanārāyaṇāvatāriṇi | tadāptistadrasāptestu sādhanaṃ bhagavān svayam ||22|| premabhaktyātmasarvasvaniveditā hareḥpriyā | ātmanivedanenāyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ samavāpyate ||23|| ātmanivedanaṃ snehapremānurāgasaṃbhṛtam | prātikūlyālasatvāśraddhādidoṣavivarjitam ||24|| anyavṛttyapratihataṃ satatasphūrtigocaram | divyāparokṣabhānāḍhyaśrīkṛṣṇakāntasaṃśritam ||25|| pañcabhūtaśarīre’syāveśaḥ kṛṣṇasya sarvathā | indriyāṇāṃ gocareṣu mūrtistasyaiva tadguṇāḥ ||26|| tadviṣayāstanmādhuryaṃ tatsukhaṃ tatpramoditā || tadrasastasya saṃsparśastadrūpaṃ tacchravastathā ||27|| tadgandhastasya cādānaṃ tadvihārastatsarjanam | tadānandaśca mananaṃ tasya sañcintanaṃ matiḥ ||28|| tanmānaṃ tannirṇayaśca tatpramā tatsmṛtistathā | tatsaṃskārāstadicchā ca sa jñeyo jñaptisaṃgrahe ||29|| sphūrtau bhāne virāme ca sa eva gocaraḥ sadā | antarbahiśca sa eva kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||4.16.30 || gupte prakāśe hṛdaye nirjane sajane’pi saḥ | kriyāyāṃ nijaceṣṭāyāṃ hāsye pramodane ca saḥ ||3 1 || sarvathābhūṣaṇādau ca śṛṃgāre’pi harirhi saḥ | snāne svapane dhūlyādau vinode ca vrate’pi saḥ ||32|| svatve pārakyarūpe ca samarpaṇe grahe’pi ca | ādāne ca pratidāne vinimaye’pi māpatiḥ ||33|| paritaḥ sanmukhe pṛṣṭhe madhye’dhaścārdhake’pi saḥ | anuyogī pratiyogī saṃsarge’pi harirhi saḥ ||34|| āsvādye rasyavikṛtau tṛptau peye’tiśītale | kāmye cākarṣaṇe goṣṭhau vinode’pi ca mādhavaḥ ||35|| gṛhe vane catvare ca vitardau maṃcake’pi saḥ | dolāyāṃ ca vimāne ca yāne ca vāhane’pi saḥ ||36|| iṣyamāṇe ca tadbhinne mahānandātmako hariḥ | ānukūlyapravāhe ca pracchādye’pi prabhurhi saḥ ||37|| evaṃ sarvatra bhagavān yasyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇa eva hi | tasyā bhaktiḥ premapūrṇā sādhanaṃ kṛṣṇalabdhikṛt ||38|| kṛṣṇāptau tadrasāptiśca śāśvatī cānivartinī | tadyogajā bhaved divyā cātmārpaṇarasādijā ||39|| anyathā nāpyate kṛṣṇo nāpyate tadraso’pi ca | nāpyate śāśvatānando vinodini kṛpāṃ vinā ||4.16.40|| sevayā tvarjayettasya kṛpāṃ snehena tanmanaḥ | arpaṇenārjayet kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇena tanmahārasam ||41|| phalaṃ brahmarasaṃ prāpya prāptavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate | ityuktā guruṇā sādhvī vinodinī tu devalī ||42|| guroḥ sevāṃ tathā cakre yathā śikṣā samarjitā | nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo gururnārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||43|| pratyakṣaḥ sarvaphalado yathābhaktānuvartanaḥ | gururbrahma guruḥ kṛṣṇo gururjīvahariḥ prabhuḥ ||44|| sa eva toṣitaḥ samyak sarvamānuṣanāṭanaḥ | tayā pratoṣito deveśvarādhipanarāyaṇaḥ ||45|| matvaivaṃ sā guruṃ bhaktyā toṣayāmāsa sundarī | brahmacaryaparā dharmaparā sevāparāyaṇā ||46|| gurustasyā gṛhe vāsaṃ ciraṃ cakāra śāntimān | athaikadā dadhārāsau rūpaṃ devalakasya vai ||47|| atha taṃ sundaraṃ kāntaṃ patiṃ guruṃ vibudhya sā | uvāca parayā prītyā dhanyāsmyanugrahārthinī ||48|| yatheṣṭaṃ gurudeva tvaṃ mama svāmisvarūpadhṛk | prasevasva nijāṃ matvā brahmarasaṃ prapāyaya 449|| pātivratyaṃ svāmyadhīnaṃ svāmī tvaṃ vartase’dhunā | nārāyaṇasvarūpastvaṃ svāmirūpo’si gṛhṇa mām ||4.16.50|| atha prasanno gururāḍ vīkṣya sarvāṃ subhāvanām | agṛhya tāṃ tataścāśīrvādaṃ dadau hṛdā mudā ||51|| bhava dāsī hareḥ patnī bhaktā caikāntinī parā | divyalakṣmīsamā śiṣyā nārāyaṇī narottamī |||52|| ahaṃ tvatsevayā tuṣṭo dadāmi te’tivaibhavam | camatkāraṃ divyarūpadhāriṇī sukhinī bhava ||53|| ityuktvā śrīgururbrahmarasāyano vinodinīm | pasparśa karamātreṇa pāyayāmāsa vāri ca ||54|| tāvad divyā pararūpā rādhālakṣmīsamā satī | nirāvaraṇadehā ca sambabhūva vinodinī ||55|| evaṃ jātā divyadevī divyakriyātimānuṣī | guruḥ pūjāṃ gṛhītvā ca kṛṣṇapūjāṃ samarpya ca ||56|| tirobabhūva sahasā vidyullateva cāmbare | vīkṣyaivaṃ paramaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ camatkāraṃ gurāvapi ||57|| vinodinī mahāścaryaparā stabdhābhavat kṣaṇam | tarkayāmāsa bahudhā ko’yaṃ gurusvarūpadhṛk ||58|| sākṣānnārāyaṇaḥ kiṃvā naro nārāyaṇānujaḥ | īśvaro vāntarātmā vā parabrahma prabhuśca vā ||59|| divyatāṃ saṃgatā yasya kṛpayā sparśanena ca | tathāpi divyadṛṣṭyāyaṃ gururmayā na vīkṣyate ||4.16.60|| ato’tidivyalokastho bhavennārāyaṇo guruḥ | māyālokāstu me dṛṣṭergocarāḥ santi cādhunā ||61|| dṛśyate na gurustatra tato brahma bhavedayam | aho prāpto vinodinyā vinodena vinodakṛt ||62||| athāpi dhanyabhāgyāsmi gurvarpitāmamāyikīm | kṛṣṇamūrtiṃ bhajiṣye’haṃ yatiṣye labdhaye punaḥ ||63|| ityevaṃ sā mahāśāntiṃ matvā dhyāyati cācyutam | tāvadanye sādhavaśca sādhvyaścāpi tiro’bhavan ||64|| sarve te śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtau layaṃ gatāḥ | atha prāptā niścayaṃ sā gururmūrtiriyaṃ yataḥ ||65|| sākṣānnārāyaṇe kṛṣṇe sarve’tra vilayaṃ gatāḥ | gururmūrtiṃ ca me datvā tiro’bhavanna lokyate ||66|| tataḥ so’yaṃ vartate’dya svāmikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | evaṃ tvatiprasantuṣṭā prāha devalakaṃ patim ||67|| mūrtiścāyaṃ svayaṃ sādhurbrahmarasāyanātmakaḥ | cetano’pi pratimāste dhanyaḥ svāmin bhavasyapi ||68|| āvayoḥ paramaṃ bhāgyaṃ vinodena ca dehinām | antarātmā pratuṣṭaḥ sannasmadgṛhamapāyayau ||69|| vinodayiṣye satataṃ taṃ sākṣātpuruṣottamam | sevāṃ karotu bhagavan bhavān svāmin sadāsya vai ||4.16.70|| atha mūrtiṃ sajīvāṃ tāṃ sevete tau mudānvitau | yathoktarītyā deveśaṃ yathāsatkāramānanam ||71|| devalako nityamevārcayatyacyutamutsukaḥ | kintu vinodinī bheje prabhuṃ pratyakṣavat patim ||72|| tathāpi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścetanarūpavān | nāvirbhavati mūrtestu bhāvābhijñaściraṃ kvacit ||73|| asthairyaṃ tu vinodinyāḥ parīkṣituṃ samicchati | vinodinī gate varṣe mūrteḥ sevanatastataḥ ||74|| vrataṃ jagrāha mūrtyagre’naśanaṃ darśanecchayā | māsaṃ vrataṃ cakāraiva mūrtyagre kamalāsane ||75|| sanniṣaktā kare mālāṃ dhṛtvā jajāpa keśavam | netrābhyāṃ tanmūrtirūpaṃ manasā mananaṃ hareḥ ||76|| ātmanā sphuraṇaṃ tasya svapnādau pratimāṃ hareḥ | ālocayati nānyadvai pūjāyāṃ sparśanaṃ vyadhāt ||77|| yāvadindriyavṛttīḥ sā niyuyojāntare harau | bāhye harau niyuyoja bāhyabhānāpi sundarī ||78|| bāhyāntaraikyamāpannā caikatānaparāyaṇā | abhavat sā satī bhaktā vinodinī vare’cyute |||79||| atha śrībhagavānasyā hāsyarasābhilālasaḥ | nāvirbhavati vyaktātmā pratīkṣate vinodanam ||4.16.80|| māsottaro vyatīyāya samayastvekakāsane | tato mūrtervinodaṃ sā kartumārabdhavatyapi ||8 1|| dṛśyase tvaṃ caikamukho tathāpi vimukho hyasi | dvimukhyāḥ pañjare nyasto bhaviṣyasyamukho’ntare ||82|| prasravaṇapraśūnyastvaṃ cāvyaktasravaṇe dhṛtaḥ | bhaviṣyasyasravo nityaṃ sasravo bhava matkṛte ||83|| evaṃ vinodavākyāni mūrterhāsyāya māninī | muktakaṇṭhena satataṃ jagāda kṛṣṇasannidhau ||84|| athāpyāha hariṃ sā ca narmavākyaṃ tataḥ param | mahadrūpo’si satataṃ vitastimūrtitāṃ gataḥ ||85|| praveṣṭuṃ ca hiraṇgarbhaṃ kimicchasi tathā kuru | evamābhāṣyāsanāt sā samutthāya nanarta ha ||86|| tāvatprasannatāṃ prāptaḥ svāmikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | mūrtiṃ vivṛtya sahasā tejasā vyāptavigrahaḥ ||87|| yuvā kiśoraḥ samabhūddhāsyaṃ kṛtvā puraḥsthitaḥ | samāśliṣyat satīṃ bhaktāmapāyayad rasaṃ nijam ||88|| mūrteḥ sukhaṃ dadau tasyai sarvendriyādigocaram | tato vinodinīṃ mūrtau līnībhūtāṃ cakāra saḥ ||89|| yāvat svasya sukhaṃ divyaṃ sarvaṃ tasyai dadau prabhuḥ | tṛptābhavattu sā divyā divyamuktānikā drutam ||4.16.90|| abhavanmāyayā hīnā brahmaloke sthitā yathā | tāvat tatra mahāpuṇyairdevalo’pi samāyayau ||91|| vīkṣya kāntena kṛṣṇena kārṣṇīṃ vinodinīṃ satīm | nijaṃ cāpi tathaicchat saḥ kṛṣṇe dravamavāptavān ||92|| śrīkṛṣṇo’pi paraṃ bhāvaṃ jñātvā devalakāntare | sakhīrūpaṃ vinodinyā iva taṃ yoṣitaṃ vyadhāt ||93|| | nararūpaṃ vihāyaiva sakhī devalikābhavat | vinodinīsamā rūpe sarvathā kṛpayā hareḥ ||94|| yathā lakṣmīḥpriyā rādhā tathā devalikābhavat | ubhe muktānike jāte divye divyavibhūṣite ||95|| divyabrahmarasāḍhye ca divyakṛṣṇasvarūpike | līne jāte kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe taddehasaṃsthite ||96|| evaṃ śrīkṛṣṇakāntaste hyubhe dhāma nināya vai | śāśvate brahmaparamānandasukhe mamajjatuḥ ||97|| mātaścaivaṃ brahmamahārasapānāśanaṃ sadā | jāyate kṛṣṇabhaktāyāstathā me vidyate’dhunā ||98|| na me’nyatrāsti bhavanaṃ bhāvanā śrīhariṃ vinā | brahmaraso harāvastītyuktvā maunaṃ samādadhat ||99|| ityevaṃ badarīdevi parabrahmaraso’vyayaḥ | yathāpyate tayāptaścobhābhyāmāptastathoditaḥ || 4.16.10 0|| yā cānyā vānya evāpi sarvasvabhāvanārpaṇāt | uktarītyā parabrahmānandarasamavāpnuyāt || 101 || parabrahmarasāvāptau parabrahmāsti kāraṇam | sādhurūpasya sevāpi parabrahmāptikāraṇam || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ parabrahmarasāśanāptaye vinodinyā devalakapatnyā vinodena prasāditabhagavato brahmarasāyanasādhurūpeṇa sākṣātprāptirmokṣaṇaṃ devalakasya sakhītvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣoḍaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 16 ||
<4.17> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi punaḥ sā bālayoginī | sureśvarī mātaraṃ yajjagāda kathayāmi te || 1 || saurāṣṭre mahuvāsākhye pattane’bdhitaṭe śubhe | bahurūpo’bhavacchūdro naikaveṣābhidhārakaḥ || 2 || rūpe tvindrasamo dehe yuvā ṣoḍaśavatsaraḥ | nārīmukhaḥ sujaṭilaḥ keśaveṣābhisundaraḥ || 3 || karṇanāsāvibhūṣādidhārakaḥ samayo kvacit | kvacid rājā kvacid rājñī kvacit senāpatistathā || 4 || kvacicchreṣṭhī kvaciccauraḥ kvacit kanyā kumārakaḥ | kvacid vadhūḥ kvacid devī devaḥ kvacinnaṭaḥ kvacit || 5 || kvacid vipraḥ kvacid yoddhā daridro bhikṣukaḥ kvacit | kvacid vanecaro naukāvāhaḥ kvacittu karṣukaḥ || 6 || kvacit preto vānaraśca kvacid bhallukarūpadhṛk | kvacit putravatī bhāryā kvacid vājiniyāmakaḥ || 7 || kvacit sādhuryatiḥ svāmī brahmacārī ca tāpasaḥ | kvacinnarmakaraḥ sarvaśṛṃgārāḍhyaḥ kvacit khalaḥ || 8 || evaṃvidhaḥ sa bhavati veṣarūpāḍhyaceṣṭitaiḥ | bāhulakaitināmnā taṃ vadanti prajājanāḥ || 9 || nṛtye veṣe gāyane taṃ kuśalaṃ vādyavādane | āhūya cotsavān lokāḥ kurvanti janarañjanān || 4.17.1 0|| pūrvabhāgyavaśāt tasya patnī tatsadṛśī tataḥ | vivāhitābhavat kanyā nāmnā līlāvatī śubhā || 11 || gāndharvīva kalābhijñā sarvaveṣābhidhāriṇī | caturā naravat prājñā naraveṣeṣu kovidā || 12|| pūrvaṃ samyak kṛto’bhyāso janmāntare phalatyapi | dharmo dhanārpaṇaṃ sevā bhaktiḥ phalanti kālataḥ || 1 3|| nākṛtaṃ prāpyate kiñciddharyanugrahamantarā | pūrvadattā śubhā vidyā nārī sampat sukhāni ca || 14|| janmāntare’bhilabhyante guṇā yaśo dhanāni ca | tathaiva kṛtapāpānāṃ copatiṣṭhanti cādhayaḥ || 15|| sukṛtīnāṃ sūtsavāstu pravardhante dine dine | bhāryā naivālpapuṇyena labhyate nijasakriyā || 16|| guṇe rūpe svabhāve ca vicāre hṛdaye samā | cāturye ca viveke ca bahupuṇyena labhyate || 17|| patiścāpi tathā patnyā svānukūlasvabhāvavān | nālpapuṇyena labhyeta labhyate tapasā tu vai || 18|| hānau duḥkhe tathodvege kaiṃkarye nirdhanasthitau | roge vipadi pīḍāyāṃ samacittau hi durlabhau || 19|| hānyādau samacittau cet svarge tayoḥ karasthitam | lābhādau tu bhavetāṃ vai samacittau gṛhegṛhe ||4.17.20 || lābhahānyoḥ samacittāḥ sādhavo yogino’malāḥ | nārāyaṇo’tibuddhāśca puṇyā vā gṛhadharmiṇaḥ ||2 1 || evametau yuyujāte kinnvekasya kṛtidvayam | evaṃvidhau tau sukhinau nāṭyādivyavasāyinau ||22|| nāṭyaprasaṃge copārjya dhanānnāmbaravastubhiḥ | samyaṅnirvahato yātrāṃ prāṇāderlokadustarām || 23|| prayātastīrthayātrāyāṃ somanāthaṃ ca raivatam | dvārāvatīṃ camatkārapuraṃ kuṃkumavāpikām ||24|| tatrākṣare śubhe kṣetre cāśvapaṭṭasarovare | snātvā śrīlomaśaṃ gatvā nematuḥ sadgurumṛṣīn ||25|| jagṛhaturmahāmantraṃ māyāpāśavināśakam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||26|| vaiṣṇavau paramau jātau bhaktau yathā kṛtaśramau | uṣaturbahukālaṃ ca bhejaturbālakṛṣṇakam ||27|| gopālabālakaṃ divyaṃ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | nityamānarcatuḥ prītyā bhejatuḥ mādhavīpatim ||28|| cakratuśca sadā tatra satsaṃgaṃ jñānamāpatuḥ | divyatāṃ prāpatuścobhau vartete dāsyaśobhitau ||29|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ muhurmuhuḥ | śuśruvatuśca tatratyāvatāracaritāni ca ||4.17.30|| pradadhyatuḥ surāṇāṃ sannṛpāṇāṃ caritānyapi | muktānāṃ yoṣitāṃ cāpi bhaktānāṃ caritānyapi ||3 1 || śrutvā hṛdaye saṃklṛpya cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe | yathāśrutāni sarvāṇi veṣaceṣṭākriyādibhiḥ || 32|| tāvavatārayāmāsaturdarśayāmāsaturmuhuḥ | rātrau cāndryāṃ hi kaumudyāṃ janebhyo’timudānvitau ||33|| janāstu lakṣaśo dṛṣṭvā bhavanti cakitā hyati | naṭīṃ naṭaṃ praśaṃsanti bahurūpābhiyoginau ||34|| devatulyāvimau staśca nārāyaṇāṃśakāviva | purāvṛttaṃ tadākāraṃ yaccopasthāpayanti vai ||35|| mānārhau kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre jātau surūpiṇau | evaṃvidhayoḥ samprāptaḥ samayo bhāgyavardhanaḥ ||36|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇajanmadinotsavaḥ | saptadaśastatra devā muktāḥ santaḥ samāyayuḥ || 37|| īśvarā mānavādyāśca sūtamāgadhabandinaḥ | maharṣitīrthaviprāśca kalāvidaḥ samāyayuḥ ||38|| ramādyāḥ śaktayaścāpi prajā lokāḥ samāyayuḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ ||39|| sambandhino bhuvanānāṃ vāsinaśca samāyayuḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇajanmatithyūrjakṛṣṇakāṣṭamīm ||4.17.40|| abhilakṣya niśāyāmāyayuḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ | aṣṭamyāṃ prātarevāyaṃ snātvā śrīkṛṣṇamādhavaḥ ||41|| kṛtamaṃgalapūjādiḥ kṛtakautukaśobhanaḥ | koṭyarbudābjapatnībhiḥ kṛtārcanasuvandanaḥ ||42|| mātrā pitrā vṛddhajanaiḥ śvaśrūbhiḥ śvaśurādibhiḥ | kṛtāśīrvādasadbhāgyaḥ kṛtaveṣābhisundaraḥ ||43|| sabhāyāṃ tu viśālāyāṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe | sarvasṛṣṭijanāḍhyāyāṃ yuktāyāṃ lomaśādibhiḥ ||44|| gajāsane jayakārān śṛṇvan kṛṣṇasadyaśaḥ | niṣasāda samāgatya tadāvādyanta sarvaśaḥ ||45|| vādyāni sarvalokānāṃ gītayaścābhavan śubhāḥ | vedaghoṣā maharṣīṇāmabhavan karṇapāvanāḥ ||46|| snehabharāṇi sarveṣāṃ vilokanāni cābhavan | harṣāḥ pramodā ānandā mūrtimantastadābhavan ||47|| pupūjuḥ paramātmānaṃ lomaśaḥ ṛṣayaḥ surāḥ | dvijā nṛpāśca pitaraḥ siddho īśvarakoṭayaḥ ||48|| apsarasaśca devyaśca mānavyo mānavādayaḥ | pātālādinivāsāśca tīrthāni jaḍacetanāḥ ||49|| samastasiddhayo vṛddhā nāryo devyo ramādikāḥ | sādhvyaśca sādhavaścāpi pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ||4.17.50|| tilakaṃ candanādyaiścākṣatakuṃkumamaṃgalaiḥ | candrakaṃ te pracakruśca puṣpahārān nyadhurgale ||51 || gandhasārān śabdasārān mantrasārān śubhāśiṣaḥ | pradaduścopadāścāpi hṛdayāni viśeṣataḥ ||52|| mukuṭaṃ kuṇḍale hārān kaṭakāni ca śṛṃkhalāḥ | ūrmikāśca maṇīn ratnasvarṇabhūṣāśca te daduḥ ||53|| yaśogānānyabhavam̐śca nartanānyabhavam̐stathā | tāmbūladānapānādi miṣṭānnamaṃgalāni ca ||54|| hastadhūnanamevāpi tadābhavan samājake | mahīmānābhiyogāśca sabhāyāṃ cābhavam̐stadā ||55|| ārārtrikaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyarṣigaṇā vyadhuḥ | muktādyāḥ saṃstavān cakruścaivaṃ mahotsavo’bhavat ||56|| atrotsave tu samprāpyāvasaraṃ bahurūpadhṛk | bāhulakaśca tatpatnī kṛtaveṣau susundarau ||57|| camatkārakarau sabhyamanoharau sabhāntare | āyayaturhasantau tāvubhau strīveṣaśobhanau ||58|| kā nārī ko naraścetyaviditau tau sabhājanaiḥ | rūpātisundarau devairaparīkṣyau tadā kṣaṇe ||59|| samakaṇṭhasvarau hāvabhāvāṃgavyañjanaiḥ samau | sarvajño’pi hariḥ sākṣāttadarthe mugdhatāṃ gataḥ ||4.17.60|| kā kathā tu tadānyeṣāṃ māyāḍhyacarmacakṣuṣān | evaṃ sabhāpi sahasā vīkṣya striyau samantataḥ ||61 || stabdhatāṃ vai gatā yadvanmugdhā puttalikāmayī | gāyanaṃ te striyau tatra vālakṛṣṇayaśomayam ||62|| cakratuḥ sarvakāmānāmānandarasapūritam | prasannaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastābhyāṃ maṇīn dadau ||63|| ratnahārānalaṃkārānāśiṣaśca śubhā dadau | atha nṛtyaṃ cakratuste striyau bhāvādigarbhitam ||64|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavṛttāntagānayuk | akṣarādhipatiḥ sākṣāt parameśo’si mānavaḥ ||65|| bhavān yeṣāṃ tu jihvāsu manassu ca matiṣvapi | ātmasvapi nartako’sti teṣāṃ mokṣo hi śāśvataḥ ||66|| prasanno bhava bhagavan rūpaṃ nṛtyaṃ susārthakam | kuru tvaṃ cāvayornāryoḥ pādasparśaṃ pradehi nau ||67|| omityāha sabhāmadhye prasannaḥ kṛṣṇanandanaḥ | drutaṃ nāryau samāyātāṃ śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāntikam ||68|| kṛṣṇacaraṇadhūlīṃ te cohaturmastake tathā | urasyudare dehe ca tataḥ pādau hareḥ punaḥ ||69|| sparśayāmāsaturvakṣojayoḥ prasannamānase | paśyatāṃ sabhyalokānāṃ tāvacchāṭīvihīnakau ||4.17.70|| puṃveṣasahitau tūrṇaṃ yuvānau saṃbabhūvatuḥ | puṃbhāṣāsahitau sarvapumaṃkapariśobhitau ||71 || strītvaṃ gataṃ pravīkṣyaiva kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | samājaśceśvarādyāśca mahāścaryaṃ prapedire ||72|| jagmuḥ sabhājanāstatra saṃśayaṃ vā narau striyau | na nirṇayaṃ tadā kartuṃ samarthāḥ ke’pi cābhavan ||73|| mugdhā sabhā samājaśca sarve nirīkṣakāstadā | athemau kiṃkiṇījālairghurghuraiḥ pādasaṃkramān ||74|| kurvantau raṃgamadhye tau mahānṛtyaṃ pracakratuḥ | śaṃkaro’pi kṣaṇaṃ mugdho|ntarasaḥ sutarāṃ tadā |||75||| gandharvā nartakāścānye galadgarvāstadābhavan | atha nṛtyaṃ vidhāyaiva bālakṛṣṇamahāprabhoḥ ||76|| saṃspṛśya caraṇau prāpyopadāśca pāritoṣikam | maṇiratnahīrakādi svarṇabhūṣāmbarādi ca ||77|| sabhāmadhye samanyasya tūrṇaṃ puṃbhāvavarjitau | abhavatāmubhau tatra paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām ||78|| ṣaṇḍhaveṣau ṣaṇḍhabhāvau ṣaṇḍhavilāsanarmadau | hastatālīparau netrakoṇollāsasamanvitau ||79|| ṣaṇḍhabhāṣāṃ bhāṣamāṇau sabhāhāsyakarāvubhau | atha kṣaṇānte tatraiko naṭī bhūtvā nanarta ha ||4.17.80|| bhūtvāparo naṭastatra vādyaṃ śreṣṭhamavādayat | paśyatāṃ devatādīnāṃ naṭī cādṛśyatāṃ gatā ||81 || naṭo’pi raṃgasātatyārthaṃ naṭī saṃbabhūva ha | nanarta yāvad raṃge sā tāvannaṭī samāyayau ||82|| dṛṣṭvā naṭīṃ tu nṛtyantīṃ naro’bhavaddhi sā naṭī | evaṃ bahusvarūpāṇi vīkṣya sabhātiharṣitā ||83|| tayordvayorbahumānaśabdān jagāda sā sabhā | atha patnīpatirūpau kṣaṇānte varamālayā ||84|| yojitau dampatīrūpau sabhāmadhye babhūvatuḥ | namaskāraṃ haraye ca sabhyebhyastau pracakratuḥ ||85|| aparādhakṣamāyāñcāṃ cakraturvinayānvitau | tasthatuśca sabhāmadhye yathārtharūpamāsthitau ||86|| tadeśvarādyā devādyā mānavāḥ saṃśayojjhitāḥ | abhavan ṛṣayaścāpi prasannāścābhavan hyati ||87|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇādyā mātā śrīkaṃbharā satī ||88|| anye’pi lokapālādyā mahāścaryaparāyaṇāḥ | upadāḥ pradadustābhyāṃ prasannatvaprayojitāḥ ||89|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prasannamānasaḥ | varadānaṃ grahītuṃ tāvuvāca tau tadā śubham ||4.17.90|| parabrahmarasānandaṃ varayāmāsaturhareḥ | divyānandamahābrahmarasābdhau magnatāṃ parām ||9 1|| arthayāmāsatuḥ kṛṣṇānnārāyaṇāddhi keśavāt | tathāstvevaṃ hariḥ prāha tata ārabhya vai tayoḥ ||92|| nirvikalpasamādhiśca babhūva kṛṣṇamodadaḥ | sarvabhūtendriyādīnāṃ vṛttiṣu sphuraṇaṃ hareḥ ||93|| sadā tayorabhavadvai yathākṣarasthamuktayoḥ | evaṃ harerhi kṛpayā kalayā nijayāpi ca ||94|| bahurūpabhavanayā haryarthakṛtayā tadā | parabrahmānandamahāsukhamodarasaṃ param ||95|| avāpatuḥ sadā divyaṃ divyadehendriyānvitau | saptadaśo janmamahotsavaḥ sampūrṇatāṃ gataḥ ||96|| bhojanāni vicitrāṇi samājānāṃ tadābhavan | pūjāśca paritoṣāśca mahādānāni cābhavan ||97|| evaṃ svāṃ mātaraṃ bālayoginyāha hareḥ rasam | yau labdhavantau tau bhaktau vṛttau ca mādhavaṃ tataḥ ||98|| evaṃ brahmarasaṃ prāptā kṛpayāpi suśāśvatam | bālayoginī saṃmagnā smṛtveśaṃ virarāma ha ||99|| evaṃ te kathito badrīpriye brahmarasaḥ paraḥ | anugraheṇa kṛṣṇasyāvāpyate nānyathā kvacit || 4.17.1 00|| bahavaḥ sevayā prāptā brahmānandarasaṃ param | kṛpayā bahavaḥ prāptā yathā brahmapriyāstviha || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ bālayoginyā mātre bahurūpadhṛgyugalasya bāhulakalīlāvatīnāmakasya bhaktivṛttāntakathanena parabrahmarasāvāptisādhanoktiḥ śrīhareḥsaptadaśajanmadinyotsavaśceti nirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||
<4.18> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi mātaraṃ bālayoginī | tataśca punarutkarṣaṃ prāha brahmarasasya sā || 1 || bhadragrāme māliyāno mālākāro’bhavat purā | māliyānasya bhāryābhūnmallikāśrītināmikā || 2 || udyānaṃ poṣayantau tau phalādivikrayārthinau | puṣpamālādikartārau bhaktau tau sambabhūvatuḥ || 3 || yatra yatra śrutavantau paritastau surālayān | saurāṣṭre tau gatavantau surapūjāṃ pracakratuḥ || 4 || sūryaṃ dāmodaraṃ somanāthaṃ śrīgopanāthakam | guptaprayāgaṃ cāpyaśvapaṭṭasaraśca raivatam || 5 || camatkāraṃ dvāravatīṃ prajagmatuḥ pupūjatuḥ | puṣpahāraphalādyaiśca tulasīdalagucchakaiḥ || 6 || kamalairvividhaiścāpi sthalapadmairjalābjakaiḥ | mālatyādikusumaiśca pārijātādipuṣpakaiḥ || 7 || campakairbakulaiścāpi vallīpuṣpaistṛṇeśajaiḥ | tathā ca kadalairmiṣṭairnavaraṃgādibhiśca vai || 8 || candanaiḥ śītalaiścāpi kesarādisumiśritaiḥ | puṣpāṇāṃ bahurūpāṇāṃ bahusugandhaśālinām || 9 || aparyuṣitabhāvānāṃ divyānāṃ cittakarṣiṇām | ūṣṇīṣaṃ pracchadapaṭīṃ catuṣphālaṃ ca dhotrakam ||4.18.1 0|| suravālaṃ prāvaraṇaṃ kambalaṃ cāṃgarakṣakam | śāṭīṃ ca ghargharīṃ vakṣobadhnikāṃ kacalīnikām || 11 || kucalīṃ karpaṭīṃ caulīṃ caulaṃ tvantaḥpaṭīṃ tathā | evamādīni vastrāṇi pauṣpāṇyeva vidhāya tau || 12|| tatra tatra śubhe tīrthe taddevīdevamūrtaye | arpayāmāsatuḥ premṇā dhārayāmāsaturhṛdā || 13|| arhayāmāsaturdevaṃ devīṃ rādhāramāpriyāḥ | mādhavīkṛṣṇaviṣṇuśrīnārāyaṇārkaśaṃkarān || 14 || sarvakausumaveṣān saṃklṛptvā dadaturmūrtaye | mūrtisthā devatā devyo gaṇeśādyā haristathā || 15|| devikādyāḥ prasannā vai bhavanti bhaktivīkṣakāḥ | atha bhūṣā samastāśca puṣpamayīrvidhāya tau || 16|| arpayāmāsaturnityaṃ devebhyo bhaktiśālinau | mukuṭaṃ grathitaṃ puṣpaiḥ kuṇḍale karṇapūrakau || 17|| gacchau ca kandukaṃ hārān mālāśca kaṭakau śubhau | śṛṃkhalā vividhāścāpi raśanāḥ kaṭisūtrakam || 18|| keśahārān stanapatre bhālapatre ca tantikām | śikhāmaṇiṃ tathā cūḍāmaṇiṃ kaustubhamuttamam || 19|| pādayorjhaṃjharīścāpi cakrāṇi cormikāstathā | naktakaṃ keśapūrām̐śca tathā dhammilamālikāḥ ||4.18.20 || kabarīsrak nābhicandrau tathānitambacandrakau | sakthimālāḥ śubhāḥ prakoṣṭhapatrāṇi ca mañjarīḥ ||21|| pṛṣṭhasūryāṃ kaṇṭhapatrāṃ caivaṃvidhāni yānyapi | bhūṣaṇāni bhavantyeva tāni sarvāṇi tāvubhau ||22|| vidhāya vividhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kalākauśalyaśālinau | tīrthadevān snehabhaktyā mudā śṛṃgāraśobhitān ||23|| cakratustau pratyahaṃ vai gatvā gatvā surālayān | śraddhā pravardhate nityaṃ sukhaṃ tayoḥ pravardhate ||24|| khyātiḥ pravardhate divyā puṇyaṃ pravardhate’vyayam | pūjāṃ prakurvatoḥ pauṣpaistayorhareranugrahaḥ ||25|| devānāṃ kṛtapūjānāṃ prasannatāpi vardhate | evaṃ tau bahupuṇyau vai jātau priyatamau tathā 26|| akhilānāṃ tu devānāṃ puṣpapūjādikāriṇau | āśīrvādātipātratvaṃ prāptau devādyanugraham ||27|| athaikadā hariḥ sākṣād dātumiyeṣa darśanam | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre pūjayantau nijaṃ yadā ||28|| aśvapaṭṭasarastīre yāḥ santi divyamūrtayaḥ | mandirāṇi samastāni devālayāstathā śubhāḥ ||29|| tatra tatra haristasmai mūrtidvārā camatkṛtim | darśayituṃ pāyayituṃ brahmarasaṃ madhuprabham ||4.18.30|| dātumiyeṣa tau divyaṃ darśanaṃ pratimodbhavam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svarṇālaye yadā ||3 1|| prātastābhyāṃ pūjito vai puṣpaśṛṃgārakāmbaraiḥ | tadā sa mānavaḥ kṛṣṇo babhūvākṣaradhāmagaḥ ||32|| upaviṣṭo divyagajāsane cākṣaradhāmani | divyabhūṣāmbarahetiśṛṃgārakautukānvitaḥ ||33|| asaṃkhyamuktasañjuṣṭo’nantamuktānikārcitaḥ | avatārī hyasaṃkhyānāmavatārādivarṣmaṇām ||34|| anantaiśvaryasāmarthyāścaryaśaktiprapūrṇakaḥ | rājādhirājaśobhaśca sarvatattvaniyāmakaḥ ||35|| anantagāḍhatejobhiḥ pūrṇamūrtiḥ parātparaḥ | evaṃ bhūtvā hi bhagavān brahmatejo hyadarśayat ||36|| guṇātītākṣarabrahma sarvatejaḥprakāraṇam | asaumāsaṃkhyabhāyuktaṃ vyāpakaṃ mūrtiniḥsṛtam ||37|| māliyānāya mallikāśriyai pradarśya dhāma tat | tatrākṣarīṃ divyabhūmiṃ taijasīṃ śāntaśītalām ||38|| mahānandamayīṃ divyapīyūṣasalilāṃ śubhām | śuddhacaitanyarūpāṃ tāmakṣarabrahmamūrtijām ||39|| darśayāmāsa bhagavān dhāmeśaśrīnarāyaṇaḥ | ākṣaraṃ nagaraṃ naijaṃ darśayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ||4.18.40|| anantamuktavasatiṃ darśayāmāsa tau tataḥ | divyasamādhau tau nītvā darśayāmāsa vāṭikām ||41|| bhadrāyanaṃ śubhaṃ grāmaṃ mahodyānaṃ ca kausumam | darśayāmāsa bhagavān yatpuṣpaiḥ pūjyate hariḥ ||42|| māliyānasya mallikāśriyā udyāna uttamaḥ | vartate tvakṣare tatra phalapuṣpadrumātmakaḥ ||43|| śāśvato divyaphalado divyamadhurasapradaḥ | divyapuṣpodbhavamiṣṭamakarandarasapradaḥ ||44|| tau pradarśya tamudyānaṃ hariḥ prāha śubhaṃ vacaḥ | pṛthvyāṃ yadarpitaṃ mahyaṃ tatsarvaṃ vāṭikādikam ||45|| udyānajanyapuṣpādi mahodyānaphalādikam | sarvaṃ vāṃ śāśvataṃ tvatra vidyate kurutaṃ nijam ||46|| kalpadrumā rasaiḥ pūrṇā bhavantyatra hi śāśvatāḥ | miṣṭaphalapradāḥ santi pibataṃ tadbhavāmṛtam ||47|| miṣṭaphalānāmadanaṃ kurutaṃ divyatṛptidam | ityuktvā bhagavām̐stābhyāṃ pāyayāmāsa tadrasam ||48 || phalāhāraṃ prasādena kārayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam | puṣpaśṛṃgāraracanāmarpayāmāsa tau prabhuḥ ||49|| divyaṃ naijaṃ sukhaṃ miṣṭaṃ śāśvataṃ modananditam | mahānandamayaṃ sarvaṃ dadau tābhyāṃ prabhuḥ svayam ||4.18.50|| yo rasaḥ śaṃkare nāsti nāje nāpīśvareṣvapi | na viṣṇau nāvatāreṣu na mukteṣvapi yo rasaḥ ||51|| raso yo vartate kṛṣṇatādātmyabhāvimātrake | kṛṣṇamūrtau sadā tvāste kṛṣṇābhinne ca vartate ||52|| kṛṣṇāṃganāyāṃ rādhāśrīprajñāmādhavikādiṣu | brahmapriyāsu sarvāsu haripriyāsu yo rasaḥ ||53||| śrīlakṣmīkamalāpadmāmāṇikyālalitādiṣu | | yo raso vartate nityapremānandamahodadhiḥ ||54|| snehākarṣaṇatādātmyādvayānandasukhodadhiḥ | sarvabhānaprabhānādilayamūrchātimūrchanaḥ ||55|| sarvendriyāntaḥkaraṇākṛṣṭipiṇḍaikyarūpadhṛk | ekatānamahānandāvicchinnamutpravāhaṇaḥ ||56|| etādṛśaṃ parabrahmamahānandarasaṃ hariḥ | aṃke kṛtvā ca tau bhaktau pāyayāmāsa mūrtijam ||57|| tataścodyānavṛkṣāṇāṃ pāyayāmāsa tanmadhu | makarandaṃ ca puṣpāṇāṃ pāyayāmāsa gandhinam ||58|| kārayāmāsa tṛptiṃ tau tatraivākṣaradhāmani | athotthāpya samādhestau darśayāmāsa bhūtalam ||59|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ mānavaṃ vigrahaṃ nijam | bālakṛṣṇālayaṃ divyaṃ sāptabhaumaṃ suvarṇajam ||4.18.60|| athotthitau tau sahasā praṇematurhariṃ muhuḥ | amūlyāpūrvalāvaṇyāmṛtarasaprapūritam ||61|| stutvā natvārcayitvaiva labdhvā tṛptiṃ tu śāśvatīm | visarjitau śrīhariṇā yayaturmandirād bahiḥ ||62|| divyabhāvānvitau puṣpahāraśṛṃgārakānvitau | aśvapaṭṭasarastīre devānāmarhaṇāya tau ||63||| yayatuḥ paścimād bhāgād uttarāṃ diśamutsukau | śaṃkaraṃ kṣetrapālaṃ cārcayāmāsaturīśvarīm ||64|| mūrtitraye harikṛṣṇaṃ vīkṣayāmāsatū ramām | trikaṃ dhṛtvā kare pātraṃ mahāmṛtarasānvitam ||65|| pāyayāmāsa tābhyāṃ vai parabrahmarasaṃ param | gaṇeśaṃ kārtikaṃ durgā rudraṃ pupūjatustataḥ ||66|| teṣu deveṣu bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhuḥ | prāpya pūjāṃ puṣpamayīṃ pāyayāmāsa tau rasam ||67|| kuberaindrāgnidharmādīn pupūjatuśca tau tataḥ | teṣu deveṣu bhagavān svāmīśrīnaravallabhaḥ ||68|| labdhvā pūjāṃ divyarūpaḥ pāyayāmāsa tau rasam | sūryacandraguruprabhṛtīn devān tau pupūjatuḥ ||69|| teṣu deveṣu bhagavān svāmī kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | pūjāṃ saṃgṛhya tau tatra pāyayāmāsa tadrasam ||4.18.70|| brahmaviṣṇumaheśādipratimāpūjanaṃ ca tau | vyadhātāṃ teṣu deveṣu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhuḥ ||71 || pūjāṃ saṃgṛhya tau tatra pāyayāmāsa tadrasam | pitṛpratimāpūjāṃ ca pracakratustataśca tau ||72|| teṣu svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkṛṣṇanandanaḥ | pūjāṃ saṃgṛhya tau bhaktau pāyayāmāsa tadrasam ||73|| siddharṣimūrtiṣu tābhyāṃ pūjitāsu pramāpatiḥ | pūjāṃ saṃgṛhya tau divyaṃ pāyayāmāsa tadrasam ||74|| īśvarāṇāmīśvarīṇāṃ mūrtiṣu mādhavīpatiḥ | pratimāsu parāṃ pūjāṃ labdhvā pauṣpīṃ ca tadrasam ||75|| pāyayāmāsa tābhyāṃ śrīkāntaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | muktānikāsu mukteṣu cāvatāreṣu mūrtiṣu ||76|| pārṣadeṣu ca gopeṣu gopīṣu śāradādiṣu | samastatīrthadeveṣu pratimāsu kṛtārhaṇām ||77|| prāpya svāmiharikṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇo’kṣarādhipaḥ | tābhyāṃ brahmarasaṃ divyaṃ pāyayāmāsa pānavat ||78|| hasan pātraṃ kare dhṛtvā brahmarasaprapūritam | anyahastaṃ nyasya mūrdhni tau saṃspṛśyāṅkasaṃsthitau ||79|| ādhāya cauṣṭhayoḥ pātraṃ pāyayāmāsa tadrasam | ghaṭukairghaṭukaiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ premarasaṃ tu śāśvatam ||4.18.80|| pāyayāmāsa mūrtisthastābhyāṃ pūjāphalātmakam | aśvapaṭṭasarastīre ye devāstīrthavāsinaḥ ||8 1|| īśvarāścāvatārāśca maharṣayaśca sādhavaḥ | siddhāḥ sādhvyaḥ pārṣadāśca śaktyo brahmayoṣitaḥ |||82||| tatra sarvatra bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | divyaṃ svaṃ darśanaṃ datvā pāyayāmāsa tau rasam ||83|| evaṃ taṃ māliyānaṃ ca mallikāśrīṃ hariḥ svayam | kṛpayā pāyayāmāsa parabrahmarasaṃ nijam ||84|| tena tau divyatāṃ prāptau brahmadhāmādimuktavat | divyadehau hi sampannau tadā māyāṃśavarjitau ||85|| puṣpaphalādisevāyāḥ phalaṃ divyaṃ prajagmatuḥ | parabrahmarasapānāt kāyākalpo vyajāyata ||86|| pāñcabhautikatattvāni vyalīyanta tayostataḥ | indriyāṇi samastāni caitanyāni tadābhavan ||87|| antaḥkaraṇamevāpi nityajñānātmakaṃ hyabhūt | māyāṃśo vilayaṃ prāpya brahmāṃśaḥ samajāyata ||88|| sarvāṃśāḥ samparāvṛttya brahmāṃśāstvabhavam̐stadā | nityatṛptau mahānandapūrṇau tau sambabhūvatuḥ ||89|| saptāśītisahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ cāyuṣo’ntare | pūjāṃ kṛtvā divyabhāvaṃ gate te mālimallike ||4.18.90|| divyadehau ṣoḍaśābdavayaskau tau babhūvatuḥ | bālakṛṣṇasamau rūpe yugalau saṃbabhūvatuḥ ||91 || atha vairāgyayuktau tau pṛthvyudyānagṛhādiṣu | brahmapāradṛśau tūrṇaṃ cārthayāmāsaturharim ||92|| na bhadrāyananagaraṃ na bhūmirna divaṃ tathā | nau satyaṃ rocate nāpi naiśalokādi sāttvikam ||93|| vinā tvatpādasevāyugdhāmākṣaranivāsanam | tasmād rakṣaya nau kṛṣṇa yatheṣṭaṃ tvakṣare pade ||94|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre divye’kṣare’tra tatra vā | arpitau svaścaraṇayostava śrīkānta sarvadā ||95|| ityabhyarthya kṣaṇaṃ maunaṃ jagṛhatustato hariḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||96|| itimantraṃ dadau tābhyāṃ vimānaṃ ca dadau śubham | pārṣadairvāhitaṃ divyaṃ preṣayāmāsa cākṣaram ||97|| kṛpayā śrīharestau vai tenaiva varṣmaṇā tataḥ | parabrahmarasaṃ pītvā yayaturdhāma cākṣaram ||98|| snātvā brahmahrade sīmni viviśatustato’kṣaram | muktau caraṇasevāyāṃ vartamānau babhūvatuḥ ||99|| ityevaṃ mātaraṃ badri prāha sā bālayoginī | parabrahmarasānandamāhātmyaṃ divyamuktidam || 4.18.1 00|| virarāma kṣaṇaṃ sāpi mātā vyacintayad rasam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāt prāpyaṃ hi sevayā || 101 || utkarṣaṃ paramaṃ jñātvā dhārayāmāsa taṃ hṛdi | yat kṛpvāpi satī nārī prāpnuyāt paramaṃ padam || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginyā mātre kathitaṃ māliyānamallikāśrībhyāṃ mālākārābhyāṃ puṣpaphalādisevayā tenaiva varṣmaṇā parabrahmarasāvāptyā divyatottaraṃ brahmākṣaradhāmaśāśvataṃ cāpunarāgamāya prāptamitinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 18 ||
<4.19> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tataḥ śrībālayoginā | svamātre jñānalabhyaṃ yaṃ prāha brahmarasottamam || 1 || yādṛṅmohaḥ śarīre sve tatrāpīndriyagolake | tatrāpi hṛdaye naije tathātmani striyāṃ sute || 2 || patyau dhane jīvikāyāṃ dehinaḥ samavartate | tādṛṅmohaṃ harermūtau kuryānnārī naro’pi vā || 3 || anyamohaṃ tyajetsarvaṃ nārāyaṇamṛṣiṃ vinā | kṣetrajñe śrīpatau kṛṣṇe kuryānmohaṃ narāyaṇe || 4 || tatra vṛttiṃ dhārayecca harau śrīpuruṣottame | ramaṇīyatame kṛṣṇe lagnaṃ mano na cālayet || 5 || gurau satsu harau snehaṃ kuryānnānyatra vai kvacit | āsaktiṃ śrīharau kuryāt tadrase pāvanottame || 6 || ātmanyeva hariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pradhārayet | harau sarvaviṣayāṇāṃ sukhānyekatra sarvathā || 7 || labhyante’to brahmaraso’vāpyate darśane’pi vai | evaṃ jñātvā bhajet kṛṣṇaṃ pātivratyena sundarī || 8 || prasanno jāyate tasyā bhagavān kṛpayā hyati | śanaiḥ śanaiḥ sevayā taṃ prabhuṃ nāthaṃ prasādayet || 9 || anekāvarttasaṃsiddhā sevayā rasamāpnuyāt | amāyā syāt sadā yasyāḥ pare kānte rameśvare || 4.19.1 0|| siddhadaśā bhavedasyāḥ kṛtārthatā ca śāśvatī | parabrahmānandarasayogyatāsyāstadā matā || 11 || ātyantikaṃ ca kalyāṇaṃ sādhvītā cottamā tathā | prāptavyā tu yayā sādhvyā tayā peyo raso hareḥ || 1 2|| aharniśaṃ smṛtiḥ kāryā kṛṣṇakāntasya svātmani | dhāryā mūrtirbhagavataḥ sevyā divyena varṣmaṇā || 13|| pūrṇābdhivat sukhaṃ tasya bhaktāyā pūryate’niśam | rasikāyāṃ rasikasya kṛṣṇasyānandapūrṇatā || 14|| bhaktyā rasikayā kṛṣṇo rasaṃ naijaṃ dadāti vai | brahmarasaṃ mahānandaṃ bhaktāyai svāmibhāvanām || 15|| nirdoṣadivyabhāvāyā brahmāntaryāmiyuktayā | bhaktyā cārpitayā kṛṣṇo rasiko rasameti vai || 16|| brahmaikyabhāvayā svāmī sevyaḥ sevikayāniśam | sevikāpi rasadācchrīkṛṣṇād rasaṃ samaśnute || 17|| kṛṣṇaḥ kāntaḥ prasannaḥ syād bhaktyā vā sevayāpi ca | ājñayā cānuvṛttyā vā taṃ dharmaṃ pālayet satī || 18|| akhaṇḍacintā kṛṣṇasya yasyā bhavati mānase | sā tadrasaṃ mahāmiṣṭaṃ prāpnotyanyā na vindati || 19|| ekatānā bhaved yā tu saikarasā prajāyate | dṛśyate bhagavān yadvan mānavo’pi na mānavaḥ ||4.19.20 || nāsya bādho māyikairvai padārthaiśca parābhavaḥ | alaukikaṃ hi sāmarthyaṃ kṛṣṇakānte virājate ||21 || asaṃkhyastrīpatiḥ kṛṣṇo nirlepo’pi rasapradaḥ | viditvaivaṃ prabhuṃ nāthaṃ bhajate rasabhāginī ||22|| kāntavrataṃ śūratā ca sarvārpaṇaṃ tadātmatā | pakṣaḥ snehaśca yasyāḥ syāt kṛṣṇe sā rasabhāginī ||23|| satāṃ sevā hareḥ sevā sādhvīsevāpi sarvadā | padmāvatīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasevātmikā yadi ||24|| yasyā bhavati saṃsāre’pyasāre sāragā tu sā | antarāyakaraṃ sarvaṃ tyajatyeva hi sā satī ||25|| mahatāṃ tu satāṃ sevā harerājñā kṛpā tathā | arpaṇaṃ sarvathā divyaparabrahmarasapradāḥ ||26|| āhārāḥ sarvathā kṛṣṇe dehendriyāntarātmanām | yasyā bhavanti satataṃ sā syādvai rasabhāginī ||27|| ātmaniveditāyajñaḥ sarvayajñaśiromaṇiḥ | parabrahmaṇi deveśe’rpaṇaṃ yat puruṣottame ||28|| āntaraṃ sarvathā dānaṃ bāhyaṃ dānaṃ ca sarvathā | hareḥ sambandhavat sarvaṃ vartanaṃ sphuraṇādikam ||29|| nirguṇaṃ bhagavadbhāvaṃ prāpya nirguṇavartanam | mahadbhāgyaṃ paraṃ prāpya paraṃ padaṃ ca nirmalam ||4.19.30 || yā sākṣād bhagavatprāptiḥ sarvendriyādihomajā | rādhālakṣmīsamā sādhvī tayā prajāyate sadā ||3 1|| mūrterbalaṃ tu bahudhā vipulaṃ rakṣyameva yat | snehastasyāḥ pravardheta baliṣṭhāyā harau prabhau ||32|| harermūrterbalavatyā naiṣkarmyaṃ saṃprasiddhyati | bhayaṃ nāsyā hi māyāyā mahākālasya vā bhavet| ||33|| pakvabhaktā hi sā tvekāntinī bhaktā hi sā bhavet | hareḥ svarūpaniṣṭhāyāṃ pakvāyāḥ śreya uttamam ||34|| evaṃvetryāḥ kṛtārthatvaṃ brahmarasābhimagnatā | sārātisāraprāptiśca śrītvaṃ sampadyate tviha ||35|| yadakṣareśānmuktāśca muktānyaḥ saṃbhavantyapi | avatārā avatāriṇyaśca rādhāramādayaḥ ||36|| īśvarā īśvarāṇyaśca gopā gopyo bhavantyapi | sakhāyaśca tathā sakhyo dāsā dāsyo bhavantyapi ||37|| ātivāhikadevāśca tathādhidevatāḥ surāḥ | adhyātmānaśca puruṣā vyūhāḥ samudbhavantyapi ||38|| adhibhūtāni sarvāṇi samastataijasāni ca | utpadyante harermūrterbrahmāntaryāmiśaktayaḥ ||39|| tamanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ samāśrayet | sarvānandapramodānāṃ nidhiṃ brahmarasāśrayam ||4.19.40|| kāmapūraṃ ca niṣkāmaṃ sarvānandarasapradam | saṃginaṃ cāpyasaṃgaṃ ca bhoginaṃ bhogavarjitam ||41|| lepinaṃ cāpi nirlepaṃ kāntaṃ kāntatvavarjitam | vareṇyaṃ cāvaraṃ ramyaṃ śayānaṃ śayanojjhitam ||42|| vadhūgrastaṃ ca vidhuraṃ gṛhasthaṃ gṛhavarjitam | aliṃgaṃ divyaliṃgaṃ ca śāstrayonimayonikam ||43|| indraṃ nirindriyaṃ cāpi śaktaṃ śaktiprayojakam | śīlinaṃ strīśīlinaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ śvetaṃ nirūpiṇam ||44|| aceṣṭaṃ divyaceṣṭaṃ ca sarvacāritryasaṃbhṛtam | evaṃvidhaṃ paraṃ kāntaṃ matvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||45|| prāpya sākṣād divyayogaṃ brahmarasamavāpnuyāt | naitādṛśyāḥ premarasārjane kiñciddhi śiṣyate ||46|| devalokā brahmalokāḥ sarvalokā hareḥ kṛte | devīlokāḥ parīlokāḥ śrīlokāśca hareḥ kṛte ||47|| guṇātītādilokāśca bhaktalokā hareḥ kṛte | muktamuktānikālokāḥ śreyasāmālayāstathā ||48|| sampadāmālayāścāpi kalpitāḥ parameśvare | bhavanti mokṣadāḥ sarve divyasvāmyabhidhiṣṭhitāḥ ||49|| sarvavidhāyāṃ vikṛtau kṛtau jñāne prasevane | hareḥ prasannatāvāñcchā yasyāḥ sā rasabhoginī ||4.19.50 || ātmaprayatnasaṃrūḍhā dehendriyādiśāsikā | haryarthakṛtasarvasvā brahmarasaṃ samaśnute ||51 || ālocanarasān divyān vyāpārasadrasān parān | ānandamodabhogādīn snehapremasukhotsavān ||52|| kāmasaṃkalpasaktyādīn ratyākarṣaṇamūrchanāḥ | samastāmṛtapānādīn tāmbūlarasamādhavīm ||53|| sparśamādhuryalāvaṇyābhinnasaṃgodbhavān rasān | aśnute dattasarvasvā sarvaśṛṃgārajān rasān ||54|| sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ yasyāstasyā brahmarasāśanam | ghanaśyāmāṃ śvetabhāṃ ca manoharāṃ kiśorikām ||55|| muktānikāmahāmaṇḍalādibhāvaprasevitām | mūrtiṃ kṛṣṇātmikāṃ prāpya bhaved brahmarasāśanam ||66|| ekarasaṃ mahātejo’kṣarabrahmaprakāśakam | rasapūrṇaṃ nijaṃ dhāma parabrahmarasātmakam |||57|| sampādayati bhagavān prajñeśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | kaivalyasaṃbhṛtaḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ ||58|| sa eva mānavaścāste tathāpyamānavo’sti saḥ | tadvastrālaṃkṛtayaśca divyā vāhanadāsikāḥ ||59|| paricaryāparā dāsā divyāḥ pānāśanārhaṇāḥ | sarvāvatāradhartā saḥ sarvāvatārakāraṇam ||4.19.60|| alaukiko’pi bhagavān vartate lokavat tviha | evaṃvettryāstviha mokṣapadaṃ karatale’sti vai ||61|| kartavyaṃ śiṣyate nāsyāḥ sādhanāntaṃ gatā tu sā | vartate brahmamodasthā parabrahmarasāśanā ||62|| satyaprāṇasthitā cāste bhāgavatāptasadrasā | ekāntikasatāṃ yogāt tādātmyarūpaniścayā ||63|| nirvikalpasamādhisthā nirguṇabrahmarūpiṇī | parabrahmarasāsvādā saiva bhavati bhāminī ||64|| yā viśiṣṭā sthūlarūpā māyā tadrasamādhavī | yā sūkṣmāpi kṛṣṇayogāt prasūtiṃ prakarotyapi ||65|| sā kṛṣṇasya sadā patnī bhogyā māyā tu bandhinī | jaḍāpi kṛṣṇasambandhād divyā tadrasasaṃbhṛtā ||66|| bhavatyasaṃkhyalokānāṃ kṛṣṇarasābhiṣañjikā | rādhāramāpriyādyāśca parabrahmarasaiḥ plutāḥ ||67|| rasayanti jagat sarvaṃ tathaiva tannarāyaṇī | sādhusaṃgatimāpannā cāpradhṛṣyā harītaraiḥ ||68|| rasayatyeva sahajānande nijātmavartini | parabrahmarase nitye svāmisakte’tiśāntide ||69|| kṛṣṇaniṣṭhāvatī sādhvī kṛṣṇasvarūpalobhinī | kṛṣṇārthadharmadhartryeva śāntiṃ drutaṃ pragacchati ||4.19.70 || tīvraśraddhā hareḥ prāptau tadrasāvāptaye’pi ca | yasyāḥ sā vindati prajñāprasūtaṃ kṛṣṇajaṃ rasam ||71|| yasyā vihvalatā kṛṣṇadarśanādau sadāsti sā | tīvravegavatīśraddhāśrayā bodhyā tu bhāminī ||72|| mahātmyajñānayuktāyāḥ śraddhātaikṣṇyaṃ prajāyate | asaṃkhyarasalobhena kṛṣṇakāntā prajāyate ||73|| kṛṣṇamūrtiṃ vinā bhedaṃ vinā tyāgaṃ prasevate | sthitaprajñā nirvikalpā dṛḍhaprajñā prabhuṃ patim ||74|| sevate sarvapāpaghnaṃ rasadaṃ cābhayapradam | so’pi bhaktāṃ tathā naijāṃ sevate puruṣottamīm ||75|| nirvikāraṃ sarvavidhakṣetrajñaṃ lepavarjitam | yogyāyogyacaritrāṇāṃ gāyikā gāyati prabhum ||76|| ahobhāgyaṃ ca manvānā sthitaprajñā harau hi sā | ākṣarīṃ sthitimāpannā dhyānakīrtanatatparā ||77|| vandanārcanadānādyaiḥ prasannatāparāyaṇā | dāsīva sarvasevārhā badrīmuktā yathā tathā ||78|| śvetadvīpanivāsābhā śrīpurābhisthiteva sā | sveṣṭadevatāśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śritā sadā ||79|| pativratā sā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe prabhaupatau | manasā varṣmaṇā bhaktyā mūrtau tatsatsu sevayā ||4.19.80|| rādhāramāpramāpadmāvatīsamā prasāditā | vartate sā labhate’tra parabrahmarasāśanam ||81 || yadā sā vartate’nādikṛṣṇasaṃgamasadrase | tadā brāhmī bhavatyeva divyā māyāparā sakhī ||82|| ātmacaitanyatādātmyaṃ harau labdhavatī satī | anādiśrīkṛṣṇakāntamātrasaṃsargasaṃbhṛtā ||83|| parabrahmābhiyogena brahmavad vyāpikā tathā | sarvaiśvaryamahāśaktyasaṃkhyacamatkṛtibhṛtā ||84|| sarvajñeva mahārājñī samrājñī samajāyate | siddhadaśāvatī patnī mahāmuktānikā yathā ||85|| siddhadaśāṃ parāṃ prāpya tenaiva varṣmaṇā priyā | golokaṃ cākṣaraṃ divyaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ śrīpuraṃ tathā ||86|| avyākṛtaṃ cāmṛtaṃ ca dhāmanyanyāni yāni ca | tatra yāti hareryogāt svatantrā rasavedinī ||87|| sṛṣṭitraye’pi sugatirjāyate kṛṣṇabhāminī | kalyāṇadaṃ hi vijñānaṃ sarvakṛttvaṃ hareḥ sadā ||88|| hareḥ satāṃ caritrāṇi daihikāni parāṇyapi | sakāmāni tathā yadvā kāmanāvarjitānyapi ||89|| divyānyeva sadā mokṣapradāni pāvanāni ca | amāyikāni sarvāṇi pratyakṣasya hareḥ satām ||4.19.90|| pratyakṣo bhagavānatra santaḥ sākṣād bhuvi sthitāḥ | prācīnāvyayadhāmasthasanātanasvarūpiṇaḥ ||9 1|| bhavantyevetimāhātmyajñānaṃ yasyāstvihāsti vai | sā prāptā paramabrahmacintāmaṇiṃ hi śāśvatam ||92|| kalyāṇaṃ paramaṃ tasyā jāyate jñānayoṣitaḥ | lakṣyaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ yasyāḥ prāpyo yasyāḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ ||93|| rājyaṃ kṛṣṇarasāvāptiḥ prajā muktānikāgaṇāḥ | ānandaḥ śrīkṛṣṇasaṃge kiṃ tasyā nanu śiṣyate ||94|| hariṃ vinā na lobho’sti paratra vā nijātmani | yāvacca brahmalokeṣu vaibhaveṣvapi kaścana ||95|| yanmano na bhavellagnaṃ sā caikāntikakoṭigā | sādhvīṃ padavīṃ cotkṛṣṭatamāṃ sādhigatā yataḥ ||96|| sādhvyāstasyā brahmapatnyāḥ pūjāṃ kurvanti devatāḥ | hareryogena sā prāptā hyalaukikacamatkṛtim ||97|| cintāmaṇiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastasyāḥ kare sthitaḥ | tena śrīkṛṣṇabhagavatpremarasaṃ samaśnute ||98|| ityevaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāntarasaṃ tvaham | mātarnityaṃ prāptavatī samaśnāmi tadaṃkagā ||99|| nānyamicchāmi rādheśādbhinnaṃ vā cetanaṃ jaḍam | ityuktvā virarāmāpi badrike bālayoginī || 4.19.10 0|| prabhokṛṣṇa harikṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa ramāpate | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin mādhavīśa satāṃ pate || 101 || śrāvayāmāsa bhajanaṃ mātaraṃ bālayoginī | nanarta ca kṣaṇaṃ magnā kānte bhāvabharā tadā || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ bālayoginyā mātre upadiṣṭasya jñānalabhyasyottamabrahmarasasya nirūpaṇamityādināmā navadaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 19 ||
<4.20> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tataḥ śrībālayoginī | punaḥ svamātaraṃ prāha yattadvadāmi te tathā || 1 || upāsanāṃ parabrahmarasāsvādanadāyinīm | ātmanaḥ kiraṇaṃ yadvanmano’ntaḥkaraṇaṃ tathā || 2 || mānasīṃ pratimāṃ kṛtvopāsīta manasi prabhum | avikṛtaṃ manastadvai yatkṛṣṇe cānusaṃhitam || 3 || tadeva bodhyaṃ paramabhāgavatasatāṃ manaḥ | āsaktaṃ yaddharau nityaṃ śītoṣṇabhāvavarjitam || 4 || sādhu manastadvijñeyaṃ kṛṣṇe niścalaniṣṭhitam | akhaṇḍasnehadhārāḍhyaṃ kṛṣṇe viśrāmameti yat| 5 || siddhavad yadivadyogijanavanmuktavanmanaḥ | vadhūvat kāntavadyacca nijeṣṭatamavattathā || 6 || yanmano vartate kṛṣṇe yatsphūrtiṃ vidadhāti yat | yanmagna yatsmṛterhetustadaśnute hareḥ rasam || 7 || nirvāsanaṃ mano nityaṃ nirvāsanaharisthitam | hareḥ satāṃ sevayā ca vāsanā līyate drutam || 8 || sevāyāṃ kiṃkarī bhūtvā rājñyapi vartate tu yā | dānādhīnasamā dāsī prasādaṃ vindati prabhoḥ || 9 || bhagavataḥ satāṃ cāpi ruceraviṣayaṃ tu yat | na kartavyaṃ bhaved yasyāḥ kartavyaṃ kṛṣṇarocakam || 4.20.1 0|| antarāyakaraṃ kṛṣṇasevāyāmiṣṭamityapi | tyaktavyaṃ ca bhaved yasyā hareḥ prasādamṛcchati || 1 1|| guruvatpitṛvanmātṛvadbhūmipālavattathā | hariḥ prasannatāmeti śiṣyāyāṃ yā hi rocikā || 1 2|| śreyase yā satāṃ prasannatārthaṃ yatate sadā | dayātyāgau kṛṣṇasevopāsanāyāṃ kṣatipradau || 13|| dayātyāgau tato mandīkṛtyāpi mādhavaṃ bhajet | puṣpaśṛṃgārahārādyaḥ prasādayet priyampatim || 14|| śayyābhojanapānādyaiḥ toṣayenmādhavīpatim | sarvasvārpaṇadānādyaiḥ rāmayellalitāpatim || 15|| sarvendriyāntaḥkaraṇairupāsīta śriyāḥ patim | dehena guṇadharmādyaiḥ prasādayejjayāpatim || 16|| bhaktān prasādayeccāpi sevayā cānusevayā | bhaktānāmapi bhaktā syād yā sā brahmarasāśanā || 17|| hareḥ prasannatāheturbhaktasevāpi cottamā | bhaktasaṃpaprasādau ca bhaktasevā rasapradā || 18|| bhūsthāpi sādhusevāyāṃ raktā yā sākṣare sthitā | na rogāḥ śrīhareḥ saṃge vighnaṃ kurvanti sevane || 19|| sāvadhānā harernāmnāṃ vṛttāntasya śrave’pi ca | dṛḍhāsaktyā dṛḍhasaṃskāraiśca kṛṣṇamayī bhavet ||4.20.20|| brāhmī bhūtvā bhajet kṛṣṇaṃ vallabhaṃ svāminaṃ prabhum | akṣarātītapuruṣottamaṃ kāraṇakāraṇam ||21 || vāsudevaṃ bhagavantaṃ mahāpuruṣapūruṣam | pitaraṃ sarvasṛṣṭīnāṃ patiṃ sarvaśarīriṇām ||22|| sākṣiṇaṃ karmiṇāṃ cāntaḥprakāśakaṃ guṇātmanām | uttamaṃ ca viśeṣaṃ ca puṃsāṃ sarvāvatāriṇam ||23|| svāminaṃ brahmapuruṣairupāsitapadāmbujam | seveta kambharānandaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ narāyaṇam ||24|| kṛṣṇe sambandhamutkṛṣṭaṃ kuryāt sañjīvanī latā | amṛtāvallikā yadvacchinnā saktāpi jīvati ||25|| vaṭadruvat prakuryācca snehaṃ śrīmativallabhe | jaṭāṃ svasmāt samudbhāvya śākhāmūlo’pi jīvati ||26|| tathendriyādiviṣayaiḥ snehaṃ kṛtvāpi mādhave | yā jīvet prāṇamarpayya sā kṛṣṇarasamaśnute ||27|| kṛṣṇaṃ kuṭumbinaṃ naijaṃ snigdhaṃ sarvārthapūrakam | jñātvā dhṛtvāgragaṃ kṛtvā vihared brahmabhūmiṣu ||28|| dhyātvā sākṣād bālakṛṣṇaṃ saṃkīrtya guṇagāyanaiḥ | āsevya hṛdaye kāntaṃ rahorasaṃ samarjayet ||29|| smṛtiṃ sadāntaḥkaraṇe kuryācchrīkṛṣṇacakriṇaḥ | prasannatāṃ hareḥ śreṣṭhāmāsādayet prasevayā ||4.20.30|| niṣkāmatāṃ prālayecca kṛṣṇārthakṛtaniścayā | sarvasvārpaṇarūpā sā śrīkṛṣṇe sarvakāmanā ||31 || evaṃ naiṣkarmyamāsādya niṣkāmaṃ kṛṣṇamarjayet | upāsīta patiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kriyayā sevayehayā |||32|| snehabhaktyā bhāvanayā nijārpaṇavidhānayā | āsaktyā prajñayā vāsanayātmārpaṇacintayā ||33|| prāṇārpaṇaprakāreṇa rasecchācintanena ca | sādhvīdharmaviśeṣeṇa tathābhyāsena cārjayet ||34|| kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇarasaṃ kṛṣṇasatāṃ satsaṃgasadrasam | kārṣṇīnā ca samastānāṃ rasaṃ divyaṃ samarjayet ||35|| sañcitāni samastāni prabhaukānte vinikṣipet | dehendriyādi karmāṇi śrīkṛṣṇe nikṣipet satī ||36|| ātmadarśanakartrī syāt paramātmavilokinī | hareścaritragītyādyaiścopāsanādibhistathā ||37|| smṛtyā santatayā cāpi kṛṣṇarasaṃ samarjayet | upāsīta hariṃ sākṣāttaccaritrāṇi kīrtayet ||38|| nāmābhibhajanaṃ kuryāt kṛṣṇadharmaṃ prapālayet | kṛṣṇalīlāmayī bhūtvā kṛṣṇabrahmarasaṃ pibet ||39|| akhaṇḍavṛttiṃ śrīkṛṣṇe samādhinā pravartayet | śūravīrā bhavet kṛṣṇe snigdhā māhātmyavedinī ||4.20.40|| kṛpāpātraṃ bhaveccāpi sevayā sā rasaṃ pibet | kṛṣṇaṃ vinānyatucchārthe sneho māyā hi tāṃ jayet ||41|| kṛṣṇājñāṃ saṃvahenmūrdhnā māyā tasyā layaṃ vrajet | dhanade putrade loke pratītirjāyate drutam ||42|| sā pratītirharau kṛṣṇe yasyāḥ sā prakṛtiṃ jayet | svabhāvaṃ svaṃ ca sā tyaktvā śrīkṛṣṇe praviśet sadā ||43|| jīvātmano harau tatra tādātmyaṃ snehasaṃbhṛtam | divyaṃ vai bandhanaṃ kṛṣṇe praveśo raṭanātmakaḥ ||44|| kṛṣṇaṃ vinā mahāduḥkhavipannadivasān nayet | kṛṣṇe’nādau pare nārāyaṇe tādātmyamāpnuyāt ||45|| dehānte vā sadehe vā kṛṣṇakāntetibhāvayet | antardṛṣṭyā harau kānte’parokṣānubhavo bhavet ||46|| tena brahmarasaśreṣṭhasukhacaitanyamāpatet | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt svarasaṃ vai samarpayet ||47|| sadā sā kṛṣṇavāmāṃgī rahasyaṃ paramaṃ labhet | jagatsthityai bhaktatṛptyai vartate bhuvi mādhavaḥ ||48|| anādivāsudevo’pi kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | dharmārthakāmanāceṣṭāḥ kṛtavān prakarotyapi ||49|| jīvā gāyanti śṛṇvanti tāste mucyanta eva ha | māyāyā bandhanāt pāpāt prāpnuvanti paraṃ padam ||4.20.50|| janma karma ratiḥ kāmo mūrtiśceṣṭā kriyā hareḥ | mūrtirdivyā mokṣadā ca sarvaṃ kṛṣṇasya mokṣakṛt ||91 || śrīkṛṣṇaparamabrahmopāsanāṃ vidadhati yā | dṛḍhapratītiyuktā sā vadhūṭīḥ syāt pareśvarī ||52|| satāṃ sevāparā sādhvī bhavet kārṣṇī janārdanī | bhaktāparādhanirapekṣiṇī kṛṣṇādyapekṣiṇī ||53|| satāṃ sevāpekṣiṇī ca śrīkṛṣṇarasabhāginī | mahāsukhābdhimagnā sā sammānārhā ramā yathā ||54|| bhavatyeva sadā sevāguṇagrāhyarthanāvatī | daṇḍavatprapraṇāmādiparā sādhvādarānvitā ||55|| ajñātadrohaśāntyarthaṃ dīnavatprārthanāparā | kṛṣṇapremātimagnā ca sādhvāśīrvādapātriṇī |||96|| bhāgyaṃ mahattamaṃ naijaṃ sevāyāṃ manyate satām | hareḥ prasannatārthaṃ sā nijakalyāṇahetave |||57||| sarvasvaṃ saṃpradāyaiva brahmarasaṃ samaśnute | pratigopisamarūpo dadāti svaṃ rasaṃ param ||58|| koṭyarbudābjapatnīnāṃ pratirūpo babhūva yaḥ | vivāhe ca ratau vāse rahasye rasasampradaḥ ||559|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo gopālanandanaḥ | akṣarādhipatiḥ svāmī kāntaḥ śrīkambharātmajaḥ ||4.20.60|| svāminīśrīmahālakṣmīlālito mādhavīpatiḥ | koṭimuktānikāsvāmī pratyātmāntaratatpatiḥ ||61 || sarvakāmapradastasya yogasthā rasamaśnute | snigdhāṃ mugdhāṃ viyuktāṃ na kadācit kurute prabhuḥ ||62|| guṇātītā nijasattāmātrarūpāṃ samutthitām | nirguṇāṃ brahmarūpātmaprītiṃ sā mādhave’śnute ||63|| yasyāḥ satāṃ bhagavataḥ saṃgo vā darśanaṃ purā | jātaṃ tasyā divyabhāvo brahmabhāvaḥ sadā bhavet ||64|| nāsyā māyā naiva rāgo vāsanā na harītarā | badarīnātharamaṇe sarvathā vartanaṃ bhavet ||65|| nirannabhuktātulyā sā hareḥ prasannatāparā | bhaktaprasādamāpannā tatparā parame pade ||66|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtisaccidānandabhoginī | satāṃ prasādamāsādya bhuṃkte dhāmākṣare sukham ||67|| agnicandrārkavidyudbhiḥ prasāditā hi sādhavaḥ | tataste saṃprakāśante sadaiva sukhino divi ||68|| śubhaiḥ santastoṣaṇīyā brahmarasāptihetave | te santi brahmacaitanyarasapūrṇā harau sthitāḥ ||69|| ātmakalyāṇaparamabrahmānandasukhaiṣiṇī | hareḥ satāṃ prasādaṃ vai sevayā sarvathārjayet ||4.20.70|| hāniṃ vṛddhiṃ hi lokānāṃ dṛṣṭvā yo na viśocati | bhajate śrīhariṃ divyaṃ satpuruṣaḥ sa kṛṣṇavat ||71 || ekāntikaṃ mahābhāgavataṃ dharmaṃ samāśritaḥ | abhāvastādṛśānāṃ tu yasyāḥ sā mṛtasadṛśī ||92|| vindatyatra na saukhyaṃ svaṃ kathaṃ brahmasukhaṃ labhet | mahāpāpāpi yā nārī satāṃ guṇaṃ prasannatām ||73|| sevāṃ cājñāṃ pragṛhṇāti sā pūtāpyakṣaraṃ vrajet | satāṃ yogena pāpāni praṇaśyanti drutaṃ tviha ||74|| indriyāṇi śarīraṃ ca mana ātmā matistathā | divyānyatra prajāyante paramokṣakarāṇyapi ||75|| akhaṇḍaṃ śāśvataṃ kṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ satsamāgame | sthitvārjyaṃ paramabrahmarasāvāptyai striyā tataḥ ||76|| kṛṣṇavat kṛṣṇabhaktānāṃ mitho bhaktaiḥ sumānanam | kartavyaṃ cāpi boddhavyaṃ māhātmyaṃ sevanaṃ tathā ||77|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasaṅgād bhaktā bhaktānikāstviha | divyāste ākṣarāḥ santi muktā nirguṇabhāvanāḥ ||78|| pāvanāḥ sarvalokānāṃ sevanīyā yato mithaḥ | mokṣadāste prasannāḥ syuḥ kṛṣṇasteṣu virājate ||79|| rādhāramādyā bhaktāsu virājante sadā striṣu | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo nareṣu rājate ||4.20.80|| prasādanīyāḥ satataṃ kṛṣṇavacchrīryathā mithaḥ | prasādena hi labhyante parabrahmarasābdhayaḥ ||8 1|| upāsanā hareryadvat tathā satāṃ sadā śubhā | bhaktānāṃ cāpi kartavyā brahmānandastato bhavet ||82|| nijānandarasaṃ bhuṃkte sahajānandasadrasam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmirasaṃ kārṣṇī vadhūḥ sadā ||83|| kṛṣṇamūrtyakhaṇḍacintāvatī sādhvī sakhī priyā | premapūrṇā bālakṛṣṇasvarūpaikyagatā satī ||84|| yā kṛṣṇarasasampūrṇā tasyāṃ kṛṣṇo’pi sarvadā | prasahya vasati premṇā dātuṃ naijaṃ rasaṃ param ||85|| sādhvīmadhye ramā cāste ramāyāṃ bhagavānapi | mahānandarasastatra kṛṣṇe nityaṃ virājate ||86|| rase premasakhī cāste premasakhyāṃ tathā hariḥ | evamaikātmyamevāsti sakhīkṛṣṇarasātmanām ||87|| sādhvī kṛṣṇamayī yatra janma gṛhṇāti sundarī | tatprasūstadgṛhaṃ tasyā dhanyāḥ kuṭumbibāndhavāḥ ||88|| brahmavitsādhusaṃgena vārteyaṃ jñāyate parā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasākṣātpradarśanam ||89|| cintanaṃ sphuraṇaṃ brahmavitsatāṃ saṃgamād bhavet | lābho mānuṣadehasya nānyo haryāptimantarā ||4.20.90|| sarvendriyāṇi sādhūnāṃ hareḥ sevārthakāni ca | tatparāṇi sadā yasyāścaikāntikī hi sā bhavet ||91|| mukhyā sā haribhaktāsu rādhā lakṣmīḥ prabhau yathā | ekāntaṃ kṛṣṇakāntasya yasyā rasāya rocate ||92|| yasyāḥ kṛṣṇasvarūpasyākārasya divyatā matā | satāṃ ca divyatā yasyāḥ sāśnute kṛṣṇasadrasam ||93|| yathā nadyaḥ samudreṣu yathāgnau tu pataṃgakāḥ | śūrā raṇeṣu satyaśca patyau kṛṣṇe tu gopikāḥ ||94|| līnāḥ sarvasvahomāśca bhavanti hi tathā harau | ekarase paripūrṇe brahmātmani pareśvare ||95|| līnā yā cākṣarī bhaktā divyā strī puruṣottamī | akhaṇḍitātisnehā ca niḥsīmaprītiyojikā ||96|| sarvadravābhiyogā ca sarvathā kṛṣṇasaṃśritā | labhate cāśnute kṛṣṇakāntarasaṃ tu śāśvatam ||97|| ātmasattāsvarūpeṇa vartamānā prabhāpatau | maryādayātitādātmyamāpannā labhate rasam ||98|| ityuktvā badrike tāvadvirarāma hi sā kṣaṇam | mātāpyupāsanāyogād brahmarasecchukī hyabhūt ||99|| bālayoginī bāleśaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ balīśvaram | bālarasātmakaṃ prāpya modate mātṛsannidhau || 4.20.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇakāntopāsanayā tadrasāvāptiritinirūpaṇanāmā viṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 20 ||
<4.21> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi sadā me sahacāriṇi | tataḥ śrīmātaraṃ prāha yaṃ dharmaṃ bālayoginī || 1 || tyāginīnāṃ vṛṣā ye ca yoginīnāṃ ca ye vṛṣāḥ | gṛhiṇīnāṃ vṛṣā ye ca te’nuyanti pareśvare || 2 || sādhvīnāṃ ye vṛṣāḥ proktā dāsīnāṃ cāpi ye vṛṣāḥ | vadhūnāṃ kiṃkarīṇāṃ ye te’nuyanti janārdane || 3 || śobhante te vṛṣāḥ sarve sarvāsāṃ mādhavīśvare | sarvadhamāśraye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe sudharmiṇi || 4 || bhogāḥ sarve vilāsāśca kāmāśca sampado’pi ca | vibhūtayaḥ striyo dāsyo yujyante paramātmani || 5 || vane vāso vivāsāśca jaṭitvaṃ cāvamānitā | kāṣāyakṛṣṇaveṣitvaṃ yujyante’pi parātmani || 6 || āśramāścāpi varṇāśca yujyante śrīramāpatau | śraddhāyutā tato nārī praseveta pareśvaram || 7 || sarvadharmāśrayaṃ jñātvā śrīkāntaṃ kambharāsutam | alpaprajñā tu gṛhṇīyāt svāṃ tu paṇḍitamāninīm || 8 || nirdoṣāṃ ca bahujñā ca pareśaṃ buddhivarjitam | sarvakartāramātmānaṃ sarvakartrīṃ pareśvarīm || 9 || lakṣmīpatiṃ badarīśaṃ laliteśaṃ tu kiṃkaram | śeṣādivanditaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tathā vṛthābhimāninam || 4.21.1 0|| nigamāgamavandyaṃ taṃ tucchaceṣṭādikāriṇam | evaṃ doṣān harau kṛṣṇe samudbhāvya vadedghṛṇām || 11 || sā tu dharmānna jānāti dharmamūrtiṃ na vindati | parameśaṃ na manute manute karmacāriṇam || 1 2| etādṛśī mohavatī brahmarasaṃ na vindati | vindatyevārasaṃ kaṣṭaṃ yāmyakṛtaṃ tu dakṣiṇe || 13| satsaṃgena vaśaṃ yāti prabhuḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | harau satsu ca sādhvīṣu tvātmabuddhiḥ sadā śubhā || 14|| yasyāḥ prajāyate prītijananī sārvakālikī | saiva vaśaṃ harikṛṣṇadhavaṃ karoti kāminī || 15|| ātmabuddhiryathā dehe nāryāṃ patyau ca mandire | bhavane pratimāyāṃ ca jale nijajanādiṣu || 1 6|| putre ca viṣaye svaṣṭe tathendriye mukhe śubhe | rūpe bhoge vilāse ca tathā yasyā harau prabhau || 17|| saiva kṛṣṇarasaṃ pāti pibatyapi muhurvadhūḥ | saiva kṛṣṇaṃ vaśaṃ sampādayatyeva na cetarā || 18|| yā bhāvinī kṛṣṇakāntā tasyāśceṣṭāpi vaiṣṇavī | devābhigamanaṃ nityaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanamanvaham || 1 9|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇavārtākathārasātimodanam | satāṃ samāgame vṛttistīrthavāso viśeṣataḥ ||4.21.20|| kṛṣṇabhakteṣu ramaṇaṃ śayana kālayāpanam | nirbhīkatvaṃ māyikeṣu tathaudāsīnyamanvaham ||21|| tulyatā kṛṣṇabhinneṣu kṛṣṇe viśeṣatā sadā | sārarūpaṃ tu yat kārṣṇaṃ tadanyat sāravarjitam ||22|| satāṃ prasannatārthaṃ ca kriyāḥ sarvāḥ praceṣṭanam | hareḥ svarūpacintaiva guṇagānaṃ harestathā ||23|| haryarthaṃ kṛtasarvasvaṃ hayarthaṃ jīvanādikam | śṛṃgārarūpasaundaryaṃ haryarthaṃ sarvameva tat ||24|| yasyā evaṃ sadā vṛttaṃ bhāvinī sā haripriyā | parabrahmarasavettrī nārāyaṇī ramānibhā ||25|| ante pakvadṛḍhamūlā parabrahmahṛdaṃgatā | prītiryasyā harau prāptā viśrāntiṃ sā rasāśanā || 26|| yatrāvaraṇaṃ nāstyeva brahmasattātmavartane | nirāvaraṇā tadyogād brahmanārāyaṇī bhavet ||27|| anyattyāgavatī sādhvī rodhakasya visarjinī | prāṇeśasyābhiyānā ca kalyāṇādeśaśāyinī ||28|| saṃginīnāṃ sakhīnāṃ śreyase yatnopadeśinī | sveṣṭasvāmicaritrāṇāṃ gāyikā copadeśikā ||29|| satāṃ hareśca kaiṃkarye vetti śreyo nijaṃ param | yasyāḥ santyadhikāḥ santaḥ śreṣṭhā brahmādito’pyati ||4.21.30|| hareḥ satāṃ suyogādvai nānyacchreyaḥ paraṃ matam | mahāpuṇyavatīnāṃ ca sevāyogaṃ karotyapi ||3 1 || snehaḥ satsu yathā patnyāṃ patyau putre ca mātari | sahodare ca pitari gurau dehe dhane tathā ||32|| kārayitrī harau satsu snehaṃ sā rasapātrikā | kṛtārthā sā nityasaktā snigdhā bhavati bhāminī ||33|| pūrvabhavādibhiḥ sādhorhareḥ sevāparāyaṇā | punarbhavaṃ prasādārthaṃ sevārthaṃ saṃgatecchayā ||34|| bhajamānāṃ na lokānāṃ vikṣepāḥ pīḍayanti tām | harerviyogavikṣepāḥ satāṃ viyogarūpiṇaḥ ||35|| pīḍayantyeva tāṃ bhaktāṃ brahmarasaparāyaṇām | svayaṃ śrūtvāvamānādi sveṣṭasya ca satāmapi ||36 || udvegaṃ hṛdaye neje prāpnoti svāvamānavat | śrutvā mānaṃ satāṃ cāpi modate sā haripriyā ||37|| sādhusvāmyaparādhādyasahamānā haripriyā | śiro datvāpi kāntasya kṛṣṇasya rañjane sthitā ||38|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe bhāve nimnagā na kadācana | asaṃśayā hareḥ kārye hyupasthitā ca yā bhavet ||39 || sapatnīnāṃ sakhīnāṃ ca snehapakṣābhiyoginī | haryarthārpitasarvasvā mastakaṃ svaṃ dadātyapi ||4.21.40 || ājñāṃ prāpyāvicāryaiva karoti sarvathā tathā | parabrahmarasāsvādā drutaṃ sā jāyate sakhī ||41 || dehendriyāntaḥkaraṇairātmanā kriyayā hi sā | kṛṣṇārpaṇavidhānā vai drutaṃ cāpnoti tadrasam ||42|| manāk vā kṛṣṇasaṃyuktā divyatāṃ yāti tatkṣaṇāt | sarvaṃ naijaṃ yojayedvai kṛṣṇasevādikarmasu ||43|| varteta śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāntaparāyaṇā | sā śrīrādhāramātulyā jāyate’traiva mādhave ||44|| pātivratyena ca tathā hyātmaniṣṭhātiśobhinā | dāsyena yāpi sevāyāṃ vartate sākṣarapriyā ||45|| prakāśamānāṃ satataṃ brāhmī cākṣarasannibhā | brahmabhāve nije rūpe parabrahma prapaśyati ||46|| ataḥ kṛṣṇetarat saukhyaṃ viṣavad bhāsate sadā | kṛṣṇasaṃge bhavecchāntiritaratra tu tāpanam ||47|| kṛṣṇasaṃgisatāṃ saṃge cāśraye śāntirasti ca | kṛtārthatā satāṃ saṃgairhareḥ saṃgairviśeṣataḥ ||48|| sevayāpi mahāmokṣo bhavet prākṛtayoṣitām | kṛṣṇasattāvatīnāryā māyākālabhayaṃ na vai ||49|| satāṃ sattāvatīnāryā vāsanābandhanaṃ na vai | ātmaniṣṭhāvatīnāryāḥ punarjanmabhayaṃ na vai ||4.21.50|| hareḥ prītimatīnāryā mṛtyupāśo na vidyate | bhaktasevāvatīnāryā nirayāṇāṃ bhayaṃ na vai ||51 || satāṃ darśanakartryāstu vyādhyādhibhīrna vidyate | santaḥ santi brahmarūpā brahmamūrtaya uttamāḥ ||52|| teṣāṃ sevāsamaṃ puṇyaṃ mokṣo vānyo na vidyate | balecchā yadi varteta sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ ||53|| svarūpāḥ śrīhareḥ santo’vatārāḥ śreyasāṃpradāḥ | paro’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīmādhavīpatiḥ |||54|| svāmī sarvāvatārāṇāṃ muktānāṃ brahmaṇastathā | svāminīnāṃ ca śaktīnāmīśvarīṇāṃ ca kāraṇam ||55|| vāsudevādayo vyūhāḥ śrīkṛṣṇādyāstu pūrṇakāḥ | āveśāḥ parśurāmādyā aṃśāḥ pṛthvādayastathā ||56|| sanakādyāḥ kalāścāpi sūryādyāśca vibhūtayaḥ | nārāyaṇāśca vibhavā arcāstu śaktimūrtayaḥ ||57|| sarve te brahmadehā vai parabrahmodbhavāḥ śubhāḥ | parabrahmasamāḥ sevyāḥ parabrahmarasāptaye ||58|| sarve te pūrṇasukhadāḥ saṃbhṛtāḥ sukhasadrasaiḥ | parabrahmānandadāste sevyā yoṣinnarādibhiḥ ||59|| mokṣadāste matāḥ sarve sarvakāmapradāstathā | divyānandapradāḥ sarve māyāpārakarāstathā ||4.21.60|| teṣāṃ sarvāvatārāṇāṃ dhārakaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo gopālanandanaḥ ||61|| koṭyarbudābjakāntānāṃ kāntaḥ śrīkambharātmajaḥ | svākṣaraparadhāmastho rājādhirājaśāsanaḥ ||62|| dadāti darśanaṃ sṛṣṭau yatrecchā bhaktapūraṇī | anādisarvasiddhayāḍhyaḥ sarvāścaryaprapūjitaḥ ||63|| anantacamatkāreśo yugapatsarvarūpadhṛk | koṭyarbudābjamūrtyātmā sarvayogakalānidhiḥ ||64|| rasiko rasikānāṃ saḥ tyāgināṃ tyāgavartanaḥ | jñānināṃ jñānadaścāpi sarvamānasapūrakaḥ ||65|| sarvabalacchalakalāmāyājālaphalārthakṛt | sarvoparisthitaḥ śāstānādisvāminarāyaṇaḥ ||66|| nirmoho dehideheṣu hyalaukikapratāpavān | bhaktasevāṃ premayuktāmaṅgīkartuṃ kṛpāvaśaḥ ||67|| bhaktadattān viṣayotthān bhogān bhuṃkte patiryathā | ajñā doṣān kalpayanti manvate saktameva tam ||68|| prākṛtaṃ mānavaṃ yadvat khalā mahimavarjitāḥ | eṣā bhrāntiśca māyā ca tādṛśānāṃ harāviha ||69|| na jñānaṃ śrīhareryadvai pratyutābhāvadarśanam | brahmasthitisamāpannā ye tvātmadarśino janāḥ ||4.21.70 || na muhyanti harau tatra jānanti parabhāvanām | nāpi muhyanti māyāyāṃ kuto moho harestadā ||71 || nirlepaḥ sarvadā cāsti kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | sarvabhoktāpyabhoktāsti pāvanaḥ pāvako yathā |||72|| nāryaḥ pavitrā jāyante tadbhogairgopikā iva | narāḥ pavitrā jāyante satsaṃgāttasya sarvathā ||73|| evaṃvido narā bhaktā bhaktānikāśca sarvaśaḥ | jñānaikāntikatānanyadāsyabhaktā matāḥ sadā ||74|| tādṛśānāṃ kṛte kṛṣṇo brahmarasān suśāśvatān | pravarṣayati mūrtisthān prapāyayati cāśritān ||75|| kṛpā mukhyaṃ sādhanaṃ vai harerbrahmarasāptaye | āśrayaḥ sādhanaṃ cāpi prapattiḥ sādhanaṃ param ||76|| ananyabhāvanā cāpi dṛḍhopāstiśca sādhanam | ājñāprapālanaṃ cāpi sevā snehaśca sādhanam ||77|| māhātmyajñānamevāpi smaraṇaṃ ca nirantaram | sarvasvārpaṇamevāpi viśvāso nyāsa ityapi ||78|| dāsyaṃ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ pātivratyaṃ sādhutvamityapi | patnītvaṃ svāminītvaṃ ca premabhāvābhiṣañjanam ||79|| kṛṣṇeṅgitānusaraṇaṃ satāṃ prasannatādikam | sākṣāt satāṃ susatsaṃgo harerbrahmarasapradaḥ ||4.21.80|| yasyāḥ satāṃ bhagavataḥ sākṣātprāptirihāsti vai | tasyāsteṣāṃ kathāgānaiḥ smṛtyā kālasya nirgamaḥ ||8 1|| tryavasthātītacaitanyātmakātmano nijasya vai | brahmarūpasya sākṣāt syād darśanaṃ kṛṣṇamiśritam |||82||| kṛṣṇavajjāyate dhāmni loke’pyatra na saṃśayaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya caraṇāśraye ||83|| atra paratra sarvatra vasati rādhikā yathā | svāminī jāyate tatra sevikānugrahāddhareḥ ||84|| yāvantaṃ ca mahimānaṃ jānāti paramātmānaḥ | sukhasāmarthyaśobhābhipratāparūpasadguṇaiḥ ||85|| tāvatsamarthā bhavati kārṣṇī nārāyaṇī yathā | tathāpi śrīhareḥ patyuḥ sāmarthyāderasīmatā ||86|| apāratā mahaiśvaryasaundaryādestu mādhave | asaṃkhyakoṭayaḥ santi mādṛśyo bhagavannibhāḥ ||87|| prāptāḥ kṛṣṇasakāśāt tā guṇaiśvaryaprabhādikam | tathāpi mahimā patyuścāpāro vidyate sadā ||88|| leśo’pi nyūnabhāvo na vidyate paramātmani | sāmarthyaguṇakarmādisaundaryasukhadāyitāḥ ||89|| kalyāṇadharmayogāśca bhavantyanantasaṃkhyakāḥ | harestairguṇaleśaiśca bhajanaiśca hareḥ pare ||4.21.90|| haritulyāḥ prajāyante hyanantārbudavaiṣṇavāḥ | tathāpi nāṇumātraśrīharipratāpasadguṇāḥ ||9 1 || nyūnatāṃ saṃvrajantyeva paripūrṇatamastataḥ | agādhāpārasīmādisakhyāntachedavarjitaḥ ||92|| vartate śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | bhajanena gatā dhāmni tatsamā api yoṣitaḥ ||93|| apāratāṃ viditvaiva sevante sevikāḥ sadā | dāsyaḥ sadā pravartante brahmarasān prabhuñjate ||94|| evaṃ kiṃ bahunoktena prāptā sādhanakoṭibhiḥ | sādhyaṃ kāntaṃ badarīśaṃ māṇikyeśaṃ satāṃ patim ||95|| bhavāmīti na cānyanme prāptavyamavaśiṣyate | vidheyaṃ śiṣyate naiva vivāhitāyāścakriṇā ||96|| sarve kāmāḥ samāptā me mātaḥ śrībālamādhave | tato’haṃ sarvadā dāsī kṛṣṇasya bālayoginī ||97|| badarīśī tāpasī ca brahmaśīlā pareśvarī | bhavāmi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāntarasātmikā ||98|| rasaṃ vindāmi tasyaiva jātāpi tava putrikā | varadānaprapūrtyarthamihāhaṃ samupāgatā ||99|| kṛṣṇārdhāhaṃ kṛṣṇakāntā lalitā māṇikī yathā | rādhā lakṣmīḥ mādhavī ca yathā kṛṣṇasya vai priyāḥ || 4.21.10 0|| bhaja mātastathā taṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | ityuktvā sā kanyakā svāṃ mātaraṃ tu sureśvarīm ||1 0 1|| virarāmādhikavāṇyai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasmṛtiḥ | tataḥ sureśvarī kāntaṃ nikāmadevamāha tat || 1 02|| putrīyaṃ badarīdevī māṇikyā cākṣare sthitā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnī pareśvarī || 103|| putrīrūpā gṛhe’smākaṃ prajātāsti narāyaṇī | nānyaṃ cecchati viṣayaṃ śrīkṛṣṇakāntamantarā ||1 04|| tadyoge cāvayormuktirbhāvinyeva na saṃśayaḥ | evaṃ vijñāya vipro’pi mumude cābhajaddharim ||1 05|| bālayoginī bālyādvai babhūva brahmacāriṇī | sā tvaṃ śrī badarīdevi badaryāśramavāsinī ||1 06|| badrīprabhe bhavasi badrikā tyāgasvarūpiṇī | smara sarvaṃ tavaivemaṃ vṛttāntaṃ parameśvari || 1 07|| mama premarasaḥ prāptastvayā vai śāśvataḥ sadā | karoṣi tvaṃ yoṣitāṃ ca mokṣaṇaṃ gītayānayā || 108||| bālayoginīṃ gītāṃ yā nārī śroṣyati vai tathā | vadiṣyati harau snehaṃ vidhāsyati vadhūriva || 1 09|| sā vaṃśaṃ ca dhanaṃ kīrtiṃ sukhaṃ śāśvatajīvanam | kāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ parabrahma samavāpsyati dhāmani || 4.21.11 0|| caturṇāṃ puruṣārthānāṃ siddhistasyā bhaviṣyati | tāmbūlaṃ prāpya kṛṣṇāṃke bhokṣyatyakṣayyatadrasam || 111 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ śāśvatabālayogabrahmarasapradadharmādīnāṃ nirūpaṇanāmaikaviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 21 ||
<4.22> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tataḥ sā bālayoginī | kriyāyogaṃ samagraṃ vai harau cakre’titanmayī || 1 || caturaṅgaṃ mahāyogaṃ yojayāmāsa mādhave | vyāpārān karmarūpān sā nidadhe śrīdhave dhave || 2 || tadyathā nijadehaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaśayyāvaśaṃ vyadhāt | hastau nijau hareḥ kaṇṭhāśleṣaṇe samayojayat || 3 || pādau kṛṣṇābhigamane kṛṣṇapradakṣiṇādiṣu | kṛṣṇārthe sā vyadhājjihvāṃ śrīkṛṣṇakīrtane vyadhāt || 4 || kaṭidānaṃ ca kṛṣṇārthaṃ kṛṣṇāṃke svāsanaṃ vyadhāt | ratiṃ prītiṃ parāsaktiṃ kāmanāṃ haraye’karot || 5 || hāvān bhāvān pramodām̐śca ceṣṭāśca haraye vyadhāt | saṃketān mauninirdeśān kriyārthān haraye’karot || 6 || bhojanaṃ śayanaṃ pānaṃ vihāraṃ haraye vyadhāt | śṛṃgāraṃ śobhanaṃ rūpaṃ divyatāṃ haraye’karot || 7 || kañjalaṃ rañjanaṃ sammārjanaṃ keśaprasādhanam | veṣaṃ bhūṣāḥ sugandhaṃ ca racanāṃ haraye vyadhāt || 8 || mālāṃ hāraṃ maṇiṃ ratnaṃ tailaṃ snānaṃ sucandanam | kesaraṃ kuṃkumaṃ candraṃ patrikāṃ haraye vyadhāt || 9 || alaktakaṃ keśaveṣaṃ dhammilaṃ kabarīṃ latām | tilaṃ tilakaṃ tilakīṃ candrikāṃ haraye vyadhāt || 4.22.10 || hāsyaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca gamanaṃ līlāṃ ramaṇaṃ khelanam | aṃgasvāsthyaṃ suśuddhiṃ ca nārāyaṇāya sā vyadhāt || 1 1|| udgāraṃ prāṇanaṃ niṣadanaṃ dehāṃgabhaṃjanam | aṃgulisphoṭanaṃ tālīvādanaṃ haraye vyadhāt || 12|| gītiṃ miṣṭasvaraṃ tālaṃ vādanaṃ cāṃgakharjanam | sandhivalayanaṃ vāryānayanaṃ śākarandhanam || 1 3|| āstaraṇaṃ tāpaśītasahanaṃ haraye vyadhāt | evaṃ sakhīvayasyābhirbālyakrīḍanakādikam || 14|| kāṣṭhasamitphalapuṣpapatrāharaṇamityapi | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāntārthamānayat || 15|| sarvāḥ kalāḥ śrīharaye’karonnātmārthamīśvarī | evaṃ vyāpārayogāṃgaṃ śrīkṛṣṇārthaṃ vyadhāt sadā || 16|| atha dvitīyaṃ yogāṃgamālocanaṃ harau vyadhāt | ālocanāni jñānāni sarvāṇi haraye vyadhāt || 17|| darśanāni samastāni yāvanti śravaṇāni ca | spārśanāni samastāni yāvanti rāsanāni ca || 18|| ghrāṇajāni samastāni jāgratsvapnakṛtāni ca | mūrchāsuṣuptituryādiprodbhavāni vyadhāddharau || 19|| pratyakṣādīni sarvāṇi pratyabhijñānakānyapi | dhāryākārāṇi sarvāṇi yāvanti sphuraṇāni ca ||4.22.20|| anumānānumityādīnyapi sā haraye vyadhāt | upamānaṃ copamitiṃ sādṛśyaṃ śābdamityapi ||21 || ākāṃkṣāvaśasaṃsargajñānāni haraye vyadhāt | arthāpādanamevāpi tarkaṃ siddhiṃ ca nirṇayam ||22|| anupalambhamevāpi saṃbhāvanāṃ kutūhalam | mānasaṃ cintanaṃ prabodhanaṃ tathābhimānanam ||23|| guṇānāṃ gaṇanāṃ cāpi bhāvanāṃ śubhavāsinīm | snehaṃ sukhaṃ pramodaṃ ca vāñcchāṃ yatnaṃ vṛṣaṃ śrutim ||24|| vegaṃ copāsanāṃ bhaktiṃ sevāṃ dhyānaṃ dayāṃ kṛtim | grahaṇaṃ smaraṇaṃ harṣaṃ vihvalatāṃ prasañjanam ||25|| evamālocanānyaṃsyā haryartha vai sadābhavan | atha tṛtīyaṃ yogāṃgaṃ jīvārpaṇaṃ vyadhāddharau ||26|| ātmā yaścetano dehe prāṇayogena jīvati | jīvanaṃ bhogasampattirbhogārpaṇaṃ vyadhāddharau ||27|| sukhamodānucaitanyaṃ prakāśaścātmarūpakaḥ | prakāśasyārpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇe vyadhādvai bālayoginī ||28|| saccidānandarūpo yo nityānandaprapūritaḥ | saccidānandatāṃ kṛṣṇe prārpayatsā tu bālikā ||29|| ātmaniveditāṃ kṛṣṇakānte vyadhāttu yoginī | sadbhāvaṃ satsvarūpe vai cidbhāvaṃ citsanātane ||4.22.30|| ānandaṃ śāśvatānande cātmānaṃ paramātmani | brahmatāṃ pūrṇatāṃ cāpi jñātṛtā cendratāṃ nijām ||3 1|| śāstṛtva rājatāṃ cāpi kṛṣṇe bālā samārpayat | atha turyaṃ parabrahmarasabhogātmakaṃ sukham || 2 2|| yogāṃgaṃ kṛṣṇanirvāṇaṃ kṛṣṇānandarasāplavam | parabrahmarasābhogaṃ kṛṣṇatādātmyasaṃbhavam ||33|| akhaṇḍāsīmasaṃbhogānandāsvādasukhottamam | svādaikatānatāmūrchātadātmakasamādhitām || 34|| dravībhāvaṃ tadadṛśyātmakatvaṃ rasadivyatām | lāvaṇyāmṛtamādhuryapīyūṣapānatṛptijām ||35|| sudhāśītalaśāntiṃ sā prārpayat paramātmani | evaṃ sā badarīdevi kanyakā bālayoginī ||36|| yogāṃgāni tu catvāri samārpayat parātmani | mātā sureśvarī vīkṣya vismayaṃ yāti nityadā ||37|| nāsyāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā tattvaṃ pārthakyaṃ bhajate kvacit | kṛṣṇaḥ kārṣṇī tathā kārṣṇī kṛṣṇaḥ sā bālayoginī ||38|| vācake’pi na vai bhedo liṅgabhedo’pyalīyata | mātrā kvacid dṛśyate sā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmikā ||39|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhūtvā dṛśyate bālayoginī | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇī lakṣmīrbadarītimuhurmuhuḥ ||4.22.40|| vyāpārālocanajīvabrahmarasasamarpaṇam | caturaṃgamahāyogaṃ yogīśvare hyavāpa sā ||41|| athaivaṃ vīkṣya tāṃ kanyāṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇām | sureśvarī sutāṃ prāha putri saṃskāramantarā ||42|| deho hyaśuddho bhavati tasmād vivāha iṣyate | vivāhena sadā śuddhiḥ kanyakānāṃ prajāyate ||43|| dīrghikāyāḥ kumāryāstu svarge tvindrasabhāsthale | sabhāyāṃ vartamānāyā yadā sabhāvisarjanam ||44|| bhavatyeva tataḥ paścāt tasyā asanamuttamam | indro matvā hyaśuddhaṃ vai kārayatyeva śodhanam ||45|| jalena prokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā śuddhiṃ karoti devarāṭ | tad vijñāya tataḥ pṛṣṭho dīrghikayā sureśvaraḥ ||46|| kathaṃ madāsane cendra prokṣaṇaṃ kriyate’nvaham | pratyuttaraṃ jagādendro bhavatī yuvatī hyasi ||47|| avivāhitakanyāsi
