hyaśuddhāsi tato nvaham | aśuddhamāsanaṃ te’tra śodhayāmi tu siñcanaiḥ ||48|| yadvā vivāhitā bhūtvā bhava śuddhimatī sute | mānavyasi rajovyāptā patiśūnyā hyaśuddhigā ||49|| patiṃ prāpya vivāhena śuddhā tvaṃ saṃbhaviṣyasi | vivāhākhyastu saṃskāraḥ patinā ca samāgamaḥ |||4.22.50|| kanyānāṃ dehaśuddhyarthaṃ brahmaṇā tu vinirmitaḥ | tad yāhi kṛtaśuddhistvaṃ bhava śuddhāsanā sute ||51 || ityuktā sā mahendreṇa kṛtvā vivāhamātmanaḥ | ṛṣiṇā sveṣṭayogyena tataḥ śuddhāsanābhavat ||52|| tat tvaṃ kanye bālike tvaṃ varaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ patiṃ prabhum | vidhinā tu vivāhena samāsādaya madgṛhe ||513|| vahniviprajanasākṣye śuddhāpi śuddhimeṣyasi | māturme vacanaṃ matvā vivāhotsavamāpnuhi ||64|| ityuktā sā mātṛbhaktā sarvadharmārthavedinī | omityāha prasū tatra mātā modamavāpa ha ||55|| dadhyau sā kanyakā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ varaṃ harim | kuṃkumavāpikāvāsaṃ pārvībadrīpriyampatim ||56|| gopālabālakaṃ śrīmatkaṃbharātanujaṃ prabhum | naranārāyaṇarūpaṃ sveṣṭasvāmipumuttamam ||57|| māturmānasasiddhyarthaṃ nitarāṃ magnamānasā | satataṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dadhyau samādhiṣu ||58|| divārātraṃ sthitā dhyāne tāvat taijasavigrahaḥ | puṣṭayuvānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hasan hariḥ ||59|| śrīkṛṣṇovallabhaḥsvāmī sarvaśṛṃgārabhūṣaṇaḥ | rūparūpānurūpāḍhyamūrtiḥ kanyāmanoharaḥ ||4.22.60|| svarṇabhāsuraśobhāṃgaḥ svayameka upāgataḥ | uvāca tāṃ nijapatnīṃ vada kiṃ kāṃkṣasi priye ||61|| yā te vāñcchā kariṣye tāṃ pūrṇāṃ brūhi manogatam | atha śīghraṃ samutthāya hṛṣṭā sā bālayoginī ||62|| papāta pādayoḥ prāha gṛhāṇa vidhinā tu mām | varamālābhūṣitaśca vahrimaṇḍapasatkṛtaḥ ||63|| vivāhanaṃ devatānāṃ sannidhau me kuru prabho | māturme vacanaṃ tathyaṃ kuru nārāyaṇa prabho ||64|| śrutvā bāloditaṃ cānugrahamūrtiḥ svayaṃ hariḥ | astvevaṃ ceti jagrāha vivāhārthaṃ samutsukaḥ ||65|| atha bālā dadau tasmai madhuparkaṃ prapūjanam | jagrāha sa tato bālā ninye taṃ nijamātaram ||66|| prāha tāṃ mātaraṃ kanyā mātaḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | āyātaḥ kṛpayā cātra tavecchayārthimānakṛt ||67|| kṛtārthaṃ kuru cātmānaṃ mātaḥ prapūjya keśavam | mānavena svarūpeṇa kṛpayā tvāmupasthitam ||68|| mātā sasaṃbhramā tasya cakre svāgatamāsanam | anarghyaṃ pradadāvarghyaṃ dadau cakre prapūjanam ||69|| nikāmadevaṃ sahasā jagādāgatamacyutam | so’pi vīkṣya hariṃ putrīprāṇeśaṃ parameśvaram ||4.22.70|| suprahṛṣṭaḥ paraṃ cakraṃ sanmānaṃ pārameśvaram | nanarta sa kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā kanyāprāṇapatiṃ patim ||71|| sarvapatiṃ kṛpāpārāvāraṃ mānavavigraham | gṛhātithiṃ saumyaveṣaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ||72|| atha mātā samiyeṣa draṣṭuṃ rūpaṃ caturbhujam | divyaṃ śrīsvāminaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram ||73|| vijñāya sahasā śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo hṛdi sthitam | caturbhujo’bhavattūrṇaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ ||74|| rādhālakṣmīpūjitaśca pārṣadādikṛtārhaṇaḥ | darśayitvā divyarūpaṃ punaḥ sa mānavo’bhavat ||75|| arcito vanditaḥ kṛṣṇo bhojitaḥ sevitastataḥ | tilakena sucandreṇa puṣpahāraiḥ praśobhitaḥ ||76|| vāgdānena ca kanyāyāḥ praharṣito vidhānataḥ | vivāhavidhinā kanyāṃ pariṇetuṃ tato’rthitaḥ ||77|| prasthāpitaśca bahudhā śīghrāgamāya cārthitaḥ | vardhitaścāśiṣā tūrṇaṃ tiro’bhavat tadāmbare ||78|| atha sarve pratīkṣante punarnārāyaṇāgamam | bālayoginīrūpāyāḥ śriyā vivāhasūtsavam ||79|| tāvannārāyaṇakṛṣṇaḥ preṣayāmāsa bhūsuram | nāmnā yogīśvaradevaṃ vṛttāntakathanāya vai ||4.22.80|| vipraḥ śīghraṃ samāgatya nikāmadevamandiram | kṛṣṇoditaṃ tu vṛttāntaṃ nikāmadevanāmine ||8 1 || kathayāmāsa sarvasvaṃ vivāhasya kṣaṇottamam | āṣāḍhadhavale pakṣe caturthyāṃ prātareva ha ||82|| āgamiṣye hi lagnoktavivāhārthaṃ kuṭumbayuk | ityuktvā prayayau viprastirobhūya nijālayam ||83|| sureśvarī ca tatputrī nikāmadevabhūsuraḥ | prasannāścābhavam̐statra kanyāvivāhamodinaḥ ||84|| atha nikāmadevaśca lagnapatraṃ vilikhya vai | preṣayāmāsa śīghraṃ tad vipradvārā tu mādhavam ||85|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ gatvā vipro harīśvaraḥ | arpayāmāsa lagnasya patraṃ maṃgalabodhakam ||86|| jagrāha bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mudā tu tat | vipraṃ pupūja puṣpādyairdhanaṃ ratnāni sampadaḥ ||87|| viprāya pradadau śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇa ādarāt | mātā śrīkaṃbharālakṣmīrmaṃgalāni hyagāpayat ||88|| dadau dānāni bahūni ropayāmāsa maṇḍapam | kuṭumbibhyaḥ patrikāśca tadbodhikā hyavāsṛjat ||89|| lomaśena samaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ prabhuḥ | aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthe snātvā nijālaye sthitaḥ ||4.22.90|| piṣṭikāmardanaṃ cakrurnāryastasya haripriyāḥ | snapayāmāsuratyarthaṃ candanādyaiḥ sumarditaiḥ ||9 1 || āṣāḍhaśuklatṛtīyāniśāyā parameśvaraḥ | vibhūṣito yuvā puṣṭo rājādhirājacihnitaḥ ||92||| mātāpitṛkṛtasarvamaṃgalaḥ sumaharṣibhiḥ | āśīrbhirvardhitaḥ sarvakuṭumbibhiḥ pramoditaḥ ||93|| tīrthadevaiśca muktaiśca brahmapriyādibhiryutaḥ | saurāṣṭrabhaktavargaiśca divyāśvagajavāhanaiḥ ||94|| pāresāhasranārībhiḥ samanvitaḥ śubhe kṣaṇe | sarvairdivyasuśobhāḍhyairyutaśca sādhubhirvaraiḥ ||95|| kuṃkumavāpikāsarvaprajābhiḥ sahito yayau | pratasthire kṛtājñāśca varavāhinikāyujaḥ ||96|| bahūtsāhabhavā nāryo narāḥ saubhāgyaśālinaḥ | prātareva brāhmakāle prāpurvarasamanvitāḥ ||97|| dhūnīgrāmaṃ mahodyānābhivyāptaṃ bahuśobhitam | karuṇāvārigātīre mahodyāne nivāsanam ||98|| viśrāntiṃ lebhire tatra tāvannikāmadevakaḥ | kuṭumbasahito nārīgītamaṃgalaśobhitaḥ ||99|| viprādisahitaḥ pūjāṃ kartuṃ tūrṇamupāyayau | anādiśrībālakṛṣṇaṃ varaṃ kanyārthamāgatam || 4.22.10 0|| sarvaiśvaryaparipūrṇaṃ vīkṣya harṣaṃ jagāma ha | divyo varo varavṛddhā divyāḥ kuṭumbinastathā || 101 || divyāśca varavāhinyāgatā nāryo narāstadā | divyā vāhāśca yānāni divyopakaraṇānyapi || 10 2|| divyā devā devatāśca devyo brahmapriyāstathā | haripriyāḥ prajāścāpi divyataijasavigrahāḥ || 1 03|| sarvaṃ divyaṃ vilokyaiva mahāścaryaṃ yayau mudhā | cintayāmāsa sarveṣāṃ daśasāhasradehinām || 1 04|| satkārārthaṃ miṣṭamannaṃ miṣṭaṃ jalaṃ ca mandiram | śayyāsanāni sarvāṇi bhavanānyuttamāni ca || 1 05|| bhojyapātrāṇyanantāni dravyānnarasaśarkarāḥ | pūjāṃ cakre mahādhairyaḥ smarannārāyaṇaprabhum || 106 || putrīpatiṃ sarvasiddhisevitaṃ cāgataṃ harim | cintāmaṇiṃ prabhuṃ spṛṣṭvā cintayāmāsa vaibhavān || 107|| nārāyaṇārthaparyāptān vivāhotsavaśobhanān | sarvārthān kalpayāmāsa pūjayan svasutāpatim || 1 08|| jāmātāraṃ prabhuṃ prāpya bhayaṃ dāridryasaṃbhavam | nābhūttasya tadā tatra putryāḥ pratāpato’pi ca || 1 09|| mahārājādhirājānāṃ cintayāmāsa sampadaḥ | tāvattatra vanoddeśe mahodyānāni sarvataḥ || 4.22.110 || phalapuṣpasugandhāḍhyajalābjapūritāni vai | abhavan tatra sauvarṇasaudhāni paritastadā || 11 1|| dāsā dāsyo’yutānyapi devā devyo’bhavan drutam | nikāmadevapakṣasya kāryanirvartakāstadā || 1 12|| pākaśālā aśvaśālā rājaśālāśca vai śubhāḥ | nārīśālā maṇḍapaśca sauvarṇanirmitāstadā || 11 3|| mahānasāni bhojyāni rasāśca madhuśarkarā | miṣṭānnāni samastāni śākāni dravavanti ca || 1 14|| gandhasārāṇi sarvāṇi dugdhasārāṇi yāni ca | bhakṣyāṇi lehyacośyāni pratyakṣāṇi tadābhavan || 115 || śayyāsanāni paryaṃkā samastabhogyakānyapi | na nyūnaṃ vidyate tatra kalpavallyo gṛhe gṛhe || 1 16|| yathā svargaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ dhūnīgrāmastathābhavat | nāryo narāśca paśavo gṛhāṇi mṛttikāsthalam || 1 17|| sarvaṃ svargasamaṃ tatra jātaṃ kṛṣṇakṛpāvaśāt | pūjayitvā varaṃ vṛddhān satkṛtvā ca prajāstathā || 1 18|| nikāmadevo vīkṣyāpi vaikuṇṭhābhaṃ nijasthalam | mumude kṛṣṇajaṃ sarvaṃ divyaṃ matvā tu vaibhavam || 1 19|| āvāsān kārayāmāsa dadau dāsīśca kiṃkarān | vādayāmāsa vādyāni vedaghoṣān vyadhāpayat || 4.22.120|| gāpayāmāsa sarvatra maṃgalāni tadā drutam | preṣayāmāsa bhogyāni rasānnasalilānyapi || 121 || apekṣitātivastūni divyamanoharāṇi ca | sevayāmāsa bhāvaiśca mahīmānānaśeṣataḥ || 122|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginyāścaturvidhamahāyogavarṇanaṃ mātṛvacanena vivāhavidhyartham anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya dhyānottaramāgamanaṃ tirobhāvaśca, vivāhārthaṃ vāhinyā saha dhūnīgrāmamāgamanam, divyavaikuṇṭhavat sampatkaraṇaṃ mahīmānasatkārādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 22 ||
<4.23> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi madhyāhnabhojanānyapi | pravṛttāni samastāni sarveṣāṃ tṛptidānyati || 1 || divyāmṛtāni sarvāṇi nihitāni tu cakriṇā | yadagre māyikāḥ sarve rasā niḥsvādatāṃ gatāḥ || 2 || saṃkalpairbālayoginyā brahmarasānvitāni vai | miṣṭānnāni samastāni bhojanāvasare’bhavan || 3 || jalaṃ brahmahradāttatra samudbhūtaṃ tadākṣarāt | golokāddhṛtadugdhādi dadhyājyanavanītakam || 4 || vaikuṇṭhāddivyaśākādi śrīpurādbhojanāni ca | kṣīrodāt pāyasānnāni badrīkṣetrāt phalāni ca || 5 || sūryalokāccaṭanyādi candrācchrīkhaṇḍakānyapi | hiraṇyayāttu pātrāṇi śrīlokācchayanāni ca || 6 || viṣṇulokāt samastāni śṛṃgārakāṇi cāgaman | nāpūrṇaṃ vidyate tatra kiṃcit saṃkalpitaṃ navam || 7 || adṛṣṭaṃ cāśrutaṃ vāpi drāg ramyaṃ samajāyata | upasthitaṃ drutaṃ bhoktuḥ sannidhau cāvilambitam || 8 || sampanne bhojane tvevaṃ badrike mukhavāsanam | tāmbūlakādi sarvaṃ ca yogyaṃ samarpitaṃ tadā || 9 || viśrāntiṃ ca tataḥ saudheṣveva te madhyake’hani | prāpustatastu sajjāścābhavan dinavyayottaram ||4.23.10|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śṛṃgāritastadā | vararājasvarūpeṇa śobhānvitaḥ suveṣitaḥ || 11 || sahasrasūkṣmamaṇibhirmadhye ca mahatā tathā | maṇinā khacitaḥ śreṣṭho mṛdusauvarṇanirmitaḥ || 1 2|| mukuṭaḥ kalgisahitastejaḥparidhiśobhitaḥ | saṃvṛtaḥ kṛṣṇaśirasi lalāṭe candramāḥ kṛtaḥ || 1 3|| kajjalaṃ netrayordattaṃ karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale śubhe | puṣpāvataṃsāḥ parito varabodhanakāriṇaḥ || 14|| mukuṭe lambitā hārāścitrasugandhipuṣpajāḥ | svarṇahārā ratnayutāḥ kaustubhena samanvitāḥ || 15|| kaṇṭhe dhṛtā pītavarṇanīśāropari vakṣasi | pītāmbaraṃ svarṇatārairgrathitaprāntaśobhitam || 16|| paṭaṃ kaṭitaṭe baddhaṃ svarṇabhāsuramujjvalam | pattrāṇe kauśeyajanye raktavarṇe piśaṃginī || 17|| skandhayoḥ śreṣṭhavasanaṃ prāvāravaramuttamam | sauvarṇaprāntasaṃśobhaṃ puṣpahārāvalibhṛtam || 18|| bhujabandhau prakoṣṭhasthaśṛṃkhale kaṭake tathā | ūrmikāścāṃgulicakrāṃgulīyakāni vai tathā || 1 9|| ratnāḍhyāni ca divyāni dhāritāni hi cakriṇaḥ | raśanāṃ svarṇanirmāṇāṃ khaḍgaṃ sauvarṇataijasam || 4.23.20|| dhārayāmāsurevainaṃ nārikelaphalādikam | caturdantaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ hastinaṃ cādrisadṛśam ||21 || mahāśuddhaṃ surūpaiśca rūpitaṃ svarṇakūthinam | sāmbālikaṃ sūryabhāvat taijasaṃ muktakoṭikam ||22|| śṛṃgārita kṛtasarvakautukaḥ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ | ārohayacchatrayaṣṭidharacāmarisevitaḥ || 23|| varavāhinikā devairjuṣṭā maharṣimānavaiḥ | divyavājigaruḍādyaiḥ śobhate dhāmagā yathā ||24|| pradīpāścauṣadhīnāṃ ca vṛtānāṃ vidyutāṃ tathā | maṇīnāṃ divyaratnānāṃ tadāsan paritaḥ sukhāḥ || 25 || evaṃ sā sarvaśobhāḍhyā vṛddhajanairalaṃkṛtā | nārīvargairatigītā vāhinī vyacarat puraḥ ||26|| tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāstathābhavan | puṣpavṛṣṭirdivyahastairmuktābhavacca cāndanī || 27|| lājākṣatādimāṃgalyairvardhitaḥ parameśvaraḥ | hastinā saṃvṛtaḥ pṛṣṭhe yayau vivāhamaṇḍapam ||28|| viśālaṃ cāmbaraspṛṣṭaṃ vicitrāmbaraśobhitam | svarṇastambhapraśākhātoraṇādyairatyalaṃkṛtam ||29 || naisargikapradīpādyaiḥ svarṇakalaśairvardhitam | kalpalatādibhirvyāptaṃ nisargagītigarjitam ||4.23.30|| magalāyatanadaivapratimādyabhirājitam | kuṇḍavipropakaraṇairvahnidevādhivāsitam ||31 || sarvasamitsamājuṣṭaṃ vedaviprābhivardhitam | etādṛśaṃ dhāmatulyaṃ prāpya vai maṇḍapaṃ varaḥ ||32|| avatīrya gajānnamaskṛtya tanmaṇḍapeśvaram | śvaśureṇa tathā śvaśrvā satkṛtaḥ pūjito hariḥ |||33||| lokācāraiḥ saṃskṛtaśca jalādyairmālikādibhiḥ | akṣatādyairvardhitaśca gṛhopakaraṇaistathā ||34|| nirvighnīkṛta īśeśo viśrāntyai nīta ālayam | mahāmandiramadhye susvarṇasaudhāntare tadā ||35|| siṃhāsane śvaśurādyairupāveśita ādṛtaḥ | hāraiḥ svāgatayatnaiśca prasādito’nnavāribhiḥ ||36|| prāghūṇikāḥ samastāśca jalatāmbūladānakaiḥ | miṣṭānnakaiḥ phalaiścāpi prasāditāḥ sukhīkṛtāḥ ||37|| vādyante tatra vādyāni gīyante gītayaḥ śubhāḥ | uddhoṣyante vedamantrāḥ pramodante narāḥ striyaḥ ||38|| atha nāryaḥ kumāryaśca saubhāgyayoṣitastadā | vividhairdivyaveṣādyaiḥ śṛṃgārairbhūṣaṇādibhiḥ ||39|| prasādhanaiḥ śṛṃgārayāmāsustāṃ bālayoginīm | sugandhitailasārādyaiḥ salilaistīrthapāvanaiḥ ||4.23.40|| candanaiḥ kesaraiḥ piṣṭaiḥ piśaṃgaiḥ svarṇacūrṇakaiḥ | saṃsnāpya ghargharīṃ svarṇabuṭṭaratnādisaṃbhṛtām ||41|| nidhārayāmāsurapi śāṭīṃ sauvarṇabhāsurīm | kañcukīṃ kānakīṃ sūkṣmatantūtthāṃ kacalīṃ tathā ||42|| colīṃ ca kucalīṃ svarṇavarṇāṃ ca naktakaṃ śubham | raktarūpāṃ sūkṣmaśāṭīsahāyiśāṭikāṃ daduḥ ||43 || keśaveśaṃ ca kabarīṃ dhammilaṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca | saphulakaṃ grathanaṃ ca kṛtvā sumukuṭaṃ nyadhuḥ ||44|| lalāṭikāṃ bālapāśīṃ cūḍāmaṇiṃ ca śṛṃkhalām | cūḍāmaṇiṃ karṇabhūṣāmīrayāne ca bālikām ||45|| natthīṃ ca candrikāṃ phullīṃ ṭippakīṃ ratnacakrikām | paṭṭapatrīṃ phullamālāṃ mudgamālāṃ ca māṣajām ||46|| caṇahārān maṇihārān parvahārān nyadhurgale | kaṭake śṛṃkhale siṃhakaṭake bhujabandhake ||47|| ūrmikāścāṃgulicakrāṇyapi prapadmapatrikām | raśanāṃ dhārayāmāsurjhaṃjhīre ghurghurīyute ||48|| kiṃkiṇījālanādāḍhyai kaṭake kāmbike nyadhuḥ| pādāṅgulīyakānyūrdhvacandrāḍhyāni nyadhustathā ||49|| kaṇṭhīṃ lalantikāṃ graiveyakāṇi kuṇḍalāni ca | muktāhārādikān hārān gucchagostanamālikāḥ ||4.23.50 || kaṃkaṇe mekhalāṃ maṃjīre ca nyadhārayattadā | nakhālaktakadānaṃ ca karapādatalādiṣu ||51 || oṣṭhagaṇḍakapolādau bhāle stanayoḥ rañjanam | kajjalaṃ netrayordehe veṣe svarṇādicūrṇakam ||52|| nyadhustā yoṣitaḥ kanyārūpe rūpābhivṛddhaye | puṣpahārānnadhuścāpi vadhūṭīmukuṭe śubhān ||53|| svalpalajjāṃ sūkṣmaśāṭikayā vyaracayan striyaḥ | tāmbūlacarvaṇaṃ miṣṭabhojaṃ vāripānakam ||54|| daduḥ prāpte muhūrte’tha lāgnike maṇḍapaṃ prati | varaṃ ca mahīmānādīnānayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||55|| viprā vṛddhā lomaśādyāḥ śiṣṭācāraṃ vyadhustadā | prakṣālya caraṇau sureśvarī nīrājanaṃ vyadhāt ||56|| pupūjākṣatakusumairlājādyaiḥ samavardhayat | varaṃ cātha gītivedairvardhito mṛtkapālakam ||57|| saṃcūrṇya natvā devām̐śca guruṃ vahniṃ sa maṇḍape | kuṇḍāgre nyaṣīdad darśitāsane vararāṭ sa hi ||58|| yoṣābhiścākṣatapuṣpairvardhito viprapuṃgavaiḥ | nipīto grāmayoṣābhiścakṣurbhistṛṣitairati ||59|| hṛdaye gamito divyaścātmanyarpita iṣṭavat | atha striyaḥ samāninyurmaṇḍapaṃ bālayoginīm ||4.23.6 0 || sureśvarīsahitāstā jaguśca lagnagītikāḥ | viprāḥ kanyāṃ tadā gandhākṣatapuṣpādibhirdrutam ||61 || vardhayāmāsuruccaiśca maṃgalāni jagurmuhuḥ | dinaṃ saṃkalpayāmāsurnyaṣādayan surāntike ||62||| kanyakāṃ vāmabhāge śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai | gaṇeśādipūjanaṃ ca kārayāmāsurityapi ||63|| kāmaphalabandhanaṃ ca maṇḍapāgniprapūjanam | kuṇḍaprapūjanaṃ vipravṛddhādipūjanaṃ tathā ||64|| prāyaścittaṃ tu śuddhyarthaṃ kārayāmāsurityatha | śrāddhāditarpaṇaṃ cāpi kuladevādipūjanam ||65 || kārayitvā varagale kanyāhastena mālikām | puṣpāṇāṃ dāpayāmāsuḥ puṣpākṣatādivardhanam ||66|| varahastena kanyāyāḥ kaṇṭhe’pi mālikāṃ tathā | vastragranthimato viprāścakrustato’bhidānakam ||67|| agneḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ caturvāraṃ ca namanārcanam | kārayāmāsurevaitau havanaṃ haviṣāṃ tathā ||68|| hastagrahaṃ pitā tatra kārayāmāsa dānakṛt | varahaste dadau hastaṃ kanyāyāstu nikāmataḥ ||69|| nikāmadevo viprarṣiścāśīrvādān dadau tadā | mahābhāgyavatī putri bhava nārāyaṇī sadā ||4.23.70|| bālakṛṣṇaḥ prajagrāha karaṃ kanyārpitaṃ kare | sahadharmān caratāṃ vai tādātmyaṃ caratāṃ sadā ||71 || dadurviprā āśiṣaśca dānaṃ daduḥ pare janāḥ | hastadravyaṃ daduścāpi bahuratnādisaṃbhṛtam ||72|| dakṣiṇārhaṇadānāni viprebhyaḥ pradadau pitā | śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇādyā dadurdānāni bhūriśaḥ ||73|| godānādisamastāni mahādānāni vai daduḥ | kavalaṃ ca mithastatra jagṛhaturvadhūvarau ||74|| anyonyasya mukhe premṇā dadatustatra maṇḍape | ūrmikākhelanaṃ tatra cakraturjalapātrake ||75|| parihāraṃ tu bhūdevāścakrurvai yoṣitastadā | gītikāpūrvakaṃ ramye mandire dampatīṃ śubhe ||76 || ninyurhāsyāni cakruśca dadustābhyāṃ subhojanam | jalapānaṃ tathā tāmbūlakaṃ daduśca vai rahaḥ ||77|| śayanaṃ pradadustatra vadhūṭī pāritoṣikam | prāpya siṣeve kāntaṃ cātha prāghuṇāstathā prajāḥ ||78|| bhuktvā vyadhuśca śayanaṃ prātarjātaṃ tato janāḥ | pañcamyāmāṣāḍhaśukle snātvā bhuktvā samutsukāḥ ||79|| dampatīvāhinīyuktāḥ sajjā gantuṃ tato’bhavan | pitānikāmadevaśca dhanaṃ prādānmahottamam ||4.23.80|| yautakaṃ bahudhā tatra divyaṃ sarvaṃ viśeṣataḥ | pradadau kanyakā sāpi śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||8 1 || pati prāha pitarau me saha kṛṣṇa naya tvayā | dhūnīgrāme pitarau me madviyogena duḥkhitau ||82|| syātāṃ tasmād bhavatkṣetraṃ naya kṛṣṇa kṛpāṃ kuru | atha tāvat samāgatya pādau dhṛtvā harerapi ||83 || prāha nikāmadevo’pi naya nau vai nijaṃ gṛham | hariḥ prāha tathāstvevaṃ tathā gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||84|| ninye snuṣāpitarau tau nijāṃ kuṃkumavāpikām | sureśvarī tathā nikāmadevo bālayoginī ||85|| yayuḥ kṛṣṇasya vāhinyā samaṃ kuṃkumavāpikām | dhūnīgrāmajanāścānye yayurbhaktā harestu ye ||86|| prasthānaṃ cakrire sarve madhyāhne bhojanottaram | devavādyānyavādyanta puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha ||87|| sureśvaryā jitā māyā jitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sutārpaṇāt | jito mokṣaśceti vāṇī surāṇāmabhavaddivi ||88|| atha svargasamo grāmo maṇḍapo divyakānakaḥ | yajñaśālā rasaśālā mahānasāni yānyapi ||89 || sarvaṃ tiro’bhavat sadyaḥ prasthite parameśvare | miṣṭānnāni prasādāni devādyā ninyurutsukāḥ ||4.23.90|| tīrthāni ca surādyāśca yayurvismayamacyute | dāsā dāsyo harikṛtā adṛśyatāṃ yayurdrutam ||9 1 || vāhayitvā vāhinīṃ svāṃ bālayoginikāpatiḥ | bālakṛṣṇaḥ priyāyuk cāyayau kuṃkumavāpikām ||92||| maṃgalāni samastāni tatrāsan kṛṣṇamandire | pitā pradadau dānāni bhojanāni madhūni ca ||93|| mahīmānādipūjāṃ sa pracakāra tathārpaṇam | dhanādīnāṃ yathāyogyaṃ vyasarjayatattaḥ param ||94|| mahīmānāḥ prasannāśca prayayuḥ svālayām̐stataḥ | vadhvāḥ pitre ca mātre ca bālakṛṣṇaḥ suvarṇajam ||95|| mandiraṃ nityavāsārthaṃ pradadau bhogyajātakam | prāpatustau parānandaṃ jāmātāraṃ hariṃ prabhum ||96|| prāpyakanyāmahābhāgyaṃ vīkṣya yayaturharṣaṇam | nivṛttau tāvṛṇāt kanyāṃ datvā tu vidhinā tataḥ ||97|| yuyujāte harermūrtau mokṣārthaṃ tāvaharniśam | athaikadā śrīnikāmadevaḥ papraccha taṃ harim ||98|| śreyase śreṣṭhamatraiva sādhanaṃ mokṣakṛttu yat | badrike śvaśuraṃ mokṣamānasaṃ vīkṣya vai tataḥ ||99|| mokṣayogaṃ svajāmātā bodhayāmāsa sarvathā | yat prāpya mānavāścāpi mokṣaṃ tūrṇamavāpnuyuḥ || 4.23.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne mahīmānānāṃ bhojanādi, śṛṃgāraḥ, maṇḍapaṃ pratigamanam, śrīkṛṣṇasya śṛṃgāro maṇḍapaṃ pratigamanam, vidhiścodvāhaḥ kuṃkumavāpikāṃ pratyāgamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayoviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 23 ||
<4.24> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi śreyase śvaśuro harim | papracchātyantikaṃ mokṣaṃ kathaṃ sa syād vadātra me || 1 || jāmātā śrībālakṛṣṇo’vatārī puruṣottamaḥ | upādideśa nikāmadevāya mokṣasādhanam || 2 || pūjyatama śvaśurātra vadāmi mokṣasādhanam | mokṣayogaṃ susulabhaṃ durbhāgyānāṃ tu durlabham || 3 || sākṣāt kṛṣṇaprasaṃgena mucyate bhavabandhanāt | kṛṣṇe sarvasvadātā vai mukto bhavati māyikāt || 4 || kanyāṃ kṛṣṇāya dātā vai yāti matparamaṃ padam | kṛṣṇatādātmyamāpannā kanyoddharati tatkulam || 5 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktyā mānavā yānti tatpadam | śrīkṛṣṇamandirāvāsā vasanti cākṣare tataḥ || 6 || śrīkṛṣṇe kṛtaviśvāsā mokṣaṃ yānti hi śāśvatam | yasya nārāyaṇī putrī sa mokṣagato hi saḥ || 7 || kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ tārayatyeva vāsinam | satsaṃgo mokṣadaścāsti kṛto nārāyaṇe paraḥ || 8 || satāṃ samāgamaḥ śreṣṭhaśreyasaḥ sādhanaṃ sadā | satīsādhvīprasaṃgena nāryo yānti paraṃ padam || 9 || sevayā prāpyate satāṃ prasannatā tayā hariḥ | hareḥ prāptau parā prāptirmokṣārthaṃ naiva vidyate || 4.24.1 0|| eṣā tu sulabhā vipravarya bhavatā cārjitā | prāptavyo vidyate nānyaḥ tato’haṃ parameśvaraḥ || 1 1|| nārāyaṇīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram | dhyātvā snehena sevitvā mucyate karmabandhanāt || 12|| so’haṃ nārāyaṇaścāsmi lakṣmīśca bālayoginī | yā sā badrīpriyā badrikāśrame’sti mama priyā || 1 3|| badrikā sā bhavatputrī mama bhāryā tvayārpitā | evaṃ māṃ tāṃ bhavān dhyātvā madrūpaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati || 14|| śreyase tvāyayoḥ sākṣātsevājñānaṃ bhavaddhitam | tat kṛtvātra mahattīrthe svayaṃ mokṣaṃ gamiṣyasi || 15|| gurudevarṣisiddharṣisevā sādhusamāgamaḥ | brahmātmavedanaṃ bhaktirmokṣasādhanamuttamam || 16|| mokṣayogo mahānasti sarvayogeśvaraḥ sukhaḥ | harermūrtiḥ sadā yogo mokṣayogo mahattamaḥ || 17|| mūlaṃ saṃsāravṛkṣasya mamāhaṃ ceti nityadā | tanmamāhaṃ pare kṛṣṇe yojitaṃ mayi mokṣakṛt || 18|| ahaṃ māyāṃkuro bodhyo vāsanā mūlameva sā | mameti skandhavān vṛkṣaḥ śākhāḥ kṣetragṛhāṇi ca || 19|| dārāḥ sakhyaḥ pallavāśca dhanadhānyādipatrikāḥ | pāpamañjarikāvyāpto duḥkhādimaladastathā ||4.24.20 || tasya prachittaye kṛṣṇamāhātmyajñānamuttamam | arjayitvā vidyayāhaṃvṛkṣaśchedyo hi paṇḍitaiḥ ||21 | tato brahmarasaṃ pītvā divyatṛptipradaṃ param | prayāntyeva parabrahma prājñā nirvṛttimuttamām || 22|| nāyaṃ deho hi vipro’sti nātmā vā vipra ucyate | vittiṃ prāpto hareryaḥ sa vipro māhātmyavittiyuk ||23|| tvamahaṃ ceti saṃsāro bhinnavāsanayā kṛtaḥ | mayi vipreśvare kṛṣṇe’rpaṇāt tvamādi līyate ||24|| gṛhaṃ dārā dhanaṃ vaṃśo līyante cāsya vāsanāḥ | tadgṛhaṃ yatra vasati sā dārā dīryate yayā ||25||| taddhanaṃ yatsahāyārthaṃ vaṃśaḥ sa yastu śāśvataḥ | nārāyaṇo gṛhaṃ nityaṃ dārā buddhiḥ pramokṣiṇī ||26||| bhaktirdhanaṃ dūramārge sahāyadaṃ tathāvyayam | vaṃśaḥ sa eva muktānāṃ vaṃśā ye te matāśca naḥ ||27|| brahmaraso mahad bhojyaṃ yena jīvati sarvadā | yanmuktaye kṛtaṃ tadvai puruṣārthaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 28|| mūrdhni kaṇṭhe lalāṭe ca hṛdaye ca nije harim | dhyāyedātmani cātmasthaṃ yaḥ sa mucyeta bandhanāt || 29|| nikāmadeva kāmānāṃ yadā layo mayīśvare | tadā niṣkāmatāmetya brahmarasān samaśnute || 4.24.30|| yathāgnirvardhate kāṣṭhaistejasvī jāyate bahuḥ | kāṣṭhāni saṃvidhāyaiva bhasmarūpāṇi nānyathā || 31 || tathātmā vardhate puṇyaiḥ suprakāśaḥ prajāyate | puṇyāni bhasmasāt kṛtvā brahmarasaṃ samaśnute ||35|| puṇyaṃ vā yadi vā pāpaṃ mahāraṇyaṃ bhavāya tat | puṇyapāpe’rpayitvā me mahāmokṣaṃ pravindati || 33|| jñātvā māṃ paramātmānaṃ svātmasthaṃ svāminaṃ patim | prabhuṃ divyaguṇāgāraṃ mucyate brahmarūpabhāk || 34|| ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smi sthūlavarjitaḥ | ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smi sūkṣmavarjitaḥ || 35|| ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smi hetuvarjitaḥ | ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smi vyomavarjitaḥ ||36|| ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smi sthānavarjitaḥ | ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smi mātravarjitaḥ ||37|| ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smīndriyavarjitaḥ | ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smi prāṇavarjitaḥ ||388|| ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smi cārthavarjitaḥ | ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smi divyatānvitaḥ ||39|| ahaṃ brahma parabrahmaprabhvasmi jñānabhānavān | parabrahmaṇi lagno’smi śeṣo dāsaśca kiṃkaraḥ ||4.24.40 nānyanme rocate kṛṣṇamantarā dṛṣṭisṛṣṭiṣu | ityevaṃ tvātmano brāhmīṃ bhāṃ jñātvā mucyate bhavāt ||41 tato na maraṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ na rogo narakaṃ na ca | na pāpairyujyate vijño niraye na ca pacyate ||42| na garbhe na tathā bāhye vāso’sya māyikaḥ kvacit | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāptaḥ śvetanārāyaṇo hi saḥ ||43 bhaktyā ca sevayopāsanayā māṃ labhate sa hi | dhyānena kīrtanenāpi pūjanena japena me ||44| stavanena vratenāpi dānena ca makhena ca | mayyarpitena sarveṇa śuddhātmā brahma jāyate ||45| nārāyaṇetimantreṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena ca | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena yāti mokṣaṇam ||46| mama bhaktyā niḥkṛṣṭo’pi sarvamāpnoti cottamam | svargaṃ vā śāśvatānandākṣaraṃ dhāma prayātyapi ||47| tuṣyāmyahaṃ yathā bhaktyā sevayā cārpaṇena ca | tathā nānyena tuṣyāmi tuṣyāmi sādhusevayā ||48| mahatāṃ śreyasāṃ mūle prasavaḥ puṇyasantateḥ | jīvitasya phalaṃ svādu smaraṇaṃ me sadā dvija ||49| muñcantyaśrūṇi saṃharṣāt saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhāḥ | gāyanti sāmasūktāni mayi vāsaṃ gatā janāḥ ||4.24.50| parabrahma pragāyanto brahmarūpetisaṃsthitāḥ | bhaktyā praṇāmakartāro vaiṣṇavāḥ pāvanā bhuvi ||51 || śrībhaktajanavātsalyaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktānumodanam | harilīlāśravaḥprītiṃ prāptānāṃ saphalo bhavaḥ ||52|| yena sarvārpaṇenaiva kṛṣṇe bhaktirniveditā | bhāvo niveśitaḥ kṛṣṇe mahābhāgavato hi saḥ ||53|| arcayatyeva māṃ nityaṃ dhyāyati māṃ raṭatyapi | sarvarāgavinirmukto mleccho viprottamo hi saḥ ||54|| mokṣagatyai pravṛtto yo matkṛpāpātrameva yaḥ | pāvanaḥ sa manuṣyāṇāṃ sa pūjyaḥ sa yathā hariḥ |||55||| punāti śrīharerbhaktaścāṇḍālo’pi tu pāvanaḥ | yadgṛhe śrīhariścāste yaccitte śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ||56|| tasmai deyaṃ tato grāhyaṃ pāvanaḥ pāpināṃ hi saḥ | śrutvānyaṃ pāpinaṃ pāpamuktaye stauti māṃ hi saḥ ||57|| dayāṃ kuru prapannāya tavāsmīti dayāṃ kuru | evaṃ bhūtābhayadasya vaśe kṛṣṇo hi vartate ||58|| vedamantrisahasrebhyo vratyayutebhya eva ca | tāpasānāṃ koṭitaśca kṛṣṇabhakto viśiṣyate ||99|| ekāntino harerbhaktā divyena varṣmaṇākṣaram | tenaiva vapuṣā bhaktyā yadvā yānti paraṃ padam ||4.24.60 || ekāntajñānabhaktyāḍhyaścānanyabhāvasaṃbhṛtaḥ | hareḥ priyatamo nityaṃ bhaktāvavyabhicāravān ||61 || āpatsvapi na muñceta prītiṃ mayyanapāyinīm | māṃ smaran māṃ cāśrayam̐śca me cittānnopasarpati ||62|| nādhīto na makhī naiva vratī nācāravānnapi | bhaktiṃ me vahate yastu kṛtyakṛtyaḥ sa vai mataḥ ||63|| tapasāṃ ca makhānāṃ ca vedānāṃ pāragā api | vinā bhaktiṃ gatiṃ naiva yānti yāṃ bhaktiyoginaḥ ||64|| yaḥ kaścicchrīkṛṣṇabhakto’pyanācāro’pyanāśramī | tathāpi jagatāṃ sūrya ivoditaḥ sa pāvanaḥ ||65|| api pāpaprayogāśca dehendriyavaśā janāḥ | bhaktā me yāntyakṣaraṃ yannārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ ||66|| dṛḍhā nārāyaṇe bhaktiryeṣāṃ cāvyabhicāriṇī | tucchaṃ svargasukhaṃ teṣāṃ bhaktiḥ śāśvatamokṣadā ||67|| karmamaye’tra saṃsāre prapannānāṃ karāt prabhuḥ | bhuṃkte’nnajalatāmbūlaṃ tuṣṭo bhavati mokṣadaḥ ||68|| yo na kṛṣṇaṃ bhojayati na pāyayati sevate | pūjayatyeva naivāpi tasya sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||69|| kathāṃ na saṃśṛṇute sa badhiro māyayāvṛtaḥ | darśanaṃ kurute naiva so’trāndho’jñānasaṃvṛtaḥ ||4.24.70|| nāmnāṃ ca kīrtane me’tra na yasya pulakodgamaḥ | hṛdullāso’pi naivāsti so’sti kuṇapa eva ha ||7 1 || mayi bhaktimatāṃ vipra muktirdāsīva vartate | mayyananyamanasā tu sarvathā bhavasaṃkṣayaḥ ||72|| yamo’pi svadūtavargān prātargadati nityaśaḥ | vaiṣṇavān varjayitvaiva carantvavaiṣṇavān prati ||73|| nāhaṃ vaiṣṇavabhaktānāṃ prabhurdaṇḍadharo’pi san | anācārī durācārī viṣṇubhakto hi mucyate ||74|| ananyabhaktimān kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇaniścayaśobhanaḥ | sādhudharmā paro divyo bhavatyeva sa uttamaḥ ||75|| yasya bhaktiḥ sthirā kṛṣṇe pratyaṇu varṣmaṇi sthitā | sarvārthāstasya karagā muktirhaste’sya vartate ||76|| mayā vinirmitā māyā sarveṣāṃ bandhanapradā | yā sā tasya bhavatyevānukūlā bhaktimokṣadā ||77|| taranti te mama māyāṃ prapadyante tu māṃ dhiyā | bhaktyā tuṣyāmi śrīnāthaḥ sevayā yāvadātmanā || 78|| nānyopāyaistuṣṭimemi yathaimi cārpaṇātmanā | saṃsāro gāralo vṛkṣastasya phale śubhe yuge ||79|| mayi snehamayī bhaktistathā sādhusamāgamaḥ | pitarastasya tuṣyanti pranṛtyanti pitāmahāḥ ||4.24.80 || satsaṃgaṃ ca tathā bhaktiṃ kurvan kule’sti cejjanaḥ | jalānnāni mayā vipra nirmitāni praśāntaye ||8 1 || tathāpi naiva māṃ lokā bhajante mohasampadaḥ | pāpā dviṣṭā mama smṛtyā yāntyamāyaṃ padaṃ mama ||82|| jaḍā api janā ye maccharaṇaṃ saṃgatā bhuvi | te’pi māyāmatikramya prayānti paramākṣaram ||83|| namasyo jāyate dehī namaskāraparo’pi me | yo’hamantarniviṣṭo’smi hṛdayālayaśobhanaḥ ||84|| mama yogena divyo me bhakto mukto’sti sarvadā | taṃ sarvasākṣiṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ namasyeta hṛdāniśam ||82|| namaskāre suśakto’pi na māṃ namaskaroti yaḥ | so’tra magno mahāghore saṃsāre na tariṣyati ||86|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe caikā mayi bhāvanamaskṛtiḥ | punāti sadyaścāṇḍālaṃ kimutānyajanāniha ||87|| kṛtvā sudaṇḍavannārāyaṇaṃ māṃ praṇamettu yaḥ | sa prāpnoti gatiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ sahasramakhajorjitām ||88|| saṃsāre duṣṭakāntāre dhāvatāṃ dehināmiha | mayi kṛṣṇe namaskāro viśrāntidaśca tārakaḥ ||89|| āsīno vā śayāno vā bhuñjāno viharannapi | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya nama uccaret ||4.24.90 || mama nāma sulabhaṃ vai jihvā dattā tadarthinī | tathāpi na gṛṇantyete nārakāḥ kiṃ tadadbhutam ||91 || anantasṛṣṭijā vyāsāḥ śeṣāścānantarūpiṇaḥ | mama līlācaritrāṇāṃ nāmnāṃ nāntaṃ prayanti te ||92|| matikṣayānnivartante na me guṇakṣayāt kvacit | avaśo’pi vadet kṛṣṇa mucyate sarvabandhanāt ||93|| baddhaḥ parikarastena sarvathā cākṣaraṃ prati | svapne’pi māṃ smaratyeṣo mokṣāya kalpyate dvijaḥ ||94|| namaḥ śrībālakṛṣṇāya śrīkṛṣṇasya śubhāya ca | vahan bhāvena bhakto’sau yamāya naiva kalpitaḥ ||95|| sūryodaye’ndhatamasāṃ kṣayavanmama kīrtane | pāpānāṃ jāyate vipra kṣayo mokṣastato’pi ca ||96|| pātheyaṃ śrīkṛtaṇanārāyaṇanāma mahādhvani | gacchatāṃ madhyalokānāṃ vighnānāṃ vinivārakam ||97|| śrīkṛṣṇaśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkṛṣṇamādhava | japannaro’kṣaraṃ yāti yugeṣu sarvadā sadā ||98|| jihvāyāṃ śrībālakṛṣṇahare yasya sa mokṣagaḥ | sarvasārottamasāraścārādhanaṃ harermama ||99|| pūjyo’si macchvaśuro’si nārāyaṇīpitāsi ca | sarvathā cānugrāhyo’si mokṣe sthito’si mānada || 4.24.10 0|| jāmātāraṃ ca māṃ labdhvā datvā dānaṃ sutātmakam | kimanyacchiṣyate mokṣe nikāmadeva me vada || 101 || sampannaṃ sarvakāryaṃ te niṣpannaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ śubham | kṛtakṛtyo’si bhagavan madrahasyaṃ tavoditam || 1 02|| prabhokṛṣṇa jayakṛṣṇa mādhavīkṛṣṇa saṃjapan | śrīkṛṣṇa lalitākṛṣṇa japan yāhi mamākṣaram || 1 03|| bālāyoginikākṛṣṇa bālākṛṣṇeti saṃjapan | me kṛṣṇo vallabhaḥ svāmī japan yāhi mamākṣaram || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne nikāmadevākhyena mokṣayogaṃ prati pṛṣṭaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāṇastasmai mokṣayogamupādideśetinirūpaṇanāmā caturviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 24 ||
<4.25> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tataḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | punaḥ svarūpayogaṃ svaṃ subhaktāya tvupādiśat || 1 || svarūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ mānavavigraham | āśritya vartate yastu tasya mokṣo’sti sarvathā || 2 || pare’kṣare rājamāno rājādhirāja īśapaḥ | avatārāvatārī yaḥ so’haṃ śrīkṛṣṇa eva hi || 3 || anantavāsudevānāṃ vāsudevottamo’smyaham | anantaśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanārāyaṇottamaḥ || 4 || anantānāṃ bhagavatāṃ bhagavānuttamottamaḥ | anantānāṃ puruṣāṇāmasmyahaṃ puruṣottamaḥ || 5 || anantānāmakṣarāṇāmakṣarottamaśāsakaḥ | anantānāṃ ca muktānāṃ muktādhipādhipo’smyaham || 6 || asaṃkhyānāṃ pārṣadānāṃ pārṣadeśeśvaro’smyaham | asaṃkhyānāṃ ca śaktīnāṃ mahāśaktīśvaro’smyaham || 7 || divyamuktānikānāṃ ca mahāmuktānikeśvaraḥ | samastasādhusādhvīnāṃ śreṣṭhasādhūttamo’smyaham || 8 || asaṃkhyānāṃ vibhavānāṃ mahāvibhūttamo’smyaham | anantāṃśāṃśarūpāṇāmaṃśī cāsmi paraḥ pumān || 9 || anantāveśakartāhaṃ mahāveśeśvaro’smyaham | asaṃkhyādhikalānāṃ ca kaleśvaro’smyahaṃ prabhuḥ || 4.25.1 0|| vibhūtīnāmasaṃkhyānāṃ mahāvibhūtipo’smyaham | māṇikyālalitārādhāramādīnāṃ paraḥ patiḥ || 11 || satāṃ patiścākṣareśaścākṣarātīta ātmapaḥ | ātmeśaḥ sarvasṛṣṭīnāṃ pālakānāṃ niyāmakaḥ || 1 2|| saccidānandarūpo’smi sadā divyo’tisundaraḥ | divyamūrtiścaikatattvātmako’saṃkhyasukhānvitaḥ || 1 3|| modapramodānandānāmāśrayo’smi mahānaham | utsavānāṃ samastānāṃ prakāśako’smi pāvanaḥ || 14|| samastānāmamṛtānāṃ sāgaro’smi sudhābhṛtaḥ | miṣṭātimiṣṭamiṣṭānāṃ rasānāmasmi śevadhiḥ || 15|| ākarṣaṇānāṃ divyānāṃ mahākarṣaṇamūrtimān | ānandamūrchanānāṃ ca sadāsmyānandamūrchanaḥ || 1 6|| sarvadivyaprasādānāṃ prasannatādivāridhiḥ | sarvalāvaṇyasukhavān sarvamādhuryasaṃbhṛtaḥ || 17|| sarvaramyaprasaṃgānāṃ prasañjako’smi mādhavaḥ | yāvanmanorathānāṃ ca pūrako’smi tṛṣāharaḥ || 18|| sarvāsāṃ cāpi tṛptīnāṃ tṛptidātāsmi tarpaṇe | santoṣāṇāṃ samastānāṃ tuṣṭastoṣaprado’smi ca || 19|| premṇāṃ ca yāvatāṃ premaprado’smi premabhūḥ prabhuḥ | snehānāṃ snigdhabhāvanāṃ snehapūrṇo bhavāmyaham ||4.25.20 || āsaktīnāṃ samastānāmāsaktipatirasmyaham | śarkarāṇāṃ ca miṣṭānāṃ pīyūṣamadhudo’smyaham |||21|| śītalānāṃ sukhānāṃ ca viśeṣaḥ śītasaukhyadaḥ | uṣṇānāṃ ca mahānandapradānāmuṣṇasaukhyadaḥ ||22|| śṛṃgārāṇāmasaṃkhyānāṃ śṛṃgārarasado’smyaham | svādānāṃ ca samastānāṃ mahāsvādabharo’smyaham ||23|| āśleṣāṇāṃ mahānandabharo’smyahaṃ pramīlane | cūmbanānāṃ samastānāṃ sakampānandado’smyaham ||24|| snehāśrūṇāṃ vāhako’smi premaromodgamo’smyaham | pulakānāṃ vicitrāṇāṃ prapulako’pi sarvathā || 25|| mohānāṃ ca samastānāṃ mugdhatāsaṃbhṛto’smyapi | śayanānāṃ suṣuptīnāṃ viśrāntīnāṃ virāmadaḥ ||26|| ārāmāṇāṃ mahārāmo rāmo’smi ramatāmaham | ramaṇo’smi sakāmānāṃ kāmo’smi kāmināmapi ||27|| ratiścāsmi ratānāṃ ca śāntiśca siddhayoginām | puṣṭiścāsmi prapuṣṭānāṃ balināṃ balamuttamam || 28|| ātmabalaṃ samastānāmasmyahaṃ nirbhayatvadam | surabhiḥ saurabhāṇāṃ ca puṣpamasmi c puṣpiṇām ||29|| phalaṃ cāsmi ca phalināṃ dhāturdhātumatāmaham | suvarṇaścāsmi varṇānāṃ rūpiṇāṃ rūpamasmyaham ||4.25.3 0|| sukaṇṭhīnāṃ miṣṭakaṇṭhaḥ susvarāṇāṃ svaro’smyaham | gītīnāṃ madhurā gītirnṛtyānāṃ caikatānatā ||3 1 || hāvo bhāvastathā ceṣṭā cihnaṃ cāsmi samastagaḥ | saṃyogo’smi dhṛtiścāsmi vṛṣo’smi sattvavānapi ||32|| ākāṃkṣāsmi samastānāṃ maryādāsmi ca dehinām | āścaryāṇāṃ samagrāṇāmāścaryamasmi sarvagam ||33|| kautukānāṃ samastānāmasmyahaṃ kautukottamaḥ | nirvṛttīnāṃ ramaṇīnāṃ kriyānirvṛttirasmyaham ||34|| sarvavidhānāṃ kelīnāṃ kelicāturyavānaham | yogānāṃ ca samastānāṃ śāśvatānandayogadaḥ ||35|| rāgāṇāṃ cāpi sarveṣāṃ rāgyahaṃ rañjanārthakṛt | śobhānāṃ yāvatīnāṃ ca śobhano’haṃ subhāsuraḥ ||36|| madānāṃ mādakaścāhaṃ bhogyānāṃ bhogavardhanaḥ | ābhogānāṃ mahābhogasvarūpo’smi prabhogiṣu ||37|| dravāṇāṃ yāvatāṃ cāsmi snehadravātmakaḥ prabhuḥ | vātsalyānāṃ vatsalatā naisargikī bhavāmyaham ||38|| cumbakānāṃ samastānāṃ piṇḍacumbakavānaham | āntarāṇāṃ praharṣāṇāṃ mahāpraharṣaṇo’smyaham ||39|| samastānāṃ prahāsyānāṃ mandahāsyaṃ bhavāmyaham | kaṭākṣāṇāṃ ceṅgitānāṃ kaṭākṣeṅgitavānaham ||4.25.40|| hārdānāṃ cāntarāṇāṃ ca mahāhṛdayavānaham | prakarṣaṇānāṃ sarveṣāṃ mahāprakarṣaṇo’smyaham ||41 || śreṣṭhānāṃ ca variṣṭhānāṃ śreṣṭhavareṇyadharmyaham | pravarāṇāṃ varāṇāṃ ca pravaro varado’smyaham ||082||| vyāpakānāmambarāṇāṃ mahāvyāpakatāsti me | kallolānāṃ ca khelānāṃ prakhelako’smi tadgataḥ ||43|| ullāsānāṃ vilāsānāṃ samullāso vilāsakṛt | bhāvanānāṃ ca bhāvānāṃ mahābhāvanayānvitaḥ ||44|| nivāsānāṃ ca vāsānāṃ vāsanānāṃ vasānakaḥ | prasthānābhimukhānāṃ ca prabhavāmyavasānakṛt ||45|| pāritoṣikavaryāṇāmupadānāṃ ca toṣaṇam | svāgatānāṃ ca mānānāṃ mānado’smi pitā prabhuḥ ||46|| prapannānāṃ cāśrayado mahādhāro’smi nāthavat | anāthānāṃ sunātho’smi dhavo’smi dhavinīgaṇe ||47|| saubhāgyānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ mahāsaubhāgyacandravān | sampadāṃ ca vipulānāṃ sampattirasmi śāśvatī ||48|| ṛddhīnāṃ paramarddhiśca lābhānāṃ cātmalābhadaḥ | prasevānāṃ cāṃgasevāsvarūpo’smi samarpaṇe ||49|| śuśrūṣāṇāṃ cānuvṛttirasmyahaṃ sādhuvṛttitā | sādhutā ca kṣamā dainyaṃ tyāgināmasmi mattatā ||4.25.50|| śīladharmaḥ samasteṣu vīryaṃ vīryavatāmaham | asmi rūpaṃ ca yoṣāsu puṃsu śmaśrurbhavāmyaham ||51 || vadhvā alaktakaścāsmi mantharā ca padoḥ gatiḥ | cāñcalyaṃ navasaṃyogād bhavāmi ca nisargajam ||52|| ānukūlyaṃ dehināṃ copakāriṇāṃ bhavāmyaham | anugraho dayā kāruṇyaṃ hitaṃ cāsmi sādhuṣu ||53|| jayo jayināṃ mūrdhanyo vidyā cātmavidāmaham | tarkaḥ sarvajñakalpānāṃ kavīnāṃ kāvyamasmyaham ||54|| vallabhatā vallabhānāṃ kūjanaṃ mantravedinām | stavanaṃ stāvakānāṃ ca bhavāmi miṣatāṃ miṣaḥ ||55|| lagnatā lagnināmasmi granthiśca grathnatāmapi | nisargo’smi nisargisthastānastānavatāmaham |||96|| nikāmadeva jānīhi cetanānāṃ tu cetanaḥ | asmyahaṃ sarvasākṣīti pravartako nivartakaḥ ||57|| sarvakarmaphaladātā sūkṣmaḥ sūkṣmāsujīvinām | sthūlaścāsmi ca sthūlānāṃ dṛśyo’smi netriṇāṃ sadā ||58|| adṛśyo’smi divyanetravihīnānāṃ tu dehinām | gocaro’smi madarthānāṃ dūre’smi dveṣiṇāmapi ||59|| jīvanaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ jaḍānāmasmi cāstitā | yoṣitāṃ nābhipadme’smi narāṇāmasmi nṛtvake ||4.25.60|| devānāṃ cāmṛte hyasmi pitṝṇāṃ puṇyasañcaye | ṛṣīṇāṃ brahmabhāve’smi mānavānāṃ naye’smi ca ||61 || śūrāṇāṃ yodhane cāsmi viduṣāṃ bahuvedane | satīnāṃ satyadharme’smi vadhūnāṃ patidaivate ||62|| patnīnāṃ pātivratye’smi putrāṇāṃ pitṛsevane | dhanināṃ dānabhāve’smi rājñāṃ dhiṣṇye vasāmyaham ||63|| apsarasāṃ cānane’smi gāndharvāṇāṃ tu gāyane | nartakīnāṃ nṛtyakārye sabhāyāṃ ca sabhāpatau ||64|| kathāyāṃ vyāsadeve’smi makhe’nale’smi sarvathā | yuddhe jaye sthitaścāsmi nītāvasmi samudyame ||65|| dugdhe gavādipaśūnāmasmi gundre tu śākhinām | saṃskāre dvidalādīnāmasmi bhikṣukabhikṣite ||66|| mandirāṇāṃ madhyadeśe bhavanānāṃ tu gopure | grāmāṇāṃ catvare cāsmi nagarāṇāṃ nayālaye ||67|| araṇyeṣu pippale’smi dehalyāṃ tu gṛhe gṛhe | tulasyāṃ vaiṣṇavasthalyāṃ vaiṣṇave’smi vane’pi ca ||68|| tīrtheṣu satsu varte’haṃ pṛthvyāṃ bhaktālaye’smi ca | kāleṣu brāhmakāle’smi sāyaṃ cārārtrike’smi ca ||69|| nakṣatre’smi jayantyādau bimbe’smi śreṣṭhapūjane | sarvamitre’smi manuje śāstre’smi matkathānvite ||4.25.70|| dharme’smi brahmacarye’haṃ śraddhāyāmasmi dātari | bhāgyavatāṃ puraścāsmi durbhāgyānāṃ tu pṛṣṭhataḥ | adhaścāsmi tu pāpānāmūrdhvamasmi divaukasām ||71 || ātmanivedināmasmi dehendriyāntarātmasu | viprāṇāṃ vacane cāsmi māyāyāṃ sāttvike guṇe ||72|| anyāyānāṃ bhayaṃ cāsmi śikṣāsmi śāsyavargiṇām | vādānāṃ nirṇayaścāsmi phalavyāpto’smi sarvathā ||73 || sajātīnāṃ pravāhe’smi cānupūrvyāṃ tu vāṅmaye | viśiṣṭaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahma tatrādvaito vasāmyaham ||74|| ato viśiṣṭabrahmādvaitātmako’haṃ pareśvaraḥ | nikāmadeva māṃ yastu jānīyāt susvarūpiṇam ||79|| śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vallabhaṃ cāryaṃ svāminaṃ bālakṛṣṇakam | muktiṃ gacchenna sandeho madvijño na praṇaśyati ||76|| śrīnikāmadeva uvāca kathaṃ viśiṣṭabrahmādvaitātmakastvaṃ vibudhyase | saṃkṣepānme kathayasva sarvasvāminnarāyaṇa ||77|| śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa uvāca viśeṣaṇaṃ sthūlamāyā sarvakāryātmikā tu yā | viśeṣaṇaṃ sūkṣmamāyā sāmyāvasthā guṇatrayam ||78|| tābhyāmacetanābhyāṃ tu viśiṣṭaṃ brahma cākṣaram | antaḥsthaṃ vyāpakaṃ cāsti viśiṣṭe te hyubhe’kṣare ||79|| viśeṣaṇaṃ sthūlātmānaḥ sarvakarmaphalāśanāḥ | viśeṣaṇaṃ sūkṣmātmānaḥ karmaphalādivarjitāḥ ||4.25.80|| tābhyāṃ vai cetanābhyāṃ tu viśiṣṭaṃ brahma cākṣaram | antaḥsthaṃ vyāpakaṃ cāsti viśiṣṭe te hyubhe’kṣare | akṣaraṃ tvekamevāsti dvitīyena vivarjitam ||8 1 || brahmābhidhaṃ dhāma divyaṃ parabrahmaparātmanaḥ | prakāśākhyaṃ saccidānandātmatejomayaṃ sadā ||82|| tadekaṃ tu caturdhātra viśeṣaṇairviśeṣitam | viśiṣṭayorviśiṣṭayoradvaitaṃ brahmadhāma tat ||83|| viśiṣṭādvaitamuktaṃ me dhāmākṣarābhidhaṃ dvija | jaḍeṣu cetaneṣveva sarvāvasthāsu sarvathā ||84|| rājate cākṣaraṃ brahma sarvāścaryasamanvitam | tatra viśiṣṭādvaite vai dhāmnyakṣare virājate ||85|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | yaḥ so’haṃ tveka evāsmi tulyādhikavivarjitaḥ ||86|| advaito’smi na svo dvau vai parameśau kadācana | ato viśiṣṭādvetādvaito’haṃ śrīparameśvaraḥ ||87|| parabrahmākṣarātītaḥ sarvātmākṣarabrahmagaḥ | viśiṣṭaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahmādvaitaṃ tatrāsmi caikalaḥ ||88|| madviśiṣṭaṃ brahma sarvajaḍacetanagaṃ matam | evaṃ cāsmi sadā vipra vyāpino vyāpako’pyaham ||89|| etatte kathitaṃ tattvaṃ mama svarūpavedane | so’haṃ mūrto’smi sarvatrākṣare mūrte’pi tejasi ||4.25.90 || akṣaraṃ brahma madyuktaṃ sarvatrāsti dvijottama | sṛṣṭitrayaṃ cākṣare’sti viśeṣaṇatayānvitam ||9 1 || akṣare santi muktāśca dhāmānyanyāni santyapi | taddhāma ca samarthaṃ madyogena mūrtimat tathā ||92|| sevāyāṃ vartate cāpi mukteśvaraṃ hi mannibham | matsārūpyaṃ bhajamānaṃ sarvādhāramapi dhruvam ||93|| pumānnakṣarapuruṣaḥ so’yaṃ brahmapumān svayam | tadeva vyāpakaṃ divyaṃ bhūmikā taijasī sadā ||94|| tatprāvirbhūtabhogyādi bhogopakaraṇānyapi | bhogāśca sampadaḥ sarvā vidyante tatra sarvaśaḥ ||95|| yadādhārā yatprapoṣā yadṛddhimanta ityapi | muktāḥ sarve vasantyeva muktānikāśca dhāmani ||96|| mama mūrteḥ suyogena pūrṇaṃ cākhaṇḍamakṣaram | avyayaṃ śāśvataṃ dhāma tatra vāso hi mokṣaṇam ||97|| nikāmadeva me yogāt tvaṃ gato’si tadakṣaram | yatrāhaṃ tatra vai dhāmākṣaraṃ nityaṃ hi vidyate ||98|| sā bhūśca sampadaḥ sarvā bhavantyatra mayi prabhau | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ tvihāsti vai ||99|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥśrīvallabhaḥ prabhuḥ | akṣarastho virāje’tra sarveśaste sutāpatiḥ || 4.25.100 || mama yogena mokṣe’si gantavyaṃ te na vidyate | mama sākṣātprasaṃgo’trākṣare mokṣapradastava || 101 || sadā tvaṃ mama mukto’si paśya divyaṃ nijaṃ gṛham | ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastaṃ cākṣaraṃ padam || 1 02|| darśayāmāsa sahasā muktaṃ nikāmadevakam | muktānikāṃ tathā sureśvarīṃ divyāṃ tu śāśvatīm || 1 03|| badrīpriyāṃ bālayoginīṃ ca padmāvatīsatīm | māṇikīṃ haripatnīṃ sa pradarśyābhāvayattiraḥ || 1 04|| badrike tvaṃ saiva cāsse yā tatra bālayoginī | māṇikyavarṇā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vāhinī || 1 05|| pṛthvyāṃ sā māṇikī vāhā vaḍavābhavadacyutā | brahmaprabhāvatī yuktā yā jayālalitātmikā || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne parabrahmasvarūpayoganirūpaṇaṃ viśiṣṭabrahmādvaitātmakaparabrahmavivecanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 25 ||
<4.26> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tato’nādinarāyaṇaḥ | bhaktaṃ nikāmadevaṃ taṃ prāha yogaṃ tu nirbhayam || 1 || śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu nikāmadeva tvaṃ nirbhīkayogamuttamam | yajjñātvā na bhayaṃ tasya māyākālādyakarmaṇām || 2 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya dhyāturanvaham | nadānatīrthatapasāṃ puṇyabhogabhayaṃ bhavet| || 3 || sarvapuṇyāni vai kṛṣṇe mayi nyastāni yena tu | tasyākṣaraṃ paraṃdhāma nirbhayaṃ prāpyameva hi || 4 || sarvakarmādhikaṃ karmopāsanaṃ mama sarvadā | smaraṇaṃ cānumananaṃ sarvathā bhayanāśanam || 5 || māyāleśānusaktistu pāpaṃ cātra mahātmanām | hareḥ smaraṇarūpaṃ tatprāyaścittaṃ mahātmanām || 6 || muhūrtasmṛtimātreṇa mama dhāmābhigo bhavet | kiṃ punaḥ satataṃ bhakto nirbhīko’nyasamāgamāt || 7 || jāgratsvapnasuṣuptānāṃ pāre tiṣṭhati yogavit | yogaḥ sa eva manaso vṛttirmayyeva sarvadā || 8 || gacchaṃstiṣṭhan śvasan kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tu māṃ smaret | pralapan viviśan bhuṃjan raman māṃ sarvathā smaret || 9 || sarvakarmasu rakto’pi cittaṃ kuryāttu yo mayi | tasya lepo na bhogānāṃ bhogamadhyādhivāsinaḥ || 4.26.1 0|| smṛtirme paramo dharmo dhyānaṃ tapaśca vai makhaḥ | śuddhiḥ sarvā parā śāntiḥ sarvaṃ me smaraṇe sthitam || 11 || durlabhaṃ yatparaṃ dūramagocaraṃ yadakṣaram | tathāpi prāpyamevāsya smarturme kṛpayā mama || 12|| apyadhvaraśatānāṃ yad vaiguṇyaṃ vikramādikam | nirdoṣaṃ pratyuta pūrṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya smṛtermama || 1 3|| na smṛtyā sadṛśaṃ me’tra śodhanaṃ cādyakāriṇām | bhavānāṃ dāhikā cāpi mokṣadā sā mama smṛtiḥ || 14|| niṣpannadhyānavṛttestu muktiratraiva janmani | smarturme’nalavat kakṣaṃ smṛtirdahati vāsanām || 15|| harau cātmasthite cittasthite tu sarvakilbiṣam | svayaṃ līnaṃ bhavatyeva tato bhayaṃ na vidyate || 16|| kalaho dūṣaṇaṃ doṣo rāga udvejanaṃ kṣayam | na krāmenmānasaṃ smarturyatastaccittago’smyaham || 17|| tithirmāsaḥ kṣaṇaṃ yogaścandro lagnaṃ śubhaṃ dinam | tadeva yatra govindaḥ smaryate sarvathā śubhaḥ || 18|| sā kṣatiḥ sā parā hānirvyasanaṃ tatparaṃ tathā | yatra kṣaṇe’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo na cintyate || 19|| kalau kṛtayugastasya yasya citte janārdanaḥ | kṛte kaliyugastasya yaccitte na janārdanaḥ ||4.26.20|| agre pṛṣṭhe pura ūrdhve’dho’bhito madhyavartule | hṛdaye yasya govindaḥ kṛtakṛtyo hi so’sti hi ||21 || śubhe’śubhe mano yasyānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇe | tasya phalaṃ mahat svargaṃ duḥkhadoṣādivarjitam ||22|| asantyajyāpi gārhasthyaṃ smarate māṃ tu yaḥ sadā | chinatti pauruṣīṃ māyāṃ mayyarpitakriyo hi saḥ ||23|| yasya citte hariścāste kṣamāvān so’parādhiṣu | ajñeṣu dayayā yukto modavān dhārmikeṣu saḥ ||24|| smarennārāyaṇaṃ māṃ tu tyāgabhogādikarmasu | jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyādau duṣkarmasvapi cādhikam ||25|| hṛdayastho’hametasya lābhaṃ jayaṃ yaśo dhanam | sampādayāmi satataṃ śāntimānandamuttamam ||26|| asaṃkhyapakṣipādapapaśūnāṃ mokṣado’smyaham | smaratāṃ mama caiśvaryaṃ kiṃ prapannanṛṇāṃ tadā ||27|| śrīkṛṣṇapādapacchāyā śītātapavivarjitā | amṛtapadadā māyābhīhantrī kiṃ na sevyate ||28|| na śāpasya bhayaṃ tasya na ca rājño bhayaṃ tathā | na tu yāmyabhayaṃ tasya yasya cittaṃ mayi prabhau ||29|| dhyānaṃ smaraṇasaṃjuṣṭaṃ pavitramuttamaṃ sadā | yena pāpāśano’pyatra lipyate na kadācana ||4.26.3 0|| yathā tu viṣaye cittaṃ tathā yasya harau mayi | tathā me satsu satsaṅge sa mukto’tra pramuktidaḥ ||3 1 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktirhṛdaye vāsakāriṇī | tatsaṅgasaṅgisaṅgāḍhyān tārayatyaghasāgarāt ||32|| tajjñānaṃ śrīhariryatra sā kathā yatra mādhavaḥ | satkarma tad yatra cāhaṃ taccittaṃ yanmadarpitam || 33|| jihvā sā yā hariṃ stauti sā tvag yā spṛśati prabhum | tau hastau cāśleṣitau māṃ tadvarṣma yanmadarthakam ||34|| śiraḥphalaṃ namo me’tra pāṇiphalaṃ madarcanam | manaḥphalaṃ mananaṃ me vacaḥphalaṃ guṇastavaḥ ||31|| merutulyaḥ pāparāśirmatsmṛterdrāgvinaśyati | sādhvasādhu caritaṃ cārpitaṃ mayi na lepakṛt ||36|| anāthānāṃ harirnātho’balānāṃ tu balaṃ hariḥ | sakāmānāṃ harirdātā sarveṣāṃ śaraṇaṃ hariḥ ||37|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrayo’tra bhūsura | tīrthaṃ tatparamaṃ māyākālakarmādināśakam ||38|| śūdraṃ carmakaraṃ cāṇḍālaṃ vā bhaktiyutaṃ mama | vipravat pāvanaṃ manye mama yogaṃ gato hi saḥ ||39|| dhanināṃ stāvakāḥ prāyo yadi stuvanti māṃ tathā | dhaneśvarāniha kṛtvā mocayāmi ca bandhanāt ||4.26.40 || vahnirvane’bhisaṃvyāptaḥ śuṣkārdradāhako yathā | tathāhaṃ hṛdaye nyasto dahāmi vāsanādikam ||41 || prajvalantaṃ mahāraṇyaṃ nāśrayanti mṛgeśvarāḥ | tathā mayā prakāśantaṃ nāśrayanti madādayaḥ ||42|| yāvadvegena bhaktirme viśvāso’pi yathā mama | tathātra phalamāpnoti kṛpātra me viśiṣyate ||43|| putradārakuṭumbādau magnā sīdanti dehinaḥ | sīdanti mayi te cedvai drāguttaranti madbalāt ||44|| muktimukhaṃ tu pihitaṃ yena sādhuniṣevaṇam | tasya muktiṃ na paśyāmi kadāpi bhāvisarjane ||45|| pūjayet paramātmānaṃ māṃ sadā hṛdaye bahiḥ | dhyāyenmāṃ sarvagaṃ mūrtaṃ kāntaṃ śrīvallabham prabhum ||46|| guruṃ patiṃ svāminaṃ māṃ juṣṭaṃ sākṣiṇamacyutam | parabrahmānādi kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram ||47|| evaṃvidhaṃ tu māṃ dhyāyan pūjya sanmānya mānada | avāpsyasi dhruvaṃ tāta śāśvataṃ me’kṣaraṃ padam ||48|| ityevaṃ bodhito vipro nikāmadeva ādṛtaḥ | mahāharṣaṃ samāpannaḥ sāmovāca tu nirbhayam ||49|| nṛtyan gāyan hasan dehaṃ kūrdayan ceṣṭayan muhuḥ | uvācāveśayogena nirbhayaṃ sāma gāyanam ||4.26.50 || bālakṛṣṇaṃ prapanno’smi kiṃ me kālaḥ kariṣyati | akṣareśaṃ parameśaṃ brahmeśaṃ puruṣottamam ||51 || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇaṃ parameśvaram | adhokṣajaṃ prapanno’smi kiṃ me mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||52|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpatimacyutam | gopālajaṃ prapanno’smi kiṃ me māyā kariṣyati ||53|| sarvāvatāriṇaṃ sarvaśaktisevitamādhavam | kāṃbhareyaṃ prapanno’smi kiṃ me pāpaṃ kariṣyati ||54|| kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ lomaśasya śubhāśramam | aśvasaraḥ prapanno’smi kiṃ me karma kariṣyati ||55|| bhagavantaṃ sarvadhāmnāṃ nārāyaṇanarāyaṇam | rādhākāntaṃ prapanno’smi kiṃ me tṛṣṇā kariṣyati ||56|| māyātāraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīmādhavīpatim | māṇikīśaṃ prapanno’smi kiṃ me kāmaḥ kariṣyati ||57|| sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ sākṣād bālayoginīsvāminam | parameśaṃ prapanno’smi kiṃ me bhrāntiḥ kariṣyati ||58|| akṣareśaṃ ca mukteśaṃ muktānikāpatiṃ harim | brahmapriyeśaṃ prāpto’smi kiṃ me sampat kariṣyati ||59|| īśvareśaṃ ceśvarāṇīpatiṃ haripriyāpatim | prabhumpatiṃ prapanno’smi ki me tamaḥ kariṣyati ||4.26.60|| padmāvatīsvāminaṃ ca jaḍacetanavartinam | lakṣmīnāthaṃ prapanno’smi kiṃ vāsanā kariṣyati ||61 || ekarūpaṃ bahurūpaṃ viśvarūpaṃ tu bālakam | satāṃ patiṃ prapanno’smi kiṃ me bandhaḥ kariṣyati ||66|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | namo’kṣaranivāsāya namo golokavāsine ||63|| namo vaikuṇṭhanāthāya namaḥ śrīpuravāsine | namo lalitākāntāya sarvakāntāya te namaḥ ||64|| bālayoginīkāntāya badrīkāntāya te namaḥ | nikāmadevanāthāya vāsudevāya te namaḥ ||65|| namo’mṛtanivāsāya namo’vyākṛtavāsine | namaḥ kailāsavāsāya hiraṇyagarbhavāsine ||66|| namaḥ siddhādhivāsāya namaḥ surādivāsine | namaḥ pitṛnivāsāya namo mānavarūpiṇe ||67|| namaḥ sarvanivāsāya namo madātmavāsine | sureśvarīhṛdisthāya namo’nantasvarūpiṇe ||68|| namo dehendriyaprāṇāntarātmavāsine sadā | namaste paramānanda namaste jñānasaṃbhṛta ||69|| namaste jñānavijñānaprada śrīpuruṣottama | namaste viśvakṛdviṣṇo namaste sarvakāraṇa ||4.26.70|| namaste gopagopīśa namaḥ sarvārthasādhaka | namaste’nugrahadātarnamaste mokṣada prabho ||71 || jaya kṛṣṇa jaya viṣṇo mamābhayada mādhava | jaya śānta cidānanda saccidānanda keśava |||72|| jaya jīva jayada tvaṃ jaya sākṣājjanārdana | jaya śāstrādisannyastabījagarbhādyupāsana ||73|| tvaṃ gurustvaṃ pitā bhrātā suhṛd bandhuḥ prasūrmama | tvaṃ mokṣastvaṃ parānandastvaṃ me sarvasvamacyuta ||74|| tvamuddhartā ca pātā ca netā tvaṃ viratirbhavān | jagat sarvaṃ tava rūparūpitaṃ saṃprakāśate ||75|| tvaṃ parabrahma bhagavan devādyaistu durāsadaḥ | mayā tvāsāditaścātra bālayoginīvaibhavāt ||76|| kastvāṃ jānāti cātmeśa muktagamyaṃ parātparam | sanātanapumāṃsaṃ taṃ purāṇapuruṣottamam ||77|| paraṃ rūpamajānto divaukaso maharṣayaḥ | avatāramayīmūrtīste bhajanti sugocarāḥ ||78|| avatārā bhajante tvāṃ pumāṃsamavatāriṇam | nārāyaṇā asaṃkhyāstvāṃ bhajante paramāyaṇam ||79|| nārāyaṇyaśca muktānyastvāṃ bhajante paraṃ patim | santo muktāstvāṃ bhajante sarvāvasthāsu satpatim ||4.26.80|| tavājñānena bhagavan mānuṣādinisargataḥ | kṣantumarhasi sarvaṃ me yat kṛtaṃ na kṛtaṃ tava ||8 1 || sarvāvasthāsu sarvatra sarvakāleṣu sarvathā | acalā tu hare bhaktisteṃ’ghriyuge’stu me prabho ||82|| prītistvayyeva satataṃ bhavatvātyantikī mama | sarvakāmaphaladātastvayi bhaktirdṛḍhāstu me ||83|| stotraṃ kartumanantasya kaḥ śaknoti tu mānavaḥ | tathāpi vyāpṛtaṃ vākyaṃ kṣamasva nātha te namaḥ ||84|| puruṣottamayogena nirbhayatvaṃ prajāyate | tava yogena puruṣaḥ puruṣottamatāṃ vrajet ||85|| adhanyo jāyate dhanyastvasādhuḥ sādhutāṃ vrajet | abhāgyo bhāgyavān syācca te stavāt puruṣottama ||86|| api lokabahiṣkāryā yadi te śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | sādhuśīlā hi te sarve jāyante paṃktipāvanāḥ ||87|| yeṣāṃ sarvādhipe kṛṣṇe bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī | api cāṇḍālakarmāṇaste’pi viprottamottamāḥ ||88|| api śaucasamācārāḥ kṛṣṇe te saṃgavarjitāḥ | śmaśānavāsāste sarve sarvakilbiṣasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||89|| tava dhyānaparā ye ca tava pūjāparāyaṇāḥ | tava prasādabhoktāraste sadā vighasāśinaḥ ||4.26.90|| ārādhya satataṃ tvāṃ śrīhariṃ sarvasukhapradam | prāpya tvāṃ paramātmānameṣṭavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||9 1 || sādhubhiścintyate yaśca sādhvībhiḥ kāmyate tu yaḥ | pīyate yogamāpannairyaḥ sa kṛṣṇo’stu me hṛdi ||92|| bhāvapuṣpaiḥ pūjayāmi śraddhāñjaliprado’smi ca | ātmānaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvārpayāmi te pareśvara ||93|| yathā sarpiḥ śarīrasthaṃ gavāṃ na kurute balam | nirgataṃ karmasaṃyuktaṃ dattaṃ tāsāṃ balapradam ||94|| tathā tvaṃ hṛdayastho’pi mānavānāṃ balāya na | tvameva nirgataḥ sākṣād bhūto balāya vidyase ||95|| vinārādhanayā kṛṣṇa tvaṃ kṛpāvaśago mama | pratyakṣaṃ mānavaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ nārāyaṇācyuta ||96|| sadaiva sevitaṃ cāpi divyaṃ rūpaṃ pradarśaya | yadyahaṃ pātramasmyatra kṛpāpātraṃ bhavāmi cet ||97|| vipratvaṃ me gataṃ cāpi tvayyeva tatsamarpitam | muktatvaṃ vartate me cet sarvāṃśe tava bhaktimān ||98|| evaṃ śrībadarīdevi prārthitaḥ parameśvaraḥ | kṛpayaiva bhūsurāya divyaṃ rūpamadarśayat ||99|| akṣarasthaṃ cāvatārairasaṃkhyairāprapūritam | muktairmuktānikābhiśca sevitaṃ kamalādibhiḥ || 4.26.1 00|| tathā śrībālayoginyā badaryā juṣṭamutsukam | kṛpayādarśayat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo nikāmine || 1 01|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṛtanirbhayayogopadeśottaraṃ nikāmadevasya divyajñānāptilābhottaraṃ stutirityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 26 ||
<4.27> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ badarīdevi tvayā nikāmayoginaḥ | patnyāḥ kathā parā divyā mokṣadāpi tato’bhavat || 1 || yāvat paśyati divyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | nikāmadevaḥ sahasā divyastabdhākṛtiṃ gataḥ || 2 || tāvat tatra samāyātā sureśvarī satī drutam | pūjārthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya kamalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 3 || sahasrakamalaiścāśvapaṭṭasarobhavaiḥ satī | candanaiścākṣataiḥ puṣpaiḥ kṛṣṇapūjārthamāgatā || 4 || vyapaśyat svapatiṃ stabdhaṃ divyasamādhisaṃsthitam | anuktvā sā drutaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya cakriṇe || 5 || kamalāni samarpyaiva candanaṃ cākṣatānyapi | samastāni supuṣpāṇi samarpya paramātmane || 6 || pādasaṃvāhanārthaṃ sā yāvat puro niṣīdati | tāvacchrīkṛṣṇakāntasya pādayornirgatā prabhā || 7 || avyāpnod badrike saudhe tataścatvaramaṇḍale | nibiḍā ca ghanībhūtāvyāpnodambaramaṇḍale || 8 || candranibhābhavat sā tu mādhuryaśītamiṣṭadā | atha vidyunnibhā jātā svargānalasamā tataḥ || 9 || mahābhūtamayī jātā taijasī sā tato’mbare | atheśvarāṇāṃ yogyā ca gamyā svarganivāsinām || 4.27.1 0|| brahmādīnāṃ tato gamyā tataśceśvarapuṃgavaiḥ | nibhālyā śrīpure dhāmni yathā vai taijasī prabhā || 11 || vāsudevaprabhā paścāt kṛṣṇaprabhākṣaraprabhā | akṣaraṃ dhāma sarvaṃ sābhavat tābhyāṃ nibhālitam || 12|| muktā muktānikāścāpi brahmapriyā haripriyāḥ | samastā śrīrmāṇikī ca lalitā ca jayā ramā || 12|| rādhāpadmāvatīśaktayaśca tābhyāṃ vilokitāḥ | dhāmni cārāmasaudhāni mandirāṇi śubhāni ca || 14|| bhavanāni vicitrāṇi muktānāmālayāḥ śubhāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mukhyamandiram || 15||| sahasraikakalaśāḍhyabahumandiramadhyagam | nibhālitāstathā sakhyaḥ sakhāyaḥ paramātmanaḥ || 1 6|| udyānāni vihārāśca divyabhogā vilokitāḥ | divyātidivyasaundaryamādhuryaujjvalyasaṃbhṛtāḥ || 17|| pārṣadāḥ pārṣadānyaśca tābhyāṃ tatra vilokitāḥ | kalpadrumā brahmadrumā brahmavallyo vilokitāḥ || 18|| phalapuṣparddhayasteṣu miṣṭarasā vibhāvitāḥ | anantabhogasāmagryo’saṃkhyasādhanasaṃbhṛtāḥ || 19|| anantadāsadāsyaścānantaiśvaryavibhūtayaḥ | anantasiddhadehāśca muktātmāno vilokitāḥ ||4.27.20||| muktairmuktānikābhiśca sevitaḥ parameśvaraḥ | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrasthito dhāmni vilokitaḥ ||21|| divyākṣare pare dhāmni saurāṣṭro’pi vilokitaḥ | aśvapaṭṭasaro divyaṃ ramyaḥ śrīlomaśāśramaḥ || 22|| maharṣīṇāṃ cāvasathānyapi divyāni tatra ca | ālokitāni divyāni koṭyarbudābjaśaktayaḥ ||23|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāntā vilokitāḥ | tatra tvaṃ badarī cāsse māṇikyā bhagavatpriyā ||24|| divyagajāsanaṃ kṛṣṇamandire sarvaśobhane | sarvarddhisaṃbhṛtaṃ cāpi tābhyāṃ vilokitaṃ tadā ||25|| atha tatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ | purāṇapuruṣo badri divyayuvā susundaraḥ || 26|| svarṇakeśaḥ svarṇaśmaśruḥ svarṇāmbaraḥ sutaijasaḥ | sarvalāvaṇyamūrtiśca mandahāsyānvitaḥ prabhuḥ || 27|| anantacandraśītāḍhyanetradvayavirājitaḥ | sarvānandapradapremarasāḍhyanetrapadmajaḥ ||28|| mandahāsyasugandhāḍhyamukhamaṇḍalarājitaḥ | raktauṣṭhasthasumādhuryapriyatābodhabodhakaḥ ||29|| śvetakāntiprasaratsadratnabījābhadantakaḥ | śrīrūpāvyaktabhāvāḍhyamāṇikyajihvikāntaraḥ ||4.27.3 0|| puṣṭaskandhadvayālambimandārādisraganvitaḥ | bhujabandhabhujāśobhacchṛṃṅkhalāḍhyaprakoṣṭhakaḥ || 31 || dakṣakaratalasthānamīnaśūladhanurdhvajaḥ | nakhacandrāvalidyotatsamagrābhipuraḥsthalaḥ ||3 2|| ratnabhūṣāvalivyāptakaustubharekhikaurasaḥ | svarṇāmbarādiśobhāḍhyo raśanākaṭiśobhitaḥ ||33|| kvaṇatkiṃkiṇikākūjatpādabhūṣāvirājitaḥ | svarṇacitramṛdusvastipādukācaraṇānvitaḥ || 34|| alaktābhacaraṇobhatalādisarvacihnavān | pārameśaṃ paraṃ chatraṃ mastakordhve virājate ||35|| cāmare cālpamāne’pi śrīlakṣmībhyāṃ dhṛte śubhe | vyajanena satī bālayoginī yatra tiṣṭhati ||36|| sureśvarī tāmbūlakaṃ yasmai kṛṣṇāya yacchati | nikāmadevaḥ śrīkṛṣṇavetradharo’tra rājate || 37|| evaṃ divyasvarūpaḥ śrīkṛṣṇastābhyāṃ pravīkṣitaḥ | athāsya kṛpayā kṛṣṇodyānāni bhavanāni ca ||38|| antaḥ praviśya sarvāṇi tābhyāṃ vilokitāni vai | anantānandamodāśca tābhyāṃ tatra samarjitāḥ ||39|| prasādāścārjitā divyaśrīkṛṣṇena samarpitāḥ | tṛptāḥ śāśvatabhāvāśca muktāścāpi vilokitāḥ ||4.27.40|| śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaśca dharmamūrtirvilokitaḥ | tathā śrīkaṃbharālakṣmīrbhaktirūpāvalokitā ||41 || santuṣṭā ca satī bālā kṛṣṇaśaktirvilokitā | evaṃ dṛṣṭvā prasādaṃ ca labdhvā bhuktvā ca tau tadā ||42|| tṛptau nārāyaṇadṛṣṭyā golokaṃ samupāgatau | akṣaraṃ dhāma sahasā samastaṃ vilayaṃ gatam ||43|| goloke śrīkṛṣṇarūpastābhyāṃ sa eva mādhavaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo vilokitaḥ ||44|| vaṃśīdharo gopikānāṃ maṇḍaleṣu sarādhikaḥ | rāsaṃ rāmayan ramayan gopavṛndeṣu vīkṣitaḥ ||45|| gavāṃ susevane sakto dugdhadadhyādibhojanaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo vilokitaḥ ||46|| atha tābhyāṃ sa golokastirobhūto vilokitaḥ | vaikuṇṭhastāvadevaiva sañjāta iti vīkṣitaḥ ||47|| tatra nārāyaṇo lakṣmīpatiḥ prabhurvilokitaḥ | asaṃkhyapārṣadaiḥ sevyo’nantaramādirāmaṇaḥ ||48|| avyākṛtaṃ mahaddhāma tatastābhyāṃ vilokitam | vāsudevastatra dhāmni vāsudevyādisevitaḥ ||49|| pradyumnādibhrātṛbhiśca sarvasāmarthyaśobhitaḥ | ālokito hi bhagavān tataḥ śrīpuradhāmani ||4.27.50|| lalitāśrīmahādevyā sevito’nantaśaktibhiḥ | amṛtākhye tato dhāmni kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sa ca ||51|| bhūmā hi bhagavān so’pi vīkṣitaḥ kamalāpatiḥ | tataḥ kailāsarūpe ca sadāśivo vilokitaḥ ||52|| sa eva bhagavām̐stābhyāṃ hiraṇyagarbhadhāmani | hiraṇmayaḥ svarṇamūrtirmahāviṣṇurvilokitaḥ ||53|| vaikuṇṭhe cāpare tatra sa vai viṣṇusvarūpadhṛk | padmāśrīsahitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vilokitaḥ ||54|| atha sūrye sa evāpi nārāyaṇo hiraṇmayaḥ | vilokito hi bhagavān vahnau vahnisvarūpadhṛk ||55|| sa eva bhagavān badrikāśrame ca narāgrajaḥ | tāpaso lokitastābhyāṃ śvetadvīpe’tha śeṣagaḥ ||56|| sa eva bhagavān kṣīre lakṣmīkānto vilokitaḥ | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre sarvāvatārarūpadhṛk ||57|| koṭyavatārasahitaḥ koṭikṛṣṇasamanvitaḥ | vilokitastatastābhyāmanādipuruṣottamaḥ ||58|| athāntaryāmirūpaḥ sa pratyātmāpi nibhālitaḥ | sureśvaryā hṛdaye’pi nikāmadevamānase ||29|| samagrāyāṃ pratimāyāṃ bālayoginikāsthiṣu | pratyavayavaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vilokitaḥ ||4.27.6 0|| evaṃ pradarśya bhagavān tābhyāṃ divyaṃ mahattamam | mahimānaṃ nijaṃ paścāt tiro’bhāvayadacyutaḥ ||6 1|| mānavaḥ sahasā jātaścāśvapaṭṭasastaṭe | pṛthvyāṃ sthito’bhavattatra snānārthakṛtaniścayaḥ ||62| nikāmadevaṃ hastābhyāṃ pasparśa ca sureśvarīm | tāvattau carmacakṣuṣkau jātau yadvaddhi mānavau ||6 3|| nipetatuḥ pūrṇakāmau kṛtasarvātmadarśanau | stutiṃ sāśrudṛṣṭinetrau cakratuḥ svāminaḥ prabhoḥ ||64|| pāvitau kṛpayā kṛṣṇa putrīdānena pāvitau | rakṣitau sannidhau kṛṣṇa kṛpayā mokṣitāvapi ||65 || kṛtakṛtyau prajātau svaḥ prārthitaṃ nāvaśiṣyate | pareśastvaṃ ciraṃ prāpto bhavārṇave punastviha || 66 || bhavo gato gato bhāvo bhayaṃ gataṃ tu naidhanam | āgatā brahmasaṃvittirbrāhmī tṛptiḥ samāgatā ||67|| yadvā preṣaya tatraiva yatrāsse tva mahākṣare | yadvā rakṣaya cātraiva pādayoste janārdana ||68|| brahmeśastvaṃ yathārtho’si janmamaraṇatārakaḥ | jā janirmā mṛtiśceti tastāraka ityasi ||69|| sarvātmako’si bhagavan sarvecchā nau rarāma ha | na tvāṃ vinā parātmānaṃ kiñcijjagati vidyate ||4.27.70|| tvāmeva viśvarūpaṃ ca paraṃ jñātvā vimucyate | sarvasthaṃ tvāṃ vilokyaiva samādhiḥ sarvadā sthitaḥ ||71|| tvāṃ dhyātvā yastyajetprāṇān sa yāti brahmadhāma vai | tvāṃ saṃsthāpya nijātmābje gantavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||72|| kṛṣṇaprakāśakaṃ dhyānaṃ sarvabandhavimocakam | aho bhāgyaṃ paraṃ nau ca yadatra milito bhavān ||73|| manthanād dṛśyate hyagnirbhavān sarvasamarpaṇāt | kṛpā te nau vimokṣāya nānyaḥ panthā hi kāraṇam ||74|| śravaṇaṃ mananaṃ dhyānaṃ jñānaṃ tīrthaṃ tapo vratam | na muktau kāraṇaṃ cātra kṛpā te cātra kāraṇam ||75|| yadā sarve samarpyante kāmā hṛtsthāstvayīśvare | tadāmṛtapadaprāptiḥ kṛpayā te bhavediha ||76|| sarvajñaḥ sarvadarśī tvaṃ kṣetrajñaścātmadīpakṛt | vilīya vāsanā naijān nayasyakṣaradhāmani ||77|| ityuccārya nama oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te | namaskāraṃ cakratustau tāvacchrībālayoginī ||78|| āyātā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya dātumuttamam | sumiṣṭaṃ salilaṃ pānayogyaṃ ca śītalaṃ satī ||79|| divyadṛṣṭyā jñātavatī pitrostūrṇaṃ hi mokṣaṇam | nātidūre ca sahasā pāyayitvā jalaṃ harim ||4.27.80|| prasādavāri pitṛbhyāṃ dadau sā bālayoginī | tāvattau kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca ||81|| jagadaturdivyavācā kṛpayā svāminaḥ prabhoḥ | prasādavāripānena dehābhyāṃ parivartitau ||82|| divyarūpau taijasau tau bhāgatyāgavivarjitau | babhūvaturhi tatraiva muktau dhāmagatau yathā ||83|| tāvad vimānaṃ subhagaṃ gajāgrapariśobhitam | muktamuktānikājuṣṭaṃ jayaśabdādikūjitam ||84|| ambaraṃ pṛthivīṃ svarge prabhāsayad yathākṣaram | avātaranmandirasya sannidhau setubhūmiṣu ||85|| jayaśabdairharikṛṣṇaṃ svāminaṃ śrīramāpatim | puṣpākṣatādibhirdivyaiścandanaistamapūjayan ||86|| avatīrya vimānācca śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmṛtam | jagṛhuśca rajo mūrdhni nidadhuśca papurjalam ||87|| paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ tāvattau mānavāvapi | divyadehau bālakṛṣṇahastadhṛtau vimānake ||88|| niṣāditau viprasureśvarīnikāmadevakau | natau putryā ca hariṇā badaryā tatra tāvubhau ||89|| māṇikyayā natau cāpi natau kṛṣṇakuṭumbibhiḥ | natvā sarvān vimānena yayaturdhāma cākṣaram ||4.27.90|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā dehino devakoṭayaḥ | evaṃ badrīpriye devi śvaśurau paramātmanā ||9 1|| preṣitāvakṣaraṃ dhāma pitarau te tadā matau | idaṃ ye paramākhyānaṃ śroṣyanti paramādarāt |||2|| śrāvayiṣyanti vā lokān prāpsyanti paramāṃ gatim | kṛṣṇasevā mokṣadā vai sādhusevā ca mokṣadā ||93|| mantro viṣaṃ vārayati vahniḥ śītaṃ haratyapi | sadā tu tau hi nirdoṣau mantraḥ kṛṣṇo’nalo hi san ||94|| satāṃ yogena muktiḥ syād yathā śrīkṛṣṇayogataḥ | kṛṣṇayogena mokṣaḥ syād yathā sādhuprasaṃgataḥ ||95|| sākṣāt kṛṣṇasya yogena divyatā varṣmaṇastviha | sarvārthalābha evāpi śiṣyate nāparaṃ sukham ||96|| bālayoginīgītāyā abhyāsena parātmanaḥ | patnī syāt kanyakā nārī naro dāsastu pārṣadaḥ ||97|| sakāmāḥ sampadāṃ vāsā niṣkāmāḥ syurvimuktigāḥ | asiddhāḥ siddhatāṃ ceyurbaddhā nirbaddhatāmapi ||98|| bhramitā brahmabhāvaṃ ca prāpnuyuḥ śravaṇādapi | mānanāt kṛṣṇatāṃ nididhyāsanāt parameśatām ||99|| prāpnuyuḥ sarvathā badri prāha śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | bālayoginīgīteyaṃ bālakṛṣṇasuyogadā || 4.27.10 0|| śrotavyā satataṃ muktyai gantavyaḥ paramaḥ pumān | bhoktavyaṃ ca sukhaṃ kārṣṇe suptavyaṃ śayane hareḥ ||1 01 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne’nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena nikāmadevāya tatpatnyai ca sarvadhāmadhāmirūpasvadarśanaṃ dattam, nikāmadevatatpatnyoḥ sadehadivyamokṣaṇaṃ kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 27 ||
<4.28> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ | kaivartakasya bhaktasya prapannasya vimocinīm || 1 || asti jvālālakaṃ nāma nagaraṃ bhadrikātaṭe | tatrāste nigaḍabhrāmo nāmnā kaivartajātijaḥ || 2 || karoti vāsaṃ bhadrāyā nadyāstu sannidhau divā | matsyagrāhakriyāsaktaḥ kuṭumbabharaṇodyamaḥ || 3 || jālamādāya bhadrāyā hrade gatvā tu matsyakān | pāśayitvā gṛhaṃ yāti sāyaṃ matsyādanaḥ sadā || 4 || vikrīya cādhikānmatsyān dhanaṃ prāpnoti yattu saḥ | tenānnaṃ śākapatrādi krītvā bharate bālakān || 5 || putrān putrīstathā patnīṃ bharate tena karmaṇā | athaikadā striyā sākaṃ vastrakṣālanahetave || 6 || bhadrāṃ nadīṃ yayau jālayuto nigaḍabhrāmakaḥ | sa tu tīre sthito jālaṃ cikṣepāgādhavāriṣu || 7 || patnī tasyāmbaraprakṣālanodyatā jalaistadā | kṣālayatyeva vastrāṇi tatra nirmalavāridhau || 8 || vastradhyānaparā yāvanmajjayatyambaraṃ jale | tāvat tatpatinā jāle pāśitaṃ tu timiṃ patim || 9 || vīkṣya drāk ca timeścakrośanaṃ śrutvā bhayāvaham | timinī pāśabaddhaṃ svaṃ patiṃ kaivarttarodhitam || 4.28.1 0|| ākṛṣyamāṇaṃ jālena bahumatsyasamanvitam | śaśāpa duḥkhamāpannā rakṣaṇe śaktivarjitā || 11 || kaivarttaṃ mānuṣīvāṇyā bhūtvātivihvalā tadā | kaivartta tvaṃ bhavāvarttānmā muktāḥ karhicid bhava || 12|| muhustimiṅgilo bhūtvā mara kaivartajālagaḥ | yathāhaṃ duḥkhinī tvatra bhavāmi patināśataḥ || 1 3|| tathā patnī tava cāpi sadāstu duḥkhinīti ca | evaṃ matsyavadhūścoktvā rurodāpatyavāritā || 14|| tāvat kaivarttikāścaryaṃ śrutvāpaśyajjalāntare | mīnī rautīti patyarthaṃ patirjālāntarārditaḥ || 15|| śāpaṃ dadau tu sā matsyetyevaṃ veda nijāntare | sahasā cāmbaraṃ tyaktvā patyuḥ sannidhimetya ca || 16|| vicārya matsyamokṣārthaṃ jālasūtraṃ kare’karot | patihastānmocayitvā labdhvā jālaṃ jale śanaiḥ || 17|| mumocābandhanāyaiva matsyānāṃ śāpabhīyutā | jālaśaithilyabhāvena matsyā jālādviniryayuḥ || 18|| sarve’pi tvakṣatā jāle nirgatya viviśurjalam | saṃvadantaḥ prasannāśca jīva tvaṃ lakṣavatsarān || 19|| sadaiva sadhavā cāpi patisevāparāyaṇā | dayāvatī ca matsyānāṃ hiṃsākarmādivarjitā ||4.28.20|| hṛṣṭā bhavatu kaivartti sadāsmadrakṣaṇādiha | evaṃ matsyādayaścoktvā viviśurjalamadhyake ||21|| atha śrutvā tu kaivartto mahāścaryaparo’bhavat | kṣudhānvito’pi patnyāstat karma vīkṣya dayāparam ||22|| anumene mumocāpi jālaṃ tīre viyatnakaḥ | patnīṃ papraccha kimidaṃ sahasā jālakarṣaṇam ||23|| patnīṃ taṃ śrāvayāmāsa śāpaṃ matsyoditaṃ tadā | kaivarttaśca samāśrutya bhayaṃ cāvāpa janmanām ||24||| matsyayonijaduḥkhānāṃ paśyannānantyamanvaham | matsyai tu śāpadātryai ca mocayitryai tu yoṣite ||25|| dhanyavādān dadau tatra yat pāpānmocitastviti | jālaṃ tyaktvā kṣaṇe tatra vahnau prajvālya dhīvaraḥ ||26||| phalakandānnaśākādastata ārabhya so’bhavat | badrike puṇyasādhūnāṃ saṃgamaḥ sadgatipradaḥ || 27|| matsyā ime’bhavat sarve ṛṣayo matsyarūpiṇaḥ | bhadrāyāṃ tajjale’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 28|| bahuvāraṃ gaje sthitvā yatra snānāya gacchati | tattīrthalobhavaśagā maharṣayo’bhavan jhaṣāḥ || 29|| yastu dhṛto mahān matsyo matsyā cānye ca ye’bhavan | matsyarūpo’bhavat so’tra maharṣiḥ pipaṭhāyanaḥ ||4.28.30|| sarvajñakalpa ūrdhvadṛk sarvavidyānidhirdvijaḥ | matsyā patnī ca nāmnāsya pāṭhāyanīti sābhavat || 31 || anye matsyādayo viprā vedajñāścābhavan jale | badrike sa tu kaivarttaḥ pāpo maharṣidaṇḍavān ||22||| patnyā sadayayā kāntastāritaḥ samayajñayā | bandhakṛnnirayaṃ yāti bandhahā yāti gauravam ||33|| jīvābhavapradātā tu sarvasvargāni vindati | bhayadastu patatyeva svargādapi sukhālayāt ||34|| atha kaivarttikī natvā papraccha jalamatsyakān | ke bhavantaḥ kathaṃ matsyāḥ kathaṃ vāgīdṛśī śubhā ||35|| kathaṃ vā matsyarūpatvaṃ kathayantu dayālayāḥ | ityabhinoditā viprāḥ pratyūcurnigaḍabhramam ||36|| atrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrād vihartuṃ gajamāsthitaḥ ||37|| rasālāraṇyamāyāti viśrāmyatyatra śādvale | snāti krīḍati bhadrāyāstaṭe satsalile hariḥ ||38|| bahudhā śrīramālakṣmīrādhāpriyādibhiḥ saha | mādhavīlalitāmuktājayābhiḥ saha pārṣadaiḥ ||39|| ramate vārṣu taistābhirbhuṃkte phalāni pāti vāḥ | prasādaṃ pradadātyevopasthitebhyaḥ kṛpāparaḥ ||4.28.40 || ṛṣibhyaḥ pārṣadebhyaśca yādobhyaḥ paśupakṣiṣu | kṣipatyete prasādaṃ taṃ prāpya yānti kṛtādarāḥ ||41 || miṣṭānnāni vicitrāṇi bhojayatyatra mādhavaḥ | utsavān prakarotyatra dānānyarpayati prabhuḥ |||42|| tadarthaṃ bahudhā cātra viprā dīnāśca sevakāḥ | vasantyatra prasādānāṃ dānānāmicchayā mudhā ||43|| vayaṃ cāpi vasāmo’tra viprā haryarthameva ha | pipaṭhāyanamūrdhanyāḥ śataṃ kuṭumbinaḥ śubhāḥ ||44|| āśramāḥ śrīrasālānāmadhaḥ santi vilokaya | athāpyatra samāyānti jalārthaṃ vanarākṣasāḥ ||45|| kvacid rātrau divā vāpi bahukrūraprakarmiṇaḥ | pīḍayanti viprajanān praharanti kvacit khalāḥ ||46|| apaharanti ca yoṣidvargaṃ haranti vastukam | pratikartuṃ vayaṃ śaktā api tvahiṃsayā sthitāḥ ||47|| bhagavallābhayogena cākleśena ca vāriṣu | kvacit kvacid vasāmo’tra matsyā bhūtvā jalāntare ||48|| kvacittu mānavāścāpi mṛgā vā siddhasādhavaḥ | bhūtvā bhūtvā vicarāmo cūtāraṇye surāṣṭrake ||49|| vada tvaṃ vai kathamatra ko’si kasmācca hiṃsasi | kathaṃ vai krūratāṃ hiṃsāṃ vahasyatrāpi mānave ||4.28.50 || durlabho mānavo deho mokṣadaḥ svargadaḥ śubhaḥ | kathaṃ hiṃsayā nirayān vrajituṃ karmakṛd bhavān ||51 || hiṃsā stainyaṃ pāradāryaṃ kapaṭaṃ chalatānṛtam | nindā doṣāropaṇaṃ ca nirayāṇāṃ pradāstvime ||52|| māṃsāśanaṃ surāpānaṃ droho mālinyamārttadā | parāpaharaṇaṃ krodho nirayāṇāṃ pradāstvime ||53|| sevā satāṃ harau bhaktiḥ parābhayapradānakam | ahiṃsanaṃ prasādānāmaśanaṃ cāpyanindanam ||54|| paropakaraṇaṃ dānaṃ svargasyaite pradā matāḥ | śuddhiḥ pūjā darśanaṃ ca satsaṃgo’nnaphalāśanam ||55|| svatvamātreṇa nirvāhaḥ svargāṇāṃ tu pradāstvime | hiṃsayā jāyate duḥkhaṃ pāpaṃ tannirayapradam ||96|| udarārthaṃ paraprāṇavināśaḥ karma nirghṛṇam | satsu phaleṣu kandeṣu vividhānneṣu satsvapi ||57|| māṃsāśano bhaved yastu sa yāti rauravaṃ param | jīvā naiva tu hantavyāḥ phalaṃ bhakṣyaṃ pavitrakṛt ||58|| dugdhaṃ peyaṃ gavāṃ samyak hantavyā gaurna vai kvacit | phalaṃ puṣpaṃ ca patraṃ ca bhakṣaṇīyaṃ drumādijam ||59|| drumā naiva vihantavyā vṛthā phalādinirvahe | dugdhaṃ peyaṃ tathā māturmāraṇīyā na jīvataḥ ||4.28.60|| madhu grāhyaṃ kusumebhyo nāśanīyāni naiva ha | karā grāhyā prajābhyastu bhakṣaṇīyā na sarvathā ||61 || kastūrikā hariṇebhyo grāhyā ghātyā na te matāḥ | evaṃ bhogamayaṃ sarvaṃ yadaṃśe bhogayogi tat ||62|| bhoktavyaṃ na tu hantavyaṃ hananaṃ narakapradam | tasmāttvaṃ hiṃsako bhūtvā mā yāhi narakān prati ||63|| svargaṃ sādhaya kaivartta tyaja hiṃsā sukhī bhava | ityupadiṣṭaḥ kaivartto natvā matsyātmakānṛṣīn ||64|| aparādhakṣamāṃ tebhyo yayāce śāpamocanīm | śāpo’yaṃ matsyikādevyā visarjitaḥ śaro yathā ||65|| lagno me hṛdaye tūrṇamudvejayati cādhikam | śāpamuktiryathā syānme tathā ṛṣe vidhehi vai ||66|| ityevaṃ tvaṃ tvarthayāmāsa yayāce tatpunaḥ punaḥ | kṛpāṃ kṛtvā tato badri pipaṭhāyanabhūsuraḥ ||67|| uvāca me vacanātte śāpo niḥsattvatāṃ gataḥ | kintu me vacanaṃ labdhvā yāhi kuṃkumavāpikām ||68|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yatra virājate | aśvapaṭṭasarovārimadhye snānaṃ vidhehi ca ||69|| darśanaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāpi vidhehi ca | pūjanaṃ patrapuṣpādyairvidhehi kurusevanam ||4.28.70|| mantraṃ gṛhāṇa matto’tra pāvanaṃ pauruṣottamam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyasvāmine svāhā ||71 || badrike sa samākarṇya mantraṃ prāpya ṛṣerguroḥ | sapatnīkaḥ sa kaivartto jagrāha niyamān yamān ||72|| ahiṃsanaṃ sādhusevāmacauryaṃ vanyavṛttitām | kandamūlaphalānnādyāhāraṃ tīrthaniṣevaṇam ||73|| bhajanaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti mālayā sadā | pūjanaṃ ca sadā nārāyaṇasya mādhavīpateḥ ||74|| satsaṃgaṃ lomaśādīnāṃ pipaṭhāyanadarśitam | bhūtānāmabhayaṃ ceti vrataṃ jagrāha sarvathā ||75|| pūjayitvā guruṃ cāpi gurvīṃ ca pipaṭhāyanīm | tathānyān sarvabrahmarṣīn jālaṃ tyaktvā nadītaṭe ||76|| jalaṃ pītvā tu bhadrāyāḥ pipaṭhāyanapādajam | natvā cāśīrvaco labdhvā sapatnīko gṛhaṃ yayau ||77|| putrādīn saha nītvaiva tyaktvā jvālālakaṃ puram | yayāvaśvapaṭṭasaro harṣito nigaḍabhramaḥ ||78|| tīrthaṃ cakāra devānāṃ darśanaṃ snānamarcanam | upavāsaṃ cakārāpi lomaśasyāpi darśanam ||79|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyārcanamuttamam | bhāvadarśanayuktaṃ sa cakāra vandanaṃ tataḥ ||4.28.80|| kṛtakṛtyo’smi bhagavan bhavaccaraṇadarśanāt | nārāyaṇena bhavatā datto mānavavigrahaḥ ||8 1 || dharmārthaḥ sa mayā nīto’dharmārthaḥ kṣapito’dhunā | pipaṭhāyanasaṃgena bodhamāpto’smi muktaye ||82|| apyahaṃ matsyaśāpācca muktyarthamatra saṃgataḥ | samuddhara kṛpāsindho prajvālayāghaparvatam ||83|| matsyādo’haṃ matsyamāra eṣa te śaraṇaṃ gataḥ | ityuktvā badrike kṛṣṇapādayornipapāta ha ||84|| tadbhāryāpi hareḥ pādau dhṛtvāṅguṣṭhaṃ cucumba ha | pādajalaṃ papau pādau dadhārorasi śītalau ||85|| mastake ca rajaścāpi dadhāra bhāvasaṃbhṛtā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastāṃ naigaḍīṃ striyam ||86|| nigaḍabhrāmakaṃ cāpi divyamūrtimadarśayat | kṛpayaiva ca pāpāni jvālayāmāsa tatkṣaṇāt ||87|| divyadṛṣṭyā nigaḍo’pi naigaḍī taṃ pareśvaram | caturbhujaṃ kamalayā sahitaṃ sandadarśa ha ||88|| bhadrānadyāṃ hariṃ tīre ramantamṛṣimaṇḍale | apaśyad viharantaṃ ca bālakṛṣṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim ||89|| athainaṃ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre tejasi bhūmni vai | apaśyat sannidhau cāpi mānavaṃ saṃsthitaṃ prabhum ||4.28.90|| evaṃ pradarśya rūpaṃ svaṃ tamāha nigaḍabhramam | pipaṭhāyanayogena yāmyakleśo gatastava ||91 || mama yogena nigaḍabhrama yāhi madakṣaram | ityuktvā virarāmāsau śrīharikṛṣṇadharmajaḥ ||92|| nigaḍabhrāmakaścāha nama om paramātmane | tāvattatra samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ pārameśvaram ||93|| divyaṃ pārṣadasaṃjuṣṭaṃ sarvasauvarṇabhūṣaṇam | nigaḍo naigaḍī cobhau tatyajaturhi bhautikau ||94|| dehau prāpyāparau divyau yayatuścādhiruhma tat | vaikuṇṭhaṃ śrīharerdhāma kalpaparyantameva ha ||95|| tato’kṣarapadaṃ tau vai prāpsyataḥ paramātmanaḥ | tatputrādyāstataścakruḥ pitrostatraurdhvadaihikam ||96|| vaiṣṇavāḥ paramā jātā bālakṛṣṇasamāśritāḥ | kaiṃkaryaṃ te prakurvanti pañca putrā hareḥ sadā ||96|| putrītrayaṃ harerdāsyaṃ cakruścājīvanaṃ tataḥ | sādhvyaśca sādhavaste vai jātā bhāgavatottamāḥ ||98|| nāmnā sādhvyaḥ puṇḍarikāsatī nirvāṇikāsatī | ānandaghanikāsādhvī tisro nārāyaṇāśritāḥ ||99|| putrāḥ pañca jñānadarbhiḥ prabhādarbhirvidarbhikaḥ | viṣṇudarbhiḥ kṛṣṇadarbhistvete bhāgavatottamāḥ || 4.28.1 00|| abhavan sādhavo divyāstāpasāḥ siddhayoginaḥ | aśvapaṭṭasarobhūmau svāmisevāparāyaṇāḥ || 101 || badrike te’pi kālena parāṃ muktiṃ tato gatāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapratāpapāvanāḥ ||1 02|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bhadrānadyāṃ pipaṭhāyanarṣiyogena nigaḍabhramādikaivarttānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrayo mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 28 ||
<4.29> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā badri māṇikye mādhavi priye | kathāṃ tvatra kṛtaghnāyā yoṣito muktikāriṇīm || 1 || āsīdekā vibhāvaryāṃ puryāṃ saurāṣṭramaṇḍale | kuthalī nāmato yoṣā dīnā sagarajātijā || 2 || ekākinī dīnabālā hyanāthābhavadārttinī | ābālyānmṛtajananīpitṛbāndhavapālakā || 3 || pañcavarṣābhavad yāvat tāvat sā mṛtarakṣakā | guruṇā sagarāṇāṃ sā poṣitā vardhitā gṛhe || 4 || prāptadvādaśavarṣā sā viveda svāṃ tu sāgarīm | na viprāṃ tena viprāṇyāṃ sneho vicchinnatāṃ gataḥ || 5 || yā mātā garbhadhartrī syāt saiva snehasya bhājanam | anyā tu kṛtrimasnehā kanyāsneho na tatra vai || 6 || vadhvāḥ sneho jananyāṃ yādṛśaḥ śvaśrvāṃ na tādṛśaḥ | janayitryāṃ yathā snehaḥ stanyadāyāṃ na tādṛśaḥ || 7 || garbhadhartryāṃ yathā snehastatsapatnyāṃ na tādṛśaḥ | gurau sneho yathā loke pitṛsnehastato’dhikaḥ || 8 || raktasnehāddharmajanyasneho gauṇo hi sarvadā | āpatkāle raktajaḥ saḥ dharmajādvai viśiṣyate || 9 || kuthalī sāgarī kanyā viprāṇyāṃ bhedadṛṣṭitaḥ | vartanaṃ tvakarottatrājñāyāṃ prasevanādiṣu ||4.29.1 0|| sarvakriyāsu yadvat sā bhrāntacittā hi vartate | na karoti gṛhakāryaṃ jalasyāharaṇādikam || 11 || mārjanaṃ majjanaṃ śayyāstaraṇaṃ peṣaṇībhramim | prātarutthāya viprāṇyā dattaṃ bhuktvā tu sotsukā || 1 2|| sagarāṇāṃ gṛhāṇyeva prayāti khelane ratā | vimanaskā vipragṛhe samanaskā tu sāgare || 1 3| sāgarībhiḥ pramadābhirbodhitā sāgarīti sā | sāgarī bhavituṃ tatra cecchad drutaṃ vivāhitā || 14|| guruṇā tu kṛtaṃ tasyā upakāraṃ na vetti sā | ābālyāt pālitā sarvadānaiḥ sā vetti naiva tat || 15 || gaṇayatyeva naivāpi mātāpitṛsamau dvijau | kṛtaṃ prapoṣaṇaṃ varṣasaptakaṃ manute na tat || 16|| abuddhitvāt svabhāvādvā bālātvādvā pradūṣaṇam | kṛtaghnītvaṃ samāpannaṃ sāgarīsaṃgato’pi vā || 17|| badrike kṛtalābhānāṃ hananaṃ narakāya tat | kṛtānāṃ hananaṃ puṇyahananaṃ svargahaṃ tathā || 18|| gurogṛhe tu kanyāyā vāso’yutajanuḥphalam | anyayoniprasūtāyā viprāṇītvaṃ hi durlabham || 19 || tadasyāḥ sulabhaṃ jātaṃ tathāpi karmanoditā | viprātvaṃ sā parityajya sāgarītve mano’karot ||4.29.20|| atha bhāryā guroḥ kanyāmupādideśa śāntaye | putrike karmasaṃsāro śasanāmūlapoṣitaḥ ||21|| viṣayādyaśano modapramodavāriṣecitaḥ | dharmādharmādiśākhaśca tṛṣṇādipatrapallavaḥ ||22|| bhogehāṃkuraśobhāḍhyaḥ sukhaduḥkhaphalapradaḥ | rāgadveṣakusumādyairākṛṣyante’tra dehinaḥ ||23|| ātmā doṣavihīnaśca vṛkṣatāmeti saṃgataḥ | saṃsārī vāsanābaddhastata ucyata ārttimān ||24|| bālye tvātmā doṣahīno nirmalaścendriyeśvaraḥ | yauvane doṣasarvasvo malinaścendriyānugaḥ ||25|| kanyā vāpi kumārā vā jihvārasātibandhanāḥ | yuvatyo vā yuvāno’pi yo niśi śnāti veginaḥ ||26|| sa vego nirjito yena yayā tau mokṣabhāginau | nityasukhaṃ parameśadhāmni tanmokṣaṇaṃ mahat ||27|| nārāyaṇaprasaṃgena satāṃ yogena kanyake | mokṣo bhavati saṃsārānnirayastvanyasaṃgataḥ ||28|| garbhe prapācito deho bālye muhuśca saṃskṛtaḥ | yauvane malino malavannimnendriyamalādhikaḥ ||29|| yadi vegena kāmena vāsanayātivegayā | paradehe naradehe mugdhā syāt sā vinaśyati ||4.29.30|| mātāpitṛsnehapātraṃ kanyā kumāravanmatā | tau tyaktyā yetaraṃ yāti sā kṛtaghnā bhavediha ||3 1|| adīyamānā kanyā vai necchayā gantumarhati | vadhūrbhūtvā preṣitā vai dharmeṇa yāti kāntagā ||32|| tvaṃ viprau poṣakau tyaktvā nityaṃ yāsi gṛhāntaram | nādya te samayastādṛg vinājñāṃ yāhi mā tathā ||33|| kanyakānāṃ paragṛhe cirayogo bhayāvahaḥ | hāvabhāvaiśca puṃyogairmaryādānāśa āpatet ||34|| vivāhavarjitā kanyā bhraṃśaṃ labhenna saṃśayaḥ | sāgarī tvaṃ janmato’pi viprā tvaṃ brāhmaṇīgṛhe ||35|| utpannaphalavat kanye pavitrā tvaṃ hi bhūsurī | dehaste nirmalo jāto viprapoṣaṇakāritaḥ ||36|| viprāṇīyogamutsṛjya sāgarīgā tu mā bhava | viprāṇīṃ māṃ vihāyaiva yadi putri gamiṣyasi ||37|| kṛtadhnītvaṃ tadā prāpya bhraśyase nātra saṃśayaḥ | ityuktā viprapatnyā sā kanyā papraccha mātaram ||38|| kīdṛśyastāḥ kṛtaghnyaśca vada me mātarañjasā | atha mātā viprapatnī nāmnā sā tvātmaśemuṣī ||39|| putrīṃ prāha kṛtānāṃ yā hantrī kṛtaghnikā tu sā | śṛṇu putri tathā nāryo bhavantīha narā api ||4.29.40|| tena pāpena nirayān bhuñjate maraṇottaram | mātṛpuṣṭā bālikā yā mātaraṃ naiva sevate ||41|| sā kṛtaghnī prathamaiva dvitīyā mātṛduḥkhadā | poṣitāpi ca kanyā yā viparītā virodhinī ||42|| sā kṛtapnā kuṭumbasya doṣavaktrī kṛtaghnikā | gṛhacchidraṃ bahirvakti kleśaṃ karoti tena yā ||43|| sā kṛtaghnā sadā proktā hantrī kīrteḥ kuṭumbinām | yā prāptayauvanā yāti vinājñāṃ paramandiram ||44|| svatantrasvavihārā sā kṛtaghnā kulanāśinī yā vidhiṃ tu samutsṛjya vṛṇute tu svayaṃvaram ||45|| sā pitrorduḥkhadā cet syāt kṛtaghnātvena dūṣitā | gṛhakāryāṇi yā tyaktvā parakāryaparāyaṇā ||46|| gṛhakāryaṃ mahatīnāmarthe rakṣati sāpi sā | vadhūrbhūtvā kāntasevāṃ yā karoti na māninī ||47|| sā kṛtaghnā tathā śvaśrūkleśinī tadvidhā tathā | sapatnīduḥkhadā yā ca gṛhanārī virodhinī ||48|| kāntasambandhikalidā gṛhakleśābhiropiṇī | kṛtaghnā sā sadā bodhyodāsīnā gṛhakarmasu ||49|| yā vadhūṃ sevikāṃ naiva śvaśrūḥ snehayati kvacit | sā vṛddhā duḥkhadā vadhvāḥ kṛtaghnā gṛhaśāsinī ||4.29.50|| yā bāleṣu pakṣapātaṃ bhojanādau viśeṣataḥ | ayogyaṃ prakarotyeṣā kṛtaghnā jñānavarjitā ||51 || kṛtopakāraṃ sāhāyyaṃ cāvamatyātivartinī | doṣān vakti virodhena kṛtaghnā sā sadā matā |||52|| puṣṭā tuṣṭā pālitā ca pālakaṃ sā vihāya cet | prayātyanyatra paśuvat sā kṛtaghnā sadā matā ||53|| abhyudayaḥ kṛto yena śikṣānnadhanamandiraiḥ | taṃ cedāpatsu sahasā kṣiped yā sā kṛtaghnikā ||54|| guruṃ devaṃ pālakaṃ ca pitaraṃ mātaraṃ patim | yā tvāpatsu prakṣipati kṛtaghnā sā prakīrtitā ||55|| kṛtāpakāraṃ vadati nopakāraṃ kadācana | sā kṛtaghnā kṛtahantrī nirayān yāti bhāminī ||56|| āpadvināśakasyāpi tadāpattau na pakṣadā | pratyutāniṣṭasaṃyoktrī sā kṛtaghnā matā sadā ||57|| pareśenārpito deho mānavo mokṣalabdhaye | taṃ pareśaṃ pravismṛtya vartate sā kṛtaghnikā ||58|||| vivāhaḥ kārito yena vivāhitā ca yena vā | tayorguṇaṃ na gṛhṇāti doṣadā sā kṛtadhnikā ||59|| adhyāpitā śikṣitā yā tathāpattāritā tu yā | tadguṇaṃ naiva jānāti virodhinī kṛtaghnikā ||4.29.60|| dharmārthaṃ mānuṣo deho dharmaṃ jānāti naiva yā | adharmārthakṛtadhyānā sā tu dharmakṛtaghnikā ||61|| dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu sāhāyyadāstu ye matāḥ | teṣāmapakṛtau lagnā yā sā kṛtaghnikā sadā ||62|| kṛtaghnānāṃ nirayā vai bhavanti duḥkhadāḥ sadā | yāmyaloke paratrāpi sarvaṃ tāsāṃ vihanyate ||63|| sukhaṃ na labhate kvāpi kṛtaghnā pāpaparvatā | kṛtajñā labhate puṇyaṃ svargaṃ sukhaṃ mahotsavam ||64|| kṛtaṃ jānāti yā kanyā nārī vṛddhā naro’pi vā | upakāraṃ prakuryācca sā syāt svarganivāsinī ||65|| atra putraprapautrādyaiḥ śobhate vaṃśavistaraiḥ | dhanadhānyāmbarasampatsvarṇādyairabhivardhate ||66|| kṛtaghnāyā vināśaṃ vai yāti sarvaṃ samūlakam | putri tvaṃ mā kṛtaghnā syā nirayān mā prayāhi ca ||67|| mama santoṣadā bhūtvā pravardhayātisampadā | yaśasā vaṃśavṛddhyāpi svarge’pi ca tato’dhikā ||68|| ityuktā kuthalī kanyā sāgarī bījadoṣataḥ | na mene sā mātṛvākyaṃ pāpaṃ yā manute nahi ||69|| na doṣaṃ manute tatra tyajane cāśrayāntare | niṣekadoṣabhāvena cāvamatya vaco hi tat ||4.29.70|| prāha prativacastatra mātaraṃ mativibhramā | mātaḥ kṛtaghnatāḥ sarvā ākarṇitā mukhāttava ||71 || svārthaste mayi ko’styatra sāgaryāṃ bhinnayoṣiti | bhinnavarṇodbhavāyāṃ ca bhinnācārādiyoṣiti ||72|| na me bhikṣugṛhe vṛttirbhikṣukī na bhavāmyaham | ahaṃ sagarajātīyā sāgaraṃ kaṃcidāpnuyām ||73|| tatra śreyo mama cāsti na vipre svāmini kvacit | bālikāścāpyanāthāśca sarvaiḥ poṣyāstu dharmataḥ ||74|| kṛto’yaṃ sarvathā nyāyo vṛddhaiścāpratidānavat | bālānāmupakāro yaḥ kartavyaṃ tat samucyate ||79|| tatra nāsti kṛtaghnatvaṃ kanyā dhanaṃ parārthakam | mātaḥ kṣamāṃ vidhehyatra majjātau tu prayāmyaham ||76|| na bhikṣāvāribahule vipre prayāmi karhicit | ityuktvā mātaraṃ natvā hyavamatya ca tadvacaḥ ||77|| pratyuta dūṣaṇaṃ datvā viprāṇyā pālanaṃ kṛtam | aviprāyāstu viprāṇyā pālanaṃ taddhi dūṣaṇam ||78|| yadvā paropakartavyaṃ mamatvavarjitaṃ vṛṣaḥ | kṛto bhavatyā tatrāyaṃ tvāgrahaḥ putrikātmakaḥ ||79|| kathaṃ vai kriyate sādhvi pūjye vimūlako mayi | mṛd bhūmau vāri salile vahnistejasi vānile ||4.29.80|| svasvatattveṣu viśrāmaṃ labhante netare kvacit | tathāhaṃ sāgarī kanyā sāgare śāntimemi ha ||81 || prayāmi sāgaraṃ vaṃśaṃ dehi vā na pradehi mām | ityuktvā badrike sā tu natvā tadātmaśemuṣīm ||82|| kuthalī samparityajya vipragṛhaṃ tu sāttvikam | rājasaṃ sāgaraṃ veśaṃ svayaṃ gatvā samāśritā ||83|| kṛtaghniketi brāhmaṇyā tadoktā sā tathāvidhā | poṣikāṃ mātaraṃ tyaktvā yato’nyatra svayaṃgatā ||84|| kṛtaghnātvamahādoṣaṃ prāptā sā kanyakā tataḥ | kintu vipragṛhe nityaṃ devaprasādabhojinī ||85|| devārcanādisevābhirbahupuṇyavatī hyabhūt | tasyāḥ puṇyapratāpena kuthalī prāptayauvanā ||86|| vibhāvarīnagaryāstu rājñā nāmnā virāmiṇā | anāthā sā sagarāya svabhṛtyāya samarpitā ||87|| nāmnā dharmakareṇāpi sagareṇa vivāhitā | rājñīsevāparā jātā mānyā sampatsubhoginī ||88|| modate bhogasampattyā dharmakaragṛhe sthitā | ciravarṣāṇi sā bhogān bubhuje puṇyanirmitāna ||89|| viṃśatiḥ putrakāścāsyāḥ kanyakāḥ sapta cābhavan | puṇyastaro’bhavattasyāḥ sāntaḥ pāpastarastataḥ ||4.29.90|| samprāptastu kṛtaghnātvabhogo viprāṇikoditaḥ | rugṇā sā tvekadā jātā śītapīḍānvitā jvaraiḥ ||91|| pīḍitā sā rurodāpi māsottaraṃ viśaktikā | upacārāḥ kṛtāḥ putraiḥ svāminā tatkuṭumbibhiḥ ||92|| tathāpi na jvaraśāntirabhavat sukhamāpa na | rājayakṣmābhavattasyāḥ sarvanāśakaro’tha sā ||93|| sasmāra brāhmaṇīṃ tatra mātaraṃ poṣikāṃ satīm | taduktaṃ tat kṛtaghnātvaṃ tatphalaṃ cāgataṃ mama ||94|| kālena bhāvi bhāvyaṃ ca bhavitavyaṃ na līyate | putraiḥ putryādibhiḥ sā tu sevitā dūrato bhayāt ||95|| rājayakṣmabhayānnānye pārśve tvāyānti karhicit | evaṃ sā varṣadaśakaṃ pīḍitā rājayakṣmaṇā ||96|| kṛtaghnatāphalaṃ tasyāḥ prāptaṃ nāpnoti cāntatām | patitā śayane tvāste pañjarābhābhavaddhi sā ||97|| atha putraṃ jyeṣṭhameva prāha sā vigatāśayā | yathā mokṣo bhavenme ca yathā me maraṇaṃ bhavet ||98|| tathā kuru madarthaṃ vai kṛtaghnatvanivāraṇam | putrastasyā drutaṃ tvāyāllomaśasyāśramaṃ prati ||99|| prārthayāmāsa taṃ śreṣṭhamaharṣiṃ mokṣaṇaṃ prati | yadvā rogasya dehasya cātmaśaktistu saṃbhavet || 4.29.10 0|| lomaśastaṃ jyeṣṭhasutaṃ tiraścāyanasaṃjñakam | jagāda hitakṛdvākyaṃ dayayā pāpanāśakam || 10 1|| mantraṃ gṛhāṇa kṛṣṇasya mātre dehi drutaṃ tathā | aśvapaṭṭajale snātvā
