prabodhitā mayā cāpi sāhāyyārthaṃ na yānti vai | pratyuta jñānavantaste nivārayanti māmapi ||46|| svasṛbhāvaṃ manāṅ naiva vijñāpayanti laukikam | śuṣkahṛdayabhāvāste śṛṇvanti nāpadaṃ tava ||47|| śṛṇu mātarmahāniṣṭaṃ saṃbhūtaṃ matpadāśraye | rākṣasaiste kanyakānāṃ prasahya haraṇaṃ kṛtam ||48|| atyaniṣṭaṃ hi tajjātaṃ mātarmocaya putrikāḥ | śocāmyahaṃ tadarthaṃ vai sannidhau te samāgataḥ ||49|| vinā tu rakṣaṇaṃ tāsāṃ nāśo vā syāttu rākṣasaiḥ | bhogaṃ vā pramadānāṃ te kariṣyanti svakīyavat ||4.37.50|| yadvā mugdhāḥ svapatnītvaṃ kariṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ | yāhi śīghraṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ saha cāyāmyahaṃ drutam |||7 || ityuktā badrike mātā kārelikā munīśvaram | śocantaṃ phutkārayuktaṃ śirohastadvayaṃ tadā ||52|| prāha mune kathaṃ kanyākṛte śokaṃ karoṣi vai | na te kanyā na te yogaḥ sambandhaste na vidyate ||53|| saṃsārottīrṇa evāsi kathaṃ saṃsarasi kṣaye | avināśaṃ nijātmānaṃ smara saṃsāravarjitam ||54||| asmādṛśīnāṃ saṃsāraḥ so’pi yāvannijārthakaḥ | bhavādṛśānāṃ saṃsāraścāsāraḥ sarvadā mataḥ ||55|| tat kathaṃ munirāṭ cintayasi strījanaceṣṭanam | kanyakā yāstu tāḥ kālāntare yāsyanti bhogyatām ||56|| patnītvaṃ parakīyātvaṃ pare tu mānavāḥ surāḥ | yadvā daityā rākṣasā vā narā vai patayo matāḥ ||57|| yathā bhāgyaṃ tathā jātaṃ jāyate’pi tathaiva hi | pūrvasañcitavegena jāyante gṛhamedhinaḥ |||58|| yadarthaṃ nirmitā kanyā patiḥ sa eva tiṣṭhati | anirmito na vai svāmī kadācidapi jāyate ||59|| rākṣasāḥ patayastāsāṃ nirmitā yadi santi cet | labdhavantaḥ runyakāstāstatra kā parivedanā ||4.37.60|| yāhi vidvan brahmamārgaṃ bhramamārgaṃ tu mā vaha | mohaṃ mā kuru pārakye daihike vāpyadaihike ||61 || prarakṣitaṃ gṛhe dravyaṃ parakīyaṃ bhaved yadi | pārakyaṃ parahaste tad yathābhāgyaṃ gamiṣyati ||62|| parityaktaṃ jane dravyaṃ svakīyaṃ ced bhaved yadi | svatvavannijahaste tat prasahyaivāgamiṣyati ||63|| abdhyudbhavā ghanāścāpi ratnāni mauktikānyapi | bhāgyavatāṃ gṛhe rāṣṭre prayāntyambaramārgataḥ ||64|| gṛhodbhavāḥ kumārā vā kumāryo yatidharmagāḥ | bhāgyavaśāt prayāntyeva vanāraṇyaguhādikam ||65|| nārikelaphale vāri pracchannamapi rohati | dīyamānamapi vāri kamale nādhirohati ||66|| tasmāt pūrvakṛtā yogā bhavanti narayoṣitām | tathā jātāḥ kanyakānāṃ tatra kā paridevanā ||67|| mayā sṛṣṭāḥ kanyakāstā badrīphalārthamutsukāḥ | svayaṃ yātrā dhṛtāstatra paraiḥ kā parivedanā ||68|| kanyakātvaṃ dhruvaṃ nāsti mātṛgṛhaṃ dhruva na ca | paragṛhaṃ sutarāṃ na tataḥ kā parivedanā ||69|| īkṣaṇaṃ na dhruvaṃ cāste parīkṣā na dhruvā tathā | parīkṣako dhruvo nāsti tataḥ kā parivedanā ||4.37.70|| yāhi vidvan kuṭīṃ naijāṃ mā mohaṃ yāhi tatkṛte | kariṣye kārayiṣye vā yogyaṃ matkanyakākṛte ||71|| ityevaṃ bodhito vipro mahāścaryaparo’bhavat | kanyakāvad bhrātaraśca mātāpi mohavarjitā ||72|| atha yāmi pitaraṃ vai kathayāmi niyojitam | vicāryetthaṃ śuṣkamanāḥ śokodgāraparāhataḥ ||73|| nistejā iva saṃbhūtvā kanyānāṃ janakaṃ yayau | pīṭayāmāsa hastābhyāṃ kapolau bhālagaṇḍakau ||74|| mumocāśrūṇi bahūni paraṃ śokaṃ tvadarśayat | āśvāsito dayāyuktaivākyairdhairyaṃ pradāpitaḥ ||75|| pitrā śanaiśca saṃpṛṣṭaḥ kāraṇaṃ prati bhūsuraḥ | uvāca hikkāsahitaḥ kampayan mastakaṃ nijam ||76|| aho duḥkhamaho kaṣṭamaho nyāyavivarjitam | mayā dṛṣṭaṃ nirghṛṇāḍhyaṃ kanyakānāṃ madantike ||77|| mamāśrame pañcabhiśca rakṣobhiḥ prabalairdrutam | kṛtaṃ tvapaharaṇaṃ vai nirbalānāṃ prasahya tu ||78|| rakṣaṇārthaṃ drutaṃ tāsāṃ samāgaccha vibhañjana | tvaṃ pitā rakṣakastāsāṃ śīghraṃ kuru mayā saha ||79|| vibhañjanābhidho rathyāmārjakaḥ prāha taṃ munim | svāgataṃ munirāṭ te’stu dhanyavādaṃ dadāmi te ||4.37.80|| vairāgyamārgavāsasya rāgaceṣṭāvidhāyinaḥ | tyaktakuṭumbayogasya parārthayogaśokinaḥ ||8 1|| vṛthā mohagatasyātra cātmārāmasya rogiṇaḥ | kiṃ te gataṃ kanyakānāṃ gamane rākṣasaiḥ saha ||82|| kanyāhastagrahāḥ sarve rākṣasā mānavā bhuvi | narahastagrahā nāryo rākṣasyastāstathā bhuvi ||83|| tyaktalajjādharmakarmāṇo ye te rākṣasā matāḥ | patnyaśca patayastadvannagnā vai rākṣasāḥ sadā ||84|| kuṇape snehavanto ye mūtragolakalubdhakāḥ | mitho yujyanta udvṛttāḥ pracchannā rākṣasāstu te ||85|| deho’yaṃ rākṣasaḥ proktaḥ paradehasya bhakṣakaḥ | mune saṃsāravelāto bahiścāsi prayāhi vai ||86|| svakhedaṃ kuru viprendra rākṣasatvavimuktaye | parakhedaparatve tu viśeṣo rākṣasāttu kaḥ ||87|| karmaṇā yogamāsādya viyogaṃ yānti karmabhiḥ | karmasambandhisaṃsāre kā te me parivedanā ||88|| pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa viprendra bhojanaṃ kuru bhāvataḥ | vāsaṃ vidhehi viśrāntiṃ śāntiṃ gṛhāṇa mā śucaḥ ||89|| sarvaṃ kālavaśaṃ loke jāyate copatiṣṭhati | kāle gate punastadvai viyujyate na tiṣṭhati ||4.37.90|| yathāyogyaṃ tu satkāraṃ labdhvā yāhi nijālayam | tyaktāhaṃmamatābhāve kathaṃ śokastvayi sthitaḥ ||91|| deho’yaṃ bhogya evāsti bhogasthānaṃ sadātmanaḥ | ātmā bhuṃkte nijaṃ matvā dehaṃ dehāntaraṃ ca vā ||92|| bhogo mohaḥ paraḥ prokto nirbhogo mohavarjitā | sukhaduḥkhaikasākṣātkārastu bhogo hi manyate ||93|| mune mā te’stu muktasya mā māṃ yojaya tatra ca | nirañjano’smi nā cāsmi mohabhañjanako’smi ca ||94|| kanyakānāṃ na me mohaste kathaṃ vartate tviha | alakṣye mohanaṃ te me vijñāpayati kṛtrimam ||95|| śokaṃ sandarśayase’tra yāhi yogin yathāgatam | vidhāsye rakṣaṇaṃ yogyaṃ svasti te me’stu sarvathā ||96|| ityuktvā bhañjanaḥ śūdro bhojanādi samārpayat | tāvat tāḥ kanyakāstatra pakvabadrīphalāni tu ||97|| saṃgṛhya tvāgatāstūrṇaṃ sarvāḥ prasannamānasāḥ | pṛṣṭāstā bhrātṛbhirmātrā pitrā tathānyamānavaiḥ ||98|| rākṣasopadrave tāstu śrutvā taṃ badrikāyanam | asatpralāpinaṃ jñātvā munidharmacyutaṃ tathā ||99|| asthānakṛtajijñāsaṃ śepurmūko bhavādhunā | ityukte mūkatāṃ sādhuravrajad vāgvidūṣaṇaiḥ || 4.37.1 00|| prārthayāmāsa manasā nirmohikanyakāstathā | mātaraṃ pitaraṃ bhrātṝnarthayāmāsa bhāṣaṇam || 101 || dayāparā dharmadhartryaḥ kṛṣṇakāntaparāyaṇāḥ | kuṭumbinaḥ samastāste cakrurnirmūkatāṃ muneḥ || 102|| munirviveda sarveṣāṃ nirmohitvaṃ mahattamam | jijñāsāyāḥ svayaṃ mohaṃ tyaktvā natvā punaḥ punaḥ || 1 03|| mānaṃ hitvā yayau pūjāṃ prāpya daṇḍabhayād drutam | evaṃ badraupriye devi kanyakā bhrātaraḥ pitā || 1 04|| mātā ca mohaśūnyāste’bhavan kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ | nirañjanaśca nirvāṇo nirmoho’pi nirīhakaḥ || 1 05|| nirāśayaśca te pañca bhrātaro nāmataḥ smṛtāḥ | niḥsvarūpā nirabhidhā nirantarā nirāgasā || 1 06|| nijānandā ca pañcaitāḥ putrikā nāmatastu tāḥ | sarve’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ || 1 07|| janmajayantyutsave caikonaviṃśe yayustataḥ | prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prabhuṃ labdhvā pūrṇāśāḥ pūrṇakāmanāḥ || 1 08|| babhūvurdivyarūpāśca śrīkṛṣṇasya prasādataḥ || hariṃ prapūjya bhāvena cāvatārya nijāntare || 109|| āgatena vimānena cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe | bālakṛṣṇecchayā tūrṇaṃ yayuścākṣaramuttamam || 4.37.110 || evaṃ badrīpriye devi kārelikākuṭumbinaḥ | bālakṛṣṇasya vai bhaktyā badrikāyanayogataḥ || 111 || divyabhāvaṃ samavāpya nirmohatāṃ pragamya ca | paraṃ mokṣaṃ yayuḥ sarve kṛṣṇakāntasya bhaktitaḥ || 1 12|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya mananācchravaṇādapi | bhuktimuktyau bhavetāṃ vai kṛṣṇakāntakṛpālavāt || 1 13|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kārelikāśūdrāṇyā mārjayitryā nirmohitvaparīkṣāyāṃ badrikāyanarṣermūkatvaṃ, śāpanivṛttiḥ, pañcakanyakānāṃ pañcaputrāṇāṃ patyuśca mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 37 ||
<4.38> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi yantrakartryāḥ kathāṃ tathā | kṛṣṇānāmnīnadītīre dvijavāṭītipattane || 1 || yantrakartrī satī nārī kuṭumbinī purābhavat | patiputravatī putrīsuhṛdbandhumatī tathā || 2 || dhanadhānyavatī sampatprapūritasumandirā | harau bhaktimatī dharme niṣṭhāvatī suyoginī || 3 || sarvasaubhāgyasampannā satāṃ sevāparāyaṇā | hiṃsādivarjitā śīladharmāḍhyā satyamāśritā || 4 || devārhaṇaparātithisatkārādipramodinī | ātmasādhanasaṃraktā māyāmāyikanispṛhā || 5 || bhajate bhagavantaṃ sā śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamam | kṛṣṇāyāṃ pratyahaṃ prātaḥ snātvā devārhaṇaṃ śubham || 6 || kṛtvā vṛddhānnamaskṛtya patiṃ sampūjya bhāvataḥ | patyuḥ pādajalaṃ dhṛtvā mukhe śirasi varṣmaṇi || 7 || devaprasādatulasīpatraṃ nyasya mukhe tataḥ | putrādyarthaṃ payaḥpānaṃ sampādayati bhāminī || 8 || nāmnā tu gomatīdevī gavāṃ sevāparāyaṇā | patistasyā nayarājābhidhaḥ paramavaiṣṇavaḥ || 9 || putrāḥ putryo bāndhavādyāḥ sarve’pi vaiṣṇavottamāḥ | bhajante paramātmānaṃ sevante sādhumaṇḍalam || 4.38.10|| vihāya bandhanīṃ māyāṃ kurvanti tvātmanā hitam | vartante dharmakāryeṣu nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ || 11 || kintu te jīvikārthaṃ vai lohayantrāṇi yānyapi | ikṣurasopayuktāni tailaniṣkāsanāni ca || 12|| evaṃvidhāni tvanyāni racayanti sma vṛttitaḥ | teṣāṃ krayeṇa labdhaṃ yaddhanaṃ tena tu jīvikām || 13|| nirvahantyeva te sarve mahābhāgavatā janāḥ | loharasadravārthaṃ te bhrāṣṭrīṃ kurvanti vai yadā || 14|| jīvāstatrāpi dahyanti pātakaṃ tat prajāyate | yantrairikṣusamūhāśca pīḍyante rasalabdhayai || 15|| tatrekṣudaṇḍakīṭādyāḥ pīḍyante rasamiśritāḥ | tilānāṃ pīḍane bhūmiphalīnāṃ pīḍanādiṣu || 16|| jantavo’pi prapīḍyante kārpāsayantrake’pi ca | mriyante’saṃkhyakīṭādyāstatpāpaṃ hiṃsanātmakam || 17|| pīḍakānāṃ yantravāhakānāṃ kaṇapradāyinām | yantraracanākartṝṇāṃ yantrāṇāṃ svāmināṃ tathā ||18|| bhṛtyānāṃ jāyate hiṃsā tathaiva karmacāriṇām | evaṃ yantrakṛtāṃ badri pāpabhāgaḥ prajāyate || 1 9|| tena pāpena lipyante nirayān yānti dāruṇān | mahābhāgavatāścaite jātikarmaparāyaṇāḥ ||4.38.20|| api puṇyamayāḥ sarve tathāpi pāpabhāginaḥ | asaṃkhyānāṃ tu kīṭānāṃ hiṃsanaṃ nityadā bhavet ||21 || yantreṣu yantrakartṝṇāṃ pāpaṃ tvasaṃkhyakaṃ sadā | āyātyeva tatasteṣāṃ muktistu sārgalā bhavet || 29| ātatāyimahāpāpaṃ sarvanāśakaraṃ matam | yantrakārā yantrapāpairlipyante tvātatāyivat |||23|| pāpairvaṃśavināśaśca smṛddhināśo’pi jāyate | pretā bhavanti mṛtvā te bāndhavān pīḍayantyapi ||24|| evaṃ badrīpriye yantrakārāṇāṃ kālaparyaye | nayarājaprabhṛtīnāṃ kuṭumbe rājayakṣmakaḥ ||25|| vāsaṃ cakāra rogo’yaṃ kṣīṇatāmanayajjanān | gomatī tu vicāryetthaṃ bhaktānāṃ rugṇatā katham || 26|| kathaṃ vā bhagavadbhaktau kṣayavāsaḥ pravartate | ābālavṛddhayoṣādyāḥ kathaṃ rogābhisaṃplutāḥ || 27|| praṣṭavyaṃ vedaviduṣe bhāgyajñāya tu sarvathā | vicāryetthaṃ yayau vipraṃ nāmnā prabhātabodhinam ||28|| papraccha taṃ tadā devī gomatī rogakāraṇam | praśnakālaṃ vīkṣya vipro jagāda yantrajaṃ phalam ||29|| yantrajā jīvahiṃsā yā sāpi kartari bhāgataḥ | saṃkramate tathā nirmātari yojayitaryapi ||4.38.3 0|| vāhayitari patyau ca svāminī kriyayānvite | nirīkṣake saṃkramate tathā sañcālake’pi ca ||31|| gomati tvatkuṭumbaṃ vai yantranirmāṇakartṛ yat | tataḥ pāpaṃ tu kīṭādihiṃsāyāḥ kramate sadā || 32|| nistāro’sya prakartavyo’nyathā vaṃśavināśanam | bhaviṣyati na sandeho yatheṣṭaṃ kuru bhāminī ||33|| śrutvā sā badrike prāha vipraṃ prabhātabodhinam | prāyaścittaṃ dehi no’tra nistāro yena jāyate ||34|| prabhātabodhastāṃ prāha prathamaṃ tvagharodhanam | prāyaścittaṃ tato dattaṃ phalaṃ karoti nānyathā ||35 || yantrāṇāṃ racanāṃ tyaktvā loṣṭhādīnāṃ tu vikrayam | krayaṃ vā prāṇayātrārthaṃ khanikhātaṃ karotvapi ||36 || ato yantranirmitestu pāpabhāgo hi ruddhyate | navaṃ pāpaṃ jāyate na jātasya niṣkṛtiṃ kuru ||37|| kuṭumbena sahitā tva tīrthayātrāṃ vidhehi vai | godāvarīṃ narmadāṃ ca tāpīṃ sābhramatīṃ tathā ||38|| śatruñjayāṃ ca hariṇīṃ bhadrāṃ ca gomatīṃ tataḥ | svarṇalekhāṃ ca kuṃkumavāpīmaśvasarovaram ||39|| puṣkaraṃ sārasaṃ tīrthaṃ yamīṃ gaṃgāṃ ca pāvanīm | sarayūṃ gaṇḍakīṃ brahmaputrāṃ tathendradyumnakam ||4.38.40|| tāmraparṇīṃ ca kāverīṃ pampāsaraśca sāgaram | kṛtvā krameṇa tīrthāni niṣpāpā bhava bhāminī ||41|| pāpakṣayo roganāśo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | śrutvā tu gomatīdevī vicāramakarottadā ||42|| roṃgiṇāṃ śakyamevaitannāsti tīrthapravāsanam | durlabhaṃ bhramaṇaṃ dīrghaṃ cirakālābhinirvaham ||43|| tasmādanyat pāpanāśakaraṃ darśaya buddhimat | yasminnanuṣṭhite sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhavedapi ||44|| prāyaścittaṃ prajāyeta rājayakṣmavināśanam | sukhaṃ bhavet kuṭumbasya śrīnāśo na bhavedapi ||45|| śrutvā vipro’tisaralāṃ bhūyaḥphalāṃ tu niṣkṛtim | jagāda tatra vai yogyāṃ satāṃ sevāṃ mahauṣadhim ||46|| gomati tvaṃ yathāśaktā yathā vikṛtitatparā | yathāsi vaiṣṇavī tadvad darśayāmi tu niṣkṛtim ||47|| adyārabhya tu satataṃ karotu sādhusevanam | sakuṭumbā bhāvayuktā sasnehā saṃśayojjhitā ||48|| divyabuddhyā divyadṛṣṭyā divyasevā tu yāvatīm | prakarotu yathā santaḥ prasannāḥ syustavopari ||49|| dehena manasā vācā karmaṇā cendriyairapi | sampadā dhanaratnādyairannavastrārpaṇairapi ||4.38.50|| śayyārpaṇopakaraṇairdāsīvad dāsavattathā | prakāśe vā rahaścāpi pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ ||51|| putrībhiśca sutaiścāpi bālairvṛddhaiḥ kuṭumbibhiḥ | vadhūbhirgṛhadānaiśca gobhiḥ svātmārpaṇairapi ||52|| sevāṃ satāṃ prakurvantu sādhvīnāmapi sarvathā | ātmanivedanādyaiśca sādhusevā hi bheṣajam ||53 || sevayā cānuvṛttyā ca nirāvaraṇayānvaham | kṛtayā niḥsaṃśayayā prasīdanti hi sādhavaḥ ||54|| prasādapreritā āśīrvādān dadati sādhavaḥ | dhanavān putravānārogyavān sampatsamedhitaḥ ||55|| sukhavān modavān sarvotsavavān bhava sarvadā | vighnā yāntu tava dūraṃ śatravo yantu saṃkṣayam ||56|| pāpānāṃ pralayaste’stu puṇyādriste bhavatvapi | śrīrvarcasv mahāpuṇyamādhivyādhivināśanam ||57|| iṣṭānāṃ saṅgamaścāpyaniṣṭānāṃ saṃkṣayo’stu te | satāṃ sevāphalaṃ divyaṃ sukhaṃ cātra paratra ca ||||58|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe bhaktiśca śāśvatī | sarvanāthe prabhaukṛṣṇe cātmaniveditāstu te ||59|| gṛhe te sādhavaḥ santu vāṭikāyāṃ ca sādhavaḥ | santaste hṛdaye santu jīvātmanyapi sādhavaḥ ||4.38.60|| dehendriyeṣu santaste pṛṣṭho’gre santu sādhavaḥ | adho vordhve pārśvabhāge sadā te santu sādhavaḥ ||61|| jāgradbhāve prasvapane suṣuptau santu sādhavaḥ | yāne pravāsane vāse cāsane śayane sthitau ||62|| jṛṃbhaṇe kṣuvane pramodane ca modane’pi ca | kriyāyāṃ krīḍane śoke sahagāḥ santu sādhavaḥ ||63|| sahāyā rakṣakāḥ santo bāndhavāḥ santu cānvitāḥ | yāmyaduḥkhaharāḥ santo daivaduḥkhaharāstathā ||64|| karmanāśakarāḥ santaḥ santu te sukhakāriṇaḥ | ādhibhautikapīḍānāṃ nāśakāḥ santu sādhavaḥ ||65|| prāṇānāṃ rakṣakāḥ santu santaste bhagavatparāḥ | iha yātrākarāḥ santaḥ parayātrākarā api ||66|| mahāyātrākarāḥ santaḥ santu te sarvato’nvitāḥ | evaṃ dvādaśasaṃślokaṃ stotraṃ dāsyanti sādhavaḥ ||67|| yatpāṭhena tathā sevābhiśca rakṣā bhaviṣyati | śīghramadyasamāramya sādhuśālāṃ suśobhanām ||68|| mandiraṃ śrībālakṛṣṇamūrteḥ prakārayatvapi | mā ciraṃ tena vighnāste vinaṃkṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||69|| yadyapi tvaṃ mahābhaktā kuṭumbaṃ te ca bhaktimat | tathāpi sāghusevābhiḥ sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati ||4.38.70|| yannendro naiva rudro’pi na yamo na ca viśvasṛṭ | na viṣṇurnaiva kālo’pi na dharmo na vrataṃ tapaḥ ||71 || naiva nārāyaṇaścāpi kartuṃ śaknoti durvaham | tatkartuṃ śaknuvantyeva kṛṣṇādhikā hi sādhavaḥ ||72|| sādhusaṃkalpitaṃ sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ paramātmanaḥ | kṛṣṇasaṃkalpitaṃ yanna tat syāt sādhuprakalpitam ||73|| sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ puṇyaṃ sādhusaṅgo hi puṇyadaḥ | sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyādrayo hi sādhavaḥ ||74|| ānakhādāśikhaṃ santaḥ pāvanā divyavigrahāḥ | rajo rajo’ṇumātraṃ vai pāvanaṃ sādhuvigrahe ||75|| atha patyau yathā patnyāṃ yathā putre dhane’pi ca | yathā vadhvāṃ yathā pitroryathā gurau harau yathā ||76|| tathā snehaḥ sadā kāryaḥ satsu sādhvīṣu bhāvataḥ | śraddhayā sevanaṃ kāryaṃ sarvārthasādhakaṃ tu tat| ||77|| bhojanīyāḥ pūjanīyāstarpaṇīyā hi sādhavaḥ | modanīyāḥ sevanīyāḥ prasādanīyāḥ sādhavaḥ ||78|| mānanīyā rakṣaṇīyāstoṣaṇīyā hi sādhavaḥ | darśanīyāḥ sparśanīyā namanīyā hi sādhavaḥ ||79|| cayanīyā dhāraṇīyā dhyātavyāḥ sādhavaḥ sadā | sādhūnāṃ tviha satsaṃgāt svargaṃ mokṣaśca śāśvataḥ ||4.38.80|| sādhavaḥ suprasannāśca cintāmaṇaya eva te | kalpadrumā akṣayabhājanāni sādhavaḥ sadā ||81|| kāmagāvaḥ sādhavo vai kṛṣṇarūpā hi sādhavaḥ | teṣāṃ samāgamo mokṣaḥ satsaṃgo bhavapārakṛt ||82|| taṃ samācara yatsaṃgaṃ roganāśaṃ prayāhi ca | svasti te’stu nīrugṇatvaṃ dīrghāyuṣṭvaṃ ca te’stvapi ||83|| ityuktā badrike devīgomatī vipramuttamam | prapūjya svagṛhaṃ gatvā śrāvayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ ||84|| patiṃ pumān kuṭumbaṃ ca tataḥ sarve samāhitāḥ | gṛhamekaṃ sādhuśālātmakaṃ pṛthak pracakrire ||85|| tatra santaḥ samāyānti tān sevante’tibhāvataḥ | gomatyādyā annavastradhanārpaṇopavastubhiḥ ||86|| nārāyaṇasvarūpān vai sādhūn matvā prapāvanān | sevante sma kuṭumbādyā yathoktabhāvakarmabhiḥ ||87|| athāśīrvādamālabdhvā satāṃ te pāvanāstathā | prabhavanti śanai rogavināśārambharohitāḥ ||88|| satāṃ hṛdaye bhagavānanādinidhanaḥ prabhuḥ | jñātvā sevāṃ paraṃ bhāvaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||89|| kṛṣṇāyanābhidhānaḥ sa sādhurbhūtvā tathā śriyam | sādhvīṃ kṛtvā yayau tasyā nagaraṃ ca gṛhaṃ tataḥ ||4.38.90|| sādhuśālāsthale gatvā gomatyādibhirādṛtaḥ | kṛṣṇāyanaḥ kṛtapūjāsvāgataḥ samuvāsa ha ||9 1|| tayoḥ sevā bahudhā vai kuṭumbena kṛtā tadā | dhanaiścitrairvarṣmabhiśca bhojanādyaiḥ samarcanaiḥ ||92|| yathā yathā hariścaicchat tathā tathā dadustu te | prasanno bhagavān jātaḥ sevayā narayoṣitām ||93|| śayane bhojane yāne sarvathā sevitaḥ prabhuḥ | varadānāya tāṃ nārīṃ prairayat sāpi tatkṣaṇam ||94|| nirogārthaṃ sampadarthaṃ mokṣārthaṃ samayācata | satāṃ sevārthamevāpi hareryogārthamityapi ||95|| hariḥ prāha tathāstvevaṃ sarvaṃ te samprajāyatām | hareḥ pādāṅguṣṭhavāri pītvā sarve hi pāvanāḥ ||96|| tadā jātā atha rogo rājayakṣmā tu mūrtimān | nirgataḥ sahasā śrīmadbālakṛṣṇājñayā drutam ||97|| natvā yayau sa kailāsaṃ kuṭumbaṃ rogavarjitam | jātaṃ praphullahṛdayaṃ modānanaṃ śubhāśrayam ||98|| atha kṛṣṇāyanaḥ kṛṣṇastebhyo mantraṃ dadau nijam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||99|| mūrtiṃ nijāṃ dadau kārṣṇāyanīkṛṣṇāyanātmikām| darśanaṃ pradadau divyaṃ caturbhujaṃ narāyaṇam || 4.38.100|| vīkṣya śrīkāntadeveśaṃ paramātmānamacyutam | prasannāste kṛtakṛtyā jātā gomatikājanāḥ || 101 || niṣpāpāḥ puṇyapuñjāste divyā mokṣābhiyoginaḥ | sarve nemuḥ pupūjuśca hareḥ pādajalaṃ papuḥ || 1 02|| prasādaṃ bhakṣayāmāsurarcayāmāsuracyutam | śriyāḥ sādhvyaḥ kanyakādyāḥ sarvāḥ striyo’rhaṇāṃ vyadhuḥ || 103|| evaṃ badrīpriye teṣāṃ nīrogitvaṃ vidhāya saḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo drutaṃ tiro’bhavat || 1 04|| atha te’pi ca saṃbhūya tīrthārthaṃ nirgatāstataḥ | viṃśe’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇajayantikotsave || 1 05|| āyayustīrthayātrāyāmaśvapaṭṭasarovaram | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ lomaśasyāśrayaṃ śubham ||1 06|| snātvā tīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇavallabham priyam | kṛṣṇāyanaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ vīkṣya prapūjya mādhavam || 1 07|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prasevya bhāvataḥ | nyūṣustatraivākṣarākhye kṣetre tvājīvanaṃ tataḥ || 108|| hareḥ padāśraye sarve yantrakārā haripriyāḥ | divyadehā abhavaṃśca jīvanmuktāḥ prabhupriyāḥ ||1 09|| harikṛṣṇasya vacane sthitāḥ sarve sadā tataḥ | haryājñayā yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ vimānasaṃsthitāḥ || 4.38.11 0|| sarve satāṃ vimānairvai prāpuḥ kṛṣṇaparāspadam | ityevaṃ badrike devi bhagavām̐stānatārayat || 11 1|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya cintanāt pāpanāśanam | svargaṃ mokṣo bhavedeva prabhukṛṣṇabalād drutam || 1 12|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne yantrakartryā gomatīnāmnyā śūdrāyāḥ sakuṭumbāyāḥ kṣayarogaḥ satāṃ sevayā sādhurūpeṇa bhagavatprāptyā roganāśo mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 38 ||
<4.39> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ dhūrtāvimokṣiṇīm | dhutārapuravāstavyā cāmaṭhājātijā hyapi || 1 || nārāyaṇaparā nārī nāmnābhūt kanakāṃgadā | patiputravatī putrīmatī bhrātṛkuṭumbinī || 2 || nagarābhyāśavāsā ca śakaṭacchāyavartinī | vṛṣabhāṇāṃ ca vatsānāṃ krayavikrayakāriṇī || 3 || jīrṇopakaraṇānāṃ ca saṃskāroddhāratatparā | krayavikrayakāryāḍhyā tathā nirvāhayoginī || 4 || harerbhaktāpi vai jātisvabhāvā dhūrtatānvitā | anṛtakapaṭāsatyaśāṭhyādyuktā hi vartate || 5 || vāṇyāṃ kriyāyāṃ manasi pratāraṇaparāyaṇā | yathākathañcid vyāmohya pradarśyāpi phalaṃ bahu || 6 || viśvāsaṃ bahudhotpādya karoti vañcanāṃ tataḥ | labdhaṃ vañcanayā yattaddhanaṃ raupyaṃ ca kāñcanam || 7 || śīghraṃ nītvā prayātyeva grāmāntaramanoyutā | anasā saumabhāgeṣu kṣetreṣu vāṭikāsvapi || 8 || annānāṃ haraṇaṃ cauryaṃ karoti karmasandhinī | evaṃvidhāpi mārgeṣu catuḥsaṃgeṣu vai niśi || 9 || śakaṭacchāyayā kālaṃ niryāpayati sīmani | tatra kaścit samāyācced bhikṣuko bhikṣukī tu vā || 4.39.1 0|| tasmai datvā yathāyogyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhuṃkte tatastu sā | evamabhyāgataparā bhikṣuke kṛṣṇamāninī || 1 1|| nārāyaṇaṃ bhikṣukaṃ tu matvārhaṇāṃ karotyapi | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ rātrau divā dehaprasevanam ||12|| jalapuṣpādyarpaṇaṃ ca kṛtvā bhuṃkte tataḥ param | evaṃ sevāparā cāste niyame bhikṣukārcane || 1 3|| vartamānā bhikṣukāya nirdaṃbhā dhūrtatāṃ nijām | nivedayati vijñā sā niṣpāpatvāya sarvathā ||14|| sā tu jānāti guruto nāmnā cārvaṃkarādhanāt | sādhave nijakṛtyaṃ vai nivedanīyamādarāt ||15|| satyaṃ vācyaṃ yacca tacca guhyaṃ vāpi prakāśajam | anyāyyaṃ vā nyāyayuktaṃ pāpaṃ puṇyaṃ pratāraṇām ||16|| dhūrtatā śubhatā cāpyaniṣṭatā kleśatā tathā | cauryaṃ cāpaharaṇaṃ ca vācyaṃ śrīgurave sadā || 17|| garhitaṃ vā praśastaṃ vā vācyaṃ cāvācyamityapi | sarvaṃ śrīgurave nivedanīyaṃ śuddhihetave ||18|| ityevaṃ jāyate karturniṣpāpatvaṃ pavitratā | bandhanaṃ jāyate naiva pāpaphalaṃ na jāyate ||1 9|| upārjitāt tathā nyāyānyāyābhyāmapi sarvadā | dātavyaṃ gurave cābhyāgatāya bhikṣukāya ca ||4.39.20|| nirdoṣatvaṃ jāyate ca tena pāpaṃ vyapohati | aniveditabhoktaiva pāpena parilipyate ||21 || niveditānnabhoktā tu pāpena nopalipyate | udarārthaṃ kuṭumbārthaṃ dasyūnāṃ dasyukarmasu ||22|| dūṣaṇaṃ jāyate naiva jātaṃ ced gurave’rpaṇāt | nirdoṣaṃ jāyate tasmād guruḥ sevyaḥ pramokṣadaḥ ||23|| gurureva parabrahma gurureva janārdanaḥ | gurureva vidhātā ca gurureva parāgatiḥ ||24|| gururevānalaḥ sūryo gurureva prakāśadaḥ | gurureva paraṃ puṇyaṃ gururdharmaḥ sukhaṃ dhanam ||25|| guruḥ svargaṃ gururviṣṇurguruḥ śaṃbhurgururvratam | gurvarpaṇaṃ paraṃ puṇyaṃ tasmācchrīgurave’rpayet ||26|| anyatra vai kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ gurvegre saṃvinaśyati | gurau pāpaṃ na kartavyaṃ gururvai paramā gatiḥ ||27|| na vai nārāyaṇo bhūmau śaṅkhadhārī milatyapi | gururnārāyaṇaḥ satyadhārī milati bhūtale ||28|| satāṃ samāgamāt tena niṣpāpatā prajāyate | santaḥ śrīguravastasmāt sevanīyā viśuddhaye ||29|| aśuddhaḥ khaluḥ saṃsāraḥ śuddhastatra gururhariḥ | aśuddhirlīyate sarvā guroryogena daihikī ||4.39.30|| mānasī līyate cāpyaśuddhirbhaktyā guroḥ sadā | gurornāmasmaraṇena cātmā pāvanatāṃ vrajet ||3 1 || gurave tvarpaṇāt sarvavastūnāṃ syāt pavitratā | narā nāryaḥ praśuddhyanti guruyogena bhūtale ||32|| gurormūrtirharermūtiḥ pāvanī pāpināmiha | tasmāt satsaṃgatiḥ kāryā pāpibhiḥ pāpahānaye ||33|| evaṃvidhaṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ gurutaḥ sā hyavāpa tu | tena sādhujanasevāṃ karoti daṃbhavarjitā ||34|| samastaṃ tatkuṭumbaṃ vai satāṃ karoti sevanam | cārvaṃkarādhanaḥ sādhurdadau tasyai manuṃ hareḥ ||35|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | dadau mūrtiṃ dadau jñānaṃ gurusevātmakaṃ tathā ||36|| evaṃ gurvājñayā nityaṃ vartate kanakāṃgadā | gurusevāparā śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaparānvaham ||37|| dhūrtatāpāpanāśārthaṃ sevate śrīhariṃ gurum | bhāvena nityamevaiṣā kṣudhāṃ tṛṣā ca sevate ||38|| akṛtvā sā guroḥ pūjāṃ cānivedyānnamityapi | vāri puṣpaṃ phalaṃ śākaṃ na bhuṃkte sā kvacit khalu ||39|| evaṃ niyamamāsādya vartate gurutatparā | athaikadā tu saptāhaṃ gururvanāntaraṃ yayau ||4.39.40|| abhyāgataśca vā sādhuḥ kaścid gṛhaṃ ca nāgataḥ | hariṃ prapūjya sā sādhvī vāṭaṃ paśyati cotsukā ||41 || kṣudhinā tṛṣitā rātrindivaṃ paśyati vāṭinam | saptāhaṃ nāgataḥ sādhurabhyāgato’pi nāgataḥ ||42|| adattvā sādhave sādhvī na bhuṃkte’nnaṃ prasādajam | anyānyasya tu kā vārtā badrike dṛḍhabhaktigā ||43|| nāpi papau ca sā vāri tvanivedya hi sādhave | tadānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrī kṛṣṇagopajaḥ ||44|| antaryāmī sarvavijñaḥ sādhurbhūtvā samāyayau | dhṛtakāṣāyavasano dhṛtakanthākamaṇḍaluḥ ||45|| dhṛtapāvaṭikākukṣirdhṛtabhasmādijolikaḥ | nārāyaṇahare viṣṇo kṛṣṇaśrībhagavāniti ||46|| raṭannuccairvadad śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo jayatyapi | hare kṛṣṇa prabhokṛṣṇa padmāvatīpate prabho ||47|| dharminiyamirakṣaka tvaṃ bhakṣarakṣakaraprabho | evaṃ nārāyaṇakṛṣṇaṃ japan śakaṭīmāyayau ||48|| āsanaṃ pāvaṭīṃ jolīṃ nyasya bhūmau hare hare | kathayitvā niṣasāda jayo bhavatu cakriṇaḥ ||49|| sukhinī syāḥ kānakāṃgi cārvaṃkarādhano’pi ca | sukhinaste kuṭumbaṃ ca putrāḥ putryo bhavantvapi ||4.39.50|| ityevaṃ samacittaśca hyāśīrvādaparāyaṇaḥ | sādhurayaṃ daivayogādāgato madgṛhaṃ tviti ||51 || matvotthāya druta sādhvī kanakāṃgī śubhāsanam | dadau natvā jalaṃ śuddhaṃ dadau phalāni vai tadā ||52|| annaṃ navaṃ dadau tasmai pavanaṃ vyajanena ca | puṣpāṇi tulasīpatrāṇyapi dadau tu bhāvataḥ ||53|| bhojanaṃ kuru sādho tvaṃ madhuparkaṃ gṛhāṇa ca | snānamācamanaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ vāri gṛhāṇa ca ||54|| āśīrvādaṃ dehi sādho pāpaṃ me nāśamāpnuyāt | mama bhāgyavaśāt prāpto nārāyaṇasvarūpavān ||55|| vāsaṃ gṛhe mama sādho kuru sevāṃ gṛhāṇa ca | oṃ namo’nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya sādhave |||56|| yogine sarvavijñāya bhaktarakṣākarāya ca | adhamoddhāraṇakartre dīnānāthadayālaye ||57|| namaḥ sādhusvarūpāya bālakṛṣṇāya te namaḥ | kaṃbharānandabālāya gopālabālakāya te |||68|| namo rādhāvihārāya kamalāpataye namaḥ | namo’ntaryāmiṇe bhaktabhāvukāya sate namaḥ ||99|| antarātmā paramātmā prasanno bhava sarvadā | sādhusevā tava sevā nārāyaṇa gṛhāṇa tām ||4.39.60|| ityevaṃ bhāvabhinnā sā dadau tat kanakāṃgadā | putrāḥ putryaḥ samastāstā daduryatheṣṭavastukam ||61 || cārvaṃkarādhanaścāpi sādhusevāṃ tadākarot | miṣṭavāṇyā caraṇayoḥ saṃvāhanaṃ vyadhānmudā ||62|| evaṃ sarvaṃ kuṭumbaṃ vai cāmaṭhājātijaṃ tadā | sevāparāyaṇaṃ jātaṃ saptāhānaśanānvitam ||63|| sādhuṃ saṃbhojayitvaiva pāyayitvā jalaṃ tathā | sevayitvā yathāyogyamājñayā ca tataḥ param ||64|| prasādānnaṃ jalaṃ sarve jagṛhurbhāvataḥ khalu | śayane cāpi sarve te cakruḥ sādhoḥ prasevanam ||65|| āprātaḥ sevanaṃ cakruḥ pādasaṃvāhanādikam | prātaḥ sādhustataḥ prāha vara vṛṇuta cāmaṭhāḥ ||66|| prasanno’smi niyamena bhaktyā satāṃ prasevayā | bhābenāhaṃ prasanno’smi gaṇayāmi na dūṣaṇam ||67|| mahāpāpātipāpāni śāṭhyāni vividhānyapi | pratāraṇāni sarvāṇi nāśayāmi kṛpāvaśaḥ ||68|| dhūrtatāṃ sarvathā cāpi viśvāsaghātanaṃ hyapi | cauryapāpaṃ tathā dravyāpaharaṇodbhavaṃ tvagham ||69|| sarvaṃ prasannabhāvo’haṃ nāśayāmi kṛpāvaśaḥ | uktvetthaṃ sādhurūpo’pi mūrtirūpo’bhavat kṣaṇam ||4.39.70|| nārāyaṇasvarūpaśca caturbhujo’bhavat kṣaṇam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkāntavallabhaḥ |||71||| śrīpriyāmādhavīrādhāmāṇikīlalitāpatiḥ | abhavattūrṇamevāsau sarvadivyavibhūṣaṇaḥ |||72|| divyatejo’bhisaṃvyāpto divyasaundaryabhājanaḥ | atha tūrṇaṃ sampradarśya rūpaṃ divyamanoharam ||73|| tiro’bhavattato mūrtau tataḥ sādhusvarūpavān | vyadṛśyata svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kṛpāvaśaḥ ||74|| atha sarve kṣaṇaṃ mugdhā niṣpāpā divyadṛṣṭayaḥ | jātā bhaktivaśāḥ kṛṣṇavaśā gadgadasusvarāḥ ||75|| bhavapāraṃ samastāste hyayācan duḥkhanāśanam | śrīhareḥ śaraṇaṃ muktimayācan tvakṣare pade ||76|| dhūtapāpāni sarvāṇi kṣamāpayeti cārthayan | pāpajāteḥ samuddhāraṃ kuru kṛṣṇeti cārthayan ||77|| atha badrīpriye svāmī svayaṃ śrīharivallabhaḥ | pādajalaṃ pāyayitvā divyadehān vyadhāddhi tān |||78||| vimānaṃ tvāgataṃ tatra divyaṃ vaikuṇṭhavāsinām | pārṣadānāṃ tatra sarve’dhyarohan pramudānvitāḥ ||79|| yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ te vai prāpya vaikuṇṭhamuttamam | śrīhareḥ pādavāsaṃ te prāpurbhaktyātibhāvayā ||4.39.8 0|| sādhurūpo haristatra tūrṇaṃ tirobhavat kṣaṇāt | evaṃ śrībadrike bhaktā kanakāṃgī tu cāmaṭhī ||8 1 || sakuṭumbā yayau mokṣaṃ dhūrtāpi bhaktipāvanā | śravaṇātpaṭhanādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavettathā |||82|| pāpanāśo bhaveccāpi svargarddhiḥ saṃbhavedapi | sādhusevāphalaṃ sākṣāt kṛṣṇaprāptirbhavedapi ||83|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne cāmaṭhījātīyāyāḥ kanakāṃgadāyāḥ sakuṭumbāyāḥ sādhusamāgamena paramabhaktyā sādhurūpeṇa bhagavatprāptimokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 39 ||
<4.40> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tathaiva pāvanīṃ kathām | dyūtakārastriyā nāmnā bhāṇavāṇītiyoṣitaḥ || 1 || sindhunadyāstaṭe ramye śarkarāpattane purā | dyūtajñavaṃśajā lokā nyavasan vai narāḥ striyaḥ || 2 || dyūtaṃ jānanti bahudhā śaṃkāranagare tathā | dyūte prāyo vijayaṃ vai striyo yānti na saṃśaya || 3 || evaṃvidhāḥ prajāḥ sindhe deśe dyūtaparāyaṇāḥ | rājāpi rājalokāśca rājabhṛtyāstathāvidhāḥ || 4 || āsan dyūtakalāvijñāḥ prajāśca prāyaśastathā | nirdhanā dhanavantaśca dyūte sīdanti vai muhuḥ || 5 || rājā sindhupradeśānāṃ nāmnā rāyaharīti vai | dyūtotsavān prativarṣaṃ karotyāmantritairnṛpaiḥ || 6 || āyānti dyūtavijñāśca nṛpā rāṣṭrāntarodbhavāḥ | dīvyanti bahuratnādyairharanti hārayantyapi || 7 || jayanti pracuraṃ lābhaṃ rājyaṃ tadāpnuvanti ca | arāṣṭrāśca prajāyante rāṣṭrādhipāstadā nṛpāḥ || 8 || viparītāśca jāyante dyūtakarmābhibhūtinaḥ | dyūtajñeṣu tadā kāle bhāṇavāṇītibhāminī || 9 || prasiddhābhūjjaye dhrauvye yatrasthā tatra vai jayaḥ | yasyārthe sā pratinidhirbhūtvā dyūte niṣīdati || 4.40.1 0|| tasya jayo bhavatyeva pāśaiḥ samanukūlagaiḥ | bahūnāṃ dyūtasamaye karoti dhanahīnatām || 11 || śarkarānagareśastāṃ bhāṇavāṇīṃ rarakṣa ha | nijālaye sadā dyūtadevanārthaṃ tu mānavaḥ || 12| saudhabhojanapānādyairvastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ | udyānayānavāhādyairdāsadāsībhirādṛtām || 1 3|| rājñīmiva nṛpo nityaṃ manyate tāṃ kṛtādarām | jātyā ca kṣatriyāṃ nimnakṣatragṛhodbhavāmapi || 14|| sājātyena ca lābhena rājñīmiva sa manyate | sāpi mānaṃ vihāyaiva dāsīva nṛpatiṃ prati || 15|| prati rājñīṃ kiṃkarīva vartate guṇaśālinī | ataḥ prasādapātraṃ sā rājñyā rājñaśca bhāminī || 16|| rājaśayyāṃ sevate’pi patiputrādimatyapi | rāyaharirnṛpastasyā guṇaṃ lābhaṃ vicārya ca || 17|| svīyāṃ matvā sevate’pi bhujiṣyāmuttamāmiva | evaṃ rājāśrayaṃ prāpyaidhitā kīrtyā ca sampadā || 18|| sakuṭumbā nṛpasaudhe tato vāsaṃ vyadhānmudā | rājyalābhaṃ pragṛhṇāti bhuṃkte sukhaṃ navaṃ navam || 19|| athaikadā rāyaharirnṛpaḥ śrīśarkarādhipaḥ | āhvayāmāsa rājānaṃ hayodarādhipaṃ śubham ||4.40.20 || koṭirāyābhidhaṃ dyūte devanārthaṃ nijālaye | koṭirāyo’pi sahasā śrutvā dyūtādyamantraṇam ||21|| saharṣaṃ tvājagāmāpi rāyaharipramandiram | dyūtadevanamevāpi samāje sarvaśobhane ||22|| yojayāmāsa nṛpatiḥ rāyahariḥ samutsukaḥ | rāyahareḥ pratinidhirbhāṇavāṇī tadābhavat ||23|| devane sā sthitā pūrvaṃ pāśān jagrāha bhāminī | tadānye’pi ca rājanyā amātyāḥ śreṣṭhino’pi ca ||24|| mahāsanāni sadasi bhejire dyūtavīkṣakāḥ | prāvartata tato dyūtaṃ parasparāpahārakam ||25|| koṭirāyastataḥ prāha hāro’yaṃ maṇiśobhitaḥ | kānakaḥ kaṇṭhabhūṣā me dhanaṃ paṇe’tra yojitam ||26||| kaste’tra sadṛśaḥ pratipaṇo’sti paṭṭake kuru | rāyaharistadovāca maṇyo me’tra santi ye ||27|| hārāścāpi dhanaṃ cāpi yojitaṃ vijayasva tat | tataḥ sākṣān pracikṣepa bhāṇavāṇī durodare ||28|| koṭirāya jitaṃ tvetat prasannā satyabhāṣata | koṭirāyastadā tatra niṣkasahasraśobhanām ||29|| mañjūṣāṃ sthāpayāmāsa prāha jayasva me dhanam | koṭirāya jitaṃ tvetad bhāṇavāṇī hyabhāṣata ||4.40.30|| atha lakṣaṃ suvarṇānāṃ raupyāṇāṃ daśalakṣakam | sthāpayāmāsa ca koṭirāyaḥ prasannamānasaḥ ||31|| bhāṇavāṇī pracikṣepa pāśān jitamabhāṣata | atha ratnānyuttamāni mauktikānyuttamānyapi ||32|| paṇe mumoca ca koṭirāyaḥ koṭisamāni vai | koṭimūlyān hīrakām̐śca paṇe mumoca sa nṛpaḥ ||33|| bhāṇavāṇī nyasya pāśān jitamityabhyabhāṣata | atha rājā koṭirāyaḥ svabhūṣāḥ svarṇanirmitāḥ ||34|| ratnahīrakanaddhāśca koṭyarbudādimūlyakāḥ | asthāpayat paṇe tatra maṇīnasaṃkhyamūlyakān ||35|| bhāṇavāṇyāḥ prasaṃkṣiptāḥ pāśā devāt parāṅmukhāḥ | koṭirāyajayārthaṃ vai patitā harṣamuttamam ||36|| sabhāyā janayāmāsurmahāścaryamatarkitam | bhāṇavāṇī gatā parājayaṃ kalāvatī hyapi ||37|| rājā rāyahariryāvajjitavān dhanamuttamam | tat sarvaṃ ca svīyamanyat sarvaṃ paṇe tu maṇḍitam ||38|| parājitavān saṃśokaṃ prāptavān kṣaṇamityapi | tataḥ sa nijaratnāni maṇīṃśca mauktikānyapi ||39|| hīrakān svarṇabhūṣāśca mañjūṣā ratnanirmitāḥ | rathaṃ svarṇamayaṃ divyaṃ caturhastisamanvitam ||4.40.40|| glahe saṃsthāpya covāca dīvyabhyanena vai tvayā | śrutvā koṭirayaścāpi paṇe sābhyadhanaṃ dadhau ||41 || koṭirāyastataḥ pāśān mumoca vijayaṃ gataḥ | atha rāyaharistatra śataṃ dāsī surūpiṇīḥ ||42|| sarvābharaṇasaṃśobhāḥ paṇo’maṇḍayadutsukaḥ | koṭirayo nyasya pāśān jitā ityabhyabhāṣata ||43|| atha rāyaharistatra sahasraṃ dāsyakarmiṇaḥ | sarvābharaṇayuktāṃśca glahe’maṇḍayadutsukaḥ ||44|| koṭirayo nyasya pāśān jitā ityabhyabhāṣata | atha rāyaharirnāgān sahasrasaṃkhyakottamān ||45|| svarṇakūthāmbālikāḍhyān hemamālān sudantinaḥ | paṇe’nyasattathā hastinikāsahasramityapi ||46|| koṭirāyo nyasya pāśān jitā ityabhyabhāṣata | atha rāyahariḥ svarṇarathān sahasrasaṃkhyakān ||47|| svarṇadaṇḍān svarṇaratnamaṇyāḍhyān dantiyojitān | glahe’maṇḍapadevāpi sotsāhaḥ svarṇacakrakān ||48|| koṭirāyo nyasya pāśān jitā ityabhyabhāṣata | atha rāyaharistatra vājinaścitracarmiṇaḥ ||49|| lakṣaṃ vai saindhavām̐statra glahe’maṇḍayadutsukaḥ | koṭirāyo nyasya pāśān jitā ityabhyabhāṣata ||4.40.50| atha rāyaharistatra naravāhanakānyapi | kānakāni śibikāśca svarṇahīrakanirmitāḥ ||5 1 || lakṣaṃ glahe’maṇḍayadvai chatracāmaraśobhitāḥ | koṭirāyo nyasya pāśān jitamityabhyabhāṣata ||52|| atha rāyaharistatra daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakān | yoddhṝn śastrānvitān svarṇavarmaveṣasamanvitān ||53|| glahe’maṇḍayadevāpi sarvābharaṇabhūṣitān | koṭirāyo nyasya pāśān jitā ityabhyabhāṣata |||54|| atha rāyaharistatra kośān daśa suvarṇakaiḥ | saṃbhṛtān rājyasarvasvānamaṇḍayadrūpavyarthai ||55|| koṭirāyo nyasya pāśān jitā ityabhya| atha rāyahariḥ rājyamandirāṇi mahānti ca ||56|| saudhān śaśāṃkadhavalān glahe’bhyamaṇḍayattadā | koṭirāyo nyasya pāśān jitānītyabhyabhāṣata ||57||| atha rāyahariḥ rājyaṃ samastaṃ cāpyamaṇḍayat | anena mama rājyena dīvyāmyadya tvayā saha ||58|| tvayā pratiglahe kiṃ vā nyasyate vada me drutam | ityuktaḥ sahasā koṭirāyo rājyamamaṇḍayat ||59|| atha pāśān mumocāpi parāvṛttiṃ tadā hyaguḥ | parājayaṃ dattavantaḥ pāśā koṭirayāya vai ||4.40.60|| rāyaharirjayaṃ labdhvā sabhāvandyo babhūva ha | asthāpayad glahe tatra bhāryāṃ nijāṃ dineśvarīm ||61 || koṭirāyaṃ tathā prāha glahe kiṃ sthāpyate tvayā | koṭirāyo nijāṃ patnīṃ candreśvarīmamaṇḍayat ||62|| bhāṇavāṇī tataḥ pāśān pracikṣepa kalānvitā | nikṛtyāha jitā rājñī śrīrāyahariṇā tviha ||63|| sabhāyāṃ prāsarat śokaḥ koṭirāyo vibhāryakaḥ | rājyahīnaḥ kṛtaścātra bhāṇavāṇyā glahe’ntime ||64|| candreśvarī tadā pātivratyadharmaparāyaṇā | bhāṇavāṇīṃ śaśāpaiva parahastāghaduḥkhitā ||65|| galatkuṣṭhā bhavaśīghraṃ vicittā durbhagā tathā | kṣayarogavatī cāpi yonirugṇā sadā bhava ||66|| unmattā śūkarītulyā bhava viṣṭhādanī sadā | anena varṣmaṇā duṣṭe rājñā samaṃ tu rākṣasī ||67|| bhava rāyahariṇaiva sākaṃ duṣṭavane’niśam | evaṃ śaptā drutaṃ tatra sabhāyāṃ bhāṇavāṇikā ||68|| rājā rāyahariścāpi tathābhāvamavāpatuḥ | utthāyotthāya sahasākūrdayatāmubhau tadā ||69|| nagnau bhūtvā nijadantānadarśayatāmudvratau | evaṃ dṛṣṭvā samājastau śokaparo’bhavat tadā ||4.40.70|| rājyajaye’pi tu buddheḥ parājaye nu kiṃ kṛtam | dravyajaye’pi lajjāyā vigame’pi nu kiṃ kṛtam ||71|| sarvajaye’pi tu duḥkhājaye tatra nu kiṃ kṛtam | nārījaye’pi tadvākyājaye tatra nu kiṃ kṛtam ||72|| arthajaye’pi dharmasyājaye tatra nu kiṃ kṛtam | evaṃ tatra samājo vai tayoḥ kṛte tvabhāṣata ||73|| pativratāyāḥ śāpo’tra bhāṇavāṇyā jito nahi | jito rājā jitā rājñī jitaṃ rājyaṃ dhanaṃ gṛham ||74|| rājñyātmā na jitastatra sarvaṃ jitaṃ tu niṣphalam | dineśvarī tadā rājñī prārthayaccandrikeśvarīm ||75|| mātaḥ rājyaṃ dhanaṃ sarvaṃ yad glahe’tra pramaṇḍitam | svāminā te tavaivāstu patirme svasthatāmiyāt ||76|| bhāṇavāṇī svasthacittā bhavatvatra sukhānvitā | kṛpāṃ kuru mahārājñi dāsyahaṃ te vadāmi vai ||77|| ityuktvā caraṇau dhṛtvā sā ruroda kṣaṇaṃ tadā | satī candreśvarīṃ prāha śṛṇu tvaṃ hitamuttamam ||78|| durodaraṃ tvasya nāma duṣṭaṃ phalaṃ tadātmanām | anyatarasya vā tvanyatamasya sarvanāśakam ||79|| āyatiṃ sāmpratabhāvaṃ vināśayati cobhayam | akṣāḥ kṣayakarā loke mumūrṣūṇāṃ nipātinaḥ ||4.40.80|| satṛṣṇāśca madāndhāśca hyapariśramasampadaḥ | rājāno naiva jānanti kāṃ daśāṃ prāpnumo glahe ||8 1 || ātmalābhaḥ paro lābho lābhaśca paramātmanaḥ | alābho rājyalābhādiścāsthiraḥ sarvaduḥkhakṛt ||82|| bhāṇavāṇī dyūtapāṇiḥ paranāśavināśinī | svasyā nāśakarī cāpi rājño nāśavidhāyinī ||83|| akṣairanakṣitulyaiḥ sā sarvasvaṃ harate sadā | sarvasvajīvikāhantrī mahāpāpaprayogiṇī ||84|| bhuṃkte pāpaphalaṃ tvadya śāpo nimittamātrakam | rājāpi dyūtinīsaṅgī phalaṃ bhuṃkte svakarmajam ||88|| śāpo me na nivṛttaḥ syāt kintu rājyaṃ patirmama | sarvaṃ kuryācchanaiḥ svāsthyaṃ patyuste saṃbhaviṣyati ||86|| rājyaṃ tato’rdhabhāgena svāminaste bhaviṣyati | tvaṃ svasā me na vai dāsī prasannāsmi sukhaṃ bhavet ||87|| ityuktā sā tathā mene sarvaṃ rājyaṃ satīkare | dadau dīneśvarī devī patyurhitāya sarvathā ||88|| candreśvarī satī dineśvarīṃ mene’tibhāvataḥ | candreśvaryāḥ patiḥ koṭirāyo mene nṛpaṃ bahu ||89|| bahubhāvena satataṃ kurvan rājyaṃ samastakam | rāyahariṃ samaicchat sa śīghraṃ tu sukhinaṃ sadā ||4.40.90|| śāpanivāraṇaṃ svāsthyaṃ tvaritaṃ tu yathā bhavet | tathopāyān samapṛcchad daivibhyaste’vadam̐stataḥ ||9 1 || satāṃ sevāsamaṃ nāsti sādhanaṃ duḥkhavārakam | sādhavaḥ khalu saṃpūjyāḥ smartavyā vipadāṃ harāḥ ||92|| toṣaṇīyāḥ sarvadānairvighnānāṃ nāśakāriṇaḥ | sarvasaubhāgyadāścāpi bhāgyottamatvakāriṇaḥ ||93|| satsaṃgaḥ sarvadā kāryaḥ sādhusaṃgapradaḥ śubhaḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā yā divyāsti bhūtale ||94|| tatkathāvācanaṃ varṣaparyantaṃ yojayatviha | tatrāmantraṇamāsādya tvāyāsyanti hi sādhavaḥ ||95|| sādhvyo’pi yoginaścāpi mahāśīrvādayojinaḥ | teṣāṃ kṛpāṃśataḥ sarvaṃ svāsthyaṃ suṣṭhu bhaviṣyati ||96|| iti daivijanairukte koṭirāyo nṛpastataḥ | kārayāmāsa vai śreṣṭhaṃ sabhāmaṇḍapamuttamam ||97|| viṣṇumūrtiṃ śriyā yuktāṃ svarṇamayīṃ suśobhanām | vedikāṃ homalābhārthaṃ kārayāmāsa cottamām ||98|| rasaśālā vāsaśālāḥ kathāśālāṃ vyadhāttadā | samāhvayat saṃhitājñān tvaśvapaṭṭasarovarāt ||99|| vimānenāyayuḥ santaḥ saṃhitājñāstu vaiṣṇavāḥ | saurāṣṭratīrtharūpāste pāvanāḥ pāvakā iva || 4.40.10 0|| avaterurmaṇḍapāgre divyadṛṣṭyā vimāninaḥ | jayakāraṃ prakurvantaḥ śrīpateḥ paramātmanaḥ || 101 || sindhutulyā saṃhitāpi lakṣmīnārāyaṇābhidhā | pañcaviṃśatisāhasrādhikalakṣābhisaṃkhyayā || 10 2|| ślokānāṃ rājamānā sā sādhubhiḥ saha cāyayau | lakṣmītulyā svarūpeṇātmanā sarasvatīsamā || 1 03|| vijñānena samā vaidaiścamatkāre ramāsamā | mokṣaṇe śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇatulyā suśobhanā || 1 04|| śaitye prabhānvitā tyāge pārvatīśāsamā śubhā | sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyā puruṣārthasamanvitā || 1 05|| āyayau sā vimānena śreyase sarvadehinām | badrike yatra santo me tatrāhaṃ sādhuvallabhaḥ || 1 06|| tatra lakṣmīḥ saṃhitā ca lalitā maṃjulā jayā | suguṇā haṃsikā rādhā virājante na saṃśayaḥ || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne sindhunadīpradeśānāṃ nṛpayordyūtakhelane sarvasvāpaharaṇe pativratāyāḥ śāpena unmattatāṃ gatayorbhāṇavāṇīrāyaharinṛpayoḥ śreyase śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāprastāve’śvapaṭṭasarovarāt sādhūnāmāgamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 40 ||
<4.41> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye tatra śarkarākhye supattane | rāyaharermandire tu mahodyānasumaṇḍite || 1 || kathāśālāsthale pārāyaṇaṃ vatsaravartanam | koṭirāyo nṛpo rāyahareḥ śreyo’bhilabdhaye || 2 || yojayāmāsa vai sa māse tvāṣāḍhaikādaśīdine | āditaścāhvayāmāsa dūtaiḥ sādhūm̐śca bhūsurān || 3 || vyāsān prapāṭhakām̐ścāpi jāpakām̐śca sahasraśaḥ | āyayuḥ sarvataḥ santo viprāḥ sādhvyaśca vaiṣṇavāḥ || 4 || svaprakāśo hi bhagavān mukhyavaktābhavattadā | lomaśaśca munistatra guruḥ pūjākaro’bhavat || 5 || anye saurāṣṭradeśīyā ājanābhāśca pūrvajāḥ | prācīnabrahmabhūmisthā rāśiyānodbhavāstathā || 6 || parīpradeśajāścāpi tathāmarīpradeśajāḥ | abriktādipradeśotthāḥ santo viprāḥ samāyayuḥ || 7 || uṣṭrapradeśajātāścāpyārārtrikotthāśca sādhavaḥ | dvīpopadvīpajāścādrivanāraṇyasamudrajāḥ || 8 || saṃhitārasavettāraḥ santastatra samāyayuḥ | sādhvyaśca sāṃkhyayoginyo muktānikāḥ samāyayuḥ || 9 || ṛṣayo munayo viprā vidvāṃsastatra cāyayuḥ | āmantritāḥ sarvabhuvāṃ vaiṣṇavā lakṣakoṭayaḥ || 4.41.10 || cāturmāsye vrate pārāyaṇe tathā viśeṣataḥ | vārṣike vṛṣaniṣpādye cāyayurbrahmavittamāḥ || 11 || teṣāṃ kṛte samastānāṃ rājyaprāsādabhūtayaḥ | arpitāḥ svāgatasaukhyabhogavāsārthamuttamāḥ || 1 2|| yathā rājarddhayo rājabhogyāstathā tu bhūsuraiḥ | aviśeṣeṇa bhogyā vai hyāsan badrīpriye tadā || 1 3||| ghṛtakulyā dadhikulyā rasakulyā saśarkarāḥ | madhukulyāḥ payaḥkulyāḥ pānakulyāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 14|| sindhusarittaṭe tatra nirmitā dīrghavāhikāḥ | viśālā bhojyaśālāśca divāniśaṃ pravartitāḥ || 159|| pānabhojanadāyinyo dāsyo dāsāśca lakṣaśaḥ | yāvaddravyāṇi tu paṇe nyastāni vijitānyapi || 16|| ubhābhyāṃ tu nṛpābhyāṃ vai tāni yajñārthameva ha | arpitāni vyayārthaṃ vai koṭirāyeṇa sarvathā || 17|| mahāsaudhe pūrito’sti rāyaharirnṛpastadā | unmatto rākṣaso yadvad bhāṇavāṇī tathāvidhā || 18|| sarve paśyanti rājānaṃ śāpadagdhaṃ vicittakam | bhāṇavāṇīṃ sarvanāśakarīṃ durodarodarām || 19|| śāpadagdhāṃ tathonmattāṃ vyapaśyanti janāstadā | etayoḥ śreyase pārāyaṇaṃ prajāyate tviti ||4.41.20||| vadanti darśakāstatra śaṃsanti candrikeśvarīm | pativratāṃ mahāsādhvīṃ paśyanti ca namanti tām ||2 1 || mahāścaryaparā lokāḥ koṭiśo vaiṣṇavāstadā | khānapānanivāsasvāgatādyaiḥ paritoṣitāḥ ||22|| āṣāḍhaikādaśīprātaḥkāle sabhāsthale yayuḥ | maṇḍapaṃ tu viśālaṃ yojitaṃ svarṇasurūpiṇam ||23||| vyapaśyan cāparaṃ svargaṃ sudharmāṃ vā sabhāmiva | vimānamiva tatrāsīd vyāsāsanaṃ mahattamam ||24||| svarṇahīrakasannaddhaṃ svarṇatoraṇamaṇḍitam | vitānacandrabhāsvacca bahumauktikasaṃbhṛtam ||25|| puṣpahārādibhiḥ śṛṃgāritaṃ haṃsādirājitam | patākikādhvajavyāptaṃ hāratoraṇakojjvalam ||26|| mṛdugendukapārśvadhrapṛṣṭhadhrādisamanvitam | darpaṇādyaiścittaharaṃ svarṇavastrādibhūṣitam ||27|| svarṇakadalīsaṃstambhaṃ saṃhitāpaṭṭakānvitam ||28|| pūjāsāmagrikāpātrasarvopacārasaṃhitam | kṛtracāmaravetrādyairalaṃkṛtajanairyutam ||29|| vipraiḥ sadbhiścākṣatādyaiḥ puṣpahāraiḥ pravardhitam | vyāsāsane tatra vipraḥ svaprakāśaparāyaṇaḥ || 4.41.3 0|| saṃhitāyā mukhyavaktā niṣasāda śubhe kṣaṇe | tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāstathābhavan || 31 || saṃhitā paṭṭake nyastā pūjitā pārameśvarī | lomaśena mahāmuktavaryeṇa badrike tadā || 32| lakṣmīdevī svayaṃ sākṣāt saṃhitāyāṃ vyadṛśyata | divyā prasannavadanā sarvatejobhivardhitā || 33|| sarvālaṃkāraśṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyā sumanoharā | nārāyaṇaṃ hṛdye sve dadhānā jñānasāgarā ||34|| atha nārāyaṇakṛṣṇastadā tasmim̐stu vaktari | vyadṛśyata caturbāhuḥ svaprakāśaparāyane ||35|| sarvaśobhākaraḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prameśvaraḥ | māṇikīlalitārādhāramāśrīmādhavīpriyāḥ ||36|| sarvāstadābhavan pārśve pūjāpātrādidhārikāḥ | muktā muktānikāścāsam̐stadā tatsannidhau śubhāḥ ||37|| viprāśca munayaḥ santaḥ sādhavaśca maharṣayaḥ | surā devyaśca tīrthāni tatra tvāsannupasthitāḥ || 38|| pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena śrīsūktena tathā tadā | nārāyaṇena sūktena devīsūktena vaidikaiḥ || 39|| mantraiḥ pūjāṃ saṃhitāyāstathā vyāsasya lomaśaḥ | akarod vidhinā tatrārārtrikaṃ koṭirājakaḥ ||4.41.40|| akaroccandanapuṣpākṣatāmbarasuvarṇakaiḥ | dhanaistathopacāraiśca gandhisārādibhiḥ phalaiḥ ||41|| maṅgalaṃ vācayāmāsa mahāśīrvādapūrvakam | saṃkalpaṃ kārayāmāsa lomaśaḥ śreyase tayoḥ |||42|| kathāśravaṇamagnāścopatasthire kṣaṇe’tra ca | sabhā pūrṇābhavallakṣalakṣalakṣādhimānavaiḥ ||43|| svaprakāśo’pi bhagavān śiṣyaḥ śrīparamātmanaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya maṅgalaṃ vyadhāt ||44|| śrīmadbrahmapurādhipo’kṣarapatiḥ sarvāvatāreśvaro, muktabrahmaniṣevitāṃghriyugalo rādhārameśeśvaraḥ | yaścāsaṃkhyanarāyaṇādhivasatiḥ śrīkṛṣṇakṛṣṇeśvaraḥ, so’yaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇo’stu sukhadaḥ saurāṣṭradhāmeśvaraḥ ||45|| yaḥ pṛthvyāṃ vicaran purā kṣitibhṛtāmokṣapramodāvaho, daityānāṃ vilayaṃkaro’rbudasatīsādhvībhujādhārakaḥ | jīvānāṃ narayoṣitāmaghaharaḥ śreyovidhātātmanāṃ, so’yaṃ kuṃkumavāpikākṣararaviḥ śrīsaṃhitādaivatam ||46|| natvā taṃ paramātmānaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇātmakam | tadvijñānamayaṃ śāstraṃ śrāvayiṣyāmi mokṣadam ||47|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu hṛdaye sadā | kathāsu jāyamānāsu mokṣado bhaktavallabhaḥ ||48|| parabrahma namaskṛtya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim | kaṃbharāśrīṃ ca gopālaṃ natvā jayaṃ samuccaret ||49|| smarāmi paramātmānaṃ namāmi vallabhamprabhum | nirdiśāmi harerbhaktiṃ śaṃsāmi sevanaṃ satām ||4.41.50||| ityevaṃ badrike kṛtvā maṃgalaṃ bījasaṃbhṛtam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāmavācayat ||51 || tadā devā mānavāśca pare’pi dehinaḥ khalu | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhyānārthino’bhavan ||52|| kṛṣṇamūrtau kathāmūtau dattadhyānāstadābhavan | kathāsāraṃ papustatra saṃkṣepād vistarādapi |||53|| pratyahaṃ tu kathānte te kurvanti paramātmanaḥ | harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa harinārāyaṇa prabho ||54|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa mokṣapradaprabho | nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ tvevaṃ samastā vādyasaṃgatāḥ ||55|| tālikābhirnṛtyagītairbhajanaṃ cakrire mudā | kathānte jāyate tvārārtrikaṃ naivedyamuttamam ||56|| pūjā vyāsasya tatraiva jāyate pratyahaṃ śubhā | jāpakā bhūsurādyāśca jayanti parameśvaram ||57|| sāyaṃ homaḥ sadā tatra prajvāyate’nalaprabhau | prāghūṇikānaneṣvatra miṣṭahomā bhavanti ca ||58|| dugdhāpānāni devānāṃ havanāni bhavanti ca | bhūsurāṇāṃ satāṃ bhojyaṃ dugdhasārādi cāmṛtam ||59|| sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ tatra bhedabhāvo na vidyate | yaddevānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ carṣīṇāṃ tat sarvadehinām ||4.41.60|| pratyahaṃ bhakṣyabhojyādi khānapānādi sadṛśam | kathā prajāyate prātastathā sāyaṃ tu sarvadā ||61 || ārārtrikaṃ samāptau ca pratyahaṃ pūjanādikam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanāmadhunyaṃ prajāyate’niśam ||62|| vitaraṇaṃ prasādānāṃ bhojanānāṃ pradānakam | suvarṇādipradānānāṃ cārpaṇaṃ pratyahaṃ tadā ||63|| evaṃ samutsavo jāto badrike saṃhitātmakaḥ | lakṣaśo mānavā jñānāmṛtaṃ pītvā tu pāvanāḥ ||64|| bhūtvā bhūtvā mahābhāgavatā bhavanti tatra vai | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||65|| itimantrapradānaṃ ca karoti lomaśo muniḥ | āścaryāṇi kathāyāṃ tu vicitrāṇi bhavantyapi ||66|| vimānāni surāṇāṃ vai śravaṇārthaṃ tadāmbare | samāgatyāvatiṣṭhanti puṣpacandanavarṣaṇam ||67|| kṛtvā prayānti satataṃ svargaṃ svargāgatāni vai | adṛśyā divyadehāśca tīrtharṣiyoginastadā ||68|| āgatyākarṇya khe sthitvā nītvā yānti prasādakam | vādyāni devalokānāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ ca gītayaḥ ||69|| apsarasāṃ gītikāśca nartanaṃ vārayoṣitam | sādhvīnāṃ bhajanaṃ ghoṣā vipravedodbhavāstadā ||4.41.70|| utsavānte prajāyante pratyahaṃ vyāsasevanam | gurūṇāṃ sevanaṃ sādhuvargāṇāṃ pūjanādikam ||71 || svāgataṃ tvāgatānāṃ vigatānāṃ mānapūjanam | madhuparko nūtanānāṃ prācīnānāṃ tu dakṣiṇāḥ ||72|| dīyante pratyahaṃ tatrānāthādīnāṃ yatheṣṭakam | pretā āgatya śṛṇvanti kathāṃ paramapāvanīm ||73|| prasādaṃ saṃpragṛhṇanti yānti mokṣapadaṃ tataḥ | vimānaiste prayāntyeva kathayitvā hyudantakam ||74|| ahaṃ bhogyaṃ sindhujānāṃ tadā śrībadrike param | mahābhāgavatāḥ santo rājante yatra vaiṣṇavāḥ ||75|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathā bhavanti ca | pravartante harerlīlājñānadharmayutāḥ kathāḥ ||76||| saṃhitātīrthamatredaṃ khyātaṃ tarhyabhavattataḥ | bhāṇavāṇī rāyahariḥ śṛṇutaḥ pratyahaṃ kathāḥ ||77|| bhuṃjāte ca prasādau tau pibataśca jalāmṛtam | pāpaprakṣālanaṃ prajāyate śanaiḥ kathāmṛtaiḥ ||78|| kathāśravaṇayogena jāyate tvātmaśodhanam | satāmāśīrvādalābhairjāyate śāpamokṣaṇam ||79|| evaṃ śuddhiḥ śanairjātā cāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ | vratadānaphalānāṃ cārpaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ kuṭumbibhiḥ ||4.41.80 || tatpuṇyena tayoḥ svāsthyaṃ śanaiḥ śanairudaicchubham | kathāyāṃ vartamānāyāmūrjamāsaḥ samāyayau ||8 1|| kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ bālakṛṣṇajanmajayantikotsavam | cakrurnṛpāḥ prajāścāpi mahīmānā narāḥ striyaḥ ||82|| maharṣayastathā devā mānavāḥ sādhavastathā | sādhyo viprā vaidikāśca pracakruste mahotsavam ||83|| ṣaṣṭhyāṃ nṛpaḥ koṭirāyaḥ parimeyapuraḥsaraḥ | prāpya patraṃ lomaśarṣeḥ śrīkṛṣṇānayanāya saḥ ||84|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīparameśvaram | kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ saurāṣṭre vyomavartmanā ||85|| vimānenāyayau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇālayāntikam | avātaranmandirāgre bālakṛṣṇaṃ vilokitum |||86 || pūjayituṃ tathāmantrayituṃ kṛṣṇāgrato’bhavat | kṛtāñjaliḥ kṛtapūjaḥ svāgataṃ prāpya darśanam ||87|| modaṃ prāpya śrīharaye hṛdayaṃ prasamarpya ca | sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa prārthayāmāsa kāraṇam ||88|| janmajayantī bhagavannekaviṃśatikā śubhā | āgatya sindhujān deśān śarkarānagarāntike ||89|| saṃhitāmaṇḍape kāryā svayaṃ bhagavatā prabho | kṛpayā netumāyātaḥ śvo gatistatra rocate ||4.41.90|| saptamyāṃ śarkarābhūmau madhyandine samāgamaḥ | kartavyo bhavatā tatra mahāsvāgatamuttamam ||9 1|| bhavitā bhagavam̐stasmādāgantavyaṃ kṛpālunā | hariḥ prāha śubhaṃ bhūyādāgantā omiti drutam ||92|| rājā rātrau tu viśrāmaṃ jagrāha tīrthamācaran | prātaḥ sajjo babhūvāpi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇājñayā ||93|| mātā pitā ṛṣayaśca santaḥ sajjāstato’bhavan | vidhāya svaṃ dvidhā rūpaṃ vimānaṃ cāruroha vai ||94|| vimānasthāḥ samastāste dvedhā kṛtāḥ parātmanā | vimānaṃ prayayau tūrṇaṃ cāmbareṇa tu badrike ||95|| sindhudeśaṃ samaprāpacchrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | dvitīyena svarūpeṇa kuṃkumavāpikāsthitaḥ ||96|| janmāhotsavalābhārthaṃ svagṛhe śrīhariṃ svayam | āgatānāṃ manastuṣṭyai kuṃkumavāpikāsthitaḥ ||97|| sindhujānāṃ manastuṣṭyai sindhudeśaṃ gato’pi ca | evaṃ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaḥ sindhutīramavātarat ||98|| sūryabhāsvadvimānaṃ tat pūjitaṃ prathamaṃ janaiḥ | harirniyet vimānācca jayaśabdaiḥ prapūjitaḥ ||99|| netrārpaṇairharṣanādairakṣataiḥ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ | pūjitaścandanādyaiśca puṣpahāraiḥ prapūjitaḥ || 4.41.100 || lājābhirvardhitaścāpi karāñjalibhirarcitaḥ | hārdairbhāvairiṅgitaiśca nijanāthaukṛto janaiḥ || 101 || pratikṛtisahasrātmā chāyāmūrtiḥ kṛto hariḥ | nārībhiśca naraiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pratibimbita ātmasu ||1 02|| atha kṛṣṇo yayau koṭirāyadarśitamandiram | lomaśādyāḥ praṇemustaṃ pupūjuḥ svāgatādibhiḥ || 10 3|| jalapānaṃ daduścāpi candreśvarī mahāsatī | candrakaṃ kauṃkumaṃ cāpyakṣatairyuktaṃ cakāra sā || 1 04|| puṣpamālāṃ dadau kaṇṭhe kṛṣṇasya candrikeśvarī | dineśvarī harestatra pādaprakṣālanādibhiḥ || 1 05|| sammānamācarat pūjāṃ vyadhād bhāvabharā tadā | anye’pi śrīharerlokā devāḥ prajājanā api || 106 || maharṣayaśca ṛṣayo vyadhuḥ pūjāṃ harestadā | yayuḥ sarve kuśalaṃ vai pṛṣṭāḥ svasvaniketanam || 1 07|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatra viśrāntimāpa vai kṣaṇam | badrike sarvatastatra parānando vyavartata || 1 08|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇauyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śarkarānagare saṃhitākathārambhe sarvalokavāsināṃ tathā janmajayantyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya cāgamaḥ svāgatādikaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 41 ||
<4.42> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tatastatra mahotsave | saptamyāṃ śrīharerdarśanārthaṃ saṃsanmahatyabhūt || 1 || divye gajāsane ramye svarṇaratnādibhāsvati | uccairuccatame kṛṣṇo nyaṣīdad divyavigrahaḥ || 2 || lakṣalakṣātilakṣāṇāṃ mānavānāṃ hi gocaraḥ | mahāsane’bhavat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’rkavattadā || 3 || divyatejo’mbārayukto divyaiśvaryapratāpavān | asīmānavadhiprāgalbhyaudāryaujjvalyamaṇḍitaḥ || 4 || tādṛksauṣṭhavamādhuryalāvaṇyahāsyaśobhitaḥ | tādṛksaundaryasādrūpyākarṣaṇānandapūritaḥ || 5 || tādṛgyauvanagāmbhīryavīryabalavirājitaḥ | tādṛkkṛpādayāsnehapremānugrahavarṣakaḥ || 6 || koṭikāmapramohāḍhyasauṣṭhavaghaṭṭanātmakaḥ | vyadyotatākṣaradhāmnā tejasā mūrchanākaraḥ || 7 || naranārīhṛdayastho’ntarātmā netragocaraḥ | sarvāvatārabhagavān tadānīṃ kṛpayābhavat || 8 || pūjito vanditaḥ sarvaiḥ svāgataṃ tu navaṃ navam | kṛtaṃ lokairbhaktavargairāsāyaṃ paramātmanaḥ || 9 || hariścopādideśāpi kṛpātmakaṃ tu saṃsadi | nijārthakṛtasarvasvabhaktebhyo’nugraheṇa vai || 4.42.1 0|| sarve bhavantu sukhino darśanānmama dehinaḥ | bhavatāṃ sukhalābhārthaṃ samāgato’smyanugrahāt || 11 || pare dhāmnyakṣare loke divyo’haṃ prabhavāmi yaḥ | sarvāvatāradhartā śrīpatiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 12|| sarveśvaraniyantā ca sarvaśaktipatiḥ prabhuḥ | sarvasiddharṣipitrṝṇāṃ surāṇāṃ daivataṃ param || 1 3|| antarātmā kālamāyāmahāpuruṣaśāsakaḥ | sohameva bhavāmyatra bālakṛṣṇo bhavādṛśaḥ || 14|| mama yogaṃ gatā ye ye te dhāmākṣaraṃ yayuḥ | vāsudevā asaṃkhyātā nārāyaṇā hyasīmakāḥ || 15|| śrīkṛṣṇāścāpyasaṃkhyātā viṣṇavo’saṃkhyamūrtayaḥ | rāmā nareśvarāḥ siddheśvarāścāpyatisaṃkhyakāḥ || 1 6|| mama yogena jāyante klṛptā vāṃśodbhavā mama | matsvarūpā mattādātmyā madabhinnā bhavanti te || 17|| māmāśritya samastāsu sṛṣṭiṣu pārameśvarāḥ | niṣpadyante’nantaśaktidharā matkṛpayā hi te || 18|| so’haṃ samastasṛṣṭīnāṃ kṛpākaṭākṣapāvanaḥ | gocaro’smi bhavatāṃ cāvatārī puruṣottamaḥ || 1 9|| saṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ ye’tra śṛṇvanti saṃsmarantyapi | teṣāmahaṃ samuddhartā māyāsaṃsāravāridheḥ ||4.42.20|| ye māṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti saṃbhajanti vai | tān matvāhaṃ nijān bhaktān tārayiṣyāmi mohataḥ ||2 1 || narā nāryaśca ṣaṇḍhāśca ye bhajiṣyanti māṃ tviha | seviṣyante ca sarvasvārpaṇaiste dhāmino mama |||22|| sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ karmatulyaṃ phalaṃ dadāmyaham | nītireṣā tu saṃsāre kṛpā me tvatirekiṇī || 23|| kṛpāyāṃ niyamo nāsti phalakarmābhibandhakaḥ | uddharāmi jagatsarvaṃ prasādena na saṃśayaḥ || 24|| vahneryogāt samastaṃ vai pāvanaṃ jāyate yathā | mama yogena sarvaṃ vai pāvanaṃ jāyate tathā || 25|| yathāhaṃ pāvanaścāsmi tathaiva mama mūrtayaḥ | santo me pāvanāḥ sarve vāṇī me pāvanī sadā || 26|| saṃhiteyaṃ mama vāṇī pāvanī sarvadehinām | lakṣmīścāhamahaṃ lakṣmīścaikaṃ tattvaṃ dvidhā kṛtam ||27|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇaścāhaṃ saṃhitā me sarasvatī | tasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa madakṣaramavāpyate ||28|| śabdamūrtiḥ sādhumūrtirdhātumūrtirmadātmikā | ahaṃ trimūrtikaścāsmi sādhvīmūrtistridhā mama |||29|| bhaktimūrtistathopāstimūrtirdīkṣātmamūrtikaḥ | ṣaṇmūrto’haṃ sadā cāsmi milāmi tatra tatra ha ||4.42.30|| sākṣādahaṃ virāje’dya sindhutīre bhavanmaṭhe | kalyāṇārthaṃ bhavatāṃ vai kṛpayā manujākṛtiḥ || 31 || nāryaścopāsate māṃ tu patirūpeṇa nityadā | upāsate patayo māṃ dhāturūpeṇa nityadā || 32|| ṣaṇḍhāḥ saṃkalparūpeṇopāsate māṃ phalojjhitāḥ | vṛkṣā rasapradaṃ māṃ tūpāsate pṛthivībhujaḥ ||33||| pakṣiṇaścāmbarātmānaṃ paśavaścauṣadhivrajam | devāḥ sudhāṃ daityavaryā balaṃ kledaṃ tu jantavaḥ || 34|| upāsate yathāyogyasvabhāvānuguṇaṃ tu mām | cakṣuṣmantaḥ surūpaṃ māṃ vinetrā sūpavarjitam ||35 || sendriyāḥ sendriyaṃ nirindriyā māṃ tu nirindriyam | satattvā māṃ tattvayuktaṃ nistattvā tattvavarjitam || 36|| saguṇā guṇavantaṃ māṃ nirguṇā guṇavarjitam | sasnehā māṃ snigdhamūrtiṃ nissnehā rūkṣamavyayam ||37|| satyaścānandadātāraṃ santaḥ śāntikhanīśvaram | upāsate yathāyogyaṃ phalaṃ tathā dadāmyaham || 38|| dehino dehavantaṃ māṃ videhā dehavarjitam | svārthāḥ parārthaghātāraṃ nissvārthāścāparigraham ||39|| jñāninaḥ svaprakāśaṃ māṃ jaḍā bhūtātmavartinam | vipannāstrāṇakartāraṃ sampannāḥ sampadātmakam ||4.42.40 || śrāntā udyamarūpaṃ māṃ vyāpṛtā yatnarūpiṇam | upāsate’lasāḥ phalojjhitaṃ māṃ rāgiṇaḥ sukham ||41 || teṣāmupāstimālambya dadāmīṣṭaphalaṃ sadā | ahaṃ vai kṛpayā labhyo mantralabhyo bhavāmi ca |||05|| bhaktilabhyaḥ snehalabhyaḥ samādhilabhya ityapi | alabhyaḥ sulabhaścāsmi saṃhitāpāṭhināṃ tviha ||43|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | itimantraprajaptustu sulabho’haṃ nirantaram ||44|| guroḥ sevāphalaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāptiruttamā | sākṣādatra bhavecceti tathā prāpto’smi vastviha ||45|| yo māṃ smarati namati caṣṭe dhyāyati sevate | tasyāhaṃ hṛdaye nityaṃ viśeṣeṇa puro’pi ca ||46|| yaḥ patnyāṃ śriyamīkṣeta patyau nārāyaṇaṃ tu yā | apatye pārṣadānme ca tadgṛhaṃ me’kṣaraṃ padam ||47|| yaḥ pravṛttau mamājñāṃ vai nivṛttau ca mayi sthitim | jīvane mama tādātmyaṃ dadhāti sa prayāti mām ||48|| yasyendriyāṇi sarvāṇi kṛṣṇārthāni mano’pi ca | ātmāpi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārthaḥ sa pumarthavān ||49|| api loke durācāro yo’nanyāśrayavān mayi | madbhaktiṃ kurute nityaṃ sa sādhurmokṣasādhanaḥ ||4.42.50|| api dharmavirāgāḍhyo niṣparigraha ātmavān | vihāya māṃ vartamānastasya hānirmahattamā ||5 1 || asādhuḥ sa tu mantavyo yo na bhajate māṃ prabhum | na vā sādhūn sevate’pi naṣṭārthaḥ sa tu sarvathā ||52|| apīndradhiṣṇyamāpanno dharmarājapratāpavān | sūryatejo’bhisampanno bhaktihīnastu nārakī ||53|| api bhautikatattveśaḥ siddhyaiśvaryaikaśevadhiḥ | bahvaṇḍānāṃ niyantā ced bhaktihīnaḥ sa nārakī ||54|| buddheḥ pāraṃ gataścāpi māyāpāraṃ gato’pi ca | brahmabhāvaṃ gataścāpi bhaktihīnastu nottamaḥ ||55|| prajāpālanaśakto’pi sarvācāraparāyaṇaḥ | satāṃ sevāvihīno yaḥ sa phalgujanmavāniha ||56|| sarvavidyādharaścāpi sarvaśāsanavīryavān | satāṃ sevāvihīnaścet phalgujīvanavāniha ||57|| devakoṭiṃ gataścāpi maharṣitāṃ gato’pi cet | mama satāṃ kṛpāśūnyastasya sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||58|| kāmadhenurgṛhe yasya kalpadrumaśca mandire | yasya gṛhe na vai santastadgṛhaṃ pherurājavat ||59|| dṛṣṭiryasyātidivyāpi sattvaṃ cāntaḥsthitaṃ tathā | satāṃ darśanahīnaścet sadāndhaḥ sa tu nārakī ||60|| pūjābhiḥ pūjitaścāpi kīrtyā prakāśamānapi | satāṃ darśanahīnaścet sadāndho dīnakiṃkaraḥ ||61 || caturdaśasu lokeṣu gatimānapi sarvathā | sādhūn prati gatihīno durgatiḥ sa tu nārakī || 62|| āraṇyako muniścāpi tyāgavairāgyaśīlavān | sādhusatsaṃgahīnaścet sa syādāraṇyakaḥ paśuḥ || 33|| māyāpāśāt paśutvaṃ vai jīvānāṃ vidyate sadā | māyā tu vāsanā bodhyā bhaktyantarāyakāriṇī || 64|| sā tu prakṣālanīyā vai satāṃ hareśca sevayā | ātmārpaṇaṃ harau kāryaṃ sarvārpaṇaṃ tu satsvapi ||65|| mayi nyasya kriyāḥ sarvā bhāvyaṃ brahmātmanā tviha | saṃhitāśravaṇaṃ kṛtvā bhāvyaṃ madātmanā tataḥ ||66|| mama bhāvayuto yaḥ syāttamuddharāmi sarvathā | svastyastu bhavatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sākṣānmama prasādataḥ ||67|| ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatra tu badrike | virarāma tataḥ śrīmān lomaśāstān manuṃ param | | 68 | | śrāvayāmāsa ca sarvān vaiṣṇavān paramāna vyadhāt | sabhāvirāmaḥ sañjāto hariḥ prapūjito janaiḥ | | 69 || viśrāmārthaṃ yayau naijaṃ sthānaṃ tatra nṛpādibhiḥ | ārārtrikaṃ ca naivedyaṃ śrīharervihitaṃ śubham | |4.42.7 0 | | anyeṣāṃ bhojanapānāsanasatkārapūjanam | yathāyogyaṃ nṛpādyaiśca kṛtaṃ niśāmukhe tadā | |7 1 | | rātrau nāryo narā rājñyo rājāno lomaśaṃ munim | svaprakāśāyanakaṃ te vaktāraṃ samasevayan ||72|| sādhūn siṣevire cāpi pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ | atoṣayan śreyase tān divyabhāvanayā yutāḥ ||73 || rātrau tatra tu devānāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ ca gītayaḥ | apsarasāṃ nartanāni gāyanāni ca yoṣitām ||74|| kavīnāṃ prācīnakathālaharyaścābhavam̐stataḥ | nāṭakānāṃ darśanāni caritrāṇāṃ harestathā ||75|| indrajālānyanekāni kalāvidāṃ tadābhavan | bhajanāni satīnāṃ ca sādhūnāṃ kīrtanāni ca ||76|| samādhayo yogavidāṃ tadābhavam̐stu badrike | sevā śreṣṭhā mumukṣūṇāṃ tādātmyaṃ tu nijātmanām ||77|| sarvārpaṇaṃ prabhaktānāṃ tadābhavam̐stu badrike | dravībhāvaścātmavidāṃ snehināṃ paramātmani || 78 || jñānināṃ tvekatānatvaṃ pratyayānāṃ tadābhavat | pramodāmodaparamānandā abhavan dehinām ||79 || kṣetrāṇāṃ pulako jātaḥ svedastu saritāṃ tadā | pravāhāṇāṃ pāvanatvaṃ jātaṃ śrīkṛṣṇayogataḥ || 4.42.80 || satāṃ prakāśanaṃ tatra maharṣīṇāṃ vinodanam | prajānāṃ dhānyasaṃskārāstadābhavan hi badrike ||8 1 || paśūnāṃ tu pavitratvaṃ pakṣiṇāṃ yādasāmapi | jambūnāṃ jīvanotkarṣo bhāvī jāto hi badrike ||82|| vallīnāṃ pādapānāṃ ca vṛkṣāṇāṃ tṛṇaśākhinām | kandānāṃ bhūtale tatra yajñārhatvaṃ tadābhavat ||8 3 || sārthakyaṃ tatra vāyūnāṃ vahnīnāṃ khasya cābhavan | vārīṇāṃ tadvikārāṇāṃ sārthakyaṃ kṛṣṇayogataḥ ||84|| śayyānāṃ mandirāṇāṃ ca vastūnāṃ kṛṣṇasañjuṣām | pāvanatvaṃ sadā jātaṃ mokṣadāyitvamuttamam ||85|| badrike kā kathā teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ karṇe tu saṃhitā | yeṣāṃ bhūmau bālakṛṣṇo yeṣāṃ dṛṣṭau tu sādhavaḥ ||86|| sureśvarāḥ samāgatya rātrau śrīśaṃ śrīvallabhamprabhum | divyadravaiḥ pūjayitvā prasādaṃ prāpya saṃyayuḥ ||87|| tīrthāni bhūvyomagāni samāgatya rahastataḥ | hareḥ pādaspṛṣṭajalaṃ pītvā yayurnijasthalīm ||88|| siddhajanā adrivāsā āgatya yogavarṣmabhiḥ | sevayitvā bālakṛṣṇaṃ yayurnaijaṃ tu gahvaram ||89|| dyauḥ svayaṃ yuvatī bhūtvā siṣeve dyupatiṃ harim | kṛtakṛtyā yayau naijaṃ nivāsaṃ tvambare tataḥ ||4.42.90|| śvetadvīpādivāsāśca muktā muktānikāstathā | kṣīravāsā badrikāsthāḥ siṣevire narāyaṇam ||9 1 || rādhāramādyāḥ sakalāḥ śaktayaḥ prāṇarakṣakam | kāntaṃ siṣevire kāntā divyamūrtaya eva tāḥ || 92|| naikarūpadharaḥ kṛṣṇovallabhāryo niśāntare | jagṛhe tvarpitāṃ sevāṃ narāṇāṃ yoṣitāmapi ||93|| niśānte sa kṣaṇaṃ nidrāṃ yoganidrāṃ nijapriyām | jagrāha ghaṭikāmātraṃ samuttasthau tataḥ prabhuḥ || 94|| anādi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakaṃ parātparam | dadhyau naijaṃ mūlarūpaṃ samutthāya kṣaṇaṃ prabhuḥ |||95|| tadāvatārāḥ sarve’pi sarvāvatāraśaktayaḥ | īśvarā īśvarāṇyaśca divyādṛśyasvarūpakaiḥ ||96|| jayantīpūjanalābhaṃ rahastatra pralebhire | muktāḥ samādhiniṣṭhāśca dhāmadhāmanivāsinaḥ || 97|| pārṣadā api kṛṣṇasya pūjālābhaṃ prapedire | pārṣadānyo gopikāśca pūjāsevāṃ pracakrire || 98|| gajo garuḍaḥ śeṣaśca vājī vāhottamāstadā | āgatyādṛśyarūpaiste rahaḥpūjāṃ vyadhurhareḥ || 99|| badrike tvaṃ mayā sākaṃ nareṇa tanunā saha | maharṣibhiḥ rahaḥpūjālābhaṃ prāptavatī tadā || 4.42.10 0|| evaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇorjāṣṭamikāprage | jayantīmiṣamālambya divyā devamapūjayan || 101 || lebhire prathamaṃ lābhaṃ cāprakāśaṃ parātmanaḥ | tato brāhmamuhūrtārdhavigamo’bhavadeva ha || 102|| jajāgāra harirlokavyavahāreṇa vai tataḥ | jajāgarurdehinaśca miṣṭavādyasvaraśravaiḥ ||1 0 3|| ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīprātarjayantīdevatā mudhā | bhūtvā kumārikā divyā sarvabhūṣāvibhūṣitā || 1 04|| āyayau divyadehenāpūjayacchrīpatiṃ patim | adṛśyā nyavasat kṛṣṇe tato’khiladinaṃ satī ||1 05|| evaṃ badrīpriye jāto mahotsavastu dehinām | pūjanārthaṃ janāḥ sajjā bhavanti sarvatastadā || 1 06|| divyacintāmaṇikalpyāḥ sāmagrīḥ sarvajātikāḥ | saha nitvāyayuḥ pūjākaraṇārthaṃ tadantikam || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śarkarāpattanamaṇḍape sāyaṃ sabhāyāṃ śrīharikṛtopadeśo hareḥ pūjanaṃ niśyutsavāḥ prātardevādikṛtarahaḥpūjanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvācatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 42 ||
<4.43> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi śrīkṛṣṇasya mahotsavam | ekaviṃśatike janmadine kṛṣṇe tu kārtike || 1 || prātareva hariṃ rājñyaḥ snapayitvā janārdanam | sarvakāmapradaṃ kāntaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 2 || candanairgandhasāraiśca mahauṣadhirasānvitaiḥ | jalaistīrthāhṛtaistailamiśritaiḥ kaisarai rasaiḥ || 3 || upasaṃprasumṛdyābhiṣiñcya mārjanamācaran | vastradhāraṇaśṛṃgārabhūṣāpuṣpādyadhārayan || 4 || mukuṭaṃ kaṭake svarṇajāte hārām̐śca kānakān | ratnamāṇikyahīrakamauktikasphaṭikānvitān || 5 || adhārayan hareḥ kaṇṭhe tilakaṃ candrakaṃ vyadhuḥ | bhāle kaisaracandraṃ ca kajjalaṃ netrayostathā || 6 || karṇāvataṃsakau ramyau karṇapūrau nyadhārayan | raśanāṃ kānakīṃ kaṭyāṃ nūpure pādayostathā || 7 || prakoṣṭhayoḥ śṛṅkhale cāṅgulyādāvūrmikādikam | cūḍāmaṇiṃ kuṇḍale ca graiveyakīyamālikāḥ || 8 || kaṭake ca maṇīn nyadhārayan suvarṇapāduke | koṭyarbudābjamūlyādhimahāmaṇīnadhārayan || 9 || yatprakāśastu sarvatra madhyandinabhramāvahaḥ | pādahastatalayoścālaktakādi nyadhārayan || 4.43.10 || sauvarṇacūrṇasaṃvyāptagātrāṇyapi hyakārayan | saindhavāśvanibhe svarṇāsane śrīsvāmivallabham || 11 || nyaṣādayam̐stadā rājñyaḥ sindhujānāṃ tu bhūbhujām | prathamaṃ tā maṃgalāni kṛtvā kṛṣṇamapūpujan || 12|| dhṛtvopadāḥ svarṇarūpyamaṇihāramayīḥ puraḥ | nyadhuste pādayorvāri prakṣālitaṃ papuḥ payaḥ || 13| ārārtrikaṃ vyadhū rājñyaḥ puṣpākṣatādivardhitam | duḥkhahānyañjalīn kṛṣṇaśiraṣṭaścāvatārayan || 14|| pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavacca kṣamāṃ yayācire dayām | dineśvarī bhāṇavāṇyā rāyaharervicittatām || 15|| nivedyāyācata svāsthyaṃ sukhaṃ ca śāśvataṃ tataḥ | haristāṃ samuvācāpi svāsthyamadyaiva śobhanam || 1 6|| bhaviṣyatyeva mā cintā kuru rājñi sukhaṃ bhavet | kṣaṇānte koṭirāyo’pi rāyahariṃ nṛpaṃ tviha || 17|| nītvā tvāyāspati pūjāṃ kartuṃ me svasthamānasam | bhāṇavāṇīṃ puro me’tra samānaya dineśvari || 18|| ityuktā badrike dineśvarī rājñī drutaṃ tadā | bhāṇavāṇīṃ vicittāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāntike || 1 9|| dineśvaryānayat kṛṣṇo bhāṇavāṇīṃ tu mastake | pasparśa pāṇinā mīnadhvajaśūladhanuṣmatā ||4.43.20|| tāvat sā svasthitimatī pāvanī jñānayoginī | nirāmayā ca nirvyādhiḥ paṇḍitevābhavad drutam ||21|| vaicittyaṃ vigataṃ tasyāḥ subuddhātvaṃ samāgatam | patitā pādayoḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sā tataḥ ||22|| pūjāṃ kṛtvā śrīhareścopadā dadau ramājuṣe | ārārtrikaṃ vidhāyāpi kṛṣṇapādajalaṃ papau ||23|| arthayāmāsa mokṣaṃ sā sarvapāpavināśanam | bandhanānāṃ vāsanānāṃ mūlanāśaṃ samārthayat ||24|| dyūtapāpavināśaṃ ca vyavāyapāpanāśanam | muktānikāsthitiṃ sāpi prārthayat paramātmataḥ ||25|| tathāstviti hariḥ prāha tāvat sā divyatāṃ gatā | divyadehā devatāvad divyaiśvaryā babhūva ha ||26|| kṛpāleśena kṛṣṇasya nirvāṇikābhavat satī | jīvanmuktābhavattūrṇaṃ dehāvaraṇavarjitā ||27|| aho kṛpā harerjātā yatnaśūnye’pi vigrahe | sayatnānāṃ tu vai siddhiḥ pūrvabhāvaṃ na saṃgatā ||28|| atha tatra mahāścaryaṃ vīkṣya kanyāḥ sahasraśaḥ | saubhāgyavatyo nāryaśca sadhavā vidhavā api ||29|| bālikāścāpi vṛddhāśca pupūjuḥ parameśvaram | bhāṇavāṇīṃ divyadehāṃ vyadhāt kṛṣṇeti mohitāḥ ||4.43.30|| tāḥ sarvā bhāvanāyuktā yathābhāvāstathābhavan | divyaguṇā divyadehā divyakriyāḥ sudevatāḥ ||3 1 || divyanetrā divyabhāvā rādhāramāsamāstadā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasparśena yoṣitaḥ ||32|| brahmapriyā abhavam̐śca haripriyāḥ sahasraśaḥ | mantraṃ tā jagṛhuḥ kṛṣṇamukhāt kārṣṇībhavecchayā ||33|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | bahvyastatrābhavan rugṇāstadrogān sa nyavārayat ||34|| bahvīnāṃ tvanapatyatvaṃ kṛṣṇastat sannyavārayat | anyāsāṃ kleśavattvādi kleśām̐stāsāṃ nyavārayat ||35|| tathānyāsāṃ nirdhanatvaṃ dāridryaṃ sa nyavārayat | anyāsāṃ tu patiprāptimattvaṃ sa kṛpayākarot ||36|| saubhāgyavattvamanyāsāṃ sampadvattvaṃ samuttamam | cakāra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvasukhārpaṇam ||37|| rājñīnāṃ pūjanakāryaṃ samāptaṃ ca prajāstriyaḥ | apūjayan hariṃ sarvā lakṣaśaḥ koṭiśaḥ striyaḥ ||38|| koṭirūpadharaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vyajāyata | tattannārīpuraḥsthitvā kāntaḥ pūjāmavālabhat ||39|| āśīrvādām̐stā agṛhṇan śubhāśiṣo dadau hariḥ | sarvāsāṃ hṛdaye kṛṣṇo divyavāsaṃ sadā vyadhāt ||4.43.40|| evaṃ ghaṭikāmātraṃ vai mahāścaryacamatkṛtim | pradarśya tu tatastirobhūyaikarūpatāṃ yayau ||41 || nārīvarge na cāpyekā kṛṣṇayoge’vaśiṣyate | dayāṃ kṛtvā tathā kṛṣṇaḥ pūjāṃ jagrāha sarvadhṛk ||42|| atha tṛptiṃ gatā nāryo dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā prapūjya tam | prāpya prāsādikaṃ bhojyaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ dalaṃ jalam ||43|| snehaṃ netrakaṭākṣaṃ ca saumyahāsyaṃ manastathā | kṛtakṛtyā abhavam̐stā divyabhautikavigrahāḥ ||44|| evaṃ hariḥ prāpya pūjāṃ nārīṇāṃ divyabhāvanām | divyaiśvaryayutāṃ cāpi tirobhāvaṃ gato’cyutaḥ ||45|| tataḥ sarvāḥ sthiravṛttyā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vilulokire | parabrahma punaḥ kaścinnārāyaṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim | |46|| śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rādhikākāntaṃ lalitāsvāminaṃ harim | svāmināthaṃ tu māṇikyāḥ padmāvatyāḥ patiṃ tathā ||47|| kāścittu badrikānāthaṃ kāścicchrībhūpatiṃ tathā | kāścittu kamalānāthaṃ prajñeśaṃ vilulokire ||48|| tataḥ śrīkuṃkumavāpīnāthaṃ taṃ vilulokire | evaṃ vīkṣya mahānandaṃ sarvānandām̐śca lebhire ||49|| saindhavyaḥ śrīhariṃ prāpya dhāminyaḥ saṃbabhūvire | vaiṣṇavyaḥ paramā jātāḥ puṇyānāṃ sarito yathā ||4.43.50|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāminvallabhāyeti tā jaguḥ | dadhyuḥ śrīparamātmānaṃ cāntarasthaṃ bahiḥsthitam ||51 || evaṃ badrīpriye prātarnārīpūjanamuttamam | nivṛttaṃ ca tato rājā koṭirāyaḥ samāyayau ||52|| bahubhirnṛpaśārdūlai rājanyai rājayogibhiḥ | rājyapālai rāṣṭrapālaiḥ sainyapālaiḥ sahāyayau ||53|| rājopacāraiḥ sakalaiḥ pūjayāmāsa mādhavam | koṭimūlyamaṇiratnanaddhaṃ mukuṭaṃ kānakam ||54|| kuṇḍale ratnakhacite kaṇṭhahārān suvarṇajān | karṇapūrān kaṭakām̐ścāṃgadān suvarṇaśṛṃkhalāḥ ||55|| ūrmikā raśanāṃ ratnanaddhāṃ hārān suvarṇajān | maṇimālā maṇikalgiṃ maṇimañjīranūpurān ||96|| ārpayaddharaye bhāle kṛtvā cāndanacandrakam | sugandhamarpayāmāsa puṣpahārān sumālikāḥ ||57|| bhūṣāśṛṃgāravastrāṇi bahumūlyāni cārpayat | svarṇapātrāṇi ramyāṇi svarṇahetīn susundarān | |58|| sauvarṇakhelakām̐ścāpi śrīkṛṣṇāya tadārpayat | dhūpadīpākṣatavārinaivedyārārtrikādibhiḥ ||59|| amūlyaratnamaṇibhirbhṛtaiḥ sthālaiḥ suvarṇajaiḥ | svarṇāḍhyopakaraṇādyaiśchatracāmaravetrakaiḥ ||4.43.6 0|| pūjayitvā hariṃkṛṣṇaṃ toṣayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ | tilakaṃ subhagaṃ bhāle kṛṣṇasya nṛpamācarat ||61 || nṛpāścānye ca rājanyāḥ kumārā rājayoginaḥ | rājasambandhinaḥ śreṣṭhivaryā rājyādhikāriṇaḥ ||62|| kastūrīkesaragandhasārakuṃkumakardamaiḥ | puṣpākṣatajalavṛndāpatrayavāṃkurādibhiḥ ||63|| prapūjya mādhavīkṛṣṇaṃ natvā pītvā padāmṛtam | ārārtrikaṃ vyadhuścāśīrvādān daduḥ śubhāvahān ||64|| koṭirāyastadā rāyahariṃ svasthasthitiṃ gatam | prairayat parameśasya pūjārthaṃ tatra sotsukam ||65 || nirāmayo gataśāpaḥ sarvabhānaprabodhavān | śrīkṛṣṇaṃvallabhaṃcāryaṃ pupūja paramādarāt ||66|| atha sarvaprajāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ janmajayantikotsave | utsukāḥ pūjayāmāsurīśeśvareśvareśvaram ||67|| tadānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇadivyasvarūpakam | vyadyotatākṣaradhāmāśritaṃ yadvat parātparam ||68|| lomaśādyā munayo’pi maharṣayaśca devatāḥ | siddhāḥ satyaḥ sādhavaścānarcuḥ śrībālakṛṣṇakam ||69|| āśīrvādān daduścāpi sūtamāgadhacāraṇāḥ | bandinaḥ kavayo bhaṭṭā vavandire śubhāśayāḥ ||4.43.70 || evaṃ madhyāhnavelāntaṃ janmajayantikotsavaḥ | samabhavattadā badri bhojanāni tato’bhavan ||71|| sāyaṃ sabhābhavad ramyā lakṣādhimānavāśritā | svaprakāśo hi bhagavānnupādideśa tatra ha |||73|| mānave khalu loke’tra śreṣṭhaṃ mānaṃ pareśvaraḥ | parameśakṛtamānā mānitā netare kvacit ||73|| śrīkṛṣṇaśrīpatinārāyaṇānādipumuttamaḥ | virājate’tra bhagavān bhavatāṃ mānakārakaḥ ||74|| bhavadbhirmānitaḥ kṛṣṇo bhavanto mānitāstataḥ | yeṣāṃ mānaṃ hareragre teṣāṃ sarvatra mānitā ||75||| yadgṛhe bhagavānāste sarve divyā hi te matāḥ | gṛhastho’pi hariṃ naije gṛhe yaḥ sthāpayet sadā ||76|| sādhureva gṛhasthaḥ sa yadgṛhaṃ mādhavātmakam | nārī nārāyaṇapūjākarī sādhvī tu sā matā ||77|| rājāpi rājate yatra śrīkṛṣṇena parātmanā | sa rājā sādhurevāsti yadgṛhe śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ||78|| rājñī nirmānadāsīva sevate parameśvaram | sā rājñī sarvadā sādhvī yato nārāyaṇaśritā ||79|| rāṣṭrīyāstu prajā yā yāḥ sevante mādhavīśvaram | sarvāḥ sādhvyo hi mantavyā yadgṛhe bhagavāniti ||4.43.80|| dhanavanto hariṃ ye tu sevante sādhavo’pi te | dhanaṃ nārāyaṇo yeṣāṃ te santaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ ||81|| san vai nārāyaṇastaṃ ye cānte dharanti sarvathā | taranti tena cānyām̐śca tārayanti bhavārṇavāt |||82|| santaste tvatra saṃsāre sādhnuvanti pumarthakam | vyāpārastu bhaved yeṣāṃ kṛṣṇārthaṃ sādhavastu te ||83|| vyavasāyo bhaved yeṣāṃ kṛṣṇātmā sādhavo’pi te | yatayo yatnavanto ye harau te santa īritāḥ ||84|| saṃnyāsino harau ye te santo mokṣaparāyaṇāḥ | vane vāsakarāḥ kṛṣṇe magnāste sādhavo matāḥ |||85|| yogaṃ kṛṣṇe prayuñjānāḥ sādhavaste’pi yoginaḥ | tapaḥ kṛṣṇaparaṃ yeṣāṃ tāpasāḥ sādhavastu te ||86|| vrataṃ yeṣāṃ pare kṛṣṇe sādhavo vratinaśca te | yajñā yeṣāṃ harau kṛṣṇe sādhavo yajñinastu te |||87|| jīvanaṃ śrīharau yeṣāṃ jīvanmuktā hi sādhavaḥ | rāgo’rpito harau kṛṣṇe vītarāgā hi sādhavaḥ ||88| indriyārthāḥ kṛtāḥ kṛṣṇe sādhakāḥ sādhavastu te | pravṛttiṃ parameśe ye kurvanti sādhavo’pi te ||89|| brahma śrīparamātmaiva tatra caranti muktaye | ye te brahmacarāḥ proktā brahmacāriṇa eva te ||4.43.90|| mananaṃ śrīhareryeṣāṃ munayaḥ sādhavo hi te | ārṣaṃ jñānaṃ hareryeṣām ṛṣayaḥ sādhavastu te ||9 1 || divyabhāvo harau yeṣāṃ devatā api sādhavaḥ | karma sarvaṃ pare yeṣāṃ parārthāḥ sādhavo’pi te ||92|| vṛttayaḥ sarvathā kṛṣṇe yeṣāṃ te dhyānisādhavaḥ | samādhānaṃ harau yeṣāṃ samādhisthā hi sādhavaḥ ||93|| kuṭumbaṃ yasya kṛṣṇārthaṃ santaḥ kuṭumbinastu te | saṃkhyāḥ sarvā harau yeṣāṃ sāṃkhyāste sādhavo matāḥ ||94|| ajñānāt prathamaṃ janma tato jñāne dvitīyakam | dvijāste sādhavo bodhyā mokṣajñānaparāyaṇāḥ ||95|| dehāttu prathamaṃ janma dīkṣayā tu dvitīyakam | nārāyaṇe dīkṣitā ye dvijāste sādhavo matāḥ ||96|| saṃsāraḥ prathamaṃ janma mokṣo janma dvitīyakam | mokṣadvijāḥ sādhavaste sarveṣāṃ tārakā bhuvi ||97|| māyāyāṃ sādhanaṃ tvādyaṃ tataḥ sādhuṣu sādhanam | ta ete tyāginaḥ santaḥ sarvamāyāvivarjitāḥ ||98|| patiyogaṃ prapannāpi prapannā yā narāyaṇam | sā patnī strī bhavet sādhvī nārāyaṇī satīśvarī ||99|| udāsīnā gṛhe yā tu nārāyaṇe tu yā sthitā | sādhusevāparā sādhvī bhavet sā brahmacāriṇī || 4.43.10 0|| ātmasādhanasañcārā mokṣasādhanatatparāḥ | sakriyāste sādhavo vai kṛṣṇakarmaparāyaṇāḥ || 101 || kṛṣṇe śaucaṃ sadā yeṣāṃ śucayaḥ sādhavastu te | kīrtanaṃ sarvadā kṛṣṇe svādhyāyasādhavastu te ||102|| hareḥ puro bhaved yasyāsanaṃ sādhuḥ sadāsanaḥ | prāṇe prāṇe hariryasya sādhuḥ prāṇāsanaḥ sa hi || 1 03|| āhāre bhagavān yasya sādhurāhāranāmavān | śāntirharau bhaved yasya śāntaḥ sādhuḥ sa vai mataḥ ||104|| yoginā śrīharau kṛṣṇe bhavitavyaṃ tu dehinā | sahanīyaṃ kaṣṭamādyaṃ kṣamā kāryāparādhiṣu || 1 09|| na kaṣṭaṃ sampradātavyaṃ kasyacidapi karmaṇā | manasā vāpi dehena vacasāpi kadācana || 1 06|| satyaṃ sampālanīyaṃ ca stainyaṃ tyājyaṃ tu yoginā | santoṣaḥ sarvathā rakṣyo bhāvyaṃ pāṣāṇakalpinā || 1 07|| svādastu sarvathā grāhyo yoginā paramātmani | ratiḥ prītirharau deyā yoginā brahmacāriṇā || 1 08|| ācāro’pi harau pālyaḥ sādhunā kṛṣṇayoginā | śrutārthaṃ śrīharau kuryācchrautaḥ sādhuḥ sa yogirāṭ || 1 09|| smṛtārthaṃ sarvathā kṛṣṇe yuñjyāt sādhuḥ sa yojakaḥ | bālyaṃ vā yauvanaṃ vāpi vārdhakyaṃ parameśvare || 4.43.11 0|| naratvaṃ pramadātvaṃ cārpaṇīyaṃ parameśvare | ta ete sādhavaḥ santi sādhanācchrīpaterhṛdi || 111 || bhūtvā sādhava evātra kṛṣṇaṃ kṛtvā nijaṃ patim | prayāntu vai narā nāryo dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ prabhoḥ || 112|| adyajanmajayantyasti hyanādiparamātmanaḥ | vardhitā sā bhavadbhirvai mahotsavena yojitā || 11 3|| bhavatāṃ sindhulokānāṃ karotvabhyudayaṃ param | paraṃ niḥśreyasaṃ cāpi kalyāṇaṃ paramaṃ tathā || 1 14|| śāśvataṃ ca mahānandaṃ karotu śrīhareḥ pade | enaṃ tvanādinidhanaṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam || 1 15|| sadā dhyāyantu hṛdaye santo bhavantu sādhavaḥ | sarvavidhāni svargāṇi bhavantu bhavatāmiha || 1 16|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprasādatastviha | prasanno bhagavānnasti bālakṛṣṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ || 1 7|| svasti vo’stu kuśalaṃ vo mahāsvargaṃ sadāstu vaḥ | mahāvaṃśādivistāro vaiṣṇavo’stu sadā tu vaḥ || 1 18|| bhavatāṃ ca gṛhe kṣetre sādhuvāso’stu mokṣadaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavāso bhavatsu ca || 1 19|| ityāśīrvacanānyuktvā prasvaprakāśaḥ īśvaraḥ | upārarāma yugapajjayanādāstato’bhavan || 4.43.120|| jayatvanādibhagavān bālakṛṣṇo jayatviha | sarvāntargatiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jayatviha || 121 || ityevaṃ jayanādaiśca tūryanādaiḥ surādibhiḥ | kṛtābhivādanādaiśca sabhā samāptimāgamat || 122|| hariryayau nijāvāsaṃ yayuḥ sarve nijālayān | koṭirāyo rāyahariṃ natvā kṛṣṇālayaṃ yayau || 1 23|| uvāca paramātmānaṃ yadarthaṃ bhagavānniha | āhūtaḥ sarvamevātra sampannaṃ nṛpamokṣaṇam || 124||| śāpamokṣo’tra sañjātaḥ paro mokṣo’pi vartate | kare gato bhagavato vīkṣaṇena hi dehinām || 125 || atha kṛṣṇājñayā rājyaṃ sindhudeśapradeśajam | ardhamardhaṃ cakratustau hāyaudaryaṃ ca śārkaram ||1 26|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dhyātvā lebhāte śāśvataṃ sukham | rātrau bhojanapānādi kṛtvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 1 27|| viśrāntiṃ paramāṃ lebhe siṣevire janāstu tam | badrike śrīharirnidrāmavāpa divyavigrāhām || 128|| evaṃ siddhiṃ parāṃ divyāṃ dadau tebhyo hariḥ svayam | hareḥ kṛpā satāṃ yadvā mokṣadā sarvaśāntidā || 1 29|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā tu sādhvī hi mokṣadā | sarvasiddhimayī vidyā parabrahmaprasañjinī || 4.43.1 30|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne janmajayantyutsave nārīṇāṃ narāṇāṃ pūjāgrahaṇaṃ bhāṇavāṇīrāyaharyornirāmayatākaraṇaṃ, sabhā, sādhutvavivecanaṃ viśrāntiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tricatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 43 ||
<4.44> śrībadrīpriyādevī uvāca kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre naranārāyaṇaprabho | bālakṛṣṇabhagavato janmajayantikotsavaḥ || 1 || kīdṛśo’pyabhavat tatra dvitīyarūpayoginaḥ | saṃkṣepācchrotucchāmi kathāṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ || 2 || śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi divyarūpo haristadā | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre bahurūpāṇyadhārayat || 3 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpaḥ svayaṃprabhuḥ | lomaśo’pyabhavat sarvamaharṣirūpavām̐stathā || 4 || svayaṃprakāśasvarūpaśca dāsadāsīsvarūpavān | bhaktabhaktānikārūpadharaḥ kṛṣṇastadābhavat || 5 || ye ye sindhuṃ gatāsteṣāṃ mūrtidhṛg veṣadhṛk prabhuḥ | sarvacihnopakaraṇadhṛkprabhustu tadābhavat || 6 || viśvakarmā samāhūto nārāyaṇena tatra ca | brahmā viṣṇurmaheśaśca mahendravaruṇādayaḥ || 7 || siddhā maharṣayo muktā muktānikāstatheśvarāḥ | devā devyaśca bhūdevāścaikaviṃśatikotsave || 8 || āyayuḥ śrīhareḥ pūjākaraṇārthaṃ prage tadā | aṣṭamyāṃ kārtikekṛṣṇe viprāścāpi samāyayuḥ || 9 || surāḥ surāṇyo devāśca lokapālāḥ samāyayuḥ | saurāṣṭravāsinaścānye kṣitidvīpanivāsinaḥ || 4.44.10 || janmajayantikāmahotsavaṃ kartuṃ samāyayuḥ | tadā brahmapriyāḥ sarvā haripriyāśca devatāḥ || 11 || śṛṃgāraṃ śrīpatikṛṣṇasvāminaḥ saṃvyadhurmudā | abhiṣekottaraṃ veṣaṃ bhūṣāśobhāṃ pracakrire || 12|| tilakaṃ candrakaṃ bhāle kuṃkumākṣatakardamaiḥ | kesaraiḥ kastūrikaiśca sugandhisārasaddravaiḥ || 13|| prapūjyārārtrikaṃ cakruḥ puṣpadīpapradānakaiḥ | āśīrbhirvardhayāmāsuḥ prajñeśaṃ mādhavīpatim || 1 4|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vikuṇṭhāparameśvaram | upadābhirvividhābhistoṣaṇaṃ tasya saṃvyadhuḥ || 15|| divyajñānā devavaryā āścaryaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ | sindhutīre haristvāste tathāste’śvasarastaṭe || 16|| nijajanmajayantyā utsavārthaṃ kṛpayā dvidhā | brahmā nīrājanaṃ cakre, lokapālāḥ pracakrire || 17|| viprā mantrairdravyavaryaiḥ pūjāṃ cakruḥ parātmanaḥ | evaṃ prātarmahāñjāta usivo’śvasarastaṭe || 18|| bhojanānyabhavam̐ścāpi sāyaṃ sabhābhavacchubhā | lomaśo divyarūpeṇa sabhākāryaṃ tadā vyadhāt || 1 9|| upādideśa bahudhā saurāṣṭrīyaprajājanān | utsave cāgatām̐llokān sarvabhūminivāsinaḥ ||4.44.20 || lokakalyāṇakartāyaṃ bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ | ekadhā bahudhā cāste sarvaśreyaḥkṛpāvaśaḥ ||2 1|| sindhudeśe vartate’dya saurāṣṭre cātra vartate | akṣare parame dhāmni vartate hṛdayeṣu naḥ ||22|| kṣīrākhye sāgare cāste śvetadvīpe’pi vartate | śrībadaryāśrame cāste kṣetre ca pauruṣottame |||22||| mūladvāravatīpūryāṃ tathā merau virājate | bhṛgorgṛhe sa evāste dharmadevagṛhe’pi ca ||24|| vahnau sūrye tayā candre satyaloke virājate | vaikuṇṭhe śrīpure cāste’vyākṛte cāmṛte pade || 25|| goloke sa hariścāste tathākṣare pare pade | sarvadhāmasu sarveśaḥ sa evāste hariḥ svayam ||26|| harerjanmotsavaścādyaikaviṃśatiguṇātmakaḥ | sarvalokeṣu sarvatra mahīyate sthale sthale ||27|| tatra tatrānyarūpeṇa vartate bhagavānayam | bhaktivaśo hi bhagavān bhajatāmeti bhaktatām ||28|| viguṇo nirguṇo vāpi bhaktaḥ priyaḥ parātmanaḥ | durācāro hyanācāro bhaktaḥ priyaḥ parātmanaḥ ||29|| ajñaḥ sujñaśca vijño vā bhaktaḥ priyaḥ parātmanaḥ | nirmalo vā vimalo vā bhaktaḥ priyaḥ parātmanaḥ ||4.44.30|| nārī ṣaṇḍho naro vāpi bhaktaḥ priyaḥ parātmanaḥ | devo daityo rākṣaso vā nāgo vā cañcumānapi ||3 1|| sakhuro vā sapuccho vā bhaktaḥ priyaḥ parātmanaḥ | api māyāmayo dehī māyāyogaparāyaṇaḥ ||32|| cet sa bhakto’nanyabhaktaḥ sa priyaḥ paramātmanaḥ | kṛṣṇasya sādhanāt sādhuḥ priyaḥ śrīparamātmanaḥ ||33|| vṛddhaścālolupaścāpi tathātmavānnadāmbhikaḥ | samyagvinītaḥ saralaḥ priya ācārya īśituḥ ||34|| dayāvatāṃ bhajaneṣu sthitānāṃ sutapasvinām | mayi nyāsavatāṃ snehavatāṃ ca vaśagātmanām ||35|| viraktānāṃ jñānijāṃ ca dāntānāṃ dānināṃ tathā | satyasthānāmalubdhānāṃ brahmātmabhāvadarśinām ||36|| kṛṣṇabhaktyaviruddhānāṃ prasīdati pareśvaraḥ | yasyālasyaṃ na vai bhaktau pramādo nāsti sarvathā ||37|| śraddhā ca vartate kṛṣṇe tasmin kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati | daurmanasyaṃ ca nāstikyaṃ yasminnaivāsti sarvathā || 38|| svārthabuddhirna yasyāsti bhaktau mānaṃ na vidyate | saṃśayo yasya naivāsti tasmin kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati ||39|| utsāhasahite nityaṃ saṃsmartari parātmanaḥ | sevāparāyaṇe bhakte dāse kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati ||4.44.40|| sarvaśrave sarvadarśinyarthabodhayute’niśam | sarvasparśavidi bhaktiyute kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati ||41 || sarvāsvādavati divyagandhamātrādisaṃvidi | seśvarye’nāvaraṇāḍhye bhakte kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati ||42|| jalavāse’nalavāse bhūvāse gahvarasthite | apyākāśanivāse’pi bhakte kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati ||43|| meghadhāre’dridhāre ca svargadhāre dharādhare | api bhaktidhare kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdatyeva nānyathā ||44|| dehādagnivinirmāṇaśakte tāpabhayojjhite | dāhavāraṇaśakte’pi bhakte kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati ||45|| jalamadhye’nalarakṣākare’nale jalagrahe | bhasmībhūte’pi nirmāṇe śakte bhakte prasīdati ||46|| parakāyapraveśādau śakte parvatadhāraṇe | pāṇibhyāṃ vāyurodhe ca śakte bhakte prasīdati ||47||| aṃgulyagranighātena bhūkampe śaktiśālini | sahasrarūpadhāre’pi bhakte kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati ||48|| ākāśagamane śakte sarvaśabdāvagāhane | yathākāmopalambhe ca śakte bhakte prasīdati ||49|| chedane tāḍane bandhe saṃsāraparivartane | mṛtyorjaye pralaye’pi śakte bhakte prasīdati ||4.44.50 || vaitṛṣṇye vartamāno’pi kṛṣṇalīlāparo na cet | kṛṣṇabhaktivihīnaścet kṛṣṇo nātra prasīdati ||51|| ākāśe krīḍate yaśca sūkṣmānarthān samṛcchati | sarvarutajñatāṃ yāti bhaktiṃ cenna karoti saḥ ||52| | tasmin śuṣke jane kṛṣṇaḥ kadāpi na prasīdati | tejorūpāṇi sarvāṇi yastu yadyapi paśyati ||53|| devabimbānyanekāni vimānānyapi paśyati | paśyati brahmaviṣṇvindrayamāgnivaruṇeśvarān ||54|| grahanakṣatratārāśca pātālabhuvanānyapi | yadyātmānaṃ parātmānaṃ snehabhaktyā na paśyati ||55|| ātmavidyāvihīnaścet kṛṣṇasevojjhitastathā | sattvaprasādahīnaśca kṛṣṇakṛpāmṛtojjhitaḥ ||56|| sādhusevāvihīnaścet tasya sarvaṃ nirarthakam | aśāśvataṃ kālabhojyaṃ tasyānte vai nirarthakam ||57||| anaiśvaryaṃ tathājñānaṃ hyadharmo rāga ityamī | yatra syuḥ so’pi bhaktaścet tasmin kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati ||58|| bhaktyā tuṣyati sarveśo bhaktihīne na tuṣyati | sādhusevāpare kṛṣṇo viśeṣeṇa pratuṣyati ||59|| sādhvīsevāparāyāṃ tu nāryāṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sadā santuṣṭo bhavati prabhākṛṣṇo dayāluracyutaḥ ||4.44.60|| paiśācaṃ bandhanaṃ kāmo rākṣasaṃ bandhanaṃ striyaḥ | yākṣaṃ tu bandhanaṃ dravyaṃ tattyāge tuṣyati prabhuḥ ||6 1 || gāndharvaṃ bandhana nāṭyaṃ māhendraṃ mandirāṇi vai | saumyaṃ tu bandhanaṃ kīrtistattyāge tuṣyati prabhuḥ ||62|| sauraṃ tu bandhanaṃ sattā prājāpatyaṃ tu vaṃśajāḥ | vaidhasaṃ bandhanaṃ dhiṣṇyaṃ tattyāge tuṣyati prabhuḥ ||63|| patistu bandhanaṃ raudraṃ sampado vaiṣṇavaṃ tu tat | vāsanā bandhanaṃ yāmyaṃ tattyāge tuṣyati prabhuḥ ||64|| dānavaṃ bandhanaṃ lobho tṛṣṇā daiteyabandhanam | viṣayā bandhanaṃ sārpaṃ tattyāge tuṣyati prabhuḥ ||65|| āgneyaṃ bandhanaṃ vairaṃ dveṣo nairṛtamucyate | bandhanaṃ nārakaṃ śaiśnaṃ yaunaṃ garbhaṃ tu bandhanam ||66|| pratiṣṭhā bandhanaṃ daurgaṃ gauravaṃ tattu rauravam | gārvaṃ tu bandhanaṃ bhautaṃ tattyāge tuṣyati prabhuḥ ||67|| vicchidya śithilīkṛtya jīrṇīkṛtya vināśya ca | bandhanāni vinirbandho yastasmim̐stuṣyati prabhuḥ ||68|| puṇyaṃ tu bandhanaṃ vārṣaṃ sāmarthyaṃ tattu daivatam | brāhmaṃ sattvotkarṣarūpaṃ tattyāge tuṣyati prabhuḥ ||69|| nirguṇaṃ bandhanaṃ kārṣṇaṃ bhaktirnirvāṇabandhanam | bandhanaṃ sat sādhusevā tadgrahe tuṣyati prabhuḥ ||4.44.70|| varṣmaṇā manasā dravyaiḥ sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ | sādhvyaḥ sarvārpaṇaiḥ sevyā mokṣadā hi prasāditāḥ ||7 1 || hariḥ satsu ca sādhvīṣu vartate mūrtimānapi | sarvakāmaprapūro naḥ sevanīyaḥ sa
