tadgataḥ ||72|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | japanīyaḥ sadā caivaṃ mantrātmā parameśvaraḥ ||73|| hṛdaye rakṣaṇīyo’yaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ | mokṣāmṛtamahānandapradātā kṛṣṇayogakṛt ||74|| kṛṣṇaḥ svāmī mamādastīti smartavyaḥ sarvadā hariḥ | sarvavāñchitadātāyaṃ sākṣād bhavati sarvathā ||75||| dānaṃ deyaṃ haraye vai vrataṃ kāryaṃ hareḥ kṛte | tapastapyaṃ tu kṛṣṇārthaṃ yogaḥ sādhyo hareḥ kṛte ||76|| makhaḥ kāryastu kṛṣṇārthaṃ tīrthaṃ kāryaṃ hareḥ kṛte | japaḥ kāryastu kṛṣṇārthaṃ snehaḥ kāryo hareḥ kṛte ||77|| satkarmāṇi samastāni kartavyāni hareḥ kṛte | ātmasaṃśodhanaṃ kāryaṃ śrīkṛṣṇārthaṃ sadā śubham ||78|| divyabhāvo grahītavyo mokṣārthaṃ harimandire | sevā satāṃ svātmavattu kartavyā kṛṣṇatuṣṭaye ||79|| ākṣaraṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ sevanīyaṃ vimuktaye | kuṃkumavāpikā sevyānādikṛṣṇasya labdhaye ||4.44.80 || raktaṃ tu kuṃkumakṣetraṃ śvetaṃ cāśvasarovaram | kṛṣṇakṣetramanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||81 || trayaṃ sevyaṃ sadā bhaktyā prītyā sattvena śraddhayā | prītiśca kaukumaṃ kṣetraṃ sattvaṃ tvaśvasarovaram |||82|| śraddhā kṛṣṇamayī bodhyā tryātmakaṃ mokṣasādhanam | prītiḥ kṛṣṇe sadāsaktiḥ sattvaṃ kṛṣṇe nijasthitiḥ ||83|| śraddhā kṛṣṇe’rpaṇaṃ naijaṃ tryātmakaṃ mokṣasādhanam | raktatā kuṃkumaṃ kṛṣṇe śvetatā ca raso harau ||84|| kṛṣṇatā karṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇe tryātmakaṃ mokṣasādhanam | mayi kṣetre harī rakto mayi sāre ito hariḥ ||85|| mayi kṛṣyāṃ harirvaptastato’haṃ harireva hi | tādātmyaṃ hariṇā sākaṃ haryātmāhaṃ samaśnuve ||86|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmisarvānandabhṛtaprabhum | evaṃ nārāyaṇe kṛṣṇe kartavyo yoga uttamaḥ ||87|| bhavapāre’tisaṃsāratārake parameśvare | svasti vo’stu svāgataṃ vo vidāyaṃ vo bhavatvapi ||88|| kṣamāpanīyo bhagavān sammāne laukike kṛte | ityuktvā lomaśaḥ sāyaṃ sabhāntaṃ prākarot tadā ||89|| bhuktvā pītvā ca haryājñāṃ nītvā yayurnijālayān | rātrau sammānitāḥ samyag bhojitāḥ pūjitā api ||4.44.90|| sevitā nidritā mahīmānāḥ prātaryayustataḥ | praśaṃsanto harernāma lomaśasyopadeśanam ||91 || śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaṃ ca kambharāśrīṃ ca mātaram | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ tathā cāśvasarovaram ||92|| praśaṃsanto hariṃ svargādikaṃ yayuḥ sureśvarāḥ | ityevaṃ badrike tatra janmajayantikotsavaḥ ||93|| dvitīyena svarūpeṇa śrīkṛṣṇaparamātmanā | kṛto manoharaḥ śreṣṭho lomaśena maharṣiṇā ||94|| brahmādyā devatāstūrṇaṃ sāyaṃ vimānatastataḥ | saurāṣṭraṃ samparityajyāyayuḥ sindhupradeśakān ||95|| yatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāste tu śārkare | nagare sindhuje deśe yatrāste lomaśo muniḥ ||96|| svaprakāśo’pi yatrāste saṃhitāvācako muniḥ | yatra lakṣmīśasaṃhitāpārāyaṇaṃ bhavatyapi ||97|| yatra yajño vartate ca ṛṣayaḥ santi saṃhitāḥ | tatrāgatya hariṃ nemuḥ pupūjuḥ śrutivallabham ||98|| jayaśabdān pracakruśca jayantīmaha ācāran | upadāśca nyadhuḥ kṛṣṇapādayoḥ punarityapi ||99|| ārārtrikaṃ vyadhū rātrau sevāṃ cakruḥ sukhapradām | rātriṃ ninyurmānitāste bhojitāḥ svāgatādibhiḥ ||4.44.10 0|| toṣitāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena sarvadevatāḥ | prātargantuṃ prasannāḥ saṃgṛhyājñāṃ paramātmanaḥ || 101|| āśīrvādānnṛpādīṃśca prayujya prayayurdivam | prātaḥ śrīkṛṣṇabhagavān snānavidhiṃ samācaran || 102| utsavā gītayaḥ kīrtanāni vādyaninādanam | bhāṭacāraṇabandīnāṃ stutayaḥ parito’bhavan || 103|| ityevaṃ badrike sarvaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakam | ākṣaraṃ tu yathā kṣetraṃ saindhavaṃ tattathābhavat ||1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre’pi dvitīyarūpeṇaikaviṃśatitamajanmajayantīdinotsave śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyopasthitirlomaśasyopadeśo devādīnāṃ mahotsavavinirvartanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuścatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 44 ||
<4.45> śrībadrīpriyovācabhagavan karuṇāsindho sindhudeśe tataḥ param | kiṃkiṃ cakāra bhagavān vada me sarvamañjasā || 1 || śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca prātarutthāya bhagavān navamyāṃ snānamācarat | veṣaṃ bhūṣāśca śṛṃgāraṃ yogyaṃ sarvaṃ dadhāra ha || 2 || tadā tūryāṇyavādyanta strīṇāṃ ca gītayo’bhavan | stāvakānāṃ giraścāpyaśrūyanta maṅgaloditāḥ || 3 || vaidikānāṃ mantraghoṣā abhavan maṇḍapāntike | yantraśabdā abhavam̐śca kṛṣṇaprabodhasūcakāḥ || 4 || ṛṣayo munayaḥ santaḥ pūjārthaṃ tatra cāyayuḥ | apūjayan parameśaṃ yathālabdhopacārakaiḥ || 5 || atha nāryo rājapatnyaḥ pūjārthaṃ tatra cāyayuḥ | apūjayan hariṃkṛṣṇaṃ mūrtiṃ tāṃ hṛdaye nyadhuḥ || 6 || atha rājādayastatra pūjanārthaṃ samāyayuḥ | bahumūlyopacāraistaṃ prāpūjayan mahīśvarāḥ || 7 || prajā nāryo narāstatrāyayurviprāśca devatāḥ | pūjanārthaṃ bhagavantamapūjayan vidhānataḥ || 8 || sarvalokā hariṃ pūjayitvā kṛtārthino’bhavan | tataḥ prāvartata dugdhapānaṃ ca bhojanādikam || 9 || tāmbūlārpaṇamevānte vidāyaṃ ca tato’bhavat | koṭirāyo rāyahariḥ prāghurṇikebhya ādarāt || 4.45.10|| pāritoṣikamutkṛṣṭaṃ pṛthag dadaturutsukau | mahīmānā yayurnaijān deśān vimānakaistataḥ || 11 || saṃhitāyā vācanārthaṃ kṛṣṇa ādiśya sevakam | svaprakāśaṃ ca sahasārārtrikaṃ saṃvidhāya ca || 1 2|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kṛtvā ca pūjanam | sajjo’bhavannijaṃ kṣetraṃ gantuṃ śrīkuṃkumākṣaram || 1 3|| tāvattatra samāyāto rājā kacchapradeśajaḥ | nāmnā mādhavarāyeti prārthayat parameśvaram || 14|| nārāyaṇasarastīraṃ pāvayituṃ ca kacchakam | bhujaṃganagaraṃ pāvayituṃ cārthayadīśvaram || 15|| tathā maharṣayo nārāyaṇasaronivāsinaḥ | dharmamokṣāyanādyāśca prārthayan parameśvaram || 16|| haristathāstviti prāha prasthitastaiḥ samaṃ tadā | sarvaiḥ prasthāpitaḥ sindhubhūbhṛdbhiḥ svīyasajjanaiḥ || 17|| svakīyena vimānena vidāyamānamānitaḥ | ambareṇa yathā tūrṇamāyayau kacchabhūtalam || 18|| nārāyaṇasarastīre’vātarat sa vimānataḥ | sasnau kṛtvā paraṃ tīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ parameśvaraḥ || 1 9|| tīrthatīre niṣasāda yāvattāvattu śaṃkaraḥ | āyayau pārvatīyukto bhraman kacche tu paścimāt ||4.45.20|| śvetarūpaṃ dharan śiṣyaiścaturbhiḥ saha mānasaiḥ | sanandena nandanena viśvanandanakena ca ||2 1|| upanandena sahitaḥ sadyojātābhidho haraḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīpuruṣottamam ||22| pupūja daṇḍavattatra praṇanāma muhurmuhuḥ | tuṣṭāva paramātmānaṃ mokṣadaṃ lokarakṣakam || 23|| nārāyaṇahare kṛṣṇa pāvitaṃ śrīsarovaram | tava nāpnā parāṃ khyātiṃ yathā gacchet tathā kuru ||24|| harirjagāda viśveśaṃ śaṃbho nārāyaṇaṃ saraḥ | śrīsaraśceti yat pūrvaṃ nārāyaṇasaro’dhunā ||21|| khyātiṃ yāsyati caitadvai purorvaśyā tu pāvitam | ūrvaśītīrthametacca caṭakātīrthamityapi ||26|| śrītīrthaṃ ca tathā sadyojātatīrthaṃ pramuktidam | nārāyaṇamahātīrthaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||27||| vāso’tra te mahādevasadyojāta bhavatviti | sadyojātamahātīrthaṃ tava nāmnā bhaviṣyati || 28|| kālāntare ca te nāmānyaparāṇi śubhāni vai | bhaviṣyantīti tīrthaṃ tat koṭīśvaraṃ bhaviṣyati ||29|| ityuktvā bhagavān śaṃbhuṃ nivāsāya sarastaṭe | ājñāṃ cakāra tatraiva śaṃbhurvāsaṃ sadākarot || 4.45.30|| tāvattatra samāyātā divyā gauḥ śvetalohitā | catuḥśṛṃgī caturvaktrā catuṣpādā caturmukhī ||3 1 || caturhastā caturnetrā caturdaṃṣṭrā catuḥstanī | nanāma pādayostūrṇaṃ vyomnā cāgatya vai puraḥ || 3 2|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādatale lileha jihvayā | harirvāri dadau tasyai jihvāyāṃ sā papau drutam ||33|| kumārī sābhavattatra viśvarūpā sarasvatī | tuṣṭāva paramātmānaṃ śrīpativallabhaṃnijam ||34|| namo’nādikṛṣṇakānta ramākānta ca te namaḥ | namaḥ śrīmāṇikīkānta lakṣmīkānta ca te namaḥ || 35|| namaḥ sarasvatīkānta rādhākānta ca te namaḥ | sukhadāśrīkānta padmāvatīkānta ca te namaḥ ||36 || ahaṃ śaktirbhavān śaktaḥ kṛṣṇāhaṃ kṛṣṇa te namaḥ | ahaṃ bhagavatī bhāryā bhagavām̐stvaṃ patiḥ prabhuḥ ||37|| tapastaptaṃ samāyātā golokāttu tavājñayā | pāvanīṃ māṃ samājñāpya sthāpayātra sarastaṭe ||38|| tīrthaṃ tvatra hare kṛṣṇa mannāmnāpi vidhehi ca | tathāstviti hariḥ prāha badrike tāṃ sarasvatīm ||39|| asthāpayat sarastīre mahādhenuṃ sarasvatīm | nārāyaṇasarastīre tīrthaṃ sārasvataṃ śubham ||4.45.40 || pāvanaṃ sarvalokānāmabhavat snānamātrataḥ | jñānadaṃ cātmabodhādipradaṃ brahmāvabodhadam ||41 || tasyā nāmāni bhagavām̐ścakāra pāvanānyapi | gopī māyā ca vidyā ca kṛṣṇā haimavatī satī ||42|| pradhānā śrīḥ prakṛtiśca viśvamātā narāyaṇī | maheśvarī śvetaraktā dvādaśeti śubhāni vai ||43|| evaṃ nāmāni samprāpya tīre sāpi tiro’bhavat | tāvattatrāpi puruṣaḥ svarṇavarṇaḥ samāyayau ||44|| sahasraśīrṣā viśvātmā sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt | sahasrabāhuḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvadevamayaḥ prabhuḥ||45|| sakaustubhaḥ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmādihetimān | tuṣṭāva daṇḍavat kṛtvānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||46|| namo’nantasvarūpāya sarvakāraṇacāriṇe | pareśāya parakṛṣṇasvarūpāya ca te namaḥ ||47|| parabrahmaṇe kṛṣṇāya parameśāya te namaḥ | vāsudeveśa kṛṣṇeśa nārāyaṇeśa te namaḥ ||48|| brahmeśasarvamukteśākṣareśa te namo namaḥ | sarvadhāmādhipataye namaste paramātmane ||49|| mādṛśā viṣṇavo’nantā udbhavanti madaṃśataḥ | taṃ vande parameśeśeśvareśvareśvareśvaram ||4.45.50|| bhagavan sarvadeveśa kālamāyeśa sarvadā | tīrthe nārāyaṇasarovare tvatpādapāvite ||51 || sadyojātena devena sthātumicchāmi sarvadā | māmatra sthāpaya kṛṣṇa lokakalyāṇahetave ||92|| tathāstvevaṃ hariḥ prāha viṣṇurvāsaṃ sadākarot | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastasmai sthāpayāmāsa pippale ||53|| sahasraśīrṣaplakṣākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ tatparamaṃ hyabhūt | tīro’bhavat plakṣavṛkṣe viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ prabhuḥ ||54|| athāyayau vyomadeśāt śmaśrulaḥ puṣṭarūpavān | hiraṇyagarbhaḥ sarvātmā sarvasṛṣṭiprabījavān ||55|| bhartā hartā jagatkartā brahmā sarvāṇḍasarjakaḥ | neme nārāyaṇakṛṣṇaṃ papāta pādayostathā ||56|| tuṣṭāva svāgataṃ prāptaḥ śrīpatiṃkṛṣṇakeśavam | harikṛṣṇa hariviṣṇo kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho ||57|| sarvasvāmin sarvadhāmin sarvaśaktipradāyaka | sarvarakṣāvidhātastvaṃ nārāyaṇo’tra cāgataḥ ||58|| kalyāṇārthaṃ tu lokānāṃ tīrthānāṃ pāvanāya ca | nārāyaṇe sarasyatra śaṃbhurviṣṇuḥ sarasvatī |||59|| yathā vāsaṃ vyadhustadvad vāsaṃ me rocate’pi ca | ājñāpaya pratiṣṭhāṃ me kurvatra bhagavanniha ||4.45.60|| tathāstvevaṃ hariḥ prāha badrike parameṣṭhinam | brahmā tatra palāśe tu drume vāsaṃ tadākarot ||61 || raktavastro’bhavad vṛkṣo raktapuṣpāvaśobhitaḥ | pāvanaḥ sarvalokānāṃ yajñānāmupakārakṛt ||62|| evaṃ devā avasan vai lokakalyāṇakāriṇaḥ | badrike ca tatastatrāścaryaṃ paramamadbhutam ||63|| abhavad tat divyarūpaṃ samākarṇaya śobhanam | śabalāśvāścaharyaśvāḥ putrā vai vedhasaḥ purā ||64|| nāradasyopadeśena vairāgyaṃ samupāśritāḥ | saptadaśasahasrāṇi tapo’rthaṃ tatra ye sthitāḥ ||65|| sarve nārāyaṇaṃkṛṣṇaṃ prāpya tatra puro’bhavan | tāpasā jaṭilāḥ śuṣkāḥ karamālāvirājinaḥ ||66|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāminārāyaṇajapānvitāḥ | prasannamānasā divyatejaḥparidhiśobhanāḥ ||67|| pratyāhṛtendriyavegā brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ | śāntā nirguṇarādheśasmaraṇe dhṛtamānasāḥ ||68|| bālasvarūpiṇaścāpi puṣṭā yauvanaśālinaḥ | saṃkīrtanaṃ prakurvantaḥ kūrdayanto’tiharṣitāḥ ||69|| karatālaiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmītivādinaḥ | aho aho hare kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho ||4.45.70|| kalyāṇakṛnmahākṛṣṇanārāyaṇa vibho prabho | evaṃ raṭantaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hyupasthitāḥ ||71 || praṇemurdaṇḍavadbhaktyā dhūlīṃ te śirasi nyadhuḥ | dhūlyāmāloṭayantaste kṛṣṇapādajalaṃ papuḥ ||72|| tuṣṭuvuḥ śrīhariṃ tatra evam hṛdayārpaṇaiḥ | nārāyaṇahare kṛṣṇa mokṣārthaṃ vayamāgatāḥ ||73|| bhavān mokṣapradaścāste dehi mokṣaṃ bhavārṇavāt | vayaṃ sarve brahmaputrāḥ śiṣyā nāradayoginaḥ ||74|| pratīkṣamāṇāḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vasāmo’tra japānvitāḥ | daivād vā kṛpayā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa bhavāniha ||75|| no mokṣārthaṃ samāyāto dehi mokṣapadaṃ param | śrutvā prāha haristām̐stu mokṣaṃ dadāmi śāśvatam ||76|| brahmatulyāḥ samarthāḥ stha naikarūpadharāḥ parāḥ | tāpasā manniyogena mūlarūpaistu sarvathā ||77|| divyatāṃ muktatāṃ prāpya yāntu dhāmākṣaraṃ mama | dvitīyastu svarūpaivaiṃ tiṣṭhantu cāṃśatastviha ||78|| nārāyaṇaparā nityaṃ devasevāparāyaṇāḥ | tīrthasya munayo bhūtvā tiṣṭhantvatra sadā sthirāḥ ||79|| ityuktā badrike te tu dvedhārūpāstadābhavan | aṃśato munirūpāste mūlato muktarūpiṇaḥ ||4.45.80 || munirūpā nyavataiṃste nārāyaṇasarastaṭe | muktarūpā divyarūpā cāgate suvimānake ||8 1 || pārṣadairdivyadehaiste niṣadyākṣaradhāma me | prayayurmuktatāṃ prāptāḥ śāśvatānandabhojinaḥ ||82|| kṛpayā me samastāste jātā matsamaśaktayaḥ | evaṃ hi badrike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo narāyaṇān ||83|| mādṛśān sarvathā kṛtvā tatastīrthasthitān janān | pāvayitvā pradāyāpi dānavastu yatheṣṭakam ||84|| tīrthottamaṃ saraḥ kṛtvā niṣadya svavimānake | bhujaṃganagare sāyaṃ prāyayau rājavāṭikām ||85|| avātarad vimānaṃ tu tadā vai rājavāṭikā | śṛṃgāritābhavat tūryaninādairabhigarjitā ||86|| sammānakaralokaiśca tathā rājakuṭumbibhiḥ | prajābhiḥ svāgatārthaṃ sā vāṭikā saṃkulā hyabhūt ||87|| harirvimānatastatra yadā vai bahirāyayau | lakṣaśo vai janā nāryo narāścandanapuṣpakaiḥ ||88|| kuṃkumākṣatavarṣābhirvardhayāmāsuracyutam | jayaśabdairmahāharṣakṛtairnārāyaṇābhidhaiḥ ||89 || svāgataṃ śrīhareścakrurbadrike rāṣṭramānavāḥ | ghaṭikāmātramevādau sthito vimānakāgrake ||4.45.9 0|| datvā svadarśanaṃ kṛṣṇo viveśa nṛpamandiram | rājā mādhavarāyaśca rājñī kalyāṇikā satī ||9 1 || pupūjatuḥ pareśaṃ taṃ papatuḥ pādavāryapi | pūjayitvopacāraiśca mukuṭādyaiśca bhūṣaṇaiḥ ||92|| veṣaiścātipramūlyaiśca svarṇaratnādihīrakaiḥ | maṇibhiḥ svarṇamudrābhiḥ prapūjyārārtrikaṃ tataḥ ||9 3|| vyadhātāṃ bhāvabhinnau tau rājyavargāstataḥ param | pupūjuḥ paramātmānaṃ yathārhabhūṣaṇādibhiḥ ||94|| ārārtrikaṃ pracakruste tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram | saṃsārād bhagavan kṛṣṇa jīvānnastārayaprabho ||95|| sākṣāttava prasaṃgena yadi divyā vayaṃ nahi | tadā keṣāṃ prasaṃgena vayaṃ divyā bhavemahi ||96|| śrutvā haristu tānprāha satāṃ saṃgena divyatā | bhaviṣyati na sandeho mokṣo vaśca bhaviṣyati ||97|| mayā nārāyaṇatīrthe rakṣitāḥ śabalāśvakāḥ | haryaśvakā brahmaputrāḥ sādhavaste madāśrayāḥ |||98|| matto mantraṃ ca samprāptā bhajante māṃ nirantaram | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||99|| evaṃvidhaṃ tu me mantraṃ dāsyanti vo vidhānataḥ | tatra yūthaṃ prāpya tīrthaṃ prayāsyatha paraṃ padam || 4.45.1 00|| sajjā bhūtvā tīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā natvā ca tān sataḥ | sevitvā tān bhajanena prayāsyatha paraṃ padam || 101 || ye sajjāstaiḥ pragantavyaṃ mokṣārthaṃ cānivartinam | ityuktvā badrike kṛṣṇa uṣitvaikaniśāṃ sukham || 1 02|| bhojanaṃ pūjanaṃ labdhvā rājñe rājñyai manuṃ nijam | datvā sevāṃ parāṃ prāpya prātarutthāya mādhavaḥ || 10 3|| naijaṃ vimānamāruhya yayau kuṃkumavāpikām | viśrāntiṃ paramāṃ prāpto nārāyaṇapareśvaraḥ || 1 04|| sindhuvārtāṃ kacchavārtāṃ cakāra janasaṃsadi | snānapūjābhojanādi cakre śāntimavāpa ha || 10 5|| ityevaṃ badrike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śriyāḥ patiḥ | divyaṃ caritraṃ subhagaṃ mokṣadaṃ pracakāra ha || 1 06|| sarvaṃ te kathitaṃ ramyaṃ svargamokṣapradaṃ śubham | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇānmuktibhāg bhavet || 1 07|| api pāpo vicittaśca dharmavarjita ityapi | śrutvā labdhvā guṇaṃ yacchet svargaṃ divyayugāyutam || 1 08|| kā kathā tu tadānyasya sevino bhaktiyoginaḥ | yatheṣṭaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo dadyāt kṛpākaraḥ || 1 09|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kacchanṛpatirmādhavarāyo hariṃ kacchamāniyāya, harirnārāyaṇasarasi śivaviṣṇuvedhaḥsarasvatīnāṃ tīrthāni kṛtavān, śabalāśvaharyaśvānāṃ dvedhā rūpāṇi kārayitvā tīrthe vāsaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ ca dattavān, bhujaṃganagare mādhavarāyanṛpatikuṭumbaṃ pāvayitvā kuṃkumavāpīmāyayau ceti nirūpaṇanāmā pañcacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 45 ||
<4.46> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kusārajātiyoṣitaḥ | satkathāṃ pāvanīṃ tatra mokṣadāṃ bhaktisaṃbhṛtām || 1 || sindhudeśe tu ye bhaktāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritāḥ | abhavam̐ste militvā vai kecit saṃghātmakāstataḥ || 2 || lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ pārāyaṇe śubhe | kārtike śuklapakṣe vai prātaścaikādaśīdine || 3 || pūjanārthaṃ saṃhitāyā āyayuścopadākarāḥ | brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā dāsāśca dāsikāḥ || 4 || yāvantaḥ puṣpahārādyaiḥ kuṃkumākṣatacandanaiḥ | dhūpadīpasunaivedyairānarcuḥ saṃhitāśriyam || 5 || ārārtrikaphalapuṣpāñjalisvarṇārpaṇaistathā | maṇiratnahīrakādyaiḥ svarṇabhūṣāmbarādibhiḥ || 6 || te svaprakāśaṃ vyāsaṃ cānarcuḥ sarve tathāvidhaiḥ | divyottamairupacāraistataḥ śrīkṛṣṇakīrtanam || 7 || cakrurvādyaviśeṣāḍhyaṃ tālikānādagarbhitam | hare kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho || 8 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīkānta sadvibho | evaṃ dhūnye prabhavati magnānāṃ sarvadehinām || 9 || ekāgramānasānāṃ vai tadāścaryaṃ mahaddhyabhūt | vimānamāgataṃ divyaṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham ||4.46.10|| tatraikā dyotikānāmnī kaṃsārī divyavigrahā | bhūtvāruhya vimāne sā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ param || 1 1|| śrībadrīpriyovācakā sā vai dyotikānāmnī kathaṃ sā divyavigrahā | kena puṇyena sā yātā dhāmākṣaraṃ tu tadvada || 12|| śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi sāsīd vai karmacāriṇī | bhṛtyā dāsī vetanena rāyaharernṛpasya vai || 1 3|| jātyā śūdrā hi kaṃsārī pātramañjanakāriṇī | mārjanādiparā tatra nṛparājñyāstu kiṃkarī || 14|| bhaktāsīt pūjane kārṣṇe kaṃsārī tu kusāriṇī | nityaṃ sā śṛṇute lakṣmīsaṃhitāṃ niyamānvitā || 15|| rājñīkāryāṇi nirvartya derahakāryāṇi sarvathā | rājñyālayasamastāni kāryāṇi pravidhāya sā ||16|| kṛtasnānajapapūjā kṛtadāsyasamastikā | kṛtādarā bhaktiniṣṭhā kathāyāmupatiṣṭhate || 17|| puṣpahāreṇa sahitāṃ puṣpahāreṇa vācakam | kuṃkumākṣatamudrābhiḥ samarcayati nityaśaḥ || 18|| karamālā sthiracittā natvā vyāsaṃ sabhāṃ tataḥ | śravaṇārthā sabhāyāṃ sā niṣīdati hyatandritā || 19|| tasyāḥ patiḥ kusāro’pi kṛṣṇasārābhidhaḥ sadā | kathāṃ śrotuṃ samāyāti śīghraṃ yāti ca karmaṇe ||4.46.20|| rājasevāparaḥ patnyāḥ kāryaṃ śeṣaṃ karoti saḥ | patnī bhāvaprapūrṇā sā kathāḥ śṛṇoti sarvathā ||2, || śratvā sandhārya rātrau svasvāmine kathayatyapi | evaṃvidhādaraparā kathāśravaṇamātrataḥ ||22|| pāvanī sā tu saṃbhūtā sarvapāpavivarjitā | tayā mantro harestatra gṛhīto vyāsataḥ śubhaḥ ||23|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | nityaṃ mantraṃ japati sā tathā karoti kīrtanam ||24|| harekṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīparameśvara | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama ||25|| evaṃ karoti bhajanaṃ bhojanaṃ caikavārakam | prasādaṃ vā phalādyaṃ vā gṛhṇātyeva na cāparam ||26|| evaṃ vai vartamānayāḥ kaṃsāryāḥ pāpamocanam | puṇyānāmudayaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprasannatā ||27|| sarvaṃ jātaṃ svabhāvena guroḥ karoti sevanam | svapanaṃ gātrasaṃvāhaṃ vastrakṣālanakādikam ||28|| vyāsasevāprapuṇyena bhaktibale pravardhitā | vyāsāsanādiklṛptyā ca sabhāsthalādimārjanāt ||29|| mahāpuṇyapratāpena karmakṣayo vyajāyata | dehatyāgasamayo’syāḥ prāptastadā hariḥ svayam ||4.46.30|| vimānaṃ divyamāruhya svayaṃ netuṃ samāyayau | divyadṛśāṃ gocaro vai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||31 || kirīṭī kuṇḍalī cakrī vāsasvī śrīsamanvitaḥ | prabhāsayan diśāḥ sarvā āgatya tu kathāsthale ||32|| avatīrya vimānāt sa tāṃ jagrāha kare hariḥ | sāpi dehaṃ bhautikaṃ vai tyaktvā natvā sabhāṃ tathā ||33|| svataḥprakāśaṃ divyaṃ svaṃ sadguruṃ viṣṇurūpiṇam | lomaśaṃ ca muniṃ sādhūnanyānnatvā punaḥ punaḥ || 34|| yācitvā ca kṣamāṃ divyadehā muktānikā śubhā | divyā kārṣṇī kṛṣṇatulyā rādhātulyā manoharā ||35|| bhūtvā vimānamāruhya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇānvitā | yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ divyaṃ paśyatāṃ divyacakṣuṣām ||36|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ tadvai kathāśravaṇasatphalam | abhavadvai tathā badri mahāmokṣapradaṃ param ||37|| kusāriṇī dyotikā sā kaṃsārī kṛṣṇasāriṇī | prasañjātā yathā ladamīrdivye dhānni vyarājata ||38|| evaṃ tadā bahavo vai narā nāryaśca pāvanāḥ | kathāṃ śrutvābhavan loke jīvanmuktā hareḥ priyāḥ ||39|| amṛtaṃ bheṣajaṃ badri karotyeva nirāmayam | kṛṣṇāmṛtaṃ tu māyānāṃ rogānnāśayati drutam ||4.46.40 || satāṃ sevā guroḥ sevā bhaktiśca bhajanaṃ hareḥ | ātmano divyatāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ kurvantyeva pramokṣaṇam ||41 || śṛṇu badrīpriye devi sāyaṃ tvekādaśītithau | ūrje tatra mahāścaryamaparaṃ saṃvyajāyata ||42|| kulālasya kuṭumbaṃ vai sevāyāṃ sarvathābhavat | kuṃbhakāro nararājastathā bhāryāsya rakṣikā ||43|| putrāḥ putryaḥ samastā vai pārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ | sarvaṃ kuṭumbaṃ nityaṃ vai sevate tatsabhāsthalam ||44|| kṣaṇe kṣaṇe jalapānaṃ dadātyatīva śītalam | pātrāṇāṃ bhañjanaṃ vāyovyajanaiḥ supradānakam ||45|| āstaraṇāstaraṇādi rajasāṃ mārjanādikam | kathānte riktabhāve tvāstaraṇānāṃ pramoḍanam ||46|| rakṣaṇaṃ ca sthale yogye kaccarādinikāsanam | kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ cāpi pūjanaṃ darśanādikam ||47|| kulālasya kuṭumbaṃ vai sarvaṃ prasevate sabhām | kathāṃ śṛṇute nityaṃ tad bhajate pārvatīpatim ||48|| evaṃ dhvastāghamevāto mantraṃ jagrāha sadguroḥ | vyāsāt prāptvā harernāmamāhātmyaṃ ca tataḥ param ||49|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | mantraṃ jepuḥ kulālāste bhajanaṃ cakrire mudā ||4.46.50|| harekṛṣṇa prabhokṛṣṇa bālanārāyaṇa prabho | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa pāraṃ kuru prabho ||51 || mālāvartanamācakruḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca | sevāṃ cakruḥ sabhāyāste vyāsasyāmitatejasaḥ ||52|| tena dagdhāni pāpāni teṣāṃ ca vāsanākṣayaḥ | janmamṛtyupravāhasyādhikāro nāśatāṃ gataḥ ||53|| sāyaṃ kathānte dhunyānte bhajanānte hareḥ puraḥ | sabhāntike kuṭumbaṃ tat samastaṃ divyabhāvanam ||54|| śrīhareḥ kṛpayā divyadehaṃ jātaṃ drutaṃ tadā | tāvat tatra samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ vyomamārgataḥ |||55|| yatra nārāyaṇakṛṣṇo rādhāyukto’bhavat prabhuḥ | prakāśayan diśaḥ sarvā vimānāt samavātarat ||56|| bhūmau tatra kulālāgre paśyatāṃ divyacakṣuṣām | sarvān vidhāya bhagavān kulālāt divyavigrahān ||57|| vimāne sve hyavasthāpya parāścaryaṃ prasārayan | yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ divyaṃ kṛpālurbhaktavatsalaḥ ||58|| kulālānāṃ sthūladehā nādṛśyanta tadā bhuvi | sthūlāste divyatāṃ prāptāḥ sevayā śrīguroḥ satām ||5 9 || vaiṣṇavānāṃ sevayā ca kathāyāḥ sevanāttathā | bhaktyā dhyānena kṛṣṇasya kārṣṇatāṃ te yayustadā ||4.46.60|| lakṣaśo vai janāstatrāścaryamagnāstato’bhavan | aho kathāyā māhātmyaṃ badrike divyamokṣakṛt ||6 1 || śṛṇu rātrau tato jātaṃ mahāścaryaṃ vadāmi te | rātryārambhe kīrtanaṃ vai cakrire sarvavaiṣṇavāḥ ||6 2|| ekādaśyā jāgaraṇe yayuḥ kṛṣṇaikatānatām | vādyayukte kīrtane vai premamagnāstadābhavan ||63|| tatraikā svarṇakārastrī dhātudhmastrī tathāparā | sumbālikābhidhā cādyā parā nāmnā vinodinī ||64|| kīrtayantyau sahasaiva tanmayyau cittarodhatām | prāpyaikatānatāṃ labdhvā samādhiṃ bhejaturdrutam ||65|| tayoragre’bhavattejomayī mūrtiḥ sanātanī | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya yauvanānvitā ||66|| ramaṇīyā sūryacandravahnividyutsamaprabhā | dedīpyamānā subhagā puṣṭā sarvāṃgasundarī ||67|| vimānaṃ divyatejomacchobhanaṃ paramādbhutam | tatrādṛśyata vai rātrau bhūtale harisannidhau ||68|| pārṣadairbahubhiryuktaṃ muktānikābhiśobhitam | cakṣuṣmatāṃ darśanārhaṃ sarveṣāṃ dṛṣṭigocaram ||69|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo viṣṇuḥ paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām | pasparśa te striyau dakṣakareṇa yāvadeva hi ||4.46.70|| tāvadvidyutsame śvete cojjvale te babhūvatuḥ | divyarūpe divyabhūṣādhare divyasuvigrahe ||71|| tayordehau bhautikau tu tatraivādṛśyatāṃ gatau | divyadehau suniṣpannau śubhau rādhāramāsamau ||72|| yuvatyau te hariṃ natvāruruhaturvimānakam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo drutaṃ hasan hariḥ ||73 || svaṃ vimānamadhiruhya nītvā te muktayoṣitau | yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ tūrṇaṃ divyenāmbaravartmanā ||74|| evaṃ tatrāścaryametaccamatkāramayaṃ hyabhūt | kathāyāḥ kīrtanādeśca phalaṃ mokṣapradaṃ śubham ||75|| badrike dvādaśīprātaḥkāle brāhme muhūrtake | āścaryaṃ paramaṃ jātaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ saṃvadāmi te ||76|| nāṭyakāro’bhavattatra nāmnā rañjanakovidaḥ | sa kṛtvā jāgaraṃ snātvā brāhme muhūrtake prage ||77|| nītvā puṣpāṇi ca mālāṃ candanaṃ kuṃkumaṃ phalam | akṣatān darbhapatrāṇi tilān gūḍhaṃ ca śarkarāḥ ||78|| godhūmān śvetadhotraṃ ca svarṇamudrāṃ ca kambalam | pūjārthaṃ saṃhitāyāḥ sa samāyayau tu maṇḍapam ||79|| yāṃ saṃhitāṃ strījanaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ karoti vai | narā natvā pūjayitvā yānti gurvarcanāya ca ||4.46.8 0|| tatra gāyan pūjanārthaṃ prāpto rañjanakovidaḥ | neme cānarca tāṃ saṃhitāṃ puṣpādibhirādarāt ||8 1 || pradakṣiṇaṃ cakārāpi tataścārārtrikaṃ vyadhāt | tatkṣaṇe ruddhacitto’sau turyāvasthāṃ viveśa ha ||82|| bhānahīnaḥ papātāsya dehastatraiva bhūtale | tāvad divyaṃ samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ projjvalaṃ śubham ||83|| ambarāt sahasā bhūmāvavātarat taḍid yathā | tatra nārāyaṇakṛṣṇo divyamūrtiradṛśyata ||84|| sarveṣāṃ gocaraḥ sākṣād ramārādhāpatiḥ prabhuḥ | māyāmuktaṃ divyadehaṃ hariḥ rañjanakovidam ||85|| muktātmānaṃ vimāne sve nītvā dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau | mahāścaryamabhūttatra badrike prātareva tat ||86|| tāvat kaścit samāyātaḥ kadaryastatra bhūsuraḥ | patrapuṣpajalayuktaḥ saṃhitāpūjanāya vai ||87|| ślokamuccārayan tasthau sammarde yoṣitāṃ tathā | namaḥ saṃhitārūpāya mādhavīsvāmine namaḥ ||88|| nirmalānāṃ hṛdisthāya mokṣadāya ca te namaḥ | namo rādhāramālakṣmīśrīrūpāyai muhurmuhuḥ ||89|| mokṣadātryai divyamātre jñānadāyai ca te namaḥ | namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇakāntāyai māṇikyāyai ca te namaḥ ||4.46.90|| brahmavidyāsvarūpāyai dhāmaśaktyai ca te namaḥ | namaḥ śrībadarīdevyai jayādevyai ca te namaḥ ||91 || namaḥ priyāyai divyāyai pāraṃgatyai ca te namaḥ | namo mātre mahālakṣmyai lalitāyai ca te namaḥ ||92|| brahmadātryai parabrahmayogadātryai ca te namaḥ | ityevaṃ sa harikṛṣṇaṃ tuṣṭāva saṃhitāśriyam ||93|| tāvannāryo dadustasmai pūjāvasaramuttamam | pupūja paramātmānaṃ kadaryo viprarāṭ tu saḥ ||94|| saṃhitāṃ pūjayāmāsa kūrdanaṃ nartanaṃ tathā | tālikāvādanaṃ gālavādanaṃ sakthiśabdanam ||95|| ghurghurāvādanaṃ cāsye cakāra kīrtanaṃ tathā | kṣaṇaṃ stabdhā darśakā vai mānavāstu tadābhavan ||96|| athaivaṃ kīrtane magnaścaikacitto’tirodhakṛt | mūrtau tvekātmatāṃ prāpto brahmarandhre viveśa ha ||97|| brahmarandhrāt tasya tejaḥ sahasrasūryasadṛśam | niryātaṃ sahasā tatra hyandhīkurvajjagattrayam ||98|| netramūrchāṃ gataḥ sarve narā nāryaśca badrike | tāvacchāntaṃ candrasamaṃ śanairdṛśya hi cābhavat ||99|| tatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī vyadṛśyata | kare gṛhṇan kadaryaṃ taṃ nāmnā śrīrāmasundaram || 4.46.100 || tāvattatra vimānaṃ vai samāyātaṃ mahāmbarāt | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatra nītvā śrīrāmasundaram || 10 1|| divyadehaṃ yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ tūrṇaṃ śriyaḥ patiḥ | āścaryaṃ paramaṃ sarvayoṣitāṃ kṛṣṇadarśanāt ||1 02|| abhavad vai narāṇāṃ ca protsāhaḥ paramo’bhavat | kadaryasya śarīraṃ tat tatraiva līnatāṃ gatam || 103 || etadvai tanmahāścaryaṃ prāptā dṛṣṭvā janāḥ punaḥ | kathāyāḥ śravaṇādetanmokṣaṇaṃ pūjanāttathā || 1 04|| sañjātaṃ śrīkadaryasya divyadehena cākṣaram | nivāsāya sadā jātaṃ dhāma yacchāśvataṃ prabhoḥ || 1 05|| ityevaṃ badrike sindhudeśe pārāyaṇakṣaṇe | nityaṃ nityaṃ prajāyante dehināṃ mokṣaṇāni vai || 1 06|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya camatkārasya kīrtanāt | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi divyā gatiḥ paraṃ padam || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne saṃhitāyāḥ śravaṇena pūjanena ca vidyotānāmnyāḥ kaṃsāriṇyāḥ, kuṃbhakārasya nararājasya kuṭumbasya, svarṇakārastriyā ambālikāyāḥ, dhātudhmastriyā vinodinyāḥ, nāṭyakārasya rañjanakovidasya, kadaryasya śrīrāmasundarasya, ca śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena mokṣaṇaṃ kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 46 ||
<4.47> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ paramapāvanīm | sindhudeśe saṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ śrotuṃ tu nityaśaḥ || 1 || vimānena samāyāti kṣārapurakṣitīśvaraḥ | nāmnā kṣīrodavīrākhyastathā rājñī ruhāraṇiḥ || 2 || ubhau śṛṇuta sadasi pūjayitvā tu vācakam | saṃhitāṃ pūjayitvāpi praṇamyarṣīn munīn gurūn || 3 || samāsīnau rājavargāsanayoḥ kṛṣṇamānasau | śravaṇena tato jātau pāvanau tau nṛpīnṛpau || 4 || jagṛhaturmanuṃ vyāsāt svīyaprakāśakāddhi tau | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā || 5 || priyakṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca | jepaturmālikādvārā nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ || 6 || cakratustau satāṃ sevāṃ kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇau | priyakṛṣṇa harikṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti tau || 7 || ūcatuḥ satataṃ ceti prātaḥ pūjāṃ pracakratuḥ | naivedyaṃ haraye dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tāmcūlakaṃ jalam || 8 || arpayāmāsaturdhyānaṃ cakratuḥ mālatīpateḥ | mahābhāgavatau tvevaṃ jātau divyaguṇānvitau || 9 || nirmānau dāsavannityaṃ vartamānau sabhāsthale | kathāmūrtiṃ kṛṣṇamūrtiṃ dhārayāmāsatuḥ sadā || 4.47.1 0|| tayoḥ prajājanāścāpi samāyānti kathārthinaḥ | narā nāryaḥ pavitrāśca jāyante śravaṇādibhiḥ || 11 || bahavaste harermantraṃ jagṛhuḥ śaraṇāgatāḥ | kārtike dhavale pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ tu kathāsthale || 12|| kṣīrodavīro nṛpatiḥ ruhāraṇyā samaṃ tathā | prajājanaiḥ samaṃ tatra kathāyāṃ samatiṣṭhata || 1 3|| śratvā kathāṃ saṃhitāyā ārārtrikaṃ vyadhāttadā | prasādaṃ śrīhareḥ prāpya bhuktvāsvādyajalāmṛtam || 14|| sabhāyāṃ tatra lokānāṃ paśyatāṃ samupāviśat | rājñī cāpi tadā tatra sannidhau samupāviśat || 15|| tāvattatra samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ divyataijasam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇādhiṣṭhitamujjvalam || 16|| avātarat sabhāpārśve tasmānnārāyaṇaprabhuḥ | niḥsasāra kṣitāvetya kṛtvā tau divyavigrahau || 17|| nṛpīnṛpau vimāne tu nītvā śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau tadā prabhuḥ || 18|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ vīkṣya lokā modamupāyayuḥ | na dehau bhautikau tatra tayoḥ staśceti tanmahat || 19|| sāmarthyaṃ vīkṣya nṛpayoḥ kṛpāṃ nārāyaṇasya ca | anenaiva tu dehena mokṣaṃ nayati mādhavaḥ ||4.47.20|| vicāryetthaṃ tu bahavo narā nāryaḥ samutsukāḥ | gantuṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ sajjā babhūvustatra badrike ||21|| tatra sahasraśaḥ santo maharṣayaḥ sahasraśaḥ | vṛddhāḥ sahasraśaścāpi striyo’nāthāḥ sahasraśaḥ ||22|| pāpā yadvā ca niṣpāpāḥ kathāśravaṇakāriṇaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhāmākṣaraṃ gantuṃ sutatparāḥ ||23|| abhavan dvādaśīsāyaṃ kathānīrājanottaram | kīrtanānte harirjñātvā bhaktānāṃ vāñchitaṃ śubham ||24|| kathāśravaṇadhautāghān śaraṇāgatisaṃplutān | tyakteṣaṇān bhaktimato netuṃ kṛṣṇaḥ samāyayau ||25|| labdhamantrān samastān vai narānnārīstadā hariḥ | kṛtvā sarvān divyadehān taccharīrāmṛtān hi tān |||26|| vimāne suviśāle vai dhṛtvā dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau | āścaryaṃ paramaṃ badri kṛṣṇenaitat tadā kṛtam ||27|| amantrāścāguravo ye te tu naivādhikāriṇaḥ | avaśiṣṭāścādhṛtāśca sthitāstatraiva te tadā ||28|| te’pi kathāśravaṇānte lomaśāt tatra vai manum | jagṛhuḥ pāvanāḥ sarve sajjāstato’bhavan khalu ||29|| athāyayau bhagavān śrīpatirnetuṃ samantrakān | rātrau vimānake dhṛtvā divyadehān prasajjitān ||4.47.30 || ninye’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo dhāmākṣaraṃ nijam | sahasraśo narā nāryo vṛddhā vā vāsanojjhitāḥ ||3 1 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtau premasnehaparāyaṇāḥ | viṣavatkṛtasaṃsārāstyaktalokeṣaṇāstathā ||32|| niruddhavṛttayaḥ kṛṣṇe prapattiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ | kṛpayā cecchayā viṣṇoryayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ || 33|| aho bhāgyaṃ hi balavad baliṣṭhā ca kṛpā hareḥ | koṭikalpatapolabhyaṃ labdhavanto’kṣaraṃ yayā ||34|| narṣayo yatpadaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yaṃ hariṃ vārjayantyapi | tapobhiralpabahulaistaṃ hariṃ te prapedire || 35|| yadarthaṃ bhūbhṛtaḥ bhūmiṃ rājyaṃ tyaktvā tapantyapi | tathāpi nāpnuvantyenaṃ taṃ prāptāḥ kṛpayā prabhoḥ || 36|| durlabhaḥ sulabho jāto dhāmeśo bhūtale tviha | adṛśyo dṛśyatāṃ prāptaḥ kṛpayā sarvadehinām ||37|| kaṣṭasādhyo haristvadya kṛpāsādhyo’sti sarvathā | kathamanyathā pāpānāṃ cakṣuṣorgocaro hariḥ ||38|| janā ūcuḥaho bhāgyaṃ śubhaṃ śreṣṭhamasmākaṃ yaddharistviha | nije gṛhe svayametya dadāti darśanaṃ nijam ||39|| evaṃvidhaṃ tu sulabhaṃ prāpyāpi na bhajanti ye | ta eva karmahīnā vai durbhāgyā mānavā api ||4.47.40|| paśuvajjīvanaṃ teṣāṃ gataṃ bhavati mokṣadam | na punarmānavo deho’vāpsyate’to bhajantu tam ||41|| gṛhṇantu śrīharermantraṃ śaraṇaṃ yāntu sarvathā | tanvā lakṣmyā dhiyā kṛṣṇaṃ prasevantāṃ kṛtādarāḥ ||42|| gṛhaṃ vāṭī sutā nārī patiḥ putrāśca vājinaḥ | sampadaścañcalāḥ sarvāstābhiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ labhantviha ||43|| evaṃ badrīpriye tatra janāḥ procuḥ parasparam | jagṛhuḥ kṛṣṇamantrām̐śca babhūvurvaiṣṇavāstadā ||44|| bhejire śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sādhūn siṣevire | narā nāryaḥ parāṃ pavitratāṃ prāpya tataḥ sadā ||45|| mahābhāgavatā bhūtvā pratīkṣante sma mādhavam | kadā nārāyaṇakṛṣṇo dhāmāsmānneṣyati prabhuḥ ||46|| kadā sākṣānnijān kṛtvā grahīṣyati karaṃ prabhuḥ | āturā evamarthāste nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ ||47|| ābālavṛddhā abhavan vivekabhaktitatparāḥ | badrike sindhujā deśāḥ kathāprabhāvatastataḥ ||48|| prāyo bhāgavatairbhaktaiḥ sampannā divyatāṃ gatāḥ | sthale sthale bālakṛṣṇo vimānena svadarśanam ||49|| datvā bhaktaṃ ca bhaktāṃ ca nayatyakṣaradhāma saḥ | evamāścaryamaniśaṃ pratyahaṃ tatra vartate ||4.47.50|| badrike parito deśe rāṣṭre grāme ca pattane | vārtteyaṃ sampravṛttā yat parāyaṇaṃ hi muktidam ||51 || yanti muktiṃ māvanāstu śrutvā pārāyaṇaṃ prabhoḥ | kṛtvā tu darśanaṃ sākṣād yānti dhāma vimānagāḥ |||52|| na pāpaṃ bhagavān kṛṣṇo gaṇayatyatra pāpinaḥ | pāvayitvā kṛpayaiva nayatyūrdhvākṣaraṃ padam |||53|| śrutvānye’pi mahāpāpāḥ pāpasantrastamānasāḥ | āgatya badrike śrutvā kathāṃ yanti paraṃ padam ||54|| evaṃvidhaṃ camatkāraṃ bahumānavakīrtitam | śrutvā pāpā mahāpāpā āyayuḥ saṃhitāsthalam ||55|| hiṃsakā ghātakāścaurāḥ kṛtaghnāśca pratārakāḥ | viśvāsaghātakā madyapānā māṃsādanā api ||56||| mumukṣāpreritāstrastāḥ karmabhiḥ svakṛtaistadā | niṣṭhāśraddhāprapattiviśvāsadharmāstu te hareḥ ||57|| kathāṃ śrutvā narā nāryo lebhire’tipavitratām | śṛṇu śrībadrike tatra mahāpāpāstriyāḥ kathām ||58|| antataḥ pāvanīṃ sarvapāpaghnāṃ kṛṣṇayogadām | abhavatsomikānāmnī gaṇikā pañca tatsutāḥ ||59||| māṃsādinyo madyapāstā jīvahiṃsāparāyaṇāḥ | sarvādinyaḥ kukkuṭādipālinyaścāṇḍabhakṣikāḥ ||4.47.60 || putryaśca gaṇikā cāpi sarvāstā vārayoṣitaḥ | mithunakuṭṭavāstavyā bījasāṃkaryagarbhajāḥ ||6 1|| śrutvā lokamukhyebhyo vai mahimānaṃ hareḥ param | kathāśravaṇajaṃ cāpi mokṣalābhaṃ prakarṇya ca ||62|| jātapāpapraṇāśecchāḥ svajñātyuddhārahetave | prathamaṃ tāḥ pañcaputryo mātā ca śarkarāpuram ||63|| saṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ śrotumāyayuḥ sādhanānvitāḥ | lomaśaṃ tāḥ praṇamyaiva cakrurnivedanaṃ nijam ||64|| dayālurlomaśastābhyo dadau kṛpāmṛtaṃ balam | hareḥ prasādajaṃ vāri puṣpaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ dadau ||65|| ekāśanaṃ vrataṃ nityaṃ snānaṃ sindhau prapūjanam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrteḥ sucintanam ||66|| madyamāṃsādisantyāgaṃ sādhusevanamanvaham | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇajāpaṃ dadau tābhyastu lomaśaḥ ||67|| badrike tāstathaivāsan sarvā gurorvacaḥsthitāḥ | māsamevaṃ vratasthāstāḥ śuśruvuḥ saṃhitākathāḥ ||68|| pāpanāśo’bhavattāsāṃ dharmaśuddhistathābhavat | dehaśuddhiśca sañjātā prasādānnaphalāśanāt ||69|| tato mantraṃ dadau tābhyo lomaśaḥ pārameśvaram | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||4.47.70|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ japam | dadau tābhyastataḥ sarvāḥ śuddhātmadivyabhāvanāḥ | kārtikasya tu pūrṇāyā ārabhya māsameva tāḥ ||71|| mārgaśīrṣapūrṇimāparyantaṃ pārāyaṇe sthitāḥ | śuśruvuḥ paramātmānaṃ lakṣmīkāntaṃ hṛdi sthitam ||72|| jepurnārāyaṇasvāmiprabhuṃkṛṣṇaṃ niśāmukhe | apaśyan paramātmānaṃ hasantaṃ drāk puraḥsthitam ||73|| guroḥ kṛpayā mantrasya japena sādhusevayā | kathāyāḥ śravaṇenāpi bhaktyā dhyānena niṣṭhayā ||74|| puṇyodayena bhagavān śrīkṛṣṇo darśanaṃ dadau | koṭikāmātisaundaryalāvaṇyayauvanānvitaḥ ||75|| sarvābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyaḥ sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhanaḥ | sarvasnehapramodāḍhyo mahānandaprado hariḥ ||76|| tejasā parito bhāgān pradyotayan hasan hariḥ | ṣaṭ tāḥ prāha varārthaṃ vai tāśca kṛṣṇaṃ pravavrire ||77|| vārāṅginya ūcuḥvaradānaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu paramo varaḥ | ākṣaraṃ ca padaṃ sthānaṃ nivāsārthaṃ sadāstu naḥ ||78|| sarvapāpavināśo’tra bhaktyā te no hyajāyata | śuddhā muktānikā divyāḥ kṛtvā naya paraṃ padam ||79|| ityevaṃ badrike tāstu vavrire śrīharestadā | tathāstvevaṃ hariḥ prāha tāvadvimānamāgatam ||4.47.80|| divyaṃ suvarṇavarṇaṃ vai sarvasampadbharaṃ śubham | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatrābhavaddhi hariḥ ||8 1 || rādhālakṣmīyutaḥ so’yaṃ cāvātarad vimānataḥ | sabhāyāḥ purataḥ sthitvā pasparśa tāśca pāṇinā ||82|| tāvattāsāṃ bhautikāstu dehāste nyapatan kṣitau | divyadehāḥ kamalāsadṛśyastā vai tadābhavan ||83|| sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ kṛṣṇājñayāruruhurutsukāḥ | vimānaṃ sahasā bālakṛṣṇena saha taddrutam ||84|| ambare tvabhavad yānaṃ yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ prati | jayanādāstadā hyāsan mahāścaryamabhūttu tat ||85|| aho pāpasamācāramayyo’pi śravaṇāddharim | patiṃ prāpya yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ bhakterhi gauravam ||86|| kṛpāluḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīsvāmivallabhaḥ | mahāpāpātipāpāḍhyān viśodhya nayati dhruvam ||87|| paraṃ padaṃ śāśvataṃ vai nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | evaṃ śrutvā badrike vai camatkāraṃ tadāparāḥ ||88|| mithaḥ prāhuraho ālyo no grāmād gaṇikā kathām | śrotuṃ pañcasutābhiḥ somikānāmnī yayau tu yā ||89|| sā prayayau vimānena harerdhāma paraṃ padam | sā dhanyā somikā cāpi dhanyā putryaśca pañca tāḥ ||4.47.90|| aruṇānī pāṭalānī dhavalānī mṛṇālinī | kiñjalkānī pañca putryo devyo bhūtvākṣaraṃ yayuḥ ||91|| aho vayaṃ prayāsyāmaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaśaraṇaṃ śubham | ātmoddhāraṃ kariṣyāmaḥ sākṣātprāpya patiṃ harim ||92|| ityevaṃ vārasundaryo mitho mithunakuṭṭagāḥ | niścitya tāḥ kathāṃ śrotumāyayurvai sahasraśaḥ ||93|| badrike tīrthayāne’pi pade pade’śvamedhajam | phalaṃ sañjāyate śrāddhavatāṃ tāsāṃ tathābhavat ||94|| pāpānyāsāṃ vinaṣṭāni tīrthābhigamanāttadā | snātvā sthitvā kathāṃ śrutvā mantraṃ prāpurhi lomaśāt ||95|| pauṣakṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ tāḥ kathānte prātareva ha | vimānaṃ tvambarātprāptaṃ vyalokayan suvarṇajam ||96|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇayuktaṃ mahāyatam | hariścāvātarat tasmāt kathāśālāntikaṃ tadā ||97|| vimānādānītavāriprokṣaṇaṃ sa muhurmuhuḥ | kṛtāvān śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vārāṃganāgaṇe ||98|| tāstu prāpya kaṇauṃstūrṇaṃ tyaktabhautikaputtalāḥ | divyamuktānikā bhūtvā tasthuḥ kṛṣṇasya sannidhau || 19|| paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ nītvā kṛṣṇo vimānake | sahasravāramuktābhiḥ sahitaścākṣaraṃ yayau || 4.47.1 00|| tāśca śuddhā brahmahrade snātvā śrīkamalāsamāḥ | dhāmamuktānikā jātāḥ kathākṛṣṇaprasādataḥ || 10 1|| śraddhayā phalamāpnoti bhaktyā prasannatāṃ tathā | sevayātmānamāpnoti kṛpayā parameśvaram || 10 2|| badrike sarvalokeṣu saṃhitāyāḥ kathābalam | prāsarat sahasā mokṣapradaṃ pāpanivāsakam || 1 03|| saṃghaśo vai narā nāryo mokṣārthaṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ | kathāyāḥ śravaṇārthaṃ te samāyānti samantataḥ || 1 04|| kīrtanāni prajāyante bhajanāni sthale sthale | satāṃ sevāḥ pravartante bhakṣyabhojyapradānakaiḥ || 1 05|| camatkārāḥ prajāyante tatra tatra dine dine | śrutvā śrutvā narā nāryo harṣitāḥ saṃbhavanti vai || 1 06|| bhajante śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ sākṣādvaddhradayasthitam | labhante paramaṃ lābhaṃ jñānaṃ śuddhiṃ parāṃ gatim || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kathāśravaṇena kṣīrodavīranṛpateḥ ruhāriṇīrājñīyutasya, sahasrādhiprajānāṃ, pañcaputrīsahitāyāḥ somikānāmnīgaṇikāyāḥ, tathā mithunakuṭṭavāsinīgaṇikānāṃ, saṃhitākathāśravaṇena mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 47 ||
<4.48> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi madyapāyā kathāṃ tathā | bilvapattanavāsāyā liyārīnāmayoṣitaḥ || 1 || bilvākhye pattane markaṭānadeśe tadābhavat | madirāvyavasāyāḍhyaṃ kuṭumbaṃ madyakartṛ tat || 2 || dhvajī tatrābhavanmukhyo nāmnā miṣṭāsavadhvajī | tasya patnī līyāryākhyā putraputrīsamanvitā || 2 || śuśrāva lokamukhataḥ kathāyāḥ paramaṃ balam | śarkarānagare kṛṣṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ tataḥ || 4 || śrotumaicchat pramadā sā svāmine prārthayattataḥ | patirmiṣṭāsavaḥ patnīṃ prāha dūre kathāsthalam || 5 || vartate dīrghamārgaśca gantavyaṃ sabhayaṃ pathi | vayaṃ dhanavihīnāśca dāridryaduḥkhapīḍitāḥ || 6 || yāsyāmo vai kathaṃ mārge vartante luṇṭakā janāḥ | patnī prāha patiṃ śrutvā nāśo dehasya vidyate || 7 || yadvākadācilloke’tra martavyaṃ sarvathā janaiḥ | adya vā bahuvarṣānte dhruvaṃ tu nidhanaṃ matam || 8 || yena kena nimittena maraṇaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati | vayaṃ pāpāḥ pāpakarmāṇaśca pāpaparāyaṇāḥ || 9 || pāpināṃ maraṇaṃ pāpe jāyate tattu śokadam | apāpe puṇyakārye vā jāyate maraṇaṃ yadi || 4.48.1 0|| kaṣṭaṃ vā jāyate tādṛk praśastaṃ lābhadaṃ tu tat | puṇyasaṃkalpakartārastīrthayātrecchavo’pi ca || 11 || akṛtakāryā api te mṛtāḥ svargaṃ prayānti hi | vayaṃ madyapibāḥ sarve sadā mahātipāpinaḥ || 12|| tīrthayātrānimittena mṛtāścet svargabhāginaḥ | luṇṭakairluṇṭitā mārge yadi ced bhikṣayā tataḥ || 1 3|| utpādya bhojanaṃ cāpi gamiṣyāmaḥ kathāsthalam | pāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ tena bhāgyānāmudayo bhavet || 14|| yadvā pramokṣaṇaṃ lokādasmāt syānnātra saṃśayaḥ | sarvathā lābha evāsti hānistatra na vidyate || 15|| tasmāttīrthaṃ prakartavyaṃ gantavyaṃ ca kathāsthale | ityuktastu tayā patnyā kuṭumbasahito dhvajī || 1 6|| sūnī śūnyaṃ gṛhaṃ kṛtvā pratasthe śarkarāyutam | yathā tu cintitaṃ pūrvaṃ tathaivāsyābhavat pathi || 17|| luṇṭakā militā mārge hṛtaṃ tairbhājanādikam | pātheyaṃ gardabhaṃ bhāravāhaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ kharam || 18|| vastrāṇi cāpi pātrāṇi luṇṭakāḥ samapāharan | te tu matvā mahatkaṣṭaṃ kintu tīrthanimittakam || 19|| pūrvaṃ vicāritaṃ cāpi nātikaṣṭaṃ tu menire | hṛtasarvasvakāḥ sarve putrāścaikādaśāpi ca ||4.48.20|| putryaḥ saptadaśa kanyāḥ pitā mātā ca te tataḥ | śanaiḥ śanaiḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ sāyaṃ sarastaṭe ||21|| drumāḍhye bhūtale rātrinirgamāya kṛtādarāḥ | kṛtāvāsā jalaṃ pītvā sasmaruḥ parameśvaram ||22|| kaṣṭaṃ prāptaṃ paraṃ mārge sarvaṃ hṛtaṃ tu luṣṭakaiḥ | adya rātrirgatā syāttu śvaḥ kaṣṭaṃ kṣudhayā bhavet ||23|| martavyaṃ vā bhikṣitavyaṃ cāttavyaṃ dalapatrakam | tathāpi tatkathāsthānaṃ gantavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||24|| niścityaivaṃ samidhaścāhṛtya vahnimacetayan | tadādhārā sthitāḥ sarve kīrtanaṃ saṃpracakrire ||25|| priyākṛṣṇaharekṛṣṇapāvannārāyaṇaprabho | śrīpatilalitākṛṣṇabālakṛṣṇaprabho vibho ||26|| evaṃ pracakrire dhunyaṃ tālīvādanapūrvakam | rātryardhaṃ vigataṃ yāvattāvat kramelakasthitaḥ ||27|| daśoṣṭrasahitaḥ kaścicchreṣṭhī bhojanavastravān | āyayau tena mārgeṇa jalaṃ pātuṃ sarastaṭe ||28||| so’pi vahniṃ śubhaṃ vīkṣya mānavām̐statra saṃsthitān | jalaṃ pītvā pāyayitvā viśrāmārthaṃ samāyayau |||29|| jaya nārāyaṇakṛṣṇetyuktvā hyavātarat sthale | uṣṭrān vṛkṣastambamūle baddhvā vahnisthalaṃ śubham ||4.48.30|| gatvā papraccha tān sarvān vṛttāntaṃ kvāgamādikam | miṣṭāsavo vinīto vai bhūtvā yātrāṃ jagāda tam |||3 1|| luṇṭakairluṇṭitaṃ sarvaṃ tadāpyenaṃ jagāda ha | atha śreṣṭhī paraṃ śrutvā kaṣṭaṃ dayāparo’bhavat ||32|| dadau vai bhojanaṃ tebhyaḥ kharjurādikamuttamam | vastrāṇyapi dadau tebhyo’bhayadānaṃ dadau tataḥ || 33|| uvāca tebhyo mudabhṛd yāmyahaṃ cāpi tatsthalam | kathāṃ śrotuṃ tato yūyamārohadhvaṃ mamoṣṭrakān | |34|| prayāsyāmo’nena pathā prāpsyāmaḥ śvaḥ prage sthalīm | uṣṭrā mārgavidaḥ santi panthānaṃ vedmi cāpyaham | |35|| jayaṃ me vidyate naivārohayadhvaṃ mamoṣṭrakān | ityuktā badrike sarve tvāruruhuḥ kramelakān || 36|| vegavanto dīrghakaṇṭhā uṣṭrā dīrghapadakramāḥ | vegavaddhāvanamagnā akrāmannoditāḥ pathaḥ ||37|| yathā vā garuḍā haṃsā vimānaṃ vā gajā iva | mārgamullaṃghayāmāsuryathāmbaravihāriṇaḥ ||38|| dinadvayasya mārgaṃ te rātryardhe niryayurjavāt | prātarjātaṃ mukhadṛśyaṃ tāvattu śarkarāpuram ||39|| te tvapaśyan puraḥ śvetasaudhālikāpraśobhitam | kathāmaṇḍapasaṃśobhadvyomakalaśarājitam ||4.48.40|| bahubhirmunibhiḥ sadbhirvaiṣṇavaiḥ pramadānaraiḥ | viharadbhiḥ snānapūjādyarthaṃ sañcāribhiḥ prage ||41 || homadhūmraiḥ sūcayadvai kathāsthānaṃ ca ghoṣaṇaiḥ | brāhmaṇānāṃ mukhamantroccāraṇānāṃ samucchritaiḥ ||42|| nārāyaṇaprabhokṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jagatprabho | bālakṛṣṇaharikṛṣṇamādhavīramaṇaprabho ||43||| evaṃ saṃkīrtanairvyāptairdhvanivyāptaṃ tu pāvanam | śarkarānagaraṃ vīkṣyāścaryaṃ paramaṃ lebhire ||44|| sindhutīre drutaṃ gatvā śreṣṭhī sasnau jale muhuḥ | avatārya samastām̐stān pradarśya mārgamuttamam ||45|| kathāsthalasya vai khyātaṃ svayamuṣṭrān samastakān | miṣṭaṃ jalaṃ pāyayitvā drutaṃ tvadṛśyatāṃ yayau ||46|| vīkṣyaitat sa dhvajī sūto mahāścaryaparo’bhavat | aho’yaṃ ko bhaved rakṣākaro’smākaṃ vanāntare ||47|| mahāmārge sukhadātā prāpakaḥ sukathāntike | nūnaṃ nārāyaṇo yadvā bhavet kaścit sureśvaraḥ ||48|| anyathā na bhavedevamadṛśyavartanaṃ kvacit | liyārī sā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sasmāra tatra ha ||49|| ākāśavāṇyā bhagavānāha tāṃ bhagavānaham | uṣṭrānādāya bhaktānāṃ rakṣārthaṃ tvāgato’bhavam ||4.48.50|| yāta śrotuṃ kathāṃ divyāṃ sevantāṃ lomaśaṃ munim | svataḥprakāśaṃ sevantāṃ gatiḥ śreṣṭhā bhaviṣyati ||51 || ityuktā badrike sarve tuṣṭā ānandamoditāḥ| yayuḥ kathāsthalaṃ nītvā kusumānyatibhāvataḥ ||52|| nemuste dūrataḥ sthitvā sabhāyāṃ sampraviśya te | saṃhitāyāḥ pūjanaṃ vai cakruḥ puṣpādibhistataḥ ||53|| niṣeduḥ śravaṇārthaṃ te yāvat kathāpravācanam | kathānte lomaśaṃ gatvā nemuḥ pādajalaṃ papuḥ ||54|| vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsurmārge kṛṣṇakṛtāvanam | yaścāsīduṣṭraśreṣṭhī vai sa tu kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||55|| bhagavān śrīharirasmān kathāsthānaṃ samānayat | tatprapattiṃ samicchāmo dehi mantraṃ supāvanam ||56|| ityarthito lomaśastān śrāvayāmāsa sanmanum | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||57|| tathā tatraiva dhunyārthaṃ dadau nāma harestadā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇapareśvara ||58|| bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa rameśvara | vrataṃ dadau madyahīnaṃ jīvanaṃ tebhya ityatha ||59|| bhojanādivyavasthāṃ ca teṣāṃ śrīlomaśo muniḥ | rājamahānasāccakre nityaṃ kuṭyāṃ nivāsanam ||4.48.60|| evaṃ te badrike tatra samūṣuḥ sarvadā sukham | sevāṃ cakruḥ satāṃ tatra pātrādimañjanaṃ tathā ||6 1|| mārjanaṃ kṣālanaṃ vastvānayanaṃ ca kathāsthale | mahīmānādidehānāṃ saṃvāhanaṃ pracakrire ||62|| śrutvā kathāṃ sevayitvā sādhūnāśīrvaco’mṛtaiḥ | vidhūya sarvapāpāni kṛṣṇaprasādabhojanaiḥ ||63|| nirmalāste samastā vai jātāḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ | puṇyātmānaḥ parā bhaktā ātmanivedino yathā || 64|| saṃsmarantyuṣṭrapālaṃ taṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vallabhātmakam | jagatsvapnasuṣuptyādāvuṣṭrapālo vilokyate ||65|| taccittāstaddhyānamagnāstasminnindriyavṛttayaḥ | tadyogasthāstatsmarāste tanmayā divyabhāvanāḥ ||66|| abhavan svalpakālena mahābhāgavatottamāḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastebhyo badrike svapnagocaraḥ ||67|| bhūtvoṣṭrapālakaḥ sākṣānnārāyaṇaḥ priyaḥpatiḥ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhārī bhavati tatkṣaṇe ||68|| evaṃ dadāti nityaṃ vai darśanaṃ bhaktibandhanaḥ | snehapāśadhṛtaḥ kṛṣṇastānnetuṃ samupāyayau ||69|| divyavimānamāruhya divyaprabhāyutaḥ prabhuḥ | avātarad vimānātsa pauṣasyaikādaśīdine ||4.48.70|| śuklapakṣe paśyatāṃ yāvatāṃ vai bhaktadehinām | miṣṭāsavastathā bhāryā liyārī putraputrikāḥ ||71 || vilokya tvāgataṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vallabhaṃ parameśvaram | sahasotthāya caraṇau natvā cakrurhi daṇḍavat ||72|| lilihuścaraṇau tasya jihvayādhārayan rajaḥ | śarīreṣu tataḥ kṛṣṇamārthayan mokṣasiddhaye ||73|| kṛpālurbhagavānāha sajjā bhavantu vai drutam | nayāmi divyadehān vai yuṣmān dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||74|| ityuktamātrāste sarve’rpitāḥ kṛṣṇasya pādayoḥ | abhavan paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ nyapatan kṣitau ||75|| bhautikāni śarīrāṇi tyaktvā bhūtvā harīcchayā | divyā muktasvarūpāste kṛṣṇatulyaśarīriṇaḥ ||76|| kṛṣṇājñayā niṣeduste drutaṃ divyavimānakam | bhajantaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā sabhāṃ śubhām ||77|| jayaśabdoccārayuktā vimānenākṣaraṃ padam | śrīkṛṣṇena samaṃ badri yayurmuktasvarūpiṇaḥ ||78|| babhūvuḥ kanyakāstāstu mātā muktānikāstathā | putrāḥ pitā ca muktāste yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ ||79|| ityevaṃ badrike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagadruruḥ | dīnānāthadaridrāṇāmuddhārako’sti sarvadā ||4.48.80|| śaraṇāgatarakṣāyāṃ tatparosti sadā prabhuḥ | anavekṣya tu pāpāni pāpināṃ durguṇām̐stathā ||81 || śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāyātān kathāśravaṇapāvanān | anugraheṇa kṛpayā tānnayatyakṣaraṃ padam ||82|| madyapānaratām̐stām̐śca narānnārīḥ samastakān | pāvayitvā prabhurninye kṛpayā svākṣaraṃ padam ||83|| gaṇayatyeva naivāyaṃ karuṇāsāgaraḥ prabhuḥ | pāpāni pāpināṃ loke nayatyavyayamakṣaram ||84|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā lokā vīkṣya camatkṛtim | dīnabandhuraho kṛṣṇaḥ svayamuddhārayatyapi ||85|| dadāti darśanaṃ naijaṃ dadāti vastu vāñchitam | kṛtvā śuddhān yāmyaduḥkhaṃ vināśya śaraṇāgatān ||86|| svayaṃ nayati divyena vimānena nijaṃ padam | aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ kathāśravaṇakāriṇām ||87|| māsamātreṇa muktiṃ sa karoti bhavapāśataḥ | saṃhitā śrīkṛṣṇarūpā lakṣmīrūpāsti śābdikī ||88|| pratimā tāṃ sevayitvā svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca vindati | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya mukto bhavenna saṃśayaḥ ||89|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kathāśravaṇena madyapasya miṣṭāsavadhvajikuṭumbasya mārge luṇṭakaprāptakaṣṭasya śrīhariṇā mārge śreṣṭhirūpeṇa rakṣitasya mokṣaṇaṃ kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 48 ||
<4.49> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi cakriṇyāḥ śobhanāṃ kathām | āsīt kālāntake rāṣṭre gaṇḍavātābhidhā satī || 1 || bhāryā sā yāskavādasya cakriṇo yantrakāriṇaḥ | putraputrīyutā cāpi kuṭumbinī suviśrutā || 2 || yasyā gṛhe lohayantrāṇyutpadyante sahasraśaḥ | ikṣupeṣaṇayantrāṇi tilapeṣaṇakāni ca || 3 || bījapeṣaṇayantrāṇi rasotpādanakānyapi | evaṃvidhāni lauhāni dhātujāni bhavanti ca || 4 || kalābhirdhāturasajānyapi praḍhālakāni ca | yaṃtrāṇāṃ vikrayaṃ sā tu karoti nityameva ha ||5|| krayaṃ karoti bījānāṃ tailārthaṃ sarvatastathā | nijagṛhe’pi yantrāṇi calanti viṃśatistadā || 6 || bhramanti tailapeṣāṇi cekṣupeṣāṇi viṃśatiḥ | cakrāṇāṃ vikrayaṃ nityaṃ bhagnānāṃ yojanaṃ punaḥ || 7 || sandhānaṃ khaṇḍitānāṃ ca kārayatyapi sā satī | yasyā vaśe karmacārāḥ sahasraśo bhavanti vai || 8 || sahasraśaḥ karmacāriṇyo’pi kurvanti tatkriyāḥ | pravartante tu yantrāṇi mahiṣoṣṭrakharādibhiḥ || 9 || nāṇakāni pralabhyante sahasrāṇi daśānvaham | evaṃvidhā mahārājñī yathā tathā tu sā satī ||4.49.1 0|| dravyāḍhyā mānavāḍhyā ca sattāḍhyā paśupālinī | cakriṇī sā dīrgharāṣṭre prasiddhāsīt kalāvatī || 1 1|| badrike sā praśuśrāva māhātmyaṃ janavarṇitam | saṃhitāyāḥ kathājanyaṃ pratāpaṃ mokṣadaṃ param || 12| sā jānāti mahācakrapeṣaṇaiḥ pāpasañcayam | bījādau jīvajantūnāṃ peṣaṇādisamudbhavam || 1 3|| sūnānāṃ ca phalaṃ yāmyapuryāṃ kaṣṭaprabhogitām | nārakīṃ ca gatiṃ nimnāṃ jānātyevātikaṣṭadām || 14|| tatpāpānāṃ praśāntyarthaṃ jijñāsāpreritā tu sā | kathāśravaṇe śraddhāḍhyā kṛtabuddhirvyajāyata || 15|| prāha svasvāminaṃ sādhvī pārāyaṇaṃ prajāyate | śarkarānagare svāmin sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 16|| camatkārāśca bahavaḥ śrūyante pāpanāśakāḥ | mokṣado bhagavām̐statra dṛśyate kṛpayādhunā || 17|| vayaṃ tu pāpino nityaṃ cakriṇaḥ cakrapeṣaṇāḥ | pāpināṃ na gatiḥ śreṣṭhā nārakī gatirīritā ||18|| rājyaṃ rāṣṭraṃ samastaṃ vā yadgṛhe vartate hyapi | dehānte niraye vāsaścet sarvaṃ tannirarthakam || 19|| dhanaṃ cākṣayakośātma dāsā dāsyo’yutānyapi | dehānte narake vāsaścettatsarvaṃ nirarthakam ||4.49.20|| vāṭīkṣetrāṇi cārāmā udyānāni gṛhāṇyapi | dehānte narake vāsaścettatsarvaṃ nirarthakam ||21 || prāsādāḥ svarṇakalaśā dhvajāropasuśobhanāḥ | sampadaḥ kṣayahīnāścāsaṃkhyātā api sarvathā ||22|| dehānte narake vāsaścettatsarvaṃ nirarthakam | mahiṣīgogajavājikramelakakareṇukāḥ ||23|| haṃsagaruḍamenādyāḥ śukasārasacātakāḥ | dehānte narake vāsaścettatsarvaṃ nirarthakam ||24|| patnyo bahvyastathā putrāḥ putryo vaṃśe ca pautrakāḥ | svasāro bhrātaro vṛddhā bāndhavā mātaraḥ striyaḥ ||25||| patayo dāsavargāśca dāsyaścāpi sahasraśaḥ | apyante narake vāsastadā sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||26|| vyāpārā bahavam̐ścāpi śakaṭīnāṃ sahasrakam | yantrāṇāmayutaṃ cāpi vāhanānāṃ sahasrakam ||27|| ānantyaṃ cāpi bhogānāṃ kīrtīnāmutsavāstathā | vidyante’pi ca dehānte nārakī cennirarthakāḥ ||28|| tasmāt svāminnātmakalyāṇārthaṃ vicintayāmyaham | pāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ dānaiḥ satāṃ sevādibhistathā || 29|| kathānāṃ śravaṇaiḥ syācca puṇyodayo bhavedapi | naiṣā smṛddhiḥ puṇyadāsti hiṃsātmikā tu cakriṇī ||4.49.30 || sā smṛddhiḥ puṇyakāryārthaṃ yojanīyeti me matiḥ | lakṣādhikaṃ nāṇakaṃ vai labdhvā yāmaḥ kathāsthalīm ||3 1 || śroṣyāmaḥ satkathāṃ nityaṃ dāsyāmo nāṇakādikam | kariṣyāmaścātmaśuddhiṃ lapsyāmaścātmano hitam |||32||| drakṣyāmaḥ śrīpatiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prāpsyāmaḥ paramaṃ padam | pradhānasyāgryabhṛtyasya kṛtvātmasāt samastakam ||33|| asaṃkhyaṃ vā dhanaṃ nītvā gacchāmo vai kathāsthalīm | jīvane niścayo nāsti nedaṃ sahāgamiṣyati ||34|| dharmakarma mahādānaṃ satāṃ prasannatā vratam | kṛṣṇabhaktiḥ kathāpuṇyaṃ paraloke sahāyadāḥ ||35|| tatkṛtvākṣayapuṇyātmadhanaṃ samarjya sarvathā | mokṣamārge gamiṣyāmo mā vṛthākleśamāvaha ||36|| ityuktaḥ svapatirnāryā mumukṣuścātmavānapi | sammatiṃ pradadau tasyai yātrārthaṃ muktihetave ||37|| prasannā gaṇḍavātā sā sajjābhavattato drutam | śataputrasutāyuktā śatadāsīsamanvitā ||38|| śatadāsairyutā pautraidviśatāmyāṃ samanvitā | snuṣābhiḥ sahitā bālairbālikābhiryutā tathā ||39|| vṛddhābhiḥ sahitā rakṣākṛdbhiśca sadbhaṭairyutā | dveśate śakaṭānāṃ ca vājināṃ dveśate tathā ||4.49.40|| uṣṭrāṇāṃ viṃśatiṃ cāpi vṛṣabhāṇāṃ śataṃ tathā | bhāravāhārthamevaiṣā payodānāṃ gavāṃ śatam ||41 || bhojanānāmapāraṃ ca vastrāṇāṃ cāpyanantakam | pātrāṇāmapyasaṃkhyatvaṃ nītvā sajjābhavattadā ||42|| yāskavādo’pi mudito yātrārthaṃ mokṣahetave | sajjo babhūva nṛpavat koṭisvarṇasamanvitaḥ ||43|| sarvopaskaraṇairyuktaḥ śreṣṭhavimānamāsthitaḥ | patnyā sākaṃ vimānena natvā gaṇeśamīśvaram ||44|| vyomnā tu śarkarābhūmiṃ yayau kuṭumbibhiḥ saha | sārthavāhāśca bhṛtyāśca godhanaṃ sampado’pi ca ||45|| bhūmārgeṇa samāyātaṃ sāyaṃ tu śarkarāpuram | tatrodyāne sindhutaṭe naije vyāpārayogini ||46|| uvāsa sarvasampanno yāskavādaḥ kuṭumbibhiḥ | vyavasthāpya samastaṃ svaṃ sainyaṃ snātvā tataśca saḥ ||47|| patnyā yuto yayau śrīmallomaśaṃ draṣṭumutsukaḥ | gatvā neme pupūjāpi hārdaṃ nyavedayattathā ||48|| lomaśo’pi śubhāśīrbhiḥ protsāhaṃ pradadau tadā | dadau kṛṣṇāmṛtavāri prasādaṃ pradadau tathā ||49|| saṃhitāyāḥ sthalaṃ nītvā kārayāmāsa darśanam | cakrī vyāsāsanaṃ vyāsaṃ pūjayāmāsa saddhanaiḥ ||4.49.50|| bahubhiścopacāraiśca vrataṃ jagrāha tatra ca | sabhāryo nityamevānnaṃ grahīṣyāmyekabhaktakam ||51 || sādhusevāṃ kariṣyāmi kathāśravaṇamanvaham | nityaṃ satāṃ bhojanāni dāsye yatheṣṭakānyapi ||52|| nityaṃ suvarṇadānāni vastradānāni nityaśaḥ | nityaṃ prasādavāryādipānaṃ ca netaradgraham ||53|| svataḥprakāśavyāsasya payaḥpānādi sarvathā | matsakāśādbhavecceti jagrāha niyamān sa tu |||54|| nityaṃ mālāśatāvarttapradakṣiṇaśatādikam | daṇḍavanmantrajapanaṃ sahasravāramuttamam ||55|| evaṃvidhām̐stu niyamān tebhyo dadau hi lomaśaḥ | dadau mantraṃ ca mālāśca nāma japārthamārpayat ||56|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmiprabhonārāyaṇeśvara ||57|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīmādhavīśvara | evaṃ datvā niyamām̐śca lomaśaḥ svāśramaṃ yayau ||58|| yāskavādādayaḥ sarve nivāsaṃ svaṃ yayustataḥ | yathāniyamamevaite vartante sma sukhasthitāḥ ||59|| kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ nityaṃ prakurvanti samutsukāḥ | sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ sarve prakurvanti kṛtādarāḥ ||4.49.60 | niḥsaṃśayā dehasevāṃ sākṣāt kurvanti vai satām | evaṃvidhānāṃ sahasā dhvastānyaghāni cakriṇām ||61 | narā nāryaḥ samastāste niṣpāpā hyabhavan drutam | antaḥkapāṭaṃ nirbhinnaṃ jñānavanto’bhavan drutam |||62| yāskavādo bhojanāni sādhubhyaścānvahaṃ dadau | vastradānāni bahūni phaladānāni sandadau ||63|| iṣṭadānāni sarvāṇi godānāni dadau tathā | dugdhadadhighṛtadānaṃ havyadānāni sandadau ||64|| kambalānāṃ pradānāni patradānāni vai dadau | śṛṃgāravastudānāni pūjāyāṃ mūrtaye dadau ||65|| yānavāhanadāni chatracāmaradānakam | upānaduṣṇīṣavarmadānaṃ bhūṣārpaṇaṃ vyadhāt ||66|| śayyādānaṃ cānnadānaṃ dhānyadānaṃ dadau tathā | svarṇarūpyakamudrādidānaṃ ratnārpaṇaṃ vyadhāt ||67|| vācakāya dadau veṣāmbarāṇi kānakaṃ ghaṭam | vibhūṣaṇāni sarvāṇi svarṇāmbarāṇi vai tathā ||68|| atha bhāryā gaṇḍavātā prasannamānasā tadā | viprāṇībhyo dadau svarṇaṃ rūpyakaṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca ||69|| mauktikāni suratnāni hīrakān śāṭikā dadau | kurcadhrīṃ ca kucadhrīṃ ca kacaloṃ colikāṃ dadau ||4.49.70|| suravālīṃ ghargharīṃ ca kucalīṃ kambalīṃ dadau | raśanāṃ vālapāśīṃ ca lalāṭikāṃ ca karṇikām ||71|| ūrmikāṃgulīyakāni kaṃkaṇavalayān dadau | kaṇṭhikāṃ cāṃgade svarṇamālāśca mudgamālikāḥ ||72|| naro bindvīṃ kuṇḍale ca sauvarṇīḥ śṛṃkhalā dadau | vātagaṇḍā dadauveva miṣṭānnāpi jalānyapi ||73|| kuṃkumākṣatapuṣpāṇi śṛṃgārāṇi dadau tathā | tasyāḥ putrāśca putryaśca godānāni pracakrire ||74|| vājidānoṣṭradānāni vṛṣadānāni vai tadā | cakrustatra supātreṣu mahādānāni vai tadā ||75|| anasāmapi dānāni saudhadānāni bhāvataḥ | tulasīvṛkṣadānāni havyadānāni sandadhuḥ ||76|| saṃhitāpustakadānaṃ sarvadānāni sandadhuḥ | sarvāstatra saha nītāḥ sampado jaḍacetanāḥ ||77|| dadurdāne harerbhaktyā viditvāvasaraṃ śubham | yānavāhanadānāni dāsīdāsapradānakam ||78|| pracakrire yathāyogyaṃ mokṣārthaṃ kṛṣṇamānasāḥ | gate pakṣe samaye tu kathājñānapariplutāḥ ||79|| divyabhāvā vyajāyanta sarve te cakriṇastadā | dāsā dāsyo bhṛtyavargā bāndhavāśca kuṭumbinaḥ ||4.49.80|| ābālavṛddhāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśanam | āturāḥ kartumevāsan mokṣamārgaparāyaṇāḥ ||81 || māghaikādaśikāsāyaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe’rhaṇottaram | ārārtrikaṃ viniṣpādya yāvat kīrtanakovidāḥ ||82|| kurvanti kīrtanaṃ tāvat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhuḥ | bhāsayam̐stejasā vyoma diśāścāvātarad bhuvi ||83|| kānakena vimānena priyālakṣmīyuto hariḥ | vimānād bahirāgatya darśanaṃ svaṃ dadau tadā ||84|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptāḥ śrotāro lakṣaśo janāḥ | narā nāryaḥ kṣaṇaṃ stabdhāstebhyo’bhibhavadṛṣṭayaḥ ||85|| abhavam̐śca tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ saṃhṛtātiprabhaṃ śubham | apaśyam̐ste muhuḥ ramyaṃ sundaraṃ gopikāpatim ||86|| gaṇḍavātābhavanmugdhā śrīkṛṣṇe mādhavīpatau | tatputryaścābhavan mugdhāścātīva paramātmani ||87|| tyaktabhānā abhavam̐stāḥ kṛṣṇākṛṣṭātmavṛttayaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇāya nijadānaṃ tadaiva samacintayan ||88|| dāsyaśca kanyakāścāpi yā yuvatyo’bhavam̐stadā | sarvā mugdhā nijadānaṃ tadā nārāyaṇe vyadhuḥ ||89 || evaṃ narāśca ye bhṛtyāḥ putrā dāsāśca karmiṇaḥ | kṛṣṇākṛṣṭātmadehāste mokṣaṇaṃ vavrire hareḥ ||4.49.90|| jñātvā teṣāmabhiprāyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaparameśvaraḥ | tūrṇaṃ vidhāya divyām̐stān samastān divyavigrahān ||9 1 || dhṛtvā naije vimāne tu kṛtvā muktān surūpiṇaḥ | vivṛttadehān puruṣān nārīrmuktānikāstathā ||92|| kṛtvā śeṣānavasthāpya bālavargān kuṭumbinaḥ | poṣakān rakṣakām̐ścāpi yugalān varayoṣitaḥ ||93|| avasthāpya kṣitau tatra tebhyo datvā śubhāśiṣaḥ | netuṃ yogyānnarānnārīrninye dhāmākṣaraṃ nijam ||94|| sahasraśo narānāryastadā taddehadhāriṇaḥ | divyadehāḥ prabhūtvaiva yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ ||95|| aho vai cakriṇāṃ bhāgyaṃ badrike narayoṣitām | sarvasvārpaṇakartṝṇāṃ yeṣāṃ netā narāyaṇaḥ ||96|| aho kālasya kavalā api dehā hi bhautikāḥ | kṛṣṇecchayā vinā pātaṃ divyā bhūtvā yayuḥ saha ||97|| anyathākartṛsāmarthyaṃ tvetadvai paramātmanaḥ | jaḍaṃ tu cetanaṃ kṛtvā krīḍatyeva ca taiḥ saha ||18||| śeṣāḥ sahasraśaścāpi narā nāryastadā tu ye | kathāṃ śrutvā viniṣpādyā darśanādabhavam̐stathā ||99|| gaṇḍavātākuṭumbaṃ tad yāskavādasya vaṃśina | vaiṣṇavāste tu māsānte yayurnaijaṃ gṛhaṃ tataḥ || 4.49.1 00|| svadeśe tanmahāścaryaṃ jagaduḥ sarvataḥ śubham | muktiṃ prāptāścakradhārā vṛddhā madhyāśca bhāvukāḥ || 10 1|| anye tathaiva bhajanaṃ badrike svālaye vyadhuḥ | evaṃ mahām̐ścamatkārastadā khyāto’bhavad bhuvi || 1 02|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇātpāpanāśanam | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi sarvecchāpūraṇaṃ bhavet || 10 3||| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kathāśravaṇena cakriṇo yāskavādasya tatpatnyā gaṇḍavātāyāśca kathāśravaṇena sahasrādhinaranārībhiḥ sahitāyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena mokṣaṇaṃ kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 49 ||
<4.50> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ nindakayoṣitaḥ | bālavane pure tvāsīnnāstikā dveṣakāriṇī || 1 || dvirvadantītināmnyeva prasiddhā śūdrabhāminī | anapatyā rugṇapatibhāryā sarvasya nindikā || 2 || yasya kasyāpi śraiṣṭhyaṃ vābhyudayaṃ sā śṛṇoti cet | khaṇḍayatyeva sāmarṣā svabhāvājjvalanātmikā || 3 || tejodveṣakarī cāpyasahamānānyagauravam | nindatyeva satī lokān sajjanām̐śca satīstathā || 4 || vipraṃ guruṃ pitarau ca vṛddhān kuṭumbino’pi ca | nṛpaṃ rājñīṃ satīṃ sādhvīṃ sādhūnnindati vai vṛthā || 5 || etādṛśyāstu nindāyāḥ pāpaṃ tasyā mahaddhyabhūt | anapatyā tataścāste rugṇaścāsyāḥ patistathā || 6 || nindanaṃ khananaṃ proktaṃ bhāgyasya vaṃśajasya ca | vaṃśasyocchedanaṃ tena pāpena jāyate tataḥ || 7 || narake vasatiḥ syācca nirvaṃśasya mṛtasya vai | puṇyanāśo nindayā syād dharmanāśo’pi nindayā || 8 || yaśohānirnindayā cānṛtaṃ sarvaṃ hi nindayā | mṛṣā kṣepo nindayā syādanartho nindayā bhavet || 9 || aparādho nindayā syād devadharmādikhaṇḍanam | nindayā śāstranāstikyaṃ vratotsavādikhaṇḍanam || 4.50.1 0|| evamādīni pāpāni prajāyante hi nindayā | nindāsvabhāvinī nārī nindati svapatiṃ hyapi || 11 || mātaraṃ pitaraṃ śvaśrūṃ śvaśuraṃ nindati hyapi | yoginaṃ ca mahātmānaṃ guruṃ pūjyaṃ pareśvaram || 12|| lakṣmīṃ rādhāṃ māṇikīṃ ca lalitāṃ cāpi nindati | muktān muktānikāścāpi mandirāṇi harestathā || 1 3|| devālayān daivijanān satpuruṣān vinindati | kathāṃ mokṣakarīṃ mokṣaṃ svagṛhaṃ ca paragṛham || 14|| nindatyeṣā caritrāṇi śrīkṛṣṇasyāpi sarvathā | pāvanāni ca kāryāṇi tīrthānyapi ca nindati || 15|| yajñayāgādikaṃ ceṣṭāpūrttaṃ cāpi vinindati | nindakaḥ sarvathā dveṣyakāraṇakaḥ prajāyate || 16|| tasmānnindā mahāpāpaṃ duṣṭanirayasadṛśam | adhonirayadā nindā mahārauravadāyinī || 17|| vaṃśanāśakarī nindā badrike’rthavināśinī | evaṃpāpābhisaṃvyāptā dvirvadantī tu śūdrikā || 18|| śuśrāva lokamukhato māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśakam | saṃhitāyāḥ kathāyā vai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ca || 19|| dvirvadantī patiṃ prāha nāmnā dvirgarjanaṃ tadā | śarkarānagare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya gauravam ||4.50.20 || śrūyate ca camatkāraḥ pratyakṣadarśanaṃ tathā | kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ cāpi sarvapāpavināśanam ||21|| gacchanti tīrthayātrārthaṃ mānavāstatra saṃghaśaḥ | na manye’haṃ tādṛśaṃ vai māhātmyaṃ tīrthabhūmijam ||22|| tīrthaṃ vrataṃ kathā yātrā dānaṃ sarvaṃ mṛṣā sadā | kiṃ tīrthena kathayā vā vṛthā yānti janāḥ khalāḥ ||23|| gatānugatiko loko luṇṭako miṣamātrakṛt | vṛthā gāyanti māhātmyaṃ lokāḥ kṛṣṇasya tatra vai ||24|| svāmin kiṃ tadbhavet satyaṃ mayānṛtaṃ tu manyate | kapaṭaṃ sarvamevaitajjaḍānāṃ tat pratāraṇam ||25|| ityuktaḥ sa patirnāmnā dvirgarjano jagāda tām | maivaṃ maivamavocastat satyamevānṛtaṃ nahi ||26|| satyo nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ satyā kathāghahāriṇī | satyaḥ sarvaścamatkāro māhālayaṃ ca ṛtaṃ hareḥ ||27|| tīrthaṃ vrataṃ kathā yātrā dānaṃ sarvamṛtaṃ priye | tīrthena kathayāghānāṃ kṣālanaṃ jāyate priye ||28|| na loko luṇṭakaḥ patni na gatānugato’pi ca | yatra śrībhagavadvārtāyajño bhavati sarvathā ||29|| vārṣikaḥ sa mahāyajñastatroddharanti pāpinaḥ | nindikā nāstikā tv tu pāpā pāpamayī sadā ||4.50.30 || pāpameva kalpayasi nindanaṃ prakaroṣi ca | kiṃ tvayā nindayā bhārye prāpyate duṣṭavādini ||3 1 || maivaṃ punaravoco māṃ na śroṣyāmi hi nindanam | nindāphalaṃ mahāghoraṃ bhujyate tvanapatyatā |||32|| punarnindāphalena tvaṃ prayāsyasi yamālayam | ityuktā sā dvirvadantī prāhānṛto yamālayaḥ ||33|| na yamā na yamāvāso bālānāṃ bhayameva tat | asatyā vai yamāḥ sarve yamālayo’nṛtālayaḥ ||34|| evamāha tadā tāṃ ca patiḥ prāha hitāvaham | duṣṭe vīkṣya camatkāraṃ saty sarvamavāpsyasi ||35|| pāpaphalaṃ bhavatyeva kṛṣṇanindotthamulbaṇam | tadā jñāsyasi satyaṃ tad yamālayaṃ yamānapi ||36|| virarāma patistūktvā sāpi nāstikyabhāvataḥ | nindatyeva hariṃ dharmaṃ kathāṃ sādhūn yamādikān ||37|| tāvadevāmbarāttatra yamadūto viniryayau | śrutvā vākyaṃ dvirvadantyāḥ ṛddhaśca darśanaṃ gatāḥ ||38|| adṛśyata karālo’ti parvataprāyadehavān | daṃṣṭrākarālaḥ kṛṣṇaśca kajjalābho bhayāvahaḥ || 39|| ūrdhvaromā bahirdanto raktasphāritanetrakaḥ | mahāmudgarahetiśca lalajjihvo vivastrakaḥ ||4.50.40 || vajrakāṭhinyapuṣṭaśca mahākapardimālikaḥ | śaṃkukarṇo dviśṛṃgaśca dīrghapāśāḍhyahastakaḥ ||41 || loṣṭhaśṛkhalāskandhaśca baddhāyomekhalākaṭiḥ | lohadaṇḍaṃ saśūlaṃ ca kare dadhan saroṣakaḥ ||42||| udyamya mudgaraṃ vegāt kruddhastāḍayituṃ ca tām | abhyāyau dvirvadantīṃ garjayan sarvato diśaḥ ||43|| tāvat sā taṃ vilokyaivābhavat trastā savepathuḥ | śaithilyadehabandhāśca tyaktaviṇmūtramūrchitā ||44|| ākrośaṃ duḥśravaṃ kṛtvā papāta tatra bhūtale | rakṣāṃ rakṣāṃ karotvevaṃ vadamānā papāta sā ||45|| prasāritāṃghrihastā cottānā vyāttānanābhavat | svedaklinnābhavat tāvad yamadūtena vai krudhā ||46|| tāḍitā mudgareṇaiva śikṣārthaṃ dvirvadantikā | mahākaṣṭaṃ ca lebhe sā drutaṃ bhagnāsthikābhavat ||47|| cūrṇadehā mahāmāramāpannā maraṇonmukhī | sañjātā sā tadā dūtaḥ pasparśa tāṃ kareṇa vai ||48|| sampannadehā sañjātā yathāpūrvaśarīriṇī | punaḥ sā gadayā vahni tāḍitā śikṣaṇāya vai ||49|| bhagnavaṃśā bhagnadehā prabhagnamastakabhavat | vihvalā cūrṇitadehā sravadraktābhito’bhavat ||4.50.50|| tathāpi sā sthiraprāṇā mahākaṣṭamavāpa ha | punaḥ kareṇa dūtastaṃ pasparśa sā samantataḥ ||51|| yathāpūrvaśarīrā sābhavat tāvad yamānugaḥ | lohadaṇḍena tāṃ pṛṣṭhe mārayāmāsa vai balāt ||52|| praphullapṛṣṭhabhāgā sā mahāmāraprapīḍitā | ākrandanaṃ mahaccakre muktakaṇṭhātitāḍitā ||93|| pāśenābadhya tāṃ dūtastasthau nagnāṃ vidhāya vai | prakāśaṃ vyaktarūpo’bhūd gocaraḥ sarvadehinām ||54|| ākrandanaṃ mahacchrutvā patiḥ pārśvanivāsinaḥ | narā nāryaḥ prapaśyanto mahātrāsātivihvalāḥ ||55|| dūre eva sthitāstrastā nāyayuḥ sannidhau bhayāt | dūtadarśanamātreṇa nirbalā viviśurgṛham ||56|| dūtastu tāṃ mahāpāpāṃ sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tadā | garjayan digvibhāgām̐śca jagāda marmabhedakam ||57|| raṇḍe duṣṭe pāpakartri nindike nāstiki khale | kathaṃ nindasi dharmaṃ tvaṃ vrataṃ puṇyaṃ hariṃ kathām ||58|| kasmānnindasi sādhūm̐stvaṃ vaṃśavināśakāriṇi | jihvāṃ te kartayiṣyāmi karṇau ca nāsikāṃ tathā ||59||| bhedayiṣyāmi vakṣojau nāśayiṣyāmi mastakam | mūrdhajān kartayiṣyāmi pāṭayiṣye’rdhavarṣma te ||4.50.60|| tvacaṃ cotkartayiṣyāmi pātayiṣyāmi dantakān | udaraṃ troṭayiṣyāmi vahniṃ dāsyāmi guhyake ||61|| lauhena śaṃkunā dehaṃ bhedayiṣyāmi pāpini | kathaṃ tvaṃ nindasi sarvān mṛṣāvādān prakatthase ||62|| yamadūtān yamaṃ naiva gaṇayasyatināstike | jīvato mārayiṣyāmi punarnaivaṃ kṛthā yathā ||63|| vadanneva mamāraināṃ pāśabaddhāṃ vaśaṃgatām | sparśena sajvarā cāpi kurvanmuhurgatajvarām ||64|| hāhākāro mahān jāto nagare tatra sarvaśaḥ | rakṣako nahi tatrāsīd balavān harimantarā ||65|| sā tadātimahāduḥkhā tāḍyamānā nirāśrayā | anāthā nāstikā svārtharakṣārthaṃ tvāstikābhavat ||66|| sasmāra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ trātāramacyutam | hṛdaye prāñjalirbhūtvā dadhyau śrīpārśvagaṃprabhum ||67|| tāvad dūto nijahetīn vṛtvā mārānnyavartata | tadā jñātavatī duṣṭā kṛṣṇasmṛterbalaṃ mahat ||68|| atha kaṣṭātimagnā sā vyājahāra hare hare | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāminnārāyaṇanarāyaṇa ||69|| tāvad dūtaḥ sthalaṃ tyaktvā dudrāva dūrato yayau | adṛśyatāṃ gato vyomni durvadantī sukhaṃ gatā ||4.50.70|| svāsthyamāsādya cotthāya dhṛtvā vastrāṇi varṣmaṇi | galitagarvā lokena dhikkṛtā ca tiraskṛtā ||71 || viveśa lajjitā tūrṇaṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ cāpyaghomukhī | viveda kṛṣṇamāhātmyaṃ māhātmyaṃ kṛṣṇasaṃsmṛteḥ ||72|| kṛṣṇanāmnāṃ ca māhātmyaṃ viveda yāmyamārataḥ | atha sā svapatiṃ prāha śreyase pāpanuttaye ||73|| saṃhitāyāḥ kathāsthānaṃ gantavyaṃ tīrtharūpi yat | yatra pārāyaṇaṃ mokṣapradaṃ pāpaghnamuttamam ||74|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāsti kathāmṛtam | tatpānārthaṃ ca sādhūnāṃ sevārthaṃ gamyameva tat ||75|| yāmyaduḥkhavināśārthaṃ gantavyaṃ tatra sarvathā | ityuktaḥ svapatistvāha tathāstvevaṃ kuru priye ||76|| mayāpi śreyase tatrāgantavyaṃ mokṣade sthale | ityevaṃ badrike kṛtvā niścayaṃ tau tu dampatī ||77|| sajjāvabhavatāṃ tūrṇaṃ padbhyāṃ mārgeṇa nirgatau | prāpya vai śarkarābhūmiṃ snātvā sindhujale tataḥ ||78|| saṃhitāyā maṇḍapau tau gatvā vṛttāntamātmanoḥ | nivedayāmāsaturvai lomaśāya mahātmane ||79|| lomaśastatsamaye ca dadau kṛṣṇapadāmṛtam | vāri prasādaṃ miṣṭaṃ ca vrataṃ dadau tataḥ param ||4.50.80|| ekabhuktaṃ nityakathāśravaṇaṃ sādhusevanam | prasādabhojanaṃ cāpi sabhāsthānādimārjanam ||81 || vaiṣṇavānāṃ dehasaṃvāhanādikaṃ ca pratyaham | sevāvrataṃ dadau tābhyāṃ tathā mantraṃ sukhapradam ||82|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāminnārāyaṇanarāyaṇa ||83|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktaparāyaṇa | evaṃ dhunyaṃ sadā kartuṃ śikṣayāmāsa nāma ca ||84|| tau tataḥ pāvanau nityaṃ dhunyaṃ vidadhataḥ śubham | naṣṭapāpau gatakleśau kathāśravaṇapāvitau ||85|| sādhusevādibhirnaṣṭavāsanau saṃbabhūvatuḥ | māsamātraṃ śrutavantau pārāyaṇakathāmṛtam ||86|| divārātraṃ satāṃ sevāṃ cakratuśca yathocitām | sarvasvārpaṇabhāvau tau sādhuprasādabhojinau ||87|| bhaktimantau snehavantau babhūvaturnarāyaṇe | kṛtadhyānau nimagnau ca harermūrtau babhūvatuḥ ||88|| nindāpāpaṃ samastaṃ tat satsevayā layaṃ gatam | mahimā sādhuṣu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe vyavardhata ||89|| athāyuḥpūrṇatāṃ prāptau gatasaṃsārabandhanau | dvirgarjano dvirvadantī hyubhau pārāyaṇasthale ||4.50.90|| māghe vasantapañcamyāṃ vasantotsavanottaram | prāptamūrchau drutaṃ tyaktvā dehau divyau babhūvatuḥ ||91 || dehābhyāṃ ṣoḍaśavarṣau divyābhyāṃ taijasānvitau | paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ gocarau sundarau śubhau ||92|| divyabhūṣaṇamālāḍhyau divyagandhānugandhitau | divyaveṣābhisampannau muktau tau sambabhūvatuḥ ||93|| tāvattatra samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ bhāsvaraṃ śubham | sauvarṇaṃ tejasā vyāptaṃ vyomamārgādavātarat ||94|| yatra nārāyaṇasvāmī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | śriyā sākaṃ vimāne śrīmāṇikyayā yuto’bhavat ||95|| divyamālāmbarabhūṣādivyaśṛṃgāraśobhanaḥ | divyābhiśca samastābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ parisevitaḥ ||96|| hasan prasādaṃ janayan paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām | tau dvau muktau vimāne sve nītvā dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau ||97|| jayaśabdā jayanādāstadābhavan samantataḥ | evaṃ śrībadrike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ priyeśvaraḥ ||98|| kathāśravaṇapuṇyena satāṃ sevāphalena ca | nināya tau mahābhaktau kṛpayā svākṣaraṃ padam ||99|| śaraṇāgatabhaktānāṃ gaṇayatyeva naiva saḥ | dūṣaṇānyaparādhān śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhuḥ || 4.50.10 0|| dayāluḥ sa dayāṃ kṛtvā śaraṇāgatarakṣakaḥ | āpadduḥkhaṃ vārayati nayatyakṣaramuttamam || 101 || paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccintanādapi | bhuktiḥ svargaṃ badri muktiḥ kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā bhavet || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne sarvanindāparāyaṇayoḥ dvirvadantīdvirgajanayoryamadūtadarśanottaraṃ saṃhitāśravaṇārthaṃgatayoḥ kṛpālurbhagavān paramamuktiṃ kṛtavānityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 50 ||
<4.51> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ gurughnamokṣadām | āsīt khanipure vipro nāmnā suraprasādakaḥ || 1 || mātāpitarau vārdhakye sutamekamavāpatuḥ | buddhyā yuktaṃ ca vātsalyapātraṃ snehāspadaṃ param || 2 || lālayāmāsatuḥ samyak pālayāmāsaturbahu | vardhayāmāsatuḥ khānapānādibhiḥ samāhitau || 3 || modayāmāsatuḥ putraṃ vastrabhūṣādibhistathā | pāṭhayāmāsatuścāpi vipravidyāṃ ca vaidikīm || 4 || tathāpi badrike bhāgyaṃ yādṛśaṃ rekhayotthitam | tādṛśaṃ bhujyate kāle bhogārthe samupasthitam || 5 || yadi pūrvakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ putrajanmapradaṃ bhavet | tadā putro jāyate’tha ṛṇāpākaraṇāya saḥ || 6 || yadi puṇyaṃ na dīrghaṃ syājjīvanārthaṃ tathā sutaḥ | utpadya maraṇaṃ caiti daivaṃ tādṛk hi nirmitam || 7 || yadi puṇyaṃ daśavarṣāyuṣyapradaṃ bhavettadā | tāvanmātraṃ gṛhe sthitvā paralokāya yāti saḥ || 8 || yadi sevārthakaṃ puṇyaṃ pitroḥ putrasya cārjitam | bhavettadā sutaḥ sevāṃ pitroḥ karoti vai dhruvām || 9 || yadi puṇyaṃ na sevārthaṃ pitṛbhyāṃ pālito’pi saḥ | tadā pitarau santyajya paradeśaṃ paragṛham || 4.51.1 0|| parāṅkaṃ vā paravaśaṃ paraputratvametyapi | sevate na suto naijaḥ pitarāvapyapuṇyataḥ || 11 || paraputraḥ sevate’pyapitarau puṇyayogataḥ | karmabandho hi saṃsāro yatrarṇa tatra padyate || 12|| anṛṇaṃ na paśuścāpi sameti mānavaḥ kutaḥ | badrike yad yadadṛṣṭajanyaṃ tad dūramityapi || 13|| sākṣātparamparayā vā tadarthamupayāti tam | kanyā gaurgajahaṃsādyā jāyante parabhūmiṣu || 14|| prapadyante’dṛṣṭavantaṃ svāminaṃ parabhūsthitam | annaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ kṣāraṃ salilamoṣadham || 15|| prajāyante’nyatra bhāgyavanto’nyatrāpnuvanti tān | tāpaḥ śaityaṃ payo mudrāmbaraṃ bhūṣā ca hīrakaḥ || 1 6|| khanyantarodbhavāścāpi prāpnuvanti paraṃ janam | evaṃ vai badrike loke karmasambandhayojitam || 17|| pravartate mahācakramagamyayogadāyakam | yadarthaṃ yatate lokastallokārthaṃ na tiṣṭhati || 18|| yadarthe na yatate tat prasahyāgatya tiṣṭhati | evaṃvidhe’tra lokai vai jñānināṃ rāgaśūnyatā || 19|| aparigrahatā cāpi viśokatā vibaddhatā | ātmārāmasukhitā ca brahmānandapadasthitiḥ || 4.51.20 || jāyante nirguṇatvaṃ ca māyāśūnyatvamityapi | mokṣaṇaṃ te prāpnuvanti vivekino hi bhaktitaḥ ||21 || anyathā tu suyoge syāt sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ viyogake | karmabaddhaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ yojanaṃ ca viyojanam ||22|| karmaśūnyasya mokṣaḥ syād durbhāgyasya na mokṣaṇam | sarve’rthāḥ santi loke’tra durbhāgyā nāpnuvanti hi ||23|| vārdhakye putravattāpi daurbhāgye sukhadā na hi | tathā suraprasādasya pitarāvativatsalau ||24|| preṣayāmāsatuḥ putramadhyayanārthamutsukau | prabhāvarapuraṃ vidvadvipragṛhe hitāvahau ||25|| bahuvidyādilābhārtha yayau suraprasādakaḥ | adhyetumadhikāṃ vidyāmāśā hi balavattarā ||26|| so’pi vidyecchayā tyaktvā mātaraṃ devanandinīm | pitaraṃ devadharmāṇaṃ yayau gurorgṛhaṃ drutam ||27|| natvā guruṃ bhargacātvālakaṃ vṛttāntamāha tam | guruḥ prasannacittaścādhyāpayāmāsa taṃ mudā ||28|| uvāsa bahuvarṣāṇi gurorgṛhe nirāmayaḥ | niścinto nityapāṭhī ca mahodyamaparāyaṇaḥ ||29|| daivajñatā tattvavittvamātmavidyāṃ samārjayat | vidvān kīrtiparipūrṇo jāto vidyāprabhāvavān || 4.51.30|| badrike sa tu vidyāptipuṇyavānapi sarvathā | pitro sevāpuṇyahīnaḥ tayoḥ sevāṃ na labdhavān || 31 || adhityāpi gṛhaṃ naiva yayau vidyābhimānavān | kadaryasya gṛhaṃ yadvannaijaṃ gṛhaṃ na rocate || 32|| ato naiva yayau pitroḥ sevālābhaṃ na cāptavān | sa lābhastu gataścāsya tāvadvṛddhau tu tadgunahe | | 33|| vārdhakyenāmayavyāptāvabhūtāvarapīḍitau | sasmaratuḥ sutaṃ tvekaṃ vidvāsaṃ dūravāsinam ||34|| adhitvā nāgataṃ preṣṭhaṃ tatyajatuśca jīvanam | putraputretiputreti vadantau maraṇaṃ gatau ||35|| badrike bahupuṇyena pitroḥ sevā tu labhyate | maraṇasya kṣaṇe putrāsyapradarśanamityapi ||36|| bahupuṇyena bhavati na bhavet karmahinayoḥ | evaṃ pāpaṃ tu putrasya jātaṃ tadā tu badrike ||37|| pitrasevākṛtaṃ sarvaṃ mṛtyurniḥśvāsakāritam | vidyādhanaṃ na vai śreṣṭhaṃ pitṛsevādisannidhau ||38|| pitṛsevā cātipuṇyatamā śreṣṭhā ca puṇyadā | mokṣadā svargadā sarvapāpadhvaṃsavidhāyinī ||39|| sarvāpannāśinī badri pitṛsevottamottamā | sā na labdhā sutaiścet sā parā hāniḥ prajanminām || 4.51.40|| sarvaṃ vināśitaṃ tena pitṛniḥśvāsabhasmitam | apyanyāśīḥsahasrāṇi dahyanti pitṛśāpataḥ ||41|| anyaśāpasahasrāṇi naśyanti tatprasādataḥ | badrike puṇyahīnasya suraprasādakasya ha ||42|| pitrasevodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ hānidaṃ samajāyata | vidyādhyāpayiturdveṣaṃ tata ārabhata dvijaḥ ||43|| bhargacātvālako vidyāguruḥ khyāto’bhavaddhyati | sahate na sa tāṃ khyātiṃ duṣṭabhāvo’timānavān ||44|| guruṃ sa nindati nityaṃ vidyāyāṃ gauravaṃ gataḥ | guroḥ kīrtiṃ khaṇḍayati gato’nyatra sabhādiṣu ||45|| evaṃ pāpena liptaḥ sa viśeṣeṇāpyajāyata | duṣṭā buddhirutthitāsya vidvānahaṃ na cāparaḥ ||46|| gururmayā samo nāsti tadānyasya tu kā kathā | evaṃ svaṃ gauravaṃ vakti cintayatyeva tādṛśam ||47|| manasā vacasā nindāṃ dveṣaṃ karoti sadguroḥ | karmaṇāpi kratau śraiṣṭhyaṃ naijaṃ vijñāpayatyapi ||48|| karmakāṇḍe ca vijñāne garvaṃ karoti cordhvagam | badrike nāśamāyāti puṇyaṃ sarvaṃ gurudviṣaḥ ||49|| vidyā bhāgyaṃ sampadaśca yaśo nāśaṃ prayānti ca | pāpaṃ bhramo vicittatvamunmattatā bhavanti ca || 4.51.50 || aunmatyena tu doṣeṇa sahito’pi gurorgṛhe | vasatyeva sa taṃ dveṣṭi guruṃ ced dṛṣṭigocaram ||51|| putravat pālitaṃ śiṣyaṃ dayālurgurudevatā | na niṣkāsayati sthānād vātsalyaṃ hi nirodhakṛt| ||52|| unmatto’pi mahāvidvānnavyavastho vivekavān | pāpābhibhūtahṛdayaḥ pāpanaṣṭavicāravān ||53|| ekadā svaguruṃ suptaṃ gatvā hastakuṭhārakaḥ | ciccheda mastakaṃ rātrau nanarta cittavarjitaḥ ||54|| nṛtyaghoṣaṃ samākarṇya tatra bhāryā gurostadā | tathā śiṣyā apare ca samāyayustadantike ||55|| tāvat kuṭhārahastaṃ taṃ vīkṣya bhāsaṃ prapedire | vīkṣya hataṃ guruṃ sarve rurudurmuktakaṇṭhinaḥ ||56||| hāhākāro mahān jātaścāśrameṣu dvijātiṣu | vicittasyātiduṣṭatvaṃ jñātvā śāpāndadustadā ||57|| aho hatyā kṛtānena duṣṭena gṛhavāsinā | mahācāṇḍālatulyena so’pi hato’stu tattathā ||58|| gurorhatyā mahāhatyā śatastrīhatyayā samā | strīhatyā tu śatabhrūṇahatyātulyā nigadyate ||59|| bhrūṇahatyā śatamatsyahatyāsamā nigadyate | matsyahatyā śatavṛkṣahatyāsamā bhavatyapi || 4.51.60|| vṛkṣahatyā śatastambanāśasamā prakīrtyate | pitā bījapradaḥ śreṣṭho mātā garbhasya rakṣiṇī ||61|| gururjñānapradānena muktido hi tayoḥ paraḥ | saṃsārārṇavamagnānāmuddhārakṛdgururhariḥ ||62|| mokṣaṃ karoti jīvānāṃ pāpāni kṣālayatyapi | kṛṣṇavadrakṣaṇaṃ māyāpāśāt karoti sadguruḥ ||63|| sa vai śreṣṭhatamaścāste’saṃkhyaprāṇipramokṣakṛt | nārāyaṇasya vijñānaṃ paricayaṃ dadātyapi ||64|| nayatyagre gatiṃ gacchannākarṣayan prapannakam | sākṣī yo dharmakarmādau yāmyakaṣṭanivārakaḥ ||65|| brahmānandapradātā ca guruḥ śreṣṭhatamo’dhikaḥ | gurormukhe caturvedā jihvāyāṃ śāradā satī ||66|| gāyatrī cauṣṭhayostasya sāvitrī kaṇṭhavartinī | mastake brahmanirvāṇaṃ bhāle rudrasthalī guroḥ ||67|| bhrūmadhye tu bhavaścāste brahmā bhūkuṭimadhyagaḥ | viṣṇurgurostu hṛdaye sūryacandrau tu netrayoḥ ||68|| karṇayorvartate śabdabrahma śāśvatamakṣaram | hastayorindradevādyā nāsāyāmaśvinīsutaḥ ||69|| golokaścāpi vaikuṇṭhastanayorvartate guroḥ | udaye tvamṛtaṃ dhāma nābhāvavyākṛtaṃ padam || 4.51.70|| jaghane satyalokaṃ ca gupte brahmavrataṃ guroḥ | kaṭyāṃ hiraṇyagarbho’sti pṛṣṭhe meruḥ surālayaḥ ||71|| nitambayormahāpṛthvī prakṛtirgahvare’sti ca | sakthnoḥ śvetadvīpadugdhodadhī staḥ śrīguroḥ sadā ||72|| jānvoḥ sutalavāsāśca jaṃghayordivyaśaktayaḥ | pādayoḥ śrīguroḥ sarvatīrthānyabhivasanti vai ||73|| pitaraścāsya keśeṣu siddhāścāsya tvaci sthitāḥ | prāṇe puṇyāni sarvāṇi mokṣo guroḥ kare sthitaḥ ||74|| guroḥ prasāde svargāṇi saṃkalpe sampadaḥ sthitāḥ | guroḥ kriyāyāṃ vai cintāmaṇayaḥ kāmadhenavaḥ ||75|| sevāyāṃ kalpavṛkṣāśca vacane kalpavallayaḥ | icchāyāmakṣayapātraṃ guroḥ snehe hariḥ svayam ||76|| guroḥ śaraṇe muktiśca gurvāsane śriyaḥ puram | gurormūrtiḥ parabrahma vāsudevo gurau sthitaḥ ||77|| śrīkṛṣṇo’sti gurutādātmyatāṃ prāptaḥ pareśvaraḥ | sarvakāmaprapūraḥ śrīsadgururbadrike bhuvi ||78|| vinā guruṃ na nistāro bhavārṇavaraṇasya vai | agurūṇāṃ dehināṃ tu gatiḥ kutrāpi nāsti vai ||79|| tasmād guruṃ śrayed bhaktyā sarvasvārpaṇasevayā | gurughnaḥ sarvavidyāghnaḥ sarvadevādināśakaḥ || 4.51.80|| svargamokṣarddhisampadghnaścātmaghno brahmahā mataḥ | sarvapumarthahāḥ proktaḥ sarvaśaktivighātakaḥ ||8 1|| gatirnāsti sthitirnāsti sthānaṃ nāsti gurorhanaḥ | yaśo nāsti sukhaṃ nāsti sarvathā dhig gurorhanaḥ |82|| sarvapāpāni lokānāṃ naśyanti gurusannidhau | gurordveṣātmakaṃ pāpaṃ kṛṣṇāgre’pi na naśyati ||83|| śrīkṛṣṇo gurvadhīno’sti rādhālakṣmyādikā api | gurvadhīnā devatāśca sarvātivāhikīprabhāḥ ||84|| gurustvanargalaṃ divyaṃ kapāṭaṃ paramokṣiṇām | gururvidyutprakāśo’sti mahādīpo’ntaraprabhaḥ || 85|| taddhāte sarvaghātānāṃ jāyante’ghāni ghātinām | tatsevane sarvasevāphalānyabhimilanti ca ||86|| tatprasāde sarvaprasannatā bhavanti sevinaḥ | gurorlābhe sarvalābhā gurorhāne layo mahān ||87|| gurormūrtiḥ sadā divyā tvāśikhānakhamadbhutā | nārāyaṇaḥ pṛthaṅ nāsti gurormūrteḥ kadācana ||88|| pūjayā sadguroḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prapūjyate | bhojanena guroḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhunakti ca ||89|| jalapānena ca guroḥ kṛṣṇastṛpto pibatyapaḥ | gurordehasya sevābhiḥ sevyate parameśvaraḥ || 4.51.90|| gurornāśena yāvatyaḥ sevā naṣṭā bhavanti vai | evaṃ tena dvijenāpi gurorhatyā kṛtā yataḥ ||91 || sarvaṃ tasyābhavad badri vinaṣṭaṃ śubhasaṃjñitam | vicitto jaḍavanmūrkha unmatto buddhivarjitaḥ ||92||| bhraman mārge vane’raṇye niryayau sa gurorgṛhāt | śarkarānagaraṃ prāpto daivātpūrvānukarmataḥ ||93|| kathāsthānaṃ yayau vidvām̐stasthau kṣaṇaṃ mudaṃ yayau | saṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ śrutvā pītvāmṛtaṃ harestadā ||94|| prasādānnaṃ mahāpaṃktau bubhuje ca kathāmakhe | satāṃ maharṣivaryāṇāṃ darśanaṃ prāptavān mudā ||95|| guruhatyākṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śanaiḥ śanairnyavartata | manasaḥ svasthatā jātā dehabhānaṃ vyavartata ||96|| unmādo’sya layaṃ prāpto vicittatā sucittatā | jātā tataḥ saśokena lomaśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ||97|| nyavedayat samastaṃ tat pāpaṃ duḥkhaṃ viśodhanam | lomaśo brahmakūrcākhyaṃ vrataṃ tasmai dadau tadā ||98|| māsaṃ cakre palāśādipatrāṇāṃ vahninā kṛtam | gavyānāṃ kvathitaṃ vāri papau śuddhiṃ jagāma saḥ ||99|| kathāyāḥ śravaṇenāsau niṣpāpaḥ sādhusevayā | vipro jātastato mantramasmai śrīlomaśo dadau || 4.51.1 00|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāminśrīharevallabha prabho || 10 1|| anādi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa padmāvatīprabho | evaṃ sa bhajanaṃ cakre dhyānaniṣṭho harau sthitaḥ || 1 02|| tīvrasaṃvegamāpannaḥ smṛtvā hatyāṃ guroḥ svayam | pitṛtyāgaṃ tathā smṛtvā mahāśokamagāttathā | | 1 03|| rātrindivaṃ bhajanaṃ sa cakāra pārameśvaram | virāgabhāvamāpannaḥ prātilomyamavāpa saḥ || 1 04|| sarvā vṛttīḥ parāvṛttya pratyāhāraṃ paraṃ gataḥ | dhārayāmāsa satataṃ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ mahāprabhum || 1 05|| dadhyau kṛṣṇaṃ ramākāntaṃ gopālabālakaṃ hṛdi | samādhau śrīpatiṃ badri sākṣāt prāpātivegavān || 1 06|| māghaśuklaikādaśyāṃ sa prātaḥ snātvā kathāsthalam | bhajannāma raṭan prāpa tasthau vyāsaṃ vyalokayan || 1 07|| pupūja mantrasahito vyāsaṃ ca saṃhitāṃ tathā | śuśrāva ca sabhāsaṃsthaḥ kathānte kīrtanottaram || 1 08|| śīghraṃ samādhimāpannaḥ prāṇāḥ saṃkucitā drutam | papāta deho bhūmau vai śrotṝṇāṃ paśyatāṃ satām || 1 09|| vimānamambarād divyamavātarat samujjvalam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastasmād bahirāgatya taṃ dvijam || 4.51.11 0|| divyarūpaṃ sumuktaṃ ca vidhāya divyavigraham | nītvā vimānake tūrṇaṃ hasan dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau || 111 || āścaryaṃ paramaṃ jātaṃ kathāśravaṇakāriṇām | aho gurughnaviprasya śaraṇyo bhagavān prabhuḥ || 11 2|| śaraṇāgatarakṣākṛt pāpaṃ vidhūya sarvathā | vipraṃ bhaktaṃ nijaṃ dhāma ninye dehiṣu vatsalaḥ || 11 3|| etādṛśī kṛpā tasya ghaṭate paramātmanaḥ | jīvāstu sarvathā pāpāḥ santi vai pāpakāriṇaḥ || 1 14|| kupālurbhagavānasti kṛpālavaśca sādhavaḥ | vinā vinimayaṃ vā ca karamṛṇaṃ vinā khalān || 1 15|| duṣṭān pāpān pāvayitvā preṣayantyakṣaraṃ padam | evaṃ vai badrike kṛṣṇo mokṣaṃ dadāti sevine || 1 16|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccintanādapi | bhuktimuktiḥ śubhaṃ svargaṃ bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ || 1 17|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne suraprasādanāmakaviprasya mātāpitṛsevāvihīnasya vidyāpradaguruhatyāvidhāyino’pi śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāśravaṇena satāṃ sevayā pāpanāśo muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikapañcāśattatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 51 ||
<4.52> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi devadrohikathāṃ tathā | vikramākhye pure tvāsīt kṣatriyo nāgavikramaḥ || 1 || pūrvakarmānurodhena bālye cāstika uttamaḥ | devapūjāṃ sādhusevāṃ karoti bhāvataḥ sadā || 2 || dravyecchayā bhūpatitvecchayā rājyecchayā tathā | yatra yatra bhavantyeva santo vā daivapūruṣāḥ || 3 || tatra tatra sakāmo’yaṃ prayātyāśīrgrahecchayā | yauvane sarvathā kṣātradharmamāśritya yodhane || 4 || tatparo vartate nityaṃ rājyecchayā paraiḥ saha | yatra yatra gataścāyaṃ yodhanārthaṃ jayārthakaḥ || 5 || tatra tatrābhavattasya parābhavo jayo na tu | tataḥ sa devatānāṃ tu mānatā kṛtavān muhuḥ || 6 || tatrāpi niṣphalatvaṃ sa prāptavān vijayaṃ na tu | evaṃ kṛte muhuḥ paścānnāstikyaṃ tvāptavān sa tu || 7 || pūjāyā nindanaṃ devamūrteśca nindanaṃ tathā | khaṇḍanaṃ dharmaśāstrāṇāṃ dharmāṇāṃ khaṇḍanaṃ tathā || 8 || sādhūnāṃ khaṇḍanaṃ cāpi vratānāṃ khaṇḍanaṃ tathā | dānānāṃ khaṇḍanaṃ sarvasatkarmaṇāṃ tu khaṇḍanam || 9 || karoti sarvathā vakti devā mṛṣā hi mūrtayaḥ | santo mṛṣā mānatāśca mṛṣā bhavanti niṣphalāḥ || 4.52.1 0|| parākramaṃ kṛtaṃ satyaṃ daivaṃ daivaṃ tu niṣphalam | parākramaṃ paraṃ daivaṃ puttalaṃ daivameva na || 11 || tasmāt parākramaṃ
